english: Now the Philistines fought against Israel, and the men of Israel fled before them, and many fell slain on Mount Gilboa.
ekegusii: Bono Abafirisiti bakarwania Abaisraeli, na Abaisraeli bagatama korwa ase bare na bagaiterwa ase egetunwa kia Giliboa.
swahili: Basi Wafilisti wakapigana na Israeli. Waisraeli wakawakimbia, na wengi wakauawa katika mlima Gilboa.

english: They put his armor in the temple of their gods and hung his head in the temple of Dagon. Jabesh-gilead’s Tribute to Saul (1 Samuel 31:11–13)
ekegusii: Bakabeeka ebirwanero biaye ime ase Hekalu ye chinyasae chiabo, erio bagasiberania omotwe oye ase Hekalu ya Dagoni.
swahili: Waliweka silaha zake katika hekalu la miungu yao, wakatundika kichwa chake katika hekalu la Dagoni.

english: When the people of Jabesh-gilead heard about everything the Philistines had done to Saul,
ekegusii: Korende ekero abanto bonsi ba Yabeshi o Gileadi baigwete aya onsi Abafirisiti bakorerete Saulo,
swahili: Wakazi wote wa Yabeshi-Gileadi waliposikia yote Wafilisti waliyomtendea Sauli,

english: all their men of valor set out and retrieved the bodies of Saul and his sons and brought them to Jabesh. And they buried their bones under the oak in Jabesh and fasted seven days.
ekegusii: abarwani bonsi chituoni bakagenda bakarusia omobere o Saulo na ey’abamura baye korwa ase yarenge, bakayerenta Yabesi. Erio bagatindeka amauga abo inse y’Omoaluni agwo Yabesi, erio bakeng’ata amatuko atano na abere.
swahili: mashujaa wao wote wakaondoka, wakautwaa mwili wa Sauli na miili ya wanawe, wakaileta Yabeshi. Wakaizika mifupa yao chini ya mti mkubwa huko Yabeshi, nao wakafunga kwa siku saba.

english: So Saul died for his unfaithfulness to the LORD, because he did not keep the word of the LORD and even consulted a medium for guidance,
ekegusii: Naboigo Saulo akwete, ekiagera atarenge omwegenwa. Tarenge omwegenwa ase Omonene na tarendete amang’an’Omonene amochigeete; naende akagenda korigia ogosemigwa korwa ase emeika y’abanto bakuure, ase okoraagwa nero,
swahili: Sauli alikufa kwa sababu hakuwa mwaminifu kwa Bwana. Hakulishika neno la Bwana, hata akataka shauri kwa mwaguzi kwa ajili ya uongozi,

english: and he failed to inquire of the LORD. So the LORD put him to death and turned the kingdom over to David son of Jesse.
ekegusii: na tarigetie okoraagwa korwa ase Omonene. Ase ayio Omonene akamoita, akarusia oborwoti asare, akaboa Daudi, mosinto o Yese.
swahili: hakumuuliza Bwana. Kwa hiyo Bwana alimuua, na ufalme akampa Daudi mwana wa Yese.

english: The Philistines followed hard after Saul and his sons, and they killed Saul’s sons Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malchishua.
ekegusii: Abafirisiti bakabwatia Saulo na abamura baye, bagaita Yonathani, na Abinadabu, na Malikisua, abamura ba Saulo.
swahili: Wafilisti wakawafuatia kwa bidii Sauli na wanawe, wakawaua Yonathani, Abinadabu na Malki-Shua.

english: When the battle intensified against Saul, the archers overtook him and wounded him.
ekegusii: Esegi ekaba entindi mono ase Saulo, na abaruti emegwe bakamoromereria, bakamorasa, bakamoaka chingoma.
swahili: Mapigano yakawa makali kumzunguka Sauli na wakati wapiga mishale walipompata, wakamjeruhi.

english: Then Saul said to his armor-bearer, “Draw your sword and run it through me, or these uncircumcised men will come and torture me!” But his armor-bearer was terrified and refused to do it. So Saul took his own sword and fell on it.
ekegusii: Erio Saulo agateebia omonto oria omobogoreretie ebirwanero, “Simora omoyio oo, ombete nkwe, erinde abanto aba batarogeti tibaabaisa kong’ita na gonchecheria.” Korende omonto oria akaanga, ekiagera nigo abeete nobwoba obonene. Ase ayio Saulo akabwata omoyio oye omonyene akegweria igoro yaye.
swahili: Sauli akamwambia mbeba silaha wake, “Futa upanga wako unichome nao, la sivyo hawa watu wasiotahiriwa watakuja na kunidhalilisha.” Lakini mbeba silaha wake akaogopa sana wala hakuweza kufanya hivyo. Kwa hiyo Sauli akachukua upanga wake mwenyewe na kuuangukia.

english: When his armor-bearer saw that Saul was dead, he too fell on his own sword and died.
ekegusii: Ekero omonto oria omobogoria ebirwanero aroche ng’a Saulo okuure, nere akegweria ase omoyio oye omonyene, agakwa.
swahili: Mbeba silaha wake alipoona kwamba Sauli amekufa, naye pia akauangukia upanga wake akafa.

english: So Saul died together with his three sons and all his house. The Philistines Possess the Towns (1 Samuel 31:7–10)
ekegusii: Naboigo Saulo agakwa, ere na abamura baye batato amo nabaanto baye bonsi.
swahili: Kwa hiyo Sauli na wanawe watatu wakafa, pamoja na nyumba yake yote.

english: When all the Israelites in the valley saw that the army had fled and that Saul and his sons had died, they abandoned their cities and ran away. So the Philistines came and occupied their cities.
ekegusii: Ekero Abaisraeli bonsi abarenge ase ense eria omweremo baroche ng’a abarwani ’esegi babo batamire, na ng’a Saulo na abamura baye bakuure, bagatiga emechie yabo bagatama. Erio Abafirisiti bagacha, bakamenya ase emechie eyio.
swahili: Waisraeli wote waliokuwa bondeni walipoona kwamba jeshi limekimbia na kwamba Sauli na wanawe wamekufa, waliacha miji yao wakakimbia. Nao Wafilisti wakaja na kukaa humo.

english: The next day, when the Philistines came to strip the dead, they found Saul and his sons fallen on Mount Gilboa.
ekegusii: Rituko ria kabere, ekero Abafirisiti bachete konuura ebinto korwa ase emebere y’abanto bakwete, bakanyora Saulo amo nabamura baye bakwete agwo ase egetunwa kia Giliboa.
swahili: Kesho yake Wafilisti walipokuja kuwavua maiti silaha, walimkuta Sauli na wanawe wameanguka katika Mlima Gilboa.

english: They stripped Saul, cut off his head, took his armor, and sent messengers throughout the land of the Philistines to proclaim the news in the temple of their idols and among their people.
ekegusii: Bakamonuura ebinto biaye, bakanacha omotwe oye bakayoira, bakaira nebirwanero biaye, erio bagatoma abanto bararie amang’ana aya amaya ase ense yonsi y’Abafilisti, ase emegwekano yabo y’ogosasimwa na ase abanto.
swahili: Wakamvua mavazi, wakachukua kichwa chake pamoja na silaha zake, wakawatuma wajumbe katika nchi yote ya Wafilisti kutangaza habari hizi miongoni mwa sanamu zao na watu wao.

english: Then all Israel came together to David at Hebron and said, “Here we are, your own flesh and blood.
ekegusii: Erio Abaisraeli bonsi bagasangerereka ase Daudi agwo Heburoni bakamoteebia, “Naama! Intwe nigo tore abamo naye, aba amanyinga ayamo, na omobere oyomo.
swahili: Israeli yote walimjia Daudi kwa pamoja huko Hebroni wakamwambia, “Sisi ni nyama yako na damu yako.

english: Now these were the chiefs of David’s mighty men, who, together with all Israel, bolstered and strengthened his kingdom, according to the word of the LORD concerning Israel.
ekegusii: Aba nabwo abanto abanene chituoni ba Daudi, baria bamosiirete bokong’u ase oborwoti bwaye, amo n’Abaisraeli bonsi bakamobeeka akaba omorwoti, koreng’ana ne ring’ana ri’Omonene igoro y’Abaisraeli.
swahili: Hawa ndio waliokuwa wakuu wa mashujaa wa Daudi: wao pamoja na Israeli wote wakauimarisha ufalme wake ili kuenea katika nchi yote, kama Bwana alivyoahidi.

english: This is the list of David’s mighty men: Jashobeam son of Hachmoni was chief of the officers; he wielded his spear against three hundred men, whom he killed at one time.
ekegusii: Oyo noro omobaro bw’abaanto chituoni ba Daudi: Ritang’ani Yasobeamu korwa Hakimoni. Ere nigo arenge omonene bwa baria batato. Ere akarwania abanto amagana atato ne ritimo riaye akabaita ase engaki eyemo.
swahili: Hii ndio orodha ya mashujaa wa Daudi: Yashobeamu, Mhakmoni, alikuwa mkuu wa maafisa; yeye aliinua mkuki wake dhidi ya watu 300, ambao aliwaua katika pambano moja.

english: Next in command was Eleazar son of Dodo the Ahohite, one of the three mighty men.
ekegusii: Na oyo o kabere bw’abwo batato n’Eleazari, mosinto o Dodo, Omoahohi.
swahili: Aliyefuata alikuwa Eleazari, mwana wa Dodai, Mwahohi, mmojawapo wa wale mashujaa watatu.

english: He was with David at Pas-dammim when the Philistines gathered there for battle. At the place with a field full of barley, the troops fled from the Philistines.
ekegusii: Ere nigo arenge amo na Daudi agwo Pasi‐Damimu ekero Abafirisiti basangererekanete amo, barwane esegi aase omogondo bw’esairi orenge. Ekero abanto batamete korwa ase Abafirisiti,
swahili: Huyo alikuwa pamoja na Daudi huko Pas-Damimu, wakati Wafilisti walikusanyika huko kwa ajili ya vita. Huko ambapo kulikuwa na shamba lililokuwa limejaa shayiri, vikosi vya Israeli vikawakimbia Wafilisti.

english: But Eleazar and David stationed themselves in the middle of the field and defended it. They struck down the Philistines, and the LORD brought about a great victory.
ekegusii: Eleazari agatenena gati gati y’omogondo oria, akaba omokong’u akayoegera, agaaka Abafirisiti, akabaita. Omonene akabaa obobui obonene.
swahili: Lakini Eleazari na Daudi wakasimama imara katikati ya lile shamba, nao wakalishindania na wakawaua Wafilisti. Naye Bwana akawapa ushindi mkubwa.

english: Three of the thirty chief men went down to David, to the rock at the cave of Adullam, while a company of Philistines was encamped in the Valley of Rephaim.
ekegusii: Rituko erimo abanto batato ba baria abanene emerongo etato bagatirimboka gochia ase egetare, bakagenda ase Daudi agwo ase rikuruma ri’Adulamu, ekero abasikari b’Abafilisti batoorete ase ense omweya y’Abarefai.
swahili: Wakuu watatu miongoni mwa wale thelathini, walimwendea Daudi katika mwamba huko kwenye pango la Adulamu, wakati kikundi cha Wafilisti kilikuwa kimepiga kambi katika Bonde la Warefai.

english: At that time David was in the stronghold, and the garrison of the Philistines was at Bethlehem.
ekegusii: Ase engaki eria Daudi nigo arenge ime ase eburi, na abasikari b’Abafilisti nigo barenge Bethlehemu.
swahili: Wakati huo Daudi alikuwa katika ngome, na kambi ya Wafilisti ilikuwa huko Bethlehemu.

english: David longed for water and said, “Oh, that someone would get me a drink of water from the well near the gate of Bethlehem!”
ekegusii: Daudi akabora ase okogania okonene, “Ntare konyora omonto andetere amaache inywe korwa ase ensoko eyio ere ase egeita kia Bethlehemu?”
swahili: Daudi akatamani maji, akasema, “Laiti mtu angenipatia maji ya kunywa kutoka kisima kilichoko karibu na lango la Bethlehemu!”

english: So the Three broke through the Philistine camp, drew water from the well at the gate of Bethlehem, and brought it back to David. But he refused to drink it; instead, he poured it out to the LORD,
ekegusii: Erio abanto baria batato bakabinya‐binyia egati y’Abafilisti aase batoorete, bakabuucha amaache korwa ase ensoko eria yarenge ase egeita kia Bethlehemu, bakayairera Daudi. Korende Daudi tayanywa otatiga ayaumorete akaba okoruegwa gw’ekenyugwa ase Omonene,
swahili: Kwa hivyo wale watatu, wakapita katikati ya safu za Wafilisti, wakachota maji kutoka kwa kisima kilicho karibu na lango la Bethlehemu, wakamletea Daudi. Lakini yeye akakataa kuyanywa. Badala yake, aliyamimina mbele za Bwana.

english: saying, “Far be it from me, my God, to do this! How can I drink the blood of these men who risked their lives?” Because they had brought it at the risk of their lives, David refused to drink it. Such were the exploits of the three mighty men.
ekegusii: akabora, “Omonene ontange tiyanywa. Aya nigo anga buna nkonywa amanyinga ’abaanto bataegerete obogima bwabo ase okorenta amaache aya.” Ase ayio akaanga tayanywa. Ayio naro abanto abwo chituoni batato bakorete.
swahili: Akasema, “Mungu apishie mbali kwamba nifanye hivi! Je kweli, niinywe damu ya watu hawa waliohatarisha maisha yao?” Kwa sababu walihatarisha maisha yao kuyaleta yale maji, Daudi hakukubali kuyanywa. Huo ndio uliokuwa ujasiri wa wale mashujaa watatu.

english: Even in times past, while Saul was king, you were the one who led Israel out and brought them back. And the LORD your God said, ‘You will shepherd My people Israel, and you will be ruler over them.’”
ekegusii: Ase engaki yaetire, nonya nekero Saulo arenge omorwoti, naye kwarenge gotang’ana Abaisraeli kobaare korwana esegi naende kobakoirana. Na Omonene, Nyasae oo, akagoteebia ng’a naye orabe omorisia bw’Abaisraeli, abanto baye, na koba omogambi igoro yabo.”
swahili: Zamani, wakati Sauli alikuwa mfalme, wewe ndiwe uliyeiongoza Israeli vitani, naye Bwana Mungu wako alikuambia, ‘Wewe utawachunga watu wangu Israeli, na utakuwa mtawala wao.’ ”

english: Now Abishai, the brother of Joab, was chief of the Three, and he lifted his spear against three hundred men, killed them, and won a name along with the Three.
ekegusii: Abisai, momura omwabo Yoabu, nigo amanyekanete ase baria batato; akarwania abanto amagana atato akabaaka ne ritimo riaye, akabaita, na igo akaba nerieta rinene ase egati ya baria batato.
swahili: Abishai, ndugu yake Yoabu ndiye alikuwa kiongozi wa hao Watatu. Aliinua mkuki wake dhidi ya watu 300, ambao aliwaua, kwa hiyo naye akawa na sifa kama hao Watatu.

english: He was doubly honored above the Three, and he became their commander, even though he was not included among the Three.
ekegusii: Ase baria batato ere nigo abwate ogosikwa okuya goetania abande, akaba omoraai obo, korende tareng’anetie na baria batato b’eritang’ani.
swahili: Alitunukiwa heshima maradufu ya wale Watatu, akawa jemadari wao, ingawa hakuhesabiwa miongoni mwao.

english: And Benaiah son of Jehoiada was a man of valor from Kabzeel, a man of many exploits. He struck down two champions of Moab, and on a snowy day he went down into a pit and killed a lion.
ekegusii: Benaya, mosinto o Yehoyada, nigo arenge omonto etuoni korwa ase Kabuseli. Ere agakora emeremo emenene, agaita abanto babere chituoni b’Abamoabu. Engaki ende, ekero ki’obokendu na amagena ’embura yatwete, agasoa engoro agaita endo aroro.
swahili: Benaya, mwana wa Yehoyada alikuwa mpiganaji hodari kutoka Kabseeli ambaye alifanya mambo makubwa ya ujasiri. Aliwaua mashujaa wawili waliokuwa hodari kuliko wote wa Moabu. Pia alishuka shimoni kulipokuwa na theluji na kumuua simba.

english: He also killed an Egyptian, a huge man five cubits tall. Although the Egyptian had a spear like a weaver’s beam in his hand, Benaiah went against him with a club, snatched the spear from his hand, and killed the Egyptian with his own spear.
ekegusii: Naende agaita Omomisiri, omonto orenge nobotambe bw’ekerengo gie chimita ibere. Omomisiri oria nigo abwate ritimo koboko kwaye, riachomeire orotanga oronene buna omwaro, korende Benaya akamochiera nenyimbo, akamoura ritimo riarenge koboko kwaye, akamoitera ne ritimo riria riaye omonyene.
swahili: Alimuua Mmisri aliyekuwa na urefu kama dhiraa tano. Ingawa Mmisri alikuwa na mkuki kama mti wa mfumaji mkononi mwake, Benaya alimwendea na rungu. Akamnyangʼanya Mmisri mkuki wake na kumuua nao.

english: These were the exploits of Benaiah son of Jehoiada, who won a name alongside the three mighty men.
ekegusii: Amang’ana aya naro Benaya, mosinto o Yehoyada, akorete. Nigo anyorete erieta rinene ase egati ya baria batato.
swahili: Haya yalikuwa mambo ya ushujaa ya Benaya mwana wa Yehoyada; naye pia alikuwa maarufu kama wale mashujaa watatu.

english: He was most honored among the Thirty, but he did not become one of the Three. And David appointed him over his guard.
ekegusii: Nonya osikire kobua baria Emerongo etato, tareng’anirie na baria batato. Daudi akamobeka akaba omoteneneri bw’abarendi b’obogima bwaye.
swahili: Yeye aliheshimiwa zaidi ya wale Thelathini, lakini hakujumuishwa miongoni mwa wale Watatu: Daudi akamweka kuwa kiongozi wa walinzi wake.

english: Now these were the mighty men: Asahel the brother of Joab, Elhanan son of Dodo of Bethlehem,
ekegusii: Abanto chituoni b’abasikari nabwo aba: Asaeli momura omwabo Yoabu, na Elihanani, mosinto o Dodo korwa Bethlehemu.
swahili: Wale watu mashujaa walikuwa: Asaheli nduguye Yoabu, Elhanani mwana wa Dodo kutoka Bethlehemu,

english: Shammoth the Harorite, Helez the Pelonite,
ekegusii: Samoti korwa Harodi na Helesi korwa Peleti;
swahili: Shamothi Mharori, Helesi Mpeloni,

english: Ira son of Ikkesh the Tekoite, Abiezer the Anathothite,
ekegusii: Ira, mosinto o Ikesi korwa Tekoa, na Abieseri korwa Anatoti;
swahili: Ira mwana wa Ikeshi kutoka Tekoa, Abiezeri kutoka Anathothi,

english: Sibbecai the Hushathite, Ilai the Ahohite,
ekegusii: Sibekai korwa Husa, na Ilai korwa Ahohi;
swahili: Sibekai Mhushathi, Ilai Mwahohi,

english: So all the elders of Israel came to the king at Hebron, where David made a covenant with them before the LORD. And they anointed him king over Israel, according to the word of the LORD through Samuel. David Conquers Jerusalem (2 Samuel 5:6–11)
ekegusii: Nabo abagaaka bonsi b’Abaisraeli bagacha ase omorwoti agwo Heburoni; na aroro Daudi agakora okobwatana kw’ogotianania nabarabwo ase obosio bw’Omonene, na barabwo bagaaka Daudi amaguta akaba omorwoti igoro ase Abaisraeli, koreng’ana ne ring’ana riri’Omonene akwanete goetera ase Samweli.
swahili: Wazee wote wa Israeli walipokuwa wamewasili kwa Mfalme Daudi huko Hebroni, alifanya mapatano nao huko Hebroni mbele za Bwana, nao wakamtia Daudi mafuta awe mfalme wa Israeli, sawasawa na Bwana alivyoahidi kupitia kwa Samweli. Daudi Ateka Yerusalemu

english: Maharai the Netophathite, Heled son of Baanah the Netophathite,
ekegusii: Maharai korwa Netofa, na Heledi, mosinto o Baana korwa Netofa;
swahili: Maharai Mnetofathi, Heledi mwana wa Baana, Mnetofathi,

english: Ithai son of Ribai from Gibeah of the Benjamites, Benaiah the Pirathonite,
ekegusii: Itai, mosinto o Ribai korwa Gibea o Benjamini, na Benaya korwa Piratoni;
swahili: Itai mwana wa Ribai kutoka Gibea ya Benyamini, Benaya Mpirathoni,

english: Hurai from the brooks of Gaash, Abiel the Arbathite,
ekegusii: Hurai korwa ase amakura ang’e na Gaasi, na Abieli korwa Ariba;
swahili: Hurai kutoka mabonde ya Gaashi, Abieli Mwaribathi,

english: Azmaveth the Baharumite, Eliahba the Shaalbonite,
ekegusii: Asimaweti korwa Gahurimu na Eliaba korwa Saalaboni;
swahili: Azmawethi Mbaharumi, Eliaba Mshaalboni,

english: the sons of Hashem the Gizonite, Jonathan son of Shagee the Hararite,
ekegusii: basinto ba Hasemu korwa Gisoni na Yonathani, mosinto o Sagee, korwa Harari;
swahili: wana wa Hashemu Mgiloni, Yonathani mwana wa Shagee Mharari,

english: Ahiam son of Sachar the Hararite, Eliphal son of Ur,
ekegusii: Ahiamu, mosinto o Sakari korwa Harari, na Elifali, mosinto o Uri;
swahili: Ahiamu mwana wa Sakari Mharari, Elifale mwana wa Uru,

english: Hepher the Mecherathite, Ahijah the Pelonite,
ekegusii: Heferi korwa Mekera na Ahiya korwa Peloni
swahili: Heferi Mmekerathi, Ahiya Mpeloni,

english: Hezro the Carmelite, Naarai son of Ezbai,
ekegusii: Hesero korwa Karimeli, na Naara, mosinto bw’Esibai;
swahili: Hezro Mkarmeli, Naarai mwana wa Ezbai,

english: Joel the brother of Nathan, Mibhar son of Hagri,
ekegusii: Yoel, momura omwabo Nathani, na Mibihari, mosinto o Hagiri.
swahili: Yoeli nduguye Nathani, Mibhari mwana wa Hagri,

english: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Beerothite, the armor-bearer of Joab son of Zeruiah,
ekegusii: Seleki korwa Amoni na Naharai korwa Beroti, omobogoria ebirwanero bia Yoabu, omomura bw’omokuungu Seruya;
swahili: Seleki Mwamoni, Naharai Mbeerothi, mbeba silaha wa Yoabu mwana wa Seruya,

english: Then David and all the Israelites marched to Jerusalem (that is, Jebus), where the Jebusites inhabited the land.
ekegusii: Daudi amo n’Abaisraeli bonsi bakagenda Yerusalemu, noro Yebusi, ase Abayebusi, abanto b’ense eria, barenge.
swahili: Daudi na Waisraeli wote wakaenda Yerusalemu (ndio Yebusi). Nao Wayebusi walioishi humo

english: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,
ekegusii: Ira na Garebu korwa Itiri;
swahili: Ira Mwithiri, Garebu Mwithiri,

english: Uriah the Hittite, Zabad son of Ahlai,
ekegusii: Uria Omohiti na Sabadi, mosinto bw’Alai,
swahili: Uria Mhiti, Zabadi mwana wa Alai,

english: Adina son of Shiza the Reubenite, chief of the Reubenites, and the thirty with him,
ekegusii: Adina, mosinto o Sisa bw’egesaku kia Rubeni, omoraai bw’abaanto b’egesaku ekio, na amo nere abanto emerongo etato;
swahili: Adina mwana wa Shiza Mreubeni, ambaye alikuwa mkuu wa Wareubeni, akiwa pamoja na watu thelathini,

english: Hanan son of Maacah, Joshaphat the Mithnite,
ekegusii: Hanani, mosinto o Maaka na Yosafati korwa Mitani;
swahili: Hanani mwana wa Maaka, Yoshafati Mmithni,

english: Uzzia the Ashterathite, Shama and Jeiel the sons of Hotham the Aroerite,
ekegusii: Usia korwa Asitera; Sama na Yeieli, basinto ba Hotamu korwa Aroeri;
swahili: Uzia Mwashterathi, Shama na Yeieli wana wa Hothamu Mwaroeri,

english: Jediael son of Shimri and his brother Joha the Tizite,
ekegusii: Yediaeli, mosinto o Simuri, na Yoha, momura omwabo, omonto o Tisi;
swahili: Yediaeli mwana wa Shimri, nduguye Yoha Mtizi,

english: Eliel the Mahavite, Jeribai and Joshaviah, the sons of Elnaam, Ithmah the Moabite,
ekegusii: Elieli korwa Mahawa Yeribai na Yosawia, basinto b’Elinamu, na Itima korwa Moabu;
swahili: Elieli Mmahawi, Yeribai na Yoshavia wana wa Elnaamu, Ithma Mmoabu,

english: Eliel, Obed, and Jaasiel the Mezobaite.
ekegusii: Elieli, na Obedi, na Yaasieli korwa Soba.
swahili: Elieli, na Obedi na Yaasieli Mmesobai.

english: The people of Jebus said to David, “You will never get in here.” Nevertheless, David captured the fortress of Zion (that is, the City of David).
ekegusii: Abanto ba Yebusi bakamoteebia, “Aye tokonyara gocha aiga nonya ng’ake.” Korende nonya naboigo, Daudi akabua eburi ya Sayoni, oyio noro Omochie o Daudi.
swahili: wakamwambia Daudi, “Wewe hutaingia humu.” Hata hivyo, Daudi akaiteka ngome ya Sayuni, Mji wa Daudi.

english: Now David had said, “Whoever is the first to strike down a Jebusite will become chief commander.” And Joab son of Zeruiah went up first, and he became the chief.
ekegusii: Daudi konya oteebire, ng’a “Monto onde bwensi orabe oyo bw’eritang’ani goita abanto ba Yebusi, ere oyio nabe omochiki omonene bw’abarwani.” Yoabu, omomura bw’omokuungu Seruya, akaba oyo bw’eritang’ani kogenda aroro; ase ayio ere akaba omochiki.
swahili: Daudi alikuwa amesema, “Yeyote aongozaye mashambulizi dhidi ya Wayebusi, atakuwa jemadari mkuu.” Yoabu mwana wa Seruya akawa wa kwanza kukwea, naye akawa mkuu.

english: So David took up residence in the fortress; that is why it was called the City of David.
ekegusii: Daudi akaba okomenya ase eburi eria enkong’u, ase ayio ekarokwa Omochie o Daudi.
swahili: Daudi akafanya makao yake kwenye ngome, hivyo ukaitwa Mji wa Daudi.

english: He built up the city around it, from the supporting terraces to the surrounding wall, while Joab restored the rest of the city.
ekegusii: Erio akaagacha omochie goetanana onsi korwa Milo, okaba egesingo kegima; na Yoabu akaroisia omochie ase konya otagokire.
swahili: Akajenga mji pande zote, kuanzia kwenye mito hadi kwenye ukuta kuzunguka, wakati huo huo Yoabu akajenga sehemu zingine zilizobaki za Yerusalemu.

english: And David became greater and greater, for the LORD of Hosts was with him. David’s Mighty Men (2 Samuel 23:8–39)
ekegusii: Daudi akamenta koba omonene, na koba nokobua, ekiagera Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo arenge amo nere. Abarwani chituoni ba Daudi (2 Sam 23:8-9)
swahili: Daudi akazidi kuwa na nguvu zaidi na zaidi, kwa sababu Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote alikuwa pamoja naye. Mashujaa Wa Daudi (2 Samweli 23:8-39)

english: Now these were the men who came to David at Ziklag, while he was still banished from the presence of Saul son of Kish (they were among the mighty men who helped him in battle;
ekegusii: Daudi nigo amenyete Sikilagi, ekero arenge kwebisa korwa ase Saulo, mosinto o Kisi. Abanto chituoni abarenge komokonya ase esegi bagacha asare.
swahili: Hawa ndio watu waliomjia Daudi huko Siklagi, wakati alikuwa amefukuzwa mbele ya Sauli mwana wa Kishi (walikuwa miongoni mwa mashujaa waliomsaidia Daudi vitani,

english: Mishmannah the fourth, Jeremiah the fifth,
ekegusii: na Misimana oyo o kane, na Yeremia oyo o gatano,
swahili: Mishmana wa nne, Yeremia wa tano,

english: Attai the sixth, Eliel the seventh,
ekegusii: na Atai oyo o gatano na rimo, na Elieli oyo o gatano na kabere,
swahili: Atai wa sita, Elieli wa saba,

english: Johanan the eighth, Elzabad the ninth,
ekegusii: na Yohanani oyo o gatano na gatato, na Elisabadi oyo o kianda,
swahili: Yohanani wa nane, Elzabadi wa tisa,

english: Jeremiah the tenth, and Machbanai the eleventh.
ekegusii: na Yeremia oyo o ikomi, na Makibani oyo o ikomi na rimo.
swahili: Yeremia wa kumi, na Makbanai wa kumi na moja.

english: These Gadites were army commanders, the least of whom was a match for a hundred, and the greatest for a thousand.
ekegusii: Abagadi aba nigo barenge abatang’ani b’abasikari, na oyo otarenge ne chinguru nigo are konyara kobua abanto rigana erimo (100), na oyorenge ne chinguru nigo are konyara kobua abanto elifu eyemo (1,000).
swahili: Hawa Wagadi walikuwa majemadari. Aliyekuwa wa mwisho kuliko wote aliweza kuongoza askari 100, na aliyekuwa na uweza zaidi ya wote aliongoza 1,000.

english: These are the ones who crossed the Jordan in the first month when it was overflowing all its banks, and they put to flight all those in the valleys, both to the east and to the west.
ekegusii: Aba nabwo abanto bambogete Yorodani ase omotienyi bw’eritang’ani, ekero orooche orwo rwaichorete goetania chingegu chinsemo chionsi, bagaseria abanto bonsi bamenyete ase ense y’amaranya, ensemo ya moocha na eya bosongo. Abatunyani ba Daudi korwa ase egesaku kia Benjamini na ekia Yuda
swahili: Wao ndio walivuka Mto Yordani katika mwezi wa kwanza ukiwa umefurika hadi kwenye kingo zake zote na kusababisha watu wote waliokuwa wanaishi kwenye mabonde kukimbilia mashariki na wengine magharibi.

english: Other Benjamites and some men from Judah also came to David in his stronghold.
ekegusii: Abanto bande b’egesaku kia Benjamini, na ekia Yuda, bagacha ase eburi agwo ase Daudi arenge.
swahili: Wabenyamini wengine na baadhi ya watu kutoka Yuda pia walikuja kwa Daudi katika ngome yake.

english: And David went out to meet them, saying, “If you have come to me in peace to help me, my heart will be united with you; but if you have come to betray me to my enemies when my hands are free of violence, may the God of our fathers see it and judge you.”
ekegusii: Daudi agasoka kobarotota akabateebia, “Onye igo mwachire buna abasani baane monkonye, rirorio enkoro yane nebwatane nainwe, korende onye nigo mwachire monsigane na kondua ase ababisa baane, nonya amaboko aane takorete okomocha konde gwonsi, rirorio Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiaito arore amang’ana ayio abae egesusuro.”
swahili: Daudi akatoka nje kuwalaki na akawaambia, “Kama mmekuja kwangu kwa amani, kunisaidia, mimi niko tayari kuwaruhusu ninyi kuungana nami. Lakini kama mmekuja ili kunisaliti kwa adui zangu wakati mimi mikono yangu haina hatia, basi Mungu wa baba zetu aone na awahukumu.”

english: Then the Spirit came upon Amasai, the chief of the Thirty, and he said: “We are yours, O David! We are with you, O son of Jesse! Peace, peace to you, and peace to your helpers, for your God helps you.” So David received them and made them leaders of his troops.
ekegusii: Erio omoika ogaacha igoro ase Amasai, omonene bw’abaanto baria Emerongo etato, nere agateeba, “Aye Daudi, intwe nigo tore abanto bao; na nigo tokobwatana amo naye, aye omwana o Yese. Omorembe obe asore, na omorembe obe ase abakogokonya, ekiagera Nyasae oo, nere okogokonya.” Erio Daudi akabanchera, akababeeka bakaba abatang’ani b’emeganda yaye y’esegi. Abatunyani ba Daudi korwa ase egesaku kia Manase
swahili: Kisha Roho akaja juu ya Amasai, mkuu wa wale Thelathini, naye akasema: “Sisi tu watu wako, ee Daudi! Nasi tuko pamoja na wewe, ee mwana wa Yese! Ushindi, naam, ushindi uwe kwako, pia ushindi kwa wale walio upande wako, kwa kuwa Mungu wako atakusaidia.” Kwa hiyo Daudi akawapokea na kuwafanya viongozi wa vikosi vyake vya uvamizi.

english: Some from Manasseh defected to David when he went with the Philistines to fight against Saul. (They did not help the Philistines because the Philistine rulers consulted and sent David away, saying, “It will cost us our heads if he defects to his master Saul.”)
ekegusii: Abanto bande b’egesaku kia Manase bagatama, bakagenda ase Daudi ekero arenge kogenda amo n’Abafilisti korwania Saulo. Korende Abafirisiti tibaete Daudi ribaga abakoonye, ekiagera ekero abagaambi babo bagambete amo, bagateeba, Aise kogenda amo naintwe, ande nigo arabwatane amo na Saulo, omonene oye, igo batobutore emetwe.
swahili: Baadhi ya watu kutoka kabila la Manase wakajiunga na Daudi wakati alikwenda pamoja na Wafilisti, kupigana na Sauli. (Daudi na watu wake hawakuwasaidia Wafilisti kwa sababu, baada ya ushauri, watawala wao walimrudisha. Wakasema, “Itatugharimu vichwa vyetu kama Daudi atatuasi na kurudi kwa Sauli bwana wake.”)

english: they were archers using both the right and left hands to sling stones and shoot arrows; and they were Saul’s kinsmen from Benjamin):
ekegusii: Abanto abwo nigo babwate amata, na nigo bamanyete koruta emegwe na amagena e chinduruche nokoboko gw’okorio amo nogw’okobee. Aba nigo barenge Ababenjamini, abanto bamwabo Saulo. Abanto aba nabwo aba:
swahili: walikuwa na pinde na walikuwa na uwezo wa kupiga mishale au kutupa mawe kwa kombeo wakitumia mkono wa kushoto au wa kulia; hawa walikuwa ndugu zake Sauli kutoka kabila la Benyamini):

english: When David went to Ziklag, these men of Manasseh defected to him: Adnah, Jozabad, Jediael, Michael, Jozabad, Elihu, and Zillethai, chiefs of thousands in Manasseh.
ekegusii: Ekero Daudi agendete Sikilagi, abanto aba b’egesaku kia Manase bagacha asare: Adina na Yosabadi, Yediaeli na Mikaeli, Yosabadi na Elihu, na Siletai. Aba nabwo barenge abateneneri b’abaanto chilifu ba Manase.
swahili: Daudi alipokwenda Siklagi, hawa ndio watu wa kabila la Manase waliojiunga naye: Adna, Yozabadi, Yediaeli, Mikaeli, Yozabadi, Elihu na Silethai, viongozi wa vikosi vya watu 1,000 katika kabila la Manase.

english: They helped David against the raiders, for they were all mighty men of valor and commanders in the army.
ekegusii: Barabwo bakaba bagokonya Daudi korwania ebiombe bi’abasakori. Abwo bonsi nigo barenge abanto chituoni, bakaba abatang’ani b’abasikari.
swahili: Walimsaidia Daudi dhidi ya makundi ya uvamizi, kwa kuwa wote walikuwa mashujaa hodari na walikuwa majemadari katika jeshi lake.

english: For at that time men came to David day after day to help him, until he had a great army, like the army of God. David’s Army Grows at Hebron
ekegusii: Rituko ase rituko abanto bakagenderera gocha ase Daudi komokonya, goika agatwara abarwani abange mono, buna abasikari ba Nyasae. Omobaro bw’abarwani ba Daudi
swahili: Siku baada ya siku watu walikuja kumsaidia Daudi, mpaka akawa na jeshi kubwa, kama jeshi la Mungu. Wengine Waungana Na Daudi Huko Hebroni

english: Now these are the numbers of men armed for battle who came to David at Hebron to turn Saul’s kingdom over to him, in accordance with the word of the LORD:
ekegusii: Oyo noro omobaro bw’emeganda y’abasikari, baria bachete ase Daudi agwo Heburoni, buna Omonene achigete, erinde bamoe oborwoti boria bwarusetigwe ase Saulo.
swahili: Hawa ndio watu waliojiandaa kwa ajili ya vita waliokuja kwa Daudi huko Hebroni ili kumtwalia ufalme kutoka kwa Sauli, kama Bwana alivyokuwa amesema:

english: From Judah: 6,800 armed troops bearing shields and spears.
ekegusii: Abayuda ababogoretie chinguba na amatimo nigo barenge chilifu isano nemo, na amagana atano na atato (6,800), baisanerete ase okorwana esegi.
swahili: watu wa Yuda, wanaochukua ngao na mikuki walikuwa 6,800 wote wakiwa tayari kwa vita.

english: From Simeon: 7,100 mighty men of valor, ready for battle.
ekegusii: Abasimeoni nigo barenge chilifu isano na ibere, ne rigana erimo (7,100), abanto chituoni abakong’u ase esegi.
swahili: Watu wa Simeoni, mashujaa waliokuwa tayari kwa vita walikuwa 7,100.

english: including Jehoiada, leader of the house of Aaron, with 3,700 men,
ekegusii: amo na Yehoyada, omoteneneri bw’eamate ya Aroni, na amo nere abanto chilifu isato, na amagana atano na abere (3,700);
swahili: pamoja na Yehoyada, kiongozi wa jamaa ya Aroni, aliyekuwa pamoja na watu 3,700,

english: and Zadok, a mighty young man of valor, with 22 commanders from his own family.
ekegusii: na Zadoki, omomura etuoni, amo nabaanto bamwabo abatang’ani b’esegi emerongo ebere, na babere (22).
swahili: na Sadoki, kijana shujaa na hodari, aliyekuwa pamoja na maafisa ishirini na wawili kutoka jamaa yake.

english: From Benjamin, the kinsmen of Saul: 3,000, most of whom had remained loyal to the house of Saul up to that time.
ekegusii: Ababenjamini, abanto b’eamate ya Saulo, nigo barenge chilifu isato (3,000), nonya nase ekero ekio abange mono kobua b’abwo bagendererete kobwatana nenyomba ya Saulo.
swahili: Watu wa Benyamini, ndugu zake Sauli, walikuwa 3,000; wengi wao walikuwa wameendelea kuwa waaminifu kwa Sauli mpaka wakati huo.

english: Ahiezer their chief and Joash, who were the sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite; Jeziel and Pelet, the sons of Azmaveth; Beracah; Jehu the Anathothite;
ekegusii: Ahieseri orenge omonene obo, naende Yoashi; aba babere mbasinto ba Semaa korwa Gibea; Yesieli na Peleti basinto b’Asimaweti; Beraka na Yehu korwa Anatoti;
swahili: Mkuu wao alikuwa Ahiezeri, na wa pili Yoashi, wote wana wa Shemaa Mgibeathi; pia Yezieli na Peleti wana wa Azmawethi; Beraka, Yehu Mwanathothi,

english: From Ephraim: 20,800 mighty men of valor, famous among their own clans.
ekegusii: Korwa ase Abaefraimu: chilifu emerongo ebere, na amagana atano na atato (20,800), abanto chituoni ase esegi bamanyekanete ase chiamate chiabo.
swahili: Watu wa Efraimu, mashujaa hodari 20,800, watu waliokuwa maarufu katika koo zao.

english: From the half-tribe of Manasseh: 18,000 designated by name to come and make David king.
ekegusii: Abanto b’egesaku ekeng’ese kia Manase: chilifu ikomi na isano na isato (18,000), baria batoretwe amarieta abo bache kobeeka Daudi abe omorwoti.
swahili: Watu wa nusu ya kabila la Manase, waliotajwa kwa majina ili waje kumweka Daudi kuwa mfalme, watu 18,000.

english: From Issachar, men who understood the times and knew what Israel should do: 200 chiefs with all their kinsmen at their command.
ekegusii: Korwa ase Abaisakaru: abanto abang’aini abamanyi ebimanyererio bie chingaki, bamanyete egento Abaisraeli bagwenerete gokora, abateneneri amagana abere (200), amo nabamwabo abarenge inse ase obochiki bwabo.
swahili: Watu wa Isakari, waliofahamu majira na kujua kile ambacho Israeli inapasa kufanya, walikuwa viongozi 200, pamoja na jamaa zao wote chini ya uongozi wao.

english: From Zebulun: 50,000 fit for service, trained for battle with all kinds of weapons of war, who with one purpose were devoted to David.
ekegusii: Korwa ase Abasabuloni: abarwani abakong’u baare nomoyo oyomo, baisanerete ase okorwana esegi, babwate ebirwanero biisaine, abanto chilifu emerongo etano (50,000).
swahili: Watu wa Zabuloni, askari wenye uzoefu mkubwa walioandaliwa tayari kwa vita wakiwa na silaha za kila aina, ili kumsaidia Daudi kwa uaminifu thabiti, walikuwa 50,000.

english: From Naphtali: 1,000 commanders, accompanied by 37,000 men with shield and spear.
ekegusii: Korwa Abanafutali: abachiki elifu eyemo (1,000), amo nabaanto chilifu emerongo etato na isano na ibere (37,000), babwate chinguba na amatimo.
swahili: Watu wa Naftali, maafisa 1,000, pamoja na watu 37,000 waliochukua ngao na mikuki.

english: From Asher: 40,000 fit for service, prepared for battle.
ekegusii: Korwa ase Abaaseri: abanto abakong’u baisanerete ase okorwana esegi, chilifu emerongo ene (40,000).
swahili: Watu wa Asheri, askari 40,000 wenye uzoefu mkubwa waliondaliwa kwa ajili ya vita.

english: And from east of the Jordan, from Reuben, Gad, and the half-tribe of Manasseh there: 120,000 armed with every kind of weapon of war.
ekegusii: Korwa ase Abareubeni na Abagadi, na ekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase, abwo bamenyete ng’umbu ya Yorodani, abanto babwate ebirwanero bionsi bi’okorwana esegi, chilifu rigana erimo na emerongo ebere (120,000).
swahili: Na pia watu kutoka mashariki ya Yordani, watu wa Reubeni, Gadi na nusu ya kabila la Manase, wakiwa na kila aina ya silaha, watu 120,000.

english: All these men of war, arrayed for battle, came to Hebron fully determined to make David king over all Israel. And all the rest of the Israelites were of one mind to make David king.
ekegusii: Abarwani aba bonsi baisanerete ase okorwana esegi, na bagacha agwo Heburoni, bare nomoyo oyomo kobeeka Daudi koba omorwoti igoro y’Abaisraeli bonsi. Boigo Abaisraeli bande bonsi nigo barenge nebirengererio ebimo bi’okobeeka Daudi abe omorwoti.
swahili: Wote hawa walikuwa watu wapiganaji waliojitolea kutumika katika safu zao. Walikuja Hebroni wakiwa wameamua kikamilifu kumfanya Daudi mfalme juu ya Israeli yote. Waisraeli wengine wote walikuwa pia na nia hiyo moja ya kumfanya Daudi kuwa mfalme.

english: They spent three days there eating and drinking with David, for their relatives had provided for them.
ekegusii: Abanto abwo bakabeera aroro amo na Daudi ase amatuko atato, bakaba bakoria na konywa, ekiagera abamwabo konya baabaariganeirie ebinto bionsi.
swahili: Watu hawa wakakaa huko na Daudi siku tatu, wakila na kunywa, kwa sababu jamaa zao zilikuwa zimewapatia mahitaji yao.

english: Ishmaiah the Gibeonite, a mighty man among the Thirty and a leader over the Thirty; Jeremiah, Jahaziel, Johanan, and Jozabad the Gederathite;
ekegusii: Isimaya korwa Gibeoni, omonto etuoni naende omoraai ase egati y’abanto baria Emerongo etato; Yeremia na Yehasieli, Yohanani na Yosabadi korwa Gedera;
swahili: na Ishmaya Mgibeoni, shujaa miongoni mwa wale Thelathini, ambaye alikuwa kiongozi wa wale Thelathini; Yeremia, Yahazieli, Yohanani, Yozabadi, Mgederathi,

english: And their neighbors from as far away as Issachar, Zebulun, and Naphtali came bringing food on donkeys, camels, mules, and oxen—abundant supplies of flour, fig cakes and raisin cakes, wine and oil, oxen and sheep. Indeed, there was joy in Israel.
ekegusii: Abaamate bamwabo abamenyete ang’e amo nabwo bamenyete ase chingongo chia Isakaru na Sabuloni, na Nafutali, abwo bakarenta chindagera babogoretie ne chitigere ne chingamia, ne chibarasi, ne chiombe; bakarenta chindagera chinyinge mono; obosie, na amabomba ’amako amomo na ay’amasabibu amomo, na edivai, na amaguta ’amazeituni, ne chiombe, ne ching’ondi, ekiagera Abaisraeli nigo barenge nomogooko omonene.
swahili: Pia, majirani zao hata wale walio mbali hadi Isakari, Zabuloni na Naftali, walikuja wakiwaletea vyakula walivyovibeba kwa punda, ngamia, nyumbu na maksai. Kulikuwepo na wingi wa unga, maandazi ya tini, maandazi ya zabibu kavu, divai, mafuta, ngʼombe na kondoo, kwa maana kulikuwa na furaha katika Israeli.

english: Eluzai, Jerimoth, Bealiah, Shemariah, and Shephatiah the Haruphite;
ekegusii: Elusai na Yerimoti, Bealia na Semaria, na Sefatia korwa Harufi;
swahili: Eluzai, Yeremothi, Bealia, Shemaria, Shefatia, Mharufi;

english: Elkanah, Isshiah, Azarel, Joezer, and Jashobeam, who were Korahites;
ekegusii: Elikana na Isia, Asareli na Yoeseri, na Yasobeamu, abarenge Abakora;
swahili: Elikana, Ishia, Azareli, Yoezeri na Yashobeamu, wana wa Kora;

english: and Joelah and Zebadiah, the sons of Jeroham from Gedor.
ekegusii: Yoela na Sebadia, basinto ba Yerohamu, korwa Gedori. Abatunyani ba Daudi korwa ase egesaku kia Gadi
swahili: Yoela na Zebadia, wana wa Yerohamu, kutoka Gedori.

english: Some Gadites defected to David at his stronghold in the desert. They were mighty men of valor, trained for battle, experts with the shield and spear, whose faces were like the faces of lions and who were as swift as gazelles on the mountains:
ekegusii: Abagadi bande bakagenda kobwatia Daudi agwo ase eburi yarenge ase erooro. Abanto aba nigo barenge chituoni, bamanyete korwana chiseegi, naende nigo bamanyete korwanera chinguba na amatimo. Amasio abo nigo arenge buna aye chindo, naende nigo barenge kominyoka buna chingabi igoro y’ebitunwa.
swahili: Baadhi ya Wagadi wakajitenga na kujiunga na Daudi katika ngome yake huko jangwani. Walikuwa mashujaa hodari, waliokuwa tayari kwa vita na wenye uwezo wa kutumia ngao na mkuki. Nyuso zao zilikuwa nyuso za simba na walikuwa na wepesi kama paa milimani.

english: Ezer the chief, Obadiah the second in command, Eliab the third,
ekegusii: Eseri nere orenge omotang’ani obo na Obadia oyo o kabere, na Eliabu oyo o gatato,
swahili: Ezeri alikuwa mkuu wao, Obadia alikuwa wa pili katika uongozi, Eliabu wa tatu,

english: Then David conferred with all his leaders, the commanders of hundreds and of thousands.
ekegusii: Daudi akaba ogosemania nabanene bonsi abarenge abatang’ani b’abarwani elifu eyemo (1,000) na abe rigana erimo (100).
swahili: Daudi alishauriana na kila afisa wake, majemadari wa maelfu na majemadari wa mamia.

english: And the anger of the LORD burned against Uzzah, and He struck him down because he had put his hand on the ark. So he died there before God.
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene akaba nendamwamu enene ase Usa, akamoaka, ekiagera akunete Esanduki eria; na Usa agakwera aroro ase obosio bwa Nyasae.
swahili: Hasira ya Bwana ikawaka dhidi ya Uza, akampiga kwa sababu aliuweka mkono wake kwenye Sanduku. Kwa hiyo akafa pale mbele za Mungu.

english: Then David became angry because the LORD had burst forth against Uzzah; so he named that place Perez-uzzah, as it is called to this day.
ekegusii: Daudi akagechigwa mono, ekiagera Omonene aitete Usa. Aase aria akarokwa Peresi‐Usa, naboigo akorokwa nonya ngoika reero iga.
swahili: Ndipo Daudi akakasirika kwa sababu ghadhabu ya Bwana ilifurika dhidi ya Uza, mahali pale pakaitwa Peres-Uza hadi leo.

english: That day David feared God and asked, “How can I ever bring the ark of God to me?”
ekegusii: Ase rituko riria Daudi akairoka Nyasae, akabora, “Naki rende ndakore imbe noboremu ndete Esanduki ya Nyasae nka bwone?”
swahili: Siku ile Daudi akamwogopa Mungu naye akauliza. “Nitawezaje kulichukua Sanduku la Mungu kwangu?”

english: So he did not move the ark with him to the City of David; instead, he took it aside to the house of Obed-edom the Gittite.
ekegusii: Ase ayio Daudi tairete Esanduki eria mwaye ase omochie okorokwa Omochie o Daudi, korende akayebogoria akayebeka nyomba mw’Obedi‐Edomu, Omogiti.
swahili: Hakulichukua hilo Sanduku akae nalo katika Mji wa Daudi. Badala yake, akalipeleka nyumbani kwa Obed-Edomu, Mgiti.

english: Thus the ark of God remained with the family of Obed-edom in his house for three months, and the LORD blessed his household and everything he owned.
ekegusii: Esanduki eria ya Nyasae ekabeera ase enka y’Obedi‐Edomu nyomba ime ase engaki y’emetienyi etato; n’Omonene agasesenia enka y’Obedi‐Edomu na ebinto bionsi abwate.
swahili: Sanduku la Mungu likabaki pamoja na jamaa ya Obed-Edomu, nyumbani kwake kwa miezi mitatu, naye Bwana akaibariki nyumba yake pamoja na kila kitu alichokuwa nacho.

english: And he said to the whole assembly of Israel, “If it seems good to you, and if this is of the LORD our God, let us send word far and wide to the rest of our brothers in all the land of Israel, and also to the priests and Levites in their cities and pasturelands, so that they may join us.
ekegusii: Erio agakwana n’Abaisraeli bonsi basangererekanete, akabateebia, “Onye ekororekana buya ase more, naende onye kore ogwancha kw’Omonene, Nyasae oito, tiga totome abanto gochia aaria na aaria barangerie abaminto baria batigarete ase ense yonsi y’Abaisraeli, na abakuani na Abalawi bakare ase emechie eria ere namarisio, erinde bachiche babe amo naintwe.
swahili: Ndipo Daudi akaliambia kusanyiko lote la Israeli, “Kama mkiona ni vyema, na kama ni mapenzi ya Bwana Mungu wetu, tupeleke ujumbe kwa ndugu zetu wengine walio mbali na walio karibu katika nchi yote ya Israeli, pia kwa makuhani na Walawi walio pamoja nao katika miji yao na katika sehemu zao za malisho yao, waje waungane na sisi.

english: Then let us bring back the ark of our God, for we did not inquire of Him in the days of Saul.”
ekegusii: Erio torente naende Esanduki ya Nyasae oito ebeere amo naintwe, ekiagera ntwayetigete ase amatuko aria Saulo arenge kogamba.”
swahili: Sisi na tulirudishe Sanduku la Mungu wetu kwetu kwa maana hatukujali wakati wa utawala wa Sauli.”

english: And because this proposal seemed right to all the people, the whole assembly agreed to it.
ekegusii: Omosangererekano oria bwonsi bw’abaanto ogancha gokora amang’ana ayio, ekiagera nigo abeete amaronge ase abanto bonsi.
swahili: Kusanyiko lote likakubaliana kufanya hivyo, kwa sababu ilionekana vyema kwa watu wote.

english: So David assembled all Israel, from the River Shihor in Egypt to Lebo-hamath, to bring the ark of God from Kiriath-jearim.
ekegusii: Ase ayio Daudi agasangereria Abaisraeli bonsi korwa Sihori ya Misiri goika egesoero kia Hamati, erinde barente Esanduki eria ya Nyasae korwa Kiriati‐Yearimu.
swahili: Basi Daudi akawakusanya Waisraeli wote, kuanzia Mto Shihori ulioko Misri hadi Lebo-Hamathi, ili kulileta Sanduku la Mungu kutoka Kiriath-Yearimu.

english: David and all Israel went up to Baalah of Judah (that is, Kiriath-jearim) to bring up from there the ark of God the LORD, who is enthroned between the cherubim—the ark that is called by the Name.
ekegusii: Daudi amo n’Abaisraeli bonsi bakagenda Baala (noro Kiriati‐Yearimu), orenge bw’Abayuda, korenta korwa aroro Esanduki ya Nyasae, eyio ekorokwa ase erieta ri’Omonene, oyio omenyete nobonene bwaye igoro y’ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba.
swahili: Daudi akiwa pamoja na Waisraeli wote wakaenda Baala ya Yuda (yaani Kiriath-Yearimu) kulipandisha Sanduku la Mungu Bwana, yeye anayeketi katika kiti cha enzi kati ya makerubi: Sanduku linaloitwa kwa Jina lake, kutoka huko.

english: So they carried the ark of God from the house of Abinadab on a new cart, with Uzzah and Ahio guiding the cart. Uzzah Touches the Ark (2 Samuel 6:5–11)
ekegusii: Bakarusia Esanduki eria ya Nyasae korwa ase enyomba y’Abinadabu, bakayebeeka igoro ase egari enyia. Usa na Ahiyo nabwo barenge koraa egari eria.
swahili: Wakalisafirisha Sanduku la Mungu kwa gari jipya la kukokotwa na maksai kutoka nyumba ya Abinadabu, Uza na Ahio wakiliongoza gari hilo.

english: David and all the Israelites were celebrating before God with all their might, with songs and on harps and lyres, with tambourines, cymbals, and trumpets.
ekegusii: Daudi na Abaisraeli bonsi bakaba bagochenga ase obosio bwa Nyasae ne chinguru chiabo chionsi, bagotera na kobugia amakano ’ebirigisa, na amakano ande, na ebikonu, ne chisani chigoakanigwa na kwoga, na ebitureeri.
swahili: Daudi pamoja na Waisraeli wote walikuwa wanasifu kwa nguvu zao zote mbele za Mungu, kwa nyimbo na kwa vinubi, zeze, matari, matoazi na tarumbeta.

english: When they came to the threshing floor of Chidon, Uzzah reached out and took hold of the ark, because the oxen had stumbled.
ekegusii: Ekero baigete ase ekeooreri gia Kidoni, Usa akarambora okoboko kwaye gosiira Esanduki eria, ekiagera chiombe chiare kong’usa egari chiagochetwe.
swahili: Walipofika kwenye uwanja wa kupuria nafaka wa Kidoni, Uza akaunyoosha mkono wake ili kulizuia Sanduku, kwa sababu maksai walijikwaa.

english: Now Hiram king of Tyre sent envoys to David, along with cedar logs, stonemasons, and carpenters, to build a palace for him.
ekegusii: Hiramu, omorwoti o Turo, agatoma abatomwa ase Daudi, akamotomera ebingese bi’emete y’emecharake na abaagacheri amagena, na abasenia be chibao, erinde baagachere Daudi enyomba.
swahili: Basi Hiramu mfalme wa Tiro akawatuma wajumbe kwa Daudi, wakiwa na magogo ya mierezi, waashi na maseremala ili kumjengea jumba la kifalme.

english: So David inquired of God, “Should I go up against the Philistines? Will You deliver them into my hand?” “Go,” replied the LORD, “for I will deliver them into your hand.”
ekegusii: Na Daudi akaboria Nyasae “Inee! Ndagenda korwania Abafirisiti?” Nobabeeke ase amaboko aane gose? Omonene akamoiraneria, “Ee, genda, nimbabeeke ase amaboko ao.”
swahili: Hivyo Daudi akamuuliza Mungu: “Je, niende kuwashambulia hao Wafilisti? Je, utawatia mikononi mwangu?” Bwana akamjibu, “Nenda, nitawatia mikononi mwako.”

english: So David and his men went up to Baal-perazim, where he defeated the Philistines and said, “Like a bursting flood, God has burst out against my enemies by my hand.” So they called that place Baal-perazim.
ekegusii: Daudi akagenda goika Baali‐Perasimu, akababua agwo. Erio akabora, “Nyasae okoroorire ababisa baane goetera ase okoboko kwane, buna chiooro chi’amaache are nemerindo chigokoroora.” Ase ayio bakaroka aase aria Baali‐Perasimu.
swahili: Hivyo Daudi pamoja na watu wake wakakwea mpaka Baal-Perasimu, akawashinda huko. Akasema, “Kama maji yafurikavyo, Mungu amewafurikia adui zangu kwa kutumia mkono wangu.” Kwa hiyo mahali pale pakaitwa Baal-Perasimu.

english: There the Philistines abandoned their gods, and David ordered that they be burned in the fire.
ekegusii: Abafirisiti bagatiga chinyasae chiabo aroro, na Daudi agachiika abanto, bachisambe nomorero.
swahili: Wafilisti walikuwa wameacha miungu yao huko, Daudi akaamuru iteketezwe kwa moto.

english: Once again the Philistines raided the valley.
ekegusii: Naende Abafirisiti bakagenda aroro eria kabere bagasakora.
swahili: Kwa mara nyingine Wafilisti wakavamia lile bonde;

english: So David again inquired of God, who answered him, “Do not march up after them, but circle around them and attack them in front of the balsam trees.
ekegusii: Ekero Daudi aboretie Nyasae naende, Nyasae akamoiraneria, “Tobarwania esegi korwa aa, korende oetanane ogende obatubokere korwa magega ase emete ekorokwa balisamu ere.
swahili: hivyo Daudi akamuuliza Mungu tena, naye Mungu akamjibu, “Usiwapandie moja kwa moja, bali wazungukie na uwashambulie kutoka mbele ya hiyo miti ya miforosadi.

english: As soon as you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the balsam trees, move out to battle, because this will mean that God has marched out before you to strike the camp of the Philistines.”
ekegusii: Na ekero oraigwe ebititiro bigoeta ase emete eyio igoro, erio ogende korwana esegi; omanye ng’a Nyasae ogotang’aneire kobua abarwani b’Abafilisti.”
swahili: Mara usikiapo sauti ya kwenda juu ya hiyo miti ya miforosadi, hapo ndipo utoke upigane vita, kwa sababu hiyo itaonyesha kwamba Mungu amekutangulia ili kupiga jeshi la Wafilisti.”

english: So David did as God had commanded him, and they struck down the army of the Philistines all the way from Gibeon to Gezer.
ekegusii: Daudi agakora buna Nyasae amochigeete, na barabwo bagaita abarwani b’Abafilisti korwa Gibeoni goikera Geseri.
swahili: Kwa hiyo Daudi akafanya kama alivyoagizwa na Mungu, wakalipiga jeshi la Wafilisti kuanzia Gibeoni hadi Gezeri.

english: And David’s fame went out into every land, and the LORD caused all nations to fear him.
ekegusii: Chinkuma chia Daudi chigasarera ase chinse chionsi; n’Omonene akarentera abanto b’ebisaku bionsi obwoba, bakamoiroka.
swahili: Hivyo umaarufu wa Daudi ukaenea katika kila nchi, naye Bwana akayafanya mataifa yote kumwogopa Daudi.

english: And David realized that the LORD had established him as king over Israel and had highly exalted his kingdom for the sake of His people Israel.
ekegusii: Erio Daudi akamanya ng’a Omonene omokong’irie ase okoba omorwoti bw’Abaisraeli, na omoimokereirie igoro ase engencho y’abanto baye Abaisraeli.
swahili: Naye Daudi akatambua kwamba Bwana amemwimarisha kuwa mfalme juu ya Israeli na kwamba ufalme wake umetukuzwa kwa ajili ya Israeli, watu wake.

english: And David took more wives in Jerusalem and became the father of more sons and daughters.
ekegusii: Daudi akanyuoma abakungu bande agwo Yerusalemu, na abwo bakamoiborera abana abange, abamura na abaiseke.
swahili: Huko Yerusalemu Daudi akaoa wake wengine zaidi na akawa baba wa wana na mabinti wengi.

english: These are the names of the children born to him in Jerusalem: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon,
ekegusii: Aya naro amarieta ’abana baiboretwe asare agwo Yerusalemu: Samua na Sobabu, Nathani na Sulemani,
swahili: Haya ndiyo majina ya watoto waliozaliwa kwake huko: Shamua, Shobabu, Nathani, Solomoni,

english: Ibhar, Elishua, Elpelet,
ekegusii: Ibuhari na Eliasama, na Elifeleti,
swahili: Ibihari, Elishua, Elpeleti,

english: Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia,
ekegusii: Noga na Nefegi, na Yafia,
swahili: Noga, Nefegi, Yafia,

english: Elishama, Beeliada, and Eliphelet. Two Victories over the Philistines (2 Samuel 5:17–25)
ekegusii: Elisama na Beliada, na Elifeleti. Abafirisiti bakobugwa (2 Sam 5:17-25)
swahili: Elishama, Beeliada na Elifeleti. Daudi Awashinda Wafilisti (2 Samweli 5:17-25)

english: When the Philistines heard that David had been anointed king over all Israel, they all went in search of him; but David learned of this and went out to face them.
ekegusii: Ekero Abafirisiti baigwete ng’a Daudi oakirwe amaguta obeire omorwoti igoro ase Abaisraeli bonsi, bagatiira gochia komorigia. Daudi akaigwa ayio, akagenda koumerana nabarabwo ase okorwana esegi.
swahili: Wafilisti waliposikia kuwa Daudi ametiwa mafuta kuwa mfalme wa Israeli yote, wakapanda na jeshi lao lote kwenda kumsaka, lakini Daudi akapata habari hizo, naye akatoka ili kwenda kukabiliana nao.

english: Now the Philistines had come and raided the Valley of Rephaim.
ekegusii: Abafirisiti bagacha gosakora agwo ase ense omweya y’Abarefai.
swahili: Basi Wafilisti walikuwa wameingia na kushambulia Bonde la Warefai,

english: David constructed buildings for himself in the City of David, and he prepared a place for the ark of God and pitched a tent for it.
ekegusii: Daudi akeagachera chinyomba agwo ase Omochie o Daudi. Akaroisia aase ase Esanduki ya Nyasae yare koganchwa, naende akayeteneneria eema aroro.
swahili: Baada ya Daudi kujijengea nyumba zake katika Mji wa Daudi, akatengeneza sehemu kwa ajili ya Sanduku la Mungu, kisha akasimamisha hema kwa ajili yake.

english: and from the Uzzielites, Amminadab the chief and 112 of his relatives.
ekegusii: korwa ase eamate ya Usieli: Aminadabu, omotang’ani obo, amo nabamwabo rigana erimo, na ikomi na babere (112).
swahili: Kutoka wazao wa Uzieli, Aminadabu kiongozi na ndugu zake 112.

english: David summoned the priests Zadok and Abiathar and the Levites Uriel, Asaiah, Joel, Shemaiah, Eliel, and Amminadab.
ekegusii: Erio Daudi akarangeria abakuani Zadoki na Abiatari, naende Abalawi: Urieli na Asaia, Yoel na Semaya, Elieli na Aminadabu,
swahili: Kisha Daudi akawaita makuhani Sadoki na Abiathari, pamoja na Walawi Urieli, Asaya, Yoeli, Shemaya, Elieli na Aminadabu.

english: And he said to them, “You are the heads of the Levitical families. You and your relatives must consecrate yourselves so that you may bring the ark of the LORD, the God of Israel, to the place I have prepared for it.
ekegusii: akabateebia, “Inwe nabateneneri be chiamate chi’Abalawi, echene inwe abanyene amo nabaanto bamino, mochie kwoyia Esanduki eria y’Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, moyebeke aase agwo inche nayeroiseirie.
swahili: Akawaambia, “Ninyi ndio viongozi wa jamaa za Walawi. Ninyi pamoja na Walawi wenzenu inawapasa mjitakase na kulipandisha Sanduku la Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli hadi mahali ambapo nimetengeneza kwa ajili yake.

english: It was because you Levites were not with us the first time that the LORD our God burst forth in anger against us. For we did not consult Him about the proper order.” The Priests and Levites Carry the Ark
ekegusii: Ekiagera inwe timwayebogoretie engaki eria entang’ani, Omonene, Nyasae oito, atoete egesusuro; titwamorigetie buna atochigeete.”
swahili: Ilikuwa ni kwa sababu hii, ninyi Walawi, hamkulipandisha Sanduku la Bwana mara ya kwanza, hata ikasababisha Bwana Mungu wetu kuwaka hasira dhidi yetu. Hatukumuuliza jinsi ya kufanya ili tupate kulileta jinsi alivyoagiza.”

english: So the priests and Levites consecrated themselves to bring up the ark of the LORD, the God of Israel.
ekegusii: Ase ayio abakuani na Abalawi bagechena abanyene, erinde bachie korenta Esanduki eria y’Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli.
swahili: Kwa hiyo makuhani pamoja na Walawi wakajitakasa ili kulipandisha Sanduku la Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli.

english: And the Levites carried the ark of God on their shoulders with the poles, as Moses had commanded in accordance with the word of the LORD.
ekegusii: Abalawi bakabogoria Esanduki eria ya Nyasae nemiaro igoro ase amareko abo, buna Musa abachigete koreng’ana ne ring’ana ri’Omonene.
swahili: Nao Walawi wakalichukua Sanduku la Mungu mabegani mwao wakitumia mipiko, kama vile Mose alivyoamuru sawasawa na neno la Bwana.

english: David also told the leaders of the Levites to appoint their relatives as singers to lift up their voices with joy, accompanied by musical instruments—harps, lyres, and cymbals.
ekegusii: Boigo Daudi agachiika abatang’ani b’Abalawi bachore abanto bamwabo babe abateri, baranyare kobugia ebinto bigoterera ase amariogi, ababugia amakano, na amakano ’ebirigisa, ne chisani chigoakanigwa na kwoga ase ogoteera nomogooko.
swahili: Daudi akawaambia viongozi wa Walawi kuwaweka ndugu zao waimbaji ili waimbe nyimbo za shangwe, wakiwa na vyombo vya uimbaji: zeze, vinubi na matoazi.

english: So the Levites appointed Heman son of Joel; from his brothers, Asaph son of Berechiah; from their brothers the Merarites, Ethan son of Kushaiah;
ekegusii: Ase igo Abalawi bagachora Hemani, mosinto o Yoel, na ase abanto bamwabo Asafu, mosinto o Berekia, na ase ororeria rwa Merari abanto bamwabo Etani, mosinto o Kusaya.
swahili: Basi Walawi wakawaweka Hemani mwana wa Yoeli; kutoka miongoni mwa ndugu zake, Asafu mwana wa Berekia; kutoka miongoni mwa ndugu zao Wamerari, Ethani mwana wa Kushaiya;

english: and with them their brothers next in rank: Zechariah, Jaaziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, and the gatekeepers Obed-edom and Jeiel.
ekegusii: Ase okobakonya baria bachorire abanto bamwabo b’omooroberio o kabere: Zakaria na Yasieli, Semiramoti na Yeieli, Uni na Eliabu, Benaya na Maaseya. Naende bagachora Matitia na Elifelehu, na Mikineya, na abarendi b’egeita Obedi‐Edomu na Yeieli.
swahili: hawa ndio waliochaguliwa kuwa wasaidizi wao: Zekaria, Yaazieli, Shemiramothi, Yehieli, Uni, Eliabu, Benaya, Maaseya, Matithia, Elifelehu, Mikneya, pamoja na mabawabu Obed-Edomu na Yehieli.

english: The musicians Heman, Asaph, and Ethan were to sound the bronze cymbals.
ekegusii: Abateri baria Hemani na Asafu, na Etani babe bakobugia chisani chi’etai chikobugigwa na kwoga.
swahili: Waimbaji Hemani, Asafu na Ethani walichaguliwa kupiga matoazi ya shaba;

english: Then David said, “No one but the Levites may carry the ark of God, because the LORD has chosen them to carry the ark of the LORD and to minister before Him forever.”
ekegusii: Erio Daudi akabora, “Onde takobogoria Esanduki eria ya Nyasae otatiga Abalawi boka, ekiagera Omonene nigo achorete Abalawi babe bakobogoria Esanduki y’Omonene, naende bamokorere botambe.”
swahili: Kisha Daudi akasema, “Hakuna mtu yeyote anayeruhusiwa kulibeba Sanduku la Mungu isipokuwa Walawi peke yao, kwa sababu Bwana aliwachagua kulibeba Sanduku la Bwana na kuhudumu mbele zake milele.”

english: Zechariah, Aziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Maaseiah, and Benaiah were to play the harps according to Alamoth.
ekegusii: Zakaria na Yasieli, Semiramoti na Yehieli, Uni na Eliabu, Maaseya na Benaya, aba babe bakobugia amakano koreng’ana buna amariogi a igoro ay’Alamoti.
swahili: Zekaria, Azieli, Shemiramothi, Yehieli, Uni, Eliabu, Maaseya na Benaya walikuwa wapiga zeze kufuatana na sauti ya alamothi,

english: And Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, Obed-edom, Jeiel, and Azaziah were to lead the music with lyres according to Sheminith.
ekegusii: Korende Matitia na Elifelehu, Mikineya na Obedi‐Edomu, Yeieli na Asasia babe abaraai ase okobugia amakano koreng’ana buna amariogi a inse a Seminiti.
swahili: na Matithia, Elifelehu, Mikneya, Obed-Edomu, Yehieli na Azazia walikuwa wapiga vinubi, wakiongozwa kwa kufuata sauti ya sheminithi.

english: Chenaniah the head Levite was the director of the music because he was highly skilled.
ekegusii: Kenania, omoraai bw’Abalawi ase amatera, abe omoteria, ekiagera namanyete emeremo eyio.
swahili: Kenania kiongozi wa Walawi alikuwa msimamizi wa uimbaji; huu ndio uliokuwa wajibu wake kwa sababu alikuwa stadi katika hilo.

english: Berechiah and Elkanah were to be guardians of the ark.
ekegusii: Berekia na Elikana babe abarendi b’egeita ase Esanduki eria y’Omonene.
swahili: Berekia na Elikana walikuwa mabawabu kwa ajili ya Sanduku.

english: Shebaniah, Joshaphat, Nethanel, Amasai, Zechariah, Benaiah, and Eliezer—the priests—were to blow the trumpets before the ark of God. Obed-edom and Jehiah were also to be guardians of the ark. Moving the Ark to Jerusalem
ekegusii: Sebania na Yehosafati, Netaneli na Amasai, Zakaria na Benaya, na Eliezeri, abakuani, babe bakobugia ebitureeri bosio bw’Esanduki eria ya Nyasae. Obedi‐Edomu na Yehia barabwo babe abarendi b’egeita ase Esanduki eria. Esanduki y’Okobwatana ekorentwa Yerusalemu
swahili: Shebania, Yoshafati, Nethaneli, Amasai, Zekaria, Benaya na Eliezeri, makuhani, walikuwa wapiga tarumbeta mbele ya Sanduku la Mungu. Obed-Edomu na Yehiya waliwekwa pia kuwa mabawabu wa Sanduku.

english: So David, the elders of Israel, and the commanders of thousands went with rejoicing to bring the ark of the covenant of the LORD from the house of Obed-edom.
ekegusii: Ase ayio Daudi, na abagaaka b’Abaisraeli, na abatang’ani b’abarwani chilifu bakagenda kwoyia Esanduki eria y’Okobwatana kw’Omonene, korwa ase enyomba y’Obedi‐Edomu, bagachenga nomogooko omonene mono.
swahili: Basi Daudi pamoja na wazee wa Israeli na majemadari wa vikosi vya elfu wakaenda ili kulipandisha Sanduku la Agano la Bwana kutoka nyumba ya Obed-Edomu kwa shangwe.

english: And because God helped the Levites who were carrying the ark of the covenant of the LORD, they sacrificed seven bulls and seven rams.
ekegusii: Ekiagera Nyasae akonyete Abalawi baria babogoretie Esanduki eria y’Okobwatana kw’Omonene, bakarua ebing’wanso bie chieri isano na ibere, ne chimingichi isano na ibere.
swahili: Kwa sababu Mungu alikuwa amewasaidia Walawi waliokuwa wanalichukua Sanduku la Agano la Bwana, mafahali saba na kondoo dume saba walitolewa dhabihu.

english: Now David was dressed in a robe of fine linen, as were all the Levites who were carrying the ark, as well as the singers and Chenaniah, the director of music for the singers. David also wore a linen ephod.
ekegusii: Daudi akabeeka eanga engiya y’egatani, boigo n’Abalawi baria bonsi babogoretie Esanduki eria bakabeeka, na abateri boigo, na Kenania, omoteria bw’abateri. Daudi akabeeka negesibao ki’egatani.
swahili: Basi Daudi alikuwa amevaa joho la kitani safi, kama walivyokuwa wamevaa Walawi wote waliokuwa wanalichukua lile Sanduku, waimbaji nao walivaa vivyo hivyo, pamoja na Kenania aliyekuwa anaongoza nyimbo za waimbaji. Daudi alivaa pia kisibau cha kitani safi.

english: So all Israel brought up the ark of the covenant of the LORD with shouting, with the sounding of rams’ horns and trumpets, and with cymbals and the music of harps and lyres. Michal’s Contempt for David (2 Samuel 6:16)
ekegusii: Ase ayio Abaisraeli bonsi bakarenta Esanduki eria y’Okobwatana kw’Omonene. Bagaaka amariogi ’omochengo, bakabugia chingoma na eirombeta, ne chisani chigoakanigwa chikwoga, naende bakabugia mono namakano, na amakano ’ebirigisa.
swahili: Hivyo Israeli wote wakalipandisha Sanduku la Agano la Bwana kwa shangwe, wakipiga pembe za kondoo dume, tarumbeta, matoazi, wakipiga zeze na vinubi.

english: As the ark of the covenant of the LORD was entering the City of David, Saul’s daughter Michal looked down from a window and saw King David dancing and celebrating, and she despised him in her heart.
ekegusii: Ekaba ekero Esanduki eria y’Okobwatana kw’Omonene yare korentwa ase Omochie o Daudi, Mikali, mosubati o Saulo, akarigereria korwa ase ekebao, akarora Daudi omorwoti ogocharoka‐charoka na gotenga ore nomogooko, akamochaya ase omoyo oye ime.
swahili: Sanduku la Agano la Bwana lilipokuwa linaingia katika Mji wa Daudi, Mikali binti Sauli akachungulia dirishani. Naye alipomwona Mfalme Daudi akicheza na kusherehekea, akamdharau moyoni mwake.

english: And David assembled all Israel in Jerusalem to bring up the ark of the LORD to the place he had prepared for it.
ekegusii: Daudi agasangereria Abaisraeli bonsi agwo Yerusalemu gochia korenta Esanduki eria y’Omonene gocha aase aye ayeroiseretie.
swahili: Daudi akawakusanya Israeli wote huko Yerusalemu ili kulipandisha Sanduku la Bwana na kulileta hadi kwenye sehemu aliyokuwa ametengeneza kwa ajili yake.

english: Then he gathered together the descendants of Aaron and the Levites:
ekegusii: Naende agasangereria amo abanto b’ororeria rwa Aroni na Abalawi.
swahili: Kisha Daudi akawakusanya pamoja wazao wa Aroni na Walawi:

english: From the Kohathites, Uriel the chief and 120 of his relatives;
ekegusii: Korwa ase eamate ya Kohati: Urieli, omotang’ani obo, amo nabamwabo rigana erimo, na emerongo ebere (120);
swahili: Kutoka wazao wa Kohathi, Urieli kiongozi na ndugu zake 120,

english: from the Merarites, Asaiah the chief and 220 of his relatives;
ekegusii: korwa ase eamate ya Merari: Asaia, omotang’ani obo, amo nabamwabo amagana abere, na emerongo ebere (220);
swahili: Kutoka wazao wa Merari, Asaya kiongozi na ndugu zake 220.

english: from the Gershomites, Joel the chief and 130 of his relatives;
ekegusii: korwa ase eamate ya Gerisomu: Yoel, omotang’ani obo, amo nabamwabo rigana erimo, na emerongo etato (130);
swahili: Kutoka wazao wa Gershoni, Yoeli kiongozi na ndugu zake 130.

english: from the Elizaphanites, Shemaiah the chief and 200 of his relatives;
ekegusii: korwa ase eamate y’Elisafani: Semaya, omotang’ani obo, amo nabamwabo amagana abere (200);
swahili: Kutoka wazao wa Elisafani, Shemaya kiongozi na ndugu zake 200.

english: from the Hebronites, Eliel the chief and 80 of his relatives;
ekegusii: korwa ase eamate ya Heburoni Elieli, omotang’ani obo, amo nabamwabo emerongo etano na etato (80);
swahili: Kutoka wazao wa Hebroni, Elieli kiongozi na ndugu zake 80.

english: So they brought the ark of God and placed it inside the tent that David had pitched for it. And they presented burnt offerings and peace offerings before God.
ekegusii: Kobarentire Esanduki eria ya Nyasae, bakayebeeka ime ase eema eria Daudi ayeteneneretie, bakarua ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa na ebi’omorembe, ase obosio bwa Nyasae.
swahili: Wakaleta Sanduku la Mungu na kuliweka ndani ya hema ambalo Daudi alikuwa amelisimamisha kwa ajili yake, na wakatoa sadaka za kuteketezwa na sadaka za amani mbele za Mungu.

english: Glory in His holy name; let the hearts of those who seek the LORD rejoice.
ekegusii: Etogerie erieta riaye richenu, abanto bonsi abakorigia Omonene basasoke ase chinkoro chiabo ime.
swahili: Lishangilieni jina lake takatifu; mioyo ya wale wamtafutao Bwana na ifurahi.

english: Seek out the LORD and His strength; seek His face always.
ekegusii: Rigia Omonene amo ne chinguru chiaye, morigie mobe ase obosio bwaye botambe.
swahili: Mtafuteni Bwana na nguvu zake; utafuteni uso wake siku zote.

english: He is the LORD our God; His judgments carry throughout the earth.
ekegusii: Ere nere Omonene, Nyasae oito, ebiina biaye nigo bire ase ense yonsi.
swahili: Yeye ndiye Bwana Mungu wetu; hukumu zake zimo duniani pote.

english: Remember His covenant forever, the word He ordained for a thousand generations—
ekegusii: Inyora botambe okobwatana kwaye kw’ogotianania, goika ebiaare elifu mobe mokoinyora ring’ana achigete,
swahili: Hulikumbuka agano lake milele, neno ambalo aliamuru, kwa vizazi elfu,

english: the covenant He made with Abraham, and the oath He swore to Isaac.
ekegusii: na okobwatana koria kw’ogotianania akorete na Aburaamu, na eira yaye y’ogotianania arierete Isaka.
swahili: agano alilolifanya na Abrahamu, kiapo alichomwapia Isaki.

english: He confirmed it to Jacob as a decree, to Israel as an everlasting covenant:
ekegusii: Eira eyio aenegetie koba ase Yakobo buna ogochika, ee, ase Israeli okobwatana gwa kare na kare,
swahili: Alilithibitisha kwa Yakobo kuwa amri, kwa Israeli liwe agano la milele:

english: ‘I will give you the land of Canaan as the portion of your inheritance.’
ekegusii: agateeba, “Aye ninkoe ense ya Kaanani ebe omwando bw’ororeria rwao.”
swahili: “Nitakupa wewe nchi ya Kanaani kuwa sehemu utakayoirithi.”

english: When they were few in number, few indeed, and strangers in the land,
ekegusii: Ase engaki eria nigo barenge abake ase omobaro, bakabarwa ng’a tibaisaini gento, nigo barenge abaeti ase ense eyio.
swahili: Walipokuwa wachache kwa idadi, wachache sana na wageni ndani yake,

english: When David had finished sacrificing the burnt offerings and peace offerings, he blessed the people in the name of the LORD.
ekegusii: Na ekero Daudi akoorire korua ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa na eki’omorembe agasesenia abanto ase erieta ri’Omonene.
swahili: Baada ya Daudi kumaliza kutoa hizo sadaka za kuteketezwa na hizo sadaka za amani, akawabariki watu katika jina la Bwana.

english: they wandered from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another.
ekegusii: Bakaba bagoetanana korwa ase egesaku ekemo gochia ase ekende, na korwa ase oborwoti obomo gochia ase obonde.
swahili: walitangatanga kutoka taifa moja hadi jingine, kutoka ufalme mmoja hadi mwingine.

english: He let no man oppress them; He rebuked kings on their behalf:
ekegusii: Nyasae tatigete abanto bande baabachande; agatogonyera abarwoti ase engencho yabo,
swahili: Hakuruhusu mtu yeyote awaonee; kwa ajili yao aliwakemea wafalme, akisema:

english: ‘Do not touch My anointed ones! Do no harm to My prophets!’ Sing to the LORD, All the Earth (Psalms 96:1–13)
ekegusii: agateeba, “Timobaisa gokuna abaakwa amaguta baane, gose timokorera ababani baane bobe!”
swahili: “Msiwaguse niliowatia mafuta; msiwadhuru manabii wangu.”

english: Sing to the LORD, all the earth. Proclaim His salvation day after day.
ekegusii: Inwe abanto b’ense yonsi, moterere Omonene! Raria ogotooreka kwaye rituko ase rituko!
swahili: Mwimbieni Bwana dunia yote; tangazeni wokovu wake siku baada ya siku.

english: Declare His glory among the nations, His wonderful deeds among all peoples.
ekegusii: Raria obonene bwaye ase egati y’ebisaku, na ogokora kwaye kw’ogokumia ase abanto bonsi!
swahili: Tangazeni utukufu wake katikati ya mataifa, matendo yake ya ajabu miongoni mwa mataifa yote.

english: For great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised; He is to be feared above all gods.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo are omonene mono, goika atogigwe, na airokwe goetania chinyasae chinde.
swahili: Kwa kuwa Bwana ni mkuu, mwenye kustahili kusifiwa kuliko wote; yeye ni wa kuogopwa kuliko miungu yote.

english: For all the gods of the nations are idols, but it is the LORD who made the heavens.
ekegusii: Chinyasae chionsi chi’abaanto b’ebisaku nemegwekano y’ogosasimwa rioka, korende Omonene nere otongete igoro chionsi.
swahili: Kwa maana miungu yote ya mataifa ni sanamu, lakini Bwana aliziumba mbingu.

english: Splendor and majesty are before Him; strength and joy fill His dwelling.
ekegusii: Ogosikwa na obonene nigo bire ase obosio bwaye, chinguru na omogooko nigo bire ase obomenyo bwaye.
swahili: Fahari na enzi viko mbele yake; nguvu na utukufu vimo patakatifu pake.

english: Ascribe to the LORD, O families of the nations, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.
ekegusii: Inwe abe chiamate chi’abaanto, togia Omonene! Motogie ase obonene bwaye na okobua kwaye!
swahili: Mpeni Bwana, enyi jamaa za mataifa, mpeni Bwana utukufu na nguvu,

english: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due His name; bring an offering and come before Him. Worship the LORD in the splendor of His holiness;
ekegusii: Mobake Omonene ase obonene bw’erieta riaye; moche ase obosio bwaye morentane ebiegwa, mosasime Omonene mweboetie obochenu!
swahili: mpeni Bwana utukufu unaostahili jina lake. Leteni sadaka na mje katika nyua zake; mwabuduni Bwana katika uzuri wa utakatifu wake.

english: Then he distributed to every man and woman of Israel a loaf of bread, a date cake, and a raisin cake.
ekegusii: Naende akagaba endagera ase omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli, ase abasacha na abakungu; kera oyomo akaegwa omogati oyomo, na enyama inke, ne ribomba ri’amasasabibu amomo.
swahili: Kisha akamgawia kila Mwisraeli mwanaume na mwanamke mkate, andazi la tende na andazi la zabibu kavu.

english: tremble before Him, all the earth. The world is firmly established; it cannot be moved.
ekegusii: Inwe abanto b’ense yonsi, mobe mokoiguswa ase obosio bwaye, ee, ense nigo eteneine bokong’u, tekonyegerigwa.
swahili: Dunia yote na itetemeke mbele zake! Ulimwengu ameuweka imara; hauwezi kusogezwa.

english: Let the heavens be glad, and the earth rejoice. Let them say among the nations, ‘The LORD reigns!’
ekegusii: Tiga igoro chibe nomogooko na ense echenge, abanto b’ebisaku bateebigwe: “Omonene nere okogamba.”
swahili: Mbingu na zishangilie, nchi na ifurahi; semeni katikati ya mataifa, “ Bwana anatawala!”

english: Let the sea resound, and all that fills it; let the fields exult, and all that is in them.
ekegusii: Tiga enyancha echenge ase okoeera, amo n’ebinto bionsi bire ime yaye, na emegondo echenge amo n’ebinto bionsi bireo.
swahili: Bahari na ivume, na vyote vilivyomo ndani yake; mashamba na yashangilie, na vyote vilivyomo ndani yake.

english: Then the trees of the forest will sing for joy before the LORD, for He is coming to judge the earth.
ekegusii: Erio emete ye rinani netere nomogooko ase obosio bw’Omonene, ekiagera ere ngocha are konachera ense ekiina.
swahili: Kisha miti ya msituni itaimba, itaimba kwa furaha mbele za Bwana, kwa maana anakuja kuihukumu dunia.

english: Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.
ekegusii: Iraneri’Omonene ng’a mbuya mono, ekiagera ere nomuya; obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete kare na kare.
swahili: Mshukuruni Bwana kwa kuwa ni mwema; upendo wake wadumu milele.

english: Then cry out: ‘Save us, O God of our salvation; gather and deliver us from the nations, that we may give thanks to Your holy name, that we may glory in Your praise.’
ekegusii: Kwana: Aye Nyasae, ogotooreka gwaito, totoorie, otosangererie amo, na otoboorie korwa ase abanto b’ebisaku, erinde totogie erieta riao richenu, na twetogerie ogotogigwa kwao.
swahili: Mlilieni, “Ee Mungu Mwokozi wetu, tuokoe. Tukusanye tena na utukomboe kutoka kwa mataifa, ili tuweze kulishukuru jina lako takatifu, na kushangilia katika sifa zako.”

english: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting.” Then all the people said, “Amen!” and “Praise the LORD!” Worship before the Ark
ekegusii: Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, atogigwe, korwa kare na kare, na gochia kare na kare! Erio abanto bonsi bagateeba, “Amina!” Na bakamotogia Omonene. Ogosasiima ase Yerusalemu na Gibeoni
swahili: Atukuzwe Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli, tangu milele na hata milele. Nao watu wote wakasema, “Amen,” na “Msifuni Bwana.”

english: So David left Asaph and his brothers there before the ark of the covenant of the LORD, to minister there regularly according to the daily requirements,
ekegusii: Ase ayio Daudi agatiga Asafu na abanto bamwabo agwo bosio bw’Esanduki eria y’Okobwatana kw’Omonene babe abakoreri asare botambe, buna okogania gwa kera rituko kwarenge.
swahili: Daudi akamwacha Asafu na wenzake mbele ya Sanduku la Agano la Bwana ili wahudumu humo mara kwa mara, kulingana na mahitaji ya kila siku.

english: along with Obed-edom and his sixty-eight relatives. Obed-edom son of Jeduthun, and also Hosah, were to be gatekeepers.
ekegusii: Obedi‐Edomu na abanto bamwabo nigo barenge emerongo etano nomo, na batano na batato (68). Ere Obedi‐Edomu mosinto o Yedutuni, na Hosea, bakabeekwa bakaba abarendi b’egeita.
swahili: Pia akamwacha Obed-Edomu pamoja na wenzake sitini na wanane wahudumu pamoja nao. Obed-Edomu mwana wa Yeduthuni na pia Hosa walikuwa mabawabu wa lango.

english: And David left Zadok the priest and his fellow priests before the tabernacle of the LORD at the high place in Gibeon
ekegusii: Daudi akabeeka Zadoki Omokuani amo nabakuani bande bamwabo, babe bagokorera Omonene ase Eema yaye agwo aase aimokererete igoro agosasimerwa aaria Gibeoni.
swahili: Daudi akamwacha kuhani Sadoki pamoja na makuhani wenzake mbele ya hema ya ibada ya Bwana katika mahali pa juu pa kuabudia huko Gibeoni

english: David appointed some of the Levites to minister before the ark of the LORD, to celebrate, to give thanks, and to praise the LORD, the God of Israel.
ekegusii: Naende agachora abanto bande b’Abalawi bakaba abakoreri bosio bw’Esanduki eria y’Omonene, bakaba bagotogia Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, na komoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono na komobaka.
swahili: Akawaweka pia baadhi ya Walawi ili wahudumu mbele ya Sanduku la Bwana kufanya maombi, kumshukuru na kumsifu Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli:

english: to regularly present burnt offerings to the LORD on the altar of burnt offerings, morning and evening, according to all that was written in the Law of the LORD, which He had commanded Israel to keep.
ekegusii: Kera emambia na omogoroba botambe babe bakorua ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa ase egesasiimero gi’ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa, koreng’ana buna arigetwe ase amachiiko ari’Omonene aete Abaisraeli.
swahili: ili kutoa sadaka za kuteketezwa kwa Bwana kwenye madhabahu ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa mara kwa mara, asubuhi na jioni, sawasawa na kila kitu kilichoandikwa katika sheria ya Bwana ambayo alikuwa amempa Israeli.

english: With them were Heman, Jeduthun, and the rest of those chosen and designated by name to give thanks to the LORD, for “His loving devotion endures forever.”
ekegusii: Amo nabwo barenge Hemani na Yedutuni, na abanto baria bachoretwe na korikwa amarieta abo ase okoiraneri’Omonene ng’a mbuya mono ase engencho y’obwanchani bwaye obwo bogendererete kare na kare.
swahili: Waliohudumu pamoja nao walikuwa Hemani, Yeduthuni na wale wote waliochaguliwa na kutajwa kwa jina kumpa Bwana shukrani, “Kwa maana fadhili zake zadumu milele.”

english: Heman and Jeduthun had with them trumpets and cymbals for the music and instruments for the songs of God. And the sons of Jeduthun were stationed at the gate.
ekegusii: Hemani na Yedutuni nigo bagachete ebitureeri ne chisani chiarenge kwoga ekero chiare goakanigwa, amo n’ebinto binde biare kobugigwa ekero amatera amaachenu agoterwa. Abanto b’eamate ya Yedutuni bagachorwa korenda egeita.
swahili: Hemani na Yeduthuni walikuwa na wajibu wa kupiga tarumbeta, matoazi na kutumia vyombo vingine kwa ajili ya nyimbo za sifa kwa Mungu. Wana wa Yeduthuni waliwekwa langoni.

english: Then all the people departed for their homes, and David returned home to bless his household.
ekegusii: Erio abanto bonsi bakarua agwo, kera omonto akagenda nka bwoye, na Daudi akagenda bwoye gosesenia abanto b’enyomba yaye.
swahili: Kisha watu wote wakaondoka, kila mmoja akarudi nyumbani kwake, naye Daudi akarudi nyumbani kuibariki jamaa yake.

english: Asaph was the chief, Zechariah was second, then Jeiel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Mattithiah, Eliab, Benaiah, Obed-edom, and Jeiel. They were to play the harps and lyres, while Asaph sounded the cymbals
ekegusii: Asafu nere orenge omotang’ani obo. Abaare komobwatia nabwo aba: Zakaria na Yeieli, Semiramoti na Yehieli, Matitia na Eliabu, Benaya na Obedi‐Edomu, na Yeieli, baria barenge kobugia amakano, na amakano ’ebirigisa. Asafu agaakania chisani chiarenge kwoga.
swahili: Asafu ndiye alikuwa mkuu wao, akisaidiwa na Zekaria, Yeieli, Shemiramothi, Yehieli, Matithia, Eliabu, Benaya, Obed-Edomu na Yeieli. Hawa ndio wangepiga zeze na vinubi, Asafu angepiga matoazi,

english: and the priests Benaiah and Jahaziel blew the trumpets regularly before the ark of the covenant of God. David’s Psalms of Thanksgiving (Psalms 105:1–15)
ekegusii: Benaya na Yahasieli, abakuani, bakaba bakobugia ebitureeri botambe agwo bosio bw’Esanduki ere ne chibao chiriikire Okobwatana kwa Nyasae.
