swahili: nao Benaya na Yahazieli makuhani, ndio wangepiga tarumbeta mara kwa mara mbele ya Sanduku la Agano la Mungu. Zaburi Ya Daudi Ya Shukrani (Zaburi 105:1-15; 96:1-13; 106:1, 47-48)

english: On that day David first committed to Asaph and his brothers this song of thanksgiving to the LORD:
ekegusii: Rituko eri nario Daudi achigete ritang’ani ng’a ogoteera gw’okomoiraneri’Omonene ng’a mbuya mono goterwe n’Asafu na abanto bamwabo ase enchera eyio. Ogoteera kw’ogotogia (Zab 105:1-5; 96:1-3; 106:1,47-48)
swahili: Siku ile, kitu cha kwanza Daudi alichofanya ni kumkabidhi Asafu na wenzake zaburi hii ya shukrani kwa Bwana:

english: “Give thanks to the LORD; call upon His name; make known His deeds among the nations.
ekegusii: Moiranerie Omonene ng’a mbuya mono! Rangeria erieta riaye ase ogokonywa, teebia abanto b’ebisaku ogokora kwaye.
swahili: Mshukuruni Bwana, liitieni jina lake; wajulisheni mataifa yale aliyoyatenda.

english: Sing to Him, sing praises to Him; tell of all His wonders.
ekegusii: Terera Omonene, moterere amatera ay’okomotogia; raria ogokora kwaye kw’ogokumia.
swahili: Mwimbieni yeye, mwimbieni yeye sifa; waambieni matendo yake yote ya ajabu.

english: After David had settled into his palace, he said to Nathan the prophet, “Here I am, living in a house of cedar, while the ark of the covenant of the LORD is under a tent.”
ekegusii: Bono ekero Daudi amenyete ase enyomba yaye agakwana na Nathani omobani, agateeba, “Rora inche nigo imenyete ase enyomba eagachire nemecharake, korende Esanduki ya Nyasae ero nigo ere ase eema ime.”
swahili: Baada ya Daudi kuingia rasmi katika jumba lake la kifalme, akamwambia nabii Nathani, “Hebu tazama, mimi ninakaa kwenye nyumba nzuri iliyojengwa kwa mierezi, wakati Sanduku la Agano la Bwana liko ndani ya hema.”

english: and have done since the day I appointed judges over My people Israel. And I will subdue all your enemies. Moreover, I declare to you that the LORD will build a house for you.
ekegusii: korwa engaki eria nachorete abagaambi igoro ase abanto baane Abaisraeli. Boigo nimbue ababisa bao bonsi. Na bono nigo ngokomanyia ng’a inche Omonene ninkoagachere enyomba.
swahili: na ambavyo wamefanya siku zote tangu nilipowachagua viongozi kwa ajili ya watu wangu Israeli. Pia nitawatiisha adui zenu wote. “ ‘Pamoja na hayo ninakuambia kwamba Bwana atakujengea nyumba:

english: And when your days are fulfilled and you go to be with your fathers, I will raise up your descendant after you, one of your own sons, and I will establish his kingdom.
ekegusii: Ekero amatuko ao araikeranigwe na obe gokogenda korara ase chisokoro chiao chiaraarete, nimbeke oyomo bw’ororeria rwao, oyorarue ase oyomo bw’abamura bao, agambe; nainche ninkong’ie oborwoti bwaye.
swahili: Wakati wako utakapokuwa umekwisha, nawe ukawa umekwenda kukaa na baba zako, nitamwinua mzao wako aingie mahali pako kuwa mfalme, mmoja wa wana wako mwenyewe, nami nitaufanya imara ufalme wake.

english: He will build a house for Me, and I will establish his throne forever.
ekegusii: Oyio nere orang’agachere enyomba; nainche ninkong’ie ekerogo kiaye ki’oborwoti kebeo kogenderera botambe.
swahili: Yeye ndiye atakayejenga nyumba kwa ajili yangu, nami nitakifanya imara kiti cha ufalme wake milele.

english: I will be his Father, and he will be My son. And I will never remove My loving devotion from him as I removed it from your predecessor.
ekegusii: Inche nimbe ise, nere nabe omwana one; tinkorusia obwanchani bwane botari koera korwa asare, buna naborusetie korwa ase oria orengeo ritang’ani asore.
swahili: Mimi nitakuwa baba yake, naye atakuwa mwanangu. Kamwe sitaondoa upendo wangu kwake, kama nilivyouondoa kwa yeye aliyekutangulia.

english: But I will set him over My house and My kingdom forever, and his throne will be established forever.”
ekegusii: Korende nimokore agenderere kobeerao botambe ase enyomba yane, na ase oborwoti bwane, na obogambi bwaye bokong’igwe kobao botari nomoerio.”
swahili: Nitamweka juu ya nyumba yangu na ufalme wangu milele; kiti chake cha enzi nitakifanya imara milele.’ ”

english: So Nathan relayed to David all the words of this entire vision. David’s Prayer of Thanksgiving (2 Samuel 7:18–29)
ekegusii: Nathani agateebia Daudi amang’ana ayio onsi buna ayaigwete na korora. Ogoaka ng’a mbuya mono gwa Daudi na ogosaba kwaye (2 Sam 7:18-29)
swahili: Nathani akamwarifu Daudi maneno yote ya maono haya. Maombi Ya Daudi (2 Samweli 7:18-29)

english: Then King David went in, sat before the LORD, and said, “Who am I, O LORD God, and what is my house, that You have brought me this far?
ekegusii: Erio Daudi omorwoti agasoa akabeera ase obosio bw’Omonene Nyasae, akabora, Aye Omonene, inche ninki ing’isaine, na eamate yane ninki eisaine, ng’a aye gwankoreire amang’ana amaya iga?
swahili: Ndipo Mfalme Daudi akaingia ndani, akaketi mbele za Bwana, akasema: “Mimi ni nani, Ee Bwana Mungu, na jamaa yangu ni nini, hata umenileta mpaka hapa nilipo?

english: And as if this was a small thing in Your eyes, O God, You have spoken about the future of the house of Your servant and have regarded me as a man of great distinction, O LORD God.
ekegusii: Naende ring’ana eri tiriisaini kende asore, aye Omonene Nyasae. Boigo gwakwanire nainche omosomba oo, igoro y’enyomba yane na amang’ana akare bosio. Ee, Omonene, gwankoreire koreng’ana nobo Mwanyabaanto, kwanyimokereirie igoro.
swahili: Kana kwamba hili halitoshi machoni pako, Ee Mungu, umenena pia kuhusu siku zijazo za nyumba ya mtumishi wako. Umeniangalia kama mtu aliyetukuka kuliko watu wote, Ee Bwana Mungu.

english: What more can David say to You for so honoring Your servant? For You know Your servant,
ekegusii: Inche Daudi, inki ndagoteebie naende kobua ayio, ekiagera gwansikire iga? Aye nigo omanyete inche, omosomba oo.
swahili: “Daudi aweza kukuambia nini zaidi kuhusu kumheshimu mtumishi wako? Kwa maana wewe unamjua mtumishi wako,

english: O LORD. For the sake of Your servant and according to Your own heart, You have accomplished this great thing and revealed all Your greatness.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ase engencho yane inche, omosomba oo, na koreng’ana nobwanchani bwao aye omonyene, gwakorire amanene aya onsi, naende kwayakorire amanyekanire.
swahili: Ee Bwana Mungu. Kwa ajili ya mtumishi wako, tena sawasawa na mapenzi yako, umefanya jambo hili kubwa sana na kujulisha ahadi hizi zote zilizo kubwa sana.

english: And Nathan replied to David, “Do all that is in your heart, for God is with you.”
ekegusii: Nathani agateebia Daudi, “Kora ande onsi ayare ase ebirengererio biao, ekiagera Nyasae nigo are amo naye.”
swahili: Nathani akamjibu Daudi, “Lolote ulilo nalo moyoni mwako litende, kwa maana Mungu yu pamoja nawe.”

english: O LORD, there is none like You, and there is no God but You, according to everything we have heard with our own ears.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, onde tari onga buna aye, gose Nyasae onde tari otatiga aye bweka, koreng’ana buna ayio konya twaigure namato aito.
swahili: “Hakuna aliye kama wewe, Ee Bwana Mungu, wala hakuna Mungu ila wewe, kama vile tulivyosikia kwa masikio yetu wenyewe.

english: And who is like Your people Israel—the one nation on earth whom God went out to redeem as a people for Himself? You made a name for Yourself through great and awesome wonders by driving out nations from before Your people, whom You redeemed from Egypt.
ekegusii: Naende mbanto ba gesaku ki bare ase ense, bare buna abanto bao Abaisraeli, abwo aye Nyasae kwabooretie babe abanto bao, okenyorera erieta ase engencho y’amang’ana amanene na ay’ogokumia ase ogoseria abanto b’ebisaku bakarua ase obosio bw’abaanto bao baria kwabooretie korwa Misiri?
swahili: Naye ni nani aliye kama watu wako Israeli: taifa pekee duniani ambalo Mungu wake alitoka kwenda kulikomboa kwa ajili yake mwenyewe na kujifanyia jina kwa ajili yake mwenyewe, kwa kufanya maajabu makubwa na ya kutisha kwa kuwafukuza mataifa mbele ya watu wako, ambao uliwakomboa kutoka Misri?

english: For You have made Your people Israel Your very own forever, and You, O LORD, have become their God.
ekegusii: Aye gwekoreire abanto bao Abaisraeli babe abanto bao kare na kare, naye Omonene kwabeire Nyasae obo.
swahili: Uliwafanya watu wako Israeli kuwa watu wako wewe mwenyewe milele, nawe, Ee Bwana Mungu, umekuwa Mungu wao.

english: And now, O LORD, let the word You have spoken concerning Your servant and his house be established forever. Do as You have promised,
ekegusii: Na bono aye Omonene, ikerania onsi aya kwariete eira igoro yane inche omosomba oo, na igoro y’ororeria rwane, na okore aya gwateebete ng’a noyakore,
swahili: “Sasa basi, Bwana ahadi uliyoweka kuhusu mtumishi wako na nyumba yake na uithibitishe milele. Fanya kama ulivyoahidi,

english: so that Your name will be established and magnified forever when it is said, ‘The LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, is God over Israel.’ And may the house of Your servant David be established before You.
ekegusii: erinde erieta riao ribeo ritogigwe goika kare na kare. Erio abanto bateebe: Omonene bw’Emeganda nere Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, ekeene nere Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli. Ase enchera eyio enyomba y’omosomba oo, inche Daudi, ekong’igwe ase obosio bwao.
swahili: ili ithibitike na jina lako litakuwa kuu milele. Kisha watu watasema, ‘ Bwana Mungu Mwenye Nguvu Zote, Mungu aliye juu ya Israeli, ndiye Mungu wa Israeli.’ Nayo nyumba ya mtumishi wako Daudi itafanywa imara mbele zako.

english: For You, my God, have revealed to Your servant that You will build a house for him. Therefore Your servant has found the courage to pray before You.
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae one kwang’orokeirie inche omosomba oo, ng’a nong’agachere enyomba. Ase ayio inche, omosomba oo, nabeire noboremu ase enkoro yane kogosaba ogosaba oko.
swahili: “Wewe, Mungu wangu, umemfunulia mtumishi wako Daudi kwamba utamjengea yeye nyumba. Hivyo mtumishi wako amekuwa na ujasiri wa kukuomba maombi haya.

english: And now, O LORD, You are God! And You have promised this goodness to Your servant.
ekegusii: Na bono, aye Omonene, aye naye Nyasae, kwandiereire inche, omosomba oo, eira gonkorera ring’ana eri rigiya.
swahili: Ee Bwana, wewe ndiwe Mungu! Umemwahidi mtumishi wako mambo haya mazuri.

english: So now You have been pleased to bless the house of Your servant, that it may continue forever before You. For You, O LORD, have blessed it, and it will be blessed forever.”
ekegusii: Gaki bono, koranche osesenie enyomba yane inche erinde egenderere kare na kare ase obosio bwao. Aye Omonene, aya gwasesenirie nigo agoseseneka kare na kare.
swahili: Basi imekupendeza kuibariki nyumba ya mtumishi wako, ili idumu milele machoni pako; kwa ajili yako, Ee Bwana, umeibariki, nayo itabarikiwa milele.”

english: But that night the word of God came to Nathan, saying,
ekegusii: Korende ase obotuko obwo, ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha ase Nathani, rikamoteebia,
swahili: Usiku ule neno la Mungu likamjia Nathani, kusema:

english: “Go and tell My servant David that this is what the LORD says: You are not the one to build Me a house in which to dwell.
ekegusii: “Genda oteebie Daudi, omosomba one, ng’a inche Omonene nigo ngoteeba iga: Aye tokong’agachera enyomba imenye imeo.
swahili: “Nenda ukamwambie mtumishi wangu Daudi, ‘Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana: Wewe hutanijengea mimi nyumba ili nikae humo.

english: For I have not dwelt in a house from the day I brought Israel up out of Egypt until this day, but I have moved from tent to tent and dwelling to dwelling.
ekegusii: Korwa engaki eria nang’anyetie Abaisraeli goika rituko ria reero inche tinana komenya ime ase enyomba, korende nabeire nkona‐kogenda korwa eyemo goika eyende, na korwa obomenyo obomo goika obonde.
swahili: Mimi sijakaa ndani ya nyumba tangu siku ile niliyowatoa Israeli kutoka Misri mpaka leo. Nimehama kutoka hema moja hadi jingine na kutoka mahali pamoja hadi pengine.

english: In all My journeys with all the Israelites, have I ever asked any of the leaders I appointed to shepherd My people, ‘Why haven’t you built Me a house of cedar?’
ekegusii: Aase ande onsi nabeire nkona‐kogenda amo n’Abaisraeli, tinana koboria mogambi onde bw’Abaisraeli, oyo nabegete akaba omorisia bw’abaanto baane ng’a nase ki atang’agachereti obomenyo bw’emecharake.
swahili: Je, popote nilipokwenda pamoja na Waisraeli wote, wakati wowote nilimwambia kiongozi yeyote niliyemwagiza kuwachunga watu wangu, kwa nini hujanijengea nyumba ya mierezi?’

english: Now then, you are to tell My servant David that this is what the LORD of Hosts says: I took you from the pasture, from following the flock, to be the ruler over My people Israel.
ekegusii: “Ase ayio, aya naro orateebie Daudi, omosomba one, ng’a inche Omonene bw’Emeganda nateebire iga: Nigo nakorusetie korwa ase kwarenge korisia ching’ondi, erinde obe gokogambera abanto baane Abaisraeli;
swahili: “Sasa basi, mwambie mtumishi wangu Daudi, ‘Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote: Nilikuchukua machungani na kutoka kuandama kondoo ili uwatawale watu wangu Israeli.

english: I have been with you wherever you have gone, and I have cut off all your enemies from before you. Now I will make for you a name like the greatest in the land.
ekegusii: nainche nkaba amo naye aande onsi ase kware kogenda ngasiria ababisa bao bonsi korwa ase obosio bwao; inche ninkore erieta riao rimanyekane, buna amarieta ’abaanto abanene b’ense amanyekanete.
swahili: Nimekuwa pamoja nawe popote ulipokwenda, nami nimekuondolea mbali adui zako wote mbele yako. Basi nitalifanya jina lako kuwa kuu kama majina ya watu walio wakuu sana duniani.

english: And I will provide a place for My people Israel and will plant them so that they may dwell in a place of their own and be disturbed no more. No longer will the sons of wickedness oppress them as they did at the beginning
ekegusii: Ninchorere abanto baane Abaisraeli aase ndababeekere bamenye, aase abo abanyene, na abakori amabe tibakobachanda naende nonya ng’ake buna baabachandete agwo ritang’ani
swahili: Nami nitawapatia watu wangu Israeli mahali na nitawapa ili wawe na mahali pao wenyewe pa kuishi na wasisumbuliwe tena. Watu waovu hawatawaonea tena, kama walivyofanya mwanzoni,

english: Some time later, David defeated the Philistines, subdued them, and took Gath and its villages from the hand of the Philistines.
ekegusii: Magega y’ayio Daudi akarwania Abafirisiti, akababua, akaira omochie o Gati amo nebichie biaye korwa ase amaboko ’Abafilisti.
swahili: Baada ya muda, Daudi akawashinda Wafilisti na kuwatiisha, naye akautwaa Gathi pamoja na vijiji vinavyouzunguka kutoka utawala wa Wafilisti.

english: he sent his son Hadoram to greet King David and bless him for fighting and defeating Hadadezer, who had been at war with Tou. Hadoram brought all kinds of articles of gold and silver and bronze,
ekegusii: agatoma Hadoramu, omomura oye, ase omorwoti Daudi komokwania na komosesenia, ekiagera ere konya arwanirie Hadadeseri na omobuire. Hadadeseri nigo abeete okonakorwania Tou. Boigo Tou agatoma ebinto bie chifeta, na ebie chitaabu, na ebie chitaai.
swahili: akamtuma mwanawe, Hadoramu kwa Mfalme Daudi ili kumsalimu na kumpongeza kwa ushindi wake katika vita dhidi ya Mfalme Hadadezeri, kwa kuwa alikuwa amepigana vita mara nyingi na Tou. Hadoramu akamletea Daudi vifaa mbalimbali vya dhahabu, fedha na shaba.

english: and King David dedicated these to the LORD, along with the silver and gold he had carried off from all these nations—from Edom and Moab, and from the Ammonites, Philistines, and Amalekites.
ekegusii: Ebinto ebio boigo Daudi akabiatananera Omonene, buna akorete ne chifeta ne chitaabu biria asakorete korwa ase ebisaku binde bionsi, korwa ase Abaedomu, na Abamoabu, na Abaamoni, na Abafirisiti, na Abaameleki.
swahili: Mfalme Daudi akaviweka vifaa hivi wakfu kwa Bwana kama vile alivyokuwa amefanya kwa fedha na dhahabu aliyokuwa ameitwaa katika mataifa yote haya: Edomu na Moabu, Waamoni, Wafilisti na Waamaleki.

english: Moreover, Abishai son of Zeruiah struck down eighteen thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt.
ekegusii: Abisai, omomura bw’omokuungu Seruya, agaita Abaedomu chilifu ikomi na isano na isato (18,000) agwo ase Riranya ri’Omonyo.
swahili: Abishai mwana wa Seruya akawaua Waedomu 18,000 katika Bonde la Chumvi.

english: He placed garrisons in Edom, and all the Edomites were subject to David. So the LORD made David victorious wherever he went. David’s Officers (2 Samuel 8:15–18)
ekegusii: Daudi akabeeka abarwani aande onsi ase egati y’Abaedomu, na Abaedomu bonsi bakaba abasomba ba Daudi, n’Omonene akaa Daudi obobui aande onsi ase arenge kogenda korwana esegi.
swahili: Akaweka kambi za askari walinzi huko Edomu, nao Waedomu wote wakawa watumishi wa Daudi. Bwana akampa Daudi ushindi kila alipokwenda. Maafisa Wa Daudi

english: Thus David reigned over all Israel and administered justice and righteousness for all his people:
ekegusii: Bono Daudi akaba okogambera Abaisraeli bonsi na akaba ogokorera abanto baye bonsi ayare boronge na ekeene.
swahili: Daudi akatawala Israeli yote, akitenda lililo haki na sawa kwa watu wake wote.

english: Joab son of Zeruiah was over the army; Jehoshaphat son of Ahilud was the recorder;
ekegusii: Yoabu, omomura bw’omokuungu Seruya, nere orenge omochiki bw’emeganda y’abarwani, na Yehosafati, mosinto bw’Ahiludi, nere orenge omoriki bw’amang’ana are gokoreka.
swahili: Yoabu mwana wa Seruya alikuwa jemadari wa jeshi; Yehoshafati mwana wa Ahiludi alikuwa mweka kumbukumbu;

english: Zadok son of Ahitub and Ahimelech son of Abiathar were priests; Shavsha was the scribe;
ekegusii: Zadoki, mosinto bw’Ahitubu, na Ahimeleki, mosinto bw’Abiatari, nabwo barenge abakuani, na Sausa nere orenge omoriki.
swahili: Sadoki mwana wa Ahitubu na Ahimeleki mwana wa Abiathari walikuwa makuhani; Shausha alikuwa mwandishi;

english: Benaiah son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and Pelethites; and David’s sons were chief officials at the king’s side.
ekegusii: Benaya, mosinto o Yehoyada, nere orenge omoteneneri bw’Abakereti na Abapeleti; na basinto ba Daudi nabwo barenge abanene bamoetanaine.
swahili: naye Benaya mwana wa Yehoyada alikuwa msimamizi wa Wakerethi na Wapelethi; nao wana wa Daudi walikuwa maafisa wakuu katika utumishi wa mfalme.

english: David also defeated the Moabites, and they became subject to David and brought him tribute.
ekegusii: Naende akabua Abamoabu, na barabwo bakaba abasomba ba Daudi, bakaba bakorenta ebango asare.
swahili: Pia Daudi akawashinda Wamoabu, wakawa watumishi wake, nao wakawa wanamletea ushuru.

english: As far as Hamath, David also defeated King Hadadezer of Zobah, who had marched out to establish his dominion along the Euphrates River.
ekegusii: Naende Daudi akabua Hadadeseri, omorwoti o Soba, agwo Hamati, ekero omorwoti oria agendete gokong’ia oborwoti bwaye aaria ase orooche rw’Eufarati.
swahili: Zaidi ya hayo, Daudi akapigana na Hadadezeri mfalme wa Soba, hadi Hamathi, wakati alikwenda kuimarisha utawala wake katika Mto Frati.

english: David captured from him a thousand chariots, seven thousand charioteers, and twenty thousand foot soldiers, and he hamstrung all the horses except a hundred he kept for the chariots.
ekegusii: Daudi agoosa chigari elifu eyemo (1,000), na abariini chibarasi chilifu isano na ibere (7,000), na abarwani abaare kogenda namagoro chilifu emerongo ebere (20,000). Erio akabutora chibarasi chionsi chinteng’e otatiga chibarasi rigana erimo (100) chikaba chikong’usa chigari.
swahili: Daudi akateka magari ya vita 1,000 miongoni mwa magari yake, waendesha hayo magari ya kukokotwa na farasi 7,000 na askari wa miguu 20,000. Daudi akakata mishipa ya miguu ya nyuma ya farasi wote wakokotao magari, ila akabakiza 100.

english: When the Arameans of Damascus came to help King Hadadezer of Zobah, David struck down twenty-two thousand men.
ekegusii: Na ekero Abasiiria ba Damesiki bachete gokonya Hadadeseri, omorwoti o Soba, Daudi akabarwania, agaita abanto chilifu emerongo ebere na ibere (22,000).
swahili: Waaramu wa Dameski, walipokuja kumsaidia Hadadezeri mfalme wa Soba, Daudi akawashambulia na kuwaua 22,000 miongoni mwao.

english: Then he placed garrisons in Aram of Damascus, and the Arameans became subject to David and brought him tribute. So the LORD made David victorious wherever he went.
ekegusii: Erio akabeeka abasikari ase egati y’Abasiiria agwo Damesiki, na Abasiiria abwo bakaba abasomba ba Daudi, bakaba bakomorentera ebango. Na Omonene akaa Daudi obobui aande onsi ase arenge kogenda korwana.
swahili: Daudi akaweka askari walinzi katika ufalme wa Waaramu huko Dameski. Basi Waaramu wakawa watumwa wa Daudi, na kumlipa ushuru. Bwana akampa Daudi ushindi kote alipokwenda.

english: And David took the gold shields that belonged to the officers of Hadadezer and brought them to Jerusalem.
ekegusii: Daudi agasakora chinguba chi’echitaabu chiria abasomba ba Hadadeseri babogoretie, agachiira Yerusalemu.
swahili: Daudi akazitwaa ngao za dhahabu zilizokuwa za maafisa wa Hadadezeri na kuzileta Yerusalemu.

english: And from Tibhath and Cun, cities of Hadadezer, David took a large amount of bronze, with which Solomon made the bronze Sea, the pillars, and various bronze articles.
ekegusii: Naende akaira chitaai chinyinge korwa Tibati na Kuni, emechie ya Hadadeseri. Korwa ase chitaai echio Sulemani akaroiseria egetuba ekenene, ne chisiiro, na ebikorero binde bie chitaai.
swahili: Kutoka miji ya Tibhathi na Kuni, iliyokuwa miji ya Hadadezeri, Daudi akatwaa shaba nyingi sana, ambayo Solomoni aliitumia kutengenezea ile Bahari ya shaba, zile nguzo na vifaa mbalimbali vya shaba.

english: When King Tou of Hamath heard that David had defeated the entire army of Hadadezer king of Zobah,
ekegusii: Tou, omorwoti o Hamati, agachia koigwa ng’a Daudi obuire abarwani bonsi ba Hadadeseri, omorwoti o Soba,
swahili: Tou mfalme wa Hamathi aliposikia kwamba Daudi amelishinda jeshi lote la Hadadezeri mfalme wa Soba,

english: Some time later, Nahash king of the Ammonites died and was succeeded by his son.
ekegusii: Magega y’ayio Nahasi, omorwoti bw’Abaamoni, agakwa, na omomura oye akaba okogamba ase ribaga riaye.
swahili: Baada ya muda, Nahashi mfalme wa Waamoni akafa, mwanawe akaingia mahali pake.

english: When Joab saw the battle lines before him and behind him, he selected some of the best men of Israel and arrayed them against the Arameans.
ekegusii: Ekero Yoabu aroche ng’a esegi nigo ere bosio na magega, agachora abanto abakong’u, abamanyete korwana esegi, akabaroberia barwane n’Abasiiria.
swahili: Yoabu akaona kuwa mbele yake na nyuma yake kumepangwa vita; kwa hiyo akachagua baadhi ya vikosi vilivyo bora sana katika Israeli akavipanga dhidi ya Waaramu.

english: And he placed the rest of the forces under the command of his brother Abishai, who arrayed them against the Ammonites.
ekegusii: Abanto bande abatigari akababeeka inse y’oboteneneri bw’Abisai momura omwabo, akaroberia barwane n’Abaamoni.
swahili: Akawaweka wale wanajeshi wengine waliobaki chini ya amri ya Abishai ndugu yake, nao wakapangwa ili wakabiliane na Waamoni.

english: “If the Arameans are too strong for me,” said Joab, “then you will come to my rescue. And if the Ammonites are too strong for you, then I will come to your rescue.
ekegusii: Erio agateebia Abisai, “Onye Abasiiria bakombua, rirorio oche onkonye, korende onye Abaamoni bagokobua, rirorio inche inchiche noboseemia.
swahili: Yoabu akasema, “Kama Waaramu watanizidi nguvu, basi itakupasa wewe unisaidie; lakini kama Waamoni watakuzidi nguvu, basi mimi nitakusaidia.

english: Be strong and let us fight bravely for our people and for the cities of our God. May the LORD do what is good in His sight.”
ekegusii: Otenene bokong’u, obe omoremu! Torwanere abanto baito na emechie ya Nyasae oito. Na ig’Omonene akore ayaroche are amaya.”
swahili: Uwe hodari na tupigane kwa ujasiri kwa ajili ya watu wetu na miji ya Mungu wetu. Bwana atafanya lile lililo jema machoni pake.”

english: So Joab and his troops advanced to fight the Arameans, who fled before him.
ekegusii: Agwo Yoabu na abanto barenge amo nere bagasuka bagaika ang’e n’Abasiiria ase okorwana esegi, na Abasiiria baria bagatama korwa asare.
swahili: Basi Yoabu na vikosi vyake wakasonga mbele kupigana na Waaramu, nao Waaramu wakakimbia mbele yake.

english: When the Ammonites saw that the Arameans had fled, they too fled before Joab’s brother Abishai, and they entered the city. So Joab went back to Jerusalem.
ekegusii: Abaamoni bagachia korora ng’a Abasiiria batamire, nabarabwo boigo bagatama korwa ase Abisai, momura omwabo Yoabu, bagasoa omochie ime. Erio Yoabu akagenda Yerusalemu.
swahili: Waamoni walipoona Waaramu wanakimbia, nao pia wakakimbia mbele ya nduguye Abishai na kuingia ndani ya mji. Basi Yoabu akarudi Yerusalemu.

english: When the Arameans saw that they had been defeated by Israel, they sent messengers to bring more Arameans from beyond the Euphrates, with Shophach the commander of Hadadezer’s army leading them.
ekegusii: Ekero Abasiiria baroche ng’a babuirwe n’Abaisraeli, bagatoma abanto korangeria Abasiiria, abarenge ng’umbu y’Eufarati, bache batang’anwe na Sofaki, omochiki bw’abasikari ba Hadadeseri.
swahili: Baada ya Waaramu kuona kwamba wameshindwa na Israeli, wakapeleka wajumbe na kuwataka Waaramu wengine kutoka ngʼambo ya Mto Frati, wakiongozwa na Shofaki, jemadari wa jeshi la Hadadezeri.

english: When this was reported to David, he gathered all Israel, crossed the Jordan, advanced toward the Arameans, and arrayed for battle against them. When David lined up to engage them in battle, they fought against him.
ekegusii: Ekero Daudi atebetigwe amang’ana ayio, agasangereria Abaisraeli bonsi amo, akaamboka orooche rwa Yorodani, erio akagenda ase bare, akaira abarwani baye b’esegi gochia kobarwania. Ekero Daudi aroberetie abarwani baye b’esegi korwania Abasiiria, barabwo bakamorwania.
swahili: Daudi alipoambiwa haya, akawakusanya Israeli wote na kuvuka Yordani. Akasonga mbele dhidi yao na akajipanga kuwakabili. Daudi akapanga vita ili kupigana na Waaramu, nao wakapigana dhidi yake.

english: But the Arameans fled before Israel, and David killed seven thousand of their charioteers and forty thousand foot soldiers. He also killed Shophach the commander of their army.
ekegusii: Abasiiria bagatama korwa ase amasio ’Abaisraeli; na Daudi agaita Abasiiria abagendia chigari chilifu isano na ibere (7,000), na abarwani barenge gotaara namagoro chilifu emerongo ene (40,000). Boigo agaita Sofaki, omochiki obo bw’abasikari.
swahili: Lakini Waaramu wakakimbia mbele ya Israeli, naye Daudi akawaua waendesha magari 7,000 na askari wao wa miguu 40,000. Pia akamuua Shofaki, jemadari wa jeshi lao.

english: When Hadadezer’s subjects saw that they had been defeated by Israel, they made peace with David and became subject to him. So the Arameans were unwilling to help the Ammonites anymore.
ekegusii: Ekero abasomba ba Hadadeseri baroche ng’a babuirwe n’Abaisraeli, bagakora omorembe na Daudi, bakebeka inse yaye. Ase ayio Abasiiria tibanchete gokonya Abaamoni naende.
swahili: Raiya wa Hadadezeri walipoona kuwa wameshindwa na Israeli, wakafanya mapatano ya amani na Daudi, wakawa watumishi wake. Hivyo Waaramu hawakukubali kuwasaidia Waamoni tena.

english: And David said, “I will show kindness to Hanun son of Nahash, because his father showed kindness to me.” So David sent messengers to console Hanun concerning his father. But when David’s servants arrived in the land of the Ammonites to console him,
ekegusii: Daudi akabora, “Goika inkorere Hanuni, omomura o Nahasi, amaya, ekiagera ise nigo arenge gonkorera amaya.” Ase igo Daudi agatoma abanto bagende komoremia ase engencho y’ogokwa gwa ise. Abasomba abwo ba Daudi bakagenda ase Hanuni agwo ase ense y’Abaamoni komoremia.
swahili: Daudi akawaza, “Nitamtendea wema Hanuni mwana wa Nahashi, kwa sababu baba yake alinitendea wema.” Hivyo Daudi akatuma wajumbe ili kumfariji Hanuni kwa ajili ya kifo cha baba yake. Watu wa Daudi walipofika kwa Hanuni katika nchi ya Waamoni ili kumfariji,

english: the princes of the Ammonites said to Hanun, “Just because David has sent you comforters, do you really believe he is showing respect for your father? Have not his servants come to you to explore the land, spy it out, and overthrow it?”
ekegusii: Korende abatang’ani b’Abaamoni bagateebia Hanuni, “Inee! Igo okagete ng’a Daudi nigo asigete iso ase ogotoma abanto gocha gokoremia? Taibo. Abasomba baye nigo bachire koroota ense eye bayesarie.”
swahili: wakuu wa Waamoni wakamwambia Hanuni, “Hivi unadhani Daudi anamheshimu baba yako kwa kuwatuma wajumbe kukufariji? Je, hawa watu hawakuja kuipeleleza na kuidadisi nchi ili waishinde?”

english: So Hanun took David’s servants, shaved their beards, cut off their garments at the hips, and sent them away.
ekegusii: Ase igo Hanuni akabwata abasomba ba Daudi akabagingira chinderu chiabo, na akabutora chianga chiabo chikaba ebimini, agachiikeria ebinema, erio akabaseria bakagenda.
swahili: Kwa hiyo Hanuni akawakamata watu wa Daudi, akawanyoa ndevu akakata nguo zao katikati kwenye matako, akawaacha waende zao.

english: When someone came and told David about his men, he sent messengers to meet them, since the men had been thoroughly humiliated. The king told them, “Stay in Jericho until your beards have grown back, and then return.”
ekegusii: Abasomba abwo bakarora obosooku obonene mono, na ekero Daudi atebetigwe buna bakoretwe, agatoma abanto bachie kobarotota na kobateebia, “Omorwoti oteebire ng’a mobeere agwo Yeriko goika chinderu chiaino chimere, erio monyare koirana nka.”
swahili: Mtu mmoja alipofika na kumpasha Daudi habari za watu hawa, akawatuma wajumbe wengine kuwalaki, kwa maana walikuwa wamevunjiwa heshima sana. Mfalme akasema, “Kaeni huko Yeriko mpaka ndevu zenu ziote, ndipo mje.”

english: When the Ammonites realized that they had become a stench to David, Hanun and the Ammonites sent a thousand talents of silver to hire for themselves chariots and horsemen from Aram-naharaim, Aram-maacah, and Zobah.
ekegusii: Abaamoni bakamanya ng’a bekorire koba okogechia ase Daudi, erio Hanuni na Abaamoni bagatoma chifeta chitalanta elifu eyemo goakanera chigari na abariini chibarasi chiare korwa Mesopotamia na Aramu‐Maaka, na korwa Soba.
swahili: Waamoni walipotambua kuwa wamekuwa machukizo kwa Daudi, Hanuni na Waamoni wakatuma talanta 1,000 za fedha ili kukodisha magari ya vita pamoja na waendeshaji wa hayo magari ya kukokotwa na farasi, kutoka Aramu-Naharaimu, Aramu-Maaka na Soba.

english: So they hired for themselves thirty-two thousand chariots, as well as the king of Maacah with his troops, who came and camped near Medeba while the Ammonites came from their cities and marched out for battle.
ekegusii: Bagasaba chigari chilifu emerongo etato na ibere (32,000) amo nomorwoti o Maaka na abarwani baye b’esegi. Barabwo bagacha, bagatoora bosio bwa Medeba. Abaamoni bagasangererigwa korwa ase emechie yabo, bagacha korwana esegi.
swahili: Wakakodisha magari ya vita 32,000 yakiwa na waendeshaji wake, pamoja na mfalme wa Maaka na vikosi vyake, wakaja na kupiga kambi karibu na Medeba. Waamoni nao wakakusanyika toka miji yao, wakatoka ili kupigana vita.

english: On hearing this, David sent Joab and the entire army of mighty men.
ekegusii: Ekero Daudi atebetigwe amang’ana ayio, agatoma Yoabu amo nabarwani bonsi chituoni b’esegi.
swahili: Daudi aliposikia jambo hili, akamtuma Yoabu na jeshi lote la wapiganaji.

english: The Ammonites marched out and arrayed themselves for battle at the entrance to the city, while the kings who had come stayed by themselves in the open country. David Defeats Ammon and Aram (2 Samuel 10:9–19)
ekegusii: Abaamoni bagacha bakarobera agwo ase egesoero ki’omochie, na abarwoti baria konya bachire bakabeera boka aase aarabu.
swahili: Waamoni wakatoka wakajipanga wakiwa tayari kwa vita langoni la mji wao, wakati wale wafalme wengine waliokuja nao walijipanga kwa vita uwanjani.

english: Adam, Seth, Enosh,
ekegusii: Adamu akaibora Seti, na Seti akaibora Enosu;
swahili: Adamu, Sethi, Enoshi,

english: Cush was the father of Nimrod, who began to be a mighty one on the earth.
ekegusii: Kusi akaibora Nimurodi. Nimurodi akaba omonto bw’eritang’ani orenge egiata ase ense.
swahili: Kushi akamzaa Nimrodi, ambaye alikua akawa mtu shujaa katika nchi.

english: Mizraim was the father of the Ludites, the Anamites, the Lehabites, the Naphtuhites,
ekegusii: Misiri nere oiborete Abaludi na Abanami, Abalehabi na Abanafutu,
swahili: Misraimu akawazaa: Waludi, Waanami, Walehabi, Wanaftuhi,

english: the Pathrusites, the Casluhites (from whom the Philistines came), and the Caphtorites.
ekegusii: Abapaturusi na Abakasiluhi (korwa ase bare nao Abafirisiti barwete), na Abakafitori.
swahili: Wapathrusi, Wakasluhi (hao ndio asili ya Wafilisti) na Wakaftori.

english: And Canaan was the father of Sidon his firstborn, and of the Hittites,
ekegusii: Na Kaanani akaibora Sidoni, omwana oye omotangi, na Heti,
swahili: Wana wa Kanaani walikuwa: Sidoni, mzaliwa wake wa kwanza, na Hethi,

english: the Jebusites, the Amorites, the Girgashites,
ekegusii: Abayebusi na Abaamori, na Abagirigasi;
swahili: Wayebusi, Waamori, Wagirgashi,

english: the Hivites, the Arkites, the Sinites,
ekegusii: Abahivi na Abaariki, na Abasini;
swahili: Wahivi, Waariki, Wasini,

english: the Arvadites, the Zemarites, and the Hamathites.
ekegusii: Abaarivadi na Abasemari, na Abahamati.
swahili: Waarvadi, Wasemari na Wahamathi. Wana Wa Shemu

english: The sons of Shem: Elam, Asshur, Arphaxad, Lud, and Aram. The sons of Aram: Uz, Hul, Gether, and Meshech.
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Shemu nabwo aba: Elamu na Asuri, Arifakisadi na Ludi, Aramu na Usi, Huli na Geteri, na Mesheki.
swahili: Wana wa Shemu walikuwa: Elamu, Ashuru, Arfaksadi, Ludi na Aramu. Wana wa Aramu walikuwa: Usi, Huli, Getheri na Mesheki.

english: Arphaxad was the father of Shelah, and Shelah was the father of Eber.
ekegusii: Arifakisadi akaibora Sela, na Sela akaibora Eberi.
swahili: Arfaksadi akamzaa Shela, Shela akamzaa Eberi.

english: Two sons were born to Eber: One was named Peleg, because in his days the earth was divided, and his brother was named Joktan.
ekegusii: Eberi akaibora abana babere abamura. Oria omotangi nigo arenge korokwa Pelegi, ekiagera ase amatuko aye abanto b’ense baatananegete, na omomura omwabo nigo arenge korokwa Yokitani.
swahili: Eberi alipata wana wawili: Mmoja wao aliitwa Pelegi, kwa kuwa wakati wake dunia iligawanyika; nduguye aliitwa Yoktani.

english: And Joktan was the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,
ekegusii: Yokitani akaibora Alimodadi na Selefu, Hasarmaweti na Yera;
swahili: Wana wa Yoktani walikuwa: Almodadi, Shelefu, Hasarmawethi, Yera,

english: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,
ekegusii: Hadoramu na Usali, na Dikila;
swahili: Hadoramu, Uzali, Dikla,

english: Obal, Abimael, Sheba,
ekegusii: Ebali na Abimaeli, na Seba;
swahili: Obali, Abimaeli, Sheba,

english: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab. All these were sons of Joktan.
ekegusii: Ofiri na Havila, na Yobabu. Abwo bonsi nigo barenge abana abamura ba Yokitani.
swahili: Ofiri, Havila na Yobabu. Wote hawa walikuwa wana wa Yoktani.

english: Eber, Peleg, Reu,
ekegusii: na Eberi, na Pelegi, na Reu,
swahili: Eberi, Pelegi, Reu,

english: Serug, Nahor, Terah,
ekegusii: na Serugi, na Nahori, na Tera,
swahili: Serugi, Nahori, Tera,

english: and Abram (that is, Abraham). The Descendants of Abraham (Genesis 25:12–18)
ekegusii: na Aburamu nere Aburaamu. Ororeria rwa Isumaeli (Omoch 25:12-16)
swahili: Tera akamzaa Abramu (yaani, Abrahamu). Jamaa Ya Abrahamu

english: The sons of Abraham were Isaac and Ishmael.
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Aburaamu nabwo Isaka na Isumaeli.
swahili: Abrahamu alikuwa na wana wawili: Isaki na Ishmaeli. Wazao Wa Hagari (Mwanzo 25:12-16)

english: These are their genealogies: Nebaioth the firstborn of Ishmael, then Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,
ekegusii: Oyo noro omooroberio bw’ororeria rwabo. Omwana omomura omotangi o Isumaeli nere Nebayoti; na abande nabwo aba: Kedari na Adibeeli, na Mibusamu;
swahili: Hawa ndio waliokuwa wazao wa Hagari: Nebayothi mzaliwa wa kwanza wa Ishmaeli, Kedari, Adbeeli, Mibsamu,

english: Mishma, Dumah, Massa, Hadad, Tema,
ekegusii: Misima na Duma, Masa na Hadadi, na Tema,
swahili: Mishma, Duma, Masa, Hadadi, Tema,

english: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These were the sons of Ishmael.
ekegusii: Yeturi na Nafisi, na Kedema. Aba nabwo abana abamura ba Isumaeli.
swahili: Yeturi, Nafishi na Kedema. Hao ndio wana wa Ishmaeli. Wazao Wa Ketura

english: The sons born to Keturah, Abraham’s concubine: Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah. The sons of Jokshan: Sheba and Dedan.
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Ketura, omokungu o sere‐sere o Aburaamu, nabwo aba: Simurani na Yokisani, Medani na Midiani, Isibaki na Sua. Abana abamura ba Yokisani nabwo Seba na Dedani.
swahili: Wana waliozaliwa na Ketura suria wa Abrahamu walikuwa: Zimrani, Yokshani, Medani, Midiani, Ishbaki na Shua. Wana wa Yokshani walikuwa: Sheba na Dedani.

english: The sons of Midian: Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah. All of these were Keturah’s sons.
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Midiani nabwo aba: Efa na Eferi, Hanoki na Abida, na Elidaa. Aba bonsi nigo barenge ab’ororeria rwa Ketura. Ororeria rwa Esau (Omoch 36:1-19)
swahili: Wana wa Midiani walikuwa: Efa, Eferi, Hanoki, Abida na Eldaa. Wote hao walikuwa wa uzao wa Ketura. Wazao Wa Sara

english: Abraham was the father of Isaac. The sons of Isaac: Esau and Israel. The Descendants of Esau (Genesis 36:1–19)
ekegusii: Aburaamu akaibora Isaka. Abana abamura ba Isaka nabwo Esau na Israeli.
swahili: Abrahamu alikuwa baba wa Isaki. Wana wa Isaki walikuwa: Esau na Israeli. Wana Wa Esau (Mwanzo 36:1-19)

english: The sons of Esau: Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.
ekegusii: Abana abamura b’Esau nabwo aba: Elifasi na Reueli, Yeusi na Yalamu, na Kora.
swahili: Wana wa Esau walikuwa: Elifazi, Reueli, Yeushi, Yalamu na Kora.

english: The sons of Eliphaz: Teman, Omar, Zepho, Gatam, and Kenaz; and by Timna, Amalek.
ekegusii: Abana abamura b’Elifasi nabwo aba: Temani na Omari, Sefo na Gatamu, Kenasi ase Timuna, na Amaleki.
swahili: Wana wa Elifazi walikuwa: Temani, Omari, Sefo, Gatamu na Kenazi; Elifazi kwa Timna akamzaa Amaleki.

english: The sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah. The Descendants of Seir (Genesis 36:20–30)
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Reueli nabwo aba: Nahati na Zera, Sama na Miza. Abanto bamenyete ase ense ya Edomu kare (Omoch 36:20-30)
swahili: Wana wa Reueli walikuwa: Nahathi, Zera, Shama na Miza. Watu Wa Seiri Waliokuwa Edomu (Mwanzo 36:20-30)

english: The sons of Seir: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan.
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Edomu nabwo aba: Lotani na Sobali, Sibeoni na Ana, Dishoni na Eseri, na Disani.
swahili: Wana wa Seiri walikuwa: Lotani, Shobali, Sibeoni, Ana, Dishoni, Eseri na Dishani.

english: The sons of Lotan: Hori and Homam. Timna was Lotan’s sister.
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Lotani nabwo Hori na Homamu; omosubati omwabo Lotani nigo arenge korokwa Timuna.
swahili: Wana wa Lotani walikuwa wawili: Hori na Homamu. Lotani alikuwa na dada yake aliyeitwa Timna.

english: The sons of Noah: Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
ekegusii: Lameki akaibora Nuhu, na Nuhu akaibora Shemu, na Hamu, na Yafeti.
swahili: Wana wa Noa walikuwa: Shemu, Hamu na Yafethi. Wana Wa Yafethi

english: The sons of Shobal: Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho, and Onam. The sons of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah.
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Sobali nabwo aba: Aliani na Manahati, Ebali na Sefo, na Onamu. Na abana abamura ba Sibeoni nabwo Aya na Ana.
swahili: Wana wa Shobali walikuwa: Alvani, Manahathi, Ebali, Shefo na Onamu. Wana wa Sibeoni walikuwa: Aiya na Ana.

english: The son of Anah: Dishon. The sons of Dishon: Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.
ekegusii: Omwana omomura bw’Ana nere Dishoni. Abana ba Dishoni nabwo aba: Hamurani na Esibani, Itirani na Kerani.
swahili: Mwana wa Ana alikuwa: Dishoni. Nao wana wa Dishoni walikuwa: Hemdani, Eshbani, Ithrani na Kerani.

english: The sons of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan, and Akan. The sons of Dishan: Uz and Aran. The Kings of Edom (Genesis 36:31–43)
ekegusii: Abana abamura b’Eseri nabwo aba: Bilihani na Sawani, na Akani. Abana abamura ba Disani nabwo Usi na Arani. Abarwoti b’Abaedomu (Omoch 36:31-43)
swahili: Wana wa Eseri walikuwa: Bilhani, Zaavani na Akani. Wana wa Dishani walikuwa: Usi na Arani. Watawala Wa Edomu (Mwanzo 36:31-43)

english: These are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom before any king reigned over the Israelites: Bela son of Beor. His city was named Dinhabah.
ekegusii: Aba nabwo abarwoti bagamberete ense y’Abaedomu, ekero omorwoti onde bwensi konya ataragambera Abaisraeli: Bela, mosinto o Beori, oyio omochie oye orenge korokwa Dinihaba.
swahili: Hawa ndio wafalme waliotawala Edomu kabla hajatawala mfalme yeyote wa Waisraeli: Bela mwana wa Beori, ambaye mji wake ni Dinhaba.

english: When Bela died, Jobab son of Zerah from Bozrah reigned in his place.
ekegusii: Ekero Bela akwete, Yobabu, mosinto o Zera, korwa Bosira, akaba okogamba ase ribaga riaye.
swahili: Bela alipofariki, Yobabu mwana wa Zera kutoka Bosra akawa mfalme baada yake.

english: When Jobab died, Husham from the land of the Temanites reigned in his place.
ekegusii: Ekero Yobabu akwete, Husamu, bw’ense y’Abatemani akaba okogamba ase ribaga riaye.
swahili: Yobabu alipofariki, Hushamu kutoka nchi ya Watemani akawa mfalme baada yake.

english: When Husham died, Hadad son of Bedad, who defeated Midian in the country of Moab, reigned in his place. And the name of his city was Avith.
ekegusii: Ekero Husamu akwete, Hadadi, mosinto o Bedadi, oria obuete Abamidiani ase ense ya Moabu, akaba okogamba ase ribaga riaye; na omochie oye noro Awiti.
swahili: Hushamu alipofariki, Hadadi mwana wa Bedadi, aliyeshinda Midiani katika nchi ya Moabu, akawa mfalme baada yake. Mji wake uliitwa Avithi.

english: When Hadad died, Samlah from Masrekah reigned in his place.
ekegusii: Ekero Hadadi akwete, Samula, oyo orwete Masereka, akaba okogamba ase ribaga riaye.
swahili: Hadadi alipofariki, Samla kutoka Masreka akawa mfalme baada yake.

english: When Samlah died, Shaul from Rehoboth on the Euphrates reigned in his place.
ekegusii: Ekero Samula akwete, Saulo oyo orwete Rehoboti, orenge ang’e norooche rw’Eufarati, akaba okogamba ase ribaga riaye.
swahili: Samla alipofariki, Shauli kutoka Rehobothi ngʼambo ya Mto Frati, akawa mfalme baada yake.

english: When Shaul died, Baal-hanan son of Achbor reigned in his place.
ekegusii: Ekero Saulo akwete, Baali Hanani, mosinto bw’Akibori, akaba okogamba ase ribaga riaye.
swahili: Shauli alipofariki, Baal-Hanani mwana wa Akbori akawa mfalme baada yake.

english: The sons of Japheth: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Yafeti nabwo aba: Gomeri na Magogu, Madai na Yavani, Tubali na Meseki, na Tirasi.
swahili: Wana wa Yafethi walikuwa: Gomeri, Magogu, Madai, Yavani, Tubali, Mesheki na Tirasi.

english: When Baal-hanan died, Hadad reigned in his place. His city was named Pau, and his wife’s name was Mehetabel daughter of Matred, the daughter of Me-zahab.
ekegusii: Ekero Baali‐Hanani akwete, Hadadi akaba okogamba ase ribaga riaye. Omochie oye nigo orenge korokwa Pai, na mokaye nigo arenge korokwa Mehetabeli, mosubati o Matiredi o Mesahabu.
swahili: Baal-Hanani alipofariki, Hadadi akawa mfalme baada yake. Mji wake uliitwa Pau, na mkewe aliitwa Mehetabeli binti Matredi, binti Me-Zahabu.

english: Then Hadad died. Now the chiefs of Edom were Timna, Alvah, Jetheth,
ekegusii: Na Hadadi agakwa. Abagaambi b’Abaedomu nabwo aba: Timuna na Alifa, na Yeteti,
swahili: Naye Hadadi pia akafa. Wakuu wa Edomu walikuwa: Timna, Alva, Yethethi,

english: Oholibamah, Elah, Pinon,
ekegusii: Oholibama na Ela, na Pinoni,
swahili: Oholibama, Ela, Pinoni,

english: Kenaz, Teman, Mibzar,
ekegusii: Kenasi na Temani, na Mibusari,
swahili: Kenazi, Temani, Mibsari,

english: Magdiel, and Iram. These were the chiefs of Edom.
ekegusii: Magadieli na Iramu. Abwo nabwo barenge abagaambi b’ebisaku bia Edomu.
swahili: Magdieli na Iramu. Hao ndio wakuu wa makabila ya Edomu.

english: The sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Gomeri nabwo aba: Asikenasi na Rifati, na Togarima.
swahili: Wana wa Gomeri walikuwa: Ashkenazi, Rifathi na Togarma.

english: And the sons of Javan: Elishah, Tarshish, the Kittites, and the Rodanites.
ekegusii: Na abana abamura ba Yavani nabwo aba: Elisha na Tarisisi, na Kitimu, na Rodanimu.
swahili: Wana wa Yavani walikuwa: Elisha, Tarshishi, Kitimu na Rodanimu. Wana Wa Hamu

english: The sons of Ham: Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Hamu nabwo aba: Kusi na Misiri, Putu na Kaanani.
swahili: Wana wa Hamu walikuwa: Kushi, Misraimu, Putu na Kanaani.

english: The sons of Cush: Seba, Havilah, Sabta, Raamah, and Sabteca. The sons of Raamah: Sheba and Dedan.
ekegusii: Na abana abamura ba Kusi nabwo aba: Seba na Havila, Sabuta na Raama, na Sabiteka. Na abana abamura ba Raama nabwo Seba na Dedani.
swahili: Wana wa Kushi walikuwa: Seba, Havila, Sabta, Raama na Sabteka. Wana wa Raama walikuwa: Sheba na Dedani.

english: In the spring, at the time when kings march out to war, Joab led out the army and ravaged the land of the Ammonites. He came to Rabbah and besieged it, but David remained in Jerusalem. And Joab attacked Rabbah and demolished it.
ekegusii: Ase engaki y’ogosimeka ekero abarwoti baare koba bakogenda korwana esegi, Yoabu agatang’ana abarwani b’esegi, agasaria ense y’Abaamoni, akagenda koboera omochie o Raba, korende Daudi akabeera agwo Yerusalemu. Yoabu akarwania Raba, akayobua akayosaria.
swahili: Mwanzoni mwa mwaka mpya, wakati ambapo wafalme huenda vitani, Yoabu aliliongoza jeshi. Aliangamiza nchi ya Waamoni, na akaenda Raba na kuuzingira, lakini Daudi alibaki Yerusalemu. Yoabu akashambulia Raba na kuuacha ukiwa magofu.

english: Then David took the crown from the head of their king. It was found to weigh a talent of gold and was set with precious stones, and it was placed on David’s head. And David took a great amount of plunder from the city.
ekegusii: Erio Daudi akarusia egutwa y’etaabu korwa ase omotwe bw’omorwoti bw’aroro, akanyora ng’a oborito bw’egutwa eria nigo bwarenge koreng’ana chikiro emerongo etato na inye, naende nigo yachabeire amagena e rigori rinene. Egutwa eyio ekabekwa igoro y’omotwe o Daudi. Ere agasakora ebinto ebinge mono bi’omochie oria.
swahili: Daudi akachukua taji kutoka kwa kichwa cha mfalme wao, lililokuwa na uzito wa talanta moja ya dhahabu, nayo ilizungushiwa vito vya thamani. Ikawekwa juu ya kichwa cha Daudi. Alichukua nyara nyingi kutoka mjini huo.

english: David brought out the people who were there and put them to work with saws, iron picks, and axes. And he did the same to all the Ammonite cities. Then David and all his troops returned to Jerusalem. Battles against the Philistines (2 Samuel 21:15–22)
ekegusii: Naende akabasokia abanto barenge ase omochie ime, akababetereria gokora emeremo ne chinseke, na amakombe ’ebioma, na ebisire. Naboigo Daudi akorete abanto b’emechie yonsi y’Abaamoni. Erio akairana Yerusalemu amo nabaanto baye. Abaisraeli bakorwania amamonto ’Abafilisti (2 Sam 21:15-22)
swahili: Akawatoa watu waliokuwa humo, akawaweka wafanye kazi kwa misumeno, sululu za chuma na mashoka. Daudi akafanya hivi kwa miji yote ya Waamoni. Kisha Daudi na jeshi lake lote wakarudi Yerusalemu. Vita Na Wafilisti (2 Samweli 21:15-22)

english: Some time later, war broke out with the Philistines at Gezer. At that time Sibbecai the Hushathite killed Sippai, a descendant of the Rephaim, and the Philistines were subdued.
ekegusii: Magega y’ayio esegi ekaba ase egati y’Abaisraeli na Abafirisiti agwo Geseri. Sibekai Omohusa agaita Sipai, omonto bw’ororeria rw’amamonto; na igo Abafirisiti bakabugwa na kogamberwa.
swahili: Baada ya muda, kulitokea vita dhidi ya Wafilisti, huko Gezeri. Wakati huo Sibekai, Mhushathi, akamuua Sipai, aliyekuwa mmoja wa wazao wa Warefai, nao Wafilisti wakashindwa.

english: Once again there was a battle with the Philistines, and Elhanan son of Jair killed Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite, the shaft of whose spear was like a weaver’s beam.
ekegusii: Naende esegi ekaba n’Abafilisti; Elihanani, mosinto o Yairi, agaita Lahami, omomura omwabo Goliato korwa Gati, oria orotanga rwe ritimo riaye rwareng’aine omwaro omonene.
swahili: Katika vita vingine na Wafilisti, Elhanani mwana wa Yairi alimuua Lahmi nduguye Goliathi, Mgiti, ambaye mkuki wake ulikuwa na mpini kama mti wa mfumaji.

english: And there was still another battle at Gath, where there was a man of great stature with six fingers on each hand and six toes on each foot—twenty-four in all. He too was descended from Rapha,
ekegusii: Naende esegi ekaba agwo Gati. Omonto omotambe narengeo, oyorenge nebiara bitano na ekemo (6) ase kera okoboko, na bitano na ekemo (6) ase kera okogoro; bionsi nigo biarenge emerongo ebere na bine. Ere boigo noyomo bw’amamonto orenge.
swahili: Katika vita vingine tena, vilivyopiganwa huko Gathi, kulikuwako na mtu mmoja mkubwa mwenye vidole sita katika kila mkono na vidole sita katika kila mguu: jumla vidole ishirini na vinne. Yeye alikuwa pia mzao wa Mrefai.

english: and when he taunted Israel, Jonathan the son of David’s brother Shimei killed him.
ekegusii: Ere akarama Abaisraeli, na Yonathani, omomura o Simea omwabo Daudi, akamoita.
swahili: Alipowadhihaki Israeli, Yonathani, mwana wa Shimea, nduguye Daudi, akamuua.

english: So these descendants of Rapha in Gath fell at the hands of David and his servants.
ekegusii: Abanto abwo nigo barenge ab’ororeria rw’amamonto korwa Gati. Abwo nigo Daudi na abanto baye baabaitete.
swahili: Hawa walikuwa ndio wazao wa Warefai huko Gathi, nao walianguka kwa mikono ya Daudi na watu wake.

english: Then Satan rose up against Israel and incited David to take a census of Israel.
ekegusii: Saitani akagania gochanda Abaisraeli, agasukia enkoro ya Daudi ase okobara Abaisraeli.
swahili: Shetani akainuka dhidi ya Israeli na kumshawishi Daudi ahesabu watu wa Israeli.

english: “Go and tell David that this is what the LORD says: ‘I am offering you three options. Choose one of them, and I will carry it out against you.’”
ekegusii: “Genda okwane na Daudi, omoteebie ng’a aya naro inche Omonene ngoteeba: Nabekire asore amang’ana atato; ase ayio chora erimo, eri ngochia kogokorera.”
swahili: “Nenda ukamwambie Daudi, hivi ndivyo asemavyo Bwana: ‘Ninakupa wewe uchaguzi wa mambo matatu. Nichagulie mojawapo nitakalotenda dhidi yako.’ ”

english: So Gad went and said to David, “This is what the LORD says: ‘You must choose
ekegusii: Erio Gadi akagenda ase Daudi akamoteebia, “Aya nar’Omonene agoteeba: Chora erimo eri oranche.
swahili: Kwa hiyo Gadi akamwendea Daudi akamwambia, “Hili ndilo Bwana asemalo: ‘Chagua:

english: between three years of famine, three months of being swept away before your enemies and overtaken by their swords, or three days of the sword of the LORD—days of plague upon the land, with the angel of the LORD ravaging every part of Israel.’ Now then, decide how I should reply to Him who sent me.”
ekegusii: Noganetie enchara echiche ase emiaka etato; gose nigo oganetie oserigwe nababisa bao ase engaki y’emetienyi etato, babe bakobabuna‐buna na kobaita nemioro; gose mochandwe n’omoro Omonene ase amatuko atato, ekero oborwaire obobe bw’ogoita abanto borache igoro ase ense eye yaino, na omomalaika bw’Omonene ogosaria ense y’Abaisraeli? Bono nteebie aya ngochia koiraneria oria ontoma.”
swahili: miaka mitatu ya njaa, au miezi mitatu ya kushindwa na adui zako, ukipatwa na upanga wao, au siku tatu za upanga wa Bwana, yaani, siku tatu za tauni katika nchi na malaika wa Bwana akiangamiza kila mahali katika Israeli.’ Sasa basi, amua jinsi nitakavyomjibu yeye aliyenituma.”

english: David answered Gad, “I am deeply distressed. Please, let me fall into the hand of the LORD, for His mercies are very great; but do not let me fall into the hands of men.” A Plague on Israel (2 Samuel 24:15–17)
ekegusii: Daudi akairaneria Gadi, “Inche nasoire ase emechando emenene. Gaki bono, tiga ingwe ase okoboko kw’Omonene, ekiagera amaabera aye namanene mono; korende ase amaboko a Mwanyabaanto tintageti ingweo.”
swahili: Daudi akamwambia Gadi, “Ninayo mahangaiko makubwa. Mimi na nianguke mikononi mwa Bwana kwa maana rehema zake ni kuu mno, lakini usiniache niangukie mikononi mwa wanadamu.”

english: So the LORD sent a plague upon Israel, and seventy thousand men of Israel fell dead.
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene akarentera Abaisraeli oborwaire obobe bw’ogoita; Abaisraeli chilifu emerongo etano na ebere (70,000) bagakwa.
swahili: Basi Bwana akatuma tauni katika Israeli, watu 70,000 wa Israeli wakafa.

english: Then God sent an angel to destroy Jerusalem, but as the angel was doing so, the LORD saw it and relented from the calamity, and He said to the angel who was destroying the people, “Enough! Withdraw your hand now!” At that time the angel of the LORD was standing by the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.
ekegusii: Nyasae agatoma omomalaika oye gochia ase Yerusalemu koyosaria; korende ekero omomalaika oria abeete ang’e koyosaria, Omonene akaywechandera, akaonchoreria ebirengererio biaye igoro y’obobe boria, agateebia omomalaika oria ogendererete gosaria omochie, “Bono aisanire, ororobia okoboko kwao!” Omomalaika oria konya oikire ang’e nekeooreri ki’Orinani Omoyebusi.
swahili: Mungu akapeleka malaika kuangamiza Yerusalemu. Lakini malaika alipokuwa akifanya hivyo, Bwana akaona na akahuzunika kwa sababu ya maafa, akamwambia yule malaika aliyekuwa anaangamiza watu, “Yatosha! Rudisha mkono wako.” Wakati huo malaika wa Bwana alikuwa amesimama katika sakafu ya kupuria nafaka ya Arauna Myebusi.

english: When David lifted up his eyes and saw the angel of the LORD standing between heaven and earth, with a drawn sword in his hand stretched out over Jerusalem, David and the elders, clothed in sackcloth, fell facedown.
ekegusii: Daudi akarigereria akarora omomalaika oria bw’Omonene oteneine gati y’ense na igoro; ere nabwate omoyio o birende ase okoboko kwaye okoramborete gochia igoro ya Yerusalemu, na Daudi na abagaaka babegete chianga chi’echigunia, bagatung’ama inse bakaumama.
swahili: Daudi akayainua macho yake akamwona huyo malaika wa Bwana akiwa amesimama katikati ya mbingu na dunia, naye ameunyoosha upanga wake juu ya Yerusalemu tayari kuangamiza. Kisha Daudi na wazee, waliokuwa wamevaa nguo za gunia, wakaanguka kifudifudi.

english: And David said to God, “Was it not I who gave the order to count the people? I am the one who has sinned and acted wickedly. But these sheep, what have they done? O LORD my God, please let Your hand fall upon me and my father’s house, but do not let this plague remain upon Your people.” David Builds an Altar (2 Samuel 24:18–25)
ekegusii: Erio Daudi agateebia Nyasae, “Inee! Tari inche nachigete abanto bakabarwa? Ninche nakorire ebibe; nakorire amang’ana amabe mono. Korende ching’ondi echi, ninki chiakorire? Nagosabire aye Omonene, Nyasae one, tiga okoboko kwao kong’ake inche amo neamate ya tata; korende oborwaire tibobaisa goita abanto bao.”
swahili: Daudi akamwambia Mungu, “Je, si mimi ndiye niliyeamuru watu wahesabiwe? Mimi ndiye niliyetenda dhambi na kukosa. Hawa ni kondoo tu. Wamefanya nini? Ee Bwana, Mungu wangu, mkono wako na uwe juu yangu mimi na jamaa yangu, lakini usiache tauni hii iendelee juu ya watu wako.”

english: Then the angel of the LORD ordered Gad to tell David to go up and build an altar to the LORD on the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.
ekegusii: Erio omomalaika bw’Omonene agachiika Gadi ateebie Daudi ng’a agende atenenie egesasiimero ase Omonene agwo ase ekeooreri ki’Orinani, Omoyebusi.
swahili: Kisha malaika wa Bwana akamwamuru Gadi amwambie Daudi apande na kumjengea Bwana madhabahu kwenye sakafu ya kupuria nafaka ya Arauna Myebusi.

english: So David went up at the word that Gad had spoken in the name of the LORD.
ekegusii: Ase ogochika kw’Omonene koria Gadi amotebetie Daudi, Daudi agatiira.
swahili: Kwa hiyo Daudi akakwea, akalitii lile neno ambalo Gadi alikuwa amelisema katika jina la Bwana.

english: So David said to Joab and the commanders of the troops, “Go and count the Israelites from Beersheba to Dan and bring me a report, so that I may know their number.”
ekegusii: Ase igo Daudi agateebia Yoabu na abatang’ani b’abasikari, “Genda mobare Abaisraeli korwa Beeri‐Seba goika Dani, erio mondetere amang’ana imanye omobaro obo.”
swahili: Kwa hiyo Daudi akamwambia Yoabu na majemadari wa jeshi, “Nendeni mkawahesabu Waisraeli kuanzia Beer-Sheba mpaka Dani. Kisha nileteeni taarifa ili kwamba niweze kufahamu wako wangapi.”

english: Now Ornan was threshing wheat when he turned and saw the angel; and his four sons who were with him hid themselves.
ekegusii: Bono Orinani nigo arenge koora engano, na agwo akeonchora akarora omomalaika, na abana baye abamura baane abarenge amo nero bakebisa.
swahili: Arauna alipokuwa akipura ngano, akageuka akamwona yule malaika. Wanawe wanne waliokuwa pamoja naye wakajificha, yeye akaendelea kupura ngano.

english: David came to Ornan, and when Ornan looked out and saw David, he left the threshing floor and bowed facedown before David.
ekegusii: Daudi agacha ase Orinani, na ekero Orinani amorooche akarua agwo ase ekeooreri, agacha agatung’ama, akaumama ase obosio bwa Daudi.
swahili: Kisha Daudi akakaribia, Arauna alipotazama na kumwona, akaondoka kwenye uwanja wa kupuria nafaka akamsujudia Daudi akiuinamisha uso wake ardhini.

english: Then David said to Ornan, “Grant me the site of this threshing floor, that I may build an altar to the LORD. Sell it to me for the full price, so that the plague upon the people may be halted.”
ekegusii: Daudi agateebia Orinani, “Ing’a ensemo eyio y’ekeooreri, ing’agachere Omonene egesasiimero, erinde oborwaire botangwe korwa ase abanto. Inche ningakane rigori riaye rionsi.”
swahili: Daudi akamwambia, “Nipatie huu uwanja wako wa kupuria nafaka ili niweze kujenga madhabahu ya Bwana tauni ipate kukomeshwa katika watu. Niuzie kwa bei yake kamili.”

english: Ornan said to David, “My lord the king may take whatever seems good. Look, I will give the oxen for the burnt offerings, the threshing sledges for the wood, and the wheat for the grain offering—I will give it all.”
ekegusii: Erio Orinani agateebia Daudi, “Ira ekeooreri ekio! Aye omonene one omorwoti, kora eki oranche. Rora, narure chiombe chibe ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa na ebikorero ebi bi’okoorera bibe chinko, na engano ebe okoruegwa kw’endagera. Nakobieire bionsi.”
swahili: Arauna akamwambia Daudi, “Uchukue huo uwanja. Mfalme bwana wangu na afanye lolote analopenda. Tazama, nitatoa maksai kwa ajili ya sadaka za kuteketezwa, vifaa vya kupuria kuwa kuni, pamoja na ngano kwa ajili ya dhabihu ya nafaka. Natoa hivi vyote.”

english: “No,” replied King David, “I insist on paying the full price, for I will not take for the LORD what belongs to you, nor will I offer burnt offerings that cost me nothing.”
ekegusii: Omorwoti Daudi agakania Orinani, akamoteebia, “Yaya taibo, korende nigo ndabiakanere rigori riikeranu; tinkoira ekere ekiao koa Omonene gose okorua ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa eke ntaakanereti.”
swahili: Lakini Mfalme Daudi akamjibu Arauna, “La hasha! Lakini ninasisitiza kwamba nitalipa bei yake kamili. Sitachukua kilicho chako kwa ajili ya Bwana au kutoa sadaka ya kuteketezwa ambayo hainigharimu chochote.”

english: So David paid Ornan six hundred shekels of gold for the site.
ekegusii: Ase igo Daudi akaa Orinani etaabu y’oborito bwe chisekeli amagana atano na rimo agoakanera ekeooreri keria.
swahili: Basi Daudi akamlipa Arauna shekeli za dhahabu 600 kwa ajili ya ule uwanja.

english: And there he built an altar to the LORD and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings. He called upon the LORD, who answered him with fire from heaven on the altar of burnt offering.
ekegusii: Daudi akaagachera Omonene egesasiimero aroro, akarua ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa, na ebi’omorembe, agasaba Omonene, nere akamoiraneria ase ogotoma omorero korwa igoro gocha ase egesasiimero keria gi’ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa.
swahili: Kisha Daudi akamjengea Bwana madhabahu mahali hapo, na kutoa sadaka za kuteketezwa na sadaka za amani. Akamwita Bwana naye Bwana akajibu maombi yake kwa moto toka mbinguni juu ya madhabahu ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa.

english: Then the LORD spoke to the angel, who put his sword back into its sheath.
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene agachiika omomalaika oria, na ere akairania omoyio oye ime ase ekegoocho.
swahili: Kisha Bwana akanena na yule malaika, naye akarudisha upanga wake katika ala yake.

english: At that time, when David saw that the LORD had answered him at the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite, he offered sacrifices there.
ekegusii: Korwa ase engaki eria, ekero Daudi aroche ng’a Omonene oiraneirie ogosaba kwaye ase ekeooreri ki’Orinani Omoyebusi, akarua ebing’wanso biaye aroro agwo.
swahili: Wakati huo, Daudi alipoona kwamba Bwana amemjibu kule kwenye uwanja wa kupuria nafaka wa Arauna Myebusi, akatoa dhabihu huko.

english: For the tabernacle of the LORD that Moses had made in the wilderness and the altar of burnt offering were presently at the high place in Gibeon,
ekegusii: Korende ase engaki eria Eema y’Omonene, eria Musa atenenetie agwo ase erooro, na egesasiimero gi’ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa nigo kiarenge agwo aase aimokererete igoro aaria Gibeoni.
swahili: Maskani ya Bwana ambayo Mose aliitengeneza kule jangwani, pamoja na madhabahu ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa kwa wakati huo vilikuwa viko mahali pa juu pa kuabudia huko Gibeoni.

english: But Joab replied, “May the LORD multiply His troops a hundred times over. My lord the king, are they not all servants of my lord? Why does my lord want to do this? Why should he bring guilt on Israel?”
ekegusii: Yoabu agateeba, “Omonene amente abanto baye bamentekane ara rigana ase omobaro obo. Inee! Aye omorwoti, omonene one, abanto aba bonsi tibari abasomba bao? Nase ki aye omonene one okogania gokora ayio? Nase ki ogochia korenta okomocha igoro ase Abaisraeli?”
swahili: Yoabu akajibu, “ Bwana na aongeze jeshi lake mara mia na zaidi. Mfalme bwana wangu, kwani hawa wote si raiya wa bwana wangu? Kwa nini bwana wangu unataka kufanya hivi? Kwa nini kuleta hatia juu ya Israeli?”

english: but David could not go before it to inquire of God, because he was afraid of the sword of the angel of the LORD.
ekegusii: Korende Daudi tagendete ase egesasiimero keria koboria Nyasae, ekiagera nigo oboete omoyio oria bw’omomalaika bw’Omonene.
swahili: Lakini Daudi hakuthubutu kuisogelea ili kumuuliza Mungu, kwa sababu aliuogopa upanga wa yule malaika wa Bwana.

english: Nevertheless, the king’s word prevailed against Joab. So Joab departed and traveled throughout Israel, and then he returned to Jerusalem.
ekegusii: Korende ring’ana ri’omorwoti rikaba ne chinguru igoro ya Yoabu. Erio Yoabu akaimoka akagenda ase Abaisraeli bonsi, erio akairana gocha Yerusalemu.
swahili: Hata hivyo, neno la mfalme likawa na nguvu juu ya Yoabu; kwa hiyo Yoabu akaondoka na kuzunguka Israeli yote kisha akarudi Yerusalemu.

english: And Joab reported to David the total number of the troops. In all Israel there were 1,100,000 men who drew the sword, including 470,000 in Judah.
ekegusii: Yoabu akaa Daudi omobaro bw’abaanto. Ase Abaisraeli bonsi abwo barenge komanya korwana esegi nemioro nigo barenge abanto emilioni eyemo, ne chilifu rigana erimo (1,100,000), na ase Abayuda abanto chilifu amagana ane na emerongo etano na ebere (470,000).
swahili: Yoabu akampa Daudi jumla ya idadi ya watu wanaoweza kupigana. Katika Israeli kulikuwa na watu 1,100,000 ambao wangeweza kutumia upanga na katika Yuda watu 470,000.

english: But Joab did not include Levi and Benjamin in the count, because the king’s command was detestable to him. Judgment for David’s Sin (2 Samuel 24:10–14)
ekegusii: Korende Yoabu tabarete Abalawi na Ababenjamini, ekiagera ogochika koria omorwoti aruete nigo kwamogechetie.
swahili: Lakini Yoabu hakuwahesabu Walawi na Wabenyamini, kwa sababu alichukizwa sana na amri ya mfalme.

english: This command was also evil in the sight of God; so He struck Israel.
ekegusii: Amang’ana ayio akoregete akagechia Nyasae; ere akaa Abaisraeli amaakwa.
swahili: Amri hii ilikuwa mbaya machoni pa Mungu pia; hivyo akaiadhibu Israeli.

english: Then David said to God, “I have sinned greatly because I have done this thing. Now I beg You to take away the iniquity of Your servant, for I have acted very foolishly.”
ekegusii: Erio Daudi agateebia Nyasae, “Nakorire ebibe ebinene ase aya nakorire. Korende bono nagosabire, onyabere inche, omosomba oo, ogosaria kwane, naki nigo nakorire egento ki’oboriri obonene.”
swahili: Kisha Daudi akamwambia Mungu, “Nimetenda dhambi kubwa kwa kufanya jambo hili. Sasa, ninakusihi, ondoa hatia ya mtumishi wako. Nimefanya jambo la kipumbavu sana.”

english: And the LORD instructed Gad, David’s seer,
ekegusii: Omonene agakwana na Gadi, omoorori o Daudi, akamoteebia,
swahili: Bwana akamwambia Gadi, mwonaji wa Daudi,

english: Then David said, “Here shall be the house of the LORD God, as well as the altar of burnt offering for Israel.”
ekegusii: Daudi agateeba, “Aiga nao egesasiimero ki’Omonene kerabe ase Abaisraeli bakoruera ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa.” Okwebeka ang’e ase okoagacha enyomba ya Nyasae
swahili: Ndipo Daudi akasema, “Nyumba ya Bwana Mungu itakuwa mahali hapa, pia pamoja na madhabahu ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa kwa ajili ya Israeli.” Maandalizi Kwa Ajili Ya Hekalu

english: He is the one who will build a house for My Name. He will be My son, and I will be his Father. And I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Israel forever.’
ekegusii: Ere naagache enyomba ase engencho y’erieta riane. Ere nabe omwana one, nainche nimbe ise, na inche ninkore ekerogo kiaye ki’oborwoti bw’Abaisraeli kebe ne chinguru goika kare na kare.
swahili: Yeye ndiye atakayejenga nyumba kwa ajili ya Jina langu. Yeye atakuwa mwanangu, nami nitakuwa baba yake. Nami nitakifanya imara kiti chake cha enzi cha utawala wake katika Israeli milele.’

english: Now, my son, may the LORD be with you, and may you succeed in building the house of the LORD your God, as He said you would.
ekegusii: “Bono omwana one, Omonene abe amo naye, erio obe nokogenderera okuya ase okoagacha enyomba y’Omonene, Nyasae oo, buna akwanete igoro yao.
swahili: “Sasa, mwanangu, Bwana awe pamoja nawe, nawe uwe na mafanikio upate kuijenga nyumba ya Bwana Mungu wako, kama alivyosema utafanya.

english: Above all, may the LORD give you insight and understanding when He puts you in command over Israel, so that you may keep the Law of the LORD your God.
ekegusii: Tiga Omonene akoe obong’aini na okomanya, erio ekero orabe gokogambera Abaisraeli obwate amachiiko a Omonene, Nyasae oo.
swahili: Bwana na akupe hekima na ufahamu wakati atakuweka juu ya Israeli, ili uweze kuishika sheria ya Bwana Mungu wako.

english: Then you will succeed, if you carefully follow the statutes and ordinances that the LORD commanded Moses for Israel. Be strong and courageous. Do not be afraid or discouraged.
ekegusii: Korarende na kobwata emeroberio yonsi eyi’Omonene achigete Musa ase engencho y’Abaisraeli nigo orasesenigwe. Obe omokong’u na omoremu! Toiroka, tobaisa gokwa omoyo!
swahili: Ndipo utakapofanikiwa, ikiwa utakuwa na bidii kutii amri na sheria Bwana alizompa Mose kwa ajili ya Israeli. Uwe hodari na ushujaa. Usiogope wala usikate tamaa.

english: Now behold, I have taken great pains to provide for the house of the LORD—100,000 talents of gold, 1,000,000 talents of silver, and bronze and iron too great to be weighed. I have also provided timber and stone, and you may add to them.
ekegusii: Ase ogwechanda mono nasangereirie ebinto bi’okoagachera enyomba y’Omonene. Nasangereirie chitaabu chitalanta chilifu rigana erimo (100,000) ne chifeta chitalanta emilioni eyemo (1,000,000), ne chitaai amo nebioma ebinge mono, bitari korengeka. Boigo narentire chibao na amagena. Ase ebinto ebio naye omente ebinde.
swahili: “Nimejitaabisha sana ili kupata mahitaji kwa ajili ya Hekalu la Bwana: talanta 100,000 za dhahabu, talanta 1,000,000 za fedha na kiasi kisichopimika cha shaba na chuma, pia mbao na mawe. Nawe waweza kuviongeza.

english: You also have many workers: stonecutters, masons, carpenters, and men skilled in every kind of work—
ekegusii: Nigo obwate abakori emeremo abange: abaabaachi amagena, na abaagacheri amagena, na abasenia be chibao, na abanto bamanyete gokora emeremo ende yonsi
swahili: Unao wafanyakazi wengi: Wachonga mawe, waashi na maseremala, pamoja na watu walio na ustadi katika kila kazi

english: in gold and silver, bronze and iron—craftsmen beyond number. Now begin the work, and may the LORD be with you.”
ekegusii: ase chitaabu, ne chifeta, na etai. Imoka, ochake gokora emeremo! Omonene abe amo naye.”
swahili: wa kufua dhahabu, fedha, shaba na chuma, mafundi wasiohesabika. Sasa basi anza kazi hii, naye Bwana awe pamoja nawe.”

english: Then David ordered all the leaders of Israel to help his son Solomon:
ekegusii: Daudi agachiika abaraai bonsi b’Abaisraeli ng’a babe bagokonya Sulemani, omwana oye, akabateebia,
swahili: Kisha Daudi akawaamuru viongozi wote wa Israeli wamsaidie Solomoni mwanawe.

english: “Is not the LORD your God with you, and has He not granted you rest on every side? For He has given the inhabitants of the land into my hand, and the land has been subdued before the LORD and His people.
ekegusii: “Inee! Omonene, Nyasae oino, tari amo nainwe? Naende tabaete omorembe ase chinsemo chiaino chionsi? Ere obekire abanto abanyene ense eye ase okoboko kwane; na ense eye nkogambera yabekirwe inse y’Omonene na inse y’abanto baye.
swahili: Akawaambia, “Je, Bwana Mungu wenu si yuko pamoja na ninyi? Pia si amewapa raha pande zote? Kwa maana amewatia wenyeji wa nchi mkononi mwangu, nayo nchi iko chini ya Bwana na watu wake.

english: Now set your heart and soul to seek the LORD your God. Get started building the sanctuary of the LORD God, so that you may bring the ark of the covenant of the LORD and the holy articles of God into the temple that will be built for the Name of the LORD.”
ekegusii: Bono beka ebirengererio biaino ne chinkoro chiaino ase okomorigia Omonene, Nyasae oino. Imoka moagache obomenyo Obochenu ase Omonene, erinde Esanduki ere ne chibao chiriikire okobwatana kw’Omonene na ebikorero ebichenu bia Nyasae birentwe ime ase enyomba eye eraagachwe ase engencho yerieta ri’Omonene.”
swahili: Sasa itoeni mioyo yenu na nafsi zenu katika kumtafuta Bwana Mungu wenu. Anzeni kujenga Maskani ya Bwana Mungu, ili mweze kulileta Sanduku la Agano la Bwana na vyombo vitakatifu vya Mungu katika Hekalu litakalojengwa kwa ajili ya Jina la Bwana.”

english: So David gave orders to gather the foreigners in the land of Israel, from whom he appointed stonecutters to prepare finished stones for building the house of God.
ekegusii: Daudi agachiika abamenyi abarenge ase ense y’Abaisraeli basangererigwe amo, akababeeka kobaacha amagena na koyaroisia ase okoagachera enyomba ya Nyasae.
swahili: Kwa hiyo Daudi akatoa amri wakusanyike wageni wote waliokuwa wanaishi Israeli, na kutoka miongoni mwao akaweka waashi ili kuchonga mawe kwa ajili ya kujenga nyumba ya Mungu.

english: David provided a large quantity of iron to make the nails for the doors of the gateways and for the fittings, together with more bronze than could be weighed
ekegusii: Naende Daudi akarenta ebioma ebinge bi’okoroisigwa emesumari y’ebisieri bi’ebiita amo nebibwatero, akarenta ne chitaai chinyinge chitare korengeka.
swahili: Daudi akatoa chuma tele ili kutengenezea misumari kwa ajili ya mafungo ya malango ya nyumba na shaba tele isiyopimika.

english: and more cedar logs than could be counted; for the Sidonians and Tyrians had brought a large quantity of cedar logs to David.
ekegusii: Boigo akarenta chibao chi’emecharake chitare kobareka, ekiagera Abasidoni nigo barenterete Daudi emecharake emenge mono.
swahili: Pia akatoa magogo ya mierezi yasiyohesabika, kwa kuwa Wasidoni na Watiro walikuwa wamemletea Daudi idadi kubwa ya mierezi.

english: And David said, “My son Solomon is young and inexperienced, and the house to be built for the LORD must be exceedingly magnificent—famous and glorious throughout all lands. Therefore I must make preparations for it.” So David made lavish preparations before his death. Solomon Anointed to Build the Temple
ekegusii: Daudi nigo arengereretie ng’a Sulemani, omwana oye omoke otaramanya amange, na enyomba egochia koagachwa ase Omonene goika ebe engiya mono, naende eramanyekane ase ense yonsi ng’a nigo ere nobonene; na igo ere bweka goika abeeke ebinto bionsi ang’e. Ase ayio Daudi agasangereria ebinto ebinge ekero atarakwa.
swahili: Daudi akasema, “Mwanangu Solomoni bado ni mdogo wa umri na hana uzoefu. Nyumba itakayojengwa kwa ajili ya Bwana inatakiwa iwe yenye uzuri mwingi na sifa na fahari mbele ya mataifa yote. Kwa hiyo nitaifanyia matayarisho.” Daudi akafanya matayarisho makubwa kabla ya kifo chake.

english: Then David called for his son Solomon and instructed him to build a house for the LORD, the God of Israel.
ekegusii: Akarangeria Sulemani, omwana oye, akamochika aagachere Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli enyomba.
swahili: Kisha akamwita Solomoni mwanawe akamwagiza kujenga nyumba kwa ajili ya Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli.

english: “My son,” said David to Solomon, “it was in my heart to build a house for the Name of the LORD my God,
ekegusii: Daudi agateebia Sulemani, “Omwana one, nigo biarenge ebirengererio biane ng’a ning’agachere erieta ri’Omonene, Nyasae one, enyomba.
swahili: Daudi akamwambia Solomoni: “Mwanangu, nilikuwa na jambo hili ndani ya moyo wangu kujenga nyumba kwa ajili ya Jina la Bwana Mungu wangu.

english: but this word of the LORD came to me: ‘You have shed much blood and waged great wars. You are not to build a house for My Name because you have shed so much blood on the ground before Me.
ekegusii: Korende ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha ase ’nde, riganteebia: Aye gwaiteire amanyinga amange, naende kwarwanire chiseegi chinene; na ase engencho y’amanyinga aya amange gwaiteire ase obosio bwane tokonyara koagacha enyomba ase engencho y’erieta riane.
swahili: Lakini neno hili la Bwana likanijia, kusema: ‘Wewe umemwaga damu nyingi na kupigana vita vingi. Wewe hutajenga nyumba kwa ajili ya Jina langu, kwa sababu umemwaga damu nyingi juu ya nchi machoni pangu.

english: But a son will be born to you who will be a man of rest. I will give him rest from all his enemies on every side; for his name will be Solomon, and I will grant to Israel peace and quiet during his reign.
ekegusii: Rora noiborerwe omwana omomura oyorabe omonto bw’omorembe; inche nimoe omorembe ase ababisa baye bonsi bamoetanaine. Nigo ararokwe Sulemani, na ase amatuko aye ning’ee Abaisraeli omorembe na obotoereru.
swahili: Lakini utakuwa na mwana ambaye atakuwa mtu wa amani na utulivu nami nitampa utulivu mbele ya adui zake wote pande zote. Jina lake ataitwa Solomoni, nami nitawapa Israeli amani na utulivu wakati wa utawala wake.

english: When David was old and full of years, he installed his son Solomon as king over Israel.
ekegusii: Ekero Daudi konya agotire mono akabeeka Sulemani, omomura oye, akaba omorwoti igoro ase Abaisraeli. Emeremo y’Abalawi
swahili: Daudi alipokuwa mzee aliyeshiba siku, akamfanya Solomoni mwanawe kuwa mfalme juu ya Israeli.

english: And the sons of Shimei: Jahath, Zina, Jeush, and Beriah. These were the sons of Shimei—four in all.
ekegusii: Na abana abamura ba Simei nabwo aba baane: Yahati na Sina, Yeusi na Beria.
swahili: Nao wana wa Shimei walikuwa wanne: Yahathi, Zina, Yeushi na Beria.

english: Jahath was the first and Zizah was the second; but Jeush and Beriah did not have many sons, so they were counted as one family and received a single assignment. The Kohathites (Numbers 3:27–32; Numbers 4:1–20)
ekegusii: Yahati nere orenge omoteneneri obo, na Sisa oyo o kabere, korende Yeusi na Beria tibabwate abana abamura abange; ase ayio bakabeekeranigwa amo ase okobarwa, bakaba eamate eyemo.
swahili: Yahathi alikuwa wa kwanza na Ziza wa pili, lakini Yeushi na Beria hawakuwa na wana wengi; kwa hiyo walihesabiwa kama jamaa moja, wakapewa wajibu kwa pamoja. Wakohathi

english: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel—four in all.
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Kohati nabwo aba baane: Amuramu na Isari, Heburoni na Usieli.
swahili: Wana wa Kohathi walikuwa wanne: Amramu, Ishari, Hebroni na Uzieli.

english: The sons of Amram: Aaron and Moses. Aaron and his descendants were set apart forever to consecrate the most holy things, to burn incense before the LORD, to minister before Him, and to pronounce blessings in His name forever.
ekegusii: Abana abamura b’Amuramu nabwo Aroni na Musa. Aroni agaatananwa koba oyochenegete mono kogenderera botambe. Ere amo nabamura baye babe bagosamba ubani ase obosio bw’Omonene na komokorera, naende babe bagosesenia ase erieta riaye botambe.
swahili: Wana wa Amramu walikuwa: Aroni na Mose. Aroni waliwekwa wakfu, yeye na wazao wake milele, wawe wakiweka wakfu vitu ambavyo ni vitakatifu mno, kutoa dhabihu mbele za Bwana, kuhudumu mbele zake na kutamka baraka katika Jina la Bwana milele.

english: As for Moses the man of God, his sons were named among the tribe of Levi.
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Musa, omonto o Nyasae, bakabareranigwa amo negesaku kia Lawi.
swahili: Wana wa Mose mtu wa Mungu walihesabiwa kama sehemu ya kabila la Lawi.

english: The sons of Moses: Gershom and Eliezer.
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Musa nabwo Gerisomu na Eliezeri.
swahili: Wana wa Mose walikuwa: Gershomu na Eliezeri.

english: The descendants of Gershom: Shebuel was the first.
ekegusii: Ase abana ba Gerisomu Sebueli nere orenge omoteneneri obo.
swahili: Wazao wa Gershomu: Shebueli alikuwa wa kwanza.

english: The descendants of Eliezer: Rehabiah was the first. Eliezer did not have any other sons, but the sons of Rehabiah were very numerous.
ekegusii: Ase abana b’Eliezeri Rehabia nere orenge omoteneneri obo. Eliezeri tabwate abana abamura bande; korende abana abamura ba Rehabia nigo barenge abange mono.
swahili: Wazao wa Eliezeri: Rehabia alikuwa wa kwanza. Eliezeri alikuwa na mwana mmoja tu, lakini wana wa Rehabia walikuwa wengi sana.

english: The sons of Izhar: Shelomith was the first.
ekegusii: Ase abana ba Isari, Selomiti nere orenge omoteneneri obo.
swahili: Wana wa Ishari: Shelomithi alikuwa wa kwanza.

english: The sons of Hebron: Jeriah was the first, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Heburoni nabwo aba: Yeria nere orenge omoteneneri obo, na Amaria, oyo o kabere, na Yahasieli, oyo o gatato, na Yekameamu, oyo o kane.
swahili: Wana wa Hebroni walikuwa: Yeria alikuwa wa kwanza, wa pili Amaria, wa tatu Yahazieli, na wa nne Yekameamu.

english: Then he gathered all the leaders of Israel, as well as the priests and Levites.
ekegusii: Daudi agasangereria abaraai bonsi b’Abaisraeli amo nabakuani na Abalawi.
swahili: Pia akawakusanya pamoja viongozi wote wa Israeli, pamoja na makuhani na Walawi.

english: The sons of Uzziel: Micah was the first and Isshiah the second. The Merarites (Numbers 3:33–37; Numbers 4:29–33)
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Usieli nabwo Mika, omoteneneri obo, na Isia, oyo o kabere.
swahili: Wana wa Uzieli walikuwa: Mika wa kwanza na Ishia wa pili. Wamerari

english: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. The sons of Mahli: Eleazar and Kish.
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Merari nabwo Mali na Musi; na abana abamura ba Mali nabwo Eleazari na Kisi.
swahili: Wana wa Merari walikuwa: Mahli na Mushi. Wana wa Mahli walikuwa: Eleazari na Kishi.

english: Eleazar died without having any sons; he had only daughters. Their cousins, the sons of Kish, married them.
ekegusii: Eleazari nigo akwete atabwati abana abamura, korende nabwate abana abaiseke. Abanto bamwabo, abana abamura ba Kisi, bakanyuoma abaiseke baria.
