swahili: Eleazari akafa bila ya kuwa na wana: alikuwa na binti tu. Binamu zao, wana wa Kishi, wakawaoa.

english: The sons of Mushi: Mahli, Eder, and Jeremoth —three in all. Levite Duties Revised
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Musi nabwo aba batato: Mali, na Ederi, na Yeremoti.
swahili: Wana wa Mushi: Mahli, Ederi na Yeremothi; wote walikuwa watatu.

english: These were the descendants of Levi by their families—the heads of families, registered individually by name—those twenty years of age or older who worked in the service of the house of the LORD.
ekegusii: Abanto aba nabwo barenge ab’ororeria rwa Lawi ase chiamate chiabo amo nabateneneri be chiamate chiria, buna barigetwe kera oyomo ase erieta riaye. Abwo nigo barenge nemiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, na nigo baisanerete gokora emeremo y’obokoreri bw’enyomba y’Omonene.
swahili: Hawa walikuwa wazao wa Lawi kwa jamaa zao. Wakuu wa jamaa kama walivyoandikwa kwa majina yao na kuhesabiwa kila mmoja, yaani, wenye uwezo wa kufanya kazi kuanzia miaka ishirini au zaidi, waliohudumu katika Hekalu la Bwana.

english: For David had said, “The LORD, the God of Israel, has given rest to His people and has come to dwell in Jerusalem forever.
ekegusii: Daudi akabora, “Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, oeire abanto baye obotoereru, na bono ere nigo amenyete Yerusalemu kare na kare.
swahili: Kwa maana Daudi alikuwa amesema, “Kwa vile Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli amewapa watu wake raha na amekuja kuishi Yerusalemu milele,

english: So now the Levites no longer need to carry the tabernacle or any of the articles for its service.”
ekegusii: Ase ayio Abalawi tibaganeirie kobogoria Eema gose ebinto binde bionsi bi’obokoreri bw’Eema eria.”
swahili: Walawi hawahitaji tena kubeba Maskani wala chombo chochote cha utumishi wake.”

english: For according to the final instructions of David, the Levites twenty years of age or older were counted,
ekegusii: Ase amatuko omoerio o Daudi, Abalawi bonsi bakarikwa, aba konya bakoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania.
swahili: Kulingana na maagizo ya mwisho ya Daudi, Walawi waliohesabiwa ni wale wa kuanzia umri wa miaka ishirini au zaidi.

english: but their duty was to assist the descendants of Aaron with the service of the house of the LORD, being responsible for the courts and chambers, the purification of all the holy things, and the work of the service of the house of God,
ekegusii: Emeremo yabo nebe ogokonya abwo b’ororeria rwa Aroni ase obokoreri bw’enyomba y’Omonene, na gotenenera chiraaro na ebinyomba ebike; boigo ogosibia ebinto bichenire, na gokora emeremo ende yonsi y’obokoreri bw’enyomba ya Nyasae.
swahili: Wajibu wa Walawi ulikuwa kuwasaidia wazao wa Aroni kuhudumu katika Hekalu la Bwana: Kuwa wasimamizi wa nyua, vyumba vya pembeni, kutakasa vyombo vitakatifu na utendaji mwingine wowote katika nyumba ya Mungu.

english: as well as for the rows of the showbread, the fine flour for the grain offering, the wafers of unleavened bread, the baking, the mixing, and all measurements of quantity and size.
ekegusii: Naende babe bagotenenera emeremo y’emegati ekoruegwa ase Nyasae, na ey’obosie obonuke bw’okoruegwa kw’endagera, na ey’emegati ere emeoo etabekiri memera, na ey’ekarangeire orogio, na ey’obosie bwochoganirie amaguta, na ey’ebirengo binde bionsi.
swahili: Walikuwa wasimamizi wa mikate iliyowekwa mezani, unga kwa ajili ya sadaka za nafaka, mikate isiyotiwa chachu, uokaji na uchanganyaji, pamoja na vipimo vyote vya wingi na ukubwa.

english: The Levites thirty years of age or older were counted, and the total number of men was 38,000.
ekegusii: Abalawi abarenge nemiaka emerongo etato na goetania bakabarwa, na omobaro obo okaba chilifu emerongo etato na isano na isato (38,000).
swahili: Walawi waliokuwa na umri wa miaka thelathini au zaidi walihesabiwa, nayo hesabu ya wanaume ilikuwa 38,000.

english: They were also to stand every morning to give thanks and praise to the LORD, and likewise in the evening.
ekegusii: Barabwo babe bagotenenera kera rituko, mambia na mogoroba, bakoiraneri’Omonene ng’a mbuya mono na komotogia.
swahili: Pia ulikuwa wajibu wao kila asubuhi kumshukuru na kumsifu Bwana. Iliwapasa pia kufanya hivyo jioni

english: Whenever burnt offerings were presented to the LORD on the Sabbaths, New Moons, and appointed feasts, they were to serve regularly before the LORD in the numbers prescribed for them.
ekegusii: Nigo barenge gokonya ekero kende gionsi ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa biarenge koruegwa ase Omonene, ase Chisabato na ase Emetienyi Emeyia, na ase Amatuko Amanene ande. Nigo baroberetigwe gokora emeremo eyio koreng’ana nomobaro oganeirie, bakagenderera koyekora botambe ase obosio bw’Omonene.
swahili: na wakati wowote sadaka za kuteketezwa zilipotolewa kwa Bwana siku za Sabato na kwenye sikukuu za Mwezi Mwandamo na katika sikukuu nyingine zilizoamriwa. Iliwapasa kuhudumu mbele za Bwana mara kwa mara kwa idadi maalum na kwa namna waliyokuwa wamepewa maelekezo.

english: So the Levites were to carry out the responsibilities for the Tent of Meeting and the Holy Place, and, under their brothers the descendants of Aaron, the service of the house of the LORD.
ekegusii: Ase enchera eye mbabe bakorenda Eema y’Omosangererekano na Aase Aachenu, na bakonye abanto bamwabo ab’ororeria rwa Aroni ase obokoreri bw’enyomba y’Omonene.
swahili: Hivyo Walawi wakafanya wajibu wao katika Hema la Kukutania, katika Mahali Patakatifu chini ya uongozi wa ndugu zao wazao wa Aroni, kwa ajili ya utumishi katika Hekalu la Bwana.

english: “Of these,” said David, “24,000 are to oversee the work of the house of the LORD, 6,000 are to be officers and judges,
ekegusii: Daudi agateeba, “Abanto chilifu emerongo ebere na baane (24,000) ase aba mbabe bagotenenera emeremo ye nyomba y’Omonene, na abanto chilifu isano nemo (6,000) nababe abateneneri na abagaambi ebiina;
swahili: Daudi akasema, “Miongoni mwa hawa, 24,000 watasimamia kazi ya Hekalu la Bwana na 6,000 watakuwa maafisa na waamuzi,

english: 4,000 are to be gatekeepers, and 4,000 are to praise the LORD with the instruments I have made for giving praise.”
ekegusii: abanto chilifu inye (4,000) nababe abarendi b’ebiita na abanto chilifu inye (4,000) babe bagotogia Omonene n’ebinto ebio bikobugigwa naroisirie ase okomotogia.”
swahili: na 4,000 watakuwa mabawabu, na wengine 4,000 watamsifu Bwana kwa ala za uimbaji nilizotoa kwa ajili ya kusudi hilo.”

english: Then David divided the Levites into divisions according to the sons of Levi: Gershom, Kohath, and Merari. The Gershonites (Numbers 3:21–26; Numbers 4:21–28)
ekegusii: Daudi agaatanana Abalawi ase ebiombe kobwatekana nabamura ba Lawi: Gerisoni na Kohati, na Merari.
swahili: Daudi akawagawa Walawi katika makundi kufuatana na wana wa Lawi: Gershoni, Kohathi na Merari. Wagershoni

english: The Gershonites: Ladan and Shimei.
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Gerisoni nabwo Ladani na Simei.
swahili: Wana wa Wagershoni walikuwa wawili: Ladani na Shimei.

english: The sons of Ladan: Jehiel the first, Zetham, and Joel—three in all.
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Ladani nabwo aba batato: Yehieli, omoteneneri obo, na Setamu, na Yoel.
swahili: Wana wa Ladani walikuwa watatu: Yehieli wa kwanza, Zethamu na Yoeli.

english: The sons of Shimei: Shelomoth, Haziel, and Haran—three in all. These were the heads of the families of Ladan.
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Simei nabwo aba batato: Selomoti na Hasieli na Harani. Aba nabwo barenge abateneneri be chiamate chia Ladani.
swahili: Wana wa Shimei walikuwa watatu: Shelomothi, Hazieli na Harani. Hawa watatu walikuwa viongozi wa jamaa za Ladani.

english: These were the divisions of the descendants of Aaron. The sons of Aaron were Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
ekegusii: Ebi nabio ebiombe bi’abaanto b’ororeria rwa Aroni. Abana abamura ba Aroni nabwo aba: Nadabu na Abihu, Eleazari na Itamari.
swahili: Hii ndiyo migawanyo ya wana wa Aroni: Aroni alikuwa na wana wanne: Nadabu, Abihu, Eleazari na Ithamari.

english: the seventh to Hakkoz, the eighth to Abijah,
ekegusii: obwa gatano na kabere bokagwera Hakosi, na obwa gatano na gatato Abiya;
swahili: ya saba Hakosi, ya nane Abiya,

english: the ninth to Jeshua, the tenth to Shecaniah,
ekegusii: obwa kianda bokagwera Yesua, na obwa ikomi Sekania;
swahili: ya tisa Yeshua, ya kumi Shekania,

english: the eleventh to Eliashib, the twelfth to Jakim,
ekegusii: obwa ikomi na rimo bokagwera Eliasibu, na obwa ikomi na kabere Yakimu;
swahili: ya kumi na moja Eliashibu, ya kumi na mbili Yakimu,

english: the thirteenth to Huppah, the fourteenth to Jeshebeab,
ekegusii: obwa ikomi na gatato bokagwera Hupa, na obwa ikomi na kane Yesebeabu;
swahili: ya kumi na tatu Hupa, ya kumi na nne Yeshebeabu,

english: the fifteenth to Bilgah, the sixteenth to Immer,
ekegusii: obwa ikomi na gatano bokagwera Biliga, na obwa ikomi na gatano na rimo Imeri;
swahili: ya kumi na tano Bilga, ya kumi na sita Imeri,

english: the seventeenth to Hezir, the eighteenth to Happizzez,
ekegusii: obwa ikomi na gatano na kabere bokagwera Hesiri, na obwa ikomi na gatano na gatato Hapisesi;
swahili: ya kumi na saba Heziri, ya kumi na nane Hapisesi,

english: the nineteenth to Pethahiah, the twentieth to Jehezkel,
ekegusii: obwa ikomi na kianda bokagwera Petahia, na obwa emerongo ebere Ezekieli;
swahili: ya kumi na tisa Pethahia, ya ishirini Yehezkeli,

english: the twenty-first to Jachin, the twenty-second to Gamul,
ekegusii: Obwa emerongo ebere na rimo bokagwera Yakini, na obwa emerongo ebere na kabere Gamuli;
swahili: ya ishirini na moja Yakini, ya ishirini na mbili Gamuli,

english: the twenty-third to Delaiah, and the twenty-fourth to Maaziah.
ekegusii: obwa emerongo ebere na gatato bokagwera Delaya, na obwa emerongo ebere na kane Maasia.
swahili: ya ishirini na tatu Delaya, ya ishirini na nne Maazia.

english: This was their appointed order for service when they entered the house of the LORD, according to the regulations prescribed for them by their forefather Aaron, as the LORD, the God of Israel, had commanded him. The Rest of the Levites
ekegusii: Oyo noro omooroberio obo bw’obokoreri bwabo bw’enyomba y’Omonene Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli buna Aroni, sokoro yabo, abarobereretie koreng’ana buna Omonene amochigeete. Abateneneri bande b’Abalawi
swahili: Huu ulikuwa ndio utaratibu wao uliokubalika wa kuhudumu walipoingia katika Hekalu la Bwana kulingana na masharti waliyoelekezwa na Aroni baba yao, kama Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli, alivyokuwa amemwamuru. Walawi Waliobaki

english: But Nadab and Abihu died before their father did, and they had no sons; so Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests.
ekegusii: Nadabu na Abihu bagakwa bagatiga ise ore moyo, barabwo tibabwate abana; na igo Eleazari na Itamari bakaba abakuani.
swahili: Nadabu na Abihu walikufa kabla ya baba yao, nao hawakuwa na wana; kwa hiyo ndugu zao Eleazari na Ithamari wakahudumu kama makuhani.

english: Now these were the remaining descendants of Levi: From the sons of Amram: Shubael; from the sons of Shubael: Jehdeiah.
ekegusii: Aba nabwo Abalawi bande: Subaeli bw’ororeria rw’Amuramu na Yehedia bw’ororeria rwa Subaeli;
swahili: Kuhusu wazao wa Lawi waliobaki: Kutoka kwa wana wa Amramu: alikuwa Shubaeli; kutoka kwa wana wa Shubaeli: alikuwa Yedeya.

english: As for Rehabiah, from his sons: The first was Isshiah.
ekegusii: Isia, omoteneneri korwa ase ororeria rwa Rehabia;
swahili: Kwa wa Rehabia, kutoka kwa wanawe: Ishia alikuwa wa kwanza.

english: From the Izharites: Shelomoth; from the sons of Shelomoth: Jahath.
ekegusii: Selomoti bw’ororeria rwa Isari, na Yahati bw’ororeria rwa Selomoti.
swahili: Kutoka kwa Waishari: alikuwa Shelomithi, kutoka kwa wana wa Shelomithi: alikuwa Yahathi.

english: From the sons of Hebron: Jeriah was the first, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Heburoni nabwo aba: Yeria omotangi, na Amaria oyo o kabere, na Yahasieli, oyo o gatato, na Yekameamu oyo o kane;
swahili: Wana wa Hebroni: Yeria alikuwa mkuu, Amaria wa pili, Yahazieli wa tatu, na Yekameamu wa nne.

english: From the sons of Uzziel: Micah; from the sons of Micah: Shamir.
ekegusii: Mika bw’ororeria rwa Usieli, na Samiri bw’ororeria rwa Mika;
swahili: Mwana wa Uzieli: alikuwa Mika; kutoka kwa wana wa Mika: alikuwa Shamiri.

english: The brother of Micah: Isshiah; from the sons of Isshiah: Zechariah.
ekegusii: Isia omomura omwabo Mika, na Zakaria bw’ororeria rwa Isia.
swahili: Ndugu yake Mika: alikuwa Ishia; na kutoka kwa wana wa Ishia: alikuwa Zekaria.

english: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. The son of Jaaziah: Beno.
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Merari nabwo Mali na Musi. Omwana omomura o Yaasia nere Beno.
swahili: Wana wa Merari: walikuwa Mahli na Mushi. Mwana wa Yaazia: alikuwa Beno.

english: The descendants of Merari from Jaaziah: Beno, Shoham, Zaccur, and Ibri.
ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rwa Merari ase Yaasia, omwana oye omomura, nabwo aba: Beno na Sohamu, Sakuri na Ibiri.
swahili: Wana wa Merari: kutoka kwa Yaazia: ni Beno, Shohamu, Zakuri na Ibri.

english: From Mahli: Eleazar, who had no sons.
ekegusii: Omwana o Mali n’Eleazari; ere tabwate abana abamura.
swahili: Kutoka kwa Mahli: alikuwa Eleazari, ambaye hakuwa na wana.

english: From Kish: Jerahmeel the son of Kish.
ekegusii: Yerameeli nomwana omomura o Kisi.
swahili: Kutoka kwa Kishi: mwana wa Kishi: alikuwa Yerameeli.

english: With the help of Eleazar’s descendant Zadok and Ithamar’s descendant Ahimelech, David divided them according to the offices of their service.
ekegusii: Daudi agaatanana abwo b’ororeria rwa Aroni na akaroberia buna bakore emeremo. Zadoki bw’ororeria rw’Eleazari na Ahimeleki bw’ororeria rwa Itamari barabwo m babete bakomokonya.
swahili: Akisaidiwa na Sadoki mwana wa Eleazari na Ahimeleki mwana wa Ithamari, Daudi aliwapanga wazao wa Aroni katika migawanyo kufuatana na wajibu wa huduma zao.

english: And the sons of Mushi: Mahli, Eder, and Jerimoth. These were the sons of the Levites, according to their families.
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Musi nabwo aba: Mali na Ederi, na Yerimoti. Aba nabwo barenge ab’ororeria rwa Lawi koreng’ana ne chiamate chiabo.
swahili: Nao wana wa Mushi: walikuwa Mahli, Ederi na Yeremothi. Hawa walikuwa Walawi kulingana na jamaa zao.

english: As their brothers the descendants of Aaron did, they also cast lots in the presence of King David and of Zadok, Ahimelech, and the heads of the families of the priests and Levites—the family heads and their younger brothers alike.
ekegusii: Abateneneri abwo be chiamate chiabo, abatang’ani amo nabamwabo abake, bagaaka obomera buna abamwabo, abanto b’ororeria rwa Aroni, ekero Daudi omorwoti, na Zadoki, na Ahimeleki, na abatang’ani be chiamate chi’abakuani na echi’Abalawi barigereretie. Oyorenge omonene ase eamate ogaakerwa obomera koreng’ana buna oyorenge omoke.
swahili: Pia walipiga kura kama vile ndugu zao wazao wa Aroni walivyofanya, mbele ya Mfalme Daudi, Sadoki, Ahimeleki na mbele ya viongozi wa jamaa ya makuhani na ya Walawi. Jamaa za ndugu wakubwa zilitendewa sawasawa na zile za ndugu wadogo.

english: Since more leaders were found among Eleazar’s descendants than those of Ithamar, they were divided accordingly. There were sixteen heads of families from the descendants of Eleazar and eight from the descendants of Ithamar.
ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rw’Eleazari bakanyorekana bare nabateneneri abange kobua abwo b’ororeria rwa Itamari. Ase ayio bakabeeka abanto ikomi na batano nomo b’ororeria rw’Eleazari babe abateneneri be chiamate chiabo, na batano na batato b’ororeria rwa Itamari babe abateneneri be chiamate chiabo.
swahili: Idadi kubwa ya viongozi walipatikana miongoni mwa wazao wa Eleazari, kuliko miongoni mwa wazao wa Ithamari, nao waligawanywa kwa uwiano: Viongozi kumi na sita kutoka jamaa ya wazao wa Eleazari na viongozi wanane kutoka jamaa ya wazao wa Ithamari.

english: Thus they were divided by lot, for there were officers of the sanctuary and officers of God among both Eleazar’s and Ithamar’s descendants.
ekegusii: Igo baatananetwe ase ogoakerwa obomera, bonsi ase enchera eyemo, ekiagera abateneneri abwo b’Aase Aachenu na abwo ba Nyasae nigo bachoretwe korwa ase ororeria rw’Eleazari amo norwa Itamari.
swahili: Waliwagawanya bila upendeleo kwa kupiga kura, kwa kuwa kulikuwa na maafisa wa mahali patakatifu na maafisa wa Mungu miongoni mwa wazao wale wa Eleazari na wale wa Ithamari.

english: The scribe, Shemaiah son of Nethanel, a Levite, recorded their names in the presence of the king and of the officers: Zadok the priest, Ahimelech son of Abiathar, and the heads of families of the priests and the Levites—one family being taken from Eleazar, and then one from Ithamar.
ekegusii: Semaya, mosinto o Netaneli Omolawi, akarika amarieta abo agwo ekero omorwoti na abanene abarenge komokonya, na Zadoki Omokuani, na Ahimeleki, mosinto bw’Abiatari, na abateneneri be chiamate chi’abakuani, na echi’Abalawi barigereretie. Chiamate chigachorwa ase ogoakerwa obomera, eyemo korwa ase ororeria rw’Eleazari, na eyende korwa ase orwa Itamari.
swahili: Mwandishi Shemaya mwana wa Nethaneli, Mlawi, aliorodhesha majina yao mbele ya Mfalme Daudi na maafisa: Kuhani Sadoki, Ahimeleki mwana wa Abiathari, na viongozi wa jamaa za makuhani na za Walawi: jamaa moja ikitoka upande wa Eleazari na nyingine upande wa Ithamari.

english: The first lot fell to Jehoiarib, the second to Jedaiah,
ekegusii: Obomera obotang’ani bokagwera Yehoyaribu, na obwa kabere Yedaya;
swahili: Kura ya kwanza ilimwangukia Yehoyaribu, ya pili Yedaya,

english: the third to Harim, the fourth to Seorim,
ekegusii: obwa gatato bokagwera Harimu, na obwa kane Seorimu;
swahili: ya tatu Harimu, ya nne Seorimu,

english: the fifth to Malchijah, the sixth to Mijamin,
ekegusii: obwa gatano bokagwera Malikia, na obwa gatano na rimo Miyamini;
swahili: ya tano Malkiya, ya sita Miyamini,

english: Additionally, David and the commanders of the army set apart some of the sons of Asaph, Heman, and Jeduthun to prophesy with the accompaniment of lyres, harps, and cymbals. The following is the list of the men who performed this service:
ekegusii: Daudi amo nabatang’ani abarenge komokonya bagaatanana ase obokoreri abamura bande b’Asafu, na aba Hemani, na aba Yedutuni, baria barenge gochia kobana ase okobugia amakano ao ao, na goakania chisani chikwoga. Omoroberio bw’abaanto baria baetwe emeremo eria noro oyo.
swahili: Daudi, pamoja na majemadari wa jeshi, wakawatenga baadhi ya wana wa Asafu, wana wa Hemani na wana wa Yeduthuni, kwa ajili ya huduma ya kutoa unabii, wakitumia vinubi, zeze na matoazi. Hii ndiyo orodha ya watu waliofanya huduma hii:

english: the third to Zaccur, his sons, and his brothers—12 in all;
ekegusii: Obwa gatato bokagwera Sakuri; ere amo nabana baye abamura na abamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na babere (12).
swahili: Ya tatu ikamwangukia Zakuri, // wanawe na jamaa zake, 12

english: the fourth to Izri, his sons, and his brothers—12 in all;
ekegusii: Obwa kane bokagwera Isiri; ere amo nabana baye abamura na abamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na babere (12).
swahili: ya nne ikamwangukia Isri, // wanawe na jamaa zake, 12

english: the fifth to Nethaniah, his sons, and his brothers—12 in all;
ekegusii: Obwa gatano bokagwera Netania; ere amo nabana baye abamura na abamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na babere (12).
swahili: ya tano ikamwangukia Nethania, // wanawe na jamaa zake, 12

english: the sixth to Bukkiah, his sons, and his brothers—12 in all;
ekegusii: Obwa gatano na rimo bokagwera Bukia; ere amo nabana baye abamura na abamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na babere (12).
swahili: ya sita ikamwangukia Bukia, // wanawe na jamaa zake, 12

english: the seventh to Jesarelah, his sons, and his brothers—12 in all;
ekegusii: Obwa gatano na kabere bokagwera Yesarela; ere amo nabana baye abamura na abamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na babere (12).
swahili: ya saba ikamwangukia Yesarela, // wanawe na jamaa zake, 12

english: the eighth to Jeshaiah, his sons, and his brothers—12 in all;
ekegusii: Obwa gatano na gatato bokagwera Yesaia; ere amo nabana baye abamura na abamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na babere (12).
swahili: ya nane ikamwangukia Yeshaya, // wanawe na jamaa zake, 12

english: the ninth to Mattaniah, his sons, and his brothers—12 in all;
ekegusii: Obwa kianda bokagwera Matania; ere amo nabana baye abamura na abamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na babere (12).
swahili: ya tisa ikamwangukia Matania, // wanawe na jamaa zake, 12

english: the tenth to Shimei, his sons, and his brothers—12 in all;
ekegusii: Obwa ikomi bokagwera Simei; ere amo nabana baye abamura na abamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na babere (12).
swahili: ya kumi ikamwangukia Shimei, // wanawe na jamaa zake, 12

english: the eleventh to Azarel, his sons, and his brothers—12 in all;
ekegusii: Obwa ikomi na rimo (11) bokagwera Asareli; ere amo nabana baye abamura na abamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na babere (12).
swahili: ya kumi na moja ikamwangukia Azareli, // wanawe na jamaa zake, 12

english: the twelfth to Hashabiah, his sons, and his brothers—12 in all;
ekegusii: Obwa ikomi na kabere (12) bokagwera Hasabia; ere amo nabana baye abamura na abamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na babere (12).
swahili: ya kumi na mbili ikamwangukia Hashabia, // wanawe na jamaa zake, 12

english: From the sons of Asaph: Zaccur, Joseph, Nethaniah, and Asarelah. These sons of Asaph were under the direction of Asaph, who prophesied under the direction of the king.
ekegusii: Ase abana abamura b’Asafu nabwo aba: Sakuri na Yusufu, Netania na Asarela. Abamura aba bakaba inse y’oboraai bw’Asafu ise, oyorenge kobana inse y’oboraai bw’omorwoti.
swahili: Kutoka kwa wana wa Asafu walikuwa: Zakuri, Yosefu, Nethania na Asarela. Wana wa Asafu walikuwa chini ya usimamizi wa Asafu, ambaye alitoa unabii chini ya usimamizi wa mfalme.

english: the thirteenth to Shubael, his sons, and his brothers—12 in all;
ekegusii: Obwa ikomi na gatato (13) bokagwera Subaeli; ere amo nabana baye abamura na abamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na babere (12).
swahili: ya kumi na tatu ikamwangukia Shubaeli, // wanawe na jamaa zake, 12

english: the fourteenth to Mattithiah, his sons, and his brothers—12 in all;
ekegusii: Obwa ikomi na kane (14) bokagwera Matitia; ere amo nabana baye abamura na abamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na babere (12).
swahili: ya kumi na nne ikamwangukia Matithia, // wanawe na jamaa zake, 12

english: the fifteenth to Jeremoth, his sons, and his brothers—12 in all;
ekegusii: Obwa ikomi na gatano bokagwera (15) Yeremoti; ere amo nabana baye abamura na abamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na babere (12).
swahili: ya kumi na tano ikamwangukia Yeremothi, // wanawe na jamaa zake, 12

english: the sixteenth to Hananiah, his sons, and his brothers—12 in all;
ekegusii: Obwa ikomi na gatano na rimo (16) bokagwera Hanania; ere amo nabana baye abamura na abamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na babere (12).
swahili: Ya kumi na sita ikamwangukia Hanania, // wanawe na jamaa zake, 12

english: the seventeenth to Joshbekashah, his sons, and his brothers—12 in all;
ekegusii: Obwa ikomi na gatano na kabere (17) bokagwera Yosibekasa; ere amo nabana baye abamura na abamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na babere (12).
swahili: ya kumi na saba ikamwangukia Yoshbekasha, // wanawe na jamaa zake, 12

english: the eighteenth to Hanani, his sons, and his brothers—12 in all;
ekegusii: Obwa ikomi na gatano na gatato (18) bokagwera Hanani; ere amo nabana baye abamura na abamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na babere (12).
swahili: ya kumi na nane ikamwangukia Hanani, // wanawe na jamaa zake, 12

english: the nineteenth to Mallothi, his sons, and his brothers—12 in all;
ekegusii: Obwa ikomi na kianda (19) bokagwera Maloti; ere amo nabana baye abamura na abamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na babere (12).
swahili: ya kumi na tisa ikamwangukia Malothi, // wanawe na jamaa zake, 12

english: the twentieth to Eliathah, his sons, and his brothers—12 in all;
ekegusii: Obwa emerongo ebere (20) bokagwera Eliata; ere amo nabana baye abamura na abamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na babere (12).
swahili: ya ishirini ikamwangukia Eliatha, // wanawe na jamaa zake, 12

english: the twenty-first to Hothir, his sons, and his brothers—12 in all;
ekegusii: Obwa emerongo ebere na rimo (21) bokagwera Hotiri; ere amo nabana baye abamura na abamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na babere (12).
swahili: ya ishirini na moja ikamwangukia Hothiri, // wanawe na jamaa zake, 12

english: the twenty-second to Giddalti, his sons, and his brothers—12 in all;
ekegusii: Obwa emerongo ebere na kabere (22) bokagwera Gidaliti; ere amo nabana baye abamura na abamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na babere (12).
swahili: ya ishirini na mbili ikamwangukia Gidalti, // wanawe na jamaa zake, 12

english: From the sons of Jeduthun: Gedaliah, Zeri, Jeshaiah, Shimei, Hashabiah, and Mattithiah—six in all—under the direction of their father Jeduthun, who prophesied with the harp, giving thanks and praise to the LORD.
ekegusii: Amo na Yedutuni nigo barenge abamura baye: Gedalia na Seri, Yesaia na Simei, Hesabia na Matitia. Abamura aba batano nomo bakaba inse y’oboraai bwa Yedutuni ise, oyorenge kobana ase okobugia obokano ase okoiraneria Nyasae ng’a mbuya mono na komotogia.
swahili: Wana wa Yeduthuni walikuwa sita: Gedalia, Seri, Yeshaya, Shimei, Hashabia, na Matithia, nao walikuwa chini ya usimamizi wa baba yao Yeduthuni, wao walikuwa wakitoa unabii wakitumia vinubi, wakimshukuru na kumtukuza Bwana.

english: the twenty-third to Mahazioth, his sons, and his brothers—12 in all;
ekegusii: Obwa emerongo ebere na gatato (23) bokagwera Mahasioti; ere amo nabana baye abamura na abamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na babere (12).
swahili: ya ishirini na tatu ikamwangukia Mahaziothi, // wanawe na jamaa zake, 12

english: and the twenty-fourth to Romamti-ezer, his sons, and his brothers—12 in all.
ekegusii: Obwa emerongo ebere na kane (24) bokagwera Romamuti‐Eseri; ere amo nabana baye abamura na abamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na babere (12).
swahili: ya ishirini na nne ikamwangukia Romamti-Ezeri, // wanawe na jamaa zake, 12.

english: From the sons of Heman: Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, Romamti-ezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, and Mahazioth.
ekegusii: Amo na Hemani nigo barenge abamura baye: Bukia na Matania, Usieli na Sebueli, Yerimoti na Hanania, Hanani na Eliata, Gidaliti na Romamuti‐Eseri, Yosibekasa na Maloti, Horiti na Mahasioti.
swahili: Wana wa Hemani walikuwa: Bukia, Matania, Uzieli, Shebueli na Yeremothi, Hanania, Hanani, Eliatha, Gidalti na Romamti-Ezeri, Yoshbekasha, Malothi, Hothiri na Mahaziothi.

english: All these sons of Heman the king’s seer were given him through the promises of God to exalt him, for God had given Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.
ekegusii: Aba nigo barenge abana abamura ba Hemani, omoorori bw’omorwoti. Nyasae amorierete eira y’okomokong’ia; ase ayio akamoa abana abamura ikomi na baane, na abaiseke batato.
swahili: Wote hawa walikuwa wana wa Hemani mwonaji wa mfalme. Aliwapata wana hawa kutokana na ahadi ya Mungu ili kumwinua. Mungu alimpa Hemani wana kumi na wanne na binti watatu.

english: All these were under the direction of their fathers for the music of the house of the LORD with cymbals, harps, and lyres, for the service of the house of God. Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman were under the direction of the king.
ekegusii: Abwo bonsi nigo barenge inse y’oboraai bwa ise ekero barenge goteera agwo ase enyomba y’Omonene na goakania chisani chikwoga, amo na kobugia amakano, na amakano ’ebirigisa. Asafu na Yedutuni, na Hemani nigo barenge inse y’oboraai bw’omorwoti.
swahili: Hawa wanaume wote walikuwa chini ya usimamizi wa baba yao kwa ajili ya uimbaji katika Hekalu la Bwana wakitumia matoazi, zeze na vinubi, kwa ajili ya huduma katika nyumba ya Mungu. Asafu, Yeduthuni na Hemani walikuwa chini ya usimamizi wa mfalme.

english: Together with their relatives, who were all trained and skillful in the songs of the LORD, they numbered 288.
ekegusii: Omobaro obo amo nabaanto bamwabo borokereretigwe goterera Omonene, abamanyete goteera buya kegima, nigo barenge amagana abere, na emerongo etano na etato, na batano na batato (288).
swahili: Pamoja na ndugu zao wote walikuwa wamefundishwa na kuwa stadi wa uimbaji kwa Bwana. Idadi yao walikuwa 288.

english: They cast lots for their duties, young and old alike, teacher as well as pupil.
ekegusii: Abwo bonsi, abake na abanene, aborokia na aborokigwa, bagaaka obomera ase ogwatanana emeremo yabo.
swahili: Vijana kwa wazee, walimu kwa wanafunzi, wote walipanga kazi zao kwa kupiga kura.

english: The first lot, which was for Asaph, fell to Joseph, his sons, and his brothers—12 in all; the second to Gedaliah, his sons, and his brothers—12 in all;
ekegusii: Obomera obotang’ani bokagwera Yusufu ase eamate y’Asafu. Obwa kabere bokagwera Gedalia; ere amo nabamwabo na abana baye abamura nigo barenge ikomi na babere (12).
swahili: Kura ya kwanza, ambayo ilikuwa kwa ajili ya Asafu, ilimwangukia Yosefu, // wanawe na jamaa zake, 12 Ya pili ikamwangukia Gedalia, // yeye na wanawe pamoja na jamaa zake, 12

english: These were the divisions of the gatekeepers: From the Korahites: Meshelemiah son of Kore, one of the sons of Asaph.
ekegusii: Aba nabwo abarendi b’ebiita: Korwa ase ororeria rwa Kora, Meselemia, omwana omomura o Kora bw’ororeria rw’Asafu.
swahili: Hii ndiyo migawanyo ya mabawabu: Kutoka kwa wana wa Kora alikuwa: Meshelemia mwana wa Kore, mmoja wa wana wa Asafu.

english: Hosah the Merarite also had sons: Shimri the first (although he was not the firstborn, his father had appointed him as the first),
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Hosa b’ororeria rwa Merari nabwo aba: Simuri, omoteneneri obo, nonya tarenge omotangi, ise akamobeka akaba omoteneneri.
swahili: Hosa, Mmerari, alikuwa na wana wafuatao: Shimri alikuwa mkuu wao (baba yake alikuwa amemweka yeye kuwa mkuu ijapokuwa hakuwa mzaliwa wa kwanza),

english: Hilkiah the second, Tebaliah the third, and Zechariah the fourth. The sons and brothers of Hosah numbered 13 in all.
ekegusii: Hilikia nigo arenge oyo o kabere, na Tebalia oyo o gatato, na Zakaria oyo o kane. Aba nabamura ba Hosa amo nabamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na batato.
swahili: Hilkia wa pili, Tabalia wa tatu na Zekaria wa nne. Wana na jamaa za Hosa jumla yao walikuwa watu kumi na watatu.

english: These divisions of the gatekeepers, through their chief men, had duties for ministering in the house of the LORD, just as their brothers did.
ekegusii: Abanto b’ebiombe ebio bi’abarendi b’ebiita amo nabatang’ani babo nigo babegetwe gokora emeremo ase enyomba y’Omonene buna Abalawi bamwabo barenge gokora.
swahili: Hii migawanyo ya mabawabu, kupitia wakuu wao, walikuwa na zamu za kuhudumu hekaluni mwa Bwana kama jamaa zao walivyokuwa nazo.

english: They cast lots for each gate, according to their families, young and old alike.
ekegusii: Abanto ba kera eamate, enke na enene, bagaaka obomera bamanye ngeita ki baraarende.
swahili: Kura zilipigwa kwa kila lango, kufuatana na jamaa zao, wakubwa kwa wadogo.

english: The lot for the East Gate fell to Shelemiah. Then lots were cast for his son Zechariah, a wise counselor, and the lot for the North Gate fell to him.
ekegusii: Obomera bokagwera Selemia ase okorenda egeita kia moocha. Naende bagaakera Zakaria, omomura oye, obomera, bokamochora korenda egeita gia sugusu. Ere nigo arenge omosemia omong’aini.
swahili: Kura ya Lango la Mashariki ilimwangukia Shelemia. Kisha wakapiga kura kwa Zekaria mwanawe, aliyekuwa mshauri mwenye hekima, nayo kura ya Lango la Kaskazini ikamwangukia.

english: The lot for the South Gate fell to Obed-edom, and the lot for the storehouses to his sons.
ekegusii: Obomera bokagwera Obedi‐Edomu, bokamochora korenda egeita kia Irianyi, na abamura baye bakaegwa korenda ebigachero.
swahili: Kura ya Lango la Kusini ikamwangukia Obed-Edomu, nayo kura ya maghala ikawaangukia wanawe.

english: The lots for the West Gate and the Shallecheth Gate on the ascending highway fell to Shuppim and Hosah. There were guards stationed at every watch.
ekegusii: Supimu na Hosea bagachorwa korenda ensemo ya bosongo, agwo ase Egeita gia Saleketi, ase enchera egotiira, na oborendi obomo bogachikana nobonde.
swahili: Kura za Lango la Magharibi na Lango la Shalekethi kwenye barabara ya juu zikawaangukia Shupimu na Hosa. Zamu za walinzi ziligawanywa kwa usawa:

english: Each day there were six Levites on the east, four on the north, four on the south, and two pairs at the storehouse.
ekegusii: Abarendi batano nomo nigo barenge kobeera ensemo ya moocha kera rituko, na ensemo ya sugusu mbaane kera rituko, na ensemo ya Irianyi mbaane kera rituko; na ase ebigachero babere babere.
swahili: Kulikuwa na Walawi sita kila siku upande wa mashariki, wanne upande wa kaskazini, wanne upande wa kusini, na wawili wawili kwa mara moja kwenye ghala.

english: As for the court on the west, there were four at the highway and two at the court.
ekegusii: Ase akanyomba kaagachire ensemo ya bosongo, abarendi baane nigo barenge agwo ase enchera, na babere ase akanyomba karia.
swahili: Kuhusu ukumbi kuelekea magharibi, kulikuwa na wanne barabarani na wawili kwenye ukumbi wenyewe.

english: These were the divisions of the gatekeepers who were descendants of Korah and Merari. The Treasurers, Officers, and Judges
ekegusii: Ebi nabio biarenge ebiombe bi’abarendi b’ebiita korwa ase abanto b’ororeria rwa Kora na orwa Merari. Emeremo ende egokorwa ase Hekalu
swahili: Hii ndiyo iliyokuwa migawanyo ya mabawabu waliokuwa wazao wa Kora na wa Merari. Watunza Hazina Na Maafisa Wengine

english: Meshelemiah had sons: Zechariah the firstborn, Jediael the second, Zebadiah the third, Jathniel the fourth,
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Meselemia nabwo aba: Zakaria omwana oye omotangi; Yediaeli oyo o kabere; Zebadia oyo o gatato; Yatinieli oyo o kane.
swahili: Meshelemia alikuwa na wana wafuatao: Zekaria mzaliwa wa kwanza, Yediaeli wa pili, Zebadia wa tatu, Yathnieli wa nne,

english: Now their fellow Levites were in charge of the treasuries of the house of God and the treasuries of the dedicated things.
ekegusii: Ahiya oyomo bw’Abalawi nere otenenerete chikungo chi’enyomba ya Nyasae, naende nere orendete ebiatananetwe bikaba ebichenu.
swahili: Katika Walawi, Ahiya alikuwa mwangalizi wa hazina za nyumba ya Mungu na mwangalizi wa hazina za vitu vilivyowekwa wakfu.

english: From the descendants of Ladan, who were Gershonites through Ladan and heads of the families of Ladan the Gershonite, were Jehieli,
ekegusii: Abamura b’ororeria rwa Ladani, nabwo Abagerisoni, nigo barenge abateneneri be chiamate chia Ladani Omogerisoni. Ase abwo nigo barenge Abayehieli.
swahili: Wazao wa Ladani, waliokuwa Wagershoni kupitia Ladani na waliokuwa viongozi wa jamaa za Ladani Mgershoni, walikuwa Yehieli,

english: the sons of Jehieli, Zetham, and his brother Joel. They were in charge of the treasuries of the house of the LORD.
ekegusii: Abamura babere b’Abayehieli, Setamu na Yoel momura omwabo, abwo bakaba bagotenenera chikungo chi’enyomba y’Omonene.
swahili: wana wa Yehieli, wana wa Zethamu na wa nduguye Yoeli. Wao walikuwa waangalizi wa hazina za Hekalu la Bwana.

english: From the Amramites, the Izharites, the Hebronites, and the Uzzielites:
ekegusii: Ase ebiombe bie chinderia chi’Amuramu, na Isari, na Heburoni, na Usieli:
swahili: Kutoka kwa wana wa Amramu, wana wa Ishari, wana wa Hebroni na wana wa Uzieli:

english: Shebuel, a descendant of Gershom son of Moses, was the officer in charge of the treasuries.
ekegusii: Sebueli, omomura o Gerisomu, mosinto o Musa, nere orenge omoteneneri omonene bwe chikungo chiria.
swahili: Shebueli, mzao wa Gershomu mwana wa Mose, alikuwa afisa mwangalizi wa hazina.

english: His relatives through Eliezer included Rehabiah his son, Jeshaiah his son, Joram his son, Zichri his son, and Shelomith his son.
ekegusii: Abanto bamwabo korwa ase Eliezeri nigo barenge Rehabia, omomura oye, na Yesaia omomura oye, na Yoramu omomura oye, na Sikiri omomura oye, na Selomiti omomura oye.
swahili: Jamaa zake kutoka kwa Eliezeri, wanawe walikuwa: Rehabia, Yeshaya, Yoramu, Zikri na Shelomithi.

english: This Shelomith and his brothers were in charge of all the treasuries for the things dedicated by King David, by the heads of families who were the commanders of thousands and of hundreds, and by the army commanders.
ekegusii: Selomiti na abamwabo nabwo batenenerete chikungo chionsi chi’ebiegwa Daudi omorwoti aatananerete Omonene, amo nebio abateneneri be chiamate, na abatang’ani b’abasikari chilifu na ab’amagana, na abachiki b’abasikari baatananete bikaba ebichenu.
swahili: Shelomithi na jamaa zake walikuwa waangalizi wa hazina zote za vitu vile vilivyowekwa wakfu na Mfalme Daudi, kwa viongozi wa jamaa waliokuwa majemadari wa maelfu na majemadari wa mamia, na kwa maafisa wengine wa jeshi.

english: They had dedicated some of the plunder from their battles to the repair of the house of the LORD.
ekegusii: Ebinto binde biasakoretwe ekero gi’esegi bigaatananwa bikaba ebiegwa ase ogokorerwa emeremo y’enyomba y’Omonene.
swahili: Baadhi ya nyara zilizotekwa vitani waliziweka wakfu kwa ajili ya ukarabati wa Hekalu la Bwana.

english: Everything that had been dedicated by Samuel the seer, Saul son of Kish, Abner son of Ner, and Joab son of Zeruiah, along with everything else that was dedicated, was under the care of Shelomith and his brothers.
ekegusii: Naboigo, nebiegwa bionsi biria Samweli omoorori, na Saulo, mosinto o Kisi, na Abineri, mosinto o Neri, na Yoabu, omomura bw’omokuungu Seruya baatananete. Ebinto bionsi bikabekwa inse y’oborendi bwa Selomiti na abamwabo. Emeremo y’Abalawi bande
swahili: Kila kitu kilichokuwa kimewekwa wakfu na Samweli mwonaji, na Sauli mwana wa Kishi, Abneri mwana wa Neri, na Yoabu mwana wa Seruya, pamoja na vitu vingine vyote vilivyokuwa vimewekwa wakfu, vyote vilikuwa chini ya uangalizi wa Shelomithi na jamaa zake.

english: From the Izrahites, Chenaniah and his sons had the outside duties as officers and judges over Israel.
ekegusii: Korwa ase Abaisari, Kenania na abamura baye bagachorwa gokora emeremo ya isiko buna abatang’ani b’emeremo ao ao, na abagaambi ebiina.
swahili: Kutoka kwa wana wa Ishari: Kenania na wanawe walipewa kazi nje ya Hekalu kama maafisa na waamuzi juu ya Israeli.

english: Elam the fifth, Jehohanan the sixth, and Eliehoenai the seventh.
ekegusii: Elamu oyo o gatano; Yehohanani oyo o gatano na rimo; Eliehoenai oyo o gatano na kabere.
swahili: Elamu wa tano Yehohanani wa sita na Eliehoenai wa saba.

english: From the Hebronites, Hashabiah and his relatives, 1,700 capable men, had charge of the affairs of Israel west of the Jordan for all the work of the LORD and for the service of the king.
ekegusii: Korwa ase Abaheburoni, Hasabia na abanto b’eamate yaye, elifu eyemo na amagana atano na abere (1,700), abanto abamanyete buya gokora emeremo yabo, bakabeekwa ensemo ya bosongo ya Yorodani gotenenera Abaisraeli ase emeremo yonsi y’Omonene na ey’omorwoti.
swahili: Kutoka kwa wana wa Hebroni: Hashabia na jamaa zake, watu 1,700 wenye uwezo, waliwajibika katika Israeli magharibi ya Yordani kwa ajili ya kazi zote za Bwana na utumishi wa mfalme.

english: As for the Hebronites, Jerijah was the chief of the Hebronites, according to the genealogies of his ancestors. In the fortieth year of David’s reign the records were searched, and strong, capable men were found among the Hebronites at Jazer in Gilead.
ekegusii: Korwa ase Abaheburoni, Yeria nere otenenerete abanto be chiamate chionsi chi’ororeria rwa Heburoni. (Ase omwaka bw’emerongo ene bw’okogamba gwa Daudi, obotuki bogakorwa, na abanto be chiamate echio abamanyete korwana esegi buya bakanyorekana agwo Yaeseri ya Gileadi).
swahili: Kuhusu wana wa Hebroni, Yeria alikuwa mkuu wao kufuatana na orodha ya jamaa yao. Katika mwaka wa arobaini wa utawala wa Daudi uchunguzi ulifanyika katika kumbukumbu, nao watu wenye uwezo miongoni mwa wana wa Hebroni wakapatikana huko Yazeri katika Gileadi.

english: Among Jerijah’s relatives there were 2,700 capable men who were heads of families. King David appointed them over the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh for every matter pertaining to God and to the affairs of the king.
ekegusii: Abanto baria abamwabo Yeria nigo barenge chilifu ibere, na amagana atano na abere (2,700), abateneneri be chiamate chiabo, bamanyete korwana esegi buya. Barabwo Daudi omorwoti akababeeka bakaba abateneneri b’abaanto b’egesaku kia Rubeni, na ab’ekia Gadi, na ab’ekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase, ase emeremo ende yonsi ya Nyasae na ey’omorwoti.
swahili: Yeria alikuwa na jamaa ya watu 2,700 waliokuwa watu wenye uwezo na viongozi wa jamaa, naye Mfalme Daudi akawaweka kuangalia Wareubeni, Wagadi na nusu ya kabila Manase kuhusu kila jambo lililomhusu Mungu na shughuli za mfalme.

english: And Obed-edom also had sons: Shemaiah the firstborn, Jehozabad the second, Joah the third, Sachar the fourth, Nethanel the fifth,
ekegusii: Abana abamura b’Obedi‐Edomu nabwo aba: Semaya omwana oye omotangi; Yehosabadi oyo o kabere; Yoa oyo o gatato; Sakari oyo o kane; Netaneli oyo o gatano;
swahili: Obed-Edomu naye alikuwa na wana wafuatao: Shemaya mzaliwa wa kwanza, Yehozabadi wa pili, Yoa wa tatu, Sakari wa nne, Nethaneli wa tano,

english: Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh, and Peullethai the eighth. For God had blessed Obed-edom.
ekegusii: Amieli oyo o gatano na rimo; Isakaru oyo o gatano na kabere; Peuletai oyo o gatano na gatato. Nyasae nigo asesenetie Obedi‐Edomu.
swahili: Amieli wa sita, Isakari wa saba, na Peulethai wa nane. (Kwa kuwa Mungu alikuwa amembariki Obed-Edomu.)

english: Also to his son Shemaiah were born sons who ruled over their families because they were strong, capable men.
ekegusii: Semaya, omomura oye, akaiborerwa abana abamura bakaba abateneneri be chiamate chiabo; abwo nigo barenge abanto abakong’u ase emeremo yabo.
swahili: Shemaya mwanawe pia alikuwa na wana, waliokuwa viongozi katika jamaa ya baba yao kwa sababu walikuwa watu wenye uwezo mkubwa.

english: Shemaiah’s sons were Othni, Rephael, Obed, and Elzabad; his brothers were Elihu and Semachiah, also capable men.
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Semaya nabwo aba: Otini na Refaeli, na Obedi, na Elisabadi; boigo Elihu na Semakia, abamura bamwabo Semaya, nigo barenge abamura abakong’u mono ase emeremo yabo.
swahili: Wana wa Shemaya ni: Othni, Refaeli, Obedi na Elizabadi; jamaa zake Elihu na Semakia walikuwa pia watu wenye uwezo.

english: All these were descendants of Obed-edom; they and their sons and brothers were capable men with strength to do the work—62 in all from Obed-edom.
ekegusii: Aba bonsi nigo barenge b’ororeria rw’Obedi‐Edomu. Barabwo amo nabana babo abamura na abanto bamwabo nigo barenge abanto abakong’u, bamanyete gokora emeremo yabo. Bonsi abwo b’Obedi‐Edomu nigo barenge emerongo etano nomo na babere.
swahili: Hawa wote walikuwa wazao wa Obed-Edomu; wao na wana wao na jamaa zao walikuwa watu wenye uwezo pamoja na nguvu za kufanya kazi. Wazao wa Obed-Edomu jumla yao walikuwa sitini na wawili.

english: Meshelemiah also had sons and brothers who were capable men—18 in all.
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Meselemia amo nabaanto bamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na batano, abamanyete buya gokora emeremo yabo.
swahili: Meshelemia alikuwa na wana na jamaa zake, waliokuwa watu wenye uwezo: jumla yao watu kumi na wanane.

english: This is the list of the Israelites—the heads of families, the commanders of thousands and of hundreds, and their officers who served the king in every matter concerning the divisions on rotating military duty each month throughout the year. There were 24,000 men in each division:
ekegusii: Oyo noro omooroberio bw’Abaisraeli na abateneneri be chiamate chiabo na obw’abatang’ani b’abasikari chilifu na ab’amagana, na obw’abateneneri b’emeremo ende yonsi ase oborwoti. Kera omotienyi ase omwaka ekeombe ki’abaanto chilifu emerongo ebere na inye (24,000), nigo kiarenge gokora emeremo inse y’oboraai bw’omotang’ani bw’omotienyi oyio.
swahili: Hii ndiyo orodha ya Waisraeli: viongozi wa jamaa, majemadari wa maelfu, majemadari wa mamia na maafisa wao, waliomtumikia mfalme kwa lolote lililohusu vikosi vya jeshi vilivyokuwa zamu mwezi baada ya mwezi katika mwaka mzima. Kila kikosi kimoja kilikuwa na watu 24,000.

english: The seventh, for the seventh month, was Helez the Pelonite, an Ephraimite. There were 24,000 men in his division.
ekegusii: Oyo o gatano na kabere, Helesi, Omopeloni bw’ororeria rw’Efraimu, akaba omoteneneri bw’ekeombe ki’omotienyi o gatano na kabere. Ekeombe kiaye nigo kiarenge nabaanto chilifu emerongo ebere na inye (24,000).
swahili: Jemadari wa kikosi cha saba kwa mwezi wa saba alikuwa Helesi Mpeloni wa Waefraimu. Kikosi chake kilikuwa na watu 24,000.

english: The eighth, for the eighth month, was Sibbecai the Hushathite, a Zerahite. There were 24,000 men in his division.
ekegusii: Oyo o gatano na gatato, Sibekai bw’ororeria rwa Husa Omozera akaba omoteneneri bw’ekeombe ki’omotienyi o gatano na gatato. Ekeombe kiaye nigo kiarenge nabaanto chilifu emerongo ebere na inye (24,000).
swahili: Jemadari wa nane kwa mwezi wa nane, alikuwa Sibekai Mhushathi wa Wazera. Kikosi chake kilikuwa na watu 24,000.

english: The ninth, for the ninth month, was Abiezer the Anathothite, a Benjamite. There were 24,000 men in his division.
ekegusii: Oyo o kianda, Abieseri korwa Anatoti bw’ororeria rwa Benjamini akaba omoteneneri bw’ekeombe ki’omotienyi o kianda. Ekeombe kiaye nigo kiarenge nabaanto chilifu emerongo ebere na inye (24,000).
swahili: Jemadari wa tisa kwa mwezi wa tisa alikuwa Abiezeri Mwanathothi wa Wabenyamini. Kikosi chake kilikuwa na watu 24,000.

english: The tenth, for the tenth month, was Maharai the Netophathite, a Zerahite. There were 24,000 men in his division.
ekegusii: Oyo o ikomi, Maharai korwa Netofa bw’ororeria rwa Zera akaba omoteneneri bw’ekeombe ki’omotienyi o ikomi. Ekeombe kiaye nigo kiarenge nabaanto chilifu emerongo ebere na inye (24,000).
swahili: Jemadari wa kumi kwa mwezi wa kumi alikuwa Maharai Mnetofathi wa Wazera. Kikosi chake kilikuwa na watu 24,000.

english: The eleventh, for the eleventh month, was Benaiah the Pirathonite, an Ephraimite. There were 24,000 men in his division.
ekegusii: Oyo o ikomi na rimo, Benaya korwa Piratoni bw’ororeria rw’Efraimu akaba omoteneneri bw’ekeombe ki’omotienyi o ikomi na rimo. Ekeombe kiaye nigo kiarenge nabaanto chilifu emerongo ebere na inye (24,000).
swahili: Jemadari wa kumi na moja kwa mwezi wa kumi na moja alikuwa Benaya Mpirathoni wa Waefraimu. Kikosi chake kilikuwa na watu 24,000.

english: The twelfth, for the twelfth month, was Heldai the Netophathite, from the family of Othniel. There were 24,000 men in his division. The Leaders of the Twelve Tribes
ekegusii: Oyo o ikomi na kabere, Helidai korwa Netofa bw’ororeria rw’Otinieli akaba omoteneneri bw’ekeombe ki’omotienyi o ikomi na kabere. Ekeombe kiaye nigo kiarenge nabaanto chilifu emerongo ebere na inye (24,000). Abaraai b’ebisaku bi’Abaisraeli
swahili: Jemadari wa kumi na mbili kwa mwezi wa kumi na mbili alikuwa Heldai Mnetofathi kutoka jamaa ya Othnieli. Kikosi chake kilikuwa na watu 24,000. Maafisa Wa Makabila

english: These officers were in charge of the tribes of Israel: Over the Reubenites was Eliezer son of Zichri; over the Simeonites was Shephatiah son of Maacah;
ekegusii: Aba nabwo barenge abaraai b’ebisaku bi’Abaisraeli: Eliezeri, mosinto o Sikiri, ase Abareubeni; Sefatia, mosinto o Maaka, ase Abasimeoni;
swahili: Maafisa waliokuwa wanaoongoza makabila ya Israeli walikuwa: Kwa Wareubeni: Eliezeri mwana wa Zikri; kwa Wasimeoni: Shefatia mwana wa Maaka;

english: over Levi was Hashabiah son of Kemuel; over Aaron was Zadok;
ekegusii: Hasabia, mosinto o Kemueli, ase Abalawi; Zadoki ase abanto ba Aroni;
swahili: kwa Walawi: Hashabia mwana wa Kemueli; kwa Aroni: Sadoki;

english: over Judah was Elihu, one of David’s brothers; over Issachar was Omri son of Michael;
ekegusii: Elihu, oyomo bw’abamura bamwabo Daudi, ase Abayuda; Omuri, mosinto o Mikaeli, ase Abaisakaru;
swahili: kwa Yuda: Elihu, nduguye Daudi; kwa Waisakari: Omri mwana wa Mikaeli;

english: over Zebulun was Ishmaiah son of Obadiah; over Naphtali was Jerimoth son of Azriel;
ekegusii: Isimaya, mosinto bw’Obadia, ase Abasabuloni; Yerimoti, mosinto bw’Asirieli, ase Abanafutali;
swahili: kwa Wazabuloni: Ishmaya mwana wa Obadia; kwa Wanaftali: Yeremothi mwana wa Azrieli;

english: Jashobeam son of Zabdiel was in charge of the first division, which was assigned the first month. There were 24,000 men in his division.
ekegusii: Yasobeamu, mosinto o Sabidieli, nere otenenerete ekeombe egetang’ani, ase omotienyi bw’eritang’ani; ekeombe kiaye nigo kiarenge nabaanto chilifu emerongo ebere na inye (24,000).
swahili: Msimamizi wa kikosi cha kwanza kwa mwezi wa kwanza alikuwa Yashobeamu mwana wa Zabdieli. Kulikuwa na watu 24,000 katika kikosi chake.

english: over the Ephraimites was Hoshea son of Azaziah; over one of the half-tribes of Manasseh was Joel son of Pedaiah;
ekegusii: Hosea, mosinto bw’Asasia, ase Abaefraimu; Yoel, mosinto o Pedaya, ase ekeng’ese kende ki’egesaku kia Manase;
swahili: kwa Waefraimu: Hoshea mwana wa Azazia; kwa nusu ya kabila la Manase: Yoeli mwana wa Pedaya;

english: over the half-tribe of Manasseh in Gilead was Iddo son of Zechariah; over Benjamin was Jaasiel son of Abner;
ekegusii: Ido, mosinto o Zakaria, ase ekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase, keria kiarenge agwo Gileadi; Yaasieli, mosinto bw’Abineri ase Ababenjamini;
swahili: kwa nusu nyingine ya kabila la Manase huko Gileadi: Ido mwana wa Zekaria; kwa Wabenyamini: Yaasieli mwana wa Abneri;

english: and over Dan was Azarel son of Jeroham. These were the leaders of the tribes of Israel.
ekegusii: Asareli, mosinto o Yerohamu, ase Abadani. Aba nabwo barenge abaraai b’ebisaku bi’Abaisraeli.
swahili: kwa Wadani: Azareli mwana wa Yerohamu. Hao ndio waliokuwa maafisa wa makabila ya Israeli.

english: David did not count the men aged twenty or under, because the LORD had said that He would make Israel as numerous as the stars of the sky.
ekegusii: Daudi tabarete na korika abanto konya bataraika emiaka emerongo ebere, ekiagera Omonene nariete eira ng’a namente Abaisraeli babe abange buna ching’enang’eni chia igoro.
swahili: Daudi hakuwahesabu watu waliokuwa chini ya miaka ishirini, kwa sababu Bwana alikuwa ameahidi kuwafanya Israeli kuwa wengi kama nyota za angani.

english: Joab son of Zeruiah began to count the men but did not finish. For because of this census wrath came upon Israel, and the number was not entered in the Book of the Chronicles of King David. David’s Various Overseers
ekegusii: Yoabu, omomura bw’omokuungu Seruya, agachaaka kobara Abaisraeli, korende takoorete emeremo eyio. Nyasae akaba nendamwamu ase Abaisraeli ase engencho y’okobarwa koria, na omobaro oyio tobegetwe ase Egetabu ki’ogokora gwa Daudi. Abateneneri b’enibo y’omorwoti
swahili: Yoabu mwana wa Seruya alianza kuwahesabu watu lakini hakumaliza. Kwa sababu ya kuwahesabu watu, hasira ya Mungu iliwaka juu ya Israeli, nayo hiyo hesabu yao haikuingizwa katika kitabu cha kumbukumbu za Mfalme Daudi. Wasimamizi Wa Mali Za Mfalme

english: Azmaveth son of Adiel was in charge of the royal storehouses. Jonathan son of Uzziah was in charge of the storehouses in the country, in the cities, in the villages, and in the fortresses.
ekegusii: Asimaweti, mosinto bw’Adieli, agatenenera chimonga chi’omorwoti; na Yonathani, mosinto bwa Usia, agatenenera chimonga chi’ense eria, ase emechie emenene na emeke, na ase emerobiri.
swahili: Azmawethi mwana wa Adieli ndiye alikuwa msimamizi wa hazina za mfalme. Msimamizi wa hazina katika mashamba, miji, vijiji na kwenye ngome alikuwa Yonathani mwana wa Uzia.

english: Ezri son of Chelub was in charge of the workers in the fields who tilled the soil.
ekegusii: Esiri, mosinto o Kelubi, agatenenera abakori emeremo b’emegondo, abarenge koyerema.
swahili: Ezri mwana wa Kelubu alikuwa msimamizi wa wafanyakazi waliolima katika mashamba.

english: Shimei the Ramathite was in charge of the vineyards. Zabdi the Shiphmite was in charge of the produce of the vineyards for the wine vats.
ekegusii: Simei Omoramati agatenenera emegondo y’emesabibu, na Sabidi Omosifumi agatenenera edivai ase yare kogachwa.
swahili: Shimei Mramathi alikuwa msimamizi wa mashamba ya mizabibu. Zabdi Mshifmi alikuwa msimamizi wa zabibu, utengenezaji na uhifadhi wa divai katika mapipa makubwa.

english: Baal-hanan the Gederite was in charge of the olive and sycamore trees in the foothills. Joash was in charge of the stores of olive oil.
ekegusii: Baali‐Hanani Omogederi agatenenera emezeituni na emeko agwo ase ense omweya. Na Yoashi agatenenera ebigachero bi’amaguta ’amazeituni.
swahili: Baal-Hanani Mgederi ndiye alikuwa mwangalizi wa mashamba ya mfalme ya mizeituni na mikuyu katika tambarare za vilima vya magharibi. Yoashi alikuwa msimamizi wa ghala za mafuta ya zeituni.

english: Shitrai the Sharonite was in charge of the herds grazing in Sharon. Shaphat son of Adlai was in charge of the herds in the valleys.
ekegusii: Sitirai Omosaroni agatenenera amaicho arenge korisia agwo Saroni, na Safati, mosinto bw’Adilai, agatenenera amaicho arenge korisia ase amakura.
swahili: Shitrai Msharoni alikuwa msimamizi wa makundi ya ngʼombe waliojilisha huko Sharoni. Shafati mwana wa Adlai alikuwa msimamizi wa yale makundi ya ngʼombe yaliyokuwa makondeni.

english: He was a descendant of Perez and chief of all the army commanders for the first month.
ekegusii: Ere nigo arenge bw’ororeria rwa Peresi, na orenge omochiki bw’abatang’ani bonsi b’abasikari ase omotienyi bw’eritang’ani.
swahili: Yeye alikuwa mzao wa Peresi, na mkuu wa maafisa wote wa jeshi kwa mwezi wa kwanza.

english: Obil the Ishmaelite was in charge of the camels. Jehdeiah the Meronothite was in charge of the donkeys.
ekegusii: Obili Omoisumaeli agatenenera chingamia, na Yedaya Omomeroni agatenenera chitigere, na
swahili: Obili Mwishmaeli alikuwa msimamizi wa ngamia. Yedeya Mmeronothi alikuwa msimamizi wa punda.

english: Jaziz the Hagrite was in charge of the flocks. All these officials were in charge of King David’s property. The Counselors
ekegusii: Yasisi Omohagari agatenenera ching’ondi ne chimbori. Aba bonsi nigo barenge abateneneri ba chinibo chia Daudi omorwoti. Abasemia ba Daudi
swahili: Yazizi Mhagri alikuwa msimamizi wa makundi ya kondoo na mbuzi. Hawa wote ndio waliokuwa maafisa wasimamizi wa mali alizokuwa nazo Mfalme Daudi.

english: David’s uncle Jonathan was a counselor; he was a man of insight and a scribe. Jehiel son of Hachmoni attended to the sons of the king.
ekegusii: Yonathani, ise moke Daudi, nere orenge omosemia; nigo arenge omonto omong’aini naende omonyasemi. Ere na Yehieli, mosinto o Hakimoni, nigo barenge abateneneri b’abana abamura b’omorwoti.
swahili: Yonathani mjomba wa Daudi alikuwa mshauri, mtu mwenye ufahamu mkubwa na mwandishi. Yehieli mwana wa Hakmoni alikuwa akiwahudumia wana wa mfalme.

english: Ahithophel was the king’s counselor. Hushai the Archite was the king’s friend.
ekegusii: Ahitofeli nere orenge omosemia bw’omorwoti, na Husai Omoariki nomosani bw’omorwoti orenge.
swahili: Ahithofeli alikuwa mshauri wa mfalme. Hushai Mwariki alikuwa rafiki wa mfalme.

english: Ahithophel was succeeded by Jehoiada son of Benaiah, then by Abiathar. Joab was the commander of the king’s army.
ekegusii: Yehoyada, mosinto o Benaya, na Abiatari bakabeekwa ase ribaga ri’Ahitofeli g akuure. Yoabu nere orenge omochiki bw’abasikari b’omorwoti.
swahili: Baada ya Ahithofeli, Yehoyada mwana wa Benaya aliingia mahali pake kama mshauri wa mfalme pamoja na Abiathari. Yoabu alikuwa ndiye jemadari wa majeshi ya mfalme.

english: Dodai the Ahohite was in charge of the division for the second month, and Mikloth was the leader. There were 24,000 men in his division.
ekegusii: Dodadi bw’ororeria rw’Ahohi nere otenenerete ekeombe ki’omotienyi o kabere. Ekeombe kiaye nigo kiarenge nabaanto chilifu emerongo ebere na inye (24,000). Mikiloti nere orenge omokonyi oye.
swahili: Msimamizi wa kikosi kwa mwezi wa pili alikuwa Dodai Mwahohi. Miklothi ndiye alikuwa kiongozi wa kikosi chake. Kikosi chake kilikuwa na watu 24,000.

english: The third army commander, as chief for the third month, was Benaiah son of Jehoiada the priest. There were 24,000 men in his division.
ekegusii: Omoteneneri bw’ekeombe kia gatato, ase omotienyi o gatato, nere Benaya, mosinto o Yehoyada Omokuani. Benaya nigo arenge omotang’ani omonene, na ekeombe kiaye nigo kiarenge nabaanto chilifu emerongo ebere na inye (24,000).
swahili: Jemadari wa kikosi cha tatu kwa mwezi wa tatu alikuwa Benaya mwana wa kuhani Yehoyada. Ndiye alikuwa mkuu wa kikosi chake kilichokuwa na watu 24,000.

english: This Benaiah was mighty among the Thirty and was over the Thirty, and his son Ammizabad was in charge of his division.
ekegusii: Benaya nere orenge omonto etuoni, omanyekanete ase baria Emerongo etato, naende orenge nomochiki obo. Amisabadi, omomura oye, nere orenge komokonya ase ekeombe ekio.
swahili: Huyu ndiye yule Benaya aliyekuwa shujaa miongoni mwa wale Thelathini na ndiye alikuwa juu yao hao Thelathini. Mwanawe Amizabadi ndiye alikuwa mkuu katika kikosi chake.

english: The fourth, for the fourth month, was Joab’s brother Asahel, and his son Zebadiah was commander after him. There were 24,000 men in his division.
ekegusii: Oyo o kane, Asaeli, omomura omwabo Yoabu, akaba omoteneneri bw’ekeombe ki’omotienyi o kane, na Sebadia, omomura oye, akagetenenera magega yaye. Ekeombe kiaye nigo kiarenge nabaanto chilifu emerongo ebere na inye (24,000).
swahili: Jemadari wa nne kwa mwezi wa nne alikuwa Asaheli nduguye Yoabu, mwanawe Zebadia ndiye aliingia mahali pake kwenye uongozi. Kikosi chake kilikuwa na watu 24,000.

english: The fifth, for the fifth month, was the commander Shamhuth the Izrahite. There were 24,000 men in his division.
ekegusii: Oyo o gatano, Samuti bw’ororeria rwa Isihari akaba omoteneneri bw’ekeombe ki’omotienyi o gatano. Ekeombe kiaye nigo kiarenge nabaanto chilifu emerongo ebere na inye (24,000).
swahili: Jemadari wa kikosi cha tano kwa mwezi wa tano alikuwa Shamhuthi Mwizrahi. Kikosi chake kilikuwa na watu 24,000.

english: The sixth, for the sixth month, was Ira son of Ikkesh the Tekoite. There were 24,000 men in his division.
ekegusii: Oyo o gatano na rimo, Ira, mosinto o Ikesi Omotekoa akaba omoteneneri bw’ekeombe ki’omotienyi o gatano na rimo. Ekeombe kiaye nigo kiarenge nabaanto chilifu emerongo ebere na inye (24,000).
swahili: Jemadari wa kikosi cha sita kwa mwezi wa sita alikuwa Ira, mwana wa Ikeshi Mtekoa. Kikosi chake kilikuwa na watu 24,000.

english: Now David summoned all the leaders of Israel to Jerusalem: the leaders of the tribes, the leaders of the divisions in the king’s service, the commanders of thousands and of hundreds, and the officials in charge of all the property and cattle of the king and his sons, along with the court officials and mighty men—every mighty man of valor.
ekegusii: Daudi akarangeria abateneneri bonsi b’Abaisraeli bache Yerusalemu. Ase ayio abateneneri b’ebisaku, na ab’ebiombe biarenge gokorera omorwoti, na abatang’ani b’abasikari chilifu na ab’amagana, na baria batenenerete chinibo chionsi chi’omorwoti ne chiombe chiaye, na echi’abana baye, amo nabateneneri b’enyomba y’omorwoti, na abanto bonsi chituoni, na abwo bonsi barenge abakong’u ase esegi, bagacha aroro.
swahili: Daudi akawaita maafisa wote wa Israeli wakusanyike huko Yerusalemu: yaani, maafisa walio juu ya makabila, majemadari wa vikosi katika utumishi wa mfalme, majemadari wa maelfu na majemadari wa mamia, maafisa wanaosimamia mali zote na mifugo ya mfalme na wanawe, wakiwemo maafisa wa jumba la kifalme, mashujaa na askari wote walio hodari.

english: Consider now that the LORD has chosen you to build a house for the sanctuary. Be strong and do it.” The Plans for the Temple
ekegusii: Bono bwerende, ekiagera Omonene ogochorire oagache enyomba ebe Obomenyo bwaye Obochenu. Obe omokong’u na okore ayio.”
swahili: Angalia basi, kwa maana Bwana amekuchagua wewe ili ujenge Hekalu kuwa mahali patakatifu. Uwe hodari ukafanye kazi hiyo.”

english: Then David gave his son Solomon the plans for the portico of the temple, its buildings, storehouses, upper rooms, inner rooms, and the room for the mercy seat.
ekegusii: Erio Daudi akaa Sulemani, omwana oye, omogwekano bw’enyomba eria enke erabe bosio bwe Hekalu, na oyo bw’ebinyomba bie Hekalu, ne chikungo chie Hekalu, na obw’ebinyomba bia irongo, na ebinyomba bia ime, na obw’akanyomba k’Oboikaranso bwa amaabera.
swahili: Ndipo Daudi akampa Solomoni mwanawe kielelezo kwa ajili ya ukumbi wa Hekalu, nyumba zake, vyumba vyake vya hazina, ghorofa zake, vyumba vyake vya ndani na mahali pa kufanyia upatanisho.

english: The plans contained everything David had in mind for the courts of the house of the LORD, for all the surrounding rooms, for the treasuries of the house of God and of the dedicated things,
ekegusii: Naende akamoa omogwekano bw’ebinto bionsi arengereretie igoro y’okoagacha chiraaro chi’enyomba y’Omonene, na obw’ebinyomba bionsi biraetanane Hekalu biagachwe ase chimonga chi’enyomba ya Nyasae chiragachwe, amo ne chikungo chi’ebiegwa biare gocha gwatananwa bibe ebichenu.
swahili: Akampa vielelezo vya yote Roho alikuwa ameviweka moyoni mwake kwa ajili ya kumbi za Hekalu la Bwana na vyumba vyote vilivyolizunguka, kwa ajili ya hazina za Hekalu la Mungu na kwa hazina za vitu vilivyowekwa wakfu.

english: for the divisions of the priests and Levites, for all the work of service in the house of the LORD, and for all the articles of service in the house of the LORD:
ekegusii: Boigo akamoa emeroberio y’ebiombe bi’abakuani na Abalawi buna barache gokora emeremo yonsi y’obokoreri bw’enyomba y’Omonene, na obw’ebinto bionsi bi’obokoreri bw’enyomba y’Omonene.
swahili: Mfalme pia akampa Solomoni maelekezo kwa ajili ya migawanyo ya huduma za makuhani na Walawi, pia kwa ajili ya kazi zote za huduma katika Hekalu la Bwana. Akampa pia maelezo kuhusu vifaa vyote vya kutumika katika huduma ya Hekalu.

english: the weight of all the gold articles for every kind of service; the weight of all the silver articles for every kind of service;
ekegusii: Akamotebereria igoro y’oborito bwe chitaabu na obwe chifeta chikoroiserigwa kera egekorero kegokorerwa ase Hekalu,
swahili: Akamwagizia uzito wa dhahabu kwa ajili ya vitu vyote vya dhahabu vya kutumika katika huduma mbalimbali, uzito wa fedha kwa ajili ya vitu vyote vya fedha vya kutumika katika huduma mbalimbali.

english: the weight of the gold lampstands and their lamps, including the weight of each lampstand and its lamps; the weight of each silver lampstand and its lamps, according to the use of each lampstand;
ekegusii: na oborito bwe chitaabu chi’ebibekerero bie chitaaya na echie chitaaya chiria, na obwa kera ekebekerero gie chitaaya ao ao, na oborito bw’echifeta chia kera ekebekerero gie chitaaya, ne chitaaya chiria, koreng’ana nemeremo ya kera ekebekerero,
swahili: Uzito wa dhahabu kwa ajili ya vinara vya dhahabu na taa zake, kukiwa na uzito kwa ajili ya kila kinara na taa zake, pamoja na uzito wa fedha kwa ajili ya kila kinara cha fedha na taa zake, kulingana na matumizi ya kila kinara;

english: the weight of gold for each table of showbread, and of silver for the silver tables;
ekegusii: na oborito bwe chitaabu chia kera emesa y’emegati ekoruegwa ase Nyasae, na obwe chifeta chikoroiserigwa chimesa chi’echifeta.
swahili: uzito wa dhahabu kwa ajili ya meza ya mikate iliyowekwa wakfu, uzito wa fedha kwa ajili ya meza ya fedha;

english: the weight of the pure gold for the forks, sprinkling bowls, and pitchers; the weight of each gold dish; the weight of each silver bowl;
ekegusii: Akamotebereria igoro ye chigami, ne chisani, na ebitaabo biroisigwe korwa ase chitaabu chichenire na igoro ye chibakuri chi’echitaabu, na echie chifeta, na oborito bwa kera eyemo;
swahili: uzito wa dhahabu safi kwa ajili ya nyuma, mabakuli ya kunyunyizia na vikombe, masinia; uzito wa dhahabu kwa ajili ya kila bakuli la dhahabu; uzito wa fedha kwa ajili ya kila bakuli la fedha;

english: the weight of the refined gold for the altar of incense; and the plans for the chariot of the gold cherubim that spread their wings and overshadowed the ark of the covenant of the LORD.
ekegusii: na igoro y’egesasiimero ki’ogosambera ubani, keraroisigwe korwa ase etaabu echenire. Akamotebereria boigo igoro y’omooroberio oyo bw’egari y’etaabu nero ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba baria baramborete chimbaaba chiabo igoro y’Esanduki ere ne chibao chiriikire okobwatana kw’Omonene na bayetubete.
swahili: na uzito wa dhahabu safi kwa ajili ya madhabahu ya kufukizia uvumba. Pia alimpa kielelezo kwa ajili ya gari, yaani, wale makerubi wa dhahabu waliokunjua mbawa zao na kuweka kivuli juu ya Sanduku la Agano la Bwana.

english: “All this,” said David, “all the details of this plan, the LORD has made clear to me in writing by His hand upon me.”
ekegusii: Daudi agateebia Sulemani, “Aya onsi Omonene nigo andikerete nokoboko kwaye, akanyorokereria buna emeremo yonsi egochia gokoreka yare kobwatekana nomogwekano orwetwe.”
swahili: Daudi akasema, “Hii yote, ninayo kwa maandishi kutoka mkononi mwa Bwana ulio juu yangu, naye amenipa ufahamu kwa ajili ya habari zote za kielelezo hiki.”

english: Then King David rose to his feet and said, “Listen to me, my brothers and my people. It was in my heart to build a house as a resting place for the ark of the covenant of the LORD and as a footstool for our God. I had made preparations to build it,
ekegusii: Erio omorwoti Daudi agatenena, agakwana, “Inwe baminto na abanto baane, inyigwe. Nigo narengereretie koagacha enyomba ase Esanduki eria ere ne chibao chiriikire okobwatana kw’Omonene erabeekwe, eyio ere egeteni ki’amagoro ’Omonene, Nyasae oito, nkabeka ebinto ang’e ase okoagacha enyomba eyio.
swahili: Mfalme Daudi akainuka na kusema: “Nisikilizeni ndugu zangu nanyi watu wangu. Nilikuwa na nia ya kujenga nyumba ili iwe mahali pa kukaa Sanduku la Agano la Bwana kwa ajili ya kuwa mahali pa kuwekea miguu ya Mungu wetu, nami nikafanya maandalizi ya kuijenga.

english: David also said to Solomon his son, “Be strong and courageous, and do it. Do not be afraid or discouraged, for the LORD God, my God, is with you. He will neither fail you nor forsake you before all the work for the service of the house of the LORD is finished.
ekegusii: Naende Daudi agateebia Sulemani, omwana oye, “Obe omokong’u, naende omoremu, erio okore ayio. Toiroka, gose tokwa moyo, ekiagera Omonene, oyore Nyasae one, nigo are amo naye. Omonene takogotiga obugwe, goika emeremo yonsi y’enyomba yaye eere.
swahili: Daudi pia akamwambia Solomoni mwanawe, “Uwe hodari na moyo mkuu, ukafanye kazi hii. Usiogope wala usifadhaike, kwa maana Bwana aliye Mungu, Mungu wangu yu pamoja nawe. Hatakuacha wala hatakupungukia mpaka kazi hii yote kwa ajili ya utumishi wa Hekalu la Bwana itakapokamilika.

english: The divisions of the priests and Levites are ready for all the service of the house of God, and every willing man of every skill will be at your disposal for the work. The officials and all the people are fully at your command.”
ekegusii: Rora ebiombe bi’abakuani na Abalawi baria barakore emeremo yonsi y’enyomba ya Nyasae nao bare aa; kera omonto ore nogwancha, naende omanyete emeremo ende yonsi, nabe naye ase emeremo yonsi. Boigo abaraai bonsi amo nabaanto bonsi nababe bagokora aya onsi orabachike.”
swahili: Migawanyo ya makuhani na Walawi iko tayari kwa ajili ya kazi yote katika Hekalu la Mungu, naye kila mtu mwenye moyo wa kupenda mwenye ustadi katika aina yoyote ya ufundi atakusaidia katika kazi yote. Maafisa na watu wote watatii kila agizo lako.”

english: but God said to me, ‘You are not to build a house for My Name, because you are a man of war who has spilled blood.’
ekegusii: Korende Omonene agankania, aganteebia: Aye tokonyara koagacha enyomba ase engencho y’erieta riane, ekiagera kwarwanire chiseegi na gwaiteire amanyinga ’abaanto.
swahili: Lakini Mungu akaniambia, ‘Wewe hutajenga nyumba kwa Jina langu, kwa sababu wewe umepigana vita na umemwaga damu.’

english: Yet the LORD, the God of Israel, chose me out of all my father’s house to be king over Israel forever. For He chose Judah as leader, and from the house of Judah He chose my father’s household, and from my father’s sons He was pleased to make me king over all Israel.
ekegusii: Korende nonya naboigo, Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, aganchora korwa ase enyomba ya tata, akambeka nkaba omorwoti igoro ase Abaisraeli kogenderera botambe. Nigo achorete Abayuda bakaba abaraai, na korwa ase Abayuda agachora enyomba ya tata, na ase egati y’abana baye Omonene akagokigwa nainche, akambeka nkaba omorwoti igoro ase Abaisraeli bonsi.
swahili: “Hata hivyo, Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli, alinichagua mimi kutoka jamaa yangu yote niwe mfalme juu ya Israeli milele. Alimchagua Yuda kuwa kiongozi na kutoka nyumba ya Yuda akaichagua jamaa yangu na kutoka wana wa baba yangu ikampendeza kunifanya niwe mfalme juu ya Israeli yote.

english: And of all my sons—for the LORD has given me many sons—He has chosen Solomon my son to sit on the throne of the kingdom of the LORD over Israel.
ekegusii: Omonene ong’eire abamura abange, na ase abwo bonsi ochorire Sulemani aikaranse ase ekerogo ki’oborwoti ki’Abaisraeli abw’Omonene akogambera.
swahili: Miongoni mwa wanangu wote, naye Bwana amenipa wengi, amemchagua Solomoni mwanangu ili kukikalia kiti cha enzi cha ufalme wa Bwana juu ya Israeli.

english: And He said to me, ‘Solomon your son is the one who will build My house and My courts, for I have chosen him as My son, and I will be his Father.
ekegusii: “Omonene agakwana aganteebia: Sulemani, omomura oo, nere oraagache enyomba yane ne chiraaro chiane, ekiagera namochorire abe omwana one, na inche nimbe ise.
swahili: Aliniambia, ‘Solomoni mwanao ndiye atakayejenga nyumba yangu na nyua zangu, kwa maana nimemchagua yeye kuwa mwanangu, nami nitakuwa baba yake.

english: I will establish his kingdom forever, if he resolutely carries out My commandments and ordinances, as is being done this day.’
ekegusii: Ninkore oborwoti bwaye bobe ne chinguru kare na kare karagenderere bokong’u kobwata na koigwera amachiiko aane, na emeroberio yane echiikire, buna agokora ase engaki eye.
swahili: Nitaufanya imara ufalme wake milele kama akiendelea kuzishika amri zangu na sheria zangu, kama afanyavyo hivi leo.’

english: So now in the sight of all Israel, the assembly of the LORD, and in the hearing of our God, keep and seek out all the commandments of the LORD your God, so that you may possess this good land and leave it as an inheritance to your descendants forever.
ekegusii: “Ase ayio bono aiga ase amasio ’Abaisraeli bonsi bare omosangererekano bw’Omonene, na ase obosio bwa Nyasae oito oyotoigwete, morende mono amachiiko onsi ay’Omonene, Nyasae onio, na koyabwatia, erio nario moramenye ase ense eye engiya na koyetigera abana baino, ebe omwando obo kogenderera botambe magega yaino.
swahili: “Hivyo basi ninawaagiza mbele za Israeli yote na kusanyiko hili la Bwana naye Mungu wetu akiwa anasikia: Kuweni na bidii kuzifuata amri za Bwana Mungu wenu, ili mpate kumiliki nchi hii nzuri na kuwaachia wana wenu kuwa urithi milele.

english: As for you, Solomon my son, know the God of your father and serve Him wholeheartedly and with a willing mind, for the LORD searches every heart and understands the intent of every thought. If you seek Him, He will be found by you; but if you forsake Him, He will reject you forever.
ekegusii: “Naye Sulemani, omwana one, omomanye Nyasae one inche iso, naende omokorere nenkoro yao yonsi, na ase ogwancha kwao gwonsi, ekiagera Omonene nigo akorenga chinkoro chionsi, naende nigo amanyete kera omooroberio na ebirengererio bionsi. Koramorigie, ere nanche omonyoore; korende onye gokomotiga, ere nigo aragotugute kare na kare.
swahili: “Nawe Solomoni mwanangu, mjue Mungu wa baba yako, ukamtumikie kwa kujitoa kwa moyo wote na kwa nia ya kumkubali, kwa maana Bwana huuchunguza kila moyo na kujua kila kusudi la kila fikira. Ukimtafuta, ataonekana kwako; bali kama ukimwacha, yeye atakukataa milele.

english: Then King David said to the whole assembly, “My son Solomon, the one whom God has chosen, is young and inexperienced. The task is great because this palace is not for man, but for the LORD God.
ekegusii: Daudi omorwoti agakwana nomosangererekano bwonsi, agateeba, “Sulemani, omwana one, oyo Omonene Nyasae achorire, nomoke, taramanya amange, na emeremo eye nigo ere emenene. Enyomba eye y’obonene tekoba ase Mwanyabaanto, korende nase Omonene.
swahili: Ndipo Mfalme Daudi akaliambia kusanyiko lote: “Mwanangu Solomoni, yeye ambaye Mungu amemchagua, ni kijana mdogo na asiye na uzoefu. Kazi hii ni kubwa, kwa sababu Hekalu hili la fahari si kwa ajili ya mwanadamu bali ni kwa ajili ya Bwana.

english: Then David blessed the LORD in the sight of all the assembly and said: “May You be blessed, O LORD, God of our father Israel, from everlasting to everlasting.
ekegusii: Daudi agatogia Omonene ase obosio bw’omosangererekano bwonsi, akabora, “Aye Omonene, Nyasae o Israeli, sokoro yaito, kware gotogigwa korwa kare na gochia kare na kare!
swahili: Daudi akamhimidi Bwana mbele ya kusanyiko lote, akisema: “Uhimidiwe wewe, Ee Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli baba yetu, tangu milele hata milele.

english: Yours, O LORD, is the greatness and the power and the glory and the splendor and the majesty, for everything in heaven and on earth belongs to You. Yours, O LORD, is the kingdom, and You are exalted as head over all.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, obonene nobwao amo nokobua, na obomeka‐meku, na obobui, na obonguru. Ebinto bionsi bire igoro na ebire ase ense nebiao. Aye Omonene, oborwoti nobwao, naye omonyene bweimokereretie igoro okaba omotwe o bionsi.
swahili: Ukuu na uweza, ni vyako, Ee Bwana, na utukufu na enzi na uzuri, kwa kuwa kila kilichoko mbinguni na duniani ni chako wewe. Ee Bwana, ufalme ni wako; umetukuzwa kuwa mkuu juu ya yote.

english: Both riches and honor come from You, and You are the ruler over all. In Your hands are power and might to exalt and give strength to all.
ekegusii: Obotenenku bwonsi na amasikani nigo bikorwa asore aye, naye okogamba igoro ase bionsi. Ase okoboko kwao chinguru na okobua nao bire; nobwate okobua kw’ogokinia na korua chinguru ase bonsi.
swahili: Utajiri na heshima vyatoka kwako; wewe ndiwe utawalaye vitu vyote. Mikononi mwako kuna nguvu na uweza ili kuinua na kuwapa wote nguvu,

english: Now therefore, our God, we give You thanks, and we praise Your glorious name.
ekegusii: Bono Nyasae oito, twakoiraneirie ng’a mbuya mono na gotogia erieta riao ri’obonene.
swahili: Sasa, Mungu wetu, tunakushukuru na kulisifu Jina lako tukufu.

english: But who am I, and who are my people, that we should be able to give as generously as this? For everything comes from You, and from Your own hand we have given to You.
ekegusii: “Korende inche ninki ing’isaine, na abanto baane ninki baisaine, goika twanyarire korua ebinto ase ogwancha buna oko? Ebinto bionsi nigo bikorwa asore; ase ayio ebinto biaruete ase okoboko kwao nabio twakoeire.
swahili: “Lakini mimi ni nani, nao watu wangu ni nani, hata tuweze kukutolea kwa ukarimu namna hii? Vitu vyote vyatoka kwako, nasi tumekutolea tu vile vitokavyo mkononi mwako.

english: For we are foreigners and strangers in Your presence, as were all our forefathers. Our days on earth are like a shadow, without hope.
ekegusii: Intwe nigo tore ase ense y’obogeni, naende nigo tore abaeti ase obosio bwao, buna chisokoro chiaito chionsi chiarenge; amatuko aito ay’okomenya ase ense nigo anga buna omorengari, na ogosemeria konde tikoiyo.
swahili: Sisi ni wageni na wapitaji machoni pako, kama walivyokuwa baba zetu wote. Siku zetu duniani ni kama kivuli, bila tumaini.

english: O LORD our God, from Your hand comes all this abundance that we have provided to build You a house for Your holy Name, and all of it belongs to You.
ekegusii: Ee, aye Omonene, Nyasae oito, ebinto ebi bionsi ebinge twarure ase okoagacha enyomba ase engencho y’erieta riao richenu nigo bikorwa ase okoboko kwao, na bionsi nebiao aye omonyene.
swahili: Ee Bwana Mungu wetu, kwa wingi wote huu ambao tumekutolea kwa kujenga Hekalu kwa ajili ya Jina lako Takatifu, vimetoka mkononi mwako, navyo vyote ni mali yako.

english: I know, my God, that You test the heart and delight in uprightness. All these things I have given willingly and with an upright heart, and now I have seen Your people who are present here giving joyfully and willingly to You.
ekegusii: Nyasae one, nimanyete ng’a aye nigo okorenga enkoro, naende nigo ogokirie nayare ay’oboronge. Ase enkoro endonge narure ebinto ebio bionsi nogwancha; na bono narorire abanto bao abare aiga bagokoruera nogwancha, naende ase omogooko omonge.
swahili: Ninajua, Mungu wangu, kwamba wewe huujaribu moyo na unapendezwa na unyofu. Vitu hivi vyote nimetoa kwa hiari na kwa moyo mnyofu. Nami sasa nimeona kwa furaha jinsi watu wako walioko hapa kwa hiari yao walivyokutolea wewe.

english: O LORD, God of our fathers Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, keep this desire forever in the intentions of the hearts of Your people, and direct their hearts toward You.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, Nyasae o Aburaamu, na o Isaka, na o Israeli chisokoro chiaito, tiga abanto bao, bagenderere koba nekerenga eke na ebirengererio ase chinkoro chiabo botambe kogenderera, naende oonchore chinkoro chiabo chibeere asore.
swahili: Ee Bwana, Mungu wa baba zetu Abrahamu, Isaki na Israeli, weka shauku hii ndani ya mioyo ya watu wako daima na uifanye mioyo yao iwe na uaminifu kwako.

english: And give my son Solomon a whole heart to keep and carry out all Your commandments, decrees, and statutes, and to build Your palace for which I have made provision.”
ekegusii: Oe Sulemani, omwana one, enkoro yeruete asore, erinde arende amachiiko ao, na oborori bwao, na emeroberio yao echiikire, akore aya onsi na aagache enyomba eria y’obonene nabeire nkobeeka ebinto bionsi ang’e ase okoyeagacha.”
swahili: Nawe umpe mwanangu Solomoni kujitolea kwako kwa moyo wote ili kuzishika amri zako, masharti yako, maagizo yako na kufanya kila kitu ili kujenga Hekalu hili la fahari ambalo kwa ajili yake nimetoa.”

english: Now with all my ability I have made provision for the house of my God—gold for the gold articles, silver for the silver, bronze for the bronze, iron for the iron, and wood for the wood, as well as onyx for the settings, turquoise, stones of various colors, all kinds of precious stones, and slabs of marble—all in abundance.
ekegusii: Inche ase ogokora aya narenge konyara, nabekire ebinto ang’e ase okoagachera enyomba ya Nyasae one: chitaabu ase ebinto bie chitaabu, ne chifeta ase ebinto bie chifeta, ne chitaai ase ebinto bie chitaai, na ebioma ase ebinto bi’ebioma, ne chibao ase ebinto bi’echibao. Amo n’ebinto ebio narure amagena e rigori rinene, buna oiniki na ayande ay’ogosata, ayare nebieni ao ao, akomeka‐meka, amo namagena ande amange amarabu akomeka‐meka.
swahili: Kwa uwezo wangu wote nimetenga mali kwa ajili ya Hekalu la Mungu wangu: dhahabu kwa kazi za dhahabu, fedha kwa ajili ya fedha, shaba kwa kazi za shaba, chuma kwa kazi za chuma na miti kwa kazi za miti, vivyo hivyo vito vya shohamu kwa ajili ya kutia kwenye vijalizo, almasi, mawe ya rangi mbalimbali, aina zote za vito vya thamani na marmar; yote haya kwa wingi mno.

english: Then David said to the whole assembly, “Blessed be the LORD your God.” So the whole assembly blessed the LORD, the God of their fathers. They bowed down and paid homage to the LORD and to the king. Solomon Anointed King (1 Kings 1:32–40)
ekegusii: Erio Daudi agateebia omosangererekano bwonsi, “Togia Omonene, Nyasae oino!” Na omosangererekano bwonsi ogatogia Omonene, Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiabo, na agwo abanto baria bagatureka emetwe yabo, bagasasiima Omonene naende bakaorokia amasikani ase omorwoti.
