swahili: Ndipo Daudi akaliambia kusanyiko lote, “Mhimidini Bwana Mungu wenu.” Hivyo wote wakamhimidi Bwana, Mungu wa baba zao. Wakasujudu na kuanguka kifudifudi mbele za Bwana na mfalme. Solomoni Akubalika Kuwa Mfalme

english: The next day they offered sacrifices and presented burnt offerings to the LORD: a thousand bulls, a thousand rams, and a thousand lambs, along with their drink offerings, and other sacrifices in abundance for all Israel.
ekegusii: Ne rituko ria kabere barabwo bakaruera Omonene ebing’wanso, bakamoruera nebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa; chieri elifu eyemo, ne chimingichi elifu eyemo, ne chimanwa chi’eching’ondi elifu eyemo, amo nokoruegwa kw’ebinyugwa gwachikiire amo nabirobio, naende akarua ebing’wanso ebinge ase engencho y’Abaisraeli bonsi.
swahili: Siku ya pili yake wakamtolea Bwana dhabihu na sadaka za kuteketezwa: mafahali 1,000, kondoo dume 1,000 na wana-kondoo dume 1,000, pamoja na sadaka za kinywaji na sadaka nyingine nyingi sana kwa ajili ya Israeli.

english: That day they ate and drank with great joy in the presence of the LORD. Then, for a second time, they designated David’s son Solomon as king, anointing him before the LORD as ruler, and Zadok as the priest.
ekegusii: Nabarabwo bakaria na konywa ase obosio bw’Omonene ase rituko riria, bakaba nomogooko omonene. Bono eria kabere bakabeeka Sulemani, mosinto o Daudi, akaba omorwoti obo; bakamoaka amaguta akaba omogambi ase ogokorera Omonene, na Zadoki agaakwa amaguta akaba Omokuani.
swahili: Wakala na kunywa kwa furaha kubwa mbele za Bwana siku ile. Wakamtawaza Solomoni mwana wa Daudi mara ya pili kuwa mfalme, wakamtia mafuta kwa ajili ya Bwana ili awe mfalme na Sadoki kuwa kuhani.

english: So Solomon sat on the throne of the LORD as king in place of his father David. He prospered, and all Israel obeyed him.
ekegusii: Erio Sulemani agaikaransa ase ekerogo ki’oborwoti bw’Omonene, akaba omorwoti ribaga ria Daudi ise, akaba ogosesenigwa, na Abaisraeli bonsi bakamoigwera.
swahili: Solomoni akaketi kwenye kiti cha enzi cha Bwana kuwa mfalme mahali pa Daudi baba yake. Akafanikiwa sana na Israeli wote wakamtii.

english: All the officials and mighty men, as well as all of King David’s sons, pledged their allegiance to King Solomon.
ekegusii: Abaraai bonsi, na abanto chituoni, amo nabamura bonsi ba Daudi omorwoti bakaria chiira ng’a mbabwatane nomorwoti Sulemani.
swahili: Maafisa wote na mashujaa, pamoja na wana wote wa Daudi, wakaahidi kumtii Mfalme Solomoni.

english: The LORD highly exalted Solomon in the sight of all Israel and bestowed on him royal majesty such as had not been bestowed on any king in Israel before him. David’s Reign and Death (1 Kings 2:10–12)
ekegusii: Omonene akaa Sulemani erieta rinene ase egati y’Abaisraeli bonsi, naende akamoa oborwoti bore nobonene obwo ataete omorwoti onde bwensi omotang’anerete agwo ase Abaisraeli. Amang’ana ameng’e igoro y’okogamba gwa Daudi
swahili: Bwana akamtukuza sana Solomoni mbele ya Israeli wote na kumvika fahari ya kifalme ambayo hakuna mfalme yeyote wa Israeli kabla yake aliwahi kuwa nayo. Muhtasari Wa Utawala Wa Daudi

english: David son of Jesse was king over all Israel.
ekegusii: Bono Daudi, mosinto o Yese, konya ogambeire Abaisraeli bonsi.
swahili: Daudi mwana wa Yese alikuwa mfalme wa Israeli yote.

english: The length of David’s reign over Israel was forty years—seven years in Hebron and thirty-three years in Jerusalem.
ekegusii: Akagambera Abaisraeli emiaka emerongo ene, emiaka etano na ebere (7) agwo Heburoni, na emiaka emerongo etato na etato (33) agwo Yerusalemu.
swahili: Alitawala Israeli kwa miaka arobaini: huko Hebroni alitawala miaka saba, na katika Yerusalemu akatawala miaka thelathini na mitatu.

english: He died at a ripe old age, full of years, riches, and honor, and his son Solomon reigned in his place.
ekegusii: Daudi agakwa ore omogotu mono bw’amatuko amange, nigo arenge omonto omonda osikire; na Sulemani, omomura oye, akaba okogamba ase ribaga riaye.
swahili: Daudi akafa akiwa mzee mwenye umri mwema, akiwa ameshiba siku, utajiri na heshima. Naye Solomoni mwanawe akawa mfalme baada yake.

english: Now the acts of King David, from first to last, are indeed written in the Chronicles of Samuel the Seer, the Chronicles of Nathan the Prophet, and the Chronicles of Gad the Seer,
ekegusii: Bono amang’ana aria Daudi omorwoti akorete korwa omochakano goika omoerie nigo ariikire ase chibuku chia Samweli omoorori, na ase echia Nathani omobani, na ase echia Gadi omoorori.
swahili: Kuhusu matukio ya utawala wa Mfalme Daudi, kuanzia mwanzo hadi mwisho, yameandikwa katika kumbukumbu za mwonaji Samweli, na kumbukumbu za nabii Nathani na kumbukumbu za mwonaji Gadi,

english: Moreover, because of my delight in the house of my God, I now give for it my personal treasures of gold and silver, over and above all that I have provided for this holy temple:
ekegusii: Boigo naende ekiagera nanchire na kwerwa ase enyomba ya Nyasae one, narure ase enyomba eye enchenu chinibo chiane chionsi chi’echitaabu ne chifeta komenta ase ebinto ebio bionsi konya narure.
swahili: Zaidi ya hayo, kwa kujitolea kwangu kwa ajili ya Hekalu la Mungu wangu, sasa ninatoa hazina zangu mwenyewe za dhahabu na fedha kwa ajili ya Hekalu la Mungu wangu, zaidi ya mali niliyotoa kwa ajili ya Hekalu hili takatifu:

english: together with all the details of his reign, his might, and the circumstances that came upon him and Israel and all the kingdoms of the lands.
ekegusii: Bakariika amang’ana onsi igoro y’okogamba kwaye, na okobua kwaye, na amang’ana onsi amonyorete ere amo n’Abaisraeli, na amarwoti ande onsi ay’ense.
swahili: pamoja na habari zote za utawala wake, nguvu zake na matukio yaliyompata yeye, na Israeli, na falme za nchi nyingine zote.

english: three thousand talents of gold (the gold of Ophir) and seven thousand talents of refined silver, to overlay the walls of the buildings,
ekegusii: Nkorua inde chitaabu, chitalanta chilifu isato, korwa ase Ofiri, ne chifeta chichenire chitalanta amagana atano na abere ase okooma chinyasi chi’enyomba,
swahili: talanta 3,000 za dhahabu (dhahabu ya Ofiri) na talanta 7,000 za fedha safi iliyosafishwa, kwa ajili ya kufunika kuta za Hekalu,

english: for the gold work and the silver work, and for all the work to be done by the craftsmen. Now who will volunteer to consecrate himself to the LORD today?”
ekegusii: na ase emeremo ende yonsi egochia gokorwa nabaroisia ebinto, chitaabu ase ebinto bie chitaabu, ne chifeta ase ebinto bie chifeta. Ning’o ogochia kwerwa ase ogwancha? Oyio tiga eatanane bweka omonyene ase Omonene rituko ria reero.”
swahili: kwa kazi ya dhahabu na kazi ya fedha na kwa kazi yote itakayofanywa na mafundi. Basi, ni nani anayependa kujitoa kwa Bwana leo?”

english: Then the leaders of the households, the officers of the tribes of Israel, the commanders of thousands and of hundreds, and the officials in charge of the king’s work gave willingly.
ekegusii: Erio abateneneri be chiamate chiabo bakarua ebiegwa bi’ogwancha; abaraai b’ebisaku na abatang’ani b’abasikari chilifu na ab’amagana, na abateneneri b’emeremo y’omorwoti boigo bakarua.
swahili: Ndipo viongozi wa jamaa, maafisa wa kabila za Israeli, majemadari wa maelfu na majemadari wa mamia, pamoja na maafisa waliokuwa wasimamizi wa kazi za mfalme wakatoa kwa hiari yao.

english: Toward the service of God’s house they gave 5,000 talents and 10,000 darics of gold, 10,000 talents of silver, 18,000 talents of bronze, and 100,000 talents of iron.
ekegusii: Barabwo bakarua ase emeremo y’enyomba ya Nyasae chitaabu chitalanta chilifu isano ne chidarikoni chilifu ikomi, ne chifeta chitalanta chilifu ikomi, ne chitaai chitalanta chilifu ikomi na isano na isato, na ebioma chitalanta chilifu rigana erimo.
swahili: Wakatoa kwa ajili ya kazi ya Hekalu la Mungu talanta 5,000 na darkoni 10,000 za dhahabu, talanta 10,000 za fedha, talanta 18,000 za shaba na talanta 100,000 za chuma.

english: Whoever had precious stones gave them to the treasury of the house of the LORD, under the care of Jehiel the Gershonite.
ekegusii: Omonto onde bwensi obwate amagena e rigori rinene akayarua, na amagena ayio akabeekwa ase ekungo y’enyomba y’Omonene, inse y’oborendi bwa Yehieli Omogerisoni.
swahili: Kila mmoja aliyekuwa na vito vya thamani akavitoa katika hazina ya Hekalu la Bwana chini ya uangalizi wa Yehieli Mgershoni.

english: And the people rejoiced at the willing response of their leaders, for they had given to the LORD freely and wholeheartedly. And King David also rejoiced greatly. David’s Prayer of Blessing
ekegusii: Erio abanto bakaba nomogooko, ekiagera bonsi nigo baruete ase ogwancha, na ase chinkoro chieruete ase Omonene. Daudi omorwoti boigo akaba nomogooko omonene. Daudi ogotogia Nyasae
swahili: Watu wakafurahi kwa sababu ya itikio la hiari la viongozi wao, kwa kuwa walikuwa wametoa kwa hiari na kwa moyo wote kwa Bwana. Mfalme Daudi pia akafurahi sana. Maombi Ya Daudi

english: These were the sons of Israel: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulun,
ekegusii: Aba nabwo abana abamura ba Israeli: Rubeni, na Simioni, Lawi na Yuda, Isakaru na Sabuloni,
swahili: Hawa ndio waliokuwa wana wa Israeli: Reubeni, Simeoni, Lawi, Yuda, Isakari, Zabuloni,

english: Ram was the father of Amminadab, and Amminadab was the father of Nahshon, a leader of the descendants of Judah.
ekegusii: Ramu akaibora Aminadabu, na Aminadabu akaibora Nahasoni, oyo orenge omotang’ani bw’abaanto b’ororeria rwa Yuda.
swahili: Ramu alimzaa Aminadabu, na Aminadabu akamzaa Nashoni, kiongozi wa kabila la Yuda.

english: Nahshon was the father of Salmon, and Salmon was the father of Boaz.
ekegusii: Nahasoni akaibora Salima, na Salima akaibora Boazi,
swahili: Nashoni akamzaa Salmoni, Salmoni akamzaa Boazi,

english: Boaz was the father of Obed, and Obed was the father of Jesse.
ekegusii: Boazi akaibora Obedi, na Obedi akaibora Yese.
swahili: Boazi akamzaa Obedi, Obedi akamzaa Yese.

english: Jesse was the father of Eliab his firstborn; Abinadab was born second, Shimea third,
ekegusii: Yese akaibora Eliabu, omwana oye omomura omotangi, na Abinadabu oyo o kabere, na Simea oyo o gatato,
swahili: Yese akawazaa Eliabu mwanawe wa kwanza; wa pili Abinadabu, wa tatu Shimea,

english: Nethanel fourth, Raddai fifth,
ekegusii: na Netaneli oyo o kane, na Radai oyo o gatano,
swahili: wa nne Nethaneli, wa tano Radai,

english: Ozem sixth, and David seventh.
ekegusii: Osemu oyo o gatano na rimo, na Daudi oyo o gatano na kabere.
swahili: wa sita Osemu, na wa saba Daudi.

english: Their sisters were Zeruiah and Abigail. And the three sons of Zeruiah were Abishai, Joab, and Asahel.
ekegusii: Abaiseke bamwabo nabwo barenge Seruya na Abigaeli. Abana abamura b’omokuungu Seruya nabwo aba: Abisai na Yoabu, na Asaeli, bonsi mbatato.
swahili: Dada zao walikuwa Seruya na Abigaili. Wana wa Seruya walikuwa watatu: Abishai, Yoabu na Asaheli.

english: Abigail was the mother of Amasa, whose father was Jether the Ishmaelite.
ekegusii: Abigaeli akaibora Amasa, na ise Amasa nere Yeteri, Omoisumaeli. Ororeria rwa Hezironi
swahili: Abigaili alikuwa mama yake Amasa, ambaye baba yake alikuwa Yetheri, Mwishmaeli. Kalebu Mwana Wa Hesroni

english: Caleb son of Hezron had children by his wife Azubah and by Jerioth. These were the sons of Azubah: Jesher, Shobab, and Ardon.
ekegusii: Kalebu, mosinto o Hezironi, akanyuoma Asuba. Asuba akamoiborera Yerioti omoiseke. Na abana abamura baye nabwo aba: Yeseri na Sobabu, na Aridoni.
swahili: Kalebu mwana wa Hesroni akazaa wana na mkewe Azuba (na pia na Yeriothi). Hawa ndio wana Azuba aliomzalia Kalebu: Yesheri, Shobabu na Ardoni.

english: When Azubah died, Caleb married Ephrath, who bore to him Hur.
ekegusii: Ekero Asuba akwete, Kalebu akanyuoma Efarata; ere akamoiborera Huri.
swahili: Azuba alipofariki, Kalebu akamwoa Efrathi, ambaye alimzalia Huri.

english: Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.
ekegusii: Dani na Yusufu, Benjamini na Nafutali, Gadi na Aseri.
swahili: Dani, Yosefu, Benyamini, Naftali, Gadi na Asheri. Yuda Hadi Wana Wa Hesroni

english: Hur was the father of Uri, and Uri was the father of Bezalel.
ekegusii: Huri akaibora Uri, na Uri akaibora Besaleli.
swahili: Huri akamzaa Uri, Uri akamzaa Bezaleli.

english: Later, Hezron slept with the daughter of Machir the father of Gilead. He had married her when he was sixty years old, and she bore to him Segub.
ekegusii: Ekero Hezironi arenge nemiaka emerongo etano nomo, akanyuoma omoiseke o Makiri, ise Gileadi, Omokungu oria akamoiborera Segubu.
swahili: Hatimaye, Hesroni akakutana kimwili na binti wa Makiri babaye Gileadi (ambaye alimwoa alipokuwa na umri wa miaka sitini), naye akamzaa Segubu.

english: Segub was the father of Jair, who had twenty-three cities in the land of Gilead.
ekegusii: Segubu akaibora Yairi, oyio obwate emechie emerongo ebere, na etato (23), ase ense ya Gileadi.
swahili: Segubu akamzaa Yairi, ambaye alitawala miji ishirini na mitatu katika Gileadi.

english: But Geshur and Aram captured Havvoth-jair, along with Kenath and its sixty surrounding villages. All these were descendants of Machir the father of Gilead.
ekegusii: Korende Abagesuri na Abaaramu bakaira korwa asare emechie etano nomo (6), emechie ya Yairi na Kenati amo nebichie biaetanaineo. Abanto bonsi bamenyeteo nigo barenge b’ororeria rwa Makiri ise Gileadi,
swahili: (Lakini Geshuri na Aramu wakateka miji ya Hawoth-Yairi, pamoja na Kenathi na viunga vyake; jumla ilikuwa miji sitini.) Wote hawa walikuwa wazao wa Makiri babaye Gileadi.

english: After Hezron died in Caleb-ephrathah, his wife Abijah bore to him Ashhur the father of Tekoa.
ekegusii: Magega Hezironi gakuure agwo Kalebu‐Eufarata, Abiya moga Hezironi akamoiborera Asuri, ise abanto ba Tekoa. Ororeria rwa Yerameeli
swahili: Baada ya Hesroni kufa huko Efrathi, Abiya mjane wa Hesroni akamzalia Ashuru, aliye baba wa Tekoa. Yerameeli Mwana Wa Hesroni

english: The sons of Jerahmeel the firstborn of Hezron: Ram his firstborn, Bunah, Oren, Ozem, and Ahijah.
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Yerameeli, omomura omotangi o Hezironi, nabwo aba: Ramu, omomura oye omotangi, Buna na Oreni, Osemu na Ahiya.
swahili: Wana wa Yerameeli mzaliwa wa kwanza wa Hesroni walikuwa: Ramu mzaliwa wake wa kwanza, Buna, Oreni, Osemu na Ahiya.

english: Jerahmeel had another wife named Atarah, who was the mother of Onam.
ekegusii: Boigo Yerameeli nabwate omokungu onde orenge korokwa Atara; nere orenge ng’ina Onamu.
swahili: Yerameeli alikuwa na mke mwingine, aliyeitwa Atara, aliyekuwa mama yake Onamu.

english: The sons of Ram the firstborn of Jerahmeel: Maaz, Jamin, and Eker.
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Ramu, omomura omotangi o Yerameeli, nabwo aba: Maasi na Yamini, na Ekeri.
swahili: Wana wa Ramu mzaliwa wa kwanza wa Yerameeli walikuwa: Maasi, Yamini na Ekeri.

english: The sons of Onam: Shammai and Jada. The sons of Shammai: Nadab and Abishur.
ekegusii: Abana abamura b’Onamu nabwo Samai na Yada. Abana abamura ba Samai nabwo Nadabu na Abisuri.
swahili: Wana wa Onamu walikuwa: Shamai na Yada. Wana wa Shamai walikuwa: Nadabu na Abishuri.

english: Abishur’s wife was named Abihail, and she bore to him Ahban and Molid.
ekegusii: Moka Abisuri nigo arenge korokwa Abihaili, nere akamoiborera Ahabani na Molidi.
swahili: Mke wa Abishuri aliitwa Abihaili, ambaye alimzalia Abani na Molidi.

english: The sons of Judah: Er, Onan, and Shelah. These three were born to him by Bath-shua the Canaanite. Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wicked in the sight of the LORD, who put him to death.
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Yuda nabwo aba: Eri na Onani, na Sela. Aba batato nabwo Batisua, omosubati orwete Kaanani, aiborerete Yuda. Eri, omwana omomura omotangi o Yuda, nigo arenge omobe ase obosio bw’Omonene, n’Omonene akamoita.
swahili: Wana wa Yuda walikuwa: Eri, Onani na Shela. Hawa watatu walizaliwa kwake na mkewe Mkanaani, binti wa Shua. Eri, mzaliwa wa kwanza wa Yuda, alikuwa mwovu machoni pa Bwana, kwa hiyo Bwana alimuua.

english: The sons of Nadab: Seled and Appaim. Seled died without children.
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Nadabu nabwo Seledi na Apaimu; Seledi agakwa atabwati bana.
swahili: Wana wa Nadabu walikuwa Seledi na Apaimu, lakini Seledi alikufa bila kuzaa watoto.

english: The son of Appaim: Ishi. The son of Ishi: Sheshan. The son of Sheshan: Ahlai.
ekegusii: Apaimu akaibora Ishi, na Ishi akaibora Sesani, na Sesani akaibora Alai.
swahili: Apaimu akamzaa: Ishi ambaye alikuwa baba wa Sheshani. Sheshani akamzaa Alai.

english: The sons of Jada the brother of Shammai: Jether and Jonathan. Jether died without children.
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Yada, momura omwabo Sama, nabwo Yeteri na Yonathani. Yeteri agakwa atabwati bana.
swahili: Wana wa Yada, nduguye Shamai walikuwa: Yetheri na Yonathani. Yetheri alikufa bila kuzaa watoto.

english: The sons of Jonathan: Peleth and Zaza. These were the descendants of Jerahmeel.
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Yonathani nabwo Peleti na Sasa. Aba nigo barenge ab’ororeria rwa Yerameeli.
swahili: Wana wa Yonathani walikuwa: Pelethi na Zaza. Hawa ndio waliokuwa wazao wa Yerameeli.

english: Sheshan had no sons, but only daughters; but he did have an Egyptian servant named Jarha.
ekegusii: Sesani tabwate abana abamura, korende igo abwate abana abaiseke boka. Ere Sesani nabwate omosomba oye omomura Omomisiri orenge korokwa Yara.
swahili: Sheshani hakuwa na watoto wa kiume, ila wasichana tu. Alikuwa na mtumishi Mmisri aliyeitwa Yarha.

english: Sheshan gave his daughter in marriage to his servant Jarha, and she bore to him Attai.
ekegusii: Sesani akaa Yara, omosomba oye, omoiseke oye akaba mokaye; ere akaibora omomura orenge korokwa Atai.
swahili: Sheshani akamwoza huyu mtumishi wake Yarha binti yake, akamzalia mwana jina lake Atai.

english: Attai was the father of Nathan, Nathan was the father of Zabad,
ekegusii: Atai akaibora Nathani, na Nathani akaibora Sabadi,
swahili: Atai akamzaa Nathani, Nathani akamzaa Zabadi,

english: Zabad was the father of Ephlal, Ephlal was the father of Obed,
ekegusii: Sabadi akaibora Efilali, na Efilali akaibora Obedi;
swahili: Zabadi akamzaa Eflali, Eflali akamzaa Obedi,

english: Obed was the father of Jehu, Jehu was the father of Azariah,
ekegusii: Obedi akaibora Yehu, na Yehu akaibora Asaria;
swahili: Obedi akamzaa Yehu, Yehu akamzaa Azaria,

english: Azariah was the father of Helez, Helez was the father of Elasah,
ekegusii: Asaria akaibora Helesi, na Helesi akaibora Eleasa;
swahili: Azaria akamzaa Helesi, Helesi akamzaa Eleasa,

english: Tamar, Judah’s daughter-in-law, bore to him Perez and Zerah. Judah had five sons in all.
ekegusii: Tamari, moka momura o Yuda, akaiborera Yuda Peresi na Zera. Yuda nigo abwate abana abamura batano.
swahili: Tamari, mkwewe Yuda, alimzalia wana wawili: Peresi na Zera. Yuda alikuwa na jumla ya wana watano.

english: Elasah was the father of Sismai, Sismai was the father of Shallum,
ekegusii: Eleasa akaibora Sisimai, na Sisimai akaibora Salumu;
swahili: Eleasa akamzaa Sismai, Sismai akamzaa Shalumu,

english: Shallum was the father of Jekamiah, and Jekamiah was the father of Elishama.
ekegusii: Salumu akaibora Yekamia, na Yekamia akaibora Elisama. Ororeria ronde rwa Kalebu
swahili: Shalumu akamzaa Yekamia, naye Yekamia akamzaa Elishama. Koo Za Kalebu

english: The sons of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel: Mesha his firstborn, who was the father of Ziph, and Mareshah his second son, who was the father of Hebron.
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Kalebu omwabo Yerameeli nabwo aba: Mesha, omwana omomura oye omotangi, oyorenge ise Sifu, oyorenge ise Maresa, na Maresa orenge ise Heburoni.
swahili: Wana wa Kalebu nduguye Yerameeli walikuwa: Mesha mzaliwa wake wa kwanza alimzaa Zifu, naye mwanawe Maresha akamzaa Hebroni.

english: The sons of Hebron: Korah, Tappuah, Rekem, and Shema.
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Heburoni nabwo aba: Kora na Tapua, Rekemu na Sema.
swahili: Hebroni alikuwa na wana wanne: Kora, Tapua, Rekemu na Shema.

english: Shema was the father of Raham the father of Jorkeam, and Rekem was the father of Shammai.
ekegusii: Sema akaibora Rahamu, ise Yorikeamu. Rekemu akaibora Samai.
swahili: Shema alikuwa baba yake Rahamu na Rahamu alikuwa baba wa Yorkeamu na Rekemu alikuwa baba wa Shamai.

english: The son of Shammai was Maon, and Maon was the father of Beth-zur.
ekegusii: Samai akaibora Maoni, na Maoni akaibora Beti‐Suri.
swahili: Shamai akamzaa Maoni na Maoni akamzaa Beth-Suri.

english: Caleb’s concubine Ephah was the mother of Haran, Moza, and Gazez. Haran was the father of Gazez.
ekegusii: Boigo Efa, omokungu o sere‐sere o Kalebu, akaibora Harani, na Moza, na Gasesi; na Harani boigo nabwate omomura orenge korokwa Gasesi.
swahili: Efa, suria wa Kalebu alikuwa mamaye Harani, Mosa na Gazezi. Harani alikuwa baba wa Gazezi.

english: The sons of Jahdai: Regem, Jotham, Geshan, Pelet, Ephah, and Shaaph.
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Yahadai nabwo aba: Regemu na Yotamu, Gesani na Peleti, Efa na Saafu.
swahili: Wana wa Yadai walikuwa: Regemu, Yothamu, Geshani, Peleti, Efa na Shaafu.

english: Caleb’s concubine Maacah was the mother of Sheber and Tirhanah.
ekegusii: Maaka, omokungu o sere‐sere o Kalebu, akaibora Seberi na Tirihana.
swahili: Maaka suria wa Kalebu alikuwa mamaye Sheberi na Tirhana.

english: She was also the mother of Shaaph father of Madmannah, and of Sheva father of Machbenah and Gibea. Caleb’s daughter was Acsah.
ekegusii: Boigo omokungu oria akaibora Saafu, ise Madimana, na Sheva, ise abanto ba Makibena na Abagibea. Omoiseke o Kalebu nigo arenge korokwa Asika.
swahili: Pia Maaka akamzaa Shaafu babaye Madmana, na Sheva babaye Makbena na Gibea. Kalebu alikuwa na binti jina lake Aksa.

english: The sons of Perez: Hezron and Hamul.
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Peresi nabwo Hezironi na Hamuli.
swahili: Wana wa Peresi walikuwa: Hesroni na Hamuli.

english: These were the descendants of Caleb. The sons of Hur the firstborn of Ephrathah: Shobal the father of Kiriath-jearim,
ekegusii: Aba nabwo barenge ab’ororeria rwa Kalebu. Abana abamura ba Huri, omwana omomura omotangi bw’Efarata, nabwo aba; Sobali, ise abanto ba Kiriati‐Yearimu,
swahili: Hawa ndio waliokuwa wazao wa Kalebu. Wana wa Huri, mzaliwa mkuu wao wa Efrathi, walikuwa: Shobali akamzaa Kiriath-Yearimu,

english: Salma the father of Bethlehem, and Hareph the father of Beth-gader.
ekegusii: na Salima, ise abanto ba Bethlehemu, na Harefu, ise abanto ba Beti‐Gaderi.
swahili: Salma akamzaa Bethlehemu, naye Harefu akamzaa Beth-Gaderi.

english: These were the descendants of Shobal the father of Kiriath-jearim: Haroeh, half the Manahathites,
ekegusii: Sobali, ise abanto ba Kiriati‐Yearimu, nabwate abana abamura bande: Haroe na ekeng’ese ki’abaanto ba Menuhoti.
swahili: Wazao wa Shobali, baba yake Kiriath-Yearimu, walikuwa: Haroe, nusu ya wakazi wa mji wa Menuhothi,

english: and the clans of Kiriath-jearim—the Ithrites, Puthites, Shumathites, and Mishraites. From these descended the Zorathites and Eshtaolites.
ekegusii: Ne chiamate chia Kiriati‐Yearimu nachio echi: Abaitiri na Abaputi, Abasumati na Abamisira. Korwa ase abanto aba nao Abasori na Abaesitaoli barwete.
swahili: pamoja na koo za Kiriath-Yearimu ambazo ni: Waithiri, Waputhi, Washumathi na Wamishrai. Kutokana na watu hawa walizaliwa Wasorathi na Waeshtaoli.

english: The descendants of Salma: Bethlehem, the Netophathites, Atroth-beth-joab, half the Manahathites, the Zorites,
ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rwa Salima nabwo abanto ba Bethlehemu, na Abaanetofa, na abanto b’Ataroti‐Beti‐Yoabu, na ekeng’ese ki’Abamanahati, nabwo Abasori,
swahili: Wazao wa Salma walikuwa: Bethlehemu, Wanetofathi, Atroth-Beth-Yoabu, nusu ya Wamanahathi, Wasori,

english: and the clans of the scribes who lived at Jabez—the Tirathites, Shimeathites, and Sucathites. These are the Kenites who came from Hammath, the father of the house of Rechab.
ekegusii: amo ne chiamate chi’abariki baria bamenyete agwo Yabesi, nabwo Abatirati, na Abasimeati, na Abasukati. Aba nabwo Abakeni abarwete ase Hamati, ise abanto b’enyomba ya Rekabu.
swahili: pamoja na koo za waandishi zilizoishi katika mji wa Yabesi: yaani Watirathi, Washimeathi na Wasukathi. Hawa ndio Wakeni waliotokana na Hamathi, baba wa nyumba ya Rekabu.

english: The sons of Zerah: Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Calcol, and Dara —five in all.
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Zera nabwo aba: Simuri na Etani, Hemani na Kalikuli, na Dara, bonsi mbatano.
swahili: Wana wa Zera walikuwa: Zimri, Ethani, Hemani, Kalkoli na Dara. Jumla ya wana wa Zera walikuwa watano.

english: The son of Carmi: Achar, who brought trouble upon Israel by violating the ban on devoted things.
ekegusii: Karimi nigo abwate omomura oyomo orenge korokwa Akari oyo ochandete Abaisraeli ase ogosakora ebinto biatananetwe na kobekwa ensemo ase Nyasae.
swahili: Mwana wa Karmi alikuwa: Akari, ambaye alileta taabu kwa Waisraeli kwa kukiuka onyo la kutokuchukua vitu vilivyokuwa vimewekwa wakfu.

english: The son of Ethan: Azariah.
ekegusii: Asaria nigo arenge omwana omomura bw’Etani. Ororeria rwaikerete ase Daudi
swahili: Mwana wa Ethani alikuwa: Azariya.

english: The sons who were born to Hezron: Jerahmeel, Ram, and Caleb.
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Hezironi nabwo aba: Yerameeli na Ramu, na Kelubai.
swahili: Wana wa Hesroni walikuwa: Yerameeli, Ramu na Kalebu. Kuanzia Ramu Mwana Wa Hesroni

english: These were the sons of David who were born to him in Hebron: The firstborn was Amnon by Ahinoam of Jezreel; the second was Daniel by Abigail of Carmel;
ekegusii: Aba nabwo abamura ba Daudi, abwo baiboretwe ekero arenge Heburoni: Amunoni, omomura oye omotangi, oiboretwe n’Ahinoamu orwete Yesireeli, na oyo o kabere Danieli, oiboretwe n’Abigaeli orwete Karimeli;
swahili: Hawa ndio waliokuwa wana wa Daudi waliozaliwa huko Hebroni: Mzaliwa wa kwanza alikuwa Amnoni ambaye mama yake aliitwa Ahinoamu wa Yezreeli; wa pili, Danieli ambaye mama yake alikuwa Abigaili wa Karmeli;

english: Solomon’s son was Rehoboam: Abijah was his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,
ekegusii: Ororeria rwa Sulemani narwo oro: Sulemani akaibora Rehoboamu, na Rehoboamu akaibora Abiya; Abiya akaibora Asa, na Asa akaibora Yehosafati;
swahili: Mwana wa Solomoni alikuwa Rehoboamu, mwanawe huyo alikuwa Abiya, mwanawe huyo alikuwa Yehoshafati, mwanawe huyo alikuwa Asa,

english: Joram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,
ekegusii: Yehosafati akaibora Yehoramu, na Yehoramu akaibora Ahasia, na Ahasia akaibora Yoashi;
swahili: mwanawe huyo alikuwa Yehoramu, mwanawe huyo alikuwa Ahazia, mwanawe huyo alikuwa Yoashi,

english: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,
ekegusii: Yoashi akaibora Amasia, na Amasia akaibora Asaria, na Asaria akaibora Yotamu;
swahili: mwanawe huyo alikuwa Amazia, mwanawe huyo alikuwa Azaria, mwanawe huyo alikuwa Yothamu,

english: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,
ekegusii: Yotamu akaibora Ahasi, na Ahasi akaibora Hezekia, na Hezekia akaibora Manase;
swahili: mwanawe huyo alikuwa Ahazi, mwanawe huyo alikuwa Hezekia, mwanawe huyo alikuwa Manase,

english: Amon his son, and Josiah his son.
ekegusii: Manase akaibora Amoni, na Amoni akaibora Yosia.
swahili: mwanawe huyo alikuwa Amoni na mwanawe huyo alikuwa Yosia.

english: The sons of Josiah: Johanan was the firstborn, Jehoiakim the second, Zedekiah the third, and Shallum the fourth.
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Yosia nabwo aba: Yohanani, omwana oye omotangi na Yehoyakimu, oyo o kabere, na Zedekia, oyo o gatato, na Salumu, oyo o kane.
swahili: Wana wa Yosia walikuwa: Yohanani mzaliwa wake wa kwanza, Yehoyakimu mwanawe wa pili, wa tatu Sedekia, wa nne Shalumu.

english: The successors of Jehoiakim: Jeconiah his son, and Zedekiah. The Royal Line After the Exile
ekegusii: Ororeria rwa Yehoyakimu narwo oro: Yehoyakimu akaibora Yekonia, na Yekonia akaibora Zedekia. Ororeria rwa Yehoyakimu
swahili: Walioingia mahali pa Yehoyakimu kama wafalme ni: Yekonia mwanawe, na Sedekia. Ukoo Wa Kifalme Baada Ya Uhamisho

english: The descendants of Jeconiah the captive: Shealtiel his son,
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Yekonia, oyo bwosetwe, nabwo aba: Sealitieli,
swahili: Hawa ndio waliokuwa wazao wa Yekonia aliyekuwa mateka: Shealtieli mwanawe,

english: Malchiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.
ekegusii: na Malikiramu, Pedaya na Senasari, Yekamia na Hosama, na Nedabia.
swahili: Malkiramu, Pedaya, Shenasari, Yekamia, Hoshama na Nedabia.

english: The sons of Pedaiah: Zerubbabel and Shimei. The children of Zerubbabel: Meshullam and Hananiah, their sister Shelomith,
ekegusii: Na abana abamura ba Pedaya nabwo Serubabeli na Simei. Abana abamura ba Serubabeli nabwo Mesulamu na Hanania, na Selomiti nere orenge omoiseke omwabo.
swahili: Wana wa Pedaya walikuwa: Zerubabeli na Shimei. Wana wa Zerubabeli walikuwa: Meshulamu na Hanania. Shelomithi alikuwa dada yao.

english: the third was Absalom the son of Maacah daughter of King Talmai of Geshur; the fourth was Adonijah the son of Haggith;
ekegusii: oyo o gatato Abisalomu, oiboretwe na Maaka, mosubati o Talimai, omorwoti o Gesuri; oyo o kane Adonia, oiboretwe na Hagiti;
swahili: wa tatu alikuwa Absalomu, ambaye mama yake alikuwa Maaka, binti Talmai mfalme wa Geshuri; wa nne, Adoniya, ambaye mama yake alikuwa Hagithi;

english: and five others: Hashubah, Ohel, Berechiah, Hasadiah, and Jushab-hesed.
ekegusii: Abamura bande batano ba Serubabeli nabwo aba: Hasuba na Oheli, Berekia na Hasadia, na Yusabi‐Hesedi.
swahili: Pia walikuwepo wengine watano: Hashuba, Oheli, Berekia, Hasadia na Yushab-Hesedi.

english: The descendants of Hananiah: Pelatiah, Jeshaiah, and the sons of Rephaiah, of Arnan, of Obadiah, and of Shecaniah.
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Hanania nabwo Pelatia na Yesaia, naende abamura ba Refaya, na ab’Arinani, na ab’Obadia, na aba Sekania.
swahili: Wazao wa Hanania walikuwa: Pelatia na Yeshaya, na wana wa Refaya, na wana wa Arnani, na wana wa Obadia, na wana wa Shekania.

english: The six descendants of Shecaniah were Shemaiah and his sons: Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah, and Shaphat.
ekegusii: Omwana o Sekania nere Semaya, na abana baye abamura nabwo aba: Hatusi na Igali, Baria na Nearia, na Safati; bonsi mbatano nomo.
swahili: Wazao wa Shekania: Shemaya na wanawe: Hatushi, Igali, Baria, Nearia na Shafati; jumla yao walikuwa sita.

english: The sons of Neariah: Elioenai, Hizkiah, and Azrikam—three in all.
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Nearia nabwo aba: Elionai na Hezekia, na Asirikamu; bonsi mbatato (3).
swahili: Wana wa Nearia walikuwa: Elioenai, Hizkia na Azrikamu; jumla yao watatu.

english: The sons of Elioenai: Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah, and Anani—seven in all.
ekegusii: Abana abamura b’Elionai nabwo aba: Hodawia na Eliasibu, Pelaya na Akubu, Yohanani na Delaya, na Anani; bonsi mbatano na babere (7).
swahili: Wana wa Elioenai walikuwa: Hodavia, Eliashibu, Pelaya, Akubu, Yohanani, Delaya na Anani; jumla yao wote saba.

english: the fifth was Shephatiah by Abital; and the sixth was Ithream by his wife Eglah.
ekegusii: oyo o gatano Sefatia, oiboretwe n’Abitali, na oyo o gatano na rimo Iteramu, oiboretwe n’Egila moga Daudi.
swahili: wa tano alikuwa Shefatia ambaye mama yake alikuwa Abitali; wa sita alikuwa Ithreamu, aliyezaliwa na mke wake Egla.

english: These six sons were born to David in Hebron, where he reigned seven years and six months. And David reigned in Jerusalem thirty-three years,
ekegusii: Abamura aba batano nomo nabwo Daudi aiboreretwe agwo Heburoni, aroro agwo ase agambete ase engaki y’emiaka etano, na ebere (7), na emetienyi etano nomo (6). Daudi akaba okogamba agwo Yerusalemu emiaka emerongo etato, na etato (33).
swahili: Hawa sita walizaliwa huko Hebroni ambako Daudi alitawala kwa miaka saba na miezi sita. Daudi alitawala Yerusalemu kwa miaka thelathini na mitatu,

english: and these sons were born to him in Jerusalem: Shimea, Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon. These four were born to him by Bathsheba daughter of Ammiel.
ekegusii: Aba nabwo baiboretwe asare agwo Yerusalemu: Simea na Sobabu, Nathani na Sulemani. Aba nigo baiboretwe na Beti‐Sua, mosubati bw’Amieli.
swahili: nao hawa ndio watoto wa Daudi waliozaliwa huko Yerusalemu: mkewe Bathsheba, binti Amieli, alimzalia Shamua, Shobabu, Nathani na Solomoni.

english: David’s other sons were Ibhar, Elishua, Eliphelet,
ekegusii: Daudi nabwate abamura bande, nabwo aba: Ibuhari na Elisama, na Elifeleti;
swahili: Pia kulikuwa na wana wengine: Ibihari, Elishua, Elifeleti,

english: Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia,
ekegusii: Noga na Nefegi, na Yafia;
swahili: Noga, Nefegi, Yafia,

english: Elishama, Eliada, and Eliphelet—nine in all.
ekegusii: Elisama na Eliada, na Elifeleti; abwo nigo barenge kianda.
swahili: Elishama, Eliada na Elifeleti; wote walikuwa tisa.

english: These were all the sons of David, besides the sons by his concubines. And Tamar was their sister. The Descendants of Solomon
ekegusii: Aba bonsi nabwo barenge abana abamura ba Daudi, naende nabwate abamura bande b’abakungu ba sere‐sere. Tamari nere orenge omoiseke omwabo abamura abwo. Ororeria rwa Sulemani omorwoti
swahili: Hawa wote walikuwa wana wa Daudi, mbali na wale wana waliozaliwa na masuria. Naye Tamari alikuwa dada yao. Wafalme Wa Yuda

english: The descendants of Judah: Perez, Hezron, Carmi, Hur, and Shobal.
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Yuda nabwo aba: Peresi na Hezironi, Karimi na Huri, na Sobali.
swahili: Wana wa Yuda walikuwa: Peresi, Hesroni, Karmi, Huri na Shobali.

english: And Jabez called out to the God of Israel, “If only You would bless me and enlarge my territory! May Your hand be with me and keep me from harm, so that I will be free from pain.” And God granted the request of Jabez. More Descendants of Judah
ekegusii: Yabesi akarangeria Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, akabora, “Onye aye ndiria kwarenge gonsesenia naende ogareyie obomenyo bwane, naende okoboko kwao kobe amo nainche, na ondende korwa ase obororo tibobaisa gonkora bobe.” Nyasae akamwanchera aya aganetie. Emeroberio ye chiamate chinde
swahili: Yabesi akamlilia Mungu wa Israeli akisema, “Ee Mungu, laiti ungenibariki kweli kweli na kuipanua mipaka yangu! Mkono wako na uwe pamoja nami, uniepushe na uovu ili nisidhurike!” Naye Mungu akamjalia hayo aliyoyaomba.

english: Chelub the brother of Shuhah was the father of Mehir, who was the father of Eshton.
ekegusii: Kelubu, omomura omwabo o Suba, nere akaibora Mehiri, oria orenge ise Esitoni.
swahili: Kelubu, nduguye Shuha, akamzaa Mehiri, naye Mehiri akamzaa Eshtoni.

english: Eshton was the father of Beth-rapha, of Paseah, and of Tehinnah the father of Ir-nahash. These were the men of Recah.
ekegusii: Esitoni akaibora Beti‐Rafa na Pasea, na Tehina, ise abanto b’omochie o Nahasi. Aba nabaanto bamenyete Reka.
swahili: Eshtoni akawazaa Beth-Rafa, Pasea na Tehina. Tehina alikuwa baba wa Iri-Nahashi. Hawa ndio waliokuwa wazao wa Reka.

english: The sons of Kenaz: Othniel and Seraiah. The sons of Othniel: Hathath and Meonothai.
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Kenasi nabwo Otinieli na Seraya; na abamura b’Otinieli nabwo Hatati na Meonotai.
swahili: Wana wa Kenazi walikuwa: Othnieli na Seraya. Wana wa Othnieli walikuwa: Hathathi na Meonathai.

english: Meonothai was the father of Ophrah, and Seraiah was the father of Joab, the father of those living in Ge-harashim, which was given this name because its people were craftsmen.
ekegusii: Meonotai akaibora Ofura. Seraya akaibora Yoabu ise Abageharasimu. Barabwo nigo barogetwe igo, ekiagera barenge abaroisia ebinto.
swahili: Meonathai akamzaa Ofra. Seraya akamzaa Yoabu, baba wa Ge-Harashimu. Liliitwa hivyo kwa sababu watu walioishi humo walikuwa mafundi.

english: The sons of Caleb son of Jephunneh: Iru, Elah, and Naam. The son of Elah: Kenaz.
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Kalebu, mosinto o Yefune, nabwo aba: Iru na Ela, na Naamu; na omwana omomura bw’Ela nere Kenasi.
swahili: Kalebu mwana wa Yefune alikuwa na wana watatu: Iru, Ela na Naamu. Naye mwana wa Ela alikuwa: Kenazi.

english: The sons of Jehallelel: Ziph, Ziphah, Tiria, and Asarel.
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Yehaleleli nabwo aba: Sifu na Zifa, Tiria na Asareli.
swahili: Wana wa Yahaleleli walikuwa: Zifu, Zifa, Tiria na Asareli.

english: The sons of Ezrah: Jether, Mered, Epher, and Jalon. And Mered’s wife Bithiah gave birth to Miriam, Shammai, and Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa.
ekegusii: Abana abamura b’Ezara nabwo aba: Yeteri na Meredi, Eferi na Yaloni. Aba nabwo abana ba Bitia, mosubati o Farao, oria Meredi anyuomete: Omoiseke oye nigo are korokwa Miriamu, na abamura nabwo Samai na Isiba, ise abanto b’Esitemoa.
swahili: Wana wa Ezra walikuwa: Yetheri, Meredi, Eferi na Yaloni. Mmojawapo wa wake zake Meredi aliwazaa: Miriamu, Shamai na Ishba aliyekuwa baba yake Eshtemoa.

english: These were the children of Pharaoh’s daughter Bithiah. Mered also took a Judean wife, who gave birth to Jered the father of Gedor, Heber the father of Soco, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah.
ekegusii: Meredi nabwate naende omokungu Omoyuda; nere akaibora Yeredi, ise abanto ba Gedori, na Heberi, ise abanto ba Soko, na Yekutieli, ise abanto ba Sanoa.
swahili: Meredi alikuwa na mke mwingine Myahudi ambaye aliwazaa: Yeredi baba wa Gedori, Heberi baba wa Soko na Yekuthieli baba wa Zanoa. Hawa walikuwa watoto wa Bithia binti Farao, ambaye Meredi alikuwa amemwoa.

english: The sons of Hodiah’s wife, the sister of Naham, were the fathers of Keilah the Garmite and of Eshtemoa the Maacathite.
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Hodia, mosubati omwabo Nahamu, nigo barenge babere, oyomo nigo arenge ise Keila Omogarimi, na oyo o kabere n’Esitemoa bw’Abamaaka.
swahili: Wana wa mke wa Hodia aliyekuwa dada yake Nahamu walikuwa: baba yake Keila, Mgarmi na Eshtemoa, Mmaakathi.

english: Reaiah son of Shobal was the father of Jahath, and Jahath was the father of Ahumai and Lahad. These were the clans of the Zorathites.
ekegusii: Reaya, mosinto o Sobali, akaibora Yahati, na Yahati akaibora Ahumai na Lahadi. Korwa ase abwo nao Abasora barwete.
swahili: Reaya mwana wa Shobali akamzaa Yahathi, Yahathi akawazaa Ahumai na Lahadi. Hizi ndizo zilizokuwa koo za Wasorathi.

english: The sons of Shimon: Amnon, Rinnah, Ben-hanan, and Tilon. The descendants of Ishi: Zoheth and Ben-zoheth.
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Shimoni nabwo aba: Amunoni na Rina, Beni‐Hanani na Tiloni. Abana abamura ba Ishi nabwo Soheti na Beni‐Soheti. Ororeria rwa Sela
swahili: Wana wa Shimoni walikuwa: Amnoni, Rina, Ben-Hanani na Tiloni. Wazao wa Ishi walikuwa: Zohethi na Ben-Zohethi.

english: The sons of Shelah son of Judah: Er the father of Lecah, Laadah the father of Mareshah and the clans of the linen workers at Beth-ashbea,
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Sela, mosinto o Yuda, nabwo aba: Eri, ise abanto ba Leka, na Laada, ise abanto ba Maresa, na aba echiamate chi’abaroisia ebitambaa bi’egatani agwo Beti‐Asibea;
swahili: Wana wa Shela, mwana wa Yuda, walikuwa: Eri baba yake Leka, Laada baba yake Maresha na jamaa za wafumaji nguo za kitani safi waliokuwa wakiishi huko Beth-Ashbea,

english: Jokim, the men of Cozeba, and Joash and Saraph, who ruled in Moab and Jashubi-lehem. (These names are from ancient records.)
ekegusii: naende Yokimu na abanto ba Koseba, Yoashi na Sarafu, abwo barenge kogambera Abamoabu, naende Yasubi‐Lehemu. (Korende amang’ana aya namakoro.)
swahili: Yokimu, watu walioishi Kozeba, Yoashi na Sarafi waliotawala huko Moabu na Yashubi-Lehemu. (Taarifa hizi ni za zamani sana.)

english: These were the potters who lived at Netaim and Gederah. They lived there in the service of the king. The Descendants of Simeon
ekegusii: Aba nabwo barenge abaroisia chinyongo na ababiare ba Netaimu na Gedera; aba nigo bamenyete amo nomorwoti, bakaba bakomokorera emeremo. Ororeria rwa Simioni
swahili: Hawa walikuwa wafinyanzi walioishi Netaimu na Gedera; waliishi huko wakimtumikia mfalme. Simeoni

english: The descendants of Simeon: Nemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, and Shaul.
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Simioni nabwo aba: Nemweli na Yamini, Yaribu na Zera, na Saulo.
swahili: Wazao wa Simeoni walikuwa: Nemueli, Yamini, Yaribu, Zera na Shauli.

english: The sons of Shaul: Shallum, Mibsam, and Mishma.
ekegusii: Saulo akaibora Salumu, na Salumu akaibora Mibusamu, na Mibusamu akaibora Misima.
swahili: Mwana wa Shauli alikuwa Shalumu, Shalumu akamzaa Mibsamu, na Mibsamu akamzaa Mishma.

english: The sons of Mishma: Hammuel, Zaccur, and Shimei.
ekegusii: Misima akaibora Hamueli, na Hamueli akaibora Sakuri, na Sakuri akaibora Simei.
swahili: Wazao wa Mishma walikuwa: Hamueli aliyemzaa Zakuri, Zakuri akamzaa Shimei.

english: Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters, but his brothers did not have many children, so their whole clan did not become as numerous as the sons of Judah.
ekegusii: Simei nigo abwate abana abamura ikomi na batano nomo (16), na abaiseke batano nomo (6); korende abamura bamwabo tibabwate abana abange, gose chiamate chiabo chionsi tichiamentekanete buna echia Yuda.
swahili: Shimei alikuwa na wana kumi na sita, na binti sita, lakini ndugu zake hawakuwa na watoto wengi, hivyo ukoo wao wote haukuwa na watu wengi kama ukoo wa Yuda.

english: They lived in Beersheba, Moladah, Hazar-shual,
ekegusii: Barabwo nigo bamenyete agwo Beeri‐Seba, na Molada, na Hasari‐Suali;
swahili: Waliishi Beer-Sheba, Molada, Hasar-Shuali,

english: Bilhah, Ezem, Tolad,
ekegusii: Bilaha, na Esemu, na Toladi;
swahili: Bilha, Esemu, Toladi,

english: These were the sons of Etam: Jezreel, Ishma, and Idbash. And their sister was named Hazzelelponi.
ekegusii: Aba nabwo barenge abana abamura b’Etamu: Yesireeli na Isima, na Idibasi, na omoiseke omwabo nigo arenge korokwa Haseleliponi.
swahili: Hawa ndio waliokuwa wana wa Etamu: Yezreeli, Ishma na Idbashi. Dada yao aliitwa Haselelponi.

english: Bethuel, Hormah, Ziklag,
ekegusii: Betueli, na Horima, na Sikilagi;
swahili: Bethueli, Horma, Siklagi,

english: Beth-marcaboth, Hazar-susim, Beth-biri, and Shaaraim. These were their cities until the reign of David.
ekegusii: Beti‐Marikaboti, na Hasari‐Susimu, na Beti‐Biri, na Saaraimu. Eye nero yarenge emechie yabo goika ekero Daudi abeete omorwoti.
swahili: Beth-Markabothi, Hasar-Susimu, Beth-Biri na Shaaraimu. Hii ilikuwa miji yao mpaka wakati wa utawala wa Daudi.

english: And their villages were Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Tochen, and Ashan—five towns—
ekegusii: Na emechie yabo emeke nigo yarenge Etamu na Aini, Rimoni na Tokeni, na Asani; yonsi netano.
swahili: Vijiji vilivyoizunguka vilikuwa Etamu, Aini, Rimoni, Tokeni na Ashani; jumla miji mitano:

english: and all their surrounding villages as far as Baal. These were their settlements, and they kept a genealogical record:
ekegusii: Boigo mbabwate ebichie biabo biaetanaine emechie eyio goikeera Baali. Obo nabwo bwarenge obomenyo bwabo. Barabwo bakarika omooroberio bwe chinderia chiabo.
swahili: pamoja na vijiji vyote kuizunguka hii miji hadi huko Baali. Haya yalikuwa makao yao, nao waliweka kumbukumbu ya ukoo wao.

english: Meshobab, Jamlech, Joshah son of Amaziah,
ekegusii: Mesobabu, na Yamuleki, na Yosha, mosinto bw’Amasia.
swahili: Meshobabu, Yamleki, Yosha mwana wa Amazia,

english: Joel, Jehu son of Joshibiah (son of Seraiah, son of Asiel),
ekegusii: Yoel, na Yehu, mosinto o Yosibia o Seraya bw’Asieli.
swahili: Yoeli, Yehu mwana wa Yoshibia, mwana wa Seraya, mwana wa Asieli.

english: Elioenai, Jaakobah, Jeshohaiah, Asaiah, Adiel, Jesimiel, Benaiah,
ekegusii: Elioenai na Yaakoba, Yesohaya na Asaia, Adieli na Yesimieli, na Benaya.
swahili: Pia Elioenai, Yaakoba, Yeshohaya, Asaya, Adieli, Yesimieli, Benaya,

english: and Ziza son of Shiphi (son of Allon, son of Jedaiah, son of Shimri, son of Shemaiah).
ekegusii: Sisa, mosinto o Sifi bw’Aloni, o Yedaya, o Simuri, o Semaya.
swahili: Ziza mwana wa Shifi, mwana wa Aloni, mwana wa Yedaya, mwana wa Shimri, mwana wa Shemaya.

english: These men listed by name were the leaders of their clans. Their families increased greatly,
ekegusii: Aba iga batoire ase amarieta abo nabwo barenge abateneneri be chiamate chiabo. Chiamate echi chikamentekana mono.
swahili: Watu hawa walioorodheshwa hapa juu kwa majina walikuwa viongozi wa koo zao. Jamaa zao ziliongezeka sana,

english: and they journeyed to the entrance of Gedor, to the east side of the valley, in search of pasture for their flocks.
ekegusii: Ase ayio barabwo bakang’anya gochia ase omochie o Gedori, ensemo ya moocha ye rikura, korigia oborisia ase chitugo chiabo.
swahili: wakaenea mpaka kwenye viunga vya Gedori kuelekea mashariki mwa bonde wakitafuta malisho kwa ajili ya mifugo yao.

english: Penuel was the father of Gedor, and Ezer was the father of Hushah. These were the descendants of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah and the father of Bethlehem.
ekegusii: Penueli nigo arenge ise Abagedori, na Eseri ise Abahusa. Aba nabwo barenge abana abamura ba Huri, omwana omotangi o Efarata, ise abanto ba Bethlehemu.
swahili: Penueli akamzaa Gedori, naye Ezeri akamzaa Husha. Hawa walikuwa wazao wa Huri, mzaliwa wa kwanza wa Efrathi, na baba yake Bethlehemu.

english: There they found rich, good pasture, and the land was spacious, peaceful, and quiet; for some Hamites had lived there formerly.
ekegusii: Aroro agwo ase banyorete oborisia obuya na obonoru, ense nigo yarenge engare, na entoereru, na ey’omorembe. Abanto bamenyete agwo ritang’ani nigo barenge abanto ba Hamu.
swahili: Huko walipata malisho mengi mazuri, nayo nchi ilikuwa na nafasi kubwa, yenye amani na utulivu. Baadhi ya Wahamu waliishi huko zamani.

english: These who were noted by name came in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah. They attacked the Hamites and Meunites there in their dwellings, devoting them to destruction even to this day. Then they settled in their place, because there was pasture for their flocks.
ekegusii: Abanto aba batoire ase amarieta abo bagacha ekero Hezekia, omorwoti bw’Abayuda, arenge kogamba. Barabwo bagasaria chiema chi’abaanto b’aroro na bagasiria Abameuni, abanto banyorekanete aroro; bakabasiria kegima na tibaiyo nonya goika reero iga. Erio bakamenya agwo ribaga riabo, ekiagera oborisia mbwarengeo ase chitugo chiabo.
swahili: Watu walioorodheshwa majina walikuja katika nchi hiyo wakati wa Hezekia mfalme wa Yuda. Akawashambulia Wahamu katika makao yao pamoja na Wameuni ambao walikuwako huko nao wakawaangamiza kabisa, kama ilivyo dhahiri hadi leo. Kisha wakafanya makazi yao huko kwa sababu kulikuwa na malisho mazuri kwa ajili ya mifugo yao.

english: And five hundred of these Simeonites led by Pelatiah, Neariah, Rephaiah, and Uzziel, the sons of Ishi, went to Mount Seir
ekegusii: Na abanto amagana atano (500) b’egesaku gia Simioni, bakagenda goika egetunwa gia Edomu, bakaba nabaraai babo: Pelatia na Nearia, Refaya na Usieli, basinto ba Ishi.
swahili: Watu wa kabila la wa Simeoni wapatao mia tano, wakiongozwa na Pelatia, Nearia, Refaya na Uzieli wana wa Ishi, wakavamia nchi ya vilima ya Seiri.

english: and struck down the remnant of the Amalekites who had escaped. And they have lived there to this day.
ekegusii: Barabwo bagasiria abanto abatigari b’Abaameleki, naende bakamenya aroro, nao bare goika reero iga.
swahili: Wakawaua Waamaleki waliobaki, waliokuwa wamenusurika, nao wanaishi huko hadi leo.

english: Ashhur the father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah and Naarah.
ekegusii: Asuri ise abanto ba Tekoa, nabwate abakungu babere, Hela na Naara.
swahili: Ashuri baba yake Tekoa alikuwa na wake wawili, Hela na Naara.

english: Naarah bore to him Ahuzzam, Hepher, Temeni, and Haahashtari. These were the descendants of Naarah.
ekegusii: Naara akamoiborera Ahusamu na Heferi, Temeni na Hahasitari. Aba nabwo barenge abana abamura ba Naara.
swahili: Hawa walikuwa wazao wa Naara: Ahuzamu, Heferi, Temeni na Haahashtari.

english: The sons of Helah were Zereth, Zohar, Ethnan,
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Hela nabwo aba: Sereti na Isihari, na Etinani.
swahili: Wana wa Hela walikuwa: Serethi, Sohari, Ethnani,

english: and Koz, who was the father of Anub and Zobebah and of the clans of Aharhel son of Harum. The Prayer of Jabez
ekegusii: Kosi nere orenge ise Anubu na Sobeba, na ise bwe chiamate chi’Aharibeli, mosinto o Harumu.
swahili: na Kosi ambaye aliwazaa Anubi, Sobeba na jamaa zote za Aharheli mwana wa Harumu.

english: Now Jabez was more honorable than his brothers. His mother had named him Jabez, saying, “Because I bore him in pain.”
ekegusii: Yabesi nigo arenge namasikani amanene kobua abamura bamwabo. Ng’ina akamoroka Yabesi, ekiagera amoiborete ase obororo.
swahili: Yabesi aliheshimiwa kuliko ndugu zake. Mama yake alimwita Yabesi, akisema, “Nilimzaa kwa huzuni.”

english: These were the sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel. Though he was the firstborn, his birthright was given to the sons of Joseph son of Israel, because Reuben defiled his father’s bed. So he is not reckoned according to birthright.
ekegusii: Aba nabwo abana abamura ba Rubeni oyio orenge omwana omomura omotangi o Israeli. (Korende ekiagera naraarete na moga ise, omwando oye bw’okoiborwa kw’obotangi okaegwa abana abamura ba Yusufu, mosinto o Israeli. Korende Yusufu tarikiri ase omooroberio bw’okonyora omwando bw’okoiborwa kw’obotangi.
swahili: Wana wa Reubeni mzaliwa wa kwanza wa Israeli (yeye alikuwa mzaliwa wa kwanza, lakini kwa kuwa alikinajisi kitanda cha baba yake, haki zake za mzaliwa wa kwanza walipewa wana wa Yosefu mwana wa Israeli. Hivyo hakuorodheshwa kwenye orodha ya ukoo wao kulingana na haki yake ya kuzaliwa.

english: During the days of Saul they waged war against the Hagrites, who were defeated at their hands, and they occupied the homes of the Hagrites throughout the region east of Gilead. The Descendants of Gad
ekegusii: Ase engaki eria Saulo arenge kogamba bakarwana esegi n’Abahagari, bakabaita, na barabwo bakamenya ase chiema chiabo agwo ase ense yonsi moocha ya Gileadi. Ororeria rwa Gadi
swahili: Wakati wa utawala wa Mfalme Sauli, walipigana vita dhidi ya Wahagari, wakaanguka kwa mikono yao, kisha wakaishi katika mahema ya Wahagari katika eneo lote la mashariki ya Gileadi. Wana Wa Gadi

english: The descendants of Gad lived next to the Reubenites in the land of Bashan, as far as Salecah:
ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rwa Gadi bakamenya sugusu y’abanto b’orwa Rubeni agwo ase ense ya Basani, bagaikera omochie o Saleka.
swahili: Wagadi waliishi jirani nao katika nchi ya Bashani, mpaka Saleka.

english: Joel was the chief, Shapham the second, then Jaanai and Shaphat, who lived in Bashan.
ekegusii: Yoel nere orenge omonene, na Safamu oyo o kabere, naende Yanai na Safati bakaba agwo Basani.
swahili: Yoeli ndiye alikuwa mkuu wao, Shafamu wa pili, na wakafuata Yanai na Shafati, huko Bashani.

english: Their kinsmen by families were Michael, Meshullam, Sheba, Jorai, Jacan, Zia, and Eber—seven in all.
ekegusii: Na abamwabo be chiamate chiabo nabwo aba: Mikaeli na Mesulamu, Seba na Yorai, Yakani na Sia, na Eberi, bonsi mbatano na babere.
swahili: Ndugu zao kulingana na koo zao walikuwa saba: Mikaeli, Meshulamu, Sheba, Yorai, Yakani, Zia na Eberi.

english: These were the sons of Abihail son of Huri, the son of Jaroah, the son of Gilead, the son of Michael, the son of Jeshishai, the son of Jahdo, the son of Buz.
ekegusii: Aba nabwo barenge basinto b’Abihaili, mosinto o Huri o Yaroa, o Gileadi, o Mikaeli, o Yesisai, o Yado, o Busi.
swahili: Hawa walikuwa ndio wana wa Abihaili mwana wa Huri, mwana wa Yaroa, mwana wa Gileadi, mwana wa Mikaeli, mwana wa Yeshishai, mwana wa Yahdo, mwana wa Buzi.

english: Ahi son of Abdiel, the son of Guni, was head of their family.
ekegusii: Ahi, mosinto bw’Abidieli, o Guni, nere orenge omoteneneri bwe chiamate chiabo.
swahili: Ahi mwana wa Abdieli, mwana wa Guni, alikuwa ndiye kiongozi wa jamaa yao.

english: They lived in Gilead, in Bashan and its towns, and throughout the pasturelands of Sharon.
ekegusii: Barabwo bonsi bakamenya agwo Gileadi na Basani, na ase emechie y’aroro na ase oborisia bwonsi bwa Saroni goikera chinsinyo chiaye.
swahili: Wagadi waliishi Gileadi, huko Bashani pamoja na vijiji vilivyoizunguka, pia katika nchi yote ya malisho ya Sharoni kote walikoenea.

english: All of them were reckoned in the genealogies during the reigns of Jotham king of Judah and Jeroboam king of Israel.
ekegusii: Aba bonsi nigo baabaretwe na korikwa ekero omobaro bwe chinderia chiabo okoretwe ase amatuko ’okogamba kwa Yotamu, omorwoti bw’Abayuda, na aya okwa Yeroboamu, omorwoti bw’Abaisraeli. Abarwani esegi b’ebisaku bia moocha
swahili: Yote haya yaliwekwa katika kumbukumbu za ukoo wao wakati wa utawala wa Yothamu, mfalme wa Yuda na Yeroboamu mfalme wa Israeli.

english: The Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh had 44,760 warriors—valiant men who carried the shield and sword, drew the bow, and were trained for battle.
ekegusii: Abanto ba Rubeni, na Abagadi, na ekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase, nigo babwate abanto chituoni barenge kobogoria chinguba na emioro, naende nigo bamanyete korasa nemegwe abanto abang’aini ase esegi. Abwo nigo barenge chilifu emerongo ene na inye, na amagana atano na abere, na emerongo etano nomo (44,760), nigo barenge bebegete ang’e korwana esegi.
swahili: Wareubeni, Wagadi na nusu ya kabila la Manase walikuwa na watu mashujaa 44,760 waliokuwa wameandaliwa kwa ajili ya vita: watu wenye nguvu, hodari wa kutumia ngao na upanga, mashujaa wa kutumia upinde, waliokuwa tayari kwa ajili ya kazi hiyo.

english: They waged war against the Hagrites, as well as Jetur, Naphish, and Nodab.
ekegusii: Bakaba bakorwana esegi n’Abahagari abarwete ase Yeturi na Nafisi, na Nodabu.
swahili: Walipigana vita dhidi ya Wahagari, Yeturi, Nafishi na Nodabu.

english: And though Judah prevailed over his brothers and a ruler came from him, the birthright belonged to Joseph.
ekegusii: Nonya Yuda obete ne chinguru ase egati y’abamura bamwabo, na korwa asare nao omogambi arwete, omwando bw’okoiborwa kw’obotangi nigo obete oyo o Yusufu.)
swahili: Na ingawa Yuda alikuwa na nguvu zaidi ya ndugu zake wote, na mtawala alitoka kwake, haki za mzaliwa wa kwanza zilikuwa za Yosefu.)

english: And because they cried out to God in battle, they were helped against their enemies, and the Hagrites and all their allies were delivered into their hands. Because they put their trust in God, He answered their prayers.
ekegusii: Ekiagera bamwegenete Nyasae bakarera ase okonyora ogokonywa, na Nyasae akaigwa ogosaba kwabo, na barabwo bakabua Abahagari na abanto bonsi barenge amo nabarabwo.
swahili: Walisaidiwa katika kupigana nao, Mungu akawatia Wahagari pamoja na wote walioungana nao mikononi mwao, kwa sababu walimlilia Mungu wakati wa vita. Alijibu maombi yao, kwa sababu walimtegemea.

english: They seized the livestock of the Hagrites—50,000 camels, 250,000 sheep, and 2,000 donkeys. They also took 100,000 captives,
ekegusii: Bagasakora chitugo chiabo: Chingamia chilifu emerongo etano (50,000), ne ching’ondi chilifu amagana abere na emerongo etano (250,000) ne chitigere chilifu ibere (2,000). Naende bagoosa abanto chilifu rigana erimo (100,000),
swahili: Walitwaa mifugo ya Wahagari: ngamia 50,000, kondoo 250,000, punda 2,000. Pia wakateka watu 100,000,

english: and many others fell slain, because the battle belonged to God. And they occupied the land until the exile. The Half-Tribe of Manasseh
ekegusii: na bagaita abanto abange, ekiagera esegi yarenge eya Nyasae. Erio bakamenya aase abo goika engaki y’okong’anyigwa. Abanto ba Manase abamenyete moocha
swahili: na wengine wengi waliuawa kwa sababu vita vilikuwa ni vya Mungu. Nao waliendelea kuikalia nchi hiyo mpaka wakati wa uhamisho. Nusu Ya Kabila La Manase

english: Now the people of the half-tribe of Manasseh were numerous. They settled in the land from Bashan to Baal-hermon (that is, Senir, also known as Mount Hermon).
ekegusii: Abanto ekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase bakamenya ense eria; bakamentekana mono, bakamenya korwa orobebe rwa Basani goika Baali‐Herimoni, na Seniri, na egetunwa kia Herimoni.
swahili: Idadi ya nusu ya kabila la Manase walikuwa wengi sana, Wakakaa kuanzia Bashani hadi Baal-Hermoni, yaani mpaka Seniri na mlima Hermoni.

english: These were the heads of their families: Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah, and Jahdiel. They were mighty men of valor, famous men, and heads of their families.
ekegusii: Aba nabwo barenge abateneneri be chiamate chiabo: Eferi na Ishi, Elieli na Asirieli, Yeremia na Hodawia, na Yadieli. Abwo nabaanto chituoni bachiete nkuma ase okorwana esegi. Ebisaku bia moocha bigwoswa
swahili: Hawa ndio waliokuwa viongozi wa jamaa za kabila hilo: Eferi, Ishi, Elieli, Azrieli, Yeremia, Hodavia na Yahdieli. Walikuwa askari shujaa watu maarufu, viongozi wa jamaa zao.

english: But they were unfaithful to the God of their fathers, and they prostituted themselves with the gods of the peoples of the land, whom God had destroyed before them.
ekegusii: Korende abanto b’ebisaku bia moocha bagakora ogosaria ase Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiabo, bagakora obotayayi, bakabwatia chinyasae chi’abaanto b’ense eria, abwo Nyasae asiretie korwa ase bare.
swahili: Lakini hawakuwa waaminifu kwa Mungu wa baba zao, nao wakafanya ukahaba kwa miungu ya mataifa, ambayo Mungu alikuwa ameyaangamiza mbele yao.

english: So the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria (that is, Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria) to take the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh into exile. And he brought them to Halah, Habor, Hara, and the river of Gozan, where they remain to this day.
ekegusii: Ase ayio Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli agaseegeta omoika o Puli, omorwoti bw’Abaasuri (nere Tiligati‐Pileseri), na Puli oyio akaira abanto b’ororeria rwa Rubeni, na ab’orwa Gadi, na ekeng’ese ki ’egesaku kia Manase goika Hala na Habori, na Hara, na goika ase orooche rwa Goseni; nao bare goika reero iga.
swahili: Kwa hiyo Mungu wa Israeli akaiamsha roho ya Pulu, mfalme wa Ashuru (ambaye pia alijulikana kama Tiglath-Pileseri), ambaye aliwachukua Wareubeni, Wagadi na nusu ya kabila la Manase kwenda uhamishoni. Akawapeleka huko Hala, Habori, Hara na mto Gozani, ambako wamekaa mpaka leo.

english: The sons of Reuben, the firstborn of Israel: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Rubeni, omwana omotangi o Israeli, nabwo aba: Hanoki na Palu, Hezironi na Karimi.
swahili: Wana wa Reubeni mzaliwa wa kwanza wa Israeli walikuwa: Hanoki, Palu, Hesroni na Karmi.

english: The descendants of Joel: Shemaiah his son, Gog his son, Shimei his son,
ekegusii: Ororeria rwa Yoel narwo oro: Yoel akaibora Semaya, na Semaya akaibora Gogi, na Gogi akaibora Simei.
swahili: Wazao wa Yoeli walikuwa: Shemaya mwanawe, Gogu mwanawe; Shimei mwanawe,

english: Micah his son, Reaiah his son, Baal his son,
ekegusii: Simei akaibora Mika, na Mika akaibora Reaya, na Reaya akaibora Baali.
swahili: Mika mwanawe, Reaya mwanawe, Baali mwanawe,

english: and Beerah his son, whom Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria carried into exile. Beerah was a leader of the Reubenites.
ekegusii: Baali akaibora Beera oria Tiligati‐Pileseri omorwoti bw’Abaasuri, aosete, akamoira ase obosomba. Beera orenge omoteneneri bw’abaanto ba Rubeni.
swahili: na Beera mwanawe, ambaye Tiglath-Pileseri mfalme wa Ashuru alimchukua kwenda uhamishoni. Beera alikuwa kiongozi wa Wareubeni.

english: His relatives by their clans are recorded in their genealogy: Jeiel the chief, Zechariah,
ekegusii: Na abamwabo ase chiamate chiabo buna barigetwe ase omooroberio bwe chinderia chi’ebiare biabo nabwo aba: Yeieli, nere orenge omoteneneri obo, na Zakaria,
swahili: Jamaa zao kulingana na koo zao, walioorodheshwa kwa kufuata koo zao kama ifuatavyo: Yeieli aliyekuwa mkuu wao, Zekaria,

english: and Bela son of Azaz, the son of Shema, the son of Joel. They settled in Aroer and as far as Nebo and Baal-meon.
ekegusii: na Bela, mosinto bw’Asasi o Sema, o Yoel, Barabwo nigo bamenyete agwo Aroeri goikera orobebe rwa Nebo na Baali‐Meoni.
swahili: Bela mwana wa Azazi, mwana wa Shema, mwana wa Yoeli. Hao waliishi katika eneo kuanzia Aroeri mpaka Nebo na Baal-Meoni.

english: They also settled in the east as far as the edge of the desert that extends to the Euphrates River, because their livestock had increased in the land of Gilead.
ekegusii: Ensemo ya moocha bakamenya goikera egesoero ki’erooro egoikera orooche rw’Eufarati, ekiagera amaicho abo nigo abuchete mono ase ense ya Gileadi.
swahili: Kwa upande wa mashariki walienea hadi pembeni mwa jangwa linaloenea mpaka kwenye Mto Frati, kwa sababu mifugo yao ilikuwa imeongezeka huko Gileadi.

english: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Lawi nabwo aba: Gerisoni na Kohati, na Merari.
swahili: Wana wa Lawi walikuwa: Gershoni, Kohathi na Merari.

english: Johanan was the father of Azariah, who served as priest in the temple that Solomon built in Jerusalem,
ekegusii: Yohanani akaibora Asaria (oyo nere orenge Omokuani ase enyomba eria Sulemani aagachete agwo Yerusalemu);
swahili: Yohanani akamzaa Azaria (ndiye alifanya kazi ya ukuhani katika Hekalu alilojenga Mfalme Solomoni huko Yerusalemu),

english: Azariah was the father of Amariah, Amariah was the father of Ahitub,
ekegusii: Asaria akaibora Amaria, na Amaria akaibora Ahitubu;
swahili: Azaria akamzaa Amaria, Amaria akamzaa Ahitubu,

english: Ahitub was the father of Zadok, Zadok was the father of Shallum,
ekegusii: Ahitubu akaibora Zadoki, na Zadoki akaibora Salumu;
swahili: Ahitubu akamzaa Sadoki, Sadoki akamzaa Shalumu,

english: Shallum was the father of Hilkiah, Hilkiah was the father of Azariah,
ekegusii: Salumu akaibora Hilikia, na Hilikia akaibora Asaria;
swahili: Shalumu akamzaa Hilkia, Hilkia akamzaa Azaria,

english: Azariah was the father of Seraiah, and Seraiah was the father of Jehozadak.
ekegusii: Asaria akaibora Seraya, na Seraya akaibora Yehosadaki.
swahili: Azaria akamzaa Seraya, Seraya akamzaa Yehosadaki.

english: Jehozadak went into captivity when the LORD sent Judah and Jerusalem into exile by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.
ekegusii: Yehosadaki agooswa akairwa ense eng’ao, ekero Omonene aruete Abayuda na abanto ba Yerusalemu bagooswa, bakairwa na Nebukadinesaro. Ororeria ronde rwa Lawi
swahili: Yehosadaki alihamishwa wakati Bwana aliwapeleka uhamishoni watu wa Yuda na Yerusalemu kwa mkono wa Mfalme Nebukadneza.

english: The sons of Levi: Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Lawi nabwo aba: Gerisomu na Kohati, na Merari.
swahili: Wana wa Lawi walikuwa: Gershoni, Kohathi na Merari.

english: These are the names of the sons of Gershom: Libni and Shimei.
ekegusii: Aya naro amarieta ’abana abamura ba Gerisomu: Libini na Simei.
swahili: Haya ndiyo majina ya wana wa Gershoni: Libni na Shimei.

english: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Kohati nabwo aba: Amuramu na Isari, na Heburoni, na Usieli.
swahili: Wana wa Kohathi walikuwa: Amramu, Ishari, Hebroni na Uzieli.

english: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. These are the clans of the Levites listed according to their fathers:
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Merari nabwo Mali na Musi. Echi nechiamate chi’abaanto ba Lawi, chiatoire ase abaise.
swahili: Wana wa Merari walikuwa: Mahli na Mushi. Zifuatazo ni koo za Walawi zilizoorodheshwa kufuatana na baba zao:

english: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Kohati nabwo aba: Amuramu na Isari, Heburoni na Usieli.
swahili: Wana wa Kohathi walikuwa: Amramu, Ishari, Hebroni na Uzieli.

english: Of Gershom: Libni his son, Jahath his son, Zimmah his son,
ekegusii: Oro narwo ororeria rwa Gerisomu: Libini omomura oye, na Yahati omomura oye, na Sima omomura oye,
swahili: Wazao wa Gershoni: Gershoni akamzaa Libni, Libni akamzaa Yahathi, Yahathi akamzaa Zima,

english: Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son, and Jeatherai his son.
ekegusii: na Yoa omomura oye, na Ido omomura oye, na Zera omomura oye, na Yeateri omomura oye.
swahili: Zima akamzaa Yoa, Yoa akamzaa Ido, Ido akamzaa Zera, Zera akamzaa Yeatherai.

english: The descendants of Kohath: Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Assir his son,
ekegusii: Oro narwo ororeria rwa Kohati: Aminadabu omomura oye, na Kora omomura oye, na Asiri omomura oye,
swahili: Wazao wa Kohathi: Kohathi akamzaa Aminadabu, Aminadabu akamzaa Kora, Kora akamzaa Asiri,

english: Elkanah his son, Ebiasaph his son, Assir his son,
ekegusii: na Elikana omomura oye, na Ebiasafu omomura oye, na Asiri omomura oye,
swahili: Asiri akamzaa Elikana, Elikana akamzaa Ebiasafu, Ebiasafu akamzaa Asiri,

english: Tahath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son, and Shaul his son.
ekegusii: na Tahati omomura oye, na Urieli omomura oye, na Usia omomura oye, na Saulo omomura oye.
swahili: Asiri akamzaa Tahathi, Tahathi akamzaa Urieli, Urieli akamzaa Uzia, Uzia akamzaa Shauli.

english: The descendants of Elkanah: Amasai, Ahimoth,
ekegusii: Abana abamura b’Elikana nabwo Amasi na Ahimoti.
swahili: Wazao wa Elikana walikuwa: Amasai na Ahimothi,

english: Elkanah his son, Zophai his son, Nahath his son,
ekegusii: Oro narwo ororeria rw’Ahimoti: Elikana omomura oye, na Sofai omomura oye, na Nahati omomura oye,
swahili: Ahimothi akamzaa Elikana, Elikana akamzaa Sofai, Sofai akamzaa Nahathi,

english: Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, and Elkanah his son.
ekegusii: na Eliabu omomura oye, na Yerohamu omomura oye, na Elikana omomura oye.
swahili: Nahathi akamzaa Eliabu, Eliabu akamzaa Yerohamu, Yerohamu akamzaa Elikana, Elikana akamzaa Samweli.

english: The sons of Samuel: Joel his firstborn and Abijah his second son.
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Samweli nabwo Yoel, omwana oye omotangi, na Abiya, oyo o kabere.
swahili: Wana wa Samweli walikuwa: Yoeli mzaliwa wake wa kwanza, na Abiya mwanawe wa pili.

english: The descendants of Merari: Mahli, Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzzah his son,
ekegusii: Oro narwo ororeria rwa Merari: Mali omomura oye, na Libini omomura oye, na Simei omomura oye, na Usa omomura oye,
swahili: Wafuatao ndio wazao wa Merari: Merari akamzaa Mahli, Mahli akamzaa Libni, Libni akamzaa Shimei, Shimei akamzaa Uza,

english: The children of Amram: Aaron, Moses, and Miriam. The sons of Aaron: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
ekegusii: Abana b’Amuramu nabwo aba: Aroni na Musa, na Miriamu omoiseke. Abana abamura ba Aroni nabwo aba: Nadabu na Abihu, Eleazari na Itamari.
swahili: Amramu alikuwa na wana: Aroni, Mose, na Miriamu. Aroni alikuwa na wana: Nadabu, Abihu, Eleazari na Ithamari.

english: Shimea his son, Haggiah his son, and Asaiah his son. The Temple Musicians
ekegusii: na Simea omomura oye, na Hagia omomura oye, na Asaia omomura oye. Abateri be Hekalu
swahili: Uza akamzaa Shimea, Shimea akamzaa Hagia, Hagia akamzaa Asaya. Waimbaji Wa Hekalu

english: These are the men David put in charge of the music in the house of the LORD after the ark rested there.
ekegusii: Aba nabwo abanto Daudi abegete bakaba abateneneri b’amatera ase enyomba y’Omonene, ekero Esanduki eria yarenge nokobwatana kw’Omonene konya yabekirwe aroro.
swahili: Hawa ndio watu ambao Daudi aliwaweka kuwa viongozi wa uimbaji katika nyumba ya Bwana, baada ya Sanduku la Agano kuletwa ili kukaa huko.

english: They ministered with song before the tabernacle, the Tent of Meeting, until Solomon built the house of the LORD in Jerusalem. And they performed their duties according to the regulations given them.
ekegusii: Nigo barenge gokora obokoreri bwabo bw’amatera agwo ase Eema y’Omosangererekano goika engaki eria Sulemani aagachete enyomba y’Omonene agwo Yerusalemu; barabwo bagakora emeremo yabo ase omooroberio ochikiire.
swahili: Walihudumu kwa kuimba mbele ya Maskani, Hema la Kukutania, mpaka hapo Mfalme Solomoni alipojenga Hekalu la Bwana huko Yerusalemu. Walitimiza wajibu wao kulingana na taratibu walizokuwa wamewekewa.

english: These are the men who served, together with their sons. From the Kohathites: Heman the singer, the son of Joel, the son of Samuel,
ekegusii: Aba nabwo abanto bakorete emeremo amo nororeria rwabo. Korwa ase ororeria rwa Kohati: Hemani, omonene bw’abateri, mosinto o Yoel o Samweli,
swahili: Wafuatao ni watu waliohudumu pamoja na wana wao: Kutoka ukoo wa Kohathi walikuwa: Hemani, mpiga kinanda, alikuwa mwana wa Yoeli, mwana wa Samweli,

english: the son of Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Eliel, the son of Toah,
ekegusii: bw’Elikana, o Yerohamu, bw’Elieli, o Toa,
swahili: mwana wa Elikana, mwana wa Yerohamu, mwana wa Elieli, mwana wa Toa,

english: the son of Zuph, the son of Elkanah, the son of Mahath, the son of Amasai,
ekegusii: o Sufu, bw’Elikana, o Mahati, bw’Amasai,
swahili: mwana wa Sufu, mwana wa Elikana, mwana wa Mahathi, mwana wa Amasai,

english: the son of Elkanah, the son of Joel, the son of Azariah, the son of Zephaniah,
ekegusii: bw’Elikana, o Yoel, bw’Asaria, o Zefania,
swahili: mwana wa Elikana, mwana wa Yoeli, mwana wa Azaria, mwana wa Sefania,

english: the son of Tahath, the son of Assir, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah,
ekegusii: o Tahati, bw’Asiri, bw’Ebiasafu, o Kora,
swahili: mwana wa Tahathi, mwana wa Asiri, mwana wa Ebiasafu, mwana wa Kora,

english: the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, the son of Israel.
ekegusii: o Isari, o Kohati, o Lawi, o Israeli.
swahili: mwana wa Ishari, mwana wa Kohathi, mwana wa Lawi, mwana wa Israeli;

english: Heman’s kinsman was Asaph, who served at his right hand: Asaph the son of Berechiah, the son of Shimea,
ekegusii: Oyo o kabere nere Asafu, oyo bw’eamate ya Hemani. Ere nigo arenge gotenena ensemo y’okoboko kwaye gw’okorio. Asafu nigo arenge mosinto o Berekia, o Simea,
swahili: na msaidizi wa Hemani alikuwa Asafu, aliyesimama mkono wa kuume: Asafu mwana wa Berekia, mwana wa Shimea,

english: Eleazar was the father of Phinehas, Phinehas was the father of Abishua,
ekegusii: Eleazari akaibora Finehasi, na Finehasi akaibora Abisua;
swahili: Eleazari akamzaa Finehasi, Finehasi akamzaa Abishua,

english: the son of Michael, the son of Baaseiah, the son of Malchijah,
ekegusii: o Mikaeli, o Baseya, o Malikia,
swahili: mwana wa Mikaeli, mwana wa Baaseya, mwana wa Malkiya,

english: the son of Ethni, the son of Zerah, the son of Adaiah,
ekegusii: bw’Etini, o Zera, bw’Adaya,
swahili: mwana wa Ethni, mwana wa Zera, mwana wa Adaya,

english: the son of Ethan, the son of Zimmah, the son of Shimei,
ekegusii: bw’Etani, o Sima, o Simei,
swahili: mwana wa Ethani, mwana wa Zima, mwana wa Shimei,

english: the son of Jahath, the son of Gershom, the son of Levi.
ekegusii: o Yahati, o Gerisomu, o Lawi.
swahili: mwana wa Yahathi, mwana wa Gershoni, mwana wa Lawi.

english: On the left were their kinsmen, the sons of Merari: Ethan the son of Kishi, the son of Abdi, the son of Malluch,
ekegusii: Ase ensemo y’okoboko kwaye gw’okobee mbarengeo abamwabo b’ororeria rwa Merari: Etani, mosinto o Kisi bw’Abidi, o Maluku,
swahili: Na kutoka kwa walioshirikiana nao, Wamerari, mkono wake wa kushoto: Ethani mwana wa Kishi, mwana wa Abdi, mwana wa Maluki,

english: the son of Hashabiah, the son of Amaziah, the son of Hilkiah,
ekegusii: o Hasabia, bw’Amasia, o Hilikia,
swahili: mwana wa Hashabia, mwana wa Amazia, mwana wa Hilkia,

english: the son of Amzi, the son of Bani, the son of Shemer,
ekegusii: bw’Amusi, o Bani, o Semeri,
swahili: mwana wa Amsi, mwana wa Bani, mwana wa Shemeri,

english: Their fellow Levites were assigned to every kind of service of the tabernacle, the house of God.
ekegusii: Abalawi bamwabo bagachorwa gokora emeremo yonsi y’Eema nero enyomba ya Nyasae. Ororeria rwa Aroni
swahili: Ndugu zao wengine Walawi walipewa huduma nyingine za kuhudumia hema takatifu, nyumba ya Mungu.

english: But Aaron and his sons did all the work of the Most Holy Place. They presented the offerings on the altar of burnt offering and on the altar of incense to make atonement for Israel, according to all that Moses the servant of God had commanded.
ekegusii: Aroni amo nabamura b’ororeria rwaye bakaba bakorua ebing’wanso agwo ase egesasiimero gi’ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa na gosambera ubani ase egesasiimero ki’ogosambera ubani. Bagakora emeremo yonsi ime y’Aase Aachenu Mono, naende bagakora ayaganetigwe ase okobwatania Abaisraeli na Nyasae, koreng’ana namang’ana onsi Musa, omosomba o Nyasae, achigete.
swahili: Lakini Aroni na uzao wake ndio waliokuwa na wajibu wa kutoa sadaka katika madhabahu ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa na kwenye madhabahu ya kufukizia uvumba pamoja na yote yaliyofanyika pa Patakatifu, wakifanya upatanisho kwa ajili ya Israeli, sawasawa na yale yote aliyoagiza Mose mtumishi wa Mungu.

english: Abishua was the father of Bukki, Bukki was the father of Uzzi,
ekegusii: Abisua akaibora Buki, na Buki akaibora Usi;
swahili: Abishua akamzaa Buki, Buki akamzaa Uzi,

english: These were the descendants of Aaron: Eleazar his son, Phinehas his son, Abishua his son,
ekegusii: Oro narwo ororeria rwa Aroni: Eleazari omomura oye, na Finehasi omomura oye, na Abisua omomura oye,
swahili: Hawa ndio waliokuwa wazao wa Aroni: Aroni akamzaa Eleazari, Eleazari akamzaa Finehasi, Finehasi akamzaa Abishua,

english: Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son,
ekegusii: na Buku omomura oye, na Usi omomura oye, na Seraya omomura oye,
swahili: Abishua akamzaa Buki, Buki akamzaa Uzi, Uzi akamzaa Zerahia,

english: Meraioth his son, Amariah his son, Ahitub his son,
ekegusii: na Merayoti omomura oye, na Amaria omomura oye, na Ahitubu omomura oye,
swahili: Zerahia akamzaa Merayothi, Merayothi akamzaa Amaria, Amaria akamzaa Ahitubu,

english: Zadok his son, and Ahimaaz his son. Territories for the Levites (Numbers 35:1–8; Joshua 21:1–45)
ekegusii: na Zadoki omomura oye, na Ahimasi omomura oye. Aase Abalawi bamenyete
swahili: Ahitubu akamzaa Sadoki, Sadoki akamzaa Ahimaasi.

english: Now these were the territories assigned to the descendants of Aaron from the Kohathite clan for their settlements, because the first lot fell to them:
ekegusii: Echi nachio chinsemo abanto b’ororeria rwa Aroni b’eamate ya Kohati bamenyete ase chingongo chiabo. Obomera bw’eritang’ani bokabagwera;
swahili: Zifuatazo ni sehemu walizopewa ziwe nchi yao kwa ajili ya makazi yao (walipewa wazao wa Aroni waliotoka katika ukoo wa Wakohathi, kwa sababu kura ya kwanza iliwaangukia):

english: They were given Hebron in the land of Judah and its surrounding pasturelands.
ekegusii: ase igo bakaegwa Heburoni amo namarisio aetanaineo, agwo ase ense ya Yuda.
swahili: Walipewa Hebroni katika nchi ya Yuda pamoja na sehemu ya malisho inayouzunguka.

english: But the fields and villages around the city were given to Caleb son of Jephunneh.
ekegusii: Korende emegondo y’omochie amo nebichie bi’omochie oyio bakaa Kalebu, mosinto o Yefune.
swahili: Lakini mashamba pamoja na vijiji vilivyouzunguka mji alipewa Kalebu mwana wa Yefune.

english: So the descendants of Aaron were given Hebron (a city of refuge), Libnah, Jattir, Eshtemoa,
ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rwa Aroni bakaegwa emechie eye: Heburoni, omochie bw’obotamero, na Libuna, amo namarisio aetanaineo, Yatiri na Esitemoa amo namarisio aetanaineo,
swahili: Kwa hiyo wazao wa Aroni walipewa miji ifuatayo pamoja na eneo la malisho: Hebroni (mji wa makimbilio), Libna, Yatiri, Eshtemoa,

english: Ashan, Juttah, and Beth-shemesh, together with their pasturelands.
ekegusii: Asani na Beti‐Semesi amo namarisio aetanaineo.
swahili: Ashani, Yuta na Beth-Shemeshi pamoja na maeneo yake ya malisho.

english: Uzzi was the father of Zerahiah, Zerahiah was the father of Meraioth,
ekegusii: Usi akaibora Seraya, na Seraya akaibora Merayoti;
swahili: Uzi akamzaa Zerahia, Zerahia akamzaa Merayothi,

english: And from the tribe of Benjamin they were given Gibeon, Geba, Alemeth, and Anathoth, together with their pasturelands. So they had thirteen cities in all among their families.
ekegusii: Na korwa ase egesaku kia Benjamini bakaegwa Geba na Alemeti, na Anatoti, emechie eyio yonsi amo namarisio aetanaineo. Emechie yabo yonsi ase chiamate chiabo nigo yarenge ikomi na etato.
swahili: Kutoka kabila la Benyamini walipewa Gibeoni, Geba, Alemethi na Anathothi, pamoja na maeneo yake ya malisho. Miji hii kumi na mitatu iligawanywa miongoni mwa koo za Wakohathi.

english: To the rest of the Kohathites, ten cities were allotted from the half-tribe of Manasseh.
ekegusii: Abanto ba Kohati abatigarete bakaegwa emechie ikomi ase ogoakerwa obomera, bakayeegwa korwa ase eamate y’ekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase.
swahili: Wazao waliobaki wa Wakohathi walipewa miji kumi kutoka koo za nusu ya kabila la Manase.

english: The Gershomites, according to their clans, were allotted thirteen cities from the tribes of Issachar, Asher, Naphtali, and Manasseh in Bashan.
ekegusii: Abanto be chiamate chi’Abagerisomu bakaegwa emechie ikomi na etato (13) agwo Basani korwa ase abanto b’ebisaku bia Isakaru, na Aseri, na Nafutali, na Manase agwo Basani.
swahili: Wazao wa Gershoni, ukoo kwa ukoo, walipewa miji kumi na mitatu kutoka kwa makabila ya Isakari, Asheri na Naftali kutoka sehemu ya kabila la Manase huko Bashani.

english: The Merarites, according to their families, were allotted twelve cities from the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and Zebulun.
ekegusii: Abanto be chiamate chi’Abamerari bakaegwa emechie ikomi na ebere (12) korwa ase ebisaku bia Rubeni, na Gadi, na Sabuloni.
swahili: Wazao wa Merari, ukoo kwa ukoo walipewa miji kumi na miwili kutoka makabila ya Reubeni, Gadi na Zabuloni.

english: So the Israelites gave to the Levites these cities and their pasturelands.
ekegusii: Naboigo Abaisraeli baete Abalawi emechie amo namarisio aetanaineo.
swahili: Kwa hiyo Waisraeli waliwapa Walawi miji hii pamoja na maeneo yake ya malisho.

english: They assigned by lot the cities named above from the tribes of Judah, Simeon, and Benjamin.
ekegusii: Emechie eyio yatoire bakabayea korwa ase ebisaku bia Yuda, na Simioni, na Benjamini ase okoyeakera obomera.
swahili: Kutoka makabila ya Yuda, Simeoni na Benyamini walipewa miji iliyotajwa hapo juu.

english: And some of the clans of the Kohathites were given cities from the tribe of Ephraim for their territory:
ekegusii: Na abanto be chiamate chinde chi’Abakohati bakaegwa emechie korwa ase orogongo rw’egesaku gi’Efraimu.
swahili: Baadhi ya koo za Wakohathi walipewa kama nchi yao miji kutoka kabila la Efraimu.

english: They were given Shechem (a city of refuge) with its pasturelands in the hill country of Ephraim, and Gezer,
ekegusii: Bakaegwa Sekemu, omochie bw’obotamero ase ense y’Efraimu na Geseri,
swahili: Katika nchi ya vilima ya Efraimu walipewa Shekemu (mji wa makimbilio) na Gezeri,

english: Aijalon, and Gath-rimmon, together with their pasturelands.
ekegusii: Ayaloni na Gati‐Rimoni, amo namarisio aetanaine emechie eyio.
swahili: Aiyaloni na Gath-Rimoni, pamoja na maeneo yake ya malisho.

english: Meraioth was the father of Amariah, Amariah was the father of Ahitub,
ekegusii: Merayoti akaibora Amaria, na Amaria akaibora Ahitubu;
swahili: Merayothi akamzaa Amaria, Amaria akamzaa Ahitubu,

english: And from the half-tribe of Manasseh the remaining clans of the Kohathites were given Aner and Bileam, together with their pasturelands.
ekegusii: Na korwa ase ekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase Abakohati abatigarete bakaegwa Aneri na Bileamu amo namarisio aetanaine emechie eyio.
swahili: Kutoka nusu ya kabila la Manase, Waisraeli waliwapa koo za Wakohathi waliobaki miji ya Aneri na Bileamu pamoja na maeneo yake ya malisho.

english: The Gershomites received the following: From the clan of the half-tribe of Manasseh they were given Golan in Bashan and also Ashtaroth, together with their pasturelands.
ekegusii: Korwa ase ekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase Abagerisomu bakaegwa Golani agwo Basani, na Asitaroti, amo namarisio aetanaine emechie eyio.
swahili: Wagershoni walipokea miji ifuatayo pamoja na maeneo yake ya malisho: Katika nusu ya kabila la Manase: walipewa Golani katika Bashani na pia Ashtarothi.

english: From the tribe of Issachar they were given Kedesh, Daberath,
ekegusii: Na korwa ase egesaku gia Isakaru bakaegwa Kedesi na Daberati,
swahili: Kutoka kabila la Isakari walipokea Kedeshi, Daberathi,

english: Ramoth, and Anem, together with their pasturelands.
ekegusii: na Ramoti, na Anemu, amo namarisio aetanaine emechie eyio.
swahili: Ramothi na Anemu, pamoja na maeneo yake ya malisho.
