english: From the tribe of Asher they were given Mashal, Abdon,
ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku gi’Aseri bakaegwa Masali na Abidoni,
swahili: Kutoka kabila la Asheri walipokea Mashali, Abdoni,

english: Hukok, and Rehob, together with their pasturelands.
ekegusii: na Hukoki na Rebobu, amo namarisio aetanaine emechie eyio.
swahili: Hukoki na Rehobu, pamoja na maeneo yake ya malisho.

english: And from the tribe of Naphtali they were given Kedesh in Galilee, Hammon, and Kiriathaim, together with their pasturelands.
ekegusii: Na korwa ase egesaku kia Nafutali bakaegwa Kedesi agwo Galili, na Hamoni, na Kiriataimu, amo namarisio aetanaine emechie eyio.
swahili: Kutoka kabila la Naftali walipokea Kedeshi katika Galilaya, Hamoni na Kiriathaimu pamoja na maeneo yake ya malisho.

english: The Merarites (the rest of the Levites) received the following: From the tribe of Zebulun they were given Rimmono and Tabor, together with their pasturelands.
ekegusii: Abamerari abatigarete bakaegwa korwa ase egesaku gia Sabuloni: Rimoni na Tabori amo namarisio aetanaine emechie eyio.
swahili: Wamerari (Walawi waliobakia) walipokea miji ifuatayo: kutoka kabila la Zabuloni walipokea Yokneamu, Karta, Rimoni na Tabori pamoja na maeneo yake ya malisho.

english: From the tribe of Reuben east of the Jordan opposite Jericho they were given Bezer in the wilderness, Jahzah,
ekegusii: Na ng’umbu ya Yorodani, ensemo ya moocha ya Yeriko, bakaegwa korwa ase egesaku kia Rubeni: Beseri agwo aase ateremu, na Yahasi,
swahili: Kutoka kabila la Reubeni, ngʼambo ya Yordani mashariki mwa Yeriko walipokea Bezeri ulioko jangwani, Yahasa,

english: Kedemoth, and Mephaath, together with their pasturelands.
ekegusii: na Kedemoti, na Mefati, amo namarisio aetanaine emechie eyio.
swahili: Kedemothi na Mefaathi pamoja na maeneo yake ya malisho.

english: Ahitub was the father of Zadok, Zadok was the father of Ahimaaz,
ekegusii: Ahitubu akaibora Zadoki, na Zadoki akaibora Ahimasi;
swahili: Ahitubu akamzaa Sadoki, Sadoki akamzaa Ahimaasi,

english: And from the tribe of Gad they were given Ramoth in Gilead, Mahanaim,
ekegusii: Na korwa ase egesaku kia Gadi bakaegwa Ramoti agwo Gileadi, na Mahanaimu,
swahili: Na kutoka kabila la Gadi walipokea Ramothi huko Gileadi, Mahanaimu,

english: Heshbon, and Jazer, together with their pasturelands.
ekegusii: na Hesiboni, na Yaeseri amo namarisio aetanaine emechie eyio.
swahili: Heshboni na Yazeri, pamoja na maeneo yake ya malisho.

english: Ahimaaz was the father of Azariah, Azariah was the father of Johanan,
ekegusii: Ahimasi akaibora Asaria, na Asaria akaibora Yohanani;
swahili: Ahimaasi akamzaa Azaria, Azaria akamzaa Yohanani,

english: The sons of Issachar: Tola, Puah, Jashub, and Shimron—four in all.
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Isakaru nabwo aba: Tola, na Pua, na Yasubu, na Simuroni, bonsi mbaane.
swahili: Wana wa Isakari walikuwa: Tola, Pua, Yashubu na Shimroni; wote ni wanne.

english: The son of Jediael: Bilhan. The sons of Bilhan: Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Chenaanah, Zethan, Tarshish, and Ahishahar.
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Yediaeli nabwo aba: Bilihani amo nabana baye abamura: Yeusi, na Benjamini, na Ehudi, na Kenaana, na Setani, na Tarisisi, na Ahisahari,
swahili: Mwana wa Yediaeli alikuwa: Bilhani. Wana wa Bilhani walikuwa: Yeushi, Benyamini, Ehudi, Kenaana, Zethani, Tarshishi na Ahishahari.

english: All these sons of Jediael were heads of their families, mighty men of valor; there were 17,200 fit for battle.
ekegusii: Aba bonsi nabwo ab’ororeria rwa Yediaeli. Barenge abateneneri be chiamate chiabo, naende nigo barenge abakong’u ase esegi. Omobaro obo nechilifu ikomi na isano na ibere, na amagana abere (17,200).
swahili: Hawa wana wote wa Yediaeli walikuwa viongozi wa jamaa zao. Kulikuwako wanaume wapiganaji 17,200 waliokuwa tayari kwenda vitani.

english: The Shuppites and Huppites were descendants of Ir, and the Hushites were descendants of Aher. The Descendants of Naphtali
ekegusii: Supimu na Hupimu nigo barenge ab’ororeria rwa Iri, naende Abahusi nab’ororeria rw’Aheri. Ororeria rwa Nafutali
swahili: Washupimu na Wahupimu walikuwa wazao wa Iri. Wahushimu walikuwa wazao wa Aheri. Wana Wa Naftali

english: The sons of Naphtali: Jahziel, Guni, Jezer, and Shallum —the descendants of Bilhah. The Descendants of Manasseh
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Nafutali nabwo aba: Yaseeli, na Guni, na Yeseri, na Salumu. Nabwo abanto b’ororeria rwa Bilia. Ororeria rwa Manase
swahili: Wana wa Naftali walikuwa: Yahzieli, Guni, Yeseri na Shalumu; hao walikuwa wazao wa Bilha. Wana Wa Manase

english: The descendants of Manasseh: Through his Aramean concubine, Asriel, as well as Machir the father of Gilead.
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Manase nabwo aba: Asirieli, oria omokungu oye o sere‐sere, orenge Omoaramai amoiborerete. Boigo omokungu oria akaibora Makiri, ise Gileadi.
swahili: Wana wa Manase walikuwa: Asirieli alikuwa mzao wake kutokana na suria wake wa Kiaramu. Huyu suria akamzaa Makiri baba wa Gileadi.

english: Machir took a wife from among the Huppites and Shuppites. The name of his sister was Maacah. Another descendant was named Zelophehad, who had only daughters.
ekegusii: Makiri akanywomeria Hupimu omokungu, boigo akanywomeria Supimu omokungu. Omoiseke omwabo nigo arenge korokwa Maaka. Omwana omomura o kabere o Manase nigo arenge korokwa Selofehadi. Selofehadi nigo abwate abana abaiseke boka.
swahili: Makiri akatwaa mke kutoka miongoni mwa Wahupimu na Washupimu. Jina la dada yake aliitwa Maaka. Mwana wa pili wa Makiri aliitwa Selofehadi, ambaye alikuwa na wasichana tu.

english: Machir’s wife Maacah gave birth to a son, and she named him Peresh. His brother was named Sheresh, and his sons were Ulam and Rekem.
ekegusii: Maaka, moka Makiri, akaibora omwana omomura, akamoroka Peresi; na momura omwabo Peresi akarokwa Seresi. Abana abamura babere ba Peresi nabwo Ulamu na Rakemu.
swahili: Maaka mkewe Makiri akamzaa mwana aliyemwita Pereshi. Jina la nduguye lilikuwa Shereshi. Wana wa Pereshi walikuwa Ulamu na Rakemu.

english: The son of Ulam: Bedan. These were the sons of Gilead son of Machir, the son of Manasseh.
ekegusii: Ulamu nabwate omwana omomura orenge korokwa Bedani. Aba nabwo barenge ab’ororeria rwa Gileadi, mosinto o Makiri o Manase.
swahili: Mwana wa Ulamu alikuwa: Bedani. Hawa ndio waliokuwa wana wa Gileadi mwana wa Makiri, mwana wa Manase.

english: His sister Hammolecheth gave birth to Ishhod, Abiezer, and Mahlah.
ekegusii: Hamoleketi omosubati omwabo Gileadi, akaibora Isi‐Hodi na Abieseri, na Mahala.
swahili: Dada yake aliyeitwa Hamolekethi aliwazaa Ish-Hodi, Abiezeri na Mahla.

english: And these were the sons of Shemida: Ahian, Shechem, Likhi, and Aniam. The Descendants of Ephraim
ekegusii: Abana ba Shemida nabwo aba: Ahiani, na Sekemu, na Liki, na Aniamu. Ororeria rw’Efraimu
swahili: Wana wa Shemida walikuwa: Ahiani, Shekemu, Liki na Aniamu. Wana Wa Efraimu

english: The sons of Tola: Uzzi, Rephaiah, Jeriel, Jahmai, Ibsam, and Shemuel, the heads of their families. In the days of David, 22,600 descendants of Tola were numbered in their genealogies as mighty men of valor.
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Tola nabwo aba: Usi na Refaya, na Yerieli, na Yamai, na Ibusamu, na Semueli. Aba nabwo abateneneri be chiamate chia Tola, abanto chituoni ase okorwana esegi ase ebigori biabo. Ase amatuko ’okogamba gwa Daudi nigo barenge chilifu emerongo ebere na ibere, na amagana atano na rimo (22,600).
swahili: Wana wa Tola walikuwa: Uzi, Refaya, Yerieli, Yahmai, Ibsamu na Shemueli waliokuwa viongozi wa jamaa zao. Wakati wa utawala wa Mfalme Daudi, wazao wa Tola walioorodheshwa kama wapiganaji katika ukoo wao walikuwa watu 22,600.

english: The descendants of Ephraim: Shuthelah, Bered his son, Tahath his son, Eleadah his son, Tahath his son,
ekegusii: Oro narwo ororeria rw’Efraimu: Sutela omomura oye, na Beredi omomura oye, na Tahati omomura oye, na Eleada omomura oye, na Tahati omomura oye,
swahili: Wana wa Efraimu walikuwa: Shuthela, ambaye alimzaa Beredi, Beredi akamzaa Tahathi, Tahathi akazaa Eleada, Eleada akamzaa Tahathi,

english: Zabad his son, and Shuthelah his son. Ezer and Elead were killed by the natives of Gath, because they went down to steal their livestock.
ekegusii: na Sabadi omomura oye, na Sutela omomura oye. Naende Efraimu nabwate abana babere, Eseri na Eleadi; baria abanto baiboretwe ase ense ya Gadi baitete, ekiagera bachete koiba chiombe chiabo.
swahili: Tahathi akamzaa Zabadi, na Zabadi akamzaa Shuthela. Ezeri na Eleadi waliuawa na wenyeji wa Gathi walipokuwa wamekwenda huko kuwanyangʼanya mifugo yao.

english: Their father Ephraim mourned for many days, and his relatives came to comfort him.
ekegusii: Efraimu ise akaba okobareera ase amatuko amange, na abamura bamwabo bagacha komoremia.
swahili: Baba yao Efraimu akawaombolezea kwa siku nyingi, na jamaa zake wakaja kumfariji.

english: And again he slept with his wife, and she conceived and gave birth to a son. So he named him Beriah, because tragedy had come upon his house.
ekegusii: Erio Efraimu akaba na mokaye, na ere akanyora oborito, akaibora omwana omomura. Efraimu akaroka omwana oria Beria, ekiagera amang’ana amabe achete ase enka yaye.
swahili: Kisha akakutana kimwili na mke wake tena, naye akachukua mimba, akamzalia mwana. Akamwita Beria, kwa sababu ya misiba iliyoipata nyumba yake.

english: His daughter was Sheerah, who built Lower and Upper Beth-horon, as well as Uzzen-sheerah.
ekegusii: Omwana oye omoiseke nigo arenge korokwa Seera, oria oagachete Beti‐Horoni ya rogoro na eya maate, na Useni‐Seera.
swahili: Beria alikuwa na binti jina lake Sheera. Huyu ndiye aliijenga miji ya Beth-Horoni ya Juu na Beth-Horoni ya Chini, pamoja na Uzen-Sheera.

english: Additionally, Rephah was his son, Resheph his son, Telah his son, Tahan his son,
ekegusii: Refa nigo arenge omomura bw’Efraimu, na Resefu omomura oye, na Tela omomura oye, na Tahani omomura oye,
swahili: Beria akamzaa pia Refa, naye Refa akamzaa Reshefu, Reshefu akamzaa Tela, Tela akamzaa Tahani,

english: Ladan his son, Ammihud his son, Elishama his son,
ekegusii: na Ladani omomura oye, na Amihudi omomura oye, na Elisama omomura oye,
swahili: Tahani akamzaa Ladani, Ladani akamzaa Amihudi, Amihudi akamzaa Elishama,

english: Nun his son, and Joshua his son.
ekegusii: na Nuni omomura oye, na Yoshua omomura oye.
swahili: Elishama akamzaa Nuni, Nuni akamzaa Yoshua.

english: Their holdings and settlements included Bethel and its villages, Naaran to the east, Gezer and its villages to the west, and Shechem and its villages as far as Ayyah and its villages.
ekegusii: Chingongo chiabo bamenyete nachio Beteli na ebichie biaye, na ensemo ya moocha Naarani, na ensemo ya bosongo Geseri na ebichie biaye, na Sekemu na ebichie biaye, na Aya na ebichie biaye.
swahili: Nchi zao na makazi yao yalijumuisha Betheli na vijiji vilivyouzunguka, Naarani ilikuwa upande wa mashariki, Gezeri pamoja na vijiji vyake upande wa magharibi, pia Shekemu na vijiji vyake hadi kufikia Aya na vijiji vyake.

english: And along the borders of Manasseh were Beth-shean, Taanach, Megiddo, and Dor, together with their villages. The descendants of Joseph son of Israel lived in these towns. The Descendants of Asher
ekegusii: Boigo ase ribebe ri’abaanto ba Manase mbabwate Beti‐Sehani na ebichie biaye, na Taanaki na ebichie biaye, na Megido na ebichie biaye, na Dori na ebichie biaye. Ase emechie eyio na ebichie nao abanto b’ororeria rwa Yusufu, mosinto o Israeli, bamenyete. Ororeria rw’Aseri
swahili: Katika mipaka ya Manase walikuwepo Beth-Shani, Taanaki, Megido na Dori pamoja na vijiji vyake. Wana wa Yosefu mwana wa Israeli waliishi katika miji hii. Wana Wa Asheri

english: The son of Uzzi: Izrahiah. The sons of Izrahiah: Michael, Obadiah, Joel, and Isshiah. All five of them were chiefs.
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Usi nabwo aba: Isiraya amo nabana baye abamura: Mikaeli, na Obadia, na Yoel, na Isia, bonsi mbatano; na abwo nigo barenge abateneneri.
swahili: Mwana wa Uzi alikuwa: Izrahia. Wana wa Izrahia walikuwa: Mikaeli, Obadia, Yoeli na Ishia. Wote hawa watano walikuwa wakuu wao.

english: The children of Asher: Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, Beriah, and their sister Serah.
ekegusii: Abana abamura b’Aseri nabwo aba: Imuna, na Isiva, na Isivi na Beria, na omoiseke omwabo Sera.
swahili: Wana wa Asheri walikuwa: Imna, Ishva, Ishvi na Beria. Dada yao alikuwa Sera.

english: The sons of Beriah: Heber, as well as Malchiel, who was the father of Birzaith.
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Beria nabwo Heberi, na Malikieli, oria orenge ise Birisaiti.
swahili: Wana wa Beria walikuwa: Heberi na Malkieli, aliyekuwa baba yake Birzaithi.

english: Heber was the father of Japhlet, Shomer, and Hotham, and of their sister Shua.
ekegusii: Heberi nere orenge ise Yafileti, na Someri, na Hotamu, na ise omoiseke omwabo Sua.
swahili: Heberi akawazaa Yafleti, Shomeri na Hothamu, na Shua dada yao.

english: The sons of Japhlet: Pasach, Bimhal, and Ashvath. These were Japhlet’s sons.
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Yafileti nabwo aba: Pasaki, na Bimuhali, na Asiwati. Aba nabwo abana abamura ba Yafileti.
swahili: Wana wa Yafleti walikuwa: Pasaki, Bimhali na Ashvathi. Hawa walikuwa wana wa Yafleti.

english: The sons of Shemer: Ahi, Rohgah, Hubbah, and Aram.
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Someri, omomura omwabo, nabwo aba: Roga, na Yehuba, na Aramu.
swahili: Wana wa Shemeri walikuwa: Ahi, Roga, Yehuba na Aramu.

english: The sons of his brother Helem: Zophah, Imna, Shelesh, and Amal.
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Helemu, omomura omwabo, nabwo aba: Sofa, na Imuna, na Selesi, na Amali.
swahili: Wana wa Helemu ndugu yake walikuwa: Sofa, Imna, Sheleshi na Amali.

english: The sons of Zophah: Suah, Harnepher, Shual, Beri, Imrah,
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Sofa nabwo aba: Sua, na Hareneferi, na Suali, na Beri, na Imura,
swahili: Wana wa Sofa walikuwa: Sua, Harneferi, Shuali, Beri, Imra,

english: Bezer, Hod, Shamma, Shilshah, Ithran, and Beera.
ekegusii: na Beseri, na Hodi, na Sama, na Silisa, na Itirani, na Beera.
swahili: Bezeri, Hodu, Shama, Shilsha, Ithrani na Beera.

english: The sons of Jether: Jephunneh, Pispa, and Ara.
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Yeteri nabwo aba: Yefune, na Pisipa, na Ara.
swahili: Wana wa Yetheri walikuwa: Yefune, Pispa na Ara.

english: The sons of Ulla: Arah, Hanniel, and Rizia.
ekegusii: Abana ba Ula nabwo aba: Ara, na Hanieli, na Risia.
swahili: Wana wa Ula walikuwa: Ara, Hanieli na Risia.

english: In addition to them, according to their genealogy, they had 36,000 troops for battle, for they had many wives and children.
ekegusii: Barabwo nigo babwate abakungu abange babaiborerete abana abamura abange. Ase igo barwete korwa ase chinderia chiabo abasikari abakong’u chilifu emerongo etato na isano nemo (36,000).
swahili: Kulingana na ukoo wa jamaa zao, walikuwa na watu hodari wa vita wapatao 36,000, kwa sababu walikuwa na wanawake na watoto wengi.

english: All these were the descendants of Asher—heads of their families, choice and mighty men of valor, and chiefs among the leaders. The number of men fit for battle, recorded in their genealogies, was 26,000.
ekegusii: Aba bonsi nigo barenge abanto b’ororeria rw’Aseri. Nigo barenge abateneneri be chiamate chiabo, abanto bamanyekanete ng’a nabakong’u ase esegi, abatang’ani b’abaraai. Abwo barigetwe korwa ase chinderia chiabo bagende korwana esegi nigo barenge chilifu emerongo ebere na isano nemo (26,000).
swahili: Hawa wote ndio waliokuwa wazao wa Asheri, viongozi wa jamaa zao, watu bora, mashujaa walio hodari na viongozi maarufu. Idadi ya watu waliokuwa tayari kwa vita, kama ilivyoorodheshwa katika ukoo wao, walikuwa 26,000.

english: Their kinsmen belonging to all the families of Issachar who were mighty men of valor totaled 87,000, as listed in their genealogies. The Descendants of Benjamin
ekegusii: Abanto bamwabo be chiamate chionsi chia Isakaru nigo barenge abakong’u ase esegi. Bonsi nigo barenge chilifu emerongo etano na etato na isano na ibere (87,000), buna barigetwe ase chinderia chiabo. Ororeria rwa Benjamini
swahili: Jamaa ya watu waliokuwa wapiganaji hodari kutoka koo zote za Isakari, kama ilivyoorodheshwa katika ukoo wao, jumla yao walikuwa 87,000. Wana Wa Benyamini

english: The three sons of Benjamin: Bela, Becher, and Jediael.
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Benjamini nabwo aba: Bela, na Bekeri, na Yediaeli, bonsi mbatato.
swahili: Wana watatu wa Benyamini walikuwa: Bela, Bekeri na Yediaeli.

english: The sons of Bela: Ezbon, Uzzi, Uzziel, Jerimoth, and Iri, heads of their families—five in all. There were 22,034 mighty men of valor listed in their genealogies.
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Bela nabwo aba: Esiboni, na Usi, na Usieli, na Yerimoti, na Iri. Aba bonsi batano nigo barenge abateneneri be chiamate chiabo, abanto abakong’u ase esegi. Abwo barikire ase omooroberio bwe chinderia chiabo nigo barenge chilifu emerongo ebere na ibere, na emerongo etato, na baane (22,034).
swahili: Wana wa Bela walikuwa: Esboni, Uzi, Uzieli, Yeremothi na Iri; walikuwa viongozi wa jamaa zao; wote ni watano. Watu wapiganaji walioorodheshwa katika ukoo wao walikuwa 22,034.

english: The sons of Becher: Zemirah, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jeremoth, Abijah, Anathoth, and Alemeth; all these were Becher’s sons.
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Bekeri nabwo aba: Semira, na Yoashi, na Eliezeri, na Elioenai, na Omuri, na Yerimoti, na Abiya, na Anatoti, na Alemeti. Aba bonsi nigo barenge abana abamura ba Bekeri.
swahili: Wana wa Bekeri walikuwa: Zemira, Yoashi, Eliezeri, Elioenai, Omri, Yeremothi, Abiya, Anathothi na Alemethi. Hawa wote walikuwa wana wa Bekeri.

english: Their genealogies were recorded according to the heads of their families—20,200 mighty men of valor.
ekegusii: Abwo barikire ase omooroberio bwe chinderia chiabo, amo nabateneneri be chiamate chiabo, nigo barenge abanto abakong’u ase esegi, abanto chilifu emerongo ebere, na amagana abere (20,200).
swahili: Orodha ya ukoo wao iliyoandikwa viongozi wa jamaa zao walikuwa wapiganaji 20,200.

english: Benjamin was the father of Bela, his firstborn; Ashbel was the second born, Aharah the third,
ekegusii: Benjamini nere orenge ise Bela, omwana oye omomura omotangi na Asibeli oyo o kabere, na Ahara oyo o gatato,
swahili: Benyamini akamzaa: Bela mzaliwa wake wa kwanza, Ashbeli mwanawe wa pili, Ahara mwanawe wa tatu,

english: Jeuz, Sachia, and Mirmah. These were his sons, heads of families.
ekegusii: Yeusi na Sakia, na Mirima. Abana aba baye nigo barenge abateneneri be chiamate chiabo.
swahili: Yeuzi, Sakia na Mirma. Hawa ndio waliokuwa wanawe, viongozi wa jamaa zao.

english: He also had sons by Hushim: Abitub and Elpaal.
ekegusii: Naende Husimu akamoiborera abamura babere, nabwo Abitubu na Elipali.
swahili: Hushimu alimzalia: Abitubu na Elpaali.

english: The sons of Elpaal: Eber, Misham, Shemed (who built Ono and Lod with its villages),
ekegusii: Abana abamura b’Elipali nabwo Eberi na Misamu, naende Semedi, oria oagachete emechie ya Omo na Lodi amo nebichie biabo. Ababenjamini abamenyete Gati na Ayaloni
swahili: Wana wa Elpaali walikuwa: Eberi, Mishamu, Shemedi (aliyeijenga miji ya Ono na Lodi, pamoja na vijiji vilivyoizunguka),

english: and Beriah and Shema (who were the heads of families of the inhabitants of Aijalon and who drove out the inhabitants of Gath).
ekegusii: Beria na Sema nigo barenge abateneneri be chiamate chi’abaanto bamenyete agwo Ayaloni, nabwo baseretie abanyene ense ya Gati.
swahili: na Beria na Shema, waliokuwa viongozi wa zile jamaa zilizokuwa zinaishi katika mji wa Aiyaloni, na ambao waliwafukuza wenyeji wa Gathi.

english: Ahio, Shashak, Jeremoth,
ekegusii: Ahiyo na Sasaki, na Yeremoti,
swahili: Wana wa Beria walikuwa Ahio, Shashaki, Yeremothi,

english: Zebadiah, Arad, Eder,
ekegusii: Sebadia na Aradi, na Ederi,
swahili: Zebadia, Aradi, Ederi,

english: Zebadiah, Meshullam, Hizki, Heber,
ekegusii: Sebadia na Mesulamu, Hisiki na Heberi,
swahili: Zebadia, Meshulamu, Hizki, Heberi,

english: Ishmerai, Izliah, and Jobab were the sons of Elpaal.
ekegusii: Isimerai na Isilia, na Yobabu; aba nigo barenge abana abamura b’Elipali.
swahili: Ishmerai, Izlia na Yobabu ndio waliokuwa wana wa Elpaali.

english: Jakim, Zichri, Zabdi,
ekegusii: Yakimu na Sikiri, na Sabidi,
swahili: Yakimu, Zikri, Zabdi,

english: Nohah the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.
ekegusii: na Noha oyo o kane, na Rafa oyo o gatano.
swahili: Noha mwanawe wa nne na Rafa mwanawe wa tano.

english: Elienai, Zillethai, Eliel,
ekegusii: Elinai na Siletai, na Elieli,
swahili: Elienai, Silethai, Elieli,

english: Adaiah, Beraiah, and Shimrath were the sons of Shimei.
ekegusii: Adaya na Beraya, na Simurati; aba nigo baare abana abamura ba Simei.
swahili: Adaya, Beraya na Shimrathi walikuwa wana wa Shimei.

english: Ishpan, Eber, Eliel,
ekegusii: Isipani na Eberi, na Elieli,
swahili: Wana wa Shashaki walikuwa Ishpani, Eberi, Elieli,

english: Abdon, Zichri, Hanan,
ekegusii: Abidoni na Sikiri, na Hanani,
swahili: Abdoni, Zikri, Hanani,

english: Hananiah, Elam, Anthothijah,
ekegusii: Hanania na Elamu, na Anitotia,
swahili: Hanania, Elamu, Anthothiya,

english: Shamsherai, Shehariah, Athaliah,
ekegusii: Samiserai na Seharia, na Atalia,
swahili: Shamsherai, Sheharia, Athalia,

english: Jaareshiah, Elijah, and Zichri were the sons of Jeroham.
ekegusii: Yaresia na Elija, na Sikiri; aba nigo barenge abana abamura ba Yerohamu.
swahili: Yaareshia, Eliya na Zikri walikuwa wana wa Yerohamu.

english: All these were heads of families, the chiefs according to their genealogies, and they lived in Jerusalem.
ekegusii: Aba nigo barenge abateneneri be chiamate chiabo ase ebiaare biabo; nigo barenge abaraai abanene. Abwo nigo bamenyete Yerusalemu. Ababenjamini abamenyete Gibeoni na Yerusalemu
swahili: Hawa wote walikuwa viongozi wa jamaa zao wakuu, kama ilivyoorodheshwa katika koo zao, nao waliishi Yerusalemu.

english: Jeiel the father of Gibeon lived in Gibeon. His wife’s name was Maacah,
ekegusii: Ise Abagibeoni nigo amenyete agwo Gibeoni; omokungu oye nigo arenge korokwa Maaka.
swahili: Yeieli alikuwa baba yake Gibeoni naye aliishi huko Gibeoni. Mke wake aliitwa Maaka.

english: The sons of Bela: Addar, Gera, Abihud,
ekegusii: Abamura ba Bela nabwo aba: Adari na Gera, na Abihudi,
swahili: Wana wa Bela walikuwa: Adari, Gera, Abihudi,

english: and Abdon was his firstborn son, then Zur, Kish, Baal, Nadab,
ekegusii: Omwana oye omomura omotangi nere Abidoni; na abande nabwo aba: Suri na Kisi, Baali na Nadabu,
swahili: Mwanawe mzaliwa wa kwanza alikuwa Abdoni, akafuatiwa na Suri, Kishi, Baali, Neri, Nadabu,

english: Gedor, Ahio, Zecher,
ekegusii: Gedori na Ahiyo, na Sekeri,
swahili: Gedori, Ahio, Zekeri,

english: and Mikloth, who was the father of Shimeah. These also lived alongside their relatives in Jerusalem. The Family of Saul
ekegusii: na Mikiloti (nere orenge ise Simea). Aba nigo bamenyete bakabebekana nabaanto bamwabo agwo Yerusalemu. Eamate y’omorwoti Saulo
swahili: na Miklothi ambaye alikuwa baba yake Shimea. Hawa pia waliishi karibu na jamaa zao huko Yerusalemu.

english: Ner was the father of Kish, Kish was the father of Saul, and Saul was the father of Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Esh-baal.
ekegusii: Neri akaibora Kisi, na Kisi akaibora Saulo, na Saulo akaibora Yonathani na Malikisua, na Abinadabu, na Esi‐Baali.
swahili: Neri akamzaa Kishi, Kishi akamzaa Sauli, Sauli akamzaa Yonathani, Malki-Shua, Abinadabu na Esh-Baali.

english: The son of Jonathan: Merib-baal, and Merib-baal was the father of Micah.
ekegusii: Omwana omomura o Yonathani nere Meribu‐Baali; ere akaibora Mika.
swahili: Yonathani akamzaa: Merib-Baali, naye Merib-Baali akamzaa Mika.

english: The sons of Micah: Pithon, Melech, Tarea, and Ahaz.
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Mika nabwo aba: Pitoni na Meleki, na Tarea, na Ahasi.
swahili: Wana wa Mika walikuwa: Pithoni, Meleki, Tarea na Ahazi.

english: Ahaz was the father of Jehoaddah, Jehoaddah was the father of Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri, and Zimri was the father of Moza.
ekegusii: Ahasi akaibora Yehoada, na Yehoada akaibora Alemeti na Asimaweti, na Simuri, na Simuri akaibora Moza.
swahili: Ahazi akamzaa Yehoada. Naye Yehoada akawazaa Alemethi, Azmawethi na Zimri, naye Zimri akamzaa Mosa.

english: Moza was the father of Binea. Raphah was his son, Eleasah his son, and Azel his son.
ekegusii: Moza akaibora Binea; Rafa nigo arenge omomura oye, na Eleasa omomura oye, na Aseli omomura oye.
swahili: Mosa akamzaa Binea, Binea akamzaa Rafa, na mwanawe huyo ni Eleasa, na mwanawe huyo ni Aseli.

english: Azel had six sons, and these were their names: Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan. All these were the sons of Azel.
ekegusii: Aseli nabwate abana abamura batano nomo, naya naro amarieta abo: Asirikamu na Bokeru, Isumaeli na Searia, Obadia na Hanani. Aba bonsi nigo barenge abana abamura b’Aseli.
swahili: Aseli alikuwa na wana sita; haya ndiyo majina yao: Azrikamu, Bokeru, Ishmaeli, Shearia, Obadia na Hanani. Hawa wote ndio waliokuwa wana wa Aseli.

english: The sons of his brother Eshek: Ulam was his firstborn, Jeush second, and Eliphelet third.
ekegusii: Abana abamura b’Eseki, momura omwabo, nabwo aba: Ulamu, omwana oye omotangi, na Yeusi, oyo o kabere, na Elifeleti, oyo o gatato.
swahili: Wana wa Esheki, nduguye Aseli, walikuwa: Mzaliwa wake wa kwanza alikuwa Ulamu, wa pili Yeushi na wa tatu Elifeleti.

english: Abishua, Naaman, Ahoah,
ekegusii: Abisua na Naamani, na Ahoa,
swahili: Abishua, Naamani, Ahoa,

english: The sons of Ulam were mighty men of valor, archers, and they had many sons and grandsons—150 in all. All these were the descendants of Benjamin.
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Ulamu nigo barenge abanto chituoni ase esegi, bamanyete koruta emegwe. Nigo babwate abana abamura na abachokoro abamura abange, bonsi nigo barenge rigana erimo, na emerongo etano. Aba bonsi nigo barenge abanto b’ororeria rwa Benjamini.
swahili: Wana wa Ulamu walikuwa mashujaa hodari walioweza kutumia upinde. Alikuwa na wana wengi na wajukuu, jumla yao 150. Hawa wote ndio walikuwa wazao wa Benyamini.

english: Gera, Shephuphan, and Huram.
ekegusii: Gera na Sefufani, na Huramu.
swahili: Gera, Shefufani na Huramu.

english: These were the descendants of Ehud who were the heads of the families living in Geba and were exiled to Manahath:
ekegusii: Abana abamura b’Ehudi nigo barenge abateneneri be chiamate chiabo, echio chiamenyete Geba. Barabwo bagooswa, bakairwa ase ense ya Manahati.
swahili: Hawa ndio wazao wa Ehudi, waliokuwa viongozi wa jamaa za wale walioishi huko Geba na ambao walihamishiwa Manahathi:

english: Naaman, Ahijah, and Gera, who carried them into exile and who was the father of Uzza and Ahihud.
ekegusii: Abamura abwo nabwo aba: Naamani na Ahiya, na Gera, oyio obairete aroro. Abana abamura baye nabwo Usa na Ahihudi.
swahili: Naamani, Ahiya na Gera. Gera alikuwa baba yao Uza na Ahihudi na ndiye aliwaongoza kwenda uhamishoni.

english: Shaharaim had sons in the country of Moab after he had divorced his wives Hushim and Baara.
ekegusii: Saharaimu akaibora abana abamura ase ense ya Moabu ekero konya aseririe Husimu na Baara, abakungu baye.
swahili: Shaharaimu aliwazaa wana katika nchi ya Moabu baada ya kuwapa talaka wake zake wawili yaani, Hushimu na Baara.

english: His sons by his wife Hodesh: Jobab, Zibia, Mesha, Malcam,
ekegusii: Hodesi mokaye akamoiborera abana abamura, nabwo aba: Yobabu na Zibia, na Mesa, na Malikamu,
swahili: Kwa mkewe Hodeshi, akawazaa wana saba: Yobabu, Sibia, Mesha, Malkamu,

english: So all Israel was recorded in the genealogies written in the Book of the Kings of Israel. But Judah was exiled to Babylon because of their unfaithfulness.
ekegusii: Abaisraeli bonsi nigo baabaretwe na korikwa koreng’ana ne chinderia chiabo, na amang’ana abo nigo anyorekanete ase Egetabu ki’ogokora kw’Abarwoti b’Abaisraeli. Abayuda nigo baosetwe bakairwa Babiloni, ekiagera tibarenge abegenwa.
swahili: Waisraeli wote waliorodheshwa katika koo zilizoandikwa kwenye kitabu cha wafalme wa Israeli. Watu Katika Yerusalemu Watu wa Yuda walichukuliwa mateka kwenda Babeli kwa sababu ya kukosa uaminifu kwa Mungu.

english: From the priests: Jedaiah, Jehoiarib, and Jachin;
ekegusii: Abakuani aba nabwo bamenyete Yerusalemu: Yedaya na Yehoyaribu, na Yakini;
swahili: Wa jamaa za makuhani walikuwa: Yedaya, Yehoyaribu na Yakini;

english: Azariah son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the chief official of God’s temple;
ekegusii: Asaria, mosinto o Hilikia o Mesulamu, o Zadoki, o Meraioti, bw’Ahitubu, omoteneneri omonene bw’enyomba ya Nyasae.
swahili: Azaria mwana wa Hilkia, mwana wa Meshulamu, mwana wa Sadoki, mwana wa Merayothi, mwana wa Ahitubu aliyekuwa afisa kiongozi wa nyumba ya Mungu.

english: Adaiah son of Jeroham, the son of Pashhur, the son of Malchijah; Maasai son of Adiel, the son of Jahzerah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Meshillemith, the son of Immer;
ekegusii: Naende Adaya, mosinto o Yerohamu o Pasuri, o Malikia; na Maasai, mosinto bw’Adieli o Yasera, o Mesulamu, o Mesilemiti, o Imeri.
swahili: Adaya mwana wa Yerohamu, mwana wa Pashuri, mwana wa Malkiya; Maasai, mwana wa Adieli, mwana wa Yahzera, mwana wa Meshulamu, mwana wa Meshilemithi, mwana wa Imeri.

english: and 1,760 of their relatives, the heads of their families, able men for the work of the service of the house of God.
ekegusii: Amo nabwo barenge abamwabo, abateneneri be chiamate chiabo, elifu eyemo, na amagana atano na abere, na emerongo etano nomo (1,760). Bonsi nigo barenge abamanyi ase ogokora emeremo ase enyomba ya Nyasae. Abalawi abamenyete Yerusalemu
swahili: Makuhani waliokuwa viongozi wa jamaa zao walikuwa 1,760. Walikuwa watu wenye uwezo, waliowajibika kuhudumu katika nyumba ya Mungu. Jamaa Za Walawi

english: From the Levites: Shemaiah son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, a descendant of Merari;
ekegusii: Abalawi aba nabwo bamenyete Yerusalemu: Semaya, mosinto o Hasubu bw’Asirikamu, o Hasabia korwa ase eamate y’Abamerari;
swahili: Jamaa za Walawi walikuwa: Shemaya, mwana wa Hashubu, mwana wa Azrikamu, mwana wa Hashabia, wa wana wa Merari.

english: Bakbakkar, Heresh, Galal, and Mattaniah son of Mica, the son of Zichri, the son of Asaph;
ekegusii: Bakibakari na Heresi, Galali na Matania, mosinto o Mika o Sikiri, bw’Asafu;
swahili: Bakbakari, Hereshi, Galali na Matania mwana wa Mika, mwana wa Zikri, mwana wa Asafu.

english: Obadiah son of Shemaiah, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun; and Berechiah son of Asa, the son of Elkanah, who lived in the villages of the Netophathites.
ekegusii: Obadia, mosinto o Semaya o Galali, o Yedutuni; na Berekia, mosinto bw’Asa bw’Elikana, oyomenyete ase emechie y’Abaanetofa. Abarendi b’ebiita bie Hekalu abamenyete Yerusalemu
swahili: Obadia mwana wa Shemaya, mwana wa Galali, mwana wa Yeduthuni. Berekia mwana wa Asa, mwana wa Elikana, ambao waliishi katika vijiji vya Wanetofathi. Jamaa Za Mabawabu

english: These were the gatekeepers: Shallum, Akkub, Talmon, Ahiman, and their relatives. Shallum was their chief;
ekegusii: Aba nabwo abarendi b’ebiita bamenyete Yerusalemu: Salumu na Akubu, Talimoni na Ahimani, na abanto bande bamwabo. Salumu nere orenge omoteneneri obo.
swahili: Mabawabu katika Hekalu la Bwana waliorudi walikuwa: Shalumu, Akubu, Talmoni, Ahimani na ndugu zao. Shalumu alikuwa mlinzi wao mkuu.

english: he was previously stationed at the King’s Gate on the east side. These were the gatekeepers from the camp of the Levites.
ekegusii: Abanto abwo bakaba bakorenda agwo ase Egeita ki’Omorwoti, ensemo ya moocha, goika engaki eye. Kare nabwo barenge abarendi b’egetwori ki’Abalawi.
swahili: Walikuwa wamewekwa katika lango la mfalme lililokuwa upande wa mashariki, mpaka wakati huu. Hawa walikuwa mabawabu wa kutoka kwenye kambi ya Walawi.

english: Shallum son of Kore, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah, and his relatives from the Korahites were assigned to guard the thresholds of the Tent, just as their fathers had been assigned to guard the entrance to the dwelling of the LORD.
ekegusii: Salumu, mosinto o Kore bw’Ebiasafu, o Kora, amo nabaanto bande b’eamate yaye, nabwo Abakora, nigo barenge abateneneri bokorenda ase Ebiita bi’Eema y’Omosangererekano, buna chisokoro chiabo chiarenge korenda ase egesoero ki’egetwori ki’Omonene.
swahili: Shalumu mwana wa Kore, mwana wa Ebiasafu, mwana wa Kora, pamoja na mabawabu wenzake kutoka jamaa yake ya Kora waliwajibika kulinda malango ya Hema, kama vile baba zao walivyokuwa wamewajibika kulinda ingilio la Maskani ya Bwana.

english: Now the first to resettle their own property in their cities were Israelites, priests, Levites, and temple servants.
ekegusii: Abanto batang’anete koirana na komenya sobo ase emechie yabo n’Abaisraeli bande, na abakuani, na Abalawi, na abakori emeremo be Hekalu.
swahili: Basi watu wa kwanza kurudi kukaa kwenye milki zao katika miji yao walikuwa baadhi ya Waisraeli, makuhani, Walawi na watumishi wa Hekalu.

english: In earlier times Phinehas son of Eleazar had been in charge of the gatekeepers, and the LORD was with him.
ekegusii: Finehasi, mosinto bw’Eleazari, nere orenge omogambi agwo kare, n’Omonene nigo arenge amo nere.
swahili: Hapo zamani Finehasi mwana wa Eleazari alikuwa kiongozi wa mabawabu, naye Bwana alikuwa pamoja naye:

english: Zechariah son of Meshelemiah was the gatekeeper at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.
ekegusii: Zakaria, mosinto o Meselemia, nere orenge omorendi bw’egeita agwo ase egesoero ki Eema y’Omosangererekano.
swahili: Zekaria mwana wa Meshelemia alikuwa bawabu katika ingilio la Hema la Kukutania.

english: The number of those chosen to be gatekeepers at the thresholds was 212. They were registered by genealogy in their villages. David and Samuel the seer had appointed them to their positions of trust.
ekegusii: Abanto aba bonsi amagana abere, na ikomi na babere (212) nigo bachoretwe bakaba abarendi b’ebisoero bi’ebiita. Bakabarwa na korikwa ase chinderia chiabo. Daudi na Samweli omoorori bakababeeka ase emeremo, ekiagera babegenete.
swahili: Jumla ya waliochaguliwa kuwa mabawabu katika sakafu za kupuria nafaka walikuwa watu 212. Waliandikishwa kwa koo zao kwenye vijiji vyao. Mabawabu hawa waliwekwa katika nafasi zao za kuaminiwa na Daudi pamoja na mwonaji Samweli.

english: So they and their descendants were assigned to guard the gates of the house of the LORD—the house called the Tent.
ekegusii: Ase igo barabwo amo nabamura be chinderia chiabo bakagenderera korenda ebiita bi’enyomba y’Omonene, nero Eema eria.
swahili: Wao na wazao wao walikuwa viongozi wa kulinda malango ya nyumba ya Bwana, nyumba iliyoitwa Hema.

english: The gatekeepers were stationed on the four sides: east, west, north, and south.
ekegusii: Abarendi baria b’ebiita bakabeera aria korenda chinsemo chia moocha, na bosongo, na sugusu, na Irianyi.
swahili: Mabawabu walikuwa pande zote nne: mashariki, magharibi, kaskazini na kusini.

english: Their relatives came from their villages at fixed times to serve with them for seven-day periods.
ekegusii: Abanto bamwabo abarenge ase emechie yabo bakabetererigwa gocha koba amo nabarabwo ase kera rituko ria gatano na kabere ase engaki yachikiire.
swahili: Ndugu zao katika vijiji vyao walikuwa wakija mara kwa mara na kuwasaidia katika kazi zao kwa vipindi mbalimbali vya siku saba.

english: But the four chief gatekeepers, who were Levites, were entrusted with the rooms and the treasuries of the house of God.
ekegusii: Abalawi baria baane abarenge abateneneri b’emeremo y’okorenda ebiita nabwo batenenerete ebinyomba ne chikungo chi’enyomba ya Nyasae.
swahili: Lakini mabawabu wanne wakuu, waliokuwa Walawi, walikabidhiwa wajibu kwa ajili ya vyumba na hazina katika nyumba ya Mungu.

english: They would spend the night stationed around the house of God, because they were responsible for guarding it and opening it every morning.
ekegusii: Barabwo bakaba bakobeera isiko bagaetanana enyomba ya Nyasae, ekiagera emeremo y’oborendi nigo yabegetwe igoro ase bare, naende nabwo barenge koigora enyomba eria kera emambia. Abalawi bande
swahili: Walikesha mahali walipowekwa kuizunguka nyumba ya Mungu, kwa sababu iliwapasa kuilinda. Pia walitunza funguo kwa ajili ya kufungua mlango kila siku asubuhi.

english: Some of them were in charge of the articles used in worship, to count them whenever they were brought in or taken out.
ekegusii: Abalawi bande nabwo batenenerete ebikorero bi’emeremo, ekiagera nigo baganeirie kobibara ekero biarenge korentwa ime, na ekero biarenge koirwa isiko ase emeremo.
swahili: Baadhi yao walikuwa viongozi wa kutunza vifaa vilivyotumika katika huduma ndani ya Hekalu; walivihesabu kila vilipoingizwa ndani na kila vilipotolewa.

english: Others were put in charge of the furnishings and other articles of the sanctuary, as well as the fine flour, wine, oil, frankincense, and spices.
ekegusii: Abande babo bagachorwa gotenenera chimesa na ebinto binde, na ebikorero ebichenu, na obosie obonuke, na edivai, na amaguta ’amazeituni, na ubani, na ebinsari.
swahili: Wengine walipangiwa kutunza mapambo na vifaa vingine vya patakatifu, pamoja na unga, divai, mafuta, uvumba na vikolezo.

english: These were some of the descendants of Judah, Benjamin, Ephraim, and Manasseh who lived in Jerusalem:
ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rwa Yuda, na orwa Benjamini, na orw’Efraimu, na orwa Manase, abwo bamenyete Yerusalemu nabwo aba.
swahili: Wale waliotoka Yuda, Benyamini, Efraimu na Manase ambao waliishi Yerusalemu walikuwa: Jamaa Za Yuda

english: And some of the sons of the priests mixed the spices.
ekegusii: Abande b’abamura b’abakuani nigo babegetwe kwearigania na gwochogania ebinsari.
swahili: Lakini baadhi ya makuhani walifanya kazi ya kuchanganya vikolezo.

english: A Levite named Mattithiah, the firstborn son of Shallum the Korahite, was entrusted with baking the bread.
ekegusii: Matitia, oyomo bw’Abalawi, omomura omotangi o Salumu, omonto bw’eamate ya Kora, agatenenera emeremo y’okoroisia emegati ekoruegwa.
swahili: Mlawi aliyeitwa Matithia, mwana mzaliwa wa kwanza wa Shalumu, wa ukoo wa Kora, alikabidhiwa wajibu kwa ajili ya kuoka mikate ya sadaka.

english: Some of their Kohathite brothers were responsible for preparing the rows of the showbread every Sabbath.
ekegusii: Boigo abande bamwabo b’eamate ya Kohati bagatenenera emeremo y’okoroisia emegati yarenge koruegwa ase Omonene kera Esabato.
swahili: Baadhi ya ndugu zao wa ukoo wa Kohathi walikuwa viongozi wa kuandaa mikate ya Wonyesho kwa ajili ya kila Sabato, mikate iliyokuwa inawekwa mezani.

english: Those who were musicians, the heads of Levite families, stayed in the temple chambers and were exempt from other duties because they were on duty day and night.
ekegusii: Abande nigo barenge abateri abanene, boigo nabwo barenge abateneneri be chiamate chi’Abalawi. Barabwo nigo bamenyete ase ebinyomba bie Hekalu; tibarenge gokora emeremo ende emeao, ekiagera omobaso na obotuko nigo barenge ase emeremo baetwe gokora.
swahili: Wale waliokuwa waimbaji, viongozi wa jamaa za Walawi, waliishi katika vyumba vya Hekalu, nao hawakufanya shughuli nyingine yoyote kwa sababu iliwapasa kuwajibika kwa kazi hiyo usiku na mchana.

english: All these were heads of Levite families, chiefs according to their genealogies, and they lived in Jerusalem. The Descendants of Saul
ekegusii: Aba nabwo barenge abateneneri be chiamate chiabo chi’Abalawi ase ebiare biabo. Abwo nigo barenge abaraai baria bamenyete Yerusalemu. Chisokoro na ororeria rw’omorwoti Saulo (1 Amg 8:29-38)
swahili: Hawa wote walikuwa viongozi wa jamaa za Walawi, wakuu kama walivyoorodheshwa katika koo zao, nao waliishi Yerusalemu. Ukoo Wa Sauli (1 Nyakati 8:29-38)

english: Jeiel the father of Gibeon lived in Gibeon. His wife’s name was Maacah.
ekegusii: Yeieli ise Abagibeoni, nigo amenyete agwo Gibeoni na mokaye nigo arenge korokwa Maaka.
swahili: Yeieli alikuwa baba yake Gibeoni naye aliishi huko Gibeoni. Mke wake aliitwa Maaka,

english: Abdon was his firstborn son, then Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab,
ekegusii: Abidoni nere orenge omwana oye omomura omotangi, na abande nabwo aba: Suri na Kisi, Baali na Neri, na Nadabu,
swahili: mwanawe mzaliwa wa kwanza alikuwa Abdoni, akafuatiwa na Suri, Kishi, Baali, Neri, Nadabu,

english: Gedor, Ahio, Zechariah, and Mikloth.
ekegusii: Gedori na Ahiyo, Zakaria na Mikiloti.
swahili: Gedori, Ahio, Zekaria na Miklothi.

english: Mikloth was the father of Shimeam. They too lived alongside their relatives in Jerusalem.
ekegusii: Mikiloti nere orenge ise Simeamu. Aba boigo nigo bamenyete bakabebekana nabamwabo agwo Yerusalemu.
swahili: Miklothi akamzaa Shimeamu. Wao pia waliishi karibu na jamaa zao huko Yerusalemu.

english: Ner was the father of Kish, Kish was the father of Saul, and Saul was the father of Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Esh-baal.
ekegusii: Neri akaibora Kisi, na Kisi akaibora Saulo, na Saulo akaibora Yonathani na Malikisua, Abinadabu na Esi‐Baali.
swahili: Neri akamzaa Kishi, Kishi akamzaa Sauli. Sauli akamzaa Yonathani, Malki-Shua, Abinadabu na Esh-Baali.

english: Uthai son of Ammihud, the son of Omri, the son of Imri, the son of Bani, a descendant of Perez son of Judah.
ekegusii: Utai, omwana bw’Amihudi, mosinto bw’Omuri o Imuri, o Bani korwa ase ororeria rwa Peresi, mosinto o Yuda,
swahili: Uthai mwana wa Amihudi, mwana wa Omri, mwana wa Imri, mwana wa Bani, wa wana wa Peresi, mwana wa Yuda.

english: The son of Jonathan: Merib-baal, who was the father of Micah.
ekegusii: Yonathani akaibora Meribu‐Baali, na Meribu‐Baali akaibora Mika.
swahili: Yonathani akamzaa Merib-Baali, naye Merib-Baali akamzaa Mika.

english: The sons of Micah: Pithon, Melech, Tahrea, and Ahaz.
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Mika nabwo aba: Pitoni na Meleki, Tarea na Ahasi.
swahili: Wana wa Mika walikuwa: Pithoni, Meleki, Tarea, na Ahazi.

english: Ahaz was the father of Jarah; Jarah was the father of Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri was the father of Moza.
ekegusii: Ahasi akaibora Yara, na Yara akaibora Alemeti na Asimaweti, na Simuri; nere Simuri akaibora Moza.
swahili: Ahazi akamzaa Yara, Yara akawazaa Alemethi, Azmawethi na Zimri, naye Zimri akamzaa Mosa.

english: Moza was the father of Binea. Rephaiah was his son, Elasah his son, and Azel his son.
ekegusii: Moza akaibora Binea, na Binea akaibora Refaya, na Refaya akaibora Eleasa, na Eleasa akaibora Aseli.
swahili: Mosa akamzaa Binea, Binea akamzaa Refaya, na mwanawe huyo ni Eleasa, na mwanawe huyo ni Aseli.

english: And Azel had six sons, and these were their names: Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan. These were the sons of Azel.
ekegusii: Aseli nabwate abana abamura batano nomo, na amarieta abo naro aya: Asirikamu, na Bokeru, na Isumaeli, na Searia, na Obadia, na Hanani. Aba nabwo abana abamura b’Aseli.
swahili: Aseli alikuwa na wana sita, na haya ndiyo majina yao: Azrikamu, Bokeru, Ishmaeli, Shearia, Obadia na Hanani. Hawa ndio waliokuwa wana wa Aseli.

english: From the Shilonites: Asaiah the firstborn and his sons.
ekegusii: na korwa Silo Asaia, omwana omotangi amo nabana baye abamura.
swahili: Wazao wa Washiloni waliorudi ni: Asaya mzaliwa wa kwanza na wanawe.

english: From the Zerahites: Jeuel and 690 relatives.
ekegusii: Ase ororeria rwa Zera Yeueli amo nabaanto bamwabo. Bonsi nigo barenge abanto amagana atano na rimo, na emerongo kianda (690).
swahili: Kwa wana wa Zera: Yeueli. Watu wa Yuda jumla yao walikuwa watu 690. Jamaa Za Benyamini

english: From the Benjamites: Sallu son of Meshullam, the son of Hodaviah, the son of Hassenuah;
ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rwa Benjamini nabwo aba: Salu, mosinto o Mesulamu o Hodawia, o Hasenua;
swahili: Kwa Benyamini walikuwa: Salu mwana wa Meshulamu, mwana wa Hodavia, mwana wa Hasenua;

english: Ibneiah son of Jeroham; Elah son of Uzzi, the son of Michri; Meshullam son of Shephatiah, the son of Reuel, the son of Ibnijah;
ekegusii: naende Ibunia, mosinto o Yerohamu, na Ela, mosinto o Usi o Mikiri, na Mesulamu, mosinto o Sefatia o Reueli, o Ibunia,
swahili: Ibneya mwana wa Yerohamu, Ela mwana wa Uzi, mwana wa Mikri; na Meshulamu mwana wa Shefatia, mwana wa Reueli, mwana wa Ibniya.

english: and 956 of their relatives according to their genealogy. All these men were heads of their families.
ekegusii: amo nabaanto bamwabo ase chinderia chiabo, nigo barenge amagana kianda, na emerongo etano, na batano nomo (956). Aba bonsi nigo barenge abateneneri be chiamate chiabo, kera oyomo ase eamate yaye. Abakuani abamenyete Yerusalemu
swahili: Watu kutoka Benyamini kama walivyoorodheshwa katika koo zao jumla yao ni 956. Watu hawa wote walikuwa viongozi wa jamaa zao. Jamaa Za Makuhani

english: I do not want you to be unaware, brothers, that our forefathers were all under the cloud, and that they all passed through the sea.
ekegusii: Baminto, tindigeti momoche komanya ng’a chisokoro chiaito chionsi nigo chiarenge inse ye riire. Barabwo bonsi bagaeta egati y’enyancha;
swahili: Ndugu zangu, sitaki mkose kufahamu ukweli huu kwamba baba zetu walikuwa wote chini ya wingu na kwamba wote walipita katikati ya bahari.

english: And do not complain, as some of them did, and were killed by the destroying angel.
ekegusii: Gose timwemurungania buna abande babo bemurunganetie bagasirigwa noria Omosiria.
swahili: Msinungʼunike kama baadhi yao walivyofanya, wakaangamizwa na mharabu.

english: Now these things happened to them as examples and were written down as warnings for us, on whom the fulfillment of the ages has come.
ekegusii: Aya agakoreka ase bare buna ekiorokererio, akarikwa ase ogotokuurera intwe abatogocherwa nomoerio bw’ense.
swahili: Mambo haya yote yaliwapata wao ili yawe mifano kwa wengine, nayo yaliandikwa ili yatuonye sisi ambao mwisho wa nyakati umetufikia.

english: So the one who thinks he is standing firm should be careful not to fall.
ekegusii: Ase ayio oyogwekaga ng’a nateneine erende tagwa.
swahili: Hivyo, yeye ajidhaniaye amesimama, aangalie asianguke.

english: No temptation has seized you except what is common to man. And God is faithful; He will not let you be tempted beyond what you can bear. But when you are tempted, He will also provide an escape, so that you can stand up under it. Flee from Idolatry (Exodus 20:22–26)
ekegusii: Ogoteemwa tikwabanyorete inwe, otatiga okore kw’engencho ya Mwanyabaanto. Nyasae nomwegenwa, takobatiga moteemwe goetania buna chinguru chiaino ching’ana, korende amo nogoteemwa nakore egesieri mogosokera, erinde monyare gokoremereria. Ogosasimwa kw’emegwekano nkogwenerete gotamwa
swahili: Hakuna jaribu lolote lililowapata ambalo si la kawaida kwa wanadamu. Naye Mungu ni mwaminifu; hataruhusu mjaribiwe kupita mnavyoweza. Lakini mnapojaribiwa atawapa njia ya kutokea ili mweze kustahimili. Karamu Za Sanamu Na Meza Ya Bwana

english: Therefore, my beloved, flee from idolatry.
ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio, abanchwa baane, tama, timobaisa gosasiima emegwekano.
swahili: Kwa hiyo wapenzi wangu, zikimbieni ibada za sanamu.

english: I speak to reasonable people; judge for yourselves what I say.
ekegusii: Igo ngokwana ase more buna ase abanto bare nobong’aini; morenge aya ngokwana.
swahili: Nasema watu wenye ufahamu, amueni wenyewe kuhusu haya niyasemayo.

english: Is not the cup of blessing that we bless a participation in the blood of Christ? And is not the bread that we break a participation in the body of Christ?
ekegusii: Egekombe keria ki’ogosesenigwa togosesenia, Inee, tikeri okobwatana namanyinga a Kristo? Omogati oria togosamunyora, tori okobwatana nomobere o Kristo?
swahili: Je, kikombe cha baraka ambacho tunakibariki, si ushirika katika damu ya Kristo? Mkate tuumegao, si ushirika wa mwili wa Kristo?

english: Because there is one loaf, we who are many are one body; for we all partake of the one loaf.
ekegusii: Ekiagera omogati noyomo, intwe abatore abange nigo tore omobere oyomo; naki intwe twensi nigo tokonyora ensemo yaito y’omogati oria oyomo.
swahili: Kwa kuwa mkate ni mmoja, sisi tulio wengi tu mwili mmoja, kwa kuwa wote twashiriki mkate mmoja.

english: Consider the people of Israel: Are not those who eat the sacrifices fellow partakers in the altar?
ekegusii: Rigereria chingencho chi’Abaisraeli; abwo bakoria ebing’wanso ebio, Inee, tibari kobwatana negesasiimero?
swahili: Waangalieni watu wa Israeli: Je, wale wote walao dhabihu si ni wale watendao kazi madhabahuni?

english: Am I suggesting, then, that food sacrificed to an idol is anything, or that an idol is anything?
ekegusii: Ninki ngokwana? Ng’a keria gekoruegwa ekeng’wanso ase omogwekano bw’ogosasimwa negento? Gose omogwekano oria negento?
swahili: Je, nina maana kwamba kafara iliyotolewa kwa sanamu ni kitu chenye maana yoyote? Au kwamba sanamu ni kitu chenye maana yoyote?

english: They were all baptized into Moses in the cloud and in the sea.
ekegusii: bonsi bakabatiswa ase Musa ime ase riire na ime ase enyancha.
swahili: Wote wakabatizwa kuwa wa Mose ndani ya lile wingu na ndani ya ile bahari.

english: No, but the sacrifices of pagans are offered to demons, not to God. And I do not want you to be participants with demons.
ekegusii: Taibo, korende ebinto biria abanto b’Ebisaku bakorua buna ebing’wanso nigo bakoruera ebirecha, gose tari Nyasae. Inche tinyancheti inwe mobwatane nebirecha.
swahili: La hasha! Lakini kafara za watu wasiomjua Mungu hutolewa kwa mashetani, wala si kwa Mungu. Nami sitaki ninyi mwe na ushirika na mashetani.

english: You cannot drink the cup of the Lord and the cup of demons too; you cannot partake in the table of the Lord and the table of demons too.
ekegusii: Timokonyara konywera egekombe ki’Omonene na egekombe ki’ebirecha. Timokonyara kobwatana nemesa y’Omonene na emesa y’ebirecha.
swahili: Hamwezi kunywa katika kikombe cha Bwana na cha mashetani pia. Hamwezi kuwa na sehemu katika meza ya Bwana na katika meza ya mashetani pia.

english: Are we trying to provoke the Lord to jealousy? Are we stronger than He? All to God’s Glory (1 Peter 4:1–11)
ekegusii: Inee! Igo tokogera Omonene abe ne ribero? Gose ntore ne chinguru kobua ere?
swahili: Je, tunataka kuamsha wivu wa Bwana? Je, sisi tuna nguvu kuliko yeye? Fanyeni Yote Kwa Utukufu Wa Mungu

english: “Everything is permissible,” but not everything is beneficial. “Everything is permissible,” but not everything is edifying.
ekegusii: “Ninde nobosibore gokora kende gionsi”, korende tari bionsi birankonye. “Ninde nobosibore gokora kende gionsi”, korende tari bionsi bikoagacha.
swahili: “Vitu vyote ni halali,” lakini si vitu vyote vilivyo na faida. “Vitu vyote ni halali,” lakini si vyote vinavyojenga.

english: No one should seek his own good, but the good of others.
ekegusii: Omonto terigeria kwenyorera ebiya, korende arigerie omogisangio oye ebiya.
swahili: Mtu yeyote asitafute yaliyo yake mwenyewe, bali kila mtu atafute yale yanayowafaa wengine.

english: Eat anything sold in the meat market without raising questions of conscience,
ekegusii: Karie kera egento egekoonigwa ase echiiro, timona koboraboria. Timotiga chinkoro chiaino chichandeke.
swahili: Kuleni chochote kinachouzwa sokoni, bila kuuliza swali lolote kwa ajili ya dhamiri.

english: for, “The earth is the Lord’s, and the fullness thereof.”
ekegusii: “Naki ense ney’Omonene, amo na bionsi ebireo.”
swahili: Kwa maana, “Dunia na vyote vilivyomo ni mali ya Bwana.”

english: If an unbeliever invites you to a meal and you want to go, eat anything set before you without raising questions of conscience.
ekegusii: Onye omonto otari nokwegena okobarangeria inwe ase endagera, na inwe morigetie kogendao; karie kera egento kerabeekwe ase amasio aino, timona kobora‐boria. Timotiga chinkoro chiaino chichandeke.
swahili: Kama ukikaribishwa chakula na mtu asiyeamini nawe ukikubali kwenda, kula kila kitu kitakachowekwa mbele yako bila kuuliza maswali kwa ajili ya dhamiri.

english: But if someone tells you, “This food was offered to idols,” then do not eat it, for the sake of the one who told you and for the sake of conscience—
ekegusii: (Korende omonto karabateebie, “Egento ekio kiarurwe ekeng’wanso ase omogwekano bw’ogosasiimwa”, timoria ase engencho yaye ere ayaborokia, na ase enkoro yaye, erinde techandeka.
swahili: Lakini kama mtu yeyote akikuambia, “Hiki kimetolewa kafara kwa sanamu,” basi usikile kwa ajili ya huyo aliyekuambia na kwa ajili ya dhamiri.

english: the other one’s conscience, I mean, not your own. For why should my freedom be determined by someone else’s conscience?
ekegusii: Natebiire “enkoro techandeka”, tari eyao, korende eyaye oria onde.) Nase ki obosibore bwane bokogambigwa nenkoro y’omonto onde omoao?
swahili: Nina maana dhamiri ya huyo aliyekuambia, wala si kwa ajili ya dhamiri yako. Lakini kwa nini uhuru wangu uhukumiwe na dhamiri ya mtu mwingine?

english: They all ate the same spiritual food
ekegusii: Bonsi bakaria endagera eria eria y’omoika.
swahili: Wote walikula chakula kile kile cha roho,

english: If I partake in the meal with thankfulness, why am I denounced because of that for which I give thanks?
ekegusii: Kondarie ensemo yane ase ogoaka ng’a mbuya mono, nase ki nkoramwa ase egento nasabeire?
swahili: Kama nikila kwa shukrani, kwa nini nashutumiwa kwa kile ambacho kwa hicho ninamshukuru Mungu?

english: So whether you eat or drink or whatever you do, do it all to the glory of God.
ekegusii: Gaki komokoria, gose mokonywa gose mogokora ing’ana rinde rionsi, kora onsi ase obonene bwa Nyasae.
swahili: Basi, lolote mfanyalo, kama ni kula au kunywa, fanyeni yote kwa utukufu wa Mungu.

english: Do not become a stumbling block, whether to Jews or Greeks or the church of God—
ekegusii: Timogocha Abayahudi gose Abagiriki, gose ekanisa ya Nyasae.
swahili: Msiwe kikwazo kwa mtu yeyote, wawe Wayahudi au Wayunani, au kwa kanisa la Mungu,

english: as I also try to please everyone in all I do. For I am not seeking my own good, but the good of many, that they may be saved.
ekegusii: Mobe buna inche; nkogwenera abanto bonsi ase chinchera chionsi. Tinkorigia kwegwenera inche omonyene, korende ngwenere abwo bare abange, erinde banyare gotoorigwa.
swahili: kama hata mimi ninavyojaribu kumpendeza kila mtu kwa kila namna. Kwa maana sitafuti mema kwa ajili yangu mwenyewe bali kwa ajili ya wengi, ili waweze kuokolewa.

english: and drank the same spiritual drink; for they drank from the spiritual rock that accompanied them, and that rock was Christ.
ekegusii: Bonsi bakanywa ekenyugwa keria keria ki’omoika, ekiagera banywete korwa ase egetare ki’omoika kiabatunyanete; na egetare keria nakio Kristo.
swahili: na wote wakanywa kile kile kinywaji cha roho, kwa maana walikunywa kutoka ule mwamba wa roho uliofuatana nao, nao ule mwamba ulikuwa Kristo.

english: Nevertheless, God was not pleased with most of them, for they were struck down in the wilderness.
ekegusii: Korende abange babo Nyasae tagweneretwe nabarabwo, nakio kiagerete emebere yabo ekwete yasiareretwe ase erooro.
swahili: Lakini Mungu hakupendezwa na wengi wao, kwa hiyo miili yao ilitapakaa jangwani.

english: These things took place as examples to keep us from craving evil things as they did.
ekegusii: Ebi igo biarenge ebiorokererio bi’ogotokuurera, erinde intwe titoba abanto bakogania amabe, buna baria baganetie.
swahili: Basi mambo haya yalitokea kama mifano ili kutuzuia tusiweke mioyo yetu katika mambo maovu kama wao walivyofanya.

english: Do not be idolaters, as some of them were. As it is written: “The people sat down to eat and to drink, and got up to indulge in revelry.”
ekegusii: Gose timoba abasasimi emegwekano buna abande babo barenge; buna eriikire, “Abanto nigo baikaransete koria na konywa, bagatenena gotenga.”
swahili: Msiwe waabudu sanamu, kama baadhi yao walivyokuwa, kama ilivyoandikwa, “Watu waliketi chini kula na kunywa, kisha wakainuka kucheza na kufanya sherehe za kipagani.”

english: We should not commit sexual immorality, as some of them did, and in one day twenty-three thousand of them died.
ekegusii: Gose titokora obotomani buna abande babo bakorete, na abanto chilifu emerongo ebere na isato bagakwa ase rituko erimo.
swahili: Wala tusifanye uzinzi kama baadhi yao walivyofanya, wakafa watu 23,000 kwa siku moja.

english: We should not test Christ, as some of them did, and were killed by snakes.
ekegusii: Gose titoteema Omonene, buna abande babo bakorete, bagasirigwa ne ching’iti.
swahili: Wala tusimjaribu Kristo, kama baadhi yao walivyofanya, wakafa kwa kuumwa na nyoka.

english: You are to imitate me, just as I imitate Christ.
ekegusii: Mobe abegi baane, buna inche inde omwegi o Kristo. Abakungu beboetie ase emesangererekano y’ekanisa
swahili: Igeni mfano wangu, kama ninavyouiga mfano wa Kristo. Utaratibu Katika Kuabudu

english: For this reason a woman ought to have a sign of authority on her head, because of the angels.
ekegusii: Ase ayio negwenerete omokungu abe nekemanyererio gi’okobua ase omotwe oye ase engencho y’abamalaika.
swahili: Kwa sababu hii na kwa sababu ya malaika, inampasa mwanamke awe na ishara ya mamlaka juu yake.

english: In the Lord, however, woman is not independent of man, nor is man independent of woman.
ekegusii: (Korende ase Omonene omokungu takoba omosacha ataiyo, gose omosacha takoba omokungu ataiyo.
swahili: Lakini katika Bwana, mwanamke hajitegemei pasipo mwanaume na mwanaume hajitegemei pasipo mwanamke.

english: For just as woman came from man, so also man is born of woman. But everything comes from God.
ekegusii: Naki buna omokungu arwete ase omosacha, naboigo na omosacha nere akoiborwa nomokuungu, korende bionsi nigo bikorua ase Nyasae.)
swahili: Kama vile mwanamke alivyoumbwa kutoka kwa mwanaume, vivyo hivyo mwanaume huzaliwa na mwanamke. Lakini vitu vyote vyatoka kwa Mungu.

english: Judge for yourselves: Is it proper for a woman to pray to God with her head uncovered?
ekegusii: Egambie inwe abanyene. Inee! Mboronge omokungu asabe Nyasae atatubeti omotwe oye?
swahili: Hukumuni ninyi wenyewe: Je, inafaa kwa mwanamke kumwomba Mungu bila kufunika kichwa chake?

english: Doesn’t nature itself teach you that if a man has long hair, it is a disgrace to him,
ekegusii: Inee! Engencho ya Mwanyabaanto teri kworokereria ng’a onye omosacha okoba netukia entambe nigo ere obosooku asare,
swahili: Je, maumbile ya asili hayatufundishi kuwa ni aibu kwa mwanaume kuwa na nywele ndefu?

english: but that if a woman has long hair, it is her glory? For long hair is given to her as a covering.
ekegusii: korende onye omokungu okoba netukia entambe nigo ere obonene bwaye? Ekiagera oeirwe etukia eria ase ogwetuba.
swahili: Lakini mwanamke akiwa na nywele ndefu ni utukufu kwake? Kwa maana mwanamke amepewa nywele ndefu ili kumfunika.

english: If anyone is inclined to dispute this, we have no other practice, nor do the churches of God. Sharing in the Lord’s Supper (Matthew 26:20–30; Mark 14:17–26; Luke 22:14–23)
ekegusii: Korende onye monto onde bwensi origetie korenta amang’ana ’okoamererania ase engencho eyio, intwe titori nengencho buna eyio, nonya ne chikanisa chia Nyasae. Ogochecheria Epasaka y’Omonene
swahili: Kama mtu anataka kubishana juu ya jambo hili, sisi wala makanisa ya Mungu hatutambui desturi nyingine. Matumizi Mabaya Ya Meza Ya Bwana

english: In the following instructions I have no praise to offer, because your gatherings do more harm than good.
ekegusii: Korende ase okobaa amachiiko akobwatia ayio tinkobatogia, ekiagera timori gosangererekana ase amaya korende ase ogosaria.
swahili: Basi katika maagizo yafuatayo, siwezi kuwasifu, kwa sababu mkutanikapo si kwa ajili ya faida bali kwa hasara.

english: First of all, I hear that when you come together as a church, there are divisions among you, and in part I believe it.
ekegusii: Naki ritang’ani naigure ng’a ekero mogosangerereka ase ekanisa ogwatananekana nkore ase more. Ayande aya naigure negenire ng’a namaene.
swahili: Kwanza, mnapokutana kama kanisa, nasikia kwamba kuna mgawanyiko miongoni mwenu, nami kwa kiasi fulani nasadiki kuwa ndivyo ilivyo.

english: And indeed, there must be differences among you to show which of you are approved.
ekegusii: Naki ogwatananekana nkogwenerete kobe ase egati yaino, erinde abwo bare abeekeene bamanyekane maiso marore ase more.
swahili: Bila shaka lazima pawe na tofauti miongoni mwenu ili kuonyesha ni nani anayekubaliwa na Mungu.

english: Now I commend you for remembering me in everything and for maintaining the traditions, just as I passed them on to you.
ekegusii: Nabatogirie baminto, ekiagera mwang’inyoire ase amang’ana onsi, na inwe mwabwatire chingencho echi nabaete koreng’ana buna nabachiete.
swahili: Ninawasifu kwa kuwa mnanikumbuka katika kila jambo na kwa kushika mafundisho niliyowapa.

english: Now then, when you come together, it is not the Lord’s Supper you eat.
ekegusii: Ekero mogosangererekana amo, timori koria endagera y’Omonene;
swahili: Mkutanikapo pamoja si chakula cha Bwana mnachokula,

english: For as you eat, each of you goes ahead without sharing his meal. While one remains hungry, another gets drunk.
ekegusii: naki kera oyomo nigo agotang’ana kobogoria endagera yaye ase okoria, oyomo nare nenchara, na oyonde otindete.
swahili: kwa kuwa mnapokula, kila mmoja wenu anakula bila kuwangoja wengine. Mmoja hukaa njaa na mwingine analewa.

english: Don’t you have your own homes in which to eat and drink? Or do you despise the church of God and humiliate those who have nothing? What can I say to you? Shall I praise you for this? No, I will not!
ekegusii: Inee! Timori ne chinyomba aase mokoragerera na konywera? Gose mwachayire ekanisa ya Nyasae na gosookia abwo batari na gento? Naki ndabateebie? Nimbatogie ase aya? Yaya, tinkobatogia. Bun’Omonene orokereretie endagera yaye egokorwa (Mat 26:26-29; Mar 14:22-25; Luk 22:14-20)
swahili: Je, hamna nyumbani kwenu ambako mnaweza kula na kunywa? Au mnalidharau kanisa la Mungu na kuwadhalilisha wale wasio na kitu? Niwaambie nini? Je, niwasifu juu ya jambo hili? La, hasha! Kuanzishwa Kwa Meza Ya Bwana (Mathayo 26:26-29; Marko 14:22-25; Luka 22:14-20)

english: For I received from the Lord what I also passed on to you: The Lord Jesus, on the night He was betrayed, took bread,
ekegusii: Naki inche nkanyora korwa ase Omonene aya nabaeire inwe, ng’a Omonene Yeso obotuko boria aruetwe akabogoria omogati,
swahili: Kwa maana mimi nilipokea kutoka kwa Bwana yale niliyowapa ninyi, kwamba Bwana Yesu, usiku ule aliposalitiwa, alitwaa mkate,

english: and when He had given thanks, He broke it and said, “This is My body, which is for you; do this in remembrance of Me.”
ekegusii: gakoorire koiraneria ng’a mbuya mono, akayosamunyora, akabora karie, “Oyo noro omobere one orurwe ase engencho yaino; kora iga ase okong’inyora inche.”
swahili: naye akiisha kushukuru, akaumega, akasema, “Huu ndio mwili wangu, uliotolewa kwa ajili yenu. Fanyeni hivi kwa ukumbusho wangu.”

english: In the same way, after supper He took the cup, saying, “This cup is the new covenant in My blood; do this, as often as you drink it, in remembrance of Me.”
ekegusii: Naboigo akabogoria egekombe magega y’okoria, akabora, “Egekombe eke nokobwatana okoyia ase amanyinga aane; kora iga kera ekero mogokenywera ase okong’inyora inche.”
swahili: Vivyo hivyo baada ya kula, akakitwaa kikombe, akisema, “Kikombe hiki ni agano jipya katika damu yangu. Fanyeni hivi kila mnywapo, kwa ukumbusho wangu.”

english: For as often as you eat this bread and drink this cup, you proclaim the Lord’s death until He comes.
ekegusii: Naki kera ekero mokoria omogati oyo na konywera egekombe eke, nigo mokoraria amakweri y’Omonene goika achiche. Okonyora endagera y’Omonene buna etagwenereti
swahili: Maana kila mlapo mkate huu na kunywea kikombe hiki, mnatangaza mauti ya Bwana mpaka ajapo. Kushiriki Meza Ya Bwana Isivyostahili

english: Therefore, whoever eats the bread or drinks the cup of the Lord in an unworthy manner will be guilty of sinning against the body and blood of the Lord.
ekegusii: Gaki kera oyokoria omogati oyo gose konywera egekombe eke ki’Omonene buna etagwenereti nabe nokomocha igoro y’omobere bw’Omonene na amanyinga aye.
swahili: Kwa hiyo, mtu yeyote alaye mkate huo au kukinywea kikombe hicho cha Bwana isivyostahili, atakuwa na hatia ya dhambi juu ya mwili na damu ya Bwana.

english: Each one must examine himself before he eats of the bread and drinks of the cup.
ekegusii: Tiga omonto erenge omonyene, erio arie omogati na konywera egekombe.
swahili: Inampasa mtu ajichunguze mwenyewe, kabla ya kula mkate na kukinywea kikombe.

english: For anyone who eats and drinks without recognizing the body eats and drinks judgment on himself.
ekegusii: Naki oyokoria na konywa buna etagwenereti nigo akwegambia ere omonyene ase okoria na konywa, ase ogotatanana ng’a oria nomobere bw’Omonene.
swahili: Kwa maana mtu yeyote alaye na kunywa pasipo kuutambua mwili wa Bwana, hula na kunywa hukumu juu yake mwenyewe.

english: But I want you to understand that the head of every man is Christ, and the head of the woman is man, and the head of Christ is God.
ekegusii: Korende nindigetie momanye ng’a Kristo nere omotwe o kera omosacha; na omosacha nere omotwe bw’omokuungu; na Nyasae nere omotwe o Kristo.
swahili: Napenda mfahamu kwamba kichwa cha kila mwanaume ni Kristo, na kichwa cha mwanamke ni mwanaume, nacho kichwa cha Kristo ni Mungu.

english: That is why many among you are weak and sick, and a number of you have fallen asleep.
ekegusii: Nakio gekogera abange ase more bare abareu na abarwaire, na abanto batari bake bakuure.
swahili: Hii ndiyo sababu wengi miongoni mwenu ni wagonjwa na dhaifu na wengine wenu hata wamekufa.

english: Now if we judged ourselves properly, we would not come under judgment.
ekegusii: Korende gatoregambie buya intwe abanyene, anga titwagambigwa.
swahili: Lakini kama tungejichunguza wenyewe tusingehukumiwa.

english: But when we are judged by the Lord, we are being disciplined so that we will not be condemned with the world.
ekegusii: Gatokogambigwa iga togosusurwa n’Omonene, titobaisa konacherwa ekiina amo nense.
swahili: Tunapohukumiwa na Bwana, tunaadibishwa ili tusije tukahukumiwa pamoja na ulimwengu.

english: So, my brothers, when you come together to eat, wait for one another.
ekegusii: Gaki baminto, komogosangererekana amo ase okoria, moganyane.
swahili: Kwa hiyo, ndugu zangu, mkutanikapo pamoja ili kula, mngojane.

english: If anyone is hungry, he should eat at home, so that when you come together it will not result in judgment. And when I come, I will give instructions about the remaining matters.
ekegusii: Omonto kare nenchara, tiga arie mwaye, timobaisa gosangererekana amo ase okonyora okogambigwa. Na aya atigaire ninyaroisie ekero ndache.
swahili: Kama mtu akiwa na njaa, ale nyumbani kwake ili mkutanapo pamoja msije mkahukumiwa. Nami nitakapokuja nitawapa maelekezo zaidi.

english: Every man who prays or prophesies with his head covered dishonors his head.
ekegusii: Kera omosacha kagosaba gose gakobana, na ere nare negento atubete omotwe oye, igo tasigeti omotwe oye.
swahili: Kila mwanaume anayeomba au kutoa unabii akiwa amefunika kichwa chake, anakiaibisha kichwa chake.

english: And every woman who prays or prophesies with her head uncovered dishonors her head, for it is just as if her head were shaved.
ekegusii: Korende kera omokungu kagosaba gose kobana na taboeti omotwe oye, igo tasigeti omotwe oye, nigo areng’aine nere oyogingerete etukia yaye.
swahili: Naye kila mwanamke anayeomba au kutoa unabii pasipo kufunika kichwa chake, anakiaibisha kichwa chake, kwani ni sawa na yeye aliyenyoa nywele.

english: If a woman does not cover her head, she should have her hair cut off. And if it is shameful for a woman to have her hair cut or shaved off, she should cover her head.
ekegusii: Naki onye omokungu tarigeti kweboa, tiga agingire etukia yaye; korende onye nobosooku ase omokungu konachwa etukia yaye gose kogingirwa tiga eboe.
swahili: Kama mwanamke hatajifunika kichwa chake, basi inampasa kunyoa nywele zake. Lakini kama ni aibu kwa mwanamke kukata au kunyoa nywele zake, basi afunike kichwa chake.

english: A man ought not to cover his head, since he is the image and glory of God; but the woman is the glory of man.
ekegusii: Naki tegwenereti omosacha gotuba omotwe oye, ekiagera nomogwekano bw’obonene bwa Nyasae; korende omokungu nobonene bw’omosaacha.
swahili: Haimpasi mwanaume kufunika kichwa chake kwa kuwa yeye ni mfano wa Mungu na utukufu wa Mungu, lakini mwanamke ni utukufu wa mwanaume.

english: For man did not come from woman, but woman from man.
ekegusii: (Naki omosacha tarwete ase omokungu, korende nomokuungu orwete ase omosacha.
swahili: Kwa maana mwanaume hakutoka kwa mwanamke, bali mwanamke alitoka kwa mwanaume.

english: Neither was man created for woman, but woman for man.
ekegusii: Gose omosacha tatongetwe ase engencho y’omokuungu, korende nomokuungu ase engencho y’omosaacha.)
swahili: Wala mwanaume hakuumbwa kwa ajili ya mwanamke, bali mwanamke kwa ajili ya mwanaume.

english: Now about spiritual gifts, brothers, I do not want you to be uninformed.
ekegusii: Ase amang’ana y’ebiegwa ebikorwa ase Omoika, baminto, tindigeti momoche komanya.
swahili: Basi ndugu zangu, kuhusu karama za rohoni, sitaki mkose kufahamu.

english: to another the working of miracles, to another prophecy, to another distinguishing between spirits, to another speaking in various tongues, and to still another the interpretation of tongues.
ekegusii: Oyonde aegwa gokora emeremo y’ebikone bie chinguru, na oyonde obobani, na oyonde okomanya kw’ogwatanana emeika, na oyonde ogokwana kw’emenwa ao ao, na oyonde okoonchora emenwa.
swahili: Kwa mwingine matendo ya miujiza, kwa mwingine unabii kwa mwingine kupambanua roho, kwa mwingine aina mbalimbali za lugha, na kwa mwingine bado, tafsiri za lugha.

english: All these are the work of one and the same Spirit, who apportions them to each one as He determines. The Body of Christ
ekegusii: Korende ebiegwa ebi bionsi nigo bikorwa ase Omoika oyo oyomo, oria oria okogabera kera oyomo buna bwanchete. Omobere oyomo ore nebimo ebinge
swahili: Haya yote hufanywa na huyo huyo Roho mmoja, Roho naye humgawia kila mtu, kama apendavyo. Mwili Mmoja, Wenye Viungo Vingi

english: The body is a unit, though it is composed of many parts. And although its parts are many, they all form one body. So it is with Christ.
ekegusii: Naki buna omobere ore oyomo, oro nore nebiimo ebinge, na ebiimo bionsi bi’omobere oria, nonya bire ebinge, nigo bire omobere oyomo; naboigo na Kristo are.
swahili: Kama vile mwili ulivyo mmoja nao una viungo vingi, navyo viungo vyote vya mwili ingawa ni vingi, ni mwili mmoja, vivyo hivyo na Kristo.

english: For in one Spirit we were all baptized into one body, whether Jews or Greeks, slave or free, and we were all given one Spirit to drink.
ekegusii: Naki ase Omoika oyomo intwe twensi tokabatiswa, tokaba omobere oyomo, nonya tore Abayahudi, gose tore Abagiriki, onye tore abasomba, gose tore abasibore; intwe twensi nigo twanyoisetigwe Omoika oyomo.
swahili: Kwa maana katika Roho mmoja wote tulibatizwa katika mwili mmoja, kama ni Wayahudi au Wayunani, kama ni watumwa au watu huru, nasi sote tulinyweshwa Roho mmoja.

english: For the body does not consist of one part, but of many.
ekegusii: Naki omobere tori nekiimo ekemo, korende nebinge.
swahili: Basi mwili si kiungo kimoja, bali ni viungo vingi.

english: If the foot should say, “Because I am not a hand, I do not belong to the body,” that would not make it any less a part of the body.
ekegusii: Onye okogoro kogoteeba, “Ekiagera inche tindi okoboko, tindi oyo bw’omobere”, Inee, igo tikori okw’omobere ase engencho eyio?
swahili: Kama mguu ungesema, “Kwa kuwa mimi si mkono basi mimi si wa mwili,” hiyo isingefanya huo mguu usiwe sehemu ya mwili.

english: And if the ear should say, “Because I am not an eye, I do not belong to the body,” that would not make it any less a part of the body.
ekegusii: Na onye ogoto kogoteeba, “Ekiagera inche tindi eriso, inche tindi oyo bw’omobere”, Inee, igo tikori okw’omobere ase engencho eyio?
swahili: Na kama sikio lingesema, “Kwa kuwa mimi si jicho, basi mimi si wa mwili,” hiyo isingefanya hilo sikio lisiwe sehemu ya mwili.

english: If the whole body were an eye, where would the sense of hearing be? If the whole body were an ear, where would the sense of smell be?
ekegusii: Onye omobere bwonsi oba eriso, anga okoigwa ng’ai kore? Onye bwonsi nogoto, anga okonyonka ng’ai kore?
swahili: Kama mwili wote ungelikuwa jicho, kusikia kungekuwa wapi? Au kama mwili wote ungelikuwa sikio, kunusa kungekuwa wapi?

english: But in fact, God has arranged the members of the body, every one of them, according to His design.
ekegusii: Korende bono Nyasae obekire ebiimo, kera ekemo ase omobere buna arigetie.
swahili: Lakini kama ilivyo, Mungu ameweka viungo katika mwili, kila kimoja kama alivyopenda.

english: If they were all one part, where would the body be?
ekegusii: Korende onye bionsi biba ekiimo ekemo, anga omobere ng’ai ore?
swahili: Kama vyote vingekuwa kiungo kimoja, mwili ungekuwa wapi?

english: You know that when you were pagans, you were influenced and led astray to mute idols.
ekegusii: Mwamanyire ng’a ekero mwarenge ab’Ebisaku nigo mware koirwa ase emegwekano y’ogosasimwa, eyio etarenge gokwana, buna mware gotang’anwa.
swahili: Mnajua kwamba mlipokuwa watu wasiomjua Mungu, kwa njia moja au ingine mlishawishika na kupotoshwa mkielekezwa kwa sanamu zisizonena.

english: As it is, there are many parts, but one body.
ekegusii: Bono ebiimo nebinge bire, korende omobere noyomo.
swahili: Kama ulivyo, una viungo vingi, lakini mwili ni mmoja.

english: The eye cannot say to the hand, “I do not need you.” Nor can the head say to the feet, “I do not need you.”
ekegusii: Eriso tirikonyara goteebia okoboko, “Tinkoganeti”, gose omotwe tokonyara goteebia amagoro, “Timbaganeti.”
swahili: Jicho haliwezi kuuambia mkono, “Sina haja nawe!” Wala kichwa hakiwezi kuiambia miguu, “Sina haja na ninyi!”

english: On the contrary, the parts of the body that seem to be weaker are indispensable,
ekegusii: Korende kobua mono, ebiimo biria bi’omobere bigokagerwa ng’a tibiri ne chinguru, nigo biganeirie kobua.
swahili: Lakini badala yake, vile viungo vya mwili vinavyoonekana kuwa dhaifu, ndivyo ambavyo ni vya muhimu sana.

english: and the parts we consider less honorable, we treat with greater honor. And our unpresentable parts are treated with special modesty,
ekegusii: Na ebiimo biria bi’omobere bigokagerwa ng’a tibiri nogosika twabieire ogosika kobua; na ebiimo biaito bitari nobuya, nigo tokobiboyia buya kobua,
swahili: Navyo vile viungo tunavyoviona havina heshima, ndivyo tunavipa heshima maalum. Vile viungo vya mwili ambavyo havina uzuri, tunavipa heshima ya pekee;

english: whereas our presentable parts have no such need. But God has composed the body and has given greater honor to the parts that lacked it,
ekegusii: naki ebiimo biaito bire nobuya tibiganeti ayio. Korende Nyasae obwatanirie omobere, na ekiimo keria keremeire ogosika okeire ogosika kobua,
swahili: wakati vile viungo vyenye uzuri havihitaji utunzaji wa pekee. Lakini Mungu ameviweka pamoja viungo vya mwili na akavipa heshima zaidi vile vilivyopungukiwa,

english: so that there should be no division in the body, but that its members should have mutual concern for one another.
ekegusii: erinde tikoba ogwatananekana ase omobere, korende ebiimo birendane.
swahili: ili pasiwe na mafarakano katika mwili, bali viungo vyote vihudumiane kwa usawa kila kimoja na mwenzake.

english: If one part suffers, every part suffers with it; if one part is honored, every part rejoices with it. The Greater Gifts
ekegusii: Onye ekiimo ekemo gechandegete, ebiimo bionsi nigo bichandegete nabirobio; onye ekiimo ekemo kegotogigwa, ebiimo bionsi nigo bikogoka amo.
swahili: Kama kiungo kimoja kikiumia, viungo vyote huumia pamoja nacho, kama kiungo kimoja kikipewa heshima, viungo vyote hufurahi pamoja nacho.

english: Now you are the body of Christ, and each of you is a member of it.
ekegusii: Inwe nigo more omobere o Kristo na ebiimo bi’omobere oyio, kera ekemo aase aye.
swahili: Sasa ninyi ni mwili wa Kristo na kila mmoja wenu ni sehemu ya huo mwili.

english: And in the church God has appointed first of all apostles, second prophets, third teachers, then workers of miracles, and those with gifts of healing, helping, administration, and various tongues.
ekegusii: Na Nyasae obekire ase ekanisa ritang’ani abatomwa, eria kabere ababani, eria gatato aborokia. Naende akabeeka abakori emeremo y’ebikone bie chinguru, abanyorire ebiegwa bi’okogwenia amarwaire, abakoonyi, abaagambi, naende abagokwana emenwa ao ao.
swahili: Mungu ameweka katika kanisa, kwanza mitume, pili manabii, tatu walimu, kisha watenda miujiza, pia karama za kuponya, karama za kusaidiana, karama za uongozi, aina mbalimbali za lugha.

english: Are all apostles? Are all prophets? Are all teachers? Do all work miracles?
ekegusii: Inee! Bonsi nabatomwa? Bonsi nababani? Bonsi naborokia? Bonsi ngokora bare ebikone bie chinguru?
swahili: Je, wote ni mitume? Je, wote ni manabii? Je, wote ni walimu? Je, wote wanatenda miujiza?

english: Therefore I inform you that no one who is speaking by the Spirit of God says, “Jesus be cursed,” and no one can say, “Jesus is Lord,” except by the Holy Spirit.
ekegusii: Ase ayio nindigetie kobamanyia, ng’a monto onde tari oyogokwana ase Omoika o Nyasae ogoteeba ng’a, “Yeso oragererigwe!” Gose onde takonyara goteeba, “Yeso n’Omonene”, otatiga ase Omoika Omochenu.
swahili: Kwa hiyo nawaambieni ya kuwa hakuna mtu anayeongozwa na Roho wa Mungu anayeweza kusema, “Yesu na alaaniwe.” Pia hakuna mtu awezaye kusema, “Yesu ni Bwana,” isipokuwa ameongozwa na Roho Mtakatifu.

english: Do all have gifts of healing? Do all speak in tongues? Do all interpret?
ekegusii: Bonsi mbare nebiegwa bi’okogwenia abarwaire? Bonsi ngokwana bare emenwa ao ao? Bonsi nkoonchora bare?
swahili: Je, wote wana karama ya kuponya? Je, wote hunena kwa lugha mpya? Je, wote wanatafsiri?

english: But eagerly desire the greater gifts. And now I will show you the most excellent way.
ekegusii: Rigia mono ebiegwa ebiya kobua. Naende nimborokie enchera ere engiya mono.
swahili: Basi tamanini sana karama zilizo kuu. Nami nitawaonyesha njia iliyo bora zaidi.

english: There are different gifts, but the same Spirit.
ekegusii: Bono mbireo ebiegwa ao ao, korende Omoika noro oria oyomo.
swahili: Kuna aina mbalimbali za karama, lakini Roho ni yule yule.

english: There are different ministries, but the same Lord.
ekegusii: Naboigo nkore ogokora ao ao, korende Omonene nere oria oyomo.
swahili: Kuna huduma za aina mbalimbali, lakini Bwana ni yule yule.

english: There are different ways of working, but the same God works all things in all people.
ekegusii: Naende nkore ogokora kw’emeremo ase chinchera ao ao, korende Nyasae nere oria oria ogokora emeremo yonsi ase bonsi.
swahili: Kisha kuna tofauti za kutenda kazi, lakini ni Mungu yule yule atendaye kazi zote kwa watu wote.

english: Now to each one the manifestation of the Spirit is given for the common good.
ekegusii: Korende kera oyomo oeirwe okomaanorerwa kw’Omoika, erinde bonsi bakonywe.
swahili: Basi kila mmoja hupewa ufunuo wa Roho kwa faida ya wote.

english: To one there is given through the Spirit the message of wisdom, to another the message of knowledge by the same Spirit,
ekegusii: Naki omonto oyomo ase Omoika aegwa ogokwana kw’obong’aini, na oyonde ring’ana ri’okomanya ase Omoika oria oyomo.
swahili: Maana mtu mmoja kwa Roho hupewa neno la hekima na mwingine neno la maarifa kwa Roho huyo huyo.

english: to another faith by the same Spirit, to another gifts of healing by that one Spirit,
ekegusii: Oyonde aegwa okwegena ase Omoika oria oria, na oyonde aegwa ekeegwa gi’okogwenia ase Omoika oria oria.
swahili: Mtu mwingine imani kwa huyo Roho na mwingine karama za kuponya kwa huyo Roho mmoja.

english: If I speak in the tongues of men and of angels, but have not love, I am only a ringing gong or a clanging cymbal.
ekegusii: Ninsa gokwana ase emenwa ya Mwanyabaanto na ey’abamalaika, onye tindi nobwanchani, nabeire buna etai ekwoga gose endege ekobuga.
