swahili: Hata kama nitasema kwa lugha za wanadamu na za malaika, kama sina upendo, nimekuwa kengele inayolialia au toazi livumalo.

english: but when the perfect comes, the partial passes away.
ekegusii: korende ekero oboikeranu bogocha, egetaikeraneti nagesire.
swahili: Lakini ukamilifu ukija, yale yasiyo kamili hutoweka.

english: When I was a child, I talked like a child, I thought like a child, I reasoned like a child. When I became a man, I set aside childish ways.
ekegusii: Ekero narenge omwana, nigo narenge gokwana buna omwana, nigo narenge korengereria buna omwana, naende nigo narenge komanya buna omwana; konabeire omonto omonene natigire amang’ana y’obwana.
swahili: Nilipokuwa mtoto, nilisema kama mtoto, niliwaza kama mtoto, nilifikiri kama mtoto. Nilipokuwa mtu mzima niliacha mambo ya kitoto.

english: Now we see but a dim reflection as in a mirror; then we shall see face to face. Now I know in part; then I shall know fully, even as I am fully known.
ekegusii: Naki ekero kia bono nigo tokorora buna ase ekerore buna orotutu; korende ekero keria ntorore obosio ase obosio. Ekero kia bono namanyire ase ensemo; ekero keria nimanye onsi, buna inche imanyekanete kegima.
swahili: Kwa maana sasa tunaona taswira kama kwa kioo, lakini wakati huo tutaona wazi. Sasa nafahamu kwa sehemu, wakati huo nitafahamu kikamilifu, kama vile mimi ninavyofahamika kikamilifu.

english: And now these three remain: faith, hope, and love; but the greatest of these is love.
ekegusii: Gaki bono biatigaire okwegena, na ogosemeria, na obwanchani, aya atato; erire rinene ase aya nobwanchani.
swahili: Basi sasa, yanadumu mambo haya matatu: Imani, tumaini na upendo. Lakini lililo kuu miongoni mwa haya matatu ni upendo.

english: If I have the gift of prophecy and can fathom all mysteries and all knowledge, and if I have absolute faith so as to move mountains, but have not love, I am nothing.
ekegusii: Naende ninsa koba nekeegwa gi’okobana, na komanya obobisi bwonsi, ne chisemi chionsi; nimba nokwegena gwonsi oko koranyare kong’anyia ebitunwa, korende onye tindi nobwanchani, inche tindi gento.
swahili: Ningekuwa na karama ya unabii na kujua siri zote na maarifa yote, hata kama nina imani kiasi cha kuweza kuhamisha milima, kama sina upendo, mimi si kitu.

english: If I give all I possess to the poor and exult in the surrender of my body, but have not love, I gain nothing.
ekegusii: Naende ningabera abataka ebinto biane bionsi, naende nindua omobere one oyie ase omorero, onye tindi nobwanchani, ayio takongwenera gento.
swahili: Kama nikitoa mali yote niliyo nayo na kama nikijitolea mwili wangu uchomwe moto, kama sina upendo, hainifaidi kitu.

english: Love is patient, love is kind. It does not envy, it does not boast, it is not proud.
ekegusii: Obwanchani nigo bokoremereria, naende nigo bokoba nobwororo. Obwanchani tibori koba ne ribero, tibori koenena, tibori gwetogia,
swahili: Upendo huvumilia, upendo hufadhili, upendo hauoni wivu, hauna majivuno, hauna kiburi.

english: It is not rude, it is not self-seeking, it is not easily angered, it keeps no account of wrongs.
ekegusii: tibokomocha koba nogosika, tibokorigia ayare ayaye, tibori kobeeigwa, tibori kobara amabe;
swahili: Haukosi kuwa na adabu, hautafuti mambo yake, haukasiriki upesi, hauweki kumbukumbu ya mabaya.

english: Love takes no pleasure in evil, but rejoices in the truth.
ekegusii: tibokogokera obobe, korende bogokera ekeene.
swahili: Upendo haufurahii mabaya bali hufurahi pamoja na kweli.

english: It bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, endures all things.
ekegusii: Obwanchani nigo bokoremereria onsi, bwegeena onsi, bosemeria onsi, bobogoria onsi.
swahili: Upendo huvumilia yote, huamini yote, hutumaini yote, hustahimili yote.

english: Love never fails. But where there are prophecies, they will cease; where there are tongues, they will be restrained; where there is knowledge, it will be dismissed.
ekegusii: Obwanchani tibori nomoerio; korende koborabeo obobani, nabosire; kerabe emenwa, neere; gochirabe chisemi, nachisire.
swahili: Upendo haushindwi kamwe. Lakini ukiwepo unabii, utakoma; zikiwepo lugha, zitakoma; yakiwepo maarifa, yatapita.

english: For we know in part and we prophesy in part,
ekegusii: Naki okomanya gwaito tikori okw’oboikeranu, na obobani bwaito tibori obw’oboikeranu;
swahili: Kwa maana tunafahamu kwa sehemu na tunatoa unabii kwa sehemu.

english: Earnestly pursue love and eagerly desire spiritual gifts, especially the gift of prophecy.
ekegusii: Rigia obwanchani, teema mono konyora ebiegwa bi’Omoika; kobua mono ase ebi, monyare kobana.
swahili: Fuateni upendo na kutaka sana karama za roho, hasa karama ya unabii.

english: Assuredly, there are many different languages in the world, yet none of them is without meaning.
ekegusii: Inyora ng’a nere emenwa ere ne chingencho chinyinge ase ense, gose onde tari nonya noyomo, otari nengencho yaye.
swahili: Bila shaka ziko sauti nyingi ulimwenguni, wala hakuna isiyo na maana.

english: If, then, I do not know the meaning of someone’s language, I am a foreigner to the speaker, and he is a foreigner to me.
ekegusii: Onye tinkomanya engencho y’omonwa oria, nimbe buna omogeni asare ere oyogokwana, na ere nabe buna omogeni ase ’nde.
swahili: Basi kama sielewi maana ya hiyo sauti, nitakuwa mgeni kwa yule msemaji, naye atakuwa mgeni kwangu.

english: It is the same with you. Since you are eager to have spiritual gifts, strive to excel in gifts that build up the church.
ekegusii: Naboigo nainwe, ekiagera morigetie mono koba abanto bare nebiegwa bi’Omoika, rigia mono momente koba nabio, erinde moagache ekanisa.
swahili: Vivyo hivyo na ninyi. Kwa kuwa mnatamani kuwa na karama za rohoni, jitahidini kuzidi sana katika karama kwa ajili ya kulijenga kanisa.

english: Therefore, the one who speaks in a tongue should pray that he may interpret.
ekegusii: Ase ayio, ere oyogokwana ase omonwa otamanyekaneti tiga asabe aegwe ekeegwa gi’okoonchora.
swahili: Kwa sababu hii, yeye anenaye kwa lugha na aombe kwamba apate kutafsiri kile anachonena.

english: For if I pray in a tongue, my spirit prays, but my mind is unfruitful.
ekegusii: Naki kondasabe ase omonwa otamanyekaneti omoika one nigo ogosaba, korende obong’aini bwane tibori kwama.
swahili: Kwa maana nikiomba kwa lugha, roho yangu inaomba, lakini akili yangu haina matunda.

english: What then shall I do? I will pray with my spirit, but I will also pray with my mind. I will sing with my spirit, but I will also sing with my mind.
ekegusii: Inki rende ekio? Nindigetie nsabe ase omoika, naende nindigetie nsabe ase obong’aini. Nindigetie ntere ase omoika, naende nindigetie ntere ase obong’aini.
swahili: Nifanyeje basi? Nitaomba kwa roho, na pia nitaomba kwa akili yangu. Nitaimba kwa roho na nitaimba kwa akili yangu pia.

english: Otherwise, if you speak a blessing in spirit, how can someone who is uninstructed say “Amen” to your thanksgiving, since he does not know what you are saying?
ekegusii: Aande onye aye ogotogia Nyasae ase omoika, nere oyoikaransete otamanyeti, naki araitabe “Amina” ase ogoaka kwao ng’a mbuya mono, na ere tamanyeti aya ogokwana?
swahili: Ikiwa unabariki kwa roho, mtu mwingine atakayejikuta miongoni mwa hao wasiojua, atawezaje kusema “Amen” katika kushukuru kwako, wakati haelewi unachosema?

english: You may be giving thanks well enough, but the other one is not edified.
ekegusii: Naki nekeene, aye gwatogirie buya, korende oria oyonde taagachiri.
swahili: Mnaweza kuwa mnatoa shukrani kweli, sawa, lakini huyo mtu mwingine hajengeki.

english: I thank God that I speak in tongues more than all of you.
ekegusii: Namoakeire Nyasae ng’a mbuya mono, ekiagera ngokwana ase emenwa kobua inwe mwensi;
swahili: Namshukuru Mungu kwamba mimi nanena kwa lugha kuliko ninyi nyote.

english: But in the church, I would rather speak five coherent words to instruct others than ten thousand words in a tongue.
ekegusii: korende nanchire gokwana amang’ana atano ase ekanisa ase obong’aini bwane, inyare kworokereria abande, kobua gokwana amang’ana chilifu ikomi ase emenwa etamanyekaneti.
swahili: Lakini ndani ya kanisa ni afadhali niseme maneno matano ya kueleweka ili niwafundishe wengine kuliko kusema maneno 10,000 kwa lugha.

english: For he who speaks in a tongue does not speak to men, but to God. Indeed, no one understands him; he utters mysteries in the Spirit.
ekegusii: Naki oyogokwana ase omonwa otamanyekaneti, tari gokwana nabaanto, korende na Nyasae, ekiagera onde tari okomoigwa, korende nigo agokwana amang’ana abobisi ase Omoika.
swahili: Kwa maana mtu yeyote anayesema kwa lugha, hasemi na wanadamu bali anasema na Mungu. Kwa kuwa hakuna mtu yeyote anayemwelewa, kwani anasema mambo ya siri kwa roho.

english: Brothers, stop thinking like children. In regard to evil be infants, but in your thinking be mature.
ekegusii: Baminto, timoba buna abana abake ase ebirengererio biaino; ase obobe mobe abana ebing’werere, korende ase okomanya kwaino mobe abanto abanene.
swahili: Ndugu zangu, msiwe kama watoto katika kufikiri kwenu, afadhali kuhusu uovu mwe kama watoto wachanga, lakini katika kufikiri kwenu, mwe watu wazima.

english: It is written in the Law: “By strange tongues and foreign lips I will speak to this people, but even then they will not listen to Me, says the Lord.”
ekegusii: Ase amachiiko nigo ariikire, “Omonene oteebire: Ase abanto b’emenwa etamanyekaneti, na ase ebikoba bi’emenwa y’abageni ninkwane nabaanto aba. Nonya nabo tibakonyigwera.”
swahili: Katika Sheria imeandikwa kwamba: “Kupitia kwa watu wenye lugha ngʼeni na kupitia midomo ya wageni, nitasema na watu hawa, lakini hata hivyo hawatanisikiliza,” asema Bwana.

english: Tongues, then, are a sign, not for believers, but for unbelievers. Prophecy, however, is for believers, not for unbelievers.
ekegusii: Gaki emenwa eyio nekemanyererio, tari ase abegenete, korende ase abategeneti. Korende obobani nekemanyererio, tari ase abategeneti, korende ase abegenete.
swahili: Basi kunena kwa lugha ni ishara, si kwa watu waaminio, bali kwa wasioamini, wakati unabii si kwa ajili ya wasioamini, bali kwa ajili ya waaminio.

english: So if the whole church comes together and everyone speaks in tongues, and some who are uninstructed or some unbelievers come in, will they not say that you are out of your minds?
ekegusii: Gaki onye ekanisa yonsi, egosangererekana amo, na mwensi mogokwana ase emenwa, erio abanto ba isiko bagocha, gose abategeneti, Inee, tibagoteeba ng’a nigo more chibarimo?
swahili: Kwa hiyo kama kanisa lote likikutana na kila mmoja akanena kwa lugha, kisha wakaingia wageni wasioelewa wasioamini, je, hawatasema kwamba wote mna wazimu?

english: But if an unbeliever or uninstructed person comes in while everyone is prophesying, he will be convicted and called to account by all,
ekegusii: Korende onye bonsi bakobana, omonto otegeneti ogocha, gose omonto o isiko, orokigwe na bonsi ng’a nomomochi are, agambigwe na bonsi;
swahili: Lakini kama mtu asiyeamini au asiyeelewa akiingia wakati kila mtu anatoa unabii, ataaminishwa na watu wote kuwa yeye ni mwenye dhambi na kuhukumiwa na wote,

english: and the secrets of his heart will be made known. So he will fall facedown and worship God, proclaiming, “God is truly among you!” Orderly Worship
ekegusii: naboigo obobisi bw’enkoro yaye bobe maiso marore; na igo aragwe maumama, na gosasiima Nyasae, atore ng’a ekeene Nyasae nigo are ase egati yaino. Omoroberio omuya bw’ogosasiima
swahili: nazo siri za moyo wake zitawekwa wazi. Kwa hiyo ataanguka chini na kumwabudu Mungu akikiri, “Kweli Mungu yuko katikati yenu!” Kumwabudu Mungu Kwa Utaratibu

english: What then shall we say, brothers? When you come together, everyone has a psalm or a teaching, a revelation, a tongue, or an interpretation. All of these must be done to build up the church.
ekegusii: Naki rende baminto? Komogosangererekana amo, kera oyomo nare nogoteera, gose okworokereria, gose okomaanorerwa, gose gokwana ase omonwa, gose koonchora, amang’ana onsi tiga akoreke ase okoagacha ekanisa.
swahili: Basi tuseme nini ndugu zangu? Mnapokutana pamoja, kila mmoja ana wimbo, au neno la mafundisho, au ufunuo, lugha mpya au atatafsiri. Mambo yote yatendeke kwa ajili ya kulijenga kanisa.

english: If anyone speaks in a tongue, two, or at most three, should speak in turn, and someone must interpret.
ekegusii: Onye omonto ogokwana ase omonwa otamanyekaneti, bakwane babere gose batato boka, korende kera omonto ase ribaga riaye, na oyomo aonchore.
swahili: Kama mtu yeyote akinena kwa lugha, basi waseme watu wawili au watatu si zaidi, mmoja baada ya mwingine na lazima awepo mtu wa kutafsiri.

english: But if there is no interpreter, he should remain silent in the church and speak only to himself and God.
ekegusii: Korende onye oyokoonchora taiyo, tiga oyogokwana ase omonwa akire ase ekanisa, ekwanere bweka omonyene naende akwane na Nyasae.
swahili: Lakini kama hakuna mtu wa kutafsiri, hao watu na wanyamaze kimya kanisani na wanene na nafsi zao wenyewe na Mungu.

english: Two or three prophets should speak, and the others should weigh carefully what is said.
ekegusii: Abaabani bakwane babere gose batato, na abande barenge amang’ana aya bakwana.
swahili: Manabii wawili au watatu wanene na wengine wapime yale yasemwayo.

english: But he who prophesies speaks to men for their edification, encouragement, and comfort.
ekegusii: Korende ere oyokobana, nigo agokwana ase abanto amang’ana ay’okobaagacha, na kobaremia, na kobabeeka chinguru.
swahili: Lakini anayetoa unabii anasema na watu akiwajenga, kuwatia moyo na kuwafariji.

english: And if a revelation comes to someone who is seated, the first speaker should stop.
ekegusii: Korende oyonde oikaransete karaigorerwe ring’ana, oria bw’eritang’ani tiga akire.
swahili: Kama mtu yeyote aliyeketi karibu, akipata ufunuo, basi yule wa kwanza na anyamaze.

english: For you can all prophesy in turn so that everyone may be instructed and encouraged.
ekegusii: Naki inwe mwensi namonyare kobana oyomo ase oyomo, erinde bonsi banyare kweorokereria, na bonsi baremigwe.
swahili: Kwa maana wote mnaweza kutoa unabii, mmoja baada ya mwingine, ili kila mtu apate kufundishwa na kutiwa moyo.

english: The spirits of prophets are subject to prophets.
ekegusii: Emeika y’ababani nigo ekoigwera ababani.
swahili: Roho za manabii huwatii manabii.

english: For God is not a God of disorder, but of peace—as in all the churches of the saints.
ekegusii: Naki Nyasae tari Nyasae bw’eburuburu, korende oyo bw’omorembe. Buna ere ase chikanisa chionsi chi’abachenu,
swahili: Kwa maana Mungu si Mungu wa machafuko bali ni Mungu wa amani. Kama ilivyo katika makusanyiko yote ya watakatifu,

english: Women are to be silent in the churches. They are not permitted to speak, but must be in submission, as the law says.
ekegusii: abakungu bakire ase chikanisa. Naki tibari ne ribaga ri’ogokwana, korende baigwere buna amachiiko agoteeba.
swahili: wanawake wanapaswa kuwa kimya kanisani. Hawaruhusiwi kusema, bali wanyenyekee kama sheria isemavyo.

english: If they wish to inquire about something, they are to ask their own husbands at home; for it is dishonorable for a woman to speak in the church.
ekegusii: Onye barigetie kweorokereria ring’ana, tiga baborie abasacha babo inka. Naki nobosooku omokungu gokwana ase ekanisa.
swahili: Kama wakitaka kuuliza kuhusu jambo lolote, wawaulize waume zao nyumbani. Kwa maana ni aibu kwa mwanamke kuzungumza kanisani.

english: Did the word of God originate with you? Or are you the only ones it has reached?
ekegusii: Inee! Ring’ana ria Nyasae nasemore riarwete, gose ninwe mweka riaikerete?
swahili: Je, neno la Mungu lilianzia kwenu? Au ni ninyi tu ambao neno la Mungu limewafikia?

english: If anyone considers himself a prophet or spiritual person, let him acknowledge that what I am writing you is the Lord’s command.
ekegusii: Omonto karerore ng’a nomobani are, gose noyo bw’Omoika, tiga amanye ng’a aya nabarikeire namachiiko ’Omonene.
swahili: Kama mtu yeyote akidhani kwamba yeye ni nabii, au ana karama za rohoni, basi na akubali kwamba haya ninayoandika ni maagizo kutoka kwa Bwana.

english: But if anyone ignores this, he himself will be ignored.
ekegusii: Onye omonto tarigeti koyamanya, tiga abe omoriri.
swahili: Kama mtu akipuuza jambo hili yeye mwenyewe atapuuzwa.

english: So, my brothers, be eager to prophesy, and do not forbid speaking in tongues.
ekegusii: Ase ayio baminto, rigia mono okobana, gose timokana ogokwana kw’emenwa.
swahili: Kwa hiyo ndugu zangu, takeni sana kutoa unabii na msikataze watu kusema kwa lugha.

english: The one who speaks in a tongue edifies himself, but the one who prophesies edifies the church.
ekegusii: Oyogokwana ase omonwa otamanyekaneti nigo akweagacha ere omonyene; korende oyokobana nigo akoagacha ekanisa.
swahili: Anenaye kwa lugha hujijenga mwenyewe, bali atoaye unabii hulijenga kanisa.

english: But everything must be done in a proper and orderly manner.
ekegusii: Amang’ana onsi akoreke ase obuya na ase omooroberio.
swahili: Lakini kila kitu kitendeke kwa heshima na kwa utaratibu.

english: I wish that all of you could speak in tongues, but I would rather have you prophesy. He who prophesies is greater than one who speaks in tongues, unless he interprets so that the church may be edified.
ekegusii: Inche nigo ndigetie inwe mwensi mokwane ase emenwa, korende kobua mono ng’a monyare kobana. Ere oyokobana nomonene kobua oyogokwana ase emenwa, otatiga omonto aonchore, erinde ekanisa eagachwe.
swahili: Ningependa kila mmoja wenu anene kwa lugha lakini ningependa zaidi nyote mtoe unabii. Kwa kuwa yeye atoaye unabii ni mkuu kuliko anenaye kwa lugha, isipokuwa atafsiri, ili kanisa lipate kujengwa.

english: Now, brothers, if I come to you speaking in tongues, how will I benefit you, unless I bring you some revelation or knowledge or prophecy or teaching?
ekegusii: Gaki baminto, kondache ase more na gokwana ase emenwa, inki ndabagwenere, onye aya ngokwana takoba amang’ana ’okomaanorerwa gose obong’aini, gose obobani, gose okworokereria?
swahili: Sasa ndugu zangu, kama nikija kwenu nikasema kwa lugha mpya nitawafaidia nini kama sikuwaletea ufunuo au neno la maarifa au unabii au mafundisho?

english: Even in the case of lifeless instruments, such as the flute or harp, how will anyone recognize the tune they are playing unless the notes are distinct?
ekegusii: Nonya n’ebinto bitari nobogima, buna ekeroria, gose obokano, onye tibikorua eriogi rire nogwatananekana, naki eramanyekane ngotera ki gokobugigwa ase ekeroria gose obokano?
swahili: Hata vitu visivyo na uhai vitoapo sauti, kama vile filimbi au kinubi, mtu atajuaje ni wimbo gani unaoimbwa kusipokuwa na tofauti ya upigaji?

english: Again, if the trumpet sounds a muffled call, who will prepare for battle?
ekegusii: Naende onye egetureeri gekobugigwa na gosokia egeturi getamanyekaneti, ning’o orabe ang’e ase esegi?
swahili: Tena kama tarumbeta haitoi sauti inayoeleweka, ni nani atakayejiandaa kwa ajili ya vita?

english: So it is with you. Unless you speak intelligible words with your tongue, how will anyone know what you are saying? You will just be speaking into the air.
ekegusii: Naboigo nainwe motakwaneti ring’ana rikoigweka, ring’ana riria rigokwanwa, naki riramanyekane? Naki igo morakwane ase embeo bosa.
swahili: Vivyo hivyo na ninyi, kama mkinena maneno yasiyoeleweka katika akili, mtu atajuaje mnalosema? Kwa maana mtakuwa mnasema hewani tu.

english: Now, brothers, I want to remind you of the gospel I preached to you, which you received, and in which you stand firm.
ekegusii: Bono baminto, nkobainyoria nde enchiri eyio nabaranderetie; nero mwanyorete, na ase eyio nao moteneine,
swahili: Basi ndugu zangu nataka niwakumbushe kuhusu Injili niliyowahubiria, mkaipokea na ambayo katika hiyo mmesimama.

english: But by the grace of God I am what I am, and His grace to me was not in vain. No, I worked harder than all of them—yet not I, but the grace of God that was with me.
ekegusii: Korende ase obuya bwa Nyasae nabeire buna inde; na obuya bwaye bore ase ’nde tibwarenge bosa. Korende kobua mono nakorire emeremo goetania bonsi, gose tari inche, korende obuya bwa Nyasae obore amo nainche.
swahili: Lakini kwa neema ya Mungu nimekuwa hivi nilivyo na neema yake kwangu haikuwa kitu bure. Bali nilizidi sana kufanya kazi kuliko mitume wote, lakini haikuwa mimi, bali ni ile neema ya Mungu iliyokuwa pamoja nami.

english: Whether, then, it was I or they, this is what we preach, and this is what you believed. The Resurrection of the Dead
ekegusii: Gaki onye ninche, gose mbaria, naboigo tokorandia, naboigo mwegenete. Okobokigwa kw’abakuure
swahili: Hivyo basi, kama ilikuwa mimi au wao, hili ndilo tunalohubiri, na hili ndilo mliloamini. Ufufuo Wa Wafu

english: But if it is preached that Christ has been raised from the dead, how can some of you say that there is no resurrection of the dead?
ekegusii: Bono onye Kristo orandiigwe ase more buna nabogetigwe korwa ase abakuure, naki rende abande ase more bagoteeba ng’a kobokigwa kw’abakuure tikori?
swahili: Basi kama tumehubiri ya kwamba Kristo alifufuliwa kutoka kwa wafu, mbona baadhi yenu mnasema hakuna ufufuo wa wafu?

english: If there is no resurrection of the dead, then not even Christ has been raised.
ekegusii: Korende onye okobokigwa kw’abakuure tikori, rirorio Kristo nere tabogetigwe.
swahili: Lakini kama hakuna ufufuo wa wafu, basi hata Kristo hakufufuliwa.

english: And if Christ has not been raised, our preaching is worthless, and so is your faith.
ekegusii: Naende onye Kristo tabogetigwe, rirorio okorandia gwaito nokwa bosa, na okwegena kwaino nokwa bosa.
swahili: Tena ikiwa Kristo hakufufuliwa kutoka kwa wafu, kuhubiri kwetu kumekuwa ni bure na imani yenu ni batili.

english: In that case, we are also exposed as false witnesses about God. For we have testified about God that He raised Christ from the dead, but He did not raise Him if in fact the dead are not raised.
ekegusii: Ee, naintwe rirorio twarorekanire koba birori b’oborimo ba Nyasae, ekiagera twateebete ng’a Nyasae nigo abogetie Kristo, oyo rirorio tamobogetie, onye abakuure tibakobokigwa.
swahili: Zaidi ya hayo, twaonekana kuwa mashahidi wa uongo kuhusu Mungu, kwa sababu tumeshuhudia kumhusu Mungu kwamba alimfufua Kristo kutoka kwa wafu, lakini hilo haliwezi kuwa kweli kama wafu hawafufuliwi.

english: For if the dead are not raised, then not even Christ has been raised.
ekegusii: Naki onye abakuure tibakobokigwa, rirorio Kristo nere tabogetigwe.
swahili: Kwa kuwa kama wafu hawafufuliwi, basi hata Kristo hajafufuka.

english: And if Christ has not been raised, your faith is futile; you are still in your sins.
ekegusii: Na onye Kristo tabogetigwe, okwegena kwaino nokwa bosa; nigo more nonya mbono ase ebibe biaino.
swahili: Tena kama Kristo hajafufuliwa, imani yenu ni batili; nanyi bado mko katika dhambi zenu.

english: Then those also who have fallen asleep in Christ have perished.
ekegusii: Naende nabwo bakwete ase Kristo basirire.
swahili: Hivyo basi, wote waliolala katika Kristo wamepotea.

english: If our hope in Christ is for this life alone, we are to be pitied more than all men. The Order of Resurrection
ekegusii: Onye nase obogima obo bwoka tosemeretie Kristo, rirorio intwe nabataka tore kobua abanto bonsi.
swahili: Ikiwa tumaini letu ndani ya Kristo ni kwa ajili ya maisha haya tu, sisi tunastahili kuhurumiwa kuliko watu wote.

english: By this gospel you are saved, if you hold firmly to the word I preached to you. Otherwise, you have believed in vain.
ekegusii: na ase eyio mwatoorigwe, onye mwabwatire mono amang’ana nabaranderetie. Onye taibo, rirorio nigo mwegenete bosa.
swahili: Kwa Injili hii mnaokolewa mkishikilia kwa uthabiti neno nililowahubiria ninyi. La sivyo, mmeamini katika ubatili.

english: But Christ has indeed been raised from the dead, the firstfruits of those who have fallen asleep.
ekegusii: Korende bono nekeene ng’a Kristo obokiigwe korwa ase abakuure buna ogotongorwa kw’abakuure.
swahili: Lakini kweli Kristo amefufuliwa kutoka kwa wafu, tunda la kwanza la wale wote waliolala.

english: For since death came through a man, the resurrection of the dead comes also through a man.
ekegusii: Naki buna amakweri arentetwe nomonto, naboigo nokobokigwa kw’abakuure kwarentirwe nomonto.
swahili: Kwa maana kama vile mauti ilivyokuja kwa njia ya mtu mmoja, vivyo hivyo, ufufuo wa wafu umekuja kwa njia ya mtu mmoja.

english: For as in Adam all die, so in Christ all will be made alive.
ekegusii: Ekiagera buna ase Adamu bonsi bagokwa, naboigo nase Kristo bonsi nababe moyo,
swahili: Kwa maana kama vile katika Adamu watu wote wanakufa, vivyo hivyo katika Kristo wote watafanywa hai.

english: But each in his own turn: Christ the firstfruits; then at His coming, those who belong to Him.
ekegusii: korende kera oyomo aase aye; Kristo agatongora, naende ekero arachiche, abare abaye nababe moyo.
swahili: Lakini kila mmoja kwa wakati wake: Kristo, tunda la kwanza kisha, wale walio wake, wakati atakapokuja.

english: Then the end will come, when He hands over the kingdom to God the Father after He has destroyed all dominion, authority, and power.
ekegusii: Erio agwo omoerio ochiche, ekero arae Nyasae Tata oborwoti, magega gasaririe kera obogambi na kera okobua ne chinguru.
swahili: Ndipo mwisho utafika, wakati atakapomkabidhi Mungu Baba ufalme, akiisha angamiza kila utawala na kila mamlaka na nguvu.

english: For He must reign until He has put all His enemies under His feet.
ekegusii: Naki negwenerete ere agambe, goika abeeke ababisa bonsi inse ase amagoro aye.
swahili: Kwa maana lazima Kristo atawale mpaka awe amewaweka adui zake wote chini ya miguu yake.

english: The last enemy to be destroyed is death.
ekegusii: Omobisa bw’omoerio orasirigwe namakweri.
swahili: Adui wa mwisho atakayeangamizwa ni mauti.

english: For “God has put everything under His feet.” Now when it says that everything has been put under Him, this clearly does not include the One who put everything under Him.
ekegusii: “Naki Nyasae obekire ebinto bionsi inse ase amagoro aye.” Korende ekero agoteeba, “Bionsi biabekirwe inse asare”, nigo amanyekanete ng’a Nyasae, oyobegete ebinto bionsi inse asare, tabariri ase ebinto ebio.
swahili: Kwa maana Mungu “ameweka vitu vyote chini ya miguu yake.” Lakini isemapo kwamba “vitu vyote” vimewekwa chini yake, ni wazi kwamba Mungu aliyetiisha vitu vyote chini ya Kristo hayumo miongoni mwa hivyo vilivyotiishwa.

english: And when all things have been subjected to Him, then the Son Himself will be made subject to Him who put all things under Him, so that God may be all in all.
ekegusii: Gaki ebinto bionsi kobiabekirwe inse asare, erio agwo Omwana omonyene nere nabekwe inse ase Nyasae, oyo obegete ebinto bionsi inse asare, erinde Nyasae abe nokobua ase bionsi.
swahili: Atakapokuwa amekwisha kuyafanya haya, ndipo Mwana mwenyewe atatiishwa chini yake yeye aliyetiisha vitu vyote, ili Mungu awe yote katika yote.

english: If these things are not so, what will those do who are baptized for the dead? If the dead are not raised at all, why are people baptized for them?
ekegusii: Inee! Aba bakobatiswa ase engencho y’abakuure, naki rende bagokora? Onye abakuure tibakoboka nonya ng’ake, nase ki bakobatiswa ase engencho yabo?
swahili: Basi kama hakuna ufufuo, watafanyaje wale wabatizwao kwa ajili ya wafu? Kama wafu hawafufuliwi kamwe, mbona watu wanabatizwa kwa ajili yao?

english: For what I received I passed on to you as of first importance: that Christ died for our sins according to the Scriptures,
ekegusii: Naki ritang’ani nabarenterete amang’ana aya nanyorete inche omonyene, ng’a Kristo nigo akwete ase engencho y’ebibe biaito, buna amariiko agoteeba;
swahili: Kwa maana yale niliyopokea ndiyo niliyowapa ninyi, kama yenye umuhimu wa kwanza: Kwamba Kristo alikufa kwa ajili ya dhambi zetu, kama yasemavyo Maandiko,

english: And why do we endanger ourselves every hour?
ekegusii: Nase ki tore nemechando kera engaki?
swahili: Nasi kwa upande wetu kwa nini tunajihatarisha kila saa?

english: I face death every day, brothers, as surely as I boast about you in Christ Jesus our Lord.
ekegusii: Ekeene baminto, ase ogwetogia kwane inde nakwo ase more ase Kristo Yeso Omonene oito, nigo ngokwa kera rituko.
swahili: Kama majivuno yangu kwa ajili yenu katika Kristo Yesu Bwana wetu ni kweli, ndugu zangu, ninakufa kila siku.

english: If I fought wild beasts in Ephesus for human motives, what did I gain? If the dead are not raised, “Let us eat and drink, for tomorrow we die.”
ekegusii: Onye, nase engencho ya Mwanyabaanto, nkarwana ne ching’iti chintindi aaria Efeso, inki erangwenere? Onye abakuure tibakoboka, “Tiga torie na konywa, ekiagera ankio natokwe.”
swahili: Kama kwa sababu za kibinadamu tu nilipigana na wanyama wakali huko Efeso, ningekuwa nimepata faida gani? Kama wafu hawafufuliwi, “Tuleni na kunywa, kwa kuwa kesho tutakufa.”

english: Do not be deceived: “Bad company corrupts good character.”
ekegusii: Timong’aineka! Egosori embe nigo egosaria chingencho chingiya.
swahili: Msidanganyike: “Ushirika na watu wabaya huharibu tabia njema.”

english: Sober up as you ought, and stop sinning; for some of you are ignorant of God. I say this to your shame. The Resurrection Body
ekegusii: Boka buna egwenerete ase oboronge, timokora ebibe naende. Naki abande tibamomanyeti Nyasae. Natebiire aya ase okobasookia. Omobere bwo’kobokigwa
swahili: Zindukeni mwe na akili kama iwapasavyo, wala msitende dhambi tena; kwa maana watu wengine hawamjui Mungu. Nasema mambo haya ili mwone aibu. Mwili Wa Ufufuo

english: But someone will ask, “How are the dead raised? With what kind of body will they come?”
ekegusii: Korende omonto naborie, “Naki abakuure baraboke? Naende mobere ki barache noro?”
swahili: Lakini mtu anaweza kuuliza, “Wafu wafufuliwaje? Watakuwa na mwili wa namna gani?”

english: You fool! What you sow does not come to life unless it dies.
ekegusii: Omoriri oyo, eke ogosimeka aye, tikeri komera getakweti.
swahili: Ninyi wapumbavu kiasi gani? Mpandacho hakiwi hai kama hakikufa.

english: And what you sow is not the body that will be, but just a seed, perhaps of wheat or something else.
ekegusii: Neke ogosimeka, tori gosimeka egento keria kegocha koba, korende embusuro yoka; onye nengano gose mbusuro ende yonsi.
swahili: Mpandapo, hampandi mwili ule utakao kuwa, bali mwapanda mbegu tu, pengine ya ngano au ya kitu kingine.

english: But God gives it a body as He has designed, and to each kind of seed He gives its own body.
ekegusii: Korende Nyasae ayea ekieni buna anchete, na kera embusuro ayea ekieni kiaye.
swahili: Lakini Mungu huipa mbegu umbo kama alivyokusudia mwenyewe na kila aina ya mbegu huipa umbo lake.

english: Not all flesh is the same: Men have one kind of flesh, animals have another, birds another, and fish another.
ekegusii: Chinyama chionsi tichiri echimo; korende echinde nechia Mwanyabaanto, echinde nechie ching’iti, echinde nechie chinyoni, na echinde nechie chinswe.
swahili: Kwa maana nyama zote si za aina moja. Binadamu wana nyama ya aina moja, wanyama wana aina nyingine, kadhalika ndege na samaki wana nyama tofauti.

english: that He was buried, that He was raised on the third day according to the Scriptures,
ekegusii: naende agatindekwa, erio akaboka rituko ria gatato, buna amariiko agoteeba;
swahili: ya kuwa alizikwa na alifufuliwa siku ya tatu, kama yasemavyo Maandiko,

english: There are also heavenly bodies and earthly bodies. But the splendor of the heavenly bodies is of one degree, and the splendor of the earthly bodies is of another.
ekegusii: Naende mbire igoro ebitongwa bitongire, na mbire ase ense ebitongwa bitongire, korende obonene bw’ebia igoro nigo bore ao, na obonene bw’ebia nse nigo bore ao.
swahili: Pia kuna miili ya mbinguni na miili ya duniani, lakini fahari wa ile miili ya mbinguni ni wa aina moja na fahari wa ile miili ya duniani ni wa aina nyingine.

english: The sun has one degree of splendor, the moon another, and the stars another; and star differs from star in splendor.
ekegusii: Obonene bw’erioba nigo bore ao, na obonene bw’omotienyi nigo bore ao, na obonene bwe ching’enang’eni nigo bore ao, naende ogwatananekana nkore ase egati ye ching’enang’eni chinyene ase obonene.
swahili: Jua lina fahari ya aina moja, mwezi nao una fahari yake na nyota pia, nazo nyota hutofautiana katika fahari.

english: So will it be with the resurrection of the dead: What is sown is perishable; it is raised imperishable.
ekegusii: Naboigo nokobokigwa kw’abakuure. Osimekwa ase ogosareka, obokigwa ase ogotasareka.
swahili: Hivyo ndivyo itakavyokuwa wakati wa ufufuo wa wafu. Ule mwili wa kuharibika uliopandwa, utafufuliwa usioharibika,

english: It is sown in dishonor; it is raised in glory. It is sown in weakness; it is raised in power.
ekegusii: Osimekwa ase obosooku, obokigwa ase obonene; osimekwa ase oboreu, obokigwa ase chinguru.
swahili: unapandwa katika aibu, unafufuliwa katika utukufu, unapandwa katika udhaifu, unafufuliwa katika nguvu,

english: It is sown a natural body; it is raised a spiritual body. If there is a natural body, there is also a spiritual body.
ekegusii: Omobere o Mwanyabaanto osimekwa, korende omobere bw’omoika obokigwa. Onye omobere o Mwanyabaanto oreo, naboigo noyo bw’omoika noreo.
swahili: unapandwa mwili wa asili, unafufuliwa mwili wa kiroho. Kama kuna mwili wa asili, basi kuna mwili wa kiroho pia.

english: So it is written: “The first man Adam became a living being;” the last Adam a life-giving spirit.
ekegusii: Naboigo eriikire, “Omonto bw’eritang’ani Adamu akaba omonto ore moyo”, Adamu bw’omoerio akaba omoika bw’okoa obogima.
swahili: Kwa hiyo imeandikwa, “Mtu wa kwanza Adamu alifanyika kiumbe hai”; Adamu wa mwisho, yeye ni roho iletayo uzima.

english: The spiritual, however, was not first, but the natural, and then the spiritual.
ekegusii: Korende oria orenge bw’omoika, tari oro orenge bw’eritang’ani, korende noria bw’omobere o Mwanyabaanto orenge bw’eritang’ani; magega y’ayio oria bw’omoika.
swahili: Lakini si ule wa kiroho uliotangulia, bali ni ule wa asili, kisha ule wa kiroho.

english: The first man was of the dust of the earth, the second man from heaven.
ekegusii: Omonto bw’eritang’ani akarwa inse, agatongwa korwa ase amaroba; omonto o kabere akarwa igoro.
swahili: Mtu wa kwanza aliumbwa kwa mavumbi ya ardhini, mtu wa pili alitoka mbinguni.

english: As was the earthly man, so also are those who are of the earth; and as is the heavenly man, so also are those who are of heaven.
ekegusii: Buna omonto oyo bw’amaroba arenge, naboigo nab’amaroba bare; na buna omonto o igoro are, naboigo naba igoro bare.
swahili: Kama vile alivyokuwa yule wa ardhini, ndivyo walivyo wale walio wa ardhini; na kwa vile alivyo mtu yule aliyetoka mbinguni, ndivyo walivyo wale walio wa mbinguni.

english: And just as we have borne the likeness of the earthly man, so also shall we bear the likeness of the heavenly man. Where, O Death, Is Your Victory? (Hosea 13:9–14)
ekegusii: Na buna tobogoretie ekieni ki’oria bw’amaroba, naboigo torabogorie ekieni ki’oria o igoro.
swahili: Kama vile tulivyochukua mfano wa mtu wa ardhini, ndivyo tutakavyochukua mfano wa yule mtu aliyetoka mbinguni.

english: and that He appeared to Cephas and then to the Twelve.
ekegusii: naende akaorokera Kefa; naende na baria ikomi na babere.
swahili: na kwamba alimtokea Kefa, kisha akawatokea wale kumi na wawili.

english: Now I declare to you, brothers, that flesh and blood cannot inherit the kingdom of God, nor does the perishable inherit the imperishable.
ekegusii: Abaminto, aya nkobateebia naya, ng’a omobere na amanyinga tibikonyora omwando bw’oborwoti bwa Nyasae; gose ogosareka tigokonyora omwando bw’ogotasareka.
swahili: Ndugu zangu nisemalo ni hili: nyama na damu haviwezi kuurithi ufalme wa Mungu, wala kuharibika kurithi kutokuharibika.

english: Listen, I tell you a mystery: We will not all sleep, but we will all be changed—
ekegusii: Rigereria, aya nkobateebia nobobisi. Titogokwa intwe twensi, korende twensi natoonchorwe,
swahili: Sikilizeni, nawaambia siri: Sote hatutalala, lakini sote tutabadilishwa

english: in an instant, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trumpet. For the trumpet will sound, the dead will be raised imperishable, and we will be changed.
ekegusii: ase ekero egesinini, okomiamia na okoramokia, ekero ki’egetureeri ki’omoerio. Naki egetureeri nakebuge, na abakuure nababokigwe, tibaaba nogosareka, na intwe natoonchorwe.
swahili: ghafula, kufumba na kufumbua, parapanda ya mwisho itakapolia. Kwa kuwa parapanda italia, nao wafu watafufuliwa na miili isiyoharibika, nasi tutabadilishwa.

english: For the perishable must be clothed with the imperishable, and the mortal with immortality.
ekegusii: Naki ogosareka kwagweneire koboigwe ogotasareka, na ogokwa koboigwe ogotakwa.
swahili: Kwa maana mwili huu wa kuharibika lazima uvae kutokuharibika, nao huu wa kufa lazima uvae kutokufa.

english: When the perishable has been clothed with the imperishable and the mortal with immortality, then the saying that is written will come to pass: “Death has been swallowed up in victory.”
ekegusii: Ekero oyo bw’ogosareka oranyore ogotasareka, na oyo bw’ogokwa oranyore ogotakwa; erio naribe ring’ana riria ririikire, “Amakweri amerirwe ase okobua.”
swahili: Kwa hiyo, mwili huu wa kuharibika utakapovaa kutokuharibika, nao huu mwili wa kufa utakapovaa kutokufa, ndipo lile neno lililoandikwa litakapotimia: “Mauti imemezwa kwa kushinda.”

english: “Where, O Death, is your victory? Where, O Death, is your sting?”
ekegusii: “Amakweri, ng’ai okobua kwao kore? Amakweri, ng’ai obororo bwao bore?”
swahili: “Kuko wapi, ee mauti, kushinda kwako? Uko wapi, ee mauti, uchungu wako?”

english: The sting of death is sin, and the power of sin is the law.
ekegusii: Obororo bw’amakweri nebibe, ne chinguru chi’ebibe namachiiko.
swahili: Uchungu wa mauti ni dhambi na nguvu ya dhambi ni sheria.

english: But thanks be to God, who gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ!
ekegusii: Korende mbuya mono ase Nyasae, ere oyogotoa okobua goetera ase Omonene oito Yeso Kristo.
swahili: Lakini ashukuriwe Mungu, yeye atupaye ushindi kwa njia ya Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo.

english: Therefore, my beloved brothers, be steadfast and immovable. Always excel in the work of the Lord, because you know that your labor in the Lord is not in vain.
ekegusii: Gaki baminto, abanchwa, mobe ne chinguru, motari gotengechigwa, momente mono gokora emeremo y’Omonene ase amatuko onsi, momanye ng’a emeremo yaino ase Omonene teri bosa.
swahili: Kwa hiyo, ndugu zangu wapenzi, simameni imara, msitikisike, mzidi sana katika kuitenda kazi ya Bwana, kwa maana mnajua ya kuwa, kazi yenu katika Bwana si bure.

english: After that, He appeared to more than five hundred brothers at once, most of whom are still living, though some have fallen asleep.
ekegusii: Magega akaorokera abaminto goetania amagana atano amo. Abange ase abwo moyo bare nonya mbono, abande bakuure.
swahili: Baadaye akawatokea wale ndugu waumini zaidi ya 500 kwa pamoja, ambao wengi wao bado wako hai, ingawa wengine wamelala.

english: Then He appeared to James, then to all the apostles.
ekegusii: Magega y’ayio akaorokera Yakobo, erio abatomwa bonsi.
swahili: Ndipo akamtokea Yakobo na kisha mitume wote.

english: And last of all He appeared to me also, as to one of untimely birth.
ekegusii: Na omoerio akang’orokera nainche. Inche nigo inde buna oyoiboretwe ase ekero getare boronge.
swahili: Mwisho wa wote, akanitokea mimi pia, ambaye ni kama aliyezaliwa si kwa wakati wake.

english: For I am the least of the apostles and am unworthy to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the church of God.
ekegusii: Naki inche nomoke ase abatomwa, ntagwenereti korokwa omotomwa, ekiagera nachandete ekanisa ya Nyasae.
swahili: Kwa maana mimi ndiye mdogo kuliko mitume wote, nisiyestahili kuitwa mtume, kwa sababu nililitesa kanisa la Mungu.

english: Now about the collection for the saints, you are to do as I directed the churches of Galatia:
ekegusii: Bono ase amang’ana y’ogosangererigwa kw’ebiegwa ase abachenu, buna nachiigete abanto be chikanisa chia Galatia, nainwe mokore boigo.
swahili: Basi kuhusu changizo kwa ajili ya watakatifu: Kama nilivyoyaagiza makanisa ya Galatia, fanyeni vivyo hivyo.

english: If Timothy comes, see to it that he has nothing to fear while he is with you, for he is doing the work of the Lord, just as I am.
ekegusii: Ekero Timotheo arache, rigereria ng’a amenye amo nainwe atari nobwoba, ekiagera nigo agokora emeremo y’Omonene buna inche.
swahili: Ikiwa Timotheo atakuja kwenu, hakikisheni kwamba hana hofu yoyote akiwa nanyi, kwa sababu anafanya kazi ya Bwana, kama mimi nifanyavyo.

english: No one, then, should treat him with contempt. Send him on his way in peace so that he can return to me, for I am expecting him along with the brothers.
ekegusii: Gaki monto onde tamochaya, korende momokoobe ase omorembe, erinde airane ase ’nde, ekiagera nimoganyete amo nabaminto.
swahili: Basi asiwepo mtu atakayekataa kumpokea. Msafirisheni kwa amani ili aweze kunijia tena. Namtarajia pamoja na ndugu.

english: Now about our brother Apollos: I strongly urged him to go to you with the brothers. He was not at all inclined to go now, but he will go when he has the opportunity. Concluding Exhortations
ekegusii: Korende ase amang’ana ’Apolo oyominto, nigo namosorora mono achiche ase more amo nabwo baminto bande, korende ere tarigeti gocha bono. Nachiche karanyore ribaga.
swahili: Basi kwa habari za ndugu yetu Apolo, nimemsihi kwa bidii aje kwenu pamoja na hao ndugu. Ingawa alikuwa hapendi kabisa kuja sasa, lakini atakuja apatapo nafasi. Maneno Ya Mwisho

english: Be on the alert. Stand firm in the faith. Be men of courage. Be strong.
ekegusii: Renda, motenene bokong’u ase okwegena kwaino, mobe abasacha, mobe ne chinguru.
swahili: Kesheni, simameni imara katika imani, fanyeni kiume, kuweni mashujaa kuweni hodari.

english: Do everything in love.
ekegusii: Amang’ana aino onsi akoreke ase obwanchani.
swahili: Fanyeni kila kitu katika upendo.

english: You know that Stephanas and his household were the first converts in Achaia, and they have devoted themselves to the service of the saints. Now I urge you, brothers,
ekegusii: Bono baminto, mwamanyire ng’a abanto ba nyomba mwa Stefana nigo barenge ab’eritang’ani koonchoka agwo Akaya; na barabwo bebekire ase emeremo y’ogokorera abachenu.
swahili: Ninyi mnajua kwamba watu wa nyumbani mwa Stefana ndio waliokuwa wa kwanza kuamini katika Akaya, nao wamejitoa kwa ajili ya kuwahudumia watakatifu. Ndugu nawasihi,

english: to submit to such as these, and to every fellow worker and laborer.
ekegusii: Nabasoroire baigwere abanto buna aba, na kera omonto oyogokora emeremo amo nabarabwo ase ogwechanda.
swahili: mjitie katika kuwahudumia watu kama hawa na kila mmoja aingiaye kwenye kazi na kuifanya kwa bidii.

english: I am glad that Stephanas, Fortunatus, and Achaicus have arrived, because they have supplied what was lacking from you.
ekegusii: Inche nagokire ase ogocha gwa Stefana na Fortunato, na Akaiko, ekiagera bamentete amange aya naremeire korwa ase more.
swahili: Nilifurahi wakati Stefana, Fortunato na Akaiko walipofika, kwa sababu wamenipatia yale niliyopungukiwa kutoka kwenu.

english: For they refreshed my spirit and yours as well. Show your appreciation, therefore, to such men. Signature and Final Greetings (Colossians 4:15–18; 2 Thessalonians 3:16–18)
ekegusii: Naki mbansasogetie ase omoika one, na emeika yaino yonsi. Gaki bainyore mono abanto buna abwo.
swahili: Kwa kuwa waliiburudisha roho yangu na zenu pia. Watu kama hawa wanastahili kutambuliwa. Salamu Za Mwisho

english: The churches in the province of Asia send you greetings. Aquila and Prisca greet you warmly in the Lord, and so does the church that meets at their house.
ekegusii: Abanto be chikanisa chi’Asia baabakwanirie. Akwila na Priskila baabakwanirie mono ase Omonene, amo n’ekanisa ere ime ase enyomba yabo.
swahili: Makanisa ya Asia yanawasalimu. Akila na Prisila, pamoja na kanisa lililoko nyumbani kwao wanawasalimu sana katika Bwana.

english: On the first day of every week, each of you should set aside a portion of his income, saving it up, so that when I come no collections will be needed.
ekegusii: Ase kera rituko rie ritang’ani ri’echuma, kera oyomo ase more abe okogaacha mwaye ensemo ase eki anyorire, koreng’ana buna aranyare, erinde ebiegwa tibisangererigwa ekero nachire.
swahili: Siku ya kwanza ya kila juma, kila mmoja wenu atenge kiasi cha fedha, kulingana na mapato yake na fedha hizo aziweke akiba, ili nitakapokuja pasiwe na lazima ya kufanya mchango.

english: All the brothers here send you greetings. Greet one another with a holy kiss.
ekegusii: Abaminto bonsi baabakwanirie. Kwanania na konyunyuntana ase obochenu.
swahili: Ndugu wote walioko hapa wanawasalimu. Salimianeni kwa busu takatifu.

english: This greeting is in my own hand—Paul.
ekegusii: Oko nogokwania kwane inche Paulo ase okoboko kwane omonyene.
swahili: Mimi, Paulo, naandika salamu hizi kwa mkono wangu mwenyewe.

english: If anyone does not love the Lord, let him be under a curse. Come, O Lord!
ekegusii: Monto onde bwensi otamwancheti Omonene nabe oragererigwe. Inchuo, Omonene oito!
swahili: Kama mtu yeyote hampendi Bwana Yesu Kristo, na alaaniwe. Bwana wetu, njoo.

english: The grace of the Lord Jesus be with you.
ekegusii: Obuya bw’Omonene Yeso bobe amo nainwe.
swahili: Neema ya Bwana Yesu iwe nanyi.

english: My love be with all of you in Christ Jesus. Amen.
ekegusii: Obwanchani bwane bobe amo nainwe mwensi ase Kristo Yeso. Amina.
swahili: Upendo wangu uwe nanyi nyote katika Kristo Yesu. Amen.

english: Then, on my arrival, I will send letters with those you recommend to carry your gift to Jerusalem.
ekegusii: Inche kondaike nimbatome ne riruube aba morachore, baire ebiegwa biaino goika Yerusalemu.
swahili: Kwa hiyo nitakapowasili, nitawapa wale mtakaowachagua barua za kuwatambulisha, ili kuwatuma wapeleke zawadi zenu huko Yerusalemu.

english: And if it is advisable for me to go also, they can travel with me. Paul’s Travel Plans (Romans 15:23–33)
ekegusii: Onye ngwenerete ngende inche, rirorio nabagende amo nainche. Emeroberio yokogenda
swahili: Kama ikionekana ni vyema na mimi niende, basi hao watu watafuatana nami. Mahitaji Binafsi

english: After I go through Macedonia, however, I will come to you; for I will be going through Macedonia.
ekegusii: Korende ninchiche ase more, magega konaetire egati ya Makedonia, ekiagera nindengereretie goeta egati ya Makedonia.
swahili: Baada ya kupitia Makedonia nitakuja kwenu, maana ninakusudia kupitia Makedonia.

english: Perhaps I will stay with you awhile, or even spend the winter, so that you can help me on my journey, wherever I go.
ekegusii: Aande gose nimenye amo nainwe, gose nimenye seino ekero gi’etoigo, monyare gonkooba ekero kende gionsi aase ndigetie kogenda.
swahili: Huenda nitakaa nanyi kwa muda, au hata kukaa nanyi kipindi chote cha baridi, ili mweze kunisaidia katika safari yangu, popote niendapo.

english: For I do not want to see you now only in passing; I hope to spend some time with you, if the Lord permits.
ekegusii: Naki tindigeti kororana nainwe ase ogoeta gwoka, ekiagera ninganetie komenya seino egeka getari geke, Omonene karanche.
swahili: Kwa maana sitaki niwaone sasa na kupita tu; natarajia kuwa nanyi kwa muda wa kutosha, kama Bwana akipenda.

english: But I will stay in Ephesus until Pentecost,
ekegusii: Bono nimenye ase Efeso goika rituko rinene ria Pentekosti;
swahili: Lakini nitakaa Efeso mpaka wakati wa Pentekoste,

english: because a great door for effective work has opened to me, even though many oppose me. Timothy and Apollos (Philippians 2:19–30)
ekegusii: naki naigoreirwe egesieri ekegare keraarente okwama, korende abange mbareo bakong’amereria.
swahili: kwa maana mlango mkubwa umefunguliwa kwangu kufanya kazi yenye matunda, nako huko kuna adui wengi wanaonipinga.

english: Paul, called to be an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, and our brother Sosthenes,
ekegusii: Inche Paulo narangeretigwe koba omotomwa o Kristo Yeso ase ogwancha kwa Nyasae. Inche amo noyominto Sostene
swahili: Paulo, niliyeitwa kwa mapenzi ya Mungu kuwa mtume wa Kristo Yesu, na Sosthene ndugu yetu.

english: I appeal to you, brothers, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that all of you agree together, so that there may be no divisions among you and that you may be united in mind and conviction.
ekegusii: Nabasoroire inwe, baminto, ase erieta ri’Omonene oito Yeso Kristo, mokwane mwensi ayamo, erinde ogwatananeka tikoba ase more; korende mobe nokobwatana ase ebirengererio ebimo na okogamba okomo.
swahili: Nawasihi ndugu zangu, katika Jina la Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo, kwamba mpatane nia zenu ninyi kwa ninyi, ili pasiwepo na matengano katikati yenu na kwamba mwe na umoja kikamilifu katika nia na katika kusudi.

english: My brothers, some from Chloe’s household have informed me that there are quarrels among you.
ekegusii: Naki baminto, nateebigwe nabaanto ba nyomba mwa Kiloe, ng’a eriomana ndire ase egati yaino.
swahili: Ndugu zangu, nimepata habari kutoka kwa baadhi ya watu wa nyumbani mwa Kloe kwamba kuna magomvi katikati yenu.

english: What I mean is this: Individuals among you are saying, “I follow Paul,” “I follow Apollos,” “I follow Cephas,” or “I follow Christ.”
ekegusii: Engencho yagera nakwana bo neye, ng’a oyomo ore ase egati yaino nigo agoteeba, “Inche noyo o Paulo,” na oyonde, “Inche noyo bw’Apolo,” na oyonde, “Inche noyo o Kefa,” na oyonde, “Inche noyo o Kristo.”
swahili: Maana yangu ni kwamba: Mmoja wenu husema, “Mimi ni wa Paulo”; mwingine, “Mimi ni wa Apolo”; mwingine, “Mimi ni wa Kefa,” na mwingine, “Mimi ni wa Kristo.”

english: Is Christ divided? Was Paul crucified for you? Were you baptized into the name of Paul?
ekegusii: Inee! Kristo naatananekire? Gose Paulo nere obambetwe ase engencho yaino? Gose igo mwabatisetwe koba aborokigwa ba Paulo?
swahili: Je, Kristo amegawanyika? Je, Paulo ndiye alisulubishwa kwa ajili yenu? Je, mlibatizwa kwa jina la Paulo?

english: I thank God that I did not baptize any of you except Crispus and Gaius,
ekegusii: Namoakeire Nyasae ng’a mbuya mono, ase engencho ntabatisete monto onde, ase more otatiga Krispo na Gayo,
swahili: Nashukuru kwamba sikumbatiza mtu yeyote isipokuwa Krispo na Gayo.

english: so no one can say that you were baptized into my name.
ekegusii: erinde onde tacha goteeba ng’a mwabatisetwe ase erieta riane.
swahili: Kwa hiyo hakuna mtu yeyote anayeweza kusema kwamba alibatizwa kwa jina langu.

english: Yes, I also baptized the household of Stephanas; beyond that I do not remember if I baptized anyone else.
ekegusii: (Naende nkabatisa abanto ba nyomba mwa Stefana. Kobua ase abwo, tinkomanya gose nabatisete monto onde.)
swahili: (Naam, niliwabatiza pia watu wa nyumbani mwa Stefana. Lakini zaidi ya hao sijui kama nilimbatiza mtu mwingine yeyote.)

english: For Christ did not send me to baptize, but to preach the gospel, not with words of wisdom, lest the cross of Christ be emptied of its power. The Message of the Cross
ekegusii: Naki Kristo tantomete ng’a mbatise, korende ndandie enchiri, tari ase obong’aini bw’amang’ana, erinde ogokwa kwa Yeso Kristo ase omosalaba tikourwa chinguru chiaye. Kristo Chinguru nobong’aini bwa Nyasae
swahili: Kwa maana Kristo hakunituma ili kubatiza bali kuhubiri Injili; sio kwa maneno ya hekima ya kibinadamu, ili msalaba wa Kristo usije ukakosa nguvu yake. Kristo Ni Hekima Na Nguvu Ya Mungu

english: For the message of the cross is foolishness to those who are perishing, but to us who are being saved it is the power of God.
ekegusii: Naki ring’ana ri’ogokwa kwa Yeso ase omosalaba noboriri ase abwo bagosira, korende ase tore intwe abatwabeire togotoorigwa nigo rire chinguru chia Nyasae.
swahili: Kwa maana ujumbe wa msalaba kwa wale wanaopotea ni upuzi, lakini kwetu sisi tunaookolewa ni nguvu ya Mungu.

english: For it is written: “I will destroy the wisdom of the wise; the intelligence of the intelligent I will frustrate.”
ekegusii: Naki neriikire, “Ninsarie obong’aini bw’abang’aini, na okomanya kw’abamanyi ninkwange.”
swahili: Kwa maana imeandikwa: “Nitaiharibu hekima ya wenye hekima, na kubatilisha akili ya wenye akili.”

english: To the church of God in Corinth, to those sanctified in Christ Jesus and called to be holy, together with all those everywhere who call on the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, their Lord and ours:
ekegusii: nkobariikera tore inwe abekanisa ya Nyasae ere ase Korinto, inwe abamwachenirwe ase Kristo Yeso, abamwarangerigwe koba abachenu amo na bonsi abakorangeria erieta ri’Omonene oito Yeso Kristo kera aase, nere Omonene obo na oyoito.
swahili: Kwa kanisa la Mungu lililoko Korintho, kwa wale waliotakaswa katika Kristo Yesu na walioitwa kuwa watakatifu, pamoja na wale wote ambao kila mahali wanaliitia Jina la Kristo Yesu Bwana wetu, aliye Bwana wao na wetu pia:

english: Where is the wise man? Where is the scribe? Where is the philosopher of this age? Has not God made foolish the wisdom of the world?
ekegusii: Ng’ai are omong’aini? Ng’ai are omworokia bw’amariiko? Ng’ai are oyokoamererania namang’ana ’ense eye? Inee! Nyasae takorete obong’aini bw’ense eye koba oboriri?
swahili: Yuko wapi mwenye hekima? Yuko wapi msomi? Yuko wapi mwanafalsafa wa nyakati hizi? Je, Mungu hakufanya hekima ya ulimwengu huu kuwa upumbavu?

english: For since in the wisdom of God the world through its wisdom did not know Him, God was pleased through the foolishness of what was preached to save those who believe.
ekegusii: Ekiagera ase obong’aini bwaye Nyasae akaroberia, ng’a ense tekonyara komomanya ase enchera y’obong’aini, agancha kobatooria abamwegenete ase oboriri bw’ering’ana riria rikorandigwa.
swahili: Kwa kuwa katika hekima ya Mungu, ulimwengu kwa hekima yake haukumjua yeye, ilimpendeza Mungu kuwaokoa wale walioamini kwa upuzi wa lile neno lililohubiriwa.

english: Jews demand signs and Greeks search for wisdom,
ekegusii: Abayahudi nigo bakonakoboria barore ebikone, na Abagiriki bakorigia obong’aini,
swahili: Wayahudi wanadai ishara za miujiza na Wayunani wanatafuta hekima.

english: but we preach Christ crucified, a stumbling block to Jews and foolishness to Gentiles,
ekegusii: korende intwe nigo tokomorandia Kristo oyobambetwe, ase Abayahudi nekegocha, na ase abanto b’Ebisaku noboriri.
swahili: Lakini sisi tunamhubiri Kristo aliyesulubiwa: yeye kwa Wayahudi ni kikwazo na kwa Wayunani ni upuzi.

english: but to those who are called, both Jews and Greeks, Christ the power of God and the wisdom of God.
ekegusii: Korende ase abwo barangeretigwe, Abayahudi na Abagiriki bonsi, Kristo nere chinguru chia Nyasae, na obong’aini bwa Nyasae.
swahili: Lakini kwa wale ambao Mungu amewaita, Wayahudi na pia Wayunani, Kristo ndiye nguvu ya Mungu na pia hekima ya Mungu.

english: For the foolishness of God is wiser than man’s wisdom, and the weakness of God is stronger than man’s strength. Wisdom from God
ekegusii: Ekiagera oboriri bwa Nyasae mbore nobong’aini kobua obongaini bwa Mwanyabaanto, na oboreu bwa Nyasae mbore ne chinguru kobua echia Mwanyabaanto.
swahili: Kwa maana upumbavu wa Mungu una hekima zaidi kuliko hekima ya wanadamu, nao udhaifu wa Mungu una nguvu kuliko nguvu ya wanadamu.

english: Brothers, consider the time of your calling: Not many of you were wise by human standards; not many were powerful; not many were of noble birth.
ekegusii: Naki baminto, rengereria nabaanto b’engencho ki more aba Nyasae arangeirie; tari abange ase more bare nobong’aini bwa Mwanyabaanto, tari abange bare ne chinguru, tari abange baiboretwe nobonene.
swahili: Ndugu zangu, kumbukeni mlivyokuwa mlipoitwa. Kwa kipimo cha kibinadamu, si wengi wenu mliokuwa na hekima. Si wengi mliokuwa na ushawishi, si wengi mliozaliwa katika jamaa zenye vyeo.

english: But God chose the foolish things of the world to shame the wise; God chose the weak things of the world to shame the strong.
ekegusii: Korende Nyasae agachora ayare amariri ase ense, erinde asookie abare nobong’aini; naende Nyasae agachora ayare amareu ase ense, erinde abasookie abare ne chinguru.
swahili: Lakini Mungu alivichagua vitu vipumbavu vya ulimwengu ili awaaibishe wenye hekima, Mungu alivichagua vitu dhaifu vya ulimwengu ili awaaibishe wenye nguvu.

english: He chose the lowly and despised things of the world, and the things that are not, to nullify the things that are,
ekegusii: Nyasae agachora ayare amasinini ase ense na ayachayire, nonya n’ebinto bire bosa, erinde akeyie biria bire nengencho, bibe bosa.
swahili: Alivichagua vitu vya chini na vinavyodharauliwa vya dunia hii, vitu ambavyo haviko, ili avibatilishe vile vilivyoko,

english: so that no one may boast in His presence.
ekegusii: Erio ase obosio bwa Nyasae onde tari ase Mwanyabaanto oretogie.
swahili: ili mtu yeyote asijisifu mbele zake.

english: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ. Thanksgiving (Philippians 1:3–11; Colossians 1:3–14)
ekegusii: Obuya na omorembe bibe ase more, ebio bikorwa ase Nyasae Tata oito, na ase Omonene Yeso Kristo. Ogosesenigwa ase Kristo
swahili: Neema na amani itokayo kwa Mungu Baba yetu na kwa Bwana Yesu Kristo iwe nanyi. Shukrani

english: It is because of Him that you are in Christ Jesus, who has become for us wisdom from God: our righteousness, holiness, and redemption.
ekegusii: Korende nogokora kwa Nyasae, ng’a inwe imore ime ase Kristo Yeso, oyo Nyasae akorete koba obong’aini bwaito na oboronge bwaito, naende ogochenwa gwaito na okoboorigwa gwaito.
swahili: Bali kwa yeye ninyi mmepata kuwa katika Kristo Yesu, aliyefanyika kwetu hekima itokayo kwa Mungu, yaani haki, na utakatifu na ukombozi.

english: Therefore, as it is written: “Let him who boasts boast in the Lord.”
ekegusii: Ase igo buna eriikire, “Ere oyogwetogia, tiga etogie ase keria Omonene akorire.”
swahili: Hivyo, kama ilivyoandikwa: “Yeye ajisifuye na ajisifu katika Bwana.”

english: I always thank my God for you because of the grace He has given you in Christ Jesus.
ekegusii: Botambe nigo nkomoakera Nyasae ng’a mbuya mono ase engencho yaino, ase engencho y’obuya bwaye obwo mwaetwe ase Kristo Yeso.
swahili: Ninamshukuru Mungu siku zote kwa ajili yenu kwa sababu ya neema yake mliyopewa katika Kristo Yesu.

english: For in Him you have been enriched in every way, in all speech and all knowledge,
ekegusii: Ase kera enchera mogatenenkigwa ime asare ase chinkwana chionsi, ne chisemi chionsi,
swahili: Kwa kuwa katika Kristo mmetajirishwa kwa kila hali, katika kusema kwenu na katika maarifa yenu yote,

english: because our testimony about Christ was confirmed in you.
ekegusii: buna oborori bwa Kristo bwabekirwe chinguru ase egati yaino.
swahili: kwa sababu ushuhuda wetu kumhusu Kristo ulithibitishwa ndani yenu.

english: Therefore you do not lack any spiritual gift as you eagerly await the revelation of our Lord Jesus Christ.
ekegusii: Na bono timoremeiri keegwa kende gionsi, komoganyete okoorokigwa kw’Omonene oito Yeso Kristo.
swahili: Kwa hiyo hamkupungukiwa na karama yoyote ya kiroho wakati mnangoja kwa shauku kudhihirishwa kwa Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo.

english: He will sustain you to the end, so that you will be blameless on the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.
ekegusii: Nere orabakong’ie goika omoerio, erinde timocha koba nokomocha ase rituko riria ri’Omonene oito Yeso Kristo.
swahili: Atawafanya imara mpaka mwisho, ili msiwe na hatia siku ile ya Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo.

english: God, who has called you into fellowship with His Son Jesus Christ our Lord, is faithful. Unity in the Church (Psalms 133:1–3; Ephesians 4:1–16)
ekegusii: Nyasae nomwegenwa, oyobarangeirie mosoe ase obomo bw’Omwana oye, Yeso Kristo Omonene oito. Ogwatananeka ime ase ekanisa
swahili: Mungu ambaye mmeitwa naye ili mwe na ushirika na Mwanawe Yesu Kristo, Bwana wetu ni mwaminifu. Mgawanyiko Ndani Ya Kanisa

english: When I came to you, brothers, I did not come with eloquence or wisdom as I proclaimed to you the testimony about God.
ekegusii: Inche, ekero nachete ase more, baminto, tinachete kobaranderia oborori bwa Nyasae ase enchera y’obuya bwe chinkwana, gose ase obong’aini.
swahili: Ndugu zangu nilipokuja kwenu, sikuja na maneno ya ushawishi wala hekima ya hali ya juu nilipowahubiria siri ya Mungu.

english: But God has revealed it to us by the Spirit. The Spirit searches all things, even the deep things of God.
ekegusii: Korende Nyasae otoyaorokeirie ase Omoika oye, naki Omoika nigo okorigia onsi, nonya nobobisi bwa Nyasae.
swahili: Lakini mambo haya Mungu ametufunulia kwa Roho wake. Roho huchunguza kila kitu, hata mambo ya ndani sana ya Mungu.

english: For who among men knows the thoughts of man except his own spirit within him? So too, no one knows the thoughts of God except the Spirit of God.
ekegusii: Naki ning’o ore ase Mwanyabaanto omanyete ebirengererio bi’omonto, otatiga omoika bw’omonto ore ime yaye? Naboigo nonde tari omanyete ebirengererio bia Nyasae otatiga Omoika o Nyasae.
swahili: Kwa maana ni nani anayejua mawazo ya mtu isipokuwa roho iliyo ndani ya huyo mtu? Vivyo hivyo hakuna mtu ajuaye mawazo ya Mungu isipokuwa Roho wa Mungu.

english: We have not received the spirit of the world, but the Spirit who is from God, that we may understand what God has freely given us.
ekegusii: Na intwe titwanyorete omoika bw’ense eye, korende Omoika orwete ase Nyasae, erinde tonyare komanya ebiegwa ebitwaeirwe na Nyasae.
swahili: Basi hatukupokea roho ya dunia bali Roho atokaye kwa Mungu, ili tuweze kuelewa kile kipawa ambacho Mungu ametupatia bure.

english: And this is what we speak, not in words taught us by human wisdom, but in words taught by the Spirit, expressing spiritual truths in spiritual words.
ekegusii: Naro nigo tokoyakwana, tari ase amang’ana tworokererigwe ne chisemi chia Mwanyabaanto, korende aya tworokererigwe n’Omoika; igo togokwana amang’ana ’Omoika ase abare n’Omoika.
swahili: Haya ndiyo tusemayo, si kwa maneno tuliyofundishwa kwa hekima ya wanadamu bali kwa maneno tuliyofundishwa na Roho, tukifafanua kweli za kiroho kwa maneno ya kiroho.

english: The natural man does not accept the things that come from the Spirit of God. For they are foolishness to him, and he cannot understand them, because they are spiritually discerned.
ekegusii: Nabo Mwanyabaanto ore ne chingencho chia kare, takonyora ebiegwa bi’Omoika o Nyasae, naki asare ere ebi nebiriri, gose takonyara kobimanya, ekiagera nigo bikomanyekana ase chinguru chi’Omoika.
swahili: Mtu ambaye hana Roho hawezi kupokea mambo yatokayo kwa Roho wa Mungu, kwa kuwa ni upuzi kwake, naye hawezi kuyaelewa kwa sababu hayo yanaeleweka tu kwa upambanuzi wa rohoni.

english: The spiritual man judges all things, but he himself is not subject to anyone’s judgment.
ekegusii: Omonto ore n’Omoika nigo akomanya onsi, korende ere takomanyigwa na monto onde.
swahili: Mtu wa kiroho hubainisha mambo yote, lakini yeye mwenyewe habainishwi na mtu yeyote.

english: “For who has known the mind of the Lord, so as to instruct Him?” But we have the mind of Christ.
ekegusii: “Naki ning’o omanyete ebirengererio bi’Omonene, erinde amworokererie?” Korende intwe ntore nebirengererio bia Kristo.
swahili: “Kwa maana ni nani aliyefahamu mawazo ya Bwana ili apate kumfundisha?” Lakini sisi tunayo mawazo ya Kristo.

english: For I resolved to know nothing while I was with you except Jesus Christ and Him crucified.
ekegusii: Naki nigo narengereretie ng’a timanya ing’ana rinde rionsi ase more otatiga igoro ya Yeso Kristo, kobua mono okobambwa kwaye ase omosalaba.
swahili: Kwa kuwa niliamua kutokujua kitu chochote wakati nikiwa nanyi isipokuwa Yesu Kristo aliyesulubiwa.

english: I came to you in weakness and fear, and with much trembling.
ekegusii: Na inche nigo narenge amo nainwe ase oboreu na okoiroka, na okoiguswa.
swahili: Mimi nilikuja kwenu nikiwa dhaifu na mwenye hofu na kwa kutetemeka sana.

english: My message and my preaching were not with persuasive words of wisdom, but with a demonstration of the Spirit’s power,
ekegusii: Enkwana yane na okorandia kwane tibiarenge amang’ana ay’okoebereria obong’aini bwa Mwanyabaanto, korende ase ekiorokererio ki’Omoika ne chinguru,
swahili: Kuhubiri kwangu na ujumbe wangu haukuwa kwa hekima na maneno ya ushawishi bali kwa madhihirisho ya nguvu za Roho

english: so that your faith would not rest on men’s wisdom, but on God’s power. Spiritual Wisdom (Ephesians 1:15–23)
ekegusii: erinde okwegena kwaino tikoba ase obong’aini bwa Mwanyabaanto korende ase chinguru chia Nyasae. Obong’ani bwa Nyasae
swahili: ili imani yenu isiwe imejengwa katika hekima ya wanadamu bali katika nguvu za Mungu. Hekima Ya Kweli Itokayo Kwa Mungu

english: Among the mature, however, we speak a message of wisdom—but not the wisdom of this age or of the rulers of this age, who are coming to nothing.
ekegusii: Korende obong’aini mbore togoteeba ase egati y’abaikeranu, na borobwo tibori obong’aini bw’ense eye, gose obw’abagaambi b’ense eye abagendererete gochia gosira,
swahili: Lakini miongoni mwa watu waliokomaa twanena hekima, wala si hekima ya ulimwengu huu au ya watawala wa dunia hii wanaobatilika.

english: No, we speak of the mysterious and hidden wisdom of God, which He destined for our glory before time began.
ekegusii: korende nigo togokwana obong’aini bw’obobisi bwa Nyasae, obwo bwabisetwe, obwo Nyasae aroberetie korwa omochakano, erinde toegwe bobe obonene bwaito.
swahili: Sisi tunanena hekima ya Mungu ambayo ni siri, tena iliyofichika, ambayo Mungu aliikusudia kabla ya ulimwengu kuwepo, kwa ajili ya utukufu wetu.

english: None of the rulers of this age understood it. For if they had, they would not have crucified the Lord of glory.
ekegusii: Abagaambi b’ense eye tibabomanyete, nonya noyomo obo; naki onye mbabomanyete, anga tibaabambete Omonene bw’obonene;
swahili: Hakuna hata mtawala mmoja wa nyakati hizi aliyeelewa jambo hili. Kwa maana kama wangelielewa, wasingemsulubisha Bwana wa utukufu.

english: Rather, as it is written: “No eye has seen, no ear has heard, no heart has imagined, what God has prepared for those who love Him.”
ekegusii: korende buna eriikire, “Aya eriso ritaroche, gose ogoto gotaigwete, gose aya atarengereirie ase enkoro y’omonto, ayio Nyasae aroiseretie abamwanchete.”
swahili: Lakini ni kama ilivyoandikwa: “Hakuna jicho limepata kuona, wala sikio limepata kusikia, wala hayakuingia moyoni wowote, yale Mungu amewaandalia wale wampendao”:

english: Brothers, I could not address you as spiritual, but as worldly—as infants in Christ.
ekegusii: Na inche, baminto, tinare konyara gokwana nainwe buna nabaanto bare n’Omoika, korende buna abanto b’engencho ya kare, buna abana ebing’werere ase Kristo.
swahili: Ndugu zangu, mimi sikuweza kusema nanyi kama watu wa kiroho, bali kama watu wa mwilini, kama watoto wachanga katika Kristo.

english: By the grace God has given me, I laid a foundation as an expert builder, and someone else is building on it. But each one must be careful how he builds.
ekegusii: Koreng’ana nobuya bwa Nyasae naetwe inche, buna omonene bw’abaagachi, oyore ne chisemi, nabekire oboroso, na omonto onde nkoagacha are igoro yaye. Korende kera omonto tiga arigererie buna akoagacha igoro yaye.
swahili: Kwa neema Mungu aliyonipa, niliweka msingi kama mjenzi stadi na mtu mwingine anajenga juu yake. Lakini kila mmoja inampasa awe mwangalifu jinsi anavyojenga.

english: For no one can lay a foundation other than the one already laid, which is Jesus Christ.
ekegusii: Naki boroso bonde tibori omonto aranyare kobeeka, otatiga boria bwaikire kobekwa, nabwo Yeso Kristo.
swahili: Kwa maana hakuna mtu yeyote awezaye kuweka msingi mwingine wowote isipokuwa ule uliokwisha kuwekwa, ambao ni Yesu Kristo.

english: If anyone builds on this foundation using gold, silver, precious stones, wood, hay, or straw,
ekegusii: Korende omonto karaagache igoro ase oboroso obwo netaabu, gose efeta, gose amagena e rigori rinene, gose emete, gose obonyansi, gose chinsiaga,
swahili: Kama mtu yeyote akijenga juu ya msingi huu kwa kutumia dhahabu, fedha, vito vya thamani, miti, majani au nyasi,

english: his workmanship will be evident, because the Day will bring it to light. It will be revealed with fire, and the fire will prove the quality of each man’s work.
ekegusii: emeremo ya kera omonto ing’a eorokigwe maiso marore. Naki Rituko erio inariyeorokie, ekiagera narioroke nomorero; na omorero oyio noteeme emeremo ya kera omonto ng’a naki ere.
swahili: kazi yake itaonekana ilivyo, kwa kuwa Siku ile itaidhihirisha. Itadhihirishwa kwa moto, nao moto utapima ubora wa kazi ya kila mtu.

english: If what he has built survives, he will receive a reward.
ekegusii: Emeremo y’omonto aagachete igoro ase oboroso kerabue, omonto oyio nanyore eng’eria.
swahili: Kama kile alichojenga kitabaki, atapokea thawabu yake.

english: If it is burned up, he will suffer loss. He himself will be saved, but only as if through the flames. God’s Temple and God’s Wisdom (Romans 12:1–8; 1 Corinthians 6:18–20)
ekegusii: Emeremo y’omonto kerayie, takonyora eng’eria, korende ere omonyene natoorigwe, korende buna oyo ogotaborigwa korwa ase omorero.
swahili: Kama kazi kitateketea, atapata hasara, ila yeye mwenyewe ataokolewa, lakini tu kama mtu aliyenusurika kwenye moto.

english: Do you not know that you yourselves are God’s temple, and that God’s Spirit dwells in you?
ekegusii: Timomanyeti ng’a inwe ne Hekalu ya Nyasae, na Omoika o Nyasae nigo amenyete ime yaino?
swahili: Je, hamjui ya kwamba ninyi wenyewe ni hekalu la Mungu na kwamba Roho wa Mungu anakaa ndani yenu?

english: If anyone destroys God’s temple, God will destroy him; for God’s temple is holy, and you are that temple.
ekegusii: Onye omonto ogosaria Hekalu ya Nyasae, Nyasae nasarie omonto oyio; naki Hekalu ya Nyasae nenchenu, nero ninwe.
swahili: Kama mtu yeyote akiliharibu hekalu la Mungu, Mungu atamwangamiza; kwa maana hekalu la Mungu ni takatifu, na ninyi ndiyo hilo hekalu.

english: Let no one deceive himself. If any of you thinks he is wise in this age, he should become a fool, so that he may become wise.
ekegusii: Omonto tabaisa kweng’aina ere omonyene. Onye omonto ase egati yaino bwerorire ng’a nomonyasemi are ase ense eye, tiga ekore omoriri, erinde anyare koba omonyasemi.
swahili: Msijidanganye. Kama mtu yeyote miongoni mwenu akidhani kuwa ana hekima kwa viwango vya dunia hii, inampasa awe mjinga ili apate kuwa na hekima.

english: For the wisdom of this world is foolishness in God’s sight. As it is written: “He catches the wise in their craftiness.”
ekegusii: Naki obong’aini bw’ense eye noboriri ase Nyasae, ekiagera neriikire, “Nyasae nigo akobwata abare nobong’aini ase obong’ainereria bwabo”,
swahili: Kwa maana hekima ya ulimwengu huu ni upuzi mbele za Mungu. Kama ilivyoandikwa: “Mungu huwanasa wenye hekima katika hila yao,”

english: I gave you milk, not solid food, for you were not yet ready for solid food. In fact, you are still not ready,
ekegusii: Nabasiibirie amabeere, timbaragereti endagera; ekiagera konya timoraisana; ee, nonya mbono timoraisana,
swahili: Naliwanywesha maziwa, wala si chakula kigumu, kwa kuwa hamkuwa tayari kwa hicho chakula. Naam, hata sasa hamko tayari.

english: And again, “The Lord knows that the thoughts of the wise are futile.”
ekegusii: naende, “Omonene nigo amanyete okorengereria kw’abare nobong’aini ng’a nokwa bosa.”
swahili: tena, “Bwana anajua kwamba mawazo ya wenye hekima ni ubatili.”

english: Therefore, stop boasting in men. All things are yours,
ekegusii: Ase ayio omonto tetogia ase Mwanyabaanto. Naki bionsi nebiaino;
swahili: Hivyo basi, mtu asijivune kuhusu wanadamu! Vitu vyote ni vyenu,

english: whether Paul or Apollos or Cephas or the world or life or death or the present or the future. All of them belong to you,
ekegusii: onye Paulo, gose Apolo, gose Kefa, gose ense, gose obogima, gose amakweri, gose biria bire bono, gose ebio birache koba; bionsi nebiaino;
swahili: ikiwa ni Paulo au Apolo au Kefa au dunia au uzima au mauti, au wakati uliopo au wakati ujao, haya yote ni yenu

english: and you belong to Christ, and Christ belongs to God.
ekegusii: na inwe naba Kristo, na Kristo noyo o Nyasae.
swahili: na ninyi ni wa Kristo, naye Kristo ni wa Mungu.

english: for you are still worldly. For since there is jealousy and dissension among you, are you not worldly? Are you not walking in the way of man?
ekegusii: ekiagera nonya mbono nigo more abanto b’engencho y’ebibe. Naki onye more ne ribero na eriomana ase egati yaino, Inee, timori abanto b’engencho y’ebibe, naende nigo mogendererete buna banto bande bonsi?
swahili: Ninyi bado ni watu wa mwilini. Kwa kuwa bado kuna wivu na magombano miongoni mwenu, je, ninyi si watu wa mwilini? Je, si mwaendelea kama watu wa kawaida?

english: For when one of you says, “I follow Paul,” and another, “I follow Apollos,” are you not mere men?
ekegusii: Ekiagera ekero omonto oyomo akobora, “Inche noyo o Paulo,” na oyonde, “Inche noyo bw’Apolo.” Inee, inwe timori Mwanyabaanto?
swahili: Kwa maana mmoja anaposema, “Mimi ni wa Paulo,” na mwingine, “Mimi ni wa Apolo,” je, ninyi si wanadamu wa kawaida?

english: What then is Apollos? And what is Paul? They are servants through whom you believed, as the Lord has assigned to each his role.
ekegusii: Gaki Apolo inki aisaine? Na Paulo inki aisaine? Intwe nabakori emeremo, ababorokereirie komwegena Omonene, kera oyomo buna Omonene amoeire.
swahili: Kwani, Apolo ni nani? Naye Paulo ni nani? Ni watumishi tu ambao kupitia wao mliamini, kama vile Bwana alivyompa kila mtu huduma yake.

english: I planted the seed and Apollos watered it, but God made it grow.
ekegusii: Inche ngasimeka, Apolo akabeeka amaache, korende Nyasae nere ogokinia.
swahili: Mimi nilipanda mbegu, Apolo akatia maji, lakini Mungu ndiye aliikuza.

english: So neither he who plants nor he who waters is anything, but only God, who makes things grow.
ekegusii: Onye nabo, oyogosimeka tai gento, nonya noyokobeeka amaache, korende Nyasae bweka oyogokinia.
swahili: Hivyo mwenye kupanda na mwenye kutia maji si kitu, bali Mungu peke yake ambaye huifanya ikue.

english: He who plants and he who waters are one in purpose, and each will be rewarded according to his own labor.
ekegusii: Naboigo oyogosimeka, na oyokobeeka amaache nigo bareng’anetie; na kera omonto nanyore eng’eria yaye koreng’ana buna emeremo yaye ere.
swahili: Apandaye mbegu ana lengo sawa na yule atiaye maji na kila mmoja atalipwa kulingana na kazi yake.

english: For we are God’s fellow workers; you are God’s field, God’s building. Christ Our Foundation (Isaiah 28:14–22; Ephesians 2:19–22; 1 Peter 2:1–8)
ekegusii: Naki intwe nabakori emeremo amo na Nyasae; inwe nomogondo o Nyasae, na oboagacho bwa Nyasae.
swahili: Kwa kuwa sisi tu watendakazi pamoja na Mungu. Ninyi ni shamba la Mungu, jengo la Mungu.

english: So then, men ought to regard us as servants of Christ and stewards of the mysteries of God.
ekegusii: Omonto natobare iga, ng’a nabasomba ba Kristo tore, na abarendi b’obobisi bwa Nyasae.
swahili: Basi, watu na watuhesabu sisi kuwa tu watumishi wa Kristo na mawakili wa siri za Mungu.

english: We are fools for Christ, but you are wise in Christ. We are weak, but you are strong. You are honored, but we are dishonored.
ekegusii: Intwe nigo tore abariri ase engencho ya Kristo, korende inwe nigo more abang’aini ase Kristo. Intwe nigo tore abareu, korende inwe nigo more ne chinguru. Inwe nigo mosikire, korende intwe tochayire.
swahili: Kwa ajili ya Kristo sisi ni wajinga, lakini ninyi mna hekima sana ndani ya Kristo. Sisi tu dhaifu, lakini ninyi mna nguvu. Tunadharauliwa, lakini ninyi mnaheshimiwa.

english: To this very hour we are hungry and thirsty, we are poorly clothed, we are brutally treated, we are homeless.
ekegusii: Nonya ngoika egeka eke kia bono ntore nenchara na erang’o, naende nigo tore gesobono; iga togoakwa chinkundi titori nobomenyo,
swahili: Mpaka saa hii tuna njaa na kiu, tu uchi, tumepigwa na hatuna makao.

english: We work hard with our own hands. When we are vilified, we bless; when we are persecuted, we endure it;
ekegusii: naende nigo togochandeka gatogokora emeremo namaboko aito abanyene. Ekero tokoramwa, twasesenia; ekero togochandwa, twaremereria;
swahili: Tunafanya kazi kwa bidii kwa mikono yetu wenyewe. Tunapolaaniwa, tunabariki, tunapoteswa, tunastahimili,

english: when we are slandered, we answer gently. Up to this moment we have become the scum of the earth, the refuse of the world. Paul’s Fatherly Warning
ekegusii: ekero togokwanwa bobe, intwe twaebereria. Twakorirwe buna eogoto y’ense na eubi y’ebinto bionsi goika bono. Obotebereria bwa ise bw’obwanchani, na ogokuurera
swahili: tunaposingiziwa, tunajibu kwa upole. Mpaka sasa tumekuwa kama takataka ya dunia na uchafu wa ulimwengu.

english: I am not writing this to shame you, but to warn you as my beloved children.
ekegusii: Tinyarigeti aya ase okobasookia, korende nkobakuurera buna abana nyanchete.
swahili: Siwaandikii mambo haya ili kuwaaibisha, bali ili kuwaonya, kama wanangu wapendwa.

english: Even if you have ten thousand guardians in Christ, you do not have many fathers; for in Christ Jesus I became your father through the gospel.
ekegusii: Naki nonya more nabateebereria chilifu ikomi ase Kristo, timori nabaiso abange. Naki ase Kristo Yeso nabeire buna iso, obaiboire ase enchiri.
swahili: Hata kama mnao walimu 10,000 katika Kristo, lakini hamna baba wengi. Mimi nilikuwa baba yenu katika Kristo Yesu kwa kuwaletea Injili.

english: Therefore I urge you to imitate me.
ekegusii: Gaki nabasoroire, mobe abegi baane.
swahili: Basi nawasihi igeni mfano wangu.

english: That is why I have sent you Timothy, my beloved and faithful child in the Lord. He will remind you of my way of life in Christ Jesus, which is exactly what I teach everywhere in every church.
ekegusii: Ase ayio natomire Timotheo ase more, oyore omwana one omwanchwa, na omwegenwa ase Omonene. Nere orabainyorie buna chingencho chiane chire ase Kristo, buna nkoborokereria kera aase ase kera ekanisa,
swahili: Kwa sababu hii ninamtuma Timotheo, mwanangu mpendwa na mwaminifu katika Bwana. Yeye atawakumbusha kuhusu njia za maisha yangu katika Kristo Yesu, ambayo yanakubaliana na mafundisho yangu ninayofundisha katika kila kanisa.

english: Some of you have become arrogant, as if I were not coming to you.
ekegusii: Abande ase more baenenire ekiagera bakagire ng’a tindi gocha ase more.
swahili: Baadhi yenu mmekuwa na jeuri mkidhani kuwa sitafika kwenu.

english: But I will come to you shortly, if the Lord is willing, and then I will find out not only what these arrogant people are saying, but what power they have.
ekegusii: Korende ninchiche ase more bwango, Omonene karanche, na inche nimanye chinguru chiabo abwo bakoenena, gose tari ogokwana kwabo.
swahili: Lakini kama Bwana akipenda, nitafika kwenu mapema, nami nitapenda kujua, si tu kile wanachosema hawa watu jeuri, bali pia kujua nguvu yao.

english: Now it is required of stewards that they be found faithful.
ekegusii: Agwo naende ayarigirie ase abarendi naro aya: banyorekane ng’a nabegenwa bare.
swahili: Tena, litakiwalo ni mawakili waonekane kuwa waaminifu.

english: For the kingdom of God is not a matter of talk but of power.
ekegusii: Naki oborwoti bwa Nyasae tibori ase ogokwana, korende ase chinguru.
swahili: Kwa kuwa Ufalme wa Mungu si maneno matupu tu bali ni nguvu.

english: Which do you prefer? Shall I come to you with a rod, or in love and with a gentle spirit?
ekegusii: Naki morigetie? Inchiche ase more nenyimbo gose nobwanchani ase omoika bw’obwororo?
swahili: Ninyi amueni. Je, nije kwenu na fimbo, au nije kwa upendo na kwa roho ya upole?

english: I care very little, however, if I am judged by you or by any human court. In fact, I do not even judge myself.
ekegusii: Asende inche, tai gento ngambigwe nainwe, gose na kegambero kende gionsi kia Mwanyabaanto. Nonya ninche omonyene tinkwegambia.
