swahili: Lakini kwangu mimi ni jambo dogo sana kwamba nihukumiwe na ninyi au na mahakama yoyote ya kibinadamu. Naam, hata mimi mwenyewe sijihukumu.

english: My conscience is clear, but that does not vindicate me. It is the Lord who judges me.
ekegusii: Naki timanyeti engencho y’ogwesoera inche omonyene, korende timbareiri oboronge ase engencho y’ayio. Omonene nere orangambie.
swahili: Dhamiri yangu ni safi, lakini hilo halinihesabii kuwa asiye na hatia. Bwana ndiye anihukumuye.

english: Therefore judge nothing before the appointed time; wait until the Lord comes. He will bring to light what is hidden in darkness and will expose the motives of men’s hearts. At that time each will receive his praise from God.
ekegusii: Ase ayio timogamba ing’ana rinde rionsi engaki etaraika, ekero Omonene ataracha; nere orabaorokerie ayabisegete ase omosunte, na koorokia amang’ana are ase chinkoro ime. Erio nario kera omonto aranyore ogotogigwa kwaye korwa ase Nyasae.
swahili: Kwa hiyo msihukumu jambo lolote kabla ya wakati wake. Ngojeni mpaka Bwana atakapokuja. Yeye atayaleta nuruni mambo yale yaliyofichwa gizani, na kuweka wazi nia za mioyo ya wanadamu. Wakati huo kila mmoja atapokea sifa anayostahili kutoka kwa Mungu.

english: Brothers, I have applied these things to myself and Apollos for your benefit, so that you may learn from us not to go beyond what is written. Then you will not take pride in one man over another.
ekegusii: Amang’ana aya, baminto, nayakwanire igoro yane na igoro y’Apolo ase engencho yaino, erinde ase amang’ana aito monyare kweorokereria timotamboka ase amang’ana ariikire. Omonto taenena ase oyomo mamincha y’oria onde.
swahili: Basi ndugu zangu, mambo haya nimeyafanya kwangu binafsi na Apolo kwa faida yenu, ili mweze kujifunza kutoka kwetu maana ya ule usemi usemao, “Msivuke zaidi ya yale yaliyoandikwa.” Hivyo hamtajivunia mtu fulani na kumdharau mwingine.

english: For who makes you so superior? What do you have that you did not receive? And if you did receive it, why do you boast as though you did not?
ekegusii: Naki ning’o ogwatananire aye noyonde? Inki ore nakio otanyoreti buna ekeegwa? Onye gwakenyorire buna ekeegwa, inki rende ogwetogeria buna tikiarenge ekeegwa?
swahili: Kwa maana ni nani aliyewafanya kuwa tofauti na wengine? Ni nini mlicho nacho ambacho hamkupokea? Nanyi kama mlipokea, kwa nini mnajivuna kama vile hamkupokea?

english: Already you have all you want. Already you have become rich. Without us, you have become kings. How I wish you really were kings, so that we might be kings with you!
ekegusii: Mwaikire koigota! Mwaikire konyora obotenenku! Mwanyorire oborwoti intwe totaiyo! Anga mbuya onye mwagambete, erinde naintwe togambe amo nainwe!
swahili: Sasa tayari mnayo yale yote mnayohitaji! Tayari mmekwisha kuwa matajiri! Mmekuwa wafalme, tena bila sisi! Laiti mngekuwa wafalme kweli ili na sisi tupate kuwa wafalme pamoja nanyi!

english: For it seems to me that God has displayed us apostles at the end of the procession, like prisoners appointed for death. We have become a spectacle to the whole world, to angels as well as to men.
ekegusii: Naki nigo ndoche ng’a Nyasae otobekire intwe abatomwa tobe ab’omoerio ase bonsi, buna abanto bagambetigwe ng’a baitwe, ekiagera twabeire ekiorokererio ki’ogosekererwa ase ense, na ase abamalaika, na ase Mwanyabaanto.
swahili: Kwa maana ninaona kwamba Mungu ametuweka sisi mitume katika nafasi ya mwisho kabisa, kama watu waliohukumiwa kufa kwenye uwanja wa tamasha, kwa sababu tumefanywa kuwa maonyesho kwa ulimwengu wote, kwa malaika na kwa wanadamu pia.

english: It is actually reported that there is sexual immorality among you, and of a kind that is intolerable even among pagans: A man has his father’s wife.
ekegusii: Amang’ana akwanirwe kera aase ng’a obotomani mbore ase egati yaino, naende obotomani buna obwo tibwana kororekana nonya nase abanto b’Ebisaku, ng’a oyomo oino namenyaine na moga ise,
swahili: Yamkini habari imeenea ya kuwa miongoni mwenu kuna uzinzi ambao haujatokea hata miongoni mwa watu wasiomjua Mungu: Kwamba mtu anaishi na mke wa baba yake.

english: I was not including the sexually immoral of this world, or the greedy and swindlers, or idolaters. In that case you would have to leave this world.
ekegusii: Tintebeti ng’a timosang’anana nabatomani b’ense eye, gose abegimeria, gose abauri, gose abagosaba emegwekano y’ogosasimwa; onye nabo anga mwarua ase ense.
swahili: Sina maana kwamba msishirikiane na wazinzi wa ulimwengu huu, au wenye tamaa mbaya, wanyangʼanyi au waabudu sanamu. Kwa kufanya hivyo ingewalazimu mtoke ulimwenguni humu.

english: But now I am writing you not to associate with anyone who claims to be a brother but is sexually immoral or greedy, an idolater or a verbal abuser, a drunkard or a swindler. With such a man do not even eat.
ekegusii: Korende bono nabarikeire ng’a timosang’anana nomonto okorokwa oyomino, karabe omotomani, gose oyokwegimeria, gose oyogosaba emegwekano y’ogosasimwa, gose omorami, gose oyogotinda, gose omouri, omonto onga buna oyio, timwancha nonya nkoria nere.
swahili: Lakini sasa nawaandikia kwamba msishirikiane na mtu yeyote anayejiita ndugu, hali akiwa ni mzinzi, au mwenye tamaa mbaya, mwabudu sanamu au msingiziaji, mlevi au mdhalimu. Mtu kama huyo hata msile naye.

english: What business of mine is it to judge those outside the church? Are you not to judge those inside?
ekegusii: Inee! Ninche ngwenerete kogambia abare isiko? Na inwe timogwenereti kogambia abare ekanisa ime?
swahili: Yanihusu nini kuwahukumu wale watu walio nje ya kanisa? Je, si mnapaswa kuwahukumu hao walio ndani?

english: God will judge those outside. “Expel the wicked man from among you.”
ekegusii: Korende abwo bare isiko, Nyasae nabagaambie, “Seria omonto oyio omobe arue ase more.”
swahili: Mungu atawahukumu hao walio nje. “Ninyi mwondoeni huyo mtu mwovu miongoni mwenu.”

english: And you are proud! Shouldn’t you rather have been stricken with grief and have removed from your fellowship the man who did this?
ekegusii: Inwe mwaenenire! Inee! Timogwenereti goichana? Tiga oyo okorire ayio arusigwe korwa ase more.
swahili: Nanyi mwajivuna! Je, haiwapasi kuhuzunika na kumtenga na ushirika wenu mtu huyo aliyefanya mambo hayo?

english: Although I am absent from you in body, I am present with you in spirit, and I have already pronounced judgment on the one who did this, just as if I were present.
ekegusii: Korende nonya tindi agwo ase omobere, nao inde agwo ase omoika. Naikire kogambia ere oyokorire ring’ana erio, buna nao narenge.
swahili: Hata kama siko pamoja nanyi katika mwili, niko nanyi katika roho. Nami nimekwisha kumhukumu mtu huyo aliyetenda jambo hili, kama vile ningekuwepo.

english: When you are assembled in the name of our Lord Jesus and I am with you in spirit, along with the power of the Lord Jesus,
ekegusii: Ase erieta ri’Omonene Yeso, inwe ekero morasangererekane, na omoika one nao ore amo nokobua kw’Omonene oito Yeso,
swahili: Mnapokutana katika Jina la Bwana wetu Yesu nami nikiwepo pamoja nanyi katika roho na uweza wa Bwana Yesu ukiwepo,

english: hand this man over to Satan for the destruction of the flesh, so that his spirit may be saved on the Day of the Lord.
ekegusii: mogwenerete koa Saitani omonto oyio, omobere oye osarigwe, erinde omoika oye oche gotoorigwa ase rituko ri’Omonene Yeso.
swahili: mkabidhini mtu huyu kwa Shetani, ili mwili wake uharibiwe, ili roho yake iokolewe katika siku ya Bwana.

english: Your boasting is not good. Do you not know that a little leaven works through the whole batch of dough?
ekegusii: Ogwetogia kwaino tikori okuya. Timomanyeti ng’a ememera emeke nigo ekobotia ribomba rigima?
swahili: Majivuno yenu si mazuri. Je, hamjui ya kwamba chachu kidogo huchachusha donge zima la unga?

english: Get rid of the old leaven, that you may be a new unleavened batch, as you really are. For Christ, our Passover lamb, has been sacrificed.
ekegusii: Rusia kegima ememera eria ya kare, erinde mobe ribomba riyia, buna more motabekiri memera. Naki Emanwa yaito y’Eng’ondi y’Epasaka yaikire koruegwa ekeng’wanso, nere Kristo.
swahili: Ondoeni chachu ya kale ili mpate kuwa donge jipya lisilotiwa chachu, kama vile mlivyo. Kwa maana Kristo, Mwana-Kondoo wetu wa Pasaka amekwisha tolewa kuwa dhabihu.

english: Therefore let us keep the feast, not with the old bread, leavened with malice and wickedness, but with the unleavened bread of sincerity and of truth. Expel the Immoral Brother
ekegusii: Gaki tobe nomoyega, tari ase ememera ya kare, gose ase ememera y’ogosaria na ey’obobe, korende ase omogati otabekiri memera, nabwo oborabu bw’omoyo na ekeene.
swahili: Kwa hiyo, tusiiadhimishe sikukuu hii, kwa chachu ya zamani, chachu ya nia mbaya na uovu, bali kwa mkate usiotiwa chachu, ndio weupe wa moyo na kweli.

english: I wrote you in my letter not to associate with sexually immoral people.
ekegusii: Nabariikerete ase riruube riane, ng’a timosang’anana nabatomani.
swahili: Niliwaandikia katika waraka wangu kuwa msishirikiane na wazinzi.

english: If any of you has a grievance against another, how dare he go to law before the unrighteous instead of before the saints!
ekegusii: Omonto onde oino karabe ne ring’ana ase oyomwabo, Inee, nare noboremu amosoere ase abwo batari abaronge? Inki rende atari komosoera ase obosio bw’abachenu?
swahili: Kama mtu yeyote wa kwenu ana ugomvi na mwenzake, anathubutuje kuupeleka kwa wasiomcha Mungu ili kuamuliwa badala ya kuupeleka kwa watakatifu?

english: nor thieves, nor the greedy, nor drunkards, nor verbal abusers, nor swindlers, will inherit the kingdom of God.
ekegusii: gose abaibi, gose abegimeria, gose abagotinda, gose abarami, gose abauri.
swahili: wala wezi, wala wenye tamaa mbaya, wala walevi, wala wanaodhihaki, wala wanyangʼanyi hawataurithi Ufalme wa Mungu.

english: And that is what some of you were. But you were washed, you were sanctified, you were justified, in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ and by the Spirit of our God.
ekegusii: Abande ase more nigo mwarenge abanto buna aba, korende mogasibigwa na mogachenwa, mwanyorire oboronge ase erieta ri’Omonene Yeso Kristo, na ase Omoika o Nyasae oito. Ebibe tibigwenereti ase obogima bw’obokristo
swahili: Baadhi yenu mlikuwa kama hao. Lakini mlioshwa, mlitakaswa, mlihesabiwa haki kwa jina la Bwana Yesu Kristo na katika Roho wa Mungu wetu. Dhambi Za Zinaa

english: “Everything is permissible for me,” but not everything is beneficial. “Everything is permissible for me,” but I will not be mastered by anything.
ekegusii: “Ninde nobosibore gokora kende gionsi”, korende tari bionsi birankonye. “Ninde nobosibore gokora kende gionsi”, korende tingwancha koba omosomba o gento kende gionsi.
swahili: “Vitu vyote ni halali kwangu”: lakini si vitu vyote vyenye faida. “Vitu vyote ni halali kwangu”: lakini sitatawaliwa na kitu chochote.

english: “Food for the stomach and the stomach for food,” but God will destroy them both. The body is not intended for sexual immorality, but for the Lord, and the Lord for the body.
ekegusii: “Endagera ney’enda na enda ney’endagera”, korende Nyasae nasarie bionsi bibere, enda na endagera. Omobere tori ase obotomani, korende nase Omonene, n’Omonene ase omobere.
swahili: “Chakula ni cha tumbo, na tumbo ni la chakula”: lakini Mungu ataviangamiza vyote viwili. Mwili haukuumbwa kwa ajili ya zinaa bali kwa ajili ya Bwana na Bwana kwa ajili ya mwili.

english: By His power God raised the Lord from the dead, and He will raise us also.
ekegusii: Nyasae nabogetie Omonene, naintwe natobokie ase okobua kwaye.
swahili: Naye Mungu aliyemfufua Bwana kutoka kwa wafu atatufufua sisi pia kwa uweza wake.

english: Do you not know that your bodies are members of Christ? Shall I then take the members of Christ and unite them with a prostitute? Never!
ekegusii: Timomanyeti ng’a emebere yaino nebiimo bia Kristo? Inee! Nimbogorie ebiimo bia Kristo na kobikora bibe ebiimo bi’omokuungu omotayayi? Yaya, nonya ng’ake!
swahili: Je, hamjui kwamba miili yenu ni viungo vya Kristo mwenyewe? Je, nichukue viungo vya mwili wa Kristo na kuviunganisha na mwili wa kahaba? La hasha!

english: Or don’t you know that he who unites himself with a prostitute is one with her in body? For it is said, “The two will become one flesh.”
ekegusii: Timomanyeti ng’a ere oyobwatanigwe nomokuungu omotayayi obeire omobere oyomo nere? Naki buna eriikire, “Baria babere nababe omobere oyomo.”
swahili: Hamjui kwamba aliyeungwa na kahaba anakuwa mwili mmoja naye? Kwa kuwa imenenwa, “Hao wawili watakuwa mwili mmoja.”

english: Flee from sexual immorality. Every other sin a man can commit is outside his body, but he who sins sexually sins against his own body.
ekegusii: Tama obotomani! Kera ebibe binde bigokorwa na Mwanyabaanto nigo bire isiko y’omobere; korende ere oyogokora obotomani igo okorire ebibe ase omobere oye omonyene.
swahili: Ikimbieni zinaa. Dhambi zingine zote atendazo mtu ziko nje ya mwili wake, lakini yeye aziniye hutenda dhambi ndani ya mwili wake mwenyewe.

english: Do you not know that your body is a temple of the Holy Spirit who is in you, whom you have received from God? You are not your own;
ekegusii: Gose timomanyeti ng’a emebere yaino ne Hekalu y’Omoika Omochenu ore ime yaino, oyo mwaeirwe na Nyasae? Na inwe timori abaino abanyene,
swahili: Je, hamjui ya kwamba miili yenu ni hekalu la Roho Mtakatifu akaaye ndani yenu, ambaye mmepewa na Mungu? Ninyi si mali yenu wenyewe,

english: Do you not know that the saints will judge the world? And if you are to judge the world, are you not competent to judge trivial cases?
ekegusii: Gose timomanyeti ng’a abachenu inabagaambie ense? Na onye ense egocha kogambigwa nainwe, Inee, timoisaini kogamba ebiina ebire ebike?
swahili: Je, hamjui kwamba watakatifu watauhukumu ulimwengu? Nanyi kama mtauhukumu ulimwengu, je, hamwezi kuamua mambo madogo madogo?

english: you were bought at a price. Therefore glorify God with your body.
ekegusii: ekiagera mwagoretwe ase rigori rinene. Ase ayio, motogie Nyasae ase emebere yaino.
swahili: kwa maana mmenunuliwa kwa gharama. Kwa hiyo mtukuzeni Mungu katika miili yenu.

english: Do you not know that we will judge angels? How much more the things of this life!
ekegusii: Timomanyeti ng’a ntogambie abamalaika? Tari kobua mono amang’ana ’obogima obo?
swahili: Hamjui kwamba tutawahukumu malaika? Je, si zaidi mambo ya maisha haya?

english: So if you need to settle everyday matters, do you appoint as judges those of no standing in the church?
ekegusii: Gaki komorabe mogosoerana ase amang’ana buna ayio, naki rende mokoyarenta ase abwo batabariri buna ngento ase ekanisa?
swahili: Kwa hiyo kama kuna ugomvi miongoni mwenu kuhusu mambo kama haya, chagueni kuwa waamuzi, watu ambao wanaonekana hata sio wa heshima katika kanisa.

english: I say this to your shame. Is there really no one among you wise enough to arbitrate between his brothers?
ekegusii: Nateebire aya ase okobasookia. Inee! Onde tari ase egati yaino ore ne chisemi chiisaine oranyare konacha amang’ana are ase egati y’abamwabo?
swahili: Nasema hivi ili mwone aibu. Je, inawezekana kuwa miongoni mwenu hakuna mtu mwenye hekima ya kutosha kuamua ugomvi kati ya waaminio?

english: Instead, one brother goes to law against another, and this in front of unbelievers!
ekegusii: Korende oyomwabo nigo agosoera oyomwabo, na ayio nase obosio bw’abwo bategeneti.
swahili: Badala yake ndugu mmoja anampeleka mwenzake mahakamani, tena mbele ya watu wasioamini!

english: The very fact that you have lawsuits among you means that you are thoroughly defeated already. Why not rather be wronged? Why not rather be cheated?
ekegusii: Amang’ana aya ng’a ngosoerana more inwe ase inwe nigo are ase okobugwa kwaino. Inki motanchereti gokorerwa bobe? Inki motanchereti kourwa ebi mobwate?
swahili: Huko kuwa na mashtaka miongoni mwenu ina maana kwamba tayari ni kushindwa kabisa. Kwa nini msikubali kutendewa mabaya? Kwa nini msikubali kunyangʼanywa?

english: Instead, you yourselves cheat and do wrong, even against your own brothers! Members of Christ
ekegusii: Korende inwe abanyene mwakoreire abanto bobe, na kobaura ebi babwate, ee nonya nase abamino.
swahili: Badala yake, ninyi wenyewe mwadanganya na kutenda mabaya, tena mwawatendea ndugu zenu.

english: Do you not know that the wicked will not inherit the kingdom of God? Do not be deceived: Neither the sexually immoral, nor idolaters, nor adulterers, nor men who submit to or perform homosexual acts,
ekegusii: Gose timomanyeti ng’a abatari noboronge tibakoira omwando bw’oborwoti bwa Nyasae? Timong’aineka; abanyaka tibakoira omwando bw’oborwoti bwa Nyasae, nonya nabasasimi emegwekano, gose abatomani, gose abakwerua ase okogania kw’omobere, gose abasacha abagwesaria nabasaacha,
swahili: Je, hamjui kwamba wasio haki hawataurithi Ufalme wa Mungu? Msidanganyike: Waasherati, wala waabudu sanamu, wala wazinzi, wala wahanithi, wala walawiti,

english: Now for the matters you wrote about: It is good to abstain from sexual relations.
ekegusii: Gaki ase amang’ana aya mwandikerete, mbuya omosacha takuna omokungu.
swahili: Basi kuhusu mambo yale mliyoyaandika: Ni vyema mwanaume asimguse mwanamke.

english: To the married I give this command (not I, but the Lord): A wife must not separate from her husband.
ekegusii: Korende baria baikire konyuomana nabachiikire, gose tari inche, korende Omonene, ng’a omokungu tatiga omosacha oye,
swahili: Kwa wale waliooana nawapa amri (si mimi ila ni Bwana): Mke asitengane na mumewe.

english: But if she does, she must remain unmarried or else be reconciled to her husband. And a husband must not divorce his wife.
ekegusii: (korende, karabe otiganire nere, atige tanyuomwa gose abwatane nomosaacha oye naende), na omosacha tatiga mokaye.
swahili: Lakini akitengana, ni lazima akae bila kuolewa, ama sivyo apatane tena na mumewe. Wala mume asimpe mkewe talaka.

english: To the rest I say this (I, not the Lord): If a brother has an unbelieving wife and she is willing to live with him, he must not divorce her.
ekegusii: Abwo bande nkobateebia inche, gose tari Omonene, ng’a onye onde ominto ore nomokuungu otegeneti na omokungu oyio bwanchire komenya nere, tamotiga.
swahili: Lakini kwa wengine nasema (si Bwana ila ni mimi): Kama ndugu ana mke asiyeamini, naye huyo mke anakubali kuishi pamoja naye, basi asimwache.

english: And if a woman has an unbelieving husband and he is willing to live with her, she must not divorce him.
ekegusii: Na omokungu ore nomosaacha otegeneti, na omosacha oyo bwanchire komenya nere, tamotiga.
swahili: Naye mwanamke aaminiye kama ameolewa na mwanaume asiyeamini na huyo mume anakubali kuishi naye, basi huyo mwanamke asimwache.

english: For the unbelieving husband is sanctified through his believing wife, and the unbelieving wife is sanctified through her believing husband. Otherwise your children would be unclean, but now they are holy.
ekegusii: Naki omosacha oria otegeneti ochenirwe ase engencho ya mokaye, na omokungu oria otegeneti ochenirwe ase engencho y’omosaacha oye. Onye taibo, abana baino anga tibaaba abachenu; korende buna ere bono, babeire abachenu.
swahili: Kwa maana huyo mume asiyeamini anatakaswa kupitia mkewe, naye mke asiyeamini anatakaswa kupitia mumewe anayeamini. Kama isingalikuwa hivyo watoto wenu wangalikuwa si safi, lakini ilivyo sasa wao ni watakatifu.

english: But if the unbeliever leaves, let him go. The believing brother or sister is not bound in such cases. God has called you to live in peace.
ekegusii: Korende oria otegeneti karaganie gotigana, tiga atigane. Oyominto omosacha gose oyominto omokungu tasibiri ase amang’ana buna ayio, korende Nyasae obarangeirie ase omorembe.
swahili: Lakini kama yule asiyeamini akijitenga, basi afanye hivyo. Katika hali kama hiyo mwanamke au mwanaume aaminiye hafungwi, kwa sababu Mungu ametuita tuishi kwa amani.

english: How do you know, wife, whether you will save your husband? Or how do you know, husband, whether you will save your wife? Live Your Calling
ekegusii: Aye omokungu, ng’ai oramanyere gose notoorie omosacha oo? Gose aye omosacha, ng’ai oramanyere gose notoorie omokungu oo?
swahili: Wewe mke, unajuaje kama utamwokoa mumeo? Au wewe mume unajuaje kama utamwokoa mkeo? Kuishi Kama Alivyoagiza Bwana

english: Regardless, each one should lead the life that the Lord has assigned to him and to which God has called him. This is what I prescribe in all the churches.
ekegusii: Kera omonto agenderere ase obogima obw’Omonene amogabeire na ase obwo Nyasae amorangereirie. Naboigo nachigete ase chikanisa chionsi.
swahili: Lakini kila mtu na aishi maisha aliyopangiwa na Bwana, yale Mungu aliyomwitia. Hii ni sheria ninayoiweka kwa makanisa yote.

english: Was a man already circumcised when he was called? He should not become uncircumcised. Was a man still uncircumcised when called? He should not be circumcised.
ekegusii: Monto onde bwensi orangerigwe na Nyasae ekero aikire kwaroka, tekora buna tarogeti, na monto onde bwensi orangerigwe otarogeti, taroka.
swahili: Je, mtu alikuwa tayari ametahiriwa alipoitwa? Asijifanye asiyetahiriwa. Je, mtu alikuwa hajatahiriwa alipoitwa? Asitahiriwe.

english: Circumcision is nothing and uncircumcision is nothing. Keeping God’s commandments is what counts.
ekegusii: Okwaroka tai gento, na ogotaroka tai gento, korende nokobwata amachiiko a Nyasae.
swahili: Kutahiriwa si kitu, na kutokutahiriwa si kitu. Lakini kuzitii amri za Mungu ndilo jambo muhimu.

english: But because there is so much sexual immorality, each man should have his own wife, and each woman her own husband.
ekegusii: Korende ase engencho y’amateemwa ay’ogokora obotomani kera omosacha abe na mokaye omonyene, na kera omokungu abe nomosaacha oye omonyene.
swahili: Lakini ili kuepuka zinaa, kila mwanaume na awe na mke wake mwenyewe na kila mwanamke awe na mume wake mwenyewe.

english: Each one should remain in the situation he was in when he was called.
ekegusii: Kera omonto tiga abe buna arenge ekero arangeretigwe.
swahili: Basi kila mmoja wenu na abaki katika hali aliyoitwa nayo.

english: Were you a slave when you were called? Do not let it concern you—but if you can gain your freedom, take the opportunity.
ekegusii: Inee! Igo kwarangeretigwe kore omosomba? Torora ng’a mbobe; korende koranyare gosiborwa, mbuya obe bo.
swahili: Je, wewe ulipoitwa ulikuwa mtumwa? Jambo hilo lisikusumbue. Ingawaje unaweza kupata uhuru, tumia nafasi uliyo nayo sasa kuliko wakati mwingine wowote.

english: For he who was a slave when he was called by the Lord is the Lord’s freedman. Conversely, he who was a free man when he was called is Christ’s slave.
ekegusii: Naki oyorangeretigwe ase Omonene kare omosomba, nomosibore ase Omonene. Naboigo noyorangeretigwe osiboire, nomosomba o Kristo.
swahili: Kwa maana yeyote aliyeitwa katika Bwana akiwa mtumwa yeye ni mtu huru kwa Bwana, kama vile yeyote aliyekuwa huru alipoitwa yeye ni mtumwa wa Kristo.

english: You were bought at a price; do not become slaves of men.
ekegusii: Mokagorwa ase rigori, timoba abasomba b’abaanto.
swahili: Mlinunuliwa kwa gharama; msiwe watumwa wa wanadamu.

english: Brothers, each one should remain in the situation he was in when God called him. The Unmarried and Widowed
ekegusii: Kera omonto, baminto, buna arenge ekero arangeretigwe, tiga aikaranse boigo ase Nyasae.
swahili: Ndugu zangu, kama kila mtu alivyoitwa, akae katika wito wake alioitiwa na Mungu. Wajane Na Wasioolewa

english: Now about virgins, I have no command from the Lord, but I give a judgment as one who by the Lord’s mercy is trustworthy.
ekegusii: Ase amang’ana ’abaiseke abekungi, tindi nogochika korwa ase Omonene, korende nabateebirie buna ndoche inche, buna oyonyorire amaabera korwa ase Omonene koba omwegenwa.
swahili: Basi, kuhusu wale walio bikira, mimi sina amri kutoka kwa Bwana, lakini mimi natoa shauri kama mtu ambaye ni mwaminifu kwa rehema za Bwana.

english: Because of the present crisis, I think it is good for a man to remain as he is.
ekegusii: Narorire ng’a ring’ana eri nerigiya ase engencho y’emechando eye tore nero, ng’a mbuya omonto abe buna are.
swahili: Kwa sababu ya shida iliyoko kwa sasa, naona ni vyema mkibaki kama mlivyo.

english: Are you committed to a wife? Do not seek to be released. Are you free of commitment? Do not look for a wife.
ekegusii: Inee! Gwasibirwe ase omokungu? Torigia gosiborwa. Nosiboire? Torigia omokungu.
swahili: Je, umeolewa? Basi usitake talaka. Je, hujaoa? Usitafute mke.

english: But if you do marry, you have not sinned. And if a virgin marries, she has not sinned. But those who marry will face troubles in this life, and I want to spare you this.
ekegusii: Korende koranyuome, tari ebibe gwakora; na omoiseke omwekungi karanyuomwe, tari ebibe akora. Korende abanto abwo nababe nemechando y’ense eye, na inche ninyanchete ng’a timosoa ase emechando eyio.
swahili: Lakini kama ukioa, hujatenda dhambi; na kama bikira akiolewa, hajatenda dhambi. Lakini wale wanaooa watakabiliana na matatizo mengi katika maisha haya, nami nataka kuwazuilia hayo.

english: What I am saying, brothers, is that the time is short. From now on those who have wives should live as if they had none;
ekegusii: Korende baminto, nigo ngoteeba iga: Ekero getigarete negeke; gaki korwa bono baria bare nabakungu, tiga babe buna tibaabwati;
swahili: Lakini ndugu zangu, nina maana kwamba muda uliobaki ni mfupi. Tangu sasa wale waliooa waishi kama wasio na wake;

english: The husband should fulfill his marital duty to his wife, and likewise the wife to her husband.
ekegusii: Omosacha ae omokungu oye ekemogwenerete; naboigo nomokuungu ae omosacha oye ekemogwenerete.
swahili: Mume atimize wajibu wake wa ndoa kwa mkewe, naye vivyo hivyo mke kwa mumewe.

english: those who weep, as if they did not; those who are joyful, as if they were not; those who make a purchase, as if they had nothing;
ekegusii: na baria bakorera babe buna tibari korera; na baria bagogete babe buna tibagogeti: na baria bakogora babe buna tibari na gento;
swahili: nao wanaoomboleza, kama ambao hawaombolezi; wenye furaha kama wasiokuwa nayo; wale wanaonunua, kama vile vitu walivyonunua si mali yao;

english: and those who use the things of this world, as if not dependent on them. For this world in its present form is passing away.
ekegusii: na baria bagokorera ense eye babe buna tibari koyekorera, ekiagera ense buna ere bono ngoeta ere.
swahili: nao wale wanaoshughulika na vitu vya dunia hii, kama ambao hawahusiki navyo. Kwa maana dunia hii kama tunavyoiona sasa inapita.

english: I want you to be free from concern. The unmarried man is concerned about the work of the Lord, how he can please the Lord.
ekegusii: Korende nindigetie ng’a timoba nogwechanda. Oyotaranyuoma nigo arengereretie amang’ana ’Omonene, buna aragwenere Omonene:
swahili: Ningetaka msiwe na masumbufu. Mwanaume ambaye hajaoa anajishughulisha na mambo ya Bwana, jinsi ya kumpendeza Bwana.

english: But the married man is concerned about the affairs of this world, how he can please his wife,
ekegusii: korende oyonyuomire nigo akorengereria amang’ana ’ense eye, buna aragwenere mokaye;
swahili: Lakini mwanaume aliyeoa anajishughulisha na mambo ya dunia, jinsi ya kumfurahisha mkewe,

english: and his interests are divided. The unmarried woman or virgin is concerned about the work of the Lord, how she can be holy in both body and spirit. But the married woman is concerned about the affairs of this world, how she can please her husband.
ekegusii: igo obeire nogwatananekana. Omoiseke omwekungi nigo akorengereria amang’ana ’Omonene, buna aranyare koba omochenu ase omobere na ase omoika, korende oyonyuomirwe nigo akorengereria amang’ana ’ense, buna aragwenere omosacha oye.
swahili: na mawazo yake yamegawanyika. Mwanamke asiyeolewa hujishughulisha na mambo ya Bwana: lengo lake ni awe mtakatifu kimwili na kiroho. Lakini yule aliyeolewa hujishughulisha na mambo ya dunia, jinsi atakavyoweza kumfurahisha mumewe.

english: I am saying this for your own good, not to restrict you, but in order to promote proper decorum and undivided devotion to the Lord.
ekegusii: Nateebire aya ase okobakonya; tari ng’a nkobabeekera nde egetango, korende ase engencho y’ayio abagwenerete, erinde monyare gokorera Omonene motang’usiri namang’ana ande.
swahili: Ninasema haya kwa faida yenu wenyewe, sio ili kuwawekea vizuizi bali mpate kuishi kwa jinsi ilivyo vyema bila kuvutwa pengine katika kujitoa kwenu kwa Bwana.

english: However, if someone thinks he is acting inappropriately toward his betrothed, and if she is beyond her youth and they ought to marry, let him do as he wishes; he is not sinning; they should get married.
ekegusii: Korende monto onde bwensi kararore ng’a takorereti omoiseke oye omwekungi ayamogwenerete, na onye omoiseke oyio oeteire obuya bw’obosae bwaye, onye negwenerete, tiga omonto oyio akore buna arigetie; tari ebibe akora, amotige anyuomwe.
swahili: Kama mtu yeyote anadhani kwamba hamtendei ilivyo sawa mwanamwali ambaye amemposa, naye akiwa umri wake unazidi kuendelea na mtu huyo anajisikia kwamba inampasa kuoa, afanye kama atakavyo. Yeye hatendi dhambi. Yawapasa waoane.

english: But the man who is firmly established in his heart and under no constraint, with control over his will and resolve in his heart not to marry the virgin, he will do well.
ekegusii: Korende oyotenenire noboremu ase enkoro yaye, na tari nokorigia, korende anyare kogambera okogania kwaye, naende orengereirie enkoro yaye ime amotige buna omoiseke oye omwekungi, nakore buya.
swahili: Lakini mwanaume ambaye ameamua moyoni mwake kutooa bila kulazimishwa na mtu yeyote, bali anaweza kuzitawala tamaa zake kutomwoa huyo mwanamwali, basi anafanya ipasavyo.

english: So then, he who marries the virgin does well, but he who does not marry her does even better.
ekegusii: Gaki oyoranyuome omoiseke omwekungi nakore buya; na oyotamonyuome okorire buya kobua.
swahili: Hivyo basi, mwanaume amwoaye mwanamwali afanya vyema, lakini yeye asiyemwoa afanya vyema zaidi.

english: A wife is bound to her husband as long as he lives. But if her husband dies, she is free to marry anyone she wishes, as long as he belongs to the Lord.
ekegusii: Omokungu nigo asibire ase omosacha oye ekero omosacha oye are moyo, korende omosacha oye karakwe, rirorio osiboirwe; nanyare konyuomwa na monto onde bwensi oyo aranche, korende nase Omonene oka.
swahili: Mwanamke aliyeolewa amefungwa na sheria maadamu mumewe yu hai. Lakini mumewe akifa, basi mwanamke huyo yuko huru kuolewa na mume mwingine ampendaye, lakini lazima awe katika Bwana.

english: The wife does not have authority over her own body, but the husband. Likewise the husband does not have authority over his own body, but the wife.
ekegusii: Omokungu tari nokobua igoro ase omobere oye, korende nomosaacha oye; naboigo nomosaacha tari nokobua igoro ase omobere oye, korende nomokuungu oye.
swahili: Mwanamke hana mamlaka juu ya mwili wake bali mumewe, wala mume hana mamlaka juu ya mwili wake bali mkewe.

english: In my judgment, however, she is happier if she remains as she is. And I think that I too have the Spirit of God.
ekegusii: Korende anga mbuya kobua karabe buna are. Nigo ndoche inche; na inche narengereirie ng’a ninde n’Omoika o Nyasae.
swahili: Lakini kwa maoni yangu, angekuwa na furaha zaidi akibaki alivyo. Nami nadhani pia nina Roho wa Mungu.

english: Do not deprive each other, except by mutual consent and for a time, so you may devote yourselves to prayer. Then come together again, so that Satan will not tempt you through your lack of self-control.
ekegusii: Timorinana otatiga mwancheranire ase egeka egeke, erinde monyare kwerua ase ogosaba; naende mobe amo, Saitani tacha kobateema ekiagera motanyare gwetanga.
swahili: Msinyimane, isipokuwa mmekubaliana kufanya hivyo kwa muda fulani ili mweze kujitoa kwa maombi, kisha mrudiane tena ili Shetani asije akapata nafasi ya kuwajaribu kwa sababu ya kutokuwa na kiasi.

english: I say this as a concession, not as a command.
ekegusii: Aya nigo nkobateebia buna ndoche; tindi korua ogochika.
swahili: Nasema haya kama ushauri na si amri.

english: I wish that all men were as I am. But each man has his own gift from God; one has this gift, another has that.
ekegusii: Ayanyanchete naro aya, ng’a abanto bonsi babe buna inche omonyene inde. Korende kera omonto nare nekeegwa kiaye omonyene gekorwa ase Nyasae, oyomo iga, na oyonde iga.
swahili: Laiti watu wangekuwa kama mimi nilivyo. Lakini kila mtu amepewa kipawa chake kutoka kwa Mungu, mmoja ana kipawa cha namna hii na mwingine ana cha namna ile.

english: Now to the unmarried and widows I say this: It is good for them to remain unmarried, as I am.
ekegusii: Bono nkobateebia nde baria bataranyuoma, na ababoraka, mbuya babe buna inche inde.
swahili: Kwa wale wasiooa na kwa wajane, nasema hivi, ingekuwa vizuri wasioe.

english: But if they cannot control themselves, let them marry. For it is better to marry than to burn with passion.
ekegusii: Korende onye tibakonyara gwetanga, tiga banyuome, ekiagera mbuya konyuoma kobua gosambwa nokogania.
swahili: Lakini kama hawawezi kujizuia, basi waoe na kuolewa, kwa maana ni afadhali kuoa au kuolewa kuliko kuwaka tamaa.

english: Now about food sacrificed to idols: We know that we all have knowledge. Knowledge puffs up, but love builds up.
ekegusii: Ase amang’ana ’ebinto bikoruegwa ebing’wanso ase emegwekano y’ogosasimwa, twamanyire ng’a “intwe twensi ntore ne chisemi.” “Chisemi” nigo chikorenta oboenenu, korende obwanchani nigo bokoagacha.
swahili: Sasa kuhusu chakula kilichotolewa sadaka kwa sanamu, tunajua kwamba “sisi sote tuna ujuzi.” Lakini ujuzi hujivuna, bali upendo hujenga.

english: For if someone with a weak conscience sees you who are well informed eating in an idol’s temple, will he not be encouraged to eat food sacrificed to idols?
ekegusii: Naki omonto karakorore aye, omonto ore nobong’aini, goikaransete ase endagera ime ase Hekalu y’emegwekano y’ogosasimwa, Inee, onye enkoro yaye ekobugwa bwango, takonyora oboremu goika arie ebinto bikoruegwa ebingwanso ase emegwekano y’ogosasimwa?
swahili: Kwa maana kama mtu yeyote mwenye dhamiri dhaifu akiwaona ninyi wenye ujuzi huu mkila katika hekalu la sanamu, je, si atatiwa moyo kula chakula kilichotolewa sadaka kwa sanamu?

english: So this weak brother, for whom Christ died, is destroyed by your knowledge.
ekegusii: Ase igo oria omoreu nigo agosirigwa ase engencho y’obong’aini bwao, nere oyominto Kristo akwete ase engencho yaye.
swahili: Kwa njia hiyo, huyo ndugu mwenye dhamiri dhaifu, ambaye Kristo alikufa kwa ajili yake, ataangamia kwa sababu ya ujuzi wenu.

english: By sinning against your brothers in this way and wounding their weak conscience, you sin against Christ.
ekegusii: Ase ayio, komorakorere abamino ebibe na goichania chinkoro chiria chikobugwa bwango, igo mwakoreire Kristo ebibe.
swahili: Mnapotenda dhambi dhidi ya ndugu zenu kwa njia hii na kujeruhi dhamiri zao zilizo dhaifu, mnamkosea Kristo.

english: Therefore, if what I eat causes my brother to stumble, I will never eat meat again, so that I will not cause him to stumble.
ekegusii: Ase ayio, endagera keragere oyominto agwe, rirorio tinkoria enyama nonya ng’ake, timbaisa kogera oyominto agwe.
swahili: Kwa hiyo, kama kile ninachokula kitamfanya ndugu yangu aanguke katika dhambi, sitakula nyama kamwe, nisije nikamfanya ndugu yangu aanguke.

english: The one who thinks he knows something does not yet know as he ought to know.
ekegusii: Omonto karekage ng’a namanyete ring’ana rinde rionsi, oyio taramanya nonya mbono buna emogwenerete amanye.
swahili: Mtu yeyote anayedhani kwamba anajua kitu, bado hajui kama impasavyo kujua.

english: But the one who loves God is known by God.
ekegusii: Korende omonto kamwanchete Nyasae, oyio omanyirwe nere.
swahili: Lakini mtu ampendaye Mungu, hujulikana naye Mungu.

english: So about eating food sacrificed to idols: We know that an idol is nothing at all in the world, and that there is no God but one.
ekegusii: Gaki ase amang’ana ay’okoria ebinto bikoruegwa ebing’wanso ase emegwekano y’ogosasimwa, twamanyire ng’a “omogwekano bw’ogosasimwa tai gento ase ense”, ekiagera twamanyire ng’a “Nyasae onde tari aande, otatiga oyomo bweka.”
swahili: Hivyo basi, kuhusu kula chakula kilichotolewa sadaka kwa sanamu: Tunajua kwamba “Sanamu si kitu chochote kabisa duniani,” na kwamba “Kuna Mungu mmoja tu.”

english: For even if there are so-called gods, whether in heaven or on earth (as there are many so-called gods and lords),
ekegusii: Gaki, nonya chire echinde chikorokwa chinyasae igoro gose ense (buna chire “chinyasae” chinyinge, na “abanene” abange)
swahili: Kwa kuwa hata kama wapo hao wanaoitwa miungu, kama wakiwa mbinguni au duniani (kama ilivyo kweli wapo “miungu” wengi na “mabwana” wengi),

english: yet for us there is but one God, the Father, from whom all things came and for whom we exist. And there is but one Lord, Jesus Christ, through whom all things came and through whom we exist.
ekegusii: korende ase tore intwe Nyasae noyomo bweka, oyore Tata, na ebinto bionsi nigo bikorwa asare, na intwe nigo tore moyo asare. Naende nare Omonene oyomo, nere Yeso Kristo, na ebinto bionsi nere obitongete, naboigo naintwe nere ototongete. Okorenda chinkoro chi’abaminto echi chikobugwa bwango
swahili: kwetu sisi yuko Mungu mmoja, aliye Baba, ambaye vitu vyote vyatoka kwake na kwa ajili yake sisi twaishi; na kuna Bwana mmoja tu, Yesu Kristo, ambaye kwa yeye vitu vyote vimekuwepo na kwa yeye tunaishi.

english: But not everyone has this knowledge. Some people are still so accustomed to idols that they eat such food as if it were sacrificed to an idol. And since their conscience is weak, it is defiled.
ekegusii: Korende obong’aini obo tibori ime ase abanto bonsi. Abande, ekiagera bakwenaria emegwekano y’ogosasimwa goika bono, bakoria endagera buna egento kiarurwe ekeng’wanso ase omogwekano bw’ogosasiimwa, na ekiagera chinkoro chiabo chikobugwa bwango, nigo chikobekwa ogotacheneka.
swahili: Lakini si wote wanaojua jambo hili. Baadhi ya watu bado wamezoea sanamu kuwa halisi hivi kwamba wanapokula chakula kama hicho wanadhani kimetolewa sadaka kwa sanamu na kwa kuwa dhamiri zao ni dhaifu, dhamiri yao inanajisika.

english: But food does not bring us closer to God: We are no worse if we do not eat, and no better if we do.
ekegusii: Korende endagera tegotorenta ang’e ase Nyasae. Totarieti, titogosiria gento, na toisa koria, tegotomenta gento.
swahili: Lakini chakula hakituleti karibu na Mungu, wala hatupotezi chochote tusipokula, wala hatuongezi chochote kama tukila.

english: Be careful, however, that your freedom does not become a stumbling block to the weak.
ekegusii: Korende rigereria ng’a obosibore boria bwaino tibocha kobagocha baria bare abareu.
swahili: Lakini angalieni jinsi mnavyotumia uhuru wenu usije ukawa kikwazo kwao walio dhaifu.

english: Am I not free? Am I not an apostle? Have I not seen Jesus our Lord? Are you yourselves not my workmanship in the Lord?
ekegusii: Inee! Inche tindi omosibore? Inche tindi omotomwa? Tinaroche Yeso, Omonene oito? Inwe timori okwama kw’emeremo yane ase Omonene?
swahili: Je, mimi si huru? Je, mimi si mtume? Je, mimi sikumwona Yesu, Bwana wetu? Je, ninyi si matunda ya kazi yangu katika Bwana?

english: Isn’t He actually speaking on our behalf? Indeed, this was written for us, because when the plowman plows and the thresher threshes, they should also expect to share in the harvest.
ekegusii: Inee! Tateebete ayio ase engencho yaito yoka? Ee, nigo ariikire ase engencho yaito; ekiagera oyokorema nagwenerete korema ase ogosemeria, na ere oyokoora nigo akoora ase ogosemeria konyora ensemo yaye y’endagera.
swahili: Je, Mungu hasemi haya hasa kwa ajili yetu? Hakika yameandikwa kwa ajili yetu, kwa sababu mtu anapolima na mpuraji akapura nafaka, wote wanapaswa kufanya hivyo wakiwa na tumaini la kushiriki mavuno.

english: If we have sown spiritual seed among you, is it too much for us to reap a material harvest from you?
ekegusii: Onye intwe twabasimekeire ebinto bi’omoika, Inee, nering’ana rinene gatoragese ebinto biaino bi’ogokonya ase obogima bw’ense eye?
swahili: Je, ikiwa sisi tulipanda mbegu ya kiroho miongoni mwenu, itakuwa ni jambo kubwa iwapo tutavuna vitu vya mwili kutoka kwenu?

english: If others have this right to your support, shouldn’t we have it all the more? But we did not exercise this right. Instead, we put up with anything rather than hinder the gospel of Christ.
ekegusii: Onye abande banyorire ensemo ebatungetie korwa ase more, Inee, intwe titokoyenyora kobua mono? Korende titorakorera oboronge obo; korende nigo tokoremereria amang’ana onsi, titobaisa gotanga enchiri ya Kristo.
swahili: Kama wengine wana haki ya kupata msaada kutoka kwenu, isingepasa tuwe na haki hiyo hata zaidi? Lakini sisi hatukutumia haki hii. Kinyume chake, tunavumilia kila kitu ili tusije tukazuia Injili ya Kristo.

english: Do you not know that those who work in the temple eat of its food, and those who serve at the altar partake of its offerings?
ekegusii: Timomanyeti ng’a baria bagokora emeremo ase Hekalu nigo bakoria endagera korwa ase Hekalu, na baria bagokorera ase egesasiimero mbare nensemo yabo ase ebinto bikoruegwa ebing’wanso?
swahili: Je, hamjui kwamba, watu wafanyao kazi hekaluni hupata chakula chao kutoka hekaluni, nao wale wahudumiao madhabahuni hushiriki kile kitolewacho madhabahuni?

english: In the same way, the Lord has prescribed that those who preach the gospel should receive their living from the gospel.
ekegusii: Na Omonene naboigo ochikiire ng’a baria bakorandia enchiri banyore ebibagwenerete korwa ase enchiri.
swahili: Vivyo hivyo, Bwana ameamuru kwamba wale wanaohubiri Injili wapate riziki yao kutokana na Injili.

english: But I have not used any of these rights. And I am not writing this to suggest that something be done for me. Indeed, I would rather die than let anyone nullify my boast.
ekegusii: Korende tindakorera amang’ana aya nonya ndimo. Gose tinyarigeti aya erinde abe boigo ase ’nde; naki mbuya ninkwa kobua omonto onde bwensi kong’ura ogwetogia kwane.
swahili: Lakini sijatumia hata mojawapo ya haki hizi. Nami siandiki haya nikitumaini kwamba mtanifanyia mambo hayo. Heri nife kuliko mtu yeyote kuninyima huku kujisifu kwangu.

english: Yet when I preach the gospel, I have no reason to boast, because I am obligated to preach. Woe to me if I do not preach the gospel!
ekegusii: Naki onye nkorandia enchiri, tindi neri ingwetogeria, ekiagera okobetererigwa kwabekirwe ase ’nde. Obobe nobwane ntarandeti enchiri!
swahili: Lakini ninapohubiri Injili siwezi kujisifu maana ninalazimika kuhubiri. Ole wangu nisipoihubiri Injili!

english: If my preaching is voluntary, I have a reward. But if it is not voluntary, I am still entrusted with a responsibility.
ekegusii: Naki onye ngokora emeremo eye ase ogwancha kwane, ninde neng’eria; korende onye tari ase ogwancha kwane, nonya nabo negenirwe noborendi.
swahili: Nikihubiri kwa hiari, ninayo thawabu. Lakini kama si kwa hiari, basi ninachofanya ni kutekeleza tu uwakili niliowekewa.

english: What then is my reward? That in preaching the gospel I may offer it free of charge, and so not use up my rights in preaching it. Paul the Servant to All
ekegusii: Gaki eng’eria yane ninki? Neye, ng’a ndandie enchiri ya Kristo ntari konyora ebintungetie, na tinsaba ebiaboronge biane ase okorandia enchiri. Omokia o Paulo bw’okorenta abanto ase Kristo
swahili: Basi je, thawabu yangu ni nini? Thawabu yangu ni hii: Ya kwamba katika kuhubiri Injili niitoe bila gharama, bila kutumia kwa utimilifu uwezo wangu nilio nao katika Injili.

english: Though I am free of obligation to anyone, I make myself a slave to everyone, to win as many as possible.
ekegusii: Naki nonya inde nobosibore korwa ase abanto bonsi, nekorire omosomba o bonsi, erinde ndete abanto abange kobua.
swahili: Ingawa mimi ni huru, wala si mtumwa wa mtu yeyote, nimejifanya kuwa mtumwa wa kila mtu, ili niweze kuwavuta wengi kadri iwezekanavyo.

english: Even if I am not an apostle to others, surely I am to you. For you are the seal of my apostleship in the Lord.
ekegusii: Naki onye inche tindi omotomwa ase abande, korende nomotomwa inde ase more inwe. Inwe nigo more ekemanyererio ki’obotomwa bwane ase Omonene.
swahili: Hata kama mimi si mtume kwa wengine, hakika mimi ni mtume kwenu, kwa maana ninyi ni mhuri wa utume wangu katika Bwana.

english: To the Jews I became like a Jew, to win the Jews. To those under the law I became like one under the law (though I myself am not under the law), to win those under the law.
ekegusii: Ase Abayahudi nkaba buna Omoyahudi, erinde mbarente Abayahudi; ase baria bare inse y’amachiiko nkaba buna oyore inse y’amachiiko (nonya inche omonyene tindi inse y’amachiiko) erinde mbarente baria bare inse y’amachiiko.
swahili: Kwa Wayahudi, nilikuwa kama Myahudi, ili niwapate Wayahudi. Kwa watu wale walio chini ya sheria, nilikuwa kama aliye chini ya sheria (ingawa mimi siko chini ya sheria), ili niweze kuwapata wale walio chini ya sheria.

english: To those without the law I became like one without the law (though I am not outside the law of God but am under the law of Christ), to win those without the law.
ekegusii: Ase baria batari namachiiko nkaba buna oyo otari namachiiko (tari buna tindi namachiiko ase obosio bwa Nyasae, korende nigo inde inse y’amachiiko a Kristo) erinde mbarente baria batari namachiiko.
swahili: Kwa watu wasio na sheria nilikuwa kama asiye na sheria (ingawa siko huru mbali na sheria ya Mungu, bali niko chini ya sheria ya Kristo), ili niweze kuwapata wale wasio na sheria.

english: To the weak I became weak, to win the weak. I have become all things to all people so that by all possible means I might save some.
ekegusii: Ase abare abareu nkaba omoreu, erinde mbarente abareu. Igo nkaba n’echingencho chionsi ase abanto bonsi, erinde inyare kobatooria abanto ase chinchera chionsi.
swahili: Kwa walio dhaifu nilikuwa dhaifu, ili niweze kuwapata walio dhaifu. Nimekuwa mtu wa hali zote kwa watu wote ili kwa njia yoyote niweze kuwaokoa baadhi yao.

english: I do all this for the sake of the gospel, so that I may share in its blessings. Run Your Race to Win
ekegusii: Na inche nigo ngokora aya onsi ase engencho y’enchiri, erinde inyare koba oyomo obo bw’abakonyora ogosesenigwa kwaye. Omokia ogwenerete ase obobui
swahili: Nafanya haya yote kwa ajili ya Injili, ili nipate kushiriki baraka zake.

english: Do you not know that in a race all the runners run, but only one receives the prize? Run in such a way as to take the prize.
ekegusii: Timomanyeti ng’a abwo bakoamererania ase okominyoka chimbero, nigo bakominyoka bonsi, korende noyomo bweka okonyora eng’eria? Minyoka boigo, erinde moyenyore.
swahili: Je, hamjui kwamba katika mashindano ya mbio wote wanaoshindana hukimbia, lakini ni mmoja wao tu apewaye tuzo? Kwa hiyo kimbieni katika mashindano kwa jinsi ambavyo mtapata tuzo.

english: Everyone who competes in the games trains with strict discipline. They do it for a crown that is perishable, but we do it for a crown that is imperishable.
ekegusii: Na kera oyokoamererania ase chigosori nigo agwetanga ase onsi. Na abwo nigo bagokora bo, erinde banyore egutwa egosareka, korende intwe tonyore eye etagosareka.
swahili: Kila mmoja anayeshiriki katika mashindano hufanya mazoezi makali. Wao hufanya hivyo ili wapokee taji isiyodumu, lakini sisi tunafanya hivyo ili kupata taji idumuyo milele.

english: Therefore I do not run aimlessly; I do not fight like I am beating the air.
ekegusii: Nonya ninche nkominyoka nde chimbero ntari gotiting’ara; naboigo inkorwanera chinkundi, tari buna oyokorwana nembeo.
swahili: Kwa hiyo mimi sikimbii kama mtu akimbiaye bila lengo, sipigani kama mtu anayepiga hewa,

english: No, I discipline my body and make it my slave, so that after I have preached to others, I myself will not be disqualified.
ekegusii: Korende nigo ngochanda omobere one na koyokoria buna omosomba, erinde konarandeirie abande, inche timba omonto ogocha kwangwa.
swahili: la, bali nautesa mwili wangu na kuutumikisha ili nikiisha kuwahubiria wengine, mimi nisiwe mtu wa kukataliwa.

english: This is my defense to those who scrutinize me:
ekegusii: Oko nakwo okoiraneria kwane ase baria bakomboria.
swahili: Huu ndio utetezi wangu kwa hao wanaokaa kunihukumu.

english: Have we no right to food and to drink?
ekegusii: Inee! Titori ne ribaga ri’okoria na konywa?
swahili: Je, hatuna haki ya kula na kunywa?

english: Have we no right to take along a believing wife, as do the other apostles and the Lord’s brothers and Cephas?
ekegusii: Titori ne ribaga koira amo naintwe omokungu ore oyominto ase okwegena buna abatomwa bande, na abamwabo Omonene, na Kefa bakorete?
swahili: Je, hatuna haki ya kusafiri na mke anayeamini, kama wanavyofanya mitume wengine na ndugu zake Bwana na Kefa?

english: Or are Barnabas and I the only apostles who must work for a living?
ekegusii: Gose ninche bweka na Barnaba totari ne ribaga ri’ogotiga emeremo ya kera rituko?
swahili: Au ni mimi na Barnaba tu inatubidi kufanya kazi ili tuweze kupata mahitaji yetu?

english: Who serves as a soldier at his own expense? Who plants a vineyard and does not eat of its fruit? Who tends a flock and does not drink of its milk?
ekegusii: Morwani ki okogenda ase esegi kero kende gionsi na kweakanera ere omonyene? Moremi ki otakoria amasabibu ’omogondo oye bw’emesabibu? Gose ning’o okorisia riicho, otakonywa amabeere aye?
swahili: Ni askari yupi aendaye vitani kwa gharama zake mwenyewe? Ni nani apandaye shamba la mizabibu na asile matunda yake? Ni nani achungaye kundi na asipate maziwa yake.

english: Do I say this from a human perspective? Doesn’t the Law say the same thing?
ekegusii: Inee! Nigo ngokwana aya buna Mwanyabaanto? Gose amachiiko tari goteeba boigo?
swahili: Je, nasema mambo haya katika mtazamo wa kibinadamu tu? Je, sheria haisemi vivyo hivyo?

english: For it is written in the Law of Moses: “Do not muzzle an ox while it is treading out the grain.” Is it about oxen that God is concerned?
ekegusii: Naki ase amachiiko a Musa nigo ariikire, “Tobaisa kobekera entang’ana ekeokio ekero ekoora endagera.” Inee! Nyasae narengereretie amang’ana e chintang’ana?
swahili: Kwa maana imeandikwa katika Sheria ya Mose: “Usimfunge maksai kinywa apurapo nafaka.” Je, Mungu hapa anahusika na ngʼombe?

english: That which was from the beginning, which we have heard, which we have seen with our own eyes, which we have gazed upon and touched with our own hands—this is the Word of life.
ekegusii: Nigo tokobarikera igoro y’ering’ana ri’obogima, erio riarengeo korwa omochakano, eri twaigwete, eri twaroche namaiso aito, eri twarigereretie, nonya namaboko aito akaribwata.
swahili: Tunawajulisha lile lililokuwepo tangu mwanzo, lile tulilosikia, ambalo tumeliona kwa macho yetu, ambalo tumelitazama na kuligusa kwa mikono yetu, kuhusu Neno la uzima.

english: If we say we have not sinned, we make Him out to be a liar, and His word is not in us.
ekegusii: Onye togoteeba ng’a titokoreti ebibe, twakorire Nyasae koba omonyaborimo, gose ring’ana riaye tiriri ime yaito.
swahili: Kama tukisema hatukutenda dhambi, twamfanya yeye kuwa mwongo na neno lake halimo ndani yetu.

english: And this is the life that was revealed; we have seen it and testified to it, and we proclaim to you the eternal life that was with the Father and was revealed to us.
ekegusii: Obogima obwo bokaorokigwa, na intwe tokaborora na kobobera kirori; na intwe igo tokabaraareria inwe obogima obwo bwa kare na kare, obwo bwarenge ase Tata na koorokigwa ase tore.
swahili: Uzima huo ulidhihirishwa; nasi tumeuona na kuushuhudia, nasi twawatangazia uzima wa milele, ambao ulikuwa pamoja na Baba, nao ukadhihirishwa kwetu.

english: We proclaim to you what we have seen and heard, so that you also may have fellowship with us. And this fellowship of ours is with the Father and with His Son, Jesus Christ.
ekegusii: Eri twarorire na koigwa, eri naboigo tokobaraareria inwe, erinde nainwe monyare kobwatana naintwe. Okobwatana gwaito nigo kore amo na Tata na Omwana oye Yeso Kristo.
swahili: Twawatangazia lile tuliloliona na kulisikia, ili nanyi mwe na ushirika nasi. Na ushirika wetu hasa ni pamoja na Baba na Mwanawe, Yesu Kristo.

english: We write these things so that our joy may be complete. Walking in the Light (John 8:12–29)
ekegusii: Nkobariikera tore aya, erinde omogooko oito oikeranigwe. Nyasae nomobaso
swahili: Tunaandika mambo haya ili furaha yetu ipate kuwa timilifu. Kutembea Nuruni

english: And this is the message we have heard from Him and announce to you: God is light, and in Him there is no darkness at all.
ekegusii: Aya naro amang’ana twaigwete korwa asare, na tokobaraareria inwe, ng’a Nyasae nomobaso, gose mosunte onde bwonsi tori ime asare.
swahili: Huu ndio ujumbe tuliosikia kutoka kwake na kuwatangazia ninyi: kwamba Mungu ni nuru na ndani yake hamna giza lolote.

english: If we say we have fellowship with Him yet walk in the darkness, we lie and do not practice the truth.
ekegusii: Onye togoteeba ng’a twabwatanire nere, naende togendererete ase omosunte, igo twatebiire oborimo, gose ayare ay’ekeene titori koyakora.
swahili: Kama tukisema kwamba twashirikiana naye huku tukienenda gizani, twasema uongo, wala hatutendi lililo kweli.

english: But if we walk in the light as He is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus His Son cleanses us from all sin.
ekegusii: Korende onye tokogenda ase omobaso, buna ere are ase omobaso, rirorio twabwatanire intwe ase intwe, na amanyinga a Yeso, Omwana oye, nigo agotosibia ebibe biaito bionsi.
swahili: Lakini tukienenda nuruni, kama yeye alivyo nuruni, twashirikiana sisi kwa sisi na damu yake Yesu, Mwana wake, yatusafisha dhambi yote.

english: If we say we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.
ekegusii: Onye togoteeba ng’a titori na bibe, iga tokweng’aina, gose ekeene tikeri ime yaito.
swahili: Kama tukisema kwamba hatuna dhambi, twajidanganya wenyewe wala kweli haimo ndani yetu.

english: If we confess our sins, He is faithful and just to forgive us our sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
ekegusii: Gatorabiorokie ebibe biaito, ere nomwegenwa na omonyene oboronge, natwabere ebibe biaito, na atosibie korwa ase ogotaba boronge gwonsi.
swahili: Kama tukiziungama dhambi zetu, yeye ni mwaminifu na wa haki, atatusamehe dhambi zetu na kutusafisha kutoka kwenye udhalimu wote.

english: My little children, I am writing these things to you so that you will not sin. But if anyone does sin, we have an advocate before the Father—Jesus Christ, the Righteous One.
ekegusii: Abana baane abake, nkobariikera nde aya, erinde timokora ebibe. Korende onye omonto okorire ebibe, ntore n’Omosaberi ase Tata, nere Yeso Kristo, Omonyene Oboronge.
swahili: Watoto wangu wapendwa, nawaandikia haya ili msitende dhambi. Lakini kama mtu yeyote akitenda dhambi, tunaye Mwombezi kwa Baba: ndiye Yesu Kristo, Mwenye Haki.

english: Whoever loves his brother remains in the light, and there is no cause of stumbling in him.
ekegusii: na ere oyobwanchete oyomwabo nigo amenyete ase omobaso, na ime asare gento tikeiyo keragere agochwe.
swahili: Yeye ampendaye ndugu yake anakaa nuruni, wala hakuna kitu chochote ndani yake cha kumkwaza.

english: But whoever hates his brother is in the darkness and walks in the darkness. He does not know where he is going, because the darkness has blinded his eyes.
ekegusii: Korende ere oyogechete oyomwabo nigo are ase omosunte ime, naende nigo akogenda ase omosunte, na tamanyeti nonya nase agochia, ekiagera omosunte omoukoirie amaiso aye.
swahili: Lakini yeyote amchukiaye ndugu yake, yuko gizani na anaenenda gizani, wala hajui anakokwenda, kwa sababu giza limempofusha macho.

english: I am writing to you, little children, because your sins have been forgiven through His name.
ekegusii: Nkobariikera nde inwe, abana baane, ekiagera ebibe biaino biaabeirwe ase engencho y’erieta riaye.
swahili: Nawaandikia ninyi, watoto wadogo, kwa sababu dhambi zenu zimesamehewa kwa ajili ya Jina lake.

english: I am writing to you, fathers, because you know Him who is from the beginning. I am writing to you, young men, because you have overcome the evil one. I have written to you, children, because you know the Father.
ekegusii: Nkobariikera nde inwe abaise, ekiagera momomanyete ere oyorengeo korwa omochakano. Nkobariikera nde inwe, abamura, ekiagera mwamobuire oria omobe. Nabarikerete inwe, abana abake, ekiagera momomanyete Tata.
swahili: Nawaandikia ninyi, akina baba, kwa sababu mmemjua yeye aliye tangu mwanzo. Nawaandikia ninyi vijana kwa sababu mmemshinda yule mwovu. Nawaandikia ninyi watoto wadogo, kwa sababu mmemjua Baba.

english: I have written to you, fathers, because you know Him who is from the beginning. I have written to you, young men, because you are strong, and the word of God abides in you, and you have overcome the evil one. Do Not Love the World
ekegusii: Nabarikerete inwe, abana bane, ekiagera momomanyete tata. Nabarikeire inwe aba Tata ekiagera momomanyete ere oyonge oo korwa omochakano. Nabarikerete inwe, abamura, ekiagera more ne chinguru, ne ring’ana ria Nyasae ndire ime yaino, na mwabuire oria omobe.
swahili: Nawaandikia ninyi akina baba, kwa sababu mmemjua yeye aliye tangu mwanzo. Nawaandikia ninyi vijana, kwa sababu mna nguvu, na neno la Mungu linakaa ndani yenu, nanyi mmemshinda yule mwovu. Msiupende Ulimwengu

english: Do not love the world or anything in the world. If anyone loves the world, the love of the Father is not in him.
ekegusii: Timwancha ense eye, nonya n’ebinto bire ase ense. Omonto karanche ense eye, obwanchani bwa Tata tibori ime yaye.
swahili: Msiupende ulimwengu wala mambo yaliyo ulimwenguni. Kama mtu yeyote akiupenda ulimwengu, upendo wa Baba haumo ndani yake.

english: For all that is in the world—the desires of the flesh, the desires of the eyes, and the pride of life—is not from the Father but from the world.
ekegusii: Naki bionsi ebire ase ense eye, okogania okobe kw’omobere, na okogania okobe kw’amaiso, na oboenenu bw’obogima obo, tibiri korua ase Tata, korende nigo bikorua ase ense.
swahili: Kwa maana kila kitu kilichomo ulimwenguni, yaani tamaa ya mwili, tamaa ya macho na kiburi cha uzima, havitokani na Baba bali hutokana na ulimwengu.

english: The world is passing away, along with its desires; but whoever does the will of God remains forever. Beware of Antichrists
ekegusii: Na ense eye nigo egoeta, na okogania kwaye, korende ere oyogokora ogwancha kwa Nyasae nigo akoba moyo goika kare na kare. Omobisa o Kristo
swahili: Nao ulimwengu unapita, pamoja na tamaa zake, bali yeye afanyaye mapenzi ya Mungu adumu milele. Onyo Dhidi Ya Wapinga Kristo

english: Children, it is the last hour; and just as you have heard that the antichrist is coming, so now many antichrists have appeared. This is how we know it is the last hour.
ekegusii: Abana baane abake, engaki eye ney’omoerio. Na buna mwaigwete ng’a omobisa o Kristo ngocha are, nonya mbono ababisa ba Kristo nabange baimokire. Ase ayio twamanyire ng’a engaki eye ney’omoerio.
swahili: Watoto wadogo, huu ni wakati wa mwisho! Kama mlivyosikia kwamba mpinga Kristo anakuja, hivyo basi wapinga Kristo wengi wamekwisha kuja. Kutokana na hili twajua kwamba huu ni wakati wa mwisho.

english: They went out from us, but they did not belong to us. For if they had belonged to us, they would have remained with us. But their departure made it clear that none of them belonged to us.
ekegusii: Abwo basokire korwa ase tore, korende tibarenge abaito. Naki onye nabaito baare, anga mbabete amo naintwe. Korende barureo, erinde emanyekane ng’a tari bonsi barenge abaito.
swahili: Walitoka kwetu, lakini hawakuwa wa kwetu hasa. Kwa maana kama wangelikuwa wa kwetu, wangelikaa pamoja nasi, lakini kutoka kwao kulionyesha kwamba hakuna hata mmoja wao aliyekuwa wa kwetu.

english: He Himself is the atoning sacrifice for our sins, and not only for ours but also for the sins of the whole world.
ekegusii: Ere nekeng’wanso gi’okobwatania ase ebibe biaito, gose tari ase ebibe biaito bioka, korende nase ebibe bi’ense yonsi.
swahili: Yeye ndiye dhabihu ya upatanisho kwa ajili ya dhambi zetu, wala si kwa ajili ya dhambi zetu tu, bali pia kwa ajili ya dhambi za ulimwengu wote.

english: You, however, have an anointing from the Holy One, and all of you know the truth.
ekegusii: Na inwe mwaakirwe amaguta nere oyore Omochenu, na mwamanyire onsi.
swahili: Lakini ninyi mmetiwa mafuta na yeye Aliye Mtakatifu, nanyi nyote mnaijua kweli.

english: I have not written to you because you lack knowledge of the truth, but because you have it, and because no lie comes from the truth.
ekegusii: Tinabarikerete inwe, ekiagera motamanyeti ekeene, korende nekiagera mokemanyete, naende momanyete ng’a borimo bonde tibori bokorwa ase ekeene.
swahili: Siwaandikii kwa sababu hamuijui kweli, bali kwa sababu mnaijua, nanyi mnajua hakuna uongo utokao katika kweli.

english: Who is the liar, if it is not the one who denies that Jesus is the Christ? This is the antichrist, who denies the Father and the Son.
ekegusii: Ning’o ore omonyaborimo otatiga ere oyogokaana ng’a Yeso tari ere Kristo? Oyogokaana Ise na Omwana, oyio nere omobisa o Kristo.
swahili: Je, mwongo ni nani? Mwongo ni mtu yule asemaye kwamba Yesu si Kristo. Mtu wa namna hiyo ndiye mpinga Kristo, yaani, yeye humkana Baba na Mwana.

english: Whoever denies the Son does not have the Father, but whoever confesses the Son has the Father as well. Remain in Christ
ekegusii: Onde bwensi ogokana Omwana tari na Ise. Ere oyokomobera Omwana kirori nigo are na Ise boigo.
swahili: Hakuna yeyote amkanaye Mwana aliye na Baba. Yeyote anayemkubali Mwana anaye na Baba pia.

english: As for you, let what you have heard from the beginning remain in you. If it does, you will also remain in the Son and in the Father.
ekegusii: Amang’ana aria mwaigwete korwa ritang’ani, tiga aikaranse ime yaino. Onye amang’ana aria mwaigwete korwa ritang’ani aikaransete ime yaino, erio nainwe namomenye ime ase Omwana, na ime ase Ise.
swahili: Hakikisheni kwamba lile mlilosikia tangu mwanzo linakaa ndani yenu. Kama lile mlilosikia tangu mwanzo linakaa ndani yenu, ninyi nanyi mtakaa ndani ya Mwana na ndani ya Baba.

english: And this is the promise that He Himself made to us: eternal life.
ekegusii: Eye nero eira atorierete intwe, ng’a tonyore obogima bwa kare na kare.
swahili: Hii ndiyo ahadi yake kwetu, yaani, uzima wa milele.

english: I have written these things to you about those who are trying to deceive you.
ekegusii: Nabarikeire amang’ana aya igoro y’abwo bakorigia kobasiria.
swahili: Nawaandikia mambo haya kuhusu wale watu ambao wanajaribu kuwapotosha.

english: And as for you, the anointing you received from Him remains in you, and you do not need anyone to teach you. But just as His true and genuine anointing teaches you about all things, so remain in Him as you have been taught.
ekegusii: Korende ogoakwa kw’amaguta okwo mwanyorete korwa ase Kristo nigo goikaransete ime yaino, na inwe timogwenereti monto onde aborokererie, ekiagera ogoakwa kw’amaguta okwo mwanyorire nkoborokererie amang’ana onsi, naende kore ogw’ekeene, gose tari oborimo. Na buna aborokereretie, menya ime ya Kristo.
swahili: Nanyi, upako mlioupata kutoka kwake unakaa ndani yenu, wala ninyi hamna haja ya mtu yeyote kuwafundisha. Lakini kama vile upako wake unavyowafundisha kuhusu mambo yote nayo ni kweli wala si uongo, basi kama ulivyowafundisha kaeni ndani yake. Watoto Wa Mungu

english: And now, little children, remain in Christ, so that when He appears, we may be confident and unashamed before Him at His coming.
ekegusii: Na bono inwe abana baane, menya ime asare, erinde ekero akoorokigwa tobe noboremu, titoba nobosooku ase obosio bwaye ekero arachiche.
swahili: Sasa basi, watoto wapendwa, kaeni ndani yake, ili atakapofunuliwa, tuwe na ujasiri, wala tusiaibike mbele zake wakati wa kuja kwake.

english: If you know that He is righteous, you also know that everyone who practices righteousness has been born of Him.
ekegusii: Onye mwamanyire ng’a ere nomonyene oboronge, naboigo mobe nobomaene ng’a kera oyogokora boronge, oyio oiboirwe nere.
swahili: Kama mkijua kuwa yeye ni mwenye haki, mwajua kwamba kila atendaye haki amezaliwa naye.

english: By this we can be sure that we have come to know Him: if we keep His commandments.
ekegusii: Onye tobwatete amachiiko aye, ntore nobomaene ng’a ntomomanyete.
swahili: Basi katika hili twajua ya kuwa tumemjua, tukizishika amri zake.

english: If anyone says, “I know Him,” but does not keep His commandments, he is a liar, and the truth is not in him.
ekegusii: Ere oyogoteeba, “Nimomanyete,” na tabwateti amachiiko aye, oyio nomonyaborimo, gose ekeene tikeri ime yaye.
swahili: Mtu yeyote asemaye kuwa, “Ninamjua,” lakini hazishiki amri zake, ni mwongo, wala ndani ya mtu huyo hamna kweli.

english: But if anyone keeps His word, the love of God has been truly perfected in him. By this we know that we are in Him:
ekegusii: Korende ere oyobwatete ring’ana riaye, ime ase oyio obwanchani bwa Nyasae bwaikeranigwe ekeene ekeene. Ase eri ntore nobomaene ng’a nigo tore ime asare:
swahili: Lakini mtu yeyote anayelitii neno lake, upendo wa Mungu umekamilika ndani yake kweli kweli. Katika hili twajua kuwa tumo ndani yake.

english: Whoever claims to abide in Him must walk as Jesus walked. A New Commandment
ekegusii: Ere oyogoteeba ng’a nigo amenyete ime asare, nagwenerete kogenda ere omonyene buna Yeso arenge kogenda. Ogochika okoyia
swahili: Yeyote anayesema anakaa ndani yake hana budi kuenenda kama Yesu alivyoenenda. Amri Mpya

english: Beloved, I am not writing to you a new commandment, but an old one, which you have had from the beginning. This commandment is the message you have heard.
ekegusii: Abanchani, timbarikereti ogochika okoyia, korende nkoria gwa kare mwarenge na korokwo korwa ritang’ani. Na ogochika koria gwa kare nakwo ring’ana riria mwaigwete.
swahili: Wapendwa, siwaandikii ninyi amri mpya bali ile ya zamani, ambayo mmekuwa nayo tangu mwanzo. Amri hii ya zamani ni lile neno mlilosikia.

english: Then again, I am also writing to you a new commandment, which is true in Him and also in you. For the darkness is fading and the true light is already shining.
ekegusii: Naende nkobariikera nde ogochika okoyia, okore ogw’ekeene ime yaye, na ime yaino, ekiagera omosunte ngoeta ore, na omobaso bw’ekeene oikire kobara.
swahili: Lakini nawaandikia amri mpya, yaani, lile neno lililo kweli ndani yake na ndani yenu, kwa sababu giza linapita na ile nuru ya kweli tayari inangʼaa.

english: If anyone claims to be in the light but hates his brother, he is still in the darkness.
ekegusii: Ere oyogoteeba ng’a nigo are ase omobaso ime, naende ogechete oyomwabo, nigo are ase omosunte ime nonya mbono,
swahili: Yeyote anayesema yumo nuruni lakini anamchukia ndugu yake bado yuko gizani.

english: Behold what manner of love the Father has given to us, that we should be called children of God. And that is what we are! The reason the world does not know us is that it did not know Him.
ekegusii: Rora, nobwanchani bore naki, obwo Tata atoeire, ng’a torokwe abana ba Nyasae, na naboigo tore! Naki ekegerete ense etatomanyeti neke, ng’a temomanyeti Nyasae.
swahili: Tazameni ni pendo kuu namna gani alilotupa Baba, kwamba sisi tuitwe wana wa Mungu! Na ndivyo tulivyo. Kwa sababu hii ulimwengu haututambui, kwa kuwa haukumtambua yeye.

english: By this the children of God are distinguished from the children of the devil: Anyone who does not practice righteousness is not of God, nor is anyone who does not love his brother. Love One Another (John 13:31–35; Romans 12:9–13)
ekegusii: Ase eri abana ba Nyasae nigo bare maiso marore, na abana ba Saitani boigo: Onde bwensi otari gokora boronge tarueti ase Nyasae, nonya noyo otancheti oyomwabo. Twanchane intwe ase intwe
swahili: Kwa jinsi hii tunaweza kujua dhahiri watoto wa Mungu na pia watoto wa ibilisi. Yeyote asiyetenda haki hatokani na Mungu, wala yeye asiyempenda ndugu yake. Mpendane Ninyi Kwa Ninyi

english: This is the message you have heard from the beginning: We should love one another.
ekegusii: Naki aya naro amang’ana mwaigwete korwa ritang’ani, ng’a twanchane intwe ase intwe.
swahili: Hili ndilo neno mlilolisikia tangu mwanzo: Kwamba imetupasa tupendane sisi kwa sisi.

english: Do not be like Cain, who belonged to the evil one and murdered his brother. And why did Cain slay him? Because his own deeds were evil, while those of his brother were righteous.
ekegusii: Titoba buna Kaini, oyorenge bw’oria omobe, agaita oyomwabo. Ere nigo amoitete ase ki? Kaini nigo aitete oyomwabo ekiagera ogokora kwaye kwarenge okobe, na okw’oyomwabo nigo kwarenge okwa boronge.
swahili: Msiwe kama Kaini aliyekuwa wa yule mwovu akamuua ndugu yake. Basi kwa nini alimuua? Ni kwa sababu matendo yake Kaini yalikuwa mabaya na ya ndugu yake yalikuwa ya haki.

english: So do not be surprised, brothers, if the world hates you.
ekegusii: Timokumia, baminto, onye abanto b’ense bakobagecha.
swahili: Ndugu zangu, ninyi msistaajabu kama ulimwengu ukiwachukia.

english: We know that we have passed from death to life, because we love our brothers. The one who does not love remains in death.
ekegusii: Intwe twamanyire ng’a twaetire korwa ase amakweri, twasoire ase obogima, ekiagera twanchire abaminto. Oyotancheti nigo amenyete ase amakweri.
swahili: Sisi tunajua ya kwamba tumepita mautini kuingia uzimani, kwa sababu tunawapenda ndugu. Kila asiyempenda ndugu yake akaa mautini.

english: Everyone who hates his brother is a murderer, and you know that eternal life does not reside in a murderer.
ekegusii: Onde bwensi ogechete oyomwabo oyio nomoiti, na inwe momanyete ng’a omoiti tari nobogima bwa kare na kare ime yaye.
swahili: Yeyote amchukiaye ndugu yake ni muuaji, nanyi mwajua ya kwamba muuaji hana uzima wa milele ndani yake.

english: By this we know what love is: Jesus laid down His life for us, and we ought to lay down our lives for our brothers.
ekegusii: Ase eri twamanyire obwanchani: Kristo nigo aruete obogima bwaye ase engencho yaito. Naboigo naintwe ntogwenerete korua obogima bwaito ase engencho y’abaminto.
swahili: Kwa namna hii twaweza kulijua pendo la Mungu: Kwa sababu Yesu Kristo aliutoa uhai wake kwa ajili yetu. Nasi imetupasa kuutoa uhai kwa ajili ya hao ndugu.

english: If anyone with earthly possessions sees his brother in need, but withholds his compassion from him, how can the love of God abide in him?
ekegusii: Korende oyore n’ebinto bi’ense, na arore oyomwabo oremeire, gotamororera amaabera, Inee, naki obwanchani bwa Nyasae borabe ime asare oyio?
swahili: Ikiwa mtu anavyo vitu vya ulimwengu huu na akamwona ndugu yake ni mhitaji lakini asimhurumie, upendo wa Mungu wakaaje ndani ya mtu huyo?

english: Little children, let us love not in word and speech, but in action and truth.
ekegusii: Abana baane, titwancha ase amang’ana gose ase ogokwana, korende ase ogokora, na ase ekeene. Oboremu ase obosio bwa Nyasae
swahili: Watoto wapendwa, tusipende kwa maneno au kwa ulimi bali kwa tendo na kweli.

english: And by this we will know that we belong to the truth, and will assure our hearts in His presence:
ekegusii: Ase eri natomanye ng’a nigo tore ab’ekeene, na ase obosio bwaye natoremie chinkoro chiaito.
swahili: Basi hivi ndivyo tutakavyoweza kujua ya kuwa sisi tu wa kweli na hivyo twaithibitisha mioyo yetu mbele za Mungu

english: Beloved, we are now children of God, and what we will be has not yet been revealed. We know that when Christ appears, we will be like Him, for we will see Him as He is.
ekegusii: Abanchani, bono nabana ba Nyasae tore, korende teraorokigwa buna torache koba. Naki twamanyire ng’a ekero araorokigwe ntogwekane nere, ekiagera natomoorore buna are.
swahili: Wapendwa, sasa tu wana wa Mungu, lakini bado haijadhihirika tutakavyokuwa, lakini twajua ya kwamba yeye atakapodhihirishwa, tutafanana naye, kwa maana tutamwona kama alivyo.

english: Even if our hearts condemn us, God is greater than our hearts, and He knows all things.
ekegusii: Onye chinkoro chiaito chigotogambia, Nyasae nomonene kobua chinkoro chiaito, na ere nigo amanyete onsi.
swahili: kila mara mioyo yetu inapotuhukumu. Kwa maana Mungu ni mkuu kuliko mioyo yetu, naye anajua kila kitu.

english: Beloved, if our hearts do not condemn us, we have confidence before God,
ekegusii: Abanchani, onye chinkoro chiaito tichigotogambia, rirorio ntore noboremu ase obosio bwa Nyasae,
swahili: Wapendwa, kama mioyo yetu haituhukumu, tunao ujasiri mbele za Mungu,

english: and we will receive from Him whatever we ask, because we keep His commandments and do what is pleasing in His sight.
ekegusii: na rinde rionsi togosaba nigo tokorinyora korwa asare, ekiagera ntobwatete amachiiko aye, naende igo tokoyakora ayakomogwenera.
swahili: lolote tuombalo, twalipokea kutoka kwake, kwa sababu tumezitii amri zake na kutenda yale yanayompendeza.

english: And this is His commandment: that we should believe in the name of His Son, Jesus Christ, and we should love one another just as He commanded us.
ekegusii: Na oko nakwo ogochika kwaye, ng’a toriegene erieta ri’Omwana oye Yeso Kristo, na gwanchana intwe ase intwe buna atochiikerete.
swahili: Hii ndiyo amri yake: kwamba tuliamini Jina la Mwanawe, Yesu Kristo, na kupendana sisi kwa sisi kama yeye alivyotuamuru.

english: Whoever keeps His commandments remains in God, and God in him. And by this we know that He remains in us: by the Spirit He has given us.
ekegusii: Na bonsi ababwatete amachiiko aye nigo bamenyete ime asare na ere ime ase bare. Na igo twamanyire ng’a ere nigo amenyete ime ase tore, twayamanyire korwa ase Omoika oria atoeire.
swahili: Wale wote wanaozishika amri zake hukaa ndani yake na yeye ndani yao. Hivi ndivyo tunavyojua kwamba anakaa ndani yetu. Nasi twajua hili kwa njia ya Roho yule aliyetupa.

english: And everyone who has this hope in Him purifies himself, just as Christ is pure.
ekegusii: Na monto onde bwensi omosemeretie nigo agwechena buna Kristo are omochenu.
swahili: Kila mmoja mwenye matumaini haya ndani yake hujitakasa, kama vile yeye alivyo mtakatifu.

english: Everyone who practices sin practices lawlessness as well. Indeed, sin is lawlessness.
ekegusii: Onde bwensi ogokora ebibe, nigo agosaria amachiiko, ekiagera ebibe nogosaria kw’amachiiko.
swahili: Kila mtu atendaye dhambi afanya uasi, kwa kuwa dhambi ni uasi.

english: But you know that Christ appeared to take away sins, and in Him there is no sin.
ekegusii: Na inwe mwamanyire ng’a Kristo nigo aorogetigwe erinde arusie ebibe biaito, na bibe tibiri ime yaye.
swahili: Lakini mwajua ya kuwa yeye alidhihirishwa ili aziondoe dhambi, wala ndani yake hamna dhambi.

english: No one who remains in Him keeps on sinning. No one who continues to sin has seen Him or known Him.
ekegusii: Onde bwensi omenyete ime asare tagokora ebibe; onde bwensi ogokora ebibe tamorochi, nonya nkomomanya tamomanyeti.
swahili: Kila mtu akaaye ndani yake hatendi dhambi. Kila mtu atendaye dhambi hakumwona yeye wala hakumtambua.

english: Little children, let no one deceive you: The one who practices righteousness is righteous, just as Christ is righteous.
ekegusii: Abana baane, monto onde tabaisa kobang’aina. Ere oyogokora oboronge nigo are omonyene oboronge, buna Kristo are omonyene oboronge.
swahili: Watoto wapendwa, mtu yeyote asiwadanganye. Kila mtu atendaye haki ana haki, kama yeye alivyo na haki.

english: The one who practices sin is of the devil, because the devil has been sinning from the very start. This is why the Son of God was revealed, to destroy the works of the devil.
ekegusii: Ere oyogokora ebibe noyo o Saitani, ekiagera Saitani nigo akorete ebibe korwa omochakano. Ekiagerete Omwana o Nyasae akaorokigwa neke, ng’a asarie emeremo ya Saitani.
swahili: Yeye atendaye dhambi ni wa ibilisi, kwa sababu ibilisi amekuwa akitenda dhambi tangu mwanzo. Kwa kusudi hili Mwana wa Mungu alidhihirishwa, ili aziangamize kazi za ibilisi.

english: Anyone born of God refuses to practice sin, because God’s seed abides in him; he cannot go on sinning, because he has been born of God.
ekegusii: Kera omonto oiboirwe na Nyasae tagokora ebibe, ekiagera oroiboro rwa Nyasae ndotigarete ime yaye, gose takonyara gokora ebibe, ekiagera oiboirwe na Nyasae.
swahili: Yeyote aliyezaliwa na Mungu hatendi dhambi, kwa sababu uzao wa Mungu wakaa ndani yake, wala hawezi kutenda dhambi kwa sababu amezaliwa na Mungu.

english: Beloved, do not believe every spirit, but test the spirits to see whether they are from God. For many false prophets have gone out into the world.
ekegusii: Abanchani, timwegena kera omoika, moteeme emeika onye neya Nyasae, ekiagera ababani b’oborimo abange basokire gochia ase ense.
swahili: Wapendwa, msiamini kila roho, bali zijaribuni hizo roho mwone kama zimetoka kwa Mungu, kwa sababu manabii wengi wa uongo wametokea ulimwenguni.

english: And love consists in this: not that we loved God, but that He loved us and sent His Son as the atoning sacrifice for our sins.
ekegusii: Obo nabwo obwanchani, tari ng’a nintwe twamwanchete Nyasae, korende nere otwanchete intwe, agatoma Omwana oye koba ekeng’wanso gi’okobwatania ase ebibe biaito.
swahili: Hili ndilo pendo: si kwamba tulimpenda Mungu, bali yeye alitupenda, akamtuma Mwanawe, ili yeye awe dhabihu ya upatanisho kwa ajili ya dhambi zetu.

english: Beloved, if God so loved us, we also ought to love one another.
ekegusii: Abanchani, onye Nyasae otwanchete igo, netogwenerete naintwe boigo gwanchana intwe ase intwe.
swahili: Marafiki wapendwa, kama Mungu alivyotupenda sisi, imetupasa na sisi kupendana.

english: No one has ever seen God; but if we love one another, God remains in us, and His love is perfected in us.
ekegusii: Monto onde tari ororire Nyasae kero kende gionsi. Gatoranchane intwe ase intwe, Nyasae nigo amenyete ime ase tore, na obwanchani bwaye bwaikeranigwe ime yaito.
swahili: Hakuna mtu yeyote aliyemwona Mungu wakati wowote. Lakini tukipendana, Mungu anakaa ndani yetu, na pendo lake limekamilika ndani yetu.

english: By this we know that we remain in Him, and He in us: He has given us of His Spirit.
ekegusii: Ase eri twamanyire ng’a ntomenyete ime asare, nere ime ase tore: Ere otoeire Omoika oye.
swahili: Tunajua kwamba twakaa ndani yake na yeye ndani yetu, kwa sababu ametupa sisi sehemu ya Roho wake.

english: And we have seen and testify that the Father has sent His Son to be the Savior of the world.
ekegusii: Na intwe twarorire, naende twabeire birori ng’a Ise otomire Omwana oye koba Omotooria bw’ense.
swahili: Nasi tumeona na kushuhudia kwamba Baba amemtuma Mwanawe ili awe Mwokozi wa ulimwengu.

english: If anyone confesses that Jesus is the Son of God, God abides in him, and he in God.
ekegusii: Onde bwensi okoorokia ng’a Yeso n’Omwana o Nyasae, Nyasae nigo amenyete ime asare, na ere ime ase Nyasae.
swahili: Kila akiriye kwamba Yesu ni Mwana wa Mungu, basi Mungu hukaa ndani yake, naye ndani ya Mungu.

english: And we have come to know and believe the love that God has for us. God is love; whoever abides in love abides in God, and God in him.
ekegusii: Na intwe twamanyire obwanchani obo Nyasae are naborobwo ase tore, na kobwegena. Nyasae nobwanchani, na ere oyomenyete ase obwanchani nigo amenyete ime ase Nyasae, na Nyasae ime asare.
swahili: Hivyo nasi twajua na kulitumainia pendo la Mungu alilo nalo kwa ajili yetu. Mungu ni Upendo. Kila akaaye katika upendo hukaa ndani ya Mungu na Mungu hukaa ndani yake.

english: In this way, love has been perfected among us, so that we may have confidence on the day of judgment; for in this world we are just like Him.
ekegusii: Ase eri obwanchani bwaikeranigwe ime yaito, erinde tobe noboremu ase rituko ri’ekiina, ekiagera buna ere are, naboigo naintwe tore ase ense eye.
swahili: Kwa njia hii, pendo hukamilishwa miongoni mwetu ili tupate kuwa na ujasiri katika siku ya hukumu, kwa sababu kama alivyo ndivyo tulivyo sisi katika ulimwengu huu.
