english: There is no fear in love, but perfect love drives out fear, because fear involves punishment. The one who fears has not been perfected in love.
ekegusii: Obwanchani tibori nobwoba, korende obwanchani oboikeranu nigo bogoseria obwoba gochia isiko. Naki obwoba mbore negesusuro, na oyore nobwoba taikeraniri ase obwanchani.
swahili: Katika pendo hakuna hofu. Lakini pendo lililo kamili huitupa nje hofu, kwa sababu hofu inahusika na adhabu. Kila mwenye hofu hakukamilika katika pendo.

english: We love because He first loved us.
ekegusii: Intwe twanchire, ekiagera ere natwanchete intwe ritang’ani.
swahili: Twampenda yeye kwa sababu yeye alitupenda kwanza.

english: By this you will know the Spirit of God: Every spirit that confesses that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is from God,
ekegusii: Ase eri nario moramanye Omoika o Nyasae: Kera omoika oyokoorokia Yeso Kristo, ng’a ochire ase omobere, oyio noyo o Nyasae,
swahili: Hivi ndivyo mnavyoweza kutambua Roho wa Mungu: Kila roho inayokubali kwamba Yesu Kristo amekuja katika mwili yatoka kwa Mungu.

english: If anyone says, “I love God,” but hates his brother, he is a liar. For anyone who does not love his brother, whom he has seen, cannot love God, whom he has not seen.
ekegusii: Omonto karatebe, “Nimwanchete Nyasae,” naende ogechete oyomwabo, oyio nomonyaborimo. Ere oyotamwancheti oyomwabo oyio aroche, takonyara komwancha Nyasae oyio atarochi.
swahili: Ikiwa mtu atasema, “Nampenda Mungu,” lakini anamchukia ndugu yake, yeye ni mwongo. Kwa maana kila mtu asiyempenda ndugu yake ambaye anamwona, atampendaje Mungu asiyemuona?

english: And we have this commandment from Him: Whoever loves God must love his brother as well.
ekegusii: Oko nakwo ogochika twaeirwe nere: Ere oyomwanchete Nyasae anche noyomwabo boigo.
swahili: Naye ametupa amri hii: Yeyote anayempenda Mungu lazima pia ampende ndugu yake.

english: and every spirit that does not confess Jesus is not from God. This is the spirit of the antichrist, which you have heard is coming and which is already in the world at this time.
ekegusii: korende kera omoika otakoorokia Yeso igo, oyio tori oyo o Nyasae. Oyio noro omoika bw’omobisa o Kristo; oyio mwaigure ng’a ngocha are, na bono oikire gocha ase ense ime.
swahili: Lakini kila roho ambayo haimkubali Yesu haitoki kwa Mungu. Hii ndiyo roho ya mpinga Kristo, ambayo mmesikia kwamba inakuja na sasa tayari iko ulimwenguni.

english: You, little children, are from God and have overcome them, because greater is He who is in you than he who is in the world.
ekegusii: Abana baane, inwe naba Nyasae more, naende mwabuire baria, ekiagera ere oyore ime ase more nomonene kobua ere oyore ime ase ense.
swahili: Watoto wapendwa, ninyi mmetokana na Mungu, nanyi mmewashinda kwa sababu yeye aliye ndani yenu ni mkuu kuliko yeye aliye katika ulimwengu.

english: They are of the world. That is why they speak from the world’s perspective, and the world listens to them.
ekegusii: Abwo nab’ense bare. Ase ayio, ayabagokwana nay’ense, na ense igo ekobaigwa.
swahili: Wao wanatokana na ulimwengu na kwa hiyo hunena yaliyo ya ulimwengu, hivyo ulimwengu huwasikiliza.

english: We are from God. Whoever knows God listens to us; whoever is not from God does not listen to us. That is how we know the Spirit of truth and the spirit of deception. Love Comes from God
ekegusii: Intwe nigo tore aba Nyasae. Ere oyomanyete Nyasae nigo agotoigwa, na ere oyotari o Nyasae tagotoigwa. Ase eri twamanyire gwatanana Omoika bw’ekeene, na omoika bw’ogosira. Nyasae nobwanchani
swahili: Sisi twatokana na Mungu na yeyote anayemjua Mungu hutusikiliza, lakini asiyetokana na Mungu hatusikilizi. Hivi ndivyo tunavyoweza kutambua Roho wa Kweli na roho ya upotovu. Mungu Ni Pendo

english: Beloved, let us love one another, because love comes from God. Everyone who loves has been born of God and knows God.
ekegusii: Abanchani, twanchane, ekiagera obwanchani nigo bokorwa ase Nyasae, na kera oyobwanchire oiboirwe na Nyasae, naende namomanyete Nyasae.
swahili: Wapendwa, tupendane, kwa kuwa pendo latoka kwa Mungu. Kila apendaye amezaliwa na Mungu, naye anamjua Mungu.

english: Whoever does not love does not know God, because God is love.
ekegusii: Oyotancheti, tamomanyeti Nyasae, ekiagera Nyasae nobwanchani.
swahili: Yeye asiyependa hamjui Mungu, kwa sababu Mungu ni pendo.

english: This is how God’s love was revealed among us: God sent His one and only Son into the world, so that we might live through Him.
ekegusii: Ase eri obwanchani bwa Nyasae bwarorekanire ase tore: Nyasae otomire Omwana oye omomoima ase ense, erinde tonyore obogima asare.
swahili: Hivi ndivyo Mungu alivyoonyesha pendo lake kwetu: Mungu alimtuma Mwanawe wa pekee ulimwenguni, ili tupate uzima kupitia kwake.

english: Everyone who believes that Jesus is the Christ has been born of God, and everyone who loves the Father also loves those born of Him.
ekegusii: Kera omonto oyobwegenete ng’a Yeso nere Kristo oiboirwe na Nyasae, na kera oyoramwanche omoibori, omwanchire na oyoiboirwe nere.
swahili: Kila mtu anayeamini kwamba Yesu ndiye Kristo amezaliwa na Mungu, na yeyote ampendaye Baba humpenda pia mtoto aliyezaliwa naye.

english: Whoever believes in the Son of God has this testimony within him; whoever does not believe God has made Him out to be a liar, because he has not believed in the testimony that God has given about His Son.
ekegusii: Ere oyomwegenire Omwana o Nyasae nare noborori obwo ime yaye. Ere oyotamwegeneti Nyasae omokorire koba omonyaborimo, ekiagera tegeneti oborori boria Nyasae aorokirie igoro y’Omwana oye.
swahili: Kila mtu amwaminiye Mwana wa Mungu anao huu ushuhuda moyoni mwake. Kila mtu asiyemwamini Mungu amemfanya yeye kuwa mwongo, kwa sababu hakuamini ushuhuda Mungu alioutoa kuhusu Mwanawe.

english: And this is that testimony: God has given us eternal life, and this life is in His Son.
ekegusii: Naki obo nabwo oborori, ng’a Nyasae otoeire obogima bwa kare na kare, na obogima obo nigo bore ime ase Omwana oye.
swahili: Huu ndio ushuhuda: kwamba Mungu ametupa uzima wa milele, nao huo uzima umo katika Mwanawe.

english: Whoever has the Son has life; whoever does not have the Son of God does not have life. Effective Prayer
ekegusii: Ere oyore n’Omwana, nare nobogima; ere oyotari n’Omwana o Nyasae, tari nobogima. Okomanya obogima bwa kare na kare
swahili: Aliye naye Mwana wa Mungu anao uzima, yeye asiye na Mwana wa Mungu hana uzima. Maneno Ya Mwisho

english: I have written these things to you who believe in the name of the Son of God, so that you may know that you have eternal life.
ekegusii: Nabarikeire inwe amang’ana aya, erinde momanye ng’a more nobogima bwa kare na kare, inwe abwo mwariegenire erieta ri’Omwana o Nyasae.
swahili: Nawaandikia mambo haya ninyi mnaoliamini Jina la Mwana wa Mungu ili mpate kujua ya kuwa mnao uzima wa milele.

english: And this is the confidence that we have before Him: If we ask anything according to His will, He hears us.
ekegusii: Oko nakwo ogosemeria tore nakwo asare, ng’a gatoramosabe gento kende gionsi koreng’ana nogwancha kwaye, nigo aratoigwe.
swahili: Huu ndio ujasiri tulio nao tunapomkaribia Mungu, kwamba kama tukiomba kitu sawasawa na mapenzi yake, atusikia.

english: And if we know that He hears us in whatever we ask, we know that we already possess what we have asked of Him.
ekegusii: Na gatomanyete ng’a nigo agotoigwa ase kende gionsi togosaba, twamanyire ng’a twanyorire keria twasabire korwa asare.
swahili: Nasi kama tunajua atusikia, lolote tuombalo, tunajua ya kwamba tumekwisha kupata zile haja tulizomwomba.

english: If anyone sees his brother committing a sin not leading to death, he should ask God, who will give life to those who commit this kind of sin. There is a sin that leads to death; I am not saying he should ask regarding that sin.
ekegusii: Omonto kararore oyomwabo ogokora ebibe bitari bi’amakweri, amosabere, na Nyasae namoe obogima; aya nase abwo bagokora ebibe bitari bi’amakweri. Mbireo ebibe bi’amakweri; tintebeti ng’a asabe ase engencho y’ebio.
swahili: Kama mtu akimwona ndugu yake akitenda dhambi isiyo ya mauti, inampasa aombe, naye Mungu atampa uzima mtu huyo. Ninamaanisha wale ambao dhambi yao si ya mauti. Iko dhambi ya mauti, sisemi kwamba utaomba kwa ajili ya hiyo.

english: All unrighteousness is sin, yet there is sin that does not lead to death. The True God
ekegusii: Bionsi ebitari ebiaboronge nebibe, korende mbireo ebibe bitari ebi’amakweri.
swahili: Jambo lolote lisilo la haki ni dhambi, lakini iko dhambi isiyo ya mauti.

english: We know that anyone born of God does not keep on sinning; the One who was born of God protects him, and the evil one cannot touch him.
ekegusii: Twamanyire ng’a kera omonto oiboirwe na Nyasae tagokora ebibe, korende oyoiboirwe na Nyasae nigo akwerenda, na oria omobe takomokuna.
swahili: Tunajua ya kuwa yeye aliyezaliwa na Mungu hatendi dhambi, bali aliyezaliwa na Mungu hujilinda, wala yule mwovu hawezi kumdhuru.

english: We know that we are of God, and that the whole world is under the power of the evil one.
ekegusii: Twamanyire ng’a nigo tore aba Nyasae, na ense yonsi nigo ere inse y’okobua kw’oria omobe.
swahili: Sisi twajua kuwa tu watoto wa Mungu na ya kwamba ulimwengu wote uko chini ya utawala wa yule mwovu.

english: By this we know that we love the children of God: when we love God and keep His commandments.
ekegusii: Ase ring’ana eri twamanyire ng’a twabanchire abana ba Nyasae ekero twamwanchire Nyasae, na kobwata amachiiko aye.
swahili: Hivi ndivyo tunavyojua kwamba tunawapenda watoto wa Mungu, kwa kumpenda Mungu na kuzitii amri zake.

english: And we know that the Son of God has come and has given us understanding, so that we may know Him who is true; and we are in Him who is true—in His Son Jesus Christ. He is the true God and eternal life.
ekegusii: Twamanyire ng’a Omwana o Nyasae oikire gocha, na ere otoeire ebirengererio bi’okomanya ere oyore bw’ekeene. Na intwe nigo tore ime asare ere oyore bw’ekeene, ime ase Omwana oye Yeso Kristo. Oyio nere ore Nyasae bw’ekeene, naende obogima bwa kare na kare.
swahili: Nasi pia twajua ya kwamba Mwana wa Mungu amekuja, naye ametupa sisi ufahamu ili tupate kumjua yeye aliye Kweli. Nasi tumo ndani yake yeye aliye Kweli, yaani, ndani ya Yesu Kristo Mwanawe. Yeye ndiye Mungu wa kweli na uzima wa milele.

english: Little children, keep yourselves from idols.
ekegusii: Abana baane, erende inwe abanyene korwa ase emegwekano y’ogosasimwa.
swahili: Watoto wapendwa, jilindeni nafsi zenu kutokana na sanamu. Amen.

english: For this is the love of God, that we keep His commandments. And His commandments are not burdensome,
ekegusii: Naki okomwancha Nyasae nario okobwata amachiiko aye, na amachiiko aye tari amarito.
swahili: Huku ndiko kumpenda Mungu, yaani, kuzitii amri zake. Nazo amri zake si nzito.

english: because everyone born of God overcomes the world. And this is the victory that has overcome the world: our faith.
ekegusii: Kera oyoiboirwe na Nyasae nigo akobua ense, na oko nakwo okobua korabue ense, okwegena gwaito.
swahili: Kwa maana kila aliyezaliwa na Mungu huushinda ulimwengu. Huku ndiko kushinda kuushindako ulimwengu, yaani, hiyo imani yetu.

english: Who then overcomes the world? Only he who believes that Jesus is the Son of God.
ekegusii: Oyorabue ense ning’o, otatiga ere oyobwegenire ng’a Yeso n’Omwana o Nyasae? Oborori igoro y’Omwana o Nyasae
swahili: Ni nani yule aushindaye ulimwengu? Ni yule tu aaminiye kwamba Yesu ni Mwana wa Mungu. Ushuhuda Kuhusu Mwana Wa Mungu

english: This is the One who came by water and blood, Jesus Christ—not by water alone, but by water and blood. And it is the Spirit who testifies to this, because the Spirit is the truth.
ekegusii: Yeso Kristo, nere oyo ochete ase amaache na amanyinga, tari ase amaache oka, korende ase amaache na amanyinga.
swahili: Huyu ndiye alikuja kwa maji na damu, yaani, Yesu Kristo. Hakuja kwa maji peke yake, bali kwa maji na damu. Naye Roho ndiye ashuhudiaye, kwa sababu Roho ndiye kweli.

english: For there are three that testify:
ekegusii: Na Omoika noro obeire kirori, ekiagera Omoika noro ekeene.
swahili: Kwa maana wako watatu washuhudiao[ mbinguni: hao ni Baba, Neno na Roho Mtakatifu. Hawa watatu ni umoja.

english: the Spirit, the water, and the blood—and these three are in agreement. God’s Testimony about His Son
ekegusii: Mbire birori bitato: Omoika, na amaache, na amanyinga, na ebi bitato nigo bikorua oborori obomo.
swahili: Pia wako mashahidi watatu duniani]: Roho, Maji na Damu; hawa watatu wanakubaliana katika umoja.

english: Even if we accept human testimony, the testimony of God is greater. For this is the testimony that God has given about His Son.
ekegusii: Onye togwancha oborori bwa Mwanyabaanto, oborori bwa Nyasae nobonene kobua, na oborori bwa Nyasae nobo, ng’a oikire kobeera Omwana oye kirori.
swahili: Kama tunaukubali ushuhuda wa wanadamu, basi ushuhuda wa Mungu ni mkuu zaidi, kwa kuwa huu ndio ushuhuda wa Mungu kwamba amemshuhudia Mwanawe.

english: Now when the queen of Sheba heard about the fame of Solomon concerning the name of the LORD, she came to test him with difficult questions.
ekegusii: Ekero eting’ana ya Seba aigwete chinkuma chia Sulemani igoro y’ayio akorete ase engencho y’erieta ri’Omonene, agacha komoteema ase okomobooria amang’ana amakong’u.
swahili: Malkia wa Sheba aliposikia habari za umaarufu wa Solomoni na uhusiano wake na jina la Bwana, akaja kumjaribu kwa maswali magumu.

english: Then she gave the king 120 talents of gold, a great quantity of spices, and precious stones. Never again was such an abundance of spices brought in as those the queen of Sheba gave to King Solomon.
ekegusii: Erio eting’ana eria akaa omorwoti ebiegwa ebio arentete: Chitaabu chikiro chilifu isano (5,000), na ebinsari ebinge mono, na amagena e rigori rinene. Naende ebinsari tibiarentetwe kero kende gionsi ebinge koreng’ana buna biria eting’ana ya Seba yarenterete omorwoti Sulemani.
swahili: Naye akampa mfalme talanta 120 za dhahabu, kiasi kikubwa sana cha vikolezi na vito vya thamani. Haikuwahi kamwe kuletwa tena vikolezi vingi hivyo kuletwa kama vile malkia wa Sheba alivyompa Mfalme Solomoni.

english: (The fleet of Hiram that brought gold from Ophir also brought from Ophir a great cargo of almug wood and precious stones.
ekegusii: Chimeeri chia Hiramu, chiria chiarentete chitaabu korwa Ofiri, chikarenta naende korwa aroro chibao chi’emete ekorokwa alumugu chinyinge mono, na amagena e rigori rinene.
swahili: (Meli za Hiramu zilileta dhahabu kutoka Ofiri; tena kutoka huko zilileta shehena kubwa ya miti ya msandali na vito vya thamani.

english: The king made the almug wood into steps for the house of the LORD and for the king’s palace, and into lyres and harps for the singers. Never before had such almug wood been brought in, nor has such been seen to this day.)
ekegusii: Korwa ase chibao chi’alumugu omorwoti akaroisia ebinto bi’enyomba y’Omonene, na ebi’enyomba y’omorwoti, naende akaroisia amakano na ebinto binde bikobugigwa nabateri. Chibao chi’emete buna eyio tichiana kororekana naende nonya ng’ake ase ense eye.
swahili: Mfalme akatumia miti ya msandali kuwa nguzo ya Hekalu la Bwana na kwa jumba la kifalme, pia kwa kutengeneza vinubi na zeze kwa ajili ya waimbaji. Kiasi hicho kingi cha msandali hakijawahi kuingizwa au kuonekana humo tangu siku ile.)

english: King Solomon gave the queen of Sheba all she desired—whatever she asked—besides what he had given her out of his royal bounty. Then she left and returned to her own country, along with her servants. Solomon’s Wealth and Splendor (2 Chronicles 1:14–17; 2 Chronicles 9:13–28)
ekegusii: Omorwoti Sulemani akaa eting’ana ya Seba ebinto bionsi aganetie na aboretie aegwe. Amo n’ebinto ebio Sulemani akamoa ebinto binde ebinge buna omorwoti anarete korua ebiegwa. Erio eting’ana eria akairana, akagenda ase ense yaye amo nabasomba baye. Obotenenku bw’omorwoti Sulemani (2 Amg 9:13-29)
swahili: Mfalme Solomoni akampa malkia wa Sheba kila kitu alichotamani na kukiomba, kando na vile mfalme alivyokuwa amempa kwa ukarimu wake wa kifalme. Kisha malkia akaondoka na kurudi katika nchi yake, yeye na watumishi wake. Fahari Ya Solomoni (2 Nyakati 9:13-28)

english: The weight of gold that came to Solomon each year was 666 talents,
ekegusii: Etaabu yaare korentwa ase Sulemani kera omwaka nigo yarenge goetania chikiro chilifu emerongo ebere na isato (23,000).
swahili: Uzito wa dhahabu ambayo Solomoni alipokea kwa mwaka ulikuwa talanta 666,

english: not including the revenue from the merchants, traders, and all the Arabian kings and governors of the land.
ekegusii: Boigo chitaabu chikarentwa korwa ase abaonchoreria b’ebinto, na baria baarenge korenta ebinto korwa ase chinse chia isiko, na korwa ase abarwoti bonsi b’Arabia na abagabana bande baarenge goakana ebango ase omorwoti.
swahili: mbali na mapato kutoka kwa wafanyabiashara na wachuuzi, na kutoka kwa wafalme wote wa Kiarabu na watawala wa nchi.

english: King Solomon made two hundred large shields of hammered gold; six hundred shekels of gold went into each shield.
ekegusii: Omorwoti Sulemani akaroisia chinguba amagana abere, agachiooma ne chitaabu chisunyuntire, na kera eng’aya nigo yarenge koira chitaabu chikiro isato na ekeng’ese.
swahili: Mfalme Solomoni akatengeneza ngao kubwa 200 kwa dhahabu iliyofuliwa; kila ngao ilikuwa na dhahabu yenye uzito wa shekeli 600

english: He also made three hundred small shields of hammered gold; three minas of gold went into each shield. And the king put them in the House of the Forest of Lebanon.
ekegusii: Naende akagoncha chinguba amagana atato agachiooma ne chitaabu chisunyuntire, na kera enguba nigo yarenge koira chitaabu ang’e chikiro ibere. Omorwoti agachibeeka ime ase Enyomba ye Rinani ria Lebanoni.
swahili: Akatengeneza pia ngao ndogo 300 za dhahabu iliyofuliwa, kila ngao ikiwa na uzito wa mane tatu za dhahabu. Mfalme akaziweka katika Jumba la Kifalme la Msitu wa Lebanoni.

english: Additionally, the king made a great throne of ivory and overlaid it with pure gold.
ekegusii: Omorwoti akaroisia ekerogo ki’oborwoti, akagechabera amaino e chinchogu na agakeooma netaabu echenire.
swahili: Kisha mfalme akatengeneza kiti kikubwa cha kifalme kwa kutumia pembe za ndovu na kukifunika kwa dhahabu safi.

english: The throne had six steps, and its back had a rounded top. There were armrests on both sides of the seat, with a lion standing beside each armrest.
ekegusii: Ekerogo keria ki’oborwoti nigo kiabwate ekeriinero kiarenge nebitambokero bitano na ekemo; ensemo ya magega ekerogo keria nigo kiamurumuntire igoro. Kera ensemo y’ekerogo mbiarengeo ebisiirero ase arenge gotoorera amaboko, na emegwekano ye chindo ebere yatenenirieo, oyomo ase kera ensemo.
swahili: Kiti hicho kilikuwa na ngazi sita na egemeo la nyuma lilikuwa la mviringo kwa juu. Pande zote za kiti kulikuwa na mahali pa kuegemeza mikono, na simba wawili wakisimama kando ya hiyo mikono.

english: She arrived in Jerusalem with a very large caravan—with camels bearing spices, gold in great abundance, and precious stones. So she came to Solomon and spoke to him all that was on her mind.
ekegusii: Agacha Yerusalemu amo nabasomba baye abange baarenge kogenda komo; boigo nabwate chingamia chiabogoretie ebinsari ne chitaabu chinyinge mono, na amagena e rigori rinene. Na ekero aigete ase Sulemani, akamoteebia amang’ana onsi arenge ase ebirengererio biaye.
swahili: Alifika Yerusalemu akiwa na msafara mkubwa sana: pamoja na ngamia waliobeba vikolezi, kiasi kikubwa cha dhahabu na vito vya thamani; alikuja kwa Solomoni na kuzungumza naye kuhusu yote ambayo alikuwa nayo moyoni mwake.

english: Twelve lions stood on the six steps, one at either end of each step. Nothing like this had ever been made for any kingdom.
ekegusii: Na emegwekano ye chindo ikomi na ebere yatenenirie aroro, oyomo ase kera ensemo ya kera egetambokero. Omogwekano bw’ekerogo buna ekio tona koroisigwa ase obogaambi bonde bwonsi.
swahili: Simba kumi na wawili walisimama kwenye ngazi sita, mmoja katika kila upande wa kila ngazi. Hakuna kitu kama hicho kilichokuwa kimefanyika kwenye ufalme mwingine wowote.

english: All King Solomon’s drinking cups were gold, and all the utensils of the House of the Forest of Lebanon were pure gold. There was no silver, because it was accounted as nothing in the days of Solomon.
ekegusii: Ebikombe bionsi bi’okonywera bi’omorwoti Sulemani nigo biarenge ebie chitaabu, na ebikorero bionsi bi’Enyomba ye Rinani ria Lebanoni nigo biarenge bie chitaabu chichenire; binde tibiarenge bie chifeta. Ase amatuko a Sulemani efeta tiyabarire ng’a negento kie rigori.
swahili: Vikombe vyote vya Mfalme Solomoni vya kunywea vilikuwa vya dhahabu na vyombo vyote vya nyumbani katika Jumba la Kifalme la Msitu wa Lebanoni vilikuwa vya dhahabu safi. Hakukuwa na kitu kilichotengenezwa kwa fedha, kwa sababu fedha ilionekana ya thamani ndogo siku za Solomoni.

english: For the king had the ships of Tarshish at sea with Hiram’s fleet, and once every three years the ships of Tarshish would arrive bearing gold, silver, ivory, apes, and peacocks.
ekegusii: Omorwoti nabwate chimeeri chiaye chia Tarisisi chiarenge goeta chinyancha amo ne chimeeri chia Hiramu. Ara rimo ase emiaka etato chimeeri chia Tarisisi nigo chiarenge gocha chiarenta chitaabu ne chifeta, na amaino e chinchogu, ne chingoge amo ne chinyoni chi’ebieni ebiya.
swahili: Mfalme alikuwa na meli nyingi za biashara baharini zilizokuwa zikiandamana na meli za Hiramu. Kwa mara moja kila miaka mitatu zilirudi, zikiwa zimebeba dhahabu, fedha, pembe za ndovu na nyani wakubwa na wadogo.

english: So King Solomon surpassed all the kings of the earth in riches and wisdom.
ekegusii: Ase igo omorwoti Sulemani akaba omonene kobua abarwoti bonsi b’ense ase obonda na obong’aini.
swahili: Mfalme Solomoni alikuwa mkuu zaidi kwa utajiri na hekima kuliko wafalme wote wa dunia.

english: The whole world sought an audience with Solomon to hear the wisdom that God had put in his heart.
ekegusii: Abanto korwa ase chinse chionsi bagacha ase Sulemani, erinde baigwe obong’aini boria Nyasae abegete ime yaye.
swahili: Dunia yote ikatafuta kukutana na Solomoni ili kusikia hekima ambayo Mungu alikuwa ameiweka katika moyo wake.

english: Year after year, each visitor would bring his tribute: articles of silver and gold, clothing, weapons, spices, horses, and mules.
ekegusii: Kera oyomo obo akaba okorenta ebiegwa biaye, ebinto bie chifeta, na ebie chitaabu, ne chianga, na ebirwanero, na ebinsari, ne chibarasi, ne chibarasi, ebinto ebinge mono, omwaka ase omwaka.
swahili: Mwaka baada ya mwaka, kila mmoja ambaye alikuja alileta zawadi: vyombo vya fedha na dhahabu, majoho, silaha na vikolezi, farasi na nyumbu.

english: Solomon accumulated 1,400 chariots and 12,000 horses, which he stationed in the chariot cities and also with him in Jerusalem.
ekegusii: Omorwoti Sulemani agasangereria amo chigari ne chibarasi chikoriinwa; nigo abwate chigari elifu eyemo, na amagana ane (1,400) ne chibarasi chikoriinwa chilifu ikomi na ibere (12,000). Echinde ase echio nigo chiabegetwe ase emechie ye chigari, ne chinde chikabekwa Yerusalemu ang’e ase omorwoti amenyete.
swahili: Solomoni akakusanya magari ya vita na farasi. Alikuwa na magari 1,400 na farasi 12,000, ambayo aliyaweka katika miji ya magari na mengine akawa nayo huko Yerusalemu.

english: The king made silver as common in Jerusalem as stones, and cedar as abundant as sycamore in the foothills.
ekegusii: Omorwoti akarenta chifeta chinyinge agwo Yerusalemu, chikabucha buna amagena, ne chibao chi’emecharake chiarenge chinyinge buna echi’emeko yarenge ase ense omweya.
swahili: Mfalme akafanya fedha kuwa kitu cha kawaida kama mawe huko Yerusalemu, mierezi akaifanya kuwa mingi kama mikuyu vilimani.

english: Solomon’s horses were imported from Egypt and Kue; the royal merchants purchased them from Kue.
ekegusii: Sulemani nigo arenge korenterwa chibarasi korwa Misiri na Kue; na abaonchoreria baye igo baarenge gochirenta korwa agwo ase ogoakana rigori gete.
swahili: Farasi wa Solomoni waliletwa kutoka Misri na kutoka Kue. Wafanyabiashara wa mfalme waliwanunua kutoka Kue.

english: A chariot could be imported from Egypt for six hundred shekels of silver, and a horse for a hundred and fifty. Likewise, they exported them to all the kings of the Hittites and to the kings of Aram.
ekegusii: Kera egari yarenge korentwa korwa Misiri nigo yarenge goakanerwa rigori rie chisekeli chi’echifeta amagana atano na rimo, na ebarasi nigo yarenge goakanerwa chisekeli rigana erimo, na emerongo etano. Na goetera ase abaonchoreria b’omorwoti abarwoti bonsi b’Abahiti na ab’Abasiiria nigo baarenge kogora chigari ne chibarasi.
swahili: Waliagiza magari kutoka Misri kwa bei ya shekeli 600 za fedha na farasi kwa shekeli 150. Pia waliwauza nje kwa wafalme wote wa Wahiti na wa Waaramu.

english: And Solomon answered all her questions; nothing was too difficult for the king to explain.
ekegusii: Sulemani akamoiraneria amaborio aye onsi; nonya ne ring’ana erimo tiriabisekanete ase omorwoti, igo amanyete onsi na komoyorokia.
swahili: Solomoni akamjibu maswali yake yote, hakukuwa na jambo lolote lililokuwa gumu kwa mfalme asiweze kumwelezea.

english: When the queen of Sheba saw all the wisdom of Solomon, the palace he had built,
ekegusii: Na ekero eting’ana eria ya Seba akoorire korora obong’aini bwonsi bwa Sulemani, na enyomba eria aagachete,
swahili: Malkia wa Sheba alipoona hekima yote ya Solomoni na jumba la kifalme alilokuwa amejenga,

english: the food at his table, the seating of his servants, the service and attire of his attendants and cupbearers, and the burnt offerings he presented at the house of the LORD, it took her breath away.
ekegusii: na endagera yarenge korentwa ase emesa yaye, na buna abakoonyi baye bamenyete, na buna abasomba baye baare komokorera, ne chianga chiabo babeegete, na buna ababogoria babogoretie ebikombe, naende akarora buna omorwoti arenge gosamba ebing’wanso biaye ase enyomba y’Omonene, agakumia na koumata.
swahili: chakula kilichokuwa mezani pake, jinsi maafisa wake walivyokaa, wahudumu katika majoho yao, wanyweshaji wake na sadaka za kuteketezwa alizotoa katika hekalu la Bwana, alipatwa na mshangao.

english: She said to the king, “The report I heard in my own country about your words and wisdom is true.
ekegusii: Eting’ana eria egateebia omorwoti: “Chinkuma nabeire nkoigwa ekero narenge ase ense yane igoro y’emeremo yao, na obong’aini bwao, nechi’ekeene bori.
swahili: Akamwambia mfalme, “Taarifa niliyosikia kwenye nchi yangu mwenyewe kuhusu mafanikio na hekima yako ni kweli.

english: But I did not believe these things until I came and saw with my own eyes. Indeed, not even half was told to me. Your wisdom and prosperity have far exceeded the report I heard.
ekegusii: Korende tinegenete amang’ana ayio nare koigwa goika ekero nachicha aa na kwerorera namaiso aane inche omonyene. Bono narorire ng’a tinateebetigwe nonya nekeng’ese ki’amang’ana aya. Obong’aini bwao, na obotenenku bwao biaetanirie amang’ana konya nkoigwa.
swahili: Lakini sikuamini mambo haya hadi nilipokuja na kuona kwa macho yangu mwenyewe. Naam, sikuambiwa hata nusu yake; katika hekima na mali umezidi sana ile taarifa niliyoisikia.

english: How blessed are your men! How blessed are these servants of yours who stand continually before you and hear your wisdom!
ekegusii: Abanto bao na abasomba bao aba bagotenena botambe ase obosio bwao na obong’aini bwao, mbare negesio ekenene.
swahili: Heri watu wako! Heri hawa maafisa wako wasimamao mbele yako daima na kusikia hekima yako!

english: Blessed be the LORD your God, who has delighted in you to set you on the throne of Israel. Because of the LORD’s eternal love for Israel, He has made you king to carry out justice and righteousness.”
ekegusii: Omonene, Nyasae oo, atogigwe, oria ogokigwe asore na okobekire ase ekerogo ki’oborwoti ki’Abaisraeli. Ekiagera Omonene anchete Abaisraeli botambe, agakobeeka okaba omorwoti, erinde onyare konacha ekeene na oboronge.”
swahili: Ahimidiwe Bwana Mungu wako, ambaye amependezwa sana nawe na kukuweka juu ya kiti cha ufalme cha Israeli. Kwa sababu ya upendo wake Bwana wa milele ajili ya Israeli, amekufanya mfalme, ili kudumisha haki na uadilifu.”

english: King Solomon, however, loved many foreign women along with the daughter of Pharaoh—women of Moab, Ammon, Edom, and Sidon, as well as Hittite women.
ekegusii: Omorwoti Sulemani nigo anchete abakungu abange b’abaanto b’ebisaku bitamomanyete Nyasae. Amo nomosubati o Farao naende nigo anchete abakungu b’Abamoabu, na Abaamoni, na Abaedomu, na Abasidoni, na Abahiti,
swahili: Hata hivyo, Mfalme Solomoni akawapenda wanawake wengi wa kigeni zaidi, mbali na binti Farao: wanawake wa Wamoabu, Waamoni, Waedomu, Wasidoni na Wahiti.

english: Although He had warned Solomon explicitly not to follow other gods, Solomon did not keep the LORD’s command.
ekegusii: naende konya amochikiire ase ring’ana erio, ng’a tabaisa gotunyana chinyasae chinde. Korende Sulemani tarenda amang’ana ayio Omonene amochiigete.
swahili: Ingawa alikuwa amemkataza Solomoni kufuata miungu mingine, Solomoni hakutii amri ya Bwana.

english: Then the LORD said to Solomon, “Because you have done this and have not kept My covenant and My statutes, which I have commanded you, I will tear the kingdom away from you and give it to your servant.
ekegusii: Ase ayio Omonene agateebia Sulemani, “Ekiagera gwakorire ayio, na tikwabwatete okobwatana kw’ogotianania, gose amachiiko aane aya nagochiigete, goika ntandorane na ndusie oborwoti korwa asore, imboe omosomba oo.
swahili: Kwa hiyo Bwana akamwambia Solomoni, “Kwa kuwa hii ndiyo hali yako na hukushika Agano langu na sheria zangu nilizokuamuru, hakika nitaurarua ufalme kutoka kwako na kumpa mmoja wa walio chini yako.

english: Nevertheless, for the sake of your father David, I will not do it during your lifetime; I will tear it out of the hand of your son.
ekegusii: Korende ase engencho ya Daudi ise tingokora ayio ase amatuko ao, korende nigo ndabotandorane korwa ase okoboko kw’omwana oo.
swahili: Hata hivyo, kwa ajili ya Daudi baba yako, sitafanya jambo hili wakati wa uhai wako. Nitaurarua kutoka mikononi mwa mwanao.

english: Yet I will not tear the whole kingdom away from him. I will give one tribe to your son for the sake of My servant David and for the sake of Jerusalem, which I have chosen.” Hadad’s Return
ekegusii: Nonya naboigo, tinkorusia oborwoti bwonsi korwa ase omwana oo, nimoe egesaku ekemo, ase engencho ya Daudi, omosomba one, naende ase engencho ya Yerusalemu, omochie oria nachorete.” Ababisa ba Sulemani
swahili: Lakini pia sitaurarua ufalme wote kutoka kwake, bali nitampa kabila moja kwa ajili ya Daudi mtumishi wangu na kwa ajili ya Yerusalemu, ambao nimeuchagua.” Adui Za Solomoni

english: Then the LORD raised up against Solomon an adversary, Hadad the Edomite, from the royal line of Edom.
ekegusii: Omonene akarentera Sulemani omobisa, na omobisa oyio nere Hadadi, omonto bw’enyomba y’oborwoti bwa Edomu.
swahili: Kisha Bwana akamwinua adui dhidi ya Solomoni, Hadadi, Mwedomu, kutoka ukoo wa ufalme wa Edomu.

english: Earlier, when David was in Edom, Joab the commander of the army had gone to bury the dead and had struck down every male in Edom.
ekegusii: Ase engaki Daudi arenge agwo Edomu, Yoabu, omochiki bw’emeganda y’esegi, akagenda gotindeka baria baitetwe.
swahili: Huko nyuma wakati Daudi alipokuwa akipigana na Edomu, Yoabu jemadari wa jeshi, aliyekuwa amekwenda kuzika waliouawa, alikuwa amewaua wanaume wote waliokuwako Edomu.

english: Joab and all Israel had stayed there six months, until he had killed every male in Edom.
ekegusii: Joabu amo na Abaisraeli bonsi baarenge komo bagatigara agwo Edomu ase engaki y’emetienyi etano nomo, bagaita na gosiria kegima kera omosacha bw’aroro.
swahili: Yoabu na Waisraeli wote walikaa huko kwa miezi sita, mpaka walipomaliza kuwaangamiza wanaume wote huko Edomu.

english: But Hadad, still just a young boy, had fled to Egypt, along with some Edomites who were servants of his father.
ekegusii: Korende Hadadi agatama gochia Misiri amo nabaanto bande b’Edomu, abasomba ba ise. Na ekero keria Hadadi nigo arenge omosae omoke.
swahili: Lakini Hadadi, akiwa bado mvulana mdogo, alikimbilia Misri akiwa na baadhi ya maafisa wa Kiedomu waliokuwa wakimhudumia baba yake.

english: Hadad and his men set out from Midian and went to Paran. They took men from Paran with them and went to Egypt, to Pharaoh king of Egypt, who gave Hadad a house and land and provided him with food.
ekegusii: Bakarua Midiani, bakagenda bagaika Parani, naende bakagenda amo nabaanto bande korwa Parani, bagaika Misiri. Aroro bakagenda ase Farao, omorwoti o Misiri. Ere akamoa enyomba, naende akamochikera endagera arenge koba okonyora botambe; boigo akamoa oboremo.
swahili: Wakaondoka Midiani wakaenda Parani. Basi wakichukua pamoja nao wanaume kutoka Parani, wakaenda Misri, kwa Farao mfalme wa Misri, ambaye alimpa Hadadi nyumba, ardhi na akampatia chakula.

english: There Hadad found such great favor in the sight of Pharaoh that he gave to him in marriage the sister of Queen Tahpenes, his own wife.
ekegusii: Hadadi akanyora ogwancherwa okonene ase obosio bwa Farao, na Farao akamonyuomeria mokoyoye, omoiseke omwabo Tapenesi mokaye, oyio orenge eting’ana.
swahili: Farao akapendezwa sana na Hadadi hata akampa ndugu wa mkewe mwenyewe, Malkia Tapenesi, ili aolewe na Hadadi.

english: These women were from the nations about which the LORD had told the Israelites, “You must not intermarry with them, for surely they will turn your hearts after their gods.” Yet Solomon clung to these women in love.
ekegusii: abanto b’ebisaku biri’Omonene akanetie Abaisraeli, akabateebia, Timobaisa konyuomerana nabarabwo, ekiagera ekeene, nigo baraonchore chinkoro chiaino, erinde mogwe na koonchokera chinyasae chiabo. Sulemani akabwatana nabarabwo, akabancha.
swahili: Walitoka katika mataifa ambayo Bwana aliwaambia Waisraeli, “Msije mkaoana nao, kwa kuwa hakika wataigeuza mioyo yenu mgeukie miungu yao.” Hata hivyo, Solomoni akakaza kuwapenda.

english: And the sister of Tahpenes bore Hadad a son named Genubath. Tahpenes herself weaned him in Pharaoh’s palace, and Genubath lived there among the sons of Pharaoh.
ekegusii: Na omoiseke omwabo Tapenesi akaiborera Hadadi Genubati, omwana omomura. Tapenesi agatacha omwana oyio agwo ase enyomba ya Farao, na Genubati akabeera ase enyomba ya Farao amo nabana abamura ba Farao.
swahili: Huyo ndugu wa Tapenesi akamzalia mwana aliyeitwa Genubathi, ambaye alilelewa na Tapenesi katika jumba la kifalme. Huko Genubathi aliishi pamoja na watoto wa Farao mwenyewe.

english: When Hadad heard in Egypt that David had rested with his fathers and that Joab, the commander of the army, was dead, he said to Pharaoh, “Let me go, that I may return to my own country.”
ekegusii: Hadadi, ekero arenge ase ense ya Misiri, akaigwa ng’a Daudi orarire ase chisokoro chiaye chiaraarete, naende ng’a Yoabu, omochiki bw’emeganda y’esegi, nere okuure agateebia Farao: “Ing’a ribaga ngende ase ense yane.”
swahili: Alipokuwa huko Misri, Hadadi alisikia kwamba Daudi amepumzika na baba zake na ya kwamba pia Yoabu aliyekuwa jemadari wa jeshi amekufa. Ndipo Hadadi akamwambia Farao, “Niruhusu niende ili niweze kurudi katika nchi yangu.”

english: But Pharaoh asked him, “What have you lacked here with me that you suddenly want to go back to your own country?” “Nothing,” Hadad replied, “but please let me go.” Rezon’s Hostility
ekegusii: Korende Farao akamobooria: “Ngento ki kwaremeirwe aiga ase ’nde ekiagera okoboria ribaga ogende ase ense yao?” Hadadi akamoiraneria: “Aye ntiga rioka, ngende.”
swahili: Farao akauliza, “Umekosa nini hapa, kwamba unataka kurudi katika nchi yako?” Hadadi akajibu, “Hakuna, lakini niruhusu niende!”

english: And God raised up against Solomon another adversary, Rezon the son of Eliada, who had fled from his master, Hadadezer king of Zobah,
ekegusii: Naende Nyasae akarentera Sulemani omobisa onde, na omobisa oyio nere Resoni, mosinto bw’Eliada, oria konya otamire korwa ase omonene oye Hadadeseri, omorwoti o Soba.
swahili: Mungu akamwinua adui mwingine dhidi ya Solomoni, Rezoni mwana wa Eliada, ambaye alikuwa amemkimbia bwana wake Hadadezeri, mfalme wa Soba.

english: and had gathered men to himself. When David killed the Zobaites, Rezon captained a band of raiders and went to Damascus, where they settled and gained control.
ekegusii: Agwo kare ekero Daudi akoorire ogoita koria okonene ase egati yabo, oyio Resoni agasangereria abanto asare, na akaba omotang’ani bw’ekeombe keria ki’abaomboganu. Barabwo bakagenda Damesiki, bakaba bakogaambera abanto b’aroro.
swahili: Akawakusanya watu, naye akawa kiongozi wa kundi la waasi, wakati Daudi alipoangamiza majeshi ya Soba; waasi walikwenda Dameski, mahali walipokaa na kumiliki.

english: Rezon was Israel’s enemy throughout the days of Solomon, adding to the trouble caused by Hadad. So Rezon ruled over Aram with hostility toward Israel. Jeroboam’s Rebellion
ekegusii: Resoni nigo abeete omobisa bw’Abaisraeli ase amatuko onsi aya Sulemani arenge kogamba, agakora ogosaria okonene buna Hadadi akorete; akagechia Abaisraeli, akaba okogaambera Abasiiria. Eira ya Nyasae ase Yeroboamu
swahili: Rezoni alikuwa adui wa Israeli kwa muda wote alioishi Solomoni, ukiongezea matatizo yaliyosababishwa na Hadadi. Kwa hiyo Rezoni akatawala katika Aramu na alikuwa mkatili kwa Israeli. Yeroboamu Anaasi Dhidi Ya Solomoni

english: Now Jeroboam son of Nebat was an Ephraimite from Zeredah whose mother was a widow named Zeruah. Jeroboam was a servant of Solomon, but he rebelled against the king,
ekegusii: Oyomo bw’abasomba ba Sulemani nigo arenge korokwa Yeroboamu, mosinto o Nebati, Omoefarati o Sereda. Ng’ina nigo arenge korokwa Serua, ere nigo arenge omoboraka. Yeroboamu akaanga koigwera omorwoti.
swahili: Pia, Yeroboamu mwana wa Nebati aliasi dhidi ya mfalme. Alikuwa mmoja wa maafisa wa Solomoni, Mwefraimu kutoka Sereda, ambaye mama yake alikuwa mjane aliyeitwa Serua.

english: and this is the account of his rebellion against the king. Solomon had built the supporting terraces and repaired the gap in the wall of the city of his father David.
ekegusii: Aya naro agerete Yeroboamu akaba mamincha y’omorwoti. Sulemani nigo aagachete Milo, na agaticha egetongo kiarenge ase Omochie o Daudi ise.
swahili: Haya ndiyo maelezo ya jinsi alivyomwasi mfalme: Solomoni alikuwa amejenga Milo naye akawa ameziba mwanya katika ukuta wa mji wa Daudi baba yake.

english: Now Jeroboam was a mighty man of valor. So when Solomon noticed that the young man was industrious, he put him in charge of the whole labor force of the house of Joseph.
ekegusii: Omonto oria Yeroboamu nigo arenge omonto ore nomokia mono, na ekero Sulemani amorooche ng’a nigo arenge omokong’u ase emeremo yaye, akamobeka akaba omoteneneri igoro ase emeremo eria abanto b’egesaku kia Yusufu baarenge kobetererigwa gokora.
swahili: Basi Yeroboamu alikuwa mtu shujaa na hodari, naye Solomoni alipoona jinsi kijana alivyofanya kazi yake, akamweka kuwa kiongozi wa kazi yote ya mikono ya nyumba ya Yosefu.

english: During that time, the prophet Ahijah the Shilonite met Jeroboam on the road as he was going out of Jerusalem. Now Ahijah had wrapped himself in a new cloak, and the two of them were alone in the open field.
ekegusii: Na ase engaki eria, ekero Yeroboamu agendete isiko korwa Yerusalemu, omobani Ahiya korwa Silo akanyorana nere inchera. Ahiya igo ambarete egetambaa ekeyia; bono abanto aba babere bakaba boka aase aarabu.
swahili: Karibu na wakati ule Yeroboamu alikuwa anatoka nje ya Yerusalemu, Ahiya nabii Mshiloni akakutana naye njiani, akiwa amevaa joho jipya. Hawa wawili walikuwa peke yao mashambani,

english: He had seven hundred wives of royal birth and three hundred concubines—and his wives turned his heart away.
ekegusii: Igo anyuomete abakungu amagana atano na abere, naende nabwate abakungu ba sere‐sere amagana atato. Abakungu baria baye bakaonchora enkoro yaye, erinde agatiga Omonene.
swahili: Alikuwa na wake 700 mabinti wa uzao wa kifalme, na masuria 300, nao wake zake wakampotosha.

english: And Ahijah took hold of the new cloak he was wearing, tore it into twelve pieces,
ekegusii: Ahiya akabwata egetambaa keria ekeyia ambarete, akagetandora ebing’ese ikomi na bibere,
swahili: naye Ahiya akachukua joho jipya alilokuwa amevaa akalirarua vipande kumi na viwili.

english: and said to Jeroboam, “Take ten pieces for yourself, for this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘Behold, I will tear the kingdom out of the hand of Solomon, and I will give you ten tribes.
ekegusii: agateebia Yeroboamu, “Eimokerie aye omonyene ebing’ese ebi ikomi, ekiagera aya nar’Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, atebiire: Rora inche igo inde ang’e gotandorana oborwoti mborusie korwa ase okoboko gwa Sulemani, nkoe ebisaku ikomi.
swahili: Kisha akamwambia Yeroboamu, “Chukua vipande kumi kwa ajili yako, kwa kuwa hivi ndivyo Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli asemavyo: ‘Tazama, ninakwenda kuuchana ufalme kutoka mikononi mwa Solomoni na kukupa wewe makabila kumi.

english: But one tribe will remain for the sake of My servant David and for the sake of Jerusalem, the city I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel.
ekegusii: Korende Sulemani ere atware egesaku ekemo, ase engencho ya Daudi, omosomba one, na ase engencho ya Yerusalemu, omochie oria nachorete korwa ase ebisaku bionsi bi’Abaisraeli.
swahili: Lakini kwa ajili ya mtumishi wangu Daudi na mji wa Yerusalemu, ambao nimeuchagua miongoni mwa makabila yote ya Israeli, atakuwa na kabila moja.

english: For they have forsaken Me to worship Ashtoreth the goddess of the Sidonians, Chemosh the god of the Moabites, and Milcom the god of the Ammonites. They have not walked in My ways, nor done what is right in My eyes, nor kept My statutes and judgments, as Solomon’s father David did.
ekegusii: Aya nigo arakoreke, ekiagera bantigire na basasimire Asitaroti, enyasae enkuungu y’Abasidoni, na Kemosi, enyasae y’Abamoabu, na Milikomu, enyasae y’Abaamoni, gose tibabwateti chinchera chiane na tibakorete ayare amaronge ase obosio bwane ase okorenda emeroberio yane echiikire na amachiiko aane, buna Daudi ise akorete.
swahili: Nitafanya hivi kwa sababu wameniacha mimi na kuabudu Ashtorethi mungu mke wa Wasidoni, Kemoshi mungu wa Wamoabu, na Moleki mungu wa Waamoni, nao hawakwenda katika njia zangu ili kufanya yaliyo sawa machoni pangu, wala kushika amri na sheria zangu kama Daudi, babaye Solomoni, alivyofanya.

english: Nevertheless, I will not take the whole kingdom out of Solomon’s hand, because I have made him ruler all the days of his life for the sake of David My servant, whom I chose because he kept My commandments and statutes.
ekegusii: Nonya naboigo tinkorusia oborwoti bwonsi korwa ase okoboko gwa Sulemani, korende nimobeke abe omogambi ase engaki y’amatuko aye onsi are moyo. Aya ninkore ase engencho ya Daudi, omosomba one, oria nachorete, oria orendete amachiiko aane amaachenu na emeroberio yane echiikire.
swahili: “ ‘Lakini sitauondoa ufalme wote kutoka mikononi mwa Solomoni, nimemfanya mtawala siku zote za maisha yake kwa ajili ya Daudi mtumishi wangu, niliyemchagua na ambaye aliyatunza maagizo na amri zangu.

english: But I will take ten tribes of the kingdom from the hand of his son and give them to you.
ekegusii: Nindusie oborwoti korwa ase okoboko kw’omwana oye; aye noegwe ebisaku ikomi,
swahili: Nitauondoa ufalme kutoka mikononi mwa mwanawe na kukupa wewe makabila kumi.

english: I will give one tribe to his son, so that My servant David will always have a lamp before Me in Jerusalem, the city where I chose to put My Name.
ekegusii: korende omwana oye nimoe egesaku ekemo, erio Daudi, omosomba one, botambe atware etaya ekomoreka ase obosio bwane agwo Yerusalemu, omochie nachorire mbeeke erieta riane aroro.
swahili: Nitampa mwanawe kabila moja ili kwamba Daudi mtumishi wangu awe na taa mbele zangu daima katika Yerusalemu, mji ambao nimeuchagua kuweka Jina langu.

english: But as for you, I will take you, and you shall reign over all that your heart desires, and you will be king over Israel.
ekegusii: Ninkobeke ogambe igoro ase bionsi buna omoyo oo oganetie, naye nobe omorwoti igoro ase Abaisraeli.
swahili: Hata hivyo, kukuhusu wewe Yeroboamu, nitakutwaa, nawe utatawala juu ya yote yale moyo wako unayotamani, utakuwa mfalme juu ya Israeli.

english: If you listen to all that I command you, walk in My ways, and do what is right in My sight in order to keep My statutes and commandments as My servant David did, then I will be with you. I will build you a lasting dynasty just as I built for David, and I will give Israel to you.
ekegusii: Koranyigwere na okore onsi aya nagochikiire na obwatie chinchera chiane, na okore ayare amaronge ase amaiso aane ase okorenda emeroberio yane na amachiiko aane buna Daudi, omosomba one, akorete, rirorio nimbe amo naye. Naende ningotenenerie egesaku kegendererete, buna nateneneretie Daudi, ninkobeke ogambere Abaisraeli.
swahili: Ikiwa utafanya kila nitakalokuamuru, kuenenda katika njia zangu na kufanya yaliyo sawa mbele za macho yangu kwa kuzishika amri zangu na maagizo yangu kama alivyofanya Daudi mtumishi wangu, nitakuwa pamoja nawe. Nitakujengea ufalme utakaodumu kama ule niliomjengea Daudi, nami nitakupa Israeli.

english: Because of this, I will humble David’s descendants—but not forever.’”
ekegusii: Ase enchera eyio ninchande abanto b’ororeeria rwa Daudi, korende tekoba igo kogenderera botambe.”
swahili: Nitawatesa wazao wa Daudi kwa ajili ya hili, lakini siyo milele.’ ”

english: For when Solomon grew old, his wives turned his heart after other gods, and he was not wholeheartedly devoted to the LORD his God, as his father David had been.
ekegusii: Ee, ekero Sulemani konya agotire, abakungu baye bakaonchora enkoro yaye gochia ase chinyasae chinde, na ere tabeete omwegenwa ase Omonene, Nyasae oye, buna Daudi ise arenge nenkoro y’obwegenwa.
swahili: Kadiri Solomoni alivyozidi kuzeeka, wake zake wakaugeuza moyo wake kuelekea miungu mingine, na moyo wake haukujitolea kikamilifu kwa Bwana Mungu wake, kama ulivyokuwa moyo wa Daudi baba yake.

english: Solomon therefore sought to kill Jeroboam. But Jeroboam arose and fled to Egypt, to Shishak king of Egypt, where he remained until the death of Solomon. The Death of Solomon (2 Chronicles 9:29–31)
ekegusii: Sulemani akarigia goita Yeroboamu, korende Yeroboamu akaimoka, agatama gochia Misiri, ase Sisaki, omorwoti o Misiri, akamenya agwo Misiri goika ekero Sulemani akwete. Ogokwa gwa Sulemani (2 Amg 9:29)
swahili: Solomoni akajaribu kumuua Yeroboamu, lakini Yeroboamu akakimbilia Misri, kwa Mfalme Shishaki, naye akakaa huko mpaka Solomoni alipofariki. Kifo Cha Solomoni (2 Nyakati 9:29-31)

english: As for the rest of the acts of Solomon—all that he did, as well as his wisdom—are they not written in the Book of the Acts of Solomon?
ekegusii: Bono amang’ana onsi igoro ya Sulemani, na aya onsi akorete, na obong’aini bwaye bwonsi nigo ariikire ase Egetabu ki’ogokora gwa Sulemani.
swahili: Kwa habari za matukio mengine ya utawala wa Solomoni, yote aliyoyafanya na hekima aliyoionyesha, je hayakuandikwa yote katika kitabu cha matendo cha Solomoni?

english: Thus the time that Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel was forty years.
ekegusii: Engaki Sulemani agambete agwo Yerusalemu igoro ase Abaisraeli nemiaka emerongo ene.
swahili: Solomoni alitawala Israeli yote miaka arobaini, akiwa Yerusalemu.

english: And Solomon rested with his fathers and was buried in the city of his father David. And his son Rehoboam reigned in his place.
ekegusii: Erio Sulemani akaraara ase chisokoro chiaye chiararete, agatindekwa ase Omochie o Daudi ise, na Rehoboamu, omomura oye, akaba okogaamba ase ribaga ria ise.
swahili: Kisha Solomoni akalala pamoja na baba zake, naye akazikwa katika mji wa Daudi baba yake. Naye Rehoboamu mwanawe akawa mfalme baada yake.

english: Solomon followed Ashtoreth the goddess of the Sidonians and Milcom the abomination of the Ammonites.
ekegusii: Sulemani igo atunyaanete na gokorera Asitaroti, enyasae enkuungu y’Abasidoni, na Milikomu, okogechia kw’Abaamoni.
swahili: Solomoni akafuata Ashtorethi mungu mke wa Wasidoni, na Moleki mungu aliyekuwa chukizo la Waamoni.

english: So Solomon did evil in the sight of the LORD; unlike his father David, he did not follow the LORD completely.
ekegusii: Sulemani agakora ayare amabe ase obosio bw’Omonene, tamotunyanete ase obwegenwa, buna Daudi ise arenge gokora.
swahili: Kwa hiyo Solomoni akafanya uovu machoni pa Bwana; hakumfuata Bwana kikamilifu kama alivyofanya Daudi baba yake.

english: At that time on a hill east of Jerusalem, Solomon built a high place for Chemosh the abomination of Moab and for Molech the abomination of the Ammonites.
ekegusii: Moocha ya Yerusalemu Sulemani akaroisia aase aimokererete igoro ase Kemosi, okogechia kw’Abamoabu, na ase Moleki, okogechia kw’Abaamoni, chinyasae chiria, chiarenge agosasimerwa.
swahili: Kwenye kilima mashariki mwa Yerusalemu, Solomoni akajenga mahali pa juu kwa ajili ya Kemoshi chukizo la Wamoabu, na kwa Moleki mungu chukizo la Waamoni.

english: He did the same for all his foreign wives, who burned incense and sacrificed to their gods. God’s Anger against Solomon
ekegusii: Naboigo aroiseretie abakungu baye bonsi baria anyuomete korwa ase ebisaku ebiaao; barabwo bagasamba ubani na bakarua ebing’wanso ase chinyasae chiabo.
swahili: Akafanya hivyo kwa wake zake wote wa kigeni, ambao walifukiza uvumba na kutoa dhabihu kwa miungu yao.

english: Now the LORD grew angry with Solomon, because his heart had turned away from the LORD, the God of Israel, who had appeared to him twice.
ekegusii: Omonene akaba nendamwamu ase Sulemani, ekiagera enkoro yaye yaonchogete korwa asare ere Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, oria omoorokerete ara kabere,
swahili: Bwana akamkasirikia Solomoni kwa sababu moyo wake uligeuka mbali na Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli, ambaye alikuwa amemtokea mara mbili.

english: Then Rehoboam went to Shechem, for all Israel had gone there to make him king.
ekegusii: Rehoboamu akagenda Sekemu, ekiagera Abaisraeli bonsi konya bachiire aroro komobeeka abe omorwoti.
swahili: Rehoboamu akaenda Shekemu, kwa kuwa Waisraeli wote walikuwa wamekwenda huko kumfanya yeye kuwa mfalme.

english: The young men who had grown up with him replied, “This is how you should answer these people who said to you, ‘Your father made our yoke heavy, but you should make it lighter.’ This is what you should tell them: ‘My little finger is thicker than my father’s waist!
ekegusii: Abamura baria bakinete komo bakamoteebia: “Aya naro orateebie abanto abwo bakoboretie ng’a bwororobie rikorogoto riria iso akorete ririto: Ekiara gi’okoboko kwane nigo kere ekenetu kobua ekebono gia tata
swahili: Wale vijana wa rika lake wakamjibu, “Waambie watu hawa waliokuambia, ‘Baba yako aliweka nira nzito juu yetu, lakini ifanye nira yetu nyepesi,’ kuwa, ‘Kidole changu kidogo ni kinene kuliko kiuno cha baba yangu.

english: Whereas my father burdened you with a heavy yoke, I will add to your yoke. Whereas my father scourged you with whips, I will scourge you with scorpions.’”
ekegusii: Na bono rikorogoto riria rikong’u tata ababeekerete, inche nigo ndarimente ribe ririto goetania. Tata nigo arenge kobang’wania ebiranya, korende inche nigo ndabe nkobang’wania ne chinkini chichomire chibonyi mesia.”
swahili: Baba yangu aliweka nira nzito juu yenu, mimi nitaifanya hata iwe nzito zaidi. Baba yangu aliwachapa kwa mijeledi, mimi nitawachapa kwa nge.’ ”

english: After three days, Jeroboam and all the people returned to Rehoboam, since the king had said, “Come back to me on the third day.”
ekegusii: Yeroboamu amo nabaanto bonsi bagacha ase Rehoboamu rituko ria gatato, buna omorwoti abateebeetie ng’a bakore.
swahili: Siku tatu baadaye, Yeroboamu na watu wote wakamrudia Rehoboamu, kama mfalme alivyokuwa amesema, “Rudini kwangu baada ya siku tatu.”

english: And the king answered the people harshly. He rejected the advice of the elders
ekegusii: Omorwoti akairaneria abanto baria amang’ana ase obotindi, akaanga ogosemia kw’abagaaka baria.
swahili: Mfalme akawajibu watu kwa ukatili. Akikataa shauri alilopewa na wazee,

english: and spoke to them as the young men had advised, saying, “Whereas my father made your yoke heavy, I will add to your yoke. Whereas my father scourged you with whips, I will scourge you with scorpions.”
ekegusii: Agakwana nabarabwo buna abamura baria bamosemetie, agateeba: “Tata nigo akorete rikorogoto riaino rikaba ririto, korende inche nimbamentere ribe ririto goetania. Tata nigo arenge kobang’wania ebiranya, korende inche nigo ndabang’wanie ne chinkini chichomire chibonyi mesia.”
swahili: akafuata shauri la vijana wa rika lake na kusema, “Baba yangu alifanya nira yenu kuwa nzito, mimi nitaifanya kuwa nzito zaidi. Baba yangu aliwachapa kwa mijeledi, mimi nitawachapa kwa nge.”

english: So the king did not listen to the people, and indeed this turn of events was from the LORD, to fulfill the word He had spoken to Jeroboam son of Nebat through Ahijah the Shilonite. The Kingdom Divided (2 Chronicles 10:16–19)
ekegusii: Ase ayio omorwoti taigwerete amang’ana ’abaanto. Ayio nigo akorekanete n’Omonene, erinde ere anyare goikerania ring’ana riaye riria akwanete ase Yeroboamu, mosinto o Nebati, goetera ase Ahiya, omobani oria korwa Silo.
swahili: Kwa hiyo mfalme hakuwasikiliza watu, kwa kuwa jambo hili lilitoka kwa Bwana, ili kutimiza neno ambalo Bwana alikuwa amenena kwa Yeroboamu mwana wa Nebati kupitia Ahiya Mshiloni.

english: When all Israel saw that the king had refused to listen to them, they answered the king: “What portion do we have in David, and what inheritance in the son of Jesse? To your tents, O Israel! Look now to your own house, O David!” So the Israelites went home,
ekegusii: Ekero Abaisraeli bonsi baroche ng’a omorwoti nigo aangete kobaigwera, bakamoiraneria, bakamoteebia: “Ngetari ki intwe tobwate ase Daudi? Titori nomwando na mosinto o Yese. Inwe Abaisraeli, genda kera omonto bwoye! Inwe abanto ba Daudi, erende inwe abanyene!” Ase igo Abaisraeli bakarua aroro agwo, bakagenda ase chinka chiabo.
swahili: Israeli wote walipoona kuwa mfalme amekataa kuwasikiliza, wakamjibu mfalme: “Tuna fungu gani kwa Daudi? Sisi hatuna urithi kwa mwana wa Yese. Nendeni kwenye mahema yenu, ee Israeli! Angalia nyumba yako mwenyewe, ee Daudi!” Hivyo Waisraeli wakaenda kwenye mahema yao.

english: but Rehoboam still reigned over the Israelites living in the cities of Judah.
ekegusii: Rehoboamu agatigwa okogaambera Abaisraeli baria bamenyete ase emechie y’Abayuda yoka.
swahili: Lakini kwa habari ya Waisraeli waliokuwa wakiishi katika miji ya Yuda, Rehoboamu akaendelea kuwatawala bado.

english: Then King Rehoboam sent out Adoram, who was in charge of the forced labor, but all Israel stoned him to death. And King Rehoboam mounted his chariot in haste and escaped to Jerusalem.
ekegusii: Erio omorwoti Rehoboamu agatoma Adorama, oria otenenerete emeremo y’okobetererigwa, gochia ase Abaisraeli, na barabwo bonsi bakamoaka amagena, agakwa; na Rehoboamu akaimoka bwango, akariina egari yaye, agatama gochia Yerusalemu.
swahili: Mfalme Rehoboamu akamtuma Adoramu, aliyekuwa msimamizi wa wale waliofanya kazi ngumu kwa kulazimishwa, lakini Israeli wote wakampiga kwa mawe hadi akafa. Hata hivyo, Mfalme Rehoboamu, akafanikiwa kuingia kwenye gari lake na kutorokea Yerusalemu.

english: So to this day Israel has been in rebellion against the house of David. Shemaiah’s Prophecy (2 Chronicles 11:1–4)
ekegusii: Ase ayio Abaisraeli babeire bare mamincha na gosaria igoro ase enyomba ya Daudi goika reero iga.
swahili: Hivyo Israeli wakaasi dhidi ya nyumba ya Daudi hadi leo.

english: When Jeroboam son of Nebat heard about this, he was still in Egypt where he had fled from King Solomon and had been living ever since.
ekegusii: Na ekero Yeroboamu, mosinto o Nebati, aigwete amang’ana ayio, akairana korwa Misiri aaria ase atamete gochia korwa ase omorwoti Sulemani.
swahili: Yeroboamu mwana wa Nebati aliposikia hili (alikuwa bado yuko Misri alikokuwa amekimbilia awe mbali na Mfalme Solomoni), akarudi kutoka Misri.

english: When all Israel heard that Jeroboam had returned, they summoned him to the assembly and made him king over all Israel. Only the tribe of Judah followed the house of David.
ekegusii: Na ekero Abaisraeli bonsi baigwete ng’a Yeroboamu oiranire, bagatoma abanto bamorangerie ache ase omosangererekano, bakamobeeka akaba omorwoti igoro ase Abaisraeli. Omonto onde tari otunyanete abanto b’enyomba ya Daudi, otatiga abanto b’egesaku kia Yuda boka. Semaya okorenta amang’ana ay’Omonene amoete (2 Amg 11:1-4)
swahili: Waisraeli wote waliposikia kwamba Yeroboamu amerudi, wakatuma watu na kumwita kwenye kusanyiko na kumfanya mfalme juu ya Israeli yote. Ni kabila la Yuda peke yake lililobaki kuwa tiifu kwa nyumba ya Daudi.

english: And when Rehoboam arrived in Jerusalem, he mobilized the whole house of Judah and the tribe of Benjamin—180,000 chosen warriors—to fight against the house of Israel and restore the kingdom to Rehoboam son of Solomon.
ekegusii: Ekero Rehoboamu achete Yerusalemu, agasangereria abanto bonsi b’enyomba ya Yuda, na egesaku kia Benjamini, abanto chilifu rigana erimo na emerongo etano na etato, abamanyete korwana esegi, bagende korwania Abaisraeli na bairanie oborwoti ase Rehoboamu, mosinto o Sulemani.
swahili: Ikawa Rehoboamu alipofika Yerusalemu, akakusanya nyumba yote ya Yuda na kabila la Benyamini, wanaume wapiganaji 180,000, kufanya vita dhidi ya nyumba ya Israeli na kuurudisha tena ufalme kwa Rehoboamu mwana wa Solomoni.

english: But the word of God came to Shemaiah the man of God:
ekegusii: Korende ring’ana ria Nyasae rigacha ase Semaya, omonto o Nyasae,
swahili: Lakini neno hili la Mungu likamjia Shemaya mtu wa Mungu:

english: “Tell Rehoboam son of Solomon king of Judah, all the house of Judah and Benjamin, and the rest of the people
ekegusii: rikamoteebia: “Teebia Rehoboamu, mosinto o Sulemani, omorwoti bw’Abayuda, otebie nabaanto bonsi b’enyomba ya Yuda, na aba eya Benjamini, na abanto bande abatigari ng’a:
swahili: “Mwambie Rehoboamu mwana wa Solomoni mfalme wa Yuda, na nyumba yote ya Yuda na Benyamini, na watu wengine wote,

english: that this is what the LORD says: ‘You are not to go up and fight against your brothers, the Israelites. Each of you must return home, for this word is from Me.’” So they listened to the word of the LORD and turned back according to the word of the LORD. Jeroboam’s Idolatry
ekegusii: Aya nar’Omonene atebiire: Inwe timogenda korwania abanto bamino Abaisraeli. Irana kera omonto nka bwoye, ekiagera aya akorekire nigo akoretwe nainche.” Ase ayio abanto bakaigwera ring’ana ri’Omonene, bakairana gochia chinka chiabo, buna abateebeetie. Yeroboamu ogotiga Omonene
swahili: ‘Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana: Msipande kupigana dhidi ya ndugu zenu, Waisraeli. Nendeni nyumbani, kila mmoja wenu, kwa kuwa hili nimelitenda mimi.’ ” Kwa hiyo wakalitii neno la Bwana na kurudi nyumbani, kama Bwana alivyokuwa ameagiza. Ndama Wa Dhahabu Huko Betheli Na Dani

english: Then Jeroboam built Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim and lived there. And from there he went out and built Penuel.
ekegusii: Erio Yeroboamu akaagacha omochie Sekemu ase ense y’ebitunwa y’Efraimu, akamenya aroro, naende akarua agwo, akagenda akaagacha Penueli.
swahili: Kisha Yeroboamu akajenga Shekemu akaizungushia ngome katika nchi ya vilima ya Efraimu na akaishi huko. Akatoka huko, akaenda akajenga Penueli.

english: Jeroboam said in his heart, “Now the kingdom might revert to the house of David.
ekegusii: Yeroboamu akarengereria ase enkoro yaye ime: “Bono oborwoti igo borabaise koirana bogende ase enyomba ya Daudi.
swahili: Yeroboamu akawaza moyoni mwake, “Sasa inawezekana ufalme ukarudi katika nyumba ya Daudi.

english: If these people go up to offer sacrifices in the house of the LORD at Jerusalem, their hearts will return to their lord, Rehoboam king of Judah; then they will kill me and return to Rehoboam king of Judah.”
ekegusii: Abanto aba baise kona kogenda korua ebing’wanso ase enyomba y’Omonene agwo Yerusalemu, chinkoro chiabo nigo chiramoiranere omonene obo Rehoboamu, omorwoti bw’Abayuda, na kobaramoiranere nigo barang’ite.”
swahili: Kama watu hawa watapanda kwenda kutoa dhabihu katika Hekalu la Bwana huko Yerusalemu, mioyo yao itamrudia bwana wao, Rehoboamu mfalme wa Yuda. Wataniua mimi na kurudi kwa Mfalme Rehoboamu.”

english: After seeking advice, the king made two golden calves and said to the people, “Going up to Jerusalem is too much for you. Here, O Israel, are your gods, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt.”
ekegusii: Ekero omorwoti arengereretie amang’ana ayio, akaroisia korwa ase etaabu emegwekano ebere ye chimori, agateebia abanto: “Igo mogochandeka mono kona kogenda Yerusalemu. Inwe Abaisraeli, rora aiga chinyasae chiaino, echi chiabarusetie ase ense ya Misiri.”
swahili: Baada ya kutafuta shauri, mfalme akatengeneza ndama wawili wa dhahabu. Akawaambia watu, “Ni gharama kubwa kwenu kukwea kwenda Yerusalemu. Hii hapa miungu yenu, ee Israeli, iliyowapandisha kutoka Misri.”

english: One calf he set up in Bethel, and the other in Dan.
ekegusii: Akabeeka eyemo Beteli na eya kabere agwo Dani.
swahili: Ndama mmoja akamweka Betheli na mwingine Dani.

english: So they sent for Jeroboam, and he and the whole assembly of Israel came to Rehoboam and said,
ekegusii: Abanto bakarangeria Yeroboamu, na ere amo nomosangererekano bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli bakagenda, bagateebia Rehoboamu,
swahili: Kwa hiyo wakatuma watu kumwita Yeroboamu, yeye na kusanyiko lote la Israeli wakamwendea Rehoboamu na kumwambia,

english: And this thing became a sin; the people walked as far as Dan to worship before one of the calves.
ekegusii: Egento eke gekagera bagakora ebibe, ekiagera abanto igo bagendete nonya ngoika Dani gosasiima enyasae eyemo y’echio.
swahili: Nalo jambo hili likawa dhambi, watu wakawa wanaenda hadi Dani kumwabudu huyo aliyewekwa huko.

english: Jeroboam also built shrines on the high places and appointed from every class of people priests who were not Levites.
ekegusii: Naende Yeroboamu akaroisia aase aimokererete igoro agosasimerwa, agachora abakuani korwa ase egati y’abanto bonsi abwo batarenge Abalawi. Ogosasiima agwo Beteli kogokanwa
swahili: Yeroboamu akajenga madhabahu mahali pa juu pa kuabudia miungu na kuwateua makuhani kutoka watu wa aina zote, ijapokuwa hawakuwa Walawi.

english: And Jeroboam ordained a feast on the fifteenth day of the eighth month, like the feast that was in Judah, and he offered sacrifices on the altar; he made this offering in Bethel to sacrifice to the calves he had set up, and he installed priests in Bethel for the high places he had set up.
ekegusii: Yeroboamu agachiika Rituko Rinene ase rituko ria ikomi na gatano ri’omotienyi o gatano na gatato, buna omogwekano bwe Rituko Rinene ase Abayuda. Ase egesasiimero agwo Beteli ere omonyene akarua ebing’wanso ase emegwekano eria ye chimori aroisetie. Naende agwo Beteli akabeeka abakuani b’aase aimokererete igoro agosasimerwa konya aroisirie.
swahili: Pia Yeroboamu akaweka sikukuu katika siku ya kumi na tano ya mwezi wa nane, kama sikukuu iliyokuwa ikifanyika huko Yuda, na akatoa dhabihu juu ya madhabahu. Akafanya hivyo huko Betheli akitoa dhabihu kwa ndama alizotengeneza. Huko Betheli akawaweka makuhani, na pia katika sehemu za juu za kuabudia miungu alizozitengeneza.

english: On the fifteenth day of the eighth month, a month of his own choosing, Jeroboam offered sacrifices on the altar he had set up in Bethel. So he ordained a feast for the Israelites, offered sacrifices on the altar, and burned incense.
ekegusii: Ase rituko ria ikomi na gatano, ase omotienyi o gatano na gatato, omotienyi achorete ere omonyene, akagenda ase egesasiimero aroisetie, agatwara Rituko Rinene ase Abaisraeli na akariina ase egesasiimero gosamba ubani.
swahili: Katika siku ya kumi na tano ya mwezi wa nane, mwezi aliouchagua mwenyewe, alitoa dhabihu juu ya madhabahu aliyokuwa amejenga huko Betheli. Kwa hiyo akaweka sikukuu kwa ajili ya Waisraeli na akapanda madhabahuni kutoa sadaka.

english: “Your father put a heavy yoke on us. But now you should lighten the burden of your father’s service and the heavy yoke he put on us, and we will serve you.”
ekegusii: “Iso igo akorete rikorogoto riaito rikaba ririto. Ase ayio bono aye orikore ribe rigusu, bwororobie emeremo eria emekong’u iso atobekerete, naintwe natogokorere.”
swahili: “Baba yako aliweka nira nzito juu yetu, lakini sasa tupunguzie kazi za kikatili na nira nzito aliyoweka juu yetu, nasi tutakutumikia.”

english: Rehoboam answered, “Go away for three days and then return to me.” So the people departed.
ekegusii: Rehoboamu akabateebia: “Genda inwe, na magega y’amatuko atato moirane gocha aa ase ’nde.” Ase ayio abanto bakagenda.
swahili: Rehoboamu akajibu, “Nendeni kwa muda wa siku tatu na kisha mnirudie.” Basi watu wakaenda zao.

english: Then King Rehoboam consulted with the elders who had served his father Solomon during his lifetime. “How do you advise me to respond to these people?” he asked.
ekegusii: Erio omorwoti Rehoboamu akabooria ogosemia korwa ase abagaaka baria baarenge gosemia Sulemani ise, ekero arenge moyo, akababoria: “Ngosemia ki mokong’a, erinde imbairanerie abanto aba?”
swahili: Kisha Mfalme Rehoboamu akataka shauri kwa wazee ambao walimtumikia Solomoni baba yake wakati wa uhai wake akawauliza, “Mnanishauri nini katika kuwajibu watu hawa?”

english: They replied, “If you will be a servant to these people and serve them this day, and if you will respond by speaking kind words to them, they will be your servants forever.”
ekegusii: Abagaaka bakamoiraneria: “Onye koganetie gokorera abanto aba bono, oigwe okoboria kwabo na okwane amang’ana amaya ase bare, erio barabwo nababe bakogokorera botambe.”
swahili: Wakajibu, “Kama leo utakuwa mtumishi wa watu hawa na kuwahudumia na kuwapa jibu linaloridhisha, watakuwa watumishi wako daima.”

english: But Rehoboam rejected the advice of the elders; instead, he consulted the young men who had grown up with him and served him.
ekegusii: Korende Rehoboamu akaanga ogosemia kw’abagaaka baria na akarigia ogosemia korwa ase abamura baria bakinete komo, na bono baarenge komokorera.
swahili: Lakini Rehoboamu akakataa shauri alilopewa na wazee na akataka ushauri kwa vijana wanaume rika lake waliokuwa wakimtumikia.

english: He asked them, “What message do you advise that we send back to these people who have spoken to me, saying, ‘Lighten the yoke your father put on us’?”
ekegusii: Akababoria: “Ngosemia ki morang’e? Ninki ndairanerie abanto aba bamboretie ng’a inyororobie chigurube chiria tata ababeekerete?”
swahili: Akawauliza, “Ninyi ushauri wenu ni nini? Tutawajibuje watu hawa wanaoniambia, ‘Ifanye nyepesi nira baba yako aliyoweka juu yetu?’ ”

english: Suddenly, as Jeroboam was standing beside the altar to burn incense, there came a man of God from Judah to Bethel by the word of the LORD.
ekegusii: Ase ogochika kw’Omonene omonto o Nyasae akarua ase ense ya Yuda. Ere agacha Beteli ekero Yeroboamu ateneine ase egesasiimero gosamba ubani.
swahili: Kwa neno la Bwana, mtu wa Mungu alifika Betheli kutoka Yuda wakati Yeroboamu alipokuwa amesimama kando ya madhabahu ili kutoa sadaka.

english: So the man of God went another way and did not return by the way he had come to Bethel. The Old Prophet and the Man of God
ekegusii: Ase ayio agaetera enchera eng’ao, tairanera ase enchera eria acherete agwo Beteli. Omobani omogotu o Beteli
swahili: Kwa hiyo akafuata njia nyingine na hakurudi kupitia njia ile ambayo alikuwa ameijia Betheli.

english: Now a certain old prophet was living in Bethel, and his sons came and told him all the deeds that the man of God had done that day in Bethel. They also told their father the words that the man had spoken to the king.
ekegusii: Narenge omobani omogotu oyomo omenyete agwo Beteli. Abana baye abamura bagacha, bakamoteebia amang’ana onsi omonto oria o Nyasae akorete ase rituko riria agwo Beteli, bakamoteebia na amang’ana akwanete nomorwoti.
swahili: Basi kulikuwepo na nabii fulani mzee aliyekuwa anaishi Betheli, ambaye wanawe walikuja kumwambia yote ambayo mtu wa Mungu alikuwa ameyafanya pale siku ile. Pia wakamwambia baba yao yale aliyomwambia mfalme.

english: “Which way did he go?” their father asked. And his sons showed him the way taken by the man of God, who had come from Judah.
ekegusii: Ise abamura baria akababoria “Nchera ki agenda?” Na abamura baye bakamworokia enchera omonto oria o Nyasae orwete ense ya Yuda agendete.
swahili: Baba yao akawauliza, “Ameelekea njia gani?” Nao wanawe wakamwonyesha ile njia yule mtu wa Mungu kutoka Yuda aliyopita.

english: So the prophet said to his sons, “Saddle the donkey for me.” Then they saddled the donkey for him, and he mounted it
ekegusii: Omobani oria omogotu agateebia abamura baye: “Imbeekere etigere egeikaransero.” Erio bakabeekera etigere egeikaransero, na omobani oria akariina etigere eria,
swahili: Hivyo akawaambia wanawe, “Nitandikieni punda.” Walipokwisha kumtandikia punda, akampanda

english: and went after the man of God. He found him sitting under an oak tree and asked, “Are you the man of God who came from Judah?” “I am,” he replied.
ekegusii: akabwatia omonto oria o Nyasae, akamonyora oikaransete inse y’omoaluni, akamobooria: “Naye omonto oria o Nyasae ochicha korwa ense ya Yuda?” Omonto oria akairaneria: “Ee, ninche.”
swahili: na kumfuatilia yule mtu wa Mungu. Akamkuta ameketi chini ya mwaloni na akamuuliza, “Je, wewe ndiwe mtu wa Mungu kutoka Yuda?” Akamjibu, “Mimi ndiye.”

english: So the prophet said to the man of God, “Come home with me and eat some bread.”
ekegusii: Omobani oria omogotu agateebia omonto oria o Nyasae: “Inchuo togende nka bwone, torie endagera.”
swahili: Basi nabii akamwambia, “Karibu nyumbani pamoja na mimi ule.”

english: But the man replied, “I cannot return with you or eat bread or drink water with you in this place.
ekegusii: Korende omobani oria orwete ense ya Yuda akamoiraneria: “Tinkoirana amo naye, gose tingwancha ondoisie nyomba mwao; tinkoria endagera amo naye gose konywa amaache aase aiga.
swahili: Yule mtu wa Mungu akasema, “Siwezi kurudi na kwenda nawe, wala siwezi kula mkate au kunywa maji pamoja nawe mahali hapa.

english: For I have been told by the word of the LORD: ‘You must not eat bread or drink water there or return by the way you came.’”
ekegusii: Naboigo nachikwa n’Omonene goetera ase ring’ana riaye, aganteebia: Tobaisa koria endagera gose konywa amaache aase aria, gose tobaisa koirana enchera gwachiereteo.”
swahili: Nimeambiwa kwa neno la Bwana: ‘Kamwe usile mkate au kunywa maji huko au kurudia njia uliyojia.’ ”

english: Then the prophet replied, “I too am a prophet like you, and an angel spoke to me by the word of the LORD, saying, ‘Bring him back with you to your house, so that he may eat bread and drink water.’” The old prophet was lying to him,
ekegusii: Omobani oria omogotu akamoteebia: “Nainche igo inde omobani buna aye, na omomalaika nigo achigetwe n’Omonene aganteebia: Genda omoiranie ache amo naye goika nyomba mwao, arie endagera na konywa amaache.” Korende igo amotebetie oborimo.
swahili: Yule nabii mzee akajibu, “Mimi pia ni nabii, kama wewe. Naye malaika alisema nami kwa neno la Bwana: ‘Mrudishe aje katika nyumba yako ili apate kula mkate na kunywa maji.’ ” (Lakini alikuwa akimwambia uongo.)

english: but the man of God went back with him, ate bread in his house, and drank water.
ekegusii: Ase ayio omonto oria o Nyasae akairana amo nomobani oria omogotu, akaria endagera na konywa amaache ase enyomba yaye.
swahili: Hivyo mtu wa Mungu akarudi pamoja naye na akala na kunywa katika nyumba yake.

english: And he cried out against the altar by the word of the LORD, “O altar, O altar, this is what the LORD says: ‘A son named Josiah will be born to the house of David, and upon you he will sacrifice the priests of the high places who burn incense upon you, and human bones will be burned upon you.’”
ekegusii: Na ase ogochika kw’Omonene omonto oria agaaka eriogi, akarera mamincha y’egesasiimero, agateeba: “Obee! Aye egesasiimero, aye egesasiimero! Omonene oteebire iga: Rora, omwana omomura naiborwe ase enyomba ya Daudi, erieta riaye Yosia; ere nang’wansere igoro yao aye egesasiimero, abakuani b’aase aimokererete igoro, baria bagosambera ubani igoro yao na amauga ’abaanto nasamberwe igoro yao.”
swahili: Akapiga kelele dhidi ya madhabahu kwa neno la Bwana: “Ee madhabahu, madhabahu! Hivi ndivyo asemavyo Bwana: ‘Mwana aitwaye Yosia atazaliwa katika nyumba ya Daudi. Juu yako atawatoa dhabihu makuhani wa mahali pa juu pa kuabudia miungu wale ambao wanatoa sadaka hapa sasa, nayo mifupa ya wanadamu itachomwa juu yako.’ ”

english: While they were sitting at the table, the word of the LORD came to the prophet who had brought him back,
ekegusii: Na ekero baarenge baikaransete ase emesa, ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha ase omobani oria omogotu, oria omoiranetie;
swahili: Wakati walipokuwa wameketi mezani, neno la Bwana likamjia yule nabii mzee aliyemrudisha huyo mtu wa Mungu.

english: and the prophet cried out to the man of God who had come from Judah, “This is what the LORD says: ‘Because you have defied the word of the LORD and have not kept the commandment that the LORD your God gave you,
ekegusii: ere agaaka eriogi, akarera ase omonto oria o Nyasae orwete ense ya Yuda, akabora: “Omonene oteebire ng’a kwangire koigwera ring’ana riaye, naende torendeti ogochika kori’Omonene, Nyasae oo, agochiigete.
swahili: Akampazia sauti yule mtu wa Mungu aliyekuwa ametoka Yuda, “Hivi ndivyo asemavyo Bwana: ‘Umeasi neno la Bwana na hukushika amri uliyopewa na Bwana Mungu wako,

english: but you went back and ate bread and drank water in the place where He told you not to do so, your body shall never reach the tomb of your fathers.’”
ekegusii: Ribaga ri’ayio kwairanire, naende kwarire endagera na kwanyure amaache aase aiga. Ay’Omonene agokanetie ng’a tokora igo. Ekiagera gwakorire igo, omobere oo gokwete tokonyara kobekwa ase chimbeera chie chisokoro chiao.”
swahili: bali ulirudi na ukala mkate na kunywa maji mahali ambapo alikuambia usile wala usinywe. Kwa hiyo maiti yako haitazikwa katika kaburi la baba zako.’ ”

english: And after the man of God had finished eating and drinking, the old prophet who had brought him back saddled the donkey for him.
ekegusii: Ekero omobani oria omogotu akoorire koria na konywa, akabeekera etigere egeikaransero ase omobani oria airanetie araikaranse.
swahili: Wakati huyo mtu wa Mungu alipomaliza kula na kunywa, nabii aliyekuwa amemrudisha akamtandikia punda wake.

english: As he went on his way, a lion met him on the road and killed him, and his body was left lying in the road, with the donkey and the lion standing beside it.
ekegusii: Na ekero omobani oria orwete ense ya Yuda arenge ase orogendo inchera, akaumerana nendo, ero ekamoita agakwa. Omobere oye ogatugutwa ase enchera, na etigere na endo chigatenena mbarabare ase omobere oria.
swahili: Alipokuwa akienda akakutana na simba njiani, akamuua na maiti yake ikabwagwa barabarani, yule punda wake na simba wakiwa wamesimama karibu yake.

english: And there were men passing by who saw the body lying in the road with the lion standing beside it, and they went and reported this in the city where the old prophet lived.
ekegusii: Abanto bagaeta aase aria, bakarora omobere otugutire ase enchera, na endo eteneine mbarabare ase omobere oria. Barabwo bakagenda bagateeba amang’ana ayio ase abanto b’omochie, agwo ase omobani oria omogotu amenyete.
swahili: Baadhi ya watu waliopita pale waliona maiti imebwagwa pale chini, simba akiwa amesimama kando ya maiti, wakaenda na kutoa habari katika mji ambao nabii mzee aliishi.

english: When the prophet who had brought him back from his journey heard this, he said, “It is the man of God who disobeyed the command of the LORD. Therefore the LORD has delivered him to the lion, and it has mauled him and killed him, according to the word that the LORD had spoken to him.”
ekegusii: Na ekero omobani oria omoiranetie korwa inchera, aigwete amang’ana ayio, agateeba: “Oyio nomonto oria o Nyasae bwangete koigwera ring’ana ri’Omonene; ase ayio, n’Omonene omorua ase endo, nero yamotandoire na komoita, koreng’ana buna Omonene amotebetie.”
swahili: Yule nabii aliyekuwa amemrudisha kutoka safari yake aliposikia habari hii akasema, “Ni yule mtu wa Mungu ambaye aliasi neno la Bwana. Bwana amemtoa kwa simba, ambaye amemrarua na kumuua, sawasawa na neno la Bwana lilivyokuwa limemwonya.”

english: Then the old prophet instructed his sons, “Saddle the donkey for me.” So they saddled it,
ekegusii: Erio agateebia abamura baye: “Imbekere etigere egeikaransero.” Nabarabwo bagakora bo.
swahili: Nabii akawaambia wanawe, “Nitandikieni punda,” nao wakafanya hivyo.

english: and he went and found the body lying in the road, with the donkey and the lion standing beside it. The lion had not eaten the body or mauled the donkey.
ekegusii: Ere akagenda, akanyora omobere otugutire ase enchera, na etigere na endo chiteneine mbarabare ase omobere oria. Endo tiyariete omobere oria, gose tiyaitete etigere eria, gose koyetandora.
swahili: Kisha akatoka akaenda akakuta maiti imebwagwa chini barabarani, punda na simba wakiwa wamesimama kando yake. Simba hakuwa amekula ile maiti wala kumrarua punda.

english: So the old prophet lifted up the body of the man of God, laid it on the donkey, and brought it back to his own city to mourn for him and bury him.
ekegusii: Omobani oria akaimokia omobere oria bw’omonto o Nyasae, akayobeeka ase etigere igoro, erio akayoirania gochia ase omochie oye omonyene, akamoreera na akamotindeka.
swahili: Basi yule nabii mzee akachukua maiti ya mtu wa Mungu, akailaza juu ya punda na akairudisha katika mji wake, ili amwombolezee na kumzika.

english: That day the man of God gave a sign, saying, “The LORD has spoken this sign: ‘Surely the altar will be split apart, and the ashes upon it will be poured out.’”
ekegusii: Omonto oria o Nyasae akarua ekemanyererio ase rituko riria, agateeba: “Eke nakio ekemanyererio Omonene akwanire: Rora, egesasiimero eke nagetandoke, ne ribu riria rire igoro yaye riiteke.”
swahili: Siku iyo hiyo, mtu wa Mungu akatoa ishara: “Hii ndiyo ishara Bwana aliyotangaza: Madhabahu haya yatapasuka na majivu yaliyo juu yake yatamwagika.”

english: Then he laid the body in his own tomb, and they lamented over him, “Oh, my brother!”
ekegusii: Ere akabeeka omobere oria ase embeera yaye omonyene, na barabwo bakamoreera, na kera oyomo agateeba: “Obee! Momura ominto!”
swahili: Kisha akailaza ile maiti katika kaburi lake huyo nabii mzee, nao wakaomboleza juu yake na kusema, “Ee ndugu yangu!”

english: After he had buried him, the prophet said to his sons, “When I die, you must bury me in the tomb where the man of God is buried. Lay my bones beside his bones,
ekegusii: Ekero akoorire komotindeka agateebia abamura baye: “Ekero nainche ndakwe, montindeke ime ase embeera eyio ase omonto o Nyasae atindekire; mwarerie amauga aane mbarabare ase amauga aye.
swahili: Baada ya kumzika, akawaambia wanawe, “Wakati nitakapokufa, mnizike kwenye kaburi alimozikwa huyu mtu wa Mungu; lazeni mifupa yangu kando ya mifupa yake.

english: for the message that he cried out by the word of the LORD against the altar in Bethel and against all the shrines on the high places in the cities of Samaria will surely come to pass.”
ekegusii: Ekeene, amang’ana aria araaretie buna achigetwe n’Omonene, agasoera egesasiimero agwo Beteli, naende agasoera aase aimokererete igoro agosasimerwa aria ase emechie ya Samaria, goika aikeranigwe.” Ebibe bia Yeroboamu bi’okomosiria
swahili: Kwa maana ujumbe alioutangaza kwa neno la Bwana dhidi ya madhabahu huko Betheli na dhidi ya madhabahu yote katika mahali pa juu pa kuabudia miungu katika miji ya Samaria, hakika yatatokea kweli.”
