swahili: Ahishari: msimamizi wa jumba la kifalme; Adoniramu mwana wa Abda: msimamizi wa kazi za kulazimisha.

english: Solomon had twelve governors over all Israel to provide food for the king and his household. Each one would arrange provisions for one month of the year,
ekegusii: Sulemani nachorete abanto abanene ikomi na babere abaarenge gosangereria endagera na koyerentera omorwoti amo nab’enyomba yaye. Kera oyomo ase aba ikomi na babere nigo areenge korenta endagera eisaine koriegwa ase omotienyi oyomo ase omwaka.
swahili: Pia Solomoni alikuwa na watawala kumi na wawili wa wilaya katika Israeli yote, walioleta mahitaji kwa mfalme na kwa watu wa nyumbani kwa mfalme. Kila mmoja alitoa chakula kwa mwezi mmoja katika mwaka.

english: and these were their names: Ben-hur in the hill country of Ephraim;
ekegusii: Aya naro amarieta ’abaanto abwo. Beni‐Huri agatenenera ense y’ebigoro y’Efraimu.
swahili: Majina yao ni haya: Ben-Huri: katika nchi ya vilima ya Efraimu;

english: Ben-deker in Makaz, in Shaalbim, in Beth-shemesh, and in Elon-beth-hanan;
ekegusii: Beni‐Dekeri agatenenera emechie ya Makasi, na Shaalabimu, na Beti‐Semesi, na Eloni, na Beti‐Hanani.
swahili: Ben-Dekeri: katika Makasi, Shaalbimu, Beth-Shemeshi na Elon-Bethhanani;

english: Now when Hiram king of Tyre heard that Solomon had been anointed king in his father’s place, he sent envoys to Solomon; for Hiram had always been a friend of David.
ekegusii: Hiramu, omorwoti o Turo ekero aigwete ng’a Sulemani oakirwe amaguta na obeire omorwoti ribaga ria ise, agatoma abasomba baye asare, ekiagera Hiramu botambe igo anchete Daudi.
swahili: Hiramu mfalme wa Tiro aliposikia kuwa Solomoni ametiwa mafuta awe mfalme mahali pa Daudi baba yake, akatuma wajumbe kwa Solomoni, kwa sababu Hiramu siku zote alikuwa na uhusiano mzuri wa kirafiki na Daudi.

english: So Hiram provided Solomon with all the cedar and cypress timber he wanted,
ekegusii: Hiramu akaa Sulemani emete, emecharake na emetarakwa buna Sulemani aganetie.
swahili: Kwa njia hii Hiramu akampa Solomoni miti yote ya mierezi na magogo ya misunobari kama alivyohitaji,

english: and year after year Solomon would provide Hiram with 20,000 cors of wheat as food for his household, as well as 20,000 baths of pure olive oil.
ekegusii: Sulemani akaa Hiramu obosie bw’engano ebitonga chilifu amagana abere (200,000) koba endagera ase abanto b’enyomba yaye, na amaguta amitire korwa ase amazeituni chilita chilifu isano na ibere, na amagana abere (7,200). Ebinto ebio Sulemani akaba okoa Hiramu ase kera omwaka.
swahili: naye Solomoni akampa Hiramu kori 20,000 za ngano kama chakula kwa ajili ya watu wa nyumbani mwake, pamoja na mafuta safi ya zeituni yaliyokamuliwa bathi 20,000. Solomoni aliendelea kumfanyia Hiramu hivyo mwaka baada ya mwaka.

english: And the LORD gave Solomon wisdom, as He had promised him. There was peace between Hiram and Solomon, and the two of them made a treaty. Solomon’s Labor Force
ekegusii: Omonene akaa Sulemani obong’aini buna amorierete eira. Omorembe okaba ase egati ya Hiramu na Sulemani, na aba babere bagakora okobwatana gw’okoigwana.
swahili: Bwana akampa Solomoni hekima, kama alivyomwahidi. Palikuwepo na uhusiano wa amani kati ya Hiramu na Solomoni, na wote wawili wakafanya mkataba.

english: Then King Solomon conscripted a labor force of 30,000 men from all Israel.
ekegusii: Omorwoti Sulemani agakora omooroberio bw’abaanto chilifu emerongo etato (30,000) korwa ase Abaisraeli bonsi, akababeeka bakore emeremo yagwenerete gokorwa.
swahili: Mfalme Solomoni akakusanya wafanyakazi 30,000 kutoka Israeli yote.

english: He sent them to Lebanon in monthly shifts of 10,000 men, so that they would spend one month in Lebanon and two months at home. And Adoniram was in charge of the forced labor.
ekegusii: Agaatanana abanto aba ase ebiombe bitato, kera ekeombe gekaba abanto chilifu ikomi. Kera ekeombe gekaba kegokora emeremo agwo Lebanoni ase omotienyi oyomo na kobeera inka ase emetienyi ebere. Adoniramu akabeekwa gotenenera emeremo eyio yagwenerete gokorwa.
swahili: Akawapeleka Lebanoni kwa zamu za watu 10,000 kwa mwezi, hivyo walikaa Lebanoni kwa mwezi mmoja na miezi miwili nyumbani. Adoniramu ndiye alikuwa kiongozi wa shokoa.

english: Solomon had 70,000 porters and 80,000 stonecutters in the mountains,
ekegusii: Boigo Sulemani nabwate abanto chilifu emerongo etano na ebere (70,000) abaarenge kobogoria chigurube, na abanto chilifu emerongo etano na etato (80,000) abaarenge kobaacha amagena agwo ase ebitunwa.
swahili: Solomoni alikuwa na wachukuzi wa mizigo 70,000 na wachonga mawe 80,000 huko vilimani,

english: not including his 3,300 foremen who supervised the workers.
ekegusii: Naende Sulemani nabwate abanto chilifu isato na amagana atato (3,300) batenenerete abanto baarenge gokora emeremo.
swahili: pamoja na wasimamizi 3,300 ambao walisimamia kazi hiyo na kuwaongoza wafanyakazi.

english: And the king commanded them to quarry large, costly stones to lay the foundation of the temple with dressed stones.
ekegusii: Omorwoti akabachika baabaache amagena amanene aye rigori rinene, erinde oboroso bw’enyomba bobekwe amagena abaachire buya.
swahili: Kwa amri ya mfalme walitoa kwenye machimbo ya mawe, mawe makubwa, yaliyo bora kwa kujengea msingi wa nyumba yaliyochongwa kwa ajili ya Hekalu.

english: So Solomon’s and Hiram’s builders, along with the Gebalites, quarried the stone and prepared the timber and stone for the construction of the temple.
ekegusii: Naboigo abaagachi ba Sulemani, na aba Hiramu amo nabaanto b’omochie o Gebali bagakora emeremo y’okobaacha na gosenia amagena na koroisia chibao ase oboagacho boria.
swahili: Mafundi wa Solomoni, wa Hiramu na watu wa Gebali walikata na kuandaa mbao na mawe kwa ajili ya ujenzi wa Hekalu.

english: And Solomon relayed this message to Hiram:
ekegusii: Na Sulemani agatoma amang’ana ase Hiramu, akabora,
swahili: Solomoni akapeleka ujumbe huu kwa Hiramu:

english: “As you are well aware, due to the wars waged on all sides against my father David, he could not build a house for the Name of the LORD his God until the LORD had put his enemies under his feet.
ekegusii: “Nomanyete ng’a Daudi tata tanyarete koagacha enyomba ase ogosasimera erieta ri’Omonene, Nyasae oye, ekiagera ababisa nigo baarenge komorwania chiseegi chinsemo chionsi, goika ekero Omonene ababeegete inse ase obogaambi bwa Daudi.
swahili: “Unajua kwamba kwa sababu ya vita vilivyopiganwa dhidi ya baba yangu Daudi kutoka pande zote, hakuweza kujenga Hekalu kwa ajili ya Jina la Bwana Mungu wake, hadi Bwana alipowaweka adui zake chini ya miguu yake.

english: But now the LORD my God has given me rest on every side, and there is no adversary or crisis.
ekegusii: Korende bono Omonene, Nyasae one, ong’eire obotoereru korwa ase kera ensemo; ababisa tibari aande, gose amabe ande onsi.
swahili: Lakini sasa Bwana Mungu wangu amenipa utulivu kila upande hakuna adui wala maafa.

english: So behold, I plan to build a house for the Name of the LORD my God, according to what the LORD said to my father David: ‘I will put your son on your throne in your place, and he will build the house for My Name.’
ekegusii: Omonene nigo ateebeetie Daudi tata: Omwana oo oria ndabeeke abe ase ekerogo kiao ki’obonene magega yao, nere orang’agachere enyomba aase mogosasimera erieta riane. Ase ayio, naganirie koagacha enyomba aase togosasimera erieta ri’Omonene, Nyasae one.
swahili: Kwa hiyo, ninakusudia kujenga Hekalu kwa ajili ya Jina la Bwana, Mungu wangu, kama Bwana alivyomwambia baba yangu Daudi, wakati aliposema, ‘Mwanao nitakayemweka kwenye kiti cha ufalme mahali pako, ndiye atajenga Hekalu kwa ajili ya Jina langu.’

english: Now therefore, order that cedars of Lebanon be cut down for me. My servants will be with your servants, and I will pay your servants whatever wages you set, for you know that there are none among us as skilled in logging as the Sidonians.” Hiram’s Reply to Solomon (2 Chronicles 2:11–18)
ekegusii: Na bono aye, chiika abanto bangechere emete emecharake ya Lebanoni. Abasomba baane mbabwatane nabasomba bao ase emeremo eyio, na inche ning’akane abasomba bao eng’eria ende yonsi orabeeke. Nomanyete ng’a abanto baane tibamanyeti kogecha emete buna abanto ba Sidoni.”
swahili: “Hivyo toa amri ili mierezi ya Lebanoni ikatwe kwa ajili yangu. Watu wangu watafanya kazi na watu wako, nami nitawalipa watu wako kwa ujira wowote utakaoupanga. Unajua kwamba hatuna mtu yeyote mwenye ustadi katika kukata miti kama Wasidoni.”

english: When Hiram received Solomon’s message, he rejoiced greatly and said, “Blessed be the LORD this day! He has given David a wise son over this great people!”
ekegusii: Ekero Hiramu aigwete amang’ana a Sulemani, akaba nomogooko omonene, akabora, “Omonene atogigwe rituko ria reero, oyo oeire Daudi omwana omomura omong’aini agambere abanto aba abange.”
swahili: Hiramu aliposikia ujumbe wa Solomoni, akafurahishwa sana akasema, “Ahimidiwe Bwana leo, kwa kuwa amempa Daudi mwana mwenye hekima kutawala juu ya taifa hili kubwa.”

english: Then Hiram sent a reply to Solomon, saying: “I have received your message; I will do all you desire regarding the cedar and cypress timber.
ekegusii: Erio agatoma amang’ana ase Sulemani, agateeba: “Naigure amang’ana gwatomire ase ’nde; igo inde ang’e gokora onsi aya oganetie ase amang’ana ’emete emecharake na emetarakwa.
swahili: Hiramu akatuma neno kwa Solomoni: “Nimepokea ujumbe ulionipelekea na nitafanya yote unayohitaji katika kukupatia magogo ya mierezi na misunobari.

english: My servants will haul the logs from Lebanon to the Sea, and I will float them as rafts by sea to the place you specify. There I will separate the logs, and you can take them away. And in exchange, you can meet my needs by providing my household with food.”
ekegusii: Abasomba baane mbayetirimbokie korwa ase Lebanoni gochia ase enyancha, nainche ninyebeke amo inyesibe, eirwe nenyancha echeng’enenete, goika aase oganetie. “Aase agwo nao erasansorerwe, na aye oyerusieo. Erio ong’isanekerie okogania kwane ase okobaa abanto baane endagera yabo.”
swahili: Watu wangu watayakokota kutoka Lebanoni hadi kwenye bahari, nami nitayafunga mafungu mafungu yaelee juu ya maji hadi utakapoelekeza. Huko nitayatenganisha, nawe utaweza kuyachukua. Wewe utakidhi haja yangu kwa kunipatia chakula kwa ajili ya watu wa nyumbani mwangu.”

english: In the four hundred and eightieth year after the Israelites had come out of the land of Egypt, in the month of Ziv, the second month of the fourth year of Solomon’s reign over Israel, he began to build the house of the LORD.
ekegusii: Ase omwaka bw’amagana ane, na emerongo etano na etato, magega Abaisraeli kobarure ense ya Misiri, noro omwaka o kane bw’okogaamba gwa Sulemani igoro y’Abaisraeli, ase omotienyi o Sivu, omotienyi o kabere, Sulemani agachaaka koagacha enyomba y’Omonene.
swahili: Katika mwaka wa 480 baada ya Waisraeli kutoka nchi ya Misri, katika mwaka wa nne wa utawala wa Solomoni katika Israeli, katika mwezi wa Zivu, ambao ndio mwezi wa pili, alianza kujenga Hekalu la Bwana.

english: He built chambers all along the temple, each five cubits high and attached to the temple with beams of cedar. God’s Promise to Solomon
ekegusii: Oboagacho bw’enyomba inse nigo bwatunyaine Hekalu, na kera rirongo nigo riareenge nobotambe gochia igoro ekerengo ki’amaboko atano. Oboagacho obwo nigo bwabwateranetigwe ne Hekalu ne chibao chi’emecharake.
swahili: Mfalme Solomoni akajenga vyumba vya pembeni kuzunguka Hekalu lote. Kimo cha kila kimoja kilikuwa dhiraa tano. Navyo vilikuwa vimeunganishwa na Hekalu kwa boriti za mierezi.

english: Then the word of the LORD came to Solomon, saying:
ekegusii: Ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha ase Sulemani, rikamoteebia,
swahili: Neno la Bwana likamjia Solomoni kusema:

english: “As for this temple you are building, if you walk in My statutes, carry out My ordinances, and keep all My commandments by walking in them, I will fulfill through you the promise I made to your father David.
ekegusii: “Amang’ana igoro y’enyomba eye okong’agachera bono nigo arabe iga: Korabwatie emeroberio yane echiikire na koigwera amachiiko aane onsi na koyakora, erio nainche ning’ikeranie ring’ana riane asore, riria nakwanete na Daudi iso:
swahili: “Kwa habari ya Hekalu hili unalojenga, kama ukifuata amri zangu, ukatunza masharti yangu na kushika maagizo yangu yote na kuyatii, kwa kupitia wewe nitatimiza ahadi niliyomwahidi Daudi baba yako.

english: And I will dwell among the Israelites and will not abandon My people Israel.” The Temple’s Interior (2 Chronicles 3:5–9)
ekegusii: Inche nigo ndamenye aroro ase egati y’Abaisraeli, tingotiga abanto baane Abaisraeli.” Okoroisia Hekalu ime (2 Amg 3:8-14)
swahili: Nami nitakaa miongoni mwa Waisraeli, nami sitawaacha watu wangu Israeli.”

english: So Solomon built the temple and finished it.
ekegusii: Sulemani akaagacha enyomba eria na akayekoora buna iga:
swahili: Basi Solomoni akajenga Hekalu na kulikamilisha.

english: He lined the interior walls with cedar paneling from the floor of the temple to the ceiling, and he covered the floor with cypress boards.
ekegusii: Agatuba chinyasi chia ime y’enyomba yonsi korwa inse goika igoro ne chibao chi’emecharake, na inse y’enyomba akayetuba ne chibao chi’emetarakwa.
swahili: Akazifunika kuta zake za ndani kwa mbao za mierezi, akizipigilia ukutani kuanzia sakafuni mwa Hekalu hadi kwenye dari na kufunika sakafu ya Hekalu kwa mbao za misunobari.

english: He partitioned off the twenty cubits at the rear of the temple with cedar boards from floor to ceiling to form within the temple an inner sanctuary, the Most Holy Place.
ekegusii: Akaagacha akanyomba ka ime bosio kegima ase Hekalu ime, kabe Aase Aachenu Mono. Obotambe bwaye nigo bwareenge bw’ekerengo ki’amaboko emerongo ebere; akanyomba karia akagatuba ne chibao chi’emecharake, korwa inse goika igoro.
swahili: Akagawa dhiraa ishirini sehemu ya nyuma ya Hekalu kwa mbao za mierezi kuanzia kwenye sakafu hadi darini ili kufanya sehemu takatifu ya ndani, yaani Patakatifu pa Patakatifu.

english: And the main hall in front of this room was forty cubits long.
ekegusii: Ensemo y’enyomba yareenge Hekalu enyene nigo yareenge y’ekerengo ki’amaboko emerongo ene.
swahili: Ukumbi mkubwa uliokuwa mbele ya chumba hiki ndio ulikuwa na urefu wa dhiraa arobaini.

english: The cedar paneling inside the temple was carved with gourds and open flowers. Everything was cedar; not a stone could be seen.
ekegusii: Chibao chi’emecharake chiatubete enyomba ime nigo chiareenge nemegwekano y’ebirandi, na ey’ebisicha, yabaachetwe ase chibao echio. Yonsi nigo yatubetwe nemecharake, na igena rinde tiriarorekanete.
swahili: Hekalu ndani ilikuwa ya mierezi iliyonakshiwa mifano ya maboga na maua yaliyochanua. Kila kitu kilikuwa cha mwerezi, hakuna jiwe ambalo lilionekana.

english: Solomon also prepared the inner sanctuary within the temple to set the ark of the covenant of the LORD there.
ekegusii: Ime ye Hekalu bosio kegima nigo aroisetie akanyomba aase Esanduki y’Okobwatana y’Omonene yareenge kobekwa.
swahili: Ndani ya Hekalu akatengeneza sehemu takatifu ya ndani, kwa ajili ya kuweka Sanduku la Agano la Bwana.

english: The house that King Solomon built for the LORD was sixty cubits long, twenty cubits wide, and thirty cubits high.
ekegusii: Enyomba eria omorwoti Sulemani aagacherete Omonene nigo yareenge iga: Obotambe bwaye nobw’ekerengo ki’amaboko emerongo etano nomo, na obogare bwaye amaboko emerongo ebere, na obotambe bwaye gochia igoro amaboko emerongo etato.
swahili: Hekalu hilo Mfalme Solomoni alilojenga kwa ajili ya Bwana lilikuwa na urefu wa dhiraa sitini, upana wa dhiraa ishirini na kimo cha dhiraa thelathini kwenda juu.

english: The inner sanctuary was twenty cubits long, twenty cubits wide, and twenty cubits high. He overlaid the inside with pure gold, and he also overlaid the altar of cedar.
ekegusii: Obotambe bw’akanyomba karia ka ime nigo bwareenge obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko emerongo ebere; naboigo obogare bwaye na obotambe bwaye gochia igoro, naende nigo kaoomire netaabu echenire. Bosio bw’akanyomba karia egesasiimero gekaroisigwa, kegatubwa ne chibao chi’emecharake.
swahili: Sehemu takatifu ya ndani ilikuwa na upana, urefu na kimo cha dhiraa ishirini ndani kwa ndani. Akaifunika ndani kwa dhahabu safi, pia akaifunika madhabahu ya mierezi vivyo hivyo.

english: So Solomon overlaid the inside of the temple with pure gold, and he extended gold chains across the front of the inner sanctuary, which was overlaid with gold.
ekegusii: Sulemani akaooma Hekalu ime netaabu engiya. Chingataare chiaoomire netaabu chikabekwa ase egesieri bosio bw’akanyomba ka ime.
swahili: Solomoni akaifunika sehemu ya ndani ya Hekalu kwa dhahabu safi, naye akaitandaza mikufu ya dhahabu kutoka upande moja hadi ule mwingine mbele ya Patakatifu pa Patakatifu, ambako palifunikwa kwa dhahabu.

english: In the inner sanctuary he made two cherubim, each ten cubits high, out of olive wood.
ekegusii: Sulemani akaroisia emegwekano y’ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba babere korwa ase emete y’emezeituni, akayebeeka agwo ase akanyomba ka ime.
swahili: Katika Patakatifu pa Patakatifu akatengeneza makerubi wawili kwa mzeituni, kila moja likiwa na dhiraa kumi kwenda juu.

english: One wing of the first cherub was five cubits long, and the other wing was five cubits long as well. So the full wingspan was ten cubits.
ekegusii: Obotambe bwa kera orobaaba rwa kera oyomo nigo bwareenge obw’amaboko atano; korwa ensinyo y’orobaaba oromo goika ey’oronde nigo bwareenge obotambe bw’amaboko ikomi.
swahili: Bawa moja la kerubi wa kwanza lilikuwa na urefu wa dhiraa tano na bawa jingine dhiraa tano, hivyo urefu kutoka ncha ya bawa moja hadi ncha ya bawa jingine ulikuwa dhiraa kumi.

english: The second cherub also measured ten cubits; both cherubim had the same size and shape,
ekegusii: Omokerubi oria onde boigo nigo areenge bw’ekerengo ekio ekio. Ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba bonsi babere nigo baarenge bareng’aine kegima ase ekerengo na bagwekaine ase ekieni.
swahili: Kerubi wa pili alikuwa na urefu wa dhiraa kumi pia, hivyo makerubi hao wawili walifanana kwa vipimo na kwa umbo.

english: and the height of each cherub was ten cubits.
ekegusii: Obotambe bwa kera egetongwa kebwate chimbaba nigo bwareenge obw’amaboko ikomi.
swahili: Kimo cha kila kerubi kilikuwa dhiraa kumi.

english: And he placed the cherubim inside the innermost room of the temple. Since their wings were spread out, the wing of the first cherub touched one wall, while the wing of the second cherub touched the other wall, and in the middle of the room their wingtips touched.
ekegusii: Ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba abwo bakabeekwa ase akanyomba karia bosio ime ye Hekalu. Chimbaaba chiabo nigo chiaramboire; orobaaba oromo rw’egetongwa kebwate chimbaba oyomo rogaika enyasi ensemo eyemo, na oromo rw’oyonde rogaika enyasi ensemo ende; gati‐gati y’enyomba orobaaba ronde rwa kera egetongwa kebwate chimbaba rogakunana.
swahili: Aliwaweka makerubi hao ndani ya Patakatifu pa Patakatifu pa Hekalu, mabawa yake yakiwa yamekunjuliwa. Bawa la kerubi mmoja liligusa ukuta mmoja, wakati bawa la yule mwingine liligusa ukuta mwingine, nayo mabawa yao mengine yaligusana katikati ya chumba.

english: He also overlaid the cherubim with gold.
ekegusii: Ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba bonsi babere bakaoomwa netaabu.
swahili: Akafunika wale makerubi kwa dhahabu.

english: Then he carved the walls all around the temple, in both the inner and outer sanctuaries, with carved engravings of cherubim, palm trees, and open flowers.
ekegusii: Sulemani agachabera chinyasi chionsi chie Hekalu, na echi’akanyomba ka ime, nemegwekano y’ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba, na ey’emekendo, na ey’ebisicha, yabaachetwe ase chibao echio.
swahili: Juu ya kuta zote zilizozunguka Hekalu, za vyumba vya ndani na vya nje, zilipambwa kwa nakshi zilizokatwa za makerubi, miti ya mitende na maua yaliyochanua.

english: The portico at the front of the main hall of the temple was twenty cubits long, extending across the width of the temple and projecting out ten cubits in front of the temple.
ekegusii: Enyomba eria yaagachetwe bosio bwe Hekalu enyene nigo yareenge iga: Obotambe bwaye gochia ime nobw’ekerengo ki’amaboko ikomi, na obogare bwaye amaboko emerongo ebere, nigo bwareng’aine nobogare bwe Hekalu.
swahili: Baraza ya mbele ya Hekalu ilienea dhiraa ishirini kulingana na upana wa Hekalu na kujitokeza dhiraa kumi mbele ya Hekalu.

english: And he overlaid the temple floor with gold in both the inner and outer sanctuaries. The Doors
ekegusii: Inse ase ebinyomba ebio bibere akaooma netaabu.
swahili: Pia alifunika sakafu zote za vyumba vya ndani na vya nje vya Hekalu kwa dhahabu.

english: For the entrance to the inner sanctuary, Solomon constructed doors of olive wood with five-sided doorposts.
ekegusii: Ebisieri bibere bikaroisigwa korwa ase chibao chi’emezeituni bikabekwa ase egesoero gi’akanyomba ka ime. Emetobwa nigo yatenenirie ensemo eyemo ya isano y’enyasi.
swahili: Kwa ingilio la Patakatifu pa Patakatifu akatengeneza milango ya mbao za mzeituni, zikiwa na miimo na vizingiti vyenye umbo la pembe tano.

english: The double doors were made of olive wood, and he carved into them cherubim, palm trees, and open flowers and overlaid the cherubim and palm trees with hammered gold.
ekegusii: Ebisieri ebio bionsi bibere bi’emezeituni bigachaberwa nemegwekano y’ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba, na ey’emekendo, na ey’ebisicha, yabaachetwe ase chibao echio. Akaooma bionsi netaabu; boigo agasiarera ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba amo ne chibao chi’emekendo netaabu.
swahili: Juu ya milango miwili ya mbao za mzeituni alinakshi makerubi, miti ya mitende pamoja na maua yaliyochanua na kufunika makerubi na miti ya mitende kwa dhahabu iliyofuliwa.

english: In the same way he made four-sided doorposts of olive wood for the sanctuary entrance.
ekegusii: Naende emetobwa y’egesieri gie Hekalu enyene ekaroisigwa korwa ase chibao chi’emezeituni ere ne chikoona inye,
swahili: Kwa njia iyo hiyo akatengeneza miimo yenye pande nne ya miti ya mizeituni, kwa ajili ya ingilio la ukumbi mkubwa.

english: The two doors were made of cypress wood, and each had two folding panels.
ekegusii: na ebisieri bibere bi’emetarakwa; kera egesieri nigo kiareenge ebing’ese bibere biare konyara koigorwa biaringanigwa.
swahili: Kulikuwa na milango miwili iliyoweza kukunjuka iliyotengenezwa kwa mbao za msunobari na kila mmoja ulikuwa na bawaba ambazo zingeuwezesha kujikunja kila kipande juu ya kingine.

english: He carved into them cherubim, palm trees, and open flowers; and he overlaid them with gold, hammered evenly over the carvings. The Courtyard
ekegusii: Ebisieri ebio bigachaberwa nemegwekano y’ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba, na ey’emekendo na ey’ebisicha, yabaachetwe ase chibao echio, bikaoomwa buya netaabu igoro y’emegwekano eyio.
swahili: Akanakshi makerubi, miti ya mitende na maua yaliyochanua juu yake na kufunika kwa dhahabu iliyonyooshwa vizuri juu ya michoro.

english: Solomon built the inner courtyard with three rows of dressed stone and one row of trimmed cedar beams.
ekegusii: Naende Sulemani akaagacha chindwaki chi’eraaro ya ime. Chindwaro isato chie chindwaki echio agachiagacha namagena abaachire, na orwaro oromo akaroagacha ne chibao chi’emecharake.
swahili: Tena akajenga ua wa ndani safu tatu za mawe yaliyochongwa na safu moja ya boriti za mierezi zilizorembwa.

english: The foundation of the house of the LORD was laid in the fourth year of Solomon’s reign, in the month of Ziv.
ekegusii: Oboroso bwe Hekalu bokabekwa ase omotienyi o Sivu, ase omwaka o kane bw’okogaamba gwa Sulemani.
swahili: Msingi wa Hekalu la Bwana uliwekwa katika mwaka wa nne, katika mwezi wa Zivu, ndio mwezi wa tano.

english: In his eleventh year and eighth month, the month of Bul, the temple was finished in every detail and according to every specification. So he built the temple in seven years.
ekegusii: Na ase omotienyi o gatano na gatato, omotienyi o Bulu, ase omwaka o ikomi nomo, oboagacho bwe Hekalu bokaera buna yaroberetigwe. Ase igo Sulemani akaira emiaka etano na ebere ase okoagacha enyomba eria.
swahili: Katika mwaka wa kumi na moja, mwezi wa Buli, ndio mwezi wa nane, Hekalu lilikamilika katika hatua zake zote kwa kufuatana na maelekezo yake Solomoni. Alilijenga kwa miaka saba.

english: He also had narrow windows framed high in the temple. The Chambers
ekegusii: Sulemani akaroisia ase enyomba eria ebibao bi’emete; ebibao ebio tibiareenge koigorwa.
swahili: Akatengeneza madirisha membamba yenye vidirisha vidogo vya juu katika Hekalu.

english: Against the walls of the temple and the inner sanctuary, Solomon built a chambered structure around the temple, in which he constructed the side rooms.
ekegusii: Naende akaagacha chinyomba chinde inse, chinyasi chiaye chichomeranirie ne chinyasi chi’enyomba enyene ase amakere na magega, akanachana ebinyomba imeo.
swahili: Akafanyiza vyumba vya pembeni kulizunguka Hekalu lote vikishikamana na kuta za Hekalu na za Patakatifu pa Patakatifu.

english: The bottom floor was five cubits wide, the middle floor six cubits, and the third floor seven cubits. He also placed offset ledges around the outside of the temple, so that nothing would be inserted into its walls.
ekegusii: Obogare bw’ebinyomba bia inse nigo bwareenge bw’ekerengo ki’amaboko atano, na ebie rirongo ria kabere amaboko atano na rimo, na ebie rirongo ria gatato amaboko atano na abere. Nigo akorete ebitambokero bikabwatana nenyasi ye Hekalu ase kera rirongo, erinde emeriibo egosiira kera rirongo etoorere ase ebitambokero ebio, etari gosoigwa ase enyasi.
swahili: Ghorofa ya chini kabisa ilikuwa na upana wa dhiraa tano, ya kati ilikuwa dhiraa sita na ya tatu ilikuwa dhiraa saba. Kuzunguka ukuta wa nje wa Hekalu akapunguza ukuta pande zote ili boriti zisishikane kwenye kuta za Hekalu.

english: The temple was constructed using finished stones cut at the quarry, so that no hammer or chisel or any other iron tool was heard in the temple while it was being built.
ekegusii: Ekero enyomba yaagachetwe, igo yaagachetwe namagena aseneirie agwo aase areenge kobaacherwa, erinde eriogi ri’enyundo, gose eri’egesire, gose eri’egekorero kende gionsi gi’ekioma tikeigugwa ase Hekalu ekero yaagachetwe.
swahili: Katika kujenga Hekalu, yalitumika tu mawe yaliyochongwa huko machimboni, wala hakuna nyundo, patasi au chombo kingine chochote cha chuma kilichosikika sauti yake katika eneo la ujenzi wa Hekalu wakati lilipokuwa likijengwa.

english: The entrance to the bottom floor was on the south side of the temple. A stairway led up to the middle level, and from there to the third floor.
ekegusii: Egesoero kegosoera ebinyomba bia inse nigo kiareenge ensemo ya Irianyi ye Hekalu na goetera ase ebiriinero abanto nigo baarenge koriina gochia ase rirongo ria kabere, na korwa aroro bariina gochia ase rirongo ria gatato.
swahili: Ingilio la ghorofa ya chini kabisa lilikuwa upande wa kusini wa Hekalu, ngazi ilielekea ghorofa ya kati na kutokea hapo ilielekea hadi ghorofa ya tatu.

english: So Solomon built the temple and finished it, roofing it with beams and planks of cedar.
ekegusii: Naboigo Sulemani akaagacha Hekalu, akayekoora. Akaroisia risang’ina ri’enyomba ne chibao chi’emecharake.
swahili: Basi Solomoni akajenga Hekalu na kulikamilisha, akiliweka paa za boriti na mbao za mierezi.

english: Solomon, however, took thirteen years to complete the construction of his entire palace.
ekegusii: Sulemani akaira emiaka ikomi na etato ase okoagacha enyomba yaye omonyene na koyekoora.
swahili: Ilimchukua Solomoni miaka kumi na mitatu kukamilisha ujenzi wa Jumba lake la kifalme.

english: The foundations were laid with large, costly stones, some ten cubits long and some eight cubits long.
ekegusii: Amagena ’oboroso nigo areenge aye rigori rinene, amagena amanene na amarito, ayande ay’obotambe bw’amaboko ikomi, na ayande ay’amaboko atano na atato.
swahili: Misingi iliwekwa kwa mawe makubwa yaliyo bora, yenye urefu wa dhiraa kumi na mengine yenye urefu wa dhiraa nane

english: Above these were high-grade stones, cut to size, and cedar beams.
ekegusii: Igoro y’oboroso nareengeo amagena ande e rigori rinene, abaachetwe koreng’ana nekerengo, amo nemeriibo y’emecharake.
swahili: Sehemu za juu kulikuwepo na mawe yenye ubora wa hali ya juu, yaliyokatwa kwa vipimo na boriti za mierezi.

english: The great courtyard was surrounded by three rows of dressed stone and a row of trimmed cedar beams, as were the inner courtyard and portico of the house of the LORD. The Pillars and Capitals (2 Chronicles 3:14–17)
ekegusii: Orwaki rw’eraaro enene igo rwaagachetwe namagena abaachire, abekire chindwaro isato gochia igoro, ne chibao chi’emecharake orwaro oromo. Naboigo norwaki rw’eraaro ya ime y’enyomba y’Omonene amo nenyomba yareenge bosio bw’aroro. Emeremo ya Hiramu
swahili: Ule ua mkuu ulizungukwa na ukuta wa safu tatu za mawe yaliyochongwa na safu moja ya boriti za mierezi zilizorembwa, kama ulivyokuwa ua wa ndani wa Hekalu la Bwana na baraza yake. Samani Za Hekalu (2 Nyakati 4)

english: Now King Solomon sent to bring Huram from Tyre.
ekegusii: Omorwoti Sulemani akarangeria Hiramu achiche korwa Turo.
swahili: Mfalme Solomoni akatuma watu Tiro kumleta Hiramu,

english: He was the son of a widow from the tribe of Naphtali, and his father was a man of Tyre, a craftsman in bronze. Huram had great skill, understanding, and knowledge for every kind of bronze work. So he came to King Solomon and carried out all his work.
ekegusii: Hiramu nigo areenge omwana bw’omokuungu omoboraka bw’egesaku kia Nafutali, na ise nigo areenge omonto o Turo, omoturi bwe chitaai. Hiramu omonyene nigo areenge nobong’aini obonge amo ne chisemi, omanyete gotura ebinto binde bionsi bie chitaai. Ere agacha ase Sulemani, akamokorera emeremo yaye yonsi. Chisiiro ibere chi’etai (2 Amg 3:15-17)
swahili: ambaye mama yake alikuwa mjane kutoka kabila la Naftali na baba yake alikuwa mtu wa Tiro tena fundi wa shaba. Hiramu alikuwa na ustadi wa hali ya juu na mzoefu katika aina zote za kazi ya shaba. Alikuja kwa Mfalme Solomoni na kufanya kazi zake zote alizopangiwa.

english: He cast two pillars of bronze, each eighteen cubits high and twelve cubits in circumference.
ekegusii: Hiramu akaroisia chisiiro ibere chi’etai; obotambe bwa kera esiiro eyemo nigo bwareenge obw’amaboko ikomi na atato, na engori y’obotambe bw’amaboko ikomi na abere egaetanana kera esiiro.
swahili: Hiramu akasubu nguzo mbili za shaba, kila moja ikiwa na urefu wa dhiraa kumi na nane, kila nguzo ikiwa na mzingo wa dhiraa kumi na mbili kwa mstari.

english: He also made two capitals of cast bronze to set on top of the pillars, each capital five cubits high.
ekegusii: Naende akaroisia ebisure bibere bi’etai enyititoire na kobombwa, akabibeeka igoro ye chisiiro; obotambe gochia igoro bwa kera egesure nigo bwareenge obw’amaboko atano.
swahili: Pia alitengeneza mataji mawili ya shaba ya kusubu ili kuyaweka juu ya hizo nguzo; kila taji lilikuwa na kimo cha dhiraa tano kwenda juu.

english: For the capitals on top of the pillars he made a network of lattice, with wreaths of chainwork, seven for each capital.
ekegusii: Kera egesure igoro ye chisiiro nigo giachabeire nebichanga bitano na bibere biasisire goetanana.
swahili: Wavu wa mikufu iliyosokotewa kwenye zile taji juu ya zile nguzo, saba kwa kila taji.

english: Likewise, he made the pillars with two rows of pomegranates around each grating to cover each capital atop the pillars.
ekegusii: Akarosia emegwekano y’amakomomanga, akayebeeka ase chindwaro ibere igoro y’ebichanga biareenge ase ebisure biria.
swahili: Akatengeneza makomamanga katika safu mbili kuzunguka kila wavu kuremba mataji yaliyo juu ya nguzo. Alifanya hivyo kwa kila nguzo.

english: And the capitals atop the pillars in the portico were shaped like lilies, four cubits high.
ekegusii: Ebisure igoro ye chisiiro chiareenge ime y’enyomba ya bosio, nigo biabombire bigwekaine ebisicha; obotambe bwabo nobw’amaboko ane.
swahili: Mataji yaliyokuwa juu ya nguzo kwenye baraza, yalikuwa katika umbo la yungiyungi, kimo chake ni dhiraa nne

english: He built the House of the Forest of Lebanon a hundred cubits long, fifty cubits wide, and thirty cubits high, with four rows of cedar pillars supporting the cedar beams.
ekegusii: Akaagacha enyomba ekorokwa Enyomba ye Rinani ria Lebanoni. Obotambe bwaye nigo bwareenge obw’amaboko rigana erimo, na obogare bwaye amaboko emerongo etano, na obotambe bwaye gochia igoro amaboko emerongo etato. Ero nigo yaagachetwe amo ne chisiiro chi’emecharake chindwaro inye. Igoro ase chisiiro echio emiamba y’emecharake yabaachetwe ekabekwa.
swahili: Alijenga Jumba la Kifalme la Msitu wa Lebanoni, urefu wake ulikuwa dhiraa 100, upana wake dhiraa hamsini na kimo chake dhiraa thelathini, likiwa na safu nne za nguzo za mierezi zikishikilia boriti za mierezi zilizorembwa.

english: On the capitals of both pillars, just above the rounded projection next to the network, were the two hundred pomegranates in rows encircling each capital.
ekegusii: Ebisure ebio nigo biareenge igoro ase chisiiro chiria ibere na igoro ye chinsemo chiatambeete gochia isiko. Emegwekano y’amakomomanga amagana abere yareenge ase chindwaro ibere ase kera egesure.
swahili: Juu ya mataji ya zile nguzo mbili, juu ya ile sehemu yenye umbo kama bakuli, karibu na ule wavu, kulikuwa na yale makomamanga 200 katika safu kuzunguka pande zote.

english: Thus he set up the pillars at the portico of the temple. The pillar to the south he named Jachin, and the pillar to the north he named Boaz.
ekegusii: Hiramu akabeeka chisiiro chiria ase enyomba bosio bwe Hekalu; esiiro yabegetwe ensemo ya Irianyi akayeroka Yakini, na eyabegetwe ensemo ya sugusu akayeroka Boazi.
swahili: Hiramu akasimamisha nguzo kwenye baraza ya Hekalu. Nguzo ya upande wa kusini akaiita Yakini, na ile ya upande wa kaskazini Boazi.

english: And the tops of the pillars were shaped like lilies. So the work of the pillars was completed. The Molten Sea (2 Chronicles 4:1–5)
ekegusii: Ebisure nigo biabombire buna ebisicha nigo biareenge igoro ase chisiiro. Na igo emeremo ye chisiiro ekaera. Egetuba ekenene keroisirie korwa ase etai (1 Amg 4:2-5)
swahili: Mataji yaliyokuwa juu yalikuwa na umbo la yungiyungi. Hivyo kazi ya nguzo ikakamilika.

english: He also made the Sea of cast metal. It was circular in shape, measuring ten cubits from rim to rim, five cubits in height, and thirty cubits in circumference.
ekegusii: Hiramu akaroisia egetuba ekenene korwa ase etai enyititoire na kobombwa, ekaba egesingo. Ekerengo korwa ensemo eyemo goika eyende nigo kiareenge eki’amaboko ikomi. Obotambe gochia igoro nigo bwareenge bw’ekerengo ki’amaboko atano. Engori y’obotambe bw’amaboko emerongo etato ekanyara goetanana egetuba ekio.
swahili: Hiramu akasubu Bahari ya chuma, yenye umbo la mviringo, ya dhiraa kumi kutoka ukingo hadi ukingo na kimo cha dhiraa tano. Mzunguko wake ulikuwa dhiraa thelathini.

english: Below the rim, ornamental buds encircled it, ten per cubit all the way around the Sea, cast in two rows as a part of the Sea.
ekegusii: Ang’e nomogo emegwekano y’amasosa iyareengeo, ikomi ase kera ekerengo gi’okoboko okomo, yarandete ekeringero ekegima. Emegwekano eyio nigo yarenge chindwaro ibere, yabombire ase egento ekemo negetuba keria.
swahili: Chini ya ukingo, ilizungukwa na maboga, kumi kwenye kila dhiraa moja. Maboga yalikuwa yamesubiwa katika safu mbili ili kuwa kitu kimoja na hiyo bahari.

english: The Sea stood on twelve oxen, three facing north, three facing west, three facing south, and three facing east. The Sea rested on them, with all their hindquarters toward the center.
ekegusii: Egetuba keria giaterekereretwe igoro y’emegwekano ye chiombe ikomi na ibere. Chiombe isato chikarigereria gochia sugusu, na isato gochia bosongo, na isato gochia Irianyi, na isato gochia moocha; chinsemo chiabo chia magega chikarigereria gochia gati‐gati inse y’egetuba keria.
swahili: Bahari iliwekwa juu ya mafahali kumi na wawili, watatu wakielekea kaskazini, watatu wakielekea magharibi, watatu wakielekea kusini na watatu wakielekea mashariki. Bahari iliwekwa juu yao na sehemu zao za nyuma zilielekeana.

english: It was a handbreadth thick, and its rim was fashioned like the brim of a cup, like a lily blossom. It could hold two thousand baths. The Ten Bronze Stands
ekegusii: Obonetu bw’etai yaroiseretigwe egetubwa keria, nigo bwarenge obw’obogare bw’egesanyi gi’okoboko, na omogo okaroisigwa buna oyo bw’egekombe, gose obw’egesicha. Egetuba keria nigo kiarenge kobekwa amaache aisaine ang’e chilita chilifu emerongo etano (50,000). Ebibekerero bi’ebituba bikoroisigwa korwa ase etai
swahili: Ilikuwa na unene wa nyanda nne na ukingo wake ulifanana na ukingo wa kikombe, kama ua la yungiyungi iliyochanua. Iliweza kuchukua bathi 2,000.

english: In addition, he made ten movable stands of bronze, each four cubits long, four cubits wide, and three cubits high.
ekegusii: Naende Hiramu akaroisia ebibekerero ikomi bi’ebituba korwa ase chitaai. Obotambe bwa kera ekebekerero nigo bwarenge obw’amaboko ane, na obogare bwaye amaboko ane, na obotambe bwaye gochia igoro amaboko atato.
swahili: Pia akatengeneza vitako kumi vya shaba vinavyoweza kuhamishika, kila kimoja kilikuwa na urefu wa dhiraa nne, upana dhiraa nne na kimo chake dhiraa tatu

english: This was the design of the stands: They had side panels attached to uprights,
ekegusii: Ebibekerero biria nigo biakoretwe iga: Chinsingo nchiarenge ase chinsemo chiabo ase egati ye chinsingo chie chikoona.
swahili: Hivi ndivyo vile vitako vilivyotengenezwa: Vilikuwa na mbao za pembeni zilizoshikamanishwa na mihimili.

english: and on the panels between the uprights were lions, oxen, and cherubim. On the uprights was a pedestal above, and below the lions and oxen were wreaths of beveled work.
ekegusii: Ase chinsingo echio yarengeo emegwekano ye chindo, na eye chieri, na ey’ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba; naboigo nase chinsingo chie chikoona igoro. Igoro na inse y’emegwekano eyio nigo yarenge emegwekano y’ebisicha biaroisirie chingata.
swahili: Juu ya mbao kati ya hiyo mihimili kulikuwa na simba, mafahali na makerubi, pia kwenye mihimili yake. Juu na chini ya simba na mafahali kulikuwa kumesokotewa taji za kufuliwa.

english: The house was roofed with cedar above the beams that rested on the pillars—forty-five beams, fifteen per row.
ekegusii: Enyomba nigo yareenge nekerama ki’emecharake igoro y’emiamba yabegetwe ase chisiiro chiria emerongo ene na isano, ikomi na isano ase kera orwaro.
swahili: Ilipauliwa kwa mierezi juu ya boriti zile zilizolala juu ya nguzo arobaini na tano, kumi na tano kwa kila safu.

english: Each stand had four bronze wheels with bronze axles and a basin resting on four supports, with wreaths at each side.
ekegusii: Kera ekebekerero nigo kiarenge namagoro ane aroisetigwe korwa ase etai. Ase chikoona chi’ekebekerero ebisiirero mbiarengeo. Ebisiirero ebio nigo biabombire nemegwekano y’ebisicha biaroisetigwe chingata ase kera ekemo.
swahili: Kila kitako kilikuwa na magurudumu manne ya shaba, na vyuma vya katikati vya kuyazungusha hayo magurudumu na kila kimoja kilikuwa na sinia kwenye vishikizo vinne vya taji iliyosubiwa kila upande.

english: The opening to each stand inside the crown at the top was one cubit deep, with a round opening like the design of a pedestal, a cubit and a half wide. And around its opening were engravings, but the panels of the stands were square, not round.
ekegusii: Omonwa bw’ekebekerero nigo orenge igoro ime y’orosingo rw’obotambe gochia igoro okoboko okomo. Omonwa oyio orenge egesingo otambeete gochia inse, obotambe bw’okoboko okomo na ekeng’ese, nao ebiechabero biarenge. Emetobwa yaye nigo yarenge ne chikoona, tiyarenge egesingo.
swahili: Ndani ya kitako kulikuwa na nafasi ya wazi iliyokuwa na umbile la mviringo lenye kina cha dhiraa moja. Nafasi hii ya wazi ilikuwa ya mviringo, pamoja na kitako chake ilikuwa dhiraa moja na nusu. Kuzunguka huo mdomo wake kulitiwa nakshi. Papi za vitako zilikuwa mraba na si za mviringo.

english: There were four wheels under the panels, and the axles of the wheels were attached to the stand; each wheel was a cubit and a half in diameter.
ekegusii: Amagoro aye ane nigo abegetwe inse ye chinsingo chiaye, ne rinyongo riaye nigo ribwateranirie nekebekerero. Obotambe bwa kera okogoro nigo bwarenge obw’okoboko okomo na ekeng’ese.
swahili: Magurudumu manne yalikuwa chini ya papi, na vyuma vya katikati vya kuzungushia magurudumu hayo vilikuwa vimeunganishwa kwenye kitako. Kipenyo cha kila gurudumu kilikuwa dhiraa moja na nusu.

english: The wheels were made like chariot wheels; their axles, rims, spokes, and hubs were all of cast metal.
ekegusii: Amagoro ayio nigo aroisetigwe buna aye chigari. Amagoro amagima nigo aroisetigwe korwa ase etai yanyititoire na kobombwa. Boigo amanyongo, ne chingata, na ebitingiro biaroisetigwe.
swahili: Magurudumu yalitengenezwa kama ya magari ya vita ya kukokotwa, vyuma vya katikati vya magurudumu, duara zake, matindi yake na vikombe vyake vyote vilikuwa vya kusubu.

english: Each stand had four handles, one for each corner, projecting from the stand.
ekegusii: Ebisiirero bine mbiarenge ase kera ekebekerero ase chikoona chiaye; biaroisetigwe bikaba egento ekemo nekebekerero.
swahili: Kila kitako kilikuwa na mikono minne, moja kwenye kila pembe, ukitokeza kutoka kwenye kitako.

english: At the top of each stand was a circular band half a cubit high. The supports and panels were cast as a unit with the top of the stand.
ekegusii: Igoro kegima ase kera ekebekerero nigo kiarenge orosingo rw’obogare bw’ekeng’ese gi’okoboko okomo; na igoro ase orosingo orwo nigo biarenge ebisiirero amo ne chinsingo chie chinsemo. Bionsi nigo biaroisetigwe bikaba egento ekemo nebisiirero.
swahili: Juu ya kitako kulikuwepo na utepe wa mviringo wenye kina cha nusu dhiraa. Vishikio na papi vilishikamana upande wa juu wa kitako.

english: He engraved cherubim, lions, and palm trees on the surfaces of the supports and panels, wherever each had space, with wreaths all around.
ekegusii: Ase ebisiirero na ase chinsingo emegwekano y’ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba, na eye chindo, na ey’emekendo, amo ney’ebisicha, ekamang’wa, buna ribaga riarenge ase kera ensemo.
swahili: Alitia nakshi za makerubi, simba na miti ya mitende juu ya uso wa vishikio na juu ya papi, katika kila nafasi iliyopatikana, pamoja na mataji yaliyosokotwa kuzunguka pande zote.

english: In this way he made the ten stands, each with the same casting, dimensions, and shape. The Ten Bronze Basins (2 Chronicles 4:6–8)
ekegusii: Naboigo akaroisia ebibekerero bionsi ikomi. Bionsi nigo biaroisetigwe korwa ase etai enyititoire na kobombwa; nigo biareng’aine na nigo biagwekaine.
swahili: Hivi ndivyo Hiramu alivyotengeneza vile vitako kumi. Vyote vilikuwa vya kusubu kwenye kalibu za kufanana kwa vipimo na kwa umbo.

english: He also made ten bronze basins, each holding forty baths and measuring four cubits across, one basin for each of the ten stands.
ekegusii: Hiramu akaroisia na ebituba ikomi bie chitaai. Obogare bwa kera egetuba nigo bwarenge obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko ane, na nigo kiare koira amaache aisaine ang’e ne chilita amagana kianda. Naboigo aroisetie ebituba ikomi, ekemo ase kera ekebekerero.
swahili: Kisha akatengeneza masinia kumi ya shaba, kila moja likiwa na ujazo wa bathi arobaini, yakiwa na kipenyo cha dhiraa nne kila sinia moja kwa kila kimoja ya vile vitako kumi.

english: He set five stands on the south side of the temple and five on the north, and he put the Sea on the south side, at the southeast corner of the temple. Completion of the Bronze Works (2 Chronicles 4:11–18)
ekegusii: Akabeeka ebibekerero bitano ensemo ya Irianyi ye Hekalu, na bitano ensemo ya sugusu, na egetuba keria ekenene agakebeeka ensemo ya Irianyi ya moocha. Ebikorero bie Hekalu (2 Amg 4:11—5:1)
swahili: Aliweka vitako vitano upande wa kusini wa Hekalu na vingine vitano upande wa kaskazini. Akaweka ile bahari upande wa kusini, katika pembe ya kusini ya Hekalu.

english: There were three rows of high windows facing one another in three tiers.
ekegusii: Enyomba eyio nigo yareenge nebibao bire ase chindwaro isato, kera ekebao kerigereretie ekende.
swahili: Madirisha yake yaliwekwa juu kwa safu tatu, yakielekeana.

english: Additionally, Huram made the pots, shovels, and sprinkling bowls. So Huram finished all the work that he had undertaken for King Solomon in the house of the LORD:
ekegusii: Hiramu akaroisia ebituba, na ebichiko, na ebitaabo. Naboigo agakoora emeremo yonsi eyaetwe na Sulemani ng’a akore ase enyomba y’Omonene.
swahili: Pia akatengeneza masinia, masepetu na mabakuli ya kunyunyizia. Kwa hiyo Huramu akakamilisha kazi zote katika Hekalu la Bwana kama vile Mfalme Solomoni alikuwa amemwagiza, yaani:

english: the two pillars; the two bowl-shaped capitals atop the pillars; the two sets of network covering both bowls of the capitals atop the pillars;
ekegusii: Akaroisia chisiiro ibere, na ebisure bibere biabegetwe igoro ye chisiiro, na ebichanga bisisire biaetanaine, bigatuba chinsemo chi’ebisure echiatambeete gochia isiko,
swahili: nguzo mbili; mataji mawili yenye umbo la bakuli juu ya hizo nguzo; nyavu mbili za kupamba hayo mataji mawili yenye umbo la bakuli juu ya hizo nguzo;

english: the four hundred pomegranates for the two sets of network (two rows of pomegranates for each network covering both the bowl-shaped capitals atop the pillars);
ekegusii: na emegwekano y’amakomomanga amagana ane eyabegetwe igoro y’ebichanga ebio, chindwaro ibere ase kera egesure kiarenge igoro ye chisiiro, erinde ensemo y’ebisure biria yatambeete etubwe.
swahili: makomamanga 400 kwa ajili ya hizo nyavu mbili (safu mbili za makomamanga kwa kila wavu, yakipamba hayo mataji mawili yenye umbo la bakuli juu ya hizo nguzo);

english: the ten stands; the ten basins on the stands;
ekegusii: Naende akaroisia ebibekerero bi’ebituba amo nebituba ikomi biaterekereireo,
swahili: vitako kumi pamoja na masinia yake kumi;

english: the Sea; the twelve oxen underneath the Sea;
ekegusii: na egetuba ekenene ekemo amo nemegwekano ye chiombe ikomi na ibere ekabekwa inse y’egetuba keria,
swahili: ile Bahari ya chuma na yale mafahali kumi na wawili chini yake;

english: and the pots, shovels, and sprinkling bowls. All the articles that Huram made for King Solomon in the house of the LORD were made of burnished bronze.
ekegusii: ne chindogio, na ebichiko, na ebitaabo. Ebinto ebio bionsi biaatoire nigo biare ebibekerero bi’enyomba y’Omonene, Hiramu aroiseretie omorwoti Sulemani. Bionsi nigo biaroisetigwe korwa ase chitaai chisibirie buya.
swahili: masufuria, masepetu na mabakuli ya kunyunyizia. Vyombo hivi vyote ambavyo Huramu alimtengenezea Mfalme Solomoni kwa ajili ya Hekalu la Bwana vilikuwa vya shaba iliyongʼarishwa.

english: The king had them cast in clay molds in the plain of the Jordan between Succoth and Zarethan.
ekegusii: Ebinto ebio omorwoti akabibomba korwa ase etai enyititoire, ime ase esike ebombire agwo egati ya Sukoti na Saretani ase Riranya ria Yorodani.
swahili: Mfalme akaamuru wavisubu katika kalibu ya udongo wa mfinyanzi katika uwanda wa Yordani ulio kati ya Sukothi na Sarethani.

english: Solomon left all these articles unweighed, because there were so many. The weight of the bronze could not be determined. Completion of the Gold Furnishings (2 Chronicles 4:19–22)
ekegusii: Sulemani agatiga korenga ebinto ebi bionsi, ekiagera biarenge ebinge mono. Oborito bw’etai eria tibwamanyekanete buna bwang’ana.
swahili: Solomoni akaviacha vitu hivi vyote bila kupima uzani wake, kwa sababu vilikuwa vingi sana hivi kwamba uzito wa shaba haungekadirika.

english: Solomon also made all the furnishings for the house of the LORD: the golden altar; the golden table on which was placed the Bread of the Presence;
ekegusii: Boigo Sulemani akaroisia ebinto binde bionsi biare kobekwa ase enyomba y’Omonene; egesasiimero gi’etaabu, na emesa y’etaabu ase emegati yare koruegwa ase Nyasae yare kobekwa.
swahili: Solomoni pia akatengeneza samani zote zilizokuwa ndani ya Hekalu la Bwana: madhabahu ya dhahabu; meza ya dhahabu za kuweka mikate ya Wonyesho;

english: the lampstands of pure gold in front of the inner sanctuary, five on the right side and five on the left; the gold flowers, lamps, and tongs;
ekegusii: Ebibekerero bie chitaaya bitano biare kobekwa ensemo ya Irianyi, na bitano ensemo ya sugusu, bosio bw’Aase Aachenu Mono; na emegwekano y’ebisicha, ne chitaaya, amo nebiinachi biakorire korwa ase chitaabu.
swahili: vinara vya taa vya dhahabu safi (vitano upande wa kuume na vitano upande wa kushoto, mbele ya Patakatifu pa Patakatifu); kazi ya maua ya dhahabu na taa na makoleo;

english: All the doorways had rectangular frames, with the openings facing one another in three tiers.
ekegusii: Ebisoero bionsi na ebibao nigo biareenge ne chikoona inye, na ebibao nigo biarigereranetie bire ase chindwaro isato.
swahili: Milango yote ilikuwa na miimo ya mstatili, ilikuwa upande wa mbele katika safu tatu, ikielekeana.

english: the pure gold basins, wick trimmers, sprinkling bowls, ladles, and censers; and the gold hinges for the doors of the inner temple (that is, the Most Holy Place ) as well as for the doors of the main hall of the temple.
ekegusii: Naende akaroisia chisani ne chigami, na ebitaabo bi’ogosambera ubani, ne chindogio chi’okorenta omorero, ne chimbata chi’ebisieri bi’akanyomba ka ime, Aase Aachenu Mono, na echi’ebisieri bie Hekalu enyene. Ebinto ebio bionsi nigo biaroisetigwe korwa ase chitaabu chichenire.
swahili: masinia ya dhahabu safi, mikasi ya kusawazishia tambi, mabakuli ya kunyunyizia, vyano na vyetezo; na bawaba za dhahabu kwa ajili ya milango ya chumba cha ndani sana, yaani Patakatifu pa Patakatifu, na pia kwa ajili ya milango ya ukumbi mkuu wa Hekalu.

english: So all the work that King Solomon had performed for the house of the LORD was completed. Then Solomon brought in the items his father David had dedicated—the silver, the gold, and the furnishings—and he placed them in the treasuries of the house of the LORD.
ekegusii: Naboigo emeremo eye yonsi omorwoti Sulemani akorete ase enyomba y’Omonene ekaera. Na Sulemani agasoyia aroro ebinto ebi Daudi ise aatananete koba ebichenu: chifeta, ne chitaabu, na ebikorero; akabigacha ase chikungo chi’enyomba y’Omonene.
swahili: Hivyo Mfalme Solomoni alipomaliza kazi ya Hekalu la Bwana, akaviingiza ndani vile vitu ambavyo Daudi baba yake alikuwa ameviweka wakfu: yaani fedha, dhahabu na samani; kisha akaviweka katika hazina za Hekalu la Bwana.

english: Solomon made his colonnade fifty cubits long and thirty cubits wide, with a portico in front of it and a canopy with pillars in front of the portico.
ekegusii: Boigo akaagacha eero ye chisiiro. Obotambe bwaye nobw’amaboko emerongo etano, na obogare bwaye amaboko emerongo etato. Bosio bw’enyomba eyio akaagacha egesona, na bosio aroro chisiiro chire nekerama.
swahili: Akajenga ukumbi wa nguzo, ambao urefu wake ulikuwa dhiraa hamsini na upana wake dhiraa thelathini. Mbele ya jengo hilo kulikuwepo baraza. Mbele ya baraza kulikuwepo na nguzo na paa lililoningʼinia.

english: In addition, he built a hall for the throne, the Hall of Justice, where he was to judge. It was paneled with cedar from floor to ceiling.
ekegusii: Naende akaagacha Enyomba y’ekerogo ki’Oborwoti, eye ekarokwa naende Enyomba y’ekegambero aase areenge kogaambera ebiina. Eye nigo yatubetwe ne chibao chi’emecharake korwa inse goika igoro.
swahili: Akajenga ukumbi wa kiti cha enzi, Ukumbi wa Hukumu, mahali ambapo angelitolea hukumu, akaufunika kwa mierezi kutoka sakafuni hadi darini.

english: And the palace where Solomon would live, set further back, was of similar construction. He also made a palace like this hall for Pharaoh’s daughter, whom he had married.
ekegusii: Naboigo enyomba yaye y’okomenya yaagachetwe magega y’enyomba eria y’ebiina, egwekaine neyio. Naende Sulemani akaagachera mokaye, mosubati o Farao, enyomba egwekaine eria yaye.
swahili: Kwenye jumba la kifalme ambamo angeliishi, aliiweka nyuma zaidi, ikiwa na mjengo wa aina moja na hiyo nyingine. Pia Solomoni akajenga jumba la kifalme linalofanana na huo ukumbi mkubwa kwa ajili ya binti Farao, aliyekuwa amemwoa.

english: All these buildings were constructed with costly stones, cut to size and trimmed with saws inside and out from the foundation to the eaves, and from the outside to the great courtyard.
ekegusii: Echio chionsi nigo chiagachetwe namagena amaya ye rigori rinene, abaachetwe koreng’ana nekerengo, akanachwa nemesumeno chinsemo chionsi korwa oboroso goika rigasio ri’enyasi. Amagena onsi nigo aroisetigwe bo, nonya naya e risiko amo nay’orwaki rw’eraaro y’enyomba y’Omonene.
swahili: Ujenzi huu wote, kuanzia nje mpaka kwenye ua mkuu na kuanzia kwenye msingi hadi upenuni, ulifanywa kwa mawe ya ubora wa hali ya juu yaliyokuwa yamechongwa kwa vipimo na kusawazishwa kwa msumeno nyuso zake za ndani na za nje.

english: At that time Solomon assembled before him in Jerusalem the elders of Israel—all the tribal heads and family leaders of the Israelites—to bring up the ark of the covenant of the LORD from Zion, the City of David.
ekegusii: Sulemani agasangereria amo abagaaka b’Abaisraeli, na abatang’ani bonsi b’ebisaku biabo, na baria barenge abaraai be chiamate chi’Abaisraeli, bache ase obosio bwaye agwo Yerusalemu, erinde bagende Sayoni, Omochie o Daudi, kwoyia Esanduki ere ne chibao chiriikire okobwatana kw’Omonene.
swahili: Kisha Mfalme Solomoni akawaita mbele zake huko Yerusalemu wazee wa Israeli, viongozi wote wa makabila na wakuu wa jamaa za Waisraeli, ili walilete Sanduku la Agano la Bwana kutoka Sayuni, Mji wa Daudi.

english: And when the priests came out of the Holy Place, the cloud filled the house of the LORD
ekegusii: Ekero abakuani baarenge gosoka korwa ase Aase Aachenu, riire rigaichora enyomba y’Omonene,
swahili: Makuhani walipoondoka katika Mahali Patakatifu, wingu likajaza Hekalu la Bwana.

english: so that the priests could not stand there to minister because of the cloud; for the glory of the LORD filled the house of the LORD. Solomon Blesses the LORD (2 Chronicles 6:1–11)
ekegusii: na igo abakuani tibaarenge konyara kogenderera nobokoreri bwabo ase engencho ye riire riria, ekiagera obonene bw’Omonene bwaichorete ase enyomba y’Omonene.
swahili: Nao makuhani hawakuweza kufanya huduma yao kwa sababu ya lile wingu, kwa kuwa utukufu wa Bwana ulijaza Hekalu lake.

english: Then Solomon declared: “The LORD has said that He would dwell in the thick cloud.
ekegusii: Erio Sulemani akabora, “Omonene obekire erioba igoro, korende oteebire ng’a narigetie komenya ase omosunte ekerima.
swahili: Ndipo Solomoni akasema, “ Bwana alisema kwamba ataishi katika giza nene;

english: I have indeed built You an exalted house, a place for You to dwell forever.”
ekegusii: Bono nakoagacheire enyomba ebe obomenyo bwao, aase oramenye kogenderera botambe.” Sulemani ogokwana ase abanto (2 Amg 6:3-11)
swahili: naam, hakika nimekujengea Hekalu zuri sana, mahali pako pa kuishi milele.” Hotuba Ya Solomoni (2 Nyakati 6:3-11)

english: And as the whole assembly of Israel stood there, the king turned around and blessed them all
ekegusii: Erio omorwoti akeonchora akarigereria abanto, agasesenia omosangererekano bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli ekero oteneine,
swahili: Kusanyiko lote la Israeli lilipokuwa limesimama hapo, mfalme akageuka na kuwabariki.

english: and said: “Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, who has fulfilled with His own hand what He spoke with His mouth to my father David, saying,
ekegusii: agateeba, “Atogigwe Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, ere oyoikeranirie nokoboko kwaye aya arierete Daudi tata eira nomonwa oye, ogoteeba:
swahili: Kisha akasema: “Ahimidiwe Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli, ambaye kwa mkono wake mwenyewe ametimiza lile alilomwahidi Daudi baba yangu kwa kinywa chake mwenyewe. Kwa kuwa alisema,

english: ‘Since the day I brought My people Israel out of Egypt, I have not chosen a city from any tribe of Israel in which to build a house so that My Name would be there. But I have chosen David to be over My people Israel.’
ekegusii: Korwa rituko riria nang’anyetie abanto baane Abaisraeli korwa Misiri, tinachorete omochie onde bwonsi ase egati y’ebisaku bionsi bi’Abaisraeli agwo ase nare koagacha enyomba, erinde erieta riane ribe aroro, korende nachorete Daudi agambere abanto baane Abaisraeli.”
swahili: ‘Tangu siku niliyowatoa watu wangu Israeli kutoka Misri, sikuchagua mji katika kabila lolote la Israeli ili Hekalu lijengwe humo ili Jina langu lipate kuwamo humo, bali nimemchagua Daudi kuwatawala watu wangu Israeli.’

english: Now it was in the heart of my father David to build a house for the Name of the LORD, the God of Israel.
ekegusii: Naende Sulemani agateeba, “Igo kwarenge okogania gwa Daudi tata koagachera erieta ri’Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, enyomba.
swahili: “Ilikuwa moyoni mwa Daudi baba yangu kujenga Hekalu kwa ajili ya Jina la Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli.

english: But the LORD said to my father David, ‘Since it was in your heart to build a house for My Name, you have done well to have this in your heart.
ekegusii: Korende Omonene akamoteebia: Buna kwarengereretie koagachera erieta riane enyomba, nigo gwakorete buya, okabeeka amang’ana ayio ime ase enkoro yao.
swahili: Lakini Bwana akamwambia Daudi baba yangu, ‘Kwa sababu ilikuwa moyoni mwako kujenga Hekalu kwa ajili ya Jina langu, ulifanya vyema kuwa na jambo hili moyoni mwako.

english: Nevertheless, you are not the one to build it; but your son, your own offspring, will build the house for My Name.’
ekegusii: Korende nonya naboigo, aye tokonyara koagacha enyomba eyio, otatiga omwana oo omomura oria oraiborwe korwa ase enda yao, nere oraagachere erieta riane enyomba.
swahili: Hata hivyo, sio wewe utakayenijengea hekalu, bali mwanao, ambaye ni nyama yako na damu yako mwenyewe, yeye ndiye atakayejenga Hekalu kwa ajili ya Jina langu.’

english: And all the men of Israel came together to King Solomon at the feast in the seventh month, the month of Ethanim.
ekegusii: Igo Abaisraeli bonsi bagacha ase omorwoti Sulemani ase Amatuko Amanene ase omotienyi bw’Etanimu, noro omotienyi o gatano na kabere.
swahili: Wanaume wote wa Israeli wakakusanyika kwa Mfalme Solomoni wakati wa sikukuu ya mwezi wa Ethanimu, ndio mwezi wa saba.

english: Now the LORD has fulfilled the word that He spoke. I have succeeded my father David, and I sit on the throne of Israel, as the LORD promised. I have built the house for the Name of the LORD, the God of Israel.
ekegusii: “Bono Omonene oikeranirie eira eria ariete, ekiagera inche natenenire ribaga ria Daudi tata, na ngoikaransa ase ekerogo ki’oborwoti bw’Abaisraeli, buna Omonene ariete eira, naende naagacheire erieta ri’Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, enyomba.
swahili: “ Bwana ametimiza ahadi aliyoiweka: Nimeingia mahali pa Daudi baba yangu na sasa ninakikalia kiti cha ufalme cha Israeli, kama vile Bwana alivyoahidi, nami nimejenga Hekalu kwa ajili ya Jina la Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli.

english: And there I have provided a place for the ark, which contains the covenant of the LORD that He made with our fathers when He brought them out of the land of Egypt.” Solomon’s Prayer of Dedication (2 Chronicles 6:12–42)
ekegusii: Naende aroro agwo naroisirie aase Esanduki ere ne chibao chiriikire okobwatana kw’Omonene ekobeera. Okobwatana kori’Omonene akorete ne chisokoro chiaito, ekero aching’anyetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri.” Ogosaba gwa Sulemani (2 Amg 6:12-42)
swahili: Nimetenga nafasi humo kwa ajili ya Sanduku la Agano, ambamo ndani yake kuna lile Agano la Bwana alilofanya na baba zetu wakati alipowatoa Misri.” Maombi Ya Solomoni Ya Kuweka Hekalu Wakfu (2 Nyakati 6:12-42)

english: Then Solomon stood before the altar of the LORD in front of the whole assembly of Israel, spread out his hands toward heaven,
ekegusii: Erio Sulemani agatenena bosio bw’egesasiimero ki’Omonene ase obosio bw’omosangererekano bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli, akarambora amaboko aye gochia igoro,
swahili: Kisha Solomoni akasimama mbele ya madhabahu ya Bwana machoni pa kusanyiko lote la Israeli, akakunjua mikono yake kuelekea mbinguni

english: and said: “O LORD, God of Israel, there is no God like You in heaven above or on earth below, keeping Your covenant of loving devotion with Your servants who walk before You with all their hearts.
ekegusii: agakwana, “Aye Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, Nyasae onde tari akogwekaine, igoro nonya ninse aa ase ense, aye bweka nigo okorenda okobwatana kw’ogotianania, naende nigo okoorokia obwanchani botari koera ase abasomba bao baria bare abegenwa asore ne chinkoro chiabo chionsi.
swahili: na kusema: “Ee Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli, hakuna Mungu kama wewe juu mbinguni wala chini duniani, wewe unayetunza Agano lako la upendo na watumishi wanaodumu katika njia yako kwa moyo wote.

english: You have kept Your promise to Your servant, my father David. What You spoke with Your mouth You have fulfilled with Your hand this day.
ekegusii: Aye gwaikeranirie eira eria kwarierete omosomba oo Daudi tata Aria gwakwanete nomonwa oo kwayaikeranirie nokoboko kwao rituko ria reero.
swahili: Umetimiza ahadi yako kwa mtumishi wako Daudi baba yangu, kwa kinywa chako uliahidi na kwa mkono wako umetimiza, kama ilivyo leo.

english: Therefore now, O LORD, God of Israel, keep for Your servant, my father David, what You promised when You said: ‘You will never fail to have a man to sit before Me on the throne of Israel, if only your descendants guard their way to walk before Me as you have done.’
ekegusii: Ase ayio aye Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, ikerania bono aya kwarierete omosomba oo Daudi tata eira, ogateeba; Takobora nonya ng’ake omonto korwa ase ororeeria rwao oraikaranse ase obosio bwane ase ekerogo ki’oborwoti ki’Abaisraeli, onye abana bao bagochia korenda chinchera chiabo, erinde babwatie chinchera chiane, buna aye gwachibwatetie.
swahili: “Sasa Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli, mtimizie mtumishi wako Daudi baba yangu ahadi zako ulizomwahidi uliposema, ‘Kamwe hutakosa kuwa na mtu atakayeketi mbele zangu kwenye kiti cha ufalme cha Israeli, kama wanao wakiangalia yote wayafanyayo kuenenda mbele zangu kama vile ulivyofanya.’

english: And now, O God of Israel, please confirm what You promised to Your servant, my father David.
ekegusii: Ase ayio, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, tiga ring’ana riao riria gwatebeetie omosomba oo Daudi tata riikeranigwe.
swahili: Sasa, Ee Mungu wa Israeli, acha neno lako lile ulilomwahidi mtumishi wako Daudi baba yangu litimie.

english: But will God indeed dwell upon the earth? Even heaven, the highest heaven, cannot contain You, much less this temple I have built.
ekegusii: “Inee! Nekeene ng’a aye Nyasae nonyare komenya aa ase ense eye? Rora, igoro na igoro aare mono tekogoisana omenye, naki rende enyomba eye inche nakoagacheire eragoisane?
swahili: “Lakini kweli, je, Mungu atafanya makao duniani? Mbingu, hata mbingu zilizo juu sana, haziwezi kukutosha wewe. Sembuse Hekalu hili nililojenga!

english: Yet regard the prayer and plea of Your servant, O LORD my God, so that You may hear the cry and the prayer that Your servant is praying before You today.
ekegusii: Korende aye Omonene, Nyasae one, koranche oigwe ogosaba kwane inche omosomba oo, na okoboria kwane kw’oboitongo, na oigwe ekerero na ogosaba oko inche omosomba oo nkogosaba bono iga.
swahili: Hata hivyo sikiliza dua ya mtumishi wako na maombi yake kwa huruma, Ee Bwana Mungu wangu. Sikia kilio na dua ambayo mtumishi wako anaomba mbele zako siku hii ya leo.

english: May Your eyes be open toward this temple night and day, toward the place of which You said, ‘My Name shall be there,’ so that You may hear the prayer that Your servant prays toward this place.
ekegusii: Tiga amaiso ao arigererie enyomba eye obotuko na omobaso aase aiga aye gwateebete igoro yaye: Erieta riane naribeere aroro. Ase ayio oigwe ogosaba oko inche, omosomba oo, ngosaba ndigereretie aase aiga.
swahili: Macho yako na yafumbuke kuelekea Hekalu hili usiku na mchana, mahali hapa ambapo ulisema, ‘Jina langu litakuwako humo,’ ili kwamba upate kusikia maombi ambayo mtumishi wako ataomba kuelekea mahali hapa.

english: When all the elders of Israel had arrived, the priests took up the ark,
ekegusii: Ekero abagaaka bonsi b’Abaisraeli bachete, abakuani bakaimokia Esanduki y’Omonene,
swahili: Wazee wote wa Israeli walipofika, makuhani wakajitwika Sanduku la Agano,

english: Hear the plea of Your servant and of Your people Israel when they pray toward this place. May You hear from heaven, Your dwelling place. May You hear and forgive.
ekegusii: Naende aye oigwe okoboria kwane kw’oboitongo inche, omosomba oo, na okw’abaanto bao Abaisraeli ekero bagosaba barigereretie aase aiga. Ee, oigwe aye korwa igoro ase obomenyo bwao bore, na ekero okoigwa bwabere.
swahili: Usikie maombi ya mtumishi wako na ya watu wako Israeli wakati wanapoomba kuelekea mahali hapa. Sikia kutoka mbinguni, mahali pa makao yako na usikiapo, samehe.

english: When a man sins against his neighbor and is required to take an oath, and he comes to take an oath before Your altar in this temple,
ekegusii: “Omonto karakorere omonto onde bobe na aborigwe koria emuma, erio achiche arie emuma eria bosio bw’egesasiimero kiao ase enyomba eye,
swahili: “Mtu anapomkosea jirani yake na akatakiwa kuapa, akija na kuapa mbele ya madhabahu yako ndani ya Hekalu hili,

english: then may You hear from heaven and act. May You judge Your servants, condemning the wicked man by bringing down on his own head what he has done, and justifying the righteous man by rewarding him according to his righteousness.
ekegusii: aye oigwe korwa agwo igoro, okore ogokora kwao, onachere abasomba bao ekiina kia boronge. Tiga oria ore omomochi abogorie egesusuro gi’okomocha kwaye, na oria ore omooronge aegwe oboronge bwaye.
swahili: basi, sikia kutoka mbinguni na ukatende. Hukumu kati ya watumishi wako, ukimhukumu yule mwenye hatia na kuleta juu ya kichwa chake yale aliyoyatenda. Umtangazie mwenye haki kwamba hana hatia, hivyo ukathibitishe kuwa haki kwake.

english: When Your people Israel are defeated before an enemy because they have sinned against You, and they return to You and confess Your name, praying and pleading with You in this temple,
ekegusii: “Ekero abanto bao Abaisraeli barabe babuirwe nababisa babo, ekiagera bakorire ebibe asore korende bagokoiranera naende na gotogia erieta riao, na ase enyomba eye bakogosaba na gokoboria ase oboitongo,
swahili: “Wakati watu wako Israeli watakapokuwa wameshindwa na adui kwa sababu ya dhambi walizofanya dhidi yako, watakapokugeukia na kulikiri jina lako, wakiomba na kufanya dua kwako katika Hekalu hili,

english: then may You hear from heaven and forgive the sin of Your people Israel. May You restore them to the land You gave to their fathers.
ekegusii: rirorio oigwe korwa agwo igoro. Bwabere ebibe bi’abaanto bao Abaisraeli, naende obarente gocha ase ense eye kwaete chisokoro chiabo.
swahili: basi usikie kutoka mbinguni, ukasamehe dhambi ya watu wako Israeli na kuwarudisha katika nchi uliyowapa baba zao.

english: When the skies are shut and there is no rain because Your people have sinned against You, and they pray toward this place and confess Your name, and they turn from their sins because You have afflicted them,
ekegusii: “Ekero igoro erabe esiekire na embura tetwa, ekiagera bakorire ebibe asore, kobarasabe barigereretie aase aiga, naende batogie erieta riao na baonchoke batige ebibe biabo, ekero aye orabae egesusuro,
swahili: “Wakati mbingu zitakapokuwa zimefungwa kusiwe na mvua kwa sababu watu wako wametenda dhambi dhidi yako, watakapoomba kuelekea mahali hapa na kulikiri jina lako nao wakageuka kutoka dhambi zao kwa sababu umewaadhibu,

english: then may You hear from heaven and forgive the sin of Your servants, Your people Israel, so that You may teach them the good way in which they should walk. May You send rain on the land that You gave Your people as an inheritance.
ekegusii: rirorio aye oigwe korwa agwo igoro. Bwabere ebibe bi’abasomba bao Abaisraeli, okoborokereria enchera engiya bagwenerete kobwatia. Naende otwerie ense yao embura, ense eria kwaeire abanto bao ekaba omwando obo.
swahili: basi usikie kutoka mbinguni na usamehe dhambi ya watumishi wako, watu wako Israeli. Wafundishe njia sahihi ya kuishi na ukanyeshe mvua juu ya nchi uliyowapa watu wako kuwa urithi.

english: When famine or plague comes upon the land, or blight or mildew or locusts or grasshoppers, or when their enemy besieges them in their cities, whatever plague or sickness may come,
ekegusii: “Kerabe enchara erache ase ense, gose oborwaire obobe bogoita, gose oborwaire bw’enyagetabo ase chindagera, gose obw’ogochirigisia, gose chingige, gose amakonde, gose ababisa bakoboera ase omochie onde bwonsi ase emechie yabo, gose obobe bonde bwonsi, gose oborwaire bonde bwonsi,
swahili: “Wakati njaa au tauni vikija juu ya nchi, au koga au kawa, nzige au panzi, au wakati adui atakapowazingira katika mji wao wowote, maafa ya namna yoyote au ugonjwa wowote unaoweza kuwajia,

english: then may whatever prayer or petition Your people Israel make—each knowing his own afflictions and spreading out his hands toward this temple—
ekegusii: oigwe ogosaba kwabo. Omonto onde bwensi, gose abanto bao bonsi Abaisraeli kobaragosabe na gokoboria ase oboitongo, kera oyomo omanyete emechando ere ase enkoro yaye, naende barambore amaboko abo gochia ase enyomba eye,
swahili: wakati dua au maombi yatakapofanywa na mmojawapo wa watu wako Israeli, kila mmoja akitambua taabu za moyo wake mwenyewe, naye akainyoosha mikono yake kuelekea Hekalu hili:

english: be heard by You from heaven, Your dwelling place. And may You forgive and act, and repay each man according to all his ways, since You know his heart—for You alone know the hearts of all men—
ekegusii: obaigwe korwa agwo igoro ase obomenyo bwao bore. Bwabere, okore ogokora kwao, okorere kera oyomo koreng’ana nogokora kwaye, (ekiagera naye bweka omanyete chinkoro chia Mwanyabaanto bonsi,)
swahili: basi usikie kutoka mbinguni, katika makao yako. Usamehe na utende, umpe kila mtu kulingana na matendo yake, kwa kuwa unaujua moyo wake (kwa kuwa ni wewe peke yako ujuaye mioyo ya watu wote),

english: and they brought up the ark of the LORD and the Tent of Meeting with all its sacred furnishings. So the priests and Levites carried them up.
ekegusii: bakayerenta amo n’Eema y’Omosangererekano na ebikorero bionsi ebichenu biarenge ime ase Eema eria. Abakuani na Abalawi nabwo barentete ebinto ebio.
swahili: nao wakalipandisha Sanduku la Bwana, na Hema la Kukutania pamoja na vyombo vyote vitakatifu vilivyokuwa ndani yake. Makuhani na Walawi wakavibeba,

english: so that they may fear You all the days they live in the land that You gave to our fathers.
ekegusii: erinde banyare gokoiroka amatuko onsi bamenyete ase ense eria kwaete chisokoro chiaito.
swahili: ili wakuogope kwa wakati wote watakaoishi katika nchi uliyowapa baba zetu.

english: And as for the foreigner who is not of Your people Israel but has come from a distant land because of Your name—
ekegusii: “Boigo onye omogeni korwa ase ense y’aare, oria otari bw’abaanto bao Abaisraeli, okoigwa chinkuma chi’erieta riao rinene,
swahili: “Kwa habari ya mgeni ambaye si miongoni mwa watu wako Israeli, lakini amekuja kutoka nchi ya mbali kwa sababu ya jina lako,

english: for they will hear of Your great name and mighty hand and outstretched arm—when he comes and prays toward this temple,
ekegusii: (ekiagera abanto inabaigwe igoro y’erieta riao rinene, naende baigwe igoro y’okoboko kwao kore ne chinguru koramboire,) onye omogeni oyio ogocha aa kogosaba origereretie enyomba eye,
swahili: kwa maana watu watasikia juu ya Jina lako kuu na juu ya mkono wako wenye nguvu na mkono wako ulionyooshwa, atakapokuja na kuomba kuelekea Hekalu hili,

english: then may You hear from heaven, Your dwelling place, and do according to all for which the foreigner calls to You. Then all the peoples of the earth will know Your name and fear You, as do Your people Israel, and they will know that this house I have built is called by Your Name.
ekegusii: oigwe korwa igoro agwo aase obomenyo bwao bore. Okorere omogeni oria amang’ana onsi akoboria, erinde abanto bonsi b’ense bamanye erieta riao, naende bakoiroke buna abanto bao Abaisraeli bakomanyete na bakoirogete, naende bamanye ng’a enyomba eye naagachire nigo ekorokwa ase erieta riao.
swahili: basi na usikie kutoka mbinguni, mahali pa makao yako, ukafanye lolote ambalo mgeni huyo anakuomba, ili mataifa yote ya dunia wapate kujua jina lako na wakuogope kama wafanyavyo watu wako Israeli nao wapate pia kujua kwamba nyumba hii niliyoijenga imeitwa kwa Jina lako.

english: When Your people go to war against their enemies, wherever You send them, and when they pray to the LORD in the direction of the city You have chosen and the house I have built for Your Name,
ekegusii: “Abanto bao kobaragende ase esegi korwania ababisa babo ase enchera ende yonsi aye orabatome gochia, na kobaragosabe aye Omonene barigereretie omochie oyio gwachorire, na enyomba eye naagacheire erieta riao,
swahili: “Wakati watu wako watakapokwenda vitani dhidi ya adui zao, popote utakapowapeleka, wakati watakapoomba kwa Bwana kuelekea mji ambao umeuchagua, na Hekalu nililolijenga kwa ajili ya Jina lako,

english: then may You hear from heaven their prayer and their plea, and may You uphold their cause.
ekegusii: rirorio oigwe korwa agwo igoro ogosaba kwabo, na okoboria kwabo kw’oboitongo, na obae oboronge bwabo.
swahili: basi usikie dua na maombi yao kutoka mbinguni, ukawatetee haki yao.

english: When they sin against You—for there is no one who does not sin—and You become angry with them and deliver them to an enemy who takes them as captives to his own land, whether far or near,
ekegusii: “Omonto tari otagokora ebibe. Ase ayio baise kogokorera ebibe, na aye korabe nendamwamu ase bare na kobabeeka ase amaboko ’ababisa babo, na abwo baboose na kobaira ase ense y’ababisa ere aare gose ang’e, obaigwe.
swahili: “Watakapotenda dhambi dhidi yako, kwa kuwa hakuna mtu yeyote ambaye hatendi dhambi, nawe ukachukizwa nao na kuwakabidhi kwa adui, ambaye atawachukua utumwani katika nchi yake mwenyewe, mbali au karibu;

english: and when they come to their senses in the land to which they were taken, and they repent and plead with You in the land of their captors, saying, ‘We have sinned and done wrong; we have acted wickedly,’
ekegusii: Kobararore okomocha kwabo ekero bare ase ense eria boosirwe gochia, beitie na koonchoka, naende bakogosaba ase oboitongo na koorokia ng’a bakorire ebibe na obokayayu, obaigwe.
swahili: na kama watabadilika mioyo yao katika nchi wanakoshikiliwa mateka, nao wakatubu na kukulilia katika nchi ya wale waliowashinda na kusema, ‘Tumetenda dhambi, tumefanya makosa, tumetenda uovu’;

english: and when they return to You with all their heart and soul in the land of the enemies who took them captive, and when they pray to You in the direction of the land that You gave to their fathers, the city You have chosen, and the house I have built for Your Name,
ekegusii: Onye bagweitia na koonchoka ase ebirengererio biabo bionsi na ase chinkoro chiabo chionsi, ekero bare ase ense eria y’ababisa babo, baria baboosete, na aroro bagosabe barigereretie gochia ase ense yabo, eria kwaete chisokoro chiabo, na barigererie omochie oyo gwachorire na enyomba eye naagachire ase ogosasiima erieta riao,
swahili: kama wakikugeukia kwa moyo wao wote na nafsi zao katika nchi ya adui zao ambao waliwachukua mateka, wakakuomba kuelekea nchi uliyowapa baba zao, kuelekea mji uliouchagua na Hekalu nililolijenga kwa ajili ya Jina lako;

english: then may You hear from heaven, Your dwelling place, their prayer and petition, and may You uphold their cause.
ekegusii: rirorio oigwe korwa agwo igoro ase obomenyo bwao bore ogosaba kwabo na okoboria kwabo kw’oboitongo, obae oboronge bwabo.
swahili: basi kutoka mbinguni, mahali pa makao yako, usikie dua yao na maombi yao na kuitetea haki yao.

english: There, before the ark, King Solomon and the whole congregation of Israel who had assembled with him sacrificed so many sheep and oxen that they could not be counted or numbered.
ekegusii: Omorwoti Sulemani amo nomoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli, baria basangererekanete amo nere bagatenena bosio bw’Esanduki eria, bakaruera aroro ebing’wanso bie ching’ondi ne chiombe chinyinge mono chitaare konyara kobareka.
swahili: naye Mfalme Solomoni na kusanyiko lote la Israeli waliokusanyika kumzunguka walikuwa mbele ya hilo Sanduku, nao wakatoa dhabihu nyingi za kondoo na ngʼombe ambao idadi yao haikuwezekana kuandikwa au kuhesabiwa.

english: May You forgive Your people who have sinned against You and all the transgressions they have committed against You, and may You grant them compassion in the eyes of their captors to show them mercy.
ekegusii: Bwabere abanto bao bakorire ebibe asore. Bwabere ogosaria kwabo gwonsi bakorire asore; okore ababisa babo, abwo baboosire baabarorere amabeebe.
swahili: Uwasamehe watu wako, waliotenda dhambi dhidi yako; uwasamehe makosa yote waliyoyatenda dhidi yako, ukawafanye wale waliowashinda kuwaonea huruma;

english: For they are Your people and Your inheritance; You brought them out of Egypt, out of the furnace for iron.
ekegusii: Abanto aba nabaanto bao, na omwando oo, oria kwarusetie korwa Misiri, ense eria yarenge buna eriko ri’ekebemberi ki’omorero.
swahili: kwa maana ni watu wako na urithi wako, uliowatoa Misri, kutoka kwenye lile tanuru la kuyeyushia chuma.

english: May Your eyes be open to the pleas of Your servant and of Your people Israel, and may You listen to them whenever they call to You.
ekegusii: “Tiga amaiso ao abe atorigereretie namaabera, inche omosomba oo amo nabaanto bao Abaisraeli, otoigwe ekero kende gionsi togokorangeria ase oboitongo.
swahili: “Macho yako na yafumbuke juu ya ombi la mtumishi wako na ombi la watu wako Israeli, nawe uwasikilize wakati wowote wanapokulilia.

english: For You, O Lord GOD, as Your inheritance, have set them apart from all the peoples of the earth, as You spoke through Your servant Moses when You brought our fathers out of Egypt.” Solomon’s Benediction
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, nigo kwabaatananete korwa ase egati y’abanto bonsi b’ense babe omwando oo, buna gwateebete goetera ase Musa, omosomba oo, ekero keria kwarusetie chisokoro chiaito korwa Misiri.” Ogosaba kw’omoerio
swahili: Kwa maana uliwachagua wao kutoka mataifa yote ya ulimwengu kuwa urithi wako mwenyewe, kama ulivyotangaza kupitia mtumishi wako Mose wakati wewe, Ee Bwana Mwenyezi, ulipowatoa baba zetu kutoka Misri.”

english: Now when Solomon had finished praying this entire prayer and petition to the LORD, he got up before the altar of the LORD, where he had been kneeling with his hands spread out toward heaven.
ekegusii: Bono ekero Sulemani akoorete ogosaba oko gwonsi na okobori’Omonene ase oboitongo, akaimoka korwa ase egesasiimero ki’Omonene aase atung’amete namaru aye inse oramborete amaboko aye gochia igoro,
swahili: Wakati Solomoni alipomaliza dua hizi zote na maombi kwa Bwana, akainuka kutoka mbele ya madhabahu ya Bwana, mahali alipokuwa amepiga magoti, mikono yake ikawa imekunjuliwa kuelekea juu mbinguni.

english: And he stood and blessed the whole assembly of Israel in a loud voice, saying:
ekegusii: agatenena agasesenia omosangererekano bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli, agakwana neriogi rinene, akabora,
swahili: Akasimama na kubariki kusanyiko lote la Israeli kwa sauti kubwa akisema:

english: “Blessed be the LORD, who has given rest to His people Israel according to all that He promised. Not one word has failed of all the good promises He made through His servant Moses.
ekegusii: “Atogigwe Omonene oria oeire abanto baye Abaisraeli obotoereru buna abarierete eira! Nonya ne ring’ana erimo tiriri ritaikeranetigwe ase eira yaye yonsi engiya ariete goetera ase Musa, omosomba oye.
