swahili: “Ahimidiwe Bwana, aliyewapa pumziko watu wake Israeli kama vile alivyokuwa ameahidi. Hakuna hata neno moja lililopunguka kati ya ahadi zote nzuri alizozitoa kupitia mtumishi wake Mose.

english: May the LORD our God be with us, as He was with our fathers. May He never leave us nor forsake us.
ekegusii: Omonene, Nyasae oito, abe naintwe buna abeete ne chisokoro chiaito; tabaisa gototiga gose gotwanga,
swahili: Bwana Mungu wetu na awe pamoja nasi kama alivyokuwa na baba zetu, kamwe asituache wala kutukataa.

english: May He incline our hearts to Himself, to walk in all His ways and to keep the commandments and statutes and ordinances He commanded our fathers.
ekegusii: korende aonchore chinkoro chiaito gochia asare, tonyare kobwatia chinchera chiaye, na kobwata amachiiko aye na emeroberio yaye echiikire, na onsi aya achiigete chisokoro chiaito.
swahili: Yeye na aielekeze mioyo yetu kwake, ili tutembee katika njia zake zote na kuzishika amri na maagizo na masharti aliyowapa baba zetu.

english: And may these words with which I have made my petition before the LORD be near to the LORD our God day and night, so that He may uphold the cause of His servant and of His people Israel as each day requires,
ekegusii: Amang’ana aya aane nasabire ase oboitongo, tiga Omonene, Nyasae oito, abe okoyainyora omobaso na obotuko, naende ae abanto baye Abaisraeli oboronge bwabo koreng’ana buna okogania gwa kera rituko kore.
swahili: Nami maneno yangu haya, ambayo nimeyaomba mbele za Bwana, yawe karibu na Bwana Mungu wetu usiku na mchana, ili kwamba atetee shauri la mtumishi wake na la watu wake Israeli kulingana na hitaji lao la kila siku,

english: Then the priests brought the ark of the covenant of the LORD to its place in the inner sanctuary of the temple, the Most Holy Place, beneath the wings of the cherubim.
ekegusii: Erio abakuani bakarenta Esanduki eria y’Okobwatana kw’Omonene, bakayesoyia aase aye ase akanyomba ka ime, agwo Aase Aachenu Mono, bakayebeka inse ye chimbaaba chi’ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba.
swahili: Makuhani wakalileta Sanduku la Agano la Bwana hadi mahali pake ndani ya sehemu takatifu ndani ya Hekalu, yaani Patakatifu pa Patakatifu, na kuliweka chini ya mabawa ya makerubi.

english: so that all the peoples of the earth may know that the LORD is God. There is no other!
ekegusii: Erio abanto b’ense yonsi banyare komanya ng’a Omonene nere Nyasae, naende enyasae ende teri.
swahili: ili kwamba mataifa yote ya dunia wajue kwamba Bwana ndiye Mungu na kwamba hakuna mwingine.

english: So let your heart be fully devoted to the LORD our God, as it is this day, to walk in His statutes and to keep His commandments.” Sacrifices of Dedication (2 Chronicles 7:4–10)
ekegusii: Ase ayio, tiga chinkoro chiaino chionsi chibe echi’ekeene ase Omonene, Nyasae oito, mobwatie emeroberio yaye echiikire na mobwate amachiiko aye buna mwakorire ase rituko ria reero.” Ogwatananwa gwe Hekalu (2 Amg 7:4-10)
swahili: Lakini ni lazima mwiweke mioyo yenu kikamilifu kwa Bwana Mungu wetu, kuishi kwa maagizo yake na kutii amri zake, kama ilivyo wakati huu.” Kuwekwa Wakfu Hekalu (2 Nyakati 7:4-10)

english: Then the king and all Israel with him offered sacrifices before the LORD.
ekegusii: Erio omorwoti na abanto bonsi amo nere bakarua ekeng’wanso ase obosio bw’Omonene.
swahili: Kisha mfalme na Israeli wote pamoja naye wakatoa dhabihu mbele za Bwana.

english: And Solomon offered as peace offerings to the LORD 22,000 oxen and 120,000 sheep. So the king and all the Israelites dedicated the house of the LORD.
ekegusii: Sulemani akarua ebing’wanso bi’omorembe ase Omonene, chiombe chilifu emerongo ebere na ibere, ne ching’ondi chilifu rigana erimo na emerongo ebere. Naboigo omorwoti amo nabaanto bonsi bagaatanana enyomba y’Omonene.
swahili: Solomoni akatoa dhabihu sadaka za amani kwa Bwana: ngʼombe 22,000, pamoja na kondoo na mbuzi 120,000. Hivyo ndivyo mfalme na Waisraeli wote walivyoweka wakfu Hekalu la Bwana.

english: On that same day the king consecrated the middle of the courtyard in front of the house of the LORD, and there he offered the burnt offerings, the grain offerings, and the fat of the peace offerings, since the bronze altar before the LORD was too small to contain all these offerings.
ekegusii: Ase rituko riria omorwoti agaatanana na gochena obogati‐gati bw’eraaro eria yarenge bosio bw’enyomba y’Omonene. Agwo nao aruerete ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa, na okoruegwa kw’endagera, na ebitinya bi’ebing’wanso bi’omorembe, ekiagera egesasiimero gi’etai ekiarenge ase obosio bw’Omonene nigo kiarenge egeke mono, tikiare goisana koira ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa, na okoruegwa kw’endagera, na ebitinya bi’ebing’wanso bi’omorembe.
swahili: Siku iyo hiyo mfalme akaweka wakfu sehemu ya katikati ya ua uliokuwa mbele ya Hekalu la Bwana na hapo akatoa sadaka za kuteketezwa, sadaka za nafaka na mafuta ya sadaka za amani, kwa sababu madhabahu ya shaba iliyokuwa mbele za Bwana ilikuwa ndogo sana kuweza kubeba sadaka hizo za kuteketezwa, sadaka za nafaka na mafuta ya sadaka ya amani.

english: So at that time Solomon and all Israel with him—a great assembly of people from Lebo-hamath to the Brook of Egypt—kept the feast before the LORD our God for seven days and seven more days—fourteen days in all.
ekegusii: Ase ayio Sulemani amo n’Abaisraeli bonsi mbabwate Amatuko Amanene ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere, naende ase amatuko ande atano na abere, amatuko onsi nikomi na ane. Omosangererekano omonene nigo orenge gosangerereka korwa egesoero kia Hamati goika akarooche ka Misiri.
swahili: Hivyo Solomoni akaiadhimisha sikukuu kwa wakati ule, na Israeli wote pamoja naye. Walikuwa kusanyiko kubwa sana, watu kutoka Lebo-Hamathi hadi Kijito cha Misri. Wakaiadhimisha mbele za Bwana Mungu wetu kwa siku saba na siku saba zaidi, yaani, jumla siku kumi na nne.

english: On the fifteenth day Solomon sent the people away. So they blessed the king and went home, joyful and glad in heart for all the good things that the LORD had done for His servant David and for His people Israel.
ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatano na gatato agatiga abanto bakagenda, na barabwo bagasesenia omorwoti, bakagenda chinka chiabo bare nomogooko na omosasoko ase chinkoro chiabo ase engencho y’obuya bwonsi bori’Omonene akorerete Daudi, omosomba oye, na Abaisraeli, abanto baye.
swahili: Siku iliyofuata, aliwaruhusu watu waondoke. Wakambariki mfalme, kisha wakaenda nyumbani, wakiwa na mashangilio na furaha rohoni kwa ajili ya mambo yote mema ambayo Bwana ametenda kwa ajili ya Daudi mtumishi wake na watu wake Israeli.

english: For the cherubim spread their wings over the place of the ark and overshadowed the ark and its poles.
ekegusii: Ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba abwo nigo baramborete chimbaaba chiabo igoro y’aase aria Esanduki eria yarenge, bagatuba Esanduki eria amo nemiaro yaye yaare kobogorerigwa.
swahili: Makerubi yalitandaza mabawa yao juu ya mahali pa Sanduku la Agano na kutia kivuli Sanduku pamoja na mipiko yake ya kubebea.

english: The poles extended far enough that their ends were visible from the Holy Place in front of the inner sanctuary, but not from outside the Holy Place; and they are there to this day.
ekegusii: Emiaro eria nigo yarenge emetambe, ne chinsinyo chiabo chikarorekana korwa Aase Aachenu ase oyo oteneine bosio bw’Aase Aachenu Mono, korende tiyarenge kororekana korwa isiko; nero nao ere agwo goika reero iga.
swahili: Mipiko hiyo ilikuwa mirefu sana kiasi kwamba ncha zake zilionekana kutoka Mahali Patakatifu mbele ya Patakatifu pa Patakatifu, lakini sio nje ya Mahali Patakatifu. Hiyo mipiko ipo hata leo.

english: There was nothing in the ark except the two stone tablets that Moses had placed in it at Horeb, where the LORD had made a covenant with the Israelites after they had come out of the land of Egypt.
ekegusii: Egento kende ekeao tikiarenge ime ase Esanduki eria, otatiga chibao chiria ibere chi’amagena, chiria Musa abegete imeo, agwo Horebu ase Omonene akorete okobwatana kw’ogotianania n’Abaisraeli ekero barwete ase ense ya Misiri.
swahili: Ndani ya Sanduku hapakuwepo kitu kingine chochote isipokuwa zile mbao mbili za mawe ambazo Mose alikuwa ameziweka ndani yake huko Horebu, mahali ambapo Bwana alifanya Agano na Waisraeli baada ya kutoka Misri.

english: Now when Solomon had finished building the house of the LORD and the royal palace, and had achieved all that he had desired to do,
ekegusii: Ekero Sulemani konya akoorire koagacha enyomba y’Omonene, na enyomba y’oborwoti, na aande onsi ase anchete koagacha,
swahili: Solomoni alipomaliza kujenga Hekalu la Bwana na jumba la kifalme, alipokwisha kufanya yote aliyotaka kufanya,

english: Now at the end of the twenty years during which Solomon built these two houses, the house of the LORD and the royal palace,
ekegusii: Sulemani akaira emiaka emerongo ebere ase okoagacha chinyomba chiria ibere, enyomba y’Omonene na ey’oborwoti.
swahili: Miaka ishirini ilipopita, ambayo katika hiyo Solomoni alijenga majengo haya mawili, yaani Hekalu la Bwana na jumba la kifalme,

english: King Solomon gave twenty towns in the land of Galilee to Hiram king of Tyre, who had supplied him with cedar and cypress logs and gold for his every desire.
ekegusii: Hiramu, omorwoti o Turo, konya oeire Sulemani chibao chi’emecharake, na echi’emetarakwa, amo ne chitaabu ase ekerengo aganetie. Magega y’ayio omorwoti Sulemani akaa Hiramu emechie emerongo ebere yarenge ase ense ya Galili.
swahili: Mfalme Solomoni akampa Hiramu mfalme wa Tiro miji ishirini katika Galilaya, kwa sababu Hiramu alikuwa amempatia mierezi yote, misunobari na dhahabu yote aliyohitaji.

english: So Hiram went out from Tyre to inspect the towns that Solomon had given him, but he was not pleased with them.
ekegusii: Korende ekero Hiramu achete korwa Turo korora emechie eria, tiyamogogetie.
swahili: Lakini Hiramu alipotoka Tiro kwenda kuiona ile miji ambayo Solomoni alikuwa amempa, hakupendezwa nayo.

english: “What are these towns you have given me, my brother?” asked Hiram, and he called them the Land of Cabul, as they are called to this day.
ekegusii: Akabora: “Emechie eye kwang’eire, oyominto, naki ere?” Ase eyio igo ekorokwa ense ya Kabuli goika reero iga.
swahili: Hiramu akauliza, “Hii ni miji ya namna gani uliyonipa, ndugu yangu?” Naye akaiita nchi ya Kabul, jina lililoko hadi leo.

english: And Hiram had sent the king 120 talents of gold.
ekegusii: Hiramu konya otomeire omorwoti chitaabu chikiro chilifu inye (4,000). Amang’ana ande Sulemani akorete (1 Amg 8:3-18)
swahili: Basi Hiramu alikuwa amempelekea mfalme talanta 120 za dhahabu.

english: This is the account of the forced labor that King Solomon imposed to build the house of the LORD, his own palace, the supporting terraces, and the wall of Jerusalem, as well as Hazor, Megiddo, and Gezer.
ekegusii: Oyo noro omooroberio bw’emeremo Sulemani abeetereretie abanto bakore: Akababeeka koagacha enyomba y’Omonene, na enyomba yaye omonyene, na Milo, na orwaki rwaetanaine Yerusalemu, na emechie ya Hasori, na Megido, na Geseri,
swahili: Haya ni maelezo kuhusu kazi za kulazimishwa ambazo Mfalme Solomoni, alivyowafanyiza watu ili kulijenga hekalu la Bwana, na jumba lake la kifalme, na Milo, ukuta wa Yerusalemu, Hazori, Megido na Gezeri.

english: Pharaoh king of Egypt had attacked and captured Gezer. He had set it on fire, killed the Canaanites who lived in the city, and given it as a dowry to his daughter, Solomon’s wife.
ekegusii: (Farao, omorwoti o Misiri, konya ochire korwania Geseri na koyosakora, naende akayosamba nomorero. Agaita abanto ba Kaanani baria bamenyete aroro, na koyorua buna ekeegwa ki’ogosokia omoiseke oye abe moga Sulemani.
swahili: (Farao mfalme wa Misri alikuwa ameushambulia na kuuteka mji wa Gezeri. Alikuwa ameuchoma moto. Akawaua Wakanaani waliokuwa wakikaa humo na kisha kuutoa kwa binti yake, yaani mkewe Solomoni, kama zawadi ya arusi.

english: So Solomon rebuilt Gezer, Lower Beth-horon,
ekegusii: Bono Sulemani akaagacha Geseri naende). Boigo akaagacha Beti‐Horoni ya maate,
swahili: Solomoni akaujenga tena Gezeri.) Akajenga Beth-Horoni ya Chini,

english: Baalath, and Tamar in the Wilderness of Judah,
ekegusii: na Baalati, na Tamari ore ase erooro, ase ense eria,
swahili: akajenga Baalathi na Tamari kwenye jangwa katika eneo la nchi yake,

english: as well as all the store cities that Solomon had for his chariots and horses —whatever he desired to build in Jerusalem, Lebanon, and throughout the land of his dominion.
ekegusii: na emechie yonsi ye chikungo, eria Sulemani abwate, na emechie ye chigari chiaye, na eye chibarasi, na oboagacho bonde bwonsi Sulemani aganetie koagacha agwo Yerusalemu, na agwo Lebanoni na ase ense yonsi y’oborwoti bwaye.
swahili: vilevile miji ya ghala na miji kwa ajili ya magari yake na kwa ajili ya farasi wake: chochote alichotaka kujenga katika Yerusalemu, katika Lebanoni, na katika eneo yote aliyotawala.

english: the LORD appeared to him a second time, as He had appeared to him at Gibeon.
ekegusii: Omonene akamoorokera eria kabere buna amoorokerete agwo Gibeoni ritang’ani.
swahili: Bwana akamtokea mara ya pili, kama alivyokuwa amemtokea huko Gibeoni.

english: As for all the people who remained of the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites (the people who were not Israelites)—
ekegusii: Abanto aba Sulemani abetereretie gokora emeremo, nigo baarenge abe chinderia chi’abaanto b’ense ya Kaanani, abwo Abaisraeli batanyarete kobua na gosiria kegima.
swahili: Watu wote waliosalia kutoka kwa Waamori, Wahiti, Waperizi, Wahivi na Wayebusi (mataifa haya hayakuwa Waisraeli),

english: their descendants who remained in the land, those whom the Israelites were unable to devote to destruction —Solomon conscripted these people to be forced laborers, as they are to this day.
ekegusii: Abanto abwo tibaarenge Abaisraeli. Nigo baarenge Abaamori, na Abahiti, na Abaperisi, na Abahivi, na Abayebusi. Abanto abwo bakagenderera koba abasomba, nabo bare goika reero iga.
swahili: yaani, wazao wao waliobakia katika nchi, ambao Waisraeli hawangeweza kuwaangamiza kabisa: hawa Solomoni akawalazimisha kuwa watumwa katika shokoa, kama ilivyo hadi leo.

english: But Solomon did not consign any of the Israelites to slavery, because they were his men of war, his servants, his officers, his captains, and the commanders of his chariots and cavalry.
ekegusii: Korende Sulemani takorete Abaisraeli bakaba abasomba. Barabwo nigo baarenge abarwani b’esegi, na abakoonyi b’oborwoti, na abachiki baye b’abarwani, na abatang’ani b’abarwani, na abachiki baye be chigari ne chibarasi chikoriinwa.
swahili: Lakini Solomoni hakumfanya yeyote wa Waisraeli kuwa mtumwa; wao ndio waliokuwa wapiganaji wake, maafisa wake wa serikali, maafisa wake, wakuu wake, majemadari wa jeshi wa magari yake ya vita na wapanda farasi.

english: They were also the chief officers over Solomon’s projects: 550 supervisors over the people who did the work.
ekegusii: Abateneneri abanene igoro y’emeremo ya Sulemani nigo baarenge abanto amagana atano, na emerongo etano; abwo nigo batenenerete abanto baarenge gokora emeremo eria.
swahili: Pia walikuwa maafisa wakuu wasimamizi wa miradi ya Solomoni: maafisa 550 waliwasimamia watu waliofanya kazi.

english: As soon as Pharaoh’s daughter had come up from the City of David to the palace that Solomon had built for her, he built the supporting terraces.
ekegusii: Korende mosubati o Farao akarua ase Omochie o Daudi, agatiira gochia komenya ase enyomba yaye eria Sulemani konya amoagacheire; magega y’ayio Sulemani akaagacha Milo.
swahili: Baada ya binti Farao kuja kutoka Mji wa Daudi na kuingia jumba la kifalme ambalo Solomoni alikuwa amemjengea, akajenga Milo.

english: Three times a year Solomon offered burnt offerings and peace offerings on the altar he had built for the LORD, burning incense with them before the LORD. So he completed the temple.
ekegusii: Ara gatato ase omwaka Sulemani nigo arenge korua ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa na ebing’wanso bi’omorembe ase egesasiimero keria aagacherete Omonene. Boigo aba ogosamba ubani ase Omonene. Ase igo agakoora emeremo y’okoagacha enyomba y’Omonene.
swahili: Solomoni akatoa dhabihu za kuteketezwa na sadaka za amani mara tatu kwa mwaka, juu ya madhabahu aliyokuwa amejengea kwa ajili ya Bwana, akifukiza uvumba mbele za Bwana pamoja na dhabihu hizo, hivyo kutimiza kanuni za hekalu.

english: King Solomon also assembled a fleet of ships at Ezion-geber, which is near Eloth in Edom, on the shore of the Red Sea.
ekegusii: Omorwoti Sulemani akaroisia chimeeri agwo Esioni‐Geberi ere ang’e na Eloti, ase omosomo bw’Enyancha Embariri, ase ense ya Edomu.
swahili: Mfalme Solomoni pia akatengeneza pia meli huko Esion-Geberi, ambayo iko karibu na Elathi katika Edomu, kwenye ukingo wa Bahari ya Shamu.

english: And Hiram sent his servants, men who knew the sea, to serve in the fleet with Solomon’s servants.
ekegusii: Hiramu agatoma abanto baye baria bamanyete emeremo ye chinyancha, bagasang’ana nabaanto ba Sulemani.
swahili: Naye Hiramu akawatuma watu wake; mabaharia walioijua bahari, kuhudumu katika hizo meli pamoja na watu wa Solomoni.

english: They sailed to Ophir and imported gold from there—420 talents —and delivered it to Solomon.
ekegusii: Barabwo bakagenda goika Ofiri, bakarenta korwa aroro chitaabu, chikiro chilifu ikomi na inye, na amagana atano (14,500), bakairera omorwoti Sulemani.
swahili: Wakasafiri kwa bahari mpaka Ofiri na kurudi na talanta 420 za dhahabu, ambazo walimkabidhi Mfalme Solomoni.

english: And the LORD said to him: “I have heard your prayer and petition before Me. I have consecrated this temple you have built by putting My Name there forever; My eyes and My heart will be there for all time.
ekegusii: Omonene akamoteebia, “Naigure ogosaba kwao na okoboria kwao kw’oboitongo. Naatananire na gochena enyomba eye kwaagachire, nabekire erieta riane ribe aroro kare na kare. Amaiso aane na enkoro yane mbibe aroro ase chingaki chionsi.
swahili: Bwana akamwambia: “Nimesikia dua na maombi uliyofanya mbele zangu, nimeliweka wakfu Hekalu hili ambalo umelijenga, kwa kuweka Jina langu humo milele. Macho yangu na moyo wangu utakuwa humo siku zote.

english: And as for you, if you walk before Me as your father David walked, with a heart of integrity and uprightness, doing all I have commanded you, and if you keep My statutes and ordinances,
ekegusii: Korabwatie chinchera chiane, buna Daudi iso achibwatetie, ase enkoro endonge na ase obwegenwa; na onye kogokora onsi aya nagochikiire, na kobwata emeroberio yonsi echiikire;
swahili: “Kukuhusu wewe, kama ukienenda kwa unyofu wa moyo na uadilifu, kama baba yako Daudi alivyofanya na kutenda yote ninayoyaagiza kwa kutunza maagizo yangu na sheria,

english: then I will establish your royal throne over Israel forever, as I promised your father David when I said, ‘You will never fail to have a man on the throne of Israel.’
ekegusii: rirorio inche ninkong’ie ekerogo kiao ki’oborwoti igoro ase Abaisraeli kare na kare, buna narierete Daudi iso eira, ngateeba: Takobora nonya ng’ake korwa ase ororeeria rwao omonto oraikaranse ase ekerogo ki’oborwoti ki’Abaisraeli.
swahili: nitakiimarisha kiti chako cha enzi juu ya Israeli milele kama nilivyomwahidi Daudi baba yako niliposema, ‘Hutakosa kamwe kuwa na mtu kwenye kiti cha enzi cha Israeli.’

english: But if indeed you or your sons turn away from following Me and do not keep the commandments and statutes I have set before you, and if you go off to serve and worship other gods,
ekegusii: Korende inwe na abanto be chinderia chiaino komoreonchore na montige, naende timorenda amachiiko aane na emeroberio yane nabaeire, korende mogende gokorera chinyasae chinde na gochisasiima,
swahili: “Lakini kama ninyi au wana wenu mkigeukia mbali nami na kuziacha amri na maagizo yangu niliyowapa na kwenda kuitumikia miungu mingine na kuiabudu,

english: then I will cut off Israel from the land that I have given them, and I will banish from My presence this temple I have sanctified for My Name. Then Israel will become an object of scorn and ridicule among all peoples.
ekegusii: rirorio ninsirie Abaisraeli korwa ase ense eria nabaeire, na enyomba eye naatananire na koyechena ase engencho y’erieta riane ninyetige, tinkoyerigereria namaiso aane. Abaisraeli nababe omorabaaro ne ring’ana rigokwanwa nabaanto b’ebisaku bionsi.
swahili: basi nitakatilia mbali Israeli kutoka nchi niliyowapa, nami nitalikataa Hekalu hili nililolitakasa kwa ajili ya Jina langu. Ndipo Israeli itakuwa kitu cha kudharauliwa na watu na kuwa kitu cha kudhihakiwa miongoni mwa watu wote.

english: And when this temple has become a heap of rubble, all who pass by it will be appalled and will hiss and say, ‘Why has the LORD done such a thing to this land and to this temple?’
ekegusii: Enyomba eye nebe rituuri riatagokire, na kera omonto ogoeta aase agwo naichanigwe na gokumia, na ekero monto onde akoboria: Nase ki Omonene akorire ayaiga ase ense eye na ase enyomba eye?
swahili: Ingawa hekalu hili linavutia sasa, wote watakaolipita watashangaa na kudhihaki wakisema, ‘Kwa nini Bwana amefanya kitu kama hiki katika nchi hii na kwa Hekalu hili?’

english: And others will answer, ‘Because they have forsaken the LORD their God who brought their fathers out of the land of Egypt, and have embraced other gods, worshiping and serving them—because of this, the LORD has brought all this disaster upon them.’” Solomon’s Additional Achievements (2 Chronicles 8:1–18)
ekegusii: Nigo barairanerie: Nekiagera barabwo batigete Omonene, Nyasae obo, oria orusetie chisokoro chiabo korwa ase ense ya Misiri, naende bakabwatana ne chinyasae ching’ao, bagachisasiima na gochikorera. Amang’ana ayio agerire Omonene orentire amabe aya onsi igoro ase bare.” Sulemani okoa Hiramu emechie (2 Amg 8:1-2)
swahili: Watu watajibu, ‘Kwa sababu wamemwacha Bwana Mungu wao, aliyewatoa baba zao Misri, nao wamekumbatia miungu mingine, wakaiabudu na kuitumikia, ndiyo sababu Bwana ameyaleta maafa haya yote juu yao.’ ” Shughuli Nyingine Za Solomoni (2 Nyakati 8)

english: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, To the elect who are exiles of the Dispersion throughout Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia, chosen
ekegusii: Korwa ase Petero, omotomwa o Yeso Kristo, gochia ase abachore ba Nyasae, abamwatananekire gochia komenya buna abamenyi ase Ponto, na Galatia, na Kapadokia, na Asia, na Bitinia.
swahili: Petro, mtume wa Yesu Kristo: Kwa wateule wa Mungu, wageni katika ulimwengu, waliotawanyika kote katika Ponto, Galatia, Kapadokia, Asia na Bithinia.

english: Concerning this salvation, the prophets who foretold the grace to come to you searched and investigated carefully,
ekegusii: Igoro ase amang’ana ogotooreka okwo ababani, baria baabaanete obuya obo borache kobacheera, bakariga‐rigia na kounenkia.
swahili: Kwa habari ya wokovu huu, wale manabii waliosema kuhusu neema ambayo ingewajia ninyi, walitafuta kwa bidii na kwa uangalifu mkubwa,

english: trying to determine the time and setting to which the Spirit of Christ in them was pointing when He predicted the sufferings of Christ and the glories to follow.
ekegusii: Bakarigia nkero ki, naende nkero kenga buna kere ki, Omoika o Kristo, oyorenge ime yabo, oorogetie, ekero otang’anete koba kirori igoro y’ogochandwa gwa Kristo, na obonene obwo borache koba magega y’ayio.
swahili: wakijaribu kujua ni wakati upi na katika mazingira gani ambayo Roho wa Kristo aliyekuwa ndani yao alionyesha, alipotabiri kuhusu mateso ya Kristo na utukufu ule ambao ungefuata.

english: It was revealed to them that they were not serving themselves, but you, when they foretold the things now announced by those who preached the gospel to you by the Holy Spirit sent from heaven. Even angels long to look into these things. A Call to Holiness (Hebrews 12:14–17)
ekegusii: Nyasae nigo abamaanorerete ng’a baabakorere inwe ase amang’ana ayio, gose tari barabwo abanyene. Ayio bono araaretigwe ase more nabaria baabaranderetie inwe enchiri ase Omoika Omochenu, oyotometwe korwa igoro. Amang’ana ayio abamalaika bare namaiga kona‐koyasiomeria. Okorangeria gw’okoba norogendo oroochenu
swahili: Walidhihirishiwa kwamba walikuwa hawajihudumii wao wenyewe, bali waliwahudumia ninyi, waliponena kuhusu mambo hayo, ambayo sasa yamehubiriwa kwenu na wale waliowahubiria ninyi Injili kwa Roho Mtakatifu aliyetumwa kutoka mbinguni. Hata malaika wanatamani kuyafahamu mambo haya. Mwito Wa Kuishi Maisha Matakatifu

english: Therefore prepare your minds for action. Be sober-minded. Set your hope fully on the grace to be given you at the revelation of Jesus Christ.
ekegusii: Ase ayio, eboyie bokong’u ebinema bi’ebirengererio biaino, mobe aberiti, mobe nogosemeria ogoikeranu ase obuya boria moraarenterwe ase okoorokigwa kwa Yeso Kristo.
swahili: Kwa hiyo, tayarisheni nia zenu kwa kazi; mwe na kiasi, mkitumainia kikamilifu ile neema mtakayopewa Yesu Kristo atakapodhihirishwa.

english: As obedient children, do not conform to the passions of your former ignorance.
ekegusii: Buna abana ba Nyasae abaigweri timwereng’ania nokogania kwaino okobe kw’eritang’ani, ekero mware motamanyete gento,
swahili: Kama watoto watiifu, msifuate tamaa zenu mbaya wakati mlipoishi kwa ujinga.

english: But just as He who called you is holy, so be holy in all you do,
ekegusii: korende buna ere, oyobarangeirie, are omochenu, naboigo nainwe mobe abachenu ase orogendo rwaino rwonsi,
swahili: Bali kama yeye aliyewaita alivyo mtakatifu, nanyi kuweni watakatifu katika mwenendo wenu wote.

english: for it is written: “Be holy, because I am holy.”
ekegusii: amariiko nigo agoteeba, mobe abachenu ekiagera inche nomochenu.
swahili: Kwa maana imeandikwa: “Kuweni watakatifu, kwa kuwa mimi ni mtakatifu.”

english: Since you call on a Father who judges each one’s work impartially, conduct yourselves in reverent fear during your stay as foreigners.
ekegusii: Onye mokomooroka Tata, ere oyoragambie kera omonto koreng’ana nogokora kwaye atari nogwanchereria, mogenderere nokoiroka ase ekero kiaino gi’okomenya aiga buna abaeti.
swahili: Kwa sababu mnamwita Baba ahukumuye kila mtu kulingana na matendo yake pasipo upendeleo, enendeni kwa hofu ya kumcha Mungu wakati wenu wa kukaa hapa duniani kama wageni.

english: For you know that it was not with perishable things such as silver or gold that you were redeemed from the empty way of life you inherited from your forefathers,
ekegusii: Momanye ng’a nigo mwaboorigwe korwa ase orogendo rwaino rotagwenereti, orwo mwanyorete korwa ase chisokoro chiaino, tari ase ebinto bigosareka, buna chifeta gose chitaabu,
swahili: Kwa maana mnafahamu kwamba mlikombolewa kutoka mwenendo wenu usiofaa ambao mliurithi kutoka kwa baba zenu, si kwa vitu viharibikavyo kama fedha na dhahabu,

english: but with the precious blood of Christ, a lamb without blemish or spot.
ekegusii: korende ase amanyinga e rigori rinene, buna ay’emanwa y’eng’ondi etari na komocha, gose na kemoa, engencho yaye amanyinga a Kristo.
swahili: bali kwa damu ya thamani ya Kristo, yule Mwana-Kondoo asiye na dosari wala doa.

english: according to the foreknowledge of God the Father and sanctified by the Spirit for obedience to Jesus Christ and sprinkling by His blood: Grace and peace be yours in abundance. A Living Hope
ekegusii: Inwe nigo mwachoretwe koreng’ana buna Nyasae Tata amanyete korwa kare, na mogachenwa n’Omoika, monyare koigwera Yeso Kristo, na konyororokerigwa namanyinga aye. Obuya na omorembe bimenteke ase oboikeranu bwonsi. Ogosemeria kore moyo
swahili: Ni ninyi ambao mlichaguliwa tangu mwanzo na Mungu Baba kulingana na alivyotangulia kuwajua, kupitia kwa kazi ya utakaso wa Roho, katika utiifu kwa Yesu Kristo na kunyunyiziwa damu yake: Neema na amani ziwe kwenu kwa wingi. Tumaini Lenye Uzima

english: He was known before the foundation of the world, but was revealed in the last times for your sake.
ekegusii: Ere nigo achoretwe na Nyasae korwa kare, ritang’ani ense etarabekwa oboroso, korende oorokigwe ase amatuko aya ay’omoerio ase engencho yaino.
swahili: Yeye alichaguliwa kabla ya kuwekwa kwa misingi ya ulimwengu, lakini akadhihirishwa katika siku hizi za mwisho kwa ajili yenu.

english: Through Him you believe in God, who raised Him from the dead and glorified Him; and so your faith and hope are in God. The Enduring Word (Isaiah 40:6–8)
ekegusii: Goetera asare ere mwamwegenire Nyasae, oyomobogetie korwa ase abakuure na akamoa obonene, erinde okwegena kwaino na ogosemeria kwaino kobe ase Nyasae.
swahili: Kupitia kwake mmemwamini Mungu, aliyemfufua kutoka kwa wafu na akampa utukufu, ili imani yenu na tumaini lenu ziwe kwa Mungu.

english: Since you have purified your souls by obedience to the truth so that you have a genuine love for your brothers, love one another deeply, from a pure heart.
ekegusii: Komwaikire gwechena emioyo yaino ase okoigwera ekeene, goikera obwanchani bw’abamino botari nobong’ainereria, gaki bono mogenderere nobwanchani inwe ase inwe bokorwa ase enkoro y’ekeene,
swahili: Basi kwa kuwa mmejitakasa nafsi zenu kwa kuitii ile kweli hata mkawa na upendo wa ndugu usio na unafiki, basi pendaneni kwa dhati kutoka moyoni.

english: For you have been born again, not of perishable seed, but of imperishable, through the living and enduring word of God.
ekegusii: ekiagera mwaiboirwe eria kabere, tari ase embusuro egosareka, korende ase eyetari gosareka, goetera ase ring’ana ria Nyasae rinyene obogima, erikobao goika kare na kare.
swahili: Kwa maana mmezaliwa upya, si kwa mbegu ile iharibikayo, bali kwa ile isiyoharibika, kupitia kwa neno la Mungu lililo hai na linalodumu milele.

english: For, “All flesh is like grass, and all its glory like the flowers of the field; the grass withers and the flowers fall,
ekegusii: Naki igo eriikire, “Mwanyabaanto bonsi nigo banga buna obonyansi, na obonene bwabo nigo bonga buna ebisicha bire mogondo. Obonyansi nigo bokwoma, na ebisicha boigo,
swahili: Maana, “Wanadamu wote ni kama majani, nao utukufu wao ni kama maua ya kondeni; majani hunyauka na maua huanguka,

english: but the word of the Lord stands forever.” And this is the word that was proclaimed to you.
ekegusii: korende ring’ana ri’Omonene nigo rirabeo goika kare na kare.” Ne ring’ana eri nario enchiri eye mwaranderetigwe.
swahili: lakini neno la Bwana ladumu milele.” Hili ndilo neno lililohubiriwa kwenu.

english: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ! By His great mercy He has given us new birth into a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,
ekegusii: Abakwe Nyasae, ise Omonene oito Yeso Kristo! Ase amaabera aye amange atoiboire eria kabere, erinde tonyore ogosemeria kore moyo goetera ase okobokigwa kwa Yeso Kristo korwa ase abakuure,
swahili: Ahimidiwe Mungu, Baba wa Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo! Kwa rehema zake kuu ametuzaa sisi mara ya pili katika tumaini lenye uzima kupitia kwa kufufuka kwa Yesu Kristo kutoka kwa wafu,

english: and into an inheritance that is imperishable, undefiled, and unfading, reserved in heaven for you,
ekegusii: ase igo intwe ntonyore omwando oyio Nyasae agacherete abanto baye aaria igoro. Omwando oyio otagosareka, otari na komocha, otari gosiria obonene bwaye,
swahili: ili tuupate urithi usioharibika, usio na uchafu, ule usionyauka: uliotunzwa mbinguni kwa ajili yenu,

english: who through faith are shielded by God’s power for the salvation that is ready to be revealed in the last time.
ekegusii: inwe abamorendire nokobua kwa Nyasae ase enchera y’okwegena, monyore ogotooreka kore ang’e koorokigwa ase ekero ki’omoerio.
swahili: ninyi ambao mnalindwa na nguvu za Mungu kwa njia ya imani, hadi uje ule wokovu ulio tayari kufunuliwa nyakati za mwisho.

english: In this you greatly rejoice, though now for a little while you may have had to suffer grief in various trials
ekegusii: Ase engencho y’ayio monyare kogoka mono, nonya mbono ase ekero egeke inamochandeke ase amateemwa a kera engencho, onye egwenerete.
swahili: Katika hili mnafurahi sana, ingawa sasa kwa kitambo kidogo mmehuzunishwa kwa majaribu ya namna nyingi.

english: so that the proven character of your faith—more precious than gold, which perishes even though refined by fire—may result in praise, glory, and honor at the revelation of Jesus Christ.
ekegusii: Igo okwegena kwaino, gakoratenene ase ogoteemwa, kore kwe rigori rinene kobua etaabu egosira (nonya egoteemwa ase omorero) naende konyorekane kogwenerete ogotogigwa, na obonene, na ogosikwa ase okoorokigwa kwa Yeso Kristo.
swahili: Haya yamewajia ili kwamba imani yenu, iliyo ya thamani kuliko dhahabu ipoteayo, ingawa hujaribiwa kwa moto, ionekane kuwa halisi na imalizie katika sifa, utukufu na heshima wakati Yesu Kristo atadhihirishwa.

english: Though you have not seen Him, you love Him; and though you do not see Him now, you believe in Him and rejoice with an inexpressible and glorious joy,
ekegusii: Ere oyo mwamwanchire, nonya timomoorochi, mwamwegenire, nonya timoramorora, na igo moragoke ase omogooko otari gotebeka oichire nobonene,
swahili: Ingawa hamjamwona, mnampenda; tena ingawa sasa hammwoni, mnamwamini na kujawa na furaha isiyoneneka yenye utukufu usioelezeka.

english: now that you are receiving the goal of your faith, the salvation of your souls.
ekegusii: ekero moranyore oboikeranu bw’okwegena kwaino, engencho yaye ogotooreka kw’emioyo yaino.
swahili: Maana mnaupokea wokovu wa roho zenu, ambao ndio lengo la imani yenu.

english: Rid yourselves, therefore, of all malice, deceit, hypocrisy, envy, and slander.
ekegusii: Gaki, beka are obobe bwonsi, na obong’ainereria bwonsi, na oborianania, na emoko, na oboitania bwonsi.
swahili: Kwa hiyo, wekeni mbali nanyi uovu wote na udanganyifu wote, unafiki, wivu na masingizio ya kila namna.

english: Once you were not a people, but now you are the people of God; once you had not received mercy, but now you have received mercy.
ekegusii: Inwe agwo kare timwarenge abanto ba Nyasae, korende bono mwabeire abanto baye; ritang’ani timwanyorete amaabera, korende bono mwanyorire amaabera. Abasomba ba Nyasae
swahili: Mwanzo ninyi mlikuwa si taifa, lakini sasa ninyi ni taifa la Mungu. Mwanzo mlikuwa hamjapata rehema, lakini sasa mmepata rehema.

english: Beloved, I urge you, as foreigners and exiles, to abstain from the desires of the flesh, which war against your soul.
ekegusii: Abanchani, nabasoroire inwe, ekiagera more abaeti ase ense engeni eatanane korwa ase okogania okobe kw’omobere okwo gokorwana nomoyo.
swahili: Wapenzi, ninawasihi, mkiwa kama wageni na wapitaji hapa ulimwenguni, epukeni tamaa mbaya za mwili ambazo hupigana vita na roho zenu.

english: Conduct yourselves with such honor among the Gentiles that, though they slander you as evildoers, they may see your good deeds and glorify God on the day He visits us. Submission to Authorities (Romans 13:1–7)
ekegusii: Mobe norogendo oruya ase egati y’abanto b’Ebisaku, erinde nonya bakobang’acha ng’a nabakori amabe more, banyare korora ogokora kwaino okuya na gotogia Nyasae rituko riria agocha kobacheera.
swahili: Kuweni na mwenendo mzuri mbele ya watu wasiomjua Mungu, ili kama wanawasingizia kuwa watenda mabaya, wayaone matendo yenu mema nao wamtukuze Mungu siku atakapokuja kwetu. Kuwatii Wenye Mamlaka

english: Submit yourselves for the Lord’s sake to every human institution, whether to the king as the supreme authority,
ekegusii: Ase engencho y’Omonene mwebeke inse ya kera ekegochikwa na Mwanyabaanto, onye nomorwoti oyore omonene,
swahili: Kwa ajili ya Bwana, tiini kila mamlaka iliyowekwa na wanadamu: Kwa mfalme kwani ndiye aliye na mamlaka ya juu zaidi,

english: or to governors as those sent by him to punish those who do wrong and to praise those who do right.
ekegusii: gose abagabana, abatomirwe nere, erinde bae abakori amabe egesusuro, na gotogia abakori amaya,
swahili: au kwa maafisa aliowaweka, kwa kuwa mfalme amewatuma ili kuwaadhibu wale wanaokosa, na kuwapongeza wale watendao mema.

english: For it is God’s will that by doing good you should silence the ignorance of foolish men.
ekegusii: ekiagera oko nakwo ogwancha kwa Nyasae, ng’a ase ogokora kwaino okuya mokirie abanto abariri ase ogotamanya kwabo.
swahili: Kwa maana ni mapenzi ya Mungu kwamba kwa kutenda mema mnyamazishe maneno ya kijinga ya watu wapumbavu.

english: Live in freedom, but do not use your freedom as a cover-up for evil; live as servants of God.
ekegusii: Mobe abanto abasibore, korende timokorera obosibore bwaino ase okobiserera obobe, korende mobe norogendo rogwenerete abasomba ba Nyasae.
swahili: Ishini kama watu huru, lakini msitumie uhuru wenu kama kisingizio cha kutenda uovu, bali ishini kama watumishi wa Mungu.

english: Treat everyone with high regard: Love the brotherhood of believers, fear God, honor the king.
ekegusii: Mosike abanto bonsi. Mwanche abamino. Moiroke Nyasae. Mosike omorwoti. Ekiorokererio ki’ogochandwa gwa Kristo
swahili: Mheshimuni kila mtu ipasavyo: Wapendeni jamaa ya ndugu waumini, mcheni Mungu, mpeni heshima mfalme.

english: Servants, submit yourselves to your masters with all respect, not only to those who are good and gentle, but even to those who are unreasonable.
ekegusii: Inwe abasomba, moigwere abanene baino ase okoiroka gwonsi, tari abwo boka abare abaya gose abororo, korende na abwo bare abatindi boigo.
swahili: Ninyi watumwa, watiini mabwana zenu kwa heshima yote, si wale mabwana walio wema na wapole peke yao, bali pia wale walio wakali.

english: For if anyone endures the pain of unjust suffering because he is conscious of God, this is to be commended.
ekegusii: Naki aya namaya mono omonto karaaremererie ogoichana ase okoinyora Nyasae, na kobogoria ogochandwa gotari kwa boronge.
swahili: Kwa maana ni jambo la sifa kama mtu akivumilia anapoteswa kwa uonevu kwa ajili ya Mungu.

english: Like newborn babies, crave pure spiritual milk, so that by it you may grow up in your salvation,
ekegusii: Buna abana ebing’werere baiborwa reero iga, moganie amabeere ’ekeene ay’omoika, erinde monyare gokina ase aro, na goikera ogotooreka,
swahili: Kama watoto wachanga, waliozaliwa sasa, yatamanini maziwa ya kiroho yasiyochanganywa na kitu kingine chochote, ili kwa hayo mpate kukua katika wokovu,

english: How is it to your credit if you are beaten for doing wrong and you endure it? But if you suffer for doing good and you endure it, this is commendable before God. Christ’s Example of Suffering (Isaiah 53:1–8)
ekegusii: Naki ngotogigwa ki more nakwo komoraaremererie ase ogoakwa chinkundi ekero mogokora ebibe? Korende komoraaremererie ogochandwa ekero mogokora amaya, oko nakwo ogwancherwa ase obosio bwa Nyasae.
swahili: Kwani ni faida gani kwa mtu kustahimili anapopigwa kwa sababu ya makosa yake? Lakini kama mkiteswa kwa sababu ya kutenda mema, nanyi mkastahimili, hili ni jambo la kusifiwa mbele za Mungu. Mfano Wa Mateso Ya Kristo

english: For to this you were called, because Christ also suffered for you, leaving you an example, that you should follow in His footsteps:
ekegusii: Ase ayio naro mwarangereretigwe, ekiagera Kristo nere nigo achandetwe ase engencho yaino, obatigeire ekiorokererio, erinde mobwatie chimbaratero chiaye.
swahili: Ninyi mliitwa kwa ajili ya haya, kwa sababu Kristo naye aliteswa kwa ajili yenu, akiwaachia kielelezo, ili mzifuate nyayo zake.

english: “He committed no sin, and no deceit was found in His mouth.”
ekegusii: Ere takorete ebibe, gose obong’ainereria tibwaruete ase omonwa oye.
swahili: “Yeye hakutenda dhambi, wala hila haikuonekana kinywani mwake.”

english: When they heaped abuse on Him, He did not retaliate; when He suffered, He made no threats, but entrusted Himself to Him who judges justly.
ekegusii: Ere ekero arenge koramwa tairaneretie okoramwa okwo, ekero arenge gochandwa tatogonyete, korende akebeka asare ere oyokogamba ase oboronge.
swahili: Yeye alipotukanwa, hakurudisha matukano; alipoteswa, hakutishia, bali alijikabidhi kwa yeye ahukumuye kwa haki.

english: He Himself bore our sins in His body on the tree, so that we might die to sin and live to righteousness. “By His stripes you are healed.”
ekegusii: Ere omonyene akabogoria ebibe biaito ase omobere oye igoro ase omote, erinde intwe tokwe korwa ase amang’ana ’ebibe, tobe moyo ase amang’ana ’oboronge. Ase amaote aye inwe mwagwenigwe.
swahili: Yeye mwenyewe alizichukua dhambi zetu katika mwili wake juu ya mti, ili tufe kwa mambo ya dhambi, bali tupate kuishi katika haki. Kwa kupigwa kwake, ninyi mmeponywa.

english: For “you were like sheep going astray,” but now you have returned to the Shepherd and Overseer of your souls.
ekegusii: Naki nigo mware buna ching’ondi chiasirire, korende bono mwairanire ase Omorisia na Omorendi bw’emioyo yaino.
swahili: Kwa maana mlikuwa mmepotea kama kondoo, lakini sasa mmerudi kwa Mchungaji na Mwangalizi wa roho zenu.

english: now that you have tasted that the Lord is good.
ekegusii: Buna amariiko agokwana mwateemire Omonene ng’a nomuya.
swahili: ikiwa kweli mmeonja ya kwamba Bwana ni mwema.

english: As you come to Him, the living stone, rejected by men but chosen and precious in God’s sight,
ekegusii: Mochiere ere, oyore rigena rire moyo, riangetwe na Mwanyabaanto, korende ase obosio bwa Nyasae nerichore, rire rie rigori rinene.
swahili: Mnapokuja kwake, yeye aliye Jiwe lililo hai, lililokataliwa na wanadamu bali kwa Mungu ni teule na la thamani kwake,

english: you also, like living stones, are being built into a spiritual house to be a holy priesthood, offering spiritual sacrifices acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.
ekegusii: Inwe abamore buna amagena are moyo moagachwe, mobe enyomba y’Omoika mobe abakuani abachenu, morue ebing’wanso bi’omoika ebirancherwe ase Nyasae goetera ase Yeso Kristo.
swahili: ninyi nanyi, kama mawe yaliyo hai, mnajengwa kuwa nyumba ya kiroho, ili mpate kuwa ukuhani mtakatifu, mkitoa dhabihu za kiroho zinazokubaliwa na Mungu kwa njia ya Yesu Kristo.

english: For it stands in Scripture: “See, I lay in Zion a stone, a chosen and precious cornerstone; and the one who believes in Him will never be put to shame.”
ekegusii: Ekiagera eriikire ase amariiko, “Rigereria, nabekire ase Sayoni rigena richore, rigena rinene ri’ekoona, naende nigo rire rie rigori rinene, na onde bwensi oyoramwegene takorora obosooku.”
swahili: Kwa maana imeandikwa katika Maandiko: “Tazama, naweka katika Sayuni, jiwe la pembeni teule lenye thamani, na yeyote atakayemwamini hataaibika kamwe.”

english: To you who believe, then, this stone is precious. But to those who do not believe, “The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone,”
ekegusii: Naki ogosika oko nokwaino, inwe abamwegenire. Korende ase abwo bategeneti nigo eriikire, “Rigena erio abaagachi bangete riabeire rigena rinene ri’ekoona,”
swahili: Kwenu ninyi mnaoamini, jiwe hili ni la thamani. Lakini kwao wasioamini, “Jiwe walilolikataa waashi limekuwa jiwe kuu la pembeni,”

english: and, “A stone of stumbling and a rock of offense.” They stumble because they disobey the word—and to this they were appointed.
ekegusii: Amariko and nigo agokwana, “Eri nario rigena eriragere bagwe, egetare kerabaiyerie bonsi.” Nigo bakwegocha ase ring’ana, ekiagera tibari koriigwera. Naki naro ayio barageretwe.
swahili: tena, “Jiwe lenye kuwafanya watu wajikwae, na mwamba wa kuwaangusha.” Wanajikwaa kwa sababu hawakulitii lile neno, kama walivyowekewa tangu zamani.

english: But you are a chosen people, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God’s own possession, to proclaim the virtues of Him who called you out of darkness into His marvelous light.
ekegusii: Korende inwe nababiare abachore, abakuani b’omorwoti, egesaku egechenu, abanto ba Nyasae omonyene, monyare koraria ogokora kwaye kw’obonene, oyobarangeretie korwa ase omosunte, gochia ase omobaso oye bw’ogokumia.
swahili: Lakini ninyi ni taifa teule, ukuhani wa kifalme, taifa takatifu, watu walio milki ya Mungu, mlioitwa ili kutangaza sifa zake yeye aliyewaita kutoka gizani mkaingie katika nuru yake ya ajabu.

english: Wives, in the same way, submit yourselves to your husbands, so that even if they refuse to believe the word, they will be won over without words by the behavior of their wives
ekegusii: Naboigo, inwe abakungu, moigwere abasacha baino, erinde onye abande bare aroro, abategeneti ring’ana, bang’uswe ase orogendo rw’abakungu babo, batatebiri ring’ana,
swahili: Kadhalika enyi wake, watiini waume zenu, ili kama kunao wasioamini lile neno, wapate kuvutwa na mwenendo wa wake zao pasipo neno,

english: For, “Whoever would love life and see good days must keep his tongue from evil and his lips from deceitful speech.
ekegusii: Naki nigo eriikire “Oyorigetie gwancha obogima na korora amatuko amaya, tiga atange oromeme rwaye tirokwana amabe, na ebikoba biaye tibikwana obong’ainereria.
swahili: Kwa maana, “Yeyote apendaye uzima na kuona siku njema, basi auzuie ulimi wake usinene mabaya, na midomo yake isiseme hila.

english: He must turn from evil and do good; he must seek peace and pursue it.
ekegusii: Tiga atige amabe, akore amaya, arigie omorembe na koyotunyana mono.
swahili: Mtu huyo lazima aache uovu, akatende mema; lazima aitafute amani na kuifuatilia sana.

english: For the eyes of the Lord are on the righteous, and His ears are inclined to their prayer. But the face of the Lord is against those who do evil.”
ekegusii: Naki amaiso Omonene nigo arigereretie abanyene oboronge, na amato aye nigo akoigwa ogosaba kwabo. Korende obosio bw’Omonene nigo bore igoro ase abwo bagokora amabe.”
swahili: Kwa maana macho ya Bwana huwaelekea wenye haki, na masikio yake yako makini kusikiliza maombi yao. Bali uso wa Bwana uko kinyume na watendao maovu.” Kuvumilia Mateso

english: Who can harm you if you are zealous for what is good? Suffering for Righteousness
ekegusii: Ning’o orabakorere amabe, komorabe nomokia ase ayare amaya?
swahili: Basi, ni nani atakayewadhuru mkiwa wenye juhudi katika kutenda mema?

english: But even if you should suffer for what is right, you are blessed. “Do not fear what they fear; do not be shaken.”
ekegusii: Korende onye mogochandwa ase engencho y’oboronge, more negesio. Timoiroka okoirokia kwabo, gose timoichana.
swahili: Lakini mmebarikiwa hata kama ikiwalazimu kuteseka kwa ajili ya haki. “Msiogope vitisho vyao, wala msiwe na wasiwasi.”

english: But in your hearts sanctify Christ as Lord. Always be prepared to give a defense to everyone who asks you the reason for the hope that is in you. But respond with gentleness and respect,
ekegusii: Tiga Omonene Kristo acheneke ase chinkoro chiaino ime. Botambe mobe ang’e koiraneria kera omonto oyokobaboria amang’ana ogosemeria okore ime yaino, korende kora ayio ase obwororo na ase okoiroka.
swahili: Bali mtakaseni Kristo kuwa Bwana mioyoni mwenu. Siku zote mwe tayari kumjibu mtu yeyote atakayewauliza kuhusu sababu ya tumaini lililomo ndani yenu. Lakini fanyeni hivyo kwa upole na kwa heshima,

english: keeping a clear conscience, so that those who slander you may be put to shame by your good behavior in Christ.
ekegusii: Na inwe renda chinkoro chiaino tichibagambia, erinde ekero mogokwanwa bobe, abwo bakobarama ase orogendo rwaino oruya ase Kristo, basookigwe.
swahili: mkizitunza dhamiri zenu ziwe safi, ili wale wasemao mabaya dhidi ya mwenendo wenu mzuri katika Kristo waaibike kwa ajili ya masingizio yao.

english: For it is better, if it is God’s will, to suffer for doing good than for doing evil.
ekegusii: Naki mbuya gochandwa ase ogokora amaya kobua gochandwa ase ogokora amabe, onye gokoba ogwancha kwa Nyasae.
swahili: Kwa maana ni afadhali kupata mateso kwa ajili ya kutenda mema, kama kuteseka huko ndiyo mapenzi ya Mungu, kuliko kuteseka kwa kutenda maovu.

english: For Christ also suffered for sins once for all, the righteous for the unrighteous, to bring you to God. He was put to death in the body but made alive in the Spirit,
ekegusii: Ekiagera Kristo nere agakwa ara rimo ase engencho y’ebibe. Ere oyorenge omonyene oboronge agachandwa ase engencho y’abatari abaronge, erinde atorente ase Nyasae. Omobere oye ogaitwa, korende omoika oye ogakorwa koba moyo.
swahili: Kwa kuwa Kristo naye aliteswa mara moja tu kwa ajili ya dhambi, mwenye haki kwa ajili ya wasio haki, ili awalete ninyi kwa Mungu. Mwili wake ukauawa, lakini akafanywa hai katika Roho.

english: in whom He also went and preached to the spirits in prison
ekegusii: Ase omoika oyo agachiera emeika eria yarenge ase obosibwa, akayeranderia.
swahili: Baada ya kufanywa hai, alikwenda na kuzihubiria roho zilizokuwa kifungoni:

english: when they see your pure and reverent demeanor.
ekegusii: kobakorora orogendo rwaino oruya rore nokoiroka.
swahili: kwa kuuona utakatifu na uchaji wa Mungu katika maisha yenu.

english: who disobeyed long ago when God waited patiently in the days of Noah while the ark was being built. In the ark a few people, only eight souls, were saved through water.
ekegusii: Emeika eyio ney’abwo bataigwerete agwo kare, ekero Nyasae aganyete ase oboremereria ase amatuko aria Nuhu are koroisia obwato. Ime ase abwo abanto abake, engencho yaye abanto batano na batato, batooregete goetera ase amache.
swahili: roho hizo ambazo zamani hazikutii, wakati ule uvumilivu wa Mungu ulipokuwa ukingoja katika siku za Noa, wakati wa kujenga safina, ambamo watu wachache tu, yaani watu wanane, waliokolewa ili wasiangamie kwa gharika.

english: And this water symbolizes the baptism that now saves you also—not the removal of dirt from the body, but the pledge of a clear conscience toward God—through the resurrection of Jesus Christ,
ekegusii: Omogwekano bw’amang’ana aya nebatiso, eyekobatooria inwe bono, tari ase okobeeka aare riko ri’omobere, korende ase okoiraneria Nyasae enkoro etari kobagambia, goetera ase okobokigwa kwa Yeso Kristo,
swahili: Nayo maji hayo ni kielelezo cha ubatizo ambao sasa unawaokoa ninyi pia: si kwa kuondoa uchafu kwenye mwili, bali kama ahadi ya dhamiri safi kwa Mungu, kwa njia ya ufufuo wa Yesu Kristo.

english: who has gone into heaven and is at the right hand of God, with angels, authorities, and powers subject to Him.
ekegusii: oyosoete igoro, na bono nao are ensemo y’okoboko gw’okorio kwa Nyasae. Abamalaika, na okobua, ne chinguru nigo bibekire inse yaye.
swahili: Yeye ameingia mbinguni na amekaa mkono wa kuume wa Mungu; nao malaika, mamlaka na nguvu zote wametiishwa chini yake.

english: Your beauty should not come from outward adornment, such as braided hair or gold jewelry or fine clothes,
ekegusii: Ogwechabera kwaino tikoba ogwa isiko ase okomina chitukia, na kobeeka ebigera bie chitaabu, gose chianga chinterere,
swahili: Kujipamba kwenu kusiwe kwa nje tu, kama vile kusuka nywele, kuvalia vitu vilivyofanyizwa kwa dhahabu na kwa mavazi.

english: but from the inner disposition of your heart, the unfading beauty of a gentle and quiet spirit, which is precious in God’s sight.
ekegusii: korende kobe ogw’enkoro y’omonto o ime otari kororekana, ogwechabera okwo gotari gosareka, ase omoika bw’obwororo na obokanyeku. Oko nakwo kore kwe rigori rinene ase obosio bwa Nyasae.
swahili: Badala yake, kujipamba kwenu kuwe katika utu wenu wa moyoni, yaani uzuri usioharibika wa roho ya upole na utulivu, ambayo ni ya thamani sana machoni pa Mungu.

english: For this is how the holy women of the past adorned themselves. They put their hope in God and were submissive to their husbands,
ekegusii: Naki oko nakwo kware ogwechabera kw’abakungu abachenu ba kare, abamosemeretie Nyasae, abwo baigwerete abasacha babo,
swahili: Kwa kuwa hivi ndivyo walivyokuwa wakijipamba wanawake watakatifu wa zamani, waliomtumaini Mungu. Wao walikuwa ni watiifu kwa waume zao,

english: just as Sarah obeyed Abraham and called him lord. And you are her children if you do what is right and refuse to give way to fear.
ekegusii: buna Sara aigwerete Aburaamu, akamoroka omonene. Na inwe bono mwabeire abana baye komorakore amaya, gose timokwoboigwa ase kogoswa konde gwonsi.
swahili: kama Sara alivyomtii mumewe Abrahamu, hata akamwita bwana. Ninyi ni watoto wa Sara kama mkitenda yaliyo mema, bila kuogopa jambo lolote.

english: Husbands, in the same way, treat your wives with consideration as a delicate vessel, and with honor as fellow heirs of the gracious gift of life, so that your prayers will not be hindered. Turning from Evil
ekegusii: Naboigo nainwe abasacha, momenye nabakungu baino ase chisemi. Moe omokungu ogosika buna oyo otari ne chinguru, ekiagera nigo more abanyamwando amo ase okonyora obuya obokorenta obogima. Erio ogosaba kwaino tigotangwa. Gochandeka ase ogokora ayare boronge
swahili: Vivyo hivyo ninyi waume, kaeni na wake zenu kwa akili, nanyi wapeni heshima mkitambua ya kuwa wao ni wenzi walio dhaifu, na kama warithi pamoja nanyi wa kipawa cha neema cha uzima, ili kusiwepo na chochote cha kuzuia maombi yenu. Kuteseka Kwa Kutenda Mema

english: Finally, all of you, be like-minded and sympathetic, love as brothers, be tenderhearted and humble.
ekegusii: Ring’ana ri’omoerio neri: Mobe nomoyo oyomo, mobogoreranie, mwanchane buna abamino, mororerane amabeebe, mobe nomoyo bw’obokanyeku.
swahili: Hatimaye, ninyi nyote kuweni na nia moja, wenye kuhurumiana, mkipendana kama ndugu, na mwe wasikitivu na wanyenyekevu.

english: Do not repay evil with evil or insult with insult, but with blessing, because to this you were called so that you may inherit a blessing.
ekegusii: Timoakanana amabe ase amabe, gose okorama ase okorama, korende ribaga ri’ayio mobe abamogosesenania, ekiagera ayio naro mwarangererigwe, ng’a monyore omwando bw’ogosesenigwa.
swahili: Msilipe ovu kwa ovu, au jeuri kwa jeuri, bali barikini, kwa maana hili ndilo mliloitiwa ili mpate kurithi baraka.

english: Therefore, since Christ suffered in His body, arm yourselves with the same resolve, because anyone who has suffered in his body is done with sin.
ekegusii: Gaki, ekiagera Kristo achandetwe ase omobere, nainwe boigo eboyie ebirwanero bi’ebirengererio ebio ebio, ekiagera ere oyochandetwe ase omobere bweatananire korwa ase ebibe.
swahili: Kwa hiyo, kwa kuwa Kristo aliteswa katika mwili wake, ninyi nanyi jivikeni nia iyo hiyo kwa maana mtu aliyekwisha kuteswa katika mwili ameachana na dhambi.

english: As good stewards of the manifold grace of God, each of you should use whatever gift he has received to serve one another.
ekegusii: Mokorerane inwe ase inwe, kera oyomo nekeegwa eke anyorete, buna abarendi abaya b’obuya bwa Nyasae, obore ne chingencho chinyinge.
swahili: Kila mmoja na atumie kipawa chochote alichopewa kuwahudumia wengine, kama mawakili waaminifu wa neema mbalimbali za Mungu.

english: If anyone speaks, he should speak as one conveying the words of God. If anyone serves, he should serve with the strength God provides, so that in all things God may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom be the glory and the power forever and ever. Amen. Suffering as Christians
ekegusii: Omonto karakwane, tiga akwane amang’ana a Nyasae. Omonto karabe omokoreri, tiga akorere ne chinguru echio Nyasae amoeire, erinde Nyasae atogigwe ase amang’ana onsi goetera ase Yeso Kristo. Asare ere obonene na okobua kare na kare. Amina. Chandeka buna Omokristo
swahili: Yeyote asemaye hana budi kusema kama mtu asemaye maneno ya Mungu mwenyewe. Yeyote ahudumuye hana budi kuhudumu kwa nguvu zile anazopewa na Mungu, ili Mungu apate kutukuzwa katika mambo yote kwa njia ya Yesu Kristo. Utukufu na uweza una yeye milele na milele. Amen. Kuteseka Kwa Kuwa Mkristo

english: Beloved, do not be surprised at the fiery trial that has come upon you, as though something strange were happening to you.
ekegusii: Abanchani, timokumia ase obokong’u obore buna omorero, obwo bwabaikeire ase okobateema, buna namang’ana amageni abanyorire.
swahili: Wapenzi, msione ajabu kwa yale mateso yanayotukia miongoni mwenu, kana kwamba ni kitu kigeni kinachowapata.

english: But rejoice that you share in the sufferings of Christ, so that you may be overjoyed at the revelation of His glory.
ekegusii: Korende ekiagera mwabwatanire nemechando ya Kristo, goka, erinde ase okomaanorwa kw’obonene bwaye monyare kogoka boigo, na gochenga.
swahili: Bali furahini kuwa mnashiriki katika mateso ya Kristo, ili mpate kufurahi zaidi wakati utukufu wake utakapofunuliwa.

english: If you are insulted for the name of Christ, you are blessed, because the Spirit of glory and of God rests on you.
ekegusii: Komorachaywe ase engencho y’erieta ria Kristo, imosesenirie ekiagera Omoika bw’obonene noyo o Nyasae nigo oikaransete igoro yaino.
swahili: Kama mkitukanwa kwa ajili ya jina la Kristo, mmebarikiwa, kwa sababu Roho wa utukufu na wa Mungu anakaa juu yenu.

english: Indeed, none of you should suffer as a murderer or thief or wrongdoer, or even as a meddler.
ekegusii: Korende onde omo oino taba omoiti, gose omoibi, gose omokori amabe, gose oyokwerosia ase amang’ana ’abaanto bande, erinde abaise gochandwa.
swahili: Lakini asiwepo mtu yeyote miongoni mwenu anayeteswa kwa kuwa ni muuaji, au mwizi, au mhalifu wa aina yoyote, au anayejishughulisha na mambo ya watu wengine.

english: But if you suffer as a Christian, do not be ashamed, but glorify God that you bear that name.
ekegusii: Korende onye omonto ogochandwa ekiagera are Omokristo tarora obosooku, korende atogie Nyasae ase erieta eri.
swahili: Lakini kama ukiteseka kwa kuwa Mkristo, usihesabu jambo hilo kuwa ni aibu, bali mtukuze Mungu kwa sababu umeitwa kwa jina hilo.

english: For it is time for judgment to begin with the family of God; and if it begins with us, what will the outcome be for those who disobey the gospel of God?
ekegusii: Naki engaki yaikire ekiina gechakere ase enyomba ya Nyasae na gakerachake ase tore, omoerio obo abwo bataigwereti enchiri ya Nyasae, naki orabe?
swahili: Kwa maana wakati umewadia wa hukumu kuanzia katika nyumba ya Mungu. Basi kama ikianzia kwetu sisi, mwisho wa hao wasiotii Injili ya Mungu utakuwaje?

english: And, “If it is hard for the righteous to be saved, what will become of the ungodly and the sinner?”
ekegusii: Na, buna eriikire, “Onye ekoba aakong’u omonyene oboronge gotooreka, oria otamoirogeti Nyasae na omonyene ebibe, naki rende kerabe asare?”
swahili: Basi, “Ikiwa ni vigumu kwa mwenye haki kuokoka, itakuwaje kwa mtu asiyemcha Mungu na mwenye dhambi?”

english: So then, those who suffer according to God’s will should entrust their souls to their faithful Creator and continue to do good.
ekegusii: Ase ayio, abwo bagochandwa koreng’ana nogwancha kwa Nyasae, tiga bakore amaya na babeeke emioyo yabo asare ere oyore Omotongi omwegenwa.
swahili: Kwa hiyo, wale wanaoteswa kulingana na mapenzi ya Mungu, wajikabidhi kwa Muumba wao aliye mwaminifu, huku wakizidi kutenda mema.

english: Consequently, he does not live out his remaining time on earth for human passions, but for the will of God.
ekegusii: Korwa bono ase amatuko aya atigarete more moyo, timogenderera koreng’ana nokogania okobe kwa Mwanyabaanto, korende koreng’ana nogwancha kwa Nyasae.
swahili: Kwa hivyo, haishi maisha yake yaliyobaki ya kuishi hapa duniani kwa tamaa mbaya za wanadamu, bali anaishi kwa mapenzi ya Mungu.

english: For you have spent enough time in the past carrying out the same desires as the Gentiles: living in debauchery, lust, drunkenness, orgies, carousing, and detestable idolatry.
ekegusii: Naki engaki yaino eye yaetire yaisanire ase ogokora aya abanto b’Ebisaku banchete gokora. Igo mwagendererete ase obonyaka, na okogania okobe, na okonywa, na emeyega y’okoria bobe na gotinda, na mware gosasiima emegwekano, ogosasiima gotarenge okoronge.
swahili: Maana wakati uliopita mmekwisha kutumia muda wa kutosha katika maisha yenu mkifanya yale ambayo wapagani hupenda kutenda: wakiishi katika uasherati, tamaa mbaya, ulevi, karamu za ulafi, vileo, ngoma mbaya, na ibada chukizo za sanamu.

english: Because of this, they consider it strange of you not to plunge with them into the same flood of reckless indiscretion, and they heap abuse on you.
ekegusii: Ase ayio, barabwo nigo bakorora ng’a nay’ogokumia, ekiagera inwe motari koayerera amo nabarabwo gochia ase obonyaka botari nekerengo, na nigo bakobarama.
swahili: Wao hushangaa kwamba ninyi hamjiingizi pamoja nao katika huo wingi wa maisha ya ufisadi, nao huwatukana ninyi.

english: But they will have to give an account to Him who is ready to judge the living and the dead.
ekegusii: Korende barabwo nigo barache korua omobaro asare ere oyore ang’e kogambia abare moyo na abakuure.
swahili: Lakini itawapasa wao kutoa hesabu mbele zake yeye aliye tayari kuwahukumu walio hai na waliokufa.

english: That is why the gospel was preached even to those who are now dead, so that they might be judged as men in the flesh, but live according to God in the spirit.
ekegusii: Nakio kiagerete abakuure bakaranderigwa enchiri, erinde bagambigwe ase omobere koreng’ana buna Mwanyabaanto bakogambigwa, na babe moyo ase omoika, koreng’ana buna Nyasae are moyo.
swahili: Kwa kuwa hii ndiyo sababu Injili ilihubiriwa hata kwa wale waliokufa, ili wahukumiwe sawasawa na wanadamu wengine katika mwili, lakini katika roho waishi kulingana na Mungu aishivyo.

english: The end of all things is near. Therefore be clear-minded and sober, so that you can pray.
ekegusii: Bono omoerio bw’amang’ana onsi oikire ang’e. Ase ayio, mobe nobong’aini na kwerita ase ogosaba.
swahili: Mwisho wa mambo yote umekaribia. Kwa hiyo kuweni na akili tulivu na kiasi, mkikesha katika kuomba.

english: Above all, love one another deeply, because love covers over a multitude of sins.
ekegusii: Kobua ase onsi mobe nomokia ase ogwanchana, ekiagera obwanchani nigo bogotuba obonge bw’ebibe.
swahili: Zaidi ya yote, dumuni katika upendo kwa maana upendo husitiri wingi wa dhambi.

english: Show hospitality to one another without complaining.
ekegusii: Mobe abamokoroisania inwe ase inwe motari kwemurungania.
swahili: Kuweni wakarimu kila mtu na mwenzake pasipo manungʼuniko.

english: As a fellow elder, a witness of Christ’s sufferings, and a partaker of the glory to be revealed, I appeal to the elders among you:
ekegusii: Nasoroire abagaaka abare ase egati yaino, inche buna omogaka omogisangio obo, na kirori bw’ogochandwa gwa Kristo, na omobwatani bw’obonene boria borache koorokigwa:
swahili: Kwa wazee waliomo miongoni mwenu, nawasihi mimi nikiwa mzee mwenzenu, shahidi wa mateso ya Kristo, na mshiriki katika utukufu utakaofunuliwa:

english: And after you have suffered for a little while, the God of all grace, who has called you to His eternal glory in Christ, will Himself restore you, secure you, strengthen you, and establish you.
ekegusii: Na Nyasae bw’obuya bwonsi, oyo obarangeirie mosoe ase obonene bwaye bwa kare na kare ase Kristo, komwaikire gochandwa ase ekero egeke, ere omonyene nabaroisie, na abakong’ie, ababeeke chinguru na kobabeeka ase oboroso obuya.
swahili: Nanyi mkiisha kuteswa kwa kitambo kidogo, Mungu wa neema yote, aliyewaita kuingia katika utukufu wake wa milele ndani ya Kristo, yeye mwenyewe atawarejesha na kuwatia nguvu, akiwaimarisha na kuwathibitisha.

english: To Him be the power forever and ever. Amen.
ekegusii: Okobua nokwaye goika kare na kare. Amina. Amakwania ’ogokoorera
swahili: Uweza una yeye milele na milele. Amen. Salamu Za Mwisho

english: Through Silvanus, whom I regard as a faithful brother, I have written to you briefly, encouraging you and testifying that this is the true grace of God. Stand firm in it.
ekegusii: Ase okoboko gwa Silivano, oyominto omwegenwa buna ndoche, nabarikeire ase amang’ana amake, kobasorora na koorokia ng’a obo nabwo obuya bw’ekeene bwa Nyasae. Tenena bokong’u ase obwo.
swahili: Kwa msaada wa Silvano, ambaye ninamhesabu kuwa ndugu mwaminifu, nimewaandikia waraka huu mfupi ili kuwatia moyo, na kushuhudia kwamba hii ni neema halisi ya Mungu. Simameni imara katika neema hiyo.

english: The church in Babylon, chosen together with you, sends you greetings, as does my son Mark.
ekegusii: Ekanisa ya Babiloni eyachorirwe amo nainwe yabakwanirie. Nonya Mariko, omwana one, obakwanirie.
swahili: Kanisa lililoko Babeli, lililochaguliwa pamoja nanyi, wanawasalimu; vivyo hivyo mwanangu Marko anawasalimu.

english: Greet one another with a kiss of love. Peace to all of you who are in Christ.
ekegusii: Kwanania ase okonyunyuntana ase obwanchani. Omorembe obe amo nainwe mwensi, abamore ase Kristo Yeso.
swahili: Salimianeni kwa busu la upendo. Amani iwe nanyi nyote mlio katika Kristo.

english: Be shepherds of God’s flock that is among you, watching over them not out of compulsion, but because it is God’s will; not out of greed, but out of eagerness;
ekegusii: Risia riicho ria Nyasae eriabekirwe ase more, tari ase okobetererigwa korende ase ogwancha buna Nyasae anchete, tari ase okonyora kw’oborianania, korende ase omoyo bw’okwerwa.
swahili: lichungeni kundi la Mungu mlilokabidhiwa, mkitumika kama waangalizi, si kwa kulazimishwa bali kwa hiari, kama Mungu anavyowataka mwe; si kwa tamaa ya fedha, bali mlio na bidii katika kutumika.

english: not lording it over those entrusted to you, but being examples to the flock.
ekegusii: Timoba abagwekora abanene igoro ase abwo mwaeirwe, korende mobe ekiorokererio ekiya ase riicho riria.
swahili: Msijifanye mabwana juu ya wale walio chini ya uangalizi wenu, bali kuweni vielelezo kwa hilo kundi.

english: And when the Chief Shepherd appears, you will receive the crown of glory that will never fade away. Cast Your Cares on Him
ekegusii: Na Omorisia omonene karaoroke namonyore egutwa y’obonene etari gosareka.
swahili: Naye Mchungaji Mkuu atakapodhihirishwa, mtapokea taji ya utukufu isiyoharibika.

english: Young men, in the same way, submit yourselves to your elders. And all of you, clothe yourselves with humility toward one another, because, “God opposes the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”
ekegusii: Naboigo nainwe abamore abake, mwebeke inse ase abagaaka. Na inwe mwensi eboyie oboitongo buna orokini, monyare gokorerana, ekiagera nigo eriikire, “Nyasae nigo akwanga abare abaenenu, korende abare abaitongo nigo akobaa obuya.”
swahili: Vivyo hivyo, ninyi mlio vijana watiini wazee. Nanyi nyote imewapasa kujivika unyenyekevu kila mtu kwa mwenzake, kwa kuwa, “Mungu huwapinga wenye kiburi, lakini huwapa wanyenyekevu neema.”

english: Humble yourselves, therefore, under God’s mighty hand, so that in due time He may exalt you.
ekegusii: Ase ayio, ekeyie inse y’okoboko kwa Nyasae okore nokobua, erinde ere abaimokererie igoro ase ekero kiaye.
swahili: Basi, nyenyekeeni chini ya mkono wa Mungu ulio hodari, ili awakweze kwa wakati wake.

english: Cast all your anxiety on Him, because He cares for you.
ekegusii: Motweke ogwechanda kwaino gwonsi, ekiagera ere nigo agwechanda mono ase engencho yaino.
swahili: Mtwikeni yeye fadhaa zenu zote, kwa maana yeye hujishughulisha sana na mambo yenu.

english: Be sober-minded and alert. Your adversary the devil prowls around like a roaring lion, seeking someone to devour.
ekegusii: Mobe aberiti na korenda! Naki omosoeri oino Saitani nigo agoetanana na koruma buna endo ekoruma, ekorigia omonto erie.
swahili: Mwe na kiasi na kukesha, maana adui yenu ibilisi huzungukazunguka kama simba angurumaye akitafuta mtu ili apate kummeza.

english: Resist him, standing firm in your faith and in the knowledge that your brothers throughout the world are undergoing the same kinds of suffering. Benediction and Farewell
ekegusii: Mwange ere, na motenene bokong’u ase okwegena, momanye ng’a ogochandwa okwo okwo gwaikeranigwe ase abamino abare ase ense engima.
swahili: Mpingeni, mkiwa thabiti katika imani, mkijua ya kwamba mateso kama hayo yanawapata ndugu zenu pote duniani.

english: Then Samuel took a flask of oil, poured it on Saul’s head, kissed him, and said, “Has not the LORD anointed you ruler over His inheritance?
ekegusii: Erio Samweli akaimokia echuba y’amaguta, akaumorera Saulo ase omotwe, akamonyunyunta, akamoteebia: “Omonene ogoakire amaguta obe omotang’ani bw’Abaisraeli, Abanto baye. Aye nogaambere Abanto ba Omonene na kobatooria korwa ase amaboko ’ababisa babo baabaetanaine. Eke nakio kerabe ekemanyererio asore ng’a Omonene ogoakire amaguta ng’a obe omotang’ani igoro ase Abanto bare omwando oye:
swahili: Ndipo Samweli akachukua chupa ndogo ya mafuta na kuyamimina juu ya kichwa cha Sauli, akambusu, akisema, “Je, Bwana hakukutia mafuta uwe kiongozi juu ya watu wake Israeli?

english: When Saul and his servant arrived at Gibeah, a group of prophets met him. Then the Spirit of God rushed upon him, and he prophesied along with them.
ekegusii: Ekero Saulo amo nomosomba oye baigete Gibea, ekeombe ekenene ki’ababani gekaumerana nere. Omoika o Nyasae ogaacha igoro asare ne chinguru, nere agaachaka kobaboka ase okobana ase egati y’ababani baria.
swahili: Walipofika Gibea, akakutana na kundi la manabii. Roho wa Mungu akaja juu yake kwa nguvu, naye akajiunga nao katika kutoa unabii kwao.

english: All those who had formerly known Saul and saw him prophesying with the prophets asked one another, “What has happened to the son of Kish? Is Saul also among the prophets?”
ekegusii: Abanto bonsi abwo konya bamomanyete agwo ritang’ani, ekero bamorooche okobana amo nababani baria, bagakwana barabwo ase barabwo: “Mang’ana ki aya amonyorire omwana o Kisi? Inee! Saulo nere nabeire oyomo bw’ababani?”
swahili: Ikawa wale wote waliomfahamu hapo mwanzo walipomwona akitoa unabii pamoja na manabii, wakaulizana, “Ni nini hiki kilichomtokea mwana wa Kishi? Je, Sauli naye pia yumo miongoni mwa manabii?”

english: Then a man who lived there replied, “And who is their father?” So the saying became a proverb: “Is Saul also among the prophets?”
ekegusii: Omonto omenyete aase aria akabooria: “Ise nere ng’o?” Ase engencho eyio amang’ana akaba agokwanwa iga: “Inee! Saulo nere nabeire oyomo bw’ababani?”
swahili: Mtu mmoja ambaye aliishi huko akajibu, “Je, naye baba yao ni nani?” Basi ikawa mithali, kusema, “Je, Sauli pia yumo miongoni mwa manabii?”

english: And when Saul had finished prophesying, he went up to the high place.
ekegusii: Ekero Saulo akoorire kobaboka ase okobana, agatiira gochia ase ekegoro aase ebing’wanso biare koruerwa.
swahili: Baada ya Sauli kumaliza kutoa unabii, alikwenda mahali pa juu.

english: Now Saul’s uncle asked him and his servant, “Where did you go?” “To look for the donkeys,” Saul replied. “When we saw they were not to be found, we went to Samuel.”
ekegusii: Ise moke Saulo akabooria Saulo na omosomba oye: “Ng’ai mwachiete?” Saulo akairaneria: “Nechitigere twagendete korigia, na ekero totachinyorete, tokagenda ase Samweli.”
swahili: Basi babaye mdogo akamuuliza Sauli na mtumishi wake, “Je, mlikuwa wapi?” Akajibu, “Tulikuwa tukiwatafuta punda. Lakini tulipoona hawapatikani, tulikwenda kwa Samweli.”

english: “Tell me,” Saul’s uncle asked, “what did Samuel say to you?”
ekegusii: Ise moke akamoteebia: “Koranche onteebie aya Samweli abateebeetie.”
swahili: Babaye mdogo Sauli akasema, “Niambie Samweli amekuambia nini.”

english: And Saul replied, “He assured us that the donkeys had been found.” But Saul did not tell his uncle what Samuel had said about the kingship. Saul Proclaimed King
ekegusii: Saulo akamoiraneria: “Nigo atotebetie boronge ng’a chitigere chianyorekanire.” Korende amang’ana aya Samweli akwanete igoro y’oborwoti tamoyatebeetie. Saulo ogokwanigwa kabeire omorwoti
swahili: Sauli akajibu, “Alituhakikishia kwamba punda wamepatikana.” Lakini hakumwambia babaye mdogo kila kitu Samweli alichomwambia kuhusu ufalme.

english: After this, Samuel summoned the people to the LORD at Mizpah
ekegusii: Erio Samweli akarangeria Abaisraeli basangererekane amo ase obosio bw’Omonene agwo Misipa,
swahili: Samweli akawaita watu wa Israeli kuja kwa Bwana huko Mispa,

english: and said to the Israelites, “This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘I brought Israel up out of Egypt, and I rescued you from the hands of the Egyptians and of all the kingdoms that oppressed you.’
ekegusii: akabateebia: “Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, oteebire iga: Inche nigo nabang’anyetie korwa Misiri, nkabatooria korwa ase amaboko y’Abanto b’amarwoti ande onsi, abwo baarenge kobachaanda.
swahili: naye akawaambia, “Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli: ‘Niliwatoa Israeli kutoka Misri, nami niliwaokoa toka nguvu za Misri na falme zote zilizowaonea.’

english: But today you have rejected your God, who saves you from all your troubles and afflictions, and you have said to Him, ‘No, set a king over us.’ Now therefore present yourselves before the LORD by your tribes and clans.”
ekegusii: Korende bono mwangire Nyasae oino oria obatooretie korwa ase obokong’u bwonsi na ogochandwa, mwateebire ng’a: tobeekere omorwoti atogambere. Gaki bono sangererekana ase obosio bw’Omonene, egesaku ase egesaku, na eamate ase eamate.”
swahili: Lakini sasa mmemkataa Mungu wenu, ambaye anawaokoa toka katika maafa yenu yote na taabu zenu zote. Nanyi mmesema, ‘Hapana, tuteulie mfalme atutawale.’ Sasa basi, jihudhurisheni wenyewe mbele za Bwana kwa kabila zenu na kwa koo zenu.”

english: When you leave me today, you will find two men at Rachel’s tomb in Zelzah on the border of Benjamin. They will say to you, ‘The donkeys you seek have been found, and now your father has stopped worrying about the donkeys and started worrying about you, asking, “What should I do about my son?”’
ekegusii: Ekero okorua aa ase ’nde reero noumerane n’abanto babere ang’e nembeera ya Raeli, ase orogongo rwa Benjamini ase Selisa. Barabwo nigo baragoteebie ng’a chitigere chiria mwagendete korigia chiatokire. Iso otigire gochichandekera, na bono naye achaandekerete, ogoteeba: Naki ndakore indore omwana one?
swahili: Utakapoondoka kwangu leo, utakutana na watu wawili karibu na kaburi la Raheli, huko Selsa kwenye mpaka wa Benyamini. Watakuambia, ‘Punda wale uliotoka kwenda kuwatafuta, wamekwisha kupatikana. Sasa baba yako ameacha kufikiri kuhusu punda na sasa ana hofu kukuhusu wewe. Anauliza, “Nitafanyaje kuhusu mwanangu?” ’

english: Thus Samuel had all the tribes of Israel come forward, and the tribe of Benjamin was selected.
ekegusii: Ase igo Samweli akarenta ebisaku bionsi bi’Abaisraeli ang’e, na egesaku gia Benjamini kegachorwa ase ogoakerwa obomera.
swahili: Samweli alipoyasogeza makabila yote ya Israeli, kabila la Benyamini likachaguliwa.

english: Then he had the tribe of Benjamin come forward by its clans, and the clan of Matri was selected. Finally, Saul son of Kish was selected. But when they looked for him, they could not find him.
ekegusii: Ekero arentire egesaku gia Benjamini ang’e, obomera bokagwera eamate ya Matiri, na ase eamate ya Matiri obomera bokagwera Saulo, omomura o Kisi, korende Abanto bagachia komorigia tibamonyora.
swahili: Kisha akalisogeza mbele kabila la Benyamini, ukoo kwa ukoo, nao ukoo wa Matri ukachaguliwa. Mwishoni Sauli mwana wa Kishi akachaguliwa. Lakini walipomtafuta, hakuonekana.

english: So again they inquired of the LORD, “Has the man come here yet?” And the LORD replied, “Behold, he has hidden himself among the baggage.”
ekegusii: Erio naende bakaboori’Omonene: “Inee! Omonto oyio nachete aa?” Omonene akairaneria: “Rigereria oyio bw’ebisete ase ebinto bikogachwa.”
swahili: Wakazidi kuuliza kwa Bwana, “Je, huyo mtu amekwisha kufika hapa?” Naye Bwana akasema, “Ndiyo, amejificha katikati ya mizigo.”

english: So they ran and brought Saul, and when he stood among the people, he was a head taller than any of the others.
ekegusii: Ase ayio bakaminyoka bakamorusia aroro, na ekero atenenete ase egati y’Abanto bamorooche ng’a naetanetie Abanto bande bonsi ase obotaambe bw’omotwe korwa amareko gochia igoro.
swahili: Wakakimbia na kumleta kutoka huko, naye aliposimama katikati ya watu, alikuwa mrefu kuliko watu wengine wote.

english: Samuel said to all the people, “Do you see the one the LORD has chosen? There is no one like him among all the people.” And all the people shouted, “Long live the king!”
ekegusii: Samweli agateebia Abanto bonsi: “Aiga morooche ere oyi’Omonene achorire. Monto onde tari aa ase egati y’Abanto aba bonsi omoreng’aine.” Erio Abanto bonsi bagaaka eriogi, bakaboora: “Omorwoti oyo achie kare!”
swahili: Samweli akawaambia watu wote, “Je, mnamwona mtu ambaye Bwana amemchagua? Hayupo aliye kama yeye miongoni mwa watu wote.” Ndipo watu wakapiga kelele, wakasema, “Mfalme na aishi maisha marefu.”

english: Then Samuel explained to the people the rights of kingship. He wrote them on a scroll and laid it up before the LORD. And Samuel sent all the people away, each to his own home.
ekegusii: Erio Samweli agateebia Abanto buna oborwoti bogwenerete kogaambwa, na akariika emeroberio eyio ase egetabu akayebeeka ase obosio bw’Omonene. Magega yayio Samweli akaa Abanto ribaga, kera oyomo agende inka bwoye.
swahili: Samweli akawaeleza watu madaraka ya ufalme. Akayaandika kwenye kitabu na kuweka mbele za Bwana. Kisha Samweli akawaruhusu watu, kila mmoja aende nyumbani kwake.

english: Saul also went to his home in Gibeah, and the men of valor whose hearts God had touched went with him.
ekegusii: Saulo nere akagenda nka bwoye aria Gibea. Abanto bande abanene, abwo Nyasae konya akwanire ne chinkoro chiabo, bakamotunyana.
swahili: Sauli pia akaenda nyumbani kwake huko Gibea, akisindikizwa na watu hodari ambao Mungu alikuwa amegusa mioyo yao.

english: But some worthless men said, “How can this man save us?” So they despised him and brought him no gifts; but Saul remained silent about it.
ekegusii: Korende Abanto bande abaarenge ababe bakaboora: “Naki oyo arakore atotoorie?” Barabwo bakamochaaya, tibamoirera biegwa binde. Korende ere akaba buna taigwete aya bakwanete.
swahili: Lakini baadhi ya watu wakorofi walisema, “Huyu mtu atawezaje kutuokoa?” Wakamdharau na wala hawakumletea zawadi. Lakini Sauli akanyamaza kimya.

english: Then you will go on from there until you come to the Oak of Tabor. Three men going up to God at Bethel will meet you there, one carrying three young goats, another carrying three loaves of bread, and another carrying a skin of wine.
ekegusii: Erio norueo, ogenderere orogendo, oike ase omote okorokwa Omoaruni ore agwo Tabori. Aroro agwo noumerane n’Abanto batato bagotiira gochia gosasiima Nyasae agwo Beteli. Oyomo obo nabe obwate chimanwa chie chimbori isato, na oyonde obogoretie emegati etato, na oyonde ekerandi keroisirie korwa ase risankwa kere nedivai.
swahili: “Kisha utakwenda mbele kutoka hapa mpaka uufikie mwaloni wa Tabori. Watu watatu wanaopanda kwa Mungu huko Betheli watakutana nawe hapo. Mmoja atakuwa amechukua wana-mbuzi watatu, mwingine mikate mitatu, na mwingine kiriba cha divai.

english: They will greet you and give you two loaves of bread, which you will accept from their hands.
ekegusii: Barabwo mbagokwanie, bakoe emegati ebere, noyianche, oyebogorie korwa ase amaboko abo.
swahili: Watakusalimu na kukupa mikate miwili, ambayo utaipokea kutoka kwao.

english: After that you will come to Gibeah of God, where the Philistines have an outpost. As you approach the city, you will meet a group of prophets coming down from the high place, preceded by harps, tambourines, flutes, and lyres, and they will be prophesying.
ekegusii: Magega y’ayio nogende gochia ekegoro kia Nyasae agwo Gibea, ase egetwori ki’Abafilisti kere. Agwo ase egesoero ki’omochie noumerane nekeombe ki’ababani bagotirimboka korwa ase ekegoro aase agwo ebing’wanso bikoruerwa, babe bakobugia amakano ne chikonu, na ebiroria, na amakano yebirigisa. Barabwo mbabe bakobaboka ase okobana.
swahili: “Baada ya hayo utakwenda Gibea ya Mungu, ambapo hapo kuna kambi ya Wafilisti. Unapokaribia mji utakutana na kundi la manabii wakiteremka kutoka mahali pa juu wakiwa na vinubi, matari, filimbi na zeze vikipigwa mbele yao, nao watakuwa wakitoa unabii.

english: Then the Spirit of the LORD will rush upon you, and you will prophesy with them; and you will be transformed into a different person.
ekegusii: Erio Omoika bw’Omonene noche igoro yao ne chinguru; naye nobaane amo nabarabwo, na oonchorwe obe kore ne chingencho ching’ao.
swahili: Roho wa Bwana atakuja juu yako kwa nguvu, nawe utatoa unabii pamoja nao; nawe utageuzwa kuwa mtu wa tofauti.

english: When these signs have come, do as the occasion demands, for God is with you.
