ekegusii: korende buna twancheirwe na Nyasae koba abatwegenirwe koegwa enchiri, nabo togokwana, tari ase okogwenera abanto, korende ase okogwenera Nyasae, oyokorenga chinkoro chiaito.
swahili: Kinyume chake, tulinena kama watu tuliokubaliwa na Mungu tukakabidhiwa Injili. Sisi hatujaribu kuwapendeza wanadamu bali kumpendeza Mungu, yeye ayachunguzaye mawazo ya ndani sana ya mioyo yetu.

english: As you know, we never used words of flattery or any pretext for greed. God is our witness!
ekegusii: Naki titwarenge namang’ana ay’okogwenera abanto, buna mwamanyire, gose ay’okobiserera obwegimeria. Nyasae nere kirori.
swahili: Kama mjuavyo, hatukuja kwenu kwa maneno ya kujipendekeza au maneno yasiyo ya kweli ili kuficha tamaa mbaya: Mungu ndiye shahidi yetu.

english: Nor did we seek praise from you or from anyone else, although as apostles of Christ we had authority to demand it.
ekegusii: Titwarigetie ogotogigwa korwa ase Mwanyabaanto, nonya nkorwa ase more, gose korwa ase abanto bande.
swahili: Wala hatukuwa tunatafuta sifa kutoka kwa wanadamu, wala kutoka kwenu au kwa mtu mwingine awaye yote. Kama mitume wa Kristo tungaliweza kuwa mzigo kwenu,

english: On the contrary, we were gentle among you, like a nursing mother caring for her children.
ekegusii: Buna abatomwa ba Kristo anga ntwabaritoerete, korende nigo tware abororo ase egati yaino, buna omokungu akorera abana baye.
swahili: lakini tulikuwa wapole katikati yenu, kama mama anayewatunza watoto wake wadogo.

english: We cared so deeply that we were delighted to share with you not only the gospel of God, but our own lives as well. That is how beloved you have become to us.
ekegusii: Naboigo naintwe tware namaiga amange ase more, tokaba nomogooko kobaa inwe, tari enchiri ya Nyasae yoka, korende nonya nobogima bwaito, ekiagera mwabeire abanchi baito.
swahili: Tuliwapenda sana kiasi kwamba tulifurahia kushirikiana nanyi, si Injili ya Mungu tu, bali hata maisha yetu, kwa sababu mlikuwa wa thamani mno kwetu.

english: Surely you recall, brothers, our labor and toil. We worked night and day so that we would not be a burden to anyone while we proclaimed to you the gospel of God.
ekegusii: Naki baminto, moinyorete emeremo yaito na obokong’u bwaito, ng’a ekero twabaranderetie enchiri ya Nyasae, tware gokora emeremo obotuko na omobaso, erinde titocha komoraarereria onde oino.
swahili: Ndugu zetu, mnakumbuka juhudi yetu na taabu yetu. Tulifanya kazi usiku na mchana, ili tusimlemee mtu yeyote wa kwenu wakati tulipokuwa tunawahubiria Injili ya Mungu.

english: So when we could bear it no longer, we were willing to be left on our own in Athens.
ekegusii: Ase ayio, ekero totanyarete koremereria kobua, togancha gotigara Atene intwe tweka.
swahili: Kwa hivyo tulipokuwa hatuwezi kuvumilia zaidi, tuliamua tubaki Athene peke yetu.

english: Night and day we pray most earnestly that we may see you face to face and supply what is lacking from your faith.
ekegusii: Obotuko na omobaso nigo tokona‐gosaba ng’a tororane nainwe amasio ase amasio, na koroisia ekebaremete ase okwegena kwaino.
swahili: Usiku na mchana tunaomba kwa bidii ili tupate kuwaona tena na kujaza kile kilichopungua katika imani yenu.

english: Now may our God and Father Himself, and our Lord Jesus, direct our way to you.
ekegusii: Bono Nyasae Tata oito omonyene, n’Omonene oito Yeso atotang’ane ase enchera yaito, toike seino.
swahili: Basi Mungu wetu na Baba yetu mwenyewe na Bwana wetu Yesu atengeneze njia ya sisi kuja kwenu.

english: And may the Lord cause you to increase and overflow with love for one another and for everyone else, just as our love for you overflows,
ekegusii: Omonene abakore momenteke na gokiina ase ogwanchana inwe ase inwe, na ase ogwancha abanto bonsi, buna intwe tobanchete inwe.
swahili: Bwana na auongeze upendo wenu na kuuzidisha kati yenu na kwa wengine wote, kama vile tulivyo na upendo mwingi kwenu.

english: so that He may establish your hearts in blamelessness and holiness before our God and Father at the coming of our Lord Jesus with all His saints. Amen.
ekegusii: Ase igo anyare gokong’ia chinkoro chiaino chibe chitari na komocha, ase obochenu ase obosio bwa Nyasae, Tata oito ekero ki’ogocha kw’Omonene oito Yeso Kristo amo nabachenu baaye bonsi.
swahili: Tunamwomba Mungu aimarishe mioyo yenu ili msiwe na lawama katika utakatifu mbele za Mungu wetu aliye Baba yetu wakati wa kuja kwake Bwana Yesu pamoja na watakatifu wote.

english: We sent Timothy, our brother and fellow worker for God in the gospel of Christ, to strengthen and encourage you in your faith,
ekegusii: Togatoma Timotheo oyominto, omokori emeremo amo na Nyasae ase okorandia enchiri ya Kristo, erinde abakong’ie na kobaremia ase okwegena kwaino,
swahili: Tukamtuma Timotheo ambaye ni ndugu yetu na mtumishi mwenzetu wa Mungu katika kuieneza Injili ya Kristo, aje kuwaimarisha na kuwatia moyo katika imani yenu,

english: so that none of you would be shaken by these trials. For you know that we are destined for this.
ekegusii: erio tatigerigwa nemechando eye. Naki inwe abanyene ’momanyete ng’a ase ayio nero torageire.
swahili: ili mtu yeyote asifadhaishwe na mateso haya. Mnajua vyema kwamba tumewekewa hayo mateso.

english: Indeed, when we were with you, we kept warning you that we would suffer persecution; and as you know, it has come to pass.
ekegusii: Naki ekero twarenge amo nainwe ntwatang’anete kobateebia ng’a ntonyore emechando, buna yabeete agwo, na inwe moyemanyete.
swahili: Kwa kweli, tulipokuwa pamoja nanyi tuliwaambia mara kwa mara kwamba tutateswa na imekuwa hivyo kama mjuavyo.

english: For this reason, when I could bear it no longer, I sent to find out about your faith, for fear that the tempter had somehow tempted you and caused our labor to be in vain. Timothy’s Encouraging Report
ekegusii: Naki ase engencho eyio, ekero ntanyarete koremereria kobua, ngatoma Timotheo, erinde inyare komanya okwegena kwaino. Noboire ng’a omoteemi oria obateemire inwe na emeremo yaito ebe eya bosa.
swahili: Kwa sababu hii nilipokuwa siwezi kuvumilia zaidi, nilimtuma mtu ili nipate habari za imani yenu. Niliogopa kwamba kwa njia fulani yule mjaribu asiwe amewajaribu, nasi tukawa tumejitaabisha bure. Taarifa Ya Timotheo Ya Kutia Moyo

english: But just now, Timothy has returned from his visit with the good news about your faith, your love, and the fond memories you have preserved, longing to see us just as we long to see you.
ekegusii: Korende bono ekero Timotheo achete ase tore korwa seino agatorentera amang’ana amaya igoro y’okwegena kwaino na obwanchani bwaino, na buna motoinyorete buya botambe. Naende agatoteebia ng’a more namaiga gotorora intwe, buna naintwe tore namaiga kobarora inwe.
swahili: Lakini sasa Timotheo ndiyo tu amerejea kwetu kutoka kwenu na ameleta habari njema kuhusu imani yenu na upendo wenu. Ametuambia kwamba siku zote mnatukumbuka kwa wema na kwamba mna shauku ya kutuona kama vile sisi tulivyo na shauku ya kuwaona ninyi.

english: For this reason, brothers, in all our distress and persecution, we have been reassured about you, because of your faith.
ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio, baminto, ase obokong’u bwaito, na emechando yaito, tokaremigwa ase okwegena kwaino.
swahili: Kwa hiyo, ndugu zetu, katika dhiki na mateso yetu yote tumefarijika kwa sababu ya imani yenu.

english: For now we can go on living, as long as you are standing firm in the Lord.
ekegusii: Naki bono nigo torabe moyo, komorabe moteneine bokong’u ase Omonene.
swahili: Sasa kwa kuwa hakika tunaishi, kwa kuwa ninyi mmesimama imara katika Bwana.

english: How can we adequately thank God for you in return for our great joy over you in His presence?
ekegusii: Nase nchera ki toranyare koiraneria Nyasae ng’a mbuya mono ase engencho yaino, ase omogooko bwonsi oyotokoigwa ase engencho yaino ase obosio bwa Nyasae oito?
swahili: Je, tutawezaje kumshukuru Mungu kiasi cha kutosha kwa ajili yenu, kutokana na furaha tuliyo nayo mbele za Mungu wetu kwa sababu yenu?

english: Finally, brothers, we ask and encourage you in the Lord Jesus to live in a way that is pleasing to God, just as you have received from us. This is how you already live, so you should do so all the more.
ekegusii: Omoerio, baminto, twababoririe na kobasorora ase Omonene Yeso ng’a buna mweorokereretie korwa ase tore nebagwenerete mogenderere kogwenera Nyasae. Buna inwe mogendererete, kora igo na komenteka.
swahili: Hatimaye, ndugu, tuliwaomba na kuwasihi katika Bwana Yesu kwamba, kama mlivyojifunza kutoka kwetu jinsi iwapasavyo kuishi ili kumpendeza Mungu, kama vile mnavyoishi, imewapasa mzidi sana kufanya hivyo.

english: And you are indeed showing this love to all the brothers throughout Macedonia. But we urge you, brothers, to excel more and more
ekegusii: Naki ekeene, nigo mwanchete abamino bonsi abare Makedonia yonsi. Korende twabasoroire, baminto, momente ayio mono kobua.
swahili: Nanyi kwa kweli mnawapenda ndugu wote katika Makedonia nzima. Lakini ndugu, tunawasihi mzidi sana kuwapenda.

english: and to aspire to live quietly, to attend to your own matters, and to work with your own hands, as we instructed you.
ekegusii: Naende kora omokia komenya ase obotoereru, na kwenaria ogokora kwaino, na gokora emeremo namaboko aino, buna twabachiigete.
swahili: Jitahidini kuishi maisha ya utulivu, kila mtu akijishughulisha na mambo yake mwenyewe na kufanya kazi kwa mikono yake, kama vile tulivyowaagiza,

english: Then you will behave properly toward outsiders, without being dependent on anyone. The Return of the Lord
ekegusii: Mogenderere buya, erinde monyore ogosika korwa ase abwo bare isiko, na timoba abamosemeretie gento korwa ase onde. Ogocha kw’Omonene
swahili: ili maisha yenu ya kila siku yajipatie heshima kutoka kwa watu walio nje, ili msimtegemee mtu yeyote. Kuja Kwake Bwana

english: Brothers, we do not want you to be uninformed about those who sleep in death, so that you will not grieve like the rest, who are without hope.
ekegusii: Korende baminto, titorigeti ng’a timomanya amang’ana igoro y’abwo bararire, mobaise goichanigwa buna abande abatari nogosemeria.
swahili: Lakini ndugu, hatutaki mkose kujua kuhusu wale waliolala mauti, ili msihuzunike kama watu wengine wasiokuwa na tumaini.

english: For since we believe that Jesus died and rose again, we also believe that God will bring with Jesus those who have fallen asleep in Him.
ekegusii: Naki onye twegenire ng’a Yeso nakwete, naende akaboka, naboigo nabwo bararire ase Yeso, Nyasae nabarente amo nere.
swahili: Kwa kuwa tunaamini kwamba Yesu alikufa na kufufuka, na kwa hivyo, Mungu kwa njia ya Yesu atawafufua pamoja naye wale waliolala mautini ndani yake.

english: By the word of the Lord, we declare to you that we who are alive and remain until the coming of the Lord will by no means precede those who have fallen asleep.
ekegusii: Naki aya twabatebirie ase ring’ana ri’Omonene, ng’a intwe abatore moyo, abatwatigaire goika ekero ki’ogocha kw’Omonene, titogotang’anera abwo baikire korara,
swahili: Kulingana na neno la Bwana mwenyewe, tunawaambia kwamba sisi ambao bado tuko hai, tuliobaki hadi kuja kwake Bwana, hakika hatutawatangulia waliolala mauti.

english: For the Lord Himself will descend from heaven with a loud command, with the voice of an archangel, and with the trumpet of God, and the dead in Christ will be the first to rise.
ekegusii: ekiagera Omonene omonyene naike korwa igoro neriogi rie ring’ana ri’ogochika amo neriogi ri’omomalaika omonene, na egeturi ki’egetureeri kia Nyasae. Na abwo bakwete ase Kristo nababooke ritang’ani.
swahili: Kwa maana Bwana mwenyewe atashuka kutoka mbinguni, akitoa amri kwa sauti kuu, pamoja na sauti ya malaika mkuu, na sauti ya tarumbeta ya Mungu. Nao waliokufa wakiwa katika Kristo watafufuka kwanza.

english: After that, we who are alive and remain will be caught up together with them in the clouds to meet the Lord in the air. And so we will always be with the Lord.
ekegusii: Erio magega y’ayio intwe, abatore moyo, abatwatigaire, inatobogorigwe amo nabarabwo gochia ase amare, erio torototere Omonene igoro gati. Nabo inatobe amo n’Omonene botambe.
swahili: Baada ya hilo sisi tulio hai, tuliosalia, tutanyakuliwa pamoja nao katika mawingu ili kumlaki Bwana hewani, hivyo tutakuwa pamoja na Bwana milele.

english: Therefore encourage one another with these words.
ekegusii: Ase ayio, remania inwe ase inwe ase amang’ana aya.
swahili: Kwa hiyo farijianeni kwa maneno haya.

english: For you know the instructions we gave you by the authority of the Lord Jesus.
ekegusii: Naki momanyete amachiiko ki twabaete korwa ase Omonene Yeso.
swahili: Kwa kuwa mnajua ni maagizo gani tuliyowapa kwa mamlaka ya Bwana Yesu.

english: For it is God’s will that you should be holy: You must abstain from sexual immorality;
ekegusii: Naki oko nakwo ogwancha kwa Nyasae, ng’a mobe abachenu, na mweatanane korwa ase obotomani.
swahili: Mapenzi ya Mungu ni kwamba ninyi mtakaswe, ili kwamba mjiepushe na zinaa,

english: each of you must know how to control his own body in holiness and honor,
ekegusii: Kera oyomo oino amanye buna akogambera omobere oye omonyene ase obochenu na ogosika,
swahili: ili kwamba kila mmoja wenu ajifunze kuutawala mwili wake mwenyewe katika utakatifu na heshima,

english: not in lustful passion like the Gentiles who do not know God;
ekegusii: tari ase okogania okobe buna abanto b’Ebisaku abatamomanyeti Nyasae.
swahili: si kwa tamaa mbaya kama watu wa Mataifa wasiomjua Mungu.

english: and no one should ever violate or exploit his brother in this regard, because the Lord will avenge all such acts, as we have already told you and solemnly warned you.
ekegusii: Bono onde tamochera oyomwabo na komong’aina ase ring’ana eri, ekiagera Omonene nere okorusia egesiomba ase aya onsi, buna twabamanyetie ritang’ani na kobakuurera bokong’u.
swahili: Katika jambo hili mtu asimkosee ndugu yake wala kumlaghai. Kwa kuwa Bwana ni mlipiza kisasi katika mambo haya yote, kama vile tulivyokwisha kuwaambia mapema na kuwaonya vikali.

english: For God has not called us to impurity, but to holiness.
ekegusii: Naki Nyasae tatorangereti tobe ase ogotacheneka, korende ase obochenu.
swahili: Kwa maana Mungu hakutuitia uchafu, bali utakatifu.

english: Anyone, then, who rejects this command does not reject man but God, the very One who gives you His Holy Spirit.
ekegusii: Ase ayio, ere oyobwangire aya, tangeti Mwanyabaanto, korende Nyasae, oyokobaa inwe Omoika oye Omochenu.
swahili: Kwa hiyo, mtu yeyote anayekataa mafundisho haya hamkatai mwanadamu, bali anamkataa Mungu anayewapa ninyi Roho wake Mtakatifu.

english: Now about brotherly love, you do not need anyone to write to you, because you yourselves have been taught by God to love one another.
ekegusii: Ase amang’ana y’obwanchani bw’obomino, tari nengencho ase more ng’a mbariikere, ekiagera inwe abanyene mworokererigwe na Nyasae, ng’a mwanchane inwe ase inwe.
swahili: Sasa kuhusu upendo wa ndugu hamna haja mtu yeyote kuwaandikia, kwa maana ninyi wenyewe mmefundishwa na Mungu kupendana.

english: Now about the times and seasons, brothers, we do not need to write to you.
ekegusii: Ase amang’ana ebiro ne chingaki, baminto, tari nengencho ase more ng’a mbariikere.
swahili: Basi, ndugu, kwa habari ya nyakati na majira hatuna haja ya kuwaandikia,

english: He died for us so that, whether we are awake or asleep, we may live together with Him.
ekegusii: oyokwete ase engencho yaito, erinde tobe moyo amo nere, kerabe tokorenda, gose tokorara chitoro.
swahili: Yeye alikufa kwa ajili yetu ili hata kama tuko macho au tumelala, tupate kuishi pamoja naye.

english: Therefore encourage and build one another up, just as you are already doing. Christian Living
ekegusii: Ase ayio, remania inwe ase inwe, na koagachana, kera omonto noyomwabo, buna mogokora. Ogosorora na ogokwania kw’ogokoorera
swahili: Kwa hiyo farijianeni na kujengana, kama vile mnavyofanya sasa. Maagizo Ya Mwisho, Salamu Na Kuwatakia Heri

english: But we ask you, brothers, to acknowledge those who work diligently among you, who preside over you in the Lord and give you instruction.
ekegusii: Korende baminto, twabasoroire inwe, mosike abwo bagokora emeremo emekong’u ase egati yaino, abwo bakobaraa ase Omonene na kobakuurera.
swahili: Sasa tunawaomba, ndugu, waheshimuni wale wanaofanya kazi kwa bidii miongoni mwenu, wale ambao wana mamlaka juu yenu katika Bwana na ambao wanawaonya.

english: In love, hold them in highest regard because of their work. Live in peace with one another.
ekegusii: Mobasike mono ase obwanchani, ase engencho y ’emeremo yabo. Mobe nomorembe inwe ase inwe.
swahili: Waheshimuni sana katika upendo kwa ajili ya kazi zao. Ishini kwa amani ninyi kwa ninyi.

english: And we urge you, brothers, to admonish the unruly, encourage the fainthearted, help the weak, and be patient with everyone.
ekegusii: Twabasoroire, baminto, mokuurere abwo bare aboro, moremie abwo berusirie moyo, mokonye abwo bare abareu, remereria nabaanto bonsi.
swahili: Nasi twawasihi, ndugu, waonyeni walio wavivu, watieni moyo waoga, wasaidieni wanyonge na kuwavumilia watu wote.

english: Make sure that no one repays evil for evil. Always pursue what is good for one another and for all people.
ekegusii: Rigereria ng’a onde taakana oyomwabo obobe ase obobe, korende botambe morigie gokorerana ayare amaya inwe ase inwe, na ase abanto bonsi.
swahili: Angalieni kuwa mtu asimlipe mwenzake maovu kwa maovu, bali siku zote tafuteni kutendeana mema ninyi kwa ninyi na kwa watu wote.

english: Rejoice at all times.
ekegusii: Goka botambe!
swahili: Furahini siku zote;

english: Pray without ceasing.
ekegusii: Saba motari gotiga!
swahili: ombeni bila kukoma;

english: Give thanks in every circumstance, for this is God’s will for you in Christ Jesus.
ekegusii: Iraneria ng’a mbuya mono ase amang’ana onsi! Naki oko nakwo ogwancha kwa Nyasae ase more ase Kristo Yeso.
swahili: shukuruni kwa kila jambo, kwa maana haya ndiyo mapenzi ya Mungu kwa ajili yenu katika Kristo Yesu.

english: Do not extinguish the Spirit.
ekegusii: Timorimia Omoika!
swahili: Msiuzime moto wa Roho Mtakatifu;

english: For you are fully aware that the Day of the Lord will come like a thief in the night.
ekegusii: Naki inwe abanyene mwamanyire buya kegima, ng’a rituko ri’Omonene nigo rirache buna omoibi agocha botuko.
swahili: kwa kuwa mnajua vyema kwamba siku ya Bwana itakuja kama mwizi ajapo usiku.

english: Do not treat prophecies with contempt,
ekegusii: Timochaaya obobani,
swahili: msiyadharau maneno ya unabii.

english: but test all things. Hold fast to what is good.
ekegusii: korende teema kera egento, bwata ekere ekiya,
swahili: Jaribuni kila kitu. Yashikeni yaliyo mema.

english: Abstain from every form of evil. Final Blessings and Instructions
ekegusii: na eatanane korwa ase obobe bwa kera engencho.
swahili: Jiepusheni na uovu wa kila namna.

english: Now may the God of peace Himself sanctify you completely, and may your entire spirit, soul, and body be kept blameless at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.
ekegusii: Nyasae omonyene omorembe abachene kegima, na inwe abanyene morendwe ase emeika, na emioyo, na emebere, na mobe motari na komocha ekero ki’ogocha kw’Omonene oito Yeso Kristo.
swahili: Mungu mwenyewe, Mungu wa amani, awatakase ninyi kabisa. Nanyi mhifadhiwe roho zenu, nafsi zenu na miili yenu, bila kuwa na lawama katika Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo.

english: The One who calls you is faithful, and He will do it.
ekegusii: Ere oyobarangeirie nomwegenwa, nakore ayio.
swahili: Yeye aliyewaita ni mwaminifu naye atafanya hayo.

english: Brothers, pray for us as well.
ekegusii: Baminto, motosabere!
swahili: Ndugu, tuombeeni.

english: Greet all the brothers with a holy kiss.
ekegusii: Nkwanerie abaminto bonsi ase okobanyunyunta ase obochenu.
swahili: Wasalimuni ndugu wote kwa busu takatifu.

english: I charge you before the Lord to have this letter read to all the brothers.
ekegusii: Nabatianirie ase Omonene, ng’a riruube eri risomwe ase abaminto bonsi.
swahili: Nawaagizeni mbele za Bwana mhakikishe kuwa ndugu wote wanasomewa barua hii.

english: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
ekegusii: Obuya bwo Omonene oito Yeso Kristo bobe amo nainwe.
swahili: Neema ya Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo iwe nanyi. Amen.

english: While people are saying, “Peace and security,” destruction will come upon them suddenly, like labor pains on a pregnant woman, and they will not escape.
ekegusii: Ekero abanto bagoteeba, “Ntore nomorembe na obotoereru”, erio nario ogosareka gokobaachera mobosokano buna obororo bw’okobina bokomoochera oyore morito, na tibakonyara gwetooria.
swahili: Wakati watu wanaposema, “Kuna amani na salama,” maangamizi huwajia ghafula, kama vile utungu umjiavyo mwanamke mwenye mimba; nao hakika hawatatoroka.

english: But you, brothers, are not in the darkness so that this day should overtake you like a thief.
ekegusii: Korende baminto, timori ase omosunte, goika rituko riria riche kobanyoora mobosokano buna omoibi,
swahili: Bali ninyi, ndugu, hampo gizani hata siku ile iwakute ghafula kama mwizi.

english: For you are all sons of the light and sons of the day; we do not belong to the night or to the darkness.
ekegusii: ekiagera inwe mwensi nabana b’oborabu, na abana b’omobaso. Intwe titori abobotuko, gose ab’omosunte.
swahili: Ninyi nyote ni wana wa nuru na wana wa mchana. Sisi si wana wa giza wala wa usiku.

english: So then, let us not sleep as the others do, but let us remain awake and sober.
ekegusii: Ase ayio titoraara chitoro buna abande bagokora, korende torende na kweriita.
swahili: Kwa hiyo basi, tusilale kama watu wengine walalavyo, bali tukeshe na kuwa na kiasi.

english: For those who sleep, sleep at night; and those who get drunk, get drunk at night.
ekegusii: Naki abwo bakorara chitoro nigo bakorara botuko, na abwo bagotinda nigo bagotinda botuko.
swahili: Kwa kuwa wote walalao hulala usiku na wale walewao hulewa usiku.

english: But since we belong to the day, let us be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love, and the helmet of our hope of salvation.
ekegusii: Korende intwe abatore ab’omobaso, tobe aberiiti, na tweboyie okwegena na obwanchani buna engobo y’ekioma ase ebikuba biaito, na ogosemeria kw’ogotooreka buna ekegogwa giaito gi’ekioma.
swahili: Lakini kwa kuwa sisi ni wana wa mchana, basi tuwe na kiasi, tukijivika imani na upendo kama dirii kifuani na tumaini letu la wokovu kama chapeo.

english: For God has not appointed us to suffer wrath, but to obtain salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ.
ekegusii: Ekiagera Nyasae tatoragerete endamwamu, korende agatoragera tonyore ogotooreka goetera ase Omonene oito Yeso Kristo,
swahili: Kwa maana Mungu hakutuita ili tupate ghadhabu bali tupate wokovu kwa njia ya Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo.

english: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the command of God our Savior and of Christ Jesus our hope,
ekegusii: Korwa ase Paulo, omotomwa o Kristo Yeso ase ogochika kwa Nyasae, Omotooria oito, na Kristo Yeso, ogosemeria gwaito,
swahili: Paulo, mtume wa Kristo Yesu kwa amri ya Mungu Mwokozi wetu na ya Kristo Yesu tumaini letu.

english: for the sexually immoral, for homosexuals, for slave traders and liars and perjurers, and for anyone else who is averse to sound teaching
ekegusii: ase abatomani, na abasacha abagwesaria ase abasacha, ase abakoiba abanto na kobaonia, ase abanyaborimo, na abakoria chimuma chi’oborimo. Na korir’abe ing’ana rinde rionsi ritabwataini nokworokereria kw’obogima,
swahili: kwa wazinzi na wahanithi, kwa wale wauzao watu, na kwa waongo na waapao kwa uongo, na kwa chochote kingine kilicho kinyume na mafundisho ya kweli,

english: that agrees with the glorious gospel of the blessed God, with which I have been entrusted. God’s Grace to Paul
ekegusii: koreng’ana nenchiri y’obonene bwa Nyasae, oyore ogosesenigwa okonene, eye inche negenirwe koyeraria. Ogoaka ng’a mbuya mono ase amaabera
swahili: ambayo yanakubaliana na Injili ya utukufu wa Mungu anayehimidiwa, ambayo mimi nimewekewa amana. Neema Ya Mungu Kwa Paulo

english: I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who has strengthened me, that He considered me faithful and appointed me to service.
ekegusii: Namoakeire Kristo Yeso, Omonene oito, oyombeegete chinguru, ng’a mbuya mono, ekiagera andoche ng’a nigo inde omwegenwa. Akambeeka ase obosomba bwaye,
swahili: Namshukuru Kristo Yesu Bwana wetu, aliyenitia nguvu, kwa sababu aliniona mwaminifu, akaniteua kwa kazi yake.

english: I was formerly a blasphemer, a persecutor, and a violent man; yet because I had acted in ignorance and unbelief, I was shown mercy.
ekegusii: nonya ritang’ani nareenge komorama na komochaanda, naboigo, nareenge omochege. Korende ere akandorera amaabera, ekiagera nakorete bo ase ogotamanya, na ase ogotegena,
swahili: Ingawa wakati fulani nilikuwa mwenye kukufuru, mtesaji na mwenye jeuri, lakini nilipata rehema kwa sababu nilitenda hivyo kwa kutojua na kutoamini kwangu.

english: And the grace of our Lord overflowed to me, along with the faith and love that are in Christ Jesus.
ekegusii: na obuya bwo Omonene oito bwamentekanire mono amo nokwegena na obwanchani ebire ime ase Kristo Yeso.
swahili: Neema ya Bwana wetu ilimiminwa juu yangu kwa wingi, ikiambatana na imani na upendo ulio katika Kristo Yesu.

english: This is a trustworthy saying, worthy of full acceptance: Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners, of whom I am the worst.
ekegusii: Ring’ana eri neri’ekeene, rigwenerete gwancherwa kegima, ng’a Kristo Yeso nigo achete ase ense gotooria abanyene ebibe, na ase abwo inche noyo bw’eritang’ani.
swahili: Msemo huu ni wa kweli na unaostahili kukubalika, usemao kwamba: Kristo Yesu alikuja ulimwenguni kuokoa wenye dhambi, ambao mimi ndiye niliye mbaya kuliko wote.

english: But for this very reason I was shown mercy, so that in me, the worst of sinners, Christ Jesus might display His perfect patience as an example to those who would believe in Him for eternal life.
ekegusii: Korende nkanyora amaabera ase engencho eyio, ng’a ase ’nde inche ritang’ani Yeso Kristo aorokie oboremereria bwaye bwonsi, erio imbe ekiorokererio ase abwo baraache komwegena ase okonyora obogima bwa kare na kare.
swahili: Lakini kwa sababu hiyo nilipata rehema, ili katika mimi, niliyekuwa mwenye dhambi kuliko wote, Kristo Yesu apate kuonyesha uvumilivu wake usio na kikomo, ili niwe kielelezo kwa wale watakaomwamini na wapate uzima wa milele.

english: Now to the King eternal, immortal, and invisible, the only God, be honor and glory forever and ever. Amen.
ekegusii: Ase Omorwoti o kare na kare, oyotakonyorekana nogosareka, oyotakororekana, nere Nyasae bweka, ase are ere ogosika na obonene kare na kare. Amina.
swahili: Basi Mfalme wa milele, asiye na mwisho, asiyeonekana, aliye Mungu pekee, apewe heshima na utukufu milele na milele. Amen.

english: Timothy, my child, I entrust you with this command in keeping with the previous prophecies about you, so that by them you may fight the good fight,
ekegusii: Timotheo, omwana one, ogochika oko nakoeire, koreng’ana namang’ana y’obobani akwanetwe igoro yao, erinde ase ayio orwane esegi ere engiya.
swahili: Mwanangu Timotheo, ninakupa agizo hili, kwa kadiri ya maneno ya unabii yaliyosemwa kukuhusu, ili kwa kuyafuata upate kupigana vita vizuri,

english: holding on to faith and a good conscience, which some have rejected and thereby shipwrecked their faith.
ekegusii: Obe nokwegena na enkoro etari gokogaambia, ebio abande babisereirie are, na ase amang’ana y’okwegena basirire.
swahili: ukiishikilia imani na dhamiri njema, ambazo wengine wamevikataa, na hivyo wakaangamia kwa habari ya imani yao.

english: To Timothy, my true child in the faith: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord. Correcting False Teachers (Titus 1:10–16)
ekegusii: gochia ase aye Timotheo, omwana one bori ase okwegena: Obuya na amaabera, na omorembe bikorwa ase Nyasae Tata, na ase Kristo Yeso, Omonene oito. Ogokuurera kw’ogweatanana korwa ase okworokereria kw’obong’ainereria
swahili: Kwa Timotheo, mwanangu halisi katika imani: Neema, rehema na amani itokayo kwa Mungu Baba na kwa Kristo Yesu Bwana wetu. Maonyo Dhidi Ya Walimu Wa Uongo

english: Among them are Hymenaeus and Alexander, whom I have handed over to Satan to be taught not to blaspheme.
ekegusii: Ase abwo mbareo Humenayo na Alekisanda, abwo nabaeire Saitani, erinde borokererigwe tibarama Nyasae.
swahili: Miongoni mwao wako Himenayo na Aleksanda, ambao nimemkabidhi Shetani ili wafundishwe wasije wakakufuru.

english: As I urged you on my departure to Macedonia, you should stay on at Ephesus to instruct certain men not to teach false doctrines
ekegusii: Buna nakoboretie ekero nare kogenda Makedonia, otigare Efeso, erinde okanie abande tiborokereria okworokereria konde okoao,
swahili: Kama nilivyokusihi wakati nilipokwenda Makedonia, endelea kubaki Efeso, ili kwamba upate kuwaagiza watu wasiendelee kufundisha mafundisho ya uongo

english: or devote themselves to myths and endless genealogies, which promote speculation rather than the stewardship of God’s work, which is by faith.
ekegusii: gose tibategerera emegano ao ao, gose ebinimboria bie chisokoro bitakoera. Ayio onsi nigo akorenta okoamererania, gose tari goikerania emeroberio ya Nyasae eyio emanyekanete ase okwegena.
swahili: wala wasitoe muda wao kwa hadithi za kubuniwa na orodha za majina ya vizazi visivyo na mwisho, ambazo huchochea mabishano badala ya mpango wa Mungu utokanao na imani.

english: The goal of our instruction is the love that comes from a pure heart, a clear conscience, and a sincere faith.
ekegusii: Bono ekerenga ki’ogochika oko nakio eke, ng’a babe nobwanehani bokorwa ase chinkoro chindabu, ne chinkoro chitari kobagaambia, na okwegena gotari nobong’ainereria.
swahili: Kusudi la maagizo haya ni upendo utokao katika moyo safi, dhamiri njema na imani ya kweli.

english: Some have strayed from these ways and turned aside to empty talk.
ekegusii: Abande bamochete ayio, batantanire na koonchokera ogokwana kwa bosa.
swahili: Watu wengine wamepotoka kutoka haya na kugeukia majadiliano yasiyo na maana kwa kuwa,

english: They want to be teachers of the law, but they do not understand what they are saying or that which they so confidently assert.
ekegusii: Naende nigo banchete koba aborokia b’amachiiko, korende tibamanyeti ayabagokwana, gose amang’ana aria bakomigereria ne chinguru.
swahili: wanataka kuwa walimu wa sheria, lakini hawajui mambo yale wanayosema wala hayo wanayoyatumainia kwa uthabiti.

english: Now we know that the law is good, if one uses it legitimately.
ekegusii: Twamanyire ng’a amachiiko namaya, onye omonto okoyakorera buna agwenerete gokorerwa,
swahili: Tunajua kwamba sheria ni njema ikiwa inatumika kwa halali kama ilivyokusudiwa.

english: We realize that law is not enacted for the righteous, but for the lawless and rebellious, for the ungodly and sinful, for the unholy and profane, for killers of father or mother, for murderers,
ekegusii: na omanyete ng’a amachiiko tabekiri ase omonto omooronge. Korende nigo abekire ase abasaria ba amachiiko, na abatari koigwera, ase abatari aba Nyasae, na abanyabibe, ase abatari abachenu, baria bare b’ense eye, ase abaiti abaise gose abang’ina, na abaiti bande,
swahili: Lakini tunajua ya kuwa sheria si kwa ajili ya wenye haki, bali kwa ajili ya wavunja sheria na waasi, kwa ajili ya wasiomcha Mungu na wenye dhambi, wasio watakatifu na wanaokufuru; kwa wale wawauao baba zao au mama zao, kwa wauaji,

english: First of all, then, I urge that petitions, prayers, intercessions, and thanksgiving be offered for everyone—
ekegusii: Gaaki, ritang’ani ase amang’ana onsi nabasoroire ng’a okoboria, na ogosaba, na okogaramera amo nokoiraneria Nyasae ng’a mbuya mono, bikoreke ase engencho y’abanto bonsi,
swahili: Awali ya yote, nasihi kwamba dua, sala, maombezi na shukrani zifanyike kwa ajili ya watu wote:

english: but with good deeds, as is proper for women who profess to worship God.
ekegusii: korende bakore ogokora okuya, buna egwenerete abakungu abakoorokia ng’a mbare ne chingeencho chi’obonyasae.
swahili: bali kwa matendo mazuri kama iwapasavyo wanawake wanaokiri kuwa wanamcha Mungu.

english: A woman must learn in quietness and full submissiveness.
ekegusii: Tiga omokungu eorokererie ase ogokira, na ase ogosika gwonsi.
swahili: Mwanamke na ajifunze kwa utulivu na kwa utiifu wote.

english: I do not permit a woman to teach or to exercise authority over a man; she is to remain quiet.
ekegusii: Ting’eti omokungu ribaga ri’okworokereria, gose kogaambera omosacha, korende nemogwenerete akire,
swahili: Simpi mwanamke ruhusa ya kufundisha au kuwa na mamlaka juu ya mwanaume. Mwanamke inampasa kukaa kimya.

english: For Adam was formed first, and then Eve.
ekegusii: ekiagera Adamu nere otongetwe ritang’ani, na magega yaye Hawa.
swahili: Kwa maana Adamu aliumbwa kwanza, kisha Eva.

english: And it was not Adam who was deceived, but the woman who was deceived and fell into transgression.
ekegusii: Na Adamu tang’ainetwe, korende nomokuungu ong’ainetwe, na igo akaba omomochi.
swahili: Wala si Adamu aliyedanganywa, bali ni mwanamke aliyedanganywa akawa mkosaji.

english: Women, however, will be saved through childbearing, if they continue in faith, love, and holiness, with self-control.
ekegusii: Korende omokungu natoorigwe goetera ase okoibora abana onye okogeenderera ase okwegena, na obwanchani, na obochenu amo nobweriiti.
swahili: Lakini mwanamke ataokolewa kwa kuzaa kwake, kama wakiendelea kudumu katika imani, upendo na utakatifu, pamoja na kuwa na kiasi.

english: for kings and all those in authority—so that we may lead tranquil and quiet lives in all godliness and dignity.
ekegusii: ase engencho y’abarwoti, na bonsi abaeire okobua, erinde tonyaare koba nobogima bw’oboitongo na obw’omorembe, na ase amang’ana onsi koba ne chingeencho chi’obonyasae, na echi’ogosikana.
swahili: kwa ajili ya wafalme na wale wote wenye mamlaka, ili tupate kuishi kwa amani na utulivu, katika uchaji wote wa Mungu na utakatifu.

english: This is good and pleasing in the sight of God our Savior,
ekegusii: Eri nerigiya, naende ndiancheire ase obosio bwa Nyasae, Omotooria oito,
swahili: Jambo hili ni jema, tena linapendeza machoni pa Mungu Mwokozi wetu,

english: who wants everyone to be saved and to come to the knowledge of the truth.
ekegusii: oyorigetie abanto bonsi batoorigwe, banyaare komanya onsi ayare ay’ekeene.
swahili: anayetaka watu wote waokolewe na wafikie kuijua kweli.

english: For there is one God, and there is one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus,
ekegusii: Inaki Nyasae noyoomo, na omobwatania gati ya Nyasae na Mwanyabaanto noyoomo, omonto oria Kristo Yeso
swahili: Kwa maana kuna Mungu mmoja na mpatanishi mmoja kati ya Mungu na wanadamu, yaani mwanadamu Kristo Yesu,

english: who gave Himself as a ransom for all—the testimony that was given at just the right time.
ekegusii: ere oyobweruete omonyene koba embooria ase engencho ya bonsi. Igoro y’ayio oborori borentwe ekero engaki yaye eraike.
swahili: aliyejitoa mwenyewe kuwa fidia kwa ajili ya wanadamu wote: jambo hili lilishuhudiwa kwa wakati wake ufaao.

english: For this reason I was appointed as a preacher, an apostle, and a faithful and true teacher of the Gentiles. I am telling the truth; I am not lying about anything.
ekegusii: Ase engencho y’ayio nkaragwa imbe omworokia, na omotomwa, erinde inyorokie abanto b’Ebisaku amang’ana y’okwegena na ekeene; nigo ngokwana ekeene, tindi gokwana oborimo.
swahili: Nami kwa kusudi hili nimewekwa niwe mhubiri na mtume (nasema kweli katika Kristo wala sisemi uongo), mwalimu wa watu wa Mataifa katika imani na kweli.

english: Therefore I want the men everywhere to pray, lifting up holy hands, without anger or dissension. Instructions to Women
ekegusii: Nigo nganetie abasacha basabe kera aase, bakoimokia amaboko amachenu, batari nendamwamu, gose na tang’u‐tang’u.
swahili: Nataka kila mahali wanaume wasali wakiinua mikono mitakatifu pasipo hasira wala kugombana.

english: Likewise, I want the women to adorn themselves with respectable apparel, with modesty, and with self-control, not with braided hair or gold or pearls or expensive clothes,
ekegusii: Naboigo nabakungu beboyie chianga chi’ogosika, babe aberiiti na abaya, tari abakomina chituukia, gose kobeeka etaabu ne chiruuru, gose chianga chie rigori rinene,
swahili: Vivyo hivyo nataka wanawake wajipambe kwa adabu na kwa heshima katika mavazi yanayostahili, si kwa kusuka nywele, kuvalia dhahabu, lulu au mavazi ya gharama kubwa,

english: This is a trustworthy saying: If anyone aspires to be an overseer, he desires a noble task.
ekegusii: Ring’ana eri neri’ekeene, onye omonto origetie koba omotang’ani bw’ekanisa, igo aganetie emeremo emiya.
swahili: Hili ni neno la kuaminiwa, kwamba mtu akitamani kazi ya uangalizi, atamani kazi nzuri.

english: Additionally, they must first be tested. Then, if they are above reproach, let them serve as deacons.
ekegusii: Barabwo boigo barengwe ritang’ani: onye bakonyorekana ng’a tibari ne chingeencho chimbe, erio baegwe emeremo y’obokonyi ase ekanisa.
swahili: Ni lazima wapimwe kwanza; kisha kama hakuna neno dhidi yao, basi na waruhusiwe kuhudumu kama mashemasi.

english: In the same way, the women must be dignified, not slanderers, but temperate and faithful in all things.
ekegusii: Naboigo nabakungu babo bateneine boronge ase ogokora okuya, tari abang’achi, babe aberiiti na abegenwa ase amang’ana onsi.
swahili: Vivyo hivyo, wake zao wawe wanawake wanaostahili heshima, wasio wasingiziaji, bali wawe na kiasi na waaminifu katika kila jambo.

english: A deacon must be the husband of but one wife, a good manager of his children and of his own household.
ekegusii: Omokonyi bw’ekanisa abe omonto ore nomokuungu oyomo, omanyete kogaambera abana baye buya, nenyomba yaye omonyene.
swahili: Shemasi awe mume wa mke mmoja na inampasa aweze kusimamia watoto wake na watu wa nyumbani mwake vyema.

english: For those who have served well as deacons acquire for themselves a high standing and great confidence in the faith that is in Christ Jesus. The Mystery of Godliness
ekegusii: Inaki abwo bagokora emeremo yabo y’obokonyi buya benyoreire amasikani na oboremu obonge ase okwegena kore ime ase Kristo Yeso. Obobisi bwe chingeencho chi’obonyasae
swahili: Wale ambao wamehudumu vyema katika huduma ya ushemasi hujipatia msimamo bora na ujasiri mkubwa katika imani yao ndani ya Kristo Yesu.

english: Although I hope to come to you soon, I am writing you these things
ekegusii: Nigo nakoriikeire amang’ana aya, inde nogosemeria ng’a ninchiche ase ore bwango.
swahili: Ingawa ninatarajia kuja kwako hivi karibuni, ninakuandikia maagizo haya sasa ili kwamba,

english: in case I am delayed, so that you will know how each one must conduct himself in God’s household, which is the church of the living God, the pillar and foundation of the truth.
ekegusii: Korende inse goteebana, erio omanye buna abanto bagwenerete kogeenderera ase enyomba ya Nyasae, ey’ere ekanisa ya Nyasae ore moyo, naende ere esiiro na oboroso ebire bi’ekeene.
swahili: kama nikikawia, utajua jinsi iwapasavyo watu kuenenda katika nyumba ya Mungu, ambayo ndiyo kanisa la Mungu aliye hai, lililo nguzo na msingi wa kweli.

english: By common confession, the mystery of godliness is great: He appeared in the flesh, was vindicated by the Spirit, was seen by angels, was proclaimed among the nations, was believed in throughout the world, was taken up in glory.
ekegusii: Naende ne ring’ana ritari koamereranigwa, ng’a obobisi bwe chingencho chi’obonyasae nobonene: Ere oyoorogetigwe ase omobere o Mwanyabaanto, akaorokigwa n’Omoika koba omonyene oboronge, akarorwa nabamalaika, akarandigwa ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku, akegenwa ase ense, naende akabogorigwa gochia igoro.
swahili: Bila shaka yoyote, siri ya utauwa ni kubwa: Alidhihirishwa katika mwili wa kibinadamu, akathibitishwa kuwa na haki katika Roho, akaonekana na malaika, akahubiriwa miongoni mwa mataifa, akaaminiwa ulimwenguni, akachukuliwa juu katika utukufu.

english: An overseer, then, must be above reproach, the husband of but one wife, temperate, self-controlled, respectable, hospitable, able to teach,
ekegusii: Omotang’ani bw’ekanisa nemogwenerete abe omonto otari gokwanwa bobe, omonto ore nomokuungu oyomo, omweriiti, na omwechiiki omwegaamberi ase onsi, abe, omooroisia abageni, na oy’omanyete kworokereria buya,
swahili: Basi, imempasa mwangalizi awe mtu asiye na lawama, mume wa mke mmoja, mwenye kiasi, anayejitawala, anayeheshimika, mkarimu, ajuaye kufundisha,

english: not dependent on wine, not violent but gentle, peaceable, and free of the love of money.
ekegusii: tari omonto onarete edivai, gose omonto bwanchete goaka abanto, abe omonto omoremereria, otari gwancha eriomana, gose otari omwegimeria.
swahili: asiwe mlevi, wala mkali bali awe mpole, asiwe mgomvi wala mpenda fedha.

english: An overseer must manage his own household well and keep his children under control, with complete dignity.
ekegusii: Naende nemogwenerete abe omonto omanyete kogambera enyomba yaye omonyene buya, na kworokereria abana baye baigwere ase ogosika gwonsi,
swahili: Lazima aweze kuisimamia nyumba yake mwenyewe vizuri na kuhakikisha kwamba watoto wake wanamtii na kuwa na heshima kwa kila njia.

english: For if someone does not know how to manage his own household, how can he care for the church of God?
ekegusii: ekiagera onye omonto tamanyeti gotenenera enyomba yaye omonyene, inaki aranyare korenda ekanisa ya Nyasae?
swahili: (Kwa maana kama mtu hajui jinsi ya kusimamia nyumba yake mwenyewe, atawezaje kuliangalia kanisa la Mungu?)

english: He must not be a recent convert, or he may become conceited and fall under the same condemnation as the devil.
ekegusii: Ere taaba omonto oonchoka reero iga, abaise goocha koenena na kogwa ase okogaambigwa gwa Saitani.
swahili: Asiwe mtu aliyeokoka karibuni asije akajivuna na kuangukia kwenye hukumu ile ile ya ibilisi.

english: Furthermore, he must have a good reputation with outsiders, so that he will not fall into disgrace and into the snare of the devil. Qualifications for Deacons (Acts 6:1–7)
ekegusii: Nagwenerete gwatorwa ng’a nomuya nabaanto bare isiko, erinde tabaisa kogwa ase ogosoerwa, na ase omoeto o Saitani. Buna abakoonyi b’ekanisa bagwenerete koba
swahili: Inampasa pia awe na sifa njema kwa watu walio nje, ili asije akalaumiwa na kuanguka kwenye mtego wa ibilisi. Sifa Za Mashemasi

english: Deacons likewise must be dignified, not double-tongued or given to much wine or greedy for money.
ekegusii: Naboigo nabakoonyi b’ekanisa babe abanto bateneneine boronge ase ogokora okuya, batari nemenwa ebere, abanto batari konywa edivai enyinge, abanto batari gwancha okonyora kw’oborianania.
swahili: Vivyo hivyo, mashemasi nao wawe watu wanaostahili heshima, wasiwe wenye kauli mbili au wenye kujifurahisha kwa mvinyo, wala wanaotamani faida isiyo halali.

english: They must hold to the mystery of the faith with a clear conscience.
ekegusii: Mbagwenerete babwate obobisi bw’okwegena ase chinkoro chitakobagaambia.
swahili: Inawapasa kushikamana sana na ile siri ya imani kwa dhamiri safi.

english: Now the Spirit expressly states that in later times some will abandon the faith to follow deceitful spirits and the teachings of demons,
ekegusii: Omoika okwanire ase amang’ana akoigweka boronge, ng’a ase ekero ki’omoerio abanto bande mbeatanane korwa ase okwegena ase okoigwera emeika y’obong’ainereria na amorokererio y’ebirecha,
swahili: Roho asema waziwazi kwamba katika siku za mwisho baadhi ya watu wataiacha imani na kufuata roho zidanganyazo na mafundisho ya mashetani.

english: To this end we labor and strive, because we have set our hope on the living God, who is the Savior of everyone, and especially of those who believe.
ekegusii: Inaki ase ring’ana erio nigo togokora emeremo ase ogwechaanda, ekiagera tomoseemeretie Nyasae ore moyo, ere oyore Omotooria bw’abaanto bonsi, mono abwo begenire.
swahili: (nasi kwa ajili ya hili tunajitaabisha na kujitahidi), kwamba tumeweka tumaini letu kwa Mungu aliye hai, ambaye ni Mwokozi wa watu wote, hasa wale waaminio.

english: Command and teach these things.
ekegusii: Obachiike na koboorokereria amang’ana ayio.
swahili: Mambo haya yaagize na kuyafundisha.

english: Let no one despise your youth, but set an example for the believers in speech, in conduct, in love, in faith, in purity.
ekegusii: Monto onde tagochaaya ekiagera ore omosae, korende obe ekiorokererio ekiya ase abwo begenire, ase ogokwana, na ase orogeendo, naende ase obwanchani, na okwegena, na obochenu.
swahili: Mtu yeyote asikudharau kwa kuwa wewe ni kijana, bali uwe kielelezo kizuri kwa waumini katika usemi, mwenendo, upendo, imani na usafi.

english: Until I come, devote yourself to the public reading of Scripture, to exhortation, and to teaching.
ekegusii: Goika nchiche, kora omokia ase ogosomera abanto amariiko, na gokuurera, na kworokereria.
swahili: Fanya bidii kusoma Maandiko hadharani, kuhubiri na kufundisha, mpaka nitakapokuja.

english: Do not neglect the gift that is in you, which was given you through the prophecy spoken over you at the laying on of the hands of the elders.
ekegusii: Totiga gokorera ekeegwa keria kwaetwe ase enchera y’obobani, ekero ekeombe ki’abagaaka giakobeekerete amaboko.
swahili: Usiache kutumia kipawa kilicho ndani yako, ambacho ulipewa kwa neno la unabii wakati wazee walikuwekea mikono.

english: Be diligent in these matters and absorbed in them, so that your progress will be evident to all.
ekegusii: Orengererie ayio, bwerue kegima ase ayio, erio okogeenderera kwao kobe maiso marore ase abanto bonsi.
swahili: Uwe na bidii katika mambo haya; ujitolee kwa ajili ya mambo haya kikamilifu, ili kila mtu aone kuendelea kwako.

english: Pay close attention to your life and to your teaching. Persevere in these things, for by so doing you will save both yourself and those who hear you.
ekegusii: Bwerende aye omonyene na okworokereria kwao, ogeenderere ase ayio, ekiagera korakore igo mbwetoorie aye omonyene amo n’abwo bakogotegerera.
swahili: Jilinde sana nafsi yako na mafundisho yako. Dumu katika hayo, kwa maana kwa kufanya hivyo, utajiokoa wewe mwenyewe pamoja na wale wanaokusikia.

english: influenced by the hypocrisy of liars, whose consciences are seared with a hot iron.
ekegusii: ase obong’ainereria bw’abaanto abanyaborimo, abwo chinkoro chiabo chiasambirwe, chitari koigwa kende.
swahili: Mafundisho kama hayo huja kupitia kwa waongo ambao ni wanafiki, hali dhamiri zao zikiungua kwa kuchomwa moto.

english: They will prohibit marriage and require abstinence from certain foods that God has created to be received with thanksgiving by those who believe and know the truth.
ekegusii: Barabwo nigo bagokaania abanto ng’a tibanyuomana, naende tibaria endagera eye Nyasae atongete, erinde baria begenire, na baikire komanya ekeene, bayenyore ase okoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono.
swahili: Wao huwakataza watu wasioe na kuwaagiza wajiepushe na vyakula fulani, ambavyo Mungu aliviumba ili vipokewe kwa shukrani na wale wanaoamini na kuijua kweli.

english: For every creation of God is good, and nothing that is received with thanksgiving should be rejected,
ekegusii: Kera egento egiatongetwe na Nyasae nekiya na tikegwenereti kwangwa, korende, nkegwenerete konyorwa amo nokoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono,
swahili: Kwa maana kila kitu alichokiumba Mungu ni chema, wala hakuna kitu chochote cha kukataliwa kama kikipokewa kwa shukrani,

english: because it is sanctified by the word of God and prayer. A Good Servant of Jesus Christ
ekegusii: ekiagera giachenirwe ne ring’ana ria Nyasae na ogosaba. Omosomba omuya o Kristo Yeso
swahili: kwa sababu kimetakaswa kwa neno la Mungu na kwa kuomba. Mtumishi Mwema Wa Yesu Kristo

english: By pointing out these things to the brothers, you will be a good servant of Christ Jesus, nourished by the words of faith and sound instruction that you have followed.
ekegusii: Koroorokererie abaminto ayio, nobe omosomba omuya o Kristo Yeso, obe oyokwerageria namang’ana y’okwegena na okworokererigwa okuya koria gwatunyanete.
swahili: Kama ukiwakumbusha ndugu mambo haya, utakuwa mtumishi mwema wa Kristo Yesu, uliyelelewa katika kweli ya imani na yale mafundisho mazuri uliyoyafuata.

english: But reject irreverent, silly myths. Instead, train yourself for godliness.
ekegusii: Korende bwange emegano etari ne chingencho chi’obonyasae eyio yanchire nabakungu abagotu. Bwenarie aye omonyene chingeencho chi’obonyasae.
swahili: Usijishughulishe kamwe na hadithi za kipagani na masimulizi ya uongo ya wanawake wazee; badala yake, jizoeze kuwa mtauwa.

english: For physical exercise is of limited value, but godliness is valuable in every way, holding promise for the present life and for the one to come.
ekegusii: Inaki okwenaria kw’omobere nokonyora ogoke, korende okwenaria gwe chingencho chi’obonyasae nokonyora ase amang’ana onsi, ekiagera nkore neira ase obogima bwa bono, na ase boria bogochia‐gocha.
swahili: Kwa maana mazoezi ya mwili yana faida kwa sehemu, lakini utauwa una faida katika mambo yote, yaani, unayo ahadi ya uzima wa sasa na ya ule ujao.

english: This is a trustworthy saying, worthy of full acceptance.
ekegusii: Ring’ana eri neri’ekeene, rigwenerete gwancherwa kegima.
swahili: Hili ni neno la kuaminiwa tena lastahili kukubaliwa kabisa,

english: Do not rebuke an older man, but appeal to him as to a father. Treat younger men as brothers,
ekegusii: Totogonyera omogaka, korende omosorore buna iso, abamura abake buna bamura bamino,
swahili: Usimkemee mzee kwa ukali bali umshawishi kama vile angekuwa ni baba yako. Uwatendee vijana kama vile ndugu zako;

english: and well known for good deeds such as bringing up children, entertaining strangers, washing the feet of the saints, imparting relief to the afflicted, and devoting herself to every good work.
ekegusii: Nemogwenerete gwatorwa ng’a nare nogokora okuya, buna oyo okinirie abana, oroisirie abageni, osibirie abachenu amagoro, okoonyire abachaandegete, na bweruete omonyene ase kera ogokora okuya.
swahili: awe ameshuhudiwa kwa matendo yake mema, aliyewalea watoto wake vizuri, aliye mkarimu, aliyewanawisha watakatifu miguu, aliyewasaidia wenye shida na aliyejitolea kwa ajili ya matendo mema ya kila namna.

english: But refuse to enroll younger widows. For when their passions draw them away from Christ, they will want to marry,
ekegusii: Korende toriika abatakanwa batari nemiaka emenge, ekiagera ekero baranyore ebirengererio ebire ao na Kristo, nigo baraganie konyuomwa.
swahili: Lakini kwa habari za wajane vijana usiwaweke kwenye orodha hiyo, maana tamaa zao za kimaumbile zikizidi kule kujitoa kwao kwa Kristo, watataka kuolewa tena.

english: and thus will incur judgment because they are setting aside their first faith.
ekegusii: Barabwo nabagaambigwe, ekiagera baatigire eira yabo ye ritang’ani.
swahili: Nao kwa njia hiyo watajiletea hukumu kwa kukiuka ahadi yao ya kwanza.

english: At the same time they will also learn to be idle, going from house to house and being not only idle, but also gossips and busybodies, discussing things they should not mention.
ekegusii: Amo nayio beorokereirie koba aboro, bagoetanana enyomba ase enyomba; tibari aboro rioka, korende nabatora‐toria, bakwerosia namang’ana y’abanto bande, bagokwana amang’ana atagwenereti.
swahili: Zaidi ya hayo, wajane kama hao huwa na tabia ya uvivu wakizurura nyumba kwa nyumba, wala hawawi wavivu tu, bali pia huwa wasengenyaji, wajiingizao katika mambo yasiyowahusu na kusema mambo yasiyowapasa kusema.

english: So I advise the younger widows to marry, have children, and manage their households, denying the adversary occasion for slander.
ekegusii: Ase igo, nanchire abatakanwa batari nemiaka emenge banyuomwe, baibore abana, barende chiinka chiabo, na tibaa moengereria onde ribaga ri’ogokwana bobe igoro ase tore.
swahili: Hivyo nawashauri wajane vijana waolewe, wazae watoto na wasimamie nyumba zao, wasije wakampa adui nafasi ya kutushutumu.

english: For some have already turned aside to follow Satan.
ekegusii: Inaki abaande bairanire magega, na gotunyana Saitani.
swahili: Kwa maana kwa kweli wajane wengine wamepotoka ili kumfuata Shetani.

english: If any believing woman has dependent widows, she must assist them and not allow the church to be burdened, so that it can help the widows who are truly in need. Honoring Elders
ekegusii: Onye omosacha gose omokungu, oyobwegenete, ore nabatakaanwa bamwabo, tiga abakoonye, ekanisa terarerigwa, erinde ebakonye baria bare abatakanwa bori.
swahili: Lakini kama mwanamke yeyote aaminiye ana wajane katika jamaa yake, inampasa awasaidie wala si kuwaacha wakililemea kanisa, ili kanisa liweze kuwasaidia wale ambao ni wajane kweli kweli. Wazee Wa Kanisa

english: Elders who lead effectively are worthy of double honor, especially those who work hard at preaching and teaching.
ekegusii: Abagaaka abakogaamba buya baabarerwe ng’a mbagwenerete amasikani ara kabere, kobua mono abwo bagokora emeremo y’okorandia na kworokereria.
swahili: Wazee wa kanisa wanaoongoza shughuli za kanisa vizuri wanastahili heshima mara mbili, hasa wale ambao kazi yao ni kuhubiri na kufundisha.

english: For the Scripture says, “Do not muzzle an ox while it is treading out the grain,” and, “The worker is worthy of his wages.”
ekegusii: Inaki amariiko nigo agoteeba, “Tobaisa kobekera entang’ana ekeokio ekero ekoora endaagera”, na “Omokori emeremo nagwenerete koegwa eng’eria yaye.”
swahili: Kwa maana Maandiko husema, “Usimfunge maksai kinywa apurapo nafaka,” tena, “Mfanyakazi anastahili mshahara wake.”

english: Do not entertain an accusation against an elder, except on the testimony of two or three witnesses.
ekegusii: Tibwancha ogosoerwa igoro y’omogaka otatiga, ase amang’ana y’abarori babere gose batato.
swahili: Usiendekeze mashtaka dhidi ya mzee isipokuwa yawe yameletwa na mashahidi wawili au watatu.

english: older women as mothers, and younger women as sisters, with absolute purity. Honoring True Widows (Ruth 1:1–5)
ekegusii: abakungu abagotu buna abaanyoko, na abakungu abasubati buna basubati bamino, ase obochenu bwonsi.
swahili: nao wanawake wazee uwatendee kama mama zako, na wanawake vijana kama dada zako, katika usafi wote.

english: But those who persist in sin should be rebuked in front of everyone, so that the others will stand in fear of sin. A Charge to Timothy
ekegusii: Abwo bagokora ebibe, obatogonyere ase amasio y’abanto bonsi, erinde abaande bairoke.
swahili: Wale wanaodumu katika dhambi uwakemee hadharani, ili wengine wapate kuogopa.

english: I solemnly charge you before God and Christ Jesus and the elect angels to maintain these principles without bias, and to do nothing out of partiality.
ekegusii: Nagochiikire ase obosio bwa Nyasae, na obwa Kristo Yeso, na obw’abamalaika abachoore, obwate amang’ana ayio, na tonacha ring’ana ritang’ani otaramanya buna rire; tokora ing’ana rinde rionsi ase ogwanchereria.
swahili: Ninakuagiza mbele za Mungu na mbele za Kristo Yesu na mbele za malaika wateule, shika maagizo haya pasipo ubaguzi wala upendeleo.

english: Do not be too quick in the laying on of hands and thereby share in the sins of others. Keep yourself pure.
ekegusii: Tobekera omonto amaboko bwango, gose tosanga nebibe bi’abaanto bande. Bwerende aye omonyene, obe omochenu.
swahili: Usiwe na haraka kumwekea mtu mikono wala usishiriki dhambi za watu wengine. Jilinde nafsi yako uwe safi.

english: Stop drinking only water and use a little wine instead, because of your stomach and your frequent ailments.
ekegusii: Korwa bono tonywa amaache oka, korende onywe edivai nke, ase engencho y’enda yao na amarwaire agokonyora ekero ase ekero.
swahili: Acha kunywa maji peke yake, tumia divai kidogo kwa sababu ya tumbo lako na maumivu yako ya mara kwa mara.

english: The sins of some men are obvious, going ahead of them to judgment; but the sins of others do not surface until later.
ekegusii: Ebibe bi’abaanto baande nigo bire maiso marore, biatang’anire gochia ase ekiina, korende ebi’abaande nigo bikobatunyana korwa magega.
swahili: Dhambi za watu wengine ni dhahiri nazo zinawatangulia kwenda hukumuni; na dhambi za watu wengine zinawafuata nyuma yao.

english: In the same way, good deeds are obvious, and even the ones that are inconspicuous cannot remain hidden.
ekegusii: Naboigo, ogokora okuya nigo kore maiso marore, na koria gotari maiso marore tigokogenderera kobisekana.
swahili: Vivyo hivyo, matendo mema yako dhahiri, na hata yale ambayo si mema hayawezi kufichika.

english: Honor the widows who are truly widows.
ekegusii: Osike abatakanwa abare abataakanwa bori.
swahili: Waheshimu wanawake wajane ambao ni wajane kweli kweli.

english: But if a widow has children or grandchildren, they must first learn to show godliness to their own family and repay their parents, for this is pleasing in the sight of God.
ekegusii: Korende onye omotakaanwa ore nabana gose abaachokoro, tiga beorokererie ritang’ani ayabagwenerete bakorere abamwabo abanyene, na koiraneria abaibori babo ng’a mbuya mono ase ebi banyorire, ekiagera ring’ana eri ndiancheire ase obosio bwa Nyasae.
swahili: Kama mjane ana watoto ama wajukuu, hawa inawapasa awali ya yote wajifunze kutimiza wajibu wao wa kumcha Mungu katika matendo kwa kuwatunza wale wa jamaa zao wenyewe, na hivyo wawarudishie wema waliowatendea wazazi wao, kwa kuwa hivi ndivyo impendezavyo Mungu.

english: The widow who is truly in need and left all alone puts her hope in God and continues night and day in her petitions and prayers.
ekegusii: Oyore omotaakanwa bori, na otigire bweka, oyo nigo amosemeretie Nyasae, na kogeenderera ase okoboria na ogosaba obotuko na omobaso.
swahili: Mwanamke ambaye ni mjane kweli kweli, yaani, yeye aliyebaki peke yake huweka tumaini lake kwa Mungu naye hudumu katika maombi usiku na mchana akimwomba Mungu ili amsaidie.

english: But she who lives for pleasure is dead even while she is still alive.
ekegusii: Korende ere, oy’otari gwetanga ase okogania kwaye, okuure nonya ore moyo.
swahili: Lakini mjane aishiye kwa anasa amekufa, ingawa anaishi.

english: Give these instructions to the believers, so that they will be above reproach.
ekegusii: Obachiike ayio, erinde babe batari na komocha.
swahili: Wape watu maagizo haya pia, ili asiwepo yeyote wa kulaumiwa.

english: If anyone does not provide for his own, and especially his own household, he has denied the faith and is worse than an unbeliever.
ekegusii: Onye omonto takoreenda abare abamwabo, mono baria be enyomba yaye, okaanire okwegena, naende nomobe kobua oy’otegeneti.
swahili: Kama mtu hawatunzi wale wa jamaa yake, hasa wale wa nyumbani mwake mwenyewe, ameikana imani, tena ni mbaya kuliko yeye asiyeamini.

english: A widow should be enrolled if she is at least sixty years old, the wife of one man,
ekegusii: Omotakaanwa anyare koriikwa onye okoorire emiaka emerongo etano nomo, naende onye orenge omokungu bw’omosaacha oyoomo.
swahili: Mjane yeyote asiwekwe kwenye orodha ya wajane isipokuwa awe ametimiza umri wa miaka sitini, na ambaye alikuwa mke wa mume mmoja,

english: All who are under the yoke of slavery should regard their masters as fully worthy of honor, so that God’s name and our teaching will not be discredited.
ekegusii: Bonsi abare inse y’obosibwa bw’obosomba baabare abanene babo ng’a mbagwenerete ogosika gwonsi, erinde erieta ria Nyasae tiriramwa, gose okworokereria gwaito.
swahili: Wale wote walio chini ya kongwa la utumwa inawapasa kuwahesabu mabwana zao kuwa wanastahili heshima yote, ili jina la Mungu lisitukanwe wala mafundisho yetu.

english: For the love of money is the root of all kinds of evil. By craving it, some have wandered away from the faith and pierced themselves with many sorrows. Fight the Good Fight
ekegusii: Inaki omochakano bw’amabe onsi nogwancha chibeesa. Abaande kobakogania ayio, nigo bakweatanana korwa ase okwegena, na kwebeeka abanyene ase obororo obonge. Esegi engiya y’okwegena
swahili: Kwa maana kupenda fedha ndiyo shina moja la maovu ya kila namna. Baadhi ya watu wakitamani fedha, wameiacha imani na kujichoma wenyewe kwa maumivu mengi. Vitu Vizuri Vya Imani

english: But you, O man of God, flee from these things and pursue righteousness, godliness, faith, love, perseverance, and gentleness.
ekegusii: Korende aye, omonto o Nyasae, tama ayio onsi, rigia oboronge, ne chingeencho chi’obonyasae, na okwegena, na obwanchani, na oboremereria na obwororo.
swahili: Lakini wewe, mtu wa Mungu, yakimbie mambo haya yote. Fuata haki, utauwa, imani, upendo, saburi na upole.

english: Fight the good fight of the faith. Take hold of the eternal life to which you were called when you made the good confession before many witnesses.
ekegusii: Rwana esegi ere engiya y’okwegena, bwata obogima bwa kare na kare, obo kwarangereretigwe konyora, na kwaorogetie ase okoorokia okuya ase obosio bw’abarori abange.
swahili: Pigana vile vita vizuri vya imani. Shika uzima wa milele ambao ndio ulioitiwa ulipokiri ule ukiri mzuri mbele ya mashahidi wengi.

english: I charge you in the presence of God, who gives life to all things, and of Christ Jesus, who made the good confession in His testimony before Pontius Pilate:
ekegusii: Nagochiikire ase obosio bwa Nyasae, oyokoa ebinto bionsi obogima, na ase Kristo Yeso, oyoruete oborori obuya ase Pontio Pilato,
swahili: Nakuagiza mbele za Mungu avipaye vitu vyote uhai, na mbele za Kristo Yesu ambaye alipokuwa anashuhudia mbele ya Pontio Pilato alikiri ukiri mzuri,

english: Keep this commandment without stain or reproach until the appearance of our Lord Jesus Christ,
ekegusii: ng’a obwate ogochika oko, obe oy’otari na kemoa, gose na komocha, goika Omonene oito Yeso Kristo aorokigwe.
swahili: uishike amri hii bila dosari wala lawama mpaka kuja kwake Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo,

english: which the blessed and only Sovereign One—the King of kings and Lord of lords—will bring about in His own time.
ekegusii: Oyosesenirie, oyore nokobua ere bweka, Omorwoti bw’abarwoti, Omonene bw’abanene, oraache gotworokia okoorokigwa okwo ase ekero kiaye.
swahili: ambaye Mungu atamleta kwa wakati wake mwenyewe: yeye ahimidiwaye, aliye peke yake Mtawala, Mfalme wa wafalme, na Bwana wa mabwana,

english: He alone is immortal and dwells in unapproachable light. No one has ever seen Him, nor can anyone see Him. To Him be honor and eternal dominion! Amen. A Charge to the Rich (Proverbs 23:1–5; James 5:1–6)
ekegusii: Nere bweka otari konyorekana namakweri, nigo amenyete ase omobaso otanyaare goikwa ang’e, na onde tari ase Mwanyabaanto omorooche gose oranyare komorora. Asare ere ogosika na okobua kare na kare. Amina.
swahili: yeye peke yake ambaye hapatikani na mauti, na anakaa katika nuru isiyoweza kukaribiwa, ambaye hakuna mwanadamu aliyemwona wala awezaye kumwona. Heshima na uweza una yeye milele. Amen.

english: Instruct those who are rich in the present age not to be conceited and not to put their hope in the uncertainty of wealth, but in God, who richly provides all things for us to enjoy.
ekegusii: Obachiike abwo bare abanda ase ense eye ya bono tibaenena, gose gosemeria obonda boria bogosira, korende bamosemerie Nyasae, oyogotoa ebinto bionsi ase obonge, tobikorere ase omogooko.
swahili: Waagize wale ambao ni matajiri wa ulimwengu huu waache kujivuna, wala wasiweke tumaini lao katika mali ambayo si ya hakika, bali waweke tumaini lao katika Mungu ambaye hutupatia vitu vyote kwa wingi ili tuvifurahie.

english: Instruct them to do good, to be rich in good works, and to be generous and ready to share,
ekegusii: Obachiike naende bakore amaya, babe abanda ase ogokora okuya, babe ang’e korua chinibo chiabo, na gwatanera abaande ase emioyo emiya,
swahili: Waagize watende mema, wawe matajiri katika matendo mema, pia wawe wakarimu na walio tayari kushiriki mali zao na wengine.

english: treasuring up for themselves a firm foundation for the future, so that they may take hold of that which is truly life. Guard the Faith
ekegusii: beagacheire abanyene oboroso obuya ase ekero kegochia-gocha erinde babwate obogima obore obogima bw’ekeene.
swahili: Kwa njia hii watajiwekea hazina kama msingi kwa ajili ya wakati ujao na hivyo watajipatia uzima, yaani, ule uzima ambao ni wa kweli. Maelekezo Ya Binafsi Na Maombi Ya Baraka

english: Those who have believing masters should not show disrespect because they are brothers, but should serve them all the more, since those receiving their good service are beloved believers. Teach and encourage these principles. Reject False Doctrines
ekegusii: Na baria bare nabanene abegeni tibaabachaaya ekiagera nabamwabo bare, korende baabakorere buya kobua, ekiagera abwo bakoreirwe emeremo emiya nigo bare abegeni na abanchwa. Bworokererie amang’ana aya, na gokuurera. Chingencho chi’obonyasae amo nogoisaneka
swahili: Wale watumwa ambao wana mabwana waaminio, haiwapasi kupunguza heshima yao kwa sababu wao ni ndugu. Badala yake, wawatumikie hata vizuri zaidi, kwa sababu wale wanaonufaika na huduma yao ni waaminio, ambao ni wapenzi wao. Fundisha mambo haya na uwahimize kuyafuata. Mafundisho Ya Uongo Na Utajiri Wa Kweli

english: O Timothy, guard what has been entrusted to you. Avoid irreverent, empty chatter and the opposing arguments of so-called “knowledge,”
ekegusii: Aye Timotheo, renda aya abekirwe ase ore. Bweatanane korwa ase amang’ana atari ne chingeencho chi’obonyasae, na korwa ase okoamererania ase aya akorokwa chisemi, korende nay’oborimo.
swahili: Timotheo, linda kile kilichowekwa amana kwako. Epuka majadiliano yasiyo ya utauwa na mabishano ambayo kwa uongo huitwa elimu,

english: which some have professed and thus swerved away from the faith. Grace be with you all.
ekegusii: Inaki abaande babwatirie ayio, na basirire korwa ase okwegena. Obuya bobe amo nainwe mwensi.
swahili: ambayo wengine kwa kujidai kuwa nayo wameiacha imani. Neema iwe nanyi. Amen.

english: If anyone teaches another doctrine and disagrees with the sound words of our Lord Jesus Christ and with godly teaching,
ekegusii: Onye omonto okworokereria konde okoao, na tabwataini namang’ana a Omonene oito Yeso Kristo, ayare y’obogima, na okworokereria kobwataine ne chingeencho chi’obonyasae,
swahili: Ikiwa mtu yeyote atafundisha mafundisho mapotovu wala hakubaliani na mafundisho manyofu ya Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo na yale ya utauwa,

english: he is conceited and understands nothing. Instead, he has an unhealthy interest in controversies and semantics, out of which come envy, strife, abusive talk, evil suspicions,
ekegusii: ere oenenire, na tamanyeti ing’ana rinde rionsi. Ere nigo are omonto ore noborwaire bw’omoyo ase amaborio na okoamererania kw’amang’ana. Ase amang’ana aya nigo bikorwao emoko, na eriomana, na oborami, na ogokagera okobe,
swahili: huyo amejivuna wala hajui kitu chochote. Yeye amejaa tamaa ya mabishano na ugomvi kuhusu maneno ambavyo matokeo yake ni wivu na mapigano, maneno ya ukorofi, shuku mbaya,

english: and constant friction between men of depraved mind who are devoid of the truth. These men regard godliness as a means of gain. Godliness with Contentment
ekegusii: na okoamererania gotari konucha ase egati y’abanto abasarekire ase ebirengererio biabo, na baurirwe ekeene. Baria bagokaga ng’a okoba ne chingencho chi’obonyasae nenchera y’okonyora.
swahili: na kuzozana kusikokoma kati ya watu walioharibika akili zao, walioikosa kweli, na ambao hudhani kwamba utauwa ni njia ya kupata faida.

english: Of course, godliness with contentment is great gain.
ekegusii: Ekeene, okoba ne chingencho chi’obonyasae amo nogoisaneka nokonyora okonene,
swahili: Lakini utauwa na kuridhika ni faida kubwa.

english: For we brought nothing into the world, so we cannot carry anything out of it.
ekegusii: inaki titwachete na gento ase ense, naende titokoira gento korwa ase ense.
swahili: Kwa kuwa hatukuja humu duniani na kitu chochote, wala hatuwezi kutoka humu na kitu.

english: But if we have food and clothing, we will be content with these.
ekegusii: Gaaki, onye tore nendagera ne chianga, inatoisaneke n’ebinto ebio.
swahili: Lakini kama tuna chakula na mavazi, tutaridhika navyo.

english: Those who want to be rich, however, fall into temptation and become ensnared by many foolish and harmful desires that plunge them into ruin and destruction.
ekegusii: Korende abwo barigetie koba abanda nigo bakogwa ase ogoteemwa na omoeto, na okogania okonge gotari nengeencho, kore okw’ogosaria, okwo gokorimeria Mwanyabaanto bachie gosira na gosareka.
swahili: Lakini wale watu wanaotamani kuwa na mali kwa haraka huanguka kwenye majaribu, na wamenaswa na tamaa nyingi za kipumbavu zenye kudhuru, zinazowazamisha watu katika uharibifu na maangamizi.

english: Then Rehoboam went to Shechem, for all Israel had gone there to make him king.
ekegusii: Rehoboamu akagenda Sekemu, ekiagera Abaisraeli bonsi konya bachiire aroro komobeka abe omorwoti.
swahili: Rehoboamu akaenda Shekemu, kwa kuwa Waisraeli wote walikuwa wamekwenda huko kumfanya yeye kuwa mfalme.

english: The young men who had grown up with him replied, “This is how you should answer these people who said to you, ‘Your father made our yoke heavy, but you should make it lighter.’ This is what you should tell them: ‘My little finger is thicker than my father’s waist!
ekegusii: Abamura baria b’ekegori kiaye bakamoteebia, “Aya naro orateebie abanto abwo bakoboretie ng’a bwororobie rikorogoto riria iso akorete ririto: Ekiara gi’okoboko kwane nigo kere ekenetu kobua ekebono gia tata
swahili: Wale vijana wa rika lake wakamjibu, “Waambie watu hawa waliokuambia, ‘Baba yako aliweka nira nzito juu yetu, lakini ifanye nira yetu nyepesi,’ kuwa, ‘Kidole changu kidogo ni kinene kuliko kiuno cha baba yangu.

english: Whereas my father burdened you with a heavy yoke, I will add to your yoke. Whereas my father scourged you with whips, I will scourge you with scorpions.’”
ekegusii: Na bono rikorogoto riria rikong’u tata ababeekerete, inche nigo ndarimente ribe ririto goetania. Tata nigo arenge kobang’wania ebiranya, korende inche nigo ndabang’wanie ne chinkini chichomire chibonyi chinyoge chinga amagwa.”
swahili: Baba yangu aliweka nira nzito juu yenu, mimi nitaifanya hata iwe nzito zaidi. Baba yangu aliwachapa kwa mijeledi; mimi nitawachapa kwa nge.’ ”

english: After three days, Jeroboam and all the people returned to Rehoboam, since the king had said, “Come back to me on the third day.”
ekegusii: Yeroboamu amo nabaanto bonsi bagacha ase Rehoboamu omorwoti rituko ria gatato buna abateebeetie bakore.
swahili: Siku tatu baadaye, Yeroboamu na watu wote wakamrudia Rehoboamu, kama mfalme alivyokuwa amesema, “Rudini kwangu baada ya siku tatu.”

english: And the king answered them harshly. King Rehoboam rejected the advice of the elders
ekegusii: Omorwoti akabairaneria amang’ana amatindi akaanga ogosemia kw’abagaaka baria.
swahili: Mfalme akawajibu watu kwa ukatili. Akikataa shauri alilopewa na wazee,

english: and spoke to them as the young men had advised, saying, “Whereas my father made your yoke heavy, I will add to your yoke. Whereas my father scourged you with whips, I will scourge you with scorpions.”
ekegusii: Agakwana nabarabwo buna abamura baria bamosemetie, agateeba, “Tata nigo akorete rikorogoto riaino rikaba ririto, korende inche nimbamentere ribe ririto goetania. Tata nigo arenge kobang’wania ebiranya, korende inche nigo ndabang’wanie ne chinkini chichomire chibonyi chinyoge chinga amagwa.”
swahili: akafuata shauri la vijana wa rika lake na kusema, “Baba yangu alifanya nira yenu kuwa nzito, mimi nitaifanya kuwa nzito zaidi. Baba yangu aliwachapa kwa mijeledi, mimi nitawachapa kwa nge.”

english: So the king did not listen to the people, and indeed this turn of events was from God, in order that the LORD might fulfill the word that He had spoken through Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam son of Nebat. The Kingdom Divided (1 Kings 12:16–19)
ekegusii: Ase ayio omorwoti taigwerete amang’ana ’abaanto. Ayio nigo akorekanete na Nyasae, erinde Omonene anyare goikerania ring’ana riria akwanete ase Yeroboamu, mosinto o Nebati, goetera ase Ahiya, omobani oria korwa Silo.
swahili: Kwa hiyo mfalme hakuwasikiliza watu, kwa kuwa jambo hili lilitoka kwa Mungu ili kutimiza neno ambalo Bwana alikuwa amenena kwa Yeroboamu mwana wa Nebati kupitia Ahiya Mshiloni.

english: When all Israel saw that the king had refused to listen to them, they answered the king: “What portion do we have in David, and what inheritance in the son of Jesse? To your tents, O Israel! Look now to your own house, O David!” So all the Israelites went home,
ekegusii: Ekero Abaisraeli bonsi baroche ng’a omorwoti nigo angete kobaigwera, bakamoiraneria, bagateeba, “Ngetari ki intwe tobwate ase Daudi? Titori nomwando na mosinto o Yese. Inwe Abaisraeli, genda kera omonto bwoye! Inwe abanto ba Daudi, erende inwe abanyene!” Ase igo Abaisraeli bonsi bakarua aroro agwo, bakagenda ase chinka chiabo.
swahili: Israeli wote walipoona kuwa mfalme amekataa kuwasikiliza, wakamjibu mfalme: “Tuna fungu gani kwa Daudi? Sisi hatuna urithi kwa mwana wa Yese. Nendeni kwenye mahema yenu, ee Israeli, angalia nyumba yako mwenyewe, ee Daudi!” Hivyo Waisraeli wakaenda kwenye mahema yao.

english: but Rehoboam still reigned over the Israelites living in the cities of Judah.
ekegusii: Rehoboamu agatigwa okogambera Abaisraeli baria bamenyete ase emechie y’Abayuda boka.
swahili: Lakini kwa habari ya Waisraeli waliokuwa wakiishi katika miji ya Yuda, Rehoboamu akaendelea kuwatawala bado.

english: Then King Rehoboam sent out Hadoram, who was in charge of the forced labor, but the Israelites stoned him to death. And King Rehoboam mounted his chariot in haste and escaped to Jerusalem.
ekegusii: Erio omorwoti Rehoboamu agatoma Hadoramu, oria otenenerete emeremo y’okobetererigwa, korende Abaisraeli bakamoaka amagena agakwa. Na Rehoboamu akaimoka bwango, akariina egari yaye, agatama gochia Yerusalemu.
swahili: Mfalme Rehoboamu akamtuma Adoniramu aliyekuwa msimamizi wa wale waliofanya kazi ngumu kwa kulazimishwa, lakini Israeli wote wakampiga kwa mawe hadi akafa. Hata hivyo, Mfalme Rehoboamu, akafanikiwa kuingia kwenye gari lake na kutorokea Yerusalemu.

english: So to this day Israel has been in rebellion against the house of David.
ekegusii: Ase ayio Abaisraeli babeire bakwanga koigwera enyomba ya Daudi, goika reero iga.
swahili: Hivyo Israeli wakaasi dhidi ya nyumba ya Daudi hadi leo.

english: When Jeroboam son of Nebat heard about this, he returned from Egypt, where he had fled from King Solomon.
ekegusii: Na ekero Yeroboamu, mosinto o Nebati, aigwete amang’ana ayio, akairana korwa Misiri aaria ase atamete gochia kwebisa korwa ase omorwoti Sulemani.
swahili: Yeroboamu mwana wa Nebati aliposikia hili (alikuwa bado yuko Misri alikokuwa amekimbilia awe mbali na Mfalme Solomoni), akarudi kutoka Misri.

english: So they sent for Jeroboam, and he and all Israel came to Rehoboam and said,
ekegusii: Abanto bakarangeria Yeroboamu; ere amo n’Abaisraeli bonsi bakagenda, bagakwana na Rehoboamu, bakamoteebia,
swahili: Kwa hiyo wakatuma watu kumwita Yeroboamu, yeye na kusanyiko lote la Israeli wakamwendea Rehoboamu na kumwambia,

english: “Your father put a heavy yoke on us. But now you should lighten the burden of your father’s service and the heavy yoke he put on us, and we will serve you.”
ekegusii: “Iso nigo akorete rikorogoto riaito rikaba ririto. Ase ayio bono aye orikore ribe rigusu, bwororobie emeremo eria emekong’u iso atobekerete, naintwe ntogokorere.”
swahili: “Baba yako aliweka nira nzito, lakini sasa tupunguzie kazi za kikatili na nira nzito aliyoweka juu yetu, nasi tutakutumikia.”

english: Rehoboam answered, “Come back to me in three days.” So the people departed.
ekegusii: Rehoboamu akabateebia, “Genda moirane aa ase ’nde naende magega y’amatuko atato.” Ase ayio bakagenda.
swahili: Rehoboamu akajibu, “Nendeni kwa muda wa siku tatu na kisha mnirudie.” Basi watu wakaenda zao.

english: Then King Rehoboam consulted with the elders who had served his father Solomon during his lifetime. “How do you advise me to respond to these people?” he asked.
ekegusii: Erio omorwoti Rehoboamu akaboria ogosemigwa korwa ase abagaaka baria barenge gosemia Sulemani ise, ekero arenge moyo, akababoria, “Ngosemia ki morang’e erinde ing’iranerie abanto aba?”
swahili: Kisha Mfalme Rehoboamu akataka shauri kwa wazee ambao walimtumikia Solomoni baba yake wakati wa uhai wake akawauliza, “Mnanishauri nini katika kuwajibu watu hawa?”

english: They replied, “If you will be kind to these people and please them by speaking kind words to them, they will be your servants forever.”
ekegusii: Abagaaka baria bakamoiraneria, “Korabe omwororo ase abanto aba na kobagwenera, naende okwane amang’ana amaya ase bare, barabwo nababe bakogokorera botambe.”
swahili: Wakajibu, “Kama leo utakuwa mtumishi wa watu hawa na kuwahudumia na kuwapa jibu linaloridhisha, watakuwa watumishi wako daima.”

english: But Rehoboam rejected the advice of the elders; instead, he consulted the young men who had grown up with him and served him.
ekegusii: Korende Rehoboamu akaanga ogosemia kw’abagaaka baria, akarigia ogosemigwa korwa ase abamura b’ekegori kiaye, abwo barenge komokorera.
swahili: Lakini Rehoboamu akakataa shauri alilopewa na wazee na akataka ushauri kwa vijana wanaume rika lake waliokuwa wakimtumikia.

english: He asked them, “What message do you advise that we send back to these people who have spoken to me, saying, ‘Lighten the yoke your father put on us’?”
ekegusii: Akababoria, “Ngosemia ki morang’e? Ninki ndairanerie abanto aba bamboretie ng’a nyororobie rikorogoto riria tata ababeekerete?”
swahili: Akawauliza, “Ninyi ushauri wenu ni nini? Tutawajibuje watu hawa wanaoniambia, ‘Ifanye nyepesi nira baba yako aliyoweka juu yetu?’ ”

english: When Rehoboam arrived in Jerusalem, he mobilized the house of Judah and Benjamin—180,000 chosen warriors—to fight against Israel and restore the kingdom to Rehoboam.
ekegusii: Ekero Rehoboamu achete Yerusalemu, agasangereria abanto b’enyomba ya Yuda, na ab’eya Benjamini, abanto chilifu rigana erimo na emerongo etano na etato (180,000), abamanyete korwana esegi, ng’a bagende korwania Abaisraeli bairanie oborwoti ase Rehoboamu.
swahili: Ikawa Rehoboamu alipofika Yerusalemu, akakusanya nyumba ya Yuda na ya Benyamini, wanaume wapiganaji 180,000, kufanya vita dhidi ya nyumba ya Israeli na kuurudisha tena ufalme kwa Rehoboamu mwana wa Solomoni.

english: Zorah, Aijalon, and Hebron, the fortified cities in Judah and Benjamin.
ekegusii: na Sora, na Ayaloni, na Heburoni, emechie eyio egiteire chindwaki ere ase orogongo rwa Yuda na orwa Benjamini.
swahili: Sora, Aiyaloni na Hebroni. Hii ndiyo iliyokuwa miji iliyojengewa ngome katika Yuda na Benyamini.

english: He strengthened their fortresses and put officers in them, with supplies of food, oil, and wine.
ekegusii: Akaagacha chiburi chiabo chikaba chinkong’u, akabeeka abateneneri imeo, na akagacha chindagera na amaguta emezeituni n’edivai.
swahili: Akaimarisha ulinzi wake na kuweka majemadari ndani yake, pamoja na ghala za mahitaji ya vyakula, mafuta ya zeituni na divai.

english: He also put shields and spears in all the cities and strengthened them greatly. So Judah and Benjamin belonged to him. Jeroboam Forsakes the Priests and Levites
ekegusii: Akabeka chinguba na amatimo ase emechie eyio yonsi, na akayekora ekaba emekong’u mono. Ase enchera eyio akagenderera kogambera Abayuda na Ababenjamini. Abakuani na Abalawi bakobwatana n’Abayuda
swahili: Akaweka ngao na mikuki katika miji na kuifanya iwe imara sana. Kwa hiyo Yuda na Benyamini zikawa zake.

english: Moreover, the priests and Levites from all their districts throughout Israel stood with Rehoboam.
ekegusii: Abakuani na Abalawi bagacha korwa ase ense y’Abaisraeli ase bamenyete, bakabwatana na Rehoboamu.
swahili: Makuhani na Walawi kutoka sehemu zote za Israeli wakawa upande wake.

english: For the Levites left their pasturelands and their possessions and went to Judah and Jerusalem, because Jeroboam and his sons had rejected them as priests of the LORD.
