ekegusii: Ase rituko ri’emerongo ebere na gatato ri’omotienyi o gatano na kabere agatiga abanto bakagenda ase chinka chiabo bare nomochengo na omogooko ase chinkoro chiabo, ase engencho y’obuya bori’Omonene aorogetie ase Daudi na ase Sulemani, na ase Abaisraeli, abanto baye. Nyasae okoorokera Sulemani naende (1 Abar 9:1)
swahili: Katika siku ya ishirini na tatu ya mwezi wa saba Solomoni akawaaga watu waende nyumbani mwao, wakishangilia na kufurahi mioyoni mwao, kwa wema mwingi Bwana Mungu aliomtendea Daudi na Solomoni na kwa ajili ya watu wake Israeli. Bwana Mungu Amtokea Solomoni (1 Wafalme 9:1-9)

english: When Solomon had finished the house of the LORD and the royal palace, successfully carrying out all that was in his heart to do for the house of the LORD and for his own palace,
ekegusii: Sulemani agakoora koagacha enyomba y’Omonene, na enyomba y’omorwoti, na ebio bionsi Sulemani aroberetie gokora ase enyomba y’Omonene na ase enyomba yaye omonyene; akabiikerania na kobikoora buya.
swahili: Solomoni alipomaliza kujenga Hekalu la Bwana na jumba la kifalme, naye akiwa amefanikiwa kutenda yale yote aliyokuwa nayo moyoni mwake kufanya katika Hekalu la Bwana na katika jumba lake mwenyewe la kifalme,

english: the LORD appeared to him at night and said to him: “I have heard your prayer and have chosen this place for Myself as a house of sacrifice.
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene akaorokera Sulemani ase obotuko, akamoteebia, “Naigure ogosaba kwao, nechoreire aase aiga abe enyomba y’okoruerwa kw’ebing’wanso.
swahili: Bwana akamtokea Solomoni usiku na kumwambia: “Nimesikia maombi yako nami nimechagua mahali hapa kwa ajili yangu mwenyewe kuwa Hekalu kwa ajili ya dhabihu.

english: If I close the sky so there is no rain, or if I command the locust to devour the land, or if I send a plague among My people,
ekegusii: Ekero ndasieke igoro, erinde ntange embura tetwa, gose nchike chingige chisarie ense, gose ntome oborwaire bogoita ase egati y’abanto baane,
swahili: “Wakati nitakapofunga mbingu ili isiwepo mvua, au nikiamuru nzige kula mazao ya nchi au nikituma tauni miongoni mwa watu wangu,

english: and if My people who are called by My name humble themselves and pray and seek My face and turn from their wicked ways, then I will hear from heaven, forgive their sin, and heal their land.
ekegusii: na kerabe abanto baane, baria bakorokwa ase erieta riane, bekanyire abanyene babe abaitongo, basabe na korigia obosio bwane, na baonchoke batige chinchera chiabo chimbe, rirorio ninyigwe korwa aiga igoro, mbaabere ebibe biabo, naende ngwenie ense yabo.
swahili: kama watu wangu, wanaoitwa kwa Jina langu, watajinyenyekesha na kuomba na kuutafuta uso wangu na kuacha njia zao mbaya, basi nitasikia toka mbinguni na kuwasamehe dhambi yao na nitaiponya nchi yao.

english: Now My eyes will be open and My ears attentive to the prayers offered in this place.
ekegusii: Bono amaiso aane narigererie, na amato aane nategerere aigwe ogosaba kogosabwa aase aiga.
swahili: Sasa macho yangu yatafumbuka na masikio yangu yatasikiliza kwa makini maombi yaombwayo mahali hapa.

english: For I have now chosen and consecrated this temple so that My Name may be there forever. My eyes and My heart will be there for all time.
ekegusii: Bono nachorire na gwatanana enyomba eye, erinde erieta riane ribeere aroro kogenderera botambe. Amaiso aane na enkoro yane mbibe aroro ase chingaki chionsi.
swahili: Kwa maana sasa nimechagua na kutakasa Hekalu hili ili kwamba Jina langu lipate kuwa huko milele. Macho yangu na moyo wangu utakuwepo huko daima.

english: And as for you, if you walk before Me as your father David walked, doing all I have commanded you, and if you keep My statutes and ordinances,
ekegusii: Aye korataare ase obosio bwane, buna Daudi iso ataarete, na korakore onsi aya nagochikiire na kobwata emeroberio yane yonsi echiikire,
swahili: “Kwa habari yako wewe, kama ukienenda mbele zangu kama Daudi baba yako alivyoenenda na kufanya yote nikuamuruyo, nawe ukizishika amri zangu na sheria zangu,

english: then I will establish your royal throne, as I covenanted with your father David when I said, ‘You will never fail to have a man to rule over Israel.’
ekegusii: rirorio ninkore ekerogo kiao ki’oborwoti kebe ne chinguru, buna nakorete okobwatana kw’ogotianania na Daudi iso, nkamoteebia: Omonto takobora korwa asore, oyio oragambere Abaisraeli.
swahili: Nitakiimarisha kiti chako cha enzi kama nilivyoagana na Daudi baba yako niliposema, ‘Hutakosa kamwe mtu wa kutawala juu ya Israeli.’

english: But if you turn away and forsake the statutes and commandments I have set before you, and if you go off to serve and worship other gods,
ekegusii: Korende komoratige emeroberio yane echiikire na amachiiko aane, ayio nabekire ase amasio aino, naende mobe mogokorera chinyasae chinde na gochisasiima;
swahili: “Lakini kama ukigeuka na kuyaacha maagizo na amri nilizowapa na kwenda kuitumikia miungu mingine na kuiabudu,

english: The priests were unable to enter the house of the LORD, because the glory of the LORD had filled it.
ekegusii: Abakuani tibarenge konyara gosoa ase enyomba y’Omonene, ekiagera obonene bw’Omonene bwaichorete ase enyomba eria y’Omonene.
swahili: Makuhani hawakuweza kuingia ndani ya Hekalu la Bwana kwa sababu utukufu wa Bwana ulilijaza.

english: then I will uproot Israel from the soil I have given them, and I will banish from My presence this temple I have sanctified for My Name. I will make it an object of scorn and ridicule among all the peoples.
ekegusii: rirorio nimbarusie korwa ase ense eye nabaeire; na enyomba eye naatananire na koyechena ase engencho y’erieta riane ninyetugute erue ase amaiso aane, naende ebe ring’ana rigokwanwa bobe nabaanto b’ebisaku bionsi.
swahili: ndipo nitakapoingʼoa Israeli kutoka nchi yangu niliyowapa, nami nitalikataa Hekalu hili nililolitakasa kwa ajili ya Jina langu. Nitalifanya kitu cha kudharauliwa na kitu cha kudhihakiwa miongoni mwa watu wote.

english: And when this temple has become a heap of rubble, all who pass by it will be appalled and say, ‘Why has the LORD done such a thing to this land and to this temple?’
ekegusii: “Enyomba eye ere nogosikwa na obonene, korende ekero ekio kera omonto orabe ogoeta naichanigwe na gokumia, naende aborie: Nase ki Omonene akorire aya ase ense eye, na ase enyomba eye?
swahili: Ingawa Hekalu hili linavutia sana sasa, wote watakaolipita watashangaa na kusema, ‘Kwa nini Bwana amefanya kitu kama hiki katika nchi hii na kwa Hekalu hili?’

english: And others will answer, ‘Because they have forsaken the LORD, the God of their fathers, who brought them out of the land of Egypt, and have embraced other gods, worshiping and serving them—because of this, He has brought all this disaster upon them.’”
ekegusii: Erio nairanerigwe: Nekiagera batigete Omonene, Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiabo, oria obarusetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri. Nigo babwatanete ne chinyasae ching’ao, bagachisasiima na gochikorera; ayio naro agerire Omonene arentire amabe aya onsi igoro ase bare.”
swahili: Watu watajibu, ‘Ni kwa sababu wamemwacha Bwana, Mungu wa baba zao, aliyewatoa Misri, nao wamekumbatia miungu mingine, wakaiabudu na kuitumikia, ndiyo sababu ameyaleta maafa haya yote juu yao.’ ”

english: When all the Israelites saw the fire coming down and the glory of the LORD above the temple, they bowed down on the pavement with their faces to the ground, and they worshiped and gave thanks to the LORD: “For He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.” Sacrifices of Dedication (1 Kings 8:62–66)
ekegusii: Ekero Abaisraeli bonsi baroche omorero orwete igoro, na baroche obonene bw’Omonene igoro ye Hekalu, bagatung’ama bakaumama gochia inse, bagasasiima Omonene na komoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono, bagateeba, “Omonene nomuya, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye bwa botambe nigo bogendererete kare na kare.”
swahili: Waisraeli wote walipoona moto ukishuka na utukufu wa Bwana ukiwa juu ya Hekalu, wakapiga magoti sakafuni wakasujudu nyuso zao mpaka chini, nao wakamwabudu na kumshukuru Bwana wakisema, “Yeye ni mwema; upendo wake unadumu milele.”

english: Then the king and all the people offered sacrifices before the LORD.
ekegusii: Erio omorwoti amo nabaanto bonsi bakarua ebing’wanso ase obosio bw’Omonene.
swahili: Ndipo mfalme na watu wote wakatoa dhabihu mbele za Bwana Mungu.

english: And King Solomon offered a sacrifice of 22,000 oxen and 120,000 sheep. So the king and all the people dedicated the house of God.
ekegusii: Sulemani omorwoti akarua ebing’wanso, chiombe chilifu emerongo ebere na ibere (22,000), ne ching’ondi chilifu rigana erimo na emerongo ebere (120,000). Naboigo omorwoti amo nabaanto bonsi bagaatanana enyomba ya Nyasae ekaba enchenu.
swahili: Naye Mfalme Solomoni akatoa dhabihu ya ngʼombe 22,000 pamoja na kondoo na mbuzi 120,000. Hivyo ndivyo mfalme na watu wote walivyoweka wakfu Hekalu la Mungu.

english: The priests stood at their posts, as did the Levites with the musical instruments of the LORD, which King David had made for giving thanks to the LORD and with which David had offered praise, saying, “For His loving devotion endures forever.” Across from the Levites, the priests sounded trumpets, and all the Israelites were standing.
ekegusii: Abakuaani bagatenena ase emeremo yabo y’obokuani, na Abalawi barengeo babwate ebinto bi’okobugigwa ase ogoterera Omonene, ebinto biria Daudi omorwoti konya aroisirie ase okoiraneri’Omonene ng’a mbuya mono, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye bwa botambe nigo bogendererete kare na kare. Daudi nigo ababegete babe bagotera ogoteera kw’ogotogia. Abakuani bakaba bakobugia ebitureeri, ekero Abaisraeli bonsi bateneine.
swahili: Makuhani wakasimama kwenye nafasi zao, vivyo hivyo Walawi wakiwa na vyombo vya uimbaji vya Bwana ambavyo Mfalme Daudi alikuwa ametengeneza kwa ajili ya kumsifu Bwana, navyo vilitumika wakati aliposhukuru, akisema, “Upendo wake wadumu milele.” Mkabala na Walawi, makuhani walipiga tarumbeta zao, nao Waisraeli wote walikuwa wamesimama.

english: Then Solomon consecrated the middle of the courtyard in front of the house of the LORD, and there he offered the burnt offerings and the fat of the peace offerings, since the bronze altar he had made could not contain all these offerings.
ekegusii: Sulemani agaatanana na gochena obogati‐gati bw’eraaro eria yarenge bosio bw’enyomba y’Omonene. Agwo nao aruerete ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa, na ebitinya bi’ebing’wanso bi’omorembe, ekiagera egesasiimero gi’etai keria Sulemani aroisetie tikiarenge konyara goisana ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa na okoruegwa kw’endagera na ebitinya.
swahili: Solomoni akaweka wakfu sehemu ya katikati ya ua uliokuwa mbele ya Hekalu la Bwana na hapo akatoa sadaka za kuteketezwa na mafuta ya sadaka za amani, kwa sababu madhabahu ya shaba aliyokuwa ametengeneza haikutosha kuweka sadaka hizo zote za kuteketezwa, sadaka za nafaka na za mafuta.

english: So at that time Solomon and all Israel with him—a very great assembly of people from Lebo-hamath to the Brook of Egypt—kept the feast for seven days.
ekegusii: Ase engaki eria Sulemani amo n’Abaisraeli bonsi mbabwate Amatuko Amanene ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere. Omosangererekano oyio omonene ogasangerereka gochakera korwa egesoero kia Hamati goikeera akarooche ka Misiri.
swahili: Hivyo Solomoni akaiadhimisha sikukuu wakati ule kwa muda wa siku saba, na Israeli wote pamoja naye. Walikuwa kusanyiko kubwa sana, watu kutoka Lebo-Hamathi hadi Kijito cha Misri.

english: On the eighth day they held a solemn assembly, for the dedication of the altar had lasted seven days, and the feast seven days more.
ekegusii: Na ase rituko ria gatano na gatato bakaba nomosangererekano bw’ogosasiima, ekiagera konya babeire barendete amatuko atano na abere ay’ogwatanana egesasiimero, amo n’Amatuko Amanene atano na abere.
swahili: Katika siku ya nane walifanya kusanyiko, kwa kuwa walikuwa wanaadhimisha kuwekwa wakfu kwa madhabahu kwa muda wa siku saba na sikukuu kwa muda wa siku nyingine saba zaidi.

english: Now at the end of the twenty years during which Solomon had built the house of the LORD and his own palace,
ekegusii: Ase omoerio bw’emiaka emerongo ebere, eria Sulemani airete ase okoagacha enyomba y’Omonene na enyomba yaye omonyene,
swahili: Miaka ishirini ilipopita, ambayo katika hiyo Solomoni alilijenga Hekalu la Bwana na jumba lake mwenyewe la kifalme,

english: They were also the chief officers for King Solomon: 250 supervisors.
ekegusii: Abateneneri abanene b’omorwoti Sulemani nigo barenge abanto amagana abere na emerongo etano; abwo nigo barenge kogambera abakori emeremo.
swahili: Pia walikuwa maafisa wakuu wa Mfalme Solomoni, yaani, maafisa wakaguzi 250 waliosimamia watu.

english: Solomon brought the daughter of Pharaoh up from the City of David to the palace he had built for her. For he said, “My wife must not live in the house of David king of Israel, because the places the ark of the LORD has entered are holy.”
ekegusii: Sulemani akang’anyia mokaye, mosubati o Farao, korwa ase Omochie o Daudi gochia ase enyomba eria amoagacherete, ekiagera nigo ateebete, “Omokungu oyo takomenya ase enyomba ya Daudi, omorwoti bw’Abaisraeli, ekiagera aase agwo ase Esanduki y’Omonene yarentirwe naachenu.”
swahili: Solomoni akampandisha mke wake binti Farao kutoka Mji wa Daudi na kumleta jumba la kifalme alilokuwa amemjengea, kwa kuwa alisema, “Mke wangu hataishi katika jumba la kifalme la Daudi mfalme wa Israeli, kwa sababu mahali ambapo Sanduku la Bwana limefika ni patakatifu.”

english: At that time Solomon offered burnt offerings to the LORD on the altar of the LORD he had built in front of the portico.
ekegusii: Erio Sulemani akarua ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa ase Omonene igoro ase egesasiimero ki’Omonene, keria aagachete agwo ang’e nenyomba yaagachetwe bosio bwe Hekalu ekabwateranigwa nero.
swahili: Mfalme Solomoni akamtolea Bwana dhabihu za kuteketezwa juu ya madhabahu ya Bwana ambayo alikuwa ameijenga mbele ya ukumbi,

english: He observed the daily requirement for offerings according to the commandment of Moses for Sabbaths, New Moons, and the three annual appointed feasts—the Feast of Unleavened Bread, the Feast of Weeks, and the Feast of Tabernacles.
ekegusii: Akabirua buna Musa achigete biruegwe ase kera Rituko Richenu: Chisabato, na Emetienyi Emeyia, na Amatuko Amanene ara gatato ase omwaka: Amatuko Amanene ay’Emegati etabekiri memera, na Amatuko Amanene e Chichuma, na Amatuko Amanene ay’Ebigutu.
swahili: kulingana na mahitaji ya kila siku kwa ajili ya sadaka zilizoamriwa na Mose kwa ajili ya Sabato, Mwezi Mwandamo na sikukuu nyingine tatu za mwaka, yaani, Sikukuu ya Mikate Isiyotiwa Chachu, Sikukuu ya Majuma na Sikukuu ya Vibanda.

english: In keeping with the ordinances of his father David, Solomon appointed the divisions of the priests over their service, and the Levites for their duties to offer praise and to minister before the priests according to the daily requirement. He also appointed gatekeepers by their divisions at each gate, for this had been the command of David, the man of God.
ekegusii: Akabwatia omooroberio o Daudi ise, akabeeka ebiombe bi’abakuani ase ogokora emeremo yabo, na Abalawi ase emeremo yabo y’ogokonya abakuani na ase ogoteera amatera ’ogotogia, na emeremo ende buna yaganeirie kera rituko. Boigo akabeeka ebiombe bi’abarendi b’ebiita gokora emeremo yabo ase kera egeita buna yaganeirie kera rituko, buna Daudi, omonto oria o Nyasae, achigete ekorwe.
swahili: Kwa kushika maagizo ya Daudi baba yake, aliweka migawanyo ya makuhani kwa ajili ya kazi zao, nao Walawi kuongoza kusifu na kusaidia makuhani kufuatana na mahitaji ya kila siku. Pia akaweka mabawabu katika migawanyo kwa ajili ya malango mbalimbali, kwa sababu hili ndilo Daudi mtu wa Mungu alilokuwa ameagiza.

english: They did not turn aside from the king’s command regarding the priests or the Levites or any matter concerning the treasuries.
ekegusii: Amang’ana onsi omorwoti achigete abakuani na Abalawi nigo aikeranetigwe kegima ase kera ring’ana rinde rionsi amo nerie chimonga.
swahili: Nao hawakuziacha amri za mfalme alizoamuru makuhani au Walawi katika jambo lolote, ikiwa ni pamoja na zile za hazina.

english: Thus all the work of Solomon was carried out, from the day the foundation was laid for the house of the LORD until it was finished. So the house of the LORD was completed.
ekegusii: Bono emeremo yonsi Sulemani akorete ase enyomba y’Omonene, korwa okobekwa kw’oboroso goika ogoikeranigwa kw’oboagacho, ekaera. Igo enyomba y’Omonene ekaba eikeranete.
swahili: Kazi yote ya Mfalme Solomoni ilifanyika kuanzia siku msingi wa Hekalu la Bwana ulipowekwa mpaka kukamilika kwake. Kwa hiyo Hekalu la Bwana likamalizika kujengwa.

english: Then Solomon went to Ezion-geber and to Eloth on the coast of Edom.
ekegusii: Magega y’ayio Sulemani akagenda agwo Esioni‐Geberi na Eloti ase engegu y’enyancha, ase ense ya Edomu.
swahili: Ndipo Solomoni akaenda Esion-Geberi na Elathi katika pwani ya Edomu.

english: So Hiram sent him ships captained by his servants, along with crews of experienced sailors. They went with Solomon’s servants to Ophir and acquired from there 450 talents of gold, which they delivered to King Solomon.
ekegusii: Huramu akamotomera chimeeri chiarenge kogendigwa nabagendia baye, amo nabaanto bande bamanyete emeremo y’enyancha. Barabwo bakagenda goika Ofiri amo nabasomba ba Sulemani, bakarenta korwa aroro chitaabu chitalanta amagana ane, na emerongo etano, bakayeirera Sulemani omorwoti.
swahili: Naye Hiramu alimpelekea meli zilizoongozwa na maafisa wake mwenyewe, watu waliokuwa na ujuzi wa baharini. Hawa watu pamoja na wale wa Solomoni wakasafiri kwa bahari mpaka Ofiri, wakaleta kutoka huko talanta 450 za dhahabu, ambazo walimkabidhi Mfalme Solomoni.

english: Solomon rebuilt the cities Hiram had given him and settled Israelites there.
ekegusii: akaagacha naende emechie eria Huramu amoete, erio akabeeka Abaisraeli aroro bayemenye.
swahili: Solomoni akajenga tena vijiji vile ambavyo Hiramu alikuwa amempa, naye akawapa Waisraeli waishi humo.

english: Then Solomon went to Hamath-zobah and captured it.
ekegusii: Erio Sulemani akagenda koira orogongo rwa Hamati na Soba,
swahili: Kisha Solomoni akaenda Hamath-Soba na kuuteka.

english: He built Tadmor in the wilderness, in addition to all the store cities that he had built in Hamath.
ekegusii: akaagacha Tadimori agwo ase erooro, amo nemechie yonsi ase baare koagacha ebinto agwo Hamati.
swahili: Pia akajenga mji wa Tadmori katika jangwa na miji yote ya kuhifadhia vitu katika Hamathi.

english: He rebuilt Upper and Lower Beth-horon as fortified cities with walls, gates, and bars,
ekegusii: Boigo naende akaagacha Beti‐Horoni ya rogoro, na Beti‐Horoni ya maate, akayegitera chindwaki na koyeroiseria ebiita amo nemekorogoto,
swahili: Akajenga tena Beth-Horoni ya Juu na Beth-Horoni ya Chini, miji yenye ngome, kuta, malango na makomeo.

english: as well as Baalath, all the store cities that belonged to Solomon, and all the cities for his chariots and horses —whatever he desired to build in Jerusalem, Lebanon, and throughout the land of his dominion.
ekegusii: akaagacha na Baalati na emechie yaye yonsi ase ebinto biarenge kogachwa, na emechie yonsi ye chigari chiaye, na eye chibarasi chiaye chikoriinwa, na amaagacho ande onsi Sulemani aganetie koagacha agwo Yerusalemu na Lebanoni, na aande onsi ase obogambi bwaye.
swahili: Solomoni pia akajenga Baalathi na miji yake yote ya kuhifadhia vitu, na miji kwa ajili ya magari yake na kwa ajili ya farasi wake, chochote alichotaka kujenga katika Yerusalemu, katika Lebanoni na katika nchi yote aliyotawala.

english: But Solomon did not consign any of the Israelites to slave labor, because they were his men of war, his officers and captains, and the commanders of his chariots and cavalry.
ekegusii: Korende Sulemani takorete Abaisraeli babe abasomba ase okomokorera emeremo. Barabwo nigo babete abasikari, na abanene b’oborwoti, na abachiki baye be chigari ne chibarasi chikoriinwa.
swahili: Lakini Solomoni hakuwafanya Waisraeli watumwa kwa ajili ya kazi yake, bali walikuwa wapiganaji, majemadari, maafisa wake, majemadari wa magari yake ya vita na waendesha magari ya vita.

english: Now when the queen of Sheba heard about the fame of Solomon, she came to test him with difficult questions. She arrived in Jerusalem with a very large caravan—with camels bearing spices, gold in abundance, and precious stones. So she came to Solomon and spoke with him about all that was on her mind.
ekegusii: Ekero eting’ana ya Seba aigwete chinkuma chia Sulemani, agacha Yerusalemu komoteema ase okomoboria amang’ana amakong’u, agacha amo nabasomba baye abange ne chingamia chiabogoretie ebinsari, ne chitaabu chinyinge, na amagena e rigori rinene. Na ekero aigete ase Sulemani, akamoteebia amang’ana onsi arenge ase ebirengererio biaye.
swahili: Malkia wa Sheba aliposikia habari za umaarufu wa Solomoni, huyo malkia akaja Yerusalemu kumjaribu kwa maswali magumu. Alifika akiwa na msafara mkubwa sana, pamoja na ngamia waliobeba vikolezi, kiasi kikubwa cha dhahabu na vito vya thamani, alikuja kwa Solomoni na kuzungumza naye kuhusu yote ambayo alikuwa nayo moyoni mwake.

english: (The servants of Hiram and of Solomon who brought gold from Ophir also brought algum wood and precious stones.
ekegusii: Abasomba ba Huramu na abasomba ba Sulemani, baria barentete chitaabu korwa Ofiri, bakarenta boigo korwa aroro chibao chi’emete ekorokwa alugumu, amo namagena e rigori rinene.
swahili: (Watumishi wa Hiramu na wa Solomoni wakaleta dhahabu kutoka Ofiri, tena wakaleta shehena kubwa ya miti ya msandali na vito vya thamani.

english: The king made the algum wood into steps for the house of the LORD and for the king’s palace, and into lyres and harps for the singers. Never before had anything like them been seen in the land of Judah.)
ekegusii: Korwa ase chibao chi’alugumu omorwoti akaroisia ebiriinero bi’enyomba y’Omonene, na ebi’enyomba y’omorwoti, naende akaroisia amakano, na amakano ’ebirigisa akobugigwa nabateri. Ebinto buna ebio tibiana‐kororekana naende nonya ng’ake ase ense y’Abayuda.
swahili: Mfalme akatumia hiyo miti ya msandali kuwa ngazi kwa ajili ya Hekalu la Bwana na kwa jumba la kifalme, pia kwa kutengeneza vinubi na zeze kwa ajili ya waimbaji. Kiasi hicho kingi cha msandali hakijawahi kuingizwa Yuda tangu siku ile.)

english: King Solomon gave the queen of Sheba all she desired—whatever she asked—far more than she had brought the king. Then she left and returned to her own country, along with her servants. Solomon’s Wealth and Splendor (1 Kings 10:14–29)
ekegusii: Omorwoti Sulemani akaa eting’ana ya Seba ebinto bionsi aganetie, na ebio asabete aegwe, goetania ekerengo ki’ebio ere arenterete omorwoti. Erio eting’ana eria akairana, akagenda ase ense yaye amo nabasomba baye. Obotenenku bw’omorwoti Sulemani (1 Abar 10:14-25)
swahili: Mfalme Solomoni akampa Malkia wa Sheba kila kitu alichotamani na kukiomba, zaidi ya vile alivyokuwa amemletea mfalme. Kisha malkia akaondoka na kurudi katika nchi yake, yeye na watumishi wake. Fahari Ya Solomoni (1 Wafalme 10:14-25)

english: The weight of gold that came to Solomon each year was 666 talents,
ekegusii: Chitaabu chiare korentwa ase Sulemani kera omwaka nigo chiarenge goetania chikiro chilifu emerongo ebere na isano (25,000).
swahili: Uzito wa dhahabu ambayo Solomoni alipokea kwa mwaka ulikuwa talanta 666,

english: not including the revenue from the merchants and traders. And all the Arabian kings and governors of the land also brought gold and silver to Solomon.
ekegusii: Boigo chitaabu n’echifeta chikaba chikorentwa nabaonchoreria b’ebinto, na baria barenge korenta ebinto korwa ase chinse chia isiko, naende chikarentwa nabarwoti b’Arabia na abagaambi bande abarenge goakana ebango ase omorwoti.
swahili: mbali na mapato yaliyoletwa na wafanyabiashara na wachuuzi. Wafalme wote wa Arabuni na watawala wa nchi wakamletea Solomoni dhahabu na fedha.

english: King Solomon made two hundred large shields of hammered gold; six hundred shekels of hammered gold went into each shield.
ekegusii: Omorwoti Sulemani akaroisia chinguba amagana abere, agachiooma ne chitaabu chisunyuntire, na kera eng’aya ekaira etaabu esunyuntire ang’e chikiro isano na ibere.
swahili: Mfalme Solomoni akatengeneza ngao kubwa 200 kwa dhahabu iliyofuliwa. Kila ngao ilikuwa na dhahabu yenye uzito wa shekeli 600

english: He also made three hundred small shields of hammered gold; three hundred shekels of gold went into each shield. And the king put them in the House of the Forest of Lebanon.
ekegusii: Naende akagoncha chinguba chinke amagana atato, agachioma ne chitaabu chisunyuntire, na kera enguba ekaira etaabu ang’e chikiro inye. Omorwoti agachibeka ime ase enyomba ekarokwa Enyomba ye Rinani ria Lebanoni.
swahili: Akatengeneza pia ngao ndogo 300 za dhahabu iliyofuliwa, kila ngao ikiwa na uzito wa mane tatu za dhahabu. Mfalme akaziweka katika Jumba la Kifalme la Msitu wa Lebanoni.

english: Additionally, the king made a great throne of ivory and overlaid it with pure gold.
ekegusii: Omorwoti akaroisia ekerogo ekenene ki’oborwoti, akagechabera amaino e chinchogu, na agakeooma netaabu echenire.
swahili: Kisha mfalme akatengeneza kiti kikubwa cha kifalme kwa kutumia pembe za ndovu na kukifunika kwa dhahabu safi.

english: The throne had six steps, and a footstool of gold was attached to it. There were armrests on both sides of the seat, with a lion standing beside each armrest.
ekegusii: Ekerogo keria ki’oborwoti nigo kiabwate ekeriinero kiarenge nebitambokero bitano na ekemo, na egeteni ki’amagoro kiaroisirie korwa ase etaabu; bionsi nigo biabwatanirie nekerogo keria. Kera ensemo y’ekerogo mbiarengeo ebisiirero ase arenge gotoorera amaboko, na emegwekano ye chindo ebere yatenenirieo, oyomo ase kera ensemo.
swahili: Kiti hicho kilikuwa na ngazi sita na mahali pa kuwekea miguu vyote vya dhahabu. Pande zote za kiti kulikuwa na mahali pa kuegemeza mikono, na simba wawili wakisimama kando ya hiyo mikono.

english: Twelve lions stood on the six steps, one at either end of each step. Nothing like this had ever been made for any kingdom.
ekegusii: Na emegwekano ye chindo ikomi na ibere yatenenirie aroro, oyomo ase kera ensemo ya kera ekeriinero. Omogwekano bw’ekerogo ekio tona koroisigwa ase obogambi bonde bwonsi.
swahili: Simba kumi na wawili walisimama kwenye ngazi sita, mmoja katika kila upande wa kila ngazi. Hakuna kitu kama hicho kilichokuwa kimefanyika kwenye ufalme mwingine wowote.

english: And Solomon answered all her questions; nothing was too difficult for him to explain.
ekegusii: Sulemani akamoiraneria amaborio aye onsi; nonya ne ring’ana erimo tiriabisekanete ase Sulemani; nigo amanyete onsi na komoyaorokia.
swahili: Solomoni akamjibu maswali yake yote, wala hakukuwa na jambo lolote lililokuwa gumu kwake asiweze kumwelezea.

english: All King Solomon’s drinking cups were gold, and all the utensils of the House of the Forest of Lebanon were pure gold. There was no silver, because it was accounted as nothing in the days of Solomon.
ekegusii: Ebikombe bionsi bi’okonywera bi’omorwoti Sulemani nigo biarenge ebie chitaabu, na ebikorero bionsi bi’enyomba ye Rinani ria Lebanoni nigo biarenge bie chitaabu chichenire. Ase amatuko a Sulemani chifeta tichiabarire ng’a negento kie rigori rinene.
swahili: Vikombe vyote vya Mfalme Solomoni vya kunywea vilikuwa vya dhahabu na vyombo vyote vya nyumbani katika Jumba la Kifalme la Msitu wa Lebanoni vilikuwa vya dhahabu safi. Hakukuwa na kitu kilichotengenezwa kwa fedha, kwa sababu fedha ilionekana ya thamani ndogo wakati wa Solomoni.

english: For the king had the ships of Tarshish that went with Hiram’s servants, and once every three years the ships of Tarshish would arrive bearing gold, silver, ivory, apes, and peacocks.
ekegusii: Chimeeri chi’omorwoti nigo chiarenge kogenda Tarisisi chibogoretie abasomba ba Huramu. Ara rimo ase emiaka etato chimeeri chia Tarisisi nigo chiarenge gocha korenta chitaabu, ne chifeta, na amaino e chinchogu, naende chikaba chikorenta chingoge ne chinyoni chikorokwa chinchimbo.
swahili: Mfalme alikuwa na meli nyingi za biashara baharini zilizoendeshwa na watu wa Hiramu. Kwa mara moja kila miaka mitatu zilirudi, zikiwa zimebeba dhahabu, fedha, pembe za ndovu na nyani wakubwa na wadogo.

english: So King Solomon surpassed all the kings of the earth in riches and wisdom.
ekegusii: Ase igo omorwoti Sulemani akaba omonene kobua abarwoti bonsi b’ense, ase obonda na obong’aini.
swahili: Mfalme Solomoni alikuwa mkuu zaidi kwa utajiri na hekima kuliko wafalme wote wa dunia.

english: All the kings of the earth sought an audience with Solomon to hear the wisdom that God had put in his heart.
ekegusii: Abarwoti bonsi b’ense bagacha ase Sulemani, erinde baigwe obong’aini bwaye boria Nyasae abegete ime yaye.
swahili: Wafalme wote wa dunia wakatafuta kukutana na Solomoni ili kusikia hekima ambayo Mungu alikuwa ameiweka katika moyo wake.

english: Year after year, each visitor would bring his tribute: articles of silver and gold, clothing, weapons, spices, horses, and mules.
ekegusii: Kera oyomo obo akaba okorenta ebiegwa biaye: ebinto bie chifeta na ebie chitaabu, ne chianga, na ebirwanero, na ebinsari, amo ne chibarasi ne chibarasi. Naboigo ekaba omwaka ase omwaka.
swahili: Mwaka baada ya mwaka, kila mmoja ambaye alikuja, alileta zawadi, vyombo vya fedha na dhahabu, majoho, silaha na vikolezi, farasi na nyumbu.

english: Solomon had 4,000 stalls for horses and chariots, and 12,000 horses, which he stationed in the chariot cities and also with him in Jerusalem.
ekegusii: Sulemani nigo abwate ameeri chilifu inye (4,000) aye chibarasi, ne chigari, ne chibarasi chiare koriinwa chilifu ikomi na ibere (12,000). Echinde ase echio nigo chiabegetwe ase emechie ye chigari, na echinde ase omorwoti amenyete agwo Yerusalemu.
swahili: Solomoni alikuwa na mabanda 4,000 kwa ajili ya farasi na magari ya vita, farasi 12,000 ambao aliwaweka katika miji ya magari ya vita na katika Yerusalemu pamoja naye.

english: He reigned over all the kings from the Euphrates to the land of the Philistines, as far as the border of Egypt.
ekegusii: Akagambera abarwoti bonsi babegetwe kogamba korwa orooche rw’Eufarati goika ase ense y’Abafilisti, na goika orobebe rw’Abamisiri.
swahili: Solomoni akatawala juu ya wafalme wote kuanzia Mto Frati mpaka kwenye nchi ya Wafilisti na kuendelea hadi mpaka wa Misri.

english: The king made silver as common in Jerusalem as stones, and cedar as abundant as sycamore in the foothills.
ekegusii: Omorwoti akarenta chifeta chinyinge agwo Yerusalemu, chikabucha buna amagena, ne chibao chi’emecharake nigo chiarenge chinyinge buna echi’emeko yarenge ase ense omweya.
swahili: Mfalme akafanya fedha kuwa kitu cha kawaida kama mawe huko Yerusalemu, mierezi akaifanya kuwa mingi kama mikuyu vilimani.

english: Solomon’s horses were imported from Egypt and from all the lands. The Death of Solomon (1 Kings 11:41–43)
ekegusii: Chibarasi chikarentwa ase Sulemani korwa Misiri na korwa ase chinse chionsi. Amang’ana ase obweng’e igoro y’obogambi bwa Sulemani (1 Abar 11:41-43)
swahili: Farasi wa Solomoni waliletwa kutoka Misri na kutoka nchi nyingine zote. Kifo Cha Solomoni (1 Wafalme 11:41-43)

english: As for the rest of the acts of Solomon, from beginning to end, are they not written in the Records of Nathan the Prophet, in the Prophecy of Ahijah the Shilonite, and in the Visions of Iddo the Seer concerning Jeroboam son of Nebat?
ekegusii: Bono amang’ana ande onsi Sulemani akorete, korwa omochakano goika omoerio, nigo ariikire ase amariko a Nathani omobani, na ase obobani bw’Ahiya korwa Silo, na ase oborori bwa Ido omoorori igoro ya Yeroboamu, mosinto o Nebati.
swahili: Kwa habari za matukio mengine ya utawala wa Solomoni, kuanzia mwanzo hadi mwisho, je, hayakuandikwa katika kumbukumbu za nabii Nathani, katika unabii wa Ahiya Mshiloni na katika maono ya Ido mwonaji kuhusu Yeroboamu mwana wa Nebati?

english: When the queen of Sheba saw the wisdom of Solomon, the palace he had built,
ekegusii: Na ekero eting’ana ya Seba yaroche obong’aini bwonsi bwa Sulemani, na enyomba eria aagachete,
swahili: Malkia wa Sheba alipoona hekima yote ya Solomoni na jumba la kifalme alilokuwa amejenga,

english: Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel forty years.
ekegusii: Sulemani akagamba agwo Yerusalemu igoro y’Abaisraeli bonsi ase emiaka emerongo ene.
swahili: Solomoni alitawala Israeli yote miaka arobaini, akiwa Yerusalemu.

english: And Solomon rested with his fathers and was buried in the city of his father David. And his son Rehoboam reigned in his place.
ekegusii: Erio Sulemani akarara ase chisokoro chiaye chiaraarete, agatindekwa ase Omochie o Daudi ise, na Rehoboamu, omwana oye, akaba okogamba ase ribaga riaye.
swahili: Kisha Solomoni akalala pamoja na baba zake, naye akazikwa katika mji wa Daudi baba yake. Naye Rehoboamu mwanawe akawa mfalme baada yake.

english: the food at his table, the seating of his servants, the service and attire of his attendants and cupbearers, and the burnt offerings he presented at the house of the LORD, it took her breath away.
ekegusii: na endagera yarenge korentwa ase emesa yaye, na akarora buna abakoonyi baye bamenyete aroro, na buna abasomba baye baare komokorera, ne chianga babegete, na ababogoria ebikombe baye, ne chianga babegete, na ebing’wanso biaye bi’ogosambwa aruete ase enyomba y’Omonene, agakumia na koumaata.
swahili: chakula kilichokuwa mezani pake, jinsi maafisa wake walivyokaa, wahudumu katika majoho yao, wanyweshaji wake na sadaka za kuteketezwa alizotoa katika Hekalu la Bwana alipatwa na mshangao.

english: She said to the king, “The report I heard in my own country about your words and wisdom is true.
ekegusii: Eting’ana eria egateebia omorwoti, “Chinkuma nabeire nkoigwa ekero narenge ase ense yane igoro y’emeremo yao, na obong’aini bwao, nechi’ekeene kegima.
swahili: Akamwambia mfalme, “Taarifa niliyosikia kwenye nchi yangu mwenyewe kuhusu mafanikio na hekima yako ni kweli.

english: But I did not believe the reports until I came and saw with my own eyes. Indeed, not half of the greatness of your wisdom was told to me. You have far exceeded the report I heard.
ekegusii: Korende tinegenete amang’ana ayio, goika ekero nachire aa na neroreire namaiso aane inche omonyene. Bono narorire ng’a tinatebetigwe nonya nekeng’ese ki’obonge bw’obong’aini bwao. Nigo bwaetanirie amang’ana konya nkoigwa.
swahili: Lakini sikuamini yaliyosemwa hadi nilipokuja na kuona kwa macho yangu mwenyewe. Naam, sikuambiwa hata nusu yake; katika hekima na mali umezidi sana kuliko ile taarifa niliyoisikia.

english: How blessed are your men! How blessed are these servants of yours who stand continually before you and hear your wisdom!
ekegusii: Abanto bao, na abasomba bao, abagotenena botambe ase obosio bwao, na koigwa obong’aini bwao, mbare negesio ekenene.
swahili: Heri watu wako! Heri hawa maafisa wako wasimamao mbele yako daima na kusikia hekima yako!

english: Blessed be the LORD your God, who has delighted in you to set you on His throne to be king for the LORD your God. Because your God loved Israel enough to establish them forever, He has made you king over them to carry out justice and righteousness.”
ekegusii: Omonene, Nyasae oo, atogigwe, oria ogokigwe asore na gokobeeka ase ekerogo kiaye ki’obonene, obe omorwoti ase obosio bwaye, ere Omonene, Nyasae oo! Ekiagera ere anchete Abaisraeli botambe, na akabakong’ia bakaba ne chinguru kare na kare, ogokorire aye koba omorwoti igoro ase bare, erinde onyare konacha ayare ay’ekeene na oboronge.”
swahili: Ahimidiwe Bwana Mungu wako, ambaye amependezwa sana nawe, na akakuweka juu ya kiti chake cha ufalme utawale kwa niaba ya Bwana Mungu wako. Kwa sababu ya upendo wa Mungu wako kwa Israeli na shauku yake ya kuwadhibitisha milele, amekufanya wewe mfalme juu yao, ili kudumisha haki na uadilifu.”

english: Then she gave the king 120 talents of gold, a great quantity of spices, and precious stones. There had never been such spices as those the queen of Sheba gave to King Solomon.
ekegusii: Erio eting’ana eria ekaa omorwoti ebiegwa ebio arentete: Chitaabu ang’e chikiro chilifu isano (5,000), na ebinsari ebinge mono, na amagena e rigori rinene. Ebinsari binde tibiarentetwe ekero kende gionsi bireng’aine na biria eting’ana ya Seba yarenterete omorwoti Sulemani.
swahili: Naye akampa mfalme talanta 120 za dhahabu, kiasi kikubwa cha vikolezi na vito vya thamani. Haikuwahi kamwe kuletwa vikolezi vizuri kama vile Malkia wa Sheba alivyompa Mfalme Solomoni.

english: Now by the mildness and gentleness of Christ, I appeal to you—I, Paul, who am humble when face to face with you, but bold when away.
ekegusii: Inche Paulo omonyene nabasoroire ase obwororo na oboitongo bwa Kristo, inche nigo inde omoitongo konde amo nainwe, korende ntari aroro ninde noboremu ase more.
swahili: Basi, mimi Paulo ninawasihi kwa unyenyekevu na upole wa Kristo, mimi niliye “mwoga” ninapokuwa pamoja nanyi ana kwa ana, lakini mwenye ujasiri nikiwa mbali nanyi!

english: For some say, “His letters are weighty and forceful, but his physical presence is unimpressive, and his speaking is of no account.”
ekegusii: Naki barabwo bateba, “Amarube aye namarito, naende nigo are amakong’u, korende ekero are amo naintwe ere omonyene nigo are omoreu, na amang’ana aye tari gento.”
swahili: Kwa maana wanasema, “Nyaraka zake ni nzito na zenye nguvu, lakini ana kwa ana ni dhaifu na kuzungumza kwake ni kwa kudharauliwa.”

english: Such people should consider that what we are in our letters when absent, we will be in our actions when present.
ekegusii: Tiga abanto banga buna abwo bamanye, ng’a buna tokoriika ase amarube aito ekero totari aroro, naboigo togokora gatoreo.
swahili: Watu kama hao wajue ya kuwa, yale tusemayo kwa barua tukiwa hatupo pamoja nanyi, ndivyo tulivyo na ndivyo tutakavyofanya tutakapokuwa pamoja nanyi.

english: We do not dare to classify or compare ourselves with some who commend themselves. When they measure themselves by themselves and compare themselves with themselves, they show their ignorance.
ekegusii: Gaki titori noboremu kwebara amo nabarabwo abare gwetogia abanyene, gose kwereng’ania nabarabwo. Korende barabwo, ekero bakwerenga abanyene barabwo ase barabwo, na kwereng’ania barabwo ase barabwo, tibari nobong’aini.
swahili: Hatuthubutu kujiweka kwenye kundi moja au kujilinganisha na hao wanaojitukuza wenyewe kuwa wao ni wa maana sana. Wanapojipima na kujilinganisha wenyewe kwa wenyewe, wanaonyesha ya kuwa hawana busara.

english: We, however, will not boast beyond our limits, but only within the field of influence that God has assigned to us—a field that reaches even to you.
ekegusii: Korende intwe titogwetogia kobua ekerengo giaito, korende ase ekerengo twagabeirwe na Nyasae, nonya nokobaikera inwe.
swahili: Lakini sisi hatujajivuna kupita kiasi, bali majivuno yetu yatakuwa katika mipaka ile Mungu aliyotuwekea, mipaka ambayo inawafikia hata ninyi.

english: We are not overstepping our bounds, as if we had not come to you. Indeed, we were the first to reach you with the gospel of Christ.
ekegusii: Naki titori gwekinia intwe abanyene goetania ekerengo giaito buna ntotari kobaikera inwe. Naki intwe nabatang’ani tore b’okobarentera inwe enchiri ya Kristo.
swahili: Kwa maana hatukuwa tunavuka mipaka katika kujisifu kwetu, kama vile ambavyo ingekuwa kama hatukuwa tumekuja kwenu. Kwa maana sisi ndio tuliokuwa wa kwanza kuja kwenu na Injili ya Kristo.

english: Neither do we boast beyond our limits in the labors of others. But we hope that as your faith increases, our area of influence among you will greatly increase as well,
ekegusii: Titori gwetogia kobua ekerengo ase emeremo y’abanto bande; korende ogosemeria gwaito nigo kore ng’a koreng’ana buna okwegena kwaino gokomenteka, na emeremo yaito ase more ementeke.
swahili: Wala hatuvuki mipaka kwa kujisifu kwetu kwa ajili ya kazi iliyofanywa na watu wengine. Tumaini letu ni kwamba imani yenu inavyozidi kukua, eneo letu la utendaji miongoni mwenu litapanuka zaidi,

english: so that we can preach the gospel in the regions beyond you. Then we will not be boasting in the work already done in another man’s territory.
ekegusii: Erio tonyare korandia enchiri ase chinse chire ng’umbu yaino, titwetogia ase emeremo yakorirwe ase ensemo y’omonto onde.
swahili: ili tuweze kuhubiri Injili sehemu zilizo mbali na maeneo yenu. Kwa maana hatutaki kujisifu kwa ajili ya kazi ambayo imekwisha kufanyika tayari katika eneo la mtu mwingine.

english: Rather, “Let him who boasts boast in the Lord.”
ekegusii: “Korende ere oyogwetogia tiga etogie ase Omonene.”
swahili: Lakini, “Yeye ajisifuye na ajisifu katika Bwana.”

english: For it is not the one who commends himself who is approved, but the one whom the Lord commends.
ekegusii: Naki omonto bwancheirwe tari ere ogwetogia omonyene, korende noyo ogotogigwa n’Omonene.
swahili: Kwa maana si yeye ajisifuye mwenyewe akubaliwaye, bali yeye ambaye Bwana humsifu.

english: I beg you that when I come I may not need to be as bold as I expect toward those who presume that we live according to the flesh.
ekegusii: Ee, nabasabire ng’a kondeo timba omokong’u ase ogokwana noboremu, ekiagera nebarire koba noboremu igoro ase baria bakagete ng’a intwe nigo togotaara ase engencho y’okogania kw’omobere.
swahili: Nawaomba nitakapokuja kwenu nisiwe na ujasiri dhidi ya watu fulani, kama ninavyotazamia kwa wale wanaodhani kwamba tunaishi kwa kufuata namna ya ulimwengu huu.

english: For though we live in the flesh, we do not wage war according to the flesh.
ekegusii: Naki nonya tomenyete ase ense eye, titori korwana esegi y’okogania gw’ense eye.
swahili: Ingawa tunaishi duniani, hatupigani vita kama ulimwengu ufanyavyo.

english: The weapons of our warfare are not the weapons of the world. Instead, they have divine power to demolish strongholds.
ekegusii: Naki ebirwanero biaito bi’eseegi tibiri ebia Mwanyabaanto, korende mbire nokobua kwa Nyasae koiyeria chindwaki.
swahili: Silaha za vita vyetu si za mwili, bali zina uwezo katika Mungu hata kuangusha ngome,

english: We tear down arguments and every presumption set up against the knowledge of God; and we take captive every thought to make it obedient to Christ.
ekegusii: Intwe nigo tokoiyeria ebirengererio na kera egetango kieimokereretie igoro kegotanga Nyasae tamanywa, na gosiba kera ekerengererio kenyare koigwera Kristo;
swahili: tukiangusha mawazo na kila kitu kilichoinuka, kijiinuacho juu ya elimu ya Mungu, na tukiteka nyara kila fikira ipate kumtii Kristo,

english: And we will be ready to punish every act of disobedience, as soon as your obedience is complete.
ekegusii: gatorabe ang’e korua egesusuro ase ogotaigwera gwonsi, ekero okoigwera kwaino gwaikeranire.
swahili: tena tukiwa tayari kuadhibu kila tendo la kutotii, kutii kwenu kutakapokamilika.

english: You are looking at outward appearances. If anyone is confident that he belongs to Christ, he should remind himself that we belong to Christ just as much as he does.
ekegusii: Morigererie ayare ase amasio aino. Onye omonto ore nobomaene ase enkoro yaye ng’a ere nomonto o Kristo, tiga arengererie omonyene, ng’a buna ere are omonto o Kristo, naboigo naintwe tore abanto ba Kristo.
swahili: Angalieni yale yaliyo machoni penu. Kama mtu yeyote anaamini kuwa yeye ni mali ya Kristo, basi kumbuka kuwa kama ulivyo wa Kristo, vivyo hivyo na sisi ndivyo tulivyo.

english: For even if I boast somewhat excessively about the authority the Lord gave us for building you up rather than tearing you down, I will not be ashamed.
ekegusii: Naki ninsa gwetogia kobua ake ase engencho y’okobua gwaito okwo twaeirwe n’Omonene, tonyare kobaagacha inwe, gose tari okobaiyeria, tinkobekwa ase obosooku.
swahili: Basi hata kama nikijisifu zaidi kidogo kuhusu mamlaka tuliyo nayo, ambayo Bwana alitupa ili kuwajenga wala si kuwabomoa, mimi sitaionea haya.

english: I do not want to seem to be trying to frighten you by my letters.
ekegusii: Tindigeti gocha kororekana buna iga ndigetie koboboyia ase amarube aane.
swahili: Sitaki nionekane kama ninayejaribu kuwatisha kwa nyaraka zangu.

english: I hope you will bear with a little of my foolishness, but you are already doing that.
ekegusii: Anga yaba buya onye mwandemereria ake ase oboriri bwane. Ee, namanyire ng’a mondemererie.
swahili: Laiti mngenivumilia kidogo katika upumbavu wangu! Naam, nivumilieni kidogo.

english: As surely as the truth of Christ is in me, this boasting of mine will not be silenced in the regions of Achaia.
ekegusii: Naende buna ekeene gia Kristo kere ime ase ’nde, omonto tari oranyare gontanga ase ogwetogia okwo ase chinsemo chi’Akaya.
swahili: Kwa hakika kama vile kweli ya Kristo ilivyo ndani yangu, hakuna mtu yeyote katika Akaya nzima atakayenizuia kujivunia jambo hili.

english: Why? Because I do not love you? God knows I do!
ekegusii: Nase ki? Ekiagera ntabancheti inwe? Nyasae namanyete ng’a nimbanchete!
swahili: Kwa nini? Je, ni kwa sababu siwapendi? Mungu anajua ya kuwa nawapenda!

english: But I will keep on doing what I am doing, in order to undercut those who want an opportunity to be regarded as our equals in the things of which they boast.
ekegusii: Korende eri ngokora, ningenderere korikora, erinde mbatange abakorigia ribaga tibanyora ribaga ri’ogwetogia barorekane koba buna intwe tore.
swahili: Nami nitaendelea kufanya lile ninalofanya sasa ili nisiwape nafasi wale ambao wanatafuta nafasi ya kuhesabiwa kuwa sawa na sisi katika mambo wanayojisifia.

english: For such men are false apostles, deceitful workers, masquerading as apostles of Christ.
ekegusii: Naki abwo nabatomwa b’oborimo, bagokora emeremo ase obong’ainereria, bakweonchora babe omogwekano bw’abatomwa ba Kristo.
swahili: Watu kama hao ni mitume wa uongo, ni wafanyakazi wadanganyifu, wanaojigeuza waonekane kama mitume wa Kristo.

english: And no wonder, for Satan himself masquerades as an angel of light.
ekegusii: Nabo tari ogokumia, ekiagera Saitani omonyene nigo akweonchora bwekora buna omomalaika bw’omobaso.
swahili: Wala hii si ajabu, kwa kuwa hata Shetani mwenyewe hujigeuza aonekane kama malaika wa nuru.

english: It is not surprising, then, if his servants masquerade as servants of righteousness. Their end will correspond to their actions. Paul’s Suffering and Service (Colossians 1:24–29)
ekegusii: Ase ayio tari ring’ana rigeni ng’a abasomba baye nabarabwo bakweonchora bekora buna abasomba b’oboronge. Omoerio obo nobe koreng’ana nemeremo yabo. Ogochandeka gwa Paulo buna omotomwa
swahili: Kwa hiyo basi si ajabu, kama watumishi wa Shetani nao hujigeuza ili waonekane kama watumishi wa haki. Mwisho wao utakuwa sawa na matendo yao yanavyostahili. Paulo Anajivunia Mateso Yake

english: I repeat: Let no one take me for a fool. But if you do, then receive me as a fool, so that I too may boast a little.
ekegusii: Nakwanire naende, omonto takaga ng’a inche nomoriri inde; korende namonkagera bo, monyanche buna omonto omoriri, erinde nainche boigo ninyare gwetogia ake.
swahili: Nasema tena, mtu yeyote asidhani kwamba mimi ni mjinga. Lakini hata kama mkinidhania hivyo, basi nipokeeni kama mjinga ili nipate kujisifu kidogo.

english: In this confident boasting of mine, I am not speaking as the Lord would, but as a fool.
ekegusii: (Eri ngokwana tindi korikwana ase okobua kw’Omonene, korende buna omoriri ase oboremu obo bw’ogwetogia
swahili: Ninayosema kuhusiana na huku kujisifu kwa kujiamini, sisemi kama vile ambavyo Bwana angesema, bali kama mjinga.

english: Since many are boasting according to the flesh, I too will boast.
ekegusii: ekiagera abange bagwetogia ase engencho yabo abanyene, na inche boigo ninyetogie).
swahili: Kwa kuwa wengi wanajisifu kama vile ulimwengu ufanyavyo, mimi nami nitajisifu.

english: For you gladly tolerate fools, since you are so wise.
ekegusii: Inwe, ekiagera more nobong’aini, nigo mokoremereria nabariri ase omogooko.
swahili: Ninyi mwachukuliana na wajinga kwa sababu mna hekima sana!

english: I am jealous for you with a godly jealousy. For I promised you to one husband, to present you as a pure virgin to Christ.
ekegusii: Naki nabaroreire ribero, na eri neribero ria Nyasae; naki nabariereire boko ase omosacha oyomo, erinde nyare kobarenta buna omoiseke omwekungi omochenu ase Kristo.
swahili: Ninawaonea wivu, wivu wa Kimungu, kwa kuwa mimi niliwaposea mume mmoja, ili niwalete kwa Kristo kama mabikira safi.

english: In fact, you even put up with anyone who enslaves you or exploits you or takes advantage of you or exalts himself or strikes you in the face.
ekegusii: Naki iga mokoremereria nomonto, karabakore mobe abasomba, kararie ebiaino, abasakore, kareimokererie igoro, karabaake inwe ase obosio.
swahili: Kweli ni kwamba mnachukuliana na mtu akiwatia utumwani au akiwatumia kwa ajili ya kupata faida au akiwanyangʼanya au akijitukuza mwenyewe au akiwadanganya.

english: To my shame I concede that we were too weak for that! Speaking as a fool, however, I can match what anyone else dares to boast about.
ekegusii: Ase obosooku bwane nigo ngokwana ng’a nigo twarenge abareu ase ogokora amang’ana aya. Emechando ya Paulo na obokong’u bwaye Korende onye omonto ore noboremu bw’ogwetogia ase rinde rionsi (nakwanire ase oboriri), na inche ninde noboremu boigo bw’ogwetogia.
swahili: Kwa aibu inanipasa niseme kwamba sisi tulikuwa dhaifu sana kwa jambo hilo! Lakini chochote ambacho mtu mwingine yeyote angethubutu kujisifia, nanena kama mjinga, nami nathubutu kujisifu juu ya hilo.

english: Are they Hebrews? So am I. Are they Israelites? So am I. Are they descendants of Abraham? So am I.
ekegusii: Barabwo n’Abaiberania? Nainche boigo. Barabwo n’Abaisraeli? Nainche boigo. Barabwo noroiboro rwa Aburaamu? Nainche boigo.
swahili: Je, wao ni Waebrania? Mimi pia ni Mwebrania. Je, wao ni Waisraeli? Mimi pia ni Mwisraeli. Je, wao ni wazao wa Abrahamu? Mimi pia ni mzao wa Abrahamu.

english: Are they servants of Christ? I am speaking like I am out of my mind, but I am so much more: in harder labor, in more imprisonments, in worse beatings, in frequent danger of death.
ekegusii: Inee! Barabwo nabasomba ba Kristo? (Bono nigo ngokwana buna ebarimo). Inche mbuya kobua; ase emeremo kobua mono, ase ogosibwa kobua mono, ase ogoakwa goetania ekerengo, ang’e namakweri ebiro ebinge.
swahili: Je, wao ni watumishi wa Kristo? (Nanena kiwazimu.) Mimi ni zaidi yao. Nimefanya kazi kwa bidii kuwaliko wao, nimefungwa gerezani mara kwa mara, nimechapwa mijeledi sana, na nimekabiliwa na mauti mara nyingi.

english: Five times I received from the Jews the forty lashes minus one.
ekegusii: Ase Abayahudi ara gatano nkanyora ogoakwa emerongo ene otatiga okomo.
swahili: Mara tano nimechapwa na Wayahudi viboko arobaini kasoro kimoja.

english: Three times I was beaten with rods, once I was stoned, three times I was shipwrecked. I spent a night and a day in the open sea.
ekegusii: Ara gatato ngaakwa chinyimbo, erimo ngaakwa amagena. Ara gatato ngasarekerwa nemeeri, obotuko obomo na omobaso oyomo ngaikaransa igoro y’endiba;
swahili: Mara tatu nilichapwa kwa fimbo, mara moja nilipigwa kwa mawe, mara tatu nimevunjikiwa na meli, nimekaa kilindini usiku kucha na mchana kutwa,

english: In my frequent journeys, I have been in danger from rivers and from bandits, in danger from my countrymen and from the Gentiles, in danger in the city and in the country, in danger on the sea and among false brothers,
ekegusii: nkaba ase orogendo ekero ase ekero, ase emechando ye chindooche, ase ogochandwa nabauri, ase ogochandwa neamate yane, ase ogochandwa nabaanto b’Ebisaku, ase emechando emechie ime, ase emechando y’erooro, ase emechando y’enyancha, ase ogochandwa nabaminto b’oborimo;
swahili: katika safari za mara kwa mara. Nimekabiliwa na hatari za kwenye mito, hatari za wanyangʼanyi, hatari kutoka kwa watu wangu mwenyewe, hatari kutoka kwa watu wa Mataifa; hatari mijini, hatari nyikani, hatari baharini; na hatari kutoka kwa ndugu wa uongo.

english: in labor and toil and often without sleep, in hunger and thirst and often without food, in cold and exposure.
ekegusii: ase emeremo na obokong’u, ase okogeesa ara aange, ase enchara na erang’o, ase ogotanyora endagera ara aange, ase embeo na ase okoba getirianda.
swahili: Nimekuwa katika kazi ngumu na taabu, katika kukesha mara nyingi; ninajua kukaa njaa na kuona kiu; nimefunga kula chakula mara nyingi; nimehisi baridi na kuwa uchi.

english: Apart from these external trials, I face daily the pressure of my concern for all the churches.
ekegusii: Kobua ase amang’ana onsi ayare korwa isiko naro okorigereria gwe chikanisa chionsi, ayare gonchichera kera rituko.
swahili: Zaidi ya hayo yote, nakabiliwa na mzigo wa wajibu wangu kwa makanisa yote.

english: Who is weak, and I am not weak? Who is led into sin, and I do not burn with grief?
ekegusii: Ning’o ore omoreu, na inche timba omoreu? Ning’o ogerire ogwe, na inche tingechigwa?
swahili: Je, ni nani aliye mdhaifu, nami nisijisikie mdhaifu? Je, nani aliyekwazwa, nami nisiudhike?

english: I am afraid, however, that just as Eve was deceived by the serpent’s cunning, your minds may be led astray from your simple and pure devotion to Christ.
ekegusii: Korende nairokire ng’a buna eng’iti eria, ase obong’ainereria bwaye, yang’ainete Hawa, naboigo ebirengererio biaino birasareke, na mobaise gotiga obwegenwa bwaino bw’ekeene more nabwo ase Kristo.
swahili: Lakini nina hofu kuwa, kama vile Eva alivyodanganywa kwa ujanja wa yule nyoka, mawazo yenu yasije yakapotoshwa, mkauacha unyofu na usafi wa upendo wenu kwa Kristo.

english: If I must boast, I will boast of the things that show my weakness.
ekegusii: Onye ngwenerete gwetogia, ninyetogerie amang’ana ’oboreu bwane.
swahili: Kama ni lazima nijisifu, basi nitajisifia yale mambo yanayoonyesha udhaifu wangu.

english: The God and Father of the Lord Jesus, who is forever worthy of praise, knows that I am not lying.
ekegusii: Nyasae, Ise Omonene Yeso, oyorabakwe goika kare na kare, omanyire ng’a tindi gokwana oborimo.
swahili: Mungu na Baba wa Bwana Yesu, yeye ambaye anahimidiwa milele, anajua ya kuwa mimi sisemi uongo.

english: In Damascus, the governor under King Aretas secured the city of the Damascenes in order to arrest me.
ekegusii: Ekero narenge aaria Damesiki gabana, oyorenge inse y’omorwoti Areta, nigo arendete omochie o Damesiki, erio ambwate.
swahili: Huko Dameski, mtawala aliyekuwa chini ya Mfalme Areta aliulinda mji wa Dameski ili kunikamata.

english: But I was lowered in a basket through a window in the wall and escaped his grasp.
ekegusii: Korende nkabekwa ase egetonga ime, ngaikerigwa ase ekebao ase orwaki, ngatooreka korwa ase amaboko aye.
swahili: Lakini nilishushwa kwa kapu kubwa kupitia katika dirisha ukutani, nikatoroka kutoka mikononi mwake.

english: For if someone comes and proclaims a Jesus other than the One we proclaimed, or if you receive a different spirit than the One you received, or a different gospel than the one you accepted, you put up with it way too easily.
ekegusii: Naki onye omonto ogocha okorandia Yeso onde omoao, otatiga oyo twarandetie intwe, gose mwanche omoika onde omoao oyomotanyorete, gose enchiri ende eng’ao eyemotanchete, igo moremereretie buya nayio.
swahili: Kwa sababu kama mtu akija na kuwahubiria Yesu mwingine ambaye si yule tuliyemhubiri, au kama mkipokea roho mwingine ambaye si yule mliyempokea, au Injili tofauti na ile mliyoikubali, ninyi mnaitii kwa urahisi.

english: I consider myself in no way inferior to those “super-apostles.”
ekegusii: Naki igo nkagete ng’a inche tindemeiri gento eki abatomwa baria abanene bare nakio.
swahili: Lakini sidhani ya kuwa mimi ni dhalili sana kuliko hao “mitume wakuu.”

english: Although I am not a polished speaker, I am certainly not lacking in knowledge. We have made this clear to you in every way possible.
ekegusii: Nonya timanyeti gokwana buya, korende obong’aini nimbwate, na ase kera enchera twaorokirie amang’ana onsi ase more.
swahili: Inawezekana mimi nikawa si mnenaji hodari, lakini ni hodari katika elimu. Jambo hili tumelifanya liwe dhahiri kwenu kwa njia zote.

english: Was it a sin for me to humble myself in order to exalt you, because I preached the gospel of God to you free of charge?
ekegusii: Inee! Nebibe nakorire ase okweirania inse, erio mokiinigwe, ekiagera nabarandeirie enchiri ya Nyasae ntari neng’eria?
swahili: Je, nilitenda dhambi kwa kujishusha ili kuwainua ninyi kwa kuwahubiria Injili ya Mungu pasipo malipo?

english: I robbed other churches by accepting their support in order to serve you.
ekegusii: Naurire abanto be chikanisa chinde enibo yabo ase okorusia eng’eria yane ase bare, erinde mbakorere inwe.
swahili: Niliyanyangʼanya makanisa mengine kwa kupokea misaada kutoka kwao ili niweze kuwahudumia ninyi.

english: And when I was with you and in need, I was not a burden to anyone; for the brothers who came from Macedonia supplied my needs. I have refrained from being a burden to you in any way, and I will continue to do so.
ekegusii: Inche ekero narenge amo nainwe ekero naremeretwe, timorarereti monto onde, ekiagera abaminto bagachia gocha korwa Makedonia bagankonya ase okoremerwa kwane. Ase amang’ana onsi nkerenda inche omonyene timbaraarereria nonya ng’ake, naende ningenderere gokora bo.
swahili: Nami nilipokuwa pamoja nanyi, nikipungukiwa na chochote, sikuwa mzigo kwa mtu yeyote, kwa maana ndugu waliotoka Makedonia walinipatia mahitaji yangu. Kwa hiyo nilijizuia kuwa mzigo kwenu kwa njia yoyote, nami nitaendelea kujizuia.

english: I must go on boasting. Although there is nothing to gain, I will go on to visions and revelations from the Lord.
ekegusii: Ningwenerete gwetogia, nonya tigokongwenera gento; korende bono ninkwane igoro y’amaroro na okomaanorerwa bikorwa ase Omonene.
swahili: Yanipasa nijisifu, ingawa haifaidi kitu. Nitaenda kwenye maono na ufunuo kutoka kwa Bwana.

english: That is why, for the sake of Christ, I delight in weaknesses, in insults, in hardships, in persecutions, in difficulties. For when I am weak, then I am strong. Paul’s Concern for the Corinthians
ekegusii: Ase engencho ya Kristo nagweneirwe namareu, na ogochaaywa, na obokong’u, na okorosigwa, na emechando yonsi; ekero inde omoreu, erio nario inde ne chinguru. Ogwechanda gwa Paulo ase ekanisa ya Korinto
swahili: Hii ndiyo sababu, kwa ajili ya Kristo, nafurahia udhaifu, katika kutukanwa, katika taabu, katika mateso na katika shida, kwa maana ninapokuwa dhaifu, ndipo nina nguvu. Wasiwasi Wa Paulo Kwa Wakorintho

english: I have become a fool, but you drove me to it. In fact, you should have commended me, since I am in no way inferior to those “super-apostles,” even though I am nothing.
ekegusii: Nabeire omoriri, korende inwe mwambetereirie koba bo. Inche ningwenerete ntogigwe nainwe, ekiagera tindemeiri gento eki abatomwa baria abanene baare nakio, nonya tindi gento.
swahili: Nimekuwa mjinga, lakini ninyi mmenilazimisha niwe hivyo. Kwa kuwa ilinipasa kusifiwa na ninyi, kwa sababu mimi si dhalili kuliko wale “mitume walio bora,” ingawa mimi si kitu.

english: The true marks of an apostle—signs, wonders, and miracles—were performed among you with great perseverance.
ekegusii: Ekeene ebimanyererio bi’omotomwa bw’ekeene nigo biaorogetigwe egati yaino ase oboremereria bwonsi ase ebikone, na amakumia, na ogokora gwe chinguru.
swahili: Mambo yanayomtambulisha mtume wa kweli, yaani, ishara, miujiza na maajabu, yalifanywa miongoni mwenu kwa saburi nyingi.

english: In what way were you inferior to the other churches, except that I was not a burden to you? Forgive me this wrong!
ekegusii: Naki ngento ki moremeire kobua chikanisa chinde, otatiga inche timbaraarereti? Monyabere okomocha okwo!
swahili: Je, ninyi ni kitu gani mlichopungukiwa kuliko makanisa mengine, ila tu kwamba mimi sikuwa mzigo kwenu? Nisameheni kwa kosa hili!

english: See, I am ready to come to you a third time, and I will not be a burden, because I am not seeking your possessions, but you. For children should not have to save up for their parents, but parents for their children.
ekegusii: Rora, ekero eke nekia gatato inche nabeire ang’e gocha ase more. Tinkobaraarereria, naki tindi korigia ebinto biaino, korende inwe abanyene, ekiagera abana tibagwenereti kobagachera abaibori enibo, korende abaibori bagachere abana.
swahili: Sasa niko tayari kuja kwenu kwa mara hii ya tatu, nami sitawalemea, kwa sababu sitahitaji chochote chenu, ila ninawahitaji ninyi, kwa kuwa hata hivyo watoto hawaweki akiba kwa ajili ya wazazi wao, bali wazazi huweka akiba kwa ajili ya watoto wao.

english: And for the sake of your souls, I will most gladly spend my money and myself. If I love you more, will you love me less?
ekegusii: Ase omogooko omonge ninyebeke, naende ninyerue ase engencho y’emioyo yaino. Onye nkomenta kobancha mono, Inee, ningwenerete koremerwa obwanchani?
swahili: Hivyo nitafurahi kutumia kila kitu nilicho nacho kwa ajili yenu, hata mwili wangu pia. Hata ingawa inaonekana ninavyozidi kuwapenda, ndivyo upendo wenu kwangu unavyopungua.

english: Be that as it may, I was not a burden to you; but crafty as I am, I caught you by trickery.
ekegusii: Korende abe bo, inche timbaraarereti, korende ekiagera inde omong’aini nkabanyora ase obong’ainereria.
swahili: Iwe iwavyo, kwa vyovyote vile mimi sikuwalemea. Lakini kwa mimi kuwa mwerevu naliwapata.

english: Did I exploit you by anyone I sent you?
ekegusii: Inee! Nabaurete gento goetera ase onde bwensi natomete ase more?
swahili: Je, nilijipatia faida kwa kumtumia mtu yeyote niliyemtuma kwenu?

english: I urged Titus to visit you, and I sent our brother with him. Did Titus exploit you in any way? Did we not walk in the same Spirit and follow in the same footsteps?
ekegusii: Ngasorora Tito agende; ngatoma oyominto oria amo nere. Inee! Tito nabaurete gento? Titwagendete ase Omoika oria oria? Titwataarete ase chimbaratero chiria chiria?
swahili: Nilimshawishi Tito aje kwenu, nami nilimtuma pamoja na ndugu yetu. Je, Tito aliwatumia ninyi ili kujipatia faida? Je, hatuenendi kwa roho moja, na hatuchukui hatua zile zile?

english: Have you been thinking all along that we were making a defense to you? We speak before God in Christ, and all of this, beloved, is to build you up.
ekegusii: Inee! Mokagete ng’a iga togwekengera ase more naende? Ase obosio bwa Nyasae nigo togokwana ase Kristo. Na aya onsi akorirwe ase okobaagacha inwe abanchwa.
swahili: Je, mmekuwa mkifikiri kwamba sisi tunajaribu kujitetea mbele yenu? Sisi tumekuwa tukinena mbele za Mungu kama wale walio katika Kristo. Na chochote tufanyacho, ndugu wapendwa, ni kwa ajili ya kuwatia nguvu.

english: I know a man in Christ who fourteen years ago was caught up to the third heaven. Whether it was in the body or out of it I do not know, but God knows.
ekegusii: Namanyire omonto oyomo ase Kristo, yaetire emiaka ikomi na ene, omonto oyio akabogorigwa gochia igoro ya gatato, (onye orenge ase omobere tinkomanya, onye orenge isiko y’omobere tinkomanya, Nyasae nere omanyete).
swahili: Namjua mtu mmoja katika Kristo ambaye miaka kumi na minne iliyopita alichukuliwa juu hadi mbingu ya tatu. Kama ni katika mwili au nje ya mwili, sijui, Mungu ajua.

english: For I am afraid that when I come, I may not find you as I wish, and you may not find me as you wish. I fear that there may be quarreling, jealousy, rage, rivalry, slander, gossip, arrogance, and disorder.
ekegusii: Naki nairokire, ng’a inse gocha timbanyora buna ndigetie kobanyora; naende ndorekane ase more, tari buna morigetie inwe. Aande gose mbanyore more neriomana, ne ribero, na endamwamu, na okweancha, na ogoitania, na okogenkana, na oboenenu, ne rirorooche.
swahili: Kwa kuwa nina hofu ya kwamba nitakapokuja naweza kuwakuta nisivyotaka, nanyi mkanikuta msivyotaka. Nina hofu kwamba panaweza kuwa na ugomvi, wivu, ghadhabu, fitina, masingizio, masengenyo, majivuno na machafuko.

english: I am afraid that when I come again, my God will humble me before you, and I will be grieved over many who have sinned earlier and have not repented of their acts of impurity, sexual immorality, and debauchery.
ekegusii: Naende nairokire, ng’a inse gocha naende, Nyasae one nankeyie inse ase more, nimbaichanere mono ase abwo bamochete kare, abataonchogete korwa ase eubi, na obotomani, na obonyaka obwo bare kwenaria.
swahili: Nina hofu kwamba nitakapokuja tena kwenu, Mungu wangu atanidhili mbele yenu, nami nitasikitishwa na wengi waliotenda dhambi mbeleni, na wala hawajatubu kwa uchafu wao, uasherati, na ufisadi walioushiriki.

english: And I know that this man—whether in the body or out of it I do not know, but God knows—
ekegusii: Na inche namanyire omonto oyio, (onye orenge ase omobere tinkomanya, onye orenge isiko y’omobere tinkomanya, Nyasae nere omanyete);
swahili: Nami najua ya kwamba mtu huyu, kwamba ni katika mwili au nje ya mwili mimi sijui, lakini Mungu ajua,

english: was caught up to Paradise. The things he heard were too sacred for words, things that man is not permitted to tell. Paul’s Thorn and God’s Grace
ekegusii: igo abogoretigwe goika Paradiso ya Nyasae, akaigwa amang’ana atagwatoreka, ayatagwenerete Mwanyabaanto ayakwane.
swahili: alinyakuliwa hadi Paradiso. Huko alisikia mambo yasiyoelezeka, mambo ambayo binadamu hana ruhusa ya kuyasimulia.

english: I will boast about such a man, but I will not boast about myself, except in my weaknesses.
ekegusii: Ase engencho y’omonto oyio ninyetogie; korende ase engencho yane tingwetogia, otatiga ase oboreu bwane.
swahili: Nitajisifu kwa ajili ya mtu kama huyo, lakini sitajisifu kuhusu mimi mwenyewe ila mimi nitajisifia udhaifu wangu.

english: Even if I wanted to boast, I would not be a fool, because I would be speaking the truth. But I refrain, so no one will credit me with more than he sees in me or hears from me,
ekegusii: Naki onye ndigetie gwetogia anga tinaba omoriri, ekiagera nintebe ekeene. Korende ninyetange, omonto tambarera kobua aya aroche ase ’nde, gose koyaigwa korwa ase ’nde.
swahili: Hata kama ningependa kujisifu, sitakuwa mjinga, kwa maana nitakuwa nasema kweli. Lakini najizuia, ili mtu yeyote asije akaniona mimi kuwa bora zaidi kuliko ninavyoonekana katika yale ninayotenda na kusema.

english: or because of these surpassingly great revelations. So to keep me from becoming conceited, I was given a thorn in my flesh, a messenger of Satan, to torment me.
ekegusii: Erinde timbaisa gocha koenena goetania ekerengo, ekiagera ase obonge bw’okomaanorerwa okwo, nkaegwa riigwa rimbetete ase omobere, omotomwa o Saitani, ang’ake, timbaisa gocha koenena goetania ekerengo.
swahili: Ili kunizuia nisijivune kwa sababu ya ufunuo huu mkuu, nilipewa mwiba katika mwili wangu, mjumbe wa Shetani, ili anitese.

english: Three times I pleaded with the Lord to take it away from me.
ekegusii: Ase engencho y’egento eke ngasaba Omonene ara gatato kendue.
swahili: Kwa habari ya jambo hili nilimsihi Bwana mara tatu aniondolee mwiba huu.

english: But He said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for My power is perfected in weakness.” Therefore I will boast all the more gladly in my weaknesses, so that the power of Christ may rest on me.
ekegusii: Korende aganteebia, “Obuya bwane bwagoisanire, ekiagera chinguru chiane chiaikeranirie ase oboreu.” Nabo ninyetogerie amareu aane ase omogooko, erio chinguru chia Kristo chiikaranse igoro ase ’nde.
swahili: Lakini aliniambia, “Neema yangu inakutosha, kwa kuwa uweza wangu hukamilika katika udhaifu.” Kwa hiyo nitajisifu kwa furaha zaidi kuhusu udhaifu wangu, ili uweza wa Kristo ukae juu yangu.

english: This is the third time I am coming to you. “Every matter must be established by the testimony of two or three witnesses.”
ekegusii: Ekero eke nekia gatato ngocha ase more. Ase emenwa y’abarori babere gose batato kera ring’ana nariikeranigwe.
swahili: Hii ndiyo mara ya tatu mimi kuja kwenu. “Shtaka lolote lazima lithibitishwe na mashahidi wawili au watatu.”

english: This is why I write these things while absent, so that when I am present I will not need to be severe in my use of the authority that the Lord gave me for building you up, not for tearing you down. Benediction and Farewell
ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio nariikire aya ekero ntari agwo, erinde nkoba agwo tinkorera obotindi ase ekerengo gi’okobua koria naetwe n’Omonene ase okobaagacha, gose tari ase okobatagora. Omoerio
swahili: Hii ndiyo sababu nawaandikia mambo haya wakati sipo, ili nikija nisiwe mkali katika kutumia mamlaka yangu, mamlaka Bwana aliyonipa ya kuwajenga ninyi wala si ya kuwabomoa. Salamu Za Mwisho

english: Finally, brothers, rejoice! Aim for perfect harmony, encourage one another, be of one mind, live in peace. And the God of love and peace will be with you.
ekegusii: Omoerio, abaminto, motigare buya. Mobe abaikeranu, moremigwe, mobe nomoyo oyomo, momenye ase omorembe. Na Nyasae bw’obwanchani na bw’omorembe abe amo nainwe.
swahili: Hatimaye, ndugu zangu, kwaherini. Kuweni wakamilifu, mkafarijike, kuweni wa nia moja, kaeni kwa amani. Naye Mungu wa upendo na amani atakuwa pamoja nanyi.

english: Greet one another with a holy kiss.
ekegusii: Kwanania ase okonyunyuntana ase obochenu. Abachenu bonsi baabakwanirie.
swahili: Salimianeni ninyi kwa ninyi kwa busu takatifu.

english: I already warned you the second time I was with you. So now in my absence I warn those who sinned earlier and everyone else: If I return, I will not spare anyone,
ekegusii: Natang’anete kobamanyia, ekero narenge seino eria kabere, naboigo bono ntaracha natang’anire komanyia abwo bakorete ebibe kare, na abande bonsi, ng’a tinkobaabera,
swahili: Nimekwisha kuwaonya nilipokuwa pamoja nanyi mara ya pili. Sasa narudia wakati sipo, kwamba nikija tena sitawahurumia wale waliokuwa wametenda dhambi hapo awali na wengine wote,

english: since you are demanding proof that Christ is speaking through me. He is not weak in dealing with you, but is powerful among you.
ekegusii: ekiagera morigetie ekiorokererio gia Kristo ng’a ere nigo agokwana ime yaino. Ere tari omoreu ase more, korende nare ne chinguru ime ase more.
swahili: kwa kuwa mnadai uthibitisho kwamba Kristo anazungumza kwa kunitumia mimi. Yeye si dhaifu katika kushughulika nanyi, bali ana nguvu kati yenu.

english: For He was indeed crucified in weakness, yet He lives by God’s power. And though we are weak in Him, yet by God’s power we will live with Him to serve you.
ekegusii: Naki igo abambetwe ase oboreu, korende moyo are ase okobua kwa Nyasae. Naki intwe nigo tore abareu asare; korende natobe moyo amo nere ase okobua kwa Nyasae gocha ase more.
swahili: Kwa kuwa alisulubiwa katika udhaifu, lakini anaishi kwa nguvu za Mungu. Vivyo hivyo, sisi tu dhaifu kupitia kwake, lakini katika kuwashughulikia ninyi tutaishi pamoja naye kwa nguvu za Mungu.

english: Examine yourselves to see whether you are in the faith; test yourselves. Can’t you see for yourselves that Jesus Christ is in you—unless you actually fail the test?
ekegusii: Erenge inwe abanyene emioyo yaino gose more ase okwegena; eteeme inwe abanyene. Gose timwemanyeti ng’a Yeso Kristo nare ime ase more? Onye taibo, rirorio mwangirwe!
swahili: Jichunguzeni wenyewe mwone kama mnaishi katika imani. Jipimeni wenyewe. Je, hamtambui ya kuwa Yesu Kristo yumo ndani yenu? Kama sivyo, basi, mmeshindwa kufikia kipimo hicho!

english: And I hope you will realize that we have not failed the test.
ekegusii: Korende nasemeirie ng’a namomanye ng’a intwe titwangiri.
swahili: Natumaini mtaona kuwa sisi hatukushindwa.

english: Now we pray to God that you will not do anything wrong—not that we will appear to have stood the test, but that you will do what is right, even if we appear to have failed.
ekegusii: Korende twasabire Nyasae, timokora rinde rire riibe, tari ng’a intwe tororekane twancheirwe, korende inwe mokore erire rigiya, natoisa koba intwe buna abangirwe.
swahili: Lakini tunamwomba Mungu msije mkatenda kosa lolote, si ili sisi tuonekane kuwa tumeshinda hilo jaribio, bali ili ninyi mtende lililo haki, hata kama tutaonekana kuwa tumeshindwa.

english: For we cannot do anything against the truth, but only for the truth.
ekegusii: Naki titokonyara gokora ring’ana mamincha y’ekeene, korende ase ekeene.
swahili: Kwa maana hatuwezi kufanya lolote kinyume na kweli, bali kuithibitisha kweli tu.

english: In fact, we rejoice when we are weak but you are strong, and our prayer is for your perfection.
ekegusii: Naki twagokire ekero intwe tore abareu, na inwe more ne chinguru. Eri twasabire neri, ng’a moikeranigwe.
swahili: Tunafurahi wakati wowote sisi tunapokuwa dhaifu, lakini ninyi mkawa na nguvu. Nayo maombi yetu ni kwamba mpate kuwa wakamilifu.

english: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, and Timothy our brother, To the church of God in Corinth, together with all the saints throughout Achaia:
ekegusii: Inche Paulo, omotomwa o Kristo Yeso ase ogwancha kwa Nyasae, amo noyominto Timotheo nkobariikera tore inwe abekanisa ya Nyasae ere ase Korinto amo n’abanto bonsi ba Nyasae abare ase ense yonsi y’Akaya.
swahili: Barua hii ni kutoka kwangu mimi Paulo, mtume wa Kristo Yesu kwa mapenzi ya Mungu, na Timotheo ndugu yetu, Kwa kanisa la Mungu lililoko Korintho, pamoja na watakatifu wote walioko Akaya yote:

english: He has delivered us from such a deadly peril, and He will deliver us. In Him we have placed our hope that He will yet again deliver us,
ekegusii: oyototooretie korwa ase amakweri amanene buna aria, naende natotoorie ase ekero kegochi‐gocha. Ere ntomosemeretie ng’a nagenderere gototooria,
swahili: Yeye aliyetuokoa kwenye hatari kubwa ya kifo na atatuokoa tena. Kwake yeye tumeweka tumaini letu kwamba ataendelea kutuokoa.

english: as you help us by your prayers. Then many will give thanks on our behalf for the favor shown us in answer to their prayers. Paul’s Change of Plans
ekegusii: ekero inwe boigo mogotokonya amo ase ogotosabera. Ase igo, abanto abange baakere Nyasae ng’a mbuya mono ase engencho yaito, ase obuya obo twaeirwe, ekiagera abange bagotosabera. Paulo okoonchora omooroberio orogendo kwaye
swahili: Kama vile mlivyoungana kusaidiana nasi katika maombi, hivyo wengi watatoa shukrani kwa niaba yetu kwa ajili ya baraka za neema tulizopata kwa majibu ya maombi ya wengi. Paulo Aahirisha Ziara

english: And this is our boast: Our conscience testifies that we have conducted ourselves in the world, and especially in relation to you, in the holiness and sincerity that are from God—not in worldly wisdom, but in the grace of God.
ekegusii: Naki ogwetogia gwaito nakwo oko, ng’a chinkoro chiaito ime nigo chigotworokia, ng’a ase obogima bwaito ase ense eye na mono kobua ase egati yaino, nigo tware kogamberwa nobochenu na oborabu bw’omoyo bokorwa ase Nyasae, tari ase obong’aini bwa Mwanyabaanto, korende ase obuya bwa Nyasae.
swahili: Basi haya ndiyo majivuno yetu: Dhamiri yetu inatushuhudia kwamba tumeenenda katika ulimwengu na hasa katika uhusiano wetu na ninyi, katika utakatifu na uaminifu utokao kwa Mungu. Hatukufanya hivyo kwa hekima ya kidunia bali kwa neema ya Mungu.

english: For we do not write you anything that is beyond your ability to read and understand. And I hope that you will understand us completely,
ekegusii: Naki titobarikereti inwe kende, otatiga ring’ana eri rioka moranyare gosoma na komanya. Na inche nasemeirie ng’a omoerio namonyare korimanya,
swahili: Kwa maana hatuwaandikii mambo ambayo hamwezi kusoma au kuyaelewa. Natumaini kwamba,

english: as you have already understood us in part, so that you may boast of us just as we will boast of you in the day of our Lord Jesus.
ekegusii: buna motomanyete ensemo, ng’a intwe nigo tore ogwetogia kwaino, buna inwe more ase tore ase rituko riria ri’Omonene Yeso.
swahili: kama vile mlivyotuelewa kwa sehemu, mtakuja kuelewa kwa ukamilifu ili mweze kujivuna kwa ajili yetu, kama na sisi tutakavyojivuna kwa ajili yenu katika siku ya Bwana Yesu.

english: Confident of this, I planned to visit you first, so that you might receive a double blessing.
ekegusii: Ekiagera narenge nobomaene obo nkarigia gocha ase more agwo ritang’ani, erinde monyore ogosesenigwa ara kabere.
swahili: Kwa kuwa nilikuwa na uhakika wa mambo haya, nilitaka nije kwenu kwanza, ili mpate faida mara mbili.

english: I wanted to visit you on my way to Macedonia, and to return to you from Macedonia, and then to have you help me on my way to Judea.
ekegusii: Ninganetie goetera seino ekero nkogenda Makedonia, naende nkorwa Makedonia ning’iranere seino, erinde monkoobe ase orogendo rwane gochia Boyahudi.
swahili: Nilipanga kuwatembelea nikiwa safarini kwenda Makedonia na kurudi tena kwenu nikitoka Makedonia, ili mnisafirishe katika safari yangu ya kwenda Uyahudi.

english: When I planned this, did I do it carelessly? Or do I make my plans by human standards, so as to say “Yes, yes” when I really mean “No, no”?
ekegusii: Inee! Ekero narengereretie gokora aya, inarenge ne chitang’u‐tang’u koroisia emeroberio yane? Gose nigo nayeroisetie buna omonto bw’ense ore ang’e goteeba, “Ee, ee”, na, “Yaya, Yaya” ase chingaki echimo?
swahili: Nilipopanga jambo hili, je, nilikuwa kigeugeu? Au ninafanya mipango yangu kwa hali ya mwili, ili niseme, “Ndiyo, ndiyo” na “Siyo, siyo” wakati huo huo?

english: But as surely as God is faithful, our message to you is not “Yes” and “No.”
ekegusii: Korende buna Nyasae are omwegenwa, ring’ana riaito ase more tiriarenge “Ee” na “Yaya.”
swahili: Hakika kama Mungu alivyo mwaminifu, maneno yetu kwenu hayajawa “Ndiyo na Siyo.”

english: For the Son of God, Jesus Christ, who was proclaimed among you by me and Silvanus and Timothy, was not “Yes” and “No,” but in Him it has always been “Yes.”
ekegusii: Naki Omwana o Nyasae, Yeso Kristo, oyo inche na Silivano, na Timotheo, twarandetie ase egati yaino tabeete “Ee” na “Yaya”, korende asare “Ee” nero ereo botambe.
swahili: Kwa kuwa Yesu Kristo, Mwana wa Mungu, ambaye tulimhubiri kwenu: Mimi, Silvano na Timotheo, hakuwa “Ndiyo” na “Siyo,” bali kwake yeye siku zote ni “Ndiyo.”

english: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ. The God of All Comfort
ekegusii: Obuya bobe ase more na omorembe bikorwa ase Nyasae Tata oito na ase Omonene Yeso Kristo. Paulo ogoakera Nyasae mbuya mono
swahili: Neema na amani itokayo kwa Mungu Baba yetu na kwa Bwana Yesu Kristo iwe nanyi. Mungu Wa Faraja Yote

english: For all the promises of God are “Yes” in Christ. And so through Him, our “Amen” is spoken to the glory of God.
ekegusii: Naki chiira chionsi chia Nyasae nigo chire “Ee” ime asare; nakio gekogera togokwana “Amina” ase Yeso Kristo ase okoa Nyasae obonene.
swahili: Kwa maana ahadi zote za Mungu zilizo katika Kristo ni “Ndiyo.” Kwa sababu hii ni kwake yeye tunasema “Amen” kwa utukufu wa Mungu.

english: Now it is God who establishes both us and you in Christ. He anointed us,
ekegusii: Gaki Nyasae oyotokong’irie amo nainwe ase Kristo; nere otochorete,
swahili: Basi ni Mungu atufanyaye sisi pamoja nanyi kusimama imara katika Kristo. Ametutia mafuta

english: placed His seal on us, and put His Spirit in our hearts as a pledge of what is to come.
ekegusii: naende agatobeeka ekemanyererio kiaye, agatoa Omoika oye ase chinkoro chiaito okaba intenenera.
swahili: kwa kututia muhuri wake na kutupa Roho wake mioyoni mwetu kuwa rehani kwa ajili ya kututhibitishia kile kijacho.

english: I call God as my witness that it was in order to spare you that I did not return to Corinth.
ekegusii: Korende inche nigo nkorigia Nyasae ambere kirori, ng’a ase okobarorera inwe amaabera tindagenda Korinto.
swahili: Mungu ni shahidi wangu kwamba ilikuwa ni kwa ajili ya kuwahurumia ninyi sikurudi Korintho.

english: Not that we lord it over your faith, but we are fellow workers with you for your joy, because it is by faith that you stand firm.
ekegusii: Tari ng’a nkogambera tore okwegena kwaino; korende nigo togokora emeremo amo nainwe ase omogooko oino, ekiagera moteneine bokong’u ase okwegena.
swahili: Si kwamba tunatawala imani yenu, bali twatenda kazi pamoja nanyi kwa ajili ya furaha yenu, kwa sababu ni kwa imani mwasimama imara.
