english: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of compassion and the God of all comfort,
ekegusii: Nyasae, Tata Omonene oito Yeso Kristo, Tata bw’amaabera, Nyasae bw’okoremia gwonsi, atogigwe.
swahili: Ahimidiwe Mungu na Baba wa Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo, Baba wa huruma na Mungu wa faraja yote.

english: who comforts us in all our troubles, so that we can comfort those in any trouble with the comfort we ourselves have received from God.
ekegusii: Ere nigo agotoremia ase emechando yaito yonsi, erinde naintwe tonyare koremia baria bare ase emechando ende yonsi, ase okoremia okwo twaremigwe intwe abanyene na Nyasae.
swahili: Yeye hutufariji katika taabu zetu, ili tuweze kuwafariji walio katika taabu yoyote kwa faraja ambayo sisi wenyewe tumepokea kutoka kwa Mungu.

english: For just as the sufferings of Christ overflow to us, so also through Christ our comfort overflows.
ekegusii: Naki buna emechando ya Kristo yatobucheire, naboigo okoremigwa gwaito gwatobucheire ase enchera ya Kristo.
swahili: Kama vile mateso ya Kristo yanavyozidi ndani ya maisha yetu, hivyo ndivyo faraja yetu inavyofurika kwa njia ya Kristo.

english: If we are afflicted, it is for your comfort and salvation; if we are comforted, it is for your comfort, which accomplishes in you patient endurance of the same sufferings we experience.
ekegusii: Korende onye intwe tore ase emechando, nigo ere ase okobanyorera inwe okoremigwa na ogotooreka, na onye intwe tokoremigwa, nigo ere ase okobanyorera inwe okoremigwa, erinde monyore chinguru na okoremereria gw’okobogoria emechando eria eria tobabogoreretie intwe.
swahili: Kama tunataabika, ni kwa ajili ya faraja na wokovu wenu; kama tukifarijiwa, ni kwa ajili ya faraja yenu, iwaleteayo saburi ya mateso yale yale yanayotupata.

english: And our hope for you is sure, because we know that just as you share in our sufferings, so also you will share in our comfort.
ekegusii: Na ogosemeria gwaito ase engencho yaino nigo goteneine bokong’u, ekiagera twamanyire ng’a buna more ababwatani b’emechando eria, naboigo morabe ababwatani ase okoremigwa koria.
swahili: Nalo tumaini letu kwenu ni thabiti, kwa sababu tunajua kwamba kama vile mnavyoshiriki mateso yetu, ndivyo pia mnavyoshiriki katika faraja yetu.

english: We do not want you to be unaware, brothers, of the hardships we encountered in the province of Asia. We were under a burden far beyond our ability to endure, so that we despaired even of life.
ekegusii: Naki baminto, nigo twanchete momanye amang’ana ’emechando eria yatonyorete Asia. Chigurube chiria nigo chiaetanetie chinguru chiaito, goika tokerusia moyo koba moyo.
swahili: Ndugu wapendwa, hatutaki mkose kujua kuhusu zile taabu tulizopata huko Asia. Kwa maana tulilemewa na mizigo sana, kiasi cha kushindwa kuvumilia, hata tulikata tamaa ya kuishi.

english: Indeed, we felt we were under the sentence of death, in order that we would not trust in ourselves, but in God, who raises the dead.
ekegusii: Ee, intwe abanyene nigo twarenge nekina ki’amakweri ase emioyo yaito, erinde titwesemeria intwe abanyene, korende tosemerie Nyasae oyokobokia abakuure;
swahili: Kwa kweli, mioyoni mwetu tulihisi tumekabiliwa na hukumu ya kifo, ili tusijitegemee sisi wenyewe bali tumtegemee Mungu afufuaye wafu.

english: So I made up my mind not to make another painful visit to you.
ekegusii: Korende nkarengereria ase omoyo one, ng’a tingocha seino naende ase okobaichania.
swahili: Hivyo nilikusudia moyoni mwangu nisifanye ziara nyingine yenye kuwaumiza ninyi.

english: If you forgive anyone, I also forgive him. And if I have forgiven anything, I have forgiven it in the presence of Christ for your sake,
ekegusii: Onde bwensi morabere inwe, nainche nimwabere. Ekero nabeire omonto, onye namwabeire egento igo namwabeire ase engencho yaino ase obosio bwa Kristo,
swahili: Kama ninyi mkimsamehe mtu yeyote, mimi pia nimemsamehe. Kile nilichosamehe, kama kulikuwa na kitu chochote cha kusamehe, nimekwisha kusamehe mbele ya Kristo kwa ajili yenu,

english: in order that Satan should not outwit us. For we are not unaware of his schemes. Triumph in Christ
ekegusii: Saitani tabaisa gotobua; naki intwe titokomocha komanya obong’ainereria bwaye. Okogania gwa Paulo kogenda Troasi
swahili: ili Shetani asitushinde. Kwa maana hatuachi kuzijua hila zake. Wasiwasi Wa Paulo Huko Troa

english: Now when I went to Troas to preach the gospel of Christ and a door stood open for me in the Lord,
ekegusii: Gaki ekero naigete Teroa ase engencho y’okorandia enchiri ya Kristo, nkaigorerwa egesieri n’Omonene,
swahili: Basi nilipofika Troa kuhubiri Injili ya Kristo na kukuta kwamba Bwana alikuwa amenifungulia mlango,

english: I had no peace in my spirit, because I did not find my brother Titus there. So I said goodbye to them and went on to Macedonia.
ekegusii: korende tinanyora ogotimoka ase omoyo one, ekiagera ntanyorete oyominto Tito aroro. Erio nkabateebia ng’a batigare buya, nkaimoka nkagenda Makedonia. Obobui goetera ase Kristo
swahili: bado nilikuwa sina utulivu akilini mwangu kwa sababu sikumkuta ndugu yangu Tito huko. Hivyo niliagana nao nikaenda Makedonia.

english: But thanks be to God, who always leads us triumphantly as captives in Christ and through us spreads everywhere the fragrance of the knowledge of Him.
ekegusii: Nyasae aakerwe ng’a mbuya mono, ere oyogotoraa ase okobua okonene botambe ase Kristo, naende oyogosokia rimisu rigiya goetera ase tore, erinde bamomanye kera aase.
swahili: Lakini Mungu ashukuriwe, yeye ambaye siku zote hutufanya tuandamane kwa ushindi tukiwa ndani ya Kristo. Naye kupitia kwetu hueneza kila mahali harufu nzuri ya kumjua yeye.

english: For we are to God the sweet aroma of Christ among those who are being saved and those who are perishing.
ekegusii: Naki intwe nigo tore ogotioka okuya gwa Kristo ase obosio bwa Nyasae, ase abwo bagotoorigwa, na ase abwo bagosira;
swahili: Kwa maana sisi kwa Mungu ni harufu nzuri ya manukato ya Kristo miongoni mwa wale wanaookolewa na kwa wale wanaopotea.

english: To the one, we are an odor of death and demise; to the other, a fragrance that brings life. And who is qualified for such a task?
ekegusii: ase abwo bagosira ogotioka kw’amakweri gokorenta amakweri; ase abwo bagotoorigwa ogotioka kw’obogima gokorenta obogima. Ning’o oraisane ase amang’ana aya?
swahili: Kwa wale wanaopotea, sisi ni harufu ya mauti iletayo mauti; lakini kwa wale wanaookolewa, sisi ni harufu nzuri iletayo uzima. Ni nani awezaye mambo hayo?

english: For we are not like so many others, who peddle the word of God for profit. On the contrary, in Christ we speak before God with sincerity, as men sent from God.
ekegusii: Naki intwe titori buna abange abagokora okoonchorana okobe ase ring’ana ria Nyasae; korende buna abanto bagokwana ase oborabu bw’omoyo, buna abanto batomirwe na Nyasae. Ase obosio bwa Nyasae, nigo togokwana, tore ime ase Kristo.
swahili: Tofauti na watu wengine wengi, sisi hatufanyi biashara na Neno la Mungu kwa ajili ya kupata faida. Kinyume chake, katika Kristo tunalisema Neno la Mungu kwa unyoofu, kama watu tuliotumwa kutoka kwa Mungu.

english: For if I grieve you, who is left to cheer me but those whom I have grieved?
ekegusii: Naki onye inche nkobaichania, gaki ning’o orangokie, otatiga oria naichanirie?
swahili: Kwa kuwa kama nikiwahuzunisha ninyi, ni nani aliyebaki wa kunifurahisha isipokuwa ninyi ambao nimewahuzunisha?

english: I wrote as I did so that on my arrival I would not be saddened by those who ought to make me rejoice. I had confidence in all of you, that you would share my joy.
ekegusii: Inche nigo nabaiikerete ring’ana eri, erinde ngocha ting’ichanigwa na baria bagwenerete kongokia, naki ninsemeretie igoro yaino inwe mwensi, ng’a omogooko one noro oyoino mwensi.
swahili: Niliandika hivyo kama nilivyofanya, ili nikija nisihuzunishwe na wale watu ambao wangenifanya nifurahi. Nina uhakika na ninyi nyote, kwamba wote mngeshiriki furaha yangu.

english: For through many tears I wrote you out of great distress and anguish of heart, not to grieve you but to let you know how much I love you.
ekegusii: Naki ase emechando emenge na ase obororo bw’enkoro, naende ase amariga amange nigo nabarikerete, tari ng’a moichanigwe, korende monyare komanya obwanchani bwane obonge inde nabwo ase more. Okwabera omokori amabe
swahili: Kwa maana niliwaandikia kutokana na dhiki kubwa na kutaabika sana kwa moyo wangu tena kwa machozi mengi, shabaha yangu si ili niwasababishe mhuzunike bali kuwaonyesha kina cha upendo wangu kwenu. Msamaha Kwa Mwenye Dhambi

english: Now if anyone has caused grief, he has not grieved me but all of you—to some degree, not to overstate it.
ekegusii: Korende onye omonto orentire ogoichania, tang’ichaneti inche bweka, korende ase ensemo obaichanirie nainwe mwensi. Ase ogokwana igo, tinkoyakong’ia mono.
swahili: Lakini ikiwa mtu yeyote amesababisha huzuni, kwa kiasi fulani hakunihuzunisha mimi kama vile alivyowahuzunisha ninyi nyote, ili nisiwe mkali kupita kiasi.

english: The punishment imposed on him by the majority is sufficient for him.
ekegusii: Egesusuro eke omonto onga buna oyio aetwe nabange, nakio kiamoisanete.
swahili: Adhabu hii aliyopewa na wengi inamtosha.

english: So instead, you ought to forgive and comfort him, so that he will not be overwhelmed by excessive sorrow.
ekegusii: Ribaga ri’aya mbuya mwabere omonto buna oyio na komoremia, tabaisa kobugwa nogoichana, erinde erusie moyo.
swahili: Basi sasa badala yake, inawapasa kumsamehe na kumfariji, ili asigubikwe na huzuni kupita kiasi.

english: Therefore I urge you to reaffirm your love for him.
ekegusii: Ase ayio nabasoroire momworokie obwanchani bwaino.
swahili: Kwa hiyo, nawasihi, mpate kuuthibitisha tena upendo wenu kwa ajili yake.

english: My purpose in writing you was to see if you would stand the test and be obedient in everything.
ekegusii: Eke nakio kiagerete nkabariikera, erinde mbateeme na komanya gose mwabeire abaigweri ase amang’ana onsi.
swahili: Sababu ya kuwaandikia ni kuona kama mngeweza kushinda hilo jaribio na kutii katika kila jambo.

english: Are we beginning to commend ourselves again? Or do we need, like some people, letters of recommendation to you or from you?
ekegusii: Inee! Ntwachakire naende gwetogia intwe abanyene? Gose intwe ntogwenerete, buna abande, konyora amarube are nogotogigwa gocha ase more, gose ayakorwa ase more?
swahili: Je, tunaanza tena kujisifu wenyewe? Au tunahitaji kupata barua za utambulisho kwenu au kutoka kwenu, kama watu wengine?

english: Indeed, what was once glorious has no glory now in comparison to the glory that surpasses it.
ekegusii: Naki keria kiarenge nobonene tikegwatorwa bono ng’a nkere nobonene ase engencho y’obonene boria bore obonene kobua.
swahili: Kwa maana kile kilichokuwa na utukufu sasa hakina utukufu ukilinganisha na huu utukufu unaozidi wa Agano Jipya.

english: For if what was fading away came with glory, how much greater is the glory of that which endures!
ekegusii: Ekiagera onye boria bwaetete bwarenge nobonene bwaye, boria boreo botambe mbore nobonene kobua mono.
swahili: Ikiwa kile kilichokuwa kinafifia kilikuja kwa utukufu, je, si zaidi utukufu wa kile kinachodumu?

english: Therefore, since we have such a hope, we are very bold.
ekegusii: Gaki, ekiagera tore nogosemeria kore buna oko, iga tore noboremu obonge gatogokwana.
swahili: Kwa hiyo, kwa kuwa tunalo tumaini hili, tuna ujasiri sana.

english: We are not like Moses, who would put a veil over his face to keep the Israelites from gazing at the end of what was fading away.
ekegusii: Titogokora buna Musa oyotubete obosio bwaye, erinde Abaisraeli tibanyara korigereria mono omoerio bw’obonene boria bwarenge goeta.
swahili: Sisi si kama Mose, ambaye ilimpasa kuweka utaji ili kufunika uso wake ili Waisraeli wasiuone ule mngʼao uliokuwa juu yake hadi ulipofifia na hatimaye kutoweka.

english: But their minds were closed. For to this day the same veil remains at the reading of the old covenant. It has not been lifted, because only in Christ can it be removed.
ekegusii: Korende ebirengererio biabo bigakong’igwa. Naki nonya ngoika rituko ria reero, ekero amariiko y’okobwatana ogokoro agosomwa, egietubo ekio ekio keba tigekorusigwa, ekiagera ase Kristo bweka kiarusigwe.
swahili: Lakini akili zao zilipumbazwa, kwa maana mpaka leo utaji ule ule hufunika wakati Agano la Kale linasomwa. Huo utaji haujaondolewa, kwa maana ni katika Kristo peke yake unaondolewa.

english: And even to this day when Moses is read, a veil covers their hearts.
ekegusii: Nonya ndero ekero amachiiko a Musa agosomwa, egietubo keria ngetubete ase chinkoro chiabo.
swahili: Hata leo Sheria ya Mose inaposomwa, utaji hufunika mioyo yao.

english: But whenever anyone turns to the Lord, the veil is taken away.
ekegusii: Korende ekero omonto akoonchokera Omonene egietubo keria nigo gekorusigwa.
swahili: Lakini wakati wowote mtu anapomgeukia Bwana, utaji unaondolewa.

english: Now the Lord is the Spirit, and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is freedom.
ekegusii: Bono Omonene nere Omoika; na aase Omoika bw’Omonene ore, agwo nao obosibore bore.
swahili: Basi Bwana ndiye Roho. Mahali alipo Roho wa Bwana hapo pana uhuru.

english: And we, who with unveiled faces all reflect the glory of the Lord, are being transformed into His image with intensifying glory, which comes from the Lord, who is the Spirit.
ekegusii: Korende intwe twensi abatokorigereria obonene bw’Omonene namaiso atatubiri, nigo tokorora buna ase ekerore obonene obwo. Nigo tokoonchorwa koba buna omogwekano oye, na kogenda korwa ase obonene goika ase obonene. Aya nigo agokorwa n’Omonene oyore Omoika.
swahili: Nasi sote, tukiwa na nyuso zisizotiwa utaji tunadhihirisha utukufu wa Bwana, kama kwenye kioo. Nasi tunabadilishwa ili tufanane naye, toka utukufu hadi utukufu mkuu zaidi, utokao kwa Bwana, ambaye ndiye Roho.

english: You yourselves are our letter, inscribed on our hearts, known and read by everyone.
ekegusii: Inwe abanyene neriruube riaito ririikire ase chinkoro chiaito, rimanyekanete na gosomwa nabaanto bonsi.
swahili: Ninyi wenyewe ndio barua yetu iliyoandikwa katika mioyo yetu, inayojulikana na kusomwa na kila mtu.

english: It is clear that you are a letter from Christ, the result of our ministry, written not with ink but with the Spirit of the living God, not on tablets of stone but on tablets of human hearts.
ekegusii: Igo momanyekanete buya ng’a mwabeire riruube ria Kristo, erire emeremo y’ogokora gwaito, ririikire tari ase egwino, korende nase Omoika o Nyasae ore moyo; tari ase chibao chi’amagena, korende ase chibao chie chinkoro chia Mwanyabaanto.
swahili: Nanyi mwadhihirisha wazi kwamba ninyi ni barua itokayo kwa Kristo, matokeo ya huduma yetu, ambayo haikuandikwa kwa wino bali kwa Roho wa Mungu aliye hai, si katika vibao vya mawe, bali katika vibao ambavyo ni mioyo ya wanadamu.

english: Such confidence before God is ours through Christ.
ekegusii: Okwo nakwo ogosemeria tore nakwo ase obosio bwa Nyasae ase Kristo;
swahili: Hili ndilo tumaini tulilo nalo mbele za Mungu kwa njia ya Kristo.

english: Not that we are competent in ourselves to claim that anything comes from us, but our competence comes from God.
ekegusii: tari ng’a ntwoisanerete intwe abanyene korengereria ring’ana rinde rionsi rikorwa ase tore abanyene, korende ogoisanera gwaito nigo gokorwa ase Nyasae,
swahili: Si kwamba sisi tunafikiri kuwa tunaweza kufanya jambo lolote wenyewe, lakini nguvu yetu inatoka kwa Mungu.

english: And He has qualified us as ministers of a new covenant, not of the letter but of the Spirit; for the letter kills, but the Spirit gives life. The Glory of the New Covenant (Exodus 34:10–35)
ekegusii: oyotoisaneirie koba abasomba b’okobwatana okoyia; tari ase ririiko, korende ase Omoika. Naki ririiko nigo rigoita, korende Omoika orua obogima.
swahili: Ndiye alituwezesha sisi kuwa wahudumu wa Agano Jipya: si wa andiko, bali wa Roho; kwa kuwa andiko huua bali Roho hutia uzima. Utukufu Wa Agano Jipya

english: Now if the ministry of death, which was engraved in letters on stone, came with such glory that the Israelites could not gaze at the face of Moses because of its fleeting glory,
ekegusii: Bono onye ogokora kw’amakweri kore ase amariiko, ayariikire chinuguta na komang’erwa ase amagena, gwachete ase obonene, goika Abaisraeli tibanyara korigereria obosio bwa Musa, ase engencho y’obonene bw’obosio bwaye; na obonene obwo bogaeta,
swahili: Basi ikiwa ile huduma iliyoleta mauti, iliyoandikwa kwa herufi juu ya jiwe ilikuja kwa utukufu, hata Waisraeli wakawa hawawezi kuutazama uso wa Mose kwa sababu ya ule utukufu wake ingawa ulikuwa ni wa kufifia,

english: will not the ministry of the Spirit be even more glorious?
ekegusii: Inee, ogokora kw’Omoika tigokoba nobonene goetania boria?
swahili: je, huduma ya Roho haitakuwa na utukufu zaidi?

english: For if the ministry of condemnation was glorious, how much more glorious is the ministry of righteousness!
ekegusii: Naki onye ogokora gw’ekiina kwarenge nobonene, igo ogokora kw’oboronge nkore nobonene kobua mono.
swahili: Ikiwa huduma ile inayowahukumu wanadamu ina utukufu, je, ile huduma iletayo haki haitakuwa ya utukufu zaidi?

english: Therefore, since God in His mercy has given us this ministry, we do not lose heart.
ekegusii: Ase ayio, ekiagera tore nobosomba obo koreng’ana namaabera a Nyasae aya twanyorire, titokwa emioyo.
swahili: Kwa hiyo, kwa kuwa tuna huduma hii kwa rehema za Mungu, hatukati tamaa.

english: We always carry around in our body the death of Jesus, so that the life of Jesus may also be revealed in our body.
ekegusii: Botambe nigo tokobogoria ase emebere yaito ogokwa kwa Yeso, erinde obogima bwa Yeso naborobwo boorokigwe ase emebere yaito.
swahili: Siku zote twachukua katika mwili kufa kwake Yesu ili kwamba uzima wa Yesu uweze kudhihirika katika miili yetu.

english: For we who are alive are always consigned to death for Jesus’ sake, so that the life of Jesus may also be revealed in our mortal body.
ekegusii: Naki intwe ekero tore moyo, amatuko onsi nigo tokoruegwa tokwe ase engencho ya Yeso, erinde obogima bwa Yeso boorokigwe ase emebere yaito eyekonyorwa namakweri.
swahili: Kwa maana sisi tulio hai siku zote tumetolewa tufe kwa ajili ya Yesu, ili kwamba uzima wake upate kudhihirishwa katika mwili wetu upatikanao na mauti.

english: So then, death is at work in us, but life is at work in you.
ekegusii: Gaki amakweri nigo agokora emeremo ime yaito, korende obogima ime yaino.
swahili: Hivyo basi, mauti inatenda kazi ndani yetu, bali uzima unatenda kazi ndani yenu.

english: And in keeping with what is written: “I believed, therefore I have spoken,” we who have the same spirit of faith also believe and therefore speak,
ekegusii: Naboigo naintwe, ekiagera tore n’Omoika oria oria bw’okwegena buna eriikire, “Negenete, na ase engencho eyio ngakwana”, igo twegenire, na ase engencho eyio nigo togokwana.
swahili: Imeandikwa, “Niliamini, kwa hiyo nimesema.” Kwa roho yule yule wa imani pia tuliamini na hivyo tunasema,

english: knowing that the One who raised the Lord Jesus will also raise us with Jesus and present us with you in His presence.
ekegusii: Twamanyire ng’a ere oyobogetie Omonene Yeso natobokie naintwe amo na Yeso, na atorente amo nainwe ase obosio bwaye.
swahili: kwa sababu tunajua kwamba yeye aliyemfufua Bwana Yesu kutoka kwa wafu, atatufufua sisi pia pamoja na Yesu na kutuleta sisi pamoja nanyi mbele zake.

english: All this is for your benefit, so that the grace that is extending to more and more people may overflow in thanksgiving, to the glory of God.
ekegusii: Naki amang’ana onsi nigo agokorwa ase engencho yaino, erinde obuya obwo bomentwe ase abwo abange, ogoaka ng’a mbuya mono komentwe, na Nyasae abakwe. Komenya ase okwegena
swahili: Haya yote ni kwa faida yenu, ili kwamba neema ile inavyowafikia watu wengi zaidi na zaidi, ipate kusababisha shukrani nyingi kwa utukufu wa Mungu.

english: Therefore we do not lose heart. Though our outer self is wasting away, yet our inner self is being renewed day by day.
ekegusii: Ase ayio, titogokwa emioyo; korende nonya omonto oito o isiko ogosarigwa, omonto oito o ime akorwe omoyia rituko ase rituko.
swahili: Kwa hiyo, hatukati tamaa. Ingawa utu wetu wa nje unachakaa, utu wetu wa ndani unafanywa upya siku kwa siku.

english: For our light and momentary affliction is producing for us an eternal glory that is far beyond comparison.
ekegusii: Naki emechando yaito eyere y’ekero egeke gioka nemegusu, egotoroiseria obonene bwa kare na kare obore obonge mono kobua.
swahili: Kwa maana dhiki yetu nyepesi iliyo ya kitambo inatutayarisha kwa ajili ya utukufu wa milele unaozidi kuwa mwingi kupita kiasi,

english: So we fix our eyes not on what is seen, but on what is unseen. For what is seen is temporary, but what is unseen is eternal.
ekegusii: Titorigereria ebinto ebikororekana, korende ebitakororekana; naki ebikororekana nebi’ekero egeke gioka, korende ebitakororekana nebia kare na kare.
swahili: kwa sababu hatuangalii yale yanayoweza kuonekana bali yale yasiyoweza kuonekana. Kwa maana yale yanayoweza kuonekana ni ya kitambo tu, bali yale yasiyoweza kuonekana ni ya milele.

english: Instead, we have renounced secret and shameful ways. We do not practice deceit, nor do we distort the word of God. On the contrary, by open proclamation of the truth, we commend ourselves to every man’s conscience in the sight of God.
ekegusii: Twangire amang’ana y’obosooku ayabisegete, gose titori gotaara ase obong’ainereria, gose gokorera ring’ana ria Nyasae noborimo. Korende ase okoorokia ayare ay’ekeene tweorokirie ase abanto bonsi ase okomanya gwe chinkoro chiabo ime, ng’a ntore nekeene ase obosio bwa Nyasae.
swahili: Tumekataa mambo ya siri na ya aibu, wala hatufuati njia za udanganyifu, tukichanganya Neno la Mungu na uongo. Kinyume cha hayo, tunadhihirisha kweli waziwazi na kujitambulisha wenyewe kwenye dhamiri ya kila mtu mbele za Mungu.

english: And even if our gospel is veiled, it is veiled to those who are perishing.
ekegusii: Korende onye enchiri yaito yabisekanete, nigo yabisekanete ase abwo bagosira.
swahili: Hata nayo Injili yetu kama imetiwa utaji, ni kwa wale tu wanaopotea.

english: The god of this age has blinded the minds of unbelievers so they cannot see the light of the gospel of the glory of Christ, who is the image of God.
ekegusii: Ase ayio enyasae y’ense eye yaukoirie ebirengererio bi’abwo bategeneti, erinde omobaso bw’enchiri y’obonene bwa Kristo, oyore ekieni kia Nyasae, tobaikera.
swahili: Kwa habari yao, mungu wa dunia hii amepofusha akili za wasioamini, ili wasione nuru ya Injili ya utukufu wa Kristo, aliye sura ya Mungu.

english: For we do not proclaim ourselves, but Jesus Christ as Lord, and ourselves as your servants for Jesus’ sake.
ekegusii: Naki titori kwerandia intwe abanyene, korende Kristo Yeso buna Omonene, na intwe abanyene buna abasomba baino ase engencho ya Yeso.
swahili: Kwa maana hatujihubiri sisi wenyewe ila tunamhubiri Yesu Kristo kuwa ni Bwana na sisi ni watumishi wenu kwa ajili ya Yesu.

english: For God, who said, “Let light shine out of darkness,” made His light shine in our hearts to give us the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ. Treasure in Jars of Clay (Romans 6:1–14)
ekegusii: Naki Nyasae oyoteebete, “Omobaso nobare korwa ase omosunte”, nere obarire ase chinkoro chiaito ime, atoe omobaso bwe chisemi chi’obonene bwa Nyasae ase obosio bwa Kristo.
swahili: Kwa kuwa Mungu, yeye aliyesema, “Nuru na ingʼae gizani,” ameifanya nuru yake ingʼae mioyoni mwetu ili kutupatia nuru ya maarifa ya utukufu wa Mungu katika uso wa Kristo.

english: Now we have this treasure in jars of clay to show that this surpassingly great power is from God and not from us.
ekegusii: Korende ntore nobotenenku obo ime ase ebibekerero bi’amaroba, erinde aorokigwe ng’a okobua okonene gwe chinguru nigo gokorwa ase Nyasae, gose tikori korwa ase tore intwe abanyene.
swahili: Lakini tunayo hazina hii katika vyombo vya udongo, ili ijulikane wazi kwamba uwezo huu wa ajabu unatoka kwa Mungu wala si kwetu.

english: We are hard pressed on all sides, but not crushed; perplexed, but not in despair;
ekegusii: Korwa ase chinsemo chionsi nigo tokomigwa, korende titori komigeka; iga togoichanigwa, korende titogokwa emioyo,
swahili: Twataabika kila upande lakini hatuangamizwi; twaona wasiwasi lakini hatukati tamaa;

english: persecuted, but not forsaken; struck down, but not destroyed.
ekegusii: iga togochandwa, korende titori gotigwa; iga togoakwa inse, korende titori gosirigwa.
swahili: twateswa lakini hatuachwi; twatupwa chini lakini hatupondwi.

english: Now we know that if the earthly tent we live in is dismantled, we have a building from God, an eternal house in heaven, not built by human hands.
ekegusii: Naki twamanyire ng’a enyomba yaito ere buna eema eyere ey’ense eye, ekero erasarigwe ntore noboagacho borwete ase Nyasae, enyomba etaagachiri namaboko, eyere igoro kare na kare.
swahili: Kwa maana twajua kama hema yetu ya dunia tunayoishi ikiharibiwa, tunalo jengo kutoka kwa Mungu, nyumba iliyo ya milele kule mbinguni, isiyojengwa kwa mikono ya wanadamu.

english: For we must all appear before the judgment seat of Christ, that each one may receive his due for the things done in the body, whether good or bad. Ambassadors for Christ
ekegusii: Naki netogwenerete intwe twensi koorokigwa ase obosio bw’ekerogo gi’ekina gia Kristo; erio kera omonto anyore koreng’ana buna are gokora ase omobere, onye bire ebiya gose onye bire ebibe. Abasani amo na Nyasae goetera ase Kristo
swahili: Kwa kuwa sisi sote tutasimama mbele ya kiti cha hukumu cha Kristo, ili kila mmoja apate kulipwa kwa ajili ya yale ambayo yametendwa katika mwili wake, yakiwa mema au mabaya. Huduma Ya Upatanisho

english: Therefore, since we know what it means to fear the Lord, we try to persuade men. What we are is clear to God, and I hope it is clear to your conscience as well.
ekegusii: Nabo gatwamanyire komoiroka Omonene, twateemire kong’usa abanto; korende twamanyekanire ase obosio bwa Nyasae, na inche nasemeirie ng’a twamanyekanire ase okomanya gwe chinkoro chiaino ime boigo.
swahili: Basi, kwa kuwa tunajua kumcha Bwana, tunajitahidi kuwavuta wengine. Lakini Mungu anatufahamu dhahiri, nami natumaini kwamba tu dhahiri katika dhamiri zenu pia.

english: We are not commending ourselves to you again. Instead, we are giving you an occasion to be proud of us, so that you can answer those who take pride in appearances rather than in the heart.
ekegusii: Titogwetogia intwe abanyene ase obosio bwaino naende, korende twabaeire ribaga ri’ogwetogia ase engencho yaito erinde monyare koba nokoiraneria ase abagwetogia ase amang’ana a isiko oka, gose tari ase amang’ana y’enkoro ime.
swahili: Sio kwamba tunajaribu kujistahilisha kwenu tena, lakini tunataka kuwapa nafasi ili mwone fahari juu yetu mweze kuwajibu hao wanaoona fahari juu ya mambo yanayoonekana badala ya mambo yaliyo moyoni.

english: If we are out of our mind, it is for God; if we are of sound mind, it is for you.
ekegusii: Naki onye twasirerigwe nobong’aini bwaito, ayio nigo are ase Nyasae; gose onye tore nobong’aini bwaito, ayio nigo are ase engencho yaino.
swahili: Kama tumerukwa na akili, ni kwa ajili ya Mungu; kama tuna akili timamu, ni kwa ajili yenu.

english: For Christ’s love compels us, because we are convinced that One died for all, therefore all died.
ekegusii: Naki obwanchani bwa Kristo nigo bogotobetereria, ekiagera twamanyire ekeene ng’a onye oyomo okuure ase engencho ya bonsi, nabo bonsi bakuure.
swahili: Kwa kuwa upendo wa Kristo unatutia nguvu, kwa sababu tunasadiki kuwa mmoja alikufa kwa ajili ya wote, kwa hiyo wote walikufa.

english: And He died for all, that those who live should no longer live for themselves, but for Him who died for them and was raised again.
ekegusii: Ere agakwa ase engencho ya bonsi, erio abare moyo tibaaba moyo ase engencho yabo boka abanyene, korende nase engencho yaye ere oyokwete, naende akaboka ase engencho yabo. Obogima oboyia ime ya Kristo
swahili: Naye alikufa kwa ajili ya watu wote, ili kwamba wote wanaoishi wasiishi tena kwa ajili ya nafsi zao wenyewe, bali kwa ajili yake yeye aliyekufa na kufufuliwa tena kwa ajili yao.

english: So from now on we regard no one according to the flesh. Although we once regarded Christ in this way, we do so no longer.
ekegusii: Ase ayio, korwa bono intwe titomanyeti monto onde koreng’ana buna Mwanyabaanto bamomanyete; nonya intwe twamomanyete Kristo ritang’ani buna Mwanyabaanto bamomanyete, korende bono titokomomanya buna igo.
swahili: Hivyo tangu sasa hatumwangalii mtu yeyote kwa mtazamo wa kibinadamu. Ingawa wakati fulani tulimwangalia Kristo kwa namna ya kibinadamu, hatumwangalii tena hivyo.

english: Therefore if anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation. The old has passed away. Behold, the new has come!
ekegusii: Ase ayio, omonto karabe ime ya Kristo nigo are egetongwa ekeyia; ebia kare biaetire, rora bionsi biabeire ebiyia.
swahili: Kwa hiyo kama mtu akiwa ndani ya Kristo, amekuwa kiumbe kipya; ya kale yamepita, tazama, yamekuwa mapya.

english: All this is from God, who reconciled us to Himself through Christ and gave us the ministry of reconciliation:
ekegusii: Korende bionsi nigo bikorwa ase Nyasae, oyotobwatanirie intwe amo nere omonyene ase Kristo, nere otoeire obosomba bw’okobwatanigwa,
swahili: Haya yote yanatokana na Mungu, ambaye ametupatanisha sisi na nafsi yake kwa njia ya Yesu Kristo na kutupata sisi huduma ya upatanisho:

english: that God was reconciling the world to Himself in Christ, not counting men’s trespasses against them. And He has committed to us the message of reconciliation.
ekegusii: ekiagera Nyasae nigo arenge ime ya Kristo, akabwatania ense amo nere omonyene, tabaabarera ogosaria kwabo; ere obekire ase tore ring’ana ri’okobwatanigwa. Amang’ana y’okobwatanigwa
swahili: Kwamba Mungu alikuwa ndani ya Kristo akiupatanisha ulimwengu na nafsi yake mwenyewe, akiwa hawahesabii watu dhambi zao. Naye ametukabidhi sisi ujumbe huu wa upatanisho.

english: For in this tent we groan, longing to be clothed with our heavenly dwelling,
ekegusii: Naki intwe ase enyomba eye iga togwechanda, ntore namaiga koboyigwa obomenyo bwaito aaria igoro.
swahili: Katika hema hii twalia kwa uchungu, tukitamani kuvikwa makao yetu ya mbinguni,

english: Therefore we are ambassadors for Christ, as though God were making His appeal through us. We implore you on behalf of Christ: Be reconciled to God.
ekegusii: Nabo tore abatomire na Kristo; Nyasae nigo akobasorora inwe goetera ase emenwa yaito. Twabasoroire ase engencho ya Kristo: Mobwatanigwe na Nyasae.
swahili: Kwa hiyo sisi ni mabalozi wa Kristo, kana kwamba Mungu anawasihi kupitia kwa vinywa vyetu. Nasi twawaomba sana ninyi kwa niaba ya Kristo, mpatanishwe na Mungu.

english: God made Him who knew no sin to be sin on our behalf, so that in Him we might become the righteousness of God.
ekegusii: Nyasae omokorire ere, oyotamanyeti ebibe, koba ebibe ase engencho yaito, erio asare intwe tobe noboronge ase Nyasae.
swahili: Kwa maana Mungu alimfanya yeye asiyekuwa na dhambi kuwa dhambi kwa ajili yetu, ili sisi tupate kufanywa haki ya Mungu kwake yeye.

english: because when we are clothed, we will not be found naked.
ekegusii: Ekero twaboyigwe titokororekana tore getirianda.
swahili: kwa kuwa tukiisha kuvikwa hatutaonekana tena kuwa uchi.

english: So while we are in this tent, we groan under our burdens, because we do not wish to be unclothed but clothed, so that our mortality may be swallowed up by life.
ekegusii: Naki intwe, abatore ase enyomba eye ere buna eema, nigo togwechanda, toritoerwa, tari ng’a igo torigetie korusigwa ase enyomba eye, korende ntorigetie okoboyigwa konde, erinde egekonyorekana namakweri kemerwe nobogima.
swahili: Kwa kuwa tukiwa bado katika hema hii twalia kwa uchungu na kulemewa, kwa sababu hatutaki kuvuliwa bali kuvikwa makao yetu ya mbinguni ili kwamba kile kipatikanacho na mauti kimezwe na uzima.

english: And God has prepared us for this very purpose and has given us the Spirit as a pledge of what is to come.
ekegusii: Gaki ere oyotoroisetie ase amang’ana aya nere Nyasae, oyotoete Omoika buna ekebwaterero giantenenera.
swahili: Basi Mungu ndiye alitufanya kwa ajili ya jambo lilo hilo naye ametupa Roho Mtakatifu kuwa amana, akituhakikishia ahadi ya kile kijacho.

english: Therefore we are always confident, although we know that while we are at home in the body, we are away from the Lord.
ekegusii: Gaki amatuko onsi nigo tore nomoyo bw’oboremu, naende twamanyire ng’a ekero tore aa ase omobere nigo tomenyete aare korwa ase Omonene,
swahili: Kwa hiyo siku zote tunalo tumaini, hata ingawa tunajua kwamba wakati tukiwa katika mwili huu, tuko mbali na Bwana,

english: For we walk by faith, not by sight.
ekegusii: ekiagera nigo togotaara ase okwegena, tari ase okorora.
swahili: kwa maana twaenenda kwa imani wala si kwa kuona.

english: We are confident, then, and would prefer to be away from the body and at home with the Lord.
ekegusii: Ntore nomoyo bw’oboremu, na twarorire buya kobua korua ase omobere na komenya amo n’Omonene.
swahili: Naam, tunalo tumaini na ingekuwa bora zaidi kuuacha mwili huu na kwenda kukaa na Bwana.

english: So we aspire to please Him, whether we are here in this body or away from it.
ekegusii: Ase ayio, onye tore aa, gose onye titori aa, nigo okogania gwaito kore ng’a tomogwenere ere.
swahili: Kwa hiyo, kama tuko katika mwili huu au tuko mbali nao, lengo letu ni kumpendeza Bwana.

english: As God’s fellow workers, then, we urge you not to receive God’s grace in vain.
ekegusii: Na intwe gatogokora emeremo amo nere, twabasoroire timonyora obuya bwa Nyasae bosa.
swahili: Kama watendakazi pamoja na Mungu, tunawasihi msipokee neema ya Mungu bure.

english: sorrowful, yet always rejoicing; poor, yet making many rich; having nothing, and yet possessing everything.
ekegusii: twaichanigwe, korende amatuko onsi nigo tore nomogooko; tore abataka, korende twabatenenkirie abange, titori na gento, nonya nabo ntore n’ebinto bionsi. Okorigia obwanchani bw’abaonchogete
swahili: tukiwa kama wenye huzuni, lakini siku zote tukifurahi; tukionekana maskini, lakini tukitajirisha wengi; tukiwa kama wasio na kitu, lakini tuna vitu vyote.

english: We have spoken freely to you, Corinthians. Our hearts are open wide.
ekegusii: Twakwanire maiso marore nainwe, Abakorinto; twaigoire chinkoro chiaito ase more.
swahili: Tumesema nanyi wazi, enyi Wakorintho na kuwafungulieni mioyo yetu wazi kabisa.

english: It is not our affection, but yours, that is restrained.
ekegusii: Titosiegeti chinkoro chiaito ase more, korende inwe nigo mosiegete echiaino ase tore.
swahili: Sisi hatujizuii kuwapenda, bali ninyi mmeuzuia upendo wenu kwetu.

english: As a fair exchange, I ask you as my children: Open wide your hearts also. Do Not Be Unequally Yoked
ekegusii: Bono nigo ngokwana nainwe buna nabana baane more. Buna twabakoreire, nainwe motokorere bo, mogareyie chinkoro chiaino. Ogokuurerwa kw’ogotasanga nabategeneti
swahili: Sasa nasema, kama na watoto wangu: Ninyi pia ifungueni mioyo yenu kabisa. Msifungiwe Nira Pamoja Na Wasioamini

english: Do not be unequally yoked with unbelievers. For what partnership can righteousness have with wickedness? Or what fellowship does light have with darkness?
ekegusii: Timosiberanigwa rikorogoto amo nabategeneti. Naki nkobwatana ki kore ase egati y’oboronge na ogosaria? Gose ngosanga ki kore ase egati y’omobaso na omosunte?
swahili: Msifungiwe nira pamoja na watu wasioamini, kwa jinsi isivyo sawasawa, kwa maana pana uhusiano gani kati ya haki na uovu? Au kuna ushirika gani kati ya nuru na giza?

english: What harmony is there between Christ and Belial? Or what does a believer have in common with an unbeliever?
ekegusii: Naende nkobwatana ki kore ase egati ya Kristo na Beliali? Gose oyobwegenete, insemo ki abwate amo noyotegeneti?
swahili: Kuna mapatano gani kati ya Kristo na Beliari? Yeye aaminiye ana sehemu gani na yeye asiyeamini?

english: What agreement can exist between the temple of God and idols? For we are the temple of the living God. As God has said: “I will dwell with them and walk among them, and I will be their God, and they will be My people.”
ekegusii: Naende ngosanga ki kore ase egati ye Hekalu ya Nyasae na emegwekano y’ogosasiimwa? Naki intwe ne Hekalu ya Nyasae ore moyo, buna Nyasae ateebete, “Nimenye ime yabo, na ase egati yabo nintaare, na inche nimbe Nyasae obo, na barabwo nababe abanto baane.
swahili: Kuna mapatano gani kati ya Hekalu la Mungu na sanamu? Kwa kuwa sisi tu Hekalu la Mungu aliye hai. Kama Mungu alivyosema: “Nitakaa pamoja nao na kutembea katikati yao, nami nitakuwa Mungu wao, nao watakuwa watu wangu.”

english: “Therefore come out from among them and be separate, says the Lord. Touch no unclean thing, and I will receive you.”
ekegusii: Ase ayio, buna Omonene agoteeba: Soka korwa ase bare, mweatanane, gose timokuna egento getachenegeti, na inche nimbaroisie.
swahili: “Kwa hiyo tokeni miongoni mwao, mkatengwe nao, asema Bwana. Msiguse kitu chochote kilicho najisi, nami nitawakaribisha.”

english: And: “I will be a Father to you, and you will be My sons and daughters, says the Lord Almighty.”
ekegusii: Nimbe Iso oino, na inwe mobe abana baane, abamura na abaiseke. Nab’Omonene Omobui oteebire.”
swahili: “Mimi nitakuwa Baba kwenu, nanyi mtakuwa wanangu na binti zangu, asema Bwana Mwenyezi.”

english: For He says: “In the time of favor I heard you, and in the day of salvation I helped you.” Behold, now is the time of favor; now is the day of salvation!
ekegusii: Naki igo agoteeba, “Ase engaki yancheire nakoiraneretie ogosaba kwao, rituko ri’ogotooreka nagokonyete.” Rora, bono nario engaki y’ogwancherwa; rora, bono nario rituko ri’ogotooreka.
swahili: Kwa maana asema: “Wakati wangu uliokubalika nilikusikia, siku ya wokovu nilikusaidia.” Tazama, wakati uliokubalika ndio huu, siku ya wokovu ndiyo sasa. Taabu Za Paulo

english: We put no obstacle in anyone’s way, so that no one can discredit our ministry.
ekegusii: Titobeka ekegocha ase onde bwensi, erinde obosomba bwaito bobaise gokwanwa bobe,
swahili: Hatuweki kitu cha kukwaza katika njia ya mtu yeyote, ili huduma yetu isionekane kuwa na lawama.

english: Rather, as servants of God we commend ourselves in every way: in great endurance; in troubles, hardships, and calamities;
ekegusii: korende ase kera ring’ana twenyorere ogotogigwa okuya buna abasomba ba Nyasae, ase okoganya okonge, ase emechando, ase obokong’u, ase ogochandwa,
swahili: Bali kama watumishi wa Mungu tuonyeshe kwa kila njia: katika saburi nyingi; katika dhiki, katika misiba, na katika shida;

english: in beatings, imprisonments, and riots; in labor, sleepless nights, and hunger;
ekegusii: ase ogoakwa, ase ogosibwa, ase ogokorerwa rirorooche, ase emeremo, ase okorenda, ase enchara,
swahili: katika kupigwa, katika kufungwa gerezani na katika ghasia; katika kazi ngumu, katika kukesha na katika kufunga;

english: in purity, knowledge, patience, and kindness; in the Holy Spirit and in sincere love;
ekegusii: ase obochenu, ase okomanya, ase oboremereria, ase obwororo, ase Omoika Omochenu, ase obwanchani botari nobong’ainereria,
swahili: katika utakatifu, katika ufahamu, katika uvumilivu, na katika utu wema; katika Roho Mtakatifu na upendo wa kweli;

english: in truthful speech and in the power of God; with the weapons of righteousness in the right hand and in the left;
ekegusii: ase amang’ana y’ekeene, ase chinguru chia Nyasae. Nigo tore nebirwanero bi’oboronge ase okoboko gw’okorio na ase okoboko gw’okobee.
swahili: katika maneno ya kweli na katika nguvu za Mungu, kwa silaha za haki za mkono wa kuume na za mkono wa kushoto;

english: through glory and dishonor, slander and praise; viewed as imposters, yet genuine;
ekegusii: Twanyorire ogosikwa na ogotasikwa; togokwanwa bobe na togokwanwa buya. Twakorirwe buna abanto abang’ainereria, korende nabaanto b’ekeene tore,
swahili: katika utukufu na katika kudharauliwa; katika sifa mbaya na katika sifa nzuri; tukiwa kama wadanganyaji, lakini tukiwa wakweli;

english: as unknown, yet well-known; dying, and yet we live on; punished, yet not killed;
ekegusii: buna abatamanyekaneti, korende nigo tomanyekanete buya; buna abagokwa, na rora moyo tore. Twasusuirwe, korende titoitiri;
swahili: tukiwa maarufu, lakini tukihesabiwa kama tusiojulikana; tukiwa kama wanaokufa, lakini tunaishi; tukipigwa, lakini hatuuawi;

english: Therefore, beloved, since we have these promises, let us cleanse ourselves from everything that defiles body and spirit, perfecting holiness in the fear of God.
ekegusii: Abanchani baane, ekiagera tore ne chiira echio, twesibie intwe abanyene ogotacheneka kw’omobere na omoika, erio toikeranie obochenu ase okomoiroka Nyasae. Omogoko o Paulo
swahili: Wapenzi, kwa kuwa tunazo ahadi hizi, basi na tujitakase nafsi zetu kutokana na kila kitu kitiacho mwili na roho unajisi, tukitimiza utakatifu kwa kumcha Mungu. Furaha Ya Paulo

english: Godly sorrow brings repentance that leads to salvation without regret, but worldly sorrow brings death.
ekegusii: Naki ogoichanigwa okore ase ogwancha kwa Nyasae nigo gokorenta okoonchoka gokoraa gochia ase ogotooreka, gotari na kweitia; korende ogoichanigwa gw’ense nigo gokorenta amakweri.
swahili: Kwa maana huzuni ya kimungu huleta toba iletayo wokovu na wala haina majuto. Lakini huzuni ya kidunia husababisha mauti.

english: Consider what this godly sorrow has produced in you: what earnestness, what eagerness to clear yourselves, what indignation, what alarm, what longing, what zeal, what vindication! In every way you have proved yourselves to be innocent in this matter.
ekegusii: Rora buna ogoichanigwa okwo kore ase ogwancha kwa Nyasae kwabarenteire omokia, na ogwekengera, na okobea, okoiroka na amaiga amange, ogwetigana na egesiomba! Ase kera enchera mweorokererie koba motari na komocha ase ring’ana erio.
swahili: Tazameni jinsi huzuni hii ya kimungu ilivyoleta faida ndani yenu: bidii mliyo nayo, juhudi mliyofanya kujitetea, uchungu wenu, hofu yenu, upendo wenu, shauku yenu na jinsi mlivyokuwa tayari kutoa adhabu inayostahili. Kwa kila njia mmejithibitisha kuwa safi katika jambo hilo.

english: So even though I wrote to you, it was not on account of the one who did wrong or the one who was harmed, but rather that your earnestness on our behalf would be made clear to you in the sight of God.
ekegusii: Nabo, nonya nabariikerete, tindigeti ase engencho yaye ere oyokorete bobe, gose tari ase engencho yaye ere oyokoreretwe bobe, korende ogwetigana kwaino ase tore konyare koorokigwa ase more ase obosio bwa Nyasae.
swahili: Hivyo ingawa niliwaandikia, haikuwa kwa sababu ya huyo aliyekosa au huyo aliyekosewa. Lakini nilitaka ninyi wenyewe mwone, mbele za Mungu, jinsi mlivyojitoa kwa ajili yetu.

english: On account of this, we are encouraged. In addition to our own encouragement, we were even more delighted by the joy of Titus. For his spirit has been refreshed by all of you.
ekegusii: Ase ayio twaremiigwe. Na kobua ase okoremigwa okwo tokagookera mono omogooko o Tito, ekiagera omoyo oye otimokigwe nainwe mwensi.
swahili: Kwa ajili ya haya tumefarijika. Zaidi ya kule sisi kutiwa moyo, tulifurahi sana kumwona Tito alivyo na furaha, kwa sababu roho yake imeburudishwa na ninyi nyote.

english: Indeed, I was not embarrassed by anything I had boasted to him about you. But just as everything we said to you was true, so our boasting to Titus has proved to be true as well.
ekegusii: Naki onye ngwetogia asare ase engencho yaino, tinasoogetigwe; korende buna twabateebeetie amang’ana onsi ase ekeene, naboigo nogwetogia gwaito ase obosio bwa Tito nigo kwarenge ogw’ekeene.
swahili: Nilikuwa nimewasifu ninyi kwake, nanyi hamkuniaibisha. Lakini kila kitu tulichowaambia ninyi, kilikuwa kweli, hivyo kule kujisifu kwetu kwa Tito kuwahusu ninyi kumethibitishwa kuwa kweli pia.

english: And his affection for you is even greater when he remembers that you were all obedient as you welcomed him with fear and trembling.
ekegusii: Obwanchani bwaye bw’omoyo ase more bwamentekanire, ekero akoinyora okoigwera kwaino inwe mwensi, na buna mwamoroisetie ase okoiroka na okoiguswa.
swahili: Upendo wake kwenu unaongezeka sana anapokumbuka jinsi mlivyokuwa watiifu, na kumpokea kwa hofu na kutetemeka.

english: I rejoice that I can have complete confidence in you.
ekegusii: Nagokire, ekiagera ase kera ring’ana ninde nomoyo bw’oboremu ase engencho yaino.
swahili: Nafurahi kwamba ninaweza kuwatumaini ninyi kabisa.

english: Make room for us in your hearts. We have wronged no one, we have corrupted no one, we have exploited no one.
ekegusii: Toigorere chinkoro chiaino; titokorereti monto onde bobe, titosareti monto, titorieti monto kiaboama.
swahili: Tupatieni nafasi mioyoni mwenu. Hatujamkosea mtu yeyote, hatujampotosha mtu yeyote, wala hatujamdhulumu mtu yeyote.

english: I do not say this to condemn you. I have said before that you so occupy our hearts that we live and die together with you.
ekegusii: Tintebeti ring’ana eri erinde mbagambie inwe, ekiagera ritang’ani konya nabateebirie ng’a inwe nigo more ne ribaga ase chinkoro chiaito, ase ogokwa na okoba moyo amo.
swahili: Sisemi haya ili kuwahukumu, kwa kuwa nilisema mwanzo, kwamba ninyi mko mioyoni mwetu hata kwa kufa pamoja au kuishi pamoja.

english: Great is my confidence in you; great is my pride in you; I am filled with encouragement; in all our troubles my joy overflows.
ekegusii: Ninde noboremu obonge kongokwana nainwe; ogwetogia kwane igoro ase more nokonge; naichoirwe nokoremigwa. Ase ogochandwa gwaito gwonsi naichoirwe nomogooko omonge mono.
swahili: Mara nyingi najivuna kwa ajili yenu; naona fahari juu yenu. Nimejawa na faraja. Nina furaha kupita kiasi katika mateso yetu yote.

english: For when we arrived in Macedonia, our bodies had no rest, but we were pressed from every direction—conflicts on the outside, fears within.
ekegusii: Naki nonya nekero twaigete Makedonia, emebere yaito tiyanyorete ogotimoka, korende togaachandwa chinsemo chionsi; isiko ekaba esegi, na ime bokaba obwoba.
swahili: Kwa maana hata tulipoingia Makedonia, miili yetu haikuwa na raha. Tulisumbuliwa kila upande, kwa nje kulikuwa na mapigano na mioyoni mwetu tulikuwa na hofu.

english: But God, who comforts the downcast, comforted us by the arrival of Titus,
ekegusii: Korende Nyasae, oyokoremia abaichanete, agatoremia ase ogocha gwa Tito,
swahili: Bali Mungu, yeye awafarijie wenye huzuni, alitufariji kwa kufika kwake Tito.

english: and not only by his arrival, but also by the comfort he had received from you. He told us about your longing, your mourning, and your zeal for me, so that I rejoiced all the more.
ekegusii: gose tari ase ogocha kwaye gwoka, korende nonya nase okoremigwa koria aremetigwe nainwe. Agatoteebia amang’ana y’amaiga aino, na okweng’ereria kwaino, na omokia oino ase ’nde, goika nkamenta kogoka.
swahili: Lakini si kule kuja kwa Tito tu, bali pia kwa faraja mliyompa. Alitueleza jinsi mlivyonionea shauku, huzuni yenu kubwa na juhudi yenu kwa ajili yangu, ili kwamba furaha yangu ipate kuwa kubwa kuliko wakati wowote.

english: Even if I caused you sorrow by my letter, I do not regret it. Although I did regret it, I now see that my letter caused you sorrow, but only for a short time.
ekegusii: Naki nonya nabaichanetie ase riruube riria tinkweitia (nonya neitetie ritang’ani), ekiagera narorire ng’a riruube riria ndiabaichanetie, korende nase ekero egeke gioka.
swahili: Hata kama niliwahuzunisha kwa barua yangu, sijutii. Ingawa nilijuta kwa muda mfupi, kwa kuwa najua kwamba barua yangu iliwaumiza, lakini ni kwa kitambo tu,

english: And now I rejoice, not because you were made sorrowful, but because your sorrow led you to repentance. For you felt the sorrow that God had intended, and so were not harmed in any way by us.
ekegusii: Bono nagokire, tari ekiagera mwaichanetigwe, korende ekiagera mwaichanetigwe goika mokaonchoka, ekiagera nigo mwaichanetigwe ase ogwancha kwa Nyasae, erinde timonyara gosira ase ogokora gwaito.
swahili: lakini sasa nina furaha, si kwa sababu mlihuzunika, bali kwa kuwa huzuni hiyo iliwafanya mtubu. Kwa maana mlihuzunishwa kama Mungu alivyokusudia watu wahuzunike na hivyo sisi hatukuwadhuru kwa njia yoyote.

english: Now, brothers, we want you to know about the grace that God has given the churches of Macedonia.
ekegusii: Bono nkobamanyia tore inwe abaminto amang’ana y’obuya bwa Nyasae, obo chikanisa chia Makedonia chiaetwe.
swahili: Basi sasa ndugu, nataka ninyi mjue kuhusu ile neema ambayo Mungu amewapa makanisa ya Makedonia.

english: And this is my opinion about what is helpful for you in this matter: Last year you were the first not only to give, but even to have such a desire.
ekegusii: Na inche ase ring’ana eri nabaeire ay’ogosemia kwane, mbuya ase more mokoore emeremo eyio eyio mwarenge abachaki koyekora omwaka oeta. Timware koyekora rioka, korende boigo mware nokogania gw’okoyekora.
swahili: Ushauri wangu kuhusu lile lililo bora kwenu juu ya jambo hili ni huu: Mwaka uliopita ninyi mlikuwa wa kwanza si tu kutoa lakini pia mlikuwa na shauku ya kufanya hivyo.

english: Now finish the work, so that you may complete it just as eagerly as you began, according to your means.
ekegusii: Bono moikeranie ogokora okwo, erinde buna mwarenge nokogania koroisia omooroberio, naboigo mobe ang’e koyoikerania ase ebi more nabio.
swahili: Sasa ikamilisheni kazi hii kwa shauku kama mlivyoanza, jitoleeni kulingana na uwezo wenu.

english: For if the eagerness is there, the gift is acceptable according to what one has, not according to what he does not have.
ekegusii: Naki aase ogwancha kore, iga bigwancherwa koreng’ana nebi omonto are nabio, tari ase ebi atabwati.
swahili: Kwa kuwa kama nia ya kutoa ipo, kitolewacho kinakubalika kulingana na kile mtu alicho nacho, wala si kwa kile ambacho hana.

english: It is not our intention that others may be relieved while you are burdened, but that there may be equality.
ekegusii: Naki tindi goteeba aya, erinde abande baabatigere na inwe moritoerwe, korende amang’ana abe areng’aine.
swahili: Nia yetu si kwamba wengine wasaidike wakati ninyi mnateseka, bali pawe na uwiano.

english: At the present time, your surplus will meet their need, so that in turn their surplus will meet your need. Then there will be equality.
ekegusii: Ekero eke kia bono obonge bwaino bobakonye ase okoremerwa kwabo; ekero kende obonge bwabo bobakonye inwe ase okoremerwa kwaino; erio amang’ana abe areng’aine. Esemba engencho yaye omogisangio
swahili: Kwa wakati huu, wingi wa vitu mlivyo navyo usaidie kutosheleza mahitaji yao, ili wakati wao watakapokuwa na wingi wa vitu, nao wapate kutosheleza mahitaji yenu.

english: As it is written: “He who gathered much had no excess, and he who gathered little had no shortfall.” Titus Commended (Titus 1:1–4)
ekegusii: Buna eriikire, “Oyosangereretie ebinge tamenteiri, nere oyosangereretie ebike taremeiri.” Obotomwa bwa Tito na obw’abande
swahili: Ndipo patakuwa na usawa, kama ilivyoandikwa: “Aliyekusanya zaidi hakuwa na ziada, wala aliyekusanya kidogo hakupungukiwa.” Tito Atumwa Korintho

english: But thanks be to God, who put into the heart of Titus the same devotion I have for you.
ekegusii: Korende Nyasae aakerwe ng’a mbuya mono, oyobekire enkoro ya Tito omokia gocha ase more.
swahili: Ninamshukuru Mungu ambaye amemtia Tito moyo wa kuwajali ninyi kama mimi ninavyowajali.

english: For not only did he welcome our appeal, but he is eagerly coming to you of his own volition.
ekegusii: Naki igo abwatete ogosorora gwaito; kobua ayio, ere akamenta koba nomokia gocha ase more ase ogwancha kwaye omonyene.
swahili: Si kwamba Tito amekubali tu ombi letu, bali anakuja kwenu akiwa na shauku kuliko wakati mwingine, tena kwa hiari yake mwenyewe.

english: Along with Titus we are sending the brother who is praised by all the churches for his work in the gospel.
ekegusii: Amo nere twatomire oyominto oria omanyekanete ase chikanisa chionsi ase okorandia kwaye kw’amang’ana amaya.
swahili: Nasi tunamtuma pamoja naye ndugu ambaye anasifiwa na makanisa yote kwa huduma yake ya kuhubiri Injili.

english: More than that, this brother was chosen by the churches to accompany us with the offering —the gracious gift we administer to honor the Lord Himself and to show our eagerness to help.
ekegusii: Gose tari ase ayio oka, korende nigo achoretwe ne chikanisa agende amo naintwe ase emeremo eye y’obuya obo togokora ase obonene bw’Omonene, na koorokia ng’a intwe nigo tore ang’e kobakorera.
swahili: Zaidi ya hayo, alichaguliwa na makanisa ili asafiri pamoja nasi tulipokuwa tunapeleka matoleo ya ukarimu, kwa ajili ya utukufu wa Bwana mwenyewe, na ili kuonyesha hisani yetu kuwasaidia.

english: In the terrible ordeal they suffered, their abundant joy and deep poverty overflowed into rich generosity.
ekegusii: Naki baria bateemetwe nemechando emenge. Nonya barenge abataka mono, omogooko obo omonge okagera bakamenta okorua kwabo.
swahili: Pamoja na majaribu makali na taabu walizopata, furaha waliyokuwa nayo ilikuwa kubwa, ingawa walikuwa maskini kupindukia, kwa upande wao walifurika kwa wingi wa ukarimu.

english: We hope to avoid any criticism of the way we administer this generous gift.
ekegusii: Twerende ne ring’ana eri, omonto tacha gotokwana bobe ase amang’ana y’ekeegwa eke tokogaba intwe.
swahili: Tunataka kuepuka lawama yoyote kuhusu jinsi tunavyosimamia matoleo haya ya ukarimu.

english: For we are taking great care to do what is right, not only in the eyes of the Lord, but also in the eyes of men.
ekegusii: Gatoraganie korengereria ayare amaya, tari ase obosio bw’Omonene bweka, korende nonya nase obosio bwa Mwanyabaanto.
swahili: Kwa kuwa tunakusudia kufanya kile kilicho haki si machoni mwa Bwana peke yake, bali pia machoni mwa watu wengine.

english: And we are sending along with them our brother whose earnestness has been proven many times and in many ways, and now even more so by his great confidence in you.
ekegusii: Amo nabarabwo twatomire oyominto oyotwarorire ara aange ase amang’ana amange ng’a nare nomokia, na bono nare nomokia kobua, ekiagera ase ogosemeria are nakorokwo ase more.
swahili: Pamoja nao, tunamtuma ndugu yetu ambaye mara kwa mara ametuthibitishia kwa njia nyingi kwamba ana shauku, naam, zaidi sana sasa kwa sababu analo tumaini kuu kwenu.

english: As for Titus, he is my partner and fellow worker among you. As for our brothers, they are messengers of the churches, to the glory of Christ.
ekegusii: Nabo omonto karaganie komanya amang’ana igoro ya Tito; ere nesemba yane, naende nomokori emeremo amo nainche ase okobakorera inwe; naende karaganie komanya amang’ana igoro y’abaminto barabwo nabatomwa be chikanisa, naende obonene bwa Kristo.
swahili: Kwa habari ya Tito, yeye ni mwenzangu na mtendakazi pamoja nami miongoni mwenu. Kwa habari za ndugu zetu, wao ni wawakilishi wa makanisa, na utukufu kwa Kristo.

english: In full view of the churches, then, show these men the proof of your love and the reason for our boasting about you.
ekegusii: Nabo moorokie ase obosio bwe chikanisa obwanchani bwaino, na ogwetogia gwaito ase engencho yaino ase bare.
swahili: Kwa hiyo waonyesheni wazi hawa ndugu uthibitisho wa upendo wenu na sababu inayotufanya tujivune kwa ajili yenu, mbele ya makanisa, ili yapate kuona.

english: For I testify that they gave according to their ability and even beyond it. Of their own accord,
ekegusii: Naki nababereire kirori ng’a nigo baruete ase omoyo bw’ogwancha, ase okonyara kwabo, na goetania okonyara kwabo.
swahili: Kwa maana nashuhudia kwamba wao walitoa kwa kadiri wawezavyo, hata na zaidi ya uwezo wao, kwa hiari yao wenyewe,

english: they earnestly pleaded with us for the privilege of sharing in this service to the saints.
ekegusii: Barabwo bagatosaba na gotosorora mono tobae ribaga babwatane naintwe ase ogokorera abachenu.
swahili: wakitusihi kwa bidii wapewe fursa ya kushiriki katika huduma hii ya kuwasaidia watakatifu.

english: And not only did they do as we expected, but they gave themselves first to the Lord and then to us, because it was the will of God.
ekegusii: Naende bagakora buna totasemeretie; ritang’ani bakerua abanyene ase Omonene, erio ase tore ase ogwancha kwa Nyasae.
swahili: Wala hawakufanya tulivyotazamia, bali walijitoa wao wenyewe kwa Bwana kwanza na ndipo wakajitoa kwa ajili yetu, kufuatana na mapenzi ya Mungu.

english: So we urged Titus to help complete your act of grace, just as he had started it.
ekegusii: Togasorora Tito aikeranie emeremo y’obuya obo buna ayechagete ase egati yaino.
swahili: Kwa hiyo tulimsihi Tito, kwa kuwa ndiye alianzisha jambo hili, akamilishe tendo hili la neema kwa upande wenu.

english: But just as you excel in everything—in faith, in speech, in knowledge, in complete earnestness, and in the love we inspired in you —see that you also excel in this grace of giving.
ekegusii: Korende buna more nobonge bw’ebinto bionsi: okwegena, na ogokwana, na obong’aini, na omokia bwonsi, na obwanchani bwaino ase tore buna tobanchete inwe, nabo mobe nobonge bw’obuya obo bwonsi. Yeso bweruete koba omogwekano
swahili: Lakini kama vile mlivyo mbele sana katika yote: Katika imani, katika usemi, katika maarifa, katika uaminifu wote na katika upendo wenu kwetu sisi, vivyo hivyo tunataka pia mzidi katika neema hii ya kutoa.

english: I am not making a demand, but I am testing the sincerity of your love in comparison to the earnestness of others.
ekegusii: Tinkwaneti aya ase okobachiika, korende ase omokia bw’abaanto bande nteeme ekeene ki’obwanchani bwaino.
swahili: Siwaamrishi, lakini nataka kujaribu unyofu wa upendo wenu kwa kuulinganisha na bidii ya wengine.

english: For you know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that though He was rich, yet for your sakes He became poor, so that you through His poverty might become rich.
ekegusii: Naki mwamanyire obuya bw’Omonene oito Yeso Kristo buna ekorete omotaka ase engencho yaino, nonya orenge omonda, erinde inwe monyare koba abanda ase obotaka bwaye.
swahili: Kwa maana mnajua neema ya Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo, kwamba ingawa alikuwa tajiri, kwa ajili yenu alikubali kuwa maskini, ili kwa umaskini wake ninyi mpate kuwa matajiri.

english: Now about the service to the saints, there is no need for me to write to you.
ekegusii: Ase amang’ana y’ogokorera abachenu, tindi nengencho y’okobariikera.
swahili: Hakuna haja yangu kuwaandikia kuhusu huduma hii itolewayo kwa ajili ya watakatifu.

english: Now He who supplies seed to the sower and bread for food will supply and multiply your store of seed and will increase the harvest of your righteousness.
ekegusii: Nere oyokorua chimbusuro na koa oyo okobusura, naende arua omogati ase okoria, nabae inwe chimbusuro, naende nachibuchie, ere nabamenteranie okwama kw’oboronge bwaino.
swahili: Yeye ampaye mpanzi mbegu kwa ajili ya kupanda na mkate kuwa chakula, atawapa na kuzizidisha mbegu zenu za kupanda na kuongeza mavuno ya haki yenu.

english: You will be enriched in every way to be generous on every occasion, so that through us your giving will produce thanksgiving to God.
ekegusii: Ekiagera mwatenenkigwe ase ebinto bionsi monyare koba nokorua gwonsi gokogera Nyasae aakerwe ng’a mbuya mono goetera ase emeremo yaito.
swahili: Mtatajirishwa kwa kila namna ili mpate kuwa wakarimu kila wakati, na kupitia kwetu, ukarimu wenu utamletea Mungu shukrani.

english: For this ministry of service is not only supplying the needs of the saints, but is also overflowing in many expressions of thanksgiving to God.
ekegusii: Naki emeremo y’ogokora oko teri goisanera abachenu okoremerwa kwabo gwoka, korende yamentekire mono egere Nyasae aakerwe ng’a mbuya mono ara aange.
swahili: Huduma hii mnayofanya si tu kwa ajili ya kukidhi mahitaji ya watakatifu, bali huzidi sana kwa shukrani nyingi apewazo Mungu.

english: Because of the proof this ministry provides, the saints will glorify God for your obedient confession of the gospel of Christ, and for the generosity of your contribution to them and to all the others.
ekegusii: Ekiagera mwaorokirie ng’a namotenene ase okorua okwo, abanto inabamotogie Nyasae ase okoigwera kwaino ase ogwatora enchiri ya Kristo, na ase okorua kwaino mwakoreire barabwo na abanto bonsi.
swahili: Kwa sababu ya huduma ambayo mmejithibitisha wenyewe, watu watamtukuza Mungu kwa ajili ya utiifu ufuatanao na ukiri wenu wa Injili ya Kristo, na kwa ukarimu wenu wa kushiriki pamoja nao na pia wengine wote.

english: And their prayers for you will express their affection for you, because of the surpassing grace God has given you.
ekegusii: Na barabwo abanyene, kobakobasabera inwe, bare namaiga amange ase more, ekiagera ase obuya boria bwa Nyasae obwo bwamentekire mono ime ase more.
swahili: Nao katika maombi yao kwenu mioyo yao itawaonea shauku kwa sababu ya neema ipitayo kiasi mliyopewa na Mungu.

english: Thanks be to God for His indescribable gift!
ekegusii: Nyasae aakerwe ng’a mbuya mono ase engencho y’ekeegwa kiaye, totanyare kogiatora buna egwenerete!
swahili: Ashukuriwe Mungu kwa karama yake isiyoelezeka.

english: For I know your eagerness to help, and I have been boasting to the Macedonians that since last year you in Achaia were prepared to give. And your zeal has stirred most of them to do likewise.
ekegusii: Naki namanyire okwebeka ang’e kwaino, okwo netogeretie ase Abamakedonia, ngoteeba ng’a abanto b’Akaya nigo bebegete ang’e korwa omwaka oeta, na omokia oino osukirie abange ase bare.
swahili: Kwa kuwa ninajua mlivyo na shauku ya kusaidia, nami nimekuwa nikijivuna kwa ajili ya jambo hilo kwa watu wa Makedonia, nikiwaambia kuwa ninyi wa Akaya mmekuwa tayari kutoa tangu mwaka jana na shauku yenu imewachochea wengi wao katika kutoa.

english: But I am sending the brothers in order that our boasting about you in this matter should not prove empty, but that you will be prepared, just as I said.
ekegusii: Korende natomire abwo baminto, erinde ogwetogia gwaito igoro yaino tikobaisa koba okwa bosa ase ring’ana eri, erinde monyare kwebeka ang’e buna nateebete.
swahili: Lakini sasa nawatuma hawa ndugu ili kujivuna kwetu kuhusu mchango wenu kusiwe maneno matupu, bali mpate kuwa tayari kama nilivyosema mngekuwa tayari.

english: Otherwise, if any Macedonians come with me and find you unprepared, we—to say nothing of you—would be ashamed of having been so confident.
ekegusii: Onye Abamakedonia bande bagocha amo nainche na tobanyore timorebeka ang’e, titocha gosooka, ekero tobasemeretie inwe. Titokwana igoro y’obosooku bwaino.
swahili: Kwa maana kama nikija na Mmakedonia yeyote na kuwakuta hamjawa tayari, tutaona aibu kusema chochote juu yenu katika matoleo.

english: So I thought it necessary to urge the brothers to visit you beforehand and make arrangements for the bountiful gift you had promised. This way, your gift will be prepared generously and not begrudgingly.
ekegusii: Nabo narorire ng’a ningwenerete ntebie abaminto aba bantang’ane gocha ase more, na koroisia bwango ekeegwa kiaino keria mwarierete eira y’okorua korwa kare, erinde kenyare koba ang’e, buna ekeegwa, gose tari buna egento gekorugwa ase obong’iti. Okorua kw’ebiegwa ebinge, na ekeegwa kia Nyasae ase Kristo
swahili: Kwa hivyo niliona ni muhimu niwahimize hawa ndugu watangulie kuja huko kwenu kabla yangu, wafanye mipango ya hayo matoleo ya ukarimu mliyokuwa mmeahidi, ili yawe tayari kama matoleo ya hiari wala si kama ya kutozwa kwa nguvu. Kupanda Kwa Ukarimu

english: Remember this: Whoever sows sparingly will also reap sparingly, and whoever sows generously will also reap generously.
ekegusii: Korende inyora aya, oyogosimeka ebike nigo akogesa ebike; oyogosimeka ebinge nigo akogesa ebinge.
swahili: Kumbukeni kwamba: Yeyote apandaye kwa uchache pia atavuna kwa uchache, naye apandaye kwa ukarimu pia atavuna kwa ukarimu.

english: Each one should give what he has decided in his heart to give, not out of regret or compulsion. For God loves a cheerful giver.
ekegusii: Kera omonto tiga arue buna arengereretie ase enkoro yaye, tari ase ogoichana, gose tari ase okobetererigwa, ekiagera Nyasae bwanchire ere oyokorua nomogooko.
swahili: Kila mtu atoe kama anavyokusudia moyoni mwake, si kwa uchoyo au kwa kulazimishwa, kwa maana Mungu humpenda yeye atoaye kwa moyo mkunjufu.

english: And God is able to make all grace abound to you, so that in all things, at all times, having all that you need, you will abound in every good work.
ekegusii: Na Nyasae nanyare kobaichoria nobuya bwonsi ase obonge, erinde monyare koba nogoisaneka gwonsi ase ebinto bionsi, monyare komenta mono ase ogokora okuya,
swahili: Naye Mungu aweza kuwapa kila baraka kwa wingi, ili katika mambo yote kila wakati, mwe na kila kitu mnachohitaji, ili mweze kushiriki kwa wingi katika kila kazi njema.

english: As it is written: “He has scattered abroad His gifts to the poor; His righteousness endures forever.”
ekegusii: buna eriikire, “Osiareire ebiegwa biaye, obieire abataka, oboronge bwaye nigo boikaransete goika kare na kare.”
swahili: Kama ilivyoandikwa: “Ametawanya vipawa vyake kwa ukarimu akawapa maskini; haki yake hudumu milele.”

english: The elder, To the chosen lady and her children, whom I love in the truth—and not I alone, but also all who know the truth—
ekegusii: Korwa ase omogaka gochia ase omokungu omochore amo nabana bao, inwe abwo nyanchete ase ekeene. Tari inche bweka mbanchete, korende nabaria bonsi abamanyete ekeene.
swahili: Mzee: Kwa bibi mteule na watoto wake, niwapendao katika kweli, wala si mimi tu, bali na wale wote waijuayo kweli:

english: If anyone comes to you but does not bring this teaching, do not receive him into your home or even greet him.
ekegusii: Omonto karache ase more, na ere tarenteti okworokereria okwo, timomooroisia ase enyomba yaino, gose timomokwania.
swahili: Msimpokee mtu yeyote anayewajia ambaye hawaletei mafundisho haya, wala msimkaribishe nyumbani mwenu.

english: Whoever greets such a person shares in his evil deeds. Conclusion (3 John 1:13–14)
ekegusii: Naki ere oyoramokwanie igo obwatanire nemeremo yaye emebe. Amang’ana ogokoorera
swahili: Yeyote amkaribishaye mtu wa namna hiyo anashiriki katika matendo maovu ya mtu huyo. Salamu Za Mwisho

english: I have many things to write to you, but I would prefer not to do so with paper and ink. Instead, I hope to come and speak with you face to face, so that our joy may be complete.
ekegusii: Nonya mbwate amang’ana amange nanga nabariikera, tindigeti koyarika ase ekaratasi na egwino, korende ninsemeretie gocha ase more gokwana nainwe obosio ase obosio, erinde omogooko oito oikeranigwe.
swahili: Ninayo mengi ya kuwaandikia, lakini sitaki kutumia karatasi na wino. Badala yake, nataraji kuja kwenu na kuongea nanyi ana kwa ana, ili furaha yetu ipate kuwa timilifu.

english: The children of your elect sister send you greetings.
ekegusii: Abana ba mosubati omino omochoore bagokwanirie.
swahili: Watoto wa dada yako mteule wanakusalimu. Amen.

english: because of the truth that abides in us and will be with us forever:
ekegusii: Twabanchire ase engencho y’ekeene eke geikaransete ime yaito, kerokio inakebe amo naintwe goika kare na kare.
swahili: kwa sababu ya ile kweli ikaayo ndani yetu na ambayo itaendelea kukaa nasi milele:

english: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and from Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, will be with us in truth and love. Walking in the Truth (John 8:30–47)
ekegusii: Obuya, na amaabera, na omorembe bikorwa ase Nyasae Tata na ase Yeso Kristo, Omwana o Tata, nigo birabe amo naintwe ase ekeene na ase obwanchani. Ekeene n’obwanchani
swahili: Neema, rehema na amani itokayo kwa Mungu Baba na kwa Yesu Kristo, Mwanawe Baba, itakuwa pamoja nasi katika kweli na upendo. Kweli Na Upendo

english: I was overjoyed to find some of your children walking in the truth, just as the Father has commanded us.
ekegusii: Nagookire mono ekiagera narorire abande ase abana bao bagendererete ase ekeene, buna Tata atochikerete.
swahili: Imenipa furaha kuu kuona baadhi ya watoto wako wanaenenda katika kweli, kama vile Baba alivyotuagiza.

english: And now I urge you, dear lady—not as a new commandment to you, but one we have had from the beginning—that we love one another.
ekegusii: Na bono, omokungu, nakoboririe ng’a twanchane intwe ase intwe. Tari ng’a nogochika okoyia ngokoriikera, korende nkoria twarenge nakorokwo korwa ritang’ani.
swahili: Sasa, bibi mpendwa, si kwamba ninakuandikia amri mpya, bali ile tuliyokuwa nayo tangu mwanzo. Tupendane kila mmoja na mwenzake.

english: And this is love, that we walk according to His commandments. This is the very commandment you have heard from the beginning, that you must walk in love. Beware of Deceivers
ekegusii: Obo nabwo obwanchani ng’a togenderere ase amachiiko aye. Oko nakwo ogochika koria mwaigwete korwa ritang’ani, ng’a mogenderere ase obwanchani.
swahili: Hili ndilo pendo, kwamba tuenende sawasawa na amri zake. Hii ndiyo amri yake kama vile mlivyosikia tangu mwanzo, kwamba mwenende katika upendo.

english: For many deceivers have gone out into the world, refusing to confess the coming of Jesus Christ in the flesh. Any such person is the deceiver and the antichrist.
ekegusii: Naki abang’ainereria abange baasokire gochia ase ense, abatari koorokia Yeso Kristo ng’a ochire ase omobere. Oyore buna abwo, nere oria omong’ainereria, naende nomobisa o Kristo.
swahili: Wadanganyifu wengi, wasiokubali kwamba Yesu Kristo amekuja katika mwili, wametokea ulimwenguni. Mtu wa namna hiyo ni mdanganyifu na mpinga Kristo.

english: Watch yourselves, so that you do not lose what we have worked for, but that you may be fully rewarded.
ekegusii: Erigererie inwe abanyene timosiria aya twabarenteire, korende monyoore eng’eria eng’ikeranu.
swahili: Jihadharini msije mkapoteza kile mlichokitenda, bali mpate kupewa thawabu kamilifu.

english: Anyone who runs ahead without remaining in the teaching of Christ does not have God. Whoever remains in His teaching has both the Father and the Son.
ekegusii: Onde bwensi oragenderere goetania, na tari gotenena ase okworokereria gwa Kristo, oyio tari na Nyasae. Ere oyogotenena ase okworokereria okwo, oyio nigo are nabwo babere, Ise na Omwana.
swahili: Mtu yeyote asiyedumu katika mafundisho ya Kristo, bali akayaacha, yeye hana Mungu. Yeyote anayedumu katika mafundisho ana Baba na Mwana pia.

english: Now Ahab had seventy sons in Samaria. So Jehu wrote letters and sent them to Samaria to the officials of Jezreel, to the elders, and to the guardians of the sons of Ahab, saying:
ekegusii: Ahabu nabwate abana abamura emerongo etano na ebere agwo Samaria. Yehu akarika amarube, akayatoma Samaria, ase abagaambi abaarenge Yesireeli, na ase abagaaka, na ase abarendi b’abana b’Ahabu, agateeba,
swahili: Wakati huu katika Samaria walikuwepo wana sabini wa nyumba ya Ahabu. Kwa hiyo Yehu akaandika barua na kuzituma Samaria: kwa maafisa wa Yezreeli, kwa wazee, na kwa walezi wa watoto wa Ahabu. Akasema,

english: Know, then, that not a word the LORD has spoken against the house of Ahab will fail, for the LORD has done what He promised through His servant Elijah.”
ekegusii: Ase ayio, manya ng’a ring’ana ri’Omonene tirikogwa inse bosa, riri’Omonene akwanete igoro y’enyomba y’Ahabu. Ekeene, Omonene okorire aya akwanete goetera ase omosomba oye Elija.”
swahili: Fahamuni basi kwamba, hakuna neno ambalo Bwana amesema dhidi ya nyumba ya Ahabu ambalo halitatimia. Bwana amefanya lile aliloahidi kupitia mtumishi wake Eliya.”

english: So Jehu killed everyone in Jezreel who remained of the house of Ahab, as well as all his great men and close friends and priests, leaving him without a single survivor.
ekegusii: Erio Yehu agaita abanto bonsi baria batigarete b’enyomba y’Ahabu agwo Yesireeli, agaita nabaanto baye abanene bonsi, na abasani baria bamanyaine, na abakuani baye, tatigaretie nonya noyomo. Abaamate b’omorwoti Ahasia bagoitwa
swahili: Hivyo Yehu akaua kila mtu huko Yezreeli aliyekuwa amebaki wa nyumba ya Ahabu, ikiwa ni pamoja na wakuu wake, rafiki zake wa karibu, na makuhani wake. Hakuacha yeyote anusurike.

english: Then Jehu set out toward Samaria. At Beth-eked of the Shepherds,
ekegusii: Yehu akaimoka, akagenda Samaria. Ekero arenge inchera, agaika Beti‐Ekedi aase abarisia baarenge konachera ching’ondi amarionya,
swahili: Kisha Yehu akaondoka kuelekea Samaria. Alipokuwa njiani karibu na nyumba ya kukatia manyoya ya kondoo, yaani, Beth-Ekedi ya wachunga kondoo,

english: Jehu met some relatives of Ahaziah king of Judah and asked, “Who are you?” “We are relatives of Ahaziah,” they answered, “and we have come down to greet the sons of the king and of the queen mother.”
ekegusii: akaumerana nabamwabo Ahasia, omorwoti bw’Abayuda, akabooria: “Inwe mbarabi?” Nabarabwo bakairaneria: “Intwe nigo tore abamwabo Ahasia, nigo tokogenda gokwania abana b’omorwoti, na ab’eting’ana, ng’ina omorwoti.”
swahili: Yehu akakutana na watu wa jamaa ya Ahazia mfalme wa Yuda, akauliza, “Ninyi ni nani?” Wao wakasema, “Sisi ni jamaa ya Ahazia, nasi tumeshuka kuwasalimu jamaa ya mfalme na ya mama malkia.”

english: Then Jehu ordered, “Take them alive.” So his men took them alive, then slaughtered them at the well of Beth-eked—forty-two men. He spared none of them.
ekegusii: Yehu agateebia abanto baye. “Babwate bare moyo!” Na barabwo bakababwata bare moyo, bakabaita na kobaruta ase engoro agwo ang’e na Beti‐Ekedi, abanto emerongo ene, na babere; tatigaretie nonya noyomo. Abaamate bonsi b’Ahabu batigarete bagaitwa
swahili: Yehu akaagiza, “Wakamateni wakiwa hai!” Kwa hiyo wakawachukua wakiwa hai, watu arobaini na wawili, na kuwachinja kando ya kisima cha Beth-Ekedi. Hakuacha yeyote anusurike.

english: When he left there, he found Jehonadab son of Rechab, who was coming to meet him. Jehu greeted him and asked, “Is your heart as true to mine as my heart is to yours?” “It is!” Jehonadab replied. “If it is,” said Jehu, “give me your hand.” So he gave him his hand, and Jehu helped him into his chariot,
ekegusii: Ekero Yehu aruete aase agwo akaumerana na Yehonadabu, mosinto o Rekabu, ogocha komoorotota. Yehu akamokwania, akamobooria: “Enkoro yao nendonge ere ase ’nde buna eyane ere asore?” Yehonadabu akamoiraneria: “Ee, nendonge ere.” Yehu akamoteebia: “Onye nabo, tobwatane amaboko.” Bakabwatana amaboko, na Yehu akamoriinia ase egari yaye ime.
swahili: Baada ya kuondoka hapo, alimkuta Yehonadabu mwana wa Rekabu, aliyekuwa akienda kumlaki. Yehu akamsalimu na kusema, “Je, moyo wako ni mnyofu kwangu kama moyo wangu ulivyo kwako?” Yehonadabu akajibu, “Ndiyo.” Yehu akasema, “Kama ndivyo, nipe mkono wako.” Yeye akampa mkono, naye Yehu akampandisha kwenye gari lake la vita.

english: saying, “Come with me and see my zeal for the LORD!” So he had him ride in his chariot.
ekegusii: Akamoteebia: “Inchuo amo nainche, orore risemi riane na omokia one ase Omonene!” Erio bakagenda komo ase egari ya Yehu.
swahili: Yehu akasema, “Twende pamoja ukaone wivu wangu kwa ajili ya Bwana.” Hivyo wakasafiri pamoja kwenye gari lake.

english: When Jehu came to Samaria, he struck down everyone belonging to Ahab who remained there, until he had destroyed them, according to the word that the LORD had spoken to Elijah. Jehu Kills the Priests of Baal
ekegusii: Na ekero aigete Samaria, agaita abanto bonsi batigarete ase enyomba y’Ahabu agwo Samaria, goika akabasiria kegima, buna Omonene ateebete goetera ase Elija. Abasasimi ba Baali bagoitwa
swahili: Yehu alipofika Samaria, akawaua wale wote waliokuwa wamesalia wa jamaa ya Ahabu, akawaangamiza, sawasawa na neno la Bwana alilosema kupitia Eliya. Watumishi Wa Baali Wauawa

english: Then Jehu brought all the people together and said, “Ahab served Baal a little, but Jehu will serve him a lot.
ekegusii: Yehu agasangereria abanto bonsi, akabateebia: “Ahabu nigo akorerete Baali ake igo, korende inche Yehu nigo ndayekorere mono goetania.
swahili: Kisha Yehu akawaleta watu wote pamoja na kuwaambia, “Ahabu alimtumikia Baali kidogo. Lakini Yehu atamtumikia zaidi.

english: Now, therefore, summon to me all the prophets of Baal, all his servants, and all his priests. See that no one is missing, for I have a great sacrifice for Baal. Whoever is missing will not live.” But Jehu was acting deceptively in order to destroy the servants of Baal.
ekegusii: Ase ayio bono, ndangereria ababani bonsi ba Baali, na abakoreri baye bonsi, na abakuani baye bonsi; onde tabaisa gotigara otache, ekiagera inche ngochia nde korua ekeng’wanso ekenene ase Baali. Omonto onde bwensi oramoche, tachicha, takoba moyo.” Korende Yehu nigo akorete ayio ase obong’ainereria, erinde aite na gosiria abakoreri ba Baali.
swahili: Sasa waiteni manabii wote wa Baali, watumishi wake wote na makuhani wake wote. Hakikisheni kwamba hakuna hata mmoja atakayekosekana, kwa sababu ninakwenda kutoa kafara kubwa sana kwa Baali. Yeyote atakayeshindwa kuja hataendelea kuishi.” Lakini Yehu alifanya hivyo kwa hila ili apate kuwaangamiza watumishi wote wa Baali.

english: “When this letter arrives, since your master’s sons are with you and you have chariots and horses, a fortified city and weaponry,
ekegusii: “Abana b’omonene oino nao bare nainwe, ne chigari ne chibarasi nao chire amo nainwe, amo nemechie egiteire chindwaki, boigo nebirwanero bionsi. Ase ayio, riruube rikobaikera,
swahili: “Mara tu barua hii itakapokufikia, kwa kuwa wana wa bwana wako wapo pamoja nawe, nawe una magari ya vita na farasi, mji wenye ngome na silaha,

english: And Jehu commanded, “Proclaim a solemn assembly for Baal.” So they announced it.
ekegusii: Yehu agachiika, agateeba: “Rangeria abanto babe nomosangererekano omochenu ase Baali!” Ase ayio, barabwo bakararia amang’ana ayio.
swahili: Yehu akasema, “Itisheni kusanyiko kwa heshima ya Baali.” Basi wakatangaza jambo hilo.

english: Then Jehu sent word throughout Israel, and all the servants of Baal came; there was not a man who failed to show. They entered the temple of Baal, and it was filled from end to end.
ekegusii: Yehu agatoma amang’ana ase Abaisraeli bonsi, na abakoreri ba Baali bonsi bagacha, goika nonya nomonto oyomo tatigara otachete. Bagasoa enyomba ya Baali, na enyomba eria egaichora nabaanto churi.
swahili: Kisha Yehu akapeleka ujumbe katika Israeli yote, nao watumishi wote wa Baali wakaja, hakuna hata mmoja ambaye hakufika. Wakasongana ndani ya hekalu la Baali hadi likajaa tangu mlango hadi mwisho wake.

english: And Jehu said to the keeper of the wardrobe, “Bring out garments for all the servants of Baal.” So he brought out garments for them.
ekegusii: Agateebia omoteneneri bwe chianga chi’ogosasimera: “Orentere abakoreri bonsi ba Baali chianga chiabo.” Ere akabarentera chianga.
swahili: Naye Yehu akamwambia yule aliyekuwa mtunza chumba cha mavazi, “Leta majoho kwa ajili ya watumishi wote wa Baali.” Basi akawaletea majoho.

english: Next, Jehu and Jehonadab son of Rechab entered the temple of Baal, and Jehu said to the servants of Baal, “Look around to see that there are no servants of the LORD here among you—only servants of Baal.”
ekegusii: Yehu agasoa enyomba ya Baali amo na Yehonadabu, mosinto o Rekabu, agateebia abakoreri ba Baali “Rigia na morore ng’a omosomba bw’Omonene tari ase egati yaino nonya noyomo, korende nabakoreri ba Baali boka.”
swahili: Kisha Yehu na Yehonadabu mwana wa Rekabu wakaingia ndani ya hekalu la Baali. Yehu akawaambia watumishi wa Baali, “Tazameni kila mahali mhakikishe kwamba hakuna hata mtumishi mmoja wa Bwana aliye hapa pamoja nanyi, ila ni watumishi wa Baali tu.”

english: And they went in to offer sacrifices and burnt offerings. Now Jehu had stationed eighty men outside and warned them, “If anyone allows one of the men I am delivering into your hands to escape, he will forfeit his life for theirs.”
ekegusii: Erio bagasoa korua ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa, na ebing’wanso binde. Yehu konya obekire abanto emerongo etano na etato isiko, buna abateebeetie: “Omonto onde bwensi ase more oratige omonto atooreke ase abwo nkobeeka ase amaboko aino, oyio goika akwe ribaga riaye.”
