ekegusii: Erio Abisalomu akarangeria Yoabu, erinde amotome ase omorwoti, korende Yoabu akaanga gocha ase are. Naende akamorangeria eria kabere, korende boigo akaanga, taacha.
swahili: Basi Absalomu akamwita Yoabu kwa kusudi la kumtuma kwa mfalme, lakini Yoabu akakataa kuja kwa Absalomu. Ndipo akamwita tena mara ya pili, lakini pia akakataa kuja.

english: Then go to the king and speak these words to him.” And Joab put the words in her mouth.
ekegusii: Erio ogeende ase omorwoti, omoteebie amang’ana ndagoteebie,” na Yoabu akamoteebia aya agochia gokwana.
swahili: Kisha nenda kwa mfalme ukazungumze maneno haya.” Naye Yoabu akaweka maneno kinywani mwa yule mwanamke.

english: Then Absalom said to his servants, “Look, Joab’s field is next to mine, and he has barley there. Go and set it on fire!” And Absalom’s servants set the field on fire.
ekegusii: Ase igo Abisalomu agateebia abasomba baye, “Rora omogondo o Yoabu nigo osinyaine n’oyone, n’oro bwamire esairi, geenda motongie omorero esairi eria eyie.” Bakageenda, bakayetongia omorero ekayia.
swahili: Ndipo akawaambia watumishi wake, “Tazama, shamba la Yoabu liko jirani na langu, naye ana shayiri humo. Nendeni mkalitie moto.” Kisha watumishi wa Absalomu wakalitia moto shamba hilo.

english: Then Joab came to Absalom’s house and demanded, “Why did your servants set my field on fire?”
ekegusii: Na bono Yoabu akaimoka, akageenda bw’Abisalomu, akamobooria, “Nase ki abasomba bao basambire esairi y’ane iga?”
swahili: Basi Yoabu akaenda nyumbani kwa Absalomu, akamwambia, “Kwa nini watumishi wako wametia moto shamba langu?”

english: “Look,” said Absalom, “I sent for you and said, ‘Come here. I want to send you to the king to ask: Why have I come back from Geshur? It would be better for me if I were still there.’ So now, let me see the king’s face, and if there is iniquity in me, let him kill me.”
ekegusii: Abisalomu akamoiraneria, “Rigereria, ’ngatoma abanto ase ore ng’a oche ogeende ase omorwoti, omoteebie amang’ana ane. Inki rende narwerete Gesuri? Nanga mbuya nare komenya aroro goika reero iga. Bono ninganetie korora omorwoti. Onye obobe bore ase ’nde ang’ite.”
swahili: Absalomu akamwambia Yoabu, “Tazama, nilikutumia ujumbe na kusema, ‘Njoo ili niweze kukutuma kwa mfalme kuuliza, “Kwa nini nimekuja kutoka Geshuri? Ingekuwa bora zaidi kwangu kama ningebaki huko!” ’ Sasa basi, nataka kuuona uso wa mfalme, na ikiwa nina hatia ya jambo lolote, basi na aniue.”

english: So Joab went and told the king, and David summoned Absalom, who came to him and bowed facedown before him. Then the king kissed Absalom.
ekegusii: Ase igo Yoabu akageenda ase omorwoti, akamoteebia amang’ana ayio. Erio omorwoti akarangeria Abisalomu; na ere akageenda ase omorwoti, akagwa inse maumama ase obosio bwaye, na omorwoti akamonyunyunta.
swahili: Basi Yoabu akaenda kwa mfalme na kumwambia jambo hili. Kisha mfalme akamwita Absalomu, naye akaingia ndani akasujudu uso wake mpaka ardhini mbele ya mfalme. Naye mfalme akambusu Absalomu.

english: When the woman from Tekoa went to the king, she fell facedown in homage and said, “Help me, O king!”
ekegusii: Omokungu oria o Tekoa, ekero aigete ase omorwoti, akagwa inse, mauaumama ase okomosika, akabora, “Aye omorwoti, koranche onkonye.”
swahili: Huyo huyo mwanamke kutoka Tekoa alipofika kwa mfalme, akaanguka kifudifudi kumpa mfalme heshima, akasema, “Ee mfalme, nisaidie!”

english: “What troubles you?” the king asked her. “Indeed,” she said, “I am a widow, for my husband is dead.
ekegusii: Omorwoti akamobooria, “Emechaando yao nereri?” Akamoiraneria, “Inche nomotakaanwa; omosacha one nigo akwete.
swahili: Mfalme akamuuliza, “Una shida gani?” Akamwambia, “Mimi ni mjane hasa, mume wangu amekufa.

english: And your maidservant had two sons who were fighting in the field with no one to separate them, and one struck the other and killed him.
ekegusii: Inche, omosomba oo omokungu, nigo nabwate abana abamura babere, nabarabwo bagachaaka kwomana kobare mogondo, gose onde tarengeo ore kobatoorania, na oyomo agaita oria, onde omwabo.
swahili: Mimi mtumishi wako nilikuwa na wana wawili. Wakapigana wao kwa wao huko shambani wala huko hapakuwa na mtu hata mmoja wa kuwaamua. Mmoja akampiga mwenzake na kumuua.

english: Now the whole clan has risen up against your maidservant and said, ‘Hand over the one who struck down his brother, that we may put him to death for the life of the brother whom he killed. Then we will cut off the heir as well!’ So they would extinguish my one remaining ember by not preserving my husband’s name or posterity on the earth.”
ekegusii: Abaamate bane bonsi banyimokeire inche, omosomba oo, bagontebia ng’a indue omomura oyio one bamoite, ekiagera aita oyomwabo. Baise komoita nigo ’ndabe tindi nomonyamwando. Naboigo bakare korigia korimia omorero one otigarete, tibatigera omosacha one erieta riaye riatorwe, gose onde oye atigare ase ense.”
swahili: Sasa ukoo wote umeinuka dhidi ya mtumishi wako, wakisema, ‘Utukabidhi huyo aliyemuua ndugu yake, ili tumuue kwa ajili ya uhai wa ndugu yake ambaye alimuua, nasi hapo tutakuwa tumekatilia mbali na mrithi pia.’ Wakifanya hivyo, watakuwa wamezima tumaini langu lililobaki, mume wangu hataachiwa jina wala mzao katika uso wa dunia.”

english: “Go home,” the king said to the woman, “and I will give orders on your behalf.”
ekegusii: Omorwoti agateebia omokungu oria “Geenda bwoo, ninkoroiserie amang’ana ayio.”
swahili: Mfalme akamwambia huyo mwanamke, “Nenda nyumbani, nami nitatoa agizo kwa ajili yako.”

english: But the woman of Tekoa said to the king, “My lord the king, may any blame be on me and on my father’s house, and may the king and his throne be guiltless.”
ekegusii: Erio omokungu oria akamoteebia, “Aye omorwoti, omonene one, tiga inche na eamate ya tata tobogorie okomocha kw’ebibe ebio. Asore omorwoti, gose ase ekerogo kiao ki’obogaambi, komocha tikobao.”
swahili: Lakini huyo mwanamke kutoka Tekoa akamwambia, “Mfalme bwana wangu, lawama na iwe juu yangu na juu ya nyumba ya baba yangu, naye mfalme na kiti chake cha enzi na asiwe na hatia.”

english: Some time later, Absalom provided for himself a chariot with horses and fifty men to run ahead of him.
ekegusii: Magega y’ayio Abisalomu akenyorera egaari, ne chibarasi, na abanto emerongo etano barabe bakominyoka bosio bwaye.
swahili: Baada ya muda, Absalomu akajipatia magari ya vita na farasi pamoja na watu hamsini wa kupiga mbio mbele yake.

english: Then Absalom sent spies throughout the tribes of Israel with this message: “When you hear the sound of the horn, you are to say, ‘Absalom reigns in Hebron!’”
ekegusii: Korende Abisalomu agatoma abanto bobisi ase ebisaku bionsi bi’Abaisraeli babiteebie, “Ekero moraigwe eriogi ri’egetuureri, erio moake eriogi moteebe: Bono Abisalomu obeire omorwoti o Heburoni!”
swahili: Kisha Absalomu akatuma wajumbe kwa siri katika makabila yote ya Israeli, kusema, “Mara mtakaposikia sauti ya tarumbeta basi semeni, ‘Absalomu ni mfalme huko Hebroni.’ ”

english: Two hundred men from Jerusalem accompanied Absalom. They had been invited as guests and they went along innocently, for they knew nothing about the matter.
ekegusii: Abanto amagana abere korwa Yerusalemu bakageenda amo n’Abisalomu. Abwo bachiigetwe koba abageni, bakageenda batari na komocha, ekiagera tibamanyete amang’ana agochia gokorwa.
swahili: Watu mia mbili kutoka Yerusalemu walikuwa wamefuatana na Absalomu. Walikuwa wamealikwa kama wageni nao walikwenda kwa nia njema, pasipo kujua lolote.

english: While Absalom was offering the sacrifices, he sent for Ahithophel the Gilonite, David’s counselor, to come from his hometown of Giloh. So the conspiracy gained strength, and Absalom’s following kept increasing. David Flees Jerusalem (Psalms 3:1–8)
ekegusii: Ekero Abisalomu areenge korua ebing’wanso, agatoma abanto korangeria Ahitofali, omoseemia bw’omorwoti Daudi, korwa ase omochie o Gilo. Obobe bwabo bw’okoba mamincha ya Daudi bokabucha, bokaba ne chinguru, na abanto abwo bakabwatana n’Abisalomu bakamentekana, bakaba abange. Daudi ogotama korwa Yerusalemu
swahili: Wakati Absalomu alipokuwa anatoa dhabihu, pia akatuma aitwe Ahithofeli, Mgiloni, mshauri wa Daudi, aje kutoka Gilo, ambao ndio mji wake wa nyumbani. Kwa hiyo mpango wa hila ukapata nguvu, na idadi ya waliofuatana na Absalomu ikaongezeka. Kukimbia Kwa Daudi

english: Then a messenger came to David and reported, “The hearts of the men of Israel are with Absalom.”
ekegusii: Abanto bakairera Daudi amang’ana, bakamoteebia, “Abaisraeli babwatanire n’Abisalomu bamoigwereire.”
swahili: Mjumbe akaja na kumwambia Daudi, “Mioyo ya watu wa Israeli inaambatana na Absalomu.”

english: And David said to all the servants with him in Jerusalem, “Arise and let us flee, or we will not escape from Absalom! We must leave quickly, or he will soon overtake us, heap disaster on us, and put the city to the sword.”
ekegusii: Erio Daudi agateebia abasomba baye bonsi, abwo barenge nere agwo Yerusalemu, “Imoka totame, onye torigetie gwetooria korwa ase Abisalomu. Ayerera bwango, Abisalomu tabaisa gocha gotoumokera na gotorentera amabe, gose aite abanto b’omochie n’omoro.”
swahili: Ndipo Daudi akawaambia maafisa wake wote waliokuwa pamoja naye huko Yerusalemu, “Njooni! Ni lazima tukimbie, la sivyo hakuna hata mmoja wetu atakayeokoka kutoka mkononi mwa Absalomu. Ni lazima tuondoke kwa haraka, la sivyo atakuja mbio na kutupata, atatuangamiza na kuupiga mji kwa upanga.”

english: The king’s servants replied, “Whatever our lord the king decides, we are your servants.”
ekegusii: Abasomba b’omorwoti bakamoteebia, “Aye omorwoti Omonene oito, intwe abasomba bao nigo twebegete ang’e gokora rinde rionsi oratoteebie.”
swahili: Maafisa wa mfalme wakamjibu, “Watumishi wako tu tayari kufanya lolote mfalme bwana wetu analochagua.”

english: Then the king set out, and his entire household followed him. But he left behind ten concubines to take care of the palace.
ekegusii: Ase igo omorwoti akageenda, na abanto bonsi b’omochie oye bakamotunyana. Omorwoti agatiga abakungu baye ba sere‐sere ikomi bakorenda enyomba yaye.
swahili: Mfalme akatoka, pamoja na watu wa nyumbani mwake wakimfuata; lakini akawaacha masuria kumi ili kuangalia jumba la kifalme.

english: So the king set out with all the people following him. He stopped at the last house,
ekegusii: Omorwoti akageenderera gotama, na abanto bonsi bakamotunyana korwa magega; bakaratenena ake ase enyomba yarenge ensinyo.
swahili: Hivyo mfalme akaondoka, pamoja na watu wote wakimfuata, wakatua mahali mbali kiasi.

english: and all his servants marched past him—all the Cherethites and Pelethites, and six hundred Gittites who had followed him from Gath.
ekegusii: Abasomba baye bonsi bagaetera ensemo, bakamoetania, amo n’Abakereti bonsi, na Abapeleti bonsi, na Abagiti amagana atano na rimo, abwo bamobwatetie korwa Gati; bonsi bagaetania omorwoti.
swahili: Watu wake wote wakatembea, wakampita wakiwa wamefuatana na Wakerethi na Wapelethi wote; pia Wagiti wote mia sita waliokuwa wamefuatana naye kutoka Gathi wakapita mbele ya mfalme.

english: Then the king said to Ittai the Gittite, “Why should you also go with us? Go back and stay with the new king, since you are both a foreigner and an exile from your homeland.
ekegusii: Omorwoti akaboria Itai Omogiti, “Nase ki naye okogeenda amo naintwe? Irana obeere nomorwoti oyio omoyia; aye nomomenyi ore, naende nigo gwaserigwa korwa seino.
swahili: Mfalme akamwambia Itai, Mgiti, “Kwa nini ufuatane na sisi? Rudi ukakae pamoja na Mfalme Absalomu. Wewe ni mgeni, mkimbizi kutoka nchini mwako.

english: He would get up early and stand beside the road leading to the city gate. Whenever anyone had a grievance to bring before the king for a decision, Absalom would call out and ask, “What city are you from?” And if he replied, “Your servant is from one of the tribes of Israel,”
ekegusii: Ase kera rituko Abisalomu nigo anarete koimoka mambia chuni, otenena enchera ensemo ase egeita ki’omochie. Na ekero omonto onde bwensi are gocha ore ne ring’ana akoira ase omorwoti agaamberwe, Abisalomu omorangeria gocha ase are, omoboria, “Aye mochie ki kwarwa?” Ekero omonto oyio amoiraneirie nase gesaku ki ki’Abaisraeli arwa,
swahili: Akawa anaamka asubuhi na mapema na kusimama kando ya barabara inayoelekea kwenye lango la mji. Wakati wowote alipokuja mtu yeyote mwenye mashtaka yanayohitaji kuletwa mbele ya mfalme kwa maamuzi, Absalomu naye angemwita na kumuuliza, “Wewe unatoka mji upi?” Naye angejibu, “Mtumishi wako anatoka katika mojawapo ya makabila ya Israeli.”

english: In fact, you arrived only yesterday; should I make you wander around with us today while I do not know where I am going? Go back and take your brothers with you. May the LORD show you loving devotion and faithfulness. ”
ekegusii: Niigoro gwacha aa. Nase ki ’ndagotige ontunyane na kona‐koong’anya amo nainche, nainche timanyeti nonya nase ’ngochia? Irana amo n’abamino, n’Omonene akoorokerie obwanchani bwaye botari koera na obwegenwa bwaye.”
swahili: Ulikuja jana tu. Nami leo nikufanye utangetange pamoja nasi, wakati sijui niendako? Rudi, nawe ukawachukue watu wa kwenu. Wema na uaminifu na viwe pamoja nawe.”

english: But Ittai answered the king, “As surely as the LORD lives, and as my lord the king lives, wherever my lord the king may be, whether it means life or death, there will your servant be!”
ekegusii: Korende Itai akamoiraneria, “Ekeene, buna Omonene are moyo, na buna aye omorwoti, omonene one, ore moyo, aande onsi ase ogochia, onye nase ogokwa, gose ase okoba moyo, agwo nao nainche, omosomba oo, ndaabe.”
swahili: Lakini Itai akamjibu mfalme, “Hakika kama Bwana aishivyo na kama mfalme bwana wangu aishivyo, popote mfalme bwana wangu atakapokuwa, ikiwa ni kuishi au kufa, hapo ndipo mtumishi wako atakapokuwa.”

english: “March on then,” said David to Ittai. So Ittai the Gittite marched past with all his men and all the little ones who were with him.
ekegusii: Erio Daudi agateebia Itai, “Gaki eta, ogeende bosio.” Itai Omogiti agaeta gochia bosio amo n’abanto baye bonsi, na abana abake bonsi, abareenge amo nere.
swahili: Daudi akamwambia Itai, “Songa mbele, endelea.” Kwa hiyo Itai, Mgiti, akaendelea pamoja na watu wake wote, pia jamaa zote waliokuwa pamoja naye.

english: Everyone in the countryside was weeping loudly as all the people passed by. And as the king crossed the Kidron Valley, all the people also passed toward the way of the wilderness.
ekegusii: Abanto b’ense eria bakarera namariogi amanene ekero abanto bonsi baare goeta, na omorwoti akaamboka akarooche ga Kidironi; abanto bonsi bakaamboka bakageenda ase enchera y’erooro.
swahili: Watu wote wa nje ya mji wakalia kwa sauti wakati watu wote walipokuwa wakipita. Mfalme naye akavuka Bonde la Kidroni, nao watu wote wakaelekea jangwani.

english: Zadok was also there, and all the Levites with him were carrying the ark of the covenant of God. And they set down the ark of God, and Abiathar offered sacrifices until the people had passed out of the city.
ekegusii: Zadoki nao areenge na Abalawi bonsi. Barabwo babogoretie Esanduki ya Nyasae ere ne chibao chiriikire okobwatana kw’ogotianania. Abiatari nere agaachao. Ababogoretie Esanduki eria bakayetoora inse goika abanto bonsi bakaba baruure ase omochie.
swahili: Sadoki pia alikuwako, kadhalika Walawi wote waliokuwa pamoja naye walikuwa wamechukua Sanduku la Agano la Mungu. Wakaweka chini Sanduku la Mungu, naye Abiathari akatoa dhabihu mpaka watu wote walipokuwa wameondoka mjini.

english: Then the king said to Zadok, “Return the ark of God to the city. If I find favor in the eyes of the LORD, He will bring me back and let me see both it and His dwelling place again.
ekegusii: Erio omorwoti agateebia Zadoki, “Bogoria Esanduki ya Nyasae, oyeiranie ase omochie ime. Onye ’nkonyora ogwancherwa ase Omonene, ere nang’iranie, ayenyorokie naende amo n’Obomenyo bwaye omonyene.
swahili: Kisha mfalme akamwambia Sadoki, “Rudisha Sanduku la Mungu mjini. Ikiwa nitapata kibali mbele za Bwana, atanirudisha, nami nitaliona Sanduku hili tena pamoja na Maskani yake.

english: But if He should say, ‘I do not delight in you,’ then here I am; let Him do to me whatever seems good to Him.”
ekegusii: Korende karanteebie ng’a timogwenereti, inche nao inde aa, ankorere aya ararore are amaya ase are.”
swahili: Lakini kama yeye atasema, ‘Mimi sipendezwi nawe,’ basi mimi niko tayari; yeye na anifanye chochote aonacho chema kwake.”

english: The king also said to Zadok the priest, “Are you not a seer? Return to the city in peace—you with your son Ahimaaz, and Abiathar with his son Jonathan.
ekegusii: Naende omorwoti agateebia Zadoki Omokuani, “Aye nomoorori. Irana ase omochie nomorembe. Oirane n’Ahimasi, omwana oo, na Yonathani, omwana bw’Abiatari, abana abwo babere baino.
swahili: Pia mfalme alimwambia kuhani Sadoki, “Je, wewe si mwonaji? Rudi mjini kwa amani pamoja na mwanao Ahimaasi na Yonathani mwana wa Abiathari. Wewe na Abiathari wachukueni wana wenu wawili.

english: See, I will wait at the fords of the wilderness until word comes from you to inform me.”
ekegusii: Naama! Inche nigo ’nkoganyera ase ebiambokero bi’orooche aiga ase erooro goika inyore amang’ana korwa ase more.”
swahili: Nitasubiri kwenye vivuko katika jangwa mpaka neno litakapotoka kwenu kuniarifu.”

english: So Zadok and Abiathar returned the ark of God to Jerusalem and stayed there. David Weeps at the Mount of Olives (Psalms 63:1–11)
ekegusii: Ase igo Zadoki na Abiatari bakabogoria Esanduki ya Nyasae; bakayeirania Yerusalemu, nabarabwo bakabeera aroro.
swahili: Kwa hiyo Sadoki na Abiathari wakarudisha Sanduku la Mungu mpaka Yerusalemu na kukaa huko.

english: Absalom would say, “Look, your claims are good and right, but the king has no deputy to hear you.”
ekegusii: Abisalomu omoteebia, “Rora, amang’ana ao namaya, naende amaronge, korende monto onde tari aa omorwoti abeegete orakoigwere.”
swahili: Kisha Absalomu angemwambia, “Tazama, malalamiko yako ni ya haki na sawasawa, lakini hakuna mwakilishi wa mfalme wa kukusikiliza.”

english: But David continued up the Mount of Olives, weeping as he went up. His head was covered, and he was walking barefoot. And all the people with him covered their heads and went up, weeping as they went.
ekegusii: Daudi agatiira gochia ase Egetunwa ki’Emezeituni igoro okona‐korera otubete omotwe oye, tabeegete bikoroto; na abanto abareenge amo nere bagetuba emetwe yabo bakorera kobagotiira.
swahili: Bali Daudi akaendelea, akapanda Mlima wa Mizeituni, akaenda huku analia, akiwa amefunika kichwa chake na bila viatu miguuni. Watu wote waliokuwa pamoja naye nao wakafunika vichwa vyao, wakawa wanapanda mlima huku wanalia.

english: Now someone told David: “Ahithophel is among the conspirators with Absalom.” So David pleaded, “O LORD, please turn the counsel of Ahithophel into foolishness!”
ekegusii: Ekero Daudi ateebetigwe ng’a Ahitofeli nere nao akare ase abwo babwatanire n’Abisalomu, agasaba, “Omonene, onchora omooroberio bw’Ahitofeli obe bosa.”
swahili: Basi Daudi alikuwa ameambiwa, “Ahithofeli alikuwa miongoni mwa washiriki wa shauri baya la Absalomu.” Ndipo Daudi akaomba, akisema, “Ee Bwana, geuza shauri la Ahithofeli kuwa ujinga.”

english: When David came to the summit, where he used to worship God, Hushai the Archite was there to meet him with his robe torn and dust on his head.
ekegusii: Ekero Daudi aigete ekegoro igoro, ase Nyasae are gosasiimerwa, Husai Omoariki agacha komoorotota; eganchwa yaye nigo yatandoire, na ebuse ere ase omotwe oye.
swahili: Daudi alipofika kwenye kilele cha mlima, mahali ambapo watu walikuwa wamezoea kumwabudu Mungu, Hushai, Mwariki, alikuwako huko kumlaki, joho lake likiwa limeraruka na mavumbi kichwani mwake.

english: David said to him, “If you go on with me, you will be a burden to me.
ekegusii: Daudi akamoteebia, “Oise kogeenda amo nainche nigo orabe egurube ase ’nde.
swahili: Daudi akamwambia, “Kama ukienda pamoja nami, utakuwa mzigo kwangu.

english: But you can thwart the counsel of Ahithophel for me if you return to the city and say to Absalom: ‘I will be your servant, my king; in the past I was your father’s servant, but now I will be your servant.’
ekegusii: Korende oise koirana ase omochie na goteebia Abisalomu: Aye omorwoti, nigo ’ndabe omosomba oo buna narenge omosomba o iso agwo ritang’ani, naboigo bono ’ndabe omosomba oo, erio nario orankoonye tosarie omooroberio bw’Ahitofeli.
swahili: Lakini ikiwa utarudi mjini na kumwambia Absalomu, ‘Nitakuwa mtumishi wako, ee mfalme; nilikuwa mtumishi wa baba yako wakati uliopita, lakini sasa nitakuwa mtumishi wako,’ basi utaweza kunisaidia kwa kupinga shauri la Ahithofeli.

english: Will not Zadok and Abiathar the priests be there with you? Report to them everything you hear from the king’s palace.
ekegusii: Inee! Zadoki na Abiatari abakuani tibakari aroro? Gaki ing’ana rinde rionsi oraigwe ase enyomba y’omorwoti oribateebie.
swahili: Je, makuhani Sadoki na Abiathari hawatakuwa pamoja nawe? Waambie lolote utakalosikia katika jumba la mfalme.

english: Indeed, their two sons, Ahimaaz son of Zadok and Jonathan son of Abiathar, are there with them. Send them to me with everything you hear.”
ekegusii: Barabwo ’mbakabwate abana babo babere, Ahimasi, omwana o Zadoki, na Yonathani, omwana bw’Abiatari. Mobe mokobatoma bandetere kera ring’ana moraigwe.”
swahili: Wana wao wawili, Ahimaasi mwana wa Sadoki na Yonathani mwana wa Abiathari, wako pamoja nao huko. Watume kwangu na lolote utakalosikia.”

english: So David’s friend Hushai arrived in Jerusalem just as Absalom was entering the city.
ekegusii: Husai, omosani o Daudi, agasoa omochie o Yerusalemu ekero Abisalomu nere asoeteo.
swahili: Kwa hiyo Hushai, rafiki wa Daudi, akafika Yerusalemu wakati Absalomu alipokuwa anaingia mjini.

english: And he would add, “If only someone would appoint me judge in the land, then everyone with a grievance or dispute could come to me, and I would give him justice.”
ekegusii: Naende Abisalomu obora, “Onye ’nabeekwa imbe omogambi ase ense eye, kera omonto ore ne ring’ana gose ekiina gete anga naacha ase ’nde, nainche anga ’namokoonya na komonyooorera oboronge.”
swahili: Absalomu aliongeza, “Laiti tu ningeteuliwa kuwa mwamuzi katika nchi. Ndipo kila mmoja mwenye mashtaka au shauri angekuja kwangu nami ningeona kwamba anapata haki.”

english: Also, when anyone approached to bow down to him, Absalom would reach out his hand, take hold of him, and kiss him.
ekegusii: Omonto arenge goika ase are na gotung’ama ase okoorokia amasikani, Abisalomu nigo arenge korambora okoboko kwaye obwata omonto oyio na komonyunyunta.
swahili: Pia, wakati mtu yeyote alipomkaribia ili kusujudu mbele yake, Absalomu alinyoosha mkono wake na kumshika pia kumbusu.

english: Absalom did this to all the Israelites who came to the king for justice. In this way he stole the hearts of the men of Israel.
ekegusii: Naboigo Abisalomu akorerete Abaisraeli bonsi abwo bareenge gocha ase omorwoti ase okogaamberwa ebiina biabo. Ase enchera eyio Abisalomu akang’usa Abaisraeli bonsi bakamwancha.
swahili: Absalomu akaendelea na tabia hii mbele ya Waisraeli wote waliomjia mfalme kumwomba awape haki; kwa hiyo Absalomu akaiba mioyo ya watu wa Israeli.

english: After four years had passed, Absalom said to the king, “Please let me go to Hebron to fulfill a vow I have made to the LORD.
ekegusii: Ekaba magega y’emiaka ene koyaerire, Abisalomu agateebia omorwoti, “Koranche ong’e ribaga ’ngeende Heburoni goikerania eira y’ane narierete Omonene.
swahili: Mnamo mwisho wa mwaka wa nne, Absalomu akamwambia mfalme, “Naomba unipe ruhusa niende Hebroni nikatimize nadhiri niliyomwekea Bwana.

english: For your servant made a vow while dwelling in Geshur of Aram, saying: ‘If indeed the LORD brings me back to Jerusalem, I will worship the LORD in Hebron.’ ”
ekegusii: Inaki inche, omosomba oo, ekero nareenge imenyete Gesuri ya Siiria, nigo narierete Omonene eira ng’a karang’iranie Yerusalemu, erio nimbe ’nkomokorera agwo Heburoni.”
swahili: Wakati mtumishi wako alipokuwa huko Geshuri katika nchi ya Aramu, niliweka nadhiri hii, ‘Ikiwa Bwana atanirudisha Yerusalemu, nitamwabudu Bwana huko Hebroni.’ ”

english: “Go in peace,” said the king. So Absalom got up and went to Hebron.
ekegusii: Omorwoti akamoteebia, “Geenda nomorembe.” Ase igo Abisalomu akaimoka, akageenda Heburoni.
swahili: Mfalme akamwambia, “Enenda kwa amani.” Hivyo akaenda Hebroni.

english: When David had gone a little beyond the summit, Ziba the servant of Mephibosheth was there to meet him. He had a pair of saddled donkeys loaded with two hundred loaves of bread, a hundred clusters of raisins, a hundred summer fruits, and a skin of wine.
ekegusii: Ekero Daudi ageendire ake goetania egetunwa igoro, akaumerana na Siba, omosomba o Mefiboseti, ore ne chitigere ibere chibogoretie emagaati amagana abere, na amabomba y’amasabibu amomo rigana erimo, na amabomba y’amako rigana erimo, amo nekerandi ekemo keroisirie korwa ase risankwa, kere nedivai.
swahili: Daudi alipokuwa amekwenda umbali mfupi kupita kilele cha mlima, akamkuta huko Siba, msimamizi wa shughuli za Mefiboshethi, akingojea kumlaki Daudi. Alikuwa na punda wawili wakiwa wametandikwa na kupakiwa mikate mia mbili, maandazi mia ya zabibu kavu, maandazi mia ya tini na kiriba cha divai.

english: But the king replied, “What have I to do with you, O sons of Zeruiah? If he curses me because the LORD told him, ‘Curse David,’ who can ask, ‘Why did you do this?’”
ekegusii: Omorwoti akabora, “Inki inde nainwe abamura b’omokuungu Seruya? Onye okoragereria, ekiagera Omonene amoteebirie ng’a andagererie inche Daudi, ning’o oranyaare komoboria; Ninki kiagera ogokora iga?”
swahili: Lakini mfalme akamwambia, “Mna nini nami, enyi wana wa Seruya? Ikiwa analaani kwa sababu Bwana amemwambia, ‘Mlaani Daudi,’ nani awezaye kuuliza, ‘Kwa nini unafanya hivi?’ ”

english: Then David said to Abishai and to all his servants, “Behold, my own son, my own flesh and blood, seeks my life. How much more, then, this Benjamite! Leave him alone and let him curse me, for the LORD has told him so.
ekegusii: Daudi agateebia Abisai na abasomba baye bonsi, “Rigereria, omwana one ’ndusetie ase enda y’ane, nere okondigia ang’ite. Bono omonto oyo bw’egesaku gia Benjamini, Inee, takondigia goetania? Motige andame. Omonene nere omotebirie ng’a andame.
swahili: Ndipo Daudi akamwambia Abishai na maafisa wake wote, “Mwanangu, yeye ambaye ametoka viunoni mwangu mwenyewe, anajaribu kuuondoa uhai wangu. Je, si zaidi sana kwa huyu Mbenyamini! Mwacheni, acha alaani, kwa maana Bwana amemwambia afanye hivyo.

english: Perhaps the LORD will see my affliction and repay me with good for the cursing I receive today.”
ekegusii: Ande Omonene ororire amabe anyoorete, nere ang’akane amaya ribaga ri’okoragererigwa okwo kwanyoorire reero.”
swahili: Inawezekana kwamba Bwana ataona dhiki yangu na kunilipa mema kwa ajili ya laana ninayopokea leo.”

english: So David and his men proceeded along the road as Shimei went along the ridge of the hill opposite him. As Shimei went, he yelled curses, threw stones, and flung dust at David.
ekegusii: Daudi na abanto baye bakaba bagendererete enchera yabo, na Simei nere okona‐goeta ensemo y’egetunwa, okoragereria; akamoruta amagena, na komosiarera ebuse.
swahili: Kwa hiyo Daudi na watu wake wakaendelea na safari yao barabarani, huku Shimei akiwa anatembea pembezoni mwa kilima sambamba na Daudi, huku akimlaani na kumtupia Daudi mawe na kumrushia mavumbi.

english: Finally, the king and all the people with him arrived, exhausted. And there he refreshed himself. The Counsel of Ahithophel and Hushai
ekegusii: Omorwoti na abanto baye bonsi konya barosire ekero baigete aase gete. Ase igo bakaba bagotimokera aroro. Abisalomu ore Yerusalemu
swahili: Mfalme na watu wote aliokuwa pamoja nao wakafika kwenye kituo chao wakiwa wamechoka. Mfalme akajiburudisha hapo. Shauri La Hushai Na Ahithofeli

english: Then Absalom and all the men of Israel came to Jerusalem, and Ahithophel was with him.
ekegusii: Abisalomu na abanto abwo bonsi b’Abaisraeli bagaika Yerusalemu, na Ahitofeli nigo arenge amo nere.
swahili: Wakati huo, Absalomu pamoja na watu wote wa Israeli wakafika Yerusalemu, naye Ahithofeli alikuwa pamoja naye.

english: And David’s friend Hushai the Archite went to Absalom and said to him, “Long live the king! Long live the king!”
ekegusii: Ekero Husai Omoariki, omosani o Daudi, aigete ase Abisalomu, akamoteebia, “Omorwoti, ochie kare! Omorwoti, ochie kare!”
swahili: Ndipo Hushai, Mwariki, rafiki wa Daudi, akamwendea Absalomu na kumwambia, “Mfalme aishi maisha marefu! Mfalme aishi maisha marefu!”

english: “Is this the loyalty you show your friend?” Absalom replied. “Why did you not go with your friend?”
ekegusii: Abisalomu akaboria Husai, “Inee! Obo nabwo obwegenwa ore nabwo ase Daudi, omosani oo? Inaki otatuny’anete omosani oo?”
swahili: Absalomu akamuuliza Hushai, “Je, huu ndio upendo unaomwonyesha rafiki yako? Kwa nini hukufuatana na rafiki yako?”

english: “Not at all,” Hushai answered. “For the one chosen by the LORD, by the people, and by all the men of Israel—his I will be, and with him I will remain.
ekegusii: Husai akamoiraneria, “Yaaya, taibo. Korende oy’Omonene achoorire, na abanto abwo, na Abaisraeli bonsi, bachoorire, inche nimbe oyoye, mbeere ase are.
swahili: Hushai akamwambia Absalomu, “La hasha, yeye aliyechaguliwa na Bwana, aliyechaguliwa na watu hawa, atakayechaguliwa tena na watu wote wa Israeli, huyu ndiye nitakayekuwa wake, nami nitabakia pamoja naye.

english: Furthermore, whom should I serve if not the son? As I served in your father’s presence, so also I will serve in yours.”
ekegusii: Naende ning’o ’ngwenerete nkorere? Tengwenereti ’ngokorere aye, omwana oye? Ee, buna narenge gokorera iso, naboigo naye ’ndagokorere.”
swahili: Zaidi ya hayo, nimtumikie nani? Je, nisimtumikie mwana? Kama vile nilivyomtumikia baba yako, ndivyo nitakavyokutumikia wewe.”

english: “Why do you have these?” asked the king. Ziba replied, “The donkeys are for the king’s household to ride, the bread and summer fruit are for the young men to eat, and the wine is to refresh those who become exhausted in the wilderness.”
ekegusii: Omorwoti akaboria Siba, “Inaki gwakora kwarenta ebinto ebi”? Siba akamoiraneria, “Chitigere nechi abanto b’omorwoti bagochia koriina, na emagaati na amatunda nebi’abamura abwo bagochia koria, na edivai baegwe banywe kobarosire ase erooro.”
swahili: Mfalme Daudi akamuuliza Siba, “Kwa nini umeleta vitu hivi?” Siba akamjibu, “Punda ni kwa ajili ya watu wa nyumba ya mfalme kupanda, mikate na matunda ni kwa ajili ya watu kula, nayo divai ni kwa kuwaburudisha watakaochoka jangwani.”

english: Then Absalom said to Ahithophel, “Give me counsel. What should we do?”
ekegusii: Erio Abisalomu agateebia Ahitofeli, “Bono buna tore aa, tosemie eki togwenerete gokora.”
swahili: Absalomu akamwambia Ahithofeli, “Tupe shauri lako. Tufanye nini?”

english: Ahithophel replied, “Sleep with your father’s concubines, whom he has left to keep the palace. When all Israel hears that you have become a stench to your father, then the hands of all who are with you will be strengthened.”
ekegusii: Ahitofeli akairaneria Abisalomu, “Soa nyomba, momeny’ane nabakungu ba sere‐sere abwo iso atiga bakorenda enyomba. Igo Abaisraeli bonsi bakoigwa ng’a kwagechiigwe na iso, na abwo bonsi bagokobwatia nigo barabeekwe chinguru.”
swahili: Ahithofeli akamjibu, “Kutana kimwili na masuria wa baba yako aliowaacha kutunza jumba la kifalme. Ndipo Israeli yote itakaposikia kwamba umejifanya chukizo kwa baba yako, nayo mikono ya kila mmoja aliye pamoja nawe itatiwa nguvu.”

english: So they pitched a tent for Absalom on the roof, and he slept with his father’s concubines in the sight of all Israel.
ekegusii: Ase igo barabwo bagateneneria Abisalomu eema kerama igoro, na ere akaraara nabakungu ba sere‐sere ba ise maiso marore ase Abaisraeli bonsi.
swahili: Kwa hiyo wakasimika hema kwa ajili ya Absalomu juu ya paa, naye akakutana kimwili na masuria wa baba yake mbele ya Israeli wote.

english: Now in those days the advice of Ahithophel was like the consultation of the word of God. Such was the regard that both David and Absalom had for Ahithophel’s advice.
ekegusii: Ase engaki eria ogoseemia kw’Ahitofeli gokaba ase abanto buna amairanerio omonto akonyora korwa ase Nyasae. Naboigo ogoseemia kw’Ahitofeli kwabeete ase Daudi na ase Abisalomu.
swahili: Ilikuwa katika siku hizo shauri lililotolewa na Ahithofeli lilikuwa kama lile ambalo limeulizwa kwa Mungu. Ndivyo Daudi na Absalomu walivyoyaheshimu mashauri yote ya Ahithofeli.

english: “Where is your master’s grandson?” asked the king. And Ziba answered, “Indeed, he is staying in Jerusalem, for he has said, ‘Today, the house of Israel will restore to me the kingdom of my grandfather.’”
ekegusii: Omorwoti akamobooria, “Ng’ai omoochokoro bw’omonene oo akare”? Siba akamoiraneria, “Yerusalemu akare. Nigo ateeba ng’a reero Abaisraeli bamoiraneirie oborwoti bwa sokoro yaye.”
swahili: Kisha mfalme akauliza, “Yuko wapi mwana wa bwana wako?” Siba akamwambia, “Anakawia Yerusalemu, kwa sababu anafikiri, ‘Leo nyumba ya Israeli itanirudishia utawala wa baba yangu.’ ”

english: So the king said to Ziba, “All that belongs to Mephibosheth is now yours!” “I humbly bow before you,” said Ziba. “May I find favor in your eyes, my lord the king!” Shimei Curses David
ekegusii: Erio omorwoti agateebia Siba, “Rigereria, kera egento ekiarenge ekia Mefiboseti nekiao.” Siba akamoteebia, “Nebeekire inse ase ore. Koranche inyore ogwancherwa ase ore, aye omorwoti, omonene one.” Daudi na Simei
swahili: Ndipo mfalme akamwambia Siba, “Yote yaliyokuwa mali ya Mefiboshethi sasa ni mali yako.” Siba akasema, “Nasujudu kwa unyenyekevu. Naomba nipate kibali mbele yako, bwana wangu mfalme.” Shimei Amlaani Daudi

english: As King David approached Bahurim, a man from the family of the house of Saul was just coming out. His name was Shimei son of Gera, and as he approached, he kept yelling out curses.
ekegusii: Ekero omorwoti Daudi aigete Bahurimu, omonto bw’eamate ya Saulo ore korokwa Simei, mosinto o Gera, agasoka korwa ase omochie. Ere kagoocha akana‐koragereria Daudi.
swahili: Mfalme Daudi alipokuwa anakaribia Bahurimu, mtu mmoja kutoka ukoo huo huo kama jamaa ya Sauli, akatoka humo, ambaye jina lake ni Shimei mwana wa Gera; akawa analaani alipokuwa akitoka.

english: He threw stones at David and at all the servants of the king, though the troops and all the mighty men were on David’s right and left.
ekegusii: Akaba okoruta amagena ase Daudi omorwoti na ase abasomba baye bonsi, nonya abanto bonsi, amo nabaria chituoni, bamoetanaine, ase ensemo ya borio na eya bomosi.
swahili: Akamtupia Daudi na maafisa wote wa mfalme mawe, ingawa vikosi vyote na walinzi maalum walikuwa kulia na kushoto mwa Daudi.

english: And as he yelled curses, Shimei said, “Get out, get out, you worthless man of bloodshed!
ekegusii: Simei gakoragereria, akabora, “Karue aa! Karue aa! Aye omoiteri amanyinga! Aye omosaria!
swahili: Shimei alivyokuwa akilaani, akasema, “Toka hapa, toka hapa, wewe mtu wa damu, wewe mtu mbaya kabisa!

english: The LORD has paid you back for all the blood of the house of Saul, in whose place you have reigned, and the LORD has delivered the kingdom into the hand of your son Absalom. See, you have come to ruin because you are a man of bloodshed!”
ekegusii: Aye nigo kwairete oborwoti korwa ase Saulo, na b’Omonene ’nkoruseria are abanto b’enyomba ya Saulo abwo gwaitete egesiomba. Bono Omonene obeekire oborwoti ase okoboko kw’Aibsalomu, omwana oo. Rigereria, obobe bwao bwakoiraneire, aye omoiteri amanyinga.”
swahili: Bwana amekulipiza kwa ajili ya damu yote uliyomwaga ya watu wa nyumba ya Sauli, ambaye nafasi yake umeimiliki wewe. Bwana amekabidhi ufalme mkononi mwa mwanao Absalomu. Maangamizi yamekupata kwa sababu wewe ni mtu wa damu!”

english: Then Abishai son of Zeruiah said to the king, “Why should this dead dog curse my lord the king? Let me go over and cut off his head!”
ekegusii: Erio Abisai, omomura bw’omokuungu Seruya, agateebia omorwoti, “Inaki eseese eria ekwete egokoragereria iga, aye omorwoti, omonene one? Tiga ’ngeende mbutore omotwe oye.”
swahili: Ndipo Abishai mwana wa Seruya akamwambia mfalme, “Kwa nini huyu mbwa mfu amlaani bwana wangu mfalme? Niruhusu nivuke nikatilie mbali kichwa chake.”

english: Furthermore, Ahithophel said to Absalom, “Let me choose twelve thousand men and set out tonight in pursuit of David.
ekegusii: Magega y’ayio Ahitofeli agateebia Abisalomu, “Tiga ’nchoore abanto chilifu ikomi na ibere (12,000), erinde ’mbwatie Daudi ase obotuko obo.
swahili: Ahithofeli akamwambia Absalomu, “Nipe ruhusa niwachague watu kumi na mbili elfu na waanze safari usiku huu huu kumfuatia Daudi.

english: Then even the most valiant soldier with the heart of a lion will melt with fear, because all Israel knows that your father is a mighty man who has valiant men with him.
ekegusii: Igo nonya noyore omoremu buna endo, nigo arairianyeke kegima, ekiagera Abaisraeli bonsi ’mbamanyete ng’a iso nigo are etuoni y’eseegi, na abanto baye nabatindi ase esegi.
swahili: Basi hata yule askari hodari kuliko wengine wote, ambaye moyo wake ni kama wa simba, atayeyuka kwa hofu, kwa maana Israeli yote wanajua kwamba baba yako ni mpiganaji na kwamba wale walio pamoja naye ni watu hodari.

english: Instead, I advise that all Israel from Dan to Beersheba—a multitude like the sand on the seashore—be gathered to you, and that you yourself lead them into battle.
ekegusii: Ase ayio ogoseemia kwane n’oko: Orente Abaisraeli bonsi amo korwa Dani goika Beeri‐Seba babe abange buna omokenye ore engegu y’enyancha; naye omonyene ogende amo nabarabwo ase esegi.
swahili: “Kwa hiyo nakushauri: Israeli wote na wakusanyikie kwako, kuanzia Dani hadi Beer-Sheba, katika wingi wao jinsi walivyo kama mchanga wa ufuoni mwa bahari, wewe mwenyewe ukiwaongoza vitani.

english: Then we will attack David wherever we find him, and we will descend on him like dew on the ground. And of all the men with him, not even one will remain.
ekegusii: Erio toorokere Daudi aande onsi aranyorekane, tomogwere buna riime rikogwa igoro ase riroba, gose titotiga onde bwensi abe moyo, ere gose monto onde bwensi bare komo.
swahili: Ndipo tutakapomshambulia popote atakapoonekana, nasi tutamwangukia kama umande unavyoshuka juu ya ardhi. Yeye mwenyewe wala watu wake hakuna atakayeachwa hai.

english: If he retreats to a city, all Israel will bring ropes to that city, and we will drag it down to the valley until not even a pebble can be found.”
ekegusii: Aise gosoa ase omochie onde bwensi, Abaisraeli bonsi nigo baraarente chingori bachietananie omochie oyio, bayokuruure gochia rooche ime, gose igena rinde tirigotigara nonya nerimo.”
swahili: Kama atakimbilia katika mji wowote, basi Israeli wote watazungushia mji ule kamba, nasi tutauburuta mji huo mpaka bondeni hadi isionekane hata changarawe ya huo mji.”

english: Then Absalom and all the men of Israel said, “The advice of Hushai the Archite is better than that of Ahithophel.” For the LORD had purposed to thwart the good counsel of Ahithophel in order to bring disaster on Absalom. Hushai’s Warning Saves David (Psalms 55:1–23)
ekegusii: Abisalomu na Abaisraeli bonsi bakaboora, “Ogoseemia kwa Husai Omoariki nokuya kobua koria kw’Ahitofeli.” Omonene nere ochiigete ogoseemia okwo okuya kw’Ahitofeli kwangwe, erinde arentere Abisalomu emechando. Daudi ogokuurerwa atame etoorie
swahili: Absalomu na watu wote wa Israeli wakasema, “Shauri la Hushai, Mwariki, ni jema zaidi kuliko lile la Ahithofeli.” Kwa maana Bwana alikuwa amekusudia kupinga shauri nzuri la Ahithofeli, ili kuleta maafa juu ya Absalomu.

english: So Hushai told Zadok and Abiathar, the priests, “This is what Ahithophel has advised Absalom and the elders of Israel, and this is what I have advised.
ekegusii: Husai agateebia Zadoki na Abiatari, abakuani, “Ahitofeli oseemirie Abisalomu na abagaaka b’Abaisraeli amang’ana aya na aya, korende inche nabaseemia iga na iga.
swahili: Hushai akawaambia makuhani Sadoki na Abiathari, “Ahithofeli amemshauri Absalomu na wazee wa Israeli kufanya kadha wa kadha, lakini mimi nimewashauri wao kufanya kadha wa kadha.

english: Now send quickly and tell David, ‘Do not spend the night at the fords of the wilderness, but be sure to cross over. Otherwise the king and all the people with him will be swallowed up.’”
ekegusii: Bono toma amang’ana bwango, mokuurere Daudi ng’a tabaisa koraara ase obotuko obo ase ebiambokero agwo ase erooro, korende goika amboke orooche, erinde tabaisa gosirigwa amo n’abanto baye bonsi.”
swahili: Sasa tumeni ujumbe haraka na kumwambia Daudi, ‘Usiku huu usilale kwenye vivuko katika jangwa; vuka bila kukosa, la sivyo, mfalme pamoja na watu wote waliofuatana naye watamezwa.’ ”

english: Now Jonathan and Ahimaaz were staying at En-rogel, where a servant girl would come and pass along information to them. They in turn would go and inform King David, for they dared not be seen entering the city.
ekegusii: Bono Yonathani na Ahimasi nigo bareenge baganyete ase ensoko y’Eni‐Rogeli, ekiagera boboete gosoa omochie ime baabaise kororwa. Omoiseke omosomba oyomo nigo arenge okona‐kobairera amang’ana, nabarabwo bayairera omorwoti Daudi.
swahili: Yonathani na Ahimaasi walikuwa wakingoja huko En-Rogeli, naye mtumishi mmoja wa kike akawa anakwenda kuwapasha habari nao wakawa wanakwenda kumwambia Mfalme Daudi, kwa maana wasingetaka kujihatarisha kuonekana wakiingia mjini.

english: But a young man did see them and told Absalom. So the two left quickly and came to the house of a man in Bahurim. He had a well in his courtyard, and they climbed down into it.
ekegusii: Korende rituko erimo omosae oyomo akabarora, agateebia Abisalomu amang’ana ayio. Ase ayio Yonathani na Ahimasi bakageenda ase enka y’omonto gete aaria Bahurimu. Omonto oyio nabwate engoro y’amaache ase omochie oye, nabarabwo bakebisa imeo,
swahili: Lakini kijana mmoja mwanaume akawaona, naye akamwambia Absalomu. Basi wote wawili wakaondoka haraka, wakaenda mpaka kwenye nyumba ya mtu mmoja huko Bahurimu. Mtu huyo alikuwa na kisima katika ua wa nyumba yake, nao Yonathani na Ahimaasi wakateremka ndani ya kisima hicho.

english: Then the man’s wife took a covering and spread it over the mouth of the well, scattering grain over it so nobody would know a thing.
ekegusii: na omokungu bw’omonto oria akaimokia egekuneko, akayekuneka, akanekera endagera yaye igoro aroro; gose omonto onde tamanyete amang’ana ayio.
swahili: Mkewe akachukua kifuniko, akakiweka kwenye mdomo wa kile kisima na kuanika nafaka juu yake. Hakuna mtu yeyote aliyefahamu chochote kuhusu jambo hilo.

english: I will attack him while he is weak and weary; I will throw him into a panic, and all the people with him will flee; I will strike down only the king
ekegusii: Inche imochiere mobosokano imogose ekero arosire na erusirie moyo. Abanto abwo bonsi bare komo mbatame, nainche ninyare goita omorwoti kare bweka.
swahili: Nitamshambulia wakati akiwa amechoka na ni dhaifu. Nitampiga na hofu, na kisha watu wote walio pamoja naye watakimbia. Nitampiga mfalme peke yake

english: When Absalom’s servants came to the woman at the house, they asked, “Where are Ahimaaz and Jonathan?” “They have crossed over the brook,” she replied. The men searched but did not find them, so they returned to Jerusalem.
ekegusii: Ekero abasomba b’Abisalomu bachete ase omokungu oria nyomba ime, bakamobooria, “Ng’ai Yonathani na Ahimasi bare?” Omokungu oria akabateebia, “Bambokire orooche orwo, bachiire.” Ekero abanto baria baabarigetie tibaabarora, bakairana Yerusalemu.
swahili: Watu wa Absalomu walipofika kwa huyo mwanamke, wakamuuliza, “Wako wapi Ahimaasi na Yonathani?” Huyo mwanamke akawajibu, “Walivuka kijito.” Watu wa Absalomu wakapekua lakini hawakuwaona hata mmoja, hivyo wakarudi Yerusalemu.

english: After the men had gone, Ahimaaz and Jonathan climbed up out of the well and went to inform King David, saying, “Get up and cross over the river at once, for Ahithophel has given this advice against you.”
ekegusii: Magega barabwo kobachiire, baria babere bagasooka korwa ase engoro eria, bakaamboka orooche bwango, bakageenda ase omorwoti Daudi bakamoteebia, “Imoka mwamboke orooche bwango, morue aa, inaki aya na aya naro Ahitofeli arobeirie mamincha yaino.”
swahili: Baada ya watu hao kuondoka, wale watu wawili yaani Yonathani na Ahimaasi wakapanda kutoka mle kisimani na kwenda kumpasha Mfalme Daudi habari. Wakamwambia, “Ondoka, uvuke haya maji haraka. Ahithofeli ameshauri kadha wa kadha dhidi yako.”

english: So David and all the people with him got up and crossed the Jordan. By daybreak, there was no one left who had not crossed the Jordan.
ekegusii: Erio Daudi na abanto bonsi barenge komo bakaimoka, bakaamboka Yorodani. Bogachia gokia, bonsi konya bambokire; onde tatigarete otaambogete.
swahili: Kwa hiyo Daudi na watu wote aliokuwa nao waliondoka na kuvuka Yordani. Kufika wakati wa mapambazuko, hapakuwa na mtu hata mmoja ambaye alikuwa hajavuka Mto Yordani.

english: When Ahithophel saw that his advice had not been followed, he saddled his donkey and set out for his house in his hometown. He put his affairs in order and hanged himself. So he died and was buried in his father’s tomb.
ekegusii: Ekero Ahitofeli arooche ng’a ogosemia kwaye kwangirwe, akariina etigere yaye, akageenda omochie oye, na karobeirie amang’ana y’enyomba yaye, akageenda agesunga, agakwa. Gakuure agatindekwa ase oboina bwa ise.
swahili: Ahithofeli alipoona kwamba shauri lake halikufuatwa, akatandika punda wake, akaondoka kwenda nyumbani kwake kwenye mji wake. Akaiweka nyumba yake katika utaratibu, kisha akajinyonga mwenyewe. Hivyo akafa na akazikwa katika kaburi la baba yake.

english: Then David went to Mahanaim, and Absalom crossed the Jordan with all the men of Israel.
ekegusii: Daudi konya oikire Mahanaimu ekero Abisalomu ambogete Yorodani amo n’Abaisraeli bonsi barenge komo.
swahili: Daudi akaenda Mahanaimu, naye Absalomu akavuka Yordani pamoja na watu wote wa Israeli.

english: Absalom had appointed Amasa over the army in place of Joab. Amasa was the son of a man named Ithra, the Ishmaelite who had married Abigail, the daughter of Nahash and sister of Zeruiah the mother of Joab.
ekegusii: Abisalomu konya obeekire Amasa koba omotang’ani bw’abarwani b’esegi ribaga ria Yoabu. Amasa nigo arenge mosinto o Yitira Omoisumaeli. Yitira nere omeny’anete n’Abigaeli, omoiseke o Nahasi, mosubati omwabo Seruya, oyorenge ng’ina Yoabu.
swahili: Absalomu alikuwa amemweka Amasa juu ya jeshi badala ya Yoabu. Amasa alikuwa mwana wa mtu mmoja aliyeitwa Yetheri, Mwisraeli, ambaye alikuwa amemwoa Abigaili binti Nahashi, dada yake Seruya mamaye Yoabu.

english: So the Israelites and Absalom camped in the land of Gilead.
ekegusii: Abisalomu amo n’Abaisraeli bagatoora ase ense ya Gileadi.
swahili: Waisraeli na Absalomu wakapiga kambi huko nchi ya Gileadi.

english: When David came to Mahanaim, he was met by Shobi son of Nahash from Rabbah of the Ammonites, Machir son of Ammiel from Lo-debar, and Barzillai the Gileadite from Rogelim.
ekegusii: Ekaba Daudi gaikire Mahanaimu, akanyorana na Sobi, mosinto o Nahasi, korwa Raba, ase ense y’Abaamoni, na Makiri, mosinto bw’Amieli, korwa Lo‐Debari, na Barisilai Omogileadi korwa Rogelimu.
swahili: Daudi alipofika Mahanaimu, Shobi mwana wa Nahashi kutoka Raba ya Waamoni, Makiri mwana wa Amieli kutoka Lo-Debari, na Barzilai Mgileadi kutoka Rogelimu

english: They brought beds, basins, and earthen vessels, as well as wheat, barley, flour, roasted grain, beans, lentils,
ekegusii: Barabwo bakarenta ebiraarero, ne chisani, na ebikorero biroisirie korwa ase amaroba. Boigo bakarenta engano, na esairi, na obosie, na ebigara bisaambire, ne ching’ende ao ao,
swahili: wakaleta matandiko ya kitandani, mabakuli na vyombo vya mfinyanzi. Walileta pia ngano na shayiri, unga na bisi, maharagwe na kunde,

english: honey, curds, sheep, and cheese from the herd for David and his people to eat. For they said, “The people have become hungry, exhausted, and thirsty in the wilderness.”
ekegusii: na obooke, na amaguta, nemekera, na ebirandi bi’mabeere ye chiombe atundire bibe endagera ase Daudi amo n’abanto bareenge komo. Abwo babirentete nigo bateebete, “Abanto aba enchara yabanyarire, naende barang’ire na barosire aiga ase erooro.”
swahili: asali na maziwa yaliyoganda, kondoo na jibini kutoka kwenye maziwa ya ngʼombe kwa ajili ya Daudi na watu wake ili wale. Kwa maana walisema, “Watu wameona njaa, tena wamechoka na wamepata kiu huko jangwani.”

english: and bring all the people back to you as a bride returning to her husband. You seek the life of only one man; then all the people will be at peace.”
ekegusii: Erio ’mbarente abanto bonsi ase ore, buna omoriakari akorentwa ase omosacha oye. Aye nomonto oyomo origetie oite; naende abanto bonsi babe n’omorembe.”
swahili: na kuwarudisha watu wote kwako. Kifo cha mtu yule unayemtafuta kitamaanisha kurudi kwa wote, hakuna hata mtu mmoja atakayeumizwa.”

english: This proposal seemed good to Absalom and all the elders of Israel.
ekegusii: Ogoseemia okwo gokagwenera Abisalomu na abagaaka bonsi b’Abaisraeli.
swahili: Mpango huu ulionekana mzuri kwa Absalomu na kwa wazee wote wa Israeli.

english: Then Absalom said, “Summon Hushai the Archite as well, and let us hear what he too has to say.”
ekegusii: Erio Abisalomu akabora, “Rangeria Husai Omoariki, toigwe nere, buna agototeebia.”
swahili: Lakini Absalomu akasema, “Pia mwiteni Hushai, Mwariki, ili tuweze kusikia anachokisema.”

english: So Hushai came to Absalom, who told him, “Ahithophel has spoken this proposal. Should we carry it out? If not, what do you say?”
ekegusii: Na ekero Husai achete ase Abisalomu, Abisalomu akamoteebia, “Aya naro Ahitofeli atoseemirie. Naro tokobwatia gose? Onye taibo, aye toteebie aya togokora.”
swahili: Hushai alipokuja, Absalomu akasema, “Ahithofeli ametoa shauri hili. Je, tufanye anavyosema? Kama sivyo, tupe maoni yako.”

english: Hushai replied, “This time the advice of Ahithophel is not sound.”
ekegusii: Husai akairaneria Abisalomu, “Ogoseemia okwo Ahitofeli abaeire tikori okuya ase ekero eke.”
swahili: Hushai akamjibu Absalomu, “Shauri la Ahithofeli alilotoa halifai kwa wakati huu.

english: He continued, “You know your father and his men. They are mighty men, and as fierce as a wild bear robbed of her cubs. Moreover, your father is a man of war who will not spend the night with the troops.
ekegusii: Naende Husai akamoteebia, “Nomanyete iso na abanto baye, ng’a n’abanto chituoni chi’eseegi, bare abakong’u, naende nigo bare abatindi buna riurugenyi yaurirwe chimanwa chiaye ase orosana. Iso nomonto omanyete korwana esegi, takoraara botuko, ere n’abanto baye.
swahili: Unamfahamu baba yako na watu wake, ni wapiganaji hodari, nao ni wakali kama dubu mwitu aliyepokonywa watoto wake. Zaidi ya hayo, baba yako ni mpiganaji jasiri, usiku hatalala pamoja na vikosi.

english: Surely by now he is hiding in a cave or some other location. If some of your troops fall first, whoever hears of it will say, ‘There has been a slaughter among the troops who follow Absalom.’
ekegusii: Ande nonya ’mbono nigo ebisete ase engoro gete, gose ase ribwago. Keraabe ng’a abanto ’mbaitwe ekero esegi egochaaka, onde bwensi karaigwe amang’ana ayio nigo arateebe ng’a abanto bare kobwatia Abisalomu babuirwe.
swahili: Hata sasa, amefichwa ndani ya pango au mahali pengine. Kama atatangulia kushambulia vikosi vyako, yeyote asikiaye habari hii atasema, ‘Kuna machinjo makubwa miongoni mwa vikosi vinavyomfuata Absalomu.’

english: Then David reviewed his troops and appointed over them commanders of hundreds and of thousands.
ekegusii: Omorwoti Daudi akaroberia abanto baye, akabaatanana ase ebiombe bi’elifu elifu, na ebie rigana, akababeekera abatang’ani
swahili: Daudi akakusanya watu aliokuwa nao na kuweka majemadari wa maelfu na majemadari wa mamia.

english: When one of the men saw this, he told Joab, “I just saw Absalom hanging in an oak tree!”
ekegusii: Omonto gete akamorora, akageenda ase Yoabu akamoteebia, “Narora Abisalomu osung’unaine agwo moino ase omoaruni igoro.”
swahili: Mmojawapo wa wale watu alipoona, akamwambia Yoabu, “Nimemwona Absalomu akiningʼinia kwenye mti wa mwaloni.”

english: “You just saw him!” Joab exclaimed. “Why did you not strike him to the ground right there? I would have given you ten shekels of silver and a warrior’s belt!”
ekegusii: Yoabu akamoiraneria, “Onye kwamorora, ninki kiaba tikwamoita erio kegima? Inche anga ’naaba nomogooko inkoe chitaabu chisekeli chi’echifeta ikomi, amo norokini.”
swahili: Yoabu akamwambia huyo mtu, “Nini! Ulimwona Absalomu? Kwa nini hukumpiga papo hapo mpaka chini? Ndipo ningekupa shekeli kumi za fedha na mkanda wa askari shujaa.”

english: The man replied, “Even if a thousand shekels of silver were weighed out into my hands, I would not raise my hand against the son of the king. For we heard the king command you and Abishai and Ittai, ‘Protect the young man Absalom for my sake. ’
ekegusii: Omonto oria agateebia Yoabu, “Nonya kware kong’a chisekeli chi’echifeta elifu eyemo, tinare korambora okoboko kwane igoro y’omwana bw’omorwoti, inaki twensi ’ntwaigwete ekero omorwoti agochiigete aye, na Abisai, na Itai, ogoteeba: Ase engencho y’ane oreende omosae oyio Abisalomu.
swahili: Lakini huyo mtu akamjibu Yoabu, “Hata kama ningepimiwa shekeli 1,000 mikononi mwangu, nisingeinua mkono wangu dhidi ya mwana wa mfalme. Tukiwa tunasikia, mfalme alikuagiza wewe na Abishai pamoja na Itai, akisema, ‘Mlindeni kijana Absalomu kwa ajili yangu.’

english: If I had jeopardized my own life —and nothing is hidden from the king—you would have abandoned me.”
ekegusii: Onye inanga tinyigwera omorwoti, korende ing’ite omwana oye, ere anga naigwa amang’ana ayio, ekiagera nigo are komanya kera ring’ana. Inee! Aye omonyene ’ngonkengera kware?”
swahili: Nami kama ningekuwa nimemtendea kwa hila, na hakuna lolote linalofichika kwa mfalme, wewe mwenyewe ungejitenga nami.”

english: But Joab declared, “I am not going to wait like this with you!” And he took three spears in his hand and thrust them through the heart of Absalom while he was still alive in the oak tree.
ekegusii: Erio Yoabu akabora, “Tinkoora gosaria chingaki gokwana naye boire.” Akaimokia amatimo atato, akabeta Abisalomu egekuba igoro, agachia konacha enkoro, ekero Abisalomu asung’unanete ase omoaluni igoro ore moyo.
swahili: Yoabu akasema, “Mimi sitapoteza muda hapa pamoja nawe.” Hivyo akachukua mikuki mitatu mkononi mwake, akamchoma Absalomu nayo moyoni alipokuwa angali hai akiningʼinia katika ule mwaloni.

english: And ten young men who carried Joab’s armor surrounded Absalom, struck him, and killed him.
ekegusii: Erio abamura ikomi ababogoreretie Yoabu ebirwanero, bagaetanana Abisalomu, bakamoaka na komoita.
swahili: Nao wabeba silaha kumi wa Yoabu wakamzunguka Absalomu, wakampiga na kumuua.

english: Then Joab blew the ram’s horn, and the troops broke off their pursuit of Israel because Joab had restrained them.
ekegusii: Magega y’ayio Yoabu akabugia egetuureri ase ogotanga esegi, na abanto bakairana bagatiga kobwatia Abaisraeli.
swahili: Kisha Yoabu akapiga tarumbeta, navyo vikosi vikaacha kuwafuata Israeli, kwa maana Yoabu aliwasimamisha.

english: They took Absalom, cast him into a large pit in the forest, and piled a huge mound of stones over him. Meanwhile, all the Israelites fled, each to his home.
ekegusii: Abanto bakaimokia omobere bw’Abisalomu, bakayoruta ase engoro entambe, agwo ase rinani, bakayotuba amagena akaba etui enene, na Abaisraeli bonsi bagatama kera omonto gochia bwoye.
swahili: Wakamchukua Absalomu, wakamtupa katika shimo kubwa huko msituni na kulundika lundo kubwa la mawe juu yake. Huko nyuma, Waisraeli wote wakakimbilia nyumbani kwao.

english: During his lifetime, Absalom had set up for himself a pillar in the King’s Valley, for he had said, “I have no son to preserve the memory of my name.” So he gave the pillar his name, and to this day it is called Absalom’s Monument. David Mourns for Absalom
ekegusii: Ekero Abisalomu arenge moyo konya bweagaacheire egento buna esiiro, agakebeeka agwo ase Ense Omweya y’Omorwoti gekaba ekeinyorio ki’erieta riaye; akarengereria ng’a tari na monyamwando. Akayeroka ase erieta riaye omonyene; na goika reero iga nigo ekorokwa Ekeinyorio ki’Abisalomu. Daudi ogoteebigwa igoro y’ogokwa kw’Abisalomu
swahili: Wakati wa uhai wa Absalomu alikuwa amechukua nguzo na kuisimamisha katika Bonde la Mfalme, kwa maana alifikiri, “Sina mwana atakayeendeleza kumbukumbu ya jina langu.” Akaita nguzo hiyo kwa jina lake mwenyewe. Nayo inaitwa Mnara wa Ukumbusho wa Absalomu mpaka leo. Daudi Aomboleza Kifo Cha Absalomu

english: Then Ahimaaz son of Zadok said, “Please let me run and tell the king the good news that the LORD has avenged him of his enemies.”
ekegusii: Ahimasi, mosinto o Zadoki, agateebia Yoabu, “Tiga iminyoke ’nteebie omorwoti amang’ana, buna Omonene amotooririe korwa ase ababisa baye.”
swahili: Basi Ahimaasi mwana wa Sadoki akasema, “Niruhusu mimi nikimbie na kumpelekea mfalme habari kwamba Bwana amemwokoa mfalme kutoka mikononi mwa adui zake.”

english: He sent out the troops, a third under Joab, a third under Joab’s brother Abishai son of Zeruiah, and a third under Ittai the Gittite. And the king said to the troops, “I will surely march out with you as well.”
ekegusii: Erio agatoma abarwani bageende korwana esegi, bare ebiombe bitato, ekemo inse y’oboraai bwa Yoabu, ne egia kabere inse y’oboraai bw’Abisai, omomura bw’omokuungu Seruya, oyorenge ng’ina Yoabu boigo, na ekia gatato inse y’oboraai bwa Itai korwa Gati. Omorwoti agateebia abanto baye, “Nigo ’nkogeenda amo nainwe inche omonyene.”
swahili: Daudi akatuma vikosi vya askari: theluthi moja ilikuwa chini ya amri ya Yoabu, theluthi ya pili chini ya Abishai mwana wa Seruya nduguye Yoabu, na theluthi ya tatu chini ya Itai, Mgiti. Mfalme akaviambia vikosi, “Hakika mimi mwenyewe nitakwenda pamoja nanyi.”

english: But Joab replied, “You are not the man to take good news today. You may do it another day, but you must not do so today, because the king’s son is dead.”
ekegusii: Yoabu akamokania, akamoteebia, “Yaya, reero tokonyara koba omonto okoira amang’ana amaya. Rituko rinde nonyare koira amang’ana amaya, korende tari reero, ekiagera omwana bw’omorwoti okuure.”
swahili: Yoabu akamwambia Ahimaasi, “Leo si wewe utakayepeleka habari. Unaweza kupeleka habari wakati mwingine, lakini leo haikupasi kupeleka, kwa sababu mwana wa mfalme amekufa.”

english: So Joab said to a Cushite, “Go, tell the king what you have seen.” The Cushite bowed to Joab and took off running.
ekegusii: Erio Yoabu agateebia Omoetiopia oyomo, “Geenda oteebie omorwoti aya kwarora.” Na Omoetiopia oria agekuumba inse ase obosio bwa Yoabu, akaminyoka kogeenda.
swahili: Ndipo Yoabu akamwambia mtu mmoja Mkushi, “Nenda, ukamwambie mfalme kile ulichoona.” Mkushi akasujudu mbele ya Yoabu akaondoka mbio.

english: Ahimaaz son of Zadok, however, persisted and said to Joab, “Regardless of whatever may happen, please let me also run behind the Cushite!” “My son,” Joab replied, “why do you want to run, since you will not receive a reward?”
ekegusii: Ahimasi, mosinto o Zadoki, agateebia Yoabu eria kabere. “Ande onsi arabe, koranche ong’e ribaga iminyoke korwa magega y’Omoetiopia oria ng’irere omorwoti amang’ana.” Yoabu akamobooria, “Omwana one, gokominyoka, ninki orachie konyora? Ayio tari amang’ana amaya airwa.”
swahili: Ahimaasi mwana wa Sadoki akamwambia tena Yoabu, “Liwalo na liwe, tafadhali niruhusu nikimbie nyuma ya huyo Mkushi.” Lakini Yoabu akajibu, “Mwanangu, mbona wataka kwenda? Wewe huna habari yoyote itakayokupa tuzo.”

english: “No matter what, I want to run!” he replied. “Then run!” Joab told him. So Ahimaaz ran by way of the plain and outran the Cushite.
ekegusii: Ahimasi akamoiraneria, “Ayio tari mang’ana, ing’a ribaga ’ngeende.” Yoabu akamoiraneria, “Minyoka bono.” Erio Ahimasi akaminyoka agaetania Omoetiopia oria agwo ase ense omweya ya Yorodani.
swahili: Ahimaasi akasema, “Liwalo na liwe, nataka kukimbia.” Kwa hiyo Yoabu akamwambia, “Haya, kimbia!” Ndipo Ahimaasi akakimbia kufuata njia ya kupitia tambarare, akafika kabla ya huyo Mkushi.

english: Now David was sitting between the two gates when the watchman went up to the roof of the gateway by the wall, looked out, and saw a man running alone.
ekegusii: Bono Daudi nigo aikaransete egati y’ebiita bibere bi’omochie, egia isiko na ekia ime. Omorendi akariina gochia kerama igoro y’ebiita, ang’e norwaki. Na ekero arigereretie akarora omonto oyomo okominyoka goocha ore bweka.
swahili: Wakati Daudi alipokuwa ameketi kati ya lango la ndani na la nje, mlinzi akapanda juu ya paa la lango kupitia ukutani. Alipotazama nje, akaona mtu mmoja akikimbia peke yake.

english: So he called out and told the king. “If he is alone,” the king replied, “he bears good news.” As the first runner drew near,
ekegusii: Omorendi akarangeria gochia inse, agateebia omorwoti amang’ana ayio. Na omorwoti akamoteebia, “Onye ore bweka nigo abwate amang’ana amaya.” Omonto oria akaba ogoika ang’e kobua.
swahili: Mlinzi akampazia mfalme sauti na kumpa taarifa. Mfalme akasema, “Ikiwa yuko peke yake, lazima atakuwa na habari njema.” Naye yule mtu akazidi kusogea karibu.

english: the watchman saw another man running, and he called out to the gatekeeper, “Look! Another man is running alone!” “This one also brings good news,” said the king.
ekegusii: Naende omorendi akarora omonto onde okominyoka goocha ore bweka. Erio akarangeria omorendi bw’egesieri, akamoteebia, “Omonto onde oyio goocha ore bweka!” Omorwoti agateeba, “Nere boigo namang’ana amaya abwate.”
swahili: Kisha mlinzi akaona mtu mwingine anakuja akikimbia, akamwita bawabu, “Tazama, mtu mwingine anakuja akikimbia peke yake!” Mfalme akasema, “Lazima atakuwa analeta habari njema pia.”

english: The watchman said, “The first man appears to me to be running like Ahimaaz son of Zadok.” “This is a good man,” said the king. “He comes with good news.”
ekegusii: Omorendi agateeba, “Nigo ’ndoche ng’a omominyoki oria bw’eritang’ani nigo anga buna Ahimasi, mosinto o Zadoki.” Erio omorwoti agateeba, “Ere nomonto omuya, nigo akorenta amang’ana amaya.”
swahili: Mlinzi akasema, “Ninaona kuwa yule wa kwanza anakimbia kama Ahimaasi mwana wa Sadoki.” Mfalme akasema, “Yeye ni mtu mwema. Analeta habari njema.”

english: Then Ahimaaz called out to the king, “All is well!” And he bowed facedown before the king. He continued, “Blessed be the LORD your God! He has delivered up the men who raised their hands against my lord the king.”
ekegusii: Ahimasi agaaka eriogi, agateebia omorwoti, “Nomorembe!” Naende agatung’ama inse, akaumama ase obosio bw’omorwoti, akabora, “Omonene, Nyasae oo, atogigwe, oyo obarusirieo abanto aba konya baimokirie amaboko abo igoro yao, aye omorwoti, omonene one.”
swahili: Ndipo Ahimaasi akamwita mfalme, akasema, “Mambo yote ni mema!” Akasujudu mbele ya mfalme uso wake mpaka ardhini, akasema, “Ahimidiwe Bwana Mungu wako! Yeye aliyewatoa watu wale walioinua mikono yao dhidi ya mfalme bwana wangu.”

english: The king asked, “Is the young man Absalom all right?” And Ahimaaz replied, “When Joab sent the king’s servant and your servant, I saw a great tumult, but I do not know what it was.”
ekegusii: Omorwoti akamobooria, “Inee! Omosae oria Abisalomu mbuya are?” Ahimasi akamoiraneria, “Ekero Yoabu antoma, inche, omosomba oo, nigo naigwa egetitiro ekenene, korende tinamanya engencho yaye.”
swahili: Mfalme akauliza, “Je, huyo kijana Absalomu yuko salama?” Ahimaasi akajibu, “Kulikuwa na machafuko mengi mara tu Yoabu alipokuwa anataka kumtuma mtumishi wa mfalme pamoja nami mtumishi wako, lakini sijui ilikuwa nini?”

english: But the people pleaded, “You must not go out! For if we have to flee, they will pay no attention to us. Even if half of us die, they will not care; but you are worth ten thousand of us. It is better for now if you support us from the city.”
ekegusii: Korende abanto bakamoiraneria, “Aye tobaisa kogeenda amo naintwe. Inaki gatoratame, barabwo tibagotoraara. Nonya abanto baito nabaisa goitwa ekeng’ese ki’omobaro, tibagotoraara. Aye nigo ore bw’engeencho enene ase tore kobua abanto baito chilifu ikomi. Ase ayio nigo erabe buya obeere ase omochie na gotokoonya korwa aroro.”
swahili: Lakini watu wakasema, “Haikupasi kwenda, ikiwa sisi tutalazimika kukimbia, wao hawatatujali. Hata kama nusu yetu tukifa hawatajali, lakini wewe una thamani ya watu kama sisi kumi elfu. Ingekuwa bora zaidi kwako basi kutupatia msaada kutoka mjini.”

english: “Move aside,” said the king, “and stand here.” So he stepped aside.
ekegusii: Omorwoti akamoteebia, “Tigera, otenene agwo ensemo,” na Ahimasi agatigera, agatenena ensemo.
swahili: Mfalme akasema, “Simama kando na usubiri hapa.” Basi akasogea kando na kusimama hapo.

english: Just then the Cushite came and said, “May my lord the king hear the good news: Today the LORD has avenged you of all who rose up against you!”
ekegusii: Omoetiopia nere agacha, agateebia omorwoti, “Nakorenteire amang’ana amaya, aye omonene one. Rero Omonene okoruseirie egesiomba ase baria bakoimokera gokorwania.”
swahili: Ndipo huyo Mkushi akawasili na kusema, “Mfalme bwana wangu, sikia habari njema! Leo Bwana amekuokoa kutoka kwa wale wote walioinuka dhidi yako.”

english: The king asked the Cushite, “Is the young man Absalom all right?” And the Cushite replied, “May what has become of the young man happen to the enemies of my lord the king and to all who rise up against you to harm you.”
ekegusii: Omorwoti akaboria Omoetiopia oria, “Inee! Omosae oria Abisalomu mbuya are?” Omoetiopia oria akamoiraneria, “Nigo nare kogania ng’a aya amonyora omosae oria, abanyore nababisa bao bonsi; boigo anyore nabaria bagokoimokera kogokorera bobe aye omorwoti Omonene one.”
swahili: Mfalme akamuuliza huyo Mkushi, “Je, kijana Absalomu yuko salama?” Huyo Mkushi akajibu, “Adui wa mfalme bwana wangu na wote wale walioinuka kukudhuru na wawe kama huyo kijana.”

english: The king was shaken and went up to the gate chamber and wept. And as he walked, he cried out, “O my son Absalom! My son, my son Absalom! If only I had died instead of you, O Absalom, my son, my son!”
ekegusii: Omorwoti agachaandeka mono, akariina gochia akanyomba karenge ase egeita igoro, akarera nobororo, akaba ogotaara‐taara na goteeba, “Abisalomu, omwana one! Obee! Omwana one! Abisalomu, ’ntare gokwa ribaga ria’o! Abisalomu, omwana one!”
swahili: Mfalme akatetemeka. Akapanda chumbani juu kupitia langoni akilia. Alipokuwa akienda, akasema, “Ee mwanangu Absalomu! Mwanangu, mwanangu Absalomu! Laiti ningekufa badala yako: Ee Absalomu, mwanangu, mwanangu!”

english: “I will do whatever seems best to you,” the king replied. So he stood beside the gate, while all the troops marched out by hundreds and by thousands.
ekegusii: Omorwoti akabairaneria, “Ayamwarora ng’a namaya n’aro ’ngokora.” Ase ayio omorwoti agatenena geita ensemo ekero abarwani baare gosooka gochia isiko ase ebiombe bi’amagana ne chilifu.
swahili: Mfalme akajibu, “Nitafanya lolote linaloonekana jema zaidi kwenu.” Kwa hiyo mfalme akasimama kando ya lango wakati watu wote wakitoka nje kwa makundi ya mamia na maelfu.

english: Now the king had commanded Joab, Abishai, and Ittai, “Treat the young man Absalom gently for my sake.” And all the people heard the king’s orders to each of the commanders regarding Absalom.
ekegusii: Omorwoti agachiika Yoabu, na Abisai, na Itai, akabateebia, “Ase engencho y’ane timokorera omosae oyio Abisalomu bobe.” Na abanto bonsi mbaigwete ekero omorwoti akoa abatang’ani abwo ogochika okwo igoro y’Abisalomu.
swahili: Mfalme akawaamuru Yoabu, Abishai na Itai, “Kuweni wapole kwa kijana Absalomu kwa ajili yangu.” Vikosi vyote vikasikia mfalme akitoa amri kwa kila jemadari kumhusu Absalomu.

english: So David’s army marched into the field to engage Israel in the battle, which took place in the forest of Ephraim.
ekegusii: Abarwani ba Daudi bakageenda orosana korwania Abaisraeli, na esegi ekarwanerwa ase rinani ria Efraimu.
swahili: Jeshi likatoka kwenda kwenye uwanja wa vita kupigana na Israeli, hivyo vita vikapiganwa katika msitu wa Efraimu.

english: There the people of Israel were defeated by David’s servants, and the slaughter was great that day—twenty thousand men.
ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakabugwa nabarwani ba Daudi. Ogoitwa okwo gokaba okonene, na ase rituko riria abanto chilifu emerongo ebere bagaitwa.
swahili: Huko jeshi la Israeli likashindwa na watu wa Daudi, siku hiyo majeruhi walikuwa wengi kiasi cha watu ishirini elfu.

english: The battle spread over the whole countryside, and that day the forest devoured more people than the sword.
ekegusii: Esegi nigo yesiarerete ase orosana rwonsi rw’aase aria, na ase rituko riria abanto abange bagakwera ase rinani ime kobua abwo baitetwe nemioro.
swahili: Vita vikaenea nchi nzima, watu wengi zaidi wakifia msituni siku hiyo kuliko waliouawa kwa upanga.

english: Now Absalom was riding on his mule when he met the servants of David, and as the mule went under the thick branches of a large oak, Absalom’s head was caught fast in the tree. The mule under him kept going, so that he was suspended in midair.
ekegusii: Abisalomu akaumerana nabasomba ba Daudi mobosokano. Nigo ariinete ebarasi yaye, n’ero egaeta inse y’omoaruni ore ne chinsagia chinetu, na omotwe bw’Abisalomu okaaga ase omote oria igoro, nere agatigara osung’unaneteo, na ebarasi yaye egaeta akaminyoka.
swahili: Basi ikawa Absalomu alikutana na watu wa Daudi. Yeye alikuwa amepanda nyumbu wake, naye nyumbu alipopita chini ya matawi yaliyosongana ya mwaloni mkubwa, kichwa cha Absalomu kilinaswa kwenye mti. Akaachwa akiningʼinia hewani, wakati nyumbu aliyekuwa amempanda aliendelea kwenda.

english: Then it was reported to Joab, “The king is weeping and mourning over Absalom.”
ekegusii: Yoabu agateebigwa ng’a omorwoti Daudi ’nkorera are na kweumia ase engencho y’Abisalomu.
swahili: Yoabu akaambiwa, “Mfalme analia na kumwombolezea Absalomu.”

english: But Absalom, the man we anointed over us, has died in battle. So why do you say nothing about restoring the king?”
ekegusii: Abisalomu, oyo twaaka amaguta akaba omorwoti oito, okuure ase esegi. Na bono, inaki motari goteeba ng’a moiranie Daudi abe omorwoti naende?”
swahili: naye Absalomu, tuliyemtia mafuta atutawale, amekufa vitani. Basi mbona hamsemi lolote kuhusu kumrudisha mfalme?”

english: Then King David sent this message to Zadok and Abiathar, the priests: “Say to the elders of Judah, ‘Why should you be the last to restore the king to his palace, since the talk of all Israel has reached the king at his quarters?
ekegusii: Daudi omorwoti agatoma abanto gochia ase Zadoki na Abiatari, abakuani, agateeba, “Kwana n’abagaaka b’Abayuda, mobamboorerie: Inaki rende mokoba abanto b’omoerio ase okong’irania inche omorwoti inka bwone, bono ekero amang’ana onsi aya Abaisraeli bakwanete aikerete nyomba mw’ane?
swahili: Mfalme Daudi akapeleka ujumbe huu kwa makuhani Sadoki na Abiathari, kusema: “Waulizeni wazee wa Yuda, ‘Kwa nini mwe wa mwisho kumrudisha mfalme katika jumba lake la kifalme, maadamu kile kinachosemwa katika Israeli yote kimemfikia mfalme katika makao yake?

english: You are my brothers, my own flesh and blood. So why should you be the last to restore the king?’
ekegusii: Inwe n’abanto baminto b’amanyinga ane ne chinyama chiane. Inaki rende morigetie koba ab’omoerio ase okong’irania inche omorwoti inka?
swahili: Ninyi ni ndugu zangu, nyama yangu na damu yangu mwenyewe. Kwa hiyo kwa nini mwe wa mwisho kumrudisha mfalme?’

english: And say to Amasa, ‘Aren’t you my flesh and blood? May God punish me, and ever so severely, if from this time you are not the commander of my army in place of Joab!’”
ekegusii: Naende moteebie Amasa: Inee! Aye tori amanyinga ane ne chinyama chiane? Nyasae ang’e egesusuro bono na kogenderera onye aye tokoba omotang’ani bw’abarwani b’esegi botambe ribaga ria Yoabu.”
swahili: Nanyi mwambieni Amasa, ‘Je, wewe si nyama yangu mwenyewe na damu yangu? Mungu na anishughulikie, tena kwa ukali, kama kuanzia sasa na kuendelea wewe si jemadari wa jeshi langu mahali pa Yoabu.’ ”

english: So he swayed the hearts of all the men of Judah as though they were one man, and they sent word to the king: “Return, you and all your servants.”
ekegusii: Abayuda bonsi bagancha amang’ana a Daudi mono, bakamotomera amang’ana ng’a airane amo nabasomba baye bonsi.
swahili: Aliipata mioyo ya watu wote wa Yuda kama vile walikuwa mtu mmoja. Wakapeleka ujumbe kwa mfalme, kusema, “Rudi, wewe na watu wako wote.”

english: So the king returned, and when he arrived at the Jordan, the men of Judah came to Gilgal to meet him and escort him across the Jordan. Shimei Pardoned
ekegusii: Ekero omorwoti are koirana gaikire Yorodani, akanyora Abayuda baachire Giligali komoorotota na komwambokia Yorodani.
swahili: Ndipo mfalme akarudi, akaenda hadi kufikia Mto Yordani. Basi watu wa Yuda walikuwa wamekuja mpaka Gilgali ili kutoka kwenda kumlaki mfalme na kumvusha Mto Yordani.

english: Then Shimei son of Gera, a Benjamite from Bahurim, hurried down with the men of Judah to meet King David,
ekegusii: Na Simei, mosinto o Gera, Omobenjamini korwa Bahurimu, akaayerera amo n’Abayuda gochia korotota omorwoti Daudi.
swahili: Shimei mwana wa Gera, wa kabila la Benyamini kutoka Bahurimu, akaharakisha kuteremka pamoja na watu wa Yuda ili kumlaki Mfalme Daudi.

english: along with a thousand men of Benjamin, as well as Ziba the steward of the house of Saul and his fifteen sons and twenty servants. They rushed down to the Jordan before the king
ekegusii: Simei nigo arenge amo n’abanto elifu eyemo b’egesaku gia Benjamini. Na Siba, omosomba o Saulo, na abamura baye ikomi na batano, na abasomba baye emerongo ebere, bakaayerera gochia ase Yorodani, bagaikao omorwoti ataraika.
swahili: Pamoja naye walikuwepo Wabenyamini elfu moja wakiwa wamefuatana na Siba, msimamizi wa nyumba ya Sauli, pia wanawe kumi na watano, na watumishi ishirini. Wakaharakisha kwenda Yordani, mahali mfalme alipokuwa.

english: and crossed at the ford to carry over the king’s household and to do what was good in his sight. When Shimei son of Gera crossed the Jordan, he fell down before the king
ekegusii: Barabwo bakaamboka orooche gochia kwambokia abanto b’enka y’omorwoti na gokora ande onsi omorwoti aganetie. Daudi ogokorera Simei amaya Ekero omorwoti abeire ang’e kwamboka Yorodani, Simei, mosinto o Gera, agatung’ama inse ase obosio bwaye,
swahili: Wakavuka kivuko ili kuwachukua watu wa nyumbani mwa mfalme ili kuwavusha na kufanya kila kitu alichotaka. Shimei mwana wa Gera alipovuka Yordani, akaanguka kifudifudi mbele ya mfalme,

english: and said, “My lord, do not hold me guilty, and do not remember your servant’s wrongdoing on the day my lord the king left Jerusalem. May the king not take it to heart.
ekegusii: akamoteebia, “Omonene one, tombarera obobe, gose toinyora aria nagokorerete ase rituko riria kwaruete Yerusalemu.
swahili: na kumwambia, “Bwana wangu na asinihesabie hatia. Usikumbuke jinsi mtumishi wako alivyofanya kosa siku ile bwana wangu mfalme alipoondoka Yerusalemu. Mfalme aliondoe moyoni mwake.

english: And that day’s victory was turned into mourning for all the people, because on that day they were told, “The king is grieving over his son.”
ekegusii: Ase igo omogooko bw’obobui okaonchoka okaba omoichano ase abanto bonsi ba Daudi, ekiagera ase rituko riria abanto nigo baigwete ng’a Daudi ’nkona‐korera are ase engencho y’omwana oye.
swahili: Kwa jeshi lote, ushindi wa siku ile ukageuka kuwa maombolezo, kwa sababu siku ile vikosi vilisikia ikisemwa, “Mfalme anahuzunika kwa ajili ya mwanawe.”

english: For your servant knows that I have sinned, so here I am today as the first of all the house of Joseph to come down to meet my lord the king.”
ekegusii: Inche, omosomba oo, namanyire ng’a ’nakorete ebibe ekero keria, ayio naro agera n’aba oyo bw’eritang’ani korwa ase enyomba ya Yusufu goocha gokorotota aye omorwoti Omonene one aiga reero.”
swahili: Kwa maana mimi mtumishi wako najua nimefanya dhambi, lakini leo nimekuja hapa kama wa kwanza wa nyumba yote ya Yosefu kushuka na kumlaki bwana wangu mfalme.”

english: But Abishai son of Zeruiah said, “Shouldn’t Shimei be put to death for this, because he cursed the LORD’s anointed?”
ekegusii: Abisai, omomura bw’omokuungu Seruya, akabora, “Inee! Simei tagoitwa akwe, ekiagera amoragereretie omoakwa amaguta bw’Omonene?”
swahili: Ndipo Abishai mwana wa Seruya akasema, “Je, Shimei hapaswi kuuawa kwa ajili ya hili? Alimlaani mpakwa mafuta wa Bwana.”

english: And David replied, “Sons of Zeruiah, what have I to do with you, that you should be my adversaries today? Should any man be put to death in Israel today? Am I not indeed aware that today I am king over Israel?”
ekegusii: Korende Daudi akamoteebia, “Ninki inde nainwe, abana b’omokuungu Seruya? Nigo moganetie koba mamincha y’ane. Bono ninche inde omorwoti bw’Abaisraeli, na onde tari ase Abaisraeli oraitwe reero.”
swahili: Daudi akajibu, “Mimi nina nini nanyi, enyi wana wa Seruya? Leo hii mmekuwa adui zangu! Je, leo kuna yeyote atakayeuawa katika Israeli? Je, mimi sijui kuwa leo ndimi mfalme katika Israeli yote?”

english: So the king said to Shimei, “You shall not die.” And the king swore an oath to him. Mephibosheth Excused
ekegusii: Na omorwoti agateebia Simei, “Togoitwa.” Naende agatiana ase ayio. Daudi ogokorera Mefiboseti amaya
swahili: Basi mfalme akamwambia Shimei, “Hutakufa.” Naye mfalme akamwahidi kwa kiapo.

english: Then Mephibosheth, Saul’s grandson, went down to meet the king. He had not cared for his feet or trimmed his mustache or washed his clothes from the day the king had left until the day he returned safely.
ekegusii: Erio Mefiboseti, omoochokoro o Saulo, agatirimboka gochia korotota omorwoti. Korwa ekero keria omorwoti aruete Yerusalemu, Mefiboseti konya tana gwesibia amagoro aye, gose konacha chinderu, gose gosibia chianga chiaye, goika rituko riria omorwoti airanete nomorembe.
swahili: Pia Mefiboshethi mwana wa Sauli akashuka kwenda kumlaki mfalme. Hakuwa amenawa miguu wala kunyoa ndevu zake wala kufua nguo zake tangu siku mfalme alipoondoka Yerusalemu mpaka siku aliporudi ile salama.

english: And he came from Jerusalem to meet the king, who asked him, “Mephibosheth, why did you not go with me?”
ekegusii: Ekero Mefiboseti achete korwa Yerusalemu gochia korotota omorwoti, omorwoti akamobooria, “Mefiboseti, inaki otageendete amo nainche?”
swahili: Wakati alipotoka Yerusalemu kuja kumlaki mfalme, mfalme akamuuliza, “Mefiboshethi, kwa nini hukufuatana nami?”

english: “My lord the king,” he replied, “because I am lame, I said, ‘I will have my donkey saddled so that I may ride on it and go with the king.’ But my servant Ziba deceived me,
ekegusii: Mefiboseti akamoiraneria, “Omonene one, nomanyete ng’a nekerema inde. Nigo natebeetie omosomba one, ng’a abeekere etigere y’ane egeikaransero, nainche ’ndiine ’ngende nomorwoti, korende ere akang’aina.
swahili: Akasema, “Bwana wangu mfalme, maadamu mimi mtumishi wako ni kiwete, nilisema, ‘Nitandikiwe punda wangu, nimpande, ili niweze kwenda pamoja na mfalme.’ Lakini Siba mtumishi wangu akanisaliti.

english: and he has slandered your servant to my lord the king. Yet my lord the king is like the angel of God, so do what is good in your eyes.
ekegusii: Boigo aganteebera oborimo ase ore aye omonene one, korende aye nigo onga buna omomalaika o Nyasae: gaki kora aya orooche arabe amaya.
swahili: Naye amemchongea mtumishi wako kwa bwana wangu mfalme. Bwana wangu mfalme ni kama malaika wa Mungu, kwa hiyo fanya lolote linalokupendeza.

english: For all the house of my grandfather deserves death from my lord the king, yet you have set your servant among those who eat at your table. What further right, then, do I have to keep appealing to the king?”
