ekegusii: Abaamate ba tata bonsi pi nigo barenge ase ore buna abagwenerete gokwa, korende okambeeka inche, omosomba oo, ase egati y’abwo bakoragera mwao. Bono aye omorwoti Omonene one, ’mboronge ki kobua ayio ’ngokoboria na korera ase ore?”
swahili: Wazao wote wa baba yangu hawastahili kitu kingine isipokuwa kifo kutoka kwa bwana wangu mfalme, lakini ulimpa mtumishi wako nafasi miongoni mwa wale waliokula mezani pako. Je, ninayo haki gani kumwomba mfalme zaidi ya hayo?”

english: The king replied, “Why say any more? I hereby declare that you and Ziba are to divide the land.”
ekegusii: Omorwoti akamoiraneria, “Inaki okona‐komenta gokwana amang’ana ayio ao? Inche natebiire ng’a aye na Siba mwatanane amaremo a Saulo.”
swahili: Mfalme akamwambia, “Kwa nini useme zaidi? Naamuru wewe na Siba mgawanye mashamba.”

english: So they returned to the city quietly that day, as people steal away in humiliation after fleeing a battle.
ekegusii: Ase rituko riria abanto bakaba bagochoba gosoa ase omochie ime buna abanto bagotama korwa ase esegi bare nobosooku ase engencho y’ayio.
swahili: Siku ile watu wakaingia mjini kimya kama vile waingiavyo kwa aibu watu waliokimbia kutoka vitani.

english: And Mephibosheth said to the king, “Instead, since my lord the king has safely come to his own house, let Ziba take it all!” David’s Kindness to Barzillai
ekegusii: Mefiboseti akamoiraneria, “Omorwoti, tiga Siba ayaire onsi, inche naisanekire ng’a aye, omonene one, kwairanire inka buya.” Daudi ogokorera Barisilai amaya
swahili: Mefiboshethi akamwambia mfalme, “Mruhusu achukue kila kitu, kwa kuwa sasa bwana wangu mfalme amerudi nyumbani salama.”

english: Now Barzillai the Gileadite had come down from Rogelim to cross the Jordan with the king and send him on his way from there.
ekegusii: Bono Barisilai Omogileadi nere konya ochire korwa Rogelimu gokooba omorwoti gochia Yorodani amboke amo nere.
swahili: Barzilai, Mgileadi, pia akashuka kutoka Rogelimu ili kuvuka Yordani pamoja na mfalme na kumsindikiza kutoka huko.

english: Barzillai was quite old, eighty years of age, and since he was a very wealthy man, he had provided for the king while he stayed in Mahanaim.
ekegusii: Barisilai nigo arenge omogotu mono, konya okoorire emiaka emerongo etano na etato. Ere nigo arenge omonda mono, akaba okorageria omorwoti ekero ere arenge agwo Mahanaimu.
swahili: Basi Barzilai alikuwa mzee sana mwenye umri wa miaka themanini. Alikuwa amempatia mfalme mahitaji wakati alipokuwa anaishi huko Mahanaimu, kwa kuwa alikuwa mtu tajiri sana.

english: The king said to Barzillai, “Cross over with me, and I will provide for you at my side in Jerusalem.”
ekegusii: Omorwoti agateebia Barisilai, “Inchuo ogende amo nainche, nimbe ’ngokorangeria aaria Yerusalemu.”
swahili: Mfalme akamwambia Barzilai, “Vuka pamoja nami na ukae nami huko Yerusalemu, nami nitakupatia mahitaji yako.”

english: But Barzillai replied, “How many years of my life remain, that I should go up to Jerusalem with the king?
ekegusii: Korende Barisilai akamoiraneria, “Emiaka y’ane nerenga etigarete ngochia koba moyo, ing’a ngende amo naye Yerusalemu komenyao?
swahili: Lakini Barzilai akamjibu mfalme, “Je, nitaishi miaka mingine mingapi, hata nipande kwenda Yerusalemu pamoja na mfalme?

english: I am now eighty years old. Can I discern what is good and what is not? Can your servant taste what he eats or drinks? Can I still hear the voice of singing men and women? Why should your servant be an added burden to my lord the king?
ekegusii: Nakoorire emiaka emerongo etan’etato, Inee, ninyare gwatanana ayare ay’okogokia na ayatari ay’okogokia? Ninyare koigwa obwansu bw’eki nkoria na eki nkonywa? Ninyare koigwa na kogookera eriogi ri’abateeri, abasacha gose abakungu? Nase ki inche, omosomba oo, ngochia gokoera obokong’u aye, omorwoti, omonene one?
swahili: Sasa nina miaka themanini. Je, naweza kutofautisha kati ya lililo jema na lililo baya? Je, mtumishi wako anaweza kujua ladha ya kile anachokula au anachokunywa? Je, bado naweza kusikiliza sauti za waimbaji wa kiume na za wanawake? Kwa nini mtumishi wako aongeze mzigo kwa bwana wangu mfalme?

english: Your servant could go with the king only a short distance past the Jordan; why should the king repay me with such a reward?
ekegusii: Ninki rende aye omorwoti ogochia kondwuera eng’eria buna eyio. Tiga inche, omosomba oo, ’nyamboke Yorodani oka.
swahili: Mtumishi wako atavuka Yordani pamoja na mfalme kwa umbali mfupi tu, lakini kwa nini mfalme anizawadie kwa namna hii?

english: Please let your servant return, that I may die in my own city near the tomb of my father and mother. But here is your servant Chimham. Let him cross over with my lord the king, and do for him what is good in your sight.”
ekegusii: Nagosabire ontige inche, omosomba oo, ing’irane, erinde ’nkwere ase omochie one, ang’e nembeera ya tata na baba. Korende omosomba oo Kimuhamu, nao are aa, tiga amboke amo naye, Omonene one, na omokorere aya orarore are amaya.”
swahili: Mruhusu mtumishi wako arudi, ili mimi nikafie katika mji wangu mwenyewe karibu na kaburi la baba yangu na mama yangu. Lakini yupo hapa mtumishi wako Kimhamu. Mruhusu avuke pamoja na bwana wangu mfalme. Mtendee lolote linalokupendeza.”

english: The king replied, “Chimham will cross over with me, and I will do for him what seems good in your sight, and I will do for you whatever you desire of me.”
ekegusii: Omorwoti akamoiraneria, “Kimuhamu nageende amo nainche, nimokorere kende gionsi aye oraganie. Na ande onsi oramborie ningokorere aye.”
swahili: Mfalme akamwambia Barzilai, “Kimhamu atavuka Yordani pamoja nami, nami nitamtendea lolote litakalokupendeza. Nawe kitu chochote unachotaka kutoka kwangu nitakutendea.”

english: So all the people crossed the Jordan, and then the king crossed over. The king kissed Barzillai and blessed him, and Barzillai returned home.
ekegusii: Erio abanto bonsi bakaamboka Yorodani, omorwoti nere akaamboka; erio omorwoti akanyunyunta Barisilai na komosesenia, ere akairana gochia inka bwoye. Abayuda na Abaisraeli Bakoamererania Igoro Y’omorwoti
swahili: Kwa hiyo watu wote wakavuka Yordani, kisha mfalme akavuka. Mfalme akambusu Barzilai na kumbariki; Barzilai akarudi nyumbani kwake.

english: But the king covered his face and cried out at the top of his voice, “O my son Absalom! O Absalom, my son, my son!”
ekegusii: Omorwoti agetuba obosio bwaye, akarera ase eriogi rinene, “Obee! Abisalomu, omwana one! Obee! Abisalomu, omwana one, omwana one!”
swahili: Mfalme akafunika uso wake akalia kwa sauti, akisema, “Ee mwanangu Absalomu! Ee Absalomu, mwanangu, mwanangu!”

english: Then the king went on to Gilgal, and Chimham crossed over with him. All the troops of Judah and half the troops of Israel escorted the king. Contention over the King
ekegusii: Omorwoti akageenda agaika Giligali na Kimuhamu akageenda amo nere. Abayuda bonsi, na abanto ekeng’ese ki’Abaisraeli nabarabwo bakageenda amo nere.
swahili: Mfalme alipovuka kwenda Gilgali, Kimhamu akavuka pamoja naye. Vikosi vyote vya Yuda na nusu ya vikosi vya Israeli vilimvusha mfalme.

english: Soon all the men of Israel came to the king and asked, “Why did our brothers, the men of Judah, take you away secretly and bring the king and his household across the Jordan, together with all of David’s men?”
ekegusii: Erio Abaisraeli bonsi bagachiera omorwoti, bakamobooria, “Nase ki Abayuda baminto bakoibete aye na eamate yao, na abanto bao bonsi, na kobaambokia Yorodani?”
swahili: Baada ya kitambo kidogo watu wote wa Israeli wakaja kwa mfalme na kumwambia, “Kwa nini ndugu zetu, watu wa Yuda, wamemrudisha mfalme kwa siri bila kutushirikisha, na kumvusha ngʼambo ya Yordani, yeye na nyumba yake, pamoja na watu wake wote?”

english: And all the men of Judah replied to the men of Israel, “We did this because the king is our relative. Why does this anger you? Have we ever eaten at the king’s expense or received anything for ourselves?”
ekegusii: Abayuda bonsi bakairaneria Abaisraeli, “Nigo twakorete igo, ekiagera omorwoti nigo are bw’eamate yaito. Nase ki rende mokobeea ase amang’ana ayio? Inee! Twarire gento kende ki’omorwoti? Gose otoeire keegwa kende?”
swahili: Watu wote wa Yuda wakawajibu watu wa Israeli, “Tulifanya hivi kwa sababu mfalme ni jamaa yetu wa karibu. Kwa nini mnakasirikia jambo hili? Je, tumekula kitu chochote cha mfalme? Je, tumejichukulia kitu chochote kwa ajili yetu wenyewe?”

english: “We have ten shares in the king,” answered the men of Israel, “so we have more claim to David than you. Why then do you despise us? Were we not the first to speak of restoring our king?” But the men of Judah pressed even harder than the men of Israel.
ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakairaneria Abayuda, bakaboora, “Omorwoti noyoito ara ikomi kobua buna are oyoino. Ase ayio, oyio Daudi noyoito bori. Nase ki mogotochaaya? Inee! Titwarenge ab’eritang’ani gokwana igoro y’okoirania omorwoti oito.” Korende amang’ana y’Abayuda nigo arenge amakong’u kobua ay’Abaisraeli.
swahili: Ndipo watu wa Israeli wakawajibu watu wa Yuda, “Tunayo haki mara kumi kwa mfalme; sisi tunahusika zaidi na Daudi kuliko ninyi. Kwa nini basi mnatudharau? Je, hatukuwa wa kwanza kuzungumza kuhusu kumrudisha mfalme nyumbani?” Lakini watu wa Yuda wakajibu kwa ukali hata zaidi kuliko watu wa Israeli.

english: Then Joab went into the house and said to the king, “Today you have disgraced all your servants who have saved your life and the lives of your sons and daughters, of your wives, and of your concubines.
ekegusii: Erio Yoabu agacha nyomba ase omorwoti, akamoteebia, “Reero aye gwakorire abasomba bao bonsi barorire obosooku, abanto aba konya batooririe obogima bwao, na obw’abana bao, abamura na abaiseke, na obw’abakuungu bao, na abakungu bao ba sere‐sere.
swahili: Kisha Yoabu akaingia ndani ya nyumba ya mfalme na kusema, “Leo umewaaibisha watu wako wote, waliookoa maisha yako, maisha ya wanao na binti zako, maisha ya wake zako na masuria wako.

english: You love those who hate you and hate those who love you! For you have made it clear today that the commanders and soldiers mean nothing to you. I know today that if Absalom were alive and all of us were dead, it would have pleased you!
ekegusii: Nigo bwanchete abwo bakogeechete na kogeecha abwo bagwanchete. Inaki reero kworokirie maiso marore ng’a abatang’ani na abasomba bao barabwo ’mbosa bare ase ore. Reero nario namanya ng’a onye Abisalomu moyo areenge, na intwe twensi tobe twakuure, erio nanga nigo kwaigwa buya.
swahili: Unawapenda wale wanaokuchukia, na unawachukia wale wanaokupenda. Leo umeonyesha wazi kwamba majemadari wako na watu wao hawana maana kwako. Naona kwamba ungefurahi kama Absalomu angekuwa hai leo na sisi sote tuwe tumekufa.

english: Now therefore get up! Go out and speak comfort to your servants, for I swear by the LORD that if you do not go out, not a man will remain with you tonight. This will be worse for you than all the adversity that has befallen you from your youth until now!” David Restored as King
ekegusii: Gaki bono koranche, oimoke osoke isiko, okwane nabasomba bao, oremie chinkoro chiabo. Ase igo natianire ase Omonene ng’a otasoogeti, monto onde tagotigara or’abe amo naye goika mambia, na amang’ana ayio nigo arabe amabe kobua ayakonyorete korwa ekero kwarenge omosae goika reero iga.”
swahili: Sasa utoke nje ukawatie moyo watu wako. Naapa kwa Bwana kwamba ikiwa hutatoka nje, hakuna mtu atakayesalia pamoja nawe ifikapo leo jioni. Hii itakuwa mbaya zaidi kwako kuliko maafa yote yaliyokupata tangu ujana wako hadi sasa.”

english: So the king got up and sat in the gate, and all the people were told: “Behold, the king is sitting in the gate.” So they all came before the king. Meanwhile, the Israelites had fled, each man to his home.
ekegusii: Erio omorwoti agasooka, agaikaransa ase egeita ki’omochie. Abanto bonsi bagateebigwa ng’a omorwoti nao are ase egeita; na igo bakageenda ase are. Daudi okoirana Yerusalemu Abaisraeli bonsi konya batamire, kera omonto gochia inka bwoye.
swahili: Kwa hiyo mfalme akaondoka akaketi kitini pake penye lango. Watu walipoambiwa, “Mfalme ameketi langoni,” watu wote wakamjia. Daudi Arudi Yerusalemu Wakati huo, Waisraeli walikuwa wamekimbilia nyumbani kwao.

english: And all the people throughout the tribes of Israel were arguing, “The king rescued us from the hand of our enemies and delivered us from the hand of the Philistines, but now he has fled the land because of Absalom.
ekegusii: Bakaba bakoamererania barabwo ase barabwo, bakaboora, “Omorwoti nigo atotooretie korwa ase amaboko y’ababisa baito, na korwa ase amaboko y’Abafilisti, na bono otamire Abisalomu, otigire ense eye.
swahili: Katika makabila yote ya Israeli, watu walikuwa wanabishana wao kwa wao, wakisema, “Mfalme alituokoa kutoka mikononi mwa adui zetu; ndiye alituokoa kutoka mikononi mwa Wafilisti. Lakini sasa mfalme ameikimbia nchi kwa sababu ya Absalomu,

english: After the death of Saul, David returned from the slaughter of the Amalekites and stayed in Ziklag two days.
ekegusii: Magega Saulo gakuure, Daudi akairana korwa ase ogoita Abaameleki, akabeera agwo Sikilagi ase engaki y’amatuko abere.
swahili: Baada ya kifo cha Sauli, Daudi alipokuwa amerudi kutoka kuwashinda Waamaleki, Daudi alikaa siku mbili huko Siklagi.

english: So I stood over him and killed him, because I knew that after he had fallen he could not survive. And I took the crown that was on his head and the band that was on his arm, and I have brought them here to my lord.”
ekegusii: Ase ayio ’nkamoika ang’e, ’nkamoita, ekiagera nigo namanyete ng’a tare koba moyo magega kaguure. Nkamorusia eguutwa y’obogaambi yare motwe oye na egetange kiarenge koboko kwaye, narentire ebinto ebio aa ase ore, aye omonene one.”
swahili: “Kwa hiyo nikamkaribia nikamuua, kwa sababu nilijua kwamba baada ya kuanguka hangeweza kupona. Nami nikachukua lile taji lililokuwa kichwani mwake na utepe uliokuwa mkononi mwake nami nimevileta hapa kwa bwana wangu.”

english: Then David took hold of his own clothes and tore them, and all the men who were with him did the same.
ekegusii: Erio Daudi akabwata chianga chiaye, agachitandora, na abanto bonsi abarenge amo nere bagakora bo.
swahili: Ndipo Daudi pamoja na watu wote waliokuwa pamoja naye wakazishika nguo zao na kuzirarua.

english: They mourned and wept and fasted until evening for Saul and his son Jonathan, and for the people of the LORD and the house of Israel, because they had fallen by the sword.
ekegusii: Bakarera na kweumia, na kweng’ata goika mogoroba ase engencho ya Saulo na Yonathani, omwana oye, na ase engencho y’abanto ba Omonene na ey’Abaisraeli, ekiagera barabwo konya baitirwe nemioro.
swahili: Wakaomboleza, wakalia pia na kufunga mpaka jioni kwa ajili ya Sauli na Yonathani mwanawe, kwa ajili ya jeshi la Bwana na nyumba ya Israeli, kwa sababu wameanguka kwa upanga.

english: And David inquired of the young man who had brought him the report, “Where are you from?” “I am the son of a foreigner,” he answered. “I am an Amalekite.”
ekegusii: Daudi akaboria omomura oria omoteebia amang’ana ayio, “Aye noyo o arari ore?” Ere akamoiraneria, “Inche nigo inde omwana bw’Omoameleki ore omomenyi aa.”
swahili: Daudi akamwambia yule kijana aliyemletea taarifa, “Wewe ni mwenyeji wa wapi?” Akamjibu, “Mimi ni mwana wa mgeni, Mwamaleki.”

english: So David asked him, “Why were you not afraid to lift your hand to destroy the LORD’s anointed?”
ekegusii: Daudi akamobooria, “Inaki yabete otairogete korambora okoboko kwao ase ogoita omoakwa amaguta bw’Omonene”?
swahili: Daudi akamuuliza, “Kwa nini hukuogopa kuinua mkono wako ili kumwangamiza mpakwa mafuta wa Bwana?”

english: Then David summoned one of the young men and said, “Go, execute him!” So the young man struck him down, and he died.
ekegusii: Erio Daudi akarangeria omomura oyomo, akamoteebia, “Inchuo omoite!” Omomura oria agaaka Omoameleki oria, akamoita,
swahili: Kisha Daudi akamwita mmoja wa watu wake na kumwambia, “Nenda ukamuue!” Kwa hiyo akampiga, naye akafa.

english: For David had said to the Amalekite, “Your blood be on your own head because your own mouth has testified against you, saying, ‘I killed the LORD’s anointed.’” David’s Song for Saul and Jonathan
ekegusii: ekiagera Daudi konya oteebirie Omoameleki oria, “Okomocha kw’ogoiterwa kw’amanyinga ao, tiga kobarwe igoro yao, ekiagera kwebereire kirori aye omonyene, ekero gwateba ng’a gwaitire omoakwa amaguta bw’Omonene.” Daudi Okoreera Saulo Na Yonathani
swahili: Kwa maana Daudi alikuwa amemwambia, “Damu yako iwe juu ya kichwa chako mwenyewe. Kinywa chako mwenyewe kimeshuhudia dhidi yako uliposema, ‘Nilimuua mpakwa mafuta wa Bwana.’ ” Ombolezo La Daudi Kwa Ajili Ya Sauli Na Yonathani

english: Then David took up this lament for Saul and his son Jonathan,
ekegusii: Daudi akareera Saulo na Yonathani, momura o Saulo, n’ogoteera oko gw’okweumia.
swahili: Daudi akafanya maombolezo haya kuhusu Sauli na Yonathani mwanawe,

english: and he ordered that the sons of Judah be taught the Song of the Bow. It is written in the Book of Jashar:
ekegusii: Agachiika ng’a abanto b’egesaku kia Yuda borokererigwe ogoteera okwo kw’obota koriikire ase Egetabu kia Yashari.
swahili: naye akaagiza kwamba watu wa Yuda wafundishwe ombolezo hili la upinde (ambalo limeandikwa katika Kitabu cha Yashari):

english: “Your glory, O Israel, lies slain on your heights. How the mighty have fallen!
ekegusii: “Inwe Abaisraeli, obonene bwaino bwasireire igoro ase ebigoro biaino! Chituoni chi’eseegi chiaitirwe.
swahili: “Walio fahari yako, ee Israeli, wameuawa juu ya mahali pako palipoinuka. Jinsi wenye nguvu walivyoanguka!

english: On the third day a man with torn clothes and dust on his head arrived from Saul’s camp. When he came to David, he fell to the ground to pay him homage.
ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatato, omonto agacha korwa ase egetwori gia Saulo; chianga chiaye nigo chiatandoire, na amaroba are ase omotwe oye. Ekero aigete ase Daudi, akagua inse maumama ase okoorokia amasikani.
swahili: Siku ya tatu akaja mtu mwenye nguo zilizoraruka na mavumbi kichwani mwake kutoka kwenye kambi ya Sauli. Alipomjia Daudi, akajitupa chini ili kumpa heshima.

english: Tell it not in Gath; proclaim it not in the streets of Ashkelon, lest the daughters of the Philistines rejoice, and the daughters of the uncircumcised exult.
ekegusii: Timoteeba amang’ana aya ase Gati, timoyararia ase chinchera chi’Askeloni. Timotiga abaiseke b’Abafilisti bachenge; timotiga abaiseke b’ abanto baria batarogeti bagoke!
swahili: “Msilisimulie hili katika Gathi, msilitangaze hili katika barabara za Ashkeloni, binti za Wafilisti wasije wakafurahia, binti za hao wasiotahiriwa wasije wakashangilia.

english: O mountains of Gilboa, may you have no dew or rain, no fields yielding offerings of grain. For there the shield of the mighty was defiled, the shield of Saul, no longer anointed with oil.
ekegusii: “Inwe ebigoro bia Giliboa, ogotoora kwe riime tikoba igoro ase more, gose embura tetwa, gose emegondo teeba ekwama endagera ekoruegwa ase Omonene, ekiagera aroro agwo nao chinguba chie chituoni chiasareretigwe, na enguba ya Saulo etaagetwe amaguta naende.
swahili: “Enyi milima ya Gilboa, msipate umande wala mvua, wala mashamba yazaayo sadaka ya nafaka. Kwa maana huko ndiko ngao ya mwenye nguvu iliponajisiwa, ngao ya Sauli haitapakwa tena mafuta.

english: From the blood of the slain, from the fat of the mighty, the bow of Jonathan did not retreat, and the sword of Saul did not return empty.
ekegusii: Obota bwa Yonathani nigo bwaitete abanto abange, nigo bwaiterete amanyinga, bogaita abanto chituoni abarenge abanoru; naboigo omoro o Saulo torenge koirana bosa.
swahili: Kutokana na damu ya waliouawa, kutokana na miili ya wenye nguvu, ule upinde wa Yonathani haukugeuka nyuma. Upanga wa Sauli haukurudi bure.

english: Saul and Jonathan, beloved and delightful in life, were not divided in death. They were swifter than eagles, they were stronger than lions.
ekegusii: Saulo na Yonathani barenge abanchwa baito, barenge gotogokia. Ase obogima na ase amakweri tibaatananetwe. Barabwo nigo barenge abaango kobua ebiongo, nigo barenge ne chinguru kobua chindo.
swahili: “Sauli na Yonathani, maishani walipendwa na kuneemeka, na katika kifo hawakutengana. Walikuwa wepesi kuliko tai, walikuwa na nguvu kuliko simba.

english: O daughters of Israel, weep for Saul, who clothed you in scarlet and luxury, who decked your garments with ornaments of gold.
ekegusii: “Inwe abakungu b’Abaisraeli, reera Saulo, nere obaboyetie chianga chie rigori rinene, chianga chimbariri chi’okwegokeria, agachichabera ebinto bi’etaabu.
swahili: “Enyi binti za Israeli, lieni kwa ajili ya Sauli, ambaye aliwavika nguo nyekundu na maridadi, ambaye aliremba mavazi yenu kwa mapambo ya dhahabu.

english: How the mighty have fallen in the thick of battle! Jonathan lies slain on your heights.
ekegusii: “Chituoni chiaitirwe ase esegi! Yonathani nao araire ase ebigoro igoro, oitire.
swahili: “Tazama jinsi mashujaa walivyoanguka vitani! Yonathani ameuawa mahali pako palipoinuka.

english: I grieve for you, Jonathan, my brother. You were delightful to me; your love to me was extraordinary, surpassing the love of women.
ekegusii: “Aye Yonathani ominto, nigo inde nomoichano omonene ase engencho yao, aye nigo konya ongogetie mono. Ase inde obwanchani bwao nigo bwarenge obonene kobua obwanchani bw’abakuungu.
swahili: Nahuzunika kwa ajili yako, Yonathani ndugu yangu, kwangu ulikuwa mpendwa sana. Upendo wako kwangu ulikuwa wa ajabu, wa ajabu zaidi kuliko ule wa wanawake.

english: How the mighty have fallen and the weapons of war have perished!”
ekegusii: Chituoni chiaitirwe, na ebirwanero bi’eseegi biasiriigwe.”
swahili: “Tazama jinsi mashujaa walivyoanguka! Silaha za vita zimeangamia!”

english: “Where have you come from?” David asked. “I have escaped from the Israelite camp,” he replied.
ekegusii: Daudi akamobooria, “Ng’ai okorwa”? Ere akamoiraneria, “Nigo natoorekire korwa ase egetwori ki’Abaisraeli.”
swahili: Daudi akamuuliza, “Wewe umetoka wapi?” Akamjibu, “Nimetoroka kutoka kambi ya Waisraeli.”

english: “What was the outcome?” David asked. “Please tell me.” “The troops fled from the battle,” he replied. “Many of them fell and died. And Saul and his son Jonathan are also dead.”
ekegusii: Naende Daudi akamobooria, “Amoteebie buna amang’ana agendererete aria.” Omonto oria akamoiraneria, “Abanto abange batamire korwa ase esegi eria, na abande abange mono baitirwe bakuure. Boigo Saulo amo na Yonathani, momura oye, baitirwe bakuure.”
swahili: Daudi akamuuliza, “Ni nini kilichotokea? Niambie.” Akasema, “Watu walikimbia kutoka vitani. Wengi wao walianguka na kufa. Naye Sauli na Yonathani mwanawe wamekufa.”

english: Then David asked the young man who had brought him the report, “How do you know that Saul and his son Jonathan are dead?”
ekegusii: Daudi akaboria omomura oria, “Inaki gwakorete okamanya ng’a Saulo na Yonathani, momura oye, bakuure?”
swahili: Ndipo Daudi akamwambia huyo kijana aliyemletea taarifa, “Je, umefahamuje kwamba Sauli na Yonathani mwanawe wamekufa?”

english: “I happened to be on Mount Gilboa,” he replied, “and there was Saul, leaning on his spear, with the chariots and the cavalry closing in on him.
ekegusii: Omomura oria akamoiraneria, “Nigo yabete ng’a nao narenge ase egetunwa kia Giliboa, na aroro ’nkarora Saulo osigamerete riitimo riaye; chigaari konya chiamoikereire ang’e, na abanto bariinete chibarasi bakomominyokia.
swahili: Yule kijana akasema, “Nilijipata huko Mlima Gilboa, naye Sauli alikuwa huko akiegemea mkuki wake, na magari ya vita na wapanda farasi wa upande wa adui wakawa wamemkaribia sana.

english: When he turned around and saw me, he called out and I answered, ‘Here I am!’
ekegusii: Agachia korigereria magega, akandora, akandangeria, na inche ngaitaba: Nao inde aa.
swahili: Alipogeuka na kuniona, akaniita, nami nikasema, ‘Je, nifanye nini?’

english: ‘Who are you?’ he asked. So I told him, ‘I am an Amalekite.’
ekegusii: Erio akamboria: Naye ng’o? Nkamoiraneria ng’a n’Omoameleki inde.
swahili: “Akaniuliza, ‘Wewe ni nani?’ “Nikamjibu, ‘Mimi ni Mwamaleki.’

english: Then he begged me, ‘Stand over me and kill me, for agony has seized me, but my life still lingers.’
ekegusii: Ere aganteebia: Koranche, ong’ike ang’e ong’ite, ekiagera nonya ngendererete koba moyo, nigo inde nobororo bw’ogokwa.
swahili: “Kisha akaniambia, ‘Nikaribie mimi na uniue! Niko katika maumivu makali ya kifo, lakini bado ningali hai.’

english: Now a worthless man named Sheba son of Bichri, a Benjamite, happened to be there, and he blew the ram’s horn and shouted: “We have no share in David, no inheritance in Jesse’s son. Every man to his tent, O Israel!”
ekegusii: Ekaba ng’a nareenge agwo Giligali omonto omoomboganu, ore korokwa Seba, mosinto o Bikiri bw’egesaku gia Benjamini. Ere akabugia egetuureri, akabora, “Ngetari ki tobwate ase Daudi? Titori nomwando na mosinto o Yese! Inwe Abaisraeli, geenda kera omonto bwoye!”
swahili: Basi, kulikuwa na mtu mbaya sana aliyeitwa Sheba mwana wa Bikri, Mbenyamini, aliyekuwako huko. Akapiga tarumbeta na kupaza sauti, “Hatuna fungu katika Daudi, wala hatuna sehemu katika mwana wa Yese! Kila mtu aende hemani mwake, enyi Israeli!”

english: Amasa was not on guard against the dagger in Joab’s hand, and Joab stabbed him in the stomach and spilled out his intestines on the ground. And Joab did not need to strike him again, for Amasa was dead. Then Joab and his brother Abishai pursued Sheba son of Bichri.
ekegusii: Amasa teritete korwa ase omoyio oria Yoabu abwate koboko kwaye. Ase igo Yoabu akamobeta omoyio oria enda, na amara akagwa inse. Erio agwo Amasa agakwa, na Yoabu tamoaka eria kabere. Magega y’ayio Yoabu na Abisai, momura omwabo, bakabwatia Seba, mosinto o Bikiri, gochia komoita.
swahili: Amasa hakuona upanga uliokuwa mkononi mwa Yoabu, naye Yoabu akamchoma nao tumboni, nayo matumbo yake yakamwagika chini. Pasipo kuchomwa mara ya pili, Amasa akafa. Basi Yoabu na Abishai nduguye wakamfuatia Sheba mwana wa Bikri.

english: One of Joab’s young men stood near Amasa and said, “Whoever favors Joab, and whoever is for David, let him follow Joab!”
ekegusii: Oyomo bw’abasomba ba Yoabu agatenena ang’e nomobere bw’Amasa akabora, “Oyo omwanchete Yoabu na oyore oyo’Daudi, tiga atuny’ane Yoabu.”
swahili: Mmoja wa watu wa Yoabu akasimama kando ya Amasa, akasema, “Yeyote ampendaye Yoabu na yeyote aliye upande wa Daudi, na amfuate Yoabu!”

english: But Amasa wallowed in his blood in the middle of the road, and when the man saw that all the troops were stopping there, he dragged the body off the road into a field and threw a garment over it.
ekegusii: Na Amasa igo arenge kogara‐gara ase amanyinga, gati‐gati y’enchera enene. Ekero omosomba oria arooche ng’a abanto bonsi batenenire, akaimokia omobere bw’Amasa korwa inchera, akayoruta mogondo ime, akayobisia egetambaa.
swahili: Amasa alikuwa akigaagaa katika damu yake katikati ya barabara; mtu mmoja akaona kwamba vikosi vyote vilikuwa vinasimama pale. Huyo mtu alipotambua kwamba kila aliyefika pale Amasa alipokuwa alisimama, alimburuta Amasa kutoka barabarani mpaka kwenye shamba na kutupia nguo juu yake.

english: As soon as Amasa’s body was removed from the road, all the men went on with Joab to pursue Sheba son of Bichri.
ekegusii: Ekero arusetigwe inchera, abanto bonsi bagaeta, bagatunyana Yoabu, erinde babwatie Seba, mosinto o Bikiri, gochia komoita.
swahili: Baada ya Amasa kuondolewa kutoka barabarani, watu wote walienda pamoja na Yoabu kumfuatia Sheba mwana wa Bikri.

english: Sheba passed through all the tribes of Israel to Abel-beth-maacah and through the entire region of the Berites, who gathered together and followed him.
ekegusii: Seba agaeta egati ye chingongo chi’ebisaku bionsi bi’Abaisraeli, agaika omochie o Abeli Beti‐Maaka, na Ababeri bonsi bagasangererekana amo, bakamotunyana.
swahili: Sheba akapita katika makabila yote ya Israeli hadi Abel-Beth-Maaka na kupitia eneo lote la Waberi ambao walijikusanya pamoja na kumfuata.

english: And Joab’s troops came and besieged Sheba in Abel-beth-maacah and built a siege ramp against the outer rampart of the city. As all the troops with Joab were battering the wall to topple it,
ekegusii: Abanto bonsi abareenge na Yoabu bagaacha Abeli Beti‐Maaka, bakamonaria, bakaagacha eburi bosio bw’omochie kororia orwaki, na abanto bagachaaka gotagora orwaki ng’a baroiyerie inse.
swahili: Vikosi vyote vya Yoabu vikaja na kumhusuru Sheba mwana wa Bikri huko Abel-Beth-Maaka. Wakauzingira mji kwa kuweka vikosi vya askari, ili kukabiliana na ngome ya mji. Walipokuwa wanagongagonga ukuta ili kuubomoa na kuuangusha chini,

english: a wise woman called out from the city, “Listen! Listen! Please tell Joab to come here so that I may speak with him.”
ekegusii: Erio omokungu gete omong’aini akarangeria korwa ase orwaki rw’omochie, agateeba, “Tegerera, tegerera! Teebia Yoabu ache aiga ang’e, ’nkwane nere.”
swahili: mwanamke mmoja mwenye busara akaita kutoka ndani ya mji, akisema, “Sikilizeni! Sikilizeni! Mwambieni Yoabu aje hapa ili niweze kuzungumza naye.”

english: When he had come near to her, the woman asked, “Are you Joab?” “I am,” he replied. “Listen to the words of your servant,” she said. “I am listening,” he answered.
ekegusii: Yoabu agasuka gochia ang’e ase are, na omokungu oria akamobooria, “Naye Yoabu?” Akairaneria, “Ee, ninche.” Omokungu oria akamoteebia, “Tegerera amang’ana ane, inche omosomba oo omokungu.” Yoabu akairaneria, “Nintegererete.”
swahili: Yoabu alikwenda mbele yake, akamuuliza, “Wewe ni Yoabu?” Akamjibu, “Ndiye mimi.” Yule mwanamke akamwambia, “Sikiliza kile mtumishi wako atakachokuambia.” Akamwambia, “Ninasikiliza.”

english: Then the woman said, “Long ago they used to say, ‘Seek counsel at Abel,’ and that is how disputes were settled.
ekegusii: Erio omokungu oria akamoteebia, “Agwo kare abanto nigo banarete goteeba: Geenda Abeli, omochie oyio, erinde onyore ogoseemigwa; ayio naro arenge gokoora amang’ana abo.
swahili: Huyo mwanamke akaendelea kusema, “Zamani za kale walikuwa wakisema, ‘Wakaulize ushauri huko Abeli,’ hivyo kulimaliza lile shauri.

english: I am among the peaceable and faithful in Israel, but you are trying to destroy a city that is a mother in Israel. Why would you swallow up the LORD’s inheritance?”
ekegusii: Intwe nigo tore abanto b’omorembe na abegenwa ase Abaisraeli. Inee! Aye nigo origetie gosiria omochie oyo ore ng’ina ase egati y’Abaisraeli? Nase ki oganetie gosaria omwando bw’Omonene?”
swahili: Sisi ni watu wa amani na waaminifu katika Israeli. Wewe unajaribu kuharibu mji ambao ni mama katika Israeli. Kwa nini unataka kumeza urithi wa Bwana?”

english: So all the men of Israel deserted David to follow Sheba son of Bichri. But the men of Judah stayed by their king all the way from the Jordan to Jerusalem.
ekegusii: Ase igo Abaisraeli bonsi bagatiga Daudi, bakabwatia Seba, mosinto o Bikiri; korende Abayuda bakabwatia omorwoti obo korwa Yorodani goika Yerusalemu.
swahili: Kwa hiyo watu wote wa Israeli wakamwacha Daudi na kumfuata Sheba mwana Bikri. Lakini watu wa Yuda wakawa karibu na mfalme wao katika safari yote kutoka Yordani mpaka Yerusalemu.

english: “Far be it!” Joab declared. “Far be it from me to swallow up or destroy!
ekegusii: Yoabu akamoiraneria, “Ayio tiga abe are nainche; timbaisa gosaria omochie na koyosiria.
swahili: Yoabu akajibu, “Hilo liwe mbali nami. Hilo liwe mbali nami kumeza au kuharibu.

english: That is not the case. But a man named Sheba son of Bichri, from the hill country of Ephraim, has lifted up his hand against the king, against David. Deliver him alone, and I will depart from the city.” “Look,” the woman replied, “his head will be thrown to you over the wall.”
ekegusii: Oyio tari oro omooroberio oito, korende omonto oyomo bw’ense y’ebitunwa ya Efraimu, Seba, mosinto o Bikiri, oimokire koba mamincha y’omorwoti Daudi. Mosokie, nainche indue aa ase omochie oyo”! Omokungu oria akamoiraneria, “Rigereria, noruterwe omotwe oye ase orwaki igoro.”
swahili: Hivyo sivyo ilivyo. Mtu mmoja jina lake Sheba mwana wa Bikri, kutoka nchi ya vilima vya Efraimu, ameinua mkono wake dhidi ya mfalme, dhidi ya Daudi. Nikabidhini mtu huyu mmoja, nami nitajiondoa katika mji huu.” Huyu mwanamke akamwambia Yoabu, “Kichwa chake mtatupiwa kupitia juu ya ukuta.”

english: Then the woman went to all the people with her wise counsel, and they cut off the head of Sheba son of Bichri and threw it to Joab. So he blew the ram’s horn and his men dispersed from the city, each to his own home. And Joab returned to the king in Jerusalem.
ekegusii: Erio omokungu oria akaebereria abanto bonsi ase chiseemi, na barabwo bakabutora Seba, mosinto o Bikiri, omotwe, bakayoruta gochia isiko ase Yoabu. Erio Yoabu akabugia egetuureri, na abanto bonsi bagaserebeekana; kera omonto akageenda bwoye. Na Yoabu akairana Yerusalemu ase omorwoti. Abakoreri ba Daudi
swahili: Ndipo huyo mwanamke akaenda kwa watu wote akiwa na ushauri wake wa busara, nao wakakata kichwa cha Sheba mwana wa Bikri na kumtupia Yoabu. Kwa hiyo Yoabu akapiga tarumbeta, na watu wake wakatawanyika kutoka mjini, kila mmoja akirejea nyumbani kwake. Naye Yoabu akarudi kwa mfalme huko Yerusalemu.

english: Now Joab was over the whole army of Israel; Benaiah son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and Pelethites;
ekegusii: Yoabu nere orenge omochiki bw’abarwani bonsi b’esegi ase Abaisraeli, na Benaya, mosinto o Yehoyada, nigo arenge omoteneneri bw’Abakereti na Abapeleti.
swahili: Yoabu alikuwa jemadari wa jeshi lote la Israeli; Benaya mwana wa Yehoyada alikuwa juu ya Wakerethi na Wapelethi;

english: Adoram was in charge of the forced labor; Jehoshaphat son of Ahilud was the recorder;
ekegusii: Adorama nigo abegetwe koba omoteneneri bw’emeremo ende yonsi. Yehosafati mosinto bw’Ahiludi, nigo areenge omoriki bw’amang’ana are gokoreka.
swahili: Adoramu alikuwa kiongozi wa wale waliofanya kazi ya kulazimishwa; Yehoshafati mwana wa Ahiludi alikuwa mweka kumbukumbu;

english: Sheva was the scribe; Zadok and Abiathar were priests;
ekegusii: Sheva nomoriiki oreenge, na Zadoki na Abiatari nabakuani bareenge.
swahili: Sheva alikuwa mwandishi; Sadoki na Abiathari walikuwa makuhani;

english: and Ira the Jairite was David’s priest.
ekegusii: Amo nabwo, Ira Omoyairi nigo areenge Omokuani ase Daudi.
swahili: na Ira, Myairi, alikuwa kuhani wa Daudi.

english: When David returned to his palace in Jerusalem, he took the ten concubines he had left to care for the palace, and he placed them in a house under guard. He provided for them, but he no longer slept with them. They were confined until the day of their death, living as widows.
ekegusii: Ekero Daudi aigete inka bwoye agwo Yerusalemu, akaira abakungu baye ikomi ba sere‐sere, abwo atigete bakorenda enyomba, akababeeka aase baranyare korendwa, akaba okobarageria, korende tachiete koba nabarabwo. Barabwo bakaba basiekeire aase agwo ase amatuko onsi bareenge moyo, bakaba bakomenya buna abatakanwa.
swahili: Daudi aliporudi katika jumba lake la kifalme huko Yerusalemu, aliwachukua wale masuria kumi aliokuwa amewaacha ili kuangalia jumba la kifalme na kuwaweka ndani ya nyumba chini ya ulinzi. Akawapa mahitaji yao lakini hakukutana nao kimwili. Waliwekwa kifungoni wakaishi kama wajane mpaka kifo chao.

english: Then the king said to Amasa, “Summon the men of Judah to come to me within three days, and be here yourself.”
ekegusii: Omorwoti agateebia Amasa, “Rangeria Abayuda bache ase ’nde ekero amatuko atato ataraera; naye obe aiga ase engaki eyio.”
swahili: Ndipo mfalme akamwambia Amasa, “Waite watu wa Yuda waje kwangu katika muda wa siku tatu, nawe mwenyewe uwepo hapa.”

english: So Amasa went to summon Judah, but he took longer than the time allotted him.
ekegusii: Amasa akageenda kobarangeria, korende agateebana, tairana ase engaki eria omorwoti, amobeekerete.
swahili: Lakini Amasa alipokwenda kuwaita Yuda, alichukua muda mrefu zaidi ya ule mfalme aliokuwa amemwekea.

english: And David said to Abishai, “Now Sheba the son of Bichri will do us more harm than Absalom. Take your lord’s servants and pursue him, or he will find fortified cities and elude us. ”
ekegusii: Daudi agateebia Abisai, “Bono Seba, mosinto o Bikiri, nigo agochia gotorentera emechando kobua eria Abisalomu atorenterete. Ira abasomba bane momobwatie, erinde tabaisa kwenyorera emechie ye chindwaki na gotokora bobe mono kobua.”
swahili: Daudi akamwambia Abishai, “Sasa Sheba mwana wa Bikri atatuletea madhara zaidi kuliko alivyofanya Absalomu. Wachukue watu wa bwana wako na umfuatie, la sivyo atapata mji wenye ngome na kututoroka.”

english: So Joab’s men, along with the Cherethites, the Pelethites, and all the mighty men, marched out of Jerusalem in pursuit of Sheba son of Bichri.
ekegusii: Erio abanto ba Yoabu, na Abakereti, na Abapeleti, ne chituoni chionsi, bagatunyana Abisai, bakarua Yerusalemu bakabwatia Seba, mosinto o Bikiri, bachie komobwata.
swahili: Hivyo watu wa Yoabu, na Wakerethi na Wapelethi, pamoja na wapiganaji mashujaa wote wakaondoka chini ya uongozi wa Abishai. Wakatoka Yerusalemu ili kumfuata Sheba mwana wa Bikri.

english: And while they were at the great stone in Gibeon, Amasa joined them. Now Joab was dressed in military attire, with a dagger strapped to his belt. And as he stepped forward, he slipped the dagger from its sheath.
ekegusii: Ekero baigete ase rigena rinene agwo Gibeoni, Amasa agachia kobarotota. Yoabu nigo abegete chianga chiaye chi’eseegi, na nigo eboeranetie omoyio o birende ase orokini. Ekero are goocha, omoyio oria okagwa inse.
swahili: Wakati walikuwa kwenye mwamba mkubwa huko Gibeoni, Amasa alikuja kuwalaki. Yoabu alikuwa amevaa mavazi yake ya kijeshi; juu yake alifunga mkanda kwenye kiuno wenye upanga ndani ya ala. Alipokuwa akienda mbele, ule upanga ukaanguka kutoka kwenye ala.

english: “Are you well, my brother?” Joab asked Amasa. And with his right hand Joab grabbed Amasa by the beard to kiss him.
ekegusii: Yoabu agakwania Amasa, “Mbuya ore oyominto?” Erio akamobwata chinderu nokoboko gw’okorio buna nigo arigetie komonyunyunta.
swahili: Yoabu akamwambia Amasa, “U hali gani, ndugu yangu?” Kisha Yoabu akamshika Amasa ndevu kwa mkono wake wa kuume ili ambusu.

english: During the reign of David there was a famine for three successive years, and David sought the face of the LORD. And the LORD said, “It is because of the blood shed by Saul and his family, because he killed the Gibeonites.”
ekegusii: Ase engaki y’obogaambi bwa Daudi enchara nigo yareenge koba omwaka ase omwaka, ase engaki y’emiaka etato, na Daudi akabori’Omonene igoro y’ayio. Omonene akamoiraneria, “Ayio nigo agokoreka ase engencho ya Saulo na enyomba yaye, ekiagera baiterete amaanyinga’ yabaanto; ere naitete Abagibeoni.”
swahili: Wakati wa utawala wa Daudi kulikuwa na njaa kwa miaka mitatu mfululizo, kwa hiyo Daudi akautafuta uso wa Bwana. Bwana akasema, “Ni kwa sababu ya Sauli na nyumba yake iliyotiwa madoa ya damu, kwa sababu aliwaua Wagibeoni.”

english: And Rizpah the daughter of Aiah took sackcloth and spread it out for herself on a rock. From the beginning of the harvest until the rain from heaven poured down on the bodies, she did not allow the birds of the air to rest on them by day, nor the beasts of the field by night.
ekegusii: Erio Risipa, mosubati o Aya, akaira chianga chi’echigunia agachiaara ase egetare keria, akabeerao korwa omochakano bwe rigesa goika embura ekorwa igoro egachaaka gotwera emebere y’abwo basungetwe, gose tatigete chinyoni chigwe ase emebere eyio mobaso, gose ching’iti chi’orosana chichicheo botuko.
swahili: Rispa binti Aiya akachukua nguo ya gunia, akajitandikia juu ya mwamba. Kuanzia mwanzo wa mavuno mpaka mvua ziliponyesha juu ya miili ya hao waliouawa, Rispa hakuruhusu ndege wa angani kuwagusa wakati wa mchana, wala wanyama wa mwitu wakati wa usiku.

english: When David was told what Saul’s concubine Rizpah, daughter of Aiah, had done,
ekegusii: Ekero Daudi atebeetigwe ayio Risipa, mosubati o Aya, omokungu o sere‐sere o Saulo akorete,
swahili: Daudi alipoambiwa kile Rispa binti Aiya, suria wa Sauli, alichokuwa amekifanya,

english: he went and took the bones of Saul and his son Jonathan from the men of Jabesh-gilead, who had stolen them from the public square of Beth-shan where the Philistines had hung the bodies after they had struck down Saul at Gilboa.
ekegusii: akageenda akoyia amauga a Saulo na aya Yonathani, momura o Saulo, korwa ase abanto ba Yabesi o Gileadi. (Abanto abwo konya baibire emebere eyio korwa ase ekeooreri agwo Bati‐Sani aase Abafirisiti baabasungete, aase rituko riria baitete Saulo aaria Giliboa.)
swahili: alikwenda akachukua mifupa ya Sauli na mwanawe Yonathani kutoka kwa watu wa Yabeshi-Gileadi. (Walikuwa wameichukua kwa siri kutoka uwanja wa watu wote huko Beth-Shani, mahali ambapo Wafilisti walikuwa wamewatundika baada ya kumuua Sauli huko Gilboa.)

english: So David had the bones of Saul and his son Jonathan brought from there, along with the bones of those who had been hanged.
ekegusii: Daudi akarenta amauga a Saulo na aya Yonathani, momura o Saulo; boigo agasangereria amauga y’abanto baria batano na babere konya batongirwe.
swahili: Daudi akaileta mifupa ya Sauli na ya mwanawe Yonathani kutoka huko, pia mifupa ya wale waliokuwa wameuawa na kutupwa ilikusanywa.

english: And they buried the bones of Saul and his son Jonathan in Zela in the land of Benjamin, in the tomb of Saul’s father Kish. After they had done everything the king had commanded, God answered their prayers for the land. Four Battles against the Philistines (1 Chronicles 20:4–8)
ekegusii: Erio bagatindeka amauga a Saulo na aya Yonathani, omwana oye, ase ense ya Benjamini, aaria Zela, ase embeera ya Kisi ise. Barabwo bagakora onsi aya omorwoti achiigete. Magega y’ayio Nyasae akaigwa aya basaberete ense eria. Esegi igoro y’amamonto y’Abafilisti (1 Amg 21:1-27)
swahili: Wakazika mifupa ya Sauli na ya mwanawe Yonathani katika kaburi la Kishi, babaye Sauli, huko Sela katika nchi ya Benyamini, nao wakafanya kila kitu mfalme alichoagiza. Baada ya hayo, Mungu akajibu maombi kwa ajili ya nchi. Vita Dhidi Ya Wafilisti (1 Nyakati 20:4-8)

english: Once again the Philistines waged war against Israel, and David and his servants went down and fought against the Philistines; but David became exhausted.
ekegusii: Esegi ekaba naende ase egati y’Abafilisti na Abaisraeli, na Daudi agatirimboka amo nabarwani baye korwania Abafirisiti. Daudi akaba orosire,
swahili: Kwa mara nyingine tena kulikuwa na vita kati ya Wafilisti na Israeli. Daudi akashuka pamoja na watu wake ili kupigana dhidi ya Wafilisti, naye akawa amechoka sana.

english: Then Ishbi-benob, a descendant of Rapha, whose bronze spear weighed three hundred shekels and who was bearing a new sword, resolved to kill David.
ekegusii: na Isi‐Benobu, oyomo bw’amamonto, nabwate riitimo riare noborito bwe chikiiro isato na ekeng’ese, naende nabwate omoro omoyia; ere akarigia goita Daudi.
swahili: Naye Ishbi-Benobu, mmoja wa wazao wa Warefai, ambaye mkuki wake ulikuwa na uzito wa shekeli 300 za shaba, alikuwa amejifunga upanga mpya, naye alisema angemuua Daudi.

english: But Abishai son of Zeruiah came to his aid, struck the Philistine, and killed him. Then David’s men swore to him, “You must never again go out with us to battle, so that the lamp of Israel may not be extinguished.”
ekegusii: Korende Abisai, omomura bw’omokuungu Seruya, akamotooria, agaita Omofilisti oria. Erio abanto ba Daudi bagakania Daudi na gotiana ng’a, “Aye bono togosooka na kogeenda ase esegi amo naintwe; aye nigo ore etaya y’Abaisraeli, toyerimia.”
swahili: Lakini Abishai mwana wa Seruya akaja kumwokoa Daudi; akampiga huyo Mfilisti, akamwangusha chini na kumuua. Ndipo watu wakamwapia Daudi, wakisema, “Kamwe hutakwenda tena nasi vitani, ili kwamba taa ya Israeli isije ikazimwa.”

english: Some time later at Gob, there was another battle with the Philistines. At that time Sibbecai the Hushathite killed Saph, one of the descendants of Rapha.
ekegusii: Magega y’ayio esegi in’yareenge ase Abaisraeli n’Abafilisti aria Gobu, na Sibeekai Omohusa agaita Safu, oyomo bw’amamonto.
swahili: Baada ya muda, kukawa na vita nyingine na Wafilisti, huko Gobu. Wakati huo Sibekai, Mhushathi, akamuua Safu, mmoja wa wazao wa Warefai.

english: Once again there was a battle with the Philistines at Gob, and Elhanan son of Jair the Bethlehemite killed the brother of Goliath the Gittite, the shaft of whose spear was like a weaver’s beam.
ekegusii: Esegi ende yarenge n’Abafilisti agwo Gobu. Elihanani, mosinto o Yaare‐Oregimu korwa Bethlehemu, agaita Goliato korwa Gati. Orotanga rwe riitimo ria Goliato nigo rwareenge buna omwaro omonene.
swahili: Katika vita vingine na Wafilisti huko Gobu, Elhanani mwana wa Yaare-Oregimu, Mbethlehemu, alimuua nduguye Goliathi, Mgiti, ambaye mkuki wake ulikuwa na mpini kama mti wa mfumaji.

english: At this, David summoned the Gibeonites and spoke to them. (Now the Gibeonites were not Israelites, but a remnant of the Amorites. The Israelites had taken an oath concerning them, but in his zeal for Israel and Judah, Saul had sought to kill them.)
ekegusii: Daudi akarangeria Abagibeoni. (Barabwo tibarenge Abaisraeli; nigo bareenge ekeombe giatigarete korwa ase Abaamori, na Abaisraeli konya baabariereire eira ng’a baabatige babe moyo, korende Saulo akarigia kobaita ase omokia oye, ase engencho y’Abaisraeli na Abayuda.)
swahili: Mfalme akawaita Wagibeoni na kuzumgumza nao. (Wagibeoni hawakuwa wa wana wa Israeli, ila walikuwa mabaki ya Waamori. Waisraeli walikuwa wameapa kuwaacha hai, lakini Sauli katika wivu wake kwa ajili ya Israeli na Yuda, alikuwa amejaribu kuwaangamiza.)

english: And there was still another battle at Gath, where there was a man of great stature with six fingers on each hand and six toes on each foot—twenty-four in all. He too was descended from Rapha,
ekegusii: Naende esegi yareenge Gati. Omonto omotambe nareengeo. Nigo areenge nebiara bitano na ekemo ase kera okoboko, na bitano na ekemo ase kera okogoro; bionsi nigo biareenge emerongo ebere na bine. Ere boigo noyomo bw’amamonto oreenge.
swahili: Katika vita vingine tena, vilivyopiganwa huko Gathi, kulikuwako na mtu mmoja mkubwa mwenye vidole sita katika kila mkono na vidole sita kila mguu, jumla vidole ishirini na vinne. Yeye alikuwa pia mzao wa Mrefai.

english: and when he taunted Israel, Jonathan the son of David’s brother Shimei killed him.
ekegusii: Ere akarama Abaisraeli, na Yonathani, momura o Simea omwabo Daudi, akamoita.
swahili: Alipowadhihaki Israeli, Yonathani mwana wa Shimea, nduguye Daudi, akamuua.

english: So these four descendants of Rapha in Gath fell at the hands of David and his servants.
ekegusii: Abanto abwo baane nigo bareenge ab’ororeria rw’amamonto korwa Gati. Barabwo nigo baitetwe na Daudi na abanto baye.
swahili: Hawa wanne walikuwa wazao wa Warefai huko Gathi, nao walianguka kwa mikono ya Daudi na watu wake.

english: So David asked the Gibeonites, “What shall I do for you? How can I make amends so that you may bless the inheritance of the LORD?”
ekegusii: Daudi akaboria Abagibeoni, “Ninki ’nkobakorera? Nindigetie gokora okobwatanigwa ase engencho y’obobe mwakoreretwe, erinde mosesenie abanto ba Omonene.”
swahili: Daudi akawauliza Wagibeoni, “Niwatendee nini? Nitawaridhishaje ili mbariki urithi wa Bwana?”

english: The Gibeonites said to him, “We need no silver or gold from Saul or his house, nor should you put to death anyone in Israel for us.” “Whatever you ask, I will do for you,” he replied.
ekegusii: Abagibeoni bakamoiraneria, “Titorigeti chifeta gose chitaabu korwa ase Saulo, gose korwa ase eamate yaye; intwe titorigeti goita omonto onde bwensi ase Abaisraeli.” Daudi akababoria, “Ninki rende ’nkobakorera?”
swahili: Wagibeoni wakamjibu, “Hatuna haki ya kudai fedha wala dhahabu kutoka kwa Sauli au jamaa yake, wala hatuna haki ya kumuua mtu yeyote katika Israeli.” Daudi akawauliza, “Mnataka niwafanyie nini?”

english: And they answered the king, “As for the man who consumed us and plotted against us to exterminate us from existing within any border of Israel,
ekegusii: Barabwo bakairaneria omorwoti, “Omonto oria akarigia gotosiria kegima ng’a titomenya ase Abaisraeli.
swahili: Wakamjibu mfalme, “Kwa habari ya mtu aliyetuangamiza na kufanya hila mbaya dhidi yetu ili kwamba tuangamizwe na tusiwe na yeyote katika Israeli,

english: let seven of his male descendants be delivered to us so that we may hang them before the LORD at Gibeah of Saul, the chosen of the LORD.” “I will give them to you,” said the king.
ekegusii: Ase ayio, tiga toegwe abamura batano na babere b’ororeria rw’aye, erinde tobasunge ase obosio bw’Omonene aiga Gibea aase Saulo, omochoore Omonene, amenyete.” Omorwoti akabairaneria, “Nimbaabae inwe.”
swahili: tupatieni wazao wake saba wa kiume tuwaue hadharani mbele za Bwana huko Gibea ya Sauli, aliyekuwa amechaguliwa na Bwana.” Basi mfalme akasema, “Nitawakabidhi kwenu.”

english: Now the king spared Mephibosheth son of Jonathan, the son of Saul, because of the oath before the LORD between David and Jonathan son of Saul.
ekegusii: Omorwoti agatiga Mefiboseti, mosinto o Yonathani o Saulo, ase engencho y’eira Daudi na Yonathani bariereranete ase Omonene,
swahili: Mfalme akamhifadhi Mefiboshethi mwana wa Yonathani, mwana wa Sauli, kwa sababu ya kile kiapo mbele za Bwana kati ya Daudi na Yonathani.

english: But the king took Armoni and Mephibosheth, the two sons whom Rizpah daughter of Aiah had borne to Saul, as well as the five sons whom Merab daughter of Saul had borne to Adriel son of Barzillai the Meholathite.
ekegusii: korende akairera Arimoni na Mefiboseti, abana abamura babere abwo Risipa, omosubati o Aya aiborerete Saulo. Naende akairera abamura batano, aba Mikali, omosubati o Saulo, aiborerete Adirieli, mosinto o Barisilai Omomehola.
swahili: Lakini mfalme akamchukua Armoni na Mefiboshethi, wana wawili wa Rispa binti Aiya, ambao alikuwa amemzalia Sauli, pamoja na wana watano wa Merabu binti Sauli, aliokuwa amemzalia Adrieli mwana wa Barzilai, Mmeholathi.

english: And he delivered them into the hands of the Gibeonites, and they hanged them on the hill before the LORD. So all seven of them fell together; they were put to death in the first days of the harvest, at the beginning of the barley harvest.
ekegusii: Akababeeka ase amaboko y’Abagibeoni, na barabwo bakabasunga ase egetunwa igoro, ase obosio bw’Omonene. Bonsi batano na babere bagaiterwa amo. Bagaitwa ase amatuko amatang’ani ye rigesa, ekero bachaakire kogesa endagera ekorokwa esairi.
swahili: Akawakabidhi kwa Wagibeoni, ambao waliwaua na kuwaweka wazi juu ya kilima mbele za Bwana. Wote saba walianguka kwa pamoja; waliuawa katika siku za kwanza za mavuno, mara tu uvunaji wa shayiri ulipokuwa unaanza.

english: And David sang this song to the LORD on the day the LORD had delivered him from the hand of all his enemies and from the hand of Saul.
ekegusii: Oko nogoteera Daudi atererete Omonene, ekero Omonene amotooretie korwa ase amaboko y’ababisa baye na aya Saulo.
swahili: Daudi alimwimbia Bwana maneno ya wimbo huu wakati Bwana alipomwokoa mikononi mwa adui zake wote, na pia mkononi mwa Sauli.

english: He parted the heavens and came down with dark clouds beneath His feet.
ekegusii: Akang’usa igoro goocha inse aa, nere agacha, riire rimwamu rikaba inse y’amagoro aye.
swahili: Akazipasua mbingu akashuka chini, mawingu meusi yalikuwa chini ya miguu yake.

english: He mounted a cherub and flew; He soared on the wings of the wind.
ekegusii: Akariina egetongwa kebwate chimbaba, akairuruka; akarorekana igoro ye chimbaaba chi’embeo.
swahili: Alipanda juu ya kerubi akaruka, akapaa juu kwa mbawa za upepo.

english: He made darkness a canopy around Him, a gathering of water and thick clouds.
ekegusii: Agetuba ere omonyene n’omosunte, na amare amarito aichire amaache.
swahili: Alifanya giza hema lake la kujifunika: mawingu meusi ya mvua ya angani.

english: From the brightness of His presence coals of fire blazed forth.
ekegusii: Korwa ase obomeka‐meku obwo bwareenge bosio bwaye okomesa gokaruta ebibembeeri bi’omorero.
swahili: Kutokana na mwanga wa uwepo wake mawingu yalisogea, ikanyesha mvua ya mawe na umeme wa radi.

english: The LORD thundered from heaven; the voice of the Most High resounded.
ekegusii: Omonene agaaka enkoba korwa igoro, na eriogi ri’Oyore Igoro Mono rikaiguugwa.
swahili: Bwana alinguruma kutoka mbinguni, sauti ya Aliye Juu Sana ilisikika.

english: He shot His arrows and scattered the foes; He hurled lightning and routed them.
ekegusii: Akaruta chinsara, agaserebania ababisa baye, akabaaka nokomesa.
swahili: Aliipiga mishale na kutawanya adui, umeme wa radi na kuwafukuza.

english: The channels of the sea appeared, and the foundations of the world were exposed at the rebuke of the LORD, at the blast of the breath of His nostrils.
ekegusii: Erio ebiambokero bi’enyancha bikarorekana, na oboroso bw’ense bokaorokigwa aarabu, ekero Omonene abatogonyerete ase okwoga kw’omoika bwe chimioro chiaye.
swahili: Mabonde ya bahari yalifunuliwa, na misingi ya dunia ikawa wazi kwa kukaripia kwake Bwana, kwa uvumi wa pumzi kutoka puani mwake.

english: He reached down from on high and took hold of me; He drew me out of deep waters.
ekegusii: Omonene akarambora okoboko kwaye korwa igoro, akambwata, akandusia ase amaache amaange.
swahili: “Alinyoosha mkono kutoka juu na kunishika; alinitoa kutoka kilindi cha maji makuu.

english: He rescued me from my powerful enemy, from foes too mighty for me.
ekegusii: Agantooria korwa ase ababisa bane bare ne chinguru, na korwa ase abwo bangechete; barabwo nigo bareenge ne chinguru kombua.
swahili: Aliniokoa kutoka adui wangu mwenye nguvu nyingi, kutoka adui zangu waliokuwa na nguvu nyingi kuliko mimi.

english: They confronted me in my day of calamity, but the LORD was my support.
ekegusii: Ekero nareenge nemechando bakandwania, korende Omonene akaba egekengero kiane.
swahili: Walinikabili siku ya msiba wangu, lakini Bwana alikuwa msaada wangu.

english: He said: “The LORD is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer.
ekegusii: Agateeba: Omonene nere egetare kiane na eburi y’ane enkong’u; nere Omotooria one.
swahili: Akasema: “ Bwana ni mwamba wangu, ngome yangu na mwokozi wangu,

english: He brought me out into the open; He rescued me because He delighted in me.
ekegusii: Akang’ira aase areenge aagare, agantooria, ekiagera namogoogetie.
swahili: Alinileta nje mahali penye nafasi tele, akaniokoa kwa kuwa alipendezwa nami.

english: The LORD has rewarded me according to my righteousness; He has repaid me according to the cleanness of my hands.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo ang’ete eng’eria y’obuya, ekiagera inde omooronge; nigo ansesenetie, ekiagera inde n’amaboko atari na komocha.
swahili: “ Bwana alinitendea sawasawa na uadilifu wangu; sawasawa na usafi wa mikono yangu amenilipa.

english: For I have kept the ways of the LORD and have not wickedly departed from my God.
ekegusii: Inche nabeire ’nkobwatia chinchera chia Omonene, tintigeti Nyasae one ase ogokora amabe.
swahili: Kwa maana nimezishika njia za Bwana; sijatenda ubaya nikamwacha Mungu wangu.

english: For all His ordinances are before me; I have not disregarded His statutes.
ekegusii: Nabeire ’nkoreenda amachiiko aye onsi, na timbeti ’ngotiga emeroberio yaye echiikire.
swahili: Sheria zake zote zi mbele yangu, wala sijayaacha maagizo yake.

english: And I have been blameless before Him and kept myself from iniquity.
ekegusii: Nigo nareenge omoikeranu ase are, ’nkereenda korwa ase obobe.
swahili: Nimekuwa sina hatia mbele zake, nami nimejilinda nisitende dhambi.

english: So the LORD has repaid me according to my righteousness, according to my cleanness in His sight.
ekegusii: Omonene ong’akanire, ekiagera ’ngokora ayare boronge, na ekiagera arooche ng’a nomochenu inde.
swahili: Bwana amenilipa sawasawa na uadilifu wangu, sawasawa na usafi wangu machoni pake.

english: To the faithful You show Yourself faithful, to the blameless You show Yourself blameless;
ekegusii: Aye Omonene nigo ore omwegenwa ase abwo bare abegenwa; nigo okweorokia ng’a nomoikeranu ore ase abwo bare abaikeranu.
swahili: “Kwa yeye aliye mwaminifu unajionyesha kuwa mwaminifu, kwa asiye na hatia unajionyesha kutokuwa na hatia,

english: to the pure You show Yourself pure, but to the crooked You show Yourself shrewd.
ekegusii: Aye nigo ore omochenu ase abwo bare abachenu, nigo okwanga abwo bare abakorekanu.
swahili: kwa aliye mtakatifu unajionyesha kuwa mtakatifu, lakini kwa aliyepotoka unajionyesha kuwa mkaidi.

english: You save an afflicted people, but Your eyes are on the haughty to bring them down.
ekegusii: Aye nigo ogotooria abanto bare abaitongo, korende amaiso ao nigo arigereretie abare abaenenu ase okobairania inse.
swahili: Wewe huwaokoa wanyenyekevu, lakini macho yako ni juu ya wenye kiburi ili uwashushe.

english: For You, O LORD, are my lamp; the LORD lights up my darkness.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene nigo ore etaya y’ane; Omonene one, nigo okoonchora omosunte one oba omobaso.
swahili: Wewe ni taa yangu, Ee Bwana. Bwana hulifanya giza langu kuwa mwanga.

english: My God is my rock, in whom I take refuge, my shield, and the horn of my salvation. My stronghold, my refuge, and my Savior, You save me from violence.
ekegusii: Nyasae one nere egetare kiane, ase are nao nyebisete, ere n’enguba y’ane enkengerete, na orogunchara rwane rwandeterete ogotooreka, naende nere eburi y’ane enkong’u, na obotamero bwane. Ere n’Omotooria one, oy’ogontooria korwa ase obotindi.
swahili: Mungu wangu ni mwamba wangu, ambaye kwake ninakimbilia, ngao yangu na pembe ya wokovu wangu. Yeye ni ngome yangu, kimbilio langu na mwokozi wangu, huniokoa kutoka kwa watu wenye jeuri.

english: For in You I can charge an army; with my God I can scale a wall.
ekegusii: Konde amo naye, nigo ndasirie omogaanda bw’eseegi, na ekero inde na Nyasae one nincharoke chindwaki igoro.
swahili: Kwa msaada wako naweza kushinda jeshi, nikiwa pamoja na Mungu wangu nitaweza kuruka ukuta.

english: As for God, His way is perfect; the word of the LORD is flawless. He is a shield to all who take refuge in Him.
ekegusii: Enchera ya Nyasae neng’ikeranu; amang’ana aye ateemirwe na gotenena. Ere nenguba ase bonsi abakomotamera.
swahili: “Kuhusu Mungu, njia yake ni kamilifu; neno la Bwana halina dosari. Yeye ni ngao kwa wote wanaokimbilia kwake.

english: For who is God besides the LORD? And who is the Rock except our God?
ekegusii: Inee! Ning’o ore Nyasae, otatiga Omonene? Ning’o ore egetare, otatiga Nyasae oito?
swahili: Kwa maana ni nani aliye Mungu zaidi ya Bwana? Ni nani aliye Mwamba isipokuwa Mungu wetu?

english: God is my strong fortress and He makes my way clear.
ekegusii: Nyasae nere eburi y’ane ye chinguru, nigo akoraa omonto omooronge ase enchera agoeta.
swahili: Mungu ndiye anivikaye nguvu na kufanya njia yangu kuwa kamilifu.

english: He makes my feet like those of a deer and stations me upon the heights.
ekegusii: Ere okorire amagoro ane abeire buna ay’egesia, onkong’irie na gontenenia ase ebitunwa.
swahili: Huifanya miguu yangu kama miguu ya kulungu, huniwezesha kusimama mahali palipo juu.

english: He trains my hands for battle; my arms can bend a bow of bronze.
ekegusii: Ere bworokereirie amaboko ane korwana esegi, erinde amaboko ane anyare gokumba obota bw’etai.
swahili: Huifundisha mikono yangu kupigana vita; mikono yangu inaweza kupinda upinde wa shaba.

english: You have given me Your shield of salvation, and Your gentleness exalts me.
ekegusii: “Aye kwang’eire enguba yao ase ogontooria, na ogokonywa kwao gwankorire nabeire omonene.
swahili: Hunipa ngao yako ya ushindi, unajishusha chini ili kuniinua.

english: You broaden the path beneath me so that my ankles do not give way.
ekegusii: Kwang’eire aase aagare ngotaara, na amagoro ane tagotererigwa.
swahili: Huyapanua mapito yangu, ili miguu yangu isiteleze.

english: I pursued my enemies and destroyed them; I did not turn back until they were consumed.
ekegusii: Nkabwatia ababisa bane, nkabasiria, gose tinairanete goika nkabakoora.
swahili: “Niliwafuatia adui zangu na nikawaseta, sikurudi nyuma mpaka walipoangamizwa.

english: I devoured and crushed them so they could not rise; they have fallen under my feet.
ekegusii: Nkabaakera inse nkabasenyenta, tibanyara koimoka, bakagwa inse y’amagoro ane, bakabugwa.
swahili: Niliwaseta kabisa, nao hawakuweza kuinuka tena; walianguka chini ya miguu yangu.

english: I will call upon the LORD, who is worthy to be praised; so shall I be saved from my enemies.
ekegusii: Nindangerie Omonene, oyo ogwenerete gotogigwa, nigo arantoorie korwa ase ababisa bane.
swahili: Ninamwita Bwana, anayestahili kusifiwa, nami ninaokolewa kutoka kwa adui zangu.

english: You have armed me with strength for battle; You have subdued my foes beneath me.
ekegusii: Aye nigo kwambeegete chinguru chi’okorwana esegi; okabeeka ababisa bane inse y’amagoro ane.
swahili: Ulinivika nguvu kwa ajili ya kupigana vita; uliwafanya adui zangu wasujudu miguuni pangu.

english: You have made my enemies retreat before me; I put an end to those who hated me.
ekegusii: Ogaseeria ababisa bane bagatama korwa ase inde, abangeechete ’nkabasiria kegima.
swahili: Uliwafanya adui zangu wageuke na kukimbia, nami nikawaangamiza adui zangu.

english: They looked, but there was no one to save them— to the LORD, but He did not answer.
ekegusii: Barabwo bakarigereria, korende onde tarenge obatooretie; bakarangeri’Omonene, korende ere tabaigwa.
swahili: Walipiga yowe, lakini hapakuwepo na yeyote wa kuwaokoa; walimlilia Bwana, lakini hakuwajibu.

english: I ground them as the dust of the earth; I crushed and trampled them like mud in the streets.
ekegusii: Nkabasunyunta bakaba ebuse ye riroba, nkabamionogora na kobatiringa buna esike egotachwa ase chinchera.
swahili: Niliwaponda kama mavumbi ya nchi; niliwaponda na kuwakanyaga kama tope barabarani.

english: You have delivered me from the strife of my people; You have preserved me as the head of nations; a people I had not known shall serve me.
ekegusii: “Aye gwantooririe korwa ase okoamererania n’abanto bane, kwandendire nabeire omogambi bw’abaanto b’ebisaku; abanto ntamanyete, bono babeire abasomba bane.
swahili: “Umeniokoa kutokana na mashambulizi ya watu wangu; umenihifadhi mimi kama kiongozi wa mataifa. Watu ambao sikuwajua wananitumikia,

english: Foreigners cower before me; when they hear me, they obey me.
ekegusii: Abamenyi nigo bebeegete inse y’ane, na ekero baigure chinkuma chiane, banyigwera.
swahili: nao wageni huja wakininyenyekea, mara wanisikiapo, hunitii.

english: Foreigners lose heart and come trembling from their strongholds.
ekegusii: Abanto b’ebisaku ebiaao berusirie moyo, kobagosooka korwa ase chiburi chiabo, nigo bakoiguswa.
swahili: Wote wanalegea, wanatoka katika ngome zao wakitetemeka.

english: The LORD lives, and blessed be my Rock! And may God, the Rock of my salvation, be exalted—
ekegusii: “Omonene nigo are moyo! Ere oyore egetare kiane atogigwe! Nyasae, egetare ki’ogotooreka kw’ane, aimokererigwe igoro.
swahili: “ Bwana yu hai! Sifa ni kwa Mwamba wangu! Atukuzwe Mungu, Mwamba, Mwokozi wangu!

english: the God who avenges me and brings down nations beneath me,
ekegusii: Nyasae nigo akonduseria egesiomba, nabeeke abanto b’ebisaku inse y’ane.
swahili: Yeye ndiye Mungu anilipiziaye kisasi, ayawekaye mataifa chini yangu,

english: who frees me from my enemies. You exalt me above my foes; You rescue me from violent men.
ekegusii: Ere nigo antooretie korwa ase ababisa bane, akanyimokereria igoro ase abare mamincha y’ane, naende agantooria korwa ase abanto abatindi.
swahili: aniwekaye huru toka kwa adui zangu. Uliniinua juu ya adui zangu; uliniokoa toka kwa watu wajeuri.

english: For the waves of death engulfed me; the torrents of chaos overwhelmed me.
ekegusii: Emerindo y’amakweri konya yang’etananire, chiooro chi’obobe chikandetera obwoba.
swahili: “Mawimbi ya mauti yalinizunguka, mafuriko ya maangamizi yalinilemea.

english: Therefore I will praise You, O LORD, among the nations; I will sing praises to Your name.
ekegusii: “Aye Omonene, ase ayio ningotogie ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku, ninterere erieta ria’o ase okoritogia.
swahili: Kwa hiyo nitakusifu, Ee Bwana, katikati ya mataifa; nitaliimbia sifa jina lako.

english: Great salvation He brings to His king. He shows loving devotion to His anointed, to David and his descendants forever.”
ekegusii: Nyasae ong’eire inche, omorwoti oye, obobui obonene, oorokirie obwanchani botari koera ase ’nde, inche omoakwa amaguta oye, inche Daudi, na ororeria rw’ane, goika kare na kare.”
swahili: Humpa mfalme wake ushindi mkuu; huonyesha fadhili zake kwa mpakwa mafuta wake, kwa Daudi na wazao wake milele.”

english: The cords of Sheol entangled me; the snares of death confronted me.
ekegusii: Obobe bw’amakweri nigo bwang’etananete, emeeto y’amakweri egantega na kombwata.
swahili: Kamba za kuzimu zilinizunguka, mitego ya mauti ilinikabili.

english: In my distress I called upon the LORD; I cried out to my God. And from His temple He heard my voice, and my cry for help reached His ears.
ekegusii: Ase emechando y’ane ’nkarangeri’Omonene; ’nkarera ase Nyasae one. Korwa ase Hekalu yaye akaigwa eriogi riane, ekerero kiane gekamoikera, ere agakeigwa.
swahili: Katika shida yangu nalimwita Bwana, nilimlilia Mungu wangu. Kutoka Hekaluni mwake alisikia sauti yangu, kilio changu kikafika masikioni mwake.

english: Then the earth shook and quaked; the foundations of the heavens trembled; they were shaken because He burned with anger.
ekegusii: Erio ense ekanyegerigwa na koondoka, amaroso a igoro agatengechigwa. Ee, ense ekaiguswa, ekiagera Omonene areenge n’endamwamu.
swahili: “Dunia ilitetemeka na kutikisika, misingi ya mbingu ikatikisika, vilitetemeka kwa sababu alikuwa amekasirika.

english: Smoke rose from His nostrils, and consuming fire came from His mouth; glowing coals blazed forth.
ekegusii: Erioki rigasoka korwa ase chimioro chiaye, na omorero ogosaamba korwa ase omonwa oye: ee, omorero bw’amakara ogasooka korwa ase are.
swahili: Moshi ukapanda kutoka puani mwake, moto uteketezao ukatoka kinywani mwake, makaa ya moto yawakayo yakatoka ndani mwake.

english: These are the last words of David: “The oracle of David son of Jesse, the oracle of the man raised on high, the one anointed by the God of Jacob, and the sweet psalmist of Israel:
ekegusii: Aya naro amang’ana y’omoerio a Daudi, mosinto o Yese, omonto oyo oimokereretigwe igoro, omoakwa amaguta o Nyasae o Yakobo, omoteri bw’amatera agwansa ase Abaisraeli:
swahili: Haya ni maneno ya mwisho ya Daudi: “Neno la Daudi mwana wa Yese, neno la mtu aliyeinuliwa na Aliye Juu Sana, mtu aliyepakwa mafuta na Mungu wa Yakobo, mwimbaji wa nyimbo wa Israeli:

english: but Eleazar stood his ground and struck the Philistines until his hand grew weary and stuck to his sword. The LORD brought about a great victory that day. Then the troops returned to him, but only to plunder the dead.
ekegusii: Korende ere agatenena, agaita Abafirisiti goika okoboko kwaye gokarosa gokananterera ase omoro. Omonene akabanyorera obobui obonene mono ase rituko riria. Erio abanto bakairana bagatunyana Eleazari, bagasakora ebisakorwa.
swahili: lakini yeye alisimama imara akawaua Wafilisti hadi mkono wake ukachoka na ukagandamana na upanga. Bwana akawapa ushindi mkubwa siku ile. Vikosi vikarudi kwa Eleazari, kuteka tu nyara za waliokufa.

english: And after him was Shammah son of Agee the Hararite. When the Philistines had banded together near a field full of lentils, Israel’s troops fled from them.
ekegusii: Na oyo o gatato ase abwo nere Sama, mosinto bw’Agee korwa Harari. Abafirisiti konya basangererekanire agwo, Lehi, ase omogondo orenge oichire ne ching’ende chi’egatani. Abaisraeli bagatama korwa ase Abafirisiti,
swahili: Aliyefuata alikuwa Shama mwana wa Agee, Mharari. Wafilisti walipokusanyika pamoja mahali palipokuwa shamba lililojaa dengu, vikosi vya Israeli viliwakimbia.

english: But Shammah took his stand in the middle of the field, defended it, and struck down the Philistines. So the LORD brought about a great victory.
ekegusii: korende Sama agatenena ase omogondo gati, akayorwanerera, agaita Abafirisiti, n’Omonene akarenta obobui obonene mono.
swahili: Lakini Shama akasimama imara katikati ya lile shamba. Akalitetea na kuwaua Wafilisti, naye Bwana akawapa ushindi mkubwa.

english: At harvest time, three of the thirty chief men went down to David at the cave of Adullam, while a company of Philistines was encamped in the Valley of Rephaim.
ekegusii: Rituko erimo, ekero kie rigesa, abanto batato ase abwo abanene emerongo etato bakageenda ase Daudi maate ase rikuruma ri’Adulamu, na Abafirisiti konya batoorire ase ense omweya y’Abarefai.
swahili: Wakati wa mavuno, viongozi watatu kati ya viongozi thelathini walishuka, wakamwendea Daudi katika pango la Adulamu, wakati kikundi cha Wafilisti kilikuwa kimepiga kambi katika Bonde la Warefai.

english: At that time David was in the stronghold, and the garrison of the Philistines was at Bethlehem.
ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio Daudi nigo areenge ase eburi ime, na abarwani b’Abafilisti nigo bareenge agwo Bethlehemu.
swahili: Wakati huo Daudi alikuwa katika ngome, na kambi ya Wafilisti ilikuwa huko Bethlehemu.

english: David longed for water and said, “Oh, that someone would get me a drink of water from the well near the gate of Bethlehem!”
ekegusii: Daudi akaba okogania amaache anywe, akabora, “Ntare konyora omonto andetere amaache inywe korwa ase ensoko eyio ere ase egeita kia Bethlehemu!”
swahili: Daudi akatamani maji, akasema, “Laiti mtu angenipatia maji ya kunywa kutoka kisima kilicho karibu na lango la Bethlehemu!”

english: So the three mighty men broke through the Philistine camp, drew water from the well near the gate of Bethlehem, and brought it back to David. But he refused to drink it; instead, he poured it out to the LORD,
ekegusii: Erio abanto baria batato bakabinya‐binyia egati y’Abafilisti aase batoorete, bakabuucha amaache korwa ase ensoko eria yareenge ase egeita gia Bethlehemu, bakayairera Daudi. Korende Daudi tayanywa, otatiga ayaiterete koba ekeng’wanso gi’ekenyugwa ase Omonene,
swahili: Basi mashujaa hao watatu wakapenya katikati ya Wafilisti, wakaenda kuchota maji kutoka kwa kisima kilicho karibu na lango la Bethlehemu, wakamletea Daudi. Lakini Daudi akakataa kuyanywa. Badala yake, aliyamimina mbele za Bwana.

english: saying, “Far be it from me, O LORD, to do this! Is this not the blood of the men who risked their lives?” So he refused to drink it. Such were the exploits of the three mighty men.
ekegusii: akabora, “Omonene antange tinkora bo. Inee! Inywe amanyinga y’abanto bataegerete obogima bwabo?” Ase ayio akaanga, tayanywa. Ayio naro abanto abwo batato chituoni bakorete.
swahili: Akasema, “Iwe mbali nami, Ee Bwana, kufanya kitu hiki. Je, hii si damu ya watu ambao walikwenda kwa kuhatarisha maisha yao?” Naye Daudi hakuyanywa. Haya yalifanywa na hao mashujaa watatu.

english: Now Abishai, the brother of Joab and son of Zeruiah, was chief of the Three, and he lifted his spear against three hundred men, killed them, and won a name along with the Three.
ekegusii: Abisai, momura omwabo Yoabu bw’omokuungu Seruya ere nigo amanyekanete ase baria batato; akarwania abanto amagana atato, akababeta ne riitimo riaye, akabaita, akaba nerieta rinene ase baria batato.
swahili: Abishai ndugu yake Yoabu mwana wa Seruya ndiye alikuwa kiongozi wa hao Watatu. Aliinua mkuki wake dhidi ya watu 300 ambao aliwaua, kwa hiyo naye akawa na sifa kama hao Watatu.

english: Was he not more honored than the Three? And he became their commander, even though he was not included among the Three.
ekegusii: Ase baria batato ere nigo abwate ogosikwa okuya goetania abande, akaba omoraai obo, korende tareng’anetie na baria batato b’eritang’ani.
swahili: Je, hakupata heshima kubwa zaidi kuliko hao Watatu? Alikuwa jemadari wao, ingawa hakuhesabiwa miongoni mwao.

english: The Spirit of the LORD spoke through me; His word was on my tongue.
ekegusii: Omoika bw’Omonene ogokwana goetera ase inde, ring’ana riaye nigo rire ase omonwa one.
swahili: “Roho wa Bwana alinena kupitia kwangu, neno lake lilikuwa ulimini mwangu.

english: And Benaiah son of Jehoiada was a man of valor from Kabzeel, a man of many exploits. He struck down two champions of Moab, and on a snowy day he went down into a pit and killed a lion.
ekegusii: Benaya, mosinto o Yehoyada, nigo arenge omonto etuoni korwa Kabuseli. Ere agakora emeremo emenene, agaita abanto babere chituoni b’Abamoabu. Engaki ende, ekero ki’obokendu, na amagena y’embura atwete, agasoa engoro agaita endo aroro.
swahili: Benaya mwana wa Yehoyada alikuwa mpiganaji hodari kutoka Kabseeli ambaye alifanya mambo makubwa ya ujasiri. Aliwaua mashujaa wawili waliokuwa hodari kuliko wote wa Moabu. Pia alishuka shimoni kulipokuwa na theluji na kumuua simba.

english: He also killed an Egyptian, a huge man. Although the Egyptian had a spear in his hand, Benaiah went against him with a club, snatched the spear from his hand, and killed the Egyptian with his own spear.
ekegusii: Boigo agaita Omomisiri orenge omonene obwate riitimo. Akamochiera nenyimbo, akamoura riitimo riare koboko kwaye, akamoita neritimo riria riaye omonyene.
swahili: Pia alimuua Mmisri mrefu mkubwa. Ingawa Mmisri alikuwa na mkuki mkononi mwake, Benaya alimwendea akiwa na rungu. Alipokonya mkuki kutoka mkononi mwa Mmisri na kumuua kwa mkuki wake mwenyewe.

english: These were the exploits of Benaiah son of Jehoiada, who won a name alongside the three mighty men.
ekegusii: Amang’ana aya naro Benaya, mosinto o Yehoyada, akorete; nere akaba n’erieta rinene buna abanto baria batato chituoni.
swahili: Haya yalikuwa mambo ya ushujaa ya Benaya mwana wa Yehoyada; naye pia alikuwa maarufu kama wale mashujaa watatu.

english: He was most honored among the Thirty, but he did not become one of the Three. And David appointed him over his guard.
ekegusii: Akanyora ogosikwa okuya ase egati ya baria emerongo etato, korende tareng’anetie na baria batato b’eritang’ani. Daudi akamobeka akaba omoreendi bw’obogima bwaye.
swahili: Yeye aliheshimiwa zaidi ya wale Thelathini, lakini hakujumuishwa miongoni mwa wale Watatu. Daudi akamweka kuwa kiongozi wa walinzi wake.

english: Now these were members of the Thirty: Asahel the brother of Joab, Elhanan son of Dodo of Bethlehem,
ekegusii: Abande ba baria emerongo etato nabwo aba: Asaeli, momura omwabo Yoabu, na Elihanani, mosinto o Dodo korwa Bethlehemu;
swahili: Miongoni mwa wale Thelathini walikuwepo: Asaheli ndugu wa Yoabu; Elhanani mwana wa Dodo kutoka Bethlehemu;

english: Shammah the Harodite, Elika the Harodite,
ekegusii: Sama na Elika korwa Harodi;
swahili: Shama, Mharodi; Elika, Mharodi;

english: Helez the Paltite, Ira son of Ikkesh the Tekoite,
ekegusii: Helesi korwa Peleti, na Ira, mosinto o Ikesi, korwa Tekoa;
swahili: Helesi, Mpalti; Ira mwana wa Ikeshi kutoka Tekoa;

english: Abiezer the Anathothite, Mebunnai the Hushathite,
ekegusii: Abieseri korwa Anatoti, na Mebunai korwa Husa;
swahili: Abiezeri kutoka Anathothi; Mebunai, Mhushathi;

english: Zalmon the Ahohite, Maharai the Netophathite,
ekegusii: Salimoni korwa Ahohi, na Maharai korwa Netofa;
swahili: Salmoni, Mwahohi; Maharai, Mnetofathi;

english: Heled son of Baanah the Netophathite, Ittai son of Ribai from Gibeah of the Benjamites,
ekegusii: Helebu, mosinto o Baana, korwa Netofa, na Itai, mosinto o Ribai, korwa Gibea, bw’egesaku gia Benjamini.
swahili: Heledi mwana wa Baana, Mnetofathi; Itai mwana wa Ribai kutoka Gibea ya Benyamini;

english: The God of Israel spoke; the Rock of Israel said to me, ‘He who rules the people with justice, who rules in the fear of God,
ekegusii: Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli okwanire, ere oyore egetare ki’Abaisraeli onteebirie: “Oyo okogaambera abanto ase oboronge, oyo okogaambera ase okoiroka Nyasae,
swahili: Mungu wa Israeli alinena, mwamba wa Israeli akaniambia: ‘Mtu anatawala watu kwa haki, wakati anapotawala akiwa na hofu ya Mungu,

english: Benaiah the Pirathonite, Hiddai from the brooks of Gaash,
ekegusii: Benaya korwa Piratoni, na Hidai korwa ase amagoko ang’e na Gaasi;
swahili: Benaya Mpirathoni; Hidai kutoka mabonde ya Gaashi;

english: Abi-albon the Arbathite, Azmaveth the Barhumite,
ekegusii: Abi‐Aliboni korwa Araba na Asimaweti korwa Bahurimu;
swahili: Abi-Alboni, Mwaribathi; Azmawethi, Mbarhumi;

english: Eliahba the Shaalbonite, the sons of Jashen, Jonathan
ekegusii: Eliaba korwa Saalaboni, na basinto ba Yaseni, na Yonathani;
swahili: Eliaba, Mshaalboni; wana wa Yasheni; Yonathani

english: son of Shammah the Hararite, Ahiam son of Sharar the Hararite,
ekegusii: Sama korwa Harari na Ahiamu, mosinto o Sharari, korwa Harari;
swahili: mwana wa Shama, Mharari; Ahiamu mwana wa Sharari, Mharari;

english: Eliphelet son of Ahasbai the Maacathite, Eliam son of Ahithophel the Gilonite,
ekegusii: Elifeleti, mosinto bw’Ahasibai, omonto korwa Maaka; Eliamu, mosinto bw’Ahitofeli, korwa Gilo;
swahili: Elifeleti mwana wa Ahasbai, Mmaakathi; Eliamu mwana wa Ahithofeli, Mgiloni;

english: Hezro the Carmelite, Paarai the Arbite,
ekegusii: Hesiro korwa Karimeli na Paarai korwa Ariba;
swahili: Hezro, Mkarmeli; Paarai, Mwarbi;

english: Igal son of Nathan of Zobah, Bani the Gadite,
ekegusii: Igali, mosinto o Nathani, korwa Soba na Bani korwa Gadi;
swahili: Igali mwana wa Nathani kutoka Soba; Bani, Mgadi;

english: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Beerothite, the armor-bearer of Joab son of Zeruiah,
ekegusii: Seleki korwa Amoni na Naharai korwa Beroti, omobogoria ebirwanero bia Yoabu, omomura bw’omokuungu Seruya;
swahili: Seleki, Mwamoni; Naharai, Mbeerothi, aliyekuwa mbeba silaha za Yoabu mwana wa Seruya;

english: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,
ekegusii: Ira na Garebu korwa Itiri;
swahili: Ira, Mwithiri; Garebu, Mwithiri;

english: and Uriah the Hittite. There were thirty-seven in all.
ekegusii: na Uria Omohiti. Bonsi nigo bareenge emerongo etato, na batan’obabere.
swahili: na Uria, Mhiti. Jumla yao wote walikuwa watu thelathini na saba.

english: is like the light of the morning at sunrise of a cloudless dawn, the glistening after the rain on the sprouting grass of the earth.’
ekegusii: nigo anga buna omobaso o mambia ase bare, buna erioba rikobara emambia etari namare. Nigo anga buna obonyansi bogokiina magega embura koyatuure.”
swahili: yeye ni kama mwanga wa asubuhi jua lichomozapo asubuhi isiyo na mawingu, kama mwanga baada ya mvua uchipuzao majani kutoka ardhini.’

english: Is not my house right with God? For He has established with me an everlasting covenant, ordered and secured in every part. Will He not bring about my full salvation and my every desire?
ekegusii: “Inee! Ororeria rw’ane tirori boronge ase Nyasae? Takorete nainche okobwatana gwa kare na kare, okwo korobeirie gotari koonchoka? Inee! Nyasae tagonsesenia na gontooria, naende ang’e aya ’nganetie?
swahili: “Je, si hivyo ilivyo nyumba yangu mbele za Mungu? Je, hajafanya Agano la milele nami, lililopangwa na kuimarishwa kila sehemu? Je, hatanifanya niufurahie wokovu wangu na kunijalia matakwa yangu yote?

english: But the worthless are all like thorns raked aside, for they can never be gathered by hand.
ekegusii: Korende abanto ababe nigo bare buna amagwa atugutire, atari gokunwa namaboko.
swahili: Lakini watu waovu wote watatupwa kando kama miiba, ambayo haikusanywi kwa mkono.

english: The man who touches them must be armed with iron or with the shaft of a spear. The fire burns them to ashes in the place where they lie.” David’s Mighty Men (1 Chronicles 11:10–47)
ekegusii: Omonto takoyakuna otatiga abe obwate ebioma na orotanga rwe riitimo, barabwo ’nabasaambwe n’omorero aroro agwo.” Abarwani chituoni ba Daudi (1 Amg 11:10-41)
swahili: Yeyote agusaye miiba hutumia chombo cha chuma au mpini wa mkuki, nayo huchomwa pale ilipo.” Mashujaa Wa Daudi (1 Nyakati 11:10-41)

english: These are the names of David’s mighty men: Josheb-basshebeth the Tahchemonite was chief of the Three. He wielded his spear against eight hundred men, whom he killed at one time.
