swahili: Siku zako zitakapokwisha nawe ulale pamoja na baba zako, nitainua mzao wako aingie mahali pako, ambaye atatoka viunoni mwako, nami nitauimarisha ufalme wake.

english: He will build a house for My Name, and I will establish the throne of his kingdom forever.
ekegusii: Ere naagaachere erieta riane enyomba, nainche ninkong’ie oborwoti bwaye bobe ne chinguru kogenderera botambe.
swahili: Yeye ndiye atakayejenga nyumba kwa ajili ya Jina langu, nami nitaimarisha kiti cha enzi cha ufalme wake milele.

english: I will be his Father, and he will be My son. When he does wrong, I will discipline him with the rod of men and with the blows of the sons of men.
ekegusii: Inche nimbe ise, nere nabe omwana one. Ekero arakore ebibe nimoe egesusuro nenyimbo na amaakwa aya Mwanyabaanto bakoegwa.
swahili: Nitakuwa baba yake, naye atakuwa mwanangu. Atakapokosea nitamwadhibu kwa fimbo ya wanadamu, kwa adhabu ya kupigwa na wanadamu.

english: But My loving devotion will never be removed from him as I removed it from Saul, whom I moved out of your way.
ekegusii: Korende obwanchani bwane botari koera tinkoborusia ase are buna naborusetie ase Saulo oyio natigeretie korwa ase obosio bwao.
swahili: Lakini upendo wangu kamwe hautaondolewa kwake, kama nilivyouondoa kwa Sauli, niliyemwondoa atoke mbele yako.

english: Your house and kingdom will endure forever before Me, and your throne will be established forever.”
ekegusii: Enyomba yao na oborwoti bwao nigo birakong’igwe bibe ne chinguru ase obosio bwane kare na kare, na ekerogo kiao ki’oborwoti nigo keratenene bokong’u kare na kare.”
swahili: Nyumba yako na ufalme wako utadumu milele mbele zangu, kiti chako cha enzi kitafanywa imara milele.’ ”

english: So Nathan relayed to David all the words of this entire vision. David’s Prayer of Thanksgiving (1 Chronicles 17:16–27)
ekegusii: Nathani agateebia Daudi amang’ana ayio onsi buna ayaigwete na koyarora. Ogoaka ng’a mbuya mono gwa Daudi, na ogosaba kwaye (1 Amg 17:16-27)
swahili: Nathani akamwarifu Daudi maneno yote ya maono haya. Maombi Ya Daudi (1 Nyakati 17:16-27)

english: Then King David went in, sat before the LORD, and said, “Who am I, O Lord GOD, and what is my house, that You have brought me this far?
ekegusii: Erio Daudi omorwoti agasoa akabeera ase obosio bw’Omonene, akabora, “Aye Omonene, inche inki ’ng’isaine, na eamate y’ane inki eisaine, ng’a aye gwankoreire amang’ana amaya iga?
swahili: Ndipo Mfalme Daudi akaingia ndani, akaketi mbele za Bwana, akasema: “Ee Bwana Mwenyezi, mimi ni nani, na jamaa yangu ni nini, hata umenileta mpaka hapa nilipo?

english: And as if this was a small thing in Your eyes, O Lord GOD, You have also spoken about the future of the house of Your servant. Is this Your custom with man, O Lord GOD?
ekegusii: Naende ring’ana eri tiriisaini kende ase ore, aye Omonene. Boigo gwakwanire igoro y’ororeeria rw’ane, inche omosomba oo, na igoro y’ebiaare bigochi‐gocha. Ee, aye Omonene, amang’ana ayio igo kwayakwanire ase Mwanyabaanto.
swahili: Naam, kana kwamba hili halitoshi machoni pako, Ee Bwana Mwenyezi, wewe umenena pia kuhusu siku zijazo za nyumba ya mtumishi wako. Je, hii ndiyo njia yako ya kawaida ya kushughulika na mwanadamu, Ee Bwana Mwenyezi?

english: he said to Nathan the prophet, “Here I am, living in a house of cedar, while the ark of God remains in a tent.”
ekegusii: Erio agateebia Nathani, omobani, “Rora, inche nigo imenyete ase enyomba eagaachire nemecharake korende Esanduki ya Nyasae ero nigo emenyete ime ase eema.”
swahili: akamwambia nabii Nathani, “Mimi hapa, ninaishi katika jumba la kifalme la mierezi, wakati Sanduku la Mungu limebaki katika hema.”

english: What more can David say to You? For You know Your servant, O Lord GOD.
ekegusii: Inche Daudi, inki ndagoteebie naende kobua ayio? Aye Omonene, nigo omanyete inche, omosomba oo.
swahili: “Je, Daudi aweza kukuambia nini zaidi? Kwa maana unamjua mtumishi wako, Ee Bwana Mwenyezi.

english: For the sake of Your word and according to Your own heart, You have accomplished this great thing and revealed it to Your servant.
ekegusii: Ase engencho y’eira yao na koreng’ana nogwancha kwao, aye Omonene, gwankoreire amanene ayio onsi, naende kwayamanyekanirie ase ’nde, inche omosomba oo.
swahili: Kwa ajili ya neno lako na kwa mapenzi yako, umefanya jambo hili kubwa na kulifanya lijulikane na lifahamike kwa mtumishi wako.

english: How great You are, O Lord GOD! For there is none like You, and there is no God but You, according to everything we have heard with our own ears.
ekegusii: Ase ayio, igo ore omonene, aye Omonene! Onde tari onga buna aye, gose Nyasae onde tari, otatiga aye bweka, koreng’ana buna ayio konya twaigure namato aito.
swahili: “Tazama jinsi ulivyo mkuu, Ee Bwana Mwenyezi! Hakuna mwingine kama wewe, wala hakuna Mungu ila wewe, kama vile tulivyosikia kwa masikio yetu wenyewe,

english: And who is like Your people Israel—the one nation on earth whom God went out to redeem as a people for Himself and to make a name for Himself? You performed great and awesome wonders by driving out nations and their gods from before Your people, whom You redeemed for Yourself from Egypt.
ekegusii: Naende ’mbaanto ba gesaku ki bare ase ense bare buna Abaisraeli bao, abwo aye Nyasae kwabooretie babe abanto bao, na igo gwakorire erieta ria’o rimanyekane. Ogakorera abanto bao abwo kwebooreretie korwa Misiri amang’ana amanene, na ay’ogokumia, ekiagera nigo gwaseretie korwa ase bare abanto b’ebisaku amo ne chinyasae chiabo.
swahili: Naye ni nani aliye kama watu wako Israeli, taifa pekee duniani ambalo Mungu alitoka kwenda kulikomboa kwa ajili yake mwenyewe, na kujifanyia jina mwenyewe, kwa kufanya maajabu makubwa na ya kutisha kwa kuwafukuza mataifa na miungu yao mbele ya watu wako, ambao uliwakomboa kutoka Misri?

english: For You have established Your people Israel as Your very own forever, and You, O LORD, have become their God.
ekegusii: Aye gwekoreire abanto bao Abaisraeli babe abanto bao kare na kare, naye Omonene kwabeire Nyasae obo.
swahili: Umeimarisha watu wako Israeli hasa kama watu wako mwenyewe milele, nawe, Ee Bwana, umekuwa Mungu wao.

english: And now, O LORD God, confirm forever the word You have spoken concerning Your servant and his house. Do as You have promised,
ekegusii: “Gaki bono, Omonene Nyasae, ikerania onsi aya kwariete eira igoro y’ane na ase ororeria rw’ane, na okore aya gwateebete ng’a nokore,
swahili: “Basi sasa, Bwana, ukaitimize ahadi uliyosema kuhusu mtumishi wako na nyumba yake milele. Fanya kama ulivyoahidi,

english: so that Your name will be magnified forever when it is said, ‘The LORD of Hosts is God over Israel.’ And the house of Your servant David will be established before You.
ekegusii: erinde erieta ria’o ritogigwe kare na kare. Erio abanto bariatore botambe, bagoteeba: Omonene bw’Emegaanda, nere Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli. Ase enchera eyio enyomba y’omosomba oo, inche Daudi, ekong’igwe ase obosio bwao.
swahili: ili kwamba jina lako litukuke milele. Ndipo watu watasema, ‘ Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote ni Mungu juu ya Israeli!’ Nayo nyumba ya mtumishi wako Daudi itakuwa imara mbele zako.

english: For You, O LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, have revealed this to Your servant when You said, ‘I will build a house for you.’ Therefore Your servant has found the courage to offer this prayer to You.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene bw’Emegaanda, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, kwang’orokeirie inche, omosomba oo, aya onsi, kogoteeba: Ninkoagaachere enyomba. Ase ayio inche, omosomba oo, nabeire noboremu ase enkoro y’ane kogosaba ogosaba oko.
swahili: “Ee Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, Mungu wa Israeli, umelifunua hili kwa mtumishi wako, ukisema, ‘Nitakujengea nyumba.’ Hivyo mtumishi wako amepata ujasiri kukuletea dua hii.

english: And now, O Lord GOD, You are God! Your words are true, and You have promised this goodness to Your servant.
ekegusii: “Na bono, aye Omonene, aye naye Nyasae, na amang’ana ao naro ekeene, na kwandiereire inche, omosomba oo, eira ng’a onkorere ring’ana eri rigiya.
swahili: Ee Bwana Mwenyezi, wewe ndiwe Mungu! Maneno yako ndiyo kweli, nawe umemwahidi mtumishi wako mambo haya mazuri.

english: Now therefore, may it please You to bless the house of Your servant, that it may continue forever before You. For You, O Lord GOD, have spoken, and with Your blessing the house of Your servant will be blessed forever.”
ekegusii: Gaki boono, koranche osesenie enyomba y’ane, inche omosomba oo, erinde egenderere kare na kare ase obosio bwao. Aye Omonene, kwariete eira eyio. Ase igo enyomba y’ane, inche omosomba oo, esesenigwe kare na kare nogosesenigwa kwao.”
swahili: Sasa naomba uwe radhi kuibariki nyumba ya mtumishi wako, ili idumu mbele zako milele, kwa maana wewe, Ee Bwana Mwenyezi, umesema, na kwa baraka zako nyumba ya mtumishi wako itaendelea kubarikiwa milele.”

english: And Nathan replied to the king, “Go and do all that is in your heart, for the LORD is with you.”
ekegusii: Nathani agateebia omorwoti, “Geenda okore ande onsi ayare ase ebirengererio biao, ekiagera Omonene nigo are amo naye.”
swahili: Nathani akamjibu mfalme, “Lolote ulilo nalo moyoni, endelea ukalifanye, kwa maana Bwana yu pamoja nawe.”

english: But that night the word of the LORD came to Nathan, saying,
ekegusii: Korende ase obotuko obwo, ring’ana ri’Omonene rigaacha ase Nathani, rikamoteebia,
swahili: Usiku ule neno la Bwana likamjia Nathani, kusema:

english: “Go and tell My servant David that this is what the LORD says: Are you the one to build for Me a house to dwell in?
ekegusii: “Geenda oteebie Daudi, omosomba one, ng’a inche Omonene nigo ngoteeba iga: Inee! Nong’agaachere enyomba ndamenye imeo?
swahili: “Nenda ukamwambie mtumishi wangu Daudi, ‘Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana: Je, ewe ndiwe wa kunijengea mimi nyumba ili nikae ndani yake?

english: For I have not dwelt in a house from the day I brought the Israelites up out of Egypt until this day, but I have moved about with a tent as My dwelling.
ekegusii: Korwa engaki eria nang’anyetie Abaisraeli korwa Misiri goika rituko ria reero inche tinana komenya ime ase enyomba, korende nabeire ’nkogeenda aande onsi imenyete ase eema.
swahili: Sijakaa ndani ya nyumba tangu siku niliyowaleta Waisraeli kutoka Misri hadi leo. Nimekuwa nikitembea kutoka mahali pamoja hadi mahali pengine ndani ya hema kama makao yangu.

english: In all My journeys with all the Israelites, have I ever asked any of the leaders I appointed to shepherd My people Israel, ‘Why haven’t you built Me a house of cedar?’
ekegusii: Aase aande onsi nabeire ’nkona‐kogeenda amo n’Abaisraeli, tinana koboria mogaambi onde bw’Abaisraeli, oyo nabeegete akaba omorisia bw’abaanto bane, nase ki otang’agaachereti obomenyo bw’emecharake.
swahili: Popote nilipotembea pamoja na Waisraeli wote, je, nimewahi kumwambia kiongozi wao yeyote niliyemwamuru kuwachunga watu wangu Israeli, “Kwa nini hujanijengea nyumba ya mierezi?” ’

english: Now then, you are to tell My servant David that this is what the LORD of Hosts says: I took you from the pasture, from following the flock, to be the ruler over My people Israel.
ekegusii: “Gaki bono naende kwana n’omosomba one Daudi, omoteebie amang’ana aya: Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo agoteeba iga: Nigo nakorusetie korwa ase oborisia aase kware gotunyana ching’ondi, ’ngakobeeka okaba omogambi bw’abaanto bane Abaisraeli.
swahili: “Sasa basi, mwambie mtumishi wangu Daudi, ‘Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote: Nilikutoa wewe kutoka machungani na kutoka kuandama kundi la kondoo na mbuzi ili kuwaongoza watu wangu Israeli.

english: I have been with you wherever you have gone, and I have cut off all your enemies from before you. Now I will make for you a name like the greatest in the land.
ekegusii: Nigo n’are kogeenda amo naye aande onsi ase kware kogeenda na kobaseeria gochia aare ababisa bao korwa ase obosio bwao. Ninkore erieta ria’o ribe rinene, buna amarieta y’abanto bande bare abanene ase ense.
swahili: Nimekuwa pamoja nawe popote ulipokwenda, nami nimekuondolea mbali adui zako wote mbele yako. Basi nitalifanya jina lako kuwa kuu kama majina ya watu walio wakuu sana duniani.

english: Some time later, David defeated the Philistines, subdued them, and took Metheg-ammah from the hand of the Philistines.
ekegusii: Magega y’ayio Daudi akarwania Abafirisiti, akababua, akabua nomochie obo omonene akayobeeka inse y’obogaambi bwaye.
swahili: Baada ya muda, Daudi akawashinda Wafilisti na kuwatiisha, naye akautwaa Metheg-Amma kutoka mikononi mwa Wafilisti.

english: he sent his son Joram to greet King David and bless him for fighting and defeating Hadadezer, who had been at war with Toi. Joram brought with him articles of silver and gold and bronze,
ekegusii: agatoma Yoramu, momura oye, ase omorwoti Daudi amokwanie na komosesenia, ekiagera ere konya arwanirie Hadadeseri omobuire. Hadadeseri nigo abeete okona‐korwania Toi. Boigo Yoramu akairera Daudi ebinto bi’etaabu, na ebi’efeta, na ebi’etai.
swahili: akamtuma mwanawe Yoramu kwa Mfalme Daudi kumsalimu na kumpongeza kwa ushindi wake katika vita dhidi ya Hadadezeri, kwa kuwa Hadadezeri alikuwa amepigana vita na Tou. Yoramu akamletea Daudi vyombo vya fedha, dhahabu na shaba.

english: and King David dedicated these to the LORD, along with the silver and gold he had dedicated from all the nations he had subdued—
ekegusii: Ebinto ebio omorwoti Daudi akabiatananera Omonene, buna akorete ne chitaai ne chitaabu chiria arusetie korwa ase abanto b’ebisaku biria abuete:
swahili: Mfalme Daudi akaviweka vifaa hivi wakfu kwa Bwana, kama vile alivyokuwa amefanya kwa fedha na dhahabu kutoka kwa mataifa yote aliyokuwa ameyashinda:

english: from Edom and Moab, from the Ammonites and Philistines and Amalekites, and from the spoil of Hadadezer son of Rehob, king of Zobah.
ekegusii: Abaedomu, na Abamoabu, na Abaamoni, na Abafirisiti, na Abaameleki. Boigo agaatananera Omonene ebisakorwa arusetie korwa ase Hadadeseri, mosinto o Rehobu, omorwoti o Soba.
swahili: yaani Edomu, Moabu, Waamoni, Wafilisti na Waamaleki. Pia akaweka wakfu nyara alizoteka kutoka kwa Hadadezeri mwana wa Rehobu, mfalme wa Soba.

english: And David made a name for himself when he returned from striking down eighteen thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt.
ekegusii: Daudi akenyorera erieta rinene ekero arenge koirana, gaitire Abaedomu chilifu ikomi na isano’isato (18,000) ase Riranya ri’Omonyo.
swahili: Naye Daudi akapata sifa baada ya kurudi kutoka kuwaua Waedomu 18,000 katika Bonde la Chumvi.

english: He placed garrisons throughout Edom, and all the Edomites were subject to David. So the LORD made David victorious wherever he went. David’s Officers (1 Chronicles 18:14–17)
ekegusii: Daudi akabeeka abarwani aande onsi ase egati y’Abaedomu, na barabwo bonsi bakaba abasomba ba Daudi, n’Omonene akaa Daudi obobui aande onsi ase arenge kogeenda korwana.
swahili: Akaweka kambi za askari walinzi katika Edomu yote, nao Waedomu wakawa chini ya Daudi. Bwana alimpatia Daudi ushindi kila alipokwenda. Maafisa Wa Daudi

english: Thus David reigned over all Israel and administered justice and righteousness for all his people:
ekegusii: Bono Daudi akaba okogaambera Abaisraeli bonsi, akaba ogokorera abanto baye bonsi oboronge na ekeene.
swahili: Daudi akatawala Israeli yote, akitenda lililo haki na sawa kwa watu wake wote.

english: Joab son of Zeruiah was over the army; Jehoshaphat son of Ahilud was the recorder;
ekegusii: Yoabu, omomura bw’omokuungu oria Seruya, nere orenge omochiki bw’emegaanda y’abarwani, na Yehosafati, mosinto bw’Ahiludi, nere orenge omoriki bw’amang’ana are gokoreka.
swahili: Yoabu mwana wa Seruya alikuwa jemadari wa jeshi; Yehoshafati mwana wa Ahiludi alikuwa mweka kumbukumbu;

english: Zadok son of Ahitub and Ahimelech son of Abiathar were priests; Seraiah was the scribe;
ekegusii: Zadoki, mosinto bw’Ahitubu, na Ahimeleki, mosinto bw’Abiatari, nabwo barenge abakuani, na Seraya nere orenge omoriki;
swahili: Sadoki mwana wa Ahitubu na Ahimeleki mwana wa Abiathari walikuwa makuhani; Seraya alikuwa mwandishi;

english: Benaiah son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and Pelethites; and David’s sons were priestly leaders.
ekegusii: Benaya, mosinto o Yehoyada, nere orenge omoteneneri bw’Abakereti, na Abapeleti, na basinto ba Daudi nigo barenge Abakuani nabwo barenge abasemia b’oborwoti.
swahili: Benaya mwana wa Yehoyada alikuwa msimamizi wa Wakerethi na Wapelethi; nao wana wa Daudi walikuwa washauri wa mfalme.

english: David also defeated the Moabites, made them lie down on the ground, and measured them off with a cord. He measured off with two lengths those to be put to death, and with one length those to be spared. So the Moabites became subject to David and brought him tribute.
ekegusii: Naende akabua Abamoabu. Akabachiika barare inse ase chindwaro. Erio akarengia chindwaro ibere chi’abaanto, agachiika abwo baitwe bakwe, na abanto b’orwaro oromo agachiika batigwe babe moyo. Bono Abamoabu bakaba abasomba ba Daudi bakaba bakomorentera ebango.
swahili: Pia Daudi akawashinda Wamoabu. Akawafanya walale chini kwa mstari akawapima kwa urefu wa kamba. Kila alipopima urefu wa hiyo kamba mara mbili hilo kundi waliuawa na alipopima mara ya tatu aliwaacha hai. Kwa hiyo Wamoabu wakawa chini ya Daudi nao wakamletea kodi.

english: David also defeated Hadadezer son of Rehob, king of Zobah, who had marched out to restore his dominion along the Euphrates River.
ekegusii: Naende Daudi akabua Hadadeseri mosinto o Rehobu, omorwoti o Soba, ekero ere agendete kogareyia obogaambi bwaye gochia ase orooche rw’Eufarati.
swahili: Zaidi ya hayo, Daudi akapigana na Hadadezeri mwana wa Rehobu, mfalme wa Soba, alipokwenda kurudisha tena utawala wake kwenye eneo la Mto Frati.

english: David captured from him a thousand chariots, seven thousand charioteers, and twenty thousand foot soldiers, and he hamstrung all the horses except a hundred he kept for the chariots.
ekegusii: Daudi agoosa abariini chibarasi elifu eyemo, na amagana atan’abere (1,700), na abarwani abaare kogendera amagoro chilifu emerongo ebere (20,000). Erio akabutora chibarasi chinteng’e, korende agatiga chibarasi rigana erimo chibe chikong’usa chigari.
swahili: Daudi akateka magari yake ya vita 1,000, askari wapanda farasi 7,000 na askari 20,000 watembeao kwa miguu. Daudi akawakata wale farasi wote wakokotao magari mishipa ya miguu, isipokuwa farasi 100 hakuwakata.

english: When the Arameans of Damascus came to help King Hadadezer of Zobah, David struck down twenty-two thousand men.
ekegusii: Na ekero Abasiiria ba Damesiki baachete gokoonya Hadadeseri, omorwoti o Soba, Daudi akabarwania, agaita abanto chilifu emerongo ebere na ibere (22,000).
swahili: Waaramu wa Dameski walipokuja kumsaidia Hadadezeri mfalme wa Soba, Daudi akawashambulia na kuwaua 22,000 miongoni mwao.

english: Then he placed garrisons in Aram of Damascus, and the Arameans became subject to David and brought him tribute. So the LORD made David victorious wherever he went.
ekegusii: Erio akabeeka abarwani ase egati y’Abasiiria agwo Damesiki, na Abasiiria abwo bakaba abasomba ba Daudi bakaba bakomorentera ebango. Omonene akaa Daudi obobui aande onsi ase are kogeenda korwana.
swahili: Daudi akaweka askari walinzi katika ufalme wa Waaramu huko Dameski, nao Waaramu wakawa watumwa wake na kumlipa ushuru. Bwana akampa Daudi ushindi kote alipokwenda.

english: And David took the gold shields that belonged to the officers of Hadadezer and brought them to Jerusalem.
ekegusii: Daudi agasakora chinguba chi’echitaabu, echio abasomba ba Hadadeseri babogoretie, agachiira Yerusalemu.
swahili: Daudi akazitwaa ngao za dhahabu zilizokuwa za maafisa wa Hadadezeri na kuzileta Yerusalemu.

english: And from Betah and Berothai, cities of Hadadezer, King David took a large amount of bronze.
ekegusii: Naende omorwoti Daudi akaira chitaai chinyinge mono korwa Bera na Berotai, emechie Hadadeseri arenge kogaambera.
swahili: Kutoka miji ya Beta na Berothai, iliyokuwa miji ya Hadadezeri, Mfalme Daudi akatwaa shaba nyingi sana.

english: When King Toi of Hamath heard that David had defeated the entire army of Hadadezer,
ekegusii: Toi, omorwoti o Hamati, agachia koigwa ng’a Daudi obuire abarwani bonsi ba Hadadeseri,
swahili: Tou, mfalme wa Hamathi, aliposikia kwamba Daudi amelishinda jeshi lote la Hadadezeri,

english: Then David asked, “Is there anyone left from the house of Saul to whom I can show kindness for the sake of Jonathan?”
ekegusii: Rituko erimo Daudi akabooria, “Inee! Monto onde natigarete ase enka ya Saulo inyare komokorera amaya ase engencho ya Yonathani?”
swahili: Daudi akauliza, “Je, hakuna mtu hata mmoja wa nyumba ya Sauli aliyebaki ambaye naweza kumtendea wema kwa ajili ya Yonathani?”

english: You and your sons and servants are to work the ground for him and bring in the harvest, so that your master’s grandson may have food to eat. But Mephibosheth, your master’s grandson, is always to eat at my table.” Now Ziba had fifteen sons and twenty servants.
ekegusii: Aye, amo n’abana bao na abasomba bao ’mobe mokomoremera emegondo. Norentere omoochokoro bw’omonene oo okwama korwa mogondo, erinde anyore endagera, korende Mefiboseti omonyene, omoochokoro bw’omonene oo, nigo arabe okoragera ase emesa y’ane botambe.” Siba nigo abwate abamura ikomi na batano na abasomba emerongo ebere.
swahili: Wewe, wanao na watumishi wako mtamlimia mashamba Mefiboshethi na kumletea mavuno, ili kwamba mwana wa bwana wako apate mahitaji yake. Naye Mefiboshethi mwana wa bwana wako atakula chakula mezani pangu daima.” (Siba alikuwa na wana kumi na watano, na watumishi ishirini.)

english: And Ziba said to the king, “Your servant will do all that my lord the king has commanded.” So Mephibosheth ate at David’s table like one of the king’s own sons.
ekegusii: Erio Siba akairaneria omorwoti, “Inche omosomba oo ninkore ayio onsi gwachiikire.” Ase igo Mefiboseti akaba okoragera ase emesa ya Daudi Omonene oye, akaba buna oyomo bw’abana b’omorwoti.
swahili: Ndipo Siba akamwambia mfalme, “Mtumishi wako atafanya chochote bwana wangu mfalme atakachoagiza mtumishi wake kufanya.” Basi Mefiboshethi akala chakula mezani pa Daudi kama mmoja wa wana wa mfalme.

english: And Mephibosheth had a young son named Mica, and all who dwelt in the house of Ziba were servants of Mephibosheth.
ekegusii: Mefiboseti nabwate omwana omomura ore korokwa Mika. Abanto bonsi abarengeo Siba bakaba abasomba ba Mefiboseti.
swahili: Mefiboshethi alikuwa na mwanawe mdogo aliyeitwa Mika, nao watu wote wa nyumba ya Siba walikuwa watumishi wa Mefiboshethi.

english: So Mephibosheth lived in Jerusalem, because he always ate at the king’s table, and he was lame in both feet.
ekegusii: Mefiboseti akaba okomenya Yerusalemu, ekiagera nigo arenge koragera ase emesa y’omorwoti. Ere nigo aremarete amagoro aye onsi abere.
swahili: Naye Mefiboshethi akaishi huko Yerusalemu, kwa sababu daima alikula mezani pa mfalme, naye alikuwa kiwete miguu yote.

english: And there was a servant of Saul’s family named Ziba. They summoned him to David, and the king inquired, “Are you Ziba?” “I am your servant,” he replied.
ekegusii: Narengeo omosomba oyomo bw’enyomba ya Saulo, orenge korokwa Siba. Abanto bakamorangeria ageende ase Daudi. Omorwoti akamobooria, “N’aye Siba?” Ere akamoiraneria, “Ee, ninche omosomba oo.”
swahili: Basi palikuwepo mtumishi wa nyumba ya Sauli aliyeitwa Siba. Wakamwita aje mbele ya Daudi, naye mfalme akamwambia, “Wewe ndiwe Siba?” Akamjibu, “Naam, mimi ndiye mtumishi wako.”

english: So the king asked, “Is there anyone left of Saul’s family to whom I can show the kindness of God?” Ziba answered, “There is still Jonathan’s son, who is lame in both feet.”
ekegusii: Naende omorwoti akamobooria, “Inee! Monto onde natigarete ase enka ya Saulo inyare komokorera obuya bwa Nyasae?” Siba akamoiraneria, “Ee, nareo omonto oyomo, mosinto o Yonathani, ore ekerema.”
swahili: Mfalme akauliza, “Je, hakuna yeyote ambaye amebaki wa nyumba ya Sauli ninayeweza kumwonyesha wema wa Mungu?” Siba akamjibu mfalme, “Bado yupo mwana wa Yonathani, yeye ni kiwete miguu yote.”

english: “Where is he?” replied the king. And Ziba said, “Indeed, he is in Lo-debar at the house of Machir son of Ammiel.”
ekegusii: Omorwoti akamobooria, “Ng’ai akare?” Siba akamoiraneria, “Nigo akare o Makiri, mosinto bw’Amieli, aaria Lo‐Debari.”
swahili: Mfalme akauliza, “Yuko wapi?” Siba akajibu, “Yuko nyumbani kwa Makiri mwana wa Amieli huko Lo-Debari.”

english: So King David had him brought from the house of Machir son of Ammiel in Lo-debar.
ekegusii: Erio omorwoti agatoma abanto bagachia komwoyia korwa o Makiri, mosinto bw’Amieli, aaria Lo‐Debari.
swahili: Basi Mfalme Daudi akamtaka aletwe kutoka Lo-Debari, kutoka nyumbani kwa Makiri mwana wa Amieli.

english: And when Mephibosheth son of Jonathan, the son of Saul, came to David, he fell facedown in reverence. Then David said, “Mephibosheth!” “I am your servant,” he replied.
ekegusii: Ekero Mefiboseti, mosinto o Yonathani o Saulo, achete ase Daudi, akagwa inse, maumama ase okoorokia amasikani. Daudi akamorangeria, “Mefiboseti!” Ere agaitaba, “Nao inde aa, inche omosomba oo!”
swahili: Mefiboshethi mwana wa Yonathani, mwana wa Sauli, alipofika kwa Daudi, akainama kumpa mfalme heshima. Daudi akamwita, “Mefiboshethi!” Mefiboshethi akajibu, “Ndimi mtumishi wako.”

english: “Do not be afraid,” said David, “for surely I will show you kindness for the sake of your father Jonathan. I will restore to you all the land of your grandfather Saul, and you will always eat at my table.”
ekegusii: Daudi akamoteebia, “Toondoka, ekiagera ningokorere amaya ase engencho ya Yonathani iso. Ninkoiranerie emegondo yonsi ya Saulo, sokoro yao, naye n’obe gokoragera ase emesa y’ane botambe.”
swahili: Daudi akamwambia, “Usiogope, kwa maana hakika nitakutendea wema kwa ajili ya baba yako Yonathani. Nitakurudishia ardhi yote iliyokuwa mali ya Sauli baba yako, nawe daima utakula chakula mezani pangu.”

english: Mephibosheth bowed down and said, “What is your servant, that you should show regard for a dead dog like me?”
ekegusii: Mefiboseti agatung’ama inse naende, akabora, “Inche inde buna esese ekwete. Ninki ing’isaine orankorere amaya buna ayio?”
swahili: Mefiboshethi akasujudu akasema, “Mimi mtumishi wako ni nini hata uangalie mbwa mfu kama mimi?”

english: Then the king summoned Saul’s servant Ziba and said to him, “I have given to your master’s grandson all that belonged to Saul and to all his house.
ekegusii: Erio omorwoti akarangeria Siba, omosomba o Saulo, akamoteebia, “Ebinto bionsi ebiarenge bia Saulo, na bionsi ebia nyomba mw’aye, nabieire omoochokoro bw’omonene oo.
swahili: Ndipo mfalme akamwita Siba mtumishi wa Sauli na kumwambia, “Nimempa mwana wa bwana wako kila kitu kilichokuwa mali ya Sauli na jamaa yake.

english: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, To the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:
ekegusii: Korwa ase Paulo amo na Silivano na Timotheo gochia ase abanto b’ekanisa y’Atesaloniki, abamore ase Nyasae Tata oito n’Omonene oito Yeso Kristo:
swahili: Paulo, Silvano na Timotheo: Kwa kanisa la Wathesalonike mlio katika Mungu Baba yetu na Bwana Yesu Kristo:

english: on the day He comes to be glorified in His saints and regarded with wonder by all who have believed, including you who have believed our testimony.
ekegusii: ekero arache ase rituko riria, erinde atogigwe ase egati y’abachenu baye, na gokumigwa ase egati ya bonsi abamwegenire, ekiagera mwegenire oborori bwaito obo twabarenteire.
swahili: siku hiyo atakapokuja kutukuzwa katika watakatifu wake na kustaajabiwa miongoni mwa wote walioamini. Ninyi pia mtakuwa miongoni mwa hawa kwa sababu mliamini ushuhuda wetu kwenu.

english: To this end, we always pray for you, that our God will count you worthy of His calling, and that He will powerfully fulfill your every good desire and work of faith,
ekegusii: Ase ayio, nigo tokobasabera botambe, erio Nyasae oito ababare ng’a mwagweneire okorangeria kwaye. Ere aikeranie kera okogania kw’obuya, na kera emeremo y’okwegena, ase okobua kwaye,
swahili: Kwa sababu hii, tunawaombea ninyi bila kukoma, ili Mungu apate kuwahesabu kuwa mnastahili wito wake na kwamba kwa uwezo wake apate kutimiza kila kusudi lenu jema na kila tendo linaloongozwa na imani yenu.

english: so that the name of our Lord Jesus will be glorified in you, and you in Him, according to the grace of our God and of the Lord Jesus Christ.
ekegusii: erinde erieta ri’Omonene oito Yeso ritogigwe ime yaino, na inwe ime yaye, koreng’ana nobuya bwa Nyasae oito, na Omonene Yeso Kristo.
swahili: Tunaomba hivi ili Jina la Bwana wetu Yesu lipate kutukuzwa ndani yenu, nanyi ndani yake, kulingana na neema ya Mungu wetu na Bwana Yesu Kristo.

english: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
ekegusii: Obuya bobe ase more na omorembe bikorwa ase Nyasae Tata oito, na ase Omonene Yeso Kristo. Ekiina ase ekero ki’ogocha gwa Kristo
swahili: Neema na amani itokayo kwa Mungu Baba na Bwana Yesu Kristo iwe nanyi. Shukrani Na Maombi

english: We are obligated to thank God for you all the time, brothers, as is fitting, because your faith is growing more and more, and your love for one another is increasing.
ekegusii: Abaminto, netogwenerete komoakera Nyasae ng’a mbuya mono botambe ase engencho yaino, buna ere boronge, ekiagera okwegena kwaino gwakiinire mono, na obwanchani bwa kera oyomo oino ase oyonde nigo bogendererete komentekana.
swahili: Ndugu, imetubidi kumshukuru Mungu kwa ajili yenu siku zote, kama ulivyo wajibu wetu, kwa sababu imani yenu inakua zaidi na zaidi na upendo wa kila mmoja wenu alio nao kwa mwenzake unazidi kuongezeka.

english: That is why we boast among God’s churches about your perseverance and faith in the face of all the persecution and affliction you are enduring. Christ’s Coming
ekegusii: Ase ayio, na intwe abanyene nigo togwetogia ase engencho yaino ase chikanisa chia Nyasae, ase engencho y’oboremereria bwaino, na okwegena more nakwo ase ogochandwa kwaino gwonsi, na emechando eye moremereretie.
swahili: Ndiyo sababu miongoni mwa makanisa ya Mungu, tunajivuna kuhusu saburi yenu na imani mliyo nayo katika mateso yote na dhiki mnazostahimili.

english: All this is clear evidence of God’s righteous judgment. And so you will be counted worthy of the kingdom of God, for which you are suffering.
ekegusii: Eke nakio ekiorokererio, ng’a ekiina kia Nyasae mboronge kere. Erio mobarwe koba abamwagweneire oborwoti bwa Nyasae, ekiagera ase engencho y’obwo mwachandirwe.
swahili: Haya yote ni uthibitisho kwamba hukumu ya Mungu ni ya haki, na kwa sababu hiyo ninyi mtahesabiwa kwamba mnastahili kuwa wa Ufalme wa Mungu, mnaoteswa kwa ajili wake.

english: After all, it is only right for God to repay with affliction those who afflict you,
ekegusii: Naki Nyasae ororire boronge kobaakana emechando baria bakobachanda inwe,
swahili: Mungu ni mwenye haki: yeye atawalipa mateso wale wawatesao ninyi

english: and to grant relief to you who are oppressed and to us as well. This will take place when the Lord Jesus is revealed from heaven with His mighty angels
ekegusii: na kobaa inwe abamwachandirwe ogotimokigwa amo naintwe. Aya nigo arakoreke ekero Omonene Yeso agocha koorokigwa korwa igoro amo nabamalaika n’okobua kwaye ase ekebemberi ki’omorero,
swahili: na kuwapa ninyi mnaoteseka raha pamoja na sisi, wakati Bwana Yesu atakapodhihirishwa kutoka mbinguni katika mwali wa moto pamoja na malaika wake wenye nguvu.

english: in blazing fire, inflicting vengeance on those who do not know God and do not obey the gospel of our Lord Jesus.
ekegusii: na kobaakana egesiomba abwo batamomanyeti Nyasae, na bataigwereti enchiri y’Omonene oito Yeso.
swahili: Atawaadhibu wale wasiomjua Mungu na ambao hawakuitii Injili ya Bwana wetu Yesu.

english: They will suffer the penalty of eternal destruction, separated from the presence of the Lord and the glory of His might,
ekegusii: Barabwo nabanyore egesusuro ki’ogosareka, naende nabaatananwe korwa ase obosio bw’Omonene kare na kare, na korwa ase obonene bw’okobua kwaye,
swahili: Wataadhibiwa kwa uangamivu wa milele na kutengwa na uso wa Bwana na utukufu wa uweza wake,

english: Now concerning the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ and our being gathered together to Him, we ask you, brothers,
ekegusii: Bono baminto, ase amang’ana y’ogocha kw’Omonene oito Yeso Kristo, na ogosangererekana gwaito ase obosio bwaye, twababoririe,
swahili: Ndugu, kuhusu kuja kwake Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo na kukusanyika kwetu pamoja mbele zake, tunawasihi,

english: and with every wicked deception directed against those who are perishing, because they refused the love of the truth that would have saved them.
ekegusii: na ase obong’ainereria bwonsi bw’ogotaba boronge ase abwo bagosira, ekiagera bangete konyora ekeene, na kogiancha erinde banyare gotoorigwa.
swahili: na kila aina ya uovu kwa wale wanaoangamia kwa sababu walikataa kuipenda kweli wapate kuokolewa.

english: For this reason God will send them a powerful delusion so that they believe the lie,
ekegusii: Ase ayio, Nyasae nabatomere obotantanu bw’echinguru, abakore begene ayare ay’oborimo,
swahili: Kwa sababu hii, Mungu ameruhusu watawaliwe na nguvu ya udanganyifu, ili waendelee kuamini uongo,

english: in order that judgment may come upon all who have disbelieved the truth and delighted in wickedness. Stand Firm
ekegusii: erinde bagambigwe bonsi abwo bateegenete ekeene, korende baare kwegokia ase ayatari ay’oboronge. Mwachorirwe ase okonyora ogotooreka
swahili: na wahukumiwe wote ambao hawakuiamini ile kweli, bali wamefurahia uovu. Simameni Imara

english: But we should always thank God for you, brothers who are loved by the Lord, because God has chosen you from the beginning to be saved by the sanctification of the Spirit and by faith in the truth.
ekegusii: Korende baminto, netogwenerete koiraneria Nyasae ng’a mbuya mono botambe ase engencho yaino, inwe abamwanchire n’Omonene, ekiagera Nyasae abachorete korwa omochakano, erinde monyore ogotooreka ase ogochenwa kogokorwa n’Omoika, na kwegena ekeene.
swahili: Lakini imetupasa sisi kumshukuru Mungu daima kwa ajili yenu, ndugu mpendwao na Bwana, kwa sababu Mungu aliwachagua ninyi tangu mwanzo ili mwokolewe kwa kutakaswa na Roho kwa kuiamini kweli.

english: To this He called you through our gospel, so that you may share in the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.
ekegusii: Ase aya naro abarangereretie inwe goetera ase enchiri eye twabaranderetie, erinde monyore obonene bw’Omonene oito Yeso Kristo.
swahili: Kwa kusudi hili Mungu aliwaita kwa njia ya kuhubiri kwetu Injili, ili mpate kushiriki katika utukufu wa Bwana Yesu Kristo.

english: Therefore, brothers, stand firm and cling to the traditions we taught you, whether by speech or by letter.
ekegusii: Ase igo baminto, tenena bokong’u, na mobwate chingencho echio twaborokereretie, onye nase amang’ana y’emenwa yaito, gose nase riruube riaito.
swahili: Hivyo basi, ndugu wapendwa, simameni imara na myashike sana yale mafundisho tuliyowapa ikiwa ni kwa maneno ya kinywa au kwa barua.

english: Now may our Lord Jesus Christ Himself and God our Father, who by grace has loved us and given us eternal comfort and good hope,
ekegusii: Bono Omonene oito Yeso Kristo omonyene, na Nyasae Tata oito, oyotwanchete na otoete okoremia gwa kare na kare, na ogosemeria okuya ase obuya bwaye,
swahili: Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo mwenyewe na Mungu Baba yetu, aliyetupenda na kwa neema yake akatupatia faraja ya milele na tumaini jema,

english: encourage your hearts and strengthen you in every good word and deed.
ekegusii: aremie chinkoro chiaino, na abakong’ie mokore ayare boronge ase kera ogokora okuya, na amang’ana amaya.
swahili: awafariji mioyo yenu na kuwaimarisha katika kila neno na tendo jema.

english: not to be easily disconcerted or alarmed by any spirit or message or letter seeming to be from us, alleging that the Day of the Lord has already come.
ekegusii: timotengechigwa bwango na gotiga ebirengererio biaino, gose timoichanigwa na moika onde, gose namang’ana, gose ne riruube rigokagwa ng’a nkorwa ase tore riarure, erigoteeba ng’a rituko ri’Omonene riaikire kobao.
swahili: msiyumbishwe kwa urahisi wala msitiwe wasiwasi na roho wala neno au barua inayosemekana kuwa imetoka kwetu, isemayo kwamba siku ya Bwana imekwisha kuwako.

english: Let no one deceive you in any way, for it will not come until the rebellion occurs and the man of lawlessness—the son of destruction—is revealed.
ekegusii: Monto onde tabang’aina ase enchera ende yonsi, ekiagera rituko riria tirigocha ogwatananekana na ogotaigwera gotaracha, na omosaria bw’amachiiko, omwana bw’obosiru, aorokigwe.
swahili: Mtu yeyote na asiwadanganye kwa namna yoyote kwa maana siku ile haitakuja mpaka uasi utokee kwanza, na yule mtu wa kuasi adhihirishwe, yule ambaye amehukumiwa kuangamizwa kabisa.

english: He will oppose and exalt himself above every so-called god or object of worship. So he will seat himself in the temple of God, proclaiming himself to be God.
ekegusii: Ere nomoengereria, omweimokereria igoro omonyene, igoro ya kera egekorokwa Nyasae, na ekegosasimwa. Naende nigo agoikaransa ase Hekalu ya Nyasae, okweraria omonyene ng’a nere Nyasae.
swahili: Yeye atapingana na kujitukuza juu ya kila kitu kiitwacho Mungu au kinachoabudiwa, ili kujiweka juu katika Hekalu la Mungu, akijitangaza mwenyewe kuwa ndiye Mungu.

english: Do you not remember that I told you these things while I was still with you?
ekegusii: Inee! Timware koinyora ng’a ekero narenge amo nainwe inabateebeetie ayio?
swahili: Je, hamkumbuki ya kwamba nilipokuwa pamoja nanyi niliwaambia mambo haya?

english: And you know what is now restraining him, so that he may be revealed at the proper time.
ekegusii: Na bono, erimotangete morimanyete, erio ekero engaki yaye eraike anyare koorokigwa.
swahili: Nanyi sasa mnajua kinachomzuia, ili apate kudhihirishwa wakati wake utakapowadia.

english: For the mystery of lawlessness is already at work, but the one who now restrains it will continue until he is taken out of the way.
ekegusii: Naki obobisi boria bw’ogosaria amachiiko bwachaakire gokora emeremo bono, na oria ore kobotanga bono goika arusigweo.
swahili: Maana ile nguvu ya siri ya uasi tayari inatenda kazi, lakini yule anayeizuia ataendelea kufanya hivyo mpaka atakapoondolewa.

english: And then the lawless one will be revealed, whom the Lord Jesus will slay with the breath of His mouth and annihilate by the majesty of His arrival.
ekegusii: Erio agwo omosaria oria bw’amachiiko aorokigwe, n’Omonene Yeso namoite n’Omoika bw’omonwa oye, na komosiria ase amasase ’okoorokigwa kwaye.
swahili: Hapo ndipo yule mwasi atafunuliwa, ambaye Bwana Yesu atamteketeza kwa pumzi ya kinywa chake na kumwangamiza kabisa kwa utukufu wa kuja kwake.

english: The coming of the lawless one will be accompanied by the working of Satan, with every kind of power, sign, and false wonder,
ekegusii: Ogocha kw’omosaria oria nigo kore ogokora gwa Saitani, naende nkobe nokobua gwonsi, na ebikone, na amakumia y’oborimo,
swahili: Kuja kwa yule mwasi kutaonekana kana kwamba ni kutenda kazi kwake Shetani ambaye hutumia nguvu zote, ishara, maajabu ya uongo,

english: Finally, brothers, pray for us, that the word of the Lord may spread quickly and be held in honor, just as it was with you.
ekegusii: Omoerio, baminto, tosabere erinde ring’ana ri’Omonene rirande na gotogigwa buna riakorire ase egati yaino,
swahili: Hatimaye, ndugu, tuombeeni ili Neno la Bwana lipate kuenea kwa haraka na kuheshimiwa kila mahali, kama vile ilivyokuwa kwenu.

english: For even while we were with you, we gave you this command: “If anyone is unwilling to work, he shall not eat.”
ekegusii: Ekiagera nonya nekero keria twarenge amo nainwe ntwabachiigete ring’ana eri, ng’a onye omonto tarigeti gokora emeremo, taegwa endagera.
swahili: Kwa maana hata tulipokuwa pamoja nanyi, tuliwapa amri kwamba: “Mtu yeyote asiyetaka kufanya kazi, hata kula asile.”

english: Yet we hear that some of you are leading undisciplined lives and accomplishing nothing but being busybodies.
ekegusii: Naki twaigure ng’a mbare abanto ase more bare aboro, batari gokora emeremo, korende nigo bakona‐gotuka amang’ana y’abaanto bande.
swahili: Kwa kuwa tunasikia kwamba baadhi ya watu miongoni mwenu ni wavivu. Hawafanyi kazi bali hujishughulisha na mambo ya wengine.

english: We command and urge such people by our Lord Jesus Christ to begin working quietly to earn their own living.
ekegusii: Nabo abanto banga buna abwo twabachikiire na kobasorora ase Omonene Yeso Kristo, ng’a bakore emeremo ase obotoereru, na koria endagera yabo abanyene.
swahili: Basi watu kama hao tunawaagiza na kuwahimiza katika Bwana Yesu Kristo, kwamba wafanye kazi kwa utulivu kwa ajili ya chakula chao wenyewe.

english: But as for you, brothers, do not grow weary in well-doing.
ekegusii: Korende baminto, timorosa gokora amaya.
swahili: Kwa upande wenu, ndugu, ninyi kamwe msichoke katika kutenda mema.

english: Take note of anyone who does not obey the instructions we have given in this letter. Do not associate with him, so that he may be ashamed.
ekegusii: Onye monto onde bwensi okwanga koigwera ring’ana eri tokwanete ase riruube eri, erusananie korwa ase omonto oyio, na timosanga nere; tiga arore obosooku.
swahili: Ikiwa mtu yeyote hayatii maagizo yetu yaliyoko katika barua hii, mwangalieni sana mtu huyo. Msishirikiane naye, ili apate kuona aibu.

english: Yet do not regard him as an enemy, but warn him as a brother. Signature and Final Greetings (1 Corinthians 16:19–24; Colossians 4:15–18)
ekegusii: Timomobara buna omobisa, korende momokuurere buna oyomino. Amang’ana omoerio
swahili: Lakini msimhesabu kuwa adui, bali mwonyeni kama ndugu. Salamu Za Mwisho

english: Now may the Lord of peace Himself give you peace at all times and in every way. The Lord be with all of you.
ekegusii: Bono Omonene bw’omorembe omonyene abae omorembe ase chingaki chionsi, na ase chinchera chionsi. Omonene abe amo nainwe mwensi.
swahili: Basi, Bwana wa amani mwenyewe awapeni amani nyakati zote na kwa kila njia. Bwana awe nanyi nyote.

english: This greeting is in my own hand—Paul. This is my mark in every letter; it is the way I write.
ekegusii: Oko nogokwania kwane inche Paulo ase okoboko kwane omonyene. Eke nakio ekemanyerio ase kera riruube riane; naboigo nkoriika.
swahili: Mimi, Paulo, ninaandika salamu hizi kwa mkono wangu mwenyewe. Hii ndio alama ya utambulisho katika barua zangu zote. Hivi ndivyo niandikavyo.

english: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with all of you.
ekegusii: Obuya bw’Omonene oito Yeso Kristo bobe amo nainwe mwensi.
swahili: Neema ya Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo iwe nanyi nyote. Amen.

english: And pray that we may be delivered from wicked and evil men; for not everyone holds to the faith.
ekegusii: ng’a totoorigwe korwa ase abanto batari abaronge, na abare ababe, ekiagera tai bonsi bare nokwegena.
swahili: Ombeni pia ili tupate kuokolewa kutokana na watu waovu na wabaya, kwa maana si wote wanaoamini.

english: But the Lord is faithful, and He will strengthen you and guard you from the evil one.
ekegusii: Korende Omonene nomwegenwa, nere orababeeke chinguru na kobarenda korwa ase oria omobe.
swahili: Lakini Bwana ni mwaminifu, naye atawaimarisha ninyi na kuwalinda kutokana na yule mwovu.

english: And we have confidence in the Lord that you are doing and will continue to do what we command.
ekegusii: Ase Omonene ntore nogosemeria igoro yaino, ng’a ngokora more ayatwabachiigete, naende mogenderere koyakora.
swahili: Nasi tuna tumaini katika Bwana ya kuwa mnafanya na mtaendelea kufanya yale tuliyowaagiza.

english: May the Lord direct your hearts into God’s love and Christ’s perseverance. A Warning against Idleness
ekegusii: Omonene atang’ane chinkoro chiaino, erinde momanye obwanchani bwa Nyasae, na oboremereria bwa Kristo. Ogokuurera kw’ogokora emeremo
swahili: Bwana aiongoze mioyo yenu katika upendo wa Mungu na katika saburi ya Kristo. Onyo Dhidi Ya Uvivu

english: Now we command you, brothers, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, to keep away from any brother who leads an undisciplined life that is not in keeping with the tradition you received from us.
ekegusii: Bono baminto, twabachikiire ase erieta ri’Omonene Yeso Kristo, mweatanane korwa ase oyomino oyore omworo, oyotabwateti chingencho echio mweorokereretie korwa ase tore.
swahili: Ndugu, tunawaagiza katika Jina la Bwana Yesu Kristo, jitengeni na kila ndugu ambaye ni mvivu na ambaye haishi kufuatana na maagizo tuliyowapa.

english: For you yourselves know how you ought to imitate us, because we were not undisciplined among you,
ekegusii: Naki inwe abanyene momanyete buna ebagwenerete motwege; titwabeete aboro ekero twarenge amo nainwe,
swahili: Maana ninyi wenyewe mnajua jinsi iwapasavyo kufuata mfano wetu. Sisi hatukuwa wavivu tulipokuwa pamoja nanyi,

english: nor did we eat anyone’s food without paying for it. Instead, in labor and toil, we worked night and day so that we would not be a burden to any of you.
ekegusii: gose titwariete endagera ya monto onde bwensi bosa, totaakaneti, korende nase obokong’u amo nogwechanda togakora emeremo obotuko na omobaso, erinde titoraarereria monto onde oino.
swahili: wala hatukula chakula cha mtu yeyote pasipo kukilipia. Badala yake tulifanya kazi kwa bidii usiku na mchana, ili tusimlemee mtu yeyote miongoni mwenu.

english: Not that we lack this right, but we wanted to offer ourselves as an example for you to imitate.
ekegusii: Tari ng’a eyio tiyatotungetie, korende igo twekorete abanyene koba ekiorokererio ekiya ase more, erinde motwege.
swahili: Tulifanya hivi, si kwa sababu hatukuwa na haki ya kupata msaada kama huo, bali ndio sisi wenyewe tuwe kielelezo.

english: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, according to the promise of life in Christ Jesus,
ekegusii: Korwa ase Paulo, omotomwa o Kristo Yeso ase ogwancha kwa Nyasae, ase engencho y’eira y’obogima bore ase Kristo Yeso,
swahili: Paulo mtume wa Kristo Yesu kwa mapenzi ya Mungu, kulingana na ile ahadi ya uzima uliomo ndani ya Kristo Yesu.

english: And now He has revealed this grace through the appearing of our Savior, Christ Jesus, who has abolished death and illuminated the way to life and immortality through the gospel,
ekegusii: bwaorokigwe bono ase okoorokigwa kw’Omotooria oito Kristo Yeso. Ere agasiria chinguru chi’amakweri, na akarenta obogima na ogotasareka goetera ase enchiri.
swahili: Lakini sasa imefunuliwa kwa kudhihirishwa kwake Mwokozi wetu, Kristo Yesu, ambaye amebatilisha mauti na kuleta uzima na kutokufa kwa njia ya Injili.

english: to which I was appointed as a preacher, an apostle, and a teacher.
ekegusii: Inaki ase enchiri eye nkaragwa koba omoraria, na omotomwa, na omworokia.
swahili: Nami nimewekwa kuwa mhubiri, mtume na mwalimu wa Injili hii.

english: For this reason, even though I suffer as I do, I am not ashamed; for I know whom I have believed, and I am convinced that He is able to guard what I have entrusted to Him for that day. Holding to Sound Teaching
ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio nanyoorire emechando eye. Korende tinkorora obosooku, inaki nimomanyete ere oyonyegenete, naende ninde nobomaene ng’a goika Rituko riria ere nanyare korenda keria angacherete.
swahili: Hii ndiyo sababu ninateseka namna hii, lakini sioni haya kwa maana ninamjua yeye niliyemwamini, na kusadiki ya kuwa anaweza kukilinda kile nilichokiweka amana kwake hadi siku ile.

english: Hold on to the pattern of sound teaching you have heard from me, with the faith and love that are in Christ Jesus.
ekegusii: Bwatia amang’ana ayare ay’obogima, ayakwaigwete korwa ase ’nde, abe ekiorokererio ogotunyana ase okwegena na obwanchani bire ase Kristo Yeso.
swahili: Shika kwa uthabiti kielelezo cha mafundisho yenye uzima yale uliyoyasikia kwangu, pamoja na imani na upendo katika Kristo Yesu.

english: Guard the treasure entrusted to you, with the help of the Holy Spirit who dwells in us.
ekegusii: Renda keria ekiya kwaetwe, okegache, okerende ase chinguru chi’Omoika Omochenu, oyomenyete ime yaito.
swahili: Ilinde ile amana uliyokabidhiwa kwa Roho Mtakatifu akaaye ndani yetu.

english: You know that everyone in the Province of Asia has deserted me, including Phygelus and Hermogenes.
ekegusii: Kwamanyire ng’a bonsi abare Asia bantigire, na ase abwo mbareo Figelo na Hermogene.
swahili: Unajua ya kuwa watu wote katika Asia wameniacha, miongoni mwao wamo Filego na Hermogene.

english: May the Lord grant mercy to the household of Onesiphorus, because he has often refreshed me and was unashamed of my chains.
ekegusii: Omonene abarorere amaabera abwo bare ab’enyomba y’Onesiforo, ekiagera ekero ase ekero nigo are gontimokia, gose t’are korora obosooku ase engencho y’obosibwa bwane.
swahili: Bwana akawahurumie watu wa nyumbani mwa Onesiforo, kwa sababu aliniburudisha mara kwa mara wala hakuionea aibu minyororo yangu.

english: Indeed, when he arrived in Rome, he searched diligently until he found me.
ekegusii: Korende ekero aigete Rumi akandigia nomokia, akanyoora.
swahili: Badala yake, alipokuwa Rumi, alinitafuta kwa bidii mpaka akanipata.

english: May the Lord grant Onesiphorus His mercy on that day. You know very well how much he ministered to me in Ephesus.
ekegusii: Omonene namwanchere anyoore amaabera korwa ase Omonene Rituko riria. Aye kwamanyire buya buna are gokora emeremo emenge aria Efeso.
swahili: Bwana na amjalie kupata rehema zake siku ile! Nawe unajua vyema jinsi alivyonisaidia huko Efeso.

english: To Timothy, my beloved child: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord. Faithfulness under Persecution (Matthew 10:16–25)
ekegusii: gocha ase Timotheo, omwana one omwanchwa: Obuya na amaabera, na omorembe, bikorwa ase Nyasae Tata, na ase Kristo Yeso, Omonene oito. Ogoaka mbuya na kobeka omokia
swahili: Kwa Timotheo, mwanangu mpendwa: Neema, rehema na amani itokayo kwa Mungu Baba, na kwa Kristo Yesu Bwana wetu. Shukrani Na Kutiwa Moyo

english: I thank God, whom I serve with a clear conscience as did my forefathers, as I constantly remember you night and day in my prayers.
ekegusii: Nigo nkomoakera Nyasae ng’a mbuya mono, oyo ngokorera nenkoro etari kongaambia, buna chisokoro chiane chiare gokora, nigo ngokoinyora botambe ase ogosaba kw’ane obotuko na omobaso.
swahili: Ninamshukuru Mungu, ninayemtumikia kwa dhamiri safi, kama walivyofanya baba zangu, ninapokukumbuka usiku na mchana katika maombi yangu.

english: Recalling your tears, I long to see you so that I may be filled with joy.
ekegusii: Ekero nkoinyora amariga ao nigo nkoba namaiga gokorora, erinde ing’ichorwe nomogooko.
swahili: Nikiyakumbuka machozi yako, ninatamani sana kukuona ili nipate kujawa na furaha.

english: I am reminded of your sincere faith, which first dwelt in your grandmother Lois and your mother Eunice, and I am convinced is in you as well.
ekegusii: Ning’inyorete okwegena ore nakorokwo, gotari nobong’ainereria, okwo kwareenge ritang’ani ase nyagokoro Lois na ase nyoko Yunuke, na inche ninde nobomaene ng’a naye nokobwate boigo.
swahili: Nimekuwa nikiikumbuka imani yako ya kweli, waliokuwa nayo bibi yako Loisi na mama yako Eunike na ambayo mimi ninasadiki sasa wewe pia unayo.

english: For this reason I remind you to fan into flame the gift of God, which is in you through the laying on of my hands.
ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio ngokoinyoria, oigererie ekeegwa ekiaruure ase Nyasae, ekere ime yao, ekio kwaetwe ekero nakobeekerete amaboko aane,
swahili: Kwa sababu hii nakukumbusha uchochee ile karama ya Mungu, iliyowekwa ndani yako nilipokuwekea mikono yangu.

english: For God has not given us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.
ekegusii: ekiagera omoika twaetwe na Nyasae tari oyo bw’obwoba, korende oyo bw’echinguru na obwanchani, na omoika bw’okwerenga intwe abanyene.
swahili: Maana Mungu hakutupa roho ya woga, bali roho ya nguvu, ya upendo na ya moyo wa kiasi.

english: So do not be ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, or of me, His prisoner. Instead, join me in suffering for the gospel by the power of God.
ekegusii: Gaaki, torora obosooku kobeera Omonene oito kirori, gose tondorera inche, omosibwa oye, obosooku, korende nonya naye oremererie emechando ase engencho y’enchiri, ase okobua kwa Nyasae,
swahili: Kwa hiyo usione haya kushuhudia kuhusu Bwana wetu, wala usinionee haya mimi niliye mfungwa kwa ajili yake. Bali uishiriki pamoja nami taabu ya Injili, kwa kadiri ya nguvu ya Mungu,

english: He has saved us and called us to a holy calling, not because of our works, but by His own purpose and by the grace He granted us in Christ Jesus before time began.
ekegusii: oyototooretie na agatorangeria ase okorangeria ogochenu, tari ase engencho y’ogokora gwaito korende koreng’ana nokorigia kwaye omonyene, na obuya bwaye. Obuya obo twaetwe ase Kristo Yeso korwa agwo kare
swahili: ambaye alituokoa na kutuita katika mwito mtakatifu: si kwa kadiri ya matendo yetu mema bali kwa sababu ya kusudi lake mwenyewe na neema yake. Neema hii tulipewa katika Kristo Yesu tangu milele.

english: You therefore, my child, be strong in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.
ekegusii: Gaaki, aye omwana one, obe ne chinguru ase obuya bore ime ase Kristo Yeso.
swahili: Basi, wewe mwanangu, uwe hodari katika neema iliyo ndani ya Kristo Yesu.

english: For this reason I endure all things for the sake of the elect, so that they too may obtain the salvation that is in Christ Jesus, with eternal glory.
ekegusii: Ase ayio naremereirie onsi ase engencho y’abachoore, erinde nabarabwo banyoore ogotooreka kore ase Kristo Yeso amo nobonene bwa kare na kare.
swahili: Kwa hiyo ninavumilia mambo yote kwa ajili ya wateule wa Mungu, kusudi wao nao wapate wokovu ulio katika Kristo Yesu, pamoja na utukufu wa milele.

english: This is a trustworthy saying: If we died with Him, we will also live with Him;
ekegusii: Ring’ana eri neri’ekeene: Onye twakwete amo nere, inatobe moyo amo nere boigo.
swahili: Hili ni neno la kuaminiwa: Kwa maana kama tumekufa pamoja naye, tutaishi pia pamoja naye.

english: if we endure, we will also reign with Him; if we deny Him, He will also deny us;
ekegusii: Onye tokoremereria, rirorio natogaambe amo nere boigo; onye tokomokaana, nere natokaane boigo;
swahili: Kama tukistahimili, pia tutatawala pamoja naye. Kama tukimkana yeye, naye atatukana sisi.

english: if we are faithless, He remains faithful, for He cannot deny Himself. The Lord’s Approved Workman
ekegusii: onye titori abegenwa, ere nigo are omwegenwa, ekiagera takonyara gwekaana ere omonyene. Omokori emeremo bwancheirwe
swahili: Kama tusipoamini, yeye hudumu kuwa mwaminifu, kwa maana hawezi kujikana mwenyewe. Mfanyakazi Aliyekubaliwa Na Mungu

english: Remind the believers of these things, charging them before God to avoid quarreling over words, which succeeds only in leading the listeners to ruin.
ekegusii: Obainyorie ayio, na kobakuurera ase obosio bwa Nyasae, tibaaba nokoamererania ase amang’ana, okwo gotanyaare gokoonya kende, korende nigo gokobasiria abagokoigwa.
swahili: Endelea kuwakumbusha mambo haya ukiwaonya mbele za Bwana waache kushindana kwa maneno ambayo hayana faida yoyote bali huwaangamiza tu wale wanaoyasikia.

english: Make every effort to present yourself approved to God, an unashamed workman who accurately handles the word of truth.
ekegusii: Kora buna oranyaare kweorokia ase obosio bwa Nyasae buna oyobwancheirwe nere, buna omokori emeremo oyotagwenereti gosookigwa, ogwatanana boronge ring’ana ri’ekeene.
swahili: Jitahidi kujionyesha kwa Mungu kuwa umekubaliwa naye, mtendakazi asiye na sababu ya kuona aibu, ukilitumia kwa usahihi neno la kweli.

english: But avoid irreverent, empty chatter, which will only lead to more ungodliness,
ekegusii: Bweatanane korwa ase amang’ana atari y’obonyasae, na atari nengeencho. Inaki ase ayio abanto nigo barageenderere komenteka ase chingeencho chitari chi’obonyasae.
swahili: Jiepushe na maneno mabaya, yasiyo na maana, yasiyo ya utauwa, kwa maana hayo huzidi kuwatosa watu katika kukosa heshima kwa Mungu.

english: and the talk of such men will spread like gangrene. Among them are Hymenaeus and Philetus,
ekegusii: Amang’ana abo nigo akoria buna rikwege ri’esiria. Ase abwo mbareo Himenayo na Fileto.
swahili: Mafundisho yao yataenea kama kidonda kisichopona. Miongoni mwao wamo Himenayo na Fileto

english: who have deviated from the truth. They say that the resurrection has already occurred, and they undermine the faith of some.
ekegusii: Abwo basireriigwe korwa ase ekeene, bagoteeba ng’a okobokigwa gwaikire kobao, na igo bakoonchorana okwegena kw’abaanto baande.
swahili: ambao wameiacha kweli, wakisema kwamba ufufuo wa wafu umekwisha kuwako, nao huharibu imani ya baadhi ya watu.

english: Nevertheless, God’s firm foundation stands, bearing this seal: “The Lord knows those who are His,” and, “Everyone who calls on the name of the Lord must turn away from iniquity.”
ekegusii: Korende oboroso obo Nyasae abeegete bore ne chinguru, boteneine boronge, bore nekemanyererio eke: “Omonene namanyete abare abaye”, naende, “Kera oyogwatora erieta ri’Omonene, tiga eatanane korwa ase obobe.”
swahili: Lakini msingi wa Mungu ulio imara umesimama, ukiwa na muhuri wenye maandishi haya: “Bwana anawajua walio wake”; tena, “Kila alitajaye jina la Bwana, na auache uovu.”

english: And the things that you have heard me say among many witnesses, entrust these to faithful men who will be qualified to teach others as well.
ekegusii: Na ayakwaigwete korwa ase ’nde ase amasio y’abarori abange oyabeeke ase abanto abegenwa, abaranyare kworokereria abaande boigo.
swahili: Nayo mambo yale uliyonisikia nikiyasema mbele ya mashahidi wengi, uwakabidhi watu waaminifu watakaoweza kuwafundisha watu wengine vilevile.

english: A large house contains not only vessels of gold and silver, but also of wood and clay. Some indeed are for honorable use, but others are for common use.
ekegusii: Ase enyomba enene tibirio ebinto bie chitaabu na ebie chifeta bioka, korende mbireo ebinto bi’emete na ebi’amaroba boigo; ebinde nebi’ogosika, na ebinde tibiri ebi’ogosika.
swahili: Katika nyumba kubwa si kwamba kuna vyombo vya dhahabu na fedha tu, bali pia vimo vyombo vya miti na vya udongo; vingine kwa matumizi maalum, na vingine kwa matumizi ya kawaida.

english: So if anyone cleanses himself of what is unfit, he will be a vessel for honor: sanctified, useful to the Master, and prepared for every good work.
ekegusii: Ase ayio, onye omonto origetie gwesibia ere omonyene ase ogweatanana korwa ase ebinto buna ebio, nabe egento ki’ogosika, giancheirwe, keragwenere Omonene, kiaroisiigwe ase kera emeremo emiya.
swahili: Basi ikiwa mtu amejitakasa na kujitenga na hayo niliyoyataja, atakuwa chombo maalum, kilichotengwa na ambacho kinamfaa mwenye nyumba, kimeandaliwa tayari kwa kila kazi njema.

english: Flee from youthful passions and pursue righteousness, faith, love, and peace, together with those who call on the Lord out of a pure heart.
ekegusii: Tama okogania okobe kw’obosae, rigia oboronge, na okwegena, na obwanchani, na omorembe, amo nabwo bakomorangeri’Omonene ase chinkoro chindabu.
swahili: Zikimbie tamaa mbaya za ujana, ufuate haki, imani, upendo na amani pamoja na wale wamwitao Bwana kwa moyo safi.

english: But reject foolish and ignorant speculation, for you know that it breeds quarreling.
ekegusii: Korende bwange amaborio y’oboriri atari aye chiseemi. Kwamanyire ng’a ayio nigo ararente eriomana.
swahili: Jiepushe na mabishano ya kipumbavu na yasiyo na maana, kwa kuwa wajua ya kwamba hayo huzaa magomvi.

english: And a servant of the Lord must not be quarrelsome, but must be kind to everyone, able to teach, and forbearing.
ekegusii: Naende tegwenereti omosomba Omonene koba omonyariomana, korende abe omwororo ase abanto bonsi, abe oy’omanyete kworokereria buya, na abe omoremereria,
swahili: Tena haimpasi mtumishi wa Bwana kuwa mgomvi, bali inampasa awe mwema kwa kila mtu, awezaye kufundisha, tena mvumilivu.

english: He must gently reprove those who oppose him, in the hope that God may grant them repentance leading to a knowledge of the truth.
ekegusii: oyorabateebererie ase obwororo abwo bakoamererania nere. Aande Nyasae nabaonchore, erinde bamanye ekeene gionsi,
swahili: Inampasa kuwaonya kwa upole wale wanaopingana naye, kwa matumaini kwamba Mungu atawajalia kutubu na kuijua kweli,

english: Then they will come to their senses and escape the snare of the devil, who has taken them captive to his will.
ekegusii: erio banyare gotaboboka na korua ase omoeto o Saitani kobasakoirwe nere goika bakore ogwancha kwaye.
swahili: ili fahamu zao ziwarudie tena, nao waponyoke katika mtego wa ibilisi ambaye amewateka wapate kufanya mapenzi yake.

english: Join me in suffering, like a good soldier of Christ Jesus.
ekegusii: Nonya naye oremererie emechando buna omorwani omuya o Kristo Yeso.
swahili: Vumilia taabu pamoja nasi kama askari mwema wa Kristo Yesu.

english: A soldier refrains from entangling himself in civilian affairs, in order to please the one who enlisted him.
ekegusii: Morwani onde tari, oyokogeenda ase esegi, orebeke ase amang’ana ande onsi y’ense eye, erinde amogwenere ere oyomoriigete.
swahili: Hakuna askari yeyote ambaye akiwa vitani hujishughulisha na mambo ya kawaida ya maisha haya kwa sababu nia yake ni kumpendeza yule aliyemwandika awe askari.

english: Likewise, a competitor does not receive the crown unless he competes according to the rules.
ekegusii: Omoamereria bwe chigosori takoegwa egutwa y’obobui ataamereraneti koreng’ana namachiiko.
swahili: Vivyo hivyo, yeye ashindanaye katika michezo hawezi kupewa tuzo ya ushindi asiposhindana kulingana na kanuni za mashindano.

english: The hardworking farmer should be the first to partake of the crops.
ekegusii: Omoremi oyobwechandeire emeremo, ere nemogwenerete abe oyo bw’eritang’ani konyora ensemo y’okwama.
swahili: Mkulima mwenye bidii ya kazi ndiye anayestahili kuwa wa kwanza kupata fungu la mavuno.

english: Consider what I am saying, for the Lord will give you insight into all things.
ekegusii: Rengereria mono ayio ngokwana, ekiagera Omonene nakoe okomanya ase amang’ana onsi.
swahili: Fikiri sana kuhusu haya nisemayo, kwa maana Bwana atakupa ufahamu katika mambo hayo yote.

english: Remember Jesus Christ, raised from the dead, descended from David, as proclaimed by my gospel,
ekegusii: Moinyore Yeso Kristo, oy’oboogete korwa ase abakuure, oyo bw’ororeria rwa Daudi, koreng’ana nenchiri eye nkorandia inche.
swahili: Mkumbuke Yesu Kristo, aliyefufuliwa kutoka kwa wafu, yeye aliye wa uzao wa Daudi. Hii ndiyo Injili yangu,

english: for which I suffer to the extent of being chained like a criminal. But the word of God cannot be chained!
ekegusii: Ase enchiri eyio ngachaandwa goika ngasibwa ne chingataare buna omokori amabe. Korende ring’ana ria Nyasae tirikobeegeka chingataare.
swahili: ambayo kwayo ninateseka hata kufikia hatua ya kufungwa minyororo kama mhalifu. Lakini neno la Mungu halifungwi.

english: But understand this: In the last days terrible times will come.
ekegusii: Gaaki, manya ring’ana eri, ng’a ase amatuko y’omoerio inachibe chingaki chi’obokong’u.
swahili: Lakini yakupasa ufahamu jambo hili, kwamba siku za mwisho kutakuwa na nyakati za hatari.

english: You, however, have observed my teaching, my conduct, my purpose, my faith, my patience, my love, my perseverance,
ekegusii: Korende aye kwabwatire okworokereria kw’ane, na orogeendo rw’ane, na okorigia kw’ane ase obogima obo, na okwegena kw’ane, na oboremereria bwane, na obwanchani bwane, na okoganya kw’ane,
swahili: Lakini wewe umeyajua mafundisho yangu, mwenendo, makusudi, imani, uvumilivu, upendo, ustahimilivu,

english: my persecutions, and the sufferings that came upon me in Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra. What persecutions I endured! Yet the Lord rescued me from all of them.
ekegusii: na ogochaandwa kw’ane, na ogochaandeka kw’ane, okwo nanyorete ase Antiokia na Ikonio, na Listra. Nogochaandwa kore inaki naremereretie! Na korwa ase ayio onsi Omonene agantooria.
swahili: mateso na taabu, yaani mambo yote yaliyonipata huko Antiokia, Ikonio na Listra, mateso yote niliyostahimili, lakini Bwana aliniokoa katika hayo yote.

english: Indeed, all who desire to live godly lives in Christ Jesus will be persecuted,
ekegusii: Ekeene, aba bonsi baganetie koba ne chingeencho chi’obonyasae ase Kristo Yeso inabachaandwe.
swahili: Naam, yeyote anayetaka kuishi maisha ya utauwa ndani ya Kristo Yesu atateswa.

english: while evil men and imposters go from bad to worse, deceiving and being deceived.
ekegusii: Korende abanto ababe na abang’ainereria mbamentekane kobua ase obobe, bakong’aina na kong’aineka.
swahili: Lakini watu waovu na wadanganyaji watazidi kuwa waovu, wakidanganya na kudanganyika.

english: But as for you, continue in the things you have learned and firmly believed, since you know from whom you have learned them.
ekegusii: Korende aye, ogenderere ase ayakworokereretigwe na koyaenekia, gokomanya ng’a nkorwa ase ng’o kweorokereretie.
swahili: Bali wewe, udumu katika yale uliyojifunza na kuyaamini kwa uthabiti, ukitambua ya kuwa ulijifunza hayo kutoka kwa nani,

english: From infancy you have known the Holy Scriptures, which are able to make you wise for salvation through faith in Christ Jesus.
ekegusii: Inaki korwa obwana bwao nomanyete amariiko amaachenu, ayaraanyare gokong’ainiyia goika onyore ogotooreka ase okwegena kore ase Kristo Yeso.
swahili: na jinsi ambavyo tangu utoto umeyajua Maandiko matakatifu, ambayo yanaweza kukuhekimisha upate wokovu kwa njia ya imani katika Kristo Yesu.

english: All Scripture is God-breathed and is useful for instruction, for conviction, for correction, and for training in righteousness,
ekegusii: Kera ririiko riutire n’Omoika o Nyasae, nario riranyare gotworokereria, na gotokuurera, na gotorongeyia, na gototang’ana ase oboronge,
swahili: Kila Andiko limevuviwa na Mungu na lafaa kwa mafundisho, kwa kuwaonya watu makosa yao, kwa kuwaongoza na kwa kuwafundisha katika haki,

english: so that the man of God may be complete, fully equipped for every good work.
ekegusii: erinde omonto o Nyasae abe oikeranigwe, oisanerigwe, anyare gokora kera ogokora okuya.
swahili: ili mtu wa Mungu awe amekamilishwa, apate kutenda kila kazi njema.

english: For men will be lovers of themselves, lovers of money, boastful, arrogant, abusive, disobedient to their parents, ungrateful, unholy,
ekegusii: Inaki abanto inababe bakweancha barabwo abanyene, abanchete chitaabu, abetogia, abaenenu, abarami, abatari koigwera abaibori babo, abatari koiraneria ng’a mbuya mono, abatari abachenu,
swahili: Kwa maana watu watakuwa wenye kujipenda wenyewe, wenye kupenda fedha, wenye kujisifu, wenye kiburi, wenye kumkufuru Mungu, wasiotii wazazi wao, wasio na shukrani, wasio watakatifu,

english: unloving, unforgiving, slanderous, without self-control, brutal, without love of good,
ekegusii: abatancheti abanto baande, abatarigeti kobwatana, abang’aachi, abatari gwetanga ase rinde rionsi, abatiindi, abageechete ayare amaya,
swahili: wasio na upendo, wasiopenda kupatanishwa, wasingiziaji, wasiozuia tamaa zao, wakatili, wasiopenda mema,

english: traitorous, reckless, conceited, lovers of pleasure rather than lovers of God,
ekegusii: abarua abaande, abatancheti gokanigwa, abamwenu, abanchete kwegokia kobua komwancha Nyasae,
swahili: wasaliti, wakaidi, waliojaa majivuno, wapendao anasa zaidi kuliko kumpenda Mungu:

english: having a form of godliness but denying its power. Turn away from such as these!
ekegusii: abakororekana ng’a mbare ne chingeencho chi’obonyasae, korende bakaana okobua gwe chingeencho echio. Bweatanane korwa ase abwo.
swahili: wakiwa na mfano wa utauwa kwa nje, lakini wakizikana nguvu za Mungu. Jiepushe na watu wa namna hiyo.

english: They are the kind who worm their way into households and captivate vulnerable women who are weighed down with sins and led astray by various passions,
ekegusii: Inaki ase egati yabo mbareo abagwesoyia ase chinyomba chi’abaanto gosakora abakungu aboro, abare ne chigurube chi’ebibe, na koraagwa nokogania okobe gwe chingeencho ao ao.
swahili: Miongoni mwao wamo wale wajiingizao katika nyumba za watu na kuwachukua mateka wanawake wajinga, waliolemewa na dhambi zao na kuyumbishwa na aina zote za tamaa mbaya.

english: who are always learning but never able to come to a knowledge of the truth.
ekegusii: Abakungu abwo nigo bakweorokereria botaambe, korende tibakonyara goikera chiseemi chi’ekeene.
swahili: Wakijifunza siku zote lakini kamwe wasiweze kufikia ujuzi wa kweli.

english: Just as Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses, so also these men oppose the truth. They are depraved in mind and disqualified from the faith.
ekegusii: Naboigo buna Yane na Yambare baengereranetie na Musa, na aba nabo bakoengererania nekeene. Ebirengererio biabo biasarekire, na okwegena kwabo kwangirwe,
swahili: Kama vile Yane na Yambre walivyopingana na Mose, vivyo hivyo watu hawa hupingana na ile kweli. Hawa ni watu wenye akili zilizopotoka, ambao wamekataliwa kwa mambo ya imani.

english: But they will not advance much further. For just like Jannes and Jambres, their folly will be plain to everyone. All Scripture Is God-Breathed (Hebrews 4:12–16)
ekegusii: korende tibakogeenderera mono, ekiagera oboriri bwabo naboorokigwe maiso marore ase abanto bonsi, buna yabeete ase baria babere. Ogochika kw’omoerio
swahili: Lakini hawataendelea sana, kwa sababu upumbavu wao utakuwa dhahiri kwa watu wote, kama ulivyokuwa dhahiri upumbavu wa hao watu wawili. Paulo Amwagiza Timotheo

english: I charge you in the presence of God and of Christ Jesus, who will judge the living and the dead, and in view of His appearing and His kingdom:
ekegusii: Nagochiikire ase obosio bwa Nyasae, na obwa Kristo Yeso, oyoraache kogaambia abare moyo na abakuure, na ase okooroka kwaye, na oborwoti bwaye.
swahili: Nakuagiza mbele za Mungu na mbele za Kristo Yesu, atakayewahukumu watu walio hai na waliokufa wakati wa kuja kwake na ufalme wake, kwamba:

english: because Demas, in his love of this world, has deserted me and gone to Thessalonica. Crescens has gone to Galatia, and Titus to Dalmatia.
ekegusii: Inaki Dema ontigire, na gwancha ense eye ya bono; ochiire Tesaloniki. Keresike ochiire Galatia na Tito Dalamatia.
swahili: kwa sababu Dema, kwa kuupenda ulimwengu, ameniacha na amekwenda Thesalonike. Kreske amekwenda Galatia na Tito amekwenda Dalmatia.

english: Only Luke is with me. Get Mark and bring him with you, because he is useful to me in the ministry.
ekegusii: Luka bweka ore aiga amo nainche. Orentane Mariko, moche komo, ekiagera ere nigo aranyare gonkoonya mono.
swahili: Ni Luka peke yake aliye hapa pamoja nami. Mtafute Marko uje naye kwa sababu ananifaa sana katika huduma yangu.

english: Tychicus, however, I have sent to Ephesus.
ekegusii: Namotomire Tukiko Efeso.
swahili: Nimemtuma Tikiko huko Efeso.

english: When you come, bring the cloak that I left with Carpus at Troas, and my scrolls, especially the parchments.
ekegusii: Ekero orache ondentanerie egetambaa gi’okwambara, eke natigerete Karipo aria Teroa. Naboigo kogocha ondentanerie chibuku, na kobua mono chiria chi’amasankwa.
swahili: Utakapokuja, niletee lile joho nililoliacha kwa Karpo huko Troa na vile vitabu vyangu, hasa vile vya ngozi.

english: Alexander the coppersmith did great harm to me. The Lord will repay him according to his deeds.
ekegusii: Alekisanda, omoturi bwe chitaai, agankorera amabe amange. Omonene namoakane koreng’ana nogokora kwaye.
swahili: Aleksanda yule mfua chuma alinitendea ubaya mkubwa. Bwana atamlipa kwa ajili ya yale aliyotenda.

english: You too should beware of him, for he has vigorously opposed our message. The Lord Remains Faithful
ekegusii: Aye bwerende korwa ase are, ekiagera nigo aengereretie okworokereria gwaito.
swahili: Wewe pia ujihadhari naye kwa sababu aliyapinga sana maneno yetu.

english: At my first defense, no one stood with me, but everyone deserted me. May it not be charged against them.
ekegusii: Ase ogwekengera kw’ane kw’eritang’ani onde tarenge otenenete amo nainche, korende bonsi bagantiga. Nasabire ng’a tibaabarerwa ebibe ase ring’ana erio.
swahili: Katika utetezi wangu wa mara ya kwanza, hakuna hata mmoja aliyeniunga mkono, bali kila mmoja aliniacha. Namwomba Mungu wasihesabiwe hatia kwa jambo hilo.

english: But the Lord stood by me and strengthened me, so that through me the message would be fully proclaimed, and all the Gentiles would hear it. So I was delivered from the mouth of the lion.
ekegusii: Korende Omonene agatenena amo nainche, akambeeka chinguru, erinde goetera ase ’nde okoraria kwe ring’ana goikeranigwe goika abanto bonsi b’Ebisaku bakoigwe. Na inche nigo natooretigwe korwa ase omonwa bw’endo.
swahili: Lakini Bwana alisimama upande wangu akanitia nguvu, ili kupitia kwangu lile Neno lihubiriwe kwa ukamilifu, watu wote Mataifa wapate kulisikia. Mimi niliokolewa kutoka kinywa cha simba.

english: And the Lord will rescue me from every evil action and bring me safely into His heavenly kingdom. To Him be the glory forever and ever. Amen. Final Greetings (Ephesians 6:21–24; Philippians 4:21–23)
ekegusii: Omonene nansibore korwa ase amabe onsi, na antoorie goika nsoe ase oborwoti bwa igoro. Ogotogigwa nokwaye kare na kare. Amina. Amakwania y’ogokoorera
swahili: Bwana ataniokoa katika kila shambulio baya na kunileta salama katika Ufalme wake wa mbinguni. Atukuzwe yeye milele na milele. Amen. Salamu Za Mwisho

english: Greet Prisca and Aquila, as well as the household of Onesiphorus.
ekegusii: Nkw’anerie Priska na Akwila, na abanto b’enyomba y’Onesiforo.
swahili: Wasalimu Prisila na Akila, na wote wa nyumbani kwa Onesiforo.

english: Preach the word; be prepared in season and out of season; reprove, rebuke, and encourage with every form of patient instruction.
ekegusii: Randia Ring’ana ria Nyasae, kora omokia ase engaki ekogwenerete, na ase eyetakogwenereti, kuurera na togonyera, na gosorora ase oboremereria bwonsi, na ase okworokereria.
swahili: Hubiri Neno; kuwa tayari wakati ufaao na wakati usiofaa; karipia, kemea na utie moyo kwa uvumilivu wote na kwa mafundisho mazuri.

english: Erastus has remained at Corinth, and Trophimus I left sick in Miletus.
ekegusii: Erasto nigo atigarete Korinto, korende Torofimo nkamotiga Mileto orwarete.
swahili: Erasto alibaki Korintho. Nami nikamwacha Trofimo huko Mileto akiwa mgonjwa.

english: Make every effort to come to me before winter. Eubulus sends you greetings, as do Pudens, Linus, Claudia, and all the brothers.
ekegusii: Teema buna oranyaare gocha ritang’ani etoigo etaracha. Eubulu ogokwanirie, naboigo Pudente na Lino, na Klaudia, na abaminto bonsi.
swahili: Jitahidi ufike huku kabla ya majira ya baridi. Eubulo anakusalimu, vivyo hivyo Pude, Lino, Klaudia na ndugu wote.

english: The Lord be with your spirit. Grace be with you all.
ekegusii: Omonene abe amo n’omoyo oo. Obuya bobe amo nainwe mwensi.
swahili: Bwana awe pamoja na roho yako. Neema iwe pamoja nanyi. Amen.

english: For the time will come when men will not tolerate sound doctrine, but with itching ears they will gather around themselves teachers to suit their own desires.
ekegusii: Na engaki neche, ekero abanto barange okworokereria kw’obogima, na ase okogania kwabo okobe benyorere aborokia abange mono, ekiagera amato abo are nebiagaso.
swahili: Maana wakati utakuja watu watakapokataa kuyakubali mafundisho yenye uzima. Badala yake, ili kutimiza tamaa zao wenyewe, watajikusanyia idadi kubwa ya walimu wapate kuwaambia yale ambayo masikio yao yanayowasha yanatamani kuyasikia.

english: So they will turn their ears away from the truth and turn aside to myths.
ekegusii: Barabwo mbeatanane korwa ase okoigwa ayare ay’ekeene, na koonchokera emegano ao ao.
swahili: Watakataa kusikiliza kweli na kuzigeukia hadithi za uongo.

english: But you, be sober in all things, endure hardship, do the work of an evangelist, fulfill your ministry.
ekegusii: Korende aye, bweriite ase amang’ana onsi, oremererie emechando, kora emeremo y’oborandia, ikerania ogokora kw’obosomba bwao.
swahili: Kwa habari yako wewe, vumilia mateso, fanya kazi ya mhubiri wa Injili, timiza wajibu wote wa huduma yako.

english: For I am already being poured out like a drink offering, and the time of my departure is at hand.
ekegusii: Inaki inche bono naikire koumorwa buna okoruegwa gw’ekenyuugwa na engaki y’ane y’ogokwa yaikire.
swahili: Kwa maana mimi sasa ni tayari kumiminwa kama sadaka ya kinywaji, nayo saa yangu ya kuondoka imetimia.

english: I have fought the good fight, I have finished the race, I have kept the faith.
ekegusii: Narwanire esegi ere engiya, nakoorire orogeendo, narendire okwegena.
swahili: Nimevipiga vita vizuri, mashindano nimeyamaliza, imani nimeilinda.

english: From now on there is laid up for me the crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous Judge, will award to me on that day—and not only to me, but to all who crave His appearing. Personal Concerns
ekegusii: Magega ase aya nagacheirwe egutwa y’oboronge, eye Omonene, omogambi bw’oboronge, arang’e ase Rituko riria gose tari inche bweka arae, korende nabaanto bonsi abanchete okoorokigwa kwaye. Ogotebereria ase Timotheo omonyene
swahili: Sasa nimewekewa taji ya haki ambayo Bwana, mwamuzi wa haki, atanitunukia siku ile: wala si mimi tu, bali pia wote ambao wamengoja kwa shauku kudhihirishwa kwake. Maelekezo Ya Binafsi

english: Make every effort to come to me quickly,
ekegusii: Teema buna oranyare gocha ase ’nde bwango.
swahili: Jitahidi kuja kwangu upesi

english: The elder, To the beloved Gaius, whom I love in the truth:
ekegusii: Korwa ase omogaka ngokorikera nde aye Gayo, omwanchani, oyonyanchete ase ekeene.
swahili: Mzee: Kwa Gayo rafiki yangu, nimpendaye katika kweli. Gayo Anasifiwa Kwa Ajili Ya Ukarimu Wake

english: So if I come, I will call attention to his malicious slander against us. And unsatisfied with that, he refuses to welcome the brothers and forbids those who want to do so, even putting them out of the church.
ekegusii: Ase ayio, kondache ning’inyore ogokora kwaye are gokora, buna are gokwana amang’ana amabe igoro ase tore. Ere taisanegeti nayio, ere omonyene tari koroisia abaminto, naende atanga baria barigetie kobaroisia, na aosokia barabwo korwa ase ekanisa.
swahili: Hivyo kama nikija, nitakumbuka matendo yake atendayo, akitusingizia kwa maneno ya hila. Wala hatosheki na hayo anayotusingizia, bali pia hukataa kuwakaribisha ndugu, na hata huwazuia wale walio tayari kufanya hivyo na kuwafukuza watoke kanisani. Demetrio

english: Beloved, do not imitate what is evil, but what is good. The one who does good is of God; the one who does evil has not seen God.
ekegusii: Omwanchani, tibwega obobe, korende bwege ekere ekiya. Ere oyogokora amaya noyo o Nyasae, korende ere oyogokora amabe tarochi Nyasae.
swahili: Rafiki mpendwa, usiige lile lililo baya bali lile lililo jema. Yeyote atendaye mema atoka kwa Mungu, bali atendaye mabaya hajamwona Mungu.

english: Demetrius has received a good testimony from everyone, and from the truth itself. We also testify for him, and you know that our testimony is true. Conclusion (2 John 1:12–13)
ekegusii: Demeturio obereirwe kirori nabaanto bonsi, naende nekeene ekenyene, ng’a nomuya are. Na intwe boigo twarorire, na aye kwamanyire ng’a oborori bwaito nobw’ekeene. Amakwania ogokoorera
swahili: Kila mtu ameshuhudia mema kuhusu Demetrio, vivyo hivyo hata na hiyo kweli yenyewe. Sisi pia twashuhudia mema juu yake, nanyi mwajua kwamba ushuhuda wetu ni kweli. Salamu Za Mwisho

english: I have many things to write to you, but I would prefer not to do so with pen and ink.
ekegusii: Nabwate amang’ana amange nanga nakoriikera, korende tindigeti gokoriikera ase ewino na ekaramu.
swahili: Ninayo mambo mengi ya kukuandikia, lakini sipendi kuandika kwa kalamu na wino.

english: Beloved, I pray that in every way you may prosper and enjoy good health, as your soul also prospers.
ekegusii: Omwanchani, nasabire ng’a ogenderere buya ase amang’ana onsi, naende obe nobogima obuya, buna omoyo oo ore buya.
