swahili: Mpendwa, naomba ufanikiwe katika mambo yote na kuwa na afya njema kama vile roho yako ifanikiwavyo.

english: For I was overjoyed when the brothers came and testified about your devotion to the truth, in which you continue to walk.
ekegusii: Naki igo nagogete mono ekero abaminto bachete baganteebia igoro y’obwegenwa bwao ore nabwo ase ekeene, na buna ogendererete ase ekeene.
swahili: Ilinifurahisha sana baadhi ya ndugu walipokuja na kutueleza juu ya uaminifu wako katika kweli na jinsi unavyoendelea kuenenda katika hiyo kweli.

english: I have no greater joy than to hear that my children are walking in the truth. Gaius Commended for Hospitality
ekegusii: Tindi nomogooko onde omonene kobua oyo, koigwa ng’a abana baane mbagendererete ase ekeene. Gayo ogotogigwa
swahili: Sina furaha kubwa kuliko hii, kusikia kwamba watoto wangu wanaenenda katika kweli.

english: Beloved, you are faithful in what you are doing for the brothers, and especially since they are strangers to you.
ekegusii: Omwanchani, igo ore omwegenwa ase onsi ayagwakoreire abwo bare abaminto, nonya bare abamenyi.
swahili: Rafiki mpendwa, wewe ni mwaminifu kwa yale unayowatendea ndugu, ingawa wao ni wageni kwako.

english: They have testified to the church about your love. You will do well to send them on their way in a manner worthy of God.
ekegusii: Barabwo babeire kirori ase ekanisa igoro y’obwanchani bwao. Nokore buya korabakonye ase orogendo rwabo, buna egwenerete ase okomokorera Nyasae.
swahili: Wameshuhudia kuhusu upendo wako mbele ya kanisa. Utafanya vyema ukiwasafirisha kama inavyostahili kwa Mungu.

english: For they went out on behalf of the Name, accepting nothing from the Gentiles.
ekegusii: Naki ase engencho y’erieta ria Yeso bagasooka isiko, tibaira gento korwa ase abanto b’Ebisaku.
swahili: Ilikuwa ni kwa ajili ya hilo Jina waliondoka, bila kukubali kupokea msaada wowote kutoka kwa watu wasioamini.

english: Therefore we ought to support such men, so that we may be fellow workers for the truth. Diotrephes and Demetrius
ekegusii: Nabo etogwenerete intwe koroisia abanto bare buna abwo, erinde tobe abakori emeremo amo nabarabwo ase ekeene. Dioterefe na Demeturio
swahili: Kwa hiyo imetupasa sisi kuonyesha ukarimu kwa watu kama hao ili tuweze kutenda kazi pamoja kwa ajili ya kweli. Deotrefe

english: I have written to the church about this, but Diotrephes, who loves to be first, will not accept our instruction.
ekegusii: Nabarikerete abekanisa amang’ana, korende Dioterefe, oyobwanchete koba oyo bw’eritang’ani ase bare, tatwancheti.
swahili: Nililiandikia kanisa, lakini Deotrefe, yeye apendaye kujifanya wa kwanza, hakubali mamlaka yetu.

english: At Caesarea there was a man named Cornelius, a centurion in what was called the Italian Regiment.
ekegusii: Ase Kaisaria narengeo omonto oyomo ore korokwa Kornelio, omotang’ani bw’abarwani rigana bw’ekeombe ekemo ki’abarwani kiare korokwa Abaitalia.
swahili: Katika mji wa Kaisaria palikuwa na mtu jina lake Kornelio, ambaye alikuwa jemadari wa kile kilichojulikana kama kikosi cha Kiitalia.

english: He became hungry and wanted something to eat, but while the meal was being prepared, he fell into a trance.
ekegusii: Akaba nenchara, akagania endagera arie. Korende ekero barenge koyeroisia, akabwatwa nobogondereria,
swahili: Alipokuwa akiomba akahisi njaa, akatamani kupata chakula. Lakini wakati walikuwa wakiandaa chakula, akalala usingizi mzito sana.

english: He saw heaven open and something like a large sheet being let down to earth by its four corners.
ekegusii: akarora igoro amaanokire, na egento kegoika, kere buna egetambaa ekenene, kebwatire emekoba ene, kegoikigwa gocha inse.
swahili: Akaona mbingu zimefunguka na kitu kama nguo kubwa kikishushwa duniani kwa ncha zake nne.

english: It contained all kinds of four-footed animals and reptiles of the earth, as well as birds of the air.
ekegusii: Ime yaye nigo biarengeo ebisaku bionsi bie ching’iti chire namagoro ane, ne ching’iti chi’orosana, na echikwagura, ne chinyoni chia igoro.
swahili: Ndani yake walikuwepo aina zote za wanyama wenye miguu minne, nao watambaao nchini, na ndege wa angani.

english: Then a voice said to him: “Get up, Peter, kill and eat!”
ekegusii: Eriogi rikamocheera, rikamoteebia: “Petero, imoka onyenye orie!”
swahili: Ndipo sauti ikamwambia “Petro, ondoka, uchinje na ule.”

english: “No, Lord!” Peter answered. “I have never eaten anything impure or unclean.”
ekegusii: Korende Petero akabora: “Yay’Omonene, ekiagera tinana koria nonya ng’ake egento getachenegeti gose ekere neubi.”
swahili: Petro akajibu, “La hasha Bwana! Sijawahi kamwe kula kitu chochote kilicho najisi.”

english: The voice spoke to him a second time: “Do not call anything impure that God has made clean.”
ekegusii: Eriogi rikamochera eria kabere, rikamoteebia: “Eki Nyasae achenire tokeroka ng’a tikeri egechenu.”
swahili: Ile sauti ikasema naye mara ya pili, “Usikiite najisi kitu chochote Mungu alichokitakasa.”

english: This happened three times, and all at once the sheet was taken back up into heaven. Peter Called to Caesarea
ekegusii: Eri rigakoreka ara gatato, na egento keria gekabogorigwa gochia igoro naende.
swahili: Jambo hili lilitokea mara tatu na ghafula ile nguo ikarudishwa mbinguni.

english: While Peter was puzzling over the meaning of the vision, the men sent by Cornelius found Simon’s house and approached the gate.
ekegusii: Ekero Petero arenge ne chitang’u‐tang’u ase omoyo oye ime ase okorora okwo aroche, engencho yaye inki, rora, abanto baria batometwe na Kornelio, kobaboririe enyomba ya Simioni, bagatenena geita.
swahili: Wakati Petro akiwa bado anajiuliza kuhusu maana ya maono haya, wale watu waliokuwa wametumwa na Kornelio wakaipata nyumba ya Simoni mtengenezaji wa ngozi wakawa wamesimama mbele ya lango.

english: They called out to ask if Simon called Peter was staying there.
ekegusii: Bakarangeria neriogi bakabooria gose Simioni, oyokorokwa Petero, nao are ime.
swahili: Wakabisha hodi na kuuliza kama Simoni aliyeitwa Petro alikuwa anaishi hapo.

english: As Peter continued to reflect on the vision, the Spirit said to him, “Behold, three men are looking for you.
ekegusii: Na Petero, karengereretie okorora koria, Omoika okamoteebia: “Rora, abanto batato bagokorigia.
swahili: Wakati Petro akiwa anafikiria juu ya yale maono, Roho Mtakatifu akamwambia, “Simoni, wako watu watatu wanaokutafuta.

english: He and all his household were devout and God-fearing. He gave generously to the people and prayed to God regularly.
ekegusii: Ere nigo arenge omonto omuya, nere amo n’abanto b’enyomba yaye bonsi nigo bamoirogete Nyasae. Nigo are koa abanto ebiegwa ebinge n’omoyo oyomo na kogenderera gosaba Nyasae botambe.
swahili: Yeye alikuwa mcha Mungu pamoja na wote wa nyumbani mwake. Aliwapa watu sadaka nyingi na kumwomba Mungu daima.

english: So get up! Go downstairs and accompany them without hesitation, because I have sent them.”
ekegusii: Imoka, oike, ogende amo nabarabwo, toba ne chitang’u‐tang’u ekiagera ninche nabatoma.”
swahili: Inuka na ushuke, usisite kwenda nao kwa kuwa mimi nimewatuma.”

english: So Peter went down to the men and said, “Here am I, the one you are looking for. Why have you come?”
ekegusii: Petero agaika ase abanto baria, agateeba: “Ninche ere oyo mokorigia. Igo mwacha ase engencho ki?”
swahili: Petro akashuka na kuwaambia wale watu waliokuwa wametumwa kutoka kwa Kornelio, “Mimi ndiye mnayenitafuta. Mmekuja kwa sababu gani?”

english: “Cornelius the centurion has sent us,” they said. “He is a righteous and God-fearing man with a good reputation among the whole Jewish nation. A holy angel instructed him to request your presence in his home so he could hear a message from you.”
ekegusii: Bakamoteebia: “Nigo twatomirwe na Kornelio, omotang’ani bw’abarwani rigana, omonto omooronge, omoirogete Nyasae, oyogokwanwa buya negesaku gionsi ki’Abayahudi. Nateebigwa n’omomalaika omochenu ng’a atome abanto ase ore gokorangeria ogende bwoye, anyare koigwa amang’ana korwa ase ore.”
swahili: Wale watu wakamjibu, “Tumetumwa na Kornelio yule jemadari. Yeye ni mtu mwema anayemcha Mungu, na anaheshimiwa na Wayahudi wote. Yeye ameagizwa na malaika mtakatifu akukaribishe nyumbani kwake, ili asikilize maneno utakayomwambia.”

english: So Peter invited them in as his guests. And the next day he got ready and went with them, accompanied by some of the brothers from Joppa. Peter Visits Cornelius
ekegusii: Erio Petero akabateebia basoe nyomba, babe abageni baye. Rituko rikobwatia akaimoka akagenda amo nabarabwo, na abande bamwabo korwa Yopa bakagenda amo nere.
swahili: Basi Petro akawakaribisha wakafuatana naye ndani, akawapa pa kulala. Kesho yake akaondoka pamoja nao, na baadhi ya ndugu kutoka Yafa wakafuatana naye. Petro Nyumbani Mwa Kornelio

english: The following day he arrived in Caesarea, where Cornelius was expecting them and had called together his relatives and close friends.
ekegusii: Rituko rigotunya erio bagasoa Kaisaria. Na Kornelio nigo arenge obaganyete, konya osangereirie eamate yaye amo nabanchi baye.
swahili: Siku iliyofuata wakawasili Kaisaria. Kornelio alikuwa akiwangoja pamoja na jamaa yake na marafiki zake wa karibu.

english: As Peter was about to enter, Cornelius met him and fell at his feet to worship him.
ekegusii: Ekero Petero achia gosoa omochie, Kornelio agasoka komoorotota, akagwa inse ase amagoro aye, akamosasiima.
swahili: Petro alipokuwa akiingia ndani, Kornelio alikuja kumlaki, akaanguka miguuni pake kwa heshima.

english: But Peter helped him up. “Stand up,” he said, “I am only a man myself.”
ekegusii: Korende Petero akamoimokia, akamoteebia: “Tenena! Inche boigo Mwanyabaanto inde.”
swahili: Lakini Petro akamwinua akamwambia, “Simama, mimi ni mwanadamu tu.”

english: As Peter talked with him, he went inside and found many people gathered together.
ekegusii: Ekero are gokwana na Kornelio, agasoa ime, akanyora abanto abange basangererekaneteo.
swahili: Petro alipokuwa akizungumza naye akaingia ndani na kukuta watu wengi wamekusanyika.

english: He said to them, “You know how unlawful it is for a Jew to associate with a foreigner or visit him. But God has shown me that I should not call any man impure or unclean.
ekegusii: Akabateebia: “Mwamanyire ng’a tari boronge omonto Omoyahudi abwatane nomonto ore bw’egesaku ekeao, nonya nokomochiera, korende Nyasae onyorokirie ng’a timoroka onde bwensi ng’a tari omochenu, gose tachenegeti.
swahili: Akawaambia, “Mnajua kabisa kwamba ni kinyume cha sheria yetu Myahudi kuchangamana na mtu wa Mataifa au kumtembelea. Lakini Mungu amenionyesha kwamba nisimwite mtu yeyote kuwa najisi au asiye safi.

english: So when I was invited, I came without objection. I ask, then, why have you sent for me?”
ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio, ekero narangeretigwe ngacha, tinaanga. Nkoboria nde: Ing’ana ki mwandangereretie?”
swahili: Ndiyo sababu ulipotuma niitwe nilikuja bila kupinga lolote. Basi sasa naomba unieleze kwa nini umeniita?”

english: One day at about the ninth hour, he had a clear vision of an angel of God who came to him and said, “Cornelius!”
ekegusii: Ang’e chinsa kianda iga chia mobaso akaba buna oy’okorota erio akarora omomalaika O Nyasae okomoochera, akamoteebia: “Kornelio!”
swahili: Siku moja alasiri, yapata saa tisa, aliona maono waziwazi, malaika wa Mungu akimjia na kumwambia, “Kornelio!”

english: Cornelius answered: “Four days ago I was in my house praying at this, the ninth hour. Suddenly a man in radiant clothing stood before me
ekegusii: Kornelio akamoiraneria: “Reero nerituko ria kane, korwa ekero narenge gosaba nyomba mwane chinsa buna echi, chinsa kianda. Ani! Omonto nateneine bosio bwane obekeire chianga chikomeka‐meka.
swahili: Kornelio akajibu, “Siku nne zilizopita, nilikuwa nyumbani nikisali saa kama hii, saa tisa alasiri. Ghafula mtu aliyevaa nguo zilizongʼaa akasimama mbele yangu,

english: and said, ‘Cornelius, your prayer has been heard, and your gifts to the poor have been remembered before God.
ekegusii: Aganteebia: Kornelio, ogosaba kwao kwaigurwe, na ebiegwa biao biainyoirwe ase Nyasae.
swahili: akasema, ‘Kornelio, maombi yako yamesikiwa na sadaka zako kwa maskini zimekumbukwa mbele za Mungu.

english: Therefore send to Joppa for Simon, who is called Peter. He is a guest in the home of Simon the tanner, by the sea.’
ekegusii: Ase igo, toma abanto Yopa, orangerie Simioni, oyokorokwa Petero; ere nomogeni are nyomba mwa Simioni, omooroisia bw’amao, nigo amenyete ang’e nengegu y’enyancha.
swahili: Basi tuma watu waende Yafa wakaulize mtu mmoja Simoni aitwaye Petro, yeye ni mgeni katika nyumba ya Simoni mtengenezaji ngozi, ambaye nyumba yake iko kando ya bahari.’

english: So I sent for you immediately, and you were kind enough to come. Now then, we are all here in the presence of God to listen to everything the Lord has instructed you to tell us.” Good News for the Gentiles
ekegusii: Erio bwango ngatoma abanto orangerigwe, na aye gwakorire buya gwachire. Na bono twensi nao tore aiga ase obosio bwa Nyasae, tonyare koigwa aya onsi Omonene agochikiire gokwana.” Ogokwana gwa Petero
swahili: Nilituma watu kwako mara moja, nawe umefanya vyema kuja. Basi sasa sisi sote tuko hapa mbele za Mungu kuyasikiliza yote ambayo Bwana amekuamuru kutuambia.” Hotuba Ya Petro

english: Then Peter began to speak: “I now truly understand that God does not show favoritism,
ekegusii: Erio Petero agachaaka gokwana, akabora: “Ase ekeene naikire komanya ng’a Nyasae tari nogwanchereria,
swahili: Ndipo Petro akafungua kinywa chake akasema, “Mungu hana upendeleo,

english: but welcomes those from every nation who fear Him and do what is right.
ekegusii: korende ase kera egesaku omonto omoirogete na gokora oboronge nigo agwancherwa nere.
swahili: Lakini katika kila taifa, kila mtu amchaye na kutenda yaliyo haki hukubaliwa naye.

english: He has sent this message to the people of Israel, proclaiming the gospel of peace through Jesus Christ, who is Lord of all.
ekegusii: Agatoma ring’ana eri ase Abaisraeli, akarandia amang’ana amaya ay’omorembe korwa ase Yeso Kristo, oyore Omonene o bonsi.
swahili: Ninyi mnajua ule ujumbe uliotumwa kwa Israeli, ukitangaza habari njema za amani kwa Yesu Kristo. Yeye ni Bwana wa wote.

english: You yourselves know what has happened throughout Judea, beginning in Galilee with the baptism that John proclaimed:
ekegusii: Inwe momanyete, ng’a ring’ana eri riaraaretigwe ase Boyahudi yonsi, rigachaakera Galili magega y’ebatiso eria Yohana arandetie,
swahili: Mnajua yale yaliyotukia katika Uyahudi wote kuanzia Galilaya baada ya mahubiri ya Yohana Mbatizaji:

english: how God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Spirit and with power, and how Jesus went around doing good and healing all who were oppressed by the devil, because God was with Him.
ekegusii: igoro ya Yeso o Nazareti, buna Nyasae amoete Omoika Omochenu ne chinguru, na buna ataarete na gokora emeremo emiya, na kogwenia bonsi abaregetwe na Saitani, ekiagera Nyasae nigo arenge amo nere.
swahili: Jinsi Mungu alivyomtia Yesu wa Nazareti mafuta katika Roho Mtakatifu na jinsi alivyokwenda huku na huko akitenda mema na kuponya wote waliokuwa wameonewa na nguvu za ibilisi, kwa sababu Mungu alikuwa pamoja naye.

english: We are witnesses of all that He did, both in the land of the Jews and in Jerusalem. And although they put Him to death by hanging Him on a tree,
ekegusii: Na intwe nigo tore kirori b’amang’ana onsi aya arenge gokora ase ense y’Abayahudi na ime ya Yerusalemu. Bakamoita, bakamosunga ase omote,
swahili: “Sisi ni mashahidi wa mambo yote aliyoyafanya katika Uyahudi na Yerusalemu. Wakamuua kwa kumtundika msalabani.

english: Cornelius stared at him in fear and asked, “What is it, Lord?” The angel answered, “Your prayers and gifts to the poor have ascended as a memorial offering before God.
ekegusii: Akamorigereria mono, akairoka, akamobooria: “Naki Omonene?” Akamoiraneria: “Ogosaba kwao na ebiegwa biao biaikire igoro, na biabeire ekeinyorio ase obosio bwa Nyasae.
swahili: Kornelio akamkazia macho kwa hofu akasema, “Kuna nini, Bwana?” Malaika akamwambia, “Sala zako na sadaka zako kwa maskini zimefika juu na kuwa ukumbusho mbele za Mungu.

english: God raised Him up on the third day and caused Him to be seen—
ekegusii: korende Nyasae akamobokia ase rituko ria gatato, akamwanchera kooroka,
swahili: Lakini Mungu alimfufua kutoka kwa wafu siku ya tatu na akamwezesha kuonekana na watu.

english: not by all the people, but by the witnesses God had chosen beforehand, by us who ate and drank with Him after He rose from the dead.
ekegusii: tari ase abanto bonsi, korende nasetore, abatwachoretwe na Nyasae tobe kirori. Intwe nigo tware koria na konywa amo nere magega y’okoboka kwaye.
swahili: Hakuonekana kwa watu wote, lakini kwetu sisi tuliochaguliwa na Mungu kuwa mashahidi, ambao tulikula na kunywa naye baada ya kufufuka kwake kutoka kwa wafu.

english: And He commanded us to preach to the people and to testify that He is the One appointed by God to judge the living and the dead.
ekegusii: Agatochiika toranderie abanto, na tobe kirori ng’a nere ochoretwe na Nyasae abe omogambi bw’abare moyo na abakuure.
swahili: Naye alituamuru kuhubiri kwa watu wote na kushuhudia kwamba ndiye alitiwa mafuta na Mungu kuwa hakimu wa walio hai na wafu.

english: All the prophets testify about Him that everyone who believes in Him receives forgiveness of sins through His name.” The Gentiles Receive the Holy Spirit (Acts 19:1–7)
ekegusii: Oyo ababani bonsi baberete kirori, ng’a onde bwensi omwegenire nigo aranyore okwaberwa kw’ebibe ase erieta riaye.” Abanto b’Ebisaku bakonyora Omoika Omochenu na ebatiso
swahili: Manabii wote walishuhudia juu yake kwamba kila mtu amwaminiye hupokea msamaha wa dhambi katika Jina lake.” Watu Wa Mataifa Wapokea Roho Mtakatifu

english: While Peter was still speaking these words, the Holy Spirit fell upon all who heard his message.
ekegusii: Ekero Petero arenge gokwana aya Omoika Omochenu ogaikera bonsi abaigwete amang’ana aya.
swahili: Wakati Petro alikuwa akisema maneno haya, Roho Mtakatifu aliwashukia wote waliokuwa wakisikiliza ule ujumbe.

english: All the circumcised believers who had accompanied Peter were astounded that the gift of the Holy Spirit had been poured out even on the Gentiles.
ekegusii: Abegenete korwa ase abaarogete abachete amo na Petero, bagakumia, ekiagera nonya n’abanto b’Ebisaku banyorire ekeegwa ki’Omoika Omochenu.
swahili: Wale wa tohara walioamini waliokuja na Petro walishangaa kwa kuona kuwa kipawa cha Roho Mtakatifu kimemwagwa juu ya watu wa Mataifa.

english: For they heard them speaking in tongues and exalting God. Then Peter said,
ekegusii: Naki baabaigwete bagokwana ase emenwa ao ao, bagotogia Nyasae. Erio Petero akabora,
swahili: Kwa kuwa waliwasikia wakinena kwa lugha mpya na kumwadhimisha Mungu. Ndipo Petro akasema,

english: “Can anyone withhold the water to baptize these people? They have received the Holy Spirit just as we have!”
ekegusii: “Inee! Omonto nanyare kobatanga abanto aba, tibaabatiswa ase amache? Abanto abwo nabarabwo banyorire Omoika Omochenu koreng’ana buna intwe?”
swahili: “Je, kuna mtu yeyote anayeweza kuzuia watu hawa wasibatizwe kwa maji? Wamempokea Roho Mtakatifu kama sisi tulivyompokea.”

english: So he ordered that they be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ. Then they asked him to stay for a few days.
ekegusii: Agachiika baabatiswe ase erieta ria Yeso Kristo. Erio bakamobooria amente komenya amo nabarabwo amatuko atari make.
swahili: Kwa hiyo akaamuru wabatizwe kwa jina la Yesu Kristo. Wakamsihi Petro akae nao kwa siku chache.

english: Now send men to Joppa to call for a man named Simon who is called Peter.
ekegusii: Gaki, bono toma abanto Yopa barangerie Simioni, oyokorokwa Petero.
swahili: Sasa tuma watu waende Yafa wakamwite mtu mmoja jina lake Simoni aitwaye Petro.

english: He is staying with Simon the tanner, whose house is by the sea. ”
ekegusii: Ere nomogeni bw’omonto oyomo okorokwa Simioni, omooroisia bw’amao; enyomba yaye nigo ere ang’e nengegu y’enyancha.”
swahili: Yeye anaishi na Simoni mtengenezaji ngozi ambaye nyumba yake iko kando ya bahari.”

english: When the angel who spoke to him had gone, Cornelius called two of his servants and a devout soldier from among his attendants.
ekegusii: Ekero omomalaika, oria okwanete nere, aimoka korwa aroro, Kornelio akarangeria abasomba baye babere na omorwani oyomo osigete Nyasae korwa ase baria bare komokorera botambe,
swahili: Yule malaika aliyekuwa akizungumza naye alipoondoka, Kornelio akawaita watumishi wake wawili pamoja na askari mmoja mcha Mungu aliyekuwa miongoni mwa wale waliomtumikia.

english: The next day at about the sixth hour, as the men were approaching the city on their journey, Peter went up on the roof to pray.
ekegusii: Rituko rikobwatia, ekero baare kogenda, kobaikire ang’e nomochie, Petero akariina kerama igoro gochia gosaba koreng’ana chinsa isano nemo chia mobaso.
swahili: Siku ya pili yake, walipokuwa wameukaribia mji, wakati wa adhuhuri, Petro alipanda juu ya nyumba kuomba.

english: The apostles and brothers throughout Judea soon heard that the Gentiles also had received the word of God.
ekegusii: Naende abatomwa na abaminto abarenge Boyahudi bakaigwa ng’a abanto b’Ebisaku nabarabwo banyorire ring’ana ria Nyasae.
swahili: Mitume na ndugu walioamini waliokuwa huko Uyahudi wakasikia kuwa watu wa Mataifa nao wamepokea neno la Mungu.

english: This happened three times, and everything was drawn back up into heaven.
ekegusii: Ring’ana eri rigakoreka ara gatato, naende ebinto biria bionsi bikang’uswa gochia igoro.
swahili: Jambo hili lilitokea mara tatu, ndipo kile kitu kikavutwa tena mbinguni.

english: Just then three men sent to me from Caesarea stopped at the house where I was staying.
ekegusii: Ani! Ekero ekio abanto batato baikire ase enyomba eria namenyete, na barabwo nigo batometwe ase ’nde korwa Kaisaria.
swahili: “Wakati ule ule watu watatu, waliokuwa wametumwa kutoka Kaisaria waliwasili katika nyumba niliyokuwa nikikaa.

english: The Spirit told me to accompany them without hesitation. These six brothers also went with me, and we entered the man’s home.
ekegusii: Omoika Omochenu oganteebia ngende amo nabarabwo, timbaisa koba ne chitang’u‐tang’u. Na abaminto aba batano nomo bakagenda amo nainche, togasoa ase enyomba y’omonto oria;
swahili: Roho Mtakatifu akaniambia niende nao bila kuwa na ubaguzi kati yao na sisi. Hawa ndugu sita pia walifuatana nami, nasi tukaingia nyumbani mwa huyo Kornelio.

english: He told us how he had seen an angel standing in his house and saying, ‘Send to Joppa for Simon who is called Peter.
ekegusii: ere agatoteebia buna aroche omomalaika oteneine mwaye, na komoteebia: Toma abanto bagende Yopa, barangerie Simioni, oyokorokwa Petero.
swahili: Akatuambia jinsi alivyoona malaika aliyekuwa amesimama katika nyumba yake na kusema, ‘Tuma watu waende Yafa wakamlete Simoni aitwaye Petro.

english: He will convey to you a message by which you and all your household will be saved.’
ekegusii: Nere oragoteebie amang’ana ayarakorentere ogotooreka, aye na ab’enyomba yao yonsi.
swahili: Yeye atakupa ujumbe ambao kwa huo wewe na wa nyumbani mwako wote mtaokoka.’

english: As I began to speak, the Holy Spirit fell upon them, just as He had fallen upon us at the beginning.
ekegusii: Ekero nachaagete gokwana, Omoika Omochenu okabaikera buna otoikerete intwe agwo ritang’ani.
swahili: “Nami nilipoanza kusema, Roho Mtakatifu akashuka juu yao kama vile alivyotushukia sisi hapo mwanzo.

english: Then I remembered the word of the Lord, as He used to say, ‘John baptized with water, but you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit.’
ekegusii: Nkainyora ring’ana riria ri’Omonene, buna ateebete: Yohana nigo arenge kobatisa ase amaache, korende inwe inamobatiswe ase Omoika Omochenu.
swahili: Nami nikakumbuka neno la Bwana alivyosema, ‘Yohana alibatiza kwa maji, lakini ninyi mtabatizwa katika Roho Mtakatifu.’

english: So if God gave them the same gift He gave us who believed in the Lord Jesus Christ, who was I to hinder the work of God?”
ekegusii: Gaki, onye Nyasae obaeire barabwo ekeegwa keria keria atoete intwe, ekero twamwegenete Omenene oito Yeso Kristo, inche ninche ng’o, ndanyaare koamereria Nyasae?”
swahili: Basi ikiwa Mungu aliwapa hawa watu kipawa kile kile alichotupa sisi tuliomwamini Bwana Yesu Kristo, mimi ni nani hata nifikirie kuwa ningeweza kumpinga Mungu?”

english: When they heard this, their objections were put to rest, and they glorified God, saying, “So then, God has granted even the Gentiles repentance unto life.” The Church at Antioch
ekegusii: Ekero bachia koigwa amang’ana aya, bagakira‐kiri. Na barabwo bagatogia Nyasae, bagoteeba: “Gaki, Nyasae oeire abanto b’Ebisaku boigo okoonchoka okwo gokorenta obogima.” Ekanisa y’abanto b’Ebisaku ase Antiokia
swahili: Waliposikia haya hawakuwa na la kupinga zaidi. Nao wakamwadhimisha Mungu wakisema, “Basi, Mungu amewapa hata watu wa Mataifa toba iletayo uzima wa milele.” Kanisa La Antiokia

english: Meanwhile those scattered by the persecution that began with Stephen traveled as far as Phoenicia, Cyprus, and Antioch, speaking the message only to Jews.
ekegusii: Baria baatananegete magega y’emechando eria yabeete igoro ya Stefano bakagenda Foiniki na Kuporo, na Antiokia, bakarandia ring’ana ase Abayahudi boka, tari ase abanto bande.
swahili: Basi wale waliotawanyika kwa ajili ya mateso yaliyotokana na kifo cha Stefano, wakasafiri hadi Foinike na Kipro na Antiokia. Nao hawakuhubiri lile Neno kwa mtu yeyote isipokuwa Wayahudi.

english: So when Peter went up to Jerusalem, the circumcised believers took issue with him
ekegusii: Erio ekero Petero achete ase Yerusalemu, baria abare ensemo y’okwaroka bakaamererania nere,
swahili: Hivyo Petro alipopanda Yerusalemu, wale wa tohara waliokuwa wameamini wakamshutumu,

english: But some of them, men from Cyprus and Cyrene, went to Antioch and began speaking to the Greeks as well, proclaiming the good news about the Lord Jesus.
ekegusii: Korende mbarengeo ase egati yabo abanto ba Kuporo na Kurene, barabwo ekero bachia goika Antiokia bagakwana n’Abagiriki, bakabaranderia amang’ana amaya igoro y’Omonene Yeso.
swahili: Lakini baadhi yao walikuwepo watu wa Kipro na Kirene, ambao walipokuja Antiokia walinena na Wayunani pia wakiwahubiria habari njema za Bwana Yesu.

english: The hand of the Lord was with them, and a great number of people believed and turned to the Lord.
ekegusii: Okoboko kw’Omonene nigo kwarenge amo nabarabwo; abanto abange bakamwege n’Omonene, na komoonchokera.
swahili: Mkono wa Bwana ulikuwa pamoja nao, nayo idadi kubwa ya watu wakaamini na kumgeukia Bwana.

english: When news of this reached the ears of the church in Jerusalem, they sent Barnabas to Antioch.
ekegusii: Abanto b’ekanisa ya Yerusalemu bakaigwa amang’ana aya, bagatoma Barnaba agende Antiokia.
swahili: Habari hizi zilipofika masikioni mwa kanisa huko Yerusalemu, wakamtuma Barnaba aende Antiokia.

english: When he arrived and saw the grace of God, he rejoiced and encouraged them all to abide in the Lord with all their hearts.
ekegusii: Ere, ekero achia goika na korora buna obuya bwa Nyasae bwakorire, akagoka, agasorora bonsi babe abegenwa ase Omonene ase okogania gwe chinkoro.
swahili: Alipofika na kuona madhihirisho ya neema ya Mungu, akafurahi na kuwatia moyo waendelee kuwa waaminifu kwa Bwana kwa mioyo yao yote.

english: Barnabas was a good man, full of the Holy Spirit and faith, and a great number of people were brought to the Lord.
ekegusii: Ere nigo arenge omonto omuya, oichire n’Omoika Omochenu na okwegena. Abanto abange bakamenteka ase Omonene.
swahili: Barnaba alikuwa mtu mwema, aliyejaa Roho Mtakatifu, mwenye imani, nayo idadi kubwa ya watu wakaongezeka kwa Bwana.

english: Then Barnabas went to Tarsus to look for Saul,
ekegusii: Barnaba akarua agwo, akagenda Tariso korigia Saulo,
swahili: Kisha Barnaba akaenda Tarso kumtafuta Sauli,

english: and when he found him, he brought him back to Antioch. So for a full year they met together with the church and taught large numbers of people. The disciples were first called Christians at Antioch.
ekegusii: na ekero amonyorete akamorenta Antiokia. Ase engaki y’omwaka omogima bagasangererekana amo ase ekanisa na kworokereria abanto abange. Agwo Antiokia nao aborokigwa batang’anete korokwa Abakristo. Obotomwa bwa Barnaba na Saulo gochia Yerusalemu
swahili: naye alipompata akamleta Antiokia. Hivyo kwa mwaka mzima Barnaba na Sauli wakakutana na kanisa na kufundisha idadi kubwa ya watu. Ilikuwa ni katika kanisa la Antiokia kwa mara ya kwanza wanafunzi waliitwa Wakristo.

english: In those days some prophets came down from Jerusalem to Antioch.
ekegusii: Ase amatuko aria ababani bagatirimboka korwa Yerusalemu gochia Antiokia.
swahili: Wakati huo manabii walishuka toka Yerusalemu hadi Antiokia.

english: One of them named Agabus stood up and predicted through the Spirit that a great famine would sweep across the whole world. (This happened under Claudius.)
ekegusii: Oyomo obo, ore korokwa Agabo, agatenena akabana ase Omoika Omochenu, ng’a enchara enene nechiche ase ense engima; ero ekaba ekero Klaudio are kogamba.
swahili: Mmoja wao, jina lake Agabo, akasimama akatabiri kwa uweza wa Roho Mtakatifu kwamba njaa kubwa itaenea ulimwengu mzima. Njaa hiyo ilitokea wakati wa utawala wa Klaudio.

english: So the disciples, each according to his ability, decided to send relief to the brothers living in Judea.
ekegusii: Na aborokigwa baria, kera oyomo koreng’ana buna okonyara kwaye, bakang’ea gotoma ogokonywa ase abamwabo abamenyete Boyahudi.
swahili: Mitume wakaamua kwamba kila mtu, kulingana na uwezo alio nao, atoe msaada kwa ajili ya ndugu wanaoishi Uyahudi.

english: and said, “You visited uncircumcised men and ate with them.”
ekegusii: bakamoteebia: “Aye ngwasoa ase abanto batarogeti, okaragera amo nabarabwo!”
swahili: wakisema, “Ulikwenda kwa watu wasiotahiriwa na kula pamoja nao.”

english: This they did, sending their gifts to the elders with Barnabas and Saul.
ekegusii: Bagakora bo, bagatoma ebiegwa ase abagaaka ase amaboko a Barnaba na Saulo.
swahili: Wakafanya hivyo, misaada yao ikapelekwa kwa wazee kwa mikono ya Barnaba na Sauli.

english: But Peter began and explained to them the whole sequence of events:
ekegusii: Korende Petero agachaaka kobateebia amang’ana onsi buna abeete,
swahili: Ndipo Petro akaanza kuwaeleza kuhusu mambo yote yalivyotokea hatua kwa hatua akisema,

english: “I was in the city of Joppa praying, and in a trance I saw a vision of something like a large sheet being let down from heaven by its four corners, and it came right down to me.
ekegusii: “Nigo narenge ase omochie okorokwa Yopa, ngosaba nare, nkaba buna oyobwatire nobogondereria, nkarora ase okorora egento kere buna egetambaa kiabwatire emekoba ene, kegoikigwa korwa igoro gocha ase ’nde.
swahili: “Nilikuwa katika mji wa Yafa nikiomba, nami nikapitiwa na usingizi wa ghafula, nikaona maono. Kulikuwa na kitu kama nguo kubwa ikishuka kutoka mbinguni, ikishushwa kwa ncha zake nne, nayo ikanikaribia.

english: I looked at it closely and saw four-footed animals of the earth, wild beasts, reptiles, and birds of the air.
ekegusii: Ngakerigereria mono, nkarora ching’iti chire n’amagoro ane, ne ching’iti chi’orosana, amo n’echikwagura, n’chinyoni chia igoro.
swahili: Nilipoangalia ndani yake kwa karibu niliona wanyama wenye miguu minne wa nchini, wanyama wa mwitu, watambaao na ndege wa angani.

english: Then I heard a voice saying to me, ‘Get up, Peter, kill and eat.’
ekegusii: Nkaigwa eriogi rigonteebia: Petero, imoka, onyenye orie!
swahili: Ndipo nikasikia sauti ikiniambia, ‘Petro, ondoka uchinje na ule.’

english: ‘No, Lord,’ I said, ‘for nothing impure or unclean has ever entered my mouth.’
ekegusii: Korende nkabora: Yay’Omonene, ekiagera egento getachenegeti gose ekere neubi, tibiana gosoa ase omonwa one nonya ng’ake.
swahili: “Nikajibu, ‘La hasha Bwana! Kitu chochote kilicho najisi hakijaingia kinywani mwangu.’

english: But the voice spoke from heaven a second time, ‘Do not call anything impure that God has made clean.’
ekegusii: Eriogi riganteebia eria kabere korwa igoro: Eki Nyasae achenire tokeroka ng’a tikeri egechenu.
swahili: “Sauti ikasema kutoka mbinguni mara ya pili, ‘Usikiite najisi kitu chochote Mungu alichokitakasa.’

english: About that time, King Herod reached out to harm some who belonged to the church.
ekegusii: Nabo ase engaki eria, omorwoti Herode akarambora amaboko aye agachanda abanto bande b’ekanisa.
swahili: Wakati huo huo Mfalme Herode Agripa aliwakamata baadhi ya watu wa kanisa.

english: They passed the first and second guards and came to the iron gate leading to the city, which opened for them by itself. When they had gone outside and walked the length of one block, the angel suddenly left him.
ekegusii: Ekero bachia goetania ensemo ye ritang’ani na ensemo ya kabere ase abarendi barendete, bagaika egeita ki’ebioma kegosoerwa omochie ime. Eke gekabaigokera, na barabwo bagaeta ase enchera eyemo. Erio kegima omomalaika oria agatiga Petero.
swahili: Wakapita lindo la kwanza na la pili, ndipo wakafika kwenye lango la chuma linaloelekea mjini. Lango likawafungukia lenyewe, nao wakapita hapo wakatoka nje. Baada ya kutembea umbali wa mtaa mmoja, ghafula yule malaika akamwacha Petro.

english: Then Peter came to himself and said, “Now I know for sure that the Lord has sent His angel and rescued me from Herod’s grasp and from everything the Jewish people were anticipating.”
ekegusii: Ekero Petero achia komanya, agateeba: “Bono namanyire bori ng’a Omonene nere otoma omomalaika oye ochia kondusia ase okoboko kwa Herode, na korwa ase ogosemeria gwonsi kw’abaanto b’Abayahudi.”
swahili: Ndipo Petro akarudiwa na fahamu, akasema, “Sasa ninajua bila shaka yoyote kuwa Bwana amemtuma malaika wake na kuniokoa kutoka makucha ya Herode Agripa na kutoka matazamio yote ya Wayahudi.”

english: And when he had realized this, he went to the house of Mary the mother of John, also called Mark, where many people had gathered together and were praying.
ekegusii: Erio kayarengereretie aya, agaika ase enyomba ya Mariamu ng’ina Yohana, oyokorokwa naende Mariko; na abanto abange nao basangererekanete gosaba.
swahili: Mara Petro alipotambua hili alikwenda nyumbani kwa Maria, mama yake Yohana aliyeitwa pia Marko, ambako watu wengi walikuwa wamekutana kwa maombi.

english: He knocked at the outer gate, and a servant girl named Rhoda came to answer it.
ekegusii: Na ekero Petero achia gotura egesieri kia geita, omoiseke omosomba, okorokwa Roda, agaacha koigwa.
swahili: Petro alipobisha hodi kwenye lango la nje, mtumishi wa kike jina lake Roda, akaja kumfungulia.

english: When she recognized Peter’s voice, she was so overjoyed that she forgot to open the gate, but ran inside and announced, “Peter is standing at the gate!”
ekegusii: Kamanyire eriogi ria Petero, akaba nomogooko, taigora egesieri, korende akaminyoka, agasoa nyomba, akabateebia ng’a Petero ngesieri ateneine.
swahili: Alipoitambua sauti ya Petro, alifurahi mno akarudi bila kufungua na kuwaeleza kwamba, “Petro yuko langoni!”

english: “You are out of your mind,” they told her. But when she kept insisting it was so, they said, “It must be his angel.”
ekegusii: Bakamoteebia: “Nebarimo ore!” Korende akaamereria mono, agateeba ng’a naboigo are. Bakaboora: “Nomomalaika oye!”
swahili: Wakamwambia yule mtumishi wa kike, “Umerukwa na akili.” Alipozidi kusisitiza kuwa ni kweli, wakasema, “Lazima awe ni malaika wake.”

english: But Peter kept on knocking, and when they opened the door and saw him, they were astounded.
ekegusii: Petero akagenderera gokong’onta egesieri. Erio bakamoigorera, bakamorora, bagakumia.
swahili: Lakini Petro aliendelea kugonga langoni, nao walipofungua lango na kumwona Petro, walistaajabu sana.

english: Peter motioned with his hand for silence, and he described how the Lord had brought him out of the prison. “Send word to James and to the brothers,” he said, and he left for another place.
ekegusii: Ere akabakania nokoboko, ng’a bakire, tibakwana, akabateebereria buna Omonene amosokia korwa ase echela. Akabora: “Genda, moteebie Yakobo na abaminto amang’ana aya.” Agasoka, akagenda ensemo ende.
swahili: Yeye akawaashiria kwa mkono wake wanyamaze kimya, akawaeleza jinsi Bwana alivyomtoa gerezani. Naye akaongeza kusema, “Waelezeni Yakobo na ndugu wengine habari hizi.” Kisha akaondoka akaenda sehemu nyingine.

english: At daybreak there was no small commotion among the soldiers as to what had become of Peter.
ekegusii: Ekero bwachia gokia abarendi bagasogwa nomoondoko omonge igoro ya Petero, naki abeete.
swahili: Kulipokucha kukawa na fadhaa kubwa miongoni mwa wale askari kuhusu yaliyomtukia Petro.

english: After Herod had searched for him unsuccessfully, he examined the guards and ordered that they be executed. Then he went down from Judea to Caesarea and spent some time there. The Death of Herod
ekegusii: Herode akamorigia, tamonyora. Akana‐kounia abarendi, agachiika ng’a baitwe. Erio agatirimboka korwa Boyahudi, akagenda Kaisaria, akamenya aroro. Ogokwa kwa Herode
swahili: Baada ya Herode kuamuru atafutwe kila mahali na bila kumpata, aliwahoji wale askari walinzi kisha akatoa amri wauawe. Basi Herode Agripa akatoka Uyahudi akaenda Kaisaria, akakaa huko kwa muda. Kifo Cha Herode Agripa

english: He had James, the brother of John, put to death with the sword.
ekegusii: Agaita Yakobo omwabo Yohana nomoyio o birende.
swahili: Akaamuru Yakobo, ndugu yake Yohana, auawe kwa upanga.

english: Now Herod was in a furious dispute with the people of Tyre and Sidon, and they convened before him. Having secured the support of Blastus, the king’s chamberlain, they asked for peace, because their region depended on the king’s country for food.
ekegusii: Herode nigo abeete mono abanto ba Turo na Sidoni. Korende barabwo bakamochiera ase obomo, na ekero baebereirie Blasto, oyorenge korenda enyomba y’omorwoti, bakarigia omorembe, ekiagera ense yabo nigo yare konyora endagera korwa ase ense y’omorwoti.
swahili: Basi Herode Agripa alikuwa amekasirishwa sana na watu wa Tiro na Sidoni. Hivyo watu wa miji hiyo miwili wakaungana pamoja wakatafuta kukutana naye. Wakiisha kuungwa mkono na Blasto, mtumishi maalum wa Mfalme Herode Agripa aliyeaminika, wakaomba mapatano ya amani maana nchi zao zilitegemea nchi ya huyo mfalme kwa mahitaji yao ya chakula.

english: On the appointed day, Herod donned his royal robes, sat on his throne, and addressed the people.
ekegusii: Ase rituko erimo eriabekire, Herode akeboyia chianga chi’oborwoti, agaikaransa ase ekerogo ki’oborwoti, agakwana ase bare.
swahili: Katika siku iliyochaguliwa Herode Agripa akavaa mavazi yake ya kifalme, akaketi kwenye kiti chake cha enzi na kuwahutubia watu.

english: And they began to shout, “This is the voice of a god, not a man!”
ekegusii: Abanto bagaaka eriogi, bagateeba: “Eri neriogi ri’enyasae, tari eri’omonto!”
swahili: Watu waliokuwa wamekusanyika wakapiga kelele, wakisema, “Hii si sauti ya mwanadamu, bali ni ya Mungu.”

english: Immediately, because Herod did not give glory to God, an angel of the Lord struck him down, and he was eaten by worms and died.
ekegusii: Erio bwango omomalaika bw’Omonene akamoaka ekiagera atasigete Nyasae; akariegwa namakonde, agatweka mo.
swahili: Ghafula, kwa kuwa Herode hakumpa Mungu utukufu, malaika wa Bwana akampiga, naye akaliwa na chango, akafa.

english: But the word of God continued to spread and multiply.
ekegusii: Korende ring’ana ria Nyasae rikagenderera komentekana.
swahili: Lakini neno la Mungu likaendelea mbele na kuenea, nao wengi wakaambatana nalo.

english: When Barnabas and Saul had fulfilled their mission to Jerusalem, they returned, bringing with them John, also called Mark.
ekegusii: Barnaba na Saulo, ekero bakoorire obotomwa bwabo, bakairana korwa Yerusalemu, bakarentana Yohana ore korokwa Mariko.
swahili: Barnaba na Sauli walipomaliza ile huduma yao iliyowapeleka, wakarudi Yerusalemu wakiwa pamoja na Yohana aitwaye Marko.

english: And seeing that this pleased the Jews, Herod proceeded to seize Peter during the Feast of Unleavened Bread.
ekegusii: Ekero aroche ng’a aya agweneire Abayahudi, akagenderera, Petero nere akabwatwa. Amatuko ayio naro amatuko emegati etabekiri memera.
swahili: Alipoona jambo hilo limewapendeza Wayahudi, akaendelea, akamkamata pia Petro. Hii ilitokea wakati wa Sikukuu ya Mikate Isiyotiwa Chachu.

english: He arrested him and put him in prison, handing him over to be guarded by four squads of four soldiers each. Herod intended to bring him out to the people after the Passover. The Rescue of Peter
ekegusii: Akamobwata akamobeka echela ime. Akamobeka ase ebiombe bine bi’abarwani; kera ekeombe nigo kiare nabarwani bane. Barabwo bakamorenda. Akarigia komosokia ase abanto magega y’Epasaka.
swahili: Baada ya kumkamata alimtia gerezani, chini ya ulinzi wa vikundi vinne vya askari, vyenye askari wanne kila kimoja. Herode alikuwa amekusudia kumtoa na kumfanyia mashtaka mbele ya watu baada ya Pasaka.

english: So Peter was kept in prison, but the church was fervently praying to God for him.
ekegusii: Nabo Petero arendetwe ase echela ime, abanto b’ekanisa bakamosabera ase Nyasae nomoyo bw’omokia.
swahili: Kwa hiyo Petro akawekwa gerezani, lakini kanisa lilikuwa likimwombea kwa Mungu kwa bidii.

english: On the night before Herod was to bring him to trial, Peter was sleeping between two soldiers, bound with two chains, with sentries standing guard at the entrance to the prison.
ekegusii: Ase obotuko boria bwatang’anerete rituko riria Herode arengereretie komoira ase ekegambero, Petero nigo arenge oraire gati y’abarendi babere, osibire nebinyuri bibere, na abarwani nigo barenge gesieri barendete echela.
swahili: Usiku ule kabla ya siku ambayo Herode Agripa alikuwa amekusudia kumtoa na kumfanyia mashtaka, Petro alikuwa amelala kati ya askari wawili, akiwa amefungwa kwa minyororo miwili. Nao walinzi wa zamu walikuwa wakilinda penye lango la gereza.

english: Suddenly an angel of the Lord appeared and a light shone in the cell. He tapped Peter on the side and woke him up, saying, “Get up quickly.” And the chains fell off his wrists.
ekegusii: Na rora, omomalaika bw’Omonene akamoorokera, na amasase akamoreka akanyomba ime. Omomalaika oria agaaka Petero rikere riaye, akamotura, agateeba: “Imoka bwango!” Ebinyuri bigasansoka korwa ase amaboko aye.
swahili: Ghafula malaika wa Bwana akatokea na nuru ikamulika mle ndani ya gereza. Yule malaika akampiga Petro ubavuni na kumwamsha, akisema, “Ondoka upesi!” Mara ile minyororo ikaanguka kutoka mikononi mwa Petro.

english: “Get dressed and put on your sandals,” said the angel. Peter did so, and the angel told him, “Wrap your cloak around you and follow me.”
ekegusii: Omomalaika akamoteebia: “Eboyie, obeke ebikoroto biao.” Agakora bo. Naende akamoteebia: “Beka eganchwa yao, ontunyane!”
swahili: Yule malaika akamwambia, “Vaa nguo zako na viatu vyako.” Petro akafanya hivyo. Kisha akamwambia, “Jifunge vazi lako na unifuate.”

english: So Peter followed him out, but he was unaware that what the angel was doing was real. He thought he was only seeing a vision.
ekegusii: Agasoka, akamotunyana, gose tamanyete ng’a ayakoretwe nomomalaika nay’ekeene, korende agakaga ng’a nokorora arorire.
swahili: Petro akatoka mle gerezani akiwa amefuatana na yule malaika. Hakujua wakati huo kuwa yaliyokuwa yakitukia yalikuwa kweli. Alidhani kuwa anaona maono.

english: Now in the church at Antioch there were prophets and teachers: Barnabas, Simeon called Niger, Lucius of Cyrene, Manaen (who had been brought up with Herod the tetrarch), and Saul.
ekegusii: Ase ekanisa ya Abantiokia mbarengeo ababani amo aborokia: Barnaba na Simioni, oyo ore korokwa Nigeri, na Lukio Omokurene, na Manaeni oyo orereretwe amo nomorwoti Herode, na Saulo.
swahili: Katika kanisa huko Antiokia ya Shamu walikuwako manabii na walimu, yaani: Barnaba, Simeoni aitwaye Nigeri, Lukio Mkirene, Manaeni aliyekuwa amelelewa pamoja na Mfalme Herode Agripa, na Sauli.

english: and said, “O child of the devil and enemy of all righteousness, you are full of all kinds of deceit and trickery! Will you never stop perverting the straight ways of the Lord?
ekegusii: “Aye omwana o Saitani omobisa bw’oboronge bwonsi, oichire nobong’ainereria n’obobe bwonsi, torigeti gotiga gokora bogeka chinchera chia Nyasae Omobui chire boronge?
swahili: akamwambia, “Ewe mwana wa ibilisi, wewe ni adui wa kila kilicho haki! Umejaa kila aina ya udanganyifu na ulaghai. Je, hutaacha kuzipotosha njia za Bwana zilizonyooka?

english: Now look, the hand of the Lord is against you, and for a time you will be blind and unable to see the light of the sun.” Immediately mist and darkness came over him, and he groped about, seeking someone to lead him by the hand.
ekegusii: Rora bono, okoboko kw’Omonene nigo kore igoro ase ore, aye nobe omouko, torora erioba ase engaki.” Erio kegima akabwatwa norotutu na omosunte, agataba‐taba akarigia abanto bamobwate okoboko bamoraae.
swahili: Nawe sasa sikiliza, mkono wa Bwana u dhidi yako. Utakuwa kipofu, wala hutaona jua kwa muda.” Mara ukungu na giza vikamfunika, naye akaenda huku na huko akitafuta mtu wa kumshika mkono ili amwonyeshe njia.

english: When the proconsul saw what had happened, he believed, for he was astonished at the teaching about the Lord. In Pisidian Antioch
ekegusii: Ekero gabana achia korora ayakoreka, akeegena, agakumia ase okworokereria kw’Omonene. Ase Antiokia ya Pisidia. Okorandia gwa Paulo ase Abayahudi
swahili: Yule mkuu wa kile kisiwa alipoona yaliyotukia, akaamini kwa sababu alistaajabishwa na mafundisho kuhusu Bwana. Paulo Na Barnaba Huko Antiokia Ya Pisidia

english: After setting sail from Paphos, Paul and his companions came to Perga in Pamphylia, where John left them to return to Jerusalem.
ekegusii: Erio Paulo na abamwabo bakamanora n’emeeri korwa Pafo, bagaika Perga ase Pamfulia. Yohana akabatiga, akairana Yerusalemu,
swahili: Kisha Paulo na wenzake wakasafiri toka Pafo wakafika Perga huko Pamfilia. Lakini, Yohana Marko akawaacha huko, akarejea Yerusalemu.

english: And from Perga, they traveled inland to Pisidian Antioch, where they entered the synagogue on the Sabbath and sat down.
ekegusii: korende barabwo bakarua Perga, bakagenda Antiokia, omochie o Pisidia. Rituko ria Esabato bagasoa ase esinagogi, bagaikaransa aroro.
swahili: Kutoka Perga wakaendelea hadi Antiokia ya Pisidia. Siku ya Sabato wakaingia ndani ya sinagogi, wakaketi.

english: After the reading from the Law and the Prophets, the synagogue leaders sent word to them: “Brothers, if you have a word of encouragement for the people, please speak.”
ekegusii: Magega kabasomire amachiiko na egetabu y’ababani, abatang’ani b’esinagogi bagatoma amang’ana ase bare kobateebia: “Abaminto, onye more ne ring’ana ri’okoremia, rikwane!”
swahili: Baada ya Sheria ya Mose na Kitabu cha Manabii kusomwa, viongozi wa sinagogi wakawatumia ujumbe wakisema, “Ndugu, kama mna neno la kuwafariji watu hawa, tafadhali lisemeni.”

english: Paul stood up, motioned with his hand, and began to speak: “Men of Israel and you Gentiles who fear God, listen to me!
ekegusii: Paulo agatenena, akarambora okoboko, agakwana: Inwe abasacha b’Abaisraeli, na inwe abamoirogete Nyasae, ntegerera.
swahili: Paulo akasimama, akawapungia mkono na kusema: “Enyi wanaume wa Israeli na ninyi nyote mnaomcha Mungu.

english: The God of the people of Israel chose our fathers. He made them into a great people during their stay in Egypt, and with an uplifted arm He led them out of that land.
ekegusii: Nyasae bw’abaanto aba Abaisraeli agachora chisokoro chiaito, na ekero barabwo bamenyete buna abamenyi ase ense ya Misiri, akabaimokereria igoro. Ase okobua kwaye akabarusia aroro,
swahili: Mungu wa watu hawa wa Israeli aliwachagua baba zetu, akawafanya kustawi walipokuwa huko Misri, kwa uwezo mwingi akawaongoza na kuwatoa katika nchi ile.

english: He endured their conduct for about forty years in the wilderness.
ekegusii: na koreng’ana engaki y’emiaka emerongo ene akaremereria nabarabwo ase erooro.
swahili: Kwa muda wa miaka arobaini alivumilia matendo yao walipokuwa jangwani.

english: And having vanquished seven nations in Canaan, He gave their land to His people as an inheritance.
ekegusii: Agasiria ebisaku bitano na bibere ase ense ya Kaanani, na ense yabo akabaa ebe omwando obo,
swahili: Naye baada ya kuyaangamiza mataifa saba waliokuwa wakiishi katika nchi ya Kanaani, akawapa Waisraeli nchi yao iwe urithi wao.

english: While they were worshiping the Lord and fasting, the Holy Spirit said, “Set apart for Me Barnabas and Saul for the work to which I have called them.”
ekegusii: Aba iga, ekero barenge gosasiima Omonene, na kweng’ata, Omoika Omochenu agateeba: “Nchorere Barnaba na Saulo ase emeremo eria nabarangereretie bayekore.”
swahili: Walipokuwa wakimwabudu Bwana na kufunga, Roho Mtakatifu akasema, “Nitengeeni Sauli na Barnaba kwa kazi ile maalum niliyowaitia.”

english: All this took about 450 years. After this, God gave them judges until the time of Samuel the prophet.
ekegusii: koreng’ana engaki y’emiaka amagana ane, na emerongo etano. Magega y’ayio akabaa abagaambi goika ekero ki’omobani Samweli.
swahili: Haya yote yalichukua kama muda wa miaka 450. “Baada ya haya, Mungu akawapa waamuzi mpaka wakati wa nabii Samweli.

english: Then the people asked for a king, and God gave them forty years under Saul son of Kish, from the tribe of Benjamin.
ekegusii: Erio magega yaye bagasaba baegwe omorwoti. Nyasae akabaa Saulo, mosinto o Kishi, omonto bw’ororeria rwa Benjamini, oyio obagamberete engaki y’emiaka emerongo ene.
swahili: Ndipo watu wakaomba wapewe mfalme, naye Mungu akawapa Sauli mwana wa Kishi wa kabila la Benyamini, aliyetawala kwa miaka arobaini.

english: After removing Saul, He raised up David as their king and testified about him: ‘I have found David son of Jesse a man after My own heart; he will carry out My will in its entirety.’
ekegusii: Ekero konya amorusirie oyo, akaimokereria Daudi igoro koba omorwoti obo. Akabateebia igoro yaye: Nanyorire Daudi, mosinto o Yese; nere omonto ongweneire ase enkoro yane, naende nere oraanyare gokora ogwancha kwane gwonsi.
swahili: Baada ya kumwondoa Sauli katika ufalme, akawainulia Daudi kuwa mfalme wao. Mungu pia alimshuhudia, akisema, ‘Nimemwona Daudi mwana wa Yese, mtu anayeupendeza moyo wangu, atakayetimiza mapenzi yangu yote.’

english: From the descendants of this man, God has brought to Israel the Savior Jesus, as He promised.
ekegusii: Korwa ase oroiboro rw’omonto oyio Nyasae orenteire Abaisraeli Omotooria, nere Yeso. Nabo abarierete eira.
swahili: “Kutoka uzao wa mtu huyu, Mungu amewaletea Israeli Mwokozi Yesu, kama alivyoahidi.

english: Before the arrival of Jesus, John preached a baptism of repentance to all the people of Israel.
ekegusii: Ritang’ani ere ataraacha, Yohana konya obarandeirie abanto bonsi ba Israeli ebatiso y’okoonchoka.
swahili: Kabla ya kuja kwa Yesu, Yohana alihubiri toba na ubatizo kwa watu wote wa Israeli.

english: As John was completing his course, he said, ‘Who do you suppose I am? I am not that One. But He is coming after me whose sandals I am not worthy to untie.’
ekegusii: Ekero Yohana abeire ang’e gokoora orogendo rwaye akabora, Nigo mokagete ng’a ninche ng’o? Inche tari Kristo. Korende magega yane ngocha are oyomo, ere oyo inche ntaisaini gosibora chinuga ch’ebikoroto bi’amagoro aye.
swahili: Yohana alipokuwa anakamilisha kazi yake, alisema: ‘Ninyi mnadhani mimi ni nani? Mimi si yeye. La hasha, lakini yeye yuaja baada yangu, ambaye mimi sistahili kufungua kamba za viatu vya miguu yake.’

english: Brothers, children of Abraham, and you Gentiles who fear God, it is to us that this message of salvation has been sent.
ekegusii: Abaminto, abanto b’ororeria rwa Aburaamu, amo nabande ase more inwe abamoirogete Nyasae, ring’ana ri’ogotooreka riatomirwe ase tore.
swahili: “Ndugu zangu, wana wa Abrahamu, nanyi watu wa Mataifa mnaomcha Mungu, ujumbe huu wa wokovu umeletwa kwetu.

english: The people of Jerusalem and their rulers did not recognize Jesus, yet in condemning Him they fulfilled the words of the prophets that are read every Sabbath.
ekegusii: Naki abamenyete Yerusalemu, na abanene babo tibamomanyete, ekiagera tibamanyete nonya namang’ana y’ababani. Ase okomogambia baikeranirie ayare gosomwa ase chibuku chi’ababani kera Esabato.
swahili: Kwa sababu wakaao Yerusalemu na viongozi wao hawakumtambua wala kuelewa maneno ya manabii yasomwayo kila Sabato, bali waliyatimiza maneno hayo kwa kumhukumu yeye.

english: And though they found no ground for a death sentence, they asked Pilate to have Him executed.
ekegusii: Nonya tibanyorete engencho y’okomoita, bagasaba Pilato aitwe.
swahili: Ijapokuwa hawakupata sababu yoyote ya kumhukumu kifo, walimwomba Pilato aamuru auawe.

english: When they had carried out all that was written about Him, they took Him down from the tree and laid Him in a tomb.
ekegusii: Ekero bachia goikerania onsi ayariikire igoro yaye, bakamoikia korwa ase omote, bakamobeka ase oboina.
swahili: Walipokwisha kufanya yale yote yaliyoandikwa kumhusu, walimshusha kutoka msalabani na kumzika kaburini.

english: And after they had fasted and prayed, they laid their hands on them and sent them off. On Cyprus
ekegusii: Erio kobakoorire okweng’ata na ogosaba bakababeekera amaboko, bakabatiga bagende. Barnaba na Saulo ase Kuporo
swahili: Ndipo baada ya kufunga na kuomba, wakawawekea mikono yao na wakawatuma waende zao. Barnaba Na Sauli Waenda Kipro

english: But God raised Him from the dead,
ekegusii: Korende Nyasae akamobokia korwa ase abakuure.
swahili: Lakini Mungu alimfufua kutoka kwa wafu.

english: and for many days He was seen by those who had accompanied Him from Galilee to Jerusalem. They are now His witnesses to our people.
ekegusii: Ase amatuko amange akarorekana ase abwo barenge gotiira komo korwa Galili goika Yerusalemu. Bono barabwo kirori baye bare ase abanto.
swahili: Naye kwa siku nyingi akawatokea wale waliokuwa pamoja naye kuanzia Galilaya hadi Yerusalemu. Nao sasa wamekuwa mashahidi wake kwa watu wetu.

english: And now we proclaim to you the good news: What God promised our fathers
ekegusii: Na intwe twabarenteire amang’ana amaya aria Nyasae arierete chisokoro chiaito eira.
swahili: “Nasi tunawaletea habari njema, kwamba yale Mungu aliyowaahidi baba zetu

english: He has fulfilled for us, their children, by raising up Jesus. As it is written in the second Psalm: ‘You are My Son; today I have become Your Father.’
ekegusii: Aya Nyasae atoikeraneirie intwe abana babo ase okobokia Yeso. Naende buna ariikire ase Zaburi ibere: Aye naye Omwana one, reero nakoiboire.
swahili: sasa ameyatimiza kwetu sisi watoto wao, kwa kumfufua Yesu, kama ilivyoandikwa katika Zaburi ya pili: “ ‘Wewe ni Mwanangu; leo mimi nimekuzaa.’

english: In fact, God raised Him from the dead, never to see decay. As He has said: ‘I will give you the holy and sure blessings promised to David.’
ekegusii: Naende ng’a nigo amobogetie korwa ase abakuure, erinde tanyara koirana naende ase ogosareka, okwanire iga, Nimbae ogosesenigwa ogochenu na ogw’ekeene, koria narierete Daudi eira.
swahili: Kwa kuwa Mungu alimfufua kutoka kwa wafu asioze kamwe, alitamka maneno haya: “ ‘Nitakupa wewe baraka takatifu zilizo za hakika nilizomwahidi Daudi.’

english: So also, He says in another Psalm: ‘You will not let Your Holy One see decay.’
ekegusii: Ase ayio okwanire naende ase Zaburi ende, Togotiga Omochenu oo arore ogosareka.
swahili: Kama ilivyosemwa mahali pengine katika Zaburi, “ ‘Hutamwacha Aliye Mtakatifu wako kuona uharibifu.’

english: For when David had served God’s purpose in his own generation, he fell asleep. His body was buried with his fathers and saw decay.
ekegusii: Naki Daudi, ekero akoorire gokorera ogwancha kwa Nyasae ase ekegori kiaye, agakwa, agatindekwa ase chisokoro chiaye chiatindegetwe, akarora ogosareka.
swahili: “Kwa maana Daudi akiisha kulitumikia kusudi la Mungu katika kizazi chake, alilala; akazikwa pamoja na baba zake na mwili wake ukaoza.

english: But the One whom God raised from the dead did not see decay.
ekegusii: Korende oyo obogetigwe na Nyasae taroche ogosareka.
swahili: Lakini yule ambaye Mungu alimfufua kutoka kwa wafu hakuona uharibifu.

english: Therefore let it be known to you, brothers, that through Jesus the forgiveness of sins is proclaimed to you.
ekegusii: Ase ayio baminto, tiga amanyekane ase more ng’a goetera ase oyio nigo mokoranderigwa okwaberwa kw’ebibe,
swahili: “Kwa hiyo ndugu zangu, nataka ninyi mjue kwamba kwa kupitia huyu Yesu msamaha wa dhambi unatangazwa kwenu.

english: Through Him everyone who believes is justified from everything you could not be justified from by the law of Moses.
ekegusii: na asere kera oyomwegenire nigo akobarerwa oboronge ase amang’ana aria atakonyarekana kobarerwa oboronge ase amachiiko a Musa.
swahili: Kwa kupitia yeye, kila mtu amwaminiye anahesabiwa haki kwa kila kitu ambacho asingeweza kuhesabiwa haki kwa sheria ya Mose.

english: So Barnabas and Saul, sent forth by the Holy Spirit, went down to Seleucia and sailed from there to Cyprus.
ekegusii: Abwo babere bagatomwa n’Omoika Omochenu, bagatirimboka gochia Selukia, na korwa agwo bakaamboka n’emeeri gochia Kuporo.
swahili: Hivyo, wakiwa wametumwa na Roho Mtakatifu, wakashuka kwenda Seleukia na kutoka huko wakasafiri baharini mpaka kisiwa cha Kipro.

english: Watch out, then, that what was spoken by the prophets does not happen to you:
ekegusii: Gaki, erende, tabaisa kobaikera amang’ana aria akwanetwe nababani:
swahili: Kwa hiyo jihadharini ili yale waliyosema manabii yasiwapate:

english: ‘Look, you scoffers, wonder and perish! For I am doing a work in your days that you would never believe, even if someone told you.’ ” A Light for the Gentiles (Isaiah 49:1–6)
ekegusii: Rigereria, inwe abachaayi, mokumie na mosire, ekiagera ngochia gokora ’nde ring’ana ase amatuko aino, eri motegene nonya ’monto onde bwensi naisa kobateebia.
swahili: “ ‘Angalieni, enyi wenye dhihaka, mkastaajabu, mkaangamie, kwa maana nitatenda jambo wakati wenu ambalo hamtasadiki, hata kama mtu akiwaambia.’ ”

english: As Paul and Barnabas were leaving the synagogue, the people urged them to continue this message on the next Sabbath.
ekegusii: Kabasokire, abanto bakabasorora bache kobateebia amang’ana aya Esabato ya kabere.
swahili: Paulo na Barnaba walipokuwa wakitoka nje ya sinagogi, watu wakawaomba wazungumze tena mambo hayo Sabato iliyofuata.

english: After the synagogue was dismissed, many of the Jews and devout converts to Judaism followed Paul and Barnabas, who spoke to them and urged them to continue in the grace of God.
ekegusii: Ekero omosangererekano bw’esinagogi oera, Abayahudi abange na abegeni b’ebisaku binde abaonchogete bakabwatana na Paulo na Barnaba, abakwanete nabarabwo, na kobaremia bagenderere ase obuya bwa Nyasae. Abatomwa bakogenda ase abanto b’Ebisaku
swahili: Baada ya kusanyiko la Sinagogi kutawanyika, wengi wa Wayahudi na waongofu wa dini ya Kiyahudi wakawafuata Paulo na Barnaba, wakazungumza nao na kuwahimiza wadumu katika neema ya Mungu.

english: On the following Sabbath, nearly the whole city gathered to hear the word of the Lord.
ekegusii: Ase Esabato ya kabere abanto abange, ang’e omochie bwonsi, bagasangererekana baigwe ring’ana ria Nyasae.
swahili: Sabato iliyofuata, karibu watu wote wa mji walikuja kusikiliza neno la Bwana.

english: But when the Jews saw the crowds, they were filled with jealousy, and they blasphemously contradicted what Paul was saying.
ekegusii: Korende ekero Abayahudi bachia korora emeganda, bagaichorwa ne ribero, bagakaana amang’ana ayare gokwanwa na Paulo, bakamorama.
swahili: Lakini Wayahudi walipoona ule umati mkubwa wa watu walijawa na wivu, wakayakanusha maneno Paulo aliyokuwa akisema.

english: Then Paul and Barnabas answered them boldly: “It was necessary to speak the word of God to you first. But since you reject it and do not consider yourselves worthy of eternal life, we now turn to the Gentiles.
ekegusii: Paulo na Barnaba bagakwana noboremu, bagateeba: Igo yagwenerete ng’a ring’ana ria Nyasae rikwanwe ase more ritang’ani. Korende ekiagera mwarisukeirie are mwenacheire inwe abanyene ng’a timogwenereti obogima bwa kare na kare, tweonchoreire abanto b’Ebisaku.
swahili: Ndipo Paulo na Barnaba wakawajibu kwa ujasiri, wakisema, “Ilitupasa kunena nanyi neno la Mungu kwanza. Lakini kwa kuwa mmelikataa, mkajihukumu wenyewe kuwa hamstahili uzima wa milele, sasa tunawageukia watu wa Mataifa.

english: For this is what the Lord has commanded us: ‘I have made you a light for the Gentiles, to bring salvation to the ends of the earth.’ ”
ekegusii: Nabo twachigetwe n’Omonene, Nakobekire obe omobaso ase abanto b’Ebisaku, erinde ogotooreka kwane kogende, goike ase chinsinyo chi’ense.
swahili: Kwa maana hili ndilo Bwana alilotuamuru: “ ‘Nimewafanya ninyi kuwa nuru kwa watu wa Mataifa, ili mpate kuuleta wokovu hadi miisho ya dunia.’ ”

english: When the Gentiles heard this, they rejoiced and glorified the word of the Lord, and all who were appointed for eternal life believed.
ekegusii: Ekero abanto b’Ebisaku bachia koigwa ayio bakagoka, bagatogia ring’ana ri’Omonene, na abwo bachiikeretwe konyora obogima bwa kare na kare bakeegena.
swahili: Watu wa Mataifa waliposikia haya wakafurahi na kulitukuza neno la Bwana; nao wote waliokuwa wamekusudiwa uzima wa milele wakaamini.

english: And the word of the Lord spread throughout that region.
ekegusii: Ring’ana ri’Omonene rikaranda ase ense eria yonsi.
swahili: Neno la Bwana likaenea katika eneo lile lote.

english: When they arrived at Salamis, they proclaimed the word of God in the Jewish synagogues. And John was with them as their helper.
ekegusii: Bagaika Salami, bakarandia ring’ana ria Nyasae ase chisinagogi chi’Abayahudi, na barabwo nigo barenge na Yohana okobakonya.
swahili: Walipowasili katika mji wa Salami, wakahubiri neno la Mungu katika sinagogi la Wayahudi. Pia walikuwa na Yohana Marko kuwa msaidizi wao.

english: The Jews, however, incited the religious women of prominence and the leading men of the city. They stirred up persecution against Paul and Barnabas and drove them out of their district.
ekegusii: Abayahudi bakaburukania abakungu abamoirogete Nyasae, abasikire n’abanto, na abanene b’omochie, bakagenka abanto bachande Paulo na Barnaba, na kobaseria korwa ensemo yabo.
swahili: Lakini Wayahudi wakawachochea wanawake wenye kumcha Mungu, wenye vyeo pamoja na watu maarufu katika mji, wakachochea mateso dhidi ya Paulo na Barnaba na kuwafukuza kutoka eneo hilo.

english: So they shook the dust off their feet in protest against them and went to Iconium.
ekegusii: Korende Paulo na Barnaba bakabakong’ontera orotu rw’amagoro abo, bakagenda Ikonio.
swahili: Hivyo Paulo na Barnaba wakakungʼuta mavumbi ya miguu yao ili kuwapinga, nao wakaenda Ikonio.

english: And the disciples were filled with joy and with the Holy Spirit.
ekegusii: Na aborokigwa bagaichorwa nomogooko na Omoika Omochenu.
swahili: Wanafunzi wakajawa na furaha na Roho Mtakatifu.

english: They traveled through the whole island as far as Paphos, where they found a Jewish sorcerer and false prophet named Bar-Jesus,
ekegusii: Ekero bakoorire goeta gati‐gati y’egesinka gionsi goika Pafo, bakanyora aroro omonto oyomo Omoyahudi omoriingoria, omobani bw’oborimo, ore korokwa Bar-Yeso.
swahili: Walipokwisha kupita katika nchi zote hizo wakafika Pafo, ambapo walikutana na Myahudi mmoja mchawi aliyekuwa nabii wa uongo, jina lake Bar-Yesu.

english: an attendant of the proconsul, Sergius Paulus. The proconsul, a man of intelligence, summoned Barnabas and Saul because he wanted to hear the word of God.
ekegusii: Omonto oyio nigo arenge amo na gabana Sergio Paulo, omonto bw’obong’aini. Ere akarangeria Barnaba na Saulo bache asare, akarigia koigwa ring’ana ria Nyasae.
swahili: Mtu huyu alikuwa pamoja na Sergio Paulo, mtu mwenye hekima aliyekuwa msaidizi wa mwakilishi wa mtawala wa kile kisiwa. Sergio Paulo akawaita Sauli na Barnaba akitaka kusikia neno la Mungu.

english: But Elymas the sorcerer (for that is what his name means) opposed them and tried to turn the proconsul from the faith.
ekegusii: Korende Elima, oria omoringoria (okoonchorwa kw’erieta riaye nakwo oko) akaamererania nabarabwo, akarigia koonchora gabana oria atige okwegena.
swahili: Lakini Elima yule mchawi (hii ndiyo maana ya jina lake), aliwapinga Barnaba na Sauli na kujaribu kumpotosha yule mkuu wa kile kisiwa aiache imani.

english: Then Saul, who was also called Paul, filled with the Holy Spirit, looked directly at Elymas
ekegusii: Korende Saulo, oyokorokwa naende Paulo, agaichorwa n’Omoika Omochenu, akamotogoreria amaiso, akabora,
swahili: Ndipo Sauli, ambaye pia aliitwa Paulo, akiwa amejawa na Roho Mtakatifu, akamkazia macho Elima huyo mchawi,

english: At Iconium, Paul and Barnabas went as usual into the Jewish synagogue, where they spoke so well that a great number of Jews and Greeks believed.
ekegusii: Aaria Ikonio Paulo na Barnaba bagasoa esinagogi amo buna engencho yarenge, bagakwana n’oboikeranu goika abanto abange b’Abayahudi na b’Ebisaku bakeegena.
swahili: Huko Ikonio Paulo na Barnaba waliingia pamoja katika sinagogi la Wayahudi kama ilivyokuwa desturi yao. Huko wakahubiri kwa uwezo mkubwa kiasi kwamba Wayahudi pamoja na watu wa Mataifa wakaamini.

english: In a loud voice Paul called out, “Stand up on your feet!” And the man jumped up and began to walk.
ekegusii: agakwana neriogi rinene, agateeba: “Tenena boronge namagoro ao.” Agatenena bwango, agataarataara.
swahili: Paulo akapaza sauti, “Simama kwa miguu yako!” Mara yule mtu akasimama upesi akaanza kutembea!

english: When the crowds saw what Paul had done, they lifted up their voices in the Lycaonian language: “The gods have come down to us in human form!”
ekegusii: Ekero emeganda yachia korora aya Paulo akora, bagaaka amariogi abo, bagakwana ase Ekelukania: “Chinyasae chiatoikeire ase emegwekano ya Mwanyabaanto!”
swahili: Ule umati wa watu ulipoona yaliyokuwa yamefanywa na Paulo, wakapiga kelele kwa lugha yao ya Kilikaonia wakasema, “Miungu imetushukia katika umbo la binadamu!”

english: Barnabas they called Zeus, and Paul they called Hermes, because he was the chief speaker.
ekegusii: Bakaroka Barnaba Zeu, na Paulo Herme, ekiagera nere orenge omonene ase ogokwana.
swahili: Wakamwita Barnaba Zeu na Paulo wakamwita Herme kwa kuwa ndiye alikuwa msemaji mkuu.

english: The priest of Zeus, whose temple was just outside the city, brought bulls and wreaths to the city gates, hoping to offer a sacrifice along with the crowds.
ekegusii: Omokuani o Zeu, oyo Hekalu yaye yarenge isiko y’omochie, akarenta chieri na ebisembe bi’ebisicha goika ase ebiita; ere amo n’abanto bakarigia korua ekeng’wanso.
swahili: Kuhani wa Zeu, ambaye hekalu lake lilikuwa nje kidogo tu ya mji, akaleta mafahali na mashada ya maua penye lango la mji kwa sababu yeye na ule umati wa watu walitaka kuwatolea dhabihu.

english: But when the apostles Barnabas and Paul found out about this, they tore their clothes and rushed into the crowd, shouting,
ekegusii: Korende abatomwa Barnaba na Paulo, ekero bachia koigwa amang’ana ayio bagatandora chianga chiabo, bakaayerera, bagasoa ase omoganda, bagaaka egeturi, bagoteeba,
swahili: Lakini mitume Paulo na Barnaba waliposikia haya, wakararua nguo zao, wakawaendea wale watu kwa haraka, wakawapigia kelele, wakisema,

english: “Men, why are you doing this? We too are only men, human like you. We are bringing you good news that you should turn from these worthless things to the living God, who made heaven and earth and sea and everything in them.
ekegusii: “Inwe abasacha! Nase ki mogokora aya? Intwe nigo tore Mwanyabaanto koreng’ana buna inwe. Twabarandeirie inwe amang’ana amaya, erinde motige chinyasae echi chia bosa, moonchokere Nyasae ore moyo, oyotongete igoro na ense, na enyancha, na ebinto ebire imeo.
swahili: “Enyi watu, kwa nini mnafanya mambo haya? Sisi ni wanadamu tu kama ninyi! Tunawaletea habari njema, tukiwaambia kwamba mgeuke mtoke katika mambo haya yasiyofaa, mmwelekee Mungu aliye hai, aliyeziumba mbingu na nchi na bahari na vitu vyote vilivyomo.

english: In past generations, He let all nations go their own way.
ekegusii: Kare ase ebigori biaetire nigo atigete ebisaku bionsi bitaare ase chinchera chiabo abanyene,
swahili: Zamani aliwaachia mataifa waishi walivyotaka.

english: Yet He has not left Himself without testimony to His goodness: He gives you rain from heaven and fruitful seasons, filling your hearts with food and gladness.”
ekegusii: korende ere omonyene tetigete atari na kirori. Ere nigo are gokora amaya na kobaa embura korwa igoro, ne chingaki chi’erigesa, agaisanekia chinkoro chiaino nendagera na omogooko.”
swahili: Lakini hakuacha kuwaonyesha watu uwepo wake: Ameonyesha wema kwa kuwanyeshea mvua toka mbinguni na kuwapa mazao kwa majira yake, naye amewapa chakula tele na kuijaza mioyo yenu na furaha.”

english: Even with these words, Paul and Barnabas could hardly stop the crowds from sacrificing to them.
ekegusii: Na ase amang’ana aya bagatanga abanto baria bokong’u, tibaabaruseria ebing’wanso.
swahili: Hata kwa maneno haya yote, ilikuwa vigumu kuuzuia ule umati wa watu kuwatolea dhabihu.

english: Then some Jews arrived from Antioch and Iconium and won over the crowds. They stoned Paul and dragged him outside the city, presuming he was dead.
ekegusii: Erio Abayahudi korwa Antiokia na Ikonio bagaacha, na ekero bagenkire abanto bagaaka Paulo amagena, bakamokurura gochia isiko y’omochie, bagakaga ng’a okuure,
swahili: Ndipo wakaja baadhi ya Wayahudi kutoka Antiokia na Ikonio wakawashawishi wale watu, wakampiga Paulo kwa mawe, wakamburuta hadi nje ya mji, wakidhani amekufa.

english: But the unbelieving Jews stirred up the Gentiles and poisoned their minds against the brothers.
ekegusii: Korende Abayahudi abategenete bakaburukania emioyo y’abanto b’Ebisaku na gosaria emioyo yabo igoro ase abaminto.
swahili: Lakini wale Wayahudi waliokataa kuamini, wakawachochea watu wa Mataifa, wakatia chuki ndani ya mioyo yao dhidi ya wale walioamini.

english: But after the disciples had gathered around him, he got up and went back into the city. And the next day he left with Barnabas for Derbe. Strengthening the Disciples
ekegusii: Korende ekero aborokigwa bamoetananire ase chinsemo chionsi, agatenena, agasoa omochie ime, ne rituko ria kabere riaye agasoka, akagenda Deribe amo na Barnaba. Okoirana ase Antiokia
swahili: Lakini baada ya wanafunzi kukusanyika akainuka na kurudi mjini. Kesho yake yeye na Barnaba wakaondoka kwenda Derbe. Paulo Na Barnaba Warudi Antiokia Huko Syria

english: They preached the gospel to that city and made many disciples. Then they returned to Lystra, Iconium, and Antioch,
ekegusii: Magega kobarandirie amang’ana amaya ase omochie oria, na kobakorire abange koba aborokigwa, bakairana goika Listra, na Ikonio, na Antiokia,
swahili: Wakahubiri habari njema katika mji huo na kupata wanafunzi wengi. Kisha wakarudi Listra, Ikonio na Antiokia,

english: strengthening the souls of the disciples and encouraging them to continue in the faith. “We must endure many hardships to enter the kingdom of God,” they said.
ekegusii: bakabeeka emioyo yaborokigwa chinguru na kobaremia bagenderere ase okwegena, bakabateebia ng’a: “Netogwenerete gosoa ase oborwoti bwa Nyasae ase enchera y’emechando emenge.”
swahili: wakiwaimarisha wanafunzi na kuwatia moyo waendelee kudumu katika imani. Wakawaonya wakisema, “Imetupasa kuingia katika Ufalme wa Mungu kwa kupitia katika taabu nyingi.”

english: Paul and Barnabas appointed elders for them in each church, praying and fasting as they entrusted them to the Lord, in whom they had believed.
ekegusii: Erio kobachorire abagaaka ase kera ekanisa ase ogosaba na okweng’ata, bakababeeka ase amaboko y’Omonene, oyio begenete.
swahili: Nao baada ya kuwateua wazee katika kila kanisa, kwa kufunga na kuomba wakawakabidhi kwa Bwana waliyemwamini.

english: After passing through Pisidia, they came to Pamphylia.
ekegusii: Bagaeta gati ya Pisidia, bagasoa Pamfulia.
swahili: Kisha wakapitia Pisidia wakafika Pamfilia.

english: And when they had spoken the word in Perga, they went down to Attalia.
ekegusii: Na magega kobarandirie ring’ana ase Perga, bagatirimboka gochia Atalia,
swahili: Baada ya kuhubiri neno la Mungu huko Perga, wakateremkia Atalia.

english: From Attalia they sailed to Antioch, where they had been commended to the grace of God for the work they had just completed.
ekegusii: na korwa agwo bakairwa n’emeeri ase enyancha, bagaika Antiokia. Agwo nao babeekeretwe ase obuya bwa Nyasae ase emeremo eria banyarete goikerania.
swahili: Kutoka Atalia wakasafiri baharini wakarudi Antiokia, ambako walikuwa wamesifiwa kwa ajili ya neema ya Mungu kutokana na ile huduma waliyokuwa wameikamilisha.

english: When they arrived, they gathered the church together and reported all that God had done through them, and how He had opened the door of faith to the Gentiles.
ekegusii: Ekero bachia goika aroro bagasangereria ekanisa amo, bakaorokia amang’ana onsi Nyasae akorete nabarabwo, na buna aigoreire abanto b’Ebisaku egesieri gi’okwegena.
swahili: Walipowasili Antiokia wakaliita kanisa pamoja na kutoa taarifa ya yale yote Mungu aliyokuwa ametenda kupitia kwao na jinsi alivyokuwa amefungua mlango wa imani kwa ajili ya watu wa Mataifa.

english: And they spent a long time there with the disciples.
ekegusii: Bakaba agwo amatuko atai make amo naborokigwa.
swahili: Nao wakakaa huko pamoja na wanafunzi kwa muda mrefu.

english: So Paul and Barnabas spent considerable time there, speaking boldly for the Lord, who affirmed the message of His grace by enabling them to perform signs and wonders.
ekegusii: Ase engaki entambe Paulo na Barnaba bakamenya aroro, bagakwana noboremu igoro ase Omonene, oyorenge koorokia ring’ana ri’obuya bwaye na kobanchera ebikone na amakumia bikoreke ase amaboko abo.
swahili: Hivyo Paulo na Barnaba wakakaa huko kwa muda wa kutosha wakihubiri kwa ujasiri juu ya Bwana, ambaye alithibitisha ujumbe wa neema yake kwa kuwawezesha kufanya ishara na miujiza.

english: The people of the city were divided. Some sided with the Jews, and others with the apostles.
ekegusii: Korende abanto b’omochie oria bagaatananekana. Abande bakabwatana n’Abayahudi na abande nabatomwa.
swahili: Lakini watu wa mji ule waligawanyika, wengine wakakubaliana na Wayahudi na wengine na mitume.

english: But when the Gentiles and Jews, together with their rulers, set out to mistreat and stone them,
ekegusii: Ekero okong’orerwa kw’abaanto b’Ebisaku na Abayahudi amo n’abanene babo gwakoretwe igoro y’abatomwa ase okobakorera amabe na kobaaka amagena,
swahili: Watu wa Mataifa na Wayahudi wakajiunga na baadhi ya viongozi, wakafanya mpango wa kuwatendea mitume mabaya na kuwapiga mawe.

english: they found out about it and fled to the Lycaonian cities of Lystra and Derbe and to the surrounding region,
ekegusii: barabwo bakanyora amang’ana, bagatama gochia Listra na Deribe, emechie ya Lukania, ne chinsemo chionsi echiarenge ang’e.
swahili: Lakini mitume walipopata habari hizi wakakimbilia Listra na Derbe, miji ya Likaonia na sehemu zilizopakana nayo.

english: where they continued to preach the gospel. The Visit to Lystra and Derbe
ekegusii: Aroro bakagenderera korandia enchiri. Ase Listra
swahili: Huko wakaendelea kuhubiri habari njema. Paulo Na Barnaba Huko Listra

english: In Lystra there sat a man crippled in his feet, who was lame from birth and had never walked.
ekegusii: Agwo Listra narengeo omonto oyomo ekerema. Ere nigo arenge rigata korwa ase okoiborwa kwaye, tana kogenda nonya ng’ake.
swahili: Katika mji wa Listra, alikuwako kiwete, ambaye alikuwa amelemaa tangu kuzaliwa na hakuwa ametembea kamwe.

english: This man was listening to the words of Paul, who looked intently at him and saw that he had faith to be healed.
ekegusii: Omonto oyio akaigwa Paulo kagokwana. Paulo akamobeta amaiso, akarora ng’a nare nokwegena gw’okogwenigwa,
swahili: Alimsikiliza Paulo alipokuwa akihubiri. Paulo alipomtazama akaona ana imani ya kuponywa.

english: Then some men came down from Judea and were teaching the brothers, “Unless you are circumcised according to the custom of Moses, you cannot be saved.”
ekegusii: Abanto gete batirimbogete korwa Boyahudi bakorokereria abaminto ng’a: “Motarogeti koreng’ana buna Musa atochigeete, timokonyaara gotooreka.”
swahili: Baadhi ya watu wakashuka Antiokia kutoka Uyahudi, nao wakawa wanawafundisha wandugu: “Msipotahiriwa kufuatana na desturi aliyofundisha Mose, hamwezi kuokoka.”

english: Now then, why do you test God by placing on the necks of the disciples a yoke that neither we nor our fathers have been able to bear?
ekegusii: Gaki, bono inaki mogoteema Nyasae na kobeeka rikorogoto igoro ase amagoti ’aborokigwa, eri chisokoro chiaito chitanyarete kobogoria, nonya nintwe totanyaare.
swahili: Sasa basi, mbona mnataka kumjaribu Mungu kwa kuweka kongwa shingoni mwa wanafunzi ambalo baba zetu wala sisi hatukuweza kulibeba?

english: On the contrary, we believe it is through the grace of the Lord Jesus that we are saved, just as they are.”
ekegusii: Korende twegenire ng’a ase amaabera a Yeso, Omonene intwe natotoorigwe buna barabwo.”
swahili: Lakini sisi tunaamini ya kuwa tunaokolewa kwa neema ya Bwana Yesu Kristo, kama wao wanavyookolewa.”

english: The whole assembly fell silent as they listened to Barnabas and Paul describing the signs and wonders God had done among the Gentiles through them.
ekegusii: Omoganda bwonsi ogakira, ogategerera Barnaba na Paulo, ekero baare koraria amang’ana igoro y’ebikone na amakumia Nyasae akorete goetera ase bare ase egati y’abanto b’Ebisaku.
swahili: Kusanyiko lote likakaa kimya, wakawasikiliza Paulo na Barnaba wakieleza jinsi Mungu alivyowatumia kutenda ishara na maajabu kwa watu wa Mataifa.

english: When they had finished speaking, James declared, “Brothers, listen to me!
ekegusii: Kobakoorire gokwana, Yakobo akairaneria: Abaminto, ntegerera.
swahili: Walipomaliza kunena, Yakobo akasema, “Ndugu zangu, nisikilizeni.

english: Simon has told us how God first visited the Gentiles to take from them a people to be His own.
ekegusii: Simioni otworokirie buna Nyasae ritang’ani acheire abanto b’Ebisaku, erinde achore abanto korwa ase bare babogorie erieta riaye.
swahili: Simoni amekwisha kutueleza jinsi Mungu, kwa mara ya kwanza alivyoonyesha kuhusika kwa kujichagulia watu kutoka watu wa Mataifa kwa ajili ya Jina lake.

english: The words of the prophets agree with this, as it is written:
ekegusii: Na amang’ana ’ababani nigo abwataine nayio, buna ariikire,
swahili: Maneno ya manabii yanakubaliana na jambo hili, kama ilivyoandikwa:

english: ‘After this I will return and rebuild the fallen tent of David. Its ruins I will rebuild, and I will restore it,
ekegusii: Magega ase aya ning’irane, ning’agache naende obomenyo bwa Daudi, boria bwagwete. Ning’agache naende aase agwo atagogete, nimbotenenie,
swahili: “ ‘Baada ya mambo haya nitarudi, nami nitajenga upya nyumba ya Daudi iliyoanguka. Nitajenga tena magofu yake na kuisimamisha,

english: so that the remnant of men may seek the Lord, and all the Gentiles who are called by My name, says the Lord who does these things
ekegusii: erinde Mwanyabaanto abatigaire barigie Omonene amo n’abanto b’Ebisaku bionsi, aba narangeirie ase erieta riane.
swahili: ili wanadamu wengine wote wapate kumtafuta Bwana, hata wale watu wa Mataifa wote ambao wanaitwa kwa Jina langu, asema Bwana, afanyaye mambo haya’

english: that have been known for ages.’
ekegusii: Naboigo Omonene agoteeba, oyo oorogetie aya korwa kare.
swahili: ambayo yamejulikana tangu zamani.

english: It is my judgment, therefore, that we should not cause trouble for the Gentiles who are turning to God.
ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio nanachire iga, ng’a titochanda abanto baria b’Ebisaku abaonchokeire Nyasae,
swahili: “Kwa hivyo uamuzi wangu ni kwamba, tusiwataabishe watu wa Mataifa wanaomgeukia Mungu.
