english: And after engaging these men in sharp debate, Paul and Barnabas were appointed, along with some other believers, to go up to Jerusalem to see the apostles and elders about this question.
ekegusii: Amang’ana aya akarenta ogwatananekana okonene, na Paulo na Barnaba bakaamererania n’abanto aba. Erio Paulo, na Barnaba, na abande korwa ase egati yabo bagachiikwa batiire gochia Yerusalemu ase abatomwa na abagaaka ase engencho y’okoamererania okwo.
swahili: Baada ya Paulo na Barnaba kutokubaliana nao kukawa na mabishano makali, Paulo na Barnaba na baadhi ya wengine miongoni mwao wakachaguliwa kwenda Yerusalemu ili kujadiliana jambo hili na mitume na wazee.

english: Instead, we should write and tell them to abstain from food polluted by idols, from sexual immorality, from the meat of strangled animals, and from blood.
ekegusii: korende tobarikere riruube ng’a beatanane korwa ase ebinto bitachenegeti bi’emegwekano y’ogosaasimwa, na obotomani, na enyama ende yonsi y’eng’iti eng’entire, na korwa ase amanyinga.
swahili: Badala yake, tuwaandikie kwamba wajiepushe na vyakula vilivyonajisiwa kwa kutolewa sanamu, wajiepushe na uasherati, au kula mnyama aliyenyongwa, na damu.

english: For Moses has been proclaimed in every city from ancient times and is read in the synagogues on every Sabbath.” The Letter to the Gentile Believers
ekegusii: Naki korwa ebigori bia kare Musa narenge n’abanto baare korandia amang’ana aye, na ase kera omochie nigo are gosomwa kera Esabato ase chisinagogi. Riruube ase Abakristo b’Ebisaku
swahili: Kwa maana katika kila mji kwa vizazi vilivyopita, Mose amekuwa na wale wanaotangaza sheria yake kwa kuwa imekuwa ikisomwa kwa sauti kubwa katika masinagogi kila Sabato.” Barua Kwa Waumini Wa Mataifa

english: Then the apostles and elders, with the whole church, decided to select men from among them to send to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas. They chose Judas called Barsabbas and Silas, two leaders among the brothers,
ekegusii: Erio akagwenera abatomwa na abagaaka amo na ekanisa yonsi gochora abanto korwa ase egati yabo na kobatoma Antiokia amo na Paulo na Barnaba. Bagatoma Yuda ore korokwa Barsaba, na Sila, abatang’ani b’abamwabo,
swahili: Mitume na wazee pamoja na kanisa lote, wakaamua kuwachagua baadhi ya watu wao na kuwatuma Antiokia pamoja na Paulo na Barnaba. Wakamchagua Yuda aitwaye Barsaba pamoja na Sila, watu wawili waliokuwa viongozi miongoni mwa ndugu.

english: and sent them with this letter: The apostles and the elders, your brothers, To the brothers among the Gentiles in Antioch, Syria, and Cilicia: Greetings.
ekegusii: bakabaa baire riruube ririikire iga: “Ase abaminto b’Ebisaku abamore ase Antiokia, na Siiria, na Kilikia. Intwe abamino, abatomwa na abagaaka, twabakwanirie.
swahili: Wakatumwa na barua ifuatayo: Sisi mitume na wazee, ndugu zenu, Kwa ndugu Mataifa mlioamini mlioko Antiokia, Shamu na Kilikia: Salamu.

english: It has come to our attention that some went out from us without our authorization and unsettled you, troubling your minds by what they said.
ekegusii: Twaigure ng’a abanto baruure aa ase tore abaabachandire ase amang’ana abo na koonchorana emioyo yaino, na intwe titwabachiigete ng’a bakore bo.
swahili: Tumesikia kwamba kuna baadhi ya watu waliokuja huko kutoka kwetu bila ruhusa yetu na kuwasumbua, wakiyataabisha mawazo yenu.

english: So we all agreed to choose men to send to you along with our beloved Barnabas and Paul,
ekegusii: Ase ayio, intwe twarorire buya ase omosangererekano oito gochora abanto na kobatoma ase more amo nabanchwa baito Barnaba na Paulo,
swahili: Hivyo tumekubaliana wote kuwachagua baadhi ya watu na kuwatuma kwenu pamoja na wapendwa wetu Barnaba na Paulo,

english: men who have risked their lives for the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.
ekegusii: abanto ababekire obogima bwabo ase engencho y’erieta ri’Omonene oito Yeso Kristo.
swahili: watu ambao wamehatarisha maisha yao kwa ajili ya jina la Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo.

english: Therefore we are sending Judas and Silas to tell you in person the same things we are writing.
ekegusii: Ase ayio twatomire Yuda na Sila, abaranyare kobateebia amang’ana ayio ayio ase emenwa yabo.
swahili: Kwa hiyo tunawatuma Yuda na Sila, kuthibitisha kwa maneno ya mdomo mambo haya tunayowaandikia.

english: It seemed good to the Holy Spirit and to us not to burden you with anything beyond these essential requirements:
ekegusii: Iga yarorekanete buya ase Omoika Omochenu amo naintwe, titobatweka egurube ende otatiga eyio egwenerete:
swahili: Kwa maana imempendeza Roho Mtakatifu na sisi tusiwatwike mzigo wowote mkubwa zaidi ya mambo haya yafuatayo ambayo ni ya lazima:

english: You must abstain from food sacrificed to idols, from blood, from the meat of strangled animals, and from sexual immorality. You will do well to avoid these things. Farewell. The Believers at Antioch Rejoice
ekegusii: Mweatanane korwa ase ebinto biruure ebing’wanso ase emegwekano y’ogosasiimwa, na korwa ase amanyinga, na korwa ase enyama ende yonsi y’eng’iti eng’entire, na korwa ase obotomani. Kamoretange nayio, namokore buya. Motigare buya.”
swahili: Kwamba mjiepushe na vyakula vilivyotolewa sadaka kwa sanamu, na damu, au kula nyama ya mnyama aliyenyongwa, na mjiepushe na uasherati. Mkiyaepuka mambo haya, mtakuwa mmefanya vyema. Kwaherini.

english: Sent on their way by the church, they passed through Phoenicia and Samaria, recounting the conversion of the Gentiles and bringing great joy to all the brothers.
ekegusii: Bagatomwa ekanisa, bagaeta gati ya Foiniki na Samaria, bakararia amang’ana ’okoonchoka kw’abaanto b’Ebisaku, bakagokia abaminto bonsi.
swahili: Hivyo wakasafirishwa na kanisa, wakiwa njiani wakapitia nchi ya Foinike na Samaria, wakawaeleza jinsi watu wa Mataifa walivyookoka. Habari hizi zikaleta furaha kubwa kwa ndugu wote.

english: So the men were sent off and went down to Antioch, where they assembled the congregation and delivered the letter.
ekegusii: Ekero baria baegwa ribaga, bagatirimboka gochia Antiokia, bagasangereria abanto b’ekanisa y’aroro, bakabaa riruube riria.
swahili: Hivyo wakaagwa, wakashuka kwenda Antiokia. Baada ya kulikusanya kanisa pamoja, wakawapa ile barua.

english: When the people read it, they rejoiced at its encouraging message.
ekegusii: Na barabwo kobarisomire, bakagoka ase engencho y’okoremigwa okwo.
swahili: Nao hao watu wakiisha kuisoma, wakafurahishwa sana kwa ujumbe wake wa kutia moyo.

english: Judas and Silas, who themselves were prophets, said much to encourage and strengthen the brothers.
ekegusii: Yuda na Sila, ekiagera nababani barenge, bakaremia emioyo y’abaminto ase amang’ana amange, bakababeeka chinguru.
swahili: Yuda na Sila, ambao wenyewe walikuwa manabii, wakanena maneno mengi ya kuwatia moyo na kuwajenga katika imani wale ndugu walioamini.

english: After spending some time there, they were sent off by the brothers in peace to return to those who had sent them.
ekegusii: Magega kobamenyire agwo ase engaki etai ’nke, bakaegwa ribaga nabaminto bagende nomorembe ase baria baabatomete. [
swahili: Baada ya kukaa huko Antiokia kwa muda, wakaagwa kwa amani na wale ndugu ili waende kwa wale waliowatuma. [

english: But Paul and Barnabas remained at Antioch, along with many others, teaching and preaching the word of the Lord. Paul’s Second Missionary Journey Begins (Acts 13:1–3; Acts 18:23–28)
ekegusii: Paulo na Barnaba bakamenya agwo Antiokia amo n’abanto bande abange, bakaba bakworokereria na korandia ring’ana ri’Omonene. Paulo na Barnaba bagwatananekana
swahili: Lakini Paulo na Barnaba walibaki Antiokia ambako wao pamoja na wengine wengi walifundisha na kuhubiri neno la Bwana. Safari Ya Pili Ya Paulo Kueneza Injili (15:36–18:22) Paulo Na Barnaba Wagawanyika

english: Some time later Paul said to Barnabas, “Let us go back and visit the brothers in every town where we proclaimed the word of the Lord, to see how they are doing.”
ekegusii: Magega y’amatuko amake Paulo agateebia Barnaba: “Toirane, tochie korora abaminto ase kera omochie twarandirie ring’ana ri’Omonene, gose mbuya bare.”
swahili: Baada ya muda, Paulo akamwambia Barnaba, “Turudi tukawatembelee ndugu katika miji yote tuliyohubiri neno la Bwana tuone jinsi wanavyoendelea.”

english: Barnabas wanted to take John, also called Mark.
ekegusii: Barnaba agancha koirana Yohana, ore korokwa Mariko, amo nabarabwo.
swahili: Barnaba alitaka wamchukue Yohana aitwaye Marko waende naye.

english: But Paul thought it best not to take him, because he had deserted them in Pamphylia and had not accompanied them in the work.
ekegusii: Korende Paulo tarora buya bairane oyio obatigete aaria Pamfulia, na tagendete amo nabarabwo gokora emeremo eria.
swahili: Lakini Paulo aliona si vyema kwa sababu aliwahi kuwaacha walipokuwa huko Pamfilia, hakutaka kuendelea kufanya kazi naye.

english: Their disagreement was so sharp that they parted company. Barnabas took Mark and sailed for Cyprus,
ekegusii: Erio eriomana rigatuboka ase egati yabo goika bagaatananekana. Barnaba akaira Mariko, akagenda n’emeeri gochia Kuporo,
swahili: Pakatokea ubishi mkali kati ya Paulo na Barnaba kuhusu jambo hili, hivyo wakagawanyika. Barnaba akamchukua Yohana Marko wakasafiri baharini kwenda Kipro.

english: On their arrival in Jerusalem, they were welcomed by the church and apostles and elders, to whom they reported all that God had done through them. The Council at Jerusalem (Amos 9:11–15; Galatians 2:1–10)
ekegusii: Ekero baigete Yerusalemu bakaroisigwa n’ekanisa amo n’Abatomwa na abagaaka, bakaboorokia amang’ana onsi aya Nyasae akorete nabarabwo.
swahili: Walipofika Yerusalemu, walipokelewa na kanisa na mitume pamoja na wazee, ndipo Paulo na Barnaba wakawaarifu kila kitu Mungu alichokuwa amefanya kupitia kwao.

english: but Paul chose Silas and left, commended by the brothers to the grace of the Lord.
ekegusii: korende Paulo agachora Sila, na ekero abegeni bamobekeire amaboko, akaimoka akagenda.
swahili: Lakini Paulo akamchagua Sila na akaondoka baada ya ndugu kuwatakia neema ya Bwana.

english: And he traveled through Syria and Cilicia, strengthening the churches.
ekegusii: Agaeta ase Siiria na Kilikia, akabeeka Ekanisa chinguru.
swahili: Akapitia Shamu na Kilikia, akiimarisha makanisa ya huko.

english: But some believers from the party of the Pharisees stood up and declared, “The Gentiles must be circumcised and required to obey the law of Moses.”
ekegusii: Korende abande ase Abafarisai, abwo begenete, bagatenena, bagateeba: “Negwenerete kobaorokia na kobachiika babwate amachiiko a Musa.” Omosangererekano ore Yerusalemu
swahili: Ndipo baadhi ya walioamini wa madhehebu ya Mafarisayo wakasimama na kusema, “Hao watu wa Mataifa lazima watahiriwe na waagizwe kutii sheria ya Mose.”

english: So the apostles and elders met to look into this matter.
ekegusii: Abatomwa na abagaaka bagasangererekana amo, erinde banyare korengereria igoro ye ring’ana erio.
swahili: Mitume na wazee wakakutana pamoja ili kufikiri jambo hili.

english: After much discussion, Peter got up and said to them, “Brothers, you know that in the early days God made a choice among you that the Gentiles would hear from my lips the message of the gospel and believe.
ekegusii: Na magega y’okoamererania okonge Petero agatenena akabateebia: “Abaminto, inwe mwamanyire ng’a ase ekero giaetire Nyasae nakorete ogochora egati yaino, ng’a korwa ase omonwa one abanto b’Ebisaku baigwe ring’ana ri’enchiri na koriegena.
swahili: Baada ya majadiliano mengi, Petro akasimama na kusema, “Ndugu zangu, mnajua kwamba siku za kwanza Mungu alinichagua ili kwa midomo yangu watu wa Mataifa wapate kusikia ujumbe wa Injili na kuamini.

english: And God, who knows the heart, showed His approval by giving the Holy Spirit to them, just as He did to us.
ekegusii: Na Nyasae, oyomanyete chinkoro chi’abaanto, akabanchera, akabaa Omoika Omochenu, koreng’ana buna atoete intwe,
swahili: Mungu, yeye ajuaye mioyo, alionyesha kwamba anawakubali kwa kuwapa Roho Mtakatifu kama vile alivyotupa sisi.

english: He made no distinction between us and them, for He cleansed their hearts by faith.
ekegusii: gose takorete gwatananekana ase egati yaito na barabwo, korende agasibia chinkoro chiabo ase okwegena.
swahili: Mungu hakutofautisha kati yetu na wao, bali alitakasa mioyo yao kwa imani.

english: Paul came to Derbe and then to Lystra, where he found a disciple named Timothy, the son of a believing Jewish woman and a Greek father.
ekegusii: Agaika Deribe na Listra, ase omworokigwa oyomo amenyete, erieta riaye Timotheo, omwana bw’omokuungu Omoyahudi, korende ise n’Omogiriki orenge.
swahili: Paulo akafika Derbe na kisha Listra, ambako kulikuwa na mwanafunzi mmoja jina lake Timotheo, ambaye mama yake alikuwa Myahudi aliyeamini, lakini baba yake alikuwa Myunani.

english: As soon as Paul had seen the vision, we got ready to leave for Macedonia, concluding that God had called us to preach the gospel to them. Lydia’s Conversion in Philippi (Revelation 2:18–29)
ekegusii: Magega y’okorora koria, erio bwango kegima tokarigia kogenda Makedonia, ekiagera twaroche ekeene ng’a Nyasae otorangeirie tobaranderie enchiri. Paulo okwamboka gochia Makedonia Ase Filipi
swahili: Baada ya Paulo kuona maono haya, tulijiandaa kwa haraka kuondoka kwenda Makedonia tukiwa tumesadiki kuwa Mungu alikuwa ametuita kuhubiri habari njema huko. Kuokoka Kwa Lidia

english: We sailed from Troas straight to Samothrace, and the following day on to Neapolis.
ekegusii: Tokamanoria emeeri korwa Teroa, tokagenda boronge goika Samotraki. Rituko rikobwatia togaika Neapoli,
swahili: Tukasafiri kwa njia ya bahari kutoka Troa na kwenda moja kwa moja hadi Samothrake, kesho yake tukafika Neapoli.

english: From there we went to the Roman colony of Philippi, the leading city of that district of Macedonia. And we stayed there several days.
ekegusii: na korwa aroro togaika Filipi, omochie ore omonene ase ensemo ya Makedonia, ense yare kogamberwa n’Abarumi. Tokamenya ase omochie oyo amatuko amake.
swahili: Kutoka huko tukasafiri hadi Filipi, mji mkuu wa jimbo hilo la Makedonia, uliokuwa koloni ya Warumi. Nasi tukakaa huko siku kadhaa.

english: On the Sabbath we went outside the city gate along the river, where it was customary to find a place of prayer. After sitting down, we spoke to the women who had gathered there.
ekegusii: Ase rituko ria Esabato togasoka isiko y’egeita ase orooche mbarabare, ase ensemo twarengereretie ng’a tonyore aase togosabera. Togaikaransa, togakwana nabakungu abasangererekanete aria.
swahili: Siku ya Sabato tukaenda nje ya lango la mji kando ya mto, mahali ambapo tulitarajia tungepata mahali pa kufanyia maombi. Tukaketi, tukaanza kuongea na baadhi ya wanawake waliokuwa wamekusanyika huko.

english: Among those listening was a woman named Lydia, a dealer in purple cloth from the city of Thyatira, who was a worshiper of God. The Lord opened her heart to respond to Paul’s message.
ekegusii: Narengeo omokungu oyomo ore korokwa Lidia; ere nigo arenge omosasiimi Nyasae. Nigo arwete omochie o Tiatira; naende nigo arenge omoonia bw’ebitambaa bimonyinga. Omokungu oyo nigo arenge omosasiima o Nyasae. Ere agatotegerera. Omonene akaigora enkoro y’omokuungu oria, erinde akaigwa na gwancha amang’ana Paulo arenge gokwana.
swahili: Mmoja wa wale wanawake waliotusikiliza aliitwa Lidia, mfanyabiashara wa nguo za zambarau, mwenyeji wa mji wa Thiatira, aliyekuwa mcha Mungu. Bwana akaufungua moyo wake akaupokea ujumbe wa Paulo.

english: And when she and her household had been baptized, she urged us, “If you consider me a believer in the Lord, come and stay at my house.” And she persuaded us. Paul and Silas Imprisoned
ekegusii: Goika omokungu oria ochia kobatiswa, ere amo nab’enyomba yaye, agatosorora na gotobetereria ogoteeba: “Onye mwandorire ng’a n’omwegeni nde ase Omonene, soa nyomba mwane, moikaranse.”
swahili: Basi alipokwisha kubatizwa yeye na watu wa nyumba yake, alitukaribisha nyumbani kwake akisema, “Kama mmeona kweli mimi nimemwamini Bwana, karibuni mkae nyumbani mwangu.” Naye akatushawishi. Paulo Na Sila Watiwa Gerezani

english: One day as we were going to the place of prayer, we were met by a slave girl with a spirit of divination, who earned a large income for her masters by fortune-telling.
ekegusii: Riruko erimo, ekero tware kogenda aase aria tware gosabera, tokaumerana n’omoiseke omosomba oyobwatire n’ekerecha ki’oboringoria. Omoiseke oyio nigo arenge konyorera abanene baye enibo enyinge ase oboringoria bwaye.
swahili: Siku moja, tulipokuwa tukienda mahali pa kusali, tulikutana na mtumwa mmoja wa kike ambaye alikuwa na pepo wa uaguzi. Naye alikuwa amewapa mabwana zake mapato makubwa ya fedha kwa ubashiri.

english: This girl followed Paul and the rest of us, shouting, “These men are servants of the Most High God, who are proclaiming to you the way of salvation!”
ekegusii: Omoiseke oyio agatunyana Paulo amo naintwe, ogoaka eriogi ogoteeba: “Abanto aba nabasomba ba Nyasae more, Nyasae Ore Igoro Mono, bakoranderia inwe enchera y’ogotooreka.”
swahili: Huyu msichana alikuwa akimfuata Paulo na sisi akipiga kelele, “Watu hawa ni watumishi wa Mungu Aliye Juu Sana, wao wanawatangazieni njia ya wokovu.”

english: She continued this for many days. Eventually Paul grew so aggravated that he turned and said to the spirit, “In the name of Jesus Christ I command you to come out of her!” And the spirit left her at that very moment.
ekegusii: Akana‐gokora ayio amatuko amange. Korende Paulo agakoona, akeonchora, agateebia ekerecha keria: “Nagochikiire ase erieta ria Yeso Kristo. Karue ase omoiseke oyo!” Gekamorua ensa eria eria. Paulo na Sila bagosibwa na gosiborwa
swahili: Akaendelea kufanya hivi kwa siku nyingi, lakini Paulo akiwa ameudhika sana, akageuka na kumwambia yule pepo mchafu, “Ninakuamuru katika jina la Yesu Kristo, umtoke!” Yule pepo mchafu akamtoka saa ile ile.

english: When the girl’s owners saw that their hope of making money was gone, they seized Paul and Silas and dragged them before the authorities in the marketplace.
ekegusii: Korende ekero abanene baye bachia korora ng’a ogosemeria kw’enibo yabo gwasirire, bakabwata Paulo na Sila, bakabakurura goika echiiro ase obosio bw’abanene b’omochie.
swahili: Basi mabwana wa yule mtumwa wa kike walipoona kuwa tumaini lao la kuendelea kujipatia fedha limetoweka, wakawakamata Paulo na Sila wakawaburuta mpaka sokoni mbele ya viongozi wa mji.

english: The brothers in Lystra and Iconium spoke well of him.
ekegusii: Omonto oyio nigo arenge gokwanwa buya nabaminto abamenyete Listra na Ikonio.
swahili: Alikuwa amesifiwa sana na wale ndugu waliokuwa wameamini huko Listra na Ikonio

english: They brought them to the magistrates and said, “These men are Jews and are throwing our city into turmoil
ekegusii: Bakabaira ase abagaambi, bagateeba: “Abanto aba basaririe omochie oito, na barabwo n’Abayahudi.
swahili: Baada ya kuwafikisha mbele ya mahakimu wakawashtaki wakisema, “Hawa watu wanaleta ghasia katika mji wetu, nao ni Wayahudi.

english: by promoting customs that are unlawful for us Romans to adopt or practice.”
ekegusii: Naende nigo bakworokereria chingencho chitari boronge ng’a tochianche gose gochienaria, ekiagera intwe n’Abarumi tore.”
swahili: Wanafundisha desturi ambazo sisi raiya wa Kirumi hatuwezi kuzikubali au kuzitimiza.”

english: The crowd joined in the attack against Paul and Silas, and the magistrates ordered that they be stripped and beaten with rods.
ekegusii: Omoganda okabwatana ase okobogerera, na abagaambi bakabatandorera chianga chiabo na gochirusia, bagachiika ng’a baakwe ne chinyimbo.
swahili: Umati wa watu waliokuwepo wakajiunga katika kuwashambulia Paulo na Sila na wale mahakimu wakaamuru wavuliwe nguo zao na wachapwe viboko.

english: And after striking them with many blows, they threw them into prison and ordered the jailer to guard them securely.
ekegusii: Kobabaakire amaakwa amange, bakabaruta echela ime, bagachiika omorendi bw’echela abarende mono.
swahili: Baada ya kuwachapa sana, wakawatupa gerezani na kumwagiza mkuu wa gereza awalinde kikamilifu.

english: On receiving this order, he placed them in the inner cell and fastened their feet in the stocks. The Conversion of the Jailer
ekegusii: Ere ekero anyorire ogochika oko akabaruta ase akanyomba ka ime, agasoyia amagoro abo ase amakorogoto.
swahili: Kufuata maelekezo haya, yule mkuu wa gereza akawaweka katika chumba cha ndani sana mle gerezani, na akawafunga miguu yao kwa minyororo.

english: About midnight Paul and Silas were praying and singing hymns to God, and the other prisoners were listening to them.
ekegusii: Korende ekero kia botuko gati Paulo na Sila nigo barenge gosaba Nyasae na komoterera amatera, na abasibwa bande nigo babategererete.
swahili: Ilipokaribia usiku wa manane, Paulo na Sila walikuwa wakiomba na kuimba nyimbo za kumsifu Mungu, nao wafungwa wengine walikuwa wakiwasikiliza.

english: Suddenly a strong earthquake shook the foundations of the prison. At once all the doors flew open and everyone’s chains came loose.
ekegusii: Erio mobosokano omotengecho omonene okaba aroro, goika amaroso ’echela agatengechigwa; bwango ebisieri bionsi bikaigoka, na ebisibo bia bonsi bigasansoka.
swahili: Ghafula pakatokea tetemeko kubwa la ardhi, hata msingi wa gereza ukatikisika. Mara milango ya gereza ikafunguka na ile minyororo iliyowafunga kila mmoja ikafunguka.

english: When the jailer woke up and saw the prison doors open, he drew his sword and was about to kill himself, presuming that the prisoners had escaped.
ekegusii: Omorendi bw’echela akaboka na akarora ebisieri bi’echela biaigokire, akang’usa omoyio o birende, akarigia gweita, ekiagera akagete ng’a abasibwa mbatamire.
swahili: Yule mkuu wa gereza alipoamka na kuona milango ya gereza iko wazi, akachomoa upanga wake akataka kujiua, akidhani ya kuwa wafungwa wote wametoroka.

english: But Paul called out in a loud voice, “Do not harm yourself! We are all here!”
ekegusii: Korende Paulo agaaka eriogi rinene, agateeba: “Tibweita, ekiagera intwe twensi nao tore aa.”
swahili: Lakini Paulo akapiga kelele kwa sauti kubwa, akasema, “Usijidhuru kwa maana sisi sote tuko hapa!”

english: Calling for lights, the jailer rushed in and fell trembling before Paul and Silas.
ekegusii: Akarigia chitaaya chirentwe, akarindoka gochia ime, okoiguswa ase obwoba, akagwa inse ase amagoro a Paulo na Sila;
swahili: Yule askari wa gereza akaagiza taa ziletwe, akaingia ndani ya kile chumba cha gereza, akapiga magoti akitetemeka mbele ya Paulo na Sila.

english: Paul wanted Timothy to accompany him, so he took him and circumcised him on account of the Jews in that area, for they all knew that his father was a Greek.
ekegusii: Paulo agancha Timotheo agende nere, erio akamoira, akamwarokia ase engencho y’Abayahudi abarenge chinsemo chiria, ekiagera bonsi mbamanyete ng’a ise n’Omogiriki orenge.
swahili: Paulo alitaka Timotheo afuatane naye, hivyo akamchukua na kumtahiri kwa sababu ya Wayahudi waliokuwa wanaishi eneo lile kwa maana wote walimjua baba yake ni Myunani.

english: Then he brought them out and asked, “Sirs, what must I do to be saved?”
ekegusii: akabarenta isiko, akababoria: “Abaanene baane, inki ndakore ntooreke?”
swahili: Kisha akawaleta nje akisema, “Bwana zangu, nifanye nini nipate kuokoka?”

english: They replied, “Believe in the Lord Jesus and you will be saved, you and your household.”
ekegusii: Bakamoiraneria: “Mwegene Omonene Yeso, na aye notooreke amo nab’enyomba yao.”
swahili: Wakamjibu, “Mwamini Bwana Yesu Kristo, nawe utaokoka, pamoja na watu wa nyumbani mwako.”

english: Then Paul and Silas spoke the word of the Lord to him and to everyone in his house.
ekegusii: Bagakwana ring’ana ri’Omonene asare na ase abanto bonsi abarenge mwaye.
swahili: Wakamwambia neno la Bwana yeye pamoja na wote waliokuwako nyumbani mwake.

english: At that hour of the night, the jailer took them and washed their wounds. And without delay, he and all his household were baptized.
ekegusii: Akabaroisia ensa eria ya botuko, akabasibia chingoma chiabo, akabatiswa ekero ekio, ere na abanto bonsi ba mwaye.
swahili: Wakati ule ule, yule mkuu wa gereza akawachukua, akawaosha majeraha yao, kisha akabatizwa yeye pamoja na wote waliokuwa nyumbani mwake bila kuchelewa.

english: Then he brought them into his home and set a meal before them. So he and all his household rejoiced that they had come to believe in God. An Official Apology
ekegusii: Akabaira mwaye, akabarageria, akagoka mono amo na bonsi b’enyomba yaye, ekiagera konya bamwegenire Nyasae.
swahili: Akawapandisha nyumbani mwake akawaandalia chakula, yeye pamoja na nyumba yake yote wakafurahi sana kwa kuwa sasa walikuwa wamemwamini Mungu.

english: When daylight came, the magistrates sent their officers with the order: “Release those men.”
ekegusii: Ekero bwachia gokia, abagaambi bagatoma abanyanyimbo, bagoteeba: “Tiga abanto abwo bagende!”
swahili: Kulipopambazuka wale mahakimu wakawatuma maafisa wao kwa mkuu wa gereza wakiwa na agizo linalosema, “Wafungue wale watu, waache waende zao.”

english: The jailer informed Paul: “The magistrates have sent orders to release you. Now you may go on your way in peace.”
ekegusii: Omorendi oria bw’echela akairera Paulo amang’ana ayio, agateeba: “Abagaambi batomire amang’ana ng’a mosiborwe; gaki bono, soka isiko, mogende nomorembe!”
swahili: Mkuu wa gereza akamwambia Paulo “Mahakimu wameagiza niwaache huru, kwa hiyo tokeni na mwende zenu kwa amani.”

english: But Paul said to the officers, “They beat us publicly without a trial and threw us into prison, even though we are Roman citizens. And now do they want to send us away secretly? Absolutely not! Let them come themselves and escort us out!”
ekegusii: Korende Paulo akabateebia: “Bagatosusura maiso marore bataratogambia kina, na intwe n’Abarumi tore, naende bagatoruta echela ime. Inee! Bono barigetie gotosokia bobisi? Yaya! Tari bo; tiga baache abanyene batosokie.”
swahili: Lakini Paulo akawaambia wale maafisa, “Wametupiga hadharani bila kutufanyia mashtaka na kutuhoji, nao wakatutupa gerezani, hata ingawa sisi ni raiya wa Rumi. Nao sasa wanataka kututoa gerezani kwa siri? Hapana! Wao na waje wenyewe watutoe humu gerezani.”

english: So the officers relayed this message to the magistrates, who were alarmed to hear that Paul and Silas were Roman citizens.
ekegusii: Abanyanyimbo bakairera abagaambi amang’ana aya, na barabwo bakoboa ekero baigwa ng’a Paulo na Sila n’Abarumi bare.
swahili: Wale maafisa wakarudi na kuwaambia wale mahakimu maneno haya, wakaogopa sana walipofahamu kuwa Paulo na Sila ni raiya wa Rumi.

english: They came to appease them and led them out, requesting that they leave the city.
ekegusii: Bagaacha bakabasaba okwaberwa. Erio kobaabasokirie isiko bakababoria barue ase omochie oria.
swahili: Kwa hiyo wakaja wakawaomba msamaha, wakawatoa gerezani, wakawaomba waondoke katika ule mji.

english: As they went from town to town, they delivered the decisions handed down by the apostles and elders in Jerusalem for the people to obey.
ekegusii: Nabo, ekero barenge goeta egati y’emechie eria, bakabaa amachiiko aria achiigetwe nabatomwa n’abagaaka abarenge Yerusalemu, erinde bayabwate.
swahili: Walipokuwa wakienda mji kwa mji, wakawa wanawapa maamuzi yaliyotolewa na mitume na wazee huko Yerusalemu ili wayafuate.

english: After Paul and Silas came out of the prison, they went to Lydia’s house to see the brothers and encourage them. Then they left the city.
ekegusii: Na barabwo bagasooka korwa ase echela, bagasoa nyomba mwa Lidia. Aroro bakanyorana nabamwabo, bakabaremia. Erio bakaimoka, bakagenda.
swahili: Baada ya Paulo na Sila kutoka gerezani walikwenda nyumbani kwa Lidia, ambapo walikutana na wale ndugu walioamini, wakawatia moyo, ndipo wakaondoka.

english: So the churches were strengthened in the faith and grew daily in numbers. Paul’s Vision of the Macedonian
ekegusii: Nabo, Chikanisa chikabekwa chinguru ase okwegena; omobaro obo okamentekana kera rituko. Orogendo rwa Paulo goetera Asia Enke
swahili: Hivyo makanisa yakawa imara katika imani na kuongezeka kiidadi kila siku.

english: After the Holy Spirit had prevented them from speaking the word in the province of Asia, they traveled through the region of Phrygia and Galatia.
ekegusii: Paulo na Timotheo bagaeta ase ense ya Furugia na Galatia, ekiagera bakanetigwe n’Omoika Omochenu ng’a tibarandia ring’ana agwo ase ense y’Asia.
swahili: Paulo pamoja na wenzake wakasafiri sehemu za Frigia na Galatia, kwa kuwa Roho Mtakatifu hakuwaruhusu kulihubiri neno huko Asia.

english: And when they came to the border of Mysia, they tried to enter Bithynia, but the Spirit of Jesus would not permit them.
ekegusii: Ekero bachia goika chimbebe chi’ense ya Misia, bagateema kogenda Bitinia, korende Omoika o Yeso tobaa ribaga;
swahili: Walipofika mpaka wa Misia, wakajaribu kuingia Bithinia lakini Roho wa Yesu hakuwaruhusu.

english: So they passed by Mysia and went down to Troas.
ekegusii: ase igo, bagaeta ime ya Misia, bagatirimbokera gochia Teroa.
swahili: Kwa hiyo wakapita Misia, wakafika Troa.

english: During the night, Paul had a vision of a man of Macedonia standing and pleading with him, “Come over to Macedonia and help us.”
ekegusii: Ase obotuko Paulo akaorokerwa n’endoto, akarora omonto o Makedonia oteneine okomosorora, okomoteebia: “Koranche, amboka gocha aa Makedonia otokoonye.”
swahili: Wakati wa usiku Paulo akaona maono, mtu wa Makedonia amesimama akimsihi, “Vuka uje huku Makedonia utusaidie.”

english: When they had passed through Amphipolis and Apollonia, they came to Thessalonica, where there was a Jewish synagogue.
ekegusii: Erio kobaetire egati y’Amfipoli na Apolonia, bagaika Tesaloniki aase esinagogi y’Abayahudi yarenge.
swahili: Wakasafiri kupitia Amfipoli na Apolonia wakafika Thesalonike, ambako kulikuwa na sinagogi la Wayahudi.

english: As soon as night had fallen, the brothers sent Paul and Silas away to Berea. On arriving there, they went into the Jewish synagogue.
ekegusii: Erio bwango kegima ase obotuko boria abaminto bagatoma Paulo na Sila gochia Beroya. Kobaikire aroro, bagasoa ase esinagogi y’Abayahudi.
swahili: Usiku ule ule, wale ndugu walioamini wakawapeleka Paulo na Sila waende zao Beroya. Walipowasili huko wakaenda kwenye sinagogi la Wayahudi.

english: Now the Bereans were more noble-minded than the Thessalonians, for they received the message with great eagerness and examined the Scriptures every day to see if these teachings were true.
ekegusii: Abayahudi aba nigo baare abaya ase ogotegerera kobua baria ba Tesaloniki; nigo babwatete Ring’ana ase obwanchani, bare kona‐koriga‐rigia amariiko kera rituko, erinde barore gose amang’ana ayio nabo are.
swahili: Hawa Waberoya walikuwa waungwana zaidi kuliko wale wa Thesalonike, kwa kuwa waliupokea ule ujumbe kwa shauku kubwa na kuyachunguza Maandiko kila siku ili kuona kama yale Paulo aliyosema yalikuwa kweli.

english: As a result, many of them believed, along with quite a few prominent Greek women and men.
ekegusii: Abange b’abaanto korwa ase bare bakeegena amo nabakungu Abagiriki abaare abasike, na abasacha batari bake.
swahili: Wayahudi wengi wakaamini pamoja na wanawake na wanaume wa Kiyunani wa tabaka la juu.

english: But when the Jews from Thessalonica learned that Paul was also proclaiming the word of God in Berea, they went there themselves to incite and agitate the crowds.
ekegusii: Korende Abayahudi ba Tesaloniki, ekero baigwete ng’a ring’ana ria Nyasae riarandigwe na Paulo ase Beroya, bakagenda aroro bakaburukania abanto na kobarubania.
swahili: Lakini wale Wayahudi wa Thesalonike waliposikia kuwa Paulo anahubiri neno la Mungu huko Beroya, wakaenda huko ili kuwashawishi watu na kuwachochea.

english: The brothers immediately sent Paul to the coast, but Silas and Timothy remained in Berea.
ekegusii: Erio kegima abaminto baria bagatoma Paulo agende goika nyancha, korende Sila na Timotheo bagatigara aroro.
swahili: Mara hiyo, wale ndugu wakamsafirisha Paulo hadi pwani, lakini Sila na Timotheo wakabaki Beroya.

english: Those who escorted Paul brought him to Athens and then returned with instructions for Silas and Timothy to join him as soon as possible. Paul in Athens
ekegusii: Baria bakoobete Paulo bakamoikia Atene, na ekero banyorire ogochika koirera Sila na Timotheo ng’a bache asare bwango buna eranyarekane, bakarua aroro. Ase Atene
swahili: Wale waliomsindikiza Paulo wakaenda naye mpaka Athene, kisha wakarudi Beroya wakiwa na maagizo kutoka kwa Paulo kuhusu Sila na Timotheo kwamba wamfuate upesi iwezekanavyo. Paulo Huko Athene

english: While Paul was waiting for them in Athens, he was deeply disturbed in his spirit to see that the city was full of idols.
ekegusii: Ekero Paulo abaganyete aria Atene, akarora buna omochie oria oichire nemegwekano y’ogosasimwa, akaigwa bobe ase omoika oye.
swahili: Paulo alipokuwa akiwasubiri huko Athene, alisumbuka sana moyoni mwake kuona vile mji huo ulivyojaa sanamu.

english: So he reasoned in the synagogue with the Jews and God-fearing Gentiles, and in the marketplace with those he met each day.
ekegusii: Nabo ase esinagogi agakwana n’Abayahudi na abanto abamoirogete Nyasae, na kera rituko ase echiiro nabaria abaare gocha aroro.
swahili: Hivyo akahojiana kwenye sinagogi na Wayahudi pamoja na Wayunani waliomcha Mungu, na pia sokoni kila siku na watu aliopatana nao huko.

english: Some Epicurean and Stoic philosophers also began to debate with him. Some of them asked, “What is this babbler trying to say?” Others said, “He seems to be advocating foreign gods.” They said this because Paul was proclaiming the good news of Jesus and the resurrection.
ekegusii: Abande abanyasemi b’Abaepikurio na Abastoiki bakaamererania nere. Abande bagateeba: “Omonto oyo nomonyamang’ana mange, inki arigetie goteeba?” Na abande: “Ororekanire ng’a nigo are buna omorandia bw’amang’ana e chinyasae chingeni”, ekiagera nigo arenge korandia amang’ana a Yeso na okobokigwa kw’abakuure.
swahili: Kisha baadhi ya Waepikureo na Wastoiko wenye falsafa wakakutana naye. Baadhi yao wakasema, “Je, huyu mpayukaji anajaribu kusema nini?” Wengine wakasema, “Inaonekana anasema habari za miungu ya kigeni.” Walisema haya kwa sababu Paulo alikuwa anahubiri habari njema kuhusu Yesu na ufufuo wa wafu.

english: So they took Paul and brought him to the Areopagus, where they asked him, “May we know what this new teaching is that you are presenting?
ekegusii: Bakamobwata, bakamoira goika Areopago, bakamobooria: “Inee! Nonyare gototeebia engencho y’okworokereria okwo okoyia ogokwana?
swahili: Hivyo wakamchukua na kumleta kwenye mkutano wa Areopago, walikomwambia, “Je, tunaweza kujua mafundisho haya mapya unayofundisha ni nini?

english: As was his custom, Paul went into the synagogue, and on three Sabbaths he reasoned with them from the Scriptures,
ekegusii: Na Paulo, buna anarete, agasoa ime aase barenge. Agwo ase Chisabato isato agakwana nabarabwo amang’ana korwa ase amariiko,
swahili: Kama desturi yake, Paulo aliingia ndani ya sinagogi, na kwa muda wa Sabato tatu akawa anahojiana nao kutoka kwenye Maandiko,

english: For you are bringing some strange notions to our ears, and we want to know what they mean.”
ekegusii: Nigo okorenta amang’ana amageni ase amato aito; gaki ntorigetie komanya engencho y’amang’ana ayio.”
swahili: Wewe unaleta mambo mapya masikioni mwetu, hivyo tungetaka kujua maana yake ni nini.”

english: Now all the Athenians and foreigners who lived there spent their time doing nothing more than hearing and articulating new ideas. Paul’s Address in the Areopagus
ekegusii: Abaatene bonsi na abamenyi abamenyete agwo tibarenge ne ribaga ase ing’ana rinde rionsi, otatiga ogokwana na gotegerera amang’ana amayia. Ogokwana gwa Paulo ase Areopago
swahili: (Waathene na wageni wote walioishi humo hawakutumia muda wao kufanya chochote kingine isipokuwa kueleza au kusikia mambo mapya).

english: Then Paul stood up in the meeting of the Areopagus and said, “Men of Athens, I see that in every way you are very religious.
ekegusii: Paulo agatenena gati‐gati y’Areopago, akabora: Inwe abasacha b’Atene! Narorire ng’a nigo more abanto abamorengereretie mono amang’ana e chinyasae,
swahili: Ndipo Paulo akasimama katikati ya Areopago akasema, “Enyi watu wa Athene! Ninaona kwamba katika kila jambo ninyi ni watu wa dini sana.

english: For as I walked around and examined your objects of worship, I even found an altar with this inscription: TO AN UNKNOWN GOD. Therefore what you worship as something unknown, I now proclaim to you.
ekegusii: ekiagera ekero narenge goetanana aria na aria, na korora ebisasimero biaino, nkarora egesasiimero keriikire amang’ana aya: GOCHIA ASE NYASAE ORIA OTAMANYEKANETI. Gaki inche nigo nkobaraareria chingencho chiaye ere oria inwe mogosasiima motamanyeti.
swahili: Kwa kuwa nilipokuwa nikitembea mjini na kuangalia kwa bidii vitu vyenu vya kuabudiwa, niliona huko madhabahu moja iliyoandikwa: Kwa Mungu Asiyejulikana. Basi sasa kile ambacho mmekuwa mkikiabudu kama kisichojulikana, ndicho ninachowahubiria.

english: The God who made the world and everything in it is the Lord of heaven and earth and does not live in temples made by human hands.
ekegusii: Nyasae, oyotongete ense na ebinto bionsi ebireo, tari komenya ase ebie Hekalu biagachire namaboko, ekiagera nere Omonene o igoro na ense,
swahili: “Mungu aliyeumba dunia na vyote vilivyomo ndani yake, yeye ndiye Bwana wa mbingu na nchi, hakai katika mahekalu yaliyojengwa kwa mikono ya wanadamu.

english: Nor is He served by human hands, as if He needed anything, because He Himself gives everyone life and breath and everything else.
ekegusii: gose tari gokorerwa namaboko a Mwanyabaanto, buna oyo oremeire gento, ekiagera nere okobaa bonsi obogima na omoika, na ebinto bionsi.
swahili: Wala hatumikiwi na mikono ya wanadamu kana kwamba anahitaji chochote, kwa sababu yeye mwenyewe ndiye awapaye watu wote uhai na pumzi na vitu vyote.

english: From one man He made every nation of men, that they should inhabit the whole earth; and He determined their appointed times and the boundaries of their lands.
ekegusii: Korwa ase omonto oyomo nere otongete kera egesaku kia Mwanyabaanto kemenye ase ense engima, akababeekera chingaki ne chimbebe chi’Obomenyo bwabo,
swahili: Kutoka kwa mtu mmoja, yeye aliumba mataifa yote ya wanadamu ili waikalie dunia yote, naye akaweka nyakati za kuishi.

english: God intended that they would seek Him and perhaps reach out for Him and find Him, though He is not far from each one of us.
ekegusii: erinde barigie Nyasae, nonya nase ogotaba‐taba bamonyore. Nonya nigo tari are korwa ase kera oyomo oito,
swahili: Mungu alifanya hivyo ili wanadamu wamtafute na huenda wakamfikia ingawa kwa kupapasapapasa ijapokuwa kwa kweli hakai mbali na kila mmoja wetu.

english: ‘For in Him we live and move and have our being.’ As some of your own poets have said, ‘We are His offspring.’
ekegusii: ekiagera: Ime asare nigo tore moyo, na togotaara, naende nigo tore nobogima bwaito; koreng’ana buna abarenti chingero bande baino bakwanete: Naki intwe twensi nigo tore ababiare baye.
swahili: ‘Kwa kuwa katika yeye tunaishi, tunatembea na kuwa na uzima wetu.’ Kama baadhi ya watunga mashairi wenu walivyosema, ‘Sisi ni watoto wake.’

english: Therefore, being offspring of God, we should not think that the Divine Being is like gold or silver or stone, an image formed by man’s skill and imagination.
ekegusii: Gaki, onye tore ababiare ba Nyasae, tetogwenereti gokaga ng’a obonyasae nigo bonga buna omogwekano bw’etaabu, gose efeta, gose rigena, buna ebinto bibaachire ase chisemi na obong’aini bwa Mwanyabaanto.
swahili: “Kwa kuwa sisi ni watoto wa Mungu, haitupasi kudhani kuwa uungu ni kama sanamu ya dhahabu au ya fedha au ya jiwe, mfano uliotengenezwa kwa ubunifu na ustadi wa mwanadamu.

english: explaining and proving that the Christ had to suffer and rise from the dead. “This Jesus I am proclaiming to you is the Christ,” he declared.
ekegusii: akaborokereria na kobateebereria ng’a Kristo nagwenerete gochandwa na koboka korwa ase abakuure, agateeba: “Yeso, oyo nkobaraareria inwe amang’ana igoro yaye, nere Kristo.”
swahili: akidhihirisha wazi na kuthibitisha kwamba ilikuwa lazima Kristo ateswe na afufuke kutoka kwa wafu. Akasema, “Huyu Yesu ninayewaambia habari zake, ndiye Kristo.”

english: Although God overlooked the ignorance of earlier times, He now commands all people everywhere to repent.
ekegusii: Ebiro biria bi’ogotamanya Nyasae nigo aombetie buna tarochi, korende bono nkoranderia are abanto bonsi ba kera aase baonchoke,
swahili: Zamani wakati wa ujinga, Mungu alijifanya kama haoni, lakini sasa anawaamuru watu wote kila mahali watubu.

english: For He has set a day when He will judge the world with justice by the Man He has appointed. He has given proof of this to everyone by raising Him from the dead.”
ekegusii: ekiagera obekire rituko eri agocha konachera abanto b’ense ekiina ase oboronge ase omonto oria aragete. Ase ayio oeire abanto bonsi ogosemeria ase okomobokia korwa ase abakuure.
swahili: Kwa kuwa ameweka siku ambayo atauhukumu ulimwengu kwa haki akimtumia mtu aliyemchagua. Amewahakikishia watu wote mambo haya kwa kumfufua Kristo kutoka kwa wafu.”

english: When they heard about the resurrection of the dead, some began to mock him, but others said, “We want to hear you again on this topic.”
ekegusii: Nabo ekero bachia koigwa amang’ana ’okobokigwa kw’abakuure abande bagasekereria, na abande bagateeba: “Inatogotegerere naende ase amang’ana ayio.”
swahili: Waliposikia habari za ufufuo wa wafu, baadhi yao wakadhihaki, lakini wengine wakasema, “Tunataka kukusikia tena ukizungumza juu ya jambo hili.”

english: At that, Paul left the Areopagus.
ekegusii: Erio Paulo akaimoka akabatiga.
swahili: Kwa hiyo Paulo akaondoka katikati yao.

english: But some joined him and believed, including Dionysius the Areopagite, a woman named Damaris, and others who were with them.
ekegusii: Abasacha bande bakabwatana nere, bakeegena, na ase abwo narengeo Dionuso, oyomo bw’ekegambero ki’Areopago, naende omokungu oyomo ore korokwa Damari, na abande amo nabarabwo.
swahili: Lakini baadhi yao wakaungana naye wakaamini. Kati yao alikuwepo Dionisio, Mwareopago na mwanamke mmoja aliyeitwa Damari na wengine wengi.

english: Some of the Jews were persuaded and joined Paul and Silas, along with a large number of God-fearing Greeks and quite a few leading women.
ekegusii: Abande bakang’useka, bakabwatana na Paulo na Sila, naboigo Abagiriki abange abasigete Nyasae amo nabakungu abasike batari bake.
swahili: Baadhi ya Wayahudi wakasadiki, wakaungana na Paulo na Sila, wakiwepo idadi kubwa ya Wayunani waliomcha Mungu na wanawake wengi mashuhuri.

english: The Jews, however, became jealous. So they brought in some troublemakers from the marketplace, formed a mob, and sent the city into an uproar. They raided Jason’s house in search of Paul and Silas, hoping to bring them out to the people.
ekegusii: Korende Abayahudi bakaba ne ribero, bakaira abanto ababe korwa ase abaomboganu, bagasangereria omoganda, na bagakora eburu‐buru ase omochie. Bagachiera abanto b’enyomba ya Yasoni, bakarigia koira Paulo na Sila isiko ase abanto.
swahili: Lakini Wayahudi ambao hawakuwa wameamini wakawa na wivu, wakawakodi watu waovu kutoka sokoni, wakakutanisha umati wa watu, wakaanzisha ghasia mjini. Wakaenda mbio nyumbani kwa Yasoni wakiwatafuta Paulo na Sila ili kuwaleta nje penye ule umati wa watu.

english: But when they could not find them, they dragged Jason and some other brothers before the city officials, shouting, “These men who have turned the world upside down have now come here,
ekegusii: Ekero batabanyora, bagakurura Yasoni na abande baminto gochia ase abanene b’omochie, bagaaka eriogi, bagateeba: “Abanto aba abaonchoranire ense baikire nonya naa,
swahili: Lakini walipowakosa wakamburuta Yasoni na ndugu wengine mbele ya maafisa wa mji, wakipiga kelele: “Watu hawa ni wale walioupindua ulimwengu wamekuja huku,

english: and Jason has welcomed them into his home. They are all defying Caesar’s decrees, saying that there is another king, named Jesus!”
ekegusii: na Yasoni akabaroisia. Barabwo bonsi nigo bagokora chingencho chire mamincha ya Kaisari, bagoteeba ng’a omorwoti onde nareo, okorokwa Yeso.”
swahili: naye Yasoni amewakaribisha nyumbani mwake. Hawa wote wanaasi amri za Kaisari wakisema yuko mfalme mwingine aitwaye Yesu.”

english: On hearing this, the crowd and city officials were greatly disturbed.
ekegusii: Omoganda oria na abanene b’omochie bagaichana ekero baigwete aya.
swahili: Waliposikia haya, ule umati wa watu na maafisa wa mji wakaongeza ghasia.

english: And they collected bond from Jason and the others, and then released them. The Character of the Bereans
ekegusii: Na barabwo kobanyorire eira y’okobatenenera korwa ase Yasoni na abamwabo, bakabatiga bagende. Ase Beroya
swahili: Nao baada ya kuchukua dhamana kwa ajili ya Yasoni na wenzake wakawaacha waende zao. Paulo Na Sila Huko Beroya

english: After this, Paul left Athens and went to Corinth.
ekegusii: Magega ase aya Paulo akarua Atene, akagenda Korinto.
swahili: Baada ya haya, Paulo akaondoka Athene akaenda Korintho.

english: For I am with you and no one will lay a hand on you, because I have many people in this city.”
ekegusii: ekiagera inche nigo inde amo naye, nonya monto onde tari oragoochere, erinde agokore bobe. Naki inche nigo inde n’abanto abange ase omochie oyo.”
swahili: kwa maana mimi niko pamoja nawe, wala hakuna mtu atakayeweza kukushambulia ili kukudhuru, kwa kuwa ninao watu wengi katika mji huu ambao ni watu wangu.”

english: So Paul stayed for a year and a half, teaching the word of God among the Corinthians. Paul before Gallio
ekegusii: Akamenya agwo omwaka oyomo na emetienyi etano nomo, akoborokereria ring’ana ria Nyasae ase egati yabo. Galio na Paulo
swahili: Hivyo Paulo akakaa huko kwa muda wa mwaka mmoja na nusu, akiwafundisha neno la Mungu.

english: While Gallio was proconsul of Achaia, the Jews coordinated an attack on Paul and brought him before the judgment seat.
ekegusii: Korende ekero Galio arenge gabana bw’Akaya, Abayahudi bakarindokera Paulo ase obomo, bakamoira bosio bw’ekegambero,
swahili: Lakini wakati Galio alipokuwa msaidizi wa mwakilishi wa mtawala huko Akaya, Wayahudi waliungana kumshambulia Paulo, wakamkamata na kumpeleka mahakamani.

english: “This man is persuading the people to worship God in ways contrary to the law,” they said.
ekegusii: bagateeba: “Omonto oyo nigo akoebereria abanto ng’a basasiime Nyasae mamincha y’amachiiko.”
swahili: Wakamshtaki wakisema, “Mtu huyu anawashawishi watu wamwabudu Mungu kinyume cha sheria.”

english: But just as Paul was about to speak, Gallio told the Jews, “If this matter involved a wrongdoing or vicious crime, O Jews, it would be reasonable for me to hear your complaint.
ekegusii: Na ekero Paulo achia korigia komaanora omonwa oye, Galio agateebia Abayahudi: “Inwe Abayahudi, onye ring’ana ri’okorega gose okong’ainereria okobe ndiakoregete, rirorio anga naremereria nainwe,
swahili: Paulo alipotaka kujitetea, Galio akawaambia Wayahudi, “Kama ninyi Wayahudi mlikuwa mkilalamika kuhusu makosa makubwa ya uhalifu ingekuwa haki kwangu kuwasikiliza.

english: But since it is a dispute about words and names and your own law, settle it yourselves. I refuse to be a judge of such things.”
ekegusii: korende onye nokoboria igoro ase amang’ana, na amarieta, na amachiiko aino, yarigererie inwe abanyene. Inche tindigeti koba omotorania bw’amang’ana ayio.”
swahili: Lakini kwa kuwa linahusu maneno, majina na sheria yenu, amueni ninyi wenyewe. Mimi sitakuwa mwamuzi wa mambo haya.”

english: And he drove them away from the judgment seat.
ekegusii: Akabaseria korwa ase ekegambero.
swahili: Akawafukuza kutoka mahakamani.

english: At this, the crowd seized Sosthenes the synagogue leader and beat him in front of the judgment seat. But none of this was of concern to Gallio. Paul Returns to Antioch
ekegusii: Erio bonsi bakabwata Sostene, omotang’ani bw’esinagogi, bakamoaka ase obosio bw’ekegambero. Korende Galio tarora ng’a amang’ana ayio gose ngento. Paulo okoirana Siiria
swahili: Ndipo wote wakamkamata Sosthene kiongozi wa sinagogi, wakampiga mbele ya mahakama, lakini Galio hakujali kitendo chao hata kidogo. Paulo Arudi Antiokia

english: Paul remained in Corinth for quite some time before saying goodbye to the brothers. He had his head shaved in Cenchrea to keep a vow he had made, and then he sailed for Syria, accompanied by Priscilla and Aquila.
ekegusii: Magega ase aya Paulo akamenta komenya agwo amatuko amange, erio agatigana nabamwabo, akamanora agasoa emeeri, akagenda Siiria, na Priskila na Akwila bakagenda amo nere. Ase Kenkrea agakigita etukia yaye, ekiagera ariete eira gete.
swahili: Baada ya kukaa Korintho kwa muda, Paulo akaagana na wale ndugu walioamini, akasafiri kwa njia ya bahari kwenda Shamu akiwa amefuatana na Prisila na Akila. Walipofika Kenkrea, Paulo alinyoa nywele zake kwa kuwa alikuwa ameweka nadhiri.

english: When they reached Ephesus, Paul parted ways with Priscilla and Aquila. He himself went into the synagogue there and reasoned with the Jews.
ekegusii: Bagaika Efeso, akabatiga agwo; ere omonyene agasoa esinagogi, agakwana n’Abayahudi.
swahili: Walipofika Efeso, Paulo aliwaacha Prisila na Akila huko, lakini yeye akaingia kwenye sinagogi akawa anajadiliana na Wayahudi.

english: There he found a Jew named Aquila, a native of Pontus, who had recently come from Italy with his wife Priscilla because Claudius had ordered all the Jews to leave Rome. Paul went to visit them,
ekegusii: Akanyora Omoyahudi oyomo, erieta riaye Akwila, omobiare o Ponto. Ere nigo achete korwa ase ense ya Italia ase amatuko a bwango amo na Priskila mokaye, ekiagera Klaudio konya ochiikire Abayahudi bonsi barue Rumi. Paulo agaika ase bare,
swahili: Huko akakutana na Myahudi mmoja jina lake Akila, mwenyeji wa Ponto, ambaye alikuwa amewasili karibuni kutoka Italia pamoja na mkewe Prisila, kwa sababu Klaudio alikuwa ameamuru Wayahudi wote waondoke Rumi. Paulo akaenda kuwaona,

english: When they asked him to stay for a while longer, he declined.
ekegusii: Ekero bamoboretie amente amatuko ande komenya amo nabarabwo, akaanga.
swahili: Walipomwomba akae nao kwa muda mrefu zaidi hakukubali.

english: But as he left, he said, “I will come back to you if God is willing.” And he set sail from Ephesus.
ekegusii: Korende ekero agotigana nabarabwo agateeba: “Ning’irane ase more naende, Nyasae karanche.” Akamanora korwa Efeso, akagenda n’emeeri.
swahili: Lakini alipokuwa akiondoka, akaahidi, “Nitarudi kama Mungu akipenda.” Kisha akasafiri kwa njia ya bahari kutoka Efeso.

english: When Paul had landed at Caesarea, he went up and greeted the church at Jerusalem. Then he went down to Antioch. Paul’s Third Missionary Journey Begins (Acts 13:1–3; Acts 15:36–41)
ekegusii: Gaikire Kaisaria, agatiira gochia gokwania abanto b’ekanisa. Erio agatirimboka gochia Antiokia.
swahili: Alitia nanga Kaisaria, akaenda Yerusalemu na kulisalimu kanisa, kisha akaenda Antiokia. Safari Ya Tatu Ya Paulo Kueneza Injili (18:23–21:16)

english: After Paul had spent some time in Antioch, he traveled from place to place throughout the region of Galatia and Phrygia, strengthening all the disciples.
ekegusii: Magega kamenyire amatuko atai make akaimoka, agaeta egati y’ense ya Galatia na Furugia, agasoa omochie ase omochie, na gokong’ia aborokigwa bonsi. Apolo ase Efeso
swahili: Baada ya kukaa huko kwa muda, akaondoka na kwenda sehemu moja hadi nyingine huko Galatia na Frigia, akiwaimarisha wanafunzi wote. Huduma Ya Apolo Huko Efeso Na Korintho

english: Meanwhile a Jew named Apollos, a native of Alexandria, came to Ephesus. He was an eloquent man, well versed in the Scriptures.
ekegusii: Nabo Omoyahudi oyomo, ore korokwa Apolo, omobiare bw’Aleksanderia, agaika Efeso. Ere nigo arenge omonto omanyete gokwana buya, naende nigo arenge omonto omanyete amariiko buya kegima.
swahili: Basi akaja Efeso Myahudi mmoja, jina lake Apolo, mwenyeji wa Iskanderia. Yeye alikuwa na elimu kubwa, pia alikuwa hodari katika Maandiko.

english: He had been instructed in the way of the Lord and was fervent in spirit. He spoke and taught accurately about Jesus, though he knew only the baptism of John.
ekegusii: Omonto oyo konya bworokererigwe enchera y’Omonene. Ase ayio omoika oye nigo orenge gwoka, agakwana na kworokereria boronge amang’ana igoro ya Yeso, korende ere nigo amanyete ebatiso ya Yohana yoka.
swahili: Alikuwa amefundishwa katika njia ya Bwana, naye alikuwa na bidii katika roho, akafundisha kwa usahihi juu ya Yesu, ingawa alijua tu ubatizo wa Yohana.

english: And he began to speak boldly in the synagogue. When Priscilla and Aquila heard him, they took him in and explained to him the way of God more accurately.
ekegusii: Agachaaka gokwana noboremu ase esinagogi. Korende ekero Priskila na Akwila bachia komoigwa bakamoira mwabo, bakamworokia enchera ya Nyasae boronge kegima.
swahili: Apolo alianza kunena kwa ujasiri mkubwa katika sinagogi. Lakini Prisila na Akila walipomsikia, walimchukua kando na kumweleza njia ya Mungu kwa ufasaha zaidi.

english: When Apollos resolved to cross over to Achaia, the brothers encouraged him and wrote to the disciples there to welcome him. On his arrival, he was a great help to those who by grace had believed.
ekegusii: Ekero arigia kwamboka enyancha gochia Akaya, abaminto bakamoremia, bakariikera aborokigwa b’aroro riruube bamoroisie. Ere gaikire aroro agakonya mono baria abegenete goetera ase obuya bwa Nyasae,
swahili: Naye Apolo alipotaka kwenda Akaya, ndugu wa Efeso walimtia moyo, wakawaandikia wanafunzi huko ili wamkaribishe. Alipofika huko, aliwasaidia sana wale ambao, kwa neema ya Mungu, walikuwa wameamini.

english: For he powerfully refuted the Jews in public debate, proving from the Scriptures that Jesus is the Christ.
ekegusii: ekiagera abuete Abayahudi kegima maiso marore, okoborokia korwa ase amariiko ng’a Yeso nere Kristo.
swahili: Kwa uwezo mkubwa aliwakanusha hadharani Wayahudi waliokuwa wakipinga, akionyesha kwa njia ya Maandiko kwamba Yesu ndiye Kristo.

english: and he stayed and worked with them because they were tentmakers by trade, just as he was.
ekegusii: na ekiagera emeremo yaye na emeremo yabo neyemo, akamenya nabarabwo, bagakora emeremo eye y’okoroisia chiema.
swahili: naye kwa kuwa alikuwa mtengeneza mahema kama wao, akakaa na kufanya kazi pamoja nao.

english: Every Sabbath he reasoned in the synagogue, trying to persuade Jews and Greeks alike.
ekegusii: Akaborokereria ase chisinagogi kera Esabato, agateema koebereria Abayahudi na Abagiriki.
swahili: Kila Sabato Paulo alikuwa akihojiana nao katika sinagogi, akijitahidi kuwashawishi Wayahudi na Wayunani.

english: And when Silas and Timothy came down from Macedonia, Paul devoted himself fully to the word, testifying to the Jews that Jesus is the Christ.
ekegusii: Korende ekero Sila na Timotheo bachia gotirimboka korwa Makedonia, Paulo agasukigwa mono ase okorandia ring’ana na koorokia ase Abayahudi nomokia ng’a Yeso nere Kristo.
swahili: Sila na Timotheo walipowasili kutoka Makedonia, walimkuta Paulo akiwa amejitolea muda wake wote katika kuhubiri, akiwashuhudia Wayahudi kwamba Yesu ndiye Kristo

english: But when they opposed and insulted him, he shook out his garments and told them, “Your blood be on your own heads! I am innocent of it. From now on I will go to the Gentiles.”
ekegusii: Ekero bachia koamererania nere na komorama, agasamusa chianga chiaye, akabateebia: “Amanyinga aino nabe igoro ase emetwe yaino! Inche tindi na komocha. Korwa bono ningende ase abanto b’Ebisaku.”
swahili: Wayahudi walipompinga Paulo na kukufuru, yeye aliyakungʼuta mavazi yake, akawaambia, “Damu yenu na iwe juu ya vichwa vyenu! Mimi sina hatia, nimetimiza wajibu wangu. Kuanzia sasa nitawaendea watu wa Mataifa.”

english: So Paul left the synagogue and went next door to the house of Titus Justus, a worshiper of God.
ekegusii: Akaimoka korwa agwo, agasoa enyomba y’omonto ore korokwa Tito Yusto, omosasiimi Nyasae. Mwaye nigo yasinyaine nesinagogi.
swahili: Kisha akaondoka mle kwenye sinagogi, akaenda nyumbani kwa mtu mmoja jina lake Tito Yusto, aliyekuwa mcha Mungu. Nyumba yake ilikuwa karibu na sinagogi.

english: Crispus, the synagogue leader, and his whole household believed in the Lord. And many of the Corinthians who heard the message believed and were baptized.
ekegusii: Krispo, omotang’ani bw’esinagogi, akamwege n’Omonene amo nab’enyomba yaye bonsi; na Abakorinto abange kobachia koigwa Paulo, bakeegena, bakabatiswa.
swahili: Kiongozi wa hilo sinagogi, aliyeitwa Krispo, akamwamini Bwana, yeye pamoja na watu wote wa nyumbani mwake. Nao Wakorintho wengi waliomsikia Paulo pia wakaamini na kubatizwa.

english: One night the Lord spoke to Paul in a vision: “Do not be afraid; keep on speaking; do not be silent.
ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Paulo botuko ase okorora: “Toiroka, korende kwana, tokira,
swahili: Usiku mmoja Bwana akamwambia Paulo katika maono, “Usiogope, lakini endelea kusema wala usinyamaze,

english: While Apollos was at Corinth, Paul passed through the interior and came to Ephesus. There he found some disciples
ekegusii: Ekaba ekero Apolo arenge Korinto, Paulo agaeta egati y’ense ya rogoro, agaika Efeso. Aroro akanyorana naborokigwa batari bake.
swahili: Apolo alipokuwa huko Korintho, Paulo alisafiri sehemu za bara, akafika Efeso. Huko akawakuta wanafunzi kadhaa,

english: This continued for two years, so that everyone who lived in the province of Asia, Jews and Greeks alike, heard the word of the Lord.
ekegusii: Amang’ana aya akagenderera ase engaki y’emiaka ebere, goika bonsi abamenyete Asia, Abayahudi na Abagiriki, bakaigwa ring’ana ri’Omonene.
swahili: Jambo hili likaendelea kwa muda wa miaka miwili, kiasi kwamba Wayahudi na Wayunani wote walioishi huko Asia wakawa wamesikia neno la Bwana. Wana Wa Skewa Wajaribu Kutoa Pepo Mchafu

english: God did extraordinary miracles through the hands of Paul,
ekegusii: Nyasae agakora ebikone ebinene mono ase amaboko a Paulo,
swahili: Mungu akafanya miujiza mingi isiyo ya kawaida kwa mkono wa Paulo,

english: so that even handkerchiefs and aprons that had touched him were taken to the sick, and the diseases and evil spirits left them. Seven Sons of Sceva
ekegusii: goika chianga na ebitambaa ebiakunete omobere oye bikairwa ase abarwaire, na igo bakagwenigwa amarwaire abo, na emeika emebe ekarua ase bare.
swahili: hivi kwamba leso au vitambaa vilivyokuwa vimegusa mwili wa Paulo viliwekwa juu ya wagonjwa, nao wakapona magonjwa yao, na pepo wachafu wakawatoka.

english: Now there were some itinerant Jewish exorcists who tried to invoke the name of the Lord Jesus over those with evil spirits. They would say, “I bind you by Jesus, whom Paul proclaims.”
ekegusii: Abande b’Abayahudi, abaseria b’emeika emebe, abarenge abaetanani, bagateema gwatora erieta ri’Omonene Yeso igoro y’ababwatire nebirecha ebibe, bagoteeba: “Twabitianirie ase Yeso oria okorandigwa na Paulo.”
swahili: Basi baadhi ya Wayahudi wenye kutangatanga huku na huko wakitoa pepo wachafu wakajaribu kutumia jina la Bwana Yesu wale wenye pepo wakisema, “Kwa jina la Yesu, yule anayehubiriwa na Paulo, nakuamuru utoke.”

english: Seven sons of Sceva, a Jewish chief priest, were doing this.
ekegusii: Abakorete ayio nabamura batano na babere ba Sikewa, Omoyahudi orenge Omokuani omonene.
swahili: Wana saba wa Skewa, Myahudi aliyekuwa kiongozi wa makuhani, walikuwa wanafanya hivyo.

english: Eventually, one of the evil spirits answered them, “Jesus I know, and I know about Paul, but who are you?”
ekegusii: Omoika oria omobe okabairaneria: “Yeso nimomanyete, na Paulo namomanyire, korende inwe mbarabi?”
swahili: Lakini pepo mchafu akawajibu, “Yesu namjua na Paulo pia namjua, lakini ninyi ni nani?”

english: Then the man with the evil spirit jumped on them and overpowered them all. The attack was so violent that they ran out of the house naked and wounded.
ekegusii: Na omonto oria obwatire n’Omoika omobe akabarindokera, akabanyara, akababua, goika bagatama korwa ase enyomba eria getirianda, bare ne chingoma baakirwe.
swahili: Kisha yule mtu aliyekuwa na pepo mchafu akawarukia, akawashambulia vikali, akawashinda nguvu wote, wakatoka ndani ya ile nyumba wakikimbia wakiwa uchi na wenye majeraha.

english: This became known to all the Jews and Greeks living in Ephesus, and fear came over all of them. So the name of the Lord Jesus was held in high honor.
ekegusii: Amang’ana aya akamanyekana ase Abayahudi na Abagiriki bonsi abamenyete Efeso; obwoba bokabasoa bonsi, na erieta ri’Omonene Yeso rikabakwa.
swahili: Habari hii ikajulikana kwa Wayahudi wote na Wayunani waliokaa Efeso, hofu ikawajaa wote, nalo jina la Bwana Yesu likaheshimiwa sana.

english: Many who had believed now came forward, confessing and disclosing their deeds.
ekegusii: Abange babo, abachaagete kwegena, bagaacha, bakaorokia chingencho chiabo chimbe baare gokora.
swahili: Wengi wa wale waliokuwa wameamini wakati huu wakaja na kutubu waziwazi kuhusu matendo yao maovu.

english: And a number of those who had practiced magic arts brought their books and burned them in front of everyone. When the value of the books was calculated, the total came to fifty thousand drachmas.
ekegusii: Abange ase baria abaare gokora chingencho chi’oboragori, bagasangereria ebitabu biabo, bakabisamba ase amasio y’abaanto bonsi. Kobakorire omobaro bw’erigori ri’ebitabu ebio, bakanyora ng’a mbiisanete chiropia chi’echifeta chilifu emerongo etano.
swahili: Idadi kubwa ya wale waliofanya mambo ya uganga wakaleta vitabu vyao na kuviteketeza kwa moto hadharani. Walipofanya hesabu ya thamani ya vitabu vilivyoteketezwa ilikuwa drakma 50,000 za fedha.

english: and asked them, “Did you receive the Holy Spirit when you became believers?” “No,” they answered, “we have not even heard that there is a Holy Spirit.”
ekegusii: Akababoria: “Mwanyorete Omoika Omochenu ekero mwegenete?” Bakamoiraneria: “Yaya, titwana koigwa nonya ng’ake ng’a Omoika Omochenu noreo.”
swahili: akawauliza, “Je, mlipokea Roho Mtakatifu mlipoamini?” Wakajibu, “Hapana, hata hatukusikia kuwa kuna Roho Mtakatifu.”

english: So the word of the Lord powerfully continued to spread and prevail. The Riot in Ephesus
ekegusii: Nabo ring’ana ri’Omonene rikaranda, rikabua. Emeroberio ya Paulo
swahili: Hivyo neno la Bwana likaenea sana na kuwa na nguvu.

english: After these things had happened, Paul resolved in the Spirit to go to Jerusalem after he had passed through Macedonia and Achaia. “After I have been there,” he said, “I must see Rome as well.”
ekegusii: Amang’ana aya achia koera, Paulo akarengereria ase omoika oye ime goeta egati ya Makedonia na Akaya gochia Yerusalemu, ogoteeba: “Magega konabeire agwo ningwenerete korora omochie o Rumi noro.”
swahili: Baada ya mambo haya kutukia, Paulo akakusudia rohoni kwenda Yerusalemu kupitia Makedonia na Akaya. Akasema, “Baada ya kufika huko, yanipasa pia kwenda Rumi.”

english: He sent two of his helpers, Timothy and Erastus, to Macedonia, while he stayed for a time in the province of Asia.
ekegusii: Agatoma abanto babere korwa ase baria baare komokoonya bagende Makedonia, nabwo Timotheo na Erasto. Ere omonyene agatigara Asia ase engaki enke. Eburu‐buru ase Efeso
swahili: Hivyo akatuma wasaidizi wake wawili, Timotheo na Erasto, waende Makedonia, wakati yeye mwenyewe alibaki kwa muda kidogo huko Asia. Ghasia Huko Efeso

english: About that time there arose a great disturbance about the Way.
ekegusii: Ase amatuko ayio eburu‐buru etari nke ekaimoka ase amang’ana ’enchera y’Omonene.
swahili: Wakati huo huo pakatokea dhiki kubwa kwa sababu ya Njia ile ya Bwana.

english: It began with a silversmith named Demetrius who made silver shrines of Artemis, bringing much business to the craftsmen.
ekegusii: Ekiagera omonto oyomo ore korokwa Demeturio, omoturi bw’echifeta, oyorenge gokora ebie Hekalu bie chifeta bi’Aritemi, nigo arenge konyorera abaroisia eniibo enyinge.
swahili: Mtu mmoja jina lake Demetrio mfua fedha aliyekuwa akitengeneza vinyago vya fedha vya Artemi na kuwapatia mafundi wake biashara kubwa,

english: Demetrius assembled the craftsmen, along with the workmen in related trades. “Men,” he said, “you know that this business is our source of prosperity.
ekegusii: Akabasangereria abwo amo nabande ab’emeremo eria, akabora: “Inwe abasacha, mwamanyire ng’a obotenenku bwaito nigo bokorwa ase emeremo eye.
swahili: aliwaita pamoja watu wengine waliofanya kazi ya ufundi kama yake na kusema, “Enyi watu, mnajua ya kuwa utajiri wetu unatokana na biashara hii!

english: And you can see and hear that not only in Ephesus, but in nearly the whole province of Asia, Paul has persuaded a great number of people to turn away. He says that man-made gods are no gods at all.
ekegusii: Naende mwarorire na koigwa ng’a Paulo, oyio oebereirie abanto na kobaonchora, tari ase Efeso oka, korende nonya nase Asia yonsi pi, okobateebia ng’a chinyasae chigokorwa namaboko tari chirochio chinyasae.
swahili: Pia ninyi mmeona na kusikia jinsi ambavyo si huku Efeso peke yake lakini ni karibu Asia yote, huyu Paulo amewashawishi na kuvuta idadi kubwa ya watu kwa kusema kuwa miungu iliyotengenezwa na watu si miungu.

english: There is danger not only that our business will fall into disrepute, but also that the temple of the great goddess Artemis will be discredited and her majesty deposed—she who is worshiped by all the province of Asia and the whole world.”
ekegusii: Nabo ere aakong’u ase tore, tari ng’a nemeremo yaito yoka erachaywe, korende nonya ne Hekalu y’Aritemi, enyasae enkuungu ere enene, nigo erabarwe ng’a teri gento. Naende enyasae eria, egosasimwa n’abanto b’Asia yonsi na ab’ense yonsi nigo eraurwe obonene bwaye.”
swahili: Kwa hiyo kuna hatari si kwa kazi yetu kudharauliwa tu, bali pia hata hekalu la mungu mke Artemi, aliye mkuu, anayeabudiwa Asia yote na ulimwengu wote, litakuwa limepokonywa fahari yake ya kiungu.”

english: When the men heard this, they were enraged and began shouting, “Great is Artemis of the Ephesians!”
ekegusii: Ekero bachia koigwa aya bagaichorwa nendamwamu, bagaaka eriogi, bagateeba: “Aritemi y’Abaefeso nenene!”
swahili: Waliposikia maneno haya, wakaghadhibika, wakaanza kupiga kelele, “Artemi wa Waefeso ni mkuu!”

english: Soon the whole city was in disarray. They rushed together into the theatre, dragging with them Gaius and Aristarchus, Paul’s traveling companions from Macedonia.
ekegusii: Omochie bwonsi ogaichorwa neburu‐buru, bakabwata Gayo na Aristariko, abanto ba Makedonia, baare gotaara amo na Paulo, bakabakurura na bakaminyoka amo gochia aase chigosori chigokorerwa.
swahili: Mara mji wote ukajaa ghasia. Wakawakamata Gayo na Aristarko, watu wa Makedonia waliokuwa wakisafiri pamoja na Paulo, na watu wakakimbilia katika ukumbi wa michezo kama mtu mmoja.

english: “Into what, then, were you baptized?” Paul asked. “The baptism of John,” they replied.
ekegusii: Akababoria: “Mbatiiso ki mwabatisetwe?” Bakamoiraneria: “Ase ebatiiso ya Yohana.”
swahili: Ndipo Paulo akawauliza, “Je, mlibatizwa kwa ubatizo gani?” Wakajibu, “Kwa ubatizo wa Yohana.”

english: Paul wanted to go before the assembly, but the disciples would not allow him.
ekegusii: Na Paulo akarigia gosoa ase egati y’abanto, korende aborokigwa tibamwanchera.
swahili: Paulo akataka kuingia katikati ya umati huo, lakini wanafunzi hawakumruhusu.

english: Even some of Paul’s friends who were officials of the province of Asia sent word to him, begging him not to venture into the theatre.
ekegusii: Abande b’abanene b’Asia, abarenge abasani baye, bagatoma abanto asare, bakamosorora tabaisa kweorokia omonyene aase chigosori chigokorerwa.
swahili: Hata baadhi ya viongozi wa sehemu ile, waliokuwa rafiki zake Paulo, wakatuma watu wakitamani asiingie katika ule ukumbi.

english: Meanwhile the assembly was in turmoil. Some were shouting one thing and some another, and most of them did not even know why they were there.
ekegusii: Bono abande nigo barenge korera iga, na abande iga, ekiagera omosangererekano oria konya obeire neburu‐buru. Abange ase bare tibamanyete nase ki basangererekanete amo.
swahili: Ule umati ulikuwa na taharuki. Wengine walikuwa wakipiga kelele, hawa wakisema hili na wengine lile. Idadi kubwa ya watu hawakujua hata ni kwa nini walikuwa wamekusanyika huko.

english: The Jews in the crowd pushed Alexander forward to explain himself, and he motioned for silence so he could make his defense to the people.
ekegusii: Abande ase omosangererekano bagatebereria Alekisanda, oyo Abayahudi bakamosukia ase amaiso ’abaanto. Alekisanda akaimokia okoboko kwaye, akarigia gwekengera.
swahili: Wayahudi wakamsukumia Aleksanda mbele na baadhi ya watu kwenye ule umati wakampa maelekezo. Akawaashiria kwa mkono ili watulie aweze kujitetea mbele ya watu.

english: But when they realized that he was a Jew, they all shouted in unison for about two hours: “Great is Artemis of the Ephesians!”
ekegusii: Korende ekero bamomanya ng’a ere n’Omoyahudi, bagakuura bonsi amo ase egeka ki’ang’e chinsa ibere chingima, bakorera: “Aritemi y’Abaefeso nenene!”
swahili: Lakini walipotambua kwamba alikuwa Myahudi, wote wakapiga kelele kwa sauti moja kwa karibu muda wa saa mbili, wakisema, “Artemi wa Efeso ni mkuu!”

english: Finally the city clerk quieted the crowd and declared, “Men of Ephesus, doesn’t everyone know that the city of Ephesus is guardian of the temple of the great Artemis and of her image, which fell from heaven?
ekegusii: Omoriki bw’omochie agakiria abanto agateeba: “Inwe abasacha b’Efeso, monto ki ore aa otamanyeti ng’a omochie bw’Abaefeso noro omorendi bwe Hekalu y’Aritemi eria enene, na obw’omogwekano oria ogwete korwa igoro?
swahili: Baadaye karani wa mji akaunyamazisha ule umati wa watu na kusema, “Enyi watu wa Efeso, je, ulimwengu wote haujui ya kuwa mji wa Efeso ndio unaotunza hekalu la Artemi aliye mkuu na ile sanamu yake iliyoanguka kutoka mbinguni?

english: Since these things are undeniable, you ought to be calm and not do anything rash.
ekegusii: Gaki, ekiagera amang’ana aya takonyara gokanwa, mogwenerete gokira, timokora ring’ana ria bwango.
swahili: Kwa hiyo, kwa kuwa mambo haya hayakanushiki, inawapasa mnyamaze na wala msifanye lolote kwa haraka.

english: For you have brought these men here, though they have neither robbed our temple nor blasphemed our goddess.
ekegusii: Naki iga mwarenta abanto aba bataibeti ebinto bie Hekalu gose korama enyasae yaito enkuungu.
swahili: Kwa kuwa mmewaleta hawa watu hapa, ingawa hawajaiba hekaluni wala kumkufuru huyu mungu wetu wa kike.

english: So if Demetrius and his fellow craftsmen have a complaint against anyone, the courts are open and proconsuls are available. Let them bring charges against one another there.
ekegusii: Ase igo, onye Demeturio na ababaachi abare amo nere bare ne ring’ana igoro ase omonto, amatuko ’yokogambigwa nare, na abagaambi mbareo, tiga basoerane.
swahili: Basi, ikiwa Demetrio na mafundi wenzake wana jambo zito dhidi ya mtu yeyote, mahakama ziko wazi na wasaidizi wa mwakilishi wa mtawala. Wanaweza kufungua mashtaka.

english: But if you are seeking anything beyond this, it must be settled in a legal assembly.
ekegusii: Korende onye more namang’ana ande, nigo araroisigwe nabagaambi ba botambe.
swahili: Lakini kama kuna jambo jingine lolote zaidi mnalotaka kulileta, itabidi lisuluhishwe katika kusanyiko halali.

english: Paul explained: “John’s baptism was a baptism of repentance. He told the people to believe in the One coming after him, that is, in Jesus.”
ekegusii: Paulo akabateebia: “Yohana nigo aare kobatiisa ebatiso y’okoonchoka, ogoteebia abanto bamwegene ere oyorache gocha magega yaye, oyio nere Yeso.”
swahili: Paulo akasema, “Ubatizo wa Yohana ulikuwa wa toba, aliwaambia watu wamwamini yeye atakayekuja baada yake, yaani, Yesu.”

english: For we are in jeopardy of being charged with rioting for today’s events, and we have no justification to account for this commotion.”
ekegusii: Ekeene obokong’u mbore ase tore, aande mbarigetie gotosoera ase engencho y’eburu‐buru eye ya reero. Karabe igo, rirorio titokonyaara gwekengera ase engencho y’omosangererekano oyo.”
swahili: Kama ilivyo sasa, tuko hatarini kushtakiwa kwa kufanya ghasia kwa sababu ya tukio la leo. Kwa kuwa hakuna sababu tutakayoweza kutoa kuhalalisha msukosuko huu.”

english: After he had said this, he dismissed the assembly.
ekegusii: Ekero akoorire gokwana aya, akaa omosangererekano ribaga ogende.
swahili: Baada ya kusema haya akavunja mkutano.

english: On hearing this, they were baptized into the name of the Lord Jesus.
ekegusii: Ekero bachia koigwa aya, bakabatiiswa ase erieta ri’Omonene Yeso.
swahili: Waliposikia haya, wakabatizwa katika jina la Bwana Yesu.

english: And when Paul laid his hands on them, the Holy Spirit came upon them, and they spoke in tongues and prophesied.
ekegusii: Na ekero Paulo abekire amaboko aye igoro ase bare, Omoika Omochenu okabaikera; bagachaaka gokwana ase emenwa na kobana.
swahili: Paulo alipoweka mikono yake juu yao, Roho Mtakatifu akawashukia, nao wakanena kwa lugha mpya na kutabiri.

english: Then Paul went into the synagogue and spoke boldly there for three months, arguing persuasively about the kingdom of God.
ekegusii: Agasoa ase esinagogi ime, agakwana noboremu, akaorokereria abanto engaki y’emetienyi etato, okobaebereria ase amang’ana y’oborwoti bwa Nyasae.
swahili: Paulo akaingia katika sinagogi na kunena humo kwa ujasiri kwa muda wa miezi mitatu, akijadiliana na watu na kuwashawishi katika mambo ya Ufalme wa Mungu.

english: But when some of them stubbornly refused to believe and publicly maligned the Way, Paul took his disciples and left the synagogue to conduct daily discussions in the lecture hall of Tyrannus.
ekegusii: Korende ekero abande bakong’etie chinkoro chiabo, na tibegena, na bagakwana bobe igoro y’Enchera y’Omonene ase obosio bw’omosangererekano, akaimoka akabatiga, akarusanania aborokigwa, akaba nkoborokereria are kera rituko ase enyomba y’amorokererio ya Tiriano.
swahili: Lakini baadhi yao walikaidi. Walikataa kuamini, na wakakashifu ujumbe wake mbele ya umati wa watu. Basi Paulo aliachana nao. Akawachukua wanafunzi naye, akahojiana nao kila siku katika darasa la Tirano.

english: In my first book, O Theophilus, I wrote about all that Jesus began to do and to teach,
ekegusii: Aye Theofilo, ase egetabu keria kie ritang’ani nariigete igoro y’amang’ana onsi aya Yeso akorete na kworokereria ekero achaagete emeremo yaye,
swahili: Katika kitabu changu cha kwanza nilikuandikia, mpendwa Theofilo, kuhusu mambo yote Yesu aliyofanya na kufundisha tangu mwanzo,

english: They were looking intently into the sky as He was going, when suddenly two men dressed in white stood beside them.
ekegusii: Kobarigereretie mono gochia igoro, ekero are kogenda, rora, abasacha babere, babeekeire chianga chindabu, bagatenena ang’e nabarabwo,
swahili: Walipokuwa bado wakikaza macho yao kuelekea juu alipokuwa akienda zake Mbinguni, tazama ghafula, wanaume wawili waliovaa mavazi meupe wakasimama karibu nao,

english: “Men of Galilee,” they said, “why do you stand here looking into the sky? This same Jesus, who has been taken from you into heaven, will come back in the same way you have seen Him go into heaven.” Matthias Replaces Judas
ekegusii: bakaboora: “Inwe abasacha ba Galili, nase ki moteneine morigereretie gochia igoro? Oyo Yeso, obogorigwe korwa as more kogenda igoro, naboigo naende arairane koreng’ana buna mwamorora akogenda igoro.” Ogochoorwa kw’omotomwa o ikomi na kabere
swahili: wakasema, “Enyi watu wa Galilaya, mbona mnasimama mkitazama juu angani? Huyu Yesu aliyechukuliwa kutoka kwenu kwenda Mbinguni, atarudi tena jinsi iyo hiyo mlivyomwona akienda zake Mbinguni.” Mathiya Achaguliwa Badala Ya Yuda (Mathayo 27:3-10)

english: Then they returned to Jerusalem from the Mount of Olives, which is near the city, a Sabbath day’s journey away.
ekegusii: Erio aborokigwa bakairana gochia Yerusalemu korwa ase egetunwa ki’Emezeituni, ekio kiarenge ang’e na Yerusalemu, oboare bw’orogendo rw’ekiromita eyemo.
swahili: Ndipo waliporudi Yerusalemu kutoka Mlima wa Mizeituni, uliokuwa karibu na Yerusalemu, umbali wa mwendo wa Sabato kutoka mjini.

english: When they arrived, they went to the upper room where they were staying: Peter and John, James and Andrew, Philip and Thomas, Bartholomew and Matthew, James son of Alphaeus, Simon the Zealot, and Judas son of James.
ekegusii: Ekero bachia gosoa, bakariina akanyomba ka irongo aase baikaransete: Petero na Yohana, Yakobo na Anderea, Filipo na Thomas, Baritholomayo na Matayo, Yakobo bw’Alufayo na Simioni, oyomo bw’Abazelote, na Yuda o Yakobo.
swahili: Walipowasili mjini Yerusalemu, walikwenda ghorofani kwenye chumba walichokuwa wakiishi. Wale waliokuwepo walikuwa: Petro, Yohana, Yakobo, Andrea, Filipo, Tomaso, Bartholomayo, Mathayo, Yakobo mwana wa Alfayo, Simoni Zelote na Yuda mwana wa Yakobo.

english: With one accord they all continued in prayer, along with the women and Mary the mother of Jesus, and with His brothers.
ekegusii: Aba iga bonsi nigo bagendererete n’ogosaba ase omoyo oyomo, amo nabakungu bande, na Mariamu ng’ina Yeso, na bamura bamwabo Yeso.
swahili: Hawa wote waliungana pamoja katika maombi. Pamoja nao walikuwepo wanawake kadha, na Maria mama yake Yesu, pamoja na ndugu zake Yesu.

english: In those days Peter stood up among the brothers (a gathering of about a hundred and twenty) and said,
ekegusii: Nyuma y’amatuko make gokaba okoumerana kw’abeegeni, abwo barenge ange (omobaro bw’abaanto ang’e rigana erimo na emerongo ebere) akabora,
swahili: Katika siku hizo Petro akasimama katikati ya waumini (jumla yao wote walikuwa watu wapatao 120), akasema,

english: “Brothers, the Scripture had to be fulfilled which the Holy Spirit foretold through the mouth of David concerning Judas, who became a guide for those who arrested Jesus.
ekegusii: Abeegeni baminto, negwenerete ririiko erio riikeranigwe, eri Omoika Omochenu okwanete kare ase omonwa o Daudi igoro ya Yudasi, oyotang’anete abanto abwo babwatete Yeso.
swahili: “Ndugu zangu, ilibidi Andiko litimie ambalo Roho Mtakatifu alitabiri kupitia kwa Daudi kumhusu Yuda aliyewaongoza wale waliomkamata Yesu.

english: He was one of our number and shared in this ministry.”
ekegusii: Naki Yudasi konya obarirwe amo naintwe, akanyora ensemo y’obokoreri amo naitwe.
swahili: Yuda alikuwa mmoja wetu, kwa maana na yeye alichaguliwa ashiriki katika huduma hii.”

english: (Now with the reward for his wickedness Judas bought a field; there he fell headlong and burst open in the middle, and all his intestines spilled out.
ekegusii: (Naboigo, goetera ase engeria eria aakanetwe ase egekoro kiaye ki’obobe, ere Yudasi akagora omogondo agwo ase agwete goika agakwa; akoreka, erio amara aye onsi agasoka.
swahili: (Basi Yuda alinunua shamba kwa zile fedha za uovu alizopata; akiwa huko shambani akaanguka, akapasuka na matumbo yote yakatoka nje.

english: This became known to all who lived in Jerusalem, so they called that field in their own language Akeldama, that is, Field of Blood.)
ekegusii: Ayio akamanyekana n’abanto bonsi abamenyete Yerusalemu, goika omogondo oria okarokwa ase omonwa obo Akeldama, engencho yaye: Omogondo bw’Amanyinga.)
swahili: Kila mtu Yerusalemu akasikia habari hizi, kwa hiyo wakapaita mahali hapo kwa lugha yao, Akeldama, yaani Shamba la Damu).

english: until the day He was taken up to heaven, after giving instructions through the Holy Spirit to the apostles He had chosen.
ekegusii: goika rituko riria abogoretigwe gochia igoro. Ritang’ani ri’ayio agachiika goetera ase Omoika Omochenu abatomwa baria achoorete.
swahili: hadi siku ile alipochukuliwa kwenda mbinguni, baada ya kuwapa maagizo kupitia kwa Roho Mtakatifu wale mitume aliowachagua.

english: “For it is written in the book of Psalms: ‘May his place be deserted; let there be no one to dwell in it,’ and, ‘May another take his position.’
