ekegusii: Naki nariikire ase egetabu gia Zaburi: Obomenyo bwaye botigare bosa, nonya monto onde tabaisa komenyao; naende nerikiire: Oboteneneri bwaye omoao aboire.
swahili: “Kama vile ilivyoandikwa katika kitabu cha Zaburi, “ ‘Mahali pake na pawe ukiwa, wala asiwepo yeyote atakayeishi humo,’ na, “ ‘Mtu mwingine aichukue nafasi yake ya uongozi.’

english: Therefore it is necessary to choose one of the men who have accompanied us the whole time the Lord Jesus went in and out among us,
ekegusii: Naboigo natonyore oyomo okobwatana naitwe koba kirori ase okobokigwa kw’omonene oito Yeso Kristo. Ere goika abe korwa ase egati yabaanto barenge gotaara amo naintwe ase ekero gionsi eki Omonene Yeso arenge gosoa na gosoka ase egati yaito,
swahili: Kwa hiyo inatubidi tumchague mtu mwingine miongoni mwa wale ambao wamekuwa pamoja nasi wakati wote Bwana Yesu alipoingia na kutoka katikati yenu,

english: beginning from John’s baptism until the day Jesus was taken up from us. For one of these must become a witness with us of His resurrection.”
ekegusii: korwa ase okobatisa kwa Yohana goika rituko riria Yeso abogoretigwe korwa ase tore gochia igoro.
swahili: kuanzia ubatizo wa Yohana mpaka siku aliyochukuliwa kutoka kwetu kwenda Mbinguni. Kwa kuwa mmoja wao inabidi awe shahidi pamoja nasi wa ufufuo wake.”

english: So they proposed two men: Joseph called Barsabbas (also known as Justus) and Matthias.
ekegusii: Bagaatora babere, Yusufu ore korokwa Barsaba, naende erieta rinde Yusto, na Matia.
swahili: Wakapendekeza majina ya watu wawili: Yosefu, aitwaye Barsaba (ambaye pia alijulikana kama Yusto) na Mathiya.

english: And they prayed, “Lord, You know everyone’s heart. Show us which of these two You have chosen
ekegusii: Bagasaba, bakaboora: “Aye omonene, oyomanyete chinkoro chi’abaanto bonsi, tworokie ning’o gwachorire ase aba iga babere
swahili: Kisha wakaomba, wakasema, “Bwana, wewe waujua moyo wa kila mtu. Tuonyeshe ni yupi kati ya hawa wawili uliyemchagua

english: to take up this ministry and apostleship, which Judas abandoned to go to his rightful place.”
ekegusii: abogorie ensemo y’ogokora oko na obotomwa obo Yudasi atigete, akagenda aase aye.”
swahili: ili achukue nafasi ya huduma ya utume ambayo Yuda aliiacha ili aende mahali pake mwenyewe.”

english: Then they cast lots, and the lot fell to Matthias; so he was added to the eleven apostles.
ekegusii: Bakabarutera obomera, na obomera bokagwera Matia; erio ere agachorwa koba amo nabatomwa ikomi nomo.
swahili: Kisha wakawapigia kura, nayo kura ikamwangukia Mathiya, naye akaongezwa kwenye wale mitume kumi na mmoja.

english: After His suffering, He presented Himself to them with many convincing proofs that He was alive. He appeared to them over a span of forty days and spoke about the kingdom of God.
ekegusii: Magega y’ogochandwa kwaye akeorokia ase bare ase ebiorokererio ebinge ng’a moyo are. Akaba okobaorokera ase engaki y’amatuko emerongo ene, na gokwana nabarabwo igoro y’oborwoti bwa Nyasae.
swahili: Baada ya mateso yake, alijionyesha kwao na kuwathibitishia kwa njia nyingi kwamba yeye yu hai. Katika muda wa siku arobaini baada ya kufufuka kwake aliwatokea na kunena kuhusu Ufalme wa Mungu.

english: And while they were gathered together, He commanded them: “Do not leave Jerusalem, but wait for the gift the Father promised, which you have heard Me discuss.
ekegusii: Ekero asangererekanete amo nabarabwo, akabachiika tibabaisa korua Yerusalemu, akabateebia: “Moganye eira ya Tata, eria mwaigwete korwa ase ’nde.
swahili: Wakati mmoja alipokuwa pamoja nao, aliwapa amri hii, “Msitoke Yerusalemu, bali ingojeni ahadi ya Baba, ambayo mmenisikia nikisema habari zake.

english: For John baptized with water, but in a few days you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit. ” The Ascension (Mark 16:19–20; Luke 24:50–53)
ekegusii: Yohana nigo arenge kobatisa ase amaache, korende inwe inamobatiiswe ase Omoika Omochenu magega y’amatuko amake.” Okobogorigwa kwa Yeso gochia igoro (Mar 16:19-20; Luk 24:50-53)
swahili: Yohana aliwabatiza kwa maji, lakini baada ya siku chache mtabatizwa kwa Roho Mtakatifu.” Yesu Apaa Mbinguni (Marko 16:19-20; Luka 24:50-53)

english: So when they came together, they asked Him, “Lord, will You at this time restore the kingdom to Israel?”
ekegusii: Erio ekero basangererekanete amo, bakamobooria: “Omonene, ekero eke nakio okoiraneria Abaisraeli oborwoti bwabo?”
swahili: Mitume walipokuwa wamekusanyika pamoja, wakamuuliza Yesu, “Bwana, je, huu ndio wakati wa kuwarudishia Israeli ufalme?”

english: Jesus replied, “It is not for you to know times or seasons that the Father has fixed by His own authority.
ekegusii: Akabairaneria: “Tari igoro yaino komanya ebiro gose chingaki. Tata obibeekire ase okobua kwaye omonyene.
swahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Si juu yenu kujua nyakati na majira ambayo Baba ameyaweka katika mamlaka yake mwenyewe.

english: But you will receive power when the Holy Spirit comes upon you, and you will be My witnesses in Jerusalem, and in all Judea and Samaria, and to the ends of the earth.”
ekegusii: Korende namonyore chinguru, ekero Omoika Omochenu abacheire, na inwe inamobe kirori baane ase Yerusalemu, na ase chinsemo chionsi chia Boyahudi na Samaria, na goika chinsinyo chi’ense.”
swahili: Lakini mtapokea nguvu akiisha kuwajilia juu yenu Roho Mtakatifu, nanyi mtakuwa mashahidi wangu katika Yerusalemu, Uyahudi kote na Samaria, hadi miisho ya dunia.”

english: After He had said this, they watched as He was taken up, and a cloud hid Him from their sight.
ekegusii: Ekero akwanete aya, kobarigereretie, akabogorigwa gochia igoro, riire rikamoira korwa ase amaiso abo.
swahili: Baada ya kusema mambo haya, walipokuwa wanatazama, akachukuliwa juu mbinguni mbele ya macho yao na wingu likampokea wasimwone tena.

english: When the uproar had ended, Paul sent for the disciples. And after encouraging them, he said goodbye to them and left for Macedonia.
ekegusii: Eburu‐buru eria egachia koera, Paulo akarangeria aborokigwa, akabaremia, agatigana nabarabwo, akaimoka akagenda Makedonia.
swahili: Baada ya zile ghasia kumalizika, Paulo aliwaita wanafunzi pamoja akawatia moyo, akawaaga, akaanza safari kwenda Makedonia.

english: But Paul went down, threw himself on the young man, and embraced him. “Do not be alarmed!” he said. “He is still alive!”
ekegusii: Korende Paulo agaika, akamoumamera, akamoagata, akabora: “Timoichana, ekiagera obogima bwaye nao bore ime yaye.”
swahili: Paulo akashuka chini, akajitupa juu yake na kumkumbatia, akasema, “Msishtuke, uzima wake bado umo ndani yake.”

english: Then Paul went back upstairs, broke bread, and ate. And after speaking until daybreak, he departed.
ekegusii: Paulo akariina igoro naende, agasamunyora omogati akaria, agakwana nabarabwo goika bogakia mambia. Erio akaimoka, akagenda.
swahili: Kisha Paulo akapanda tena ghorofani, akamega mkate na kula. Baada ya kuongea mpaka mapambazuko, akaondoka.

english: And the people were greatly relieved to take the boy home alive. From Troas to Miletus
ekegusii: Bakarenta omomura oria, ore moyo, bakaba nokoremigwa okonene. Orogendo gochia Mileto
swahili: Watu wakamrudisha yule kijana nyumbani akiwa hai nao wakafarijika sana. Paulo Awaaga Wazee Wa Efeso

english: We went on ahead to the ship and sailed to Assos, where we were to take Paul aboard. He had arranged this because he was going there on foot.
ekegusii: Korende intwe togatang’ana kogenda n’emeeri, tokagenda goika Asosi. Tokarengereria ng’a ntonyore Paulo aria, ekiagera ere nabo achiigete. Ere omonyene nigo arengereretie kogenda namagoro.
swahili: Tukatangulia melini tukasafiri mpaka Aso ambako tungempakia Paulo. Alikuwa amepanga hivyo kwa maana alitaka kufika kwa miguu.

english: And when he met us at Assos, we took him aboard and went on to Mitylene.
ekegusii: Ekero achia gotoikeera aaria Asosi, tokamosoyia ase emeeri, togaika Metilene.
swahili: Alipotukuta huko Aso, tulimpakia melini, tukasafiri wote mpaka Mitilene.

english: Sailing on from there, we arrived the next day opposite Chios. The day after that we arrived at Samos, and on the following day we came to Miletus.
ekegusii: Tokamanora korwa agwo, ne rituko ria kabere togaika kororia Kio. Rituko ria gatato togaika Samo, tokabeera Torogilo, ne rituko ria kane togaika Mileto.
swahili: Kutoka huko tuliendelea kwa njia ya bahari, na kesho yake tukafika mahali panapokabili Kio. Siku iliyofuata tukavuka kwenda Samo, na kesho yake tukawasili Mileto.

english: Paul had decided to sail past Ephesus to avoid spending time in the province of Asia, because he was in a hurry to reach Jerusalem, if possible, by the day of Pentecost. Paul’s Farewell to the Ephesians
ekegusii: Naki Paulo nigo arengereretie goeta Efeso mbarabare, tabaisa goteebana ase Asia, ekiagera nigo are koayerera kogenda Yerusalemu rituko ria Pentekosti, keranyarekane. Paulo ogoakera abagaaka ba Efeso ng’a batigare buya
swahili: Paulo alikuwa ameamua tusipitie Efeso ili asitumie muda mwingi huko sehemu za Asia, kwa sababu alikuwa anatamani kama ikiwezekana kufika Yerusalemu kabla ya siku ya Pentekoste.

english: From Miletus, Paul sent to Ephesus for the elders of the church.
ekegusii: Korwa Mileto Paulo agatoma abanto kogenda Efeso barangerie abagaaka b’ekanisa.
swahili: Paulo akiwa Mileto, alituma mjumbe kwenda Efeso kuwaita wazee wa kanisa waje wakutane naye.

english: When they came to him, he said, “You know how I lived the whole time I was with you, from the first day I arrived in the province of Asia.
ekegusii: Bagachia goika asare, akabateebia. “Inwe abanyene mwamanyire buna narenge egati yaino ekero gionsi korwa rituko rie ritang’ani nachaagete gotacha aiga Asia,
swahili: Walipofika akawaambia, “Ninyi wenyewe mnajua jinsi nilivyoishi katikati yenu muda wote tangu siku ya kwanza nilipokanyaga hapa Asia.

english: I served the Lord with great humility and with tears, especially in the trials that came upon me through the plots of the Jews.
ekegusii: buna nakorerete Omonene ase obokanyeku bwonsi, na ase amariga, na ase amateemwa nanyorete ase ogotega kw’Abayahudi.
swahili: Nilimtumikia Bwana kwa unyenyekevu wote na kwa machozi nikivumilia taabu na mapingamizi yaliyonipata kutokana na hila za Wayahudi.

english: After traveling through that area and speaking many words of encouragement, he arrived in Greece,
ekegusii: Erio gaetire chinsemo chiria na gokwana amang’ana amange ase okobaremia, agaika Bogiriki.
swahili: Alipita katika sehemu zile, akinena na watu maneno mengi ya kuwatia moyo. Ndipo hatimaye akawasili Uyunani,

english: I did not shrink back from declaring anything that was helpful to you as I taught you publicly and from house to house,
ekegusii: Inche tinabisete ring’ana rinde rionsi eriranyare kobakonya, korende inaborogetie inwe maiso marore enyomba ase enyomba,
swahili: Mnajua kwamba sikusita kuhubiri jambo lolote ambalo lingekuwa la kuwafaa ninyi, lakini nilifundisha hadharani na nyumba kwa nyumba.

english: testifying to Jews and Greeks alike about repentance to God and faith in our Lord Jesus Christ.
ekegusii: na ngakuurera Abayahudi na Abagiriki baonchokere Nyasae, na komwegen’Omonene oito Yeso Kristo.
swahili: Nimewashuhudia Wayahudi na Wayunani kwamba inawapasa kumgeukia Mungu kwa kutubu dhambi na kumwamini Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo.

english: And now, compelled by the Spirit, I am going to Jerusalem, not knowing what will happen to me there.
ekegusii: Gaki bono rora, nkogenda nde Yerusalemu, nasibirwe n’Omoika. Timanyeti ayarachie konyoora aaria,
swahili: “Nami sasa nimesukumwa na Roho, ninakwenda Yerusalemu wala sijui ni nini kitakachonipata huko.

english: I only know that in town after town the Holy Spirit warns me that chains and afflictions await me.
ekegusii: otatiga ng’a Omoika Omochenu nigo okoorokia omochie ase omochie ng’a ogosibwa na emechando mbinganyete.
swahili: Ila ninachojua tu ni kwamba Roho Mtakatifu amenionya kuwa vifungo na mateso vinaningoja.

english: But I consider my life of no value to me, if only I may finish my course and complete the ministry I have received from the Lord Jesus—the ministry of testifying to the good news of God’s grace.
ekegusii: Korende obogima bwane timbobareti ng’a negento kie rigori rinene ase ’nde, erinde nkoore orogendo rwane, na obosomba boria nanyorete ase Omonene Yeso koorokia enchiri y’amaabera a Nyasae.
swahili: Lakini siyahesabu maisha yangu kuwa ya thamani kwangu, kama kuyamaliza mashindano na kukamilisha ile kazi Bwana Yesu aliyonipa, yaani, kazi ya kuishuhudia Injili ya neema ya Mungu.

english: Now I know that none of you among whom I have preached the kingdom will see my face again.
ekegusii: Bono rora, namanyire ng’a timokondora obosio bwane naende, inwe mwensi aba nabeire ngotaara ase egati yaino na kobaranderia amang’ana ’oborwoti bwa Nyasae.
swahili: “Nami sasa najua ya kuwa hakuna hata mmoja miongoni mwenu ambaye nimemhubiria Ufalme wa Mungu katika kwenda kwangu huku na huko, atakayeniona uso tena.

english: Therefore I testify to you this day that I am innocent of the blood of all men.
ekegusii: Ase ayio nabaorokeirie bonsi ase rituko ria reero, ng’a inche tindi na komocha ase amanyinga a monto onde bwensi,
swahili: Kwa hiyo nawatangazia leo, sina hatia ya damu ya mtu awaye yote.

english: For I did not shrink back from declaring to you the whole will of God.
ekegusii: ekiagera tinangete kobaranderia amang’ana ’okworokereria gwonsi kwa Nyasae.
swahili: Kwa kuwa sikusita kuwatangazia mapenzi yote ya Mungu.

english: Keep watch over yourselves and the entire flock of which the Holy Spirit has made you overseers. Be shepherds of the church of God, which He purchased with His own blood.
ekegusii: Mwerende inwe abanyene amo ne riicho riria Omoika Omochenu obabegete mobe abarendi korisia ekanisa ya Nyasae, eye enyorerete namanyinga aye omonyene.
swahili: Jilindeni nafsi zenu na mlilinde lile kundi lote ambalo Roho Mtakatifu amewaweka ninyi kuwa waangalizi wake. Lichungeni kanisa lake Mungu alilolinunua kwa damu yake mwenyewe.

english: I know that after my departure, savage wolves will come in among you and will not spare the flock.
ekegusii: Namanyire inche ng’a magega ase okoimoka kwane chisese chi’orosana chintindi nachiche ase more, tichirorera riicho amaabera,
swahili: Najua kwamba baada yangu kuondoka, mbwa mwitu wakali watakuja katikati yenu ambao hawatalihurumia kundi.

english: where he stayed three months. And when the Jews formed a plot against him as he was about to sail for Syria, he decided to go back through Macedonia.
ekegusii: Akamenya aroro emetienyi etato. Ekiagera Abayahudi bamoboerete, konya omanoire kogenda ase enyancha gochia Siiria, agachoora koiranera goetera Makedonia.
swahili: ambako alikaa kwa muda wa miezi mitatu. Alipokuwa anakaribia kuanza safari kwa njia ya bahari kwenda Shamu, kwa sababu Wayahudi walikuwa wamefanya shauri baya dhidi yake, aliamua kurudi kupitia njia ya Makedonia.

english: Even from your own number, men will rise up and distort the truth to draw away disciples after them.
ekegusii: naende korwa ase egati yaino abanto mbaimoke bagokwana amang’ana ’obong’ainereria, bang’use aborokigwa babatunyane.
swahili: Hata kutoka miongoni mwenu watainuka watu na kuupotosha ukweli ili wawavute wanafunzi wawafuate.

english: Therefore be alert and remember that for three years I never stopped warning each of you night and day with tears.
ekegusii: Ase ayio renda, moinyore ng’a ase emiaka etato, obotuko na omobaso, tinatigete gokuurera kera omonto ase amariga.
swahili: Hivyo jilindeni! Kumbukeni kwamba kwa miaka mitatu sikuacha kamwe kuwaonya kila mmoja kwa machozi usiku na mchana.

english: And now I commit you to God and to the word of His grace, which can build you up and give you an inheritance among all who are sanctified.
ekegusii: Gaki bono nababekire ase amaboko a Nyasae, na ase ring’ana ri’obuya bwaye, asare ere oyoranyaare kobaagacha na kobaa omwando amo nabwo bonsi abachenirwe.
swahili: “Sasa nawakabidhi kwa Mungu na kwa neno la neema yake, linaloweza kuwajenga na kuwapa ninyi urithi miongoni mwa wote ambao wametakaswa.

english: I have not coveted anyone’s silver or gold or clothing.
ekegusii: Tinaganetie efeta, nonya netaabu gose chianga.
swahili: Sikutamani fedha wala dhahabu wala vazi la mtu yeyote.

english: You yourselves know that these hands of mine have ministered to my own needs and those of my companions.
ekegusii: Inwe abanyene mwamanyire ng’a amaboko aya aane ankoreire okorigia kwane, na okw’abwo barenge amo nainche.
swahili: Ninyi wenyewe mnajua kwamba mikono yangu hii imetumika kwa mahitaji yangu na ya wale waliokuwa pamoja nami.

english: In everything, I showed you that by this kind of hard work we must help the weak, remembering the words of the Lord Jesus Himself: ‘It is more blessed to give than to receive.’”
ekegusii: Ase amang’ana aya onsi nabaorokeirie ng’a ase ogokora emeremo iga, nebagwenerete mokonye abatari ne chinguru, na koinyora amang’ana ’Omonene Yeso, buna akwanete omonyene: Nasesenirie oyokorua kobua oyokonyoora.”
swahili: Katika kila jambo nimewaonyesha kwamba kwa njia hii ya kufanya kazi kwa bidii imetupasa kuwasaidia wadhaifu, mkikumbuka maneno ya Bwana Yesu mwenyewe jinsi alivyosema, ‘Ni heri kutoa kuliko kupokea.’ ”

english: When Paul had said this, he knelt down with all of them and prayed.
ekegusii: Gakoorire gokwana aya agatung’ama inse, agasaba amo nabarabwo bonsi.
swahili: Paulo alipomaliza kusema haya akapiga magoti pamoja nao wote akaomba.

english: They all wept openly as they embraced Paul and kissed him.
ekegusii: Na bonsi bakaiyeria amariga, bakaboania Paulo rigoti riaye, bakamonyunyunta.
swahili: Wote wakalia, wakamkumbatia Paulo na kumbusu,

english: They were especially grieved by his statement that they would never see his face again. Then they accompanied him to the ship.
ekegusii: Bagaichana kobua ase engencho ye ring’ana riaye, ateebete ng’a: “Timokondora obosio bwane naende.” Bakamokooba goika ase emeeri.
swahili: Kilichowahuzunisha zaidi ni kwa sababu ya yale maneno aliyosema kwamba kamwe hawatauona uso wake tena. Wakaenda naye mpaka kwenye meli.

english: Paul was accompanied by Sopater son of Pyrrhus from Berea, Aristarchus and Secundus from Thessalonica, Gaius from Derbe, Timothy, and Tychicus and Trophimus from the province of Asia.
ekegusii: Abanto aba bakagenda nere: Sopater Omoberoya, mosinto o Piro, Aristariko na Sekundo, abanto ba Tesaloniki, na Gayo, omonto o Deribe, na Timotheo, na abanto b’Asia, Tukiko na Torofimo.
swahili: Paulo alikuwa amefuatana na Sopatro mwana wa Piro, Mberoya, Aristarko na Sekundo kutoka Thesalonike na Gayo, mtu wa Derbe, Timotheo pamoja na Tikiko na Trofimo kutoka sehemu ya Asia.

english: These men went on ahead and waited for us in Troas.
ekegusii: Abanto aba bagatang’ana, bagatoganyera Teroa.
swahili: Hawa watu walitutangulia wakaenda kutungojea Troa.

english: And after the Feast of Unleavened Bread, we sailed from Philippi, and five days later we rejoined them in Troas, where we stayed seven days. Eutychus Revived at Troas (2 Kings 4:18–37)
ekegusii: Intwe tokarua Filipi n’emeeri magega y’amatuko y’Emegati etabekiri memera, tokagenda orogendo rw’amatuko atano, tokabaikeera Teroa. Tokabeera aroro amatuko atano na abere. Eutiko
swahili: Lakini sisi tukasafiri kwa njia ya bahari kwa siku tano kutoka Filipi baada ya siku za Sikukuu ya Mikate Isiyotiwa Chachu, nasi tukaungana na wengine huko Troa, ambako tulikaa kwa siku saba. Eutiko Afufuliwa Huko Troa

english: On the first day of the week we came together to break bread. Since Paul was ready to leave the next day, he talked to them and kept on speaking until midnight.
ekegusii: Ase rituko rie ritang’ani ri’echuma, ekero twasangererekanete ase ogosamunyora omogati, Paulo agakwana nabarabwo, agachiererera namang’ana aye goika botuko gati, ekiagera arengereretie komanora rituko ria kabere.
swahili: Siku ya kwanza ya juma tulikutana pamoja kwa ajili ya kumega mkate. Paulo akaongea na watu, naye kwa kuwa alikuwa amekusudia kuondoka kesho yake, aliendelea kuongea mpaka usiku wa manane.

english: Now there were many lamps in the upper room where we were gathered.
ekegusii: Nchiarengeo chitaaya chinyinge ase enyomba ya irongo aase twasangererekanete.
swahili: Kwenye chumba cha ghorofani walimokuwa wamekutania kulikuwa na taa nyingi.

english: And a certain young man named Eutychus, seated in the window, was sinking into a deep sleep as Paul talked on and on. When he was sound asleep, he fell from the third story and was picked up dead.
ekegusii: Omomura oyomo, erieta riaye Eutiko, oikaransete ase ekebao, akabwatwa ne chitoro chindito ekero Paulo agendererete gokwana; akabugwa ne chitoro chinyinge akagwa korwa rirongo ria gatato, akabogorigwa konya okuure.
swahili: Kijana mmoja jina lake Eutiko, alikuwa amekaa dirishani, wakati Paulo alipokuwa akihubiri kwa muda mrefu, alipatwa na usingizi mzito, akaanguka kutoka ghorofa ya tatu, wakamwinua akiwa amekufa.

english: After we had torn ourselves away from them, we sailed directly to Cos, and the next day on to Rhodes, and from there to Patara.
ekegusii: Ekero twatananekire nabarabwo na komanora n’emeeri, tokagenda boronge goika Kosi, na ase rituko ria kabere togaika Rodo, na korwa aroro togaika Patara.
swahili: Tulipokwisha kujitenga nao, tukaanza safari kwa njia ya bahari moja kwa moja mpaka Kosi. Siku ya pili yake tukafika Rodo na kutoka huko tukaenda Patara.

english: After we had been there several days, a prophet named Agabus came down from Judea.
ekegusii: Gatwamenyire aroro amatuko atai make, omobani oyomo, erieta riaye Agabo, agatirimboka korwa Boyahudi.
swahili: Baada ya kukaa kwa siku kadhaa, akateremka nabii mmoja kutoka Uyahudi jina lake Agabo.

english: Coming over to us, he took Paul’s belt, bound his own feet and hands, and said, “The Holy Spirit says: ‘In this way the Jews of Jerusalem will bind the owner of this belt and hand him over to the Gentiles.’”
ekegusii: Agaacha ase tore, akabogoria orokini rwa Paulo, agesibera amagoro na amaboko, akabora: “Omoika Omochenu oteebire iga: Naboigo Abayahudi ba Yerusalemu barache gosiba omonto omonyene orokini oro, na barabwo nabamobeke ase amaboko ’abaanto b’Ebisaku.”
swahili: Alipotufikia akachukua mshipi wa Paulo akajifunga, akautumia kufunga mikono na miguu yake mwenyewe akasema, “Roho Mtakatifu anasema: ‘Hivi ndivyo Wayahudi wa Yerusalemu watakavyomfunga mwenye mshipi huu na kumkabidhi kwa watu wa Mataifa.’ ”

english: When we heard this, we and the people there pleaded with Paul not to go up to Jerusalem.
ekegusii: Togachia koigwa aya, intwe na abanto baria tokamosorora tabaisa gotiira gochia Yerusalemu.
swahili: Tuliposikia maneno haya sisi na ndugu wengine tukamsihi Paulo asiende Yerusalemu.

english: Then Paul answered, “Why are you weeping and breaking my heart? I am ready not only to be bound, but also to die in Jerusalem for the name of the Lord Jesus.”
ekegusii: Erio Paulo akairaneria: “Inki eke mogokora, mokorera na kong’ita omoyo? Nigo inde ang’e, tari ase ogosibwa gwoka, korende nonya nogoitwa ase Yerusalemu ase engencho y’erieta ri’Omonene Yeso.”
swahili: Lakini Paulo akajibu, “Kwa nini mnalia na kunivunja moyo? Mimi niko tayari si kufungwa tu, bali hata kufa huko Yerusalemu kwa ajili ya jina la Bwana Yesu.”

english: When he would not be dissuaded, we fell silent and said, “The Lord’s will be done.”
ekegusii: Erio kangire amang’ana aito togakira togateeba: “Ogwancha kw’Omonene tiga gokoreke.” Goika Yerusalemu
swahili: Alipokuwa hashawishiki, tukaacha kumsihi, tukasema, “Mapenzi ya Bwana na yatendeke.”

english: After these days, we packed up and went on to Jerusalem.
ekegusii: Magega ase amatuko ayio tokeebeka ang’e togatiira kogenda Yerusalemu.
swahili: Baada ya haya, tukajiandaa, tukaondoka kwenda Yerusalemu.

english: Some of the disciples from Caesarea accompanied us, and they took us to stay at the home of Mnason the Cypriot, an early disciple. Paul’s Arrival at Jerusalem
ekegusii: Abande baborokigwa ba Kaisaria bakagenda amo naintwe, bagatoira mwa Mnasoni, omonto o Kuporo, omworokigwa o kare, tokarara bwoye.
swahili: Baadhi ya wanafunzi kutoka Kaisaria wakafuatana nasi na kutupeleka nyumbani kwa Mnasoni, ambaye tungekaa kwake. Yeye alikuwa mtu wa Kipro, mmoja wa wanafunzi wa zamani. Kukamatwa Kwa Paulo, Na Safari Yake Kwenda Rumi (21:17–28:31) Paulo Awasili Yerusalemu

english: When we arrived in Jerusalem, the brothers welcomed us joyfully.
ekegusii: Ekero twaigete Yerusalemu abaminto bagatoroisia ase omogooko. Omokia o Paulo bw’okobwatana n’Abakristo b’Abayahudi
swahili: Tulipofika Yerusalemu ndugu wakatukaribisha kwa furaha.

english: The next day Paul went in with us to see James, and all the elders were present.
ekegusii: Rituko rikobwatia Paulo agasoa mwa Yakobo amo naintwe, na abagaaka bonsi nao barenge.
swahili: Kesho yake Paulo pamoja na wengine wetu tulikwenda kumwona Yakobo, na wazee wote walikuwepo.

english: Paul greeted them and recounted one by one the things that God had done among the Gentiles through his ministry.
ekegusii: Kabakwanirie, akaborokia amang’ana onsi erimo erimo, aya Nyasae akorire ase egati y’abanto b’Ebisaku ase obosomba bwaye.
swahili: Baada ya kuwasalimu, Paulo akatoa taarifa kamili ya mambo yote ambayo Mungu alikuwa amefanya miongoni mwa watu wa Mataifa kupitia huduma yake.

english: Finding a ship crossing over to Phoenicia, we boarded it and set sail.
ekegusii: Tokanyoora emeeri eyeranyaare kwamboka goika Foiniki, tokariina emeeri eria, tokagenda.
swahili: Hapo tukapata meli iliyokuwa inavuka kwenda Foinike tukapanda tukasafiri nayo.

english: When they heard this, they glorified God. Then they said to Paul, “You see, brother, how many thousands of Jews have believed, and all of them are zealous for the law.
ekegusii: Barabwo, ekero bachia koigwa, bagatogia Nyasae, bakamoteebia: “Oyominto, kwarorire ng’a Abayahudi chilifu chinyinge begenire; na barabwo bonsi nigo bare nomokia ng’a amachiiko abwatwe.
swahili: Baada ya kusikia mambo haya wakamwadhimisha Mungu. Ndipo wakamwambia Paulo, “Ndugu, unaona kulivyo na maelfu ya Wayahudi walioamini, nao wote wana juhudi kwa ajili ya sheria.

english: But they are under the impression that you teach all the Jews who live among the Gentiles to forsake Moses, telling them not to circumcise their children or observe our customs.
ekegusii: Na barabwo mbateebetigwe ng’a kworokereirie Abayahudi bonsi abamenyete ase egati y’abanto b’Ebisaku ng’a batige Musa, gokobakania tibarokia abana babo, gose tibabwatia chingencho chiaito.
swahili: Lakini wameambiwa habari zako kwamba unafundisha Wayahudi wote waishio miongoni mwa watu wa Mataifa kumkataa Mose, na kwamba unawaambia wasiwatahiri watoto wao wala kufuata desturi zetu.

english: What then should we do? They will certainly hear that you have come.
ekegusii: Inki rende kegwenerete gekorwe? Ekeene, nabo baraigwe ng’a gwachire aiga.
swahili: Sasa tufanyeje? Bila shaka watasikia kwamba umekuja Yerusalemu.

english: Therefore do what we advise you. There are four men with us who have taken a vow.
ekegusii: Gaki kora ring’ana eri toragoteebie. Mbare aiga ase tore abanto baane abariete eira gete.
swahili: Kwa hiyo fanya lile tunalokuambia. Tunao watu wanne hapa ambao wameweka nadhiri.

english: Take these men, purify yourself along with them, and pay their expenses so they can have their heads shaved. Then everyone will know that there is no truth to these rumors about you, but that you also live in obedience to the law.
ekegusii: Ira abanto aba okore buna engencho y’ogwesibia ere amo nabarabwo, obaakanere chitaabu, erinde bakigite chitukia chiabo. Igo abanto bonsi banyare komanya ng’a amang’ana aria bateebetigwe igoro yao tari ay’ekeene, korende aye omonyene nigo okogenderera buya na kobwata amachiiko.
swahili: Jiunge na watu hawa, mfanye utaratibu wa ibada ya kujitakasa pamoja nao, na ulipe gharama ili wanyoe nywele zao. Kwa njia hii kila mtu atafahamu ya kuwa mambo waliyosikia si ya kweli na kwamba wewe unaishika sheria.

english: As for the Gentile believers, we have written to them our decision that they must abstain from food sacrificed to idols, from blood, from the meat of strangled animals, and from sexual immorality.”
ekegusii: Korende ase abanto b’Ebisaku abegenete, twatomire riruube buna twanacha, ng’a beatanane korwa ase ebinto biruure ebing’wanso ase emegwekano y’ogosasiimwa, na korwa ase amanyinga, na korwa ase enyama ende yonsi y’eng’iti eng’entire, na korwa ase obotomani.”
swahili: Lakini kuhusu wale watu wa Mataifa walioamini, tumewaandikia uamuzi wetu: kwamba wajitenge na vyakula vilivyotolewa sadaka kwa sanamu, na damu, au kula nyama ya mnyama aliyenyongwa, na wajiepushe na uasherati.”

english: So the next day Paul took the men and purified himself along with them. Then he entered the temple to give notice of the date when their purification would be complete and the offering would be made for each of them. Paul Seized at the Temple
ekegusii: Erio Paulo akaira abasacha baria, ne rituko ria kabere agakora buna engencho yare y’ogwesibia amo nabarabwo. Erio agasoa Hekalu ime, ase okoraria amang’ana ’ogwesibia na engaki y’okorua esadaka ase engencho ya kera oyomo obo. Eburu‐buru yabeete Yerusalemu, na okobwatwa gwa Paulo
swahili: Ndipo kesho yake Paulo akawachukua wale watu na akajitakasa pamoja nao. Akaingia ndani ya hekalu ili atoe taarifa ya tarehe ambayo siku zao za utakaso zingemalizika na sadaka ingetolewa kwa ajili ya kila mmoja wao. Paulo Akamatwa

english: When the seven days were almost over, some Jews from the province of Asia saw Paul at the temple. They stirred up the whole crowd and seized him,
ekegusii: Ekero amatuko aria atano na abere achia koba ang’e goikeranigwa Abayahudi abarwete Asia bakamorora ase Hekalu ime, bagaseegeta abanto bonsi, bakamobwata,
swahili: Zile siku saba zilipokaribia kumalizika, baadhi ya Wayahudi kutoka sehemu za Asia waliokuwa wamemwona Paulo ndani ya Hekalu, wakachochea umati wote wa watu, nao wakamkamata.

english: crying out, “Men of Israel, help us! This is the man who teaches everywhere against our people and against our law and against this place. Furthermore, he has brought Greeks into the temple and defiled this holy place.”
ekegusii: bagaaka eriogi, bagateeba: “Inwe abasacha ba Israeli, tokonye! Omonto oyo nere oria okworokereria abanto ase kera ensemo mamincha y’egesaku giaito, na amachiiko, na aase aiga. Kobua ase aya orentire Abagiriki ase Hekalu ime ogindirie Aase aiga Aachenu riko.”
swahili: Wakapiga kelele wakisema, “Waisraeli wenzetu, tusaidieni! Huyu ndiye yule mtu anayefundisha kila mtu na kila mahali, kinyume na watu wetu, sheria zetu na hata Hekalu hili. Zaidi ya hayo amewaleta Wayunani ndani ya Hekalu na kupanajisi mahali hapa patakatifu.”

english: For they had previously seen Trophimus the Ephesian with him in the city, and they assumed that Paul had brought him into the temple.
ekegusii: Ekiagera baroche Torofimo Omoefeso amo nere ase omochie, bagakaga ng’a Paulo namosoirie ase Hekalu ime.
swahili: (Walikuwa wamemwona Trofimo, mwenyeji wa Efeso, akiwa mjini pamoja na Paulo wakadhani kuwa Paulo alikuwa amemwingiza Hekaluni.)

english: After sighting Cyprus and passing south of it, we sailed on to Syria and landed at Tyre, where the ship was to unload its cargo.
ekegusii: Ekero twachia korora egesinka gekorokwa Kuporo, tokagetiga ensemo y’okobee; tokagenda goika Siiria, togaika Turo; na agwo chigurube chikarusigwa ase emeeri.
swahili: Tulipokiona kisiwa cha Kipro, tukakizunguka tukakiacha upande wetu wa kushoto, tukasafiri mpaka Shamu, tukatia nanga katika bandari ya Tiro ambapo meli yetu ilikuwa ipakue shehena yake.

english: The whole city was stirred up, and the people rushed together. They seized Paul and dragged him out of the temple, and at once the gates were shut.
ekegusii: Omochie bwonsi ogatitira, na abanto bakaminyoka gocha amo, bakabwata Paulo, bakamokurura, bakamosokia korwa ase Hekalu. Erio ebisieri bigasiekwa.
swahili: Mji wote ukataharuki, watu wakaja wakikimbia kutoka pande zote wakamkamata Paulo, wakamburuta kutoka Hekaluni. Milango ya Hekalu ikafungwa.

english: While they were trying to kill him, the commander of the Roman regiment received a report that all Jerusalem was in turmoil.
ekegusii: Ekero bateemire komoita, amang’ana agaikera omotang’ani bw’abarwani elifu ng’a omochie omogima o Yerusalemu osarekire.
swahili: Walipokuwa wakitaka kumuua, habari zikamfikia jemadari wa jeshi la askari wa Kirumi kwamba mji wa Yerusalemu wote ulikuwa katika machafuko.

english: Immediately he took some soldiers and centurions and ran down to the crowd. When the people saw the commander and the soldiers, they stopped beating Paul.
ekegusii: Erio bwango akaira abarwani na abatang’ani b’abarwani rigana, akaminyoka gochia ase bare. Na barabwo bagachia korora omotang’ani oria omonene na abarwani, bagatiga goaka Paulo.
swahili: Mara yule jemadari akachukua maafisa wengine wa jeshi pamoja na askari wakakimbilia kwenye ile ghasia, wale watu waliokuwa wakifanya ghasia walipomwona yule jemadari na askari wakija, wakaacha kumpiga Paulo.

english: The commander came up and arrested Paul, ordering that he be bound with two chains. Then he asked who he was and what he had done.
ekegusii: Erio omotang’ani oria omonene agaika aroro, akamobwata, agachiika asibwe nebinyuri bibere. Akababoria: “Nere ng’o oyo, naende inki akora?”
swahili: Yule jemadari akaja, akamkamata Paulo akaamuru afungwe kwa minyororo miwili. Akauliza yeye ni nani, na alikuwa amefanya nini.

english: Some in the crowd were shouting one thing, and some another. And since the commander could not get at the truth because of the uproar, he ordered that Paul be brought into the barracks.
ekegusii: Abande ase omosangererekano bagaaka eriogi bagoteeba iga, na abande iga. Ekero atanyarete komanya oboronge bw’amang’ana aria ase engencho y’egeturi keria, agachiika arentwe ime ase enyomba y’abarwani.
swahili: Baadhi ya watu katika ule umati wakapiga kelele, hawa wakisema hili na wengine lile. Yule jemadari alipoona kuwa hawezi kupata hakika ya habari kwa sababu ya zile kelele, akaamuru Paulo apelekwe katika ngome ya jeshi.

english: When Paul reached the steps, he had to be carried by the soldiers because of the violence of the mob.
ekegusii: Nabo agachia goika ase ebiriinero akabogorigwa nabarwani ase engencho y’obotindi bw’omoganda,
swahili: Paulo alipofika penye ngazi, ilibidi askari wambebe juu juu kwa sababu fujo za ule umati wa watu zilikuwa kubwa.

english: For the crowd that followed him kept shouting, “Away with him!” Paul Addresses the Crowd
ekegusii: ekiagera omoganda bw’abaanto omotunyanete, ogoaka egeturi, ogateba: “Morusieo oyo!”
swahili: Umati wa watu ulikuwa ukifuata ukiendelea kupiga kelele ukisema, “Mwondoe huyu!” Paulo Anajitetea

english: As they were about to take Paul into the barracks, he asked the commander, “May I say something to you?” “Do you speak Greek?” he replied.
ekegusii: Na Paulo, ekero aikigwe ang’e gosoigwa ime ase enyomba y’abarwani, akaboria omotang’ani oria omonene: “Ninyore ribaga ngoteebie ring’ana?” Omotang’ani oria akabora: “Inee! Nomanyete Ekegiriki?
swahili: Mara tu Paulo alipokaribia kuingizwa kwenye ngome ya jeshi, akamwambia yule jemadari, “Je, naweza kukuambia jambo moja?” Yule jemadari akamjibu, “Je, unajua Kiyunani?

english: “Aren’t you the Egyptian who incited a rebellion some time ago and led four thousand members of the ‘Assassins’ into the wilderness?”
ekegusii: Aye tori Omomisiri oria, ere reero iga oseegeta abanto baria Abaiti chilifu inye, akabatang’ana gochia ase erooro?”
swahili: Je, wewe si yule Mmisri ambaye siku hizi za karibuni alianzisha uasi akaongoza kundi la magaidi 4,000 wenye silaha jangwani?”

english: But Paul answered, “I am a Jew from Tarsus in Cilicia, a citizen of no ordinary city. Now I beg you to allow me to speak to the people.”
ekegusii: Paulo akamoiraneria: “Inche n’Omoyahudi, omonto o Tariso, omochie o Kilikia, omobiare bw’omochie otari moke; nagosabire ong’e ribaga nkwane n’abanto aba.”
swahili: Paulo akajibu, “Mimi ni Myahudi, mzaliwa wa Tarso, huko Kilikia, raiya wa mji maarufu. Tafadhali niruhusu nizungumze na hawa watu.”

english: We sought out the disciples in Tyre and stayed with them seven days. Through the Spirit they kept telling Paul not to go up to Jerusalem.
ekegusii: Gatwanyorire aborokigwa, tokabeera aroro amatuko atano na abere. Na barabwo bagateebia Paulo ase okobua kw’Omoika Omochenu tatiira gochia Yerusalemu.
swahili: Baada ya kuwatafuta wanafunzi wa huko, tukakaa nao kwa siku saba. Wale wanafunzi wakiongozwa na Roho wakamwambia Paulo asiende Yerusalemu.

english: Having received permission, Paul stood on the steps and motioned to the crowd. A great hush came over the crowd, and he addressed them in Hebrew:
ekegusii: Erio ekero amoete ribaga, Paulo agatenena ase ebiriinero igoro, akabakiria nokoboko abanto baria. Kabakiririe kegima, agakwana nabarabwo ase omonwa bw’Ekeiberania, agateeba.
swahili: Akiisha kupata ruhusa ya yule jemadari, Paulo akasimama penye ngazi akawapungia watu mkono ili wanyamaze. Wote waliponyamaza kimya, Paulo akazungumza nao kwa lugha ya Kiebrania, akasema:

english: But when our time there had ended, we set out on our journey. All the disciples, with their wives and children, accompanied us out of the city and knelt down on the beach to pray with us.
ekegusii: Ekero amatuko aito achia koera, tokaimoka, tokagenda ase orogendo rwaito; na abwo bonsi, na abakungu babo, na abana, bagatokooba goika isiko y’omochie; togatung’ama ase engegu y’enyancha, togasaba.
swahili: Lakini muda wetu ulipokwisha, tukaondoka tukaendelea na safari yetu. Wale wanafunzi pamoja na wake zao na watoto wakatusindikiza hadi nje ya mji. Wote tukapiga magoti pale pwani tukaomba.

english: And after we had said our farewells, we went aboard the ship, and they returned home.
ekegusii: Gatwatebanirie ng’a motigare buya, intwe tokariina emeeri, na barabwo bakairana gochia sobo. Goika Kaisaria
swahili: Baada ya kuagana, tukapanda melini, nao wakarudi majumbani mwao.

english: When we had finished our voyage from Tyre, we landed at Ptolemais, where we greeted the brothers and stayed with them for a day. Paul Visits Philip the Evangelist
ekegusii: Gotwachia gokoora orogendo rwaito korwa Turo, togaika Tolemai, togakwania abaminto, togaikaransa nabarabwo rituko erimo.
swahili: Tukaendelea na safari yetu toka Tiro tukafika Tolemai, tukawasalimu ndugu wa huko, tukakaa nao kwa siku moja.

english: Leaving the next day, we went on to Caesarea and stayed at the home of Philip the evangelist, who was one of the Seven.
ekegusii: Mambia yaye tokaimoka tokagenda Kaisaria, togasoa enyomba ya Filipo, omorandia bw’enchiri. Nere orenge oyomo bwa baria batano na babere; tokamenya bwoye.
swahili: Siku iliyofuata tukaondoka, tukafika Kaisaria. Huko tukaenda nyumbani kwa mwinjilisti mmoja jina lake Filipo, aliyekuwa mmoja wa wale Saba, tukakaa kwake.

english: He had four unmarried daughters who prophesied.
ekegusii: Omonto oyo narenge nabaiseke bane abekungi, baare kobana.
swahili: Filipo alikuwa na binti wanne mabikira waliokuwa wanatoa unabii.

english: “Brothers and fathers, listen now to my defense before you.”
ekegusii: “Inwe abaminto, na abatata, ntegerera aya ngwekengera omonyene ase more bono.”
swahili: “Ndugu zangu na baba zangu, sikilizeni utetezi wangu.”

english: Then I asked, ‘What should I do, Lord?’ ‘Get up and go into Damascus,’ He told me. ‘There you will be told all that you have been appointed to do.’
ekegusii: Nkaboria: Ninki ndakore Omonene? Omonene aganteebia: Imoka ogende goika Damesiki, agwo noteebigwe onsi aya gwachiikirwe oyakore.
swahili: “Nikauliza, ‘Nifanye nini Bwana?’ “Naye Bwana akaniambia, ‘Inuka uingie Dameski, huko utaambiwa yote yakupasayo kufanya.’

english: Because the brilliance of the light had blinded me, my companions led me by the hand into Damascus.
ekegusii: Na ekero nasinyetwe korora ase engencho y’oborabu bw’amasase aria, nkaraagwa namaboko abo abarenge amo nainche, ngaika Damesiki.
swahili: Kwa kuwa nilikuwa siwezi kuona kwa ajili ya mngʼao wa ile nuru, wenzangu wakanishika mkono wakaniongoza kuingia Dameski.

english: There a man named Ananias, a devout observer of the law who was highly regarded by all the Jews living there,
ekegusii: “Erio omonto oyomo ore korokwa Anania, omoiroki Nyasae ase ogotunyana amachiiko, ore gokwanwa buya n’Abayahudi bonsi abamenyete agwo,
swahili: “Mtu mmoja mcha Mungu, jina lake Anania, alikuja kuniona. Alizishika sana sheria zetu, na aliheshimiwa sana na Wayahudi waliokuwa wakiishi huko Dameski.

english: came and stood beside me. ‘Brother Saul,’ he said, ‘receive your sight.’ And at that moment I could see him.
ekegusii: aganchichera agatenena ang’e nainche, aganteebia: Oyominto Saulo, nyora okorora. Ase ensa eria eria nkanyora okorora, nkamorora.
swahili: Akasimama karibu nami, akasema, ‘Ndugu Sauli, pata kuona tena!’ Saa ile ile nikapata kuona tena, nami nikaweza kumwona.

english: Then he said, ‘The God of our fathers has appointed you to know His will, and to see the Righteous One, and to hear His voice.
ekegusii: Aganteebia: Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiaito ogochorire onyare komanya ogwancha kwaye, na korora Omonyene Oboronge, na koigwa eriogi rikorwa ase omonwa oye.
swahili: “Akasema, ‘Mungu wa baba zetu amekuchagua wewe ili ujue mapenzi yake, umwone yeye Aliye Mwenye Haki na upate kusikia maneno kutoka kinywani mwake.

english: You will be His witness to everyone of what you have seen and heard.
ekegusii: Naki nomobeere kirori ase abanto bonsi igoro y’amang’ana aya kwarorire na koyaigwa.
swahili: Kwa kuwa utakuwa shahidi wake kwa watu kuhusu kile ulichokiona na kukisikia.

english: And now what are you waiting for? Get up, be baptized, and wash your sins away, calling on His name.’
ekegusii: Gaki bono, inki ogotebanera? Tenena obatiswe, bwesibie ebibe biao, orangerie erieta riaye.
swahili: Sasa basi, mbona unakawia? Inuka, ukabatizwe na dhambi zako zikasafishwe, ukiliita Jina lake.’ Paulo Atumwa Kwa Watu Wa Mataifa

english: Later, when I had returned to Jerusalem and was praying at the temple, I fell into a trance
ekegusii: “Ekero nairanete Yerusalemu, ngosaba narenge ase Hekalu ime, nkabwatwa nobogondereria,
swahili: “Baada ya kurudi Yerusalemu, nilipokuwa ninaomba Hekaluni, nilipitiwa na usingizi wa ghafula

english: and saw the Lord saying to me, ‘Hurry! Leave Jerusalem quickly, because the people here will not accept your testimony about Me.’
ekegusii: nkarora Omonene aroro, ogonteebia: Ayerera, karue Yerusalemu bwango, ekiagera tibagwancha oborori bwao igoro yane.
swahili: nikamwona Bwana akiniambia, ‘Harakisha utoke Yerusalemu upesi, maana hawataukubali ushuhuda wako kunihusu mimi.’

english: ‘Lord,’ I answered, ‘they know very well that in one synagogue after another I imprisoned and beat those who believed in You.
ekegusii: Na inche nkaboora: Omonene, barabwo mbamanyete ng’a nigo narenge gosiba baria bakwegenete na kobaaka ase chisinagogi chionsi.
swahili: “Nami nikasema, ‘Bwana, wao wenyewe wanajua jinsi nilivyokwenda kwenye kila sinagogi ili kuwatupa gerezani na kuwapiga wale waliokuamini.

english: When they heard him speak to them in Hebrew, they became even more silent. Then Paul declared,
ekegusii: Na ekero bachia koigwa ng’a nigo agokwana nabarabwo ase omonwa bw’Ekeiberania, bakamenta gokira. Agakwana.
swahili: Waliposikia akisema kwa lugha ya Kiebrania, wakanyamaza kimya kabisa. Ndipo Paulo akasema,

english: And when the blood of Your witness Stephen was shed, I stood there giving my approval and watching over the garments of those who killed him.’
ekegusii: Ekero amanyinga a Stefano, kirori oo, agoiterwa, inche nao narenge nateneine ang’e, ngancha aitwe, nkarenda chianga chiabo baria abamoitete.
swahili: Wakati damu ya shahidi wako Stefano ilipomwagwa, mimi mwenyewe nilikuwa nimesimama kando, nikikubaliana na kitendo hicho na kutunza mavazi ya wale waliomuua.’

english: Then He said to me, ‘Go! I will send you far away to the Gentiles.’” Paul the Roman Citizen
ekegusii: Nere aganteebia: Genda, ekiagera inche ningotome aare ase abanto b’Ebisaku.” Paulo ogoteeba ng’a n’Omorumi are
swahili: “Ndipo Bwana akaniambia, ‘Nenda, kwa maana nitakutuma mbali, kwa watu wa Mataifa.’ ” Paulo Na Jemadari Wa Kirumi

english: The crowd listened to Paul until he made this statement. Then they lifted up their voices and shouted, “Rid the earth of him! He is not fit to live!”
ekegusii: Bagategerera Paulo goika ring’ana riria rigakwanwa. Erio bagaaka eriogi riabo, bagateeba: “Morusieo oyo ase ense, ekiagera tagwenereti abe moyo.”
swahili: Ule umati wa watu wakamsikiliza Paulo mpaka aliposema neno hilo, ndipo wakapaza sauti zao na kupiga kelele wakisema, “Mwondoeni duniani, hafai kuishi!”

english: As they were shouting and throwing off their cloaks and tossing dust into the air,
ekegusii: Bagachia kona‐goaka egeturi na gotandora chianga chiabo na gosiara‐siara ebuse gochia igoro.
swahili: Walipokuwa wakipiga kelele na kutoa mavazi yao huku wakirusha mavumbi juu hewani,

english: the commander ordered that Paul be brought into the barracks. He directed that Paul be flogged and interrogated to determine the reason for this outcry against him.
ekegusii: Omotang’ani bw’abarwani elifu agachiika arentwe ime ase enyomba enene y’abarwani, agachiika aborigwe amang’ana aye ase okong’wanigwa emecharichi, erinde amanye engencho bakomwogerera eriogi buna eri.
swahili: yule jemadari akaamuru Paulo aingizwe kwenye ngome. Akaelekeza kwamba achapwe viboko na aulizwe ili kujua kwa nini watu walikuwa wanampigia kelele namna hiyo.

english: But as they stretched him out to strap him down, Paul said to the centurion standing there, “Is it lawful for you to flog a Roman citizen without a trial?”
ekegusii: Korende ekero bamosibire engori, Paulo akaboria omotang’ani bw’abarwani rigana, oyo oteneine ang’e nere: “Inee! Mboronge kong’wania omonto Omorumi emecharichi, na ere ataranacherwa ekiina?”
swahili: Lakini walipokwisha kumfunga kwa kamba za ngozi ili wamchape viboko, Paulo akamwambia kiongozi wa askari aliyekuwa amesimama pale karibu naye, “Je, ni halali kwenu kwa mujibu wa sheria kumchapa mtu ambaye ni raiya wa Rumi hata kabla hajapatikana na hatia?”

english: On hearing this, the centurion went and reported it to the commander. “What are you going to do?” he said. “This man is a Roman citizen.”
ekegusii: Omotang’ani oria ochia koigwa aya, akagenda akoorokia omotang’ani oria omonene, akabora: “Naki origetie gokora? Ekiagera omonto oyo n’Omorumi are.”
swahili: Yule kiongozi aliposikia maneno haya, alimwendea yule jemadari na kumwambia, “Unataka kufanya nini? Kwa maana huyu mtu ni raiya wa Rumi.”

english: The commander went to Paul and asked, “Tell me, are you a Roman citizen?” “Yes,” he answered.
ekegusii: Omotang’ani oria omonene agacha, akamoteebia: “Nteebia, n’Omorumi ore?” Agateeba: “Ee.”
swahili: Yule jemadari akaja akamuuliza Paulo, “Niambie, wewe ni raiya wa Rumi?” Paulo akajibu, “Naam, hakika ndiyo.”

english: “I paid a high price for my citizenship,” said the commander. “But I was born a citizen,” Paul replied.
ekegusii: Omotang’ani oria, omonene akairaneria: “Inche nigo nagorete obobiare obo ase chitaabu chinyinge.” Paulo agateeba: “Inche n’Omorumi omobiare.”
swahili: Ndipo yule jemadari akasema, “Mimi ilinigharimu kiasi kikubwa cha fedha kupata uraia wangu.” Paulo akasema “Lakini mimi ni raiya wa Rumi kwa kuzaliwa.”

english: Then those who were about to interrogate Paul stepped back, and the commander himself was alarmed when he realized that he had put a Roman citizen in chains.
ekegusii: Erio baria barenge ang’e komoboria bakaimoka, bakamotiga bwango, na oria omotang’ani omonene akoboa ekero aigwa ng’a n’Omorumi are, na konya omosibire. Ogwekengera gwa Paulo bosio bw’ekegambero
swahili: Mara wale waliokuwa wanataka kumhoji wakajiondoa haraka, naye yule jemadari akaingiwa na hofu alipotambua ya kuwa amemfunga Paulo, ambaye ni raia wa Rumi, kwa minyororo. Paulo Apelekwa Mbele Ya Baraza

english: “I am a Jew, born in Tarsus of Cilicia, but raised in this city. I was educated at the feet of Gamaliel in strict conformity to the law of our fathers. I am just as zealous for God as any of you here today.
ekegusii: “Inche n’Omoyahudi, naiboreretwe Tariso, omochie o Kilikia, nkarererwa ase omochie oyo ase amagoro a Gamalieli, nkorokererigwa bokong’u amachiiko ye chisokoro chiaito. Nkaba omonto oyore nomokia ase Nyasae, buna inwe mwensi more reero iga.
swahili: “Mimi ni Myahudi, niliyezaliwa Tarso huko Kilikia, lakini nimelelewa katika mji huu. Miguuni mwa Gamalieli, nilifundishwa kikamilifu katika sheria ya baba zetu, na nikawa mwenye juhudi kwa ajili ya Mungu kama kila mmoja wenu alivyo leo.

english: The next day the commander, wanting to learn the real reason Paul was accused by the Jews, released him and ordered the chief priests and the whole Sanhedrin to assemble. Then he brought Paul down and had him stand before them.
ekegusii: Rituko rikobwatia akarengereria komanya boronge nase engencho ki asoeirwe n’Abayahudi, akamosibora, agachiika abakuani abanene na abanto b’ekegambero bonsi bache. Agatirimbokia Paulo, akamobeka ase amasio abo.
swahili: Kesho yake, kwa kuwa yule jemadari alitaka kujua hakika kwa nini Paulo alikuwa anashutumiwa na Wayahudi, alimfungua, na akawaagiza viongozi wa makuhani na baraza lote likutane. Kisha akamleta Paulo, akamsimamisha mbele yao.

english: I persecuted this Way even to the death, detaining both men and women and throwing them into prison,
ekegusii: Ngachanda abanto b’Enchera eye goika nkabaita bagakwa, ngasiba abasacha na abakungu na kobabeeka echela ime,
swahili: Niliwatesa watu wa Njia hii hadi kufa, nikiwakamata waume kwa wake na kuwatupa gerezani,

english: as the high priest and the whole Council can testify about me. I even obtained letters from them to their brothers in Damascus, and I was on my way to apprehend these people and bring them to Jerusalem to be punished.
ekegusii: buna Omokuani omonene na abagaaka bonsi b’ekegambero bare kirori ase ’nde. Naetwe amarube nabarabwo ing’ire ase abaminto abarenge Damesiki, erio mbarente abarenge agwo, mbaire Yerusalemu basibire erinde baegwe egesusuro.
swahili: kama kuhani mkuu na baraza zima la wazee wanavyoweza kushuhudia kunihusu. Hata nilipokea barua kutoka kwao kwenda kwa ndugu wale wa Dameski, nami nikaenda huko ili kuwaleta watu hawa Yerusalemu kama wafungwa ili waadhibiwe. Paulo Aeleza Juu Ya Kuokoka Kwake (Matendo 9:1-19; 26:12-18)

english: About noon as I was approaching Damascus, suddenly a bright light from heaven flashed around me.
ekegusii: “Erio ekero nare kogenda, konaikire ang’e na Damesiki, ekero kia mobaso gati mobosokano amasase akarwa igoro akambarera chinsemo chionsi.
swahili: “Nilipokuwa njiani kuelekea Dameski, yapata saa sita mchana, ghafula nuru kubwa kutoka mbinguni ikanimulika kotekote.

english: I fell to the ground and heard a voice say to me, ‘Saul, Saul, why do you persecute Me?’
ekegusii: Nkagwa inse, nkaigwa eriogi rigonteebia: Saulo, Saulo, nase ki gwanchandire?
swahili: Nikaanguka chini, nikasikia sauti ikiniambia, ‘Sauli, Sauli! Mbona unanitesa?’

english: ‘Who are You, Lord?’ I asked. ‘I am Jesus of Nazareth, whom you are persecuting,’ He replied.
ekegusii: Nkairaneria: Naye ng’Omonene? Aganteebia: Ninche Yeso o Nazareti oyogwachandire aye.
swahili: “Nikajibu, ‘Wewe ni nani Bwana?’ “Naye akaniambia, ‘Mimi ni Yesu wa Nazareti unayemtesa.’

english: My companions saw the light, but they could not understand the voice of the One speaking to me.
ekegusii: Na baria barenge amo nainche mbaroche amasase aria, korende tibaigwete eriogi ri’oria ore gokwana nainche.
swahili: Basi wale watu waliokuwa pamoja nami waliiona ile nuru, lakini hawakuisikia sauti ya yule aliyekuwa akisema nami.

english: Paul looked directly at the Sanhedrin and said, “Brothers, I have conducted myself before God in all good conscience to this day.”
ekegusii: Paulo akarigereria mono abanto b’ekegambero, akabora: “Baminto, nabeireo ase obosio bwa Nyasae goika reero iga, na enkoro yane tekongambia.”
swahili: Paulo akawakazia macho wale wajumbe wa baraza, akasema, “Ndugu zangu, nimetimiza wajibu wangu kwa Mungu kwa dhamiri safi kabisa hadi leo.”

english: The dispute grew so violent that the commander was afraid they would tear Paul to pieces. He ordered the soldiers to go down and remove him by force and bring him into the barracks.
ekegusii: Ekero eriomana rinene riachia kooroka, omotang’ani oria omonene akoboa ng’a Paulo nabaise kobutoranwa nabarabwo, agachiika abarwani baike na komotaboria korwa ase amaboko abo, na komorenta ase enyomba enene y’abarwani.
swahili: Ugomvi ukawa mkubwa kiasi kwamba yule jemadari akahofu kuwa wangemrarua Paulo vipande vipande, akaamuru vikosi vya askari vishuke na kumwondoa Paulo katikati yao kwa nguvu na kumleta ndani ya ngome ya jeshi.

english: The following night the Lord stood near Paul and said, “Take courage! As you have testified about Me in Jerusalem, so also you must testify in Rome.” The Plot to Kill Paul (John 16:1–4)
ekegusii: Obotuko bori’Omonene agatenena ang’e nere, akamoteebia: “Remia enkoro, ekiagera buna kwamberete kirori Yerusalemu, nekogwenerete kombera boigo Rumi.” Okobwatana kw’Abayahudi komoboera Paulo
swahili: Usiku uliofuata, Bwana akasimama karibu naye akamwambia, “Jipe moyo! Kama vile ulivyonishuhudia hapa Yerusalemu, hivyo imekupasa kunishuhudia huko Rumi pia.” Hila Za Kumuua Paulo

english: When daylight came, the Jews formed a conspiracy and bound themselves with an oath not to eat or drink until they had killed Paul.
ekegusii: Bogachia gokiamoka, Abayahudi bakabwatana komoboera Paulo, bagatianania ng’a tibakoria gose tibakonywa goika bamoitire.
swahili: Kulipopambazuka Wayahudi wakafanya shauri pamoja na kujifunga kwa kiapo kwamba hawatakula wala kunywa mpaka wawe wamemuua Paulo.

english: More than forty of them were involved in this plot.
ekegusii: Abwo batiananetie nigo barenge abanto kobua emerongo ene.
swahili: Waliofanya mpango huo walikuwa zaidi ya watu arobaini.

english: They went to the chief priests and elders and said, “We have bound ourselves with a solemn oath not to eat anything until we have killed Paul.
ekegusii: Barabwo bakagenda ase abakuani abanene na abagaaka, bakaboora: “Ntwatiananetie bokong’u ng’a titoria gento goika twaitire Paulo.
swahili: Wakawaendea viongozi wa makuhani na wazee na kusema, “Tumejifunga pamoja kwa kiapo kwamba hatutakula wala kunywa mpaka tuwe tumemuua Paulo.

english: Now then, you and the Sanhedrin petition the commander to bring him down to you on the pretext of examining his case more carefully. We are ready to kill him on the way.”
ekegusii: Gaki bono inwe amo nab’ekegambero moteebie omotang’ani oria omonene amotirimbokie gocha ase more, buna inwe morigetie komanya chingencho chiaye buya kobua; na intwe nigo tore ang’e komoita ritang’ani ataraika ase more.”
swahili: Hivyo basi, wewe pamoja na baraza, inawapasa mkamjulishe jemadari ili amteremshe Paulo kwenu, mjifanye kama mnataka kufanya uchunguzi wa kina zaidi wa shauri lake. Nasi tuko tayari kumuua kabla hajafika hapa.”

english: But when the son of Paul’s sister heard about the plot, he went into the barracks and told Paul.
ekegusii: Omoigwa o Paulo akaigwa amang’ana igoro y’okoboera kwabo, akagenda, agasoa ime ase enyomba enene, akamanyia Paulo amang’ana ayio.
swahili: Lakini mtoto wa dada yake Paulo aliposikia juu ya shauri hilo baya, alikwenda kule kwenye ngome ya askari na kumweleza Paulo.

english: Then Paul called one of the centurions and said, “Take this young man to the commander; he has something to tell him.”
ekegusii: Paulo akarangeria oyomo bw’abatang’ani b’abarwani rigana, akamoteebia: “Ira omomura oyo ase omotang’ani omonene, ekiagera nabwate ring’ana akomoteebia.”
swahili: Ndipo Paulo akamwita mmoja wa viongozi wa askari, akamwambia, “Mpeleke huyu kijana kwa jemadari, analo jambo la kumweleza.”

english: So the centurion took him to the commander and said, “Paul the prisoner sent and asked me to bring this young man to you. He has something to tell you.”
ekegusii: Erio akamoimokia, akamoira ase omotang’ani oria omonene, akamoteebia: “Paulo, oria omosibwa nandangeria, omboria nkorentere omomura oyo, ekiagera nare ne ring’ana akogoteebia.”
swahili: Hivyo yule kiongozi wa askari akampeleka yule kijana kwa jemadari, akamwambia, “Paulo yule mfungwa aliniita na kuniomba nimlete huyu kijana kwako, kwa sababu ana neno la kukueleza.”

english: The commander took the young man by the hand, drew him aside, and asked, “What do you need to tell me?”
ekegusii: Omotang’ani oria omonene akamobwata okoboko, akagenda nere ensemo, akamobooria bobisi: “Ing’ana ki obwate origetie gonteebia?”
swahili: Yule jemadari akamshika yule kijana mkono, akampeleka kando na kumuuliza, “Unataka kuniambia nini?”

english: At this, the high priest Ananias ordered those standing near Paul to strike him on the mouth.
ekegusii: Anania, Omokuani omonene, agachiika baria bateneine ang’e nere bamoake omonwa oye.
swahili: Kwa ajili ya jambo hili kuhani mkuu Anania akaamuru wale waliokuwa karibu na Paulo wampige kofi kinywani.

english: He answered, “The Jews have agreed to ask you to bring Paul to the Sanhedrin tomorrow on the pretext of acquiring more information about him.
ekegusii: Akabora: “Abayahudi babwatanire kogosaba otirimbokie Paulo gochia bosio bw’ekegambero ankio, buna igo barigetie komanya chingencho chiaye buya kobua.
swahili: Yule kijana akasema, “Wayahudi wamekubaliana wakuombe umpeleke Paulo kwenye baraza lao kesho kwa kisingizio kwamba wanataka kufanya uchunguzi wa kina wa shauri lake.

english: Do not let them persuade you, because more than forty men are waiting to ambush him. They have bound themselves with an oath not to eat or drink until they have killed him; they are ready now, awaiting your consent.”
ekegusii: Gaki aye tibwancha, ekiagera abanto kobua emerongo ene bamoboeire, batiananirie ng’a tibakoria gose tibakonywa goika bamoitire; na barabwo nigo bare ang’e baganyete eira korwa ase ore.”
swahili: Lakini usishawishiwe nao kwa maana zaidi ya watu arobaini wanamvizia. Wamejifunga kwa kiapo kwamba hawatakula wala kunywa mpaka wawe wamemuua Paulo. Sasa wako tayari, wanangoja idhini yako kwa ajili ya ombi lao.”

english: So the commander dismissed the young man and instructed him, “Do not tell anyone that you have reported this to me.” Paul Sent to Felix
ekegusii: Erio omotang’ani oria omonene agatiga omomura oria agende, akamoteebia: “Toteebia monto onde ng’a kwamanyirie aya.” Paulo okoirwa goika Kaisaria
swahili: Yule jemadari akamruhusu yule kijana aende na akamwonya, akisema, “Usimwambie mtu yeyote kwamba umenieleza habari hizi.” Paulo Ahamishiwa Kaisaria

english: Then he called two of his centurions and said, “Prepare two hundred soldiers, seventy horsemen, and two hundred spearmen to go to Caesarea in the third hour of the night.
ekegusii: Magega y’ayio akarangeria babere b’abatang’ani b’abarwani rigana, akabateebia: “Beka ang’e abarwani amagana abere, na abarwani abariini chibarasi emerongo etano na ebere, na abare namatimo amagana abere ase okogenda Kaisaria chinsa isato chia botuko.
swahili: Kisha yule jemadari akawaita viongozi wake wawili wa askari akawaambia, “Jiandaeni kuondoka saa tatu usiku huu kuelekea Kaisaria pamoja na askari 200, wapanda farasi sabini na watu 200 wenye mikuki.

english: Provide mounts for Paul to take him safely to Governor Felix.”
ekegusii: Naende beka ang’e chibarasi bariinie Paulo, momoire buya ase Feliki, gabana.”
swahili: Pia tayarisheni na farasi watakaotumiwa na Paulo, mkampeleke salama kwa mtawala Feliksi.”

english: And he wrote the following letter:
ekegusii: Akarika riruube iga:
swahili: Kisha akaandika barua kwa Feliksi kama ifuatavyo:

english: Claudius Lysias, To His Excellency, Governor Felix: Greetings.
ekegusii: “Ase omosike gabana Feliki. Inche Klaudio Lisia, nagokwanirie.
swahili: Klaudio Lisia, Kwa Mtawala, Mtukufu Feliksi: Salamu.

english: This man was seized by the Jews, and they were about to kill him when I came with my troops to rescue him. For I had learned that he is a Roman citizen,
ekegusii: Omonto oyo nigo abwatwa n’Abayahudi, na barabwo bakaba ang’e komoita. Erio ngacha nomoganda bw’abarwani, nkamotooria, konya nanyorire amang’ana ng’a n’Omorumi are.
swahili: Mtu huyu alikamatwa na Wayahudi wakakaribia kumuua, lakini nikaja na vikosi vyangu vya askari nikamwokoa, kwa kuwa nilipata habari kwamba yeye ni raiya wa Rumi.

english: and since I wanted to understand their charges against him, I brought him down to their Sanhedrin.
ekegusii: Naende nkarigia komanya engencho yaye bakomosoera, nkamotirimbokia na komobeka bosio bw’ekegambero kiabo.
swahili: Nilitaka kujua kwa nini walikuwa wanamshutumu, hivyo nikamleta mbele ya baraza lao.

english: I found that the accusation involved questions about their own law, but there was no charge worthy of death or imprisonment.
ekegusii: Nkanyora ng’a nigo asoeirwe ase engencho y’amaborio ’amachiiko abo, korende tasoeiri ase ring’ana rigwenerete agoitwa nonya ngosibwa.
swahili: Ndipo nikaona kuwa alikuwa anashutumiwa kwa mambo yanayohusu sheria yao, lakini hakuwa ameshtakiwa kwa jambo lolote linalostahili kifo au kifungo.

english: Then Paul said to him, “God will strike you, you whitewashed wall! You sit here to judge me according to the law, yet you yourself violate the law by commanding that I be struck.”
ekegusii: Erio Paulo akamoteebia: “Nyasae nagoake aye, enyasi eakire echooka! Aye gwaikaransire konachera inche ekiina boronge koreng’ana buna ogochika, naende kogoteeba mamincha y’amachiiko ng’a ng’akwe?”
swahili: Ndipo Paulo akamwambia, “Mungu atakupiga wewe, ewe ukuta uliopakwa chokaa! Wewe umeketi hapo ili kunihukumu kwa mujibu wa sheria, lakini wewe mwenyewe unakiuka sheria kwa kuamuru kwamba nipigwe kinyume cha sheria!”

english: When I was informed that there was a plot against the man, I sent him to you at once. I also instructed his accusers to present their case against him before you.
ekegusii: Ekero nanyora amang’ana ng’a Abayahudi bamoboereire omonto oyo, ngachora komotoma ase ore erio kegima, ngachiika abamosoeri bache bakwane amang’ana igoro yaye ase obosio bwao.”
swahili: Nilipoarifiwa kuwa kulikuwa na shauri baya dhidi ya mtu huyu, nilimtuma kwako mara moja. Niliwaagiza washtaki wake pia waeleze mashtaka yao dhidi yake mbele yako.

english: So the soldiers followed their orders and brought Paul by night to Antipatris.
ekegusii: Erio abarwani baria bakaimokia Paulo buna bachiigetwe, bakamoira gochia Antipatiri ase obotuko boria.
swahili: Hivyo askari, kwa kufuata maelekezo waliyopewa, wakamchukua Paulo wakati wa usiku na kumleta mpaka Antipatri.

english: The next day they returned to the barracks and let the horsemen go on with him.
ekegusii: Ekero bwakia mambia bagatiga abarwani be chibarasi bagenderere norogendo na Paulo, na barabwo abanyene bakairana ase enyomba enene y’abarwani.
swahili: Kesho yake wakawaacha wale wapanda farasi waendelee na safari wakiwa na Paulo, wao wakarudi kwenye ngome ya askari.

english: When the horsemen arrived in Caesarea, they delivered the letter to the governor and presented Paul to him.
ekegusii: Abarwani baria be chibarasi bagachia goika Kaisaria, bakaa gabana riruube riria, bakabeeka na Paulo ase obosio bwaye.
swahili: Askari walipofika Kaisaria, walimpa mtawala ile barua, na kumkabidhi Paulo kwake.

english: The governor read the letter and asked what province Paul was from. Learning that he was from Cilicia,
ekegusii: Ekero arisomire, akaboria: “Omonto oyo noyo bw’ense ki?” Ekero aigwete ng’a nomonto o Kilikia, agateeba,
swahili: Mtawala alipokwisha kuisoma ile barua alimuuliza Paulo alikuwa mtu wa jimbo gani. Alipojua kuwa anatoka Kilikia,

english: he said, “I will hear your case when your accusers arrive.” Then he ordered that Paul be kept under guard in Herod’s Praetorium.
ekegusii: “Ninche nyigwe amang’ana ao ekero abagosoeri bao barache.” Agachiika arendwe ase enyomba y’ekegambero kia Herode.
swahili: alisema, “Nitasikiliza shauri lako washtaki wako watakapofika hapa.” Kisha akaamuru Paulo awekwe chini ya ulinzi kwenye jumba la kifalme la Herode.

english: But those standing nearby said, “How dare you insult the high priest of God!”
ekegusii: Baria bateneine ang’e nere bakaboora: “Inee! Naye okorama Omokuani omonene o Nyasae?”
swahili: Wale watu waliokuwa wamesimama karibu na Paulo wakamwambia, “Je, wewe wathubutu kumtukana kuhani mkuu wa Mungu?”

english: “Brothers,” Paul replied, “I was not aware that he was the high priest, for it is written: ‘Do not speak evil about the ruler of your people.’ ”
ekegusii: Paulo agateeba ng’a: “Tinamanyete baminto ng’a ere n’Omokuani omonene, naki nariikire: Tokwana bobe omogambi bw’abaanto bao.”
swahili: Paulo akajibu, “Ndugu zangu, sikujua kwamba yeye alikuwa kuhani mkuu. Kwa maana imeandikwa, ‘Usimnenee mabaya kiongozi wa watu wako.’ ”

english: Then Paul, knowing that some of them were Sadducees and others Pharisees, called out in the Sanhedrin, “Brothers, I am a Pharisee, the son of a Pharisee. It is because of my hope in the resurrection of the dead that I am on trial.”
ekegusii: Korende ekero Paulo achia komanya ng’a ensemo eyemo n’Abasadukai, na ensemo ya kabere n’Abafarisai, agaaka eriogi ase ekegambero keria, agateeba: “Abaminto, inche n’Omofarisai, omwana bw’Abafarisai; inche nigo nkogambigwa ase engencho y’ogosemeria na ase okobokigwa kw’abakuure.”
swahili: Paulo alipotambua ya kuwa baadhi yao walikuwa Masadukayo na wengine ni Mafarisayo, akapaza sauti kwenye baraza, “Ndugu zangu, mimi ni Farisayo, mwana Farisayo. Hapa nimeshtakiwa kuhusu tumaini langu katika ufufuo wa wafu.”

english: As soon as he had said this, a dispute broke out between the Pharisees and Sadducees, and the assembly was divided.
ekegusii: Erio gakwanire aya, ogwatananekana gokaba egati y’Abafarisai na Abasadukai, na omosangererekano ogaatananekana.
swahili: Aliposema haya, farakano likaanza kati ya Mafarisayo na Masadukayo na baraza lote likagawanyika.

english: For the Sadducees say that there is neither a resurrection, nor angels, nor spirits, but the Pharisees acknowledge them all.
ekegusii: Naki Abasadukai nigo bagokana ng’a kobokigwa tikori, nonya nabamalaika, nonya nemeika, korende Abafarisai nigo bagwancha onsi.
swahili: (Kwa maana Masadukayo wanasema kwamba hakuna ufufuo, wala hakuna malaika au roho, lakini Mafarisayo wanaamini haya yote.)

english: A great clamor arose, and some scribes from the party of the Pharisees got up and contended sharply, “We find nothing wrong with this man. What if a spirit or an angel has spoken to him?”
ekegusii: Bikaba ebituri ebinge; aborokia b’amariiko b’ensemo y’Abafarisai bagatenena, bakamobuna, bagoteeba: “Titorochi bobe bonde ase omonto oyo. Aande onye n’Omoika gose omomalaika okwanire nere?”
swahili: Kukawa na ghasia kubwa, nao baadhi ya walimu wa sheria ambao ni Mafarisayo, wakasimama wakapinga kwa nguvu wakisema, “Hatuoni kosa lolote la mtu huyu! Huenda ikawa roho au malaika amezungumza naye”

english: Five days later the high priest Ananias came down with some elders and a lawyer named Tertullus, who presented to the governor their case against Paul.
ekegusii: Magega y’amatuko atano, Anania, Omokuani omonene, agatirimboka amo nabande b’abagaaka na Omokuani oyomo, Teritulo; barabwo bagateebereria gabana amang’ana igoro ya Paulo.
swahili: Baada ya siku tano, kuhani mkuu Anania akashuka akiwa amefuatana na baadhi ya wazee pamoja na mwanasheria mmoja aitwaye Tertulo, nao wakaleta mashtaka yao dhidi ya Paulo mbele ya mtawala.

english: When the governor motioned for Paul to speak, he began his response: “Knowing that you have been a judge over this nation for many years, I gladly make my defense.
ekegusii: Erio gabana akarutera Paulo okoboko erinde akwane. Paulo akairaneria, “Amaene namanyire ng’a aye kwabeire omogambi ase egesaku eke ase ekero ki’emiaka emenge, igo ninyare gwekengera ase omoyo bw’omosasoko.
swahili: Mtawala Feliksi alipompungia Paulo mkono ili ajitetee, yeye akajibu, “Najua kwamba wewe umekuwa hakimu katika taifa hili kwa miaka mingi, hivyo natoa utetezi wangu kwa furaha.

english: You can verify for yourself that no more than twelve days ago I went up to Jerusalem to worship.
ekegusii: Naki buna oranyare komanya, amatuko taraeta kobua ikomi na abere korwa ekero natiirete kogenda Yerusalemu gosasiima.
swahili: Unaweza kuhakikisha kwa urahisi kuwa hazijapita zaidi ya siku kumi na mbili tangu nilipopanda kwenda Yerusalemu kuabudu.

english: Yet my accusers did not find me debating with anyone in the temple or riling up a crowd in the synagogues or in the city.
ekegusii: Abanto aba tibanyoreti nkoamererania na monto, gose koburukania omosangererekano ase Hekalu ime, nonya nase chisinagogi gose ase omochie ime.
swahili: Hawa wanaonishtaki hawakunikuta nikibishana na mtu yeyote Hekaluni au kuchochea umati wa watu katika sinagogi au mahali pengine popote mjini.

english: Nor can they prove to you any of their charges against me.
ekegusii: Gose tibakonyara koorokia amang’ana aya bansoera bono ng’a namaene are.
swahili: Wala hawawezi kabisa kukuthibitishia mashtaka haya wanayonishtaki kwayo.

english: I do confess to you, however, that I worship the God of our fathers according to the Way, which they call a sect. I believe everything that is laid down by the Law and written in the Prophets,
ekegusii: Korende ring’ana eri ndaorokie ase ore, ng’a ase enchera eyio bakoroka ensemo y’ogweatanana, inche nigo nkomosaisima Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiaito, na kwegena ayariikire ase amachiiko na ase chibuku chi’ababani.
swahili: Lakini, ninakubali kwamba mimi namwabudu Mungu wa baba zetu, mfuasi wa Njia, ile ambayo wao wanaiita dhehebu. Ninaamini kila kitu kinachokubaliana na Sheria na kile kilichoandikwa katika Manabii,

english: and I have the same hope in God that they themselves cherish, that there will be a resurrection of both the righteous and the wicked.
ekegusii: Ninde nogosemeria ase Nyasae buna barabwo bare nakorokwo, ng’a okobokigwa kw’abakuure nakobe ase abanyene oboronge, na ase abatari abanyene oboronge boigo.
swahili: nami ninalo tumaini kwa Mungu, ambalo hata wao wenyewe wanalikubali kwamba kutakuwa na ufufuo wa wafu, kwa wenye haki na wasio na haki.

english: In this hope, I strive always to maintain a clear conscience before God and man.
ekegusii: Inche boigo nateemire koba nenkoro etari kongambia ase obosio bwa Nyasae, na ase obosio bw’abaanto.
swahili: Kwa hiyo ninajitahidi siku zote kuwa na dhamiri safi mbele za Mungu na mbele za wanadamu.

english: After several years, then, I returned to Jerusalem to bring alms to my people and to present offerings.
ekegusii: Bono yaetire emiaka etai meke ngacha ndetere abanto b’egesaku kiane ebiegwa, naende indue chisadaka.
swahili: “Basi, baada ya kutokuwepo kwa miaka mingi nilikuja Yerusalemu ili kuwaletea watu wangu msaada kwa ajili ya maskini na kutoa dhabihu.

english: At the time they found me in the temple, I was ceremonially clean and was not inciting a crowd or an uproar. But there are some Jews from the province of Asia
ekegusii: Ekero narenge gokora aya, bakaanyora ime ase Hekalu nesibirie, timbeti nomoganda gose rirorooche. Korende Abayahudi bande, abarwete Asia mbarengeo.
swahili: Nilikuwa nimeshatakaswa kwa taratibu za kiibada waliponikuta Hekaluni nikifanya mambo haya. Hapakuwa na umati wa watu, pamoja nami wala aliyehusika kwenye fujo yoyote.

english: who ought to appear before you and bring charges, if they have anything against me.
ekegusii: Abwo mbagwenerete koba aiga ase obosio bwao na gonsoera, onye bare ne ring’ana igoro ase ’nde.
swahili: Lakini kulikuwa na baadhi ya Wayahudi kutoka Asia, ambao wangelazimika wawepo hapa mbele yako ili watoe mashtaka kama wanalo jambo lolote dhidi yangu.

english: When Paul had been called in, Tertullus opened the prosecution: “Because of you, we have enjoyed a lasting peace, and your foresight has brought improvements to this nation.
ekegusii: Ekero Teritulo achia korangerigwa, agachaaka komosoera, agateeba: “Aye, omosike Feliki, ase okogamba kwao twanyorire omorembe omonge, na ase okorigereria kwao gwakoreire egesaku giaito ebinto ebinge ebiya,
swahili: Paulo alipoitwa aingie ndani, Tertulo akaanza kutoa mashtaka akisema, “Mtukufu Feliksi, kwa muda mrefu tumefurahia amani na matengenezo mengi mazuri yamefanywa kwa ajili ya watu hawa kwa sababu ya upeo wako wa kuona mambo ya mbele.

english: Otherwise, let these men state for themselves any crime they found in me when I stood before the Sanhedrin,
ekegusii: Gose abanto aba bare aa abanyene bateebe nkomocha ki banyorete ase ’nde ekero natenena ase ekegambero,
swahili: Au, watu hawa walioko hapa waseme ni uhalifu gani walioniona nao waliponisimamisha mbele ya baraza,

english: unless it was this one thing I called out as I stood in their presence: ‘It is concerning the resurrection of the dead that I am on trial before you today.’” The Verdict Postponed
ekegusii: otatiga ase engencho ye ring’ana erimo nateebete neriogi rinene, ekero natenenete egati yabo. Ngateba: Ase engencho y’okobokigwa kw’abakuure nakio nkogamberigwa ase obosio bwaino iga reero.” Feliki ogotiga ekiina keraare
swahili: isipokuwa ni kuhusu jambo hili moja nililopiga kelele mbele yao kwamba, ‘Mimi nashtakiwa mbele yenu leo kwa sababu ya ufufuo wa wafu.’ ”

english: Then Felix, who was well informed about the Way, adjourned the hearing and said, “When Lysias the commander comes, I will decide your case.”
ekegusii: Korende Feliki, ekiagera amanyete boronge amang’ana ’Enchera eria, agatiga ekiina keraare, akabora: “Lisia, omochiki omonene bw’abarwani karatirimboke, rirorio ninyigwe amang’ana aino.”
swahili: Basi Feliksi ambaye alikuwa anafahamu vizuri habari za Njia ile, akaahirisha shauri lile kwa maelezo yake akisema, “Wakati jemadari Lisia atakapoteremka huku, nitaamua shauri lako.”

english: He ordered the centurion to keep Paul under guard, but to allow him some freedom and permit his friends to minister to his needs.
ekegusii: Agachiika omotang’ani oria bw’abarwani rigana arende Paulo, korende amoe ribaga rike, gose tamokania nonya noyomo bw’abasani baye komokorera, gose gocha komorora.
swahili: Ndipo akaamuru kiongozi wa askari amweke chini ya ulinzi lakini ampe uhuru na kuwaruhusu rafiki zake wamhudumie.

english: After several days, Felix returned with his wife Drusilla, who was a Jewess. He sent for Paul and listened to him speak about faith in Christ Jesus.
ekegusii: Magega y’amatuko atari make, Feliki agaika na Durusila mokaye, oyorenge Omoyahudi. Akarangeria Paulo, akamoigwa ogokwana amang’ana igoro y’okomwegena Kristo Yeso.
swahili: Baada ya siku kadhaa, Feliksi alikuja pamoja na Drusila mkewe, ambaye alikuwa Myahudi. Alituma aitiwe Paulo, naye akamsikiliza alipokuwa akinena juu ya imani katika Kristo Yesu.

english: As Paul expounded on righteousness, self-control, and the coming judgment, Felix became frightened and said, “You may go for now. When I find the time, I will call for you.”
ekegusii: Ekero Paulo are gokwana amang’ana igoro y’oboronge, na okweriita, na ekiina kegochi‐gocha, Feliki akaba nobwoba, akamoteebia: “Ase ekero eke bono, karagenda; ekero ndanyore ribaga, ninkorangerie naende.”
swahili: Naye Paulo alipokuwa akinena juu ya haki, kuwa na kiasi na juu ya hukumu ijayo, Feliksi aliingiwa na hofu na kusema, “Hiyo yatosha sasa! Waweza kuondoka. Nitakapokuwa na wasaa nitakuita.”

english: At the same time, he was hoping that Paul would offer him a bribe. So he sent for Paul frequently and talked with him.
ekegusii: Amo nayio nigo asemeretie ng’a naegwe chifeta na Paulo. Nabo akana‐komorangeria ekero ase ekero gokwana nere.
swahili: Wakati huo Feliksi alitazamia kwamba Paulo angempa rushwa. Hivyo akawa anamwita mara kwa mara na kuzungumza naye.

english: After two years had passed, Felix was succeeded by Porcius Festus. And wishing to do the Jews a favor, Felix left Paul in prison.
ekegusii: Korende emiaka ebere koyaerire, Porikio Festo agasoa obogambi ribaga ria Feliki; na Feliki akarigia gwekora omuya ase Abayahudi, agatiga Paulo osibire.
swahili: Baada ya miaka miwili kupita, Porkio Festo akaingia kwenye utawala mahali pa Feliksi, lakini kwa kuwa Feliksi alitaka kuwapendeza Wayahudi, akamwacha Paulo gerezani.

english: In every way and everywhere, most excellent Felix, we acknowledge this with all gratitude.
ekegusii: gaki iga tokobinyora kera ekero na kera aase, na gokoakera ng’a mbuya mono.
swahili: Wakati wote na kila mahali, kwa namna yoyote, mtukufu sana Feliksi, tumeyapokea mambo haya yote kwa shukrani nyingi.

english: But in order not to burden you any further, I beg your indulgence to hear us briefly.
ekegusii: Korende tinkogochanda kobua, nagosoroire ototegerere ase amang’ana amake ase ogwancha kwao.
swahili: Lakini nisije nikakuchosha zaidi, ningekuomba kwa hisani yako utusikilize kwa kifupi.

english: We have found this man to be a pestilence, stirring up dissension among the Jews all over the world. He is a ringleader of the sect of the Nazarenes,
ekegusii: Naki twanyorire omonto oyo ng’a nomochege are, na omochaaki bw’eriomana ase Abayahudi abare ase ense yonsi, naende nomotang’ani bw’ekeombe ki’Abanazareti.
swahili: “Tumemwona mtu huyu kuwa ni msumbufu, anayechochea ghasia miongoni mwa Wayahudi duniani pote. Yeye ndiye kiongozi wa dhehebu la Wanazarayo,

english: and he even tried to desecrate the temple; so we seized him.
ekegusii: Naende nigo ateemete kogindia Hekalu riko. Ase ayio tokamobwata, [tokarigia komogambia ase amachiiko aito.
swahili: na hata amejaribu kulinajisi Hekalu, hivyo tukamkamata; [tukataka kumhukumu kufuatana na sheria zetu.

english: By examining him yourself, you will be able to learn the truth about all our charges against him.”
ekegusii: agachiika abamosoeri baria bache ase ore.] Aye omonyene nonyare komoboria, onyore engencho y’amang’ana onsi twamosoereire intwe.”
swahili: akiwaamuru washtaki wake waje mbele yako: ili] kwa kumchunguza wewe mwenyewe unaweza kujua kutoka kwake mambo yote tunayomshtaki kwayo.”

english: The Jews concurred, asserting that these charges were true. Paul’s Defense to Felix
ekegusii: Abayahudi nabarabwo bakamosoera, bakaboora ng’a amang’ana ayio naboigo are.
swahili: Pia wale Wayahudi wakaunga mkono wakithibitisha kuwa mashtaka yote haya ni kweli. Paulo Ajitetea Mbele Ya Feliksi

english: Three days after his arrival in the province, Festus went up from Caesarea to Jerusalem,
ekegusii: Bono Festo gasoire ase obogambi bwaye, magega y’amatuko atato agatiira gochia Yerusalemu korwa Kaisaria.
swahili: Siku tatu baada ya Festo kuwasili Kaisaria kuchukua wajibu wake mpya, alipanda kwenda Yerusalemu,

english: Paul replied, “I am standing before the judgment seat of Caesar, where I ought to be tried. I have done nothing wrong to the Jews, as you yourself know very well.
ekegusii: Korende Paulo agateeba: “Inche nigo nteneine aiga bosio bw’ekegambero gia Kaisari, ase ngwenerete kogamberigwa; timochereti Abayahudi ring’ana buna aye omanyete buya.
swahili: Paulo akasema, “Mimi sasa nimesimama mbele ya mahakama ya Kaisari, ambako ndiko ninakostahili kushtakiwa. Kama vile wewe mwenyewe ujuavyo vyema kabisa sijawatendea Wayahudi kosa lolote.

english: If, however, I am guilty of anything worthy of death, I do not refuse to die. But if there is no truth to their accusations against me, no one has the right to hand me over to them. I appeal to Caesar!”
ekegusii: Onye namochire, gose nakorire ring’ana ringwenerete ogokwa, tinyangeti ogokwa, korende onye tari ekeene ring’ana eri bansoereire, onde tari oranyare kombeka ase amaboko abo. Nindigetie ekiina kiane keirwe ase Kaisari.”
swahili: Basi kama mimi nina hatia ya kutenda kosa lolote linalostahili kifo, sikatai kufa. Lakini kama mashtaka yaliyoletwa dhidi yangu na hawa Wayahudi si kweli, hakuna yeyote aliye na haki ya kunikabidhi mikononi mwao. Naomba rufaa kwa Kaisari!”
