english: Then Festus conferred with his council and replied, “You have appealed to Caesar. To Caesar you will go!” Festus Consults Agrippa
ekegusii: Erio Festo agachia gokoora gokwana n’abanto b’ekegambero, akairaneria: “Norigetie ekiina kiao keirwe ase Kaisari, nabo oragende ase Kaisari.” Agripa na Bereniki
swahili: Baada ya Festo kufanya shauri pamoja na baraza lake, akatangaza, “Wewe umeomba rufaa kwa Kaisari, nako kwa Kaisari utakwenda!” Festo Aomba Ushauri Kwa Agripa

english: After several days had passed, King Agrippa and Bernice came down to Caesarea to pay their respects to Festus.
ekegusii: Amatuko atai make gaetire, Agripa omorwoti na Bereniki bagaika Kaisaria gokwania Festo.
swahili: Baada ya siku kadhaa Mfalme Agripa na Bernike wakapanda kuja Kaisaria kumsalimu Festo.

english: Since they were staying several days, Festus laid out Paul’s case before the king: “There is a certain man whom Felix left in prison.
ekegusii: Na ekero baikaransire aroro amatuko amange, Festo agateebia omorwoti amang’ana igoro ya Paulo, agateeba: “Nare aa omonto oyomo omosibwa, otigetwe na Feliki.
swahili: Kwa kuwa walikuwa wakae huko Kaisaria kwa siku nyingi, Festo alijadili shauri la Paulo na mfalme, akisema, “Kuna mtu mmoja hapa ambaye Feliksi alimwacha gerezani.

english: While I was in Jerusalem, the chief priests and elders of the Jews presented their case and requested a judgment against him.
ekegusii: Ekero narenge Yerusalemu, abakuani abanene na abagaaka b’Abayahudi baganteebia amang’ana igoro yaye, bakarigia agambigwe.
swahili: Nilipokuwa huko Yerusalemu, viongozi wa makuhani na wazee wa Wayahudi walinijulisha habari zake na wakaomba hukumu dhidi yake.

english: I told them that it is not the Roman custom to hand a man over before he has had an opportunity to face his accusers and defend himself against their charges.
ekegusii: Nkabairaneria ng’a tari engencho y’Abarumi korua omonto onde bwensi aitwe ritang’ani omonto oria omosoerwa atararorana nabamosoeri baye obosio ase obosio, na koegwa ribaga gwekengera ase ogosoerwa kwaye.
swahili: “Lakini mimi nikawaambia kwamba si desturi ya Kirumi kumtoa mtu yeyote auawe kabla mshtakiwa kuonana uso kwa uso na washtaki wake, naye awe amepewa nafasi ya kujitetea kuhusu mashtaka anayoshutumiwa.

english: So when they came here with me, I did not delay. The next day I sat on the judgment seat and ordered that the man be brought in.
ekegusii: Ase igo ekero basangererekanete aiga, tintebaaneti, korende rituko ria kabere ngaikaransa ase ekerogo kiane gi’ekegambero, ngachiika omonto oyo arentwe.
swahili: Hivyo walipokutana hapa, sikukawia, kesho yake niliitisha baraza, nikaketi penye kiti changu cha hukumu, nikaagiza huyo mtu aletwe.

english: But when his accusers rose to speak, they did not charge him with any of the crimes I had expected.
ekegusii: Na baria abamosoeri ekero batenenete, tibamosoera ase ing’ana riibe, buna nakagete,
swahili: Washtaki wake waliposimama, hawakushtaki kwa uhalifu wowote niliokuwa ninatarajia.

english: They only had some contentions with him regarding their own religion and a certain Jesus who had died, but whom Paul affirmed to be alive.
ekegusii: korende iga barenge namaborio gete, okoamererania igoro asare ase edini yabo abanyene, na ase amang’ana igoro y’omonto oyomo, Yeso, oyoikire gokwa, korende oyo Paulo akona‐goteeba ng’a moyo are.
swahili: Badala yake walikuwa na vipengele fulani vya kutokukubaliana naye kuhusu dini yao na juu ya mtu mmoja aitwaye Yesu, ambaye alikufa, lakini yeye Paulo alidai kwamba yu hai.

english: where the chief priests and Jewish leaders presented their case against Paul. They urged Festus
ekegusii: Abakuani abanene na abanene b’Abayahudi bakamomanyia amang’ana igoro ya Paulo. Bagasorora Festo,
swahili: ambako viongozi wa makuhani na viongozi wa Wayahudi walikuja mbele yake na kuleta mashtaka yao dhidi ya Paulo.

english: Since I was at a loss as to how to investigate these matters, I asked if he was willing to go to Jerusalem and be tried there on these charges.
ekegusii: Inche ngasinywa komanya buna nkorigia ekeene ki’amang’ana aya, nkamobooria gose narigetie kogenda Yerusalemu agamberigwe aroro ase amang’ana aya.
swahili: Kwa kuwa sikujua jinsi ya kupeleleza jambo hili, nilimuuliza kama angependa kwenda Yerusalemu na kuhojiwa huko kuhusu mashtaka haya.

english: But when Paul appealed to be held over for the decision of the Emperor, I ordered that he be held until I could send him to Caesar.”
ekegusii: Korende ekero Paulo arigia ng’a arendwe goika agamberigwe ase Omorwoti omonene, ngachiika arendwe goika inyare komoira ase Kaisari.”
swahili: Lakini Paulo alipoomba afadhiliwe ili rufaa yake isikilizwe na Mfalme Agusto, nilimwamuru alindwe mpaka nitakapoweza kumpeleka kwa Kaisari.”

english: Then Agrippa said to Festus, “I would like to hear this man myself.” “Tomorrow you will hear him,” Festus declared. Paul before Agrippa and Bernice
ekegusii: Agripa agateebia Festo: “Nainche omonyene nindigetie koigwa omonto oyio.” Akabora: “Noche omoigwe ankio.”
swahili: Ndipo Agripa akamwambia Festo, “Ningependa kumsikiliza mtu huyo mimi mwenyewe.” Yeye akajibu, “Kesho utamsikia.” Paulo Aletwa Mbele Ya Agripa

english: The next day Agrippa and Bernice came with great pomp and entered the auditorium, along with the commanders and leading men of the city. And Festus ordered that Paul be brought in.
ekegusii: Rituko rikobwatia Agripa agaacha amo na Bereniki ase obonene obonge, bagasoa ase ekegambero amo nabatang’ani b’abarwani elifu na abanto abanene b’omochie. Festo akarua ogochika ng’a Paulo arentwe ime.
swahili: Siku iliyofuata Agripa na Bernike walifika kwa fahari kubwa wakaingia katika ukumbi wa mahakama, pamoja na majemadari wa jeshi na watu mashuhuri wa mji. Ndipo kwa amri ya Festo, Paulo akaletwa ndani.

english: Then Festus said, “King Agrippa and all who are present with us, you see this man. The whole Jewish community has petitioned me about him, both here and in Jerusalem, crying out that he ought not to live any longer.
ekegusii: Festo agateeba: “Omorwoti Agripa, na inwe mwensi abamore aa amo naintwe, mwarorire omonto oyo! Ase engencho yaye omogaanda bwonsi bw’Abayahudi aaria Yerusalemu na aiga mbamboria mbakoonye, bagaaka eriogi ng’a temogwenereti abe moyo.
swahili: Festo akasema, “Mfalme Agripa, nanyi nyote mlio hapa pamoja nasi, mnamwona mtu huyu! Jumuiya yote ya Kiyahudi wamenilalamikia kuhusu mtu huyu huko Yerusalemu na hapa Kaisaria, wakipiga kelele kwamba haimpasi kuendelea kuishi.

english: But I found he had done nothing worthy of death, and since he has now appealed to the Emperor, I decided to send him.
ekegusii: Korende ngachia korora ng’a takoreti gento ekebe kegwenerete aitwe; na ere omonyene karigetie agamberigwe ase Omorwoti omonene, nkarengereria komotoma asare.
swahili: Sikuona kwamba ametenda jambo lolote linalostahili kifo, ila kwa kuwa alikuwa ameomba rufaa yake kwa mfalme, niliamua kumpeleka Rumi.

english: I have nothing definite to write to our sovereign one about him. Therefore I have brought him before all of you, and especially before you, King Agrippa, so that after this inquiry I may have something to write.
ekegusii: Na inche tindi ne ring’ana ri’ekeene nkoriikera omonene one igoro asare. Ase ayio namorentire aiga ase obosio bwaino, kobua mono ase obosio bwao, aye omorwoti Agripa, erinde gotwakoorire komobooria, inyore ring’ana nkorika.
swahili: Lakini mimi sina kitu maalum cha kumwandikia Bwana Mtukufu kumhusu mtu huyu. Kwa hiyo nimemleta mbele yenu ninyi nyote, hasa mbele yako, Mfalme Agripa, ili kutokana na matokeo ya uchunguzi huu, niweze kupata kitu cha kuandika.

english: For it seems unreasonable to me to send on a prisoner without specifying the charges against him.”
ekegusii: Naki narorire ng’a nering’ana ritari boronge koira omosibwa otatiga koorokia amasoerwa aria asoereire.”
swahili: Kwa kuwa naona hakuna sababu ya kumpeleka mfungwa bila kuainisha mashtaka dhidi yake.”

english: to grant them a concession against Paul by summoning him to Jerusalem, because they were preparing an ambush to kill him along the way.
ekegusii: na bakamosaba abanchere, arue ogochika ng’a Paulo arentwe Yerusalemu, konya barobeirie komoboera na komoitera nchera.
swahili: Wakamsihi sana Festo, kama upendeleo kwao, aamuru Paulo ahamishiwe Yerusalemu, kwa kuwa walikuwa wanaandaa kumvizia ili wamuue akiwa njiani.

english: But Festus replied, “Paul is being held in Caesarea, and I myself am going there soon.
ekegusii: Festo akairaneria ng’a Paulo narendire aria Kaisaria; ere omonyene nigo arengereretie kogenda aroro bwango.
swahili: Festo akawajibu, “Paulo amezuiliwa huko Kaisaria, nami mwenyewe ninakwenda huko hivi karibuni.

english: So if this man has done anything wrong, let some of your leaders come down with me and accuse him there.”
ekegusii: Agakwana: “Baria bare nokobua ase egati yaino, tiga batirimboke amo nainche, onye ring’ana rire riibe ase omonto oria, bamosoere.”
swahili: Baadhi ya viongozi wenu wafuatane nami na kutoa mashtaka dhidi ya mtu huyo huko, kama amekosa jambo lolote.”

english: After spending no more than eight or ten days with them, Festus went down to Caesarea. The next day he sat on the judgment seat and ordered that Paul be brought in.
ekegusii: Ekero abeire amo nabarabwo tari kobua amatuko atano na atato gose ikomi, agatirimboka gochia Kaisaria; ne rituko ria kabere agaikaransa ase ekerogo kiaye gi’ekegambero, agachiika Paulo arentwe.
swahili: Baada ya Festo kukaa miongoni mwao kwa karibu siku nane au kumi, akashuka kwenda Kaisaria na siku iliyofuata akaitisha mahakama, akaketi penye kiti chake cha hukumu, akaamuru Paulo aletwe mbele yake.

english: When Paul arrived, the Jews who had come down from Jerusalem stood around him, bringing many serious charges that they could not prove.
ekegusii: Ekero Paulo achire, Abayahudi abarwete Yerusalemu bagatenena, bakamoetanana, bakarenta amasoero amange amarito igoro yaye, ayabatanyare koorokia oboene ng’a mboronge are.
swahili: Paulo alipotokea, wale Wayahudi waliokuwa wameteremka toka Yerusalemu wakasimama wakiwa wamemzunguka, wakileta mashtaka mengi mazito dhidi yake ambayo hawakuweza kuyathibitisha.

english: Then Paul made his defense: “I have committed no offense against the law of the Jews or against the temple or against Caesar.”
ekegusii: Paulo agekengera iga: “Inche timocheti ring’ana igoro ase amachiiko ’Abayahudi, gose ase Hekalu, nonya nase Kaisari.”
swahili: Ndipo Paulo akajitetea, akasema, “Mimi sikufanya jambo lolote kinyume cha sheria ya Wayahudi au dhidi ya Hekalu au kinyume cha Kaisari.”

english: But Festus, wishing to do the Jews a favor, said to Paul, “Are you willing to go up to Jerusalem to stand trial before me on these charges?” Paul Appeals to Caesar
ekegusii: Korende Festo akarigia gwekora omuya ase Abayahudi, akaboria Paulo: “Norigetie kogenda Yerusalemu ogamberigwe aroro ase obosio bwane?”
swahili: Festo, akitaka kuwapendeza Wayahudi, akamuuliza Paulo, “Je, ungependa kwenda Yerusalemu na kukabili mashtaka mbele yangu huko?”

english: Agrippa said to Paul, “You have permission to speak for yourself.” Then Paul stretched out his hand and began his defense:
ekegusii: Agripa agateebia Paulo: “Nore ne ribaga gokwana amang’ana ao.” Erio Paulo akarambora okoboko kwaye, agekengera:
swahili: Ndipo Agripa akamwambia Paulo, “Unayo ruhusa kujitetea.” Hivyo Paulo akawaashiria kwa mkono wake, akaanza kujitetea, akasema:

english: And that is what I did in Jerusalem. With authority from the chief priests I put many of the saints in prison, and when they were condemned to death, I cast my vote against them.
ekegusii: Ngakora aya aria Yerusalemu: Ngasiba abachenu abange ase echela, ekero naeirwe okobua nabakuani abanene; tari ayio oka, korende kobagoitwa, nigo narenge gwancha abe bo ase bare.
swahili: Nami hayo ndiyo niliyoyafanya huko Yerusalemu. Kwa mamlaka ya viongozi wa makuhani, niliwatia wengi wa watakatifu gerezani na walipokuwa wakiuawa, nilipiga kura yangu kuunga mkono.

english: I frequently had them punished in the synagogues, and I tried to make them blaspheme. In my raging fury against them, I even went to foreign cities to persecute them.
ekegusii: Nkabasusura ebiro ebinge ase chisinagogi chionsi, naende mbabetereria korama, nkababwaterwa endamwamu enene mono, nkabatunya na kobachanda goika emechie y’ense engeni.
swahili: Mara nyingi nilikwenda kutoka sinagogi moja hadi ingine nikiamuru waadhibiwe, nami nilijaribu kuwalazimisha wakufuru. Katika shauku yangu dhidi yao, hata nilikwenda miji ya kigeni ili kuwatesa. Paulo Aeleza Kuhusu Kuokoka Kwake (Matendo 9:1-19; 22:6-16)

english: In this pursuit I was on my way to Damascus with the authority and commission of the chief priests.
ekegusii: “Nabo ase emeremo eyio nigo narenge kogenda Damesiki, nigo naetwe okobua na amachiiko korwa ase abakuani abanene.
swahili: “Siku moja nilipokuwa katika mojawapo ya safari hizi nikiwa ninakwenda Dameski, nilikuwa na mamlaka na agizo kutoka kwa kiongozi wa makuhani.

english: About noon, O king, as I was on the road, I saw a light from heaven, brighter than the sun, shining around me and my companions.
ekegusii: Aye omorwoti, ekero kia mobaso gati, kande enchera kogenda, nkarora amasase akorwa igoro abuete okobara kw’erioba, akambarera chinsemo chionsi amo nabaria barenge amo nainche.
swahili: Ilikuwa yapata adhuhuri, ee mfalme, nilipokuwa njiani, niliona nuru kutoka mbinguni kali kuliko jua, ikingʼaa kunizunguka pande zote mimi na wale niliokuwa pamoja nao.

english: We all fell to the ground, and I heard a voice say to me in Hebrew, ‘Saul, Saul, why do you persecute Me? It is hard for you to kick against the goads.’
ekegusii: Tokagwa inse twensi, nkaigwa eriogi rigonteebia ase omonwa bw’Ekeiberania: Saulo, Saulo, nase ki gwanchandire? Naakong’u ase ore goaka ensonga y’esimisi chintacho.
swahili: Wote tulipokuwa tumeanguka chini, nikasikia sauti ikisema nami kwa lugha ya Kiebrania, ‘Sauli, Sauli, mbona unanitesa? Ni vigumu kwako kuupiga teke mchokoo.’

english: ‘Who are You, Lord?’ I asked. ‘I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting,’ the Lord replied.
ekegusii: Na inche nkaboora: Naye ng’Omonene? Omonene aganteebia: Ninche Yeso, oyogwachandire aye.
swahili: “Nikauliza, ‘Ni nani wewe, Bwana?’ “Naye Bwana akajibu, ‘Ni Mimi Yesu unayemtesa.

english: ‘But get up and stand on your feet. For I have appeared to you to appoint you as a servant and as a witness of what you have seen from Me and what I will show you.
ekegusii: Korende imoka, otenene namagoro ao, ekiagera nakoorokeire ase engencho eye: nkobeke obe omokori na kirori bw’amang’ana aya kwarora, na amang’ana ayio ndeorokerie ase ore.
swahili: Sasa inuka usimame kwa miguu yako. Nimekutokea ili nikuteue uwe mtumishi na shahidi wa mambo ambayo umeyaona, na yale nitakayokuonyesha.

english: I will rescue you from your own people and from the Gentiles. I am sending you to them
ekegusii: Ningotoorie korwa ase abanto bao, na korwa ase abanto b’Ebisaku, ase abwo ndagotome.
swahili: Nitakuokoa kutoka kwa watu wako na watu wa Mataifa ambao ninakutuma kwao,

english: to open their eyes, so that they may turn from darkness to light and from the power of Satan to God, that they may receive forgiveness of sins and an inheritance among those sanctified by faith in Me.’
ekegusii: Nigo oraramokie amaiso abo baonchoke korwa ase omosunte, bache ase omobaso, batige okobua gwa Saitani na baonchokere Nyasae, banyore okwaberwa kw’ebibe biabo, na omwando ase egati yabo abachenirwe ase okonyegena.
swahili: uyafumbue macho yao ili wageuke kutoka gizani waingie nuruni, na kutoka kwenye nguvu za Shetani wamgeukie Mungu, ili wapate msamaha wa dhambi na sehemu miongoni mwa wale waliotakaswa kwa kuniamini mimi.’

english: So then, King Agrippa, I was not disobedient to the heavenly vision.
ekegusii: “Aye omorwoti Agripa! Ase ayio tinare kwanga koigwera okorora koria kwarwete igoro,
swahili: “Hivyo basi, Mfalme Agripa, sikuacha kuyatii yale maono yaliyotoka mbinguni,

english: “King Agrippa, I consider myself fortunate to stand before you today to defend myself against all the accusations of the Jews,
ekegusii: “Omorwoti Agripa, nerorire omonyene ng’a ninde negesio, ekiagera ninyekengere ase obosio bwao reero, ase amang’ana aria onsi nasoerwa n’Abayahudi.
swahili: “Mfalme Agripa, najiona kuwa na heri kusimama mbele yako leo ninapojitetea kuhusu mashtaka yote ya Wayahudi,

english: First to those in Damascus and Jerusalem, then to everyone in the region of Judea, and then to the Gentiles, I declared that they should repent and turn to God, performing deeds worthy of their repentance.
ekegusii: korende ritang’ani nigo naranderetie baria ba Damesiki, na Yerusalemu, na ase ense ya Boyahudi, na abanto b’Ebisaku, baonchoke, baonchokere Nyasae bakore ogokora kobwataine okoonchoka kwabo.
swahili: bali niliyatangaza kwanza kwa wale wa Dameski, kisha Yerusalemu na katika vijiji vyote vya Uyahudi na pia kwa watu wa Mataifa, kwamba inawapasa kutubu na kumgeukia Mungu na kuthibitisha toba yao kwa matendo yao.

english: For this reason the Jews seized me in the temple courts and tried to kill me.
ekegusii: Naki ase engencho eyio Abayahudi bakambwatera ime ase Hekalu, bagateema kong’ita.
swahili: Ni kwa sababu hii Wayahudi walinikamata nilipokuwa Hekaluni, wakataka kuniua.

english: But I have had God’s help to this day, and I stand here to testify to small and great alike. I am saying nothing beyond what the prophets and Moses said would happen:
ekegusii: Goika reero iga nanyorire ogokonywa korwa ase Nyasae. Ase igo ninteneine na koba kirori ase abake na abanene. Tindi gokwana amang’ana ande otatiga aria ababani na Musa bakwanete ng’a nabe,
swahili: Hadi leo nimepata msaada kutoka kwa Mungu, na hivyo nasimama hapa nikishuhudia kwa wakubwa na wadogo. Sisemi chochote zaidi ya yale ambayo manabii na Mose walisema yatatukia:

english: that the Christ would suffer, and as the first to rise from the dead, would proclaim light to our people and to the Gentiles.” Festus Interrupts Paul’s Defense
ekegusii: buna Kristo agwenerete achandwe, naende ase okoba omotang’ani ase okobokigwa kw’abakuure, nararie amang’ana ’omobaso ase abanto baye, na ase abanto b’Ebisaku.”
swahili: kwamba Kristo atateswa, na kwamba yeye atakuwa wa kwanza kufufuka kutoka kwa wafu, na atatangaza nuru kwa watu wake na kwa watu wa Mataifa.” Paulo Aeleza Juu Ya Kuhubiri Kwake

english: At this stage of Paul’s defense, Festus exclaimed in a loud voice, “You are insane, Paul! Your great learning is driving you to madness!”
ekegusii: Agachia gwekengera iga, Festo agakwana neriogi rinene: “Paulo, nebarimo ore! Ogosoma kwao okonge kwaonchoire obong’aini bwao.”
swahili: Paulo alipokuwa akifanya utetezi huu, Festo akasema kwa sauti kubwa, “Paulo, wewe umerukwa na akili! Kusoma kwingi kunakufanya uwe kichaa!”

english: But Paul answered, “I am not insane, most excellent Festus; I am speaking words of truth and sobriety.
ekegusii: Korende Paulo agakwana: “Omosike Festo, tindi ebarimo, korende nigo ngokwana amang’ana ’ekeene na ay’obong’aini kegima.
swahili: Lakini Paulo akajibu, “Mimi sijarukwa na akili, mtukufu sana Festo, bali nanena kweli nikiwa na akili zangu timamu.

english: For the king knows about these matters, and I can speak freely to him. I am confident that none of this has escaped his notice, because it was not done in a corner.
ekegusii: Naki omorwoti namanyete engencho y’amang’ana aya, naende ninyare gokwana nere ntari nokoiroka, ekiagera namanyire mono ng’a ring’ana tiriri nonya nerimo ase ayio otamanyeti, ekiagera erio tiriakoregete bobisi.
swahili: Naam, Mfalme anajua kuhusu mambo haya yote, nami nasema naye kwa uhuru. Kwa sababu nina hakika kwamba hakuna hata mojawapo ya mambo haya asilolijua, kwa kuwa hayakufanyika mafichoni.

english: King Agrippa, do you believe the prophets? I know you do.”
ekegusii: Omorwoti Agripa, Inee, mbwegenete ababani? Namanyire ng’a nobegenete.”
swahili: Mfalme Agripa, je, unaamini manabii? Najua kuwa unaamini.”

english: Then Agrippa said to Paul, “Can you persuade me in such a short time to become a Christian?”
ekegusii: Agripa agateebia Paulo: “Ase amang’ana amake norigetie gonkora imbe Omokristo.”
swahili: Agripa akamwambia Paulo, “Je, unanishawishi kwa haraka namna hii niwe Mkristo?”

english: “Short time or long,” Paul replied, “I wish to God that not only you but all who hear me this day may become what I am, except for these chains.”
ekegusii: Paulo akamoiraneria: “Nasabire Nyasae ng’a ase amang’ana amake, gose amange, tari aye bweka, korende naba bonsi abantegererete reero, babe buna inche otatiga ase ebinyuri ebi.”
swahili: Paulo akasema, “Ikiwa ni kwa haraka au la, namwomba Mungu, si wewe peke yako bali pia wale wote wanaonisikiliza leo, wawe kama mimi nilivyo, kasoro minyororo hii.”

english: especially since you are acquainted with all the Jewish customs and controversies. I beg you, therefore, to listen to me patiently.
ekegusii: Nabo ekiagera aye kwamanyire mono chingencho chionsi na amaborio onsi Abayahudi bare naro, nagosabire ontegerere ase oboremereria.
swahili: hasa kwa sababu unajua vyema desturi zote za Kiyahudi na ya kuwa wewe unajua kwa undani mila na masuala ya mabishano. Kwa hiyo, nakusihi unisikilize kwa uvumilivu.

english: Then the king and the governor rose, along with Bernice and those seated with them.
ekegusii: Erio omorwoti, na gabana, na Bereniki, na baria baikaransete amo nabarabwo bagatenena,
swahili: Baada ya kusema hayo, mfalme akainuka pamoja na mtawala na Bernike na wale waliokuwa wameketi pamoja nao.

english: On their way out, they said to one another, “This man has done nothing worthy of death or imprisonment.”
ekegusii: bakagenda are ake, bagateebania, bakaboora: “Omonto oyo takoreti ring’ana rigwenerete ogokwa gose ogosibwa.”
swahili: Walipokuwa wakiondoka, wakaambiana, “Mtu huyu hafanyi jambo lolote linalostahili kufa au kufungwa.”

english: And Agrippa said to Festus, “This man could have been released if he had not appealed to Caesar.”
ekegusii: Agripa agateebia Festo: “Omonto oyo nanga nasiborwa onye atarigia ekiina kiaye keirwe ase Kaisari.”
swahili: Agripa akamwambia Festo, “Mtu huyu angeachwa huru kama hangekuwa amekata rufaa kwa Kaisari.”

english: Surely all the Jews know how I have lived from the earliest days of my youth, among my own people and in Jerusalem.
ekegusii: “Abayahudi bonsi mbamanyete obogima bwane korwa obosae bwane buna bwarenge korwa omochakano, ase egesaku kiane na ase Yerusalemu.
swahili: “Wayahudi wote wanajua jinsi nilivyoishi tangu nilipokuwa mtoto, kuanzia mwanzo wa maisha yangu katika nchi yangu na pia huko Yerusalemu.

english: They have known me for a long time and can testify, if they are willing, that I lived as a Pharisee, adhering to the strictest sect of our religion.
ekegusii: Mbamanyete korwa ase ekero egetambe, na onye barigetie, banyare koorokia buna narenge oyomo bw’ekeombe keria gi’okobetererigwa bokong’u kobwata engencho yaito y’okomoiroka Nyasae, nakio ekeombe ki’Abafarisai.
swahili: Wao wamefahamu kwa muda mrefu na wanaweza kushuhudia kama wakipenda, ya kwamba kutokana na misimamo mikali sana ya dhehebu letu kwenye dini yetu, niliishi nikiwa Farisayo.

english: And now I stand on trial because of my hope in the promise that God made to our fathers,
ekegusii: Na bono ninteneine aiga ngambigwe ase engencho y’ogosemeria kw’eira eria chisokoro chiaito chiaetwe na Nyasae,
swahili: Nami sasa ni kwa sababu ya tumaini langu katika kile ambacho Mungu aliwaahidi baba zetu, ninashtakiwa leo.

english: the promise our twelve tribes are hoping to realize as they earnestly serve God day and night. It is because of this hope, O king, that I am accused by the Jews.
ekegusii: eira eyio eyio ebisaku biaito ikomi na bibere biasemeretie koyeikera, kobiragenderere komosasiima Nyasae obotuko na omobaso. Aye omorwoti! Ase engencho y’ogosemeria okwo nasoereirwe n’Abayahudi.
swahili: Hii ndiyo ahadi ambayo makabila yetu kumi na mawili yanatarajia kuiona ikitimizwa wanapomtumikia Mungu kwa bidii usiku na mchana. Ee mfalme, ninashtakiwa na Wayahudi kwa ajili ya tumaini hili.

english: Why would any of you consider it incredible that God raises the dead?
ekegusii: Nase ki motari gwancha nga Nyasae nkobabookia are abakuure?
swahili: Kwa nini yeyote miongoni mwenu afikiri kwamba ni jambo lisilosadikika Mungu kufufua wafu?

english: So then, I too was convinced that I ought to do all I could to oppose the name of Jesus of Nazareth.
ekegusii: “Ekeene inche omonyene naroche ng’a nengwenerete gokora amang’ana amange mamincha y’erieta ria Yeso o Nazareti.
swahili: “Mimi pia nilikuwa nimeshawishika kwamba imenipasa kufanya yote yale yaliyowezekana kupinga Jina la Yesu wa Nazareti.

english: When it was decided that we would sail for Italy, Paul and some other prisoners were handed over to a centurion named Julius, who belonged to the Imperial Regiment.
ekegusii: Ekero amang’ana achiikwa ng’a togende n’emeeri goika Italia, bakabeeka Paulo na abasibwa bande ase amaboko a Yulio, omotang’ani bw’abarwani rigana ase ekeombe ki’abarwani ki’omogambi Augusto.
swahili: Ilipoamuliwa kwamba tungesafiri kwa njia ya bahari kwenda Italia, Paulo na wafungwa wengine wakakabidhiwa kwa kiongozi mmoja wa askari aliyeitwa Juliasi, aliyekuwa wa Kikosi cha Walinzi wa Kaisari.

english: “Men, I can see that our voyage will be filled with disaster and great loss, not only to ship and cargo, but to our own lives as well.”
ekegusii: “Inwe abasacha, narorire ng’a orogendo oro narobe nemechando na ogosira okonge, tari ase chigurube na emeeri bioka, korende nonya nase obogima bwaito boigo.”
swahili: “Mabwana, naona kuwa hii safari ni yenye maafa na ya kuleta hasara kubwa kwa meli na shehena, pia kwa maisha yetu.”

english: But contrary to Paul’s advice, the centurion was persuaded by the pilot and by the owner of the ship.
ekegusii: Korende omotang’ani oria akaigwera omoraai na omonyene emeeri kobua aya Paulo akwanete.
swahili: Lakini badala ya yule kiongozi wa askari kusikiliza yale Paulo aliyosema, akafuata zaidi ushauri wa nahodha na mwenye meli.

english: Since the harbor was unsuitable to winter in, the majority decided to sail on, if somehow they could reach Phoenix to winter there. Phoenix was a harbor in Crete facing both southwest and northwest. The Storm at Sea (Jonah 1:4–10)
ekegusii: Ekiagera ekiambokero eke tikiarenge ekiya ase abanto komenya aroro ekero gi’etoigo, abange babo bakarigia mono korua aroro, erinde keranyarekane, baike Foiniki na kobeera aroro ekero ki’obokendu. Na kerokio nekiambokero gia Kirete, kerigereretie gati ya Irianyi ya bosongo na sugusu ya bosongo.
swahili: Kwa kuwa ile bandari ilikuwa haifai kukaa wakati wa majira ya baridi, wengi wakashauri kwamba tuendelee na safari wakitarajia kufika Foinike na kukaa huko kwa majira ya baridi. Hii ilikuwa bandari iliyoko katika kisiwa cha Krete ikikabili upande wa kusini-magharibi na kaskazini-magharibi. Dhoruba Baharini

english: When a gentle south wind began to blow, they thought they had their opportunity. So they weighed anchor and sailed along, hugging the coast of Crete.
ekegusii: Naende embeo ya Irianyi egachia kogusa ake, bagakaga ng’a banyorire eki barigetie konyora, bakang’usa ekeroochi, bakagenda ang’e na Kirete, ang’e mono nengegu.
swahili: Upepo mtulivu ulipoanza kuvuma toka kusini, wakadhani kuwa wangeweza kufikia lengo lao, hivyo wakangʼoa nanga na kusafiri wakipita kandokando ya pwani ya kisiwa cha Krete.

english: But it was not long before a cyclone called the Northeaster swept down across the island.
ekegusii: Magega ase ekero egeke omwaga bw’echinguru okorokwa Eurakilo, ore gocha buna ekembugu‐mbugu ogaaka emeeri.
swahili: Lakini baada ya muda mfupi ikavuma tufani kubwa iitwayo “Eurakilo” toka kisiwa cha Krete.

english: Unable to head into the wind, the ship was caught up. So we gave way and let ourselves be driven along.
ekegusii: Ekero emeeri yatwometwe na tiyare konyara goeta ase omwaga, tokayetiga etoire ase ekoirwa gochia.
swahili: Meli ikapigwa na dhoruba na haikuweza kushindana na ule upepo, tukarudishwa baharini upepo ulikokuwa unaelekea.

english: Passing to the lee of a small island called Cauda, we barely managed to secure the lifeboat.
ekegusii: Togaeta togakengana ase egesinka egeke gekorokwa Kilaudia, tokanyara ase obokong’u kobogoria obwato oboke.
swahili: Hatimaye tukisafiri kupita chini ya kisiwa kidogo kiitwacho Kauda, ambapo kwa kuwa tulikuwa tumekingiwa upepo na hicho kisiwa, tuliweza kwa shida kuifunga mashua ya kuokolea watu.

english: After hoisting it up, the crew used ropes to undergird the ship. And fearing that they would run aground on the sandbars of Syrtis, they lowered the sea anchor and were driven along.
ekegusii: Magega kobakoorire kobotiria bakabogoria chingori chi’ogokonya, bagachietanania emeeri. Bakairoka ng’a tibaabaisa korateera ase omokenye okorokwa Siriti, bagasibora ebitambaa, bakairwa bosa.
swahili: Watu walipokwisha kuivuta mashua hiyo na kuiingiza katika meli, waliifunga kwa kamba chini ya meli yenyewe ili kuzishikanisha pamoja. Wakiogopa kupelekwa kwenye mchanga karibu na pwani ya Sirti, wakashusha matanga wakaiacha meli isukumwe na huo upepo.

english: We were tossed so violently that the next day the men began to jettison the cargo.
ekegusii: Ekiagera konya twatwomirwe mono nomwaga oria, rituko ria kabere bagachaaka gotuguta chigurube nyancha ime.
swahili: Tulikuwa tunapigwa na dhoruba kwa nguvu, kiasi kwamba kesho yake walianza kutupa shehena toka melini.

english: On the third day, they threw the ship’s tackle overboard with their own hands.
ekegusii: Rituko ria gatato bagatuguta ebinto bi’emeeri namaboko abo abanyene.
swahili: Siku ya tatu, wakatupa vyombo vya meli baharini kwa mikono yao wenyewe.

english: We boarded an Adramyttian ship about to sail for ports along the coast of Asia, and we put out to sea. Aristarchus, a Macedonian from Thessalonica, was with us.
ekegusii: Togasoa ase emeeri y’Aderamiti eyarenge ang’e kogenda goika emechie ye chingegu chi’Asia, tokaimoka. Aristariko, Omomakedonia o Tesaloniki, nigo arenge amo naintwe.
swahili: Tulipanda meli iliyotoka Adramitio, iliyokuwa inakaribia kusafiri kwenda kwenye bandari zilizopo pwani ya Asia, tukaanza safari yetu tukiwa pamoja na Aristarko, Mmakedonia kutoka Thesalonike.

english: When neither sun nor stars appeared for many days and the great storm continued to batter us, we abandoned all hope of being saved.
ekegusii: Ekero erioba ne ching’enang’eni bitarorekanete ase amatuko amange, na omwaga omonene mono ogatotuba, tokerusia moyo ase ogotooreka.
swahili: Kulipokuwa hakuna kuonekana kwa jua wala nyota kwa siku nyingi, nayo dhoruba ikiwa inaendelea kuwa kali, hatimaye tulikata kabisa tamaa ya kuokoka.

english: After the men had gone a long time without food, Paul stood up among them and said, “Men, you should have followed my advice not to sail from Crete. Then you would have averted this disaster and loss.
ekegusii: Bagachia koba ekero egetambe batari koria endagera, Paulo agatenena gati‐gati yabo, akabora: “Inwe abasacha, onye mwanyigwerete timorua Kirete, nanga titwanyora emechando na ogosira buna oko.
swahili: Baada ya watu kukaa siku nyingi bila kula chakula, Paulo akasimama katikati yao akasema, “Enyi watu, iliwapasa kunisikiliza na kuacha kusafiri baharini kutoka Krete, ndipo ninyi mngekuwa mmejinusuru na uharibifu huu na hasara hii.

english: But now I urge you to keep up your courage, because you will not experience any loss of life, but only of the ship.
ekegusii: Bono nabateebirie, remia chinkoro chiaino, ekiagera monto tagosira, otatiga emeeri yoka.
swahili: Sasa ninawasihi sana, jipeni moyo mkuu kwa kuwa hakuna hata mmoja wenu atakayepoteza maisha yake, ila meli itaangamia.

english: For just last night an angel of God, whose I am and whom I serve, stood beside me
ekegusii: Ekiagera obotuko obo bwa reero omomalaika o Nyasae, oria inche inde omonto oye, naende nere ngosasiima,
swahili: Jana usiku, malaika wa Mungu yule ambaye mimi ni wake na ambaye ninamwabudu alisimama karibu nami,

english: and said, ‘Do not be afraid, Paul; you must stand before Caesar. And look, God has granted you the lives of all who sail with you.’
ekegusii: natenenete ang’e nainche aganteebia: Paulo toiroka, nogwenerete gotenena ase obosio bwa Kaisari. Naende rora, Nyasae okoeire abanto bonsi, abakogenda amo naye.
swahili: naye akasema, ‘Paulo usiogope, kwa kuwa ni lazima usimame mbele ya Kaisari, naye Mungu amekupa kwa neema uhai wa wote wanaosafiri pamoja nawe.

english: So take courage, men, for I believe God that it will happen just as He told me.
ekegusii: Ase ayio abasacha, remia chinkoro chiaino, ekiagera ninde nokwegena ase Nyasae, ng’a nabe buna natebetigwe.
swahili: Hivyo jipeni moyo, enyi watu, kwa kuwa ninamwamini Mungu kwamba yatakuwa kama vile alivyoniambia.’

english: However, we must run aground on some island.” The Shipwreck
ekegusii: Korende netogwenerete goikigwa ase egesinka gete.”
swahili: Lakini hata hivyo meli yetu itakwama kwenye kisiwa fulani.” Maangamizi Ya Meli

english: On the fourteenth night we were still being driven across the Adriatic Sea. About midnight the sailors sensed they were approaching land.
ekegusii: Goika obotuko bwa ikomi na kane bogachia goika tokairwa gochia aria na aria ase enyancha y’Adiria. Botuko gati abagendia b’emeeri bagakaga ng’a baikire ang’e ase ense enyomo.
swahili: Usiku wa kumi na nne ulipofika, tulikuwa bado tunasukumwa na upepo katika Bahari ya Adria. Ilipokuwa yapata usiku wa manane, mabaharia wakahisi kwamba walikuwa wanakaribia nchi kavu.

english: They took soundings and found that the water was twenty fathoms deep. Going a little farther, they took another set of soundings that read fifteen fathoms.
ekegusii: Bakaruta ekerengo, bakanyora ebirengo bi’amaboko emerongo ebere. Bakagenderera ake, bakaruta ekerengo naende, bakanyora ebirengo bi’amaboko ikomi na bitano.
swahili: Kwa hiyo wakapima kina cha maji na kukuta kilikuwa pima ishirini, baada ya kuendelea mbele kidogo wakapima tena wakapata kina cha pima kumi na tano.

english: Fearing that we would run aground on the rocks, they dropped four anchors from the stern and prayed for daybreak.
ekegusii: Bakoboa ng’a mbaabaise gotwomerigwa ase ebitare, bakaruta ebirochi bine bia magega, bagasaba ng’a bokie.
swahili: Wakiogopa kwamba meli yetu ingegonga kwenye miamba, wakashusha nanga nne za nyuma ya meli, wakawa wanaomba kupambazuke.

english: The next day we landed at Sidon, and Julius treated Paul with consideration, allowing him to visit his friends and receive their care.
ekegusii: Rituko rikobwatia togaika Sidoni. Yulio akarenda Paulo buya, akamoa ribaga agende ase abasani baye akonywe nabarabwo.
swahili: Kesho yake tukatia nanga Sidoni, naye Juliasi akamfanyia wema Paulo, akamruhusu aende kwa rafiki zake ili wamtimizie mahitaji yake.

english: Meanwhile, the sailors attempted to escape from the ship. Pretending to lower anchors from the bow, they let the lifeboat down into the sea.
ekegusii: Naende abagendia bagachia korigia gotama na gotiga emeeri, bagaikia obwato oboke gochia nyancha, bakang’ainereria buna mbarigetie koruta ebirochi korwa bosio bw’emeeri.
swahili: Katika jaribio la kutoroka kutoka kwenye meli, mabaharia wakashusha mashua ya kuokolea watu baharini, wakijifanya kwamba wanakwenda kushusha nanga za omo.

english: But Paul said to the centurion and the soldiers, “Unless these men remain with the ship, you cannot be saved.”
ekegusii: Paulo agateebia omotang’ani oria bw’abarwani rigana, na abarwani: “Aba bataikaranseti ase emeeri ime timokonyara gotooreka.”
swahili: Ndipo Paulo akamwambia yule jemadari na askari, “Hawa watu wasipobaki katika meli, hamtaweza kuokoka.”

english: So the soldiers cut the ropes to the lifeboat and set it adrift.
ekegusii: Erio abarwani bakanacha chingori chi’obwato, bakabotiga bogwe amaache ime.
swahili: Hivyo basi wale askari wakakata kamba zilizoshikilia ile mashua ya kuokolea watu kwenye meli, wakaiacha ianguke humo baharini.

english: Right up to daybreak, Paul kept urging them all to eat: “Today is your fourteenth day in constant suspense, without taking any food.
ekegusii: Bogachia gokiamoka Paulo agasorora bonsi barie endagera, akabora: “Reero nerituko ria ikomi na kane moganyete na mogendererete motana koria gento.
swahili: Kabla ya mapambazuko, Paulo akawasihi watu wote wale chakula akisema, “Leo ni siku ya kumi na nne mmekuwa katika wasiwasi mkiwa mmefunga na bila kula chochote.

english: So for your own preservation, I urge you to eat something, because not a single hair of your head will be lost.”
ekegusii: Gaki nabasoroire morie endagera, nebe ase ogotooreka kwaino; naki tikagosira nonya nagatukia akamo k’omotwe bw’oyomo oino.”
swahili: Kwa hiyo nawasihi mle chakula, kwa maana itawasaidia ili mweze kuishi. Kwa kuwa hakuna hata mmoja wenu atakayepoteza unywele hata mmoja kutoka kichwani mwake.”

english: After he had said this, Paul took bread and gave thanks to God in front of them all. Then he broke it and began to eat.
ekegusii: Gakoorire gokwana aya, akabogoria omogati akairaneria ng’a mbuya mono ase Nyasae ase amasio abo bonsi, akayosamunyora, agachaaka koria.
swahili: Baada ya kusema maneno haya, Paulo akachukua mkate, akamshukuru Mungu mbele yao wote, akaumega akaanza kula.

english: They were all encouraged and took some food themselves.
ekegusii: Erio bonsi bakagonkomoka, na barabwo bakaria endagera.
swahili: Ndipo wote wakatiwa moyo, wakaanza kula chakula.

english: In all, there were 276 of us on board.
ekegusii: (Na ase emeeri ime nigo twarenge abanto amagana abere, na emerongo etano na ebere, na batano nomo.)
swahili: Ndani ya meli tulikuwa jumla ya watu 276.

english: After the men had eaten their fill, they lightened the ship by throwing the grain into the sea.
ekegusii: Kobaigotire bakagusuyia emeeri ase ogotuguta engano ase enyancha ime.
swahili: Baada ya watu wote kula chakula cha kutosha, wakapunguza uzito wa meli kwa kutupa ngano baharini.

english: When daylight came, they did not recognize the land, but they sighted a bay with a sandy beach, where they decided to run the ship aground if they could.
ekegusii: Kobwachia gokia, tibamanya ense eria, otatiga baroche omosomo ore nengegu, bagateebania gosoyia emeeri aroro, keranyarekane.
swahili: Kulipopambazuka, mabaharia hawakuitambua ile nchi, lakini waliona ghuba yenye ufuko wa mchanga, ambako waliamua kuipweleza meli kama ingewezekana.

english: After putting out from there, we sailed to the lee of Cyprus because the winds were against us.
ekegusii: Korwa agwo tokagenda ase enyancha, togakengana ase egesinka gekorokwa Kuporo, ekiagera chimbeo chiarenge korua bosio.
swahili: Kutoka huko tukaingia baharini tena na tukapita upande wa chini wa kisiwa cha Kipro kwa sababu upepo ulikuwa wa mbisho.

english: Cutting away the anchors, they left them in the sea as they loosened the ropes that held the rudders. Then they hoisted the foresail to the wind and made for the beach.
ekegusii: Bakaruta ebirochi biria, bakabitiga nyancha ime, bakaororobia chingori chi’ebionchori, bagatiiria egetambaa kia bosio embeo ekeguserere, bakaonchora emeeri gochia engegu.
swahili: Kwa hiyo wakatupa nanga zote na kuziacha baharini, na wakati huo huo wakalegeza kamba zilizokuwa zikishikilia usukani wa meli. Kisha wakatweka tanga la mbele lishike upepo na kuisukuma meli kuelekea pwani.

english: But the vessel struck a sandbar and ran aground. The bow stuck fast and would not move, and the stern was being broken up by the pounding of the waves.
ekegusii: Bagaika aase chinsanganio chie chinyancha ibere, bakaroria emeeri aroro goika ekarateera; obosio bw’emeeri bogasensema omokenye, ekabwatwa kegima, korende korwa magega egatagorwa ne chinguru chi’emerindo.
swahili: Lakini wakafika mahali ambapo bahari mbili zinakutana, wakaipweleza meli ufuoni, omo ikakwama sana, ikawa haiwezi kuondolewa, lakini sehemu ya shetri ikavunjika vipande vipande kwa kule kupiga kwa mawimbi yenye nguvu.

english: The soldiers planned to kill the prisoners so none of them could swim to freedom.
ekegusii: Omoroberio bw’abarwani nigo orenge ng’a baite abasibwa, omonto tareema abaise gotama.
swahili: Wale askari wakapanga kuwaua wale wafungwa ili kuzuia hata mmoja wao asiogelee na kutoroka.

english: But the centurion, wanting to spare Paul’s life, thwarted their plan. He commanded those who could swim to jump overboard first and get to land.
ekegusii: Korende omotang’ani oria akarigia gotooria Paulo, akabataanga, tibakora buna barengereretie. Agachiika baria baranyare komura berute nyancha ime, bagende ense enyomo.
swahili: Lakini yule jemadari alitaka kuokoa maisha ya Paulo, basi akawazuia askari wasitekeleze mpango wao. Akaamuru wale wanaoweza kuogelea wajitupe baharini kwanza, waogelee mpaka nchi kavu.

english: The rest were to follow on planks and various parts of the ship. In this way everyone was brought safely to land.
ekegusii: Abaratigare bagende, abande ase chibao, na abande ase ebinto binde bi’emeeri. Naboigo abanto bonsi bagaika ase ense enyomo buya.
swahili: Waliosalia wangefika nchi kavu kwa kutumia mbao au vipande vya meli iliyovunjika, hivyo ikatimia kwamba wote wakaokoka na kufika nchi kavu salama.

english: And when we had sailed across the open sea off the coast of Cilicia and Pamphylia, we came to Myra in Lycia.
ekegusii: Togaeta enyancha ensemo ya Kilikia na Pamfulia, togaika Mira, omochie o Likia.
swahili: Baada ya sisi kuvuka bahari iliyoko upande wa Kilikia na Pamfilia, tukafika Mira huko Likia.

english: There the centurion found an Alexandrian ship sailing for Italy and put us on board.
ekegusii: Aria omotang’ani oria akanyora emeeri y’Aleksanderia eyarenge ang’e kogenda gochia Italia, agatoriinia.
swahili: Huko yule kiongozi wa askari akapata meli ya Iskanderia ikielekea Italia, akatupandisha humo.

english: After sailing slowly for many days, we arrived off Cnidus. When the wind impeded us, we sailed to the lee of Crete, opposite Salmone.
ekegusii: Tokagenda ng’ora ase ekero ki’amatuko amange, togaika Kinido ase obokong’u, na ekiagera embeo yatotangete, togaeta ang’e na Kirete maate, erinde tokengane embeo ang’e na Salimone.
swahili: Tukasafiri polepole kwa siku nyingi na kwa shida, hatimaye tukafika karibu na Nido. Kwa kuwa upepo wa mbisho ulituzuia tusiweze kushika mwelekeo tuliokusudia, tukapita chini ya Krete mkabala na Salmone.

english: After we had moved along the coast with difficulty, we came to a place called Fair Havens, near the town of Lasea.
ekegusii: Togaeta ase obokong’u engegu ase engegu, togaika aase akorokwa Ebiambokero Ebiya. Ang’e nagwo norengeo omochie ore korokwa Lasaya. Gochia Melita. Omwaga na ogotagorwa kw’emeeri
swahili: Tukaambaa na pwani kwa shida, tukafika sehemu iitwayo Bandari Nzuri, karibu na mji wa Lasea.

english: By now much time had passed, and the voyage had already become dangerous because it was after the Fast. So Paul advised them,
ekegusii: Naende ekero ekenge konya giaetire, na orogendo rwabeire nobokong’u, ekiagera amatuko ’okweng’ata konya aetire, Paulo akabateebia,
swahili: Muda mwingi ulikuwa umepotea na kusafiri baharini kulikuwa hatari kwa sababu wakati huu ulikuwa baada ya siku za kufunga. Hivyo Paulo akawaonya akasema,

english: Once we were safely ashore, we learned that the island was called Malta.
ekegusii: Gatwatoorekire twensi, erio tokamanya ng’a egesinka keria nigo kiare korokwa Melita.
swahili: Baada ya kufika nchi kavu salama, ndipo tukafahamu kwamba jina la kile kisiwa ni Malta.

english: The islanders honored us in many ways and supplied our needs when we were ready to sail. Paul Arrives in Italy
ekegusii: Na barabwo bagatosika ase ogosika okonene; naende ekero twachia gosoa emeeri bagatoa ebinto biria twaremeire. Orogendo gochia Rumi rogendererete
swahili: Wakatupa heshima nyingi, nasi tulipokuwa tayari kusafiri kwa njia ya bahari, wakapakia melini vitu vyote tulivyokuwa tunavihitaji. Paulo Awasili Rumi

english: After three months we set sail in an Alexandrian ship that had wintered in the island. It had the Twin Brothers as a figurehead.
ekegusii: Magega y’emetienyi etato tokagenda n’emeeri y’Aleksanderia, eyabegetwe kobeera aria ase egesinka ekero gi’etoigo, na ekemanyererio kiaye kiarenge Diosikuri (engencho yaye abamura chibarongo).
swahili: Miezi mitatu baadaye tukaanza safari kwa meli iliyokuwa imetia nanga kwenye kisiwa hicho kwa ajili ya majira ya baridi. Hii ilikuwa meli ya Iskanderia yenye alama ya miungu pacha waitwao Kasta na Poluksi.

english: Putting in at Syracuse, we stayed there three days.
ekegusii: Togaika Sirakusa, tokamenyao amatuko atato.
swahili: Kituo chetu cha kwanza kilikuwa Sirakusa na tukakaa huko siku tatu.

english: From there we weighed anchor and came to Rhegium. After one day, a south wind came up, and on the second day we arrived at Puteoli.
ekegusii: Korwa agwo togaetanana, togaikera Regiumu. Magega ye rituko erimo embeo ya Irianyi ekagusa; rituko ria kabere togaika Puteoli.
swahili: Kisha tukangʼoa nanga, tukafika Regio. Siku iliyofuata, upepo mkali wa kusi ukavuma, na siku ya pili yake tukafika Puteoli.

english: There we found some brothers who invited us to spend the week with them. And so we came to Rome.
ekegusii: Agwo tokanyora abaminto, bagatosorora tomenye amo nabarabwo amatuko atano, na abere; erio togaika Rumi.
swahili: Huko tukawakuta ndugu, nasi tukakaribishwa tukae nao kwa siku saba. Hivyo tukaendelea na safari mpaka Rumi.

english: The brothers there had heard about us and traveled as far as the Forum of Appius and the Three Taverns to meet us. When Paul saw them, he was encouraged and gave thanks to God. Paul Preaches at Rome (Isaiah 6:1–13)
ekegusii: Abaminto b’aroro, ekero baigwete amang’ana igoro yaito, bagacha goika Apioforo na Tiretaberne gotorototera aroro. Paulo ekero achia kobarora, akamobaka Nyasae, akaremigwa.
swahili: Ndugu wa huko Rumi waliposikia habari zetu, walikuja mpaka Soko la Apio na mahali paitwapo Mikahawa Mitatu kutulaki. Paulo alipowaona, alimshukuru Mungu akatiwa moyo.

english: When we arrived in Rome, Paul was permitted to stay by himself, with a soldier to guard him.
ekegusii: Ekero twasoa Rumi, Paulo akaegwa ribaga komenya ere bweka, amo nomorendi ore komorenda. Paulo ogokwana n’Abayahudi agwo Rumi
swahili: Tulipofika Rumi, Paulo aliruhusiwa kuishi peke yake akiwa na askari wa kumlinda. Paulo Ahubiri Rumi Chini Ya Ulinzi

english: After three days, he called together the leaders of the Jews. When they had gathered, he said to them, “Brothers, although I have done nothing against our people or the customs of our fathers, I was taken prisoner in Jerusalem and handed over to the Romans.
ekegusii: Magega y’amatuko atato, akarangeria abanene b’Abayahudi amo. Ekero basangererekanire akabateebia: “Baminto, nonya tinkoreti ring’ana riibe ase abanto baito, gose ring’ana riatananegete korwa ase chingencho chie chisokoro chiaito, korwa Yerusalemu nkabekwa ase amaboko ’Abarumi buna omosibwa.
swahili: Siku tatu baadaye Paulo akawaita pamoja viongozi wa Kiyahudi. Walipokwisha kukusanyika akawaambia, “Ndugu zangu, ingawa sikufanya jambo lolote dhidi ya watu wetu au dhidi ya desturi za baba zetu, lakini nilikamatwa huko Yerusalemu nikakabidhiwa kwa Warumi.

english: They examined me and wanted to release me, because there was no basis for a death sentence against me.
ekegusii: Ekero bakoorire komboria bakarigia gonsibora, ekiagera tibanyorete engencho ende yonsi yangwenerete ng’itwe.
swahili: Wao walipokwisha kunihoji, wakataka kuniachia huru kwa sababu hawakuona kosa lolote nililolifanya linalostahili adhabu ya kifo.

english: But when the Jews objected, I was compelled to appeal to Caesar, even though I have no charge to bring against my nation.
ekegusii: Korende ekero Abayahudi bangete aya, nkabetererigwa korigia ekiina kiane keirwe ase Kaisari, tari ng’a narenge ne ring’ana ri’ogosoera abanto b’egesaku kiane.
swahili: Lakini Wayahudi walipopinga uamuzi huo, nililazimika kukata rufaa kwa Kaisari, ingawa sikuwa na lalamiko lolote juu ya taifa langu.

english: The islanders showed us extraordinary kindness. They kindled a fire and welcomed all of us because it was raining and cold.
ekegusii: Abanyene ense eria bagatokorera obuya boetete engencho, ekiagera bagatoutera omorero, bagatoroisia intwe twensi, ekiagera embura yatwete na obokendu mbwarenge.
swahili: Wenyeji wa kile kisiwa wakatufanyia ukarimu usio wa kawaida. Waliwasha moto na kutukaribisha sisi sote kwa sababu mvua ilikuwa inanyesha na kulikuwa na baridi.

english: So for this reason I have called to see you and speak with you. It is because of the hope of Israel that I am bound with this chain.”
ekegusii: Nabo ase engencho eyio nero nabarangereirie, erinde mbarore, na gokwana nainwe, ekiagera nasibirwe ase ekenyuri eke ase engencho y’ogosemeria kw’Abaisraeli.”
swahili: Basi hii ndiyo sababu nimewatumania, ili niseme nanyi. Kwa kuwa ni kwa ajili ya tumaini la Israeli nimefungwa kwa minyororo.”

english: The leaders replied, “We have not received any letters about you from Judea, nor have any of the brothers from there reported or even mentioned anything bad about you.
ekegusii: Baria bakamoteebia: “Intwe titwana konyora amarube ande agokwana amang’ana igoro yao korwa Boyahudi, gose onde ominto tari nonya noyomo oikire aiga na gototeebia amang’ana, gose okwanire ring’ana riibe igoro yao.
swahili: Wakamjibu, “Hatujapokea barua zozote kutoka Uyahudi zinazokuhusu, wala hapana ndugu yeyote aliyekuja hapa ambaye ametoa taarifa au kuzungumza jambo lolote baya juu yako.

english: But we consider your views worth hearing, because we know that people everywhere are speaking against this sect.”
ekegusii: Korende ntorigetie koigwa korwa ase ore buna orooche aye, ekiagera ase ekeombe keria twamanyire ng’a giakwanirwe bobe kera aase.”
swahili: Lakini tungependa kusikia kutoka kwako unalofikiri kwa sababu tunajua kwamba kila mahali watu wanazungumza mabaya kuhusu jamii hii.”

english: So they set a day to meet with Paul, and many people came to the place he was staying. He expounded to them from morning to evening, testifying about the kingdom of God and persuading them about Jesus from the Law of Moses and the Prophets.
ekegusii: Kobachorire rituko nere, abanto abange mono bagacha asare aase amenyete. Akabateebereria korwa mambia goika mogoroba, na koorokia amang’ana igoro y’oborwoti bwa Nyasae, agateema kobateebereria amang’ana igoro ya Yeso korwa ase amang’ana ’amachiiko a Musa na korwa ase ababani.
swahili: Baada ya kupanga siku ya kuonana naye, watu wengi wakaja kuanzia asubuhi hadi jioni akawaeleza na kutangaza kuhusu Ufalme wa Mungu akijaribu kuwahadithia juu ya Yesu kutoka Sheria ya Mose na kutoka Manabii.

english: Some of them were convinced by what he said, but others refused to believe.
ekegusii: Abande bagancha ayakwanete, abande tibayaancha.
swahili: Baadhi wakasadiki yale aliyosema, lakini wengine hawakuamini.

english: They disagreed among themselves and began to leave after Paul had made this final statement: “The Holy Spirit was right when He spoke to your fathers through Isaiah the prophet:
ekegusii: Ekiagera batabwatanete barabwo ase barabwo, bakagenda ekero Paulo akwanete ring’ana eri erimo ng’a: Omoika Omochenu nokwanete buya ne chisokoro chiaito goetera ase omonwa bw’omobani Isaya, ogoteeba,
swahili: Hivyo hawakukubaliana, nao walipokuwa wanaondoka, Paulo akatoa kauli moja zaidi: “Roho Mtakatifu alinena kweli na baba zenu aliposema mambo yale yaliyomhusu Bwana Yesu kwa kinywa cha nabii Isaya kwamba:

english: ‘Go to this people and say, “You will be ever hearing but never understanding; you will be ever seeing but never perceiving.”
ekegusii: Genda ase abanto aba, obateebie: Okoigwa namoigwe, korende timokomanya nonya ng’ake, na okorora namorore, korende timoyarengereria nonya ng’ake.
swahili: “ ‘Nenda kwa watu hawa na useme, “Hakika mtasikiliza lakini hamtaelewa; na pia mtatazama, lakini hamtaona.”

english: For this people’s heart has grown callous; they hardly hear with their ears, and they have closed their eyes. Otherwise they might see with their eyes, hear with their ears, understand with their hearts, and turn, and I would heal them.’
ekegusii: Naki chinkoro chi’abaanto aba chiabeire chinyoro, na amato abo nigo are amarito ase okoigwa, na amaiso abo bayamiamirie, tibacha korora namaiso abo, gose baigwe namato abo, gose bamanye ne chinkoro chiabo, baonchoke, na inche mbagwenie.
swahili: Kwa kuwa mioyo ya watu hawa imekuwa migumu; hawasikii kwa masikio yao, na wamefumba macho yao. Wasije wakaona kwa macho yao, na wakasikiliza kwa masikio yao, wakaelewa kwa mioyo yao, na kugeuka nami nikawaponya.’

english: Be advised, therefore, that God’s salvation has been sent to the Gentiles, and they will listen!”
ekegusii: Naki amanyekane ase more ng’a ogotooreka oko kwa Nyasae kwairirwe ase abanto b’Ebisaku, nabarabwo nabaigwe.
swahili: “Basi na ijulikane kwenu kwamba, huu wokovu wa Mungu umepelekwa kwa watu wa Mataifa, nao watasikiliza.” [

english: Paul gathered a bundle of sticks, and as he laid them on the fire, a viper, driven out by the heat, fastened itself to his hand.
ekegusii: Paulo nigo arenge gosangereria chinko na gochibeka ase omorero, eng’iti egasoka ase engencho y’omorero oria, ekamwenarerera okoboko kwaye.
swahili: Paulo alikuwa amekusanya mzigo wa kuni na alipokuwa anaweka kwenye moto kwa ajili ya joto, nyoka mwenye sumu akatoka humo na kujisokotea mkononi mwake.

english: Paul stayed there two full years in his own rented house, welcoming all who came to visit him.
ekegusii: Paulo akamenya engaki y’emiaka ebere ase enyomba amenyete, eye are goakanera, akaba okoroisia abanto bonsi abarenge komochiera,
swahili: Kwa miaka miwili mizima Paulo alikaa huko kwa nyumba aliyokuwa amepanga. Akawakaribisha wote waliokwenda kumwona.

english: Boldly and freely he proclaimed the kingdom of God and taught about the Lord Jesus Christ.
ekegusii: okorandia amang’ana ’oborwoti bwa Nyasae, na kworokereria abanto amang’ana igoro y’Omonene Yeso Kristo noboremu obonge, takanigwa na monto.
swahili: Akahubiri Ufalme wa Mungu na kufundisha mambo yale yaliyomhusu Bwana Yesu Kristo, kwa ujasiri wote na bila kizuizi chochote.

english: When the islanders saw the creature hanging from his hand, they said to one another, “Surely this man is a murderer. Although he was saved from the sea, Justice has not allowed him to live.”
ekegusii: Abanyene ense eria, ekero barora eng’iti eria esung’unaine ase okoboko kwaye, bagateebania: “Takomocha omonto oyo koba omoiti, nonya otooregete korwa ase enyancha, oboronge tibokomotiga abe moyo.”
swahili: Wale wenyeji wa kile kisiwa walipomwona yule nyoka akiningʼinia mkononi mwa Paulo, wakaambiana, “Huyu mtu lazima awe ni muuaji, ingawa ameokoka kutoka baharini, haki haijamwacha aishi.”

english: But Paul shook the creature off into the fire and suffered no ill effects.
ekegusii: Korende akayesamunsera riko, taba na bobe bonde.
swahili: Lakini Paulo akamkungʼutia yule nyoka ndani ya moto wala yeye hakupata madhara yoyote.

english: The islanders were expecting him to swell up or suddenly drop dead. But after waiting a long time and seeing nothing unusual happen to him, they changed their minds and said he was a god.
ekegusii: Bakamorigereria mono, bagakaga ng’a nabimbe, gose nagwe inse na gokwa bwango, korende ekero baganya engaki entambe, na bobe bonde tibomonyooreti, bakaonchora ebirengererio biabo, bakaboora ng’a ere nenyasae.
swahili: Watu walikuwa wanangoja avimbe au aanguke ghafula na kufa. Lakini baada ya kungoja kwa muda mrefu na kuona kwamba hakuna chochote kisicho cha kawaida kilichomtokea, wakabadili mawazo yao na kuanza kusema kwamba yeye ni mungu.

english: Nearby stood an estate belonging to Publius, the chief official of the island. He welcomed us and entertained us hospitably for three days.
ekegusii: Ang’e nase aria yarengeo emegondo y’omonene bw’egesinka keria, erieta riaye Pubilio. Omonto oyo agatoroisia ase omoyo bw’obosani, tokaba abageni baye ase ekero ki’amatuko atato.
swahili: Basi karibu na sehemu ile, palikuwa na shamba kubwa la mtu mmoja kiongozi wa kile kisiwa, aliyeitwa Publio. Alitupokea na akatuhudumia kwa ukarimu mkubwa kwa muda wa siku tatu.

english: The father of Publius was sick in bed, suffering from fever and dysentery. Paul went in to see him, and after praying and placing his hands on him, he healed the man.
ekegusii: Ekaba ng’a ise Publio narenge omonyareku ase esosera na gosaa amanyinga. Paulo agasoa asare akamosabera, akabeeka amaboko aye igoro yaye, akamogwenia.
swahili: Baba yake Publio alikuwa mgonjwa kitandani, akiwa anaumwa homa na kuhara damu. Paulo akaingia ndani ili kumwona na baada ya maombi, akaweka mikono juu yake na kumponya.

english: After this had happened, the rest of the sick on the island came and were cured as well.
ekegusii: Ayio agachia gokoreka, abande ase egesinka keria, abarenge namarwaire, bagacha, bakagwenigwa.
swahili: Jambo hili lilipotukia, watu wote wa kisiwa kile waliokuwa wagonjwa wakaja, nao wakaponywa.

english: When the day of Pentecost came, they were all together in one place.
ekegusii: Ekero rituko ria Pentekosti riaigete, aborokigwa ba Yeso bonsi nigo barenge aase aamo.
swahili: Siku ya Pentekoste ilipowadia, waamini wote walikuwa mahali pamoja.

english: Phrygia and Pamphylia, Egypt and the parts of Libya near Cyrene; visitors from Rome,
ekegusii: Furugia na Pamfulia, Misiri ne chinsemo chia Libia ya Kurene, amo nabageni korwa Rumi,
swahili: Frigia, Pamfilia, Misri na pande za Libya karibu na Kirene na wageni kutoka Rumi,

english: both Jews and converts to Judaism; Cretans and Arabs—we hear them declaring the wonders of God in our own tongues!”
ekegusii: Abayahudi na abanto b’ebisaku binde abaonchogete, Abakirete na Abaarabu, intwe twensi twaigure aba iga bagokwana ase emenwa yaito igoro y’ogokora gwe chinguru kwa Nyasae.”
swahili: Wayahudi na waongofu, Wakrete na Waarabu, sote tunawasikia watu hawa wakisema mambo makuu ya ajabu ya Mungu katika lugha zetu wenyewe.”

english: Astounded and perplexed, they asked one another, “What does this mean?”
ekegusii: Bagakumia bonsi, bagaichana na koborania: “Amang’ana aya, engencho yaye ninki?”
swahili: Wakiwa wameshangaa na kufadhaika wakaulizana, “Ni nini maana ya mambo haya?”

english: But others mocked them and said, “They are drunk on new wine!” Peter Addresses the Crowd (Psalms 16:1–11; Joel 2:28–32)
ekegusii: Abande bagasekereria, bagoteeba: “Nigo batindire nedivai enyia.” Ogokwana gwa Petero ekero gia Pentekosti
swahili: Lakini wengine wakawadhihaki wakasema, “Hawa wamelewa divai!” Petro Ahutubia Umati

english: Then Peter stood up with the Eleven, lifted up his voice, and addressed the crowd: “Men of Judea and all who dwell in Jerusalem, let this be known to you, and listen carefully to my words.
ekegusii: Korende Petero agatenena amo na baria ikomi nomo, agaaka eriogi riaye, akabateebia: “Inwe abasacha ba Boyahudi, na inwe mwensi abamomenyete Yerusalemu, tiga ring’ana eri rimanyekane ase more, tegerera amang’ana aane.
swahili: Ndipo Petro akasimama pamoja na wale mitume kumi na mmoja, akainua sauti yake na kuhutubia ule umati wa watu, akasema: “Wayahudi wenzangu na ninyi nyote mkaao Yerusalemu, jueni jambo hili mkanisikilize.

english: These men are not drunk, as you suppose. It is only the third hour of the day!
ekegusii: Taibo buna mokagete; abanto aba tibatindeti, ekiagera bono nechinsa isato chioka chia mobaso,
swahili: Hakika watu hawa hawakulewa kama mnavyodhania, kwa kuwa sasa ni saa tatu asubuhi!

english: No, this is what was spoken by the prophet Joel:
ekegusii: korende ring’ana eri ndiria riakwanetwe nomobani Yoel:
swahili: La, hili ni jambo lililotabiriwa na nabii Yoeli, akisema:

english: ‘In the last days, God says, I will pour out My Spirit on all people. Your sons and daughters will prophesy, your young men will see visions, your old men will dream dreams.
ekegusii: “Nebe ase amatuko ’omoerio, Omonene oteebire, nimbaiterere abanto bonsi Omoika one, na abana baino, abamura na abaiseke, inababane. Abamura baino nabarore amaroro, na abagaaka baino nabarote chindoto.
swahili: “ ‘Katika siku za mwisho, asema Mungu, nitamimina Roho wangu juu ya wote wenye mwili. Wana wenu na binti zenu watatabiri, vijana wenu wataona maono, na wazee wenu wataota ndoto.

english: Even on My menservants and maidservants I will pour out My Spirit in those days, and they will prophesy.
ekegusii: Naboigo, ase amatuko ayio nimbaiterere abasomba baane, abasacha na abakungu, Omoika one, na barabwo inababane.
swahili: Hata juu ya watumishi wangu, wanaume kwa wanawake, katika siku zile nitamimina Roho wangu, nao watatabiri.

english: I will show wonders in the heavens above and signs on the earth below, blood and fire and billows of smoke.
ekegusii: Ning’orokie amakumia ase igoro, na ebikone ase ense inse, amanyinga na omorero, ne rikundesi ri’erioki.
swahili: Nami nitaonyesha maajabu juu mbinguni, na ishara chini duniani: damu, moto, na mawimbi ya moshi.

english: Suddenly a sound like a mighty rushing wind came from heaven and filled the whole house where they were sitting.
ekegusii: Mobosokano okogusa kogaacha korwa igoro, okogusa buna ogw’ekerambauti gekogusa ne chinguru, kogaichora enyomba yonsi aase baikaransete.
swahili: Ghafula sauti kama mvumo mkubwa wa upepo mkali uliotoka mbinguni ukaijaza nyumba yote walimokuwa wameketi.

english: The sun will be turned to darkness, and the moon to blood, before the coming of the great and glorious Day of the Lord.
ekegusii: Erioba narionchoke ribe omosunte, na omotienyi nobe amanyinga, ekero rituko riria ri’Omonene ritaracha, rituko erire rinene, na erire maiso marore.
swahili: Jua litakuwa giza na mwezi utakuwa mwekundu kama damu, kabla ya kuja siku ile kuu ya Bwana iliyo tukufu.

english: And everyone who calls on the name of the Lord will be saved.’
ekegusii: Naende nebe ng’a kera oyorarangerie erieta ri’Omonene natoorigwe”.
swahili: Na kila mtu atakayeliitia jina la Bwana, ataokolewa.’

english: Men of Israel, listen to this message: Jesus of Nazareth was a man certified by God to you by miracles, wonders, and signs, which God did among you through Him, as you yourselves know.
ekegusii: Inwe abasacha ba Israeli, igwa amang’ana aya, Yeso o Nazareti, omonto o orogetigwe ase more na Nyasae ase ogokora gwe chinguru, na amakumia, na ebikone ebi Nyasae akorete nere egati yaino, buna inwe abanyene momanyete,
swahili: “Enyi Waisraeli, sikilizeni maneno haya nisemayo: Yesu wa Nazareti alikuwa mtu aliyethibitishwa kwenu na Mungu kwa miujiza, maajabu na ishara, ambayo Mungu alitenda miongoni mwenu kupitia kwake, kama ninyi wenyewe mjuavyo.

english: He was delivered up by God’s set plan and foreknowledge, and you, by the hands of the lawless, put Him to death by nailing Him to the cross.
ekegusii: Yeso oyio nigo aruetwe ase amang’ana aroberetigwe na Nyasae, oyo oyamanyete korwa kare, na inwe mokamobamba na komoita ase amaboko ’abaanto batari namachiiko.
swahili: Huyu mtu akiisha kutolewa kwa shauri la Mungu lililokusudiwa kwa kujua kwake Mungu tangu zamani, ninyi, kwa mikono ya watu wabaya, mlimuua kwa kumgongomea msalabani.

english: But God raised Him from the dead, releasing Him from the agony of death, because it was impossible for Him to be held in its clutches.
ekegusii: Korende Omonene akamobokia ekero ororobirie obororo bw’amakweri, ekiagera tare konyarekana abwatwe naro.
swahili: Lakini Mungu alimfufua kutoka kwa wafu akamwondolea uchungu wa mauti, kwa sababu haikuwezekana yeye kushikiliwa na nguvu za mauti.

english: David says about Him: ‘I saw the Lord always before me; because He is at my right hand, I will not be shaken.
ekegusii: Naki igo Daudi agokwana igoro yaye: Naroche Omonene ase obosio bwane botambe, ekiagera nigo are ensemo y’okoboko kwane gw’okorio, erinde tinyoboa.
swahili: Kwa maana Daudi asema kumhusu yeye: “ ‘Nalimwona Bwana mbele yangu daima. Kwa sababu yuko mkono wangu wa kuume, sitatikisika.

english: Therefore my heart is glad and my tongue rejoices; my body also will dwell in hope,
ekegusii: Ase ayio enkoro yane nigo ere nomosasooko, oromeme rwane narogooke; na kobua, omobere one noro notimoke ase ogosemeria,
swahili: Kwa hiyo moyo wangu unafurahia, na ulimi wangu unashangilia; mwili wangu nao utapumzika kwa tumaini.

english: because You will not abandon my soul to Hades, nor will You let Your Holy One see decay.
ekegusii: ekiagera aye togotiga omoyo one agwo aase abakuure, gose togotiga Omochenu oo arore ogosareka.
swahili: Kwa maana hutaniacha kaburini, wala hutamwacha Aliye Mtakatifu wako kuona uharibifu.

english: You have made known to me the paths of life; You will fill me with joy in Your presence.’
ekegusii: Kwanyorokereirie chinchera chi’obogima; nong’ichorie omogooko ase obosio bwao.
swahili: Umenionyesha njia za uzima, utanijaza na furaha mbele zako.’

english: Brothers, I can tell you with confidence that the patriarch David died and was buried, and his tomb is with us to this day.
ekegusii: Abaminto, ninyare gokwana nainwe maiso marore igoro y’omogaka oito o kare, Daudi, ng’a nigo akwete, naende agatindekwa, na embeera yaye nao ere aiga goika reero.
swahili: “Ndugu zangu Waisraeli, nataka niwaambie kwa uhakika kwamba baba yetu Daudi alikufa na kuzikwa, nalo kaburi lake lipo hapa mpaka leo.

english: They saw tongues like flames of fire that separated and came to rest on each of them.
ekegusii: Chimeme buna echi’omorero chikabaorokera, chikabaatananekera, naende chikabaikaransera kera oyomo obo.
swahili: Zikatokea ndimi kama za moto zilizogawanyika na kukaa juu ya kila mmoja wao.

english: But he was a prophet and knew that God had promised him on oath that He would place one of his descendants on his throne.
ekegusii: Ekiagera Daudi arenge omobani, naende amanyete ng’a Nyasae namotianetie ase emuma ng’a ase oroiboro rwaye nabeeke oyomo ase ekerogo kiaye ki’obonene,
swahili: Lakini alikuwa nabii na alijua ya kuwa Mungu alikuwa amemwahidi kwa kiapo kwamba angemweka mmoja wa wazao wake penye kiti chake cha enzi.

english: Foreseeing this, David spoke about the resurrection of the Christ, that He was not abandoned to Hades, nor did His body see decay.
ekegusii: agatang’ana korora aya, agakwana igoro y’okoboka kwaye Kristo, ng’a tagotigwa agwo aase abakuure, nonya nomobere oye tokorora ogosareka.
swahili: Daudi, akiona mambo yaliyoko mbele, akanena juu ya kufufuka kwa Kristo, kwamba hakuachwa kaburini, wala mwili wake haukuona uharibifu.

english: God has raised this Jesus to life, to which we are all witnesses.
ekegusii: Oyo Yeso Nyasae akamobokia na ase aya intwe twensi nigo tore kirori.
swahili: Mungu alimfufua huyu Yesu na sisi sote ni mashahidi wa jambo hilo.

english: Exalted, then, to the right hand of God, He has received from the Father the promised Holy Spirit and has poured out what you now see and hear.
ekegusii: Ase ayio, kaimokererigwe igoro ase ensemo y’okoboko gw’okorio kwa Nyasae, naende kanyorire korwa ase Tata Omoika Omochenu oria arieretwe eira oiteire ayamwarorire na koyaigwa.
swahili: Basi ikiwa yeye ametukuzwa kwa mkono wa kuume wa Mungu, amepokea kutoka kwa Baba ahadi ya Roho Mtakatifu, naye amemimina kile mnachoona sasa na kusikia.

english: For David did not ascend into heaven, but he himself says: ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at My right hand
ekegusii: Ekiagera Daudi tagendete igoro, korende ere omonyenye nigo agoteeba: “Omonene agateebia Omonene one, Ikaransa ensemo y’okoboko kwane gw’okorio,
swahili: Kwa kuwa Daudi hakupaa kwenda mbinguni, lakini anasema, “ ‘ Bwana alimwambia Bwana wangu: “Keti mkono wangu wa kuume,

english: until I make Your enemies a footstool for Your feet.”’
ekegusii: goika mbeke ababisa bao babe inse y’amagoro ao”.
swahili: hadi nitakapowaweka adui zako chini ya miguu yako.” ’

english: Therefore let all Israel know with certainty that God has made this Jesus, whom you crucified, both Lord and Christ!” Three Thousand Believe
ekegusii: Naboigo, tiga enyomba yonsi ya Israeli emanye ekeene ng’a Nyasae obekire Yeso, oyio mwabambete, obeire Omonene naende Kristo.
swahili: “Kwa hiyo Israeli wote na wajue jambo hili kwa uhakika kwamba: Mungu amemfanya huyu Yesu, ambaye ninyi mlimsulubisha, kuwa Bwana na Kristo.” Waumini Waongezeka

english: When the people heard this, they were cut to the heart and asked Peter and the other apostles, “Brothers, what shall we do?”
ekegusii: Ekero bachia koigwa aya, bagasambwa ase chinkoro chiabo, bakabooria Petero na abatomwa bande: “Abaminto, inki torakore?”
swahili: Watu waliposikia maneno haya yakawachoma mioyo yao, wakawauliza Petro na wale mitume wengine, “Ndugu zetu tufanye nini?”

english: Peter replied, “Repent and be baptized, every one of you, in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of your sins, and you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.
ekegusii: Petero akabairaneria: “Onchoka, mobatiswe kera oyomo ase erieta ria Yeso Kristo, monyore okwaberwa kw’ebibe biaino, na inwe inamoegwe ekeegwa ki’Omoika Omochenu.
swahili: Petro akawajibu, “Tubuni, mkabatizwe kila mmoja wenu kwa jina la Yesu Kristo, ili mpate kusamehewa dhambi zenu, nanyi mtapokea kipawa cha Roho Mtakatifu.

english: This promise belongs to you and your children and to all who are far off—to all whom the Lord our God will call to Himself.”
ekegusii: Naki eira eye nigo ere ase more na ase abana baino, na ase abanto bonsi abare aare, na bonsi abarangerigwe n’Omonene nyasae oito.”
swahili: Kwa kuwa ahadi hii ni kwa ajili yenu na watoto wenu, na kwa wote walio mbali, na kila mtu ambaye Bwana Mungu wetu atamwita amjie.”

english: And they were all filled with the Holy Spirit and began to speak in other tongues as the Spirit enabled them.
ekegusii: Bonsi bagaichorwa n’Omoika Omochenu, bagachaaka gokwana ase emenwa emeao, buna Omoika obaete gwatora.
swahili: Wote wakajazwa na Roho Mtakatifu, wakaanza kunena kwa lugha nyingine, kama Roho alivyowajalia.

english: With many other words he testified, and he urged them, “Be saved from this corrupt generation.”
ekegusii: Petero akabaorokeria ase amang’ana ande amange na kobakuurera, ogoteeba: “Etoorie korwa ase ekegori eke getari ekeronge.”
swahili: Petro akawaonya kwa maneno mengine mengi na kuwasihi akisema, “Jiepusheni na kizazi hiki kilichopotoka.”

english: Those who embraced his message were baptized, and about three thousand were added to the believers that day. The Fellowship of Believers (Acts 4:32–37)
ekegusii: Na barabwo abanchete ring’ana riaye bakabatiswa, ne rituko riria bakamentekana abanto koreng’ana chilifu isato.
swahili: Wale wote waliopokea ujumbe wa Petro kwa furaha wakabatizwa na siku ile waliongezeka watu wapatao 3,000. Ushirika Wa Waumini

english: They devoted themselves to the apostles’ teaching and to the fellowship, to the breaking of bread and to prayer.
ekegusii: Barabwo bakagenderera ase okworokereria kw’abatomwa na ase obomo, ase ogosamunyora omogati na ase ogosaba. Obogima bw’ekeombe ki’Abakristo
swahili: Nao wakawa wanadumu katika mafundisho ya mitume, katika ushirika, katika kumega mkate na katika kusali.

english: A sense of awe came over everyone, and the apostles performed many wonders and signs.
ekegusii: Kera omonto agasogwa nomoondoko, na amakumia amange na ebikone bigakorwa nabatomwa.
swahili: Kila mtu akaingiwa na hofu ya Mungu, nayo miujiza mingi na ishara zikafanywa na mitume.

english: All the believers were together and had everything in common.
ekegusii: Na bonsi abeegenete nigo barenge aase aamo, naende bakaba n’ebinto bionsi ase obomo;
swahili: Walioamini wote walikuwa mahali pamoja, nao walikuwa na kila kitu shirika.

english: Selling their possessions and goods, they shared with anyone who was in need.
ekegusii: bakaoonia chinibo chiabo na ebinto ebibarenge nabio, na kobigabera abanto bonsi koreng’ana buna kera oyomo aremeire.
swahili: Waliuza mali zao na vitu walivyokuwa navyo, kila mtu akagawiwa kadiri ya mahitaji yake.

english: With one accord they continued to meet daily in the temple courts and to break bread from house to house, sharing their meals with gladness and sincerity of heart,
ekegusii: Kera rituko bakagenderera gosangererekana amo ase Hekalu ime, bagosamunyora emegati enyomba ase enyomba na koragerera amo ase omogooko na ase chinkoro chi’oboitongo,
swahili: Siku zote kwa moyo mmoja walikutana ndani ya ukumbi wa Hekalu, wakimega mkate nyumba kwa nyumba, wakila chakula chao kwa furaha na moyo mweupe,

english: praising God and enjoying the favor of all the people. And the Lord added to their number daily those who were being saved.
ekegusii: bakomotogia Nyasae na kogwenera abanto bonsi. Omonene akabamentera kera rituko ase okorenta baria barenge gotoorigwa.
swahili: wakimsifu Mungu na kuwapendeza watu wote. Kila siku Bwana akaliongeza kanisa wale waliokuwa wakiokolewa.

english: Now there were dwelling in Jerusalem God-fearing Jews from every nation under heaven.
ekegusii: Mbamenyete Yerusalemu Abayahudi abasigete Nyasae, abanto korwa ase kera egesaku inse y’erioba.
swahili: Basi walikuwepo Yerusalemu Wayahudi wanaomcha Mungu kutoka kila taifa chini ya mbingu.

english: And when this sound rang out, a crowd came together in bewilderment, because each one heard them speaking his own language.
ekegusii: Ekero eriogi eri riaigwetwe, omoganda ogasangererekana amo, okaba nogokumia, ekiagera kera oyomo abaigwete bagokwana ase omonwa oye omonyene.
swahili: Waliposikia sauti hii, umati wa watu ulikusanyika pamoja wakistaajabu, kwa sababu kila mmoja wao aliwasikia wakisema kwa lugha yake mwenyewe.

english: Astounded and amazed, they asked, “Are not all these men who are speaking Galileans?
ekegusii: Bagakumia bonsi na goichana, bagateebania: “Inee! Aba bonsi bagokwana, tibari Abagalili?
swahili: Wakiwa wameshangaa na kustaajabu wakauliza, “Je, hawa wote wanaozungumza si Wagalilaya?

english: How is it then that each of us hears them in his own native language?
ekegusii: Naki yaba iga, intwe toigwete kera egento bagokwana kera oyomo ase omonwa oye aiboretwe noro?
swahili: Imekuwaje basi kila mmoja wetu anawasikia wakinena kwa lugha yake ya kuzaliwa?

english: Parthians, Medes, and Elamites; residents of Mesopotamia, Judea and Cappadocia, Pontus and Asia,
ekegusii: Abapariti, Abamedi na Abaelamiti, na abwo bamenyete Mesopotamia, Boyahudi na Kapadokia, Ponto na Asia,
swahili: Wapathi, Wamedi, Waelami, wakazi wa Mesopotamia, Uyahudi, Kapadokia, Ponto na Asia,

english: One afternoon Peter and John were going up to the temple at the hour of prayer, the ninth hour.
ekegusii: Rituko erimo Petero na Yohana nigo barenge gotiira gochia ase Hekalu chinsa chi’ogosaba, chinsa kianda.
swahili: Siku moja Petro na Yohana walikuwa wanapanda kwenda Hekaluni kusali yapata saa tisa alasiri.

english: they recognized him as the man who used to sit begging at the Beautiful Gate of the temple, and they were filled with wonder and amazement at what had happened to him. Peter Speaks in Solomon’s Colonnade (Deuteronomy 18:15–22)
ekegusii: Bakamomanya ng’a nere oria orenge goikaransa na gosaba ebiegwa aria ase Egesieri Ekiya gie Hekalu. Erio bagaichorwa nogokumia na ogoichana ase amang’ana aria akoregete asare.
swahili: wakamtambua kuwa ni yule mtu aliyekuwa akiketi nje ya Hekalu penye lango liitwalo Zuri akiomba msaada, nao wakajawa na mshangao, wakastaajabu juu ya yale yaliyomtukia. Petro Anashuhudia Kuwa Yesu Anaponya

english: While the man clung to Peter and John, all the people were astonished and ran to them in the walkway called Solomon’s Colonnade.
ekegusii: Ekero are kobwata‐bwata Petero na Yohana, abanto bonsi ase ogokumia bakaminyoka na gosangererekana amo ase bare ase egesona kiare korokwa Egesona gia Sulemani. Ogokwana gwa Petero ase Hekalu ime
swahili: Aliyeponywa alipokuwa akiambatana na Petro na Yohana, watu wote walishangaa mno, wakaja wakiwakimbilia pale ukumbi wa Solomoni.

english: And when Peter saw this, he addressed the people: “Men of Israel, why are you surprised by this? Why do you stare at us as if by our own power or godliness we had made this man walk?
ekegusii: Ekero Petero arora aya akaboria abanto: “Inwe abasacha ba Israeli, inki mogokumeria aya gose nase ki inwe mogotobeta amaiso, ng’a buna intwe ase chinguru chiaito abanyene, gose ase obuya bwaito, twamokora oyo ogenda?
swahili: Petro alipoona watu wamekusanyika akawaambia, “Enyi Waisraeli, kwa nini mnastaajabu kuhusu jambo hili? Mbona mnatukazia macho kwa mshangao kana kwamba ni kwa uwezo wetu au utakatifu wetu tumemfanya mtu huyu kutembea?

english: The God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, the God of our fathers, has glorified His servant Jesus. You handed Him over and rejected Him before Pilate, even though he had decided to release Him.
ekegusii: Nyasae o Aburaamu, na o Isaka, na o Yakobo, Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiaito, oeire Omosomba oye Yeso obonene, ere inwe mokamorua na komwanga ase obosio bwa Pilato, ekero agambete ekiina kiaye ng’a amosibore.
swahili: Mungu wa Abrahamu na Isaki na Yakobo, Mungu wa baba zetu amemtukuza Mwanawe Yesu, ambaye ninyi mlimtoa ahukumiwe kifo na mkamkana mbele ya Pilato, ingawa yeye alikuwa ameamua kumwachia aende zake.

english: You rejected the Holy and Righteous One and asked that a murderer be released to you.
ekegusii: Korende mokamwanga oria Omochenu, Omonyene Oboronge, na mokaboria moegwe omoiti.
swahili: Ninyi mlimkataa huyo Mtakatifu na Mwenye Haki mkaomba mpewe yule muuaji.

english: You killed the Author of life, but God raised Him from the dead, and we are witnesses of the fact.
ekegusii: Mogaita Omotongi bw’obogima. Korende Nyasae akamobokia korwa ase abakuure, na ase ayio intwe nigo tore kirori.
swahili: Hivyo mkamuua aliye chanzo cha uzima, lakini Mungu akamfufua kutoka kwa wafu. Sisi tu mashahidi wa mambo haya.

english: By faith in the name of Jesus, this man whom you see and know has been made strong. It is Jesus’ name and the faith that comes through Him that has given him this complete healing in your presence.
ekegusii: Na ase okwegena kw’erieta riaye, erieta riaye riamobekire chinguru omonto oyo mwarorire aiga na komomanya; na okwegena koria kore ase enchera ya Yeso kwamonyoreire obogima oboikeranu, buna mwarorire mwensi.
swahili: Kwa imani katika jina la Yesu, huyu mtu mnayemwona na kumfahamu ametiwa nguvu. Ni kwa jina la Yesu na imani itokayo kwake ambayo imemponya kabisa huyu mtu, kama ninyi wote mnavyoona.

english: And now, brothers, I know that you acted in ignorance, as did your leaders.
ekegusii: “Na bono baminto, namanyire ng’a nigo mwakorete aya ase ogotamanya kwaino, buna abanene baino bakorete.
swahili: “Sasa ndugu zangu, najua ya kuwa ninyi mlitenda bila kujua, kama walivyofanya viongozi wenu.

english: But in this way God has fulfilled what He foretold through all the prophets, saying that His Christ would suffer.
ekegusii: Korende Nyasae agaikereania amang’ana aya akwanete ase emenwa y’ababani bonsi, ng’a Kristo Omwana oye nachandwe, oyio oyaikeranirie ase enchera eye.
swahili: Lakini kwa njia hii Mungu alitimiza kile ambacho alikuwa ametabiri kwa vinywa vya manabii wake wote, kwamba Kristo atateswa.

english: Repent, then, and turn back, so that your sins may be wiped away,
ekegusii: Ase ayio onchoka, moirane, erinde ebibe biaino bitinyigwe, erio chingaki chi’ogotimokigwa chinyare gocha korwa ase obosio bw’Omonene,
swahili: Tubuni basi mkamgeukie Mungu, dhambi zenu zifutwe, ili zipate kuja nyakati za kuburudishwa kwa kuwepo kwake Bwana,

english: And a man who was lame from birth was being carried to the temple gate called Beautiful, where he was put every day to beg from those entering the temple courts.
ekegusii: Na omonto oyomo, orenge rigata korwa okoiborwa kwaye, ore kobogorigwa n’abanto na kobeekwa kera rituko ase egesieri gie Hekalu kiare korokwa Egesieri Ekiya, erinde asabe ebiegwa ase abwo baare gosoa ase Hekalu.
swahili: Basi palikuwa na mtu mmoja aliyekuwa kiwete tangu kuzaliwa. Alichukuliwa na kuwekwa kwenye lango la Hekalu liitwalo Zuri, kila siku ili aombe msaada kwa watu wanaoingia Hekaluni.
