english: that times of refreshing may come from the presence of the Lord, and that He may send Jesus, the Christ, who has been appointed for you.
ekegusii: anyare gotoma Yeso, oria mwarageretwe korwa kare, nere Kristo.
swahili: naye apate kumtuma Kristo, ambaye ameteuliwa kwa ajili yenu, yaani Yesu.

english: Heaven must take Him in until the time comes for the restoration of all things, which God announced long ago through His holy prophets.
ekegusii: Ere igoro yagwenerete komonyoora, goika chichiche chingaki chi’ebinto bionsi bigokorwa ebiyia, ebiakwanetwe na Nyasae ase emenwa y’ababani baaye abachenu korwa kare.
swahili: Ilimpasa mbingu zimpokee mpaka wakati wa kufanywa upya kila kitu, kama Mungu alivyoahidi zamani kupitia kwa vinywa vya manabii wake watakatifu.

english: For Moses said, ‘The Lord your God will raise up for you a prophet like me from among your brothers. You must listen to Him in everything He tells you.
ekegusii: Musa nateebete: Omonene Nyasae oino nabatomere omobani buna antomete korwa ase egati y’abamino. Momoigwere ase amang’ana onsi arabateebie.
swahili: Kwa maana Mose alisema, ‘Bwana Mungu wenu atawainulia nabii kama mimi kutoka miongoni mwa ndugu zenu. Itawapasa kumtii huyo kwa kila jambo atakalowaambia.

english: Everyone who does not listen to Him will be completely cut off from among his people. ’
ekegusii: Naende nebe ng’a kera omonto otaigwereti omobani oyio nigo arasirigwe na gwatananwa korwa ase egati y’abanto ba Nyasae.
swahili: Mtu yeyote ambaye hatamsikiliza huyo nabii, atatupiliwa mbali kabisa na watu wake.’

english: Indeed, all the prophets from Samuel on, as many as have spoken, have proclaimed these days.
ekegusii: Na ababani bonsi abakwanete korwa Samweli, na baria bachete korwa magega yaye, bakararia igoro yaria agokoreka ase amatuko aya.
swahili: “Naam, manabii wote tangu Samweli na waliokuja baada yake, wote walitabiri kuhusu siku hizi.

english: And you are sons of the prophets and of the covenant God made with your fathers when He said to Abraham, ‘Through your offspring all the families of the earth will be blessed.’
ekegusii: Inwe nigo more oroiboro rw’echiira chiria Nyasae akorete goetera ase ababani baye gocha ase more naende nigo more abasangi ase okobwatana koria Nyasae akorete ne chisokoro chiaino, ekero ateebetie Aburaamu: Ase oroiboro rwao ebisaku bionsi bi’ense inabisesenigwe.
swahili: Ninyi ndio wana wa manabii na wa Agano ambalo Mungu alifanya na baba zenu, akimwambia Abrahamu, ‘Kupitia kwa uzao wako, watu wote wa ulimwengu watabarikiwa.’

english: When God raised up His Servant, He sent Him first to you to bless you by turning each of you from your wicked ways.”
ekegusii: Ekero Nyasae abogetie Omosomba oye, akamotoma ase more ritang’ani, erinde abasesenie ase ogwatanana kera oyomo oino korwa ase obobe bwaye.”
swahili: Mungu alipomfufua Yesu Mwanawe, alimtuma kwenu kwanza, ili awabariki kwa kumgeuza kila mmoja wenu kutoka njia yake mbaya.”

english: When he saw Peter and John about to enter, he asked them for money.
ekegusii: Omonto oyio agachia korora Petero na Yohana kobagosoa Hekalu ime, agasaba bamoe ebiegwa.
swahili: Huyu mtu alipowaona Petro na Yohana wakikaribia kuingia Hekaluni, akawaomba wampe sadaka.

english: Peter looked directly at him, as did John. “Look at us!” said Peter.
ekegusii: Petero akamobeta amaiso, amo na Yohana, akabora: “Torigererie intwe!”
swahili: Wakamkazia macho, kisha Petro akamwambia, “Tutazame sisi.”

english: So the man gave them his attention, expecting to receive something from them.
ekegusii: Akabarigereria, osemeretie ng’a naegwe egento korwa ase bare.
swahili: Hivyo yule mtu akawatazama, akitazamia kupata kitu kutoka kwao.

english: But Peter said, “Silver or gold I do not have, but what I have I give you: In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, get up and walk! ”
ekegusii: Korende Petero akamoteebia: “Efeta timbwati, nonya netaabu, korende eki mbwate nakio ngokoa: Ase erieta ria Yeso Kristo o Nazareti, tenena ogende!”
swahili: Ndipo Petro akamwambia, “Sina fedha wala dhahabu, lakini nilicho nacho ndicho nikupacho. Kwa jina la Yesu Kristo wa Nazareti, tembea!”

english: Taking him by the right hand, Peter helped him up, and at once the man’s feet and ankles were made strong.
ekegusii: Akamobwata okoboko gw’okorio, akamoimokia igoro. Erio kegima amagoro aye ne chinengo chi’amagoro aye bikanyora chinguru.
swahili: Petro akamshika yule mtu kwa mkono wa kuume akamwinua, mara nyayo zake na vifundo vya miguu yake vikapata nguvu.

english: He sprang to his feet and began to walk. Then he went with them into the temple courts, walking and leaping and praising God.
ekegusii: Akaimoka bwango, agatenena, agachaaka kogenda, agasoa Hekalu ime amo nabarabwo, ogotaara na gotuma‐tuma, na komotogia Nyasae.
swahili: Akaruka juu na kusimama, akaanza kutembea. Kisha akaingia Hekaluni pamoja na Petro na Yohana, huku akitembea na kurukaruka na kumsifu Mungu.

english: When all the people saw him walking and praising God,
ekegusii: Abanto bonsi bakamorora ogotaara na komotogia Nyasae.
swahili: Watu wote walipomwona akitembea na kumsifu Mungu,

english: While Peter and John were speaking to the people, the priests and the captain of the temple guard and the Sadducees came up to them,
ekegusii: Ekero barenge gokwana n’abanto, abakuani abanene, na omonene bw’abarendi be Hekalu, na Abasadukai bagaacha.
swahili: Wakati Petro na Yohana walipokuwa wakisema na watu, makuhani, mkuu wa walinzi wa Hekalu na Masadukayo wakawajia,

english: then let this be known to all of you and to all the people of Israel: It is by the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, whom you crucified but whom God raised from the dead, that this man stands before you healed.
ekegusii: tiga emanyekane ase more mwensi, amo nase abanto bonsi ba Israeli, buna omonto oyo nigo ateneine bosio bwaino ore omogima kegima ase chinguru chi’erieta ria Yeso Kristo omo Nazareti—oria inwe mwabambete, nere oyio Nyasae abogetie korwa ase abakuure.
swahili: ijulikane kwenu nyote na kwa watu wote wa Israeli kwamba: Ni kwa jina la Yesu Kristo wa Nazareti, ambaye ninyi mlimsulubisha lakini Mungu akamfufua kutoka kwa wafu, kwa jina hilo mtu huyu anasimama mbele yenu akiwa mzima kabisa.

english: This Jesus is ‘the stone you builders rejected, which has become the cornerstone.’
ekegusii: Yeso nere oyio amariiko agokwanera iga rigena riria inwe abaagachi mwachaayete riaonchokire koba rigena riengencho enene kobua onsi.
swahili: Huyu ndiye “ ‘jiwe ambalo ninyi wajenzi mlilikataa, ambalo limekuwa jiwe kuu la pembeni.’

english: Salvation exists in no one else, for there is no other name under heaven given to men by which we must be saved.” The Name Forbidden
ekegusii: Ogotoreka nigo gokonyorekana ase are ere bweka; nase ase ense engima onde taiyo naende oyio Nyasae aruure oranyare gototoria.
swahili: Wala hakuna wokovu katika mwingine awaye yote, kwa maana hakuna jina jingine chini ya mbingu walilopewa wanadamu litupasalo sisi kuokolewa kwalo.” Ujasiri Wa Petro Na Yohana Washangaza Watu

english: When they saw the boldness of Peter and John and realized that they were unschooled, ordinary men, they marveled and took note that these men had been with Jesus.
ekegusii: Abagaaka b’ekegambero bakegosa mono korora buna Petero na Yohana batenenete ase oboremu na boigo kwemanyia buna barabwo n’abanto batachiete ande kemasomo. Erio barabwo bakamanya ng’a Petero na Yohana noo barenge amo na Yeso ase orogendo rwaye.
swahili: Wale viongozi na wazee walipoona ujasiri wa Petro na Yohana na kujua ya kuwa walikuwa watu wa kawaida, wasio na elimu, walishangaa sana, wakatambua kwamba hawa watu walikuwa na Yesu.

english: And seeing the man who had been healed standing there with them, they had nothing to say in response.
ekegusii: Ekero bachia korora omonto oria ogwenetigwe, oteneine amo nabarabwo, tibaaba na ing’ana rinde rionsi bagokwana.
swahili: Lakini kwa kuwa walikuwa wanamwona yule kiwete aliyeponywa amesimama pale pamoja nao, hawakuweza kusema lolote kuwapinga.

english: So they ordered them to leave the Sanhedrin and then conferred together.
ekegusii: Bakabachiika basoke korwa ase ekegambero, erio bagachaaka gokwana barabwo ase barabwo.
swahili: Wakawaamuru watoke nje ya Baraza la Wayahudi wakati wakisemezana jambo hilo wao kwa wao.

english: “What shall we do with these men?” they asked. “It is clear to everyone living in Jerusalem that a remarkable miracle has occurred through them, and we cannot deny it.
ekegusii: Bagoteeba: “Inki torakorere abanto aba? Ekiagera egekone eke giakorirwe nabarabwo kere maiso marore ase abanto bonsi abamenyete Yerusalemu, titokonyara kogekaana.
swahili: Wakaulizana, “Tuwafanyie nini watu hawa? Hatuwezi kukanusha muujiza huu mkubwa walioufanya ambao ni dhahiri kwa kila mtu Yerusalemu.

english: But to keep this message from spreading any further among the people, we must warn them not to speak to anyone in this name.”
ekegusii: Korende gokiria ring’ana eri tiricha gosiarerwa egati y’abanto; tiga tobagose, tibakwana na monto onde bwensi ase erieta ria Yeso.”
swahili: Lakini ili kuzuia jambo hili lisiendelee kuenea zaidi kwa watu, ni lazima tuwaonye watu hawa ili wasiseme tena na mtu yeyote kwa jina la Yesu.”

english: Then they called them in again and commanded them not to speak or teach at all in the name of Jesus.
ekegusii: Bakabarangeria, bakabatianera tibaabaisa gokwana gose kworokereria ase erieta ria Yeso.
swahili: Kisha wakawaita tena ndani na kuwaamuru wasiseme wala kufundisha kamwe kwa hili jina la Yesu. Imetupasa Kumtii Mungu Kuliko Wanadamu

english: But Peter and John replied, “Judge for yourselves whether it is right in God’s sight to listen to you rather than God.
ekegusii: Korende Petero na Yohana bakabairaneria: “nacha inwe abanyene ndiriri rironge ase obosio bwa Nyasae—-kobaigwera inwe gose komoigwera Nyasae.
swahili: Lakini Petro na Yohana wakajibu, “Amueni ninyi wenyewe iwapo ni haki mbele za Mungu kuwatii ninyi kuliko kumtii Mungu.

english: greatly disturbed that they were teaching the people and proclaiming in Jesus the resurrection of the dead.
ekegusii: Bakabea ase engencho abatomwa abwo babere nigo bare kworokereria abanto ng’a Yeso nabogete korwa ase abakuure, eyio ekworokia ng’a abanto bakuure mbabokigwe babe moyo.
swahili: huku wakiwa wamekasirika sana kwa sababu mitume walikuwa wanawafundisha watu na kuhubiri kwamba kuna ufufuo wa wafu ndani ya Yesu.

english: For we cannot stop speaking about what we have seen and heard.”
ekegusii: Ekiagera intwe titokonyara gotiga gokwana ayatweroreire na kweigwera.”
swahili: Lakini sisi hatuwezi kuacha kusema yale tuliyoyaona na kuyasikia.”

english: After further threats they let them go. They could not find a way to punish them, because all the people were glorifying God for what had happened.
ekegusii: Erio ekegambero gekabatianera n’echinguru erio bakabaigorera bagende. Barobwo bakanyora buna tekonyarekana babae egesusuro ekiagera abanto bonsi nigo bagendererete gotogia Nyasae ase ogokora koria kwabete.
swahili: Baada ya vitisho vingi, wakawaacha waende zao. Hawakuona njia yoyote ya kuwaadhibu, kwa sababu ya watu, kwa kuwa watu wote walikuwa wakimsifu Mungu kwa kile kilichokuwa kimetukia.

english: For the man who was miraculously healed was over forty years old. The Believers’ Prayer (Psalms 2:1–12)
ekegusii: Emiaka y’omonto oria egekone eke giokogwenigwa kiaberete nigo yarenge goetania emerongo ene. Abeegeni Bagasaba baegwe oboremu
swahili: Kwa kuwa umri wa yule mtu aliyekuwa ameponywa kwa muujiza ulikuwa zaidi ya miaka arobaini. Maombi Ya Waumini

english: On their release, Peter and John returned to their own people and reported everything that the chief priests and elders had said to them.
ekegusii: Erio kegima ekero Petero na Yohana baigoreretwe, barabwo bakairana goika ase omoganda erio bakabateebia aria abakuani abanene na abagaaka baabateebetie.
swahili: Punde Petro na Yohana walipoachiliwa, walirudi kwa waumini wenzao wakawaeleza waliyoambiwa na viongozi wa makuhani na wazee.

english: When the believers heard this, they lifted up their voices to God with one accord. “Sovereign Lord,” they said, “You made the heaven and the earth and the sea and everything in them.
ekegusii: Ekero abegeeni baigwete ayio, bakaba amo ase ogosaba Nyasae bakobora: Omonene na omotongi o igoro n’ense n’enyancha, na bionsi ebigotoka imeo!
swahili: Watu waliposikia hayo, wakainua sauti zao, wakamwomba Mungu kwa pamoja, wakisema, “Bwana Mwenyezi, uliyeziumba mbingu na nchi na bahari, na vitu vyote vilivyomo.

english: You spoke by the Holy Spirit through the mouth of Your servant, our father David: ‘Why do the nations rage and the peoples plot in vain?
ekegusii: Naye gwakwanete n’Omoika Omochenu goetera ase omonwa o sokoro yaito Daudi, omosomba oo, ekero atebeete Nase ki abanto b’ebisaku bakorete rirorooche, inki gekogera abanto baroberetie emeroberio ere bosa?
swahili: Wewe ulisema kwa Roho Mtakatifu kupitia kwa kinywa cha baba yetu Daudi, mtumishi wako, ukasema: “ ‘Mbona mataifa wanaghadhibika, na kabila za watu zinawaza ubatili?

english: The kings of the earth take their stand and the rulers gather together against the Lord and against His Anointed One.’
ekegusii: Abarwoti b’ense bakebeeka ang’e, na abagaambi nigo baumeranete amo erio barwanie Omonene amo na Kristo oye.
swahili: Wafalme wa dunia wamejipanga, na watawala wanakusanyika pamoja dhidi ya Bwana na dhidi ya Mpakwa Mafuta wake.’

english: In fact, this is the very city where Herod and Pontius Pilate conspired with the Gentiles and the people of Israel against Your holy servant Jesus, whom You anointed.
ekegusii: Ekiagera ekeene Herode na Pontio Pilato nigo baumeranete ase omochie omonene amo n’abanto b’Ebisaku, na Abaisraeli boigo mamaincha ya Yeso Omosomba oo omochenu oyo gwakorete koba Kristo.
swahili: Ni kweli Herode na Pontio Pilato pamoja na watu wa Mataifa na Waisraeli, walikusanyika katika mji huu dhidi ya mwanao mtakatifu Yesu uliyemtia mafuta.

english: They carried out what Your hand and will had decided beforehand would happen.
ekegusii: Barobwo bakaumerana gokora kera ring’ana erio goetera ase chinguru amo n’ogwancha kwao kwaroberetie korwa omochakano anyare koba.
swahili: Wao wakafanya yale ambayo uweza wako na mapenzi yako yalikuwa yamekusudia yatokee tangu zamani.

english: And now, Lord, consider their threats, and enable Your servants to speak Your word with complete boldness,
ekegusii: Ase igo bono, aye Omonene, rora ogotianerwa okwo kwabeire, erio aye otwanchere, intwe abasomba bao tokwane ring’ana riao n’oboremu bwonsi.
swahili: Sasa, Bwana angalia vitisho vyao na utuwezeshe sisi watumishi wako kulinena neno lako kwa ujasiri mkuu.

english: They seized Peter and John, and because it was evening, they put them in custody until the next day.
ekegusii: Barabwo bakababwata, bakababeeka echela ime goika rituko riare kobwatia ekiagera konya riagorobire.
swahili: Wakawakamata Petro na Yohana na kuwatia gerezani mpaka kesho yake kwa kuwa ilikuwa jioni.

english: as You stretch out Your hand to heal and perform signs and wonders through the name of Your holy servant Jesus.”
ekegusii: Rambora okoboko kwao, naende ancha buna ebikone binyare gokorekana goetera ase erieta ri’Omosomba oo omochenu, Yeso.
swahili: Nyoosha mkono wako ili kuponya wagonjwa na kutenda ishara na miujiza kwa jina la Mwanao mtakatifu Yesu.”

english: After they had prayed, their meeting place was shaken, and they were all filled with the Holy Spirit and spoke the word of God boldly. Sharing among Believers (Acts 2:42–47)
ekegusii: Ekero barabwo bakorete gosaba ase agwo barabwo basangerekanete agatengechigwa. Barobwo bonsi bagaichorwa n’Omoika Omochenu na boigo bagachaaka gokwana ring’ana ria Nyasae noboremu. Abegeeni bagosanga ebire ebiabo
swahili: Walipokwisha kuomba, mahali walipokuwa wamekutanika pakatikiswa, wote wakajazwa na Roho Mtakatifu, wakanena neno la Mungu kwa ujasiri. Walioamini Washirikiana Mali Zao

english: The multitude of believers was one in heart and soul. No one claimed that any of his possessions was his own, but they shared everything they owned.
ekegusii: Omoganda bwabegeeni nigo obwataine ase ebirengererio na ase chinkoro. Tari nonya n’oyomo ase egati yabo orenge gokwana buna kende gionsi abwate ere omonyene n’ekiaye, korende nigo babete bagosanga ase oboamo kera ekemo ekio babwate.
swahili: Wale walioamini wote walikuwa na moyo mmoja na nia moja. Wala hakuna hata mmoja aliyesema chochote alichokuwa nacho ni mali yake mwenyewe, lakini walishirikiana kila kitu walichokuwa nacho.

english: With great power the apostles continued to give their testimony about the resurrection of the Lord Jesus. And abundant grace was upon them all.
ekegusii: Abatomwa bakagenderera koba kirori igoro y’okoboka kwa Yeso Kristo na Omonene akabaitororera bonsi obotenenku bw’ogosesenigwa kwaye.
swahili: Mitume wakatoa ushuhuda wa kufufuka kwa Bwana Yesu kwa nguvu nyingi na neema ya Mungu ilikuwa juu yao wote.

english: There were no needy ones among them, because those who owned lands or houses would sell their property, bring the proceeds from the sales,
ekegusii: Na monto onde tarenge ase egati yabo oyorenge nokoremerwa, ekiagera abanto bonsi abarenge nemegondo ne chinyomba nigo babioonetie, bakarenta chitaabu chi’ebinto biria biaoonetigwe,
swahili: Wala hapakuwepo mtu yeyote miongoni mwao aliyekuwa mhitaji, kwa sababu mara kwa mara wale waliokuwa na mashamba na nyumba waliviuza, wakaleta thamani ya vitu vilivyouzwa,

english: and lay them at the apostles’ feet for distribution to anyone as he had need.
ekegusii: bagachibeeka ase amagoro ’abatomwa; na kera omonto akagaberwa koreng’ana buna aremeire.
swahili: wakaiweka miguuni pa mitume, kila mtu akagawiwa kadiri ya mahitaji yake.

english: Joseph, a Levite from Cyprus, whom the apostles called Barnabas (meaning Son of Encouragement),
ekegusii: Na Yusufu ore korokwa nabatomwa Barnaba (engencho yaye: “Omwana bw’Oboremia”), Omolawi, omonto o Kuporo,
swahili: Yosefu, Mlawi kutoka Kipro, ambaye mitume walimwita Barnaba (maana yake Mwana wa Faraja),

english: sold a field he owned, brought the money, and laid it at the apostles’ feet.
ekegusii: akaonia omogondo oye, akarenta chitaabu, agachibeeka ase amagoro yabatomwa.
swahili: aliuza shamba alilokuwa nalo, akaleta hizo fedha alizopata na kuziweka miguuni pa mitume.

english: But many who heard the message believed, and the number of men grew to about five thousand.
ekegusii: Korende abange ase abwo abaigwete amang’ana aya bakeegena; na omobaro bw’abasaacha nigo obete koreng’ana chilifu isano.
swahili: Lakini wengi waliosikia lile neno waliamini, idadi yao ilikuwa yapata wanaume 5,000.

english: The next day the rulers, elders, and scribes assembled in Jerusalem,
ekegusii: Ekero bwachia gokia rituko riare kobwatia, abarai ba Abayahudi, abanene, amo n’Aborokia b’amachiiko bagasangererekana ime ya Yerusalemu.
swahili: Kesho yake, viongozi wa Kiyahudi, wazee na walimu wa sheria wakakusanyika Yerusalemu.

english: along with Annas the high priest, Caiaphas, John, Alexander, and many others from the high priest’s family.
ekegusii: Barobwo bakaumerana na Anasi Omokuani omonene, na Kayafa, na Yohana, na Alekisanda, na bonsi abarenge b’eamate y’Omokuani omonene.
swahili: Walikuwepo kuhani mkuu Anasi, Kayafa, Yohana, Iskanda, na wengi wa jamaa ya kuhani mkuu.

english: They had Peter and John brought in and began to question them: “By what power or what name did you do this?”
ekegusii: Bakababeka abatomwa batenene ase obosio bwabo, erio bakababoria “’ngaki mwanyara gokora aya? Ase kobua ki gose nase erieta riango mwarangeria?”
swahili: Baada ya kuwasimamisha Petro na Yohana katikati yao, wakawauliza, “Ni kwa uwezo gani au kwa jina la nani mmefanya jambo hili?”

english: Then Peter, filled with the Holy Spirit, said to them, “Rulers and elders of the people!
ekegusii: Erio Petero oichire n’Omoika Omochenu, akabateebia: Abaanene b’abaanto, na abagaaka,
swahili: Petro, akiwa amejaa Roho Mtakatifu, akajibu, “Enyi watawala na wazee wa watu,

english: If we are being examined today about a kind service to a man who was lame, to determine how he was healed,
ekegusii: onye intwe tokoborigwa reero iga ase ogokora okuya gwakorekana ase omonto oyo ekerema naende ng’aki abwenigwa,
swahili: kama leo tukihojiwa kwa habari ya mambo mema aliyotendewa yule kiwete na kuulizwa jinsi alivyoponywa,

english: Now a man named Ananias, together with his wife Sapphira, also sold a piece of property.
ekegusii: Korende narenge omosacha oyomo ore korokwa Anania, oyio amo na mokaye Sabira baoonetie ensemo y’omogondo obo.
swahili: Lakini mtu mmoja jina lake Anania pamoja na mkewe Safira waliuza kiwanja.

english: At that instant she fell down at his feet and died. Then the young men came in and, finding her dead, carried her out and buried her beside her husband.
ekegusii: Erio kegima akagwa ase amagoro aye, agakwa. Abamura baria bagasoa, bakamonyora okuure. Erio bakamobogoria gochia isiko, bakamotindeka ase omosacha oye ensemo.
swahili: Saa ile ile akaanguka chini miguuni mwake na kufa. Nao wale vijana wakaingia, wakamkuta amekufa, wakamchukua wakamzika kando ya mumewe.

english: And great fear came over the whole church and all who heard about these events. The Apostles Heal Many
ekegusii: Omoondoko omonene okabwata ekanisa yonsi na abanto bonsi abaigwete aya. Ebikone na amakumia
swahili: Hofu kuu ikalipata kanisa lote pamoja na watu wote waliosikia juu ya matukio haya. Mitume Waponya Wengi

english: The apostles performed many signs and wonders among the people, and with one accord the believers gathered together in Solomon’s Colonnade.
ekegusii: Ebikone ebinge na amakumia bikagenderera gokoreka ase egati y’abanto amo n’abatomwa. Ebegeeni bonsi bagasangererekana amo ase Egesona gia Sulemani.
swahili: Mitume wakafanya ishara nyingi na miujiza miongoni mwa watu. Walioamini wote walikuwa wakikusanyika katika ukumbi wa Solomoni.

english: Although the people regarded them highly, no one else dared to join them.
ekegusii: Onde tarenge korwa isiko obete noboremu kobwatana nabarabwo, korende abanto bakabasika ogosika okonene.
swahili: Hakuna mtu mwingine aliyethubutu kuambatana nao ijapokuwa waliheshimiwa sana na watu.

english: Yet more and more believers were brought to the Lord—large numbers of both men and women.
ekegusii: Korende abanto abange bakamentwa ase abegeeni omoganda omonene bw’abasacha na’abakuungu abwo begenete omonene.
swahili: Hata hivyo, waliomwamini Bwana wakazidi kuongezeka, wanaume na wanawake.

english: As a result, people brought the sick into the streets and laid them on cots and mats, so that at least Peter’s shadow might fall on some of them as he passed by.
ekegusii: Goetera ase emeremo eye abatomwa bare gokora, abarwaire nigo barenge kobogorigwa isiko ase amarere n’ebisero biabo erinde ekero Petero agoeta, omorengari oye okune abande b’abwo.
swahili: Hata wakawa wanawaleta wagonjwa na kuwalaza kwenye magodoro na kwenye vitanda barabarani ili yamkini Petro akipita kivuli chake kiwaguse baadhi yao.

english: Crowds also gathered from the towns around Jerusalem, bringing the sick and those tormented by unclean spirits, and all of them were healed. The Apostles Arrested and Freed
ekegusii: Nonya n’abanto korwa ase emechie eria yaetanaine Yerusalemu bagesangereria, bakarenta abarwaire amo nabwo babwatire nebirecha bi’eubi, na bonsi bakagwenigwa. Abatomwa bagochandwa
swahili: Pia watu wakakusanyika kutoka miji iliyokuwa karibu na Yerusalemu, wakileta wagonjwa na watu walioteswa na pepo wachafu. Hao wote wakaponywa. Mitume Washtakiwa

english: Then the high priest and all his associates, who belonged to the party of the Sadducees, were filled with jealousy. They went out
ekegusii: Omokuani omonene akaimoka, na bonsi abarenge amo nere; abwo nabwo barenge b’Abasadukai. Bagaichorwa ne ribero rinene ase Abatomwa ase igo bakaroberia kobaimokeria egetambokero.
swahili: Kisha kuhani mkuu na wenzake wote waliokuwa pamoja naye, waliokuwa wa kundi la Masadukayo, wakajawa na wivu.

english: and arrested the apostles and put them in the public jail.
ekegusii: Bakabwata abatomwa, bakababeeka ime ase echela y’abanto bonsi ime.
swahili: Wakawakamata mitume na kuwatia gerezani.

english: But during the night an angel of the Lord opened the doors of the jail and brought them out, saying,
ekegusii: Korende ase obotuko boria omomalaika bw’Omonene akaigora ebisieri bi’echela, akabasokia isiko, erio akabateebia,
swahili: Lakini wakati wa usiku, malaika wa Bwana akaja, akafungua milango ya gereza na akawatoa nje. Akawaambia,

english: With his wife’s full knowledge, he kept back some of the proceeds for himself, but brought a portion and laid it at the apostles’ feet.
ekegusii: Korende ere ase ogwancherana na mokaye akabisa ensemo ye chitaabu echio baonetie, erio akaa abatomwa ensemo eria yatigarete.
swahili: Huku mkewe akijua kikamilifu, Anania alificha sehemu ya fedha alizopata, akaleta kiasi kilichobaki na kukiweka miguuni pa mitume.

english: “Go, stand in the temple courts and tell the people the full message of this new life.”
ekegusii: “Genda, motenene ase Hekalu ime, moteebie abanto bonsi amang’ana onsi igoro y’Obogima obo oboyia.”
swahili: “Nendeni, mkasimame Hekaluni mkawaambie watu maneno yote ya uzima huu mpya.”

english: At daybreak the apostles entered the temple courts as they had been told and began to teach the people. When the high priest and his associates arrived, they convened the Sanhedrin —the full assembly of the elders of Israel—and sent to the jail for the apostles.
ekegusii: Abatomwa bakaigwera, mambia kobogokiamoka bagasoa Hekalu ime bagachaaka kworokereria. Omokuani omonene n’ababwatani baye bakarangeria abanene b’Abayahudi goika ase omosangererekano goika ase ekegambero ki’abaanto bonsi; erio bagatoma ogochika gochia ase echela erinde barente abatomwa baria ase ekegambero.
swahili: Waliposikia haya wakaenda Hekaluni alfajiri wakaendelea kufundisha watu. Kuhani mkuu na wale waliokuwa pamoja nao walipowasili, alikusanya baraza na wazee wote wa Israeli wakatuma wale mitume waletwe kutoka gerezani.

english: But on arriving at the jail, the officers did not find them there. So they returned with the report:
ekegusii: Korende ekero abarendi bachia goika, tibaabanyora echela ime. Bakairana, bagateeba,
swahili: Lakini wale walinzi wa Hekalu walipokwenda gerezani hawakuwakuta mitume mle. Kwa hiyo wakarudi na kutoa habari.

english: “We found the jail securely locked, with the guards posted at the doors; but when we opened them, we found no one inside.” The Apostles before the Sanhedrin
ekegusii: “Echela nigo twayenyora esiekire buya kegima, na abarendi bateneine bisieri, korende twachia koigora ebiita titwanyora monto onde ime.”
swahili: Wakasema, “Tumekuta milango ya gereza imefungwa sawasawa na askari wa gereza wamesimama nje ya mlango, lakini tulipofungua milango hakuwepo mtu yeyote ndani.”

english: When the captain of the temple guard and the chief priests heard this account, they were perplexed as to what was happening.
ekegusii: Na ekero omonene bw’abarendi be Hekalu na abakuani abanene bachia koigwa amang’ana aya, bagasogwa nomoichano omonene ase engencho yabo, naki arabe amang’ana aya.
swahili: Basi mkuu wa walinzi wa Hekalu na viongozi wa makuhani waliposikia haya, wakafadhaika na kushangaa sana kwa ajili yao kwamba jambo hili litakuwaje.

english: Then someone came in and announced, “Look, the men you put in jail are standing in the temple courts teaching the people!”
ekegusii: Omonto oyomo agaacha, akabateebia: “Rora, abanto baria mwabeegete echela ime nigo bateneine ase Hekalu ime kworokereria abanto.”
swahili: Ndipo mtu mmoja akaja akawaambia, “Tazameni watu mliowatia gerezani wako Hekaluni wakiwafundisha watu.”

english: At that point, the captain went with the officers and brought the apostles—but not by force, for fear the people would stone them.
ekegusii: Erio omonene bw’abarendi akagenda amo n’abanto baaye, bakabarenta, korende tari ase chinguru, ekiagera barenge nobwoba ng’a mbaakwe amagena n’abanto.
swahili: Ndipo yule mkuu wa walinzi wa Hekalu wakaenda pamoja na askari wakawaleta wale mitume, lakini bila ghasia kwa sababu waliogopa kupigwa mawe na watu.

english: They brought them in and made them stand before the Sanhedrin, where the high priest interrogated them.
ekegusii: Ekero baabarentire bakababeeka ase ekegambero. Omokuani omonene akababoria,
swahili: Wakiisha kuwaleta mitume wakawaamuru kusimama mbele ya baraza ili kuhani mkuu awahoji.

english: “We gave you strict orders not to teach in this name,” he said. “Yet you have filled Jerusalem with your teaching and are determined to make us responsible for this man’s blood.”
ekegusii: “Inee! Titwabakanetie bokong’u ng’a timworokereria ase erieta ri’omonto oyo? Korende rora aya mwakorire! Akababoria. Mwaichoirie Yerusalemu nokworokereria kwaino, naende morigetie gotororekania koba buna nintwe twaretete ogokwa kwaye.”
swahili: “Tuliwaonya kwa nguvu msifundishe kwa jina hili, lakini ninyi mmeijaza Yerusalemu yote mafundisho yenu na tena mmekusudia kuleta damu ya mtu huyu juu yetu.”

english: But Peter and the other apostles replied, “We must obey God rather than men.
ekegusii: Korende Petero na abatomwa bande bakairaneria: “Goika intwe toigwere Nyasae kobua Mwanyabaanto.
swahili: Petro na wale mitume wengine wakajibu, “Imetupasa kumtii Mungu kuliko wanadamu.

english: Then Peter said, “Ananias, how is it that Satan has filled your heart to lie to the Holy Spirit and withhold some of the proceeds from the land?
ekegusii: Erio Petero akamobooria: “Anania, nase ki ogwancha Saitani gokobogoria okong’aina Omoika Omochenu na kobisa ensemo ye chitaabu kwanyora korwa ase omogondo?
swahili: Petro akamuuliza, “Anania, mbona Shetani ameujaza moyo wako ili kumwambia uongo Roho Mtakatifu, ukaficha sehemu ya fedha ulizopata kutokana na kiwanja?

english: The God of our fathers raised up Jesus, whom you had killed by hanging Him on a tree.
ekegusii: Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiaito nigo abogetie Yeso korwa ase amakweri, nyuma inwe mwamoitire ase okomosunga ase omosalaba.
swahili: Mungu wa baba zetu alimfufua Yesu kutoka kwa wafu, ambaye ninyi mlimuua kwa kumtundika kwenye msalaba.

english: God exalted Him to His right hand as Prince and Savior, in order to grant repentance and forgiveness of sins to Israel.
ekegusii: Nyasae akamoimokereria igoro ase ensemo y’okoboko kwaye gw’okorio buna Omoraai na Omotooria, erinde abae abanto ba Israeli ribaga riokoonchoka erinde banyore okwaberwa kw’ebibe biabo.
swahili: Mungu alimtukuza, akamweka mkono wake wa kuume kuwa Kiongozi na Mwokozi ili awape Israeli toba na msamaha wa dhambi.

english: We are witnesses of these things, and so is the Holy Spirit, whom God has given to those who obey Him.” Gamaliel’s Advice
ekegusii: Intwe nigo tore kirori ase amang’ana aya onsi—intwe amo n’Omoika Omochenu, oyio ore ekeegwa kia Nyasae ase baria bonsi bakomoigwera ere.”
swahili: Nasi tu mashahidi wa mambo haya, vivyo hivyo na Roho Mtakatifu ambaye Mungu amewapa wale wanaomtii.”

english: When the Council members heard this, they were enraged, and they resolved to put the apostles to death.
ekegusii: Ekero abanto baria b’ekegambero bachia koigwa aya bakagechigwa, bakarigia goita abatomwa bakwe.
swahili: Wale wajumbe wa baraza la wazee waliposikia haya, walijawa na ghadhabu, wakataka kuwaua mitume.

english: But a Pharisee named Gamaliel, a teacher of the law who was honored by all the people, stood up in the Sanhedrin and ordered that the men be put outside for a short time.
ekegusii: Korende Omofarisai oyomo ore korokwa Gamalieli, oyomo bw’ekegambero, omworokia bw’amachiiko, omonto osikire n’abanto bonsi, agachiika ng’a abanto aba babekwe isiko ake,
swahili: Lakini Farisayo mmoja, jina lake Gamalieli, aliyekuwa mwalimu wa sheria, aliyeheshimiwa na watu wote, akasimama mbele ya baraza akaamuru mitume watolewe nje kwa muda.

english: “Men of Israel,” he said, “consider carefully what you are about to do to these men.
ekegusii: erio agakwana ase ekegambero keria, “Inwe abasacha b’Abaisraeli, erende buna morakorere abanto aba.
swahili: Ndipo alipowaambia wajumbe wa baraza, “Enyi watu wa Israeli, fikirini kwa uangalifu mnayotaka kuwatendea watu hawa.

english: Some time ago Theudas rose up, claiming to be somebody, and about four hundred men joined him. He was killed, all his followers were dispersed, and it all came to nothing.
ekegusii: Naki ase amatuko aetire Theuda naimoka, agetogia ng’a ere nomonto omonene; abanto koreng’ana amagana ane bakabwatana nere, korende ere agaitwa, na abatunyani baye bonsi bagaserebekana, n’ekeombe kiaye kegasira.
swahili: Kwa maana wakati uliopita, aliinuka mtu mmoja jina lake Theuda, alijidai kuwa yeye ni mtu maarufu, akapata wafuasi wapatao 400 walioambatana naye. Lakini aliuawa, na wafuasi wake wote wakatawanyika, wakawa si kitu.

english: After him, Judas the Galilean appeared in the days of the census and drew away people after him. He too perished, and all his followers were scattered.
ekegusii: Magega yaye, Yudasi Omogalili nere akaimoka ase amatuko aria ekero abanto baare koriikwa, akang’usa abanto abange bamotunyane. Nere boigo agasira, na bonsi abamotunyanete bagaserebekana.
swahili: Baada yake, alitokea Yuda Mgalilaya wakati wa kuorodhesha watu, naye akaongoza kundi la watu kuasi. Yeye pia aliuawa, nao wafuasi wake wakatawanyika.

english: So in the present case I advise you: Leave these men alone. Let them go! For if their purpose or endeavor is of human origin, it will fail.
ekegusii: Na bono nabateebirie, timobaisa koira getambokero kende gionsi ase abanto aba. Batige! Ekiagera onye ring’ana eri, gose emeremo eye, neya Mwanyabaanto, nesarigwe,
swahili: Kwa hiyo, kwa habari ya jambo hili nawashauri, jiepusheni na watu hawa. Waacheni waende zao! Kwa maana kama kusudi lao na shughuli yao imetokana na mwanadamu, haitafanikiwa.

english: But if it is from God, you will not be able to stop them. You may even find yourselves fighting against God.”
ekegusii: korende onye neya Nyasae, timokonyaara koyesaria nonya ng’ake; mobaise kororekana ng’a Nyasae mokorwania!”
swahili: Lakini ikiwa imetoka kwa Mungu, hamtaweza kuwazuia watu hawa. Badala yake mtajikuta mnapigana na Mungu.”

english: Did it not belong to you before it was sold? And after it was sold, was it not at your disposal? How could you conceive such a deed in your heart? You have not lied to men, but to God!”
ekegusii: Nyuma otaraonia omogondo oyo noyoo orenge; Na ekero oonetigwe chitaabu nechiao chiarenge. Nase ki kwarengereretie gokora ring’ana eri? Totebeti Mwanyabaanto oborimo, korende Nyasae.”
swahili: Je, kabla hujauza hicho kiwanja si kilikuwa mali yako? Hata baada ya kukiuza, fedha ulizopata si zilikuwa kwenye uwezo wako? Kwa nini basi umewaza hila hii moyoni mwako kufanya jambo kama hili? Wewe hukumwambia uongo mwanadamu bali Mungu.”

english: At this, they yielded to Gamaliel. They called the apostles in and had them flogged. Then they ordered them not to speak in the name of Jesus, and released them.
ekegusii: Bagancha amang’ana aye, na ekero barangeretie abatomwa, bakabachwata, bakabachiika tibakwana ase erieta ria Yeso. Erio bakabatiga bagende.
swahili: Wakapokea ushauri wa Gamalieli. Wakawaita mitume ndani, wakaamuru wachapwe mijeledi, kisha wakawaagiza wasinene tena kwa jina la Yesu, wakawaachia waende zao.

english: The apostles left the Sanhedrin, rejoicing that they had been counted worthy of suffering disgrace for the Name.
ekegusii: Abatomwa bakarua ase ekegambero keria, bagogete ekiagera konya baabarirwe ng’a bagweneire korenterwa obosooku ase engencho y’Erieta ria Yeso.
swahili: Nao mitume wakatoka nje ya baraza, wakiwa wamejaa furaha kwa sababu wamehesabiwa kustahili kupata aibu kwa ajili ya jina la Yesu.

english: Every day, in the temple courts and from house to house, they did not stop teaching and proclaiming the good news that Jesus is the Christ.
ekegusii: Na kera rituko, ase Hekalu ime na ase chinyomba chiabo tibatigete kworokereria na korandia amang’ana amaya igoro ya Yeso, oyio ore Kristo.
swahili: Kila siku, Hekaluni na nyumba kwa nyumba, hawakuacha kufundisha na kuhubiri habari njema kwamba Yesu ndiye Kristo.

english: On hearing these words, Ananias fell down and died. And great fear came over all who heard what had happened.
ekegusii: Ekero Anania achia koigwa amang’ana aya, agaaka inse, agakwa. Omoondoko omonene ogasoa ase abanto bonsi abaigwete aya.
swahili: Anania aliposikia maneno haya akaanguka chini na kufa. Hofu kuu ikawapata wote waliosikia jambo lililokuwa limetukia.

english: Then the young men stepped forward, wrapped up his body, and carried him out and buried him.
ekegusii: Abamura bagacha bagatuba omobere oye egetambaa, bakamobogoria gochia isiko, bakamotindeka.
swahili: Vijana wakaja, wakaufunga mwili wake sanda, wakamchukua nje kumzika.

english: About three hours later his wife also came in, unaware of what had happened.
ekegusii: Magega ye chinsa isato mokaye agasoa, ere tamanyete aya akoregete.
swahili: Saa tatu baadaye mkewe Anania akaingia, naye hana habari ya mambo yaliyotukia.

english: “Tell me,” said Peter, “is this the price you and your husband got for the land?” “Yes,” she answered, “that is the price.”
ekegusii: Petero akamobooria: “Nteebia, eri nario rigori aye n’omosacha oo mwaonetie omogondo ase?” Akairaneria: “Ee, ase rigori oino.”
swahili: Petro akamuuliza, “Niambie, je, mliuza kiwanja kwa thamani hii?” Akajibu, “Ndiyo, tuliuza kwa thamani hiyo.”

english: “How could you agree to test the Spirit of the Lord?” Peter replied. “Look, the feet of the men who buried your husband are at the door, and they will carry you out also.”
ekegusii: Petero akamobooria: “Naki abeete aye n’omosacha oo mogancherana goteema Omoika bw’Omonene? Abasacha abwo batindeka omosacha oo nao bare agwo gesieri, na barabwo nabakobogorie aye gochia isiko.”
swahili: Ndipo Petro akamwambia, “Imekuwaje mkakubaliana kumjaribu Roho wa Bwana? Tazama! Nyayo za vijana waliomzika mumeo ziko mlangoni, wewe nawe watakuchukua nje.”

english: In those days when the disciples were increasing in number, the Grecian Jews among them began to grumble against the Hebraic Jews because their widows were being overlooked in the daily distribution of food.
ekegusii: Bono ase amatuko aria, ekero aborokigwa barenge komentekana omobaro obo, nkwabeete okwemurungania kw’Abayahudi abarenge gokwana Ekegiriki igoro ase Abayahudi baria barenge gokwana Ekearamaiki, ekiagera ababoraka baabo bebetwe ase okogaberwa gwa kera rituko.
swahili: Basi ikawa katika siku hizo, wakati idadi ya wanafunzi ilipokuwa ikiongezeka sana, palitokea manungʼuniko kati ya Wayahudi wa Kiyunani, dhidi ya Waebrania kwa sababu wajane wao walisahaulika katika mgawanyo wa chakula wa kila siku.

english: but they could not stand up to his wisdom or the Spirit by whom he spoke.
ekegusii: Korende tibanyara kobua obong’aini na Omoika oyo are gokwana noro.
swahili: Lakini hawakuweza kushindana na hekima yake wala huyo Roho ambaye alisema kwake.

english: Then they prompted some men to say, “We heard Stephen speak words of blasphemy against Moses and against God.”
ekegusii: Goika bakagenka abanto bateebe: “Ntwaigwa omonto oyo ogokwana amang’ana ’oborami igoro ya Musa na Nyasae.”
swahili: Ndipo kwa siri wakawashawishi watu fulani waseme, “Tumemsikia Stefano akisema maneno ya kufuru dhidi ya Mose na dhidi ya Mungu.” Stefano Afikishwa Mbele Ya Baraza

english: So they stirred up the people, elders, and scribes and confronted Stephen. They seized him and brought him before the Sanhedrin,
ekegusii: Bagaseega abanto na abagaaka na aborokia b’amariiko, bagachiera Stefano bakamobwata, bakamoira bosio bw’ekegambero.
swahili: Wakawachochea watu, wazee na walimu wa Sheria, nao wakamkamata Stefano wakamfikisha mbele ya baraza.

english: where they presented false witnesses who said, “This man never stops speaking against this holy place and against the law.
ekegusii: Bagatenenia kirori b’oborimo abaare goteeba: “Omonto oyo tatigeti gokwana bobe igoro y’aase Aa Aachenu na igoro y’amachiiko.
swahili: Wakaweka mashahidi wa uongo ambao walishuhudia wakisema, “Mtu huyu kamwe haachi kusema dhidi ya mahali hapa patakatifu na dhidi ya Sheria.

english: For we have heard him say that Jesus of Nazareth will destroy this place and change the customs that Moses handed down to us.”
ekegusii: Naki ntwamoigwa ogoteeba ng’a Yeso oyio o Nazareti inasarie aase aa, na koonchora chingencho echi twaetwe na Musa.”
swahili: Kwa maana tumemsikia akisema kwamba Yesu wa Nazareti atapaharibu mahali patakatifu na kubadili desturi zote tulizopewa na Mose.”

english: All who were sitting in the Sanhedrin looked intently at Stephen, and they saw that his face was like the face of an angel.
ekegusii: Abanto bonsi, abaikaransete ase ekegambero eke, bakamobeta amaiso, bakarora obosio bwaye ng’a nigo bwabeire buna obosio bw’omomalaika.
swahili: Watu wote waliokuwa wameketi katika baraza wakimkazia macho Stefano, wakaona uso wake unangʼaa kama uso wa malaika.

english: So the Twelve summoned all the disciples and said, “It is unacceptable for us to neglect the word of God in order to wait on tables.
ekegusii: Baria ikomi na babere bakarangeria omoganda bw’aborokigwa, bagateeba: “Tetogwenereti intwe gotiga ring’ana ria Nyasae na gokora emeremo ye chimesa.
swahili: Wale mitume kumi na wawili wakakusanya wanafunzi wote pamoja wakasema, “Haitakuwa vyema sisi kuacha huduma ya neno la Mungu ili kuhudumu mezani.

english: Therefore, brothers, select from among you seven men confirmed to be full of the Spirit and wisdom. We will appoint this responsibility to them
ekegusii: Gaki baminto, chora abanto batano na babere korwa ase egati yaino, abamanyekanete ng’a nabaya, baichire n’Omoika na obong’aini, erinde tobabeeke ase emeremo eye.
swahili: Kwa hiyo ndugu, chagueni watu saba miongoni mwenu, watu wenye sifa njema, waliojawa na Roho Mtakatifu na hekima, ambao tunaweza kuwakabidhi kazi hii,

english: and will devote ourselves to prayer and to the ministry of the word.”
ekegusii: Korende intwe inatogenderere ase ogosaba na gokorera ring’ana ria Nyasae.”
swahili: nasi tutatumia muda wetu kuomba na huduma ya neno.”

english: This proposal pleased the whole group. They chose Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Spirit, as well as Philip, Prochorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, and Nicolas from Antioch, a convert to Judaism.
ekegusii: Ring’ana eri rikagwenera omosangererekano bwonsi. Bagachora Stefano, omonto oichire nokwegena na Omoika Omochenu, na Filipo, na Prokoro, na Nikanora, na Timoni, na Parmena, na Nikolao bw’Antiokia, omonto oonchogete.
swahili: Yale waliyosema yakawapendeza watu wote, nao wakamchagua Stefano (mtu aliyejawa na imani na Roho Mtakatifu) pamoja na Filipo, Prokoro, Nikanori, Timoni, Parmena na Nikolao, mwongofu kutoka Antiokia.

english: They presented these seven to the apostles, who prayed and laid their hands on them.
ekegusii: Bakababeeka bosio bw’abatomwa, na barabwo bakabasabera na kobabeekera amaboko.
swahili: Wakawaleta watu hawa mbele ya mitume, nao wakawaombea na kuwawekea mikono juu yao.

english: So the word of God continued to spread. The number of disciples in Jerusalem grew rapidly, and a great number of priests became obedient to the faith. The Arrest of Stephen
ekegusii: Ring’ana ria Nyasae rikaranda, na omobaro bw’aborokigwa okamentekana mono ase Yerusalemu, na abakuani abange bakaigwera okwegena. Ogosoerwa gwa Stefano
swahili: Neno la Mungu likazidi kuenea. Idadi ya wanafunzi ikazidi kuongezeka sana katika Yerusalemu hata makuhani wengi wakaitii ile imani. Kukamatwa Kwa Stefano

english: Now Stephen, who was full of grace and power, was performing great wonders and signs among the people.
ekegusii: Na Stefano, oichire obuya na okobua, nigo arenge gokora amakumia amanene na ebikone egati y’abanto.
swahili: Stefano, akiwa amejaa neema na nguvu za Mungu, alifanya ishara na miujiza mikubwa miongoni mwa watu.

english: But resistance arose from what was called the Synagogue of the Freedmen, including Cyrenians, Alexandrians, and men from the provinces of Cilicia and Asia. They began to argue with Stephen,
ekegusii: Korende abanto bande b’esinagogi yare korokwa Esinagogi y’Abasibore, aba nigo barenge Abakuurene na Abaaleksanderia, na baria korwa ase Kilikia na Asia, bakaimoka bakaamererania na Stefano.
swahili: Hata hivyo, ukainuka upinzani wa watu wa Sinagogi la Watu Huru (kama lilivyokuwa linaitwa), la Wayahudi wa Kirene na wa Iskanderia, na wengine kutoka Kilikia na Asia. Watu hawa wakaanza kupingana na Stefano.

english: Then the high priest asked Stephen, “Are these charges true?”
ekegusii: Omokuani omonene akaboria Stefano: “Inee! Amang’ana ayio naboigo are?”
swahili: Ndipo kuhani mkuu akamuuliza Stefano, “Je, mashtaka haya ni ya kweli?”

english: and rescued him from all his troubles. He granted Joseph favor and wisdom in the sight of Pharaoh king of Egypt, who appointed him ruler over Egypt and all his household.
ekegusii: akamorusia ase emechando yaye yonsi, akamoa ogwancherwa na obong’aini ase obosio bwa Farao, omorwoti o Misiri; ere akamobeka akaba gabana igoro ya Misiri na enyomba yaye yonsi.
swahili: Akamwokoa kutoka mateso yote yaliyompata, tena akampa kibali na hekima aliposimama mbele ya Farao, mfalme wa Misri, ambaye alimweka kuwa mtawala juu ya Misri na juu ya jumba lote la kifalme.

english: Then famine and great suffering swept across Egypt and Canaan, and our fathers could not find food.
ekegusii: Erio enchara ekaba igoro ase ense yonsi ya Misiri na Kaanani, na emechando emenge, ne chisokoro chiaito tichianyora endagera echiisanete.
swahili: “Basi kukawa na njaa katika nchi yote ya Misri na Kanaani, ikasababisha dhiki kubwa, nao baba zetu wakawa hawana chakula.

english: When Jacob heard that there was grain in Egypt, he sent our fathers on their first visit.
ekegusii: Korende Yakobo gachia koigwa ng’a endagera nekare Misiri, agatoma chisokoro chiaito aroro ase orogendo rwe ritang’ani.
swahili: Lakini Yakobo aliposikia kwamba kuna nafaka huko Misri, aliwatuma baba zetu, wakaenda huko kwa mara yao ya kwanza.

english: On their second visit, Joseph revealed his identity to his brothers, and his family became known to Pharaoh.
ekegusii: Ase orogendo rwa kabere Yusufu akemanyekania ase bamura bamwabo, na eamate ya Yusufu egaacha, ekamanyekana ase Farao.
swahili: Walipokwenda mara ya pili, Yosefu alijitambulisha kwa ndugu zake, nao ndugu zake Yosefu wakajulishwa kwa Farao.

english: Then Joseph sent for his father Jacob and all his relatives, seventy-five in all. Israel Oppressed in Egypt (Exodus 1:8–22)
ekegusii: Erio Yusufu agatoma abanto gochia korangeria Yakobo ise, na eamate yaye yonsi, abanto emerongo etano na ebere na batano.
swahili: Ndipo Yosefu akawatuma kumleta Yakobo baba yake pamoja na jamaa yake yote, jumla yao walikuwa watu sabini na watano.

english: So Jacob went down to Egypt, where he and our fathers died.
ekegusii: Yakobo agatirimboka, agaika Misiri; ere agakwera aroro, ere omonyene ne chisokoro chiaito.
swahili: Hivyo Yakobo akaenda Misri ambako yeye na baba zetu walifia.

english: Their bones were carried back to Shechem and placed in the tomb that Abraham had bought from the sons of Hamor at Shechem for a price he paid in silver.
ekegusii: Bakabogorigwa goika Sekemu, bagatindekwa ase embeera eria Aburaamu agorete ase chifeta korwa ase abana ba Hamori, aaria Sekemu.
swahili: Miili yao ilirudishwa Shekemu na kuzikwa katika kaburi ambalo Abrahamu alinunua kutoka kwa wana wa Hamori kwa kiasi fulani cha fedha.

english: As the time drew near for God to fulfill His promise to Abraham, our people in Egypt increased greatly in number.
ekegusii: Ekero eira eria Nyasae aete Aburaamu yachia goika ang’e goikeranigwa, abanto baria bakamenteka na kobucha mono aaria Misiri,
swahili: “Lakini wakati ulipokuwa unakaribia wa kutimizwa kwa ile ahadi ambayo Mungu alikuwa amempa Abrahamu, watu wetu walizidi kuongezeka sana huko Misri.

english: Then another king, who knew nothing of Joseph, arose over Egypt.
ekegusii: goika omorwoti onde akabeekwa Misiri, oyotamomanyete Yusufu.
swahili: Ndipo mfalme mwingine ambaye hakujua lolote kuhusu Yosefu akatawala Misri.

english: He exploited our people and oppressed our fathers, forcing them to abandon their infants so they would die. The Birth and Adoption of Moses (Exodus 2:1–10; Hebrews 11:23–29)
ekegusii: Oyio agakorera egesaku giaito obong’ainereria, na agakorera chisokoro chiaito amabe, na barabwo bagachiikwa ng’a batugute abana babo ebing’werere, erinde tibaaba moyo.
swahili: Huyu mfalme akawatendea watu wetu hila na kuwatesa baba zetu kwa kuwalazimisha wawatupe watoto wao wachanga ili wafe.

english: And Stephen declared: “Brothers and fathers, listen to me! The God of glory appeared to our father Abraham while he was still in Mesopotamia, before he lived in Haran,
ekegusii: Stefano akairaneria. Abaminto na abatata, ntegerere. Nyasae bw’obonene naorokerete sokoro yaito Aburaamu, ekero arenge ase Mesopotamia, ritang’ani ataramenya Harani,
swahili: Stefano akajibu, “Ndugu zangu na baba zangu, nisikilizeni! Mungu wa utukufu alimtokea baba yetu Abrahamu, alipokuwa bado yuko Mesopotamia, kabla hajaishi Harani,

english: At that time Moses was born, and he was beautiful in the sight of God. For three months he was nurtured in his father’s house.
ekegusii: Ekero ekio Musa akaiborwa, ere nigo arenge omuya mono, akagwenera Nyasae. Akarererwa nyomba mwa ise ase engaki y’emetienyi etato.
swahili: “Wakati huo Mose alizaliwa, naye hakuwa mtoto wa kawaida. Akalelewa nyumbani kwa baba yake kwa muda wa miezi mitatu.

english: When he was set outside, Pharaoh’s daughter took him and brought him up as her own son.
ekegusii: Ekero achia gotugutwa, omoiseke o Farao akamoira, ’akamotuga na komorera buna omwana oye.
swahili: Waliposhindwa kumficha zaidi, wakamweka nje mtoni na binti Farao akamchukua akamtunza kama mtoto wake mwenyewe.

english: So Moses was educated in all the wisdom of the Egyptians and was powerful in speech and action. The Rejection and Flight of Moses (Exodus 2:11–22)
ekegusii: Musa akaorokererigwa chiseemi chionsi chia Misiri, akaba omokong’u ase amang’ana na ase ogokora.
swahili: Mose akafundishwa hekima yote ya Wamisri, akawa mtu hodari kwa maneno na matendo.

english: When Moses was forty years old, he decided to visit his brothers, the children of Israel.
ekegusii: Ekero akoorire emiaka emerongo ene, akarengereria ase enkoro yaye kogenda korora abamwabo, Abaisraeli.
swahili: “Mose alipokuwa na umri wa miaka arobaini aliamua kuwatembelea ndugu zake Waisraeli.

english: And when he saw one of them being mistreated, Moses went to his defense and avenged him by striking down the Egyptian who was oppressing him.
ekegusii: Akarora oyomo obo ogokorerwa bobe n’Omomisiri, akamokonya; agaakanera oria orenge gochandwa egesiomba, agaaka Omomisiri oria akamoita.
swahili: Aliona mmoja wao akidhulumiwa na Mmisri, akamtetea yule aliyeonewa, akampiga yule Mmisri akamuua kulipiza kisasi.

english: He assumed his brothers would understand that God was using him to deliver them, but they did not.
ekegusii: Nigo akagete ng’a abamwabo mbamanye ng’a Nyasae nabae obosibore goetera ase okoboko kwaye, korende tibamanya.
swahili: Mose alidhani kuwa ndugu zake wangetambua kwamba Mungu anamtumia ili kuwaokoa, lakini wao hawakuelewa.

english: The next day he came upon two Israelites who were fighting, and he tried to reconcile them, saying, ‘Men, you are brothers. Why are you mistreating each other?’
ekegusii: Rituko rikobwatia akaorokera Abaisraeli babere ekero baare korwana, akarigia kobatorania agateeba: Abaminto, inwe nabamo, nase ki mokorwana?
swahili: Siku iliyofuata Mose aliwakuta Waisraeli wawili wakigombana, akajaribu kuwapatanisha kwa kuwaambia, ‘Enyi watu, ninyi ni ndugu, mbona mnataka kudhulumiana?’

english: But the man who was abusing his neighbor pushed Moses aside and said, ‘Who made you ruler and judge over us?
ekegusii: Korende oria orenge gokorera oyomwabo bobe, akamosukeria are, agateeba: Ning’o okobegete koba omonene gose omogambi ase tore?
swahili: “Lakini yule mtu aliyekuwa akimdhulumu mwenzake akamsukuma Mose kando, akamuuliza, ‘Ni nani aliyekufanya mtawala na mwamuzi juu yetu?

english: Do you want to kill me as you killed the Egyptian yesterday?’
ekegusii: Inee! Norigetie kong’ita buna gwaita Omomisiri oria igoro?
swahili: Je, unataka kuniua kama ulivyomuua yule Mmisri jana?’

english: At this remark, Moses fled to the land of Midian, where he lived as a foreigner and had two sons. The Call of Moses (Exodus 3:1–22)
ekegusii: Ase engencho y’amang’ana aya Musa agatama gochia ase ense ya Midiani, akamenya aroro buna omomenyi. Akaiborera abana babere abamura aroro.
swahili: Mose aliposikia maneno haya, alikimbilia huko Midiani alikokaa kama mgeni, naye akapata watoto wawili wa kiume.

english: and told him, ‘Leave your country and your kindred and go to the land I will show you.’
ekegusii: akamoteebia: Karue ase ense yao, na ase eamate yao, ogende goika ase ense ndakworokie.
swahili: akamwambia, ‘Ondoka kutoka nchi yako na kutoka kwa jamii yako, uende hadi nchi nitakayokuonyesha.’

english: After forty years had passed, an angel appeared to Moses in the flames of a burning bush in the desert near Mount Sinai.
ekegusii: Ekero emiaka emerongo ene yachia koera, omomalaika akamoorokera ase ogwoka kw’omorero ase egetutu aaria erooro y’egetunwa gia Sinai.
swahili: “Basi baada ya miaka arobaini kupita, malaika wa Mungu akamtokea Mose jangwani karibu na Mlima Sinai katika kichaka kilichokuwa kinawaka moto.

english: When Moses saw it, he marveled at the sight. As he approached to look more closely, the voice of the Lord came to him:
ekegusii: Musa agakumia ase okorora koria, na ekero achia goika ang’e gokorora, eriogi ri’Omonene rikamocheera, rigateeba:
swahili: Alipoona mambo haya, alishangaa yale maono. Aliposogea ili aangalie kwa karibu, akaisikia sauti ya Bwana, ikisema:

english: ‘I am the God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.’ Moses trembled with fear and did not dare to look.
ekegusii: Ninche Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiao, Nyasae o Aburaamu, na o Isaka, na o Yakobo. Musa akaiguswa, tarenge na boremu bw’okorigereria.
swahili: ‘Mimi ndimi Mungu wa baba zako, Mungu wa Abrahamu, Isaki na Yakobo.’ Mose alitetemeka kwa hofu na hakuthubutu kutazama.

english: Then the Lord said to him, ‘Take off your sandals, for the place where you are standing is holy ground.
ekegusii: Omonene akamoteebia: Rusia ebikoroto biao korwa ase amagoro ao, ekiagera aase agwo oteneine nase aachenu.
swahili: “Ndipo Bwana akamwambia, ‘Vua viatu vyako kwa maana mahali unaposimama ni patakatifu.

english: I have indeed seen the oppression of My people in Egypt. I have heard their groaning and have come down to deliver them. Now come, I will send you back to Egypt.’
ekegusii: Ekeene, narorire ogokorerwa bobe kw’abaanto baane abare Misiri, naigure okorera kwabo, naikire mbasibore. Inchuo bono, ngotome goika Misiri.
swahili: Hakika nimeona mateso ya watu wangu huko Misri. Nimesikia kilio chao cha uchungu, nami nimeshuka ili niwaokoe. Basi sasa njoo, nami nitakutuma Misri.’

english: This Moses, whom they had rejected with the words, ‘Who made you ruler and judge?’ is the one whom God sent to be their ruler and redeemer through the angel who appeared to him in the bush.
ekegusii: Musa nere oyio bangete, bagateeba: Ning’o okobegete koba omonene gose omogambi? Nere otometwe na Nyasae, goetera ase amaboko ’omomalaika oria omoorokerete ase egetutu keria, koba omonene na omosibori.
swahili: “Huyu ndiye Mose yule waliyemkataa wakisema, ‘Ni nani aliyekufanya mtawala na mwamuzi juu yetu?’ Alikuwa ametumwa na Mungu mwenyewe kuwa mtawala na mkombozi wao, kwa njia ya yule malaika aliyemtokea katika kile kichaka.

english: He led them out and performed wonders and signs in the land of Egypt, at the Red Sea, and for forty years in the wilderness.
ekegusii: Omonto oyio nere obarusetie korwa aroro magega gakorire amakumia na ebikone ase ense ya Misiri, na ase Enyancha Embariri, naende ase erooro ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ene.
swahili: Aliwaongoza wana wa Israeli kutoka Misri, baada ya kufanya ishara na maajabu mengi huko Misri, katika Bahari ya Shamu, na katika jangwa kwa muda wa miaka arobaini.

english: This is the same Moses who told the Israelites, ‘God will raise up for you a prophet like me from among your brothers.’
ekegusii: Musa oyio nere oteebetie Abaisraeli ng’a: Nyasae nabaimokerie omobani onga buna inche korwa ase egati y’abamino.
swahili: “Huyu ndiye yule Mose aliyewaambia Waisraeli, ‘Mungu atawainulia nabii kama mimi kutoka miongoni mwa ndugu zenu wenyewe.’

english: He was in the assembly in the wilderness with the angel who spoke to him on Mount Sinai, and with our fathers. And he received living words to pass on to us. The Rebellion of Israel (Exodus 32:1–35; Deuteronomy 9:7–29; Amos 5:16–27)
ekegusii: Naende nere orenge ase baria basangererekanete ase erooro amo nomomalaika oyokwanete nere ase egetunwa gia Sinai, naende amo ne chisokoro chiaito; nere oetwe amang’ana ’obogima atoe.
swahili: Huyu ndiye yule Mose aliyekuwa katika kusanyiko huko jangwani, ambaye malaika alisema naye pamoja na baba zetu kwenye Mlima Sinai, naye akapokea maneno yaliyo hai ili atupatie.

english: But our fathers refused to obey him. Instead, they rejected him and in their hearts turned back to Egypt.
ekegusii: Omonto oyio chisokoro chiaito chikaanga koimoigwera, chikamosukeria are. Na ase ebirengererio biabo bakairana Misiri,
swahili: “Lakini baba zetu walikataa kumtii Mose, badala yake wakamkataa na kuielekeza mioyo yao Misri tena.

english: So Abraham left the land of the Chaldeans and settled in Haran. After his father died, God brought him out of that place and into this land where you are now living.
ekegusii: Erio akarua ase ense y’Abakalidayo, akamenya Harani. Magega ise gakuure, Nyasae akamong’anyia korwa aroro goika ense eye inwe momenyete bono.
swahili: “Hivyo aliondoka katika nchi ya Wakaldayo akaenda kukaa Harani. Baada ya kifo cha baba yake, Mungu akamtoa huko akamleta katika nchi hii ambayo mnaishi sasa.

english: They said to Aaron, ‘Make us gods who will go before us! As for this Moses who led us out of the land of Egypt, we do not know what has happened to him.’
ekegusii: bagateebia Aroni: Tokorere chinyasae echiranyare gototang’ana. Titomanyeti eriamonyorire Musa, oyotorusetie ase ense ya Misiri.
swahili: Wakamwambia Aroni, ‘Tufanyie miungu watakaotuongoza, kwa maana mtu huyu Mose aliyetutoa nchi ya Misri, hatujui yaliyompata.’

english: At that time they made a calf and offered a sacrifice to the idol, rejoicing in the works of their hands.
ekegusii: Ase amatuko aria bagakora omogwekano bw’emori, bakarenta ekeng’wanso ase omogwekano oria basasiimete, bakagokera emeremo y’amaboko abo.
swahili: Huu ni ule wakati walitengeneza sanamu katika umbo la ndama, wakailetea sadaka kufanya maadhimisho kwa ajili ya kile kitu walichokitengeneza kwa mikono yao wenyewe.

english: But God turned away from them and gave them over to the worship of the host of heaven, as it is written in the book of the prophets: ‘Did you bring Me sacrifices and offerings forty years in the wilderness, O house of Israel?
ekegusii: Korende Nyasae akeonchora korwa ase bare, akabatiga basasiime erioba na omotienyi ne ching’enang’eni chia igoro, buna ariikire ase egetabu y’ababani: Inwe Abaisraeli, Inee, ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ene, eyio mwarenge ase erooro, mwandeterete ebing’wanso amo nokoruegwa konde?
swahili: Ndipo Mungu akageuka, akawaacha waabudu jeshi lote la mbinguni, kama ilivyoandikwa katika Kitabu cha Manabii: “ ‘Je, mliniletea dhabihu na sadaka kwa miaka arobaini kule jangwani, ee nyumba ya Israeli?

english: You have taken along the tabernacle of Molech and the star of your god Rephan, the idols you made to worship. Therefore I will send you into exile beyond Babylon.’ The Tabernacle of the Testimony (Exodus 40:1–33; Hebrews 9:1–10)
ekegusii: Yaya, nigo mwabogoretie Moleki, enyasae yaino, na eng’enang’eni y’enyasae Refani, emegwekano eyio mwakorete, erinde moyesasime. Ase ayio nimbang’anyie goika ng’umbu ya Babiloni.
swahili: La, ninyi mliinua madhabahu ya Moleki, na nyota ya mungu wenu Refani, vinyago mlivyotengeneza ili kuviabudu. Kwa hiyo nitawapeleka mbali’ kuliko Babeli.

english: Our fathers had the tabernacle of the Testimony with them in the wilderness. It was constructed exactly as God had directed Moses, according to the pattern he had seen.
ekegusii: Eema y’oborori nigo yarenge amo ne chisokoro chiaito ase erooro, buna Nyasae achigete, ekero atebeetie Musa ng’a ayekore buna ekiorokererio keria aroche.
swahili: “Baba zetu walikuwa na lile Hema la Ushuhuda huko jangwani. Lilikuwa limetengenezwa kama Mungu alivyokuwa amemwelekeza Mose, kulingana na kielelezo alichoona.

english: And our fathers who received it brought it in with Joshua when they dispossessed the nations God drove out before them. It remained until the time of David,
ekegusii: Chisokoro chiaito nchiayenyorete buna omwando, chikayesoyia amo na Yoshua, ekero bairete ense y’ebisaku biria Nyasae aseretie korwa ase obosio bwe chisokoro chiaito. Nigo babete nero goika amatuko a Daudi,
swahili: Baba zetu wakiisha kulipokea hema kwa kupokezana wakiongozwa na Yoshua katika milki ya nchi kutoka kwa yale mataifa ambayo Mungu aliyafukuza mbele yao, nalo likadumu katika nchi mpaka wakati wa Daudi,

english: who found favor in the sight of God and asked to provide a dwelling place for the God of Jacob.
ekegusii: oyio onyorete ogwancherwa ase obosio bwa Nyasae, agasaba ng’a anyorere Nyasae o Yakobo obomenyo.
swahili: ambaye alipata kibali kwa Mungu, naye akaomba kwamba ampatie Mungu wa Yakobo maskani.

english: But it was Solomon who built the house for Him.
ekegusii: Korende Sulemani nere omoagacherete enyomba.
swahili: Lakini alikuwa Solomoni ndiye alimjengea Mungu nyumba.

english: However, the Most High does not dwell in houses made by human hands. As the prophet says:
ekegusii: Korende Ere Oyore Igoro Mono tari komenya ase chinyomba chiagachire namaboko, buna omobani agoteeba:
swahili: “Hata hivyo, Yeye Aliye Juu Sana hakai kwenye nyumba zilizojengwa kwa mikono ya wanadamu. Kama nabii alivyosema:

english: ‘Heaven is My throne and the earth is My footstool. What kind of house will you build for Me, says the Lord, or where will My place of repose be?
ekegusii: Igoro nekerogo kiane ki’obonene, na ense negeteni kiane ki’amagoro. Omonene oteebire: Inyomba ki moranyaare kong’agachera? Gose ng’ai aase are ndanyaare gotimokera?
swahili: “ ‘Mbingu ni kiti changu cha enzi, nayo dunia ni mahali pa kuweka miguu yangu. Mtanijengea nyumba ya namna gani? asema Bwana. Au mahali pangu pa kupumzikia patakuwa wapi?

english: He gave him no inheritance here, not even a foot of ground. But God promised to give possession of the land to Abraham and his descendants, even though he did not yet have a child.
ekegusii: Tamoete omwando ime aa, nonya koreng’ana ase akobeeka okogoro, korende akamoriera eira ng’a namoe ense eria ebe obomenyo bwaye, na obw’oroiboro rwaye magega yaye, nonya tarenge nomwana.
swahili: Mungu hakumpa urithi wowote katika nchi hii, hakumpa hata mahali pa kuweka wayo mmoja. Bali Mungu alimwahidi kuwa yeye na uzao wake baada yake wangeirithi hii nchi, ingawa wakati huo Abrahamu hakuwa na mtoto.

english: Has not My hand made all these things?’
ekegusii: Inee! Tari okoboko kwane gwakorete ebinto ebi bionsi?
swahili: Je, mkono wangu haukufanya vitu hivi vyote?’

english: You stiff-necked people with uncircumcised hearts and ears! You always resist the Holy Spirit, just as your fathers did.
ekegusii: “Inwe abamore nebigoti ebikong’u, motarogeti ase chinkoro, nonya namato, motaonchogeti; botambe nigo mokoamereria Omoika Omochenu. Buna chisokoro chiaino chiarenge gokora, nainwe nabo mogokora.
swahili: “Enyi watu wenye shingo ngumu, msiotahiriwa mioyo wala masikio, daima hamwachi kumpinga Roho Mtakatifu, kama walivyofanya baba zenu.

english: Which of the prophets did your fathers fail to persecute? They even killed those who foretold the coming of the Righteous One. And now you are His betrayers and murderers—
ekegusii: Ning’o ase ababani chisokoro chiaino chitachandete? Na barabwo mbaitete baria babanete amang’ana igoro y’ogocha kw’oria Omonyene Oboronge. Inwe bono mwabeire abamorua na abamoiti.
swahili: Je, kuna nabii gani ambaye baba zenu hawakumtesa? Waliwaua wale waliotabiri habari za kuja kwake yule Mwenye Haki. Nanyi sasa mmekuwa wasaliti wake na wauaji.

english: you who received the law ordained by angels, yet have not kept it.” The Stoning of Stephen
ekegusii: Inwe abamwanyorete amachiiko ayarentetwe nabamalaika, korende timwayabwata.” Ogokwa gwa Stefano
swahili: Ninyi ndio mlipokea sheria zilizoletwa kwenu na malaika, lakini hamkuzitii.” Stefano Apigwa Mawe

english: On hearing this, the members of the Sanhedrin were enraged, and they gnashed their teeth at him.
ekegusii: Ekero bachia koigwa amang’ana aya, bakagechigwa ase chinkoro chiabo ime, bakamoromananeria amaino.
swahili: Waliposikia haya wakaghadhibika, wakamsagia meno.

english: But Stephen, full of the Holy Spirit, looked intently into heaven and saw the glory of God and Jesus standing at the right hand of God.
ekegusii: Korende ere oichire n’Omoika Omochenu, akarigereria mono gochia igoro, akarora obonene bwa Nyasae, na Yeso oteneine ensemo y’okoboko gw’okorio kwa Nyasae.
swahili: Lakini yeye Stefano, akiwa amejaa Roho Mtakatifu, alikaza macho mbinguni, akaona utukufu wa Mungu, na Yesu akiwa amesimama mkono wa kuume wa Mungu.

english: “Look,” he said, “I see heaven open and the Son of Man standing at the right hand of God.”
ekegusii: Agateeba: “Rora, narorire igoro amaanokire, na Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto oteneine ensemo y’okoboko gw’okorio kwa Nyasae.”
swahili: Akasema, “Tazameni! Naona mbingu zimefunguka, na Mwana wa Adamu amesimama upande wa kuume wa Mungu.”

english: At this they covered their ears, cried out in a loud voice, and rushed together at him.
ekegusii: Korende bagaaka egeturi ase eriogi rinene, bagakuneka amato abo, bakamorindokera bonsi amo,
swahili: Lakini wao wakapiga kelele kwa sauti kubwa, wakaziba masikio yao, wakamrukia kwa nia moja.

english: They dragged him out of the city and began to stone him. Meanwhile the witnesses laid their garments at the feet of a young man named Saul.
ekegusii: bakamosokia isiko y’omochie, bakamoaka amagena. Na kirori bakabeeka chianga chiabo ase amagoro ’omomura oyomo, ore korokwa Saulo.
swahili: Wakamtupa nje ya mji, wakampiga kwa mawe. Nao mashahidi wakaweka mavazi yao miguuni mwa kijana mmoja ambaye jina lake aliitwa Sauli.

english: While they were stoning him, Stephen appealed, “Lord Jesus, receive my spirit.”
ekegusii: Bagaaka Stefano amagena ekero arenge gosaba, ogoteeba: “Omonene Yeso, ira omoika one.”
swahili: Walipokuwa wakimpiga mawe, Stefano aliomba, “Bwana Yesu, pokea roho yangu.”

english: God told him that his descendants would be foreigners in a strange land, and that they would be enslaved and mistreated four hundred years.
ekegusii: Nyasae agakwana iga: Oroiboro rwa Aburaamu inababe abamenyi ase ense y’abanto bande, na barabwo inababakore babe abasomba babo, na kobakorera bobe, ase engaki y’emiaka amagana ane.
swahili: Mungu akasema naye hivi: ‘Wazao wako watakuwa wageni kwenye nchi ambayo si yao, nao watafanywa watumwa na kuteswa kwa miaka mia nne.’

english: Falling on his knees, he cried out in a loud voice, “Lord, do not hold this sin against them.” And when he had said this, he fell asleep.
ekegusii: Akabeeka amaru inse, akarera ase eriogi rinene: “Omonene, tobabare ebibe ebi!” Ochia gokoora gokwana aya, agakwa. Na Saulo nigo aroche buya ase ogoitwa kwaye.
swahili: Kisha akapiga magoti, akalia kwa sauti kubwa akasema, “Bwana usiwahesabie dhambi hii.” Baada ya kusema hayo, akalala.

english: ‘But I will punish the nation that enslaves them,’ God said, ‘and afterward they will come forth and worship Me in this place.’
ekegusii: Nyasae agateeba: Ninkegambie ekiina egesaku keria kerabakore babe abasomba babo, na magega y’ayio nabaruo, na barabwo nabansasiimere aase aiga.
swahili: Mungu akasema, ‘Lakini mimi nitaliadhibu taifa watakalolitumikia kama watumwa, na baadaye watatoka katika nchi hiyo na wataniabudu mahali hapa.’

english: Then God gave Abraham the covenant of circumcision, and Abraham became the father of Isaac and circumcised him on the eighth day. And Isaac became the father of Jacob, and Jacob of the twelve patriarchs. Joseph Sold into Egypt (Genesis 37:12–30)
ekegusii: Akamoa okwaroka buna ekemanyererio gi’okobwatana. Erio Aburaamu akaibora Isaka, akamosara rituko ria gatano na gatato. Isaka akaibora Yakobo, na Yakobo akaibora baria ikomi na babere, abagaaka baito ba kare.
swahili: Ndipo akampa Abrahamu Agano la tohara. Naye Abrahamu akamzaa Isaki na kumtahiri siku ya nane. Baadaye Isaki akamzaa Yakobo, naye Yakobo akawazaa wale wazee wetu kumi na wawili.

english: Because the patriarchs were jealous of Joseph, they sold him as a slave into Egypt. But God was with him
ekegusii: Baria abagaaka baito ba kare bakarorera Yusufu ribero, bakamoonia gochia Misiri. Korende Nyasae akaba amo nere,
swahili: “Kwa sababu wazee wetu walimwonea wivu Yosefu ndugu yao, walimuuza kama mtumwa huko Misri. Lakini Mungu alikuwa pamoja naye.

english: And Saul was there, giving approval to Stephen’s death. On that day a great persecution broke out against the church in Jerusalem, and all except the apostles were scattered throughout Judea and Samaria.
ekegusii: Ase rituko riria emechando emenene egaacha igoro ase ekanisa ya Yerusalemu; bonsi bagaserebanigwa gochia chinse chia Boyahudi na Samaria, otatiga abatomwa bataserebaanetigwe.
swahili: Naye Sauli alikuwepo pale, akiridhia kuuawa kwa Stefano. Kanisa Lateswa Na Kutawanyika Siku ile kukatukia mateso makuu dhidi ya kanisa huko Yerusalemu, waumini wote isipokuwa mitume wakatawanyika, wakakimbilia Uyahudi na Samaria.

english: and all the people, from the least to the greatest, heeded his words and said, “This man is the divine power called the Great Power.”
ekegusii: Bonsi, abake na abanene, bakamotegerera, bagateeba: “Omonto oyo nigo are okobua koria kwa Nyasae gokorokwa Okobua Okonene.”
swahili: nao watu wote wakubwa kwa wadogo wakamsikiliza na kumaka, wakisema “Mtu huyu ndiye uweza wa Mungu ujulikanao kama ‘Uweza Mkuu.’ ”

english: They paid close attention to him because he had astounded them for a long time with his sorcery.
ekegusii: Bakamotegerera, ekiagera ase amatuko amange nigo barenge gokumia ase oborogi bwaye.
swahili: Wakamfuata kwa sababu kwa muda mrefu alikuwa amewashangaza kwa uchawi wake.

english: But when they believed Philip as he preached the gospel of the kingdom of God and the name of Jesus Christ, they were baptized, both men and women.
ekegusii: Korende ekero bachia kwegena Filipo, gakorandia amang’ana amaya igoro y’oborwoti bwa Nyasae na erieta ria Yeso Kristo, bakabatiswa, abasacha na abakungu.
swahili: Lakini watu walipomwamini Filipo alipohubiri habari njema za Ufalme wa Mungu na jina la Yesu Kristo, wakabatizwa wanaume na wanawake.

english: Even Simon himself believed and was baptized. He followed Philip closely and was astounded by the great signs and miracles he observed.
ekegusii: Nonya n’Simioni omonyene akeegena, na magega kabatisirwe akagenderera koba amo na Filipo. Ekero aroche ebikone na ogokora okonene gwe chinguru biakoretwe, agakumia. Petero na Yohana ase Samaria
swahili: Simoni naye akaamini na akabatizwa. Akamfuata Filipo kila mahali, akistaajabishwa na ishara kuu na miujiza aliyoiona.

english: When the apostles in Jerusalem heard that Samaria had received the word of God, they sent Peter and John to them.
ekegusii: Na ekero abatomwa ba Yerusalemu bachia koigwa ng’a Abasamaria banchire ring’ana ria Nyasae, bakabatomera Petero na Yohana.
swahili: Basi mitume waliokuwa Yerusalemu waliposikia kuwa Samaria wamelipokea neno la Mungu, wakawatuma Petro na Yohana waende huko.

english: On their arrival, they prayed for them to receive the Holy Spirit.
ekegusii: Barabwo bagatirimboka, bakabasabera, erinde banyore Omoika Omochenu,
swahili: Nao walipofika wakawaombea ili wampokee Roho Mtakatifu,

english: For the Holy Spirit had not yet fallen upon any of them; they had simply been baptized into the name of the Lord Jesus.
ekegusii: ekiagera konya torabaikera nonya noyomo obo. Barabwo nigo baabatisetwe rioka ase erieta ri’Omonene Yeso.
swahili: kwa sababu Roho Mtakatifu alikuwa bado hajawashukia hata mmoja ila wamebatizwa tu katika jina la Bwana Yesu.

english: Then Peter and John laid their hands on them, and they received the Holy Spirit.
ekegusii: Erio Petero na Yohana bakababeekera amaboko abo, na barabwo bakanyora Omoika Omochenu.
swahili: Ndipo Petro na Yohana wakaweka mikono yao juu ya wale waliobatizwa, nao wakapokea Roho Mtakatifu.

english: When Simon saw that the Spirit was given through the laying on of the apostles’ hands, he offered them money.
ekegusii: Ekero Simioni achia korora ng’a abanto nigo bakoegwa Omoika ase okobeekerwa amaboko nabatomwa, akabarentera chitaabu,
swahili: Simoni alipoona kuwa watu wanapokea Roho Mtakatifu mitume walipoweka mikono juu yao, akataka kuwapa fedha

english: “Give me this power as well,” he said, “so that everyone on whom I lay my hands may receive the Holy Spirit.”
ekegusii: agateeba: “Ing’a nainche okobua oko, ng’a kera omonto ndabeekere amaboko aane anyore Omoika Omochenu.”
swahili: akisema, “Nipeni na mimi uwezo huu ili kila mtu nitakayeweka mikono yangu juu yake apate kupokea Roho Mtakatifu.”

english: God-fearing men buried Stephen and mourned deeply over him.
ekegusii: Abanto abeegeni bagatindeka Stefano, bakamoreera okorera okonene.
swahili: Watu wacha Mungu wakamzika Stefano na kumwombolezea sana.

english: But Peter replied, “May your silver perish with you, because you thought you could buy the gift of God with money!
ekegusii: Korende Petero akamoteebia: “Chifeta chiao chisire amo naye, ekiagera okagete ng’a nonyore ekeegwa kia Nyasae ase chitaabu!
swahili: Petro akamjibu, “Fedha yako na iangamie pamoja nawe, kwa sababu ulidhani unaweza kununua karama ya Mungu kwa fedha!

english: You have no part or share in our ministry, because your heart is not right before God.
ekegusii: Tori negetari gose nensemo ase ring’ana eri, ekiagera enkoro yao teri boronge ase obosio bwa Nyasae.
swahili: Wewe huna sehemu wala fungu katika huduma hii kwa kuwa moyo wako si mnyofu mbele za Mungu.

english: Repent, therefore, of your wickedness, and pray to the Lord. Perhaps He will forgive you for the intent of your heart.
ekegusii: Ase ayio onchoka korwa ase obobe bwao obo, osabe Omonene, erinde, keranyarekane, bwaberwe ebirengererio bi’enkoro yao.
swahili: Kwa hiyo tubu kwa uovu huu wako na umwombe Bwana. Yamkini aweza kukusamehe mawazo uliyo nayo moyoni mwako.

english: For I see that you are poisoned by bitterness and captive to iniquity.”
ekegusii: Naki nakororire ng’a nore nobororo buna endorwe, naende nigo ore ase egesibo ki’ebibe.”
swahili: Kwa maana ninaona kwamba wewe umejawa na uchungu na ni mfungwa wa dhambi.”

english: Then Simon answered, “Pray to the Lord for me, so that nothing you have said may happen to me.”
ekegusii: Simioni akairaneria: “Insabera inwe ase Omonene, ng’a amang’ana aya mwakwanire tabaisa gocha konyora nonya nerimo riabo.”
swahili: Ndipo Simoni akajibu, “Niombeeni kwa Bwana, ili hayo mliyosema lolote yasinitukie.”

english: And after Peter and John had testified and spoken the word of the Lord, they returned to Jerusalem, preaching the gospel in many of the Samaritan villages. Philip and the Ethiopian (Isaiah 53:1–8)
ekegusii: Erio kabaorokirie oborori na korandia ring’ana ri’Omonene, bakairana Yerusalemu, bakorandia amang’ana amaya ase ebichie ebinge bi’Abasamaria. Filipo na Omoetiopia omogomba
swahili: Nao walipokwisha kutoa ushuhuda na kuhubiri neno la Bwana, wakarudi Yerusalemu wakihubiri Injili katika vijiji vingi vya Samaria. Filipo Na Towashi Wa Kushi

english: Now an angel of the Lord said to Philip, “Get up and go south to the desert road that goes down from Jerusalem to Gaza.”
ekegusii: Omomalaika Omonene agateebia Filipo: “Imoka ogende ensemo ya Irianyi goika enchera eria egotirimboka korwa Yerusalemu ekogenda Gasa.” Eye nenchera y’erooro.
swahili: Basi malaika wa Bwana akamwambia Filipo, “Nenda upande wa kusini kwenye ile barabara itokayo Yerusalemu kuelekea Gaza ambayo ni jangwa.”

english: So he started out, and on his way he met an Ethiopian eunuch, a court official in charge of the entire treasury of Candace, queen of the Ethiopians. He had gone to Jerusalem to worship,
ekegusii: Akaimoka, akagenda. Na rora, ekero are inchera, akarora omonto bw’Ethiopia, omokoreri, oyobegetwe igoro y’enibo yonsi ya Kandake, enting’ana ya Ethiopia. Ere nigo agendete Yerusalemu gosasiima.
swahili: Hivyo akaondoka. Akiwa njiani akakutana na towashi wa Kushi, aliyekuwa afisa mkuu, mwenye mamlaka juu ya hazina zote za Kandake, Malkia wa Kushi. Huyu towashi alikuwa amekwenda Yerusalemu ili kuabudu,

english: and on his return was sitting in his chariot reading Isaiah the prophet.
ekegusii: Ekero arenge koirana na oikaransete ase egari yaye, nigo arenge gosoma egetabu y’omobani Isaya.
swahili: naye akiwa njiani kurudi nyumbani alikuwa ameketi garini mwake akisoma kitabu cha nabii Isaya.

english: The Spirit said to Philip, “Go over to that chariot and stay by it.”
ekegusii: Erio Omoika ogateebia Filipo: “Genda ang’e negari eyio, ogende nero.”
swahili: Roho Mtakatifu akamwambia Filipo, “Nenda kwenye lile gari ukae karibu nalo.”

english: But Saul began to destroy the church. Going from house to house, he dragged off men and women and put them in prison. Philip in Samaria
ekegusii: Korende Saulo agasaria ekanisa, agasoa kera enyomba akaba ogokurura abasacha na abakungu, na kobaira ase echela. Filipo ase Samaria
swahili: Lakini kwa habari ya Sauli alikuwa analiharibu kanisa, akiingia nyumba kwa nyumba, akiwaburuta wanawake na wanaume na kuwatupa gerezani. Filipo Ahubiri Injili Samaria

english: So Philip ran up and heard the man reading Isaiah the prophet. “Do you understand what you are reading?” Philip asked.
ekegusii: Filipo akaminyoka gochia asare, akamoigwa ogosoma egetabu y’omobani Isaya, akamobooria: “Inee! Kwamanyire buya aya ogosoma?”
swahili: Ndipo Filipo akakimbilia lile gari na kumsikia yule mtu anasoma kitabu cha nabii Isaya. Filipo akamuuliza, “Je, unaelewa hayo usomayo?”

english: “How can I,” he said, “unless someone guides me?” And he invited Philip to come up and sit with him.
ekegusii: Akamoiraneria: “Naki ndanyare komanya otatiga omonto antang’ane?” Agateebia Filipo ariine, aikaranse amo nere.
swahili: Yule towashi akasema, “Nitawezaje kuelewa mtu asiponifafanulia?” Hivyo akamkaribisha Filipo ili apande na kuketi pamoja naye.

english: The eunuch was reading this passage of Scripture: “He was led like a sheep to the slaughter, and as a lamb before the shearer is silent, so He did not open His mouth.
ekegusii: Amang’ana e ririiko ayarenge gosoma naro aya: “Akairwa buna eng’ondi egochia konyenywa, na buna emanwa etari kwana ase omonachi bw’amarionya, naboigo tamaanorete omonwa oye.
swahili: Huyu towashi alikuwa anasoma fungu hili la Maandiko: “Aliongozwa kama kondoo aendaye machinjoni, kama mwana-kondoo anyamazavyo mbele yake yule amkataye manyoya, hivyo hakufungua kinywa chake.

english: In His humiliation He was deprived of justice. Who can recount His descendants? For His life was removed from the earth.”
ekegusii: Ase ogwekeyia kwaye ekiina kiaye gekarusigwa. Ning’o oranyare gototeebia ororeria rwaye? Ekiagera obogima bwaye bwarusigwe ase ense.”
swahili: Katika kufedheheshwa kwake alinyimwa haki yake. Nani awezaye kueleza juu ya kizazi chake? Kwa maana maisha yake yaliondolewa kutoka duniani.”
