english: “Tell me,” said the eunuch, “who is the prophet talking about, himself or someone else?”
ekegusii: Omogomba oria akaboria Filipo: “Koranche onteebie igoro ya ng’o omobani oyo agokwana, igoro yaye omonyene gose igoro y’omonto onde?”
swahili: Yule towashi akamuuliza Filipo, “Tafadhali niambie, nabii huyu anena habari zake mwenyewe au habari za mtu mwingine?”

english: Then Philip began with this very Scripture and told him the good news about Jesus.
ekegusii: Filipo agachaaka gokwana; agachakera korwa ase ririiko eri, akamoranderia amang’ana amaya igoro ya Yeso.
swahili: Ndipo Filipo akaanza kutumia fungu lile la Maandiko, akamweleza habari njema za Yesu.

english: As they traveled along the road and came to some water, the eunuch said, “Look, here is water! What is there to prevent me from being baptized?”
ekegusii: Ekero bagendererete inchera, bagaika aase amaache arenge. Oria omogomba akabora: “Rora amaache aya! Inki kegontanga timbatiswa?” [
swahili: Walipokuwa wakiendelea na safari wakafika mahali palipokuwa na maji, yule towashi akamuuliza Filipo, “Tazama, hapa kuna maji. Kitu gani kitanizuia nisibatizwe?” [

english: And he gave orders to stop the chariot. Then both Philip and the eunuch went down into the water, and Philip baptized him.
ekegusii: Agachiika egari eria etenene, na bonsi babere, Filipo na oria omogomba, bagatirimboka gochia ase amaache ime, erio Filipo akamobatisa.
swahili: Naye akaamuru lile gari lisimamishwe. Wakateremka kwenye maji wote wawili, yule towashi na Filipo, naye Filipo akambatiza.

english: When they came up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord carried Philip away, and the eunuch saw him no more, but went on his way rejoicing.
ekegusii: Ekero bachia korwa ase amaache, Omoika bw’Omonene ogataboria Filipo; omogomba oria tamorora naende, korende nigo agendete enchera yaye ore nomogooko.
swahili: Nao walipopanda kutoka kwenye maji, ghafula Roho wa Bwana akamnyakua Filipo, naye towashi hakumwona tena, lakini akaenda zake akifurahi.

english: Those who had been scattered preached the word wherever they went.
ekegusii: Na baria baserebaanetigwe bakagenda chinsemo ne chinsemo, bakarandia ring’ana ria Nyasae.
swahili: Kwa hiyo wale waliotawanyika wakalihubiri neno la Mungu kila mahali walipokwenda.

english: But Philip appeared at Azotus and traveled through that region, preaching the gospel in all the towns until he came to Caesarea.
ekegusii: Korende Filipo akarorekana ase Asoto, na ekero arenge goeta, akarandia enchiri ase emechie yonsi, goika agaika Kaisaria.
swahili: Filipo akajikuta yuko Azoto, akasafiri akihubiri Injili katika miji yote mpaka alipofika Kaisaria.

english: Philip went down to a city in Samaria and proclaimed the Christ to them.
ekegusii: Filipo agatirimboka, agasoa omochie o Samaria, akabaranderia Kristo.
swahili: Filipo akateremkia mji mmoja wa Samaria akawahubiria habari za Kristo

english: The crowds gave their undivided attention to Philip’s message and to the signs they saw him perform.
ekegusii: Emeganda yonsi ase omoyo oyomo bagategerera amang’ana onsi Filipo are gokwana, ekero bamoigwete na korora ebikone ebiarenge gokora.
swahili: Watu walipomsikia Filipo na kuona ishara na miujiza aliyofanya, wakasikiliza kwa bidii yale aliyosema.

english: With loud shrieks, unclean spirits came out of many who were possessed, and many of the paralyzed and lame were healed.
ekegusii: Ekiagera abange babwatire nebirecha bi’eubi, na ebirecha ebi bikarwa ase bare, bikarera ase egeturi ekenene; abanto abarenge amagata, na baria barenge ebirema bakagwenigwa.
swahili: Pepo wachafu wakawa wakiwatoka watu wengi huku wakipiga kelele na wengi waliopooza na viwete wakaponywa.

english: So there was great joy in that city. Simon the Sorcerer (Deuteronomy 18:9–14)
ekegusii: Ase igo omogooko omonene okaba ase omochie oria. Simioni omoorogi
swahili: Hivyo pakawa na furaha kuu katika mji huo. Simoni Mchawi

english: Prior to that time, a man named Simon had practiced sorcery in the city and astounded the people of Samaria. He claimed to be someone great,
ekegusii: Omonto oyomo ore korokwa Simioni, agwo ritang’ani nigo arenge gokora oborogi ase omochie oria; abanto ba Samaria bakamokumia, ekero are goteeba ng’a ere omonyene nomonto omonene.
swahili: Basi mtu mmoja jina lake Simoni alikuwa amefanya uchawi kwa muda mrefu katika mji huo akiwashangaza watu wote wa Samaria. Alijitapa kwamba yeye ni mtu mkuu,

english: Meanwhile, Saul was still breathing out murderous threats against the disciples of the Lord. He approached the high priest
ekegusii: Korende ase chingaki echio Saulo akamenta kobagosa na korengereria goita aborokigwa bw’Omonene. Akagenda ase Omokuani omonene,
swahili: Wakati ule ule, Sauli alikuwa bado anazidisha vitisho vya kuua wanafunzi wa Bwana, akamwendea kuhani mkuu,

english: In Damascus there was a disciple named Ananias. The Lord spoke to him in a vision, “Ananias!” “Here I am, Lord,” he answered.
ekegusii: Ase Damesiki narengeo omworokigwa ore korokwa Anania. Omonene akamoteebia ase chindoto: “Anania!” Ere akairaneria: “Omonene nao inde aiga.”
swahili: Huko Dameski alikuwepo mwanafunzi mmoja jina lake Anania. Bwana alimwita katika maono, “Anania!” Akajibu, “Mimi hapa Bwana.”

english: “Get up!” the Lord told him. “Go to the house of Judas on Straight Street and ask for a man from Tarsus named Saul, for he is praying.
ekegusii: Omonene akamoteebia: “Imoka ogende enchera eria Endonge, origie ime ase enyomba ya Yudasi omonto okorokwa Saulo o Tariso; rora, nao are agosaba.
swahili: Bwana akamwambia, “Ondoka uende katika barabara iitwayo Nyofu ukaulize katika nyumba ya Yuda mtu kutoka Tarso, jina lake Sauli, kwa maana wakati huu anaomba,

english: In a vision he has seen a man named Ananias come and place his hands on him to restore his sight.”
ekegusii: Na ere ase okorora ororire omonto okorokwa Anania ogosoa, okomobekera amaboko, anyare korora.”
swahili: katika maono amemwona mtu aitwaye Anania akija na kuweka mikono juu yake ili apate kuona tena.”

english: But Ananias answered, “Lord, many people have told me about this man and all the harm he has done to Your saints in Jerusalem.
ekegusii: Korende Anania akairaneria: “Omonene, naigure korwa ase abanto abange igoro y’omonto oyo, buna akoreire abachenu bao Yerusalemu amabe amange.
swahili: Anania akajibu, “Bwana, nimesikia kutoka kwa watu wengi habari nyingi kuhusu mtu huyu na madhara yote aliyowatendea watakatifu wako huko Yerusalemu.

english: And now he is here with authority from the chief priests to arrest all who call on Your name.”
ekegusii: Aiga nigo are nokobua korwa ase abakuani abanene asibe abanto bonsi baria bakorangeria erieta riao.”
swahili: Naye amekuja hapa Dameski akiwa na mamlaka kutoka kwa viongozi wa makuhani ili awakamate wote wanaotaja jina lako.”

english: “Go!” said the Lord. “This man is My chosen instrument to carry My name before the Gentiles and their kings, and before the people of Israel.
ekegusii: Korende Omonene akamoteebia: “Genda aye rioka, ekiagera oyio nomokoreri one omochore, aire erieta riane gochia ase abanto b’Ebisaku, na ase abarwoti, na ase Abaisraeli.
swahili: Lakini Bwana akamwambia Anania, “Nenda! Mtu huyu ni chombo changu kiteule nilichokichagua, apate kulichukua Jina langu kwa watu wa Mataifa na wafalme wao na mbele ya watu wa Israeli.

english: I will show him how much he must suffer for My name.”
ekegusii: Inche nimworokie onsi ayaramogwenere gochandwa ase engencho y’erieta riane.”
swahili: Nami nitamwonyesha jinsi impasavyo kuteseka kwa ajili ya Jina langu.”

english: So Ananias went to the house, and when he arrived, he placed his hands on Saul. “Brother Saul,” he said, “the Lord Jesus, who appeared to you on the road as you were coming here, has sent me so that you may see again and be filled with the Holy Spirit.”
ekegusii: Anania akagenda, agasoa nyomba ime. Akamobekera amaboko aye, akabora: “Oyominto Saulo, Omonene Yeso, ere oyokoorokerete ase enchera kware gochera, ontomire, erinde onyare korora naende, na oichorwe n’Omoika Omochenu.”
swahili: Kisha Anania akaenda kwenye ile nyumba, akaingia ndani. Akaweka mikono yake juu ya Sauli akasema, “Ndugu Sauli, Bwana Yesu aliyekutokea njiani amenituma kwako ili upate kuona tena na ujazwe Roho Mtakatifu.”

english: At that instant, something like scales fell from Saul’s eyes, and his sight was restored. He got up and was baptized,
ekegusii: Erio kegima ebinto buna amasabo bikagwa korwa ase amaiso aye, akanyora okorora, agatenena, akabatiswa,
swahili: Ghafula vitu kama magamba vikaanguka chini, kutoka machoni mwa Sauli, akapata kuona tena. Akasimama, akabatizwa.

english: and after taking some food, he regained his strength. And he spent several days with the disciples in Damascus. Saul Preaches at Damascus
ekegusii: akaragera, akanyora chinguru. Akaba agwo amatuko atari make amo naborokigwa abarenge Damesiki.
swahili: Baada ya kula chakula, akapata nguvu tena. Sauli akakaa siku kadhaa pamoja na wanafunzi huko Dameski. Sauli Ahubiri Dameski

english: and requested letters to the synagogues in Damascus, so that if he found any men or women belonging to the Way, he could bring them as prisoners to Jerusalem.
ekegusii: akamobooria amoe amarube ariikire ase chisinagogi chia Damesiki, erinde onye okonyora abanto b’Enchera eye, abasacha gose abakungu, abasibe na kobarenta Yerusalemu.
swahili: naye akamwomba kuhani mkuu ampe barua za kwenda kwenye masinagogi huko Dameski, ili akimkuta mtu yeyote wa Njia Ile, akiwa mwanaume au mwanamke, aweze kuwafunga na kuwaleta Yerusalemu.

english: Saul promptly began to proclaim Jesus in the synagogues, declaring, “He is the Son of God.”
ekegusii: Erio agwo kegima akamorandia Yeso ase chisinagogi, okobora: “Ere n’Omwana o Nyasae.”
swahili: Papo hapo akaanza kuhubiri kwenye masinagogi kwamba “Yesu Kristo ni Mwana wa Mungu”

english: All who heard him were astounded and asked, “Isn’t this the man who wreaked havoc in Jerusalem on those who call on this name? And hasn’t he come here to take them as prisoners to the chief priests?”
ekegusii: Na bonsi abamoigwete bagakumia, bagateeba: “Tari ere oyo orenge Yerusalemu goteema goita abare korangeria erieta eri? Naende aiga, erinde abasibe, abaire ase abakuani abanene?”
swahili: Watu wote waliomsikia Sauli walishangaa na kuuliza, “Huyu si yule mtu aliyesababisha maangamizi makuu huko Yerusalemu miongoni mwa watu waliolitaja jina hili? Naye si amekuja hapa kwa kusudi la kuwakamata na kuwapeleka wakiwa wafungwa mbele ya viongozi wa makuhani?”

english: But Saul was empowered all the more, and he confounded the Jews living in Damascus by proving that Jesus is the Christ. The Escape from Damascus
ekegusii: Korende Saulo akagenderera komenteka koba ne chinguru, agatantania Abayahudi abamenyete Damesiki, ase okoorokia ekeene ng’a Yeso nere Kristo.
swahili: Sauli akazidi kuwa hodari na kuwashangaza Wayahudi walioishi Dameski kwa kuthibitisha kuwa Yesu ndiye Kristo.

english: After many days had passed, the Jews conspired to kill him,
ekegusii: Ekero amatuko amange aetire, Abayahudi bakamogamba, erinde banyare komoita,
swahili: Baada ya siku nyingi kupita, Wayahudi wakafanya shauri kumuua Sauli.

english: but Saul learned of their plot. Day and night they watched the city gates in order to kill him.
ekegusii: korende okogamba kwabo gokamanyekana na Saulo. Bakamoboera ase ebiita omobaso na obotuko, erinde banyare komoita.
swahili: Lakini shauri lao likajulikana kwa Sauli. Wayahudi wakawa wanalinda malango yote ya mji, usiku na mchana ili wapate kumuua.

english: One night, however, his disciples took him and lowered him in a basket through a window in the wall. Saul in Jerusalem
ekegusii: Korende aborokigwa baye bakamoira botuko na komoikeria ase orwaki, ore egetonga ime. Saulo ore ase Yerusalemu na Tariso
swahili: Lakini wafuasi wake wakamchukua usiku wakamshusha akiwa ndani ya kapu kupitia mahali penye nafasi ukutani. Sauli Huko Yerusalemu

english: When Saul arrived in Jerusalem, he tried to join the disciples, but they were all afraid of him, not believing that he was a disciple.
ekegusii: Ekero achia goika Yerusalemu agateema kobwatana naborokigwa; na barabwo bonsi bakamoiroka, ekiagera tibanchete ng’a ere nomworokigwa arenge.
swahili: Sauli alipofika Yerusalemu akajaribu kujiunga na wanafunzi lakini wote walimwogopa, kwa maana hawakuamini kwamba kweli naye alikuwa mwanafunzi.

english: Then Barnabas brought him to the apostles and described how Saul had seen the Lord, who spoke to him on the road to Damascus, and how Saul had spoken boldly in that city in the name of Jesus.
ekegusii: Korende Barnaba akamobwata okoboko, akamoira ase abatomwa, akabateebereria buna Saulo aroche Omonene nchera, naende ng’a Omonene nakwanete nere, na buna arandetie noboremu ase Damesiki ase erieta ria Yeso.
swahili: Lakini Barnaba akamchukua, akampeleka kwa wale mitume. Akawaeleza jinsi Sauli akiwa njiani alivyomwona Bwana, jinsi Bwana alivyosema naye na jinsi alivyohubiri kwa ujasiri kwa jina la Yesu huko Dameski.

english: So Saul stayed with them, moving about freely in Jerusalem and speaking boldly in the name of the Lord.
ekegusii: Saulo akaba amo nabarabwo ase Yerusalemu, agasoa na gosoka,
swahili: Kwa hiyo Sauli akakaa nao akitembea kwa uhuru kila mahali huko Yerusalemu, akihubiri kwa ujasiri katika jina la Bwana.

english: He talked and debated with the Grecian Jews, but they tried to kill him.
ekegusii: akarandia noboremu ase erieta ri’Omonene. Agakwana na koamererania n’Abayahudi abarenge gokwana Ekegiriki, korende barabwo bakarigia komoita.
swahili: Alinena na kuhojiana na Wayahudi wenye asili ya Kiyunani lakini wao walijaribu kumuua.

english: As Saul drew near to Damascus on his journey, suddenly a light from heaven flashed around him.
ekegusii: Ekero arenge kogenda, gaikire ang’e na Damesiki, erio mobasokano amasase akarwa igoro, akamomesera korwa chinsemo chionsi.
swahili: Basi akiwa katika safari yake, alipokaribia Dameski, ghafula nuru kutoka mbinguni ikamwangaza kotekote.

english: When the brothers learned of this, they took him down to Caesarea and sent him off to Tarsus. The Healing of Aeneas
ekegusii: Ekero abamwabo bachia konyora amang’ana aya, bakamoira goika Kaisaria, bakamotoma agende Tariso.
swahili: Wale ndugu walipopata habari wakampeleka hadi Kaisaria, wakamsafirisha kwenda Tarso.

english: Then the church throughout Judea, Galilee, and Samaria experienced a time of peace. It grew in strength and numbers, living in the fear of the Lord and the encouragement of the Holy Spirit.
ekegusii: Erio ekanisa ekanyora omorembe ase chinsemo chionsi chia Boyahudi, na Galili, na Samaria. Ekagenderera koagachwa ase okoiroka kw’Omonene, na ase okoremia kw’Omoika Omochenu ekamentekana. Okogwenia gwa Petero ase Lida
swahili: Ndipo kanisa katika Uyahudi wote, Galilaya na Samaria likafurahia wakati wa amani. Likatiwa nguvu, na kwa faraja ya Roho Mtakatifu, idadi yake ikazidi kuongezeka, na likaendelea kudumu katika kumcha Bwana. Matendo Ya Petro (9:32–12:25) Kuponywa Kwa Ainea

english: As Peter traveled throughout the area, he went to visit the saints in Lydda.
ekegusii: Ekero Petero are goetanana ase chinsemo chionsi, agatirimboka gochia ase abachenu abamenyete Lida.
swahili: Petro alipokuwa akisafiri sehemu mbalimbali, alikwenda kuwatembelea watakatifu walioishi huko Lida.

english: There he found a man named Aeneas, who had been paralyzed and bedridden for eight years.
ekegusii: Akanyora omonto oyomo aroro ore korokwa Ainea. Omonto oyio konya obeire ekeoru borere ase engaki y’emiaka etano na etato, are rigata.
swahili: Huko alimkuta mtu mmoja aitwaye Ainea, ambaye alikuwa amepooza na kwa muda wa miaka minane alikuwa hajaondoka kitandani.

english: “Aeneas,” Peter said to him, “Jesus Christ heals you! Get up and put away your mat.” Immediately Aeneas got up,
ekegusii: Petero akamoteebia: “Ainea, Yeso Kristo okogwenirie; imoka bware oborere bwao!” Erio kegima akaimoka.
swahili: Petro akamwambia, “Ainea, Yesu Kristo anakuponya, inuka utandike kitanda chako.” Mara Ainea akainuka.

english: and all who lived in Lydda and Sharon saw him and turned to the Lord. The Raising of Tabitha (John 11:38–44)
ekegusii: Na abanto bonsi abamenyete Lida na Saroni bakamorora, bakaonchokera Omonene. Dorika okoiranerigwa obogima
swahili: Watu wote wa Lida na Sharoni walipomwona Ainea akitembea wakamgeukia Bwana. Petro Amfufua Dorkasi

english: In Joppa there was a disciple named Tabitha (which is translated as Dorcas), who was always occupied with works of kindness and charity.
ekegusii: Ase Yopa narengeo omworokigwa oyomo ore korokwa Tabitha, engencho yaye Dorika, gose Engabi. Omokungu oyio nigo arenge oichire nogokora okuya na ebiegwa ebi arenge korua.
swahili: Huko Yafa palikuwa na mwanafunzi jina lake Tabitha (ambalo kwa Kiyunani ni Dorkasi ). Huyu alikuwa mkarimu sana, akitenda mema na kuwasaidia maskini.

english: At that time, however, she became sick and died, and her body was washed and placed in an upper room.
ekegusii: Ase amatuko aria akarwara, agakwa. Ekero bamosibirie bakamobeka akanyomba ka irongo.
swahili: Wakati huo akaugua, akafa na wakiisha kuuosha mwili wake wakauweka katika chumba cha ghorofani.

english: Since Lydda was near Joppa, the disciples heard that Peter was there and sent two men to urge him, “Come to us without delay.”
ekegusii: Ekiagera Lida nigo orenge ang’e na Yopa, na aborokigwa konya baigure ng’a Petero nao are aria, bagatoma abanto babere asare komosorora na komoteebia: “Koranche, totebana gocha ase tore.”
swahili: Kwa kuwa Yafa hapakuwa mbali sana na Lida, wanafunzi waliposikia kwamba Petro yuko huko waliwatuma watu wawili kwake ili kumwomba, “Tafadhali njoo huku pasipo kukawia.”

english: So Peter got up and went with them. On his arrival, they took him to the upper room. All the widows stood around him, weeping and showing him the tunics and other clothing that Dorcas had made while she was still with them.
ekegusii: Petero akaimoka, akagenda amo nabarabwo. Ekero aikire aroro, bakamoira akanyomba ka irongo. Ababoraka bonsi bagatenena ang’e nere bakorera, na komworokia chiganchwa ne chianga echi Dorika arenge koroisia ekero arenge amo nabarabwo.
swahili: Kwa hiyo Petro akainuka akaenda nao, naye alipowasili, wakampeleka hadi kwenye chumba cha ghorofani alipokuwa amelazwa. Wajane wengi walisimama karibu naye wakilia na kuonyesha majoho na nguo nyingine ambazo Dorkasi alikuwa amewashonea alipokuwa pamoja nao.

english: He fell to the ground and heard a voice say to him, “Saul, Saul, why do you persecute Me?”
ekegusii: Akagwa inse, akaigwa eriogi rikomoteebia: “Saulo, Saulo, nase ki ogonchanda iga?”
swahili: Akaanguka chini, akasikia sauti ikimwambia, “Sauli, Sauli, mbona unanitesa?”

english: Then Peter sent them all out of the room. He knelt down and prayed, and turning toward her body, he said, “Tabitha, get up!” She opened her eyes, and seeing Peter, she sat up.
ekegusii: Petero akabasokia bonsi isiko, agatung’ama, agasaba. Akeonchora gochia ase egetondo, agateeba: “Tabitha, imoka!” Na ere akaramokia amaiso aye; ekero arora Petero, akaboka, agaikaransa.
swahili: Petro akawatoa wote nje ya kile chumba, kisha akapiga magoti akaomba, akaugeukia ule mwili akasema, “Tabitha, inuka.” Akafumbua macho yake na alipomwona Petro, akaketi.

english: Peter took her by the hand and helped her up. Then he called the saints and widows and presented her to them alive.
ekegusii: Petero akamoa okoboko kwaye, akamoimokia. Erio akarangeria abachenu baria na ababoraka, akamorenta ase bare ore moyo.
swahili: Petro akamshika mkono akamwinua, ndipo akawaita wale watakatifu na wajane akamkabidhi kwao akiwa hai.

english: This became known all over Joppa, and many people believed in the Lord.
ekegusii: Aya akamanyekana ase Yopa, ase omochie omogima, na abanto abange bakamwege n’Omonene.
swahili: Habari hizi zikajulikana sehemu zote za Yafa na watu wengi wakamwamini Bwana.

english: And Peter stayed for several days in Joppa with a tanner named Simon.
ekegusii: Petero akamenya Yopa amatuko atai make ase enyomba y’omonto oyomo ore korokwa Simioni, omooroisia bw’amao.
swahili: Petro akakaa Yafa kwa siku nyingi akiishi na Simoni mtengenezaji ngozi.

english: “Who are You, Lord?” Saul asked. “I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting,” He replied.
ekegusii: Akamoboria: “Naye ng’o Omonene?” Akairaneria: “Ninche Yeso, oyo gwachandire aye,
swahili: Sauli akajibu, “U nani wewe, Bwana?” Ile sauti ikajibu, “Mimi ni Yesu unayemtesa.

english: “Now get up and go into the city, and you will be told what you must do.”
ekegusii: korende imoka osoe omochie, noteebigwe ayarakogwenere okore.”
swahili: Sasa inuka uingie mjini, nawe utaambiwa yakupasayo kutenda.”

english: The men traveling with Saul stood there speechless. They heard the voice but did not see anyone.
ekegusii: Abanto abagendete amo nere bagatenena, bagakira‐kiri; bakaigwa eriogi, korende tibarora monto.
swahili: Watu waliokuwa wakisafiri pamoja na Sauli wakasimama bila kuwa na la kusema, kwa sababu walisikia sauti lakini hawakumwona aliyekuwa akizungumza.

english: Saul got up from the ground, but when he opened his eyes he could not see a thing. So they led him by the hand into Damascus.
ekegusii: Saulo akaimoka korwa inse, korende ekero achia koramokia amaiso aye tarora gento. Bakamobwata okoboko, bakamoira Damesiki.
swahili: Sauli akainuka kutoka pale chini na alipojaribu kufungua macho yake hakuweza kuona kitu chochote. Basi wakamshika mkono wakamwongoza mpaka Dameski.

english: For three days he was without sight, and he did not eat or drink anything. Ananias Baptizes Saul
ekegusii: Akaba omouko amatuko atato, atari koria, nonya nkonywa. Saulo ase omochie o Damesiki
swahili: Naye kwa muda wa siku tatu alikuwa kipofu naye hakula wala kunywa chochote.

english: These are the words of Amos, who was among the sheepherders of Tekoa—what he saw concerning Israel two years before the earthquake, in the days when Uzziah was king of Judah and Jeroboam son of Jehoash was king of Israel.
ekegusii: Aya naro amang’ana Amos, oyomo bw’abarisia ba Tekoa, arooche. Nyasae nigo amoorokeretie Amos amang’ana aya onsi igoro ya Israeli emiaka ebere ekero omotengecho bw’ense konya otaracha. Ekero ekio Usia nere orenge omorwoti bw’Abayuda, na Yeroboamu, mosinto o Yehoasi, nere orenge omorwoti bw’Abaisraeli.
swahili: Maneno ya Amosi, mmoja wa wachunga wanyama wa Tekoa: yale aliyoyaona kuhusu Israeli miaka miwili kabla ya tetemeko la ardhi, wakati Uzia alikuwa mfalme wa Yuda, na Yeroboamu mwana wa Yehoashi alikuwa mfalme wa Israeli.

english: So I will send fire upon the walls of Tyre to consume its citadels.”
ekegusii: Ase ayio nintome omorero ase chindwaki chia Turo; oro nosambe osirie chinyomba chinkong’u chi’aroro.” Edomu.
swahili: Nitatuma moto kwenye kuta za Tiro ambao utateketeza ngome zake.”

english: This is what the LORD says: “For three transgressions of Edom, even four, I will not revoke My judgment, because he pursued his brother with the sword and stifled all compassion; his anger raged continually, and his fury flamed incessantly.
ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene ateebire: “Ase engencho y’ogosaria kw’ abanto ba Edomu ara gatato, ee, ara kane, tingotanga egesusuro tikebanyora. Barabwo nigo babwatetie abamwabo bare nemioro, tibabete namaabera nonya ng’ake; nigo bagendererete koba nendamwamu na ekeririanda botambe.
swahili: Hili ndilo Bwana asemalo: “Kwa dhambi tatu za Edomu, hata kwa dhambi nne, sitaizuia ghadhabu yangu. Kwa sababu alimfuatia ndugu yake kwa upanga, alikataa kuonyesha huruma yoyote, kwa sababu hasira yake kali iliendelea kupanda wakati wote na ghadhabu iliwaka bila kuzuiliwa.

english: So I will send fire upon Teman to consume the citadels of Bozrah.”
ekegusii: Ase ayio nintome omorero ase omochie o Temani; oro nosambe osirie chinyomba chinkong’u chia Bosira.” Amoni.
swahili: Nitatuma moto juu ya Temani ambao utateketeza ngome za Bosra.”

english: This is what the LORD says: “For three transgressions of the Ammonites, even four, I will not revoke My judgment, because they ripped open the pregnant women of Gilead in order to enlarge their territory.
ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene ateebire: “Ase engencho y’ogosaria kw’Abaamoni ara gatato, ee, ara kane, tingotanga egesusuro tikebanyora. Barabwo nigo boorete abakungu ba Gileadi barenge barito, ekero barenge kogareyia orogongo rwabo.
swahili: Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana: “Kwa dhambi tatu za Amoni, hata kwa dhambi nne, sitaizuia ghadhabu yangu. Kwa sababu aliwatumbua wanawake wajawazito wa Gileadi ili kuongeza mipaka yake.

english: So I will kindle a fire in the walls of Rabbah to consume its citadels amid war cries on the day of battle and a violent wind on the day of tempest.
ekegusii: Ase ayio nintongie omorero ase chindwaki chia Raba; nisambe insirie chinyomba chinkong’u chi’aroro. Ase rituko erio ebikuuro bi’eseegi mbiigugwe, boigo ndibe rituko ri’omwaga na ekembugu‐mbugu.
swahili: Nitatuma moto kwenye kuta za Raba ambao utateketeza ngome zake katikati ya vilio vya vita katika siku ya mapigano, katikati ya upepo mkali katika siku ya dhoruba.

english: Their king will go into exile — he and his princes together,” says the LORD.
ekegusii: Omorwoti amo nabagaambi b’oborwoti bwaye mbooswe bairwe ase obosomba.” Nabo Omonene ateebire.
swahili: Mfalme wake atakwenda uhamishoni, yeye pamoja na maafisa wake,” asema Bwana.

english: He said: “The LORD roars from Zion and raises His voice from Jerusalem; the pastures of the shepherds mourn, and the summit of Carmel withers.”
ekegusii: Amos agateeba, “Omonene natogonye korwa Sayoni, aake eriogi riaye korwa Yerusalemu. Amarisio ’abarisia naichane, obonyansi bw’egetunwa gia Karimeli igoro mbwome.” Ekiina kia Nyasae ase abanto basinyaine n’Abaisraeli Siria.
swahili: Alisema: “ Bwana ananguruma toka Sayuni, pia ananguruma kutoka Yerusalemu; malisho ya wachunga wanyama yanakauka, kilele cha Karmeli kinanyauka.” Hukumu Juu Ya Majirani Wa Israeli

english: This is what the LORD says: “For three transgressions of Damascus, even four, I will not revoke My judgment, because they threshed Gilead with sledges of iron.
ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene ateebire: “Ase engencho y’ogosaria kw’ abanto ba Damesiki ara gatato, ee, ara kane, tingotanga egesusuro tikebanyora, ekiagera barabwo baoorire Abagileadi nebioorero bi’ebioma.
swahili: Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana: “Kwa dhambi tatu za Dameski, hata kwa dhambi nne, sitaizuia ghadhabu yangu. Kwa sababu aliipura Gileadi kwa vyombo vya chuma vyenye meno.

english: So I will send fire upon the house of Hazael to consume the citadels of Ben-hadad.
ekegusii: Ase ayio nintome omorero ase enyomba ya Hasaeli; oro nosambe osirie kegima chinyomba chinkong’u chia Beni‐Hadadi.
swahili: Nitatuma moto juu ya nyumba ya Hazaeli ambao utateketeza ngome za Ben-Hadadi.

english: I will break down the gates of Damascus; I will cut off the ruler of the Valley of Aven and the one who wields the scepter in Beth-eden. The people of Aram will be exiled to Kir,” says the LORD.
ekegusii: Nimbune emekorogoto y’ebiita bia Damesiki; ninsirie abanto bamenyete ase ense omweya y’Aveni, na oyio obwate enyimbo y’omogaambi agwo Beti‐Edeni. Abanto ba Siiria mbairwe ase obosomba gochia ase ense ya Kiri.” Nabo Omonene ateebire. Filisiti.
swahili: Nitalivunja lango la Dameski; nitamwangamiza mfalme aliyeko katika Bonde la Aveni, na yeye ambaye anaishika fimbo ya utawala katika Beth-Edeni. Watu wote wa Aramu watakwenda uhamishoni huko Kiri,” asema Bwana.

english: This is what the LORD says: “For three transgressions of Gaza, even four, I will not revoke My judgment, because they exiled a whole population, delivering them up to Edom.
ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene ateebire: “Ase engencho y’ogosaria kw’ abanto ba Gasa ara gatato, ee, ara kane, tingotanga egesusuro tikebanyora. Barabwo nigo bairete abanto egesaku ekegima gochia ase ense ya Edomu, bakabakora abasomba.
swahili: Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana: “Kwa dhambi tatu za Gaza, hata kwa dhambi nne, sitaizuia ghadhabu yangu. Kwa sababu walichukua mateka jumuiya nzima na kuwauza kwa Edomu,

english: So I will send fire upon the walls of Gaza, to consume its citadels.
ekegusii: Ase ayio nintome omorero ase chindwaki chia Gasa; oro nosambe insirie chinyomba chinkong’u chi’aroro.
swahili: nitatuma moto juu ya kuta za Gaza ambao utateketeza ngome zake.

english: I will cut off the ruler of Ashdod and the one who wields the scepter in Ashkelon. I will turn My hand against Ekron, and the remnant of the Philistines will perish,” says the Lord GOD.
ekegusii: Ninsirie abanto bamenyete Asidodi, na oyo obwate enyimbo y’obogambi agwo Asikeloni. Ning’onchore okoboko kwane kobe mamincha ya Ekironi, na abatigari b’Abafilisti mbasirigwe.” Turo.
swahili: Nitamwangamiza mfalme wa Ashdodi na yeye aishikaye fimbo ya utawala katika Ashkeloni. Nitaugeuza mkono wangu dhidi ya Ekroni, hadi Mfilisti wa mwisho atakapokufa,” asema Bwana Mwenyezi.

english: This is what the LORD says: “For three transgressions of Tyre, even four, I will not revoke My judgment, because they delivered up a whole congregation of exiles to Edom and broke a covenant of brotherhood.
ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene ateebire: “Ase engencho y’ogosaria kw’ abanto ba Turo ara gatato, ee, ara kane, tingotanga egesusuro tikebanyora. Barabwo nigo bairete abanto egesaku ekegima ase ense ya Edomu, tibainyorete okobwatana kw’ogotianania kw’obomwabo.
swahili: Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana: “Kwa dhambi tatu za Tiro, hata kwa dhambi nne, sitaizuia ghadhabu yangu. Kwa sababu ameuza jumuiya nzima ya mateka kwa Edomu, na kutokujali mapatano ya undugu,

english: This is what the LORD says: “For three transgressions of Moab, even four, I will not revoke My judgment, because he burned to lime the bones of Edom’s king.
ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene ateebire: “Ase engencho y’ogosaria kw’ abanto ba Moabu ara gatato, ee, ara kane, tingotanga egesusuro tikebanyora. Barabwo nigo basambete amauga ’omorwoti o Edomu akaba ribu.
swahili: Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana: “Kwa dhambi tatu za Moabu, hata kwa dhambi nne, sitaizuia ghadhabu yangu. Kwa sababu alichoma mifupa ya mfalme wa Edomu, ikawa kama chokaa.

english: And I brought you up from the land of Egypt and led you forty years in the wilderness, that you might take possession of the land of the Amorite.
ekegusii: Ninche nabarusetie inwe korwa ase ense ya Misiri, erio nkabaraa ase erooro ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ene, na inwe mokaira ense y’Abaamori ekaba eyaino.
swahili: “Niliwapandisha toka Misri, na nikawaongoza miaka arobaini jangwani niwape nchi ya Waamori.

english: I raised up prophets from your sons and Nazirites from your young men. Is this not true, O children of Israel?” declares the LORD.
ekegusii: Erio ngachora abana baino bande bakaba ababani, na abamura bande nkabaatanana bakaba Aberwa bane. Inwe Abaisraeli, Inee, amang’ana ayio tari bo are?” Nabo Omonene ateebire.
swahili: Pia niliinua manabii kutoka miongoni mwa wana wenu na Wanadhiri kutoka miongoni mwa vijana wenu. Je, hii si kweli, enyi watu wa Israeli?” asema Bwana.

english: “But you made the Nazirites drink wine and commanded the prophets not to prophesy.
ekegusii: “Korende inwe mokaa Aberwa abwo beritete edivai bakanywa, mogakania ababani tibaabana.
swahili: “Lakini mliwafanya Wanadhiri kunywa mvinyo na kuwaamuru manabii wasitoe unabii.

english: Behold, I am about to crush you in your place as with a cart full of grain.
ekegusii: Rora nimbaramatere gochia inse mokeme buna egari eichire chibando.
swahili: “Sasa basi, nitawaponda kama gari lipondavyo wakati limejazwa nafaka.

english: Escape will fail the swift, the strong will not prevail by his strength, and the mighty will not save his life.
ekegusii: Ekero ekio abanto bamanyete kominyoka chimbero, mbasinywe gotama, na abwo bare ne chinguru, mbaborwe chinguru, na abarwani esegi bare chituoni, tibagotooria obogima bwabo.
swahili: Mkimbiaji hodari hatanusurika, wenye nguvu wataishiwa nguvu zao, na shujaa hataweza kuokoa maisha yake.

english: The archer will not stand his ground, the fleet of foot will not escape, and the horseman will not save his life.
ekegusii: Omonto omanyete koruta chinsara, tagotenena arwane, gose oyomanyete kominyoka chimbero, tagwetooria, na omoriini ebarasi tagwetooria.
swahili: Mpiga upinde atakimbia, askari wapiga mbio hawataweza kutoroka, na mpanda farasi hataokoa maisha yake.

english: Even the bravest of mighty men will flee naked on that day,” declares the LORD.
ekegusii: Ase rituko erio omonto ore omoremu mono ase egati y’abarwani chituoni, natugute ebirwanero biaye atame ore getirianda.” Nabo Omonene ateebire.
swahili: Hata askari walio mashujaa sana siku hiyo watakimbia uchi,” asema Bwana.

english: So I will send fire against Moab to consume the citadels of Kerioth. Moab will die in tumult, amid war cries and the sound of the ram’s horn.
ekegusii: Ase ayio nintome omorero ase ense ya Moabu; oro nosambe osirie chinyomba chinkong’u chia Kerioti. Abamoabu mbakwe ase ebikuuro bi’eseegi, na ase eriogi ri’ebitureri bi’eseegi na ebi’abarwani esegi.
swahili: Nitatuma moto juu ya Moabu ambao utateketeza ngome za Keriothi. Moabu ataanguka kwa ghasia kubwa katikati ya vilio vya vita na mlio wa tarumbeta.

english: I will cut off the ruler of Moab and kill all the officials with him,” says the LORD.
ekegusii: Ninsirie omogambi ebiina o Moabu nabagaambi b’aroro.” Nabo Omonene ateebire. Yuda.
swahili: Nitamwangamiza mtawala wake na kuwaua maafisa wake wote pamoja naye,” asema Bwana.

english: This is what the LORD says: “For three transgressions of Judah, even four, I will not revoke My judgment, because they reject the Law of the LORD and fail to keep His statutes; they are led astray by the lies in which their fathers walked.
ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene ateebire: “Ase engencho y’ogosaria kw’Abayuda ara gatato, ee, ara kane, tingotanga egesusuro tikebanyora. Barabwo nigo bachaayete amachiiko ’Omonene, gose tibabwatete emeroberio yaye echiikire, korende amang’ana ’obong’ainereria bwabo, ayio chisokoro chiabo chiarenge kobwatia abasiririe.
swahili: Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana: “Kwa dhambi tatu za Yuda, hata kwa dhambi nne, sitaizuia ghadhabu yangu. Kwa sababu wameikataa sheria ya Bwana na hawakuzishika amri zake, kwa sababu wamepotoshwa na miungu ya uongo, miungu ambayo babu zao waliifuata.

english: So I will send fire upon Judah to consume the citadels of Jerusalem.”
ekegusii: Ase ayio nintome omorero ase ense y’Abayuda; nisambe insirie chinyomba chinkong’u chia Yerusalemu.” Nyasae okonachera Abaisraeli ekiina
swahili: Nitatuma moto juu ya Yuda ambao utateketeza ngome za Yerusalemu.” Hukumu Juu Ya Israeli

english: This is what the LORD says: “For three transgressions of Israel, even four, I will not revoke My judgment, because they sell the righteous for silver and the needy for a pair of sandals.
ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene ateebire: “Ase engencho y’ogosaria kw’Abaisraeli ara gatato, ee, ara kane, tingotanga egesusuro tikebanyora. Barabwo nigo baoonetie abanyene oboronge ase rigori ri’efeta ase engencho batare konyara goakana singo, na abataka bakabaonia ase engencho batare konyara goakana rigori ri’ebikoroto bibere.
swahili: Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana: “Kwa dhambi tatu za Israeli, hata kwa dhambi nne, sitaizuia ghadhabu yangu. Wanawauza wenye haki kwa fedha, na maskini kwa jozi ya viatu.

english: They trample on the heads of the poor as on the dust of the earth; they push the needy out of their way. A man and his father have relations with the same girl and so profane My holy name.
ekegusii: Abanto abwo nigo bagotiringera emetwe y’abataka nabwo batari n’echinguru ase orotu rw’ense, naende nigo bagokorekania amang’ana ’omonto omoitongo. Omomura na ise nigo bagokora obonyaka n’omosomba omoiseke oyomo, na igo bakora erieta riane riaba eritachenegeti.
swahili: Wanakanyaga juu ya vichwa vya maskini, kama vile juu ya mavumbi ya nchi, na kukataa haki kwa walioonewa. Baba na mwanawe hushiriki msichana mmoja, kwa hivyo hulinajisi Jina langu takatifu.

english: They lie down beside every altar on garments taken in pledge. And in the house of their God, they drink wine obtained through fines.
ekegusii: Mbarabare ase kera egesasiimero barabwo nigo bakorara inse igoro ye chianga chikobekwa kebwaterero. Ase enyomba y’enyasae yabo banywa edivai y’abwo bagambetigwe bakarusigwa chitaabu.
swahili: Watu hulala kando ya kila madhabahu juu ya nguo zilizowekwa rehani. Katika nyumba ya mungu wao hunywa mvinyo ulionunuliwa kwa fedha walizotozwa watu.

english: Yet it was I who destroyed the Amorite before them, though his height was like that of the cedars, and he was as strong as the oaks. Yet I destroyed his fruit above and his roots below.
ekegusii: “Korende ase engencho y’Abaisraeli, inche Omonene ngasiria Abaamori abwo barenge abatambe buna emecharake, naende abakong’u buna Omoaluni.
swahili: “Nilimwangamiza Mwamori mbele yao, ingawa alikuwa mrefu kama mierezi, na mwenye nguvu kama mialoni. Niliyaangamiza matunda yake juu na mizizi yake chini.

english: Hear this word that the LORD has spoken against you, O children of Israel, against the whole family that I brought up out of the land of Egypt:
ekegusii: Inwe Abaisraeli, tegerera moigwe amang’ana ay’Omonene akwanire igoro yaino, ee, igoro y’egesaku eke gionsi arusetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri:
swahili: Sikilizeni neno hili alilosema Bwana dhidi yenu, enyi watu wa Israeli, dhidi ya jamaa nzima niliowapandisha toka Misri:

english: “For they know not how to do right,” declares the LORD. “They store up violence and destruction in their citadels.”
ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: “Abanto abwo tibamanyeti gokora ayare amaya. Nigo bagachete ebinto bi’obouri na ebi’oboibi ase chinyomba chiabo chinkong’u.”
swahili: Bwana asema: “Hawajui kutenda lililo jema, wale ambao hujilundikia nyara na vitu vilivyotekwa katika ngome zao.”

english: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: “An enemy will surround the land; he will pull down your strongholds and plunder your citadels.”
ekegusii: Ababisa mbanaarie ense eye, baiyerie chindwaki chiaino inse, ne chinyomba chiaino chinkong’u chisakorwe.
swahili: Kwa hiyo hili ndilo asemalo Bwana Mwenyezi: “Adui ataizingira nchi; ataangusha chini ngome zenu na kuteka nyara maboma yenu.”

english: This is what the LORD says: “As the shepherd snatches from the mouth of the lion two legs or a piece of an ear, so the Israelites dwelling in Samaria will be rescued having just the corner of a bed or the cushion of a couch.
ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene agoteeba: “Buna koreng’ana omorisia agotoria korwa ase omonwa bw’endo amagoro abere, gose egetabo ki’ogoto kw’eng’ondi eyio konya endo yarire, naboigo bake barataborigwe, abwo bamenyete Samaria baikaransete ase ebirogo ebiororo na ase emeito etubire nebitambaa bi’ariri.”
swahili: Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana: “Kama vile mchungaji aokoavyo kinywani mwa simba vipande viwili tu vya mfupa wa mguu au kipande cha sikio, hivyo ndivyo Waisraeli watakavyookolewa, wale wakaao Samaria kwenye kingo za vitanda vyao, na katika Dameski kwenye viti vyao vya fahari.”

english: Hear and testify against the house of Jacob, declares the Lord GOD, the God of Hosts.
ekegusii: Omonene, oyore Nyasae bw’Emeganda, nigo agoteeba iga: “Tegerera moigwe amang’ana aya, erio moyararie ase ororeria rwa Yakobo.
swahili: “Sikia hili na ushuhudie dhidi ya nyumba ya Yakobo,” asema Bwana, Bwana Mungu Mwenye Nguvu Zote.

english: On the day I punish Israel for their transgressions, I will visit destruction on the altars of Bethel; the horns of the altar will be cut off, and they will fall to the ground.
ekegusii: Ase rituko erio ndarue egesusuro ase Abaisraeli ase engencho y’ebibe biabo, ninsarie na gotagora ebisasimero bia Beteli; nintagore na koiyeria inse chinsinyo chionsi chi’ebisasibero bionsi.
swahili: “Siku nitakapomwadhibu Israeli kwa sababu ya dhambi zake, nitaharibu madhabahu za Betheli; pembe za madhabahu zitakatiliwa mbali na kuanguka chini.

english: I will tear down the winter house along with the summer house; the houses of ivory will also perish, and the great houses will come to an end,” declares the LORD.
ekegusii: Nintagore chinyomba ase mokobeera ekero ki’etoigo amo nechio mokobeera ekero ki’egurugura; boigo ninsarie chinyomba chichabeire amaino e chinchogu, ne chinyomba chinene nchisirigwe kegima.” Nabo Omonene ateebire.
swahili: Nitabomoa nyumba ya wakati wa masika, pamoja na nyumba ya wakati wa kiangazi; nyumba zilizonakshiwa kwa pembe za ndovu na majumba makubwa ya fahari yatabomolewa,” asema Bwana.

english: “Only you have I known from all the families of the earth; therefore I will punish you for all your iniquities.”
ekegusii: “Ninwe mweka namanyete na korenda ase chiamate chionsi chi’ense. Ase ayio nimbae egesusuro ase engencho y’ebibe biaino bionsi.” Emeremo y’omobani
swahili: “Ni ninyi tu niliowachagua kati ya jamaa zote za dunia; kwa hiyo nitawaadhibu kwa ajili ya dhambi zenu zote.”

english: Can two walk together without agreeing where to go?
ekegusii: Inee! Abanto babere mbataarere amo onye tibabwataini?
swahili: Je, watu wawili hutembea pamoja wasipokubaliana kufanya hivyo?

english: Does a lion roar in the forest when he has no prey? Does a young lion growl in his den if he has caught nothing?
ekegusii: Inee! Endo nerume ase rinani, onye teraita eke yare gotwara? Gose endo ensae nkoruma ere, onye terabwata kende ekoria?
swahili: Je, simba hunguruma katika kichaka wakati hana mawindo? Aweza kuvuma katika pango wakati ambao hajakamata chochote?

english: Does a bird land in a snare where no bait has been set? Does a trap spring from the ground when it has nothing to catch?
ekegusii: Inee! Enyoni nebwatwe ase egesugunia onye tebekeiri egekoyengusa? Gose omoeto notegoke bosa onye tonyegeiri na gento?
swahili: Je, ndege aweza kuanguka kwenye mtego ulio ardhini ambapo hajategewa chambo? Je, mtego unaweza kufyatuka toka ardhini wakati ambapo hakuna chochote cha kunasa?

english: If a ram’s horn sounds in a city, do the people not tremble? If calamity comes to a city, has not the LORD caused it?
ekegusii: Inee! Egetureri gi’eseegi nkebugigwe ase omochie, na abanto tibaaba nobwoba? Amang’ana amabe nabe ase omochie, Omonene atayatometi?
swahili: Je, tarumbeta inapopigwa mjini kujulisha hatari, watu hawatetemeki? Mji upatwapo na maafa, je, si Bwana amesababisha?

english: Surely the Lord GOD does nothing without revealing His plan to His servants the prophets.
ekegusii: Ekeene, Omonene tagokora ring’ana rinde rionsi ritang’ani ataramaanora obobisi bwaye ase abasomba baye ababani.
swahili: Hakika Bwana Mwenyezi hatafanya neno lolote bila kuwafunulia watumishi wake manabii siri yake.

english: The lion has roared— who will not fear? The Lord GOD has spoken— who will not prophesy?
ekegusii: Endo koyarumire, monto ki otari kwoboa? Omonene gakwanire, ning’o otari koraria obobani obwo? Okogambigwa gwa Samaria
swahili: Simba amenguruma: je, ni nani ambaye hataogopa? Bwana Mwenyezi ametamka: je, ni nani awezaye kukosa kutoa unabii?

english: Proclaim to the citadels of Ashdod and to the citadels of Egypt: “Assemble on the mountains of Samaria; see the great unrest in the city and the acts of oppression in her midst.”
ekegusii: Raria amang’ana ayio ase chinyomba chinkong’u chi’Asidodi, na echi’ense ya Misiri, moteebie abanto bare aroro: “Inchuo, mosangererekane amo igoro ase ebitunwa bia Samaria, morore eburu‐buru ere aroro, na buna obobe bogendererete gokorwa aroro.”
swahili: Tangazeni katika ngome za Ashdodi na katika ngome za Misri: “Kusanyikeni juu ya milima ya Samaria; angalieni wingi wa wasiwasi ulio ndani yake, na uonevu ulio miongoni mwa watu wake.”

english: Hear this word, you cows of Bashan on Mount Samaria, you women who oppress the poor and crush the needy, who say to your husbands, “Bring us more to drink.”
ekegusii: Igwa ring’ana eri inwe chiombe chia Basani, inwe abamomenyete ase Egetunwa gia Samaria, inwe abamochandete abataka na gokorera abaremeire bobe, inwe abamogotebia abasacha baino: “Torentere egento tonywe!”
swahili: Sikilizeni neno hili, ninyi ngʼombe wa Bashani mlioko juu ya Mlima Samaria, ninyi wanawake mnaowaonea maskini, na kuwagandamiza wahitaji, na kuwaambia wanaume wenu, “Tuleteeni vinywaji!”

english: “I sent plagues among you like those of Egypt; I killed your young men with the sword, along with your captured horses. I filled your nostrils with the stench of your camp, yet you did not return to Me,” declares the LORD.
ekegusii: “Nigo nabarenterete amaakwa anga buna aria narentete Misiri; naende ngaita abamura baino nemioro; nkabaura chibarasi chiaino, nkabatiokeria oboguundo bw’ abanto baino baitetwe, agwo ase ebitwori biaino. Korende nonya naboigo timwairanete gocha asende.” Nabo Omonene ateebire.
swahili: “Niliwapelekea tauni miongoni mwenu kama nilivyofanya kule Misri. Niliwaua vijana wenu wa kiume kwa upanga, niliwachukua farasi wenu. Nilijaza pua zenu kwa uvundo kutoka kwenye kambi zenu, hata hivyo hamjanirudia mimi,” asema Bwana.

english: “Some of you I overthrew as I overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah, and you were like a firebrand snatched from a blaze, yet you did not return to Me,” declares the LORD.
ekegusii: “Ngasiria abanto bande baino, buna inche Nyasae nasiretie Sodomu na Gomora, na inwe nigo mwarenge buna ekegenga giataboretigwe korwa riko. Korende nonya nabo, timwairanete gocha asende.” Nab’Omonene ateebire.
swahili: “Niliwaangamiza baadhi yenu kama nilivyoangamiza Sodoma na Gomora. Mlikuwa kama kijiti kiwakacho kilichonyakuliwa motoni, hata hivyo hamjanirudia,” asema Bwana.

english: “Therefore, that is what I will do to you, O Israel, and since I will do this to you, prepare to meet your God, O Israel!
ekegusii: “Inwe Abaisraeli, amang’ana ayio naro ndabakorere. Ase ayio, ekiagera ngocha kobakorera ayio, ebeke ang’e, moumerane nainche Nyasae oino.”
swahili: “Kwa hiyo hili ndilo nitakalowafanyia, Israeli, na kwa sababu nitawafanyia hili, jiandaeni kukutana na Mungu wenu, ee Israeli.”

english: For behold, He who forms the mountains, who creates the wind and reveals His thoughts to man, who turns the dawn to darkness and strides on the heights of the earth— the LORD, the God of Hosts, is His name.”
ekegusii: Rora, oria otongete ebitunwa na embeo, oria okoorokeria Mwanyabaanto ebirengererio biabo bamanya buna bire, oria okoonchora emambia yaba omosunte, oria ogoeta otacha ebitunwa bi’ense, Omonene Nyasae bw’Emeganda, nario erieta riaye.
swahili: Yeye ambaye hufanya milima, anaumba upepo, na kufunua mawazo yake kwa mwanadamu, yeye ageuzaye asubuhi kuwa giza, na kukanyaga mahali pa juu pa nchi: Bwana Mungu Mwenye Nguvu Zote ndilo jina lake.

english: The Lord GOD has sworn by His holiness: “Behold, the days are coming when you will be taken away with hooks, and your posterity with fishhooks.
ekegusii: Ase ayio Omonene otianire ase obochenu bwaye, ogoteeba: “Rora, amatuko ngocha are, ababisa baino barabang’use nebigobanio baabarusie aiga, na abatigari baino bang’uswe ne chindobio.
swahili: Bwana Mwenyezi ameapa kwa utakatifu wake: “Hakika wakati utakuja mtakapochukuliwa na kulabu, na wanaosalia kwa ndoana za samaki.

english: You will go out through broken walls, each one straight ahead of her, and you will be cast out toward Harmon, ” declares the LORD.
ekegusii: Nigo moraeterigwe ase chinyasi chibochogete, kera omokungu oyomo ase oyomo, morutwe ase Harimoni.” Nab’Omonene ateebire. Abaisraeli bagosinywa kwegera
swahili: Nanyi mtakwenda moja kwa moja kupitia mahali palipobomolewa kwenye ukuta, nanyi mtatupwa nje kuelekea Harmoni,” asema Bwana.

english: “Go to Bethel and transgress; rebel even more at Gilgal! Bring your sacrifices every morning, your tithes every three days.
ekegusii: “Inchuo Beteli, mokorere ebibe aroro; boigo inchwo Giligali, momente gokora ebibe aroro. Kera emambia mobe mokorenta ebing’wanso biaino; na ase kera rituko ria gatato morente ensemo yaino ya ikomi.
swahili: “Nendeni Betheli mkatende dhambi; nendeni Gilgali mkazidi kutenda dhambi. Leteni dhabihu zenu kila asubuhi, zaka zenu kila mwaka wa tatu.

english: Offer leavened bread as a thank offering, and loudly proclaim your freewill offerings. For that is what you children of Israel love to do,” declares the Lord GOD.
ekegusii: Mosambe emegati ebekire ememera ebe okoruegwa gw’okoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono, mochike na koraria igoro y’okoruegwa kwaino kw’ogwancha, ekiagera ayio naro inwe Abaisraeli mwanchete gokora.” Nabo Omonene ateebire.
swahili: Mchome mkate uliotiwa chachu kama sadaka ya shukrani, jisifuni kuhusu sadaka zenu za hiari: jigambeni kwa ajili ya sadaka hizo, enyi Waisraeli, kwa kuwa hili ndilo mnalopenda kulitenda,” asema Bwana Mwenyezi.

english: “I beset all your cities with cleanness of teeth and all your towns with lack of bread, yet you did not return to Me,” declares the LORD.
ekegusii: “Inche tinabaete gento kende mogotakuna ase emechie yaino yonsi, na endagera ekabora aase aino onsi. Korende nonya naboigo timwairanete gocha asende.” Nab’Omonene ateebire.
swahili: “Niliwapa njaa kwenye kila mji, na ukosefu wa chakula katika kila mji, hata hivyo bado hamjanirudia mimi,” asema Bwana.

english: “I also withheld the rain from you when the harvest was three months away. I sent rain on one city but withheld it from another. One field received rain; another without rain withered.
ekegusii: “Ekero emetienyi etato konya yatigaire endagera yame ngatanga embura tiyatwa. Nigo narenge gotoma embura yatwa ase omochie oyomo, korende nayetanga tegotwa ase emechie ende; nigo narenge koyerenta yatwa ase omogondo oyomo, korende nayetanga ase emegondo ende, ero yaba ekwoma.
swahili: “Pia niliwazuilia ninyi mvua miezi mitatu kabla ya kufikia mavuno. Nilinyesha mvua kwenye mji mmoja, lakini niliizuia mvua isinyeshe mji mwingine. Shamba moja lilipata mvua, na lingine halikupata, nalo likakauka.

english: People staggered from city to city for water to drink, but they were not satisfied; yet you did not return to Me,” declares the LORD.
ekegusii: Ekero ekio abanto b’emechie ebere, gose etato, bakaba bakona‐goetanana gochia ase omochie oyomo korigia amaache banywe, korende tibanyora ayakobaisana. Nonya naboigo timwairanete gocha asende.” Nabo Omonene ateebire.
swahili: Watu walitangatanga mji hata mji kutafuta maji, lakini hawakupata ya kuwatosha kunywa, hata hivyo hamjanirudia mimi,” asema Bwana.

english: “I struck you with blight and mildew in your growing gardens and vineyards; the locust devoured your fig and olive trees, yet you did not return to Me,” declares the LORD.
ekegusii: “Nkabarentera oborwaire bw’enyagetabo, na obw’okorigisia chindagera chiaino; emegondo yaino emenge, amo ney’emesabibu, na emeko yaino, na emezeituni yaino ekariegwa ne chingige. Korende nonya naboigo, timwairanete gocha asende.” Nabo Omonene ateebire.
swahili: “Mara nyingi nilizipiga bustani zenu na mashamba ya mizabibu, niliyapiga kwa kutu na ukungu. Nzige walitafuna tini zenu na miti ya mizeituni, hata hivyo hamjanirudia mimi,” asema Bwana.

english: Hear this word, O house of Israel, this lamentation I take up against you:
ekegusii: Inwe Abaisraeli, igwa amang’ana ’okorera kwane gw’okobokia amagombo ase engencho yaino:
swahili: Sikia neno hili, ee nyumba ya Israeli, ombolezo hili ninalifanya kuwahusu ninyi:

english: There are those who hate the one who reproves in the gate and despise him who speaks with integrity.
ekegusii: Abanto nigo bageechete oria okorwanerera ekeene agwo ase ekegambero kere geita, na bagechigwa noyo ogokwana ay’ekeene.
swahili: mnamchukia yule akemeaye mahakamani, na kumdharau yule ambaye husema kweli.

english: Therefore, because you trample on the poor and exact from him a tax of grain, you will never live in the stone houses you have built; you will never drink the wine from the lush vineyards you have planted.
ekegusii: Ase ayio, buna koreng’ana mwatindacheire abataka inse na kobaura engano yabo ebe ebango, nebe ekero moraagache chinyomba chi’amagena abaachire, timogochimenya, na ekero morasimeke emesabibu ase emegondo emiya, timokonywa edivai yaye.
swahili: Mnamgandamiza maskini na kumlazimisha awape nafaka. Kwa hiyo, ingawa mmejenga majumba ya mawe ya fahari, hamtaishi ndani yake; ingawa mmepanda mashamba mazuri ya mizabibu, hamtakunywa divai yake.

english: For I know that your transgressions are many and your sins are numerous. You oppress the righteous by taking bribes; you deprive the poor of justice in the gate.
ekegusii: Inche nimanyete ogosaria kwaino ng’a nokonene na ebibe biaino ng’a nebinene mono. Nigo mogochanda omonyaboronge, boigo mokoegwa riaaki, erio mwaseria abataka korwa ase ekegambero kere geita tibakonyora oboronge bwabo.
swahili: Kwa kuwa ninajua hesabu ya makosa yenu na ukubwa wa dhambi zenu. Mmewaonea wenye haki na kupokea rushwa na kuzuia haki ya maskini mahakamani.

english: Therefore, the prudent keep silent in such times, for the days are evil.
ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio, omonto ore omong’aini nakire‐kiri ase engaki buna eyio, ekiagera eyio nengaki embe.
swahili: Kwa hiyo mtu mwenye busara hunyamaza kimya nyakati kama hizo, kwa kuwa nyakati ni mbaya.

english: Seek good, not evil, so that you may live. And the LORD, the God of Hosts, will be with you, as you have claimed.
ekegusii: Rigia ayare amaya, na tari ayare amabe, erio nario morabe moyo. Komorakore bo, Omonene, Nyasae bw’Emeganda, nabe amo nainwe, buna inwe mwatebiire.
swahili: Tafuteni mema, wala si mabaya, ili mpate kuishi. Ndipo Bwana Mungu Mwenye Nguvu Zote atakuwa pamoja nanyi, kama msemavyo yupo nanyi.

english: Hate evil and love good; establish justice in the gate. Perhaps the LORD, the God of Hosts, will be gracious to the remnant of Joseph.” Woe to Rebellious Israel (Acts 7:39–43)
ekegusii: Gecha ayare amabe, na mwanche ayare amaya. Motenenere oboronge agwo ase ekegambero kere geita. Komorakore bo, ande nabo Omonene, Nyasae bw’Emeganda, ararorere abatigari ba Yusufu amaabera.
swahili: Yachukieni maovu, yapendeni mema; dumisheni haki mahakamani. Yamkini Bwana Mungu Mwenye Nguvu Zote atawahurumia mabaki ya Yosefu.

english: Therefore this is what the LORD, the God of Hosts, the Lord, says: “There will be wailing in all the public squares and cries of ‘Alas! Alas!’ in all the streets. The farmer will be summoned to mourn, and the mourners to wail.
ekegusii: Ase ayio, aya naro Omonene, Nyasae bw’Emeganda, oyore Omonene, atebiire: “Ebirero mbibe ase chiraaro chionsi chi’omochie, na ase chinchera chiaye chionsi abanto barere bakobuga: Obee! Obee! Mbarangerie abaremi bache korera, na abamanyete kobokia amagombo bache kweng’ereria.
swahili: Kwa hiyo hili ndilo Bwana, Bwana Mungu Mwenye Nguvu Zote, asemalo: “Kutakuwepo maombolezo katika barabara zote na vilio vya uchungu katika njia kuu zote. Wakulima wataitwa kuja kulia, na waombolezaji waje kuomboleza.

english: There will be wailing in all the vineyards, for I will pass through your midst,” says the LORD.
ekegusii: Ebirero mbibe ase emegondo yonsi y’emesabibu. Ayio onsi nigo arabe, ekiagera inche Omonene ning’ete ase egati yaino mbaite.” Nabo Omonene atebiire.
swahili: Kutakuwepo kuomboleza katika mashamba yote ya mizabibu, kwa kuwa nitapita katikati yenu,” asema Bwana. Siku Ya Bwana

english: Woe to you who long for the Day of the LORD! What will the Day of the LORD be for you? It will be darkness and not light.
ekegusii: Obobe nobwaino inwe abamoganetie rituko ri’Omonene riike! Nase ki moganetie rituko riria ri’Omonene? Rituko erio nigo rirabe eri’omosunte, gose tirikoba eri’omobaso.
swahili: Ole wenu ninyi mnaoitamani siku ya Bwana! Kwa nini mnaitamani siku ya Bwana? Siku hiyo itakuwa giza, si nuru.

english: It will be like a man who flees from a lion, only to encounter a bear, or who enters his house and rests his hand against the wall, only to be bitten by a snake.
ekegusii: Nigo erabe buna ekero omonto agotama korwa ase endo, aumerane nedubu, gose ekero agosoa mwaye atoorera okoboko kwaye ase enyasi, na eng’iti emorome.
swahili: Itakuwa kama vile mtu aliyemkimbia simba kumbe akakutana na dubu, kama vile mtu aliyeingia nyumbani mwake na kuupumzisha mkono wake kwenye ukuta, kumbe akaumwa na nyoka.

english: “Fallen is Virgin Israel, never to rise again. She lies abandoned on her land, with no one to raise her up.”
ekegusii: “Abaisraeli banga buna omoiseke omwekungi bagure, tibakonyara koboka naende; batigirwe bagwete ase ense yabo, monto onde tari orabagororokie batenene.”
swahili: “Bikira Israeli ameanguka, kamwe hatainuka tena, ameachwa pweke katika nchi yake, hakuna yeyote wa kumwinua.”

english: Will not the Day of the LORD be darkness and not light, even gloom with no brightness in it?
ekegusii: Rituko riria ri’Omonene nigo rirabe eri’omosunte, tirikoba eri’oborabu, ee, neri’omosunte ekerima, na omobaso tokobara nonya ng’ake.
swahili: Je, siku ya Bwana haitakuwa giza, na si nuru: giza nene, bila mwonzi wa mwanga?

english: “I hate, I despise your feasts! I cannot stand the stench of your solemn assemblies.
ekegusii: “Inche nigo ngechete na gochaaya Amatuko aino Amanene. Tingokiri nemesangererekano yaino y’ogosasiima.
swahili: “Ninachukia, ninazidharau sikukuu zenu za dini; siwezi kuvumilia makusanyiko yenu.

english: Even though you offer Me burnt offerings and grain offerings, I will not accept them; for your peace offerings of fattened cattle I will have no regard.
ekegusii: Namoisa kondetera ebing’wanso biaino bi’ogosambwa, na okoruegwa kw’endagera, tinkobianchera; na tingwancha nonya nokorigereria ndigererie ching’iti chiaino chinoru chikoruegwa chibe ebing’wanso bi’omorembe.
swahili: Hata ingawa mnaniletea sadaka zenu za kuteketezwa na sadaka za nafaka, sitazikubali. Ingawa mnaniletea sadaka nzuri za amani, sitazitambua.

english: Take away from Me the noise of your songs! I will not listen to the music of your harps.
ekegusii: Rusia korwa asende okwoga kwaino kw’amatera, tingwancha ntegerere amariogi ’amakano aino.
swahili: Niondoleeni kelele za nyimbo zenu! Sitasikiliza sauti za vinubi vyenu.

english: But let justice roll on like a river, and righteousness like an ever-flowing stream.
ekegusii: Korende tiga ekeene kegenderere buna amaache amaange, na oboronge bobe buna orooche amaache aye atari koera nonya ng’ake.
swahili: Lakini acheni haki itiririke kama mto, na uadilifu uwe kama kijito kisichokauka!

english: Did you bring Me sacrifices and offerings forty years in the wilderness, O house of Israel?
ekegusii: “Inwe Abaisraeli, Inee, ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ene mwarenge ase erooro, mwandeterete ebing’wanso amo nokoruegwa konde?
swahili: “Je, mliniletea dhabihu na sadaka kwa miaka arobaini kule jangwani, ee nyumba ya Israeli?

english: You have taken along Sakkuth your king and Kaiwan your star god, the idols you made for yourselves.
ekegusii: Inwe mobogorie Sikuti, omogwekano oyio mogosasiima buna omorwoti oino, na Kiyuni, enyasae yaino ye ching’enang’eni mweroiseretie.
swahili: Mmeyainua madhabahu ya mfalme wenu, Sikuthi mungu wenu mtawala, na Kiuni mungu wenu wa nyota, ambao mliwatengeneza wenyewe.

english: Therefore I will send you into exile beyond Damascus,” says the LORD, whose name is the God of Hosts.
ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio inche nimbaire ase obosomba ase ense ere ng’umbu ya Damesiki.” Nabo Omonene ateebire. Nyasae bw’Emeganda, nario erieta riaye.
swahili: Kwa sababu hiyo nitawapeleka uhamishoni mbali kupita Dameski,” asema Bwana, ambaye jina lake ni Mungu Mwenye Nguvu Zote.

english: This is what the Lord GOD says: “The city that marches out a thousand strong will only see a hundred return, and the one that marches out a hundred strong will have but ten left in the house of Israel.” A Call to Repentance (Joel 1:13–20; Zephaniah 2:1–3; Luke 13:1–5)
ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene agoteeba: “Omochie bw’Abaisraeli otomete abarwani esegi elifu eyemo, bono nigo otigarete ne rigana erimo, na oyotomete rigana erimo, bono nigo otigarete na ikomi.”
swahili: Hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo: “Wakati mmoja wa miji yako utakapopeleka watu elfu moja vitani kwa ajili ya Israeli, mia moja tu watarudi; wakati mji utakapopeleka mia moja, kumi tu ndio watarudi hai.”

english: For this is what the LORD says to the house of Israel: “Seek Me and live!
ekegusii: Aya nar’Omonene agotebia Abaisraeli: “Ndigie inche, erio nario morabe moyo.
swahili: Hili ndilo Bwana asemalo kwa nyumba ya Israeli: “Nitafuteni mpate kuishi;

english: Do not seek Bethel or go to Gilgal; do not journey to Beersheba, for Gilgal will surely go into exile, and Bethel will come to nothing.
ekegusii: Korende timogenda Beteli, gose timosoa Giligali, gose timogenda goika Beeri‐Seba, ekiagera abanto ba Giligali mbairwe ase obosomba, na Beteli nosirigwe kegima.”
swahili: msitafute Betheli, msiende Gilgali, msisafiri kwenda Beer-Sheba. Kwa maana kwa hakika Gilgali itakwenda uhamishoni, na Betheli itafanywa kuwa si kitu.”

english: Seek the LORD and live, or He will sweep like fire through the house of Joseph; it will devour everything, with no one at Bethel to extinguish it.
ekegusii: Morigie Omonene, nario morabe moyo; motakoreti bo, Omonene nigo arachere ororeria rwa Yusufu arosirie buna omorero ogosiria, na onde tari orayorimie atoorie Beteli.
swahili: Mtafuteni Bwana mpate kuishi, au atafagia nyumba ya Yosefu kama moto; utawateketeza, nayo Betheli haitakuwa na yeyote wa kuuzima.

english: There are those who turn justice into wormwood and cast righteousness to the ground.
ekegusii: Inwe nigo mokoonchorana ayare amaronge aba ay’obororo, na mwatuguta oboronge inse ase riroba.
swahili: Ninyi ambao mnageuza haki kuwa uchungu na kuiangusha haki chini

english: He who made the Pleiades and Orion, who turns darkness into dawn and darkens day into night, who summons the waters of the sea and pours them over the face of the earth— the LORD is His name—
ekegusii: Oria otongete egetuse gie ching’enang’eni chiria isano na ibere, na ekio gekorokwa Orioni, oria okoonchora omosunte ekerima oba emambia, naende oonchora omobaso oba obotuko, oria okorangeria amaache ’enyancha oyaumora igoro ase ense, Omonene, nario erieta riaye.
swahili: (yeye ambaye alifanya Kilimia na Orioni, ambaye hugeuza giza kuwa mapambazuko na mchana kuwa usiku, ambaye huyaita maji ya bahari na kuyamwaga juu ya uso wa nchi: Bwana ndilo jina lake;

english: He flashes destruction on the strong, so that fury comes upon the stronghold.
ekegusii: Ere nigo akorenta ogosiria kwa mobosokano ase abwo bare ne chinguru, boigo nagere ogosareka gochere chiburi chinkong’u.
swahili: yeye hufanya maangamizo kwenye ngome na kufanya mji uliozungushiwa ngome kuwa ukiwa),

english: Woe to those at ease in Zion and those secure on Mount Samaria, the distinguished ones of the foremost nation, to whom the house of Israel comes.
ekegusii: Obobe nobwabo abwo bamenyete buya agwo Sayoni, na abwo batoererete ase ebitunwa bia Samaria, abwo bare abasike b’egesaku egetang’ani, eki Abaisraeli bagochiera.
swahili: Ole wenu ninyi mnaostarehe na kuridhika katika Sayuni, na ninyi mnaojisikia salama juu ya Mlima Samaria, ninyi watu mashuhuri wa taifa lililoendelea kuliko mataifa mengine, ambao watu wa Israeli wanawategemea!

english: And when the relative who is to burn the bodies picks them up to remove them from the house, he will call to one inside, “Is anyone else with you?” “None,” that person will answer. “Silence,” the relative will retort, “for the name of the LORD must not be invoked.”
ekegusii: Omoamate bw’omonto oyio okuure nache kobogoria amauga amo noyo ogochia koyasamba. Omoamate oria narangerie onde bwensi otigarete ase enyomba eria ime, amoborie, “Onde nare aa motigarete komo?” Omonto oria nairanerie, akane, “Yaya.” Erio omoamate oria namoteebie “Kira‐kiri! Twerende titobaisa gwatora erieta ri’Omonene.”
swahili: Kama jamaa ambaye atachoma miili akija ili kuitoa nje ya nyumba, na kumuuliza yeyote ambaye bado anajificha humo, “Je, yuko mtu yeyote pamoja nawe?” Naye akisema, “Hapana,” ndipo atakaposema, “Nyamaza kimya! Haturuhusiwi kutaja jina la Bwana.”

english: For the LORD gives a command: “The great house will be smashed to pieces, and the small house to rubble.”
ekegusii: Ase ayio rora, Omonene narue ogochika ng’a chinyomba chire chinene na echire chinke chiiyerigwe inse chisamunyokane.
swahili: Kwa kuwa Bwana ameamuru, naye atabomoa jumba kubwa vipande vipande na nyumba ndogo vipande vidogo vidogo.

english: “Do horses gallop on the cliffs? Does one plow the sea with oxen? But you have turned justice into poison and the fruit of righteousness into wormwood—
ekegusii: Inee! Chibarasi nchinyare kominyoka igoro ase egetare? Gose omonto nanyare korema egetare ne chiombe? Korende inwe mwaonchoire ayare ay’oboronge abeire obosongo, na okwama kw’oboronge kwabeire obororo buna chinkama.
swahili: Je, farasi waweza kukimbia kwenye miamba mikali? Je, aweza mtu kulima huko kwa maksai? Lakini mmegeuza haki kuwa sumu na matunda ya uadilifu kuwa uchungu:

english: you who rejoice in Lo-debar and say, ‘Did we not take Karnaim by our own strength?’
ekegusii: Inwe nigo mokogokera egento kere bosa, mogoteeba, “Inee! Titwenyorerete ching’unchara goetera ase chinguru chiaito abanyene?”
swahili: ninyi mnaoshangilia kushindwa kwa Lo-Debari na kusema, “Je, hatukuteka Karnaimu kwa nguvu zetu wenyewe?”

english: For behold, I will raise up a nation against you, O house of Israel,” declares the LORD, the God of Hosts, “and they will oppress you from Lebo-hamath to the Brook of the Arabah.”
ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene, Nyasae bw’Emeganda, agoteeba: “Inwe Abaisraeli rora, nimbarentere abanto b’egesaku gete; barabwo mbaabachande gochakera ase egesoero kia Hamati goikera ase akarooche g’Ekerubo Ekiomo.”
swahili: Maana Bwana Mungu Mwenye Nguvu Zote asema, “Nitainua taifa dhidi yenu, ee nyumba ya Israeli, nalo litawatesa kuanzia Lebo-Hamathi hadi Bonde la Araba.”

english: Cross over to Calneh and see; go from there to the great Hamath; then go down to Gath of the Philistines. Are you better than these kingdoms? Is their territory larger than yours?
ekegusii: Genda goika Kaline, moyorore, naende mogende goika Hamati, oyio ore omochie omonene, naende motirimboke gochia Gati bw’Abafilisti. Inee! Barabwo nigo bare buya kobua abanto b’amarwoti aya are aiga? Gose chingongo chiabo nechinene kobua orogongo rwaino?
swahili: Nendeni Kalne mkaone kutoka huko; mwende hadi Hamathi iliyo kuu, kisha mshuke hadi Gathi ya Wafilisti. Je, wao ni bora kuliko falme zenu mbili? Je, nchi yao ni kubwa kuliko yenu?

english: You dismiss the day of calamity and bring near a reign of violence.
ekegusii: Obobe nobwaino, inwe abamogoteeba ng’a rituko ri’obobe ng’are rire, na mwanchera ogokora okobe kw’obotindi kobeera ase egati yaino.
swahili: Mnaiweka mbali siku iliyo mbaya na kuleta karibu utawala wa kuogofya.

english: You lie on beds inlaid with ivory, and lounge upon your couches. You dine on lambs from the flock and calves from the stall.
ekegusii: Obobe nobwaino inwe aba mokoraarera amarere achabeire amaino e chinchogu, naende mwaba mokwerambora ase ebirogo biaino bigwotota. Nigo mokoba mokoria chimanwa chi’eching’ondi chichorire, ne chimori chinoru korwa ase ameeri.
swahili: Ninyi mnalala juu ya vitanda vilivyofunikwa kwa pembe za ndovu, na kujinyoosha juu ya viti vya fahari. Mnajilisha kwa wana-kondoo wazuri na ndama walionenepeshwa.

english: You improvise songs on the harp like David and invent your own musical instruments.
ekegusii: Inwe nigo mogotera amatera ay’okwoga, na mweroiseria amakano ao ao, aya mokobugia, buna Daudi akorete.
swahili: Ninyi mnapiga vinubi kama Daudi, huku mkitunga nyimbo za vinanda mbalimbali.

english: You drink wine by the bowlful and anoint yourselves with the finest oils, but you fail to grieve over the ruin of Joseph.
ekegusii: Nigo mokonywa edivai korwa ase ebitaabo ebinene, naende mweaka amaguta e rigori rinene, korende timoichanereti ogosirigwa kw’ororeria rwa Yusufu.
swahili: Mnakunywa mvinyo kwa bakuli zilizojazwa, na mnajipaka mafuta mazuri, lakini hamhuzuniki kwa maangamizi ya Yosefu.

english: Therefore, you will now go into exile as the first of the captives, and your feasting and lounging will come to an end. The Pride of Israel
ekegusii: Ase ayio, inwe mobe ab’eritang’ani koirwa ase obosomba, na emegoko y’emeyega yaino neere.
swahili: Kwa hiyo mtakuwa miongoni mwa watu wa kwanza kwenda uhamishoni; karamu zenu na kustarehe kutakoma. Bwana Anachukia Kiburi Cha Israeli

english: The Lord GOD has sworn by Himself—the LORD, the God of Hosts, has declared: “I abhor Jacob’s pride and detest his citadels, so I will deliver up the city and everything in it.”
ekegusii: Omonene, Nyasae bw’Emeganda, nigo agoteeba iga: “Inche Omonene netianirie ngoteeba: Nigo ngechirie noboenenu bw’ abanto ba Yakobo, na nigo ngechete chinyomba chiabo chinkong’u. Ase ayio nintige omochie osirigwe amo n’ebinto bionsi bireo.”
swahili: Bwana Mwenyezi ameapa kwa nafsi yake mwenyewe: Bwana Mungu Mwenye Nguvu Zote asema: “Nachukia kiburi cha Yakobo, nachukia ngome zake; nitautoa mji wao na kila kitu kilichomo ndani mwake.”

english: And if there are ten men left in one house, they too will die.
ekegusii: Nebe ng’a onye abasacha ikomi batigaire ase enyomba eyemo, nabarabwo goika bakwe.
swahili: Kama watu kumi watabaki katika nyumba moja, wao pia watakufa.

english: This is what the Lord GOD showed me: He was preparing swarms of locusts just after the king’s harvest, as the late spring crop was coming up.
ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene anyorogetie ase amaroro: Nkamorora ogotonga chingige ekero obonyansi bwachagete goseboka; okwo nogoseboka gwa kabere ekero obonyansi bw’omorwoti konya bwagekirwe.
swahili: Hili ndilo alilonionyesha Bwana Mwenyezi katika maono: Alikuwa anaandaa makundi ya nzige baada ya kuvunwa fungu la mfalme na wakati ule tu mimea ya pili ilipokuwa ikichipua.

english: Then Amaziah the priest of Bethel sent word to Jeroboam king of Israel, saying, “Amos has conspired against you in the midst of the house of Israel. The land cannot bear all his words,
ekegusii: Erio Amasia, Omokuani o Beteli, agatoma amang’ana ase Yeroboamu, omorwoti bw’Abaisraeli, komoteebia, “Amos oseegetire Abaisraeli bonsi babe mamincha yao; na ense eye tekonyara koremereria amang’ana aye onsi.
swahili: Kisha Amazia kuhani wa Betheli akatuma ujumbe kwa Yeroboamu mfalme wa Israeli, akisema: “Amosi analeta fitina juu yako katikati ya Israeli. Nchi haiwezi kuvumilia maneno yake yote.

english: for this is what Amos has said: ‘Jeroboam will die by the sword, and Israel will surely go into exile, away from their homeland.’”
ekegusii: Amang’ana aya naro akwanire: Yeroboamu naitwe nemioro, na Abaisraeli mbarusigwe ase ense yabo bairwe ase obosomba.”
swahili: Kwa kuwa hili ndilo Amosi analosema: “ ‘Yeroboamu atakufa kwa upanga, na kwa hakika Israeli watakwenda uhamishoni, mbali na nchi yao.’ ”

english: And Amaziah said to Amos, “Go away, you seer! Flee to the land of Judah; earn your bread there and do your prophesying there.
ekegusii: Naende Amasia agateebia Amos, “Aye omoorori, tama ogende ase ense y’Abayuda; aroro agwo nonyore endagera okoria, na obe gokobaanera aroro.
swahili: Kisha Amazia akamwambia Amosi, “Nenda zako, ewe mwonaji! Urudi katika nchi ya Yuda. Ujipatie riziki yako huko na kutoa unabii wako.

english: But never prophesy at Bethel again, because it is the sanctuary of the king and the temple of the kingdom.”
ekegusii: Korende tobaisa kobaanera aiga Beteli naende nonya ng’ake, ekiagera aiga nase aachenu a omorwoti, naende aa nao Hekalu y’obogambi bwonsi.”
swahili: Usiendelee kutoa unabii katika Betheli, kwa sababu hapa ni mahali pa mfalme pa kuabudia na Hekalu la ufalme huu.”

english: “I was not a prophet,” Amos replied, “nor was I the son of a prophet; rather, I was a herdsman and a tender of sycamore-fig trees.
ekegusii: Erio Amos akairaneria Amasia, akamoteebia, “Inche tindi omobani, gose omwana bw’omobani bworokereretigwe obobani, nigo narenge omorisia, naende omorendi bw’emeko.
swahili: Amosi akamjibu Amazia, “Mimi sikuwa nabii wala mwana wa nabii, lakini nilikuwa mchungaji wa kondoo na mtunza mikuyu.

english: But the LORD took me from following the flock and said to me, ‘Go, prophesy to My people Israel.’
ekegusii: Korende Omonene akandusia korwa ase narenge korisia ching’ondi, agantebia: Genda obanere abanto bane Abaisraeli.
swahili: Lakini Bwana akanitoa kutoka kuchunga kondoo na kuniambia, ‘Nenda, ukawatabirie watu wangu Israeli.’

english: Now, therefore, hear the word of the LORD. You say: ‘Do not prophesy against Israel; do not preach against the house of Isaac.’
ekegusii: Ase ayio, igwa ring’ana ri’Omonene. Aye nigo ogonkania ng’a timbaisa kobana mamincha y’Abaisraeli na tindandia mamincha y’ororeria rwa Isaka.
swahili: Sasa basi, sikieni neno la Bwana. Ninyi mnasema, “ ‘Usitabiri dhidi ya Israeli, na uache kuhubiri dhidi ya nyumba ya Isaki.’

english: Therefore this is what the LORD says: ‘Your wife will become a prostitute in the city, and your sons and daughters will fall by the sword. Your land will be divided by a measuring line, and you yourself will die on pagan soil. And Israel will surely go into exile, away from their homeland.’”
ekegusii: Ase ayio, aya naro amang’an’Omonene agoteeba: Mokao nabe omotayayi, abe ogokora obonyaka ase omochie omonene, na abana bao, abamura na abaiseke, ’mbakenywe nemioro. Oboremo bwao mbwatananwe ase okorengwa nengori; aye omonyene nokwere ase ense etachenegeti. Abaisraeli goika barusigwe ase ense yabo, bairwe ase obosomba.”
swahili: “Kwa hiyo hili ndilo asemalo Bwana: “ ‘Mke wako atakuwa kahaba mjini, nao wana wako na binti zako watauawa kwa upanga. Shamba lako litapimwa na kugawanywa, na wewe mwenyewe utafia katika nchi ya kipagani. Nayo Israeli kwa hakika itakwenda uhamishoni, mbali na nchi yao.’ ”

english: And when the locusts had eaten every green plant in the land, I said, “Lord GOD, please forgive! How will Jacob survive, since he is so small?”
ekegusii: Ekero chingige chiria chiakoorire koria ebimeri bionsi bi’ense, inche ngasaba, ngateba, “Aye Omonene, nagosoroire bwabere! Naki abanto b’ororeria rwa Yakobo baranyare koba moyo, ekero bare abake iga?”
swahili: Wakati nzige walikuwa wamekula mimea yote ya nchi, nililia kwa sauti kuu, “ Bwana Mwenyezi, samehe! Je, Yakobo atawezaje kuendelea kuishi? Yeye ni mdogo sana!”

english: So the LORD relented from this plan. “It will not happen,” He said.
ekegusii: Ase ayio, Omonene akaonchora ebirengererio biaye, agateeba, “Ayio bono takoba bo.” Amaroro igoro y’omorero
swahili: Kwa hiyo Bwana akaghairi. Kisha Bwana akasema, “Hili halitatokea.” Maono Ya Pili: Moto

english: This is what the Lord GOD showed me: The Lord GOD was calling for judgment by fire. It consumed the great deep and devoured the land.
ekegusii: Aya nar’Omonene anyorogetie ase amaroro: Nkarora Omonene ogocha korua egesusuro goetera ase omorero; omorero oyio ogasamba chindiba chinene, naende ogaachaka gosamba nense ekoremwa.
swahili: Hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi alilonionyesha katika maono: Bwana Mwenyezi alikuwa akiita hukumu ya moto; nao ulikausha vilindi vikuu, ukateketeza nchi.

english: Then I said, “Lord GOD, please stop! How will Jacob survive, since he is so small?”
ekegusii: Erio nkamotebia, “Aye Omonene, nagosoroire, tiga tobaisa gokora ayio. Naki abanto b’ororeria rwa Yakobo baranyare koba moyo ekero bare abake iga?”
swahili: Ndipo nikalia, “ Bwana Mwenyezi, nakusihi, zuia! Je, Yakobo atawezaje kuendelea kuishi? Yeye ni mdogo sana!”

english: So the LORD relented from this plan. “It will not happen either,” said the Lord GOD.
ekegusii: Erio Omonene akaonchora ebirengererio biaye, agateeba, “Naya boigo takoba bo.” Amaroro igoro y’ekebiro gi’okorengera
swahili: Kwa hiyo Bwana akaghairi. Bwana Mwenyezi akasema, “Hili nalo halitatokea.” Maono Ya Tatu: Timazi

english: This is what He showed me: Behold, the Lord was standing by a wall true to plumb, with a plumb line in His hand.
ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene anyorogetie ase amaroro: Nkamorora oteneine igoro y’orwaki rwaagachetwe ase okorengwa nekebiro, na ase okoboko kwaye nabwate ekebiro.
swahili: Hili ndilo alilonionyesha katika maono: Bwana alikuwa amesimama karibu na ukuta ambao ulikuwa umejengwa kwa timazi, akiwa na uzi wa timazi mkononi mwake.

english: “Amos, what do you see?” asked the LORD. “A plumb line,” I replied. “Behold,” said the Lord, “I am setting a plumb line among My people Israel; I will no longer spare them:
ekegusii: Omonene akamboria, “Amos, ngento ki eke orooche?” Nkamoiraneria, nkamotebia, “Eke nekebiro.” Erio Omonene agantebia, “Rora, nindenge abanto bane Abaisraeli nekebiro eke. Tinkobaetania nonya ng’ake.
swahili: Naye Bwana akaniuliza, “Je, Amosi unaona nini?” Nikamjibu, “Uzi wa timazi.” Kisha Bwana akasema, “Tazama, ninaweka uzi wa timazi miongoni mwa watu wangu Israeli; sitawahurumia tena.

english: The high places of Isaac will be deserted, and the sanctuaries of Israel will be laid waste; and I will rise up against the house of Jeroboam with My sword.” Amaziah Accuses Amos
ekegusii: Aase aimokererete igoro, ase abanto b’ororeria rwa Isaka bagosasiimera bosa, na aase ande onsi Abaisraeli bagosasiimera natagorwe abe bosa. Ning’ite abanto b’enyomba ya Yeroboamu nemioro.” Amos na Amasia
swahili: “Mahali pa Isaki pa juu pa kuabudia miungu pataangamizwa, na mahali patakatifu pa Israeli pa kuabudia pataharibiwa; kwa upanga wangu nitainuka dhidi ya nyumba ya Yeroboamu.” Amosi Na Amazia

english: This is what the Lord GOD showed me: I saw a basket of summer fruit.
ekegusii: Aya nar’Omonene anyorogetie ase amaroro: Nkarora egetonga kere namatunda amatobu.
swahili: Hili ndilo alilonionyesha Bwana Mwenyezi katika maono: kikapu cha matunda yaliyoiva.

english: I will turn your feasts into mourning and all your songs into lamentation. I will cause everyone to wear sackcloth and every head to be shaved. I will make it like a time of mourning for an only son, and its outcome like a bitter day.
ekegusii: Ning’onchore emeyega yaino ebe ebirero, na amatera aino abe okorera gw’okobokia amagombo. Nindete omoichano ase abanto bonsi, erio beboyie chigunia, na kera omonto akigite etukia y’omotwe oye. Mbatige mobe buna omonto okoreera omwana oye omomoima, na omoerio oye nobe rituko ri’obororo.”
swahili: Nitageuza sikukuu zenu za kidini kuwa maombolezo, na kuimba kwenu kote kuwe kilio. Nitawafanya ninyi nyote mvae nguo ya gunia na kunyoa nywele zenu. Nitaufanya wakati ule uwe kama wa kuombolezea mwana wa pekee, na mwisho wake kama siku ya uchungu.

english: Behold, the days are coming, declares the Lord GOD, when I will send a famine on the land— not a famine of bread or a thirst for water, but a famine of hearing the words of the LORD.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: “Rora, amatuko ngocha are, ndarente enchara ase ense, tari enchara y’endagera, gose tari erang’o y’amaache, korende nenchara ye ring’ana ri’Omonene.
swahili: “Siku zinakuja,” asema Bwana Mwenyezi, “wakati nitakapotuma njaa katika nchi yote: si njaa ya chakula wala kiu ya maji, lakini njaa ya kusikia maneno ya Bwana.

english: People will stagger from sea to sea and roam from north to east, seeking the word of the LORD, but they will not find it.
ekegusii: Abanto mbatayaye korwa ase enyancha goika ase enyancha ende, na korwa sugusu goika moocha; mbaminyoke gochia aaria na aaria, babe bakorigia ring’ana ri’Omonene, korende tibakorinyora.
swahili: Wanaume watayumbayumba kutoka bahari hadi bahari na kutangatanga kutoka kaskazini mpaka mashariki, wakitafuta neno la Bwana, lakini hawatalipata.

english: In that day the lovely young women— the young men as well— will faint from thirst.
ekegusii: Ase rituko erio abaiseke abekungi abanyabieni na abamura mbagoy’ane ase okoba nerang’o.
swahili: “Katika siku ile “wasichana wazuri na vijana wanaume wenye nguvu watazimia kwa sababu ya kiu.

english: Those who swear by the guilt of Samaria and say, ‘As surely as your god lives, O Dan,’ or, ‘As surely as the way of Beersheba lives’— they will fall, never to rise again.”
