ekegusii: Mwerende mono, timobaisa kwanga koa omotaka oyio egento na goteeba: Omwaka bw’okwabera chisiira obeire ang’e. Timobia ebirengererio ebibe buna ebio ribaga ase chinkoro chiaino. Onye mokoba abang’iti na kwanga koa oyomino ore omotaka egento, ere narere ase Omonene, ekiagera mwamorinire eki aremeire, nainwe ’namobe n’ebibe.
swahili: Jihadhari usijiwekee wazo hili ovu: “Mwaka wa saba, mwaka wa kufuta madeni umekaribia,” usije ukaonyesha nia mbaya kwa ndugu yako mhitaji na ukaacha kumpa chochote. Anaweza kumlalamikia Bwana dhidi yako nawe utakuwa umepatikana na hatia ya dhambi.

english: Observe the month of Abib and celebrate the Passover to the LORD your God, because in the month of Abib the LORD your God brought you out of Egypt by night.
ekegusii: “Mobe mokorenda Epasaka y’Omonene Nyasae oino, ase omotienyi bw’Abibu, ekiagera ase obotuko obomo bw’omotienyi oyio, nario Omonene Nyasae oino abarusetie Misiri.
swahili: Shikeni mwezi wa Abibu, na kuiadhimisha Pasaka ya Bwana Mungu wenu, kwa sababu katika mwezi wa Abibu, Mungu aliwatoa Misri usiku.

english: And you shall celebrate the Feast of Weeks to the LORD your God with a freewill offering that you give in proportion to how the LORD your God has blessed you,
ekegusii: Morende Amatuko Amanene ye Chichuma ase Omonene Nyasae oino, Morente ebiegwa bi’ogwancha ase Omonene Nyasae oino, mobirue buna koreng’ana abasesenirie.
swahili: Kisha msherehekee Sikukuu ya Majuma kwa Bwana Mungu wenu kwa kutoa sadaka ya hiari kwa kadiri ya baraka ambayo Bwana Mungu wenu amewapa.

english: and you shall rejoice before the LORD your God in the place He will choose as a dwelling for His Name—you, your sons and daughters, your menservants and maidservants, and the Levite within your gates, as well as the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widows among you.
ekegusii: Agwo aase Omonene arachoore abe obomenyo bw’erieta riaye, nao morageende na mogooke ase obosio bwaye, inwe n’abana baino, abamura n’abaiseke, n’abasomba baino, abamura n’abaiseke, n’Abalawi bamenyete ase emechie yaino, n’abamenyi, ne’chintakana, n’ababoraka bare ase egati yaino.
swahili: Shangilieni mbele za Bwana Mungu wenu mahali atakapopachagua kama makao ya Jina lake, ninyi, wana wenu na binti zenu, watumishi wenu wa kiume na wa kike, Walawi walio katika miji yenu, na wageni, yatima na wajane waishio miongoni mwenu.

english: Remember that you were slaves in Egypt, and carefully follow these statutes. The Feast of Tabernacles (Numbers 29:12–40)
ekegusii: Moinyore ng’a nainwe nigo mwarenge abasomba aaria Misiri, ase ayio morende na kobwata emeroberio eyio yonsi echiikire. Amatuko amanene y’Ebigutu (Abal 23:33-43)
swahili: Kumbukeni kwamba mlikuwa watumwa kule Misri na mfuate amri hizi kwa uangalifu. Sikukuu Ya Vibanda (Walawi 23:33-43)

english: You are to celebrate the Feast of Tabernacles for seven days after you have gathered the produce of your threshing floor and your winepress.
ekegusii: “Ekero mwaoorire chindagera chiaino naende mwamitire amasabibu aino inamobe n’amatuko amanene y’Ebigutu ase engaki y’amatuko atan’abere.
swahili: Adhimisheni sikukuu ya vibanda kwa siku saba baada ya kukusanya mazao yenu ya nafaka na kukamua zabibu.

english: And you shall rejoice in your feast—you, your sons and daughters, your menservants and maidservants, and the Levite, as well as the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widows among you.
ekegusii: Mogooke ase amatuko ayio, inwe amo nabana baino, abamura n’abaiseke, na abasomba baino, abamura n’abaiseke, na Abalawi, n’abamenyi, ne’chintakana, n’ababoraka, abwo bamenyete ase emechie yaino.
swahili: Mfurahie sikukuu yenu, ninyi, wana wenu, binti zenu, watumishi wenu wa kiume na wa kike, Walawi, wageni, yatima na wajane ambao wanaishi katika miji yenu.

english: For seven days you shall celebrate a feast to the LORD your God in the place He will choose, because the LORD your God will bless you in all your produce and in all the work of your hands, so that your joy will be complete.
ekegusii: ’Namorende amatuko amanene a Omonene Nyasae oino, ase engaki y’amatuko atano n’abere; moyareende aase agwo Omonene arachoore, ekiagera Omonene Nyasae oino, nasesenie okwama kw’emegondo yaino amo n’emeremo yaino yonsi. Ase ayio monyaare kogooka mwensi amo.
swahili: Kwa siku saba mtaiadhimisha sikukuu ya Bwana Mungu wenu katika mahali atakapopachagua Bwana. Kwa kuwa Bwana Mungu wenu atawabariki katika mavuno yenu na katika kazi zote za mikono yenu na furaha yenu itakamilika.

english: Three times a year all your men are to appear before the LORD your God in the place He will choose: at the Feast of Unleavened Bread, the Feast of Weeks, and the Feast of Tabernacles. No one should appear before the LORD empty-handed.
ekegusii: “Ara gatano kera omwaka abanto baino abasacha babe bagoocha ase obosio bw’Omonene Nyasae oino, aase agwo arachoore; bageende aroro ase Amatuko Amanene y’Emegati etabeekiri memera, na ase Amatuko Amanene ye’Chichuma, na ase amatuko amanene y’Ebigutu. Tibageenda ase obosio bw’Omonene bare n’amaboko amasa.
swahili: Wanaume wenu wote lazima wajitokeze mara tatu kwa mwaka mbele za Bwana Mungu wenu mahali atakapopachagua: kwa ajili ya Sikukuu ya Mikate Isiyotiwa Chachu, Sikukuu ya Majuma, na Sikukuu ya Vibanda. Hakuna mtu atakayejitokeza mbele za Bwana mikono mitupu:

english: Everyone must appear with a gift as he is able, according to the blessing the LORD your God has given you. Judges and Justice
ekegusii: Kera omonto arue ebinto koreng’ana buna Omonene Nyasae oino, amosesenirie. Amachiiko ase abagaambi
swahili: Kila mmoja wenu ni lazima alete zawadi kulingana na jinsi ambavyo Bwana Mungu wenu alivyowabariki. Waamuzi

english: You are to appoint judges and officials for your tribes in every town that the LORD your God is giving you. They are to judge the people with righteous judgment.
ekegusii: “Mochoore abagaambi na abateneneri korwa ase ebisaku biaino, babe bakogaamba agwo ase emechie yaino, eyi’Omonene Nyasae oino, agochia kobaa. Abwo babe bakogaamba ebiina bi’abaanto ase oboronge.
swahili: Wateue waamuzi na maafisa kwa kila kabila lenu katika kila mji ambao Bwana Mungu wenu anawapa, nao watawaamua watu kwa usawa.

english: Do not deny justice or show partiality. Do not accept a bribe, for a bribe blinds the eyes of the wise and twists the words of the righteous.
ekegusii: Timobaisa koonchorana oboronge, gose gwanchereria abanto, gose timoegwa riaaki, ekiagera riaaki nigo rikoukoria amaiso ’abang’aini, naende nigo rikoonchorana na korina abanyaaboronge oboronge bwabo.
swahili: Msipotoshe haki wala msifanye upendeleo. Msikubali rushwa kwa sababu rushwa hupofusha macho ya wenye busara na kugeuza maneno ya wenye haki.

english: You are to offer to the LORD your God the Passover sacrifice from the herd or flock in the place the LORD will choose as a dwelling for His Name.
ekegusii: Morusie eng’ondi, gose embori, gose eng’ombe, korwa ase amaicho aino, mogende aase Omonene arachoore abe obomenyo bw’erieta riaye, erio morue eng’iti eria ebe ekeng’wanso gi’Epasaka ase Omonene Nyasae oino.
swahili: Mtatoa dhabihu ya Pasaka ya mnyama kwa Bwana Mungu wenu kutoka kundi lenu la mbuzi na kondoo au la ngʼombe, mahali pale ambapo Bwana atapachagua kama makao kwa ajili ya Jina lake.

english: Pursue justice, and justice alone, so that you may live, and you may possess the land that the LORD your God is giving you. Forbidden Forms of Worship
ekegusii: Oboronge nabwo bwoka moraabe mokobwatia, erio nario moraabe moyo, na koira ense eri’Omonene Nyasae oino, agochia kobaa.
swahili: Mfuate haki na haki peke yake, ili mweze kuishi na kuimiliki nchi ambayo Bwana Mungu wenu anawapa. Kuabudu Miungu Mingine

english: Do not set up any wooden Asherah pole next to the altar you will build for the LORD your God,
ekegusii: “Timobaisa gosimiseria Asera, enyasae eria enkuungu, omote onde bwensi, komenta ase egesasiimero moraagachere Omonene Nyasae oino.
swahili: Msisimamishe nguzo yoyote ya Ashera kando ya madhabahu mliyomjengea Bwana Mungu wenu,

english: and do not set up for yourselves a sacred pillar, which the LORD your God hates.
ekegusii: Naende timobaisa gotenenia esiiro ende yonsi y’ogosasiimwa, ekiagera Omonene Nyasae oino, nageechete ebinto buna ebio.
swahili: wala msisimamishe jiwe la kuabudu, kwa maana Bwana Mungu wenu anavichukia vitu hivi.

english: You must not eat leavened bread with it; for seven days you are to eat with it unleavened bread, the bread of affliction, because you left the land of Egypt in haste—so that you may remember for the rest of your life the day you left the land of Egypt.
ekegusii: Timobaisa koria ekeng’wanso ekio amo n’emegati ebeekire ememera; ase engaki y’amatuko atan’abere moraabe mokoria emegati etabeekiri memera, eyio n’emegati y’emechando, ekiagera ekero mwaruete ase ense ya Misiri nigo mwaayererete gotama. Igo ase amatuko aino onsi more moyo mobe mokoinyora rituko mwaruete ase ense ya Misiri.
swahili: Msile nyama hiyo pamoja na mikate iliyotiwa chachu, lakini kwa siku saba mtakula mikate isiyotiwa chachu, mikate ya kujitesa, kwa sababu mliondoka Misri kwa haraka, ili kwamba siku zote za maisha yenu mpate kukumbuka wakati wenu wa kuondoka Misri.

english: No leaven is to be found in all your land for seven days, and none of the meat you sacrifice in the evening of the first day shall remain until morning.
ekegusii: Ase engaki y’amatuko atan’abere, ememera tenyorekana ase ense yaino yonsi, na enyama y’ekeng’wanso kiaruetwe ase omogoroba bwe rituko rie ritang’ani tetigarigwa ebeo ase obotuko bwonsi goika rituko ria kabere.
swahili: Chachu isionekane katika mali zenu katika nchi yenu yote kwa siku saba. Nyama yoyote ya dhabihu mtakayotoa jioni ya siku ya kwanza isibakizwe mpaka asubuhi.

english: You are not to sacrifice the Passover animal in any of the towns that the LORD your God is giving you.
ekegusii: “Timoruera ekeng’wanso gi’Epasaka ase emechie ende yaino, eyi’Omonene Nyasae oino agochia kobaa.
swahili: Kamwe msitoe dhabihu ya Pasaka katika mji wowote ambao Bwana Mungu wenu amewapa,

english: You must only offer the Passover sacrifice at the place the LORD your God will choose as a dwelling for His Name. Do this in the evening as the sun sets, at the same time you departed from Egypt.
ekegusii: Aase Omonene Nyasae oino, arachoore koba obomenyo bw’erieta riaye, agwo nao oka moraruere ekeng’wanso gi’Epasaka. Agwo nao moraabe mogokerua ekero kia mogoroba, ase chinsa chireng’aine chiria mwaruete Misiri.
swahili: isipokuwa mahali atakapopachagua kama makao kwa ajili ya Jina lake. Hapo ndipo lazima mtoe dhabihu ya Pasaka jioni, jua litakapotua, iwe kumbukumbu yenu ya kutoka Misri.

english: And you shall roast it and eat it in the place the LORD your God will choose, and in the morning you shall return to your tents.
ekegusii: Moiyeke chinyama chi’ekeng’wanso ekio, mochiriere aase ari’Omonene Nyasae oino, arachoore. Rituko ria kabere mambia, moirane gochia ase chiema chiaino.
swahili: Okeni na mle mahali pale ambapo Bwana Mungu wenu atakapopachagua, kisha asubuhi mrudi kwenye mahema yenu.

english: For six days you must eat unleavened bread, and on the seventh day you shall hold a solemn assembly to the LORD your God, and you must not do any work. The Feast of Weeks (Numbers 28:26–31)
ekegusii: Ase amatuko atano na rimo, morie emegati etabeekiri memera, na ase rituko ria gatan’akabere, mobe n’omosangererekano bw’engeencho enene bw’okomosasiima Omonene Nyasae oino. Ase rituko erio timokora meremo ende yonsi. Amatuko Amanene ye’Rigesa (Okong’ 34:22; Abal 23:15-22)
swahili: Kwa siku sita mtakula mikate isiyotiwa chachu na siku ya saba fanyeni kusanyiko kwa ajili ya Bwana Mungu wenu na msifanye kazi. Sikukuu Ya Mavuno (Kutoka 34:22; Walawi 23:15-21)

english: You are to count off seven weeks from the time you first put the sickle to the standing grain.
ekegusii: “Mobare chichuma isan’aibere, mochaake korwa engaki eria mogochaaka rigesa ase emegondo yaino.
swahili: Mhesabu majuma saba tangu wakati mnapoanza kuchukua mundu kuvuna nafaka.

english: You shall not sacrifice to the LORD your God an ox or a sheep with any defect or serious flaw, for that is detestable to the LORD your God. Purge the Idolater
ekegusii: “Timobaisa korua eng’iti ende yonsi, chiombe, gose ching’ondi, gose chimbori, ey’ere n’ekemocho ase omobere oye, ebe ekeng’wanso ase Omonene Nyasae oino. Eyio nigo ere okogeechia ase are.
swahili: Msimtolee Bwana Mungu wenu dhabihu ya maksai au kondoo ambaye ana dosari yoyote au hitilafu ndani yake, kwa kuwa hilo litakuwa chukizo kwake.

english: You must abide by the verdict they give you at the place the LORD will choose. Be careful to do everything they instruct you,
ekegusii: Morende mono na gokora amang’ana ayio barabwo barabateebie korwa aase agwo Omonene arachoore. Mokore koreng’ana buna barabasemie.
swahili: Ni lazima mtende sawasawa na maamuzi watakayowapa mahali Bwana atakapopachagua. Kuweni waangalifu kufanya kila kitu watakachowaongoza kufanya.

english: according to the terms of law they give and the verdict they proclaim. Do not turn aside to the right or to the left from the decision they declare to you.
ekegusii: Mokore koreng’ana buna barabateebererie, na buna baranache ekiina aase more; timotiga ogoseemia kwabo na koonchoka aande, gochia ase ensemo y’okorio gose ey’okobee.
swahili: Fanyeni sawasawa na sheria wanayowafundisha na maamuzi wanayowapa. Msigeuke mkono wa kuume au kushoto kuacha kufanya yale wanayowaambia.

english: But the man who acts presumptuously, refusing to listen either to the priest who stands there to serve the LORD your God, or to the judge, must be put to death. You must purge the evil from Israel.
ekegusii: Omonto onde bwensi ore omomwenu na okwanga koigwera Omokuani oyio ogotenena agwo ase obosio bw’Omonene Nyasae oino, gose aange koigwera omogambi, ere goika aitwe akwe. Goika morusie obobe borue ase Abaisraeli.
swahili: Mwanaume atakayeonyesha dharau kwa mwamuzi au kwa kuhani ambaye amewekwa kumtumikia Bwana Mungu wenu lazima auawe. Lazima mwondoe uovu katika Israeli.

english: Then all the people will hear and be afraid, and will no longer behave arrogantly. Guidelines for a King (1 Samuel 8:1–9)
ekegusii: Ekero abanto bonsi baraigwe amang’ana ayio mbairoke, tibakora ogokora kw’obomwenu naende. Ogoseemigwa ase ogochoora omorwoti
swahili: Watu wote watasikia na kuogopa, nao hawatakuwa wenye kudharau tena. Mfalme

english: When you enter the land that the LORD your God is giving you and have taken possession of it and settled in it, and you say, “Let us set a king over us like all the nations around us,”
ekegusii: “Ekero moraabe mwaikire na komenya ase ense eyi’Omonene Nyasae oino, agochia kobaa ebe eyaino, aande moganie omorwoti abagaambere, buna ebisaku biria bibaetanaine bibwate abarwoti baabo bakobagaambera.
swahili: Wakati utakapoingia katika nchi anayowapa Bwana Mungu wenu kuimiliki na kukaa humo, nanyi mkasema, “Na tumweke mfalme juu yetu kama mataifa yanayotuzunguka,”

english: you are to appoint over yourselves the king whom the LORD your God shall choose. Appoint a king from among your brothers; you are not to set over yourselves a foreigner who is not one of your brothers.
ekegusii: Erio mobeeke omorwoti oyi’Omonene Nyasae oino, arabachoorere. Mobeeke omonto bw’ abanto bamino abe omorwoti igoro ase more, korende omonto otari bw’egesaku kiaino timomobeeka abe omorwoti oino.
swahili: kuweni na uhakika wa kumweka mfalme juu yenu ambaye Bwana Mungu wenu atamchagua. Ni lazima atoke miongoni mwa ndugu zenu wenyewe. Msimweke mgeni juu yenu ambaye si ndugu wa Kiisraeli.

english: But the king must not acquire many horses for himself or send the people back to Egypt to acquire more horses, for the LORD has said, ‘You are never to go back that way again.’
ekegusii: Omorwoti oyio takwementera chibarasi chinyinge, gose tabaisa gotoma abanto bairane Misiri ase ogochia korigia chibarasi chinyinge, ekiagera Omonene obateebirie ng’a timokonyaara koirana gochia ase enchera eria naende.
swahili: Hata hivyo, kamwe mfalme asijipatie hesabu kubwa ya farasi kwa ajili yake mwenyewe, au kuwafanya watu warudi Misri ili kupata farasi zaidi, kwa maana Bwana amekuambia, “Hamtairudia njia ile tena.”

english: He must not take many wives for himself, lest his heart go astray. He must not accumulate for himself large amounts of silver and gold.
ekegusii: Omorwoti oria taba na abakungu abange, ekiagera ayio nigo aragere enkoro yaye eonchoke etige Omonene, gose takorigia kwementera chitaabu ne’chifeta.
swahili: Kamwe asioe wake wengi, la sivyo moyo wake utapotoka. Kamwe asijilimbikizie kiasi kikubwa cha fedha na dhahabu.

english: When he is seated on his royal throne, he must write for himself a copy of this instruction on a scroll in the presence of the Levitical priests.
ekegusii: Ekero aikaransire ase ekerogo ki’obonene ase oborwoti bwaye, arente egetabu y’amachiiko korwa ase abakuani, Abalawi, naende ariike amang’ana ayio ayio ase egetabu ende.
swahili: Atakapokuwa amekalia kiti cha ufalme wake, ajiandikie kwenye kitabu nakala ya sheria kwa ajili yake mwenyewe kutoka zile sheria za makuhani ambao ni Walawi.

english: It is to remain with him, and he is to read from it all the days of his life, so that he may learn to fear the LORD his God by carefully observing all the words of this instruction and these statutes.
ekegusii: Ere natware egetabu eyio abe ogosooma amachiiko ayio onsi ase amatuko y’obogima bwaye bwonsi, erio neorokererie komoiroka Omonene, Nyasae oye, na koreenda amang’ana onsi y’ogochika okwo na ay’emeroberio echiikire, na koyakora.
swahili: Atakuwa na nakala hiyo, naye ataisoma siku zote za maisha yake ili kwamba ajifunze kumheshimu Bwana Mungu wake na kufuata kwa uangalifu maneno yote ya sheria hii na amri hizi,

english: If a man or woman among you in one of the towns that the LORD your God gives you is found doing evil in the sight of the LORD your God by transgressing His covenant
ekegusii: “N’enyaare koba ng’a agwo ase omochie onde oino ase eyi’Omonene Nyasae oino, arabae, omonto, omosacha gose omokungu, anyorekane okorire amabe ase obosio bw’Omonene Nyasae oino, ase ogosaria okobwatana kwaye kw’ogotianania,
swahili: Ikiwa mwanaume au mwanamke anayeishi kati ya mojawapo ya miji akupayo Bwana, anakutwa anafanya uovu mbele za Bwana Mungu wenu, kwa kuvunja Agano lake,

english: Then his heart will not be exalted above his countrymen, and he will not turn aside from the commandment, to the right or to the left, in order that he and his sons may reign many years over his kingdom in Israel.
ekegusii: Goika akore igo, erinde tabaisa koenena ase ogochaaya abanto bande bamwabo, gose tabaisa koonchoka korwa ase amachiiko na kogeenda ase ensemo y’okorio gose ey’okobee. Karaigwere, ere amo n’abana baye ’mbabe bakogaambera Abaisraeli ase engaki entambe.
swahili: naye asijifikirie kuwa ni bora kuliko ndugu zake na kuipotosha sheria. Ndipo yeye na wazao wake watatawala katika ufalme wake kwa muda mrefu katika Israeli.

english: and going to worship other gods, bowing down to them or to the sun or moon or any of the host of heaven—which I have forbidden—
ekegusii: na gosasiima chinyasae ching’ao na gochikorera ase ogosasiima risase, gose omotienyi, gose ching’enang’eni chia igoro, ebio abakanirie ng’a timobisasiima.
swahili: naye amekwenda kinyume na agizo langu kuabudu miungu mingine na kuisujudia, kama vile jua, mwezi au nyota za angani,

english: and if it is reported and you hear about it, you must investigate it thoroughly. If the report is true and such an abomination has happened in Israel,
ekegusii: Komorateebigwe amang’ana buna ayio erio moyauna‐unie. Onye mokonyora ekeene ng’a amang’ana ayio akorirwe ase egati y’Abaisraeli,
swahili: hili likiwa limeletwa mbele yenu, ni lazima kulichunguza kikamilifu. Ikiwa ni kweli na kuwa limehakikishwa kwamba hili ni chukizo lililofanyika katika Israeli,

english: you must bring out to your gates the man or woman who has done this evil thing, and you must stone that person to death.
ekegusii: erio nario moraarente agwo ase ebiita biaino omonto oria, omosacha gose omokungu, oyio okorire ogokora okwo okobe, erio momoake amagena goika akwe.
swahili: mchukueni huyo mwanaume au mwanamke ambaye amelifanya tendo hili ovu kwenye lango la mji wenu na kumpiga mawe mtu huyo mpaka afe.

english: On the testimony of two or three witnesses a man shall be put to death, but he shall not be executed on the testimony of a lone witness.
ekegusii: Omonto oyio nigo araitwe ase oborori bw’ abanto babere gose batato, korende tagoitwa ase oborori bw’omonto oyomo.
swahili: Kwa ushuhuda wa mashahidi wawili au watatu mtu huyo atauawa, bali hakuna mtu atakayeuawa kwa ushuhuda wa shahidi mmoja tu.

english: The hands of the witnesses shall be the first in putting him to death, and after that, the hands of all the people. So you must purge the evil from among you. Courts of Law
ekegusii: Abanto baria birori nabwo barabe abatang’ani komoaka amagena ase okomoita, na magega yabo abanto bande bamanye komoaka amagena. Naboigo morarusie obobe bwonsi korwa ase more.
swahili: Ni lazima kwanza mikono ya mashahidi itangulie kumuua huyo mtu, kisha mikono ya watu wote. Ni lazima mwondoe uovu miongoni mwenu. Mahakama Za Sheria

english: If a case is too difficult for you to judge, whether the controversy within your gates is regarding bloodshed, lawsuits, or assaults, you must go up to the place the LORD your God will choose.
ekegusii: Onye amang’ana arentirwe ase more, ayaare amakong’u koyanacha, karabe amang’ana ogoiterwa kw’amanyinga, gose ay’ogokora oboronge ase omonto, gose obobe omonto akoreire omonto onde, gose ekiina kende gionsi kere egekong’u ase more agwo ase emechie yaino, erio moimoke mogeende aase agwo Omonene Nyasae oino, arachoore,
swahili: Kama mashauri yanaletwa katika mahakama zenu ambayo ni magumu zaidi kwenu kuyaamua, ikiwa ni umwagaji wa damu, madai au mashambulio, yapelekeni mahali ambapo Bwana Mungu wenu atapachagua.

english: You are to go to the Levitical priests and to the judge who presides at that time. Inquire of them, and they will give you a verdict in the case.
ekegusii: mogeende ase abakuani Abalawi n’aase omogambi bw’engaki eyio. Mobateebie amang’ana ayio amakong’u, na barabwo ’nabaanache ekiina kia boronge.
swahili: Nendeni kwa makuhani, ambao ni Walawi, na kwa mwamuzi ambaye atakuwa kazini wakati huo. Ulizeni kwao nao watawapa maamuzi.

english: The Levitical priests—indeed the whole tribe of Levi—shall have no portion or inheritance with Israel. They are to eat the offerings made by fire to the LORD; that is their inheritance.
ekegusii: “Abakuani Abalawi n’egesaku gionsi ki’Abalawi tibakonyoora egetari gose omwando amo n’Abaisraeli baande. Nigo barabe bakoria ebing’wanso bigosambwa n’omorero ase Omonene na okoruegwa konde gokorentwa asaare.
swahili: Makuhani ambao ni Walawi, yaani kabila lote la Lawi, hawatakuwa na mgawo wala urithi pamoja na Israeli. Wataishi kwa sadaka zitolewazo kwa ajili ya Bwana za kuteketezwa kwa moto, kwa maana huo ndio urithi wao.

english: Let no one be found among you who sacrifices his son or daughter in the fire, practices divination or conjury, interprets omens, practices sorcery,
ekegusii: Monto onde oino tabaisa korua omwana oye, omomura gose omoiseke, asambwe ase omorero ime abe ekeng’wanso. Onde taba ase egati yaino oyogokora oboringooria, gose oborogi, gose koruta chinche, gose oyogokora oboragori,
swahili: Asionekane mtu yeyote miongoni mwenu ampitishaye mwanawe au binti yake katika moto, atakayefanya uaguzi, ulozi, anayetabiri nyakati, anayejishughulisha na uchawi,

english: casts spells, consults a medium or spiritist, or inquires of the dead.
ekegusii: gose oyokorangeria ebirecha, gose okorigia ogosemigwa korwa ase emeika y’abakuure, gose oborogi bonde bwonsi.
swahili: wala arogaye kwa kupiga mafundo, wala mwaguzi au anayeabudu mizimu, wala awaombaye wafu.

english: For whoever does these things is detestable to the LORD. And because of these detestable things, the LORD your God is driving out the nations before you.
ekegusii: Onde bwensi orakore ebinto ebi nigo arabe okogeechia ase Omonene Nyasae, n’a ase engencho y’okogeechia buna okwo, Omonene oino naseerie abanto abwo konya bamenyete ase ense eria, barue ase amasio aino.
swahili: Mtu yeyote afanyaye mambo haya ni chukizo kwa Bwana, tena ni kwa sababu ya matendo haya ya kuchukiza wayafanyayo ndiyo maana Bwana Mungu wenu atayafukuza mataifa hayo mbele yenu.

english: You must be blameless before the LORD your God.
ekegusii: Inwe goika mobe abaikeranu ase obosio bw’Omonene Nyasae oino.” Eira y’ogotoma omobani
swahili: Kamwe msilaumiwe mbele za Bwana Mungu wenu. Nabii

english: Though these nations, which you will dispossess, listen to conjurers and diviners, the LORD your God has not permitted you to do so. A Prophet Like Moses (Acts 3:11–26)
ekegusii: Naende Musa agateeba, “Abanto b’ebisaku ebio mogochia goseeria nigo bakoigwera abarogi na abariori, korende inwe Omonene Nyasae oino, obakaanirie ng’a timobaisa gokora ebinto ebio.
swahili: Mataifa mtakayowafukuza husikiliza wale wafanyao ulozi na uaguzi. Lakini kwenu ninyi, Bwana Mungu wenu hajawaruhusu kufanya hivyo.

english: The LORD your God will raise up for you a prophet like me from among your brothers. You must listen to him.
ekegusii: Korende ase egati y’abamino, Omonene Nyasae oino, nabaimokerie omobani onga buna inche. Oyio nere moraigwere.
swahili: Bwana Mungu wenu atawainulia nabii kama mimi kutoka miongoni mwa ndugu zenu wenyewe. Msikilizeni yeye.

english: This is what you asked of the LORD your God at Horeb on the day of the assembly, when you said, “Let us not hear the voice of the LORD our God or see this great fire anymore, so that we will not die!”
ekegusii: “Nigo er’abe buna mwaboretie Omonene Nyasae oino, ase rituko riria mwasangererekanete agwo Horebu, mogakwana: Tototiga toigwe eriogi ri’Omonene Nyasae oito, kagokwana, gose titogenderera korora omorero oyio omonene. Toise koriigwa na koyorora, nigo torakwe.
swahili: Kwa kuwa hivi ndivyo mlivyomwomba Bwana Mungu wenu kule Horebu siku ile ya kusanyiko, wakati mliposema, “Na tusiisikie sauti ya Bwana Mungu wetu, wala kuuona moto huu mkubwa tena, ama sivyo tutakufa.”

english: Then the LORD said to me, “They have spoken well.
ekegusii: Omonene aganteebia: Amang’ana ayio bakwanire nayekeene.
swahili: Bwana akaniambia: “Wanachosema ni vyema.

english: I will raise up for them a prophet like you from among their brothers. I will put My words in his mouth, and he will tell them everything I command him.
ekegusii: Korwa ase egati y’abaamwabo nimbaimokerie omobani onga buna aye, nimbeeke amang’ana ane as’omonwa oye, nere n’abateebie ayio onsi ndamochiike.
swahili: Nitawainulia nabii kama wewe kutoka miongoni mwa ndugu zao; nitaweka maneno yangu kinywani mwake, naye atawaambia kila kitu nitakachomwamuru.

english: And I will hold accountable anyone who does not listen to My words that the prophet speaks in My name.
ekegusii: Omonto onde bwensi oraange koigwera amang’ana ane ayio ndachiike omobani oyio ayakwane ase erieta riane, inche bweka omonyene ning’ee omonto oyio egesusuro.
swahili: Kama mtu yeyote hatasikiliza maneno yangu ambayo huyo nabii atayasema kwa Jina langu, mimi mwenyewe nitamwajibisha.

english: Although they have no inheritance among their brothers, the LORD is their inheritance, as He promised them.
ekegusii: Ase ayio tibakonyoora omwando amo n’abanto bamwabo, ekiagera Omonene omonyene nere omwando obo, buna abarierete eira.
swahili: Hawatakuwa na urithi miongoni mwa ndugu zao; Bwana ndiye urithi wao, kama alivyowaahidi.

english: But if any prophet dares to speak a message in My name that I have not commanded him to speak, or to speak in the name of other gods, that prophet must be put to death.”
ekegusii: Korende omobani oraenene, na gokwana ase erieta riane aya ’ntamochigeti akwane, gose oyio orakwane ase amarieta ye’chinyasae ching’ao, omobani oyio nigo araitwe akwe.
swahili: Lakini nabii ambaye atathubutu kusema kwa Jina langu kitu chochote ambacho sikumwamuru akiseme, au nabii ambaye husema kwa jina la miungu mingine ni lazima auawe.”

english: You may ask in your heart, “How can we recognize a message that the LORD has not spoken?”
ekegusii: “Na komoreborie ase chinkoro chiaino ime: ’Naki torakore tomanye gose ring’ana riria rigokwanwa n’eri’Omonene?
swahili: Mnaweza kuulizana wenyewe, “Tutawezaje kujua wakati ujumbe haukusemwa na Bwana?”

english: When a prophet speaks in the name of the LORD and the message does not come to pass or come true, that is a message the LORD has not spoken. The prophet has spoken presumptuously. Do not be afraid of him.
ekegusii: Rirorio momanye ng’a, ekero omobani arakwane ring’ana ase erieta ri’Omonene, korende ring’ana erio tiriikeranigwa, gose koba ekeene, erio n’ering’ana Omonene atakwanete. Omobani oyio nigo arikwana ase obomwenu bwaye, inwe timobaisa komoiroka.
swahili: Ikiwa kile nabii anachotangaza kwa jina la Bwana hakikutokea au kutimia, huo ni ujumbe ambao Bwana hakusema. Nabii huyo amesema kwa ujuaji. Msimwogope huyo.

english: This shall be the priests’ share from the people who offer a sacrifice, whether a bull or a sheep: the priests are to be given the shoulder, the jowls, and the stomach.
ekegusii: “Ekero abanto barabe bakorua eng’ombe, gose eng’ondi, gose embori, koba ekeng’wanso, bae abakuani rireko, ne chinsea ibere, n’enda; ebio nabio ebitari abanto barae abakuani.
swahili: Hili ndilo fungu la makuhani kutoka kwa watu watakaotoa dhabihu ya fahali au kondoo: mguu wa mbele, mataya na matumbo.

english: You are to give them the firstfruits of your grain, new wine, and oil, and the first wool sheared from your flock.
ekegusii: Moe abakuani ogotongora kwaino kw’endagera, na edivai, na amaguta, na amarionya amatang’ani mokonacha korwa ase ching’ondi chiaino.
swahili: Mtawapa malimbuko ya nafaka zenu, divai mpya, mafuta na sufu ya kwanza kutoka manyoya ya kondoo zenu,

english: For the LORD your God has chosen Levi and his sons out of all your tribes to stand and minister in His name for all time.
ekegusii: Omonene Nyasae oino, ochoorire Lawi n’ororeeria rw’aye ase egati y’ebisaku biaino bionsi, babe bagokora emeremo ase erieta riaye, korwa ekiaare ekemo gochia ekende ase amatuko onsi.
swahili: kwa kuwa Bwana Mungu wenu amewachagua pamoja na wazao wao kutoka makabila yenu kusimama na kuhudumu katika jina la Bwana siku zote.

english: Now if a Levite moves from any town of residence throughout Israel and comes in all earnestness to the place the LORD will choose,
ekegusii: “Omolawi onde bwensi oraabe omenyete ase emechie ende yonsi y’Abaisraeli karaganie koruao, nabo aranyare goocha ase agwo Omonene arachoore.
swahili: Ikiwa Mlawi atahama kutoka mmojawapo ya miji yenu popote katika Israeli ambapo anaishi, akaja kwa moyo wote mahali ambapo Bwana atapachagua,

english: then he shall serve in the name of the LORD his God like all his fellow Levites who stand there before the LORD.
ekegusii: Ere na’be ogokora emeremo ase erieta ri’Omonene, Nyasae oye, buna Abalawi bande bamwabo bagotenena gokora emeremo ase obosio bw’Omonene.
swahili: anaweza akahudumu katika jina la Bwana Mungu wake kama Walawi wenzake wote wanaohudumu hapo mbele za Bwana.

english: They shall eat equal portions, even though he has received money from the sale of his father’s estate. Sorcery Forbidden (Acts 8:9–25)
ekegusii: Nere oyio naatananerwe egetari kiaye ki’endagera kereng’aine n’eki’Abalawi bande, nonya okonyora egento ase okoonia omwando atigeretwe n’abaibori baye. Ogokuurerwa kw’ogotenaria chingeencho chi’ abanto batamomanyeti Nyasae
swahili: Atashiriki sawa katika mafao yao, hata kama amepokea fedha kutoka mauzo ya mali ya jamaa yake. Matendo Ya Machukizo

english: When you enter the land that the LORD your God is giving you, do not imitate the detestable ways of the nations there.
ekegusii: “Ekero moraike ase ense eri’Omonene Nyasae oino, agochia kobaa, timobaisa kweorokereria kobwatia chingencho chi’okogechia okwo ebisaku biria bimenyeteo binarete gokora.
swahili: Wakati mtakapoingia katika nchi ambayo Bwana Mungu wenu anawapa, msijifunze kuiga njia za machukizo za mataifa ya huko.

english: When the LORD your God has cut off the nations whose land He is giving you, and when you have driven them out and settled in their cities and houses,
ekegusii: “Ekero Omonene Nyasae oino, arabe osiririe abanto b’ebisaku biria mogochia koegwa ense yabo, na ekero mwairire ense amo n’emechie yabo, na komenya ase chinyomba chiabo,
swahili: Wakati Bwana Mungu wenu atakapokuwa amewaangamiza mataifa ambayo nchi yao anawapa ninyi, wakati mtakapokuwa mmewafukuza na kuishi katika miji yao na nyumba zao,

english: Thus innocent blood will not be shed in the land that the LORD your God is giving you as an inheritance, so that you will not be guilty of bloodshed.
ekegusii: Komorakore ayio, amanyinga y’ abanto batari na komocha tabaisa goiterwa ase ense eye Omonene Nyasae oino, agochia kobaa ebe omwando oino, ase igo timokoba na komocha kw’ogoitera amanyinga.
swahili: Fanyeni hivi ili damu isiyo na hatia isimwagwe katika nchi yenu, ambayo Bwana Mungu wenu anawapa kama urithi wenu, ili kwamba msije mkawa na hatia ya kumwaga damu.

english: If, however, a man hates his neighbor and lies in wait, attacks him and kills him, and then flees to one of these cities,
ekegusii: “Korende onye omonto ogeechete omonto onde erinde amoboere na komoaka goika akwe, na magega y’ayio atamere oyomo bw’emechie eyio,
swahili: Lakini kama mtu anamchukia ndugu yake, akamvizia, akamshambulia na kumuua, kisha akakimbilia katika mmojawapo ya miji hii,

english: the elders of his city must send for him, bring him back, and hand him over to the avenger of blood to die.
ekegusii: erio abagaaka b’omochie bw’omoiti oria batome abanto bamorusie korwa ase omochie oria atameire, bamobeeke ase okoboko kw’oria okorusia egesiomba ki’oyomwabo, nere aite omoiti oria.
swahili: wazee wa mji wake watatuma ujumbe kwake, kumleta kutoka mji ule na kumkabidhi mlipiza kisasi cha damu kumuua.

english: You must show him no pity. You are to purge from Israel the guilt of shedding innocent blood, that it may go well with you.
ekegusii: Timobaisa komoororera amaabera, korende morusie korwa ase Abaisraeli okomocha kw’ogoiterwa kw’amanyinga y’omonto otarenge na komocha, erinde nebe buya ase more. Orobebe orokoro
swahili: Msimwonee huruma. Lazima mwondoe katika Israeli hatia ya umwagaji damu isiyo na hatia ili kwamba mpate kufanikiwa.

english: You must not move your neighbor’s boundary marker, which was set up by your ancestors to mark the inheritance you shall receive in the land that the LORD your God is giving you to possess. The Testimony of Two or Three Witnesses (Matthew 18:15–20)
ekegusii: “Tobaisa gotumana orobebe ronde rwonsi rw’omogisangio oo, orwo abanto ba kare babeegete ase orogongo rw’omwando oria oraegwe ase ense eri’Omonene Nyasae oino, arakoe ebe eyao. Igoro y’okoba kirori
swahili: Usisogeze jiwe la mpaka wa jirani yako ambao uliwekwa na wale waliokutangulia katika urithi upokeao katika nchi Bwana Mungu wako anayowapa kuimiliki. Mashahidi

english: A lone witness is not sufficient to establish any wrongdoing or sin against a man, regardless of what offense he may have committed. A matter must be established by the testimony of two or three witnesses.
ekegusii: “Omonto oyomo bweka tagoisana koba kirori igoro ase omonto onde okorire ogosaria, gose ebibe binde bionsi akorire; korende ekiina nigo keranachwe ekero birori babere gose batato bakwanire oborori bwabo.
swahili: Shahidi mmoja hatoshi kumtia hatiani mtu kwa uhalifu au kosa lolote ambalo anaweza kuwa amelitenda. Lazima shauri lolote lithibitishwe kwa ushuhuda wa mashahidi wawili au watatu.

english: If a false witness testifies against someone, accusing him of a crime,
ekegusii: Onye omonto onde okoba kirori bw’oborimo ase okogania gokorera omonto onde bobe, na komosoera,
swahili: Kama shahidi mwenye nia ya kumdhuru mwingine akisimama kumshtaki mtu kwa uhalifu,

english: both parties to the dispute must stand in the presence of the LORD, before the priests and judges who are in office at that time.
ekegusii: abanto abwo babere barenge kwomana goika baachiche ase obosio bw’Omonene, ase abakuani na abagaambi abwo batenenerete ase amatuko ayio.
swahili: watu wawili wanaohusika katika mabishano lazima wasimame mbele za Bwana na mbele ya makuhani na waamuzi ambao wako kazini wakati huo.

english: The judges shall investigate thoroughly, and if the witness is proven to be a liar who has falsely accused his brother,
ekegusii: Abagaambi goika baunenkie mono bamanye gose kirori oria nigo agosoera oyomwabo ase oborimo.
swahili: Waamuzi lazima wafanye uchunguzi kwa makini na shahidi akionekana kuwa ni mwongo, akitoa ushuhuda wa uongo dhidi ya ndugu yake,

english: you must do to him as he intended to do to his brother. So you must purge the evil from among you.
ekegusii: Komoranyore ng’a n’oborimo, erio mokorere kirori oria amang’ana aria aria ere arengereretie gokorera oyomwabo. Naboigo morusie obobe borue ase more.
swahili: basi mtende kama alivyotaka kumtendea ndugu yake. Ni lazima mwondoe uovu miongoni mwenu.

english: then you are to set apart for yourselves three cities within the land that the LORD your God is giving you to possess.
ekegusii: mwatanane emechie etato ase ense eyi’Omonene Nyasae oino, agochia kobaa.
swahili: ndipo mtenge miji mitatu iliyopo katikati ya nchi kwa ajili yenu, katika nchi ambayo Bwana Mungu wenu anawapa kuimiliki.

english: Then the rest of the people will hear and be afraid, and they will never again do anything so evil among you.
ekegusii: Abanto bande ekero baraigwe ayio bairoke, tibakora okomocha konga buna okwo ase egati yaino.
swahili: Watu watakaosalia watasikia hili na kuogopa, uovu kama huo kamwe hautatendeka tena miongoni mwenu.

english: You must show no pity: life for life, eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, and foot for foot.
ekegusii: Timobaisa komororera amaabera. Egesusuro nigo keraabe obogima ase obogima, eriso ase eriso na erino ase erino, okoboko ase okoboko na okogoro ase okogoro.
swahili: Msionyeshe huruma, uhai kwa uhai, jicho kwa jicho, jino kwa jino, mkono kwa mkono, mguu kwa mguu.

english: You are to build roads for yourselves and divide into three regions the land that the LORD your God is giving you as an inheritance, so that any manslayer can flee to these cities.
ekegusii: Ense eyi’Omonene Nyasae oino, agochia kobaa, moyiate ase chinsemo isato, na moroisie chinchera chikogeenda ase emechie eyio etato, erio omonto karaite oyonde mosiabano, abe ogotamera oyomo bw’emechie eyio.
swahili: Jengeni barabara katika miji hiyo na kuigawa mara tatu, nchi anayowapa Bwana Mungu wenu kama urithi, ili kwamba yeyote amuuaye mtu aweze kukimbilia humo.

english: Now this is the situation regarding the manslayer who flees to one of these cities to save his life, having killed his neighbor accidentally, without intending to harm him:
ekegusii: Omonto onde bwensi oraite oyonde mosiabano, atabwati obobisa nere, nanyaare gotamera oyomo bw’emechie eyio, na gotooria obogima bwaye.
swahili: Hii ndiyo kanuni kuhusu mtu amuuaye mwingine na kukimbilia humo kuokoa maisha yake, yaani, yeye amuuaye jirani yake bila kukusudia, wala hakumchukia kabla ya hapo.

english: If he goes into the forest with his neighbor to cut timber and swings his axe to chop down a tree, but the blade flies off the handle and strikes and kills his neighbor, he may flee to one of these cities to save his life.
ekegusii: N’ebe ng’a omonto ogeendire amo n’oyonde ase rinani kogeecha emete, na ekero aimokirie egesire, na egesire ekio gesomoke korwa ase omote, gecharare, geite omonto oria onde, omoiti oria nabo aratamere oyomo bw’emechie eyio ase ogotooria obogima bwaye.
swahili: Kwa mfano, mtu aweza kwenda msituni na jirani yake kukata miti, naye anapozungusha shoka kuangusha mti, shoka linaweza kuchomoka kutoka kwenye mpini na kumpiga jirani yake na kumuua. Yule mtu anaweza kukimbilia katika mmojawapo ya miji hii na kuokoa maisha yake.

english: Otherwise, the avenger of blood might pursue the manslayer in a rage, overtake him if the distance is great, and strike him dead though he did not deserve to die, since he did not intend any harm.
ekegusii: Nenyaare koba ng’a orogeendo rogochia ase omochie bw’obotamero nigo rore orotambe, na omonto oria oganetie korusia egesiomba abwatie omoiti oria, na komoikeera nchera, na ase endamwamu yaye amoite, nonya omoiti oria tagwenerete goitwa, ekiagera aitete omonto mosiabano atabwati obobisa nere.
swahili: Kama sivyo, mlipiza kisasi cha damu anaweza kumfuatilia kwa hasira kali, naye akamkamata na kumuua kama umbali ni mrefu sana hata ingawa hastahili kifo, kwa sababu amemuua jirani yake bila kukusudia.

english: This is why I am commanding you to set apart for yourselves three cities.
ekegusii: Ase ayio nabachiikire mwatanane emechie etato.
swahili: Hii ndiyo sababu nimewaagiza ninyi kutenga miji mitatu ya makimbilio kwa ajili yenu.

english: And if the LORD your God enlarges your territory, as He swore to your fathers, and gives you all the land He promised them,
ekegusii: “Ekero Omonene Nyasae oino, aragareyie orogongo rwaino robe oronene, buna arierete chisokoro chiaino eira ase ogotiana, na kobaa inwe ense yonsi eria ateebetie chisokoro chiaino ng’a n’abayee,
swahili: Kama Bwana Mungu wenu akipanua nchi yenu, kama alivyoahidi kwa kiapo kwa baba zenu na kuwapa nchi yote aliyowaahidi,

english: and if you carefully keep all these commandments I am giving you today, loving the LORD your God and walking in His ways at all times, then you are to add three more cities to these three.
ekegusii: nainwe komoraarende na kobwata amachiiko aya nabaeire ase rituko ria reero na komwancha Omonene Nyasae oino, ase okobwatia chinchera chiaye botambe, erio nario moranyaare komenta emechie ende etato.
swahili: kwa sababu mmefuata kwa uangalifu sheria zote ninazowaamuru leo, kumpenda Bwana Mungu wenu na kuenenda siku zote katika njia zake, ndipo mtenge miji mingine, mitatu zaidi.

english: These are the words that Moses spoke to all Israel in the wilderness east of the Jordan—in the Arabah opposite Suph—between Paran and Tophel, Laban, Hazeroth, and Dizahab.
ekegusii: Egetabu eke nigo kebwate amang’ana Musa akwanete n’Abaisraeli ekero barenge ase erooro, moocha y’orooche rwa Yorodani. Nigo barenge ase Ekerubo Ekiomo kerigereretie Sufu, obogati bw’omochie o Parani ase ensemo eyemo, na emechie ya Tofeli na Labani, na Haseroti, na Disahabu ase ensemo ende.
swahili: Haya ni maneno Mose aliyoyasema kwa Israeli yote jangwani mashariki ya Yordani, ambayo iko Araba, inayokabiliana na Sufu, kati ya Parani na Tofeli, Labani, Haserothi na Dizahabu.

english: The LORD your God has multiplied you, so that today you are as numerous as the stars in the sky.
ekegusii: Omonene Nyasae oino, obamentekanirie mono, na bono inwe nigo more abange mono buna ching’enang’eni chia igoro.
swahili: Bwana Mungu wenu ameongeza hesabu yenu, hivi kwamba leo ninyi ni wengi kama nyota za angani.

english: May the LORD, the God of your fathers, increase you a thousand times over and bless you as He has promised.
ekegusii: Tiga Omonene, Nyasae bw’echisokoro chiaino, abamentekanie ara elifu, mobe abange goetania buna more bono, naende abasesenie buna ariete eira.
swahili: Naye Bwana, Mungu wa baba zenu na awaongeze mara elfu na kuwabariki kama alivyoahidi!

english: But how can I bear your troubles, burdens, and disputes all by myself?
ekegusii: Korende naki ndakore inyare inche bweka kobogoria egurube enene y’okogaayana emechando yaino
swahili: Lakini mimi nitawezaje kubeba matatizo yenu, na mizigo yenu, na magomvi yenu peke yangu?

english: Choose for yourselves wise, understanding, and respected men from each of your tribes, and I will appoint them as your leaders.”
ekegusii: chora abanto abang’aini, abare abamanyi, abanto bamanyekanete buya korwa ase kera egesaku, na inche nimbabeeke babe abataang’ani baino.
swahili: Chagueni baadhi ya watu wenye hekima, wenye ufahamu na wanaoheshimika kutoka kila kabila lenu, nami nitawaweka juu yenu.”

english: And you answered me and said, “What you propose to do is good.”
ekegusii: Inwe nigo mwancheranete buna ayio namaya na buna moyakore.
swahili: Mlinijibu, “Shauri ulilolitoa ni zuri.”

english: So I took the leaders of your tribes, wise and respected men, and appointed them as leaders over you—as commanders of thousands, of hundreds, of fifties, and of tens, and as officers for your tribes.
ekegusii: Ase ayio nkabeeka abanto baria abang’aini na bamanyekanete buya, abwo mwachorete korwa ase ebisaku biaino nkababeeka koba abaraai baino. Abande ase chilifu, na abande ase amagana, na abande ase emerongo etano, na abande ase ikomi. Naboigo nkababeeka abateneneri bande b’ebisaku biaino bionsi.
swahili: Kwa hiyo niliwachukua wanaume viongozi wa makabila yenu, wenye hekima na wanaoheshimika, nami nikawateua wawe na mamlaka juu yenu kama majemadari wa maelfu, wa mamia, wa hamsini, na wa makumi, na kama maafisa wa makabila.

english: At that time I charged your judges: “Hear the disputes between your brothers, and judge fairly between a man and his brother or a foreign resident.
ekegusii: Ase engaki eria ngachiika abagaambi baino, nkabateebia: Motegerere ebiina bire ase egati y’Abaisraeli bamino. Monache ekiina kia boronge, keraabe ase egati y’omonto n’oyomwabo, gose ase egati yaye n’omomenyi omenyete bwoye.
swahili: Nami wakati ule nikawaagiza waamuzi wenu: Sikilizeni magomvi kati ya ndugu zenu na mwamue kwa haki, hata kama shauri ni kati ya ndugu wa Kiisraeli, au kati ya mmoja wa ndugu wa Kiisraeli na mgeni.

english: Show no partiality in judging; hear both small and great alike. Do not be intimidated by anyone, for judgment belongs to God. And bring to me any case too difficult for you, and I will hear it.”
ekegusii: Timoba n’ogwanchereria komokonacha ebiina; mokore boronge, abe omonto omoke gose omonene. Timoiroka omonto onde bwensi, ekiagera okonacha mogokora nigo gokorwa ase Nyasae. Onye kiina kende gionsi kere egekong’u ase more, mokendetere, na inche ninkenache.
swahili: Msionyeshe upendeleo katika maamuzi; wasikilizeni wote sawasawa, wadogo kwa wakubwa. Msimwogope mtu yeyote, kwa kuwa hukumu ni ya Mungu. Mniletee mimi shauri lolote lililo gumu sana kwenu, nami nitalisikiliza.

english: And at that time I commanded you all the things you were to do. Twelve Spies Sent Out (Numbers 13:1–33)
ekegusii: Naboigo ase engaki eria nabachiigete igoro y’amang’ana onsi mogwenerete gokora. Abanto chirooti bagatomwa korwa ase Kadeshi‐Barinea (Omob 13:1-33)
swahili: Nami wakati ule niliwaambia kila kitu ambacho mngefanya. Wapelelezi Wanatumwa (Hesabu 13:1-33)

english: And just as the LORD our God had commanded us, we set out from Horeb and went toward the hill country of the Amorites, through all the vast and terrifying wilderness you have seen. When we reached Kadesh-barnea,
ekegusii: Intwe togakora buna Omonene, Nyasae oito, atochiigete. Tokarua ase egetunwa gia Sinai, tokageenda, togaeta ase egati y’erooro enene ekwoboyia mono, eria mwarooche ase ense y’ebitunwa bia Abaamori; erio togaika Kadeshi‐Barinea.
swahili: Kisha, kama Bwana Mungu wetu alivyotuamuru, tuliondoka kutoka Horebu na kwenda kuelekea nchi ya vilima ya Waamori, kupitia jangwa lile kubwa lote la kutisha, lile mliloliona, nasi tukafika Kadesh-Barnea.

english: It is an eleven-day journey from Horeb to Kadesh-barnea by way of Mount Seir.
ekegusii: Nigo rore orogendo rwa amatuko ikomi na rimo korwa ase egetunwa kia Horebu goetera ase ense y’ebitunwa bia Edomu goika Kadeshi‐Barinea.
swahili: (Ni mwendo wa siku kumi na moja kutoka Horebu kwa njia ya Mlima Seiri mpaka Kadesh-Barnea.)

english: I said: “You have reached the hill country of the Amorites, which the LORD our God is giving us.
ekegusii: ’Nkabateebia: Bono mwaikire ase ense y’ebitunwa y’Abaamori, eyi’Omonene, Nyasae oito, agochia gotoa.
swahili: Kisha niliwaambia, “Mmefika katika nchi ya vilima ya Waamori, ambayo Bwana Mungu wetu anatupa.

english: See, the LORD your God has placed the land before you. Go up and take possession of it as the LORD, the God of your fathers, has told you. Do not be afraid or discouraged.”
ekegusii: Rigereria, Omonene Nyasae oino, obaeire ense eria. Genda moyeire ebe eyaino, buna Omonene, Nyasae bw’echisokoro chiaino, abateebirie. Timoiroka, gose timokwa emioyo.
swahili: Tazama, Bwana Mungu wenu amewapa nchi. Pandeni mkaimiliki kama Bwana, Mungu wa baba zenu, alivyowaambia. Msiogope, wala msikate tamaa.”

english: Then all of you approached me and said, “Let us send men ahead of us to search out the land and bring us word of what route to follow and which cities to enter.”
ekegusii: Erio inwe mwensi mogaacha ase ’nde, moganteebia: Totome abanto bagende koroota ense eria, erinde batorentere amang’ana buna ense eria ere, barore enchera togochia goetera, naende emechie eria togochia koira, buna ere.
swahili: Ndipo ninyi nyote mkanijia na kusema, “Tupeleke watu watutangulie kuipeleleza nchi kwa ajili yetu, na kutuletea taarifa kuhusu njia tutakayopita, na miji tutakayoiendea.”

english: The plan seemed good to me, so I selected twelve men from among you, one from each tribe.
ekegusii: Amang’ana ayio akarorekana ase ’nde ng’a namaya, na inche ngachoora abanto ikomi na babere, oyomo korwa ase kera egesaku.
swahili: Wazo hilo lilionekana zuri kwangu; kwa hiyo niliwachagua watu wenu kumi na wawili, mwanaume mmoja kutoka kila kabila.

english: They left and went up into the hill country, and came to the Valley of Eshcol and spied out the land.
ekegusii: Abanto abwo bakageenda gochia ase ense eria y’ebitunwa, bagaika ase ense omweya y’Esikoli, bakaroota ense eria.
swahili: Waliondoka na kukwea katika nchi ya vilima, wakafika katika Bonde la Eshkoli na kuipeleleza.

english: They took some of the fruit of the land in their hands, carried it down to us, and brought us word: “It is a good land that the LORD our God is giving us.” Israel’s Rebellion (Numbers 14:1–12)
ekegusii: Bakanyora okwama gw’ense eria, bagakorenta ase tore, naende bagatorentera amang’ana aya barooche agwo ase ense eria, bagakwana: Ense eri’Omonene Nyasae oito, agochia gotoa nigo ere entobu mono.
swahili: Wakachukua baadhi ya matunda ya nchi, wakatuletea na kutuarifu, “Ni nchi nzuri ambayo Bwana Mungu wetu anatupa.” Uasi Dhidi Ya Bwana (Hesabu 14:20-45)

english: But you were unwilling to go up; you rebelled against the command of the LORD your God.
ekegusii: Korende timwanchete kogeenda ase ense eria, mokaanga koigwera ogochika Omonene Nyasae oino, abaete.
swahili: Lakini hamkuwa tayari kukwea, mkaasi dhidi ya amri ya Bwana Mungu wenu.

english: You grumbled in your tents and said, “Because the LORD hates us, He has brought us out of the land of Egypt to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites to be annihilated.
ekegusii: Mokemurungania ekero mwamenyete ase chiema chiaino, mogateeba: Omonene nigo atogeechete, nakio kiagerete agatorusia korwa ase ense ya Misiri, erinde atobeeke ase amaboko ya Abaamori, nabarabwo batoite na gotosiria.
swahili: Mkanungʼunika ndani ya mahema yenu na kusema, “ Bwana anatuchukia, kwa hiyo alitutoa Misri ili kututia mikononi mwa Waamori kutuangamiza.

english: Where can we go? Our brothers have made our hearts melt, saying: ‘The people are larger and taller than we are; the cities are large, with walls up to the heavens. We even saw the descendants of the Anakim there.’”
ekegusii: Nase ki toragende aroro? Abaminto batwoboirie, ekiagera bateebire ng’a abanto bare ase ense eria n’abanene naende n’abatambe gotobua. Emechie yabo n’emenene, naende nigo egiteire chindwaki chigete igoro. Naende ntwarora amamonto aroro.
swahili: Twende wapi? Ndugu zetu wametufanya kufa moyo. Wanasema, ‘Watu wa huko wana nguvu zaidi na ni warefu kuliko sisi tulivyo; miji ni mikubwa, yenye kuta zilizofika juu angani. Zaidi ya hayo, tumewaona Waanaki huko.’ ”

english: So I said to you: “Do not be terrified or afraid of them!
ekegusii: Korende nkabateebia: Timoiroka abanto baria.
swahili: Ndipo nikawaambia, “Msihofu, wala msiwaogope.

english: In the fortieth year, on the first day of the eleventh month, Moses proclaimed to the Israelites all that the LORD had commanded him concerning them.
ekegusii: Ase rituko rie ritang’ani ri’omotienyi o ikomi nomo, omwaka bw’emerongo ene, korwa barwete Misiri, Musa akabateebia amang’ana onsi ayi’Omonene amochiigete abateebie.
swahili: Katika mwaka wa arobaini, siku ya kwanza ya mwezi wa kumi na moja, Mose aliwatangazia Waisraeli yale yote Bwana aliyomwamuru kuwahusu.

english: The LORD your God, who goes before you, will fight for you, just as you saw Him do for you in Egypt
ekegusii: Omonene Nyasae oino, oria okobaraa, nere orabarwanere esegi buna mwarooche ay’abakorerete ekero mwarenge Misiri,
swahili: Bwana Mungu wenu anayewatangulia, atawapigania, kama alivyofanya kwa ajili yenu huko Misri, mbele ya macho yenu hasa,

english: and in the wilderness, where the LORD your God carried you, as a man carries his son, all the way by which you traveled until you reached this place.”
ekegusii: naende ekero mwarenge ase erooro. ’Mwarooche buna abaraaete, na ase chinchera chionsi echio mwaetete goika mogaika aase aa: ere nigo ababogoretie buna omonto akobogoria omwana oye.
swahili: na pia huko jangwani. Huko mliona jinsi Bwana Mungu wenu alivyowachukua, kama baba amchukuavyo mwanawe, katika njia yote mliyoiendea mpaka mkafika mahali hapa.”

english: But in spite of all this, you did not trust the LORD your God,
ekegusii: Korende nonya okorete ayio onsi, timwegenete Omonene,
swahili: Pamoja na hili, hamkumtegemea Bwana Mungu wenu,

english: who went before you on the journey, in the fire by night and in the cloud by day, to seek out a place for you to camp and to show you the road to travel. Israel’s Penalty (Numbers 14:20–35)
ekegusii: nonya oyorenge kobatang’ana botambe na kobarigeria aase mware gochia gotoora. Ase obotuko nigo arenge kobaraa n’omorero, na ase omobaso obaraa ne riire, koborokia aase mware goetera. Omonene okoa Abaisraeli egesusuro (Omob 14:20-35)
swahili: ambaye aliwatangulia katika safari yenu, kwa moto usiku na kwa wingu mchana, kuwatafutia mahali penu pa kupiga kambi na kuwaonyesha njia mtakayoiendea.

english: When the LORD heard your words, He grew angry and swore an oath, saying,
ekegusii: Omonene akaigwa okwemurungania kwaino, akaba n’endamwamu, agatiana na goteeba:
swahili: Wakati Bwana aliposikia lile mlilosema, alikasirika, akaapa, akasema:

english: “Not one of the men of this evil generation shall see the good land I swore to give your fathers,
ekegusii: Ekeene, onde tari ase abanto b’ekegori eke ekebe oraike ase ense eria entobu narierete chisokoro chiaino eira ng’a nimbayee,
swahili: “Hakuna mtu wa kizazi hiki kiovu atakayeona nchi nzuri niliyoapa kuwapa baba zenu,

english: except Caleb son of Jephunneh. He will see it, and I will give him and his descendants the land on which he has set foot, because he followed the LORD wholeheartedly.”
ekegusii: otatiga Kalebu mosinto o Yefune. Ere nasoe ense eria. Ere obeire omwegenwa ase inde nimoyee ere na ororeeria rw’aye, ense eyio arotire.
swahili: isipokuwa Kalebu mwana wa Yefune. Yeye ataiona, nami nitampa yeye na wazao wake nchi aliyoikanyaga kwa miguu, kwa sababu alimfuata Bwana kwa moyo wote.”

english: The LORD was also angry with me on your account, and He said, “Not even you shall enter the land.
ekegusii: Ase engencho yaino Omonene nigo abeete n’endamwamu ase inde agateeba “Nonya naye Musa tokonyaara gosoa ase ense eria.”
swahili: Kwa sababu yenu Bwana pia alinikasirikia mimi, akasema, “Hutaingia hiyo nchi pia.

english: Joshua son of Nun, who stands before you, will enter it. Encourage him, for he will enable Israel to inherit the land.
ekegusii: Korende Yoshua, mosinto o Nuni, omokonyi oo, nere orasoe aroro. Mobeeke chinguru, omoremie, ekiagera nere oraraae Abaisraeli bagende koira ense eria.
swahili: Lakini msaidizi wako, Yoshua mwana wa Nuni, ataingia. Mtie moyo, kwa sababu atawaongoza Waisraeli kuirithi hiyo nchi.

english: And the little ones you said would become captives—your children who on that day did not know good from evil—will enter the land that I will give them, and they will possess it.
ekegusii: Naende Omonene agatoteebia twensi: Abana baino abake abwo mwateebete ng’a ’nabooswe, abwo ase rituko ria reero bataramanya ayaare amabe gose amaya, nabwo baraike ase ense eria, inche nimbayee ebe eyabo.
swahili: Wale watoto ambao mliwasema wangelichukuliwa mateka, yaani watoto wenu ambao bado hawajui jema na baya, wataingia katika nchi. Nitawapa hiyo nchi, nao wataimiliki.

english: This was after he had defeated Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived in Heshbon, and then at Edrei had defeated Og king of Bashan, who lived in Ashtaroth.
ekegusii: Amang’ana aya nigo abeete ekero Omonene konya abuire Sihoni, omorwoti bw’Abaamori, oyio ogambete ase omochie o Hesiboni, amo n’omorwoti Ogi o Basani, oyio ogambete ase emechie ya Asitaroti na Edirei.
swahili: Hii ilikuwa baada ya kumshinda Sihoni mfalme wa Waamori, ambaye alitawala Heshboni, na pia huko Edrei alikuwa amemshinda Ogu mfalme wa Bashani, ambaye alitawala huko Ashtarothi.

english: But you are to turn back and head for the wilderness along the route to the Red Sea. ” The Defeat at Hormah (Numbers 14:40–45)
ekegusii: Korende inwe onchoka, mogende gochia ase erooro, gochia ase enchera ekogeenda ase omosomo bwa Akaba.
swahili: Bali ninyi geukeni, mwondoke kuelekea jangwani kwa kufuata njia ya Bahari ya Shamu.”

english: “We have sinned against the LORD,” you replied. “We will go up and fight, as the LORD our God has commanded us.” Then each of you put on his weapons of war, thinking it easy to go up into the hill country.
ekegusii: Erio mokang’iraneria moganteebia: Musa twakorire ebibe ase Omonene, korende bono ’nkogeenda tore korwana esegi buna Omonene Nyasae oito, atochiigete. Kera omonto ase more akabogoria ebirwanero biaye bi’eseegi, akarengereria ng’a namang’ana amagusu kogeenda koira ense eria y’ebitunwa.
swahili: Ndipo mkanijibu, “Tumemtenda Bwana dhambi. Tutakwenda kupigana, kama Bwana Mungu wetu alivyotuamuru.” Hivyo kila mmoja wenu akachukua silaha zake, huku mkifikiri kuwa ni rahisi kukwea katika nchi ya vilima.

english: But the LORD said to me, “Tell them not to go up and fight, for I am not with you to keep you from defeat by your enemies.”
ekegusii: Omonene aganteebia: Bakanie, obateebie ng’a tibaabaisa kogeenda korwana esegi, ekiagera inche Omonene tindi amo nabarabwo. Kobaragende nigo bagochia kobugwa n’ababisa baabo.
swahili: Lakini Bwana aliniambia, “Waambie, ‘Msipande kupigana, kwa sababu sitakuwa pamoja nanyi. Mtashindwa na adui zenu.’ ”

english: So I spoke to you, but you would not listen. You rebelled against the command of the LORD and presumptuously went up into the hill country.
ekegusii: ’Nkabateebia amang’ana ayi’Omonene akwanete, korende mokaanga koigwera, mogasaria amang’ana Omonene abachiigete, mokageenda n’obomwenu ase ense eria y’ebitunwa.
swahili: Hivyo niliwaambia, lakini hamkutaka kusikia. Mliasi dhidi ya amri ya Bwana, na katika kiburi chenu mlienda katika nchi ya vilima.

english: Then the Amorites who lived in the hills came out against you and chased you like a swarm of bees. They routed you from Seir all the way to Hormah.
ekegusii: Abaamori abamenyete ase ense eria bagaacha bakabaumokera buna chinchoke. Bakabaseria goika Horima erio bakababua agwo ase ense y’ebitunwa ya Edomu.
swahili: Waamori ambao waliishi katika vilima hivyo waliinuka dhidi yenu, wakawafukuza kama kundi la nyuki wakiwapiga njia yote ya Seiri mpaka Horma.

english: And you returned and wept before the LORD, but He would not listen to your voice or give ear to you.
ekegusii: Erio inwe, mokarera ase Omonene abakoonye, korende Omonene taigwete ekerero kiaino gose tabategererete. Emiaka Abaisraeli bamenyete ase erooro
swahili: Mlirudi na kulia mbele za Bwana, lakini Mungu hakusikiliza kilio chenu, wala hakuwajali.

english: For this reason you stayed in Kadesh for a long time—a very long time.
ekegusii: Ekio gekagera mokabeera agwo Kadeshi ase amatuko amaange.
swahili: Hivyo mlikaa Kadeshi kwa siku nyingi, kwa muda ule wote mliokaa huko.

english: On the east side of the Jordan in the land of Moab, Moses began to explain this law, saying:
ekegusii: Nigo yarenge ekero abanto barenge ase ense ya Moabu, moocha y’orooche rwa Yorodani, Musa agachaaka kworokereria na kwegeria amachiiko a Nyasae. Ogoteeba,
swahili: Huko mashariki ya Yordani katika nchi ya Moabu, Mose alianza kuielezea sheria hii, akisema:

english: The LORD our God said to us at Horeb: “You have stayed at this mountain long enough.
ekegusii: Ekero twarenge ase egetunwa gia Sinai, Omonene, Nyasae oito, agakwana naintwe, agatoteebia, “Mwabereire aiga ase egetunwa eke ase egeka geisaine.
swahili: Bwana Mungu wetu alisema nasi huko Horebu, “Mmekaa vya kutosha katika mlima huu.

english: Resume your journey and go to the hill country of the Amorites; go to all the neighboring peoples in the Arabah, in the hill country, in the foothills, in the Negev, and along the seacoast to the land of the Canaanites and to Lebanon, as far as the great River Euphrates.
ekegusii: Tagora ebigutu imoka mochaake orogeendo rwaino. Genda gochia ase ense y’ebitunwa y’Abaamori, na ase abanto b’echinse chietanaineo-gochia ase Ekerubo kia Jorodani, na ase ense y’ebitunwa, na ase ense omweya, na ase ense ere ang’e n’Enyancha Enene. Mogende ase ense y’ Abakaanani gochia ase egetunwa kia Lebanoni, na goikera ase orooche roria oronene rw’Eufarati.
swahili: Vunjeni kambi, msonge mbele kuelekea nchi ya vilima ya Waamori; nendeni kwa watu wote ambao ni majirani wa Araba, katika milima, upande wa magharibi chini ya vilima, katika Negebu na kandokando ya pwani, mpaka nchi ya Wakanaani hadi Lebanoni, na kufika mto mkubwa Frati.

english: See, I have placed the land before you. Enter and possess the land that the LORD swore He would give to your fathers Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and to their descendants after them.” Moses Appoints Leaders (Exodus 18:13–27)
ekegusii: Eyio yonsi n’ense inche Omonene nariete eira koa chisokoro chiaino Aburaamu, na Isaka, na Yakobo, chisokoro chiaino, amo n’abanto b’ororeeria rwabo. Genda moyeire.” Musa ogochoora abagaambi (Okong’ 18:13-27)
swahili: Tazama, nimewapa ninyi nchi hii. Ingieni mkaimiliki nchi ambayo Bwana aliapa kuwa angaliwapa baba zenu, Abrahamu, Isaki na Yakobo, pamoja na vizazi vyao baada yao.” Uteuzi Wa Viongozi (Kutoka 18:13-27)

english: At that time I said to you, “I cannot carry the burden for you alone.
ekegusii: Musa agakwana n’abanto, Ase engaki eria twarenge egetunwa gia Sinai nigo nabateebetie ng’a inche bweka tinkonyaara kobaraa.
swahili: Wakati ule niliwaambia, “Ninyi mmekuwa mzigo mzito sana kwangu kuwachukua peke yangu.

english: When you go out to war against your enemies and see horses, chariots, and an army larger than yours, do not be afraid of them; for the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, is with you.
ekegusii: “Ekero moraabe mokogeenda korwania ababisa baino esegi, na mokorora chibarasi, ne’chigari, na abarwani babo bare abange kobua abaino, timobairoka, ekiagera Omonene Nyasae oino, oria obarusetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri, nigo are amo nainwe.
swahili: Mtakapokwenda vitani kupigana na adui zenu na mkaona farasi na magari ya vita na jeshi kubwa kuliko lenu, msiwaogope, kwa sababu Bwana Mungu wenu aliyewatoa kutoka Misri, atakuwa pamoja nanyi.

english: When you approach a city to fight against it, you are to make an offer of peace.
ekegusii: “Komogoika ang’e n’omochie mogochia korwania esegi, ritang’ani morarie amang’ana y’omorembe ase abanto b’omochie oyio.
swahili: Wakati mtakapokwenda kushambulia mji, wapeni watu wake masharti ya amani.

english: If they accept your offer of peace and open their gates, all the people there will become forced laborers to serve you.
ekegusii: Onye bakoiraneria ng’a berure abanyene ase more na kobaa ribaga mosoe ase omochie obo, rirorio abanto bonsi bare ase omochie oria ’mbabe bakobakorera emeremo emekong’u na babe abasomba baino.
swahili: Wakikubali na kuwafungulia malango yao, watu wake wote watawatumikia kwa kufanya kazi ngumu na watawatumikia.

english: But if they refuse to make peace with you and wage war against you, lay siege to that city.
ekegusii: Korende onye bakwanga kwerua abanyene ase more, korende baabarwanie esegi, rirorio moire omochie obo na komenyao.
swahili: Ikiwa watakataa kufanya mapatano ya amani na wakiwaingiza katika vita, basi mtauzunguka mji huo kwa vita.

english: When the LORD your God has delivered it into your hand, you must put every male to the sword.
ekegusii: Omonene Nyasae oino, kayobeekire ase amaboko aino, moite n’emioro abanto abasacha bonsi bareo.
swahili: Wakati Bwana Mungu wenu atakapouweka mji huo mkononi mwenu, waueni kwa upanga wanaume wote waliomo ndani yake.

english: But the women, children, livestock, and whatever else is in the city—all its spoil—you may take as plunder, and you shall use the spoil of your enemies that the LORD your God gives you.
ekegusii: Korende abakungu babo, na abana mobaire babe abaino, amo ne’chitugo chionsi. Ebinto bionsi ebire ase omochie oyio mobisakore, mobiire bibe ebiaino, nainwe mogookere ebisakorwa biababisa baino. Omonene Nyasae oino, nere obabieire.
swahili: Kwa upande wa wanawake, watoto, mifugo na kila kitu kingine chochote ndani ya huo mji, mnaweza kuvichukua kama nyara kwa ajili yenu. Nanyi mnaweza kuzitumia hizo nyara ambazo Bwana Mungu wenu amewapa kutoka kwa adui zenu.

english: This is how you are to treat all the cities that are far away from you and do not belong to the nations nearby.
ekegusii: Ayio naro morakore ase emechie ere aare korwa ase more, eyio etari y’ abanto bare ang’e naiga.
swahili: Hivi ndivyo mtakavyofanya kwa miji yote ambayo iko mbali nanyi, ambayo haimilikiwi na mataifa ya karibu.

english: However, in the cities of the nations that the LORD your God is giving you as an inheritance, you must not leave alive anything that breathes.
ekegusii: “Korende ase emechie y’ abanto b’ense eyi’Omonene Nyasae oino, agochia kobaa ebe omwando oino, timotiga getongwa kende gionsi kereo kebe moyo.
swahili: Hata hivyo, katika miji ya mataifa ambayo Bwana Mungu wenu anawapa kama urithi, msiache kitu chochote hai kinachopumua.

english: For you must devote them to complete destruction —the Hittites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites—as the LORD your God has commanded you,
ekegusii: Moite Abahiti, na Abaamori, na Abakaanani, na Abaperisi, na Abahivi, na Abayebusi, mobasirie kegima buna Omonene Nyasae oino, abachiigete.
swahili: Waangamizeni kabisa Wahiti, Waamori, Wakanaani, Waperizi, Wahivi na Wayebusi, kama Bwana Mungu wenu alivyowaamuru.

english: so that they cannot teach you to do all the detestable things they do for their gods, and so cause you to sin against the LORD your God.
ekegusii: Erio nario batabaise koborokereria inwe gokora okogeechia kwabo, okwo banarete ase ogosasiima chinyasae chiabo na gochikorera, na kogera inwe mokore ebibe ase Omonene Nyasae oino.
swahili: La sivyo, watawafundisha kufuata mambo yote ya machukizo wanayofanya wakiabudu miungu yao, nanyi mtatenda dhambi dhidi ya Bwana Mungu wenu.

english: When you lay siege to a city for an extended time while fighting against it to capture it, you must not destroy its trees by putting an axe to them, because you can eat their fruit. You must not cut them down. Are the trees of the field human, that you should besiege them?
ekegusii: “Ekero mwanaaririe omochie na koyoboera ase engaki entambe, na koyorwania esegi, erinde moyoire, timobaisa gosaria emete ereo. Monyaare koria amatunda y’emete eyio, korende timoyegeecha. Inee! Emete nero n’abanto erinde moyesirie?
swahili: Wakati mtakapouzunguka mji kwa vita kwa muda mrefu, mkipigana dhidi yake ili kuuteka, msiharibu miti yake kwa kuikata kwa shoka, kwa sababu mtaweza kula matunda yake. Hivyo msiikate. Je, miti hiyo ya mashambani ni watu, hata muizingire?

english: When you are about to go into battle, the priest is to come forward and address the army,
ekegusii: Ekero mogoika ang’e nase esegi ekorwanera, Omokuani ageende bosio, akwane n’abanto,
swahili: Wakati mtakapokaribia kwenda vitani, kuhani atakuja mbele na kuhutubia jeshi.

english: But you may destroy the trees that you know do not produce fruit. Use them to build siege works against the city that is waging war against you, until it falls.
ekegusii: Mogeeche emete eria yoka momanyete ng’a teri kwama amatunda akoriegwa. Moyekorere emeremo y’okoagachera aase mogokengana korwa ase omochie oria mokorwania esegi, goika obugwe.
swahili: Hata hivyo, mnaweza kuikata miti ambayo sio miti ya matunda na kuitumia kujenga ngome, mpaka mji ulio katika vita na ninyi utakapoanguka.

english: saying to them, “Hear, O Israel, today you are going into battle with your enemies. Do not be fainthearted or afraid; do not be alarmed or terrified because of them.
ekegusii: abateebie: Inwe Abaisraeli, tegerera! Bono mwabeire ang’e kogeenda korwania ababisa baino. Timobaisa gokwa emioyo, timoiroka gose koiguswa, gose timoboboa,
swahili: Atasema: “Sikia, ee Israeli, leo unakwenda vitani kupigana na adui zako. Usife moyo wala usiogope, usitishwe wala usitiwe hofu mbele yao.

english: For the LORD your God goes with you to fight for you against your enemies, to give you the victory.”
ekegusii: ekiagera Omonene Nyasae oino, nagende amo nainwe, erio arwanie ababisa baino na kobarentera obobui.
swahili: Kwa kuwa Bwana Mungu wenu ndiye huenda pamoja nanyi kuwapigania dhidi ya adui zenu na kuwapatia ushindi.”

english: Furthermore, the officers are to address the army, saying, “Has any man built a new house and not dedicated it? Let him return home, or he may die in battle and another man dedicate it.
ekegusii: “Erio abateneneri bakwane n’abanto, baabateebie: Onye omonto ore aiga oagachire enyomba, korende tarayemenya, tiga airane bwoye, tabaisa gochia gokwera ase esegi, na omonto omoao achie koira enyomba yaye na koyemenya.
swahili: Maafisa wataliambia jeshi: “Je, kuna yeyote aliyejenga nyumba mpya ambayo haijawekwa wakfu? Yeye na arudi nyumbani, ama sivyo anaweza kufa vitani na mtu mwingine akaiweka wakfu.

english: Has any man planted a vineyard and not begun to enjoy its fruit? Let him return home, or he may die in battle and another man enjoy its fruit.
ekegusii: Gose onye omonto ore aiga osimegete emesabibu ase omogondo oye, nere tararia amatunda korwao, tiga airane ageende ’nka, tabaisa gochia gokwera ase esegi, na omonto omoao achie koria amatunda y’omogondo oye.
swahili: Je, kuna yeyote aliyepanda shamba la mizabibu na hajaanza kulifurahia? Yeye na arudi nyumbani, au sivyo anaweza kufa vitani na mtu mwingine akalifurahia.

english: Has any man become pledged to a woman and not married her? Let him return home, or he may die in battle and another man marry her.”
ekegusii: Gose onye omonto ore aiga, oriereire omoiseke boko, ko taramorenta ’nka bwoye, tiga oyio airane agende ’nka, tabaisa gochia gokwera ase esegi, na omonto omoao achie koira omoiseke oria.
swahili: Je, kuna yeyote aliyeposa mwanamke na hajamwoa? Yeye na arudi nyumbani, ama sivyo anaweza kufa vitani na mtu mwingine akamwoa.”

english: Then the officers shall speak further to the army, saying, “Is any man afraid or fainthearted? Let him return home, so that the hearts of his brothers will not melt like his own.”
ekegusii: “Naende abateneneri baria bagenderere gokwana n’abanto, babateebie: Onye omonto ore aiga ore omwoba, ore n’enkoro eondogete, oyio tiga airane agende ’nka bwoye, tabaisa kogera chinkoro chi ’abaamwabo chiondoke buna aondogete ere omonyene.
swahili: Kisha maafisa wataongeza haya, “Je, kuna mtu anayeogopa ama kufa moyo? Yeye na arudi nyumbani ili ndugu zake nao wasije wakafa moyo pia.”

english: When the officers have finished addressing the army, they are to appoint commanders to lead it.
ekegusii: Na ekero abateneneri baria bakoorire gokwana n’abarwani baria, bachoore abatang’ani babe bakoraa abarwani b’esegi.
swahili: Wakati maafisa watakapomaliza kuzungumza na jeshi, watawateua wakuu wa vikosi.

english: If one is found slain, lying in a field in the land that the LORD your God is giving you to possess, and it is not known who killed him,
ekegusii: “Omonto karanyorekane oitirwe okuure ore orosana ime agwo ase ense eri’Omonene Nyasae oino, agochia kobaa, na onye omonto omoita tamanyekaneti,
swahili: Kama mtu akikutwa ameuawa, naye amelala kwenye shamba katika nchi ambayo Bwana Mungu wenu anawapa kuimiliki, wala haijulikani ni nani aliyemuua,

english: When you go to war against your enemies and the LORD your God delivers them into your hand and you take them captive,
ekegusii: “Ekero mokogeenda ase esegi korwania ababisa baino, n’Omonene Nyasae oino, ababeeke ase amaboko aino, nainwe mobabue na moboose,
swahili: Mkienda vitani kupigana na adui zenu naye Bwana Mungu wenu akawatia adui mikononi mwenu, nanyi mkachukua mateka,

english: if you see a beautiful woman among them, and you desire her and want to take her as your wife,
ekegusii: n’onde oino arore omokungu ore omonyakieni ase egati yabooswa abwo, nere aganie komoira abe mokaaye,
swahili: kama ukiona miongoni mwa mateka mwanamke mzuri wa sura nawe wavutwa naye, waweza kumwoa akawa mke wako.

english: then you shall bring her into your house. She must shave her head, trim her nails,
ekegusii: rirorio amoire ’nka bwoye, na omokungu oria akigite etukia y’omotwe oye naende aninte chinchara chiaye.
swahili: Mlete nyumbani mwako, anyoe nywele na kukata kucha zake,

english: and put aside the clothing of her captivity. After she has lived in your house a full month and mourned her father and mother, you may have relations with her and be her husband, and she shall be your wife.
ekegusii: Aonchoorerie chianga chiria abegete ekero oosetwe, na agenderere kobeera agwo enka y’omonto oyio, abe okoreera ise na ng’ina ase engaki y’omotienyi omogima. Magega yaye omonto oria amotware abe mokaaye.
swahili: avue nguo alizokuwa amevaa alipotekwa. Baada ya kuishi nyumbani mwako na kumwombolezea baba yake na mama yake kwa mwezi mzima, ndipo utakapoweza kumwendea na kuwa mume wake naye atakuwa mke wako.

english: And if you are not pleased with her, you are to let her go wherever she wishes. But you must not sell her for money or treat her as a slave, since you have dishonored her. Inheritance Rights of the Firstborn
ekegusii: Korende keraabe ng’a tagookiri n’omokuungu oyio, amoe ribaga agende aande onsi ase aranche, korende tamoonia chitaabu gose komokorera buna agokorera omosomba, ekiagera igo amobetereretie koba nere, na akamoa obosooku. Igoro y’omomura omotangi okoira omwando
swahili: Lakini kama hutaendelea kupendezwa naye, mwache aende popote anapotaka. Kamwe huwezi kumuuza au kumtendea kama mtumwa, kwa sababu utakuwa umemvunjia heshima. Haki Ya Mzaliwa Wa Kwanza

english: If a man has two wives, one beloved and the other unloved, and both bear him sons, but the unloved wife has the firstborn son,
ekegusii: “Nenyaare koba ng’a omonto nabwate abakungu babere; ere nigo anchete oyomo na bwangete oria onde. Abakungu abwo bonsi babere baiboreire omosacha oyio abana, korende omwana omoisia omotangi nigo are oyo bw’omokuungu oria angete.
swahili: Kama mwanaume ana wake wawili, naye anampenda mmoja na mwingine hampendi na wote wawili wamemzalia wana wa kiume, lakini mwana mzaliwa wa kwanza ni wa yule mke asiyempenda,

english: when that man assigns his inheritance to his sons he must not appoint the son of the beloved wife as the firstborn over the son of the unloved wife.
ekegusii: Ekero rituko ri’okobariera omwando riraike, omonto oria takoba ne ribaga gwanchereria omomura oye bw’omokuungu oria anchete, na komoa omwando bw’okoiborwa kw’obotangi ribaga ri’okomoa oria ore omotangi bori oiboreretwe n’omokuungu atancheti.
swahili: wakati anapotoa wosia wa mali yake kwa wanawe, kamwe asitoe haki za mzaliwa wa kwanza kwa mwana wa mke ampendaye kwa upendeleo, badala ya mzaliwa hasa wa kwanza, ambaye ni mwana wa mke ambaye hampendi.

english: Instead, he must acknowledge the firstborn, the son of his unloved wife, by giving him a double portion of all that he has. For that son is the firstfruits of his father’s strength; the right of the firstborn belongs to him. A Rebellious Son (Luke 15:11–32)
ekegusii: Goika amoe omomura oye omotangi chinibo ara kabere, nonya ore omwana bw’omokuungu atancheti. Omomura oyio nere omotangi; omwando bw’okoiborwa kw’obotangi n’oyoye. Igoro y’omomura otari koigwera
swahili: Ni lazima amkubali mwana wa mke asiyempenda kama mzaliwa wa kwanza kwa kumpa sehemu ya vile vyote alivyo navyo maradufu. Mwana huyo ni ishara ya kwanza ya nguvu za baba yake. Haki ya mzaliwa wa kwanza ni yake yeye. Mwana Mwasi

english: If a man has a stubborn and rebellious son who does not obey his father and mother and does not listen to them when disciplined,
ekegusii: “Nenyaare koba ng’a omonto nabwate omwana omomura omobe, omoenenu, otari koigwera ise gose ng’ina, nonya bateemire komoa egesusuro ase okomoorongeyia, ere tari kobaigwera.
swahili: Kama mtu ana mwana mkaidi na mwasi ambaye hamtii baba yake na mama yake, na hasikii wazazi wanapomrudi,

english: his father and mother are to lay hold of him and bring him to the elders of his city, to the gate of his hometown,
ekegusii: Ise na ng’ina omwana oyio bamobwate, bamoire ase abagaaka b’omochie agwo ase bakogaambera ebiina geita ki’omochie.
swahili: baba yake na mama yake watamleta kwa wazee kwenye lango la mji wake.

english: your elders and judges must come out and measure the distance from the victim to the neighboring cities.
ekegusii: rirorio abagaaka baino amo n’abagaambi, bageende korenga oboaare korwa aase agwo omonto oyio akwerete goika ase emechie eetanaine ere ang’e nase agwo.
swahili: wazee wenu na waamuzi watatoka na kupima umbali kutoka maiti alipolala mpaka kwenye miji ya jirani.

english: and say to the elders, “This son of ours is stubborn and rebellious; he does not obey us. He is a glutton and a drunkard.”
ekegusii: Agwo bakwane amang’ana aya ase abagaaka baria: Omwana oyo oito nigo are omoenenu, na omosaria, tari gotoigwera, nigo are omoria bobe na gotinda ase okonywa.
swahili: Watawaambia wazee, “Huyu mwanetu ni mkaidi na mwasi. Hatutii sisi, yeye ni mpotovu na mlevi.”

english: Then all the men of his city will stone him to death. So you must purge the evil from among you, and all Israel will hear and be afraid. Cursed Is Anyone Hung on a Tree
ekegusii: Erio agwo abanto bonsi b’omochie oye bamoake amagena goika akwe. Ase enchera eyio morusie obobe borue ase egati yaino. Abaisraeli bonsi kobaraigwe ayio, mbairoke. Amachiiko ande ao ao
swahili: Kisha wanaume wote wa mjini mwake watampiga kwa mawe mpaka afe. Ndivyo imewapasa kuondoa maovu kati yenu. Israeli yote itasikia hili na kuogopa. Sheria Mbalimbali

english: If a man has committed a sin worthy of death, and he is executed, and you hang his body on a tree,
ekegusii: “Onye omonto okorire ebibe na koegwa egesusuro ki’ogoitwa, asungwe ase omote.
swahili: Kama mtu ana hatia ya kosa linalompasa kuuawa naye akauawa, mwili wake utaangikwa mtini,

english: you must not leave the body on the tree overnight, but you must be sure to bury him that day, because anyone who is hung on a tree is under God’s curse. You must not defile the land that the LORD your God is giving you as an inheritance.
ekegusii: Omobere oye totigwa ore ase omote igoro obotuko obogima, korende otindekwe ase rituko erio erio, ekiagera omonto oitirwe ase ogosungwa nigo aragereirie na Nyasae. Timobaisa gotiga ense yaino ebe n’obobe, ense eyi’Omonene Nyasae oino, abaeire ebe omwando oino.
