swahili: kamwe msiuache mwili wake mtini usiku kucha. Hakikisheni mnauzika mwili wake siku ile ile, kwa sababu kila mtu anayeangikwa mtini yupo chini ya laana ya Mungu. Msiinajisi nchi ambayo Bwana Mungu wenu anawapa kama urithi wenu.

english: Then the elders of the city nearest the victim shall take a heifer that has never been yoked or used for work,
ekegusii: Erio abagaaka b’omochie oranyorekane ore ang’e kobua nase omonto oyio akwerete, bachoore ritororo ritarakorigwa emeremo, gose ritarasiberwa rikorogoto ase ogokuruura ebinto.
swahili: Kisha wazee wa ule mji ulio karibu zaidi na yule maiti watamchukua mtamba ambaye hajapata kufanyishwa kazi na ambaye hajafungwa nira,

english: bring the heifer to a valley with running water that has not been plowed or sown, and break its neck there by the stream.
ekegusii: Barabwo baire ritororo riria, baritirimbokie gochia ase rigoko ase orooche rore n’amaache agotirimboka, rigoko ritana koremwa gose gosimekwa chindagera, na aroro agwo ase rigoko, babune ebigoti bie ritororo riria.
swahili: na kumpeleka kwenye bonde ambalo halijapata kulimwa au kupandwa mazao na ambapo kuna chemchemi itiririkayo. Huko kwenye hilo bonde, wazee watamvunja yule mtamba shingo.

english: And the priests, the sons of Levi, shall come forward, for the LORD your God has chosen them to serve Him and pronounce blessings in His name and to give a ruling in every dispute and case of assault.
ekegusii: Na abakuani Abalawi bagende agwo ase rigoko, ekiagera Omonene Nyasae oino, abachoorire bamokorere na gosesenia ase erieta riaye. Ase ring’ana riabo kera eriomana na ogokorerana bobe ase obotindi ’nabinachwe.
swahili: Makuhani, hao wana wa Lawi, watasogea mbele, kwa kuwa Bwana Mungu wenu, amewachagua kuhudumu na kutoa baraka katika jina la Bwana, na kuamua mashauri yote ya mabishano na mashambulio.

english: Then all the elders of the city nearest the victim shall wash their hands by the stream over the heifer whose neck has been broken,
ekegusii: Abagaaka bonsi b’omochie oria ore ang’e kobua nase aria omonto oria aiteretwe baisaabere amaboko abo igoro ase ritororo riria riabunetwe ebigoti agwo ase rigoko.
swahili: Ndipo wazee wote wa mji ulio karibu zaidi na huyo maiti watanawa mikono yao juu ya huyo mtamba ambaye shingo yake imevunjwa huko kwenye bonde,

english: and they shall declare, “Our hands did not shed this blood, nor did our eyes see it.
ekegusii: Erio bakwane amang’ana aya ase okoenekia oborori bwabo: Amaboko aito tari aro aitera amanyinga aya, gose amaiso aito tarooche ayio kagokorwa.
swahili: nao watatangaza: “Mikono yetu haikumwaga damu hii, wala macho yetu hayakuona likifanyika.

english: Accept this atonement, O LORD, for Your people Israel whom You have redeemed, and do not hold the shedding of innocent blood against them.” And the bloodshed will be atoned for.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, abera abanto bao Abaisraeli, aba kwabooretie; tobabarera okomocha oko kw’ogoiterwa kw’amanyinga y’omonto otari na komocha. Naboigo baaberwe okomocha oko kw’ogoiterwa kw’amanyinga.
swahili: Ee Bwana, ukubali upatanisho kwa watu wako Israeli, ambao umewakomboa, wala usiwahesabie watu wako hatia ya damu ya mtu asiyekuwa na hatia.” Nayo damu iliyomwagika itakuwa imefanyiwa upatanisho.

english: So you shall purge from among you the guilt of shedding innocent blood, since you have done what is right in the eyes of the LORD. Marrying a Captive Woman
ekegusii: Goika morusie korwa ase more okomocha kw’ogoiterwa kw’amanyinga ’omonto otari na komocha; mokore boronge ase obosio bw’Omonene. Igoro y’abakuungu bugooswa korwa ase esegi
swahili: Hivyo mtakuwa mmejitakasa wenyewe kutoka hatia ya kumwaga damu isiyokuwa na hatia, kwa kuwa mmefanya lile lililo sawa mbele za macho ya Bwana. Kuoa Mwanamke Mateka

english: If you see your brother’s ox or sheep straying, you must not ignore it; be sure to return it to your brother.
ekegusii: “Korarore eng’ombe y’oyomino gose eng’ondi yaye ekogenda gosira, tobaisa koombia buna toyerochi, korende goika oyeiranie gochia ase omonyene.
swahili: Kama ukimwona ngʼombe au kondoo wa ndugu yako anapotea, usipuuze, bali uhakikishe unamrudisha kwa mwenyewe.

english: Do not plow with an ox and a donkey yoked together.
ekegusii: “Gokorema, tobaisa gosiberania eng’ombe n’etigere ching’use obokombe amo.
swahili: Usilime kwa maksai aliyefungwa nira pamoja na punda.

english: Do not wear clothes of wool and linen woven together.
ekegusii: “Tobaisa kobeeka eanga eroiseranirie chiusi chi’amarionya na echi’egatani amo.
swahili: Usivae nguo za sufu na kitani zilizofumwa pamoja.

english: You are to make tassels on the four corners of the cloak you wear. Marriage Violations
ekegusii: “Okore amasugunia, oyabeeke ase emego ene y’eganchwa yao entambe, eria okwambara. Amachiiko igoro y’okoba omweriiti
swahili: Fanya vishada kwenye pembe nne za joho unalovaa. Kukiuka Taratibu Za Ndoa

english: Suppose a man marries a woman, has relations with her, and comes to hate her,
ekegusii: “Nenyaare koba ng’a omonto onyuomire omokungu bamenyane, na magega y’ayio amwange,
swahili: Ikiwa mtu atamwoa mke na, baada ya kufanya naye tendo la ndoa, akamchukia,

english: and he then accuses her of shameful conduct and gives her a bad name, saying, “I married this woman and had relations with her, but I discovered she was not a virgin.”
ekegusii: amosoere ase amang’ana y’obonyaka, erio asarie erieta riaye, ogoteeba: Nigo naira omokungu oyo, na ekero naba nere tindoochi ebimanyererio bi’obwekungi bwaye.
swahili: akimsingizia na kumwita jina baya, akisema, “Nilimwoa mwanamke huyu, lakini nilipomkaribia sikupata uthibitisho wa ubikira wake”

english: Then the young woman’s father and mother shall bring the proof of her virginity to the city elders at the gate
ekegusii: “Onye naboigo, ise na ng’ina omoiseke oria bamoire ase abagaaka b’omochie oria, ase bakogaambera agwo ase egeita, baabarentere ebimanyererio bi’obwekungi bw’omoiseke oria.
swahili: ndipo baba na mama wa msichana wataleta uthibitisho kwamba alikuwa bikira kwa wazee wa mji kwenye lango.

english: and say to the elders, “I gave my daughter in marriage to this man, but he has come to hate her.
ekegusii: Ise omoiseke oria akwane n’abagaaka baria, abateebie: ’Naa omonto oyo omoiseke one abe mokaaye, na bono ere omwangire.
swahili: Baba wa msichana atawaambia wazee, “Nilimwoza binti yangu kwa huyu mwanaume, lakini hampendi.

english: And now he has accused her of shameful conduct, saying, ‘I discovered that your daughter was not a virgin.’ But here is the proof of her virginity.” And they shall spread out the cloth before the city elders.
ekegusii: Boigo osoereire omoiseke oyo one na omorenteire obosooku ogoteeba ng’a taroochi ebimanyererio bi’obwekungi bwaye. Korende rora aa, egetambaa eke nkebwate ebimanyererio bi’obwekungi bwaye. Erio barambore egetambaa keria ase amaiso ’abagaaka b’omochie oria.
swahili: Sasa amemsingizia na kusema, ‘Sikumkuta huyu binti akiwa bikira.’ Lakini hapa kuna uthibitisho wa ubikira wa binti yangu.” Kisha wazazi wake wataonyesha nguo zake kwa wazee wa mji,

english: Then the elders of that city shall take the man and punish him.
ekegusii: Erio abagaaka b’omochie oria babwate omosacha oria, bamoake ebiranya.
swahili: nao wazee watamchukua huyo mwanaume na kumwadhibu.

english: They are also to fine him a hundred shekels of silver and give them to the young woman’s father, because this man has given a virgin of Israel a bad name. And she shall remain his wife; he must not divorce her as long as he lives.
ekegusii: Naende bamonachere aakane, chitaabu, chisekeli chi’echifeta rigana erimo, amoe ise omoiseke oria, ekiagera osaririe erieta ri’omoiseke omwekungi bw’Abaisraeli. Erio oria agenderere koba mokaaye, na omosacha oye tabaisa komotiga nonya ng’ake ase obogima bwaye bwonsi.
swahili: Watamtoza shekeli mia moja za fedha na kupewa wazazi wa msichana, kwa sababu mwanaume huyu amempa bikira wa Kiisraeli jina baya. Ataendelea kuwa mke wake; kamwe hawezi kumpa talaka siku zote za maisha yake.

english: If your brother does not live near you, or if you do not know who he is, you are to take the animal home to remain with you until your brother comes seeking it; then you can return it to him.
ekegusii: Onye tamenyeti ang’e naye gose tomomanyeti, goika oyerente bwoo ebeere aroro goika oria omino ache koyerigia, erio omoyee.
swahili: Ikiwa huyo ndugu haishi karibu nawe au kama hufahamu yeye ni nani, mchukue nyumbani kwako huyo mnyama umweke mpaka mwenyewe aje kumtafuta. Ndipo umrudishie.

english: If, however, this accusation is true, and no proof of the young woman’s virginity can be found,
ekegusii: “Korende keraabe ng’a namaene ebimanyererio bi’obwekungi bw’omoiseke oria tibirorekaneti,
swahili: Hata hivyo, kama shtaka ni la kweli na hakuna uthibitisho juu ya ubikira wa huyo msichana ulioweza kupatikana,

english: she shall be brought to the door of her father’s house, and there the men of her city will stone her to death. For she has committed an outrage in Israel by being promiscuous in her father’s house. So you must purge the evil from among you.
ekegusii: rirorio bamorente ase egesieri ki’enyomba ya ise, na abanto b’omochie bw’omoiseke oria bamoake amagena akwe, ekiagera orentire obosooku ase egati y’Abaisraeli ase ogokora obonyaka ekero atarasoka. Goika morusie obobe borue ase more.
swahili: huyo msichana ataletwa kwenye mlango wa nyumba ya baba yake, na hapo watu wa mji wake watampiga kwa mawe hadi afe. Amefanya kitu cha aibu katika Israeli kwa kufanya ukahaba akiwa nyumbani kwa babaye. Lazima mwondoe uovu katikati yenu.

english: If a man is found lying with another man’s wife, both the man who slept with her and the woman must die. You must purge the evil from Israel.
ekegusii: “Omonto omosacha aise konyorekana oraire n’omokuungu bw’omonto onde, bonsi babere, omosacha oria amo n’omokuungu oria, goika baitwe bakwe. Goika morusie obobe borue ase Abaisraeli.
swahili: Ikiwa mwanaume atakutwa akizini na mke wa mtu mwingine, wote wawili, mwanaume na mwanamke aliyezini naye, lazima wauawe. Lazima mwondoe uovu katika Israeli.

english: If there is a virgin pledged in marriage to a man, and another man encounters her in the city and sleeps with her,
ekegusii: “Omoiseke omwekungi oriereirwe boko nomonto, karaumerane nomosaacha omoao agwo ase omochie, na omosacha oyio abe nere,
swahili: Ikiwa mwanaume atakutana na bikira mjini ambaye ameposwa na mtu akazini naye,

english: you must take both of them out to the gate of that city and stone them to death—the young woman because she did not cry out in the city, and the man because he has violated his neighbor’s wife. So you must purge the evil from among you.
ekegusii: mobasokie bonsi babere, mobaire isiko y’egeita ki’omochie, erio mobaake amagena bakwe. Omoiseke oria aitwe, ekiagera atakuurete akonywe, nonya orenge ase omochie ime, na omosacha oria, ekiagera atomana n’omoiseke oriereirwe boko n’omonto omoao. Goika morusie obobe borue ase more.
swahili: utawachukua wote wawili kwenye lango la mji na kuwapiga kwa mawe mpaka wafe; yule msichana kwa kuwa alikuwa mjini na hakupiga kelele kuomba msaada, na yule mwanaume kwa sababu amemtenda jeuri mke wa mtu mwingine. Lazima mwondoe uovu katikati yenu.

english: But if the man encounters a betrothed woman in the open country, and he overpowers her and lies with her, only the man who has done this must die.
ekegusii: “Korende omonto karaumerane n’omoiseke omwekungi oriereirwe boko n’omonto omoao amobwate ne chinguru abe nere agwo ase orosana isiko y’omochie, omonto oria nere bweka oraitwe akwe.
swahili: Lakini ikiwa itatokea mwanaume akakutana na msichana aliyeposwa huko mashambani, akambaka, mwanaume aliyefanya hivi peke yake ndiye atakayeuawa.

english: Do nothing to the young woman, because she has committed no sin worthy of death. This case is just like one in which a man attacks his neighbor and murders him.
ekegusii: Timokorera omoiseke oria ing’ana rinde; ere takorete okomocha kogwenerete aitwe, ekiagera amang’ana ayio nigo anga buna ekero omonto akorwania omonto onde omoao na komoita moeneno.
swahili: Usimtendee msichana yule jambo lolote; hajafanya dhambi inayostahili kifo. Shauri hili ni kama lile la yeyote ambaye anamshambulia na kumuua kwa makusudi jirani yake,

english: When he found her in the field, the betrothed woman cried out, but there was no one to save her.
ekegusii: Omonto oyio nigo amonyoorete agwo ase orosana, akamorwania ne chinguru. Nonya omoiseke oria okuurete akonywe, monto onde tarengeo okomokoonya.
swahili: kwa maana mwanaume huyo alimkuta msichana huko mashambani, na ingawa msichana aliyeposwa alipiga kelele, hapakuwa na mtu wa kumwokoa.

english: If a man encounters a virgin who is not pledged in marriage, and he seizes her and lies with her, and they are discovered,
ekegusii: “Omonto karaumerane n’omoiseke omwekungi otararierwa boko, na komobwata ne chinguru, abe nere, nabarabwo babere banyorwe,
swahili: Ikiwa itatokea mwanaume akutane na bikira ambaye hajaposwa na kumbaka nao wakakutwa,

english: then the man who lay with her must pay the young woman’s father fifty shekels of silver, and she must become his wife because he has violated her. He must not divorce her as long as he lives.
ekegusii: rirorio omonto oria naae ise omoiseke oria chitaabu, chisekeli chi’echifeta emerongo etano, atwaare omoiseke oria abe mokaaye, ekiagera omosareirie obwekungi bwaye; takoba n’eribaga komotiga ase obogima bwaye bwonsi.
swahili: mwanaume atamlipa baba wa msichana shekeli hamsini za fedha. Ni lazima amwoe huyo msichana, kwa maana amemfanyia jeuri. Kamwe hawezi kumpa talaka siku zote za maisha yake.

english: And you shall do the same for his donkey, his cloak, or anything your brother has lost and you have found. You must not ignore it.
ekegusii: Naboigo orakore koranyore etigere yaye, gose eanga yaye, gose gento kende gionsi ki’oyomino gesirete; aye kogokenyora tobaisa koombia tomogekoonyera.
swahili: Fanya vivyo hivyo ukimkuta punda wa nduguyo au joho lake au chochote alichopoteza. Usipuuze jambo hilo.

english: A man is not to marry his father’s wife, so that he will not dishonor his father’s marriage bed.
ekegusii: “Omonto tabaisa korara na moga ise, abaise korentera ise obosooku.
swahili: Mwanaume asimwoe mke wa baba yake; kamwe asidhalilishe kitanda cha baba yake.

english: If you see your brother’s donkey or ox fallen on the road, you must not ignore it; you must help him lift it up.
ekegusii: “Koranyore etigere y’oyomino yaguure inse agwo ase enchera, gose eng’ombe yaye, tobaisa koombia oyetige aroro; goika oyegororokie etenene.
swahili: Kama ukimwona punda wa nduguyo au ngʼombe wake ameanguka barabarani, usipuuze jambo hilo. Msaidie asimame kwa miguu yake.

english: A woman must not wear men’s clothing, and a man must not wear women’s clothing, for whoever does these things is detestable to the LORD your God.
ekegusii: “Omokungu tabaisa kobeeka chianga chi’omosaacha, gose omosacha tabaisa kobeeka echi’omokuungu. Onde bwensi orakore bo, nigo arakore ayaare okogeechia ase Omonene Nyasae oino.
swahili: Haimpasi mwanamke kuvaa nguo za kiume wala mwanaume kuvaa nguo za kike, kwa maana Bwana Mungu wenu anachukia yeyote ambaye hufanya hivi.

english: If you come across a bird’s nest with chicks or eggs, either in a tree or on the ground along the road, and the mother is sitting on the chicks or eggs, you must not take the mother along with the young.
ekegusii: “Keraabe ng’a kwanyoorire egeswa ki’enyoni kere igoro ase omote, gose inse ase riroba, na onyoore enyoni eng’ina eraire igoro ase amage aye, gose ase amagena, tobaisa koira enyoni eria amo n’amage aye.
swahili: Kama ukikuta kiota cha ndege kando ya barabara, iwe juu ya mti au chini, naye ndege amelala juu ya makinda au mayai, usimchukue huyo ndege pamoja na makinda yake.

english: You may take the young, but be sure to let the mother go, so that it may be well with you and that you may prolong your days.
ekegusii: Oire amage oka, korende eng’ina ero oyetige eiruruke egende. Korakore igo n’ebe buya ase ore, naende n’obe moyo ase engaki entambe.
swahili: Waweza kuchukua makinda, lakini uwe na hakika ya kumwacha huyo ndege, ili upate kufanikiwa na uweze kuishi maisha marefu.

english: If you build a new house, you are to construct a railing around your roof, so that you do not bring bloodguilt on your house if someone falls from it.
ekegusii: “Ekero okoagaacha enyomba enyia, goika oagache egetango ase ekerama insinyo, erio nario omonto atagwe korwao akwe; okomocha kw’ogokwa kw’omonto oragwe korwao tigokobarerwa enyomba yao.
swahili: Wakati unapojenga nyumba mpya, fanya ukuta wa kuzuia kandokando ya dari ili usijiletee hatia ya kumwaga damu juu ya nyumba yako ikiwa yeyote ataanguka kutoka humo.

english: Do not plant your vineyard with two types of seed; if you do, the entire harvest will be defiled —both the crop you plant and the fruit of your vineyard.
ekegusii: “Tobaisa gosimeka chimbusuro chi’ebisaku bibere ase omogondo oo bw’emesabibu; oise gokora bo okwama kwao gwonsi ogw’echio gwasimegete amo nokw’emesabibu nigo korairwe kobe agwo aase Aachenu.
swahili: Usipande aina mbili za mbegu katika shamba lako la mizabibu; ikiwa utafanya hivyo, si mazao utakayopanda tu yatakuwa najisi, bali nayo matunda ya shamba la mizabibu pia.

english: No man with crushed or severed genitals may enter the assembly of the LORD.
ekegusii: “Omosacha ogombairie, gose ekiimo kiaye ki’obosacha kebutogete, tabaisa gosoa ase omosangererekano Omonene.
swahili: Asiingie mtu yeyote aliyehasiwa kwa kupondwa makende au kwa kukatwa uume wake katika kusanyiko la Bwana.

english: If any man among you becomes unclean because of a nocturnal emission, he must leave the camp and stay outside.
ekegusii: Onye omonto ase egati yaino obeire oyotachenegeti ase ogosokia embusuro yaye y’oroiboro botuko, oyio asoke gochia isiko y’egetwori; tabaisa gosoa ime aroro.
swahili: Ikiwa mtu amechafuka kwa sababu ya kutokwa na shahawa usiku, inampasa atoke nje ya kambi na kukaa huko.

english: When evening approaches, he must wash with water, and when the sun sets he may return to the camp.
ekegusii: “Ekero kia mogoroba, esibie omobere n’amaache, na ekero bwairiire kegima asoe ase egetwori.
swahili: Lakini jioni ikikaribia ataoga, na baada ya jua kuzama ataingia tena kambini.

english: You must have a place outside the camp to go and relieve yourself.
ekegusii: “Mochoore aase isiko y’ebitwori ase mogochia gwekonyera.
swahili: Tengeni mahali nje ya kambi ambapo mnaweza kwenda kujisaidia.

english: And you must have a digging tool in your equipment so that when you relieve yourself you can dig a hole and cover up your excrement.
ekegusii: Mobe mokoimokia chinyimbo amo nebirwanero biaino; ekero mogochia rosana agwo isiko y’ebitwori, mokuunye chingoro ne chinyimbo chiria, na ekero mwekonyire motube obonyira n’amaroba.
swahili: Kama sehemu ya vifaa vyenu kuweni na kitu cha kulimia, nanyi mnapojisaidia, chimba shimo na kisha funika kile kikutokacho.

english: For the LORD your God walks throughout your camp to protect you and deliver your enemies to you. Your camp must be holy, lest He see anything unclean among you and turn away from you. Miscellaneous Laws
ekegusii: Ebitwori biaino goika bibe ebichenu, ekiagera Omonene Nyasae oino, nigo agotaara ase ebitwori biaino, erinde abakoonye, n’abeeke ababisa baino ase amaboko aino. Omonene tabaisa korora obonyinyeru ase more; aise koborora, nigo arabatige. Amachiiko are ao ao
swahili: Kwa kuwa Bwana Mungu wenu hutembea katika kambi yenu ili kuwalinda na kuwaweka adui zenu mikononi mwenu. Kambi yenu ni lazima iwe takatifu, ili asione kitu chochote miongoni mwenu kilicho kichafu akageuka na kuwaacha. Sheria Mbalimbali

english: Do not return a slave to his master if he has taken refuge with you.
ekegusii: “Onye omosomba otamire korwa ase omonene oye, ochire ase more, timobaisa komoirania gochia ase omonene oye naende.
swahili: Ikiwa mtumwa amekimbilia kwako, usimrudishe kwa bwana wake.

english: Let him live among you wherever he chooses, in the town of his pleasing. Do not oppress him.
ekegusii: Motige amenye amo nainwe ase omochie arachoore, oyio oramogookie agwo ase emechie yaino. Timobaisa komokorera bobe.
swahili: Mwache aishi miongoni mwenu mahali popote anapopapenda na katika mji wowote anaochagua. Usimwonee.

english: No daughter or son of Israel is to be a shrine prostitute.
ekegusii: “Onde taaba ase Abaisraeli, omokungu gose omosacha, okwebeeka ase obonyaka bwe chie hekalu.
swahili: Asiwepo Mwisraeli mwanamke kahaba au mwanaume hanithi wa mahali pa kuabudia miungu.

english: You must not bring the wages of a prostitute, whether female or male, into the house of the LORD your God to fulfill any vow, because both are detestable to the LORD your God.
ekegusii: Timobaisa korenta ase enyomba y’Omonene Nyasae oino, chitaabu chikonyorekana korwa ase obonyaka bw’abakuungu, gose obw’abasaacha banga buna chisese, ase ogoikerania chiira. Chibesa chikonyorekana korwa ase chinchera echio nigo chire okogeechia ase Omonene Nyasae oino.
swahili: Kamwe usilete mapato ya ukahaba ikiwa ni ya mwanamke au ni ya mwanaume katika nyumba ya Bwana Mungu wako kwa ajili ya nadhiri yoyote, kwa sababu Bwana Mungu wako anachukizwa na yote mawili.

english: Do not charge your brother interest on money, food, or any other type of loan.
ekegusii: “Ekero okoa omonto bw’egesaku kiao chitaabu singo, gose endagera, gose gento kende gionsi, tobaisa komoboria ebitoki ekero agokoiraneria egento keria airete singo.
swahili: Usimtoze ndugu yako riba, iwe ni fedha ama chakula ama kitu kingine chochote ambacho waweza kupata riba juu yake.

english: No one of illegitimate birth may enter the assembly of the LORD, nor may any of his descendants, even to the tenth generation.
ekegusii: “Ekerentane, gose omonto bw’ororeeria rw’aye, nonya ngoika ekiaare gia ikomi, tabaisa gosoa ase omosangererekano Omonene.
swahili: Mtu yeyote ambaye amezaliwa kwenye ndoa isiyo halali au wazao wake wasiingie kwenye kusanyiko la Bwana, hata mpaka kizazi cha kumi.

english: You may charge a foreigner interest, but not your brother, so that the LORD your God may bless you in everything to which you put your hand in the land that you are entering to possess.
ekegusii: Nonyare gosaba ebitoki korwa ase omonto omomenyi kwaete singo, korende tari korwa ase omonto omino Omoisraeli. Koraigwere amang’ana ayio, rirorio Omonene Nyasae oino, nagosesenie ase ense eria mogochia koira ebe eyaino.
swahili: Unaweza kumtoza mgeni riba, lakini siyo nduguyo Mwisraeli, ili kwamba Bwana Mungu wako akubariki katika kila kitu unachoweka mkono katika nchi unayoingia kuimiliki.

english: If you make a vow to the LORD your God, do not be slow to keep it, because He will surely require it of you, and you will be guilty of sin.
ekegusii: “Ekero okoria eira ase Omonene, Nyasae oo, goika oikeranie eira eyio. Otayeikeraneti nigo Omonene arakobarere ebibe ebio.
swahili: Ukiweka nadhiri kwa Bwana Mungu wako, usichelewe kuitimiza, kwa kuwa Bwana Mungu wako atakudai, nawe utakuwa na hatia ya dhambi.

english: But if you refrain from making a vow, you will not be guilty of sin.
ekegusii: Korende koratige koria eira, tokobarerwa ebibe ase ayio.
swahili: Lakini ukijizuia kuweka nadhiri, hutakuwa na hatia.

english: Be careful to follow through on what comes from your lips, because you have freely vowed to the LORD your God with your own mouth.
ekegusii: Orende mono, oikeranie egento gwakwanete n’omonwa oo, ekiagera nigo kwariete eira y’ogwancha ase Omonene, Nyasae oo.
swahili: Chochote kitakachotamkwa kwa midomo yako ni lazima uhakikishe umekifanya, kwa sababu uliweka nadhiri yako kwa hiari mbele za Bwana Mungu wako kwa kinywa chako mwenyewe.

english: When you enter your neighbor’s vineyard, you may eat your fill of grapes, but you must not put any in your basket.
ekegusii: “Ekero ogoeta ase omogondo bw’emesabibu bw’omogisangio oo norie amatunda y’emesabibu goika oigote, korende totwa nonya n’erimo obeeke ase esaaro yao na koriira.
swahili: Kama ukiingia katika shamba la mizabibu la jirani yako, unaweza kula zabibu kadiri utakavyo, lakini usiweke chochote kwenye kikapu chako.

english: When you enter your neighbor’s grainfield, you may pluck the heads of grain with your hand, but you must not put a sickle to your neighbor’s grain.
ekegusii: Ekero oraabe kogoeta ase omogondo bw’omogisangio oo ore n’endagera eteneine, notabore ebigara n’okoboko kwao obunge otakune chinyeke, korende tobaisa kogesa n’omoyio oo ore enkuro endagera yaye eteneine.
swahili: Kama ukiingia katika shamba la nafaka la jirani yako, unaweza kukwanyua kwa mikono yako, lakini usikate kwa mundu nafaka iliyosimama.

english: No Ammonite or Moabite or any of their descendants may enter the assembly of the LORD, even to the tenth generation.
ekegusii: “Abaamoni, gose Abamoabu, gose ororeeria rwabo, nonya ngoika ekiaare gia ikomi, tibaabaisa gosoa ase omosangererekano bw’Omonene nonya ng’ake.
swahili: Hapatakuwa na Mwamoni au Mmoabu au yeyote wa wazao wao atakayeruhusiwa kuingia katika kusanyiko la Bwana, hata mpaka kizazi cha kumi.

english: For they did not meet you with food and water on your way out of Egypt, and they hired Balaam son of Beor from Pethor in Aram-naharaim to curse you.
ekegusii: Barabwo tibaabarototete na kobarentera endagera na amaache ekero mwarenge ase orogeendo korwa Misiri, naende nigo barangeretie Baalamu, mosinto o Beori, korwa Petori ya Mesopotamia achiche kobaragereria inwe.
swahili: Kwa kuwa hawakuja kuwalaki wakiwa na mkate na maji mlipokuwa njiani mlipotoka Misri, tena walimwajiri Balaamu mwana wa Beori kutoka Pethori iliyoko Aramu-Naharaimu ili kuwalaani ninyi.

english: Yet the LORD your God would not listen to Balaam, and the LORD your God turned the curse into a blessing for you, because the LORD your God loves you.
ekegusii: Nonya naboigo Omonene Nyasae oino, taigwerete Baalamu, korende akaonchora okoragereria koria gokaba ogosesenigwa ase more, ekiagera Omonene Nyasae oino, nigo abanchete.
swahili: Hata hivyo, Bwana Mungu wenu hakumsikiliza Balaamu bali aligeuza laana kuwa baraka kwenu kwa sababu Bwana Mungu wenu anawapenda.

english: You are not to seek peace or prosperity from them as long as you live.
ekegusii: Ase amatuko aino onsi more moyo, timobaisa kobarigeria omorembe, gose ogosesenigwa.
swahili: Msitafute mapatano ya urafiki nao maisha yenu yote.

english: Do not despise an Edomite, for he is your brother. Do not despise an Egyptian, because you lived as a foreigner in his land.
ekegusii: “Timobaisa gochaaya Abaedomu, barabwo n’abanto bamino; gose timobaisa gochaaya Abamisiri, ekiagera inwe agwo kare nao mwarenge abamenyi ase ense yabo.
swahili: Usimchukie Mwedomu, kwa kuwa yeye ni ndugu yako. Usimchukie Mmisri, kwa sababu uliishi kama mgeni katika nchi yake.

english: The third generation of children born to them may enter the assembly of the LORD. Uncleanness in the Camp (Leviticus 15:1–12)
ekegusii: Abanto b’ekiaare kia gatato ase ororeeria rwabo, bancherwe basoe ase omosangererekano Omonene. Okorenda egetwori ki’abarwani b’esegi kebe gechenegete
swahili: Kizazi cha tatu cha watoto watakaozaliwa nao wanaweza kuingia katika kusanyiko la Bwana. Unajisi Katika Kambi

english: When you are encamped against your enemies, then you shall keep yourself from every wicked thing.
ekegusii: “Ekero morabe mokogeenda korwania ababisa baino, na momenyete ase egetwori, mwerende mono korwa ase kera egento getachenegeti.
swahili: Unapokuwa umepiga kambi dhidi ya adui zako, jitenge na kitu chochote kisicho safi.

english: If a man marries a woman, but she becomes displeasing to him because he finds some indecency in her, he may write her a certificate of divorce, hand it to her, and send her away from his house.
ekegusii: “Nenyaare koba ng’a omonto onyuomire omokungu, na magega y’ayio amwange, ekiagera anyorire ring’ana ase are ritamogogeti. Erio amoriikere riruube ri’ogotigana nere, ae omokungu oria na komoseeria korwa bwoye.
swahili: Ikiwa mtu atamwoa mke na akamchukia kwa sababu ya kukosa adabu, naye akamwandikia hati ya talaka, akampa na kumfukuza kutoka nyumbani kwake,

english: When you lend anything to your neighbor, do not enter his house to collect security.
ekegusii: “Ekero okoa omogisangio oo egento kende gionsi singo, tobaisa gosoa ase enyomba yaye koira egento keria abeekire kebe intenenera.
swahili: Unapomkopesha jirani yako chochote, usiingie nyumbani kwake kutwaa kile anachokitoa kama rehani.

english: You are to stand outside while the man to whom you are lending brings the security out to you.
ekegusii: Aye otenene isiko y’enyomba yaye, nere akorentere egento abeeka koba intenenera.
swahili: Ukae nje na umwache huyo mtu uliyemkopesha akuletee hiyo rehani.

english: If he is a poor man, you must not go to sleep with the security in your possession;
ekegusii: Onye omonto oria n’omotaka, tobaisa kogeenda korara n’egento keria kiaye kere bwoo.
swahili: Ikiwa mtu huyo ni maskini, usiende kulala ukiwa na hiyo rehani yake katika milki yako.

english: be sure to return it to him by sunset, so that he may sleep in his own cloak and bless you, and this will be credited to you as righteousness before the LORD your God.
ekegusii: “Ekero bogochia koira omoiranerie egetambaa akwambara erinde ebisie, nario aragosesenie, na igo gwakorire ayaare boronge ase obosio bw’Omonene, Nyasae oo.
swahili: Rudisha vazi lake kabla ya machweo ya jua ili apate kulilalia. Kisha atakushukuru na kitaonekana kama kitendo cha haki mbele za Bwana Mungu wako.

english: Do not oppress a hired hand who is poor and needy, whether he is a brother or a foreigner residing in one of your towns.
ekegusii: “Tobaisa gokorera bobe omonto omoriikwa ore omotaka na oremeire, karabe omonto omino Omoisraeli, gose omomenyi omenyete ase ense yaino.
swahili: Usimwonee mtu maskini na mhitaji ambaye umemwajiri, akiwa ni nduguyo Mwisraeli au mgeni anayeishi katika mojawapo ya miji yenu.

english: You are to pay his wages each day before sunset, because he is poor and depends on them. Otherwise he may cry out to the LORD against you, and you will be guilty of sin.
ekegusii: Rituko riria akorire emeremo, omoe eng’eria yaye ritang’ani risase ritaragwa, ekiagera ere n’omotaka, nigo asemeretie konyora eng’eria yaye. Onye tokomoakana nigo arabaise korera ase Omonene igoro yao, naende ayio nigo arabe ebibe ase ore.
swahili: Mlipe ujira wake kila siku kabla ya jua kutua, kwa sababu yeye ni maskini na anautegemea ujira huo. La sivyo, anaweza kumlilia Bwana dhidi yako, nawe ukapata hatia ya dhambi.

english: Fathers shall not be put to death for their children, nor children for their fathers; each is to die for his own sin.
ekegusii: “Abaibori tibagoitwa ase engencho y’ebibe bi’abana babo, gose abana tibagoitwa ase engencho y’ebibe bi’abaibori babo; korende kera omonto nigo araitwe ase engencho y’ebibe biaye omonyene.
swahili: Baba wasiuawe kwa ajili ya watoto wao, wala watoto wasiuawe kwa ajili ya baba zao; kila mmoja atakufa kwa ajili ya dhambi yake mwenyewe.

english: Do not deny justice to the foreigner or the fatherless, and do not take a widow’s cloak as security.
ekegusii: “Tobaisa korina omonto omomenyi, gose entakaana, oboronge bwaye, na toira eanga y’ omoboraka ebe intenenera.
swahili: Usipotoshe hukumu ya mgeni au yatima, au kuchukua vazi la mjane kama rehani.

english: Remember that you were slaves in Egypt, and the LORD your God redeemed you from that place. Therefore I am commanding you to do this.
ekegusii: Korende moinyore ing’a nainwe ’mwarenge abasomba ase ense ya Misiri, korende Omonene Nyasae oino, akababooria korwa aroro; ase ayio nabachiikire mobwatie amang’ana ayio.
swahili: Kumbukeni kwamba mlikuwa watumwa huko Misri, naye Bwana Mungu wenu akawakomboa kutoka huko. Hii ndiyo sababu ninawaamuru kutenda hili.

english: If you are harvesting in your field and forget a sheaf there, do not go back to get it. It is to be left for the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow, so that the LORD your God may bless you in all the work of your hands.
ekegusii: “Ekero mokogesa chindagera chi’emegondo yaino, na mwebe omosaima bw’endagera mogondo, timobaisa koirana gochia koywoyia, korende moyotige obe oyo bw’omonto omomenyi omenyete ase more, gose oyo bwe chintakana, n’ababoraka, erio nario Omonene Nyasae oino, arasesenie emeremo yaino yonsi mogokora.
swahili: Unapovuna shamba lako na ukasahau mganda, usirudi kuuchukua. Acha kwa ajili ya mgeni, yatima na mjane, ili Bwana Mungu wako aweze kukubariki wewe katika kazi zote za mikono yako.

english: If, after leaving his house, she goes and becomes another man’s wife,
ekegusii: Naende nenyaare koba ng’a omokungu oyio gatigire omosacha oria, agende anyuomwe n’omosaacha omoao,
swahili: ikiwa baada ya kuondoka nyumbani kwake atakuwa mke wa mtu mwingine,

english: When you beat the olives from your trees, you must not go over the branches again. What remains will be for the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow.
ekegusii: Ekero mwatorire amazeituni aino, timoirana naende gosangereria ase chinsagia aya mwamochete gotora. Moyatigere abamenyi, ne’chintakana, n’ababoraka.
swahili: Unapovuna zeituni kutoka miti yako, usirudie matawi mara ya pili. Acha kilichobaki kwa ajili ya mgeni, yatima na mjane.

english: When you gather the grapes of your vineyard, you must not go over the vines again. What remains will be for the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow.
ekegusii: Ekero mwatorire amasabibu aino, timoirana naende gochia gosangereria ayatigaire, korende moyatigere abamenyi, ne’chintakana, n’ababoraka.
swahili: Unapochuma zabibu katika shamba lako la mizabibu usirudie tena. Acha zinazobaki kwa ajili ya mgeni, yatima na mjane.

english: Remember that you were slaves in the land of Egypt. Therefore I am commanding you to do this.
ekegusii: Inyora ng’a inwe nigo mwarenge abasomba ase ense ya Misiri; ase ayio nabachiikire mobwatie amang’ana ayio.
swahili: Kumbuka kwamba mlikuwa watumwa katika nchi ya Misri. Ndiyo sababu ninawaamuru kufanya hili.

english: and the second man hates her, writes her a certificate of divorce, hands it to her, and sends her away from his house, or if he dies,
ekegusii: na oyo nere amwange, amoriikere riruube ri’ogotigana, amoseerie korwa bwoye, gose omosacha oyio o kabere akwe.
swahili: ikiwa mume wake wa pili atachukizwa naye akamwandikia hati ya talaka, akampa na kumfukuza kutoka nyumbani kwake, au kama akifa,

english: then the husband who divorced her first may not remarry her after she has been defiled, for that is an abomination to the LORD. You must not bring sin upon the land that the LORD your God is giving you as an inheritance.
ekegusii: Ase amang’ana ayio onsi, omosacha oria bw’eritang’ani omoseretie, tabaisa komoirania goocha bwoye abe mokaaye naende, ekiagera omokungu oria obeire oyotachenegeti; okwo nigo kore okogeechia ase obosio bw’Omonene, nainwe timobaisa korenta okomocha kobe ase ense eyi’Omonene Nyasae oino, agochia kobaa ebe omwando oino. Amachiiko are ao ao
swahili: basi yule mume wake wa kwanza, ambaye alimpa talaka, haruhusiwi kumwoa tena baada ya mwanamke huyo kuwa najisi. Hayo yatakuwa machukizo machoni pa Bwana. Usilete dhambi juu ya nchi ambayo Bwana Mungu wako anakupa kama urithi.

english: If a man is newly married, he must not be sent to war or be pressed into any duty. For one year he is free to stay at home and bring joy to the wife he has married. Additional Laws
ekegusii: “Onye omonto onyuomire omokungu tageenda ase esegi amo n’abarwani bande, gose taegwa emeremo ende yonsi akorere egesaku, korende nigo araegwe ribaga abeere ’nka bwoye ase omwaka oyomo kogokia mokaaye.
swahili: Kama mtu ameoa karibuni, kamwe asipelekwe vitani au kupewa wajibu mwingine wowote. Kwa mwaka mmoja atakuwa huru kubaki nyumbani ili amfurahishe mke aliyemwoa.

english: Do not take a pair of millstones or even an upper millstone as security for a debt, because that would be taking one’s livelihood as security.
ekegusii: “Onye omonto okoa omonto onde egento singo, taira orogena gose ensio bibe intenenera, ekiagera igo n’obogima bwaye akoira bobe intenenera.
swahili: Usitoe jozi ya mawe ya kusagia, hata ikiwa lile la juu, kuweka rehani kwa ajili ya deni, kwa sababu itakuwa ni kuweka uhai wa mtu kama dhamana.

english: If a man is caught kidnapping one of his Israelite brothers, whether he treats him as a slave or sells him, the kidnapper must die. So you must purge the evil from among you.
ekegusii: “Omonto karanyorekane oibire Omoisraeli omwabo amokore buna omosomba, gose amoonie, omoibi oria goika aitwe akwe. Goika morusie obobe korwa ase more.
swahili: Kama mtu akikamatwa akiiba yeyote miongoni mwa ndugu zake wa Waisraeli na kumtenda kama mtumwa au akimuuza, mwizi huyo ni lazima auawe. Nawe utaondoa uovu kutoka miongoni mwenu.

english: In cases of infectious skin diseases, be careful to diligently follow everything the Levitical priests instruct you. Be careful to do as I have commanded them.
ekegusii: “Mwerende mono ekero mwarwarire oborwaire bwa ukoma, mokore buna abakuani Abalawi barabateebie.
swahili: Pakitokea magonjwa ya ngozi ya kuambukiza, mwe waangalifu sana kufanya sawasawa na maagizo ya makuhani, ambao ni Walawi. Ni lazima mfuate kwa uangalifu yale niliyowaamuru.

english: Remember what the LORD your God did to Miriam on the journey after you came out of Egypt.
ekegusii: Ayio onsi inche nabachiigete ng’a babateebie, goika moyakore. Inyora ay’Omonene Nyasae oino, akorerete Miriamu ekero mwarenge ase orogeendo rwaino korwa Misiri.
swahili: Kumbukeni kile Bwana Mungu wenu alichomfanyia Miriamu njiani baada ya ninyi kutoka Misri.

english: If there is a dispute between men, they are to go to court to be judged, so that the innocent may be acquitted and the guilty condemned.
ekegusii: “Onye abanto babere babwate eriomana ase egati yabo, rirorio bageende ase ekegaambero, erio abagaambi bagaambe ekiina ekio, na oyio ore n’oboronge aegwe oboronge bwaye, na oria ore n’okomocha abarerwe okomocha kwaye.
swahili: Watu wanapokuwa na ugomvi, wapeleke mahakamani na waamuzi wataamua shauri hilo; watawaachia wasio na kosa na kuwahukumu wenye hatia.

english: And his family name in Israel will be called “The House of the Unsandaled.”
ekegusii: Eamate y’omonto oyio emanyekane ase Abaisraeli, buna eamate y’omonto oyio osomoretwe egekooroto korwa ase okogoro kwaye. Amachiiko ande
swahili: Jamaa ya mtu huyo itafahamika katika Israeli kama Jamaa ya Aliyevuliwa Kiatu.

english: If two men are fighting, and the wife of one steps in to rescue her husband from the one striking him, and she reaches out her hand and grabs his genitals,
ekegusii: “Ekero abasacha babere bakorwana, na omokungu bw’omosaacha oyomo achiche gokoonya omosacha oye, na omokungu oria arambore okoboko abwate ekiimo ki’obosaacha ki’omonto oria onde,
swahili: Ikiwa watu wawili wanapigana na mke wa mmoja wao akaja kumwokoa mumewe na yule anayemshambulia, naye mke huyo akifika na kumkamata sehemu za siri,

english: You shall not have two differing weights in your bag, one heavy and one light.
ekegusii: “Timobaisa koba n’ebirengo bibere ase chisaaro chiaino, ekemo ekenene na ekende egeke.
swahili: Usiwe na mawe ya kupimia ya aina mbili katika mkoba wako, moja zito na jingine jepesi.

english: You shall not have two differing measures in your house, one large and one small.
ekegusii: Timobaisa gotwara ebimunu bikorenga bibere ase chinyomba chiaino, ekemo ekenene, na ekende egeke.
swahili: Usiwe na vipimo viwili tofauti katika nyumba yako, kimoja kikubwa, kingine kidogo.

english: You must maintain accurate and honest weights and measures, so that you may live long in the land that the LORD your God is giving you.
ekegusii: Mokorere ebirengo bi’ekeene, naende ebiisaine bi’okomanya oborito na obonge; erio nario amatuko aino arabe amaange ase ense eri’Omonene Nyasae oino, agochia kobaa.
swahili: Ni lazima uwe na uzito na vipimo sahihi na vya haki, ili upate kuishi maisha marefu katika nchi anayokupa Bwana Mungu wako.

english: For everyone who behaves dishonestly in regard to these things is detestable to the LORD your God. Revenge on the Amalekites
ekegusii: Abanto bonsi bagokora oborianania buna obwo, nigo bare okogeechia ase Omonene Nyasae oino. Amachiiko ay’ogoita Abaameleki
swahili: Kwa maana Bwana Mungu wako humchukia yeyote ambaye hufanya mambo kama haya, yeyote anayetenda kwa udanganyifu.

english: Remember what the Amalekites did to you along your way from Egypt,
ekegusii: “Moinyore aya Abaameleki baabakorerete ekero mwarenge ase orogeendo korwa Misiri.
swahili: Kumbuka kile Waamaleki walichowatendea mlipokuwa njiani mkitoka Misri.

english: how they met you on your journey when you were tired and weary, and they attacked all your stragglers; they had no fear of God.
ekegusii: Barabwo tibamoirogete Nyasae. Ase ayio bagaacha, bakabarwania na goita abanto abatigarete magega konya bagoyire na korosa.
swahili: Wakati mlipokuwa mmechoka na kuishiwa nguvu kwa safari yenu, wakawapiga wale wote waliokuja nyuma. Waamaleki hawakumwogopa Mungu.

english: When the LORD your God gives you rest from the enemies around you in the land that He is giving you to possess as an inheritance, you are to blot out the memory of Amalek from under heaven. Do not forget!
ekegusii: Ase ayio, n’ebe ekero Omonene Nyasae oino, abaeire ense eria ebe omwando oino, naende ekero abaeire obotoereru korwa ase ababisa baino bonsi baabaetanaine, goika mosirie Abaameleki bonsi, tibainyorwa nonya ng’ake inse y’erioba. Timobaisa kweba amang’ana ayio.
swahili: Bwana Mungu wako atakapokupa pumziko mbali na adui zako wote wanaokuzunguka katika nchi akupayo kuimiliki kuwa urithi, utafutilia mbali kumbukumbu lote la Waamaleki chini ya mbingu. Usisahau!

english: If the guilty man deserves to be beaten, the judge shall have him lie down and be flogged in his presence with the number of lashes his crime warrants.
ekegusii: Keraabe ng’a oria omomochi nigo agwenerete goakwa ebiranya, omogambi oria amochiike aramame inse agwo ase obosio bwaye na goakwa ebiranya koreng’ana buna okomocha kwaye kore.
swahili: Kama mtu mwenye hatia anastahili kuchapwa, mwamuzi atamwamuru alale chini ili achapwe mbele yake idadi ya viboko kulingana na kosa lake,

english: He may receive no more than forty lashes, lest your brother be beaten any more than that and be degraded in your sight.
ekegusii: Omonto oyio aakwe ebiranya emerongo ene, korende tari goetania ebio; aise kogenderera goakwa goetania, nigo arasookigwe ase obosio bwao. Takoegwa ogoakwa goetania okwo gochiikire.
swahili: lakini kamwe asichapwe zaidi ya viboko arobaini. Ikiwa atachapwa zaidi ya viboko arobaini, nduguyo atadhalilika machoni pako.

english: When brothers dwell together and one of them dies without a son, the widow must not marry outside the family. Her husband’s brother is to take her as his wife and fulfill the duty of a brother-in-law for her.
ekegusii: “Onye abamura babere ba ise omo bamenyete aase aamo, na oyomo akwe, nere tabwate omwana, omokungu bw’omonto oria takonyuomwa n’omonto bw’eamate eng’ao, korende omomura omwabo omosacha oye nere oratware omokungu oria abe ribaga ria momura omwabo.
swahili: Ikiwa ndugu wanaishi pamoja na mmoja wao akafa bila kuacha mwana, kamwe mjane wake asiolewe nje ya jamaa hiyo. Ndugu wa mumewe atamchukua, amwoe na kutimiza wajibu wa shemeji kwake.

english: The first son she bears will carry on the name of the dead brother, so that his name will not be blotted out from Israel.
ekegusii: Omwana omoisia omotangi omokungu oria araibore, arokwe erieta ri’oyomwabo ise oria okwete. Erio nario erieta riaye ritabaise gosira korwa ase Abaisraeli.
swahili: Mwana wa kwanza atakayemzaa atapewa jina la ndugu aliyekufa ili jina lake lisifutike katika Israeli.

english: But if the man does not want to marry his brother’s widow, she is to go to the elders at the city gate and say, “My husband’s brother refuses to preserve his brother’s name in Israel. He is not willing to perform the duty of a brother-in-law for me.”
ekegusii: Korende onye omonto oria okwanga gotwara moka momura omwabo, rirorio omokungu oria agende ase abagaaka bare agwo ase egeita ki’omochie, akwane amang’ana aya: Omomura omwabo omosacha one bwangire goteneneria oyomwabo egesaku, erinde erieta riaye tirisira korwa ase Abaisraeli.
swahili: Hata hivyo, ikiwa ndugu huyo wa mume hataki kuoa huyo mke wa nduguye, mjane atawaendea wazee kwenye lango la mji na kusema, “Ndugu wa mume wangu anakataa kuendeleza jina la nduguye katika Israeli. Hataki kutimiza wajibu wa shemeji kwangu.”

english: Then the elders of his city shall summon him and speak with him. If he persists and says, “I do not want to marry her,”
ekegusii: “Erio abagaaka baria b’omochie barangerie omonto oria, bakwane nere, na karagenderere gokaana ng’a tatageti gotwara omokungu oria,
swahili: Ndipo wazee wa mji wake watamwita na kuzungumza naye. Kama atashikilia kukataa akisema, “Sitaki kumwoa,”

english: his brother’s widow shall go up to him in the presence of the elders, remove his sandal, spit in his face, and declare, “This is what is done to the man who will not maintain his brother’s line.”
ekegusii: erio omokungu oria omoboraka aike ang’e ase omomura oria omwabo omosacha oye, asomore egekooroto korwa ase okogoro kw’omonto oria agwo ase amasio y’abagaaka, naende amotwere amate ase obosio bwaye, akwane: Nabo arakorwe omonto onde bwensi okwanga goteneneria omomura omwabo egesaku.
swahili: mjane wa nduguye atamwendea mbele ya wazee, atamvua kiatu kimoja na kumtemea mate usoni, na kusema, “Hivi ndivyo ambavyo hufanywa kwa mtu ambaye atakataa kuendeleza jamaa ya ndugu yake.”

english: When you enter the land that the LORD your God is giving you as an inheritance, and you take possession of it and settle in it,
ekegusii: “Ekero moraabe mwaikire ase ense eri’Omonene Nyasae oino, agochia kobaa ebe omwando oino, na komenyao,
swahili: Mtakapokuwa mmeingia nchi ile ambayo Bwana Mungu wenu anawapa kama urithi na mtakapokuwa mmeimiliki na kukaa ndani yake,

english: And now, behold, I have brought the firstfruits of the land that You, O LORD, have given me.” Then you are to place the basket before the LORD your God and bow down before Him.
ekegusii: Bono rora, inche narentire ogotongora gwe chindagera chiamire ase riroba ri’ense eye Omonene atoeire. “Erio obeeke egetonga keria inse ase obosio bw’Omonene, Nyasae oo, na osasiime agwo ase obosio bwaye.
swahili: nami sasa ninaleta malimbuko ya ardhi ambayo wewe, Ee Bwana, umenipa.” Weka kapu mbele za Bwana Mungu wako na usujudu mbele zake.

english: So you shall rejoice—you, the Levite, and the foreigner dwelling among you—in all the good things the LORD your God has given to you and your household.
ekegusii: Ogookere ebinto bionsi ebi’Omonene, Nyasae oo, akoeire, aye amo n’eamate yao; boigo Abalawi, na abamenyi bamenyete ase egati yaino bagooke amo naye.
swahili: Kisha wewe pamoja na Walawi na wageni wote walioko miongoni mwenu mtafurahi katika vitu vyote vizuri ambavyo Bwana Mungu wenu amewapa pamoja na wa nyumbani mwenu.

english: When you have finished laying aside a tenth of all your produce in the third year, the year of the tithe, you are to give it to the Levite, the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow, that they may eat and be filled within your gates.
ekegusii: “Ase omwaka o gatato orue ensemo ya ikomi y’okwama kwao gwe chindagera ase Abalawi, n’abamenyi, ne’chintakana, n’ababoraka, erinde barabwo banyore chindagera chibaisaine barariere agwo ase emechie yaino.
swahili: Wakati utakapokuwa umeshatoa zaka zote za mazao yako katika mwaka wa tatu, ambao ni mwaka wa zaka, utampa Mlawi, mgeni, yatima na mjane, ili waweze kula katika miji yenu na kushiba.

english: Then you shall declare in the presence of the LORD your God, “I have removed from my house the sacred portion and have given it to the Levite, the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow, according to all the commandments You have given me. I have not transgressed or forgotten Your commandments.
ekegusii: Erio okwane amang’ana aya ase obosio bw’Omonene, Nyasae oo, omoteebie: Inche nabirusirie korwa ase enyomba yane ebinto biatananetwe bibe ebichenu, nabieire Abalawi, n’abamenyi, ne’chintakana, n’ababoraka. Nakorire buna gwanchiigete. Tinsareti gose tinyebeti ogochika konde kwao.
swahili: Kisha umwambie Bwana Mungu wako: “Nimeondoa katika nyumba yangu ile sehemu iliyowekwa wakfu na nimempa Mlawi, mgeni, yatima na mjane, kulingana na yote uliyoamuru. Sijazihalifu amri zako wala kusahau hata mojawapo.

english: I have not eaten any of the sacred portion while in mourning, or removed any of it while unclean, or offered any of it for the dead. I have obeyed the LORD my God; I have done everything You commanded me.
ekegusii: Tinariete ensemo eria ya ikomi ase omoichano, gose tinarusetie korwa ase ensemo eria ekero nareenge ’ntachenegeti gose tinaruete ensemo ende yonsi ya ikomi ase engencho y’abakuure. Nabeire ’ngokoigwera aye Omonene Nyasae one; nakorire amang’ana aria onsi gwanchiigete.
swahili: Sijala sehemu iliyowekwa wakfu wakati nilipokuwa nikiomboleza, wala sijaondoa mojawapo wakati nilipokuwa najisi, wala sijatoa sehemu yake yoyote kwa wafu. Nimemtii Bwana Mungu wangu; nimefanya kila kitu ulichoniamuru.

english: Look down from Your holy habitation, from heaven, and bless Your people Israel and the land You have given us as You swore to our fathers—a land flowing with milk and honey.” Obey the LORD’s Commands
ekegusii: Korwa agwo igoro, ase Obomenyo bwao Obochenu bore, origererie, erinde otorore inse aa; osesenie abanto bao Abaisraeli, osesenie na ense eye gwatoeire buna kwarierete chisokoro chiaito eira, ense entenenku ere n’amabeere na amooke. Abanto ba Omonene omonyene
swahili: Angalia chini kutoka mbinguni, maskani yako matakatifu, uwabariki watu wako Israeli pamoja na nchi uliyotupa kama ulivyoahidi kwa kiapo kwa baba zetu, nchi inayotiririka maziwa na asali.” Fuata Maagizo Ya Bwana

english: The LORD your God commands you this day to follow these statutes and ordinances. You must be careful to follow them with all your heart and with all your soul.
ekegusii: “Rituko ria rero Omonene, Nyasae oo, ogochiikire oigwere na kobwata amachiiko aya n’emeroberio echiikire. Ase ayio oyarende mono na koyakora n’enkoro yao yonsi, na omoyo oo bwonsi.
swahili: Bwana Mungu wako anakuagiza leo kufuata amri hizi na sheria; zishike kwa bidii kwa moyo wako wote na kwa roho yako yote.

english: Today you have proclaimed that the LORD is your God and that you will walk in His ways, keep His statutes and commandments and ordinances, and listen to His voice.
ekegusii: Rituko ria reero kwaorokirie ng’a Omonene nere Nyasae oo, naende ng’a n’obwatie chinchera chiaye chionsi na kobwata emeroberio yaye echiikire, n’amachiiko aye, na aya onsi achiikire, naende ng’a nomoigwere.
swahili: Umetangaza leo kwamba Bwana ndiye Mungu wako na kwamba utafuata njia zake, kwamba utayashika maagizo yake, amri zake na sheria zake nawe utamtii.

english: And today the LORD has proclaimed that you are His people and treasured possession as He promised, that you are to keep all His commandments,
ekegusii: Omonene nere okwanire rituko ria reero ng’a, ere buna abarierete eira, inwe nabaanto baye b’ekeene, nere omonyene boigo obachiikire ng’a morende na kobwata amachiiko aye onsi.
swahili: Naye Bwana ametangaza leo kwamba ninyi ni taifa lake, hazina yake ya thamani kama alivyoahidi, ili kwamba mpate kuyashika maagizo yake yote.

english: that He will set you high in praise and name and honor above all the nations He has made, and that you will be a holy people to the LORD your God, as He has promised.
ekegusii: N’abakore mobe abanene igoro ase ebisaku bionsi biria atongete; n’abakore momanyekane ase ogotogigwa okuya na ogosikwa, nainwe ’namobe abanto bare abachenu ase Omonene Nyasae oino, buna ere ateebire.”
swahili: Ametangaza kwamba atawaweka juu kuliko mataifa mengine aliyoyafanya katika sifa, kuwa fahari na heshima, na kwamba mtakuwa taifa takatifu kwa Bwana Mungu wenu, kama alivyoahidi.

english: you are to take some of the firstfruits of all your produce from the soil of the land that the LORD your God is giving you and put them in a basket. Then go to the place the LORD your God will choose as a dwelling for His Name,
ekegusii: kera oyomo oino, arusie ogotongora gw’okwama kw’endagera aragese korwa ase omogondo bw’ense eria. Erio ayebeeke ase egetonga ime, ayeire goika aase ari’Omonene Nyasae oino, arachoore abe obomenyo bw’erieta riaye.
swahili: chukueni baadhi ya mavuno ya kwanza ya yale yote mtakayozalisha kutoka udongo wa nchi ambayo Bwana Mungu wenu anawapa na mweke kwenye kapu. Kisha uende mahali ambapo Bwana Mungu wako atapachagua kuwa makao kwa ajili ya Jina lake

english: to the priest who is serving at that time, and say to him, “I declare today to the LORD your God that I have entered the land that the LORD swore to our fathers to give us.”
ekegusii: Agende ase Omokuani oyo otenenerete ase engaki eyio, amoteebie: Ase rituko ria reero naorokirie ase Omonene Nyasae oito, ng’a naikire ase ense eye Omonene arierete chisokoro chiaito eira ng’a natoyee.
swahili: na umwambie kuhani atakayekuwepo kwa wakati huo, “Ninatangaza leo kwa Bwana Mungu wako kwamba nimekuja katika nchi ambayo Bwana aliwaapia baba zetu kwamba atatupa.”

english: Then the priest shall take the basket from your hands and place it before the altar of the LORD your God,
ekegusii: “Erio Omokuani arusie egetonga keria korwa ase okoboko kwao akebeeke bosio bw’egesasiimero kia Omonene Nyasae oino.
swahili: Kuhani atapokea lile kapu mikononi mwako na kuliweka chini mbele ya madhabahu ya Bwana Mungu wako.

english: and you are to declare before the LORD your God, “My father was a wandering Aramean, and he went down to Egypt few in number and lived there and became a great nation, mighty and numerous.
ekegusii: Oiranerie amang’ana aya okwane ase obosio bw’Omonene, Nyasae oo: Sokorooria yane nigo arenge Omoaramu, orenge okona‐koong’anyang’anya. Agatirimboka gochia Misiri, akaba omomenyi aroro amo n’abanto baye. Ekero ageendete ase ense eria nigo abwate abanto abake, na aroro agwo bakabucha, bakaba egesaku ekenene, kiarenge n’echinguru, naende kiarenge n’abanto abange.
swahili: Kisha utatangaza mbele za Bwana Mungu wako: “Baba yangu alikuwa Mwaramu aliyekuwa anatangatanga, akaenda Misri pamoja na watu wachache, akaishi huko hadi akawa taifa kubwa, lenye nguvu na watu wengi.

english: But the Egyptians mistreated us and afflicted us, putting us to hard labor.
ekegusii: Abamisiri bagatokorera bobe, bakaba bagotochaanda na gotokoria emeremo emekong’u.
swahili: Lakini Wamisri walituonea na kututaabisha, wakitufanyisha kazi ngumu.

english: So we called out to the LORD, the God of our fathers; and the LORD heard our voice and saw our affliction, toil, and oppression.
ekegusii: Erio tokarera ase Omonene, Nyasae bw’echisokoro chiaito, atokoonye, nere agatoigwa, akarora emechando yaito, na emeremo emekong’u twarenge gokora, na ogokorerwa bobe gwaito.
swahili: Kisha tulimlilia Bwana, Mungu wa baba zetu, naye Bwana akasikia sauti yetu na akaona huzuni yetu, taabu yetu na mateso yetu.

english: Then the LORD brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand and an outstretched arm, with great terror, signs, and wonders.
ekegusii: Omonene agatorusia ase ense ya Misiri n’okoboko kwaye kore n’echinguru koramboire, na ase okoondokia okonene na ebikone na amakumia.
swahili: Kwa hiyo Bwana akatutoa nchi ya Misri kwa mkono wenye nguvu na ulionyooshwa, pamoja na utisho mkuu, ishara za miujiza na maajabu.

english: And He brought us to this place and gave us this land, a land flowing with milk and honey.
ekegusii: Agatorenta aiga na gotoyea ense eye entenenku ere n’amabeere na amooke.
swahili: Akatuleta mahali hapa akatupa nchi hii, nchi inayotiririka maziwa na asali;

english: Then Moses and the elders of Israel commanded the people: “Keep all the commandments I am giving you today.
ekegusii: Ekero Musa arenge n’abagaaka b’Abaisraeli, agachiika abanto erio akabateebia, “Mobwate amachiiko aya onsi nabachiikire ase rituko ria reero.
swahili: Mose na wazee wa Israeli wakawaagiza watu: “Yashikeni maagizo haya yote ninayowaagiza leo.

english: You shall therefore obey the voice of the LORD your God and follow His commandments and statutes I am giving you today.” Curses Pronounced from Ebal
ekegusii: Ase ayio moigwere Omonene Nyasae oino, n’emeroberio yaye echiikire, na mobwate amachiiko aye, ayio inche ’nkobaa rituko ria reero.” Okoragererigwa kw’abatakoigwera
swahili: Mtii Bwana Mungu wako, na kufuata amri zake na maagizo ninayokupa leo.”

english: On that day Moses commanded the people:
ekegusii: Musa agachiika abanto ase rituko erio erio, agakwana,
swahili: Siku ile ile Mose akawaagiza watu:

english: “When you have crossed the Jordan, these tribes shall stand on Mount Gerizim to bless the people: Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Joseph, and Benjamin.
ekegusii: “Ekero moraabe mwambokire gochia ng’umbu ya Yorodani, Abasimeoni, na Abalawi, na Abayuda, na Abaisakaru, na Abayusufu, na Ababenjamini, batenene igoro ase egetunwa kia Gerisimu, basesenie abanto.
swahili: Mtakapovuka Mto Yordani, makabila haya yatasimama juu ya Mlima Gerizimu kubariki watu: Simeoni, Lawi, Yuda, Isakari, Yosefu na Benyamini.

english: And these tribes shall stand on Mount Ebal to deliver the curse: Reuben, Gad, Asher, Zebulun, Dan, and Naphtali.
ekegusii: Na Abareubeni n’Abagadi, n’Abaaseri, n’Abasabuloni, n’Abadani, n’Abanafutali batenene igoro ase egetunwa kia Ebali baragererie abanto.
swahili: Makabila haya yatasimama juu ya Mlima Ebali kwa kutamka laana: Reubeni, Gadi, Asheri, Zabuloni, Dani na Naftali.

english: Then the Levites shall proclaim in a loud voice to every Israelite:
ekegusii: Na Abalawi bakwane amang’ana aya n’eriogi rinene, erinde Abaisraeli bonsi bayaigwe.
swahili: Nao Walawi watawasomea watu wote wa Israeli kwa sauti kubwa:

english: ‘Cursed is the man who makes a carved idol or molten image—an abomination to the LORD, the work of the hands of a craftsman—and sets it up in secret.’ And let all the people say, ‘Amen!’
ekegusii: “Aragererigwe omonto oyoraroisie omogwekano bw’ogosasiimwa, koyotenenia na koyosasiima bobisi, koraabe omogwekano obaachire, gose oyo bw’ebioma binyititoire na kobombwa, eyere emeremo y’omooroisia omong’aini. Okwo n’okogeechia ase Omonene. “Abanto bonsi bairanerie, bateebe: Amina.
swahili: “Alaaniwe mtu afanyaye sanamu ya kuchonga au mwenye kusubu sanamu, kitu ambacho ni chukizo kwa Bwana, kazi ya mikono ya fundi stadi, na kuisimamisha kwa siri.” Kisha watu wote watasema, “Amen!”

english: ‘Cursed is he who dishonors his father or mother.’ And let all the people say, ‘Amen!’
ekegusii: “Aragererigwe omonto ogochaaya ise gose ng’ina. “Abanto bonsi bairanerie, bateebe: Amina.
swahili: “Alaaniwe mtu amdharauye baba yake na mama yake.” Kisha watu wote watasema, “Amen!”

english: ‘Cursed is he who moves his neighbor’s boundary stone.’ And let all the people say, ‘Amen!’
ekegusii: “Aragererigwe omonto ogotumana orobebe rw’omogisangio oye. “Abanto bonsi bairanerie, bateebe: Amina.
swahili: “Alaaniwe mtu asogezaye jiwe la mpaka wa jirani yake.” Kisha watu wote watasema, “Amen!”

english: ‘Cursed is he who lets a blind man wander in the road.’ And let all the people say, ‘Amen!’
ekegusii: “Aragererigwe omonto ogotantania omonto omouko na komosiria enchera. “Abanto bonsi bairanerie, bateebe: Amina.
swahili: “Alaaniwe mtu ampotoshaye kipofu njiani.” Kisha watu wote watasema, “Amen!”

english: ‘Cursed is he who withholds justice from the foreigner, the fatherless, or the widow.’ And let all the people say, ‘Amen!’
ekegusii: “Aragererigwe omonto okorina omomenyi, gose entakaana, gose omotakaanwa, oboronge bwaye. “Abanto bonsi bairanerie, bateebe: Amina.
swahili: “Alaaniwe mtu apotoshaye haki ya mgeni, yatima au mjane.” Kisha watu wote watasema, “Amen!”

english: And on the day you cross the Jordan into the land that the LORD your God is giving you, set up large stones and coat them with plaster.
ekegusii: Ase rituko riria moramboke gochia ng’umbu ya Yorodani, na ekero moraike ase ense eri’Omonene Nyasae oino, agochia kobaa, motenenie amagena amanene, moyaoomeranie.
swahili: Mtakapokuwa mmevuka Mto Yordani na kuingia katika nchi awapayo Bwana Mungu wenu, msimamishe mawe makubwa na mkayatie lipu.

english: ‘Cursed is he who sleeps with his father’s wife, for he has violated his father’s marriage bed.’ And let all the people say, ‘Amen!’
ekegusii: “Aragererigwe omonto oraraare na moga ise, ekiagera ayio nokorentera ise obosooku. “Abanto bonsi bairanerie, bateebe: Amina.
swahili: “Alaaniwe mtu akutanaye kimwili na mke wa baba yake, kwa maana anadharau malazi ya baba yake.” Kisha watu wote watasema, “Amen!”

english: ‘Cursed is he who lies with any animal.’ And let all the people say, ‘Amen!’
ekegusii: “Aragererigwe omonto oraraare n’eng’iti ende yonsi. “Abanto bonsi bairanerie, bateebe: Amina.
swahili: “Alaaniwe mtu akutanaye kimwili na mnyama yeyote.” Kisha watu wote watasema, “Amen!”

english: ‘Cursed is he who sleeps with his sister, the daughter of his father or the daughter of his mother.’ And let all the people say, ‘Amen!’
ekegusii: “Aragererigwe omonto oraraare n’omoiseke omwabo, omoiseke o ise, gose oyo o ng’ina. “Abanto bonsi bairanerie, bateebe: Amina.
swahili: “Alaaniwe mtu akutanaye kimwili na dada yake, binti wa baba yake au binti wa mama yake.” Kisha watu wote watasema, “Amen!”

english: ‘Cursed is he who sleeps with his mother-in-law.’ And let all the people say, ‘Amen!’
ekegusii: “Aragererigwe omonto oraraare na ng’ina biara. “Abanto bonsi bairanerie, bateebe: Amina.
swahili: “Alaaniwe mtu akutanaye kimwili na mama mkwe wake.” Kisha watu wote watasema, “Amen!”

english: ‘Cursed is he who strikes down his neighbor in secret.’ And let all the people say, ‘Amen!’
ekegusii: “Aragererigwe omonto oraite omonto onde bobisi. “Abanto bonsi bairanerie, bateebe: Amina.
swahili: “Alaaniwe mtu amuuaye jirani yake kwa siri.” Kisha watu wote watasema, “Amen!”

english: ‘Cursed is he who accepts a bribe to kill an innocent person.’ And let all the people say, ‘Amen!’
ekegusii: “Aragererigwe omonto oraegwe riaaki, erinde agende goita omonto otari na komocha. “Abanto bonsi bairanerie, bateebe: Amina.
swahili: “Alaaniwe mtu apokeaye rushwa ili kumuua mtu asiye na hatia.” Kisha watu wote watasema, “Amen!”

english: ‘Cursed is he who does not put the words of this law into practice.’ And let all the people say, ‘Amen!’
ekegusii: “Aragererigwe omonto otari kobwata amang’ana onsi ay’ogochika oko, na koyakora. “Abanto bonsi bairanerie, bateebe: Amina.
swahili: “Alaaniwe mtu yule ambaye hatashikilia maneno ya sheria hii kwa kuyatekeleza.” Kisha watu wote watasema, “Amen!”

english: Write on them all the words of this law when you have crossed over to enter the land that the LORD your God is giving you, a land flowing with milk and honey, just as the LORD, the God of your fathers, has promised you.
ekegusii: Erio moriike ase amagena ayio amang’ana onsi y’ogochika oko. Ekero moraabe mwambokire gochia ng’umbu na gosoa ense eri’Omonene Nyasae oino, agochia kobaa, ense eria entenenku ere n’amabeere na amooke, buna Omonene, Nyasae bw’echisokoro chiaino, abarierete eira ng’a n’abayee,
swahili: Andikeni juu yake maneno yote ya sheria hii wakati mtakapokuwa mmevuka na kuingia katika nchi awapayo Bwana Mungu wenu, nchi itiririkayo maziwa na asali, kama vile Bwana, Mungu wa baba zenu, alivyowaahidi.

english: And when you have crossed the Jordan, you are to set up these stones on Mount Ebal, as I am commanding you today, and you are to coat them with plaster.
ekegusii: na komwambokire ng’umbu, buna nabachiikire rituko ria reero, motenenie amagena aria ase egetunwa kia Ebali, erio moyaoomeranie amo n’ekebuuse giechooka.
swahili: Mtakapokuwa mmevuka Yordani, simamisheni mawe haya juu ya Mlima Ebali, kama ninavyowaagiza leo, mkayatie lipu.

english: Moreover, you are to build there an altar to the LORD your God, an altar of stones. You must not use any iron tool on them.
ekegusii: Aroro agwo moaagachere Omonene Nyasae oino, egesasiimero ki’amagena. Timobaisa gokorera emeremo na gekorero kende gionsi gi’ekioma.
swahili: Huko mjengeeni Bwana Mungu wenu madhabahu, madhabahu ya mawe. Msitumie kifaa chochote cha chuma juu yake.

english: You shall build the altar of the LORD your God with uncut stones and offer upon it burnt offerings to the LORD your God.
ekegusii: Egesasiimero keria ki’Omonene Nyasae oino, mokeagachere amagena atabaachiri; na igoro yaye momoruere ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa,
swahili: Jengeni madhabahu ya Bwana Mungu wenu kwa mawe ya shambani, na mtoe sadaka za kuteketezwa juu yake kwa Bwana Mungu wenu.

english: There you are to sacrifice your peace offerings, eating them and rejoicing in the presence of the LORD your God.
ekegusii: morue na ebing’wanso bi’omorembe, mobiriereo na mogooke ase obosio bw’Omonene Nyasae oino.
swahili: Toeni sadaka za amani juu yake, mkizila na kufurahia mbele za Bwana Mungu wenu.

english: And you shall write distinctly upon these stones all the words of this law.”
ekegusii: Ase amagena ayio moriike amang’ana onsi y’ogochika oko, arorekane buya kegima.”
swahili: Nanyi mtaandika maneno yote ya sheria hii kwa wazi sana juu ya mawe haya ambayo mmesimamisha.” Laana Kutoka Mlima Ebali

english: Then Moses and the Levitical priests spoke to all Israel: “Be silent, O Israel, and listen! This day you have become the people of the LORD your God.
ekegusii: Musa na abakuani Abalawi bagakwana n’Abaisraeli bonsi, bakabateebia, “Inwe Abaisraeli, tegerera, moigwe! Rituko ria reero inwe mwabeire abanto b’Omonene Nyasae oino.
swahili: Kisha Mose na makuhani, ambao ni Walawi, wakawaambia Israeli wote, “Nyamaza ee Israeli, sikiliza! Sasa umekuwa taifa la Bwana Mungu wako.

english: “Now if you faithfully obey the voice of the LORD your God and are careful to follow all His commandments I am giving you today, the LORD your God will set you high above all the nations of the earth.
ekegusii: “Komoramoigwere Omonene Nyasae oino, erinde morende na kobwata amachiiko aye onsi inche nabachiikire ase rituko ria reero, Omonene Nyasae oino, nabakore mobe abanene kobua ebisaku bionsi bire ase ense.
swahili: Kama ukimtii Bwana Mungu wako kwa bidii na kufuata amri zake zote ninazokupa leo kwa bidii, Bwana Mungu wako atakuweka juu ya mataifa yote katika dunia.

english: Then all the peoples of the earth will see that you are called by the name of the LORD, and they will stand in awe of you.
ekegusii: Abanto bonsi b’ense ’mbaabarore mogwatorwa ase erieta riaye, erio baabairoke.
swahili: Kisha mataifa yote ya dunia wataona kuwa unaitwa kwa jina la Bwana, nao watakuogopa.

english: The LORD will make you prosper abundantly—in the fruit of your womb, the offspring of your livestock, and the produce of your land—in the land that the LORD swore to your fathers to give you.
ekegusii: Omonene nabae obotenenku, nabuchie oroiboro rwe chinda chiaino, nabuchie ne’chitugo chiaino, naende nabae okwama okonge kwe riroba agwo ase ense eria arierete chisokoro chiaino eira ng’a n’abayee inwe.
swahili: Bwana atakupa kustawi kwa wingi, katika tunda la uzao wa tumbo lako, katika wanyama wachanga wa mifugo yako na katika mazao ya ardhi yako, katika nchi aliyowaapia baba zako kuwapa.

english: The LORD will open the heavens, His abundant storehouse, to send rain on your land in season and to bless all the work of your hands. You will lend to many nations, but borrow from none.
ekegusii: Nabakunorere emonga yaye engiya ere igoro, na abatwerie embura ase ense yaino ase chingaki chiganeirie. Nasesenie emeremo yaino yonsi mogokora, erinde monyaare koa abanto b’ebisaku ebinge ebinto singo. Korende inwe timokoremerwa, erinde mochie gosaba singo.
swahili: Bwana atafungua mbingu, ghala zake za baraka, kukupa mvua kwa majira yake na kubariki kazi zako zote za mikono yako. Utakopesha mataifa mengi lakini hutakopa kwa yeyote.

english: The LORD will make you the head and not the tail; you will only move upward and never downward, if you hear and carefully follow the commandments of the LORD your God, which I am giving you today.
ekegusii: Komoraigwere amachiiko y’Omonene Nyasae oino, ayio ’nkobaa rituko ria reero, na mobe abeegenwa ase okoyakora, nabakore mobe ab’omotwe, gose tari ab’ekemincha. Nabakore mogenderere gokiina, gose timokogenderera gokeeigwa gochia inse.
swahili: Bwana atakufanya kichwa, wala si mkia. Kama utazingatia maagizo ya Bwana Mungu wako ninayokupa siku hii ya leo na kuyafuata kwa bidii, daima utakuwa juu, kamwe hutakuwa chini.

english: Do not turn aside to the right or to the left from any of the words I command you today, and do not go after other gods to serve them. The Curses of Disobedience (Leviticus 20:1–9; Leviticus 26:14–39)
ekegusii: Ayio nigo arakoreke onye timokoonchoka aande, gochia ensemo y’okorio gose ey’okobee, timotiga nonya ne’ring’ana erimo ri’ayio nabaeire ase rituko ria reero, erinde mogeende gosasiima chinyasae ching’ao na gochikorera. Ekerabanyore abatari koigwera (Abal 26:14-46)
swahili: Usihalifu amri zangu zozote ninazokupa leo, kwa kwenda kuume au kushoto, kwa kufuata miungu mingine na kuitumikia. Laana Kwa Kutokutii (Walawi 26:14-46)

english: If, however, you do not obey the LORD your God by carefully following all His commandments and statutes I am giving you today, all these curses will come upon you and overtake you:
ekegusii: “Korende onye timokoigwera Omonene Nyasae oino, gose onye timokoba abegenwa na gokorera amachiiko aye onsi, na emeroberio yaye echiikire, ayio inche nabaeire ase rituko ria reero, rirorio okoragererigwa oko gwonsi ’nagoche ase more na kobanyore.
swahili: Hata hivyo, kama hutamtii Bwana Mungu wako na kuzishika kwa bidii amri zake zote na maagizo ninayokupa leo, laana hizi zote zitakuja juu yako na kukupata:

english: You will be cursed in the city and cursed in the country.
ekegusii: “Imoragererigwe ase emechie yaino, na ase emegondo yaino.
swahili: Utalaaniwa mjini na utalaaniwa mashambani.

english: Your basket and kneading bowl will be cursed.
ekegusii: “Neragererigwe endagera y’ebitonga biaino amo n’ebituba biaino mogoseera obosie.
swahili: Kapu lako na chombo chako cha kukandia kitalaaniwa.

english: The fruit of your womb will be cursed, as well as the produce of your land, the calves of your herds, and the lambs of your flocks.
ekegusii: “Ndoragererigwe oroiboro rwe chinda chiaino amo n’okwama kwaino kwe riroba, na okobiara gwe’chiombe chiaino, na ogwe’ching’ondi ne’chimbori chiaino.
swahili: Uzao wa tumbo lako utalaaniwa, mazao ya ardhi yako, ndama wa makundi yako ya ngʼombe na wana-kondoo wa makundi yako.

english: You will be cursed when you come in and cursed when you go out.
ekegusii: “Imoragererigwe ekero mogosoa inka, na ekero mokogeenda isiko.
swahili: Utalaaniwa uingiapo na utokapo.

english: And all these blessings will come upon you and overtake you, if you will obey the voice of the LORD your God:
ekegusii: Komoraigwere eriogi ri’Omonene Nyasae oino, rirorio nabae ogosesenigwa oko gwonsi kobe okwaino.
swahili: Baraka hizi zote zitakuja juu yako na kukupata, kama ukimtii Bwana Mungu wako:

english: The LORD will send curses upon you, confusion and reproof in all to which you put your hand, until you are destroyed and quickly perish because of the wickedness you have committed in forsaking Him.
ekegusii: “Omonene nabarentere okoragererigwa, na obotantanu, na emechando ase emeremo yaino yonsi mogokora, goika mosirigwe na koera bwango ase engencho y’ogokora kwaino okobe, na ekiagera mwantigire inche.
swahili: Bwana ataleta laana juu yako, fadhaa na kukaripiwa katika kila kitu unachokigusa kwa mkono wako, mpaka uwe umeharibiwa na kuangamizwa ghafula kwa ajili ya maovu uliyoyafanya kwa kumwacha yeye.

english: The LORD will make the plague cling to you until He has exterminated you from the land that you are entering to possess.
ekegusii: Nabarentere amarwaire agoita akobabwatia, na inwe mosire korwa ase ense eria mogochia gosoa na koyeira ebe eyaino.
swahili: Bwana atakupiga kwa magonjwa mpaka akuangamize kutoka nchi unayoingia kuimiliki.

english: The LORD will strike you with wasting disease, with fever and inflammation, with scorching heat and drought, and with blight and mildew; these will pursue you until you perish.
ekegusii: Nabaake n’oborwaire borakoore obogima, na obw’esosera, na obw’okobimbia omobere; narente riberera ri’egurugura entindi, na oborwaire bw’enyagetabo ase chindagera, na obw’okorigisia chindagera chiaino. Amaakwa ayio ’nababwatie goika abasirie kegima.
swahili: Bwana atakupiga kwa magonjwa ya kudhoofisha, kwa homa na kuwashwa, hari na kwa ukame, kutu na kuwa na uchungu ambavyo vitakupiga mpaka uangamie.

english: The sky over your head will be bronze, and the earth beneath you iron.
ekegusii: Igoro nekong’e pa, ebe buna etai, embura tetwa, riroba ri’ense riome rikong’e pa, ribe buna ekioma.
swahili: Anga juu yako itakuwa shaba, na ardhi chini yako itakuwa chuma.

english: The LORD will turn the rain of your land into dust and powder; it will descend on you from the sky until you are destroyed.
ekegusii: Ribaga ri’embura egotwa ase riroba riaino, Omonene narente ebuse na omokenye bibatwere korwa igoro na kobasiria kegima.
swahili: Bwana atafanya mvua ya nchi yako kuwa mavumbi na mchanga; vitakujia kutoka angani mpaka uangamie.

english: The LORD will cause you to be defeated before your enemies. You will march out against them in one direction but flee from them in seven. You will be an object of horror to all the kingdoms of the earth.
ekegusii: “Omonene nae ababisa baino ribaga bababue. Namoetere enchera eyemo ekero mokogeenda kobarwania, korende motame korwa ase bare, moetere chinchera isan’aibere. Amagaambi onsi are ase ense nakumie na kwoboa ase amang’ana arabanyoore inwe.
swahili: Bwana atakufanya ushindwe mbele ya adui zako. Utawajia kwa njia moja lakini utawakimbia mbele yao kwa njia saba, nawe utakuwa kitu cha kuchukiza kwa falme zote za dunia.

english: Your corpses will be food for all the birds of the air and beasts of the earth, with no one to scare them away.
ekegusii: Ebitondo biaino ’mbibe endagera ye chinyoni chia igoro, na eye ching’iti chi’orosana, na onde tari orachiseerie achioboyie.
swahili: Mizoga yenu itakuwa chakula cha ndege wa angani na wanyama wa nchi, wala hapatakuwepo mtu yeyote wa kuwafukuza.

english: The LORD will afflict you with the boils of Egypt, with tumors and scabs and itch from which you cannot be cured.
ekegusii: Omonene nabarentere inwe amagumba buna aria arenterete Abamisiri, nabarentere n’amasisa, na okweagia, amarwaire ayio atanyaare kogwenigwa.
swahili: Bwana atakupiga kwa majipu ya Misri na kwa vidonda vitokavyo usaha na kuwashwa, ambako huwezi kuponywa.

english: The LORD will afflict you with madness, blindness, and confusion of mind,
ekegusii: Nabakore mobe chibarimo, na emeuko, na omwochogano bw’ebirengererio.
swahili: Bwana atakupiga kwa wazimu, upofu na kuchanganyikiwa kwa akili.

english: and at noon you will grope about like a blind man in the darkness. You will not prosper in your ways. Day after day you will be oppressed and plundered, with no one to save you.
ekegusii: Ekero kia mobaso inamotaba‐tabe buna emeuko egotabataba ase omosunte, timokonyaara korora enchera. Timogosesenigwa ase emeremo ende yonsi moraabe mogokora. ’Namobe mogochaandwa na kourwa ebinto biaino botambe, na onde tari orabakoonye.
swahili: Wakati wa adhuhuri utapapasapapasa huku na huko kama mtu kipofu katika giza. Hutafanikiwa katika lolote ufanyalo; siku baada ya siku utaonewa na kunyangʼanywa, wala hakuna yeyote atakayekuokoa.

english: You will be blessed in the city and blessed in the country.
ekegusii: “Imosesenigwe ase emechie yaino na ase emegondo yaino.
swahili: Utabarikiwa mjini na utabarikiwa mashambani.

english: You will be pledged in marriage to a woman, but another man will violate her. You will build a house but will not live in it. You will plant a vineyard but will not enjoy its fruit.
ekegusii: “Nebe kwariereire omoiseke boko, na omonto omoao amoire araare nere: noagache enyomba, korende tokoyemenya. Nosimeke emesabibu ase omogondo oo, korende tokoria amasabibu korwao.
swahili: Utaposa mke, lakini mtu mwingine atakutana naye kimwili. Utajenga nyumba, lakini hutaishi ndani yake. Utapanda shamba la mizabibu, lakini hutakula matunda yake.

english: Your ox will be slaughtered before your eyes, but you will not eat any of it. Your donkey will be taken away and not returned to you. Your flock will be given to your enemies, and no one will save you.
ekegusii: Chiombe chiaino ’nachinyenyerwe ase amaiso aino, korende timokoria chinyama chiabo. ’Namourwe chitigere chiaino ne chinguru ekero morigereretie, na tichikoiranigwa ase more naende. Ababisa baino mbaegwe ching’ondi chiaino, na onde tari orabakonye inwe.
swahili: Ngʼombe wako atachinjwa mbele ya macho yako lakini hutakula nyama yake. Punda wako atachukuliwa kwa nguvu kutoka kwako wala hatarudishwa. Kondoo wako watapewa adui zako, wala hakuna mtu yeyote wa kuwaokoa.

english: Your sons and daughters will be given to another nation, while your eyes grow weary looking for them day after day, with no power in your hand.
ekegusii: Abana baino, abamura na abaiseke, inabairwe n’abanto b’egesaku ekeao ekero morigereretie, erio mobe mochaandegete. Rituko ase rituko ’mobe n’amaiga ase abana baino, korende timokonyaara gotanga tibairwa.
swahili: Wanao na binti zako watatolewa kwa mataifa mengine, nawe utayachosha macho yako ukiwatazamia siku baada ya siku, hutakuwa na nguvu kuinua mkono.

english: A people you do not know will eat the produce of your land and of all your toil. All your days you will be oppressed and crushed.
ekegusii: Abanto b’egesaku motamanyeti nabarie okwama kwe riroba riaino, na baire ebinto mwabeire mogochaandekera; barabwo mbaabakorere bobe, babachaande botambe.
swahili: Taifa usilolijua watakula mazao ya nchi yako na taabu ya kazi yako, hutakuwa na chochote, bali kuonewa kikatili siku zako zote.

english: You will be driven mad by the sights you see.
ekegusii: Komorarore aya onsi, nigo morasareke ase ebirengererio biaino, mobe buna chiosi.
swahili: Vitu utakavyoviona kwa macho yako vitakufanya wazimu.

english: The LORD will afflict you with painful, incurable boils on your knees and thighs, from the soles of your feet to the top of your head.
ekegusii: Omonene nabaake moriegwe namagumba amabe ase amaru aino na ase amagoro aino, ee amagumba ayio natuboke korwa chimbaratero chiaino goika emetwe yaino igoro, nainwe timokogwena.
swahili: Bwana atayapiga magoti yako na miguu yako kwa majipu yenye maumivu makali yasiyoponyeka, yakienea kutoka nyayo za miguu yako hadi utosini.

english: The LORD will bring you and the king you appoint to a nation neither you nor your fathers have known, and there you will worship other gods—gods of wood and stone.
ekegusii: “Omonene ’nabaire inwe amo n’omorwoti oyio oino morechoorere, ababeeke inse y’egesaku kende ekeao, eke inwe, gose chisokoro chiaino motamanyete. Aroro agwo inamokorere chinyasae ching’ao chiroisirie korwa ase emete na amagena.
swahili: Bwana atakupeleka wewe na mfalme uliyemweka juu yako uende kwenye taifa ambalo hukulijua wewe wala baba zako. Huko utaabudu miungu mingine, miungu ya miti na mawe.

english: You will become an object of horror, scorn, and ridicule among all the nations to which the LORD will drive you.
ekegusii: Ase egati y’ abanto b’ense eyio ase Omonene arabasiarere gochia, inwe ’mobe ab’ogoichanerwa, mobe omorabaaro ogokwanwa ase obobe n’abanto abwo.
swahili: Utakuwa kitu cha kuchukiza, tena kitu cha kudharauliwa na kudhihakiwa kwa mataifa yote huko Bwana atakakokupeleka.

english: You will sow much seed in the field but harvest little, because the locusts will consume it.
ekegusii: “’Namosimeke chimbusuro chinyinge ase emegondo, korende mogese endagera ensinini, ekiagera chingige ’nachirie chindagera chiaino.
