swahili: Utapanda mbegu nyingi katika shamba lakini utavuna haba, kwa sababu nzige watazila.

english: You will plant and cultivate vineyards, but will neither drink the wine nor gather the grapes, because worms will eat them.
ekegusii: Inamosimeke emesabibu ase emegondo na gokora emeremo aroro, korende timokonywa edivai, gose koria amasabibu korwao, ekiagera amakonde nigo arasoe arie yonsi.
swahili: Utapanda mashamba ya mizabibu na kuyapalilia, lakini hutakunywa divai yake wala hutakusanya zabibu, kwa sababu wadudu watazila.

english: The fruit of your womb will be blessed, as well as the produce of your land and the offspring of your livestock— the calves of your herds and the lambs of your flocks.
ekegusii: “’Ndosesenigwe oroiboro rwe chinda chiaino, amo n’okwama kwaino kwe riroba, na okobiara gwe chitugo chiaino chi’echiombe, ne’ching’ondi, ne’chimbori.
swahili: Utabarikiwa uzao wa tumbo lako, na mazao ya nchi yako na wanyama wako wachanga wa kufugwa, yaani ndama wa makundi yako ya ngʼombe, na wana-kondoo wa makundi yako.

english: You will have olive trees throughout your territory but will never anoint yourself with oil, because the olives will drop off.
ekegusii: Inamosimeke emezeituni ase orogongo rwaino rwonsi, korende timokweaka amaguta aye, ekiagera amazeituni nigo araaroroke atarama.
swahili: Utakuwa na mizeituni katika nchi yako yote, lakini hutatumia hayo mafuta yake, kwa sababu zeituni zitapukutika.

english: You will father sons and daughters, but they will not remain yours, because they will go into captivity.
ekegusii: Nigo moraibore abana, abamura na abaiseke, korende tibakoba abaino, mbooswe bairwe ase obosomba.
swahili: Utakuwa na wana na binti lakini hawatakuwa nawe, kwa sababu watachukuliwa mateka.

english: Swarms of locusts will consume all your trees and the produce of your land.
ekegusii: Chingige ’nchirie emete yaino morasimeke, na okwama kwaino kwe riroba.
swahili: Makundi ya nzige yatavamia miti yako yote na mazao ya nchi yako.

english: The foreigner living among you will rise higher and higher above you, while you sink down lower and lower.
ekegusii: “Abamenyi bare ase egati yaino ’mbabe abanene kobabua, korende inwe mogenderere gokea mobe inse ase bare.
swahili: Mgeni anayeishi miongoni mwako atainuka juu zaidi na zaidi kuliko wewe, lakini wewe utashuka chini zaidi na zaidi.

english: He will lend to you, but you will not lend to him. He will be the head, and you will be the tail.
ekegusii: Barabwo ’mbabe n’ebinto ebinge barabae inwe singo, korende inwe nigo moraaremerwe, timokoba n’ebinto morabae singo. Barabwo mbabe ab’omotwe, na inwe mobe ab’ekemincha.
swahili: Yeye atakukopesha, lakini wewe hutamkopesha. Yeye atakuwa kichwa, lakini wewe utakuwa mkia.

english: All these curses will come upon you. They will pursue you and overtake you until you are destroyed, since you did not obey the LORD your God and keep the commandments and statutes He gave you.
ekegusii: “Okoragererigwa okwo gwonsi ’nkobaachere na kobabwatia goika kobasirie kegima, ekiagera motaigwerete Omonene Nyasae oino, na koyabwata amachiiko aye ayio abaete, na emeroberio yaye echiikire.
swahili: Laana hizi zote zitakuja juu yako. Zitakufuatia na kukupata mpaka uangamizwe, kwa sababu hukumtii Bwana Mungu wako, na kuzishika amri zake na maagizo yake aliyokupa.

english: These curses will be a sign and a wonder upon you and your descendants forever.
ekegusii: Okwo nigo koraabe ekemanyererio na ogokumia igoro ase more, na ase chinderia chiaino kogenderera botambe.
swahili: Zitakuwa ishara na ajabu kwako na kwa wazao wako milele.

english: Because you did not serve the LORD your God with joy and gladness of heart in all your abundance,
ekegusii: Omonene Nyasae oino, nigo abasesenetie, akabaa ebinto ebinge, na ebinto ebio bikagera timwamokorera n’omogooko bwe chinkoro chiaino.
swahili: Kwa sababu hukumtumikia Bwana Mungu wako kwa furaha na kwa moyo wakati wa kufanikiwa kwako,

english: you will serve your enemies the LORD will send against you in famine, thirst, nakedness, and destitution. He will place an iron yoke on your neck until He has destroyed you.
ekegusii: Ase ayio ’namobakorere ababisa baino, abw’Omonene aratome goocha kobarwania; inamobe n’enchara, n’erang’o y’amaache, ’namobe gesobono, naende ’namoremerwe ebinto bionsi. Nabeeke rikorogoto ri’ekioma igoro ase ebigoti biaino goika abasirie kegima.
swahili: kwa hiyo katika njaa na kiu, katika uchi na umaskini wa kutisha, utawatumikia adui ambao Bwana atawatuma dhidi yako. Yeye ataweka nira ya chuma shingoni mwako hadi amekwisha kukuangamiza.

english: The LORD will bring a nation from afar, from the ends of the earth, to swoop down upon you like an eagle—a nation whose language you will not understand,
ekegusii: Omonene narente egesaku ekeao geeche kobarwania korwa aare, korwa ensinyo y’ense, ekere ekiango gekoiruruka buna ekeongo, ekio motamanyete omonwa obo.
swahili: Bwana ataleta taifa dhidi yako kutoka mbali, kutoka miisho ya dunia, kama tai ashukiavyo mawindo chini, taifa ambalo hutaijua lugha yake,

english: Your basket and kneading bowl will be blessed.
ekegusii: “Nesesenigwe endagera y’ebitonga biaino amo ney’ebituba biaino mogoseera obosie.
swahili: Kapu lako na vyombo vyako vya kukandia vitabarikiwa.

english: a ruthless nation with no respect for the old and no pity for the young.
ekegusii: Abanto b’egesaku eke babwate amasio yobotindi; babe batari koyiera omonto omogotu gose koyiera abasae amaabera.
swahili: taifa lenye uso mkali lisilojali wazee wala kuwahurumia vijana.

english: They will eat the offspring of your livestock and the produce of your land until you are destroyed. They will leave you no grain or new wine or oil, no calves of your herds or lambs of your flocks, until they have caused you to perish.
ekegusii: Barabwo mbarie chimoori chi’echiombe chiaino, na okwama kwe riroba riaino, goika mosirigwe kegima. Tibakobatigareria endagera yaino, gose edivai, gose amaguta, gose chimoori chi’echiombe chiaino, gose chimanwa chi’eching’ondi n’echie chimbori chiaino; ’nabagere mosire kegima.
swahili: Watakula wadogo wa mifugo yako na mazao ya nchi yako mpaka umeangamia. Hawatakuachia nafaka, divai mpya au mafuta, wala ndama wowote wa kundi lako au wana-kondoo wa kundi lako mpaka umekuwa magofu.

english: They will besiege all the cities throughout your land, until the high and fortified walls in which you trust have fallen. They will besiege all your cities throughout the land that the LORD your God has given you.
ekegusii: Barabwo nigo barabamige mono ase emechie yaino yonsi, babarwanie goika chindwaki chiaino chintambe, echio moraabe mosemeretie, chigwe inse agwo ase ense yaino yonsi; ee, ’mbaabamige ase emechie yaino yonsi ase ense eri’Omonene Nyasae oino, abaeire.
swahili: Nao wataizingira miji yote katika nchi yako mpaka kuta ndefu za ngome ambazo unazitegemea zimeanguka. Watazingira miji yote katika nchi ambayo Bwana Mungu wako anakupa.

english: Then you will eat the fruit of your womb, the flesh of the sons and daughters whom the LORD your God has given you, in the siege and distress that your enemy will inflict on you.
ekegusii: “Ekero ababisa baino barabamige na kobasiongororokana, nigo moraabe n’emechando emenene, goika morie emebere y’abana baino, bari’Omonene Nyasae oino, abaeire.
swahili: Utakula uzao wa tumbo lako, nyama ya wana wako na binti zako ambao Bwana Mungu wako amekupa, kwa sababu ya mateso yale adui zako watakayokuletea wakati wa kukuzingira.

english: The most gentle and refined man among you will begrudge his brother, the wife he embraces, and the rest of his children who have survived,
ekegusii: Omonto ore omwororo mono, naende ore bw’enyomba y’amasikani ase egati yaino n’abe ne’ribero rinene ri’endagera, arine momura omwabo, na mokaaye oria anchete, na abana baye batigarete bare moyo.
swahili: Hata yule mtu muungwana sana na makini miongoni mwako hatakuwa na huruma kwa ndugu yake mwenyewe au kwa mke ampendaye au watoto wake waliosalia,

english: refusing to share with any of them the flesh of his children he will eat because he has nothing left in the siege and distress that your enemy will inflict on you within all your gates.
ekegusii: Takobaa enyama y’emebere y’ abanto baye eyio akoria ere omonyene, ekiagera tabwati kende kiamotigareire. Emechando buna eyio nero ababisa baino barabarentere ekero barasiongororokane emechie yaino yonsi.
swahili: naye hatampa hata mmoja wao nyama ya watoto wake ambao anawala. Kwa kuwa hakuna kitu kingine kilichosalia kwake katika mazingirwa makali ambayo adui yako watakuletea kwa miji yako yote.

english: The most gentle and refined woman among you, so gentle and refined she would not venture to set the sole of her foot on the ground, will begrudge the husband she embraces and her son and daughter
ekegusii: Omokungu ore omwereria mono naende ore bw’enyomba y’amasikani ase egati yaino, oria otarenge konyaara gotacha inse namagoro aye agende aande, ekiagera igo are omwereria narorere omosacha oye anchete mono ribero, narorere n’abana baye, abamura na abaiseke, ribero boigo.
swahili: Mwanamke ambaye ni muungwana sana na makini miongoni mwako, yaani ambaye ni makini sana na muungwana kiasi kwamba asingethubutu kugusa ardhi kwa wayo wa mguu wake, yeye atakuwa mchoyo kwa mume ampendaye na mwanawe mwenyewe au binti yake,

english: the afterbirth that comes from between her legs and the children she bears, because she will secretly eat them for lack of anything else in the siege and distress that your enemy will inflict on you within your gates.
ekegusii: Ekero akoibora nigo arabarine nonya nomogoye okorwa ase enda yaye, na abana akoibora. Ere omonyene nayorie bobisi, ekiagera oborirwe ebinto akoria. Emechando eyio nero ababisa baino barabarentere ekero barasiongororokane ase emechie yaino yonsi.
swahili: kondoo wa nyuma kutoka kwenye tumbo lake na watoto anaowazaa. Kwa kuwa anakusudia kuwala kwa siri wakati wa kuzingirwa na katika taabu zile ambazo adui yako atazileta juu yako na miji yako.

english: If you are not careful to observe all the words of this law which are written in this book, that you may fear this glorious and awesome name—the LORD your God—
ekegusii: “Onye timokoba abeegenwa na gokora amang’ana aya onsi y’ogochika oko, ayio ariikire ase egetabu eke, erinde moiroke erieta eri ri’obonene na erigwenerete koirokwa: Omonene Nyasae oino,
swahili: Kama hutafuata kwa bidii maneno yote ya sheria hii, ambayo yameandikwa katika kitabu hiki na kama hutalicha hili jina la fahari na la kutisha, yaani la Bwana Mungu wako,

english: He will bring upon you and your descendants extraordinary disasters, severe and lasting plagues, and terrible and chronic sicknesses.
ekegusii: rirori’Omonene narente ase more, na igoro ase abana baino, amaakwa are amanene na amatindi aragenderere ase engaki entambe.
swahili: Bwana ataleta mapigo ya kutisha juu yako na kwa wazao wako, maafa makali na ya kudumu, magonjwa mazito na ya kudumu.

english: You will be blessed when you come in and blessed when you go out.
ekegusii: “Imosesenigwe ekero mogosoa inka, na ekero mokogeenda isiko.
swahili: Utabarikiwa uingiapo na utabarikiwa utokapo.

english: He will afflict you again with all the diseases you dreaded in Egypt, and they will cling to you.
ekegusii: Naende abarentere amarwaire onsi buna aria arenterete Abamisiri, ayio moirogete, naro ’nagenderere kobeera ase more.
swahili: Atakuletea juu yako magonjwa yote ya Misri yale uliyoyaogopa, nayo yataambatana nawe.

english: The LORD will also bring upon you every sickness and plague not recorded in this Book of the Law, until you are destroyed.
ekegusii: Omonene nabarentere amarwaire ao ao, na emechando eyio etariikiri ase egetabu eke y’amachiiko, goika inwe mosirigwe kegima.
swahili: Pia Bwana atakuletea kila aina ya ugonjwa na maafa ambayo hayakuandikwa humu katika kitabu hiki cha sheria, mpaka utakapokuwa umeangamizwa.

english: You who were as numerous as the stars in the sky will be left few in number, because you would not obey the voice of the LORD your God.
ekegusii: Nonya more abange buna ching’enang’eni chia igoro, ’namosirigwe motigare more abake mono, ekiagera motaigwerete Omonene Nyasae oino.
swahili: Ninyi ambao mlikuwa wengi kama nyota za angani mtaachwa wachache tu, kwa sababu hamkumtii Bwana Mungu wenu.

english: Just as it pleased the LORD to make you prosper and multiply, so also it will please Him to annihilate you and destroy you. And you will be uprooted from the land you are entering to possess.
ekegusii: Nigo er’abe ng’a buna Omonene agoogetigwe ase okobakorera amaya, akagera mokamentekana ase enchera buna eyio, naboigo agochia kogookigwa ase okorenta ogosirigwa ase more na kobaseeria kegima, nainwe morusigweo, moere kegima korwa ase ense eria mogochia koira ebe eyaino.
swahili: Kama ilivyompendeza Bwana kuwafanya ninyi mstawi na kuongezeka kwa idadi, ndivyo itakavyompendeza kuwaharibu na kuwaangamiza ninyi. Mtangʼolewa kutoka nchi mnayoiingia kuimiliki.

english: Then the LORD will scatter you among all the nations, from one end of the earth to the other, and there you will worship other gods, gods of wood and stone, which neither you nor your fathers have known.
ekegusii: “Omonene nabasiarere gochia ase egati y’ebisaku ebinge, korwa ensinyo eyemo y’ense goika eyende. Agwo ’namokorere chinyasae ching’ao chiroisirie korwa ase emete na amagena, echio inwe motamanyete, nonya ne’chisokoro chiaino.
swahili: Kisha Bwana atawatawanya miongoni mwa mataifa yote, kutoka mwisho mmoja wa dunia hadi mwingine. Huko mtaabudu miungu mingine, miungu ya miti na ya mawe, ambayo ninyi wala baba zenu hamkuijua.

english: Among those nations you will find no repose, not even a resting place for the sole of your foot. There the LORD will give you a trembling heart, failing eyes, and a despairing soul.
ekegusii: “Ekero moraabe more ase egati y’ebisaku ebio timokonyoora obotoereru, gose amagoro aino takonyoora aase agotimokera; korende aroro agwo Omonene nabae chinkoro chi’obwoba, na agosunkeera naende mobe n’obogima bochaandegete bw’okwerusia moyo.
swahili: Miongoni mwa mataifa hayo hamtapata raha wala mahali pa kupumzisha wayo wa mguu wenu. Huko Bwana atawapa mahangaiko ya mawazo, macho yaliyochoka kwa kungojea na moyo uliokata tamaa.

english: So your life will hang in doubt before you, and you will be afraid night and day, never certain of survival.
ekegusii: Omobaso n’obotuko ’namobe n’obwoba, n’obogima bwaino ’mbobe ase emechando; inwe timogosemeria okoba kw’obogima bwaino ng’a ’mbogenderere.
swahili: Utaishi katika mahangaiko siku zote, ukiwa umejaa hofu usiku na mchana, wala hutakuwa kamwe na uhakika wa maisha yako.

english: In the morning you will say, ‘If only it were evening!’ and in the evening you will say, ‘If only it were morning!’—because of the dread in your hearts of the terrifying sights you will see.
ekegusii: Ase engencho y’omoondoko bwe chinkoro chiraabe n’obwoba, na ase amakumia y’okoirokia, na ase aria morarore n’amaiso aino, nigo morateebe ase engaki ya mambia: ’Naki y’are koba buya onye yaaba mogoroba, na ase engaki ya mogoroba moteebe: Naki y’are koba buya onye yaaba mambia.
swahili: Wakati wa asubuhi utasema hivi, “Laiti ingekuwa jioni!” Jioni utasema, “Laiti ingekuwa asubuhi,” kwa sababu ya hofu ile itakayojaza moyo wako na vitu vile macho yako yatakavyoviona.

english: The LORD will return you to Egypt in ships by a route that I said you should never see again. There you will sell yourselves to your enemies as male and female slaves, but no one will buy you.”
ekegusii: Omonene nabatige moriine chimeeri moirane gochia Misiri, orogeendo orwo inche nabateebetie ng’a timokorogeenda naende. Ekero moraabe mwaikireo, ase okoremerwa kwaino ’namwerue inwe abanyene, morigie kweoonia ase ababisa baino mobe abasomba baabo, abasacha na abakungu, korende ekero moraabe mokwerwa igo, omonto tagotoka orabagore.”
swahili: Bwana atawarudisha tena Misri kwa meli, safari niliyosema kamwe hamngeenda tena. Huko mtajiuza ninyi wenyewe kwa adui zenu kama watumwa wa kiume na wa kike, lakini hakuna yeyote atakayewanunua.

english: The LORD will cause the enemies who rise up against you to be defeated before you. They will march out against you in one direction but flee from you in seven.
ekegusii: “Omonene nabatige ababisa baino, baria bagoocha kobarwania, babugwe ase amasio aino. Barabwo ’mbaabachere baetere ase enchera eyemo ekero bagoocha kobarwania, korende mbatame korwa ase more baetere chinchera isan’aibere.
swahili: Bwana atasababisha adui wainukao dhidi yako kushindwa mbele yako. Watakujia kwa njia moja lakini watakimbia mbele yako kwa njia saba.

english: The LORD will decree a blessing on your barns and on everything to which you put your hand; the LORD your God will bless you in the land He is giving you.
ekegusii: “Omonene ’nachiike ogosesenia kwaye goocha ase more, ase ebiage biaino, na ase emeremo yonsi mogokora; nabasesenie ase ense eyi’Omonene Nyasae oino, agochia kobaa ebe eyaino.
swahili: Bwana ataagiza baraka juu ya ghala zako na juu ya kila kitu utakachogusa kwa mkono wako. Bwana Mungu wako atakubariki katika nchi anayokupa.

english: The LORD will establish you as His holy people, just as He has sworn to you, if you keep the commandments of the LORD your God and walk in His ways.
ekegusii: “Kamorarende na kobwata amachiiko y’Omonene Nyasae oino, na gotaara ase chinchera chiaye, nabaimokererie igoro mobe abanto abachenu ase are, buna abariereire eira na gotiana.
swahili: Bwana atakufanya kuwa taifa lake takatifu, kama alivyokuahidi kwa kiapo, kama ukishika maagizo ya Bwana Mungu wako na kwenda katika njia zake.

english: These are the words of the covenant that the LORD commanded Moses to make with the Israelites in the land of Moab, in addition to the covenant He had made with them at Horeb.
ekegusii: Aya n’aro amang’ana y’okobwatana kw’ogotianania Omonene achiigete Musa akore n’Abaisraeli agwo ase ense ya Moabu. Okobwatana okwo nigo kwamentetwe ase kori’Omonene konya akorire amo nabarabwo aaria Horebu.
swahili: Haya ndiyo maneno ya Agano Bwana aliyomwagiza Mose kufanya na Waisraeli huko Moabu, kuwa nyongeza ya Agano alilofanya nao huko Horebu.

english: All of you are standing today before the LORD your God—you leaders of tribes, elders, officials, and all the men of Israel,
ekegusii: “Rituko ria reero inwe mwensi nigo moteneine aiga ase obosio bw’Omonene Nyasae oino; inwe abatang’ani b’ebisaku, na abagaaka, na abateneneri, inwe kera oyomo bw’Abaisraeli,
swahili: Ninyi nyote leo mnasimama mbele za Bwana Mungu wenu; mkiwa viongozi na wakuu wenu, wazee na maafisa wenu, na wanaume wengine wote wa Israeli,

english: your children and wives, and the foreigners in your camps who cut your wood and draw your water—
ekegusii: na abana baino, n’abakuungu baino, na abamenyi abwo bamenyete amo nainwe ase ebitwori biaino, na abanto bonsi abwo bakobaateria chiinko amo n’abwo bakobarentera amaache.
swahili: pamoja na watoto wenu, wake zenu na pia wageni waishio katika kambi zenu wanaowapasulia kuni na kuwachotea maji.

english: so that you may enter into the covenant of the LORD your God, which He is making with you today, and into His oath,
ekegusii: Na boono ’monyaare gosoa ase okobwatana kw’ogotianania okw’Omonene Nyasae oino, agokora amo nainwe rituko ria reero,
swahili: Mnasimama hapa ili kufanya Agano na Bwana Mungu wenu, Agano ambalo Mungu analifanya nanyi siku hii ya leo na kulitia muhuri kwa kiapo,

english: and so that He may establish you today as His people, and He may be your God as He promised you and as He swore to your fathers, to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
ekegusii: erinde ase rituko ria reero, Omonene anyare kobakora mobe abanto baye b’ekeene. Ere ’nabe Nyasae oino, buna abateebetie na buna arierete chisokoro chiaino Aburaamu, na Isaka, na Yakobo, eira ase ogotiana.
swahili: kuwathibitisha ninyi siku hii ya leo kama taifa lake, ili aweze kuwa Mungu wenu kama alivyowaahidi na kama alivyowaapia baba zenu Abrahamu, Isaki na Yakobo.

english: I am making this covenant and this oath not only with you,
ekegusii: Gose tari nainwe mweka ’ngokora okobwatana okwo kw’ogotianania,
swahili: Ninafanya Agano hili pamoja na kiapo chake, sio na ninyi tu

english: but also with those who are standing here with us today in the presence of the LORD our God, as well as with those who are not here today.
ekegusii: korende nigo ’nkogokora nainwe abamoteneine aiga reero amo naintwe ase obosio bw’Omonene Nyasae oito, naende amo nabwo batateneini amo naintwe aiga reero.
swahili: mnaosimama hapa na sisi leo mbele za Bwana Mungu wetu, bali pia pamoja na wale ambao hawapo hapa leo.

english: For you yourselves know how we lived in the land of Egypt and how we passed through the nations on the way here.
ekegusii: “Inwe abanyene ’momanyete buna obogima bwaito bwarenge ekero twamenyete ase ense ya Misiri, naende buna twarweteo na goeta egati‐gati y’ebisaku ebio ase twaetete.
swahili: Ninyi wenyewe mnajua jinsi tulivyoishi nchini Misri na jinsi tulivyopita katikati ya nchi mpaka tukafika hapa.

english: You saw the abominations and idols among them made of wood and stone, of silver and gold.
ekegusii: ’Mwarooche ebinto babwate bi’okogeechia, emegwekano yabo baare gosasiima, yaroisirie korwa ase emete, n’amagena, ne’chifeta, ne’chitaabu, eyio yarenge ase egati yabo.
swahili: Mliona miongoni mwao vinyago vyao vya kuchukiza na sanamu za miti na mawe, za fedha na dhahabu.

english: Make sure there is no man or woman, clan or tribe among you today whose heart turns away from the LORD our God to go and worship the gods of those nations. Make sure there is no root among you that bears such poisonous and bitter fruit,
ekegusii: Mwerende, tabaisa koba ase egati yaino omonto omosacha gose omokungu, gose eamate, gose egesaku, oraonchoke ase rituko ria reero, atige Omonene Nyasae oito, na gosasiima chinyasae chi’ abanto b’ebisaku ebio. Toba ase egati yaino omori okomera ekemeri kere n’obosongo gekwama okwama okororo.
swahili: Hakikisheni kwamba hakuna mwanaume au mwanamke, ukoo au kabila miongoni mwenu leo ambalo moyo wake utamwacha Bwana Mungu wetu, kwenda kuabudu miungu ya mataifa hayo. Hakikisheni hakuna mzizi miongoni mwenu unaotoa sumu chungu ya namna hii.

english: because when such a person hears the words of this oath, he invokes a blessing on himself, saying, ‘I will have peace, even though I walk in the stubbornness of my own heart.’ This will bring disaster on the watered land as well as the dry.
ekegusii: Omonto aise koba aiga, oyo oigwete amang’ana y’okobwatana okwo kw’ogotianania naende eremie abe n’obomaene ime ase enkoro yaye, erio akwane: Nabo er’abe buya ase ’nde nonya ’nkogenderera koba oyotaigwereti, oyio nigo arabasirie mwensi, abamogotinda na abamore nerang’o.
swahili: Wakati mtu wa namna hii asikiapo maneno ya kiapo hiki, hujibariki mwenyewe na kisha hufikiri, “Nitakuwa salama, hata kama nikiendelea kuifuata njia yangu mwenyewe.” Hili litaleta maafa juu ya nchi iliyonyeshewa sawasawa na nchi kame.

english: Moses summoned all Israel and proclaimed to them, “You have seen with your own eyes everything the LORD did in Egypt to Pharaoh, to all his officials, and to all his land.
ekegusii: Musa agasangereria Abaisraeli bonsi amo, akabateebia, “’Mwarooche n’amaiso aino amang’an’Omonene akorete ase ense ya Misiri, na buna akorerete Farao amo n’abanene b’ense yaye, na ense yaye yonsi.
swahili: Mose akawaita Waisraeli wote akawaambia: Macho yenu yameona yale yote Bwana aliyofanya kwa Mfalme Farao huko Misri, kwa maafisa wake wote na kwa nchi yake yote.

english: The LORD will never be willing to forgive him. Instead, His anger and jealousy will burn against that man, and every curse written in this book will fall upon him. The LORD will blot out his name from under heaven
ekegusii: Omonene takonyaara kwabera omonto onga buna oyio, korende endamwamu yaye, ne’risemi ’mbibe igoro y’omonto oyio, na okoragereria okwo gwonsi koriikire ase egetabu eke nigo koraabeere ase are, n’Omonene natinyie erieta ri’omonto oyio rirue inse y’erioba, tainyorwa.
swahili: Bwana kamwe hatakuwa radhi kumsamehe, ghadhabu na wivu wa Mungu vitawaka dhidi ya mtu huyo. Laana zote zilizoandikwa katika kitabu hiki zitamwangukia na Bwana atafuta jina lake chini ya mbingu.

english: and single him out from all the tribes of Israel for disaster, according to all the curses of the covenant written in this Book of the Law.
ekegusii: Omonene ’namokore abe ekiorokererio ase amasio y’ abanto b’ebisaku bionsi bi’Abaisraeli, na amorentere amaakwa onsi koreng’ana n’okoragereria gw’okobwatana kw’ogotianania oko koriikire ase egetabu eke y’amachiiko.
swahili: Bwana atamtwaa peke yake kutoka makabila ya Israeli kwa maangamizo, kulingana na laana zote za Agano zilizoandikwa kwenye Kitabu hiki cha Sheria.

english: Then the generation to come—your sons who follow you and the foreigner who comes from a distant land—will see the plagues of the land and the sicknesses the LORD has inflicted on it.
ekegusii: “Ase ebiaare bigochi‐goocha, ne’chinderia chiaino, n’abamenyi baraache korwa ase chinse chi’aare, ’mbarore emechando y’ense eria, na amarwaire Omonene ayetomeire.
swahili: Watoto wako watakaofuata baada yako katika vizazi vya baadaye na wageni ambao watakuja kutoka nchi za mbali, wataona maafa, yaliyoipata nchi na magonjwa ambayo Bwana aliyaleta juu yake.

english: All its soil will be a burning waste of sulfur and salt, unsown and unproductive, with no plant growing on it, just like the destruction of Sodom and Gomorrah, Admah and Zeboiim, which the LORD overthrew in His fierce anger.
ekegusii: Ense yonsi inayome pa ebe buna amagena y’omorero akonyititoka, na omonyoo, ebe bosa etari kwama, noonya n’obonyansi tibokomerao, esirigwe buna emechie ya Sodomu, na Gomora, na Adima, na Seboimu, eri’Omonene asiretie ekero abeete n’endamwamu na okogeechigwa.
swahili: Nchi yote itakuwa jaa linaloungua la chumvi na kiberiti: hakutakuwa kilichopandwa, hakutakuwa kinachochipua, wala hakutakuwa mimea inayoota juu yake. Itakuwa kama maangamizo ya Sodoma na Gomora, Adma na Seboimu, ambazo Bwana aliangamiza kwa hasira kali.

english: So all the nations will ask, ‘Why has the LORD done such a thing to this land? Why this great outburst of anger?’
ekegusii: Ee, ebisaku bionsi ’mbiboorie: Ninki kiagerete Omonene akorete ense eye ekaba iga? ’Naki endamwamu yaye yokire iga?
swahili: Mataifa yote yatauliza: “Kwa nini Bwana amefanya hivi juu ya nchi hii? Kwa nini hasira hii kali ikawaka?”

english: And the people will answer, ‘It is because they abandoned the covenant of the LORD, the God of their fathers, which He made with them when He brought them out of the land of Egypt.
ekegusii: Erio abanto mbairanerie, bateebe: Ayio nigo akoregete, ekiagera abanto baatigete okobwatana kw’ogotianania kw’Omonene, Nyasae bw’echisokoro chiabo, okwo akorete amo nabarabwo, ekero abarusetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri.
swahili: Na jibu litakuwa: “Ni kwa sababu watu hawa waliacha Agano la Bwana, Mungu wa baba zao, Agano alilofanya nao wakati alipowatoa katika nchi ya Misri.

english: They went and served other gods, and they worshiped gods they had not known—gods that the LORD had not given to them.
ekegusii: Barabwo nigo barenge gokorera chinyasae ching’ao na gochisasiima, chinyasae barabwo batamanyete agwo ritang’ani, echi’Omonene atabaete.
swahili: Walienda zao na kuabudu miungu mingine na kuisujudia, miungu wasioijua, miungu ambayo Mungu hakuwapa.

english: Therefore the anger of the LORD burned against this land, and He brought upon it every curse written in this book.
ekegusii: Ase ayio endamwamu y’Omonene ekaba enene ase ense eye, ere akarenta okoragereria gwonsi okwo koriikire ase egetabu eke.
swahili: Kwa hiyo hasira ya Bwana ikawaka dhidi ya nchi hii, hivyo Mungu akaleta juu yake laana zote zilizoandikwa katika kitabu hiki.

english: The LORD uprooted them from their land in His anger, rage, and great wrath, and He cast them into another land, where they are today.’
ekegusii: Ase endamwamu yaye enene, na obotindi, ne’risemi rinene, Omonene akabaseeria korwa ase ense yabo, akabasiarera gochia ase ense eng’ao; nao bare goika reero iga.
swahili: Katika hasira kali na katika ghadhabu kuu Bwana aliwangʼoa kutoka nchi yao na kuwasukumia katika nchi nyingine, kama ilivyo sasa.”

english: The secret things belong to the LORD our God, but the things revealed belong to us and to our children forever, so that we may follow all the words of this law.
ekegusii: “Amang’ana abobisi nigo are ase Omonene Nyasae oito, korende ayio amaanoirwe nigo are ase tore na ase abana baito kogenderera botambe, naintwe goika tokore amang’ana onsi ariikire ase amachiiko aya.
swahili: Mambo ya siri ni ya Bwana Mungu wetu, bali yaliyofunuliwa ni yetu na watoto wetu milele, ili tuweze kuyafanya maneno yote ya sheria hii.

english: You saw with your own eyes the great trials, and those miraculous signs and wonders.
ekegusii: Boigo ’mwarooche n’amaiso aino amaakwa aria amanene, na ebikone, n’amakumia amanene;
swahili: Kwa macho yenu wenyewe mliona yale majaribu makubwa, ishara zile za miujiza na maajabu makubwa.

english: Yet to this day the LORD has not given you a mind to understand, eyes to see, or ears to hear.
ekegusii: korende goika rituko ria rero Omonene taraigora ebirengererio biaino, erinde monyaare komanya buya; gose tarabaa amaiso akorora buya, gose amato akoigwa buya
swahili: Lakini mpaka leo Bwana hajawapa akili ya kuelewa au macho yanayoona au masikio yanayosikia.

english: For forty years I led you in the wilderness, yet your clothes and sandals did not wear out.
ekegusii: Ase engaki yonsi y’emiaka emerongo ene Omonene abeete okobaraa ase erooro. Chianga chiaino tichiabagoterete, gose ebikoroto biaino tibiabagoterete.
swahili: Kwa muda wa miaka arobaini niliyowaongoza jangwani, nguo zenu hazikuchakaa, wala viatu miguuni mwenu.

english: You ate no bread and drank no wine or strong drink, so that you might know that I am the LORD your God.
ekegusii: Timwabeete mokoria omogati, gose konywa edivai, gose ekenyugwa kende gionsi kegotindia, erio nario moranyaare komanya ng’a ere nere Omonene Nyasae oino.
swahili: Hamkula mkate na hamkunywa divai wala kileo chochote. Nilifanya hivi ili mpate kujua kuwa mimi ndimi Bwana Mungu wenu.

english: When you reached this place, Sihon king of Heshbon and Og king of Bashan came out against us in battle, but we defeated them.
ekegusii: Ekero twachete aase aya, Sihoni omorwoti o Hesiboni, na Ogi, omorwoti o Basani, bagaacha gotorwania esegi, korende tokababua.
swahili: Wakati mlipofika mahali hapa, Sihoni mfalme wa Heshboni na Ogu mfalme wa Bashani walikuja kupigana dhidi yetu, lakini tuliwashinda.

english: We took their land and gave it as an inheritance to the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh.
ekegusii: Tokaira ense yabo, tokayea abanto b’egesaku kia Rubeni, na ab’ekia Gadi, na ekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase, na eyio ekaba omwando obo.
swahili: Tuliichukua nchi yao na kuwapa Wareubeni, Wagadi na nusu ya kabila la Manase kama urithi wao.

english: So keep and follow the words of this covenant, that you may prosper in all you do.
ekegusii: Ase ayio moigwere, mokore amang’ana onsi ay’okobwatana okwo kw’ogotianania erio nario morasesenigwe ase emeremo yonsi moraabe mogokora.
swahili: Fuateni kwa bidii masharti ya Agano hili, ili kwamba mweze kustawi katika kila kitu mnachofanya.

english: Then we turned back and headed for the wilderness by way of the Red Sea, as the LORD had instructed me, and for many days we wandered around Mount Seir.
ekegusii: Omoerio tokaonchoka, tokageenda gochia ase erooro goetera ase enchera egochia ase omosomo bwa Akaba, buna Omonene konya anteebiire. Ase amatuko amaange, tokaba tokonakoong’anyaong’anya ase ense y’ebitunwa bia Edomu.
swahili: Kisha tukageuka nyuma na kusafiri kuelekea jangwani kwa njia inayoelekea Bahari ya Shamu, kama Bwana alivyonielekeza. Kwa muda mrefu tulitembea kuzunguka vilima katika nchi ya Seiri.

english: (The Emites used to live there, a people great and many, as tall as the Anakites.
ekegusii: (Amamonto are korokwa Abaemi nabwo bamenyete agwo Ari. Abanto abwo nigo barenge abanene, bareng’aine na Abanaki abwo nabarabwo barenge amamonto.
swahili: (Waemi walikuwa wakiishi huko hapo zamani, watu wenye nguvu na wengi, warefu kama Waanaki.

english: Like the Anakites, they were also regarded as Rephaim, though the Moabites called them Emites.
ekegusii: Na buna Abanaki abwo nigo barenge korokwa Abarefai, korende Abamoabu nigo barenge kobaroka Abaemi.
swahili: Kama walivyokuwa Waanaki, hao pia walikuwa kama Warefai, lakini Wamoabu waliwaita Waemi.

english: The Horites used to live in Seir, but the descendants of Esau drove them out. They destroyed the Horites from before them and settled in their place, just as Israel did in the land that the LORD gave them as their possession.)
ekegusii: Abahori nigo bakamenyire Edomu, korende abanto b’ororeeria rw’Esau bakabaseeria na gosaria ense yabo, bakamenya ase ense eria ribagaa riabo. Bagakora buna Abaisraeli bakorete ase ense eri’Omonene abaete ebe eyaabo.)
swahili: Wahori waliishi Seiri, lakini wazao wa Esau waliwafukuza. Waliwaangamiza Wahori na kukaa mahali pao, kama Waisraeli walivyofanya katika nchi ambayo Bwana aliwapa kama milki yao.)

english: “Now arise and cross over the Brook of Zered.” So we crossed over the Brook of Zered.
ekegusii: “Naende Omonene agatoteebia: Bono imoka, mogende mwamboke gochia ng’umbu y’akarooche ga Seredi. Erio tokageenda, tokaamboka akarooche akwo.
swahili: Bwana akasema, “Sasa ondokeni mvuke Bonde la Zeredi.” Hivyo tukavuka bonde.

english: The time we spent traveling from Kadesh-barnea until we crossed over the Brook of Zered was thirty-eight years, until that entire generation of fighting men had perished from the camp, as the LORD had sworn to them.
ekegusii: Korwa engaki twarwete Kadeshi‐Barinea goika ekero twambogete akarooche ga Seredi nigo yarenge emiaka emerongo etato, na etano na etato (38). Abanto bonsi b’ekegori keria, abamanyete korwana esegi, bagakwa bakaera, buna Omonene konya atianire.
swahili: Miaka thelathini na minane ilipita tangu wakati tulipoondoka Kadesh-Barnea mpaka tulipovuka Bonde la Zeredi. Kwa wakati huo kile kizazi chote cha wanaume kuanzia wale wawezao kwenda vitani kilikuwa kimekufa, kama Bwana alivyokuwa amewaapia.

english: Indeed, the LORD’s hand was against them, to eliminate them from the camp, until they had all perished.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo agendererete koamererania nabarabwo, goika bonsi bagasira kegima.
swahili: Mkono wa Bwana uliwakabili hadi alipowaangamiza wote huko kambini.

english: Now when all the fighting men among the people had died,
ekegusii: “Ekero abarwani bonsi b’esegi konya bakuure,
swahili: Ikawa baada ya mtu wa mwisho kuanzia wale wawezao kwenda vitani kufa,

english: the LORD said to me,
ekegusii: Omonene aganteebia:
swahili: Bwana akaniambia,

english: “Today you are going to cross the border of Moab at Ar.
ekegusii: Reero moetere orobebe rwa Moabu ase enchera ya Ari.
swahili: “Leo utapita katika nchi ya Moabu huko Ari.

english: But when you get close to the Ammonites, do not harass them or provoke them, for I will not give you any of the land of the Ammonites. I have given it to the descendants of Lot as their possession.”
ekegusii: Ekero moraike ang’e n’ense y’Abaamoni, abanto b’ororeeria rwa Loti, timobaisa kobachegia gose kobarwania esegi, ekiagera tinkobaa inwe nonya n’enseemo eyemo y’orogongo orwo nabaeire barabwo.”
swahili: Utakapokuja kwa Waamoni, msiwasumbue wala kuwachokoza kwa vita, kwa kuwa sitawapa ardhi yoyote iliyo ya Waamoni kuwa milki yenu. Nimeitoa kama milki ya wazao wa Loti.”

english: At this time the LORD said to me,
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene agakwana nainche, aganteebia:
swahili: Kisha Bwana akaniambia,

english: (That too was regarded as the land of the Rephaim, who used to live there, though the Ammonites called them Zamzummites.
ekegusii: (Orogongo orwo nigo naende rwamanyekanete buna ense y’Abarefai. Erieta ri’abanto abwo bamenyeteo agwo kare, korende Abaamoni bakabaroka Abasamusumi.
swahili: (Hiyo pia ilidhaniwa kuwa nchi ya Warefai waliokuwa wakiishi huko, lakini Waamoni waliwaita Wazamzumi.

english: They were a people great and many, as tall as the Anakites. But the LORD destroyed them from before the Ammonites, who drove them out and settled in their place,
ekegusii: Abanto aba nigo barenge abanene naende abatambe buna Abanaki; boigo nigo barenge abange. Korende Omonene akabasiria, na Abaamoni bakaba bakomenya ase ense eria ribaga riabo.
swahili: Walikuwa watu wenye nguvu na wengi, warefu kama Waanaki. Bwana akawaangamiza kutoka mbele ya Waamoni, ambao waliwafukuza na kukaa mahali pao.

english: just as He had done for the descendants of Esau who lived in Seir, when He destroyed the Horites from before them. They drove them out and have lived in their place to this day.
ekegusii: Naboigo Omonene akorerete abanto b’ororeeria rw’Esau, baria bamenyete ase ense y’ebitunwa ya Edomu. Agaita Abahori, na Abaesau bakaba bakomenya ase ense eria ribaga riabo, nao bamenyete goika reero iga.
swahili: Bwana alikuwa amefanya vivyo hivyo kwa wazao wa Esau, ambao waliishi Seiri, wakati alipowaangamiza Wahori watoke mbele yao. Waliwafukuza na wao wakaishi mahali pao mpaka leo.

english: And the Avvim, who lived in villages as far as Gaza, were destroyed by the Caphtorites, who came out of Caphtor and settled in their place.) The Defeat of Sihon (Numbers 21:21–30)
ekegusii: Abaavi nigo bamenyete agwo ase Emechie yarenge ensemo ase enyancha ya Mediterania goika Gaza. Abakafitori korwa ase egesinga gia Kaptori bagaita Abaavi bakaba bakomenya ase ense eria ribaga riabo.)
swahili: Nao Waavi ambao waliishi katika vijiji mpaka Gaza, Wakaftori waliokuja kutoka Kaftori waliwaangamiza na kukaa mahali pao.)

english: “Arise, set out, and cross the Arnon Valley. See, I have delivered into your hand Sihon the Amorite, king of Heshbon, and his land. Begin to take possession of it and engage him in battle.
ekegusii: “Naende Omonene agateeba: Imoka, mochaake orogeendo rwaino, mwamboke orooche rw’Arinoni. Naama! Nabeekire ase amaboko aino Sihoni Omoamori, omorwoti o Hesiboni, amo n’ense yaye. Ase igo, mochaake komorwania esegi, moire ense yaye.
swahili: “Ondoka sasa na uvuke Bonde la Arnoni. Tazama, nimemweka mikononi mwako Sihoni Mwamori, mfalme wa Heshboni na nchi yake. Anza kuimiliki nchi hiyo na umwingize katika vita.

english: This very day I will begin to put the dread and fear of you upon all the nations under heaven. They will hear the reports of you and tremble in anguish because of you.”
ekegusii: Reero ninchaake kogosa abanto bonsi bare inse y’erioba, erinde baabairoke na koboboa ekero bakoigwa chinkuma chiaino, nabatengechigwe n’omoondoko. Abaisraeli bakobua omorwoti Sihoni (Omob 21:21-30)
swahili: Siku hii ya leo nitaanza kuwatia hofu na woga mataifa yote chini ya mbingu wawaogope ninyi. Watakaposikia taarifa zenu, watatetemeka na kufadhaika kwa sababu yenu.” Kushindwa Kwa Sihoni Mfalme Wa Heshboni (Hesabu 21:21-30)

english: So from the Wilderness of Kedemoth I sent messengers with an offer of peace to Sihon king of Heshbon, saying,
ekegusii: “Erio ngatoma abanto korwa ase erooro ya Kedemoti, bakageenda ase Sihoni, omorwoti o Hesiboni, nkamotomera amang’ana y’omorembe, ngateeba:
swahili: Kutoka jangwa la Kedemothi nilituma wajumbe wenye maneno ya amani kwa Sihoni mfalme wa Heshboni kusema,

english: “Let us pass through your land; we will stay on the main road. We will not turn to the right or to the left.
ekegusii: Koranche onyanchere ng’etere ase ense yao. Nigo ndaete ase enchera enene yoka; tinkogobera aande.
swahili: “Turuhusu tupite katika nchi yako. Tutapita katika barabara kuu, hatutageuka kuume wala kushoto.

english: You can sell us food to eat and water to drink in exchange for silver. Only let us pass through on foot,
ekegusii: Nong’oonerie endagera indie na amaache inywe, nainche ninkoe chitaabu. Aye ing’a ribaga ng’ete n’amagoro ase ense yao.
swahili: Tuuzie chakula tule na maji tunywe kwa thamani yake katika fedha. Turuhusu tu tupite kwa miguu,

english: just as the descendants of Esau who live in Seir and the Moabites who live in Ar did for us, until we cross the Jordan into the land that the LORD our God is giving us.”
ekegusii: Buna abanto b’ororeeria rw’Esau, abamenyete Edomu, na Abamoabu, abamenyete Ari, bankorerete, naye onkorere boigo, goika imbe nambokire orooche rwa Yorodani, na nasoire ase ense eri’Omonene Nyasae oito, agochia gotoa.
swahili: kama wazao wa Esau ambao wanaishi Seiri na Wamoabu ambao wanaishi Ari walivyotufanyia, mpaka tuvuke Yordani kuingia nchi ambayo Bwana Mungu wetu anatupatia.”

english: “You have been wandering around this hill country long enough; turn to the north
ekegusii: Mwabeire mokona koong’anya-ong’anya ase ense eye y’ebitunwa ase engaki entambe eisaine; bono onchoka mogende gochia ensemo ya Sugusu.
swahili: “Umetembea kuzunguka hii nchi ya vilima kwa muda wa kutosha; sasa geukia kaskazini.

english: But Sihon king of Heshbon would not let us pass through, for the LORD your God had made his spirit stubborn and his heart obstinate, that He might deliver him into your hand, as is the case this day.
ekegusii: “Korende Sihoni, omorwoti o Hesiboni, akaanga, tatoa ribaga toete ase ense yaye Omonene Nyasae oino. Nigo akong’etie enkoro yaye ekaba ey’ogotaigwera, akamobeka ase amaboko aino, na inwe mokamobua na mokaira ense yaye, eyio tobwate goika rero iga.
swahili: Lakini Sihoni mfalme wa Heshboni alikataa kuturuhusu kupita. Kwa kuwa Bwana Mungu wako alikuwa ameifanya roho yake kuwa ngumu na moyo wake kuwa mkaidi ili amweke kwenye mikono yenu, kama alivyofanya sasa.

english: Then the LORD said to me, “See, I have begun to deliver Sihon and his land over to you. Now begin to conquer and possess his land.”
ekegusii: “Omonene aganteebia: Rora, nachaakire kobeeka Sihoni amo n’ense yaye ase amaboko aino. Ase ayio, chaaka koira ense yaye ebe eyaino.
swahili: Bwana akaniambia, “Tazama, nimeanza kuwapa Mfalme Sihoni na nchi yake kwako. Sasa anzeni kuishinda na kuimiliki nchi yake.”

english: So Sihon and his whole army came out for battle against us at Jahaz.
ekegusii: Erio Sihoni amo n’abanto baye bonsi bagaacha gotorwania esegi, ekero twarenge ase omochie o Yahasi,
swahili: Wakati Sihoni pamoja na jeshi lake lote walipokuja kukutana nasi katika vita huko Yahazi,

english: And the LORD our God delivered him over to us, and we defeated him and his sons and his whole army.
ekegusii: korende Omonene Nyasae oito, akamobeka ase amaboko aito, ere amo n’abamura baye, na abanto baye bonsi, na intwe tokabaita.
swahili: Bwana Mungu wetu alimweka mikononi mwetu, nasi tukamwangamiza pamoja na wanawe na jeshi lake lote.

english: At that time we captured all his cities and devoted to destruction the people of every city, including women and children. We left no survivors.
ekegusii: Ase engaki eria tokabwata emechie yaye yonsi, tokayesaria, togaita abasacha, n’abakuungu, na abana, titwatigaretie monto ore moyo, nonya n’oyomo.
swahili: Kwa wakati ule tuliteka miji yake yote na kuiangamiza kabisa: wanaume, wanawake na watoto. Hatukumwacha yeyote.

english: We carried off for ourselves only the livestock and the plunder from the cities we captured.
ekegusii: Togoosa chitugo chiabo, na gosakora ebinto biarenge ase emechie eyio bikaba ebiaito.
swahili: Lakini mifugo na nyara tulizoziteka kutoka ile miji tulijichukulia wenyewe.

english: From Aroer on the rim of the Arnon Valley, along with the city in the valley, even as far as Gilead, not one city had walls too high for us. The LORD our God gave us all of them.
ekegusii: Korwa Aroeri, omochie oria ore ase engegu y’orooche rw’Arinoni, goika Gileadi, amo n’omochie ore ase rikura, omochie onde torenge ne chindwaki chinkong’u totanyaarete gotagora. Omonene Nyasae oito, nigo abegete emechie yonsi ase amaboko aito.
swahili: Kutoka Aroeri kwenye ukingo wa Bonde la Arnoni, kutoka mji ulio ndani ya bonde, hata mpaka Gileadi, hapakuwa na mji hata mmoja uliokuwa na nguvu kutushinda. Bwana Mungu wetu alitupa yote.

english: But you did not go near the land of the Ammonites, or the land along the banks of the Jabbok River, or the cities of the hill country, or any place that the LORD our God had forbidden.
ekegusii: Korende titwaigete ang’e ase ense y’Abaamoni, gose ase chingegu chi’orooche rwa Yaboki, na emechie y’ense y’ebitunwa, na aande onsi ase Omonene Nyasae oito, atokanetie titogeendao.
swahili: Lakini kulingana na amri ya Bwana Mungu wetu, hamkujiingiza katika nchi yoyote ya Waamoni, wala katika sehemu yoyote iliyo kandokando ya Mto Yaboki, wala katika miji iliyoko katika vilima.

english: and command the people: ‘You will pass through the territory of your brothers, the descendants of Esau, who live in Seir. They will be afraid of you, so you must be very careful.
ekegusii: Naende aganteebia: Bachiike abanto, obateebie ng’a ’mbare ang’e goeta ase orogongo rw’ abanto bamwabo, abanto b’ororeeria rwa Esau, abwo bamenyete Edomu. Barabwo nigo barabairoke. Ase ayio mwerende mono,
swahili: Wape watu maagizo haya: ‘Mko karibu kupita katikati ya nchi ya ndugu zako ambao ni wazao wa Esau, ambao wanaishi Seiri. Watawaogopa, lakini mwe waangalifu.

english: Do not provoke them, for I will not give you any of their land, not even a footprint, because I have given Mount Seir to Esau as his possession.
ekegusii: timobaisa korwana nabarabwo, ekiagera tinkobaa inwe ense yabo nonya n’enseemo enke eisaine egesanyi gi’okogoro, ekiagera naeire abanto b’ororeeria rw’Esau ense y’ebitunwa ya Edomu ebe eyaabo.
swahili: Msiwachokoze kwa vita kwa maana sitawapa ninyi sehemu yoyote ya nchi yao, hata sehemu ya kutosha kuweka wayo wenu juu yake. Nimempa Esau nchi ya vilima ya Seiri kama yake mwenyewe.

english: You are to pay them in silver for the food you eat and the water you drink.’”
ekegusii: Nigo moragore endagera n’amache korwa ase bare.
swahili: Mtawalipa fedha kwa chakula mtakachokula na maji mtakayokunywa.’ ”

english: Indeed, the LORD your God has blessed you in all the work of your hands. He has watched over your journey through this vast wilderness. The LORD your God has been with you these forty years, and you have lacked nothing.
ekegusii: Inyora buna Omonene Nyasae oino, abasesenirie ase emeremo yaino yonsi mwabeire mogokora. Nigo abeire obarendete ase orogeendo rwaino ase erooro eye enene ase emiaka eye emerongo ene. Omonene Nyasae oino, obeire amo nainwe, na inwe timwaremeretwe na gento kende.
swahili: Bwana Mungu wenu amewabariki kwa kazi yote ya mikono yenu. Amewalinda katika safari yenu katikati ya jangwa hili kubwa. Kwa miaka hii arobaini Bwana Mungu wenu amekuwa pamoja nanyi, na hamkupungukiwa na kitu chochote.

english: So we passed by our brothers, the descendants of Esau, who live in Seir. We turned away from the Arabah road, which comes up from Elath and Ezion-geber, and traveled along the road of the Wilderness of Moab.
ekegusii: Erio tokaimoka, tokagenderera, togatiga enchera ekogenda ase emechie ya Elati, na Esioni‐Geberi gochia ase ekerubo Ekiomo, erio tokaonchoka, tokageenda gochia ase erooro ya Moabu.
swahili: Basi tulipita kwa ndugu zetu wazao wa Esau ambao wanaishi Seiri. Tuligeuka kutoka njia ya Araba ambayo inatokea Elathi na Esion-Geberi, tukasafiri kufuata njia ya jangwa la Moabu.

english: Then the LORD said to me, “Do not harass the Moabites or provoke them to war, for I will not give you any of their land, because I have given Ar to the descendants of Lot as their possession.”
ekegusii: Omonene aganteebia: Timobaisa gochegia abanto ba Moabu abanto b’ororeeria rwa Loti, gose korwana na barabwo Nabaeire omochie o Ari tinkobaa inwe ensemo ende yonsi y’ense yabo ebe eyaino.
swahili: Kisha Bwana akaniambia, “Usiwasumbue Wamoabu kwa vita, kwa kuwa sitawapa sehemu yoyote ya nchi yao. Nimetoa nchi ya Ari kwa wazao wa Loti kama milki yao.”

english: “When all these things come upon you—the blessings and curses I have set before you—and you call them to mind in all the nations to which the LORD your God has banished you,
ekegusii: “Ekero ogosesenigwa na okoragererigwa, ayio naborokereirie aria arabe gakobanyora ekero mogendererete komenya ase egati y’ebisaku bionsi ebio ase Omonene Nyasae oino, arabaseerie gochia, ’monyaare koinyora amang’ana ane.
swahili: Wakati baraka hizi zote pamoja na laana nilizoziweka mbele yako zitakapokujia, nawe ukazitafakari moyoni popote Bwana Mungu wako atakapokutawanya miongoni mwa mataifa,

english: if you obey the LORD your God by keeping His commandments and statutes that are written in this Book of the Law, and if you turn to Him with all your heart and with all your soul. The Choice of Life or Death
ekegusii: komoraigwere Omonene Nyasae oino, na mobwate amachiiko aye onsi na emeroberio echiikire, ariikire ase egetabu eke y’amachiiko, naende komoramoonchokere ne chinkoro chiaino chionsi, na emioyo yaino yonsi.
swahili: kama ukimtii Bwana Mungu wako, na kuzishika amri zake na maagizo yake ambayo yameandikwa katika Kitabu hiki cha Sheria, na kumgeukia Bwana Mungu wako kwa moyo wako wote na kwa roho yako yote. Uzima Na Mauti

english: For this commandment I give you today is not too difficult for you or beyond your reach.
ekegusii: “Ogochika okwo nabaeire rituko ria reero tikori ogokong’u mono ase more, gose tikori aare korwa ase more.
swahili: Ninachokuagiza leo sio kigumu sana kwako au usichokiweza.

english: It is not in heaven, that you should need to ask, ‘Who will ascend into heaven to get it for us and proclaim it, that we may obey it?’
ekegusii: Tigokari aaria igoro, erinde moborie: Ning’o oranyaare koriina gochia aaria igoro agotorentere korwa aroro, erinde tokoigwe na kogokora?
swahili: Hakiko juu mbinguni, ili uulize, “Ni nani atakayepanda mbinguni kukileta na kututangazia ili tuweze kutii?”

english: And it is not beyond the sea, that you should need to ask, ‘Who will cross the sea to get it for us and proclaim it, that we may obey it?’
ekegusii: Gose tigokari ng’umbu y’enyancha, erinde moborie: Ning’o oranyaare kwamboka gochia ng’umbu y’enyancha agotorentere, erinde tokoigwe na togokore?
swahili: Wala hakiko ngʼambo ya bahari, ili uulize, “Ni nani atakayevuka bahari kwenda kukichukua na kututangazia ili tupate kutii?”

english: But the word is very near you; it is in your mouth and in your heart, so that you may obey it.
ekegusii: Taibo! Ring’ana riria nigo rire ang’e nainwe ase emenwa yaino, na ase chinkoro chiaino, erinde monyaare korikora.
swahili: La hasha! Lile neno liko karibu sana nawe; liko kinywani mwako na ndani ya moyo wako ili uweze kulitii.

english: See, I have set before you today life and goodness, as well as death and disaster.
ekegusii: “Rora, rituko ria reero nabeekire ase amasio aino obogima na ayaare amaya, amakweri na ayaare amabe.
swahili: Tazama, naweka mbele yako leo uzima na mafanikio, mauti na maangamizo.

english: For I am commanding you today to love the LORD your God, to walk in His ways, and to keep His commandments, statutes, and ordinances, so that you may live and increase, and the LORD your God may bless you in the land that you are entering to possess.
ekegusii: Komoraigwere amachiiko yo Omonene Nyasae oino, aya inche ’nkobaa ase rituko ria reero, ase okomwancha na gotaara ase chinchera chiaye na kobwata amachiiko aye, na emeroberio yaye echiikire, erio inwe ’namobe moyo na komentekana, nere nabasesenie ase ense eyio mogochia gosoa na koira ebe eyaino.
swahili: Ninakuamuru leo kwamba umpende Bwana Mungu wako, utembee katika njia zake, na kutunza maagizo yake, amri na sheria zake; ndipo utakapoishi na kuongezeka, naye Bwana Mungu wako atakubariki katika nchi unayoingia kuimiliki.

english: But if your heart turns away and you do not listen, but are drawn away to bow down to other gods and worship them,
ekegusii: Korende mogochia koonchoka ase chinkoro chiaino na komotiga timomoigwera, korende mong’uswe moonchoke gosasiima chinyasae ching’ao na gochikorera,
swahili: Lakini kama moyo wako ukigeukia mbali ukawa huna utii, kama umevutwa kuisujudia miungu mingine na kuiabudu,

english: I declare to you today that you will surely perish; you shall not prolong your days in the land that you are crossing the Jordan to possess.
ekegusii: nabaorokeirie ase rituko ria reero ng’a goika mosire. Timogochia komenya engaki entambe ase ense eria ere ng’umbu ya Yorodani, eria mogochia koira ebe eyaino.
swahili: nakutangazia leo hii kwamba hakika utaangamizwa. Hutaishi maisha marefu katika nchi unayovuka Yordani kuiingia na kuimiliki.

english: I call heaven and earth as witnesses against you today that I have set before you life and death, blessing and cursing. Therefore choose life, so that you and your descendants may live,
ekegusii: Rituko ria reero narangeirie igoro na ense chibe birori ase more ng’a inche nabeekire ase amasio aino obogima na amakweri, ogosesenigwa na okoragererigwa. Ase ayio, chora obogima, erinde inwe amo ne chinderia chiaino monyaare kogenderera koba moyo.
swahili: Leo ninaziita mbingu na nchi kama mashahidi dhidi yako kwamba nimeweka mbele yako uzima na mauti, baraka na laana. Basi sasa chagueni uzima, ili wewe na watoto wako mpate kuishi,

english: and when you and your children return to the LORD your God and obey His voice with all your heart and all your soul according to everything I am giving you today,
ekegusii: Inwe amo nabana baino komoramoiranere Omonene Nyasae oino, na koigwera amang’ana aye ase chinkoro chiaino chionsi, na ase emioyo yaino yonsi, amang’ana ayio nabachiikire rituko ria reero,
swahili: hapo wewe na watoto wako mtakapomrudia Bwana Mungu wako, na kumtii kwa moyo wako wote na kwa roho yako yote kulingana na kila kitu ninachokuamuru leo,

english: and that you may love the LORD your God, obey Him, and hold fast to Him. For He is your life, and He will prolong your life in the land that the LORD swore to give to your fathers, to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.”
ekegusii: Mwanche Omonene Nyasae oino, momoigwere na mobe abegenwa ase are. Ekero morakore ayio, rirorio ’namogenderere koba moyo na komenya ase ense eyi’Omonene arierete chisokoro chiaino Aburaamu, na Isaka, na Yakobo eira ng’a n’abayee.”
swahili: na ili upate kumpenda Bwana Mungu wako, uisikilize sauti yake na kuambatana naye. Kwa kuwa Bwana ndiye uzima wako, na atakupa wingi wa siku ili upate kuishi katika nchi aliyoapa kuwapa baba zako Abrahamu, Isaki na Yakobo.

english: then He will restore you from captivity and have compassion on you and gather you from all the nations to which the LORD your God has scattered you.
ekegusii: rirori’Omonene Nyasae oino, n’abarorere amaabera na kobasesenia, naende abairanie korwa ase ebisaku bionsi ebio ase abasiarerete gochia.
swahili: ndipo Bwana Mungu wako atakapokurudisha kutoka utumwani na kukuhurumia, naye atakukusanya tena kutoka mataifa yote kule alikutawanya.

english: Even if you have been banished to the farthest horizon, He will gather you and return you from there.
ekegusii: Nonya mwasiareretwe gochia ase chinsinyo chi’ense, Omonene Nyasae oino, nabasangererie korwao,
swahili: Hata kama umefukuziwa katika nchi ya mbali kiasi gani chini ya mbingu, kutoka huko Bwana Mungu wako atakukusanya na kukurudisha.

english: And the LORD your God will bring you into the land your fathers possessed, and you will take possession of it. He will cause you to prosper and multiply more than your fathers.
ekegusii: na kobairania gochia ase ense eria chisokoro chiaino chiairete ekaba eyabo, erio nainwe moyeire ebe eyaino. Ere nabakorere amaya, naende ababuchie mobe abange goetania chisokoro chiaino.
swahili: Yeye Bwana atakurudisha katika nchi iliyokuwa mali ya baba zako, nawe utaimiliki. Naye atakufanya ufanikiwe sana na kukuzidisha kwa idadi kuliko baba zako.

english: The LORD your God will circumcise your hearts and the hearts of your descendants, and you will love Him with all your heart and with all your soul, so that you may live.
ekegusii: Omonene Nyasae oino, narokie chinkoro chiaino, ne chinkoro chi’ororeeria rwaino, nabae inwe ne chinderia chiaino chinkoro chi’okoigwera; erio nario moramwanche ne chinkoro chiaino chionsi, na emioyo yaino yonsi, mogenderere koba moyo.
swahili: Bwana Mungu wako ataitahiri mioyo yenu na mioyo ya wazao wenu ili mweze kumpenda kwa moyo wako wote na kwa roho yako yote ukaishi.

english: Then the LORD your God will put all these curses upon your enemies who hate you and persecute you.
ekegusii: Omonene oino nabeeke okoragereria okwo gwonsi igoro y’ababisa baino, na igoro ya baria baabageechete na kobachaanda.
swahili: Bwana Mungu wako ataweka laana hizi zote juu ya adui zako ambao wanakuchukia na kukutesa.

english: And you will again obey the voice of the LORD and follow all His commandments I am giving you today.
ekegusii: Nainwe moigwere Omonene naende, na kobwata amachiiko aye onsi aya ’nkobateebia rituko ria reero.
swahili: Utamtii tena Bwana na kuzishika amri zake zote ninazokupa leo.

english: So the LORD your God will make you abound in all the work of your hands and in the fruit of your womb, the offspring of your livestock, and the produce of your land. Indeed, the LORD will again delight in your goodness, as He delighted in that of your fathers,
ekegusii: Omonene Nyasae oino, nabasesenie mono ase emeremo yaino yonsi mogokora n’amaboko aino, nasesenie oroiboro rwaino romentekane, ’namente ne chiombe chiaino na okwama kwaino kwe riroba. Na buna Omonene agoogete ase ogosesenia chisokoro chiaino, naboigo aragooke ase okobasesenia inwe,
swahili: Ndipo Bwana Mungu wako atakapokufanikisha sana katika kazi zote za mikono yako na katika uzao wa tumbo lako, wadogo wa mifugo yako na mazao ya nchi yako. Bwana atakufurahia tena na kukufanikisha, kama alivyowafurahia baba zako,

english: When Moses had finished speaking these words to all Israel,
ekegusii: Musa akagenderera gokwana amang’ana aya ase Abaisraeli bonsi.
swahili: Kisha Mose akaenda akasema maneno haya kwa Waisraeli wote:

english: Then Moses commanded them, “At the end of every seven years, at the appointed time in the year of remission of debt, during the Feast of Tabernacles,
ekegusii: Musa akabachiika akabateebia, “Ase omoerio o kera omwaka o gatan’akabere, ase engaki echiikire y’omwaka bw’obosibore, ase Amatuko Amanene ay’Ebigutu,
swahili: Kisha Mose akawaamuru, akasema: “Mwishoni mwa kila miaka saba, katika mwaka wa kufuta madeni, wakati wa Sikukuu ya Vibanda,

english: when all Israel comes before the LORD your God at the place He will choose, you are to read this law in the hearing of all Israel.
ekegusii: ekero Abaisraeli bonsi bagoocha ase obosio bw’Omonene Nyasae oino, aase agwo arachoore, osome amachiiko onsi, erinde Abaisraeli bonsi bayaigwe.
swahili: Waisraeli wote wanapokuja mbele za Bwana Mungu wenu mahali atakapopachagua, utasoma sheria hii mbele yao masikioni mwao.

english: Assemble the people—men, women, children, and the foreigners within your gates—so that they may listen and learn to fear the LORD your God and to follow carefully all the words of this law.
ekegusii: Mosangererie abanto bonsi, abasacha na abakungu, na abana, na abamenyi bamenyete ase emechie yaino, erio bonsi baigwe na kweorokereria komoiroka Omonene Nyasae oino, erinde babe abegenwa na bakore amang’ana onsi y’amachiiko aya.
swahili: Kusanya watu wote, wanaume, wanawake, watoto na wageni wanaoishi katika miji yenu, ili waweze kusikia na kujifunza kumcha Bwana Mungu wenu na kufuata kwa bidii maneno yote ya sheria hii.

english: Then their children who do not know the law will listen and learn to fear the LORD your God, as long as you live in the land that you are crossing the Jordan to possess.” God Commissions Joshua
ekegusii: Erio abana baabo konya bataramanya amachiiko aya, bayaigwe na kweorokereria komoiroka Omonene, Nyasae oino, ekero moraabe mogendererete komenya ase ense eria ng’umbu ya Yorodani, eyio mogochia koira ebe eyaino.” Ogoteebereria kw’omoerio kw’Omonene ase Musa
swahili: Watoto wao, ambao hawaijui sheria hii, lazima waisikie na kujifunza kumcha Bwana Mungu wenu kwa muda mtakaoishi katika nchi mnayovuka Yordani kuimiliki.” Kuasi Kwa Waisraeli Kunatabiriwa

english: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Behold, the time of your death is near. Call Joshua and present yourselves at the Tent of Meeting, so that I may commission him.” So Moses and Joshua went and presented themselves at the Tent of Meeting.
ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa, “Naama! Amatuko ao abereire ang’e ogochia gokwa. Rangeria Yoshua, erinde moochiche agwo ase Eema y’Omosangererekano, erio imobeeke ase emeremo agwenerete akore.” Musa na Yoshua bakageenda agwo ase Eema y’Omosangererekano,
swahili: Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Sasa siku ya kifo chako imekaribia. Mwite Yoshua, mkajihudhurishe katika Hema la Kukutania, mahali nitakapompa maagizo ya kazi.” Kwa hiyo Mose na Yoshua wakaja na kujihudhurisha kwenye Hema la Kukutania.

english: Then the LORD appeared at the tent in a pillar of cloud, and the cloud stood over the entrance to the tent.
ekegusii: Omonene akaoroka agwo ore ime ase riire rire buna esiiro, narirorio rigatenena agwo ase egesieri ki’Eema eria.
swahili: Kisha Bwana akatokea katika Hema katika nguzo ya wingu, nalo wingu likasimama juu ya ingilio la Hema.

english: And the LORD said to Moses, “You will soon rest with your fathers, and these people will rise up and prostitute themselves with the foreign gods of the land they are entering. They will forsake Me and break the covenant I have made with them.
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene agateebia Musa, “Rora kwabereire ang’e gochia gokwa na ogende gotimoka ase chisokoro chiao chitimogete; magega y’ayio abanto aba nigo baratige koba abegenwa ase ’nde, bakorere chinyasae chingeni chi’ense eria ase bakogeenda komenya; barabwo ’mbantige, naende basarie okobwatana kw’ogotianania nakorete amo nabarabwo.
swahili: Kisha Bwana akamwambia Mose: “Unakwenda kupumzika na baba zako, nao watu hawa hivi karibuni watazini na miungu migeni ya nchi wanayoingia. Wataniacha na kuvunja Agano nililofanya nao.

english: On that day My anger will burn against them, and I will abandon them and hide My face from them, so that they will be consumed, and many troubles and afflictions will befall them. On that day they will say, ‘Have not these disasters come upon us because our God is no longer with us?’
ekegusii: Ase engaki eria endamwamu yane nebe enene igoro ase bare, inche nimbatige na nimbise obosio bwane, tibandora, erio barabwo ’mbasirigwe. Amabe amaange na emechando emenge ’nabichiche igoro ase bare, erio baborie ase rituko erio: Inee! Amabe aya onsi tari igo achire igoro ase tore, ekiagera Nyasae oito atari ase egati yaito?
swahili: Siku hiyo nitawakasirikia na kuwaacha; nitawaficha uso wangu, nao wataangamizwa. Maafa mengi na shida nyingi zitakuja juu yao, nao siku hiyo watauliza, ‘Je, maafa haya hayakuja juu yetu kwa sababu Mungu wetu hayuko pamoja nasi?’

english: And on that day I will surely hide My face because of all the evil they have done by turning to other gods.
ekegusii: Ase rituko riria ekeene nimbise obosio bwane korwa ase bare, ekiagera bakorire amabe baonchokeire chinyasae ching’ao.
swahili: Nami hakika nitauficha uso wangu siku hiyo kwa sababu ya maovu yao yote kwa kugeukia miungu mingine.

english: Now therefore, write down for yourselves this song and teach it to the Israelites; have them recite it, so that it may be a witness for Me against them.
ekegusii: “Bono riika ogoteera oko, oborokererie Abaisraeli, bamanye kogoteera, erinde korokwo kobe kirori one ase Abaisraeli.
swahili: “Sasa ujiandikie wimbo huu, uwafundishe Waisraeli na uwaamuru wauimbe, ili upate kuwa ushahidi wangu dhidi yao.

english: he said to them, “I am now a hundred and twenty years old; I am no longer able to come and go, and the LORD has said to me, ‘You shall not cross the Jordan.’
ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Bono inche nakoorire emiaka rigana erimo na merongo ebere, tinkonyaara kobaraa kogenderera. Boig’Omonene onkanirie ng’a tinkwamboka ngende ng’umbu ya Yorodani.
swahili: “Sasa nina miaka mia moja na ishirini nami siwezi tena kuwaongoza. Bwana ameniambia, ‘Hutavuka Yordani.’

english: When I have brought them into the land that I swore to give their fathers, a land flowing with milk and honey, they will eat their fill and prosper. Then they will turn to other gods and worship them, and they will reject Me and break My covenant.
ekegusii: Nimbaire ase ense eyio entenenku ere n’amabeere na amooke, eyio narierete chisokoro chiabo eira ng’a nimbayee. Aroro agwo ’mbanyore ebinto ebinge barie, baisaneke na konora, korende nigo baraonchokere chinyasae ching’ao na gochikorera, erio banchaaye na gosaria okobwatana kwane kw’ogotianania.
swahili: Nitakapokwisha kuwaingiza katika nchi itiririkayo maziwa na asali, nchi niliyowaahidi baba zao kwa kiapo, nao watakapokula wakashiba na kufanikiwa, watageukia miungu mingine na kuiabudu, wakinikataa mimi na kuvunja Agano langu.

english: And when many troubles and afflictions have come upon them, this song will testify against them, because it will not be forgotten from the lips of their descendants. For I know their inclination, even before I bring them into the land that I swore to give them.”
ekegusii: Ekero amabe amaange na emechando biraabe bikobaachera, ogoteera oko ’nakoborokererie na kobe kirori ase bare, ekiagera tigokwebwa nonya nase chinderia chiabo. Nimanyete ebirengererio bare nabio bono, ritang’ani konya ntarabarenta ase ense eyio nariete eira ng’a nimbayee.”
swahili: Maafa na shida zitakapokuja juu yao, wimbo huu utashuhudia dhidi yao, kwa sababu hautasahauliwa na wazao wao. Ninajua lile wanaloandaa kufanya, hata kabla sijawaingiza katika nchi niliyowaahidi kwa kiapo.”

english: So that very day Moses wrote down this song and taught it to the Israelites.
ekegusii: Ase rituko erio Musa akariika ogoteera koria akorokereria Abaisraeli.
swahili: Hivyo Mose akaandika wimbo huu siku ile na akawafundisha Waisraeli.

english: Then the LORD commissioned Joshua son of Nun and said, “Be strong and courageous, for you will bring the Israelites into the land that I swore to give them, and I will be with you.” The Law Placed in the Ark
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene akamwatanana Yoshua, mosinto o Nuni, akamoteebia, “Otenene bokong’u, obe noboremu, ekiagera naye orabaire Abaisraeli ase ense eria nabarierete eira ng’a nimbayee. Inche nimbe amo naye.”
swahili: Bwana akampa Yoshua mwana wa Nuni agizo hili: “Uwe hodari na shujaa, kwa kuwa utawaleta Waisraeli katika nchi niliyowaahidi kwa kiapo, nami mwenyewe nitakuwa pamoja nawe.”

english: When Moses had finished writing in a book the words of this law from beginning to end,
ekegusii: Musa akayariika amang’ana ayio onsi y’amachiiko ime ase egetabu.
swahili: Baada ya Mose kumaliza kuandika kwenye kitabu maneno ya sheria hii kutoka mwanzo hadi mwisho,

english: he gave this command to the Levites who carried the ark of the covenant of the LORD:
ekegusii: Erio agachiika Abalawi baria barenge kobogoria Esanduki eria y’Omonene, ere ne’chibao chiriikire okobwatana kw’ogotianania, agateeba,
swahili: akawapa Walawi wale waliolibeba Sanduku la Agano la Bwana agizo hili, akawaambia:

english: “Take this Book of the Law and place it beside the ark of the covenant of the LORD your God, so that it may remain there as a witness against you.
ekegusii: “Ira egetabu eke kiamachiiko, mokebeeke ensemo y’Esanduki eria ere n’okobwatana kw’ogotianania kw’Omonene Nyasae oino, erio kebeereo ase okoba kirori ase more.
swahili: “Chukueni Kitabu hiki cha Sheria mkakiweke kando ya Sanduku la Agano la Bwana Mungu wenu. Hapo ndipo kitakapokaa kama shahidi dhidi yenu.

english: For I know how rebellious and stiff-necked you are. If you are already rebelling against the LORD while I am still alive, how much more will you rebel after my death!
ekegusii: Inche nimanyete ng’a timori abaigweri, korende nigo more abanyabigoti bikong’u. Rora bono, ekero inde moyo amo nainwe, mwasaririe ase Omonene, Inee, ekero ndabe nakuure timogosaria mono kobua?
swahili: Kwa kuwa ninajua jinsi mlivyo waasi na mlivyo na shingo ngumu. Kama mmekuwa mkiasi dhidi ya Bwana nikiwa bado niko hai na nikiwa pamoja nanyi, mtaasi mara ngapi baada ya kufa kwangu!

english: Assemble before me all the elders of your tribes and all your officers so that I may speak these words in their hearing and call heaven and earth to witness against them.
ekegusii: Sangereria abagaaka bonsi b’ebisaku biaino, na abanene bonsi, obarente ase ’nde, erinde imbateebie amang’ana aya; inche nindangerie igoro na ense chibe birori ase bare.
swahili: Kusanyeni mbele yangu wazee wote wa makabila yenu na maafisa wenu wote, ili nipate kusema maneno haya masikioni mwao na kuziita mbingu na nchi ili kushuhudia dhidi yao.

english: For I know that after my death you will become utterly corrupt and turn from the path I have commanded you. And in the days to come, disaster will befall you because you will do evil in the sight of the LORD to provoke Him to anger by the work of your hands.” Moses Begins His Song
ekegusii: Namanyire ng’a magega inche konakuure, ekeene inwe nigo morakore amabe, naende nigo moraonchoke na gotiga enchera eye nabachiikire. Ase ayio, ase amatuko agoocha obobe ’nabobanyore, ekiagera nigo mogochia gokora amabe ase obosio bw’Omonene, erio momogeechie abe n’endamwamu goetera ase emeremo ende yonsi moraabe mogokora.” Ogoteera kwa Musa
swahili: Kwa kuwa ninajua baada ya kifo changu hakika mtakuwa waovu kabisa na kugeuka kutoka njia niliyowaamuru ninyi. Katika siku zijazo, maafa yatawapata kwa sababu mtafanya maovu mbele ya macho ya Bwana, na kuchochea hasira yake kwa yale mikono yenu itakayokuwa imefanya.” Wimbo Wa Mose

english: The LORD your God Himself will cross over ahead of you. He will destroy these nations before you, and you will dispossess them. Joshua will cross ahead of you, as the LORD has said.
ekegusii: Omonene, Nyasae oino omonyene, nabatang’ane aseerie ebisaku bionsi bire ase amasio aino, erinde moire ense yabo, na Yoshua nabe omoraai oino, buna Omonene ateebire.
swahili: Bwana Mungu wenu, yeye mwenyewe atavuka mbele yenu. Ataangamiza mataifa haya mbele yenu, nanyi mtaimiliki nchi yao. Pia Yoshua atavuka mbele yenu, kama Bwana alivyosema.

english: Then Moses recited aloud to the whole assembly of Israel the words of this song from beginning to end:
ekegusii: Erio Musa agakwana amang’ana onsi ay’ogoteera oko ekero omosangererekano bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli bategererete.
swahili: Mose akayasoma maneno ya wimbo huu kutoka mwanzo hadi mwisho katika masikio ya kusanyiko lote la Israeli:

english: And the LORD will do to them as He did to Sihon and Og, the kings of the Amorites, when He destroyed them along with their land.
ekegusii: Omonene nakore ebisaku ebio buna akorete Sihoni na Ogi, abarwoti b’Abaamori, ekero keria abasiretie, agasaria ne chinse chiabo.
swahili: Naye Bwana atawafanyia watu hao kile alichowafanyia Sihoni na Ogu, wafalme wa Waamori, ambao aliwaangamiza pamoja na nchi yao.

english: The LORD will deliver them over to you, and you must do to them exactly as I have commanded you.
ekegusii: Omonene nababeeke ase amaboko aino, nainwe mobakore koreng’ana namang’ana onsi nabachiikire.
swahili: Bwana atawakabidhi kwenu, nanyi lazima mwatendee yale yote niliyowaamuru.

english: Be strong and courageous; do not be afraid or terrified of them, for it is the LORD your God who goes with you; He will never leave you nor forsake you.”
ekegusii: Motenene bokong’u, mobe abaremu, timobaisa kobairoka gose koboboa, ekiagera Omonene Nyasae oino, nagende amo nainwe, takobatiga mobugwe, gose takobatuguta.”
swahili: Kuweni imara na moyo wa ushujaa. Msiogope wala msifadhaike kwa sababu yao, kwa kuwa Bwana Mungu wenu anakwenda pamoja nanyi; kamwe hatawaacha wala hatawatupa ninyi.”

english: Then Moses called for Joshua and said to him in the presence of all Israel, “Be strong and courageous, for you will go with this people into the land that the LORD swore to their fathers to give them, and you shall give it to them as an inheritance.
ekegusii: Erio Musa akarangeria Yoshua, agakwana nere agwo ase Abaisraeli bonsi baigwete, akamoteebia, “Otenene bokong’u, obe omoremu, ekiagera naye orabatang’ane abanto aba gochia ase ense eri’Omonene arierete chisokoro chiabo eira ng’a n’abayee. Naye orabaatananere ense eria ebe omwando obo.
swahili: Kisha Mose akamwita Yoshua na akamwambia mbele ya Israeli wote, “Uwe imara na moyo wa ushujaa, kwa kuwa ni lazima uende na watu hawa katika nchi ile Bwana aliyowaapia baba zao kuwapa, nawe ni lazima uwagawie kama urithi wao.

english: The LORD Himself goes before you; He will be with you. He will never leave you nor forsake you. Do not be afraid or discouraged.” The Reading of the Law (Nehemiah 8:1–8)
ekegusii: Omonene nere oragotang’ane, nabe amo naye, takogotiga obugwe, gose takogotuguta, Tobaisa koiroka gose kwoboa.” Amachiiko arabe agosomwa kera omwaka o gatan’akabere
swahili: Bwana mwenyewe atakutangulia naye atakuwa pamoja nawe; kamwe hatakuacha wala hatakutupa. Usiogope, wala usifadhaike.” Kusoma Sheria

english: So Moses wrote down this law and gave it to the priests, the sons of Levi, who carried the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and to all the elders of Israel.
ekegusii: Musa akariika amachiiko ayio, erio akayaa abakuani Abalawi barenge kobogoria Esanduki ere ne chibao chiriikire okobwatana kw’ogotianania kw’Omonene, boigo akayea abagaaka bonsi b’Abaisraeli.
swahili: Kwa hiyo Mose akaandika sheria hii na kuwapa makuhani, wana wa Lawi, waliochukua Sanduku la Agano la Bwana na wazee wote wa Israeli.

english: Give ear, O heavens, and I will speak; hear, O earth, the words of my mouth.
ekegusii: “Inwe igoro, ntegerera moigwe, nkwane, naye ense, igwa amang’ana akorwa ase omonwa one.
swahili: Sikilizeni, enyi mbingu, nami nitasema; sikia, ee nchi, maneno ya kinywa changu.

english: He found him in a desert land, in a barren, howling wilderness; He surrounded him, He instructed him, He guarded him as the apple of His eye.
ekegusii: “Omonene nigo abanyorete ase erooro etamenyiri n’abanto, eyarenge kogosa nokwoga gwe ching’iti chi’orosana, erio akabaraa aroro, akabarenda na kobarageria, akabarenda buna arendete endorero y’eriso riaye.
swahili: Katika nchi ya jangwa alimkuta, katika nyika tupu ivumayo upepo. Alimhifadhi na kumtunza; akamlinda kama mboni ya jicho lake,

english: As an eagle stirs up its nest and hovers over its young, He spread His wings to catch them and carried them on His pinions.
ekegusii: Buna ekeongo gekorangeria amage aye na kiayorokereria koiruruka, kiarambora chimbaaba chiaye keyabogoria, naboigo Omonene akobogoria abanto baye ase chimbaaba chiaye ime.
swahili: kama tai avurugaye kiota chake, na kurukaruka juu ya makinda yake, ambaye hutanda mabawa yake kuwadaka, na huwachukua kwenye mabawa yake.

english: The LORD alone led him, and no foreign god was with him.
ekegusii: Omonene bweka omonyene nere obaraaete, na enyasae engeni tiyarenge amo nere.
swahili: Bwana peke yake alimwongoza; hakuwepo mungu mgeni pamoja naye.

english: He made him ride on the heights of the land and fed him the produce of the field. He nourished him with honey from the rock and oil from the flinty crag,
ekegusii: “Akabakiinia na kobatiiria ase ebitunwa igoro, akabarageria n’okwama kw’emegondo, na obooke korwa ase egetare ime, n’amaguta y’emazeituni korwa ase egetare egekong’u.
swahili: Akamfanya apande sehemu zilizoinuka za nchi, akamlisha kwa mavuno ya mashamba. Akamlea kwa asali toka mwambani, na kwa mafuta kutoka mwamba mgumu,

english: with curds from the herd and milk from the flock, with the fat of lambs, with rams from Bashan, and goats, with the choicest grains of wheat. From the juice of the finest grapes you drank the wine.
ekegusii: Akabaa amanooga ye chiombe, na amabeere ye chimbori, ne chinyama chinoru chie chimanwa chi’eching’ondi, na echie chimingichi, amo ne ching’ondi ne chimbori chingiya chikorwa Basani. Mokaria engano yarenge engiya mono, na mokanywa edivai korwa ase amasabibu amonyinga.
swahili: kwa jibini na maziwa kutoka makundi ya ngʼombe na kutoka makundi ya mbuzi, kwa mafuta ya wana-kondoo na mbuzi, kwa kondoo dume wazuri wa Bashani, na kwa ngano nzuri. Ukanywa damu ya zabibu inayotoa povu.

english: But Jeshurun grew fat and kicked— becoming fat, bloated, and gorged. He abandoned the God who made him and scorned the Rock of his salvation.
ekegusii: “Korende Yesuruni akanora, akaenena. Akanora na koneta, akagirigenta; erio akaanga Nyasae oria omotongete; agachecheria Egetare keria kiarenge ogotooreka kwaye.
swahili: Yeshuruni alinenepa na kupiga teke; alikuwa na chakula tele, akawa mzito na akapendeza sana. Akamwacha Mungu aliyemuumba, na kumkataa Mwamba Mwokozi wake.

english: They provoked His jealousy with foreign gods; they enraged Him with abominations.
ekegusii: Barabwo bakagera Omonene akaba ne risemi, ekiagera basasiimete chinyasae chingeni, bakagera akaba n’endamwamu enene, ekiagera akorete okogeechia.
swahili: Wakamfanya Mungu kuwa na wivu kwa miungu yao migeni, na kumkasirisha kwa sanamu zao za machukizo.

english: They sacrificed to demons, not to God, to gods they had not known, to newly arrived gods, which your fathers did not fear.
ekegusii: Bakarua ebing’wanso ase ebirecha bitari Nyasae: bagasasiima chinyasae batamanyete agwo ritang’ani, chinyasae chinyia chiasoete magega, echio chisokoro chiaino chitairogete.
swahili: Wakatoa dhabihu kwa pepo, ambao si Mungu: miungu wasiyoijua, miungu iliyojitokeza siku za karibuni, miungu ambayo baba zenu hawakuiogopa.

english: You ignored the Rock who brought you forth; you forgot the God who gave you birth.
ekegusii: Mogatiga Egetare keria kiabaiborete, mokeeba Nyasae oria obaete obogima.
swahili: Mkamwacha Mwamba, aliyewazaa ninyi; mkamsahau Mungu aliyewazaa.

english: When the LORD saw this, He rejected them, provoked to anger by His sons and daughters.
ekegusii: “Ekero Omonene arooche amang’ana ayio, akabaanga, akaba n’endamwamu ase abana baye, abamura na abaiseke.
swahili: Bwana akaona hili, akawakataa, kwa sababu alikasirishwa na wanawe na binti zake.

english: Let my teaching fall like rain and my speech settle like dew, like gentle rain on new grass, like showers on tender plants.
ekegusii: Amorokererio ane tiga atwe buna embura, na enkwana yane etoore buna riime ri’embura, buna omonyirira okonyirira igoro ase obonyansi obobese, na buna embura engiya egotwa igoro ase ebimeri ebirere.
swahili: Mafundisho yangu na yanyeshe kama mvua, na maneno yangu na yashuke kama umande, kama manyunyu juu ya majani mabichi, kama mvua tele juu ya mimea myororo.

english: He said: “I will hide My face from them; I will see what will be their end. For they are a perverse generation— children of unfaithfulness.
ekegusii: Akabora: Nimbise obosio bwane korwa ase bare, erio ndore omoerio obo buna ogochia koba, ekiagera barabwo nekegori egesisikanu, abanto batari abeegenwa.
swahili: Akasema, “Nitawaficha uso wangu, nami nione mwisho wao utakuwa nini, kwa kuwa wao ni kizazi kilichopotoka, watoto ambao si waaminifu.

english: They have provoked My jealousy by that which is not God; they have enraged Me with their worthless idols. So I will make them jealous by those who are not a people; I will make them angry by a nation without understanding.
ekegusii: Bagerire nabeire ne risemi ase engencho y’egetari Nyasae, nagechiigwe ase emegwekano yabo ere bosa, eyio bagosasiima. Ase ayio inche ninseegete abanto abachorochombu, erinde babageechie nimbatige bageechigwe ase okobarentera egesaku ekeriri.
swahili: Wamenifanya niwe na wivu kwa kile ambacho si mungu, na kunikasirisha kwa sanamu zao zisizokuwa na thamani. Nitawafanya wawaonee wivu wale ambao si taifa. Nitawafanya wakasirishwe na taifa lile lisilo na ufahamu.

english: For a fire has been kindled by My anger, and it burns to the depths of Sheol; it consumes the earth and its produce, and scorches the foundations of the mountains.
