ekegusii: Endamwamu yane yokire buna omorero, n’oro nosambe goika aase abakuure, nosambe ense na okwama koreo, nosambe na amaroso y’ebitunwa.
swahili: Kwa maana moto umewashwa kwa hasira yangu, ule uwakao hadi kwenye vina vya mauti. Utateketeza dunia pamoja na mazao yake, na kuwasha moto katika misingi ya milima.

english: I will heap disasters upon them; I will spend My arrows against them.
ekegusii: “Nimbeeke amabe onsi igoro ase bare, nimbarase n’chinsara chiane.
swahili: “Nitalundika majanga juu yao na kutumia mishale yangu dhidi yao.

english: They will be wasted from hunger and ravaged by pestilence and bitter plague; I will send the fangs of wild beasts against them, with the venom of vipers that slither in the dust.
ekegusii: ’Nabakwe ase engencho y’enchara ne riberera rikorura, ’nabariegwe namarwaire amabe agoita. Nimbatomere ching’iti chi’orosana chire n’amaino amooge chibarwanie, ne ching’iti chingeenda inse chire n’obosongo, chibarome.
swahili: Nitatuma njaa kali dhidi yao maradhi mabaya, yateketezayo na tauni ya kufisha; nitawapelekea meno makali ya wanyama mwitu, na sumu ya nyoka wale watambaao mavumbini.

english: Outside, the sword will take their children, and inside, terror will strike the young man and the young woman, the infant and the gray-haired man.
ekegusii: Ekero abana babo bare isiko mbaitwe n’emioro, ekero bare ime ase chinyomba obwoba mbobaite; ebio mbiite abamura, na abaiseke, na abana bakogonka, amo n’abanto abagotu.
swahili: Barabarani upanga utawakosesha watoto; nyumbani mwao hofu itatawala. Vijana wao wa kiume na wa kike wataangamia, pia watoto wachanga na wazee wenye mvi.

english: I would have said that I would cut them to pieces and blot out their memory from mankind,
ekegusii: Ngateeba: Nigo nareenge gochia kobasiarera gochia aare, erio mbasirie kegima, tibaabaisa koinyorwa ase egati ya Mwanyabaanto.
swahili: Nilisema ningewatawanya na kufuta kumbukumbu lao katika mwanadamu.

english: if I had not dreaded the taunt of the enemy, lest their adversaries misunderstand and say: ‘Our own hand has prevailed; it was not the LORD who did all this.’”
ekegusii: Onye ’noboete ng’a ababisa baabo ’mbaabaise gochia gwetogia na bangeechie, ’mbaabaise gochia goteeba: Nintwe twababua, gose tari Omonene okorire ayio onsi.
swahili: Lakini nilihofia dhihaka za adui, adui asije akashindwa kuelewa, na kusema, ‘Mikono yetu imeshinda; Bwana hakufanya yote haya.’ ”

english: Israel is a nation devoid of counsel, with no understanding among them.
ekegusii: Abaisraeli n’abanto batancheti ogosemigwa, na tibari n’obong’aini bonde bwonsi.
swahili: Wao ni taifa lisilo na akili, hakuna busara ndani yao.

english: If only they were wise, they would understand it; they would comprehend their fate.
ekegusii: Onye nabang’aini barenge nanga ’mbamanya amang’ana aya, na korengereria igoro y’omoerio obo.
swahili: Laiti wangekuwa na hekima wangefahamu hili, na kutambua mwisho wao utakuwa aje!

english: For I will proclaim the name of the LORD. Ascribe greatness to our God!
ekegusii: Inche nindarie erieta ri’Omonene. Inwe motogie Nyasae oito!
swahili: Nitalitangaza jina la Bwana. Naam, sifuni ukuu wa Mungu wetu!

english: How could one man pursue a thousand, or two put ten thousand to flight, unless their Rock had sold them, unless the LORD had given them up?
ekegusii: Naki omonto oyomo arakore aseerie abanto elifu eyemo, na abanto babere baseerie abanto chilifu ikomi, onye oria ore egetare kiabo atabaoonetie na kobarua, naende onye Omonene tabatigete?
swahili: Mtu mmoja angewezaje kufukuza elfu moja, au wawili kufukuza elfu kumi, kama si kwamba Mwamba wao amewauza, kama si kwamba Bwana amewaacha?

english: For their rock is not like our Rock, even our enemies concede.
ekegusii: Egetare kiabo tikeri buna Egetare giaito, nonya n’ababisa baito ’mbamanyete amang’ana ayio.
swahili: Kwa kuwa mwamba wao si kama Mwamba wetu, sawasawa na vile adui zetu wanavyokiri.

english: But their vine is from the vine of Sodom and from the fields of Gomorrah. Their grapes are poisonous; their clusters are bitter.
ekegusii: Emesabibu yabo nigo ekorwa ase emesabibu ya Sodomu, na korwa ase emegondo ya Gomora; na amasabibu abo nigo are n’obosongo, ebisago biabo nigo bire ebiroro.
swahili: Mzabibu wao unatoka kwenye mzabibu wa Sodoma, na kutoka kwenye mashamba ya Gomora. Zabibu zake zimejaa sumu, na vishada vyake vimejaa uchungu.

english: Their wine is the venom of serpents, the deadly poison of cobras.
ekegusii: Edivai yabo nigo enga buna obosongo bwe ching’iti, na obotindi bwabo buna obosongo obotindi bw’amarubi.
swahili: Mvinyo wao ni sumu ya nyoka, sumu yenye kufisha ya swila.

english: “Have I not stored up these things, sealed up within My vaults?
ekegusii: “Omonene nigo akoboria: Inee! Amang’ana aya tagachiri ase ’nde? Tabeekiri ekemanyererio ase ekungo yane?
swahili: “Je, hili sikuliweka akiba na kulifungia kwenye vyumba vyangu vya hazina?

english: Vengeance is Mine; I will repay. In due time their foot will slip; for their day of disaster is near, and their doom is coming quickly.”
ekegusii: Egesiomba n’ekiane, ninche ’ndaakane, kegachire goika amagoro abo atererigwe, ekiagera rituko ri’emechando yabo riaikire ang’e, na ogosirigwa kwabo nigo kogoocha bwango.
swahili: Ni juu yangu kulipiza kisasi; nitalipiza. Wakati utakapowadia, mguu wao utateleza; siku yao ya maafa ni karibu, na maangamizo yao yanawajia haraka.”

english: For the LORD will vindicate His people and have compassion on His servants when He sees that their strength is gone and no one remains, slave or free.
ekegusii: Omonene nanachere abanto baye ekiina kia boronge, na arorere abasomba baye amaabera, ekero ararore ng’a chinguru chiabo chiaerire, naende onde tatigareti, omosomba gose omobiare.
swahili: Bwana atawahukumu watu wake, na kuwahurumia watumishi wake atakapoona nguvu zao zimekwisha wala hakuna yeyote aliyebaki, mtumwa au aliye huru.

english: He will say: “Where are their gods, the rock in which they took refuge,
ekegusii: Erio naborie: Ng’ai chinyasae chiabo chire? Egetare ekio basemeretie na kogetamera, ng’ai kere?
swahili: Atasema: “Sasa iko wapi miungu yao, mwamba walioukimbilia,

english: which ate the fat of their sacrifices and drank the wine of their drink offerings? Let them rise up and help you; let them give you shelter!
ekegusii: Chinyasae echio chiariete ebitinya bi’ebing’wanso biabo, na konywa okoruegwa kw’ebinyugwa bi’edivai, ng’ai chire? Tiga chichiche erio chibakonye na kobarenda.
swahili: miungu wale waliokula mafuta ya dhabihu zao na kunywa mvinyo wa sadaka zao za vinywaji? Wainuke basi, wawasaidie! Wawapeni basi ulinzi!

english: See now that I am He; there is no God besides Me. I bring death and I give life; I wound and I heal, and there is no one who can deliver from My hand.
ekegusii: “Rora bono, inche ninche bweka Nyasae, onde tari otatiga inche bweka. Ninche ’ngoita, naende nairania obogima, ninche ’ngoaka, naende nagwenia. Onde tari oranyaare kwerwanerera ekonye korwa ase okoboko kwane.
swahili: “Tazama basi, Mimi mwenyewe, Mimi Ndiye! Hakuna mungu mwingine ila Mimi. Mimi ninaua na Mimi ninafufua, Mimi nimejeruhi na Mimi nitaponya, wala hakuna awezaye kuokoa kutoka mkononi mwangu.

english: He is the Rock, His work is perfect; all His ways are just. A God of faithfulness without injustice, righteous and upright is He.
ekegusii: “Omonene nere Egetare giaito, emeremo yaye nemeikeranu, ekiagera chinchera chiaye chionsi nechindonge. Nyasae nomwegenwa otari nobobe; ere nigo are omonyene ekeene na oboronge.
swahili: Yeye ni Mwamba, kazi zake ni kamilifu, njia zake zote ni haki. Mungu mwaminifu ambaye hakosei, yeye ni mnyofu na mwenye haki.

english: For I lift up My hand to heaven and declare: As surely as I live forever,
ekegusii: Inche ninche ’nkoimokia amaboko ane gochia igoro, natiana na goteeba: Buna inche inde moyo kare na kare.
swahili: Ninainua mkono wangu kuelekea mbinguni na kusema: Hakika kama niishivyo milele,

english: when I sharpen My flashing sword, and My hand grasps it in judgment, I will take vengeance on My adversaries and repay those who hate Me.
ekegusii: Nigo ’ngotieria omoro one okomesa, n’okoboko kwane kwanacha ekiina. Nindusie egesiomba igoro ase ababisa bane, ning’akane baria bonsi bangeechete.
swahili: wakati ninapounoa upanga wangu unaometameta na mkono wangu unapoushika ili kutoa hukumu, nitalipiza kisasi juu ya adui zangu na kuwalipiza wale wanaonichukia.

english: I will make My arrows drunk with blood, while My sword devours flesh— the blood of the slain and captives, the heads of the enemy leaders.”
ekegusii: Nintindie chinsara chiane n’amanyinga, omoro one oite abanto, oigote chinyama chi’abwo baitirwe, na amanyinga yabooswa na emetwe y’abatang’ani b’ababisa.
swahili: Nitailevya mishale yangu kwa damu, wakati upanga wangu ukitafuna nyama: damu ya waliochinjwa pamoja na mateka, vichwa vya viongozi wa adui.”

english: Rejoice, O heavens, with Him, and let all God’s angels worship Him. Rejoice, O nations, with His people; for He will avenge the blood of His children. He will take vengeance on His adversaries and repay those who hate Him; He will cleanse His land and His people.
ekegusii: “Inwe abanto b’ebisaku, goka amo n’abanto b’Omonene; ekiagera orusirie egesiomba ki’amanyinga y’abasomba baye; orusirie egesiomba igoro ase ababisa baye, okorire okobwatania ase ense yaye na ase abanto baye.”
swahili: Furahini, enyi mataifa, pamoja na watu wake, kwa kuwa atailipiza damu ya watumishi wake, atalipiza kisasi juu ya adui zake na kufanya upatanisho kwa ajili ya nchi na watu wake.

english: Then Moses came with Joshua son of Nun and recited all the words of this song in the hearing of the people.
ekegusii: Musa ekero arenge na Yoshua, mosinto o Nuni, agacha agakwana amang’ana onsi y’ogoteera okwo, ekero abanto bategererete. Amorokererio y’omoerio a Musa
swahili: Mose na Yoshua mwana wa Nuni wakaja, wakanena maneno yote ya wimbo watu wakiwa wanasikia.

english: When Moses had finished reciting all these words to all Israel,
ekegusii: Ekero Musa akoorire gokwana amang’ana ayio ase Abaisraeli bonsi,
swahili: Mose alipomaliza kuyasoma maneno haya yote kwa Israeli wote,

english: he said to them, “Take to heart all these words I testify among you today, so that you may command your children to carefully follow all the words of this law.
ekegusii: akabateebia, “Renda na koigwera amang’ana onsi aya nabeekire abe kirori ase more ase rituko ria reero, mochiike abana baino babwate na gokora amang’ana onsi y’amachiiko ayio.
swahili: akawaambia, “Yawekeni moyoni maneno yote ambayo nimewatangazia kwa makini siku hii ya leo, ili kwamba mpate kuwaagiza watoto wenu wayatii kwa bidii maneno yote ya sheria hii.

english: For they are not idle words to you, because they are your life, and by them you will live long in the land that you are crossing the Jordan to possess.” Moses’ Death Foretold
ekegusii: Ayio tari amang’ana abosa ase more, naro obogima bwaino; na ase okoigwera amang’ana aya ’namogenderere komenya engaki entambe ase ense eyio mogochia koira ng’umbu ya Yorodani.”
swahili: Siyo maneno matupu tu kwenu, bali ni uzima wenu. Kwa hayo mtaishi maisha marefu katika nchi mnayovuka Yordani kuimiliki.” Mose Aelezwa Kuhusu Kifo Chake

english: On that same day the LORD said to Moses,
ekegusii: Ase rituko erio eri’Omonene agateebia Musa,
swahili: Siku hiyo hiyo Bwana akamwambia Mose,

english: “Go up into the Abarim Range to Mount Nebo, in the land of Moab across from Jericho, and view the land of Canaan, which I am giving to the Israelites as their own possession.
ekegusii: “Tiira gochia ase ebitunwa bi’Abarimu, ase egetunwa kia Nebo, kere ase ense ya Moabu, kororia Yeriko, erio origererie ense ya Kaanani eyio ingochia koa Abaisraeli ebe eyabo.
swahili: “Kwea katika mapangano ya Mlima Abarimu hadi kilima cha Nebo kilichoko Moabu, ngʼambo ya Yeriko, na uitazame Kanaani, nchi ninayowapa Waisraeli kama milki yao wenyewe.

english: His people have acted corruptly toward Him; the spot on them is not that of His children, but of a perverse and crooked generation.
ekegusii: Barabwo basaririe ase Omonene, na bono tibagenderereti korokwa abana baye; nigo bare abanto b’obosooku, ekegori egesareku, naende egesiru.
swahili: Wamefanya mambo ya upotovu mbele zake; kwa aibu yao, wao si watoto wake tena, lakini ni kizazi kilicho kiovu na kilichopotoka.

english: And there on the mountain that you climb, you will die and be gathered to your people, just as your brother Aaron died on Mount Hor and was gathered to his people.
ekegusii: Aye nokwere ase egetunwa ekio ase ogotiira gochia, osangererekane amo n’abanto bao, buna Aroni momura omino akwerete ase egetunwa kia Hori, akabwatia abanto baye,
swahili: Utafia kwenye mlima huo unaokwea na kukusanyika pamoja na watu wako, kama ndugu yako Aroni alivyofia juu ya Mlima Hori naye akakusanyika kwa watu wake.

english: For at the waters of Meribah-kadesh in the Wilderness of Zin, both of you broke faith with Me among the Israelites by failing to treat Me as holy in their presence.
ekegusii: ekiagera timwabeete abeegenwa ase ’nde ase egati y’Abaisraeli agwo ase amaache a Meriba‐Kadeshi, ase erooro ya Sini. Timwansigete na kworokia Abaisraeli ng’a inche nigo inde omochenu.
swahili: Hii ni kwa sababu ninyi wawili mlivunja uaminifu nami mbele ya Waisraeli kwenye maji ya Meriba-Kadeshi katika Jangwa la Sini, na kwa sababu hamkuuinua utakatifu wangu miongoni mwa Waisraeli.

english: Although you shall see from a distance the land that I am giving the Israelites, you shall not enter it.”
ekegusii: Ase ayio nonyare korora ense eria ere bosio bwao, korende tokonyaara kogeenda aroro na gosoa ase ense eria ’ngochia koa Abaisraeli.”
swahili: Kwa hiyo, utaiona tu nchi kwa mbali; wewe hutaingia nchi ninayowapa watu wa Israeli.”

english: Is this how you repay the LORD, O foolish and senseless people? Is He not your Father and Creator? Has He not made you and established you?
ekegusii: Inwe abanto abariri motari nobong’aini, Inee, eye nero enchera mogoakanera Omonene? Inee, ere tari iso, oria obatongete, na obakorire mwabeire ne chinguru?
swahili: Je, hii ndiyo njia ya kumlipa Bwana, enyi watu wajinga na wasio na busara? Je, yeye siye Baba yenu, Muumba wenu, aliyewafanya ninyi na kuwaumba?

english: Remember the days of old; consider the years long past. Ask your father, and he will tell you, your elders, and they will inform you.
ekegusii: “Inyora amatuko a kare, rengereria igoro y’emiaka y’ebiaare biaetire. Boria iso, nere nakworokererie amang’ana ayio, boria abagaaka baino, nabarabwo mbakoyateebie.
swahili: Kumbuka siku za kale; tafakari vizazi vya zamani vilivyopita. Uliza baba yako, naye atakuambia, wazee wako, nao watakueleza.

english: When the Most High gave the nations their inheritance, when He divided the sons of man, He set the boundaries of the peoples according to the number of the sons of God.
ekegusii: Ekero Oyore Igoro Mono aete abanto b’ebisaku emiando yabo, na ekero aatananete Mwanyabaanto. Akababeekera chimbebe ase baramenye, kobwatekana n’omobaro bw’Abaisraeli,
swahili: Aliye Juu Sana alipowapa mataifa urithi wao, alipogawanya wanadamu wote, aliweka mipaka kwa ajili ya mataifa sawasawa na hesabu ya wana wa Israeli.

english: But the LORD’s portion is His people, Jacob His allotted inheritance.
ekegusii: Omonene bwechooreire abanto baye babe egetari kiaye, abanto ba Yakobo nabwo barurwe babe omwando oye.
swahili: Kwa kuwa fungu la Bwana ni watu wake, Yakobo kura yake ya urithi.

english: This is the blessing that Moses the man of God pronounced upon the Israelites before his death.
ekegusii: Oko nakwo ogosesenia Musa, omonto o Nyasae, asesenetie Abaisraeli ekero konya atarakwa.
swahili: Hii ndiyo baraka Mose mtu wa Mungu aliyotamka kwa Waisraeli kabla ya kifo chake.

english: He will teach Your ordinances to Jacob and Your law to Israel; he will set incense before You and whole burnt offerings on Your altar.
ekegusii: Barabwo ’mborokererie Abayakobo emeroberio yao echiikire na Abaisraeli amachiiko ao, ’mbarente ubani ase obosio bwao, naende ’mbasambere ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa ase egesasiimero kiao.
swahili: Humfundisha Yakobo mausia yako na Israeli sheria yako. Hufukiza uvumba mbele zako na sadaka nzima za kuteketezwa juu ya madhabahu yako.

english: Bless his substance, O LORD, and accept the work of his hands. Smash the loins of those who rise against him, and of his foes so they can rise no more.”
ekegusii: Omonene, obasesenie amo nebi bionsi babwate, bwanche emeremo eria bagokora, obune chibachwa chi’ababisa baabo baria bagoocha kobarwania, baria baabageechete, tibaabaisa goocha kobarwania naende.”
swahili: Ee Bwana, bariki ustadi wake wote, nawe upendezwe na kazi ya mikono yake. Vipige viuno vya wale wainukao dhidi yake; wapige adui zake hata wasiinuke tena.”

english: Concerning Benjamin he said: “May the beloved of the LORD rest secure in Him; God shields him all day long, and upon His shoulders he rests.”
ekegusii: Agakwana igoro y’Ababenjamini: “Aba n’abanchwa ba Omonene, ’mbamenye inse y’oborendi bwaye bare n’obotoereru, Omonene nabagitere abaetanane botambe, barabwo mbamenye ase amareko aye.”
swahili: Kuhusu Benyamini akasema: “Mwache mpenzi wa Bwana apumzike salama kwake, kwa maana humkinga mchana kutwa, na yule Bwana ampendaye hupumzika kati ya mabega yake.”

english: Concerning Joseph he said: “May his land be blessed by the LORD with the precious dew from heaven above and the deep waters that lie beneath,
ekegusii: Agakwana igoro y’Abayusufu: “Ogosesenigwa kw’Omonene kobe ase riroba riabo, abae ebiegwa ebiya bikorwa igoro, abae obotooru na ebinto ebiya bire ase riroba ime,
swahili: Kuhusu Yosefu akasema: “ Bwana na aibariki nchi yake kwa umande wa thamani kutoka mbinguni juu, na vilindi vya maji vilivyotulia chini;

english: with the bountiful harvest from the sun and the abundant yield of the seasons,
ekegusii: abae amatunda amaya y’okwama kw’omobaso, abae okwama okonge kw’emetienyi.
swahili: pamoja na vitu vilivyo bora sana viletwavyo na jua, na vitu vizuri sana vinavyoweza kutolewa na mwezi;

english: with the best of the ancient mountains and the bounty of the everlasting hills,
ekegusii: Asesenie ebigoro bia kare bitubwe n’obonge bw’okwama okuya, n’ebitunwa bireo botambe, birue okwama okonge boigo.
swahili: pamoja na zawadi bora sana za milima ya zamani na kwa wingi wa baraka za vilima vya milele;

english: with the choice gifts of the land and everything in it, and with the favor of Him who dwelt in the burning bush. May these rest on the head of Joseph and crown the brow of the prince of his brothers.
ekegusii: Abae ebinto ebiya korwa ase riroba, na ebiichire ime yaye, amo n’ogwancherwa gokorwa ase are ere oyobweorokereretie ase egetutu keria. Ogosesenigwa okwo kobe igoro y’Abayusufu, ekiagera Yusufu nigo achooretwe akaba omogambi ase egati y’abaamwabo.
swahili: pamoja na baraka nzuri mno za ardhi na ukamilifu wake, na upendeleo wake yeye aliyeishi kwenye kichaka kilichokuwa kinawaka moto. Hivi vyote na vikae juu ya kichwa cha Yosefu, juu ya paji la uso la aliye mkuu miongoni mwa ndugu zake.

english: His majesty is like a firstborn bull, and his horns are like those of a wild ox. With them he will gore the nations, even to the ends of the earth. Such are the myriads of Ephraim, and such are the thousands of Manasseh.”
ekegusii: Omotangi oye nigo are n’obonene bw’echinguru buna chieeri, ne ching’unchara chiaye nigo chire buna echi’eng’era, ase chirochio naseerie abanto goikera ase chinsinyo chionsi chi’ense. Echio nachio chilifu ikomi chi’Abaefraimu, naende echio nachio chilifu chinyinge chi’Abamanase.”
swahili: Katika fahari yeye ni kama fahali mzaliwa wa kwanza; pembe zake ni pembe za nyati, na kwa pembe hizo atapiga mataifa, hata yaliyo miisho ya dunia. Hivyo ndivyo yalivyo makumi elfu ya Efraimu; hivyo ndivyo yalivyo maelfu ya Manase.”

english: Concerning Zebulun he said: “Rejoice, Zebulun, in your journeys, and Issachar, in your tents.
ekegusii: Musa agakwana igoro y’Abasabuloni: “Inwe Abasabuloni, mogooke ekero mogosooka isiko, nainwe Abaisakaru, mogooke ase chiema chiaino ime.
swahili: Kuhusu Zabuloni akasema: “Shangilia, Zabuloni, wakati wa kutoka nje, nawe Isakari, katika mahema yako.

english: They will call the peoples to a mountain; there they will offer sacrifices of righteousness. For they will feast on the abundance of the seas and the hidden treasures of the sand.”
ekegusii: Barabwo ’mbarangerie abanto b’ebisaku bachiche ase egetunwa kiabo, aroro agwo ’nabarue ebing’wanso ebironge, ekiagera nigo bakonyora obotenenku bwabo korwa ase chinyancha ase chinibo chibisekanete ime y’omokenye.”
swahili: Watawaita mataifa kwenye mlima, na huko mtatoa dhabihu za haki; watajifurahisha kwa wingi uliojaza bahari, kwa hazina zilizofichwa mchangani.”

english: He said: “The LORD came from Sinai and dawned upon us from Seir; He shone forth from Mount Paran and came with myriads of holy ones, with flaming fire at His right hand.
ekegusii: Akabora: “Omonene agacha korwa Sinai, akabamorekera korwa Edomu, akabara buna risase korwa ase egetunwa gia Parani; agacha ore amo n’abachenu chilifu ikomi, ogochika kore buna chinsase chi’omorero gokabaachera korwa ase ensemo yaye y’okorio.
swahili: Alisema: “ Bwana alikuja kutoka Mlima Sinai, akachomoza kama jua juu yao kutoka Mlima Seiri, akaangaza kutoka Mlima Parani. Alikuja pamoja na watakatifu makumi elfu kutoka kusini, kutoka materemko ya mlima wake.

english: Concerning Gad he said: “Blessed is he who enlarges the domain of Gad! He lies down like a lion and tears off an arm or a head.
ekegusii: Agakwana igoro y’Abagadi: “Omonene abakwe, oria okogareyia orogongo rw’Abagadi. Abagadi nigo barabe bakoramama inse buna endo, batandora okoboko amo n’ekeore ki’omotwe.
swahili: Kuhusu Gadi akasema: “Atabarikiwa yeye aongezaye milki ya Gadi! Gadi huishi huko kama simba, akirarua kwenye mkono au kichwa.

english: He chose the best land for himself, because a ruler’s portion was reserved for him there. He came with the leaders of the people; he administered the LORD’s justice and His ordinances for Israel.”
ekegusii: Bageechoorera abanyene orogongo rwarenge oruya, ekiagera agwo nao egetari ki’omogaambi kiagachetwe. Bakaba amo n’abataang’ani b’ abanto, bakaba bagokora oboronge bw’Omonene na konacha ebiina bi’ekeene ase Abaisraeli.”
swahili: Alijichagulia nchi nzuri kuliko zote kwa ajili yake mwenyewe; fungu la kiongozi lilikuwa limehifadhiwa kwa ajili yake. Viongozi wa watu walipokusanyika, alitimiza haki ya mapenzi ya Bwana, na hukumu zake kuhusu Israeli.”

english: Concerning Dan he said: “Dan is a lion’s cub, leaping out of Bashan.”
ekegusii: Agakwana igoro y’Abadani: “Abadani nigo banga buna endo ensae egocharoka korwa Basani.”
swahili: Kuhusu Dani akasema: “Dani ni mwana simba, akiruka kutoka Bashani.”

english: Concerning Naphtali he said: “Naphtali is abounding with favor, full of the blessing of the LORD; he shall take possession of the sea and the south.”
ekegusii: Agakwana igoro y’Abanafutali: “Inwe Abanafutali nigo mwanyorire ogwancherwa okonge na ogosesenigwa kw’ogoisaneka korwa ase Omonene, moire orogongo rore ase enyancha ensemo ya Irianyi,”
swahili: Kuhusu Naftali akasema: “Naftali amejaa tele upendeleo wa Bwana, naye amejaa baraka yake; atarithi magharibi na kusini.”

english: And concerning Asher he said: “May Asher be the most blessed of sons; may he be the most favored among his brothers and dip his foot in oil.
ekegusii: Agakwana igoro y’Abaaseri: “Abaaseri basesenigwe kobua ebisaku binde. Tiga barabwo banchwe n’abaamwabo; amagoro abo atache riroba rikomera amazeituni.
swahili: Kuhusu Asheri akasema: “Aliyebarikiwa zaidi sana katika wana ni Asheri; yeye na apate upendeleo kwa ndugu zake, yeye na anawe miguu yake kwenye mafuta.

english: May the bolts of your gate be iron and bronze, and may your strength match your days.”
ekegusii: Emekorogoto y’ebiita biaino ebe ey’ebioma ne chitaai, na buna amatuko aino arabe, naboigo ne chinguru chiaino chiraabe.
swahili: Makomeo ya malango yako yawe chuma na shaba, nazo nguvu zako zitakuwa sawa na siku zako.

english: “There is none like the God of Jeshurun, who rides the heavens to your aid, and the clouds in His majesty.
ekegusii: “Aye Yesuruni, onde tari ore buna Nyasae oo, oria ogoeta igoro gati ase obonene bwaye goocha kogokoonya.
swahili: “Hakuna mwingine kama Mungu wa Yeshuruni, ambaye hupanda juu ya mbingu ili akusaidie, na juu ya mawingu katika utukufu wake.

english: The eternal God is your dwelling place, and underneath are the everlasting arms. He drives out the enemy before you, giving the command, ‘Destroy him!’
ekegusii: Nyasae o kare na kare nere ore obotamero bwaino; Inse aa nao amaboko aye a kare na kare are kogaamba. Naseerie ababisa baino korwa ase more, abateebie inwe: Basirie!
swahili: Mungu wa milele ni kimbilio lako, na chini kuna mikono ya milele. Atamfukuza adui yako mbele yako, akisema, ‘Mwangamize yeye!’

english: So Israel dwells securely; the fountain of Jacob lives untroubled in a land of grain and new wine, where even the heavens drip with dew.
ekegusii: Ase ayio Abaisraeli nigo baramenye batari n’obwoba, na ororeeria rorwete ase Yakobo nigo roramenye ase obotoereru, ase ense eichire endagera n’edivai ase riime rigotonya korwa igoro.
swahili: Hivyo Israeli ataishi salama peke yake. Mzao wa Yakobo ni salama katika nchi ya nafaka na divai mpya, mahali ambapo mbingu hudondosha umande.

english: Blessed are you, O Israel! Who is like you, a people saved by the LORD? He is the shield that protects you, the sword in which you boast. Your enemies will cower before you, and you shall trample their high places.”
ekegusii: Inwe Abaisraeli, imosesenirie! Inwe n’abanto mwatoorigwe n’Omonene. Nere enguba yaino ekobakengera; Nere omoro oino okobarentera obobui! Ababisa baino ’mbebeeke inse ase more, nainwe motaare goetera ase ebigoro biabo.”
swahili: Ee Israeli, wewe umebarikiwa! Ni nani kama wewe, taifa lililookolewa na Bwana? Yeye ni ngao yako na msaada wako, na upanga wako uliotukuka. Adui zako watatetemeka mbele yako, nawe utapakanyaga mahali pao pa juu.”

english: Surely You love the people; all the holy ones are in Your hand, and they sit down at Your feet; each receives Your words—
ekegusii: Amaene, nigo anchete abanto b’ebisaku bionsi; abachenu baye bonsi nigo bare ase oborendi bw’okoboko kwaye. Barabwo nigo baikaraansete inse ase amagoro yo Omonene, borokererigwe amang’ana aye.
swahili: Hakika ni wewe ambaye huwapenda watu, watakatifu wako wote wamo mkononi mwako. Miguuni pako wote wanasujudu na kutoka kwako wanapokea mafundisho,

english: the law that Moses gave us, the possession of the assembly of Jacob.
ekegusii: Musa agatoa amachiiko, ayio are omwando bw’omosangererekano bw’ abanto ba Yakobo.
swahili: sheria ile Mose aliyotupa sisi, tulio milki ya kusanyiko la Yakobo.

english: So the LORD became King in Jeshurun when the leaders of the people gathered, when the tribes of Israel came together.
ekegusii: Omonene akaba omorwoti o Yesuruni ekero abatang’ani b’ abanto basangererekanete amo n’abanto b’ebisaku bi’Abaisraeli.”
swahili: Alikuwa mfalme juu ya Yeshuruni wakati viongozi wa watu walipokusanyika, pamoja na makabila ya Israeli.

english: Let Reuben live and not die, nor his men be few.”
ekegusii: Musa agakwana: “Tiga Abareubeni bagenderere koba moyo, tibaabaisa gokwa, nonya abanto abwo bare abake.”
swahili: “Reubeni na aishi, asife, wala watu wake wasiwe wachache.”

english: And concerning Judah he said: “O LORD, hear the cry of Judah and bring him to his people. With his own hands he defends his cause, but may You be a help against his foes.”
ekegusii: Agakwana igoro y’Abayuda: “Aye Omonene, igwa okorera kw’Abayuda, obairanie naende babe amo n’abanto bamwabo. Berwanerere boka n’amaboko abo, obakonye ekero ababisa baabo bakobarwania.”
swahili: Akasema hili kuhusu Yuda: “Ee Bwana, sikia kilio cha Yuda, mlete kwa watu wake. Kwa mikono yake mwenyewe hujitetea. Naam, uwe msaada wake dhidi ya adui zake!”

english: Concerning Levi he said: “Give Your Thummim to Levi and Your Urim to Your godly one, whom You tested at Massah and contested at the waters of Meribah.
ekegusii: Agakwana igoro y’Abalawi: “Omonene, obamaanorere babe nobomanyi goetera ase Tumimu na Urimu, ekiagera barabwo nabeegenwa bao bare. Aye’ nkwabateemete aria Masa. ’Nkwaamereranetie nabarabwo ase amaache a Meriba.
swahili: Kuhusu Lawi alisema: “Thumimu yako na Urimu yako ulimpa, mtu yule uliyemfadhili. Ulimjaribu huko Masa na kushindana naye kwenye maji ya Meriba.

english: He said of his father and mother, ‘I do not consider them.’ He disregarded his brothers and did not know his own sons, for he kept Your word and maintained Your covenant.
ekegusii: Barabwo nigo bakwanete igoro y’abaise na abaang’ina, ng’a tibaabarooche, bagatigana n’abaamwabo, gose tibaabarete abana babo ng’a ’mbare nengeencho ase bare, ekiagera baigwete ring’ana ria’o, bakabwata okobwatana kw’ogotianania gwakorete na barabwo.
swahili: Alinena hivi kuhusu baba yake na mama yake, ‘Mimi siwahitaji kamwe.’ Akawasahau jamaa zake, asiwatambue hata watoto wake, lakini akaliangalia neno lako na kulilinda Agano lako.

english: Then Moses went up from the plains of Moab to Mount Nebo, to the top of Pisgah, which faces Jericho. And the LORD showed him the whole land—from Gilead as far as Dan,
ekegusii: Musa akarua emieya ya Moabu, agatiira gochia ase egetunwa kia Nebo igoro ase egechuuria gia Pisiga, kororia Yeriko. Omonene akamworokia ense eria yonsi, ense ya Gileadi goika orogongo rwa Dani,
swahili: Kisha Mose akaupanda mlima Nebo kutoka tambarare za Moabu mpaka kilele cha Pisga, ngʼambo ya Yeriko. Huko Bwana akamwonyesha nchi yote: kutoka Gileadi mpaka Dani,

english: Since that time, no prophet has risen in Israel like Moses, whom the LORD knew face to face—
ekegusii: Korwa engaki eyio mobani onde tana gotooka ase Abaisraeli onga buna Musa, oyi’Omonene arenge gokwana nere obosio ase obosio.
swahili: Tangu wakati huo, katika Israeli hajainuka nabii mwingine kama Mose, ambaye Bwana alimjua uso kwa uso,

english: no prophet who did all the signs and wonders that the LORD sent Moses to do in the land of Egypt to Pharaoh and to all his officials and all his land,
ekegusii: Onde tana gotooka okorete ebikone buna ebi Omonene atomete Musa kobikora ase ense ya Misiri, na ase Farao amo n’abasomba baye, na ense yaye yonsi.
swahili: aliyetenda ishara zote zile za miujiza na maajabu ambayo Bwana alimtuma kuyatenda huko Misri, yaani kwa Farao na maafisa wake wote na nchi yake yote.

english: and no prophet who performed all the mighty acts of power and awesome deeds that Moses did in the sight of all Israel.
ekegusii: Mobani onde tari okorete ogokora gwe chinguru chinene, na ogokora okonene, na gw’okoondokia okwo Musa aorogetie ase amaiso y’Abaisraeli bonsi.
swahili: Kwa kuwa hakuna mtu yeyote aliyewahi kuonyesha nguvu nyingi ama kutenda matendo ya kutisha ambayo Mose aliwahi kuyafanya mbele ya Israeli yote.

english: all of Naphtali, the land of Ephraim and Manasseh, all the land of Judah as far as the Western Sea,
ekegusii: na orogongo rwonsi rwa Nafutali, na orwa Efraimu, na orwa Manase, na orwa Yuda rwonsi goika Enyancha Enene ya bosongo,
swahili: Naftali yote, nchi ya Efraimu na Manase, nchi yote ya Yuda mpaka bahari ya magharibi,

english: the Negev, and the region from the Valley of Jericho (the City of Palms) all the way to Zoar.
ekegusii: na Negebu, na ense omweya ya Yeriko, Omochie bw’Emekendo, na goika Soari.
swahili: Negebu na nchi yote kuanzia Bonde la Yeriko, Mji wa Mitende, hadi Soari.

english: And the LORD said to him, “This is the land that I swore to give Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob when I said, ‘I will give it to your descendants.’ I have let you see it with your own eyes, but you will not cross into it.”
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene akamoteebia Musa, “Eye nero ense eria narierete Aburaamu, na Isaka, na Yakobo eira ng’a ning’ee ororeeria rwabo ebe eyabo. Inche nigo nakoeire ribaga oyerore namaiso ao, korende tokonyaara kwamboka gochia aroro.”
swahili: Kisha Bwana akamwambia, “Hii ndiyo nchi niliyomwahidi Abrahamu na Isaki na Yakobo kwa kiapo niliposema, ‘Nitawapa wazao wako.’ Nimekuruhusu uione kwa macho yako, lakini hutavuka kuingia.”

english: So Moses the servant of the LORD died there in the land of Moab, as the LORD had said.
ekegusii: Musa, omosomba bw’Omonene, agakwera agwo ase ense ya Moabu, buna Omonene ateebete.
swahili: Naye Mose mtumishi wa Bwana akafa huko Moabu, kama Bwana alivyokuwa amesema.

english: And He buried him in a valley in the land of Moab facing Beth-peor, and no one to this day knows the location of his grave.
ekegusii: Omonene akamotindeka agwo ase rikura ri’ense ya Moabu kororia Beti‐Peori; korende goika reero iga monto onde tari omanyete embeera yaye.
swahili: Mungu akamzika huko Moabu, katika bonde mkabala na Beth-Peori, lakini hakuna ajuaye kaburi lake lilipo mpaka leo.

english: Moses was a hundred and twenty years old when he died, yet his eyes were not weak, and his vitality had not diminished.
ekegusii: Musa ekero akwete konya omenyire emiaka rigana erimo, na merongo ebere, korende amaiso aye konya tarasareka, gose chinguru chiaye konya tichiramoerera
swahili: Mose alikuwa na umri wa miaka mia moja na ishirini alipofariki; hata hivyo nguvu ya macho yake haikufifia wala mwili wake haukudhoofika.

english: The Israelites grieved for Moses in the plains of Moab thirty days, until the time of weeping and mourning for Moses came to an end.
ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakamoreera ase engaki y’amatuko emerongo etato agwo ase emieya ya Moabu, na magega y’ayio amatuko okomoreera na kobokia amagombo ase engencho yaye akaera.
swahili: Waisraeli wakaomboleza kwa ajili ya Mose kwenye tambarare za Moabu kwa siku thelathini, mpaka wakati wa kulia na kuomboleza ulipopita.

english: Now Joshua son of Nun was filled with the spirit of wisdom because Moses had laid his hands on him. So the Israelites obeyed him and did as the LORD had commanded Moses.
ekegusii: Yoshua, mosinto o Nuni, nigo aichire n’Omoika bw’obong’aini, ekiagera Musa konya omobeekeire amaboko aye na Abaisraeli bakaba bakomoigwera, bagakora buna Omonene konya achiikire Musa.
swahili: Basi Yoshua mwana wa Nuni alijazwa roho ya hekima kwa sababu Mose alikuwa ameweka mikono yake juu yake. Kwa hiyo Waisraeli wakamsikiliza na wakafanya yale ambayo Bwana alikuwa amemwagiza Mose.

english: Then we turned and went up the road to Bashan, and Og king of Bashan and his whole army came out to meet us in battle at Edrei.
ekegusii: “Magega y’ayio tokaonchoka, togatiira gochia sugusu gochia ase orogongo rwa Basani. Ogi, omorwoti o Basani, amo n’abanto baye bonsi, bagaacha gotorwania esegi agwo ase omochie o Edirei.
swahili: Kisha tukageuka tukakwea kufuata njia iliyoelekea Bashani, Ogu mfalme wa Bashani akaondoka na jeshi lake lote kupigana na sisi huko Edrei.

english: all the cities of the plateau, all of Gilead, and all of Bashan as far as the cities of Salecah and Edrei in the kingdom of Og.
ekegusii: Tokaira orogongo rwonsi orwo rwarenge inse y’omorwoti Ogi o Basani: emechie yonsi yarenge ase ense eraire eimokererete igoro na Gileadi yonsi, na Basani yonsi, goikera Saleka na Edirei.”
swahili: Tuliteka miji yote kwenye uwanda wa juu, Gileadi yote, Bashani yote mpaka kufika Saleka na Edrei, miji ya utawala wa Ogu huko Bashani.

english: (For only Og king of Bashan had remained of the remnant of the Rephaim. His bed of iron, nine cubits long and four cubits wide, is still in Rabbah of the Ammonites.) Land Division East of the Jordan (Numbers 32:1–42; Joshua 13:8–14)
ekegusii: (Ogi, omorwoti o Basani, nere orenge oyobwomoerio ase Abarefai. Esanduki yaye y’ogotindekerwa eyaroiseirie ebioma, nigo yarenge chimita inye ase obotambe boigo n’echimita ibere ase obogare koreng’ana nokorenga kwa boronge. Nao ere agwo Raba, omochie bw’Abaamoni.) Ebisaku biamenyete Moocha ya Yorodani (Omob 32:1-42)
swahili: (Mfalme Ogu wa Bashani ndiye peke yake aliyesalia miongoni mwa mabaki ya Warefai. Kitanda chake kilikuwa cha chuma chenye urefu wa dhiraa tisa na upana wa dhiraa nne. Mpaka sasa kinaweza kuonekana katika mji wa Waamoni wa Raba.) Mgawanyo Wa Nchi Mashariki Ya Yordani (Hesabu 32:1-42)

english: So at that time we took possession of this land. To the Reubenites and Gadites I gave the land beyond Aroer along the Arnon Valley, and half the hill country of Gilead, along with its cities.
ekegusii: “Ekero twairete ense eria ekaba eyaito, ’nkaa abanto b’egesaku kia Rubeni, na ekia Gadi, orogongo roria rogochaakera ase omochie bw’Aroeri, rore ang’e norooche rw’Arinoni amo n’ekeng’ese gi’ense y’ebitunwa ya Gileadi, na emechie yarengeo.
swahili: Katika nchi tuliyoiteka wakati ule, niliwapa kabila la Reubeni na Gadi eneo lililoko kaskazini la Aroeri kando ya Bonde la Arnoni, na nusu ya eneo la milima ya Gileadi, pamoja na miji yake.

english: To the half-tribe of Manasseh I gave the rest of Gilead and all of Bashan, the kingdom of Og. (The entire region of Argob, the whole territory of Bashan, used to be called the land of the Rephaim.)
ekegusii: Nkaa ekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase ensemo yatigarete ase ense ya Gileadi, amo na Basani yonsi, eyio yarenge obogaambi bwa Ogi. Orwo narwo orogongo rwonsi rw’Arigobu.” (Basani yonsi nigo yarenge korokwa ense ya Refaimu.
swahili: Kisha nusu ya kabila la Manase niliwapa sehemu ya Gileadi iliyobaki pamoja na Bashani yote, ambayo ilikuwa utawala wa Ogu. (Eneo lote la Argobu katika Bashani lilikuwa linajulikana kama nchi ya Warefai.

english: Jair, a descendant of Manasseh, took the whole region of Argob as far as the border of the Geshurites and Maacathites. He renamed Bashan after himself, Havvoth-jair, by which it is called to this day.
ekegusii: Yairi, omonto bw’ororeeria rwa Manase, akaira orogongo rwonsi rw’Arigobu, narwo Basani, goika orogongo rw’Abagesuri na Abamaaka. Akaroka emechie yarengeo ase erieta riaye, Emechie ya Yairi, nabo ekorokwa goika reero iga.)
swahili: Yairi, mzao wa kabila la Manase, alichukua eneo lote la nchi ya Argobu hadi kufikia mpaka wa Wageshuri na Wamaaka, ukaitwa kwa jina lake; kwa hiyo mpaka leo hii Bashani inaitwa Hawoth-Yairi.)

english: To Machir I gave Gilead,
ekegusii: “Nkaa abanto b’eamate ya Makiri, orogongo rwa Gileadi,
swahili: Nikampa Makiri nchi ya Gileadi.

english: and to the Reubenites and Gadites I gave the territory from Gilead to the Arnon Valley (the middle of the valley was the border) and up to the Jabbok River, the border of the Ammonites.
ekegusii: na abanto b’egesaku kia Rubeni na ab’egesaku kia Gadi ’nkabaa orogongo gochakera Gileadi goikera orooche rw’Arinoni. Egati‐gati y’orooche orwo ekaba orobebe rwabo rw’enseemo ya Irianyi, na orooche rwa Yaboki rokaba orobebe rwabo sugusu, orwarenge orobebe rw’Abaamoni.
swahili: Lakini niliwapa Wareubeni na Wagadi eneo kuanzia Gileadi hadi Bonde la Arnoni (katikati ya bonde ulikuwa ndio mpaka), kuelekea mpaka Mto Yaboki, ambao ndio mpaka wa Waamoni.

english: The Jordan River in the Arabah bordered it from Chinnereth to the Sea of the Arabah (the Salt Sea ) with the slopes of Pisgah to the east.
ekegusii: Bakanyora orogongo rwe rikura ria Yorodani. Orwo rokaba orobebe rwabo rwa bosongo, korwa ase enyancha ya Kinereti, ensemo ya sugusu, goika ase orogongo rwe nyacha y’omoonyo, ensemo ya Irianyi inse y’ebitirimboko bia Pisiga, ensemo ya moocha.
swahili: Kwa upande wa magharibi mpaka wao ulikuwa Yordani katika Araba, toka ziwa Galilaya hadi Bahari ya Araba (yaani Bahari ya Chumvi), kwenye miteremko ya Pisga upande wa mashariki.

english: At that time I commanded you: “The LORD your God has given you this land to possess. All your men of valor are to cross over, armed for battle, ahead of your brothers, the Israelites.
ekegusii: “Ase engaki eria inche ’nkabachiika, nkabateebia: Omonene Nyasae oino, obaeire ense eye, ebe eyaino. Ase ayio abarwani baino bonsi, baria bare chituoni, baimokie ebirwanero biabo bi’eseegi, bagende bamboke gochia ng’umbu ya Yorodani, batang’anere Abaisraeli bamwabo.
swahili: Wakati huo nilikuamuru: “ Bwana Mungu wako amekupa nchi hii uimiliki. Lakini ni lazima wanaume wenu wote wenye uwezo, wakiwa wamejiandaa tayari kwa vita, wavuke ngʼambo wakiwatangulia ndugu zako Waisraeli.

english: But your wives, your children, and your livestock—I know that you have much livestock—may remain in the cities I have given you,
ekegusii: “Korende abakungu baino n’abana, barabwo batigare amo ne’chitugo chiaino ase emechie eyio nabaeire. (Nimanyete ng’a nigo mobwate chitugo chinyinge.)
swahili: Lakini wake zenu, watoto wenu na mifugo yenu (kwani najua mnayo mifugo mingi) wanaweza kukaa katika miji niliyowapa,

english: But the LORD said to me, “Do not fear him, for I have delivered him into your hand, along with all his people and his land. Do to him as you did to Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived in Heshbon.”
ekegusii: Korende Omonene aganteebia: Tobaisa komoiroka, ekiagera ere amo n’abanto baye bonsi nababeekire ase amaboko ao, boigo nakoeire ense yaye. Nomokore buna gwakorete Sihoni, omorwoti bw’Abaamori, oria orenge kogaamba agwo Hesiboni.
swahili: Bwana akaniambia, “Usimwogope kwa kuwa nimekwisha mkabidhi mikononi mwako pamoja na jeshi lake lote na nchi yake. Umfanyie sawasawa na ulivyomfanyia Sihoni mfalme wa Waamori, ambaye alitawala huko Heshboni.”

english: until the LORD gives rest to your brothers as He has to you, and they too have taken possession of the land that the LORD your God is giving them across the Jordan. Then each of you may return to the possession I have given you.”
ekegusii: Mokonye Abaisraeli bamino goika banyore ense eri’Omonene, arabae ng’umbu ya Yorodani na goika Omonene abae barabwo omorembe buna abaete inwe iga. Nyuma yayio ’namoirane gocha ase ense eye nabaeire inwe.
swahili: mpaka hapo Bwana atakapowapa ndugu zenu kupumzika kama alivyowapa ninyi, wao pia wamiliki ile nchi ambayo Bwana Mungu wenu anawapa, ngʼambo ya Yordani. Baada ya hapo, kila mmoja wenu anaweza kurudi kwenye milki niliyowapa.” Mose Akatazwa Kuvuka Yordani

english: And at that time I commanded Joshua: “Your own eyes have seen all that the LORD your God has done to these two kings. The LORD will do the same to all the kingdoms you are about to enter.
ekegusii: “Ase ekero keria ’ngachiika Yoshua, ’nkamoteebia: ’Nkwarooche amang’ana onsi ay’Omonene, Nyasae oino, akorerete abarwoti baria babere Sihoni na Ogi; Naboigo arakorere kera oyomo ase ense oraabe kogosoa.
swahili: Wakati huo nilimwamuru Yoshua, “Umejionea kwa macho yako mwenyewe yale yote ambayo Bwana Mungu wenu amewafanyia wafalme hawa wawili. Bwana atazifanyia falme zote huko mnakokwenda vivyo hivyo.

english: At that time I also pleaded with the LORD:
ekegusii: “Ase engaki eria ’ngasaba mono,
swahili: Wakati huo nilimsihi Bwana:

english: “O Lord GOD, You have begun to show Your greatness and power to Your servant. For what god in heaven or on earth can perform such works and mighty acts as Yours?
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, bono kwanyorokirie inche, omosomba oo, omochakano bwoka bw’obonene bwao, n’okoboko kwao gwechinguru. Enyasae ende teri, igoro gose ase ense, eranyaare gokora emeremo emenene na eyechinguru buna ey’ogokora aye.
swahili: “Ee Bwana Mwenyezi, umemwonyesha mtumishi wako ukuu wako na mkono wako wenye uweza. Kwa kuwa ni mungu yupi aliye mbinguni au duniani anayeweza kufanya kazi na matendo makuu kama ufanyayo wewe?

english: Please let me cross over and see the good land beyond the Jordan—that pleasant hill country as well as Lebanon!”
ekegusii: Nagosabire, koranche aye Omonene ong’e ribaga nyamboke gochia ng’umbu ya Yorodani, indore ense eria engiya y’ebitunwa amo na Lebanoni.
swahili: Acha niende nikaione hiyo nchi nzuri ngʼambo ya Yordani, ile nchi nzuri ya vilima na Lebanoni.”

english: But the LORD was angry with me on account of you, and He would not listen to me. “That is enough,” the LORD said to me. “Do not speak to Me again about this matter.
ekegusii: “Korende ase engencho yaino inwe Omonene akaba n’endamwamu ase ’nde tanchete koigwa okoboria kwane. Korende aganteebia: Ayio aisanire! Tobaisa gokwana nainche gento kende igoro ye ring’ana erio.
swahili: Lakini kwa sababu yenu Bwana alinikasirikia na hakutaka kunisikiliza. Bwana aliniambia, “Hilo latosha; usiseme nami jambo hili tena.

english: Go to the top of Pisgah and look to the west and north and south and east. See the land with your own eyes, for you will not cross this Jordan.
ekegusii: Tiira gochia igoro ase egentunwa gia Pisiga, otenene ase egechuuria kiaye, oimokie amaiso ao, origererie gochia ensemo ya bosongo, na sugusu, na Irianyi, na moocha, origererie buya ense eria orarore, ekiagera tokonyaara kwamboka ng’umbu ya Yorodani.
swahili: Kwea juu ya kilele cha Pisga uangalie magharibi, kaskazini, kusini na mashariki. Iangalie hiyo nchi kwa macho yako, kwa vile wewe hutavuka Yordani.

english: But commission Joshua, encourage him, and strengthen him, for he will cross over ahead of the people and enable them to inherit the land that you will see.”
ekegusii: Tebereria Yoshua, omoremie na omobeeke chinguru, ekiagera nere oraraae abanto aba, abaambokie ng’umbu, ense eyio orarore.
swahili: Lakini mwagize Yoshua, mtie moyo na umtie nguvu, kwa kuwa yeye atawaongoza watu hawa hadi ngʼambo na kuwarithisha nchi utakayoiona.”

english: So we stayed in the valley opposite Beth-peor.
ekegusii: “Ase ayio tokabeera ase rikura riarochie omochie o Beti‐Peori.”
swahili: Kwa hiyo tulikaa kwenye bonde karibu na Beth-Peori.

english: So the LORD our God also delivered Og king of Bashan and his whole army into our hands. We struck them down until no survivor was left.
ekegusii: “Ase ayio Omonene akabeeka omorwoti Ogi, amo n’abanto baye bonsi, ase amaboko aito, erio tokabaita bonsi pi, nonya n’oyomo tatigara ore moyo.
swahili: Hivyo Bwana Mungu wetu pia akamweka Ogu mfalme wa Bashani pamoja na jeshi lake lote mikononi mwetu. Tuliwaangamiza wote, hakubakia hata mmoja.

english: At that time we captured all sixty of his cities. There was not a single city we failed to take—the entire region of Argob, the kingdom of Og in Bashan.
ekegusii: Boigo tokaira emechie yaye yonsi ase engaki eria. Titwatigete nonya n’omochie oyomo totairete. Emechie yonsi twairete nigo yarenge emerongo etano nomo, tokaira orogongo rwonsi rw’Arigobu, ase Ogi, Omorwoti o Basani, arenge kogaamba.
swahili: Wakati huo tuliteka miji yake yote. Hakuna mji hata mmoja kati ya ile sitini ambao hatukuuteka, yaani eneo lote la Argobu, utawala wa Mfalme Ogu katika Bashani.

english: All these cities were fortified with high walls and gates and bars, and there were many more unwalled villages.
ekegusii: Emechie eyio yonsi nigo yagiteire chindwaki chintambe gochia igoro, na ebiita biarenge gosiekwa n’emekorogoto; naboigo ebichie ebinge mbiarengeo bitagiteire chindwaki.
swahili: Miji yote hii ilijengewa ngome zenye kuta ndefu zenye malango na makomeo, pia kulikuwako na vijiji vingi ambavyo havikujengewa kuta.

english: We devoted them to destruction, as we had done to Sihon king of Heshbon, utterly destroying the men, women, and children of every city.
ekegusii: Togasaria emechie eyio yonsi, togaita abanto bonsi, abasacha n’abakuungu, na abana, buna twakorete ase emechie ya Sihoni, omorwoti o Hesiboni.
swahili: Tuliwaangamiza kabisa, kama tulivyomfanyia Sihoni mfalme wa Heshboni, tukiangamiza kila mji, yaani wanaume, wanawake na watoto.

english: But all the livestock and plunder of the cities we carried off for ourselves.
ekegusii: Tokaira chitugo chionsi na gosakora ebinto biarenge ase emechie eyio bikaba ebiaito.
swahili: Lakini wanyama wote wa kufuga pamoja na nyara kutoka kwenye miji yao tulichukua vikawa vyetu.

english: At that time we took from the two kings of the Amorites the land across the Jordan, from the Arnon Valley as far as Mount Hermon—
ekegusii: “Ase engaki eria tokaira ense y’abarwoti baria babere b’Abaamori, ense yarenge moocha y’orooche rwa Yorodani, gochaakera orooche rw’Arinoni goikera egetunwa kia Herimoni.
swahili: Hivyo kwa wakati huo tukachukua kutoka kwa wafalme hawa wawili wa Waamori nchi ya mashariki ya Yordani, kutoka Bonde la Arnoni mpaka kufika kwenye Mlima Hermoni.

english: which the Sidonians call Sirion but the Amorites call Senir—
ekegusii: (Abanto ba Sidoni nigo bakoroka egetunwa kia Herimoni Sirioni, na Abaamori nigo bagokeroka Seniri.)
swahili: (Wasidoni huuita mlima huo Sirioni, nao Waamori huuita Seniri.)

english: Hear now, O Israel, the statutes and ordinances I am teaching you to follow, so that you may live and may enter and take possession of the land that the LORD, the God of your fathers, is giving you.
ekegusii: Naende Musa agakwana, “Inwe Abaisraeli, bono igwera amachiiko na emeroberio ’nkoborokereria, moyakore, erio nario moraabe moyo, erinde mogende moire ense eria, Omonene, Nyasae bw’echisokoro chiaino, agochia kobaa.
swahili: Sikia sasa, ee Israeli, amri na sheria nitakazokufundisha wewe. Zifuate ili upate kuishi na uingie kuimiliki nchi ambayo Bwana, Mungu wa baba zako anawapa.

english: The day you stood before the LORD your God at Horeb, the LORD said to me, “Gather the people before Me to hear My words, so that they may learn to fear Me all the days they live on the earth, and that they may teach them to their children.”
ekegusii: erinde bamanye ayakoregete ase rituko riria mwatenenete ase obosio bw’Omonene Nyasae oino, agwo Horebu, ekero Omonene akwanete nainche, aganteebia: Sangereria abanto bonsi amo, na inche mbateebie amang’ana, erinde beorokererie konyiroka ase amatuko onsi barabe bare moyo ase ense, nabarabwo baborokererie abana babo boigo.
swahili: Kumbuka siku uliyosimama mbele za Bwana Mungu wako kule Horebu, wakati aliponiambia, “Wakutanishe watu mbele yangu wasikie maneno yangu ili kwamba waweze kujifunza kuniheshimu kwa muda wote watakaoishi katika nchi, nao waweze kuwafundisha watoto wao maneno hayo.”

english: You came near and stood at the base of the mountain, a mountain blazing with fire to the heavens, with black clouds and deep darkness.
ekegusii: “Inwe nigo mwachete ang’e, mogatenena ase egetunwa keria mbarabare, ekero kiagendererete gwoka omorero oria ochongororogete gochia igoro obwate erioki rimwamu ti, na amare, n’omosunte omonene.
swahili: Mlisogea karibu na mkasimama chini ya mlima wakati ulipowaka moto mpaka mbinguni juu, pamoja na mawingu meusi na giza nene.

english: And the LORD spoke to you out of the fire. You heard the sound of the words, but saw no form; there was only a voice.
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene agakwana nainwe korwa ase omorero oria ime, mokaigwa amang’ana aye, korende timwarooche ekieni kiaye. Nigo mwaigwete eriogi rioka.
swahili: Ndipo Bwana alipozungumza nanyi kutoka moto. Mkasikia sauti ya maneno lakini hamkuona umbo, kulikuwa na sauti tu.

english: He declared to you His covenant, which He commanded you to follow—the Ten Commandments that He wrote on two tablets of stone.
ekegusii: Omonene akaborokereria okobwatana kwaye kw’ogotianania, akabachiika mokobwate; okwo nakwo amachiiko aye ikomi. Akayariika ase chibao ibere chi’amagena.
swahili: Aliwatangazia Agano lake na Amri Kumi, ambazo aliwaamuru mzifuate, kisha akaziandika juu ya vibao viwili vya mawe.

english: At that time the LORD commanded me to teach you the statutes and ordinances you are to follow in the land that you are crossing the Jordan to possess. A Warning against Idolatry (Deuteronomy 12:29–32; Ezekiel 6:1–7)
ekegusii: Aroro agwo Omonene aganchiika ng’a imborokererie amachiiko ayio, na emeroberio echiikire, erinde monyaare koyaigwera ase ense eria mokogeenda koira. Ogokuurera kw’ogotasasiima emegwekano y’ogosasiimwa
swahili: Naye Bwana alinielekeza wakati huo kuwafundisha ninyi sheria na amri ambazo mnapaswa kuzifuata katika nchi ambayo mnavuka Yordani kuimiliki. Kuabudu Sanamu Kwakatazwa

english: So since you saw no form of any kind on the day the LORD spoke to you out of the fire at Horeb, be careful
ekegusii: “Ekero Omonene akwanete nainwe korwa ase omorero ime agwo Horebu, timwarooche ekieni kiaye. Ase ayio moigwere na kwerenda,
swahili: Hamkuona umbo la aina yoyote siku ambayo Bwana alizungumza nanyi kule Horebu kutoka kwenye moto. Kwa hiyo mjihadhari kwa uangalifu sana,

english: that you do not act corruptly and make an idol for yourselves of any form or shape, whether in the likeness of a male or female,
ekegusii: timobaisa gokora ebibe na gwesaria ase okoroisia omogwekano bw’ogosasiimwa, omogwekano onde bwensi ogwekaine omonto, omosacha gose omokungu,
swahili: ili msije mkajichafua na kujitengenezea sanamu au kinyago chenye umbo lolote kama la mwanaume au mwanamke,

english: of any beast that is on the earth or bird that flies in the air,
ekegusii: gose omogwekano ogwekaine eng’iti ende yonsi ere ase ense, gose oyo bw’enyoni ebwate chimbaaba ekoiruruka igoro,
swahili: au kama mnyama aliye juu ya nchi au ndege yeyote arukaye angani,

english: or of any creature that crawls on the ground or fish that is in the waters below.
ekegusii: gose oyo bw’eng’iti ekwagura ase riroba, gose oyo bw’enswe ende yonsi ere ime ase amaache inse y’ense.
swahili: au kama kiumbe kitambaacho juu ya ardhi au samaki yeyote aliye ndani ya maji.

english: When you look to the heavens and see the sun and moon and stars—all the host of heaven—do not be enticed to bow down and worship what the LORD your God has apportioned to all the nations under heaven.
ekegusii: Ekero okorigereria gochia igoro, gokorora ebinto bitongire bireo buna risase, na omotienyi, ne ching’enang’eni, omoganda oyio bwonsi, tobaisa gotiga Omonene, erinde osasiime na gokorera ebinto ebio, ekiagera Omonene, Nyasae oo, obirure ase ebisaku bionsi bire inse y’erioba.
swahili: Na utazamapo juu angani na ukaliona jua, mwezi na nyota na vyote vinavyoipamba mbingu, usije ukashawishiwa kuviinamia na kuviabudu vile ambavyo Bwana Mungu wenu alivyogawia mataifa yote chini ya mbingu.

english: You must not add to or subtract from what I command you, so that you may keep the commandments of the LORD your God that I am giving you.
ekegusii: Timomenta ring’ana rinde rionsi ase aria nabachiikire, gose timorusia gento aroro. Mobwate amachiiko y’Omonene, Nyasae oino, ayio inche nabaeire.
swahili: Usiongeze wala usipunguze chochote ninachowaamuru ninyi, ila myashike maagizo ya Bwana Mungu wenu ambayo nawapa.

english: Yet the LORD has taken you and brought you out of the iron furnace, out of Egypt, to be the people of His inheritance, as you are today.
ekegusii: Korende inwe Omonene obarusirie ase eriiko ri’ebioma rigosamba, nario Misiri, erinde mobe abanto baye ere omonyene buna more goika reero iga.
swahili: Lakini kwenu ninyi, Bwana amewatoa kutoka kwenye tanuru ya kuyeyushia chuma, katika Misri kuwa watu wa urithi wake kama mlivyo sasa.

english: The LORD, however, was angry with me on account of you, and He swore that I would not cross the Jordan to enter the good land that the LORD your God is giving you as an inheritance.
ekegusii: Kobua ayio Omonene nigo abeete ase engencho yaino, agatiana ng’a inche tinkonyaara kwamboka orooche rwa Yorodani, na kogeenda ase ense eria engiy’Omonene Nyasae oino, agochia kobaa, ebe omwando oino.
swahili: Bwana alinikasirikia kwa sababu yenu na akaapa kwamba sitavuka Yordani kuingia katika nchi nzuri Bwana Mungu wenu anayowapa kuwa urithi wenu.

english: For I will not be crossing the Jordan, because I must die in this land. But you shall cross over and take possession of that good land.
ekegusii: Inche goika ’nkwere aiga ase orogongo oro: ting’eiri ribaga kwamboka Yorodani, korende ninwe moramboke, erinde moire ense eria engiya.
swahili: Nitakufa katika nchi hii; sitavuka Yordani, lakini ninyi ni karibu mvuke mkaimiliki ile nchi nzuri.

english: Be careful that you do not forget the covenant of the LORD your God that He made with you; do not make an idol for yourselves in the form of anything He has forbidden you.
ekegusii: Moigwere na kwerenda, timobaisa kweba okobwatana kw’ogotianania, okw’Omonene Nyasae oino, akorete nainwe; timobaisa koroisia omogwekano onde bwensi mogosasiima. Omonene Nyasae oino, obakanirie ayio.
swahili: Jihadharini msilisahau Agano la Bwana Mungu wenu lile alilofanya nanyi; msijitengenezee sanamu katika umbo la kitu chochote ambacho Bwana Mungu wenu amewakataza.

english: For the LORD your God is a consuming fire, a jealous God.
ekegusii: Omonene Nyasae oino, nigo are omorero ogosamba na gosiria; ere nere Nyasae bwe risemi.
swahili: Kwa kuwa Bwana Mungu wenu ni moto ulao, Mungu mwenye wivu.

english: After you have children and grandchildren and you have been in the land a long time, if you then act corruptly and make an idol of any form—doing evil in the sight of the LORD your God and provoking Him to anger—
ekegusii: “Komogochia koibora abana na abaachokoro, naende komenya amatuko amaange ase ense eyio; timokora ebibe na gwesaria ase okoroisia omogwekano onde bwensi mogosasiima gose gokora amabe ase obosio bw’Omonene Nyasae oino. Moise gokora ayio, rirorio nigo moramogeechie abe n’endamwamu ase more.
swahili: Baada ya kuwa na watoto na wajukuu na kuishi katika nchi hiyo siku nyingi, tena kama mkijichafua na kutengeneza sanamu ya aina yoyote, mkifanya maovu machoni pa Bwana Mungu wenu na kumfanya awe na hasira,

english: I call heaven and earth as witnesses against you this day that you will quickly perish from the land that you are crossing the Jordan to possess. You will not live long upon it, but will be utterly destroyed.
ekegusii: Onye timokoigwera, inche ’nkorangeria inde igoro na ense chibe birori ase more reero ng’a, goika mosire kegima ase obwango. Timokomenya amatuko amaange ase ense eyio mogochia koira, ekero moramboke Yorodani.
swahili: ninaziita mbingu na nchi kama mashahidi dhidi yenu siku hii kwamba mtaangamia mara moja kutoka nchi ile ambayo mnavuka Yordani kuimiliki. Hamtaishi kule kwa muda mrefu bali kwa hakika mtaangamizwa.

english: Then the LORD will scatter you among the peoples, and only a few of you will survive among the nations to which the LORD will drive you.
ekegusii: Omonene nabasiarere ase egati y’ abanto b’ebisaku binde, nainwe abamoratigare n’abake ase omobaro, namomenye ase egati y’ abanto baria ase Omonene arabaire.
swahili: Bwana atawatawanya miongoni mwa mataifa, na ni wachache wenu tu watakaosalia miongoni mwa mataifa hayo ambayo Bwana atawafukuzia.

english: And there you will serve man-made gods of wood and stone, which cannot see or hear or eat or smell.
ekegusii: Agwo ase morasiarerwe gochia, ’namobe mogosasiima chinyasae chiroisirie korwa ase emete na amagena, emeremo y’amaboko a Mwanyabaanto, echio chitari korora, gose koigwa, gose koragera, gose konyonka.
swahili: Huko mtaabudu miungu ya miti na mawe iliyotengenezwa na watu, ambayo haiwezi kuona au kusikia wala kula au kunusa.

english: But if from there you will seek the LORD your God, you will find Him if you seek Him with all your heart and with all your soul.
ekegusii: Korende aroro agwo, komorarigie Omonene Nyasae oino, ne chinkoro chiaino chionsi, na emioyo yaino yonsi, inamomonyoore.
swahili: Lakini kama mtamtafuta Bwana Mungu wenu, mtampata; kama mtamtafuta kwa moyo wenu wote na kwa roho yote.

english: Your eyes have seen what the LORD did at Baal-peor, for the LORD your God destroyed from among you all who followed Baal of Peor.
ekegusii: Inwe abanyene mwarooche ari’Omonene akorerete Baali‐Peori; abanto baria bonsi basasiimete Baali‐Peori, akabasiria korwa ase egati yaino.
swahili: Mliona kwa macho yenu wenyewe kile Bwana alichokifanya kule Baal-Peori. Bwana Mungu wenu aliwaangamiza kutoka miongoni mwenu kila mmoja aliyemfuata Baali wa Peori,

english: When you are in distress and all these things have happened to you, then in later days you will return to the LORD your God and listen to His voice.
ekegusii: Ekero moraabe n’emechando, na ayio onsi arabanyoore ase amatuko agochia goocha, imomoiranere Omonene Nyasae oino, naende moigwere eriogi riaye.
swahili: Wakati mnapokuwa katika dhiki, nayo mambo haya yote yamewatokea siku hizo, ndipo mtamrudia Bwana Mungu wenu na kumtii.

english: For the LORD your God is a merciful God; He will not abandon you or destroy you or forget the covenant with your fathers, which He swore to them by oath. The LORD Alone Is God
ekegusii: Omonene Nyasae oino, takobatiga, ekiagera ere n’oyo bw’amaabera. Takobasiria, gose takweba okobwatana kwaye kw’ogotianania akorete ne’chisokoro chiaino.
swahili: Kwa maana Bwana Mungu wenu ni Mungu mwenye huruma, hatawaacha au kuwaangamiza wala kusahau Agano alilofanya na baba zenu, alilowathibitishia kwa kiapo. Bwana Ndiye Mungu

english: Indeed, ask now from one end of the heavens to the other about the days that long preceded you, from the day that God created man on earth: Has anything as great as this ever happened or been reported?
ekegusii: “Bono booria, momanye korwa ase amatuko a kare, amatuko ayio arengeo ekero konya motaraiborwa, korwa rituko riria Nyasae atongete Mwanyabaanto ase ense, naende moboorie momanye korwa ase ensemo eyemo y’ense goikera ensemo ende, gose amang’ana agwekaine buna aya ana koba, gose koigugwa.
swahili: Sasa uliza kuhusu siku za zamani, zamani kabla ya wakati wako, tangu siku ile Mungu alipomuumba mtu juu ya nchi, uliza kutoka mwisho mmoja wa mbingu mpaka mwisho mwingine wa mbingu. Je, kumepata kutokea jambo jingine lililo kubwa kama hili, au kuna jambo jingine kama hilo limepata kusikiwa?

english: Has a people ever heard the voice of God speaking out of the fire, as you have, and lived?
ekegusii: Inee! Abanto bande bana koigwa Nyasae ogokwana korwa ase egati‐gati y’omorero buna inwe mwaiguure, naende mogendererete koba moyo?
swahili: Je, kuna watu wengine wowote waliosikia sauti ya Mungu ikizungumza kwenye moto, kama mlivyosikia, nao wakaishi?

english: Or has any god tried to take as his own a nation out of another nation—by trials, signs, wonders, and war, by a strong hand and an outstretched arm, and by great terrors—as the LORD your God did for you in Egypt, before your eyes?
ekegusii: Gose enyasae ende kero kende gionsi yana korenta egesaku kende korwa ase egati y’ebisaku binde, erinde agekore kebe abanto baye omonyene, buna Omonene Nyasae oino, abakorerete inwe agwo Misiri? Ase amaiso aino nigo arentete amateemwa, na ebikone, na amakumia, na esegi, na ase okoboko kore ne chinguru koramboire akarenta okoondokia okonene.
swahili: Je, kuna mungu yeyote amepata kujaribu mwenyewe kuchukua taifa moja kutoka taifa lingine, kwa mapigo, kwa ishara za miujiza na maajabu, kwa vita, kwa mkono wenye nguvu na mkono ulionyooshwa au kwa matendo makuu ya kutisha, kama yale ambayo Bwana Mungu wenu aliyofanya kwa ajili yenu huko Misri mbele ya macho yenu?

english: You were shown these things so that you would know that the LORD is God; there is no other besides Him.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo aborogetie ayio, erinde momanye ng’a Omonene nere Nyasae; onde tari otatiga ere bweka.
swahili: Mlionyeshwa mambo haya ili mpate kujua kuwa Bwana ndiye Mungu; hakuna mwingine ila yeye.

english: He let you hear His voice from heaven to discipline you, and on earth He showed you His great fire, and you heard His words out of the fire.
ekegusii: Akabakora mokaigwa eriogi riaye riarwete igoro, erinde anyare koborokereria; na ase ense akaborokia omorero omonene, nainwe mokaigwa amang’ana aye korwa ase egati‐gati y’omorero oria.
swahili: Kutoka mbinguni amewasikizisha sauti yake ili kuwaadilisha. Hapa duniani aliwaonyesha moto wake mkubwa, nanyi mlisikia maneno yake kutoka kwenye ule moto.

english: Because He loved your fathers, He chose their descendants after them and brought you out of Egypt by His presence and great power,
ekegusii: Agancha chisokoro chiaino, na ase engencho eyio akabachoora inwe, ororeeria rwabo, mobe ribaga riabo, na ere omonyene akabang’anyia korwa Misiri ase okobua kwaye okonene.
swahili: Kwa sababu aliwapenda baba zenu na alichagua wazao wao baada yao, aliwatoa katika nchi ya Misri kwa Uwepo wake na kwa uwezo wake mkuu,

english: to drive out before you nations greater and mightier than you, and to bring you into their land and give it to you for your inheritance, as it is this day.
ekegusii: Korwa bosio bwaino akabiseeria ebisaku biarenge ebinene, naende biarenge ne chinguru kobabua; akabarenta ase ense yabo, nainwe mokayeira ekaba omwando oino, naboigo ere nonya ngoika reero iga.
swahili: aliwafukuza mbele yenu mataifa makubwa na yenye nguvu kuliko ninyi na kuwaleta ninyi katika nchi yao na akawapa ninyi kuwa urithi wenu, kama ilivyo leo.

english: Know therefore this day and take to heart that the LORD is God in heaven above and on the earth below; there is no other.
ekegusii: Ase ayio manya rituko ria reero, morengererie mono ng’a, Omonene nere Nyasae o igoro na ense; naende onde tari otatiga ere bweka.
swahili: Kubalini na mweke moyoni leo kuwa Bwana ndiye Mungu mbinguni juu na duniani chini. Hakuna mwingine.

english: But you who held fast to the LORD your God are alive to this day, every one of you.
ekegusii: Korende inwe abamwabete abegenwa ase Omonene Nyasae oino, kera oyomo oino moy’are goika reero iga.
swahili: lakini ninyi nyote mlioshikamana na Bwana kwa uthabiti, Mungu wenu, mko hai mpaka leo.

english: Keep His statutes and commandments, which I am giving you today, so that you and your children after you may prosper, and that you may live long in the land that the LORD your God is giving you for all time. Cities of Refuge (Numbers 35:9–34; Deuteronomy 19:1–14; Joshua 20:1–9)
ekegusii: Inwe goika morende emeroberio yaye echiikire n’amachiiko aye, ayio inche nkobaa rituko ria reero, erio nario er’abe buya ase more, naboigo nase abana baino, naende amatuko aino nabe amaange ase ense eri’Omonene Nyasae oino, agochia kobaa ebe eyaino kogenderera.” Emechie y’obotamero moocha ya Yorodani
swahili: Mshike amri na maagizo yake ninayowapa leo, ili mpate kufanikiwa ninyi na watoto wenu baada yenu, na mpate kuishi maisha marefu katika nchi awapayo Bwana Mungu wenu siku zote. Miji Ya Makimbilio

english: Then Moses set aside three cities across the Jordan to the east
ekegusii: Erio Musa agachoora emechie etato agwo moocha ya Yorodani.
swahili: Kisha Mose akatenga miji mitatu mashariki ya Yordani,

english: to which a manslayer could flee after killing his neighbor unintentionally without prior malice. To save one’s own life, he could flee to one of these cities:
ekegusii: Emechie eyio nero omoiti aranyare gotamera, ere oy’oraite omonto omwabo mosiabano, gose oyio atabwati obobisa nere. Omonto oria karatamere oyomo bw’emechie eyio nigo aratigwe abe moyo.
swahili: ambayo mtu yeyote aliyemuua mtu angeweza kukimbilia ikiwa amemuua jirani yake bila kukusudia na bila kuwa na chuki naye siku zilizopita. Angeweza kukimbilia katika mmojawapo ya miji hii na kuokoa maisha yake.

english: Bezer in the wilderness on the plateau belonging to the Reubenites, Ramoth in Gilead belonging to the Gadites, or Golan in Bashan belonging to the Manassites. Introduction to the Law
ekegusii: Beseri ase erooro, ase ense eraire eimokererete igoro, nigo orenge omochie bw’obotamero ase abanto b’egesaku kia Rubeni, na Ramoti ase ense ya Gileadi ase abanto ba Gadi, na Golani ase ense ya Basani ase abanto ba Manase. Okoruegwa kw’amachiiko a Nyasae
swahili: Miji hiyo ilikuwa: Bezeri katika tambarare ya jangwa kwa ajili ya Wareubeni; Ramothi katika nchi ya Gileadi kwa ajili ya Wagadi; nao mji wa Golani katika nchi ya Bashani kwa ajili ya Wamanase. Utangulizi Wa Sheria

english: This is the law that Moses set before the Israelites.
ekegusii: Aya naro amachiiko a Nyasae Musa aruete ase Abaisraeli.
swahili: Hii ndiyo sheria Mose aliyoweka mbele ya Waisraeli.

english: These are the testimonies, statutes, and ordinances that Moses proclaimed to them after they had come out of Egypt,
ekegusii: Magega Abaisraeli kobaruure Misiri, Musa akaa Abaisraeli oborori, na emeroberio echiikire, n’amachiiko aya.
swahili: Haya ndiyo masharti, amri na sheria Mose aliyowapa wana wa Israeli wakati walitoka Misri,

english: while they were in the valley across the Jordan facing Beth-peor in the land of Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived in Heshbon and was defeated by Moses and the Israelites after they had come out of Egypt.
ekegusii: Aya nigo abeete agwo moocha ya Yorodani ase rikura riarenge ensemo ekororia Beti‐Peori, ase orogongo rwa Sihoni, omorwoti bw’Abaamori, oyio omenyete agwo Hesiboni. Nere oria Musa na Abaisraeli babuete ekero barwete Misiri,
swahili: nao walikuwa katika bonde karibu na Beth-Peori mashariki ya Yordani, katika nchi ya Sihoni mfalme wa Waamori, ambaye alitawala Heshboni, naye alishindwa na Mose na Waisraeli walipokuja toka Misri.

english: They took possession of the land belonging to Sihon and to Og king of Bashan—the two Amorite kings across the Jordan to the east—
ekegusii: bakaira ense yaye ekaba eyabo, naende bakaira ense ya Ogi, omorwoti o Basani. (Abarwoti abwo babere nigo bamenyete moocha ya Yorodani.)
swahili: Waliimiliki nchi yake na nchi ya Ogu mfalme wa Bashani, wafalme wawili Waamori waliotawala mashariki ya Yordani.

english: extending from Aroer on the rim of the Arnon Valley as far as Mount Siyon (that is, Hermon),
ekegusii: Bakaira ense gochaakera Aroeri ase orobebe rwe rigoko ri’Arinoni goikera egetunwa keria Sioni (nakio Herimoni).
swahili: Nchi hii ilienea kutoka Aroeri ukingoni mwa Bonde la Arnoni mpaka Mlima Sioni (yaani Hermoni),

english: including all the Arabah on the east side of the Jordan and as far as the Sea of the Arabah, below the slopes of Pisgah.
ekegusii: Bakaira orogongo gochakera rikura moocha ya Yorodani goikera ase Enyancha y’omonyoo inse y’ebitirimboko bi’egetunwa gia Pisiga.
swahili: pamoja na eneo lote la Araba mashariki ya Yordani, na kuenea mpaka Bahari ya Araba kwenye miteremko ya Pisga.

english: See, I have taught you statutes and ordinances just as the LORD my God has commanded me, so that you may follow them in the land that you are about to enter and possess.
ekegusii: “Naama! Inche naborokereirie amachiiko na emeroberio, buna Omonene Nyasae one, anchiigete, erinde inwe moyaigwere ase ense eria mokogeenda koira ebe eyaino.
swahili: Tazama, nimewafundisha amri na sheria kama Bwana Mungu wangu alivyoniamuru mimi, ili mzifuate katika nchi mnayoiingia kuimiliki.

english: Observe them carefully, for this will show your wisdom and understanding in the sight of the peoples, who will hear of all these statutes and say, “Surely this great nation is a wise and understanding people.”
ekegusii: Moyabwate na koyaigwera, ekiagera ayio naro araorokererie abanto b’ebisaku binde ng’a ’more n’obong’aini. Barabwo kobaraigwe amachiiko aya onsi mbateebe: Ekeene, abanto b’egesaku eke ekenene nigo bare abamanyi naende nabang’aini!
swahili: Zishikeni kwa uangalifu, kwa kuwa hii itaonyesha hekima na ufahamu wenu kwa mataifa, ambayo yatasikia kuhusu amri zote hizi, nao watasema, “Hakika taifa hili kubwa ni watu wenye hekima na ufahamu.”

english: For what nation is great enough to have a god as near to them as the LORD our God is to us whenever we call on Him?
ekegusii: “Inee! ’Mbanto ba gesaku ki ekenene babwate enyasae ere ang’e nabarabwo buna Omonene Nyasae oito, are ang’e naintwe? Nigo agotoigwa kero kende gionsi tokomorangeria atokoonye.
swahili: Ni taifa gani jingine lililo kubwa kiasi cha kuwa na miungu yao iliyo karibu nao kama Bwana Mungu wetu alivyo karibu nasi wakati wowote tunapomwomba?

english: And what nation is great enough to have righteous statutes and ordinances like this entire law I set before you today?
ekegusii: Naende mbanto ba gesaku ki ekenene babwate amachiiko amaronge na emeroberio emeronge, buna amachiiko aya onsi inche naborokereirie reero?
swahili: Nalo ni taifa gani jingine lililo kubwa hivi lenye kuwa na amri na sheria za haki kama hizi ninazoweka mbele yenu leo?

english: Only be on your guard and diligently watch yourselves, so that you do not forget the things your eyes have seen, and so that they do not slip from your heart as long as you live. Teach them to your children and grandchildren.
ekegusii: Mwerende! Morende chinkoro chiaino, erinde timobaisa kweba ayamwarorire n’amaiso aino, gose koyatiga arue ase chinkoro chiaino ase amatuko onsi more moyo. Boigo moyorokererie abana baino na abaachokoro baino,
swahili: Mwe waangalifu, na makini ili msije mkasahau mambo ambayo mliyaona kwa macho yenu, wala kuyaacha yaondoke moyoni mwenu siku zote za uhai wenu. Mwafundishe hayo watoto wenu na watoto wao baada yao.

english: Then Moses summoned all Israel and said to them: Hear, O Israel, the statutes and ordinances that I declare in your hearing this day. Learn them and observe them carefully.
ekegusii: Musa akarangeria Abaisraeli bonsi goocha amo, erio akabateebia, Inwe Abaisraeli, igwa amachiiko na emeroberio echiikire ’nkobateebia rituko ria reero, moyieorokererie, mobe n’obomaene ng’a ’moyakore.
swahili: Mose akawaita Israeli wote, akawaambia: Ee Israeli, sikilizeni amri na sheria ninazowatangazia leo. Jifunzeni, na mwe na hakika kuzifuata.

english: but showing loving devotion to a thousand generations of those who love Me and keep My commandments.
ekegusii: Korende nigo ’nkoborokia obwanchani bwane botari koera goika ebiaare chilifu, ase abwo banyanchete na babwatete amachiiko ane.
swahili: lakini ninaonyesha upendo kwa maelfu ya vizazi vya wale wanipendao na kuzishika amri zangu.

english: You shall not take the name of the LORD your God in vain, for the LORD will not leave anyone unpunished who takes His name in vain.
ekegusii: “Toriatora bosa na korikorera bobe erieta ri’Omonene, Nyasae oo, ekiagera Omonene tagotiga komoa egesusuro oria okoriatora bosa na korikorera bobe erieta riaye.”
swahili: Usilitaje bure jina la Bwana Mungu wako, kwa kuwa Bwana hataacha kumhesabia hatia yeye alitajaye jina lake bure.

english: Observe the Sabbath day by keeping it holy, as the LORD your God has commanded you.
ekegusii: “Bwata rituko ri’Esabato, oriatanane ribe richenu, buna Omonene Nyasae oo, agochiigete.
swahili: Adhimisha siku ya Sabato na kuiweka takatifu, kama Bwana Mungu wako alivyokuagiza.

english: Six days you shall labor and do all your work,
ekegusii: Ase amatuko atano na rimo okore emeremo yao yonsi.
swahili: Kwa siku sita utafanya kazi na kutenda shughuli zako zote.

english: but the seventh day is a Sabbath to the LORD your God, on which you must not do any work—neither you, nor your son or daughter, nor your manservant or maidservant, nor your ox or donkey or any of your livestock, nor the foreigner within your gates, so that your manservant and maidservant may rest as you do.
ekegusii: Korende rituko ria gatan’akabere, ne’rituko ri’Esabato riatananwe ase Nyasae oo. Ase rituko erio tokora emeremo ende yonsi, aye gose omwana oo, omomura gose omoiseke, nonya n’omosomba oo, omomura gose omoiseke, gose eng’ombe yao, gose etigere yao, gose etugo yao ende yonsi egokora emeremo, gose omomenyi oyomenyete mwao. Omosomba oo, omomura gose omoiseke, nabarabwo batimoke buna aye ogotimoka.
swahili: Lakini siku ya Saba ni Sabato kwa Bwana, Mungu wako. Siku hiyo hutafanya kazi yoyote, wewe, wala mwanao au binti yako, wala mtumishi wa kiume au mtumishi wa kike, wala ngʼombe wako, punda wako au mnyama wako yeyote, wala mgeni aliyeko malangoni mwako, ili kwamba mtumishi wako wa kiume na wa kike wapate kupumzika kama wewe.

english: Remember that you were a slave in the land of Egypt, and that the LORD your God brought you out of there with a mighty hand and an outstretched arm. That is why the LORD your God has commanded you to keep the Sabbath day.
ekegusii: Inyora ng’a aye omonyene nigo kwarenge omosomba ase ense ya Misiri, n’Omonene, Nyasae oo, agakorusia korwa aroro n’okoboko kore ne chinguru koramboire. Ase ayio Omonene, Nyasae oo, nigo agochiigete orende rituko ri’Esabato.
swahili: Kumbuka mlikuwa watumwa huko Misri, na Bwana Mungu wenu aliwatoa huko kwa mkono wenye nguvu na kwa mkono ulionyooshwa. Kwa hiyo Bwana Mungu wako amekuagiza kuiadhimisha siku ya Sabato.

english: Honor your father and your mother, as the LORD your God has commanded you, so that your days may be long and that it may go well with you in the land that the LORD your God is giving you.
ekegusii: “Sika iso na nyoko, buna Omonene, Nyasae oo, agochiikire; nario oramenye amatuko amaange, naende er’abe buya ase ore ase ense eri’Omonene, Nyasae oo, agochia gokoa.
swahili: Waheshimu baba yako na mama yako, kama Bwana Mungu wako alivyokuagiza, ili siku zako zipate kuwa nyingi na kufanikiwa katika nchi Bwana Mungu wako anayokupa.

english: The LORD our God made a covenant with us at Horeb.
ekegusii: Omonene Nyasae oito, nakorete okobwatana kw’ogotianania amo naintwe agwo Horebu.
swahili: Bwana Mungu wetu alifanya Agano nasi katika mlima wa Horebu.

english: You shall not bear false witness against your neighbor.
ekegusii: “Tomoteebera omogisangio oo oborimo.
swahili: Usimshuhudie jirani yako uongo.

english: You shall not covet your neighbor’s wife. You shall not covet your neighbor’s house or field, or his manservant or maidservant, or his ox or donkey, or anything that belongs to your neighbor.” Moses Intercedes for the People (Exodus 20:18–21; Hebrews 12:18–29)
ekegusii: “Tobaisa kogania omokungu bw’omogisangio oo. Tobaisa kogania enyomba y’omogisangio oo, nonya n’omogondo oye, gose omosomba oye, omomura gose omoiseke, gose eng’ombe yaye, gose etigere yaye, gose gento kende gionsi abwate.
swahili: Usitamani mke wa jirani yako. Usitamani nyumba ya jirani yako au shamba lake, mtumishi wake wa kiume au wa kike, ngʼombe au punda wake, wala kitu chochote cha jirani yako.”

english: The LORD spoke these commandments in a loud voice to your whole assembly out of the fire, the cloud, and the deep darkness on the mountain; He added nothing more. And He wrote them on two tablets of stone and gave them to me.
ekegusii: “Amang’ana aya nar’Omonene akwanete ase omosangererekano oino bwonsi agwo ase egetunwa, ekero akwanete korwa ase egati‐gati y’omorero, ne riire, na omosunte ekerima. Akayakwana n’eriogi rinene, na tamentete gento kende gionsi. Akayariika ase chibao ibere chi’amagena, erio agachiing’a. Abanto bakoba n’obwoba (Okong’ 20:18-21)
swahili: Hizi ndizo amri alizozitangaza Bwana kwa sauti kubwa kwa kusanyiko lenu lote huko mlimani kutoka kwenye moto, wingu na giza nene, wala hakuongeza chochote zaidi. Kisha akaziandika juu ya vibao viwili vya mawe, naye akanipa mimi. Woga Wa Watu Mlimani (Kutoka 20:18-21)

english: And when you heard the voice out of the darkness while the mountain was blazing with fire, all the heads of your tribes and your elders approached me,
ekegusii: “Ekero egetunwa keria kiagendererete gwoka omorero, mokaigwa eriogi korwa ase egati‐gati y’omosunte oria, nainwe mwensi, abamore abatang’ani na abagaaka ase ebisaku biaino, mogaacha ase ’nde.
swahili: Mliposikia sauti kutoka kwenye giza, mlima ulipokuwa ukiwaka moto, viongozi wenu wote wa makabila yenu na wazee wenu walinijia mimi.

english: and you said, “Behold, the LORD our God has shown us His glory and greatness, and we have heard His voice out of the fire. Today we have seen that a man can live even if God speaks with him.
ekegusii: Mokabora: Naama, Omonene Nyasae oito, otworokirie obonene bwaye na obonguru bwaye, naintwe twaiguure eriogi riaye korwa ase egati‐gati y’omorero. Rituko ria reero twarorire Nyasae ogokwana na Mwanyabaanto, na Mwanyabaanto oyio ogendererete koba moyo.
swahili: Nanyi mkasema, “ Bwana Mungu wetu ametuonyesha utukufu na enzi yake, nasi tumesikia sauti yake kutoka kwenye moto. Leo tumeona kwamba mwanadamu anaweza kuishi hata kama Mungu akizungumza naye.

english: But now, why should we die? For this great fire will consume us, and we will die, if we hear the voice of the LORD our God any longer.
ekegusii: Bono nase ki togwenerete gokwa? Omorero oyo omonene nigo ogochia gotosamba na gotosiria, onye naende togochia koigwa eriogi ri’Omonene Nyasae oito, goika tokwe.
