swahili: Lakini sasa, kwa nini tufe? Moto huu mkubwa utatuteketeza sisi na tutakufa kama tukiendelea kusikia sauti ya Bwana Mungu wetu zaidi.

english: For who of all flesh has heard the voice of the living God speaking out of the fire, as we have, and survived?
ekegusii: Inee! Omonto nareo obeire okoigwa Nyasae ore moyo kagokwana korwa ase egati‐gati y’omorero, buna intwe twamoiguure, na omonto oyio ogendererete koba moyo?
swahili: Ni mtu yupi mwenye mwili ambaye amewahi kuisikia sauti ya Mungu aliye hai akizungumza kutoka kwenye moto, kama sisi tulivyoisikia, naye akaishi?

english: Go near and listen to all that the LORD our God says. Then you can tell us everything the LORD our God tells you; we will listen and obey.”
ekegusii: Naende moganteebia: Aye genda ang’e, oigwe amang’ana onsi Omonene Nyasae oito, agokwana. Erio oche ototeebie onsi ayio Omonene Nyasae oito, aragoteebie, naintwe ’natoyaigwe na koyakora.
swahili: Sogea karibu usikie yale yote asemayo Bwana Mungu wetu. Kisha utuambie chochote kile ambacho Bwana Mungu wetu anakuambia. Tutasikiliza na kutii.”

english: And the LORD heard the words you spoke to me, and He said to me, “I have heard the words that these people have spoken to you. They have done well in all that they have spoken.
ekegusii: “Omonene nigo aigwete amang’ana aino ekero keria mware gokwana nainche, erio aganteebia: Naiguure amang’ana abanto abwo bakwanire naye. Ayio onsi bagoteebirie, mbuya bakwanire.
swahili: Bwana aliwasikia wakati mlipozungumza nami, na Bwana akaniambia, “Nimesikia kile hawa watu walichokuambia. Kila kitu walichokisema ni kizuri.

english: If only they had such a heart to fear Me and keep all My commandments always, so that it might be well with them and with their children forever.
ekegusii: Onye ndiria baare koba n’omoyo oyio botambe, na kong’iroka na korenda amachiiko ane onsi, nanga kera egento nigo kiare koba buya ase bare, na ase ororeeria rwabo, kare na kare.
swahili: Laiti kama mioyo yao ingekuwa na mwelekeo wa kuniogopa na kuzishika amri zangu zote daima, ili kwamba wafanikiwe wao pamoja na watoto wao milele!

english: He did not make this covenant with our fathers, but with all of us who are alive here today.
ekegusii: Omonene takorete okobwatana okwo ne’chisokoro chiaito, korende nigo akorete okobwatana okwo naintwe abanyene, intwe twensi abatore moyo rituko ria reero.
swahili: Si kwamba Bwana alifanya Agano na baba zetu, bali alifanya nasi, nasi sote ambao tuko hai hapa leo.

english: Go and tell them: ‘Return to your tents.’
ekegusii: Genda obateebie bairane ase chiema chiabo.
swahili: “Nenda uwaambie warudi kwenye mahema yao.

english: But you stand here with Me, that I may speak to you all the commandments and statutes and ordinances you are to teach them to follow in the land that I am giving them to possess.”
ekegusii: Korende aye tigara aa ase ’nde, na inche ngoteebie amachiiko onsi, na emeroberio echiikire, na onsi aya nachiikire, ayio ogochia koborokia, erio bayarende na koyakora ase ense eria ’ngochia kobaa, ebe eyabo.
swahili: Lakini wewe baki hapa pamoja nami ili niweze kukupa maagizo yote, amri na sheria ambazo utawafundisha wazifuate katika nchi ninayokwenda kuwapa waimiliki.”

english: So be careful to do as the LORD your God has commanded you; you are not to turn aside to the right or to the left.
ekegusii: “Ase ayio morende na gokora ayio Omonene Nyasae oino, abachiikire. Timoyatiga na koonchoka gochia aande, ensemo y’okorio gose ey’okobee.
swahili: Hivyo kuweni waangalifu kuyafanya yale Bwana Mungu wenu aliyowaagiza; msigeuke upande wa kuume wala wa kushoto.

english: You must walk in all the ways that the LORD your God has commanded you, so that you may live and prosper and prolong your days in the land that you will possess.
ekegusii: Mobwatie chinchera chionsi Omonene Nyasae oino, abachiikire, erio nario mor’abe moyo, naende nario er’abe buya ase more, na inwe momenye amatuko amaange ase ense eria mogochia koira ebe eyaino.
swahili: Fuateni yale yote ambayo Bwana Mungu wenu aliwaagiza, ili mpate kuishi, kustawi na kuziongeza siku zenu katika nchi mtakayoimiliki.

english: The LORD spoke with you face to face out of the fire on the mountain. The Ten Commandments (Exodus 20:1–17)
ekegusii: Agwo ase egetunwa, korwa ase egati-gati y’omorero, Omonene nigo akwanete nainwe obosio ase obosio.
swahili: Bwana alisema nanyi uso kwa uso kutoka moto juu ya mlima.

english: At that time I was standing between the LORD and you to declare to you the word of the LORD, because you were afraid of the fire and would not go up the mountain. And He said:
ekegusii: Ase engaki eria inche nabeete ’nteneine ase egati y’Omonene nainwe, nareenge gokwana nainwe ring’ana ri’Omonene, ekiagera inwe nigo mwarenge n’obwoba ase engencho y’omorero oria, timwatiirete goocha ase egetunwa. “Omonene agakwana:
swahili: (Wakati huo nilisimama kati ya Bwana na ninyi kuwatangazia neno la Bwana, kwa sababu mliogopa ule moto, nanyi hamkupanda mlimani.) Naye Mungu alisema:

english: “I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.
ekegusii: Inche ninche Omonene Nyasae oino, nabarusetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri, ense y’obosomba.
swahili: “Mimi ndimi Bwana Mungu wako, niliyekutoa katika nchi ya Misri, kutoka nchi ya utumwa.

english: You shall have no other gods before Me.
ekegusii: “Toba ne chinyasae chinde otatiga inche.
swahili: Usiwe na miungu mingine ila mimi.

english: You shall not make for yourself an idol in the form of anything in the heavens above, on the earth below, or in the waters beneath.
ekegusii: “Tobaisa gwekorera omogwekano bw’ogosasiimwa, omogwekano o getongwa kende gionsi kere igoro, gose ase ense, gose ime ase amaache inse y’ense.
swahili: Usijitengenezee sanamu katika umbo la kitu chochote kilicho juu mbinguni au duniani chini au ndani ya maji.

english: You shall not bow down to them or worship them; for I, the LORD your God, am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on their children to the third and fourth generations of those who hate Me,
ekegusii: Tobaisa gotugama gose gosasiima emegwekano, ekiagera inche Omonene, Nyasae oo, inche ’Nyasae bwe risemi. Ase engencho y’amabe y’abaibori nigo ’nkobaa abana egesusuro goika ekiaare kia gatato na egia kane, abwo bangeechete.
swahili: Usivisujudie wala kuviabudu; kwa kuwa Mimi, Bwana Mungu wako, ni Mungu mwenye wivu, ninayewaadhibu watoto kwa ajili ya dhambi za baba zao hadi kizazi cha tatu na cha nne cha wanichukiao,

english: These are the commandments and statutes and ordinances that the LORD your God has instructed me to teach you to follow in the land that you are about to enter and possess,
ekegusii: “Aya naro amachiiko, na emeroberio echiikire, Omonene Nyasae oino, anchiigete imborokererie, erinde moyaigwere na koyakora ase ense eria mogochia koira ebe eyaino.
swahili: Haya ndiyo maagizo, amri na sheria ambazo Bwana Mungu wenu aliniagiza niwafundishe ninyi ili mpate kuyashika katika nchi ambayo ninyi mnavuka Yordani kuimiliki,

english: And when the LORD your God brings you into the land He swore to your fathers, to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, that He would give you—a land with great and splendid cities that you did not build,
ekegusii: “Omonene Nyasae oino, nabaire na kobaikia ase ense eria arierete chisokoro chiaino, Aburaamu, na Isaka, na Yakobo eira, ng’a nabae inwe ense eria ebwate emechie emenene naende emiya, eyio inwe motaagachete.
swahili: Wakati Bwana Mungu wako atakapokuleta katika nchi aliyowaapia baba zako, Abrahamu, Isaki na Yakobo, kukupa wewe, nchi kubwa, ina miji inayopendeza ambayo hukuijenga,

english: with houses full of every good thing with which you did not fill them, with wells that you did not dig, and with vineyards and olive groves that you did not plant—and when you eat and are satisfied,
ekegusii: Chinyomba nigo chiraabe chiichire n’ebinto ebiya, ebio inwe motabegeteo, ne chinsooko chi’amaache echio motakuunyete, na emegondo y’emesabibu na ey’emezeituni, eyio motasimegete.
swahili: nyumba zilizojaa vitu vizuri vya aina nyingi ambavyo hukuvijaza, visima ambavyo hukuchimba, na mashamba ya mizabibu na mizeituni ambayo hukupanda wewe, basi, utakapokula na kushiba,

english: be careful not to forget the LORD who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.
ekegusii: Komoraikeo mwerende mono, timobaisa kweba Omonene oria obarusetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri, ase mwarenge abasomba.
swahili: jihadhari usije ukamwacha Bwana, aliyekutoa katika nchi ya Misri, kutoka nchi ya utumwa.

english: Fear the LORD your God, serve Him only, and take your oaths in His name.
ekegusii: Momoiroke Omonene Nyasae oino; momokorere ere bweka na motiane ase erieta riaye rioka.
swahili: Utamcha Bwana Mungu wako, na umtumikie yeye peke yake na kuapa kwa jina lake.

english: Do not follow other gods, the gods of the peoples around you.
ekegusii: Timobaisa gosasiima chinyasae chinde chionsi chiria chi’ abanto baabaetanaine.
swahili: Usifuate miungu mingine, miungu ya mataifa yanayokuzunguka;

english: For the LORD your God, who is among you, is a jealous God. Otherwise the anger of the LORD your God will be kindled against you, and He will wipe you off the face of the earth.
ekegusii: Omonene Nyasae oino, oyomenyete ase egati yaino, nigo are Nyasae bwe risemi; mwerende, erinde endamwamu yaye tebaisa gwoka igoro ase more na kobasiria korwa ase ense.
swahili: kwa kuwa Bwana Mungu wako, ambaye yuko katikati yako, ni Mungu mwenye wivu na hasira yake itawaka dhidi yako, naye atakuangamiza kutoka uso wa nchi.

english: Do not test the LORD your God as you tested Him at Massah.
ekegusii: “Timobaisa komoteema Omonene Nyasae oino, buna mwamoteemete aaria Masa.
swahili: Usimjaribu Bwana Mungu wako kama ulivyofanya huko Masa.

english: You are to diligently keep the commandments of the LORD your God and the testimonies and statutes He has given you.
ekegusii: Mobe abeegenwa ase okobwata amachiiko a Omonene Nyasae oino, na oborori bwaye, na emeroberio echiikire, eyio abaeire.
swahili: Utayashika maagizo ya Bwana Mungu wako kwa bidii, na masharti na amri alizokupa.

english: Do what is right and good in the sight of the LORD, so that it may be well with you and that you may enter and possess the good land that the LORD your God swore to give your fathers,
ekegusii: Mokore ayaare amaronge na’amaya ase obosio bw’Omonene, erio nario er’abe buya ase more, monyaare gosoa na koira ense eria engiy’Omonene arierete chisokoro chiaino eira ng’a n’abayee,
swahili: Fanya lililo haki na jema mbele za Bwana, ili upate kufanikiwa, uweze kuingia na kuimiliki nchi nzuri ambayo Bwana aliahidi kwa kiapo kwa baba zako,

english: driving out all your enemies before you, as the LORD has said. Teach Your Children
ekegusii: na kobaseeria ababisa baino bonsi korwa ase more, buna Omonene ateebete.
swahili: kuwafukuza kwa nguvu adui zako mbele yako kama Bwana alivyosema.

english: so that you and your children and grandchildren may fear the LORD your God all the days of your lives by keeping all His statutes and commandments that I give you, and so that your days may be prolonged.
ekegusii: Ase obogima bwaino bwonsi, inwe amo nabana baino, na abaachokoro baino, goika moiroke Omonene Nyasae oino, na kobwata emeroberio yaye yonsi yachiikirwe, n’amachiiko aye onsi ayio inche ’nkobachiika, erio nario amatuko aino arabe amaange.
swahili: ili kwamba ninyi, watoto wenu na watoto wao baada yao wamche Bwana Mungu wenu siku zote kwa kushika amri na maagizo yake yote ninayowapa, ili mweze kuyafurahia maisha marefu.

english: In the future, when your son asks, “What is the meaning of the decrees and statutes and ordinances that the LORD our God has commanded you?”
ekegusii: “Ase chingaki chigochia‐goocha ekero abana baino barababorie: Ninki engencho y’oborori obo, n’amachiiko aya, na emeroberio eye, ebi Omonene Nyasae oito, abachiigete? Nase ki Omonene Nyasae oito, abachiigete amachiiko aya na emeroberio eye?
swahili: Siku zijazo, mtoto wako atakapokuuliza, “Ni nini maana ya masharti haya, amri na sheria hizi ambazo Bwana Mungu wako alikuagiza wewe?”

english: then you are to tell him, “We were slaves of Pharaoh in Egypt, but the LORD brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand.
ekegusii: Goika mobairanerie: Intwe nigo twarenge abasomba ba Farao ase ense ya Misiri, n’Omonene agatorusiao n’okoboko kwaye gwe’chinguru.
swahili: Mwambie: “Tulikuwa watumwa wa Farao huko Misri, lakini Bwana alitutoa sisi kutoka Misri kwa mkono wenye nguvu.

english: Before our eyes the LORD inflicted great and devastating signs and wonders on Egypt, on Pharaoh, and on all his household.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo aorogetie ebikone na amakumia amanene, naende ay’okoondokia, aaria ase ense ya Misiri, ase Farao, na ase abanto bonsi b’enyomba yaye, naintwe tokayarora.
swahili: Bwana akapeleka mbele yetu ishara za miujiza na maajabu makubwa na ya kutisha mno juu ya Misri na Farao pamoja na nyumba yake yote.

english: But He brought us out from there to lead us in and give us the land that He had sworn to our fathers.
ekegusii: Omonene agatorusia ase ense eria, erio agatorenta aiga, agatoa ense eye arierete chisokoro chiaito eira ng’a n’abayee.
swahili: Lakini Mungu akatutoa huko, akatuleta na kutupa nchi hii ambayo aliwaahidi baba zetu kwa kiapo.

english: And the LORD commanded us to observe all these statutes and to fear the LORD our God, that we may always be prosperous and preserved, as we are to this day.
ekegusii: Erio agatochiika ng’a toigwere amachiiko aya onsi, na koimoroka ere Omonene Nyasae oito, erio nario er’abe buya ase tore botambe. Toise gokora bo ere natorende, buna atorendete goika reero iga, naintwe ’natogenderere koba moyo.
swahili: Bwana akatuagiza tutii amri hizi zote na kumcha Bwana Mungu wetu, ili tupate kustawi na kuendelea kuwa hai kama ilivyo leo.

english: And if we are careful to observe every one of these commandments before the LORD our God, as He has commanded us, then that will be our righteousness.”
ekegusii: Onye tokorenda na koigwera amachiiko aya onsi, ase obosio bw’Omonene Nyasae, buna ere atochiikire, nigo torabarerwe oboronge.”
swahili: Kama tukizitii kwa bidii amri hizi zote mbele za Bwana Mungu wetu, kama alivyotuamuru sisi, hiyo itakuwa haki yetu.”

english: Hear, O Israel, and be careful to observe them, so that you may prosper and multiply greatly in a land flowing with milk and honey, just as the LORD, the God of your fathers, has promised you.
ekegusii: Ase ayio inwe Abaisraeli, tegerera moigwe, monyaare koyarenda; erio nario er’abe buya ase more, naende ’momentekane mono ase ense eria entenenku ere n’amabeere n’amooke, buna Omonene, Nyasae bw’echisokoro chiaino, abarierete eira.
swahili: Sikia, ee Israeli, nawe uwe mwangalifu kutii ili upate kufanikiwa na kuongezeka sana katika nchi itiririkayo maziwa na asali, kama Bwana, Mungu wa baba zenu, alivyowaahidi ninyi.

english: Hear, O Israel: The LORD our God, the LORD is One.
ekegusii: “Inwe Abaisraeli, tegerera moigwe! Omonene Nyasae oito, nere bweka Omonene.
swahili: Sikia, ee Israeli: Bwana Mungu wako, Bwana ni mmoja.

english: And you shall love the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your strength.
ekegusii: Mwanche Omonene, Nyasae oo, n’enkoro yao yonsi, n’omoyo oo bwonsi, ne chinguru chiao chionsi.
swahili: Mpende Bwana Mungu wako kwa moyo wako wote, na kwa roho yako yote, na kwa nguvu zako zote.

english: These words I am commanding you today are to be upon your hearts.
ekegusii: Amang’ana aya ’nkobachiika rituko ria reero timobaisa koyeeba nonya ng’ake.
swahili: Amri hizi ninazokupa leo zitakuwa katika moyo wako.

english: And you shall teach them diligently to your children and speak of them when you sit at home and when you walk along the road, when you lie down and when you get up.
ekegusii: Moyorokererie abana baino mono, mobe mokona‐koyairanerera botambe; moyakwane ekero moikaransete ase chinyomba chiaino, na ekero more ase orogeendo inchera, na ekero mogochia korara, na ekero mokobooka.
swahili: Wafundishe watoto wako kwa bidii. Nena kuhusu amri hizi uketipo nyumbani na wakati utembeapo njiani, ulalapo na uamkapo.

english: Tie them as reminders on your hands and bind them on your foreheads.
ekegusii: Moyasiberanie ase amaboko aino, na moyabeeke ase amasio aino igoro, abe amariiko akobainyoria.
swahili: Zifunge kama alama juu ya mkono wako, na uzifunge juu ya paji la uso wako.

english: Write them on the doorposts of your houses and on your gates.
ekegusii: Moyariike ase emetobwa na emeriibo y’ebisieri bi’echinyomba chiaino, na ase ebiita biaino. Ogokuurerwa igoro y’ogotaigwera
swahili: Ziandike kwenye miimo ya milango ya nyumba yako na juu ya malango yako.

english: When the LORD your God brings you into the land that you are entering to possess, and He drives out before you many nations—the Hittites, Girgashites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites, seven nations larger and stronger than you—
ekegusii: “Omonene Nyasae oino, nabaikie ase ense eria, mogochia koira ebe eyaino, na aseerie ebisaku ebinge birue ase amasio aino, ebisaku bitano bibere bire ebinene, naende bire nechinguru kobabua. Ebisaku ebio nabio ebi: Abahiti, na Abagirigasi, na Abaamori, na Abakaanani, na Abaperisi, na Abahivi, na Abayebusi.
swahili: Bwana Mungu wako akuletapo katika nchi unayoingia kuimiliki, na awafukuzapo mbele yako mataifa mengi, yaani Wahiti, Wagirgashi, Waamori, Wakanaani, Waperizi, Wahivi na Wayebusi, mataifa saba makubwa tena yenye nguvu kuliko wewe,

english: But those who hate Him He repays to their faces with destruction; He will not hesitate to repay to his face the one who hates Him.
ekegusii: Korende ere nigo akobaakana obobe baria bamogeechete, na kobasiria. Tari goteebana koa omonto oria omogeechete egesusuro.
swahili: Lakini kwa wale wanaomchukia atawalipiza kwenye nyuso zao kwa maangamizi; hatachelewa kuwalipiza kwenye nyuso zao wale wamchukiao.

english: So keep the commandments and statutes and ordinances that I am giving you to follow this day. The Promises of God (Exodus 23:20–33)
ekegusii: Bono morende na koigwera amachiiko, na emeroberio echiikire, mokore ayio onsi nabachiikire ase rituko ria reero. Ogosesenigwa ase abaigweri (Okoir 28:1-14)
swahili: Kwa hiyo, kuweni waangalifu kufuata maagizo, amri na sheria ninazowapa leo. Baraka Za Utiifu (Kumbukumbu 28:1-14)

english: If you listen to these ordinances and keep them carefully, then the LORD your God will keep His covenant and the loving devotion that He swore to your fathers.
ekegusii: “Komoraigwere emeroberio eye echiikire na koyereenda, na koyekora, rirori’Omonene Nyasae oino, naikeranie na gokong’ia okobwatana kwaye kw’ogotianania, okwo akorete nainwe, na kobaorokeria obwanchani bwaye botari koera, buna arierete chisokoro chiaino eira ase ogotiana.
swahili: Kama mkizingatia sheria hizi na kuzifuata kwa uangalifu, basi Bwana Mungu wenu atatunza Agano lake la upendo nanyi, kama alivyowaapia baba zenu.

english: He will love you and bless you and multiply you. He will bless the fruit of your womb and the produce of your land—your grain, new wine, and oil, the young of your herds and the lambs of your flocks—in the land that He swore to your fathers to give you.
ekegusii: Ere nabanche na kobasesenia, nabamentekanie. Boigo nasesenie oroiboro rwe chinda chiaino, na okwama kw’emegondo yaino, na endagera yaino, na edivai yaino, na amaguta aino y’amazeituni; chiombe chiaino ’nchimentekane, amo ne ching’ondi ne chimbori chiaino, ase ense eria arierete chisokoro chiaino eira ng’a n’abayee.
swahili: Atawapenda ninyi na kuwabariki na kuongeza idadi yenu. Atabariki uzao wa tumbo lenu, mazao ya nchi yenu, nafaka, divai mpya na mafuta, ndama za ngʼombe wa makundi yenu, na kondoo za makundi yenu katika nchi ile aliyoapa kuwapa baba zenu.

english: You will be blessed above all peoples; among you there will be no barren man or woman or livestock.
ekegusii: ’Namosesenigwe kobua ebisaku binde bionsi. Ase egati yaino onde tari omosacha gose omokungu, oraabe omogomba, gose etugo ende yaino tekogombaa.
swahili: Mtabarikiwa kuliko mataifa mengine yote, hakuna wanaume wala wanawake kwenu watakaokosa watoto, wala mifugo yenu haitakuwa tasa.

english: And the LORD will remove from you all sickness. He will not lay upon you any of the terrible diseases you knew in Egypt, but He will inflict them on all who hate you.
ekegusii: Omonene narusie amarwaire onsi korwa ase more; nonya nobomo bw’amarwaire aria amabe arenge Misiri, aria ase mwamenyete, tagoocha igoro ase more kobachaanda, korende nigo arayarente ase abanto baria bonsi babageechete.
swahili: Bwana atawakinga na kila ugonjwa. Mungu hatatia juu yenu ugonjwa wowote mbaya mlioufahamu huko Misri, lakini atatia ugonjwa juu ya wale wote wanaokuchukia.

english: You must destroy all the peoples the LORD your God will deliver to you. Do not look on them with pity. Do not worship their gods, for that will be a snare to you.
ekegusii: Abanto abwo bonsi Omonene Nyasae oino, arabeeke ase amaboko aino, mobasirie, timobarorera amaabera. Timobaisa gokorera chinyasae chiabo, ekiagera ase ogokora igo, chirochio ’nachinyaare kobatiga.
swahili: Ni lazima mwangamize watu wote ambao Bwana Mungu wenu atawatia mikononi mwenu. Msiwatazame kwa kuwahurumia na msiitumikie miungu yao, kwa kuwa itakuwa mtego kwenu.

english: You may say in your heart, “These nations are greater than we are; how can we drive them out?”
ekegusii: “Moise goteeba ase chinkoro chiaino ime: Ebisaku ebi nigo bire ebinene gotobua, naki toranyaare kobiseeria birueo?
swahili: Mnaweza kujiuliza wenyewe “Mataifa haya ni yenye nguvu kuliko sisi. Tutawezaje kuwafukuza?”

english: But do not be afraid of them. Be sure to remember what the LORD your God did to Pharaoh and all Egypt:
ekegusii: Timobairoka, korende moinyore buna Omonene Nyasae oino, akorerete Farao na abanto bonsi ba Misiri.
swahili: Lakini msiwaogope. Kumbukeni vyema jinsi Bwana Mungu wenu alivyofanya kwa Farao na kwa wote huko Misri.

english: the great trials that you saw, the signs and wonders, and the mighty hand and outstretched arm by which the LORD your God brought you out. The LORD your God will do the same to all the peoples you now fear.
ekegusii: Moinyore amaakwa amanene aria mwarooche, na ebikone, na amakumia, na buna Omonene Nyasae oino, abarusetieo n’okoboko kwaye kore nechinguru, koramboire. Naboigo arakore abanto bonsi baria moirogete.
swahili: Mliona kwa macho yenu wenyewe majaribu makubwa, ishara za miujiza na maajabu, mkono wenye nguvu na ulionyooshwa, ambao kwa huo Bwana Mungu wenu aliwatoa mtoke Misri. Bwana Mungu wenu atawafanyia hivyo watu wote ambao mnawaogopa sasa.

english: and when the LORD your God has delivered them over to you to defeat them, then you must devote them to complete destruction. Make no treaty with them and show them no mercy.
ekegusii: Ekero Omonene Nyasae oino, arabeeke abanto abwo ase amaboko aino, nainwe mobabue, goika mobaite na kobasiria kegima, timobaisa gokora okobwatana kw’ogotianania nabarabwo, gose kobarorera amaabera.
swahili: pia Bwana Mungu wako atakapowatia mkononi mwako na ukawashinda, basi ni lazima uwaangamize wote kabisa. Usifanye agano nao, wala usiwahurumie.

english: Moreover, the LORD your God will send the hornet against them until even the survivors hiding from you have perished.
ekegusii: Naende Omonene natome ebiaramba ase egati yabo bibarase, baria abatigari barebise korwa ase more, basire kegima.
swahili: Zaidi ya hayo, Bwana Mungu wenu atatuma manyigu miongoni mwao hadi yale mabaki watakaojificha waangamie.

english: Do not be terrified by them, for the LORD your God, who is among you, is a great and awesome God.
ekegusii: Timoondoka ase engencho yabo, ekiagera Omonene Nyasae oino, nigo are egati yaino, ere nere Nyasae omonene, naende oyo bw’okoondokia.
swahili: Msiingiwe na hofu kwa sababu yao, kwa kuwa Bwana Mungu wenu, ambaye yupo miongoni mwenu ni mkuu naye ni Mungu wa kutisha.

english: The LORD your God will drive out these nations before you little by little. You will not be enabled to eliminate them all at once, or the wild animals would multiply around you.
ekegusii: Omonene Nyasae oino, naseerie ebisaku ebio ng’orang’ora, birue ase more. Timobaisa kobiseeria biere kegima ase ekero ekemo gioka. Moise gokora bo, ching’iti chi’orosana nigo chiramentekane chibachaande.
swahili: Bwana Mungu wenu atawafukuza mataifa hayo mbele yenu kidogo kidogo. Hamtaruhusiwa kuwaondoa wote kwa mara moja, la sivyo wanyama mwitu wataongezeka na kuwa karibu nanyi.

english: But the LORD your God will give them over to you and throw them into great confusion, until they are destroyed.
ekegusii: Korende Omonene Nyasae oino, nabeeke ababisa baino ase amaboko aino, erio abatantanie, nainwe goika mobasirie kegima.
swahili: Lakini Bwana Mungu wenu atawatia watu hao mikononi mwenu, akiwatia katika kuchanganyikiwa kukubwa mpaka wawe wameangamizwa.

english: He will hand their kings over to you, and you will wipe out their names from under heaven. No one will be able to stand against you; you will annihilate them.
ekegusii: Nabeeke abarwoti babo ase amaboko aino, erio mobaite na kobasiria nonya n’amarieta abo tainyorwa ase ense. Omonto onde tari, nonya n’oyomo, oranyaare korwana nainwe na kobabua; goika mobasirie kegima.
swahili: Atawatia wafalme wao mikononi mwenu, nanyi mtayafuta majina yao chini ya mbingu. Hakuna hata mmoja atakayeweza kusimama dhidi yenu bali mtawaangamiza.

english: You must burn up the images of their gods; do not covet the silver and gold that is on them or take it for yourselves, or you will be ensnared by it; for it is detestable to the LORD your God.
ekegusii: Emegwekano yabo bagosasiima moyesambe n’omorero. Timogania koira chifeta gose chitaabu chire ase emegwekano eyio. Moise gochigania nigo chiraabe chikobatega. Ayio onsi nigo arabe okogeechia ase Omonene Nyasae oino.
swahili: Vinyago vya miungu yao mtavichoma moto. Msitamani fedha wala dhahabu iliyo juu yao, wala msizichukue kwa ajili yenu, la sivyo mtakuwa mmetekwa navyo. Kwa kuwa ni chukizo kwa Bwana Mungu wenu.

english: And you must not bring any detestable thing into your house, or you, like it, will be set apart for destruction. You are to utterly detest and abhor it, because it is set apart for destruction.
ekegusii: Timobaisa korenta okogeechia buna okwo ase chinyomba chiaino. Komorakore igo, nigo moraragererigwe. Mokogeeche na kogochaaya, ekiagera korokwo nigo koragereirie.”
swahili: Msilete vitu vya machukizo katika nyumba zenu kwani ninyi, mtatengwa kama vitu hivyo kwa maangamizo. Ukichukie kabisa kitu hicho kwa kuwa kimetengwa kwa maangamizo.

english: Do not intermarry with them. Do not give your daughters to their sons or take their daughters for your sons,
ekegusii: Timobaisa konyuomerana nabarabwo; timorua abana baino abaiseke ase abamura babo, gose timonyuomeria abana baino abamura ase abaiseke babo,
swahili: Usioane nao. Usimtoe binti yako kuolewa na mwanawe, au kumchukua binti yake aolewe na mwanao.

english: because they will turn your sons away from following Me to serve other gods. Then the anger of the LORD will burn against you, and He will swiftly destroy you.
ekegusii: ekiagera barabwo nigo baraonchore abana baino abamura batige gosasiima Omonene, erio bakorere chinyasae ching’ao. Eri’Omonene abaise koba n’endamwamu ase more, abasirie ara rimo rioka.
swahili: Kwa maana watamgeuza mwanao aache kunifuata, ili aitumikia miungu mingine, nayo hasira ya Bwana itawaka dhidi yako, naye atakuangamiza ghafula.

english: Instead, this is what you are to do to them: tear down their altars, smash their sacred pillars, cut down their Asherah poles, and burn their idols in the fire.
ekegusii: Aya naro morabakorere: Motagore ebisasimero biabo, mobutore chisiiro chiabo bagosasiima, monachane emete y’Asera, enyasae yabo enkuungu, na mosambe n’omorero emegwekano yabo bagosasiima,
swahili: Hili ndilo utakalowafanyia: Vunja madhabahu yao, vunja mawe yao ya kuabudia, katakata nguzo zao za Ashera na kuchoma sanamu zao kwa moto.

english: For you are a people holy to the LORD your God. The LORD your God has chosen you to be a people for His prized possession out of all peoples on the face of the earth.
ekegusii: ekiagera inwe n’abanto mwatananetwe koba abachenu ase Omonene Nyasae oino. Ere obachoorire mobe abanto baye omonyene kobua abanto bande bonsi bare ase ense.
swahili: Kwa kuwa wewe ni taifa takatifu kwa Bwana Mungu wako. Bwana Mungu wako amekuchagua wewe kutoka mataifa yote juu ya uso wa dunia kuwa watu wake, hazina yake ya thamani.

english: The LORD did not set His affection on you and choose you because you were more numerous than the other peoples, for you were the fewest of all peoples.
ekegusii: “Omonene tang’usetwe nainwe, gose tabachoorete ekiagera mwarenge abange kobua abanto bande (inwe nigo mwarenge abake mono kobua abanto bonsi),
swahili: Bwana hakuweka upendo wake juu yenu na kuwachagua kwa sababu mlikuwa wengi mno kuliko watu wengine, kwa maana ninyi ndio mliokuwa wachache sana kuliko mataifa yote.

english: But because the LORD loved you and kept the oath He swore to your fathers, He brought you out with a mighty hand and redeemed you from the house of slavery, from the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt.
ekegusii: korende ekiagera nigo abanchete, naende akagania goikerania eira eria arierete chisokoro chiaino. Ayio akagera Omonene akabang’anyia n’okoboko kwaye kore nechinguru, na kobabooria korwa ase ense y’obosomba korwa ase okoboko gwa Farao, omorwoti o Misiri.
swahili: Lakini ni kwa sababu Bwana aliwapenda ninyi na kutunza kiapo alichowaapia babu zenu kwamba atawatoa ninyi kwa mkono wenye nguvu na kuwakomboa kutoka nchi ya utumwa, kutoka nguvu za Farao mfalme wa Misri.

english: Know therefore that the LORD your God is God, the faithful God who keeps His covenant of loving devotion for a thousand generations of those who love Him and keep His commandments.
ekegusii: Gaki manya ng’a Omonene Nyasae oino, nere bweka Nyasae bw’ekeene, naende Nyasae bw’obwegenwa, oyokorenda okobwatana kwaye kw’ogotianania, na koorokia obwanchani bwaye botari koera goika ebiaare chilifu ase baria bamwanchete na babwatete amachiiko aye.
swahili: Basi ujue kwamba Bwana Mungu wako ndiye Mungu; ni Mungu mwaminifu, anayetunza Agano la upendo kwa maelfu ya vizazi vya wale wanaompenda na kuzishika amri zake.

english: You must carefully follow every commandment I am giving you today, so that you may live and multiply, and enter and possess the land that the LORD swore to give your fathers.
ekegusii: “Moigwere amachiiko aya onsi nabaeire ase rituko ria reero, moyabwate, erio nario moraabe moyo na komentekana, erinde mogende moire ense eri’Omonene arierete chisokoro chiaino eira ng’a n’abayee.
swahili: Uwe mwangalifu kufuata kila agizo ninalokupa wewe leo, ili mweze kuishi, kuongezeka na mweze kuingia mkamiliki nchi ambayo Bwana aliahidi kwa kiapo kwa baba zenu.

english: When you eat and are satisfied, you are to bless the LORD your God for the good land that He has given you.
ekegusii: ’Namonyoore endagera morie moisaneke. Erio motogie Omonene Nyasae oino, ase engencho y’ense eyio engiya abaeire. Ogokuurerwa ase ogotamweba Omonene
swahili: Wakati mtakapokwisha kula na kushiba, msifuni Bwana Mungu wenu kwa ajili ya nchi nzuri aliyowapa.

english: Be careful not to forget the LORD your God by failing to keep His commandments and ordinances and statutes, which I am giving you this day.
ekegusii: “Mwerende mono, timobaisa kweba Omonene Nyasae oino. Timobaisa gotiga kobwata amachiiko aye, na emeroberio yaye yonsi echiikire, aya ’nkobaa ase rituko ria reero.
swahili: Jihadharini msimsahau Bwana Mungu wenu, mkashindwa kushika maagizo yake, sheria na amri zake ambazo ninawapa leo.

english: Otherwise, when you eat and are satisfied, when you build fine houses in which to dwell,
ekegusii: Ekero moraabe mwanyorire endagera ebaisaine na koigota, naende mwaagachire chinyomba chingiya na komenyao,
swahili: Angalia wakati mtakapokuwa mmekula na kushiba, mkajenga nyumba nzuri na kukaa humo,

english: and when your herds and flocks grow large and your silver and gold increase and all that you have is multiplied,
ekegusii: na ekero amaicho aino ye’chiombe na aye’ching’ondi arabe amentekanire, ne’chifeta, ne’chitaabu chiaino boigo, n’ebinto binde bionsi mobwate biramentekane,
swahili: na wakati makundi yenu ya ngʼombe na mbuzi na kondoo yatakapoongezeka na fedha na dhahabu yenu itakapoongezeka na vyote mlivyo navyo vitakapozidishwa,

english: then your heart will become proud, and you will forget the LORD your God who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.
ekegusii: timobaisa koenena na kweba Omonene Nyasae oino, oy’obarusetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri, ense y’obosomba.
swahili: basi mioyo yenu isiwe na kiburi mkamsahau Bwana Mungu wenu aliyewatoa katika nchi ya Misri, kutoka nchi ya utumwa.

english: He led you through the vast and terrifying wilderness with its venomous snakes and scorpions, a thirsty and waterless land. He brought you water from the rock of flint.
ekegusii: Akabaraa na kobaetia ase erooro enene eyarenge ey’okoondokia, eyarenge ne’ching’iti chingeenda inse chire n’obosongo, n’ebiuge boigo: ase erooro eria enyomo etabwate amaache ere akababochorera amaache korwa ase egetare keria egekong’u.
swahili: Aliwaongoza kupitia jangwa lile kubwa na la kutisha, nchi ile ya kiu isiyo na maji, yenye nyoka wa sumu na nge. Aliwatolea maji kutoka kwenye mwamba mgumu.

english: He fed you in the wilderness with manna that your fathers had not known, in order to humble you and test you, so that in the end He might cause you to prosper.
ekegusii: Agwo ase erooro akabaa mana mokaria, endagera chisokoro chiaino chitamanyete, anyare kobakora mobe abaitongo na kobateema, erinde ase omoerio oino abakorere amaya.
swahili: Aliwapa mana ya kula jangwani, kitu ambacho baba zenu hawakukijua, ili kuwanyenyekesha na kuwajaribu ninyi ili mwishoni apate kuwatendea mema.

english: You might say in your heart, “The power and strength of my hands have made this wealth for me.”
ekegusii: Mwerende, timobaisa gokwana ase chinkoro chiaino ime: Okobua gwaito ne chinguru chi’amaboko aito nachio chiatonyoreire obotenenku obo.
swahili: Mnaweza kusema, “Uwezo wangu na nguvu za mikono yangu ndizo zilizonipatia utajiri huu.”

english: But remember that it is the LORD your God who gives you the power to gain wealth, in order to confirm His covenant that He swore to your fathers even to this day.
ekegusii: Moinyore ng’a Omonene Nyasae oino, nere okobaa chinguru chi’okonyoora obotenenku, ekiagera aganetie gokong’ia okobwatana kwaye kw’ogotianania okwo akorete ne’chisokoro chiaino buna akorire goika reero iga.
swahili: Lakini kumbukeni Bwana Mungu wenu, ndiye ambaye huwapa uwezo wa kupata utajiri, na hivyo kulithibitisha Agano lake, ambalo aliwaapia baba zenu, kama ilivyo leo.

english: If you ever forget the LORD your God and go after other gods to worship and bow down to them, I testify against you today that you will surely perish.
ekegusii: Komoramwebe Omonene Nyasae oino, na koonchoka gochia ase chinyasae ching’ao ase ogochikorera, na gochisasiima, nabakuureire ase rituko ria reero ng’a, ekeene, goika mosire kegima.
swahili: Ikiwa mtamsahau Bwana Mungu wenu, mkaifuata miungu mingine, mkaiabudu na kuisujudia, ninashuhudia dhidi yenu leo kwamba hakika mtaangamizwa.

english: Remember that these forty years the LORD your God led you all the way in the wilderness, so that He might humble you and test you in order to know what was in your heart, whether or not you would keep His commandments.
ekegusii: Moinyore buna Omonene Nyasae oino, abeire okobaraa ase orogeendo rwaino rwonsi ase erooro, ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ene yaetire, ase okobakora mobe abaitongo na kobateema ase okomanya ebirengerio biaino, arore gose ’moganetie korenda amachiiko aye, gose yaya.
swahili: Kumbuka jinsi Bwana Mungu wenu alivyowaongoza katika njia yote katika jangwa kwa miaka hii arobaini, kukunyenyekeza na kukujaribu ili ajue lililoko moyoni mwako, kwamba utayashika maagizo yake au la.

english: Like the nations that the LORD has destroyed before you, so you will perish if you do not obey the LORD your God.
ekegusii: Buna ebisaku biria, Omonene arasirie korwa ase amasio aino, naboigo nainwe morasirigwe, ekiagera motaigwerete eriogi ri’Omonene Nyasae oino.”
swahili: Kama mataifa Bwana aliyoyaangamiza mbele yenu, ndivyo ninyi mtakavyoangamizwa kwa kutokumtii Bwana Mungu wenu.

english: He humbled you, and in your hunger He gave you manna to eat, which neither you nor your fathers had known, so that you might understand that man does not live on bread alone, but on every word that comes from the mouth of the LORD.
ekegusii: Akabakora mokaba abaitongo, akabatiga mokaba n’enchara. Erio akabaa mana, endagera gete eyio inwe motamanyete, nonya ne’chisokoro chiaino chitamanyete, erinde monyaare komanya ng’a omonto takonyaara koba moyo ase endagera yoka, korende nigo akoba moyo ase kera ring’ana riikorwa ase omonwa bw’Omonene.
swahili: Alikudhili na kukufanya uone njaa kisha akulishe kwa mana, ambayo wewe wala baba zako hamkuijua, awafundishe kuwa mwanadamu hataishi kwa mkate tu bali kwa kila neno litokalo katika kinywa cha Bwana.

english: Your clothing did not wear out and your feet did not swell during these forty years.
ekegusii: Ase emiaka eyio yonsi emerongo ene, chianga chiano tichiabagoterete, gose amagoro aino tabiimbete.
swahili: Nguo zenu hazikuchakaa wala miguu yenu haikuvimba kwa miaka hii arobaini.

english: So know in your heart that just as a man disciplines his son, so the LORD your God disciplines you.
ekegusii: Momanye ng’a, buna omonto akoa omwana oye egesusuro ase okomoorongeyia, naboigo n’Omonene Nyasae oino, akobaa egesusuro ase okobarongeyia.
swahili: Mjue basi ndani ya mioyo yenu kama mtu anavyomwadibisha mwanawe, ndivyo Bwana Mungu wako atawaadibisha ninyi.

english: Therefore you shall keep the commandments of the LORD your God, walking in His ways and fearing Him.
ekegusii: Ase ayio mobwate amachiiko a y’Omonene Nyasae oino, ase ogotaara ase chinchera chiaye na komoiroka.
swahili: Shikeni maagizo ya Bwana Mungu wenu mtembee katika njia zake na kumheshimu.

english: For the LORD your God is bringing you into a good land, a land of brooks and fountains and springs that flow through the valleys and hills;
ekegusii: Omonene Nyasae oino, ’nkobaira are ase ense engiya ebwate chindooche ne’chinsooko, ne’chintuboka chigosookia amaache gochia ase amagoko na ase ebitunwa.
swahili: Kwa kuwa Bwana Mungu wenu anawaleta katika nchi nzuri, nchi yenye vijito na mabwawa ya maji, yenye chemchemi zinazotiririka mabondeni na katika vilima;

english: a land of wheat, barley, vines, fig trees, and pomegranates; a land of olive oil and honey;
ekegusii: Ense eyio ere n’engano n’esairi, n’emesabibu, n’emeko, n’emekomomanga, n’emezeituni, boigo n’amooke.
swahili: nchi yenye ngano na shayiri, mizabibu na mitini, mikomamanga, mafuta ya zeituni na asali;

english: a land where you will eat food without scarcity, where you will lack nothing; a land whose rocks are iron and whose hills are ready to be mined for copper.
ekegusii: Ase ense eyio inamorie endagera enyinge etari kobaerera; aroro timokoremerwa gento kende gionsi. Amagena areo nigo are n’ebioma, naende ’namoremere chitaai korwa ase ebitunwa biaye.
swahili: nchi ambayo chakula hakitapungua na hamtakosa chochote; nchi ambayo miamba yake ni chuma na mnaweza kuchimba shaba kutoka kwenye vilima.

english: Hear, O Israel: Today you are about to cross the Jordan to go in and dispossess nations greater and stronger than you, with large cities fortified to the heavens.
ekegusii: “Inwe Abaisraeli, tegerera moigwe! Ase rituko ria reero mwabeire ang’e kwamboka Yorodani kogeenda koira ense y’ebisaku bire ebinene mono, naende bire ne chinguru kobabua. Emechie yabo n’emenene, naende nigo egiteire chindwaki chintambe gochia igoro.
swahili: Sikiliza, ee Israeli. Sasa mnakaribia kuvuka Yordani mwingie na kuwafukuza mataifa makubwa na yenye nguvu kuliko ninyi pamoja na miji mikubwa yenye kuta zilizofika juu angani.

english: Then the LORD gave me the two stone tablets, inscribed by the finger of God with the exact words that the LORD spoke to you out of the fire on the mountain on the day of the assembly.
ekegusii: Omonene akang’a chibao chiria ibere chi’amagena echio Ere Omonyene ariigete n’ekiara kiaye. Nigo chiariikire amang’ana onsi Omonene konya akwanire nainwe agwo ase egetunwa korwa ase egati‐gati y’omorero, ekero mwasangererekanete aroro.
swahili: Bwana alinipa mbao mbili za mawe zilizoandikwa kwa kidole cha Mungu. Juu ya mbao hizo kulikuwepo amri zote ambazo Bwana aliwatangazia kule mlimani kwa njia ya moto, siku ya kusanyiko.

english: And at the end of forty days and forty nights, the LORD gave me the two stone tablets, the tablets of the covenant.
ekegusii: Ase omoerio bw’amatuko aria emerongo ene, omobaso na obotuko, Omonene akang’a chibao chiria ibere chi’amagena echio chiariikire okobwatana kw’ogotianania.
swahili: Mwisho wa siku arobaini usiku na mchana, Bwana alinipa mbao mbili za mawe, mbao za Agano.

english: And the LORD said to me, “Get up and go down from here at once, for your people, whom you brought out of Egypt, have corrupted themselves. How quickly they have turned aside from the way that I commanded them! They have made for themselves a molten image.”
ekegusii: “Eri’Omonene aganteebia: Imoka otirimboke bwango korwa aiga ase egetunwa, ekiagera abanto abwo kwang’anyetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri bakorire ebibe. Baonchokire bwango, batigire enchera eria nabachiigete kobwatia. Beroiseirie omogwekano bw’ogosasiimwa onyititoire na kobombwa.
swahili: Kisha Bwana akaniambia, “Shuka chini mara moja, kwa sababu watu wako ambao umewatoa katika nchi ya Misri wamepotoka. Wamegeukia mbali haraka kutoka lile nililowaagiza, wamejitengenezea sanamu ya kusubu.”

english: The LORD also said to me, “I have seen this people, and they are indeed a stiff-necked people.
ekegusii: “Boigo Omonene agakwana nainche, aganteebia: Narorire abanto aba ng’a n’abanyabigoti bikong’u.
swahili: Naye Bwana akaniambia, “Nimewaona watu hawa nao ni watu wenye shingo ngumu sana!

english: Leave Me alone, so that I may destroy them and blot out their name from under heaven. Then I will make you into a nation mightier and greater than they are.”
ekegusii: Tobaisa goteema gontanga, ’ntige imbasirie naende intinyie amarieta abo, nimbakore beebwe kegima, tibaabaisa koinyorwa ase ense, erio ’ngokore aye obe egesaku ekenene, naende kere ne chinguru kobabua.
swahili: Niache, ili nipate kuwaangamiza na kufuta jina lao kutoka chini ya mbingu. Nami nitakufanya kuwa taifa lenye nguvu zaidi na kuwa wengi kuliko wao.”

english: So I went back down the mountain while it was blazing with fire, with the two tablets of the covenant in my hands.
ekegusii: “Nkairana, ngatirimboka korwa ase egetunwa imbogoretie ase amaboko ane abere chibao chiria ibere chi’amagena chiariikire okobwatana kw’ogotianania. Egetunwa keria nigo kiarenge gwoka omorero.
swahili: Kwa hiyo niligeuka na kuteremka kutoka mlimani kwani mlima ulikuwa ukiwaka moto. Pia vibao vile viwili vya Agano vilikuwa mikononi mwangu.

english: And I saw how you had sinned against the LORD your God; you had made for yourselves a molten calf. You had turned aside quickly from the way that the LORD had commanded you.
ekegusii: Erio ’nkarora ng’a mwakorire ebibe ase Omonene, Nyasae oino: konya mweroiseirie omogwekano bw’emori onyititoire na kobombwa, na mwaonchokire bwango, mwatigire enchera eri’Omonene abachiigete mobwatie.
swahili: Nilipotazama, niliona kuwa mmefanya dhambi dhidi ya Bwana Mungu wenu; mmejifanyia sanamu ya kusubu katika umbo la ndama. Mmegeuka upesi kutoka njia ile Bwana aliyowaagiza.

english: So I took the two tablets and threw them out of my hands, shattering them before your eyes.
ekegusii: ’Nkabwata chibao chiria ibere chi’amagena ase amaboko ane, ’ngachiakera inse, ’ngachiatera agwo ase amasio aino.
swahili: Kwa hiyo nilichukua vibao vile viwili nikavitupa na kuvipasua vipande vipande mbele ya macho yenu.

english: Then I fell down before the LORD for forty days and forty nights, as I had done the first time. I did not eat bread or drink water because of all the sin you had committed in doing what was evil in the sight of the LORD and provoking Him to anger.
ekegusii: Erio naende ’nkarara maumama ase obosio bw’Omonene buna agwo ritang’ani, ase engaki y’amatuko emeronge ene, omobaso n’obotuko. Tinabeete ’nkoria kende gose konywa, ase engencho y’ebibe bionsi inwe konya mwakorire, ase ogokora amabe ase obosio bw’Omonene, mokamogeechia goika akaba n’endamwamu.
swahili: Ndipo tena nikasujudu mbele za Bwana kwa siku arobaini usiku na mchana. Sikula mkate wala sikunywa maji, kwa sababu ya dhambi yote mliyoifanya, mkifanya lile lililo ovu mbele za Bwana na kumkasirisha.

english: For I was afraid of the anger and wrath that the LORD had directed against you, enough to destroy you. But the LORD listened to me this time as well.
ekegusii: Nigo nabeete n’obwoba obonene ase engencho y’endamwamu entindi Omonene abeete nero ase more, ekiagera nigo ageechetigwe mono, goika akaba ang’e kobaita. Korende nonya nase engaki eri’Omonene akanyigwa.
swahili: Niliogopa hasira na ghadhabu ya Bwana, kwa kuwa aliwakasirikia vya kutosha na kutaka kuwaangamiza. Lakini Bwana alinisikiliza tena.

english: The people are strong and tall, the descendants of the Anakim. You know about them, and you have heard it said, “Who can stand up to the sons of Anak?”
ekegusii: Abanto bakareo n’abanene, naende n’abatambe, abanto b’ororeeria rw’Anaki mwabeire mokoigwa chinkuma chiabo, bagokwanwa: Ning’o oranyaare kobua Abanaki?
swahili: Watu ni wenye nguvu na warefu, ni wana wa Waanaki! Mnafahamu habari zao na mmesikia inavyosemekana: “Ni nani awezaye kusimama dhidi ya Waanaki?”

english: The LORD was angry enough with Aaron to destroy him, but at that time I also prayed for Aaron.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo abeete n’endamwamu enene ase Aroni boigo, akaba ang’e komoita, korende ase engaki eria eria ’nkamosabera Aroni.
swahili: Bali yeye alimkasirikia Aroni kiasi cha kutaka kumwangamiza, nami wakati huo nilimwombea Aroni pia.

english: And I took that sinful thing, the calf you had made, and burned it in the fire. Then I crushed it and ground it to powder as fine as dust, and I cast it into the stream that came down from the mountain.
ekegusii: Nkabogoria egento keria ki’ebibe, emori eria konya mwaroisirie, ’nkayesamba n’omorero, n’kayesunyunta, ’nkayesia ekaba orotu. ’Ngatuguta orotu orwo ase akarooche karenge gotirimboka korwa ase egetunwa keria.
swahili: Kisha nikachukua ile sanamu ya ndama mliyoitengeneza na kuichoma kwenye moto. Nikaiponda na kuisaga ikawa unga laini kama vumbi, nikatupa lile vumbi kwenye kijito kilichotiririka toka mlimani.

english: You continued to provoke the LORD at Taberah, at Massah, and at Kibroth-hattaavah.
ekegusii: “Boigo naende mwagerete Omonene akaba n’endamwamu ekero mwarenge agwo Tabera, na Masa, na Kibiroti‐Hatawa.
swahili: Pia mlimkasirisha Bwana huko Tabera, Masa na Kibroth-Hataava.

english: And when the LORD sent you out from Kadesh-barnea, He said, “Go up and possess the land that I have given you.” But you rebelled against the command of the LORD your God. You neither believed Him nor obeyed Him.
ekegusii: Na ekero Omonene abatomete korwa Kadeshi‐Barinea akabateebia: Genda moire ense eria nabaeire, korende inwe mogasaria timwaigwera ogochika kw’Omonene, Nyasae oino; timwamwegenete gose koigwera eriogi riaye.
swahili: Vilevile wakati Bwana alipowatuma kutoka Kadesh-Barnea, alisema, “Kweeni, mkaimiliki nchi ambayo nimewapa.” Lakini mliasi dhidi ya agizo la Bwana Mungu wenu. Hamkumtegemea wala kumtii.

english: You have been rebelling against the LORD since the day I came to know you.
ekegusii: Ee, korwa nachagete kobamanya, mwabeire motari koigwera Omonene.
swahili: Mmekuwa waasi dhidi ya Bwana tangu nilipowajua ninyi.

english: So I fell down before the LORD for forty days and forty nights, because the LORD had said He would destroy you.
ekegusii: “Ase igo ’nkarara maumama ase obosio bw’Omonene ase engaki y’amatuko emerongo ene, omobaso n’obotuko, ekiagera Omonene nigo ateebete ng’a goika abasirie.
swahili: Nilianguka kifudifudi mbele za Bwana kwa zile siku arobaini usiku na mchana kwa sababu Bwana alikuwa amesema angewaangamiza ninyi.

english: And I prayed to the LORD and said, “O Lord GOD, do not destroy Your people, Your inheritance, whom You redeemed through Your greatness and brought out of Egypt with a mighty hand.
ekegusii: ’Ngasaba Omonene, ’ngakwana, Aye Omonene, tobaisa goita abanto bao aba bare omwando oo, aba gwatooretie ase okobua kwao okonene, aba kwarusetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri n’okoboko kwao kore ne chinguru.
swahili: Nilimwomba Bwana na kusema, “Ee Bwana Mwenyezi, usiangamize watu wako, urithi wako mwenyewe ule ulioukomboa kwa uweza wako mkuu na kuwatoa katika nchi ya Misri kwa mkono wenye nguvu.

english: Remember Your servants Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. Overlook the stubbornness of this people and the wickedness of their sin.
ekegusii: Inyora abasomba bao, Aburaamu, na Isaka, na Yakobo; tobaisa kobarera abanto aba ogotaigwera kwabo gose obonyaka bwabo, gose ebibe biabo.
swahili: Wakumbuke watumishi wako Abrahamu, Isaki na Yakobo. Usiangalie ukaidi wa watu hawa, uovu wao wala dhambi yao.

english: Otherwise, those in the land from which You brought us out will say, ‘Because the LORD was not able to bring them into the land He had promised them, and because He hated them, He has brought them out to kill them in the wilderness.’
ekegusii: Abamisiri nigo barabaise gokwana: Omonene nigo asinyetwe kobaira na kobaikia ase ense eria konya ariire eira ng’a abayee, naende nigo abageechete, nakio kiagerete akabarusia aiga, erinde agachia kobaitera agwo ase erooro.
swahili: Watu wa nchi ile uliyotutoa sisi wasije wakasema, ‘Ni kwa sababu Bwana hakuweza kuwachukua mpaka nchi aliyokuwa amewaahidia, kwa sababu aliwachukia, akawaleta ili aje kuwaua jangwani.’

english: But they are Your people, Your inheritance, whom You brought out by Your great power and outstretched arm.”
ekegusii: Aba n’abanto bao, na omwando oo, aba kwang’anyetie ne chinguru chinene, na ase okoboko kwao koramboire.”
swahili: Bali wao ni watu wako, urithi wako ule ulioutoa Misri kwa uweza wako mkuu na kwa mkono wako ulionyooka.”

english: But understand that today the LORD your God goes across ahead of you as a consuming fire; He will destroy them and subdue them before you. And you will drive them out and annihilate them swiftly, as the LORD has promised you.
ekegusii: Ase ayio manya bono ng’a Omonene Nyasae oino, oy’orabatang’ane inwe, nigo are buna omorero ogosamba. Ere nasirie abanto baria na kobabeeka inse yaino, erio nario moranyaare kobaseeria na kobaita bwango ara rimo rioka, buna abarierete inwe eira.
swahili: Kuweni na hakika leo kwamba Bwana Mungu wenu ndiye atakayetangulia kuvuka mbele yenu kama moto uteketezao. Atawaangamiza; atawatiisha mbele yenu. Nanyi mtawafukuza na kuwaangamiza mara moja, kama Bwana alivyowaahidi.

english: When the LORD your God has driven them out before you, do not say in your heart, “Because of my righteousness the LORD has brought me in to possess this land.” Rather, the LORD is driving out these nations before you because of their wickedness.
ekegusii: Ekero Omonene, Nyasae oino, arabe oseeririe abanto abwo korwa ase amasio aino, timobaisa gokwana ase chinkoro chiaino ime: Oboronge bwaito nabwo bwagera Omonene agatorenta toire ense eye. Taibo! Korende Omonene nigo araseerie abanto abwo barue ase amasio aino, ase engencho y’obobe bwabo.
swahili: Baada ya Bwana Mungu wenu kuwafukuza mbele yenu, msiseme mioyoni mwenu, “ Bwana ametuleta hapa kuimiliki nchi hii kwa sababu ya haki yetu.” La, ni kwa sababu ya uovu wa mataifa haya ndiyo Bwana anawafukuza mbele yenu.

english: It is not because of your righteousness or uprightness of heart that you are going in to possess their land, but it is because of their wickedness that the LORD your God is driving out these nations before you, to keep the promise He swore to your fathers, to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
ekegusii: Inwe timori gochia koira ense eria yabo ekiagera more abanyene oboronge, gose ab’ekeene ase chinkoro chiaino. Taibo! Korende obobe bw’ebisaku ebio nabwo bwagerire Omonene Nyasae oino, arabaseerie korwa ase amasio aino, erinde anyare goikerania eira ariete na gotiana ase chisokoro chiaino, Aburaamu, na Isaka na Yakobo.
swahili: Si kwa sababu ya haki yenu wala uadilifu wenu kwamba mtaimiliki nchi yao; lakini kwa sababu ya uovu wa mataifa haya, Bwana Mungu wenu atawafukuza mbele yenu, ili kutimiza lile alilowaapia baba zenu Abrahamu, Isaki na Yakobo.

english: Understand, then, that it is not because of your righteousness that the LORD your God is giving you this good land to possess, for you are a stiff-necked people. The Golden Calf (Exodus 32:1–35; Acts 7:39–43)
ekegusii: Ase ayio mobe n’obomaene ng’a Omonene Nyasae oino, tari gochia kobaa ense eria engiya ekiagera more abanyene oboronge. Taibo! Inwe nigo more abanto abanyabigoti bikong’u.”
swahili: Basi mjue, si kwa sababu ya haki yenu Bwana Mungu wenu anawapa nchi hii nzuri kuimiliki, kwa kuwa ninyi ni taifa lenye shingo ngumu. Ndama Ya Dhahabu

english: Remember this, and never forget how you provoked the LORD your God in the wilderness. From the day you left the land of Egypt until you reached this place, you have been rebelling against the LORD.
ekegusii: “Moinyore, timobaisa kweba buna mwagerete Omonene, Nyasae oino, akaba n’endamwamu agwo ase erooro. Korwa ase rituko riria mwaruete ase ense ya Misiri, goika ekero mwaigete aase aiga, mwabeire motari koigwera Omonene.
swahili: Kumbukeni hili, kamwe msisahau jinsi mlivyomkasirisha Bwana Mungu wenu kwa hasira huko jangwani. Tangu siku mlipotoka Misri mpaka mlipofika hapa, mmekuwa waasi dhidi ya Bwana.

english: At Horeb you provoked the LORD, and He was angry enough to destroy you.
ekegusii: Nonya n’ekero mwarenge agwo Horebu, mokagera Omonene akaba n’endamwamu enene, ere akebeeka ang’e kegima kobasiria.
swahili: Kule Horebu mliamsha ghadhabu ya Bwana, kwa hiyo alikasirika vya kutosha hata akataka kuwaangamiza.

english: When I went up on the mountain to receive the tablets of stone, the tablets of the covenant that the LORD made with you, I stayed on the mountain forty days and forty nights. I ate no bread and drank no water.
ekegusii: Ekero inche natiirete gochia ase egetunwa igoro koegwa chibao chiria chi’amagena chiariikire okobwatana kw’ogotianania kori’Omonene akorete nainwe, ’nkagenderera kobeera ase egetunwa igoro ase amatuko emerongo ene, omobaso n’obotuko, tinare koria kende, gose konywa.
swahili: Nilipopanda mlimani kupokea mbao za mawe, mbao za Agano lile Bwana alilofanya nanyi, nilikaa mlimani siku arobaini usiku na mchana, sikula mkate wala sikunywa maji.

english: As dead flies bring a stench to the perfumer’s oil, so a little folly outweighs wisdom and honor.
ekegusii: Chingi chikwete nigo chikogundia amaguta akweakwa atioka bobe; naboigo na oboriri obosinini bokobua obong’aini na amasikani.
swahili: Kama vile nzi waliokufa huacha harufu mbaya kwenye manukato, ndivyo upumbavu kidogo huzidi nguvu hekima na heshima.

english: If the axe is dull and the blade unsharpened, more strength must be exerted, but skill produces success.
ekegusii: Onye omonto tagotieria ekioma ekero giatuire, rirorio goika abeeke chinguru chinyinge ase ogokora emeremo nakerokio, korende obong’aini nigo bogokonya omonto abue.
swahili: Kama shoka ni butu na halikunolewa, nguvu nyingi zinahitajika, lakini ustadi utaleta mafanikio.

english: If the snake bites before it is charmed, there is no profit for the charmer.
ekegusii: Omoebia ching’iti ching’enda inse aise gotiga eng’iti emorome ritang’ani atarayeebia, rirorio omoebia oyio nigo arabe bosa.
swahili: Kama nyoka akiuma kabla ya kufanyiwa uaguzi, mwaguzi hatahitajika tena.

english: The words of a wise man’s mouth are gracious, but the lips of a fool consume him.
ekegusii: Amang’ana akorua ase omonto omong’aini nigo akogera bwanchwa, korende aya akorua ase ebikoba bi’omoriri nigo akomosiria.
swahili: Maneno yatokayo kinywani mwa mtu mwenye hekima yana neema, bali mpumbavu huangamizwa na midomo yake mwenyewe.

english: The beginning of his talk is folly, and the end of his speech is evil madness.
ekegusii: Oyio omoriri nigo agochaka gokwana amang’ana ’oboriri, naende oyakoora nobobarimo obobe.
swahili: Mwanzoni maneno yake ni upumbavu, mwishoni ni wazimu mbaya,

english: Yet the fool multiplies words. No one knows what is coming, and who can tell him what will come after him?
ekegusii: Omoriri nigo are omonyamang’ana mange. Monto onde tamanyeti aya agochia koba. Ning’o oranyare komoteebia ekegochia koba korwa magega yaye.
swahili: naye mpumbavu huzidisha maneno. Hakuna yeyote ajuaye linalokuja, ni nani awezaye kueleza ni jambo gani litakalotokea baada yake?

english: The toil of a fool wearies him, for he does not know the way to the city.
ekegusii: Emeremo y’omoriri nigo ekomoorosia, goika osinywa komanya enchera ekogenda ase omochie.
swahili: Kazi ya mpumbavu humchosha mwenyewe, hajui njia iendayo mjini.

english: Woe to you, O land whose king is a youth, and whose princes feast in the morning.
ekegusii: Obobe nobwao, aye ense, ekero omorwoti oo are omwana, na abagaambi bao bakobeera ase emeyega y’okwegokia ase chingaki chia mambia.
swahili: Ole wako, ee nchi ambayo mfalme wako alikuwa mtumwa na ambayo wakuu wako hufanya karamu asubuhi.

english: Blessed are you, O land whose king is a son of nobles, and whose princes feast at the proper time— for strength and not for drunkenness.
ekegusii: Nosesenirie aye ense, ekero omorwoti oo are omonto omosike na omosibore; na abarai bao bakoragera ase engaki egwenerete, ase okonyora chinguru, korende tari ase ogotinda.
swahili: Heri wewe, ee nchi ambayo mfalme wako ni wa uzao wenye kuheshimika na ambayo wakuu wako hula chakula kwa wakati unaofaa: ili kupata nguvu na si kwa ajili ya ulevi.

english: Through laziness the roof caves in, and in the hands of the idle, the house leaks.
ekegusii: Ekero omonto are omworo ekerama ki’enyomba yaye nigo gekogwa, na ase engencho y’obworo obwo embura nigo egotwa imeo.
swahili: Kama mtu ni mvivu paa la nyumba huinama, kutokana na mikono milegevu, nyumba huvuja.

english: A feast is prepared for laughter, and wine makes life merry, but money is the answer for everything.
ekegusii: Emeyega ye chindagera nigo ekorenta omogooko, na edivai nigo egokora omonto bweigwa buya, na ase chitaabu nonyare kogora ebinto bionsi.
swahili: Karamu hufanywa kwa ajili ya kicheko, nao mvinyo hufurahisha maisha, lakini fedha ni jawabu la mambo yote.

english: A wise man’s heart inclines to the right, but the heart of a fool to the left.
ekegusii: Enkoro y’omonto omong’aini nigo ekomoraa gochia borio, korende ey’omoriri nigo ekomoraa gochia bomosi.
swahili: Moyo wa mwenye hekima huelekea kuume, lakini moyo wa mpumbavu huelekea kushoto.

english: Do not curse the king even in your thoughts, or curse the rich even in your bedroom, for a bird of the air may carry your words, and a winged creature may report your speech.
ekegusii: Tobaisa koragereria omorwoti nonya nase ebirengererio biao, gose tobaisa koragereria omonto omonda ekero ore ase akanyomba kao g’okorara. Oise gokora bo, enyoni nebaise koira amang’ana ao, gose egetongwa kere ne chimbaaba ngetebe amang’ana ayio.
swahili: Usimshutumu mfalme hata ikiwa ni katika mawazo yako, au kumlaani tajiri katika chumba chako cha kulala, kwa sababu ndege wa angani wanaweza kuchukua maneno yako, naye ndege anayeruka anaweza kutoa taarifa ya yale uliyosema.

english: Even as the fool walks along the road, his sense is lacking, and he shows everyone that he is a fool.
ekegusii: Nonya nekero omonto omoriri agotaara inchera nigo akoborwa okomanya, na igo omanyia kera omonto ng’a ere nomoriri.
swahili: Hata anapotembea barabarani, mpumbavu hukosa ufahamu na kudhihirisha kwa kila mmoja jinsi alivyo mpumbavu.

english: If the ruler’s temper flares against you, do not abandon your post, for calmness lays great offenses to rest.
ekegusii: Omogambi karabe nendamwamu asore, tobaisa gotiga emeremo yao, ekiagera oboremereria nigo boragere ebibe ebinene biaberwe.
swahili: Kama hasira ya mtawala ikiwaka dhidi yako, usiache mahali pako, utulivu huweza kuzuia makosa mengi.

english: There is an evil I have seen under the sun— an error that proceeds from the ruler:
ekegusii: Aiga inse y’erioba narorire obobe, na obobe obo nigo bokorentwa nabagaambi:
swahili: Kuna ubaya niliouona chini ya jua, aina ya kosa litokalo kwa mtawala:

english: Folly is appointed to great heights, but the rich sit in lowly positions.
ekegusii: Omoriri nigo akoegwa amasikani amanene, ekero abanto abanda bagendererete goikaransa aase a inse.
swahili: Wapumbavu kuwekwa kwenye nafasi nyingi za juu, wakati matajiri hushika nafasi za chini.

english: I have seen slaves on horseback, while princes go on foot like slaves.
ekegusii: Narorire abasomba bariinete chibarasi, na abagaambi bagotaara namagoro buna abasomba.
swahili: Mimi nimeona watumwa wamepanda farasi, wakati wakuu wakitembea kwa miguu kama watumwa.

english: He who digs a pit may fall into it, and he who breaches a wall may be bitten by a snake.
ekegusii: Omonto ogokunya engoro, nere oragwe imeo, na oyo okobochora enyasi, eng’iti engenda inse nemorome.
swahili: Yeye achimbaye shimo aweza kutumbukia ndani yake, yeyote abomoaye ukuta anaweza kuumwa na nyoka.

english: The one who quarries stones may be injured by them, and he who splits logs endangers himself.
ekegusii: Oyo ogwatia amagena nigo araakwe naro, na oyo ogwatia emete, ande nanyore obokong’u asero.
swahili: Yeyote apasuaye mawe inawezekana yakamuumiza, yeyote apasuaye magogo inawezekana yakamuumiza.

english: Cast your bread upon the waters, for after many days you will find it again.
ekegusii: Eteria endagera yao igoro ye chinyancha, na magega y’amatuko amange nekoiranere.
swahili: Tupa mkate wako juu ya maji, kwa maana baada ya siku nyingi utaupata tena.

english: So banish sorrow from your heart, and cast off pain from your body, for youth and vigor are fleeting.
ekegusii: Ase ayio tiga aya akogochanda arue ase enkoro yao, na aya akorenta obororo ase omobere oo arue boigo, ekiagera obosae na obuya bw’obogima nigo bore bosa.
swahili: Kwa hiyo basi, ondoa wasiwasi moyoni mwako na utupilie mbali masumbufu ya mwili wako, kwa kuwa ujana na nguvu ni ubatili.

english: Divide your portion among seven, or even eight, for you do not know what disaster may befall the land.
ekegusii: Atanana ebi obwate oe abanto batano na babere, gose batano na batato, ekiagera tomanyeti amabe agochia konyora ense.
swahili: Wape sehemu watu saba, naam hata wanane, kwa maana hujui ni baa gani litakalokuwa juu ya nchi.

english: If the clouds are full, they will pour out rain upon the earth; whether a tree falls to the south or to the north, in the place where it falls, there it will lie.
ekegusii: Amare gaichoire nembura, nigo embura eyio egotwa igoro ase ense, na omote koragwe ororie ensemo ya Irianyi gose eya sugusu, nigo oragenderere kobeera inse agwo ase ogwete.
swahili: Kama mawingu yamejaa maji, hunyesha mvua juu ya nchi. Kama mti ukianguka kuelekea kusini au kuelekea kaskazini, mahali ulipoangukia, hapo ndipo utakapolala.

english: He who watches the wind will fail to sow, and he who observes the clouds will fail to reap.
ekegusii: Omonto okona‐korigereria komanya igoro y’embeo tagosimeka, na oyo okona‐korigereria amare buna are takogesa.
swahili: Yeyote atazamaye upepo hatapanda, yeyote aangaliaye mawingu hatavuna.

english: As you do not know the path of the wind, or how the bones are formed in a mother’s womb, so you cannot understand the work of God, the Maker of all things.
ekegusii: Buna otamanyeti ase embeo ekogusa gochia, gose buna amauga ’omwana ore ase enda ya ng’ina agokina, naboigo tokonyara komanya emeremo ya Nyasae oyio ogokora amang’ana onsi.
swahili: Kama vile usivyofahamu njia ya upepo, au jinsi mwili uumbwavyo ndani ya tumbo la mama, vivyo hivyo huwezi kufahamu kazi ya Mungu, Muumba wa vitu vyote.

english: Sow your seed in the morning, and do not rest your hands in the evening, for you do not know which will succeed, whether this or that, or if both will equally prosper. Enjoy Your Years
ekegusii: Busura embusuro yao mambia, nonya mogoroba totiga koyebusura, ekiagera tomanyeti eye erame, neye gose neria, gose nchionsi amo chirame buya.
swahili: Panda mbegu yako asubuhi, nako jioni usiruhusu mikono yako ilegee, kwa maana hujui ni ipi itakayofanikiwa, kwamba ni hii au ni ile, au kwamba zote zitafanikiwa sawasawa. Mkumbuke Muumba Wako Ukiwa Bado Kijana

english: Light is sweet, and it pleases the eyes to see the sun.
ekegusii: Omobaso nigo ore omwansu, na amaiso nigo akogokigwa korora erioba.
swahili: Nuru ni tamu, tena inafurahisha macho kuona jua.

english: So if a man lives many years, let him rejoice in them all. But let him remember the days of darkness, for they will be many. Everything to come is futile.
ekegusii: Omonto karagenderere koba moyo ase engaki y’emiaka emenge, tiga agokere engaki eyio yonsi, korende goika ainyore ng’a amatuko ’omosunte nabe amange mono. Onsi aya agochi‐gocha nigo are bosa. Ogosemigwa kw’abasae
swahili: Hata kama mtu ataishi miaka mingi kiasi gani, na aifurahie yote. Lakini na akumbuke siku za giza, kwa maana zitakuwa nyingi. Kila kitu kitakachokuja ni ubatili.

english: Rejoice, O young man, while you are young, and let your heart be glad in the days of your youth. Walk in the ways of your heart and in the sight of your eyes, but know that for all these things God will bring you to judgment.
ekegusii: Aye omosae, gokera engaki y’obosae bwao, tiga enkoro yao ekorentere omogooko ase amatuko ’obosae bwao; bwatia chinchera chi’okogania gw’enkoro yao, na aya amaiso ao akorora. Korende oinyore ng’a ase ayio onsi Nyasae nakorangerie ase ekiina.
swahili: Furahi ewe kijana, wakati ungali kijana, moyo wako na ukupe furaha katika siku za ujana wako. Fuata njia za moyo wako na chochote macho yako yaonayo, lakini ujue kwamba kwa ajili ya haya yote Mungu atakuleta hukumuni.

english: Remember your Creator in the days of your youth, before the days of adversity come and the years approach of which you will say, “I find no pleasure in them,”
ekegusii: Moinyore Omotongi oo ekero ore omosae, ekero amatuko amabe ataracha, na emiaka eyio emebe etaraika ang’e ekero oratebe, “Tindi nomogooko koba moyo ase engaki buna eye!”
swahili: Mkumbuke Muumba wako siku za ujana wako, kabla hazijaja siku za taabu, wala haijakaribia miaka utakaposema, “Mimi sifurahii hiyo”:

english: The Teacher searched to find delightful sayings and to record accurate words of truth.
ekegusii: Akarigia konyora amang’ana arenge kogokia, akarika amang’ana ’ekeene ase oboronge.
swahili: Mhubiri alitafiti ili kupata maneno sahihi na kila alichoandika kilikuwa sawa na kweli.

english: The words of the wise are like goads, and the anthologies of the masters are like firmly embedded nails driven by a single Shepherd.
ekegusii: Amang’ana abanto abang’aini bagokwana nigo anga buna chimbambo chinyoge, na aya basangereirie anga buna emesumari eakeire bokong’u. Ayio onsi nebiegwa korwa ase Omorisia oyomo.
swahili: Maneno ya wenye hekima ni kama mchokoro, mithali zao zilizokusanywa pamoja ni kama misumari iliyogongomewa ikawa imara, yaliyotolewa na Mchungaji mmoja.

english: And by these, my son, be further warned: There is no end to the making of many books, and much study wearies the body.
ekegusii: Aye omwana one, kobua ase aya onsi, igwera ogokuurerwa oko. Okorika ebitabu ebinge tikori nomoerio; ogosoma okonge nigo gokorosia omobere.
swahili: Tena zaidi ya hayo, mwanangu, kubali maonyo, hakuna mwisho wa kutunga vitabu vingi, nako kusoma sana huuchosha mwili.

english: When all has been heard, the conclusion of the matter is this: Fear God and keep His commandments, because this is the whole duty of man.
ekegusii: Amang’ana onsi aigurwe, Omoerio bw’amang’ana onsi noyo: Omoiroke Nyasae na obwate amachiiko aye, ekiagera ayio naro abanto bonsi bagwenerete bakore.
swahili: Hii ndiyo jumla ya maneno; yote yamekwisha sikiwa: Mche Mungu, nawe uzishike amri zake, maana kwa jumla ndiyo impasayo mtu.

english: For God will bring every deed into judgment, along with every hidden thing, whether good or evil.
ekegusii: Nyasae narente kera ogokora ase ekiina ekero aranachere obobisi bwonsi ekiina, karabe amaya gose amabe.
swahili: Kwa maana Mungu ataleta hukumuni kila kazi, pamoja na kila neno la siri, likiwa jema au baya.

english: before the light of the sun, moon, and stars is darkened, and the clouds return after the rain,
ekegusii: Omoinyore ekero erioba, na omobaso, na omotienyi, ne ching’enang’eni, bitarabekwa omosunte, gose amare atarairanerana embura koyature.
swahili: kabla jua na nuru, nao mwezi na nyota havijatiwa giza, kabla ya kurudi mawingu baada ya mvua;

english: on the day the keepers of the house tremble and the strong men stoop, when those grinding cease because they are few and those watching through windows see dimly,
ekegusii: Engaki eyio abarendi b’enyomba mbaiguswe, na abasacha bare ne chinguru bekumbe, na abagosia batige gosia ekiagera bare abake ase omobaro, na abwo batengerete korwa ase ebibao, batubwe norotutu tibarora buya.
swahili: siku ile walinzi wa nyumba watakapotetemeka, nao watu wenye nguvu watakapojiinamisha, wakati wasagao watakapokoma kwa sababu ya uchache, nao wachunguliao madirishani kutiwa giza;

english: when the doors to the street are shut and the sound of the mill fades away, when one rises at the sound of a bird and all the daughters of song grow faint,
ekegusii: Ebisieri birochie ase chinchera mbisiekwe, na amariogi ay’ogosia nakee; amariogi e chinyoni natabobore omonto korwa ase chitoro, na amariogi ’abaiseke bagotera nakee.
swahili: wakati milango ya kuingia barabarani itakapofungwa na sauti ya kusaga kufifia; wakati watu wataamshwa kwa sauti ya ndege, lakini nyimbo zao zote zikififia;

english: when men fear the heights and dangers of the road, when the almond tree blossoms, the grasshopper loses its spring, and the caper berry shrivels— for then man goes to his eternal home and mourners walk the streets.
ekegusii: Abanto nigo barabe nobwoba ase ebitiiro, na okogoswa kobe ase chinchera. Emelozi nesiche, na ebisase bibe bikwagura ng’ora ng’ora, na okogania gwonsi ngosire. Eyio nengaki Mwanyabaanto aragende ase obomenyo bwaye bwa kare na kare; abakona‐korera mbabe bakomochiera ekero ase ekero.
swahili: wakati watu watakapoogopa kilichoinuka juu na hatari zitakazokuwepo barabarani; wakati mlozi utakapochanua maua na panzi kujikokota nawe usiwe na shauku ya kitu chochote. Ndipo mwanadamu aiendea nyumba yake ya milele nao waombolezaji wakizunguka barabarani.

english: Remember Him before the silver cord is snapped and the golden bowl is crushed, before the pitcher is shattered at the spring and the wheel is broken at the well,
ekegusii: Engori eroisirie korwa ase efeta nebutorwe, na egetaabo keroisirie korwa ase etaabu ngiatwe, na enyongo yatwe agwo ase ensoko y’amaache, na ekebara‐bara nkebunwe agwo ase egesima ki’amaache.
swahili: Mkumbuke Muumba wako: kabla haijakatika kamba ya fedha, au bakuli la dhahabu halijavunjika; kabla mtungi kuvunjika kwenye chemchemi, au gurudumu kuvunjika kisimani,

english: before the dust returns to the ground from which it came and the spirit returns to God who gave it.
ekegusii: Erio orotu ndoirane, ase riroba buna rwarenge, na omoika oirane gochia ase Nyasae oria oyoruete.
swahili: nayo mavumbi kurudi ardhini yalikotoka, na roho kurudi kwa Mungu aliyeitoa.

english: “Futility of futilities,” says the Teacher. “Everything is futile!” The Whole Duty of Man
ekegusii: Ase ayio omorandia nigo agoteeba. Aya mbosa, bosa; onsi mbosa kegima. Okobeekwa amo kw’amang’ana
swahili: Mhubiri asema, “Ubatili! Ubatili! Kila kitu ni ubatili!” Hitimisho La Mambo

english: Not only was the Teacher wise, but he also taught the people knowledge; he pondered, searched out, and arranged many proverbs.
ekegusii: Ekiagera omorandia oria arenge omong’aini, akagenderera kworokereria abanto chisemi na korua ogosemia okuya. Agasangereria na gotuka, naende akaroisia emereng’anio emenge.
swahili: Mhubiri hakuwa tu na hekima, bali aliwagawia watu maarifa pia. Alitafakari na kutafiti na akaweka katika utaratibu mithali nyingi.

english: These are the words of the Teacher, the son of David, king in Jerusalem:
ekegusii: Aya naro amang’ana ’omorandia mosinto o Daudi, omorwoti o Yerusalemu.
swahili: Maneno ya Mhubiri, mwana wa Daudi, mfalme huko Yerusalemu:

english: Is there a case where one can say, “Look, this is new”? It has already existed in the ages before us.
ekegusii: Inee! Ing’ana rinde ndireo rigokwanwa ng’a neriyia? Yaya. Kera ring’ana nao riarenge korwa kare, intwe konya totarabao.
swahili: Kuna kitu chochote ambacho mtu anaweza kusema, “Tazama! Kitu hiki ni kipya”? Kilikuwepo tangu zamani za kale, kilikuwepo kabla ya wakati wetu.

english: There is no remembrance of those who came before, and those yet to come will not be remembered by those who follow after. With Wisdom Comes Sorrow
ekegusii: Amang’ana aetire takoinyorwa, gose ayagochi‐gocha takoinyorwa nabwo bakorwa magega. Aya omorandia eorokereirie
swahili: Hakuna kumbukumbu ya watu wa zamani, hata na wale ambao hawajaja bado hawatakumbukwa na wale watakaofuata baadaye. Hekima Ni Ubatili

english: I, the Teacher, was king over Israel in Jerusalem.
ekegusii: Inche omorandia nigo narenge omorwoti igoro ase Abaisraeli, agwo Yerusalemu.
swahili: Mimi, Mhubiri, nilikuwa mfalme wa Israeli katika Yerusalemu.

english: And I set my mind to seek and explore by wisdom all that is done under heaven. What a heavy burden God has laid upon the sons of men to occupy them!
ekegusii: Nkerua nenkoro yane korigia na komanya ase obong’aini amang’ana onsi agokoreka inse y’erioba. Nigo ere emeremo etari y’omogooko Nyasae aeire Mwanyabaanto bechande ase okoyekora.
swahili: Nilitumia muda wangu wote kujifunza na kuvumbua kwa hekima yote yanayofanyika chini ya mbingu. Jinsi gani Mungu ameweka mzigo mzito juu ya wanadamu!

english: I have seen all the things that are done under the sun, and have found them all to be futile, a pursuit of the wind.
ekegusii: Narigereirie kera egento kegokorwa inse y’erioba, narorire ng’a bionsi nigo bire bosa; nigo enga buna okominyokia embeo.
swahili: Nimeshaona mambo yote yanayotendeka chini ya jua, hayo yote ni ubatili, hii ni kukimbiza upepo.

english: What is crooked cannot be straightened, and what is lacking cannot be counted.
ekegusii: Egento giachiire bogeka tigekorongeigwa, na ekiaremire tigekobareka.
swahili: Kilichopindika hakiwezi kunyooshwa, kile ambacho hakipo haiwezekani kukihesabu.

english: I said to myself, “Behold, I have grown and increased in wisdom beyond all those before me who were over Jerusalem, and my mind has observed a wealth of wisdom and knowledge.”
ekegusii: Nkerengereria inche omonyene erio ngateeba, “Nenyoreire obong’aini obonge kobua abwo bonsi bantang’anerete kogamba agwo Yerusalemu. Enkoro yane yanyorire obong’aini obonge na okomanya okonge.”
swahili: Niliwaza mwenyewe, “Tazama, nimekua na kuongezeka katika hekima kuliko yeyote aliyewahi kutawala Yerusalemu kabla yangu. Nimekuwa na uzoefu mkubwa wa hekima na maarifa.”

english: So I set my mind to know wisdom and madness and folly; I learned that this, too, is a pursuit of the wind.
ekegusii: Naende nkerua nenkoro yane komanya goatanana gati y’echisemi, n’oboriri, obong’aini na obobarimo, korende nigo nanyorete ng’a ayio onsi akominyokerwa konyorwa nigo are buna embeo bosa.
swahili: Ndipo nilipojitahidi kufahamu kutofautisha hekima, wazimu na upumbavu, lakini nikatambua hata hili nalo ni kukimbiza upepo.

english: For with much wisdom comes much sorrow, and as knowledge grows, grief increases.
ekegusii: Ekiagera ase obong’aini obonge bore, nao omoichano omonge ore, na omonto okomenta chisemi, nigo akomenta obororo.
swahili: Kwa kuwa hekima nyingi huleta huzuni kubwa; maarifa yanapoongezeka, masikitiko yanaongezeka.

english: “Futility of futilities,” says the Teacher, “futility of futilities! Everything is futile!”
ekegusii: Omorandia nigo agoteeba: Mbosa na bosa kegima, mbosa, bosa. Amang’ana onsi mbosa.
swahili: “Ubatili mtupu! Ubatili mtupu!” Mhubiri anasema. “Ubatili mtupu! Kila kitu ni ubatili.”

english: What does a man gain from all his labor, at which he toils under the sun?
ekegusii: Mbitoki ki Mwanyabaanto akonyora ase okwerosia gokora emeremo emekong’u aiga inse y’erioba?
swahili: Mwanadamu anafaidi nini kutokana na kazi yake yote anayotaabikia chini ya jua?

english: Generations come and generations go, but the earth remains forever.
ekegusii: Ekegori ekemo nigo kegoeta, na ekende giacha, korende ense nigo egendererete kobao goika kare na kare.
swahili: Vizazi huja na vizazi hupita, lakini dunia inadumu milele.

english: The sun rises and the sun sets; it hurries back to where it rises.
ekegusii: Erioba nigo rigosoka naende riarimera, erio riaayerera gochia aase rigosoka korwa.
swahili: Jua huchomoza na jua huzama, nalo huharakisha kurudi mawioni.

english: The wind blows southward, then turns northward; round and round it swirls, ever returning on its course.
ekegusii: Embeo nigo ekogusa gochia Irianyi, naende yaonchoka yagusa gochia sugusu; nigo ekona‐goetanana yagenderera kogusa, naende yagenderera goetanana naende yairana.
swahili: Upepo huvuma kuelekea kusini na kugeukia kaskazini, hurudia mzunguko huo huo, daima ukirudia njia yake.

english: All the rivers flow into the sea, yet the sea is never full; to the place from which the streams come, there again they flow.
ekegusii: Chindooche chionsi nigo chikogenda ase enyancha, korende tiyana goichora. Amache ayio nigo akoirana gochia ase chindooche echio chiachakerete, naende agenderera kogenda.
swahili: Mito yote hutiririka baharini, hata hivyo bahari kamwe haijai. Mahali mito inapotoka, huko hurudi tena.

english: All things are wearisome, more than one can describe; the eye is not satisfied with seeing, nor the ear content with hearing.
ekegusii: Amang’ana onsi agokorwa nigo akorenta omooroso otanyare gokwaneka. Amaiso tari goisaneka naya akorora, na amato tari goisaneka naya akoigwa.
swahili: Vitu vyote vinachosha, zaidi kuliko mtu anavyoweza kusema. Jicho kamwe halitosheki kutazama, wala sikio halishibi kusikia.

english: What has been will be again, and what has been done will be done again; there is nothing new under the sun.
ekegusii: Aya arengeo kare, naro agochia kobao naende. Aya akoregete kare, naro agochia gokoreka naende. Ande tari are amayia inse y’erioba.
swahili: Kile kilichokuwepo kitakuwepo tena, kile kilichofanyika kitafanyika tena, hakuna kilicho kipya chini ya jua.

english: I said to myself, “Come now, I will test you with pleasure; enjoy what is good!” But it proved to be futile.
ekegusii: Ngakwana nenkoro yane, ngateba, “Bono ninteeme ndore naki omogooko ore, imbe nkwegokia omonyene.” Korende nonya nayio onsi nigo arenge bosa.
swahili: Nikafikiri moyoni mwangu, “Haya basi, nitakujaribu kwa anasa nione ni lipi lililo jema.” Lakini hilo nalo likaonekana ni ubatili.

english: Anything my eyes desired, I did not deny myself. I refused my heart no pleasure. For my heart took delight in all my work, and this was the reward for all my labor.
ekegusii: Egento kende gionsi narenge korora na gokegania tinare gwetanga gokenyora, gose tinarinete enkoro yane omogooko onde bwensi, ekiagera enkoro yane nigo yagokerete aya onsi nechanderete, na omogooko oyio noro orenge eng’eria yane y’emeremo yonsi nechanderete.
