swahili: Sikujinyima kitu chochote ambacho macho yangu yalikitamani, hakuna anasa ambayo niliunyima moyo wangu. Moyo wangu ulifurahia kazi zangu zote, hii ilikuwa thawabu ya kazi zangu zote.

english: Yet when I considered all the works that my hands had accomplished and what I had toiled to achieve, I found everything to be futile, a pursuit of the wind; there was nothing to be gained under the sun. The Wise and the Foolish
ekegusii: Magega y’ayio nkarengereria igoro y’emeremo eyio nakorete namaboko aane, na buna nayiechanderete. Naama! Ayio onsi nigo arenge bosa, na aya naminyokerete konyora nigo are buna embeo bosa, gose bitoki binde tibiri konyorekana inse y’erioba.
swahili: Hata hivyo nilipokuja kuangalia yote ambayo mikono yangu ilikuwa imefanya na yale niliyotaabika kukamilisha, kila kitu kilikuwa ni ubatili, ni kukimbiza upepo; hapakuwa na faida yoyote chini ya jua. Hekima Na Upumbavu Ni Ubatili

english: Then I turned to consider wisdom and madness and folly; for what more can the king’s successor do than what has already been accomplished?
ekegusii: Nkaonchora ebirengererio biane korigereria obong’aini na obobarimo, na oboriri. Omonto oyio okobekwa oborwoti ribaga ri’oyio orengeo, ninki arakore? Tagokora kende otatiga keria oyio omotang’ani akorete.
swahili: Kisha nikageuza mawazo yangu kufikiria hekima, wazimu na upumbavu. Ni nini zaidi mtu anayetawala baada ya mfalme anachoweza kufanya ambacho hakijafanywa?

english: And I saw that wisdom exceeds folly, just as light exceeds darkness:
ekegusii: Erio nkamanya ng’a obong’aini nigo bobuete oboriri, buna oborabu bobuete omosunte.
swahili: Nikaona kuwa hekima ni bora kuliko upumbavu, kama vile nuru ilivyo bora kuliko giza.

english: The wise man has eyes in his head, but the fool walks in darkness. Yet I also came to realize that one fate overcomes them both.
ekegusii: Omonto omong’aini nigo abwate amaiso ase omotwe oye, korende omonto omoriri nigo agotaara ase omosunte; nonya naboigo, nkarora ng’a bonsi nigo bakonyorwa negento ekemo.
swahili: Mtu mwenye hekima ana macho katika kichwa chake, lakini mpumbavu anatembea gizani; lakini nikaja kuona kwamba wote wawili hatima yao inafanana.

english: So I said to myself, “The fate of the fool will also befall me. What then have I gained by being wise?” And I said to myself that this too is futile.
ekegusii: Erio nkebooria, “Ande, amang’ana akomonyoora omoriri naro aranyore nainche, nase ki rende inche nabeire nobong’aini obonge?” Ase ayio ngeteebia ng’a aya boigo mbosa.
swahili: Kisha nikafikiri moyoni mwangu, “Hatima ya mpumbavu itanipata mimi pia. Nitafaidi nini basi kwa kuwa na hekima?” Nikasema moyoni mwangu, “Hili nalo ni ubatili.”

english: For there is no lasting remembrance of the wise, just as with the fool, seeing that both will be forgotten in the days to come. Alas, the wise man will die just like the fool!
ekegusii: Buna ere ase omonto omong’aini, naboigo ere nase omoriri, onde takogenderera koinyorwa; bonsi nigo barabe bebirwe kegima ase amatuko agochi‐gocha. Inee! Omonto omong’aini tagokwa buna oria omoriri agokwa?
swahili: Kwa maana kwa mtu mwenye hekima, kama ilivyo kwa mpumbavu, hatakumbukwa kwa muda mrefu, katika siku zijazo wote watasahaulika. Kama vile ilivyo kwa mpumbavu, mtu mwenye hekima pia lazima atakufa! Kutaabika Ni Ubatili

english: So I hated life, because the work that is done under the sun was grievous to me. For everything is futile and a pursuit of the wind. The Futility of Work
ekegusii: Ase ayio nkagecha obogima, ekiagera emeremo egokorwa inse y’erioba, nigo ekorenta obororo ase ’nde. Ayio onsi mbosa, na aya akominyokerwa konyorwa nigo are buna embeo bosa.
swahili: Kwa hiyo nikachukia maisha, kwa sababu kazi inayofanyika chini ya jua ilikuwa masikitiko kwangu. Yote hayo ni ubatili, ni kukimbiza upepo.

english: I hated all for which I had toiled under the sun, because I must leave it to the man who comes after me.
ekegusii: Nkagecha emeremo yonsi, eyio nabeete ngwechandera inse y’erioba, ekiagera goika ntigere omonto orambwatie ebinto ebio nakorire.
swahili: Nikachukia kila kitu nilichokuwa nimetaabikia chini ya jua, kwa sababu ni lazima nimwachie yule ajaye baada yangu.

english: And who knows whether that man will be wise or foolish? Yet he will take over all the labor at which I have worked skillfully under the sun. This too is futile.
ekegusii: Ning’o omanyete gose omonto oyio nigo arabe omong’aini, gose nigo arabe omoriri? Korende oyio goika aire ebinto ebio bionsi nechandeire inde nobong’aini kobinyora inse y’erioba. Ayio boigo mbosa.
swahili: Nani ajuaye kama atakuwa ni mtu mwenye hekima au mpumbavu? Lakini hata hivyo yeye ndiye atakayetawala kazi zote ambazo nimemiminia juhudi na ustadi chini ya jua. Hili nalo ni ubatili.

english: I said of laughter, “It is folly,” and of pleasure, “What does it accomplish?”
ekegusii: Nkanyora ng’a amaseko nigo are obobarimo, na omogooko tori gokora gento kende ekiya.
swahili: Nikasema, “Kicheko nacho ni upumbavu. Nayo matokeo ya anasa ni nini?”

english: So my heart began to despair over all the labor that I had done under the sun.
ekegusii: Ase ayio ngachaka goichana na gokwa omoyo ase engencho y’emeremo yonsi nechanderete inse y’erioba.
swahili: Kwa hiyo moyo wangu ukaanza kukata tamaa juu ya kazi yangu yote niliyoifanya kwa taabu chini ya jua.

english: When there is a man who has labored with wisdom, knowledge, and skill, and he must give his portion to a man who has not worked for it, this too is futile and a great evil.
ekegusii: Omonto nigo agokora emeremo emekong’u nobong’aini bwaye, ne chisemi, na okomanya kwaye, konyora ebinto, korende magega yaye atigera omonto omoao otabiechanderete okwegokia nabirobio. Ayio boigo mbosa, naende mbobe mono.
swahili: Kwa kuwa mtu anaweza kufanya kazi yake kwa hekima, maarifa na ustadi, kisha analazimika kuacha vyote alivyo navyo kwa mtu mwingine ambaye hajavifanyia kazi. Hili nalo pia ni ubatili tena ni balaa kubwa.

english: For what does a man get for all the toil and striving with which he labors under the sun?
ekegusii: Ngento ki omonto aranyore ekero akorire emeremo emekong’u na kwerosia mono inse y’erioba?
swahili: Mtu atapata nini kwa taabu yote na kuhangaika kwa bidii katika kazi anayotaabikia chini ya jua?

english: Indeed, all his days are filled with grief, and his task is sorrowful; even at night, his mind does not rest. This too is futile.
ekegusii: Nigo akoba nobokong’u ase amatuko aye onsi are moyo, na emeremo yaye emekong’u nigo ere ey’omoichano; nonya nase obotuko obogima ebirengererio biaye tibiri gotimoka. Ayio boigo mbosa.
swahili: Siku zake zote kazi yake ni maumivu na masikitiko, hata usiku akili yake haipati mapumziko. Hili nalo pia ni ubatili.

english: Nothing is better for a man than to eat and drink and enjoy his work. I have also seen that this is from the hand of God.
ekegusii: Egento ekiya omonto aranyare gokora nokoria na konywa, na kogokera ebinto ebio echandeire kobinyora. Nkamanya ng’a nonya nayio nigo akorwa ase okoboko kwa Nyasae.
swahili: Hakuna kitu bora anachoweza kufanya mtu zaidi ya kula na kunywa na kuridhika katika kazi yake. Hili nalo pia, ninaona, latokana na mkono wa Mungu,

english: For apart from Him, who can eat and who can find enjoyment?
ekegusii: Ning’o oranyare koria, gose konyora omogooko, onye tari amo n’Omonene?
swahili: kwa sababu pasipo yeye, ni nani awezaye kula na kufurahi?

english: To the man who is pleasing in His sight, He gives wisdom and knowledge and joy, but to the sinner He assigns the task of gathering and accumulating that which he will hand over to one who pleases God. This too is futile and a pursuit of the wind.
ekegusii: Nyasae nigo akoa omonto oyo okomogokia obong’aini, naende omoa okomanya, na omogooko, korende nigo akoa omonyabibe emeremo y’ogosangereria ebinto na kobigacha, korende omonto oria abie oria ogogetie Nyasae. Ayio boigo mbosa, na aya akominyokerwa konyorwa nigo are buna embeo bosa.
swahili: Kwa yule mtu anayempendeza Mungu, Mungu humpa hekima, maarifa na furaha, bali kwa mwenye dhambi Mungu humpa kazi ya kukusanya na kuhifadhi utajiri ili Mungu ampe yule anayempenda. Hili nalo pia ni ubatili, ni kukimbiza upepo.

english: I sought to cheer my body with wine and to embrace folly—my mind still guiding me with wisdom—until I could see what was worthwhile for men to do under heaven during the few days of their lives.
ekegusii: Ekero ebirengererio biane biarenge koraagwa nobong’aini, nkagania kogokia omobere one nekenyugwa ki’edivai, nkarigia kobwatia oboriri obwo, erinde ndore ayare amaya agwenerete Mwanyabaanto bakore inse y’erioba, ase amatuko ayio amake bagendererete koba moyo.
swahili: Nikajaribu kujifurahisha kwa mvinyo na kukumbatia upumbavu, huku bado akili yangu inaniongoza kwa hekima. Nilitaka kuona ni lipi bora watu wafanye kwa siku chache wanazoishi chini ya mbingu.

english: I expanded my pursuits. I built houses and planted vineyards for myself.
ekegusii: Ngakora emeremo emenene; nkeagachera chinyomba na gwesimekera emesabibu ase emegondo.
swahili: Nikafanya miradi mikubwa: Nikajijengea majumba na kulima mashamba ya mizabibu.

english: I made gardens and parks for myself, where I planted all kinds of fruit trees.
ekegusii: Nkeroiseria emegondo na emegondo ende y’amatunda, erio ngasimeka emete y’amatunda ao ao.
swahili: Nikatengeneza bustani na viwanja vya starehe nikaotesha huko kila aina ya miti ya matunda.

english: I built reservoirs to water my groves of flourishing trees.
ekegusii: Nkeroiseria amatibo ase nare korusia amaache nasiarera emete egokina ase rinani.
swahili: Nikajenga mabwawa ya kukusanya maji ya kunyweshea hii miti iliyokuwa inastawi vizuri.

english: I acquired menservants and maidservants, and servants were born in my house. I also owned more herds and flocks than anyone in Jerusalem before me,
ekegusii: Nkagora abasomba, abasacha na abakungu; abwo bakanyiborera abasomba bande ase enka yane; nigo nabwate amaicho amange e chiombe, ne chimbori, ne ching’ondi, nkabua abwo bonsi bantang’anerete kogamba agwo Yerusalemu.
swahili: Nikanunua watumwa wa kiume na wa kike na watumwa wengine walizaliwa nyumbani mwangu. Pia nilikuwa na makundi ya ngʼombe, kondoo na mbuzi kuliko mtu yeyote aliyewahi kuishi Yerusalemu kabla yangu.

english: and I accumulated for myself silver and gold and the treasure of kings and provinces. I gathered to myself male and female singers, and the delights of the sons of men—many concubines.
ekegusii: Boigo ngasangereria chifeta ne chitaabu, amo ne chimonga chi’abarwoti na echie chingongo chi’oborwoti bwane; ngatwara abateeri, abasacha na abakungu, naende ngatwara abakungu abange Mwanyabaanto bagosanera.
swahili: Nikajikusanyia fedha na dhahabu, hazina za wafalme na za majimbo. Nikajipatia waimbaji wanaume na wanawake, nazo nyumba za masuria: vitu ambavyo moyo wa mwanadamu hufurahia.

english: So I became great and surpassed all in Jerusalem who had preceded me; and my wisdom remained with me.
ekegusii: Ase ayio nkaba omonto bw’amasikani amanene, nkabua abwo bantang’anerete kogamba agwo Yerusalemu; boigo obong’aini bwane bogantigarera.
swahili: Nikawa maarufu sana kuliko mtu mwingine yeyote aliyepata kuishi Yerusalemu kabla yangu. Katika haya yote bado nikawa nina hekima.

english: To everything there is a season, and a time for every purpose under heaven:
ekegusii: Kera egento nkere nekero kiaye, na aiga inse y’erioba kera ekegokorekana nkere nengaki yaye.
swahili: Kuna wakati kwa ajili ya kila jambo, nayo majira kwa kila tendo chini ya mbingu:

english: I have seen the burden that God has laid upon the sons of men to occupy them.
ekegusii: Narorire obokong’u obwo Nyasae aeire Mwanyabaanto bechande naborobwo.
swahili: Nimeona mzigo Mungu alioweka juu ya wanadamu.

english: He has made everything beautiful in its time. He has also set eternity in the hearts of men, yet they cannot fathom the work that God has done from beginning to end.
ekegusii: Okorire kera egento kiabeire egeseera ase engaki yaye, naende obekire ime ase chinkoro chia Mwanyabaanto engaki etabe nomoerio. Korende nonya naboigo tibakonyara komanya aya Nyasae akorete korwa omochakano goika omoerio.
swahili: Amefanya kila kitu kiwe kizuri kwa wakati wake. Pia ameiweka hiyo milele katika mioyo ya wanadamu, wala hawawezi kutambua kwa kina yale ambayo Mungu amefanya tangu mwanzo hadi mwisho.

english: I know that there is nothing better for them than to rejoice and do good while they live,
ekegusii: Namanyire ng’a gento kende tikeri kere ekiya kerabagwenere otatiga babe nomogooko, naende bakore ayare amaya ekero bare moyo.
swahili: Ninajua kwamba hakuna kitu bora kwa wanadamu kuliko kuwa na furaha na kutenda mema wakati wanapoishi.

english: and also that every man should eat and drink and find satisfaction in all his labor—this is the gift of God.
ekegusii: Omonto kararie na konywa, naende egokie ase ebio echandeire, ekio nekeegwa kia Nyasae.
swahili: Tena ni karama ya Mungu kila mtu apate kula na kunywa na kujiburudisha kwa mema katika kazi yake yote.

english: I know that everything God does endures forever; nothing can be added to it or taken from it. God does it so that they should fear Him.
ekegusii: Namanyire ng’a gento kende gionsi Nyasae agokora nigo gekogenderera kobao kare na kare; gento kende tigekomentwa ase ekio, gose kende tigekorusigwa korwa ase ekio. Nyasae nere okorire igo, erinde Mwanyabaanto bamoiroke.
swahili: Ninajua kwamba kila kitu anachokifanya Mungu kitadumu milele, hakuna kinachoweza kuongezwa au kupunguzwa. Mungu hufanya hivyo ili watu wamche yeye.

english: What exists has already been, and what will be has already been, for God will call to account what has passed. From Dust to Dust
ekegusii: Amang’ana areo bono, nao arenge korwa kare; na ayio agochia koba, boigo nao arenge korwa kare. Nyasae nigo agokora egento keria keria kiaba naende. Oboronge tibori ase ense
swahili: Chochote kilichopo kilishakuwepo, na kitakachokuwepo kimekwishakuwepo kabla; naye Mungu huyaita yale yaliyopita yarudi tena.

english: Furthermore, I saw under the sun that in the place of judgment there is wickedness, and in the place of righteousness there is wickedness.
ekegusii: Naende nkarora aiga inse y’erioba ng’a aase ekeene na oboronge bigwenerete koba, nao obobe bore.
swahili: Pia nikaona kitu kingine tena chini ya jua: Mahali pa kutolea hukumu, uovu ulikuwepo, mahali pa kupatia haki, uovu ulikuwepo.

english: I said in my heart, “God will judge the righteous and the wicked, since there is a time for every activity and every deed.”
ekegusii: Erio ngateeba ase enkoro yane ime ng’a Nyasae nanachere abanyaboronge ekiina, na abanyabibe boigo, ekiagera obeekire engaki ase kera ring’ana, na ase kera emeremo.
swahili: Nikafikiri moyoni mwangu, “Mungu atawaleta hukumuni wote wawili wenye haki na waovu, kwa maana kutakuwako na wakati kwa ajili ya kila jambo, wakati kwa ajili ya kila tendo.”

english: I said to myself, “As for the sons of men, God tests them so that they may see for themselves that they are but beasts.”
ekegusii: Naende ngateeba ase enkoro yane ime ng’a Nyasae nigo agoteema Mwanyabaanto kobaenekia ng’a barabwo nigo banga buna ching’iti.
swahili: Pia nikafikiri, “Kuhusu wanadamu, Mungu huwajaribu ili wajione kwamba wao ni kama wanyama.

english: For the fates of both men and beasts are the same: As one dies, so dies the other—they all have the same breath. Man has no advantage over the animals, since everything is futile.
ekegusii: Amang’ana akonyora ching’iti naro ayio akobanyora Mwanyabaanto; buna ching’iti chigokwa, naboigo na Mwanyabaanto bagokwa. Omoika noyomo ore ase ching’iti na ase Mwanyabaanto; Mwanyabaanto tabueti ching’iti kende. Amang’ana onsi mbosa.
swahili: Hatima ya mwanadamu ni kama ile ya wanyama; wote wana mwisho unaofanana: Jinsi anavyokufa mnyama, ndivyo anavyokufa mwanadamu. Wote wana pumzi inayofanana; mwanadamu hana cha zaidi kuliko mnyama. Kila kitu ni ubatili.

english: a time to be born and a time to die, a time to plant and a time to uproot,
ekegusii: Nere engaki y’okoiborwa, na ey’ogokwa; engaki y’ogosimeka, na ey’ogosimora ekio giasimegetwe;
swahili: wakati wa kuzaliwa na wakati wa kufa, wakati wa kupanda na wakati wa kungʼoa yaliyopandwa,

english: All go to one place; all come from dust, and all return to dust.
ekegusii: Mwanyabaanto nigo bakogenda aase ching’iti chikogenda; Mwanyabaanto nigo baruete ase amaroba, ne ching’iti naboigo; nigo bakoirana ase amaroba, naboigo na chirochio.
swahili: Wote huenda mahali panapofanana; wote hutoka mavumbini, mavumbini wote hurudi.

english: Who knows if the spirit of man rises upward and the spirit of the animal descends into the earth?
ekegusii: Ning’o omanyete gose omoika o Mwanyabaanto niigoro ogochia, na oyo bwe ching’iti ogenda inse y’ense?
swahili: Ni nani ajuaye kama roho ya mtu huenda juu na roho ya mnyama hushuka chini ardhini?”

english: I have seen that there is nothing better for a man than to enjoy his work, because that is his lot. For who can bring him to see what will come after him?
ekegusii: Ase ayio nkarora ng’a gento kende tikeri kere ekiya, otatiga omonto agokere emeremo yaye; ekio nakio egetari kiaye. Ning’o orachie komoirania ache korora na komanya ayakoregete magega yaye?
swahili: Kwa hiyo nikaona kwamba hakuna kitu kilicho bora zaidi kwa mwanadamu kuliko kuifurahia kazi yake, kwa sababu hilo ndilo fungu lake. Kwa maana ni nani awezaye kumrudisha ili aje kuona kile kitakachotendeka baada yake?

english: a time to kill and a time to heal, a time to break down and a time to build,
ekegusii: engaki y’ogoita, na ey’okogwenia; engaki y’ogotagora, na ey’okoagacha;
swahili: wakati wa kuua na wakati wa kuponya, wakati wa kubomoa, na wakati wa kujenga,

english: a time to weep and a time to laugh, a time to mourn and a time to dance,
ekegusii: engaki y’okorera, na ey’ogoseka; engaki y’okobokia amagombo, na ey’ogotenga;
swahili: wakati wa kulia na wakati wa kucheka, wakati wa kuomboleza na wakati wa kucheza,

english: a time to cast away stones and a time to gather stones together, a time to embrace and a time to refrain from embracing,
ekegusii: engaki y’ogosiarera amagena, na ey’okoyasangereria; engaki y’okoboania, na ey’ogotaboania;
swahili: wakati wa kutawanya mawe na wakati wa kukusanya mawe, wakati wa kukumbatia na wakati wa kutokumbatia,

english: a time to search and a time to count as lost, a time to keep and a time to discard,
ekegusii: engaki y’okorigia, na ey’ogosiria; engaki y’okogaacha, na ey’ogotuguta;
swahili: wakati wa kutafuta na wakati wa kupoteza, wakati wa kuweka na wakati wa kutupa,

english: a time to tear and a time to mend, a time to be silent and a time to speak,
ekegusii: engaki y’ogotandora, na ey’okobareera; engaki y’ogokira, na ey’ogokwana;
swahili: wakati wa kurarua na wakati wa kushona, wakati wa kunyamaza na wakati wa kuzungumza,

english: a time to love and a time to hate, a time for war and a time for peace. God’s Works Remain Forever
ekegusii: engaki y’ogwanchana, na ey’okogechana; engaki y’esegi, na ey’omorembe.
swahili: wakati wa kupenda na wakati wa kuchukia, wakati wa vita na wakati wa amani.

english: What does the worker gain from his toil?
ekegusii: Inee! Mbitoki ki omonto akonyora ase emeremo yonsi agwechandera?
swahili: Mfanyakazi anapata faida gani kutokana na taabu yake?

english: Again I looked, and I considered all the oppression taking place under the sun. I saw the tears of the oppressed, and they had no comforter; the power lay in the hands of their oppressors, and there was no comforter.
ekegusii: Naende nkarigereria nkarora ogokora okobe kware gokorwa inse y’erioba. Nkarora abwo bagokorerwa bobe bakorera, na monto onde tarengeo okobaremia, ekiagera abwo barenge kobakorera bobe nigo barenge nokobua, na onde tarengeo okobaremia.
swahili: Nikatazama tena nikaona uonevu wote uliokuwa unafanyika chini ya jua: Nikaona machozi ya walioonewa, wala hawana wa kuwafariji; uwezo ulikuwa upande wa wale wanaowaonea, wala hawana wa kuwafariji.

english: For if one falls down, his companion can lift him up; but pity the one who falls without another to help him up!
ekegusii: Oyomo karagwe, oyonde namogororokie; korende obobe nobwaye oria ore bweka ekero aragwe, na onde tari oramogororokie.
swahili: Kama mmoja akianguka, mwenzake atamwinua. Lakini ni jambo la kuhuzunisha kwa mtu yule aangukaye naye hana wa kumwinua!

english: Again, if two lie down together, they will keep warm; but how can one keep warm alone?
ekegusii: Abanto babere kobararaare amo mbaigwe riberera korende naki oyomo arakore aigwe riberera kare bweka?
swahili: Pia, kama wawili wakilala pamoja watapashana joto. Lakini ni vipi mtu aweza kujipasha joto mwenyewe?

english: And though one may be overpowered, two can resist. Moreover, a cord of three strands is not quickly broken. The Futility of Power
ekegusii: Omonto aise korwania oyomo ore bweka, namobue, korende onye bare babere, takobabua. Engori esisire nemegoye etato teri kobutoka bwango.
swahili: Ingawa mtu mmoja aweza kushindwa, watu wawili wanaweza kumkabili adui na kumshinda. Kamba ya nyuzi tatu haikatiki kwa urahisi. Maendeleo Ni Ubatili

english: Better is a poor but wise youth than an old but foolish king who no longer knows how to take a warning.
ekegusii: Omwana omosae omotaka ore nobong’aini niigo’are omuya kobua omorwoti omogotu ore omoriri, otari gwancha gosemigwa;
swahili: Afadhali kijana maskini mwenye hekima kuliko mfalme mzee mpumbavu ambaye hajui tena kupokea maonyo.

english: For the youth has come from the prison to the kingship, though he was born poor in his own kingdom.
ekegusii: neba ng’a omosae oria nigo aruete echela akabeekwa oborwoti, gose nigo aiboretwe ore omotaka ase obogambi bw’omorwoti oria.
swahili: Kijana huyo angeweza kutokea gerezani akapata ufalme, au angeweza kuwa amezaliwa katika umaskini kwenye huo ufalme.

english: I saw that all who lived and walked under the sun followed this second one, the youth who succeeded the king.
ekegusii: Nkarora abanto bonsi abamenyete inse y’erioba bakobwatia omosae oria ogochia kobeekwa oborwoti ribaga ri’oria orengeo.
swahili: Nikaona kwamba wote walioishi na kutembea chini ya jua walimfuata kijana, aliyepokea ufalme.

english: There is no limit to all the people who were before them. Yet the successor will not be celebrated by those who come even later. This too is futile and a pursuit of the wind.
ekegusii: Abanto abwo arenge koraa tibare kobareka. Nonya naboigo abwo barachiche magega y’abwo tibakomogokera. Ekeene, aya naro mbosa, na aya akominyokerwa konyorwa nigo are buna embeo bosa.
swahili: Hapakuwa na kikomo cha watu wote aliowatawala. Lakini wale waliokuja baadaye hawakufurahia kazi ya yule aliyepokea ufalme. Hili nalo pia ni ubatili, ni kukimbiza upepo.

english: So I admired the dead, who had already died, above the living, who are still alive.
ekegusii: Nkarora ng’a nigo ere buya ase abakuure kobua ase abare moyo.
swahili: Nami nikasema kwamba wafu, waliokwisha kufa, wana furaha kuliko watu walio hai, ambao bado wanaishi.

english: But better than both is he who has not yet existed, who has not seen the evil that is done under the sun.
ekegusii: Korende ase oyo otaraiborwa, oyio otararora ogokora okobe kore aiga inse y’erioba, nigo ere buya asare kobua ase abwo bonsi bare moyo na abakuure.
swahili: Lakini aliye bora kuliko hao wawili ni yule ambaye hajazaliwa bado, ambaye hajaona ule uovu unaofanyika chini ya jua.

english: I saw that all labor and success spring from a man’s envy of his neighbor. This too is futile and a pursuit of the wind.
ekegusii: Erio nkarora emeremo eye emekong’u egokorwa, na omokia bwonsi bw’ogwechanda ase ogokora emeremo, ayio nigo agokorwa, ekiagera omonto akoba ne ribero ng’a abue oyonde. Ayio boigo mbosa, nigo are buna okominyokia embeo.
swahili: Tena nikaona kuwa kazi zote na mafanikio yote huchipuka kutokana na wivu wa mtu kwa jirani yake. Hili nalo ni ubatili, ni kukimbiza upepo.

english: The fool folds his hands and consumes his own flesh.
ekegusii: Omoriri nigo agwetumata, na bweria omobere oye orea.
swahili: Mpumbavu hukunja mikono yake na kujiangamiza mwenyewe.

english: Better one handful with tranquility than two handfuls with toil and pursuit of the wind.
ekegusii: Mbuya koba negento geichire oroe oromo na koba nomorembe, kobua koba n’ebinto biichire chindoe ibere na koba nogwechanda na kominyokera konyora ebire buna embeo bosa.
swahili: Afadhali konzi moja pamoja na utulivu kuliko konzi mbili pamoja na taabu na kukimbiza upepo.

english: Again, I saw futility under the sun.
ekegusii: Naende nkarora obosa kegima bore inse y’erioba:
swahili: Tena nikaona kitu kingine kilicho ubatili chini ya jua:

english: There is a man all alone, without even a son or brother. And though there is no end to his labor, his eyes are still not content with his wealth: “For whom do I toil and bereave my soul of enjoyment?” This too is futile—a miserable task.
ekegusii: Nare omonto otabwate omwana gose omwabo; ere nigo agendererete gwechanda gokora emeremo emekong’u, na amaiso aye tari goisaneka ne chinibo; omonto oyio tana kweboria, “Ning’o ngochandekera gokorera na kwerina omogooko bwonsi?” Aya naro mbosa, na ogwechanda gotari nomogooko.
swahili: Kulikuwepo mwanadamu aliye peke yake, hakuwa na mwana wala ndugu. Hapakuwa na mwisho wa kazi yake, hata hivyo macho yake hayakutosheka na utajiri wake. Aliuliza, “Ninajitaabisha hivi kwa ajili ya nani, nami kwa nini ninajinyima kufurahia?” Hili pia ni ubatili, ni shughuli yenye taabu!

english: Two are better than one, because they have a good return for their labor.
ekegusii: Nigo ere buya koba babere kobua oyomo, ekiagera mbanyore eng’eria engiya ase emeremo yabo bagokora.
swahili: Wawili ni afadhali kuliko mmoja, kwa sababu wana malipo mazuri kwa kazi yao:

english: Guard your steps when you go to the house of God. Draw near to listen rather than to offer the sacrifice of fools, who do not know that they do wrong.
ekegusii: Orende amagoro ao ekero ogosoa ase enyomba ya Nyasae; mbuya kogenda aroro ase ogotegerera kobua korua ebing’wanso ebio abariri bakorua, ekiagera abwo tibamanyeti ng’a nigo bagokora ebibe.
swahili: Linda hatua zako uendapo katika nyumba ya Mungu. Karibia usikilize kuliko kutoa dhabihu ya wapumbavu, ambao hawajui kuwa wanafanya kosa.

english: He who loves money is never satisfied by money, and he who loves wealth is never satisfied by income. This too is futile.
ekegusii: Omonto bwanchete chitaabu, tagoisaneka nachirochio; gose oyobwanchete obotenenku, tagoisaneka nebitoki biaye. Ayio boigo mbosa.
swahili: Yeyote apendaye fedha kamwe hatosheki na fedha; yeyote apendaye utajiri kamwe hatosheki na kipato chake. Hili nalo pia ni ubatili.

english: When good things increase, so do those who consume them; what then is the profit to the owner, except to behold them with his eyes?
ekegusii: Ekero obotenenku bokomentekana, boigo nabwo bakoboria nigo bakomentekana; bono mbuya ki oria omonyene akonyora, otatiga akoborora namaiso rioka?
swahili: Mali ikiongezeka, ndivyo walaji wanavyoongezeka. Hii nayo inamfaidia nini mwenye mali isipokuwa ni kushibisha macho yake?

english: The sleep of the worker is sweet, whether he eats little or much, but the abundance of the rich man permits him no sleep.
ekegusii: Chitoro chi’omokori emeremo nigo chire chingiya mono, neba ng’a nigo abwate egento egeke akoria, gose ebinge; korende obotenenku bw’omonto omonda tibokomotiga araare chitoro.
swahili: Usingizi wa kibarua ni mtamu, awe amekula kidogo au kingi, lakini wingi wa mali humnyima tajiri usingizi.

english: There is a grievous evil I have seen under the sun: wealth hoarded to the harm of its owner,
ekegusii: Obobe mono narorire inse y’erioba nabwo obo: chinibo chinyinge chikogachwa nigo chiranyare gosiria omonto ochigachete.
swahili: Nimeshaona uovu mzito chini ya jua: Utajiri uliolimbikizwa kwa kujinyima na kuleta madhara kwa mwenye mali,

english: or wealth lost in a failed venture, so when that man has a son there is nothing to pass on.
ekegusii: Chinibo echio nigo chigosira ase egesio ekebe, na ekero omonto oyio aiboire omwana omomura nigo akonyorekana ore bosa, tabwati kende akomoa.
swahili: au utajiri uliopotea kwa bahati mbaya, hivyo kwamba wakati akiwa na mwana hakuna chochote kilichobaki kwa ajili yake.

english: As a man came from his mother’s womb, so he will depart again, naked as he arrived. He takes nothing for his labor to carry in his hands.
ekegusii: Buna aiboretwe ore getirianda korwa ase enda ya ng’ina, naboigo aragende ore getirianda buna achete, gose takoira kende ase ebio echandeire mono kobinyora.
swahili: Mtu hutoka tumboni mwa mama yake uchi, naye jinsi alivyokuja vivyo hivyo huondoka. Hachukui chochote kutokana na kazi yake ambacho anaweza kukibeba mkononi mwake.

english: This too is a grievous evil: Exactly as a man is born, so he will depart. What does he gain as he toils for the wind?
ekegusii: Obo boigo nobobe bw’obororo; onye okorua ase ense ogenda buna achete, mbitoki ki abwate ase ogwechanda gokora emeremo emekong’u y’okominyokia aya are buna embeo bosa?
swahili: Hili nalo ni baya la kusikitisha: Kama vile mtu ajavyo, vivyo hivyo huondoka, naye anapata faida gani, maadamu hutaabika kwa ajili ya upepo?

english: Moreover, all his days he eats in darkness, with much sorrow, sickness, and anger.
ekegusii: Ase obogima bwaye bwonsi nigo abeire okoria endagera ore ase omosunte, obeire ogwechanda ore nobororo na okogechigwa.
swahili: Siku zake zote hula gizani, pamoja na fadhaa kubwa, mateso na hasira.

english: Here is what I have seen to be good and fitting: to eat and drink, and to find satisfaction in all the labor one does under the sun during the few days of life that God has given him—for this is his lot.
ekegusii: Naama! Aya narorire are amaya na agwenerete nokoria na konywa na koba nomogooko ase ebinto ebio bionsi omonto echandeire aiga inse y’erioba, ase engaki y’amatuko amake Nyasae amoeire; ekio nakio egetari kiaye.
swahili: Ndipo nikatambua kwamba ni vyema na sahihi kwa mtu kula na kunywa na kutosheka katika kazi yake ngumu chini ya jua katika siku chache za maisha yake Mungu alizompa, kwa maana hili ndilo fungu lake.

english: Furthermore, God has given riches and wealth to every man, and He has enabled him to enjoy them, to accept his lot, and to rejoice in his labor. This is a gift from God.
ekegusii: Onye Nyasae oeire omonto obotenenku ne chinibo, naende omoeire okobua gw’okwegokia ase ebinto ebio na kobikorera ase obuya bwaye, boigo koba nomogooko ase emeremo yaye, ayio onsi nigo are ebiegwa bia Nyasae.
swahili: Zaidi ya yote, Mungu anapompa mtu yeyote utajiri na milki, humwezesha kuvifurahia, kukubali fungu lake na kuwa na furaha katika kazi yake, hii ni karama ya Mungu.

english: Do not be quick to speak, and do not be hasty in your heart to utter a word before God. After all, God is in heaven and you are on earth. So let your words be few.
ekegusii: Tobaisa koba omwango ase ogokwana amang’ana, gose enkoro yao teba enyango gokwana ase obosio bwa Nyasae, ekiagera ere nigo are igoro, naye nigo ore inse aa ase ense; ase ayio tiga amang’ana ogokwana abe amake.
swahili: Usiwe mwepesi kuzungumza, usiwe na haraka katika moyo wako kuzungumza lolote mbele za Mungu. Mungu yuko mbinguni nawe uko duniani, kwa hiyo maneno yako na yawe machache.

english: For a man seldom considers the days of his life, because God keeps him occupied with the joy of his heart.
ekegusii: Omonto oyio takogenderera koinyora amatuko aetire ay’obogima bwaye, ekiagera Nyasae nigo akomoa omogooko ase enkoro yaye.
swahili: Mara chache mtu huzifikiri siku za maisha yake, kwa sababu Mungu humfanya ashikwe na furaha ya moyoni.

english: As a dream comes through many cares, so the speech of a fool comes with many words.
ekegusii: Chindoto nigo chigocha korwa ase ogwechanda okonge, ne chinkwana chinyinge nigo chikorenta amang’ana ’oboriri.
swahili: Kama vile ndoto huja wakati kuna shughuli nyingi, ndivyo yalivyo mazungumzo ya mpumbavu wakati kuna maneno mengi.

english: When you make a vow to God, do not delay in fulfilling it, because He takes no pleasure in fools. Fulfill your vow.
ekegusii: Ekero kwarire eira ase Nyasae, tobaisa goteebana koyeikerania, ekiagera ere tari kogokigwa nabaanto abariri. Ikerania eira kwariete.
swahili: Wakati unapomwekea Mungu nadhiri, usikawie kuitimiza. Yeye hafurahii wapumbavu; timiza nadhiri yako.

english: It is better not to vow than to make a vow and not fulfill it.
ekegusii: Mbuya toria eira kobua koria eira na toyeikerania.
swahili: Ni afadhali usiweke nadhiri kuliko kuiweka na usiitimize.

english: Do not let your mouth cause your flesh to sin, and do not tell the messenger that your vow was a mistake. Why should God be angry with your words and destroy the work of your hands?
ekegusii: Tobaisa gotiga amang’ana ’omonwa oo agere okore ebibe, gose tobaisa goteebia omosomba o Nyasae ng’a oko nokomocha gwakora. Nase ki oragere Nyasae agechigwe nogokwana kwao, na asarie emeremo y’amaboko ao?
swahili: Usiruhusu kinywa chako kukuingiza dhambini. Tena usijitetee mbele ya huyo mjumbe wa hekaluni, ukisema, “Niliweka nadhiri kwa makosa.” Kwa nini Mungu akasirike kwa ajili ya yale unayosema na kuiharibu kazi ya mikono yako?

english: For as many dreams bring futility, so do many words. Therefore, fear God. The Futility of Wealth (Psalms 49:1–20)
ekegusii: Ekero amang’ana atari nengencho amentekanire, ne chindoto chiamentekanire, obobe nigo bokoba obonge; korende aye omoiroke Nyasae. Obogima nigo bore bosa
swahili: Kuota ndoto kwingi na maneno mengi ni ubatili. Kwa hiyo simama katika kicho cha Mungu. Utajiri Ni Ubatili

english: If you see the oppression of the poor and the denial of justice and righteousness in the province, do not be astonished at the matter; for one official is watched by a superior, and others higher still are over them.
ekegusii: Tobaisa goichana ekero orarore agwo ase obogambi abataka bagokorerwa bobe, na ekeene na oboronge biarusigweo ase enchera y’obotindi, omonene oyio okogamba nigo arigereirie noria ore omonene komobua, naende mbare abwo bare abanene kobua abwo bare nokobua.
swahili: Kama ukiona maskini wanaonewa katika nchi, hukumu na haki vikipotoshwa, usishangazwe na mambo hayo, kwa maana afisa mmoja anaangaliwa na aliye juu yake zaidi na juu ya hao wawili kuna wengine walio juu zaidi yao.

english: The produce of the earth is taken by all; the king himself profits from the fields.
ekegusii: Mbuya ase ense ere nomorwoti okogamba buya na korigereria ng’a abanto nkorema bare emegondo yabo.
swahili: Mafanikio ya nchi ni kwa ajili ya wote, hata mfalme mwenyewe hufaidi kutoka mashambani.

english: There is another evil I have seen under the sun, and it weighs heavily upon mankind:
ekegusii: Mbore obobe narorie aiga inse y’erioba boritoerete Mwanyabaanto:
swahili: Nimeona ubaya mwingine chini ya jua, nao unalemea sana wanadamu:

english: Whatever exists was named long ago, and what happens to a man is foreknown; but he cannot contend with one stronger than he.
ekegusii: Gento kende gionsi kereo nigo kiarogetwe erieta korwa kare, naende nigo yamanyekanete eki omonto are gocha koba. Mwanyabaanto takonyara koamererania noria ore ne chinguru komobua.
swahili: Lolote lililopo limekwisha kupewa jina, naye mwanadamu alivyo ameshajulikana; hakuna mtu awezaye kushindana na mwenye nguvu kuliko yeye.

english: For the more words, the more futility—and how does that profit anyone?
ekegusii: Ogokwana okonge nigo gokorenta amang’ana amange are bosa. Inee! Ayio mbuya ki akorenta ase Mwanyabaanto?
swahili: Maneno yanavyokuwa mengi, ndivyo yanavyokosa maana, Je, hilo linamfaidia vipi yeyote?

english: For who knows what is good for a man during the few days in which he passes through his fleeting life like a shadow? Who can tell a man what will come after him under the sun?
ekegusii: Ning’o omanyete egento kere ekiya ase omonto, ekero amenyete amatuko amake ase obogima bore bosa, agoeta buna omorengari? Ning’o oranyare goteebia omonto amang’ana arabe korwa magega yaye aiga inse y’erioba?
swahili: Kwa maana ni nani anayejua lililo jema kwa ajili ya maisha ya mwanadamu, katika siku chache na za ubatili anazopita kama kivuli? Ni nani awezaye kumwambia yatakayotokea chini ya jua baada ya yeye kuondoka?

english: God gives a man riches, wealth, and honor, so that he lacks nothing his heart desires; but God does not allow him to enjoy them. Instead, a stranger will enjoy them. This is futile and a grievous affliction.
ekegusii: Nyasae oeire omonto obotenenku, ne chinibo, na ogosikwa, na omonto oyio taremeiri gento kende ase ebio bionsi aganetie, korende Nyasae tamoeti okobua gw’okwegokia ase ebinto ebio; omonto omoao nigo akobiira bwegokia nabirobio. Ayio naro mbosa, naende nogwechanda okobe.
swahili: Mungu humpa mwanadamu utajiri, mali na heshima, hivyo hakukosa chochote moyo wake unachokitamani. Lakini Mungu hamwezeshi kuvifurahia, badala yake mgeni ndiye anayevifurahia. Hili ni ubatili, ni ubaya unaosikitisha.

english: A man may father a hundred children and live for many years; yet no matter how long he lives, if he is unsatisfied with his prosperity and does not even receive a proper burial, I say that a stillborn child is better off than he.
ekegusii: Onye omonto oiboire abana rigana erimo, na abe moyo ase engaki y’emiaka emenge, ee, nonya amatuko ’obogima bwaye abeire amange, korende tegogetie ase ebinto ebiya bi’obogima obwo, na tatindekwa ase amasikani, nigo ngoteeba ng’a omwana okwerete enda ya ng’ina nigo are buya kobua omonto oyio.
swahili: Mtu anaweza kuwa na watoto mia moja naye akaishi miaka mingi, lakini haidhuru kuwa ataishi muda mrefu kiasi gani, kama hawezi kufurahia mafanikio yake na kwamba hapati mazishi ya heshima, ninasema afadhali mtoto aliyezaliwa akiwa amekufa kuliko yeye.

english: For a stillborn child enters in futility and departs in darkness, and his name is shrouded in obscurity.
ekegusii: Omwana oyio okwete nigo achete egento bosa, naende nigo akogenda gochia ase omosunte, na omosunte oyio otuba erieta riaye.
swahili: Kuzaliwa kwake hakuna maana, huondokea gizani na gizani jina lake hufunikwa.

english: The child, though neither seeing the sun nor knowing anything, has more rest than that man,
ekegusii: Omwana oria taroche erioba, gose tamanyete gento kende, korende nonya naboigo nigo akonyora omotimoko kobua omonto oria,
swahili: Ingawa hakuwahi kuliona jua wala kujua kitu chochote, yeye ana pumziko zaidi kuliko mtu huyo,

english: even if he lives a thousand years twice over but fails to enjoy his prosperity. Do not all go to the same place?
ekegusii: nonya omonto oria ogochia komenya emiaka chilifu ibere, korende tanyora omogooko ase obogima bwaye. Inee! Abwo bonsi babere tibakogenda aase amo?
swahili: Hata kama huyo mtu ataishi miaka elfu mara mbili na zaidi, lakini akashindwa kufurahia mafanikio yake, je, wote hawaendi sehemu moja?

english: All a man’s labor is for his mouth, yet his appetite is never satisfied.
ekegusii: Emeremo yonsi omonto akwerosia gokora nokonyora egento akoria, korende nonya naboigo tari koigota.
swahili: Juhudi zote za binadamu ni kwa ajili ya kinywa chake, hata hivyo hamu yake kamwe haitoshelezwi.

english: What advantage, then, has the wise man over the fool? What gain comes to the poor man who knows how to conduct himself before others?
ekegusii: Mbuya ki omonto omong’aini abwate kobua oyore omoriri? Gose ninki omonto omotaka akonyora, oria omanyete buna akwerenda ase abare moyo?
swahili: Mtu mwenye hekima ana faida gani zaidi ya mpumbavu? Mtu maskini anapata faida gani kwa kujua jinsi ya kujistahi mbele ya watu wengine?

english: Better what the eye can see than the wandering of desire. This too is futile and a pursuit of the wind.
ekegusii: Eki amaiso aroche nigo kere buya kobua eki okogania ng’a okenyore. Ayio boigo mbosa, na okominyokia aya are buna embeo bosa.
swahili: Ni bora kile ambacho jicho linakiona kuliko hamu isiyotoshelezwa. Hili nalo ni ubatili, ni kukimbiza upepo.

english: A good name is better than fine perfume, and one’s day of death is better than his day of birth.
ekegusii: Erieta rigiya nigo ribuete amaguta amaya akweakwa, ne rituko ri’ogokwa nigo rire rigiya kobua eri’okoiborwa.
swahili: Afadhali sifa nzuri kuliko manukato safi, nayo siku ya kufa kuliko ya kuzaliwa.

english: Do not say, “Why were the old days better than these?” For it is unwise of you to ask about this.
ekegusii: Tobaisa goteeba, “Nase ki amatuko a kare arenge amaya kobua aya bono?” Okoboria okwo tikori okw’obong’aini.
swahili: Usiseme, “Kwa nini siku za kale zilikuwa bora kuliko siku hizi?” Kwa maana si hekima kuuliza maswali kama hayo.

english: Wisdom, like an inheritance, is good, and it benefits those who see the sun.
ekegusii: Obong’aini nigo bore obuya buna omwando, na nigo bogokonya abwo baroche erioba.
swahili: Hekima, kama ulivyo urithi, ni kitu chema na huwafaidia wale walionalo jua.

english: For wisdom, like money, is a shelter, and the advantage of knowledge is that wisdom preserves the life of its owner.
ekegusii: Obong’aini nigo bogotokonya buna chitaabu chigotokonya, korende obuya bw’omonyasemi mboria ng’a obong’aini nigo bokorenda obogima bw’oyio ong’ainiire.
swahili: Hekima ni ulinzi kama fedha ilivyo ulinzi, lakini faida ya maarifa ni hii: kwamba hekima huhifadhi maisha ya aliye nayo.

english: Consider the work of God: Who can straighten what He has bent?
ekegusii: Rengereria emeremo ya Nyasae! Ning’o oranyare korongeyia egento Omonene akorire borogochi?
swahili: Tafakari kile Mungu alichokitenda: Nani awezaye kunyoosha kile ambacho yeye amekipinda?

english: In the day of prosperity, be joyful, but in the day of adversity, consider this: God has made one of these along with the other, so that a man cannot discover anything that will come after him. The Limits of Human Wisdom
ekegusii: Ekero amatuko ao are amaya kabe nomogooko, na ekero are amabe rengereria ng’a Nyasae nere okorire ayio onsi abere, erinde omonto tabaisa komanya erirache komobwatia korwa magega yaye.
swahili: Nyakati zikiwa nzuri, ufurahi, lakini nyakati zikiwa mbaya, tafakari: Mungu amefanya hiyo moja, naam, sanjari na hiyo nyingine. Kwa hiyo, mwanadamu hawezi kugundua kitu chochote kuhusu maisha yake ya baadaye.

english: In my futile life I have seen both of these: A righteous man perishing in his righteousness, and a wicked man living long in his wickedness.
ekegusii: Ase obogima obo bwane obore bosa narorire kera egento; narorire omonto omonyaboronge ogosira ore ase oboronge bwaye, na omonyabibe okogenderera koba moyo amatuko amange ore ase ebibe biaye.
swahili: Katika maisha haya yangu ya ubatili nimeshaona haya mawili: mtu mwadilifu akiangamia katika uadilifu wake, naye mtu mwovu akiishi maisha marefu katika uovu wake.

english: Do not be overly righteous, and do not make yourself too wise. Why should you destroy yourself?
ekegusii: Tobaisa koba omooronge goetania, gose koba omong’aini goetania. Nase ki ogwesiria aye omonyene?
swahili: Usiwe mwenye haki kupita kiasi, wala usiwe na hekima kupita kiasi: kwa nini kujiangamiza mwenyewe?

english: Do not be excessively wicked, and do not be a fool. Why should you die before your time?
ekegusii: Tobaisa koba omobe goetania, gose tobaisa koba omoriri. Nase ki oganetie gokwa engaki yao etaraika?
swahili: Usiwe mwovu kupita kiasi, wala usiwe mpumbavu: kwa nini kufa kabla ya wakati wako?

english: It is good to grasp the one and not let the other slip from your hand. For he who fears God will follow both warnings.
ekegusii: Nigo ere buya ng’a obwate ring’ana eri erimo, na totiga neria kabere, ekiagera omonto omoirogete Nyasae namanye eki agokora ase kera ring’ana.
swahili: Ni vyema kushika hilo moja na wala usiache hilo jingine likupite. Mtu amchaye Mungu ataepuka huko kupita kiasi.

english: Wisdom makes the wise man stronger than ten rulers in a city.
ekegusii: Obong’aini nigo bogokora abare abang’aini koba ne chinguru chibuete echi’abagaambi ikomi bare ase omochie oyomo.
swahili: Hekima humfanya yeye aliye nayo kuwa na uwezo zaidi kuliko watawala kumi katika mji.

english: It is better to enter a house of mourning than a house of feasting, since death is the end of every man, and the living should take this to heart.
ekegusii: Mbuya kogenda ase enyomba y’ebirero kobua kogenda ase enyomba y’omoyega bw’okwegokia, ekiagera oyio noro omoerio o kera omonto, na abare moyo mbabeeke amang’ana aya ase chinkoro chiabo.
swahili: Afadhali kwenda kwenye nyumba ya msiba kuliko kwenda kwenye nyumba ya karamu, kwa kuwa kifo ni hatima ya kila mwanadamu, imewapasa walio hai kuliweka hili mioyoni mwao.

english: Surely there is no righteous man on earth who does good and never sins.
ekegusii: Ekeene, omonto tari aiga ase ense ore omooronge ogokora amaya otari gokora ebibe.
swahili: Hakuna mtu mwenye haki duniani ambaye hufanya mambo ya haki na kamwe asitende dhambi.

english: Do not pay attention to every word that is spoken, or you may hear your servant cursing you.
ekegusii: Tobaisa gotegerera amang’ana onsi abanto bagokwana, nigo orabaise koigwa omosomba oo ogokoragereria.
swahili: Usitie maanani kila neno linalosemwa na watu, la sivyo, waweza kumsikia mtumishi wako akikulaani:

english: For you know in your heart that many times you yourself have cursed others.
ekegusii: Aye omonyene nomanyete ase enkoro yao ng’a ase chingaki chinyinge kwabeire gokoragereria abanto bande.
swahili: kwa kuwa unafahamu moyoni mwako kwamba wewe mwenyewe mara nyingi umewalaani wengine.

english: All this I tested by wisdom, saying, “I resolve to be wise.” But it was beyond me.
ekegusii: Aya onsi ngateema koyaenekia ase enchera y’obong’aini, ngateeba, “Goika imbe nobong’aini.” Korende obong’aini obwo bokabeera aare korwa ase ’nde.
swahili: Yote haya niliyajaribu kwa hekima, nikasema, “Nimeamua kuwa na hekima”: lakini hii ilikuwa nje ya uwezo wangu.

english: What exists is out of reach and very deep. Who can fathom it?
ekegusii: Amang’ana aria nigo akare aare mono, naende akare aatambe gochia inse, aatambe mono, ning’o oranyare koyatuka?
swahili: Vyovyote hekima ilivyo, hekima iko mbali sana na imejificha, ni nani awezaye kuigundua?

english: I directed my mind to understand, to explore, to search out wisdom and explanations, and to understand the stupidity of wickedness and the folly of madness.
ekegusii: Erio ngachaka korengereria imanye, na gotuka, na korigia obong’aini, na komanya buna ebinto bionsi bire; naende nkagania komanya obobe bw’oboriri, na oboriri obore obobarimo.
swahili: Nikageuza fikira zangu ili kuelewa, kuchunguza na kuitafuta hekima na kusudi la mambo, na ili kuelewa ujinga wa uovu, na wazimu wa upumbavu.

english: And I find more bitter than death the woman who is a snare, whose heart is a net, and whose hands are chains. The man who pleases God escapes her, but the sinner is ensnared.
ekegusii: Erio nkanyora egento ekeroro kebuete amakweri. Egento ekio nakio omokungu enkoro yaye yarenge omotego, naende amaboko aye are chingataare. Omonto ogogetie Nyasae tari kobwatwa nomokuungu oyio, korende omonyabibe ere nigo akobwatwa.
swahili: Nimeona jambo lililo chungu kuliko mauti, mwanamke ambaye ni mtego, ambaye moyo wake ni wavu wa kutegea na mikono yake ni minyororo. Mtu ampendezaye Mungu atamkwepa, bali mwenye dhambi atanaswa naye.

english: “Behold,” says the Teacher, “I have discovered this by adding one thing to another to find an explanation.
ekegusii: Omorandia nigo agoteeba iga: Naama! Amang’ana ayio nkayamanya, ekero nabeekeranetie ring’ana erimo ase erinde koyamanya onsi.
swahili: Mhubiri anasema, “Tazama, hili ndilo nililogundua: “Nimegundua kitu kimoja baada ya kingine nilipokuwa katika kusudi la mambo:

english: While my soul was still searching but not finding, among a thousand I have found one upright man, but among all these I have not found one such woman.
ekegusii: Aya nabeire nkona‐koyairanerera korigia komanya buna are, korende tindayamanya. Ase abanto elifu eyemo nkanyora omosacha oyomo, korende ase abwo bonsi tinanyorete omokungu nonya noyomo.
swahili: ningali natafiti lakini sipati: nilimpata mwanaume mmoja mnyofu miongoni mwa elfu, lakini hakuna mwanamke mmoja mnyofu miongoni mwao.

english: Only this have I found: I have discovered that God made men upright, but they have sought out many schemes.”
ekegusii: Naama! Egento gioka narigirie nanyorire neke: Nyasae nigo atongete Mwanyabaanto bare abaikeranu, korende barabwo batukire chinchera chinyinge chi’okobaisanekia.
swahili: Hili ndilo peke yake nililolipata: Mungu amemuumba mwanadamu mnyofu, lakini mwanadamu amebuni mambo mengi.”

english: Sorrow is better than laughter, for a sad countenance is good for the heart.
ekegusii: Omoichano nigo ore omuya kobua amaseko, ekiagera omoichano okororekana ase obosio nigo ogokora enkoro yaba nomogooko.
swahili: Huzuni ni afadhali kuliko kicheko, kwa sababu uso wenye huzuni wafaa kwa moyo.

english: The heart of the wise is in the house of mourning, but the heart of fools is in the house of pleasure.
ekegusii: Chinkoro chi’abaanto abang’aini nigo chikoba ase enyomba y’ebirero, korende chinkoro chi’abariri nigo chire ase enyomba y’okwegokia.
swahili: Moyo wa wenye hekima uko katika nyumba ya msiba, lakini moyo wa wapumbavu uko katika nyumba ya anasa.

english: It is better to heed a wise man’s rebuke than to listen to the song of fools.
ekegusii: Mbuya omonto gotegerera ogotogonyerwa kw’omonto omong’aini kobua gotegerera ogoteera kw’abariri.
swahili: Afadhali kusikia karipio la mtu mwenye hekima, kuliko kusikiliza wimbo wa wapumbavu.

english: For like the crackling of thorns under the pot, so is the laughter of the fool. This too is futile.
ekegusii: Ogoseka kw’abariri nigo konga amagwa akoyia atoreka inse y’enyongo ere riko. Ayio boigo mbosa.
swahili: Kama ilivyo kuvunjika kwa miiba chini ya sufuria, ndivyo kilivyo kicheko cha wapumbavu. Hili nalo pia ni ubatili.

english: Surely extortion turns a wise man into a fool, and a bribe corrupts the heart.
ekegusii: Ekeene, emoko nigo ekoonchora omonto omong’aini oba omoriri, ne riaaki nigo rigosaria ebirengererio.
swahili: Dhuluma humfanya mtu mwenye hekima kuwa mpumbavu, nayo rushwa huuharibu moyo.

english: The end of a matter is better than the beginning, and a patient spirit is better than a proud one.
ekegusii: Omoerio bw’egento nigo ore omuya kobua omochakano oye; na omonto omoremereria nigo are omuya kobua omonto omoenenu.
swahili: Mwisho wa jambo ni bora kuliko mwanzo wake, uvumilivu ni bora kuliko kiburi.

english: Do not be quickly provoked in your spirit, for anger settles in the lap of a fool.
ekegusii: Tobaisa koba omwango ase okogechigwa, ekiagera okogechigwa nigo komenyete ase chinkoro chi’abariri.
swahili: Usiwe mwepesi kukasirika rohoni mwako, kwa kuwa hasira hukaa kifuani mwa wapumbavu.

english: Who is like the wise man? Who knows the interpretation of a matter? A man’s wisdom brightens his face, and the sternness of his face is changed.
ekegusii: Ning’o onga buna omonto omong’aini? Ning’o omanyete engencho y’amang’ana? Obong’aini nigo bogokora obosio bw’omonto bwagirigenta, nigo bokoonchora obokong’u bw’okororekana kwaye. Igwera Omorwoti
swahili: Ni nani aliye kama mtu mwenye hekima? Ni nani ajuaye maelezo ya mambo? Hekima hungʼarisha uso wa mtu na kubadili ugumu wa uso wake. Mtii Mfalme

english: Then too, I saw the burial of the wicked who used to go in and out of the holy place, and they were praised in the city where they had done so. This too is futile.
ekegusii: Nkarora abakori amabe batindekirwe batimogete, na ekero abanto bairanete korwa ase achenu nigo bare kobatogia agwo ase omochie. Ayio boigo mbosa.
swahili: Ndipo pia, nikaona waovu wakizikwa, wale ambao walizoea kuingia na kutoka mahali patakatifu na kupewa sifa katika mji ambapo walikuwa wamefanya haya. Hili nalo ni ubatili.

english: When the sentence for a crime is not speedily executed, the hearts of men become fully set on doing evil.
ekegusii: Ase engencho obobe botari konacherwa ekiina bwango, chikoro chia Mwanyabaanto nigo chikwerua gokora ayare amabe.
swahili: Wakati hukumu juu ya tendo ovu haitekelezwi upesi, mioyo ya watu hujaa mipango ya kutenda maovu.

english: Although a sinner does evil a hundred times and still lives long, yet I also know that it will go well with those who fear God, who are reverent in His presence.
ekegusii: Omonyabibe nakora ebibe ara rigana, naende agenderere koba moyo ase engaki entambe; nonya naboigo, nimanyete ng’a nigo erabe buya ase abwo bamoirogete Nyasae, ekiagera bamoirogete.
swahili: Ingawa mtu mwovu hufanya maovu mia moja na akaendelea kuishi maisha marefu, najua kwamba itakuwa bora zaidi kwa watu wanaomwogopa Mungu, wamchao Mungu.

english: Yet because the wicked do not fear God, it will not go well with them, and their days will not lengthen like a shadow. God’s Ways Are Mysterious
ekegusii: Korende abakori amabe tibakonyora amaya ayio, gose obogima bwabo tibokoba obotambe. Nigo banga buna omorengari ogoeta, ekiagera tibamoirogete Nyasae.
swahili: Lakini kwa sababu waovu hawamwogopi Mungu, hawatafanikiwa, maisha yao hayatarefuka kama kivuli.

english: There is a futility that is done on the earth: There are righteous men who get what the actions of the wicked deserve, and there are wicked men who get what the actions of the righteous deserve. I say that this too is futile.
ekegusii: Nare amang’ana abosa kegima agokorekana aiga ase ense; mbareo abanto abanyaboronge bakonyorwa negesusuro ki’ogokora kw’abanyabibe, na boigo abanyabibe banyora obuya bw’ogokora kw’abanyaboronge. Ase ayio ngateeba, “Ayio boigo mbosa.”
swahili: Kuna kitu kingine ambacho ni ubatili kinachotokea duniani: Watu waadilifu kupata yale yanayowastahili waovu, nao waovu kupata yale yanayowastahili waadilifu. Hili nalo pia, nasema ni ubatili.

english: So I commended the enjoyment of life, because there is nothing better for a man under the sun than to eat and drink and be merry. For this joy will accompany him in his labor during the days of his life that God gives him under the sun.
ekegusii: Ngatogia omogooko, na nkarora ng’a Mwanyabaanto tabwati gento kende kere ekiya aiga inse y’erioba, otatiga arie na konywa, na kwegokia barabwo abanyene. Ayio naro aranyare kobeera asare ekero agendererete gokora emeremo emekong’u ase obogima obo are moyo, obo Nyasae amoeire aiga inse y’erioba.
swahili: Kwa hiyo mimi ninasifu kufurahia maisha, kwa sababu hakuna kitu bora zaidi kwa mwanadamu chini ya jua kuliko kula, kunywa na kufurahi. Kisha furaha itafuatana naye kazini mwake siku zote za maisha yake ambazo amepewa na Mungu chini ya jua.

english: When I applied my mind to know wisdom and to observe the task that one performs on the earth—though his eyes do not see sleep in the day or even in the night—
ekegusii: Ekero nabeegete ebirengererio biane komanya obong’aini na korora emeremo emekong’u abanto bagokora aiga ase ense, batari korara chitoro omobaso gose obotuko.
swahili: Nilipotafakari akilini mwangu ili nijue hekima na kuangalia kazi ya mwanadamu duniani, jinsi ambavyo macho yake hayapati usingizi mchana wala usiku,

english: I saw every work of God, and that a man is unable to comprehend the work that is done under the sun. Despite his efforts to search it out, he cannot find its meaning; even if the wise man claims to know, he is unable to comprehend.
ekegusii: Erio nkarora ng’a omonto takonyara komanya emeremo ende yonsi ya Nyasae egokorekana aiga inse y’erioba. Omonto naisa gwechanda mono ase okorigia koyemanya, takonyara koyemanya. Nonya omonto omong’aini ogoteeba ng’a namanyete, takonyara koyemanya.
swahili: ndipo nikaona yale yote ambayo Mungu ameyafanya. Hakuna yeyote awezaye kuelewa yale yanayotendeka chini ya jua. Licha ya juhudi zake zote za kutafuta, mtu hawezi kugundua maana yake. Hata ingawa mtu mwenye hekima anadai kuwa anafahamu, kwa hakika hawezi kutambua.

english: Keep the king’s command, I say, because of your oath before God.
ekegusii: Inche nigo nkogosemia: Oigwere amang’ana omorwoti achiikire, ekiagera nkwarierete Nyasae eira.
swahili: Nawaambia, Tii amri ya mfalme, kwa sababu uliapa mbele za Mungu.

english: Do not hasten to leave his presence, and do not persist in a bad cause, for he will do whatever he pleases.
ekegusii: Toayerera gotiga obokoreri ase obosio bwaye, na tobwatana nogokora okobe, ekiagera ere nigo agokora onsi ayanchete.
swahili: Usiharakishe kuondoka mbele ya mfalme. Usiendelee kutenda lililo baya, kwa maana mfalme atafanya lolote apendalo.

english: For the king’s word is supreme, and who can say to him, “What are you doing?”
ekegusii: Ring’ana ri’omorwoti nigo rire nokobua. Ning’o oranyare komobooria, “Aye ngento ki eke ogokora?”
swahili: Kwa kuwa neno la mfalme ndilo lenye mamlaka ya mwisho, nani awezaye kumwambia, “Je, wewe unafanya nini?”

english: Whoever keeps his command will come to no harm, and a wise heart knows the right time and procedure.
ekegusii: Omonto okoigwera amachiiko takonyorwa namabe, na enkoro y’omonto omong’aini nigo ekomanya engaki na enchera y’okonacha boronge.
swahili: Yeyote anayetii agizo lake hatadhurika, moyo wa hekima utajua wakati muafaka na jinsi ya kutenda.

english: For there is a right time and procedure to every purpose, though a man’s misery weighs heavily upon him.
ekegusii: Kera ring’ana ndibwate engaki yaye na enchera yaye y’okonacha boronge, na emechando y’omonto nigo ekomoritoera.
swahili: Kwa maana kuna wakati muafaka na utaratibu wa kila jambo, ingawa huzuni ya mwanadamu huwa nzito juu yake.

english: Since no one knows what will happen, who can tell him what is to come?
ekegusii: Omonto tamanyeti ayagochia koba, na ning’o oranyare komoteebia buna amang’ana arabe?
swahili: Kwa vile hakuna mtu ajuaye siku zijazo, ni nani awezaye kumwambia linalokuja?

english: As no man has power over the wind to contain it, so no one has authority over his day of death. As no one can be discharged in wartime, so wickedness will not release those who practice it.
ekegusii: Monto onde tari obwate okobua igoro y’embeo, gose igoro ye rituko ri’ogokwa kwaye; ogotooreka tikori ase esegi, gose obobe tibogotooria abwo bakobokora. Ababe na abaronge
swahili: Hakuna mwanadamu awezaye kushikilia roho yake asife, wala hakuna mwenye uwezo juu ya siku ya kufa kwake. Kama vile hakuna yeyote arudishwaye nyuma wakati wa vita, kadhalika uovu hautawaweka huru wale wautendao.

english: All this I have seen, applying my mind to every deed that is done under the sun; there is a time when one man lords it over another to his own detriment. Fear God (Isaiah 8:11–15)
ekegusii: Ayio onsi nigo nayaroche ekero nabegete ebirengererio biane kwegera aya onsi agokorwa aiga inse y’erioba, ekero omonto oyomo akogambera omonto onde na komokorera bobe ase okomochanda.
swahili: Yote haya niliyaona, nilipokuwa natafakari kila kitu kinachotendeka chini ya jua. Kuna wakati ambapo mtu hujifanya bwana juu ya wengine kwa madhara yake mwenyewe.

english: So I took all this to heart and concluded that the righteous and the wise, as well as their deeds, are in God’s hands. Man does not know what lies ahead, whether love or hate.
ekegusii: Nkarengereria igoro y’amang’ana aya onsi, ngateema komanya buna abanyene oboronge na abare nobong’aini bare ase okoboko kwa Nyasae, amo nogokora kwabo, gokorabe okw’obwanchani gose ogw’okogecha. Monto onde tamanyeti amang’ana are bosio.
swahili: Kwa hiyo niliyatafakari yote haya nikafikia uamuzi kwamba waadilifu na wenye hekima na yale wanayoyafanya yako mikononi mwa Mungu, lakini hakuna mtu ajuaye kama anangojewa na upendo au chuki.

english: Whatever you find to do with your hands, do it with all your might, for in Sheol, where you are going, there is no work or planning or knowledge or wisdom.
ekegusii: Gento kende gionsi okoboko kwao koranyare gokora, gekore ne chinguru chiao chionsi; ekiagera agwo aase abakuure ase oragende, meremo ende tekaiyo, gose okorengereria, gose chisemi, gose obong’aini.
swahili: Lolote mkono wako upatalo kufanya, fanya kwa nguvu zako zote, kwa kuwa huko kuzimu, unakokwenda, hakuna kufanya kazi wala mipango wala maarifa wala hekima.

english: I saw something else under the sun: The race is not to the swift, nor the battle to the strong; neither is the bread to the wise, nor the wealth to the intelligent, nor the favor to the skillful. For time and chance happen to all.
ekegusii: Nkarora aiga inse y’erioba ng’a tari abwo bakominyoka bwango bakobua, gose ababwate chinguru tari barabwo bakobua esegi, gose abare nobong’aini tari barabwo bakonyora endagera, gose abare nokomanya tari barabwo babwate chinibo, gose abanyasemi tari barabwo bakonyora ogwancherwa; korende kera omonto nigo akonyorwa nengaki yaye na egesio kiaye.
swahili: Nimeona kitu kingine tena chini ya jua: Si wenye mbio washindao mashindano au wenye nguvu washindao vita, wala si wenye hekima wapatao chakula au wenye akili nyingi wapatao mali, wala wenye elimu wapatao upendeleo, lakini fursa huwapata wote.

english: For surely no man knows his time: Like fish caught in a cruel net or birds trapped in a snare, so men are ensnared in an evil time that suddenly falls upon them. Wisdom Is Better than Strength
ekegusii: Ekiagera Mwanyabaanto onde tamanyeti engaki ya mabe. Buna koreng’ana chinswe chikobwatwa ase ekeonga ase egesio ekebe, ne chinyoni ase obosugunia, naboigo na Mwanyabaanto bakonyorwa nengaki embe, babwatwa mobosokano. Ebirengererio bi’obong’aini na ebi’oboriri
swahili: Zaidi ya hayo, hakuna mwanadamu ajuaye wakati saa yake itakapokuja: Kama vile samaki wavuliwavyo katika wavu mkatili, au ndege wanaswavyo kwenye mtego, vivyo hivyo wanadamu hunaswa na nyakati mbaya zinazowaangukia bila kutazamia. Hekima Ni Bora Kuliko Upumbavu

english: I have also seen this wisdom under the sun, and it was great to me:
ekegusii: Nainde amang’ana aya naro naroche igoro y’obong’aini aiga inse y’erioba, naro akarorekana ase ’nde ng’a namanene;
swahili: Pia niliona chini ya jua mfano huu wa hekima ambao ulinivutia sana:

english: There was a small city with few men. A mighty king came against it, surrounded it, and built large siege ramps against it.
ekegusii: Norenge omochie omoke omenyire nabaanto abake; omorwoti orenge omonene mono agacha koyorwania esegi; akayonaaria, akaagacha chiburi chinene chi’ogwekengera ase okoyorwania.
swahili: Palikuwa na mji mdogo uliokuwa na watu wachache ndani yake. Mfalme mwenye nguvu akainuka dhidi yake, akauzunguka akaweka jeshi kubwa dhidi yake.

english: Now a poor wise man was found in the city, and he saved the city by his wisdom. Yet no one remembered that poor man.
ekegusii: Korende ase omochie oyio akanyorekana aroro omonto omotaka orenge omong’aini, na ase obong’aini bwaye agatooria omochie oria. Nonya naboigo, monto onde tari oinyorete omotaka oria.
swahili: Katika mji huo kulikuwepo mtu mmoja maskini lakini mwenye hekima, naye akauokoa ule mji kwa hekima yake. Lakini hakuna aliyemkumbuka yule maskini.

english: And I said, “Wisdom is better than strength, but the wisdom of the poor man is despised, and his words are not heeded.”
ekegusii: Erio ngateeba, “Obong’aini nigo bore obuya mbobuete chinguru, nonya obong’aini bw’omonto oria omotaka bwachayetwe, na amang’ana aye tarenge koigwerwa.”
swahili: Kwa hiyo, nikasema, “Hekima ni bora kuliko nguvu.” Lakini hekima ya maskini imedharauliwa, wala hakuna anayesikiliza maneno yake.

english: The calm words of the wise are heeded over the shouts of a ruler among fools.
ekegusii: Nigo ere buya gotegerera amang’ana omonto omong’aini agokwana ase obotoereru kobua gotegerera amang’ana ’omogambi ogoaka eriogi ase egati y’abanto abariri.
swahili: Maneno ya utulivu ya mwenye hekima husikiwa kuliko makelele ya mtawala wa wapumbavu.

english: Wisdom is better than weapons of war, but one sinner destroys much good.
ekegusii: Obong’aini nigo bore obuya kobua ebirwanero bi’esegi; korende omonyabibe oyomo nigo agosaria amaya amange.
swahili: Hekima ni bora kuliko silaha za vita, lakini mwenye dhambi mmoja huharibu mema mengi.

english: It is the same for all: There is a common fate for the righteous and the wicked, for the good and the bad, for the clean and the unclean, for the one who sacrifices and the one who does not. As it is for the good, so it is for the sinner; as it is for the one who makes a vow, so it is for the one who refuses to take a vow.
ekegusii: Egento nekemo gekobanyora bonsi, omonyene oboronge na omonyabibe, oyore omuya na ochenegete na oyo otachenegeti, oyo okorua ebing’wanso na oyo otari kobirua. Buna ekoba ase omonto omuya, naboigo ekoba nase omonyabibe; buna ekoba ase oria okoria eira y’ogotiana, naboigo ekoba nase oria otari koria eira y’ogotiana.
swahili: Wote wanayo hatima inayofanana, mwadilifu na mwovu, mwema na mbaya, aliye safi na aliye najisi, wale wanaotoa dhabihu na wale wasiotoa. Kama ilivyo kwa mtu mwema, ndivyo ilivyo kwa mtu mwenye dhambi; kama ilivyo kwa wale wanaoapa, ndivyo ilivyo kwa wale wasioapa.

english: This is an evil in everything that is done under the sun: There is one fate for everyone. Furthermore, the hearts of men are full of evil and madness while they are alive, and afterward they join the dead.
ekegusii: Obo nabwo obobe ase aya onsi agokorekana aiga inse y’erioba, ng’a egento nekemo gekobanyora bonsi; chinkoro chia Mwanyabaanto nigo chiichire obobe na obobarimo ekero bare moyo, na magega y’ayio nigo bakogeenda ase abakuure.
swahili: Huu ni ubaya ulio katika kila kitu kinachotendeka chini ya jua: Mwisho unaofanana huwapata wote. Zaidi ya hayo, mioyo ya watu, imejaa ubaya na kuna wazimu mioyoni mwao wangali hai, hatimaye huungana na waliokufa.

english: There is hope, however, for anyone who is among the living; for even a live dog is better than a dead lion.
ekegusii: Korende omonto ore ase egati y’abare moyo nare nogosemeria, na esese ere moyo nigo ekonyora amaya kobua endo ekwete.
swahili: Yeyote aliye miongoni mwa walio hai analo tumaini, hata mbwa hai ni bora kuliko simba aliyekufa!

english: For the living know that they will die, but the dead know nothing. They have no further reward, because the memory of them is forgotten.
ekegusii: Ee, abare moyo mbamanyete ng’a mbakwe, korende abakuure tibamanyeti gento kende, na tibagenderereti konyora eng’eria; tibakoinyorwa nonya ndinde.
swahili: Kwa maana walio hai wanajua kwamba watakufa, lakini wafu hawajui chochote, hawana tuzo zaidi, hata kumbukumbu yao imesahaulika.

english: Their love, their hate, and their envy have already vanished, and they will never again have a share in all that is done under the sun. Enjoy Your Portion in This Life
ekegusii: Obwanchani bwabo, na okogecha, ne ribero, bionsi ebio nigo biasirete amo nabarabwo. Tibabwati nonya ng’ake egetari kende ase ayio agokorwa aiga inse y’erioba.
swahili: Upendo wao, chuki yao na wivu wao vimetoweka tangu kitambo, kamwe hawatakuwa tena na sehemu katika lolote linalotendeka chini ya jua.

english: Go, eat your bread with joy, and drink your wine with a cheerful heart, for God has already approved your works:
ekegusii: Aye bono genda, orie endagera yao nomogooko, na onywe edivai yao kore nomosasoko ase enkoro yao, ekiagera Nyasae bwanchire emeremo yao.
swahili: Nenda, kula chakula chako kwa furaha, unywe divai yako kwa moyo wa shangwe, kwa maana sasa Mungu anakubali unachofanya.

english: Let your garments always be white, and never spare the oil for your head.
ekegusii: Tiga chianga chiao chibe chindabu botambe, na amaguta okweakwa tamocha ase omotwe oo.
swahili: Daima uvae nguo nyeupe na daima upake kichwa chako mafuta.

english: Enjoy life with your beloved wife all the days of the fleeting life that God has given you under the sun—all your fleeting days. For this is your portion in life and in your labor under the sun.
ekegusii: Ase amatuko onsi ay’obogima obo bore bosa, obo Nyasae akoeire omenye aiga inse y’erioba, omenye nomogooko amo nomokuungu oo bwanchete. Okomenya nomogooko, nakio egetari kiao ase obogima obo, ekero ogendererete gwechanda ase emeremo emekong’u inse y’erioba.
swahili: Furahia maisha na mke wako, umpendaye, siku zote za maisha ya ubatili uliyopewa na Mungu chini ya jua, siku zote za ubatili. Kwa maana hili ndilo fungu lako katika maisha na katika kazi yako ya taabu chini ya jua.

english: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, To the saints in Ephesus, the faithful in Christ Jesus:
ekegusii: Inche Paulo, omotomwa o Kristo Yeso ase ogwancha kwa Nyasae, nkobariikera nde inwe abachenu abamomenyete Efeso, abeegeni ba Kristo Yeso:
swahili: Paulo, mtume wa Kristo Yesu, kwa mapenzi ya Mungu: Kwa watakatifu walioko Efeso, walio waaminifu katika Kristo Yesu:

english: as a plan for the fullness of time, to bring all things in heaven and on earth together in Christ.
ekegusii: ng’a ase ekero ki’ogoikeranigwa kw’engaaki nabeekeranie ebinto bionsi bibe n’obomo ase Kristo, ebinto bire igoro, na ebire ase ense, ase ere oyio.
swahili: ili yapate kutimizwa wakati mkamilifu utakapowadia, yaani, kuvitia vitu vyote vya mbinguni na vya duniani pamoja, chini ya kiongozi mmoja, ndiye Kristo.

english: In Him we were also chosen as God’s own, having been predestined according to the plan of Him who works out everything by the counsel of His will,
ekegusii: Ime yaye twanyorire omwando, koreng’ana buna twachooretwe korwa kare ase okorigia kwaye ere oy’okorete onsi koreng’ana nogwancha kwaye,
swahili: Katika Kristo sisi nasi tumepata urithi, tukisha kuchaguliwa sawasawa na kusudi la Mungu, yeye ambaye hufanya mambo yote kulingana na kusudi la mapenzi yake,

english: in order that we, who were the first to hope in Christ, would be for the praise of His glory.
ekegusii: erinde intwe abatwatang’anete komosemeria Kristo togere obonene bwaye botogigwe.
swahili: ili kwamba, sisi tuliokuwa wa kwanza kuweka tumaini katika Kristo, tupate kuishi kwa sifa ya utukufu wake.

english: And in Him, having heard and believed the word of truth—the gospel of your salvation—you were sealed with the promised Holy Spirit,
ekegusii: Ase ere oyio, inwe abamwaigure ring’ana ri’ekeene, enchiri y’ogotooreka kwaino, na komwaikire komwegena ere, mokabekwa ekemanyererio n’Omoika Omochenu, oria mwarieretwe eira.
swahili: Ninyi pia mliingia ndani ya Kristo mliposikia Neno la kweli, Injili ya wokovu wenu. Mkiisha kuamini, ndani yake mlitiwa muhuri, yaani, Roho Mtakatifu mliyeahidiwa,

english: who is the pledge of our inheritance until the redemption of those who are God’s possession, to the praise of His glory. Spiritual Wisdom (1 Corinthians 2:6–16)
ekegusii: Oyo nere ore intenenera ase omwando oito, goika okoboorigwa kw’abare aba Nyasae, ase ogotogigwa kw’obonene bwaye. Ogosaba gwa Paulo
swahili: yeye ambaye ni amana yetu akituhakikishia urithi wetu hadi ukombozi wa wale walio milki ya Mungu kwa sifa ya utukufu wake. Shukrani Na Maombi

english: For this reason, ever since I heard about your faith in the Lord Jesus and your love for all the saints,
ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio, ekero naigwete amang’ana y’okwegena kwaino more nakorokwo ase Omonene Yeso, na obwanchani bwaino ase abachenu bonsi,
swahili: Kwa sababu hii, tangu niliposikia juu ya imani yenu katika Bwana Yesu na upendo wenu kwa watakatifu wote,

english: I have not stopped giving thanks for you, remembering you in my prayers,
ekegusii: tintigeti koiraneria ng’a mbuya mono ase engencho yaino, na kobainyora ase ogosaba kw’ane.
swahili: sijaacha kumshukuru Mungu kwa ajili yenu, nikiwakumbuka katika maombi yangu.

english: that the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the glorious Father, may give you a spirit of wisdom and revelation in your knowledge of Him.
ekegusii: Nasabire ng’a Nyasae Omonene oito Yeso Kristo, Tata Obonene, abae omoika bw’obong’aini na bw’okomaanorerwa, erinde momomanye;
swahili: Nazidi kumwomba Mungu wa Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo, Baba wa utukufu, awajalieni ninyi roho ya hekima na ya ufunuo, ili mpate kumjua zaidi.

english: I ask that the eyes of your heart may be enlightened, so that you may know the hope of His calling, the riches of His glorious inheritance in the saints,
ekegusii: naende ng’a amaiso ye chinkoro chiaino abekwe omobaso, erinde momanye ogosemeria koria abarangereretie monyore, na komanya obonda bw’obonene bw’omwando oye buna bore, obo abachenu baeirwe.
swahili: Ninaomba pia kwamba macho ya mioyo yenu yatiwe nuru ili mpate kujua tumaini mliloitiwa, utajiri wa urithi wa utukufu wake kwa watakatifu

english: and the surpassing greatness of His power to us who believe. These are in accordance with the working of His mighty strength,
ekegusii: Nasabire ng’a momanye obonene bw’okobua kwaye botari nekerengo, obo bwatoikeire intwe abatwegenire koreng’ana nogokora gw’okobua kwaye okonene.
swahili: na uweza wake mkuu usiolinganishwa kwa ajili yetu sisi tuaminio. Uweza huo unaofanya kazi ndani yetu, ni sawa na ile nguvu kuu mno

english: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ. Spiritual Blessings (Romans 8:28–34)
ekegusii: Obuya bobe ase more na omorembe bikorwa ase Nyasae Tata oito, na ase Omonene Yeso Kristo. Ogosesenigwa kw’omoika ase Kristo
swahili: Neema na amani itokayo kwa Mungu Baba yetu na kwa Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo iwe nanyi. Baraka Za Kiroho Katika Kristo Yesu

english: which He exerted in Christ when He raised Him from the dead and seated Him at His right hand in the heavenly realms,
ekegusii: Ere nigo akorete emeremo eyio ase Kristo ekero amoboogetie korwa ase abakuure, akamoikaransia ensemo y’okoboko kwaye gw’okorio aaria igoro,
swahili: aliyoitumia katika Kristo alipomfufua kutoka kwa wafu, na akamketisha mkono wake wa kuume huko mbinguni,

english: far above all rule and authority, power and dominion, and every name that is named, not only in the present age but also in the one to come.
ekegusii: igoro mono kobua okogaamba gwonsi, na okobua, ne chinguru, na oborwoti, na igoro ya kera erieta rigwatorwa, tari ase ense eye yoka, korende neria egochia‐gocha boigo.
swahili: juu sana kuliko falme zote na mamlaka, enzi na milki, na juu ya kila jina litajwalo, si katika ulimwengu huu tu, bali katika ule ujao pia.

english: And God put everything under His feet and made Him head over everything for the church,
ekegusii: Naende akabeeka ebinto bionsi inse y’amagoro aye, akamobeka abe omotwe igoro y’ebinto bionsi ase ekanisa,
swahili: Naye Mungu ameweka vitu vyote viwe chini ya miguu yake na amemfanya yeye awe kichwa cha vitu vyote kwa ajili ya Kanisa,

english: which is His body, the fullness of Him who fills all in all.
ekegusii: eyio ere omobere oye, ogoikerania kwaye ere oyogoikerania ebinto bionsi ase bonsi.
swahili: ambalo ndilo mwili wake, ukamilifu wake yeye aliye yote katika yote.

english: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us in Christ with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly realms.
ekegusii: Nyasae, Ise Omonene oito Yeso Kristo, atogigwe, ere oyotosesenetie ase Kristo nogosesenigwa gwonsi kw’omoika aase aaria igoro,
swahili: Ahimidiwe Mungu na Baba wa Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo, aliyetubariki sisi kwa baraka zote za rohoni, katika ulimwengu wa roho ndani ya Kristo.

english: For He chose us in Him before the foundation of the world to be holy and blameless in His presence. In love
ekegusii: buna atochoorete ase ere ritang’ani ense etarabekwa oboroso, erinde tobe abachenu, totari na komocha ase obosio bwaye.
swahili: Kwa maana alituchagua katika yeye kabla ya kuumbwa ulimwengu ili tuwe watakatifu na bila lawama mbele zake. Kwa upendo

english: He predestined us for adoption as His sons through Jesus Christ, according to the good pleasure of His will,
ekegusii: Ase obwanchani bwaye Nyasae atochorete korwa kare, erinde tokorwe koba abana baye ase enchera ya Yeso Kristo, koreng’ana nokogania kw’ogwancha kwaye,
swahili: alitangulia kutuchagua tuwe wanawe kwa njia ya Yesu Kristo kwa furaha yake na mapenzi yake mwenyewe.

english: to the praise of His glorious grace, which He has freely given us in the Beloved One.
ekegusii: erinde obonene bw’obuya bwaye botogigwe, obo atoeire buna ekeegwa ase Omwanchwa oye.
swahili: Kwa hiyo tunamsifu Mungu kwa huruma zake kuu alizotumiminia sisi katika Mwanawe Mpendwa.

english: In Him we have redemption through His blood, the forgiveness of our trespasses, according to the riches of His grace
ekegusii: Ase are ere ntore nokoboorigwa ase amanyinga aye, na okwaberwa kw’ebibe biaito ase obonge bw’obuya bwaye,
swahili: Ndani yake tunao ukombozi kwa njia ya damu yake, yaani, msamaha wa dhambi, sawasawa na wingi wa neema yake

english: that He lavished on us with all wisdom and understanding.
ekegusii: obo ere akabomenta ase tore ase chiseemi na obong’aini bwonsi.
swahili: aliyotumiminia kwa wingi, kwa hekima yote na maarifa yote.

english: And He has made known to us the mystery of His will according to His good pleasure, which He purposed in Christ
ekegusii: Nyasae agatomanyia obobisi bw’ogwancha kwaye, koreng’ana nokogania kwaye buna aroberetie ase Kristo,
swahili: Naye alitujulisha siri ya mapenzi yake sawasawa na uradhi wa mapenzi yake, ambayo alikusudia katika Kristo,

english: And you were dead in your trespasses and sins,
ekegusii: Inwe nigo mwareenge mokwete ase ogosaria kwaino, na ebibe biaino.
swahili: Kwa habari zenu, mlikuwa wafu katika makosa na dhambi zenu,

english: For we are God’s workmanship, created in Christ Jesus to do good works, which God prepared in advance as our way of life. One in Christ (Philippians 2:1–4)
ekegusii: Inaki nigo tore emeremo y’amaboko aye, togatongwa ase Kristo Yeso, erinde tokore ogokora okuya okwo Nyasae aroisetie ritang’ani, erio totaare ime ase okwo. Abamo na Kristo
swahili: Kwa maana sisi ni kazi ya mikono ya Mungu, tulioumbwa katika Kristo Yesu, ili tupate kutenda matendo mema, ambayo Mungu alitangulia kuyaandaa tupate kuishi katika hayo. Wamoja Katika Kristo

english: Therefore remember that formerly you who are Gentiles in the flesh and called uncircumcised by the so-called circumcision (that done in the body by human hands)—
ekegusii: Ase ayio, inyora buna mwareenge kare. Inwe abanto b’Ebisaku ase chingeencho chi’omobere mware korokwa abanto batarogeti na baria bakwaroka ase okwaroka kw’omobere kogokorwa n’amaboko.
swahili: Kwa hiyo kumbukeni kwamba ninyi ambao hapo awali mlikuwa watu wa Mataifa kwa kuzaliwa na kuitwa “wasiotahiriwa” na wale wanaojiita “waliotahiriwa” (yaani tohara ifanyikayo katika mwili kwa mikono ya wanadamu),

english: remember that at that time you were separate from Christ, alienated from the commonwealth of Israel, and strangers to the covenants of the promise, without hope and without God in the world.
ekegusii: Inyora ng’a engaki eria timwareenge na Kristo, nigo mwatananekanete korwa ase obobiare bw’Abaisraeli, abageni b’okobwatana kw’eira, motareenge na gosemeria konde, na motareenge na gosemeria na Nyasae ase ense.
swahili: kumbukeni kwamba wakati ule mlikuwa mbali na Kristo, mkiwa mmetengwa kutoka jumuiya ya Israeli, na mkiwa wageni katika yale maagano ya ahadi, nanyi mkiwa hamna tumaini wala Mungu duniani.

english: But now in Christ Jesus you who once were far away have been brought near through the blood of Christ.
ekegusii: Korende bono, ase Kristo Yeso, inwe abamwareenge are agwo ritang’ani, mwarentirwe ang’e n’amanyinga a Kristo.
swahili: Lakini sasa katika Kristo Yesu, ninyi ambao hapo kwanza mlikuwa mbali na Mungu, sasa mmeletwa karibu kwa njia ya damu ya Kristo.

english: For He Himself is our peace, who has made the two one and has torn down the dividing wall of hostility
ekegusii: Inaki Kristo nomorembe oito, otokorete intwe, Abayahudi n’Abagiliki, koba oyomo, goetera ase omobere oye agatagora etoto eria yatwatananete, engencho yaye obobisa.
swahili: Kwa maana yeye mwenyewe ndiye amani yetu, aliyetufanya sisi tuliokuwa wawili, yaani, Wayahudi na watu wa Mataifa, tuwe wamoja kwa kuvunja kizuizi na kubomoa ule ukuta wa uadui uliokuwa kati yetu,

english: by abolishing in His flesh the law of commandments and decrees. He did this to create in Himself one new man out of the two, thus making peace
