ekegusii: Ere agasiria richiiko ri’Abayahudi n’emeroberio y’amachiiko, erinde ase ere omonyene atonge omonto oyomo omoyia korwa ase baria babere, igo agakora omorembe,
swahili: kwa kuibatilisha ile sheria pamoja na amri zake na maagizo yake alipoutoa mwili wake, ili apate kufanya ndani yake mtu mmoja mpya badala ya hao wawili, hivyo akifanya amani,

english: and reconciling both of them to God in one body through the cross, by which He extinguished their hostility.
ekegusii: na kobwatania baria babere na Nyasae ase omobere oyoomo, ase omosalaba, aase aiterete obobisa boria.
swahili: naye katika mwili huu mmoja awapatanishe wote wawili na Mungu kupitia msalaba, ili kwa huo msalaba akaangamiza uadui wao.

english: He came and preached peace to you who were far away and peace to those who were near.
ekegusii: Kristo agacha korandia omorembe ase abanto b’ebisaku abwo mwareenge are, na ase Abayahudi abwo bareenge ang’e.
swahili: Alikuja na kuhubiri amani kwenu ninyi mliokuwa mbali na pia akahubiri amani kwao waliokuwa karibu.

english: For through Him we both have access to the Father by one Spirit. Christ Our Cornerstone (Isaiah 28:14–22; 1 Corinthians 3:10–15; 1 Peter 2:1–8)
ekegusii: Inaki goeteera ase Kristo intwe twensi Abayahudi amo n’abanto b’ebisaku twanyorire enchera y’okomoika ang’e na Tata, ase Omoika oyomo.
swahili: Kwa maana kwa kupitia kwake, sisi sote tunaweza kumkaribia Baba katika Roho mmoja.

english: Therefore you are no longer strangers and foreigners, but fellow citizens with the saints and members of God’s household,
ekegusii: Gaki korwa bono inwe abanto b’ebisaku timori abamenyi gose abaeti, korende mwabeire ababiare amo n’abachenu, abanto b’enyomba ya Nyasae,
swahili: Hivyo basi, ninyi sasa si wageni tena wala wapitaji, bali mmekuwa wenyeji pamoja na watakatifu na pia jamaa wa nyumbani mwake Mungu.

english: in which you used to walk when you conformed to the ways of this world and of the ruler of the power of the air, the spirit who is now at work in the sons of disobedience.
ekegusii: Ime ase ebio nigo mwabigendererete kare ase ogotunyana chingeencho chi’ense eye, na gotunyana omogambi bw’okobua kwa igoro gati, oyore omoika oria ogokora emeremo ase abanto bataigwereti Nyasae.
swahili: ambazo mlizitenda mlipofuatisha namna ya ulimwengu huu na za yule mtawala wa ufalme wa anga, yule roho atendaye kazi sasa ndani ya wale wasiotii.

english: built on the foundation of the apostles and prophets, with Christ Jesus Himself as the cornerstone.
ekegusii: mwagaachirwe igoro y’oboroso bw’abatomwa na ababani, na Kristo Yeso omonyene nere rigena rinene ri’ekoona.
swahili: Mmejengwa juu ya msingi wa mitume na manabii, naye Kristo Yesu mwenyewe ndiye jiwe kuu la pembeni.

english: In Him the whole building is fitted together and grows into a holy temple in the Lord.
ekegusii: Ase are ere oboagacho bwonsi bwabwataniigwe amo, na gokiina, bobe Hekalu Enchenu ase Omonene.
swahili: Ndani yake jengo lote limeshikamanishwa pamoja na kusimamishwa ili kuwa Hekalu takatifu katika Bwana.

english: And in Him you too are being built together into a dwelling place for God in His Spirit.
ekegusii: Asere inwe boigo mw’agaachirwe amo, mobe obomenyo bwa Nyasae, ase Omoika.
swahili: Katika yeye ninyi nanyi mnajengwa pamoja ili mpate kuwa makao ambayo Mungu anaishi ndani yake kwa njia ya Roho wake.

english: All of us also lived among them at one time, fulfilling the cravings of our flesh and indulging its desires and thoughts. Like the rest, we were by nature children of wrath.
ekegusii: Naboigo naintwe twensi twagendete agwo kare ase okogania gwe chingeencho chiaito chimbe, togaikerania okogania kw’emebere yaito, na ebirengererio biaito, tokaba ase chingeencho chiaito; abanto abaragwe ase endamwamu ya Nyasae buna abwo bande.
swahili: Sisi sote pia tuliishi katikati yao hapo zamani, tukitimiza tamaa za asili yetu ya dhambi na kufuata tamaa zake na mawazo yake. Nasi kwa asili tulikuwa wana wa ghadhabu, kama mtu mwingine yeyote.

english: But because of His great love for us, God, who is rich in mercy,
ekegusii: Korende Nyasae, oyore n’obonge bw’amaabera, ase obwanchani bwaye obonene atwanchete,
swahili: Lakini Mungu kwa upendo wake mwingi kwetu sisi, ambaye ni mwingi wa rehema,

english: made us alive with Christ even when we were dead in our trespasses. It is by grace you have been saved!
ekegusii: nonya n’ekero keria twareenge tokwete ase ogosaria gwaito, agatoa obogima amo na Kristo; inaki mwatoorigwe ase obuya bwa Nyasae.
swahili: hata tulipokuwa wafu kwa ajili ya makosa yetu, alitufanya tuwe hai pamoja na Kristo Yesu, yaani, mmeokolewa kwa neema.

english: And God raised us up with Christ and seated us with Him in the heavenly realms in Christ Jesus,
ekegusii: Naende agatobookia amo nere, agatoikaransia amo nere aaria igoro ase Kristo Yeso,
swahili: Mungu alitufufua pamoja na Kristo na kutuketisha pamoja naye katika ulimwengu wa roho katika Kristo Yesu,

english: in order that in the coming ages He might display the surpassing riches of His grace, demonstrated by His kindness to us in Christ Jesus.
ekegusii: erinde ase ebiro biraache naorokie obonda bw’obuya bwaye, obo boetete ekerengo, ase obwororo ase tore ime ase Kristo Yeso.
swahili: ili katika ule ulimwengu ujao apate kuonyesha wingi wa neema yake isiyopimika, iliyodhihirishwa kwetu kwa wema wake ndani ya Kristo Yesu.

english: For it is by grace you have been saved through faith, and this not from yourselves; it is the gift of God,
ekegusii: Inaki mwatoorigwe ase obuya, ase enchera y’okwegena; ayio tarwete ase more abanyene, korende nekeegwa kia Nyasae;
swahili: Kwa maana mmeokolewa kwa neema, kwa njia ya imani, wala si kwa matendo yenu mema. Hii ni zawadi kutoka kwa Mungu,

english: not by works, so that no one can boast.
ekegusii: gose tari ase ogokora, monto onde taacha gwetogia.
swahili: si kwa matendo, ili mtu yeyote asije akajisifu.

english: For this reason I, Paul, the prisoner of Christ Jesus for the sake of you Gentiles...
ekegusii: Inaki ase ayio inche Paulo nabeire omosibwa o Kristo Yeso ase engencho yaino, inwe abanto b’Ebisaku.
swahili: Kwa sababu hii, mimi Paulo, mfungwa wa Kristo Yesu kwa ajili yenu ninyi watu wa Mataifa:

english: His purpose was that now, through the church, the manifold wisdom of God should be made known to the rulers and authorities in the heavenly realms,
ekegusii: erinde bono, ase enchera y’ekanisa, obong’aini bwa Nyasae, obore ne chingeencho chinyinge, bomanyekane n’abagaambi na abare nokobua kwa igoro.
swahili: Ili sasa kwa njia ya Kanisa, hekima yote ya Mungu ipate kujulikana kwa watawala na wenye mamlaka katika ulimwengu wa roho,

english: according to the eternal purpose that He accomplished in Christ Jesus our Lord.
ekegusii: Nabo kwareenge okorigia kwaye gwa kare na kare, okwo aikeranetie ase Kristo Yeso, Omonene oito.
swahili: sawasawa na kusudi lake la milele katika Kristo Yesu Bwana wetu.

english: In Him and through faith in Him we may enter God’s presence with boldness and confidence.
ekegusii: Asere ntore noboremu na ogosemeria kw’ogosoa ase enchera y’okomwegena.
swahili: Ndani yake na kwa njia ya imani katika yeye twaweza kumkaribia Mungu kwa uhuru na kwa ujasiri.

english: So I ask you not to be discouraged because of my sufferings for you, which are your glory. Paul’s Prayer for the Ephesians
ekegusii: Gaki nabasabire, timokwa emioyo ase engencho y’ogochaandwa kw’ane inde nakwo ase engencho yaino, okore obonene bwaino. Obwanchani bwa Kristo
swahili: Kwa hiyo, nawaomba msikate tamaa kwa sababu ya mateso yangu kwa ajili yenu, hayo ni utukufu wenu. Maombi Ya Paulo Kwa Waefeso

english: ... for this reason I bow my knees before the Father,
ekegusii: Ase ayio namobekeire amaru aane inse Tata,
swahili: Kwa sababu hii nampigia Baba magoti,

english: from whom every family in heaven and on earth derives its name.
ekegusii: ekiagera bonsi abakorwa ase Tata, abare igoro na abare ase ense, nigo bakorokwa ase erieta riaye.
swahili: ambaye ubaba wote wa kila jamaa za mbinguni na za duniani unatokana naye.

english: I ask that out of the riches of His glory He may strengthen you with power through His Spirit in your inner being,
ekegusii: Nasabire ng’a koreng’ana nobonda bw’obonene bwaye, abanchere momentwe chinguru ase okobua goeteera ase Omoika oye ase omonto o ime;
swahili: Namwomba Mungu awaimarishe kwa kuwatia nguvu mioyo yenu kwa njia ya Roho wake kwa kadiri ya utajiri wa utukufu wake,

english: so that Christ may dwell in your hearts through faith. Then you, being rooted and grounded in love,
ekegusii: na Kristo amenye ase chinkoro chiaino komwamwegenire. Nasabire ng’a inwe komor’abe n’emeri na oboroso ase obwanchani,
swahili: ili kwamba, Kristo apate kukaa mioyoni mwenu kwa njia ya imani. Nami ninaomba kwamba ninyi mkiwa wenye mizizi tena imara katika msingi wa upendo,

english: will have power, together with all the saints, to comprehend the length and width and height and depth
ekegusii: monyaare koba ne chinguru ase okomanya amo nabachenu bonsi obogare na obotambe, na gochia igoro, na gochia inse,
swahili: mwe na uwezo wa kufahamu pamoja na watakatifu wote jinsi ulivyo upana, urefu, kimo na kina upendo wa Kristo,

english: of the love of Christ, and to know this love that surpasses knowledge, that you may be filled with all the fullness of God.
ekegusii: na komanya obwanchani bwa Kristo oboetete okomanya, erinde monyaare goichorigwa ogoichorwa gwonsi kwa Nyasae.
swahili: na kujua upendo huu unaopita fahamu, ili mpate kujazwa na kufikia kipimo cha ukamilifu wote wa Mungu.

english: Surely you have heard about the stewardship of God’s grace that was given to me for you,
ekegusii: Ase ekeene mwaigure amang’ana y’oborendi bw’obuya bwa Nyasae, obo naetwe ase engencho yaino.
swahili: Kwa hakika mmekwisha kusikia kuhusu ile huduma ya neema ya Mungu niliyopewa kwa ajili yenu,

english: Now to Him who is able to do so much more than all we ask or imagine, according to His power that is at work within us,
ekegusii: Gaki, ase are ere oyoranyaare gokora goetania mono kobua aya togosaba gose aya tokorengereria, koreng’ana ne chinguru chigokora emeremo ime ase tore,
swahili: Basi kwa yeye awezaye kutenda mambo ya ajabu yasiyopimika kuliko yote tuyaombayo au tuyawazayo, kwa kadiri ya uweza wake ule utendao kazi ndani yetu,

english: to Him be the glory in the church and in Christ Jesus throughout all generations, forever and ever. Amen.
ekegusii: ase are ere obonene ase ekanisa na ase Kristo Yeso goika ebigori bionsi kare na kare. Amina.
swahili: yeye atukuzwe katika kanisa na katika Kristo Yesu kwa vizazi vyote, milele na milele. Amen.

english: that is, the mystery made known to me by revelation, as I have already written briefly.
ekegusii: Ase okomaanorerwa nateebetigwe obobisi boria buna nabariikera reero iga ase amang’ana amake.
swahili: yaani, ile siri iliodhihirishwa kwangu kwa njia ya ufunuo, kama nilivyotangulia kuandika kwa kifupi.

english: In reading this, then, you will be able to understand my insight into the mystery of Christ,
ekegusii: Ase ayio, ekero morayasome, inamonyaare korora okomanya kw’ane kw’obobisi bwa Kristo.
swahili: Kwa kusoma haya, basi mtaweza kuelewa ufahamu wangu katika siri ya Kristo.

english: which was not made known to men in other generations as it has now been revealed by the Spirit to God’s holy apostles and prophets.
ekegusii: Obobisi obo Nyasae tamanyetie Mwanyabaanto ase ebigori binde buna bono ase Omoika abaigoreire abatomwa baye abachenu na ababani.
swahili: Siri hii haikudhihirishwa kwa wanadamu katika vizazi vingine kama vile sasa ilivyodhihirishwa na Roho kwa mitume na manabii watakatifu wa Mungu.

english: This mystery is that through the gospel the Gentiles are fellow heirs, fellow members of the body, and fellow partakers of the promise in Christ Jesus.
ekegusii: Obobisi boria nobo, ng’a abanto b’Ebisaku babeire abanyamwando amo naintwe, ebiimo bi’omobere oyomo, na ababwatani amo naintwe ase eira ere ase Kristo Yeso ase enchera y’enchiri.
swahili: Siri hii ni kwamba, kwa njia ya Injili, watu wa Mataifa ni warithi pamoja na Israeli, viungo vya mwili mmoja na washiriki pamoja wa ahadi katika Kristo Yesu.

english: I became a servant of this gospel by the gift of God’s grace, given me through the working of His power.
ekegusii: Nabo ’ngakorwa koba omosomba bw’enchiri eye koreng’ana nekeegwa ki’obuya bwa Nyasae obo naetwe ase ogokora gw’okobua kwaye.
swahili: Nimekuwa mtumishi wa Injili hii kwa kipawa cha neema ya Mungu niliyopewa kwa nguvu yake itendayo kazi.

english: Though I am less than the least of all the saints, this grace was given me: to preach to the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ,
ekegusii: Inche inde omoke kobua abachenu bonsi; nonya nabo ’nkaegwa obuya bw’okoranderia abanto b’Ebisaku obonda bwa Kristo, obo botari korengeka.
swahili: Ingawa mimi ni mdogo kuliko aliye mdogo kabisa miongoni mwa watakatifu wote, nilipewa neema hii: ili niwahubirie watu wa Mataifa kuhusu utajiri usiopimika ulio ndani ya Kristo,

english: and to illuminate for everyone the stewardship of this mystery, which for ages past was kept hidden in God, who created all things.
ekegusii: Nkaegwa kobaorokereria abanto bonsi barore omooroberio bw’obobisi boria bwabisetwe korwa kare ase Nyasae, oyotongete ebinto bionsi;
swahili: na kuweka wazi kwa kila mtu siri hii iliyokuwa imefichwa tangu zamani katika Mungu, aliyeumba vitu vyote.

english: As a prisoner in the Lord, then, I urge you to walk in a manner worthy of the calling you have received:
ekegusii: Ase ayio, inche omosibwa ase engencho y’Omonene nabasoroire mogenderere buna egwenerete okorangerigwa kwaino mwarangereretigwe
swahili: Basi, mimi niliye mfungwa wa Bwana, nawasihi mwenende kama inavyostahili wito wenu mlioitiwa.

english: He who descended is the very One who ascended above all the heavens, in order to fill all things.
ekegusii: Oyoigete nere oyio ogendete boigo igoro ya igoro, erinde ebinto bionsi biichorwe nere.)
swahili: Yeye aliyeshuka ndiye alipaa juu zaidi kupita mbingu zote, ili apate kuujaza ulimwengu wote.)

english: And it was He who gave some to be apostles, some to be prophets, some to be evangelists, and some to be pastors and teachers,
ekegusii: Ere akarua abande babe abatomwa, na abande ababani, na abande abarandia, na abande abarisia, na abande aboorokia.
swahili: Ndiye aliweka wengine kuwa mitume, wengine kuwa manabii, wengine kuwa wainjilisti, wengine kuwa wachungaji na walimu,

english: to equip the saints for works of ministry and to build up the body of Christ,
ekegusii: Agakora bo ase ogoikerania abachenu ase emeremo y’obosomba, goika omobere o Kristo oagachwe.
swahili: kwa kusudi la kuwakamilisha watakatifu kwa ajili ya kazi za huduma, ili kwamba mwili wa Kristo upate kujengwa

english: until we all reach unity in the faith and in the knowledge of the Son of God, as we mature to the full measure of the stature of Christ.
ekegusii: Nabo goika intwe twensi tonyaare goikera obomo bw’okwegena, na komanya mono Omwana o Nyasae, na koba omonto omoikeranu, goika ekerengo ki’ogokiina kw’ogoichorwa gwa Kristo;
swahili: mpaka sote tutakapoufikia umoja katika imani na katika kumjua sana Mwana wa Mungu na kuwa watu wazima kwa kufikia kimo cha ukamilifu wa Kristo.

english: Then we will no longer be infants, tossed about by the waves and carried around by every wind of teaching and by the clever cunning of men in their deceitful scheming.
ekegusii: erinde titoba naende abana ebing’werere, bagotumatumigwa aaria na aaria, na koirurukigwa ase kera embeo y’okworokereria, ase obong’ainereria bw’abaanto, ekero bakobang’aina kobwatia chiinchera chi’okobasiria.
swahili: Ili tusiwe tena watoto wachanga, tukitupwatupwa huku na huku na kuchukuliwa na kila upepo wa mafundisho kwa hila za watu, kwa ujanja, kwa kufuata njia zao za udanganyifu.

english: Instead, speaking the truth in love, we will in all things grow up into Christ Himself, who is the head.
ekegusii: Korende tokwane ekeene ase obwanchani, tokiine goika toikere Kristo ase chiinchera chionsi; nere ore omotwe.
swahili: Badala yake, tukiambiana kweli kwa upendo, katika mambo yote tukue, hata tumfikie yeye aliye kichwa, yaani, Kristo.

english: From Him the whole body, fitted and held together by every supporting ligament, grows and builds itself up in love through the work of each individual part. New Life in Christ (Colossians 3:1–17)
ekegusii: Ase are ere omobere bwonsi onyare gokiina ogokiina kw’omobere na kweagaacha omonyene ase obwanchani, korasang’ananigwe na kobwatanigwa ase ogokoonywa gwa kera ekiimo koreng’ana n’emeremo ya kera ensemo. Obogima obokoro na boria oboyia
swahili: Kutoka kwake, mwili wote ukiwa umeungamanishwa na kushikamanishwa pamoja kwa msaada wa kila kiungo, hukua na kujijenga wenyewe katika upendo, wakati kila kiungo kinafanya kazi yake. Maisha Ya Zamani Na Maisha Mapya

english: So I tell you this, and insist on it in the Lord, that you must no longer walk as the Gentiles do, in the futility of their thinking.
ekegusii: Bono ’ngokwana nde ring’ana eri, na koba kirori ase Omonene; korwa bono timogeenda buna abanto b’Ebisaku bakogeenda ase ebirengorerio biabo bitari nengeencho.
swahili: Hivyo nawaambia hivi, nami nasisitiza katika Bwana kwamba, msiishi tena kama watu wa Mataifa waishivyo, katika ubatili wa mawazo yao.

english: They are darkened in their understanding and alienated from the life of God because of the ignorance that is in them due to the hardness of their hearts.
ekegusii: Obong’aini bwabo bwabekirwe omosunte, barusananiigwe korwa ase obogima bwa Nyasae ekiagera ase ogotamanya koria kore ime ase bare ase engencho y’obokong’u bwe chinkoro chiabo.
swahili: Watu hao akili zao zimetiwa giza na wametengwa mbali na uzima wa Mungu kwa sababu ya ujinga wao kutokana na ugumu wa mioyo yao.

english: Having lost all sense of shame, they have given themselves over to sensuality for the practice of every kind of impurity, with a craving for more.
ekegusii: Chinkoro chiabo chiabeire n’amagandi, bebeekire ase chingeencho chiimbe chi’omobere, erio ase obwegimeria banyaare gokora kera engencho y’eubi.
swahili: Wakiisha kufa ganzi, wamejitia katika mambo ya ufisadi na kupendelea kila aina ya uchafu, wakiendelea kutamani zaidi.

english: with all humility and gentleness, with patience, bearing with one another in love,
ekegusii: ase obokanyeku bwonsi na obwororo, na ase oboremereria mokobogorerania ase obwanchani.
swahili: Kwa unyenyekevu wote na upole, mkiwa wavumilivu, mkichukuliana kwa upendo.

english: But this is not the way you came to know Christ.
ekegusii: Korende inwe timworokereretigwe komomanya Kristo ase enchera eyio.
swahili: Lakini ninyi, hivyo sivyo mlivyojifunza Kristo.

english: Surely you heard of Him and were taught in Him—in keeping with the truth that is in Jesus—
ekegusii: Inwe mwamoigwete na kworokererigwa nere, buna ekeene kere ime ase Yeso.
swahili: Kama hivyo ndivyo ilivyo, ninyi mmemsikia, tena mmefundishwa naye, vile kweli ilivyo katika Yesu.

english: to put off your former way of life, your old self, which is being corrupted by its deceitful desires;
ekegusii: Rusia chingeencho chiaino chi’eritang’ani chi’oboMwanyabaanto bwa kare, obwasariigwe ase okobwatia okogania kw’obong’ainereria;
swahili: Mlifundishwa kuuvua mwenendo wenu wa zamani, utu wenu wa kale, ulioharibiwa na tamaa zake za udanganyifu,

english: to be renewed in the spirit of your minds;
ekegusii: mokorwe abayia ase emeika na ebirengererio biaino,
swahili: ili mfanywe upya roho na nia zenu,

english: and to put on the new self, created to be like God in true righteousness and holiness.
ekegusii: mweboyie omonto omoyia, oyotongetwe ase omogwekano o Nyasae ase oboronge na obochenu bw’ekeene. Emeroberio y’obogima oboyia
swahili: mkajivike utu mpya, ulioumbwa sawasawa na mfano wa Mungu katika haki yote na utakatifu. Kanuni Za Maisha Mapya

english: Therefore each of you must put off falsehood and speak truthfully to his neighbor, for we are all members of one another.
ekegusii: Gaki aboria oborimo, mokw’ane ekeene kera omonto nomogisangio oye, inaki nigo tore ebiimo ebimo intwe ase intwe.
swahili: Kwa hiyo kila mmoja wenu avue uongo na kuambiana kweli mtu na jirani yake, kwa maana sisi sote tu viungo vya mwili mmoja.

english: “Be angry, yet do not sin.” Do not let the sun set upon your anger,
ekegusii: Mobee, korende timokora ebibe; erioba tiriigwa na inwe more n’endamwamu,
swahili: Mkikasirika, msitende dhambi, wala jua lisichwe mkiwa bado mmekasirika,

english: and do not give the devil a foothold.
ekegusii: gose timoa Saitani ribaga.
swahili: wala msimpe ibilisi nafasi.

english: He who has been stealing must steal no longer, but must work, doing good with his own hands, that he may have something to share with the one in need.
ekegusii: Omoibi taiba naende; mbuya akore emeremo ase omokia namaboko aye na gokora ayare amaya, erinde abe negento akomwatanera oyoremeire.
swahili: Yeye ambaye amekuwa akiiba, asiibe tena, lakini lazima ajishughulishe, afanye kitu kifaacho kwa mikono yake mwenyewe, ili awe na kitu cha kuwagawia wahitaji.

english: Let no unwholesome talk come out of your mouths, but only what is helpful for building up the one in need and bringing grace to those who listen.
ekegusii: Ogokwana okobe tikorua ase emenwa yaino, korende okore okuya na okoranyaare kobaa obuya abwo bagokoigwa na koagaacha abaganeirie koagaachwa.
swahili: Maneno mabaya yasitoke vinywani mwenu, bali yale yafaayo kwa ajili ya kuwajenga wengine kulingana na mahitaji yao, ili yawafae wale wasikiao.

english: and with diligence to preserve the unity of the Spirit through the bond of peace.
ekegusii: Mokore omokia konyora obomo bw’Omoika ase egesibo ki’omorembe.
swahili: Jitahidini kudumisha umoja wa Roho katika kifungo cha amani.

english: And do not grieve the Holy Spirit of God, in whom you were sealed for the day of redemption.
ekegusii: Gose timoichania Omoika Omochenu o Nyasae, ase are ere oyomwabegetwe ekemanyererio goika rituko ri’okoboorigwa.
swahili: Wala msimhuzunishe Roho Mtakatifu wa Mungu, ambaye kwake mlitiwa muhuri kwa ajili ya siku ya ukombozi.

english: Get rid of all bitterness, rage and anger, outcry and slander, along with every form of malice.
ekegusii: Obororo bwonsi, na endamwamu, na okobea, na eriomana, na emerumi birusigwe ase more, amo n’obobe bwonsi.
swahili: Ondoeni kabisa uchungu, ghadhabu, hasira, makelele na masingizio pamoja na kila aina ya uovu.

english: Be kind and tenderhearted to one another, forgiving each other just as in Christ God forgave you.
ekegusii: Mobe nobwororo inwe ase inwe, mororerane amabeebe, na kwaberana inwe ase inwe, buna Nyasae ase Kristo abaaberete inwe.
swahili: Kuweni wafadhili na wenye kuhurumiana ninyi kwa ninyi, mkisameheana, kama vile naye Mungu katika Kristo alivyowasamehe ninyi.

english: There is one body and one Spirit, just as you were called to one hope when you were called;
ekegusii: Omobere n’oyoomo, na Omoika n’oyoomo, buna mwarangeretigwe ase ogosemeria okomo gw’okorangerigwa kwaino.
swahili: Kuna mwili mmoja na Roho mmoja, kama vile mlivyoitwa katika tumaini moja.

english: one Lord, one faith, one baptism;
ekegusii: Omonene oyomo, okwegena okomo, ebatiso eyemo,
swahili: Tena kuna Bwana mmoja, imani moja, ubatizo mmoja,

english: one God and Father of all, who is over all and through all and in all.
ekegusii: Nyasae oyomo, ore Tata o bonsi, ere ore igoro ase bonsi, goetera ase bonsi, na ime ase bonsi.
swahili: Mungu mmoja ambaye ni Baba wa wote, aliye juu ya yote, katika yote na ndani ya yote.

english: Now to each one of us grace has been given according to the measure of the gift of Christ.
ekegusii: Korende kera oyomo oito naetwe obuya koreng’ana n’ekerengo gi’ekeegwa gia Kristo.
swahili: Lakini kila mmoja wetu amepewa neema kwa kadiri ya kipimo cha kipawa cha Kristo.

english: This is why it says: “When He ascended on high, He led captives away, and gave gifts to men.”
ekegusii: Ase ayio nigo agoteeba. “Ekero ageendete igoro, akaira abasakore, akaa Mwanyabaanto ebiegwa.”
swahili: Kwa hiyo husema: “Alipopaa juu zaidi, aliteka mateka, akawapa wanadamu vipawa.”

english: What does “He ascended” mean, except that He also descended to the lower parts of the earth?
ekegusii: (Gaki, ring’ana eri, “Ageendete igoro”, engencho yaye inki otatiga naboigo aigete nonya ngoika ensemo yainse y’ense?
swahili: (Asemapo “alipaa juu,” maana yake nini isipokuwa ni kusema pia kwamba Kristo alishuka pande za chini sana za dunia?

english: Be imitators of God, therefore, as beloved children,
ekegusii: Ase ayio, mobe abegi ba Nyasae, buna abana abanchwa;
swahili: Kwa hiyo, mfuateni Mungu kama watoto wapendwao,

english: Test and prove what pleases the Lord.
ekegusii: Teema mono komanya ekeragwenere Omonene.
swahili: nanyi tafuteni yale yanayompendeza Bwana.

english: Have no fellowship with the fruitless deeds of darkness, but rather expose them.
ekegusii: Timosaanga n’ogokora kw’omosuunte ogotakwama, korende ribaga ri’ayio mokoorokie,
swahili: Msishiriki matendo ya giza yasiyofaa, bali yafichueni.

english: For it is shameful even to mention what the disobedient do in secret.
ekegusii: ekiagera nobosooku nonya nogokwana amang’ana ayio agokorwa nabarabwo bobisi.
swahili: Kwa maana ni aibu hata kutaja mambo yale ambayo wasiotii wanayafanya sirini.

english: So it is said: “Wake up, O sleeper, rise up from the dead, and Christ will shine on you.”
ekegusii: Ase ayio oteebire, “Booka aye osundogete, booka korwa ase abakuure, na Kristo nakobarerie.”
swahili: kwa kuwa nuru ndiyo hufanya kila kitu kionekane. Hii ndiyo sababu imesemekana: “Amka, wewe uliyelala, ufufuke kutoka kwa wafu, naye Kristo atakuangazia.”

english: Pay careful attention, then, to how you walk, not as unwise but as wise,
ekegusii: Ase ayio, rigereria mono buna mogotaara, tari buna abanto batari n’obong’aini, korende buna abare n’obong’aini.
swahili: Kwa hiyo angalieni sana jinsi mnavyoenenda, si kama watu wasio na hekima, bali kama wenye hekima,

english: redeeming the time, because the days are evil.
ekegusii: Renda engaki yaino, ekiagera amatuko aya namabe.
swahili: mkiukomboa wakati, kwa sababu nyakati hizi ni za uovu.

english: Therefore do not be foolish, but understand what the Lord’s will is.
ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio, timoba abariri, korende mobe abanto bakomanya buna ogwancha kw’Omonene kore.
swahili: Kwa hiyo msiwe wajinga, bali mpate kujua nini mapenzi ya Bwana.

english: Do not get drunk on wine, which leads to reckless indiscretion. Instead, be filled with the Spirit.
ekegusii: Naende timotinda ase edivai, ekiagera ase eyio inamoirwe ase obonyaka, korende moichorwe n’Omoika.
swahili: Pia msilewe kwa mvinyo, ambamo ndani yake mna upotovu, bali mjazwe Roho.

english: Speak to one another with psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs. Sing and make music in your hearts to the Lord,
ekegusii: Motebereranie ase chizaburi, na amateera, ne chingero chi’omoika; moteere na kobugia amariogi ase Omonene ase chinkoro chiaino,
swahili: Msemezane ninyi kwa ninyi kwa zaburi, nyimbo na tenzi za rohoni, mkimwimbia na kumsifu Bwana mioyoni mwenu,

english: and walk in love, just as Christ loved us and gave Himself up for us as a fragrant sacrificial offering to God.
ekegusii: mogeende ase obwanchani, buna Kristo atwanchete intwe, naende akerua ere omonyene ase engencho yaito, akaba esadaka na ekeng’wanso, bire ogotioka okuya ase Nyasae.
swahili: mkiishi maisha ya upendo, kama vile Kristo alivyotupenda sisi akajitoa kwa ajili yetu kuwa sadaka yenye harufu nzuri na dhabihu kwa Mungu.

english: always giving thanks to God the Father for everything in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ. Wives and Husbands (Song 1:1–17; 1 Peter 3:1–7)
ekegusii: mokomoakera Nyasae Tata ng’a mbuya mono amatuko onsi, ase amang’ana onsi, ase erieta ri’Omonene oito Yeso Kristo.
swahili: siku zote mkimshukuru Mungu Baba kwa kila jambo katika Jina la Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo.

english: Submit to one another out of reverence for Christ.
ekegusii: Mosikane inwe ase inwe ase okomoiroka Kristo. Abakungu na abasacha (Abakol 3:18—4:1)
swahili: Nyenyekeaneni ninyi kwa ninyi kwa heshima kwa ajili ya Kristo. Mafundisho Kuhusu Wake Na Waume

english: Wives, submit to your husbands as to the Lord.
ekegusii: Inwe abakungu, moigwere abasacha baino buna mokoigwera Omonene.
swahili: Ninyi wake, watiini waume zenu kama kumtii Bwana.

english: For the husband is the head of the wife as Christ is the head of the church, His body, of which He is the Savior.
ekegusii: Inaki omosacha nomotwe bw’omokuungu, buna Kristo are omotwe bw’ekanisa; ere omonyene n’Omotooria bw’omobere oye, engencho yaye ekanisa.
swahili: Kwa maana mume ni kichwa cha mkewe kama vile Kristo alivyo kichwa cha Kanisa, ambalo ni mwili wake, naye Kristo ni Mwokozi wake.

english: Now as the church submits to Christ, so also wives should submit to their husbands in everything.
ekegusii: Korende buna ekanisa eigwerete Kristo, naboigo nabakungu baigwere abasacha babo ase kera ring’ana.
swahili: Basi, kama vile Kanisa linavyomtii Kristo, vivyo hivyo na wake nao imewapasa kuwatii waume zao kwa kila jambo.

english: Husbands, love your wives, just as Christ loved the church and gave Himself up for her
ekegusii: Na inwe abasacha, mwanche abakungu baino, buna Kristo anchete ekanisa, naende akerua omonyene ase engencho y’ero,
swahili: Ninyi waume, wapendeni wake zenu, kama vile Kristo alivyolipenda Kanisa akajitoa kwa ajili yake

english: to sanctify her, cleansing her by the washing with water through the word,
ekegusii: erio anyare koyechena ase okoyesibia ase amaache na ase ring’ana,
swahili: kusudi alifanye takatifu, akilitakasa kwa kuliosha kwa maji katika Neno lake,

english: and to present her to Himself as a glorious church, without stain or wrinkle or any such blemish, but holy and blameless.
ekegusii: erinde anyare kwenyorera ekanisa y’obonene, etari na kemoa gose omonia, gose rinde rionsi buna aya, korende ebe enchenu etari na kemoa.
swahili: apate kujiletea Kanisa tukufu lisilo na doa wala kunyanzi au waa lolote, bali takatifu na lisilo na hatia.

english: In the same way, husbands ought to love their wives as their own bodies. He who loves his wife loves himself.
ekegusii: Naboigo egwenerete abasacha banche abakungu babo buna emebere yabo abanyene. Oyobwanchete mok’aye bweanchire ere omonyene.
swahili: Vivyo hivyo imewapasa waume kuwapenda wake zao kama miili yao wenyewe. Ampendaye mkewe hujipenda mwenyewe.

english: Indeed, no one ever hated his own body, but he nourishes and cherishes it, just as Christ does the church.
ekegusii: Inaki omonto taiyo ogeechete omobere oye omonyene, korende nigo akoyorageria na koyorenda, buna Kristo akorageria ekanisa,
swahili: Hakuna mtu anayeuchukia mwili wake mwenyewe, bali huulisha na kuutunza vizuri, kama Kristo anavyolitunza Kanisa lake.

english: But among you, as is proper among the saints, there must not be even a hint of sexual immorality, or of any kind of impurity, or of greed.
ekegusii: Korende, buna egwenerete abachenu, obotomani na eubi yonsi, gose obwegimeria, tibiatorwa ase egati yaino nonya ng’ake.
swahili: Lakini uasherati, usitajwe miongoni mwenu, wala uchafu wa aina yoyote, wala tamaa, kwa sababu mambo haya hayastahili miongoni mwa watakatifu.

english: For we are members of His body.
ekegusii: ekiagera nigo tore ebiimo bi’omobere oye.
swahili: Sisi tu viungo vya mwili wake.

english: “For this reason a man will leave his father and mother and be united to his wife, and the two will become one flesh.”
ekegusii: Nigo eriikire, “Ase engencho eyio, omonto natige ise na ng’ina abwatane na mok’aye, na abwo babere inababe omobere oyoomo.”
swahili: “Kwa sababu hii, mwanaume atamwacha baba yake na mama yake, naye ataambatana na mkewe, na hao wawili watakuwa mwili mmoja.”

english: This mystery is profound, but I am speaking about Christ and the church.
ekegusii: Obo nobobisi obonene; korende ngokwana nde amang’ana a Kristo na ekanisa.
swahili: Siri hii ni kubwa, bali mimi nanena kuhusu Kristo na Kanisa.

english: Nevertheless, each one of you also must love his wife as he loves himself, and the wife must respect her husband.
ekegusii: Korende kera omonto anche mok’aye buna eanchete ere omonyene; na omokungu tamocha gosika omosacha oye.
swahili: Hata hivyo, kila mmoja wenu ampende mkewe kama anavyoipenda nafsi yake mwenyewe, naye mke lazima amheshimu mumewe.

english: Nor should there be obscenity, foolish talk, or crude joking, which are out of character, but rather thanksgiving.
ekegusii: Motige kegima amang’ana amabe, gose ay’oboriri, gose obosekereria, aya’atagwenereti; korende mbuya kobua koiraneria ng’a mbuya mono.
swahili: Wala pasiwepo mazungumzo machafu ya aibu, au maneno ya upuzi au mzaha, ambayo hayafai, badala yake mshukuruni Mungu.

english: For of this you can be sure: No immoral, impure, or greedy person (that is, an idolater), has any inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and of God.
ekegusii: Inaki ring’ana eri mwarimanyire kegima, ng’a omotomani, gose oyo otachenegeti, gose omonto omwegimeria (engencho yaye omosasiimi emegwekano) takonyora omwando ase oborwoti bwa Kristo na Nyasae. Taara buna abana b’omobaso
swahili: Kwa habari ya mambo haya mjue hakika kwamba: Msherati, wala mtu mwovu, wala mwenye tamaa mbaya, mtu kama huyo ni mwabudu sanamu, kamwe hataurithi Ufalme wa Kristo na wa Mungu.

english: Let no one deceive you with empty words, for because of such things the wrath of God is coming on the sons of disobedience.
ekegusii: Monto onde tabang’aina ase amang’ana atari nengeencho, ekiagera ase aya endamwamu ya Nyasae nigo ekobaachera abanto b’ogotaigwera.
swahili: Mtu yeyote na asiwadanganye kwa maneno matupu, kwa kuwa hasira ya Mungu huwaka kwa sababu ya mambo kama haya juu ya wale wasiomtii.

english: Therefore do not be partakers with them. Children of Light
ekegusii: Ase ayio, timosaanga nabarabwo.
swahili: Kwa hiyo, msishirikiane nao.

english: For you were once darkness, but now you are light in the Lord. Walk as children of light,
ekegusii: Inaki kare nigo mwareenge omosunte, korende bono mwabeire omobaso ase Omonene. Mogeenderere buna abana b’omobaso
swahili: Kwa maana zamani ninyi mlikuwa giza, lakini sasa ninyi ni nuru katika Bwana. Enendeni kama watoto wa nuru

english: for the fruit of the light consists in all goodness, righteousness, and truth.
ekegusii: (inaki okwama kw’omobaso nigo gokonyorekana ase obuya bwonsi, na ase oboronge, na ase ekeene).
swahili: (kwa kuwa tunda la nuru hupatikana katika wema wote, haki na kweli),

english: Children, obey your parents in the Lord, for this is right.
ekegusii: Inwe abana, moigwere abaibori baino ase Omonene, ekiagera obo nabwo oboronge.
swahili: Enyi watoto, watiini wazazi wenu katika Bwana, kwa kuwa hili ni jema.

english: Finally, be strong in the Lord and in His mighty power.
ekegusii: Omoerio, motenene bokong’u ase Omonene, na ase chinguru chi’okobua kwaye.
swahili: Hatimaye, mzidi kuwa hodari katika Bwana na katika uweza wa nguvu zake.

english: Put on the full armor of God, so that you can make your stand against the devil’s schemes.
ekegusii: Eboyie ebirwanero bionsi bia Nyasae, erinde monyaare gotenena korwania obong’ainereria bwa Saitani.
swahili: Vaeni silaha zote za Mungu ili kwamba mweze kuzipinga hila za ibilisi.

english: For our struggle is not against flesh and blood, but against the rulers, against the authorities, against the powers of this world’s darkness, and against the spiritual forces of evil in the heavenly realms.
ekegusii: Inaki okoamererania gwaito tikori ase abare n’amanyinga ne chinyama, korende igoro y’abagaambi na abare nokobua, igoro y’abanene b’omosuunte bw’ense eye, na igoro y’emegaanda y’ebirecha ebibe bire igoro.
swahili: Kwa maana kushindana kwetu si juu ya nyama na damu, bali dhidi ya falme, mamlaka, dhidi ya wakuu wa giza na majeshi ya pepo wabaya katika ulimwengu wa roho.

english: Therefore take up the full armor of God, so that when the day of evil comes, you will be able to stand your ground, and having done everything, to stand.
ekegusii: Ase ayio, bogoria ebirwanero bionsi bia Nyasae, erinde monyaare koamererania ase rituko ri’obobe, na komwaikeranirie onsi, motenene.
swahili: Kwa hiyo vaeni silaha zote za Mungu ili mweze kushindana siku ya uovu itakapokuja nanyi mkiisha kufanya yote, simameni imara.

english: Stand firm then, with the belt of truth buckled around your waist, with the breastplate of righteousness arrayed,
ekegusii: Tenena gaaki, mweboyie ebinema biaino nekeene, na kobeeka oboronge buna engobo y’ekioma ase ebikuba biaino,
swahili: Kwa hiyo simameni imara mkiwa mmejifunga kweli kiunoni na kuvaa dirii ya haki kifuani,

english: and with your feet fitted with the readiness of the gospel of peace.
ekegusii: na gosiberwa amagoro aino engencho y’okoba ang’e eyio twanyorire ase enchiri y’omorembe.
swahili: nayo miguu yenu ifungiwe utayari tuupatao kwa Injili ya amani.

english: In addition to all this, take up the shield of faith, with which you can extinguish all the flaming arrows of the evil one.
ekegusii: Kobua onsi bogoria enguba y’okwegena, ase eyio namonyaare korimia emegwe yonsi y’omorero y’oria omobe.
swahili: Zaidi ya haya yote, twaeni ngao ya imani, ambayo kwa hiyo mtaweza kuizima mishale yote yenye moto ya yule mwovu.

english: And take the helmet of salvation and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God.
ekegusii: Naende bogoria ekegogwa gi’ekioma ki’ogotooreka, na omoro bw’Omoika, n’oro ring’ana ria Nyasae.
swahili: Vaeni chapeo ya wokovu na mchukue upanga wa Roho, ambao ni Neno la Mungu.

english: Pray in the Spirit at all times, with every kind of prayer and petition. To this end, stay alert with all perseverance in your prayers for all the saints.
ekegusii: Mosabe botambe ase Omoika ase ogosaba gwonsi na ase okoboria kw’ogosorora, na gotagesia ase kera ring’ana. Mogenderere gosabera abachenu bonsi.
swahili: Mkiomba kwa Roho siku zote katika sala zote na maombi, mkikesha kila wakati mkiwaombea watakatifu wote.

english: Pray also for me, that whenever I open my mouth, words may be given me so that I will boldly make known the mystery of the gospel,
ekegusii: Monsabere nainche, ng’egwe amang’ana ase ogokwana n’oboremu, erinde ndandie obobisi bw’enchiri.
swahili: Niombeeni na mimi pia, ili kila nifunguapo kinywa changu, nipewe maneno ya kusema, niweze kutangaza siri ya Injili kwa ujasiri,

english: “Honor your father and mother” (which is the first commandment with a promise),
ekegusii: “Sika iso na nyoko” (ogochika oko nakwo ogochika kw’eritang’ani kore neira),
swahili: “Waheshimu baba yako na mama yako,” hii ndio amri ya kwanza yenye ahadi,

english: for which I am an ambassador in chains. Pray that I may proclaim it fearlessly, as I should. Final Greetings (Philippians 4:21–23; 2 Timothy 4:19–22)
ekegusii: Ase ayio, nigo inde oyo otometwe nsibire ebinyuri, inyore oboremu bw’ogokwana amang’ana buna ngwenerete gokwana. Amang’ana y’ogokoorera (Abakol 4:7-8)
swahili: ambayo mimi ni balozi wake katika vifungo. Ombeni ili nipate kuhubiri kwa ujasiri kama inipasavyo. Salamu Za Mwisho

english: Tychicus, the beloved brother and faithful servant in the Lord, will tell you everything, so that you also may know about me and what I am doing.
ekegusii: Erinde monyaare komanya buna inche inde, naende ninki ngokora, Tukiko, oyominto omwanchwa, omosomba omwegenwa ase Omonene, nabateebie amang’ana onsi.
swahili: Tikiko, aliye ndugu mpendwa na mtumishi mwaminifu katika Bwana, atawaambia kila kitu, ili pia mpate kujua hali yangu na kile ninachofanya sasa.

english: I have sent him to you for this very purpose, that you may know about us, and that he may encourage your hearts.
ekegusii: Namotomire ase more ase engencho eyio eyio, erinde monyaare komanya buna tore; na ere naremie chinkoro chiaino.
swahili: Ninamtuma kwenu kwa ajili ya kusudi hili hasa, ili mpate kujua hali yetu, na awatie moyo.

english: Peace to the brothers and love with faith from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
ekegusii: Omorembe obe ase abaminto, na obwanchani amo nokwegena bikorwa ase Nyasae Tata, na ase Omonene Yeso Kristo.
swahili: Amani iwe kwa ndugu, na pendo pamoja na imani kutoka kwa Mungu Baba na Bwana Yesu Kristo.

english: Grace to all who love our Lord Jesus Christ with an undying love.
ekegusii: Obuya bobe amo na bonsi abamwanchete Omonene oito Yeso Kristo n’obwanchani botari gosareka.
swahili: Neema iwe na wote wampendao Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo kwa upendo wa dhati. Amen.

english: “that it may go well with you and that you may have a long life on the earth.”
ekegusii: “erinde ebe buya ase ore, nario oramenye amatuko amange ase ense.”
swahili: “upate baraka na uishi siku nyingi duniani.”

english: Fathers, do not provoke your children to wrath; instead, bring them up in the discipline and instruction of the Lord. Serving with Honor (Colossians 3:22–25; 1 Timothy 6:1–2)
ekegusii: Na inwe abaise, timochegia abana baino baabaise kobeeigwa, korende mobarere ase amasikani na ase okworokereria kw’Omonene. Abasomba na abanene babo
swahili: Ninyi akina baba, msiwachokoze watoto wenu, bali waleeni kwa nidhamu na mafundisho ya Bwana. Mafundisho Kuhusu Watumwa Na Mabwana

english: Slaves, obey your earthly masters with respect and fear and sincerity of heart, just as you would obey Christ.
ekegusii: Inwe abasomba, moigwere abanene baino ase ense eye buna mokoigwera Kristo, ase obwoba na okoiguswa, na ase oboitongo bw’enkoro,
swahili: Ninyi watumwa, watiini hao walio mabwana zenu hapa duniani kwa heshima na kwa kutetemeka na kwa moyo mmoja, kama vile mnavyomtii Kristo.

english: And do this not only to please them while they are watching, but as servants of Christ, doing the will of God from your heart.
ekegusii: gose tari ase obosomba bw’okwegwenia ase amaiso ya Mwanyabaanto, korende buna abasomba ba Kristo, mogokora ogwancha kwa Nyasae ase chinkoro chiaino;
swahili: Watiini, si tu wakati wakiwaona ili mpate upendeleo wao, bali mtumike kama watumwa wa Kristo, mkifanya mapenzi ya Mungu kwa moyo.

english: Serve with good will, as to the Lord and not to men,
ekegusii: ase omoyo omuya mogokorera Omonene, gose tari Mwanyabaanto.
swahili: Tumikeni kwa moyo wote, kama vile mnamtumikia Bwana na si wanadamu.

english: because you know that the Lord will reward each one for whatever good he does, whether he is slave or free.
ekegusii: Naende momanye ng’a ring’ana rigiya omonto agokora, naegwe erio erio n’Omonene, k’arabe omosomba, gose omosibore.
swahili: Mkijua kwamba Bwana atampa kila mtu thawabu kwa lolote jema alilotenda, kama yeye ni mtumwa au ni mtu huru.

english: And masters, do the same for your slaves. Give up your use of threats, because you know that He who is both their Master and yours is in heaven, and there is no favoritism with Him. The Full Armor of God
ekegusii: Na inwe abanene, bakorere ayio ayio, motige kobairokia. Momanye ng’a ere oyore Omonene obo, nere oyoino ore igoro, na ase are gwanchereria tikoiyo. Esegi igoro y’amabe
swahili: Nanyi mabwana, watendeeni watumwa wenu kwa jinsi iyo hiyo. Msiwatishe, kwa kuwa mnajua ya kwamba yeye aliye Bwana wenu na Bwana wao yuko mbinguni, naye hana upendeleo. Silaha Za Mungu

english: Now King Xerxes imposed tribute throughout the land, even to its farthest shores.
ekegusii: Omorwoti Ahaswero akarusia ebango ase abanto b’ense yaye, na ase ebisinka bie chinyancha.
swahili: Mfalme Ahasuero alitoza ushuru katika ufalme wake wote hadi kwenye miambao yake ya mbali.

english: And all of Mordecai’s powerful and magnificent accomplishments, together with the full account of the greatness to which the king had raised him, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Media and Persia?
ekegusii: Bono amang’ana onsi igoro y’ogokora kwaye gwonsi, na okobua kwaye, amo namang’ana onsi buna aimokereretie Moredekai igoro, nigo ariikire ase Egetabu ki’ogokora kw’abarwoti b’Abamedia na ab’Abaayemi.
swahili: Matendo yake yote ya nguvu na uwezo, pamoja na habari zote za ukuu wa Mordekai ambao mfalme alikuwa amemkuza, je, hayakuandikwa katika kitabu cha kumbukumbu za wafalme wa Umedi na Uajemi?

english: For Mordecai the Jew was second only to King Xerxes, preeminent among the Jews and highly favored by his many kinsmen, seeking the good of his people and speaking peace to all his countrymen.
ekegusii: Moredekai, Omoyahudi oria, nere orenge oyo o kabere ase omorwoti Ahaswero. Nigo arenge omonene ase Abayahudi, osikire nabamwabo bonsi, ekiagera nigo arenge korigia amaya ase abanto baye, na akerua ase okobarentera omorembe.
swahili: Mordekai Myahudi alikuwa wa pili kwa cheo kutoka Mfalme Ahasuero, naye alikuwa bora kabisa miongoni mwa Wayahudi, akipandishwa katika heshima ya juu na ndugu zake Wayahudi kwa sababu aliwatendea mema watu wake, na alizungumza kwa ajili ya ustawi wa Wayahudi wote.

english: This is what happened in the days of Xerxes, who reigned over 127 provinces from India to Cush.
ekegusii: Amang’ana aya naro akoregete ase amatuko ’Ahaswero, oyio ogamberete chingongo rigana erimo, na emerongo ebere, na isano na ibere (127), gochaakera India goikera Ethiopia.
swahili: Hili ndilo lililotokea wakati wa utawala wa Mfalme Ahasuero, yule aliyetawala juu ya majimbo mia na ishirini na saba tangu Bara Hindi hadi Kushi.

english: On the seventh day, when the king’s heart was merry with wine, he ordered the seven eunuchs who served him—Mehuman, Biztha, Harbona, Bigtha, Abagtha, Zethar, and Carkas—
ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatano na kabere ri’omoyega oyio, omorwoti kanyure edivai akaba nomosasoko ase enkoro yaye. Ase ayio akarangeria Mehumani na Bisita, Haribona na Bigita, Abagita na Setari, na Karikasi, abakoreri baye batano na babere abagombaetigwe, abwo barenge komokorera ere ase enyomba yaye,
swahili: Siku ya saba, wakati Mfalme Ahasuero alikuwa amesisimka roho yake kwa mvinyo, aliamuru matowashi saba waliokuwa wakimhudumia, yaani, Mehumani, Biztha, Harbona, Bigtha, Abagtha, Zethari na Karkasi,

english: to bring Queen Vashti before him, wearing her royal crown, to display her beauty to the people and officials. For she was beautiful to behold.
ekegusii: akabachika barente Vasti eting’ana achiche ase obosio bwaye obegete egutwa y’oborwoti. Vasti nigo arenge omokungu omonyakieni mono; ase igo omorwoti akagania amoorokie ase abanto bonsi na ase abanene barenge agwo, erinde bamorore.
swahili: kumleta Malkia Vashti mbele ya mfalme akiwa amevaa taji lake la kifalme, ili aonyeshe uzuri wake kwa watu na wakuu, kwa kuwa alikuwa ni mzuri wa kupendeza.

english: Queen Vashti, however, refused to come at the king’s command brought by his eunuchs. And the king became furious, and his anger burned within him. Queen Vashti Deposed
ekegusii: Abasomba baria b’omorwoti bakairera Vasti amang’ana ayio, korende ere akaanga koigwera ogochika kw’omorwoti. Ayio akagera omorwoti akaba nendamwamu enene mono yarenge gwoka ime yaye buna omorero.
swahili: Lakini wakati watumishi walipotoa amri ya mfalme, Malkia Vashti alikataa kuja. Ndipo mfalme alighadhibika, na hasira yake ikawaka.

english: Then the king consulted the wise men who knew the times, for it was customary for him to confer with the experts in law and justice.
ekegusii: Nigo yarenge engencho y’omorwoti arigie ogosemigwa korwa ase abanto abang’aini bamanyete amachiiko, naende bamanyete kogamba ebiina. Ase ayio akarangeria abanto abasemia, baria bamanyete ebimanyererio bie chingaki.
swahili: Kwa kuwa ilikuwa desturi ya mfalme kupata ushauri kwa wataalamu katika mambo ya sheria na haki, alizungumza na watu wenye busara, ambao walijua nyakati,

english: His closest advisors were Carshena, Shethar, Admatha, Tarshish, Meres, Marsena, and Memucan, the seven princes of Persia and Media who had personal access to the king and ranked highest in the kingdom.
ekegusii: Abanto anarete koboria botambe nabwo aba: Karisena na Setari, Adimata na Tarisisi, Meresi na Marisena, na Memukani. Aba batano na babere nigo barenge abagaambi korwa ase ense y’Ayemi, na eya Media, naende nabwo barenge nebirogo ebinene ase obogambi bwaye.
swahili: nao waliokuwa karibu na mfalme ni Karshena, Shethari, Admatha, Tarshishi, Meresi, Marsena na Memukani, wakuu saba wa Uajemi na Umedi waliokuwa na nafasi ya pekee kwa mfalme nao walikuwa na vyeo vya juu kabisa katika utawala wake.

english: “According to law,” he asked, “what should be done with Queen Vashti, since she refused to obey the command of King Xerxes delivered by the eunuchs?”
ekegusii: Omorwoti agateebia abanto baria, “Inche omorwoti Ahaswero natoma abasomba baria baane, nabachika barente Vasti eting’ana ase ’nde, korende ere bwanga koigwera ogochika okwo. Inee! Ngento ki agwenerete akorerwe kobwatekana nogochika?”
swahili: Mfalme akauliza, “Kulingana na sheria, Malkia Vashti anapaswa kutendewa nini? Malkia hakutii amri ya Mfalme Ahasuero ambayo matowashi walimpelekea.”

english: And in the presence of the king and his princes, Memucan replied, “Queen Vashti has wronged not only the king, but all the princes and the peoples in all the provinces of King Xerxes.
ekegusii: Erio Memukani agateebia omorwoti na abanene bonsi, “Vasti eting’ana tari ng’a nomorwoti bweka amocheire, korende omocheire abanene bonsi, na abanto bonsi bare ase chingongo chionsi echio aye omorwoti Ahaswero okogambera.
swahili: Kisha Memukani akajibu mbele ya mfalme na wakuu, “Malkia Vashti si kwamba amemkosea mfalme tu bali pia amewakosea wakuu wote na watu wa himaya yote ya Mfalme Ahasuero.

english: For the conduct of the queen will become known to all women, causing them to despise their husbands and say, ‘King Xerxes ordered Queen Vashti to be brought before him, but she did not come.’
ekegusii: Ogokora oko eting’ana yakorire goise komanyekana ase abakungu bonsi, nigo koragere abakungu bande bachaye abasacha babo, bateebe: Omorwoti Ahaswero nachika abasomba baye barente Vasti eting’ana asare, korende Vasti akaanga, tacha ase omorwoti.
swahili: Kwa maana tendo hili la malkia litajulikana kwa wanawake wote, kwa hiyo watawadharau waume zao na kusema, ‘Mfalme Ahasuero aliagiza Malkia Vashti aletwe mbele yake, lakini alikataa.’

english: This very day the noble women of Persia and Media who have heard about the queen’s conduct will say the same thing to all the king’s officials, resulting in much contempt and wrath.
ekegusii: Rituko ria reero ritaraera, abakungu b’abanene bonsi b’Abaayemi na ab’Abamedia mbabe bakoigwa aya eting’ana yakorire, na igo bagochia koyateebia abanene bonsi ase obogambi, na ogochaayana okonene nigo kogochia koba amo nokoengererania okonene.
swahili: Leo hii wanawake wa wakuu wa Uajemi na Umedi ambao wamesikia juu ya tabia ya malkia watawatendea wakuu wote wa mfalme vivyo hivyo. Hapatakuwepo na mwisho wa dharau na magomvi.

english: So if it pleases the king, let him issue a royal decree, and let it be recorded in the laws of Persia and Media so that it cannot be repealed, that Vashti shall never again enter the presence of King Xerxes, and that her royal position shall be given to a woman better than she.
ekegusii: Aye omorwoti koranche orue ogochika kw’oborwoti ng’a Vasti tabaisa kororekana ogocha ase obosio bwao nonya ndinde rionsi, aye omorwoti Ahaswero. Orike ogochika okwo ase amachiiko ’Abaayemi na ay’Abamedia ariikire, erinde ayio tanyara koonchorwa. Aye omorwoti ochore omokungu omoao obwenerete kobua Vasti, omoe obonene obwo bw’oborwoti.
swahili: “Kwa hiyo, kama itampendeza mfalme, atoe amri ya kifalme na iandikwe katika sheria ya Uajemi na Umedi, ambayo haitabadilika, kwamba Vashti kamwe asije tena mbele ya Mfalme Ahasuero. Pia mfalme na atoe hiyo nafasi yake ya umalkia kwa mwanamke mwingine aliye bora kumliko yeye.

english: In those days King Xerxes sat on his royal throne in the citadel of Susa.
ekegusii: Ase amatuko aria, ekero Ahaswero omorwoti arenge goikaransa ase ekerogo kiaye ki’oborwoti aaria ase eburi ya Susa, amang’ana aya naro arenge gokoreka.
swahili: Wakati huo Mfalme Ahasuero alitawala katika kiti chake cha enzi katika ngome ya mji wa Shushani.

english: The edict the king issues will be heard throughout his vast kingdom—and so all women, from the least to the greatest, will honor their husbands.”
ekegusii: Ekero amang’ana ’ogochika okwo kw’omorwoti arararigwe ase oborwoti obo obonene, abakungu bonsi, abanene na abake, mbabe bagosika abasacha babo.”
swahili: Kisha mbiu hii ya mfalme itakapotangazwa katika himaya yake iliyo kubwa sana, wanawake wote watawaheshimu waume zao, kuanzia mdogo hadi mkubwa.”

english: The king and his princes were pleased with this counsel; so the king did as Memucan had advised.
ekegusii: Ogosemia okwo kwa Memukani gokagokia omorwoti amo nabanene bonsi, na omorwoti agakora buna Memukani ateebete.
swahili: Mfalme na wakuu wake walipendezwa na shauri hili, hivyo basi mfalme akafanya kama Memukani alivyopendekeza.

english: He sent letters to all the provinces of the kingdom, to each province in its own script and to each people in their own language, proclaiming that every man should be master of his own household.
ekegusii: Erio agatoma amarube gochia ase chingongo chionsi chi’obogambi bwaye. Amarube ayio akarikwa ase kera orogongo ase okorikwa kw’engencho y’amariko abo, ase kera egesaku ase omonwa obo, goteeba ng’a kera omosacha abe okogamba ase enka yaye, naende abe ogokwana nabaanto baye ase omonwa bw’egesaku kiaye.
swahili: Alipeleka barua katika sehemu zote za ufalme wake, kwa kila jimbo kwa maandishi yake mwenyewe na kwa kila watu katika lugha yao wenyewe, akitangaza kwa msemo wa kila watu kwamba inampasa kila mwanaume kuwa mtawala wa nyumba yake mwenyewe.

english: In the third year of his reign, Xerxes held a feast for all his officials and servants. The military leaders of Persia and Media were there, along with the nobles and princes of the provinces.
ekegusii: Ase omwaka o gatato bw’okogamba kwaye agakora omoyega omonene ase abanene bonsi amo nabatang’ani abarenge ase obogambi bwaye. Akarangeria abatang’ani b’abasikari b’Abaayemi, na ab’Abamedia, na abanene amo nabagaambi be chingongo chiaye.
swahili: Katika mwaka wa tatu wa utawala wake, alifanya karamu kwa ajili ya wakuu wake wote pamoja na maafisa. Akawaalika viongozi wa jeshi wa Uajemi na Umedi, wana wa wafalme na wakuu wa majimbo.

english: And for a full 180 days he displayed the glorious riches of his kingdom and the magnificent splendor of his greatness.
ekegusii: Ase engaki entambe y’emetienyi etano nomo (6), omorwoti akaba okworokia abanto abwo obonda na obonene bw’oborwoti bwaye, obwo bw’ogosika okonene.
swahili: Kwa siku zote 180 mfalme alionyesha utajiri mwingi wa ufalme wake, fahari na utukufu wa enzi yake.

english: At the end of this time, in the garden court of the royal palace, the king held a seven-day feast for all the people in the citadel of Susa, from the least to the greatest.
ekegusii: Amatuko ayio kaerire, akaroisia omoyega omonene ase abanto bonsi, abanene na abake, abarenge agwo Susa, omochie omonene. Omoyega oyio okabeera ase eraaro y’egeticha yagiteire, yarenge ase enyomba y’omorwoti, na okagenderera ase amatuko atano na abere.
swahili: Siku hizo zilipopita, mfalme alifanya karamu kwa muda wa siku saba, katika bustani ya ndani katika jumba la kifalme, kwa ajili ya watu wote kuanzia mdogo hadi mkubwa, waliokuwa katika ngome ya mji wa Shushani.

english: Hangings of white and blue linen were fastened with cords of fine white and purple material to silver rings on the marble pillars. Gold and silver couches were arranged on a mosaic pavement of porphyry, marble, mother-of-pearl, and other costly stones.
ekegusii: Aase agwo nigo achabeire nobwari obonge: ebitambaa ebirabu na ebiare buru, bionsi biaroisirie korwa ase egatani. Ebitambaa ebio nigo biasungeire ne chingori chindabu ne chimonyinga, chiaroisirie korwa ase egatani engiya. Chingori echio nigo chiasoirie ase chibonyi chi’echifeta chiarenge ase chisiiro chi’amagena amarabu akomeka‐meka ye rigori rinene. Ebiikaransero biaroisirie korwa ase chitaabu ne chifeta nigo biabekire inse aase atichire n’amagena akomeka‐meka e rigori rinene, amarabu na amabariri, na ayare buna obonyansi na amamwamu.
swahili: Bustani ilikuwa na mapazia ya kitani nyeupe na buluu, yaliyofungiwa kamba za kitani nyeupe na kitambaa cha zambarau, kwenye pete za fedha juu ya nguzo za marmar. Kulikuwepo viti vya dhahabu na vya fedha vilivyokuwa vimewekwa kwenye ile sakafu iliyotengenezwa kwa mawe ya rangi, marmar, lulumizi na mawe mengine ya thamani.

english: Beverages were served in an array of goblets of gold, each with a different design, and the royal wine flowed freely, according to the king’s bounty.
ekegusii: Ebinyugwa bikabekwa ase ebikoombe biaroisirie korwa ase chitaabu; kera egekoombe nigo kiaroisetigwe k’obwaye getagwekaini ekende. Edivai ekonyugwa ase enyomba y’omorwoti ekarentwa ase obonge.
swahili: Vyombo vya dhahabu vilitumika kwa watu kunywea mvinyo, kila kimoja tofauti na kingine, naye mfalme akatoa mvinyo kwa wingi kwa kadiri ya ukarimu wake.

english: By order of the king, no limit was placed on the drinking, and every official of his household was to serve each man whatever he desired. Queen Vashti’s Refusal
ekegusii: Omoroberio okabekwa buna ebinyugwa ebio biarenge konyugwa; monto onde tarenge kobetererigwa, ekiagera omorwoti nigo achigete abasomba baye, abatenenerete enyomba yaye, ng’a batige kera omonto anywe ebinyugwa buna aganetie.
swahili: Kwa amri ya mfalme kila mgeni aliruhusiwa kunywa alichotaka, kwa kuwa mfalme alitoa maagizo kwa watumishi wote wa kuhudumu mvinyo kumhudumia kila mtu kwa jinsi alivyotaka.

english: Queen Vashti also gave a banquet for the women in the royal palace of King Xerxes.
ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio eyio, Vasti eting’ana, moka omorwoti, nere agakorera abakungu omoyega agwo ase enyomba y’omorwoti Ahaswero.
swahili: Malkia Vashti pia akawafanyia wanawake karamu katika jumba la kifalme la Mfalme Ahasuero.

english: Some time later, when the anger of King Xerxes had subsided, he remembered Vashti and what she had done, and what had been decreed against her.
ekegusii: Nyuma y’amang’ana ayio, ekero endamwamu y’omorwoti Ahaswero yakendire, akaba okoinyora igoro ya Vasti, buna akorete, naende buna ogochika kwaruetwe igoro yaye.
swahili: Baadaye, wakati hasira ya Mfalme Ahasuero ilikuwa imetulia, alimkumbuka Vashti na kile alichokuwa amekifanya na alilokuwa ameamuru juu yake.

english: Esther did not reveal her people or her lineage, because Mordecai had instructed her not to do so.
ekegusii: Bono Esiteri konya taremanyekania ekiagera konya Moredekai omosemirie, omokanirie ng’a tabaisa kwemanyekania ase abanto b’ense eria amenyete ng’a ngesaku ki are, gose noyo bw’enyomba ki.
swahili: Esta alikuwa hajadhihirisha uraia wala kabila lake, kwa sababu Mordekai alikuwa amemkataza.

english: And every day Mordecai would walk back and forth in front of the court of the harem to learn about Esther’s welfare and what was happening to her.
ekegusii: Kera rituko Moredekai nigo abeete okona‐gotaara ase eraaro, bosio bw’enyomba y’abakungu baria, erinde amanye buna Esiteri agendererete komenya agwo, na igoro y’obogima bwaye.
swahili: Kila siku Mordekai alikuwa akitembeatembea karibu na ua wa nyumba ya wanawake kujua Esta alivyoendelea na kuona yaliyokuwa yakitendeka kwake.

english: In the twelve months before her turn to go to King Xerxes, the harem regulation required each young woman to receive beauty treatments with oil of myrrh for six months, and then with perfumes and cosmetics for another six months.
ekegusii: Kera oyomo ase abaiseke abwo nigo abeete okweroisia omobere oye ase engaki y’omwaka oyomo. Ase engaki y’emetienyi etano nomo emetang’ani nigo baare koba bakweaka amaguta a manemane, na emetienyi etano nomo ende babe bakweaka amaguta ande agotioka buya ase okweroisia emebere yabo. Erio ekero engaki yaigete; kera omoiseke oyomo oyomo akaba okorentwa ase omorwoti Ahaswero.
swahili: Kabla zamu ya msichana haijafika ya kwenda kwa Mfalme Ahasuero, ilimbidi atimize miezi kumi na miwili ya matunzo ya urembo kama ilivyokuwa imepangwa. Kwa miezi sita walikuwa wajipake mafuta ya manemane, na miezi sita kujipaka manukato na vipodozi.

english: When the young woman would go to the king, she was given whatever she requested to take with her from the harem to the king’s palace.
ekegusii: Ekero omoiseke arenge gochia ase obosio bw’omorwoti, nigo arenge koegwa korwa ase enyomba y’abaiseke baria egento kende gionsi arenge kogania koira.
swahili: Basi hivi ndivyo ambavyo msichana angeingia kwa mfalme: Kila kitu alichohitaji aliruhusiwa kuchukua kutoka nyumba ya wanawake na kwenda navyo katika jumba la mfalme.

english: She would go there in the evening, and in the morning she would return to a second harem under the care of Shaashgaz, the king’s eunuch in charge of the concubines. She would not return to the king unless he delighted in her and summoned her by name.
ekegusii: Nigo arenge kogenda ase omorwoti chingaki chia mogoroba, erio ase rituko rikobwatia ekero bwakire oirana gochia ase enyomba ende y’abakungu inse y’oborendi bwa Saasigasi, oyorenge omokoreri bw’abakungu ba sere‐sere b’omorwoti. Tarenge koirana gochia ase omorwoti eria kabere, otatiga onye omorwoti ogogetigwe nere, naende aba okomorangeria ase ogwatora erieta riaye.
swahili: Jioni angekwenda pale na asubuhi kurudi sehemu nyingine ya nyumba ya wanawake katika utunzaji wa Shaashgazi, towashi wa mfalme ambaye alikuwa mkuu wa masuria. Hangeweza kurudi kwa mfalme mpaka apendezwe naye na kuagiza aitwe kwa jina lake.

english: Now Esther was the daughter of Abihail, the uncle from whom Mordecai had adopted her as his own daughter. And when it was her turn to go to the king, she did not ask for anything except what Hegai, the king’s trusted official in charge of the harem, had advised. And Esther found favor in the eyes of everyone who saw her.
ekegusii: Ekero engaki y’okogenda ase omorwoti yaigete ase Esiteri, oyio orenge omoiseke bw’Abihaili, ise moke Moredekai, oyio omotugete buna omwana oye, taboretie gento kende akoirana otatiga ebi Hegai, omokorer bw’omorwoti, oria otenererete abaiseke baria, amosemetie. Bono Esiteri nigo agwenerete abanto bonsi baare komoorora.
swahili: Zamu ya Esta ilipofika kwenda kwa mfalme (msichana ambaye Mordekai alikuwa amemlea, binti wa Abihaili mjomba wake), Esta hakutaka vitu zaidi ya vile ambavyo Hegai, towashi wa mfalme aliyekuwa mkuu wa nyumba ya wanawake alivyokuwa amemshauri. Naye Esta alipata kibali kwa kila mtu aliyemwona.

english: She was taken to King Xerxes in the royal palace in the tenth month, the month of Tebeth, in the seventh year of his reign. Esther Becomes Queen
ekegusii: Ase ayio, omwaka o gatano na kabere bw’okogamba kw’omorwoti Ahaswero, omotienyi o ikomi okorokwa Tebeti, Esiteri akarentwa ase omorwoti, agwo ase enyomba yaye y’oborwoti.
swahili: Esta alipelekwa kwa Mfalme Ahasuero katika makao ya mfalme mwezi wa kumi, yaani mwezi wa Tebethi, katika mwaka wake wa saba wa kutawala.

english: And the king loved Esther more than all the other women, and she found grace and favor in his sight more than all of the other virgins. So he placed the royal crown upon her head and made her queen in place of Vashti.
ekegusii: Omorwoti akaba ogwancha Esiteri kobua abakungu bande bonsi. Esiteri akamogwenera akanyora obuya nogwancherwa ase omorwoti kobua abaiseke bande bonsi abekungi. Omorwoti akamobekeera egutwa y’oborwoti ase omotwe oye, akamobeka akaba eting’ana ribaga ria Vasti.
swahili: Basi ikawa mfalme alivutiwa na Esta kuliko wanawake wengine wote, naye akapata upendeleo na kibali kuliko mabikira wengine. Kisha akamvika taji la kifalme kichwani mwake na kumfanya malkia badala ya Vashti.

english: Then the king held a great banquet, Esther’s banquet, for all his officials and servants. He proclaimed a tax holiday in the provinces and gave gifts worthy of the king’s bounty.
ekegusii: Omorwoti agakora omoyega omonene bw’amasikani ase Esiteri, akarangeria abanene bonsi b’obogambi na abasomba baye aroro. Boigo akaraareria abanto bakeanerigwe ebango ase ense yaye, naende akarua ebiegwa ebinge buna omorwoti agwenerete akore. Moredekai ogotooria obogima bw’omorwoti
swahili: Mfalme akafanya karamu kubwa, karamu ya Esta, kwa wakuu wake wote na maafisa. Mfalme alitangaza mapumziko katika majimbo yake yote na kugawa zawadi kwa ukarimu wa kifalme. Mordekai Afunua Hila

english: When the virgins were assembled a second time, Mordecai was sitting at the king’s gate.
ekegusii: Ekero abaiseke abekungi basangererekanete engaki ya kabere, Moredekai akaba ogoikaransa ase egeita ki’omorwoti.
swahili: Wakati mabikira walikusanyika mara ya pili, Mordekai alikuwa ameketi katika lango la mfalme.

english: Then the king’s attendants proposed, “Let a search be made for beautiful young virgins for the king,
ekegusii: Erio abasomba abarenge gokorera omorwoti bakamoteebia, “Tiga abaiseke abekungi abanyabieni barigigwe barentwe asore, aye omorwoti.
swahili: Kisha watumishi waliomhudumia mfalme walipendekeza, “Na ufanyike utafiti kwa ajili ya wanawali mabikira wazuri wa sura kwa ajili ya mfalme.

english: Esther still had not revealed her lineage or her people, just as Mordecai had instructed. She obeyed Mordecai’s command, as she had done under his care. Mordecai Uncovers a Conspiracy
ekegusii: Esiteri konya taramanyia abanto b’ense eria ng’a ngesaku ki are, gose noyo bw’enyomba ki. Moredekai nigo amosemetie igo, na Esiteri akamoigwera buna konya abeire okomoigwera ekero akinetigwe nere.
swahili: Lakini Esta alikuwa ameficha siri ya kabila lake na uraia wake, kama Mordekai alivyokuwa amemwambia, kwa maana aliendelea kufuata maelekezo ya Mordekai kama alivyokuwa akifanya alipokuwa akimlea.

english: In those days, while Mordecai was sitting at the king’s gate, Bigthan and Teresh, two of the king’s eunuchs who guarded the entrance, grew angry and conspired to assassinate King Xerxes.
ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio Moredekai arenge kobeera agwo ase egeita ki’enyomba y’oborwoti, abakoreri babere b’omorwoti, Bigitana, na Teresi, abwo barenge korenda ase egesieri ki’enyomba, bakaba nendamwamu ase omorwoti, bakarigia enchera y’okomoita.
swahili: Wakati Mordekai alikuwa ameketi kwenye lango la mfalme, Bigthana na Tereshi, maafisa wawili wa mfalme waliokuwa walinzi wa lango, walikasirika na kupanga njama ya kumuua Mfalme Ahasuero.

english: When Mordecai learned of the plot, he reported it to Queen Esther, and she informed the king on Mordecai’s behalf.
ekegusii: Moredekai akamanya ayio, akayateebia Esiteri eting’ana, nere akayateebia omorwoti ribaga ria Moredekai.
swahili: Lakini Mordekai aligundua hila hii na kumwambia Malkia Esta, ambaye baadaye alimwarifu mfalme, huku akimsifu Mordekai.

english: After the report had been investigated and verified, both officials were hanged on the gallows. And all this was recorded in the Book of the Chronicles in the presence of the king.
ekegusii: Obotuki bogakorwa, na amang’ana akanyorekana ng’a namaene arenge; abanto baria babere bakabwatwa, bagatongwa ase chimbambo igoro. Amang’ana ayio akarikerwa ase obosio bw’omorwoti ase Egetabu ki’amang’ana arenge gokoreka.
swahili: Taarifa hiyo ilipochunguzwa na kuonekana kuwa kweli, maafisa hao wawili waliangikwa juu ya miti ya kunyongea. Haya yote yaliandikwa katika kitabu cha kumbukumbu mbele ya mfalme.

english: and let the king appoint commissioners in each province of his kingdom to assemble all the beautiful young women into the harem at the citadel of Susa. Let them be placed under the care of Hegai, the king’s eunuch in charge of the women, and let them be given beauty treatments.
ekegusii: Aye omorwoti, chora abateneneri ase chingongo chionsi chi’obogambi bwao obachike basangererie abaiseke abekungi abare abanyabieni, baabarente ase enyomba y’abakungu ere agwo ase eburi ya Susa. Barabwo babekwe inse y’oborendi bwa Hegai, omokoreri oria ogombaetigwe, oyio otenenerete abakungu bamenyete ase enyomba yao. Abaiseke abwo baegwe amaguta abo bakweaka.
swahili: Mfalme na ateue maafisa katika kila jimbo la himaya yake kuwaleta hao wanawali wote wazuri wa sura katika nyumba ya wanawake katika ngome ya mji wa Shushani. Kisha wawekwe chini ya utunzaji wa Hegai, towashi wa mfalme, msimamizi wa wanawake; na wapewe matunzo yote ya urembo.

english: Then let the young woman who pleases the king become queen in place of Vashti.” This suggestion pleased the king, and he acted accordingly. Esther Finds Favor
ekegusii: Omoiseke oria orakogokie aye omorwoti, otige abe eting’ana ribaga ria Vasti.” Ogosemia okwo gokagwenera omorwoti, ere agakora buna asemetigwe.
swahili: Kisha yule ambaye atampendeza mfalme na awe malkia badala ya Vashti.” Shauri hili likampendeza mfalme, naye akalifuata.

english: Now there was at the citadel of Susa a Jewish man from the tribe of Benjamin named Mordecai son of Jair, the son of Shimei, the son of Kish.
ekegusii: Agwo ase eburi ya Susa, narengeo Omoyahudi oyomo ore korokwa Moredekai, mosinto o Yairi, o Simei, o Kisi, bw’ororeria rwa Benjamini.
swahili: Basi katika mji wa ngome ya Shushani palikuwa na Myahudi wa kabila ya Benyamini, jina lake Mordekai mwana wa Yairi, mwana wa Shimei, mwana wa Kishi,

english: He had been carried into exile from Jerusalem by Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon among those taken captive with Jeconiah king of Judah.
ekegusii: Moredekai oyo nigo arenge oyomo bwa baria bairetwe ase obosomba chingaki chiria omorwoti Yekonia, omorwoti bw’Abayuda, abwo omorwoti Nebuchadnezzar airete ase obosomba amo nabaanto bande.
swahili: ambao walichukuliwa uhamishoni kutoka Yerusalemu na Mfalme Nebukadneza wa Babeli, wakiwa miongoni mwa waliochukuliwa mateka pamoja na Mfalme Yekonia wa Yuda.

english: And Mordecai had brought up Hadassah (that is, Esther), the daughter of his uncle, because she did not have a father or mother. The young woman was lovely in form and appearance, and when her father and mother had died, Mordecai had taken her in as his own daughter.
ekegusii: Moredekai natugete omoiseke oyomo, omwana o ise moke. Omoiseke oyio nigo arenge korokwa Hadasa, na erieta rinde n’Esiteri. Nigo abwate omobere omuya, naende nigo arenge omonyakieni mono. Ekero abaibori baye bonsi bakwete, Moredekai akaba okomotuga buna omwana oye.
swahili: Mordekai alikuwa na binamu yake msichana aliyeitwa Hadasa, ambaye alimlea kwa kuwa hakuwa na baba wala mama. Msichana huyu, ambaye pia alijulikana kwa jina la Esta, alikuwa na umbo na sura ya kupendeza, naye Mordekai alimtunza kama binti yake mwenyewe baada ya baba yake na mama yake kufariki.

english: When the king’s command and edict had been proclaimed, many young women gathered at the citadel of Susa under the care of Hegai. Esther was also taken to the palace and placed under the care of Hegai, the custodian of the women.
ekegusii: Ekero ogochika koria okoyia kw’omorwoti kwaraaretigwe, na abaiseke basangereretigwe agwo ase eburi ya Susa, bakabeekwa inse y’oborendi bwa Hegai, oyorenge omorendi bw’abakungu ase enyomba y’omorwoti; Esiteri nigo arenge oyomo bw’abwo.
swahili: Wakati agizo na amri ya mfalme lilitangazwa, wanawali wengi waliletwa kwenye ngome ya mji wa Shushani na kuwekwa chini ya uangalizi wa Hegai. Pia Esta alipelekwa katika jumba la mfalme na akakabidhiwa Hegai, aliyekuwa mkuu wa nyumba ya wanawake.

english: And the young woman pleased him and obtained his favor, so he quickly provided her with beauty treatments and the special diet. He assigned to her seven select maidservants from the palace and transferred her with them to the best place in the harem.
ekegusii: Omoiseke oria akagokia Hegai mono, akanyora ogwancherwa nere. Ase obwango obwo Hegai akamoa amaguta akweaka erinde arorekane ore omonyakieni, na akamoa endagera yamogwenerete. Boigo akaa Esiteri abaiseke batano na babere abachoretwe asare korwa ase enyomba y’omorwoti bakaba bakomokorera. Hegai akaira Esiteri amo nabakoreri baria baye bamenye aase aagiya mono ase enyomba eria y’abakungu.
swahili: Msichana huyu alimpendeza na kupata kibali mbele zake. Mara moja akaanza kumpa matunzo ya uzuri na chakula maalum. Alimpa Esta vijakazi saba waliochaguliwa kutoka jumba la kifalme, na kumhamishia yeye pamoja na vijakazi wake katika sehemu bora zaidi katika nyumba ya wanawake.

english: After these events, King Xerxes honored Haman son of Hammedatha, the Agagite, elevating him to a position above all the princes who were with him.
ekegusii: Nyuma y’amang’ana ayio, omorwoti Ahaswero agakinia Hamani, mosinto o Hamedata Omoagagi, akamoa obonene kobua abanene bande bonsi abarenge amo nere.
swahili: Baada ya matukio haya, Mfalme Ahasuero alimheshimu Hamani mwana wa Hamedatha, Mwagagi, akampandisha na kumpa kiti chake cha heshima cha juu sana kuliko wakuu wengine wote.

english: So the king removed the signet ring from his finger and gave it to Haman son of Hammedatha, the Agagite, the enemy of the Jews.
ekegusii: Erio omorwoti akarusia ebonyi yarenge ase ekiara kiaye gi’okoboko, yabwate ekemanyererio kiaye, akayea omobisa oria bw’Abayahudi, Hamani, mosinto o Hamedata, Omoagagi,
swahili: Basi mfalme alichukua pete yake ya muhuri kutoka kwenye kidole chake na kumpa Hamani mwana wa Hamedatha, Mwagagi, adui wa Wayahudi.

english: “Keep your money,” said the king to Haman. “These people are given to you to do with them as you please.”
ekegusii: Omorwoti agateebia Hamani, “Chibesa echio gwachieirwe, na abanto kwabaeirwe, okore ande onsi orarore akogwenerete.”
swahili: Mfalme akamwambia Hamani, “Baki na fedha yako na uwatendee hao watu utakavyo.”

english: On the thirteenth day of the first month, the royal scribes were summoned and the order was written exactly as Haman commanded the royal satraps, the governors of each province, and the officials of each people, in the script of each province and the language of every people. It was written in the name of King Xerxes and sealed with the royal signet ring.
ekegusii: Ase ayio, ase rituko ria ikomi na gatato, ri’omotienyi bw’eritang’ani, Hamani akarangeria abariki b’omorwoti erio akabateebia, barike amang’ana ’ogochika koria omorwoti aruete bayaonchore ase kera omonwa na kera engencho yokorika ase oborwoti bwonsi erio bayatome gochia ase abagaambi abanene b’oborwoti, na ase abagabana, na ase abanene b’abaanto be chingongo chionsi ase oborwoti bwaye. Amang’ana ayio nigo arigetwe akabeekwa erieta ri’omorwoti Ahaswero amo nekemanyererio ki’ebonyi eria yaye.
swahili: Kisha siku ya kumi na tatu ya mwezi wa kwanza waandishi wa mfalme waliitwa. Wakaandika barua kwa kila jimbo na katika kila lugha ya watu kama agizo la Hamani lilivyotoka kwa mfalme, kwa watawala wa majimbo mbalimbali, na wakuu wa watu mbalimbali. Hizi ziliandikwa kwa jina la Mfalme Ahasuero mwenyewe na kutiwa muhuri wa pete yake mwenyewe.

english: And the letters were sent by couriers to each of the royal provinces with the order to destroy, kill, and annihilate all the Jews—young and old, women and children—and to plunder their possessions on a single day, the thirteenth day of Adar, the twelfth month.
ekegusii: Amarube aria akaegwa abanto abaango bakayaminyokia gochia ase chingongo chionsi chiare ase oborwoti boria. Nigo arenge goteeba ng’a ase rituko erimo rioka, rituko ria ikomi na gatato ri’omotienyi o ikomi na kabere, noro Adari, Abayahudi bonsi, abanto abake na abagotu, abakungu na abana, baitwe tibarorerwa mabeera basirigwe pi, na ebinto biabo bisakorwe.
swahili: Barua zilipelekwa na tarishi katika majimbo yote ya mfalme zikiwa na amri ya kuharibu, kuua na kuangamiza Wayahudi wote, wadogo kwa wakubwa, wanawake na watoto wadogo, siku moja, yaani siku ya kumi na tatu ya mwezi wa kumi na mbili, ndio mwezi wa Adari, na pia kuteka nyara vitu vyao.

english: A copy of the text of the edict was to be issued in every province and published to all the people, so that they would be ready on that day.
ekegusii: Amang’ana ’amarube ayio achikirwe nigo abegetwe maiso marore ase chingongo chionsi ase obogambi boria koraareria abanto bonsi bebeeke ang’e goika rituko riria riike.
swahili: Nakala ya andiko la amri ilipaswa kutolewa kama sheria katika kila jimbo, na kufahamishwa kwa watu wa kila taifa ili waweze kuwa tayari kwa siku ile.

english: The couriers left, spurred on by the king’s command, and the edict was issued in the citadel of Susa. Then the king and Haman sat down to drink, but the city of Susa was in confusion.
ekegusii: Ase Ogochika koria kw’omorwoti amang’ana ayio akabeekwa maiso marore ase eburi ya Susa, gokabetereria abanto baria abaango baminyoka gochia ase chingongo chionsi. Erio omorwoti na Hamani bagaikaransa konywa, korende omochie o Susa okaba nogoichana.
swahili: Kwa kuharakishwa na amri ya mfalme, matarishi walikwenda na andiko lilitolewa katika mji wa ngome ya Shushani. Mfalme na Hamani waliketi na kunywa, lakini mji wa Shushani ulifadhaika.

english: All the royal servants at the king’s gate bowed down and paid homage to Haman, because the king had commanded that this be done for him. But Mordecai would not bow down or pay homage.
ekegusii: Omorwoti akarua ogochika ng’a abasomba baye bonsi barenge kobeera ase egeita kiaye batung’ame bosio bwa Hamani ase okomosasiima. Bonsi bagakora bo, korende Moredekai ere akanga gokora bo.
swahili: Maafisa wote wa mfalme waliokaa langoni mwa mfalme walipiga magoti na kumpa Hamani heshima, kwa kuwa mfalme alikuwa ameamuru hili kuhusu Hamani. Lakini Mordekai hakumpigia magoti wala kumheshimu.

english: Then the royal servants at the king’s gate asked Mordecai, “Why do you disobey the command of the king?”
ekegusii: Erio abasomba bande b’omorwoti abarenge kobeera agwo ase egeita bakabooria Moredekai, Inee! “Nase ki kwangire koigwera ogochika kw’omorwoti?”
swahili: Kisha maafisa wa mfalme waliokuwa langoni mwa mfalme walimuuliza Mordekai, “Kwa nini hutii agizo la mfalme?”

english: Day after day they warned him, but he would not comply. So they reported it to Haman to see whether Mordecai’s behavior would be tolerated, since he had told them he was a Jew.
ekegusii: Bakaba bagokwana nere rituko ase rituko ng’a aigwere ogochika koria, korende tabeete ogotegerera amang’ana abo. Ere abateebia “inche n’Omoyahudi naende tingotung’amera Hamani”. Ase ayio abasomba baria bagateebia Hamani, erinde barore gose amang’ana a Moredekai nancherwe.
swahili: Siku baada ya siku walizungumza naye lakini hakukubali. Kwa hiyo walimweleza Hamani kuona kama tabia ya Mordekai itaweza kuvumiliwa, kwa maana alikuwa amewaambia kuwa yeye ni Myahudi.

english: When Haman saw that Mordecai would not bow down or pay him homage, he was filled with rage.
ekegusii: Hamani akaba nendamwamu enene mono ekero aroche ng’a Moredekai tarenge gotung’ama ase okomosasiima,
swahili: Wakati Hamani alipoona kuwa Mordekai hampigii magoti wala kumpa heshima alighadhibika.

english: And when he learned the identity of Mordecai’s people, he scorned the notion of laying hands on Mordecai alone. Instead, he sought to destroy all of Mordecai’s people, the Jews, throughout the kingdom of Xerxes.
ekegusii: na ekero amanyete ng’a Moredekai n’Omoyahudi orenge, akarora ng’a tari Moredekai bweka arae egesusuro, korende ere akaria eira goita Abayahudi bonsi abarenge ase oborwoti bw’Ahaswero.
swahili: Hata hivyo baada ya kujulishwa watu wa Mordekai ni akina nani, alibadili wazo la kumuua Mordekai peke yake. Badala yake Hamani alitafuta njia ya kuwaangamiza watu wote wa Mordekai, yaani, Wayahudi, walio katika ufalme wote wa Ahasuero.

english: In the twelfth year of King Xerxes, in the first month, the month of Nisan, the Pur (that is, the lot) was cast before Haman to determine a day and month. And the lot fell on the twelfth month, the month of Adar.
ekegusii: Ase omwaka o ikomi na kabere bw’okogamba kw’omorwoti Ahaswero, omotienyi bw’eritang’ani okorokwa Nisani, Hamani akarwa ogochika obomera bagoakwa obwo bware korokwa Puri, erio banyore rituko na omotienyi arenge gocha goikerania ebirengererio biaye biogoita Abayahudi, erio bagaikera rituko ria ikomi na gatato r’omotienyi o ikomi na kabere okorokwa Adari.
