ekegusii: Amanyinga ayio abe ekemanyererio ase chinyomba chiria morabe momenyete. Ekero ndarore amanyinga aria ning’ete mbatige inwe, na amaakwa aria takobanyora inwe abasirie, ekero ndaake ense ya Misiri.
swahili: Damu itakuwa ishara kwa ajili yenu ya kuonyesha nyumba ambazo mtakuwamo; nami nitakapoiona damu, nitapita juu yenu. Hakuna pigo la uharibifu litakalowagusa ninyi nitakapoipiga Misri.

english: And this day will be a memorial for you, and you are to celebrate it as a feast to the LORD, as a permanent statute for the generations to come.
ekegusii: Rituko eri inaribe ase more rituko rikoinyorwa, na inwe morirende ribe Rituko Rinene ri’Omonene. Nigo moraribwate ebiaare ase ebiaare, ribe rituko rinene ri’omoyega goika kare na kare.” Amatuko Amanene ay’Emegati etabekiri memera
swahili: “Siku hii itakuwa kumbukumbu kwenu, mtaiadhimisha kuwa sikukuu kwa Bwana, katika vizazi vyenu vyote: mtaishika kuwa amri ya kudumu.

english: For seven days you must eat unleavened bread. On the first day you are to remove the leaven from your houses. Whoever eats anything leavened from the first day through the seventh must be cut off from Israel.
ekegusii: “Ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere goika morie emegati etabekiri memera. Rituko rie ritang’ani morusie ememera korwa chinyomba chiaino kegima, ekiagera monto onde bwensi orarie omogati obekire ememera korwa rituko rie ritang’ani goika eria gatano na kabere, nigo araatananwe korwa ase obomo bw’Abaisraeli.
swahili: Kwa siku saba mtakula mikate isiyotiwa chachu. Katika siku ya kwanza mtaondoa chachu yote ndani ya nyumba zenu, kwa maana yeyote atakayekula chochote chenye chachu kuanzia siku ya kwanza hadi ya saba lazima akatiliwe mbali kutoka Israeli.

english: On the first day you are to hold a sacred assembly, and another on the seventh day. You must not do any work on those days, except to prepare the meals—that is all you may do.
ekegusii: Ase rituko rie ritang’ani inamobe nomosangererekano bwatananire ase ogosasiima, na ase rituko ria gatano na kabere boigo mobe nomosangererekano bwatananire ase ogosasiima. Ase amatuko ayio timokora meremo ende yonsi, otatiga okoroisia endagera ase kera omonto ayio oka naro morakore.
swahili: Katika siku ya kwanza mtakuwa na kusanyiko takatifu, na kusanyiko jingine katika siku ya saba. Katika siku hizo msifanye kazi kamwe isipokuwa kutayarisha chakula cha kila mmoja; hilo ndilo tu mtakalofanya.

english: So you are to keep the Feast of Unleavened Bread, for on this very day I brought your divisions out of the land of Egypt. You must keep this day as a permanent statute for the generations to come.
ekegusii: Goika mobe mokorenda rituko eri rinene ri’Emegati etabekiri memera, ekiagera ase rituko eri nario emeganda yaino yarusetigwe ase ense ya Misiri. Morende rituko erio ebiaare ase ebiaare. Oko nakwo korabe ogochika ase more kogenderera botambe.
swahili: “Mtaadhimisha Sikukuu ya Mikate Isiyotiwa Chachu, kwa sababu hiyo ndiyo siku ile niliyovitoa vikosi vyenu kutoka Misri. Mtaiadhimisha siku hii kwa vizazi vyenu vyote kuwa amri ya kudumu.

english: In the first month you are to eat unleavened bread, from the evening of the fourteenth day until the evening of the twenty-first day.
ekegusii: “Goika morie emegati etabekiri memera, gochakera omogoroba bwe rituko ria ikomi na kane ri’omotienyi bw’eritang’ani goika omogoroba bwe rituko ri’emerongo ebere na rimo.
swahili: Katika mwezi wa kwanza mtakula mikate isiyotiwa chachu, kuanzia jioni ya siku ya kumi na nne hadi jioni ya siku ya ishirini na moja.

english: For seven days there must be no leaven found in your houses. If anyone eats something leavened, that person, whether a foreigner or native of the land, must be cut off from the congregation of Israel.
ekegusii: Ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere ememera terorekana ase chinyomba chiaino nonya ng’ake; naki onde bwensi orarie egento kebekire ememera naatananwe korwa ase omoganda bw’Abaisraeli, onye ore omomenyi gose omobiare.
swahili: Kwa muda wa siku saba isionekane chachu yoyote katika nyumba zenu. Yeyote alaye chochote chenye chachu ndani yake, lazima akatiliwe mbali kutoka jumuiya ya Israeli, akiwa ni mgeni au mzawa.

english: “This month is the beginning of months for you; it shall be the first month of your year.
ekegusii: “Omotienyi oyo nobe oyo bw’eritang’ani ase more, oyo bw’ogochaka emetienyi yo omwaka.
swahili: “Mwezi huu utakuwa mwanzo wa miezi kwenu, yaani mwezi wa kwanza wa mwaka wenu.

english: You are not to eat anything leavened; eat unleavened bread in all your homes.”
ekegusii: Timoria gento kende gionsi kebekire ememera; mobe mokoria emegati etabekiri memera aande onsi morabe momenyete.” Epasaka ye ritang’ani
swahili: Msile chochote kilichotiwa chachu. Popote muishipo, ni lazima mle mikate isiyotiwa chachu.”

english: Then Moses summoned all the elders of Israel and told them, “Go at once and select for yourselves a lamb for each family, and slaughter the Passover lamb.
ekegusii: Erio Musa akarangeria abagaaka bonsi b’Abaisraeli, akabateebia, “Genda mochore chimanwa echirabaisane abanto ba kera enyomba, mochinyenye chibe chimanwa chi’omoyega bw’Epasaka.
swahili: Ndipo Mose akawaita wazee wote wa Israeli na kuwaambia, “Nendeni mara moja mkachague wanyama kwa ajili ya jamaa zenu, mkachinje mwana-kondoo wa Pasaka.

english: Take a cluster of hyssop, dip it into the blood in the basin, and brush the blood on the top and sides of the doorframe. None of you shall go out the door of his house until morning.
ekegusii: Erio moimokie chinsagia chia hisopo, mochitobeke ase amanyinga are egetaabo ime, mogindie omoriibo bw’emetobwa ya gesieri igoro amo nemetobwa eria ebere. Onde tabaisa gosoka korwa nyomba mwaye goika mambia.
swahili: Chukueni kitawi cha hisopo, kichovyeni kwenye damu iliyopo kwenye sinia na kuipaka baadhi ya hiyo damu kwenye vizingiti na kwenye miimo yote miwili ya milango. Mtu yeyote asitoke nje ya mlango wa nyumba yake mpaka asubuhi.

english: When the LORD passes through to strike down the Egyptians, He will see the blood on the top and sides of the doorframe and will pass over that doorway; so He will not allow the destroyer to enter your houses and strike you down.
ekegusii: Inaki Omonene nache aete ense ya Misiri aite Abamisiri, korende ekero ararore amanyinga agindirie omoriibo bw’emetobwa ya gesieri igoro na emetobwa eria ebere, nigo araete egesieri ekio, gose tagotiga oria omosiria asoe chinyomba chiaino abaite.
swahili: Bwana apitapo katika nchi yote kuwapiga Wamisri, ataiona damu juu ya vizingiti na kwenye miimo ya milango, naye atapita juu, wala hatamruhusu mwangamizi kuingia katika nyumba zenu na kuwapiga ninyi.

english: And you are to keep this command as a permanent statute for you and your descendants.
ekegusii: Ring’ana eri goika morirende, ribe ogochika kwaino, inwe amo nabana baino kogenderera botambe.
swahili: “Shikeni maagizo haya yawe kanuni ya kudumu kwenu na kwa ajili ya wazao wenu.

english: When you enter the land that the LORD will give you as He promised, you are to keep this service.
ekegusii: Ekero moraike ase ense eri’Omonene arabae, buna abarierete eira, goika mobe mokomoruera ekeng’wanso eke.
swahili: Mtakapoingia katika nchi Bwana atakayowapa kama alivyoahidi, shikeni desturi hii.

english: When your children ask you, ‘What does this service mean to you?’
ekegusii: Na agwo ekero abana baino barache kobaboria: Engencho y’amang’ana aya ninki?.
swahili: Watoto wenu watakapowauliza, ‘Sikukuu hii ina maana gani kwenu?’

english: you are to reply, ‘It is the Passover sacrifice to the LORD, who passed over the houses of the Israelites in Egypt when He struck down the Egyptians and spared our homes.’” Then the people bowed down and worshiped.
ekegusii: Inamobairanerie: Eke nekeng’wanso gi ’Epasaka y’Omonene, ekiagera naetete chinyomba chi’Abaisraeli aaria Misiri ekero aitete Abamisiri, korende agatiga chinyomba chiaito.” Erio Abaisraeli bagatung’ama inse, bagasasiima Nyasae.
swahili: Basi waambieni, ‘Hii ni dhabihu ya Pasaka kwa Bwana, ambaye alipita juu ya nyumba za Waisraeli katika nchi ya Misri na hakudhuru nyumba zetu alipowapiga Wamisri.’ ” Ndipo watu wa Israeli waliposujudu na kuabudu.

english: And the Israelites went and did just what the LORD had commanded Moses and Aaron. The Tenth Plague: Death of the Firstborn
ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakagenda, bagakora onsi ay’Omonene achigete Musa na Aroni. Ogoakwa gwa ikomi: ogokwa kw’abana abatangi ne ching’iti chintangi
swahili: Waisraeli wakafanya kama vile Bwana alivyomwagiza Mose na Aroni.

english: Now at midnight the LORD struck down every firstborn male in the land of Egypt, from the firstborn of Pharaoh, who sat on his throne, to the firstborn of the prisoner in the dungeon, as well as all the firstborn among the livestock.
ekegusii: Bogachia koba botuko gati, Omonene agaita abana abatangi bonsi ase ense ya Misiri, gochakera omwana omotangi o Farao oyoikaransete ase ekerogo kiaye ki’obogambi, goika omwana omotangi bw’omonto osibire echela, boigo ne ching’iti chintangi chionsi chigaitwa.
swahili: Ilipofika usiku wa manane, Bwana akawapiga wazaliwa wa kwanza wote katika Misri, kuanzia mzaliwa wa kwanza wa Farao, mrithi wa kiti cha ufalme, hadi mzaliwa wa kwanza wa mfungwa, aliyekuwa gerezani, na wazaliwa wa kwanza wa mifugo yote pia.

english: Tell the whole congregation of Israel that on the tenth day of this month each man must select a lamb for his family, one per household.
ekegusii: Genda oraarerie omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli, obateebie: Rituko ria ikomi ri’omotienyi oyo kera omonto ore na mwaye achore emanwa, erio kera enyomba ebe nemanwa eyemo.
swahili: Iambie jumuiya yote ya Israeli kwamba katika siku ya kumi ya mwezi huu, kila mtu atatwaa mwana-kondoo mmoja kwa ajili ya familia yake, mmoja kwa kila nyumba.

english: During the night Pharaoh got up—he and all his officials and all the Egyptians—and there was loud wailing in Egypt; for there was no house without someone dead. The Exodus Begins
ekegusii: Farao, amo nabasomba baye bonsi, na Abamisiri bonsi bakaboka botuko. Ebirero ebinene bikaba ase ense yonsi ya Misiri, ekiagera nyomba ende tiyatigarete monto atakwete.
swahili: Farao, na maafisa wake wote, na Wamisri wote wakaamka usiku, na kulikuwa na kilio kikubwa katika nchi ya Misri, kwa kuwa haikuwepo nyumba ambayo hakufa mtu. Kutoka

english: Then Pharaoh summoned Moses and Aaron by night and said, “Get up, leave my people, both you and the Israelites! Go, worship the LORD as you have requested.
ekegusii: Erio Farao akarangeria Musa na Aroni obotuko boria, akabateebia, “Imoka, morue aa ase abanto baane, inwe na Abaisraeli bonsi! Genda mokorere Omonene buna mwabeire mokoboria!
swahili: Wakati huo Farao akawaita Mose na Aroni na kuwaambia, “Ondokeni! Tokeni kwa watu wangu, ninyi pamoja na Waisraeli! Nendeni mkamwabudu Bwana kama mlivyoomba.

english: Take your flocks and herds as well, just as you have said, and depart! And bless me also.”
ekegusii: Ira ching’ondi chiaino ne chiombe chiaino buna mwaboririe, morue aa; monsabere, na inche nsesenigwe.”
swahili: Chukueni makundi yenu ya kondoo na mbuzi pamoja na ngʼombe, kama mlivyosema, nanyi mwende zenu. Nanyi pia mnibariki.”

english: And in order to send them out of the land quickly, the Egyptians urged the people on. “For otherwise,” they said, “we are all going to die!”
ekegusii: Abamisiri bagasorora Abaisraeli, bakabaayereria barue ase ense yabo; naki nigo bateebete ng’a, “Aande nigo torabaise gokwa intwe twensi.”
swahili: Wamisri wakawahimiza Waisraeli waondoke kwa haraka na kuacha nchi yao. Kwa kuwa walisema, “La sivyo, tutakufa wote!”

english: So the people took their dough before it was leavened, carrying it on their shoulders in kneading bowls wrapped in clothing.
ekegusii: Abanto abwo bakaimokia amasie abo konya atarabekwa memera, bakaboa ebituba biabo, ebi baare oboseemiara obosie, ase ebitambaa biabo baare kwambara, bakabibogoria ase amareko abo.
swahili: Hivyo watu wakachukua donge lao la unga kabla ya kutiwa chachu, wakaweka ndani ya mabakuli ya kukandia, wakayaviringisha katika vitambaa na kuyabeba mabegani mwao.

english: Furthermore, the Israelites acted on Moses’ word and asked the Egyptians for articles of silver and gold, and for clothing.
ekegusii: Abaisraeli konya bakorire buna Musa abateebeetie; konya basabire korwa ase Abamisiri ebinto bie chifeta na ebie chitaabu amo ne chianga.
swahili: Waisraeli wakafanya kama Mose alivyowaelekeza, nao wakawaomba Wamisri wawapatie vitu vya fedha, dhahabu na nguo.

english: And the LORD gave the people such favor in the sight of the Egyptians that they granted their request. In this way they plundered the Egyptians.
ekegusii: Omonene konya oeire abanto abwo ogwancherwa ase Abamisiri, na barabwo bakabaa kende gionsi eki baganetie. Ase enchera eye bagasakora Abamisiri. Abaisraeli bakong’anya korwa Misiri
swahili: Basi Bwana alikuwa amewafanya Wamisri kuwa wakarimu kwa hawa watu, wakawapatia Waisraeli vile walivyotaka kwao; kwa hiyo wakawateka nyara Wamisri.

english: The Israelites journeyed from Rameses to Succoth with about 600,000 men on foot, besides women and children.
ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakamanora kogenda namagoro korwa Ramesesi, bagaika Sukoti. Nigo barenge abasacha koreng’ana chilifu amagana atano na rimo (600,000), abakungu na abana tibaabaretwe.
swahili: Waisraeli wakasafiri kutoka Ramesesi mpaka Sukothi. Walikuwepo wanaume wapatao 600,000 waendao kwa miguu bila kuhesabu wanawake na watoto.

english: And a mixed multitude also went up with them, along with great droves of livestock, both flocks and herds.
ekegusii: Na omoganda omonene mono bw’abaanto b’ebisaku ao ao bakagenda komo, bakairana ching’ondi, ne chiombe, ne chitugo chinde chinyinge mono.
swahili: Watu wengine wengi wakafuatana nao, pamoja na makundi makubwa ya mifugo wakiwemo kondoo, mbuzi na ngʼombe.

english: Since their dough had no leaven, the people baked what they had brought out of Egypt into unleavened loaves. For when they had been driven out of Egypt, they could not delay and had not prepared any provisions for themselves.
ekegusii: Ase obosie boria konya botarabekwa memera obwo barentanete korwa Misiri bakaroisia emegati etabekiri memera. Ememera tiyarengeo, ekiagera nigo baseretigwe korwa Misiri ase obwango, bataranyora ribaga koroisia endagera bagochia koria.
swahili: Wakatengeneza maandazi yasiyotiwa chachu kwa ule unga uliokandwa waliokuwa wameutoa Misri, donge hilo la unga halikuwa limetiwa chachu, kwa kuwa walikuwa wameondolewa Misri kwa haraka nao hawakuwa na muda wa kuandaa chakula chao.

english: If the household is too small for a whole lamb, they are to share with the nearest neighbor based on the number of people, and apportion the lamb accordingly.
ekegusii: Korende onye abanto b’enyomba eyemo bare abake, batanyare koria emanwa eria bayekoore, rirorio ere na omogisangio oye, oyobasinyaine, basangere emanwa eyemo, koreng’ana buna omobaro bw’abaanto bareo. Ase kera emanwa goika mobare abanto abarache koyeria koreng’ana buna kera oyomo aranyare koria.
swahili: Ikiwa nyumba yoyote ina watu wachache wasioweza kumaliza huyo mwana-kondoo mzima, nyumba hiyo itabidi ishirikiane na nyumba ya jirani wa karibu, baada ya kuzingatia idadi ya watu waliomo. Mtaangalia ni kiasi gani cha nyama kitahitajika kulingana na mahitaji ya kila mtu.

english: Now the duration of the Israelites’ stay in Egypt was 430 years.
ekegusii: Abaisraeli konya bamenyire ase ense ya Misiri ase engaki y’emiaka amagana ane, na emerongo etato (430).
swahili: Waisraeli walikuwa wameishi Misri kwa muda wa miaka 430.

english: At the end of the 430 years, to the very day, all the LORD’s divisions went out of the land of Egypt.
ekegusii: Ase rituko erio erio riomoerio bwe emiaka eyio amagana ane, na emerongo etato, emeganda yonsi y’Omonene ekang’anya korwa ase ense ya Misiri.
swahili: Ilikuwa ni siku ya mwisho ya hiyo miaka 430, vikosi vyote vya Bwana vilipokuwa vimeondoka Misri.

english: Because the LORD kept a vigil that night to bring them out of the land of Egypt, this same night is to be a vigil to the LORD, to be observed by all the Israelites for the generations to come. Instructions for the Passover
ekegusii: Obotuko obwo nigo bwarenge obotuko bw’okorenda, ekero Omonene arenge ang’e ase okong’anyia Abaisraeli korwa ase ense ya Misiri. Obwo nobotuko Omonene, bogwenerete korendwa n’Abaisraeli ebiaare ase ebiaare. Omoroberio bw’Epasaka
swahili: Kwa sababu Bwana aliutenga usiku ule ili kuwatoa Waisraeli katika nchi ya Misri, katika usiku huu Waisraeli wote wanapaswa kuadhimisha kwa kukesha ili kumheshimu Bwana katika vizazi vijavyo. Masharti Kwa Ajili Ya Pasaka

english: And the LORD said to Moses and Aaron, “This is the statute of the Passover: No foreigner is to eat of it.
ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa na Aroni, “Omoroberio bw’Epasaka noro oyo: Omonto omomenyi tabaisa koyeria,
swahili: Bwana akamwambia Mose na Aroni, “Haya ndiyo masharti kwa ajili ya Pasaka: “Mgeni hataruhusiwa kula Pasaka.

english: But any slave who has been purchased may eat of it, after you have circumcised him.
ekegusii: korende omosomba onde bwensi omogorwa chitaabu ere ayerie gokwamwarokirie.
swahili: Mtumwa yeyote ambaye mmemnunua aweza kuila kama mmemtahiri,

english: A temporary resident or hired hand shall not eat the Passover.
ekegusii: Omogeni omenyete ase more, gose omonto orikire tibayeria Epasaka eyio.
swahili: lakini kibarua yeyote au msafiri haruhusiwi kula.

english: It must be eaten inside one house. You are not to take any of the meat outside the house, and you may not break any of the bones.
ekegusii: Goika erierwe enyomba eyemo ime, timobaisa gosokia chinyama chinde isiko; timobuna riuga riaye rinde rionsi.
swahili: “Sharti iliwe ndani ya nyumba; msichukue nyama yoyote nje ya nyumba hiyo. Msiuvunje mfupa wowote.

english: The whole congregation of Israel must celebrate it.
ekegusii: Omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli goika osange omoyega oyio.
swahili: Jumuiya yote ya Israeli ni lazima waiadhimishe Pasaka hiyo.

english: If a foreigner resides with you and wants to celebrate the LORD’s Passover, all the males in the household must be circumcised; then he may come near to celebrate it, and he shall be like a native of the land. But no uncircumcised man may eat of it.
ekegusii: Onye omomenyi omenyete bwoo bwanchete koria Epasaka y’Omonene, ere na abasacha bonsi abare amo nere goika barokigwe. Erio anyare koria Epasaka, na ere abe buna omobiare oino. Korende onde bwensi otarokiri tayeria.
swahili: “Mgeni aishiye miongoni mwenu ambaye anataka kuadhimisha Pasaka ya Bwana ni lazima wanaume wote waliomo nyumbani mwake wawe wametahiriwa, ndipo aweze kushiriki kama mzawa. Mwanaume yeyote asiyetahiriwa haruhusiwi kuila.

english: The same law shall apply to both the native and the foreigner who resides among you.”
ekegusii: Ogochika nokomo ase omobiare bw’Abaisraeli na omomenyi oyomenyete ase egati yaino.”
swahili: Sheria iyo hiyo itamuhusu mzawa na mgeni anayeishi miongoni mwenu.”

english: Your lamb must be an unblemished year-old male, and you may take it from the sheep or the goats.
ekegusii: Mochore emanwa y’omwaka oyomo etari na kemocho ase omobere oye, ebe eng’ondi gose embori.
swahili: Wanyama mtakaowachagua, lazima wawe wa kiume wa umri wa mwaka mmoja wasiokuwa na dosari, mwaweza kuwachukua kati ya kondoo au mbuzi.

english: Then all the Israelites did this—they did just as the LORD had commanded Moses and Aaron.
ekegusii: Abaisraeli bonsi bagakora buna Omonene achigete Musa na Aroni.
swahili: Waisraeli wote walifanya kama vile Bwana alivyomwagiza Mose na Aroni.

english: And on that very day the LORD brought the Israelites out of the land of Egypt by their divisions.
ekegusii: Ase rituko erio eri’Omonene akang’anyia emeganda yonsi y’Abaisraeli korwa ase ense ya Misiri.
swahili: Siku ile ile Bwana akawatoa Waisraeli katika nchi ya Misri kwa vikosi vyao.

english: You must keep it until the fourteenth day of the month, when the whole assembly of the congregation of Israel will slaughter the animals at twilight.
ekegusii: Mochigache goika rituko ria ikomi na kane ri’omotienyi oyio. Agwo omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli bachinyenye mogoroba.
swahili: Tunzeni wanyama hao mpaka siku ya kumi na nne ya mwezi, ambapo lazima watu wa jumuiya yote ya Israeli wachinje wanyama hao wakati wa jioni.

english: They are to take some of the blood and put it on the sides and tops of the doorframes of the houses where they eat the lambs.
ekegusii: Barabwo baimokie amanyinga aria, bayagindie emetobwa ebere ya gesieri na omoribo o igoro bw’emetobwa, ase kera enyomba barayeriere emanwa eria.
swahili: Ndipo watakapochukua baadhi ya hiyo damu na kuipaka kwenye vizingiti vya juu na miimo ya milango ya nyumba ambamo watakula wana-kondoo hao.

english: They are to eat the meat that night, roasted over the fire, along with unleavened bread and bitter herbs.
ekegusii: Ase obotuko obwo barie chinyama chiria chisambire nomorero, amo nemegati etabekiri memera, ne chinyeni chindoro.
swahili: Usiku huo huo watakula nyama iliyookwa kwenye moto, pamoja na mboga chungu za majani na mikate isiyotiwa chachu.

english: Do not eat any of the meat raw or cooked in boiling water, but only roasted over the fire—its head and legs and inner parts.
ekegusii: Timoria chinde imbese gose chiyekire ase amaache, korende chionsi goika chisambwe nomorero amo nomotwe na ebirenge, ne chinyama chianda.
swahili: Msile nyama mbichi wala iliyochemshwa, lakini iwe imeokwa kwenye moto, kichwa, miguu na nyama zake za ndani.

english: Then the LORD said to Moses,
ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa,
swahili: Bwana akamwambia Mose,

english: Therefore you shall keep this statute at the appointed time year after year.
ekegusii: Ase ayio ogochika oko goika korende omwaka ase omwaka ase engaki eyio echiikire.” Abana abatangi ne ching’iti chintangi
swahili: Ni lazima uishike amri hii kwa wakati uliopangwa mwaka baada ya mwaka.

english: And after the LORD brings you into the land of the Canaanites and gives it to you, as He swore to you and your fathers,
ekegusii: “Ekero Omonene arakorae na kogoikia ase ense ya Kaanani, eyio akorierete eira, aye amo ne chisokoro chiao, na akoyee,
swahili: “Baada ya Bwana kukuingiza katika nchi ya Wakanaani na kukupa nchi hiyo, kama alivyokuahidi kwa kiapo na kwa baba zako,

english: you are to present to the LORD the firstborn male of every womb. All the firstborn males of your livestock belong to the LORD.
ekegusii: omorwere omonene kera omwana omomura omotangi; na kera eng’iti entangi y’e tugo yao, echio nigo chirabe echi’Omonene.
swahili: inakupasa kumtolea Bwana mzaliwa wa kwanza wa kila tumbo. Wazaliwa wote wa kwanza wa kiume wa mifugo yako ni mali ya Bwana.

english: You must redeem every firstborn donkey with a lamb, and if you do not redeem it, you are to break its neck. And every firstborn of your sons you must redeem.
ekegusii: Korende kera emori entangi y’etigere goika oyeboorie ase okorua emanwa y’eng’ondi ebe ekeng’wanso. Onye tibwancheti koyebooria goika oyebune ebigoti. Kera omwana omoisia omotangi o Mwanyabaanto goika omoboorie.
swahili: Kila mzaliwa wa kwanza wa punda utamkomboa kwa mwana-kondoo, lakini kama hukumkomboa, utamvunja shingo yake. Kila mzaliwa wa kwanza mwanaume miongoni mwa wana wenu utamkomboa.

english: In the future, when your son asks you, ‘What does this mean?’ you are to tell him, ‘With a mighty hand the LORD brought us out of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.
ekegusii: Engaki erache omwana oo karakoborie: Engencho y’amang’ana aya ninki? Goika omoiranerie: Ase okoboko kwaye gwe chinguru Omonene agatong’anyia korwa Misiri agwo ase twarenge abasomba.
swahili: “Katika siku zijazo, mwanao akikuuliza, ‘Hii ina maana gani?’ Mwambie, ‘Kwa mkono wenye nguvu Bwana alitutoa katika nchi ya Misri, kutoka nchi ya utumwa.

english: And when Pharaoh stubbornly refused to let us go, the LORD killed every firstborn in the land of Egypt, both of man and beast. This is why I sacrifice to the LORD the firstborn male of every womb, but I redeem all the firstborn of my sons.’
ekegusii: Naki ekero Farao akong’etie enkoro yaye akaanga gotoa ribaga kogenda, Omonene agaita kera omwana omotangi ase ense ya Misiri amo ne ching’iti chintangi chionsi. Nakio gekogera nkoruera Omonene kera eng’iti entangi ye tugo yane, na omwana one omomura omotangi nigo nkomobooria.
swahili: Farao alipokataa kwa ukaidi kuturuhusu kuondoka, Bwana aliua kila mzaliwa wa kwanza wa Wamisri, mwanadamu na wa mnyama. Hii ndiyo sababu ninatoa dhabihu kwa Bwana mzaliwa wa kwanza wa kiume, wa kila tumbo na kumkomboa kila mzaliwa wa kwanza wa wana wangu.’

english: So it shall serve as a sign on your hand and a symbol on your forehead, for with a mighty hand the LORD brought us out of Egypt.” The Pillars of Cloud and Fire
ekegusii: Amang’ana aya goika abe ekemanyererio ase okoboko kwao na ase obosio bwao, ekiagera Omonene natorusetie korwa Misiri nokoboko kwaye gwe chinguru.” Riire na omorero
swahili: Jambo hili litakuwa kama ishara kwenye mkono wako na kama alama kwenye paji la uso wako, kwamba Bwana alikutoa katika nchi ya Misri kwa mkono wake wenye nguvu.” Nguzo Ya Wingu Na Moto

english: When Pharaoh let the people go, God did not lead them along the road through the land of the Philistines, though it was shorter. For God said, “If the people face war, they might change their minds and return to Egypt.”
ekegusii: Ekero Farao aete Abasiraeli ribaga bagende, Nyasae tabaraete baetere ense y’Abafilisti, nonya enchera eyio yarenge omobutokanio. Nyasae nigo arengereretie ng’a aande onye abanto aba bagochia koumera esegi mbaabaisa koirana Misiri.
swahili: Farao alipowaachia watu waende, Mungu hakuwaongoza kufuata njia ipitiayo katika nchi ya Wafilisti, ingawa njia hiyo ilikuwa fupi zaidi. Kwa maana Mungu alisema, “Wakikabiliana na vita, wanaweza kubadili mawazo yao na kurudi Misri.”

english: So God led the people around by the way of the wilderness toward the Red Sea. And the Israelites left the land of Egypt arrayed for battle.
ekegusii: Ase ayio Nyasae akabaraa goetanana ase erooro gochia Enyancha Embariri. Na Abaisraeli bakarua ase ense ya Misiri bare nebirwanero bi’esegi.
swahili: Kwa hiyo Mungu akawaongoza watu kupitia njia ya kuzunguka kupitia jangwani, kuelekea Bahari ya Shamu. Waisraeli walipanda kutoka nchi ya Misri wakiwa wamejiandaa kwa vita.

english: Moses took the bones of Joseph with him because Joseph had made the sons of Israel swear a solemn oath when he said, “God will surely attend to you, and then you must carry my bones with you from this place.”
ekegusii: Musa akairana amauga a Yusufu buna konya Yusufu amochikiire konya atarakwa. Nigo konya otianirie Abaisraeli, agateeba, “Ekero Nyasae arabachere abakoonye morue ase aa, goika moire amauga aane, mogende naro.”
swahili: Mose akachukua mifupa ya Yosefu kwa sababu Yosefu alikuwa amewaapisha wana wa Israeli. Alikuwa amewaambia, “Hakika Mungu atakuja kuwasaidia, nanyi ni lazima mwiichukue mifupa yangu mwende nayo kutoka mahali hapa.”

english: “Consecrate to Me every firstborn male. The firstborn from every womb among the Israelites belongs to Me, both of man and beast.”
ekegusii: “Nyatananere kera omwana omotangi bw’Abaisraeli, oyo okoigora enda ya ng’ina, ne ching’iti chintangi boigo. Ekiagera kera omwana omomura omotangi bw’Abaisraeli noyone ne ching’iti chitangi boigo nechiane.” Rituko rinene ri’Emegati etabekiri memera
swahili: “Niwekeeni wakfu kila mzaliwa wa kwanza wa kiume. Kila mtoto wa kwanza aliye kifungua tumbo miongoni mwa Waisraeli ni mali yangu, akiwa wa mwanadamu au wa mnyama.”

english: They set out from Succoth and camped at Etham on the edge of the wilderness.
ekegusii: Barabwo bakaimoka bakarua Sukoti, bagatoora agwo Etamu aase erooro echakerete.
swahili: Baada ya Waisraeli kuondoka Sukothi wakapiga kambi huko Ethamu pembeni mwa jangwa.

english: And the LORD went before them in a pillar of cloud to guide their way by day, and in a pillar of fire to give them light by night, so that they could travel by day or night.
ekegusii: Omonene akaba okobatang’ana, mobaso ase riire riare buna esiiro koborokia enchera, na botuko ase omorero orenge buna esiiro kobaa oborabu, erio barore ase bakogenda, omobaso na obotuko.
swahili: Wakati wa mchana Bwana aliwatangulia kwa nguzo ya wingu kuwaongoza katika njia yao, na wakati wa usiku aliwatangulia kwa nguzo ya moto kuwaangazia, ili waweze kusafiri mchana au usiku.

english: Neither the pillar of cloud by day nor the pillar of fire by night left its place before the people.
ekegusii: Riire riria riare kobaraa mobaso nigo riarenge bosio bwabo botambe, na omorero botuko, toruete ase amasio abo.
swahili: Ile nguzo ya wingu wakati wa mchana au ile nguzo ya moto wakati wa usiku haikuondoka mahali pake mbele ya watu.

english: So Moses told the people, “Remember this day, the day you came out of Egypt, out of the house of slavery; for the LORD brought you out of it by the strength of His hand. And nothing leavened shall be eaten.
ekegusii: Erio Musa agateebia abanto, “Mobe mokoinyora rituko eri mwang’anyete korwa ase ense ya Misiri, ense eyio mwarenge abasomba, ekiagera Omonene abang’anyetie korwa agwo nokoboko kwaye gwe chinguru. Ase rituko erio omogati obekire ememera toriegwa.
swahili: Ndipo Mose akawaambia watu, “Ikumbukeni siku hii, siku ambayo mlitoka katika nchi ya Misri, katika nchi ya utumwa, kwa sababu Bwana aliwatoa humo kwa mkono wenye nguvu. Msile chochote kilichotiwa chachu.

english: Today, in the month of Abib, you are leaving.
ekegusii: Rituko ria reero ase omotienyi bw’Abibu nario mokong’anya korwa aa.
swahili: Leo, katika mwezi wa Abibu, mnatoka.

english: And when the LORD brings you into the land of the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Hivites, and Jebusites—the land He swore to your fathers that He would give you, a land flowing with milk and honey—you shall keep this service in this month.
ekegusii: Omonene nabarierete chisokoro chiaino eira ng’a nabae ense y’Abakanaani, na Abahiti, na Abaamori, na Abahivi, na Abayebusi. Eyio nense entenenku ere namabeere na obooke. Ekero arabaikie agwo goika mobe mokomoruera ekeng’wanso eke ase omotienyi oyio.
swahili: Bwana atakapokuleta katika nchi ya Wakanaani, Wahiti, Waamori, Wahivi na Wayebusi, nchi aliyowaapia baba zako kukupa, nchi itiririkayo maziwa na asali, utaiadhimisha sikukuu hii katika mwezi huu:

english: For seven days you are to eat unleavened bread, and on the seventh day there shall be a feast to the LORD.
ekegusii: Ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere mobe mokoria emegati etabekiri memera; ase rituko ria gatano na kabere ribe Rituko Rinene ri’Omonene.
swahili: Kwa siku saba utakula mikate isiyotiwa chachu na katika siku ya saba utamfanyia Bwana sikukuu.

english: Unleavened bread shall be eaten during those seven days. Nothing leavened may be found among you, nor shall leaven be found anywhere within your borders.
ekegusii: Emegati etabekiri memera eriegwe ase amatuko atano na abere. Emegati ebekire ememera, gose ememera emenyene, tibirorekana ase ense yaino engima.
swahili: Kwa muda wa siku saba utakula mikate isiyotiwa chachu, pasionekane kitu chochote kilicho na chachu miongoni mwako, wala chachu yoyote isionekane popote ndani ya mipaka yako.

english: And on that day you are to explain to your son, ‘This is because of what the LORD did for me when I came out of Egypt.’
ekegusii: Ekero mogochaka omoyega, ase rituko erio moteebie abana baino buna nigo mogokora ayio onsi ase okoinyora ay’Omonene abakorerete ekero abang’anyetie korwa Misiri.
swahili: Siku ile utamwambia mwanao, ‘Nafanya hivi kwa sababu ya jambo ambalo Bwana alinitendea nilipotoka katika nchi ya Misri.’

english: It shall be a sign for you on your hand and a reminder on your forehead that the Law of the LORD is to be on your lips. For with a mighty hand the LORD brought you out of Egypt.
ekegusii: Amang’ana aya abe ekemanyererio ase okoboko kwao, na ase obosio bwao abe ekeinyorio kegokoinyoria, erinde ogenderere gokwana amachiiko y’Omonene, ekiagera Omonene nakong’anyetie korwa Misiri nokoboko kwaye gwe chinguru.
swahili: Adhimisho hili, litakuwa kama alama kwenye mkono wako na ukumbusho katika paji lako la uso, kwamba sheria ya Bwana inapaswa iwe kinywani mwako. Kwa kuwa Bwana alikutoa katika nchi ya Misri kwa mkono wake wenye nguvu.

english: Then the LORD said to Moses,
ekegusii: Omonene agakwana na Musa, akamoteebia.
swahili: Ndipo Bwana akamwambia Mose,

english: As Pharaoh approached, the Israelites looked up and saw the Egyptians marching after them, and they were terrified and cried out to the LORD.
ekegusii: Ekero Abaisraeli barigereretie magega bakarora Farao na abarwani baye b’esegi bakobabwatia korwa magega, erio agwo barabwo bakaba nobwoba obonene, bakarera ase Omonene.
swahili: Farao alipokaribia, Waisraeli wakainua macho yao, wakawaona Wamisri wakija nyuma yao. Wakashikwa na hofu, wakamlilia Bwana.

english: They said to Moses, “Was it because there were no graves in Egypt that you brought us into the wilderness to die? What have you done to us by bringing us out of Egypt?
ekegusii: Erio bagateebia Musa, “Inee! Chimbeera tichiarenge Misiri? Nase ayio ogatorenta toche gokwera aa ase erooro? Igo gwatokorera bobe ekero gwatorusia korwa Misiri!
swahili: Wakamwambia Mose, “Je, ni kwamba hayakuwako makaburi huko Misri hata umetuleta tufe huku jangwani? Umetufanyia nini kututoa Misri?

english: Did we not say to you in Egypt, ‘Leave us alone so that we may serve the Egyptians’? For it would have been better for us to serve the Egyptians than to die in the wilderness.”
ekegusii: Titwagotebetie ayio aaria Misiri? Tokagoteebia ng’a: Totige tokorere Abamisiri. Naki anga mbuya tware gokorera Abamisiri kobua gokwera aiga ase erooro.”
swahili: Hatukukuambia tulipokuwa huko Misri, tuache tuwatumikie Wamisri? Ingekuwa vyema zaidi kwetu kuwatumikia Wamisri kuliko kufa jangwani!”

english: But Moses told the people, “Do not be afraid. Stand firm and you will see the LORD’s salvation, which He will accomplish for you today; for the Egyptians you see today, you will never see again.
ekegusii: Musa akabateebia Abaisraeli, “Timwoboa, motenene bokong’u reero morore buna Omonene arabatoorie; naki Abamisiri abamorooche reero iga, timokobarora naende nonya ng’ake.
swahili: Mose akawajibu Waisraeli, “Msiogope. Simameni imara, nanyi mtauona wokovu Bwana atakaowapatia leo. Hao Wamisri mnaowaona leo kamwe hamtawaona tena.

english: The LORD will fight for you; you need only to be still.” Parting the Red Sea
ekegusii: Omonene nabarwanere inwe, na inwe mokire‐kiri rioka.”
swahili: Bwana atawapigania ninyi, nanyi mnatakiwa kutulia tu.”

english: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Why are you crying out to Me? Tell the Israelites to go forward.
ekegusii: Omonene akaboria Musa, “Inki okorera ase ’nde? Bateebie Abaisraeli bagenderere bosio.
swahili: Ndipo Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Kwa nini wewe unanililia? Waambie Waisraeli waendelee mbele.

english: And as for you, lift up your staff and stretch out your hand over the sea and divide it, so that the Israelites can go through the sea on dry ground.
ekegusii: Aye imokia enyimbo yao, na orambore okoboko kwao igoro y’enyancha, erinde yaatananeke, Abaisraeli banyare goeta egati y’enyancha ase ense enkamoku.
swahili: Inua fimbo yako na unyooshe mkono wako juu ya bahari ili kuyagawa maji, hivyo kwamba Waisraeli wapate kupita mahali pakavu baharini.

english: And I will harden the hearts of the Egyptians so that they will go in after them. Then I will gain honor by means of Pharaoh and all his army and chariots and horsemen.
ekegusii: Rora, ninkore chinkoro chi’Abamisiri chibe chinkong’u, barabwo mbaababwatie korwa magega. Nabo inche inyenyorere ogotogigwa ase okobua Farao amo nemeganda yaye yonsi, ne chigari chiaye, na abariini chibarasi chiaye.
swahili: Nitaifanya mioyo ya Wamisri kuwa migumu kusudi waingie baharini wakiwafuatia. Nami nitajipatia utukufu kupitia Farao pamoja na jeshi lake lote, kupitia magari yake ya vita na wapanda farasi wake.

english: The Egyptians will know that I am the LORD when I am honored through Pharaoh, his chariots, and his horsemen.”
ekegusii: Na Abamisiri nabamanye ng’a ninche Omonene, ekero nkwenyorera ogotogigwa ase okomobua Farao amo ne chigari chiaye na abariini chibarasi chiaye.”
swahili: Nao Wamisri watajua kwamba Mimi ndimi Bwana nitakapojipatia utukufu kupitia Farao, magari yake ya vita na wapanda farasi wake.”

english: And the angel of God, who had gone before the camp of Israel, withdrew and went behind them. The pillar of cloud also moved from before them and stood behind them,
ekegusii: Erio omomalaika o Nyasae, oyio otang’aine omoganda bw’Abaisraeli, akairana magega yabo. Ne riire riria riateneine buna esiiro bosio bwabo rikairana magega yabo,
swahili: Ndipo malaika wa Mungu, aliyekuwa akisafiri mbele ya jeshi la Israeli, akaondoka akakaa nyuma yao. Pia ile nguzo ya wingu ikaondoka hapo mbele yao na kusimama nyuma,

english: “Tell the Israelites to turn back and encamp before Pi-hahiroth, between Migdol and the sea. You are to encamp by the sea, directly opposite Baal-zephon.
ekegusii: Bateebie Abaisraeli ng’a bairane gochia Pi‐Hahiroti, batoore agwo ase egati ya Migidoli na enyancha kororia Baali‐Sefoni ase enyancha mbarabare.
swahili: “Waambie Waisraeli wageuke nyuma na wapige kambi karibu na Pi-Hahirothi, kati ya Migdoli na bahari. Watapiga kambi kando ya bahari, mkabala na Baal-Sefoni.

english: so that it came between the camps of Egypt and Israel. The cloud was there in the darkness, but it lit up the night. So all night long neither camp went near the other.
ekegusii: rikabeera gati y’omoganda bw’Abaisraeli na oyo bw’Abamisiri. Agwo riire riria rikabao amo nomosunte; korende ase obotuko riire rikarenta oborabu. Na ase obotuko obogima omoganda oyomo toikanete ang’e noyonde.
swahili: ikakaa kati ya majeshi ya Misri na Israeli. Usiku kucha wingu likaleta giza upande mmoja na nuru kwa upande mwingine, kwa hiyo hakuna aliyemkaribia mwenzake usiku kucha.

english: Then Moses stretched out his hand over the sea, and all that night the LORD drove back the sea with a strong east wind that turned it into dry land. So the waters were divided,
ekegusii: Erio Musa akarambora okoboko kwaye igoro y’enyancha; n’Omonene agasukia enyancha gochia magega ne chinguru chi’omwaga okorwa moocha okagusa obotuko obogima. Naboigo agakora enyancha koba ense enkamoku. Amache agaatananeka,
swahili: Ndipo Mose akanyoosha mkono wake juu ya bahari, naye Bwana akayasukuma maji ya bahari nyuma kwa upepo mkali wa mashariki usiku ule wote na kupafanya nchi kavu. Maji yakagawanyika,

english: and the Israelites went through the sea on dry ground, with walls of water on their right and on their left.
ekegusii: na Abaisraeli bagaeta egati y’enyancha ase ense enkamoku. Amache akaba agotenena buna orwaki ensemo ya borio na ensemo ya bomosi ase bare.
swahili: nao Waisraeli wakapita baharini mahali pakavu, maji yakiwa ukuta upande wao wa kuume na upande wao wa kushoto.

english: And the Egyptians chased after them—all Pharaoh’s horses, chariots, and horsemen—and followed them into the sea.
ekegusii: Na Abamisiri bagasoa na kobabwatia gochia gati y’enyancha amo ne chibarasi chionsi chia Farao, ne chigari chiaye, na abariini chibarasi.
swahili: Wamisri wakawafuatia ndani ya bahari, pamoja na farasi wote wa Farao, magari ya vita na wapanda farasi.

english: At morning watch, however, the LORD looked down on the army of the Egyptians from the pillar of fire and cloud, and He threw their camp into confusion.
ekegusii: Bwachia koba mambia, Omonene akaba origereretie omoganda bw’Abamisiri korwa ase esiiro y’omorero na eye riire, akabatantania.
swahili: Karibia mapambazuko, Bwana akaliangalia jeshi la Wamisri kutoka ile nguzo ya moto na ya wingu, akalifadhaisha.

english: He caused their chariot wheels to wobble, so that they had difficulty driving. “Let us flee from the Israelites,” said the Egyptians, “for the LORD is fighting for them against Egypt!”
ekegusii: Omonene akagokora amagoro e chigari chiabo, goika bagasinywa kogenda bosio. Erio Abamisiri bagateeba, “Tiga totame korwa ase Abaisraeli, ekiagera Omonene nkobarwanera are mamincha yaito intwe Abamisiri.”
swahili: Mungu akayaondoa magurudumu ya magari yao, kwa hivyo wakayaendesha kwa shida. Nao Wamisri wakasema, “Tuachane na Waisraeli! Bwana anawapigania dhidi ya Misri.” Wafuatiaji Wazama

english: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Stretch out your hand over the sea, so that the waters may flow back over the Egyptians and their chariots and horsemen.”
ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa, “Rambora okoboko kwao igoro y’enyancha, erinde amaache airanerane igoro y’Abamisiri, ne chigari chiabo amo nabariini chibarasi.”
swahili: Ndipo Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Nyoosha mkono wako juu ya bahari ili maji yarudiane yawafunike Wamisri, magari yao ya vita na wapanda farasi wao.”

english: So Moses stretched out his hand over the sea, and at daybreak the sea returned to its normal state. As the Egyptians were retreating, the LORD swept them into the sea.
ekegusii: Musa akarambora okoboko kwaye igoro y’enyancha, na ekero bwachia gokiamoka, amaache akairana ase konya are botambe. Abamisiri bagatema gotama korwa ase amaache, korende Omonene akabasiria ase amaache.
swahili: Mose akanyoosha mkono wake juu ya bahari, wakati wa mapambazuko bahari ikarudiana na kuwa kama kawaida. Wamisri wakajaribu kuyakimbia maji, lakini Bwana akawasukumia ndani ya bahari.

english: The waters flowed back and covered the chariots and horsemen—the entire army of Pharaoh that had chased the Israelites into the sea. Not one of them survived.
ekegusii: Amache akairanerana, akamera chigari, na abariini chibarasi amo nomoganda bwonsi bw’abarwani ba Farao, obatunyanete Abaisraeli, gochia ase enyancha. Monto onde tatigara nonya noyomo.
swahili: Maji yakarudiana na kuyafunika magari ya vita na wapanda farasi pamoja na jeshi lote la Farao lililokuwa limewafuata Waisraeli ndani ya bahari. Hakuna hata mmoja wao aliyenusurika.

english: But the Israelites had walked through the sea on dry ground, with walls of water on their right and on their left.
ekegusii: Korende Abaisraeli bakagenderera goeta egati y’enyancha ase ense enkamoku, amaache akaba ateneine buna orwaki ensemo ya borio na ensemo ya bomosi ase bare.
swahili: Lakini Waisraeli wakapita baharini mahali pakavu, ukiwepo ukuta wa maji upande wao wa kuume na upande wao wa kushoto.

english: For Pharaoh will say of the Israelites, ‘They are wandering the land in confusion; the wilderness has boxed them in.’
ekegusii: Farao narengererie ng’a Abaisraeli batantanire enchera bakogenda, na erooro yabatangire tibagenda.
swahili: Farao atafikiri kwamba, ‘Hao Waisraeli wanatangatanga katika nchi kwa kuchanganyikiwa, nalo jangwa limewafungia.’

english: That day the LORD saved Israel from the hand of the Egyptians, and Israel saw the Egyptians dead on the shore.
ekegusii: Naboigo ase rituko riri’Omonene atooretie Abaisraeli korwa ase amaboko ’Abamisiri; na Abaisraeli bakarora Abamisiri bakwete bacheng’enenete ase engegu y’enyancha.
swahili: Siku ile Bwana akawaokoa Waisraeli kutoka mikononi mwa Wamisri, nao Waisraeli wakawaona Wamisri wamelala ufuoni mwa bahari wakiwa wamekufa.

english: When Israel saw the great power that the LORD had exercised over the Egyptians, the people feared the LORD and believed in Him and in His servant Moses.
ekegusii: Na ekero Abaisraeli baroche buna Omonene aorokirie okobua kwaye okonene igoro y’Abamisiri, bakamoiroka Omonene, bakamwegena Omonene na Musa, omosomba oye.
swahili: Basi Waisraeli walipoona uwezo mkubwa Bwana aliodhihirisha dhidi ya Wamisri, watu wakamwogopa Bwana na wakaweka tumaini lao kwake na kwa Mose mtumishi wake.

english: And I will harden Pharaoh’s heart so that he will pursue them. But I will gain honor by means of Pharaoh and all his army, and the Egyptians will know that I am the LORD.” So this is what the Israelites did.
ekegusii: Inche ninkong’ie enkoro ya Farao, erio ababwatie korwa magega, na inche ninyenyorere ogotogigwa ase okobua Farao amo nomoganda oye bwonsi, na Abamisiri bamanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene. Abaisraeli bagakora buna bateebetigwe.
swahili: Nami nitaufanya moyo wa Farao mgumu, naye atawafuatilia. Lakini nitajipatia utukufu kwa ajili yangu mwenyewe kupitia Farao na jeshi lake lote, nao Wamisri watajua kuwa mimi ndimi Bwana.” Kwa hiyo Waisraeli wakafanya hivyo.

english: When the king of Egypt was told that the people had fled, Pharaoh and his officials changed their minds about them and said, “What have we done? We have released Israel from serving us.”
ekegusii: Ekero Farao, omorwoti o Misiri, ateebetigwe ng’a Abaisraeli batamire, ere amo nabasomba baye bakaonchora ebirengererio biabo, bakaboora, “Inki eke twakora? Tokaa Abaisraeli ribaga korua aa ase barenge gotokorera.”
swahili: Mfalme wa Misri alipoambiwa kuwa Waisraeli wamekimbia, Farao na maafisa wake wakabadili nia zao kuhusu Waisraeli, wakasema, “Tumefanya nini? Tumewaachia Waisraeli waende zao na tumeukosa utumishi wao!”

english: So Pharaoh prepared his chariot and took his army with him.
ekegusii: Erio Farao akabeeka egari yaye y’esegi amo na abarwani baye b’esegi ang’e.
swahili: Kwa hiyo akaandaliwa gari lake la vita, naye akaenda pamoja na jeshi lake.

english: He took 600 of the best chariots, and all the other chariots of Egypt, with officers over all of them.
ekegusii: Naende akaira chigari amagana atano na rimo, echi achorete, amo ne chigari chinde chionsi, na abariini chituoni bachiriinete.
swahili: Akachukua magari bora mia sita, pamoja na magari mengine yote ya Misri, pamoja na maafisa wa magari hayo yote.

english: And the LORD hardened the heart of Pharaoh king of Egypt so that he pursued the Israelites, who were marching out defiantly.
ekegusii: Omonene agakong’ia enkoro ya Farao, omorwoti o Misiri, na ere akabwatia Abaisraeli korwa magega, ekero barabwo bang’anyete bare nobomwenu.
swahili: Bwana akaufanya mgumu moyo wa Farao, mfalme wa Misri, kwa hiyo akawafuatia Waisraeli, waliokuwa wakiondoka Misri kwa ujasiri.

english: The Egyptians—all Pharaoh’s horses and chariots, horsemen and troops—pursued the Israelites and overtook them as they camped by the sea near Pi-hahiroth, opposite Baal-zephon.
ekegusii: Abamisiri bakababwatia korwa magega amo ne chibarasi chionsi, ne chigari chia Farao, na abariini chibarasi chiaye, na abarwani baye bonsi, bakabanyora batoorire enyancha mbarabare, ang’e na Pi‐Hahiroti kororia Baali‐Sefoni.
swahili: Nao Wamisri, yaani farasi wote wa Farao na magari ya vita, wapanda farasi na vikosi vya askari, wakawafuatia Waisraeli, wakawakuta karibu na Pi-Hahirothi, mkabala na Baal-Sefoni walipokuwa wamepiga kambi kando ya bahari.

english: Then Moses and the Israelites sang this song to the LORD: “I will sing to the LORD, for He is highly exalted. The horse and rider He has thrown into the sea.
ekegusii: Erio Musa na Abaisraeli bakamoterera Omonene ogoteera oko, bagoteeba: Nimoterere Omonene, ekiagera ere obuire ase okobua okonene; chibarasi amo nabachiriinete obarimeirie ase enyancha ime.
swahili: Ndipo Mose na Waisraeli wakamwimbia Bwana wimbo huu: “Nitamwimbia Bwana, kwa kuwa ametukuzwa sana. Farasi na mpanda farasi amewatosa baharini.

english: But You blew with Your breath, and the sea covered them. They sank like lead in the mighty waters.
ekegusii: Naboigo ekero aye kwagusete buna omwaga, amaache akabamera; bakamerwa buna embunde ekorimera ase amaache amange ime, yarika inse.
swahili: Lakini ulipuliza kwa pumzi yako, bahari ikawafunika. Wakazama kama risasi kwenye maji makuu.

english: Who among the gods is like You, O LORD? Who is like You—majestic in holiness, revered with praises, performing wonders?
ekegusii: Omonene, ning’o onga buna aye ase egati ye chinyasae? Ning’o onga buna aye ore nobonene na obochenu? Naye ogwenerete koirokwa na gotogigwa, aye naye oyogokora amakumia.
swahili: “Ni nani miongoni mwa miungu aliye kama wewe, Ee Bwana? Ni nani kama Wewe: uliyetukuka katika utakatifu, utishaye katika utukufu, ukitenda maajabu?

english: You stretched out Your right hand, and the earth swallowed them up.
ekegusii: Ekero kwaramborete okoboko kwao gw’okorio, ense ekabamera.
swahili: Uliunyoosha mkono wako wa kuume na nchi ikawameza.

english: With loving devotion You will lead the people You have redeemed; with Your strength You will guide them to Your holy dwelling.
ekegusii: Ase chiira chiao chi’obwanchani chiria kwabarierete okaraa abanto aba kwabooretie, ase chinguru chiao okabaikia ase obomenyo bwao obochenu.
swahili: “Katika upendo wako usiokoma utawaongoza watu uliowakomboa. Katika nguvu zako utawaongoza mpaka makao yako matakatifu.

english: The nations will hear and tremble; anguish will grip the dwellers of Philistia.
ekegusii: Abanto b’ebisaku bakayaigwa, bagatengechigwa ase omoondoko, omoichano na obororo bikabwata abamenyete Bofilisti.
swahili: Mataifa watasikia na kutetemeka, uchungu utawakamata watu wa Ufilisti.

english: Then the chiefs of Edom will be dismayed; trembling will seize the leaders of Moab; those who dwell in Canaan will melt away,
ekegusii: Abagaambi b’Edomu bakaondoka, abanto abanene ba Moabu bakabwatwa nomotengecho, na abanto bonsi ba Kaanani bakerusia moyo.
swahili: Wakuu wa Edomu wataogopa, viongozi wa Moabu watatetemeka kwa hofu, watu wa Kanaani watayeyuka,

english: and terror and dread will fall on them. By the power of Your arm they will be as still as a stone until Your people pass by, O LORD, until the people You have bought pass by.
ekegusii: Omoondoko na obwoba bikababwata; ase engencho y’okobua gw’okoboko kwao bagatenena, bagakira‐kiri buna amagena, goika abanto bao baetire, ee, Omonene, goika abanto bao kwabooretie baetire.
swahili: vitisho na hofu vitawaangukia. Kwa nguvu ya mkono wako watatulia kama jiwe, mpaka watu wako waishe kupita, Ee Bwana, mpaka watu uliowanunua wapite.

english: You will bring them in and plant them on the mountain of Your inheritance— the place, O LORD, You have prepared for Your dwelling, the sanctuary, O Lord, Your hands have established.
ekegusii: Nobasoyie na kobabeeka ase egetunwa kiao aye omonyene, aase aria kweroiseretie, aye Omonene, obomenyo obochenu kwaagachete namaboko ao.
swahili: Utawaingiza na kuwapandikiza juu ya mlima wa urithi wako: hapo mahali, Ee Bwana, ulipopafanya kuwa makao yako, mahali patakatifu, Ee Bwana, ulipopajenga kwa mikono yako.

english: The LORD will reign forever and ever!”
ekegusii: Omonene nagaambe kare na kare.
swahili: Bwana atatawala milele na milele.”

english: For when Pharaoh’s horses, chariots, and horsemen went into the sea, the LORD brought the waters of the sea back over them. But the Israelites walked through the sea on dry ground.
ekegusii: Ekero chibarasi chia Farao, amo ne chigari na abariini basoete nyancha ime, Omonene akairania amaache igoro yabo, akabatuba; korende Abaisraeli bagaeta egati y’enyancha ase ense enkamoku. Ogoteera kwa Miriamu
swahili: Farasi wa Farao, magari yake ya vita na wapanda farasi wake walipoingia baharini, Bwana aliyarudisha maji ya bahari yakawafunika, lakini wana wa Israeli walipita baharini mahali pakavu.

english: The LORD is my strength and my song, and He has become my salvation. He is my God, and I will praise Him, my father’s God, and I will exalt Him.
ekegusii: Omonene nere chinguru chiane, nimoterere ere, ere nogotooreka kwane. Ere Nyasae one, nimotogie; ere Nyasae o tata, ninterere obonene bwaye.
swahili: Bwana ni nguvu zangu na wimbo wangu; amekuwa wokovu wangu. Yeye ni Mungu wangu, nami nitamsifu, Mungu wa baba yangu, nami nitamtukuza.

english: Then Miriam the prophetess, Aaron’s sister, took a tambourine in her hand, and all the women followed her with tambourines and dancing.
ekegusii: Na Miriamu omobani, omoiseke omwabo Aroni, akaimokia ekebangarara kiaye, na abakungu bonsi bakamobwatia bakobugia ebibangarara biabo na goteenga.
swahili: Kisha Miriamu yule nabii mke, ndugu yake Aroni, akachukua matari mkononi mwake na wanawake wote wakamfuata na matari yao wakicheza.

english: And Miriam sang back to them: “Sing to the LORD, for He is highly exalted; the horse and rider He has thrown into the sea.” The Waters of Marah
ekegusii: Miriamu akabaterera ogoteera kogoteeba, “Moterere Omonene, ekiagera ere obuire ase okobua okonene, chibarasi amo nabachiriinete obarimeirie ase enyancha ime.” Chinsoko chire namaache amaroro
swahili: Miriamu akawaimbia: “Mwimbieni Bwana, kwa maana ametukuka sana. Farasi na mpanda farasi amewatosa baharini.” Maji Ya Mara Na Elimu

english: Then Moses led Israel from the Red Sea, and they went out into the Desert of Shur. For three days they walked in the desert without finding water.
ekegusii: Erio Musa agatang’ana Abaisraeli kogenda orogendo korwa ase Enyancha Embariri gochia erooro ya Suri. Bagataara ase engaki y’amatuko atato ase erooro, na tibanyora maache.
swahili: Kisha Mose akawaongoza Israeli kutoka Bahari ya Shamu na kuingia katika Jangwa la Shuri. Kwa siku tatu walisafiri jangwani bila kupata maji.

english: And when they came to Marah, they could not drink the water there because it was bitter. (That is why it was named Marah.)
ekegusii: Erio bagaika aase are korokwa Mara, tibanyara konywa amaache arengeo, ekiagera arenge amaroro mono. Nakio kiagerete aase aria akarokwa Mara.
swahili: Walipofika Mara, hawakuweza kunywa maji yake kwa sababu yalikuwa machungu. (Ndiyo sababu mahali hapo panaitwa Mara )

english: So the people grumbled against Moses, saying, “What are we to drink?”
ekegusii: Agwo abanto bakemurunganeria Musa, bakamobooria, “Ninki tokonywa?”
swahili: Kwa hiyo watu wakamnungʼunikia Mose, wakisema, “Tunywe nini?”

english: And Moses cried out to the LORD, and the LORD showed him a log. And when he cast it into the waters, they were sweetened. There the LORD made for them a statute and an ordinance, and there He tested them,
ekegusii: Musa akarera ase Omonene, n’Omonene akamworokia ekeng’ese kio omote. Omote oyio Musa akayoruta amaache ime, na amaache aria akaba amaansu. Agw’Omonene akabeekera abanto amaachiko akobaraa, na agwo akaba okobateema.
swahili: Ndipo Mose akamlilia Bwana, naye Bwana akamwonyesha kipande cha mti. Akakitupa ndani ya maji, nayo maji yakawa matamu. Huko Bwana akawapa amri na sheria na huko akawajaribu.

english: saying, “If you will listen carefully to the voice of the LORD your God, and do what is right in His eyes, and pay attention to His commands, and keep all His statutes, then I will not bring on you any of the diseases I inflicted on the Egyptians. For I am the LORD who heals you.”
ekegusii: Akabora, “Oise koigwera aya inche Omonene oo ngokwana, na koyakora ayare boronge ase amaiso aane, na gotegerera amaachiko aane, na kobwata emeroberio yane yonsi, rirorio inche tingokobekera amarwaire ande onsi buna aria nabeekerete Abamisiri; naki ninche Omonene oo, oyogokogwenia.”
swahili: Mungu akasema, “Kama mkisikiliza kwa bidii sauti ya Bwana Mungu wenu na kuyafanya yaliyo sawa machoni pake, kama mkiyatii maagizo yake na kuzishika amri zake zote, sitaleta juu yenu ugonjwa wowote niliowaletea Wamisri, kwa kuwa Mimi ndimi Bwana, niwaponyaye.”

english: Then they came to Elim, where there were twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees, and they camped there by the waters.
ekegusii: Erio abanto bagaika Elimu; agwo chinsoko nchiarengeo ikomi na ibere, na emekendo emerongo etan’abere (70). Bagatoora agwo ang’e namaache.
swahili: Kisha wakafika Elimu, mahali palipokuwa na chemchemi kumi na mbili, na miti sabini ya mitende, wakapiga kambi huko karibu na maji.

english: The LORD is a warrior, the LORD is His name.
ekegusii: Omonene nomorwani bwe chiseegi, Omonene nario erieta riaye.
swahili: Bwana ni shujaa wa vita; Bwana ndilo jina lake.

english: Pharaoh’s chariots and army He has cast into the sea; the finest of his officers are drowned in the Red Sea.
ekegusii: Orutire chigari chia Farao amo nomoganda oye ase enyancha ime; abarwani baye abachore obarimeirie ase enyancha embariri.
swahili: Magari ya vita ya Farao na jeshi lake amewatosa baharini. Maafisa wa Farao walio bora sana wamezamishwa katika Bahari ya Shamu.

english: The depths have covered them; they sank there like a stone.
ekegusii: Amache abatubire, barimeire chindiba ime buna rigena rikorutwa.
swahili: Maji yenye kina yamewafunika, wamezama mpaka vilindini kama jiwe.

english: Your right hand, O LORD, is majestic in power; Your right hand, O LORD, has shattered the enemy.
ekegusii: Omonene, okoboko kwao gw’okorio nkore nokobua okonene, Omonene, okoboko kwao gw’okorio ngosenyente ababisa.
swahili: “Mkono wako wa kuume, Ee Bwana ulitukuka kwa uweza. Mkono wako wa kuume, Ee Bwana, ukamponda adui.

english: You overthrew Your adversaries by Your great majesty. You unleashed Your burning wrath; it consumed them like stubble.
ekegusii: Ase okobua kwao okonene nigo okobaiyeria inse abagokoimokera; endamwamu yao ekobera, nigo ekobasamba buna chimboba chinyomo.
swahili: Katika ukuu wa utukufu wako, ukawaangusha chini wale waliokupinga. Uliachia hasira yako kali, ikawateketeza kama kapi.

english: At the blast of Your nostrils the waters piled up; like a wall the currents stood firm; the depths congealed in the heart of the sea.
ekegusii: Ase omoika korwa ase chimioro chiao amaache akaimoka, agatenena buna orwaki, enyancha egakamoka goika inse kegima.
swahili: Kwa pumzi ya pua zako maji yalijilundika. Mawimbi ya maji yakasimama imara kama ukuta, vilindi vikagandamana ndani ya moyo wa bahari.

english: The enemy declared, ‘I will pursue, I will overtake. I will divide the spoils; I will gorge myself on them. I will draw my sword; my hand will destroy them.’
ekegusii: Omobisa agateeba, “Nimbabwatie, mbaikeere, mbiatanane ebi ndasakore, omoyo one oisaneke; ninsomore omoyio one o birende, nimbasirie nokoboko kwane.”
swahili: “Adui alijivuna, ‘Nitawafuatia, nitawapata. Nitagawanya nyara; nitajishibisha kwa wao. Nitafuta upanga wangu na mkono wangu utawaangamiza.’

english: On the fifteenth day of the second month after they had left the land of Egypt, the whole congregation of Israel set out from Elim and came to the Desert of Sin, which is between Elim and Sinai.
ekegusii: Omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli okamanora na koimoka korwa Elimu, na ase rituko ria ikomi na gatano ri’omotienyi o kabere magega kobarure ense ya Misiri, bagaika ase erooro ya Sini, eyio ere egati y’Elimu na Sinai.
swahili: Jumuiya yote ya Kiisraeli ikaondoka Elimu, wakafika Jangwa la Sini, lililokuwa kati ya Elimu na Sinai, siku ya kumi na tano ya mwezi wa pili baada ya kutoka Misri.

english: And as Aaron was speaking to the whole congregation of Israel, they looked toward the desert, and there in a cloud the glory of the LORD appeared.
ekegusii: Ekaba ekero Aroni arenge gokwana nomoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli, barabwo bakeonchora bakarigereria gochia ase erooro, bakarora obonene bw’Omonene bokooroka korwa ase riire.
swahili: Aroni alipokuwa akizungumza na jumuiya yote ya Waisraeli, wakatazama kuelekea jangwani, na huko wakaona utukufu wa Bwana ukitokeza katika wingu.

english: Then the LORD said to Moses,
ekegusii: Omonene agakwana na Musa, akamoteebia,
swahili: Bwana akamwambia Mose,

english: “I have heard the grumbling of the Israelites. Tell them, ‘At twilight you will eat meat, and in the morning you will be filled with bread. Then you will know that I am the LORD your God.’”
ekegusii: “Naigure okwemurungania kw’Abaisraeli. Kwana nabarabwo, obateebie ng’a engaki ya mogoroba mbaegwe enyama barie, na mambia inabarie omogati. Erio bamanye ng’a ninche Omonene, Nyasae obo.”
swahili: “Nimesikia manungʼuniko ya Waisraeli. Waambie, ‘Jioni mtakula nyama, na asubuhi mtashiba mikate. Ndipo mtajua ya kwamba Mimi ndimi Bwana Mungu wenu.’ ”

english: That evening quail came and covered the camp, and in the morning there was a layer of dew around the camp.
ekegusii: Mogoroba chinkware chigaacha, chigaichora ase batoorete, na mambia yaye aase onsi aetanaine aase aria akanyorwa atoorire riimi.
swahili: Jioni ile kware wakaja wakaifunika kambi na asubuhi kulikuwa na tabaka la umande kuzunguka kambi.

english: When the layer of dew had evaporated, there were thin flakes on the desert floor, as fine as frost on the ground.
ekegusii: Na ekero riimi riakamokire, bakarora inse aria ase erooro ebinto binga buna amagoocho, bikarorekana buna obosie oborabu.
swahili: Wakati umande ulipoondoka, vipande vidogo vidogo kama theluji vilionekana juu ya uso wa jangwa.

english: When the Israelites saw it, they asked one another, “What is it?” For they did not know what it was. So Moses told them, “It is the bread that the LORD has given you to eat.
ekegusii: Ekero Abaisraeli babiroche tibamanyete gose mbinto ki, bagachaaka koborania barabwo ase barabwo, “Mbinto ki biria?” Musa akabateebia, “Oria nomogati oy’Omonene abaeire morie.
swahili: Waisraeli walipoona, wakaambiana, “Hiki ni nini?” Kwa kuwa hawakujua kilikuwa kitu gani. Mose akawaambia, “Huu ndio mkate ambao Bwana amewapa mle.

english: This is what the LORD has commanded: ‘Each one is to gather as much as he needs. You may take an omer for each person in your tent.’”
ekegusii: Ring’ana erio nario Omonene achigete: Sangereria endagera eyio, kera oyomo buna agwenerete, ebimunu bibere ase kera omonto. Kera omonto asangererie buna abwate abanto bang’ana ase eema yaye.”
swahili: Hivi ndivyo Bwana alivyoamuru: ‘Kila mmoja akusanye kiasi anachohitaji. Chukueni pishi moja kwa kila mtu mliye naye katika hema yenu.’ ”

english: So the Israelites did this. Some gathered more, and some less.
ekegusii: Abaisraeli bagakora bo, bagasangereria abande enyinge, na abande enke.
swahili: Waisraeli wakafanya kama walivyoambiwa, baadhi yao wakakusanya zaidi, wengine pungufu.

english: When they measured it by the omer, he who gathered much had no excess, and he who gathered little had no shortfall. Each one gathered as much as he needed to eat.
ekegusii: Korende ekero bayerengete ase ebirengo, oyosangereretie enyinge tatigaria kende, na ere oyosangereretie enke taremeretwe gento. Kera oyomo konya osangereirie buna okoria kwaye kwang’ana.
swahili: Nao walipopima katika pishi, yule aliyekusanya zaidi hakuwa na ziada, wala aliyekusanya kidogo hakupungukiwa. Kila mmoja alikusanya kiasi alichohitaji.

english: Then Moses said to them, “No one may keep any of it until morning.”
ekegusii: Musa akabateebia, “Monto onde tatigaria endagera ende goika mambia.”
swahili: Kisha Mose akawaambia, “Mtu yeyote asibakize chochote mpaka asubuhi.”

english: And there in the desert they all grumbled against Moses and Aaron.
ekegusii: Agwo ase erooro omoganda bwonsi bwa Abaisraeli bakemurunganeria Musa na Aroni,
swahili: Huko jangwani hiyo jumuiya yote wakawanungʼunikia Mose na Aroni.

english: But they did not listen to Moses; some people left part of it until morning, and it became infested with maggots and began to smell. So Moses was angry with them.
ekegusii: Korende tibaigwera Musa; abande bagatigaria eyende goika rituko ria kabere, na mambia yaye bakayenyora yagundire na yasoirwe namakonde, na Musa akababea mono.
swahili: Hata hivyo, wengine hawakuzingatia aliyosema Mose, wakahifadhi kiasi fulani mpaka asubuhi, lakini kile alichohifadhi kikajaa mabuu na kuanza kunuka. Kwa hiyo Mose akawakasirikia.

english: Every morning each one gathered as much as was needed, and when the sun grew hot, it melted away. The Sabbath Observed (Genesis 2:1–3; Hebrews 4:1–11)
ekegusii: Ase igo kera emambia bakaba bagosangereria kera oyomo buna okoria kwaye kwang’ana; korende ekero omobaso oyesambire, yanyititoka.
swahili: Kila asubuhi, kila mmoja alikusanya kiasi alichohitaji na jua lilipokuwa kali, iliyeyuka.

english: On the sixth day, they gathered twice as much food—two omers per person —and all the leaders of the congregation came and reported this to Moses.
ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatano na rimo baba bagosangereria endagera eria ekerengo ara kabere, ase kera omonto ebimunu bine. Abagaaka bonsi b’omoganda bakagenda goteebia Musa amang’ana ayio.
swahili: Siku ya sita, wakakusanya mara mbili, kiasi cha pishi mbili kwa kila mtu, nao viongozi wa jumuiya wakaja kumwarifu Mose.

english: He told them, “This is what the LORD has said: ‘Tomorrow is to be a day of complete rest, a holy Sabbath to the LORD. So bake what you want to bake, and boil what you want to boil. Then set aside whatever remains and keep it until morning.’”
ekegusii: Ere akabairaneria, “Ring’ana erio nario Omonene konya atebiire: Ankio nerituko richenu ri’ogotimoka, Esabato Enchenu yaatananirwe ase Omonene. Mosambe eki moganetie gosamba, na moiyeke eki moganetie koiyeka, na ebiratigare mobigache goika ankio.”
swahili: Mose akawaambia, “Hivi ndivyo alivyoagiza Bwana: ‘Kesho itakuwa siku ya mapumziko, Sabato takatifu kwa Bwana. Kwa hiyo okeni kile mnachotaka kuoka na mchemshe kile mnachotaka kuchemsha. Hifadhini chochote kinachobaki na mkiweke mpaka asubuhi.’ ”

english: So they set it aside until morning as Moses had commanded, and it did not smell or contain any maggots.
ekegusii: Na buna Musa abachigete bakagacha endagera eria yatigarete goika rituko ria kabere; ero tiyagunda etioke, gose tiyasogwa namakonde.
swahili: Kwa hiyo wakavihifadhi mpaka asubuhi, kama Mose alivyoagiza, na havikunuka wala kuwa na mabuu.

english: “Eat it today,” Moses said, “because today is a Sabbath to the LORD. Today you will not find anything in the field.
ekegusii: Musa akabateebia, “Karie eye reero, ekiagera reero n’Esabato yaatananirwe ase Omonene, ekiagera reero timokoyerora isiko ase erooro.
swahili: Mose akawaambia, “Kuleni leo, kwa sababu leo ni Sabato kwa Bwana. Hamtapata chochote juu ya nchi leo.

english: For six days you may gather, but on the seventh day, the Sabbath, it will not be there.”
ekegusii: Ase amatuko atano na rimo mobe mokoyesangereria endagera eye, korende rituko ria gatano na kabere n’Esabato, endagera eyio tegotoka.”
swahili: Kwa siku sita mtakusanya, lakini siku ya saba, yaani Sabato, hakutakuwepo chochote.”

english: Yet on the seventh day some of the people went out to gather, but they did not find anything.
ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatano na kabere abande ase abanto baria bakagenda koyesangereria, tibayenyora.
swahili: Hata hivyo, baadhi ya watu wakatoka kwenda kukusanya siku ya saba, lakini hawakupata chochote.

english: Then the LORD said to Moses, “How long will you refuse to keep My commandments and instructions?
ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa, “Ngoika ririri morabe mokwanga ogotebereria kwane na amachiiko aane?
swahili: Ndipo Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Je, mtaacha kushika maagizo na maelekezo yangu mpaka lini?

english: Understand that the LORD has given you the Sabbath; that is why on the sixth day He will give you bread for two days. On the seventh day, everyone must stay where he is; no one may leave his place.”
ekegusii: Inyora ng’a inche Omonene nabaeire Esabato. Ase rituko ria gatano na rimo nkobaa endagera y’amatuko abere. Ase ayio, ase rituko eri ria gatano na kabere mobeere kera omonto aase aye, onde tabaisa korua inka.”
swahili: Fahamuni kuwa Bwana amewapa ninyi Sabato, ndiyo sababu katika siku ya sita amewapa mikate ya siku mbili. Kila mmoja inampasa kukaa pale alipo katika siku ya saba. Hata mmoja haruhusiwi kutoka.”

english: “If only we had died by the LORD’s hand in the land of Egypt!” they said. “There we sat by pots of meat and ate our fill of bread, but you have brought us into this desert to starve this whole assembly to death!”
ekegusii: bakabateebia, “Nanga mbuya onye twakwerete ase amaboko a ’Omonene aaria ase ense ya Misiri. Agwo tware goikaransa ase chinyongo chie chinyama, tware koria endagera ende enyinge, twaigota. Korende bono mwatorentire aa ase erooro ase ogotoita intwe twensi nenchara.”
swahili: Waisraeli wakawaambia, “Laiti tungelikufa kwa mkono wa Bwana huko Misri! Huko tuliketi tukizunguka masufuria ya nyama na tukala vyakula tulivyovitaka, lakini ninyi mmetuleta huku jangwani ili mpate kuua mkutano huu wote kwa njaa.”

english: So the people rested on the seventh day. The Jar of Manna
ekegusii: Naboigo abanto bakaba bagotimoka ase rituko ria gatano na kabere.
swahili: Kwa hiyo watu wakapumzika siku ya saba.

english: Now the house of Israel called the bread manna. It was white like coriander seed and tasted like wafers made with honey.
ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakaroka endagera eyio mana; ero nigo yare buna chinyeke chi’amaemba enkomba, chindabu, na obwansu bwaye nigo bware buna omogati ore nobooke.
swahili: Watu wa Israeli wakaita ile mikate mana Ilikuwa myeupe kama mbegu za mtama na ladha yake ilikuwa kama mkate mwembamba uliotengenezwa kwa asali.

english: Moses said, “This is what the LORD has commanded: ‘Keep an omer of manna for the generations to come, so that they may see the bread I fed you in the wilderness when I brought you out of the land of Egypt.’”
ekegusii: Musa akabateebia, “Omonene otochikiire togache endagera eye inke ya Mana ase engencho ye chinderia chiaito, erinde banyare gocha korora endagera eye Omonene atoete torie ase erooro, ekero atorusetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri.”
swahili: Mose akasema, “Hivi ndivyo alivyoagiza Bwana: ‘Chukueni pishi ya mana na kuhifadhi kwa ajili ya vizazi vijavyo ili vione mikate niliyowapa mle jangwani nilipowatoa katika nchi ya Misri.’ ”

english: So Moses told Aaron, “Take a jar and fill it with an omer of manna. Then place it before the LORD to be preserved for the generations to come.”
ekegusii: Musa agateebia Aroni, “Imokia ekeguuru, obeke ebimunu bibere bia mana imeo, oyebeke ase obosio bw’Omonene egachwe ase engencho y’ebigori bigochi‐gocha.”
swahili: Kwa hiyo Mose akamwambia Aroni, “Chukua gudulia na uweke pishi moja ya mana ndani yake. Kisha uweke mbele za Bwana ili kihifadhiwe kwa ajili ya vizazi vijavyo.”

english: And Aaron placed it in front of the Testimony, to be preserved just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
ekegusii: Buna Omonene achigete Musa, naboigo Aroni ayebegete bosio bw’Esanduki ere ne chibao chiriikire oborori, ekagachwao.
swahili: Kama Bwana alivyomwagiza Mose, hatimaye Aroni alikuja kuihifadhi ndani ya Sanduku la Ushuhuda.

english: The Israelites ate manna forty years, until they came to a land where they could settle; they ate manna until they reached the border of Canaan.
ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakagenderera koria mana engaki y’emiaka emerongo ene, goika bagaika aase ense abanto bamenyete; ense yarenge orobebe rw’ense ya Kaanani.
swahili: Waisraeli wakala mana kwa miaka arobaini, mpaka walipofika katika nchi iliyokaliwa na watu; walikula mana hadi walipofika mpakani mwa Kanaani.

english: (Now an omer is a tenth of an ephah.)
ekegusii: (Ekerengo ki’ebimunu bibere ekio nensemo ya ikomi y’ekerengo gi’efa.)
swahili: (Pishi moja ni sehemu ya kumi ya kipimo cha efa. )

english: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Behold, I will rain down bread from heaven for you. Each day the people are to go out and gather enough for that day. In this way I will test whether or not they will follow My instructions.
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene agateebia Musa, “Rora, nimbatwerie endagera korwa igoro. Kera rituko abanto bagende isiko, basangererie eyekobaisana ase rituko erio. Ase enchera eyio inche mbateeme gose mbabwatie amachiiko aane.
swahili: Kisha Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Nitanyesha mikate kutoka mbinguni kwa ajili yenu. Watu watatoka kila siku na kukusanya kitakachowatosha kwa siku ile, kwa njia hii, nitawajaribu nione kama watafuata maelekezo yangu.

english: Then on the sixth day, when they prepare what they bring in, it will be twice as much as they gather on the other days.”
ekegusii: Korende rituko ria gatano na rimo goika basangererie na koroisia ara kabere buna bagosangereria amatuko ande.”
swahili: Siku ya sita watatayarisha kile waletacho ndani, nacho kitakuwa mara mbili kuliko ya kile walichokusanya kila siku.”

english: So Moses and Aaron said to all the Israelites, “This evening you will know that it was the LORD who brought you out of the land of Egypt,
ekegusii: Erio Musa na Aroni bagateebia Abaisraeli bonsi, “Mogoroba reero inwe nario moramanye ng’a Omonene nere obarusetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri,
swahili: Kwa hiyo Mose na Aroni wakawaambia Waisraeli wote, “Jioni mtajua kwamba Bwana ndiye aliwatoa Misri,

english: and in the morning you will see the LORD’s glory, because He has heard your grumbling against Him. For who are we that you should grumble against us?”
ekegusii: na mambia inamorore obonene bw’Omonene, ekiagera ere oigure buna mwamwemurunganeirie. Ee, mwamwemurunganeirie Omonene, tari intwe. Intwe inki toisaine moratuemurunganerie?”
swahili: kisha asubuhi mtauona utukufu wa Bwana, kwa sababu amesikia manungʼuniko yenu dhidi yake. Sisi ni nani hata mtunungʼunikie?”

english: And Moses added, “The LORD will give you meat to eat this evening and bread to fill you in the morning, for He has heard your grumbling against Him. Who are we? Your grumblings are not against us but against the LORD.”
ekegusii: Naende Musa agateeba, “inwe buna morore obonene bw’Omonene ekero arabae chinyama morie mogoroba, na mambia abae omogati morie, moigote ekiagera ere oigure buna mwamwemurunganeirie. Inki mokwemurunganeria ase tore? Intwe titoisaini gento. Tari intwe mwemurunganeirie, korende n’Omonene.”
swahili: Pia Mose akasema, “Mtajua kuwa alikuwa Bwana wakati atakapowapa nyama mle ifikapo jioni na mikate yote mtakayohitaji asubuhi kwa sababu amesikia manungʼuniko yenu dhidi yake. Sisi ni nani? Hamnungʼuniki dhidi yetu, bali dhidi ya Bwana.”

english: Then Moses said to Aaron, “Tell the whole congregation of Israel, ‘Come before the LORD, for He has heard your grumbling.’”
ekegusii: Musa agateebia Aroni, “Bateebie omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli basuke gocha ase obosio bw’Omonene, ekiagera oigure okwemurungania kwabo.”
swahili: Kisha Mose akamwambia Aroni, “Iambie jumuiya yote ya Waisraeli kwamba, ‘Mje mbele zake Bwana, kwa maana amesikia manungʼuniko yenu.’ ”

english: Then the whole congregation of Israel left the Desert of Sin, moving from place to place as the LORD commanded. They camped at Rephidim, but there was no water for the people to drink.
ekegusii: Omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli okaimoka korwa erooro ya Sinai. Barabwo bakabwatia orogendo rwabo, bakana‐gotoora buna Omonene abachiigete, Bagaika Refidimu, bagatoora aroro, korende mache tarengeo abanto baare konyara konywa.
swahili: Jumuiya yote ya Israeli ikaondoka kutoka Jangwa la Sini, ikisafiri kutoka sehemu moja hadi nyingine kama Bwana alivyoagiza. Wakapiga kambi huko Refidimu, lakini hapakuwa na maji ya watu kunywa.

english: Joshua did as Moses had instructed him and fought against the Amalekites, while Moses, Aaron, and Hur went up to the top of the hill.
ekegusii: Yoshua agakora buna Musa amotebetie, akarwania Abaameleki, na Musa, na Aroni, na Huri bagatiira gochia ekegoro igoro.
swahili: Kwa hiyo Yoshua akapigana na Waamaleki kama Mose alivyomwagiza, nao Mose, Aroni na Huri wakapanda juu ya kilima.

english: As long as Moses held up his hands, Israel prevailed; but when he lowered them, Amalek prevailed.
ekegusii: Ekaba Musa kaimokirie amaboko aye igoro, rirorio Abaisraeli babua, na kayairanirie inse, Abaameleki babua.
swahili: Ikawa wakati wote Mose alipokuwa amenyanyua mikono yake, Waisraeli walikuwa wakishinda, lakini kila aliposhusha mikono yake Waamaleki walishinda.

english: When Moses’ hands grew heavy, they took a stone and put it under him, and he sat on it. Then Aaron and Hur held his hands up, one on each side, so that his hands remained steady until the sun went down.
ekegusii: Ekero amaboko a Musa arosire, Aroni na Huri bakaimokia rigena, bakaritereka inse, na Musa akariikaransera. Erio bakaba bagosiira amaboko a Musa, oyomo okoboko gwo korio, na oyonde ogwokobee. Naboigo bakamosiira goika erioba rikagwa.
swahili: Mikono ya Mose ilipochoka, wakachukua jiwe na kumpa alikalie. Aroni na Huri wakaishikilia juu mikono ya Mose, mmoja upande huu na mwingine upande huu. Wakaitegemeza mikono yake ikabaki thabiti mpaka jua lilipozama.

english: So Joshua overwhelmed Amalek and his army with the sword.
ekegusii: Na igo Yoshua akabua Abaameleki kegima, akabaita nemioro.
swahili: Kwa hiyo Yoshua akalishinda jeshi la Waamaleki kwa upanga.

english: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Write this on a scroll as a reminder and recite it to Joshua, because I will utterly blot out the memory of Amalek from under heaven.”
ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa, “Yarike amang’ana aya ase egetabu, abe amang’ana ’okoinyorwa, oteebie Yoshua ng’a ninsirie Abaameleki erio bebwe kegima, tibaabaisa koinyorwa inse y’erioba.”
swahili: Kisha Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Andika mambo haya katika kitabu ili yakumbukwe, na uhakikishe kwamba Yoshua amesikia, kwa sababu nitafuta kabisa kumbukumbu la Amaleki chini ya mbingu.”

english: And Moses built an altar and named it The LORD Is My Banner.
ekegusii: Musa akaagacha egesasiimero agwo, agakeroka “Yahwe Nisi”, engencho yaye, “Omonene nebendera yane y’esegi”,
swahili: Mose akajenga madhabahu na kuiita Yehova Nisi.

english: “Indeed,” he said, “a hand was lifted up toward the throne of the LORD. The LORD will war against Amalek from generation to generation.”
ekegusii: agateeba, “Ninyimokie okoboko kwane igoro, kobe ekemanyererio ki’Omonene, na gotiana ng’a Omonene nigo aragenderere korwania Abaameleki ebiaare ase ebiaare.”
swahili: Mose akasema, “Kwa maana mikono iliinuliwa mpaka kwenye kiti cha enzi cha Bwana. Bwana atakuwa na vita dhidi ya Waamaleki kutoka kizazi hata kizazi.”

english: So the people contended with Moses, “Give us water to drink.” “Why do you contend with me?” Moses replied. “Why do you test the LORD?”
ekegusii: Erio abanto bakomania Musa, bagoteeba, “Toe amaache tonywe!” Musa akabateebia, “Nase ki mokonyomania? Nase ki mogoteema Omonene?.”
swahili: Kwa hiyo wakagombana na Mose wakisema, “Tupe maji ya kunywa.” Mose akajibu, “Mbona mnagombana nami? Kwa nini mnamjaribu Bwana?”

english: But the people thirsted for water there, and they grumbled against Moses: “Why have you brought us out of Egypt—to make us and our children and livestock die of thirst?”
ekegusii: Agwo bakaba nerang’o enene y’amaache, bakemurunganeria Musa, bakaboora, “Ninki gwatoruseria Misiri gocha aa, amo nabana baito ne chitugo chiaito, togokwa ase erang’o?”
swahili: Lakini watu walikuwa na kiu huko, wakanungʼunika dhidi ya Mose, wakisema, “Kwa nini ulitutoa kule Misri, ukatuleta hapa utuue kwa kiu sisi, watoto wetu na mifugo yetu?”

english: Then Moses cried out to the LORD, “What should I do with these people? A little more and they will stone me!”
ekegusii: Musa akarera ase Omonene, akabora, “Ninki ngokorera abanto aba? Barabwo nigo bare ang’e kong’aka amagena.”
swahili: Kisha Mose akamlilia Bwana, akasema, “Niwafanyie nini watu hawa? Sasa wanakaribia kunipiga kwa mawe.”

english: And the LORD said to Moses, “Walk on ahead of the people and take some of the elders of Israel with you. Take along in your hand the staff with which you struck the Nile, and go.
ekegusii: Omonene akairaneria Musa, “Oete bosio bwa abanto aba, oire abagaaka bande b’Abaisraeli, oire boigo nenyimbo yao, eria kwaagete orooche, motang’ane abanto mogende.
swahili: Bwana akamjibu Mose, “Pita mbele ya watu. Wachukue pamoja nawe baadhi ya wazee wa Israeli, ichukue mkononi mwako ile fimbo uliyopiga nayo Mto Naili, nawe uende.

english: Behold, I will stand there before you by the rock at Horeb. And when you strike the rock, water will come out of it for the people to drink.” So Moses did this in the sight of the elders of Israel.
ekegusii: Nondore inteneine agwo ase egetare kia Horebu, nkoganyete. Oake egetare, na amaache arwe aroro, erinde abanto banyore banywe.” Musa agakora bo ase amasio ’abagaaka b’Abaisraeli.
swahili: Huko nitasimama mbele yako karibu na mwamba wa Horebu. Uupige mwamba na maji yatatoka ndani yake kwa ajili ya watu kunywa.” Kwa hiyo Mose akafanya haya mbele ya wazee wa Israeli.
