english: He named the place Massah and Meribah because the Israelites quarreled, and because they tested the LORD, saying, “Is the LORD among us or not?” The Defeat of the Amalekites
ekegusii: Akaroka aase aria Masa na Meriba, ase engencho y’eriomana ri’Abaisraeli, naende ekiagera abanto bamoteemete Omonene, bakoboora, “Inee! Omonene nare aa ase egati yaito, gose taiyo?” Esegi n’Abaameleki
swahili: Naye akapaita mahali pale Masa, na Meriba kwa sababu Waisraeli waligombana na kumjaribu Bwana wakisema, “Je, Bwana yu pamoja nasi au la?” Vita Na Waamaleki

english: After this, the Amalekites came and attacked the Israelites at Rephidim.
ekegusii: Erio Abaameleki bakaoroka na korwania Abaisraeli aaria Refidimu.
swahili: Waamaleki wakaja na kuwashambulia Waisraeli huko Refidimu.

english: So Moses said to Joshua, “Choose some of our men and go out to fight the Amalekites. Tomorrow I will stand on the hilltop with the staff of God in my hand.”
ekegusii: Erio Musa agateebia Yoshua, “Tochorere abanto bagende korwana n’Abaameleki ankio; inche ninche ’ntenene ekegoro igoro, na enyimbo ya Nyasae in’yebwate koboko kwane.”
swahili: Mose akamwambia Yoshua, “Chagua baadhi ya watu wetu na uende kupigana na Waamaleki. Kesho nitasimama juu ya kilima nikiwa na fimbo ya Mungu mkononi mwangu.”

english: Now Moses’ father-in-law Jethro, the priest of Midian, heard about all that God had done for Moses and His people Israel, and how the LORD had brought Israel out of Egypt.
ekegusii: Jethiro, Omokuani o Midiani, ise biara Musa, akaigwa amang’ana onsi aya Nyasae akorerete Musa na Abaisraeli, abanto baye, na buna abang’anyetie korwa Misiri.
swahili: Basi Yethro, kuhani wa Midiani, baba mkwe wa Mose, akawa amesikia kila kitu Mungu alichomfanyia Mose na watu wake wa Israeli, pia jinsi Bwana alivyowatoa Israeli Misri.

english: Jethro declared, “Blessed be the LORD, who has delivered you from the hand of the Egyptians and of Pharaoh, and who has delivered the people from the hand of the Egyptians.
ekegusii: akabora, “Omonene atogigwe, oyo obatooretie abanto baye korwa ase amaboko ’Abamisiri, na korwa ase Farao.
swahili: Yethro akasema, “Sifa na ziwe kwa Bwana, aliyekuokoa wewe kutoka mikononi mwa Wamisri na Farao, na aliyewaokoa watu kutoka mikononi mwa Wamisri.

english: Now I know that the LORD is greater than all other gods, for He did this when they treated Israel with arrogance.”
ekegusii: Bono namanyire ng’a Omonene nomonene kobua chinyasae chinde chionsi, ekiagera atooririe abanto baye korwa ase Abamisiri abwo baabaenenerete.”
swahili: Sasa najua ya kuwa Bwana ni mkuu kuliko miungu mingine yote, kwa kuwa amewatendea hivi wale waliowatenda Israeli kwa ujeuri.”

english: Then Moses’ father-in-law Jethro brought a burnt offering and sacrifices to God, and Aaron came with all the elders of Israel to eat bread with Moses’ father-in-law in the presence of God. Jethro Advises Moses (Deuteronomy 1:9–18)
ekegusii: Erio Jethiro ise biara Musa akamoruera Nyasae ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa na ebing’wanso binde bi’okonyenywa. Aroni amo nabagaaka bonsi b’Abaisraeli bagacha bakaragera amo nere, ase obosio bwa Nyasae. Jethiro Ogosemia Musa igoro yokogamba Ebiina (Okoir 1:9-18)
swahili: Kisha Yethro, baba mkwe wa Mose, akaleta sadaka ya kuteketezwa na dhabihu nyingine kwa Mungu, naye Aroni pamoja na wazee wote wa Israeli wakaja kula chakula pamoja na baba mkwe wa Mose mbele za Mungu. Ushauri Wa Yethro (Kumbukumbu 1:9-18)

english: The next day Moses took his seat to judge the people, and they stood around him from morning until evening.
ekegusii: Rituko ria kabere Musa agaikaransa kogamba ebiina bi’abaanto; na abanto nigo barengeo bamoetanaine korwa mambia goika mogoroba.
swahili: Siku iliyofuata, Mose akachukua nafasi yake kama hakimu wa watu, nao wakasimama kumzunguka kuanzia asubuhi hadi jioni.

english: When his father-in-law saw all that Moses was doing for the people, he asked, “What is this that you are doing for the people? Why do you sit alone as judge, with all the people standing around you from morning till evening?”
ekegusii: Ekero ise biara Musa aroche onsi aya Musa are gokorera abanto, akamobooria. “Inki eke ogokorera abanto? Naki oikaransete aye bweka, na abanto bagoetanaine korwa mambia goika mogoroba?”
swahili: Baba mkwe wake alipoona yote Mose anayowafanyia watu, akasema, “Ni nini hiki unachowafanyia watu? Kwa nini wewe unakuwa mwamuzi wa watu hawa peke yako, wakati watu hawa wamesimama wakikuzunguka tangu asubuhi mpaka jioni?”

english: “Because the people come to me to inquire of God,” Moses replied.
ekegusii: Musa akamoiraneria ise biara, “Nekiagera abanto bagonchichera, bakorigia oboraai bwa Nyasae.
swahili: Mose akamjibu, “Kwa sababu watu wananijia kutaka mapenzi ya Mungu.

english: “Whenever they have a dispute, it is brought to me to judge between one man and another, and I make known to them the statutes and laws of God.”
ekegusii: Ekero bomanire nigo bagocha ase ’nde, na inche nabagambera ebiina biabo na kobamanyia emeroberio ya Nyasae na amachiiko aye.”
swahili: Kila wakiwa na shauri huletwa kwangu, nami huamua kati ya mtu na mwenzake na kuwajulisha juu ya amri na sheria za Mungu.”

english: But Moses’ father-in-law said to him, “What you are doing is not good.
ekegusii: Erio Jethiro agateebia Musa, “Enchera eye y’okobagambera ebiina biabo teri engiya.
swahili: Baba mkwe wa Mose akamjibu, “Unachofanya sio kizuri.

english: Surely you and these people with you will wear yourselves out, because the task is too heavy for you. You cannot handle it alone.
ekegusii: Nigo okorosigwa, aye amo nabaanto aba bonsi bare aa. Naki emeremo eye nemerito mono asore, tokonyara koyekora aye bweka.
swahili: Wewe pamoja na watu hawa wanaokujia mtajichosha bure. Kazi ni nzito sana kwako, huwezi kuibeba mwenyewe.

english: Now listen to me; I will give you some advice, and may God be with you. You must be the people’s representative before God and bring their causes to Him.
ekegusii: Bono ntegerera, ngoteebie chisemi chingiya orakore, na Nyasae nabe amo naye. Aye kabe oyo ogotenenera abanto ase obosio bwa Nyasae, na komoirera amang’ana abo.
swahili: Sasa nisikilize mimi, nitakupa shauri, naye Mungu na awe pamoja nawe. Yapasa wewe uwe mwakilishi wa watu mbele za Mungu na ulete mashauri yao kwake.

english: After Moses had sent back his wife Zipporah, his father-in-law Jethro had received her,
ekegusii: Jethiro akaretana Sipora moka Musa ekiagera Musa konya omoiranirie ase ise.
swahili: Baada ya Mose kumrudisha mkewe Sipora, Yethro baba mkwe wake alimpokea

english: Teach them the statutes and laws, and show them the way to live and the work they must do.
ekegusii: Goika oborokererie amachiiko na emeroberio, na obateebererie buna ebagwenerete babe na gokora.
swahili: Uwafundishe amri na sheria, tena uwaonyeshe namna ya kuishi na kazi zinazowapasa wao kufanya.

english: Furthermore, select capable men from among the people—God-fearing, trustworthy men who are averse to dishonest gain. Appoint them over the people as leaders of thousands, of hundreds, of fifties, and of tens.
ekegusii: Korende ochore abanto abamoirogete Nyasae, abegenwa, abatakorigia riaaki, abaranyare koba abaraai b’abaanto b’emeganda elifu, ne rigana, na emerongo etano, na ikomi.
swahili: Lakini uchague watu wenye uwezo miongoni mwa watu wote, watu wanaomwogopa Mungu, watu waaminifu wanaochukia mali ya dhuluma, uwateuwe wawe maafisa juu ya maelfu, mamia, hamsini na makumi.

english: Have these men judge the people at all times. Then they can bring you any major issue, but all minor cases they can judge on their own, so that your load may be lightened as they share it with you.
ekegusii: Otige barabwo babe bakogambera abanto ebiina bia botambe. Ebiina ebikong’u birobio bakobirentere, korende ebire ebike babigambe barabwo boka. Ase enchera eyio egurube yao tekoba endito mono, ekiagera barabwo mbayebogorie amo naye.
swahili: Waweke wawe waamuzi wa watu kwa wakati wote, lakini waambie wakuletee kila shauri lililo gumu; yale yaliyo rahisi wayaamue wao wenyewe. Hii itafanya mzigo wako kuwa mwepesi, kwa sababu watashirikiana nawe.

english: If you follow this advice and God so directs you, then you will be able to endure, and all these people can go home in peace.”
ekegusii: Korakore igo, buna Nyasae aragochiikere, aye nonyore chinguru chi’okogenderera, na abanto aba bonsi ’nabagende chinka chiabo bare nomorembe.”
swahili: Kama ukifanya hivi, na ikiwa Mungu ameagiza hivyo, utaweza kushinda uchovu, nao watu hawa wote watarudi nyumbani wameridhika.” Kuchaguliwa Kwa Waamuzi

english: Moses listened to his father-in-law and did everything he said.
ekegusii: Musa agancha amang’ana aya ise biara amosemetie.
swahili: Mose akamsikiliza baba mkwe wake na kufanya kila kitu alichosema.

english: So Moses chose capable men from all Israel and made them heads over the people as leaders of thousands, of hundreds, of fifties, and of tens.
ekegusii: Agachora abanto b’Abaisraeli abaranyare gokora emeremo eyio, akababeeka babe abaraai b’Abaisraeli, b’emeganda elifu, ne rigana, na emerongo etano, na ikomi.
swahili: Mose akawachagua watu wenye uwezo kutoka Israeli yote, akawafanya kuwa viongozi wa watu, maafisa juu ya maelfu, mamia, hamsini na makumi.

english: And they judged the people at all times; they would bring the difficult cases to Moses, but any minor issue they would judge themselves.
ekegusii: Barabwo bakaba bakogamba ebiina bi’abaanto botambe. Ebiina ebikong’u baba bakobirentera Musa, korende ebire ebike baba bakobigamba abanyene.
swahili: Wakatumika kama waamuzi wa watu kwa wakati wote. Mashauri magumu wakayaleta kwa Mose, lakini yale yaliyo rahisi wakayaamua wenyewe.

english: Then Moses sent his father-in-law on his way, and Jethro returned to his own land.
ekegusii: Erio Musa agakooba ise biara, akamotiga okogenda ase ense yaye.
swahili: Kisha Mose akaagana na Yethro baba mkwe wake, naye akarudi kwa nchi yake.

english: along with her two sons. One son was named Gershom, for Moses had said, “I have been a foreigner in a foreign land.”
ekegusii: Naboigo akarentana Gerisomu na Eliezeri, abana abamura babere ba Musa. (Musa nigo ateebete, “Nabeire omomenyi ase ense engeni”), na akaroka omwana oyomo Gerisomu.
swahili: pamoja na wanawe wawili. Jina la mmoja aliitwa Gershomu, kwa kuwa Mose alisema, “Nimekuwa mgeni katika nchi ya kigeni.”

english: The other son was named Eliezer, for Moses had said, “The God of my father was my helper and delivered me from the sword of Pharaoh.”
ekegusii: Boigo akaroka omwana oye okabere Eliezeri agateeba, “Nyasae o tata obeire omokonyi one, agantooria korwa ase ogoita gwa Farao”.
swahili: Mwingine aliitwa Eliezeri, kwa kuwa alisema, “Mungu wa baba yangu alikuwa msaada wangu, akaniokoa kutoka upanga wa Farao.”

english: Moses’ father-in-law Jethro, along with Moses’ wife and sons, came to him in the desert, where he was encamped at the mountain of God.
ekegusii: Nabo Jethiro, ise biara Musa, amo na moka Musa na abana baye babere, bagacha ase erooro aase Musa konya atoorire ase egetunwa kia Nyasae.
swahili: Yethro, baba mkwe wa Mose, pamoja na wana wawili wa Mose na mkewe, wakamjia Mose huko jangwani, mahali alipokuwa amepiga kambi karibu na mlima wa Mungu.

english: He sent word to Moses, “I, your father-in-law Jethro, am coming to you with your wife and her two sons.”
ekegusii: Konya otomire amang’ana ase Musa buna ngocha are aretane moka Musa nabana baye babere.
swahili: Yethro alikuwa ametuma ujumbe kwake Mose, kusema, “Mimi Yethro baba mkwe wako ninakuja kwako pamoja na mke wako na wanao wawili.”

english: So Moses went out to meet his father-in-law and bowed down and kissed him. They greeted each other and went into the tent.
ekegusii: Erio Musa agasoka komoorotota, agatung’ama na komonyunyunta. Ekero bakwananirie bagasoa ase eema.
swahili: Kwa hiyo Mose akatoka kumlaki baba mkwe wake, akainama na kumbusu. Wakasalimiana, kisha wakaingia hemani.

english: Then Moses recounted to his father-in-law all that the LORD had done to Pharaoh and the Egyptians for Israel’s sake, all the hardships they had encountered along the way, and how the LORD had delivered them.
ekegusii: Musa agateebia ise biara aya onsi Omonene akorerete Farao amo n’Abamisiri ase engencho y’Abaisraeli, na obokong’u bwonsi obwo banyorete inchera, naende buna Omonene abatooretie.
swahili: Mose akamwambia baba mkwe wake kuhusu kila kitu Bwana alichomfanyia Farao na Wamisri kwa ajili ya Israeli, na pia kuhusu shida zote walizokutana nazo njiani na jinsi Bwana alivyowaokoa.

english: And Jethro rejoiced over all the good things the LORD had done for Israel, whom He had rescued from the hand of the Egyptians.
ekegusii: Ekero Jethiro aigwete amaya onsi Nyasae akorerete Abaisraeli ase okobatooria korwa ase amaboko ’Abamisiri akagoka mono,
swahili: Yethro akafurahishwa sana kusikia juu ya mambo yote mazuri Bwana aliyowatendea Waisraeli kuwaokoa kutoka mkono wa Wamisri.

english: In the third month, on the same day of the month that the Israelites had left the land of Egypt, they came to the Wilderness of Sinai.
ekegusii: Rituko rie ritang’ani ri’omotienyi o gatato magega Abaisraeli kobarure ase ense ya Misiri, bagaika ase erooro ya Sinai.
swahili: Mnamo mwezi wa tatu baada ya Waisraeli kuondoka Misri, siku kama iyo hiyo, wakafika katika Jangwa la Sinai.

english: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Go to the people and consecrate them today and tomorrow. They must wash their clothes
ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa, “Genda ase abanto aba, obachene reero na ankio, naende obateebie basibie chianga chiabo,
swahili: Naye Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Nenda kwa watu ukawaweke wakfu leo na kesho. Waambie wafue nguo zao

english: and be prepared by the third day, for on the third day the LORD will come down on Mount Sinai in the sight of all the people.
ekegusii: bebeke ang’e goika mambia ende ekiagera ase rituko erio ria gatato, inche Omonene ning’ike ase egetunwa gia Sinai, agwo ase abanto bonsi barandore.
swahili: na wawe tayari siku ya tatu, kwa sababu siku hiyo, Bwana atashuka juu ya mlima Sinai machoni pa watu wote.

english: And you are to set up a boundary for the people around the mountain and tell them, ‘Be careful not to go up on the mountain or touch its base. Whoever touches the mountain shall surely be put to death.
ekegusii: Aye goika obekere abanto aba orobebe roetanane egetunwa eke, obateebie: Mwerende, timotiira ase egetunwa igoro, gose timokuna chinsinyo chiaye. Onde bwensi oragekune nigo araitwe akwe.
swahili: Weka mipaka kuzunguka mlima kwa ajili ya watu, uwaambie, ‘Mwe waangalifu, msije mkapanda mlimani au kuugusa. Yeyote atakayeugusa mlima hakika atauawa.

english: No hand shall touch him, but he shall surely be stoned or shot with arrows—whether man or beast, he must not live.’ Only when the ram’s horn sounds a long blast may they approach the mountain. ”
ekegusii: Okoboko kw’omonto onde tigokuna omonto orakore ayio, korende nigo araakwe amagena gose araswe nemegwe. Aya achikirwe ase Mwanyabaanto na ase ching’iti, korende ekero egetureeri kerabugigwe, erio nario abanto baratiire gocha ase egetunwa.”
swahili: Hakika atapigwa mawe au kupigwa mishale; mkono wa mtu hautamgusa. Akiwa mwanadamu au mnyama, hataruhusiwa kuishi.’ Ila tu wakati baragumu itakapopigwa kwa mfululizo, ndipo watu wote watakapopanda mlimani.”

english: When Moses came down from the mountain to the people, he consecrated them, and they washed their clothes.
ekegusii: Musa agatirimboka korwa ase egetunwa gochia ase abanto, akabachena, na barabwo bagasibia chianga chiabo.
swahili: Baada ya Mose kushuka kutoka mlimani akawaendea watu na kuwaweka wakfu, wakafua nguo zao.

english: “Be prepared for the third day,” he said to the people. “Do not draw near to a woman.” The LORD Visits Sinai
ekegusii: Musa akabateebia, “Mwebeke ang’e, na goika rituko ria gatato, timobaisa goika abakungu baino ang’e.”
swahili: Kisha akawaambia watu, “Jitayarisheni kwa ajili ya siku ya tatu. Mwanaume yeyote asimkaribie mwanamke.”

english: On the third day, when morning came, there was thunder and lightning. A thick cloud was upon the mountain, and a very loud blast of the ram’s horn went out, so that all the people in the camp trembled.
ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatato ekero kia mambia bikaba enkoba na okomesa, ne riire ririto rigaika ase egetunwa, na eriogi ri’egetureeri rikooga mono. Abanto bonsi ase egetwori bakaondoka na koiguswa.
swahili: Asubuhi ya siku ya tatu kulikuwa na ngurumo na radi pamoja na wingu nene juu ya mlima na mlio mkubwa sana wa tarumbeta. Kila mmoja aliyekuwa kambini akatetemeka.

english: Then Moses brought the people out of the camp to meet with God, and they stood at the foot of the mountain.
ekegusii: Erio Musa agatang’ana abanto korwa ase egetwori bachie koumerana na Nyasae. Barabwo bagatenena ase egetunwa mbarabare.
swahili: Kisha Mose akawaongoza watu kutoka kambini kukutana na Mungu, nao wakasimama chini ya mlima.

english: Mount Sinai was completely enveloped in smoke, because the LORD had descended on it in fire. And the smoke rose like the smoke of a furnace, and the whole mountain quaked violently.
ekegusii: Egetunwa gionsi gia Sinai kegatubwa nerioki, ekiagera Omonene aigete aroro ore ase omorero ime; na erioki rigachongororoka gochia igoro buna eri’eriko rinene ri’oboturi, na egetunwa ekegima gekanyegerigwa mono.
swahili: Mlima Sinai ulikuwa umefunikwa na moshi, kwa sababu Bwana alishuka juu yake katika moto. Moshi wa moto huo ulipanda juu kama moshi kutoka kwenye tanuru kubwa na mlima wote ukatetemeka kwa nguvu nyingi,

english: And as the sound of the ram’s horn grew louder and louder, Moses spoke and God answered him in the thunder.
ekegusii: Eriogi ri’egetureeri rikagenderera kwoga mono kobua. Musa agakwana, na Nyasae akamoiraneria nogoaka gw’enkoba.
swahili: nayo sauti ya tarumbeta ikawa kubwa zaidi na zaidi. Kisha Mose akazungumza na sauti ya Bwana ikamjibu.

english: After they had set out from Rephidim, they entered the Wilderness of Sinai, and Israel camped there in front of the mountain.
ekegusii: Bakamanora korwa Refidimu, bagaika ase erooro ya Sinai, bagatoora kororia egetunwa gia Sinai.
swahili: Baada ya kuondoka Refidimu, waliingia katika Jangwa la Sinai na Israeli wakapiga kambi pale jangwani mbele ya mlima.

english: The LORD descended to the top of Mount Sinai and called Moses to the summit. So Moses went up,
ekegusii: Omonene agaika ase egechuria ki’egetunwa gia Sinai, akarangeria Musa agende asare, na Musa agatiira gochiao.
swahili: Bwana akashuka juu ya Mlima Sinai na akamwita Mose apande juu mlimani. Kwa hiyo Mose akapanda juu,

english: and the LORD said to him, “Go down and warn the people not to break through to see the LORD, lest many of them perish.
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene agateebia Musa, “Tirimboka gochia inse ase abanto, obakuurere tibatamboka orobebe bache kondora. Baise gokora igo, abange babo mbakwe.
swahili: naye Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Shuka ukawaonye watu ili wasijipenyeze kutafuta kumwona Bwana na wengi wao wakafa.

english: Even the priests who approach the LORD must consecrate themselves, or the LORD will break out against them.”
ekegusii: Na abakuani barabwo kobagocha ase ’nde, inche Omonene, goika bechene, timbaisa kobaa egesusuro.”
swahili: Hata makuhani, watakaomkaribia Bwana ni lazima wajiweke wakfu, la sivyo Bwana atawaadhibu.”

english: But Moses said to the LORD, “The people cannot come up Mount Sinai, for You solemnly warned us, ‘Put a boundary around the mountain and set it apart as holy.’”
ekegusii: Musa agateebia Omonene, “Abanto aba tibakonyara gotiira gocha aa ase egetunwa gia Sinai, ekiagera aye omonyene ngwatokania, ogatoteebia: Beka orobebe roetanane egetunwa, na ogiatanane kebe egechenu.”
swahili: Mose akamwambia Bwana, “Watu hawawezi kupanda mlima Sinai kwa sababu wewe mwenyewe ulituonya ukisema, ‘Wekeni mipaka kuuzunguka mlima na kuutenga kama patakatifu.’ ”

english: And the LORD replied, “Go down and bring Aaron with you. But the priests and the people must not break through to come up to the LORD, or He will break out against them.”
ekegusii: Omonene akamoteebia, “Tirimboka gochia inse, orente Aroni, motiire nere gocha aa. Korende abakuani na abanto tibaabaisa gotamboka orobebe gocha aa ase ’nde, mbaise kobaa egesusuro.”
swahili: Bwana akajibu, “Shuka ukamlete Aroni pamoja nawe. Lakini makuhani pamoja na watu wasije wakalazimisha kuja kwa Bwana, nisije nikawaadhibu.”

english: So Moses went down to the people and spoke to them.
ekegusii: Erio Musa agatirimboka gochia ase abanto, akabateebia amang’ana ayio.
swahili: Basi Mose akashuka kwa watu na kuwaambia lile aliloambiwa.

english: Then Moses went up to God, and the LORD called to him from the mountain, “This is what you are to tell the house of Jacob and explain to the sons of Israel:
ekegusii: Musa agatiira gochia egetunwa igoro koumerana na Nyasae. Omonene akamorangeria agwo ase egetunwa, akamoteebia, “Amang’ana aya naro orateebie abanto b’egesaku kia Yakobo, baria Abaisraeli:
swahili: Kisha Mose akakwea kwenda kwa Mungu, naye Bwana akamwita kutoka kwenye ule mlima akasema, “Hivi ndivyo utakavyosema na nyumba ya Yakobo na utakachowaambia watu wa Israeli:

english: ‘You have seen for yourselves what I did to Egypt, and how I carried you on eagles’ wings and brought you to Myself.
ekegusii: Inwe mwarorire aya nakoreire Abamisiri, na buna nababogoretie inwe buna ekeongo ekobogoria amage aye ase chimbaaba chiaye, nabarentire aiga ase ’nde.
swahili: ‘Ninyi wenyewe mmeona nililofanya huko Misri, jinsi nilivyowabeba kwenye mbawa za tai na kuwaleta kwangu.

english: Now if you will indeed obey My voice and keep My covenant, you will be My treasured possession out of all the nations—for the whole earth is Mine.
ekegusii: Bono komoranyigwere na kobwata okobwatana kwane kw’ogotianania, rirorio inamobe abanto baane. Naki ense yonsi neyane, korende inwe inamobe abanto baane abachore kobua abanto b’ebisaku binde.
swahili: Sasa kama mkinitii kikamilifu na kutunza Agano langu, basi ninyi mtakuwa mali yangu ya thamani kubwa miongoni mwa mataifa yote. Ijapokuwa dunia yote ni mali yangu,

english: And unto Me you shall be a kingdom of priests and a holy nation.’ These are the words that you are to speak to the Israelites.”
ekegusii: Inwe inamobe oborwoti bwane, abanto bagonkorera buna abakuani, egesaku kiane egechenu. Amang’ana aya naro orateebie Abaisraeli.”
swahili: ninyi mtakuwa kwangu ufalme wa makuhani na taifa takatifu.’ Haya ndiyo maneno utakayosema kwa wana wa Israeli.”

english: So Moses went back and summoned the elders of the people and set before them all these words that the LORD had commanded him.
ekegusii: Erio Musa akagenda akarangeria abagaaka b’Abaisraeli amo, akabateebia amang’ana ayio onsi Omonene amochigeete.
swahili: Kwa hiyo Mose akarudi, akawaita wazee wa watu na kuwaambia maneno yote ambayo Bwana alikuwa amemwamuru ayaseme.

english: And all the people answered together, “We will do everything that the LORD has spoken.” So Moses brought their words back to the LORD.
ekegusii: Na abanto bonsi amo bakairaneria, bakaboora, “Ayio onsi Omonene atebiire, inatoyakore.” Musa nere akairera Omonene amang’ana abanto bairaneretie.
swahili: Watu wote wakajibu kwa pamoja, “Tutafanya kila kitu Bwana alichokisema.” Naye Mose akarudisha majibu yao kwa Bwana.

english: The LORD said to Moses, “Behold, I will come to you in a dense cloud, so that the people will hear when I speak with you, and they will always put their trust in you.” And Moses relayed to the LORD what the people had said.
ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa, “Ninchiche asore inde ase riire ririto ime, erio abanto aba baigwe kongokwana naye, na barabwo bakwegene botambe.” Erio Musa agateebia Omonene amang’ana abanto bairaneretie. Abanto bagochenwa
swahili: Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Nitakujia katika wingu zito, ili watu wanisikie nikinena nawe na kila mara waweke tumaini lao kwako.” Kisha Mose akamwambia Bwana yale ambayo watu walikuwa wamesema.

english: These are the names of the sons of Israel who went to Egypt with Jacob, each with his family:
ekegusii: Aya naro amarieta y’abamura ba Israeli abasoete Misiri amo na Yakobo ise, kera oyomo amo nabaanto b’enyomba yaye:
swahili: Haya ndiyo majina ya wana wa Israeli ambao walikwenda Misri na Yakobo, kila mmoja akiwa pamoja na jamaa yake:

english: Come, let us deal shrewdly with them, or they will increase even more; and if a war breaks out, they may join our enemies, fight against us, and leave the country. ”
ekegusii: goika torigie chisemi tobatenenie, tibagenderera komenteka, ekiagera toise gochaka esegi, barabwo nigo barabwatane nababisa baito batorwanie, erio bang’anye korwa ense yaito.”
swahili: Njooni, ni lazima tuwashughulikie kwa uangalifu, la sivyo watazidi kuwa wengi zaidi, na ikiwa patatokea vita, watajiunga na adui zetu kupigana dhidi yetu na kuondoka katika nchi hii.”

english: So the Egyptians appointed taskmasters over the Israelites to oppress them with forced labor. As a result, they built Pithom and Rameses as store cities for Pharaoh.
ekegusii: Ase ayio Abamisiri bakabeeka abateneneri abatindi igoro ase Abaisraeli barenge erio baabachande nemeremo emekong’u mono yobosomba. Agwo Abaisraeli bakaagachera Farao emechie y’okogaacha chinibo, nero Pitoni na Ramesesi.
swahili: Basi Wamisri wakaweka wasimamizi wa kuwasimamia na kuwatesa Waisraeli kwa kazi ngumu, nao wakajenga miji ya Pithomu na Ramesesi ya kuweka akiba ya Farao.

english: But the more they were oppressed, the more they multiplied and flourished; so the Egyptians came to dread the Israelites.
ekegusii: Korende buna Abamisiri bagendererete kobachanda mono, naboigo Abaisraeli bagendererete komenteka na gwesiarera, goika Abamisiri bakabairoka mono.
swahili: Lakini walivyozidi kuteswa ndivyo walivyozidi kuongezeka na kuenea katika nchi; Wamisri wakawaogopa Waisraeli,

english: They worked the Israelites ruthlessly
ekegusii: Erio Abamisiri bakaba abatindi ase Abaisraeli na kobabetereria gokora emeremo emekong’u
swahili: kwa hiyo wakawatumikisha kwa ukatili.

english: and made their lives bitter with hard labor in brick and mortar, and with all kinds of work in the fields. Every service they imposed was harsh.
ekegusii: bagakora obogima bwabo bokaba obokong’u ase okobakoria emeremo y’ogotiringa esike na koroisia amatabori, na emeremo ende ao ao ase emegondo. Ase emeremo ende yonsi Abaisraeli baare gokora nigo baare gokorigwa ase obotindi.
swahili: Wakafanya maisha ya Waisraeli kuwa machungu kwa kufanya kazi ngumu ya kutengeneza lami na kufyatua matofali, na kazi zote za mashambani; katika kazi zao zote ngumu, Wamisri waliwatumia Waisraeli kwa ukatili.

english: Then the king of Egypt said to the Hebrew midwives, whose names were Shiphrah and Puah,
ekegusii: Omorwoti o Misiri agachiika Sifura na Pua, abaiboria b’Abaiberania, akabateebia,
swahili: Mfalme wa Misri akawaambia wakunga wa Kimisri waliowazalisha wanawake wa Kiebrania, ambao majina yao ni Shifra na Pua,

english: “When you help the Hebrew women give birth, observe them on the birthstools. If the child is a son, kill him; but if it is a daughter, let her live.”
ekegusii: “Ekero mokorigereria abakungu b’Abaiberania kobakoibora, morigererie mwana ki oiborwa; onye nomoisia, momoite, korende karabe omoiseke, momotige abe moyo.”
swahili: “Mtakapowazalisha wanawake wa Kiebrania, chunguzeni wanapojifungua. Ikiwa ni mtoto wa kiume, muueni, lakini ikiwa ni msichana, mwacheni aishi.”

english: The midwives, however, feared God and did not do as the king of Egypt had instructed; they let the boys live.
ekegusii: Korende abaiboria baria nigo bamoirogete Nyasae, tibakorete buna omorwoti o Misiri abateebeetie, korende barabwo bagatiga abana abamura bakaba moyo.
swahili: Lakini hao wakunga walimcha Mungu na hawakufanya kile mfalme wa Misri alichowaambia kufanya, bali wakawaacha watoto wa kiume waishi.

english: So the king of Egypt summoned the midwives and asked them, “Why have you done this? Why have you let the boys live?”
ekegusii: Erio Omorwoti o Misiri akarangeria abaiboria baria, akababoria, “Nase ki mwakorire iga Mwatigire abana abaisia bakoiborwa bare moyo.”?
swahili: Ndipo mfalme wa Misri akawaita hao wakunga, akawauliza, “Kwa nini mmefanya hivi? Mbona mmeacha watoto wa kiume waishi?”

english: The midwives answered Pharaoh, “The Hebrew women are not like the Egyptian women, for they are vigorous and give birth before a midwife arrives.”
ekegusii: Abaiboria baria bakairaneria Farao, “Abakungu b’Abaiberania tibari buna aba Abamisiri; barabwo nabaango ase okoibora, nigo bakoibora ritang’ani omoiboria ataraika.”
swahili: Wakunga wakamjibu Farao, “Wanawake wa Kiebrania ni tofauti na wanawake wa Kimisri; wao wana nguvu, nao hujifungua watoto kabla wakunga hawajafika.”

english: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah;
ekegusii: Rubeni, Simioni, Lawi na Yuda;
swahili: Reubeni, Simeoni, Lawi na Yuda;

english: So God was good to the midwives, and the people multiplied and became even more numerous.
ekegusii: Nyasae agakorera abaiboria baria amaya, na Abaisraeli bakagenderera komenteka na koba ne chinguru mono.
swahili: Kwa hiyo Mungu akawatendea mema wakunga hao. Waisraeli wakaongezeka na kuendelea kuwa wengi zaidi.

english: And because the midwives feared God, He gave them families of their own.
ekegusii: Na ekiagera abakungu baria abaiboria bamoirogete Nyasae, ere akabasesenia, na barabwo bakenyorera chinyomba chiabo.
swahili: Kwa vile hao wakunga walimcha Mungu, Mungu akawajalia kuwa na jamaa zao wenyewe.

english: Then Pharaoh commanded all his people: “Every son born to the Hebrews you must throw into the Nile, but every daughter you may allow to live.”
ekegusii: Erio Farao agachiika abanto baye bonsi, akabateebia, “Kera omwana omoisia oraiborwe ase Abaiberania, momotugute ase orooche rwa Naeli, korende kera omwana omoiseke momotige abe moyo.”
swahili: Kisha Farao akatoa agizo hili kwa watu wake wote: “Kila mtoto wa kiume atakayezaliwa kwa Waebrania lazima atupwe katika Mto Naili, bali kila mtoto wa kike aachwe aishi.”

english: Issachar, Zebulun, and Benjamin;
ekegusii: Isakaru na Sabuloni, na Benjamini;
swahili: Isakari, Zabuloni na Benyamini;

english: Dan and Naphtali; Gad and Asher.
ekegusii: Dani na Nafutali, Gadi na Aseri.
swahili: Dani na Naftali, Gadi na Asheri.

english: The descendants of Jacob numbered seventy in all, including Joseph, who was already in Egypt.
ekegusii: Abanto bonsi abaiboire korwa ase Yakobo nigo barenge emerongo etano na ebere. Yusufu momura o Yakobo ere konya nao amenyete Misiri korwa kare.
swahili: Wazao wote wa Yakobo walikuwa watu sabini; Yosefu alikuwa tayari yuko Misri.

english: Now Joseph and all his brothers and all that generation died,
ekegusii: Korende Yusufu, na bamura bamwabo bonsi, na abanto bonsi b’ekegori keria bagakwera Misiri.
swahili: Basi Yosefu na kaka zake wote na kizazi kile chote walikufa,

english: but the Israelites were fruitful and increased rapidly; they multiplied and became exceedingly numerous, so that the land was filled with them. Oppression by a New King (Acts 7:15–19)
ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakaba abegenwa ase Nyasae erio bagasarara na komenteka, bagatwara chinguru chinene, bakaba abange na obonge bwabo bokabucha kegima ase ense eria.
swahili: lakini Waisraeli walikuwa wamezaana na kuongezeka sana, idadi yao ikawa kubwa mno, kwa hiyo wakaijaza nchi.

english: Then a new king, who did not know Joseph, came to power in Egypt.
ekegusii: Erio Omorwoti omoyia, oyotamomanyete Yusufu, akaira obogambi bw’ense ya Misiri.
swahili: Kisha mfalme mpya ambaye hakufahamu habari za Yosefu akatawala Misri.

english: “Look,” he said to his people, “the Israelites have become too numerous and too powerful for us.
ekegusii: Ere agateebia abanto baye, “Rigereria, Abaisraeli aba babeire abange gotobua, naende babeire ne chinguru gotobua,
swahili: Akawaambia watu wake, “Tazameni, Waisraeli wamekuwa wengi mno kwa idadi kutuliko sisi.

english: And God spoke all these words:
ekegusii: Nyasae agakwana amang’ana aya onsi, agateeba,
swahili: Ndipo Mungu akasema maneno haya yote:

english: but the seventh day is a Sabbath to the LORD your God, on which you must not do any work—neither you, nor your son or daughter, nor your manservant or maidservant or livestock, nor the foreigner within your gates.
ekegusii: korende rituko ria gatano na kabere nerituko ri’Esabato, riatananetwe na Nyasae oo. Ase rituko erio tokora emeremo ende yonsi, aye, gose omwana oo, omomura gose omoiseke, nonya nomosomba oo, omomura gose omoiseke, gose chitugo chiao, gose omomenyi ore ase omochie oo.
swahili: lakini siku ya saba ni Sabato kwa Bwana Mungu wako. Siku hiyo hutafanya kazi yoyote, wewe, wala mwanao au binti yako, wala mtumishi wako wa kiume au wa kike, wala wanyama wako, wala mgeni aliye ndani ya malango yako.

english: For in six days the LORD made the heavens and the earth and the sea and all that is in them, but on the seventh day He rested. Therefore the LORD blessed the Sabbath day and set it apart as holy.
ekegusii: Naki ase amatuko atano na rimo nar’Omonene atongete igoro na ense, ne chinyancha, na bionsi ebire imeo; agatimoka ase rituko ria gatano na kabere. Ase ayio Omonene agasesenia rituko ri’Esabato, akariatanana ribe richenu.
swahili: Kwa kuwa kwa siku sita, Bwana aliumba mbingu na nchi, bahari na vyote vilivyomo, lakini akapumzika siku ya saba. Kwa hiyo Bwana akaibariki siku ya Sabato na kuifanya takatifu.

english: Honor your father and mother, so that your days may be long in the land that the LORD your God is giving you.
ekegusii: “Sika iso na nyoko, nario oramenye amatuko amange ase ense eye Omonene, are ang’e gokoa.
swahili: Waheshimu baba yako na mama yako, ili upate kuishi siku nyingi katika nchi anayokupa Bwana Mungu wako.

english: You shall not bear false witness against your neighbor.
ekegusii: “Tomotebera omogisangio oo oborimo.
swahili: Usimshuhudie jirani yako uongo.

english: You shall not covet your neighbor’s house. You shall not covet your neighbor’s wife, or his manservant or maidservant, or his ox or donkey, or anything that belongs to your neighbor.” Moses Comforts the People (Deuteronomy 5:22–33; Hebrews 12:18–29)
ekegusii: “Tobaisa kogania enyomba y’omoamate oo. Tobaisa kogania omokungu bw’omoamate oo, nonya nomosomba oye, omomura gose omoiseke, gose eng’ombe yaye, gose etigere yaye, gose kende gionsi omoamate oo abwate.” Abanto bakoondoka (Okoir 5:22-23)
swahili: Usiitamani nyumba ya jirani yako. Usimtamani mke wa jirani yako, wala mtumishi wake wa kiume au wa kike, wala ngʼombe wake au punda wake, wala chochote kile alicho nacho jirani yako.” Watu Wanaogopa (Kumbukumbu 5:22-33)

english: When all the people witnessed the thunder and lightning, the sounding of the ram’s horn, and the mountain enveloped in smoke, they trembled and stood at a distance.
ekegusii: Ekero abanto bonsi barooche okomesa, na koigwa enkoba na eriogi ri’egetureeri na korora egetunwa gekoimoka erioki, bakaiguswa, bagatenenera aare.
swahili: Watu walipoona ngurumo na radi, na kusikia mlio wa tarumbeta, na kuuona mlima katika moshi, walitetemeka kwa woga. Wakasimama mbali

english: “Speak to us yourself and we will listen,” they said to Moses. “But do not let God speak to us, or we will die.”
ekegusii: Barabwo bagateebia Musa, “Kwana naintwe aye omonyene, na intwe inatogotegerere, korende Nyasae takwana naitwe ekiagera ogokwana naintwe, nigo torakwe.”
swahili: na wakamwambia Mose, “Sema nasi wewe mwenyewe, nasi tutakusikiliza. Lakini usimwache Mungu aseme nasi, la sivyo tutakufa.”

english: “I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.
ekegusii: “Inche ninche Nyasae Omonene, oyokorusetie ase ense ya Misiri, ase ense y’obosomba.
swahili: “Mimi ndimi Bwana Mungu wako, niliyekutoa Misri, kutoka nchi ya utumwa.

english: “Do not be afraid,” Moses replied. “For God has come to test you, so that the fear of Him may be before you, to keep you from sinning.”
ekegusii: Musa akabairaneria, “Timoondoka! Naki Nyasae nigo achire kobateema inwe, erio egere mogenderere komoiroka, erinde timokora ebibe.”
swahili: Mose akawaambia watu, “Msiogope! Mungu amekuja kuwajaribu, ili kwamba hofu ya Mungu iwakalie, msitende dhambi.”

english: And the people stood at a distance as Moses approached the thick darkness where God was. Idolatry Forbidden (1 Corinthians 10:14–22)
ekegusii: Abanto bonsi bagatenena aare, korende Musa ere akagenda ang’e ase riire riria rimwamu, ase Nyasae arenge. Amachiiko igoro y’ebisasimero
swahili: Watu wakabaki mbali, wakati Mose alipolisogelea lile giza nene mahali pale Mungu alipokuwa. Sanamu Na Madhabahu

english: Then the LORD said to Moses, “This is what you are to tell the Israelites: ‘You have seen for yourselves that I have spoken to you from heaven.
ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa, “Amang’ana aya naro orateebie Abaisraeli: Inwe abanyene mwarorire ng’a nigo nakwanire nainwe korwa igoro.
swahili: Kisha Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Waambie Waisraeli hivi: ‘Mmejionea wenyewe kwamba nimesema nanyi kutoka mbinguni:

english: You are not to make any gods alongside Me; you are not to make for yourselves gods of silver or gold.
ekegusii: Timwekorera chinyasae chinde chi’echifeta gose echie chitaabu chi’ogosasimwa; monsasime inche bweka.
swahili: Msijifanyizie miungu yoyote na kuilinganisha nami, msijitengenezee miungu ya fedha wala miungu ya dhahabu.

english: You are to make for Me an altar of earth, and sacrifice on it your burnt offerings and peace offerings, your sheep and goats and cattle. In every place where I cause My name to be remembered, I will come to you and bless you.
ekegusii: Ong’agachere egesasiimero ki’amaroba, onduere ebing’wanso igoro yaye, ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa, na ebi’omorembe, korwa ase ching’ondi chiao, ne chiombe chiao. Kera aase ndatebe onsasimere, ninchiche asore, ngosesenie.
swahili: “ ‘Utanitengenezea madhabahu ya udongo, na juu yake utoe sadaka za kuteketezwa kwa moto na sadaka za amani, kondoo zako, mbuzi na ngʼombe zako. Popote nitakapofanya Jina langu liheshimiwe, nitakuja kwenu na kuwabariki.

english: Now if you make an altar of stones for Me, you must not build it with stones shaped by tools; for if you use a chisel on it, you will defile it.
ekegusii: Onye gokong’agachera egesasiimero ki’amagena, tokeagacha namagena abaachire; ekiagera onye gokoyabaacha nebikorero biao, rirorio kwayabekire riko.
swahili: Ikiwa unanitengenezea madhabahu ya mawe, usiijenge kwa mawe ya kuchonga, maana mkitumia chombo cha kuchongea mtaitia unajisi.

english: And you must not go up to My altar on steps, lest your nakedness be exposed on it.’
ekegusii: Naende totiirera ebiriinero igoro, gokogenda ase egesasiimero, egetirianda kiao tikebaisa kooroka.”
swahili: Msitumie ngazi kupandia kwenye madhabahu yangu, uchi wako usije ukadhihirika kwa chini.’

english: You shall not make for yourself an idol in the form of anything in the heavens above, on the earth below, or in the waters beneath.
ekegusii: “Tobaisa gwekorera omogwekano bw’ogosasimwa, omogwekano o getongwa kende gionsi kere igoro, gose kere ense, gose kere ime ase amaache inse y’ense.
swahili: Usijitengenezee sanamu katika umbo la kitu chochote kilicho juu mbinguni, au duniani chini, au ndani ya maji.

english: You shall not bow down to them or worship them; for I, the LORD your God, am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on their children to the third and fourth generations of those who hate Me,
ekegusii: Tobaisa gotugama gose gosasiima emegwekano ekorire, ekiagera inche ninche Nyasae Omonene, Nyasae bwe risemi. Ase engencho y’amabe yabaibori nigo nkoa abana egesusuro goika ekiaare kia gatato na egia kane, abwo bangechete.
swahili: Usivisujudie wala kuviabudu; kwa kuwa Mimi, Bwana Mungu wako, ni Mungu mwenye wivu, ninayewaadhibu watoto kwa ajili ya dhambi za baba zao hadi kizazi cha tatu na cha nne cha wanichukiao,

english: but showing loving devotion to a thousand generations of those who love Me and keep My commandments.
ekegusii: Korende nigo nkoborokia obwanchani bwane botari koera goika ebiaare chilifu, ase abwo banyanchete na babwatete amachiiko aane.
swahili: lakini ninaonyesha upendo kwa maelfu ya vizazi vya wale wanipendao na kuzishika amri zangu.

english: You shall not take the name of the LORD your God in vain, for the LORD will not leave anyone unpunished who takes His name in vain.
ekegusii: “Toriatora bosa na korikorera bobe erieta ria Nyasae Omonene, ekiagera Omonene tagotiga komoa egesusuro omonto oria okoriatora bosa na korikorera bobe erieta riaye.
swahili: Usilitaje bure jina la Bwana Mungu wako, kwa kuwa Bwana hataacha kumhesabia hatia yeye alitajaye jina lake bure.

english: Remember the Sabbath day by keeping it holy.
ekegusii: “Riinyore na korisika rituko ri’Esabato, orirende ribe richenu.
swahili: Ikumbuke siku ya Sabato, uitakase.

english: Six days you shall labor and do all your work,
ekegusii: Amatuko atano na rimo okore emeremo yao yonsi,
swahili: Kwa siku sita utafanya kazi na kutenda shughuli zako zote,

english: “These are the ordinances that you are to set before them:
ekegusii: “Aya naro amachiiko orae Abaisraeli.”
swahili: “Hizi ndizo sheria utakazoweka mbele ya Waisraeli:

english: If he takes another wife, he must not reduce the food, clothing, or marital rights of his first wife.
ekegusii: Onye omonto oyio okonyuoma omokungu o kabere, takorina oria omotang’ani endagera yaye, ne chianga chiaye na kende gionsi aganetie buna mokaye.
swahili: Ikiwa huyo mwana aliyeozwa mtumwa mwanamke ataoa mwanamke mwingine, ni lazima aendelee kumtosheleza huyo mke wa kwanza kwa chakula, mavazi na haki zote za ndoa.

english: If, however, he does not provide her with these three things, she is free to go without monetary payment. Personal Injury Laws
ekegusii: Atamokorereti amang’ana aya atato, goika aegwe ribaga arue bwoye ataakaneiri embooria.” Amachiiko ase abaiti
swahili: Iwapo hatamtosheleza kwa mambo hayo matatu, huyo mke wa kwanza ataondoka na kuwa huru bila malipo yoyote ya fedha. Majeraha Ya Mwilini

english: Whoever strikes and kills a man must surely be put to death.
ekegusii: “Monto onde bwensi oraake omonto na amoite akwe, nere goika aitwe akwe.
swahili: “Yeyote ampigaye mtu na kumuua ni lazima auawe hakika.

english: If, however, he did not lie in wait, but God allowed it to happen, then I will appoint for you a place where he may flee.
ekegusii: Korende onye tamong’erete otatiga Nyasae omobegete ase amaboko aye, erio ninkworokie aase omoiti oria aratamere.
swahili: Hata hivyo, kama hakumuua kwa makusudi, lakini Mungu akaruhusu itendeke, basi atakimbilia mahali nitakapomchagulia.

english: But if a man schemes and acts willfully against his neighbor to kill him, you must take him away from My altar to be put to death.
ekegusii: Korende omonto ogoita oyomwabo mweno ase obong’ainereria, ere goika aitwe akwe, naisa gotamera egesasiimero kiane.
swahili: Lakini kama mtu akipanga na kumuua mwingine kwa makusudi, mwondoe katika madhabahu yangu na kumuua.

english: Whoever strikes his father or mother must surely be put to death.
ekegusii: “Onde bwensi oraake ise gose ng’ina, nere goika aitwe akwe.
swahili: “Yeyote amshambuliaye baba yake au mama yake ni lazima auawe.

english: Whoever kidnaps another man must be put to death, whether he sells him or the man is found in his possession.
ekegusii: “Onde bwensi oraibe omonto goika aitwe akwe, karabe omoonirie gose omobwate ase amaboko aye.
swahili: “Yeyote amtekaye nyara mwingine akamuuza au akamweka kwake, akikamatwa ni lazima auawe.

english: Anyone who curses his father or mother must surely be put to death.
ekegusii: “Onde bwensi oraragererie ise gose ng’ina, nere goika aitwe akwe.” Amachiiko ase abwo bagoaka abande
swahili: “Yeyote atakayemlaani baba yake au mama yake ni lazima auawe.

english: If men are quarreling and one strikes the other with a stone or a fist, and he does not die but is confined to bed,
ekegusii: “Abanto babere kobarabe bakorwana, na oyomo aake oyonde rigena, gose enkundi, amoate chingoma, echio chiramokore omorwaire goika araare borere,
swahili: “Kama watu wakigombana na mmoja akimpiga mwingine kwa jiwe au kwa ngumi yake na hakufa bali akaugua na kulala kitandani,

english: then the one who struck him shall go unpunished, as long as the other can get up and walk around outside with his staff. Nevertheless, he must compensate the man for his lost work and see that he is completely healed.
ekegusii: karabe otimokire, naende asoke isiko gotaara ogwesiirera enyimbo, rirorio oria omoagete nigo aratigwe, otatiga amoakane ase engencho y’eng’eria eria asiririe ekero arwarete, na ere amorende goika agwene kegima.
swahili: yule aliyempiga ngumi hatahesabiwa kuwa na hatia kama mwenzake ataamka na kujikongoja kwa fimbo yake, lakini hata hivyo, ni lazima amlipe fidia ya muda wake aliopoteza na awajibike mpaka apone kabisa.

english: If you buy a Hebrew servant, he is to serve you for six years. But in the seventh year, he shall go free without paying anything.
ekegusii: Koragore omosomba Omoiberania, nigo aragokorere ase engaki y’emiaka etano nomo, korende omwaka o gatano na kabere mosibore agende ko tomoakana kende.
swahili: “Kama ukimnunua mtumwa wa Kiebrania, atakutumikia kwa miaka sita. Lakini katika mwaka wa saba, atakuwa huru naye atakwenda zake pasipo kulipa chochote.

english: If a man strikes his manservant or maidservant with a rod, and the servant dies by his hand, he shall surely be punished.
ekegusii: “Omonto karaake omosomba oye, omomura gose omoiseke, nenyimbo, erinde akwere ase amaboko aye, goika aegwe egesusuro.
swahili: “Kama mtu akimpiga mtumwa wake wa kiume au wa kike kwa fimbo na mtumwa huyo akafa papo hapo, ni lazima aadhibiwe

english: However, if the servant gets up after a day or two, the owner shall not be punished, since the servant is his property.
ekegusii: Korende omosomba oyio karagenderere koba moyo rituko erimo gose abere, omonto oyio takoegwa egesusuro, ekiagera omosomba oyio nenibo yaye.
swahili: lakini ikiwa mtumwa ataamka baada ya siku moja au mbili, hataadhibiwa, kwa sababu yule mtumwa ni mali yake.

english: If men who are fighting strike a pregnant woman and her child is born prematurely, but there is no further injury, he shall surely be fined as the woman’s husband demands and as the court allows.
ekegusii: “Abanto abasacha kobarabe bakorwana, na kogwera omokungu ore morito, na oborito bwaye bogwe, korende atabeti na bobe bonde, omonto oria omogwerete goika aakane buna omosacha bw’omokuungu oria araborie magega abagaambi kobanachire ekiina.
swahili: “Ikiwa watu wawili wanapigana na wakamuumiza mwanamke mjamzito, naye akazaa kabla ya wakati lakini hakuna majeraha makubwa, mhalifu atatozwa mali kiasi cha madai ya mume wa yule mwanamke, na jinsi mahakama itakavyoamua.

english: But if a serious injury results, then you must require a life for a life—
ekegusii: Korende omokungu oria karakwe, rirorio egesusuro kebe obogima ase obogima,
swahili: Lakini kukiwa na jeraha kubwa, ni lazima ulipe uhai kwa uhai,

english: eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot,
ekegusii: eriso ase eriso, na erino ase erino, okoboko ase okoboko, na okogoro ase okogoro,
swahili: jicho kwa jicho, jino kwa jino, mkono kwa mkono, mguu kwa mguu,

english: burn for burn, wound for wound, and stripe for stripe.
ekegusii: ogosambwa ase ogosambwa, na eriote ase eriote, naende ogosionorwa ase ogosionorwa.
swahili: kuchomwa moto kwa kuchomwa moto, jeraha kwa jeraha, mchubuko kwa mchubuko.

english: If a man strikes and blinds the eye of his manservant or maidservant, he must let the servant go free as compensation for the eye.
ekegusii: “Omonto karaake omosomba oye, omomura gose omoiseke, na komwata eriso, rirorio goika amotige abe omosibore ase engencho y’eriso riaye.
swahili: “Ikiwa mtu atampiga mtumwa mwanaume au mwanamke kwenye jicho na kuliharibu, ni lazima amwache huru yule mtumwa kama fidia ya hilo jicho.

english: And if he knocks out the tooth of his manservant or maidservant, he must let the servant go free as compensation for the tooth.
ekegusii: Naende Karamoake omosomba oye omomura gose omoiseke amogookore erino, goika amotige abe omosibore ase engencho y’erino riaye.” Amachiiko ase abanyene chitugo
swahili: Kama akimvunja jino mtumwa wa kiume au wa kike, ni lazima amwache huru huyo mtumwa kwa kufidia hilo jino.

english: If an ox gores a man or woman to death, the ox must surely be stoned, and its meat must not be eaten. But the owner of the ox shall not be held responsible.
ekegusii: “Eeri eise goita omonto, omosacha gose omokungu, ne ching’unchara chiaye, goika eakwe amagena ekwe, ne chinyama chiaye tichiriegwa; korende omonyene eng’ombe eyio taegwa egesusuro.
swahili: “Kama fahali akimuua mwanaume au mwanamke kwa kumpiga kwa pembe, fahali huyo ni lazima auawe kwa kupigwa mawe, na nyama yake haitaliwa. Lakini mwenye fahali huyo hatawajibika.

english: But if the ox has a habit of goring, and its owner has been warned yet does not restrain it, and it kills a man or woman, then the ox must be stoned and its owner must also be put to death.
ekegusii: Korende eeri eyio, onye enarete goita abanto, na omonyene eeri eyio okuureirwe, na ere tayesibeti, ero keraite omonto, omosacha gose omokungu, nigo eraakwe amagena ekwe, na omonyene nere aitwe akwe.
swahili: Lakini hata hivyo, ikiwa huyo fahali amekuwa na tabia ya kupiga kwa pembe, na mwenyewe ameonywa na hakutaka kumfungia naye akamuua mwanaume au mwanamke, huyo fahali ni lazima auawe kwa mawe na mwenye fahali pia auawe.

english: If he arrived alone, he is to leave alone; if he arrived with a wife, she is to leave with him.
ekegusii: Onye ochete bwoo tarenge na mokungu, rirorio nabo aragende bweka, korende onye orenge nomokuungu, omokungu oye nigo aragende amo nere.
swahili: Kama akija peke yake, atakwenda huru peke yake, lakini kama akija na mke, ataondoka pamoja naye.

english: If payment is demanded of him instead, he may redeem his life by paying the full amount demanded of him.
ekegusii: Onye embooria ekoborigwa korwa asare, goika arue chionsi echi chiraganigwe, chibe embooria ase obogima bwaye.
swahili: Lakini ikiwa malipo yatatakiwa kwake, basi anaweza kulipa kinachodaiwa ili kuukomboa uhai wake.

english: If the ox gores a son or a daughter, it shall be done to him according to the same rule.
ekegusii: Onye eng’ombe egoita omomura gose omoiseke ne ching’unchara chiaye, ogochika nakwo okwo okomo.
swahili: Sheria hii pia itatumika ikiwa fahali atampiga kwa pembe mwana au binti.

english: If the ox gores a manservant or maidservant, the owner must pay thirty shekels of silver to the master of that servant, and the ox must be stoned.
ekegusii: Onye eeri egoita omosomba, omomura gose omoiseke, omonyene eng’ombe nigo araakane omonyene omosomba oria chisekeli chi’echifeta emerongo etato, na eeri eria eitwe ase ogoakwa amagena.
swahili: Ikiwa fahali atampiga mtumwa wa kike au wa kiume, mwenye fahali atalipa shekeli thelathini za fedha kwa bwana mwenye mtumwa, na fahali ni lazima auawe kwa mawe.

english: If a man opens or digs a pit and fails to cover it, and an ox or a donkey falls into it,
ekegusii: “Omonto karatige engoro yasie, gose onye okunyire engoro na tayekuneka, na eng’ombe gose etigere egwe imeo,
swahili: “Kama mtu akiacha shimo wazi, ama akachimba shimo kisha asilifukie, na ngʼombe au punda akatumbukia ndani yake,

english: the owner of the pit shall make restitution; he must pay its owner, and the dead animal will be his.
ekegusii: rirorio omonyene engoro goika aakane omonyene etugo chitaabu. Erio eng’iti eria y akuure ebe eyaye.
swahili: mwenye shimo ni lazima alipe hasara iliyotokea; ni lazima amlipe mwenye mnyama. Mnyama aliyekufa atakuwa wake.

english: If a man’s ox injures his neighbor’s ox and it dies, they must sell the live one and divide the proceeds; they also must divide the dead animal.
ekegusii: Eeri y’omonto keraite ey’omonto onde ekwe, erio barabwo baoonie eeri eyio ere moyo, baatanane chitaabu echio, baatanane ne chinyama chi’eng’ombe eria y akuure boigo.
swahili: “Kama fahali wa mtu fulani atamuumiza fahali wa mtu mwingine na akafa, watamuuza yule aliye hai na wagawane sawa fedha pamoja na mnyama aliyekufa.

english: But if it was known that the ox had a habit of goring, yet its owner failed to restrain it, he shall pay full compensation, ox for ox, and the dead animal will be his.
ekegusii: Korende onye emanyekanete ng’a eeri eria nigo enarete goita abanto, na omonyene tayesibeti, goika aakane omonyene eeri eria y akuure ase okomoa eeri eria ere moyo; na eria y akuure ebe eyaye.”
swahili: Hata hivyo, kama ikifahamika kwamba fahali huyo alikuwa na tabia ya kupiga kwa pembe na mwenyewe hakumfunga, ni lazima mwenye fahali alipe mnyama kwa mnyama, na mnyama aliyekufa atakuwa wake.

english: If his master gives him a wife and she bears him sons or daughters, the woman and her children shall belong to her master, and only the man shall go free.
ekegusii: Onye omonene oye omonyuomeretie omokungu, na ere omoiboreire abana, abamura gose abaiseke, omokungu oria na abana baye nigo barabe enibo y’omonene oye; omosacha oria nigo ararueo ere bweka,
swahili: Kama bwana wake alimpatia mke naye akamzalia wana au binti, mwanamke pamoja na watoto wake watakuwa mali ya bwana wake na huyo mwanaume ataondoka peke yake.

english: But if the servant declares, ‘I love my master and my wife and children; I do not want to go free,’
ekegusii: Korende omosomba oria karatebe: Nimwanchete omonene one amo na mokane, na abana baane, tinganeti korua ase obosomba bwane,
swahili: “Lakini kama mtumishi akisema, ‘Ninampenda bwana wangu, mke wangu pamoja na watoto na sitaki kuwa huru,’

english: then his master is to bring him before the judges. And he shall take him to the door or doorpost and pierce his ear with an awl. Then he shall serve his master for life.
ekegusii: erio omonene oye amorente ase obosio bwa Nyasae, amoikie ase egesieri gose ase emetobwa ya gesieri na amotue ogoto kwaye n’esindake. Erio omonto oria abe omosomba oye ase obogima bwaye bwonsi.
swahili: ndipo bwana wake atakapolazimika kumpeleka mbele ya waamuzi. Kisha atampeleka kwenye mlango au kizingiti na kutoboa sikio lake kwa shazia. Naye atamtumikia bwana wake maisha yake yote.

english: And if a man sells his daughter as a servant, she is not to go free as the menservants do.
ekegusii: “Omonto karaoonie omwana oye omoiseke koba omosomba, omoiseke oyio tagosiborwa buna abasomba abamura barasiborwe.
swahili: “Kama mtu akimuuza binti yake kuwa mtumwa, hataachwa huru kama watumwa wa kiume waachiwavyo.

english: If she is displeasing in the eyes of her master who had designated her for himself, he must allow her to be redeemed. He has no right to sell her to foreigners, since he has broken faith with her.
ekegusii: Onye omoiseke oyio tagwenereti omonene oye, oyorengereretie komokora abe mokaye, rirorio nigo araboorigwe airane. Omonene oye takoba ne ribaga komoonia ase egesaku ekegeni, ekiagera among’ainete.
swahili: Kama hakumpendeza bwana wake aliyemchagua, huyo bwana atamwacha akombolewe. Hatakuwa na haki ya kumuuza kwa wageni, kwa sababu huyo bwana atakuwa amekosa uaminifu.

english: And if he chooses her for his son, he must deal with her as with a daughter.
ekegusii: Onye okomoa omomura oye abe mokaye, rirorio amwanche buna omwana oye omoiseke.
swahili: Kama akimchagua aolewe na mwanawe, ni lazima ampe haki za kuwa binti yake.

english: “If a man steals an ox or a sheep and slaughters or sells it, he must repay five oxen for an ox and four sheep for a sheep.
ekegusii: Omonto karaibe eng’ombe gose eng’ondi na koyenyenya, gose ayeoonie, nigo araakane chiombe isano ribaga ri’eng’ombe eyemo, ne ching’ondi inye ribaga ri’eng’ondi eyemo.
swahili: “Kama mtu akiiba maksai au kondoo na kumchinja au kumuuza, ni lazima alipe ngʼombe watano badala ya maksai mmoja na kondoo wanne badala ya kondoo mmoja.

english: If a man gives a donkey, an ox, a sheep, or any other animal to be cared for by his neighbor, but it dies or is injured or stolen while no one is watching,
ekegusii: “Omonto karae omoiri oye etigere, gose eeri, gose eng’ondi, gose etugo ende yonsi ebe sagare, na etugo eria eitwe gose eakwe, gose eirwe monto tarora,
swahili: “Kama mtu akimpa jirani yake punda, ngʼombe, kondoo au mnyama mwingine yeyote amtunzie, akifa au akijeruhiwa au akichukuliwa wakati haonekani na mtu yeyote,

english: an oath before the LORD shall be made between the parties to determine whether or not the man has taken his neighbor’s property. The owner must accept the oath and require no restitution.
ekegusii: omoiri oria goika atenene bosio bw’ekegambero atiane ase Omonene ng’a takuneti enibo aetwe sagare. Omonyene etugo eria goika anche ng’a ayio atianwa namaene, na tagoakanwa.
swahili: jambo hili kati yao wawili litaamuliwa kwa kuapa kiapo mbele za Bwana, kwamba huyo jirani hakuhusika na wizi wa mali ya jirani yake. Mwenye mali itampasa akubali jambo hili, na hakuna malipo yatakayohitajika.

english: But if the animal was actually stolen from the neighbor, he must make restitution to the owner.
ekegusii: Korende onye nigo yaibwa korwa asare ere goika aakane omonyene oria.
swahili: Lakini kama mnyama aliibwa kwa jirani, itampasa amlipe mwenye mnyama.

english: If the animal was torn to pieces, he shall bring it as evidence; he need not make restitution for the torn carcass.
ekegusii: Onye yariegwa nenyang’au, arente chinyama chintigari chibe kirori, taakana ase eye enyang’au yaitete.
swahili: Kama ameraruliwa na mnyama pori, ataleta mabaki ya mnyama kama ushahidi, naye hatadaiwa kulipa mnyama aliyeraruliwa.

english: If a man borrows an animal from his neighbor and it is injured or dies while its owner is not present, he must make full restitution.
ekegusii: “Omonto karasabe na koegwa etugo sagare korwa ase omoiri oye, na etugo eyio keraakwe gose ekwe, na omonyene tayerochi, omonto oria goika ayeakane.
swahili: “Kama mtu akimwazima mnyama kutoka kwa jirani yake, na kama akiumia au akafa na mwenye mnyama hayupo, lazima amlipe huyo mnyama.

english: If the owner was present, no restitution is required. If the animal was rented, the fee covers the loss. Laws of Social Responsibility
ekegusii: Onye omonyene abao ekero egoakwa gose egokwa, rirorio tagoakanwa. Onye etugo eyio yarenge eyogoakanerwa rirerio, ogoakanerwa okwo kobe kogoisanera ogosirerwa okwo. Amachiiko y’ogotanga obonyaka na obobe bonde
swahili: Lakini mwenye mnyama akiwa angalipo na mnyama wake, mwazimaji hatalazimika kumlipa. Kama mnyama alikuwa amekodishwa, fedha iliyolipwa kwa kukodisha inatosha kwa kufidia hasara. Uwajibikaji Wa Kijamii

english: If a man seduces a virgin who is not pledged in marriage and sleeps with her, he must pay the full dowry for her to be his wife.
ekegusii: “Omonto karamoege na gosaria omoiseke omwekungi otararierwa boko, goika aakane enibo eraisane erio amonyuome.
swahili: “Kama mtu akimshawishi bikira ambaye hajaposwa na akilala naye, lazima alipe mahari, kisha atamwoa msichana huyo.

english: If her father absolutely refuses to give her to him, the man still must pay an amount comparable to the bridal price of a virgin.
ekegusii: Korende onye ise omoiseke okwanga, tamomoa, omonto oyio goika aakane chitaabu chireng’aine rigori ri’omoiseke omwekungi.
swahili: Baba wa msichana akikataa katakata kumpa huyo mtu huyo msichana wake, bado ni lazima huyo mtu atalipa mahari kama inavyostahili malipo ya ubikira.

english: You must not allow a sorceress to live.
ekegusii: “Totiga omokungu omoorogi abe moyo.
swahili: “Usiruhusu mwanamke mchawi aishi.

english: Whoever lies with an animal must surely be put to death.
ekegusii: “Omonto oraraare neng’iti goika aitwe akwe.
swahili: “Mtu yeyote aziniye na mnyama lazima auawe.

english: If anyone sacrifices to any god other than the LORD alone, he must be set apart for destruction.
ekegusii: “Omonto oraruere enyasae ende yonsi ekeng’wanso, otatiga Omonene bweka, goika asirigwe kegima.
swahili: “Mtu awaye yote anayemtolea mungu mwingine dhabihu isipokuwa Bwana, lazima aangamizwe.

english: You must not exploit or oppress a foreign resident, for you yourselves were foreigners in the land of Egypt.
ekegusii: “Tobaisa gokorera omomenyi bobe, gose komochegia, ekiagera nainwe abanyene mwarenge abamenyi ase ense ya Misiri.
swahili: “Usimtendee mgeni vibaya au kumwonea, kwa kuwa nanyi mlikuwa wageni huko Misri.

english: You must not mistreat any widow or orphan.
ekegusii: Tochanda omoboraka onde bwensi, gose omwana entakana oyo abaibori baye bakuure.
swahili: “Usimdhulumu mjane wala yatima.

english: If you do mistreat them, and they cry out to Me in distress, I will surely hear their cry.
ekegusii: Oise kobachanda abwo, na barabwo kobaraarere ase ’nde, amaene, inche ninyigwe ekerero kiabo.
swahili: Kama ukifanya hivyo nao wakinililia, hakika nitasikia kilio chao.

english: My anger will be kindled, and I will kill you with the sword; then your wives will become widows and your children will be fatherless.
ekegusii: Endamwamu yane inayoke, na inche mbaite n’omoro, na abakungu baino nababe ababoraka, na abana baino babe chintakaana batari nabaise.
swahili: Hasira yangu itawaka, nami nitawaua kwa upanga, wake zenu watakuwa wajane na watoto wenu watakuwa yatima.

english: If you lend money to one of My people among you who is poor, you must not act as a creditor to him; you are not to charge him interest.
ekegusii: “Oise komoa singo omonto onde one omotaka ore ase egati yaino, tobaisa gokora buna abwo bakoa abanto singo na koboria ebitoki ebinge; tobaisa komoboria ebitoki.
swahili: “Kama ukimkopesha mmojawapo wa watu wangu fedha ambaye ni mhitaji, usiwe kama mtu mkopesha fedha; usimtoze riba.

english: If you take your neighbor’s cloak as collateral, return it to him by sunset,
ekegusii: “Onye kogosaba omonto onde egetambaa kiaye akwambara kebe intenenera, goika omokeiranerie erioba ritaragwa,
swahili: Kama ukichukua vazi la jirani kama rehani, ulirudishe kwake kabla jua kuzama,

english: because his cloak is the only covering he has for his body. What else will he sleep in? And if he cries out to Me, I will hear, for I am compassionate.
ekegusii: ekiagera nakio gioka abwate akwebisia. Eke nakio abwate gekomobekera riberera ase omobere oye. Inee! Otakemoeti, inki rende araraarere? Ere karaarere ase ’nde, ekeene, nimoigwe, ekiagera inche nomonyamaabera.
swahili: kwa kuwa vazi lake ndilo pekee alilo nalo la kumfunika mwili wake. Ni nini kingine atajifunika nacho? Atakaponililia, nitasikia, kwa kuwa nina huruma.

english: You must not blaspheme God or curse the ruler of your people.
ekegusii: “Tobaisa korama Nyasae, gose koragereria omorai bw’abaanto bao.” Ogotongora, na omwana omotangi, ne ching’iti chintangi
swahili: “Usimkufuru Mungu au kumlaani mtawala wa watu wako.

english: You must not hold back offerings from your granaries or vats. You are to give Me the firstborn of your sons.
ekegusii: “Totebana kondetera ogotongora kwao kwe rigesa ri’endagera na eri’emesabibu. Ong’e omwana oo omomura omotangi ase abana bao, abe oyone.
swahili: “Usiache kutoa sadaka kutoka ghala lako au mapipa yako. “Lazima unipe mzaliwa wa kwanza wa wana wako.

english: You shall do likewise with your cattle and your sheep. Let them stay with their mothers for seven days, but on the eighth day you are to give them to Me.
ekegusii: Ong’e boigo chimori chintangi chi’echiombe, ne chimaanwa chintangi chi’eching’ondi. Ochitige chikoore amatuko atano na abere, ko rituko ria gatano na gatato ochindetere.
swahili: Ufanye vivyo hivyo kwa ngʼombe wako na kwa kondoo wako. Waache wakae na mama zao kwa siku saba, lakini siku ya nane unipe.

english: You are to be My holy people. You must not eat the meat of a mauled animal found in the field; you are to throw it to the dogs.
ekegusii: “Mobe abanto baane abachenu; timobaisa koria eng’iti ende yonsi eyaitirwe nenyang’au ase orosana, motugutere chisese chinyama echio.”
swahili: “Ninyi mtakuwa watu wangu watakatifu. Kwa hiyo msile nyama ya mnyama aliyeraruliwa na wanyama pori; mtupieni mbwa.

english: If a man grazes his livestock in a field or vineyard and allows them to stray so that they graze in someone else’s field, he must make restitution from the best of his own field or vineyard.
ekegusii: “Omonto kararisie etugo yaye ase omogondo bw’endagera, gose oyo bw’emesabibu, na gotiga riicho riaye ririe endagera y’omonto onde, nere goika aakane endagera enoru korwa ase omogondo oye, gose eyere engiya korwa ase emesabibu yaye.
swahili: “Kama mtu akichunga mifugo yake katika shamba au shamba la mizabibu, na akawaachia wajilishe katika shamba la mtu mwingine, ni lazima alipe vitu bora kutoka kwenye shamba lake mwenyewe au kutoka shamba lake la mizabibu.

english: If a fire breaks out and spreads to thornbushes so that it consumes stacked or standing grain, or the whole field, the one who started the fire must make full restitution.
ekegusii: “Onye omonto ogosamba omorero, na omorero oyio bwesiarere gochia ase amagwa, na emesaima y’endagera ere ase omogondo eyie, omonto oria goika aakane yonsi pi.
swahili: “Kama moto ukiwaka na kuenea kwenye vichaka vya miiba na kuteketeza miganda ya nafaka au nafaka ambayo haijavunwa, au kuteketeza shamba lote, mtu yule aliyewasha moto lazima alipe.

english: If a man gives his neighbor money or goods for safekeeping and they are stolen from the neighbor’s house, the thief, if caught, must pay back double.
ekegusii: “Omonto karae omoiri oye chitaabu, gose ebinto binde biaye amogachere, na birobio biibwe korwa nyomba mwaye, omoibi karanyorekane goika aakane ara kabere.
swahili: “Kama mtu akimpa jirani yake fedha au mali nyingine amtunzie, na kama vikiibwa kutoka nyumba ya huyo jirani, kama mwizi atashikwa, lazima alipe mara mbili.

english: If the thief is not found, the owner of the house must appear before the judges to determine whether he has taken his neighbor’s property.
ekegusii: Korende atanyorekaneti, oria omonyene enyomba arentwe ase obosio bw’ekegambero, erinde amanywe gose nere obiibete.
swahili: Lakini mwizi asipopatikana, mwenye nyumba atafika mbele ya waamuzi ili kuthibitisha kuwa hakuchukua mali ya mwenzake.

english: In all cases of illegal possession of an ox, a donkey, a sheep, a garment, or any lost item that someone claims, ‘This is mine,’ both parties shall bring their cases before the judges. The one whom the judges find guilty must pay back double to his neighbor.
ekegusii: “Eriomana rinde rionsi riise gotuboka, onye igoro y’eng’ombe, gose etigere, gose eng’ondi, gose eanga, gose gento kende gionsi kerasire, na omonto oyomo aamererie ng’a nekiaye, ekiina ekio ki’abaanto abwo babere nigo keraarentwe ase obosio bw’egesasiimero. Na oria Nyasae araorokie ng’a nomomochi, goika aakane oria onde ara kabere.
swahili: Pakiwepo jambo lolote la mali isiyo halali, ikiwa ni maksai, punda, kondoo, mavazi, ama mali yoyote iliyopotea ambayo fulani atasema, ‘Hii ni mali yangu,’ pande zote mbili wataleta mashauri yao mbele ya waamuzi. Yule ambaye waamuzi watamwona kuwa na hatia atamlipa jirani yake mara mbili.

english: “You shall not spread a false report. Do not join the wicked by being a malicious witness.
ekegusii: “Tobaisa gosiarera oborimo, na tobaisa gokengera omokori amabe ase okomobera kirori bw’oborimo.
swahili: “Usieneze habari za uongo. Usimsaidie mtu mwovu kwa kuwa shahidi mwenye nia ya kudhuru wengine.

english: For six years you are to sow your land and gather its produce,
ekegusii: “Ase emiaka etano nomo osimeke na kobusura endagera, na ogese ebiamire,
swahili: “Kwa muda wa miaka sita mtapanda mashamba yenu na kuvuna mazao,

english: but in the seventh year you must let it rest and lie fallow, so that the poor among your people may eat from the field and the wild animals may consume what they leave. Do the same with your vineyard and olive grove.
ekegusii: korende omwaka o gatano na kabere otige omogondo otimoke, toremwa, korende ebirakine na kwama ase omogondo obitigere abataka, na ebi baratigarie bibe endagera ye ching’iti chi’orosaana. Okore boigo nomogondo oo bw’emesabibu na oyo bw’emezeituni.
swahili: lakini katika mwaka wa saba usiilime ardhi wala kuitumia, ili watu walio maskini miongoni mwenu waweze kupata chakula kutoka kwenye hayo mashamba, nao wanyama pori wapate chakula kwa yale mabaki watakayobakiza. Utafanya hivyo katika shamba lako la mizabibu na la mizeituni.

english: For six days you are to do your work, but on the seventh day you must cease, so that your ox and your donkey may rest and the son of your maidservant may be refreshed, as well as the foreign resident.
ekegusii: “Ase amatuko atano na rimo okore emeremo yao, korende ase rituko ria gatano na kabere otimoke, na eng’ombe yao na etigere yao nachirochio chitimoke; naboigo nomosomba oo omomura oiboreire bwoo, na omomenyi oo, nabarabwo batimoke.”
swahili: “Kwa siku sita fanya kazi zako, lakini siku ya saba usifanye kazi, ili maksai wako na punda wako wapate kupumzika, naye mtumwa aliyezaliwa nyumbani mwako, pamoja na mgeni, wapate kustarehe.

english: Pay close attention to everything I have said to you. You must not invoke the names of other gods; they must not be heard on your lips. The Three Feasts of Pilgrimage (Leviticus 23:1–3)
ekegusii: “Motegerere mono onsi aya nabateebirie na moyabwate. Timwatora amarieta ye chinyasae chinde; ayio taigugwa korwa ase emenwa yaino.” Amatuko Amanene (Okong’ 34:18-26; Okoir 16:1-17)
swahili: “Uzingatie kutenda kila kitu nilichokuambia. Usiombe kwa majina ya miungu mingine, wala usiyaruhusu kusikika kinywani mwako. Sikukuu Tatu Za Mwaka (Kutoka 34:18-26; Kumbukumbu 16:1-17)

english: Three times a year you are to celebrate a feast to Me.
ekegusii: “Kera omwaka nobe kogontwarera Amatuko Amanene ara gatato.
swahili: “Mara tatu kwa mwaka utanifanyia sikukuu.

english: You are to keep the Feast of Unleavened Bread as I commanded you: At the appointed time in the month of Abib you are to eat unleavened bread for seven days, because that was the month you came out of Egypt. No one may appear before Me empty-handed.
ekegusii: Ase omotienyi bwa Abibu, omotienyi oyio mwaruete ase ense ya Misiri, Goika orende Rituko Rinene ri’Emegati etabekiri memera ase enchera eyio nagochigeete. Naboigo orie emegati etabekiri memera ase amatuko atano na abere buna nagochigeete. Na monto onde tabaisa gocha ase obosio bwane namaboko amasa.
swahili: “Utaadhimisha Sikukuu ya Mikate Isiyotiwa Chachu; kwa siku saba utakula mikate isiyotiwa chachu kama nilivyokuagiza. Fanya jambo hili kwa wakati uliopangwa katika mwezi wa Abibu, ndio mwezi wa nne, kwa sababu katika mwezi huo ulitoka Misri. “Mtu yeyote asije mbele yangu mikono mitupu.

english: You are also to keep the Feast of Harvest with the firstfruits of the produce from what you sow in the field. And keep the Feast of Ingathering at the end of the year, when you gather your produce from the field.
ekegusii: “Naende goika orende Rituko Rinene rie Rigesa ekero okogesa ogotongora gw’okwama kw’omogondo oo gwasimegete na ogakora emeremo. “Orende boigo Rituko Rinene ri’Ogosangereria Rigesa ri’omoerio bw’omwaka ekero ogosangereria okwama kw’emeremo yao emekong’u gwakorete.
swahili: “Utaadhimisha Sikukuu ya Mavuno kwa malimbuko ya mazao yako uliyopanda katika shamba lako. “Utaadhimisha Sikukuu ya Kukusanya mavuno mwishoni mwa mwaka, unapokusanya mavuno yako toka shambani.

english: Three times a year all your males are to appear before the Lord GOD.
ekegusii: Ara gatato kera omwaka abanto bao abasacha babe bagocha ase obosio bwane, inche Omonene Nyasae.
swahili: “Mara tatu kwa mwaka wanaume wote watakuja mbele za Bwana Mwenyezi.

english: You must not offer the blood of My sacrifices with anything leavened, nor may the fat of My feast remain until morning.
ekegusii: “Tobaisa kondetera amanyinga ’ekeng’wanso amo nomogati obekire ememera. Ebitinya bie chinyama echi nkoruerwa ekeng’wanso ase rituko riane rinene, tibitigara goika bokie rituko rikobwatia.
swahili: “Msitoe damu ya dhabihu kwangu pamoja na kitu chochote kilicho na chachu. “Mafuta ya mnyama wa sadaka ya sikukuu yangu yasibakizwe mpaka asubuhi.

english: Bring the best of the firstfruits of your soil to the house of the LORD your God. You must not cook a young goat in its mother’s milk. God’s Angel to Lead (Deuteronomy 7:12–26)
ekegusii: “Goika orente ogotongora okore okuya korwa ase omogondo oo, ase enyomba yane inche Omonene Nyasae oo. “Tobaisa koiyekera emanwa y’embori ime y’amabeere ’eng’ina.” Chiira na amatebererio
swahili: “Utaleta malimbuko bora ya ardhi yako katika nyumba ya Bwana Mungu wako. “Usimchemshe mwana-mbuzi katika maziwa ya mama yake. Malaika Wa Mungu Kuandaa Njia

english: You shall not follow the crowd in wrongdoing. When you testify in a lawsuit, do not pervert justice by siding with the crowd.
ekegusii: Tobaisa koba ensemo y’abare abange kobarigetie gokora amabe, gose tobaisa kobakorera abwo bare abange ogwanchereria na gotanga oboronge ase okoba kirori bw’okoonchorana oboronge.
swahili: “Usifuate umati wa watu katika kutenda mabaya. Unapotoa ushahidi kwenye mashtaka, usipotoshe haki ukijumuika na umati wa watu,

english: Behold, I am sending an angel before you to protect you along the way and to bring you to the place I have prepared.
ekegusii: “Nintome omomalaika agotang’ane na gokorenda ase enchera, agoikie aase aria nakoroiseirie.
swahili: “Tazama, ninamtuma malaika akutangulie mbele yako akulinde njiani na kukuleta mpaka mahali nilipoandaa.

english: Pay attention to him and listen to his voice; do not defy him, for he will not forgive rebellion, since My Name is in him.
ekegusii: Mwerende ase obosio bwaye, na moigwere aya arabateebie. Tobaisa kwanga komoigwera, ere takomoororera amaabera oyoramoche koigwera ekiagera erieta riane nigo rire ime yaye.
swahili: Mtamtii na kusikiliza kile anachokisema. Usiasi dhidi yake; hatakusamehe uasi wako, kwa maana Jina langu limo ndani yake.

english: But if you will listen carefully to his voice and do everything I say, I will be an enemy to your enemies and a foe to your foes.
ekegusii: Korende koramoigwere ere, na gokora ayio onsi nakwanire inche, rirorio nindwanie ababisa bao, ninchande abwo bakogochanda.
swahili: Kama ukitii kweli kweli kile asemacho na kufanya yote nisemayo, nitakuwa adui wa adui zako, na nitawapinga wale wakupingao.

english: For My angel will go before you and bring you into the land of the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Canaanites, Hivites, and Jebusites, and I will annihilate them.
ekegusii: Naki omomalaika one nagotang’ane akoire na kogoikia ase ense y’Abaamori, na Abahiti, na Abaperisi, na Abakanaani, na Abahivi, na Abayebusi, na inche nimbasirie.
swahili: Malaika wangu atatangulia mbele yako na kukuleta katika nchi ya Waamori, Wahiti, Waperizi, Wakanaani, Wahivi na Wayebusi, nami nitawafutilia mbali.

english: You must not bow down to their gods or serve them or follow their practices. Instead, you are to demolish them and smash their sacred stones to pieces.
ekegusii: Timosasiima chinyasae chiabo, gose gochikorera; na timokora buna abanto abwo bagokora, korende mosirie kegima emegwekano yabo y’ogosasimwa na moyaiyerie inse amagena abo onsi are aase bagosasimera.
swahili: Usiisujudie miungu yao, au kuiabudu, wala kufuata desturi yao. Utayabomoa kabisa na kuvunjavunja mawe yao ya ibada vipande vipande.

english: So you shall serve the LORD your God, and He will bless your bread and your water. And I will take away sickness from among you.
ekegusii: Momokorere Omonene Nyasae oino, na inche ninsesenie endagera yaino na amaache aino, nindusie amarwaire ase more.
swahili: Utamwabudu Bwana Mungu wako, na baraka zake zitakuwa juu ya vyakula vyako na maji yako. Nami nitaondoa maradhi miongoni mwako,

english: No woman in your land will miscarry or be barren; I will fulfill the number of your days.
ekegusii: Ase ense yaino mokuungu onde tari oborito bwaye boragwe, gose onde takoba omogomba; nimbae obogima obotambe.
swahili: na hakuna atakayeharibu mimba wala atakayekuwa tasa katika nchi yako. Nami nitakupa maisha makamilifu.

english: I will send My terror ahead of you and throw into confusion every nation you encounter. I will make all your enemies turn and run.
ekegusii: “Nintang’anie okwoboyia kwane bosio bwaino, na goichanie na gotantania abanto bonsi abwo morabe mokoumerana nabarabwo; ninkore ababisa baino bonsi baonchoke batame korwa ase more.
swahili: “Nitapeleka utisho wangu mbele yako na kufadhaisha kila taifa utakalolifikia. Nitafanya adui zako wote wakupe kisogo na kukimbia.

english: I will send the hornet before you to drive the Hivites and Canaanites and Hittites out of your way.
ekegusii: Nintome ebiaramba birase na goseria Abahivi, na Abakanaani, na Abahiti, korwa ase Kaanani bosio bwao.
swahili: Nitatanguliza manyigu mbele yako kuwafukuza Wahivi, Wakanaani na Wahiti waondoke njiani mwako.

english: I will not drive them out before you in a single year; otherwise the land would become desolate and wild animals would multiply against you.
ekegusii: Tinkobaseria ase omwaka oyomo, ense ebaise koba bosa, ne ching’iti chi’orosana chimenteke chibachande.
swahili: Lakini sitawafukuza kwa mara moja, kwa sababu nchi itabaki ukiwa na wanyama pori watakuwa wengi mno kwako.

english: And do not show favoritism to a poor man in his lawsuit.
ekegusii: Tobaisa gwanchereria omonto omotaka ase ekiina kiaye.
swahili: nawe usimpendelee mtu maskini katika mashtaka yake.

english: Little by little I will drive them out ahead of you, until you become fruitful and possess the land.
ekegusii: Nigo ndabaserie ng’ora ng’ora goika momenteke moisane komenya ense eyio.
swahili: Nitawafukuza kidogo kidogo mbele yako, mpaka uwe umeongezeka kiasi cha kutosha kuimiliki nchi.

english: And I will establish your borders from the Red Sea to the Sea of the Philistines, and from the desert to the Euphrates. For I will deliver the inhabitants into your hand, and you will drive them out before you.
ekegusii: Inche ninkobekere orobebe rwao gochakera Enyancha Embariri goikera Enyancha y’Abafilisti, naende korwa ase erooro goika orooche rwa Eufarati, ekiagera nimbeke ababiare b’ense eyio ase amaboko aino, na inwe mobaseerie, batame korwa ase more.
swahili: “Nitaweka mipaka ya nchi yako kuanzia Bahari ya Shamu hadi Bahari ya Wafilisti, na kuanzia jangwani hadi Mto Frati. Nitawatia watu wanaoishi katika nchi hizo mikononi mwako, nawe utawafukuza watoke mbele yako.

english: You shall make no covenant with them or with their gods.
ekegusii: Tobaisa gokora okobwatana konde gwonsi nabarabwo, gose ne chinyasae chiabo.
swahili: Usifanye agano lolote nao wala na miungu yao.

english: They must not remain in your land, lest they cause you to sin against Me. For if you serve their gods, it will surely be a snare to you.”
ekegusii: Barabwo tibaamenya ase ense yao, baabaise kogera onkorere ebibe. Onye kogokorera chinyasae chiabo, chirochio nachinyare kogotega.”
swahili: Usiwaache waishi katika nchi yako, la sivyo watakusababisha utende dhambi dhidi yangu, kwa sababu ibada ya miungu yao hakika itakuwa mtego kwako.”

english: If you encounter your enemy’s stray ox or donkey, you must return it to him.
ekegusii: “Oise korora eng’ombe y’omobisa oo gose etigere yaye egosira goika omoyeiranerie.
swahili: “Kama ukikutana na maksai au punda wa adui yako anapotea, hakikisha umemrudisha kwake.

english: If you see the donkey of one who hates you fallen under its load, do not leave it there; you must help him with it.
ekegusii: Korarore etigere y’oyo okogechete yagure negurube ebogoretie, tobaisa koyeetania, korende oyekonye.
swahili: Ukiona punda wa mtu anayekuchukia ameanguka na mzigo wake, usimwache hapo alipoangukia; hakikisha kuwa umemsaidia.

english: You shall not deny justice to the poor in their lawsuits.
ekegusii: “Tobaisa korina omonto omotaka oboronge bwaye, ekero ekiina kiaye gekogambwa.
swahili: “Usiwanyime haki watu wako walio maskini katika mashtaka yao.
