english: Stay far away from a false accusation. Do not kill the innocent or the just, for I will not acquit the guilty.
ekegusii: Bwetange kegima korwa ase oborimo, na tobaisa kogera omonyaboronge aitwe, ekiagera inche Omonene tingotiga koa omomochi egesusuro.
swahili: Ujiepushe na mashtaka ya uongo, wala usimuue mtu asiye na hatia au mtu mwaminifu, kwa maana sitamhesabia hana hatia yeye aliye na hatia.

english: Do not accept a bribe, for a bribe blinds those who see and twists the words of the righteous.
ekegusii: Tobaisa gwancha oegwe riaaki, ekiagera riaaki nigo rikoukoria omonto erinde takorora ayare boronge; naende nigo rigosaria ekiina ki’abanyene oboronge.
swahili: “Usipokee rushwa, kwa kuwa rushwa hupofusha wale waonao, na kupinda maneno ya wenye haki.

english: Do not oppress a foreign resident, since you yourselves know how it feels to be foreigners; for you were foreigners in the land of Egypt. Sabbath Laws (Leviticus 25:1–7; Deuteronomy 15:1–6)
ekegusii: “Tobaisa gokorera omomenyi bobe, naki inwe momanyete buna omomenyi akoigwa ase enkoro yaye, ekiagera nainwe abanyene mwarenge abamenyi ase ense ya Misiri.” Omwaka o gatano na kabere, ne rituko ria gatano na kabere
swahili: “Usimwonee mgeni; ninyi wenyewe mnajua jinsi mgeni anavyojisikia, kwa sababu mlikuwa wageni Misri. Sheria Za Sabato

english: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Come up to the LORD—you and Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, and seventy of Israel’s elders—and you are to worship at a distance.
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene agateebia Musa, “Tiira gocha aa ase ’nde, aye amo na Aroni, na Nadabu, na Abihu, na abagaaka b’Abaisraeli emerongo etano na ebere. Mobeere aare ake, motugame inse monsasiime.
swahili: Kisha Mungu akamwambia Mose, “Njooni huku juu kwa Bwana, wewe na Aroni, Nadabu na Abihu, pamoja na wazee sabini wa Israeli. Mniabudu kwa mbali,

english: and they saw the God of Israel. Under His feet was a work like a pavement made of sapphire, as clear as the sky itself.
ekegusii: bakarora Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli. Inse y’amagoro aye nigo arenge buna amagena e rigori rinene akorokwa safiro, are nobokenonoku buna obore igoro.
swahili: nao wakamwona Mungu wa Israeli. Chini ya miguu yake kulikuwa na kitu kama sakafu ya mawe ya yakuti samawi, iliyo safi kama anga angavu.

english: But God did not lay His hand on the nobles of Israel; they saw Him, and they ate and drank. Moses on the Mountain
ekegusii: Omonene tarambora okoboko kwaye kobakorera bobe abagaaka baria b’Abaisraeli. Barabwo kobarorire Nyasae, bakaria na konywa. Musa ase egetunwa gia Sinai
swahili: Lakini Mungu hakuinua mkono wake dhidi ya hawa viongozi wa Waisraeli; walimwona Mungu, nao wakala na kunywa.

english: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Come up to Me on the mountain and stay here, so that I may give you the tablets of stone, with the law and commandments I have written for their instruction.”
ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa, “Tiira gocha aa ase ’nde egetunwa igoro, oganye aa, na inche nkoe chibao chi’amagena chire namachiiko onsi aya narikireo, ayio ogochia kworokereria abanto.”
swahili: Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Panda uje kwangu huku mlimani na ukae hapa, nami nitakupa vibao vya mawe, vyenye sheria na amri ambazo nimeziandika ziwe mwongozo wao.”

english: So Moses set out with Joshua his attendant and went up on the mountain of God.
ekegusii: Musa akaimoka amo nomosomba oye Yoshua, erio ere agatiira gochia egetunwa kia Nyasae.
swahili: Basi Mose akaondoka na Yoshua mtumishi wake, naye Mose akapanda juu kwenye mlima wa Mungu.

english: And he said to the elders, “Wait here for us until we return to you. Aaron and Hur are here with you. Whoever has a dispute can go to them.”
ekegusii: Agateebia abagaaka baria, “Motoganye aiga goika ekero torairane ase more. Rora Aroni na Huri nao bare aiga amo nainwe; onye omonto ore nobokong’u bonde, agende ababorie.”
swahili: Mose akawaambia wazee wa Israeli, “Tungojeni hapa mpaka tutakapowarudia. Aroni na Huri wako pamoja nanyi, na kila aliye na neno aweza kuwaendea wao.”

english: When Moses went up on the mountain, the cloud covered it,
ekegusii: Erio Musa agatiira gochia egetunwa igoro, ne riire rikagetuba.
swahili: Mose alipopanda juu mlimani, wingu liliufunika huo mlima,

english: and the glory of the LORD settled on Mount Sinai. For six days the cloud covered it, and on the seventh day the LORD called to Moses from within the cloud.
ekegusii: Obonene bw’Omonene bogaacha bokabeera igoro y’egetunwa gia Sinai, ne riire rikagetuba ase engaki y’amatuko atano na rimo. Rituko ria gatano na kabere Omonene akarangeria Musa korwa riire gati.
swahili: nao utukufu wa Bwana ukatua juu ya Mlima Sinai. Kwa muda wa siku sita wingu lilifunika mlima, na siku ya saba Bwana akamwita Mose kutoka katikati ya lile wingu.

english: And the sight of the glory of the LORD was like a consuming fire on the mountaintop in the eyes of the Israelites.
ekegusii: Ase Abaisraeli obonene bw’Omonene bokarorekana buna omorero ogosiria, ase egetunwa igoro.
swahili: Kwa Waisraeli utukufu wa Bwana ulionekana kama moto uteketezao juu ya mlima.

english: Moses entered the cloud as he went up on the mountain, and he remained on the mountain forty days and forty nights.
ekegusii: Musa agasoa riire ime, agatiira gochia egetunwa igoro, akabeera aroro ase engaki y’amatuko emerongo ene, omobaso na obotuko.
swahili: Kisha Mose akaingia ndani ya lile wingu alivyokuwa akipanda mlimani. Naye akakaa huko mlimani kwa muda wa siku arobaini, usiku na mchana.

english: Moses alone shall approach the LORD, but the others must not come near. And the people may not go up with him.”
ekegusii: Naye Musa bweka orachiche ong’ike ang’e, korende abwo bande tibang’ika ang’e. Boigo n’Abaisraeli barabwo tibachicha amo naye nonya ng’ake.”
swahili: lakini Mose peke yake ndiye atakayemkaribia Bwana; wengine wasije karibu. Nao watu wasije wakapanda pamoja naye.”

english: When Moses came and told the people all the words and ordinances of the LORD, they all responded with one voice: “All the words that the LORD has spoken, we will do.”
ekegusii: Musa akagenda agateebia abanto amang’ana onsi ay’Omonene akwanete, na amachiiko aye onsi. Abanto bonsi bakamoiraneria ase eriogi erimo, bakaboora, “Amang’ana ayio onsi Omonene akwanire inatoyakore.”
swahili: Mose alipokwenda na kuwaambia watu maneno yote na sheria zote za Bwana, wakaitikia kwa sauti moja, “Kila kitu alichosema Bwana tutakifanya.”

english: And Moses wrote down all the words of the LORD. Early the next morning he got up and built an altar at the base of the mountain, along with twelve pillars for the twelve tribes of Israel.
ekegusii: Erio Musa akariika amachiiko onsi ay’Omonene omoete. Erio akaimoka maambia chuni, akaagacha egesasiimero inse ye getunwa, agatenenia amagena ikomi na abere koreng’ana nebisaku ikomi na bibere bi’Abaisraeli.
swahili: Ndipo Mose akaandika kila kitu Bwana alichokuwa amesema. Akaamka kesho yake asubuhi na mapema na kujenga madhabahu chini ya mlima na kusimamisha nguzo kumi na mbili za mawe kuwakilisha makabila kumi na mawili ya Israeli.

english: Then he sent out some young men of Israel, and they offered burnt offerings and sacrificed young bulls as peace offerings to the LORD.
ekegusii: Agatoma abamura b’Abaisraeli bakarua ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa, bakanyenyera Omonene chieri chi’ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe.
swahili: Kisha akawatuma vijana wanaume wa Kiisraeli, nao wakatoa sadaka za kuteketezwa na dhabihu za mafahali wachanga kuwa sadaka za amani kwa Bwana.

english: Moses took half of the blood and put it in bowls, and the other half he sprinkled on the altar.
ekegusii: Musa akabogoria ekeng’ese ki’amanyinga aya, akayabeeka egetaabo ime, na ekeng’ese kende akanyororokeria egesasiimero.
swahili: Mose akachukua nusu ya damu ya wale wanyama na kuiweka kwenye mabakuli na nusu nyingine akainyunyiza juu ya madhabahu.

english: Then he took the Book of the Covenant and read it to the people, who replied, “All that the LORD has spoken we will do, and we will be obedient.”
ekegusii: Erio akaimokia egetabu gi’okobwatana kw’ogotianania agwo ase amariko a Omonene ariikire agasomera abanto bakaigwa, erio Barabwo bakaboora, “Natoigwere na gokora onsi ay’Omonene akwanire.”
swahili: Kisha akachukua kile Kitabu cha Agano na kuwasomea watu. Nao wakajibu, “Tutafanya kila kitu alichosema Bwana, nasi tutatii.”

english: So Moses took the blood, sprinkled it on the people, and said, “This is the blood of the covenant that the LORD has made with you in accordance with all these words.”
ekegusii: Musa akaimokia amanyinga aria arenge egetaabo ime, akanyororokeria abanto, akabora, “Aya n’amanyinga okobwatana okw’Omonene akorire ase ogotianania nainwe ase okobaa amachiiko aya onsi.”
swahili: Ndipo Mose akachukua ile damu, akawanyunyizia wale watu, akasema, “Hii ni damu ya agano ambalo Bwana amelifanya nanyi kufuatana na maneno haya yote.”

english: Then Moses went up with Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel,
ekegusii: Erio Musa, na Aroni, na Nadabu, na Abihu, na abagaaka baria emerongo etano na ebere b’Abaisraeli bagatiira gochia egetunwa igoro,
swahili: Mose na Aroni, Nadabu na Abihu, pamoja na wazee sabini wa Israeli wakapanda mlimani,

english: And they are to construct an ark of acacia wood, two and a half cubits long, a cubit and a half wide, and a cubit and a half high.
ekegusii: “Mondoiserie Esanduki ye chibao chi’omokonge. Obotambe bwaye bobe obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko abere na ekeng’ese, na obogare bwaye okoboko okomo na ekeng’ese, na obotambe bwaye gochia igoro okoboko okomo na ekeng’ese.
swahili: “Nao watatengeneza Sanduku la mbao za mshita, lenye urefu wa dhiraa mbili na nusu, upana wa dhiraa moja na nusu, na kimo cha dhiraa moja na nusu.

english: Overlay it with pure gold both inside and out, and make a gold molding around it.
ekegusii: Oyeome netaabu echenire ime na isiko, oyeetananie omong’orooria bw’etaabu.
swahili: Utalifunika hilo Sanduku kwa dhahabu safi ndani na nje, na kulifanyia ukingo wa dhahabu juu yake kulizunguka.

english: Cast four gold rings for it and fasten them to its four feet, two rings on one side and two on the other.
ekegusii: Okore chibonyi inye chi’echitaabu, ochibeke ase amagoro aye ane, ibere ase kera ensemo.
swahili: Utalisubu kwa pete nne za dhahabu na kuzifungia kwenye miguu yake minne, pete mbili kwa upande mmoja na pete mbili kwa upande mwingine.

english: And make poles of acacia wood and overlay them with gold.
ekegusii: Obaache emiaro ebere y’emekonge, oyeoome netaabu.
swahili: Kisha utatengeneza mipiko ya mti wa mshita na kuzifunika kwa dhahabu.

english: Insert the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark, in order to carry it.
ekegusii: Osoyie emiaro eyio ase chibonyi ime ase okobogoreria Esanduki eria.
swahili: Utaiingiza hiyo mipiko kwenye zile pete katika pande mbili za Sanduku ili kulibeba.

english: The poles are to remain in the rings of the ark; they must not be removed.
ekegusii: Emiaro eyio goika ebe ime ase chibonyi echio, terusigwao.
swahili: Hiyo mipiko itabakia daima katika hizo pete za hilo Sanduku; haitaondolewa.

english: And place inside the ark the Testimony, which I will give you. The Mercy Seat (Exodus 37:6–9)
ekegusii: Ime y’Esanduki eria obeke chibao echi chiriikire oborori, echi ndakoe.” Oboikaranso bwa amaabera
swahili: Kisha weka ndani ya hilo Sanduku ule Ushuhuda nitakaokupa.

english: And you are to construct a mercy seat of pure gold, two and a half cubits long and a cubit and a half wide.
ekegusii: “Oroisie ekemumeko gi’etaabu echenire kebe Oboikaranso bwa amaabera. Obotaambe bwaye bobe ekerengo ki’amaboko abere na ekeng’ese, na obogare bwaye okoboko okomo na ekeng’ese.
swahili: “Tengeneza kifuniko cha upatanisho cha dhahabu safi, chenye urefu wa dhiraa mbili na nusu, na upana wa dhiraa moja na nusu.

english: Make two cherubim of hammered gold at the ends of the mercy seat,
ekegusii: Naende okore emegwekano y’ebitongwa bibere bibwate chimbaba ey’etaabu esunyuntire, oyebeke ase chinsinyo ibere chi’Ekerogo Kiamaabera,
swahili: Tengeneza makerubi wawili wa dhahabu iliyofuliwa katika miisho ya hicho kifuniko.

english: one cherub on one end and one on the other, all made from one piece of gold.
ekegusii: oyomo ase kera ensinyo. Oyekore ebe egento ekemo n’Ekerogo kia Amaabera.
swahili: Tengeneza kerubi mmoja kwenye mwisho mmoja, na kerubi mwingine kwenye mwisho mwingine; watengeneze makerubi hao wawe kitu kimoja na hicho kifuniko katika miisho hiyo miwili.

english: “Tell the Israelites to bring Me an offering. You are to receive My offering from every man whose heart compels him.
ekegusii: “Bateebie Abaisraeli ng’a bandetere ebiegwa; aye obisangererie korwa ase kera omonto oyoranche kobirua ase ’nde.
swahili: “Waambie Waisraeli waniletee sadaka. Utapokea sadaka kwa niaba yangu kutoka kwa kila mtu ambaye moyo wake wapenda kutoa.

english: And the cherubim are to have wings that spread upward, overshadowing the mercy seat. The cherubim are to face each other, looking toward the mercy seat.
ekegusii: Ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba abwo barambore chimbaaba chiabo igoro y’ekerogo kiamaabera, babobekere ekiriri, na amasio abo abe achikaine, na barabwo barigererie ekerogo kiamaabera.
swahili: Makerubi hao watakuwa wametandaza mabawa kuelekea juu, yakitia kivuli hicho kifuniko. Makerubi hao wataelekeana, wakitazama hicho kifuniko.

english: Set the mercy seat atop the ark, and put the Testimony that I will give you into the ark.
ekegusii: Oterekerere ekerogo kia amaabera igoro y’Esanduki eria. Erio obeke imeo chibao echi chiriikire oborori, echi ndakoe.
swahili: Weka huo Ushuhuda nitakaokupa ndani ya hilo Sanduku la Agano, na uweke hicho kifuniko juu ya hilo Sanduku.

english: And I will meet with you there above the mercy seat, between the two cherubim that are over the ark of the Testimony; I will speak with you about all that I command you regarding the Israelites. The Table of Showbread (Exodus 37:10–16; Leviticus 24:5–9)
ekegusii: Agwo ninchiche ng’umerane naye. Korwa igoro y’ekerogo kia amaabera, gati‐gati y’ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba aba babere bare igoro y’Esanduki ere ne chibao chiriikire oborori, nimbe ngokwana naye igoro y’amachiiko aya ngochia koa Abaisraeli goetera asore.” Emesa y’emegati erabe ekoruegwa ase Nyasae (Okong’ 37:10-16)
swahili: Hapo juu ya hicho kifuniko, kati ya hao makerubi wawili walioko juu ya hilo Sanduku la Ushuhuda, hapo ndipo nitakapokutana nawe na kukupa maagizo yangu kwa ajili ya Waisraeli. Meza Ya Mikate Ya Wonyesho (Kutoka 37:10-16)

english: You are also to make a table of acacia wood two cubits long, a cubit wide, and a cubit and a half high.
ekegusii: “Oroisie emesa ye chibao chi’emekonge. Obotambe bwaye bobe obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko abere, na obogare bwaye okoboko okomo, na obotambe bwaye gochia igoro okoboko okomo na ekeng’ese.
swahili: “Tengeneza meza ya mbao za mshita yenye urefu wa dhiraa mbili, upana wa dhiraa moja, na kimo cha dhiraa moja na nusu.

english: Overlay it with pure gold and make a gold molding around it.
ekegusii: Oyeome netaabu echenire, oyeetananie omong’ororia bw’etaabu.
swahili: Ifunike kwa dhahabu safi, na kuitengenezea ukingo wa dhahabu kuizunguka pande zote.

english: And make a rim around it a handbreadth wide and put a gold molding on the rim.
ekegusii: Erio obeke orosingo robe nobogare bong’ana egesanyi gi’okoboko, na oroetananie omong’ororia bw’etaabu.
swahili: Kisha tengeneza upapi wenye upana wa nyanda nne, na ufanyie ule upapi ukingo wa dhahabu kuuzunguka pande zote.

english: Make four gold rings for the table and fasten them to the four corners at its four legs.
ekegusii: Okore chibonyi inye chi’echitaabu ase emesa eria, ochibeeke ase chikoona inye ase amagoro aye,
swahili: Tengeneza pete nne za dhahabu kwa ajili ya meza hiyo, na uzifungie kwenye pembe nne, pale penye miguu yake minne.

english: The rings are to be close to the rim, to serve as holders for the poles used to carry the table.
ekegusii: ang’e norosingo; na emiaro esoigwe imeo, erinde emesa enyare kobogorerigwa.
swahili: Pete hizo zitakuwa karibu na ukingo ule ili kuishikilia ile mipiko itakayotumika kuibebea hiyo meza.

english: Make the poles of acacia wood and overlay them with gold, so that the table may be carried with them.
ekegusii: Obaache emiaro eria korwa ase emekonge, oyeome netaabu, nero emesa erabogorerigwe.
swahili: Tengeneza mipiko hiyo kwa mbao za mshita, uifunike na dhahabu, uitumie kubeba hiyo meza.

english: You are also to make the plates and dishes, as well as the pitchers and bowls for pouring drink offerings. Make them out of pure gold.
ekegusii: Oroisie chinteru na ebitaabo ase ubani, ne chisani, korwa ase ebio bagocha koumora ebinyugwa ebikoruegwa. Obiroisie bionsi korwa ase chitaabu chichenire.
swahili: Tengeneza sahani zake na masinia yake kwa dhahabu safi, pamoja na bilauri na bakuli zake kwa ajili ya kumiminia sadaka.

english: This is the offering you are to accept from them: gold, silver, and bronze;
ekegusii: Na ebiegwa orasangererie korwa ase bare nabio ebi: chitaabu, ne chifeta, ne chitaai;
swahili: Hizi ndizo sadaka utakazozipokea kutoka kwao: dhahabu, fedha na shaba;

english: And place the Bread of the Presence on the table before Me at all times. The Lampstand (Exodus 37:17–24; Numbers 8:1–4)
ekegusii: Ase emesa eyio obeke emegati erabe ekoruegwa ase ’nde, imbe nkoyerora botambe.” Ekebekerero gie chitaaya (Okong’ 37:17-24)
swahili: Utaweka mikate ya Wonyesho juu ya meza hii iwe mbele yangu daima. Kinara Cha Taa (Kutoka 37:17-24)

english: Then you are to make a lampstand of pure, hammered gold. It shall be made of one piece, including its base and shaft, its cups, and its buds and petals.
ekegusii: “Oroisie ekebekerero gie chitaaya gi’etaabu echenire esunyuntire, okeroisie na enterekerero amo ne ritina na emegwekano y’amamumu na ebisicha, bionsi bibe egento ekemo.
swahili: “Tengeneza kinara cha taa cha dhahabu safi iliyofuliwa vizuri katika kitako chake na ufito wake; vikombe vyake vinavyofanana na ua, matovu yake na maua yake viwe kitu kimoja.

english: Six branches are to extend from the sides of the lampstand—three on one side and three on the other.
ekegusii: Chinsagia isano nemo chibe chigosoka korwa ase ritina, isato korwa ase ensemo eyemo, na isato korwa ase ensemo ende.
swahili: Matawi sita yatatokeza kuanzia ule ufito wa katikati wa kinara cha taa: matawi matatu upande mmoja na matatu upande mwingine.

english: There are to be three cups shaped like almond blossoms on the first branch, each with buds and petals, three on the next branch, and the same for all six branches that extend from the lampstand.
ekegusii: Orosagia rwe ritang’ani robe nemegwekano etato y’ebisicha binga buna ebi’omolozi, kera ekemo kebe ne rimumu na egesicha, na orosagia rwa kabere boigo robe nemegwekano etato y’ebisicha binga buna ebi’omolozi; ne chinsagia chionsi isano nemo chibe boigo.
swahili: Vikombe vitatu vya mfano wa maua ya mlozi yenye matovu na maua vitakuwa katika tawi moja, vikombe vitatu katika tawi jingine, na vivyo hivyo kwa matawi yote sita yanayotokeza kwenye kile kinara cha taa.

english: And on the lampstand there shall be four cups shaped like almond blossoms with buds and petals.
ekegusii: Ritina rinyene ri’ekebekerero keria ribe nemegwekano ene y’ebisicha binga buna ebi’omolozi, kera ekemo kebe ne rimumu na egesicha.
swahili: Juu ya kinara chenyewe vitakuwepo vikombe vinne vya mfano wa maua ya mlozi yakiwa na matovu yake na maua yake.

english: For the six branches that extend from the lampstand, a bud must be under the first pair of branches, a bud under the second pair, and a bud under the third pair.
ekegusii: Rimumu erimo ribe inse ya kera chinsagia ibere chigosoka korwa ase ritina. Ase ayio amamumu abe inse ye chinsagia echio isano nemo, chiroisigwe chibe egento ekemo ne ritina.
swahili: Tovu moja litakuwa chini ya jozi ya kwanza ya matawi yaliyotokeza kwenye kinara cha taa, tovu la pili chini ya jozi ya pili, nalo tovu la tatu chini ya jozi ya tatu, yaani matawi sita kwa jumla.

english: The buds and branches are to be all of one piece with the lampstand, hammered out of pure gold.
ekegusii: Amamumu ayio amo ne chinsagia biroisigwe bibe egento ekemo ne ritina, bionsi biroisigwe korwa ase ribomba erimo ri’etaabu echenire esunyuntire.
swahili: Matovu na matawi yote yatakuwa kitu kimoja na kile kinara cha taa, yakifuliwa kwa dhahabu safi.

english: Make seven lamps and set them up on the lampstand so that they illuminate the area in front of it.
ekegusii: “Oroisie chitaaya isano na ibere, ochibeke igoro y’ekebekerero keria, erinde chimoreke gochia bosio.
swahili: “Kisha tengeneza taa zake saba na uziweke juu ya kinara hicho ili ziangaze mbele yake.

english: The wick trimmers and their trays must be of pure gold.
ekegusii: Ebinachi ne chindogio chiaye biroisigwe korwa ase chitaabu chichenire.
swahili: Mikasi ya kusawazishia tambi, pamoja na masinia, zote zitakuwa za dhahabu safi.

english: The lampstand and all these utensils shall be made from a talent of pure gold.
ekegusii: Okorere chitaabu chichenire chikiro emerongo etano ase okoroisia ekebekerero gie chitaaya amo nebikorero biaye.
swahili: Utatumia talanta moja ya dhahabu safi kutengeneza hicho kinara na vifaa vyake vyote.

english: blue, purple, and scarlet yarn; fine linen and goat hair;
ekegusii: chiusi chi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri; egatani engiya na amanya e chimbori;
swahili: nyuzi za rangi ya buluu, za zambarau, za rangi nyekundu, pamoja na kitani safi; singa za mbuzi;

english: See to it that you make everything according to the pattern shown you on the mountain.
ekegusii: Origererie buya obikore buna nakworogetie ase egetunwa.”
swahili: Hakikisha kuwa umevitengeneza sawasawa na ule mfano ulioonyeshwa kule mlimani.

english: ram skins dyed red and fine leather; acacia wood;
ekegusii: amasankwa e chimingichi aakire etaago, na amasankwa amaterere e ching’iti chia rooche, ne chibao chi’emekonge;
swahili: ngozi za kondoo dume zilizopakwa rangi nyekundu, na ngozi za pomboo; mbao za mshita;

english: olive oil for the light; spices for the anointing oil and for the fragrant incense;
ekegusii: amaguta e chitaaya, na ebinto bi’okoroisia amaguta akwaakwa abachore, na ebi’okoroisia ubani ye rimusu rigiya;
swahili: mafuta ya zeituni kwa ajili ya taa; vikolezi kwa ajili ya mafuta ya upako, pamoja na uvumba wa harufu nzuri;

english: and onyx stones and gemstones to be mounted on the ephod and breastpiece.
ekegusii: amagena e rigori rinene, buna oiniki na ayande, akobekwa ase egesibao ki’Omokuani na ase egesembe kiaye.
swahili: na vito vya shohamu na vito vingine vya thamani vya kuweka kwenye kisibau na kile kifuko cha kifuani.

english: And they are to make a sanctuary for Me, so that I may dwell among them.
ekegusii: Obateebie bandoiserie Obomenyo Obochenu, na inche inyare komenya ase egati yabo.
swahili: “Kisha uwaamuru wanitengenezee mahali patakatifu, nami nitakaa miongoni mwao.

english: You must make the tabernacle and design all its furnishings according to the pattern I show you. The Ark of the Covenant (Exodus 37:1–5)
ekegusii: Mondoiserie Obomenyo na ebinto bionsi ebirabeo, buna ndakworokie.” Esanduki yamachiiko (Okong’ 37:1-9)
swahili: Tengeneza hema hili na vyombo vyake vyote sawasawa na kielelezo nitakachokuonyesha. Sanduku La Agano (Kutoka 37:1-9)

english: “You are to construct the tabernacle itself with ten curtains of finely spun linen, each with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and cherubim skillfully worked into them.
ekegusii: “Oroisie eema y’Obomenyo nebitambaa ikomi biroisirie korwa ase chiusi chi’egatani chisisire amo ne chiusi chi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri. Omoroisia omong’aini abiroisie bibe nemegwekano y’ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba.
swahili: “Tengeneza maskani kwa mapazia kumi ya kitani iliyosokotwa vizuri na nyuzi za rangi ya buluu, za zambarau, na za rangi nyekundu, naye fundi stadi atatarizi makerubi kwenye mapazia hayo.

english: Make fifty loops along the edge of the end curtain in the first set, and fifty loops along the edge of the corresponding curtain in the second set.
ekegusii: Okore ebioro emerongo etano, obibeke ase ensinyo ye rirondia rinene rie ritang’ani, na emerongo etano ase rirondia rinene ria kabere rigochakera.
swahili: Tengeneza vitanzi hamsini kwenye upindo wa pazia la mwisho la fungu moja, na vivyo hivyo kwenye upindo wa pazia la mwisho la fungu hilo lingine.

english: Make fifty bronze clasps and put them through the loops to join the tent together as a unit.
ekegusii: Oture ebigobanio emerongo etano bi’etai ase ebioro biria, obwatanerie amarondia ayio abere abe eema eyemo engima.
swahili: Kisha tengeneza vifungo hamsini vya shaba, uviingize katika vile vitanzi ili kukaza hema pamoja kuwa kitu kimoja.

english: As for the overlap that remains of the tent curtains, the half curtain that is left over shall hang down over the back of the tabernacle.
ekegusii: Ekeng’ese kie rirondia riria kementire kebekwe gesung’unane, getube magega y’Obomenyo.
swahili: Kuhusu kile kipande cha ziada cha pazia la Hema, nusu ya hilo pazia lililobaki litaningʼinizwa upande wa nyuma wa Hema.

english: And the tent curtains will be a cubit longer on either side, and the excess will hang over the sides of the tabernacle to cover it.
ekegusii: Ekerengo gi’okoboko okomo kie rirondia keringwe, getube Obomenyo ase kera rikere riaye.
swahili: Mapazia ya hema yatakuwa na urefu wa dhiraa moja zaidi pande zote, sehemu itakayobaki itaningʼinia pande zote za Hema ili kuifunika.

english: Also make a covering for the tent out of ram skins dyed red, and over that a covering of fine leather. The Frames and Bases (Exodus 36:20–34)
ekegusii: “Oroisie rirondia ri’amasankwa e chimingichi aakire etaago, ribe rigotuba eema, ne rirondia rinde ri’amasankwa amaterere e ching’iti chia rooche, ribe rikobekwa igoro ye rirondia rie ritang’ani.
swahili: Tengeneza kifuniko cha hema kwa ngozi za kondoo dume zilizotiwa rangi nyekundu, na juu yake kifuniko cha ngozi za pomboo.

english: You are to construct upright frames of acacia wood for the tabernacle.
ekegusii: “Oroisie chibao chi’emekonge ase Obomenyo, echio chiratenenigwe.
swahili: “Tengeneza mihimili ya kusimamisha ya mti wa mshita kwa ajili ya maskani.

english: Each frame is to be ten cubits long and a cubit and a half wide.
ekegusii: Obotambe bwa kera ebao bobe obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko ikomi, na obogare bwaye okoboko okomo na ekeng’ese.
swahili: Kila mhimili uwe na urefu wa dhiraa kumi na upana wa dhiraa moja na nusu,

english: Two tenons must be connected to each other for each frame. Make all the frames of the tabernacle in this way.
ekegusii: Okore chintamang’o ibere ase kera ebao, ase chibao echio chirabwatanerigwe. Naboigo oranyare koroisia chibao chionsi chi’Obomenyo.
swahili: zikiwa na ndimi mbili zilizo sambamba kila mmoja na mwingine. Tengeneza mihimili yote ya maskani jinsi hii.

english: Construct twenty frames for the south side of the tabernacle,
ekegusii: Koraroisie chibao echio, oroisie emerongo ebere ase ensemo ya Irianyi.
swahili: Tengeneza mihimili ishirini kwa ajili ya upande wa kusini wa maskani,

english: with forty silver bases under the twenty frames—two bases for each frame, one under each tenon.
ekegusii: Oroisie ne chinterekerero chi’echifeta emerongo ene, chibe ibere ibere ase kera ebao ase okobwaterania chintamang’o chiaye ibere.
swahili: kisha tengeneza vitako arobaini vya fedha vya kuweka chini ya hiyo mihimili, vitako viwili kwa kila mhimili, kimoja chini ya kila ulimi.

english: Each curtain shall be twenty-eight cubits long and four cubits wide —all curtains the same size.
ekegusii: Obotambe bwa kera egetambaa bobe obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko emerongo ebere, na atano na atato, na obogare bwaye amaboko ane. Ebitambaa ebio bionsi bibe bi’ekerengo ekemo.
swahili: Mapazia yote yatatoshana kwa ukubwa: kila moja litakuwa na urefu wa dhiraa ishirini na nane, na upana wa dhiraa nne

english: For the second side of the tabernacle, the north side, make twenty frames
ekegusii: Ase ensemo ya sugusu y’Obomenyo oroisie chibao emerongo ebere,
swahili: Kuhusu upande wa kaskazini wa maskani, tengeneza mihimili ishirini

english: and forty silver bases—two bases under each frame.
ekegusii: amo ne chinterekerero chi’echifeta emerongo ene, ibere ibere ase kera ebao.
swahili: na vitako arobaini vya fedha, viwili chini ya kila mhimili.

english: Make six frames for the rear of the tabernacle, the west side,
ekegusii: Ase ensemo ya magega y’Obomenyo eyerochie bosongo, oroisie chibao isano nemo,
swahili: Kisha tengeneza mihimili sita kwa mwisho ulio mbali, yaani upande wa magharibi wa maskani,

english: and two frames for the two back corners of the tabernacle,
ekegusii: naende chibao ibere chie chikoona chi’Obomenyo ensemo ya magega.
swahili: na pia utengeneze mihimili miwili ya pembe za upande ulio mbali.

english: coupled together from bottom to top and fitted into a single ring. These will serve as the two corners.
ekegusii: Kera ebao ase echio ibere ebwatanigwe ne chibao chie chinsinyo, korwa inse goika igoro ase ebonyi entang’ani ere. Ase enchera eyio chibao ibere chibekwe ase chikoona ibere.
swahili: Katika pembe hizi mbili ni lazima mihimili yake iwe miwili kuanzia chini mpaka juu, na iingizwe kwenye pete moja; mihimili ya pembe hizi mbili itafanana.

english: So there are to be eight frames and sixteen silver bases—two under each frame.
ekegusii: Chibao chionsi nigo chirabe isano na isato, ne chinterekerero chiabo chi’echifeta ikomi na isano nemo, ibere ibere inse ya kera ebao.
swahili: Kwa hiyo itakuwepo mihimili minane, na vitako kumi na sita vya fedha, viwili chini ya kila mhimili.

english: You are also to make five crossbars of acacia wood for the frames on one side of the tabernacle,
ekegusii: “Obaache emeriibo ye chibao chi’emekonge, etano ase okoriiba chibao chie rikere erimo ri’Obomenyo,
swahili: “Pia tengeneza mataruma ya mti wa mshita: matano kwa ajili ya mihimili ya upande mmoja wa maskani,

english: five for those on the other side, and five for those on the rear side of the tabernacle, to the west.
ekegusii: na etano ase okoriiba chibao chie rikere rinde, na etano y’ensemo ya magega, eyerochie bosongo.
swahili: matano kwa ajili ya mihimili ya upande mwingine, na matano kwa ajili ya mihimili ya upande wa magharibi, mwisho kabisa mwa maskani.

english: The central crossbar in the middle of the frames shall extend from one end to the other.
ekegusii: Omoriibo o gati‐gati obekwe omogima, oriibe korwa ensinyo eyemo goika eyende.
swahili: Taruma la katikati litapenya katikati ya mihimili kutoka mwisho mmoja hadi mwisho mwingine.

english: Overlay the frames with gold and make gold rings to hold the crossbars. Also overlay the crossbars with gold.
ekegusii: Oome chibao echio netaabu na okore chibonyi chi’echitaabu ase emeriibo erasoigwe, na emeriibo eria oyeoome netaabu.
swahili: Funika hiyo mihimili kwa dhahabu, kisha tengeneza pete za dhahabu ambazo zitashikilia hayo mataruma. Pia funika hayo mataruma kwa dhahabu.

english: Five of the curtains are to be joined together, and the other five joined as well.
ekegusii: Ebitambaa bitano bibwatanigwe bibe rirondia erimo. Naboigo nebitambaa binde bitano.
swahili: Unganisha mapazia matano pamoja; fanya vivyo hivyo kwa hayo mengine matano.

english: So you are to set up the tabernacle according to the pattern shown you on the mountain. The Veil (Exodus 36:35–36)
ekegusii: Otenenie Obomenyo obwo buna nakworogetie ase egetunwa.
swahili: “Simamisha Hema sawasawa na mfano ulioonyeshwa kule mlimani.

english: Make a veil of blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and finely spun linen, with cherubim skillfully worked into it.
ekegusii: “Oroisie etoto ye chiusi chi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, amo ne chiusi chi’egatani engiya, chisisire. Omoroisia omong’aini ayeroisie ebe nemegwekano y’ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba.
swahili: “Tengeneza pazia la nyuzi za rangi ya buluu, za zambarau, na za rangi nyekundu na kitani safi iliyosokotwa vizuri, naye fundi stadi atirizi makerubi kwenye hilo pazia.

english: Hang it with gold hooks on four posts of acacia wood, overlaid with gold and standing on four silver bases.
ekegusii: Osunge etoto eria y’egetambaa ase chisiiro inye chi’emekonge chioomire netaabu, chire nebigobanio bie chitaabu, chiratenene ase chinterekerero inye chi’echifeta.
swahili: Litundike kwa kulabu za dhahabu kwenye nguzo nne za mti wa mshita ambazo zimefunikwa kwa dhahabu, zikiwa zimesimamishwa kwenye vitako vinne vya fedha.

english: And hang the veil from the clasps and place the ark of the Testimony behind the veil. So the veil will separate the Holy Place from the Most Holy Place.
ekegusii: Osunge etoto eria inse y’ebigobanio, obeke Esanduki eyere ne chibao chiriikire oborori moino y’etoto. Etoto eria yaatanane Aase Aachenu korwa ase Aase Aachenu Mono.
swahili: Ningʼiniza pazia hilo kwenye vifungo, kisha weka Sanduku la Ushuhuda nyuma ya pazia. Pazia litatenganisha Mahali Patakatifu kutoka Patakatifu pa Patakatifu.

english: Put the mercy seat on the ark of the Testimony in the Most Holy Place.
ekegusii: Erio obeke oboikaranso bw’amaabera igoro y’Esanduki eria ere ne chibao chiriikire oborori ime y’Aase Aachenu Mono.
swahili: Weka kifuniko cha kiti cha rehema juu ya Sanduku la Ushuhuda ndani ya Patakatifu pa Patakatifu.

english: And place the table outside the veil on the north side of the tabernacle, and put the lampstand opposite the table, on the south side. The Curtain for the Entrance (Exodus 36:37–38)
ekegusii: Obeke emesa isiko y’etoto ensemo ya sugusu, na ekebekerero gie chitaaya ensemo ya Irianyi, ase Obomenyo ime.
swahili: Weka meza nje ya pazia upande wa kaskazini wa Hema, kisha weka kinara cha taa upande wa kusini wa Hema.

english: For the entrance to the tent, you are to make a curtain embroidered with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and finely spun linen.
ekegusii: Naende ase egesoero ki’eema oroisie egetambaa korwa ase chiusi chi’egatani engiya chisisire, amo ne chiusi chi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, buna omoroisia omong’aini aranyare gokeroisia.
swahili: “Kwa ajili ya ingilio la hema, tengeneza pazia la nyuzi za rangi ya buluu, za zambarau, na za rangi nyekundu na kitani safi iliyosokotwa vizuri, kazi ya mtarizi.

english: Make five posts of acacia wood for the curtain, overlay them with gold hooks, and cast five bronze bases for them.
ekegusii: Naende obaache chisiiro isano chi’emekonge ase ogosunga egetambaa ekio, ochioome netaabu; oture ebigobanio bie chitaai. Okore chinterekerero inye chie chitaai chinyititoire, chibe ase chisiiro echio.”
swahili: Tengeneza kulabu za dhahabu kwa ajili ya hilo pazia, na nguzo tano za mshita zilizofunikwa kwa dhahabu. Kisha mimina vitako vitano vya shaba kwa ajili yake.

english: Make loops of blue material on the edge of the end curtain in the first set, and do the same for the end curtain in the second set.
ekegusii: Okore ebioro bie chiusi chiburu, obibeke ase ensinyo y’egetambaa eke kere ensinyo y’ensemo eyemo ya kera rirondia.
swahili: Tengeneza vitanzi vya kitambaa cha buluu kwenye upindo wa pazia la mwisho la fungu la kwanza, na ufanye vivyo hivyo na pazia la fungu la mwisho.

english: Make fifty loops on one curtain and fifty loops on the end curtain of the second set, so that the loops line up opposite one another.
ekegusii: Okore ebioro emerongo etano, obibeke ase egetambaa kegochakera rirondia rie ritang’ani, na emerongo etano ase egetambaa kegokoorera rirondia ria kabere. Ebioro bia kera rirondia bibe bichikaine.
swahili: Fanya vitanzi hamsini katika pazia mmoja, na vitanzi vingine hamsini kwenye pazia la mwisho la fungu hilo lingine, nazo vitanzi vyote vielekeane.

english: Make fifty gold clasps as well, and join the curtains together with the clasps, so that the tabernacle will be a unit. The Eleven Curtains of Goat Hair (Exodus 36:14–19)
ekegusii: Oture ebigobanio bie chitaabu emerongo etano, obwateranie amarondia ayio abere amo, ebe eema eyemo y’Obomenyo.
swahili: Kisha tengeneza vifungo hamsini vya dhahabu ili vitumike kufunga na kuunganisha mapazia pamoja kufanya Hema liwe kitu kimoja.

english: You are to make curtains of goat hair for the tent over the tabernacle—eleven curtains in all.
ekegusii: “Oroisie amarondia ikomi na rimo ay’amanya e chimbori, abe eema y’ogotuba Obomenyo obwo.
swahili: “Tengeneza mapazia kumi na moja ya singa za mbuzi kwa ajili ya kufunika maskani.

english: Each of the eleven curtains is to be the same size—thirty cubits long and four cubits wide.
ekegusii: Obotambe bwa kera rirondia bobe obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko emerongo etato, na obogare bwaye amaboko ane. Amarondia onsi ikomi na rimo abe ay’ekerengo ekemo.
swahili: Mapazia hayo kumi na moja yatakuwa na kipimo kimoja, yaani urefu wa dhiraa thelathini, na upana wa dhiraa nne.

english: Join five of the curtains into one set and the other six into another. Then fold the sixth curtain over double at the front of the tent.
ekegusii: Obwatanie amarondia atano amo, na amarondia ande atano na rimo oyabwateranie ao. Erio oringe erimo rirondia ria gatano na rimo igoro y’egesoero ki’eema.
swahili: Unganisha hayo mapazia matano yawe fungu moja, na hayo mengine sita yawe fungu lingine. Kunja hilo pazia la sita mara mbili mbele ya maskani.

english: “You are to build an altar of acacia wood. The altar must be square, five cubits long, five cubits wide, and three cubits high.
ekegusii: “Oagache egesasiimero gie chibao chi’emekonge. Obotambe bwaye bobe obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko atano, na obogare bwaye amaboko atano, nabo chinsemo chionsi inye chibe chireng’aine; na obotambe bwaye gochia igoro bobe obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko atato.
swahili: “Jenga madhabahu ya mbao za mti wa mshita, kimo chake kiwe dhiraa tatu; itakuwa mraba, urefu wake dhiraa tano, na upana wake dhiraa tano.

english: with twenty posts and twenty bronze bases, and silver hooks and bands on the posts.
ekegusii: Chisiiro chikobibwata chibe emerongo ebere chie chitaai, ne chinterekerero chiabo emerongo ebere chie chitaai. Ebigobanio bie chisiiro chiria ne chinuga chiabo chibe chi’echifeta.
swahili: pamoja na nguzo ishirini na vitako vya shaba ishirini, na kulabu na tepe za fedha juu ya hizo nguzo.

english: Likewise there are to be curtains on the north side, a hundred cubits long, with twenty posts and twenty bronze bases, and with silver hooks and bands on the posts.
ekegusii: Naboigo ase ensemo ya sugusu oroisie ebitambaa bire nobotambe bw’ekerengo ki’amaboko rigana erimo, bisiirwe ne chisiiro emerongo ebere, ne chinterekerero chiabo emerongo ebere chie chitaai. Ebigobanio amo ne chinuga chiabo bibe bie chifeta.
swahili: Upande wa kaskazini utakuwa na urefu wa dhiraa mia moja, nao utakuwa na mapazia, pamoja na nguzo ishirini na vitako vya shaba ishirini, pamoja na kulabu na tepe za fedha juu ya hizo nguzo.

english: The curtains on the west side of the courtyard shall be fifty cubits wide, with ten posts and ten bases.
ekegusii: Ase obogare bw’eraaro ensemo ya bosongo oroisie ebitambaa bi’ekerengo ki’amaboko emerongo etano, ne chisiiro ikomi, amo ne chinterekerero chiabo ikomi.
swahili: “Upande wa magharibi wa ua utakuwa na upana wa dhiraa hamsini, nao utakuwa na mapazia, na nguzo kumi na vitako vyake kumi.

english: The east side of the courtyard, toward the sunrise, is to be fifty cubits wide.
ekegusii: Obogare bw’ensemo ya bosio, erochie moocha, bobe obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko emerongo etano.
swahili: Upande wa mwisho wa mashariki jua linakochomoza, ua pia utakuwa na upana wa dhiraa hamsini.

english: Make the curtains on one side fifteen cubits long, with three posts and three bases,
ekegusii: Ase ensemo eyemo y’egesoero bibe ebitambaa bi’ekerengo ki’amaboko ikomi na atano, bisiirwe ne chisiiro isato ne chinterekerero chiabo isato.
swahili: Mapazia yenye urefu wa dhiraa kumi na tano yatakuwa upande mmoja wa ingilio, pamoja na nguzo tatu na vitako vitatu.

english: and the curtains on the other side fifteen cubits long, with three posts and three bases.
ekegusii: Naboigo nensemo ende y’egesoero bibekwe ebitambaa bi’ekerengo ki’amaboko ikomi na atano, bisiirwe ne chisiiro isato, amo ne chinterekerero chiaye isato.
swahili: Kutakuwepo tena na mapazia ya dhiraa kumi na tano kwa upande mwingine wa ingilio, pamoja na nguzo tatu na vitako vitatu.

english: The gate of the courtyard shall be twenty cubits long, with a curtain embroidered with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and finely spun linen. It shall have four posts and four bases.
ekegusii: Na ase egesoero oroisie egetambaa gi’ekerengo ki’amaboko emerongo ebere, korwa ase chiusi chi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, amo ne chiusi chi’egatani engiya chisisire, ebe emeremo y’omoroisia omong’aini. Egetambaa ekio gesiirwe ne chisiiro inye ne chinterekerero chiabo inye.
swahili: “Kuhusu ingilio la ua, weka pazia lenye urefu wa dhiraa ishirini la nyuzi za rangi ya buluu, za zambarau, na za rangi nyekundu pamoja na kitani iliyosokotwa vizuri, kazi ya mtarizi. Pazia hilo litashikiliwa na nguzo nne na vitako vinne.

english: All the posts around the courtyard shall have silver bands, silver hooks, and bronze bases.
ekegusii: Chisiiro chionsi echietanaine eraaro nigo chirabe ne chinuga na ebigobanio bie chifeta, ne chinterekerero chiabo chibe chie chitaai.
swahili: Nguzo zote zinazozunguka ua zitakuwa na tepe na kulabu za fedha, na vitako vya shaba.

english: The entire courtyard shall be a hundred cubits long and fifty cubits wide, with curtains of finely spun linen five cubits high, and with bronze bases.
ekegusii: Obotambe bw’eraaro eyio bobe obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko rigana erimo, na obogare bwaye amaboko emerongo etano. Egetambaa keria geetanaine eraaro kebe nobotambe gochia igoro bw’ekerengo ki’amaboko atano na keroisigwe ne chiusi chi’egatani engiya chisisire. Chinterekerero chi’eraaro chibe echie chitaai.
swahili: Ua wa kukutania utakuwa na urefu wa dhiraa mia moja na upana wa dhiraa hamsini, ukiwa na mapazia ya kitani yaliyosokotwa vizuri yenye urefu wa dhiraa tano kwenda juu na vitako vya shaba.

english: All the utensils of the tabernacle for every use, including all its tent pegs and the tent pegs of the courtyard, shall be made of bronze. The Oil for the Lamps (Leviticus 24:1–4)
ekegusii: Ebikorero bi’Obomenyo ebirabe bigokorerwa ase emeremo ende yonsi, amo nebirochi bi’ebitambaa na ebi’eraaro bionsi, nigo birabe ebie chitaai.” Okorendwa gwe chitaaya (Abal 24:1-4)
swahili: Vyombo vingine vyote vinavyotumika katika maskani kwa shughuli yoyote, pamoja na vigingi vyote na hata vile vya ua, vitakuwa vya shaba. Mafuta Ya Kinara Cha Taa (Walawi 24:1-4)

english: Make a horn on each of its four corners, so that the horns are of one piece, and overlay it with bronze.
ekegusii: Ase chikoona inye chi’egesasiimero oroisie emegwekano ye ching’unchara inye. Ching’unchara echio nigo chirabe egento ekemo negesasiimero; oome gionsi netai.
swahili: Tengeneza upembe kwenye kila pembe ya hizo pembe nne, ili zile pembe na madhabahu ziwe zimeungana, na ufunike madhabahu kwa shaba.

english: And you are to command the Israelites to bring you pure oil of pressed olives for the light, to keep the lamps burning continually.
ekegusii: “Ochike Abaisraeli barente amaguta amaya, amitire korwa ase amazeituni, akobekwa ase chitaaya kera rituko, chibe chikogenderera gwoka botambe.
swahili: “Utawaamuru Waisraeli wakuletee mafuta safi ya zeituni yaliyokamuliwa kwa ajili ya mwanga ili zile taa ziwake mfululizo.

english: In the Tent of Meeting, outside the veil that is in front of the Testimony, Aaron and his sons are to tend the lamps before the LORD from evening until morning. This is to be a permanent statute for the Israelites for the generations to come.
ekegusii: Ime y’Eema y’Omosangererekano, isiko y’etoto eria ekeng’ete aase chibao chirikire oborori chibekire, Aroni na abamura baye inababe bakorenda chitaaya chiria chigwoka korwa mogoroba goika mambia, ase obosio bw’Omonene. Okwo nigo korabe ogochika ase Abaisraeli ebiare ase ebiare.”
swahili: Katika Hema la Kukutania, nje ya pazia lililo mbele ya Sanduku la Ushuhuda, Aroni na wanawe watahakikisha kuwa taa hizo zinawaka kuanzia jioni mpaka asubuhi mbele za Bwana. Hili litakuwa agizo la milele miongoni mwa Waisraeli kwa vizazi vyote vijavyo.

english: Make all its utensils of bronze—its pots for removing ashes, its shovels, its sprinkling bowls, its meat forks, and its firepans.
ekegusii: Okore chindogio chi’okobuucha ribu korwa ase egesasiimero. Naende okore ebichiko, na ebitaabo, ne chigami, ne chindogio chi’okorenta omorero. Ebinto ebi bionsi biroisigwe korwa ase chitaai.
swahili: Tengeneza vyombo vyake vyote kwa shaba: vyungu vyake vya kuondolea majivu, masepetu, mabakuli ya kunyunyizia, uma za nyama, na vyombo vya kuchukulia moto.

english: Construct for it a grate of bronze mesh, and make a bronze ring at each of the four corners of the mesh.
ekegusii: Okore boigo egechungi gi’etai na obeke chibonyi inye chie chitaai ase chikoona chiaye inye.
swahili: Kisha tengenezea hayo madhabahu wavu wa shaba, na utengeneze pete za shaba kwenye kila moja ya hizo pembe nne za huo wavu.

english: Set the grate beneath the ledge of the altar, so that the mesh comes halfway up the altar.
ekegusii: Obeke egechungi eke korwa inse y’orosingo geike gochia gati‐gati y’egesasiimero.
swahili: Weka wavu huo chini ya ukingo wa madhabahu ili ufikie nusu ya kimo cha madhabahu.

english: Additionally, make poles of acacia wood for the altar and overlay them with bronze.
ekegusii: Obaache emiaro y’emekonge ase egesasiimero ekio, oyeome netai.
swahili: Tengeneza mipiko ya mti wa mshita kwa ajili ya madhabahu, na uifunike kwa shaba.

english: The poles are to be inserted into the rings so that the poles are on two sides of the altar when it is carried.
ekegusii: Oyesoyie ase chibonyi echio chie chinsemo ibere chi’egesasiimero, ebeo ekero gekobogorigwa.
swahili: Hiyo mipiko itaingizwa kwenye zile pete ili iwe pande mbili za madhabahu inapobebwa.

english: Construct the altar with boards so that it is hollow. It is to be made just as you were shown on the mountain. The Courtyard (Exodus 38:9–20)
ekegusii: Egesasiimero keagachwe ne chibao, ime getigwe giasaime. Okeroisie buna kworogetigwe ase egetunwa.” Eraaro y’Obomenyo (Okong’ 38:9-20)
swahili: Tengeneza madhabahu yawe na uvungu ndani yake ukitumia mbao. Utaitengeneza sawasawa na vile ulivyoonyeshwa mlimani. Ua Wa Kukutania (Kutoka 38:9-20)

english: You are also to make a courtyard for the tabernacle. On the south side of the courtyard make curtains of finely spun linen, a hundred cubits long on one side,
ekegusii: “Oroisie eraaro y’Obomenyo. Ase ensemo ya Irianyi oroisie ebitambaa bie chiusi chindabu chi’egatani chisisire, bibe ekerengo ki’amaboko rigana erimo, bibe bigokenga eraaro ensemo eyemo.
swahili: “Tengeneza ua kwa ajili ya Hema la Kukutania. Upande wa kusini utakuwa na urefu wa dhiraa mia moja, na utakuwa na mapazia ya kitani iliyosokotwa vizuri,

english: “Next, have your brother Aaron brought to you from among the Israelites, along with his sons Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar, to serve Me as priests.
ekegusii: Orangerie Aroni, momura omino, omobeke abe ange naye boigo nabamura baye obatanane korwa ase Abaisraeli, erio obarente ase obosio bwao, babe bagonkorera emeremo y’obokuani, ere Aroni amo nabamura baye Nadabu, na Abihu, na Eleazari, na Itamari.
swahili: “Mtwae Aroni ndugu yako aliyeletwa kwako kutoka miongoni mwa Waisraeli, pamoja na wanawe Nadabu, Abihu, Eleazari na Ithamari, ili wanitumikie katika kazi ya ukuhani.

english: six of their names on one stone and the remaining six on the other, in the order of their birth.
ekegusii: amarieta atano na rimo ase rigena erimo, na atano na rimo ase rigena rinde, ase omooroberio bw’okoiborwa kwabo.
swahili: kufuatana na walivyozaliwa: majina sita katika kito kimoja, na mengine sita katika kito kingine.

english: Engrave the names of the sons of Israel on the two stones the way a gem cutter engraves a seal. Then mount the stones in gold filigree settings.
ekegusii: Ase chisemi chi’omooroisia omanyete buya gotura na komang’a ekemanyererio, omang’e amarieta ’abamura ba Israeli ase amagena aria abere. Erio obeke amagena aria ase ebikonde bie chitaabu.
swahili: Yachore majina ya wana wa Israeli juu ya vito hivyo viwili kama vile sonara anavyochonga muhuri. Kisha uvitie vito hivyo katika vijalizo vya dhahabu,

english: Fasten both stones on the shoulder pieces of the ephod as memorial stones for the sons of Israel. Aaron is to bear their names on his two shoulders as a memorial before the LORD.
ekegusii: Oyabeeke ase ebitwang’a bi’amareko bi’egesibao keria ki’obokuani, abe ase okoinyora abamura ba Israeli. Naboigo Aroni abogorie amarieta abo ase amareko aye abere, abe ekeinyorio ase obosio bw’Omonene botambe.
swahili: na uvifungie juu ya vipande vya mabega ya kisibau yawe kama vito vya ukumbusho kwa wana wa Israeli. Aroni atavaa majina hayo mabegani mwake kama kumbukumbu mbele za Bwana.

english: Fashion gold filigree settings
ekegusii: Oture ebikonde bibere bi’etaabu,
swahili: Tengeneza vijalizo vya dhahabu

english: and two chains of pure gold, made of braided cord work; and attach these chains to the settings. The Breastpiece (Exodus 39:8–21)
ekegusii: na okore ebichanga bibere bie chitaabu chichenire, bisisire buna engori, bibwatanigwe nebikonde biria. Egesembe ki’obokuani (Okong’ 39:8-21)
swahili: na mikufu miwili ya dhahabu safi iliyosokotwa kama kamba, na uifunge mikufu hiyo kwenye vijalizo. Kifuko Cha Kifuani (Kutoka 39:8-21)

english: You are also to make a breastpiece of judgment with the same workmanship as the ephod. Construct it with gold, with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and with finely spun linen.
ekegusii: Oroisie egesembe gi’ekina ase Omokuani. Omoroisia omong’aini akeroisie ase egetambaa kere buna eki’egesibao ki’obokuani, korwa ase chiusi chi’echitaabu, na echi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, amo nechi’egatani engiya chisisire.
swahili: “Fanyiza kifuko cha kifuani kwa ajili ya kufanya maamuzi, kazi ya fundi stadi. Kitengeneze kama kile kisibau: cha dhahabu, na nyuzi za rangi ya buluu, za zambarau, na za rangi nyekundu, cha kitani safi iliyosokotwa.

english: It must be square when folded over double, a span long and a span wide.
ekegusii: Egesembe keria kebe keringire rimo. Obotambe bwaye bobe chisentimita emerongo ebere, na ibere, na obogare bwaye boigo.
swahili: Kitakuwa cha mraba, chenye urefu wa shibiri moja na upana wa shibiri moja, na kikunjwe mara mbili.

english: And mount on it a setting of gemstones, four rows of stones: In the first row there shall be a ruby, a topaz, and an emerald;
ekegusii: Obeke emeng’ororia ene y’amagena e rigori rinene ase egesembe keria. Ase omong’ororia bw’eritang’ani obeke saridio, na topasio, na sumaridi;
swahili: Kisha weka safu nne za vito vya thamani juu yake. Safu ya kwanza itakuwa na akiki, yakuti manjano na zabarajadi;

english: in the second row a turquoise, a sapphire, and a diamond;
ekegusii: na ase oyo o kabere alimasi, na safiro, na yasipi;
swahili: katika safu ya pili itakuwa na almasi, yakuti samawi na zumaridi;

english: in the third row a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;
ekegusii: na ase oyo o gatato hiakinto, na agati, na ametisito;
swahili: safu ya tatu itakuwa na hiakintho, akiki nyekundu na amethisto;

english: Make holy garments for your brother Aaron, to give him glory and splendor.
ekegusii: Oroiserie Aroni, momura omino, chianga chinchenu chi’obonene na echi’oboseera.
swahili: Mshonee Aroni ndugu yako mavazi matakatifu ili yampe ukuu na heshima.

english: and in the fourth row a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper. Mount these stones in gold filigree settings.
ekegusii: na ase oyo o kane kurusolito, na oiniki, na berulo. Amagena ayio onsi abekwe ase ebikonde bie chitaabu.
swahili: na safu ya nne itakuwa na krisolitho, shohamu na yaspi. Yote yatiwe kwenye vijalizo vya dhahabu.

english: The twelve stones are to correspond to the names of the sons of Israel, each engraved like a seal with the name of one of the twelve tribes.
ekegusii: Amagena ayio nigo arabe ikomi na abere, abe namarieta ’abamura ba Israeli. Amarieta ayio amang’erwe buna omonto akomang’a ekemanyererio. Kera rigena ribe nerieta ri’egesaku ekemo ki’ebisaku biabo ikomi na bibere.
swahili: Patakuwa na vito kumi na viwili, kila kimoja kwa jina mojawapo la wana wa Israeli, kila kimoja kichorwe kama muhuri kikiwa na jina mojawapo la yale makabila kumi na mawili.

english: For the breastpiece, make braided chains like cords of pure gold.
ekegusii: Okore ebichanga bie chitaabu chichenire bisisire, bibekwe ase egesembe keria.
swahili: “Kwa ajili ya kile kifuko cha kifuani, tengeneza mikufu ya dhahabu safi, iliyosokotwa kama kamba.

english: You are also to make two gold rings and fasten them to the two corners of the breastpiece.
ekegusii: Okore boigo chibonyi ibere chi’etaabu, ochibeke ase emego ya igoro y’egesembe keria.
swahili: Tengeneza pete mbili za dhahabu kwa ajili yake, uzifungie kwenye pembe mbili za hicho kifuko cha kifuani.

english: Then fasten the two gold chains to the two gold rings at the corners of the breastpiece,
ekegusii: Osiberanie ebichanga ebi bibere bie chitaabu ase chibonyi chi’emego ya igoro y’egesembe keria.
swahili: Funga ile mikufu miwili ya dhahabu kwenye hizo pete zilizo katika pembe za hicho kifuko cha kifuani,

english: and fasten the other ends of the two chains to the two filigree settings, attaching them to the shoulder pieces of the ephod at the front.
ekegusii: Chinsinyo chinde chi’ebichanga biria bibere ochisiberanie nebikonde biria bibere, naende obibwateranie bionsi ase ebitwanga bi’amareko bire bosio ase egesibao ki’obokuani.
swahili: nazo zile ncha nyingine za mkufu zifunge kwenye vile vijalizo viwili, na uzishikamanishe na vile vipande vya mabega vya kile kisibau upande wa mbele.

english: Make two more gold rings and attach them to the other two corners of the breastpiece, on the inside edge next to the ephod.
ekegusii: Okore chibonyi chinde ibere chi’echitaabu, ochibeke ase egesembe keria ase emego ebere ya inse korwa magega, echigeete egesibao.
swahili: Tengeneza pete mbili za dhahabu, uzishikamanishe kwenye pembe mbili za chini, upande wa ndani wa kifuko cha kifuani karibu na kisibau.

english: Make two additional gold rings and attach them to the bottom of the two shoulder pieces of the ephod, on its front, near its seam just above its woven waistband.
ekegusii: Naende okore chibonyi chinde ibere chi’echitaabu, ochibwateranie ase ebitwanga biria bibere bi’amareko bi’egesibao bire bosio, ang’e nomobarero, igoro y’orokini rw’egesibao.
swahili: Tengeneza pete nyingine mbili za dhahabu, na uzishikamanishe sehemu ya chini ya vipande vya mabega upande wa mbele wa kile kisibau, karibu na pindo juu kidogo ya mshipi wa kiunoni wa kisibau.

english: The rings of the breastpiece shall be tied to the rings of the ephod with a cord of blue yarn, so that the breastpiece is above the waistband of the ephod and does not swing out from the ephod.
ekegusii: Chibonyi chiria chibekire ase egesembe chibwateranigwe ne chibonyi chi’egesibao neusi eburu; erio egesembe keria kebeere orokini igoro, tigecha gosuka.
swahili: Pete za kifuko cha kifuani zitafungwa kwenye pete zile za kisibau kwa kamba ya buluu, ziunganishwe na ule mshipi wa kiunoni, ili kifuko cha kifuani kisisogee kutoka kwenye kile kisibau.

english: Whenever Aaron enters the Holy Place, he shall bear the names of the sons of Israel over his heart on the breastpiece of judgment, as a continual reminder before the LORD.
ekegusii: Naboigo Aroni arabogorie amarieta ’abamura ba Israeli ase egesembe keria gi’ekina igoro y’enkoro yaye ekero agosoa ime y’Aase Aachenu, ayarente abe ekeinyorio botambe ase obosio bw’Omonene.
swahili: “Wakati wowote Aroni aingiapo Mahali Patakatifu, atakuwa na yale majina ya wana wa Israeli moyoni mwake juu ya kile kifuko cha kifuani cha uamuzi kama kumbukumbu ya kudumu mbele za Bwana.

english: You are to instruct all the skilled craftsmen, whom I have filled with a spirit of wisdom, to make garments for Aaron’s consecration, so that he may serve Me as priest.
ekegusii: Oteebie abaroisia abang’aini, abwo naeire obong’aini ne chisemi, baroiserie Aroni chianga, erinde aatananwe abe ogonkorera emeremo y’obokuani.
swahili: Waambie mafundi stadi wote niliowapa hekima katika shughuli hiyo wamtengenezee Aroni mavazi hayo, ili awekwe wakfu, anitumikie katika kazi ya ukuhani.

english: And place the Urim and Thummim in the breastpiece of judgment, so that they will also be over Aaron’s heart whenever he comes before the LORD. Aaron will continually carry the judgment of the sons of Israel over his heart before the LORD. Additional Priestly Garments (Exodus 39:22–31)
ekegusii: Obeke Urimu na Tumimu (engencho yaye omobaso na oboikeranu) ime y’egesembe gi’ekina bibe igoro y’enkoro ya Aroni, ekero akogenda ase obosio bw’Omonene. Ekero Aroni are ase obosio bw’Omonene abogorie ekiorokererio gi’ekina botambe ase engencho y’Abaisraeli. Chianga chinde chi’abakuani (Okong’ 39:22-31)
swahili: Pia weka Urimu na Thumimu ndani ya kifuko cha kifuani, yawe juu ya moyo wa Aroni kila mara aingiapo mbele za Bwana. Kwa hiyo siku zote Aroni atakuwa na uwezo kufanya maamuzi kwa ajili ya wana wa Israeli mbele za Bwana. Mavazi Mengine Ya Kikuhani (Kutoka 39:22-31)

english: You are to make the robe of the ephod entirely of blue cloth,
ekegusii: Okore eganchwa korwa ase egetambaa keroisirie ne chiusi chire buru chioka.
swahili: “Shona joho la kisibau lote kwa kitambaa cha rangi ya buluu tupu,

english: with an opening at its top in the center. Around the opening shall be a woven collar with an opening like that of a garment, so that it will not tear.
ekegusii: Obochore engoro gati gati, ase omotwe ogosoera, oyebeke ekenario buna egi’esati, techa gotandoka.
swahili: na katikati uweke nafasi ya kuingizia kichwa. Kutakuwa na utepe uliofumwa, unaofanana na ukosi kuizunguka nafasi hiyo, ili isichanike.

english: Make pomegranates of blue, purple, and scarlet yarn all the way around the lower hem, with gold bells between them,
ekegusii: Okore emegwekano y’amatunda e rikomomanga korwa ase chiusi chi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, oyebeke eetanane omoringero o inse. Ase egati ya kera omogwekano bwe rikomomanga obeke chindege chi’echitaabu.
swahili: Tengeneza makomamanga ya nyuzi za rangi ya buluu, za zambarau, na za rangi nyekundu kuzunguka pindo la hilo joho, na uweke pia vikengele vya dhahabu kati ya hayo makomamanga.

english: alternating the gold bells and pomegranates around the lower hem of the robe.
ekegusii: Naboigo ebe emegwekano ye rikomomanga bwateranie ne chindege chi’echitaabu bietanane omoringero o inse bw’eganchwa.
swahili: Hivyo vikengele vya dhahabu na makomamanga vitapishana kuzunguka upindo wa joho lile.

english: Aaron must wear the robe whenever he ministers, and its sound will be heard when he enters or exits the sanctuary before the LORD, so that he will not die.
ekegusii: Aroni goika ayebeke eganchwa eyio ekero agokora emeremo y’obokuani, na eriogi rie chindege chiria riigweke ekero agosoa Aase Aachenu ase obosio bw’Omonene, na ekero agosoka, erio tabaisa gokwa.
swahili: Ni lazima Aroni alivae anapofanya huduma. Sauti ya hivyo vikengele itasikika anapoingia na kutoka Mahali Patakatifu mbele za Bwana, ili asije akafa.

english: You are to make a plate of pure gold and engrave on it as on a seal: HOLY TO THE LORD.
ekegusii: Okore ebao y’etaabu echenire, na buna omonto akomang’a ekemanyererio omang’ere amang’ana ayio: “Achenirwe ase Omonene”.
swahili: “Tengeneza bamba la dhahabu safi na uchore juu yake maneno haya kama vile muhuri huchorwa: Mtakatifu kwa Bwana.

english: Fasten to it a blue cord to mount it on the turban; it shall be on the front of the turban.
ekegusii: Oyesiberanie bosio bw’ekegogwa ne chiusi chire buru.
swahili: Lifunge hilo bamba kwa kamba ya buluu kwenye kilemba, nalo ni lazima liwe mbele ya kilemba.

english: And it will be worn on Aaron’s forehead, so that he may bear the iniquity of the holy things that the sons of Israel consecrate with regard to all their holy gifts. It shall always be on his forehead, so that they may be acceptable before the LORD.
ekegusii: Aroni ayebogorie ase obosio bwaye igoro. Ase igo abogoreranie na korusia amamocho are nebiegwa ebiraatananwe, ebi’Abaisraeli barabe bakoruera Omonene. Aroni nigo arabe okoyebogoria botambe ase obosio bw’Omonene.
swahili: Aroni alivae bamba hilo kwenye paji la uso wake, naye atachukua hatia kuhusu sadaka takatifu za Waisraeli wanazoweka wakfu, sadaka za aina yoyote. Litakuwa kwenye paji la uso wa Aroni daima ili zikubalike kwa Bwana.

english: You are to weave the tunic with fine linen, make the turban of fine linen, and fashion an embroidered sash.
ekegusii: “Oroisie eganchwa entambe amo nekegogwa korwa ase chiusi chi’egatani engiya, na orokini rwe chiusi chire ne chirangi ao ao.
swahili: “Fuma koti la kitani safi na ufanye kilemba cha kitani safi. Mshipi uwe ni kazi ya mtarizi.

english: These are the garments that they shall make: a breastpiece, an ephod, a robe, a woven tunic, a turban, and a sash. They are to make these holy garments for your brother Aaron and his sons, so that they may serve Me as priests.
ekegusii: Ne chianga baramoroiserie nachio echi: Egesembe ki’obokuani, na egesibao ki’obokuani, na eganchwa, na eganchwa ende erobekanirie egoika inse, na ekegogwa, na orokini. Bakorere Aroni amo nabamura baye chianga chinchenu, erio babe bagonkorera emeremo y’obokuani.
swahili: Haya ndiyo mavazi watakayoshona: kifuko cha kifuani, kisibau, kanzu, joho lililorembwa, kilemba na mshipi. Mavazi haya yatashonwa kwa ajili ya ndugu yako Aroni na wanawe ili wanitumikie katika kazi ya ukuhani.

english: Make tunics, sashes, and headbands for Aaron’s sons, to give them glory and splendor.
ekegusii: “Erio oroiserie abamura ba Aroni chiganchwa, ne chinkini; naende obaroiserie ebigogwa emechoro bi’ogosika na ebi’oboseera:
swahili: Watengenezee wana wa Aroni makoti, mishipi na kofia, ili kuwapa ukuu na heshima.

english: After you put these garments on your brother Aaron and his sons, anoint them, ordain them, and consecrate them so that they may serve Me as priests.
ekegusii: Obekere Aroni, momura omino, amo nabamura baye, chianga echio. Erio obaake amaguta, obaatanane na kobachena, babe bagonkorera emeremo y’obokuani.
swahili: Baada ya kumvika Aroni ndugu yako pamoja na wanawe nguo hizi, watie mafuta na kuwabariki. Waweke wakfu ili wanitumikie katika kazi ya ukuhani.

english: Make linen undergarments to cover their bare flesh, extending from waist to thigh.
ekegusii: Obaroiserie chisirwari chi’egatani, chigoika amariagati abo, chibe chigotuba obogetirianda bwabo.
swahili: “Watengenezee nguo za ndani za kitani zitakazofunika mwili, kutoka kiunoni hadi mapajani.

english: Aaron and his sons must wear them whenever they enter the Tent of Meeting or approach the altar to minister in the Holy Place, so that they will not incur guilt and die. This is to be a permanent statute for Aaron and his descendants.
ekegusii: Aroni na abamura baye goika bachibeke botambe ekero bagosoa Eema y’Omosangererekano, gose kobakogenda ase egesasiimero gokora emeremo y’obokuani Aase Aachenu ime, tibaabaisa kwerentera okomocha na gokwa. Oko nogochika koragenderere ase Aroni na ororeria rwaye.
swahili: Aroni na wanawe ni lazima wavae haya kila wanapoingia katika Hema la Kukutania au wanaposogelea madhabahu wakati wa kutoa huduma katika Mahali Patakatifu, ili wasije wakafanya kosa wakafa. “Haya yawe maagizo ya kudumu kwa Aroni na vizazi vyake.

english: They shall use gold, along with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and fine linen. The Ephod (Exodus 39:1–7)
ekegusii: Nabwo abaroisia bachiroisie korwa ase chiusi chi’echitaabu, na echi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, amo nechi’egatani engiya.
swahili: Waambie watumie dhahabu na nyuzi za rangi ya buluu, za zambarau, na za rangi nyekundu pamoja na kitani safi. Kisibau

english: They are to make the ephod of finely spun linen embroidered with gold, and with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn.
ekegusii: Bakore egesibao ki’obokuani korwa ase chiusi chi’echitaabu na echi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, amo nechi’egatani engiya chisisire; keroisigwe nomooroisia omong’aini.
swahili: “Tengeneza kisibau cha dhahabu, na nyuzi za rangi ya buluu, za zambarau, za rangi nyekundu na kitani safi iliyosokotwa, kazi ya fundi stadi.

english: It shall have two shoulder pieces attached at two of its corners, so it can be fastened.
ekegusii: Egesibao ekio ki’obokuani kebe nebitwanga bibere bi’amareko, aase gekobwateranigwa.
swahili: Kitakuwa na vipande viwili vya mabegani vilivyoshikizwa kwenye pembe zake mbili ili kufungia kisibau.

english: And the skillfully woven waistband of the ephod must be of one piece, of the same workmanship—with gold, with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and with finely spun linen.
ekegusii: Orokini rw’okobwataneria egesibao ekio amo robe rw’egetambaa keria ki’egesibao, keroisirie korwa ase chiusi chi’echitaabu, na echi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, amo nechi’egatani engiya chisisire.
swahili: Mshipi wa kiunoni uliofumwa kwa ustadi utafanana nacho: utakuwa kitu kimoja na hicho kisibau, nao utengenezwe kwa dhahabu na nyuzi za rangi ya buluu, za zambarau, na nyekundu na kwa kitani iliyosokotwa vizuri.

english: Take two onyx stones and engrave on them the names of the sons of Israel:
ekegusii: Orente amagena abere a oiniki, na ase amagena ayio omang’ere amarieta ’abamura ba Israeli:
swahili: “Chukua vito viwili vya shohamu, na uchore juu yake majina ya wana wa Israeli

english: “Now this is what you are to do to consecrate Aaron and his sons to serve Me as priests: Take a young bull and two rams without blemish,
ekegusii: “Aya naro orakore ase Aroni na abamura baye ase okobaatanana, babe bagonkorera emeremo y’obokuani: Orusie eeri ensae ne chimingichi ibere chitari na kemocho ase emebere yabo.
swahili: “Hili ndilo utakalofanya ili kuwaweka wakfu makuhani ili wanitumikie mimi katika kazi ya ukuhani: Chukua fahali mchanga mmoja na kondoo dume wawili wasio na dosari.

english: You are to present the bull at the front of the Tent of Meeting, and Aaron and his sons are to lay their hands on its head.
ekegusii: “Orente eeri bosio bw’Eema y’Omosangererekano; Aroni na abamura baye babeeke amaboko abo ase omotwe bw’eeri eyio.
swahili: “Mlete yule fahali mbele ya Hema la Kukutania, naye Aroni na wanawe wataweka mikono yao juu ya kichwa chake.

english: And you shall slaughter the bull before the LORD at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.
ekegusii: Erio oyenyenyere ase obosio bw’Omonene ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano.
swahili: Mchinje huyo fahali mbele za Bwana kwenye mlango wa Hema la Kukutania.

english: Take some of the blood of the bull and put it on the horns of the altar with your finger; then pour out the rest of the blood at the base of the altar.
ekegusii: Oimokie amanyinga make y’eeri, erinde ogindie nekiara kiao emegwekano ye ching’unchara chi’egesasiimero. Na amanyinga amatigari oyaumore inse ase egesasiimero.
swahili: Chukua sehemu ya damu ya huyo fahali na kuipaka kwenye pembe za hayo madhabahu kwa kidole chako, na damu iliyobaki uimwage sehemu ya chini ya madhabahu.

english: Take all the fat that covers the entrails and the lobe of the liver, and both kidneys with the fat on them, and burn them on the altar.
ekegusii: Orusie ebitinya biria bitubete chinyama chi’enda; naboigo nebi’eriini, ne chinyigo chionsi ibere, amo nebitinya bichitubete; obisambere ase egesasiimero igoro.
swahili: Kisha chukua mafuta yote ya huyo mnyama ya sehemu za ndani, yale yanayofunika ini, figo zote mbili pamoja na mafuta yake, uviteketeze juu ya madhabahu.

english: But burn the flesh of the bull and its hide and dung outside the camp; it is a sin offering.
ekegusii: Korende chinyama chieeri eyio, ne risankwa, enda na eura yonsi obisambere isiko y’egetwori. Ekio nekeng’wanso ase engencho y’ebibe.
swahili: Lakini nyama ya huyo fahali na ngozi yake na matumbo yake utavichoma nje ya kambi. Hii ni sadaka ya dhambi.

english: Take one of the rams, and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on its head.
ekegusii: “Orente emingichi eyemo ase echio ibere, na Aroni na abamura baye babeeke amaboko abo ase omotwe oye.
swahili: “Chukua mmoja wa wale kondoo dume, naye Aroni na wanawe wataweka mikono yao juu ya kichwa chake.

english: You are to slaughter the ram, take its blood, and sprinkle it on all sides of the altar.
ekegusii: Erio oyenyenye na oitorore amanyinga aye ase egesasiimero chinsemo chionsi.
swahili: Mchinje huyo kondoo dume, chukua damu yake na uinyunyize pande zote za hayo madhabahu.

english: Cut the ram into pieces, wash the entrails and legs, and place them with its head and other pieces.
ekegusii: Onache chinyama chi’emingichi eria chibe ebing’ese; osibie chinyama chi’enda eria amo nebirenge, na obibeeke igoro y’ebing’ese biria na omotwe oye.
swahili: Mkate huyo kondoo dume vipande vipande na usafishe sehemu za ndani pamoja na miguu, ukiviweka pamoja na kichwa na vipande vingine.

english: Then burn the entire ram on the altar; it is a burnt offering to the LORD, a pleasing aroma, an offering made by fire to the LORD.
ekegusii: Osambere chinyama echi chionsi chi’emingichi ase egesasiimero igoro. Eke nekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa ase Omonene, ekeng’wanso ki’omorero kere ne rimisu rigiya rikogwenera Omonene.
swahili: Kisha mteketeze huyo kondoo dume mzima juu ya madhabahu. Hii ni sadaka ya kuteketezwa kwa Bwana, harufu ya kupendeza, sadaka iliyotolewa kwa Bwana kwa moto.

english: Take the second ram, and Aaron and his sons are to lay their hands on its head.
ekegusii: “Erio orente emingichi eria ende, na Aroni na abamura baye babeeke amaboko abo ase omotwe oye.
swahili: “Mchukue yule kondoo dume mwingine, naye Aroni na wanawe waweke mikono yao juu ya kichwa chake.

english: along with unleavened bread, unleavened cakes mixed with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil. Make them out of fine wheat flour,
ekegusii: Orusie boigo emegati etabekiri memera na amaandasi atabekiri memera, biroisirie namaguta, na emegati emeoo eakire amaguta. Emegati eyio yonsi eroisigwe korwa ase obosie obonuke bw’engano.
swahili: Kutokana na unga laini wa ngano usiotiwa chachu, tengeneza mikate na maandazi yaliyokandwa kwa mafuta, pamoja na mikate midogo myembamba.

english: Slaughter the ram, take some of its blood, and put it on the right earlobes of Aaron and his sons, on the thumbs of their right hands, and on the big toes of their right feet. Sprinkle the remaining blood on all sides of the altar.
ekegusii: Magega y’ayio oyenyenye, orusie amanyinga make, na ase amanyinga ayio ogindie mesia y’ogoto kwa borio kwa Aroni amo na mesia y’amato ’abamura baye; ogindie boigo ebiara ebinene bi’amaboko abo a borio, na ebiara ebinene bi’amagoro abo a borio. Oitorore amanyinga amatigari ase egesasiimero chinsemo chionsi.
swahili: Mchinje, uchukue sehemu ya damu yake na kuipaka kwenye masikio ya Aroni na wanawe, kwenye vidole gumba vya mikono yao ya kuume, pia kwenye vidole gumba vya miguu yao ya kuume. Kisha nyunyiza hiyo damu pande zote za madhabahu.

english: And take some of the blood on the altar and some of the anointing oil and sprinkle it on Aaron and his garments, as well as on his sons and their garments. Then he and his garments will be consecrated, as well as his sons and their garments.
ekegusii: Orusie amanyinga make ayare ase egesasiimero, na amaguta ayio akweakwa, onyororokerie Aroni ne chianga chiaye, na abamura baye, ne chianga chiabo. Naboigo Aroni na abamura baye baatananwe ase emeremo emechenu, amo ne chianga chiabo.
swahili: Pia chukua sehemu ya damu iliyo juu ya madhabahu na sehemu ya mafuta ya upako, umnyunyizie Aroni na mavazi yake, pia wanawe na mavazi yao. Ndipo Aroni na wanawe pamoja na mavazi yao watakuwa wamewekwa wakfu.

english: Take the fat from the ram, the fat tail, the fat covering the entrails, the lobe of the liver, both kidneys with the fat on them, and the right thigh (since this is a ram for ordination),
ekegusii: “Orusie ebitinya bi’emingichi eyio, na omokera oye ore omonoru, na ebitinya bitubete chinyama chi’enda, na ebi’eriini, ne chinyigo chionsi ibere amo nebitinya bichitubete, na ebachwa ya borio, ekiagera emingichi eyio nigo yarurwe ase ogwatanana abakuani ase emeremo emechenu.
swahili: “Chukua mafuta ya huyu kondoo dume, mafuta ya mkia, mafuta ya sehemu za ndani yale yanayofunika ini, figo zote mbili na mafuta yake, pamoja na paja la kulia. (Huyo ndiye kondoo dume kwa ajili ya kuwaweka wakfu.)

english: along with one loaf of bread, one cake of bread made with oil, and one wafer from the basket of unleavened bread that is before the LORD.
ekegusii: Orusie omogati oyomo, ne rindasi erimo riroisirie namaguta, na omogati oyomo omoo, ebio bitabekiri memera, bire ase egetonga ime, bibekire ase obosio bw’Omonene.
swahili: Kutoka kwenye kile kikapu chenye mikate iliyotengenezwa bila chachu, kilichoko mbele za Bwana, chukua mkate, andazi lililokandwa kwa mafuta na mkate mdogo mwembamba.

english: Put all these in the hands of Aaron and his sons and wave them before the LORD as a wave offering.
ekegusii: Ebi bionsi obibeeke ase amaboko Aroni amo nay’abamura baye, obisungusie bibe okoruegwa ase Omonene.
swahili: Viweke vitu hivi vyote mikononi mwa Aroni na wanawe na uviinue mbele za Bwana kuwa sadaka ya kuinuliwa.

english: Then take them from their hands and burn them on the altar atop the burnt offering as a pleasing aroma before the LORD; it is an offering made by fire to the LORD.
ekegusii: Erio obirusie ase amaboko abo, obisambere ase egesasiimero igoro y’ekeng’wanso keria kere ne rimisu rigiya rikogwenera Omonene. Eke nekeng’wanso ki’omorero.
swahili: Kisha vichukue vitu hivyo kutoka mikononi mwao, uviteketeze juu ya madhabahu pamoja na sadaka ya kuteketezwa kuwa harufu nzuri ya kupendeza kwa Bwana, sadaka iliyotolewa kwa Bwana kwa moto.

english: Take the breast of the ram of Aaron’s ordination and wave it before the LORD as a wave offering, and it will be your portion.
ekegusii: “Obogorie ritaana ri’emingichi eyio yarurwe ase ogwatanana Aroni, orisungusie ribe okoruegwa ase Omonene. Nerio naribe eriao, erigotungetie korwa ase eng’iti eyio.
swahili: Baada ya kuchukua kidari cha huyo kondoo dume wa kuwekwa wakfu kwa Aroni, kiinue mbele za Bwana kuwa sadaka ya kuinuliwa, nayo itakuwa fungu lako.

english: Consecrate for Aaron and his sons the breast of the wave offering that is waved and the thigh of the heave offering that is lifted up from the ram of ordination.
ekegusii: “Nabo ekeo Omokuani akobekwa ensemo, naboigo oraatanane ritaana ri’emingichi eyio yarurwe ekeng’wanso amo nekenama kiaye, ebitari ebio bi’emingichi eyio bibe ebitungetie Aroni amo nabamura baye.
swahili: “Weka wakfu zile sehemu za kondoo dume aliyetumika kwa kumweka wakfu Aroni na wanawe: kidari kile kilichoinuliwa na lile paja lililotolewa.

english: This will belong to Aaron and his sons as a regular portion from the Israelites, for it is the heave offering the Israelites will make to the LORD from their peace offerings.
ekegusii: Ebi nigo birabe bitungetie Abakuani kogenderera botambe korwa ase Abaisraeli, bibe ekeegwa ki’Omonene korwa ase bare, ekeng’wanso kiabo ki’omorembe.
swahili: Siku zote hili litakuwa fungu la kawaida kutoka kwa Waisraeli kwa ajili ya Aroni na wanawe. Hili ni toleo la Waisraeli watakalotoa kwa Bwana kutoka sadaka zao za amani.

english: The holy garments that belong to Aaron will belong to his sons after him, so they can be anointed and ordained in them.
ekegusii: “Chianga chiria chinchenu chia Aroni nigo chiraegwe ab’ororeria rwaye magega g akuure, bachieboyie ekero bagochia goakwa amaguta na gwatananwa.
swahili: “Mavazi matakatifu ya Aroni yatakuwa ya wazao wake ili kwamba waweze kutiwa mafuta na kuwekwa wakfu wakiwa wameyavaa.

english: put them in a basket, and present them in the basket, along with the bull and the two rams.
ekegusii: Oyebeke ase egetonga, oyendetere ebe egetonga ime ekero okondetera ekeng’wanso ki’eeri na egie chimingichi chiria ibere.
swahili: Viwekwe vyote ndani ya kikapu na kuvitoa pamoja na yule fahali na wale kondoo dume wawili.

english: The son who succeeds him as priest and enters the Tent of Meeting to minister in the Holy Place must wear them for seven days. Food for the Priests
ekegusii: Omomura o Aroni, oyorabogorie emeremo y’obokuani ase ribaga ria ise, goika eboyie chianga echi engaki y’amatuko atano na abere, ekero agochia gosoa Eema y’Omosangererekano na gokora emeremo ime y’Aase Aachenu.
swahili: Mwana atakayeingia mahali pake kuwa kuhani na kuja kwenye Hema la Kukutania kuhudumu katika Mahali Patakatifu atayavaa kwa siku saba.

english: You are to take the ram of ordination and boil its flesh in a holy place.
ekegusii: “Oire emingichi eria yarurwe ase ogwatanana abakuani ase emeremo emechenu, oiyekere chinyama chiaye Aase Aachenu.
swahili: “Chukua nyama ya huyo kondoo dume wa kuwaweka wakfu uipike katika Mahali Patakatifu.

english: At the entrance to the Tent of Meeting, Aaron and his sons are to eat the meat of the ram and the bread that is in the basket.
ekegusii: Agwo ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano, Aroni na abamura baye barie chinyama chi’emingichi eria amo nemegati ere ase egetonga ime.
swahili: Aroni na wanawe wataila ile nyama ya huyo kondoo dume pamoja na ile mikate iliyo kwenye hicho kikapu wakiwa hapo ingilio la Hema la Kukutania.

english: They must eat those things by which atonement was made for their ordination and consecration. But no outsider may eat them, because these things are sacred.
ekegusii: Barabwo barie ebinto ebi biarurwe ase ogokora okobwatanigwa ekero baatananetwe ase emeremo emechenu. Monto onde omoao takoba ne ribaga ri’okobiria, ekiagera ebinto ebi nebichenu.
swahili: Watakula sadaka hizi ambazo upatanisho ulifanywa kwazo kwa ajili ya kuwaweka wakfu na kuwatakasa. Lakini hakuna mtu mwingine yeyote anayeruhusiwa kuvila, kwa sababu ni vitakatifu.

english: And if any of the meat of ordination or any bread is left until the morning, you are to burn up the remainder. It must not be eaten, because it is sacred.
ekegusii: Onye chinyama gose emegati bigotigara goika mambia, erio obisambe nomorero; tibibaisa koriegwa, ekiagera nebichenu.
swahili: Ikiwa nyama yoyote ya huyo kondoo dume iliyotumika kwa kuwaweka wakfu au mkate wowote umebaki mpaka asubuhi, vichomwe. Kamwe visiliwe, kwa sababu ni vitakatifu.

english: This is what you are to do for Aaron and his sons based on all that I have commanded you, taking seven days to ordain them.
ekegusii: “Naboigo orakorere Aroni amo nabamura baye koreng’ana buna nagochikiire. Ogwatananwa kwabo kobe gokogenderera ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere.
swahili: “Hivyo utamfanyia Aroni na wanawe kila kitu kama vile nilivyokuamuru: Utachukua muda wa siku saba kuwaweka wakfu.

english: Sacrifice a bull as a sin offering each day for atonement. Purify the altar by making atonement for it, and anoint it to consecrate it.
ekegusii: Kera rituko orue eeri ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe ase ogokora okobwatanigwa. Ase okorua ekeng’wanso ase okobwatanigwa nigo orabe kogochena egesasiimero. Erio ogeake amaguta na kogiatanana ase emeremo emechenu.
swahili: Utatoa dhabihu ya fahali kila siku kuwa sadaka ya dhambi ili kufanya upatanisho. Takasa madhabahu kwa kufanya upatanisho kwa ajili yake, nayo uitie mafuta na kuiweka wakfu.

english: For seven days you shall make atonement for the altar and consecrate it. Then the altar will become most holy; whatever touches the altar will be holy. The Daily Offerings (Numbers 28:1–8)
ekegusii: Ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere obe gokogenderera gokora okobwatanigwa ase egesasiimero na kogechena mono; na kera egento kerabe gekogekuna, nigo kerabe egechenu.” Ebing’wanso bia kera rituko (Omob 28:1-8)
