swahili: Kwa muda wa siku saba fanya upatanisho kwa ajili ya madhabahu na kuiweka wakfu. Ndipo madhabahu itakuwa takatifu sana na chochote kitakachoigusa kitakuwa kitakatifu.

english: This is what you are to offer regularly on the altar, each day: two lambs that are a year old.
ekegusii: “Na ebing’wanso orabe gokorua igoro ase egesasiimero nabio ebi: Kera rituko botambe, orue chimanwa ibere chi’eching’ondi echiakoorire omwaka oyomo.
swahili: “Kwa kawaida hiki ndicho utakachotoa juu ya madhabahu kila siku: wana-kondoo wawili wenye umri wa mwaka mmoja.

english: Offer one lamb in the morning and the other at twilight.
ekegusii: Emanwa eyemo y’echio oyerue mambia na eria ende mogoroba.
swahili: Utamtoa mmoja asubuhi na huyo mwingine jioni.

english: Then present Aaron and his sons at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting and wash them with water.
ekegusii: “Erio orente Aroni amo nabamura baye ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano, obasibie namaache.
swahili: Kisha mlete Aroni na wanawe kwenye lango la Hema la Kukutania na uwaoshe kwa maji.

english: With the first lamb offer a tenth of an ephah of fine flour, mixed with a quarter hin of oil from pressed olives, and a drink offering of a quarter hin of wine.
ekegusii: Amo nemanwa eria entang’ani orue ebimunu bibere bi’obosie obonuke bwochoganirie namaguta amaya, egetuba ekemo na ekeng’ese, amitire korwa ase amazeituni. Naende goika orue edivai egetuba ekemo na ekeng’ese ebe okoruegwa gw’ekenyugwa.
swahili: Pamoja na mwana-kondoo wa kwanza utatoa efa moja ya unga wa ngano laini uliochanganywa na robo ya hini ya mafuta yaliyokamuliwa, pamoja na robo ya hini ya divai kuwa sadaka ya kinywaji.

english: And offer the second lamb at twilight with the same grain offering and drink offering as in the morning, as a pleasing aroma, an offering made by fire to the LORD.
ekegusii: Emanwa eria ende oyerue mogoroba; oyerue amo nokoruegwa kw’endagera na ogw’ekenyugwa, buna gwakorete mambia, kobe ekeng’wanso ki’omorero kebe ne rimisu rigiya ase Omonene.
swahili: Huyo mwana-kondoo mwingine mtoe dhabihu wakati wa machweo pamoja na sadaka za unga na za kinywaji kama vile ulivyofanya asubuhi, kuwa harufu ya kupendeza, sadaka iliyotolewa kwa Bwana kwa moto.

english: For the generations to come, this burnt offering shall be made regularly at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting before the LORD, where I will meet you to speak with you.
ekegusii: Ekeng’wanso eke ki’ogosambwa kebe gekoruegwa ebiaare ase ebiaare botambe agwo ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano, ase obosio bwane, inche Omonene. Agwo ndabe nkoumerana nainwe, naende nkwane naye.
swahili: “Kwa vizazi vijavyo itakuwa kawaida kutoa sadaka hii ya kuteketezwa kila mara kwenye ingilio la Hema la Kukutania mbele za Bwana. Hapo ndipo nitakapokutana na ninyi na kusema nanyi,

english: I will also meet with the Israelites there, and that place will be consecrated by My glory.
ekegusii: Agwo ning’umerane n’Abaisraeli, na aase agwo ning’akore abe aachenu nobonene bwane.
swahili: Huko ndipo nitakapokutana na Waisraeli, nalo Hema la Kukutania litatakaswa na utukufu wangu.

english: So I will consecrate the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and I will consecrate Aaron and his sons to serve Me as priests. God Will Dwell among the People
ekegusii: Ninchene Eema y’Omosangererekano amo negesasiimero; naboigo ninchene Aroni amo nabamura baye babe bagonkorera ase emeremo y’obokuani.
swahili: “Kwa hiyo nitaliweka wakfu Hema la Kukutania pamoja na madhabahu, nami nitamweka wakfu Aroni na wanawe ili wanitumikie mimi katika kazi ya ukuhani.

english: Then I will dwell among the Israelites and be their God.
ekegusii: Inche nimenye ase egati y’Abaisraeli, imbe Nyasae obo.
swahili: Ndipo nitakapofanya makao miongoni mwa Waisraeli na kuwa Mungu wao.

english: And they will know that I am the LORD their God, who brought them out of the land of Egypt so that I might dwell among them. I am the LORD their God.
ekegusii: Erio barabwo nabamanye ng’a inche ninche Nyasae obo; ninche nabarusetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri, erinde imbe imenyete ase egati yabo. Inche ninche Nyasae obo.”
swahili: Nao watajua kuwa Mimi Ndimi Bwana Mungu wao, aliyewatoa Misri ili nipate kufanya makao miongoni mwao. Mimi Ndimi Bwana Mungu wao.

english: Take the garments and clothe Aaron with the tunic, the robe of the ephod, the ephod itself, and the breastplate. Fasten the ephod on him with its woven waistband.
ekegusii: Oimokie chianga chiria, obekere Aroni: Eganchwa erobekanirie egoika inse, na eganchwa eria ende, na egesibao ki’obokuani na egesembe keria; omoboerie norokini rw’egesibao.
swahili: Chukua yale mavazi na umvike Aroni koti, joho la kisibau na kisibau chenyewe pamoja na kile kifuko cha kifuani. Mfungie hicho kisibau kwa ule mshipi wa kiunoni uliosukwa kwa ustadi.

english: Put the turban on his head and attach the holy diadem to the turban.
ekegusii: Omobekere na ekegogwa omotwe oye, na ase ekegogwa eke osiberanie ekemanyererio keria egechenu gekoorokia ng’a bwatananirwe.
swahili: Weka kilemba kichwani mwake na kuweka taji takatifu ishikamane na hicho kilemba.

english: Then take the anointing oil and anoint him by pouring it on his head.
ekegusii: Erio oimokie amaguta akweakwa, omonyoororokerie ase omotwe oye, omoyaake na omobeke ensemo ase emeremo emechenu.
swahili: Chukua yale mafuta ya upako umimine juu ya kichwa chake.

english: Present his sons as well and clothe them with tunics.
ekegusii: “Orente na abamura baye, obabeekere chianga.
swahili: Walete wanawe na uwavike makoti,

english: Wrap the sashes around Aaron and his sons and tie headbands on them. The priesthood shall be theirs by a permanent statute. In this way you are to ordain Aaron and his sons. The Order of the Sacrifices (Leviticus 8:22–36)
ekegusii: Obaboerie chinkini ebinema biabo, Aroni na abamura baye, na obabeekere ebigogwa emetwe yabo. Ase enchera eyio bwatanane Aroni amo nabamura baye obabeeke ensemo babe bagonkorera emeremo y’obokuani kogenderera botambe.
swahili: pia uwavike zile tepe za kichwani. Ndipo uwafunge Aroni na wanawe mishipi. Ukuhani ni wao kwa agizo la kudumu. Kwa njia hii utamweka wakfu Aroni na wanawe.

english: Now a man of the house of Levi married a daughter of Levi,
ekegusii: Narengeo Omonto oyomo bw’egekasu kia Lawi akamonyuoma omoiseke korwa egesaku kia Lawi.
swahili: Basi mtu mmoja wa nyumba ya Lawi akaoa mwanamke Mlawi,

english: When the child had grown older, she brought him to Pharaoh’s daughter, and he became her son. She named him Moses and explained, “I drew him out of the water.” The Rejection and Flight of Moses (Acts 7:23–29)
ekegusii: Ekero omwana oria akinire, omokungu oria akamoirania ase omoiseke o Farao koba omwana oye na ere akamoroka Musa, ogoteeba, “Ndooche namorusetie.” Musa ogotama gochia Midiani
swahili: Mtoto alipokua, akampeleka kwa binti Farao, naye akawa mwanawe. Akamwita jina lake Mose akisema, “Nilimtoa kwenye maji.” Mose Akimbilia Midiani

english: One day, after Moses had grown up, he went out to his own people and observed their hard labor. He saw an Egyptian beating a Hebrew, one of his own people.
ekegusii: Egachia koba ekero Musa abeire omonto omonene, rituko erimo akagenda gokwania Abaiberania bamwabo, akarora buna baare gokorigwa emeremo yobosomba emekong’u. Agwo akarora Omomisiri ogoita oyomo bw’Abaiberania bamwabo.
swahili: Siku moja, baada ya Mose kukua, akaondoka kwenda walikokuwa watu wake, na akachunguza jinsi walivyokuwa wakifanya kazi ngumu. Akamwona Mmisri akimpiga Mwebrania, mmojawapo wa watu wake.

english: After looking this way and that and seeing no one, he struck down the Egyptian and hid his body in the sand.
ekegusii: Erio akamaga‐maga chinsemo chionsi, na ekero arora ng’a monto onde tari aande, agaita Omomisiri oria agakwa, erio akabisa omobere oye ase omokenye ime.
swahili: Mose akatazama huku na huko asione mtu yeyote, akamuua yule Mmisri, akamficha mchangani.

english: The next day Moses went out and saw two Hebrews fighting. He asked the one in the wrong, “Why are you attacking your companion?”
ekegusii: Naende akagenda rituko ria kabere, akarora Abaiberania babere abasacha bakorwana; akamobooria oria ochegetie oyomwabo, “Nase ki ogoaka oyomino?”
swahili: Kesho yake akatoka, akaona Waebrania wawili wakipigana. Akamuuliza yule aliyekosa, “Mbona unampiga Mwebrania mwenzako?”

english: But the man replied, “Who made you ruler and judge over us? Are you planning to kill me as you killed the Egyptian? ” Then Moses was afraid and thought, “This thing I have done has surely become known.”
ekegusii: Omonto oria akamoiraneria, “Ning’o okobegete koba omoteneneri na omogayani igoro yaito? Inee! Nigo origetie kong’ita buna gwaita Omomisiri oria?” Aya akagera Musa akoboa. Ere agateeba ase omoyo oye ime, “Ndoche ng’a eng’ana eye yamanyekanire!”
swahili: Yule mtu akamjibu, “Ni nani aliyekufanya mtawala na mwamuzi juu yetu? Je, unataka kuniua kama ulivyomuua yule Mmisri?” Ndipo Mose akaogopa na kuwaza, “Jambo lile nililofanya lazima limefahamika.”

english: When Pharaoh heard about this matter, he sought to kill Moses. But Moses fled from Pharaoh and settled in the land of Midian, where he sat down beside a well.
ekegusii: Ekero Farao achia koigwa amang’ana ayio akarigia goita Musa, korende Musa agatama korwa o Farao akagenda komenya ase ense y’Abamidiani.
swahili: Farao aliposikia jambo hili, alijaribu kumuua Mose, lakini Mose akamkimbia Farao na kwenda kuishi katika nchi ya Midiani, akaketi kando ya kisima.

english: Now the priest of Midian had seven daughters, and they came to draw water and fill the troughs to water their father’s flock.
ekegusii: Narengeo Omokuani o Midiani ore korokwa Jethiro obwate abaiseke batano na babere. Barabwo bagacha kobuucha amaache; bagaichoria chintuba amaache banyoisie riicho ria ise.
swahili: Kuhani wa Midiani alikuwa na binti saba, nao wakaja kisimani ili kuchota maji na kujaza hori kwa ajili ya kunyweshea mifugo ya baba yao.

english: And when some shepherds came along and drove them away, Moses rose up to help them and watered their flock.
ekegusii: Erio abarisia b’aroro bagacha bagaseria abaiseke baria ba Jethiro, korende Musa agatenena agakonya abaiseke baria na kobanyoiseria riicho riabo.
swahili: Baadhi ya wachungaji wakaja wakawafukuza hao wasichana. Ndipo Mose akainuka, akawasaidia na kunywesha mifugo yao.

english: When the daughters returned to their father Reuel, he asked them, “Why have you returned so early today?”
ekegusii: Ekero abaiseke baria bairanete ase ise, ere akababoria, “Nakimwakora reero mwairana bwango iga?”
swahili: Hao wasichana waliporudi nyumbani kwa Reueli baba yao, akawauliza, “Imekuwaje leo mmerudi mapema hivyo?”

english: “An Egyptian rescued us from the shepherds,” they replied. “He even drew water for us and watered the flock.”
ekegusii: Bakamoiraneria, “Omomisiri oyomo otokonya korwa ase abarisia baria; amo nayio otobuuchera amaache na gotonyoiseria riicho riaito.”
swahili: Wakamjibu, “Mmisri mmoja alituokoa kutoka mikononi mwa wachungaji. Pia mtu huyo alituchotea maji na kunywesha mifugo.”

english: and she conceived and gave birth to a son. When she saw that he was a beautiful child, she hid him for three months.
ekegusii: Omokungu oyio akaba morito, akaibora omwana omoisia, na ekero aroche ng’a omwana oria nomuya mono, akamobisa ase engaki y’emetienyi etato.
swahili: naye mwanamke huyo akapata mimba, akazaa mtoto wa kiume. Alipoona mtoto huyo ni mzuri, akamficha kwa miezi mitatu.

english: “So where is he?” their father asked. “Why did you leave the man behind? Invite him to have something to eat.”
ekegusii: Erio ise akababoria abaiseke baye, “Ng’ai are? Naki mwakora mwatiga omonto oyio? Gachie momorangerie ache koragera.”
swahili: Akawauliza binti zake, “Yuko wapi? Mbona mmemwacha? Mkaribisheni ale chakula.”

english: Moses agreed to stay with the man, and he gave his daughter Zipporah to Moses in marriage.
ekegusii: Musa agancha komenya bw’omonto oria na omonto oria akaa Musa Sipora, omoiseke oye, akaba mokaye.
swahili: Mose akakubali kukaa kwa huyo mtu, ambaye alimpa Mose binti yake aliyeitwa Sipora amwoe.

english: And she gave birth to a son, and Moses named him Gershom, saying, “I have become a foreigner in a foreign land.” God Hears the Cry of the Israelites
ekegusii: Omokungu oyio akamoiborera omwana omoisia, na Musa akamoroka Gerisomu, ogoteeba, “Nabeire omomenyi ase ense engeni.”
swahili: Sipora alizaa mtoto wa kiume, naye Mose akamwita Gershomu, akisema, “Nimekuwa mgeni katika nchi ya kigeni.”

english: After a long time, the king of Egypt died. The Israelites groaned and cried out under their burden of slavery, and their cry for deliverance from bondage ascended to God.
ekegusii: Magega y’engaki entambe koyaetire omorwoti o Misiri agakwa. Abaisraeli bakaba bakweumia inse y’obosomba obwo, bakarera bakonywe, na ekerero kiabo korwa ase obosomba kegaika igoro, ase Nyasae obo.
swahili: Baada ya muda mrefu, mfalme wa Misri akafa. Waisraeli wakalia kwa huzuni katika utumwa wao, walilia na kilio chao cha kutaka msaada kwa ajili ya utumwa kikamfikia Mungu.

english: So God heard their groaning, and He remembered His covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
ekegusii: Nyasae akaigwa ekerero kiabo, na akainyora okobwatana kwaye kw’ogotianania, okwo akorete na Aburaamu, na Isaka, na Yakobo;
swahili: Mungu akasikia kilio chao cha huzuni, akakumbuka Agano alilofanya na Abrahamu pamoja na Isaki na Yakobo.

english: God saw the Israelites and took notice.
ekegusii: Nyasae akarigereria ogochandeka kw’Abaisraeli ase obosomba erio akabainyora.
swahili: Kwa hiyo Mungu akawaangalia Waisraeli na kuwahurumia.

english: But when she could no longer hide him, she got him a papyrus basket and coated it with tar and pitch. Then she placed the child in the basket and set it among the reeds along the bank of the Nile.
ekegusii: Korende ekero aroche ng’a takonyara komobisa goetania agwo, akaimokia ekebaari ki’amauncho, agakeooma esike, erio agaaka eramu korwa isiko. Erio akaareria omwana oria ase ekebaari ime, agakebeeka ase amauncho ime y’orooche rwa Naeli.
swahili: Lakini alipoona hawezi kumficha zaidi, akamtengenezea kisafina cha mafunjo, akakipaka lami. Kisha akamweka huyo mtoto ndani yake, akakificha katikati ya matete kando ya ukingo wa Mto Naili.

english: And his sister stood at a distance to see what would happen to him.
ekegusii: Omoiseke omwabo omwana oria agatenena aare ake amanye egekonyora omwana.
swahili: Dada ya huyo mtoto akasimama mbali ili kuona kitakachompata mtoto.

english: Soon the daughter of Pharaoh went down to bathe in the Nile, and her attendants were walking along the riverbank. And when she saw the basket among the reeds, she sent her maidservant to retrieve it.
ekegusii: Erio omoiseke o Farao agatirimboka gochia Naeli rooche gwesibia, na abasomba baye abaiseke bakaba bakona goonchokanana ase engegu. Ekero aroche ekebaari keria ase amauncho, agatoma omoiseke oyomo akerente;
swahili: Ndipo binti Farao akateremka mtoni Naili kuoga, nao wahudumu wake wakawa wanatembea ukingoni mwa mto. Binti mfalme akaona kisafina katikati ya manyasi, akamtuma mmoja wa watumwa wake wa kike kukichukua.

english: When she opened it, she saw the child, and behold, the little boy was crying. So she had compassion on him and said, “This is one of the Hebrew children.”
ekegusii: agakemumora, akanyora omwana omoke ore imeo. Omwana oria akarera, na omoiseke o Farao akamororera amabeebe, agakwana, “Oyoiga noyomo bw’abana b’Abaiberania.”
swahili: Alifungua kisafina akaona mtoto ndani yake. Mtoto alikuwa akilia, akamhurumia. Akasema, “Huyu ni mmoja wa watoto wa Kiebrania.”

english: Then his sister said to Pharaoh’s daughter, “Shall I go and call one of the Hebrew women to nurse the child for you?”
ekegusii: Agwo agwo Omoiseke omwabo omwana oria akaoroka akaboria omoiseke o Farao, “Inee! Norigetie ngende nkorangererie omokungu okogonkia oyomo bw’Abaiberania ache gokomogonkeria?”
swahili: Ndipo dada wa huyo mtoto akamuuliza binti Farao, “Je, niende nikakutafutie mmoja wa wanawake wa Kiebrania akulelee huyu mtoto?”

english: “Go ahead,” Pharaoh’s daughter told her. And the girl went and called the boy’s mother.
ekegusii: Omoiseke o Farao akamoiraneria, “Ee, genda!” Erio akagenda, akarangeria ng’ina omwana oria.
swahili: Binti Farao akamjibu, “Ndiyo, nenda.” Yule msichana akaenda akamleta mama wa mtoto.

english: Pharaoh’s daughter said to her, “Take this child and nurse him for me, and I will pay your wages.” So the woman took the boy and nursed him.
ekegusii: Omoiseke o Farao agateebia omokungu oria, “Moire omwana oyo, omongonkerie, na inche ninkoe eng’eria yao.” Erio omokungu oria akaira omwana, akamorera.
swahili: Binti Farao akamwambia, “Mchukue huyu mtoto unisaidie kumlea, nami nitakulipa.” Basi yule mwanamke akamchukua mtoto na kumlea.

english: “You are also to make an altar of acacia wood for the burning of incense.
ekegusii: “Oroisie egesasiimero gie chibao chi’emekonge ase ubani egosamberwa.
swahili: “Tengeneza madhabahu kwa mbao za mshita kwa ajili ya kufukizia uvumba.

english: Once a year Aaron shall make atonement on the horns of the altar. Throughout your generations he shall make atonement on it annually with the blood of the sin offering of atonement. The altar is most holy to the LORD.” The Census Offering (2 Samuel 24:1–9; 1 Chronicles 21:1–6)
ekegusii: Ara rimo kera omwaka Aroni akore okobwatanigwa ase ching’unchara chiaye. Naboigo ara rimo kera omwaka nakorere egesasiimero okobwatanigwa namanyinga ’ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe. Ayio nigo arakorerwe ebiaare ase ebiaare. Egesasiimero ekio nagiatananwe kebe egechenu mono ase Omonene.” Ebango y’Obomenyo Obochenu
swahili: Mara moja kwa mwaka Aroni atafanya upatanisho juu ya pembe za hayo madhabahu. Upatanisho huu wa mwaka lazima ufanywe kwa damu ya sadaka ya upatanisho kwa ajili ya dhambi kwa vizazi vijavyo. Ni takatifu sana kwa Bwana.” Fedha Ya Upatanisho

english: Then the LORD said to Moses,
ekegusii: Omonene agakwana na Musa, akamoteebia,
swahili: Naye Bwana akamwambia Mose,

english: “When you take a census of the Israelites to number them, each man must pay the LORD a ransom for his life when he is counted. Then no plague will come upon them when they are numbered.
ekegusii: “Ekero orabe gokobara Abaisraeli ase okorikwa kwabo, kera omonto arue ekeegwa ase Omonene, kebe embooria ase obogima bwaye, tibaabaisa konyora amaakwa ekero bakorikwa.
swahili: “Utakapowahesabu Waisraeli, kila mmoja lazima alipe kwa Bwana fidia kwa ajili ya nafsi yake wakati wa kuhesabiwa kwake. Ndipo hakutakuwa na pigo juu yao unapowahesabu.

english: Everyone who crosses over to those counted must pay a half shekel, according to the sanctuary shekel, which weighs twenty gerahs. This half shekel is an offering to the LORD.
ekegusii: Ase igo, kera omonto oyorache korikwa goika arue ekeng’ese gi’esekeli ase ekerengo gi’esekeli egokorerwa ase Obomenyo Obochenu, ebe ekeegwa ase Omonene. (Esekeli eyemo nechigera emerongo ebere.)
swahili: Kila mmoja anayekwenda upande wa wale waliokwisha hesabiwa atatoa nusu shekeli, kulingana na shekeli ya mahali patakatifu, ambayo ina uzito wa gera ishirini. Hii nusu shekeli ni sadaka kwa Bwana.

english: Everyone twenty years of age or older who crosses over must give this offering to the LORD.
ekegusii: Kera omonto oyorarikwe, engencho yaye oyokoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, goika arue ekeegwa eke ase Omonene.
swahili: Wote wale wanaovuka, wenye umri wa miaka ishirini au zaidi, watatoa sadaka kwa Bwana.

english: In making the offering to the LORD to atone for your lives, the rich shall not give more than a half shekel, nor shall the poor give less.
ekegusii: Oyore omonda takorua goetania ekeng’ese gi’esekeli, gose oyore omotaka takorua inse y’ekio, ekero morarue ekeegwa ekio ase Omonene. Kerokio kebe embooria ase obogima bwaino.
swahili: Matajiri hawatalipa zaidi ya nusu shekeli, nao maskini hawatatoa pungufu wakati mnatoa sadaka kwa Bwana kwa kufanya upatanisho wa nafsi zenu.

english: Take the atonement money from the Israelites and use it for the service of the Tent of Meeting. It will serve as a memorial for the Israelites before the LORD to make atonement for your lives.” The Bronze Basin (Exodus 38:8)
ekegusii: Koranyore chitaabu echi Abaisraeli bararue chibe embooria, ochikorere ase emeremo y’Eema y’Omosangererekano. Ase igo Abaisraeli babe bakoinyorwa ase obosio bw’Omonene, naende chitaabu echio chibe embooria ase obogima bwabo.” Egetuba gi’etai
swahili: Utapokea fedha ya upatanisho kutoka kwa Waisraeli na uzitumie kwa ajili ya huduma ya Hema la Kukutania. Itakuwa ni ukumbusho kwa Waisraeli mbele za Bwana kufanya upatanisho kwa ajili ya nafsi zenu.” Sinia La Kunawia

english: And the LORD said to Moses,
ekegusii: Omonene agakwana na Musa, akamoteebia,
swahili: Kisha Bwana akamwambia Mose,

english: “You are to make a bronze basin with a bronze stand for washing. Set it between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and put water in it,
ekegusii: “Oroisie egetuba gi’etai amo nenterekerero yaye y’etai. Okebeeke egati y’Eema y’Omosangererekano na egesasiimero, na obeeke amaache imeo.
swahili: “Tengeneza sinia la shaba lenye kitako cha shaba kwa ajili ya kunawia. Liweke kati ya Hema la Kukutania na madhabahu, kisha uweke maji ndani yake.

english: with which Aaron and his sons are to wash their hands and feet.
ekegusii: Aroni na abamura baye babe bagwesibia amaache ayio amaboko na amagoro.
swahili: Aroni na wanawe watanawa mikono na miguu yao kwa maji yatokayo katika hilo sinia.

english: It is to be square, a cubit long, a cubit wide, and two cubits high. Its horns must be of one piece.
ekegusii: Obotambe bwaye bobe obw’ekerengo gi’okoboko okomo, na obogare bwaye okoboko okomo; nabo chinsemo chiaye inye chibe chireng’aine; na obotambe bwaye gochia igoro bobe amaboko abere. Emegwekano yaye ye ching’unchara nigo eraroisigwe ebe egento ekemo negesasiimero.
swahili: Madhabahu hayo yawe mraba, urefu na upana wake dhiraa moja, na kimo cha dhiraa mbili, nazo pembe zake zitakuwa kitu kimoja nayo.

english: Whenever they enter the Tent of Meeting or approach the altar to minister by presenting an offering made by fire to the LORD, they must wash with water so that they will not die.
ekegusii: Ekero bagosoa ase Eema y’Omosangererekano goika besibie ase amaache ayio, tibaabaisa gokwa; naboigo ekero bakogenda ase egesasiimero ase okoruera Omonene ekeng’wanso ki’omorero
swahili: Wakati wowote wanapoingia katika Hema la Kukutania, watanawa kwa maji ili kwamba wasije wakafa. Pia, wanapokaribia madhabahu ili kuhudumu kwa kuleta sadaka zilizotolewa kwa Bwana kwa moto,

english: Thus they are to wash their hands and feet so that they will not die; this shall be a permanent statute for Aaron and his descendants for the generations to come.” The Anointing Oil
ekegusii: Barabwo babe bagoisaba amaboko, basibie na amagoro abo, tibaabaisa gokwa. Ekio nigo korabe ogochika koragenderere asare na ase ororeria rwaye ebiaare ase ebiaare.” Amaguta akweakwa
swahili: watanawa mikono na miguu yao ili kwamba wasije wakafa. Hii itakuwa ni amri ya kudumu kwa ajili ya Aroni na wazao wake kwa vizazi vijavyo.” Mafuta Ya Upako

english: Then the LORD said to Moses,
ekegusii: Naende Omonene agakwana na Musa, akamoteebia,
swahili: Kisha Bwana akamwambia Mose,

english: “Take the finest spices: 500 shekels of liquid myrrh, half that amount (250 shekels) of fragrant cinnamon, 250 shekels of fragrant cane,
ekegusii: “Oimokie ebinto bigotioka buya: Amaguta a manemane chikiro ikomi, na omodalasini ore ne rimisu rigiya chikiro isano, na amanukato are ne rimisu rigiya chikiro isano,
swahili: “Chukua vikolezi bora vifuatavyo: shekeli 500 za manemane ya maji, shekeli 250 za mdalasini wenye harufu nzuri, shekeli 250 za miwa yenye harufu nzuri,

english: 500 shekels of cassia —all according to the sanctuary shekel—and a hin of olive oil.
ekegusii: na kasia chikiro ikomi. (Bionsi bibe bi’ekerengo kegokorerwa ase Obomenyo Obochenu). Oimokie na amaguta ’emezeituni ebituba bine.
swahili: shekeli 500 za aina nyingine ya mdalasini, vyote kulingana na shekeli ya mahali patakatifu, pia hini ya mafuta ya zeituni.

english: Prepare from these a sacred anointing oil, a fragrant blend, the work of a perfumer; it will be a sacred anointing oil.
ekegusii: Ase ebinto ebio oroisie amaguta akweakwa ase chisemi chi’omooroisia omong’aini, abe amaguta amaachenu akweakwa.
swahili: Vitengeneze vikolezi hivi kuwa mafuta matakatifu ya upako yenye harufu nzuri, kazi ya mtengeneza manukato. Yatakuwa mafuta matakatifu ya upako.

english: Use this oil to anoint the Tent of Meeting, the ark of the Testimony,
ekegusii: Oake Eema y’Omosangererekano, na Esanduki ere ne chibao chiriikire oborori,
swahili: Kisha yatumie kupaka hilo Hema la Kukutania, Sanduku la Ushuhuda,

english: the table and all its utensils, the lampstand and its utensils, the altar of incense,
ekegusii: na emesa amo n’ebinto bireo, na ekebekerero gie chitaaya amo nebikorero biaye, na egesasiimero ase ubani egosamberwa,
swahili: meza na vifaa vyake vyote, kinara cha taa na vifaa vyake vyote, madhabahu ya kufukizia uvumba,

english: the altar of burnt offering and all its utensils, and the basin with its stand.
ekegusii: na egesasiimero ase ebing’wanso bigosamberwa amo nebikorero biaye, na egetuba amo nenterekerero yaye.
swahili: madhabahu ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa na vyombo vyake vyote na sinia pamoja na kitako chake.

english: You are to consecrate them so that they will be most holy. Whatever touches them shall be holy.
ekegusii: Naboigo oraatanane ebinto ebi, obikore ebichenu kegima, erio onde bwensi orabikune abe omochenu.
swahili: Utaviweka wakfu ili viwe vitakatifu sana na kila kitakachoigusa kitakuwa kitakatifu.

english: Overlay with pure gold the top and all the sides and horns, and make a molding of gold around it.
ekegusii: Oyeoome netaabu echenire, igoro yaye, ne chinsemo chiaye inye, amo ne ching’unchara chiaye; oyeetananie omong’ororia bw’etaabu.
swahili: Funika hayo madhabahu juu na pande zote na pia pembe zake kwa dhahabu safi, na uifanyizie ukingo wa dhahabu kuizunguka.

english: Anoint Aaron and his sons and consecrate them to serve Me as priests.
ekegusii: Aroni na abamura baye obaake amaguta na kobaatanana babe bagonkorera emeremo y’obokuani.
swahili: “Mtie Aroni na wanawe mafuta na uwaweke wakfu ili waweze kunitumikia katika kazi ya ukuhani.

english: And you are to tell the Israelites, ‘This will be My sacred anointing oil for the generations to come.
ekegusii: Kwana n’Abaisraeli, obateebie ng’a amaguta aya akweakwa abe amaachenu ase ’nde egati yaino ebiaare ase ebiaare.
swahili: Waambie Waisraeli, ‘Haya yatakuwa mafuta matakatifu yangu ya upako kwa vizazi vijavyo.

english: It must not be used to anoint an ordinary man, and you must not make anything like it with the same formula. It is holy, and it must be holy to you.
ekegusii: Tabaisa goakwa ase emebere ya Mwanyabaanto bande bonsi. Timoroisia amaguta ande anga buna ayio. Ayio namaachenu, nabe amaachenu ase more.
swahili: Usiyamimine juu ya miili ya wanadamu wala usitengeneze mafuta ya aina nyingine kwa utaratibu huu. Ni mafuta matakatifu na ni lazima myaone kuwa ni matakatifu.

english: Anyone who mixes perfume like it or puts it on an outsider shall be cut off from his people.’” The Incense
ekegusii: Monto onde bwensi aise koroisia amaguta buna ayio gose koyaaka omonto omoao, oyotari Omokuani, nigo araatananwe korwa ase egesaku kiaye.” Amanukato
swahili: Mtu yeyote atakayetengeneza manukato kama hayo na yeyote atakayeyamimina juu ya mtu yeyote ambaye si kuhani atakatiliwa mbali na watu wake.’ ” Uvumba

english: The LORD also said to Moses, “Take fragrant spices—gum resin, onycha, galbanum, and pure frankincense—in equal measures,
ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa, “Oimokie ebinto bigotioka buya: Oborembo bwa nafiti, na amaguta ’amakorogonte na oborembo bwa kalibani, na ebinto binde ebiansu, na ubani engiya; kera egento kebe gi’ekerengo ekemo.
swahili: Kisha Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Chukua vikolezi vyenye harufu nzuri vifuatavyo: natafi, shekelethi, kelbena na uvumba safi vyote vikiwa na vipimo sawa,

english: and make a fragrant blend of incense, the work of a perfumer, seasoned with salt, pure and holy.
ekegusii: Korwa ase ebinto ebio oroisie amanukato oyaroisie ase chisemi chi’omooroisia omong’aini ebekwe omonyoo, abe amarabu achenire.
swahili: pia tengeneza mchanganyiko wa uvumba wenye harufu nzuri, kazi ya mtengeneza manukato. Utiwe chumvi ili upate kuwa safi na mtakatifu.

english: Grind some of it into fine powder and place it in front of the Testimony in the Tent of Meeting, where I will meet with you. It shall be most holy to you.
ekegusii: Orusie bike, erio obiswage bibe obosie. Obeke boke bosio bw’Esanduki ere ne chibao chiriikire oborori, ase Eema y’Omosangererekano, aase ndaumerane naye. Amanukato ayio abe amaachenu mono ase more.
swahili: Saga baadhi yake kuwa unga na uweke mbele ya Sanduku la Ushuhuda ndani ya Hema la Kukutania, mahali ambapo nitakutana nawe. Itakuwa takatifu sana kwenu.

english: You are never to use this formula to make incense for yourselves; you shall regard it as holy to the LORD.
ekegusii: Timweroiseria amanukato ande onsi y’ogosambwa anga buna ayio. Abe ase more amaachenu ase obosio bw’Omonene.
swahili: Msitengeneze uvumba mwingine wowote wa namna hii kwa ajili yenu wenyewe; uoneni kuwa ni mtakatifu kwa Bwana.

english: Anyone who makes something like it to enjoy its fragrance shall be cut off from his people.”
ekegusii: Monto onde bwensi aise koroisia amanukato anga buna ayio ase okwegokeria rimisu riaye nigo araatananwe korwa ase egesaku ki’abaanto b’Omonene.”
swahili: Yeyote atakayetengeneza uvumba kama huu ili kufurahia harufu yake nzuri lazima akatiliwe mbali na watu wake.”

english: And make two gold rings below the molding on opposite sides to hold the poles used to carry it.
ekegusii: Okore chibonyi ibere chi’echitaabu ochibeke inse y’omong’ororia chinsemo ibere, na emiaro esoigwe imeo, erinde egesasiimero kenyare kobogorerigwa.
swahili: Tengeneza pete mbili za dhahabu kwa ajili ya madhabahu chini ya huo ukingo, ziwe mbili kila upande, za kushikilia hiyo mipiko itumikayo kuibebea madhabahu.

english: Make the poles of acacia wood and overlay them with gold.
ekegusii: Obaache emiaro eria korwa ase emekonge, oyeoome netaabu.
swahili: Tengeneza mipiko kwa miti ya mshita na uifunike kwa dhahabu.

english: Place the altar in front of the veil that is before the ark of the Testimony —before the mercy seat that is over the Testimony—where I will meet with you.
ekegusii: Obeke egesasiimero ekio bosio bw’etoto eria ekengete aase aria esanduki egachire, eria ere ne chibao chiriikire oborori amo n’Ekerogo ki’Amaabera igoro yaye. Aase agwo ndabe nkoumerana naye.
swahili: Weka hayo madhabahu mbele ya lile pazia lililo mbele ya Sanduku la Ushuhuda, lililo mbele ya kiti cha rehema kilicho juu ya Sanduku la Ushuhuda, mahali ambapo nitakutana nawe.

english: And Aaron is to burn fragrant incense on it every morning when he tends the lamps.
ekegusii: Kera emambia ekero Aroni akoroisia chitaaya nabe ogosambera agwo ubani egotioka buya,
swahili: “Itampasa Aroni kufukiza uvumba wenye harufu nzuri juu ya madhabahu kila siku asubuhi wakati anapowasha zile taa.

english: When Aaron sets up the lamps at twilight, he must burn the incense perpetually before the LORD for the generations to come.
ekegusii: naende ekero arabe ogwokia chitaaya engaki ya mogoroba. Ogosambwa okwo kwa ubani nigo koragenderere botambe ase obosio bw’Omonene, ebiaare ase ebiaare.
swahili: Itampasa afukize uvumba tena wakati anapowasha taa wakati wa machweo ili uvumba ufukizwe daima mbele za Bwana kwa vizazi vijavyo.

english: On this altar you must not offer unauthorized incense or a burnt offering or grain offering; nor are you to pour a drink offering on it.
ekegusii: Timobaisa gosamba ubani eye etachikiri, gose ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa, gose okoruegwa kw’endagera, gose timobaisa koumora okoruegwa gw’ekenyugwa igoro yaye.
swahili: Usifukize uvumba mwingine wowote juu ya madhabahu haya au sadaka nyingine yoyote ya kuteketezwa wala sadaka ya nafaka, wala usimimine sadaka ya kinywaji juu yake.

english: Then the LORD said to Moses,
ekegusii: Omonene agakwana na Musa, akamoteebia,
swahili: Ndipo Bwana akamwambia Mose,

english: as well as the woven garments, both the holy garments for Aaron the priest and the garments for his sons to serve as priests,
ekegusii: ne chianga chingiya chinchenu chia Aroni Omokuani, na echi’abamura baye, echi barabeeke ekero bagokora emeremo y’obokuani,
swahili: pamoja na mavazi matakatifu yaliyofumwa ya kuhani Aroni, na mavazi kwa ajili ya wanawe wakati wanahudumu katika kazi ya ukuhani,

english: in addition to the anointing oil and fragrant incense for the Holy Place. They are to make them according to all that I have commanded you.” The Sign of the Sabbath (Numbers 15:32–36)
ekegusii: na amaguta akweakwa, na ubani ere ne rimisu rigiya esamberwe Aase Aachenu ime. Ase ogokora ebinto ebi bionsi goika bakore buna nagochikiire kegima.” Esabato, rituko ri’ogotimoka
swahili: pia mafuta ya upako na uvumba wenye harufu nzuri kwa ajili ya Mahali Patakatifu. Watavitengeneza sawasawa kama vile nilivyokuagiza wewe.” Sabato

english: And the LORD said to Moses,
ekegusii: Omonene agakwana na Musa, akamoteebia.
swahili: Kisha Bwana akamwambia Mose,

english: “Tell the Israelites, ‘Surely you must keep My Sabbaths, for this will be a sign between Me and you for the generations to come, so that you may know that I am the LORD who sanctifies you.
ekegusii: Kwana n’Abaisraeli aye omonyene obateebie “Goika morende Chisabato chiane, ekiagera echio nekemanyererio egati yane nainwe ebiaare ase ebiaare, erinde momanye ng’a ninche Omonene oyokobachena.
swahili: “Waambie Waisraeli, ‘Ninyi ni lazima mzishike Sabato zangu. Hii itakuwa ni ishara kati yangu na ninyi kwa ajili ya vizazi vijavyo, ili mpate kujua kwamba Mimi Ndimi Bwana, niwafanyaye ninyi watakatifu.

english: Keep the Sabbath, for it is holy to you. Anyone who profanes it must surely be put to death. Whoever does any work on that day must be cut off from among his people.
ekegusii: Ase igo morende rituko ri’Esabato, ekiagera ne rituko richenu ase more. Onde bwensi aise korisaria, nigo araitwe akwe. Onde bwensi aise gokora emeremo ase rituko erio nigo araatananwe korwa ase egesaku ki’abaanto b’Omonene.
swahili: “ ‘Mtaishika Sabato, kwa sababu ni takatifu kwenu. Yeyote atakayeinajisi lazima auawe, yeyote atakayefanya kazi siku hiyo lazima akafie mbali na watu wake.

english: For six days work may be done, but the seventh day is a Sabbath of complete rest, holy to the LORD. Whoever does any work on the Sabbath day must surely be put to death.
ekegusii: Mokore emeremo amatuko atano na rimo, korende rituko ria gatano na kabere n’Esabato Enchenu, rituko ri’ogotimoka, richenu ase Omonene. Onde bwensi aise gokora emeremo ase rituko erio goika aitwe akwe.
swahili: Kwa siku sita, mtafanya kazi, lakini siku ya saba ni Sabato ya kupumzika, takatifu kwa Bwana. Yeyote afanyaye kazi yoyote siku ya Sabato ni lazima auawe.

english: The Israelites must keep the Sabbath, celebrating it as a permanent covenant for the generations to come.
ekegusii: Nabo Abaisraeli goika babwate na korenda rituko ri’Esabato ebiaare ase ebiaare, ekiagera oko nokobwatana koragenderere botambe.
swahili: Waisraeli wataishika Sabato, kuiadhimisha kwa vizazi vijavyo kuwa Agano la milele.

english: It is a sign between Me and the Israelites forever; for in six days the LORD made the heavens and the earth, but on the seventh day He rested and was refreshed.’” Moses Receives the Tablets
ekegusii: Rituko erio ribe ekemanyererio keragenderere egati yane na Abaisraeli, ekiagera ase amatuko atano na rimo inche Omonene natongete igoro na ense, korende ase rituko ria gatano na kabere ngatiga emeremo yane yonsi, na gotimoka.” Chibao ibere chi’Amachiko
swahili: Itakuwa ishara kati yangu na Waisraeli milele, kwa kuwa kwa muda wa siku sita Bwana aliumba mbingu na dunia, na siku ya saba akaacha kufanya kazi, akapumzika.’ ”

english: When the LORD had finished speaking with Moses on Mount Sinai, He gave him the two tablets of the Testimony, tablets of stone inscribed by the finger of God.
ekegusii: Ekero Omonene akoorire gokwana na Musa agwo ase egetunwa gia Sinai, akamoa chibao ibere chi’amagena chiriikire oborori nekiara kia Nyasae.
swahili: Bwana alipomaliza kusema na Mose juu ya Mlima Sinai, Mungu akampa vile vibao viwili vya Ushuhuda, vibao vya mawe vilivyoandikwa kwa kidole cha Mungu.

english: “See, I have called by name Bezalel son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah.
ekegusii: “Rora, nachorire Besaleli, oyore mosinto o Uri, mochokoro o Huri, bw’egesaku kia Yuda.
swahili: “Tazama, nimemchagua Bezaleli mwana wa Uri, mwana wa Huri, wa kabila la Yuda,

english: And I have filled him with the Spirit of God, with skill, ability, and knowledge in all kinds of craftsmanship,
ekegusii: Inche Nyasae namoichoirie omoika one, namoeire obong’aini ne chisemi amanye gokora emeremo ende yonsi y’oboroisia,
swahili: nami nimemjaza Roho wa Mungu, pamoja na ustadi, uwezo na ujuzi katika aina zote za ufundi,

english: to design artistic works in gold, silver, and bronze,
ekegusii: abe oyomanyete koroberia na koroisia ebinto bie chitaabu, ne chifeta, ne chitaai.
swahili: ili kubuni michoro ya kupendeza katika ufundi wa dhahabu, fedha na shaba,

english: to cut gemstones for settings, and to carve wood, so that he may be a master of every craft.
ekegusii: Ere abe okobaacha amagena e rigori rinene na koyabeka ase ebikonde, na kobaacha emete, na gokora emeremo ende yonsi y’oboroisia.
swahili: kuchonga vito na kuvitia mahali, kufanya ufundi kwa mbao, na kujishughulisha na aina zote za ufundi.

english: Moreover, I have selected Oholiab son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, as his assistant. I have also given skill to all the craftsmen, that they may fashion all that I have commanded you:
ekegusii: Nachorire Oholiabu, mosinto bw’Ahisamaki bw’egesaku kia Dani amokonye ase emeremo eyio. Nabaeire abaroisia bande bonsi obong’aini, erinde banyare gokora ebinto bionsi ebi nagochikiire.
swahili: Tena nimemteua Oholiabu mwana wa Ahisamaki, wa kabila la Dani, ili kumsaidia. Pia mafundi wote nimewapa ustadi wa kutengeneza kila kitu nilichokuamuru wewe:

english: the Tent of Meeting, the ark of the Testimony and the mercy seat upon it, and all the other furnishings of the tent—
ekegusii: Barabwo baroisie Eema y’Omosangererekano, na Esanduki ebe ne chibao chiriikire oborori, na Oboikaranso bwa amaabera, na ebinto bionsi bi’Eema eyio,
swahili: Hema la Kukutania, Sanduku la Ushuhuda pamoja na kiti cha rehema juu yake, pia na vifaa vyote vya kwenye hema,

english: the table with its utensils, the pure gold lampstand with all its utensils, the altar of incense,
ekegusii: emesa na ebinto birabeo, ekebekerero gie chitaaya gi’etaabu echenire na ebikorero biaye na egesasiimero ase ubani erasamberwe,
swahili: meza na vifaa vyake, kinara cha taa cha dhahabu safi na vifaa vyake vyote, madhabahu ya kufukizia uvumba,

english: the altar of burnt offering with all its utensils, and the basin with its stand—
ekegusii: egesasiimero ase ebing’wanso birasamberwe na ebikorero biaye, na egetuba amo nenterekerero yaye,
swahili: madhabahu ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa na vyombo vyake vyote, sinia na kinara chake,

english: Now when the people saw that Moses was delayed in coming down from the mountain, they gathered around Aaron and said, “Come, make us gods who will go before us. As for this Moses who brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we do not know what has happened to him!”
ekegusii: Ekero abanto baroche ng’a Musa otebanire goika korwa ase egetunwa, bagasangererekana amo, bagachiera Aroni, bakamoteebia, “Inchuo aa, otokorere enyasae eratotang’ane, ekiagera titomanyeti eki kiamonyorire Musa, oyo otong’anyetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri.”
swahili: Watu walipoona kuwa Mose amekawia sana kushuka kutoka mlimani, walimkusanyikia Aroni na kumwambia, “Njoo, tutengenezee miungu itakayotutangulia. Kwa maana huyu jamaa yetu Mose aliyetupandisha kutoka Misri, hatujui jambo lililompata.”

english: Now leave Me alone, so that My anger may burn against them and consume them. Then I will make you into a great nation.”
ekegusii: Bono tiga endamwamu yane yoke igoro ase bare, erinde mbasirie, erio ngokore aye obe egesaku ekenene.”
swahili: Sasa niache ili hasira yangu ipate kuwaka dhidi yao, nami nipate kuwaangamiza. Kisha nitakufanya wewe kuwa taifa kubwa.”

english: But Moses sought the favor of the LORD his God, saying, “O LORD, why does Your anger burn against Your people, whom You brought out of the land of Egypt with great power and a mighty hand?
ekegusii: Korende Musa agasorora Omonene, Nyasae oye, akabora, “Gaaki Omonene nase ki’endamwamu yao ekoberorokera abanto bao, abakwang’anyetie korwa Misiri ase okobua okonene, na ase okoboko kwao gwe chinguru?
swahili: Lakini Mose akamsihi Bwana Mungu wake, akasema, “Ee Bwana, kwa nini hasira yako iwake dhidi ya watu wako, wale uliowatoa Misri kwa uweza mkuu na mkono wenye nguvu?

english: Why should the Egyptians declare, ‘He brought them out with evil intent, to kill them in the mountains and wipe them from the face of the earth’? Turn from Your fierce anger and relent from doing harm to Your people.
ekegusii: Inee! Nigo origetie Abamisiri bateebe: Igo abarusia aa, oganetie kobaita ase ebitunwa na kobasiria kegima? Ase igo onchoka korwa ase endamwamu yao enene, tokora amabe aya kwarengereirie gokorera abanto bao.
swahili: Kwa nini Wamisri waseme, ‘Ni kwa nia mbaya aliwatoa Misri, ili awaue milimani na kuwafuta usoni mwa dunia’? Achilia mbali hasira yako kali, waonee huruma na usilete maafa juu ya watu wako.

english: Remember Your servants Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, to whom You swore by Your very self when You declared, ‘I will make your descendants as numerous as the stars in the sky, and I will give your descendants all this land that I have promised, and it shall be their inheritance forever.’”
ekegusii: Inyora abasomba bao Aburaamu, na Isaka, na Israeli, na buna kwabarierete eira ase ogwetiania, okabateebia: Nigo ndamente oroiboro rwaino robe oronge buna ching’enang’eni chia igoro. Nimbae ense eye yonsi nabarierete eira ng’a nimbae ebe omwando obo kare na kare.”
swahili: Wakumbuke watumishi wako Abrahamu, Isaki na Israeli, ambao uliwaapia kwa nafsi yako mwenyewe: ‘Nitawafanya uzao wako kuwa wengi kama nyota za angani, nami nitawapa wazao wako nchi hii yote ambayo niliwaahidia, nayo itakuwa urithi wao milele.’ ”

english: So the LORD relented from the calamity He had threatened to bring on His people.
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene akaonchoka, tabakorera amabe aria konya arengereirie gokorera abanto baye.
swahili: Kisha Bwana akawaonea huruma, wala hakuleta juu ya watu wake maafa aliyokuwa amekusudia.

english: Then Moses turned and went down the mountain with the two tablets of the Testimony in his hands. They were inscribed on both sides, front and back.
ekegusii: Musa akeonchora, agatirimboka korwa ase egetunwa igoro, na ase amaboko aye obwate chibao ibere chi’amagena chiriikire oborori chinsemo chionsi ibere, bosio na magega.
swahili: Mose akageuka, akashuka kutoka mlimani akiwa na vibao viwili vya Ushuhuda mikononi mwake. Vilikuwa vimeandikwa pande zote mbili, mbele na nyuma.

english: The tablets were the work of God, and the writing was the writing of God, engraved on the tablets.
ekegusii: Chibao echio nigo chiaroisetigwe na Nyasae omonyene, na amariko aya nigo ariikire na Nyasae, amang’eire ase chibao chiria.
swahili: Vibao hivyo vilikuwa kazi ya Mungu; maandishi yalikuwa mwandiko wa Mungu, yaliyochorwa kama muhuri juu ya vibao.

english: When Joshua heard the sound of the people shouting, he said to Moses, “The sound of war is in the camp.”
ekegusii: Yoshua akaigwa eriogi ri’abaanto bakwoga, agateebia Musa, “Naigure eriogi ase egetwori, eriogi buna eri’esegi.”
swahili: Yoshua aliposikia sauti za watu wakipiga kelele, akamwambia Mose, “Kuna sauti ya vita kambini.”

english: But Moses replied: “It is neither the cry of victory nor the cry of defeat; I hear the sound of singing!”
ekegusii: Musa akamoiraneria, “Eriogi eri tiriri eri’abaanto babuire esegi, gose eri’okorera kw’abaanto babuirwe, korende eriogi naigure neri’abaanto bagotera.”
swahili: Mose akajibu: “Si sauti ya ushindi, wala si sauti ya kushindwa; ni sauti ya kuimba ninayosikia.”

english: As Moses approached the camp and saw the calf and the dancing, he burned with anger and threw the tablets out of his hands, shattering them at the base of the mountain.
ekegusii: Musa gaikire ang’e negetwori akarora emori eria, na buna abanto baare gotenga, akaba nendamwamu enene; agaakera inse chibao chiria abwate maboko aye, chigaateka, chikaba ebisamunye ase egetunwa inse.
swahili: Mose alipoikaribia kambi na kuona yule ndama na ile michezo, hasira yake ikawaka, akatupa vile vibao vilivyokuwa mikononi mwake, akavipasua vipande vipande pale chini ya mlima.

english: So Aaron told them, “Take off the gold earrings that are on your wives and sons and daughters, and bring them to me.”
ekegusii: Aroni akabateebia, “Rusia ebigera bie chitaabu bire ase amato ’abakungu baino, na ase abana baino, abamura na abaiseke, mobindetere.”
swahili: Aroni akawajibu, “Vueni vipuli vya dhahabu ambavyo wake zenu, wana wenu na binti zenu wamevaa, mkaniletee.”

english: Then he took the calf they had made, burned it in the fire, ground it to powder, and scattered the powder over the face of the water. Then he forced the Israelites to drink it.
ekegusii: Erio akabwata emori eria bakorete, akayesamba na koyesegenya goika ekaba orotu, akaroitera ase amaache ime, na akaa Abaisraeli amaache ayio, na barabwo bakanywa.
swahili: Kisha akamchukua yule ndama waliokuwa wamemtengeneza na kumchoma kwenye moto, kisha akamsaga kuwa unga, akanyunyiza kwenye maji na kuwafanya Waisraeli wanywe.

english: “What did this people do to you,” Moses asked Aaron, “that you have led them into so great a sin?”
ekegusii: Agwo Musa akaboria Aroni, “Naki abanto aba bagokorete goika okagera bagakora ebibe ebinene buna ebi?”
swahili: Mose akamwambia Aroni, “Watu hawa walikufanyia nini, hata ukawaongoza kufanya dhambi kubwa hivyo?”

english: “Do not be enraged, my lord,” Aaron replied. “You yourself know that the people are intent on evil.
ekegusii: Aroni akamoiraneria, “Omonene one, toba nendamwamu entindi, aye nomanyete abanto aba ng’a nababe.
swahili: Aroni akamwambia, “Usikasirike bwana wangu. Unajua jinsi watu hawa walivyo tayari kwa maovu.

english: They told me, ‘Make us gods who will go before us. As for this Moses who brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we do not know what has happened to him!’
ekegusii: Naki nigo banteebia: Tokorere enyasae eratotang’ane, ekiagera titomanyeti eki kiamonyorire Musa, oyo otong’anyetie korwa Misiri.
swahili: Wao waliniambia, ‘Tufanyie miungu itakayotuongoza. Kwa kuwa huyu jamaa yetu Mose aliyetupandisha kutoka Misri, hatufahamu yaliyompata.’

english: So I said to them, ‘Whoever has gold, let him take it off,’ and they gave it to me. And when I threw it into the fire, out came this calf!”
ekegusii: Inche: nkabateebia: Onde bwensi obwate etaabu ayerusie. Barabwo bagachirusia, bagaching’a, na inche ngachiruta ase omorero ime, na emori eye ekabao.”
swahili: Kwa hiyo nikawaambia, ‘Yeyote aliye na kito chochote cha dhahabu avue.’ Kisha wakanipa hiyo dhahabu, nami nikaitupa motoni, akatokea huyu ndama!”

english: Moses saw that the people were out of control, for Aaron had let them run wild and become a laughingstock to their enemies.
ekegusii: Musa akarora abanto bakoonchobana, na buna Aroni abatigete baonchobaane na gosasiima omogwekano oria, ase amasio ’ababisa babo.
swahili: Mose akaona kuwa watu wameasi, kwa kuwa Aroni alikuwa amewaacha waasi, na hivyo kuwa kichekesho kwa adui zao.

english: So Moses stood at the entrance to the camp and said, “Whoever is for the LORD, come to me.” And all the Levites gathered around him.
ekegusii: Agwo Musa agatenena geita ki’egetwori, akabora, “Onde bwensi oyore ensemo y’Omonene ache aa ase ’nde.” Abana bonsi ba Lawi bagasangererekana asare.
swahili: Kwa hiyo Mose akasimama kwenye ingilio la kambi, akasema, “Yeyote aliye upande wa Bwana, aje upande wangu.” Walawi wote wakamjia.

english: He told them, “This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘Each of you men is to fasten his sword to his side, go back and forth through the camp from gate to gate, and slay his brother, his friend, and his neighbor.’”
ekegusii: Ere akabateebia, Omonene Nyasae, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, oteebire iga “Kera oyomo oino abogorie omoyio oye o birende, agende aaria na aaria ase egetwori korwa egeita ekemo goika ekende. Kera oyomo aite onde bwensi aranyore, nonya noyomwabo, gose omosani, gose omogisangio”.
swahili: Ndipo alipowaambia, “Hili ndilo Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli asemalo: ‘Kila mmoja wenu ajifunge upanga wake kiunoni aende huku na huko kambi yote mwisho hadi mwisho mwingine, kila mmoja amuue ndugu yake, na rafiki yake na jirani yake.’ ”

english: The Levites did as Moses commanded, and that day about three thousand of the people fell dead.
ekegusii: Abana ba Lawi bagakora buna Musa abateebeetie, na abanto chilifu isato bagaitwa ase rituko erio.
swahili: Walawi wakafanya kama Mose alivyoamuru, siku ile wakafa watu wapatao 3,000.

english: Afterward, Moses said, “Today you have been ordained for service to the LORD, since each man went against his son and his brother; so the LORD has bestowed a blessing on you this day.”
ekegusii: Musa akabateebia. “Reero inwe mweatananire ase ogokorera Omonene, kera oyomo ase rigori ria mosubati omwabo gose momura omwabo; ase ig’Omonene obasesenirie reero.”
swahili: Kisha Mose akasema, “Leo mmewekwa wakfu kwa Bwana, kwa kuwa mlikuwa kinyume na wana wenu wenyewe na ndugu zenu, naye Mungu amewabariki leo.”

english: Then all the people took off their gold earrings and brought them to Aaron.
ekegusii: Erio abanto bonsi bakarusia ebigera bie chitaabu biare ase amato abo, bakamobiirera Aroni.
swahili: Kwa hiyo watu wote wakavua vipuli vyao, wakavileta kwa Aroni.

english: The next day Moses said to the people, “You have committed a great sin. Now I will go up to the LORD; perhaps I can make atonement for your sin.”
ekegusii: Rituko ria kabere Musa agateebia abanto, “Mwakorire ebibe ebinene mono. Na bono ngotiira inde gochia ase Omonene, aande nabo ndabanyorere okobwatanigwa, ekiagera mwakorire ebibe.”
swahili: Siku iliyofuata Mose akawaambia watu, “Mmefanya dhambi kubwa. Lakini sasa nitapanda juu kwa Bwana, labda nitaweza kufanya upatanisho kwa ajili ya dhambi yenu.”

english: So Moses returned to the LORD and said, “Oh, what a great sin these people have committed! They have made gods of gold for themselves.
ekegusii: Ase igo Musa akairana gochia ase Omonene, akamoteebia, “Abanto aba bakorire ebibe ebinene mono, bekoreire enyasae y’etaabu.
swahili: Hivyo Mose akarudi kwa Bwana na kumwambia, “Lo! Hawa watu wamefanya dhambi kubwa namna gani! Wamejitengenezea miungu ya dhahabu.

english: Yet now, if You would only forgive their sin.... But if not, please blot me out of the book that You have written.”
ekegusii: Na bono, koranche, obaabere ebibe biabo. Onye taibo, rirorio otinyie erieta riane korwa ase egetabu eria kwarigete.”
swahili: Lakini sasa nakusihi, wasamehe dhambi yao; lakini kama sivyo, basi nifute kutoka kwenye kitabu ulichoandika.”

english: The LORD replied to Moses, “Whoever has sinned against Me, I will blot out of My book.
ekegusii: Omonene akairaneria Musa, “Omonto oria onkoreire ebibe, nere ndatinyie erieta riaye korwa ase egetabu yane.
swahili: Bwana akamjibu Mose, “Yeyote aliyenitenda dhambi ndiye nitakayemfuta kutoka kwenye kitabu changu.

english: Now go, lead the people to the place I described. Behold, My angel shall go before you. But on the day I settle accounts, I will punish them for their sin.”
ekegusii: Korende bono genda, oraae abanto abwo goika aase aria nagotebetie; omomalaika one nagotang’ane. Korende rituko ndiche ekero ndabae egesusuro ase engencho y’ebibe biabo.”
swahili: Sasa nenda, uongoze hao watu mpaka mahali nilipokuambia, naye malaika wangu atakutangulia. Pamoja na hayo, wakati utakapofika wa mimi kuwaadhibu, nitawaadhibu kwa ajili ya dhambi yao.”

english: And the LORD sent a plague on the people because of what they had done with the calf that Aaron had made.
ekegusii: Omonene akabaa egesusuro, ekiagera bagerete Aroni agakora emori eria, bakayesasiima.
swahili: Ndipo Bwana akawapiga watu kwa ugonjwa wa tauni kwa sababu ya yale waliyoyafanya kwa ndama yule ambaye alitengenezwa na Aroni.

english: He took the gold from their hands, and with an engraving tool he fashioned it into a molten calf. And they said, “These, O Israel, are your gods, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt!”
ekegusii: Ere akanyora ebinto ebi korwa ase amaboko abo, akanyititora chitaabu chiria. Ekero yabwatanire, akayebomba, ekaba omogwekano bw’emori eeri. Abanto bagateeba, “Abaisraeli aba, eye nero enyasae yaino, eyabang’anyetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri.”
swahili: Akavichukua vile vitu walivyomkabidhi, akavifanyiza kwa kusubu sanamu yenye umbo la ndama, akaichonga kwa kutumia chombo. Kisha wakasema, “Hii ndiyo miungu yenu, ee Israeli, iliyowapandisha kutoka Misri.”

english: When Aaron saw this, he built an altar before the calf and proclaimed: “Tomorrow shall be a feast to the LORD.”
ekegusii: Ekero Aroni ayeroche, akaagacha egesasiimero bosio bwaye; erio akararia, akabora, “Ankio nigo rirabe Rituko Rinene ri’Omonene.”
swahili: Aroni alipoona hili, akajenga madhabahu mbele ya yule ndama na kutangaza, “Kesho kutakuwa na sikukuu kwa Bwana.”

english: So the next day they arose, offered burnt offerings, and presented peace offerings. And the people sat down to eat and drink, and got up to indulge in revelry.
ekegusii: Rituko ria kabere abanto bakaimoka mambia chuni, bakarua ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa, bakarenta na ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe. Abanto bagaikaransa, bakaria na konywa, erio bakaimoka gotenga.
swahili: Kwa hiyo siku iliyofuata watu wakaamka asubuhi na mapema na kutoa sadaka za kuteketeza na sadaka za amani. Baadaye watu wakaketi kula na kunywa, nao wakasimama, wakajizamisha katika sherehe.

english: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Go down at once, for your people, whom you brought up out of the land of Egypt, have corrupted themselves.
ekegusii: Korende Omonene agateebia Musa, Tirimboka gochia inse, ekiagera abanto abwo bao kwang’anyetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri besaririe ase ogokora amabe,
swahili: Kisha Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Shuka, kwa sababu watu wako, uliowatoa Misri, wamepotoka.

english: How quickly they have turned aside from the way that I commanded them! They have made for themselves a molten calf and have bowed down to it. They have sacrificed to it and said, ‘These, O Israel, are your gods, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt.’”
ekegusii: baonchokire bwango, batigire enchera eria nabachigete gotunyana, bekoreire emori eeri y’etaabu. Bayesasimire na koyeruera ekeng’wanso, bagoteeba, Abaisraeli aba, eye nero enyasae yaino, eyabang’anyetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri.
swahili: Wamekuwa wepesi kugeuka na kuacha niliyowaamuru, na wamejitengenezea sanamu ya kuyeyusha yenye umbo la ndama. Wameisujudia na kuitolea dhabihu, nao wamesema, ‘Hii ndiyo miungu yenu, ee Israeli iliyokupandisha kutoka Misri.’ ”

english: The LORD also said to Moses, “I have seen this people, and they are indeed a stiff-necked people.
ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa, “Narorire abanto aba ng’a nabanyabigoti bikong’u.
swahili: Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Nimeona watu hawa, nao ni watu wenye shingo ngumu.

english: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Leave this place, you and the people you brought up out of the land of Egypt, and go to the land that I promised to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob when I said, ‘I will give it to your descendants.’
ekegusii: Omonene agakwana na Musa, akamoteebia, Imoka korwa aa ogende, aye amo nabaanto aba kwang’anyetie korwa Misiri, obaire ase ense eria narierete Aburaamu na Isaka na Yakobo eira, ngateba “Ning’ee ororeria rwaino ense eyio.
swahili: Kisha Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Ondoka mahali hapa, wewe pamoja na hao watu uliowapandisha kutoka Misri, mpande mpaka nchi niliyomwahidi Abrahamu, Isaki na Yakobo kwa kiapo, nikisema, ‘Nitawapa wazao wenu nchi hii.’

english: When all the people saw the pillar of cloud standing at the entrance to the tent, they would stand up and worship, each one at the entrance to his own tent.
ekegusii: Ekero abanto bonsi barorire riire riria rigotenena ase egesoero ki’Eema, baba bakoimoka na gotung’ama inse ase ogosasiima, kera omonto ase egesoero ki’eema yaye.
swahili: Kila mara watu walipoona hiyo nguzo ya wingu ikiwa imesimama kwenye ingilio la hema, wote walisimama wakaabudu, kila mmoja kwenye ingilio la hema lake.

english: Thus the LORD would speak to Moses face to face, as a man speaks to his friend. Then Moses would return to the camp, but his young assistant Joshua son of Nun would not leave the tent. The Promise of God’s Presence
ekegusii: Na Omonene aba ogokwana na Musa obosio ase obosio, buna omonto agokwana nomonto onde. Erio Musa aba okoirana gochia ase egetwori, korende Yoshua, omosomba oye omosae, mosinto o Nuni, tare korua ase Eema eria. Eira y’Omonene y’okoba amo nabaanto baye
swahili: Bwana angezungumza na Mose uso kwa uso, kama vile mtu azungumzavyo na rafiki yake. Kisha Mose angerudi kambini, lakini msaidizi wake kijana Yoshua mwana wa Nuni hakuondoka mle Hemani. Mose Na Utukufu Wa Bwana

english: Then Moses said to the LORD, “Look, You have been telling me, ‘Lead this people up,’ but You have not let me know whom You will send with me. Yet You have said, ‘I know you by name, and you have found favor in My sight.’
ekegusii: Musa agateebia Omonene, “Rora, aye nigo gwantebeetie: Baire abanto aba, korende tigwanteebia ng’a ning’o oratome agende amo nainche. Naende oganteebia: Ninkomanyete buya kegima, na buna okorokwa; naye kwanyorire ogwancherwa ase obosio bwane.
swahili: Mose akamwambia Bwana, “Umekuwa ukiniambia, ‘Ongoza watu hawa,’ lakini hujanifahamisha ni nani utakayemtuma pamoja nami. Umesema, ‘Ninakujua wewe kwa jina lako, nawe umepata kibali mbele zangu.’

english: Now if indeed I have found favor in Your sight, please let me know Your ways, that I may know You and find favor in Your sight. Remember that this nation is Your people.”
ekegusii: Ase igo, onye nanyorire ogwancherwa ase obosio bwao, nagosabire, onyorokie chinchera chiao, erinde inyare gokomanya na konyora ogwancherwa ase obosio bwao, naende rigereria ng’a abanto b’egesaku eke nabaanto bao bare.”
swahili: Ikiwa umependezwa nami, nifundishe njia zako ili nipate kukujua, nami nizidi kupata kibali mbele zako. Kumbuka kuwa taifa hili ni watu wako.”

english: And the LORD answered, “My Presence will go with you, and I will give you rest.”
ekegusii: Omonene akamoteebia, “Inche omonyene nigo ndagende amo naye, na ninkoe obotoereru.”
swahili: Bwana akajibu, “Uso wangu utakwenda pamoja nawe, nami nitakupa raha.”

english: “If Your Presence does not go with us,” Moses replied, “do not lead us up from here.
ekegusii: Musa akamoiraneria, “Onye aye omonyene tokogenda amo naintwe, rirorio totige, tobeere aa.
swahili: Kisha Mose akamwambia, “Kama Uso wako hauendi pamoja nasi, usituondoe hapa.

english: For how then can it be known that Your people and I have found favor in Your sight, unless You go with us? How else will we be distinguished from all the other people on the face of the earth?”
ekegusii: Naki eramanyekane ng’a inche na abanto bao twanyorire ogwancherwa ase obosio bwao, onye tokogenda amo naintwe? Koragende amo naintwe, natororekane ng’a twachorirwe korwa ase abanto bande b’ense eye.”
swahili: Mtu yeyote atajuaje kuwa mimi pamoja na watu wako tumepata kibali mbele zako, usipokwenda pamoja nasi? Ni nini kingine kitakachoweza kututofautisha mimi na watu wako miongoni mwa watu wengine wote walio katika uso wa dunia?”

english: So the LORD said to Moses, “I will do this very thing you have asked, for you have found favor in My sight, and I know you by name.”
ekegusii: Omonene akairaneria Musa, “Ninkore erio kwamboria, ekiagera kwanyorire ogwancherwa ase obosio bwane, na inche ninkomanyete buya kegima, na buna okorokwa.”
swahili: Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Nitakufanyia jambo lile uliloomba, kwa sababu ninapendezwa nawe, nami ninakujua kwa jina lako.”

english: Then Moses said, “Please show me Your glory.”
ekegusii: Musa akamosaba, “Koranche, onyorokie obonene bwao!”
swahili: Kisha Mose akasema, “Basi nionyeshe utukufu wako.”

english: “I will cause all My goodness to pass before you,” the LORD replied, “and I will proclaim My name—the LORD—in your presence. I will have mercy on whom I have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I have compassion.”
ekegusii: Omonene akamoiraneria, “Ninkore obosiani bwane bwonsi boete ase obosio bwao, na erieta riane, inche Omonene, nindirarie ase obosio bwao. Nimororere amabeebe oyio ndarorere amabeebe, na nimororere amaabera oyio ndarorere amaabera.”
swahili: Ndipo Bwana akasema, “Nitapitisha wema wangu wote mbele yako, nami nitalitangaza Jina langu, Bwana, mbele ya uso wako. Nitamrehemu yeye nimrehemuye, na pia nitamhurumia yeye nimhurumiaye.”

english: And I will send an angel before you, and I will drive out the Canaanites, Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites.
ekegusii: Nintome omomalaika agotang’ane, Niserie Abakanaani, na Abaamori, na Abahiti, na Abaperisi, na Abahivi na Abayebusi.
swahili: Nitamtuma malaika mbele yenu, naye atawafukuza Wakanaani, Waamori, Wahiti, Waperizi, Wahivi na Wayebusi.

english: But He added, “You cannot see My face, for no one can see Me and live.”
ekegusii: Naende akamokania, akamoteebia, “Tokonyara korora obosio bwane, ekiagera Mwanyabaanto aise kondora, takonyara koba moyo.”
swahili: Lakini Mungu akasema, “Hutaweza kuuona uso wangu, kwa kuwa hakuna mtu yeyote awezaye kuniona akaishi.”

english: The LORD continued, “There is a place near Me where you are to stand upon a rock,
ekegusii: Naende Omonene akagenderera komoteebia, “Rora, aase aiga are ang’e nainche, aye oranyare gotenena egetare igoro.
swahili: Kisha Bwana akasema, “Kuna mahali karibu nami ambapo unaweza kusimama juu ya mwamba.

english: and when My glory passes by, I will put you in a cleft of the rock and cover you with My hand until I have passed by.
ekegusii: Erio ekero obonene bwane borabe bogoeta, ninkobeke ase omotaro bw’egetare keria, na ngotube nokoboko kwane, goika imbe naetire.
swahili: Utukufu wangu unapopita, nitakuweka gengeni kwenye mwamba na kukufunika kwa mkono wangu mpaka nitakapokwisha kupita.

english: Then I will take My hand away, and you will see My back; but My face must not be seen.”
ekegusii: Erio ndusie okoboko kwane, na aye ondore amagega aane, korende obosio bwane tokonyara koborora.”
swahili: Kisha nitaondoa mkono wangu nawe utaona mgongo wangu; lakini kamwe uso wangu hautaonekana.”

english: Go up to a land flowing with milk and honey. But I will not go with you, because you are a stiff-necked people; otherwise, I might destroy you on the way.”
ekegusii: Nimbaire ase ense ere entenenku y’amabeere na amooke. Inche omonyene tinkogenda amo nainwe, mbaise kobaitera inchera, ekiagera inwe nabanyabigoti bikong’u.”
swahili: Pandeni mwende katika nchi itiririkayo maziwa na asali. Lakini mimi sitakwenda pamoja nanyi, kwa sababu ninyi ni watu wenye shingo ngumu, nisije nikawaangamiza njiani.”

english: When the people heard these bad tidings, they went into mourning, and no one put on any of his jewelry.
ekegusii: Ekero abanto baigwete amang’ana ayio amakong’u bakarera na onde taba obegete ebinto biaye bi’ogwechabera.
swahili: Watu waliposikia habari hizo za huzuni, wakaanza kuomboleza wala hakuna mtu aliyevaa mapambo yoyote.

english: For the LORD had said to Moses, “Tell the Israelites, ‘You are a stiff-necked people. If I should go with you for a single moment, I would destroy you. Now take off your jewelry, and I will decide what to do with you.’”
ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa “Bateebie Abaisraeli: Inwe nabanyabigoti bikong’u. Inse kogenda amo nainwe, nonya netagika eyemo, nigo ndabasirie kegima. Gaki bono rusia ebinto biaino ebi mwechaberete, erio ndore inki ndabakorere.”
swahili: Kwa kuwa Bwana alikuwa amemwambia Mose, “Waambie Waisraeli, ‘Ninyi ni watu wenye shingo ngumu. Kama ningefuatana nanyi hata kwa muda mfupi, ningewaangamiza. Sasa vueni mapambo yenu, nami nitaamua nitakalowatendea.’ ”

english: So the Israelites stripped themselves of their jewelry from Mount Horeb onward. The Tent of Meeting
ekegusii: Ase igo Abaisraeli bakarusia ebinto biria bechaberete, na tibabibeka korwa ekero baruete egetunwa kia Horebu nakogenderera. Eema y’Omosangererekano
swahili: Hivyo Waisraeli wakavua mapambo yao katika Mlima wa Horebu. Hema La Kukutania

english: Now Moses used to take the tent and pitch it at a distance outside the camp. He called it the Tent of Meeting, and anyone inquiring of the LORD would go to the Tent of Meeting outside the camp.
ekegusii: Musa nigo anarete koira eema na koyetenenia are ake korwa ase egetwori akayeroka “Eema y’Omosangererekano.” Na onde bwensi oganetie kobori’Omonene ring’ana, goika are kogende ase Eema eria, isiko y’egetwori.
swahili: Basi Mose alikuwa na desturi ya kuchukua hema na kuliweka wakfu nje ya kambi umbali kiasi, akaliita “Hema la Kukutania.” Kila aliyekuwa akiulizia shauri kwa Bwana, angelikwenda katika Hema la Kukutania nje ya kambi.

english: Then, whenever Moses went out to the tent, all the people would stand at the entrances to their own tents and watch Moses until he entered the tent.
ekegusii: Engaki ende yonsi Musa arenge kogenda ase Eema eria, abanto bonsi nigo baare koimoka na gotenena, kera omonto ase egesoero ki’eema yaye, na korigereria Musa goika osoire Eema eria ime.
swahili: Wakati wowote Mose alipokwenda kwenye Hema, watu wote waliinuka na kusimama kwenye maingilio ya mahema yao, wakimwangalia Mose mpaka aingie kwenye Hema.

english: As Moses entered the tent, the pillar of cloud would come down and remain at the entrance, and the LORD would speak with Moses.
ekegusii: Ekero Musa asoire Eema eria, riire riare buna esiiro riba rigoika na gotenena ase egesoero ki’Eema eria, n’Omonene aba ogokwana na Musa.
swahili: Kila mara Mose alipoingia ndani ya hema, nguzo ya wingu ingeshuka chini na kukaa kwenye ingilio, wakati Mungu akizungumza na Mose.

english: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Chisel out two stone tablets like the originals, and I will write on them the words that were on the first tablets, which you broke.
ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa, “Baacha chibao chi’amagena ibere chire buna chiria chi’eritang’ani, na inche nindiike ase chibao echio amang’ana aria arenge ase chiria chi’eritang’ani, echio gwatete.
swahili: Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Chonga vibao viwili vya mawe kama vile vya kwanza, nami nitaandika juu yake maneno yale yaliyokuwa kwenye vile vibao vya kwanza, ulivyovivunja.

english: And the LORD said, “Behold, I am making a covenant. Before all your people I will perform wonders that have never been done in any nation in all the world. All the people among whom you live will see the LORD’s work, for it is an awesome thing that I am doing with you.
ekegusii: Omonene akabora, “Rora, bono ngokora inde nainwe okobwatana kw’ogotianania. Ase amasio ’abaanto bao bonsi ninkore ebikone ebio bitana gokoreka ase ense yonsi, gose ase egesaku kende gionsi. Na abanto bonsi abagoetanaine inabarore ogokora kw’Omonene, naki ayio ndagokorere namang’ana ay’okoondokia.
swahili: Kisha Bwana akasema: “Tazama ninafanya Agano mbele ya watu wako wote. Mbele ya watu wako wote nitafanya maajabu ambayo hayajafanyika katika taifa lolote katika ulimwengu wote. Watu wale mnaoishi miongoni mwao wataona jinsi ilivyo ya kushangaza ile kazi nitakayowafanyia mimi Bwana wenu.

english: Observe what I command you this day. I will drive out before you the Amorites, Canaanites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites.
ekegusii: Obwate amachiiko ayio ndakoe reero. Norore ase obosio bwao ngoseria Abaamori, na Abakanaani, na Abahiti, na Abaperisi, na Abahivi, na Abayebusi.
swahili: Tii yale ninayokuamuru leo. Tazama nawafukuza mbele yako Waamori, Wakanaani, Wahiti, Waperizi, Wahivi na Wayebusi.

english: Be careful not to make a treaty with the inhabitants of the land you are entering, lest they become a snare in your midst.
ekegusii: Bwerende, tobaisa gokora okobwatana nabanyene ense eria ase okogenda, baabaise kobatega mogwe.
swahili: Uwe mwangalifu, usifanye agano na wale wanaokaa katika nchi ile unayoiendea, la sivyo watakuwa mtego katikati yako.

english: Rather, you must tear down their altars, smash their sacred stones, and chop down their Asherah poles.
ekegusii: Inwe motagore ebisasimero biabo, mobiiyerie inse, na gosenyenta chisiiro chi’amagena ase bagosasimera.
swahili: Bomoa madhabahu yao, vunja mawe yao ya kuabudia na ukatekate nguzo zao za Ashera.

english: For you must not worship any other god, for the LORD, whose name is Jealous, is a jealous God.
ekegusii: “Tobaisa gosasiima enyasae ende eng’ao, ekiagera Omonene nigo akorokwa Omonyaisemi, nere Nyasae bwe risemi.
swahili: Usiabudu mungu mwingine, kwa kuwa Bwana, ambaye jina lake ni Wivu, ni Mungu mwenye wivu.

english: Do not make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land, for when they prostitute themselves to their gods and sacrifice to them, they will invite you, and you will eat their sacrifices.
ekegusii: Tobaisa gokora okobwatana nabanyene ense eria, ekiagera ekero bagokora obotomani ase ogosasiima chinyasae chiabo na gochiruera ebing’wanso, mbaabaise kobarangeria inwe morie ebing’wanso biabo.
swahili: “Uwe mwangalifu usifanye agano na wale watu wanaoishi katika nchi, kwa maana wakati wanapojifanyia ukahaba kwa miungu yao na kuwatolea kafara, watakualika wewe nawe utakula sadaka za matambiko yao.

english: And when you take some of their daughters as brides for your sons, their daughters will prostitute themselves to their gods and cause your sons to do the same.
ekegusii: Inamoire abakungu korwa ase abasubati babo abwo bagokora obotomani ase ogosasiima chinyasae chiabo, barabwo bakore abamura baino basasime chinyasae chiabo.
swahili: Unapowachagua baadhi ya binti zao kuwa wake wa wana wenu na binti hao wakajifanyia ukahaba kwa miungu yao, watawaongoza wana wenu kufanya vivyo hivyo.

english: You shall make no molten gods for yourselves.
ekegusii: “Tibwekorera chinyasae korwa ase ebioma binyititoire na kobombwa.
swahili: “Usijifanyie sanamu za kusubu.

english: You are to keep the Feast of Unleavened Bread. For seven days at the appointed time in the month of Abib, you are to eat unleavened bread as I commanded you. For in the month of Abib you came out of Egypt.
ekegusii: “Orende rituko rinene ri’Emegati etabekiri memera; na buna nagochigeete, orie emegati etabekiri memera ase amatuko atano na abere, ase engaki yachigetwe, y’omotienyi bw’Abibu, naki ase omotienyi oyio oyio noro kwaruete ense ya Misiri.
swahili: “Utaadhimisha Sikukuu ya Mikate Isiyotiwa Chachu. Kwa siku saba mtakula mikate isiyotiwa chachu, kama nilivyokuamuru. Fanya hivi kwa wakati ulioamriwa, katika mwezi wa Abibu, ndio mwezi wa nne, kwa kuwa katika mwezi huo ndipo wewe ulipotoka Misri.

english: The first offspring of every womb belongs to Me, including all the firstborn males among your livestock, whether cattle or sheep.
ekegusii: “Kera omwana omoisia omotangi nabe oyone, ne ching’iti chintangi boigo, chibe chieri gose chimingichi.
swahili: “Mzaliwa wa kwanza wa kila tumbo ni mali yangu, pamoja na wazaliwa wa kwanza wote wa kiume wa mifugo yako, ikiwa ni wa ngʼombe au wa kondoo au mbuzi.

english: Be ready in the morning, and come up on Mount Sinai to present yourself before Me on the mountaintop.
ekegusii: Oche bwebeeke ang’e mambia, otiire gocha ase egetunwa gia Sinai maambia, bweorokie aroro ase inde ase egechuria ki’egetunwa.
swahili: Uwe tayari asubuhi, kisha upande juu ya Mlima Sinai. Uje mbele zangu kukutana nami huko juu ya mlima.

english: You must redeem the firstborn of a donkey with a lamb; but if you do not redeem it, you are to break its neck. You must redeem all the firstborn of your sons. No one shall appear before Me empty-handed.
ekegusii: Korende emori entangi y’etigere goika oyeboorie ase okorua eng’ondi ebe ekeng’wanso. Onye tibwancheti koyebooria, goika oyebune ebigoti. Abana bao abaisia abatangi goika obaboorie. Onde tari orabe ogocha ase obosio bwane, inche Omonene, namaboko amasa.
swahili: Utakomboa mzaliwa wa kwanza wa punda kwa mwana-kondoo, lakini kama humkomboi, utavunja shingo yake. Utakomboa wazaliwa wako wa kwanza wote wa kiume. “Mtu yeyote asije mbele zangu mikono mitupu.

english: Six days you shall labor, but on the seventh day you shall rest; even in the seasons of plowing and harvesting, you must rest.
ekegusii: “Okore emeremo ase amatuko atano na rimo, korende rituko ria gatano na kabere otimoke, nonya nengaki y’okorema na eye rigesa.
swahili: “Kwa siku sita utafanya kazi, lakini siku ya saba utapumzika, hata ikiwa ni majira ya kulima au ya kuvuna lazima upumzike.

english: And you are to celebrate the Feast of Weeks with the firstfruits of the wheat harvest, and the Feast of Ingathering at the turn of the year.
ekegusii: “Orende Rituko Rinene rie Chichuma, ase engencho y’ogotongora kw’engano, ne Rituko Rinene ri’Ogosangereria Rigesa, omoerio bw’omwaka.
swahili: “Utaadhimisha Sikukuu ya Majuma kwa malimbuko ya mavuno ya ngano, na Sikukuu ya Mavuno mwishoni mwa mwaka.

english: Three times a year all your males are to appear before the Lord GOD, the God of Israel.
ekegusii: “Ara gatato kera omwaka abanto bao bonsi abasacha babe bagocha ase obosio bwane, inche Omonene Nyasae, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli.
swahili: Mara tatu kwa mwaka wanaume wako wote watakuja mbele za Bwana Mwenyezi, Mungu wa Israeli.

english: For I will drive out the nations before you and enlarge your borders, and no one will covet your land when you go up three times a year to appear before the LORD your God.
ekegusii: Ninserie abanto b’ebisaku korwa asore na kogareyia orogongo rwao, onde tari orakoroure ase chingaki echi isato kera omwaka, ekero orabe kogocha ase obosio bwane, inche Omonene, Nyasae oo.
swahili: Nitawafukuza mataifa mbele yako na kupanua mipaka ya nchi yako, wala hakuna mtu yeyote atakayeitamani nchi yako wakati unapokwenda mara tatu kila mwaka kuonana na Bwana Mungu wako.

english: Do not offer the blood of a sacrifice to Me along with anything leavened, and do not let any of the sacrifice from the Passover Feast remain until morning.
ekegusii: “Ekero okondetera amanyinga ’ekeng’wanso, tobaisa koyandetera amo nomogati obekire ememera. Tobaisa gotigaria chinyama chinde chi’ekeng’wanso kie rituko rinene ri’Epasaka goika mambia.
swahili: “Usinitolee damu ya dhabihu pamoja na kitu chochote chenye chachu, wala usibakize dhabihu yoyote ya Sikukuu ya Pasaka mpaka asubuhi.

english: Bring the best of the firstfruits of your soil to the house of the LORD your God. You must not cook a young goat in its mother’s milk.”
ekegusii: “Goika orente ase enyomba yane, inche Omonene oo, ogotongora kwao okore okuya korwa ase omogondo oo. “Tobaisa koiyekera emanwa y’embori, gose yeng’ondi ime y’amabeere ’eng’ina.”
swahili: “Leta matunda ya kwanza yaliyo bora zaidi ya ardhi yako katika nyumba ya Bwana Mungu wako. “Usimchemshe mwana-mbuzi katika maziwa ya mama yake.”

english: The LORD also said to Moses, “Write down these words, for in accordance with these words I have made a covenant with you and with Israel.”
ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa, “Riika amang’ana aya, ekiagera ase amang’ana ayio nakorire okobwatana kw’ogotianania naye amo n’Abaisraeli.”
swahili: Kisha Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Andika maneno haya, kwa maana kulingana na maneno haya, nimefanya Agano na wewe pamoja na Israeli.”

english: So Moses was there with the LORD forty days and forty nights without eating bread or drinking water. He wrote on the tablets the words of the covenant—the Ten Commandments.
ekegusii: Musa akabeera n’Omonene ase engaki y’amatuko emerongo ene, omobaso na obotuko, tare koria kende, gose konywa, akarika ase chibao echi ibere amang’ana ’okobwatana koria, Amachiiko ayio ikomi. Musa ogotirimboka korwa ase egetunwa
swahili: Mose alikuwa huko pamoja na Bwana kwa siku arobaini usiku na mchana bila kula chakula wala kunywa maji. Naye akaandika juu ya vibao maneno ya Agano, yaani zile Amri Kumi. Mngʼao Wa Uso Wa Mose

english: And when Moses came down from Mount Sinai with the two tablets of the Testimony in his hands, he was unaware that his face had become radiant from speaking with the LORD.
ekegusii: Musa agatirimboka korwa ase egetunwa gia Sinai, obwate ase okoboko kwaye chibao chiriikire oborori, ere tamanya ng’a risankwa ri’obosio bwaye nigo riare komeka‐meka, ekiagera konya okwanire n’Omonene.
swahili: Mose alipoteremka kutoka Mlima Sinai akiwa na vile vibao viwili vya Ushuhuda mikononi mwake, hakujua kuwa uso wake ulikuwa ukingʼaa, kwa sababu alikuwa amezungumza na Bwana.

english: No one may go up with you; in fact, no one may be seen anywhere on the mountain—not even the flocks or herds may graze in front of the mountain.”
ekegusii: Monto onde tatiira amo naye, gose monto onde tarorekana aande onsi ase egetunwa eke, gose ching’ondi ne chiombe tichiba chikorisia ang’e negetunwa eke.”
swahili: Mtu yeyote asije pamoja nawe, wala asionekane mtu popote juu ya mlima, wala kondoo na mbuzi au ngʼombe wasilishe karibu mbele ya huo mlima.”

english: Aaron and all the Israelites looked at Moses, and behold, his face was radiant. And they were afraid to approach him.
ekegusii: Aroni na abanto bonsi, ekero baroche buna risankwa ri’obosio bwa Musa riare komeka‐meka, bakoboa komoika ang’e.
swahili: Aroni na Waisraeli wote walipomwona Mose, kuwa uso wake unangʼaa, waliogopa kumkaribia.

english: But Moses called out to them; so Aaron and all the leaders of the congregation returned to him, and Moses spoke to them.
ekegusii: Korende Musa akabarangeria, erio Aroni amo nabatang’ani bonsi b’omosangererekano bakairana asare, na Musa agakwana nabarabwo.
swahili: Lakini Mose akawaita, kwa hiyo Aroni na viongozi wote wa jumuiya wakarudi, naye akazungumza nao.

english: And after this all the Israelites came near, and Moses commanded them to do everything that the LORD had told him on Mount Sinai.
ekegusii: Magega y’ayio Abaisraeli bonsi bagacha ase Musa, na ere akabaa amachiiko onsi ay’Omonene konya amoeire ase egetunwa gia Sinai.
swahili: Baadaye Waisraeli wote wakamkaribia, naye akawapa amri zote Bwana alizompa katika Mlima wa Sinai.

english: When Moses had finished speaking with them, he put a veil over his face.
ekegusii: Ekero Musa akoorire gokwana nabarabwo, akabeeka egietubo ase obosio bwaye.
swahili: Mose alipomaliza kuzungumza nao, akaweka utaji kwenye uso wake.

english: But whenever Moses went in before the LORD to speak with Him, he would remove the veil until he came out. And when he came out, he would tell the Israelites what he had been commanded,
ekegusii: Ekero kende gionsi Musa are gosoa eema ase obosio bw’Omonene gokwana nere, nigo are korusia egietubo goika osoka korwa aroro. Ekero asokire aba ogoteebia Abaisraeli amang’ana onsi aya achikirwe gokwana,
swahili: Lakini kila wakati Mose alipoingia mbele za Bwana kuzungumza naye, aliondoa ule utaji mpaka alipotoka nje. Naye alipotoka nje na kuwaambia Waisraeli lile ambalo ameagizwa,

english: and the Israelites would see that the face of Moses was radiant. So Moses would put the veil back over his face until he went in to speak with the LORD.
ekegusii: na barabwo baba bakorora risankwa ri’obosio bwaye rikomeka‐meka. Erio Musa abeeka egietubo ase obosio bwaye goika airana naende gokwana n’Omonene.
