swahili: waliona kuwa uso wake unangʼaa. Kisha Mose angeliweka tena utaji juu ya uso wake mpaka alipokwenda kuzungumza na Bwana.

english: So Moses chiseled out two stone tablets like the originals. He rose early in the morning, and taking the two stone tablets in his hands, he went up Mount Sinai as the LORD had commanded him.
ekegusii: Erio Musa akabaacha chibao ibere chi’amagena chire buna chiria chi’eritang’ani, akaimoka mambia chuni, agatiira gochia ase egetunwa gia Sinai, buna Omonene konya amochikiire, obogoretie chibao chiria ibere chi’amagena koboko kwaye.
swahili: Kwa hiyo Mose akachonga vibao viwili vya mawe kama vile vya kwanza, naye akapanda juu ya Mlima Sinai asubuhi na mapema, kama Bwana alivyokuwa amemwagiza, akachukua vile vibao viwili vya mawe mikononi mwake.

english: And the LORD descended in a cloud, stood with him there, and proclaimed His name, the LORD.
ekegusii: Omonene agaika ore riire ime, agatenena amo nere, akararia erieta NYASAE OMOBUI.
swahili: Kisha Bwana akashuka katika wingu akasimama pamoja naye huko, akalitangaza jina lake, Bwana.

english: Then the LORD passed in front of Moses and called out: “The LORD, the LORD God, is compassionate and gracious, slow to anger, abounding in loving devotion and faithfulness,
ekegusii: Omonene agaeta ase obosio bwa Musa, akeraria, “Omonene Nyasae, nere Nyasae omonyene amaabera na obuya, tari omwango bw’okoba nendamwamu; nigo are nobwanchani botari koera, na obwegenwa.
swahili: Bwana akapita mbele ya Mose, akitangaza, “ Bwana, Bwana, Mungu mwenye huruma na neema, asiye mwepesi wa hasira, mwingi wa upendo na uaminifu,

english: maintaining loving devotion to a thousand generations, forgiving iniquity, transgression, and sin. Yet He will by no means leave the guilty unpunished; He will visit the iniquity of the fathers on their children and grandchildren to the third and fourth generations.”
ekegusii: Nigo agokorera ebiare chilifu obwanchani botari koera; ere nigo akwabera amamocho, na ogosaria, na ebibe, korende tagotiga koa abana na abachokoro egesusuro goika ekiaare kia gatato na egia kane ase engencho y’amabe ’abaibori babo.”
swahili: akidumisha upendo kwa maelfu, pia akisamehe uovu, uasi na dhambi. Lakini haachi kuadhibu mwenye hatia; huwaadhibu watoto na watoto wao kwa ajili ya dhambi ya baba zao hata katika kizazi cha tatu na cha nne.”

english: Moses immediately bowed down to the ground and worshiped.
ekegusii: Erio bwango Musa agatung’ama inse agatureka omotwe, agasasiima,
swahili: Mara Mose akasujudu na kuabudu.

english: “O Lord,” he said, “if I have indeed found favor in Your sight, my Lord, please go with us. Although this is a stiff-necked people, forgive our iniquity and sin, and take us as Your inheritance.” The LORD Renews the Covenant (2 Corinthians 3:7–18)
ekegusii: akabora, “Omonene, onye bono nanyorire ogwancherwa ase obosio bwao, nagosabire ogende amo naintwe. Naki abanto aba nabanyabigoti bikong’u, korende otwabere ogosaria gwaito na ebibe biaito, otwanchere tobe abanto bao.” Okobwatana kw’ogotianania kogokorwa naende (Okong’ 23:14-19; Okoir 7:1-5; 16:1-17)
swahili: Mose akasema, “Ee Bwana, kama nimepata kibali mbele zako, basi Bwana uende pamoja nasi. Ingawa watu hawa ni wenye shingo ngumu, samehe uovu wetu na dhambi yetu, tuchukue kuwa urithi wako.” Kufanya Agano Upya (Kutoka 23:14-19; Kumbukumbu 7:1-5; 16:1-17)

english: Then Moses assembled the whole congregation of Israel and said to them, “These are the things that the LORD has commanded you to do:
ekegusii: Musa akarangeria omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli amo, akabateebia, “Aya nar’Omonene achiikire morakore:
swahili: Mose akakusanya jumuiya yote ya Waisraeli na kuwaambia, “Haya ndiyo mambo ambayo Bwana amewaamuru ninyi mfanye:

english: Let every skilled craftsman among you come and make everything that the LORD has commanded:
ekegusii: “Abaroisia bonsi abang’aini abare ase egati yaino, tiga bache baroisie ebinto bionsi Omonene achiikire,
swahili: “Wote wenye ujuzi miongoni mwenu inawapasa kuja na kutengeneza kila kitu Bwana alichoamuru:

english: the tabernacle with its tent and covering, its clasps and frames, its crossbars, posts, and bases;
ekegusii: nabio ebi: Obomenyo na eema yaye, na egietubo kiaye, ebigobanio ne chibao chiaye, na emeriibo, ne chisiiro amo ne chinterekerero chiabo;
swahili: Maskani pamoja na hema lake na kifuniko chake, vibanio, mihimili, mataruma, nguzo na vitako;

english: the ark with its poles and mercy seat, and the veil to shield it;
ekegusii: Esanduki na emiaro yaye, na Oboikaranso bw’amaabera, na etoto eria erabeekwe ebokenge;
swahili: Sanduku la Agano pamoja na mipiko yake, kifuniko cha kiti cha rehema na pazia linalokizuia;

english: the table with its poles, all its utensils, and the Bread of the Presence;
ekegusii: emesa na emiaro yaye, na ebikorero biaye bionsi, na emegati eria eraruegwe ase Nyasae;
swahili: meza na mipiko yake pamoja na vyombo vyake vyote, mikate ya Wonyesho;

english: the lampstand for light with its accessories and lamps and oil for the light;
ekegusii: ekebekerero gie chitaaya na ebikorero biaye, ne chitaaya chiaye amo namaguta e chitaaya,
swahili: kinara cha taa kwa ajili ya mwanga pamoja na vifaa vyake vyote, taa na mafuta kwa ajili ya mwanga;

english: the altar of incense with its poles; the anointing oil and fragrant incense; the curtain for the doorway at the entrance to the tabernacle;
ekegusii: na egesasiimero ase ubani egosamberwa amo nemiaro yaye, na amaguta akweakwa, na amanukato are ne rimisu rigiya, na ebitambaa bigosungwa ase egesoero ki’Obomenyo obwo;
swahili: madhabahu ya kufukiza uvumba pamoja na mipiko yake, mafuta ya upako na uvumba wenye harufu nzuri; pazia la mlangoni mahali pa kuingilia ndani ya maskani;

english: the altar of burnt offering with its bronze grate, its poles, and all its utensils; the basin with its stand;
ekegusii: na egesasiimero aase ebing’wanso bigosamberwa amo negechungi kiaye gi’etai, na emiaro yaye, na ebikorero biaye bionsi, na egetuba amo nenterekerero yaye;
swahili: madhabahu ya sadaka za kuteketeza pamoja na wavu wake wa shaba, mipiko yake pamoja na vyombo vyake vyote; sinia la shaba pamoja na tako lake;

english: the curtains of the courtyard with its posts and bases, and the curtain for the gate of the courtyard;
ekegusii: ebitambaa ebirakenge eraaro, ne chisiiro amo ne chinterekerero chiaye, na egetambaa ki’egesoero ki’eraaro,
swahili: pazia la eneo la ua pamoja na nguzo zake na vitako vyake, pazia la ingilio la kwenye ua;

english: the tent pegs for the tabernacle and for the courtyard, along with their ropes;
ekegusii: na ebirochi bi’Obomenyo na ebi’eraaro amo ne chingori chiabo,
swahili: vigingi vya hema kwa ajili ya maskani pamoja na ua na kamba zake;

english: and the woven garments for ministering in the holy place—both the holy garments for Aaron the priest and the garments for his sons to serve as priests.” The People Offer Gifts
ekegusii: ne chianga chiria chinseera chigokorerwa ime y’Ase Achenu, engencho yaye chianga chia Aroni Omokuani, amo nechi’abamura baye, barabe bakobeeka ekero bagokora emeremo yabo y’obokuani.” Abanto bakorenta ebiegwa biabo
swahili: mavazi yaliyofumwa yanayovaliwa wakati wa huduma katika mahali patakatifu, yaani mavazi matakatifu kwa ajili ya kuhani Aroni, na mavazi kwa ajili ya wanawe watakapokuwa wakihudumu katika kazi ya ukuhani.”

english: For six days work may be done, but the seventh day shall be your holy day, a Sabbath of complete rest to the LORD. Whoever does any work on that day must be put to death.
ekegusii: Mokore emeremo ase amatuko atano na rimo, korende rituko ria gatano na kabere nigo rirabe richenu ase more, rituko ri’Esabato, riogotimoka ase Omonene. Onde bwensi aise gokora emeremo ase rituko erio goika aitwe akwe.
swahili: Kwa siku sita, mtafanya kazi, lakini siku ya saba itakuwa takatifu kwenu, Sabato ya kupumzika kwa Bwana. Yeyote atakayefanya kazi yoyote siku hiyo ni lazima auawe.

english: Then the whole congregation of Israel withdrew from the presence of Moses.
ekegusii: Erio omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli okaruao agwo ase obosio bwa Musa.
swahili: Ndipo jumuiya yote ya Waisraeli ilipoondoka mbele ya Mose,

english: And everyone whose heart stirred him and whose spirit prompted him came and brought an offering to the LORD for the work on the Tent of Meeting, for all its services, and for the holy garments.
ekegusii: Naende bakairana kera oyomo buna enkoro yaye yamosugetie, na buna anchete ere omonyene, bakarentera Omonene ebiegwa biabo ase okoroisia Eema y’Omosangererekano na ebinto bionsi ebiaganeirie, ase emeremo eria na ase chianga chiria chinchenu.
swahili: na kila mmoja aliyependa na ambaye moyo wake ulimsukuma alikuja na kuleta sadaka kwa Bwana, kwa ajili ya kazi katika Hema la Kukutania, kwa ajili ya huduma yake yote na kwa ajili ya mavazi matakatifu.

english: So all who had willing hearts, both men and women, came and brought brooches and earrings, rings and necklaces, and all kinds of gold jewelry. And they all presented their gold as a wave offering to the LORD.
ekegusii: Barabwo bagacha, abasacha na abakungu, na ase ogwancha kwabo bakarenta amameka, na ebigera bi’amato abo, ne chibonyi chi’ebiara, ne chisonoi, na ebinto ao ao bie chitaabu bi’ogwechabera. Kera omonto akarenta ebinto bie chitaabu, ebi aatananete ase ogokorera Omonene.
swahili: Wote waliokuwa na utayari, wanaume kwa wanawake, wakaja wakaleta vito vya dhahabu vya kila aina: vipini, vipuli, pete na mapambo. Wote wakatoa dhahabu zao kama sadaka ya kuinuliwa kwa Bwana.

english: Everyone who had blue, purple, or scarlet yarn, or fine linen, goat hair, ram skins dyed red, or articles of fine leather, brought them.
ekegusii: Naende kera omonto oyo obwate chiusi chi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, na egatani engiya, na amanya e chimbori, na amasankwa e chimingichi aakire etaago, na amasankwa e ching’iti chia rooche, akabirenta.
swahili: Kila mmoja aliyekuwa na nyuzi za rangi ya buluu, za zambarau, au za rangi nyekundu au kitani safi, au singa za mbuzi, ngozi za kondoo dume zilizotiwa rangi nyekundu, au ngozi za pomboo, wakavileta.

english: And all who could present an offering of silver or bronze brought it as a contribution to the LORD. Also, everyone who had acacia wood for any part of the service brought it.
ekegusii: Bonsi abaare konyara korua chifeta ne chitaai bakabirenta bibe ebiegwa ase Omonene, na bonsi abarenge nemekonge eyere emiya ase emeremo ende yonsi, bakayerenta.
swahili: Wale waliotoa sadaka ya fedha au shaba wakavileta kama sadaka kwa Bwana, na kila aliyekuwa na mti wa mshita kwa ajili ya kazi yoyote ile akauleta.

english: Every skilled woman spun with her hands and brought what she had spun: blue, purple, or scarlet yarn, or fine linen.
ekegusii: Na abakungu abaroisia abang’aini bagasisa namaboko abo chiusi chi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, na echi’egatani engiya, bagachirenta.
swahili: Kila mwanamke aliyekuwa na ujuzi alisokota kwa mikono yake na alileta kile alichosokota, iwe ni nyuzi za rangi ya buluu, za zambarau, au za rangi nyekundu au kitani safi.

english: And all the skilled women whose hearts were stirred spun the goat hair.
ekegusii: Na abakungu bonsi, abasugetigwe ase emioyo yabo, naende bamanyete emeremo eye, bagasisa amanya e chimbori abe chiusi.
swahili: Wanawake wote waliopenda na waliokuwa na ujuzi wakasokota singa za mbuzi.

english: The leaders brought onyx stones and gemstones to mount on the ephod and breastpiece,
ekegusii: Abatang’ani babo bakarenta amagena e rigori rinene buna oiniki na ayande arabekwe ase egesibao na egesembe ki’obokuani,
swahili: Viongozi wakaleta vito vya shohamu pamoja na vito vingine vya thamani kwa ajili ya kuweka kwenye kisibau na kwenye kifuko cha kifuani.

english: as well as spices and olive oil for the light, for the anointing oil, and for the fragrant incense.
ekegusii: naende ebinto bie rimisu rigiya amo namaguta e chitaaya, na amaguta akweakwa, na ubani ere ne rimisu rigiya.
swahili: Wakaleta pia vikolezi na mafuta ya zeituni kwa ajili ya mwanga, kwa ajili ya mafuta ya upako na kwa ajili ya uvumba wenye harufu nzuri.

english: So all the men and women of the Israelites whose hearts prompted them brought a freewill offering to the LORD for all the work that the LORD through Moses had commanded them to do. Bezalel and Oholiab (Exodus 31:1–11)
ekegusii: Abaisraeli bonsi, abasacha na abakungu, abarenge nogwancha korenta ebinto bi’emeremo eye Omonene achigete goetera ase Musa, bakarenta ebiegwa biabo ase Omonene. Abaroisia b’Obomenyo (Okong’ 31:1-11)
swahili: Waisraeli wote waume kwa wake waliokuwa wanapenda wakaleta mbele za Bwana kwa hiari yao wenyewe sadaka kwa ajili ya kazi yote ya Bwana aliyokuwa amewaagiza kuifanya kupitia kwa Mose. Bezaleli Na Oholiabu (Kutoka 31:1-11)

english: Do not light a fire in any of your dwellings on the Sabbath day.” Offerings for the Tabernacle (Exodus 25:1–9)
ekegusii: Timobaisa gouta omorero ase rituko ri’Esabato, aande onsi ase momenyete.” Ogosangererigwa kw’ebiegwa ase Obomenyo Obochenu (Okong’ 25:1-9)
swahili: Msiwashe moto mahali popote katika makazi yenu siku ya Sabato.” Vifaa Kwa Ajili Ya Maskani Ya Mungu (Kutoka 25:1-9)

english: Then Moses said to the Israelites, “See, the LORD has called by name Bezalel son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah.
ekegusii: Musa agateebia Abaisraeli, Rora, Omonene ochorire Besaleli, oyore mosinto o Uri, mochokoro o Huri bw’egesaku kia Yuda.
swahili: Kisha Mose akawaambia Waisraeli, “Tazameni, Bwana amemchagua Bezaleli mwana wa Uri, mwana wa Huri, wa kabila la Yuda,

english: And He has filled him with the Spirit of God, with skill, ability, and knowledge in all kinds of craftsmanship,
ekegusii: Omoichoirie omoika o Nyasae, omoeire obong’aini ne chisemi anyare gokora emeremo ende yonsi y’oboroisia,
swahili: naye amemjaza Roho wa Mungu, pamoja na ustadi, na uwezo na ujuzi katika aina zote za ufundi,

english: to design artistic works in gold, silver, and bronze,
ekegusii: abe oyomanyete koroberia na koroisia ebinto bie chitaabu, ne chifeta, ne chitaai,
swahili: ili kubuni michoro ya kupendeza katika ufundi wa dhahabu, fedha na shaba,

english: to cut gemstones for settings, and to carve wood, so that he may be a master of every artistic craft.
ekegusii: abe okobaacha amagena e rigori rinene na koyabeeka ase ebikonde, na kobaacha emete, na gokora emeremo ende yonsi y’oboroisia.
swahili: kuchonga vito na kuvitia mahali, kufanya ufundi kwa mbao, na kujishughulisha na aina zote za ufundi wa kupendeza.

english: And the LORD has given both him and Oholiab son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, the ability to teach others.
ekegusii: Omonene omoeire ere amo na Oholiabu, mosinto bw’Ahisamaki bw’egesaku kia Dani, obong’aini bw’okworokereria abande oboroisia bwabo.
swahili: Tena amempa yeye pamoja na Oholiabu, mwana wa Ahisamaki, wa kabila la Dani, uwezo wa kufundisha wengine.

english: He has filled them with skill to do all kinds of work as engravers, designers, embroiderers in blue, purple, and scarlet yarn and fine linen, and as weavers—as artistic designers of every kind of craft.
ekegusii: Obaichoirie obong’aini ase chinkoro chiabo, erinde banyare gokora emeremo ende yonsi buna okomang’a, na okoroberia, na koroisia ebitambaa bie chiusi chi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, na echi’egatani engiya, na koroisia ebitambaa binde bionsi. Banyare gokora emeremo ende yonsi na bamanye koroberia oboroisia bonde bwonsi.
swahili: Amewajaza ustadi wa kufanya kazi za aina zote zifanywazo na mafundi, na wenye kubuni michoro, pia na watarizi kwa rangi za buluu, zambarau, nyekundu na kitani safi, na wafumaji: wote wakiwa mafundi na wabunifu hodari.

english: Moses also told the whole congregation of Israel, “This is what the LORD has commanded:
ekegusii: Musa agateebia omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli, “Aya nar’Omonene achiikire:
swahili: Mose akaiambia jumuiya yote ya Waisraeli, “Hili ndilo Bwana aliloamuru:

english: Take from among you an offering to the LORD. Let everyone whose heart is willing bring an offering to the LORD: gold, silver, and bronze;
ekegusii: Moruere Omonene ebiegwa. Kera omonto oyore nomoyo bw’ogwancha aruere Omonene ebinto ebi: Etaabu, na efeta, na etai;
swahili: Toeni sadaka kwa Bwana kutoka mali mliyo nayo. Kila mmoja aliye na moyo wa kupenda atamletea Bwana sadaka ya dhahabu, fedha na shaba;

english: blue, purple, and scarlet yarn; fine linen and goat hair;
ekegusii: chiusi chi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri; egatani engiya na amanya e chimbori;
swahili: nyuzi za rangi ya buluu, za zambarau, za rangi nyekundu na kitani safi; singa za mbuzi;

english: olive oil for the light; spices for the anointing oil and for the fragrant incense;
ekegusii: amaguta e chitaaya, na ebinto bi’okoroisia amaguta akweakwa, na ebi’okoroisia ubani;
swahili: mafuta ya zeituni kwa ajili ya taa; vikolezi kwa ajili ya mafuta ya upako, pamoja na uvumba wa harufu nzuri;

english: and onyx stones and gemstones to be mounted on the ephod and breastpiece. The Skilled Craftsmen
ekegusii: amagena e rigori rinene buna oiniki na ayande akobekwa ase egesibao na egesembe ki’obokuani.” Ebinto bi’Obomenyo bwa Nyasae (Okong’ 39:32-43)
swahili: vito vya shohamu, na vito vingine vya thamani vya kuweka kwenye kisibau na kile kifuko cha kifuani.

english: “So Bezalel, Oholiab, and every skilled person are to carry out everything commanded by the LORD, who has given them skill and ability to know how to perform all the work of constructing the sanctuary.”
ekegusii: Besaleli na Oholiabu amo nabaroisia bande bonsi, aba Omonene konya aeire obong’aini, abare nogwancha kw’ogokora emeremo ende yonsi egwenerete ase okoagacha Obomenyo Obochenu, goika bakore kera emeremo buna Omonene konya achiikire. Abanto bakorenta ebiegwa ebinge
swahili: Kwa hiyo Bezaleli, Oholiabu na kila mtu Bwana aliyempa ustadi na uwezo wa kujua jinsi ya kufanya kazi zote za kujenga mahali patakatifu wataifanya hiyo kazi kama vile Bwana alivyoagiza.”

english: And he joined five of the curtains together, and the other five he joined as well.
ekegusii: Akabwatania ebitambaa bitano amo, bikaba rirondia erimo. Naboigo nebitambaa binde bitano.
swahili: Wakayaunganisha mapazia matano pamoja, pia wakafanya vivyo hivyo kwa hayo mengine matano.

english: He made loops of blue material on the edge of the end curtain in the first set, and also on the end curtain in the second set.
ekegusii: Agakora ebioro bie chiusi chiburu, bakabibeeka ase ensinyo y’egetambaa kere ensinyo y’ensemo ya kera rirondia.
swahili: Kisha wakatengeneza vitanzi vya kitambaa cha buluu kwenye upindo wa pazia la mwisho la fungu la kwanza, pia wakafanya vivyo hivyo na pazia la fungu la mwisho.

english: He made fifty loops on one curtain and fifty loops on the end curtain of the second set, so that the loops lined up opposite one another.
ekegusii: Agakora ebioro emerongo etano, akabibeeka ase egetambaa kegochakera rirondia rie ritang’ani, na emerongo etano ase egetambaa kegokoorera rirondia ria kabere. Ebioro bia kera rirondia bigachikana.
swahili: Wakatengeneza pia vitanzi hamsini katika pazia mmoja, na vitanzi vingine hamsini kwenye pazia la mwisho la fungu hilo lingine, nazo vitanzi vyote vikaelekeana.

english: He also made fifty gold clasps to join the curtains together, so that the tabernacle was a unit. The Eleven Curtains of Goat Hair (Exodus 26:7–14)
ekegusii: Agatura ebigobanio bie chitaabu emerongo etano, na ase ebio akabwatania amarondia ayio amo, akaba eema eyemo y’Obomenyo.
swahili: Kisha wakatengeneza vifungo hamsini vya dhahabu, na wakavitumia kufunga na kuunganisha zile fungu mbili za mapazia pamoja ili maskani ipate kuwa kitu kimoja.

english: He then made curtains of goat hair for the tent over the tabernacle—eleven curtains in all.
ekegusii: Erio akaroisia amarondia ikomi na rimo ay’amanya e chigoree, akaba eema y’ogotuba Obomenyo boria.
swahili: Wakatengeneza mapazia kumi na moja ya singa za mbuzi kwa ajili ya kufunika maskani.

english: Each of the eleven curtains was the same size—thirty cubits long and four cubits wide.
ekegusii: Obotambe bwa kera rirondia nigo bwarenge obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko emerongo etato, na obogare bwaye amaboko ane. Amarondia onsi aya ikomi na rimo nigo arenge ay’ekerengo ekemo.
swahili: Mapazia hayo kumi na moja yalikuwa na kipimo kimoja, yaani urefu wa dhiraa thelathini, na upana wa dhiraa nne.

english: He joined five of the curtains into one set and the other six into another.
ekegusii: Akabwatania amarondia atano amo, akaba rirondia erimo, naende atano na rimo akaba rirondia erimo.
swahili: Wakaunganisha mapazia matano kuwa fungu moja, na hayo mengine sita kuwa fungu lingine.

english: He made fifty loops along the edge of the end curtain in the first set, and fifty loops along the edge of the corresponding curtain in the second set.
ekegusii: Agakora ebioro emerongo etano, akabibeeka ase ensinyo ye rirondia rinene rie ritang’ani, na emerongo etano ase rirondia rinene ria kabere ase rigochakera.
swahili: Kisha wakatengeneza vitanzi hamsini kwenye upindo wa pazia la mwisho la fungu moja, na vivyo hivyo kwenye upindo wa pazia la mwisho la fungu hilo lingine.

english: He also made fifty bronze clasps to join the tent together as a unit.
ekegusii: Naende agakora ebigobanio emerongo etano bie chitaai ase okobwaterania amarondia ayio abere, abe eema engima.
swahili: Wakatengeneza vifungo hamsini vya shaba ili kukaza hema pamoja kuwa kitu kimoja.

english: Additionally, he made for the tent a covering of ram skins dyed red, and over that a covering of fine leather. The Frames and Bases (Exodus 26:15–30)
ekegusii: Agakora rirondia ri’amasankwa e chimingichi aakire etaago, ase ogotuba eema, ne rirondia rinde ri’amasankwa amaterere e ching’iti chia rooche, erirabeekwe igoro ye rirondia rie ritang’ani.
swahili: Kisha wakatengeneza kifuniko cha hema kwa ngozi za kondoo dume zilizotiwa rangi nyekundu, na juu yake kifuniko cha ngozi za pomboo.

english: Then Moses summoned Bezalel, Oholiab, and every skilled person whom the LORD had gifted—everyone whose heart stirred him to come and do the work.
ekegusii: Erio Musa akarangeria Besaleli amo na Oholiabu na abaroisia bande bonsi, aba Omonene aeire obong’aini, abaasugetigwe ase chinkoro chiabo, bache, bachake emeremo eria.
swahili: Ndipo Mose akawaita Bezaleli na Oholiabu na kila mtu mwenye ustadi ambaye Bwana alikuwa amempa uwezo na mwenye kupenda kuja na kufanya kazi.

english: Next, he constructed upright frames of acacia wood for the tabernacle.
ekegusii: Naende akaroisia chibao chi’emekonge ase Obomenyo, agachitenenia.
swahili: Wakatengeneza mihimili ya kusimamisha ya mti wa mshita kwa ajili ya maskani.

english: Each frame was ten cubits long and a cubit and a half wide.
ekegusii: Obotambe bwa kera ebao nigo bware obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko ikomi, na obogare okoboko okomo na ekeng’ese.
swahili: Kila mhimili ulikuwa na urefu wa dhiraa kumi, na upana wa dhiraa moja na nusu,

english: Two tenons were connected to each other for each frame. He made all the frames of the tabernacle in this way.
ekegusii: Agakora chintamang’o ibere ase kera ebao, ase chibao echio chirabwateranigwe. Naboigo aroisetie chibao echi chionsi chi’Obomenyo.
swahili: zikiwa na ndimi mbili zilizokuwa sambamba kila mmoja na mwingine. Wakatengeneza mihimili yote ya maskani jinsi hii.

english: He constructed twenty frames for the south side of the tabernacle,
ekegusii: Akaroisia chibao emerongo ebere ase ensemo ya Irianyi.
swahili: Wakatengeneza mihimili ishirini kwa ajili ya upande wa kusini wa maskani,

english: with forty silver bases to put under the twenty frames—two bases for each frame, one under each tenon.
ekegusii: Agakora ne chinterekerero chi’echifeta emerongo ene, chibe ibere ibere inse ya kera ebao ase chintamang’o chiaye ibere.
swahili: na wakatengeneza vitako arobaini vya fedha vya kuweka chini ya hiyo mihimili, vitako viwili kwa kila mhimili, kimoja chini ya kila ulimi.

english: For the second side of the tabernacle, the north side, he made twenty frames
ekegusii: Nase ensemo ya kabere, nero ya sugusu y’Obomenyo, akaroisia chibao emerongo ebere,
swahili: Kwa upande wa kaskazini wa maskani wakatengeneza mihimili ishirini

english: and forty silver bases—two bases under each frame.
ekegusii: ne chinterekerero chiaye chi’echifeta emerongo ene, ibere ibere inse ya kera ebao.
swahili: na vitako arobaini vya fedha, viwili chini ya kila mhimili.

english: He made six frames for the rear of the tabernacle, the west side,
ekegusii: Korende ase ensemo ya magega y’Obomenyo, eyerochie bosongo, akaroisia chibao isano nemo.
swahili: Wakatengeneza mihimili sita kwa mwisho ulio mbali, yaani upande wa magharibi wa maskani,

english: and two frames for the two back corners of the tabernacle,
ekegusii: Naende akaroisia chibao ibere chikaba chikoona chi’Obomenyo ensemo ya magega.
swahili: na mihimili miwili ikatengenezwa kwa ajili ya pembe za maskani za upande uliokuwa mbali.

english: coupled together from bottom to top and fitted into a single ring. He made both corners in this way.
ekegusii: Kera ebao ase echio ibere ekabwatanigwa ne chibao chie chinsinyo, korwa inse goika igoro ase ebonyi entang’ani ere; naboigo bakorete ase chibao echio ibere echiabegetwe ase chikoona ibere.
swahili: Katika pembe hizi mbili mihimili yake ilikuwa miwili kuanzia chini mpaka juu, na ikaingizwa kwenye pete moja; mihimili ya pembe hizi mbili ilifanana.

english: They received from Moses all the contributions that the Israelites had brought to carry out the service of constructing the sanctuary. Meanwhile, the people continued to bring freewill offerings morning after morning,
ekegusii: Barabwo bakaegwa korwa ase Musa ebiegwa ebi bionsi Abaisraeli konya barentire ase okoroisia Obomenyo boria Obochenu. Na Abaisraeli bakagenderera komorentera ebiegwa biabo kera emambia.
swahili: Wakapokea kutoka kwa Mose sadaka zote ambazo Waisraeli walikuwa wameleta ili kuifanya kazi ya ujenzi wa Mahali Patakatifu. Nao watu wakaendelea kuleta sadaka za hiari kila asubuhi.

english: So there were eight frames and sixteen silver bases—two under each frame.
ekegusii: Chibao chionsi nigo chiabeete isano na isato, ne chinterekerero chiabo chi’echifeta ikomi, na isano nemo, ibere ibere inse ya kera ebao.
swahili: Kwa hiyo kulikuwa na mihimili minane, na vitako kumi na sita vya fedha, viwili chini ya kila mhimili.

english: He also made five crossbars of acacia wood for the frames on one side of the tabernacle,
ekegusii: Akabaacha emeriibo etano y’emekonge, eriibe chibao chie rikere erimo ri’Obomenyo,
swahili: Wakatengeneza pia mataruma kwa mti wa mshita: matano kwa ajili ya mihimili ya upande mmoja wa maskani,

english: five for those on the other side, and five for those on the rear side of the tabernacle, to the west.
ekegusii: na etano ase rikere rinde, na etano ase ensemo ya magega, eyerochie bosongo.
swahili: matano kwa ajili ya mihimili ya upande mwingine, na matano kwa ajili mihimili ya upande wa magharibi, mwisho kabisa mwa maskani.

english: He made the central crossbar to run through the center of the frames, from one end to the other.
ekegusii: Akabaacha omoriibo o gati‐gati omogima, ase okoriiba chibao korwa ensinyo eyemo goika eyende.
swahili: Wakatengeneza taruma la katikati, likapenya katikati ya mihimili kutoka mwisho mmoja hadi mwisho mwingine.

english: And he overlaid the frames with gold and made gold rings to hold the crossbars. He also overlaid the crossbars with gold. The Veil (Exodus 26:31–35)
ekegusii: Erio akaooma chibao echio netaabu, agakora chibonyi chi’echitaabu ase emiaro erasoigwe, naende akaooma emeriibo eria netaabu.
swahili: Wakaifunika hiyo mihimili kwa dhahabu, na wakatengeneza pete za dhahabu za kushikilia hayo mataruma. Pia wakayafunika hayo mataruma kwa dhahabu.

english: Next, he made the veil of blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and finely spun linen, with cherubim skillfully worked into it.
ekegusii: Akaroisia etoto ye chiusi chi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, amo ne chiusi chi’egatani engiya chisisire. Omoroisia omong’aini akayeroisia ekaba emegwekano y’ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba.
swahili: Wakatengeneza pazia la nyuzi za rangi ya buluu, za zambarau, na za rangi nyekundu na kitani safi iliyosokotwa vizuri, naye fundi stadi akatirizi makerubi kwenye hilo pazia.

english: He also made four posts of acacia wood for it and overlaid them with gold, along with gold hooks; and he cast four silver bases for the posts. The Curtain for the Entrance (Exodus 26:36–37)
ekegusii: Naende akabaacha chisiiro inye chi’emekonge, agachiooma netaabu, na ebigobanio biaye bie chitaabu. Agakora chinterekerero inye korwa ase efeta enyititoire.
swahili: Wakatengeneza nguzo nne za mti wa mshita kwa ajili yake na kuzifunika kwa dhahabu. Wakatengeneza kulabu za dhahabu kwa ajili ya nguzo hizo, na kusubu vitako vinne vya fedha.

english: For the entrance to the tent, he made a curtain embroidered with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and finely spun linen,
ekegusii: Na ase egesoero ki’Eema akaroisia egetambaa korwa ase chiusi chi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, amo nechi’egatani, keroisirie nomoroisia omong’aini.
swahili: Kwa ajili ya ingilio la hema wakatengeneza pazia la nyuzi za rangi ya buluu, za zambarau, na za rangi nyekundu na kitani safi iliyosokotwa vizuri, kazi ya mtarizi.

english: together with five posts and their hooks. He overlaid the tops of the posts and their bands with gold, and their five bases were bronze.
ekegusii: Bakabaacha chisiiro isano amo nebigobanio biabo, bakaooma ebisure ne chinuga chiabo netaabu. Chinterekerero chiabo isano nigo chiakorire korwa ase chitaai.
swahili: Pia wakatengeneza nguzo tano zenye kulabu. Wakafunika ncha za juu za hizo nguzo pamoja na tepe zake kwa dhahabu, na pia wakatengeneza vitako vyake vitano vya shaba.

english: so that all the skilled craftsmen who were doing all the work on the sanctuary left their work
ekegusii: Erio abaroisia baria abang’aini, abarenge gokora emeremo ende yonsi ase Obomenyo boria Obochenu, magega kobatigire emeremo eye baare gokora bagacha ase Musa,
swahili: Ikafika wakati mafundi wote wenye ujuzi waliokuwa wakiifanya kazi yote ya mahali patakatifu wakasimamisha kazi zao,

english: and said to Moses, “The people are bringing more than enough for doing the work the LORD has commanded us to do.”
ekegusii: bakamoteebia, “Abanto barentire ebiegwa ebinge goetania ebiaganeirie ase emeremo eri’Omonene achigete ekorwe.”
swahili: wakaja na kumwambia Mose, “Watu wanaleta vitu vingi kuliko tunavyohitaji kwa ajili ya kazi hii ambayo Bwana ameagiza ifanyike.”

english: After Moses had given an order, they sent a proclamation throughout the camp: “No man or woman should make anything else as an offering for the sanctuary.” So the people were restrained from bringing more,
ekegusii: Ase ayio Musa akarareria abanto bonsi b’egetwori, akabachiika, “Onde tabaisa korenta ebiegwa binde goetania ebi konya biasangererigwe ase Obomenyo Obochenu, abe omosacha gose omokungu.” Ase igo abanto bagatiga korenta ebiegwa binde.
swahili: Ndipo Mose akatoa agizo, nao wakapeleka neno hili katika kambi yote: “Mtu yeyote mwanaume au mwanamke asilete tena kitu chochote kwa ajili ya sadaka ya mahali patakatifu.” Hivyo watu wakazuiliwa kuleta zaidi,

english: since what they already had was more than enough to perform all the work. The Ten Curtains for the Tabernacle (Exodus 26:1–6)
ekegusii: Ebi konya barentire nigo biabeete ebinge, bigaetania ebiaganeirie ase emeremo eria yare gocha gokorwa. Eema y’Obomenyo ekoroisigwa (Okong’ 26:1-37)
swahili: kwa sababu walivyokuwa navyo tayari vilitosha na kuzidi kuifanya kazi yote. Maskani Ya Mungu (Kutoka 26:1-37)

english: All the skilled craftsmen among the workmen made the ten curtains for the tabernacle. They were made of finely spun linen, as well as blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, with cherubim skillfully worked into them.
ekegusii: Abaroisia bonsi abang’aini b’abakori emeremo bakaroisia eema y’Obomenyo. Bakayeroisia nebitambaa ikomi, biroisirie korwa ase chiusi chi’egatani engiya chisisire amo ne chiusi chi’amarionya chimbariri Omoroisia omong’aini akabiroisia, bire nemegwekano y’ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba.
swahili: Watu wote wenye ustadi miongoni mwa wafanyakazi wote wakatengeneza maskani kwa mapazia kumi ya kitani iliyosokotwa vizuri, na nyuzi za rangi ya buluu, za zambarau, na za rangi nyekundu, naye fundi stadi akatirizi makerubi kwenye mapazia hayo.

english: Each curtain was twenty-eight cubits long and four cubits wide; all the curtains were the same size.
ekegusii: Obotambe bwa kera egetambaa nigo bwarenge obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko emerongo ebere, na atano na atato, na obogare bwaye amaboko ane; bionsi nigo biarenge bi’ekerengo ekemo.
swahili: Mapazia yote yalitoshana kwa ukubwa: kila moja lilikuwa na urefu wa dhiraa ishirini na nane, na upana wa dhiraa nne

english: Bezalel went on to construct the ark of acacia wood, two and a half cubits long, a cubit and a half wide, and a cubit and a half high.
ekegusii: Erio Besaleli akaroisia Esanduki ye chibao chi’emekonge. Obotambe bwaye nigo bwarenge obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko abere na ekeng’ese, na obogare bwaye okoboko okomo na ekeng’ese, na obotambe bwaye gochia igoro okoboko okomo, na ekeng’ese.
swahili: Bezaleli akatengeneza Sanduku la mbao za mshita: urefu wake ulikuwa dhiraa mbili na nusu, upana wake dhiraa moja na nusu, na kimo chake dhiraa moja na nusu.

english: He also made the table of acacia wood two cubits long, a cubit wide, and a cubit and a half high.
ekegusii: Akaroisia emesa ye chibao chi’emekonge. Obotambe bwaye nigo bwarenge obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko abere, na obogare bwaye okoboko okomo na obotambe bwaye gochia igoro okoboko okomo na ekeng’ese.
swahili: Akatengeneza meza ya mbao za mshita yenye urefu wa dhiraa mbili, upana wa dhiraa moja, na kimo cha dhiraa moja na nusu.

english: He overlaid it with pure gold and made a gold molding around it.
ekegusii: Akayeoma netaabu echenire, akayeetanania omong’ororia bw’etaabu.
swahili: Kisha akaifunika kwa dhahabu safi, na kuitengenezea ukingo wa dhahabu kuizunguka pande zote.

english: And he made a rim around it a handbreadth wide and put a gold molding on the rim.
ekegusii: Erio agakora orosingo rore nobogare bong’ana egesanyi gi’okoboko, na akaroetanania omong’ororia bw’etaabu.
swahili: Pia akatengeneza upapi wenye upana wa nyanda nne, na kuufanyia ule upapi ukingo wa dhahabu kuuzunguka pande zote.

english: He cast four gold rings for the table and fastened them to the four corners at its four legs.
ekegusii: Naende agakora chibonyi inye korwa ase chitaabu, ne chibonyi echio agachibeka ase chikoona inye ase amagoro aye ane.
swahili: Akasubu pete nne za dhahabu kwa ajili ya meza hiyo, na kuzifungia kwenye pembe nne, pale penye miguu yake minne.

english: The rings were placed close to the rim, to serve as holders for the poles used to carry the table.
ekegusii: Chibonyi chiria chikabekwa ang’e norosingo, na emiaro eria egasoigwa imeo, erinde emesa enyare kobogorerigwa.
swahili: Pete hizo ziliwekwa karibu na ukingo ule ili kuishikilia ile mipiko iliyotumika kuibebea hiyo meza.

english: He made the poles of acacia wood for carrying the table and overlaid them with gold.
ekegusii: Akabaacha emiaro eria korwa ase emekonge, akayeooma netaabu.
swahili: Mipiko hiyo ya kubebea meza ilitengenezwa kwa mti wa mshita, na ilikuwa imefunikwa kwa dhahabu.

english: He also made the utensils for the table out of pure gold: its plates and dishes, as well as its bowls and pitchers for pouring drink offerings. The Lampstand (Exodus 25:31–40; Numbers 8:1–4)
ekegusii: Agakora ebikorero biare kobekwa ase emesa igoro: chinteru na ebitaabo ase ubani, ne chisani, korwa ase ebio bagocha koumora ebinyugwa ebikoruegwa; akabiroisia bionsi korwa ase chitaabu chichenire. Ekebekerero gie chitaaya gekoroisigwa (Okong’ 25:31-40)
swahili: Vyombo vyote vya mezani vilitengenezwa kwa dhahabu safi: yaani sahani zake, masinia, na bakuli na bilauri zake kwa ajili ya kumiminia sadaka za vinywaji. Kinara Cha Taa (Kutoka 25:31-40)

english: Then he made the lampstand out of pure hammered gold, all of one piece: its base and shaft, its cups, and its buds and petals.
ekegusii: Akaroisia ekebekerero gie chitaaya gi’etaabu echenire esunyuntire. Akayeroisia nenterekerero amo ne ritina, na emegwekano y’amamumu na ebisicha; bionsi bikaroisigwa bikaba egento ekemo.
swahili: Akatengeneza kinara cha taa cha dhahabu safi iliyofuliwa vizuri katika kitako chake na ufito wake; vikombe vyake vilivyofanana na ua, matovu na maua vilikuwa kitu kimoja.

english: Six branches extended from the sides, three on one side and three on the other.
ekegusii: Nigo kiare ne chinsagia isano nemo, chiasogete korwa ase ritina, isato korwa ase ensemo eyemo, na isato korwa ase ensemo ende.
swahili: Matawi sita yalitokeza kuanzia ule ufito wa katikati wa kinara cha taa: matawi matatu upande mmoja na matatu upande mwingine.

english: There were three cups shaped like almond blossoms on the first branch, each with buds and petals, three on the next branch, and the same for all six branches that extended from the lampstand.
ekegusii: Orosagia rwe ritang’ani rokaba nemegwekano etato y’ebisicha binga buna ebi’omolozi, kera ekemo ne rimumu na egesicha, na orosagia rwa kabere boigo rokaba nemegwekano y’ebisicha binga buna ebi’omolozi; ne chinsagia chionsi isano nemo chikaba boigo.
swahili: Vikombe vitatu vya mfano wa maua ya mlozi yenye matovu na maua vilikuwa katika tawi moja, vikombe vitatu katika tawi jingine, na vivyo hivyo kwa matawi yote sita yaliyotokeza kwenye kile kinara cha taa.

english: He overlaid it with pure gold, both inside and out, and made a gold molding around it.
ekegusii: Akayeooma netaabu echenire, ime na isiko, akayeetanania omong’ororia bw’etaabu.
swahili: Akalifunika kwa dhahabu safi ndani na nje, na kulizungushia ukingo wa dhahabu.

english: And on the lampstand were four cups shaped like almond blossoms with buds and petals.
ekegusii: Ritina rinyene ri’ekebekerero gie chitaaya keria rikaba nemegwekano ene y’ebisicha binga buna ebi’omolozi.
swahili: Juu ya kinara chenyewe kulikuwepo na vikombe vinne vya mfano wa maua ya mlozi yakiwa na matovu yake na maua yake.

english: A bud was under the first pair of branches that extended from the lampstand, a bud under the second pair, and a bud under the third pair.
ekegusii: Rimumu erimo rikaba inse ya kera chinsagia ibere chigosoka korwa ase ritina. Ase ayio rikaba rimumu erimo inse ya kera orosagia rw’echio isano nemo chiroisirie chikaba egento ekemo ne ritina.
swahili: Tovu moja lilikuwa chini ya jozi ya kwanza ya matawi yaliyotokeza kwenye kinara cha taa, tovu la pili chini ya jozi ya pili, nalo tovu la tatu chini ya jozi ya tatu, yaani, matawi sita kwa jumla.

english: The buds and branches were all of one piece with the lampstand, hammered out of pure gold.
ekegusii: Bionsi bikaroisigwa korwa ase ribomba erimo ri’etaabu echenire esunyuntire.
swahili: Matovu na matawi yote yalikuwa kitu kimoja na kile kinara cha taa, yakiwa yamefuliwa kwa dhahabu safi.

english: He also made its seven lamps, its wick trimmers, and trays of pure gold.
ekegusii: Naende akaroisia chitaaya chiaye isano na ibere, na ebiinachi, ne chindogio chiaye chi’echitaabu chichenire.
swahili: Akatengeneza taa zake saba, na pia mikasi ya kusawazishia tambi, pamoja na masinia, zote kwa dhahabu safi.

english: He made the lampstand and all its utensils from a talent of pure gold. The Altar of Incense (Exodus 30:1–10)
ekegusii: Ekebekerero keria gie chitaaya amo nebikorero biaye bionsi bikaroisigwa korwa ase chitaabu chichenire chi’ekerengo gie chikiro emerongo etano. Egesasiimero ase ubani erasamberwe gekoroisigwa (Okong’ 30:1-5)
swahili: Akatengeneza kinara hicho cha taa pamoja na vifaa vyake vyote kutumia talanta moja ya dhahabu safi. Madhabahu Ya Kufukizia Uvumba (Kutoka 30:1-5)

english: He made the altar of incense out of acacia wood. It was square, a cubit long, a cubit wide, and two cubits high. Its horns were of one piece.
ekegusii: Akaroisia egesasiimero gie chibao chi’emekonge ase ubani erasamberwe. Obotambe bwaye nigo bwarenge obw’ekerengo gi’okoboko okomo, na obotambe bwaye gochia igoro amaboko abere. Emegwekano ye ching’unchara ekaroisigwa ekaba egento ekemo negesasiimero.
swahili: Akatengeneza madhabahu ya kufukizia uvumba kwa mbao za mshita. Ilikuwa ya mraba, urefu na upana wake dhiraa moja, na kimo cha dhiraa mbili, nazo pembe zake zilikuwa kitu kimoja nayo.

english: And he overlaid with pure gold the top and all the sides and horns. Then he made a molding of gold around it.
ekegusii: Agakeooma netaabu echenire, igoro yaye, ne chinsemo chiaye, amo ne ching’unchara chiaye, akayeetanania omong’ororia bw’etaabu.
swahili: Akafunika hayo madhabahu juu na pande zote na pia zile pembe zake kwa dhahabu safi, na akayafanyizia ukingo wa dhahabu kuizunguka.

english: He made two gold rings below the molding on opposite sides to hold the poles used to carry it.
ekegusii: Agakora chibonyi ibere chi’echitaabu, agachibeeka inse y’omong’ororia ase chinsemo ibere. Ase chibonyi echio emiaro egasoigwa, erinde egesasiimero kenyare kobogorerigwa.
swahili: Akatengeneza pete mbili za dhahabu kwa ajili ya madhabahu chini ya huo ukingo, zikiwa mbili kila upande, za kushikilia hiyo mipiko iliyotumika kuyabebea madhabahu.

english: And he made the poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with gold.
ekegusii: Na emiaro eria akabaacha korwa ase emekonge, akayeooma netaabu. Amaguta akweakwa na amanukato akoroisigwa (Okong’ 30:22-38)
swahili: Akatengeneza mipiko kwa miti ya mshita na kuifunika kwa dhahabu.

english: He also made the sacred anointing oil and the pure, fragrant incense, the work of a perfumer.
ekegusii: Naende akaroisia amaguta amaachenu akweakwa, na ubani echenire are ne rimisu rigiya, akayaroisia buna omooroisia, oyomanyete buya, aranyare koyaroisia.
swahili: Pia akatengeneza mafuta matakatifu ya upako, na uvumba safi wenye harufu nzuri, kazi ya mtengeneza manukato.

english: And he cast four gold rings for its four feet, two rings on one side and two on the other.
ekegusii: Agakora chibonyi inye korwa ase etaabu enyititoire, agachibeeka ase amagoro aye ane, ibere ase kera rikere.
swahili: Akasubu pete nne za dhahabu na kuzifungia kwenye miguu yake minne, pete mbili kwa upande mmoja na pete mbili kwa upande mwingine.

english: Then he made poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with gold.
ekegusii: Akabaacha emiaro y’emekonge, akayeooma netaabu.
swahili: Kisha akatengeneza mipiko ya mti wa mshita na kuzifunika kwa dhahabu.

english: He inserted the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark in order to carry it. The Mercy Seat (Exodus 25:17–22)
ekegusii: Agasoyia emiaro eyio ase chibonyi ime ase okobogoreria esanduki eria.
swahili: Akaiingiza hiyo mipiko kwenye zile pete katika pande mbili za Sanduku ili kulibeba.

english: He constructed a mercy seat of pure gold, two and a half cubits long and a cubit and a half wide.
ekegusii: Akaroisia ekemumeko gi’etaabu echenire ebe Oboikaranso bwa’Amaabera. Obotambe bwaye nigo bwarenge obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko abere na ekeng’ese, na obogare bwaye okoboko okomo na ekeng’ese.
swahili: Akatengeneza kifuniko cha upatanisho kwa dhahabu safi: urefu wake ulikuwa dhiraa mbili na nusu, na upana wake dhiraa moja na nusu.

english: He made two cherubim of hammered gold at the ends of the mercy seat,
ekegusii: Erio agakora emegwekano y’ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba babere ey’etaabu esunyuntire, akayebeka ase chinsinyo ibere chi’Oboikaranso bwa amaabera,
swahili: Kisha akatengeneza makerubi wawili wa dhahabu iliyofuliwa katika miisho ya hicho kifuniko.

english: one cherub on one end and one on the other, all made from one piece of gold.
ekegusii: oyomo ase kera ensinyo, akayekora ekaba egento ekemo n’Oboikaranso bwa amaabera.
swahili: Akatengeneza kerubi mmoja kwenye mwisho mmoja, na kerubi mwingine kwenye mwisho mwingine; akawatengeneza kuwa kitu kimoja na hicho kifuniko katika miisho hiyo miwili.

english: And the cherubim had wings that spread upward, overshadowing the mercy seat. The cherubim faced each other, looking toward the mercy seat. The Table of Showbread (Exodus 25:23–30; Leviticus 24:5–9)
ekegusii: Ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba abwo bakarambora chimbaaba chiabo igoro y’Oboikaranso bwa amaabera, bakabobekera ekiriri, na amasio abo agachiikana; na barabwo bakarigereria Oboikaranso bwa amaabera. Emesa y’emegati ekoruegwa ase Omonene ekoroisigwa (Okong’ 25:23-30)
swahili: Makerubi hao walikuwa wametandaza mabawa kuelekea juu, wakitia kivuli hicho kifuniko. Makerubi hao walielekeana, wakitazama hicho kifuniko. Meza (Kutoka 25:23-30)

english: Bezalel constructed the altar of burnt offering from acacia wood. It was square, five cubits long, five cubits wide, and three cubits high.
ekegusii: Erio akaagacha egesasiimero gie chibao chi’emekonge ase ebing’wanso birasamberwe. Obotambe bwaye nigo bwarenge obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko atano, na obogare bwaye amaboko atano; nabo chinsemo chiaye inye chikaba chireng’aine, na obotambe bwaye gochia igoro nigo bwarenge obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko atato.
swahili: Akatengeneza madhabahu ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa kwa mbao za mti wa mshita, kimo chake dhiraa tatu; nayo ilikuwa mraba, urefu wake dhiraa tano, na upana wa dhiraa tano

english: with twenty posts and twenty bronze bases, and with silver hooks and bands on the posts.
ekegusii: Chisiiro chiaye emerongo ebere echiare kobibwata nigo chiarenge ne chinterekerero chiabo emerongo ebere chie chitaai, korende ebigobanio ne chinuga chiabo nigo chiarenge chi’echifeta.
swahili: pamoja na nguzo ishirini na vitako vya shaba ishirini, na kulabu na tepe za fedha juu ya hizo nguzo.

english: The north side was also a hundred cubits long, with twenty posts and twenty bronze bases. The hooks and bands of the posts were silver.
ekegusii: Naboigo ase ensemo ya sugusu akaroisia ebitambaa bire nobotambe bw’ekerengo ki’amaboko rigana erimo. Chisiiro emerongo ebere echiare kobibwata nigo chiarenge ne chinterekerero chiabo emerongo ebere chie chitaai, korende ebigobanio ne chinuga chiabo nigo chiarenge chi’echifeta.
swahili: Upande wa kaskazini ulikuwa na urefu wa dhiraa mia moja, pamoja na nguzo ishirini na vitako vya shaba ishirini, pamoja na kulabu na tepe za fedha juu ya hizo nguzo.

english: The west side was fifty cubits long and had curtains, with ten posts and ten bases. The hooks and bands of the posts were silver.
ekegusii: Ase ensemo ya bosongo bakaroisia ebitambaa bire nobotambe bw’ekerengo ki’amaboko emerongo etano, ne chisiiro ikomi amo ne chinterekerero chiabo ikomi, korende ebigobanio ne chinuga chiabo nigo chiarenge chi’echifeta.
swahili: Upande wa mwisho wa magharibi ulikuwa na upana wa dhiraa hamsini na ulikuwa na mapazia, na nguzo kumi na vitako vyake kumi, pamoja na kulabu na tepe za fedha juu ya hizo nguzo.

english: And the east side, toward the sunrise, was also fifty cubits long.
ekegusii: Obogare bw’ensemo ya bosio, erochie moocha, nigo bwarenge obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko emerongo etano.
swahili: Upande wa mwisho wa mashariki jua linakochomoza, pia ulikuwa na upana wa dhiraa hamsini.

english: The curtains on one side of the entrance were fifteen cubits long, with three posts and three bases.
ekegusii: Ase ensemo eyemo y’egesoero bakaroisia ebitambaa bi’ekerengo ki’amaboko ikomi na atano, ne chisiiro isato amo ne chinterekerero chiabo isato.
swahili: Mapazia yenye urefu wa dhiraa kumi na tano yalikuwa upande mmoja wa ingilio, pamoja na nguzo tatu na vitako vitatu.

english: And the curtains on the other side were also fifteen cubits long, with three posts and three bases as well.
ekegusii: Naboigo ase ensemo ende bakaroisia ebitambaa bi’ekerengo ki’amaboko ikomi na atano, ne chisiiro isato amo ne chinterekerero chiabo isato. Ase igo chinsemo chionsi ibere chi’egesoero chikaba chireng’aine.
swahili: Mapazia yenye urefu wa dhiraa kumi na tano yalikuwa upande mwingine wa ingilio la ua, pamoja na nguzo tatu na vitako vitatu.

english: All the curtains around the courtyard were made of finely spun linen.
ekegusii: Ebitambaa bionsi ebiaetanaine eraaro eria bikaroisigwa ne chiusi chi’egatani engiya chisisire.
swahili: Mapazia yote yaliyozunguka ua yalikuwa ya kitani iliyosokotwa vizuri.

english: The bases for the posts were bronze, the hooks and bands were silver, and the plating for the tops of the posts was silver. So all the posts of the courtyard were banded with silver.
ekegusii: Chinterekerero chie chisiiro chiaye nigo chiarenge chie chitaai, korende ebigobanio ne chinuga chiabo nigo chiarenge chi’echifeta, na ebisure biabo bikaoomwa nefeta.
swahili: Vitako vya nguzo vilikuwa vya shaba. Kulabu na tepe juu ya nguzo zilikuwa za fedha, na ncha zake zilifunikwa kwa fedha. Kwa hiyo nguzo zote za ua zilikuwa na tepe za fedha.

english: The curtain for the entrance to the courtyard was embroidered with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and finely spun linen. It was twenty cubits long and, like the curtains of the courtyard, five cubits high,
ekegusii: Egetambaa ki’egesoero bakaroisia korwa ase chiusi chi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, amo nechi’egatani chisisire. Obotambe bw’egetambaa keria nigo bwarenge obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko atano koreng’ana nobogare bwaye buna ebitambaa binde bi’eraaro.
swahili: Pazia la ingilio la ua lilikuwa la nyuzi za rangi ya buluu, za zambarau, na za rangi nyekundu pamoja na kitani iliyosokotwa vizuri, kazi ya mtarizi. Pazia hilo lilikuwa na urefu wa dhiraa ishirini kama zile za kwenye ua, na kimo chake kilikuwa dhiraa tano,

english: with four posts and four bronze bases. Their hooks were silver, as well as the bands and the plating of their tops.
ekegusii: Chisiiro inye, echiare gokebwata, ne chinterekerero chiabo inye, nigo chiarenge chie chitaai, korende ebigobanio biabo nigo biarenge bie chifeta, na ebisure bie chisiiro bikaoomwa nefeta, ne chinuga chiabo nigo chiarenge chi’echifeta.
swahili: likiwa na nguzo nne na vitako vinne vya shaba. Kulabu zake na tepe zake zilikuwa za fedha, na ncha zake zilikuwa zimefunikwa kwa fedha.

english: He made a horn at each of its four corners, so that the horns and altar were of one piece, and he overlaid the altar with bronze.
ekegusii: Ase chikoona inye chi’egesasiimero akaroisia emegwekano ene ye ching’unchara, akayeroisia ekaba egento ekemo negesasiimero, akaooma gionsi netai.
swahili: Akatengeneza upembe kwenye kila pembe ya hizo pembe nne, ili zile pembe na madhabahu zikawa zimeungana, akafunika madhabahu kwa shaba.

english: All the tent pegs for the tabernacle and for the surrounding courtyard were bronze. An Inventory of Materials (Ezra 2:68–70; Nehemiah 7:70–73)
ekegusii: Ebirochi bionsi bi’eema y’Obomenyo na ebi’ebitambaa bi’eraaro nigo biarenge bie chitaai. Omobaro bw’ebinto biare gokorerwa ase Obomenyo Obochenu
swahili: Vigingi vyote vya maskani na vya ua ulioizunguka vilikuwa vya shaba. Vifaa Vilivyotumika

english: This is the inventory for the tabernacle, the tabernacle of the Testimony, as recorded at Moses’ command by the Levites under the direction of Ithamar son of Aaron the priest.
ekegusii: Oyo noro omobaro bw’ebinto ebiakoreretwe ase okoroisia Obomenyo, engencho yaye Obomenyo bw’Oborori. Omobaro oyo Musa achigete ogakorwa n’Abalawi inse y’oboraai bwa Itamari, mosinto o Aroni, Omokuani.
swahili: Ifuatayo ni orodha ya vifaa vilivyotumika kwa ajili ya ujenzi wa maskani, maskani ya Ushuhuda, ambavyo vilitayarishwa na Walawi kama alivyoagiza Mose, chini ya usimamizi wa Ithamari, mwana wa kuhani Aroni.

english: Bezalel son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, made everything that the LORD had commanded Moses.
ekegusii: Besaleli, mosinto o Uri o Huri bw’egesaku kia Yuda, agakora onsi ay’Omonene achigete Musa.
swahili: (Bezaleli mwana wa Uri, mwana wa Huri, wa kabila la Yuda, alifanya kila kitu Bwana alichomwamuru Mose,

english: With him was Oholiab son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, an engraver, designer, and embroiderer in blue, purple, and scarlet yarn and fine linen.
ekegusii: Amo nere nigo arenge Oholiabu, omwana o Ahisamaki bw’egesaku kia Dani, komokonya. Ere nigo arenge omong’aini bw’okomang’a na kobaacha, na bw’okoroisia ebitambaa bie chiusi chi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, amo nechi’egatani engiya.
swahili: akiwa pamoja na Oholiabu mwana wa Ahisamaki, wa kabila la Dani, fundi stadi wa kutia nakshi, kubuni michoro, mtarizi kwa rangi ya buluu, ya zambarau, nyekundu na kitani safi.)

english: All the gold from the wave offering used for the work on the sanctuary totaled 29 talents and 730 shekels, according to the sanctuary shekel.
ekegusii: Etaabu yonsi eyakoreretwe ase emeremo y’okoroisia Obomenyo Obochenu, eyaatananetwe ebe ekerugwa, nigo yarenge chikiro elifu eyemo, na amagana ane, na emerongo etano nomo, na isano (1,465) ase ekerengo gi’esekeli y’Obomenyo Obochenu.
swahili: Jumla ya dhahabu iliyopatikana kutokana na sadaka ya kuinuliwa kwa ajili ya kazi ya mahali patakatifu ilikuwa na uzito wa talanta 29 na shekeli 730, kulingana na shekeli ya mahali patakatifu.

english: The silver from those numbered among the congregation totaled 100 talents and 1,775 shekels, according to the sanctuary shekel—
ekegusii: Efeta eyaruetwe nomoganda bw’abwo barigetwe nigo yarenge chikiro chilifu isano, na emerongo etato, na isano (5,035), ase ekerengo gi’esekeli y’Obomenyo Obochenu.
swahili: Fedha iliyopatikana kutokana na jumuiya ya watu waliohesabiwa ilikuwa yenye uzito wa talanta mia moja na shekeli 1,775, kulingana na shekeli ya mahali patakatifu.

english: a beka per person, that is, half a shekel, according to the sanctuary shekel, from everyone twenty years of age or older who had crossed over to be numbered, a total of 603,550 men.
ekegusii: Kera omonto oyorigetwe, oyokoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, akarua ebeka eyemo, engencho yaye ekeng’ese gi’esekeli ase ekerengo gi’esekeli y’Obomenyo Obochenu. Abanto abwo nigo barenge chilifu amagana atano na rimo na isato, na amagana atano, na emerongo etano (603,550).
swahili: Kila mtu alitoa beka moja, ambayo ni sawa na nusu shekeli ya fedha, kwa kazi ya mahali patakatifu, kutoka kwa kila mtu aliyekuwa amehesabiwa mwenye umri wa miaka ishirini au zaidi, ambao jumla yao walikuwa wanaume 603,550.

english: The hundred talents of silver were used to cast the bases of the sanctuary and the bases of the veil—100 bases from the 100 talents, one talent per base.
ekegusii: Chikiro chilifu isano chi’echifeta chiria nigo chiakoretwe ase okoroisia chinterekerero chi’Obomenyo Obochenu ne chi’etoto eria; chikiro chilifu isano ase chinterekerero rigana erimo, chikiro emerongo etano ase kera enterekerero.
swahili: Talanta hizo 100 za fedha zilitumika kusubu vile vitako mia moja kwa ajili ya mahali patakatifu na pazia: vitako mia moja kwa talanta mia, yaani, talanta moja kwa kila kitako.

english: With the 1,775 shekels of silver he made the hooks for the posts, overlaid their tops, and supplied bands for them.
ekegusii: Ase chifeta chikiro emerongo etato na isano chiatigarete chiakoreretwe ase okoroisia ebigobanio bie chisiiro na ase okooma ebisure biabo, na koroisia chinuga chiabo.
swahili: Akatumia zile shekeli hizo 1,775 kutengeneza kulabu za nguzo, kufunika ncha za nguzo na kutengeneza vitanzi vyake.

english: The bronze from the wave offering totaled 70 talents and 2,400 shekels.
ekegusii: Chitaai chiatananetwe chibe ekerugwa, nigo chiarenge chikiro chilifu isato, na amagana atano, na emerongo ene, na isano (3,545).
swahili: Shaba iliyopatikana kutokana na sadaka ya kuinuliwa ilikuwa na uzito wa talanta 70 na shekeli 2,400.

english: He made all the altar’s utensils of bronze—its pots, shovels, sprinkling bowls, meat forks, and firepans.
ekegusii: Akaroisia ebikorero bionsi bi’egesasiimero nabio ebi: Chindogio chi’okobuucha riibu, na ebichiko, na ebitaabo, ne chigami, ne chindogio chi’okorenta omorero. Ebinto ebi bionsi akabiroisia korwa ase chitaai.
swahili: Akatengeneza vyombo vyake vyote kwa shaba: vyungu vyake vya kuondolea majivu, masepetu, mabakuli ya kunyunyizia, uma za nyama na vyombo vya kuchukulia moto.

english: He used it to make the bases for the entrance to the Tent of Meeting, the bronze altar and its bronze grating, all the utensils for the altar,
ekegusii: Ase chitaai chiria akaroisia chinterekerero chi’egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano, na egesasiimero gi’etai amo negechungi kiaye, na ebikorero biaye bionsi,
swahili: Akaitumia hiyo shaba kutengeneza vitako vya ingilio la Hema la Kukutania, madhabahu ya shaba pamoja na ule wavu wake na vyombo vyake vyote,

english: the bases for the surrounding courtyard and its gate, and all the tent pegs for the tabernacle and its surrounding courtyard.
ekegusii: ne chinterekerero chie chisiiro chi’eraaro chibe chinsemo chionsi, na echi’egesoero ki’eraaro, na ebirochi bionsi bi’eema y’Obomenyo, na ebi’eraaro chinsemo chionsi.
swahili: vile vitako vya ule ua uliozunguka na vile vya ingilio, na vigingi vyote vya Maskani pamoja na ule ua uliozunguka.

english: He made a grate of bronze mesh for the altar under its ledge, halfway up from the bottom.
ekegusii: Agakora egechungi gi’etai, agakebeeka korwa inse y’orosingo, kegaika gochia igoro gati gati y’egesasiimero.
swahili: Akatengeneza wavu wa shaba chini ya ukingo wa madhabahu ili ufikie nusu ya kimo cha madhabahu.

english: At the four corners of the bronze grate he cast four rings as holders for the poles.
ekegusii: Agakora chibonyi inye, agachibeka ase chikoona inye chi’egechungi ekio gi’etai, ase emiaro egosoigwa.
swahili: Akasubu pete za shaba za kushikilia ile mipiko kwa ajili ya zile pembe nne za huo wavu wa shaba.

english: And he made the poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with bronze.
ekegusii: Akabaacha emiaro eria korwa ase emekonge, akayeooma netai.
swahili: Akatengeneza mipiko ya mti wa mshita na kuifunika kwa shaba.

english: Then he inserted the poles into the rings on the sides of the altar for carrying it. He made the altar with boards so that it was hollow. The Bronze Basin (Exodus 30:17–21)
ekegusii: Agasoyia emiaro eria ase chibonyi chire chinsemo chi’egesasiimero, erinde kenyare kobogorerigwa. Agakeagacha ne chibao, akagetiga giasaime. Egetuba gekoroisigwa (Okong’ 30:18)
swahili: Akaiingiza ile mipiko kwenye zile pete, ili iwe pande mbili za madhabahu kwa ajili ya kuibeba. Akaitengeneza madhabahu yenye uvungu ndani yake akitumia mbao. Sinia La Kunawia (Kutoka 30:18)

english: Next he made the bronze basin and its stand from the mirrors of the women who served at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting. The Courtyard (Exodus 27:9–19)
ekegusii: Akaroisia egetuba amo nenterekerero yaye korwa ase ebirore bie chitaai bi’abakuungu baare gokorera ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano. Eraaro y’Obomenyo Omonene (Okong’ 27:9-19)
swahili: Akatengeneza sinia la shaba lenye kitako cha shaba kutoka kwa vioo vya shaba vilivyotolewa na wanawake waliohudumu pale ingilio la Hema la Kukutania. Ua Wa Hema La Kukutania (Kutoka 27:9-19)

english: Then he constructed the courtyard. The south side of the courtyard was a hundred cubits long and had curtains of finely spun linen,
ekegusii: Ase ensemo ya Irianyi akaroisia ebitambaa bie chiusi chindabu chi’egatani chisisire. Obotambe bwabo nigo bwarenge obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko rigana erimo.
swahili: Kisha akatengeneza ua. Upande wa kusini ulikuwa na urefu wa dhiraa mia moja, na ulikuwa na mapazia ya kitani iliyosokotwa vizuri,

english: From the blue, purple, and scarlet yarn they made specially woven garments for ministry in the sanctuary, as well as the holy garments for Aaron, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
ekegusii: Korwa ase chiusi chi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, bakaroisia chianga chinseera chi’ogokorera emeremo ime y’Aase Aachenu. Bakaroisia chianga chinchenu chia Aroni, buna Omonene konya achiikire Musa.
swahili: Kutokana na nyuzi za rangi ya buluu, ya zambarau na nyekundu akatengeneza mavazi yaliyofumwa kwa ajili ya kuhudumu katika mahali patakatifu. Pia akamshonea Aroni mavazi matakatifu, kama Bwana alivyomwagiza Mose. Kisibau

english: And they mounted on it four rows of gemstones: The first row had a ruby, a topaz, and an emerald;
ekegusii: Bagakebeekera emeng’ororia ene y’amagena e rigori. Ase omong’ororia bw’eritang’ani bakabeeka saridio, na topasio, na sumaridi;
swahili: Kifuko hicho kilipambwa kwa safu nne za vito vya thamani. Safu ya kwanza ilikuwa na akiki, yakuti manjano na zabarajadi;

english: the second row had a turquoise, a sapphire, and a diamond;
ekegusii: na ase oyo o kabere alimasi, na safiro, na yasipi;
swahili: safu ya pili ilikuwa na almasi, yakuti samawi na zumaridi;

english: the third row had a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;
ekegusii: na ase oyo o gatato hiakinto, na agati, na ametisito;
swahili: safu ya tatu ilikuwa na hiakintho, akiki nyekundu na amethisto;

english: and the fourth row had a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper. These stones were mounted in gold filigree settings.
ekegusii: na ase oyo o kane kurusolito, na oiniki, na berulo. Amagena ayio onsi bakayabeka ase ebikonde bie chitaabu.
swahili: katika safu ya nne ilikuwa na krisolitho, shohamu na yaspi. Vito hivyo vilitiwa kwenye vijalizo vya dhahabu.

english: The twelve stones corresponded to the names of the sons of Israel. Each stone was engraved like a seal with the name of one of the twelve tribes.
ekegusii: Na amagena ayio nigo arenge ikomi na abere, akaba namarieta ’abamura ba Israeli, amang’ekire buna ekemanyererio gekomang’wa. Kera rigena rikaba nerieta ri’egesaku ekemo ki’ebisaku biabo ikomi na bibere.
swahili: Palikuwa na vito kumi na viwili, kila kimoja kikiwa na jina mojawapo la wana wa Israeli; kila kimoja kilichorwa kama muhuri kikiwa na jina mojawapo la yale makabila kumi na mawili.

english: For the breastpiece they made braided chains like cords of pure gold.
ekegusii: Bagakora ebichanga bie chitaabu chichenire bisisire, bikabeekwa ase egesembe keria.
swahili: Kwa ajili ya kile kifuko cha kifuani akakitengenezea mikufu ya dhahabu safi, iliyosokotwa kama kamba.

english: They also made two gold filigree settings and two gold rings, and fastened the two rings to the two corners of the breastpiece.
ekegusii: Bagakora na ebikonde bibere bie chitaabu, ne chibonyi ibere chi’echitaabu, na bakabeeka chibonyi echi ibere ase emego ebere ya igoro y’egesembe keria.
swahili: Akatengeneza vijalizo viwili vya dhahabu na pete mbili za dhahabu, na kuzifungia pete hizo kwenye pembe mbili za hicho kifuko cha kifuani.

english: Then they fastened the two gold chains to the two gold rings at the corners of the breastpiece,
ekegusii: Bagasiberania ebichanga ebi bibere bie chitaabu ase chibonyi echi ibere ase emego y’egesembe keria.
swahili: Akafunga hiyo mikufu miwili ya dhahabu kwenye hizo pete katika pembe za hicho kifuko cha kifuani,

english: and they fastened the other ends of the two chains to the two filigree settings, attaching them to the shoulder pieces of the ephod at the front.
ekegusii: Naende bakabwaterania chinsinyo chinde ibere chi’ebichanga ase ebikonde biria bibere, na buna biare igo bakabibwaterania nebitwanga bi’amareko bire bosio bw’egesibao ki’obokuani.
swahili: nazo zile ncha nyingine za mkufu akazifunga kwenye vile vijalizo viwili, na kuzishikamanisha na vile vipande vya mabega vya kile kisibau upande wa mbele.

english: They made two more gold rings and attached them to the other two corners of the breastpiece, on the inside edge next to the ephod.
ekegusii: Bagakora chibonyi ibere chi’echitaabu bagachibeeka ase egesembe keria, ase emego ebere ya inse korwa magega, echigeete egesibao.
swahili: Akatengeneza pete mbili za dhahabu na kuzishikamanisha kwenye pembe mbili za chini, upande wa ndani wa kifuko cha kifuani karibu na kisibau.

english: Bezalel made the ephod of finely spun linen embroidered with gold, and with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn.
ekegusii: Bagakora egesibao ki’obokuani korwa ase chiusi chi’etaabu, na echi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, amo nechi’egatani engiya chisisire.
swahili: Akatengeneza kisibau cha dhahabu, na nyuzi za rangi ya buluu, za zambarau, na nyekundu na kitani iliyosokotwa vizuri.

english: They made two additional gold rings and attached them to the bottom of the two shoulder pieces of the ephod, on its front, near the seam just above its woven waistband.
ekegusii: Naende bagakora chibonyi chinde chi’echitaabu, bagachibeeka ase ebitwanga biria bibere bi’amareko bi’egesibao bire bosio, ang’e nomobarero, igoro y’orokini rw’egesibao.
swahili: Kisha akatengeneza pete nyingine mbili za dhahabu na kuzishikamanisha sehemu ya chini ya vipande vya mabega upande wa mbele wa kile kisibau, karibu na pindo juu kidogo ya mshipi wa kiunoni wa kisibau.

english: Then they tied the rings of the breastpiece to the rings of the ephod with a cord of blue yarn, so that the breastpiece was above the waistband of the ephod and would not swing out from the ephod, just as the LORD had commanded Moses. Additional Priestly Garments (Exodus 28:31–43)
ekegusii: Bagachibwaterania chibonyi chi’egesembe amo nechi’egesibao ki’obokuani neusi eburu; erio egesembe gekabeera orokini igoro, tigecha gosuka. Bionsi bigakoreka buna Omonene konya achiikire Musa. Chianga chinde chi’abakuani chikoroisigwa (Okong’ 28:31-43)
swahili: Akafunga pete za hicho kifuko cha kifuani kwenye pete za kisibau kwa kamba ya buluu, wakiziunganisha na ule mshipi wa kiunoni, ili kifuko cha kifuani kisisogee kutoka kwenye kile kisibau, kama Bwana alivyomwagiza Mose. Mavazi Mengine Ya Kikuhani (Kutoka 28:31-43)

english: They made the robe of the ephod entirely of blue cloth, the work of a weaver,
ekegusii: Agakora eganchwa korwa ase egetambaa keroisirie ne chiusi chiburu chioka.
swahili: Akashona joho la kisibau lote kwa kitambaa cha rangi ya buluu tupu, kazi ya mfumaji,

english: with an opening in the center of the robe like that of a garment, with a collar around the opening so that it would not tear.
ekegusii: Ase eganchwa eria bakabochora engoro ase omotwe ogosoera, enga buna engoro y’esati. Engoro eria ekabekwa ekenaario buna egi’esati, techa gotandoka.
swahili: na lilikuwa na nafasi ya shingo katikati ya joho lile iliyofanana na ukosi, na utepe ulioshonwa kuizunguka nafasi hiyo ili isichanike.

english: They made pomegranates of blue, purple, and scarlet yarn and finely spun linen on the lower hem of the robe.
ekegusii: Bagakora emegwekano y’amatunda e rikomomanga korwa ase chiusi chi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, bakayebeeka ase omoringero o inse.
swahili: Akatengeneza makomamanga ya nyuzi za rangi ya buluu, za zambarau, na nyekundu na ya kitani iliyosokotwa vizuri kuzunguka pindo la hilo joho.

english: They also made bells of pure gold and attached them around the hem between the pomegranates,
ekegusii: Naende bagakora chindege chi’echitaabu chichenire, bagachibeeka gati y’emegwekano ye rikomomanga chietanane omoringero o inse ase eganchwa.
swahili: Kisha akatengeneza vikengele vya dhahabu safi na kuvishikamanisha kuzunguka pindo hilo kati ya hayo makomamanga.

english: alternating the bells and pomegranates around the lower hem of the robe to be worn for ministry, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
ekegusii: Ase igo omong’ororia bw’emegwekano ye rikomomang’a bwateranirie ne chindege orenge ase omoringero o inse ase eganchwa eria ekobekwa ase obokoreri bw’obokuani. Naboigo buna Omonene konya achiikire Musa.
swahili: Hivyo vikengele na makomamanga vilipishana kuzunguka upindo wa joho ili livaliwe kwa kuhudumu, kama Bwana alivyomwagiza Mose.

english: For Aaron and his sons they made tunics of fine linen, the work of a weaver,
ekegusii: Bakaroiseria Aroni amo nabamura baye chiganchwa chi’egatani engiya,
swahili: Pia akamtengenezea Aroni na wanawe makoti ya kitani safi, kazi ya mfumaji,

english: as well as the turban of fine linen, the ornate headbands and undergarments of finely spun linen,
ekegusii: na egetinti amo nebigogwa emechoro bi’oboseera bi’egatani engiya, ne chisirwari chi’egatani engiya,
swahili: na kilemba cha kitani safi, tepe za kichwani za kitani, na nguo za ndani za kitani iliyosokotwa vizuri.

english: and the sash of finely spun linen, embroidered with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
ekegusii: na orokini rwe chiusi chi’egatani engiya chisisire, amo ne chiusi chi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri. Bionsi bigakoreka buna Omonene konya achiikire Musa.
swahili: Mshipi ulikuwa wa kitani iliyosokotwa vizuri ya rangi ya buluu, na zambarau, na nyekundu, kazi ya mtarizi, kama Bwana alivyomwagiza Mose.

english: They hammered out thin sheets of gold and cut threads from them to interweave with the blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and fine linen—the work of a skilled craftsman.
ekegusii: Bagasunyunta etaabu ekaba eng’ao, naende bakayeninta ekaba chiusi chinyerere, bagachisang’ania ne chiusi chi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, ase okoroisia egetambaa buna omooroisia omong’aini aranyare gokeroisia.
swahili: Akafua vipande vyembamba vya dhahabu kwa nyundo na kutengeneza nyuzi nyembamba ili kuzifuma pamoja na hizo nyuzi za rangi ya buluu, za zambarau, na za rangi nyekundu na kitani safi, kazi ya fundi stadi.

english: They also made the plate of the holy crown of pure gold, and they engraved on it, like an inscription on a seal: HOLY TO THE LORD.
ekegusii: Bagatura ebao y’etaabu echenire, na buna omonto akomang’a ekemanyererio, bakamang’a amang’ana aya: “Achenirwe ase Omonene”.
swahili: Kisha akatengeneza lile bamba, taji takatifu, kwa dhahabu safi na kuchora juu yake maneno haya kama vile muhuri huchorwa: Mtakatifu kwa Bwana.

english: Then they fastened to it a blue cord to mount it on the turban, just as the LORD had commanded Moses. Moses Approves the Work
ekegusii: Bakayesiberania bosio bw’ekegogwa ne chiusi chiburu, buna Omonene konya achiikire Musa. Ogoikeranigwa kw’emeremo (Okong’ 35:10-19)
swahili: Kisha wakalifunga kwa kamba ya rangi ya buluu ili kulishikamanisha na kile kilemba kama Bwana alivyomwagiza Mose. Mose Akagua Maskani Ya Mungu (Kutoka 35:10-19)

english: So all the work for the tabernacle, the Tent of Meeting, was completed. The Israelites did everything just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
ekegusii: Naboigo emeremo y’Obomenyo bw’Eema y’Omosangererekano egaikeranigwa n’Abaisraeli; bagakora onsi buna Omonene konya achiikire Musa.
swahili: Kwa hiyo kazi yote ya maskani, Hema la Kukutania ikakamilika. Waisraeli wakafanya kila kitu sawasawa kama vile Bwana alivyomwagiza Mose.

english: Then they brought the tabernacle to Moses: the tent with all its furnishings, its clasps, its frames, its crossbars, and its posts and bases;
ekegusii: Barabwo bakarentera Musa Obomenyo boria, na eema amo n’ebinto bionsi ebirabeo: ebigobanio, ne chibao, ne chisiiro amo ne chinterekerero chiabo,
swahili: Ndipo wakaleta maskani kwa Mose: hema pamoja na vifaa vyake vyote, vibanio vyake, mihimili yake, mataruma yake, nguzo na vitako vyake;

english: the covering of ram skins dyed red, the covering of fine leather, and the veil of the covering;
ekegusii: na egietubo ki’amasankwa e chimingichi, aakire etaago, na egietubo ki’amasankwa e ching’iti chia rooche, na etoto eria ekengete,
swahili: kifuniko cha ngozi za kondoo dume kilichotiwa rangi nyekundu, kifuniko cha ngozi za pomboo, pazia la kufunikia;

english: the ark of the Testimony with its poles and the mercy seat;
ekegusii: na Esanduki eria ere ne chibao chiriikire oborori, amo nemiaro yaye, na ekerogo kia amaabera,
swahili: Sanduku la Ushuhuda pamoja na mipiko yake na kiti cha rehema,

english: the table with all its utensils and the Bread of the Presence;
ekegusii: na emesa amo nebikorero biaye bionsi, na Emegati eyare koruegwa ase Nyasae,
swahili: meza pamoja na vyombo vyake vyote na mikate ya Wonyesho;

english: the pure gold lampstand with its row of lamps and all its utensils, as well as the oil for the light;
ekegusii: na ekebekerero gie chitaaya gi’etaabu echenire, ne chitaaya chiare kobekwa aroro amo nebikorero biaye bionsi, na amaguta e chitaaya,
swahili: kinara cha taa cha dhahabu safi, safu zake za taa pamoja na vifaa vyake vyote pamoja na mafuta kwa ajili ya taa;

english: the gold altar, the anointing oil, the fragrant incense, and the curtain for the entrance to the tent;
ekegusii: na egesasiimero gi’etaabu, na amaguta akweakwa, na ubani ekorua rimisu rigiya, na egetambaa ki’egesoero ki’Eema,
swahili: madhabahu ya dhahabu, mafuta ya upako, uvumba wenye harufu nzuri na pazia la ingilio la hema;

english: the bronze altar with its bronze grating, its poles, and all its utensils; the basin with its stand;
ekegusii: na egesasiimero gi’etai amo negechungi gi’etai, na emiaro yaye, na ebikorero biaye bionsi, na egetuba amo nenterekerero yaye,
swahili: madhabahu ya shaba, pamoja na wavu wa shaba, nguzo zake na vyombo vyake vyote, sinia, na tako lake;

english: They made shoulder pieces for the ephod, which were attached at two of its corners, so it could be fastened.
ekegusii: Bakaroisia ebitwanga bi’amareko bi’egesibao keria, bakabibwatania nakerokio, magega na bosio; chinsinyo chiaye ibere ibere chikabwatanigwa amo.
swahili: Akatengeneza vipande vya mabegani vya kisibau, vilivyoshikizwa kwenye pembe zake mbili ili kukifungia kisibau.

english: the curtains of the courtyard with its posts and bases; the curtain for the gate of the courtyard, its ropes and tent pegs, and all the equipment for the service of the tabernacle, the Tent of Meeting;
ekegusii: na ebitambaa bi’eraaro, ne chisiiro amo ne chinterekerero chiabo, na egetambaa ki’egesoero ki’eraaro, ne chingori, na ebirochi, na ebikorero bionsi bi’obokoreri ase Obomenyo ime, ase Eema y’o mosangererekano,
swahili: mapazia ya ua pamoja na nguzo na vitako vyake, pia na pazia kwa ajili ya ingilio la kwenye ua; kamba zake na vigingi vya hema kwa ajili ya ua; vyombo vyote vilivyohitajiwa kwa ajili ya maskani, Hema la Kukutania;

english: and the woven garments for ministering in the sanctuary, both the holy garments for Aaron the priest and the garments for his sons to serve as priests.
ekegusii: ne chianga chiria chinseera chi’abakuani ase obokoreri bwabo ime y’Aase Aachenu, engencho yaye chianga chia Aroni amo nechi’abamura baye barabe bakobeeka ekero bagokora emeremo y’obokuani.
swahili: na mavazi yaliyofumwa yanayovaliwa wakati wa huduma katika mahali patakatifu, yaani mavazi matakatifu ya kuhani Aroni na mavazi kwa ajili ya wanawe watakapokuwa wakihudumu katika kazi ya ukuhani.

english: The Israelites had done all the work just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
ekegusii: Abaisraeli konya bakorire emeremo yonsi boronge kegima buna Omonene konya achiikire Musa.
swahili: Waisraeli walikuwa wamefanya kazi yote sawasawa na vile Bwana alivyokuwa amemwagiza Mose.

english: And Moses inspected all the work and saw that they had accomplished it just as the LORD had commanded. So Moses blessed them.
ekegusii: Musa akariga‐rigereria ebinto bionsi ebiakoretwe, akarora ng’a abanto babikorire boronge kegima buna Omonene konya achiikire. Erio Musa akabasesenia.
swahili: Mose akakagua kazi na kuona kuwa walikuwa wameifanya sawasawa kama vile Bwana alivyokuwa ameagiza. Kwa hiyo Mose akawabariki.

english: And the skillfully woven waistband of the ephod was of one piece with the ephod, of the same workmanship—with gold, with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and with finely spun linen, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
ekegusii: Orokini rw’okobwataneria egesibao rokaroisigwa rw’egetambaa keria ki’egesibao keroisirie korwa ase chiusi chi’etaabu, na echi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, amo nechi’egatani engiya chisisire. Bionsi bigakoreka buna Omonene konya achiikire Musa.
swahili: Mshipi wa kiunoni uliofumwa kwa ustadi ulifanana nacho: ulikuwa kitu kimoja na hicho kisibau, nao ulitengenezwa kwa dhahabu na nyuzi za rangi ya buluu, za zambarau, na nyekundu na kwa kitani iliyosokotwa vizuri, kama Bwana alivyomwagiza Mose.

english: They mounted the onyx stones in gold filigree settings, engraved like a seal with the names of the sons of Israel.
ekegusii: Bakabaacha amagena e rigori rinene akorokwa oiniki, bakayabeeka ase ebikonde bie chitaabu; na buna omooroisia omong’aini aranyare komanya komang’era ebimanyererio, bakamang’era amarieta ’abamura ba Israeli.
swahili: Akatengeneza vito vya shohamu vilivyowekwa katika vijalizo vya dhahabu, navyo vilichorwa na majina ya wana wa Israeli kama vile muhuri huchorwa.

english: Then they fastened them on the shoulder pieces of the ephod as memorial stones for the sons of Israel, as the LORD had commanded Moses. The Breastpiece (Exodus 28:15–30)
ekegusii: Bakayabeeka ase ebitwanga bi’amareko ase egesibao ki’obokuani, abe ase okoinyora abamura ba Israeli. Bionsi bigakoreka buna Omonene konya achiikire Musa. Egesembe ki’obokuani gekoroisigwa (Okong’ 28:15-30)
swahili: Kisha akavifungia kwenye vipande vya mabega ya kisibau kuwa vito vya ukumbusho kwa wana wa Israeli, kama Bwana alivyomwagiza Mose. Kifuko Cha Kifuani (Kutoka 28:15-30)

english: He made the breastpiece with the same workmanship as the ephod, with gold, with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and with finely spun linen.
ekegusii: Egesembe ki’obokuani bagakeroisia, buna omooroisia omong’aini aranyare gokeroisia, korwa ase egetambaa kere buna eki’egesibao ki’obokuani, nakio keroisirie korwa ase chiusi chi’etaabu na echi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, amo nechi’egatani engiya chisisire.
swahili: Akafanyiza kifuko cha kifuani, kazi ya fundi stadi. Akakitengeneza kama kile kisibau: cha dhahabu, na nyuzi za rangi ya buluu, za zambarau, na za rangi nyekundu, cha kitani safi iliyosokotwa.

english: It was square when folded over double, a span long and a span wide.
ekegusii: Bakaroisia egesembe keria keringire rimo; obotambe bwaye nigo bwarenge chisentimita emerongo ebere, na ibere, na obogare bwaye boigo. Chinsemo chiaye inye nigo chiarenge chireng’aine.
swahili: Kifuko hicho kilikuwa cha mraba, chenye urefu wa shibiri moja na upana wa shibiri moja, nacho kilikunjwa mara mbili.

english: Meanwhile, Moses was shepherding the flock of his father-in-law Jethro, the priest of Midian. He led the flock to the far side of the wilderness and came to Horeb, the mountain of God.
ekegusii: Musa nigo arenge omorisia bwe riicho, rituko erimo gakorisia riicho ria Jethiro oyio orenge ise biara na Omokuani o Midiani, akariraa gochia bosongo y’erooro, agaika magega ya Horebu, egetunwa egechenu.
swahili: Basi Mose alikuwa anachunga mifugo ya Yethro mkwewe, kuhani wa Midiani. Mose akapeleka mifugo mbali nyuma ya jangwa, naye akafika Horebu, mlima wa Mungu.

english: Therefore, go! I am sending you to Pharaoh to bring My people the Israelites out of Egypt.”
ekegusii: Ase ayio, ’ngogotoma inde ogende ase Farao orusie abanto baane Abaisraeli korwa ense ya Misiri.”
swahili: Basi, sasa nenda. Ninakutuma kwa Farao ili kuwatoa watu wangu Waisraeli kutoka Misri.”

english: But Moses asked God, “Who am I, that I should go to Pharaoh and bring the Israelites out of Egypt?”
ekegusii: Korende Musa akamoteebia Nyasae, “Inche ninche ng’o, kogenda ase Farao ’ndusie Abaisraeli korwa ense ya Misiri?”
swahili: Lakini Mose akamwambia Mungu, “Mimi ni nani hata niende kwa Farao kuwatoa Waisraeli nchini Misri?”

english: “I will surely be with you,” God said, “and this will be the sign to you that I have sent you: When you have brought the people out of Egypt, all of you will worship God on this mountain.”
ekegusii: Nyasae akamoiraneria, “Inche nimbe amo naye. Aye noruisie Abaisraeli korwa Misiri erio moche monsasime inche Nyasae ase egetunwa eke, na eke nakio kerabe ekemanyererio asore ng’a ninche omonyene nagotoma.”
