swahili: Naye Mungu akasema, “Mimi nitakuwa pamoja nawe. Hii itakuwa ishara kwako kwamba ni Mimi nimekutuma: Hapo utakapokuwa umewatoa watu Misri, mtamwabudu Mungu katika mlima huu.”

english: Then Moses asked God, “Suppose I go to the Israelites and say to them, ‘The God of your fathers has sent me to you,’ and they ask me, ‘What is His name?’ What should I tell them?”
ekegusii: Erio Musa agateebia Nyasae, “Kondaimoke kogenda ase Abaisraeli na kobateebia: Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiaino ontomire inche ase more, barabwo baramboria: Erieta riaye, nere ng’o? Inki ndabateebie?”
swahili: Mose akamwambia Mungu, “Ikiwa nitawaendea Waisraeli na kuwaambia, ‘Mungu wa baba zenu amenituma kwenu,’ nao wakiniuliza, ‘Jina lake ni nani?’ Nitawaambia nini?”

english: God said to Moses, “I AM WHO I AM. This is what you are to say to the Israelites: ‘I AM has sent me to you.’”
ekegusii: Nyasae akamoiraneria Musa, “INCHE NINCHE INDE BUNA INDE. Obateebie Abaisraeli buna oria okorokwa: INCHE ontomire ase more.”
swahili: Mungu akamwambia Mose, “ Mimi niko ambaye niko. Hivyo ndivyo utakavyowaambia Waisraeli: ‘ Mimi niko amenituma kwenu.’ ”

english: God also told Moses, “Say to the Israelites, ‘The LORD, the God of your fathers—the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob—has sent me to you.’ This is My name forever, and this is how I am to be remembered in every generation.
ekegusii: Naende Nyasae akamoteebia Musa, “Goika obateebie Abaisraeli: Omonene bwe chisokoro chiaino, Nyasae o Aburaamu, Nyasae o Isaka, na boigo Nyasae o Yakobo ontomire ase more; erio nario erieta riane kare na kare; ase erio nigo ’ndabe ekeinyorio ekiare ase ekiare.
swahili: Vilevile Mungu akamwambia Mose, “Waambie Waisraeli, ‘ Bwana, Mungu wa baba zenu, Mungu wa Abrahamu, Mungu wa Isaki, na Mungu wa Yakobo amenituma kwenu.’ Hili ndilo Jina langu milele, Jina ambalo mtanikumbuka kwalo kutoka kizazi hadi kizazi.

english: Go, assemble the elders of Israel and say to them, ‘The LORD, the God of your fathers—the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob—has appeared to me and said: I have surely attended to you and have seen what has been done to you in Egypt.
ekegusii: Genda, osangererie abagaaka b’Abaisraeli, obateebie ng’a: Omonene bwe chisokoro chiaino, Nyasae o Aburaamu, na o Isaka, na o Yakobo nang’orokera, aganteebia ng’a mbateebie: Amaene, narorire aya Abamisiri bakobakorera,
swahili: “Nenda, ukawakusanye wazee wa Israeli, uwaambie, ‘ Bwana, Mungu wa baba zenu, Mungu wa Abrahamu, Isaki na Yakobo, alinitokea akaniambia: Nimewatazama, nami nimeona mliyofanyiwa katika Misri.

english: And I have promised to bring you up out of your affliction in Egypt, into the land of the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites—a land flowing with milk and honey.’
ekegusii: na igo narire eira ng’a nimbang’anyie korwa Misiri ase mogochandwa, na kobaira ase ense y’Abakaanani, na Abahiti, na Abaamori, na Abaperisi, na Abahivi, na Abayebusi, ense entenenku egoiteka amabeere na obooke.
swahili: Nami nimeahidi kuwapandisha kutoka mateso yenu katika nchi ya Misri, niwapeleke nchi ya Wakanaani, Wahiti, Waamori, Waperizi, Wahivi na Wayebusi, nchi itiririkayo maziwa na asali.’

english: The elders of Israel will listen to what you say, and you must go with them to the king of Egypt and tell him, ‘The LORD, the God of the Hebrews, has met with us. Now please let us take a three-day journey into the wilderness, so that we may sacrifice to the LORD our God.’
ekegusii: “Na abagaaka b’Abaisraeli inabaigwe amang’ana ao. Erio mogende, aye na abagaaka ba Abaisraeli, ase omorwoti o Misiri, momoteebie: Nyasae bw’Abaiberania, natoorokera; na bono twanchere togende orogendo rw’amatuko atato gochia ase erooro, erio toruere Omonene oito, ekeng’wanso.
swahili: “Wazee wa Israeli watakusikiliza. Kisha wewe na wazee mtakwenda kwa mfalme wa Misri na kumwambia, ‘ Bwana, Mungu wa Waebrania ametutokea. Turuhusu twende safari ya siku tatu huko jangwani kutoa dhabihu kwa Bwana Mungu wetu.’

english: But I know that the king of Egypt will not allow you to go unless a mighty hand compels him.
ekegusii: Korende inche omonyene nimanyete ng’a omorwoti o Misiri takobaa ribaga mogende atabeetereirie nokoboko kwane gwe chinguru.
swahili: Lakini nafahamu kwamba mfalme wa Misri hatawaruhusu kwenda, mpaka mkono wenye nguvu umlazimishe.

english: There the angel of the LORD appeared to him in a blazing fire from within a bush. Moses saw the bush ablaze with fire, but it was not consumed.
ekegusii: Agwo omomalaika bw’Omonene akamoorokera ase omogwekano bw’erisase ri’omorero riare gwoka korwa ase obogatagati bw’egetutu gete. Musa akarigereria, akarora ng’a nonya kiare gwoka, tikiare koyia keere.
swahili: Huko malaika wa Bwana akamtokea Mose katika mwali wa moto kutoka kichakani. Mose akaona kwamba ingawa kile kichaka kilikuwa kinawaka moto, kilikuwa hakiteketei.

english: So I will stretch out My hand and strike the Egyptians with all the wonders I will perform among them. And after that, he will release you.
ekegusii: Erio inche nindambore okoboko kwane, ng’ake Abamisiri namaakwa aane yogokumia. Erio magega Omorwoti nabae ribaga mogende.
swahili: Kwa hiyo nitaunyoosha mkono wangu na kuwapiga Wamisri kwa maajabu yote nitakayofanya miongoni mwao. Baada ya hayo, atawaruhusu mwondoke.

english: And I will grant this people such favor in the sight of the Egyptians that when you leave, you will not go away empty-handed.
ekegusii: “Nimbae abanto baane ogwancherwa ase obosio bw’Abamisiri; ekero moragende, timokogenda more namaboko amasa.
swahili: “Nami nitawapa hawa watu upendeleo mbele ya Wamisri, kwa hiyo mtakapoondoka nchini hamtaondoka mikono mitupu.

english: Every woman shall ask her neighbor and any woman staying in her house for silver and gold jewelry and clothing, and you will put them on your sons and daughters. So you will plunder the Egyptians.”
ekegusii: Kera omokungu asabe omogisangio oye, na omokungu onde bwensi omenyete nyomba mwaye, ebinto bie chifeta na ebie chitaabu amo ne chianga; mobibekere abana baino, abamura na abaiseke. Ase enchera eyio nero morasakore Abamisiri chinibo chiabo.”
swahili: Kila mwanamke Mwisraeli atamwomba jirani yake Mmisri na mwanamke yeyote anayeishi nyumbani kwake ampe vyombo vya fedha, dhahabu na nguo, ambavyo mtawavika wana wenu na binti zenu. Hivyo mtawateka nyara Wamisri.”

english: So Moses thought, “I must go over and see this marvelous sight. Why is the bush not burning up?”
ekegusii: Erio Musa agateeba, “Nigo ’ngoeta korwa moino ’ndore okorora oko kw’ogokumia, imanye naki egetutu eke getari koyia keere.”
swahili: Ndipo Mose akawaza, “Nitageuka sasa nione kitu hiki cha ajabu, nami nione ni kwa nini kichaka hiki hakiteketei.”

english: When the LORD saw that he had gone over to look, God called out to him from within the bush, “Moses, Moses!” “Here I am,” he answered.
ekegusii: Ekero Omonene arooche ng’a Musa oikire ang’e arore, akamorangeria korwa ase egetutu ime, “Musa! Musa!” Musa agaitaba ogoteeba, “Nao inde aa.”
swahili: Bwana alipoona kuwa amegeuka ili aone, Mungu akamwita kutoka ndani ya kile kichaka, “Mose! Mose!” Naye Mose akajibu, “Mimi hapa.”

english: “Do not come any closer,” God said. “Take off your sandals, for the place where you are standing is holy ground.”
ekegusii: Nyasae akamoteebia, “Tobaisa goika ang’e nonya ng’ake. Rusia ebikoroto biao, ekiagera aase agwo oteneine naachenu.”
swahili: Mungu akamwambia, “Usikaribie zaidi. Vua viatu vyako, kwa maana mahali unaposimama ni patakatifu.”

english: Then He said, “I am the God of your father, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.” At this, Moses hid his face, for he was afraid to look at God.
ekegusii: Naende akamoteebia, “Inche ninche Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiao, Nyasae o Aburaamu, Nyasae o Isaka, na Nyasae o Yakobo.” Erio Musa agatuba obosio bwaye, ekiagera nigo airogete komorigereria Nyasae.
swahili: Kisha akamwambia, “Mimi ni Mungu wa baba yako, Mungu wa Abrahamu, Mungu wa Isaki, na Mungu wa Yakobo.” Mose aliposikia hayo, akafunika uso wake kwa sababu aliogopa kumtazama Mungu.

english: The LORD said, “I have indeed seen the affliction of My people in Egypt. I have heard them crying out because of their oppressors, and I am aware of their sufferings.
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene akabora, “Amaene narorire emechando yabaanto baane abwo bakare Misiri; naigure buna bakweumia inse yamaboko y’Abamisiri abwo bakobachanda, na inche namanyire kegima obororo bwabo.
swahili: Bwana akamwambia, “Hakika nimeona mateso ya watu wangu katika Misri. Nimesikia kilio chao kwa sababu ya wasimamizi wao, nami naguswa na mateso yao.

english: I have come down to rescue them from the hand of the Egyptians and to bring them up out of that land to a good and spacious land, a land flowing with milk and honey—the home of the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites.
ekegusii: Nainche nigo naikire inse mbatoorie korwa ase amaboko ya Abamisiri, mbatiirie korwa ase ense eria ya Misiri, mbaire ase ense engiya engare, ense eichire namabeere nobooke, ense ya Abakanaani, na Abahiti, na Abaamori, na Abaperisi, na Abahivi, na Abayebusi bono genda.
swahili: Basi nimeshuka niwaokoe kutoka mkono wa Wamisri, niwatoe na kuwapandisha kutoka nchi hiyo, niwapeleke katika nchi nzuri na kubwa, nchi itiririkayo maziwa na asali, nchi ya Wakanaani, Wahiti, Waamori, Waperizi, Wahivi na Wayebusi.

english: And now the cry of the Israelites has reached Me, and I have seen how severely the Egyptians are oppressing them.
ekegusii: Nainde bono ekerero ki’Abaisraeli giaikire ase ’nde, naende narorire ogochandwa koria Abamisiri bakobachanda,
swahili: Sasa kilio cha Waisraeli kimenifikia, nami nimeona jinsi Wamisri wanavyowatesa.

english: Then the LORD said to Moses,
ekegusii: Omonene agakwana na Musa, akamoteebia,
swahili: Kisha Bwana akamwambia Mose:

english: Anoint the altar of burnt offering and all its utensils; consecrate the altar, and it shall be most holy.
ekegusii: Naende oake amaguta ase egesasiimero ase ebing’wanso birasamberwe, amo nebikorero biaye bionsi. Naboigo ogiatanane, kebe egechenu mono.
swahili: Kisha yapake mafuta hayo madhabahu ya kuteketezea sadaka pamoja na vifaa vyake vyote; weka wakfu madhabahu nayo yatakuwa takatifu sana.

english: Anoint the basin and its stand and consecrate them.
ekegusii: Oake egetuba amaguta amo nenterekerero yaye, na kogiatanana.
swahili: Paka sinia mafuta pamoja na kishikilio chake na uviweke wakfu.

english: Then bring Aaron and his sons to the entrance to the Tent of Meeting and wash them with water.
ekegusii: “Orente Aroni amo nabamura baye ase egesoero ki’Eema y’omosangererekano, obasibie namaache.
swahili: “Mlete Aroni na wanawe kwenye ingilio la Hema la Kukutania na uwaoshe kwa maji.

english: And you are to clothe Aaron with the holy garments, anoint him, and consecrate him, so that he may serve Me as a priest.
ekegusii: Erio obeekere Aroni chianga chiria chinchenu, omoake amaguta na komwatanana, anyare gonkorera ase emeremo y’obokuani,
swahili: Kisha mvike Aroni yale mavazi matakatifu, umtie mafuta na kumweka wakfu ili apate kunitumikia katikati ya ukuhani.

english: Bring his sons forward and clothe them with tunics.
ekegusii: Orente na abamura baye, obabeekere chianga chiabo,
swahili: Walete wanawe na uwavike makoti.

english: Anoint them just as you anointed their father, so that they may also serve Me as priests. Their anointing will qualify them for a permanent priesthood throughout their generations.”
ekegusii: obaake amaguta buna oraake ise, na barabwo nababe abakuani baane. Ogoakwa kw’amaguta kwabo nkobanyorere obokuani boragenderere botambe ase ororeria rwabo, ebiaare ase ebiaare.”
swahili: Kisha watie mafuta kama ulivyomtia baba yao, ili nao pia wanitumikie katika kazi ya ukuhani. Kutiwa mafuta kwao kutakuwa kwa ajili ya ukuhani utakaoendelea kwa vizazi vyote vijavyo.”

english: Moses did everything just as the LORD had commanded him.
ekegusii: Musa agakora onsi buna Omonene konya amochikiire.
swahili: Mose akafanya kila kitu sawa kama vile Bwana alivyomwagiza.

english: So the tabernacle was set up on the first day of the first month of the second year.
ekegusii: Ase rituko rie ritang’ani, omotienyi bw’eritang’ani, omwaka o kabere magega kobarure Misiri, obomenyo boria bogatenenigwa.
swahili: Kwa hiyo Maskani ya Mungu ilisimikwa katika siku ya kwanza ya mwezi wa kwanza, katika mwaka wa pili.

english: When Moses set up the tabernacle, he laid its bases, positioned its frames, inserted its crossbars, and set up its posts.
ekegusii: Musa agatenenia Obomenyo boria, akabeeka chinterekerero aase abo, agatenenia ne chibao chiaye, agasoyia emeriibo, na gotenenia chisiiro.
swahili: Mose alipoweka wakfu Maskani ya Mungu, aliweka vitako mahali pake, akasimamisha mihimili, akatia mataruma na kusimamisha nguzo.

english: Then he spread the tent over the tabernacle and put the covering over the tent, just as the LORD had commanded him.
ekegusii: Akaara eema igoro y’obomenyo boria, na kobeeka egietubo kiaye buna Omonene konya amochikiire.
swahili: Kisha akalitandaza hema juu ya Maskani ya Mungu na kuifunika hema, kama Bwana alivyomwagiza.

english: “On the first day of the first month you are to set up the tabernacle, the Tent of Meeting.
ekegusii: “Ase rituko rie ritang’ani, omotienyi bw’eritang’ani, otenenie obomenyo, Eema eria y’Omosangererekano.
swahili: “Simika Maskani ya Mungu, yaani Hema la Kukutania, katika siku ya kwanza ya mwezi wa kwanza.

english: Moses took the Testimony and placed it in the ark, attaching the poles to the ark; and he set the mercy seat atop the ark.
ekegusii: Akaimokia chibao chiriikire oborori, agachibeeka ase esanduki ime, agasoyia emiaro ase chibonyi, akamumeka esanduki eria n’ekerogo ki’amaabera.
swahili: Akachukua ule Ushuhuda na kuuweka ndani ya Sanduku la Agano, akaweka ile mipiko ya kubebea hilo Sanduku na kuweka kiti cha rehema juu yake.

english: Then he brought the ark into the tabernacle, put up the veil for the screen, and shielded off the ark of the Testimony, just as the LORD had commanded him.
ekegusii: Akabeeka esanduki eria ime y’obomenyo, agasunga etoto eria y’egetambaa ase ogokenga esanduki ere ne chibao chiriikire oborori, buna Omonene konya amochikiire.
swahili: Kisha Mose akalileta Sanduku ndani ya Maskani ya Mungu, akatundika pazia ili kulifunika Sanduku la Ushuhuda, kama Bwana alivyomwagiza.

english: Moses placed the table in the Tent of Meeting on the north side of the tabernacle, outside the veil.
ekegusii: Akabeeka emesa ase Eema y’omosangererekano ime, isiko y’etoto, ensemo ya sugusu,
swahili: Mose akaweka meza ndani ya Hema la Kukutania, upande wa kaskazini ya Maskani ya Mungu nje ya pazia

english: He arranged the bread on it before the LORD, just as the LORD had commanded him.
ekegusii: na akaroberia emegati igoro yaye ase obosio bw’Omonene, buna ere konya amochikiire.
swahili: na kupanga mikate juu yake mbele za Bwana, kama Bwana alivyomwagiza.

english: He also placed the lampstand in the Tent of Meeting opposite the table on the south side of the tabernacle
ekegusii: Akabeeka ekebekerero gie chitaaya ase obomenyo ime, ensemo ya Irianyi, kororia ase emesa.
swahili: Akaweka kinara cha taa ndani ya Hema la Kukutania mkabala na meza upande wa kusini mwa Maskani ya Mungu

english: and set up the lamps before the LORD, just as the LORD had commanded him.
ekegusii: Naende akabeeka chitaaya igoro y’ekebekerero ase obosio bw’Omonene, buna ere konya amochikiire.
swahili: na kuziweka taa mbele za Bwana, kama Bwana alivyomwagiza.

english: Moses placed the gold altar in the Tent of Meeting, in front of the veil,
ekegusii: Akabeeka na egesasiimero gi’etaabu ase Eema y’omosangererekano ime, bosio bw’etoto,
swahili: Mose akaweka madhabahu ya dhahabu ndani ya Hema la Kukutania mbele ya pazia

english: and he burned fragrant incense on it, just as the LORD had commanded him.
ekegusii: na igoro yaye agasambera ubani ekorua rimisu rigiya, buna Omonene konya amochikiire.
swahili: na kufukiza uvumba wenye harufu nzuri, kama Bwana alivyomwagiza.

english: Then he put up the curtain at the entrance to the tabernacle.
ekegusii: Agasunga egetambaa ki’egesoero ki’obomenyo.
swahili: Kisha akaweka pazia kwenye ingilio la Maskani ya Mungu.

english: He placed the altar of burnt offering near the entrance to the tabernacle, the Tent of Meeting, and offered on it the burnt offering and the grain offering, just as the LORD had commanded him.
ekegusii: Na egesasiimero ase ebing’wanso birasamberwe akabeeka ase egesoero ki’eema y’Omosangererekano. Igoro yaye akarua ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa, na okoruegwa kw’endagera, buna Omonene konya amochikiire.
swahili: Mose akaweka madhabahu ya sadaka za kuteketezwa karibu na ingilio la Maskani ya Mungu, yaani Hema la Kukutania, na kutoa juu yake sadaka za kuteketezwa na sadaka za nafaka kama Bwana alivyomwagiza.

english: Put the ark of the Testimony in it and screen off the ark with the veil.
ekegusii: Obeeke esanduki ere ne chibao chiriikire oborori imeo, na oyekenge netoto.
swahili: Weka Sanduku la Ushuhuda ndani yake na ulifunike kwa pazia. Ingiza meza na kupanga vitu vyake juu yake.

english: He placed the basin between the Tent of Meeting and the altar and put water in it for washing;
ekegusii: Akabeeka egetuba ase egati y’Eema y’omosangererekano na egesasiimero, akabeeka amaache ogwesibia imeo.
swahili: Akaweka sinia kati ya Hema la Kukutania na madhabahu, akaweka maji ndani yake kwa ajili ya kunawia,

english: and from it Moses, Aaron, and his sons washed their hands and feet.
ekegusii: Musa na Aroni bakaba bagoisaba amaboko na gosibia amagoro ase amaache ayio.
swahili: Naye Mose, Aroni na wanawe wakayatumia kwa kunawia mikono na miguu yao.

english: They washed whenever they entered the Tent of Meeting or approached the altar, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
ekegusii: Ekero baare gosoa Eema y’omosangererekano, gose goika ang’e ase egesasiimero, baba bagwesibia, buna Omonene konya achiikire Musa.
swahili: Wakanawa kila walipoingia katika Hema la Kukutania au walipoikaribia madhabahu kama Bwana alivyomwagiza Mose.

english: And Moses set up the courtyard around the tabernacle and the altar, and he hung the curtain for the entrance to the courtyard. So Moses finished the work. The Cloud and the Glory (Numbers 9:15–23)
ekegusii: Agatenenia orosenge rw’eraaro roetanane Obomenyo na egesasiimero, na agasunga ebitambaa bi’egesoero ki’eraaro. Naboigo Musa agakoora emeremo eyio yonsi. Riire igoro y’Eema y’Omosangererekano (Omob 9:15-23)
swahili: Kisha Mose akafanya ua kuizunguka Maskani ya Mungu na madhabahu, pia akaweka pazia kwenye ingilio la huo ua. Hivyo Mose akaikamilisha kazi. Utukufu Wa Bwana (Hesabu 9:15-23)

english: Then the cloud covered the Tent of Meeting, and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle.
ekegusii: Erio riire rigatuba Eema y’omosangererekano, na obonene bw’Omonene bogaichora ime ase Obomenyo.
swahili: Ndipo wingu likafunika Hema la Kukutania, na utukufu wa Bwana ukaijaza Maskani ya Mungu.

english: Moses was unable to enter the Tent of Meeting because the cloud had settled on it, and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle.
ekegusii: Musa tanyara gosoa eema y’omosangererekano, ekiagera riire riria riabeete igoro yaye, na obonene bogaichora ime ase obomenyo.
swahili: Mose hakuweza kuingia ndani ya Hema la Kukutania kwa sababu wingu lilikuwa limetua juu ya Hema, nao utukufu wa Bwana ukaijaza Maskani ya Mungu.

english: Whenever the cloud was lifted from above the tabernacle, the Israelites would set out through all the stages of their journey.
ekegusii: Na ekero kende gionsi riire riare koimokerera igoro korwa ase obomenyo obwo, Abaisraeli nigo baare koimoka kogenda orogendo rwabo. Naboigo baare gokora ase orogendo rwabo rwonsi.
swahili: Katika safari yote ya Waisraeli, kila wakati wingu lilipoinuka kutoka juu ya Maskani ya Mungu, wangeondoka;

english: If the cloud was not lifted, they would not set out until the day it was taken up.
ekegusii: Korende onye riire tiriare koimokerera igoro, barabwo tibaare koimoka kogenda goika rituko riria riire riare koimokerera igoro naende.
swahili: lakini kama wingu halikuinuka, hawakuondoka, mpaka siku lilipoinuka.

english: For the cloud of the LORD was over the tabernacle by day, and fire was in the cloud by night, in the sight of all the house of Israel through all their journeys.
ekegusii: Naki riire ri’Omonene nigo riare kobeera ase bomenyo ekero kia mobaso, na ekero kia botuko omorero oba ase riire ime; na agwo Abaisraeli bonsi baba bakorirora aande onsi ase barenge ase orogendo rwabo.
swahili: Kwa hiyo wingu la Bwana lilikuwa juu ya maskani mchana, na moto ulikuwa katika hilo wingu wakati wa usiku, machoni pa nyumba yote ya Israeli siku zote za safari zao.

english: Then bring in the table and set out its arrangement; bring in the lampstand as well, and set up its lamps.
ekegusii: Osoyie emesa, na obeeke ebinto biaye igoro yaye; osoyie na ekebekerero gie chitaaya, na obeeke chitaaya igoro yaye.
swahili: Kisha ingiza kinara cha taa na uweke taa zake juu yake.

english: Place the gold altar of incense in front of the ark of the Testimony, and hang the curtain at the entrance to the tabernacle.
ekegusii: Erio obeeke egesasiimero gi’etaabu ase ubani erasamberwe bosio bw’Esanduki ere ne chibao chiriikire oborori, na osunge egetambaa kere ase egesoero ki’obomenyo.
swahili: Weka madhabahu ya dhahabu ya kufukizia uvumba mbele ya Sanduku la Ushuhuda kisha uweke pazia kwenye lango la Maskani ya Mungu.

english: Place the altar of burnt offering in front of the entrance to the tabernacle, the Tent of Meeting.
ekegusii: Obeeke egesasiimero ase ebing’wanso birasamberwe bosio bw’egesoero ki’obomenyo, Eema eria y’Omosangererekano.
swahili: “Weka madhabahu ya sadaka za kuteketezwa mbele ya lango la Maskani ya Mungu, yaani Hema la Kukutania;

english: And place the basin between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and put water in it.
ekegusii: Obeeke egetuba egati y’Eema y’omosangererekano na egesasiimero, obeeke na amaache imeo.
swahili: weka sinia kati ya Hema la Kukutania na madhabahu, na uweke maji ndani yake.

english: Set up the surrounding courtyard and hang the curtain for the entrance to the courtyard.
ekegusii: Otenenie orosenge rw’egetambaa roetanane eraaro, na osunge egetambaa ase egesoero ki’eraaro.
swahili: Fanyiza ua kuzunguka maskani na uweke pazia penye ingilio la ua.

english: Take the anointing oil and anoint the tabernacle and everything in it; consecrate it along with all its furnishings, and it shall be holy.
ekegusii: “Oimokie amaguta akweakwa, oake obomenyo na ebinto bionsi ebire imeo na obwatanane obomenyo amo n’ebinto biaye bionsi, erinde bibe ebichenu.
swahili: “Chukua mafuta ya upako, ipake Maskani ya Mungu pamoja na kila kitu kilichomo ndani yake; iweke wakfu pamoja na vitu vyote vilivyomo ndani mwake, nayo itakuwa takatifu.

english: Then Moses answered, “What if they do not believe me or listen to my voice? For they may say, ‘The LORD has not appeared to you.’”
ekegusii: Erio Musa akamoiraneria Nyasae akamoteebia, “Eraba rende ng’a agwo tibanyegeti, gose koigwa eriogi riaane, barabwo nigo baratebe: Omonene takoorokereti.”
swahili: Mose akamjibu, “Itakuwaje kama hawataniamini au kunisikiliza, waseme, ‘ Bwana hakukutokea’?”

english: “Please, Lord,” Moses replied, “I have never been eloquent, neither in the past nor since You have spoken to Your servant, for I am slow of speech and tongue.”
ekegusii: Erio Musa agateebia Omonene, “Koranche, Omonene one, inche tindi Omokuani omuya, nonya nkorwa kare, gose korwa riria gwachaagete gokwana nainche, omosomba oo. Oromeme rwane nororito na nigo ingotutura.”
swahili: Mose akamwambia Bwana, “Ee Bwana, kamwe sijapata kuwa msemaji kwa ufasaha wakati uliopita wala tangu ulipoanza kuzungumza na mtumishi wako. Ulimi wangu ni mzito kuzungumza.”

english: And the LORD said to him, “Who gave man his mouth? Or who makes the mute or the deaf, the sighted or the blind? Is it not I, the LORD?
ekegusii: Omonene akamoiraneria, “Ning’o okoa Mwanyabaanto omonwa bw’ogokwana? Ning’o omokorete abe rimama, gose omotino, gose abe okorora, gose koba omouko? Inee! Tari inche Omonene?
swahili: Bwana akamwambia, “Ni nani aliyempa mwanadamu kinywa? Ni nani aliyemfanya mtu kuwa kiziwi au bubu? Ni nani anayempa mtu kuona au upofu? Je, si mimi, Bwana?

english: Now go! I will help you as you speak, and I will teach you what to say.”
ekegusii: Bono genda! Nainche omonyene nimbe naye naende ninkoe amang’ana ogochia gokwana nomonwa oo na gokworokereria aya ogochia goteeba.”
swahili: Sasa nenda, nitakusaidia kusema, nami nitakufundisha jambo la kusema.”

english: But Moses replied, “Please, Lord, send someone else.”
ekegusii: Korende Musa akamoiraneria, “Omonene, koranche, toma monto onde bwensi oranche.”
swahili: Lakini Mose akasema, “Ee Bwana, tafadhali mtume mtu mwingine kufanya kazi hiyo.”

english: Then the anger of the LORD burned against Moses, and He said, “Is not Aaron the Levite your brother? I know that he can speak well, and he is now on his way to meet you. When he sees you, he will be glad in his heart.
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene akaba nendamwamu ekoberoroka ase Musa, akamoteebia, “Inee! Aroni momura omino, oria Omolawi, takaiyo? Nimanyete ng’a ere nere omonto omanyete gokwana buya. Naama! Ngocha are gokorotota; ere ekero arakorore nasasoke ase enkoro yaye.
swahili: Ndipo hasira ya Bwana ikawaka dhidi ya Mose, akamwambia, “Vipi kuhusu ndugu yako, Aroni Mlawi? Ninajua yeye anaweza kuzungumza vizuri. Naye yuko tayari njiani kukulaki, na moyo wake utafurahi wakati atakapokuona.

english: You are to speak to him and put the words in his mouth. I will help both of you to speak, and I will teach you what to do.
ekegusii: Aye nokwane nere, omoteebie aya agochia gokwana. Inche nimbae inwe babere amang’ana mogochia gokwana, boigo nimbaorokererie aya mogochi gokora.
swahili: Utazungumza naye na kuweka maneno kinywani mwake. Nitawasaidia ninyi wawili kusema, nami nitawafundisha jambo la kufanya.

english: He will speak to the people for you. He will be your spokesman, and it will be as if you were God to him.
ekegusii: Nere orabe ogokwana nabaanto ribaga riao; ere abe Omokuani oo, na aye obe Enyasae asare ere.
swahili: Aroni ataongea na watu badala yako na itakuwa kwamba yeye amekuwa kinywa chako nawe utakuwa kama Mungu kwake.

english: But take this staff in your hand so you can perform signs with it.” Moses Leaves for Egypt
ekegusii: Aye obogorie enyimbo eyio koboko kwao, nero orakorere ebikone.” Musa okoirana gochia Misiri
swahili: Lakini chukua fimbo hii mkononi mwako ili uweze kuitumia kufanya ishara hizo za ajabu.” Mose Anarudi Misri

english: Then Moses went back to his father-in-law Jethro and said to him, “Please let me return to my brothers in Egypt to see if they are still alive.” “Go in peace,” Jethro replied.
ekegusii: Musa akairana gochia ase Jethiro, ise biara, akamoteebia, “Koranche, tiga ing’irane gochia Misiri korora abaminto gose moyo bare.” Jethiro akamoteebia, “Ee, genda nomorembe.”
swahili: Kisha Mose akarudi kwa Yethro mkwewe akamwambia, “Niruhusu nirudi kwa watu wangu Misri kuona kama yuko hata mmoja wao ambaye bado anaishi.” Yethro akamwambia, “Nenda, nami nakutakia mema.”

english: Now the LORD had said to Moses in Midian, “Go back to Egypt, for all the men who sought to kill you are dead.”
ekegusii: Ekero Musa konya atararwa aaria Midiani, Omonene akamoteebia, “Irana gochia Misiri, ekiagera baria bonsi barigetie obogima bwao bakuure.”
swahili: Basi Bwana alikuwa amemwambia Mose huko Midiani, “Rudi Misri kwa maana watu wote waliotaka kukuua wamekufa.”

english: And the LORD asked him, “What is that in your hand?” “A staff,” he replied.
ekegusii: Omonene akamobooria, “Inki ekio obwate koboko kwao?” Musa akairaneria, “Nenyimbo.”
swahili: Ndipo Bwana akamwambia, “Ni nini hicho kilicho mkononi mwako?” Akajibu, “Fimbo.”

english: So Moses took his wife and sons, put them on a donkey, and headed back to Egypt. And he took the staff of God in his hand.
ekegusii: Musa akaimokia mokaye na abana baye, akabariinia etigere igoro, na barabwo bakairana gochia ase ense ya Misiri. Ere akabogoria enyimbo ya Nyasae koboko kwaye.
swahili: Basi Mose akamchukua mkewe na wanawe, akawapandisha juu ya punda na kuanza safari kurudi Misri. Naye akaichukua ile fimbo ya Mungu mkononi mwake.

english: The LORD instructed Moses, “When you go back to Egypt, see that you perform before Pharaoh all the wonders that I have put within your power. But I will harden his heart so that he will not let the people go.
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene agateebia Musa, “Bono ekero orabe gokoirana Misiri, origererie buya ng’a nokore ase obosio bwa Farao amakumia onsi aya nakoeire okobua gw’okoyakora. Korende ninkong’ie enkoro yaye, na ere tagotiga abanto bagende.
swahili: Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Utakaporudi Misri, hakikisha kwamba utafanya mbele ya Farao maajabu yote niliyokupa uwezo wa kuyafanya. Lakini nitafanya moyo wake kuwa mgumu ili kwamba asiwaruhusu watu waende.

english: Then tell Pharaoh that this is what the LORD says: ‘Israel is My firstborn son,
ekegusii: Erio omoteebie Farao: Aya nar’Omonene agoteeba: Abaisraeli nomwana one omotangi.
swahili: Kisha mwambie Farao, ‘Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana: Israeli ni mwanangu mzaliwa wa kwanza,

english: and I told you to let My son go so that he may worship Me. But since you have refused to let him go, behold, I will kill your firstborn son!’”
ekegusii: Inche nagotebirie: Moe omwana one ribaga agende gonsasiima korende koraange, rirorio nigo ndaite omwana oo omotangi.”
swahili: nami nilikuambia, “Ruhusu mwanangu aondoke, ili aweze kuniabudu mimi.” Lakini ukakataa kumruhusu kwenda, basi nitaua mwana wako mzaliwa wa kwanza.’ ”

english: Now at a lodging place along the way, the LORD met Moses and was about to kill him.
ekegusii: Kobare nchera kogenda, Omonene akaumerana na Musa aase baare gotimokera, akarigia komoita.
swahili: Mose alipokuwa mahali pa kulala wageni akiwa njiani kurudi Misri, Bwana akakutana naye, akataka kumuua.

english: But Zipporah took a flint knife, cut off her son’s foreskin, and touched it to Moses’ feet. “Surely you are a bridegroom of blood to me,” she said.
ekegusii: Erio Sipora akaimokia rigena riare erioge, agasara omwana oye risankwa ria isiko ri’ekiimo kiaye ki’obosacha akarikunia amagoro a Musa, akabora, “Amaene, nigo ore omonywomi one bw’amanyinga.”
swahili: Lakini Sipora akachukua jiwe gumu, akakata govi la mwanawe na kugusa nalo miguu ya Mose. Sipora akasema, “Hakika wewe ni bwana arusi wa damu kwangu.”

english: So the LORD let him alone. (When she said, “bridegroom of blood,” she was referring to the circumcision.) The People Believe Moses and Aaron
ekegusii: Agw’Omonene agatiga Musa, tamoita. Erio omokungu oyio agateeba, “Omonyuomi bw’amanyinga ase engencho y’okwaroka.”
swahili: Sipora alipomwita Mose, “Bwana arusi wa damu,” alikuwa anamaanisha ile tohara. Baada ya hayo Bwana akamwacha.

english: Meanwhile, the LORD had said to Aaron, “Go and meet Moses in the wilderness.” So he went and met Moses at the mountain of God and kissed him.
ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Aroni, “Genda gochia ase erooro orotote Musa.” Erio Aroni akagenda, akaumerana na Musa ase egetunwa kia Nyasae, akamonyunyunta.
swahili: Bwana akamwambia Aroni, “Nenda jangwani ukamlaki Mose.” Basi akakutana na Mose kwenye mlima wa Mungu, akambusu.

english: And Moses told Aaron everything the LORD had sent him to say, and all the signs He had commanded him to perform.
ekegusii: Musa agateebia Aroni amang’ana onsi Omonene amotebetie, na igoro y’ebikone bionsi amochigeete akore.
swahili: Kisha Mose akamwambia Aroni kila kitu Bwana alichomtuma kusema, vilevile habari za ishara na maajabu alizokuwa amemwamuru kufanya.

english: Then Moses and Aaron went and assembled all the elders of the Israelites,
ekegusii: Erio Musa na Aroni bakagenda, bagasangereria abagaaka bonsi b’Abaisraeli.
swahili: Mose na Aroni wakawakusanya wazee wote wa Waisraeli,

english: “Throw it on the ground,” said the LORD. So Moses threw it on the ground, and it became a snake, and he ran from it.
ekegusii: Omonene akamoteebia, “Yerute inse!” Na ekero Musa ayeruta inse, ekaonchoka ekaba eng’iti, na Musa agatama korwa asere.
swahili: Bwana akasema, “Itupe chini.” Mose akaitupa chini hiyo fimbo nayo ikawa nyoka, naye akaikimbia.

english: and Aaron relayed everything the LORD had said to Moses. And Moses performed the signs before the people,
ekegusii: Aroni akabateebia amang’ana onsi Omonene atebeetie Musa, na ere agakora ebikone biria maiso marore ase obosio bw’abaanto.
swahili: naye Aroni akawaambia kila kitu Bwana alichokuwa amemwambia Mose. Pia akafanya ishara mbele ya watu,

english: and they believed. And when they heard that the LORD had attended to the Israelites and had seen their affliction, they bowed down and worshiped.
ekegusii: Erio abanto bakwegena; na ekero baigwete ng’a Omonene bwechandeire Abaisraeli, na ororire emechando yabo, barabwo bagatung’ama inse, bakamosasiima.
swahili: nao wakaamini. Nao waliposikia kuwa Bwana anajishughulisha nao, na kwamba ameona mateso yao, walisujudu na kuabudu.

english: “Stretch out your hand and grab it by the tail,” the LORD said to Moses, who reached out his hand and caught the snake, and it turned back into a staff in his hand.
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene akamoteebia Musa, “Rambora okoboko kwao, oyebwate ekemincha.” Erio ere akarambora okoboko kwaye, akayebwata, na ase okoboko kwaye ekaonchoka, ekaba enyimbo naende.
swahili: Kisha Bwana akamwambia, “Nyoosha mkono wako umkamate mkiani.” Basi Mose akanyoosha mkono akamkamata yule nyoka, naye akabadilika tena kuwa fimbo mkononi mwake.

english: “This is so that they may believe that the LORD, the God of their fathers—the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob—has appeared to you.” Moses’ Hand
ekegusii: Na Omonene akamoteebia, “Okore igo, na barabwo inabegene ng’a inche Omonene, Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiabo, Nyasae o Aburaamu, na o Isaka, na o Yakobo nakoorokera.”
swahili: Bwana akasema, “Hivi ndivyo Waisraeli watakavyoamini kuwa Bwana, Mungu wa baba zao, Mungu wa Abrahamu, Mungu wa Isaki, na Mungu wa Yakobo, amekutokea wewe.”

english: Furthermore, the LORD said to Moses, “Put your hand inside your cloak. ” So he put his hand inside his cloak, and when he took it out, his hand was leprous, white as snow.
ekegusii: Naende Omonene akamoteebia, “Soyia okoboko kwao eanga yao ime ase egekuba kiao.” Musa agakora boigo; na ekero akorusetie akanyora ng’a kwabeire okorabu se ase buna okwo omorwaire bwa ukoma.
swahili: Kisha Bwana akamwambia, “Weka mkono wako ndani ya joho lako.” Basi Mose akaweka mkono wake ndani ya joho lake, naye alipoutoa, ulikuwa na ukoma, mweupe kama theluji.

english: “Put your hand back inside your cloak,” said the LORD. So Moses put his hand back inside his cloak, and when he took it out, it was restored, like the rest of his skin.
ekegusii: Naende Omonene akamoteebia, “Irania okoboko kwao eanga ime ase egekuba kiao.” Musa agakora bo, na ekero akorusetie akanyora ng’a kwabeire buya, buna koreng’ana omobere oye onde ore.
swahili: Mungu akamwambia, “Sasa urudishe tena huo mkono ndani ya joho lako.” Basi Mose akaurudisha mkono wake ndani ya joho lake na alipoutoa, ulikuwa mzima, kama sehemu zingine za mwili wake.

english: And the LORD said, “If they refuse to believe you or heed the witness of the first sign, they may believe that of the second.
ekegusii: Omonene akamoteebia, “Onye tibakwegena amang’ana ao, gose tibagwancha ase egekone kie ritang’ani, rirorio mbanche ase egia kabere.
swahili: Ndipo Bwana akamwambia, “Kama hawatakuamini wewe, au kutojali ishara ya kwanza, wataamini ishara ya pili.

english: But if they do not believe even these two signs or listen to your voice, take some water from the Nile and pour it on the dry ground. Then the water you take from the Nile will become blood on the ground.” The Appointment of Aaron
ekegusii: Onye tibakwegena nonya nase ebikone ebio bibere, gose gwancha amang’ana ao, rirorio obuuche amaache make korwa ase orooche rwa Naeli, oyaitere ase ense enyomo; amaache ayio orabuuche korwa ase orooche naonchoke abe amanyinga ase ense enyomo.”
swahili: Lakini kama hawataamini ishara hizi mbili au hawatawasikiliza ninyi, chukua kiasi cha maji kutoka Mto Naili uyamimine juu ya ardhi kavu. Maji mtakayotoa mtoni yatakuwa damu juu ya ardhi.”

english: After that, Moses and Aaron went to Pharaoh and said, “This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘Let My people go, so that they may hold a feast to Me in the wilderness.’”
ekegusii: Erio Musa na Aroni bakagenda ase Farao, bakamoteebia, “Aya nar’Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, agoteeba: Kae abanto baane ribaga basoe ase orogendo gochia gonkorera omoyega bwe Rituko Rinene aaria ase erooro.”
swahili: Baadaye Mose na Aroni wakaenda kwa Farao, wakamwambia, “Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli: ‘Waruhusu watu wangu waende, ili waweze kunifanyia sikukuu huko jangwani.’ ”

english: So the taskmasters and foremen of the people went out and said to them, “This is what Pharaoh says: ‘I am no longer giving you straw.
ekegusii: Abachandi abwo na abateneneri bagasoka bagateebia Abaisraeli, “Farao oteebire iga: Tinkobaa inwe chimboba naende.
swahili: Basi viongozi wa watumwa na wasimamizi wakaenda kuwaambia watu, “Hivi ndivyo Farao asemavyo: ‘Sitawapa tena nyasi.

english: Go and get your own straw wherever you can find it; but your workload will in no way be reduced.’”
ekegusii: Genda inwe mweka mwerigerie chimboba aande onsi morachinyore; korende goika moroisie omobaro bw’amatabori oria o botambe, kende nkeiyo nonya negeke kegokeigwa korwa ase ekerengo kie emeremo yaino ya kera rituko.”
swahili: Nendeni mkatafute nyasi wenyewe popote mnapoweza kuzipata, lakini kazi yenu haitapunguzwa hata kidogo.’ ”

english: So the people scattered all over the land of Egypt to gather stubble for straw.
ekegusii: Erio Abaisraeli bagesiarera ase ense yonsi ya Misiri na kwerigeria obonyansi ribaga rie chimboba.
swahili: Basi watu wakatawanyika kote nchini Misri kukusanya mabua ya kutumia badala ya nyasi.

english: The taskmasters kept pressing them, saying, “Fulfill your quota each day, just as you did when straw was provided.”
ekegusii: Abachandi baria bakagenderera kobabetereria, bagoteeba, “Goika moroisie kera rituko ekerengo kia amatabori buna konya mokoroisia ekero mware korenterwa chimboba.”
swahili: Viongozi wa watumwa wakasisitiza, wakisema, “Timizeni kazi mnayotakiwa kwa kila siku, kama wakati ule mlipokuwa mkipewa nyasi.”

english: Then the Israelite foremen, whom Pharaoh’s taskmasters had set over the people, were beaten and asked, “Why have you not fulfilled your quota of bricks yesterday or today, as you did before?” The Cry of the Israelites
ekegusii: Abachandi abwo babekire na Farao bakaba bagoaka abateneneri b’Abaisraeli, abwo babegetwe gotenenera emeremo, bakabateebia, “Naki motaikeranetie omobaro oino bw’amatabori igoro na reero, oyio konya mokoroisia botambe?”
swahili: Wasimamizi wa Kiisraeli waliochaguliwa na viongozi wa watumwa wa Farao walipigwa na kuulizwa, “Kwa nini hamkutimiza kiwango chenu cha kutengeneza matofali jana na leo, kama mwanzoni?”

english: So the Israelite foremen went and appealed to Pharaoh: “Why are you treating your servants this way?
ekegusii: Erio abateneneri b’Abaisraeli bakagenda ase Farao, bagateeba, “Inki ogotokorera abasomba bao iga?
swahili: Ndipo wasimamizi wa Kiisraeli wakaenda kumlilia Farao, wakisema: “Mbona umewatendea watumishi wako hivi?

english: No straw has been given to your servants, yet we are told, ‘Make bricks!’ Look, your servants are being beaten, but the fault is with your own people.”
ekegusii: Chimboba titori koegwa, korende nigo tokona‐kobetererigwa ng’a toroisie amatabori. Na bono, abasomba bao, nigo bakona‐goakwa; korende okomocha nokw’abaanto bao.”
swahili: Watumishi wako hawapewi nyasi, hata hivyo tumeambiwa, ‘Tengenezeni matofali!’ Watumishi wako wanapigwa, lakini kosa ni la watu wako wenyewe.”

english: “You are slackers!” Pharaoh replied. “Slackers! That is why you keep saying, ‘Let us go and sacrifice to the LORD.’
ekegusii: Farao akabairaneria, “Inwe naboro mono. Nigo mobarachete nakio gekogera mogoteeba ng’a: Toe ribaga togende toruere Omonene ekeng’wanso.
swahili: Farao akasema, “Ninyi ni wavivu ndiyo sababu mnasema, ‘Turuhusu twende tukamtolee Bwana dhabihu.’

english: Now get to work. You will be given no straw, yet you must deliver the full quota of bricks.”
ekegusii: Irana gochia ase emeremo yaino. Timokorenterwa chimboba, korende goika moroisie ekerengo kia amatabori, keria mochikiire koroisia.”
swahili: Sasa nendeni kazini. Hamtapewa nyasi zozote, nanyi ni lazima mtengeneze matofali.”

english: The Israelite foremen realized they were in trouble when they were told, “You must not reduce your daily quota of bricks.”
ekegusii: Abateneneri b’Abaisraeli bakarora ng’a basoire ase obokong’u ekiagera bateebetigwe ng’a, “Goika moikeranie kera rituko ekerengo keria kia amatabori.”
swahili: Wasimamizi wa Kiisraeli walitambua kuwa wako taabani walipoambiwa, “Hamtakiwi kupunguza idadi ya matofali mliotakiwa kutengeneza kila siku.”

english: But Pharaoh replied, “Who is the LORD that I should obey His voice and let Israel go? I do not know the LORD, and I will not let Israel go.”
ekegusii: Farao akairaneria, “Omonene nere ng’o inyigwe amang’ana aye, na koa Abaisraeli ribaga bagende? Inche timomanyeti Omonene, gose tinkoa Abaisraeli ribaga bagende.”
swahili: Farao akasema, “Huyo Bwana ni nani, hata nimtii na kuruhusu Israeli uende? Simjui huyo Bwana wala sitawaruhusu Israeli waende.”

english: When they left Pharaoh, they confronted Moses and Aaron, who stood waiting to meet them.
ekegusii: Ekero baare korua ase Farao, bakanyora Musa na Aroni agwo nchera baabaganyete,
swahili: Walipoondoka kwa Farao, wakawakuta Mose na Aroni wakingojea kukutana nao,

english: “May the LORD look upon you and judge you,” the foremen said, “for you have made us a stench before Pharaoh and his officials; you have placed in their hand a sword to kill us!”
ekegusii: bakabateebia, “Omonene abarigererie na konacha ekiina, ekiagera mwatokorire koba chindoso ase obosio bwa Farao na ase abasomba baye. Mwabaeire engencho yogotoita.” Ogosaba kwa Musa
swahili: wakawaambia Mose na Aroni, “ Bwana na awaangalie awahukumu ninyi! Mmetufanya tunuke kwa Farao na maafisa wake, nanyi mmeweka upanga mikononi mwao ili kutuua sisi.” Mungu Anaahidi Ukombozi

english: So Moses returned to the LORD and asked, “Lord, why have You brought trouble upon this people? Is this why You sent me?
ekegusii: Erio Musa akairana gochia ase Omonene, akamoteebia, “Omonene, nase ki ogokorera abanto aba amabe buna aya? Inki rende gwantomera inche?
swahili: Mose akarudi kwa Bwana na kumwambia, “Ee Bwana, mbona umewaletea watu hawa taabu? Kwa nini basi ukanituma mimi?

english: Ever since I went to Pharaoh to speak in Your name, he has brought trouble on this people, and You have not delivered Your people in any way.”
ekegusii: Naki korwa riria nagendete ase Farao gokwana amang’ana ao omentire gokorera abanto bao bobe mono, na aye torakora kende ase okobatooria.”
swahili: Tangu nilipomwendea Farao kuzungumza naye kwa jina lako, amewaletea taabu watu hawa, nawe kamwe hujawakomboa watu wako.”

english: “The God of the Hebrews has met with us,” they answered. “Please let us go on a three-day journey into the wilderness to sacrifice to the LORD our God, or He may strike us with plagues or with the sword.”
ekegusii: Erio Musa na Aroni bakamoteebia, “Nyasae bw’Abaiberania natoorokera. Koranche, otoe ribaga togende orogendo rw’amatuko atato gochia ase erooro, erinde tomoruere Omonene, Nyasae oito, ebing’wanso, tabaisa gocha gotoita namarwaire gose nemioro.”
swahili: Ndipo Mose na Aroni wakasema, “Mungu wa Waebrania amekutana nasi. Sasa turuhusu tuwe na safari ya siku tatu ya jangwani ili tukamtolee Bwana Mungu wetu dhabihu, la sivyo aweza kutupiga sisi kwa tauni au kwa upanga.”

english: But the king of Egypt said to them, “Moses and Aaron, why do you draw the people away from their work? Get back to your labor!”
ekegusii: Omorwoti o Misiri akabairaneria, “Musa na Aroni, nase ki mogotenenia abanto korwa ase emeremo yabo? Irana gochia ase emeremo yaino y’obosomba.”
swahili: Lakini mfalme wa Misri akasema, “Mbona ninyi Mose na Aroni mnawachukua watu waache kazi zao? Rudini kwenye kazi zenu!”

english: Pharaoh also said, “Look, the people of the land are now numerous, and you would be stopping them from their labor.” Bricks and Straw
ekegusii: Naende Farao akabora, “Abanto aba babeire abange kobua abanyene ense eye. Naende morigetie kobarusia ase emeremo yabo yobosomba.”
swahili: Kisha Farao akasema, “Tazama, sasa watu hawa ni wengi, nanyi mnawazuia kufanya kazi.”

english: That same day Pharaoh commanded the taskmasters of the people and their foremen:
ekegusii: Ase rituko erio erio Farao agachiika abwo abachandi amo nabateneneri, akabateebia,
swahili: Siku iyo hiyo Farao akatoa amri hii kwa viongozi wa watumwa na wasimamizi wa watu akawaambia:

english: “You shall no longer supply the people with straw for making bricks. They must go and gather their own straw.
ekegusii: “Timoa abanto aba naende chimboba ase okoroisia amatabori, buna mware kobaa agwo ritang’ani. Tiga bagende barabwo boka kwerigeria chimboba.
swahili: “Tangu sasa msiwape hawa watu nyasi za kutengenezea matofali. Wao wakusanye nyasi zao wenyewe.

english: But require of them the same quota of bricks as before; do not reduce it. For they are lazy; that is why they are crying out, ‘Let us go and sacrifice to our God.’
ekegusii: Korende mobabetererie baroisie omobaro bw’amatabori oyo baare gokora ritang’ani, batari koyokeyia. Barabwo tibari nemeremo ebaisaine. Nakio gekogera bakona‐koboria ng’a: Toe ribaga togende koruera Nyasae oito ekeng’wanso.
swahili: Lakini watakeni kutengeneza matofali kiasi kile kile cha mwanzo, kiwango kisipunguzwe. Wao ni wavivu, ndiyo sababu wanalia, wakisema, ‘Turuhusiwe twende kumtolea Mungu wetu dhabihu.’

english: Make the work harder on the men so they will be occupied and pay no attention to these lies.”
ekegusii: Bae abanto abwo emeremo emerito mono, kegima baisaneke nero, na tibanyora ribaga riogotegerera amang’ana ’oborimo.”
swahili: Fanyeni kazi kuwa ngumu zaidi kwa watu hao ili kwamba wakazane na kazi na kuacha kusikiliza uongo.”

english: But the LORD said to Moses, “Now you will see what I will do to Pharaoh, for because of My mighty hand he will let the people go; because of My strong hand he will drive them out of his land.”
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene agateebia Musa, “Bono norore aya ndakorere Farao. Naki ase okoboko kwane gwe chinguru nimobetererie abae abanto baane ribaga bagende, ee, ase okoboko kwane gwe chinguru nabetererigwe abaserie korwa ase ense yaye.” Okorangerigwa kwa Musa naende
swahili: Kisha Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Sasa utaona kitu nitakachomfanyia Farao: Kwa sababu ya mkono wangu wenye nguvu atawaachia watu waende; kwa sababu ya mkono wangu wenye nguvu atawafukuza waondoke nchini mwake.”

english: So the LORD said to Moses,
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene agakwana na Musa akamoteebia,
swahili: Ndipo Bwana akamwambia Mose,

english: “Go and tell Pharaoh king of Egypt to let the Israelites go out of his land.”
ekegusii: “Genda okwane na Farao, omorwoti o Misiri, omoteebie abae Abaisraeli ribaga bagende, barue ase ense yaye.”
swahili: “Nenda, mwambie Farao mfalme wa Misri awaachie Waisraeli waondoke nchini mwake.”

english: But in the LORD’s presence Moses replied, “If the Israelites will not listen to me, then why would Pharaoh listen to me, since I am unskilled in speech? ”
ekegusii: Musa agakwana n’Omonene, akamoteebia. “Rora Abaisraeli baangire konyigwera, naki rende Farao ere arakore anyigwere, inche omonto ntamanyeti gokwana.?”
swahili: Lakini Mose akamwambia Bwana, “Ikiwa Waisraeli hawatanisikiliza, kwa nini yeye Farao anisikilize mimi, ambaye huzungumza kwa kigugumizi?” Orodha Ya Jamaa Ya Mose Na Aroni

english: Then the LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron and gave them a charge concerning both the Israelites and Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring the Israelites out of the land of Egypt. Genealogies of Moses and Aaron
ekegusii: Korende Omonene agakwana na Musa na Aroni, akabachika bagende bateebie Abaisraeli na Farao, omorwoti o Misiri, ng’a batomirwe barusie Abaisraeli korwa ase ense ya Misiri. Omoroberio bw’ororeria rwa Musa na Aroni
swahili: Ndipo Bwana akanena na Mose na Aroni kuhusu Waisraeli na Farao mfalme wa Misri, naye akawaamuru wawatoe Waisraeli kutoka Misri.

english: These were the heads of their fathers’ houses: The sons of Reuben, the firstborn of Israel, were Hanoch and Pallu, Hezron and Carmi. These were the clans of Reuben.
ekegusii: Abanto aba nabwo barenge emetwe ye chiamate chiabo. Abana abamura ba Rubeni, omomura omotangi o Israeli, nabwo aba: Hanoki, na Palu, na Hezironi, na Karimi. Aba nabwo chiamate chia Rubeni.
swahili: Hawa walikuwa wakuu wa jamaa zao: Wana wa Reubeni mzaliwa wa kwanza wa kiume wa Israeli walikuwa Hanoki, Palu, Hesroni na Karmi. Hawa walikuwa ndio koo za Reubeni.

english: The sons of Simeon were Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jachin, Zohar, and Shaul, the son of a Canaanite woman. These were the clans of Simeon.
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Simioni nabwo aba: Yemueli, na Yamini, na Ohadi, na Yakini, na Sohari, na Saulo, omwana bw’omokuungu Omokanani. Aba nabwo chiamate chia Simioni.
swahili: Wana wa Simeoni walikuwa Yemueli, Yamini, Ohadi, Yakini, Sohari na Shauli mwana wa mwanamke Mkanaani. Hawa walikuwa ndio koo za Simeoni.

english: These were the names of the sons of Levi according to their records: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari. Levi lived 137 years.
ekegusii: Aya naro amarieta ’abamura ba Lawi, buna batunyaine ase okoiborwa kwabo: Gerisoni, na Kohati, na Merari. Lawi nigo akoorete emiaka rigana erimo, na emerongo etato, na etano na ebere (137).
swahili: Haya ndiyo majina ya wana wa Lawi kufuatana na orodha zao: Gershoni, Kohathi na Merari. Lawi aliishi miaka 137.

english: The sons of Gershon were Libni and Shimei, by their clans.
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Gerisoni nabwo Libini na Simei, ne chiamate chiabo.
swahili: Wana wa Gershoni kwa koo, walikuwa Libni na Shimei.

english: The sons of Kohath were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel. Kohath lived 133 years.
ekegusii: Na abana abamura ba Kohati nabwo aba: Amuramu, na Isari, na Heburoni, na Usieli. Kohati nigo akoorete emiaka rigana erimo, na emerongo etato, na etato (133).
swahili: Wana wa Kohathi walikuwa Amramu, Ishari, Hebroni na Uzieli. Kohathi aliishi miaka 133.

english: The sons of Merari were Mahli and Mushi. These were the clans of the Levites according to their records.
ekegusii: Na abana abamura ba Merari nabwo Mali na Musi. Aba nabwo chiamate chia Lawi, buna batunyaine ase okoiborwa kwabo.
swahili: Wana wa Merari walikuwa Mahli na Mushi. Hizi ndizo zilizokuwa koo za Lawi kufuatana na orodha zao.

english: God also told Moses, “I am the LORD.
ekegusii: Nyasae agakwana na Musa, akamoteebia, “Inche ninche Omonene.
swahili: Pia Mungu akamwambia Mose, “Mimi ndimi Bwana.

english: And Amram married his father’s sister Jochebed, and she bore him Aaron and Moses. Amram lived 137 years.
ekegusii: Amuramu akanyuoma Yokebedi, omoiseke omwabo ise; na ere akamoiborera Aroni na Musa. Amuramu nigo akoorete emiaka rigana erimo, na emerongo etato, na etano na ebere (137).
swahili: Amramu akamwoa Yokebedi, shangazi yake, ambaye alimzalia Aroni na Mose. Amramu aliishi miaka 137.

english: The sons of Izhar were Korah, Nepheg, and Zichri.
ekegusii: Na abana abamura ba Isari nabwo aba: Kora, na Nefegi, na Sikiri.
swahili: Wana wa Ishari walikuwa Kora, Nefegi na Zikri.

english: The sons of Uzziel were Mishael, Elzaphan, and Sithri.
ekegusii: Na abana abamura ba Usieli nabwo aba: Mishaeli na Elisafani, na Sitiri.
swahili: Wana wa Uzieli walikuwa Mishaeli, Elisafani na Sithri.

english: And Aaron married Elisheba, the daughter of Amminadab and sister of Nahshon, and she bore him Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
ekegusii: Aroni akanyuoma Elisheba, omoiseke bw’Aminadabu, omoiseke omwabo Nashoni. Ere akamoiborera Nadabu, na Abihu, na Eleazari, na Itamari.
swahili: Aroni akamwoa Elisheba binti wa Aminadabu ndugu yake Nashoni, naye akamzalia Nadabu, Abihu, Eleazari na Ithamari.

english: The sons of Korah were Assir, Elkanah, and Abiasaph. These were the clans of the Korahites.
ekegusii: Na abana abamura ba Kora nabwo aba: Asiri, na Elikana, na Abiasafu. Aba nabwo chiamate chia Kora.
swahili: Wana wa Kora walikuwa Asiri, Elikana na Abiasafu. Hawa walikuwa ndio koo za Kora.

english: Aaron’s son Eleazar married one of the daughters of Putiel, and she bore him Phinehas. These were the heads of the Levite families by their clans.
ekegusii: Eleazari, omwana o Aroni, akanyuoma omoiseke oyomo bw’abaiseke ba Putieli, na ere akamoiborera Finehasi. Abanto aba nabwo barenge emetwe ye chinyomba chi’Abalawi, eamate ase eamate.
swahili: Eleazari mwana wa Aroni akamwoa mmoja wa binti za Putieli, naye akamzalia Finehasi. Hawa walikuwa ndio wakuu wa jamaa za Walawi, ukoo kwa ukoo.

english: It was this Aaron and Moses to whom the LORD said, “Bring the Israelites out of the land of Egypt by their divisions.”
ekegusii: Aroni amo na Musa nabwo bari’Omonene atebeetie, “Barusie Abaisraeli ase ense ya Misiri, omoganda ase omoganda.”
swahili: Hawa walikuwa Aroni na Mose wale wale ambao Bwana aliwaambia, “Watoeni Waisraeli katika nchi ya Misri kwa vikosi vyao.”

english: Moses and Aaron were the ones who spoke to Pharaoh king of Egypt in order to bring the Israelites out of Egypt.
ekegusii: Aba nabwo baria Musa na Aroni bateebeetie Farao ng’a barusie Abaisraeli korwa Misiri. Omonene ogochika Musa na Aroni
swahili: Ndio hao hao waliozungumza na Farao mfalme wa Misri kuhusu kuwatoa Waisraeli Misri. Ilikuwa ni huyo Mose na huyo Aroni. Aroni Kuzungumza Badala Ya Mose

english: Now on the day that the LORD spoke to Moses in Egypt,
ekegusii: Rituko riri’Omonene akwanete na Musa ase ense ya Misiri
swahili: Bwana aliponena na Mose huko Misri,

english: He said to him, “I am the LORD; tell Pharaoh king of Egypt everything I say to you.”
ekegusii: akamoteebia, “Inche ninche Omonene. Otebie Farao, omorwoti o Misiri, amang’ana onsi nkogoteebia.”
swahili: akamwambia, “Mimi ndimi Bwana. Mwambie Farao mfalme wa Misri kila kitu nikuambiacho.”

english: I appeared to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob as God Almighty, but by My name the LORD I did not make Myself known to them.
ekegusii: Naorokerete Aburaamu, na Isaka, na Yakobo buna Nyasae Omobui. Korende ase erieta riane Yahwe, gose Omonene, tinamanyekanete ase bare.
swahili: Nilimtokea Abrahamu, Isaki na Yakobo kama Mungu Mwenyezi, ingawa sikuwajulisha Jina langu, Yehova, Mimi mwenyewe sikujitambulisha kwao.

english: But in the LORD’s presence Moses replied, “Since I am unskilled in speech, why would Pharaoh listen to me?”
ekegusii: Korende Musa akairaneri’Omonene akamoteebia, “Inche nomonto ntamanyeti gokwana, naki rende Farao arakore anyigwere?”
swahili: Lakini Mose akamwambia Bwana, “Kwa kuwa mimi huzungumza kwa kigugumizi, Farao atanisikiliza mimi?”

english: I also established My covenant with them to give them the land of Canaan, the land where they lived as foreigners.
ekegusii: Naende ninche nakorete okobwatana kw’ogotianania nabarabwo ng’a nimbae ense ya Kaanani, ense eria barenge buna abamenyi.
swahili: Pia niliweka Agano langu nao kuwapa nchi ya Kanaani, ambako waliishi kama wageni.

english: Furthermore, I have heard the groaning of the Israelites, whom the Egyptians are enslaving, and I have remembered My covenant.
ekegusii: Na bono naigure okwerera kw’Abaisraeli abwo Abamisiri babegete inse y’obosomba, naende ning’inyorete okobwatana koria kwane.
swahili: Zaidi ya hayo, nimesikia kilio cha huzuni cha Waisraeli ambao Wamisri wamewatia utumwani, nami nimelikumbuka Agano langu.

english: Therefore tell the Israelites: ‘I am the LORD, and I will bring you out from under the yoke of the Egyptians and deliver you from their bondage. I will redeem you with an outstretched arm and with mighty acts of judgment.
ekegusii: Ase igo oteebie Abaisraeli ng’a, Inche ninche Omonene, ndabarusie korwa ase emeremo emerito inse y’Abamisiri. Nimbatoorie korwa ase obosomba bwaino. Ase okoboko kwane koramboire, na goetera ase ebisusuro ebinene, nimbaboorie.
swahili: “Kwa hiyo, waambie Waisraeli: ‘Mimi ndimi Bwana, nami nitawatoa mtoke katika kongwa la Wamisri. Nitawaweka huru mtoke kuwa watumwa wao, nami nitawakomboa kwa mkono ulionyooshwa pamoja na matendo makuu ya hukumu.

english: I will take you as My own people, and I will be your God. Then you will know that I am the LORD your God, who brought you out from under the yoke of the Egyptians.
ekegusii: Nimbakore mobe abanto baane, na inche nimbe Nyasae oino. Inwe namomanye ng’a ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino, oyobarusirie korwa ase emeremo emerito inse y’Abamisiri.
swahili: Nitawatwaa mwe watu wangu mwenyewe, nami nitakuwa Mungu wenu. Ndipo mtajua kuwa mimi ndimi Bwana Mungu wenu, niliyewatoa chini ya kongwa la Wamisri.

english: And I will bring you into the land that I swore to give to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. I will give it to you as a possession. I am the LORD!’”
ekegusii: Nimbaire goika ense eria nariete eira koa Aburaamu, na Isaka, na Yakobo. Nimbayee ebe omwando oino. Inche ninche Omonene.”
swahili: Nami nitawaleta mpaka nchi niliyoapa kwa mkono ulioinuliwa kumpa Abrahamu, Isaki na Yakobo. Nitawapa iwe milki yenu. Mimi ndimi Bwana.’ ”

english: Moses relayed this message to the Israelites, but on account of their broken spirit and cruel bondage, they did not listen to him.
ekegusii: Musa agateebia Abaisraeli amang’ana ayio, korende barabwo tibancha gotegerera, ekiagera konya emioyo yabo y akuure, ase engencho y’emeremo y’obosomba obotindi.
swahili: Mose akawaarifu Waisraeli jambo hili, lakini hawakumsikiliza kwa sababu ya maumivu makuu ya moyoni na utumwa wa kikatili.

english: The LORD answered Moses, “See, I have made you like God to Pharaoh, and your brother Aaron will be your prophet.
ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa, “Rora nagokorire obe buna Nyasae ase Farao, na Aroni akwane nere buna omobani oo.
swahili: Kisha Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Tazama, nimekufanya kuwa kama Mungu kwa Farao, naye Aroni, huyo ndugu yako, atakuwa nabii wako.

english: So Moses and Aaron went to Pharaoh and did just as the LORD had commanded. Aaron threw his staff down before Pharaoh and his officials, and it became a serpent.
ekegusii: Musa na Aroni bakagenda ase Farao, bagakora buna Omonene abachiigete. Aroni akaruta enyimbo yaye bosio bwa Farao na bw’abasomba baye, na ero ekaonchoka ekaba eng’iti.
swahili: Ndipo Mose na Aroni wakaenda kwa Farao wakafanya sawasawa kama vile Bwana alivyoagiza. Aroni akaitupa ile fimbo yake chini mbele ya Farao na maafisa wake, nayo ikawa nyoka.

english: But Pharaoh called the wise men and sorcerers and magicians of Egypt, and they also did the same things by their magic arts.
ekegusii: Erio Farao akarangeria abanto abanyasemi na abaragori, na abwo abaringoria ba Misiri bagakora boigo ase oborogi bwabo bwa bobisi.
swahili: Farao naye akawaita watu wenye maarifa na wachawi na waganga wa Kimisri, nao wakafanya vivyo hivyo kwa siri ya uganga wao.

english: Each one threw down his staff, and it became a serpent. But Aaron’s staff swallowed up the other staffs.
ekegusii: Kera oyomo obo akaruta enyimbo yaye inse, na chirochio chikaonchoka, chikaba ching’iti; korende enyimbo ya Aroni ekamera chinyimbo chiabo.
swahili: Kila mmoja alitupa fimbo yake chini, nayo ikawa nyoka. Lakini fimbo ya Aroni ikazimeza zile fimbo zao.

english: Still, Pharaoh’s heart was hardened, and he would not listen to them, just as the LORD had said. The First Plague: Blood
ekegusii: Enkoro ya Farao nigo yarenge enkong’u, na buna Omonene atebeete, taigwera Musa na Aroni. Amaakwa ikomi Ogoakwa kw’eritang’ani: Amache akoonchoka koba amanyinga
swahili: Hata hivyo moyo wa Farao ukawa mgumu, naye hakuwasikiliza Mose na Aroni, sawasawa kama vile Bwana alivyokuwa amesema. Pigo La Kwanza: Damu

english: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Pharaoh’s heart is unyielding; he refuses to let the people go.
ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa, “Farao okong’irie enkoro yaye, bwangire koa abanto aba ribaga bagende.
swahili: Kisha Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Moyo wa Farao ni mgumu, anakataa kuwaachia watu kuondoka.

english: Go to Pharaoh in the morning as you see him walking out to the water. Wait on the bank of the Nile to meet him, and take in your hand the staff that was changed into a snake.
ekegusii: Ase igo, genda oumerane na Farao ekero aragende rooche mambia, ogende otenene ase engegu, omoganye aroro. Enyimbo eria yaonchogete ekaba eng’iti, oyebogorie koboko kwao.
swahili: Nenda kwa Farao asubuhi wakati anapokwenda mtoni. Ngoja ukingoni mwa Naili ili uonane naye, na uchukue mkononi mwako fimbo ile iliyobadilishwa kuwa nyoka.

english: Then say to him, ‘The LORD, the God of the Hebrews, has sent me to tell you: Let My people go, so that they may worship Me in the wilderness. But you have not listened until now.
ekegusii: Omoteebie ng’a: Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaiberania, ontomire ngoteebie ng’a oe abanto baye ribaga bagende komokorera ase erooro. Naye goika bono toraigwa.
swahili: Kisha umwambie, ‘ Bwana, Mungu wa Waebrania, amenituma nikuambie: Waachie watu wangu waende, ili wapate kuniabudu jangwani. Lakini hadi sasa hujasikiliza.

english: This is what the LORD says: By this you will know that I am the LORD. Behold, with the staff in my hand I will strike the water of the Nile, and it will turn to blood.
ekegusii: Ase ig’Omonene oteebire iga: Ase ring’ana eri ndakore, nario oramanye ng’a ninche Omonene. Rigereria, ning’ake amaache y’orooche rwa Naeli nenyimbo eye mbwate koboko kwane, na amaache aya naonchoke abe amanyinga.
swahili: Hili ndilo Bwana asemalo: Kwa hili utajua kuwa Mimi ndimi Bwana: Fimbo iliyo mkononi mwangu nitapiga nayo maji ya Naili nayo yatabadilika kuwa damu.

english: The fish in the Nile will die, the river will stink, and the Egyptians will be unable to drink its water.’”
ekegusii: Ne chinswe chire ase orooche ime inachikwe, chigunde, na orooche narotioke bobe, na Abamisiri nabasinywe konywa amaache aria.”
swahili: Samaki waliomo katika Mto Naili watakufa, nao mto utanuka vibaya, Wamisri hawataweza kunywa hayo maji yake.’ ”

english: And the LORD said to Moses, “Tell Aaron, ‘Take your staff and stretch out your hand over the waters of Egypt—over their rivers and canals and ponds and reservoirs—that they may become blood.’ There will be blood throughout the land of Egypt, even in the vessels of wood and stone.”
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene agateebia Musa moteebie Aroni, aimokie enyimbo yaye, arambore okoboko kwaye igoro ase amaache onsi ay’Abamisiri, ase chindooche chiabo na ase ebirooche, ase amatibo onsi ne chinsoko. Amache ayio onsi aonchoke abe amanyinga. Naboigo amanyinga abe ase ense yonsi ya Misiri, nonya nase chintuba na ase chinyongo chionsi.
swahili: Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Mwambie Aroni, ‘Chukua ile fimbo yako unyooshe mkono wako juu ya maji ya Misri, juu ya chemchemi na mifereji, juu ya madimbwi na mabwawa yote,’ navyo vitabadilika kuwa damu. Damu itakuwa kila mahali katika Misri, hata kwenye vyombo vya miti na vya mawe.”

english: You are to speak all that I command you, and your brother Aaron is to tell Pharaoh to let the Israelites go out of his land.
ekegusii: Aye oteebie oyomino Aroni ayio onsi nagochikiire, na ere akwane na Farao, amoteebie ng’a ae Abaisraeli ribaga barue ase ense yaye.
swahili: Utasema kila kitu nitakachokuagiza, naye Aroni ndugu yako atamwambia Farao awaachie Waisraeli watoke katika nchi yake.

english: Moses and Aaron did just as the LORD had commanded; in the presence of Pharaoh and his officials, Aaron raised the staff and struck the water of the Nile, and all the water was turned to blood.
ekegusii: Musa na Aroni bagakora buna Omonene abachigete. Ase obosio bwa Farao na abasomba baye, Aroni akaimokia enyimbo yaye, agaaka orooche, na amaache ayare imeo akaonchoka, akaba amanyinga.
swahili: Mose na Aroni wakafanya kama vile Bwana alivyokuwa amewaagiza. Akainua fimbo yake machoni pa Farao na maafisa wake na kuyapiga maji ya Mto Naili, na maji yote yakabadilika kuwa damu.

english: The fish in the Nile died, and the river smelled so bad that the Egyptians could not drink its water. And there was blood throughout the land of Egypt.
ekegusii: Ne chinswe chiare ase orooche chigakwa, na orooche rokagunda na gotioka, na Abamisiri bagasinywa konywa amaache aria. Amanyinga akaba ase ense yonsi ya Misiri.
swahili: Samaki katika Mto Naili wakafa, nao mto ukanuka vibaya sana kiasi kwamba Wamisri hawakuweza kunywa maji yake. Damu ilikuwa kila mahali katika nchi ya Misri.

english: But the magicians of Egypt did the same things by their magic arts. So Pharaoh’s heart was hardened, and he would not listen to Moses and Aaron, just as the LORD had said.
ekegusii: Erio abaringoria ba Misiri bagakora boigo ase oborogi bwabo. Farao akagenderera gokong’ia enkoro yaye, na buna Omonene konya atebiire, tabaigwa.
swahili: Lakini waganga wa Misri kwa kutumia siri ya uganga wao wakafanya vivyo hivyo, nao moyo wa Farao ukawa mgumu, hakuwasikiliza Mose na Aroni, kama vile Bwana alivyokuwa amesema.

english: Instead, Pharaoh turned around, went into his palace, and did not take any of this to heart.
ekegusii: Erio Farao akairana akogenda bwoye, amang’ana aria tayabeka ase omoyo oye.
swahili: Badala yake, Farao akageuka, akaenda kwenye jumba lake la kifalme, wala hakulitia hili moyoni.

english: So all the Egyptians dug around the Nile for water to drink, because they could not drink the water from the river.
ekegusii: Abamisiri bonsi bagakunya‐kunya mbarabare y’orooche ase okorigia amaache bakonywa, ekiagera tibare konyara konywa amaache a rooche.
swahili: Nao Wamisri wote wakachimba kandokando ya Mto Naili kupata maji ya kunywa, kwa sababu hawakuweza kunywa maji ya mto. Pigo La Pili: Vyura

english: And seven full days passed after the LORD had struck the Nile.
ekegusii: Amatuko atano na abere akaera korwa riri’Omonene aagete orooche rwa Naeli.
swahili: Zilipita siku saba baada ya Bwana kuyapiga maji ya Mto Naili.

english: But I will harden Pharaoh’s heart, and though I will multiply My signs and wonders in the land of Egypt,
ekegusii: Korende ninkong’ie enkoro ya Farao; nonya nabo ninkore ebikone ebinge na amakumia amange ase ense ya Misiri.
swahili: Lakini nitaufanya moyo wa Farao kuwa mgumu. Ingawa nitazidisha ishara na maajabu katika Misri,

english: Pharaoh will not listen to you. Then I will lay My hand on Egypt, and by mighty acts of judgment I will bring the divisions of My people the Israelites out of the land of Egypt.
ekegusii: Korende Farao takobaigwa. Inche nindambore okoboko kwane igoro y’Abamisiri na kobaa ebisusuro ebinene, na nindusie emeganda yane, abanto baane Abaisraeli, korwa ase ense ya Misiri.
swahili: hatawasikiliza. Kisha nitaupeleka mkono wangu juu ya Misri, na kwa matendo makuu ya hukumu nitavitoa vikundi vyangu, watu wangu Waisraeli.

english: And the Egyptians will know that I am the LORD, when I stretch out My hand against Egypt and bring the Israelites out from among them.”
ekegusii: Erio Abamisiri mbamanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene, ekero ndarambore okoboko kwane ase barabwo na koruisia Abaisraeli korwa ase bare.”
swahili: Nao Wamisri watajua kuwa Mimi ndimi Bwana nitakapounyoosha mkono wangu dhidi ya Misri na kuwatoa Waisraeli watoke humo.”

english: So Moses and Aaron did just as the LORD had commanded them.
ekegusii: Musa na Aroni bagakora buna Omonene abachigete.
swahili: Mose na Aroni wakafanya sawasawa kama vile Bwana alivyowaagiza.

english: Moses was eighty years old and Aaron was eighty-three when they spoke to Pharaoh. Aaron’s Staff
ekegusii: Ekero keria bakwanete na Farao, Musa nigo arenge nemiaka emerongo etano na etato (80), na Aroni emiaka emerongo etano na etato, na etato (83). Enyimbo ya Aroni
swahili: Mose alikuwa na umri wa miaka themanini na Aroni alikuwa na umri wa miaka themanini na mitatu walipozungumza na Farao. Fimbo Ya Aroni Yawa Nyoka

english: The LORD said to Moses and Aaron,
ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa na Aroni,
swahili: Bwana akamwambia Mose na Aroni,

english: “When Pharaoh tells you, ‘Perform a miracle,’ you are to say to Aaron, ‘Take your staff and throw it down before Pharaoh,’ and it will become a serpent. ”
ekegusii: “Ekero Farao arababorie ng’a mokore egekone, erio aye Musa oteebie Aroni abogorie enyimbo yaye, ayerute inse bosio bwa Farao, na ero neonchoke ebe eng’iti.”
swahili: “Farao atakapowaambia, ‘Fanyeni muujiza,’ basi mwambie Aroni, ‘Chukua fimbo yako na uitupe chini mbele ya Farao,’ nayo fimbo itakuwa nyoka.”

english: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Go to Pharaoh and tell him that this is what the LORD says: ‘Let My people go, so that they may worship Me.
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene agateebia Musa, “Genda oteebie Farao: Aya nar’Omonene agoteeba: Bae abanto baane ribaga bagende gonkorera.
swahili: Ndipo Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Nenda kwa Farao ukamwambie, ‘Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana: Waachie watu wangu waende, ili wapate kuniabudu.

english: “Tomorrow,” Pharaoh answered. “May it be as you say,” Moses replied, “so that you may know that there is no one like the LORD our God.
ekegusii: Farao akairaneria, “Ng’ankio.” Musa akamoteebia, “Nigo erabe buna gwateba, erinde omanye ng’a onde tari buna Omonene, Nyasae oito.
swahili: Farao akasema, “Kesho.” Mose akamjibu, “Itakuwa kama unavyosema, ili upate kujua kwamba hakuna yeyote kama Bwana Mungu wetu.

english: The frogs will depart from you and your houses and your officials and your people; they will remain only in the Nile.”
ekegusii: Ebioto nabirue asore na ase chinyomba chiao, ase abasomba bao na ase abanto bao; binde tibigotigara otatiga ase orooche rwa Naeli oka.”
swahili: Vyura wataondoka kwako na katika nyumba zako, kwa maafisa wako na kwa watu wako, ila watabakia katika Mto Naili tu.”

english: After Moses and Aaron had left Pharaoh, Moses cried out to the LORD for help with the frogs that He had brought against Pharaoh.
ekegusii: Musa na Aroni bakarua o Farao, na Musa akabori’Omonene arusie ebioto ebio amorenterete Farao.
swahili: Baada ya Mose na Aroni kuondoka kwa Farao, Mose akamlilia Bwana kuhusu vyura aliokuwa amewaleta kwa Farao.

english: And the LORD did as Moses requested, and the frogs in the houses, the courtyards, and the fields died.
ekegusii: Omonene agakora buna Musa amoboretie, na ebioto ebio biare ase chinyomba, na ase chigoora, na aande onsi isiko, bigakwa.
swahili: Naye Bwana akafanya lile Mose alilomwomba. Vyura wakafia ndani ya nyumba, viwanjani na mashambani.

english: They were piled into countless heaps, and there was a terrible stench in the land.
ekegusii: Abanto bakabisangereria, bakabibeka ebinge chinyinge, na ense yonsi egatioka bobe.
swahili: Wakayakusanya malundo, nchi nzima ikanuka.

english: When Pharaoh saw that there was relief, however, he hardened his heart and would not listen to Moses and Aaron, just as the LORD had said. The Third Plague: Gnats
ekegusii: Korende ekero Farao aroche ng’a amang’ana abeire buya, agakong’ia enkoro yaye naende, na buna Omonene ateebete, akanga koigwa Musa na Aroni. Ogoakwa kw’agatato: Chinsona
swahili: Lakini Farao alipoona pametokea nafuu, akaushupaza moyo wake na hakuwasikiliza Mose na Aroni, kama vile Bwana alivyokuwa amesema. Pigo La Tatu: Viroboto

english: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Tell Aaron, ‘Stretch out your staff and strike the dust of the earth, that it may turn into swarms of gnats throughout the land of Egypt.’”
ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa, “Moteebie Aroni aimokie enyimbo yaye aake orotu rw’eriroba, na rororwo naroonchoke robe chinsona ase ense ya Misiri.”
swahili: Ndipo Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Mwambie Aroni, ‘Nyoosha fimbo yako uyapige mavumbi ya ardhi,’ nayo nchi yote ya Misri mavumbi yatakuwa viroboto.”

english: This they did, and when Aaron stretched out his hand with his staff and struck the dust of the earth, gnats came upon man and beast. All the dust of the earth turned into gnats throughout the land of Egypt.
ekegusii: Barabwo bagakora bo. Aroni akarambora okoboko kwaye, agaaka riroba nenyimbo yaye, na orotu rokaonchoka rokaba chinsona, na chirochio chikaroma Mwanyabaanto ne chitugo. Orotu rwonsi rwe riroba rokaonchoka rokaba chinsona.
swahili: Wakafanya hivyo, Aroni aliponyoosha mkono wake wenye fimbo na kuyapiga mavumbi ya nchi, viroboto wakawajia watu na wanyama. Mavumbi yote katika nchi ya Misri yakawa viroboto.

english: The magicians tried to produce gnats using their magic arts, but they could not. And the gnats remained on man and beast.
ekegusii: Abaringoria nabarabwo bagateema korenta chinsona ase oborogi bwabo, korende tibanyara. Chinsona echio chikaba aande onsi, ase Mwanyabaanto na ase chitugo.
swahili: Lakini waganga walipojaribu kutengeneza viroboto kwa siri ya uganga wao, hawakuweza. Nao viroboto walikuwa juu ya watu na wanyama.

english: “This is the finger of God,” the magicians said to Pharaoh. But Pharaoh’s heart was hardened, and he would not listen to them, just as the LORD had said. The Fourth Plague: Flies
ekegusii: Abaringoria bagateebia Farao, “Eke nekiara kia Nyasae.” Korende Farao agakong’ia enkoro yaye, na buna Omonene ateebete, akanga kobaigwa. Ogoakwa gwa kane Chingi chikorentwa
swahili: Waganga wale wakamwambia Farao, “Hiki ni kidole cha Mungu.” Lakini moyo wa Farao ukawa mgumu naye hakuwasikiliza, kama vile Bwana alivyosema. Pigo La Nne: Mainzi

english: But if you refuse to let them go, I will plague your whole country with frogs.
ekegusii: Korende koraange kobaa ribaga bagende, rirorio inche ning’ake ense yao yonsi ase okorenta ebioto.
swahili: Kama ukikataa kuwaruhusu kuondoka, basi nitaipiga nchi yako yote kwa kuwaletea vyura.

english: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Get up early in the morning, and when Pharaoh goes out to the water, stand before him and tell him that this is what the LORD says: ‘Let My people go, so that they may worship Me.
ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa, “Oche oimoke mambia chuni ekero Farao agochia kogenda rooche, otenene ase obosio bwaye, omoteebie: Aya nar’Omonene agoteeba: Bae abanto baane ribaga bagende bankorere.
swahili: Kisha Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Amka mapema asubuhi na usimame mbele ya Farao wakati anapokwenda mtoni nawe umwambie, ‘Hili ndilo Bwana asemalo: Waachie watu wangu waende, ili wapate kuniabudu.

english: But if you will not let My people go, I will send swarms of flies upon you and your officials and your people and your houses. The houses of the Egyptians and even the ground where they stand will be full of flies.
ekegusii: Onye tokoa abanto baane ribaga, rirorio nintome chingi chinyinge igoro yao na abasomba bao, na igoro y’abanto bao ne chinyomba chiao. Chinyomba chi’Abamisiri inachiichorwe ne chingi, nonya nense eyio yonsi bamenyete.
swahili: Kama hutawaachia watu wangu waondoke nitakupelekea makundi ya mainzi juu yako, kwa maafisa wako, kwa watu wako na kwenye nyumba zenu. Nyumba za Wamisri zitajazwa mainzi, hata na ardhi yote ya Misri.

english: But on that day I will give special treatment to the land of Goshen, where My people live; no swarms of flies will be found there. In this way you will know that I, the LORD, am in the land.
ekegusii: Korende ase rituko erio nintige ensemo ya Goseni, ase abanto baane bamenyete; chingi echio tichigochiao, erio nomanye ng’a ninche Omonene bw’ense eye.
swahili: “ ‘Lakini siku ile nitafanya kitu tofauti katika nchi ya Gosheni, ambapo watu wangu wanaishi, hapatakuwepo na makundi ya mainzi, ili mpate kujua kwamba Mimi, Bwana, niko katika nchi hii.

english: I will make a distinction between My people and your people. This sign will take place tomorrow.’”
ekegusii: Ninkore ogwatananeka egati y’abanto baane na abao. Ankio egekone eke nagekoreke.”
swahili: Nitaweka tofauti kati ya watu wangu na watu wenu. Ishara hii ya ajabu itatokea kesho.’ ”

english: And the LORD did so. Thick swarms of flies poured into Pharaoh’s palace and into the houses of his officials. Throughout Egypt the land was ruined by swarms of flies.
ekegusii: Omonene agakora ayio. Chingi chigaacha ase obonge mono ase chinyomba chia Farao, na echi’abasomba baye, na ase ense yonsi ya Misiri. Na ense eria egasarigwa ne chingi chiria.
swahili: Naye Bwana akafanya hivyo. Makundi makubwa ya mainzi yalimiminika katika jumba la kifalme la Farao na katika nyumba za maafisa wake, pia nchi yote ya Misri ikaharibiwa na mainzi.

english: Then Pharaoh summoned Moses and Aaron and said, “Go, sacrifice to your God within this land.”
ekegusii: Erio Farao akarangeria Musa na Aroni, akabateebia, “Genda moruere Nyasae oino ekeng’wanso, korende naiga ase ense yaito.”
swahili: Ndipo Farao akamwita Mose na Aroni na kuwaambia, “Nendeni mkamtolee Mungu wenu dhabihu katika nchi hii.”

english: But Moses replied, “It would not be right to do that, because the sacrifices we offer to the LORD our God would be detestable to the Egyptians. If we offer sacrifices that are detestable before the Egyptians, will they not stone us?
ekegusii: Musa akamoiraneria, “Titokonyara gokora igo, ekiagera intwe ntoruere Omonene, Nyasae oito, ekeng’wanso ekeragechie Abamisiri. Na onye Abamisiri bagotorora tokorua ekeng’wanso buna ekio, Inee, tibagocha gotoaka amagena?
swahili: Lakini Mose akamwambia, “Hilo halitakuwa sawa. Dhabihu tutakazomtolea Bwana Mungu wetu zitakuwa chukizo kwa Wamisri. Kama tukitoa dhabihu ambazo ni chukizo mbele yao, je, hawatatupiga mawe?

english: We must make a three-day journey into the wilderness and sacrifice to the LORD our God as He commands us.”
ekegusii: Goika togende orogendo rw’amatuko atato gochia ase erooro, erinde toruere Omonene, Nyasae oito, ekeng’wanso buna atochikiire.”
swahili: Ni lazima twende mwendo wa siku tatu mpaka tufike jangwani ili tumtolee Bwana Mungu wetu dhabihu, kama alivyotuagiza.”

english: Pharaoh answered, “I will let you go and sacrifice to the LORD your God in the wilderness, but you must not go very far. Now pray for me.”
ekegusii: Farao akabateebia, “Nimbae ribaga mogende moruere Omonene, Nyasae oino, ekeng’wanso ase erooro, korende timogenda aare, naende monsabere inche.”
swahili: Farao akamwambia, “Nitawaruhusu mwende kumtolea Bwana Mungu wenu dhabihu huko jangwani, lakini hamna ruhusa kwenda mbali sana. Sasa mniombee.”

english: “As soon as I leave you,” Moses said, “I will pray to the LORD, so that tomorrow the swarms of flies will depart from Pharaoh and his officials and his people. But Pharaoh must not act deceitfully again by refusing to let the people go and sacrifice to the LORD.”
ekegusii: Musa akamoiraneria, “Bono buna nkorua asore nimosabe Omonene arusie chingi korwa asore aye Farao, na ase abasomba bao, na ase abanto bao, ankio mambia. Korende aye Farao, tokora obong’ainereria naende, na kwanga koa abanto ribaga bagende baruere Omonene ekeng’wanso.”
swahili: Mose akajibu, “Mara tu nitakapoondoka, nitamwomba Bwana na kesho mainzi yataondoka kwa Farao, kwa maafisa wake na kwa watu wake. Hakikisha tu kwamba Farao hatatenda kwa udanganyifu tena kwa kutokuwaachia watu waende kumtolea Bwana dhabihu.”

english: The Nile will teem with frogs, and they will come into your palace and up to your bedroom and onto your bed, into the houses of your officials and your people, and into your ovens and kneading bowls.
ekegusii: Orooche rwa Naeli naroichorwe nebioto, na birobio nabitiire korwa aroro, nabisoe nyomba mwao, na enyomba yao y’okorara, amo noborere bwao; nabisoe ne chinyomba chi’abasomba bao na echi’abaanto bao, ase amariiko ao ase okogeekera emegati, na ase ebituba biao bi’ooboseemiara obosie.
