swahili: Mto Naili utafurika vyura. Watakuja kwenye jumba lako la kifalme na katika chumba chako cha kulala na kitandani mwako, katika nyumba za maafisa wako na kwa watu wako, vyura hao wataingia katika meko yenu na kwenye vyombo vya kukandia unga.

english: Then Moses left Pharaoh and prayed to the LORD,
ekegusii: Erio Musa akarua o Farao, agasaba Omonene.
swahili: Ndipo Mose akamwacha Farao na kumwomba Bwana,

english: and the LORD did as Moses requested. He removed the swarms of flies from Pharaoh and his officials and his people; not one fly remained.
ekegusii: Omonene agakora buna Musa ateebete, akarusia chingi chiria ase Farao, na ase abasomba baye, na ase abanto baye; tichiatigara nonya neyemo.
swahili: naye Bwana akafanya lile Mose alilomwomba. Mainzi yakaondoka kwa Farao, kwa maafisa wake na kwa watu wake, wala hakuna hata inzi aliyebakia.

english: But Pharaoh hardened his heart this time as well, and he would not let the people go.
ekegusii: Korende Farao agakong’ia enkoro yaye nonya nengaki eyio, taa abanto ribaga bagende.
swahili: Lakini wakati huu pia Farao akaushupaza moyo wake, wala hakuwaruhusu Waisraeli waondoke.

english: The frogs will come up on you and your people and all your officials.’”
ekegusii: Ebioto ebio inabikogenderere omobere oo, na ey’abaanto bao, na ey’abasomba bao.”
swahili: Vyura watapanda juu yako, juu ya watu wako na maafisa wako wote.’ ”

english: And the LORD said to Moses, “Tell Aaron, ‘Stretch out your hand with your staff over the rivers and canals and ponds, and cause the frogs to come up onto the land of Egypt.’”
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene agateebia Musa, “Moteebie Aroni abwate enyimbo yaye, ayeimokie igoro ye chindooche, na ebirooche, na amatibo, erinde agere ebioto bigende igoro ase ense yonsi ya Misiri.”
swahili: Ndipo Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Mwambie Aroni, ‘Nyoosha mkono wako ukiwa na ile fimbo yako juu ya vijito, mifereji na madimbwi, fanya vyura waje juu ya nchi ya Misri.’ ”

english: So Aaron stretched out his hand over the waters of Egypt, and the frogs came up and covered the land of Egypt.
ekegusii: Aroni akarambora okoboko kwaye igoro y’amaache onsi a Misiri, na ebioto bigatiira, bigatuba ense eyio yonsi.
swahili: Ndipo Aroni akaunyoosha mkono wake juu ya maji ya Misri, nao vyura wakatokea na kuifunika nchi.

english: But the magicians did the same thing by their magic arts, and they also brought frogs up onto the land of Egypt.
ekegusii: Na abaringoria bagakora boigo ase oborogi bwabo, bakarenta ebioto igoro ase ense ya Misiri.
swahili: Lakini waganga wakafanya vivyo hivyo kwa siri ya uganga wao, nao pia wakafanya vyura kuja juu ya nchi ya Misri.

english: Pharaoh summoned Moses and Aaron and said, “Pray to the LORD to take the frogs away from me and my people. Then I will let your people go, that they may sacrifice to the LORD.”
ekegusii: Erio Farao akarangeria Musa na Aroni, akabateebia, “Mosabe Omonene arusie ebioto korwa ase ense na korwa ase abanto baane, na inche ning’ee abanto baye ribaga bagende koruera Omonene ekeng’wanso.”
swahili: Ndipo Farao akamwita Mose na Aroni na kusema, “Mwombeni Bwana awaondoe vyura kutoka kwangu na kwa watu wangu, nami nitawaachia watu wenu waende kumtolea Bwana dhabihu.”

english: Moses said to Pharaoh, “You may have the honor over me. When shall I pray for you and your officials and your people that the frogs (except for those in the Nile) may be taken away from you and your houses?”
ekegusii: Musa agateebia Farao, “Ase amasikani ao, naye oranteebie ngaki ki ndagosabere aye amo nabasomba bao, na abanto bao, erinde ebioto birue asore na ase chinyomba chiao, bitigare koba ase orooche rwa Naeli oka.”
swahili: Mose akamwambia Farao, “Ninakupa heshima ya kuamua ni wakati gani wa kukuombea wewe, maafisa wako na watu wako ili kwamba vyura watoke kwenu na kwenye nyumba zenu. Isipokuwa wale walio katika Mto Naili.”

english: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Go to Pharaoh and tell him that this is what the LORD, the God of the Hebrews, says: ‘Let My people go, so that they may worship Me.
ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa, “Genda oteebie Farao: Aya nar’Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaiberania, agoteeba: Bae abanto baane ribaga bagende, erinde bankorere.
swahili: Ndipo Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Nenda kwa Farao ukamwambie, ‘Hili ndilo Bwana, Mungu wa Waebrania asemalo: “Waachie watu wangu waende ili wapate kuniabudu.”

english: So they took soot from the furnace and stood before Pharaoh. Moses tossed it into the air, and festering boils broke out on man and beast.
ekegusii: Erio bakabuucha ribu korwa riko, bakagenda ase obosio bwa Farao. Musa akarisiara gochia igoro, na rirorio rikarenta amagumba na amaote amabe ase Mwanyabaanto ne chitugo.
swahili: Basi wakachukua majivu kwenye tanuru na kusimama mbele ya Farao. Mose akayarusha hewani, nayo majipu yenye kufura yakatokea miilini mwa watu na wanyama.

english: The magicians could not stand before Moses, because the boils had broken out on them and on all the Egyptians.
ekegusii: Na abaringoria tibanyara gotenena ase obosio bwa Musa, ekiagera amagumba konya abariire barabwo buna Abamisiri bande.
swahili: Waganga hawakuweza kusimama mbele ya Mose kwa sababu ya majipu yale yaliyokuwa miilini mwao na juu ya miili ya Wamisri wote.

english: But the LORD hardened Pharaoh’s heart, and he would not listen to them, just as the LORD had said to Moses. The Seventh Plague: Hail
ekegusii: Korende Omonene agakong’ia enkoro ya Farao, na buna Omonene konya atebirie Musa, Farao akaanga koigwa Musa na Aroni. Ogoakwa gwa gatan’akabere Embura y’amagena
swahili: Lakini Bwana akaufanya moyo wa Farao kuwa mgumu, naye hakuwasikiliza Mose na Aroni, sawasawa kama vile Bwana alivyokuwa amemwambia Mose. Pigo La Saba: Mvua Ya Mawe

english: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Get up early in the morning, stand before Pharaoh, and tell him that this is what the LORD, the God of the Hebrews, says: ‘Let My people go, so that they may worship Me.
ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa, “Oche oimoke mambia chuni, otenene ase obosio bwa Farao, omoteebie: Aya nar’Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaiberania, agoteeba: Bae abanto baane ribaga bagende, erinde bankorere.
swahili: Kisha Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Amka mapema asubuhi, usimame mbele ya Farao, umwambie, ‘Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana, Mungu wa Waebrania: Waachie watu wangu waende, ili kwamba waweze kuniabudu,

english: Otherwise, I will send all My plagues against you and your officials and your people, so you may know that there is no one like Me in all the earth.
ekegusii: Engaki eye nindete amaakwa aane onsi igoro yao aye omonyene, na igoro y’abasomba bao, na ase abanto bao, erinde omanye ng’a onde tari, nonya noyomo, ore buna inche, ase ense engima.
swahili: au wakati huu nitaleta mapigo yangu yenye nguvu dhidi yako, maafisa wako na watu wako, ili upate kujua kuwa hakuna mwingine kama Mimi katika dunia yote.

english: For by this time I could have stretched out My hand and struck you and your people with a plague to wipe you off the earth.
ekegusii: Naki ase engaki eye nanga narambora okoboko kwane ngoake aye amo nabaanto bao namarwaire amabe abaite, aye nanga ngwasira korwa ase ense eye.
swahili: Kwa kuwa mpaka sasa ningelikuwa nimenyoosha mkono wangu na kukupiga wewe na watu wako kwa pigo ambalo lingekufutilia mbali juu ya nchi.

english: But I have raised you up for this very purpose, that I might display My power to you, and that My name might be proclaimed in all the earth.
ekegusii: Korende nagotigire obe moyo ase engencho eye inyare kworokia okobua kwane, na erieta riane nario rirararigwe ase ense yonsi.
swahili: Lakini nimekuinua wewe kwa kusudi hili hasa, ili nipate kukuonyesha uwezo wangu, na ili Jina langu lipate kutangazwa duniani yote.

english: Still, you lord it over My people and do not allow them to go.
ekegusii: Ekiagera aye nigo ogendererete gotanga abanto baane, na tori kobaa ribaga bagende.
swahili: Bado unaendelea kujiinua juu ya watu wangu, wala hutaki kuwaachia waende.

english: Behold, at this time tomorrow I will rain down the worst hail that has ever fallen on Egypt, from the day it was founded until now.
ekegusii: Ase igo ankio, engaki buna eye, nindete embura y’amagena endito mono, eyio omogwekano oye etana gotwa rinde ase Misiri korwa riria ense eye yachaagete goika bono.
swahili: Kwa hiyo, kesho wakati kama huu nitaleta mvua mbaya sana ya mawe ambayo haijapata kunyesha katika nchi ya Misri, tangu siku ilipoumbwa mpaka leo.

english: So give orders now to shelter your livestock and everything you have in the field. Every man or beast that remains in the field and is not brought inside will die when the hail comes down upon them.’”
ekegusii: Bono, origererie orore ng’a chitugo chiao chiarentirwe inka, naboigo na kende kiao gionsi kere isiko. Onye abanto bonsi abare isiko tibakorentwa ase chinyomba ime, embura y’amagena nebaite bakwe, ne chitugo chionsi boigo.”
swahili: Sasa toa amri urudishe wanyama wote watoke malishoni na chochote ambacho kipo mashambani waje mpaka mahali pa usalama, kwa sababu mvua ya mawe itanyesha juu ya kila mtu na kila mnyama ambaye hajaletwa ndani ambao bado wako nje mashambani, nao watakufa.’ ”

english: But if you continue to restrain them and refuse to let them go,
ekegusii: Naki onye gokwanga kobaa ribaga, na kogenderera kobatanga,
swahili: Kama ukikataa kuwaachia waende, nawe ukiendelea kuwashikilia,

english: Those among Pharaoh’s officials who feared the word of the LORD hurried to bring their servants and livestock to shelter,
ekegusii: Abande b’abasomba ba Farao, abwo bairogete ring’ana ri’Omonene, bakaayerera korenta abasomba babo ne chitugo chiabo inka.
swahili: Wale maafisa wa Farao ambao waliliogopa neno la Bwana wakafanya haraka kuwaleta watumwa wao na mifugo yao ndani.

english: but those who disregarded the word of the LORD left their servants and livestock in the field.
ekegusii: Korende abwo basiereretie ring’ana ri’Omonene, bagatiga abasomba babo ne chitugo chiabo isiko.
swahili: Lakini wale waliopuuza neno la Bwana wakawaacha watumwa wao na mifugo yao shambani.

english: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Stretch out your hand toward heaven, so that hail may fall on all the land of Egypt—on man and beast and every plant of the field throughout the land of Egypt.”
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene agateebia Musa, “Rambora okoboko kwao gochia igoro, erio embura y’amagena etwe ase ense ya Misiri, etwere Mwanyabaanto ne chitugo, na ebimeri bionsi bi’emegondo ase ense yonsi ya Misiri.”
swahili: Ndipo Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Nyoosha mkono wako kuelekea angani ili kwamba mvua ya mawe inyeshe juu ya Misri yote, juu ya watu, wanyama na juu ya kila kitu kiotacho katika mashamba ya Misri.”

english: So Moses stretched out his staff toward heaven, and the LORD sent thunder and hail, and lightning struck the earth. So the LORD rained down hail upon the land of Egypt.
ekegusii: Musa akaimokereria enyimbo yaye gochia igoro, n’Omonene akarenta chinkoba na embura y’amagena, na okomesa gw’enkoba kogaika ase ense. Naboigo Omonene agaitera embura y’amagena igoro ya Misiri.
swahili: Mose alipoinyoosha fimbo yake kuelekea angani, Bwana akatuma ngurumo na mvua ya mawe, umeme wa radi ulimulika hadi nchi. Kwa hiyo Bwana akaifanya mvua ya mawe kunyesha juu ya nchi ya Misri,

english: The hail fell and the lightning continued flashing through it. The hail was so severe that nothing like it had ever been seen in all the land of Egypt from the time it became a nation.
ekegusii: Embura enene y’amagena egatwa, na okomesa gw’enkoba gokagenderera amo nembura eyio. Na embura y’amagena eria yarenge endito mono, eyio omogwekano oye etana gotwa ase ense ya Misiri korwa ekero egesaku ekio giachaagete komenyao.
swahili: mvua ya mawe ikanyesha na radi ikamulika pote. Ikawa dhoruba ya kutisha ambayo haijakuwako katika nchi ya Misri, tangu nchi hiyo iwe taifa.

english: Throughout the land of Egypt, the hail struck down everything in the field, both man and beast; it beat down every plant of the field and stripped every tree.
ekegusii: Embura eria y’amagena egaita Mwanyabaanto bonsi abarenge isiko, amo ne chitugo chionsi ase ense ya Misiri. Egaita na gosaria ebimeri bionsi bi’emegondo, ekabuna na emete yonsi y’orosana.
swahili: Mvua ya mawe ikaharibu kila kitu katika nchi ya Misri kilichokuwa katika mashamba, watu na wanyama, ikaharibu kila kitu kinachoota mashambani na kuvunja kila mti.

english: The only place where it did not hail was in the land of Goshen, where the Israelites lived.
ekegusii: Ase ensemo ya Goseni yoka, ase Abaisraeli bamenyete, nao embura y’amagena etatwete.
swahili: Mahali pekee ambapo mvua ya mawe haikunyesha ni nchi ya Gosheni, ambako Waisraeli waliishi.

english: Then Pharaoh summoned Moses and Aaron. “This time I have sinned,” he said. “The LORD is righteous, and I and my people are wicked.
ekegusii: Farao akarangeria Musa na Aroni, akabateebia, “Ase engaki eye inche nakorire ebibe; Omonene nere omonyene oboronge, inche na abanto baane nabamochi tore.
swahili: Ndipo Farao akawaita Mose na Aroni akawaambia, “Wakati huu nimetenda dhambi. Bwana ni mwenye haki, mimi na watu wangu ni wakosaji.

english: Pray to the LORD, for there has been enough of God’s thunder and hail. I will let you go; you do not need to stay any longer.”
ekegusii: Nsabere ase Omonene. Chinkoba echi amo nembura y’amagena biatonyarire. Nimbae ribaga mogende, timogwenereti mobeere aa goetania.”
swahili: Mwombeni Bwana, kwa kuwa tumepata ngurumo na mvua za mawe za kututosha. Nitawaachia mwondoke; hamtahitaji kungoja zaidi.”

english: Moses said to him, “When I have left the city, I will spread out my hands to the LORD. The thunder will cease, and there will be no more hail, so that you may know that the earth is the LORD’s.
ekegusii: Musa akamoiraneria, “Ekero nkorua ase omochie oo ninyimokie amaboko aane nsabe Omonene. Chinkoba echi nachisire, na embura y’amagena tegotwa goetania. Erio aye onyare komanya ng’a ense ney’Omonene.
swahili: Mose akamjibu, “Nitakapokuwa nimetoka nje ya mji, nitanyoosha mikono yangu juu kumwomba Bwana. Ngurumo zitakoma na hapatakuwepo mvua ya mawe tena, ili upate kujua kuwa, nchi ni mali ya Bwana.

english: then the hand of the LORD will bring a severe plague on your livestock in the field—on your horses, donkeys, camels, herds, and flocks.
ekegusii: erio nario okoboko kw’Omonene koraake chitugo chiao aase chikorisia, ne chibarasi chiao, ne chitigere, ne chingamia, ne chiombe, ne ching’ondi; chirochio chinyore oborwaire obobe mono borachiite.
swahili: mkono wa Bwana utaleta pigo baya kwa mifugo yako, juu ya farasi wako, punda, ngamia, ngʼombe wako, kondoo na mbuzi.

english: But as for you and your officials, I know that you still do not fear the LORD our God.”
ekegusii: Korende nimanyete ng’a, aye na abasomba bao, timomoirogeti Omonene Nyasae nonya mbono.”
swahili: Lakini ninajua kuwa wewe na maafisa wako bado hammwogopi Bwana Mungu.”

english: (Now the flax and barley were destroyed, since the barley was ripe and the flax was in bloom;
ekegusii: Egatani na esairi bigaakwa, bigasarigwa, naki esairi konya yabekire ebigara, na egatani ngosomoria yare.
swahili: (Kitani na shayiri viliharibiwa, kwa kuwa shayiri ilikuwa na masuke, na kitani ilikuwa katika kutoa maua.

english: but the wheat and spelt were not destroyed, because they are late crops.)
ekegusii: Korende chingano tichiasaretigwe, ekiagera konya tichirakina.
swahili: Hata hivyo, ngano na jamii nyingine ya ngano hazikuharibiwa kwa sababu zilikuwa hazijakomaa bado.)

english: Then Moses departed from Pharaoh, went out of the city, and spread out his hands to the LORD. The thunder and hail ceased, and the rain no longer poured down on the land.
ekegusii: Korende Musa akarua o Farao, agasoka isiko yo omochie, akaimokia amaboko aye, agasaba Omonene. Erio chinkoba chiria na embura y’amagena bigatangwa, na embura tiyagenderera gotwa ase ense.
swahili: Kisha Mose akaondoka kwa Farao akaenda nje ya mji. Mose akanyoosha mikono yake kuelekea kwa Bwana, ngurumo na mvua ya mawe vikakoma, mvua haikuendelea tena kunyesha nchini.

english: When Pharaoh saw that the rain and hail and thunder had ceased, he sinned again and hardened his heart—he and his officials.
ekegusii: Ekero Farao aroche ng’a embura y’amagena ne chinkoba biatangirwe, akagenderera gokora ebibe, bagakong’ia chinkoro chiabo ere amo nabasomba baye.
swahili: Farao alipoona kwamba mvua ya mawe na ngurumo zimekoma, akafanya dhambi tena. Yeye na maafisa wake wakafanya mioyo yao kuwa migumu.

english: So Pharaoh’s heart was hardened, and he would not let the Israelites go, just as the LORD had said through Moses.
ekegusii: Enkoro ya Farao ekagenderera koba enkong’u, na buna Omonene konya akwanire goetera ase Musa, akaanga gotiga Abaisraeli bagende.
swahili: Kwa hiyo moyo wa Farao ukawa mgumu, wala hakuwaachia Waisraeli waende, kama vile Bwana alivyokuwa amesema kupitia Mose.

english: But the LORD will make a distinction between the livestock of Israel and the livestock of Egypt, so that no animal belonging to the Israelites will die.’”
ekegusii: Korende Omonene nakore ogwatananeka egati ye chitugo chi’Abaisraeli na echi’Abamisiri. Ase echi’Abaisraeli ende tegokwa nonya neyemo.”
swahili: Lakini Bwana ataweka tofauti kati ya mifugo ya Israeli na ile ya Misri, kwamba hakuna mnyama wa Mwisraeli atakayekufa.’ ”

english: The LORD set a time, saying, “Tomorrow the LORD will do this in the land.”
ekegusii: Omonene agachora engaki, akabora, “Ankio inche Omonene ninchiche nkore ayio ase ense eye.”
swahili: Bwana akaweka wakati na kusema, “Kesho Bwana atalitenda hili katika nchi.”

english: And the next day the LORD did just that. All the livestock of the Egyptians died, but not one animal belonging to the Israelites died.
ekegusii: Rituko ria kabere Omonene agakora buna ateebete. Chitugo chionsi chi’Abamisiri chigakwa, korende echi’Abaisraeli ende tiyakwa nonya neyemo.
swahili: Siku iliyofuata Bwana akalitenda: Mifugo yote ya Wamisri ikafa, lakini hakuna hata mnyama mmoja wa wana wa Israeli aliyekufa.

english: Pharaoh sent officials and found that none of the livestock of the Israelites had died. But Pharaoh’s heart was hardened, and he would not let the people go. The Sixth Plague: Boils
ekegusii: Farao agatoma abanto barigie egiakoregete, na barabwo bakamorentera amang’ana ng’a ase Abaisraeli tugo yabo ende tekweti. Nonya nabo enkoro ya Farao ekagenderera koba enkong’u, tabaa abanto ribaga bagende. Ogoakwa kwa gatan’arimo: Amagumba
swahili: Farao akatuma watu kuchunguza, nao wakakuta kuwa hakuna hata mnyama mmoja wa Waisraeli aliyekufa. Lakini moyo wa Farao haukukubali kuwaachia watu waende. Pigo La Sita: Majipu

english: Then the LORD said to Moses and Aaron, “Take handfuls of soot from the furnace; in the sight of Pharaoh, Moses is to toss it into the air.
ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa na Aroni, “Genda mobuuche ribu riichire roe korwa riko, na Musa arisiare gochia igoro, ase obosio bwa Farao.
swahili: Kisha Bwana akamwambia Mose na Aroni, “Chukueni majivu ya tanuru, naye Mose ayarushe angani mbele ya Farao.

english: It will become fine dust over all the land of Egypt, and festering boils will break out on man and beast throughout the land.”
ekegusii: Narirorio rionchoke ribe orotu, roirurukigwe ase ense yonsi ya Misiri, rorente amagumba na amaote amabe, ase Mwanyabaanto ne chitugo.”
swahili: Yatakuwa vumbi jepesi juu ya nchi yote ya Misri, pia yatatokea majipu yenye kufura juu ya watu na wanyama katika nchi yote.”

english: And I looked and saw above the expanse, above the heads of the cherubim, the likeness of a throne of sapphire.
ekegusii: Nkarigereria, nkarora igoro ase eanga eria yarenge igoro y’emetwe y’ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba egento kenga buna safiro, rigena rikomeka‐meka, nabaachire buna ekerogo ki’obonene.
swahili: Nikatazama, nikaona juu ya ile nafasi iliyokuwa juu ya vichwa vya wale makerubi kulikuwa na kitu mfano wa kiti cha enzi cha yakuti samawi.

english: As for their appearance, all four had the same form, like a wheel within a wheel.
ekegusii: Amagoro aria ane nigo agwekaine, kera okogoro nigo kwaroisirie kogasoanigwa nokonde.
swahili: Kule kuonekana kwake, yote manne yalifanana kila gurudumu lilikuwa kama linazunguka ndani ya lingine.

english: When they moved, they would go in any of the four directions, without turning as they moved. For wherever the head faced, the cherubim would go in that direction, without turning as they moved.
ekegusii: Ekero amagoro ayio arenge kogenda, nigo arenge kogenda ase chinsemo inye chionsi, tarenge koonchoka, akaba akogenda gochia bosio rioka, korende ase okogoro kwa bosio kwarenge kogenda gochia, onsi nigo arenge kobwatia gochiao atari koonchoka ekero akogenda.
swahili: Yalipozunguka, yalikwenda kokote katika pande nne walikoelekea wale makerubi. Magurudumu hayakugeuka wakati makerubi yalipokwenda. Makerubi walikwenda upande wowote kichwa kilikoelekea pasipo kugeuka walipokuwa wakienda.

english: Their entire bodies, including their backs, hands, and wings, were full of eyes all around, as were their four wheels.
ekegusii: Emebere y’ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba baria, na emegongo yabo, na amaboko abo, ne chimbaaba chiabo, amo namagoro aria ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba baria baane babwate, nigo biaichire namaiso ase chinsemo chionsi.
swahili: Miili yao yote, pamoja na migongo yao, mikono na mabawa yao yote yalikuwa yamejaa macho kabisa kama yalivyokuwa yale magurudumu yao manne.

english: I heard the wheels being called “the whirling wheels.”
ekegusii: Nkaigwa amagoro aria akorokwa “Oborundarundia”.
swahili: Nikasikia magurudumu yakiitwa, “Magurudumu ya kisulisuli.”

english: Each of the cherubim had four faces: the first face was that of a cherub, the second that of a man, the third that of a lion, and the fourth that of an eagle.
ekegusii: Kera egetongwa kebwate chimbaba nigo kebwate amasio ane; obosio bw’eritang’ani nigo bwarenge buna obw’egetongwa kebwate chimbaba, na obwa kabere buna obwa Mwanyabaanto, na obwa gatato buna obw’endo, na obwa kane buna obw’ebiongo.
swahili: Kila mmoja wa wale makerubi alikuwa na nyuso nne: Uso mmoja ulikuwa kama vile wa kerubi, uso wa pili ulikuwa wa mwanadamu, uso wa tatu ulikuwa wa simba na uso wa nne ulikuwa wa tai.

english: Then the cherubim rose upward. These were the living creatures I had seen by the River Kebar.
ekegusii: Amakerubi abwo bakaimoka gochia igoro. Ebitongwa ebio nabio biria narooche ang’e norooche rwa Kebari.
swahili: Kisha makerubi wakapaa juu. Hawa ndio wale viumbe walio hai niliowaona kando ya Mto Kebari.

english: When the cherubim moved, the wheels moved beside them, and even when they spread their wings to rise from the ground, the wheels did not veer away from their side.
ekegusii: Ekero ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba baria barenge kogenda naboigo na amagoro aria naro arenge goeta mbarabare yabo, na ekero ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba baria barenge korambora chimbaaba chiabo ase okoimoka gochia igoro, amagoro aria tarenge gwatananeka korwa ase bare.
swahili: Wakati makerubi walipokwenda, magurudumu yaliyoko kando yao yalikwenda na wakati makerubi walipotanda mabawa yao wapate kupaa juu kutoka ardhi, magurudumu yale hayakuondoka pembeni mwao.

english: When the cherubim stood still, the wheels also stood still, and when they ascended, the wheels ascended with them, for the spirit of the living creatures was in the wheels.
ekegusii: Ekero barenge gotenena, na amagoro aria naro atenena; ekero barenge koimoka gochia igoro, na amagoro aria aimoka amo nabarabwo, ekiagera omoika bw’ebitongwa biria nigo orenge ime yabo.
swahili: Makerubi yaliposimama kimya, nayo pia yalitulia kimya, nao makerubi yalipoinuka juu, magurudumu nayo yaliinuka juu pamoja nao, kwa sababu roho ya vile viumbe hai ilikuwa ndani yake.

english: Then the glory of the LORD moved away from the threshold of the temple and stood above the cherubim.
ekegusii: Erio obonene bw’Omonene bokarua ase omoriibo o inse bw’egesieri ki’enyomba y’Omonene, bokagenda bogatenena igoro y’ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba baria.
swahili: Kisha utukufu wa Bwana ukaondoka pale kwenye kizingiti cha Hekalu na kusimama juu ya wale makerubi.

english: As I watched, the cherubim lifted their wings and rose up from the ground, with the wheels beside them as they went. And they stopped at the entrance of the east gate of the house of the LORD, with the glory of the God of Israel above them.
ekegusii: Erio ’nkarora ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba baria bakorambora chimbaaba chiabo na koimokerera igoro korwa ase riroba ekero bagendete, na amagoro aria naro akagenda amo nabarabwo. Bagatenena ase egesoero ki’egeita kia moocha kegochia ase enyomba y’Omonene, na obonene bwa Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli nigo bwarenge igoro yabo.
swahili: Nilipokuwa nikitazama, makerubi yakatanda mabawa yao na kuinuka kutoka ardhini, nao walipokuwa wakienda, yale magurudumu yakaenda pamoja nao. Wakasimama kwenye ingilio la lango la mashariki la nyumba ya Bwana, nao utukufu wa Mungu wa Israeli ukawa juu yao.

english: And the LORD said to the man clothed in linen, “Go inside the wheelwork beneath the cherubim. Fill your hands with burning coals from among the cherubim and scatter them over the city.” And as I watched, he went in.
ekegusii: Omonene agateebia omonto oria obegete eanga y’egatani, “Genda ase egati‐gati y’amagoro aria anga chinyange, are inse y’egetongwa kebwate chimbaba, bwanchare namaboko ao omorero bw’amakara ore ase egati y’ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba baria, oyosiarere igoro y’omochie.” Erio akagenda imorigereretie.
swahili: Bwana akamwambia mtu yule aliyekuwa amevaa nguo ya kitani, “Ingia katikati ya yale Magurudumu yaliyo chini ya makerubi. Ukaijaze mikono yako makaa ya mawe ya moto kutoka katikati ya makerubi na uyatawanye juu ya mji.” Nilipokuwa nikiangalia, akaingia ndani.

english: These were the living creatures I had seen beneath the God of Israel by the River Kebar, and I knew that they were cherubim.
ekegusii: Ebitongwa ebio nabio biria narooche bire inse ya Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli ang’e norooche rwa Kebari, na nkamanya ng’a abwo nebitongwa bibwate chimbaba barenge.
swahili: Hawa walikuwa ndio viumbe hai niliokuwa nimewaona chini ya Mungu wa Israeli kando ya Mto Kebari, nami nikatambua ya kuwa hao walikuwa makerubi.

english: Each had four faces and four wings, with what looked like human hands under their wings.
ekegusii: Kera oyomo nigo abwate amasio ane, ne chimbaaba inye, na inse ya kera orobaaba egento nkiarengeo gekororekana buna okoboko kwa Mwanyabaanto.
swahili: Kila mmoja alikuwa na nyuso nne, mabawa manne, chini ya mabawa yao kulikuwa na kile kilichoonekana kama mikono ya mwanadamu.

english: Their faces looked like the faces I had seen by the River Kebar. Each creature went straight ahead.
ekegusii: Amasio abo nigo agwekaine kegima buna aria narooche agwo ang’e norooche rwa Kebari. Kera oyomo akagenderera gochia bosio atari koonchoka.
swahili: Nyuso zao zilifanana kama zile nilizokuwa nimeziona kando ya Mto Kebari. Kila mmoja alikwenda mbele moja kwa moja.

english: Now when the man went in, the cherubim were standing on the south side of the temple, and a cloud filled the inner court.
ekegusii: Ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba abwo nigo bateneine ensemo ya Irianyi y’enyomba y’Omonene, ekero omonto oria asoeteo, ne riire rigaichora ase eraaro ya ime.
swahili: Basi wale makerubi walikuwa wamesimama upande wa kusini wa Hekalu wakati yule mtu alipoingia ndani, wingu likaujaza ule ukumbi wa ndani.

english: Then the glory of the LORD rose from above the cherubim and stood over the threshold of the temple. The temple was filled with the cloud, and the court was filled with the brightness of the glory of the LORD.
ekegusii: Erio obonene bw’Omonene bokaimokerera igoro, bokarua ase egetongwa kebwate chimbaba oria, bokagenda ase omoriibo o inse bw’egesieri ki’enyomba eria; enyomba eria egaichorwa ne riire, na eraaro egaichorwa nobomeka‐meku bw’obonene bw’Omonene.
swahili: Kisha utukufu wa Bwana ukainuka kutoka juu ya wale makerubi ukaenda kwenye kizingiti cha Hekalu. Wingu likajaza Hekalu, nao ukumbi ukajawa na mngʼao wa utukufu wa Bwana.

english: The sound of the wings of the cherubim could be heard as far as the outer court, like the voice of God Almighty when He speaks.
ekegusii: Eriogi ri’ogoakania chimbaaba chi’ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba baria rikaigugwa ase eraaro ya isiko, buna eriogi ria Nyasae Omobui ekero agokwana.
swahili: Sauti ya mabawa ya wale makerubi ingeweza kusikika mpaka kwenye ukumbi wa nje, kama sauti ya Mungu Mwenyezi wakati anapoongea.

english: When the LORD commanded the man clothed in linen, saying, “Take fire from within the wheelwork, from among the cherubim,” the man went in and stood beside a wheel.
ekegusii: Ekero Omonene achiigete omonto oria obegete eanga y’egatani agende korusia omorero korwa ase egati‐gati y’amagoro aria anga chinyange, korwa ase egati‐gati y’ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba, omonto oria agasoa agatenena ang’e nokomo kw’amagoro aria.
swahili: Bwana alipomwamuru yule mtu aliyevaa nguo za kitani akisema, “Chukua moto toka katikati ya magurudumu, kutoka katikati ya makerubi,” yule mtu aliingia ndani akasimama pembeni mwa gurudumu.

english: Then one of the cherubim reached out his hand and took some of the fire that was among them. And he put it into the hands of the man clothed in linen, who received it and went out.
ekegusii: Omokerubi oria oyomo akarambora okoboko kwaye ase egati‐gati y’ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba bande, na agaanchara omorero bw’amakara orenge ase egati‐gati y’ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba baria bande, akayobeka ase amaboko ’omonto oria obegete eanga y’egatani, na omonto oria akayobogoria, agasoka n’oro isiko.
swahili: Ndipo mmoja wa wale makerubi akanyoosha mkono wake kwenye moto uliokuwa katikati yao. Akachukua baadhi ya moto na kuutia mikononi mwa yule mtu aliyevaa mavazi ya kitani, naye akaupokea akatoka nje.

english: (The cherubim appeared to have the form of human hands under their wings.)
ekegusii: Nkarora inse ye chimbaaba chi’ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba baria egento gekororekana buna okoboko kw’omonto.
swahili: (Chini ya mabawa ya makerubi paliweza kuonekana kitu kilichofanana na mikono ya mwanadamu.)

english: Then I looked and saw four wheels beside the cherubim, one wheel beside each cherub. And the wheels gleamed like a beryl stone.
ekegusii: Nkarigereria nkarora amagoro aria anga chinyange ane mbarabare y’ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba, okomo kore ang’e ase kera egetongwa kebwate chimbaba. Amagoro aria nigo arenge kororekana anga buna kurusolito, rigena rikomeka‐meka.
swahili: Nikatazama, nikaona magurudumu manne kando ya makerubi, moja kando ya kila kerubi. Magurudumu hayo yalimetameta kama kito cha zabarajadi.

english: Then the Spirit lifted me up and brought me to the gate of the house of the LORD that faces east. And there at the entrance of the gate were twenty-five men. Among them I saw Jaazaniah son of Azzur and Pelatiah son of Benaiah, who were leaders of the people.
ekegusii: Omoika okanyimokereria igoro, okang’ira ase egeita ki’enyomba y’Omonene kiarochie moocha. Na rora, agwo ase egesieri ki’egeita mbarengeo abasacha emerongo ebere, na batano, na ase egati yabo nkarora Yasania, mosinto bw’Asuri, na Peletia, mosinto o Benaya, abwo barenge abagaambi b’ abanto.
swahili: Ndipo Roho akaniinua na kunileta mpaka kwenye lango la nyumba ya Bwana linalotazama upande wa mashariki. Pale kwenye ingilio la lango kulikuwepo wanaume ishirini na watano, nami nikaona miongoni mwao Yaazania mwana wa Azuri na Pelatia mwana wa Benaya, viongozi wa watu.

english: You will fall by the sword, and I will judge you even to the borders of Israel. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
ekegusii: Inwe imoitwe nemioro. Nimbanachere ekiina agwo ase ribebe ri’Abaisraeli. Erio momanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene.
swahili: Mtaanguka kwa upanga, nami nitatimiza hukumu dhidi yenu katika mipaka ya Israeli. Ndipo mtajua kuwa Mimi ndimi Bwana.

english: The city will not be a pot for you, nor will you be the meat within it. I will judge you even to the borders of Israel.
ekegusii: Omochie oyo tori gochia koba buna enyang’eni ase more, na inwe timori koba chinyama ime yaye; inche nimbanachere ekiina agwo ase ribebe ri’Abaisraeli.
swahili: Mji huu hautakuwa chungu kwa ajili yenu, wala hamtakuwa nyama ndani yake. Nitatoa hukumu dhidi yenu katika mipaka ya Israeli.

english: Then you will know that I am the LORD. For you have neither followed My statutes nor practiced My ordinances, but you have conformed to the ordinances of the nations around you.” A Promise of Restoration (Jeremiah 32:36–44)
ekegusii: Erio momanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene. Inwe mwangire kobwatia emeroberio y’ane echiikire, gose timori gokora aya nachiikire, korende nigo mogokora koreng’ana namachiiko y’ abanto b’ebisaku ebio bibaetanaine.”
swahili: Nanyi mtajua ya kuwa Mimi ndimi Bwana, kwa kuwa hamkufuata amri zangu wala kuzishika sheria zangu, bali mmefuata mwenendo wa mataifa yanayowazunguka.”

english: Now as I was prophesying, Pelatiah son of Benaiah died. Then I fell facedown and cried out in a loud voice, “Oh, Lord GOD, will You bring the remnant of Israel to a complete end?”
ekegusii: Ekero nagendererete kobana, Pelatia, mosinto o Benaya, agakwa. Erio ’ngatung’ama inse maumama, ’nkarera neriogi rinene, ’nkabora, “Aye Omonene, Inee, nigo ogochia goita osirie kegima abatigari b’Abaisraeli?” Eira ya Nyasae ase abooswa
swahili: Basi nilipokuwa ninatoa unabii, Pelatia mwana wa Benaya akafa. Ndipo nikaanguka kifudifudi, nikalia kwa sauti kuu nikasema, “Ee Bwana Mwenyezi! Je utaangamiza kabisa mabaki ya Israeli?”

english: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
ekegusii: Ring’ana ri’Omonene rigaacha asende, riganteebia,
swahili: Neno la Bwana likanijia kusema:

english: “Son of man, your brothers—your relatives, your fellow exiles, and the whole house of Israel—are those of whom the people of Jerusalem have said, ‘They are far away from the LORD; this land has been given to us as a possession.’
ekegusii: “Aye Mwanyabaanto, abanto bamenyete Yerusalemu nigo bagokwana igoro y’ abanto bamino b’egesaku kiao, ee, igoro y’Abaisraeli bonsi, bagoteeba: Barabwo nigo bare aare korwa ase Omonene, ense eye nintwe twaeirwe ebe eyaito.
swahili: “Mwanadamu, ndugu zako, ndugu zako ambao ni wa uhusiano wa damu na nyumba yote ya Israeli, ndio wale ambao watu wa Yerusalemu wamesema, ‘Wako mbali na Bwana; nchi hii tulipewa sisi kuwa milki yetu.’ Ahadi Ya Kurudi Kwa Israeli

english: Therefore declare that this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Although I sent them far away among the nations and scattered them among the countries, yet for a little while I have been a sanctuary for them in the countries to which they have gone.’
ekegusii: “Ase ayio obateebie ng’a aya naro Omonene agoteeba: Nonya nabaseririe gochia aare ase egati y’ abanto b’ebisaku na kobasiarera gochia ase chinse chionsi, inche omonyene nabeire inde obomenyo bwabo obochenu ase engaki eyio enke, agwo ase chinse echio baseretigwe gochia.
swahili: “Kwa hiyo sema, ‘Hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo: Ingawa niliwapeleka mbali miongoni mwa mataifa na kuwatawanya katika nchi mbalimbali, lakini kwa kitambo kidogo mimi nimekuwa mahali patakatifu kwao katika nchi walizokwenda.’

english: Therefore declare that this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘I will gather you from the peoples and assemble you from the countries to which you have been scattered, and I will give back to you the land of Israel.’
ekegusii: “Ase ayio obateebie ng’a aya naro Omonene agoteeba: Nimbasangererie korwa ase abanto b’ebisaku, na korwa ase chinse echio ase nabasiarerete gochia, erio mbairanie inwe Abaisraeli, ’mbae ense yaino.
swahili: “Kwa hiyo sema: ‘Hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo: Nitawakusanyeni kutoka mataifa na kuwarudisha kutoka nchi ambazo mmetawanywa, nami nitawarudishia nchi ya Israeli.’

english: When they return to it, they will remove all its detestable things and all its abominations.
ekegusii: Ekero barabe bairanire ase ense eyio, mbatugute korwa aroro emegwekano egosasiimwa y’obosooku, na okogechia gwonsi.
swahili: “Watairudia nchi na kuondoa vinyago vyote vya upotovu na sanamu zote za machukizo.

english: And I will give them singleness of heart and put a new spirit within them; I will remove their heart of stone and give them a heart of flesh,
ekegusii: Ekero ekio nimbae enkoro eyemo, naende mbeke omoika omoyia ime yabo. Nindusie korwa ase bare chinkoro chire chinkong’u buna rigena, erio mbae echire chinyororo buna chinyama.
swahili: Nitawapa moyo mmoja na kuweka roho mpya ndani yao, nitaondoa kutoka ndani yao moyo wa jiwe na kuwapa moyo wa nyama.

english: And the LORD said to me, “Son of man, these are the men who plot evil and give wicked counsel in this city.
ekegusii: Omonene aganteebia, “Aye Mwanyabaanto, abanto aba nabwo bagokora emeroberio y’ogokora ebibe na korua ogoseemia kw’ogokora amabe ase omochie oyo.
swahili: Bwana akaniambia, “Mwanadamu, hawa ndio wafanyao hila na kutoa mashauri potovu katika mji huu.

english: so that they may follow My statutes, keep My ordinances, and practice them. Then they will be My people, and I will be their God.
ekegusii: Erio nario barabwatie emeroberio y’ane echiikire, babwatie na amachiiko ane na koyaigwera. Barabwo mbabe abanto bane, na inche nimbe Nyasae obo.
swahili: Kisha watafuata amri zangu na kuwa waangalifu kutii sheria zangu. Watakuwa watu wangu nami nitakuwa Mungu wao.

english: But as for those whose hearts pursue detestable things and abominations, I will bring their conduct down upon their own heads, declares the Lord GOD.” God’s Glory Leaves Jerusalem
ekegusii: Korende abanto abwo chinkoro chiabo chikobwatia emegwekano bagosasiima y’obosooku na okogechia, barabwo imbaakane ogokora kwabo kobairanere.” Nabo Omonene agoteeba. Obonene bwa Nyasae bogotiga Yerusalemu
swahili: Lakini kwa wale ambao mioyo yao imeambatana na vinyago vyao vya upotovu na sanamu zao za machukizo, nitaleta juu ya vichwa vyao yale waliyotenda asema Bwana Mwenyezi.”

english: Then the cherubim, with the wheels beside them, spread their wings, and the glory of the God of Israel was above them.
ekegusii: Erio ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba bikarambora chimbaaba chiabo, na amagoro arenge mbarabare yabo; na obonene bwa Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli bokaba igoro yabo.
swahili: Ndipo wale makerubi, wenye magurudumu pembeni mwao, wakakunjua mabawa yao, nao utukufu wa Mungu wa Israeli ulikuwa juu yao.

english: And the glory of the LORD rose up from within the city and stood over the mountain east of the city.
ekegusii: Erio obonene bw’Omonene bokaimokerera igoro korwa ase omochie oria, bokagenda bogatenena igoro ase egetunwa kere moocha y’omochie.
swahili: Basi utukufu wa Bwana ukapaa juu kutoka mji, ukatua juu ya mlima ulio upande wa mashariki ya mji.

english: And the Spirit lifted me up and carried me back to Chaldea, to the exiles in the vision given by the Spirit of God. After the vision had gone up from me,
ekegusii: Ase okorora naetwe, Omoika o Nyasae okanyimokereria igoro, okang’ira ase ense y’Abakalidayo, ase abanto abwo boosetwe barenge. Nyuma y’ayio okorora koria narooche gokarua asende.
swahili: Roho akaniinua na kunileta mpaka kwa watu wa uhamisho huko Ukaldayo nikiwa katika yale maono niliyopewa na Roho wa Mungu. Ndipo maono niliyokuwa nimeyaona yakanitoka,

english: I told the exiles everything the LORD had shown me.
ekegusii: Erio ngateebia abanto abwo bonsi boosetwe amang’ana onsi ay’Omonene konya anyorokirie.
swahili: nami nikawaeleza wale watu wa uhamisho kila kitu Bwana alichokuwa amenionyesha.

english: They are saying, ‘Is not the time near to build houses? The city is the cooking pot, and we are the meat.’
ekegusii: Barabwo nigo bagoteeba ng’a engaki teraika ang’e tokoagacha chinyomba; omochie oyo n’enyang’eni ekoiyeka, na intwe nechinyama.
swahili: Wao husema, ‘Je, hivi karibuni hautakuwa wakati wa kujenga nyumba? Mji huu ni chungu cha kupikia, nasi ndio nyama.’

english: Therefore prophesy against them; prophesy, O son of man!”
ekegusii: Ase ayio, aye Mwanyabaanto, bana ayare mamincha, yabo; ee baabaanere.”
swahili: Kwa hiyo toa unabii dhidi yao, tabiri, Ewe mwanadamu.”

english: And the Spirit of the LORD fell upon me and told me to declare that this is what the LORD says: “That is what you are thinking, O house of Israel; and I know the thoughts that arise in your minds.
ekegusii: Omoika bw’Omonene ogaacha igoro ase inde, oganteebia, “Bateebie ng’a aya naro Omonene agoteeba: Inwe Abaisraeli, naboigo mogokwana; inche nigo imanyete ayare ase chinkoro chiaino ime.
swahili: Kisha Roho wa Bwana akaja juu yangu, naye akaniambia niseme: “Hili ndilo Bwana asemalo: Hili ndilo ninyi mnalosema, ee nyumba ya Israeli, lakini ninajua mnalowaza mioyoni mwenu.

english: You have multiplied those you killed in this city and filled its streets with the dead.
ekegusii: Mwaitire abanto abange goetania, ase omochie oyo, mwaichoirie chinchera chiaye nebitondo.
swahili: Mmewaua watu wengi katika mji huu na kujaza barabara zake maiti.

english: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: The slain you have laid within this city are the meat, and the city is the pot; but I will remove you from it.
ekegusii: “Ase ayio, aya naro Omonene agoteeba: Abwo mwaitire baraire ase omochie ime nabwo chinyama, na omochie oyo n’oro enyang’eni ekoiyeka; korende inwe abanyene nimbasokie korwa ase omochie oyo.
swahili: “Kwa hiyo hili ndilo asemalo Bwana Mwenyezi: maiti ulizozitupa huko ni nyama na mji huu ni chungu, lakini nitawaondoa mtoke huko.

english: You fear the sword, so I will bring the sword against you, declares the Lord GOD.
ekegusii: Inwe nigo moirogete ogoitwa nemioro, nindete emioro ebaite. Nab’Omonene ateebire.
swahili: Mnaogopa upanga, nao upanga huo ndio nitakaouleta juu yenu, asema Bwana Mwenyezi.

english: I will bring you out of the city and deliver you into the hands of foreigners, and I will execute judgments against you.
ekegusii: Nimbarusie ase omochie oyo, mbabeeke ase amaboko y’ abanto abaao, na ’mbanachere ekiina.
swahili: Nitawaondoa mtoke katika mji na kuwatia mikononi mwa wageni nami nitawaadhibu.

english: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
ekegusii: Ring’ana ri’Omonene rigaacha asende, riganteebia:
swahili: Neno la Bwana likanijia kusema:

english: Tell them that this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘This burden concerns the prince in Jerusalem and all the house of Israel who are there.’
ekegusii: Bono obairanerie, obateebie: Aya naro Omonene agoteeba: Okoorokerigwa oko nigo kore igoro y’omogaambi o Yerusalemu, amo n’Abaisraeli bonsi bare imeo.
swahili: “Waambie, ‘Hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo: Neno hili linamhusu mkuu aliye katika Yerusalemu na nyumba yote ya Israeli ambao wako huko.’

english: You are to say, ‘I am a sign to you.’ Just as it happened here, so will it be done to them; they will go into exile as captives.
ekegusii: Obateebie ng’a aye nigo ore ekemanyererio ase bare, na buna aye gwakorire nabarabwo nabo barakore, mbang’anyigwe bairwe ase obosomba.
swahili: Waambie, ‘Mimi ndiye ishara kwenu.’ “Kama vile nilivyotenda, basi litatendeka vivyo hivyo kwao. Watakwenda uhamishoni kama mateka.

english: And at dusk the prince among them will lift his bags to his shoulder and go out. They will dig through the wall to bring him out. He will cover his face so he cannot see the land.
ekegusii: Omogambi ore ase egati yabo naimokie ebinto biaye abibeke ireko agende; ekero omosunte ochire abochore ekebao ase enyasi aetereo; nigo aratube obosio bwaye tabaisa korora ense namaiso aye.
swahili: “Naye mkuu aliye miongoni mwao atabeba mizigo yake begani mwake kwenye giza la jioni na kuondoka na tundu litatobolewa ukutani kwa ajili yake ili kupitia hapo. Atafunika uso wake ili kwamba asiweze kuiona nchi.

english: But I will spread My net over him, and he will be caught in My snare. I will bring him to Babylon, the land of the Chaldeans; yet he will not see it, and there he will die.
ekegusii: Nimobekere ekeonga kiane abwatwe ase oboreba bwane; erio imoire Babiloni, ase ense y’Abakalidayo; nonya naboigo takoyerora namaiso aye, korende nao arakwere.
swahili: Nitatandaza wavu wangu kwa ajili yake, naye atanaswa kwenye mtego wangu, nitamleta mpaka Babeli, nchi ya Wakaldayo, lakini hataiona, naye atafia huko.

english: And I will scatter to every wind all the attendants around him and all his troops, and I will draw a sword to chase after them.
ekegusii: Ninsiarere gochia ase chinsemo chionsi abanto bonsi abamoetanaine ase okomokonya, na abarwani baye bonsi b’esegi boigo, naende nimbabwatie n’omoro one.
swahili: Wote wanaomzunguka nitawatawanya pande zote, watumishi wake na majeshi yake yote, nami nitawafuatilia kwa upanga uliofutwa.

english: And they will know that I am the LORD, when I disperse them among the nations and scatter them throughout the countries.
ekegusii: “Ekero ndabaserie gochia ase abanto b’ebisaku na mbasiarere gochia ase chinse ching’ao, barabwo ’mbamanye ng’a ninche Omonene.
swahili: “Wao watajua kwamba Mimi ndimi Bwana, nitakapowatawanya miongoni mwa mataifa na kuwafukuza huku na huko katika nchi zote.

english: But I will spare a few of them from sword and famine and plague, so that in the nations to which they go, they can recount all their abominations. Then they will know that I am the LORD.”
ekegusii: Korende nintigarie abanto bake korwa ase egati yabo bataitwe nemioro, gose nenchara, gose noborwaire bogoita, erinde kobare agwo ase egati y’ abanto b’ebisaku ase barairwe, banyare koorokia ebibe biabo bi’okogechia bakorire. Erio ’mbamanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene.” Omobani okoiguswa ore ekiorokererio
swahili: Lakini nitawaacha wachache wao waokoke na upanga, njaa na tauni, ili kwamba katika mataifa watakakokwenda waweze kutambua matendo ya machukizo waliotenda. Ndipo watajua kuwa Mimi ndimi Bwana.”

english: Moreover, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
ekegusii: Ring’ana ri’Omonene rigaacha asende, riganteebia:
swahili: Neno la Bwana likanijia kusema:

english: “Son of man, eat your bread with trembling, and drink your water with quivering and anxiety.
ekegusii: “Aye Mwanyabaanto, karie endagera yao kore nomoondoko, na onywe amaache ao gokoiguswa na gochandeka.
swahili: “Mwanadamu, tetemeka wakati ulapo chakula chako, tetemeka kwa hofu wakati unywapo maji yako.

english: Then tell the people of the land that this is what the Lord GOD says about those living in Jerusalem and in the land of Israel: ‘They will eat their bread with anxiety and drink their water in dread, for their land will be stripped of everything in it because of the violence of all who dwell in it.
ekegusii: Oteebie abanto bamenyete ase ense eye ng’a aya naro Omonene agoteeba igoro y’ abanto bamenyete Yerusalemu ase ense y’Abaisraeli: Barabwo mbarie endagera yabo bare nomoichano na mbanywe amaache abo bare nobwoba, ekiagera ense yabo nesakorwe na ebinto bionsi bireo, etigwe ere bosa ase engencho y’obobe obwo abanto bareo bakorire.
swahili: Waambie watu wa nchi: ‘Hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo kuhusu hao wanaoishi Yerusalemu na katika nchi ya Israeli: Watakula chakula chao kwa wasiwasi na kunywa maji yao kwa kufadhaika, kwa kuwa nchi yao itanyangʼanywa kila kitu chake kwa sababu ya udhalimu wa wote wanaoishi humo.

english: “Son of man, you are living in a rebellious house. They have eyes to see but do not see, and ears to hear but do not hear, for they are a rebellious house.
ekegusii: “Aye Mwanyabaanto omenyete ase egati y’ abanto batari koigwera; abwo babwate amaiso akorigereria, korende tibari korora, na amato agotegerera, korende tibari koigwa, ekiagera barabwo tibari koigwera.
swahili: “Mwanadamu, unaishi miongoni mwa watu waasi. Wana macho ya kuona, lakini hawaoni na masikio ya kusikia lakini hawasikii, kwa kuwa ni watu waasi.

english: The inhabited cities will be laid waste, and the land will become desolate. Then you will know that I am the LORD.’” The Presumptuous Proverb
ekegusii: Emechie eyio emenyire nesarigwe kegima, na ense etigwe ere bosa. Erio nario moramanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene.” Ogoikeranigwa kw’obobani kore ang’e
swahili: Miji inayokaliwa na watu itaharibiwa na nchi itakuwa ukiwa. Ndipo mtakapojua kwamba Mimi ndimi Bwana.’ ”

english: Again the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
ekegusii: Naende ring’ana ri’Omonene rigaacha asende, riganteebia:
swahili: Neno la Bwana likanijia kusema:

english: “Son of man, what is this proverb that you have in the land of Israel: ‘The days go by, and every vision fails’?
ekegusii: “Aye Mwanyabaanto, mebayeno ki eye mogokwana ase ense y’Abaisraeli, mogoteeba: Amatuko abaanetwe abeire amaange mono, na amaroro y’obobani abeire bosa?
swahili: “Mwanadamu, ni nini hii mithali mlio nayo katika nchi ya Israeli: ‘Siku zinapita na hakuna maono yoyote yanayotimia?’

english: Therefore tell them that this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘I will put an end to this proverb, and in Israel they will no longer recite it.’ But say to them: ‘The days are at hand when every vision will be fulfilled.
ekegusii: Ase ayio bateebie ng’a aya naro Omonene agoteeba: Ninsirie emebayeno eyio, tibayekwana naende ase ense y’Abaisraeli. Korende bateebie: Amatuko ayio abeire ang’e, na amaroro onsi y’obobani goika aikeranigwe.
swahili: Waambie, ‘Hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo: Nitaikomesha mithali hii, nao hawataitumia tena katika Israeli.’ Waambie, ‘Siku zimekaribia wakati kila maono yatakapotimizwa.

english: For there will be no more false visions or flattering divinations within the house of Israel,
ekegusii: “Amaroro y’obobani y’okong’ainereria, gose oboringoria bw’okweansia, tibikoba ase egati y’Abaisraeli nonya ng’ake.
swahili: Kwa maana hapatakuwepo tena na maono ya uongo wala ubashiri wa udanganyifu miongoni mwa watu wa Israeli.

english: because I, the LORD, will speak whatever word I speak, and it will be fulfilled without delay. For in your days, O rebellious house, I will speak a message and bring it to pass, declares the Lord GOD.’”
ekegusii: Inche Omonene ninkwane ring’ana nganetie gokwana, na rirorio goika riikerane, tirigoteebana nonya ng’ake. Inwe egesaku getari koigwera, ase amatuko aino ninkwane ring’ana ndiikeranie. Nabo inche Omonene nateebire.”
swahili: Lakini Mimi Bwana nitasema neno nitakalo, nalo litatimizwa bila kuchelewa. Kwa maana katika siku zako, wewe nyumba ya kuasi, nitatimiza kila nisemalo, asema Bwana Mwenyezi.’ ”

english: Furthermore, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
ekegusii: Naende ring’ana ri’Omonene rigaacha asende, riganteebia:
swahili: Neno la Bwana likanijia kusema:

english: “Son of man, take note that the house of Israel is saying, ‘The vision that he sees is for many years from now; he prophesies about the distant future.’
ekegusii: “Aye Mwanyabaanto, Abaisraeli nigo bagoteeba iga: Okorora koria ere arorire nokw’amatuko atabe bwango; nigo akobana igoro ye chingaki chikare aare chitaracha.
swahili: “Mwanadamu, nyumba ya Israeli inasema, ‘Maono yale anayoyaona ni kwa ajili ya miaka mingi ijayo, naye hutabiri kuhusu siku zijazo zilizo mbali.’

english: Therefore tell them that this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘None of My words will be delayed any longer. The message I speak will be fulfilled, declares the Lord GOD.’”
ekegusii: Ase ayio obateebie ng’a aya naro Omonene agoteeba: Amang’ana ane tagoteebana nonya ng’ake taikeranigwa, onsi aya nakwanire goika aikeranigwe. Ninche Omonene nakwanire.”
swahili: “Kwa hiyo, waambie, ‘Hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo: Hakuna maneno yangu yatakayocheleweshwa tena zaidi, lolote nisemalo litatimizwa, asema Bwana Mwenyezi.’ ”

english: Therefore, son of man, pack your bags for exile. In broad daylight, set out from your place and go to another as they watch. Perhaps they will understand, though they are a rebellious house.
ekegusii: “Ase ayio, aye Mwanyabaanto, ebeke ang’e amo n’ebinto biao, obe buna omonto okong’anya korwa ase ense yaye, ong’anye mobaso ekero abanto barooche. Ong’anye korwa aase ao otaare goika aase aande kobarooche. Ande nabo barabaise komanya nonya bare abanto batari koigwera.
swahili: “Kwa hiyo, mwanadamu, funga mizigo yako kwa kwenda uhamishoni tena wakati wa mchana, wakiwa wanakutazama, toka nje na uende mahali pengine kutoka hapo ulipo. Labda wataelewa, ingawa wao ni nyumba ya kuasi.

english: Bring out your baggage for exile by day, as they watch. Then in the evening, as they watch, go out like those who go into exile.
ekegusii: Osokie ebinto biao isiko mobaso kobarooche, ebinto buna ebi’oyo okong’anya korwa ase ense yaye, na rigoika mogoroba, ogende aye bweka kobarooche, buna oyo okong’anya korwa ase ense yaye.
swahili: Wakati wa mchana, wakiwa wanakutazama, toa nje mizigo yako iliyofungwa kwa ajili ya kwenda uhamishoni. Kisha wakati wa jioni, wakiwa wanakutazama toka nje kama wale waendao uhamishoni.

english: As they watch, dig through the wall and carry your belongings out through it.
ekegusii: Obochore ekebao ase enyasi ekero abanto abwo bakorooche, erio obogorie ebinto biao oetereo.
swahili: Wakiwa wanakutazama, toboa ukuta utolee mizigo yako hapo.

english: And as they watch, lift your bags to your shoulder and take them out at dusk; cover your face so that you cannot see the land. For I have made you a sign to the house of Israel.”
ekegusii: Ekero omosunte ochire, obeke ebinto biao ireko, ekero abanto bakorigereretie. Otube obosio bwao torora ense, ekiagera nagokorire aye obe ekemanyererio ase egesaku ki’Abaisraeli.”
swahili: Beba mizigo hiyo begani mwako wakikuangalia uichukue nje wakati wa giza la jioni. Funika uso wako ili usione nchi, kwa maana nimekufanya ishara kwa nyumba ya Israeli.”

english: So I did as I was commanded. I brought out my bags for exile by day, and in the evening I dug through the wall by hand. I took my belongings out at dusk, carrying them on my shoulder as they watched.
ekegusii: Inche ngakora buna nachigetwe; mobaso gati ngasokia ebinto biane isiko, nkaba buna nkong’anya inde, na riachia koba mogoroba, nkabochora enyasi namaboko ane. Ekero omosunte ochire, nkabeka ebinto biane ireko, nkagenda ekero abanto barigereretie.
swahili: Basi nikafanya kama nilivyoamriwa. Wakati wa mchana nilitoa vitu vyangu nje vilivyofungwa tayari kwa uhamishoni. Kisha wakati wa jioni nikatoboa ukuta kwa mikono yangu. Nikachukua mizigo yangu nje wakati wa giza la jioni, nikiwa nimeibeba mabegani mwangu huku wakinitazama.

english: And in the morning the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
ekegusii: Rituko ria kabere mambia, ring’ana ri’Omonene rigaacha asende, riganteebia:
swahili: Asubuhi neno la Bwana likanijia kusema:

english: “Son of man, hasn’t the rebellious house of Israel asked you, ‘What are you doing?’
ekegusii: “Aye Mwanyabaanto, ekeene, Abaisraeli abwo batari koigwera mbakoborie ng’a ninki ekio ogokora.
swahili: “Mwanadamu, je, nyumba ile ya kuasi ya Israeli haikukuuliza, ‘Unafanya nini?’

english: Because they have led My people astray, saying, ‘Peace,’ when there is no peace, and whitewashing any flimsy wall that is built,
ekegusii: “Abaabani abwo basiririe abanto bane, babaebereirie na kobateebia: Omorembe; na omorembe tori aande. Ekero abanto baagachire orwaki barabwo nigo bakoroaka echooka etochoganiri buya.
swahili: “ ‘Kwa sababu ni kweli wanapotosha watu wangu, wakisema, “Amani,” wakati ambapo hakuna amani, pia kwa sababu, wakati ukuta dhaifu unapojengwa, wanaufunika kwa kupaka chokaa,

english: tell those whitewashing the wall that it will fall. Rain will come in torrents, I will send hailstones plunging down, and a windstorm will burst forth.
ekegusii: Ase ayio goika oteebie ababani abwo bagoaka orwaki orwo echooka eyio ng’a orwaki orwo narogwe. Embura y’omoubera netwe amo namagena amanene, na ekembugu‐mbugu biroiyerie inse.
swahili: kwa hiyo waambie hao wanaoupaka chokaa isiyokorogwa vyema kwamba ukuta huo utaanguka. Mvua kubwa ya mafuriko itanyesha, nami nitaleta mvua ya mawe inyeshe kwa nguvu, nao upepo wa dhoruba utavuma juu yake.

english: Surely when the wall has fallen, you will not be asked, ‘Where is the whitewash with which you covered it?’
ekegusii: Ekero orwaki orwo rorabe rwagure inse, Inee, abanto tibakobaboria: Ng’ai echooka eria mwaroagete ere bono?
swahili: Wakati ukuta utakapoanguka, je, watu hawatawauliza, “Iko wapi chokaa mliyopaka ukuta?”

english: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: In My wrath I will release a windstorm, and in My anger torrents of rain and hail will fall with destructive fury.
ekegusii: “Ase ayio, aya naro Omonene agoteeba: Nintome ekembugu‐mbugu inde nendamwamu na ekeririanda, nintome embura ere ne chinguru, naende ase endamwamu y’ane nintome embura ere namagena amanene, nsarie bionsi kegima.
swahili: “ ‘Kwa hiyo hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo: Katika ghadhabu yangu nitauachia upepo wa dhoruba, pia katika hasira yangu mvua ya mawe na mvua ya mafuriko itanyesha ikiwa na ghadhabu ya kuangamiza.

english: I will tear down the wall you whitewashed and level it to the ground, so that its foundation is exposed. The city will fall, and you will be destroyed within it. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
ekegusii: Erio ing’iyerie inse orwaki orwo mwaagete echooka, erinde oboroso bwaye botuborwe. Ekero orwaki orwo roragwe, inwe ina moitwe mokwereo. Erio nario moramanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene.
swahili: Nitaubomoa ukuta mlioupaka chokaa na kuuangusha chini ili msingi wake uachwe wazi. Utakapoanguka, mtaangamizwa ndani yake, nanyi mtajua kuwa Mimi ndimi Bwana.

english: And after I have vented My wrath against the wall and against those who whitewashed it, I will say to you: ‘The wall is gone, and so are those who whitewashed it—
ekegusii: “Ase ayio ning’umore endamwamu y’ane eerere ase okoiyeria orwaki roria na gosiria baria baroagete echooka eria. Erio nimbateebie: Orwaki roria tiroiyo, nonya mbaria baroagete echooka tibaiyo.
swahili: Hivyo ndivyo nitakavyoitimiza ghadhabu yangu dhidi ya huo ukuta na dhidi yao walioupaka chokaa. Nitawaambia ninyi, “Ukuta umebomoka na vivyo hivyo wale walioupaka chokaa,

english: those prophets of Israel who prophesied to Jerusalem and saw a vision of peace for her when there was no peace, declares the Lord GOD.’ Reproof of False Prophetesses
ekegusii: Abwo nabwo barenge ababani baria b’Abaisraeli baabaanete igoro ya Yerusalemu, na barooche amaroro y’omorembe, nonya omorembe torengeo. Nabo Omonene ateebire. Obobani bore mamincha y’ababani abakungu abang’ainereria
swahili: wale manabii wa Israeli waliotabiri juu ya Yerusalemu na kuona maono ya amani kwa ajili yake wakati kulipokuwa hakuna amani, asema Bwana Mwenyezi.” ’

english: Now, O son of man, set your face against the daughters of your people who prophesy out of their own imagination. Prophesy against them
ekegusii: “Aye Mwanyabaanto, barigererie abakungu b’ abanto bao, abwo bakobana amang’ana akorwa ase ebirengererio biabo abanyene, obaane amang’ana are mamincha yabo.
swahili: “Sasa, mwanadamu, kaza uso wako dhidi ya binti za watu wako wanaotabiri mambo kutoka mawazo yao wenyewe. Tabiri dhidi yao

english: and tell them that this is what the Lord GOD says: Woe to the women who sew magic charms on their wrists and make veils for the heads of people of every height, in order to ensnare their souls. Will you ensnare the souls of My people but preserve your own?
ekegusii: Obateebie ng’a aya naro Omonene agoteeba. “Obobe nobwabo abakungu abwo bakobareera ebimoya bire namaebi, babisiba ase amaboko abo, naende baabareera ebitambaa bagotuba emetwe y’ abanto abake na abanene, erinde baabarichania. Inee! Inwe abakungu aba, nigo mogochia korigia abanto bane na kobarichania, mobasirie, erinde inwe mogenderere koba moyo na kwenyorera ebitoki?
swahili: na useme, ‘Hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo: Ole wao wanawake washonao hirizi za uchawi juu ya viwiko vyao vyote na kutengeneza shela za urefu wa aina mbalimbali kwa ajili ya kufunika vichwa vyao kwa makusudi ya kuwanasa watu. Je, mtatega uhai wa watu wangu lakini ninyi mponye wa kwenu?

english: You have profaned Me among My people for handfuls of barley and scraps of bread. By lying to My people who would listen, you have killed those who should not have died and spared those who should not have lived.
ekegusii: Inwe mwankorire nabeire buna nigo inde oyotachenegeti ase egati y’ abanto bane, ase okogania esairi eichire roe, na ebisamunye bi’omogati. Mwaitire abatagwenerete goitwa, na abagwenerete goitwa mwabatigire koba moyo. Ayio nigo mwayakorire ase okong’ainereria abanto bane, abwo bagwancherana n’oborimo.
swahili: Ninyi mmeninajisi miongoni mwa watu wangu kwa ajili ya konzi chache za shayiri na chembe za mkate. Kwa kuwaambia uongo watu wangu, wale ambao husikiliza uongo, mmewaua wale watu ambao wasingekufa na kuwaacha hai wale ambao wasingeishi.

english: “Son of man, prophesy against the prophets of Israel who are now prophesying. Tell those who prophesy out of their own imagination: Hear the word of the LORD!
ekegusii: “Aye mway abanto, bana mamincha y’ababani b’Abaisraeli, abwo bakobana amang’ana akorwa ase ebirengererio biabo abanyene, obateebie: Igwa ring’ana ri’Omonene!
swahili: “Mwanadamu, tabiri dhidi ya manabii wa Israeli wanaotabiri sasa. Waambie hao ambao hutabiri kutokana na mawazo yao wenyewe: ‘Sikia neno la Bwana!

english: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: See, I am against the magic charms with which you ensnare souls like birds, and I will tear them from your arms. So I will free the souls you have ensnared like birds.
ekegusii: “Ase ayio, aya naro Omonene agoteeba: Rora nagechire ebimoya bire namaebi, ebio mokobwatera abanto buna nechinyoni mokobwata; nimbibutore korwa ase amaboko aino, erinde nsibore abanto abwo mwabwatire, barabwo batame buna chinyoni.
swahili: “ ‘Kwa hiyo hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo: Mimi niko kinyume na hizo hirizi zenu za uchawi ambazo kwa hizo mnawatega watu kama ndege, nami nitazirarua kutoka mikononi mwenu, nitawaweka huru watu wale mliowatega kama ndege.

english: I will also tear off your veils and deliver My people from your hands, so that they will no longer be prey in your hands. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
ekegusii: Boigo nintandore ebietubo biaino, ’ndusie abanto bane korwa ase amaboko aino, tibakogenderera koba abooswa ase more. Erio nario moramanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene.
swahili: Nitazirarua shela zenu na kuwaokoa watu wangu kutoka mikononi mwenu, nao hawatakuwa tena mawindo ya nguvu zenu. Ndipo mtakapojua kuwa Mimi ndimi Bwana.

english: Because you have disheartened the righteous with your lies, even though I have caused them no grief, and because you have encouraged the wicked not to turn from their evil ways to save their lives,
ekegusii: “Ase engencho y’oborimo bwaino mwagerire abanyene oboronge baichanire ase chinkoro chiabo, abwo inche ntaichanetie. Nigo mwagerire abakori amabe koba noboremu, erinde tibaonchoka batige chinchera chiabo chi’obobe, erinde batoorie obogima bwabo.
swahili: Kwa sababu mliwavunja moyo wenye haki kwa uongo wenu, wakati mimi sikuwaletea huzuni na kwa kuwa mliwatia moyo waovu ili wasiziache njia zao mbaya na hivyo kuokoa maisha yao,

english: therefore you will no longer see false visions or practice divination. I will deliver My people from your hands. Then you will know that I am the LORD.”
ekegusii: Ase ayio timokogenderera korora amaroro y’obong’ainereria, gose kwenaria oboringoria. Nindusie abanto bane korwa ase amaboko aino. Erio nario moramanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene.”
swahili: kwa hiyo hamtaona tena maono ya uongo wala kufanya ubashiri. Nitawaokoa watu wangu kutoka mikononi mwenu. Nanyi ndipo mtakapojua kuwa Mimi ndimi Bwana.’ ”

english: This is what the Lord GOD says: Woe to the foolish prophets who follow their own spirit, yet have seen nothing.
ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene agoteeba: Obobe nobw’ababani abwo abariri bakobwatia emeika yabo abanyene, na tibabwati korora konde gwonsi bagokwana.
swahili: Hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo: Ole wao manabii wapumbavu wafuatao roho yao wenyewe na wala hawajaona chochote!

english: Your prophets, O Israel, are like foxes among the ruins.
ekegusii: Inwe Abaisraeli, ababani baino nigo banga buna ebibwe bimenyete ase amaturi.
swahili: Manabii wako, ee Israeli, ni kama mbweha katikati ya magofu.

english: You did not go up to the gaps or restore the wall around the house of Israel so that it would stand in the battle on the Day of the LORD.
ekegusii: Barabwo tibatiirete gochia aase atagoire, gose tibagiterete Abaisraeli chindwaki, erinde bekengere ase esegi ye rituko ri’Omonene.
swahili: Hamjakwea kwenda kuziba mahali palipobomoka katika ukuta ili kuukarabati kwa ajili ya nyumba ya Israeli, ili kwamba isimame imara kwenye vita katika siku ya Bwana.

english: They see false visions and speak lying divinations. They claim, ‘Thus declares the LORD,’ when the LORD did not send them; yet they wait for the fulfillment of their message.
ekegusii: Amaroro abo nay’obong’ainereria, na oboringoria bwabo nobw’oborimo. Barabwo nigo bagoteeba iga: Omonene oteebire bo. Korende Omonene tabatometi. Nonya naboigo, nigo basemeretie ng’a Omonene naikeranie amang’ana abo baabanire.
swahili: Maono yao ni ya uongo na ubashiri wao ni wa udanganyifu. Wao husema, “ Bwana amesema,” wakati Bwana hakuwatuma, bado wakitarajia maneno yao kutimizwa.

english: Haven’t you seen a false vision and spoken a lying divination when you proclaim, ‘Thus declares the LORD,’ even though I have not spoken?
ekegusii: Inee! Tari amaroro y’obong’ainereria barorire, naende nigo bakoringoria oboringoria bw’oborimo, ekero bagokwana ng’a Omonene oteebire bo, na inche Omonene tinkwaneti ayio?
swahili: Je, hamjaona maono ya uongo na kusema ubashiri wa udanganyifu hapo msemapo, “ Bwana asema,” lakini Mimi sijasema?

english: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: Because you have uttered vain words and seen false visions, I am against you, declares the Lord GOD.
ekegusii: “Ase ayio aya naro Omonene agoteeba: Ekiagera mwakwanire obong’ainereria naende mwarorire amaroro y’oborimo, rora, inche nigo inde mamincha yaino. Nabo Omonene ateebire.
swahili: “ ‘Kwa hiyo hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo: Kwa sababu ya uongo wa maneno yenu na kwa madanganyo ya maono yenu, Mimi ni kinyume na ninyi, asema Bwana Mwenyezi.

english: My hand will be against the prophets who see false visions and speak lying divinations. They will not belong to the council of My people or be recorded in the register of the house of Israel, nor will they enter the land of Israel. Then you will know that I am the Lord GOD.
ekegusii: Okoboko kwane ngoake ababani abwo bakorora amaroro y’obong’ainereria, naende nigo bakoringoria oboringoria bw’oborimo. Barabwo tibakobeera ase omosangererekano bw’ abanto bane, gose tibakorikwa amo n’Abaisraeli, gose tibagosoa ase ense y’Abaisraeli. Erio nario moramanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene.
swahili: Mkono wangu utakuwa dhidi ya manabii ambao huona maono ya uongo na kusema ubashiri wa udanganyifu. Hawatakuwa katika baraza la watu wangu au kuandikwa katika kumbukumbu ya nyumba ya Israeli wala hawataingia katika nchi ya Israeli. Ndipo mtajua kuwa Mimi ndimi Bwana Mwenyezi.

english: Then some of the elders of Israel came and sat down before me.
ekegusii: Abagaaka bande b’Abaisraeli bagaacha asende, bagaikaransa ase obosio bwane.
swahili: Baadhi ya wazee wa Israeli walinijia na kuketi mbele yangu.

english: They will bear their punishment—the punishment of the inquirer will be the same as that of the prophet—
ekegusii: Abwo mbabogorie egesusuro ki’ebibe biabo, egesusuro ki’omobani na eki’omonto oria ochete koboria amang’ana korwa ase are, nigo kerabe ekemo.
swahili: Watachukua hatia yao, nabii atakuwa na hatia sawa na yule mtu aliyekuja kuuliza neno kwake.

english: in order that the house of Israel may no longer stray from Me and no longer defile themselves with all their transgressions. Then they will be My people and I will be their God, declares the Lord GOD.’” Four Dire Judgments
ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteeba ng’a ase enchera eyio Abaisraeli tibakorua asende bachie gosira, gose gwesoyia ase ogotacheneka nonya ng’ake ase engencho y’ogosaria kwabo gwonsi, korende mbabe abanto baane, na inche imbe Nyasae obo.” Nuhu, Danieli, na Ayubu
swahili: “ ‘Ndipo watu wa Israeli hawataniacha tena, wala kujitia unajisi tena kwa dhambi zao zote. Ndipo watakuwa watu wangu nami nitakuwa Mungu wao, asema Bwana Mwenyezi.’ ” Hukumu Isiyoepukika

english: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
ekegusii: Naende ring’ana ri’Omonene rigaacha asende, riganteebia:
swahili: Neno la Bwana likanijia kusema,

english: “Son of man, if a land sins against Me by acting unfaithfully, and I stretch out My hand against it to cut off its supply of food, to send famine upon it, and to cut off from it both man and beast,
ekegusii: “Aye Mwanyabaanto, onye ense egokora ebibe asende ase gokora aya atari ay’obwegenwa, nindambore okoboko kwane igoro yaye, ninsirie endagera nyerentere enchara, naende ng’ite Mwanyabaanto ne ching’iti,
swahili: “Mwanadamu, kama nchi itanitenda dhambi kwa kutokuwa waaminifu nami nikinyoosha mkono wangu dhidi yake kukatilia mbali upatikanaji wake wa chakula na kuipelekea njaa na kuua watu wake na wanyama wao,

english: then even if these three men—Noah, Daniel, and Job—were in it, their righteousness could deliver only themselves, declares the Lord GOD.
ekegusii: nonya abanto aba batato: Nuhu, Danieli, na Ayubu, barenge kobao, oboronge bwabo tibware gotooria monto onde bwensi, otatiga ’mbarabwo boka bwarenge gotooria.” Nabo Omonene ateebire.
swahili: hata kama watu hawa watatu: Noa, Danieli na Ayubu wangekuwa ndani ya nchi hiyo, ndio hao tu wangeweza kujiokoa wenyewe kwa uadilifu wao, asema Bwana Mwenyezi.

english: Or if I send wild beasts through the land to leave it childless and desolate, with no man passing through it for fear of the beasts,
ekegusii: “Gose inse korenta ching’iti chi’orosana chintindi chichiche ase ense eyio chiyesarie ebe bosa, erinde monto onde tabaisa goeta ase ense eyio ase engencho ye ching’iti echio,
swahili: “Au kama nikipeleka wanyama pori katika nchi hiyo yote na kuifanya isiwe na watoto, nayo ikawa ukiwa kwamba hakuna mtu apitaye katika nchi hiyo kwa sababu ya wanyama pori,

english: then as surely as I live, declares the Lord GOD, even if these three men were in it, they could not deliver their own sons or daughters. They alone would be delivered, but the land would be desolate.
ekegusii: nonya abanto abwo batato barenge koba ase ense eyio, ekeene, buna inche Omonene Nyasae inde moyo, tibare konyara gotooria abana bareo, abamura gose abaiseke. Mbarabwo boka baarenge gotoorigwa, korende ense ero esarigwe ebe bosa.” Nab’Omonene ateebire.
swahili: hakika kama niishivyo, asema Bwana Mwenyezi, hata kama watu hawa watatu wangekuwa humo ndani yake, wasingeweza kuokoa wana wao wala binti zao. Wao peke yao wangeokolewa, lakini nchi ingekuwa ukiwa.

english: Or if I bring a sword against that land and say, ‘Let a sword pass through it,’ so that I cut off from it both man and beast,
ekegusii: “Gose inse gotoma omoro ase ense na ntebe: Omoro tiga oetere ense eye, naende insirie kegima Mwanyabaanto ne ching’iti,
swahili: “Au kama nikileta upanga dhidi ya nchi hiyo na kusema, ‘Upanga na upite katika nchi yote,’ nami nikiua watu wake na wanyama wao,

english: then as surely as I live, declares the Lord GOD, even if these three men were in it, they could not deliver their own sons or daughters. They alone would be delivered.
ekegusii: nonya abanto abwo batato barenge kobao, ekeene, buna inche Omonene Nyasae inde moyo, tibare konyara gotooria abana bareo, abamura gose abaiseke, korende ’mbarabwo boka baarenge gotoorigwa.” Nabo Omonene ateebire.
swahili: hakika kama niishivyo, asema Bwana Mwenyezi, hata kama watu hawa watatu wangekuwa humo ndani yake, wasingeweza kuokoa wana wao wala binti zao. Wao wenyewe tu wangeokolewa.

english: Or if I send a plague into that land and pour out My wrath upon it through bloodshed, cutting off from it both man and beast,
ekegusii: “Gose inse gotoma oborwaire bogoita ase ense eyio, ing’umore endamwamu y’ane egere ogoiterwa kw’amanyinga, ng’ite Mwanyabaanto ne ching’iti aroro,
swahili: “Au kama nikipeleka tauni katika nchi hiyo na kumwaga ghadhabu yangu juu yake kwa njia ya kumwaga damu, kuua watu wake na wanyama wao,

english: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
ekegusii: Erio ring’ana ri’Omonene rigaacha asende, riganteebia:
swahili: Ndipo neno la Bwana likanijia kusema:

english: then as surely as I live, declares the Lord GOD, even if Noah, Daniel, and Job were in it, they could not deliver their own sons or daughters. Their righteousness could deliver only themselves.
ekegusii: nonya Nuhu, Danieli, na Ayubu barenge kobao, ekeene, buna inche Omonene inde moyo, oboronge bwabo tibware gotooria abana bareo, abamura gose abaiseke, otatiga mbarabwo boka bwarenge gotooria.” Nabo Omonene Nyasae ateebire.
swahili: hakika kama niishivyo, asema Bwana Mwenyezi, hata kama Noa, Danieli na Ayubu wangekuwa humo ndani yake, wasingeweza kumwokoa mwana wala binti. Wao wangeweza kujiokoa wenyewe tu kwa uadilifu wao.

english: For this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘How much worse will it be when I send against Jerusalem My four dire judgments—sword, famine, wild beasts, and plague—in order to cut off from it both man and beast?
ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene agoteeba: “Naki erabe emechando emenene goetania ekero ndatome ase Yerusalemu ebisusuro biane bine: omoro, enchara, ching’iti chintindi, na oborwaire bogoita, erinde ng’ite na gosiria Mwanyabaanto amo ne ching’iti!
swahili: “Kwa maana hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo: Itakuwa vibaya kiasi gani nitakapopeleka dhidi ya Yerusalemu hukumu zangu nne za kutisha, yaani, upanga, njaa, wanyama pori na tauni, ili kuua watu wake na wanyama wao!

english: Yet, behold, some survivors will be left in it—sons and daughters who will be brought out. They will come out to you, and when you see their conduct and actions, you will be comforted regarding the disaster I have brought upon Jerusalem—all that I have brought upon it.
ekegusii: Nonya naboigo ’mbatigare abanto bande bare moyo, amo nabana baabo, abamura na abaiseke. Abwo mbasoke korwao bache ase more. Ekero baraache, morigererie orogendo rwabo, na ogokora kwabo. Erio nario moraisaneke ng’a egesusuro ekio naruete igoro ya Yerusalemu, na aya onsi nayokorerete ase engencho y’ebibe biaye nay’oboronge.
swahili: Lakini watakuwepo wenye kuokoka, wana na binti wataletwa kutoka nje ya nchi hiyo. Watawajia ninyi, nanyi mtakapoona mwenendo wao na matendo yao, mtafarijika kuhusu maafa niliyoleta juu ya Yerusalemu, kwa ajili ya yale yote niliyoleta juu yake.

english: They will bring you consolation when you see their conduct and actions, and you will know that it was not without cause that I have done all these things within it,’ declares the Lord GOD.”
ekegusii: Barabwo mbabaremie, na ekero morarore chinchera chiabo, na ogokora kwabo, nigo moramanye ng’a aya nakorerete omochie oyio tinayakorete engencho ende etaiyo. Nabo Omonene ateebire.”
swahili: Mtafarijika wakati mtakapoona mwenendo wao na matendo yao, kwa kuwa mtajua kwamba sikufanya lolote ndani yake bila sababu, asema Bwana Mwenyezi.”

english: “Son of man, these men have set up idols in their hearts and put wicked stumbling blocks before their faces. Should I consult with them in any way?
ekegusii: “Aye Mwanyabaanto, abanto aba baeire emegwekano bagosasiima ribaga koba ase chinkoro chiabo, na emegwekano eyio yabeire ekegocha gekobaraa gochia gokora ebibe. Inee! Ninyanche abanto banga buna abwo baborie amang’ana korwa asende?
swahili: “Mwanadamu, watu hawa wameweka sanamu katika mioyo yao na kuweka vitu viovu vya kukwaza mbele ya macho yao. Je, kweli niwaruhusu waniulize jambo lolote?

english: Therefore speak to them and tell them that this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘When any Israelite sets up idols in his heart and puts a wicked stumbling block before his face, and then comes to the prophet, I the LORD will answer him according to his great idolatry,
ekegusii: “Ase igo, kwana nabarabwo, obateebie ng’a aya naro Omonene agoteeba: Omonto onde bwensi bw’Abaisraeli orae emegwekano yaye agosasiima ribaga ase enkoro yaye, na emegwekano eyio ebe ekegocha gekomoraa gochia gokora ebibe, naende abe ogocha ase omobani, oyio ninche Omonene omonyene ndamoiranerie buna agwenerete ase engencho y’emegwekano yaye emenge agosasiima.
swahili: Kwa hiyo sema nao uwaambie, ‘Hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo: Wakati Mwisraeli yeyote anapoweka sanamu moyoni mwake na kuweka kitu kiovu cha kukwaza mbele ya macho yake na kisha akaenda kwa nabii, Mimi Bwana nitamjibu peke yangu sawasawa na ukubwa wa ibada yake ya sanamu.

english: so that I may take hold of the hearts of the people of Israel. For because of their idols, they are all estranged from Me.’
ekegusii: Erio nario ’ndanyare koirania chinkoro chi’Abaisraeli abwo baatananirwe korwa ase ’nde ase engencho y’emegwekano yabo bagosasiima gocha ase ’nde.
swahili: Nitafanya jambo hili ili kukamata tena mioyo ya watu wa Israeli, ambao wote wameniacha kwa ajili ya sanamu zao.’

english: Therefore tell the house of Israel that this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Repent and turn away from your idols; turn your faces away from all your abominations.
ekegusii: “Ase ayio, teebia Abaisraeli ng’a aya naro Omonene agoteeba: Eitie moonchoke, motige gosasiima emegwekano yaino; onchoka motige ebibe biaino bionsi bi’okogechia.
swahili: “Kwa hiyo iambie nyumba ya Israeli, ‘Hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo: Tubuni! Geukeni kutoka kwenye sanamu zenu na mkatae matendo yenu yote ya machukizo!

english: For when any Israelite or any foreigner dwelling in Israel separates himself from Me, sets up idols in his heart, and puts a wicked stumbling block before his face, and then comes to the prophet to inquire of Me, I the LORD will answer him Myself.
ekegusii: “Omonto onde bwensi bw’Abaisraeli, gose omomenyi omenyete ase egati yabo, orataayaye korwa asende na koa emegwekano eyio ribaga ase enkoro yaye, eyio ekoba ekegocha gekomoraa gochia gokora ebibe, naende abe ogocha ase omobani komboria amang’ana goetera ase are, oyio ninche Omonene omonyene ndamoiranerie.
swahili: “ ‘Mwisraeli yeyote au mgeni yeyote anayeishi katika Israeli anapojitenga nami na kujiwekea sanamu katika moyo wake na kwa hivyo kuweka kitu kiovu cha kukwaza mbele ya macho yake na kisha akamwendea nabii kuuliza shauri kwangu, mimi Bwana nitamjibu mwenyewe.

english: I will set My face against that man and make him a sign and a proverb; I will cut him off from among My people. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
ekegusii: Nigo ndamobee, erinde abe ekiorokererio na omobayeeno ogokwanwa nabaanto, naende imwatanane kegima korwa ase abanto bane. Erio nario moramanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene.
swahili: Nitaukaza uso wangu dhidi ya mtu huyo na kumwadhibu na kumfanya ishara kwa watu. Nitamkatilia mbali kutoka watu wangu. Ndipo mtakapojua kuwa Mimi ndimi Bwana.

english: But if the prophet is enticed to speak a message, then it was I the LORD who enticed him, and I will stretch out My hand against him and destroy him from among My people Israel.
ekegusii: “Omobani karang’aineke akwane ring’ana ri’obobani, rirorio ninche Omonene nang’ainire omobani oyio; nindambore okoboko kwane imoite arue ase egati y’Abaisraeli, abanto bane.
swahili: “ ‘Naye nabii kama atakuwa ameshawishika kutoa unabii, Mimi Bwana nitakuwa nimemshawishi nabii huyo, nami nitaunyoosha mkono wangu dhidi yake na kumwangamiza kutoka miongoni mwa watu wangu Israeli.

english: “Son of man, how does the wood of the vine surpass any other branch among the trees in the forest?
ekegusii: “Aye Mwanyabaanto, Inee, naki omote bw’omosabibu gose orosagia rw’aye robuete emete ende yonsi, ase ogotogigwa, ase egati y’emete ende ere ase rinani?
swahili: “Mwanadamu, je, ni vipi mti wa mzabibu unaweza kuwa bora zaidi kuliko tawi la mti mwingine wowote ndani ya msitu?

english: Can wood be taken from it to make something useful? Or can one make from it a peg on which to hang utensils?
