english: In the eleventh year, on the seventh day of the first month, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatano na kabere, omotienyi bw’eritang’ani, omwaka o ikomi nomo, ring’ana ri’Omonene rigaacha asende, riganteebia:
swahili: Katika mwaka wa kumi na moja, mwezi wa kwanza, siku ya saba, neno la Bwana likanijia kusema:

english: “Son of man, I have broken the arm of Pharaoh king of Egypt. See, it has not been bound up for healing, or splinted for strength to hold the sword.
ekegusii: “Aye Mwanyabaanto, inche nabunete okoboko gwa Farao, omorwoti o Misiri; na rora, tikwana koboerwa ebitete kogwene, erinde kobe ne chinguru kobwate omoro naende.
swahili: “Mwanadamu, nimevunja mkono wa Farao mfalme wa Misri. Haukufungwa ili upone au kuwekewa kipande cha ubao ili upate nguvu za kuweza kuchukua upanga.

english: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: Behold, I am against Pharaoh king of Egypt. I will break his arms, both the strong one and the one already broken, and will make the sword fall from his hand.
ekegusii: Ase ayio, aya naro Omonene agoteeba: Nigo inde mamincha ya Farao, omorwoti o Misiri, nimbune amaboko aye onsi, koria kore nechinguru amo na koria kwabunegete; ning’iyerie omoro korwa ase okoboko kwaye.
swahili: Kwa hiyo hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo: Mimi ni kinyume na Farao mfalme wa Misri. Nitavunja mikono yake yote miwili, ule mkono ulio mzima pia na ule uliovunjika na kuufanya upanga uanguke toka mkononi mwake.

english: I will disperse the Egyptians among the nations and scatter them throughout the lands.
ekegusii: Ninserie Abamisiri gochia ase ebisaku binde, mbasiarere gochia ase chinse ao ao.
swahili: Nitawatawanya Wamisri miongoni mwa mataifa na kuwafukuza huku na huko katika nchi zote.

english: I will strengthen the arms of Babylon’s king and place My sword in his hand, but I will break the arms of Pharaoh, who will groan before him like a mortally wounded man.
ekegusii: Ninkong’ie amaboko yomorwoti o Babiloni, mbeke omoro one ase okoboko kwaye, korende amaboko a Farao nin’yabune, erinde achandeke ase obosio bw’omorwoti o Babiloni, abe okona‐kweumia ore buna omonto oakire chingoma chikomoita.
swahili: Nitaitia nguvu mikono ya mfalme wa Babeli na kuutia upanga wangu mkononi mwake, lakini nitavunja mikono ya Farao, naye atalia kwa huzuni mbele yake kama mtu aliyetiwa jeraha la kumfisha.

english: I will strengthen the arms of Babylon’s king, but Pharaoh’s arms will fall limp. Then they will know that I am the LORD, when I place My sword in the hand of Babylon’s king, and he wields it against the land of Egypt.
ekegusii: Ee, ninkong’ie amaboko yomorwoti o Babiloni, korende aya Farao naborwe chinguru. Erio mbamanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene. Ekero ndabeeke omoro one ase okoboko kw’omorwoti o Babiloni, ere nayorage gochia ase ense ya Misiri.
swahili: Nitaitia nguvu mikono ya mfalme wa Babeli, lakini mikono ya Farao italegea. Ndipo watakapojua kwamba Mimi ndimi Bwana, nitakapoutia upanga wangu mkononi mwa mfalme wa Babeli, naye ataunyoosha dhidi ya Misri.

english: I will disperse the Egyptians among the nations and scatter them throughout the lands. Then they will know that I am the LORD.”
ekegusii: Ninserie Abamisiri gochia ase ebisaku, mbasiarere gochia ase chinse ao ao. Erio mbamanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene.”
swahili: Nitawatawanya Wamisri miongoni mwa mataifa na kuwafukuza huku na huko katika nchi mbalimbali. Ndipo watakapojua kwamba Mimi ndimi Bwana.”

english: For the day is near, the Day of the LORD is near. It will be a day of clouds, a time of doom for the nations.
ekegusii: Rituko riria riaikire ang’e, ee, rituko ri’Omonene riaikire ang’e. Nigo rirabe rituko ri’amare, engaki y’okogambigwa kw’ abanto b’ebisaku.
swahili: Kwa kuwa siku ile imekaribia, siku ya Bwana imekaribia, siku ya mawingu, siku ya maangamizi kwa mataifa.

english: A sword will come against Egypt, and there will be anguish in Cush when the slain fall in Egypt, its wealth is taken away, and its foundations are torn down.
ekegusii: Omoro nochiche igoro ya Misiri, na emechando emenene nebe aaria Ethiopia, ekero abanto ba Misiri baraitwe, na obotenenku bwabo boirwe, na amaroso yense eria naiyerigwe inse.
swahili: Upanga utakuja dhidi ya Misri, nayo maumivu makuu yataijia Ethiopia. Mauaji yatakapoangukia Misri, utajiri wake utachukuliwa na misingi yake itabomolewa.

english: Cush, Put, and Lud, and all the various peoples, as well as Libya and the men of the covenant land, will fall with Egypt by the sword.
ekegusii: “Abanto ba Ethiopia, na aba Libia, na Abaludi, na abanto bonsi bagasang’anana amo, na aba Kubu, na abanto b’ense y’okobwatana; abwo bonsi mbakenywe nemioro, bakwe amo n’Abamisiri.
swahili: Kushi na Putu, Ludi na Arabia yote, Libya na watu wa nchi ya Agano watauawa kwa upanga pamoja na Misri.

english: For this is what the LORD says: The allies of Egypt will fall, and her proud strength will collapse. From Migdol to Syene they will fall by the sword within her, declares the Lord GOD.
ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene agoteeba: Abanto abwo bonsi abagokonya Abamisiri mbagwe, na okobua kwabo kw’obonene ngosirigwe; abanto mbakenywe nemioro ase ense eye korwa Migidoli goikera Siwene. Nabo Omonene ateebire.
swahili: “ ‘Hili ndilo Bwana asemalo: “ ‘Wale walioungana na Misri wataanguka na kiburi cha nguvu zake kitashindwa. Kutoka Migdoli hadi Aswani, watauawa ndani yake kwa upanga, asema Bwana Mwenyezi.

english: They will be desolate among desolate lands, and their cities will lie among ruined cities.
ekegusii: Ense eyio nesarigwe ebe bosa ase egati ye chinse chinde chisaregete chikaba bosa, na emechie yaye nesarigwe ebe bosa ase egati y’emechie ende esaregete ekaba bosa.
swahili: “ ‘Hizo nchi zitakua ukiwa miongoni mwa nchi zilizo ukiwa, nayo miji yao itakuwa magofu miongoni mwa miji iliyo magofu.

english: Then they will know that I am the LORD when I set fire to Egypt and all her helpers are shattered.
ekegusii: Erio ekero ’ndabe natongirie omorero agwo Misiri, na abakoonyi baye bonsi basirigwe, barabwo mbamanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene.
swahili: Ndipo watakapojua kwamba mimi ndimi Bwana, nitakapoiwasha Misri moto na wote wamsaidiao watapondwa.

english: On that day messengers will go out from Me in ships to frighten Cush out of complacency. Anguish will come upon them on the day of Egypt’s doom. For it is indeed coming.
ekegusii: “Ekero rituko erio rirache, abatomwa mbarue asende, bariine chimeeri bagende Ethiopia, baondokie abanto b’aroro, abwo batakagereti ng’a bobe bonde mbobanyore. Omoichano nobachere ase rituko riria ri’ogosirigwa kwa Misiri. Ee, rora, emechando eyio ngocha ere!
swahili: “ ‘Siku hiyo wajumbe watatoka kwangu kwa merikebu, ili kuwatia hofu Ethiopia, wakiwa katika hali yao ya kuridhika. Maumivu makali yatawapata siku ya maangamizi ya Misri, kwa kuwa hakika itakuja.

english: In the eleventh year, on the first day of the third month, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
ekegusii: Ase rituko rie ritang’ani, omotienyi o gatato, omwaka o ikomi nomo, ring’ana ri’Omonene rigaacha asende, riganteebia:
swahili: Katika mwaka wa kumi na moja, mwezi wa tatu, siku ya kwanza, neno la Bwana likanijia, kusema:

english: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Since it became great in height and set its top among the clouds, and it grew proud on account of its height,
ekegusii: “Ase ayio, aya naro Omonene agoteeba: Ekiagera kweimokereretie igoro na ogakiina ogaetania emete ende, na enkoro yao ekaenenera obotambe bwaye,
swahili: “ ‘Kwa hiyo hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo: Kwa sababu ulikuwa mrefu sana, kilele chake kikiwa juu ya majani manene ya miti na kwa sababu ulikuwa na kiburi cha urefu wake,

english: I delivered it into the hand of the ruler of the nations, for him to deal with it according to its wickedness. I have banished it.
ekegusii: ninkobeke ase amaboko y’oyore nokobua ase egati y’ebisaku. Oyio ekeene nigo arayokorere buna anchete, ekiagera inche nayotugutire ase engencho y’ogokora kwaye okobe.
swahili: niliutia mikononi mwa mtawala wa mataifa, ili yeye aushughulikie sawasawa na uovu wake. Nikaukatilia mbali,

english: Foreigners, the most ruthless of the nations, cut it down and left it. Its branches have fallen on the mountains and in every valley; its boughs lay broken in all the earth’s ravines. And all the peoples of the earth left its shade and abandoned it.
ekegusii: Abanto b’ebisaku ebigeni, abare abatindi mono goetania ab’ebisaku binde, mbayogeche bayotige inse. Chinsagia chiaye nchigwe, chibeere igoro ase ebitunwa na inse ase amagoko onsi. Ebisagia biaye mbibuneke bibeere ase chindooche chionsi chi’ense eria. Abanto bonsi bare ase ense eria mbatame, barue ase ekiriri kiaye bayotige.
swahili: nayo mataifa mageni yaliyo makatili sana yaliukata huo mti na kuuacha. Matawi yake yalianguka juu ya milima na kwenye mabonde yote, vitawi vyake vikavunjika na kusambaa katika makorongo yote ya nchi. Mataifa yote ya duniani yakaondoka kutoka kwenye kivuli chake na kuuacha.

english: All the birds of the air nested on its fallen trunk, and all the beasts of the field lived among its boughs.
ekegusii: Ase ritina riaye, erio rirabe rigwete inse chinyoni chionsi nchiche chibeereo, na ase chinsagia chiaye ching’iti chionsi chi’orosana nchibeereo.
swahili: Ndege wote wa angani wakakaa kwenye ule mti ulioanguka na wanyama pori wote wakakaa katikati ya vitawi vyake.

english: This happened so that no other trees by the waters would become great in height and set their tops among the clouds, and no other well-watered trees would reach them in height. For they have all been consigned to death, to the depths of the earth, among the mortals who descend to the Pit.’
ekegusii: Ayio nigo arakoreke, erinde mote onde bwensi ore ase amaache tobaisa kweenenia ase obotambe bwaye, gose gwetambeyia gochia igoro ase amare; gose emete ende yonsi ekonyora amaache tekina gochia igoro yeenenie, ekiagera yonsi yachikeirwe ogokwa esoe inse ye riroba ase Mwanyabaanto bakuure basoete.
swahili: Kamwe hakutakuwa na miti mingine kando ya hayo maji itakayorefuka zaidi ya huo, vilele vyake vikiwa juu ya majani yote ya miti. Hakuna miti mingine, hata kama imekunywa maji vizuri namna gani, itakayofikia urefu huo. Yote mwisho wake ni kifo, na kuingia ardhini, kama vile ilivyo kwa wanadamu, pamoja na wale waendao shimoni.

english: This is what the Lord GOD says: ‘On the day it was brought down to Sheol, I caused mourning. I covered the deep because of it; I held back its rivers; its abundant waters were restrained. I made Lebanon mourn for it, and all the trees of the field fainted because of it.
ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene agoteeba: Ase rituko erio omote oria ogendete aase abakuure ngachiika ebirero birerwe; nigo natubete chindiba ase engencho yaye, ngatanga chindooche chiaye, nkaochania amaache amanene. Nigo nachiigete egetunwa kia Lebanoni keyobokerie amagombo, na emete yonsi y’orosana egasusana ase engencho yaye.
swahili: “ ‘Hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo: Katika siku ile mwerezi uliposhushwa chini kaburini nilizifunika chemchemi zenye maji mengi kwa maombolezo: Nilivizuia vijito vyake na wingi wa maji yake nikauzuia. Kwa sababu yake niliivika Lebanoni huzuni, nayo miti yote ya shambani ikanyauka.

english: I made the nations quake at the sound of its downfall, when I cast it down to Sheol with those who descend to the Pit. Then all the trees of Eden, the choicest and best of Lebanon, all the well-watered trees, were consoled in the earth below.
ekegusii: Nigo natengechetie ebisaku ase okogwa kwaye, ekero nayogechete nkayotuguta gochia aase abakuure, ase abwo bagendete ase chimbeera. Erio emete yonsi ya Edeni, na eyechorire ere emiya mono ya Lebanoni, yonsi eye ekonywa amaache, ekaba ekweremia emenyene agwo inse ye riroba.
swahili: Niliyafanya mataifa yatetemeke kwa kishindo cha kuanguka kwake wakati nilipoushusha chini kaburini pamoja na wale washukao shimoni. Ndipo miti yote ya Edeni, miti iliyo bora kuliko yote na iliyo mizuri sana ya Lebanoni, miti yote ile iliyokunywa maji vizuri, ilifarijika hapa duniani.

english: They too descended with it to Sheol, to those slain by the sword. As its allies they had lived in its shade among the nations.
ekegusii: Emete eyio egasoa amo n’oro gochia aase abakuure ase abwo baitetwe nemioro basoete, ee, emete eyio nigo yaikaransete ase ekiriri kiaye ase egati y’ebisaku ase okoyokonya.
swahili: Wale walioishi katika kivuli chake, wale walioungana naye miongoni mwa mataifa, nao pia walikuwa wamezikwa pamoja naye, wakiungana na wale waliouawa kwa upanga.

english: Who then is like you in glory and greatness among the trees of Eden? You also will be brought down to the depths of the earth to be with the trees of Eden. You will lie among the uncircumcised, with those slain by the sword. This is Pharaoh and all his multitude, declares the Lord GOD.’”
ekegusii: “Norori ase emete yonsi ya Edeni oreng’anigwe naye ase ogosikwa na obonene? Aye noirwe amo nemete ende yonsi ya Edeni, otugutwe inse ye riroba amo nero; nobe amo nabwo batarogeti, abaitetwe nemioro. “Ayio naro arakoreke ase Farao amo nomoganda oye bwonsi. Omonene oteebire ayio.”
swahili: “ ‘Ni miti ipi ya Edeni inayoweza kulinganishwa nawe kwa fahari na utukufu? Hata hivyo, wewe pia, utashushwa chini pamoja na miti ya Edeni mpaka kuzimu, utalala miongoni mwa wasiotahiriwa, pamoja na wale waliouawa kwa upanga. “ ‘Huyu ni Farao pamoja na makundi yake yote ya wajeuri, asema Bwana Mwenyezi.’ ”

english: “Son of man, say to Pharaoh king of Egypt and to his multitude: ‘Who can be compared to your greatness?
ekegusii: “Aye Mwanyabaanto, kwana na Farao, omorwoti o Misiri, amo nomoganda oye, oborie: “Ning’o oraareng’anigwe naye ase obonene bwao?
swahili: “Mwanadamu, mwambie Farao mfalme wa Misri na makundi yake ya wajeuri: “ ‘Je, ni nani awezaye kulinganishwa na wewe katika fahari.

english: Look at Assyria, a cedar in Lebanon, with beautiful branches that shaded the forest. It towered on high; its top was among the clouds.
ekegusii: Naama! Ense y’Abaasuri nigo yarenge buna omocharake o Lebanoni, obwate chinsagia chingiya chire nekiriri ekiya. Nigo okinete gochia igoro, ogaetania chinsagia chi’emete ende.
swahili: Angalia Ashuru, wakati fulani ilikuwa mwerezi huko Lebanoni, ukiwa na matawi mazuri ukitia msitu kivuli; ulikuwa mrefu sana, kilele chake kilipita majani ya miti yote.

english: The waters made it grow; the deep springs made it tall, directing their streams all around its base and sending their channels to all the trees of the field.
ekegusii: Omote oyio okaba okonyora amaache na gokiina; chinsoko chia inse chikayotambeyia. Chindooche nigo chiaetanaine ase osimekire, magega yaye chindooche echio chikaba chikonyosia emete yonsi ye rinani amaache.
swahili: Maji mengi yaliustawisha, chemchemi zenye maji mengi ziliufanya urefuke; vijito vyake vilitiririka pale ulipoota pande zote na kupeleka mifereji yake kwenye miti yote ya shambani.

english: Therefore it towered higher than all the trees of the field. Its branches multiplied, and its boughs grew long as it spread them out because of the abundant waters.
ekegusii: “Ase ayio omocharake oria ogakiina, Ogatambea ogaetania emete yonsi ye rinani, chinsagia chiaye chikamentekana, na ebisagia biaye bigatambea, ase engencho y’amaache amaange arengeo akayokinia.
swahili: Hivyo ukarefuka kupita miti yote ya shambani; vitawi vyake viliongezeka na matawi yake yakawa marefu, yakitanda kwa sababu ya wingi wa maji.

english: All the birds of the air nested in its branches, and all the beasts of the field gave birth beneath its boughs; all the great nations lived in its shade.
ekegusii: Chinyoni chionsi chikaagacha ebiswa biabo ase chinsagia chiaye, ne ching’iti chikabiarera inse ye chinsagia chiaye; inse y’ekiriri kiaye abanto b’ebisaku bionsi ebinene bikamenyao.
swahili: Ndege wote wa angani wakaweka viota kwenye vitawi vyake, wanyama wote wa shambani wakazaana chini ya matawi yake, mataifa makubwa yote yaliishi chini ya kivuli chake.

english: It was beautiful in its greatness, in the length of its limbs, for its roots extended to abundant waters.
ekegusii: Omote oria okaba omuya mono ase obonene bwaye na ase chinsagia chiaye chintambe, ekiagera emeri yaye yaigete inse ase amaache amaange arenge.
swahili: Ulikuwa na fahari katika uzuri, ukiwa na matawi yaliyotanda, kwa kuwa mizizi yake ilikwenda chini mpaka kwenye maji mengi.

english: The cedars in the garden of God could not rival it; the cypresses could not compare with its branches, nor the plane trees match its boughs. No tree in the garden of God could compare with its beauty.
ekegusii: Emecharake ende ey’omogondo o Nyasae tiyayoetanetie, gose emebunduki tiyarenge ne chinsagia buna echiaye; na emeuru tiyarenge nebisagia buna ebiaye. Ee, omote onde bw’omogondo o Nyasae torenge omosiani buna oro.
swahili: Mierezi katika bustani ya Mungu haikuweza kushindana nao, wala misunobari haikuweza kulingana na vitawi vyake, wala miaramoni haikulinganishwa na matawi yake, wala hakukuwa na mti katika bustani ya Mungu wa kulinganisha na uzuri wake.

english: I made it beautiful with its many branches, the envy of all the trees of Eden, which were in the garden of God.’
ekegusii: Nigo nayokorete okaba omosiani ase engencho y’obonge bwe chinsagia chiaye, goika emete yonsi ya Edeni, omogondo o Nyasae, ekayosanera.
swahili: Niliufanya kuwa mzuri ukiwa na matawi mengi, ulionewa wivu na miti yote ya Edeni katika bustani ya Mungu.

english: In the twelfth year, on the first day of the twelfth month, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
ekegusii: Ase rituko rie ritang’ani, omotienyi o ikomi na kabere, omwaka o ikomi na kabere, ring’ana ri’Omonene rigaacha ase inde, riganteebia:
swahili: Katika mwaka wa kumi na mbili, mwezi wa kumi na mbili, siku ya kwanza ya mwezi, neno la Bwana likanijia, kusema:

english: I will cause many peoples to be appalled over you, and their kings will shudder in horror because of you when I brandish My sword before them. On the day of your downfall each of them will tremble every moment for his life.’
ekegusii: Ning’ichanie abanto abange na abarwoti babo mboboe mono ase engencho yao, ekero ndabe nkomesia omoro one ase amasio abo. Ee, ase rituko ri’okogwa kwao mbabe bakonakoiguswa kera engaki, kera omonto ase engencho y’obogima bwaye.
swahili: Nitayafanya mataifa mengi wakustaajabie, wafalme wao watatetemeka kwa hofu kwa ajili yako nitakapotikisa upanga wangu mbele yao. Siku ya anguko lako kila mmoja wao atatetemeka kila dakika kwa ajili ya maisha yake.

english: For this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘The sword of the king of Babylon will come against you!
ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene agoteeba: Omoro bw’omorwoti o Babiloni norentwe igoro yao.
swahili: “ ‘Kwa kuwa hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo: “ ‘Upanga wa mfalme wa Babeli utakuja dhidi yako.

english: I will make your hordes fall by the swords of the mighty, the most ruthless of all nations. They will ravage the pride of Egypt and all her multitudes will be destroyed.
ekegusii: Nindete abarwani chituoni, abare abatindi goetania ebisaku bionsi, abwo mbaite emeganda yao nemioro. Barabwo mbasirie obonene bwa Misiri bobe bosa, na emeganda yaye yonsi nesirigwe.
swahili: Nitafanya makundi yako ya wajeuri kuanguka kwa panga za watu mashujaa, taifa katili kuliko mataifa yote. Watakivunjavunja kiburi cha Misri, nayo makundi yake yote ya wajeuri yatashindwa.

english: I will slaughter all her cattle beside the abundant waters. No human foot will muddy them again, and no cattle hooves will disturb them.
ekegusii: Ning’ite ching’iti chionsi chikorisia mbarabare ase amaache amaange are; amagoro ya Mwanyabaanto, gose ebitaago bie ching’iti, tibikogenderera goturubania amaache ayio biyasarie.
swahili: Nitaangamiza mifugo yake yote wanaojilisha kando ya maji mengi, hayatavurugwa tena kwa mguu wa mwanadamu wala kwato za mnyama hazitayachafua tena.

english: Then I will let her waters settle and will make her rivers flow like oil,’ declares the Lord GOD.
ekegusii: Erio nintige amaache areo akenonoke, ne chindooche chiminyoke buna amaguta. Nab’Omonene ateebire.
swahili: Kisha nitafanya maji yake yatulie na kufanya vijito vyake vitiririke kama mafuta, asema Bwana Mwenyezi.

english: ‘When I make the land of Egypt a desolation and empty it of all that filled it, when I strike down all who live there, then they will know that I am the LORD.’
ekegusii: Ekero ndasarie ense ya Misiri ebe bosa, na ebinto bionsi bireo bisirigwe, naende nsirie abanto bonsi bamenyeteo, erio mbamanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene.
swahili: Nitakapoifanya Misri kuwa ukiwa na kuiondolea nchi kila kitu kilichomo ndani yake, nitakapowapiga wote waishio humo, ndipo watakapojua kuwa Mimi ndimi Bwana.’

english: This is the lament they will chant for her; the daughters of the nations will chant it. Over Egypt and all her multitudes they will chant it, declares the Lord GOD.” Egypt Cast into the Pit
ekegusii: Ayio naro amagombo arabokigwe igoro ya Misiri. Abakungu b’ebisaku mbabokie amagombo igoro yaye, na igoro y’emeganda yaye yonsi. Nabo Omonene ateebire.” Ense y’abakuure
swahili: “Hili ndilo ombolezo watakalomwimbia. Binti za mataifa wataliimba, kwa kuwa Misri na makundi yake yote ya wajeuri wataliimba, asema Bwana Mwenyezi.”

english: In the twelfth year, on the fifteenth day of the month, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
ekegusii: Ase rituko ria ikomi na gatano, omotienyi bw’eritang’ani, omwaka o ikomi na kabere, ring’ana ri’Omonene rigaacha ase ’nde, rigantebia:
swahili: Katika mwaka wa kumi na mbili, mwezi wa kwanza, siku ya kumi na tano ya mwezi, neno la Bwana likanijia kusema:

english: “Son of man, wail for the multitudes of Egypt, and consign her and the daughters of the mighty nations to the depths of the earth with those who descend to the Pit:
ekegusii: “Aye Mwanyabaanto, bokeria emeganda ya Misiri amagombo, obatugute abanto baye gochia inse, amo nabaanto b’ebisaku bire nobonene, bagende aase abakuure agwo ase chimbeera, ase abakuure bagendete.
swahili: “Mwanadamu, omboleza kwa ajili ya makundi ya wajeuri wa Misri na uwatupe kuzimu yeye na binti za mataifa yenye nguvu, waende huko pamoja nao washukao shimoni.

english: Whom do you surpass in beauty? Go down and be placed with the uncircumcised!
ekegusii: “Aye Misiri, ning’o obuete ase obosiani? Tirimboka ogende inse otimoke amo nabatarogeti?
swahili: Je, ninyi mnamzidi nani kwa uzuri? Shukeni chini! Nanyi mkalazwe pamoja na hao wasiotahiriwa!

english: “Son of man, take up a lament for Pharaoh king of Egypt and say to him: ‘You are like a lion among the nations; you are like a monster in the seas. You thrash about in your rivers, churning up the waters with your feet and muddying the streams.’
ekegusii: “Aye Mwanyabaanto, rera obokie amagombo igoro ya Farao, omorwoti o Misiri, omoteebie: Aye nigo kwareng’anetigwe nendo ensae ase egati y’ebisaku, nigo onga eng’iti enene mono buna eng’oina ere enyancha ime. Nigo kwaberogetie korwa ase chindooche chiao, okaburukania amaache namagoro ao, okabokia etintira y’amaache e chindooche chiabo.
swahili: “Mwanadamu, fanya maombolezo kwa ajili ya Farao mfalme wa Misri na umwambie: “ ‘Wewe ni kama simba miongoni mwa mataifa, wewe ni kama joka kubwa baharini, unayevuruga maji kwa miguu yako na kuchafua vijito.

english: They will fall among those slain by the sword. The sword is appointed! Let them drag her away along with all her multitudes.
ekegusii: “Abanto ba Misiri mbaitwe barare amo nabwo baitetwe nemioro. Emioro y’okobasiria yarurwe. Ase ayio rusia ense eyio aroro amo nemeganda yaye yonsi.
swahili: Wataanguka miongoni mwa wale waliouawa kwa upanga. Upanga umefutwa, mwache aburutwe mbali pamoja na hao wajeuri wake wote.

english: Mighty chiefs will speak from the midst of Sheol about Egypt and her allies: ‘They have come down and lie with the uncircumcised, with those slain by the sword.’
ekegusii: Korwa agwo aase abakuure abare ne chinguru ase egati ye chituoni mbakwane igoro y’Abamisiri na abakoonyi babo, bateebe: Baria batarogeti baitirwe nemioro, baachire inse aa korara.
swahili: Kutoka kuzimu viongozi hodari watanena kuhusu Misri pamoja na wale walioungana nao, ‘Wameshuka chini, nao wamelala kimya pamoja na hao wasiotahiriwa, pamoja na wale waliouawa kwa upanga.’

english: Assyria is there with her whole company; her graves are all around her. All of them are slain, fallen by the sword.
ekegusii: “Abaasuri nao bakare amo nemeganda yabo yonsi, chimbeera chiabo nigo chibaetanaine ase chinsemo chionsi. Bonsi baitirwe nemioro bakuure.
swahili: “Ashuru yuko huko pamoja na jeshi lake lote, amezungukwa na makaburi ya watu wake wote waliouawa, wale wote walioanguka kwa upanga.

english: Her graves are set in the depths of the Pit, and her company is all around her grave. All of them are slain, fallen by the sword— those who once spread terror in the land of the living.
ekegusii: Chimbeera chiabo nigo chikare inse aatambe, na emeganda yabo nigo eetanaine chimbeera chiabo ase chinsemo chionsi. Bonsi baitirwe nemioro bakuure; abanto abwo kare barentete obwoba ase ense y’abare moyo.
swahili: Makaburi yao yako kwenye kina cha chini cha shimo na jeshi lake limelala kulizunguka kaburi lake. Wote waliokuwa wameeneza hofu kuu katika nchi ya walio hai wameuawa, wameanguka kwa upanga.

english: Elam is there with all her multitudes around her grave. All of them are slain, fallen by the sword— those who went down uncircumcised to the earth below, who once spread their terror in the land of the living. They bear their disgrace with those who descend to the Pit.
ekegusii: “Abaelamu nao bakare amo nemeganda yabo yonsi eetanaine chimbeera chiabo. Bonsi baitirwe nemioro bakuure. Abwo bonsi barentete obwoba ase ense y’abare moyo; nigo bagendete gochia aase abakuure ekero konya batararoka na bono babogoirie obosooku bwabo amo nabwo bagendire ase chimbeera.
swahili: “Elamu yuko huko, pamoja na makundi yake yote ya wajeuri wakiwa wamelizunguka kaburi lake. Wote wameuawa, wameanguka kwa upanga. Wote waliokuwa wameeneza hofu katika nchi ya walio hai walishuka kuzimu bila kutahiriwa. Wanaichukua aibu yao pamoja na wale washukao shimoni.

english: Among the slain they prepare a resting place for Elam with all her hordes, with her graves all around her. All of them are uncircumcised, slain by the sword, although their terror was once spread in the land of the living. They bear their disgrace with those who descend to the Pit. They are placed among the slain.
ekegusii: Abaelamu amo nemeganda yabo yonsi banyorire amarere abo ase egati y’abwo baitetwe nemioro, ne chimbeera chi’emeganda yabo nigo chibaetanaine. Abwo bonsi bagaitwa nemioro ekero konya batararoka. Agwo kare nigo barentete obwoba ase ense y’abare moyo. Bono babogoirie obosooku amo nabwo bagendire ase chimbeera, ee, nigo babekire ase egati y’abwo baitetwe nemioro.
swahili: Kitanda kimetandikwa kwa ajili yake miongoni mwa waliouawa, pamoja na makundi yake yote ya wajeuri wakiwa wamelizunguka kaburi lake. Wote ni watu wasiotahiriwa, wameuawa kwa upanga. Kwa sababu vitisho vyao vilienea katika nchi ya walio hai, wameichukua aibu yao pamoja na wale washukao shimoni, nao wamewekwa miongoni mwa waliouawa.

english: Meshech and Tubal are there with all their multitudes, with their graves all around them. All of them are uncircumcised, slain by the sword, because they spread their terror in the land of the living.
ekegusii: “Abameseki na Abatubali nao bakare amo nemeganda yabo yonsi, ne chimbeera chi’emeganda eyio nigo chibaetanaine ase chinsemo chionsi. Abwo bonsi nabaanto batarogeti, nigo baitetwe nemioro. Agwo kare nigo barentete obwoba ase ense y’abare moyo.
swahili: “Mesheki na Tubali wako humo, pamoja na makundi yao ya wajeuri wakiwa wameyazunguka makaburi yao. Wote hawakutahiriwa, wameuawa kwa upanga kwa sababu walieneza vitisho vyao katika nchi ya walio hai.

english: They do not lie down with the fallen warriors of old, who went down to Sheol with their weapons of war, whose swords were placed under their heads, whose shields rested on their bones, although the terror of the mighty was once in the land of the living.
ekegusii: Inee! Abwo batarogeti tibakorara amo ne chituoni chi’eseegi chiagendete gochia aase abakuure amo nebirwanero biabo bi’eseegi, na emioro yabo ebekire inse y’emetwe yabo, na ebibe biabo bakorete tibiatubete amauga abo? Barabwo nigo barentete obwoba ase ense y’abare moyo buna chituoni chi’eseegi chigokora.
swahili: Je, hawakulala na mashujaa wengine wasiotahiriwa waliouawa, ambao wameshuka kaburini wakiwa na silaha zao za vita, ambao panga zao ziliwekwa chini ya vichwa vyao na uovu wao juu ya mifupa yao? Adhabu kwa ajili ya dhambi zao ilikuwa juu ya mifupa yao, ingawa vitisho vya mashujaa hawa vilikuwa vimeenea hadi kwenye nchi ya walio hai.

english: But you too will be shattered and lie down among the uncircumcised, with those slain by the sword.
ekegusii: “Naboigo nainwe Abamisiri, morasenyentwe, mokwe amo nabatarogeti, abwo baitetwe nemioro.
swahili: “Wewe pia, ee Farao, utavunjwa nawe utalala miongoni mwa wasiotahiriwa, pamoja na wale waliouawa kwa upanga.

english: Edom is there, and all her kings and princes, who despite their might are laid among those slain by the sword. They lie down with the uncircumcised, with those who descend to the Pit.
ekegusii: “Abaedomu nao bakare amo nabarwoti babo, na abagaambi babo bonsi. Nonya barenge nokobua nigo baraire amo na baria baitetwe nemioro, batarogeti bagendete ase chimbeera.
swahili: “Edomu yuko humo, wafalme wake wote na wakuu wake wote, ambao ijapokuwa wana nguvu, wamelazwa pamoja na wale waliouawa kwa upanga. Wamelala pamoja na wasiotahiriwa, pamoja na wale washukao shimoni.

english: This is what the Lord GOD says: ‘I will spread My net over you with a company of many peoples, and they will draw you up in My net.
ekegusii: Ase ayio, aya naro Omonene agoteeba: Nindute ekeonga kiane igoro yao, nakio omoganda omonene orakong’use okobeke ase rikuru riane ime.
swahili: “ ‘Hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo: “ ‘Nikiwa pamoja na wingi mkubwa wa watu nitautupa wavu wangu juu yako, nao watakukokota katika wavu wangu.

english: All the leaders of the north and all the Sidonians are there; they went down in disgrace with the slain, despite the terror of their might. They lie uncircumcised with those slain by the sword and bear their shame with those who descend to the Pit.
ekegusii: “Abagaambi bonsi ba sugusu nao bakare amo n’Abasidoni bonsi; bonsi bagendire gochia ase abwo baitetwe nemioro. Ase engencho y’obwoba barentete ekero barenge nokobua, bono babeire nobosooku. Nigo baraire batarogeti amo na baria baitetwe nemioro; nigo babogoretie obosooku bwabo bare ase egati y’abwo bagendete ase chimbeera.
swahili: “Wakuu wote wa kaskazini na Wasidoni wote wako huko, wameshuka chini pamoja na waliouawa kwa aibu ijapokuwa kuna vitisho vilivyosababishwa na nguvu zao. Wamelala bila kutahiriwa pamoja na wale waliouawa kwa upanga na kuchukua aibu yao pamoja na wale washukao chini shimoni.

english: Pharaoh will see them and be comforted over all his multitude— Pharaoh and all his army, slain by the sword, declares the Lord GOD.
ekegusii: “Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: Ekero Farao ararore abwo baitetwe, nigo areremie ase engencho y’emeganda yaye yonsi eyio yaitetwe nemioro.
swahili: “Farao, yeye pamoja na jeshi lake lote, atakapowaona atafarijiwa kwa ajili ya makundi yake yote ya wajeuri, wale waliouawa kwa upanga, asema Bwana Mwenyezi.

english: For I will spread My terror in the land of the living, so that Pharaoh and all his multitude will be laid to rest among the uncircumcised, with those slain by the sword, declares the Lord GOD.”
ekegusii: “Inche nigo naete Farao ribaga arente obwoba ase ense y’abare moyo; ase ayio ere amo nomoganda oye bwonsi barare ase egati y’abatarogeti, abwo baitetwe nemioro. Nabo Omonene atebiire.”
swahili: Ingawa nilimfanya Farao aeneze vitisho vyake katika nchi ya walio hai, Farao pamoja na makundi yake yote ya wajeuri watalazwa miongoni mwa wasiotahiriwa, pamoja na wale waliouawa kwa upanga, asema Bwana Mwenyezi.”

english: I will abandon you on the land and hurl you into the open field. I will cause all the birds of the air to settle upon you, and all the beasts of the earth to eat their fill of you.
ekegusii: Erio ngotugute igoro ase ense enyomo, na nkorute aase aarabu, agwo ndangerie chinyoni chionsi chikogwere, ne ching’iti chire ase ense engima chikorie chiigote.
swahili: Nitakutupa nchi kavu na kukuvurumisha uwanjani. Nitawafanya ndege wote wa angani watue juu yako na wanyama wote wa nchi watajishibisha nyama yako.

english: I will put your flesh on the mountains and fill the valleys with your remains.
ekegusii: Nintugute chinyama chi’omobere oo ase ebitunwa igoro, na oboguundo bwao boichore ase amagoko.
swahili: Nitatawanya nyama yako juu ya milima na kujaza mabonde kwa mabaki yako.

english: I will drench the land with the flow of your blood, all the way to the mountains— the ravines will be filled.
ekegusii: Ninyonsie ense nemegoko y’amanyinga ao, aichore aike ase ebitunwa igoro, ne chindooche chiichorwe naro.
swahili: Nitailowanisha nchi kwa damu yako inayotiririka njia yote hadi milimani, nayo mabonde yatajazwa na nyama yako.

english: When I extinguish you, I will cover the heavens and darken their stars. I will cover the sun with a cloud, and the moon will not give its light.
ekegusii: Ekero ekio ndagosirie nintube igoro, imbeke omosunte ase ching’enang’eni; nintube erioba ne riire, na omotienyi tokobara.
swahili: Nitakapokuzimisha, nitafunika mbingu na kuzitia nyota zake giza; nitalifunika jua kwa wingu, nao mwezi hautatoa nuru yake.

english: All the shining lights in the heavens I will darken over you, and I will bring darkness upon your land,’ declares the Lord GOD.
ekegusii: Emebaso yonsi ya igoro ninyetube omosunte ase engencho yao, nindete omosunte ase ense yao. Nabo Omonene ateebire.
swahili: Mianga yote itoayo nuru angani nitaitia giza juu yako; nitaleta giza juu ya nchi yako, asema Bwana Mwenyezi.

english: ‘I will trouble the hearts of many peoples, when I bring about your destruction among the nations, in countries you do not know.
ekegusii: “Ekero ndarentere abanto b’ebisaku amang’ana igoro y’ogosirigwa kwao, ning’ichanie chinkoro chi’ abanto abange ase chinse echio otamanyeti.
swahili: Nitaifadhaisha mioyo ya mataifa mengi nitakapokuangamiza miongoni mwa mataifa, nikikuleta uhamishoni miongoni mwa nchi ambazo haujapata kuzijua.

english: Now as for you, son of man, tell the house of Israel that this is what they have said: ‘Our transgressions and our sins are heavy upon us, and we are wasting away because of them! How can we live?’
ekegusii: Ase ayio aye Mwanyabaanto, inyoria Abaisraeli ayabagokwana, bateeba: Ogosaria gwaito, na ebibe biaito biatoritoeire, na ebio bigendererete gotochanda na gotoreyia. Naki rende toranyare koba moyo?
swahili: “Mwanadamu, sema na nyumba ya Israeli uwaambie, ‘Hili ndilo mnalosema: “Makosa yetu na dhambi zetu zimetulemea, nasi tunadhoofika kwa sababu ya hayo. Tutawezaje basi kuishi?” ’

english: Say to them: ‘As surely as I live, declares the Lord GOD, I take no pleasure in the death of the wicked, but rather that the wicked should turn from their ways and live. Turn! Turn from your evil ways! For why should you die, O house of Israel?’
ekegusii: Bateebie ng’a inche Omonene Nyasae nigo ngoteeba iga: Ekeene, buna inche inde moyo, tindi kogokera ogokwa kw’omokori amabe, korende nigo nganetie omokori amabe aonchoke, atige enchera yaye embe abe moyo. Ase ayio onchoka, onchoka, motige chinchera chiaino chimbe! Inwe Abaisraeli, nase ki moganetie mokwe?
swahili: Waambie, ‘Hakika kama mimi niishivyo, asema Bwana Mwenyezi, sifurahii kifo cha watu waovu, bali kwamba wageuke kutoka njia zao mbaya wapate kuishi. Geukeni! Geukeni kutoka njia zenu mbaya! Kwa nini mkafe, ee nyumba ya Israeli?’

english: Therefore, son of man, say to your people: ‘The righteousness of the righteous man will not deliver him in the day of his transgression; neither will the wickedness of the wicked man cause him to stumble on the day he turns from his wickedness. Nor will the righteous man be able to survive by his righteousness on the day he sins.’
ekegusii: Aye Mwanyabaanto, teebia abanto bao ng’a ekero omonyaboronge aratige oboronge bwaye akore ebibe, oboronge boria bwaye tibokomotooria; na ekero omokori amabe araonchoke atige obobe bwaye, obobe boria bwaye tibokomoita, kareitie na kobotiga. Omonyaboronge takoba moyo ase engencho y’oboronge bwaye rituko riria arakore ebibe.
swahili: “Kwa hiyo, mwanadamu, waambie watu wako, ‘Haki ya mtu mwenye haki haitamwokoa wakati anapoacha kutii, wala uovu wa mtu mwovu hautamsababisha yeye kuanguka anapotubu na kuacha uovu. Mtu mwenye haki, kama akitenda dhambi, hataishi kwa sababu ya uadilifu wake wa awali.’

english: If I tell the righteous man that he will surely live, but he then trusts in his righteousness and commits iniquity, then none of his righteous works will be remembered; he will die because of the iniquity he has committed.
ekegusii: Kondateebie omonyaboronge ng’a nabe moyo, korende ere asemerie oboronge bwaye na akore aya atari ay’oboronge, rirorio ogokora kwaye konde gwonsi kw’oboronge akorete tigokoinyorwa; ere nakwe ase engencho y’ayio atari oboronge akorire.
swahili: Kama nikimwambia mtu mwenye haki kwamba hakika utaishi, lakini akategemea hiyo haki yake na kutenda uovu, hakuna tendo lolote la haki alilotenda litakalokumbukwa, atakufa kwa ajili ya uovu alioutenda.

english: But if I tell the wicked man, ‘You will surely die,’ and he turns from his sin and does what is just and right—
ekegusii: Naende, kondateebie omokori amabe: Aye goika okwe, korende karaonchoke atige ebibe biaye, akore ayare ay’ekeene na oboronge,
swahili: Nami kama nikimwambia mtu mwovu, ‘Hakika utakufa,’ kisha akageuka kutoka dhambi yake na kufanya lile lililo haki na sawa,

english: if he restores a pledge, makes restitution for what he has stolen, and walks in the statutes of life without practicing iniquity—then he will surely live; he will not die.
ekegusii: ere karairanie egento airete gekaba intenenera, naende airanie eki aureretie, na abwatie emeroberio echiikire ey’obogima atari gokora ebibe, omonto oyio, ekeene nabe moyo, tagokwa.
swahili: kama akirudisha kile alichochukua rehani kwa ajili ya deni, akarudisha alichoiba na kufuata amri zile ziletazo uzima, wala hafanyi uovu, hakika ataishi, hatakufa.

english: None of the sins he has committed will be held against him. He has done what is just and right; he will surely live.
ekegusii: Ase ebibe ebio akorete takobarerwa nonya nekemo; ere okorire ayare ay’ekeene na oboronge, ekeene goika abe moyo.
swahili: Hakuna dhambi yoyote aliyoitenda itakayokumbukwa juu yake. Ametenda lile lililo haki na sawa, hakika ataishi.

english: Yet your people say, ‘The way of the Lord is not just.’ But it is their way that is not just.
ekegusii: Abanto b’egesaku kiao nigo bagoteeba: Chinchera chia Omonene tichiri echi’ekeene, korende chinchera chiabo nachio chitari echi’ekeene.
swahili: “Lakini watu wako wanasema, ‘Njia ya Bwana si sawa.’ Lakini ni njia zao ambazo si sawa.

english: If a righteous man turns from his righteousness and commits iniquity, he will die for it.
ekegusii: Ekero omonyaboronge aratige oboronge bwaye akore aya atari ay’oboronge, oyio nakwe ase engencho y’ayio.
swahili: Kama mtu mwenye haki akigeuka kutoka uadilifu wake na kufanya uovu, atakufa kwa ajili ya huo uovu.

english: But if a wicked man turns from his wickedness and does what is just and right, he will live because of this.
ekegusii: Na omokori amabe karaonchoke, atige amabe aye, erio akore ayare ay’ekeene na oboronge, nabe moyo ase engencho y’ayio.
swahili: Naye mtu mwovu kama akigeuka kutoka uovu wake na kufanya lile lililo haki na sawa, kwa kufanya hivyo ataishi.

english: “Son of man, speak to your people and tell them: ‘Suppose I bring the sword against a land, and the people of that land choose a man from among them, appointing him as their watchman,
ekegusii: Aye Mwanyabaanto, teebia abanto bamino ng’a ekero ndarente omoro igoro ase ense, na abanto b’ense eyio bachore omonto oyomo obo, bamobeke abe omorendi obo,
swahili: “Mwanadamu, sema na watu wako uwaambie, ‘Nitakapoleta upanga dhidi ya nchi, nao watu wa nchi wakamchagua mmoja wa watu wao na kumfanya awe mlinzi wao,

english: Yet you say, ‘The way of the Lord is not just.’ But I will judge each of you according to his ways, O house of Israel.” Word of Jerusalem’s Fall
ekegusii: Korende inwe Abaisraeli nigo mogendererete goteeba: Chinchera chia Omonene tichiri echi’ekeene. Ninachere kera omonto ekiina koreng’ana nogokora kwaye. Amang’ana igoro y’okogwa kwa Yerusalemu
swahili: Lakini, ee nyumba ya Israeli, unasema, ‘Njia ya Bwana si sawa.’ Lakini nitamhukumu kila mmoja wenu sawasawa na njia zake mwenyewe.” Anguko La Yerusalemu Laelezewa

english: In the twelfth year of our exile, on the fifth day of the tenth month, a fugitive from Jerusalem came to me and reported, “The city has been taken!”
ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatano, omotienyi o ikomi, omwaka o ikomi na kabere, magega gotwairirwe ase obosomba, omonto konya otamire korwa Yerusalemu, agacha asende, aganteebia, “Omochie oria obuirwe.”
swahili: Mwaka wa kumi na mbili wa uhamisho wetu, mwezi wa kumi, siku ya tano, mtu aliyekuwa ametoroka kutoka Yerusalemu akanijia na kusema, “Mji wa Yerusalemu umeanguka!”

english: Now the evening before the fugitive arrived, the hand of the LORD was upon me, and He opened my mouth before the man came to me in the morning. So my mouth was opened and I was no longer mute.
ekegusii: Mogoroba ekero omonto oyio ataracha asende, okoboko kw’Omonene konya gwachire igoro y’ane, na ase emambia eria omonto oria otamete konya ataraika asende, Omonene konya omaanoire omonwa one, na tinagendererete koba rimama. Ebibe bi’abaanto
swahili: Basi jioni kabla mtu huyo hajaja, mkono wa Bwana, ulikuwa juu yangu, naye alifungua kinywa changu kabla ya mtu yule aliyenijia asubuhi hajafika. Basi kinywa changu kilifunguliwa na sikuweza tena kunyamaza.

english: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
ekegusii: Naende ring’ana ri’Omonene rigaacha ase inde, riganteebia:
swahili: Ndipo neno la Bwana likanijia kusema:

english: “Son of man, those living in the ruins in the land of Israel are saying, ‘Abraham was only one man, yet he possessed the land. But we are many; surely the land has been given to us as a possession.’
ekegusii: “Aye Mwanyabaanto, abanto abwo bamenyete ase amaturi aaria ase ense y’Abaisraeli, nigo bagokwana, bateeba: Aburaamu nigo arenge omonto oyomo, na ere akanyora ense eye ekaba eyaye; korende intwe nigo tore abange, ekeene, ense eye nero twaeirwe ebe eyaito.
swahili: “Mwanadamu, watu wanaoishi katika magofu hayo katika nchi ya Israeli wanasema hivi, ‘Abrahamu alikuwa mtu mmoja tu, hata hivyo akaimiliki nchi. Lakini sisi ni wengi, hakika tumepewa nchi kuwa milki yetu.’

english: Therefore tell them that this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘You eat meat with the blood in it, lift up your eyes to your idols, and shed blood. Should you then possess the land?
ekegusii: “Ase ayio, bateebie ng’a aya naro Omonene agoteeba: Inwe nigo mokoria enyama ere namanyinga, naende nigo mokorigereria emegwekano yaino mogosasiima, boigo inwe nigo mogoitera amanyinga y abanto. Inee! Naki moranyare koira ense eye ebe eyaino?
swahili: Kwa hiyo waambie, ‘Hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo: Kwa kuwa mnakula nyama pamoja na damu na kuinulia sanamu zenu macho na kumwaga damu, je, mtaimiliki nchi?

english: You have relied on your swords, you have committed detestable acts, and each of you has defiled his neighbor’s wife. Should you then possess the land?’
ekegusii: Inwe nigo mwegenete emioro yaino; nigo mogokora ay’okogechia, kera oyomo oino nigo agotomana nomokuungu bw’omonto onde. Inee! Naki moranyare koira ense eye ebe eyaino?
swahili: Mnategemea panga zenu, mnafanya mambo ya machukizo na kila mmoja wenu humtia unajisi mke wa jirani yake. Je, mtaimiliki nchi?’

english: Tell them that this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘As surely as I live, those in the ruins will fall by the sword, those in the open field I will give to be devoured by wild animals, and those in the strongholds and caves will die by plague.
ekegusii: “Aye goika obateebie ng’a aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteeba: Ekeene, buna inche inde moyo, abanto abwo bamenyete ase amaturi mbakenywe nemioro, na abare isiko nintome ching’iti chi’orosana chibarie; abwo bamenyete ase ebitare na ime ase amakuruma, amarwaire amabe nabaite.
swahili: “Waambie hivi: ‘Hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo: Hakika kama niishivyo, wale waliobaki katika magofu wataanguka kwa upanga, wale walio nje mashambani nitawatoa wararuliwe na wanyama pori, nao wale walio katika ngome na kwenye mapango watakufa kwa tauni.

english: I will make the land a desolate waste, and the pride of her strength will come to an end. The mountains of Israel will become desolate, so that no one will pass through.
ekegusii: Ninsarie ense eyio ebe bosa kegima, ne chinguru chiabo echio chibaenenetie nchiere pi. Ebitunwa bi’Abaisraeli mbitigare bosa, monto onde takoba ogoetera aroro.
swahili: Nitaifanya nchi kuwa ukiwa na utupu na kiburi cha nguvu zake zitafikia mwisho, nayo milima ya Israeli itakuwa ukiwa ili mtu yeyote asipite huko.

english: Then they will know that I am the LORD, when I have made the land a desolate waste because of all the abominations they have committed.’
ekegusii: Ekero ’ndabe nasaririe kegima ense eyio yabo ebe bosa, ase engencho y’ebibe biabo bionsi bi’okogechia bakorire, erio mbamanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene. Ay’abete magega Ezekieli kabanire
swahili: Kisha watajua kuwa Mimi ndimi Bwana, nitakapokuwa nimeifanya nchi kuwa ukiwa na utupu kwa sababu ya mambo yote ya machukizo waliyotenda.’

english: and he sees the sword coming against that land and blows the ram’s horn to warn the people.
ekegusii: omonto oyio kararore omoro oyio ogocha igoro ase ense, abugie egetureeri ki’ogokuurera abanto.
swahili: naye auonapo upanga unakuja dhidi ya nchi na kupiga tarumbeta kuonya watu,

english: As for you, son of man, your people are talking about you near the city walls and in the doorways of their houses. One speaks to another, each saying to his brother, ‘Come and hear the message that has come from the LORD!’
ekegusii: “Aye Mwanyabaanto, abanto bao nigo bagosangererekana amo agwo ase chinyasi, na ase ebisieri bi’echinyomba, bagamba igoro yao, na kera omonto okwana nomogisangio oye, bateebania: Inchuo togende, toigwe ng’a naki ring’ana rikorwa ase Omonene rigoteeba.
swahili: “Kwa habari yako wewe, mwanadamu, watu wako wanaongea habari zako wakiwa karibu na kuta na kwenye milango ya nyumba, wakiambiana kila mmoja na mwenzake, ‘Njooni msikie ujumbe ule utokao kwa Bwana.’

english: So My people come to you as usual, sit before you, and hear your words; but they do not put them into practice. Although they express love with their mouths, their hearts pursue dishonest gain.
ekegusii: Ase ayio nigo bagocha ase ore buna abagocha ase omosangererekano, baikaransa ase obosio bwao buna abanto bane, barabwo baigwa amang’ana ogokwana, korende tibari koyakorera. Nigo bakworokia obwanchani obonge ase ebikoba igoro, korende ime ase chinkoro chiabo nigo bakwerigeria ebitoki.
swahili: Watu wangu wanakujia, kama wafanyavyo, nao wanaketi mbele yako kama watu wangu na kusikiliza maneno yako, lakini hawayatendi. Kwa maana udanganyifu u katika midomo yao, lakini mioyo yao ina tamaa ya faida isiyo halali.

english: Indeed, you are to them like a singer of love songs with a beautiful voice, who skillfully plays an instrument. They hear your words but do not put them into practice.
ekegusii: Naama! Aye kwabeire ase bare buna omonto obwate eriogi rigiya ogoteera amatera ay’okogokia, naende okobugia obokano buya. Nigo bakoigwa amang’ana ayio ao, korende tibari koyakorera.
swahili: Naam, mbele yao umekuwa tu kama yeye aimbaye nyimbo za mapenzi kwa sauti nzuri za kuvutia na kupiga vyombo kwa ustadi, kwa kuwa wanasikia maneno yako lakini hawayatendi.

english: So when it comes to pass—and surely it will come—then they will know that a prophet has been among them.”
ekegusii: Korende ekero amang’ana ayio araikeranigwe (ekiagera goika aikeranigwe), erio nario baramanye ng’a omobani narenge ase egati yabo.”
swahili: “Wakati mambo haya yote yatakapotimia, kwa kuwa hakika yatatokea, ndipo watakapojua kwamba nabii amekuwepo miongoni mwao.”

english: Then if anyone hears the sound of the horn but fails to heed the warning, and the sword comes and takes him away, his blood will be on his own head.
ekegusii: Omonto onde bwensi oraigwe eriogi ri’egetureeri ekio, korende taigwera ogokuurerwa okwo, omoro koramonyore omoite, okomocha kw’ogoiteka kw’amanyinga aye, nakobarwe igoro yaye.
swahili: kama mtu yeyote asikiapo sauti ya tarumbeta hakukubali kuonywa, basi upanga ujapo na kuutoa uhai wake, damu yake itakuwa juu ya kichwa chake mwenyewe.

english: Since he heard the sound of the horn but failed to heed the warning, his blood will be on his own head. If he had heeded the warning, he would have saved his life.
ekegusii: Ere nigo aigwete eriogi ri’egetureeri, korende taigwera ogokuurerwa okwo, ase ayio okomocha kw’ogoiteka kw’amanyinga aye nakobarwe igoro yaye. Korende karaigwere ogokuurerwa okwo, natoorie obogima bwaye.
swahili: Kwa kuwa alisikia sauti ya tarumbeta lakini hakukubali maonyo, damu yake itakuwa juu ya kichwa chake mwenyewe. Kama angekubali maonyo, angelijiokoa mwenyewe.

english: But if the watchman sees the sword coming and fails to blow the horn to warn the people, and the sword comes and takes away a life, then that one will be taken away in his iniquity, but I will hold the watchman accountable for his blood.’
ekegusii: Korende omorendi oria kararore omoro ogocha, na tabugia egetureeri, erinde abanto bakuurerwe, na omoro oria ochiche oite omonto onde obo, omonto oyio nakwe ore ase ebibe biaye, korende inche ninganie amanyinga yomonto oyio korwa ase okoboko kw’omorendi oria.
swahili: Lakini kama mlinzi akiona upanga unakuja na asipige tarumbeta kuonya watu na upanga ukija na kutoa uhai wa mmoja wao, yule mtu ataondolewa kwa sababu ya dhambi yake, lakini damu yake nitaitaka mkononi mwa mlinzi huyo.’

english: As for you, O son of man, I have made you a watchman for the house of Israel; so hear the word from My mouth and give them the warning from Me.
ekegusii: Ase ayio, aye Mwanyabaanto, nakobekire obe omorendi bw’Abaisraeli. Kero kende gionsi oraigwe ring’ana rikorwa ase omonwa one, obakuurere ribaga riane.
swahili: “Mwanadamu, nimekufanya wewe kuwa mlinzi kwa ajili ya nyumba ya Israeli, kwa hiyo sikia neno nisemalo na uwape maonyo kutoka kwangu.

english: If I say to the wicked, ‘O wicked man, you will surely die,’ but you do not speak out to dissuade him from his way, then that wicked man will die in his iniquity, yet I will hold you accountable for his blood.
ekegusii: Kondateebie omonto omokori amabe: Aye omokori amabe, goika okwe, na aye okire tokwana omokuurere ng’a aonchoke korwa ase enchera yaye embe, omokori amabe oria nakwe ore ase ebibe biaye, korende ninganie amanyinga aye korwa ase okoboko kwao.
swahili: Nimwambiapo mtu mwovu, ‘Ewe mtu mwovu, hakika utakufa,’ nawe hukusema neno la kumwonya ili atoke katika njia zake, yule mtu mwovu atakufa kwa ajili ya dhambi yake, mimi nitaitaka damu yake mkononi mwako.

english: But if you warn the wicked man to turn from his way, and he does not turn from it, he will die in his iniquity, but you will have saved your life. The Message of the Watchman
ekegusii: Korende korakuurere omokori amabe ng’a aonchoke atige enchera yaye, na ere aange koyetiga, oyio nakwe ore ase ebibe biaye, korende aye notoorie omoyo oo. Aya kera omonto agwenerete gokora
swahili: Lakini kama utamwonya huyo mtu mwovu aache njia zake mbaya naye hafanyi hivyo, atakufa kwa ajili ya dhambi yake, lakini utakuwa umejiokoa mwenyewe.

english: This is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, I am against the shepherds, and I will demand from them My flock and remove them from tending the flock, so that they can no longer feed themselves. For I will deliver My flock from their mouths, and it will no longer be food for them.’ The Good Shepherd (Psalms 23:1–6; John 10:1–21)
ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene agoteeba: Naama! Inche nigo inde mamincha y’abarisia abwo. Ninganie ching’ondi chiane korwa ase amaboko abo; nimbaange, tibakogenderera koba abarisia be ching’ondi chiane; abarisia abwo tibakogenderera kwerageria boka abanyene. Nintoorie ching’ondi chiane korwa ase emenwa yabo tichiba endagera yabo. Omorisia omuya
swahili: Hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo: Mimi ni kinyume na wachungaji nami nitawadai kondoo zangu mikononi mwao. Nitawafukuza kutoka kwenye kuchunga kundi langu, ili wachungaji wasiendelee kujitunza wenyewe. Nitaokoa kondoo zangu kutoka kwenye vinywa vyao, nao kondoo hawatakuwa tena chakula chao.

english: For this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, I Myself will search for My flock and seek them out.
ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene agoteeba: Naama! Ninche bweka omonyene ndarigie ching’ondi chiane, nchinyore na gochirenda.
swahili: “ ‘Kwa kuwa hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo: Mimi mwenyewe nitawaulizia kondoo wangu na kuwatafuta.

english: As a shepherd looks for his scattered sheep when he is among the flock, so I will look for My flock. I will rescue them from all the places to which they were scattered on a day of clouds and darkness.
ekegusii: Buna koreng’ana omorisia akorigia ching’ondi chiaye chiaserebekanire, ochisangereria amo naende, naboigo nainche ndasangererie ching’ondi chiane, nchitoorie korwa ase chinsemo chionsi aase chiaserebekanete gochia ase rituko rie rirumbe na omosunte omonene.
swahili: Kama vile mchungaji atafutavyo kundi lake lililotawanyika wakati akiwa pamoja nalo, hivyo ndivyo nitakavyowatafuta kondoo wangu. Nitawaokoa kutoka mahali pote walipokuwa wametawanyikia katika siku ya mawingu na giza nene.

english: I will bring them out from the peoples, gather them from the countries, and bring them into their own land. I will feed them on the mountains of Israel, in the ravines, and in all the settlements of the land.
ekegusii: Ninchirusie korwa ase egati y’ abanto b’ebisaku binde, nchisangererie korwa ase chinse ao ao, erio nchirente ase ense yabo abanyene. Nimbe ngochirisia igoro ase ebitunwa bi’Abaisraeli, na ase chindooche, na ase chinsemo chionsi chi’ense eyio chimenyire nabaanto.
swahili: Nitawatoa katika mataifa na kuwakusanya kutoka nchi mbalimbali, nami nitawaleta katika nchi yao wenyewe. Nitawalisha kwenye milima ya Israeli, katika mabonde na mahali pote panapokalika katika nchi.

english: I will feed them in good pasture, and the lofty mountains of Israel will be their grazing land. There they will lie down in a good grazing land; they will feed in rich pasture on the mountains of Israel.
ekegusii: Ninchirisie ase oborisia obuya. Ee, nchibe chikorisia ase oborisia obonoru bw’ebitunwa bi’Abaisraeli.
swahili: Nitawachunga kwenye malisho mazuri na miinuko ya mlima wa Israeli patakuwa mahali pao pa malisho. Huko watajipumzisha kwa amani katika nchi ya malisho mazuri, nao watajilisha huko katika malisho tele katika milima ya Israeli.

english: I will tend My flock and make them lie down, declares the Lord GOD.
ekegusii: Inche omonyene nindisie ching’ondi chiane, naende nchinyore aase chigotimokera. Nabo Omonene ateebire.
swahili: Mimi mwenyewe nitawachunga kondoo zangu na kuwafanya wapumzike, asema Bwana Mwenyezi.

english: I will seek the lost, bring back the strays, bind up the broken, and strengthen the weak; but the sleek and strong I will destroy. I will shepherd them with justice.’
ekegusii: “Echiasirete ninchirigie nchinyore, na echio chiaserebekanete nchiiranie asende; echibunegete ninchiboere ebitete, na echire chindeu ninchibeke chinguru; korende echire chinoru naende chire ne chinguru ninchisirie, ee, ninchigambie ekiina kia boronge.
swahili: Nitawaulizia kondoo waliopotea na kuwaleta waliotangatanga. Nitawafunga waliojeruhiwa na kuwatia nguvu walio dhaifu lakini wale waliojikinai na wenye nguvu nitawaangamiza. Nitalichunga kundi kwa haki.

english: This is what the Lord GOD says to you, My flock: ‘I will judge between one sheep and another, between the rams and the goats.
ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene agoteeba: Inwe ching’ondi chiane, ninache ekiina ase egati y’eng’ondi na eng’ondi ende, na ase egati ye chimingichi ne chigoree.
swahili: “ ‘Kwa habari yenu, enyi kundi langu, hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo: Nitahukumu kati ya kondoo na kondoo, kati ya kondoo dume na mbuzi.

english: Is it not enough for you to feed on the good pasture? Must you also trample the rest of the pasture with your feet? Is it not enough for you to drink the clear waters? Must you also muddy the rest with your feet?
ekegusii: Inee! Nigo are amang’ana amagusu ase more ng’a komwanyorire oborisia obuya, mwatiringera inse namagoro aino obonyansi obwatigaire? Naende komwanyure amaache amakenonoku, mwaturubania namagoro aino ayatigaire?
swahili: Je, haiwatoshi ninyi kujilisha kwenye malisho mazuri? Je, ni lazima ninyi kuyakanyaga pia malisho yenu yaliyobaki kwa miguu yenu? Je, haiwatoshi ninyi kunywa maji safi? Je, ni lazima kuyachafua maji mengine kwa miguu yenu?

english: Why must My flock feed on what your feet have trampled, and drink what your feet have muddied?’
ekegusii: Inee! Ching’ondi chiane nigo chirabe chikorisia obonyansi mwatiringire namagoro aino, naende chinywe amaache ayio mwaturubanirie namagoro aino?
swahili: Je, ni lazima kundi langu wajilishe kwa yale mliyoyakanyaga na kunywa maji mliyoyachafua kwa miguu yenu?

english: “Son of man, prophesy against the shepherds of Israel. Prophesy and tell them that this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Woe to the shepherds of Israel, who only feed themselves! Should not the shepherds feed their flock?
ekegusii: “Aye Mwanyabaanto, bana, oteebie abarisia b’Abaisraeli ng’a aya naro Omonene akobateebia: Obobe nobwaino, inwe abarisia b’Abaisraeli, ekiagera mwabeire mokwerageria inwe mweka abanyene! Inee! Tegwenereti abarisia barisie ching’ondi?
swahili: “Mwanadamu, tabiri juu ya wachungaji wa Israeli, tabiri na uwaambie: ‘Hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo: Ole wa wachungaji wa Israeli ambao hujitunza wenyewe tu! Je, haiwapasi wachungaji kutunza kundi la kondoo?

english: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says to them: ‘Behold, I Myself will judge between the fat sheep and the lean sheep.
ekegusii: “Ase ayio, aya naro Omonene agochiteebia: Inche bweka omonyene ninache ekiina ase egati ye ching’ondi chinoru ne chindeu.
swahili: “ ‘Kwa hiyo, hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi awaambialo: Tazama, mimi mwenyewe nitahukumu kati ya kondoo wanono na waliokonda.

english: Since you shove with flank and shoulder, butting all the weak ones with your horns until you have scattered them abroad,
ekegusii: Nigo mogosukia chiria chindeu namakere aino, na amareko, naende mwachitwoma ne ching’unchara chiaino, goika mwachisiarera gochia ase chinsemo chionsi chi’aare.
swahili: Kwa sababu mmewapiga kikumbo na kuwapiga kwa pembe zenu kondoo wote walio dhaifu mpaka wakawafukuza,

english: I will save My flock, and they will no longer be prey. I will judge between one sheep and another.
ekegusii: Ase ayio nintoorie ching’ondi chiane, gose tichikoba chigotwarwa buna ching’iti. Ninache ekiina ase egati y’eng’ondi na eng’ondi ende.
swahili: nitaliokoa kundi langu na hawatatekwa nyara tena. Nitahukumu kati ya kondoo na kondoo.

english: I will appoint over them one shepherd, My servant David, and he will feed them. He will feed them and be their shepherd.
ekegusii: Ninchibekere omorisia oyomo achirisie, nere Daudi, omosomba one. Ere nachirisie, abe omorisia obo.
swahili: Nitaweka juu yao mchungaji mmoja, mtumishi wangu Daudi, naye atawachunga, atawachunga na kuwa mchungaji wao.

english: I, the LORD, will be their God, and My servant David will be a prince among them. I, the LORD, have spoken. The Covenant of Peace
ekegusii: Inche Omonene nimbe Nyasae obo; na Daudi, omosomba one, abe omogambi ase egati yabo. Ninche Omonene nakwanire ayio.
swahili: Mimi Bwana nitakuwa Mungu wao, naye mtumishi wangu Daudi atakuwa mkuu miongoni mwao. Mimi Bwana nimenena.

english: I will make with them a covenant of peace and rid the land of wild animals, so that they may dwell securely in the wilderness and sleep in the forest.
ekegusii: Ninkore okobwatana kw’omorembe amo nabarabwo. Ninsirie ching’iti chintindi chirue ase ense eyio, na abanto bane mbamenye ase erooro na babe bakorara ase amanani bare n’obotoereru.
swahili: “ ‘Nitafanya nao Agano la amani na kuwaondoa wanyama wa mwitu kutoka nchi yao ili kondoo wangu waweze kupumzika nyikani na msituni kwa salama.

english: I will make them and the places around My hill a blessing. I will send down showers in season—showers of blessing.
ekegusii: “Nimbasesenie barabwo abanyene, na nigo ndasesenie aase onsi aetanaine egetunwa kiane. Nimbatwerie embura ase chingaki chindonge; embura eyio nebe ey’ogosesenia.
swahili: Nitawabariki wao pamoja na maeneo yanayozunguka kilima changu. Nitawanyeshea mvua kwa majira yake, kutakuwepo mvua za baraka.

english: The trees of the field will give their fruit, and the land will yield its produce; My flock will be secure in their land. Then they will know that I am the LORD, when I have broken the bars of their yoke and delivered them from the hands that enslaved them.
ekegusii: Emete y’emegondo ina yame amatunda abo, ne riroba ndiame endagera yaye; barabwo abanyene mbamenye ase ense eyio bare n’obotoereru. Ekero ndabune amakorogoto arue ase amagoti abo, mbatoorie korwa ase amaboko ay’abwo baabakorete abasomba, erio mbamanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene.
swahili: Miti ya shambani itatoa matunda yake na ardhi itatoa mazao yake, watu watakaa salama katika nchi yao. Watajua kuwa Mimi ndimi Bwana, nitakapovunja vifungo vya nira zao na kuwaokoa kutoka mikono ya wale waliowafanya watumwa.

english: They will no longer be prey for the nations, and the beasts of the earth will not consume them. They will dwell securely, and no one will frighten them.
ekegusii: Tibagotwarwa buna ching’iti naende nabaanto b’ebisaku, gose ching’iti chi’orosana tichikobaria. Mbabe bamenyete bare noborendi obuya, gose onde tari oraboboie.
swahili: Hawatatekwa tena nyara na mataifa, wala wanyama pori hawatawala tena. Wataishi kwa salama, wala hakuna yeyote atakayewatia hofu.

english: And I will raise up for them a garden of renown, and they will no longer be victims of famine in the land or bear the scorn of the nations.
ekegusii: Nimbamererie ebimeri bibe ogotogigwa okuya; barabwo mbamenye ase ense eyio, na enchara tekobaria ebaite, gose tibakoba bagochaaywa nabaanto batamomanyeti Nyasae.
swahili: Nitawapa nchi yenye sifa kutokana na mazao yake, hawatapatwa na njaa katika nchi tena wala hawatadharauliwa na mataifa.

english: You eat the fat, wear the wool, and butcher the fattened sheep, but you do not feed the flock.
ekegusii: Nigo mokoria echire chinoru, naende mwabeka chianga chiroisirie korwa ase amarionya abo; ee, nigo mokonyenya echire chinoru, korende timori korisia ching’ondi echio mochiigotie.
swahili: Mnakula mafuta ya wanyama, mnavaa mavazi ya sufu na kuchinja kondoo walionona, lakini hamlitunzi kundi.

english: Then they will know that I, the LORD their God, am with them, and that they, the house of Israel, are My people,’ declares the Lord GOD.
ekegusii: Barabwo mbamanye ng’a inche Omonene, Nyasae obo, nigo inde amo nabarabwo, naende ng’a Abaisraeli barabwo nabaanto bane. Nabo Omonene ateebire.
swahili: Ndipo watakapojua kuwa Mimi, Bwana, Mungu wao, niko pamoja nao, na kwamba wao, nyumba ya Israeli, ni watu wangu, asema Bwana Mwenyezi.

english: ‘You are My flock, the sheep of My pasture, My people, and I am your God,’ declares the Lord GOD.”
ekegusii: “Inwe neching’ondi chiane, ee, nigo more ching’ondi chie riicho riane, inwe nigo more Mwanyabaanto, na inche nigo inde Nyasae oino. Nabo Omonene ateebire.”
swahili: Ninyi ni kondoo wangu, kondoo wa malisho yangu, ninyi ni watu wangu, nami ni Mungu wenu, asema Bwana Mwenyezi.’ ”

english: You have not strengthened the weak, healed the sick, bound up the injured, brought back the strays, or searched for the lost. Instead, you have ruled them with violence and cruelty.
ekegusii: Echio chire chindeu, timori gochibeka chinguru, na echire chindwaire, timori gochigwenia, na echibunegete, timori gochiboera ebitete, na echiaserebekanire, timori gochiirania asende, na echiasirire, timori gochirigia; mwabeire mogochigambera ase ogochibetereria more nobotindi.
swahili: Hamkuwatia nguvu walio dhaifu wala hamkuwaganga wenye maradhi wala kuwafunga waliojeruhiwa. Hamkuwarudisha waliotangatanga wala kuwatafuta wale waliopotea. Badala yake mmewatawala kwa ukali na kwa ukatili.

english: They were scattered for lack of a shepherd, and when they were scattered they became food for all the wild beasts.
ekegusii: Ase ayio chiaserebekanire gochia aande onsi, ekiagera chitabwati omorisia, chiabeire endagera ye ching’iti chionsi chi’orosana, ee chiaserebekanire.
swahili: Hivyo walitawanyika kwa sababu hapakuwepo mchungaji, nao walipotawanyika, wakawa chakula cha wanyama wa mwitu wote.

english: My flock went astray on all the mountains and every high hill. They were scattered over the face of all the earth, with no one to search for them or seek them out.’
ekegusii: Bono ching’ondi chiane nigo chigotayaya ase ebitunwa bionsi, na ase kera ekegoro egetambe. Ching’ondi chiane chiaserebekanire gochia aande onsi ase ense, na onde tari ogochirigia gose gochiitaa.
swahili: Kondoo wangu walitawanyika, wakatangatanga kwenye milima yote na kwenye kila kilima kirefu. Kondoo wangu walitawanyika juu ya uso wa dunia yote bila kuwa na yeyote wa kuwaulizia wala wa kuwatafuta.

english: Therefore, you shepherds, hear the word of the LORD:
ekegusii: “Ase ayio, inwe abarisia, igwa ring’ana ri’Omonene.
swahili: “ ‘Kwa hiyo, ninyi wachungaji, lisikieni neno la Bwana:

english: ‘As surely as I live, declares the Lord GOD, because My flock lacks a shepherd and has become prey and food for every wild beast, and because My shepherds did not search for My flock but fed themselves instead,
ekegusii: Omonene Nyasae nigo agoteeba iga: Ekeene, buna inche inde moyo, ching’ondi chiane chiabeire chigotwarwa na koba endagera ya kera eng’iti y’orosana, ekiagera omorisia ataiyo, naende abarisia bane tibagendeti korigia ching’ondi chiane, korende babeire bakwerageria boka abanyene, na tari ching’ondi chiane bakorageria.
swahili: Kwa hakika kama niishivyo, asema Bwana Mwenyezi, kwa sababu kondoo zangu wamekosa mchungaji na hivyo wametekwa nyara na kuwa chakula cha wanyama wote wa mwituni na kwa sababu wachungaji wangu, hawakuwatafuta kondoo zangu, bali wachungaji wamejitunza wenyewe, nao hawakuwalisha kondoo zangu,

english: therefore, you shepherds, hear the word of the LORD!’
ekegusii: Ase ayio, inwe abarisia, igwa ring’ana ri’Omonene:
swahili: kwa hiyo enyi wachungaji, sikieni neno la Bwana:

english: Because you have said, ‘These two nations and countries will be ours, and we will possess them,’ even though the LORD was there,
ekegusii: “Aye nigo gwateebete: Ebisaku ebi bibere mbibe ebiane, ne chinse echio ibere chibe echiane, na intwe tochigambere, nony’Omonene omenyeteo.
swahili: “ ‘Kwa sababu umesema, “Mataifa haya mawili na nchi hizi zitakuwa zetu nasi tutazimiliki,” ingawa hata mimi Bwana nilikuwa huko,

english: therefore as surely as I live, declares the Lord GOD, I will treat you according to the anger and jealousy you showed in your hatred against them, and I will make Myself known among them when I judge you.
ekegusii: Ase ayio, inche Omonene Nyasae nigo ngoteeba iga: Ekeene, buna inche inde moyo, ningokorere koreng’ana nendamwamu yao, ne ribero ria’o, erio kwaorogetie, ekiagera ogechete Abaisraeli. Ekero ndakonachere ekiina, nimanyekane ase egati yabo.
swahili: kwa hiyo hakika kama niishivyo, asema Bwana Mwenyezi, nitakutenda kwa kadiri ya hasira na wivu uliouonyesha katika chuki yako juu yao nami nitafanya nijulikane miongoni mwao wakati nitakapokuhukumu.

english: Then you will know that I, the LORD, have heard every contemptuous word you uttered against the mountains of Israel when you said, ‘They are desolate; they are given to us to devour!’
ekegusii: Erio nario oramanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene. Inche naigure amang’ana ao y’okorama gwakwanire mamincha y’ebitunwa bi’Abaisraeli, kogoteeba: Biasarigwe biabeire bosa, biabekirwe ase amaboko aito tobirie.
swahili: Ndipo utakapojua kuwa Mimi Bwana nimesikia mambo yote ya dharau uliyosema dhidi ya milima ya Israeli. Ulisema, “Wamefanyika ukiwa na kutiwa mikononi mwetu tuwararue.”

english: You boasted against Me with your mouth and multiplied your words against Me. I heard it Myself!
ekegusii: Ekeene, naigure amang’ana aino amaange ay’ogwetogia mwakwanire mamincha y’ane.
swahili: Ulijigamba dhidi yangu na kusema maneno dhidi yangu bila kujizuia, nami nikayasikia.

english: This is what the Lord GOD says: While the whole earth rejoices, I will make you desolate.
ekegusii: “Aya nar’Omonene agoteeba: Ense yonsi negoke ekero ndagosarie obe bosa.
swahili: Hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo: Wakati dunia yote inashangilia nitakufanya ukiwa.

english: As you rejoiced when the inheritance of the house of Israel became desolate, so will I do to you. You will become a desolation, O Mount Seir, and so will all of Edom. Then they will know that I am the LORD.
ekegusii: Ekiagera kwagokerete ogosarigwa kw’omwando bw’Abaisraeli, ningosarie aye obe bosa. Ee, ningosarie aye egetunwa gia Edomu obe bosa, aye Edomu engima. Erio nario abanto baramanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene.
swahili: Kwa sababu ulishangilia wakati urithi wa nyumba ya Israeli ulipofanyika ukiwa, hivyo ndivyo nitakavyokutendea. Utakuwa ukiwa, ee mlima Seiri, wewe na Edomu yote. Kisha ndipo watajua kuwa Mimi ndimi Bwana.’ ”

english: “Son of man, set your face against Mount Seir and prophesy against it,
ekegusii: “Aye Mwanyabaanto, rigereria gochia ase Egetunwa gia Edomu, obaane mamincha yaye,
swahili: “Mwanadamu, elekeza uso wako juu ya mlima Seiri, utabiri dhidi yake

english: and declare that this is what the Lord GOD says: Behold, I am against you, O Mount Seir. I will stretch out My hand against you and make you a desolate waste.
ekegusii: ogeteebie ng’a aya naro Omonene agoteeba: “Aye Egetunwa gia Edomu, inche nigo inde mamincha yao, nindambore okoboko kwane igoro yao, ngosarie obe bosa.
swahili: na useme: ‘Hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo: Mimi ni kinyume nawe, ee mlima Seiri, nami nitanyoosha mkono wangu dhidi yako na kukufanya ukiwa na usiyekaliwa na watu wala kulimika.

english: I will turn your cities into ruins, and you will become a desolation. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
ekegusii: Nintagore emechie yao ebe amaturi, na ebe ense esaregete kegima ere bosa; erio nario oramanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene.
swahili: Nitaifanya miji yako kuwa magofu nawe utakuwa ukiwa. Ndipo utakapojua kuwa Mimi ndimi Bwana.

english: Because you harbored an ancient hatred and delivered the Israelites over to the sword in the time of their disaster at the final stage of their punishment,
ekegusii: “Nigo kwagendererete koba nobobisa ime ase enkoro yao igoro y’Abaisraeli, okabarua bagaitwa nemioro ase engaki y’emechando yabo, ekero baikerete engaki y’egesusuro ki’ebibe biabo.
swahili: “ ‘Kwa sababu ulificha moyoni uadui wa siku nyingi nawe ukawatoa Waisraeli wauawe kwa upanga wakati wa maafa yao, wakati adhabu yake ilipofikia kilele chake,

english: therefore as surely as I live, declares the Lord GOD, I will give you over to bloodshed and it will pursue you. Since you did not hate bloodshed, it will pursue you.
ekegusii: Ase ayio, Omonene Nyasae agoteeba iga: Ekeene, buna inche inde moyo, ningotige amanyinga ao aiteke, na ogoiteka okwo kw’amanyinga ao ngokobwatie: aye togecheti ogoiteka kw’amanyinga, ase ayio, ogoiteka kw’amanyinga ao ngokobwatie.
swahili: kwa hiyo hakika kama niishivyo, asema Bwana Mwenyezi, nitakutia katika umwagaji damu nao utakufuatia. Kwa kuwa hakuchukia kumwaga damu, kumwaga damu kutakufuatia.

english: I will make Mount Seir a desolate waste and will cut off from it those who come and go.
ekegusii: Ase enchera eye ninsarie kegima Egetunwa gia Edomu kebe bosa tikemenywa naende, ng’ite kera omonto oyogosoa aroro, na oyogosoka korwao.
swahili: Nitaufanya Mlima Seiri ukiwa na usiokaliwa na watu wala kulimika na kuukatilia mbali na wote wanaokuja na wanaokwenda.

english: I will fill its mountains with the slain; those killed by the sword will fall on your hills, in your valleys, and in all your ravines.
ekegusii: Ning’ichorie ebitunwa biao nabaanto baraitwe nemioro; ee, abwo baraitwe nemioro mbagwe ase ebigoro biao, na ase amakura ao, na ase chindooche chiao.
swahili: Nitaijaza milima yenu kwa watu wake waliouawa, wale waliouawa kwa upanga wataanguka juu ya vilima vyako na katika mabonde yako na katika makorongo yako yote.

english: I will make you a perpetual desolation, and your cities will not be inhabited. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
ekegusii: Ninkoonchore ogenderere koba bosa botambe, na emechie yao tekomenywa naende. Erio nario moramanye ng’a ninche Omonene.
swahili: Nitakufanya ukiwa milele, watu hawataishi katika miji yako. Ndipo utakapojua kuwa Mimi ndimi Bwana.

english: “And you, son of man, prophesy to the mountains of Israel and say: O mountains of Israel, hear the word of the LORD.
ekegusii: “Aye Mwanyabaanto, bana oteebie ebitunwa bi’Abaisraeli: Inwe ebitunwa bi’Abaisraeli, igwa ring’ana ri’Omonene!
swahili: “Mwanadamu, itabirie milima ya Israeli na useme, ‘Ee milima ya Israeli, sikieni neno la Bwana.

english: I will multiply the people upon you—the house of Israel in its entirety. The cities will be inhabited and the ruins rebuilt.
ekegusii: Ninsangererie abanto abange bache ase more bamenyeo, ee, Abaisraeli bonsi; emechie yaino nemenywe naende, na amatombe naro naagachwe naende.
swahili: nami nitaizidisha idadi ya watu kwenu, naam, nyumba yote ya Israeli. Miji itakaliwa na watu na magofu yatajengwa upya.

english: I will fill you with people and animals, and they will multiply and be fruitful. I will make you as inhabited as you once were, and I will make you prosper more than before. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
ekegusii: Ninsangererie goocha ase more abanto abange, ne ching’iti chinyinge. Abanto mbamentekane babuche, ne ching’iti boigo. Nintige momenye buna engaki eria ya kare, na nimbakorere amaya abuete aria amatang’ani. Erio nario moramanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene.
swahili: Nitaongeza idadi ya watu na wanyama juu yenu, nao watazaana sana na kuwa wengi mno. Nitawakalisha watu ndani yenu kama ilivyokuwa wakati uliopita, nami nitawafanya mfanikiwe kuliko hapo kwanza. Ndipo mtakapojua kuwa Mimi ndimi Bwana.

english: Yes, I will cause My people Israel to walk upon you; they will possess you, and you will be their inheritance, and you will no longer deprive them of their children.
ekegusii: Nindete Abaisraeli, abanto bane, bataare igoro yaino, mbaabaire inwe, na inwe mobe omwando obo. Timokogenderera goita abana babo.
swahili: Nitawafanya watu, watu wangu Israeli, kutembea juu yenu. Watawamiliki ninyi, nanyi mtakuwa urithi wao, kamwe hamtawaondolea tena watoto wao.

english: For this is what the Lord GOD says: Because people say to you, ‘You devour men and deprive your nation of its children,’
ekegusii: “Aya n’aro Omonene agoteeba: Abanto nigo bagoteeba ng’a aye ense nigo okoria abanto, naende gwaitire abana b’egesaku kiao.
swahili: “ ‘Hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo: Kwa sababu watu wanakuambia, “Unawala watu na kuliondolea taifa lako watoto wake,”

english: therefore you will no longer devour men or deprive your nation of its children, declares the Lord GOD.
ekegusii: Ase ayio bono tokogenderera koria abanto, gose goita abana b’egesaku kiao. Nabo Omonene ateebire.
swahili: kwa hiyo hutakula tena watu wala kulifanya tena taifa lako lisiwe na watoto, asema Bwana Mwenyezi.

english: I will no longer allow the taunts of the nations to be heard against you, and you will no longer endure the reproach of the peoples or cause your nation to stumble, declares the Lord GOD.” A New Heart and a New Spirit (Romans 8:9–11; Galatians 5:16–26)
ekegusii: Tinkogotiga osekererwe nabaanto b’ebisaku nonya ng’ake, gose togochaaywa n’abanto. Aye togotiga egesaku kiao kegwe. Nabo Omonene ateebire.” Obogima oboyia bw’Abaisraeli
swahili: Sitakufanya tena usikie dhihaka za mataifa, wala kudharauliwa na kabila za watu, wala kulifanya taifa lako lianguke, asema Bwana Mwenyezi.’ ”

english: Again the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
ekegusii: Naende ring’ana ri’Omonene rigaacha ase inde, riganteebia:
swahili: Neno la Bwana likanijia tena, kusema:

english: “Son of man, when the people of Israel lived in their land, they defiled it by their own ways and deeds. Their behavior before Me was like the uncleanness of a woman’s impurity.
ekegusii: Aye Mwanyabaanto, ekero Abaisraeli bamenyete ase ense yabo, bakayekora ekaba eyetachenegeti goetera ase chinchera chiabo na ogokora kwabo, ekiagera ogokora kwabo nigo kwabete ase obosio bwane buna ogotacheneka kw’omokuungu, ekero are nomotienyi.
swahili: “Mwanadamu, nyumba ya Israeli walipokuwa wakiishi katika nchi yao wenyewe, waliinajisi kwa mwenendo wao na matendo yao. Mwenendo wao mbele zangu ulikuwa kama mwanamke aliye katika hedhi.

english: So I poured out My wrath upon them because of the blood they had shed on the land, and because they had defiled it with their idols.
ekegusii: Nkaumora endamwamu y’ane ase bare, ekiagera baiterete amanyinga y abanto ase ense eye, na ekiagera bakorete ense ekaba eyetachenegeti ase ogosasiima emegwekano.
swahili: Hivyo nilimwaga ghadhabu yangu juu yao kwa sababu walikuwa wamemwaga damu katika nchi na kwa sababu walikuwa wameitia nchi unajisi kwa sanamu zao.

english: I dispersed them among the nations, and they were scattered throughout the lands. I judged them according to their ways and deeds.
ekegusii: Nkabasiarera gochia ase egati y’ abanto b’ebisaku, bakaba besiarerete ase chinse ao ao. Nkabanachera ekiina koreng’ana norogendo rwabo, na ogokora kwabo.
swahili: Nikawatawanya miongoni mwa mataifa, nao wakaenda huku na huko katika nchi mbalimbali, nikawahukumu sawasawa na mwenendo wao na matendo yao.

english: This is what the Lord GOD says: Because the enemy has said of you, ‘Aha! The ancient heights have become our possession,’
ekegusii: Aya nar’Omonene agoteeba: Ababisa baino baabasekereire, bagoteeba: Ahaa! Aase aimokererete igoro a kare ase baare gosasiimera abeire aaito.
swahili: Hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi asemalo: Kwa sababu adui wanasema juu yako, “Aha! Mahali palipoinuka pa zamani pamekuwa milki yetu.” ’

english: And wherever they went among the nations, they profaned My holy name, because it was said of them, ‘These are the people of the LORD, yet they had to leave His land.’
ekegusii: Korende aase aande onsi bagendete ase egati y’ abanto b’ebisaku ebio, nigo bakorete erieta riane richenu rikaba eritachenegeti, na abanto bagakwana igoro yabo, bagateeba: Aba nabwo abanto ba Omonene, nonya naboigo baserigwe korwa ase ense eyio yaye.
swahili: Tena popote walipokwenda miongoni mwa mataifa walilitia unajisi Jina langu takatifu, kwa kuwa watu walisema kuwahusu, ‘Hawa ndio watu wa Bwana, lakini imewapasa kuondoka katika nchi yake.’

english: But I had concern for My holy name, which the house of Israel had profaned among the nations to which they had gone.
ekegusii: Korende ngechandera erieta riane richenu erio Abaisraeli bagerete rigakorwa rikaba eritachenegeti ase egati y’ abanto b’ebisaku ebio ase bagendete.
swahili: Lakini niliwahurumia kwa ajili ya Jina langu takatifu, ambalo nyumba ya Israeli imelitia unajisi miongoni mwa mataifa huko walikokwenda.
