ekegusii: Korende abwo baabarire ng’a nabanene bare (tari gento ase ’nde nonya barenge nobonene bore naki; Nyasae tari nogwanchereria ase Mwanyabaanto), nakwanire ng’a abwo baabarire ng’a nabanene bare tibamentereti gento ase ’nde.
swahili: Kwa habari ya wale waliokuwa wakubaliwe kuwa viongozi (kwangu mimi sikujali vyeo vyao, maana Mungu hana upendeleo), wale watu hawakuniongezea chochote.

english: On the contrary, they saw that I had been entrusted to preach the gospel to the uncircumcised, just as Peter had been to the circumcised.
ekegusii: Korende bakarora ekeene, ng’a inche negenirwe koranderia abatarogeti enchiri, buna Petero egenetwe koyeranderia baria baarogete.
swahili: Badala yake walitambua kwamba nilikuwa nimekabidhiwa kazi ya kuhubiri Injili kwa watu wa Mataifa, kama vile Petro alivyokabidhiwa kuhubiri Injili kwa Wayahudi.

english: For the One who was at work in Peter’s apostleship to the circumcised was also at work in my apostleship to the Gentiles.
ekegusii: (Naki ere oyoete Petero chinguru koba omotomwa bw’abaarogete, nere ong’ete inche chinguru koba omotomwa bw’abaanto b’Ebisaku.)
swahili: Kwa maana, Mungu aliyekuwa akitenda kazi katika huduma ya Petro kama mtume kwa Wayahudi, ndiye pia aliyekuwa anatenda kazi katika huduma yangu kama mtume kwa watu wa Mataifa.

english: And recognizing the grace that I had been given, James, Cephas, and John—those reputed to be pillars—gave me and Barnabas the right hand of fellowship, so that we should go to the Gentiles, and they to the circumcised.
ekegusii: Naende ekero bachia komanya obuya boria naeirwe, Yakobo na Kefa, na Yohana, abasikire bare buna chisiiro, bagatoa inche na Barnaba okoboko gw’okorio gw’okobwatana, erinde intwe togende ase abanto b’Ebisaku, na barabwo bagende ase abanto b’okwaroka.
swahili: Basi, Yakobo, Kefa na Yohana, walioonekana kama nguzo za kanisa, walitupa mkono wa shirika, mimi na Barnaba walipotambua ile neema niliyopewa. Wakakubali kwamba sisi twende kwa watu wa Mataifa na wao waende kwa Wayahudi.

english: O foolish Galatians! Who has bewitched you? Before your very eyes Jesus Christ was clearly portrayed as crucified.
ekegusii: Inwe Abagalatia abariri! Ning’o obaarogete inwe? Amang’ana igoro y’okobambwa kwa Yeso Kristo nigo aorogetigwe ase more maiso marore.
swahili: Ninyi Wagalatia wajinga! Ni nani aliyewaroga? Yesu Kristo aliwekwa wazi mbele yenu kwamba amesulubiwa.

english: All who rely on works of the law are under a curse. For it is written: “Cursed is everyone who does not continue to do everything written in the Book of the Law.”
ekegusii: Naki baria bonsi basemeretie ogokora kw’amachiiko, nigo bare inse y’okoragererigwa, ekiagera neriikire, “Kera omonto oyotari kobwata onsi ayarikire ase egetabu y’amachiiko na koyakora oragererigwe.”
swahili: Kwa maana wote wanaotumainia matendo ya sheria wako chini ya laana, kwa kuwa imeandikwa, “Alaaniwe kila mtu asiyeshikilia kutii mambo yote yaliyoandikwa katika Kitabu cha Sheria.”

english: Now it is clear that no one is justified before God by the law, because, “The righteous will live by faith.”
ekegusii: Bono nigo are maiso marore, ng’a onde tari oranyore oboronge ase obosio bwa Nyasae ase amachiiko; ekiagera nigo ariikire, “Omonyene oboronge nabe moyo ase okwegena.”
swahili: Basi ni dhahiri kwamba hakuna mtu anayehesabiwa haki mbele za Mungu kwa kushikilia sheria, kwa maana, “Mwenye haki ataishi kwa imani.”

english: The law, however, is not based on faith; on the contrary, “The man who does these things will live by them.”
ekegusii: Amachiiko nigo are ao ase okwegena, ekiagera nigo ariikire, “Omonto oyorakore ayio nabe moyo ase aro.”
swahili: Lakini sheria haitegemei imani. Kinyume chake, “Mtu atendaye matendo hayo ataishi kwa hayo.”

english: Christ redeemed us from the curse of the law by becoming a curse for us. For it is written: “Cursed is everyone who is hung on a tree.”
ekegusii: Kristo natobooretie korwa ase okoragererigwa kw’amachiiko, ekero akoretwe koba okoragererigwa ase engencho yaito, ekiagera neriikire, “Kera omonto oyobambirwe igoro ase omote nigo are inse y’okoragererigwa kwa Nyasae.”
swahili: Kristo alitukomboa kutoka laana ya sheria kwa kufanyika laana kwa ajili yetu, kwa maana imeandikwa, “Amelaaniwa yeye aangikwaye juu ya mti.”

english: He redeemed us in order that the blessing promised to Abraham would come to the Gentiles in Christ Jesus, so that by faith we might receive the promise of the Spirit. The Purpose of the Law (Romans 7:1–6)
ekegusii: Igo ogosesenigwa okwo Aburaamu anyorete goikera abanto b’Ebisaku goetera ase Kristo Yeso, erinde tonyare konyora Omoika ase enchera y’okwegena, buna twarieretwe eira. Ogochika n’echiira
swahili: Alitukomboa ili kwamba baraka aliyopewa Abrahamu ipate kuwafikia watu wa Mataifa kwa njia ya Kristo Yesu, ili kwa imani tupate kupokea ile ahadi ya Roho. Sheria Na Ahadi

english: Brothers, let me put this in human terms. Even a human covenant, once it is ratified, cannot be canceled or amended.
ekegusii: Abaminto, ngokwana ’nde ase omobwekano bw’amang’ana a kera rituko. Ekero okoriera kw’omwando bw’omonto kogoikerana, onde tari oranyaare gokoonchora gose komenta ring’ana.
swahili: Ndugu zangu, nataka nitoe mfano kutoka maisha ya kila siku. Kama vile hakuna mtu awezaye kutangua au kuongeza kitu katika agano la mtu ambalo limekwisha kuthibitishwa, vivyo hivyo kwa hali kama hii.

english: The promises were spoken to Abraham and to his seed. The Scripture does not say, “and to seeds,” meaning many, but “and to your seed,” meaning One, who is Christ.
ekegusii: Chiira chiria chiarieretwe Aburaamu na omoiborwa oye. Biblia teri gokwana amang’ana aya, “Ase oroiboro” buna nase abange; korende eira iga erengete ase oyomo, “Ase omoiborwa oo”, nere Kristo.
swahili: Ahadi zilinenwa kwa Abrahamu na kwa mzao wake. Maandiko hayasemi “kwa wazao,” likimaanisha watu wengi, bali “kwa mzao wako,” yaani mtu mmoja, ndiye Kristo.

english: What I mean is this: The law that came 430 years later does not revoke the covenant previously established by God, so as to nullify the promise.
ekegusii: Aya ngokwana naya: Okobwatana koria gwakoretwe ritang’ani na Nyasae; na amachiiko aria akarentwa magega y’emiaka amagana ane, na emerongo etato, tagosaria okobwatana koria, erinde eira eria ebe eya bosa.
swahili: Ninachotaka kusema ni kwamba, sheria, ambayo ilitolewa miaka 430 baadaye, haitangui Agano lililothibitishwa na Mungu ili kuibatilisha ahadi ile.

english: For if the inheritance depends on the law, then it no longer depends on a promise; but God freely granted it to Abraham through a promise.
ekegusii: Naki omwando korabe ase amachiiko, tokoba naende ase eira; korende Nyasae akayoa Aburaamu ase eira.
swahili: Kwa maana kama urithi hupatikana kwa sheria, basi hautegemei tena ahadi, lakini Mungu kwa neema yake alimpa Abrahamu urithi kwa njia ya ahadi. Kusudi La Sheria

english: Why then was the law given? It was added because of transgressions, until the arrival of the seed to whom the promise referred. It was administered through angels by a mediator.
ekegusii: Amachiiko rende, inki agwenerete? Akamentwa ase engencho y’amamocho, goika omoiborwa oria orieretwe eira anyare gocha. Amachiiko aria nigo aruetwe goetera ase abamalaika ase okoboko kw’omobwatania.
swahili: Kwa nini basi iwepo sheria? Sheria iliwekwa kwa sababu ya makosa mpaka atakapokuja yule Mzao wa Abrahamu, ambaye alitajwa katika ile ahadi. Sheria iliamriwa na malaika kwa mkono wa mpatanishi.

english: I would like to learn just one thing from you: Did you receive the Spirit by works of the law, or by hearing with faith?
ekegusii: Tiga mbaborie ring’ana eri rioka: Igo mwanyorete Omoika ase ogokora kw’amachiiko, gose ase okwegena goetera ase okoigwa?
swahili: Nataka nijifunze neno moja kutoka kwenu: Je, mlipokea Roho wa Mungu kwa kushika sheria, au kwa kuyaamini yale mliyosikia?

english: A mediator is unnecessary, however, for only one party; but God is one.
ekegusii: Oyore omobwatania tari omobwatania ase oyomo, korende Nyasae noyomo. Engencho y’amachiiko
swahili: Basi mpatanishi huhusisha zaidi ya upande mmoja, lakini Mungu ni mmoja.

english: Is the law, then, opposed to the promises of God? Certainly not! For if a law had been given that could impart life, then righteousness would certainly have come from the law.
ekegusii: Inee! Amachiiko nigo are mamincha yechiira chia Nyasae? Yaya, taibo! Naki onye amachiiko aruetwe ayaranyare koa abanto obogima, anga oboronge nigo bwanyorekanete ase amachiiko.
swahili: Je basi, sheria inapingana na ahadi za Mungu? La hasha! Kwa maana kama sheria iliyotolewa ingeweza kuwapa watu uzima, basi haki ingepatikana kwa njia ya sheria.

english: But the Scripture pronounces all things confined by sin, so that by faith in Jesus Christ the promise might be given to those who believe.
ekegusii: Korende amariiko asiekeire bonsi inse y’okobua kw’ebibe, erinde abegenire baegwe ayio ariereretwe eira ase enchera y’okomwegena Yeso o Kristo.
swahili: Lakini Maandiko yamefanya vitu vyote vifungwe chini ya nguvu ya dhambi, ili yale yaliyoahidiwa kwa njia ya imani katika Yesu Kristo yapate kupewa wale wanaoamini.

english: Before this faith came, we were held in custody under the law, locked up until faith should be revealed.
ekegusii: Korende ekero okwegena gotaracha, nigo twabwatire inse y’amachiiko, twasibire goika okwegena goche koorokigwa.
swahili: Kabla imani hii haijaja tulikuwa tumewekwa chini ya sheria, tumefungwa mpaka ile imani ifunuliwe.

english: So the law became our guardian to lead us to Christ, that we might be justified by faith.
ekegusii: Naboigo amachiiko abeire omotebereria oito agotoira goika ase Kristo, erinde tonyore oboronge ase okwegena.
swahili: Hivyo, sheria ilikuwa kiongozi kutufikisha kwa Kristo, ili tupate kuhesabiwa haki kwa imani.

english: Now that faith has come, we are no longer under a guardian. Sons through Faith in Christ
ekegusii: Korende bono okwegena kogwachire, titori naende inse y’omotebereria.
swahili: Lakini sasa kwa kuwa ile imani imekuja, hatusimamiwi tena na sheria. Watoto Wa Mungu

english: You are all sons of God through faith in Christ Jesus.
ekegusii: Naki ime ase Kristo Yeso inwe mwensi mwabeire abana ba Nyasae ase enchera y’okwegena.
swahili: Kwa maana ninyi nyote mmekuwa watoto wa Mungu katika Kristo Yesu kwa njia ya imani.

english: For all of you who were baptized into Christ have clothed yourselves with Christ.
ekegusii: Ekiagera inwe mwensi, abamwabatisetwe ase Kristo, mwamweboire Kristo.
swahili: Kwa maana wote mliobatizwa ndani ya Kristo, mmemvaa Kristo.

english: There is neither Jew nor Greek, slave nor free, male nor female, for you are all one in Christ Jesus.
ekegusii: Aiga tari Omoyahudi gose Omogiriki, tari omosomba gose omosibore, tari omosacha gose omokungu, ekiagera inwe mwensi nigo more oyomo ime ase Kristo Yeso.
swahili: Wala hakuna tena Myahudi au Myunani, mtumwa au mtu huru, mwanaume wala mwanamke, maana nyote mmekuwa wamoja ndani ya Kristo Yesu.

english: And if you belong to Christ, then you are Abraham’s seed and heirs according to the promise.
ekegusii: Naki onye inwe naba Kristo, rirorio mwabeire oroiboro rwa Aburaamu, na abanyamwando ase eira.
swahili: Nanyi mkiwa ni mali ya Kristo, basi ninyi ni wa uzao wa Abrahamu na warithi sawasawa na ile ahadi.

english: Are you so foolish? After starting in the Spirit, are you now finishing in the flesh?
ekegusii: Nabo more abariri buna iga? Mogachaaka ase Omoika, na bono morigetie goikeranigwa ase chingencho chiaino abanyene?
swahili: Je, ninyi ni wajinga kiasi hicho? Baada ya kuanza kwa Roho, je, sasa mwataka kumalizia katika mwili?

english: Have you suffered so much for nothing, if it really was for nothing?
ekegusii: Inee! Igo mwanarete emechando emenge enga buna eye bosa? Aande gose tiyarenge bosa.
swahili: Je, mlipata mateso kiasi hicho bure? Ni kama kweli yalikuwa bure!

english: Does God lavish His Spirit on you and work miracles among you because you practice the law, or because you hear and believe?
ekegusii: Ere oyokobaa inwe Omoika na gokora ebikone bie chinguru egati yaino, Inee, igo agokora ayio ase ogokora kw’amachiiko gose ase okwegena goetera ase okoigwa?
swahili: Je, Mungu huwapa Roho wake na kufanya miujiza katikati yenu kwa sababu mnatii sheria, au kwa sababu mnaamini kile mlichosikia?

english: So also, “Abraham believed God, and it was credited to him as righteousness.”
ekegusii: Nabo “Aburaamu nigo amwegenete Nyasae, na ase engencho eyio akabarwa koba omonyene oboronge.”
swahili: Kama vile “Abrahamu alimwamini Mungu na ikahesabiwa kwake kuwa haki.”

english: Understand, then, that those who have faith are sons of Abraham.
ekegusii: Gaki manya iga, ng’a baria bare nokwegena, abwo nabwo bare abana ba Aburaamu.
swahili: Fahamuni basi kwamba wale walio na imani, hao ndio watoto wa Abrahamu.

english: The Scripture foresaw that God would justify the Gentiles by faith, and foretold the gospel to Abraham: “All nations will be blessed through you.”
ekegusii: Korende ayio amariiko aroche korwa kare, ng’a Nyasae nae abanto b’Ebisaku oboronge ase okwegena. Ase ayio akaranderia Aburaamu enchiri kare, akabora, “Asore aye abanto b’ebisaku bionsi nabasesenigwe.”
swahili: Maandiko yakitabiri kwamba Mungu angewahesabia haki watu wa Mataifa kwa imani, alitangulia kumtangazia Abrahamu Injili akisema kwamba, “Kwa kupitia kwako mataifa yote yatabarikiwa.”

english: So those who have faith are blessed along with Abraham, the man of faith. Christ Has Redeemed Us
ekegusii: Naboigo abwo bare nokwegena mbasesenirie amo na Aburaamu oyorenge omwegeni.
swahili: Kwa sababu hii, wale wote wanaoamini wanabarikiwa pamoja na Abrahamu, mtu wa imani. Sheria Na Laana

english: What I am saying is that as long as the heir is a child, he is no different from a slave, although he is the owner of everything.
ekegusii: Korende nigo ngokwana ng’a omonyamwando, ekero are omwana, tari nogwatananeka nomosomba, nonya ore omonyene enibo yonsi.
swahili: Lile nisemalo ni kwamba wakati wote mrithi bado ni mtoto, hana tofauti na mtumwa, ingawa ndiye mmiliki wa mali yote.

english: You are observing special days and months and seasons and years!
ekegusii: Nigo mokorenda mono amatuko, na emetienyi, na ebiro, na emiaka.
swahili: Mnaadhimisha siku maalum, miezi, nyakati na miaka!

english: I fear for you, that my efforts for you may have been in vain.
ekegusii: Noboire ng’a nigo nerosirie bosa ase engencho yaino.
swahili: Nina hofu juu yenu, kwamba kazi niliyofanya kwa ajili yenu inaweza kuwa nimejitaabisha bure.

english: I beg you, brothers, become like me, for I became like you. You have done me no wrong.
ekegusii: Abaminto, nabasoroire, mobe buna inche inde, ekiagera inche nigo nabeire buna inwe. Timwankorerete bobe bonde.
swahili: Ndugu zangu, nawasihi mwe kama mimi, kwa sababu mimi nimekuwa kama ninyi. Hamkunitendea jambo lolote baya.

english: You know that it was because of an illness that I first preached the gospel to you.
ekegusii: Inwe mwamanyire ng’a inabaranderetie enchiri ritang’ani ase engencho y’oboreu bw’omobere one.
swahili: Ninyi mwajua kwamba ni kwa ajili ya udhaifu wangu niliwahubiria Injili.

english: And although my illness was a trial to you, you did not despise or reject me. Instead, you welcomed me as if I were an angel of God, as if I were Christ Jesus Himself.
ekegusii: Nonya oboreu boria bwarenge ogoteemwa ase more timwanchayete gose timwanyangete, korende mokandoisia buna omomalaika o Nyasae ee, buna Kristo Yeso omonyene.
swahili: Ingawa hali yangu iliwatia majaribuni, hamkunidharau wala kunidhihaki, bali mlinikaribisha kama malaika wa Mungu, kama vile Kristo Yesu.

english: What then has become of your blessing? For I can testify that, if it were possible, you would have torn out your eyes and given them to me.
ekegusii: Ng’ai rende omogooko oino ore? Naki nababereire kirori, ng’a onye yanyarekana, anga mwanduseria amaiso aino mong’e.
swahili: Ile hali ya furaha mliyokuwa nayo imekwenda wapi? Naweza kushuhudia kwamba, kama ingewezekana mngengʼoa macho yenu na kunipa mimi.

english: Have I now become your enemy by telling you the truth?
ekegusii: Inee! Nabeire omobisa oino, ekiagera nabateebirie ayare ay’ekeene?
swahili: Je, sasa nimekuwa adui yenu kwa kuwaambia kweli?

english: Those people are zealous for you, but not in a good way. Instead, they want to isolate you from us, so that you may be zealous for them.
ekegusii: Baria bande mbare nomokia ase more, korende tari ase enchera ere engiya; mbarigetie kobasiekera isiko, erinde monyare gokora omokia kobakorera.
swahili: Hao wana shauku ya kuwapata lakini si kwa kusudi zuri. Wanachotaka ni kuwatenga mbali nasi, ili ninyi mpate kuwaonea wao shauku.

english: Nevertheless, it is good to be zealous if it serves a noble purpose—at any time, and not only when I am with you.
ekegusii: Korende mbuya botambe korigia omokia ase ring’ana rire rigiya, na tari ekero inde amo nainwe rioka.
swahili: Ni vizuri wakati wote kuwa na shauku kwa ajili ya kusudi zuri, si wakati nikiwa pamoja nanyi tu.

english: My children, for whom I am again in the pains of childbirth until Christ is formed in you,
ekegusii: Abana baane abake, ninde nokoromwa gw’okobina gw’okobaibora naende, goika Kristo arorekane ime yaino.
swahili: Watoto wangu wapendwa, ambao kwa mara nyingine ninawaonea utungu, ninatamani kwamba Kristo aumbike ndani yenu.

english: He is subject to guardians and trustees until the date set by his father.
ekegusii: Ere nigo are inse y’abareri na abarendi goika engaki eria yachigetwe na ise eike.
swahili: Yeye huwa yuko chini ya uangalizi wa walezi na wadhamini mpaka ufike wakati uliowekwa na baba yake.

english: how I wish I could be with you now and change my tone, because I am perplexed about you. Hagar and Sarah (Genesis 21:9–21)
ekegusii: Ee, anga nancha koba amo nainwe bono, na koonchora eriogi riane, ekiagera timanyeti inki ngokora ase more. Abana babere abamura
swahili: Natamani kama ningekuwa pamoja nanyi sasa, pengine ningebadilisha sauti yangu. Kwa maana nina wasiwasi kwa ajili yenu. Mfano Wa Hagari Na Sara

english: Tell me, you who want to be under the law, do you not understand what the law says?
ekegusii: Nteebie, inwe abamorigetie koba inse y’amachiiko, Inee, timori koigwera amachiiko?
swahili: Niambieni, ninyi mnaotaka kuwa chini ya sheria, je, hamjui sheria inavyosema?

english: For it is written that Abraham had two sons, one by the slave woman and the other by the free woman.
ekegusii: Naki neriikire, ng’a Aburaamu nigo arenge nabana babere abamura, oyomo bw’omokuungu omosomba, na oyomo bw’omokuungu omonyuome, oyotarenge omosomba.
swahili: Kwa maana imeandikwa kwamba Abrahamu alikuwa na wana wawili, mmoja wa mwanamke mtumwa na wa pili wa mwanamke huru.

english: His son by the slave woman was born according to the flesh, but his son by the free woman was born through the promise.
ekegusii: Korende omwana oria bw’omokuungu omosomba akaiborwa buna monto onde bwensi; na oria bw’omokuungu omonyuome, oyotarenge omosomba, akaiborwa ase eira.
swahili: Lakini, mtoto wa mwanamke mtumwa alizaliwa kwa mapenzi ya mwili, na yule mwingine wa mwanamke huru alizaliwa kutokana na ahadi ya Mungu.

english: These things serve as illustrations, for the women represent two covenants. One covenant is from Mount Sinai and bears children into slavery: This is Hagar.
ekegusii: Amang’ana ayio nigo agokwanwa buna omoreng’anio. Abakungu aba nabwo amabwatano abere. Okomo nigo gokorwa egetunwa Sinai, gokoibora abana ase obosomba; nere Hagari.
swahili: Mambo haya yanaweza kuchukuliwa kama mfano. Kwa maana hao wanawake wawili ni mfano wa maagano mawili: Agano la kwanza, ni lile lililofanyika katika Mlima Sinai, lizaalo watoto wa utumwa. Hili ndilo huyo Hagari.

english: Now Hagar stands for Mount Sinai in Arabia and corresponds to the present-day Jerusalem, because she is in slavery with her children.
ekegusii: Naki Hagari, engencho yaye egetunwa Sinai ekere Arabia, kegwekanirie na Yerusalemu ya bono, ekiagera nigo are ase obosomba amo nabana baye.
swahili: Basi Hagari anawakilisha Mlima Sinai ulioko Arabuni, na unafanana na Yerusalemu ya sasa ambayo iko utumwani pamoja na watoto wake.

english: But the Jerusalem above is free, and she is our mother.
ekegusii: Korende Yerusalemu ya igoro nomochie omosibore, noro baba oito.
swahili: Lakini Yerusalemu wa juu ni huru, nayo ndiye mama yetu.

english: For it is written: “Rejoice, O barren woman, who bears no children; break forth and cry aloud, you who have never travailed; because more are the children of the desolate woman than of her who has a husband.”
ekegusii: Naki neriikire, “Aye ore omogomba, otari koibora, goka! Aye otari nokobina ase okoibora, aka eriogi, orere nomogooko, ekiagera abana baye oria otigetwe nigo bare abange kobua abaye oyore nomosaacha.”
swahili: Kwa maana imeandikwa: “Furahi, ewe mwanamke tasa, wewe usiyezaa; paza sauti, na kuimba kwa furaha, wewe usiyepatwa na utungu wa kuzaa; kwa maana watoto wa mwanamke aliyeachwa ukiwa ni wengi kuliko wa mwanamke mwenye mume.”

english: Now you, brothers, like Isaac, are children of promise.
ekegusii: Gaki baminto, inwe nigo more abana b’eira buna Isaka.
swahili: Basi, sisi ndugu zangu, ni kama Isaki, tu watoto wa ahadi.

english: At that time, however, the son born by the flesh persecuted the son born by the Spirit. It is the same now.
ekegusii: Korende buna ase ekero keria oria oiboretwe koreng’ana buna onde bwensi nigo amochandete oria oiboretwe ase engencho y’Omoika, naboigo nonya ngoika bono.
swahili: Lakini, kama vile ilivyokuwa siku zile yule aliyezaliwa kwa mwili alivyomchokoza yule aliyezaliwa kwa Roho, ndivyo ilivyo hata sasa.

english: So also, when we were children, we were enslaved under the basic principles of the world.
ekegusii: Nabo naintwe, ekero twarenge abana, nigo twarenge abasomba inse y’amorokererio aye ritang’ani y’ense.
swahili: Vivyo hivyo na sisi, tulipokuwa bado watoto wadogo, tulikuwa utumwani chini ya taratibu za kawaida za ulimwengu.

english: But what does the Scripture say? “Expel the slave woman and her son, for the slave woman’s son will never share in the inheritance with the free woman’s son.”
ekegusii: Korende amariiko naki agoteeba? Igo agoteeba, “Seria omosomba oria amo nomwana oye, ekiagera omwana bw’omokuungu omosomba takonyora omwando nonya ng’ake amo nomwana bw’omokuungu omonyuome, oyotarenge omosomba.”
swahili: Lakini Maandiko yasemaje? “Mwondoe mwanamke mtumwa pamoja na mwanawe, kwa sababu mwana wa mwanamke mtumwa kamwe hatarithi pamoja na mwana wa aliye huru.”

english: Therefore, brothers, we are not children of the slave woman, but of the free woman.
ekegusii: Naboigo baminto, intwe titori abana b’omokuungu omosomba, korende nabana b’omokuungu omonyuome, oyotarenge omosomba.
swahili: Kwa hiyo ndugu zangu, sisi si watoto wa mwanamke mtumwa, bali wa yule aliye huru.

english: But when the time had fully come, God sent His Son, born of a woman, born under the law,
ekegusii: Korende ekero engaki yaigete, Nyasae agatoma Omwana oye; ere akaiborwa nomokuungu, akaiborerwa inse y’amachiiko,
swahili: Lakini ulipowadia utimilifu wa wakati, Mungu alimtuma Mwanawe, ambaye alizaliwa na mwanamke, akazaliwa chini ya sheria,

english: to redeem those under the law, that we might receive our adoption as sons.
ekegusii: erinde ababoorie baria barenge inse y’amachiiko, erinde tonyare gokorwa koba abana baye.
swahili: kusudi awakomboe wale waliokuwa chini ya sheria, ili tupate kupokea zile haki kamili za kufanywa watoto wa Mungu.

english: And because you are sons, God sent the Spirit of His Son into our hearts, crying out, “Abba, Father!”
ekegusii: Ekiagera inwe more abana baye, Nyasae agatoma Omoika bw’Omwana oye ase chinkoro chiaito, okorera, “Abba!” Engencho yaye “Tata!”
swahili: Kwa sababu ninyi ni watoto wa Mungu, Mungu amemtuma Roho wa Mwanawe mioyoni mwetu, anayelia, “Abba, Baba.”

english: So you are no longer a slave, but a son; and since you are a son, you are also an heir through God. Paul’s Concern for the Galatians
ekegusii: Ase igo, aye tori omosomba naende, korende Nyasae ogokorire koba omwana oye; na onye kwabeire omwana, naboigo kwabeire omonyamwando. Paulo ogosorora baria baonchogete tibairana magega
swahili: Kwa hiyo, wewe si mtumwa tena, bali ni mtoto, kwa kuwa wewe ni mtoto, Mungu amekufanya wewe pia kuwa mrithi kwa kupitia Kristo. Paulo Awashawishi Wagalatia

english: Formerly, when you did not know God, you were slaves to those who by nature are not gods.
ekegusii: Agwo ritang’ani, ekero motamomanyete Nyasae, inwe nigo mwarenge abasomba ase chinyasae chitare chinyasae bori.
swahili: Zamani, mlipokuwa hammjui Mungu, mlikuwa watumwa wa viumbe ambavyo kwa asili si Mungu.

english: But now that you know God, or rather are known by God, how is it that you are turning back to those weak and worthless principles? Do you wish to be enslaved by them all over again?
ekegusii: Korende bono, komwaikire komomanya Nyasae, gose kobua, mwamanyekanire na Nyasae, nase ki rende mokoiranera amorokererio aye ritang’ani, ayare amoro na amataka? Nase ki morigetie koyakorera naende?
swahili: Lakini sasa kwa kuwa mmemjua Mungu, au zaidi mmejulikana na Mungu, inakuwaje mnarejea tena katika zile kanuni za kwanza zenye udhaifu na upungufu? Mnataka ziwafanye tena watumwa?

english: It is for freedom that Christ has set us free. Stand firm, then, and do not be encumbered once more by a yoke of slavery.
ekegusii: Kristo agatosibora, erinde tomenye ase obosibore; gaki tenena bokong’u, timobwatwa naende ase obosibwa bw’obosomba.
swahili: Kristo alitupa uhuru, akataka tubaki huru. Hivyo simameni imara wala msikubali tena kulemewa na kongwa la utumwa.

english: I am confident in the Lord that you will take no other view. The one who is troubling you will bear the judgment, whoever he may be.
ekegusii: Ase Omonene ninde nogosemeria ase more ng’a timokoba nebirengererio binde ebiao, korende ere oyokobachanda nabogorie okogambigwa kwaye, naba onde bwensi.
swahili: Nina hakika katika Bwana kwamba hamtakuwa na msimamo mwingine. Mtu anayewachanganya anastahili adhabu, hata awe nani.

english: Now, brothers, if I am still preaching circumcision, why am I still being persecuted? In that case the offense of the cross has been abolished.
ekegusii: Korende baminto, onye inche ngendererete nonya mbono koraria amang’ana y’okwaroka, nase ki rende nkona‐gochandwa? Igo ekegocha ki’omosalaba kiarusigwe.
swahili: Lakini ndugu zangu, kama mimi bado ninahubiri kuhusu kutahiriwa, kwa nini bado ninateswa? Katika hiyo hali basi, kwazo la msalaba limeondolewa.

english: As for those who are agitating you, I wish they would proceed to emasculate themselves!
ekegusii: Anga nancha ng’a abwo bakobachanda begombayie abanyene. Obosibore goika bogamberwe nobwanchani
swahili: Laiti hao wanaowavuruga wangejihasi wao wenyewe!

english: For you, brothers, were called to freedom; but do not use your freedom as an opportunity for the flesh. Rather, serve one another in love.
ekegusii: Inwe abaminto, nigo mwarangeretigwe monyore obosibore; korende ogosiborwa kwaino tikoba ogw’okobwatia chingencho chiaino chi’ebibe, mbuya mokorerane inwe ase inwe ase obwanchani.
swahili: Ndugu zangu, ninyi mliitwa ili mwe huru, hivyo msitumie uhuru wenu kama fursa ya kufuata tamaa za mwili, bali tumikianeni ninyi kwa ninyi kwa upendo.

english: The entire law is fulfilled in a single decree: “Love your neighbor as yourself.”
ekegusii: Naki amachiiko onsi aikeranigwe ase ring’ana erimo, na rirorio nario eri, “Mwanche omogisangio oo buna bweanchete.”
swahili: Kwa maana sheria yote hukamilika katika amri moja: “Mpende jirani yako kama nafsi yako.”

english: But if you keep on biting and devouring one another, watch out, or you will be consumed by one another. Walking by the Spirit (Ezekiel 36:16–38; Romans 8:9–11)
ekegusii: Korende kerabe mokoromana na koriana, rigereria timocha gosirania inwe ase inwe. Okwama kw’Omoika na ogokora gwe chingencho chi’ebibe
swahili: Kama mkiumana na kutafunana, angalieni, msije mkaangamizana. Maisha Ya Kiroho

english: So I say, walk by the Spirit, and you will not gratify the desires of the flesh.
ekegusii: Gaki nigo nkobateebia, mogenderere ase Omoika na timogoikerania okogania gwe chingencho chiaino chi’ebibe.
swahili: Kwa hiyo nasema, enendeni kwa Roho, wala hamtazitimiza kamwe tamaa za mwili.

english: For the flesh craves what is contrary to the Spirit, and the Spirit what is contrary to the flesh. They are opposed to each other, so that you do not do what you want.
ekegusii: Naki okogania gwe chingencho chi’ebibe nigo gokoamererania n’Omoika na okogania kw’Omoika nigo gokoamererania ne chingencho chi’ebibe; naki ebi iga bikorwana goika timokonyara gokora ayamorigetie gokora.
swahili: Kwa maana mwili hutamani yale yaliyo kinyume na Roho, naye Roho hutamani yale yaliyo kinyume na mwili. Roho na mwili hupingana na kwa sababu hiyo hamwezi kufanya mnayotaka.

english: But if you are led by the Spirit, you are not under the law.
ekegusii: Korende komokoraagwa n’Omoika, rirorio timori inse y’amachiiko.
swahili: Lakini kama mkiongozwa na Roho, hamko chini ya sheria.

english: The acts of the flesh are obvious: sexual immorality, impurity, and debauchery;
ekegusii: Ogokora gwe chingencho chi’ebibe nigo kore maiso marore na korokwo nobotomani, eubi, obonyaka,
swahili: Basi matendo ya mwili ni dhahiri nayo ni haya: Uasherati, uchafu, ufisadi,

english: Take notice: I, Paul, tell you that if you let yourselves be circumcised, Christ will be of no value to you at all.
ekegusii: Igwa, inche Paulo nkobateebia nde inwe, ng’a moise kwarokigwa, rirorio Kristo takoba nengencho ende ase more.
swahili: Sikilizeni! Mimi, Paulo, nawaambieni kwamba kama mkikubali kutahiriwa, basi Kristo hatawafaidia chochote.

english: idolatry and sorcery; hatred, discord, jealousy, and rage; rivalries, divisions, factions,
ekegusii: ogosasiima emegwekano, oborogi, obobisa, eriomana, ribero, endamwamu, obong’iti, okwerusanania, ogweatanana,
swahili: kuabudu sanamu, uchawi, uadui, ugomvi, wivu, hasira, fitina, faraka, uzushi,

english: and envy; drunkenness, orgies, and the like. I warn you, as I did before, that those who practice such things will not inherit the kingdom of God.
ekegusii: emoko, oboiti, ogotinda, chigosori chimbe, na amang’ana ande buna ayio. Nabakuureire buna narenge kobakuurera ritang’ani, ng’a abwo bagokora amang’ana anga buna ayio, tibakonyora omwando bw’oborwoti bwa Nyasae.
swahili: husuda, ulevi, ulafi na mambo mengine yanayofanana na hayo. Nawaonya, kama nilivyokwisha kuwaonya kabla, kwamba watu watendao mambo kama hayo, hawataurithi Ufalme wa Mungu.

english: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness,
ekegusii: Korende okwama kw’Omoika nobwanchani, omogooko, omorembe, oboremereria, obwororo, obuya, obwegenwa,
swahili: Lakini tunda la Roho ni upendo, furaha, amani, uvumilivu, utu wema, fadhili, uaminifu,

english: gentleness, and self-control. Against such things there is no law.
ekegusii: oboitongo, okwerita ase onsi; machiko ande tari arange amang’ana buna ayio.
swahili: upole na kiasi. Katika mambo kama haya hakuna sheria.

english: Those who belong to Christ Jesus have crucified the flesh with its passions and desires.
ekegusii: Abwo bare abakristo Yeso baabambire chingencho chiabo chi’ebibe amo nokogania okobe na okorengereria kwabo.
swahili: Wote walio wa Kristo Yesu wameusulubisha mwili na shauku zake pamoja na tamaa zake.

english: Since we live by the Spirit, let us walk in step with the Spirit.
ekegusii: Onye intwe twabeire moyo ase Omoika, togenderere boigo ase Omoika.
swahili: Kwa kuwa tunaishi kwa Roho, basi, tuenende kwa Roho.

english: Let us not become conceited, provoking and envying one another.
ekegusii: Titoba nokogania kw’ogwetogia abanyene, titochegania, gose koba nemoko intwe ase intwe.
swahili: Tusijisifu bure, tukichokozana na kuoneana wivu.

english: Again I testify to every man who gets himself circumcised that he is obligated to obey the whole law.
ekegusii: Naende ngoteebia nde kera omonto oyokwarokigwa, ng’a rirorio osibirwe ase ogoikerania amachiiko onsi.
swahili: Namshuhudia tena kila mtu anayekubali kutahiriwa kwamba inampasa kushika sheria yote.

english: You who are trying to be justified by the law have been severed from Christ; you have fallen away from grace.
ekegusii: Mwatananirwe korwa ase Kristo, inwe abamorigetie konyora oboronge korwa ase amachiiko, mwagure korwa ase obuya.
swahili: Ninyi mnaotafuta kuhesabiwa haki kwa njia ya sheria mmetengwa na Kristo, mko mbali na neema ya Mungu.

english: But by faith we eagerly await through the Spirit the hope of righteousness.
ekegusii: Naki intwe ase Omoika ntoganyete oboronge boria tosemeretie ase enchera y’okwegena.
swahili: Kwa maana, kwa njia ya Roho kwa imani, tunangojea kwa shauku tumaini la haki.

english: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision nor uncircumcision has any value. All that matters is faith, expressed through love.
ekegusii: Naki ase Kristo Yeso okwaroka tikogokonyorera kende, gose ogotaroka, korende okwegena okwo nakwo kogokora emeremo ase obwanchani.
swahili: Kwa maana ndani ya Kristo Yesu, kutahiriwa au kutokutahiriwa hakuleti tofauti, bali lililo muhimu ni imani itendayo kazi kwa njia ya upendo.

english: You were running so well. Who has obstructed you from obeying the truth?
ekegusii: Nigo mwarenge kominyoka buya; ning’o obatangete timoigwera ekeene?
swahili: Mlikuwa mkipiga mbio vizuri. Ni nani aliyewazuia msiitii kweli?

english: Such persuasion does not come from the One who calls you.
ekegusii: Okoebereria okwo tikwarwete asare ere oyobarangeretie inwe.
swahili: Ushawishi wa namna hiyo haukutokana na yule anayewaita.

english: A little leaven works through the whole batch of dough.
ekegusii: Ememera emeke nigo ekobotia ribomba rigima.
swahili: “Chachu kidogo huchachua donge zima.”

english: Brothers, if someone is caught in a trespass, you who are spiritual should restore him with a spirit of gentleness. But watch yourself, or you also may be tempted.
ekegusii: Abaminto, onye omonto obuirwe nokomocha konde, inwe abamore ab’Omoika nebagwenerete koirania omonto oyio ase omoika bw’obwororo. Erigererie aye omonyene, tobaisa goteemwa.
swahili: Ndugu zangu, ikiwa mtu ameghafilika akatenda dhambi, basi ninyi mlio wa rohoni, mrejesheni upya mtu huyo kwa roho ya upole. Lakini jihadharini, ili ninyi wenyewe msije mkajaribiwa.

english: Therefore, as we have opportunity, let us do good to everyone, and especially to the family of faith. Final Warnings and Blessings
ekegusii: Nabo gatorabe ne ribaga tokorere abanto bonsi amaya, korende kobua mono abwo bare ab’okwegena. Ogokuurera na ogosesenigwa
swahili: Kwa hiyo, kadiri tupatavyo nafasi na tuwatendee watu wote mema, hasa wale wa jamaa ya waaminio. Si Kutahiriwa Bali Kuwa Kiumbe Kipya

english: See what large letters I am using to write to you with my own hand!
ekegusii: Rigereria, buna chinuguta chire chinene echi nabariikeire nokoboko kwane omonyene.
swahili: Angalieni herufi kubwa nitumiazo ninapowaandikia kwa mkono wangu mwenyewe!

english: Those who want to make a good impression outwardly are trying to compel you to be circumcised. They only do this to avoid persecution for the cross of Christ.
ekegusii: Bonsi abwo barigetie kororekana buya ase emebere yabo, abwo nabwo bakobabetereria ng’a mwarokigwe, erinde tibachandwa ase engencho y’omosalaba o Kristo.
swahili: Wale wanaotaka kuonekana wazuri kwa mambo ya mwili wanataka wawalazimishe kutahiriwa. Sababu pekee ya kufanya hivyo ni kuepuka kuteswa kwa ajili ya msalaba wa Kristo.

english: For the circumcised do not even keep the law themselves, yet they want you to be circumcised that they may boast in your flesh.
ekegusii: Naki nonya mbarabwo abanyene abaarogete tibabwateti amachiiko, korende mbarigetie inwe mwarokigwe, erinde banyare gwetogeria emebere yaino.
swahili: Hata wale waliotahiriwa wenyewe hawaitii sheria, lakini wanataka ninyi mtahiriwe ili wapate kujivuna kwa habari ya miili yenu.

english: But as for me, may I never boast, except in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through which the world has been crucified to me, and I to the world.
ekegusii: Ogwetogia kobe are nainche, otatiga inyetogerie omosalaba Omonene oito Yeso Kristo, ase oro ense yabambirwe ase ’nde, na inche ase ense.
swahili: Mungu apishie mbali nisije nikajivunia kitu chochote isipokuwa msalaba wa Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo, ambaye kwa yeye ulimwengu umesulubiwa kwangu, nami nimesulubiwa kwa ulimwengu.

english: For neither circumcision nor uncircumcision means anything. What counts is a new creation.
ekegusii: Naki okwaroka tai gento, gose ogotaroka tai gento, korende negento koba egetongwa ekeyia.
swahili: Kwa maana katika Kristo Yesu, kutahiriwa au kutokutahiriwa si kitu, bali kule kuwa kiumbe kipya ni kila kitu!

english: Peace and mercy to all who walk by this rule, even to the Israel of God.
ekegusii: Omorembe na amaabera bibe amo na bonsi abaragenderere ase ogochika oko, na amo n’Abaisraeli ba Nyasae.
swahili: Amani na rehema viwe na wote wanaofuata kanuni hii, na juu ya Israeli wa Mungu.

english: From now on let no one cause me trouble, for I bear on my body the marks of Jesus.
ekegusii: Korwa bono monto onde tanchanda; naki nabogoirie ekemanyererio kia Yeso ase omobere one.
swahili: Hatimaye, tangu sasa mtu yeyote asinitaabishe, kwa maana nachukua katika mwili wangu chapa zake Yesu.

english: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit, brothers. Amen.
ekegusii: Abaminto, obuya bw’omonene oito Yeso Kristo bobe amo nemioyo yaino. Amina.
swahili: Ndugu zangu, neema ya Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo iwe pamoja na roho zenu. Amen.

english: Carry one another’s burdens, and in this way you will fulfill the law of Christ.
ekegusii: Bogorerania chigurube inwe ase inwe, nario moraikeranie amachiiko a Kristo.
swahili: Chukulianeni mizigo ninyi kwa ninyi, nanyi kwa njia hii mtatimiza sheria ya Kristo.

english: If anyone thinks he is something when he is nothing, he deceives himself.
ekegusii: Naki omonto karekage ng’a ere naisaine, ere taisaini kende; igo akweng’aina ere omonyene.
swahili: Kama mtu yeyote akijiona kuwa yeye ni bora na kumbe sivyo, basi mtu huyo anajidanganya mwenyewe.

english: Each one should test his own work. Then he will have reason to boast in himself alone, and not in someone else.
ekegusii: Korende kera omonto arenge emeremo yaye omonyene. Onye ore nengencho y’ogwetogia, tiga ayietogerie bweka omonyene, na tereng’ania nomogisangio oye.
swahili: Lakini kila mtu na aipime kazi yake mwenyewe, ndipo aweze kujisifu, bila kujilinganisha na mtu mwingine.

english: For each one should carry his own load.
ekegusii: Naki kera omonto nebogorererie egurube yaye omonyene.
swahili: Kwa maana, kila mtu atauchukua mzigo wake mwenyewe.

english: Nevertheless, the one who receives instruction in the word must share in all good things with his instructor.
ekegusii: Korende ere oyokworokererigwa ring’ana, abwatane nere oyokomworokereria ase ebinto ebiya bionsi.
swahili: Basi, yeye afundishwaye katika neno na amshirikishe mwalimu wake mema yote.

english: Do not be deceived: God is not to be mocked. Whatever a man sows, he will reap in return.
ekegusii: Timong’aineka; Nyasae tagokorerwa echeche. Naki kende gionsi omonto agosimeka, nakio arache kogesa.
swahili: Msidanganyike, Mungu hadhihakiwi. Kwa kuwa kile apandacho mtu ndicho atakachovuna.

english: The one who sows to please his flesh, from the flesh will reap destruction; but the one who sows to please the Spirit, from the Spirit will reap eternal life.
ekegusii: Naki ere oyogosimeka ase chingencho chiaye chi’ebibe nache kogesa ogosareka korwa ase chingencho chiaye chi’ebibe, korende ere oyogosimeka ase Omoika nache kogesa obogima bwa kare na kare korwa ase Omoika.
swahili: Apandaye kwa mwili, katika mwili wake atavuna uharibifu, lakini yeye apandaye katika Roho, katika Roho atavuna uzima wa milele.

english: Let us not grow weary in well-doing, for in due time we will reap a harvest if we do not give up.
ekegusii: Titorosa gokora amaya, ekiagera natogese ekero engaki eraike, totakweti emioyo.
swahili: Hivyo, tusichoke katika kutenda mema, kwa kuwa tutavuna kwa wakati wake tusipokata tamaa.

english: This is the account of Noah’s sons Shem, Ham, and Japheth, who also had sons after the flood. The Japhethites
ekegusii: Oro narwo ororeeria rw’abana ba Nuhu: Shemu, na Hamu, na Yafeti. Na aba batato bakaibora abana abamura magega y’etoigo eria.
swahili: Hawa ndio wazao wa Noa: Shemu, Hamu na Yafethi, ambao walizaa wana baada ya gharika. Wazao Wa Yafethi

english: His kingdom began in Babylon, Erech, Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.
ekegusii: Omochakano bw’obogaambi bwaye nigo bware Babiloni, na Ereku, na Akadi, (na Kaline); eyio yonsi nigo yaare ase ense ya Sinari.
swahili: Vituo vyake vya kwanza katika ufalme wake vilikuwa Babeli, Ereki, Akadi na Kalne katika Shinari.

english: From that land he went forth into Assyria, where he built Nineveh, Rehoboth-Ir, Calah,
ekegusii: Akarwa ase ense eria, akagenda goika Asuri, akaagacha Ninawi, na Rehoboti‐Iri, na Kala,
swahili: Kutoka nchi ile alikwenda Ashuru, ambako alijenga Ninawi, Rehoboth-iri, Kala,

english: and Resen, which is between Nineveh and the great city of Calah.
ekegusii: na Reseni, omochie omonene oyorenge egati ya Ninawi na Kala.
swahili: na Reseni, iliyo kati ya Ninawi na Kala; huo ndio mji mkubwa.

english: Mizraim was the father of the Ludites, the Anamites, the Lehabites, the Naphtuhites,
ekegusii: Misiri neere esokoro ya Abaludi, na Abanami, na Abalehabi, na Abanafutu,
swahili: Misraimu alikuwa baba wa: Waludi, Waanami, Walehabi, Wanaftuhi,

english: the Pathrusites, the Casluhites (from whom the Philistines came), and the Caphtorites.
ekegusii: na Abapaturusi, Abakasiluhi, (korwa ase bare nao Abafirisiti barwete), na Abakafitori.
swahili: Wapathrusi, Wakasluhi (hao ndio asili ya Wafilisti), na Wakaftori.

english: And Canaan was the father of Sidon his firstborn, and of the Hittites,
ekegusii: Kaanani akaibora Sidoni, omwana oye omotangi, na Heti,
swahili: Kanaani alikuwa baba wa: Sidoni mzaliwa wake wa kwanza, Hethi,

english: the Jebusites, the Amorites, the Girgashites,
ekegusii: na Abayebusi, na Abaamori, na Abagirigasi,
swahili: Wayebusi, Waamori, Wagirgashi,

english: the Hivites, the Arkites, the Sinites,
ekegusii: na Abahivi, na Abaarikiti, na Abasini,
swahili: Wahivi, Waariki, Wasini,

english: the Arvadites, the Zemarites, and the Hamathites. Later the Canaanite clans were scattered,
ekegusii: na Abaarivadi, na Abaseremari, na Abahamati. Erio magega y’ayio eamate ya Kaanani egesiarera.
swahili: Waarvadi, Wasemari na Wahamathi. Baadaye koo za Wakanaani zilitawanyika,

english: and the borders of Canaan extended from Sidon toward Gerar as far as Gaza, and then toward Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim, as far as Lasha.
ekegusii: Orobebe rw’Abakaanani rogachaka korwa ase Sidoni, rokagenda enchera ya Gerari, rogaika Gasa, naende ase enchera ya Sodomu, na Gomora, na Adima, na Seboimu, rogaika Lasa.
swahili: na mipaka ya Kanaani ilienea kutoka Sidoni kuelekea Gerari hadi Gaza, kisha kuelekea Sodoma, Gomora, Adma na Seboimu, hadi kufikia Lasha.

english: The sons of Japheth: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.
ekegusii: Abana ba Yafeti nabwo aba: Gomeri, na Magogu, na Madai, na Yavani, na Tubali, na Mesheki, na Tirasi.
swahili: Wana wa Yafethi walikuwa: Gomeri, Magogu, Madai, Yavani, Tubali, Mesheki na Tirasi.

english: These are the sons of Ham according to their clans, languages, lands, and nations. The Semites
ekegusii: Aba nabwo abana ba Hamu, buna bareenge ase chiamate chiabo, na emenwa yabo, ne chinse chiabo, na ebisaku biabo.
swahili: Hawa ni wana wa Hamu kwa koo zao na lugha zao, katika nchi zao na mataifa yao. Wazao Wa Shemu

english: And sons were also born to Shem, the older brother of Japheth; Shem was the forefather of all the sons of Eber.
ekegusii: Shemu, oyorenge sokoro y’abana b’Eberi, naende oyio neere orenge omomura omonene omwabo Yafeti, akaiborerwa abana.
swahili: Shemu ambaye ni ndugu mkubwa wa Yafethi, kwake kulizaliwa wana pia. Shemu alikuwa baba wa wana wote wa Eberi.

english: The sons of Shem: Elam, Asshur, Arphaxad, Lud, and Aram.
ekegusii: Abana ba Shemu nabwo aba: Elamu, na Asuri, na Arifakisadi, na Ludi, na Aramu.
swahili: Wana wa Shemu walikuwa: Elamu, Ashuru, Arfaksadi, Ludi na Aramu.

english: The sons of Aram: Uz, Hul, Gether, and Mash.
ekegusii: Na abana ba Aramu nabwo aba: Usi, na Huli, na Geteri, na Masi.
swahili: Wana wa Aramu walikuwa: Usi, Huli, Getheri na Mesheki.

english: Arphaxad was the father of Shelah, and Shelah was the father of Eber.
ekegusii: Arifakisadi akaibora Sela, na Sela akaibora Eberi.
swahili: Arfaksadi alikuwa baba wa Shela, naye Shela akamzaa Eberi.

english: Two sons were born to Eber: One was named Peleg, because in his days the earth was divided, and his brother was named Joktan.
ekegusii: Eberi akaibora abana babere abamura. Omomura omotangi nigo aare korokwa Pelegi, ekiagera ase amatuko aye nario ense yaatananegete, na oyomwabo nigo aare korokwa Yokitani.
swahili: Eberi akapata wana wawili: Mmoja wao aliitwa Pelegi, kwa kuwa wakati wake ndipo dunia iligawanyika; nduguye aliitwa Yoktani.

english: And Joktan was the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,
ekegusii: Yokitani akaibora Alimodadi, na Selefu, na Hasarmaweti, na Yera,
swahili: Yoktani alikuwa baba wa: Almodadi, Shelefu, Hasarmawethi, Yera,

english: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,
ekegusii: na Hadoramu, na Usali, na Dikila,
swahili: Hadoramu, Uzali, Dikla,

english: Obal, Abimael, Sheba,
ekegusii: na Obali, na Abimaeli, na Seba,
swahili: Obali, Abimaeli, Sheba,

english: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab. All these were sons of Joktan.
ekegusii: na Ofiri, na Havila, na Yobabu. Abwo bonsi nabwo abana ba Yokitani.
swahili: Ofiri, Havila na Yobabu. Hawa wote walikuwa wana wa Yoktani.

english: The sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.
ekegusii: Na abana ba Gomeri nabwo aba: Asikenasi, na Rifati, na Togama.
swahili: Wana wa Gomeri walikuwa: Ashkenazi, Rifathi na Togarma.

english: Their territory extended from Mesha to Sephar, in the eastern hill country.
ekegusii: Ensemo eria bamenyete nigo yachakerete Mesa gochia Sefari, ase ebitunwa bia moocha.
swahili: Nchi waliyoishi ilienea toka Mesha kuelekea Sefari kwenye nchi ya vilima iliyoko mashariki.

english: These are the sons of Shem, according to their clans, languages, lands, and nations.
ekegusii: Aba nabwo abana ba Shemu, buna baareenge ase chiamate chiabo, na emenwa yabo, ne chinse chiabo, na ebisaku biabo.
swahili: Hao ndio wana wa Shemu kwa koo zao na lugha zao, katika nchi zao na mataifa yao.

english: All these are the clans of Noah’s sons, according to their generations and nations. From these the nations of the earth spread out after the flood.
ekegusii: Echio nachio chiamate chi’abana ba Nuhu, koreng’ana na ororeeria rwabo ase ebisaku biabo; na korwa ase bare ebisaku bigesiarera ase ense yonsi magega y’etoigo.
swahili: Hizi ndizo koo za wana wa Noa, kufuatana na vizazi vyao, katika mataifa yao. Kutokana na hawa mataifa yalienea duniani kote baada ya gharika.

english: And the sons of Javan: Elishah, Tarshish, the Kittites, and the Rodanites.
ekegusii: Na abana ba Yavani nabwo aba: Elisha, na Tarisisi, na Kitimu, na Rodani.
swahili: Wana wa Yavani walikuwa: Elisha, Tarshishi, Kitimu na Rodanimu.

english: From these, the maritime peoples separated into their territories, according to their languages, by clans within their nations. The Hamites
ekegusii: Aba nabwo chisokoro chi’abaanto abwo bamenyete mbarabare ye nyancha na as’ebisinka. Barabwo nororeeria rwa Yebita abwo bamenyete kera oyomo ase egesaku kiaye, ne chingongo chiabo na kera oyomo ase omonwa oye areenge gokwana.
swahili: (Kutokana na hawa mataifa ya Pwani yalienea katika nchi zao, kwa koo zao katika mataifa yao, kila moja kwa lugha yake.) Wazao Wa Hamu

english: The sons of Ham: Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.
ekegusii: Na abana ba Hamu nabwo aba: Kusi, na Misiri, na Putu, na Kaanani.
swahili: Wana wa Hamu walikuwa: Kushi, Misraimu, Putu na Kanaani.

english: The sons of Cush: Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah, and Sabteca. And the sons of Raamah: Sheba and Dedan.
ekegusii: Na abana ba Kusi nabwo aba: Seba, na Havila, na Sabuta, na Raama, na Sabiteka. Na abana ba Raama nabwo aba: Seba na Dedani.
swahili: Wana wa Kushi walikuwa: Seba, Havila, Sabta, Raama na Sabteka. Wana wa Raama walikuwa: Sheba na Dedani.

english: Cush was the father of Nimrod, who began to be a mighty one on the earth.
ekegusii: Kusi akaibora Nimurodi. Nimurodi akaba omonto bw’eritang’ani oyorenge nokobua ase ense.
swahili: Kushi akamzaa Nimrodi, ambaye alikua akawa mtu shujaa duniani.

english: He was a mighty hunter before the LORD; so it is said, “Like Nimrod, a mighty hunter before the LORD.”
ekegusii: Ere nigo areenge omotwari omokong’u bwe ching’iti, ase obosio bw’ Omonene. Ase ayio, igo abanto banarete goteeba igoro y’omonto: “Igo anga buna Nimurodi, omotwari omokong’u bwe ching’iti, ase obosio bw’ Omonene.”
swahili: Alikuwa mwindaji hodari mbele za Bwana. Ndiyo sababu watu husema, “Kama Nimrodi, hodari wa kuwinda mbele za Bwana.”

english: Now the whole world had one language and a common form of speech.
ekegusii: Abanto b’ense engima nigo baarenge nomonwa oyomo na amang’ana abwekaine.
swahili: Wakati huo dunia yote ilikuwa na lugha moja na msemo mmoja.

english: This is the account of Shem. Two years after the flood, when Shem was 100 years old, he became the father of Arphaxad.
ekegusii: Oyo noro omooroberio bw’ororeeria rwa Shemu. Ekero konya Shemu aikire emiaka rigana erimo (100), akaibora Arifakisadi; ekaba emiaka ebere magega y’etoigo eria.
swahili: Hivi ndivyo vizazi vya Shemu. Miaka miwili baada ya gharika, Shemu alipokuwa na miaka 100, akamzaa Arfaksadi.

english: And after he had become the father of Arphaxad, Shem lived 500 years and had other sons and daughters.
ekegusii: Magega y’okoiborwa kwa Arifakisadi, Shemu naende akamenya emiaka amagana atano (500), akaibora abana bande, abamura na abaiseke.
swahili: Baada ya kumzaa Arfaksadi, Shemu aliishi miaka 500, akazaa watoto wengine wa kiume na wa kike.

english: When Arphaxad was 35 years old, he became the father of Shelah.
ekegusii: Ekero konya Arifakisadi aikire emiaka emerongo etato, na etano (35) akaibora Sela.
swahili: Wakati Arfaksadi alipokuwa na miaka thelathini na mitano, akamzaa Shela.

english: And after he had become the father of Shelah, Arphaxad lived 403 years and had other sons and daughters.
ekegusii: Magega y’okoiborwa gwa Sela, Arifakisadi nigo kakoorete emiaka amagana ane, na etato (403), akamanya akaibora abana bande, abamura na abaiseke.
swahili: Baada ya Arfaksadi kumzaa Shela, aliishi miaka 403, akazaa watoto wengine wa kiume na wa kike.

english: When Shelah was 30 years old, he became the father of Eber.
ekegusii: Ekero konya Sela akoorire emiaka emerongo etato (30), akaibora Eberi.
swahili: Shela alipokuwa na miaka thelathini, akamzaa Eberi.

english: And after he had become the father of Eber, Shelah lived 403 years and had other sons and daughters.
ekegusii: Magega y’okoiborwa kwa Eberi, Sela agaika emiaka amagana ane, na etato (403), erio akaibora abana bande, abamura na abaiseke.
swahili: Shela baada ya kumzaa Eberi, aliishi miaka 403, akazaa watoto wengine wa kiume na wa kike.

english: When Eber was 34 years old, he became the father of Peleg.
ekegusii: Ekero konya Eberi aikire emiaka emerongo etato, na ene (34), akaibora Pelegi.
swahili: Eberi alipokuwa na miaka thelathini na minne, akamzaa Pelegi.

english: And after he had become the father of Peleg, Eber lived 430 years and had other sons and daughters.
ekegusii: Magega y’okoiborwa gwa Pelegi, Eberi agakoora emiaka amagana ane, na emerongo etato (430), akaibora abana bande, abamura na abaiseke.
swahili: Baada ya Eberi kumzaa Pelegi, aliishi miaka 430, akazaa watoto wengine wa kiume na wa kike.

english: When Peleg was 30 years old, he became the father of Reu.
ekegusii: Ekero konya Pelegi aikire emiaka emerongo etato (30), akaibora Reu.
swahili: Pelegi alipokuwa na miaka thelathini, akamzaa Reu.

english: And after he had become the father of Reu, Peleg lived 209 years and had other sons and daughters.
ekegusii: Magega y’okoiborwa kwa Reu, Pelegi gaikire emiaka amagana abere, na kianda (209), akaibora abana bande, abamura na abaiseke.
swahili: Baada ya Pelegi kumzaa Reu, aliishi miaka 209, akazaa watoto wengine wa kiume na wa kike.

english: And as people journeyed eastward, they found a plain in the land of Shinar and settled there.
ekegusii: Abanto abwo bakaimoka kogenda orogendo gochia ensemo ya moocha, bakanyora ense omweya ase ense ya Shinari, bagachaaka komenya aroro.
swahili: Watu walipoelekea upande wa mashariki, wakafika kwenye tambarare katika nchi ya Shinari nao wakaishi huko.

english: When Reu was 32 years old, he became the father of Serug.
ekegusii: Ekero konya Reu aikire emiaka emerongo etato, na ebere (32), akaibora Serugi,
swahili: Reu alipokuwa na miaka thelathini na miwili, akamzaa Serugi.

english: And after he had become the father of Serug, Reu lived 207 years and had other sons and daughters.
ekegusii: Magega y’okoiborwa gwa Serugi, Reu gaikire emiaka amagana abere, na etano na ebere (207), akaibora abana abamura na abaiseke.
swahili: Baada ya Reu kumzaa Serugi, aliishi miaka 207, akazaa watoto wengine wa kiume na wa kike.

english: When Serug was 30 years old, he became the father of Nahor.
ekegusii: Ekero konya Serugi aikire emiaka emerongo etato (30) akaibora Nahori.
swahili: Serugi alipokuwa na miaka thelathini, akamzaa Nahori.

english: And after he had become the father of Nahor, Serug lived 200 years and had other sons and daughters.
ekegusii: Magega y’okoiborwa kwa Nahori, Serugi agaika emiaka amagana abere (200), akaibora abana bande, abamura na abaiseke.
swahili: Baada ya Serugi kumzaa Nahori, aliishi miaka 200, akazaa watoto wengine wa kiume na wa kike.

english: When Nahor was 29 years old, he became the father of Terah.
ekegusii: Ekero konya Nahori aikire emiaka emerongo ebere, na kianda (29), akaibora Tera.
swahili: Nahori alipokuwa na miaka ishirini na tisa, akamzaa Tera.

english: And after he had become the father of Terah, Nahor lived 119 years and had other sons and daughters.
ekegusii: Magega y’okoiborwa gwa Tera, Nahori gaikire emiaka rigana erimo, na ikomi na kianda (119), akaibora abana bande, abamura na abaiseke.
swahili: Baada ya Nahori kumzaa Tera, aliishi miaka 119, akazaa watoto wengine wa kiume na wa kike.

english: When Terah was 70 years old, he became the father of Abram, Nahor, and Haran. Terah’s Descendants
ekegusii: Ekero konya Tera aikire emiaka emerongo etano na ebere (70), akaibora Aburamu, na Nahori, na Harani. Ororeeria rwa Tera
swahili: Tera alipokuwa na miaka sabini, akamzaa Abramu, Nahori na Harani. Wazao Wa Tera

english: This is the account of Terah. Terah became the father of Abram, Nahor, and Haran. And Haran became the father of Lot.
ekegusii: Oyo noro omoroberio bw’ororeeria rwa Tera. Tera akaibora Aburamu, na Nahori, na Harani. Harani akaibora Loti.
swahili: Hawa ndio wazao wa Tera. Tera aliwazaa Abramu, Nahori na Harani. Harani akamzaa Loti.

english: During his father Terah’s lifetime, Haran died in his native land, in Ur of the Chaldeans.
ekegusii: Harani agatanga gokwa, agatiga Tera ise ore moyo, ase ense eria aiboreretwe, ase Uru y’Abakalidayo.
swahili: Tera alipokuwa bado hai, Harani akafa huko Uru ya Wakaldayo, nchi alimozaliwa.

english: And Abram and Nahor took wives for themselves. Abram’s wife was named Sarai, and Nahor’s wife was named Milcah; she was the daughter of Haran, who was the father of both Milcah and Iscah.
ekegusii: Aburamu na Nahori bakanyuoma abarugi. Moka Aburamu nigo areenge korokwa Sarai, na moka Nahori Milka, omwana omosubati o Harani; oyio nere orenge ise Milka na Isika.
swahili: Abramu na Nahori walioa. Mke wa Abramu aliitwa Sarai, na mke wa Nahori aliitwa Milka; Milka na Iska walikuwa watoto wa Harani.

english: And they said to one another, “Come, let us make bricks and bake them thoroughly.” So they used brick instead of stone, and tar instead of mortar.
ekegusii: Barabwo bagateebania: “Inchuo, toroisie amatobori na toyasambe nomorero.” Igo bakanyora amatabori ribaga ri’amagena, na bakore esike gete ase okoyabwaterania.
swahili: Wakasemezana wao kwa wao, “Njooni, tufyatue matofali na tuyachome vizuri kwa moto.” Walitumia matofali badala ya mawe, na lami kwa ajili ya kushikamanishia hayo matofali.

english: But Sarai was barren; she had no children.
ekegusii: Korende Sarai igo areenge omogomba, tabwate mwana.
swahili: Sarai alikuwa tasa, hakuwa na watoto.

english: And Terah took his son Abram, his grandson Lot son of Haran, and his daughter-in-law Sarai the wife of Abram, and they set out from Ur of the Chaldeans for the land of Canaan. But when they arrived in Haran, they settled there.
ekegusii: Tera akaira Aburamu omwana oye, na Loti omochokoro oye, omwana o Harani, amo na Sarai, moka momura oye Aburamu; bakagenda komo gochia Uru y’Abakalidayo, bakagenda goika ense ya Kaanani. Korende ekero baigete omochie o Harani, bakamenya aroro.
swahili: Tera akamchukua Abramu mwanawe, Loti mwana wa Harani mwanawe, na Sarai mkwewe, mke wa Abramu mwanawe, wakatoka kwa pamoja katika Uru ya Wakaldayo kwenda nchi ya Kanaani. Lakini walipofika Harani, wakaishi huko.

english: Terah lived 205 years, and he died in Haran.
ekegusii: Tera agaika emiaka amagana abere, na etano (205); erio agakwera aaria Harani.
swahili: Tera alikufa huko Harani akiwa na miaka 205.

english: “Come,” they said, “let us build for ourselves a city with a tower that reaches to the heavens, that we may make a name for ourselves and not be scattered over the face of all the earth.”
ekegusii: Erio bagateeba: “Inchuo tweagachere omochie na omoorobiri, na obotambe bwaye boike erioba igoro, tweekorere erieta rinene, titobaisa gocha goserebanigwa ase ense yonsi.”
swahili: Ndipo wakasema, “Njooni, tujijengee mji wenye mnara ambao utafika hadi mbinguni, ili tujipatie jina tusije tukatawanyika usoni pa dunia yote.”

english: Then the LORD came down to see the city and the tower that the sons of men were building.
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene agaika goocha inse, erinde arore omochie na omoorobiri oyio abana ba Mwanyabaanto konya baagachire.
swahili: Lakini Bwana akashuka ili auone mji na mnara ambao wanadamu waliokuwa wanaujenga.

english: And the LORD said, “If they have begun to do this as one people speaking the same language, then nothing they devise will be beyond them.
ekegusii: Omonene agateeba: “Rora, abanto aba negesaku ekemo, na bagokwana omonwa oyomo bonsi na amang’ana abwekaine. Na bono rora, aya naro bachakire gokora, eyio ekworokia ng’a magega y’ayio tibagosinywa gento kende gionsi baraarengererie gokora.
swahili: Bwana akasema, “Ikiwa kama taifa moja wanaozungumza lugha moja wameanza kufanya hili, basi hakuna lolote watakalopanga kufanya ambalo halitawezekana kwao.

english: Come, let Us go down and confuse their language, so that they will not understand one another’s speech.”
ekegusii: Eta togende toike inse ase bare, tobatantanie ase omonbwa obo tibaigwana ase chinkwana chiao barabwo ase barabwo.”
swahili: Njooni, tushuke tuvuruge lugha yao ili wasielewane wao kwa wao.”

english: So the LORD scattered them from there over the face of all the earth, and they stopped building the city.
ekegusii: Ase igo, Omonene akabaserebania korwa agwo, bagesiarera ase ense yonsi, na abamenyeo. Erio bagatiga koagacha omochie oria.
swahili: Hivyo Bwana akawatawanya kutoka mahali pale kwenda katika dunia yote, nao wakaacha kuujenga huo mji.

english: That is why it is called Babel, for there the LORD confused the language of the whole world, and from that place the LORD scattered them over the face of all the earth. Genealogy from Shem to Abram (1 Chronicles 1:17–27)
ekegusii: Aase ayio baare koagacha akarokwa Babiloni, ekiagera Omonene atantanetie omonwa bw’abaanto b’ense yonsi, na korwa agwo Omonene akabaserebania erio bagende ense yonsi, bayemenye. Ororeeria rwa Shemu
swahili: Ndiyo maana pakaitwa Babeli, kwa sababu hapo ndipo Bwana alipoivuruga lugha ya dunia nzima. Kutoka hapo Bwana akawatawanya katika uso wa dunia yote. Shemu Hadi Abramu (1 Nyakati 1:24-27)

english: Then the LORD said to Abram, “Leave your country, your kindred, and your father’s household, and go to the land I will show you.
ekegusii: Omonene agakwana na Aburamu, akamoteebia: “Karwe ase ense eye yao, na ase eamate yao, na ase omochie o iso bwonsi, ogende goika ense ndakworokie.
swahili: Bwana akawa amemwambia Abramu, “Ondoka kutoka nchi yako, uache jamii yako na nyumba ya baba yako, uende hadi nchi nitakayokuonyesha.

english: Now there was a famine in the land. So Abram went down to Egypt to live there for a while because the famine was severe.
ekegusii: Bono enchara egasoa ase ense eria, na ase engencho enchara eria yareenge enene mono, ekagera Aburamu agatirimboka gochia Misiri achi kobeera aroro
swahili: Basi kulikuwako na njaa katika nchi, naye Abramu akashuka kwenda Misri kukaa huko kwa muda, kwa maana njaa ilikuwa kali.

english: As he was about to enter Egypt, he said to his wife Sarai, “Look, I know that you are a beautiful woman,
ekegusii: Kobaikire aang’e gosoa Misiri, agateebia Sarai mokaye iga: “Nimanyete ng’a nigo ore omokungu omonyakieni ase okororekana;
swahili: Alipokuwa karibu kuingia Misri, akamwambia Sarai mkewe, “Ninajua ya kwamba wewe ni mwanamke mzuri wa sura.

english: and when the Egyptians see you, they will say, ‘This is his wife.’ Then they will kill me but will let you live.
ekegusii: aande gose Abamisiri, ekero barakorore, nigo barateebe: Oyo mokaye; erio bang’ite inche, korende aye bagotige moyo.
swahili: Wakati Wamisri watakapokuona, watasema, ‘Huyu ni mke wake.’ Ndipo wataniua, lakini wewe watakuacha hai.

english: Please say you are my sister, so that I will be treated well for your sake, and on account of you my life will be spared.”
ekegusii: Ase ayio, bagokoboria igo, obateebie ng’a aye mosubati ominto ore, erinde ebe buya ase ’nde, na ase engencho yao imbe moyo.”
swahili: Sema wewe ni dada yangu, ili nitendewe mema kwa ajili yako, na maisha yangu yatahifadhiwa kwa sababu yako.”

english: So when Abram entered Egypt, the Egyptians saw that the woman was very beautiful.
ekegusii: Ekero Aburamu asoete Misiri, Abamisiri bakarora omokungu oyio ng’a nigo areenge omonyakieni mono.
swahili: Abramu alipoingia Misri, Wamisri wakamwona Sarai kuwa ni mwanamke mzuri sana wa sura.

english: When Pharaoh’s officials saw Sarai, they commended her to him, and she was taken into the palace of Pharaoh.
ekegusii: Ekero abagaambi baaria abaarenge inse ya Farao bachia korora omokungu oria, bakamotogia mono ase obosio bwa Farao. Na omokungu oria akairwa komenya mwa Farao.
swahili: Maafisa wa Farao walipomwona, wakamsifia kwa Farao; ndipo Sarai akapelekwa kwa nyumba ya mfalme.

english: He treated Abram well on her account, and Abram acquired sheep and cattle, male and female donkeys, menservants and maidservants, and camels.
ekegusii: Farao agakorera Aburamu buya ase engencho ya Sarai, na Aburamu nigo anyorete ching’ondi, ne chieeri chi’okorema, ne chitigere, na abasomba, abamura na abaiseke, ne chitigere chiaberi, ne chingamia.
swahili: Kwa ajili ya Sarai, Farao akamtendea Abramu mema, naye Abramu akapata kondoo, ngʼombe, punda, ngamia na watumishi wa kiume na wa kike.

english: The LORD, however, afflicted Pharaoh and his household with severe plagues because of Abram’s wife Sarai.
ekegusii: Korende Omonene akarenta amaakwa amanene ase Farao amo na abanto baye ase engencho ya Sarai, moka Aburamu.
swahili: Lakini Bwana akamwadhibu Farao na nyumba yake kwa maradhi ya kufisha kwa sababu ya kumchukua Sarai, mke wa Abramu.

english: So Pharaoh summoned Abram and asked, “What have you done to me? Why didn’t you tell me she was your wife?
ekegusii: Erio Farao akarangeria Aburamu, akamobooria: “Inki eke gwankoreire iga, otaare gonteebia ng’a oyo Sarai mokao?
swahili: Ndipo Farao akamwita Abramu, akamuuliza, “Umenifanyia nini? Kwa nini hukuniambia ni mke wako?

english: Why did you say, ‘She is my sister,’ so that I took her as my wife? Now then, here is your wife. Take her and go!”
ekegusii: Naki gwakorete iga, ogateeba ng’a oyo mosubati omino, erio ekagera na inche nkamoira akaba mokane? Bono mokao oyio moire, ogende nere.”
swahili: Kwa nini ulisema, ‘Yeye ni dada yangu,’ hata nikamchukua kuwa mke wangu? Sasa basi, mke wako huyu hapa. Mchukue uende zako!”

english: I will make you into a great nation, and I will bless you; I will make your name great, so that you will be a blessing.
ekegusii: Ningokore obe egesaku ekenene, ningosesenie, ninkore erieta riao ribe rinene, na aye nobe omosesenigwa.
swahili: “Mimi nitakufanya taifa kubwa na nitakubariki, Nitalikuza jina lako, nawe utakuwa baraka.

english: Then Pharaoh gave his men orders concerning Abram, and they sent him away with his wife and all his possessions.
ekegusii: Erio Farao agachiika abanto bakoobe Aburamu amo na mokaye na kende gionsi abwate.
swahili: Kisha Farao akawapa watu wake amri kuhusu Abramu, wakamsindikiza pamoja na mke wake na kila alichokuwa nacho.

english: I will bless those who bless you and curse those who curse you; and all the families of the earth will be blessed through you. ”
ekegusii: “Nimbasesenie abwo baragosesenie, nere oyogochecheria erieta riao nimoragererie, na goetera asore aye nimbisesenie ebisaku bionsi bi’ense.”
swahili: Nitawabariki wale wanaokubariki, na yeyote akulaaniye nitamlaani; na kupitia kwako mataifa yote duniani yatabarikiwa.”

english: So Abram departed, as the LORD had directed him, and Lot went with him. Abram was seventy-five years old when he left Haran.
ekegusii: Erio Aburamu akaimoka, akagenda buna Omonene amoteebetie, na Loti akagenda amo nere. Aburamu nigo areenge omomura bw’ekegori kiemiaka emerongo etano na ebere, na etano (75), ekero are kong’anya korwa Harani.
swahili: Hivyo Abramu akaondoka kama Bwana alivyokuwa amemwambia; naye Loti akaondoka pamoja naye. Wakati Abramu alipoitwa aondoke Harani, alikuwa na miaka sabini na mitano.

english: And Abram took his wife Sarai, his nephew Lot, and all the possessions and people they had acquired in Haran, and set out for the land of Canaan. When they came to the land of Canaan,
ekegusii: Aburamu akaira Sarai mokaye, na Loti, omwana omomura omwabo, na ebinto bionsi ebi babwate, ebio konya benyoreire abanyene, na abasomba babo bonsi babwate agwo Harani, bakaimoka, bakagenda ense ya Kaanani.
swahili: Abramu akamchukua Sarai mkewe pamoja na Loti mwana wa ndugu yake, mali zote walizokuwa nazo pamoja na watu aliokuwa amewapata huko Harani, wakasafiri mpaka nchi ya Kanaani, wakafika huko.

english: Abram traveled through the land as far as the site of the Oak of Moreh at Shechem. And at that time the Canaanites were in the land.
ekegusii: Ekero baigeteo, Aburamu agaeta gati y’ense eria goika Shekemu, aase aachenu, aase omote okorokwa omwaloni orenge, agwo More. Ase engaki eyio Abakaanani nabwo bamenyete ase ense eyio.
swahili: Abramu akasafiri katika nchi hiyo akafika huko Shekemu, mahali penye mti wa mwaloni ulioko More. Wakati huo Wakanaani walikuwa wanaishi katika nchi hiyo.

english: Then the LORD appeared to Abram and said, “I will give this land to your offspring. ” So Abram built an altar there to the LORD, who had appeared to him.
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene akamoorokera Aburamu, akamoteebia: “Ning’ee ororeeria rwao ense eye ebe omwando obo.” Ase igo, Aburamu akaagachera Omonene egesasiimero agwo, Omonene oyo omoorokerete.
swahili: Bwana akamtokea Abramu, akamwambia, “Nitawapa uzao wako nchi hii.” Hivyo hapa akamjengea madhabahu Bwana aliyekuwa amemtokea.

english: From there Abram moved on to the hill country east of Bethel and pitched his tent, with Bethel to the west and Ai to the east. There he built an altar to the LORD, and he called on the name of the LORD.
ekegusii: Erio akarwa agwo, akagenda goika ebitunwa bire ensemo ya moocha ya Beteli, agatenenia eema yaye aroro. Korwa aase agwo Beteli nigo orenge ensemo ya bosongo, na Ai ensemo ya moocha. Na agwo akaagachera Omonene egesasiimero, erio akarangeria erieta ri’Omonene.
swahili: Kutoka huko Abramu akasafiri kuelekea kwenye vilima mashariki ya Betheli, naye akapiga hema huko, Betheli ikiwa upande wa magharibi na Ai upande wa mashariki. Huko alimjengea Bwana madhabahu na akaliitia jina la Bwana.

english: And Abram journeyed on toward the Negev. Abram and Sarai in Egypt
ekegusii: Na Aburamu akabwatia orogendo akagenderera bosio gochia ensemo ya Negebu. Aburamu okogenda Misri
swahili: Kisha Abramu akasafiri kuelekea upande wa Negebu. Abramu Katika Nchi Ya Misri

english: So Abram went up out of Egypt into the Negev—he and his wife and all his possessions—and Lot was with him.
ekegusii: Aburamu akarwa Misiri, akagenda gochia Negebu, ere amo na mokaye na ebi bionsi abwate, na Loti akageenda amo nere.
swahili: Hivyo Abramu akakwea kutoka Misri kwenda Negebu, yeye na mkewe na kila kitu alichokuwa nacho, pia Loti akaenda pamoja naye.

english: And Lot looked out and saw that the whole plain of the Jordan, all the way to Zoar, was well watered like the garden of the LORD, like the land of Egypt. (This was before the LORD destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah.)
ekegusii: Loti akaimokereria amaiso aye igoro akarigereria, akarora ense omweya bw’erikura ria Yorodani, ng’a in’yarenge n’amaache amange kera aase, na igo orenge buna omogondo Omonene, na buna ense ya Misiri; gochia ensemo ya Soari. Nabo yarenge ritang’ani Omonene atarasaria Sodomu na Gomora.
swahili: Loti akatazama akaona lile bonde lote la Yordani kuwa lilikuwa na maji tele, kama bustani ya Bwana, kama nchi ya Misri, kuelekea Soari. (Hii ilikuwa kabla Bwana hajaharibu Sodoma na Gomora.)

english: So Lot chose the whole plain of the Jordan for himself and set out toward the east. And Abram and Lot parted company.
ekegusii: Ase igo, Loti agechorera bweka ense omweya yonsi ya Yorodani. Barabwo bagatananekana. Igo Loti akamanora kogenda gochia moocha.
swahili: Hivyo Loti akajichagulia bonde lote la Yordani, akaelekea upande wa mashariki. Watu hao wawili wakatengana:

english: Abram lived in the land of Canaan, but Lot settled in the cities of the plain and pitched his tent toward Sodom.
ekegusii: Aburamu akamenya ase ense ya Kaanani, na Loti nere akamenya egati y’emechie agwo ase ense eria y’omweya, akang’anyia eema yaye gochia Sodomu.
swahili: Abramu akaishi katika nchi ya Kanaani, wakati Loti aliishi miongoni mwa miji ya lile bonde na kupiga mahema yake karibu na Sodoma.

english: But the men of Sodom were wicked, sinning greatly against the LORD. God Renews the Promise to Abram
ekegusii: Abanto ba Sodomu nigo barenge ababe, barenge gokora ebibe ebinge ase obosio bw’Omonene. Aburamu okong’anya gochia ase Heburoni
swahili: Basi watu wa Sodoma walikuwa waovu, wakifanya sana dhambi dhidi ya Bwana.

english: After Lot had departed, the LORD said to Abram, “Now lift up your eyes from the place where you are, and look to the north and south and east and west,
ekegusii: Magega Loti na Aburamu kobaatananekire, Omonene agateebia Aburamu: “Imokereria amaiso ao igoro, origererie korwa agwo aase ore, origererie ensemo ya sugusu, na Irianyi, na moocha, na bosongo;
swahili: Baada ya Loti kuondoka Bwana akamwambia Abramu, “Ukiwa hapo ulipo, inua macho yako utazame kaskazini na kusini, mashariki na magharibi.

english: for all the land that you see, I will give to you and your offspring forever.
ekegusii: naki ense eye yonsi orooche ninkoyee aye na ororeeria rwao goika kare na kare.
swahili: Nchi yote unayoiona nitakupa wewe na uzao wako hata milele.

english: I will make your offspring like the dust of the earth, so that if one could count the dust of the earth, then your offspring could be counted.
ekegusii: Ningokore aye n’ororeeria rwao robe buna orotu rw’ense rotanyare kobareka; onye omonto okonyara kobara orotu rw’ense, rirorio nanyare boigo kobara ororeeria rwao narororwo.
swahili: Nitaufanya uzao wako uwe mwingi kama mavumbi ya nchi, hivyo kama kuna yeyote awezaye kuhesabu mavumbi, basi uzao wako utahesabika.

english: Get up and walk around the land, through its length and breadth, for I will give it to you.”
ekegusii: Bono imoka, otaare ense eye, orore obotambe na oboagare bwaye, ekiagera ninkoe aye ense eyio.”
swahili: Ondoka, tembea katika marefu na mapana ya nchi, kwa maana ninakupa wewe.”

english: So Abram moved his tent and went to live near the Oaks of Mamre at Hebron, where he built an altar to the LORD.
ekegusii: Erio Aburamu akang’anyia eema yaye, agacha akamenya ebitutu bw’emete ekorokwa emialoni agwo Mamure, ang’e na Heburoni. Akaagachera Omonene egesasiimero aroro.
swahili: Basi Abramu akaondoa mahema yake, akaenda kuishi karibu na mialoni ya Mamre huko Hebroni, huko akamjengea Bwana madhabahu.

english: And Abram had become extremely wealthy in livestock and silver and gold.
ekegusii: Nabo Aburamu areenge omotenenku mono, nigo abwate etugo enyinge, ne chifeta, ne chitaabu.
swahili: Wakati huo Abramu alikuwa tajiri sana wa mifugo, fedha na dhahabu.

english: From the Negev he journeyed from place to place toward Bethel, until he came to the place between Bethel and Ai where his tent had formerly been pitched,
ekegusii: Akaimoka korwa Negebu, akageenda agaika Beteli, agwo aase atenenetie eema yaye ritang’ani kegima, gati ya Beteli na Ai,
swahili: Kutoka Negebu, akapita mahali hadi mahali, hadi akafika Betheli, mahali hapo ambapo mwanzoni alipiga hema lake kati ya Betheli na Ai

english: to the site where he had built the altar. And there Abram called on the name of the LORD.
ekegusii: agwo nao aase Aburamu aagachete egesasiimero kie ritang’ani kegima na korirangeria erieta ri’Omonene. Aburamu na Loti bagwatananeka
swahili: hapo ambapo alikuwa amejenga madhabahu ya kwanza. Huko Abramu akaliitia jina la Bwana.

english: Now Lot, who was traveling with Abram, also had flocks and herds and tents.
ekegusii: Na Loti, oyogendete amo n’Aburamu, nigo abwate ching’ondi, ne chiombe, ne chiema.
swahili: Basi Loti, ambaye alikuwa anafuatana na Abramu, alikuwa pia na makundi ya mbuzi, kondoo, ngʼombe na mahema.

english: But the land was unable to support both of them while they stayed together, for they had so many possessions that they were unable to coexist.
ekegusii: Ase igo, ense eria tiyabaisana banyare komenya amo bonsi babere, ekiagera chinibo chiabo nechinyinge chiarenge, goika tibanyara komenya amo.
swahili: Lakini nchi haikuwatosha kukaa pamoja kwa ajili ya wingi wa mali zao.

english: And there was discord between the herdsmen of Abram and the herdsmen of Lot. At that time the Canaanites and the Perizzites were also living in the land.
ekegusii: Agwo eriomana rigatuboka egati y’abarisia b’Aburamu, na abarisia ba Loti. Ase engaki eyio Abakaanani na Abaperisi nabwo bamenyete ase ense eria.
swahili: Ukazuka ugomvi kati ya wachunga mifugo wa Abramu na wale wa Loti. Wakati huo, Wakanaani na Waperizi ndio waliokuwa wenyeji wa nchi hiyo.

english: So Abram said to Lot, “Please let there be no contention between you and me, or between your herdsmen and my herdsmen. After all, we are brothers.
ekegusii: Erio Aburamu agateebia Loti, “Tari buya twomane inche naye, gose abarisia baane na abao, ekiagera intwe nabaanto abamo tore.
swahili: Hivyo Abramu akamwambia Loti, “Pasiwe na ugomvi wowote kati yangu na wewe, wala kati ya wachungaji wangu na wako, kwa kuwa sisi ni ndugu.

english: Is not the whole land before you? Now separate yourself from me. If you go to the left, I will go to the right; if you go to the right, I will go to the left.” Lot Proceeds toward Sodom
ekegusii: Inee! Ense eye yonsi teri ase obosio bwao? Tigango twatananeke. Koragende ensemo ya bomosi, inche ningende eya borio; koragende ensemo ya borio, inche ningende eya bomosi.”
swahili: Je, nchi yote haiko mbele yako? Tutengane. Kama ukielekea kushoto, nitakwenda kulia; kama ukielekea kulia, mimi nitakwenda kushoto.”

english: In those days Amraphel king of Shinar, Arioch king of Ellasar, Chedorlaomer king of Elam, and Tidal king of Goiim
ekegusii: Ekaba ase amatuko ’Amurafeli, omorwoti o Shinari, na Arioki, omorwoti o Eleasari, na Kedorilaoma, omorwoti o Elamu, na Tidali, omorwoti o Goiimu,
swahili: Wakati huu Amrafeli mfalme wa Shinari, Arioko mfalme wa Elasari, Kedorlaoma mfalme wa Elamu, na Tidali mfalme wa Goimu

english: Now the Valley of Siddim was full of tar pits, and as the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled, some men fell into the pits, but the survivors fled to the hill country.
ekegusii: Na ense omweya ya Sidimu nigo yaichire amabwago y’esike gete, na abarwoti abwo ba Sodomu na Gomora ekero baarenge gotama, bakagwa ase amabwago ayio ime, na baria batigarete bagatama gochia ebitunwa igoro.
swahili: Basi Bonde la Sidimu lilikuwa limejaa mashimo ya lami, nao wafalme wa Sodoma na wa Gomora walipokimbia, baadhi ya watu walitumbukia huko na wengine wakakimbilia vilimani.

english: The four kings seized all the goods of Sodom and Gomorrah and all their food, and they went on their way.
ekegusii: Erio ababisa bagasakora chinibo chionsi chia Sodomu na Gomora, na endagera yabo yonsi bakaira chinsobo.
swahili: Wale wafalme wanne wakateka mali yote ya Sodoma na Gomora pamoja na vyakula vyao vyote, kisha wakaenda zao.

english: They also carried off Abram’s nephew Lot and his possessions, since Lot was living in Sodom.
ekegusii: Naboigo bagoosa Loti, omwana omomura omwabo Aburamu, oyomenyete agwo Sodomu, bakamoira amo nenibo yaye.
swahili: Pia walimteka Loti mwana wa ndugu yake Abramu pamoja na mali zake, kwa kuwa alikuwa akiishi Sodoma.

english: Then an escapee came and reported this to Abram the Hebrew. Now Abram was living near the Oaks of Mamre the Amorite, a brother of Eshcol and Aner, all of whom were bound by treaty to Abram.
ekegusii: Omonto oyomo, oyotamete korwa ase abooswa, akagenda agateebia Aburamu Omoiberania, oyomenyete ase akaanani k’emete enga buna Emealuni ka Mamure, oria Omoamori, momura omwabo Esikoli na Aneri. Abwo konya bakorire okobwatana na Aburamu.
swahili: Mtu mmoja aliyekuwa ametoroka akaja kumpa Abramu Mwebrania taarifa. Wakati huu Abramu alikuwa anaishi karibu na mialoni ya Mamre Mwamori, aliyekuwa ndugu yake Eshkoli na Aneri, ambao wote walikuwa wameungana na Abramu.

english: And when Abram heard that his relative had been captured, he mobilized the 318 trained men born in his household, and they set out in pursuit as far as Dan.
ekegusii: Aburamu agachia koigwa ng’a oyomwabo osakoirwe na gwoswa, agatoma abamura baye abakong’u, abaiboire bwoye, abamanyire korwana esegi, babwatie ababisa goika Dani. Abarwani aba nigo baarenge amagana atato, na ikomi na batano na batato.
swahili: Abramu alipopata habari kwamba jamaa yake amechukuliwa mateka, akawaita watu 318 wa nyumbani mwake waliokuwa wamefunzwa kupigana vita, wakawafuatilia hadi Dani.

english: During the night, Abram divided his forces and routed Chedorlaomer’s army, pursuing them as far as Hobah, north of Damascus.
ekegusii: Bwachia koba botuko, Aburamu agaatanana abanto baye, erinde barwanie ababisa babo, akababua akabaseria goika Hoba, sugusu ya Damesiki.
swahili: Wakati wa usiku Abramu aliwagawa watu wake katika vikosi ili awashambulie, na akawafuatilia, akawafukuza hadi Hoba, kaskazini ya Dameski.

english: He retrieved all the goods, as well as his relative Lot and his possessions, together with the women and the rest of the people. Melchizedek Blesses Abram (Psalms 110:1–7; Hebrews 7:1–10)
ekegusii: Erio akairania enibo yonsi, na akairania boigo Loti omwabo amo nenibo yaye, na abakungu, na abanto bande abasakoretwe. Melkizedeki ogosesenia Aburamu
swahili: Akarudisha mali zote, na akamrudisha Loti jamaa yake na mali zake, pamoja na wanawake na watu wengine.
