english: After Abram returned from defeating Chedorlaomer and the kings allied with him, the king of Sodom went out to meet him in the Valley of Shaveh (that is, the King’s Valley).
ekegusii: Ekero Aburamu are koirana korwa ogoita Kedorilaoma amo n’abarwoti baria baarenge amo nere, omorwoti o Sodomu agasooka akamoorototera Aburamu ase ense omweya ya Shawe, eyio n’Ense omweya y’Omorwoti.
swahili: Abramu aliporudi baada ya kumshinda Mfalme Kedorlaoma na wale wafalme waliojiunga naye, mfalme wa Sodoma akatoka kwenda kumlaki katika Bonde la Shawe (yaani Bonde la Mfalme).

english: Then Melchizedek king of Salem brought out bread and wine—since he was priest of God Most High —
ekegusii: Erio Melkizedeki, omorwoti o Salemu, akareenta omogati na edivai; ere nigo areenge Omokuani o Nyasae Ore Igoro Mono.
swahili: Ndipo Melkizedeki mfalme wa Salemu alipoleta mkate na divai. Alikuwa kuhani wa Mungu Aliye Juu Sana.

english: and he blessed Abram and said: “Blessed be Abram by God Most High, Creator of heaven and earth,
ekegusii: Akamosesenia, akabora, “Aburamu asesenigwe na Nyasae Ore Igoro Mono, oyotongete igoro na ense;
swahili: Naye akambariki Abramu, akisema, “Abarikiwe Abramu na Mungu Aliye Juu Sana, Muumba wa mbingu na nchi.

english: went to war against Bera king of Sodom, Birsha king of Gomorrah, Shinab king of Admah, Shemeber king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (that is, Zoar).
ekegusii: abarwoti aba bagakora esegi na Bera, omorwoti o Sodomu, na Birisa, omorwoti o Gomora, na Shinabu, omorwoti o Adima na Shemeberi, omorwoti o Seboimu, na omorwoti o Bela noro Soari.
swahili: kwa pamoja walikwenda kupigana vita dhidi ya Bera mfalme wa Sodoma, Birsha mfalme wa Gomora, Shinabu mfalme wa Adma, Shemeberi mfalme wa Seboimu, na mfalme wa Bela (yaani Soari).

english: and blessed be God Most High, who has delivered your enemies into your hand.” Then Abram gave Melchizedek a tenth of everything.
ekegusii: Nyasae Ore Igoro Mono atogigwe, oyo obekire ababisa bao inse y’amaboko ao!” Aburamu akamoa ensemo ya ikomi ya kera egento ekiabwate.
swahili: Abarikiwe Mungu Aliye Juu Sana, ambaye amewaweka adui zako mkononi mwako.” Ndipo Abramu akampa Melkizedeki sehemu ya kumi ya kila kitu.

english: The king of Sodom said to Abram, “Give me the people, but take the goods for yourself.”
ekegusii: Omorwoti o Sodomu agateebia Aburamu: “Ing’a abanto baane, korende enibo ero oire aye.”
swahili: Mfalme wa Sodoma akamwambia Abramu, “Nipe hao watu na hizo mali uchukue wewe mwenyewe.”

english: But Abram replied to the king of Sodom, “I have raised my hand to the LORD God Most High, Creator of heaven and earth,
ekegusii: Korende Aburamu agateebia omorwoti o Sodomu: “Naimokirie okoboko kwane na gotiana ase Omonene Nyasae Ore Igoro Mono, oyotongete igoro na ense,
swahili: Lakini Abramu akamwambia mfalme wa Sodoma, “Nimeinua mkono wangu kwa Bwana, Mungu Aliye Juu Sana, Muumba wa mbingu na dunia, na nimeapa

english: that I will not accept even a thread, or a strap of a sandal, or anything that belongs to you, lest you should say, ‘I have made Abram rich.’
ekegusii: ng’a tinkoira nonya ng’ake eusi, gose enuga y’egekoroto kiao, gose kende gionsi kiao, obaise gocha goteeba: Ninche natenenkirie Aburamu.
swahili: kwamba sitapokea kitu chochote kilicho chako, hata kama ni uzi au gidamu ya kiatu, ili kamwe usije ukasema, ‘Nimemtajirisha Abramu.’

english: I will accept nothing but what my men have eaten and the share for the men who went with me—Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre. They may take their portion.”
ekegusii: Tinkoira gento kende gionsi otatiga endagera eyio abamura abwo bariete, na ensemo y’abwo bagendete amo nainche; tiga Aneri, na Esikoli, na Mamure, barabwo baire ebiabo.”
swahili: Sitapokea chochote, ila kile tu watu wangu walichokula na sehemu ambayo ni fungu la watu waliokwenda pamoja nami, ambao ni Aneri, Eshkoli na Mamre. Wao na wapewe fungu lao.”

english: The latter five came as allies to the Valley of Siddim (that is, the Salt Sea ).
ekegusii: Abarwoti abwo bonsi bakabwatana, bagasangererekana ase ense omweya ya Sidimu, agwo nao Enyancha y’omonyo ere.
swahili: Hawa wote waliotajwa mwishoni waliunganisha majeshi yao kutoka Bonde la Sidimu (yaani Bahari ya Chumvi).

english: For twelve years they had been subject to Chedorlaomer, but in the thirteenth year they rebelled.
ekegusii: Konya bamokoreire Kedorilaoma emeremo ase engaki y’emiaka ikomi na ebere, korende omwaka o ikomi na gatato bakaenena, tibamokorera naende.
swahili: Walikuwa wametawaliwa na Mfalme Kedorlaoma kwa miaka kumi na miwili, lakini mwaka wa kumi na tatu waliasi.

english: In the fourteenth year, Chedorlaomer and the kings allied with him went out and defeated the Rephaites in Ashteroth-karnaim, the Zuzites in Ham, the Emites in Shaveh-kiriathaim,
ekegusii: Na omwaka o ikomi na kane Kedorilaoma na abarwoti baria babwataine nere bagacha, bakarwania na kobua Abarefai ase Asteroti‐Karinaimu, na Abasusi ase Hamu, na Abaemi ase Shawe‐Kiriataimu,
swahili: Mnamo mwaka wa kumi na nne, Mfalme Kedorlaoma na wafalme waliojiunga naye walikwenda kupigana na kuwashinda Warefai katika Ashtaroth-Kanaimu, Wazuzi katika Hamu, Waemi katika Shawe-Kiriathaimu,

english: and the Horites in the area of Mount Seir, as far as El-paran, which is near the desert.
ekegusii: n’Abahori ase egetunwa Edomu goika Eli-Parani ore ang’e nerooro.
swahili: na Wahori katika nchi ya kilima cha Seiri, hadi El-Parani karibu na jangwa.

english: Then they turned back to invade En-mishpat (that is, Kadesh), and they conquered the whole territory of the Amalekites, as well as the Amorites who lived in Hazazon-tamar.
ekegusii: Erio bakairana goika bagaika Enimisifati, noro okorokwa Kadeshi, bagasaria ense yonsi y’Abaameleki, na eya Abaamori abwo bamenyete Hasasoni-Tamari.
swahili: Kisha wakarudi wakaenda En-Misfati (yaani Kadeshi), wakashinda nchi yote ya Waamaleki, pamoja na Waamori waliokuwa wakiishi Hasason-Tamari.

english: Then the king of Sodom, the king of Gomorrah, the king of Admah, the king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (that is, Zoar) marched out and arrayed themselves for battle in the Valley of Siddim
ekegusii: Agwo omorwoti o Sodomu, na oyo o Gomora, na oyo bw’Adima, na oyo o Seboimu, na oyo o Bela, noro Soari, bakageenda, bakabwatarena korwana esegi ase ense omweya ya Sidimu,
swahili: Ndipo mfalme wa Sodoma, mfalme wa Gomora, mfalme wa Adma, mfalme wa Seboimu, na mfalme wa Bela (yaani Soari) wakatoka kupanga majeshi yao kwenye Bonde la Sidimu

english: against Chedorlaomer king of Elam, Tidal king of Goiim, Amraphel king of Shinar, and Arioch king of Ellasar—four kings against five. Abram Rescues Lot
ekegusii: barwane na Kedorilaoma, omorwoti o Elamu, na Tidali, omorwoti o Goimu, na Amurafeli, omorwoti o Shinari, na Arioki, omorwoti o Eliesari. Abarwoti abwo baane bakarwania baria batano.
swahili: dhidi ya Kedorlaoma, mfalme wa Elamu, Tidali mfalme wa Goimu, Amrafeli mfalme wa Shinari, na Arioko mfalme wa Elasari, yaani wafalme wanne dhidi ya wafalme watano.

english: After these events, the word of the LORD came to Abram in a vision: “Do not be afraid, Abram. I am your shield, your very great reward.”
ekegusii: Magega y’amang’ana ayio, naende ring’ana ri’Omonene rigachiera Aburamu ase endooto, rigoteeba: “Aburamu, toiroka, Inche nenguba yao, na eng’eria yao nebe enene mono.”
swahili: Baada ya jambo hili, neno la Bwana likamjia Abramu katika maono: “Usiogope, Abramu. Mimi ni ngao yako, na thawabu yako kubwa sana.”

english: So Abram brought all these to Him, split each of them down the middle, and laid the halves opposite each other. The birds, however, he did not cut in half.
ekegusii: Akamorentera echio chionsi, agatandora kera eyemo chimbaara ibere, akabeeka kera orobaara rogachikana norwamwabo, korende chinyoni chirochio tachitandora.
swahili: Abramu akamletea hivi vyote, akampasua kila mnyama vipande viwili, akavipanga kila kimoja kuelekea mwenzake, lakini hata hivyo ndege, hakuwapasua vipande viwili.

english: And the birds of prey descended on the carcasses, but Abram drove them away.
ekegusii: Na ekero chinsoti chiachia kogwa ase amabego aria, Aburamu agachiseria.
swahili: Kisha ndege walao nyama wakatua juu ya mizoga, lakini Abramu akawafukuza.

english: As the sun was setting, Abram fell into a deep sleep, and suddenly great terror and darkness overwhelmed him.
ekegusii: Erioba ko riabeire ang’e kogwa, Aburamu akabwatwa ne chitoro chindito, na obwoba obonene mono bokamosoa.
swahili: Wakati jua lilipokuwa linatua, Abramu akashikwa na usingizi mzito, giza nene na la kutisha likaja juu yake.

english: Then the LORD said to Abram, “Know for certain that your descendants will be strangers in a land that is not their own, and they will be enslaved and mistreated four hundred years.
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene agateebia Aburamu: “Manya amaene kegima ng’a ororeeria rwao inarooche koba abamenyi ase ense etari eyabo, na barabwo inababe abasomba b’abaanto b’agwo, na abwo inababachaande mono ase engaki y’emiaka amagana ane.
swahili: Kisha Bwana akamwambia, “Ujue hakika kwamba wazao wako watakuwa wageni kwenye nchi ambayo si yao, nao watafanywa watumwa na kuteswa kwa miaka mia nne.

english: But I will judge the nation they serve as slaves, and afterward they will depart with many possessions.
ekegusii: Abanto b’egesaku keria, barabakore babe abasomba babo, nimbagambie, na magega y’ayio nabarweo bare nenibo enyinge mono.
swahili: Lakini nitaliadhibu taifa lile watakalolitumikia kama watumwa, na baadaye watatoka huko na mali nyingi.

english: You, however, will go to your fathers in peace and be buried at a ripe old age.
ekegusii: Korende aye nogende ase chisokoro chiao ase omorembe. Igo oratindekwe ase obogotu obuya.
swahili: Wewe, hata hivyo utakwenda kwa baba zako kwa amani na kuzikwa katika uzee mwema.

english: In the fourth generation your descendants will return here, for the iniquity of the Amorites is not yet complete.”
ekegusii: Barabwo bagoika ase ekiaare gia kane inabairane gocha aa, ekiagera obobe bw’Abaamori tiboraikerana goika bono.”
swahili: Katika kizazi cha nne wazao wako watarudi hapa, kwa maana dhambi ya Waamori bado haijafikia kipimo kilichojaa.”

english: When the sun had set and darkness had fallen, behold, a smoking firepot and a flaming torch appeared and passed between the halves of the carcasses.
ekegusii: Ekero erioba riagure, na omosunte osoire, eriko rigosokia erioki amo nekieri kere nomorero ekebemberi, bigaeta gati-gati ye chinyama chiria.
swahili: Wakati jua lilipokuwa limezama na giza limeingia, tanuru la moshi na mwali wa moto unaowaka vikatokea na kupita kati ya vile vipande vya nyama.

english: On that day the LORD made a covenant with Abram, saying, “To your descendants I have given this land—from the river of Egypt to the great River Euphrates—
ekegusii: Ase rituko eri’Omonene agakora okobwatana kw’ogotianania n’Aburamu, agateeba: “Ororeeria rwao naroire ense eye gochakera ase orooche orwo oronene rokorokwa Eufarati,
swahili: Siku hiyo Bwana akafanya Agano na Abramu, na kumwambia, “Nitawapa wazao wako nchi hii, kuanzia Kijito cha Misri hadi mto ule mkubwa, Frati,

english: the land of the Kenites, Kenizzites, Kadmonites,
ekegusii: ase ense y’Abakeni, na Abakenisi, na Abakadimoni,
swahili: yaani nchi ya Wakeni, Wakenizi, Wakadmoni,

english: But Abram replied, “O Lord GOD, what can You give me, since I remain childless, and the heir of my house is Eliezer of Damascus?”
ekegusii: Aburamu akamobooria: “Inee! Omonene, ninki gose orang’e, egekogera nigo nde aang’e gokwa ntari na mwana, na oyorache koira omwando one n’Eliezeri, oyo Omodamesiki?”
swahili: Lakini Abramu akasema, “Ee Bwana Mwenyezi, utanipa nini na mimi sina hata mtoto na atakayerithi nyumba yangu ni huyu Eliezeri Mdameski?”

english: Hittites, Perizzites, Rephaites,
ekegusii: na Abahiti, na Abaperisi, na Abarefai,
swahili: Wahiti, Waperizi, Warefai,

english: Amorites, Canaanites, Girgashites, and Jebusites.”
ekegusii: na Abaamori, na Abakaanani, na Abagirigasi, na Abayebusi.”
swahili: Waamori, Wakanaani, Wagirgashi na Wayebusi.”

english: Abram continued, “Behold, You have given me no offspring, so a servant in my household will be my heir.”
ekegusii: Aburamu akabora naende: “Rora, tong’eti abana, na omosomba oyoiboirwe aa bwone, nere oraire omwando one!”
swahili: Abramu akasema, “Hukunipa watoto, hivyo mtumishi katika nyumba yangu ndiye atakuwa mrithi wangu.”

english: Then the word of the LORD came to Abram, saying, “This one will not be your heir, but one who comes from your own body will be your heir.”
ekegusii: Erio ring’ana ri’Omonene rikamochiera Aburamu naende, rigateeba: “Omonto oyio, tari ere oraire omwando oo, otatiga omwana oo bori, orarwe ase enda yao, nere oraire omwando oo.”
swahili: Ndipo neno la Bwana lilipomjia: “Mtu huyu hatakuwa mrithi wako, bali mwana atakayetoka katika viuno vyako mwenyewe ndiye atakayekuwa mrithi wako.”

english: And the LORD took him outside and said, “Now look to the heavens and count the stars, if you are able.” Then He told him, “So shall your offspring be.”
ekegusii: Omonene akamosokia isiko, akamoteebia: “Rigereria gochia igoro, na obare ching’enang’eni, gose nonyare gochinchera.” Erio akamoteebia: “Ororeeria rwao naboigo rorabe.”
swahili: Akamtoa nje na kusema, “Tazama juu kuelekea mbinguni na uhesabu nyota, kama hakika utaweza kuzihesabu.” Ndipo akamwambia, “Hivyo ndivyo uzao wako utakavyokuwa.”

english: Abram believed the LORD, and it was credited to him as righteousness.
ekegusii: Aburamu nigo amwegenete Omonene, na ase engencho eyi’Omonene akagokigwa nere erio akamobara koba omonyene oboronge.
swahili: Abramu akamwamini Bwana, naye kwake hili likahesabiwa kuwa haki.

english: The LORD also told him, “I am the LORD, who brought you out of Ur of the Chaldeans to give you this land to possess.” God Confirms His Promise (Numbers 34:1–15; Romans 4:13–25)
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene akamoteebia: “Inche ninche Omonene, nakorusetie korwa ase Uru y’Abakalidayo, ninkoe ense eye ebe omwando oo bori.”
swahili: Pia akamwambia, “Mimi ndimi Bwana, niliyekutoa toka Uru ya Wakaldayo nikupe nchi hii uimiliki.”

english: But Abram replied, “Lord GOD, how can I know that I will possess it?”
ekegusii: Aburamu akamobooria: “Inee! Aye Omonene, naki ndakore imanye ng’a nebe omwando one bori?”
swahili: Lakini Abramu akasema, “Ee Bwana Mwenyezi, nitawezaje kujua kwamba nitapata kuimiliki?”

english: And the LORD said to him, “Bring Me a heifer, a goat, and a ram, each three years old, along with a turtledove and a young pigeon.”
ekegusii: Omonene akamoiraneria: “Ndetera emori ritororo y’emiaka etato, na embori esubeni y’emiaka etato, na emingichi y’emiaka etato, ne riruma ne riige rie riruma.”
swahili: Ndipo Bwana akamwambia, “Niletee mtamba wa ngʼombe, mbuzi na kondoo dume, kila mmoja wa miaka mitatu, pamoja na hua na kinda la njiwa.”

english: Now Abram’s wife Sarai had borne him no children, but she had an Egyptian maidservant named Hagar.
ekegusii: Bono Sarai, moka Aburamu, tamoiborerete bana. Sarai nareenge nomoiseke omosomba Omomisiri, ore korokwa Hagari.
swahili: Basi Sarai, mkewe Abramu, alikuwa hajamzalia watoto. Lakini alikuwa na mtumishi wa kike Mmisri jina lake Hagari,

english: Then the angel added, “I will greatly multiply your offspring so that they will be too numerous to count.”
ekegusii: Naende omomalaika Omonene akamoteebia: “Nimentekanie ororeeria rwao, na omobaro obo tokonyara kobareka, ekiagera nigo barabe abange mono.”
swahili: Malaika akaendelea akasema, “Nitazidisha wazao wako, hivi kwamba watakuwa wengi mno wasiohesabika.”

english: The angel of the LORD proceeded: “Behold, you have conceived and will bear a son. And you shall name him Ishmael, for the LORD has heard your cry of affliction.
ekegusii: Naende Omomalaika Omonene akamoteebia, “Rora, morito ore, noibore omwana omoisia; nomooroke Isumaeli, ekiagera Omonene oigure ekerero ki’emechando yao.
swahili: Pia malaika wa Bwana akamwambia: “Wewe sasa una mimba nawe utamzaa mwana. Utamwita jina lake Ishmaeli, kwa sababu Bwana amesikia juu ya huzuni yako.

english: He will be a wild donkey of a man, and his hand will be against everyone, and everyone’s hand against him; he will live in hostility toward all his brothers.”
ekegusii: Ere nigo arabe buna etigere y’orosana ase egati y’abanto, na okoboko kwaye nigo korabe igoro y’abanto bonsi, na amaboko ’abaanto bonsi nigo arabe igoro yaye; ere nigo aramenye bosio bw’abamwabo bonsi.”
swahili: Atakuwa punda-mwitu katikati ya wanadamu, mkono wake utakuwa dhidi ya kila mtu na mkono wa kila mtu dhidi yake, naye ataishi kwa uhasama na ndugu zake wote.”

english: So Hagar gave this name to the LORD who had spoken to her: “You are the God who sees me, ” for she said, “Here I have seen the One who sees me!”
ekegusii: Ase ayio Hagari Akaroka Omonene oyo okwanete nere Eli‐Roi, engencho yaye “Aye naye Nyasae bw’okorora”; naki akebooria: “Inee! Amaene, narorire Nyasae, na ere ontiga inde moyo magega konamororire?”
swahili: Hagari akampa Bwana aliyezungumza naye jina hili: “Wewe ndiwe Mungu unionaye mimi,” kwa maana alisema, “Sasa nimemwona yeye anayeniona mimi.”

english: Therefore the well was called Beer-lahai-roi. It is located between Kadesh and Bered.
ekegusii: Ase ayio ensoko eria ekarokwa Beeri‐Lahai‐Roi; ero nigo ere egati ya Kadeshi na Beredi.
swahili: Ndiyo sababu kisima kile kikaitwa Beer-Lahai-Roi, ambacho bado kipo huko hata leo kati ya Kadeshi na Beredi.

english: And Hagar bore Abram a son, and Abram gave the name Ishmael to the son she had borne.
ekegusii: Erio Hagari akaiborera Aburamu omwana omoisia; nere Akaroka omwana oria oye, Isumaeli.
swahili: Hivyo Hagari akamzalia Abramu mwana, naye Abramu akamwita huyo mwana Hagari aliyemzalia, Ishmaeli.

english: Abram was eighty-six years old when Hagar bore Ishmael to him.
ekegusii: Aburamu konya obeire nemiaka emerongo etano na etato, na etano nomo (86), ekero Hagari amoiborerete Isumaeli.
swahili: Abramu alikuwa na umri wa miaka themanini na sita wakati Hagari alipomzalia Ishmaeli.

english: So Sarai said to Abram, “Look now, the LORD has prevented me from bearing children. Please go to my maidservant; perhaps I can build a family by her.” And Abram listened to the voice of Sarai.
ekegusii: Sarai agateebia Aburamu: “Norooche bono ng’a Omonene ontangire tinyora abana, menyana nomoiseke oyo one omosomba; aande nabo ndanyore abana korwa asare.” Aburamu akaigwera ogokwana gwa Sarai.
swahili: hivyo Sarai akamwambia Abramu, “ Bwana amenizuilia kupata watoto. Nenda, ukakutane kimwili na mtumishi wangu wa kike, huenda nitaweza kupata watoto kupitia kwake.” Abramu akakubaliana na lile Sarai alilosema.

english: So after he had lived in Canaan for ten years, his wife Sarai took her Egyptian maidservant Hagar and gave her to Abram to be his wife.
ekegusii: Ase igo, magega Aburamu kamenyire ense ya Kaanani ase emiaka ikomi, Sarai akaimokia Hagari, omosomba oye Omomisiri, akamomoa Aburamu, omosacha oye, ng’a abe buna mokaye.
swahili: Hivyo baada ya Abramu kuishi katika nchi ya Kanaani miaka kumi, Sarai akamchukua mtumishi wake wa kike wa Kimisri, Hagari na kumpa mumewe awe mke wake.

english: And he slept with Hagar, and she conceived. But when Hagar realized that she was pregnant, she began to despise her mistress.
ekegusii: Erio bakamenyana na Hagari, na ere akaba morito. Ekero Hagari achia korora ng’a obeire morito, agachaaka gochaaya Sarai moibori omwabo.
swahili: Akakutana kimwili na Hagari, naye akapata mimba. Hagari alipojua kuwa ana mimba, alianza kumdharau Sarai.

english: Then Sarai said to Abram, “May the wrong done to me be upon you! I delivered my servant into your arms, and ever since she saw that she was pregnant, she has treated me with contempt. May the LORD judge between you and me.”
ekegusii: Sarai agateebia Aburamu: “Obobe obo bwanyorete, tiga naye bokonyore! Inakoa omoiseke one omosomba koboko kwao; ere, ekero achia korora ng’a obeire morito, onchayire. Tiga Omonene atwatanane inche naye!”
swahili: Ndipo Sarai akamwambia Abramu, “Unawajibika na manyanyaso ninayoyapata. Nilimweka mtumishi wangu mikononi mwako, sasa kwa vile anajua kwamba ana mimba, ananidharau mimi. Bwana na aamue kati yako na mimi.”

english: “Here,” said Abram, “your servant is in your hands. Do whatever you want with her.” Then Sarai treated Hagar so harshly that she fled from her.
ekegusii: Aburamu nere agateebia Sarai: “Rora, omosomba oo oyio nase amaboko ao are; moonchie buna oranche.” Erio Sarai akamochanda bobe, na ere agatama korwa asare.
swahili: Abramu akamwambia, “Mtumishi wako yuko mikononi mwako. Mtendee lolote unalofikiri ni bora zaidi.” Ndipo Sarai akamtesa Hagari, hivyo akamtoroka.

english: Now the angel of the LORD found Hagar by a spring of water in the desert—the spring along the road to Shur.
ekegusii: Omomalaika Omonene akarora Hagari ase erooro ase ensoko y’amaache yareenge ase enchera ekogenda Suri.
swahili: Malaika wa Bwana akamkuta Hagari karibu na chemchemi huko jangwani; ilikuwa chemchemi ile iliyokuwa kando ya barabara iendayo Shuri.

english: “Hagar, servant of Sarai,” he said, “where have you come from, and where are you going?” “I am running away from my mistress Sarai,” she replied.
ekegusii: Akamobooria: “Aye omosomba o Sarai, ng’ai okorwa, naende ng’ai okogenda?” Akamoiraneria: “Nigo ngotama korwa ase moibori ominto Sarai.”
swahili: Malaika akamwambia, “Hagari, mtumishi wa Sarai, umetokea wapi, na unakwenda wapi?” Akamjibu, “Ninamkimbia bibi yangu Sarai.”

english: So the angel of the LORD told her, “Return to your mistress and submit to her authority.”
ekegusii: Erio omomalaika Omonene akamoteebia: “Irana gochia ase moibori omino, na bwekeyie asare.”
swahili: Ndipo malaika wa Bwana akamwambia, “Rudi kwa bibi yako ukajishushe chini yake.”

english: When Abram was ninety-nine years old, the LORD appeared to him and said, “I am God Almighty. Walk before Me and be blameless.
ekegusii: Ekero Aburamu amenyire emiaka emerongo kianda, na kianda (99). Omonene akamoorokera, akamoteebia: “Inche ninche Nyasae Omobui; genderera ase obosio bwane, na obe omoikeranu.
swahili: Abramu alipokuwa na miaka tisini na tisa, Bwana akamtokea akamwambia, “Mimi ndimi Mungu Mwenyezi; enenda mbele zangu na uishi kwa unyofu.

english: This is My covenant with you and your descendants after you, which you are to keep: Every male among you must be circumcised.
ekegusii: Oko nakwo okobwatana kwane, orabwate egati yane naye, na ororeeria rwao rorache korwa magega yao: Kera omosacha ore ase more arokigwe.
swahili: Hili ni Agano langu na wewe pamoja na wazao wako baada yako, Agano mtakalolishika: Kila mwanaume miongoni mwenu atatahiriwa.

english: You are to circumcise the flesh of your foreskin, and this will be a sign of the covenant between Me and you.
ekegusii: Goika mwarokigwe risankwa ria isiko ri’ekiimo kiaino ki’obosacha, na ayio nabe ekemanyererio gi’okobwatana egati yane nainwe.
swahili: Mtafanyiwa tohara na hii itakuwa ni alama ya Agano kati yangu na ninyi.

english: Generation after generation, every male must be circumcised when he is eight days old, including those born in your household and those purchased from a foreigner—even those who are not your offspring.
ekegusii: Ekiaare ase ekiaare kera omwana omoisia ore ase egati yaino goika arokigwe ekero akoorire amatuko atano na atato, omobiare o inka amo nomogorwa chitaabu korwa ase abanto ba isiko, otari bw’ororeeria rwao.
swahili: Kwa vizazi vijavyo, kila mwanaume miongoni mwenu mwenye siku nane ni lazima atahiriwe, pamoja na watakaozaliwa nyumbani mwako au walionunuliwa kwa fedha kutoka kwa mgeni, wale ambao sio watoto wako.

english: Whether they are born in your household or purchased, they must be circumcised. My covenant in your flesh will be an everlasting covenant.
ekegusii: Omobiare o inka na omogorwa chitaabu, bonsi goika barokigwe. Ase igo, ekemanyererio gi’okobwatana kwane inakebe ase emebere yaino goika kare na kare.
swahili: Awe amezaliwa nyumbani mwako au amenunuliwa kwa fedha yako, ni lazima watahiriwe. Agano langu katika mwili wako litakuwa ni Agano la milele.

english: But if any male is not circumcised, he will be cut off from his people; he has broken My covenant.”
ekegusii: Omosacha onde bwensi otarokirie risankwa ria isiko ri’ekiimo kiaye ki’obosacha, omonto oyio nigo araatananwe korwa ase abanto bamwabo, aserigwe gochia isiko, ekiagera osaririe okobwatana kwane.”
swahili: Kila mwanaume asiyetahiriwa, ambaye hajapata tohara ya mwilini, atatengwa na watu wake, amelivunja Agano langu.”

english: Then God said to Abraham, “As for Sarai your wife, do not call her Sarai, for her name is to be Sarah.
ekegusii: Naende Nyasae agateebia Aburaamu: “Sarai mokao, tobaisa komooroka naende Sarai, korende erieta riaye nigo rirabe Sara.
swahili: Pia Bwana akamwambia Abrahamu, “Kwa upande wa Sarai mkeo, hutamwita tena Sarai bali jina lake litakuwa Sara.

english: And I will bless her and will surely give you a son by her. I will bless her, and she will be the mother of nations; kings of peoples will descend from her.”
ekegusii: Nimosesenie, nkonyorere omwana omomura korwa asare, nimosesenie, abe ng’ina bw’ebisaku; na abarwoti b’abaanto inabaiborwe korwa asare.”
swahili: Nitambariki na hakika nitakupatia mwana kwake. Nitambariki na kwamba atakuwa mama wa mataifa, wafalme wa mataifa watatoka kwake.”

english: Abraham fell facedown. Then he laughed and said to himself, “Can a child be born to a man who is a hundred years old? Can Sarah give birth at the age of ninety?”
ekegusii: Erio Aburaamu agatugama inse, agaseka, akabora ase omoyo oye ime: “Inee! Omonto ore nemiaka rigana nanyare koibora omwana?” Sara nere oyo ore nemiaka emerongo kianda aibore omwana?
swahili: Abrahamu akaanguka kifudifudi, akacheka na kusema moyoni mwake, “Je, mtu wa miaka mia moja aweza kuzaa mwana? Je, Sara atazaa mtoto katika umri wa miaka tisini?”

english: And Abraham said to God, “O that Ishmael might live under Your blessing!”
ekegusii: Aburaamu agateebia Nyasae: “Koranche, Isumaeli abe moyo ase obosio bwao!”
swahili: Abrahamu akamwambia Mungu, “Laiti Ishmaeli naye angeshiriki baraka yako!”

english: But God replied, “Your wife Sarah will indeed bear you a son, and you are to name him Isaac. I will establish My covenant with him as an everlasting covenant for his descendants after him.
ekegusii: Nyasae akamokania, akamoteebia: “Taibo, Sara mokao nakoiborere omwana omomura, na aye nomooroke Isaka. Inche ning’ikeranie nere okobwatana kwane kw’ogotianania, kobe okobwatana gwa kare na kare ase ororeeria rwaye rorache korwa magega yaye.
swahili: Ndipo Mungu akasema, “Ndiyo, lakini mkeo Sara atakuzalia wewe mwana, nawe utamwita jina lake Isaki. Nitalithibitisha Agano langu naye kama Agano la milele kwa ajili yake na wazao wake baada yake.

english: I will establish My covenant between Me and you, and I will multiply you exceedingly.”
ekegusii: Inche ninkore okobwatana kw’ogotianania egati yane naye, ninkomentekanie mono.”
swahili: Nami nitafanya Agano langu kati yangu na wewe, nami nitakuzidisha sana sana.”

english: As for Ishmael, I have heard you, and I will surely bless him; I will make him fruitful and multiply him greatly. He will become the father of twelve rulers, and I will make him into a great nation.
ekegusii: Ase amang’ana igoro ya Isumaeli nakoigure, rora, nimosesenie nimomentekanie mono, naibore abagaambi ikomi na babere; ninkore egesaku ekenene kerwe asare.
swahili: Kwa upande wa Ishmaeli, nimekusikia: hakika nitambariki, nitamfanya awe na uzao mwingi na nitaongeza sana idadi yake. Atakuwa baba wa watawala kumi na wawili, nami nitamfanya awe taifa kubwa.

english: But I will establish My covenant with Isaac, whom Sarah will bear to you at this time next year.”
ekegusii: Korende ning’ikeranie okobwatana kwane na Isaka, oyo Sara araibore ase engaki buna eye iga, ase omwaka ogocha.”
swahili: Lakini Agano langu nitalithibitisha kwa Isaki, ambaye Sara atakuzalia mwaka ujao majira kama haya.”

english: When He had finished speaking with Abraham, God went up from him.
ekegusii: Nyasae ekero akoorire gokwana na Aburaamu, akairana korwa asare, akagenda.
swahili: Wakati alipomaliza kuzungumza na Abrahamu, Mungu akapanda juu akaondoka kwa Abrahamu.

english: On that very day Abraham took his son Ishmael and all those born in his household or purchased with his money—every male among the members of Abraham’s household—and he circumcised them, just as God had told him.
ekegusii: Erio Aburaamu akabwata Isumaeli omwana oye, na abasomba aba baiboire ase enka yaye, na abagorwa chitaabu, kera omonto omosacha ore ase abanto b’enka ya Aburaamu, akabarokia risankwa ria isiko ri’ekiimo kiabo ki’obosacha, ase rituko riria riria, buna Nyasae amotebetie.
swahili: Siku ile ile, Abrahamu akamchukua Ishmaeli mwanawe na wote waliozaliwa nyumbani mwake pamoja na walionunuliwa kwa fedha zake, kila mwanaume wa nyumbani mwake, akawatahiri, kama Mungu alivyomwagiza.

english: So Abraham was ninety-nine years old when he was circumcised,
ekegusii: Aburaamu konya oikire nemiaka emerongo kianda, na kianda (99), ekero arogetigwe.
swahili: Abrahamu alikuwa na umri wa miaka tisini na tisa alipotahiriwa,

english: and his son Ishmael was thirteen;
ekegusii: Na Isumaeli, omwana oye, nigo konya aikire emiaka ikomi, na etato, ekero arogetigwe.
swahili: naye Ishmaeli mwanawe alitahiriwa akiwa na umri wa miaka kumi na mitatu.

english: Abraham and his son Ishmael were circumcised on the same day.
ekegusii: Ase rituko erio erio Aburaamu akarokigwa amo na omwana oye Isumaeli.
swahili: Abrahamu na Ishmaeli mwanawe walitahiriwa siku ile ile,

english: And all the men of Abraham’s household—both servants born in his household and those purchased from foreigners—were circumcised with him.
ekegusii: Na abanto bonsi baiboire ase enka yaye, na abagorwa chitaabu korwa ase abanto ba isiko, bakarokigwa amo nere.
swahili: Kila mwanaume nyumbani mwa Abrahamu, pamoja na wote waliozaliwa nyumbani mwake au aliyenunuliwa kwa fedha kutoka kwa mgeni, alitahiriwa pamoja naye.

english: Then Abram fell facedown, and God said to him,
ekegusii: Erio Aburamu agatugama inse akaumama, na Nyasae akamoteebia,
swahili: Abramu akaanguka kifudifudi, naye Mungu akamwambia,

english: “As for Me, this is My covenant with you: You will be the father of many nations.
ekegusii: “Rora, okobwatana kwane nabwatanire naye nakwo oko: Aye nobe sokoro bw’ebisaku ebinge.
swahili: “Kwa upande wangu, hili ndilo Agano langu na wewe: Wewe utakuwa baba wa mataifa mengi.

english: No longer will you be called Abram, but your name will be Abraham, for I have made you a father of many nations.
ekegusii: Bono erieta riao tirikoba naende Aburamu, korende nigo orarokwe Aburaamu, ekiagera nagokorire obe sokoro bw’ebisaku ebinge.
swahili: Jina lako hutaitwa tena Abramu, bali jina lako litakuwa Abrahamu, kwa maana nimekufanya wewe baba wa mataifa mengi.

english: I will make you exceedingly fruitful; I will make nations of you, and kings will descend from you.
ekegusii: Ninkomente obe na ororeeria oronge mono, ninkore ebisaku ebinge birue asore, na abarwoti nabarue asore boigo.
swahili: Nitakufanya uwe na uzao mwingi sana, kwako yatatoka mataifa nao wafalme watatoka kwako.

english: I will establish My covenant as an everlasting covenant between Me and you and your descendants after you, to be your God and the God of your descendants after you.
ekegusii: “Ning’ikeranie okobwatana kw’ogotianania egati yane naye, na ororeeria rwao korwa magega yao, kogenderera ekiaare ase ekiaare, kobe okobwatana gwa kare na kare; imbe Nyasae oo, na oyo bw’ororeeria rwao korwa magega yao.
swahili: Nitalithibitisha Agano langu kama Agano la milele kati yangu na wewe na wazao wako baada yako na vizazi vijavyo niwe Mungu wako na Mungu wa wazao wako.

english: And to you and your descendants I will give the land where you are residing—all the land of Canaan—as an eternal possession; and I will be their God.” The Covenant of Circumcision
ekegusii: Inche ninkoe aye, na ororeeria rwao rorache korwa magega yao, ense eye omenyete bono buna omomenyi, ense yonsi ya Kaanani, ebe eyaino kare na kare, na inche nimbe Nyasae obo.” Okobwatana gw’okwarokigwa, na eira y’okoiborwa gwa Isaka
swahili: Nchi yote ya Kanaani, unakoishi sasa kama mgeni, nitakupa kuwa milki yako milele, na uzao wako, nami nitakuwa Mungu wao.”

english: God also said to Abraham, “You must keep My covenant—you and your descendants in the generations after you.
ekegusii: Nyasae agateebia Aburaamu: “Aye goika obwate okobwatana kwane kw’ogotianania, aye na ororeeria rwao rorache korwa magega yao, ekiaare ase ekiaare.
swahili: Ndipo Mungu akamwambia Abrahamu, “Kwa upande wako, lazima ushike Agano langu, wewe na wazao wako kwa ajili ya vizazi vijavyo.

english: Then the LORD appeared to Abraham by the Oaks of Mamre in the heat of the day, while he was sitting at the entrance of his tent.
ekegusii: Omonene akaorokera Aburaamu ase emete enga buna Emealuni agwo Mamure, ekero Aburaamu aikaransete gesieri ki’eema yaye, engaki y’omobaso omoororo.
swahili: Bwana akamtokea Abrahamu karibu na mialoni ya Mamre wakati alipokuwa ameketi kwenye ingilio la hema lake wakati wa adhuhuri.

english: Then the LORD said, “I will surely return to you at this time next year, and your wife Sarah will have a son!” Now Sarah was behind him, listening at the entrance to the tent.
ekegusii: Omonene akamoteebia: “Amaene, inche ning’irane asore omwaka ogocha engaki enga buna eye, na ninyore ng’a Sara mokao onyorire omwana omoisia.” Ko erio Sara nigo ategererete gesieri ki’eema yareenge magega y’Omonene.
swahili: Kisha Bwana akasema, “Hakika nitakurudia tena majira kama haya mwakani na Sara mkeo atakuwa ana mwana.” Sara alikuwa akiwasikiliza kwenye ingilio la hema, lililokuwa nyuma yake.

english: And Abraham and Sarah were already old and well along in years; Sarah had passed the age of childbearing.
ekegusii: Bono Aburaamu na Sara konya bagotire mono, baetanirie emiaka y’obosae, na Sara konya oeteire emiaka y’okonyora abana.
swahili: Abrahamu na Sara walikuwa wazee tena waliosogea miaka, naye Sara alikuwa amekoma katika desturi ya wanawake.

english: So she laughed to herself, saying, “After I am worn out and my master is old, will I now have this pleasure?”
ekegusii: Ase ayio, Sara agaseka ase omoyo oye ime, ogoteeba: “Buna inde omogotu iga, na omosacha one nere ogotire, naki eranyarekane inyore omogooko oyio?”
swahili: Hivyo Sara akacheka kimoyomoyo alipokuwa akiwaza, “Baada ya mimi kuwa mkongwe hivi na bwana wangu amezeeka, je, nitaweza kufurahia jambo hili?”

english: And the LORD asked Abraham, “Why did Sarah laugh and say, ‘Can I really bear a child when I am old?’
ekegusii: Omonene akabooria Aburaamu: “Ninki Sara agosekera, ogoteeba: Inche amaene ninyibore omwana buna nagotire iga?
swahili: Ndipo Bwana akamwambia Abrahamu, “Kwa nini Sara amecheka na kusema, ‘Kweli nitazaa mtoto nami sasa ni mzee?’

english: Is anything too difficult for the LORD? At the appointed time I will return to you—in about a year—and Sarah will have a son.”
ekegusii: Ing’ana ki rire rikong’u igo riramosinye Omonene? Engaki ndairane asore ase omwaka ogocha, engaki enga buna eye, ninyore ng’a Sara onyorire omwana omoisia.”
swahili: Je, kuna jambo lolote gumu lisilowezekana kwa Bwana? Nitakurudia mwakani majira kama haya, naye Sara atakuwa na mwana.”

english: But Sarah was afraid, so she denied it and said, “I did not laugh.” “No,” replied the LORD, “but you did laugh.” Abraham Intercedes for Sodom
ekegusii: Sara agakana, agateeba: “Inche tinsegeti,” naki nigo noboete. Omonene akamoteebia: “Taibo; korende aye ngwaseka.” Aburaamu ogosabera abanto ba Sodomu
swahili: Sara akaogopa kwa kuwa alidanganya na kusema, “Mimi sikucheka.” Lakini Bwana akasema, “Ndiyo, ulicheka!” Abrahamu Aiombea Sodoma

english: When the men got up to leave, they looked out over Sodom, and Abraham walked along with them to see them off.
ekegusii: Erio abanto abwo bakaimoka korwa agwo, bakagenda, bakaba barigereretie gochia Sodomu, na Aburaamu akagenda amo nabarabwo, akabakooba.
swahili: Wakati watu hao waliposimama ili waondoke, walielekeza nyuso zao Sodoma, Abrahamu akawatoa kitambo kidogo ili awasindikize.

english: And the LORD said, “Shall I hide from Abraham what I am about to do?
ekegusii: Omonene agateeba: “Inee! Imobise Aburaamu ring’ana ngochia gokora,
swahili: Ndipo Bwana akasema, “Je, nimfiche Abrahamu jambo ninalokusudia kufanya?

english: Abraham will surely become a great and powerful nation, and through him all the nations of the earth will be blessed.
ekegusii: ekero ndoche ng’a ngochia are koba egesaku ekenene gie chinguru, na ebisaku bionsi bi’ense inabisesenigwe goetera asare?
swahili: Hakika Abrahamu atakuwa taifa kubwa na lenye nguvu, kupitia kwake mataifa yote ya dunia yatabarikiwa.

english: For I have chosen him, so that he will command his children and his household after him to keep the way of the LORD by doing what is right and just, in order that the LORD may bring upon Abraham what He has promised.”
ekegusii: Naki namochorire, ng’a ere arue ogochika gochia ase abana baye na bonsi abagotoka enka yaye, na baria abarache koiborwa korwa magega yaye, babwatie enchera y’Omonene, bakore oboronge na ekeene, erinde Omonene aikeranerie Aburaamu, onsi aya amorierete eira.”
swahili: Kwa maana nimemchagua yeye, ili awaongoze watoto wake na jamaa yake kufuata njia ya Bwana, kwa kuwa waadilifu na kutenda haki, ili Bwana atimize ahadi yake kwa Abrahamu.”

english: And Abraham looked up and saw three men standing nearby. When he saw them, he ran from the entrance of his tent to meet them and bowed low to the ground.
ekegusii: Agwo akaimokereria amaiso aye igoro, akarora abanto batato bateneine bosio bwaye. Ekero abarora, akaminyoka korwa gesieri ki’eema, agachia kobarotota, agatung’ama inse,
swahili: Abrahamu akainua macho akaona watu watatu wamesimama karibu naye. Alipowaona, aliharakisha kutoka kwenye ingilio la hema lake kuwalaki na kuwasujudia hadi nchi.

english: Then the LORD said, “The outcry against Sodom and Gomorrah is great. Because their sin is so grievous,
ekegusii: Naende Omonene agateeba: “Ekiagera ekerero gia Sodomu na Gomora nekenene, na ebibe biabo biamentekire mono,
swahili: Basi Bwana akasema, “Kilio dhidi ya Sodoma na Gomora ni kikubwa sana na dhambi yao inasikitisha sana,

english: I will go down to see if their actions fully justify the outcry that has reached Me. If not, I will find out.”
ekegusii: nigo ndaike gochia inse, indore onye bakorire amabe amange buna ekerero eke kiang’ikeire kegoteeba; onye taibo, nimanye ayio.”
swahili: kwamba nitashuka nione kama waliyoyatenda ni mabaya kiasi cha kilio kilichonifikia. Kama sivyo, nitajua.”

english: And the two men turned away and went toward Sodom, but Abraham remained standing before the LORD.
ekegusii: Erio abanto baria bakarwa agwo, bakagenda gochia Sodomu, korende Aburaamu agatigara oteneine agwo ase obosio bw’Omonene.
swahili: Basi wale watu wakageuka wakaenda kuelekea Sodoma, lakini Abrahamu akabaki amesimama mbele za Bwana.

english: Abraham stepped forward and said, “Will You really sweep away the righteous with the wicked?
ekegusii: Aburaamu agasuka gochia ase Omonene, akamobooria: “Inee! Amaene, nigo orasirie abanyene oboronge amo nabakori amabe?
swahili: Ndipo Abrahamu akamsogelea akasema: “Je, utawaangamiza wenye haki na waovu?

english: What if there are fifty righteous ones in the city? Will You really sweep it away and not spare the place for the sake of the fifty righteous ones who are there?
ekegusii: Aande ase omochie oria abanyene oboronge emerongo etano mbakareo, nigo orayosirie, gose noyororere amaabera ase engencho y’abwo abanyene oboronge emerongo etano?
swahili: Je, ikiwa watakuwepo watu wenye haki hamsini katika mji huo, hivi kweli utauangamiza na wala hutauacha kwa ajili ya hao watu hamsini wenye haki waliomo ndani yake?

english: Far be it from You to do such a thing—to kill the righteous with the wicked, so that the righteous and the wicked are treated alike. Far be it from You! Will not the Judge of all the earth do what is right?”
ekegusii: Yaya gaki teeba boigo, ekeene, nosirie abanyene oboronge nabakori amabe amo? Omonyene oboronge tagokorerwa buna abakori amabe! Inee! Aye Omogambi omonene bw’ense engima notige gokora ayare y’oboronge!”
swahili: Hilo na liwe mbali nawe, kufanya jambo kama hilo, kuwaua wenye haki pamoja na waovu, kuwatendea wenye haki sawasawa na waovu. Iwe mbali nawe! Je, Mwamuzi wa dunia yote hatafanya lililo sawa?”

english: So the LORD replied, “If I find fifty righteous ones within the city of Sodom, on their account I will spare the whole place.”
ekegusii: Omonene akamoteebia: “Inse konyora abanyene oboronge emerongo etano ase omochie oria o Sodomu, rirorio nigo ndatige gosiria omochie aria ase engencho y’abwo, abaronge.”
swahili: Bwana akasema, “Kama nikipata watu hamsini wenye haki katika mji wa Sodoma, nitausamehe huo mji wote kwa ajili yao.”

english: Then Abraham answered, “Now that I have ventured to speak to the Lord—though I am but dust and ashes—
ekegusii: Aburaamu akairaneria: “Rigereria, ningendererete gokwana n’Omonene, nonya inche inde orotu rw’amaroba, na eriibu bosa.
swahili: Kisha Abrahamu akasema tena: “Sasa kwa kuwa nimekuwa na ujasiri wa kuzungumza na Bwana, ingawa mimi si kitu bali ni mavumbi na majivu;

english: suppose the fifty righteous ones lack five. Will You destroy the whole city for the lack of five?” He replied, “If I find forty-five there, I will not destroy it.”
ekegusii: Aande ase baria emerongo etano baise koba batano tibaiyo, abanyene oboronge, Inee, nosarie omochie ekiagera batano tibaiyo?” Nyasae akairaneria: “Tingosaria omochie, kondarore agwo emerongo ene, na batano.”
swahili: je, kama hesabu ya wenye haki imepungua watano katika hamsini, utauangamiza huo mji wote kwa ajili ya hao watano waliopungua?” Bwana akamwambia, “Kama nikiwakuta huko watu arobaini na watano, sitauangamiza.”

english: Once again Abraham spoke to the LORD, “Suppose forty are found there?” He answered, “On account of the forty, I will not do it.”
ekegusii: Aburaamu akagenderera naende gokwana nere: “Aande baraisa kororekana rende emerongo ene?” Nyasae akairaneria: “Ase engencho y’abwo emerongo ene, tingosaria omochie.”
swahili: Abrahamu akazungumza naye kwa mara nyingine, “Je, kama huko watapatikana watu arobaini tu?” Akamjibu, “Kwa ajili ya hao arobaini, sitauangamiza.”

english: “My lord,” said Abraham, “if I have found favor in your sight, please do not pass your servant by.
ekegusii: akabora: “Omonene one, onye nanyorire ogwancherwa ase obosio bwao, tong’etaania inche, omosomba oo.
swahili: Akasema, “Kama nimepata kibali machoni penu, ee bwana wangu, usimpite mtumishi wako.

english: Then Abraham said, “May the Lord not be angry, but let me speak further. Suppose thirty are found there?” He replied, “If I find thirty there, I will not do it.”
ekegusii: Aburaamu akabora: “Omonene, koranche, tobaisa kombea nainche, ningendererete gokwana naye. Aande barabaisa konyorekana rende emerongo etato?” Omonene akairaneria: “Tingosaria omochie oria, inse konyora mbare emerongo etato aroro.”
swahili: Ndipo akasema, “Bwana na asikasirike, lakini niruhusu nizungumze. Je, kama huko watakuwepo thelathini tu?” Akajibu, “Sitapaangamiza ikiwa nitawakuta huko watu thelathini.”

english: And Abraham said, “Now that I have ventured to speak to the Lord, suppose twenty are found there?” He answered, “On account of the twenty, I will not destroy it.”
ekegusii: Aburaamu akabora: “Rora, ningendererete gokwana n’Omonene. Baise konyorekana rende emerongo ebere?” Omonene akairaneria: “Ase engencho y’abwo emerongo ebere, tingosaria omochie.”
swahili: Abrahamu akasema, “Sasa kwa kuwa nimekuwa na ujasiri sana kuzungumza na Bwana, je, kama wakipatikana huko watu ishirini tu?” Bwana akajibu, “Kwa ajili ya hao ishirini, sitauangamiza.”

english: Finally, Abraham said, “May the Lord not be angry, but let me speak once more. Suppose ten are found there?” And He answered, “On account of the ten, I will not destroy it.”
ekegusii: Aburaamu akamobooria naende: “Omonene, tobaisa kombea, bono ndimo rioka ngokoboria, barachia konyorekana rende ikomi boka?” Nyasae akairaneria: “Tingosaria omochie, inse konyora agwo ikomi boka.”
swahili: Abrahamu akasema, “Bwana na asikasirike, lakini niruhusu nizungumze tena mara moja tu. Itakuwaje kama watapatikana huko watu kumi tu?” Bwana akajibu, “Kwa ajili ya hao kumi, sitauangamiza.”

english: When the LORD had finished speaking with Abraham, He departed, and Abraham returned home.
ekegusii: Ekero Omonene akoorete gokwana na Aburaamu, akagenda; na Aburaamu akairana bwoye.
swahili: Bwana alipomaliza kuzungumza na Abrahamu, akaondoka, naye Abrahamu akarudi nyumbani kwake.

english: Let a little water be brought, that you may wash your feet and rest yourselves under the tree.
ekegusii: Tiga morenterwe amaache make, mwesibie amagoro, na motimokere aa ase ekiriiri ki’omote oyo.
swahili: Acha yaletwe maji kidogo, kisha ninyi nyote mnawe miguu yenu na mpumzike chini ya mti huu.

english: And I will bring a bit of bread so that you may refresh yourselves. This is why you have passed your servant’s way. After that, you may continue on your way.” “Yes,” they replied, “you may do as you have said.”
ekegusii: Inche imbarentere endagera inke morie, erio monyore chinguru; erio momanye kogenderera gochia ase mware kogenda, naki aase aiga mwaeta mbwone, inche omosomba oino.” Bakamoteebia: “Gaki, kora buna gwateeba.”
swahili: Niruhusuni niwapatie chakula kidogo mle, ili mpate nguvu mwendelee na safari yenu, kwa kuwa mmekuja kwa mtumishi wenu.” Nao wakamjibu, “Vema sana, fanya kama unavyosema.”

english: So Abraham hurried into the tent and said to Sarah, “Quick! Prepare three seahs of fine flour, knead it, and bake some bread.”
ekegusii: Ase igo, Aburaamu akaayerera, agasoa eema ime agwo ase Sara arenge, akamoteebia: “Renta bwango obosie, ebirengo bitato, obokonye, oroisie emegati.”
swahili: Hivyo Abrahamu akaharakisha akaingia hemani kwa Sara, akamwambia, “Chukua vipimo vitatu vya unga laini haraka, ukande na uoke mikate.”

english: Meanwhile, Abraham ran to the herd, selected a tender and choice calf, and gave it to a servant, who hurried to prepare it.
ekegusii: Erio Aburaamu akaminyoka getii ase riicho riaye, akarenta emori engiya, enoru, enterere, akayea omosomba oye, akamoteebia: “Yeroisie bwango, orente.”
swahili: Kisha Abrahamu akakimbia kwenda kwenye kundi, akachagua ndama mzuri, laini na akampa mtumishi, ambaye aliharakisha kumtayarisha.

english: Then Abraham brought curds and milk and the calf that had been prepared, and he set them before the men and stood by them under the tree as they ate. Sarah Laughs at the Promise
ekegusii: Akabogoria amaguta, na amabeere, ne chinyama chi’emori eria aroisetie, agaterekera abageni baria. Ere agatenena ase bare ensemo ase ekiriiri ki’omote, ekero baare koragera.
swahili: Kisha akaleta jibini, maziwa na nyama ya yule ndama iliyoandaliwa, akaviweka mbele ya wageni. Walipokuwa wakila, alisimama karibu nao chini ya mti.

english: “Where is your wife Sarah?” they asked. “There, in the tent,” he replied.
ekegusii: Barabwo bakamobooria: “Ng’ai Sara mokao are?” Ere akabairaneria: “Neema ime are.”
swahili: Wakamuuliza, “Yuko wapi Sara mkeo?” Akasema, “Yuko huko, ndani ya hema.”

english: Now the two angels arrived at Sodom in the evening, and Lot was sitting in the gateway of the city. When Lot saw them, he got up to meet them, bowed facedown,
ekegusii: Abamalaika baria babere bakagenda, bagaika Sodomu mogoroba, na Loti nigo areenge oikaransete geita gia Sodomu. Ekero Loti abarooche, akaimoka kobarotota, agatugama inse, akaumama,
swahili: Malaika wale wawili wakafika Sodoma wakati wa jioni, naye Loti alikuwa ameketi kwenye lango la mji. Wakati alipowaona, aliondoka kwenda kuwalaki na kuwasujudia hadi chini.

english: But the men inside reached out, pulled Lot into the house with them, and shut the door.
ekegusii: Korende abanto baria baarenge ime bakarambora amaboko abo, bakang’usa Loti gochia nyomba ime, na erio kegima bagasieka egesieri.
swahili: Lakini watu wale waliokuwa ndani wakanyoosha mkono wakamvuta Loti ndani ya nyumba na kufunga mlango.

english: And they struck the men at the entrance, young and old, with blindness, so that they wearied themselves trying to find the door. Lot Flees to Zoar
ekegusii: Erio bagaukoria abanto baria baarenge korwa isiko, erinde bagasinywa konyora egesieri.
swahili: Kisha wakawapiga kwa upofu wale watu waliokuwa mlangoni mwa ile nyumba, vijana kwa wazee, hivyo hawakuweza kuupata mlango.

english: Then the two men said to Lot, “Do you have anyone else here—a son-in-law, your sons or daughters, or anyone else in the city who belongs to you? Get them out of here,
ekegusii: Erio abasacha baria babere bakabooria Loti: “Nore nonde omino aa? Nobwate abana bao banyuomete abaiseke bao, gose abamura na abaiseke bao, gose kobwate bande bamino ase omochie oyo, barusie korwa aase aa.
swahili: Wale watu wawili wakamwambia Loti, “Una mtu mwingine yeyote hapa, wakwe zako, wana au binti, ama yeyote mwingine aliye wako katika mji huu? Waondoe hapa,

english: because we are about to destroy this place. For the outcry to the LORD against its people is so great that He has sent us to destroy it.”
ekegusii: Naki intwe nigo twachire gosaria aase aa, ekiagera ekerero kiaye kiamentekire ase obosio bw’Omonene; ase ayio Omonene ototoomire tosarie aase aa.”
swahili: kwa sababu tunapaangamiza mahali hapa. Kilio kwa Bwana dhidi ya watu wa hapa ni kikubwa kiasi kwamba ametutuma kupaangamiza.”

english: So Lot went out and spoke to the sons-in-law who were pledged in marriage to his daughters. “Get up,” he said. “Get out of this place, for the LORD is about to destroy the city!” But his sons-in-law thought he was joking.
ekegusii: Erio Loti agasooka, agateebia abamura aba konya bariereire abaiseke baye boko: “Imoka bwango, morue aase aa, ekiagera Omonene ngocha are gosaria omochie oyo,” Korende barabwo bagakaga ng’a negosori akobakorera. Loti ogotoorigwa amo nabaiseke baye, korende mokaye akoomera inchera
swahili: Kwa hiyo Loti alitoka ili kuzungumza na wakwe zake, waliokuwa wamewaposa binti zake. Akawaambia, “Fanyeni haraka kuondoka mahali hapa, kwa kuwa Bwana yu karibu kuangamiza mji huu!” Lakini wakwe zake walifikiri kwamba alikuwa akitania.

english: At daybreak the angels hurried Lot along, saying, “Get up! Take your wife and your two daughters who are here, or you will be swept away in the punishment of the city.”
ekegusii: Bogachia gokia mambia, abamalaika baria bakaayereria Loti, bakamoteebia: “Imoka bwango, ira mokao na abaiseke bao babere abare aa amo naye, tobaisa gosirigwa ase egesusuro keria omochie oyo ogochia konyora.”
swahili: Kunako mapambazuko, malaika wakamhimiza Loti, wakamwambia, “Fanya haraka! Mchukue mke wako na binti zako wawili walioko hapa, la sivyo utaangamizwa wakati mji utakapoadhibiwa.”

english: But when Lot hesitated, the men grabbed his hand and the hands of his wife and his two daughters. And they led them safely out of the city, because of the LORD’s compassion for them.
ekegusii: Ekero abeete ogoteebana, abanto abwo bakamobwata okoboko, bakabwata na mokaye na abaiseke baye, ekiagera Omonene amororerete amaabera, akamosokia isiko y’omochie.
swahili: Alipositasita, wale watu wakamshika mkono wake na mikono ya mke wake na binti zake wawili na kuwaongoza salama nje ya mji, kwa kuwa Bwana alikuwa na huruma kwao.

english: As soon as the men had brought them out, one of them said, “Run for your lives! Do not look back, and do not stop anywhere on the plain! Flee to the mountains, or you will be swept away!”
ekegusii: Ekero baabasookirie isiko, oyomo obo akabateebia: “Tama, motoorie obogima bwaino; timorigereria magega, gose timotenena aande onsi ase ense eraire. Motame gochia ase ebitunwa, timobaisa gosira.”
swahili: Mara walipokwisha kuwatoa nje, mmoja wao akawaambia, “Mkimbie kwa usalama wenu! Msitazame nyuma, wala msisimame popote katika nchi tambarare! Kimbilieni milimani, ama sivyo mtaangamizwa!”

english: But Lot replied, “No, my lords, please!
ekegusii: Loti akabakania, akabateebia: “Taibo, Omonene one;
swahili: Lakini Loti akawajibu, “La hasha, bwana zangu, tafadhalini!

english: Your servant has indeed found favor in your sight, and you have shown me great kindness by sparing my life. But I cannot run to the mountains; the disaster will overtake me, and I will die.
ekegusii: rora omosomba oo onyorire ogwancherwa ase amaiso ao, kwamentire amaabera ao ase ’nde ase ogotooria obogima bwane; korende inche tinkonyara gotama ng’ikeere ebitunwa; amabe abaise konyora, ang’ite.
swahili: Mtumishi wenu amepata kibali mbele ya macho yenu, nanyi mmeonyesha wema mkubwa kwangu kwa kuokoa maisha yangu. Lakini siwezi kukimbilia milimani, janga hili litanikumba, nami nitakufa.

english: and said, “My lords, please turn aside into the house of your servant; wash your feet and spend the night. Then you can rise early and go on your way.” “No,” they answered, “we will spend the night in the square.”
ekegusii: akabora: “Abaanene baane, gobera gocha aa, mosoe mw’omosomba oino, monyore amaache mwesibie amagoro aino, moraare goika mambia bokie; erio moche moimoke mambia, mogende.” Barabwo bagakana, bagateeba: “Yaya, nigo tokoba aa inchera obotuko obo bwonsi.”
swahili: Akasema, “Bwana zangu, tafadhali karibuni kwenye nyumba ya mtumishi wenu. Mnaweza kunawa miguu na kulala hapa kisha asubuhi na mapema mwendelee na safari yenu.” Wakamjibu, “La hasha, tutalala hapa nje uwanjani.”

english: Look, there is a town nearby where I can flee, and it is a small place. Please let me flee there—is it not a small place? Then my life will be saved.”
ekegusii: Rora omochie oyo ore ang’e aiga, omochie omoke, noro ndaike bwango. Tiga ntame gochia ase omochie oria, ore omoke iga, ntoorie obogima bwane.”
swahili: Tazama, hapa kuna mji karibu wa kukimbilia, nao ni mdogo. Niruhusuni nikimbilie humo, ni mdogo sana, ama sivyo? Ndipo maisha yangu yatasalimika.”

english: “Very well,” he answered, “I will grant this request as well, and will not demolish the town you indicate.
ekegusii: Ere akamoteebia: “Rora, nagwancheire ase ring’ana erio boigo. Tingosaria omochie oyio gwateeba.
swahili: Akamwambia, “Vema sana, nitalikubali hili ombi pia, sitauangamiza mji ulioutaja.

english: Hurry! Run there quickly, for I cannot do anything until you reach it.” That is why the town was called Zoar.
ekegusii: Ayerera, bwetoorie, ekiagera tingokora ing’ana rinde rionsi goika gwasoire omochie oria ime.” Ase ayio, omochie oyio okarokwa Soari. Sodomu na Gomora egosambwa na gosarigwa
swahili: Lakini ukimbilie huko haraka, kwa sababu sitaweza kufanya lolote mpaka ufike huko.” (Ndiyo maana mji huo ukaitwa Soari. )

english: Then the LORD rained down sulfur and fire on Sodom and Gomorrah—from the LORD out of the heavens.
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene akaruta amagena ’omorero korwa igoro akonyititoka na omorero igoro ya Sodomu na Gomora,
swahili: Ndipo Bwana akanyesha moto wa kiberiti uliotoka mbinguni kwa Bwana juu ya Sodoma na Gomora.

english: Thus He destroyed these cities and the entire plain, including all the inhabitants of the cities and everything that grew on the ground.
ekegusii: agasamba emechie eyio, amo nense eyio yonsi eraire, na agasiria bonsi abamenyete imeo, na ebinto bionsi biare gokina ase ense eria.
swahili: Hivyo akaiteketeza miji ile na eneo lote la tambarare, pamoja na wote waliokuwa wanaishi katika miji, hata pia mimea yote katika nchi.

english: But Lot’s wife looked back, and she became a pillar of salt.
ekegusii: Korende moka Loti nigo areenge korwa magega, akarigereria magega, akaonchoka, akooma, akaba buna rigena ri’omonyoo.
swahili: Lakini mke wa Loti akatazama nyuma, hivyo akawa nguzo ya chumvi.

english: Early the next morning, Abraham got up and returned to the place where he had stood before the LORD.
ekegusii: Mambia kobwakia, Aburaamu akagenda aase aria atenenete ase obosio bw’Omonene.
swahili: Asubuhi na mapema siku iliyofuata, Abrahamu akaamka na kurudi mahali pale aliposimama mbele za Bwana.

english: He looked down toward Sodom and Gomorrah and all the land of the plain, and he saw the smoke rising from the land like smoke from a furnace.
ekegusii: Ere akarigereria maate gochia ensemo ya Sodomu na Gomora, na ense yonsi eraire, na agwo akarora erioki rigotiira korwa inse, buna erioki rikorwa ase eriko rinene.
swahili: Akatazama upande wa Sodoma na Gomora, kuelekea nchi yote ya tambarare, akaona moshi mzito ukipanda kutoka kwenye nchi, kama moshi utokao kwenye tanuru.

english: So when God destroyed the cities of the plain, He remembered Abraham, and He brought Lot out of the catastrophe that destroyed the cities where he had lived. Lot and His Daughters
ekegusii: Ekaba ekero Nyasae asaretie emechie eyio y’ense eraire, akaba okoinyora Aburaamu, akarusia Loti ase ogosarigwa koria, ekero asambete emechie eyio ase Loti amenyete. Omochaki bwe chinderia chi’Abamoabu na Abaamoni
swahili: Kwa hiyo Mungu alipoiangamiza miji ya tambarare alimkumbuka Abrahamu, akamtoa Loti kutoka kwenye lile janga lililoharibu miji ile ambamo Loti alikuwa ameishi. Loti Na Binti Zake

english: But Lot insisted so strongly that they followed him into his house. He prepared a feast for them and baked unleavened bread, and they ate.
ekegusii: Korende akabasorora mono, na barabwo bakagobera, erio bagasoa nyomba mwaye. Erio akabaroiseria endagera, na emegati etabekiri memera, na barabwo bakaria.
swahili: Lakini akasisitiza kwa nguvu kwamba waingie pamoja naye nyumbani kwake. Akawaandalia chakula, mikate isiyotiwa chachu, nao wakala.

english: Lot and his two daughters left Zoar and settled in the mountains—for he was afraid to stay in Zoar—where they lived in a cave.
ekegusii: Loti agatiira korwa Soari, agacha akamenya ase ebitunwa amo nabaiseke baye babere, ekiagera nigo oboete komenya Soari; akamenya ase rikuruma amo nabaiseke baye babere.
swahili: Loti na binti zake wawili waliondoka Soari na kufanya makao yao kule milimani, kwa maana aliogopa kukaa Soari. Yeye na binti zake wawili waliishi katika pango.

english: One day the older daughter said to the younger, “Our father is old, and there is no man in the land to sleep with us, as is the custom over all the earth.
ekegusii: Omoiseke oye omotangi agateebia oyomwabo omoke: “Tata ogotire, gose monto onde tari ase ense oyorache gotonyuoma buna engencho y’ense yonsi ere.
swahili: Siku moja binti mkubwa akamwambia yule mdogo, “Baba yetu ni mzee na hakuna mwanaume mahali hapa atakayekutana na sisi kimwili, kama ilivyo desturi ya mahali pote duniani.

english: Come, let us get our father drunk with wine so we can sleep with him and preserve his line.”
ekegusii: Bono, tiga toe tata edivai anywe, atinde, toraare nere, erinde tomotenenerie egesaku kiaye, tigesira.”
swahili: Tumnyweshe baba yetu mvinyo kisha tukutane naye kimwili ili tuhifadhi uzao wetu kupitia baba yetu.”

english: So that night they got their father drunk with wine, and the firstborn went in and slept with her father; he was not aware when she lay down or when she got up.
ekegusii: Bakanyoinsia ise edivai ase obotuko boria; omoiseke oria omotangi agachia, akaraara nere, ise tamanya ekero araara, gose ekero aboka.
swahili: Usiku ule walimnywesha baba yao mvinyo, alipolewa binti yake mkubwa akaingia na kukutana naye kimwili. Baba yao hakujua wakati binti yake alipoingia kulala naye wala alipotoka.

english: The next day the older daughter said to the younger, “Look, I slept with my father last night. Let us get him drunk with wine again tonight so you can go in and sleep with him and we can preserve our father’s line.”
ekegusii: Rituko rikobwatia omoiseke oria omotangi agateebia oria omoke omwabo: “Rora, obotuko bwa igoro nigo naraire na Tata; tomonyooinsie naende edivai ase obotuko obo, erio naye ochie, oraare nere, erinde tomotenenerie egesaku kiaye, tigesira.”
swahili: Siku iliyofuata binti mkubwa akamwambia yule mdogo, “Usiku uliopita mimi nilikutana kimwili na baba yangu. Tumnyweshe divai tena, usiku huu nawe ukutane naye kimwili ili tuweze kuhifadhi uzao wetu kupitia baba yetu.”

english: So again that night they got their father drunk with wine, and the younger daughter went in and slept with him; he was not aware when she lay down or when she got up.
ekegusii: Bakamonyoinsia naende edivai ase obotuko obwo. Omoiseke oria omoke akaimoka, akaraara nere, ise tamanya ekero araara, gose ekero aboka.
swahili: Kwa hiyo wakamnywesha baba yao mvinyo tena usiku ule, naye binti yake mdogo akaingia, akakutana naye kimwili. Kwa mara nyingine baba yao hakujua binti yake alipolala naye wala alipoondoka.

english: Thus both of Lot’s daughters became pregnant by their father.
ekegusii: Naboigo abaiseke abwo babere ba Loti bakorete iga, ekagera bakaba barito korwa ase ise.
swahili: Hivyo binti wawili wa Loti wakapata mimba kwa baba yao.

english: The older daughter gave birth to a son and named him Moab. He is the father of the Moabites of today.
ekegusii: Ase igo omoiseke oria omotangi akaibora omwana omoisia, akamoroka Moabu; oyio nere sokoro bw’Abamoabu goika reero iga.
swahili: Binti mkubwa akamzaa mwana, akamwita jina lake Moabu; ndio baba wa Wamoabu hata leo.

english: The younger daughter also gave birth to a son, and she named him Ben-ammi. He is the father of the Ammonites of today.
ekegusii: Na moiseke oria omwabo omoke, nere akaibora omwana omoisia, akamoroka Ben‐Ami; oyio nere sokoro bw’Abaamoni goika reero iga.
swahili: Binti mdogo naye pia akamzaa mwana, naye akamwita Benami; ndiye baba wa Waamoni hata leo.

english: Before they had gone to bed, all the men of the city of Sodom, both young and old, surrounded the house.
ekegusii: Ritang’ani batarachia korara, abanto bonsi b’omochie oria o Sodomu, abamura na abagaaka, bagacha bagaetanana enyomba,
swahili: Kabla hawajaenda kulala, watu wote kutoka kila sehemu ya mji wa Sodoma, vijana kwa wazee, waliizunguka nyumba.

english: They called out to Lot, saying, “Where are the men who came to you tonight? Send them out to us so we can have relations with them!”
ekegusii: bakarangeria Loti, bakamobooria: “Abanto abwo bacha mwao bono botuko, ng’ai bare? Basokie isiko aa, tobakore abakungu.”
swahili: Wakamwita Loti wakisema, “Wako wapi wale watu ambao walikuja kwako jioni hii? Watoe nje kwetu ili tuweze kuwalawiti.”

english: Lot went outside to meet them, shutting the door behind him.
ekegusii: Loti agasoka isiko ase abanto baria, agasieka egesieri korwa magega yaye,
swahili: Loti akatoka nje kuonana nao, akaufunga mlango nyuma yake,

english: “Please, my brothers,” he pleaded, “don’t do such a wicked thing!
ekegusii: akabateebia: “Baminto, nabasoroire, timokora obosooku buna obo.
swahili: akasema, “La hasha, rafiki zangu. Msifanye jambo hili ovu.

english: Look, I have two daughters who have never slept with a man. Let me bring them to you, and you can do to them as you please. But do not do anything to these men, for they have come under the protection of my roof.”
ekegusii: Rora, nimbwate abaiseke baane babere abekungi; tiga mbaabarentere, na mobakorere buna moranche, korende abanto aba iga timobakorera ing’ana rinde rionsi, ekiagera basoire nyomba mwane ime na nigo bare inse y’oborendi bwane.”
swahili: Tazama, ninao binti wawili ambao kamwe hawajakutana kimwili na mwanaume. Acha niwatoe nje kwenu, nanyi mnaweza kuwafanyia lolote mnalotaka. Lakini msiwafanyie chochote watu hawa, kwa sababu wako kwenye ulinzi chini ya dari langu.”

english: “Get out of the way!” they replied. And they declared, “This one came here as a foreigner, and he is already acting like a judge! Now we will treat you worse than them.” And they pressed in on Lot and moved in to break down the door.
ekegusii: Korende barabwo bakamoteebia: “Torwereo!” Naende bagateebania: “Omonto oyo nomomenyi are aa seito, na bono nigo arigetie gototeebereria! Bono nigo toragokorere bobe mono kobua buna nanga tware gokorera abanto abwo.” Erio bagatwoma‐twoma Loti mono, bakarigia kobuna egesieri.
swahili: Wakamjibu, “Tuondokee mbali.” Wakaendelea kusema, “Huyu mtu alikuja hapa kama mgeni na sasa anataka kuwa mwamuzi wetu! Tutakutenda vibaya kuliko wao.” Waliendelea kumlazimisha Loti na kusonga mbele ili kuvunja mlango.

english: In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth.
ekegusii: Agwo omochakano Nyasae agatonga igoro na ense,
swahili: Hapo mwanzo Mungu aliumba mbingu na dunia.

english: God called the dry land “earth,” and the gathering of waters He called “seas.” And God saw that it was good.
ekegusii: Akaroka aase aria aomo ense, na amaache aria asangererekanete amo akayaroka chinyancha. Nyasae akarora ayio ng’a namaya.
swahili: Mungu akaiita nchi kavu “ardhi,” nalo lile kusanyiko la maji akaliita “bahari.” Mungu akaona kuwa ni vyema.

english: Then God said, “Let the earth bring forth vegetation: seed-bearing plants and fruit trees, each bearing fruit with seed according to its kind.” And it was so.
ekegusii: Erio agachiika agateeba: “Tiga ense emere ebimeri bigokina, buna ebimeri bikorua na emete ekwama amatunda are ne chimbusuro chire imeo, kera oyomo ase egesaku kiaye ekenyene” ayio akaba boigo.
swahili: Kisha Mungu akasema, “Ardhi na itoe mimea: miche itoayo mbegu, miti juu ya nchi itoayo matunda yenye mbegu ndani yake, kila mmea kulingana na aina zake mbalimbali.” Ikawa hivyo.

english: And there was evening, and there was morning—the third day. The Fourth Day
ekegusii: Erio agwo rikaba mogoroba, naende bogakia mambia, rituko ria gatato.
swahili: Ikawa jioni, ikawa asubuhi, siku ya tatu.

english: And God said, “Let there be lights in the expanse of the sky to distinguish between the day and the night, and let them be signs to mark the seasons and days and years.
ekegusii: Erio Nyasae agachiika “Tiga emebaso ebe ase oboiko bw’aaria igoro, bwatanane omobaso korwa ase obotuko; erio ebe ebimanyererio bikworokia ebiro bi’amatuko, ne chingaki, n’emiaka,
swahili: Mungu akasema, “Iwepo mianga kwenye nafasi ya anga ili itenganishe usiku na mchana, nayo iwe alama ya kutambulisha majira mbalimbali, siku na miaka,

english: And let them serve as lights in the expanse of the sky to shine upon the earth.” And it was so.
ekegusii: ebe emebaso ase oboiko aaria igoro, boyee ense omobaso na oborabu,” ayio onsi akaba boigo.
swahili: nayo iwe mianga kwenye nafasi ya anga ya kutia nuru juu ya dunia.” Ikawa hivyo.

english: God made two great lights: the greater light to rule the day and the lesser light to rule the night. And He made the stars as well.
ekegusii: Erio Nyasae agakora emebaso ebere emenene, Risase rigaambere ekero kia mobaso n’omotienyi ogaambere ekero kia botuko; agakora ne ching’enang’eni boigo.
swahili: Mungu akafanya mianga miwili mikubwa: mwanga mkubwa utawale mchana, na mwanga mdogo utawale usiku. Pia Mungu akafanya nyota.

english: God set these lights in the expanse of the sky to shine upon the earth,
ekegusii: Akayebeka ase eanga aaria igoro, eyee ense oborabu,
swahili: Mungu akaiweka katika nafasi ya anga iangaze dunia,

english: to preside over the day and the night, and to separate the light from the darkness. And God saw that it was good.
ekegusii: egaambere omobaso na obotuko, na gwatanana oborabu korwa ase omosunte. Nyasae akarora ayio ng’a namaya.
swahili: itawale usiku na mchana, na ikatenganishe nuru na giza. Mungu akaona kuwa hili ni jema.

english: And there was evening, and there was morning—the fourth day. The Fifth Day
ekegusii: Erio agwo rikaba mogoroba, naende bogakia mambia, rituko ria kane.
swahili: Ikawa jioni, ikawa asubuhi, siku ya nne.

english: Now the earth was formless and void, and darkness was over the surface of the deep. And the Spirit of God was hovering over the surface of the waters. The First Day
ekegusii: Bono ense tiyarenge na kieni kende, gose kende gionsi tikiareengeo, n’omosunte ekerima nigo oyetubete, na Omoika o Nyasae ogatoeerera igoro y’amaache.
swahili: Wakati huu dunia ilikuwa haina umbo, tena ilikuwa tupu. Giza lilikuwa juu ya uso wa vilindi vya maji, naye Roho wa Mungu alikuwa ametulia juu ya maji.

english: And God said, “Let the waters teem with living creatures, and let birds fly above the earth in the open expanse of the sky.”
ekegusii: Naende Nyasae agachiika, “Tiga amaache atware obonge bw’ebitongwa bire moyo, ne chinyoni chikoiruruka igoro ase ense, chigoetanana inse y’eaanga ya igoro.”
swahili: Mungu akasema, “Kuwepo na viumbe hai tele kwenye maji, nao ndege waruke juu ya dunia katika nafasi ya anga.”

english: So God created the great sea creatures and every living thing that moves, with which the waters teemed according to their kinds, and every bird of flight after its kind. And God saw that it was good.
ekegusii: Erio Nyasae agatonga ebitongwa ebinene bire ase amaache ime, amo n’ebitongwa binde bionsi bimenyete ase amache ime, boigo agatoonga chinyoni. Nyasae akarora ng’a ayio namaya.
swahili: Kwa hiyo Mungu akaumba viumbe wakubwa wa baharini na kila kiumbe hai kiendacho majini kulingana na aina zake, na kila ndege mwenye mabawa kulingana na aina yake. Mungu akaona kuwa hili ni jema.

english: Then God blessed them and said, “Be fruitful and multiply and fill the waters of the seas, and let birds multiply on the earth.”
ekegusii: Erio akabisesenia bionsi, agateeba ebitoongwa biria bimenyete amaache ime bisaraare biichore ime ase chinyancha, naende agateebia chinyoni chisaraare ase ense.
swahili: Mungu akavibariki, akasema, “Zaeni mwongezeke, mkayajaze maji ya bahari, nao ndege waongezeke katika dunia.”

english: And there was evening, and there was morning—the fifth day. The Sixth Day
ekegusii: Erio agwo rikaba mogoroba, naende bogakia mambia, rituko ria gatano.
swahili: Ikawa jioni, ikawa asubuhi, siku ya tano.

english: And God said, “Let the earth bring forth living creatures according to their kinds: livestock, land crawlers, and beasts of the earth according to their kinds.” And it was so.
ekegusii: Naende Nyasae agachiika, “Tiga ense etware ebitongwa bire moyo, kera egesaku n’engencho yaye. Ching’iti chigotugwa, n’echikwagura, ne ching’iti chi’orosana, kera egesaku nengencho yaye” ayio akaba boigo.
swahili: Mungu akasema, “Ardhi na itoe viumbe hai kulingana na aina zake: wanyama wa kufugwa, viumbe vitambaavyo ardhini na wanyama pori, kila mnyama kulingana na aina yake.” Ikawa hivyo.

english: Then God said, “Let Us make man in Our image, after Our likeness, to rule over the fish of the sea and the birds of the air, over the livestock, and over all the earth itself and every creature that crawls upon it.”
ekegusii: Erio Nyasae agateeba: “Bono tiga tokore omonto; ase omogwekano oito, otobwekaine. Nigo arabe n’echinguru agaambere chinswe chia nyancha, ne chinyoni chikoiruruka igoro, ne ching’iti chigotugwa, ne ching’iti chionsi chi’orosana, na ense yonsi, ne ching’iti chionsi chinene n’echinke.”
swahili: Ndipo Mungu akasema, “Tufanye mtu kwa mfano wetu, kwa sura yetu, wakatawale juu ya samaki wa baharini na ndege wa angani, juu ya mifugo, juu ya dunia yote, na juu ya viumbe wote watambaao juu ya nchi.”

english: So God created man in His own image; in the image of God He created him; male and female He created them.
ekegusii: Nabo Nyasae agatonga Mwanyabaanto ase omobwekano oye omonyene; ase omobwekano o Nyasae ere akamotonga. Agatonga omosacha na omokungu,
swahili: Kwa hiyo Mungu akamuumba mtu kwa mfano wake mwenyewe, kwa mfano wa Mungu alimuumba; mwanaume na mwanamke aliwaumba.

english: God blessed them and said to them, “Be fruitful and multiply, and fill the earth and subdue it; rule over the fish of the sea and the birds of the air and every creature that crawls upon the earth.”
ekegusii: akabasesenia, akabateebia: “Moibore, mosarare, moichore ase ense, na moyegaambere. Ngokobeeka inde ogaambere chinswe, ne chinyoni, n’echingiti chionsi chi’orosana.
swahili: Mungu akawabariki na akawaambia, “Zaeni na mkaongezeke, mkaijaze tena dunia na kuitiisha. Mkatawale samaki wa baharini, ndege wa angani, na kila kiumbe hai kiendacho juu ya ardhi.”

english: Then God said, “Behold, I have given you every seed-bearing plant on the face of all the earth, and every tree whose fruit contains seed. They will be yours for food.
ekegusii: Nabaeire kera ekemeri gekwama chimbusuro, na kera omote okwama amatunda ebio nabio biraabe endagera yaino.
swahili: Kisha Mungu akasema, “Nimewapa kila mche utoao mbegu juu ya uso wa dunia yote, na kila mti wenye matunda yenye mbegu ndani yake. Vitakuwa chakula chenu.

english: And God said, “Let there be light,” and there was light.
ekegusii: Erio Nyasae agachiika: “Tiga oborabu bobeo,” erio kegima oborabu bokabao.
swahili: Mungu akasema, “Iwepo nuru,” nayo nuru ikawepo.

english: And to every beast of the earth and every bird of the air and every creature that crawls upon the earth—everything that has the breath of life in it—I have given every green plant for food.” And it was so.
ekegusii: Korende ching’iti chi’orosana ne chinyoni chionsi nachieire ebimeri ebibese bionsi bibe endagera yabo.” Ayio onsi akaba boigo.
swahili: Nao wanyama wote wa dunia, ndege wote wa angani, na viumbe vyote viendavyo juu ya ardhi: yaani kila kiumbe chenye pumzi ya uhai, ninawapa kila mche wa kijani kuwa chakula.” Ikawa hivyo.

english: And God looked upon all that He had made, and indeed, it was very good. And there was evening, and there was morning—the sixth day.
ekegusii: Nyasae akarora ebinto ebio bionsi akorete, na birobio nigo biareenge ebiya mono. Erio agwo rikaba mogoroba, naende bogakia mambia, rituko ria gatano na rimo.
swahili: Mungu akaona vyote alivyoumba, na tazama, ilikuwa vizuri sana. Ikawa jioni, ikawa asubuhi, siku ya sita.

english: And God saw that the light was good, and He separated the light from the darkness.
ekegusii: Nyasae akagokigwa na keria aroche. Erio agaatanana oborabu korwa ase omosunte,
swahili: Mungu akaona ya kuwa nuru ni njema, ndipo Mungu akatenganisha nuru na giza.

english: God called the light “day,” and the darkness He called “night.” And there was evening, and there was morning—the first day. The Second Day
ekegusii: akaroka oborabu boria omobaso, na omosunte akayoroka obotuko. Erio agwo rikaba mogoroba, naende bokaba maambia, rituko rie ritang’ani.
swahili: Mungu akaiita nuru “mchana,” na giza akaliita “usiku.” Ikawa jioni, ikawa asubuhi, siku ya kwanza.

english: And God said, “Let there be an expanse between the waters, to separate the waters from the waters.”
ekegusii: Erio Nyasae agachiika, “Tiga oboiko bobe egati‐gati y’amaache, erio bwatanane amaache korwa ase amaache ande.”
swahili: Mungu akasema, “Iwepo nafasi kati ya maji igawe maji na maji.”

english: So God made the expanse and separated the waters beneath it from the waters above. And it was so.
ekegusii: Igo Nyasae agakora oboiko boria, bogaatanana amaache ayare inse y’eaanga korwa ase amaache ayare igoro y’oboiko; ayio akaba boigo.
swahili: Kwa hiyo Mungu akafanya nafasi, akatenganisha maji yaliyo chini ya hiyo nafasi na maji yaliyo juu yake. Ikawa hivyo.

english: God called the expanse “sky.” And there was evening, and there was morning—the second day. The Third Day
ekegusii: Akaroka oboiko boria igoro. Erio agwo rikaba mogoroba, naende bogakia mambia, rituko ria kabere.
swahili: Mungu akaiita hiyo nafasi “anga.” Ikawa jioni, ikawa asubuhi, siku ya pili.

english: And God said, “Let the waters under the sky be gathered into one place, so that the dry land may appear.” And it was so.
ekegusii: Naende Nyasae agachiika, “Tiga amaache ayare inse y’erioba asangererekane aase aamo, egere ense enyomo erorekane;” ayio akaba boigo.
swahili: Mungu akasema, “Maji yaliyopo chini ya anga na yakusanyike mahali pamoja, pawepo na nchi kavu.” Ikawa hivyo.

english: Now Abraham journeyed from there to the region of the Negev and settled between Kadesh and Shur. While he was staying in Gerar,
ekegusii: Erio Aburaamu akaimoka korwa agwo mamure, akagenda gochia ensemo y’ense ya Negebu, akaroisia obomenyo bwaye, egati ya Kadeshi na Suri agwo Gerari.
swahili: Basi Abrahamu akaendelea mbele kutoka huko hadi nchi ya Negebu na akaishi kati ya Kadeshi na Shuri. Kwa muda mfupi alikaa Gerari kama mgeni,

english: Abimelech also asked Abraham, “What prompted you to do such a thing?”
ekegusii: Naende Abimeleki akabooria Aburaamu: “Inki kwareengereretie goika ogakora ring’ana eri?”
swahili: Abimeleki akamuuliza Abrahamu, “Ulikuwa na kusudi gani kufanya hivi?”

english: Abraham replied, “I thought to myself, ‘Surely there is no fear of God in this place. They will kill me on account of my wife.’
ekegusii: Aburaamu akamoiraneria: “Nabo nakorete igo, ekiagera narooche ng’a abamoirogete Nyasae tibari aase aa, na barabwo nigo barang’ite ase engencho ya mokane.
swahili: Abrahamu akajibu, “Niliwaza kwamba, ‘Hakika hakuna hofu ya Mungu mahali hapa, nao wataniua kwa sababu ya mke wangu.’

english: Besides, she really is my sister, the daughter of my father—though not the daughter of my mother—and she became my wife.
ekegusii: Ere amaene nomoiseke ominto, tata noyomo, korende ng’ina nomoao, na inche nkamonyuoma.
swahili: Pamoja na hayo, ni kweli kwamba yeye ni dada yangu, binti wa baba yangu ingawa si mtoto wa mama yangu; basi akawa mke wangu.

english: So when God had me journey from my father’s house, I said to Sarah, ‘This is how you can show your loyalty to me: Wherever we go, say of me, “He is my brother.”’”
ekegusii: Ekero Nyasae andusetie korwa ase omochie o tata kogenda gochia aaria na aaria ngateebia mokane: Obwo nabwo obwanchani orankorere: kera aase toragende oteebe igoro yane ng’a inche momura omino.”
swahili: Wakati Bwana aliponifanya nisafiri mbali na nyumbani mwa baba yangu, nilimwambia, ‘Hivi ndivyo utakavyoonyesha pendo lako kwangu: Kila mahali tutakapokwenda, kuhusu mimi sema, “Huyu ni kaka yangu.” ’ ”

english: So Abimelech brought sheep and cattle, menservants and maidservants, and he gave them to Abraham and restored his wife Sarah to him.
ekegusii: Erio Abimeleki akaimokia ching’ondi ne chiombe, amo nabasomba, abamura na abaiseke, akaa Aburaamu, akamoiraneria na Sara mokaye.
swahili: Kisha Abimeleki akatwaa kondoo na ngʼombe, na watumwa wa kiume na wa kike akampa Abrahamu, akamrudisha Sara kwa mumewe.

english: And Abimelech said, “Look, my land is before you. Settle wherever you please.”
ekegusii: Abimeleki akamoteebia: “Rora, ense yane nigo ere ase obosio bwao; menya aande onsi ase oranche komenya.”
swahili: Abimeleki akasema, “Nchi yangu iko mbele yako, ishi popote unapotaka.”

english: And he said to Sarah, “See, I am giving your brother a thousand pieces of silver. It is your vindication before all who are with you; you are completely cleared.”
ekegusii: Ere agateebia Sara: “Rora naeire momura omino chisekeli chi’echifeta elifu eyemo, chibe entorobi yao ase amaiso ’abaanto bonsi abare amo naye, erio omanyekane ng’a nomonto omooronge ore.”
swahili: Akamwambia Sara, “Ninampa kaka yako shekeli elfu moja za fedha. Hii ni kufidia kosa lililofanyika dhidi yako mbele ya wote walio pamoja nawe; haki yako imethibitishwa kabisa.”

english: Then Abraham prayed to God, and God healed Abimelech and his wife and his maidservants, so that they could again bear children—
ekegusii: Erio Aburaamu agasaba Nyasae; na Nyasae akagwenia Abimeleki amo na mokaye, na abasomba baye abakungu, na barabwo bakaibora abana.
swahili: Kisha Abrahamu akamwomba Mungu, naye Mungu akamponya Abimeleki, mke wake, na watumwa wake wa kike kwamba waweze kupata watoto tena,

english: for on account of Abraham’s wife Sarah, the LORD had completely closed all the wombs in Abimelech’s household.
ekegusii: Naki Omonene konya okorire abakungu b’enka y’Abimeleki koba abagomba, erio tibaibora, ase engencho ya Sara moka Aburaamu.
swahili: kwa kuwa Bwana alikuwa ameyafunga matumbo ya wote katika nyumba ya Abimeleki kwa sababu ya Sara, mke wa Abrahamu.

english: Abraham said of his wife Sarah, “She is my sister.” So Abimelech king of Gerar had Sarah brought to him.
