ekegusii: Ekero are agwo, Aburaamu agakwana igoro ya Sara mokaye ogoteeba: “Oyo mosubati ominto.” Abimeleki, omorwoti o Gerari agatoma abanto kwoyia Sara.
swahili: huko Abrahamu akasema kuhusu Sara mkewe, “Huyu ni dada yangu.” Kisha Abimeleki mfalme wa Gerari akatuma Sara aletwe, naye akamchukua.

english: One night, however, God came to Abimelech in a dream and told him, “You are as good as dead because of the woman you have taken, for she is a married woman.”
ekegusii: Korende Nyasae akaorokera Abimeleki botuko ase okorota, akamoteebia: “Aye goika okwe, ekiagera omokungu oyo kwarentire nomokuungu bw’omonto onde.”
swahili: Lakini Mungu akamjia Abimeleki katika ndoto wakati wa usiku na kumwambia, “Wewe ni kama mfu kwa sababu ya huyu mwanamke uliyemchukua; yeye ni mke wa mtu.”

english: Now Abimelech had not gone near her, so he replied, “Lord, would You destroy a nation even though it is innocent?
ekegusii: Abimeleki konya ataraba nere, akabora: “Aye Omonene, Inee, nigo oraite nonya nabanyaboronge?
swahili: Wakati huo Abimeleki alikuwa bado hajamsogelea, kwa hiyo akasema, “Je, Bwana utaliharibu taifa lisilo na hatia?

english: Didn’t Abraham tell me, ‘She is my sister’? And she herself said, ‘He is my brother.’ I have done this in the integrity of my heart and the innocence of my hands.”
ekegusii: Inee! Omonto oyio tantebeetie ere omonyene ng’a oyo mosubati omwabo? Na omokungu nere aganteebia ng’a oyo momura omwabo? Ase enkoro etari na komocha konde, na ase amaboko amarabu nakorire ayio.”
swahili: Hakusema kwangu, ‘Huyu ni dada yangu,’ naye Sara pia hakusema, ‘Huyu ni kaka yangu’? Nimefanya haya kwa dhamiri njema na mikono safi.”

english: Then God said to Abimelech in the dream, “Yes, I know that you did this with a clear conscience, and so I have kept you from sinning against Me. That is why I did not let you touch her.
ekegusii: Erio Nyasae akamoteebia ase okoroota: “Inche namanyire ng’a ase enkoro etari na komocha gwakorire aya, na inche nkagotanga tigwankorera ebibe. Ase ayio, tinakoa ribaga omokune.
swahili: Kisha Mungu akamwambia katika ndoto, “Ndiyo, najua ya kwamba umefanya haya kwa dhamiri safi, kwa hiyo nimekuzuia usinitende dhambi. Ndiyo sababu sikukuacha umguse.

english: Now return the man’s wife, for he is a prophet; he will pray for you and you will live. But if you do not restore her, be aware that you will surely die—you and all who belong to you.”
ekegusii: Bono moiranerie omonto oria mokaye, ekiagera ere n’omobani, nagosabere onyare koba moyo. Korende otamoiranereti, manya amaene, goika okwe, aye amo na abanto bao bonsi ore nabarabwo.”
swahili: Sasa umrudishe huyo mke wa mtu, kwa maana ni nabii, naye atakuombea nawe utaishi. Lakini kama hutamrudisha, ujue kwa hakika kuwa wewe na watu wako wote mtakufa.”

english: Early the next morning Abimelech got up and summoned all his servants; and when he described to them all that had happened, the men were terrified.
ekegusii: Abimeleki akaimoka mambia chuni akarangeria abasomba baye bonsi, akabateebia amang’ana aya onsi, na abanto abwo bakaondoka mono.
swahili: Kesho yake asubuhi na mapema Abimeleki akawaita maafisa wake wote, na baada ya kuwaambia yote yaliyotokea, waliogopa sana.

english: Then Abimelech called Abraham and asked, “What have you done to us? How have I sinned against you, that you have brought such tremendous guilt upon me and my kingdom? You have done things to me that should not be done.”
ekegusii: Erio Abimeleki akarangeria Aburaamu, akamobooria: “Inki eke gwatokoreire iga? Inki nakomocheire goika kwarentire igoro yane na igoro y’oborwoti bwane ebibe ebinene buna ebi? Gwankoreire amang’ana atagwenereti gokorwa.”
swahili: Kisha Abimeleki akamwita Abrahamu na kumwambia, “Wewe umetufanyia nini? Nimekukosea nini hata ukaleta hatia kubwa namna hii juu yangu na ufalme wangu? Umenifanyia mambo ambayo hayakupasa kufanyika.”

english: Now the LORD attended to Sarah as He had said, and the LORD did for Sarah what He had promised.
ekegusii: Omonene akamotaarera Sara, akamokorera buna konya amoriereire eira.
swahili: Wakati huu Bwana akamrehemu Sara kama alivyokuwa amesema, naye Bwana akamtendea Sara kile alichokuwa ameahidi.

english: and she said to Abraham, “Expel the slave woman and her son, for the slave woman’s son will never share in the inheritance with my son Isaac!”
ekegusii: Ase ayio agateebia Aburaamu: “Moserie omokungu oyo omosomba amo nomwana oye, ekiagera omwana bw’omokuungu oyo omosomba takoria omwando amo nomwana one Isaka.”
swahili: Sara akamwambia Abrahamu, “Mwondoe mwanamke huyo mtumwa pamoja na mwanawe, kwa kuwa mwana wa mwanamke mtumwa kamwe hatarithi pamoja na mwanangu Isaki.”

english: Now this matter distressed Abraham greatly because it concerned his son Ishmael.
ekegusii: Ring’ana erio tiriamogwenera Aburaamu nonya ng’ake, ase engencho y’omwana oye.
swahili: Jambo hili lilimhuzunisha sana Abrahamu kwa sababu lilimhusu mwanawe.

english: But God said to Abraham, “Do not be distressed about the boy and your maidservant. Listen to everything that Sarah tells you, for through Isaac your offspring will be reckoned.
ekegusii: Korende Nyasae agateebia Aburaamu: “Ring’ana eri tiriba riibe asore, ase engencho y’omwana oyo, na ase engencho y’omokuungu oyo, omosomba oo. Rinde rionsi Sara akogoteebia, riigwere, ekiagera korwa ase Isaka ororeeria rwao narwatorwe.
swahili: Lakini Mungu akamwambia, “Usihuzunike hivyo kwa sababu ya kijana na mtumishi wako wa kike. Sikiliza lolote Sara analokuambia, kwa sababu uzao wako utahesabiwa kupitia kwake Isaki.

english: But I will also make a nation of the slave woman’s son, because he is your offspring.”
ekegusii: Naboigo, omwana bw’omokuungu oyo omosomba nimokore abe egesaku ekenene, ekiagera nere oyio nomwana oo.”
swahili: Nitamfanya huyu mwana wa mtumishi wako wa kike kuwa taifa pia, kwa sababu naye ni uzao wako.”

english: Early in the morning, Abraham got up, took bread and a skin of water, put them on Hagar’s shoulders, and sent her away with the boy. She left and wandered in the Wilderness of Beersheba.
ekegusii: Erio Aburaamu akaimoka mambia chuni, akaimokia omogati na ebirandi biroiseirie amasankwa, bire n’amaache, akabiaa Hagari, akamobibekera mareko. Akamorentera na omwana, akamoteebia agende amo nere. Akagenda, akana‐koong’anya ase erooro ya Beeri‐Seba.
swahili: Kesho yake asubuhi na mapema, Abrahamu akachukua chakula na kiriba cha maji, akampa Hagari. Akaviweka mabegani mwa Hagari, akamwondoa pamoja na kijana. Hagari akashika njia, akatangatanga katika jangwa la Beer-Sheba.

english: When the water in the skin was gone, she left the boy under one of the bushes.
ekegusii: Ekero amaache aria areenge ebirandi ime aerire, akaareria omwana inse y’egetutu.
swahili: Maji yalipokwisha kwenye kiriba, akamwacha kijana chini ya mojawapo ya vichaka.

english: Then she went off and sat down nearby, about a bowshot away, for she said, “I cannot bear to watch the boy die!” And as she sat nearby, she lifted up her voice and wept.
ekegusii: Erio akagenda, agaikaransa are ake, ase oboare bw’okoruta ensara, ekiagera nigo atebeete: “Tinkonyara korigereria omwana one ekero ogokwa.” Ekero aikaransete omorigereretie, agaaka eriogi riaye, akareera.
swahili: Kisha akajiendea zake akaketi karibu, umbali wa kutupa mshale, akawaza, “Siwezi kumwangalia kijana akifa.” Ikawa alipokuwa ameketi pale karibu, akaanza kulia kwa huzuni.

english: Then God heard the voice of the boy, and the angel of God called to Hagar from heaven, “What is wrong, Hagar? Do not be afraid, for God has heard the voice of the boy where he lies.
ekegusii: Nyasae akaigwa okoreera kw’omwana, na omomalaika o Nyasae akarangeria Hagari korwa igoro, akamoteebia: “Hagari, inki okoreera? Tibwoboa, ekiagera Nyasae oigure okoreera kw’omwana agwo ase araire.
swahili: Mungu akamsikia kijana akilia, malaika wa Mungu akamwita Hagari kutoka mbinguni na kumwambia, “Kuna nini Hagari? Usiogope, Mungu amesikia kijana analia akiwa amelala pale.

english: Get up, lift up the boy, and take him by the hand, for I will make him into a great nation.”
ekegusii: Tenena, oimokie omwana, omobwate koboko kwao; naki nimokore abe egesaku ekenene.”
swahili: Mwinue kijana na umshike mkono, kwa maana nitamfanya kuwa taifa kubwa.”

english: Then God opened her eyes, and she saw a well of water. So she went and filled the skin with water and gave the boy a drink.
ekegusii: Erio Nyasae akaramokia Hagari amaiso, na ere akarora ensoko y’amaache, akagenda, akabuucha, agaichoria ekerandi amaache, akaa omwana oria erio akanywa.
swahili: Ndipo Mungu akamfumbua Hagari macho yake naye akaona kisima cha maji. Hivyo akaenda akajaza kiriba maji na kumpa kijana anywe.

english: So Sarah conceived and bore a son to Abraham in his old age, at the very time God had promised.
ekegusii: Erio Sara akaba morito, akaiborera Aburaamu omwana omoisia ase obogotu bwaye, ase engaki eria Nyasae amotebeetie.
swahili: Sara akapata mimba, akamzalia Abrahamu mwana katika uzee wake, majira yale ya Mungu aliomwahidi.

english: And God was with the boy, and he grew up and settled in the wilderness and became a great archer.
ekegusii: Nyasae akaba amo nomwana oria. Ere akamenya ase erooro, akaba omomanyi bw’okorasa nemegwe.
swahili: Mungu akawa pamoja na huyu kijana alipokuwa akiendelea kukua. Aliishi jangwani na akawa mpiga upinde.

english: And while he was dwelling in the Wilderness of Paran, his mother got a wife for him from the land of Egypt. The Covenant at Beersheba
ekegusii: Akamenya ase erooro ya Parani, na ng’ina akamonyuomeria omokungu korwa ase ense ya Misiri. Aburaamu na Abimeleki bagokora okobwatana
swahili: Alipokuwa akiishi katika Jangwa la Parani, mama yake akampatia mke kutoka Misri. Mapatano Katika Beer-Sheba

english: At that time Abimelech and Phicol the commander of his army said to Abraham, “God is with you in all that you do.
ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio Abimeleki na Pikoli, omochiki omonene bw’abarwani baye, bagateebia Aburaamu: “Nyasae nare amo naye ase ande onsi ogokora.
swahili: Wakati huo Abimeleki na Fikoli mkuu wa majeshi yake wakamwambia Abrahamu, “Mungu yu pamoja nawe katika kila kitu unachofanya.

english: Now, therefore, swear to me here before God that you will not deal falsely with me or my children or descendants. Show to me and to the country in which you reside the same kindness that I have shown to you.”
ekegusii: Ase ayio, bono karie eira na gotiana ase Nyasae ng’a togonkorera obong’ainereria inche, na abana baane, na abachokoro baane, korende koreng’ana buna inche nagokorerete aye, obwanchani obo naye onkorere nainche boigo, amo nense eye aye omenyete ime.”
swahili: Sasa niapie hapa mbele za Mungu kwamba hutanitenda hila mimi, watoto wangu wala wazao wangu. Nitendee mimi na nchi ambayo unaishi kama mgeni wema ule ule ambao nimekutendea.”

english: And Abraham replied, “I swear it.”
ekegusii: Aburaamu agateeba: “Ee, ninkoriere eira.”
swahili: Abrahamu akasema, “Ninaapa hivyo.”

english: But when Abraham complained to Abimelech about a well that Abimelech’s servants had seized,
ekegusii: Aburaamu akamwemurunganeria Abimeleki ase engencho y’ensoko eria abasomba b’Abimeleki bamourete.
swahili: Ndipo Abrahamu akalalamika kwa Abimeleki kuhusu kisima cha maji ambacho watumishi wa Abimeleki walikuwa wamekinyangʼanya.

english: Abimelech replied, “I do not know who has done this. You did not tell me, so I have not heard about it until today.”
ekegusii: Abimeleki akamoteebia: “Inche timanyeti ning’o okorete ring’ana erio, gose tikwana gonteebia; nonya nokoigwa, tinana koyaigwa otatiga reero rioka.”
swahili: Lakini Abimeleki akasema, “Sijui ni nani ambaye amefanya hili. Hukuniambia, leo tu ndipo ninasikia habari zake.”

english: So Abraham brought sheep and cattle and gave them to Abimelech, and the two men made a covenant.
ekegusii: Erio Aburaamu akaimokia etugo yaye, ching’ondi ne chiombe, akaa Abimeleki, na barabwo babere bagakora okobwatana gati yabo.
swahili: Hivyo Abrahamu akaleta kondoo na ngʼombe, akampa Abimeleki, nao watu hawa wawili wakafanya mapatano.

english: Abraham separated seven ewe lambs from the flock,
ekegusii: Aburaamu agaatanana chimanwa chisigiti isano na ibere, agachibeeka ensemo.
swahili: Abrahamu akatenga kondoo wa kike saba kutoka kwenye kundi,

english: and Abimelech asked him, “Why have you set apart these seven ewe lambs?”
ekegusii: Abimeleki akabooria Aburaamu: “Inee, chimanwa echi chisigiti isano na ibere gwatanana, engencho yaye inki?”
swahili: Abimeleki akamuuliza Abrahamu, “Ni nini maana ya hawa kondoo wa kike saba uliowatenga peke yao?”

english: And Abraham gave the name Isaac to the son Sarah bore to him.
ekegusii: Omwana oyio Sara aiborete, Aburaamu ise akamoroka Isaka.
swahili: Abrahamu akamwita Isaki yule mwana ambaye Sara alimzalia.

english: He replied, “You are to accept the seven ewe lambs from my hand as my witness that I dug this well.”
ekegusii: Aburaamu akamoiraneria: “Chimanwa echi chisigiti isano na ibere nigo nagochieire korwa ase okoboko kwane, erinde chibe kirori ase ’nde, ng’a ensoko eye ninche nayeremete.”
swahili: Abrahamu akamjibu, “Upokee hawa kondoo wa kike saba kutoka mkononi mwangu kama ushahidi kuwa nilichimba kisima hiki.”

english: So that place was called Beersheba, because it was there that the two of them swore an oath.
ekegusii: Ase ayio bakaaroka ase agwo Beeri‐Seba, ekiagera barabwo babere mbariereranete emuma aroro.
swahili: Hivyo mahali pale pakaitwa Beer-Sheba, kwa sababu watu wawili waliapiana hapo.

english: After they had made the covenant at Beersheba, Abimelech and Phicol the commander of his army got up and returned to the land of the Philistines.
ekegusii: Ekero bakorire okobwatana aria Beeri‐Seba, Abimeleki na Pikoli, oria omochiki omonene bw’abarwani baye, bakaimoka korwa agwo, bakairana ase ense y’Abafilisti.
swahili: Baada ya mapatano kufanyika huko Beer-Sheba, Abimeleki na Fikoli mkuu wa majeshi yake wakarudi katika nchi ya Wafilisti.

english: And Abraham planted a tamarisk tree in Beersheba, and there he called upon the name of the LORD, the Eternal God.
ekegusii: Aburaamu agasimeka omote onga buna ekerachuoki aria Beeri‐Seba, na agwo akarangeria erieta ria Nyasae Omonene o kare na kare ase okomosasiima.
swahili: Abrahamu akapanda mti wa mkwaju huko Beer-Sheba, na hapo akaliitia jina la Bwana, Mungu wa milele.

english: And Abraham resided in the land of the Philistines for a long time.
ekegusii: Aburaamu akamenya buna omomenyi ase ense y’Abafilisti amatuko amange.
swahili: Naye Abrahamu akakaa katika nchi ya Wafilisti kwa muda mrefu.

english: When his son Isaac was eight days old, Abraham circumcised him, as God had commanded him.
ekegusii: Ekero Isaka akoorire amatuko atano na atato, Aburaamu akamwarokia, buna Nyasae konya amochikiire.
swahili: Isaki alipokuwa na umri wa siku nane, Abrahamu akamtahiri, kama Mungu alivyomwamuru.

english: Abraham was a hundred years old when his son Isaac was born to him.
ekegusii: Aburaamu nigo areenge nemiaka rigana erimo ekero Isaka, omwana oye, aiboretwe.
swahili: Abrahamu alikuwa na miaka 100 wakati Isaki mwanawe alipozaliwa.

english: Then Sarah said, “God has made me laugh, and everyone who hears of this will laugh with me.”
ekegusii: Sara akabora: “Nyasae onkoreire amaseko, na onde bwensi orayaigwe nansegisie.”
swahili: Sara akasema, “Mungu ameniletea kicheko, kila mmoja atakayesikia jambo hili atacheka pamoja nami.”

english: She added, “Who would have told Abraham that Sarah would nurse children? Yet I have borne him a son in his old age.”
ekegusii: Naende agateeba: “Ning’o nanga ore komoteebia Aburaamu ng’a Sara nagonkie abana? Na bono namoiboreire omwana ase obogotu bwaye.”
swahili: Akaongeza kusema, “Nani angemwambia Abrahamu kuwa Sara angenyonyesha watoto? Tena nimemzalia mwana katika uzee wake.” Hagari Na Ishmaeli Wafukuzwa

english: So the child grew and was weaned, and Abraham held a great feast on the day Isaac was weaned. Sarah Turns against Hagar (Galatians 4:21–30)
ekegusii: Omwana oria agakina, agatiga okogonka. Ase rituko riria Isaka atigete kogonka, Aburaamu agakora omoyega omonene. Ogoserigwa gwa Isumaeli na Hagari
swahili: Mtoto akakua, akaachishwa kunyonya. Siku hiyo Isaki alipoachishwa kunyonya, Abrahamu alifanya sherehe kubwa.

english: But Sarah saw that the son whom Hagar the Egyptian had borne to Abraham was mocking her son,
ekegusii: Korende Sara akarora omwana oria o Hagari Omomisiri, oyio aiborerete Aburaamu, ogochecheria Isaka, omwana oye.
swahili: Lakini Sara aliona kuwa mwana ambaye Hagari, Mmisri, aliyemzalia Abrahamu alikuwa anadhihaki,

english: Some time later God tested Abraham and said to him, “Abraham!” “Here I am,” he answered.
ekegusii: Ekaba magega y’amang’ana ayio, Nyasae akabeekera Aburaamu ogoteemwa. Akamorangeria: “Aburaamu!” Na Aburaamu akamoitabeera. “Nao inde aa.”
swahili: Baadaye Mungu akamjaribu Abrahamu. Akamwambia, “Abrahamu!” Abrahamu akajibu, “Mimi hapa.”

english: Then Abraham reached out his hand and took the knife to slaughter his son. The LORD Provides the Sacrifice
ekegusii: Erio Aburaamu akarambora okoboko kwaye, akabogoria omoyio anyenye omwana oye.
swahili: Kisha akanyoosha mkono wake na akachukua kisu ili amchinje mwanawe.

english: Just then the angel of the LORD called out to him from heaven, “Abraham, Abraham!” “Here I am,” he replied.
ekegusii: Korende omomalaika Omonene akamorangeria korwa igoro, akabora: “Aburaamu, Aburaamu!” Ere agaitaba: “Nao inde aa.”
swahili: Lakini malaika wa Bwana akamwita kutoka mbinguni, akamwambia, “Abrahamu! Abrahamu!” Akajibu, “Mimi hapa.”

english: “Do not lay a hand on the boy or do anything to him,” said the angel, “for now I know that you fear God, since you have not withheld your only son from me. ”
ekegusii: Omomalaika oria akamoteebia: “Torambora okoboko kwao igoro ase omwana oo, gose tomokorera ing’ana rinde rionsi riibe. Bono namanyire ng’a nomoirogete Nyasae, naende narorire ng’a tondineti omwana oo omomoima.”
swahili: Akamwambia, “Usimdhuru kijana, wala usimtendee jambo lolote. Sasa ninajua kwamba unamcha Mungu, kwa sababu hukunizuilia mwanao, mwana wako wa pekee.”

english: Then Abraham looked up and saw behind him a ram in a thicket, caught by its horns. So he went and took the ram and offered it as a burnt offering in place of his son.
ekegusii: Aburaamu akaimokerereria amaiso aye igoro, akaonchora ebigoti gochia aa anaaria, akarora eng’ondi emingichi ebwatire ching’unchara ase orosana nemerande. Aburaamu akagenda, akarusia eng’ondi eyio, akayerua, ekaba ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa ase ribaga ri’omwana oye.
swahili: Abrahamu akainua macho yake, akaona kondoo dume amenaswa pembe zake nyuma yake katika kichaka. Akaenda akamchukua huyo kondoo dume, akamtoa awe sadaka ya kuteketezwa badala ya mwanawe.

english: And Abraham called that place The LORD Will Provide. So to this day it is said, “On the mountain of the LORD it will be provided.”
ekegusii: Aburaamu Akaaroka aase aria “Omonene nayaroke” (Yahwe‐Yire); buna abanto bagokwana goika reero iga: “Ase egetunwa ki’ Omonene, nao ekonyorekana.”
swahili: Abrahamu akapaita mahali pale Yehova-Yire. Mpaka siku ya leo inasemekana, “Katika mlima wa Bwana itapatikana.”

english: And the angel of the LORD called to Abraham from heaven a second time,
ekegusii: Omomalaika Omonene akarangeria Aburaamu korwa igoro eria kabere, akamoteebia:
swahili: Basi malaika wa Bwana akamwita Abrahamu kutoka mbinguni mara ya pili,

english: saying, “By Myself I have sworn, declares the LORD, that because you have done this and have not withheld your only son,
ekegusii: “Omonene oteebire: Netianirie inche omonyene, ekiagera gwakorire ring’ana eri, gose tondineti omwana oo omomoima.
swahili: akasema, “Ninaapa kwa nafsi yangu, asema Bwana, kwamba kwa sababu umefanya jambo hili na hukunizuilia mwanao, mwana wako wa pekee,

english: I will surely bless you, and I will multiply your descendants like the stars in the sky and the sand on the seashore. Your descendants will possess the gates of their enemies.
ekegusii: Ase ogosesenia ningosesenie, na ase okomenta nimente ororeeria rwao, robe oronge buna ching’enang’eni chia igoro na buna omokenye ore engegu y’enyancha, na ororeeria rwao inarobue emechie y’ababisa babo,
swahili: hakika nitakubariki, na nitauzidisha uzao wako kama nyota za angani na kama mchanga ulioko pwani. Wazao wako watamiliki miji ya adui zao,

english: And through your offspring all nations of the earth will be blessed, because you have obeyed My voice.”
ekegusii: na ase ororeeria rwao ebisaku bionsi bi’ense inabisesenigwe, ekiagera kwanyigwereire.”
swahili: na kupitia uzao wako mataifa yote duniani yatabarikiwa, kwa sababu umenitii.”

english: Abraham went back to his servants, and they got up and set out together for Beersheba. And Abraham settled in Beersheba. The Sons of Nahor
ekegusii: Erio Aburaamu akairana gochia ase abamura baria baarenge komo; bonsi bakaimoka, bakagenda amo gochia Beeri‐Seba; na Aburaamu akaba okomenya agwo Beeri‐Seba. Ororeeria rwa Nahori
swahili: Ndipo Abrahamu akawarudia watumishi wake, wakaondoka wakaenda wote pamoja mpaka Beer-Sheba. Abrahamu akaishi huko Beer-Sheba. Wana Wa Nahori

english: “Take your son,” God said, “your only son Isaac, whom you love, and go to the land of Moriah. Offer him there as a burnt offering on one of the mountains, which I will show you.”
ekegusii: Nyasae akamoteebia: “Moire Isaka, omwana oyo oo omomoima, oyobwanchete, ogende nere goika ense ya Moria. Agwo omorue abe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosaambwa ase egetunwa ekemo ki’ebio ndakworokie.”
swahili: Kisha Mungu akamwambia, “Umchukue mwanao, mwana wako wa pekee, Isaki umpendaye, uende katika nchi ya Moria. Mtoe huko kama sadaka ya kuteketezwa juu ya mlima mmojawapo nitakaokuambia.”

english: Some time later, Abraham was told, “Milcah has also borne sons to your brother Nahor:
ekegusii: Magega y’amang’ana ayio kaerire Aburaamu agateebigwa ng’a, “Milka oiboreire momura omino Nahori abana.
swahili: Baada ya muda, Abrahamu akaambiwa, “Milka pia amepata watoto, amemzalia ndugu yako Nahori wana:

english: Uz the firstborn, his brother Buz, Kemuel (the father of Aram),
ekegusii: Abana abwo nabwo aba: Usi, omwana oye omotangi, na Busi omwabo, na Kemueli, ise Aramu,
swahili: Usi mzaliwa wake wa kwanza, Buzi nduguye, Kemueli (baba wa Aramu),

english: Chesed, Hazo, Pildash, Jidlaph, and Bethuel.”
ekegusii: na Kesedi, na Haso, na Pilidasi, na Yidilafu, na Betueli.”
swahili: Kesedi, Hazo, Pildashi, Yidlafu na Bethueli.”

english: And Bethuel became the father of Rebekah. Milcah bore these eight sons to Abraham’s brother Nahor.
ekegusii: Betueli nere omoiborete omoiseke ore korokwa Rebeka. Abwo batano na batato nabwo Milka aiborerete Nahori, momura omwabo Aburaamu.
swahili: Bethueli akamzaa Rebeka. Milka alimzalia Nahori nduguye Abrahamu hao wana wanane.

english: Moreover, Nahor’s concubine, whose name was Reumah, bore Tebah, Gaham, Tahash, and Maacah.
ekegusii: Naende omokungu oye o sere‐sere, ore korokwa Reuma, akamoiborera Teba, na Gahamu, na Tahasi, na Maaka.
swahili: Suria wake Nahori aliyeitwa Reuma pia alikuwa na wana: Teba, Gahamu, Tahashi na Maaka.

english: So Abraham got up early the next morning, saddled his donkey, and took along two of his servants and his son Isaac. He split the wood for a burnt offering and set out for the place God had designated.
ekegusii: Aburaamu akaimoka mambia chuni, akabeeka ebinto ase etigere yaye, akairana abamura babere amo nere, na Isaka omwana oye. Agaatia chinko agochia gosambera ekeng’wanso, akaimoka, akagenda gochia aase aria ateebetigwe na Nyasae.
swahili: Abrahamu akaamka asubuhi na mapema siku iliyofuata, akamtayarisha punda wake. Akawachukua watumishi wake wawili pamoja na Isaki mwanawe. Baada ya kuchanja kuni za kutosha kwa ajili ya hiyo sadaka ya kuteketezwa, akaondoka kuelekea mahali Mungu alipokuwa amemwambia.

english: On the third day Abraham looked up and saw the place in the distance.
ekegusii: Rituko ria gatato Aburaamu akaimokereria amaiso aye igoro, akarora aase aria korwa aare.
swahili: Siku ya tatu Abrahamu akainua macho, akapaona mahali pale kwa mbali.

english: “Stay here with the donkey,” Abraham told his servants. “The boy and I will go over there to worship, and then we will return to you.”
ekegusii: Erio Aburaamu agateebia abamura baria abaarenge komo: “Ikaransa inwe aiga amo netigere eye! Inche amo nomwana oyo one nkogenda tore gochia aria, tosasime, erio toirane ase more naende.”
swahili: Akawaambia watumishi wake, “Kaeni hapa pamoja na punda, wakati mimi na kijana tunakwenda kule. Tutakwenda kuabudu na kisha tutawarudia.”

english: Abraham took the wood for the burnt offering and placed it on his son Isaac. He himself carried the fire and the sacrificial knife, and the two of them walked on together.
ekegusii: Aburaamu akaimokia chinko echi areenge gochia gosambera ekeng’wanso, agatweka Isaka omwana oye, na ere omonyene akaimokia omorero na omoyio. Bakagenda amo bonsi babere.
swahili: Abrahamu akachukua kuni kwa ajili ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa, akamtwika Isaki mwanawe, yeye mwenyewe akachukua moto na kisu. Walipokuwa wakienda pamoja,

english: Then Isaac said to his father Abraham, “My father!” “Here I am, my son,” he replied. “The fire and the wood are here,” said Isaac, “but where is the lamb for the burnt offering?”
ekegusii: Isaka agakwana na Aburaamu ise, agateeba: “Tata!” Ise agoitaba ogoteeba: “Nao inde aa, omwana one.” Isaka akamobooria: “Rora, omorero ne chinko ntobwate, korende ng’ai emaanwa y’eng’ondi ere togochia gokorera ekeng’wanso ki’ogosaambwa?”
swahili: Isaki akanena akamwambia Abrahamu baba yake, “Baba yangu!” Abrahamu akaitika, “Mimi hapa, mwanangu.” Isaki akasema, “Moto na kuni zipo, Je, yuko wapi mwana-kondoo kwa ajili ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa?”

english: Abraham answered, “God Himself will provide the lamb for the burnt offering, my son.” And the two walked on together.
ekegusii: Aburaamu akamoiraneria: “Omwana one, Nyasae nenyorere emaanwa y’eng’ondi ase ekeng’wanso eke.” Erio bakagenderera amo bonsi babere.
swahili: Abrahamu akajibu, “Mwanangu, Mungu mwenyewe atajipatia mwana-kondoo kwa ajili ya hiyo sadaka ya kuteketezwa.” Nao hawa wawili wakaendelea mbele pamoja.

english: When they arrived at the place God had designated, Abraham built the altar there and arranged the wood. He bound his son Isaac and placed him on the altar, atop the wood.
ekegusii: Kobaikire aase aria ateebetigwe na Nyasae, Aburaamu akaagacha egesasiimero agwo, akaara chinko igoro yaye, agasiba Isaka omwana oye, akamwareria igoro ye chinko chiria.
swahili: Walipofika mahali pale alipokuwa ameambiwa na Mungu, Abrahamu akajenga madhabahu hapo, akaziweka kuni juu yake. Akamfunga Isaki mwanawe na akamlaza kwenye madhabahu, juu ya zile kuni.

english: Now Ephron was sitting among the sons of Heth. So in the presence of all the Hittites who had come to the gate of his city, Ephron the Hittite answered Abraham,
ekegusii: Bono Efuroni nigo areenge oikaransete agwo ase egati y’Abahiti. Ere Efuroni, Omohiti, akairaneria Aburaamu ekero Abahiti bonsi, abaare goetera egeita ki’omochie oye, bamotegererete,
swahili: Efroni Mhiti alikuwa ameketi miongoni mwa watu wake, akamjibu Abrahamu mbele ya Wahiti wote waliokuwepo katika lango la mji.

english: “No, my lord. Listen to me. I give you the field, and I give you the cave that is in it. I give it to you in the presence of my people. Bury your dead.”
ekegusii: agateeba: “Yaya, omonene one, ntegerera. Oboremo boria nakoeire amo ne rikuruma riria rire imeo, ase amaiso ’abaanto baminto nakobieire; otindeke mokao aroro.”
swahili: “La hasha, bwana wangu, nisikilize, nakupa shamba, pia nakupa pango lililomo ndani yake. Nakupa mbele ya watu wangu. Uzike maiti wako.”

english: Again Abraham bowed down before the people of the land
ekegusii: Erio Aburaamu agatugama inse ase amasio ’abaanto b’ense eria.
swahili: Abrahamu akasujudu tena, mbele ya wenyeji wa nchi,

english: and said to Ephron in their presence, “If you will please listen to me, I will pay you the price of the field. Accept it from me, so that I may bury my dead there.”
ekegusii: Agateebia Efuroni ekero abanto b’ense eria bamotegererete: “Koranche, ntegerera! Inche nindue rigori ri’oboremo; naye obogorie chifeta korwa ase ’nde, na inche nintindeke mokane aroro.”
swahili: akamwambia Efroni wale watu wakiwa wanasikia, “Tafadhali nisikilize. Nitakulipa fedha za hilo shamba. Kubali kuzipokea ili niweze kumzika maiti wangu.”

english: Ephron answered Abraham,
ekegusii: Efuroni akairaneria Aburaamu,
swahili: Efroni akamjibu Abrahamu,

english: “Listen to me, my lord. The land is worth four hundred shekels of silver, but what is that between you and me? Bury your dead.”
ekegusii: akamoteebia: “Omonene one, ntegerera! Oboremo obwo bw’erigori rie chisekeli chi’efeta amagana ane, ngento ki toengereranie inche naye? Tindeka mokao agwo.”
swahili: “Nisikilize, bwana wangu, thamani ya ardhi hiyo ni shekeli 400 za fedha, lakini hiyo ni nini kati yako na mimi? Mzike maiti wako.”

english: Abraham agreed to Ephron’s terms and weighed out for him the price he had named in the hearing of the Hittites: four hundred shekels of silver, according to the standard of the merchants.
ekegusii: Aburaamu bagaancherana na Efuroni; na Aburaamu akarengera Efuroni chifeta chiria ateebete Abahiti kobaigwete, chisekeli chi’echifeta amagana ane, koreng’ana nekerengo giancheranire nabaonchoreria.
swahili: Abrahamu akakubali masharti ya Efroni, akampimia ile fedha aliyotaja masikioni mwa Wahiti: Shekeli 400 za fedha kulingana na viwango vya uzito vilivyokuwa vikitumika wakati huo na wafanyabiashara.

english: So Ephron’s field at Machpelah near Mamre, the cave that was in it, and all the trees within the boundaries of the field were deeded over
ekegusii: Oboremo bw’Efuroni obwo bware agwo Makipela moocha ya Mamure, oboremo amo ne rikuruma riria riare imeo na emete yonsi yareengeo, ensemo eria yonsi Aburaamu akayeegwa.
swahili: Hivyo shamba la Efroni huko Makpela karibu na Mamre, yaani shamba pamoja na pango lililokuwamo, nayo miti yote iliyokuwamo ndani ya mipaka ya shamba hilo, vilikabidhiwa,

english: to Abraham’s possession in the presence of all the Hittites who had come to the gate of his city.
ekegusii: Igo ayeetwe ase amasio ’Abahiti, abwo bonsi baare gosoera egeita kiaye.
swahili: kwa Abrahamu kuwa mali yake mbele ya Wahiti wote waliokuwa wamekuja kwenye lango la mji.

english: After this, Abraham buried his wife Sarah in the cave of the field at Machpelah near Mamre (that is, Hebron) in the land of Canaan.
ekegusii: Magega y’ayio Aburaamu agatindeka Sara mokaye ase rikuruma ri’oboremo bware agwo Makipela, moocha ya Mamure, agwo nao Heburoni, ase ense ya Kaanani.
swahili: Baada ya hayo Abrahamu akamzika Sara mkewe kwenye pango ndani ya shamba la Makpela karibu na Mamre (huko Hebroni) katika nchi ya Kanaani.

english: She died in Kiriath-arba (that is, Hebron) in the land of Canaan, and Abraham went out to mourn and to weep for her.
ekegusii: Sara agakwera ase Kiriati‐Ariba, agwo nao Heburoni, ase ense ya Kaanani. Aburaamu akagenda komoreera Sara na okweumia okonene, na akaroberia omoyega bw’ogotindekwa kwaye.
swahili: Sara akafa huko Kiriath-Arba (yaani Hebroni) katika nchi ya Kanaani, Abrahamu akamwombolezea na kumlilia Sara.

english: So the field and its cave were deeded by the Hittites to Abraham as a burial site.
ekegusii: Nabo oboremo boria, ne rikuruma riria riare imeo, Aburaamu akabinyora korwa ase Abahiti bibe aase kwaye agwo ase agotindeka abakuure.
swahili: Hivyo Wahiti wakamkabidhi Abrahamu shamba pamoja na pango lililokuwa humo kuwa mahali pa kuzikia.

english: Then Abraham got up from beside his dead wife and said to the Hittites,
ekegusii: Aburaamu akaimoka korwa ase egetondo kiaye, agateebia Abahiti,
swahili: Ndipo Abrahamu akainuka kutoka pale penye maiti ya mke wake. Akazungumza na Wahiti, akasema,

english: “I am a foreigner and an outsider among you. Give me a burial site among you so that I can bury my dead.”
ekegusii: “Inche nomomenyi inde, imenyete ase egati yaino; komoranche mong’e aase ntindeke omokungu one onkwereire, imorusie ase obosio bwane.”
swahili: “Mimi ni mpitaji na mgeni miongoni mwenu. Niuzieni sehemu ya ardhi yenu ili niweze kumzika maiti wangu.”

english: The Hittites replied to Abraham,
ekegusii: Abahiti bakairaneria Aburaamu, bakamoteebia,
swahili: Wahiti wakamjibu Abrahamu,

english: “Listen to us, sir. You are God’s chosen one among us. Bury your dead in the finest of our tombs. None of us will withhold his tomb for burying your dead.”
ekegusii: “Omonene, totegerere! Aye nigo ore omonto omonene o Nyasae ase egati yaito. Tindeka omokungu oo ase embeera ende yonsi engiya orachoore. Onde tari ase egati yaito orakorine embeera yaye gose agotange totindeka omokungu oo.”
swahili: “Bwana, tusikilize. Wewe ni mtawala mkuu sana miongoni mwetu. Zika maiti wako katika kaburi unalolipenda kati ya makaburi yetu. Hakuna mtu wa kwetu atakayekuzuia kaburi lake ili kuzika maiti wako.”

english: Then Abraham rose and bowed down before the people of the land, the Hittites.
ekegusii: Aburaamu akaimoka, agatugama inse ase amasio ’Abahiti, abanto b’ense eria.
swahili: Abrahamu akainuka na akasujudu mbele ya wenyeji wa nchi, yaani Wahiti.

english: “If you are willing for me to bury my dead,” he said to them, “listen to me, and approach Ephron son of Zohar on my behalf
ekegusii: Ere agakwana nabarabwo, akabora: “Komoranche mong’e ribaga ntindeke omokungu one, imorusie ase obosio bwane, monyigwe na monsabere ase Efuroni, omwana o Sohari,
swahili: Akawaambia, “Kama mnaniruhusu kumzika maiti wangu, basi nisikilizeni mkamsihi Efroni mwana wa Sohari kwa niaba yangu

english: to sell me the cave of Machpelah that belongs to him; it is at the end of his field. Let him sell it to me in your presence for full price, so that I may have a burial site.”
ekegusii: ang’e rikuruma riaye, erio rire agwo Makipela, ase ensinyo y’oboremo bwaye. Ase rigori riikeranu tiga ang’ere ase amasio aino, togoranereo, ribe aase aane ndabe ngotindeka abakuure.”
swahili: ili aniuzie pango la Makpela, lililo mali yake, nalo liko mwisho wa shamba lake. Mwambieni aniuzie kwa bei kamili atakayosema ili liwe mahali pangu pa kuzikia miongoni mwenu.”

english: By now Abraham was old and well along in years, and the LORD had blessed him in every way.
ekegusii: Bono Aburaamu konya obeire omogotu, akoorire emiaka emenge; n’Omonene konya omosesenirie ase amang’ana onsi.
swahili: Wakati huu Abrahamu alikuwa mzee mwenye miaka mingi, naye Bwana alikuwa amembariki katika kila njia.

english: Then the servant took ten of his master’s camels and departed with all manner of good things from his master in hand. And he set out for Nahor’s hometown in Aram-naharaim.
ekegusii: Erio omosomba oria akarusia chingamia ikomi chi’omonene oye, akaimokia na ebiegwa ebinge ebiya; akaimoka, akagenda gochia Mesopotamia, agaika omochie oria Nahori amenyete.
swahili: Ndipo huyo mtumishi akachukua ngamia kumi miongoni mwa ngamia za bwana wake, akaondoka, akiwa amechukua aina zote za vitu vizuri kutoka kwa bwana wake. Akaelekea Aramu-Naharaimu na kushika njia kwenda mji wa Nahori.

english: As evening approached, he made the camels kneel down near the well outside the town at the time when the women went out to draw water.
ekegusii: Agwo agatimokeria chingamia isiko y’omochie ang’e nensoko y’amaache engaki ya mogoroba, ekero abakungu bagocha kobuucha amaache.
swahili: Akawapigisha ngamia magoti karibu na kisima cha maji nje ya mji, ilikuwa inaelekea jioni, wakati ambapo wanawake wanakuja kuteka maji.

english: “O LORD, God of my master Abraham,” he prayed, “please grant me success today, and show kindness to my master Abraham.
ekegusii: Ere agasaba, agateeba: “Aye Omonene, Nyasae bw’omonene one Aburaamu, nagosabire, onsesenie ase amang’ana aane a reero, okorere omonene one Aburaamu obwanchani.
swahili: Kisha akaomba, “Ee Bwana, Mungu wa bwana wangu Abrahamu, nipatie ushindi leo, uonyeshe huruma kwa bwana wangu Abrahamu.

english: Here I am, standing beside the spring, and the daughters of the townspeople are coming out to draw water.
ekegusii: Rora, ninteneine aiga ase ensoko y’amaache, na abaiseke b’omochie oyo ngocha bare kobuucha amaache.
swahili: Tazama, nimesimama karibu na kisima hiki cha maji, nao binti za watu wa mji huu wanakuja kuteka maji.

english: Now may it happen that the girl to whom I say, ‘Please let down your jar that I may drink,’ and who responds, ‘Drink, and I will water your camels as well’—let her be the one You have appointed for Your servant Isaac. By this I will know that You have shown kindness to my master.” Rebekah Is Chosen
ekegusii: Tiga ebe iga; Kondaborie oyomo obo: Koranche obeke enyongo yao inse, inche inywe amaache, na ere karang’iranerie: Ee, kanywe aye, na nimbuuchere chingamia chiao nachirochio; otige oyio abe nere gwachoreire omosomba oo Isaka, na inche erio nimanye ng’a aye Omonene one gwankoreire amaya ase obwanchani.”
swahili: Basi na iwe hivi, nitakapomwambia binti mmojawapo, ‘Tafadhali tua mtungi wako nipate kunywa maji,’ naye akisema, ‘Kunywa, nitawanywesha na ngamia wako pia.’ Basi na awe ndiye uliyemchagua kwa ajili ya mtumishi wako Isaki. Kwa hili nitajua umemhurumia bwana wangu.”

english: Before the servant had finished praying, Rebekah came out with her jar on her shoulder. She was the daughter of Bethuel son of Milcah, the wife of Abraham’s brother Nahor.
ekegusii: Ritang’ani atarakoora ogosaba kwaye, akarora Rebeka ogocha obogoretie enyongo yaye mareko. Ere nomoiseke o Betueli, na Betueli nomwana o Milka, moka Nahori, momura omwabo Aburaamu.
swahili: Ikawa kabla hajamaliza kuomba, Rebeka akatokea akiwa na mtungi begani mwake. Alikuwa binti wa Bethueli. Bethueli alikuwa mwana wa Milka aliyekuwa mke wa Nahori ndugu wa Abrahamu.

english: Now the girl was very beautiful, a virgin who had not had relations with any man. She went down to the spring, filled her jar, and came up again.
ekegusii: Na omoiseke oria nigo areenge omonyakieni, naende nomwekuungi, otaraba na mosacha onde. Agatirimboka gochia ase ensoko, agaichoria enyongo yaye amaache, agatiira.
swahili: Huyu msichana alikuwa mzuri sana wa sura, bikira, ambaye hakuna mtu aliyekuwa amekutana naye kimwili. Aliteremka kisimani, akajaza mtungi wake akapanda juu.

english: So the servant ran to meet her and said, “Please let me have a little water from your jar.”
ekegusii: Erio omosomba oria akaminyoka bwango gochia komoorotota, akamosaba: “Koranche, ong’e amaache inywe.”
swahili: Ndipo yule mtumishi akaharakisha kukutana naye akamwambia, “Tafadhali nipe maji kidogo katika mtungi wako.”

english: “Drink, my lord,” she replied, and she quickly lowered her jar to her hands and gave him a drink.
ekegusii: Ere akamoiraneria akamoteebia: “Kanywe, omonene one!” Agatoora enyongo yaye bwango, akayebeeka koboko kwaye, akamoa, na ere akanywa.
swahili: Yule msichana akasema, “Kunywa, bwana wangu.” Akashusha kwa haraka mtungi mkononi mwake na akampa, akanywa.

english: After she had given him a drink, she said, “I will also draw water for your camels, until they have had enough to drink.”
ekegusii: Gakoorire komoa amaache, akabora: “Ne chingamia chiao boigo ninchibuuchere, na chirochio chinywe.”
swahili: Baada ya kumpa yule mtumishi yale maji, akamwambia, “Nitateka maji kwa ajili ya ngamia zako pia mpaka wote watosheke.”

english: So Abraham instructed the chief servant of his household, who managed all he owned, “Place your hand under my thigh,
ekegusii: Aburaamu akarangeria omosomba oye oyo konya omokoreire ase emiaka emenge mono, na omorenderete enibo yaye yonsi, akamoteebia: “Beka okoboko kwao inse y’ebinama biane,
swahili: Akamwambia mtumishi wake mkuu wa vitu vyote katika nyumba yake, yule aliyekuwa msimamizi wa vitu vyote alivyokuwa navyo, “Weka mkono wako chini ya paja langu,

english: And she quickly emptied her jar into the trough and ran back to the well to draw water, until she had drawn water for all his camels.
ekegusii: Akaayerera, akaumora amaache aria areenge ase enyongo ase orotuba ime, akaminyoka bwango ase ensoko naende, agachibuuchera chingamia chiaye chionsi.
swahili: Akafanya haraka kumimina maji kwenye birika ya kunyweshea wanyama, akakimbia kisimani kuteka maji mengine na akateka ya kuwatosha ngamia wake wote.

english: Meanwhile, the man watched her silently to see whether or not the LORD had made his journey a success.
ekegusii: Erio omonto oria akamobeta amaiso, akaba okirete kiri, erinde amanye gose Omonene osesesenirie orogendo rwaye, gose taibo.
swahili: Pasipo kusema neno, yule mtumishi akamtazama kwa makini aone kama Bwana ameifanikisha safari yake, au la.

english: And after the camels had finished drinking, he took out a gold ring weighing a beka, and two gold bracelets for her wrists weighing ten shekels.
ekegusii: Ekero chingamia chiakoorire konywa amaache, omonto oria akamoruseria ekegera gi’etaabu, kiare noborito bwe chigiramu isano na isato, na ebitange bibere bie chitaabu ase amaboko aye, ebiare noborito bwe chigiramu rigana erimo, na emerongo etano.
swahili: Ikawa ngamia walipokwisha kunywa wote, yule mtumishi akampa huyo msichana pete ya puani ya dhahabu yenye uzito wa beka moja na bangili mbili za dhahabu zenye uzito wa shekeli kumi.

english: “Whose daughter are you?” he asked. “Please tell me, is there room in your father’s house for us to spend the night?”
ekegusii: Akamobooria: “Nomoiseke o ng’o ore? Naende onteebie gose ribaga ndire mwa iso toranyare koraara botuko.”
swahili: Kisha akamuuliza, “Wewe ni binti wa nani? Tafadhali uniambie, je, kuna nafasi katika nyumba ya baba yako tutakapoweza kulala?”

english: She replied, “I am the daughter of Bethuel, the son that Milcah bore to Nahor.”
ekegusii: Ere akamoiraneria: “Inche nomoiseke o Betueli, oyo Milka aiborerete Nahori.”
swahili: Yule msichana akamjibu, “Mimi ni binti wa Bethueli, mwana wa Milka aliyemzalia Nahori.”

english: Then she added, “We have plenty of straw and feed, as well as a place for you to spend the night.”
ekegusii: Naende akamoteebia: “Seito obonyansi mboreo, na aase tokorisia aisaine, na enyomba y’abageni bakorara nereo.”
swahili: Akaendelea kusema, “Kwetu kuna majani mengi na malisho, tena kuna nafasi kwa ajili yenu kulala.”

english: Then the man bowed down and worshiped the LORD,
ekegusii: Erio omonto oria agatugama inse, agasasiima Omonene,
swahili: Yule mtumishi akasujudu na kumwabudu Bwana,

english: saying, “Blessed be the LORD, the God of my master Abraham, who has not withheld His kindness and faithfulness from my master. As for me, the LORD has led me on the journey to the house of my master’s relatives.”
ekegusii: agateeba: “Omonene, Nyasae bw’omonene one Aburaamu, atogigwe! Ere tatigeti koorokia omonene one obuya na obwegenwa. Omonene ondaaire enchera, naikire enka y’abamwabo omonene one.”
swahili: akisema, “Atukuzwe Bwana, Mungu wa bwana wangu Abrahamu, ambaye hakuondoa wema na uaminifu wake kwa bwana wangu. Mimi nami, Bwana ameniongoza safarini akanifikisha nyumbani kwa jamaa za bwana wangu.”

english: The girl ran and told her mother’s household about these things.
ekegusii: Erio omoiseke oria akaminyoka, agaika inka sobo, agateebia abanto ba nyomba mwa ng’ina amang’ana ayio.
swahili: Yule msichana akakimbia akawaeleza watu wa nyumbani mwa mama yake kuhusu mambo haya.

english: and I will have you swear by the LORD, the God of heaven and the God of earth, that you will not take a wife for my son from the daughters of the Canaanites among whom I am dwelling,
ekegusii: na inche ninkoboorie otiane ase Omonene Nyasae o igoro na ense, ng’a tokorigeria omwana one omokungu korwa ase abaiseke b’Abakaanani, aba imenyete ase egati yabo.
swahili: Ninataka uape kwa Bwana, Mungu wa mbingu na Mungu wa nchi, kwamba hutamtwalia mwanangu mke kutoka binti za Wakanaani, ambao ninaishi miongoni mwao,

english: “Come, you who are blessed by the LORD,” said Laban. “Why are you standing out here? I have prepared the house and a place for the camels.”
ekegusii: akamoteebia: “Inchuo, aye osesenirie n’Omonene! Naki oteneine isiko aa? Inche nakoroiseirie enyomba ase ogochia koraara, na aase e chingamia chiao.”
swahili: Akamwambia, “Karibu nyumbani wewe uliyebarikiwa na Bwana, kwa nini unasimama huko nje? Mimi nimekuandalia nyumba na mahali kwa ajili ya ngamia.”

english: So the man came to the house, and the camels were unloaded. Straw and feed were brought to the camels, and water to wash his feet and the feet of his companions.
ekegusii: Erio omonto oria agasoa nyomba, na Labani agasibora chingamia chigurube chiabo, agachia obonyansi, na chirochio chikaria. Naende akarentera omonto oria amaache, akarentera na abwo baarenge komo, bagesibia amagoro.
swahili: Hivyo yule mtumishi akaenda nyumbani, mizigo ikaondolewa juu ya ngamia. Majani na malisho yakaletwa kwa ajili ya ngamia na maji kwa ajili yake na watu wake ili kunawa miguu.

english: Then a meal was set before the man, but he said, “I will not eat until I have told you what I came to say.” So Laban said, “Please speak.”
ekegusii: Erio akaariganigwa ase endagera, korende agateeba: “Tinkoria endagera, goika ndateeba amang’ana ane.” Erio Labani akairaneria: “Gaki, yakwane!”
swahili: Ndipo chakula kikaandaliwa kwa ajili yake, lakini akasema, “Sitakula mpaka niwe nimewaambia yale niliyo nayo ya kusema.” Labani akasema, “Basi tuambie.”

english: “I am Abraham’s servant,” he replied.
ekegusii: Erio agateeba: “Inche nomosomba o Aburaamu.
swahili: Hivyo akasema, “Mimi ni mtumishi wa Abrahamu.

english: “The LORD has greatly blessed my master, and he has become rich. He has given him sheep and cattle, silver and gold, menservants and maidservants, camels and donkeys.
ekegusii: Omonene osesenirie omonene one mono, na ere obeire omotenenku. Omoeire amaicho e ching’ondi, na aye chiombe, chifeta ne chitaabu, na abasomba, abamura na abaiseke, chingamia ne chitigere.”
swahili: Bwana amembariki sana bwana wangu, amekuwa tajiri. Amempa kondoo na ngʼombe, fedha na dhahabu, watumishi wa kiume na wa kike, ngamia na punda.

english: My master’s wife Sarah has borne him a son in her old age, and my master has given him everything he owns.
ekegusii: Na Sara, moka omonene one, akamoiborera omwana omomura ekero amenyire omogotu; na omonene one oeire omwana oyio bionsi ebi abwate.
swahili: Sara mkewe bwana wangu amemzalia mwana katika uzee wake, naye amempa kila kitu alichokuwa nacho.

english: My master made me swear an oath and said, ‘You shall not take a wife for my son from the daughters of the Canaanites in whose land I dwell,
ekegusii: Omonene one akamboria ntiane, aganteabia: “Torigeria omwana one omokungu korwa ase abaiseke b’Abakaanani, aba imenyete ase ense yabo;
swahili: Naye bwana wangu ameniapisha na akasema, ‘Kamwe usimtwalie mwanangu mke katika binti za Wakanaani, ambao ninaishi katika nchi yao,

english: but you shall go to my father’s house and to my kindred to take a wife for my son.’
ekegusii: Korende ogende ase omochie o tata, ase eamate yane, orentere omwana one omokungu korwa aroro.
swahili: ila uende mpaka kwa jamaa ya baba yangu na ukoo wangu mwenyewe, ukamtwalie mwanangu mke huko.’

english: Then I asked my master, ‘What if the woman will not come back with me?’
ekegusii: Na inche ngateebia omonene one: Aande omokungu oria atancheraneti gocha amo nainche.
swahili: “Kisha nikamuuliza bwana wangu, ‘Je, kama huyo mwanamke hatakubali kurudi nami?’

english: but will go to my country and my kindred to take a wife for my son Isaac.”
ekegusii: Korende ogende ase ense yane na ase eamate yane, orentere omwana one Isaka omokungu korwa aroro abe mokaye.”
swahili: bali utakwenda katika nchi yangu na jamaa zangu umpatie Isaki mwanangu mke.”

english: And he told me, ‘The LORD, before whom I have walked, will send His angel with you and make your journey a success, so that you may take a wife for my son from my kindred and from my father’s house.
ekegusii: Korende aganteebia: Omonene oyo ngendererete ase obosio bwaye, natome omomalaika oye amo naye, asesenie orogendo rwao. Naye orentere omwana one omokungu korwa ase eamate yane, korwa ase omochie o tata;
swahili: “Akanijibu, ‘ Bwana ambaye nimetembea mbele zake, atatuma malaika wake pamoja nawe, na kuifanikisha safari yako, ili uweze kupata mke kwa ajili ya mwanangu katika ukoo wangu na kutoka jamaa ya baba yangu.

english: And when you go to my kindred, if they refuse to give her to you, then you will be released from my oath.’
ekegusii: erio nosiborwe korwa ase eira eyio nakoboririe otiane. Ekero oraike ase eamate yane, onye tibagokoa omoiseke oyio, aye rirorio nobe gwasiboirwe korwa ase ogotiana kwao.”
swahili: Kisha, utakapokwenda kwenye ukoo wangu, utakuwa umefunguliwa kutoka kiapo changu hata kama wakikataa kukupa huyo binti, utakuwa umefunguliwa kutoka kiapo changu.’

english: So when I came to the spring today, I prayed: O LORD, God of my master Abraham, if only You would make my journey a success!
ekegusii: “Inche igo nacha reero ase ensoko, nasaba iga: Aye Omonene, Nyasae bw’omonene one Aburaamu, koranche onsesenie bono ase orogendo rwane nkogenda.
swahili: “Nilipokuja kisimani leo nilisema, ‘Ee Bwana, Mungu wa bwana wangu Abrahamu, ikikupendeza, naomba uifanikishe safari niliyoijia.

english: Here I am, standing beside this spring. Now if a maiden comes out to draw water and I say to her, ‘Please let me drink a little water from your jar,’
ekegusii: Rora ninteneine aiga ase ensoko y’amaache. Tiga ebe iga: Omoiseke onde omo orache kobuucha amaache, na inche imosabe oyio: Koranche ong’e amaache make korwa ase enyongo yao inywe.
swahili: Tazama, ninasimama kando ya kisima hiki, kama mwanamwali akija kuteka maji nami nikimwambia, tafadhali niruhusu ninywe maji kidogo kutoka kwenye mtungi wako,

english: and she replies, ‘Drink, and I will draw water for your camels as well,’ may she be the woman the LORD has appointed for my master’s son.
ekegusii: Onye ere okong’iraneria: Ee, kanywe, na nimbuuchere chingamia chiao nachirochio; otige oyio abe nere omokungu Omonene achoreire omwana bw’omonene one.”
swahili: naye kama akiniambia, “Kunywa, nami nitateka maji kwa ajili ya ngamia wako pia,” basi huyo awe ndiye mke ambaye Bwana amemchagulia mwana wa bwana wangu.’

english: And before I had finished praying in my heart, there was Rebekah coming out with her jar on her shoulder, and she went down to the spring and drew water. So I said to her, ‘Please give me a drink.’
ekegusii: “Ritang’ani ntarakoora ogosaba ase omoyo one, narora Rebeka ogocha obegete enyongo yaye mareko, ogotirimboka gochia ase ensoko kobuucha amaache.” Na inche namosaba: “Koranche, ong’e amaache inywe.”
swahili: “Kabla sijamaliza kuomba moyoni mwangu, Rebeka akatokea, amebeba mtungi begani mwake. Akashuka kisimani akateka maji, nami nikamwambia, ‘Tafadhali nipe maji ninywe.’

english: She quickly lowered her jar from her shoulder and said, ‘Drink, and I will water your camels as well.’ So I drank, and she also watered the camels.
ekegusii: Ere orusia enyongo yaye bwango korwa ase amareko aye, oyebeeka inse, onteebia: Kanywe, ne chingamia chiao ninchibuchere boigo. Erio ong’a, nanywa, oa ne chingamia, nachirochio chianywa.
swahili: “Akafanya haraka kushusha mtungi wake begani na kusema, ‘Kunywa na nitawanywesha ngamia wako pia,’ basi nikanywa, akawanywesha na ngamia pia.

english: Then I asked her, ‘Whose daughter are you?’ She replied, ‘The daughter of Bethuel son of Nahor, whom Milcah bore to him.’ So I put the ring on her nose and the bracelets on her wrists.
ekegusii: Erio namobooria: “Nomoiseke o ng’o ore?” Ere ong’iraneria: “Inche nomoiseke o Betueli oyo Milka aiborerete Nahori.” Agwo namobekera ekegera chimioro chiaye, na ebitange ase amaboko aye.
swahili: “Nikamuuliza, ‘Wewe ni binti wa nani?’ “Akasema, ‘Mimi ni binti wa Bethueli, mwana wa Nahori, Milka aliyemzalia.’ “Ndipo nilipotia pete puani mwake na bangili mikononi mwake,

english: Then I bowed down and worshiped the LORD; and I blessed the LORD, the God of my master Abraham, who led me on the right road to take the granddaughter of my master’s brother for his son.
ekegusii: Erio natugama inse nasasiima Omonene. Naende namotogia Omonene, Nyasae bw’omonene one Aburaamu, oyontang’anete ase enchera endonge, erinde imorentere omwana bw’omonene one omokungu korwa ase eamate yaye.
swahili: nikasujudu na nikamwabudu Bwana. Nikamtukuza Bwana, Mungu wa bwana wangu Abrahamu, aliyeniongoza katika njia sahihi ili nimtwalie mwana na bwana wangu mke katika jamaa zake.

english: Now if you will show kindness and faithfulness to my master, tell me; but if not, let me know, so that I may go elsewhere.”
ekegusii: Bono rende, onye morigetie gokorera Omonene one amaya, na ayare boronge, monteebie; onye taibo, monteebie, ngende ensemo ende eng’ao korigia.
swahili: Ikiwa mtaonyesha wema na uaminifu kwa bwana wangu, mniambie, la sivyo, mniambie, ili niweze kujua njia ya kugeukia.”

english: The servant asked him, “What if the woman is unwilling to follow me to this land? Shall I then take your son back to the land from which you came?”
ekegusii: Omosomba oria akamoiraneria: “Aande, omokungu oria atancheraneti gocha amo nainche goika ase ense eye; Inee, nigo ndaire omwana oo goika ase ense eria kwarwete?”
swahili: Yule mtumishi akamuuliza, “Je, kama huyo mwanamke atakataa kuja nami katika nchi hii? Je, nimpeleke mwanao katika hiyo nchi uliyotoka?”

english: Laban and Bethuel answered, “This is from the LORD; we have no choice in the matter.
ekegusii: Erio Labani na Betueli bakamoiraneria, bakamoteebia: “Amang’ana aya nigo arure ase Omonene; intwe titokonyara gokwana ande, amabe gose amaya.
swahili: Labani na Bethueli wakajibu, “Jambo hili limetoka kwa Bwana, hatuwezi kukuambia jambo lolote baya au jema.

english: Rebekah is here before you. Take her and go, and let her become the wife of your master’s son, just as the LORD has decreed.”
ekegusii: Rora, Rebeka oyio ore ase obosio bwao, moire, mogende komo, achie koba omokungu bw’omwana bw’omonene oo, buna Omonene konya ateebire.”
swahili: Rebeka yuko hapa, mchukue na uende, awe mke wa mwana wa bwana wako, sawasawa na Bwana alivyoongoza.”

english: When Abraham’s servant heard their words, he bowed down to the ground before the LORD.
ekegusii: Ekero omosomba o Aburaamu aigwete amang’ana abo, agatugama inse ase obosio bw’Omonene.
swahili: Ikawa huyo mtumishi wa Abrahamu aliposikia waliyosema, alisujudu mpaka nchi mbele za Bwana.

english: Then he brought out jewels of silver and gold, and articles of clothing, and he gave them to Rebekah. He also gave precious gifts to her brother and her mother.
ekegusii: Erio omosomba oria akarusia ebinto bi’ogwechabera bie chitaabu, na ebie chifeta, amo ne chianga, akaa Rebeka. Naende akaa momura omwabo amo na ng’ina ebiegwa bi’erigori rinene.
swahili: Ndipo huyo mtumishi akatoa vitu vilivyotengenezwa kwa dhahabu na kwa fedha pamoja na mavazi, akampa Rebeka, pia akawapa zawadi za thamani kubwa nduguye na mamaye.

english: Then he and the men with him ate and drank and spent the night there. When they got up the next morning, he said, “Send me on my way to my master.”
ekegusii: Ere na abanto baria baarenge komo bakaria na bakanywa, erio bakaraara aroro. Mambia kobwachia gokia akabateebia: “Ing’a ribaga ng’irane ase omonene one.”
swahili: Kisha yeye na wale watu waliokuwa pamoja naye wakala, wakanywa na kulala palepale. Walipoamka asubuhi, yule mtumishi, akasema, “Nipeni ruhusa nirudi kwa bwana wangu.”

english: But her brother and mother said, “Let the girl remain with us ten days or so. After that, she may go.”
ekegusii: Momura omwabo Rebeka na ng’ina bakamoteebia: “Tiga omoiseke oyo arabeere aiga koreng’ana amatuko ikomi; magega y’ayio mogende komo.”
swahili: Lakini ndugu yake Rebeka pamoja na mama yake wakajibu, “Acha binti akae kwetu siku kumi au zaidi, ndipo mwondoke.”

english: But he replied, “Do not delay me, since the LORD has made my journey a success. Send me on my way so that I may go to my master.”
ekegusii: Ere akabateebia: “Timobaisa goteebania, ekiagera Omonene onsesenirie ase orogendo rwane; ing’a ribaga ngende ase omonene one.”
swahili: Lakini yule mtumishi akawaambia, “Msinicheleweshe, kwa kuwa Bwana amefanikisha safari yangu, nipeni ruhusa nirudi kwa bwana wangu.”

english: So they said, “We will call the girl and ask her opinion.”
ekegusii: Bakamoteebia: “Tiga torangerie omoiseke, tomoboorie, toigwe buna agoteeba.”
swahili: Ndipo wakasema, “Acha tumwite huyo binti tumuulize, tusikie atakavyosema.”

english: They called Rebekah and asked her, “Will you go with this man?” “I will go,” she replied.
ekegusii: Bakarangeria Rebeka, bakamobooria: “Inee! Inabwanche ogende nomonto oyo?” Akairaneria: “Ee, nanchire, ngende nere.”
swahili: Kwa hiyo wakamwita Rebeka na kumuuliza, “Je, utakwenda na mtu huyu?” Akasema, “Nitakwenda.”

english: So they sent their sister Rebekah on her way, along with her nurse and Abraham’s servant and his men.
ekegusii: Erio bakaa Rebeka ribaga amo nomoreri oye bagende nomosomba o Aburaamu na abanto baye.
swahili: Hivyo wakamwaga ndugu yao Rebeka aondoke, pamoja na mjakazi wake, mtumishi wa Abrahamu na watu wake.

english: Abraham replied, “Make sure that you do not take my son back there.
ekegusii: Aburaamu akamoiraneria: “Bwerende, tobaisa koira omwana one aroro.
swahili: Abrahamu akasema, “Hakikisha kwamba hutamrudisha mwanangu huko.

english: And they blessed Rebekah and said to her, “Our sister, may you become the mother of thousands upon thousands. May your offspring possess the gates of their enemies.”
ekegusii: Bagasesenia Rebeka, bakamoteebia, “Oyominto, obe ng’ina abanto chilifu ne chilifu; ororeeria rwao inarobue emechie y’ababisa bao, royegambere!”
swahili: Wakambariki Rebeka, wakamwambia, “Ndugu yetu, uwe wewe kumi elfu, mara elfu nyingi, nao wazao wako wamiliki malango ya adui zao.”

english: Then Rebekah and her servant girls got ready, mounted the camels, and followed the man. So the servant took Rebekah and left. Isaac Marries Rebekah
ekegusii: Erio Rebeka akaimoka amo nabaiseke baye abasomba, bakariina chingamia, bagatunyana omonto oria. Naboigo omosomba oria akaira Rebeka, akagenda nere sobo.
swahili: Rebeka na vijakazi wake wakajiandaa, wakapanda ngamia zao wakafuatana na yule mtu. Hivyo yule mtumishi akamchukua Rebeka akaondoka.

english: Now Isaac had just returned from Beer-lahai-roi, for he was living in the Negev.
ekegusii: Bono Isaka konya orure ase ensoko ya Beeri‐Lahai‐Roi, ekiagera nigo amenyete ase ense ya Negebu.
swahili: Basi Isaki alikuwa ametoka Beer-Lahai-Roi, kwa kuwa alikuwa anaishi nchi ya Negebu.

english: Early in the evening, Isaac went out to the field to meditate, and looking up, he saw the camels approaching.
ekegusii: Isaka nigo achiete mogondo ekero kia mogoroba, akaba ore nebirengererio. Agwo akaimokereria amaiso aye igoro, akarora chingamia chigocha.
swahili: Isaki akatoka kwenda shambani kutafakari wakati wa jioni, alipoinua macho yake, akaona ngamia wanakuja.

english: And when Rebekah looked up and saw Isaac, she got down from her camel
ekegusii: Rebeka nere akaimokereria amaiso aye igoro, akarora Isaka; erio agaika bwango korwa ase engamia igoro,
swahili: Rebeka pia akainua macho akamwona Isaki. Akashuka kutoka kwenye ngamia wake

english: and asked the servant, “Who is that man in the field coming to meet us?” “It is my master,” the servant answered. So she took her veil and covered herself.
ekegusii: akabooria omosomba oria: “Monto ki oria ogotaara ase omogondo, ogocha koumerana naintwe?” Omosomba oria akamoiraneria: “Oria nere omonene one.” Erio omoiseke oria akabwata egietubo kiaye, agetuba.
swahili: na akamuuliza yule mtumishi, “Ni nani mtu yule aliye kule shambani anayekuja kutulaki?” Yule mtumishi akajibu, “Huyu ndiye bwana wangu.” Hivyo Rebeka akachukua shela yake akajifunika.

english: Then the servant told Isaac all that he had done.
ekegusii: Na omosomba oria agateebia Isaka amang’ana onsi, buna akorete.
swahili: Kisha yule mtumishi akamweleza Isaki mambo yote aliyoyatenda.

english: And Isaac brought her into the tent of his mother Sarah and took Rebekah as his wife. And Isaac loved her and was comforted after his mother’s death.
ekegusii: Isaka agasoyia Rebeka ase eema ya ng’ina ime, akaba omonywomire, naende akaba omwanchete. Ase ogi, Isaka akaremigwa korwa ase omoichano bw’ogokwa kwa ng’ina.
swahili: Ndipo Isaki akamwingiza Rebeka katika hema la Sara mama yake, Isaki akamchukua Rebeka, hivyo akawa mke wake. Isaki akampenda, akafarijika baada ya kifo cha mama yake.

english: The LORD, the God of heaven, who brought me from my father’s house and my native land, who spoke to me and promised me on oath, saying, ‘To your offspring I will give this land’—He will send His angel before you so that you can take a wife for my son from there.
ekegusii: Omonene, Nyasae o igoro na ense, oyondusetie o tata korwa ase ense eria naiboreretwe, ere nigo akwanete nainche na gotiana, ogoteeba: Ning’ee ororeeria rwao ense eye, ere natome omomalaika oye agotang’ane; aye norentere omwana one omokungu korwa aroro.
swahili: Bwana, Mungu wa mbingu, aliyenitoa nyumbani kwa baba yangu na nchi yangu niliyozaliwa na aliyesema nami na akaniahidi kwa kiapo, akisema, ‘Nitawapa watoto wako nchi hii,’ atatuma malaika wake akutangulie ili umpatie mwanangu mke kutoka huko.

english: And if the woman is unwilling to follow you, then you are released from this oath of mine. Only do not take my son back there.”
ekegusii: Na omokungu oria atancheti moche komo, rirorio nosiborwe korwa ase eira eye okoria ase ’nde, korende tobaisa koira omwana one gochia aroro.”
swahili: Kama huyo mwanamke asipokubali kufuatana nawe, basi utafunguliwa kutoka kiapo nilichokuapisha. Ila usimrudishe mwanangu huko.”

english: So the servant placed his hand under the thigh of his master Abraham and swore an oath to him concerning this matter.
ekegusii: Erio omosomba oria ababeeka okoboko kwaye inse y’ekebono kia Aburaamu, omonene oye, akerama ase ring’ana erio.
swahili: Basi yule mtumishi akaweka mkono wake chini ya paja la bwana wake Abrahamu akamwapia kuhusu shauri hili.

english: Now Abraham had taken another wife, named Keturah,
ekegusii: Aburaamu akanyuoma omokungu onde, ore korokwa Ketura.
swahili: Abrahamu alioa mke mwingine, ambaye jina lake aliitwa Ketura.

english: This was the field that Abraham had bought from the Hittites. Abraham was buried there with his wife Sarah.
ekegusii: ase oboremo boria Aburaamu agorete korwa ase Abahiti. Agwo nao Aburaamu atindegetwe ase Sara mokaye nere atindegetwe.
swahili: Shamba ambalo Abrahamu alilinunua kwa Wahiti. Hapo ndipo Abrahamu alipozikwa pamoja na mkewe Sara.

english: After Abraham’s death, God blessed his son Isaac, who lived near Beer-lahai-roi. The Descendants of Ishmael (1 Chronicles 1:28–31)
ekegusii: Magega y’ogokwa kwa Aburaamu, Nyasae agasesenia Isaka, omwana oye. Na Isaka akamenya ang’e nensoko yaare korokwa Beeri‐Lahai‐Roi. Ororeeria rwa Isumaeli
swahili: Baada ya kifo cha Abrahamu, Mungu akambariki mwanawe Isaki, ambaye baadaye aliishi karibu na Beer-Lahai-Roi. Wana Wa Ishmaeli

english: This is the account of Abraham’s son Ishmael, whom Hagar the Egyptian, Sarah’s maidservant, bore to Abraham.
ekegusii: Oro narwo ororeeria rwa Isumaeli, omwana o Aburaamu, oyo Hagari, omosomba o Sara, amoiborerete.
swahili: Hivi ndivyo vizazi vya Ishmaeli mtoto wa Abrahamu, ambaye mjakazi wake Sara, Hagari Mmisri, alimzalia Abrahamu.

english: These are the names of the sons of Ishmael in the order of their birth: Nebaioth the firstborn of Ishmael, then Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,
ekegusii: Aya naro amarieta ’abana ba Isumaeli, ase omooroberio bw’okoiborwa kwabo: Nebayoti, nere omwana oye omotangi, na Kedari, na Adibeeli, na Mibusamu,
swahili: Haya ndiyo majina ya wana wa Ishmaeli, yaliyoorodheshwa kulingana na jinsi walivyozaliwa: Mzaliwa wa kwanza wa Ishmaeli ni Nebayothi, akafuatia Kedari, Adbeeli, Mibsamu,

english: Mishma, Dumah, Massa,
ekegusii: na Misima, na Duma, na Masa,
swahili: Mishma, Duma, Masa,

english: Hadad, Tema, Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah.
ekegusii: na Hadadi, na Tema, na Yeturi, na Nafisi, na Kedema.
swahili: Hadadi, Tema, Yeturi, Nafishi na Kedema.

english: These were the sons of Ishmael, and these were their names by their villages and encampments—twelve princes of their tribes.
ekegusii: Aba nabwo abana ba Isumaeli, na aya naro amarieta abo ase emechie yabo na ebitwori biabo, na barabwo nigo baarenge abagaambi ikomi na babere, ase ebisaku biabo.
swahili: Hawa walikuwa wana wa Ishmaeli na haya ni majina ya viongozi wa makabila kumi na mawili kulingana na makao yao na kambi zao.

english: Ishmael lived a total of 137 years. Then he breathed his last and died, and was gathered to his people.
ekegusii: Isumaeli nigo aigetie emiaka rigana erimo, na emerongo etato, na etano na ebere (137), erio erio agakwa; agasangererekana amo nabaanto baye.
swahili: Kwa jumla Ishmaeli aliishi miaka 137. Akapumua pumzi ya mwisho, akafa, naye akakusanywa pamoja na watu wake.

english: Ishmael’s descendants settled from Havilah to Shur, which is near the border of Egypt as you go toward Asshur. And they lived in hostility toward all their brothers. Jacob and Esau (Malachi 1:1–5; Romans 9:6–29)
ekegusii: Abana ba Isumaeli nigo baamenyete bagachaakera Havila, bagaika Suri moocha ya Misiri, ase enchera ekogenda Asuri; bakamenya babebekaine n’abamwabo bonsi. Okoiborwa gwa Esau na Yakobo
swahili: Wazao wa Ishmaeli waliishi kuanzia nchi ya Havila hadi Shuri, karibu na mpaka wa Misri, unapoelekea Ashuru. Hao waliishi kwa uhasama na ndugu zao wote. Yakobo Na Esau

english: This is the account of Abraham’s son Isaac. Abraham became the father of Isaac,
ekegusii: Oro narwo ororeeria rwa Isaka, mosinto o Aburaamu. Aburaamu nere oiborete Isaka.
swahili: Hivi ndivyo vizazi vya Isaki mwana wa Abrahamu. Abrahamu akamzaa Isaki,

english: and she bore him Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah.
ekegusii: Nere akamoiborera Simurani, na Yokisani, na Medani, na Midiani, na Isibaki, na Sua.
swahili: Huyu alimzalia Zimrani, Yokshani, Medani, Midiani, Ishbaki na Shua.

english: and Isaac was forty years old when he married Rebekah, the daughter of Bethuel the Aramean from Paddan-aram and the sister of Laban the Aramean.
ekegusii: Isaka nigo areenge nemiaka emerongo ene ekero anyuomete Rebeka, omoiseke o Betueli, Omoaramu o Padan‐Aramu, omoiseke omwabo Labani, Omoaramu.
swahili: Isaki alikuwa na umri wa miaka arobaini alipomwoa Rebeka binti Bethueli Mwaramu kutoka Padan-Aramu, nduguye Labani Mwaramu.

english: Later, Isaac prayed to the LORD on behalf of his wife, because she was barren. And the LORD heard his prayer, and his wife Rebekah conceived.
ekegusii: Isaka agasabera mokaye ase Omonene, ekiagera nigo areenge omogomba. Omonene akaigwa ogosaba kwaye, na Rebeka mokaye akaba morito.
swahili: Isaki akamwomba Bwana kwa ajili ya mke wake, kwa sababu alikuwa tasa. Bwana akajibu maombi yake na Rebeka mkewe akapata mimba.

english: But the children inside her struggled with each other, and she said, “Why is this happening to me?” So Rebekah went to inquire of the LORD,
ekegusii: Abana bakaba bakomigana enda yaye ime. Ere akabora: “Onye nabo iga, okoba moyo kwane ninki korangwenere?” Akagenda koboori’Omonene.
swahili: Watoto wakashindana tumboni mwake, akasema, “Kwa nini haya yanatokea kwangu?” Kwa hiyo akaenda kumuuliza Bwana.

english: and He declared to her: “Two nations are in your womb, and two peoples from within you will be separated; one people will be stronger than the other, and the older will serve the younger.”
ekegusii: Omonene akamoiraneria, “Ebisaku bibere mbire enda yao ime, abanto babere orache koibora, na barabwo mbaatananekane korwa okoiborwa kwabo; oyomo nabe ne chinguru kobua oria onde, oria omonene omosomba bw’oria omoke.”
swahili: Bwana akamjibu, “Mataifa mawili yamo tumboni mwako, na mataifa hayo mawili kutoka ndani yako watatenganishwa. Mmoja atakuwa na nguvu zaidi kuliko mwingine, na yule mkubwa atamtumikia yule mdogo.”

english: When her time came to give birth, there were indeed twins in her womb.
ekegusii: Ekero amatuko aye ay’okoibora achia goikerana, bakanyora ne chibarongo chiare enda yaye ime.
swahili: Wakati wake wa kujifungua ulipotimia, walikuwepo mapacha wa kiume tumboni mwake.

english: The first one came out red, covered with hair like a fur coat; so they named him Esau.
ekegusii: Oyo bw’eritang’ani agasooka, ere nigo areenge omobariri, omobere bwonsi nigo orenge namarionya; bakamoroka Esau.
swahili: Wa kwanza kuzaliwa alikuwa mwekundu, mwili wake wote ulikuwa kama mtu aliyevaa vazi lenye nywele; wakamwita jina lake Esau.

english: After this, his brother came out grasping Esau’s heel; so he was named Jacob. And Isaac was sixty years old when the twins were born.
ekegusii: Magega yaye oyomwabo agasooka, okoboko kwaye kobwatete egetingiro gia Esau na ere bakamoroka Yakobo. Isaka nigo areenge nemiaka emerongo etano nomo (60), ekero mokaye abaiborete. Esau okoonia omwando oye bw’okoiborwa kw’obotangi
swahili: Baadaye, ndugu yake akatoka, mkono wake ukiwa umemshika Esau kisigino; akaitwa jina lake Yakobo. Isaki alikuwa mwenye miaka sitini Rebeka alipowazaa.

english: When the boys grew up, Esau became a skillful hunter, a man of the field, while Jacob was a quiet man who stayed at home.
ekegusii: Ekero abana abwo bakinire, Esau akaba omotwari bwe ching’iti, korende Yakobo nigo areenge omonto omotoereru, ore kobeera ase chiema.
swahili: Watoto wakakua, naye Esau akakuwa mwindaji hodari, mtu wa mbugani, wakati Yakobo alikuwa mtu mtulivu, mwenye kukaa nyumbani.

english: Because Isaac had a taste for wild game, he loved Esau; but Rebekah loved Jacob. Esau Sells His Birthright
ekegusii: Isaka nigo amwanchete Esau, ekiagera areenge komorentera chinyama chi’obotwari bwaye; korende Rebeka nigo amwanchete Yakobo.
swahili: Isaki, ambaye alikuwa anapendelea zaidi nyama za porini, alimpenda Esau, bali Rebeka alimpenda Yakobo.

english: One day, while Jacob was cooking some stew, Esau came in from the field and was famished.
ekegusii: Rituko erimo Yakobo naiyegete omosori gete. Esau agacha korwa orosana, konya orosire mono, ogoyire ase engencho y’enchara.
swahili: Siku moja Yakobo alipika mchuzi wa dengu, Esau akarudi kutoka porini akiwa na njaa kali.

english: Jokshan was the father of Sheba and Dedan. And the sons of Dedan were the Asshurites, the Letushites, and the Leummites.
ekegusii: Yokisani akaibora Seba na Dedani. Na basinto ba Dedani nabwo aba: Ashurimu, na Letusi, na Leumi.
swahili: Yokshani alikuwa baba wa Sheba na Dedani, wazao wa Dedani walikuwa Waashuri, Waletushi na Waleumi.

english: He said to Jacob, “Let me eat some of that red stew, for I am famished.” (That is why he was also called Edom. )
ekegusii: Na Esau agasaba Yakobo: “Koranche, ong’e omosori oyio omobariri inywe, ekiagera n akuure enchara.” Ase ayio bakamoroka Edomu (engencho yaye, omobariri).
swahili: Esau akamwambia Yakobo, “Haraka, nipe huo mchuzi mwekundu! Nina njaa kali sana!” (Hii ndiyo sababu pia aliitwa Edomu.)

english: “First sell me your birthright,” Jacob replied.
ekegusii: Yakobo akamoiraneria: “Ritang’ani ng’oonerie omwando oo bw’okoiborwa kw’obotangi.”
swahili: Yakobo akamjibu, “Niuzie kwanza haki yako ya mzaliwa wa kwanza.”

english: “Look,” said Esau, “I am about to die, so what good is a birthright to me?”
ekegusii: Esau agateeba: “Rora, inche nigo inde ang’e gokwa, omwando oyo bw’okoiborwa kw’obotangi inki orankonye?”
swahili: Esau akasema, “Tazama, mimi niko karibu ya kufa, itanifaa nini haki ya mzaliwa wa kwanza?”

english: “Swear to me first,” Jacob said. So Esau swore to Jacob and sold him the birthright.
ekegusii: Yakobo akamoteebia: “Karatiana ritang’ani ase ’nde.” Esau agatiana, erio akaooneria Yakobo omwando oye bw’okoiborwa kw’obotangi.
swahili: Yakobo akamwambia, “Niapie kwanza.” Hivyo Esau akamwapia, akamuuzia Yakobo haki yake ya kuzaliwa.

english: Then Jacob gave some bread and lentil stew to Esau, who ate and drank and then got up and went away. Thus Esau despised his birthright.
ekegusii: Erio Yakobo akaa Esau omogati na omosori bwe ching’ende, na ere akaria na konywa; erio akaimoka akagenda. Naboigo Esau achayete omwando oye bw’okoiborwa kw’obotangi.
swahili: Ndipo Yakobo akampa Esau mkate na ule mchuzi wa dengu. Akala na kunywa, kisha akainuka akaenda zake. Kwa hiyo Esau alidharau haki yake ya mzaliwa wa kwanza.

english: The sons of Midian were Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah. All these were descendants of Keturah.
ekegusii: Basinto ba Midiani nabwo aba: Efa, na Eferi, na Hanoki, na Abida, na Elidaa. Abwo bonsi nabwo baarenge abana ba Ketura.
swahili: Wana wa Midiani walikuwa Efa, Eferi, Hanoki, Abida na Eldaa. Hawa wote walikuwa uzao wa Ketura.

english: Abraham left everything he owned to Isaac.
ekegusii: Aburaamu akaa Isaka ebinto bionsi ebi abwate.
swahili: Abrahamu akamwachia Isaki kila kitu alichokuwa nacho.

english: But while he was still alive, Abraham gave gifts to the sons of his concubines and sent them away from his son Isaac to the land of the east. The Death of Abraham
ekegusii: Korende abana b’abakuungu baria ba sere‐sere Aburaamu akabaa ebiegwa. Ekero are moyo, konya atarakwa, akabateebia barue ase omwana oye Isaka, bagende gochia moocha, ase ense ya Moocha. Ogokwa kwa Aburaamu
swahili: Lakini Abrahamu alipokuwa bado hai, akawapa watoto wa masuria wake zawadi, kisha akawaondoa waende kuishi pande za mashariki mbali na mwanawe Isaki.

english: And at a ripe old age he breathed his last and died, old and contented, and was gathered to his people.
ekegusii: Nigo asogetie omoyo ase obogotu n’obuya, ore omogaka, oisanekire nemiaka emenge; agasangerekana amo nabaanto baye.
swahili: Ndipo Abrahamu akapumua pumzi ya mwisho na akafa akiwa mwenye umri mzuri, mzee aliyeshiba siku, naye akakusanywa pamoja na watu wake.

english: His sons Isaac and Ishmael buried him in the cave of Machpelah near Mamre, in the field of Ephron son of Zohar the Hittite.
ekegusii: Isaka na Isumaeli bakamotindeka ase rikuruma agwo Makipela ase oboremo bwa Efuroni, omwana o Sohari, Omohiti, moocha ya Mamure,
swahili: Watoto wake Isaki na Ishmaeli wakamzika katika pango la Makpela karibu na Mamre, katika shamba lililokuwa la Efroni mwana wa Sohari Mhiti,

english: Now there was another famine in the land, subsequent to the one that had occurred in Abraham’s time. And Isaac went to Abimelech king of the Philistines at Gerar.
ekegusii: Bono enchara yachete ase ense eria, nenchara y’ogokumia, tari eria yachete ritang’ani ase engaki ya Aburaamu. Erio Isaka agachiera Abimeleki, omorwoti bw’Abafilisti, aria Gerari.
swahili: Basi njaa kubwa ikawa katika nchi hiyo, kuliko ile njaa iliyotangulia iliyotokea wakati wa Abrahamu. Isaki akamwendea Abimeleki mfalme wa Wafilisti huko Gerari.

english: “What is this you have done to us?” asked Abimelech. “One of the people could easily have slept with your wife, and you would have brought guilt upon us.”
ekegusii: Abimeleki akamobooria: “Inki eke gwatokoreire iga? Aande monto onde oito areenge gochia araare na mokao, na aye anga nigo gwatobeka ase okomocha.”
swahili: Ndipo Abimeleki akamjibu, “Ni nini hiki ulichotufanyia? Ingewezekana mtu yeyote akawa amekutana kimwili na mke wako, nawe ungeleta hatia juu yetu.”

english: So Abimelech warned all the people, saying, “Whoever harms this man or his wife will surely be put to death.” Isaac’s Prosperity
ekegusii: Ase ayio Abimeleki agatianera abanto bonsi, akabateebia: “Monto onde bwensi aise gokuna omonto oyo ore aa, gose mokaye, goika aitwe.”
swahili: Hivyo Abimeleki akatoa amri kwa watu wote, akisema, “Yeyote atakayemnyanyasa mtu huyu au mkewe hakika atauawa.”

english: Now Isaac sowed seed in the land, and that very year he reaped a hundredfold. And the LORD blessed him,
ekegusii: Isaka agasimeka endagera ase ense eria, akagesa ase omwaka oyio ara rigana, n’Omonene akamosesenia.
swahili: Isaki akapanda mazao katika nchi hiyo, kwa mwaka huo huo, akavuna mara mia, kwa sababu Bwana alimbariki.

english: and he became richer and richer, until he was exceedingly wealthy.
ekegusii: Omonto oyio akaba ne chinguru, akagenderera komenteka gokina, goika akaba nokobua okonene.
swahili: Isaki akawa tajiri, mali zake zikaendelea kuongezeka mpaka akawa tajiri sana.

english: He owned so many flocks and herds and servants that the Philistines envied him.
ekegusii: Nigo abeete nenibo y’amaicho e ching’ondi ne chiombe, na abasomba abange. Ase igo, Abafirisiti bakamororera ribero.
swahili: Akawa na mifugo ya kondoo na ngʼombe, na watumishi wengi sana, kiasi kwamba Wafilisti wakamwonea wivu.

english: So the Philistines took dirt and stopped up all the wells that his father’s servants had dug in the days of his father Abraham.
ekegusii: (Ne chinsoko chiria chionsi abasomba ba Aburaamu ise Isaka baremete, Abafirisiti konya bachitichire namaroba.)
swahili: Kwa hiyo visima vyote vilivyochimbwa na watumishi wakati wa Abrahamu baba yake, Wafilisti wakavifukia, wakavijaza udongo.

english: Then Abimelech said to Isaac, “Depart from us, for you are much too powerful for us.”
ekegusii: Erio Abimeleki agateebia Isaka: “Karue ase tore, ekiagera aye kwamenyire ne chinguru chinyinge gotobua.”
swahili: Ndipo Abimeleki akamwambia Isaki, “Ondoka kwetu, kwa maana umetuzidi nguvu sana.”

english: So Isaac left that place and encamped in the Valley of Gerar and settled there.
ekegusii: Ase igo, Isaka akang’anya korwa aroro, agatoora ase ense eraire ya Gerari, akamenya aroro.
swahili: Basi Isaki akatoka huko akajenga kambi katika Bonde la Gerari, akaishi huko.

english: Isaac reopened the wells that had been dug in the days of his father Abraham, which the Philistines had stopped up after Abraham died. And he gave these wells the same names his father had given them.
ekegusii: Isaka akarubora chinsoko chiria naende, echio chiaremetwe ase engaki ya Aburaamu ise, ekiagera Abafirisiti konya bachitichire magega Aburaamu g akuure. Isaka agachiroka buna ise achirogete ritang’ani.
swahili: Ndipo Isaki akavichimbua tena vile visima vya maji ambavyo vilichimbwa siku zile za Abrahamu baba yake, ambavyo Wafilisti walivifukia baada ya kufa Abrahamu, akavipa majina yale yale ambayo baba yake alikuwa amevipa.

english: Then Isaac’s servants dug in the valley and found a well of fresh water there.
ekegusii: Abasomba ba Isaka bakarema agwo ase ense eraire, bakanyora entuboka y’amaache.
swahili: Watumishi wa Isaki wakachimba katika lile bonde wakagundua huko kisima chenye maji safi.

english: The LORD appeared to Isaac and said, “Do not go down to Egypt. Settle in the land where I tell you.
ekegusii: Na Omonene akaorokera Isaka, akamoteebia: “Totirimboka gochia Misiri, korende omenye ase ense eye ndakworokererie.
swahili: Bwana akamtokea Isaki, akamwambia, “Usiende Misri, bali ukae katika nchi nitakayokuambia.

english: But the herdsmen of Gerar quarreled with Isaac’s herdsmen and said, “The water is ours!” So he named the well Esek, because they contended with him.
ekegusii: Abarisia b’ensemo ya Gerari bakaba bakwomana nabarisia ba Isaka, bagoteeba: “Amache aya nayaito.” Ase igo, Isaka Akayeroka entuboka eria Eseki, ekiagera bamwomaneretie aroro.
swahili: Lakini wachungaji wa Gerari wakagombana na wachungaji wa Isaki wakisema, “Maji haya ni yetu!” Ndipo akakiita kile kisima Eseki, kwa sababu waligombana naye.

english: Then they dug another well and quarreled over that one also; so he named it Sitnah.
ekegusii: Naende bakarema, bakanyora entuboka ende, nero bakayiomanera. Ase igo, akayeroka Sitina.
swahili: Kisha wakachimba kisima kingine, lakini hata hicho pia wakakigombania, akakiita Sitna.

english: He moved on from there and dug another well, and they did not quarrel over it. He named it Rehoboth and said, “At last the LORD has made room for us, and we will be fruitful in the land.”
