ekegusii: Akaimoka korwa agwo, akagenda akarema akanyora entuboka ende; eyio ero tibayiomanera. Ase ayio akayeroka Rehoboti, akabora: “Naki Omonene otoeire ense engare, na toragenderere komenteka ase ense eye.”
swahili: Akaondoka huko, akachimba kisima kingine, wala hakuna yeyote aliyekigombania. Akakiita Rehobothi, akisema, “Sasa Bwana ametufanyia nafasi, nasi tutastawi katika nchi.”

english: From there Isaac went up to Beersheba,
ekegusii: Isaka akarua aroro, agatiira gochia Beeri‐Seba.
swahili: Kutoka pale akaenda Beer-Sheba.

english: and that night the LORD appeared to him and said, “I am the God of your father Abraham. Do not be afraid, for I am with you. I will bless you and multiply your descendants for the sake of My servant Abraham.”
ekegusii: Ase obotuko obwo obw’Omonene akamoorokera, akamoteebia: “Inche ninche Nyasae o Aburaamu iso, tibwoboa, ekiagera nigo inde amo naye, ningosesenie aye amo na ororeeria rwao, ase engencho y’omosomba one Aburaamu.”
swahili: Usiku ule Bwana akamtokea, akamwambia, “Mimi ndimi Mungu wa Abrahamu baba yako. Usiogope, kwa maana mimi niko pamoja nawe, nitakubariki na kuongeza idadi ya wazao wako kwa ajili ya Abrahamu mtumishi wangu.”

english: So Isaac built an altar there and called on the name of the LORD, and he pitched his tent there. His servants also dug a well there. Isaac’s Covenant with Abimelech
ekegusii: Na Isaka akaagacha egesasiimero aroro, akarangeria erieta ri’Omonene, agatenenia chiema chiaye aroro. Na agwo abasomba baye bakarema, bakanyora entuboka. Isaka na Abimeleki bagokora okobwatana
swahili: Isaki akajenga madhabahu huko, akaliitia jina la Bwana. Akapiga hema lake huko, nao watumishi wake wakachimba kisima.

english: Later, Abimelech came to Isaac from Gerar, with Ahuzzath his adviser and Phicol the commander of his army.
ekegusii: Erio Abimeleki akarwa Gerari, amo n’Ahusati, omosemia oye ase obogaambi, na Pikoli, oria omochiki omonene bw’abarwani baye, bagachiera Isaka.
swahili: Wakati huo, Abimeleki alikuwa amemjia kutoka Gerari, akifuatana na Ahuzathi mshauri wake, pamoja na Fikoli jemadari wa majeshi yake.

english: “Why have you come to me?” Isaac asked them. “You hated me and sent me away.”
ekegusii: Na Isaka akababooria: “Inki mwacha korigia aa bwone, na ekero nare nainwe nigo mongechete, naende mwanseretie korwa seino?”
swahili: Isaki akawauliza, “Mbona mmekuja kwangu na ninyi mlinichukia na kunifukuza?”

english: “We can plainly see that the LORD has been with you,” they replied. “We recommend that there should now be an oath between us and you. Let us make a covenant with you
ekegusii: Bakamoiraneria: “Amaene, twarorire maiso marore ng’a Omonene nigo are amo naye. Na nigo torengereretie ng’a totiananie na tokore okobwatana naye ng’a,
swahili: Wakamjibu, “Tuliona wazi kuwa Bwana alikuwa pamoja nawe, kwa hiyo tukasema, ‘Inabidi kuwe na kiapo cha mapatano kati yetu, kati yetu na wewe. Na tufanye mkataba pamoja nawe

english: that you will not harm us, just as we have not harmed you but have done only good to you, sending you on your way in peace. And now you are blessed by the LORD.”
ekegusii: bono togotokorera bobe bonde, buna intwe totagokunete, gose totagokorerete bobe, otatiga amaya oka; tokagotiga okagenda bwoo nomorembe. Naye bono nomosesenigwa Omonene.”
swahili: kwamba hutatudhuru, kama jinsi nasi hatukuwanyanyasa bali tuliwatendea mema wakati wote na kuwaondoa kwetu kwa amani. Tena sasa umebarikiwa na Bwana.’ ”

english: Stay in this land as a foreigner, and I will be with you and bless you. For I will give all these lands to you and your offspring, and I will confirm the oath that I swore to your father Abraham.
ekegusii: Obe buna omomenyi ase ense eye, na inche nimbe amo naye, ningosesenie; naki ninkoe aye na ororeeria rwao chinse echi chionsi, na ning’ikeranie eira yane eyio natianete ase Aburaamu iso.
swahili: Kaa katika nchi hii kwa kitambo, mimi nitakuwa pamoja na wewe na nitakubariki. Kwa maana nitakupa wewe na uzao wako nchi hizi zote na nitatimiza kiapo nilichomwapia Abrahamu baba yako.

english: So Isaac prepared a feast for them, and they ate and drank.
ekegusii: Erio Isaka akabakorera omoyega, bakaria na bakanywa.
swahili: Basi Isaki akawaandalia karamu, nao wakala na kunywa.

english: And they got up early the next morning and swore an oath to each other. Then Isaac sent them on their way, and they left him in peace.
ekegusii: Bakaimoka mambia chuni, bagatianania barabwo ase barabwo; na Isaka akabakooba, na barabwo bakarua asare, bakagenda nomorembe.
swahili: Kesho yake asubuhi na mapema, wakaapizana wao kwa wao. Kisha Isaki akawaruhusu waende zao, wakamwacha Isaki kwa amani.

english: On that same day, Isaac’s servants came and told him about the well they had dug. “We have found water!” they told him.
ekegusii: Ase rituko riria riria abasomba ba Isaka bagaacha, bakamorentera amang’ana igoro y’entuboka eria banyorete, bakamoteebia: “Twanyorire amaache.”
swahili: Siku hiyo watumishi wa Isaki wakaja wakampa habari kuhusu kisima walichokuwa wamekichimba, wakamwambia, “Tumepata maji!”

english: So he called it Shibah, and to this day the name of the city is Beersheba. Esau’s Wives
ekegusii: Ere akayeroka Seba; na ase engencho eyio omochie oyio nigo okorokwa Beeri‐Seba goika reero iga. Esau okonyuoma abakungu babere
swahili: Naye akakiita Shiba, mpaka leo mji huo unaitwa Beer-Sheba.

english: When Esau was forty years old, he took as his wives Judith daughter of Beeri the Hittite and Basemath daughter of Elon the Hittite.
ekegusii: Ekero Esau gaika nemiaka emerongo ene akanyuoma Yuditi, omoiseke o Beeri, Omohiti, na Basemati, omoiseke o Eloni, nere n’Omohiti.
swahili: Esau alipokuwa na umri wa miaka arobaini, akamwoa Yudithi binti Beeri Mhiti, kisha akamwoa Basemathi binti Eloni Mhiti.

english: And they brought grief to Isaac and Rebekah.
ekegusii: Barabwo babere bagakora obogima bwa Isaka na Rebeka koba nobororo obonge.
swahili: Hawa walikuwa chanzo cha huzuni ya Isaki na Rebeka.

english: I will make your descendants as numerous as the stars in the sky, and I will give them all these lands, and through your offspring all nations of the earth will be blessed,
ekegusii: Nimente ororeeria rwao robe oronge buna ching’enang’eni chia igoro; ne chinse echi chionsi ninchiee ororeeria rwao; na ase ororeeria rwao ebisaku bionsi bi’ense inabisesenigwe,
swahili: Nitafanya wazao wako kuwa wengi kama nyota za angani, nami nitawapa nchi hizi zote na kutokana na uzao wako mataifa yote yatabarikiwa,

english: because Abraham listened to My voice and kept My charge, My commandments, My statutes, and My laws.” Isaac Deceives Abimelech
ekegusii: ekiagera Aburaamu naigwerete amang’ana aane, akabwata aya namochiigete, na amachiiko aane, na aya narigete, amo nogoteebereria kwane.”
swahili: kwa sababu Abrahamu alinitii mimi akatunza kanuni zangu na maagizo yangu, amri zangu pamoja na sheria zangu.”

english: So Isaac settled in Gerar.
ekegusii: Ase igo, Isaka akamenya Gerari.
swahili: Hivyo Isaki akaishi huko Gerari.

english: But when the men of that place asked about his wife, he said, “She is my sister.” For he was afraid to say, “She is my wife,” since he thought to himself, “The men of this place will kill me on account of Rebekah, because she is so beautiful.”
ekegusii: Ekero abanto b’aase aria baamoboretie amang’ana igoro ya mokaye, akabateebia: “Oyo ’mosubati ominto.” Naki nigo oboete goteeba ng’a ere ’mokaye, akarengereria ng’a abanto b’aase aria mbaabaise komoita ase engencho ya Rebeka, ekiagera ere areenge omonyakieni.
swahili: Watu wa mahali pale walipomuuliza habari za mke wake, akasema, “Huyu ni dada yangu,” kwa sababu aliogopa kusema, “Huyu ni mke wangu.” Alifikiri, “Watu wa mahali pale wataweza kumuua kwa sababu ya Rebeka, kwa kuwa alikuwa mzuri wa sura.”

english: When Isaac had been there a long time, Abimelech king of the Philistines looked down from the window and was surprised to see Isaac caressing his wife Rebekah.
ekegusii: Ekero konya bamenyire aria engaki entambe, Abimeleki, omorwoti bw’Abafilisti, akarigereria korwa ase ekebao, akarora Isaka bakogosoria na Rebeka mokaye.
swahili: Wakati Isaki alipokuwa amekaa huko siku nyingi, Abimeleki mfalme wa Wafilisti akachungulia dirishani, akaona jinsi Isaki alivyomkumbatia Rebeka mke wake.

english: Abimelech sent for Isaac and said, “So she is really your wife! How could you say, ‘She is my sister’?” Isaac replied, “Because I thought I might die on account of her.”
ekegusii: Erio Abimeleki akarangeria Isaka, akamobooria: “Amaene, oyo ’mokao? Naki gwakora ogateeba ng’a oyo mosubati omino?” Isaka akamoiraneria: “Nigo nareengereretie ng’a, aande nimbaise goitwa ase engencho yaye.”
swahili: Abimeleki akamwita Isaki akamwambia, “Hakika huyu ni mke wako! Mbona uliniambia, ‘Huyu ni dada yangu?’ ” Isaki akamjibu, “Kwa sababu nilifikiri ningeweza kuuawa kwa sababu yake.”

english: When Isaac was old and his eyes were so weak that he could no longer see, he called his older son Esau and said to him, “My son.” “Here I am,” Esau replied.
ekegusii: Ekero Isaka konya abeire omogotu, nonya na amaiso aye konya amerire orotutu, atari korora buya, akarangeria Esau, omwana oye omotangi, akamoteebia: “Omwana one!” Ere agaitaba: “Nao inde aa Tata.”
swahili: Isaki alipokuwa mzee na macho yake yalipokuwa yamekosa nguvu asiweze kuona tena, akamwita Esau mwanawe mkubwa, akamwambia, “Mwanangu.” Akajibu, “Mimi hapa.”

english: Then take it to your father to eat, so that he may bless you before he dies.”
ekegusii: Erio omoirere iso arie, erinde anyare kogosesenia ritang’ani atarakwa.”
swahili: Kisha umpelekee baba yako ale, ili apate kukubariki kabla hajafa.”

english: Jacob answered his mother Rebekah, “Look, my brother Esau is a hairy man, but I am smooth-skinned.
ekegusii: Korende Yakobo agateebia Rebeka ng’ina; “Norooche Esau ominto nomonto omerete amarionya ase omobere oye, korende inche omobere one nigo ore omoterere.
swahili: Yakobo akamwambia Rebeka mama yake, “Lakini ndugu yangu Esau ana nywele mwilini, mimi nina ngozi nyororo.

english: What if my father touches me? Then I would be revealed to him as a deceiver, and I would bring upon myself a curse rather than a blessing.”
ekegusii: Aande, Tata nigo arantaba‐tabe, na inche imbe ase amaiso aye buna omong’ainereria, inyerentere okoragererigwa ribaga ri’ogosesenigwa.”
swahili: Itakuwaje kama baba yangu akinigusa? Itaonekana kwake kama niliyemfanyia ujanja na kuleta laana juu yangu badala ya baraka.”

english: His mother replied, “Your curse be on me, my son. Just obey my voice and go get them for me.”
ekegusii: Ng’ina akamoteebia: “Okoragererigwa kwao tiga kobe igoro yane; igwa aya nkogoteebia rimo rioka, genda ondetere chimanwa echio chie chimbori.”
swahili: Mama yake akamwambia, “Mwanangu, laana na iwe juu yangu. Fanya tu ninalokuambia, nenda ukaniletee hao wana-mbuzi.”

english: So Jacob went and got two goats and brought them to his mother, who made the tasty food his father loved.
ekegusii: Erio agwo akagenda, akarentera ng’ina chimanwa echio, na ere akaroisia endagera engiya, eria ise anchete.
swahili: Kwa hiyo alikwenda akawaleta, akampa mama yake, akaandaa chakula kitamu, kama vile alivyopenda baba yake.

english: And Rebekah took the finest clothes in the house that belonged to her older son Esau, and she put them on her younger son Jacob.
ekegusii: Erio Rebeka akabogoria eanga eria engiya mono ya Esau, omwana oye omotangi; eye nigo yagachire nyomba mwaye, akayebekera Yakobo, omwana oye omoke.
swahili: Kisha Rebeka akachukua nguo nzuri za Esau mwanawe wa kwanza, alizokuwa nazo nyumbani, akamvika Yakobo mwanawe mdogo.

english: She also put the skins of the young goats on his hands and on the smooth part of his neck.
ekegusii: Na amasankwa aria e chimanwa chie chimbori akamoboyia ase amaboko aye ne rigoti.
swahili: Pia akamfunika mikononi na sehemu laini ya shingo kwa ngozi za mbuzi.

english: Then she handed her son Jacob the tasty food and bread she had made.
ekegusii: Erio ababeeka ase amaboko ’omwana oye Yakobo endagera eria engiya aroisetie, amo nomogati.
swahili: Hatimaye akampa Yakobo hicho chakula kitamu pamoja na mkate aliouoka.

english: So Jacob went to his father and said, “My father.” “Here I am!” he answered. “Which one are you, my son?”
ekegusii: Yakobo akagenda agasoa nyomba mwaise, akamoteebia: “Tata!” Nere agaitaba: “Nao inde aa. Naye ng’o, mwana one?”
swahili: Akamwendea baba yake akasema, “Baba yangu.” Akajibu, “Naam, mwanangu, wewe ni nani?”

english: Jacob said to his father, “I am Esau, your firstborn. I have done as you told me. Please sit up and eat some of my game, so that you may bless me.”
ekegusii: Yakobo akairaneria ise iga: “Ninche Esau, omwana oo omotangi. Nakorire buna gwantebeetie; booka, oikaranse egere orie enyama y’obotwari bwane, erio onsesenie.”
swahili: Yakobo akamwambia baba yake, “Mimi ni Esau mzaliwa wako wa kwanza. Nimefanya kama ulivyoniambia. Tafadhali uketi, ule sehemu ya mawindo yangu ili uweze kunibariki.”

english: “Look,” said Isaac, “I am now old, and I do not know the day of my death.
ekegusii: Akamoteebia: “Rora bono inche nagotire, gose timanyeti engaki y’ogokwa kwane.
swahili: Isaki akasema, “Mimi sasa ni mzee na sijui siku ya kifo changu.

english: But Isaac asked his son, “How did you ever find it so quickly, my son?” “Because the LORD your God brought it to me,” he replied.
ekegusii: Isaka akamobooria: “Omwana one, naki gwakora kwanyora ching’iti bwango iga?” Yakobo akamoiraneria: “mboora Omonene, Nyasae oo, ochindetera.”
swahili: Isaki akamuuliza mwanawe. “Umepataje haraka namna hii, mwanangu?” Akajibu, “ Bwana Mungu wako amenifanikisha.”

english: Then Isaac said to Jacob, “Please come closer so I can touch you, my son. Are you really my son Esau, or not?”
ekegusii: Erio Isaka agateebia Yakobo: “Inchuo aiga ang’e ase ’nde, ngotabatabe, erinde imanye gose naye omwana one Esau, gose tari ere.”
swahili: Kisha Isaki akamwambia Yakobo, “Mwanangu tafadhali sogea karibu nami ili nikupapase, nione kama hakika ndiwe Esau mwanangu, au la.”

english: So Jacob came close to his father Isaac, who touched him and said, “The voice is the voice of Jacob, but the hands are the hands of Esau.”
ekegusii: Yakobo akagenda agaika ise ang’e, na ere akamotaba‐taba, akabora: “Eriogi rirorio neria Yakobo, korende amaboko naya Esau.”
swahili: Yakobo akasogea karibu na baba yake Isaki, ambaye alimpapasa na kusema, “Sauti ni ya Yakobo, bali mikono ni ya Esau.”

english: Isaac did not recognize him, because his hands were hairy like those of his brother Esau; so he blessed him.
ekegusii: Na ise tamomanya, ekiagera amaboko aye nigo areenge namarionya buna aya Esau omwabo. Ase igo, akamosesenia.
swahili: Hakumtambua, kwa sababu mikono yake ilikuwa na nywele kama ya ndugu yake Esau, kwa hiyo akambariki.

english: Again he asked, “Are you really my son Esau?” And he replied, “I am.”
ekegusii: Akamobooria: “Amaene, naye omwana one Esau?” Yakobo akamoiraneria: “Ee, Tata ninche.”
swahili: Akamuuliza, “Hivi kweli wewe ni mwanangu Esau?” Akajibu, “Mimi ndiye.”

english: “Serve me,” said Isaac, “and let me eat some of my son’s game, so that I may bless you.” Jacob brought it to him, and he ate; then he brought him wine, and he drank.
ekegusii: Naende Isaka akamoteebia: “Ng’ererie endagera eyio gocha ang’e aiga, omwana one, indie enyama y’obotwari bwao, erio ngosesenie.” Ase igo, akamoyeirera endagera eria na ere akaria, akamoa na edivai, akanywa.
swahili: Kisha akasema, “Mwanangu, niletee sehemu ya mawindo yako nile, ili nipate kukubariki.” Yakobo akamletea naye akala, akamletea na divai akanywa.

english: Then his father Isaac said to him, “Please come near and kiss me, my son.”
ekegusii: Isaka ise akamoteebia: “Omwana one, inchwo aiga ang’e ase ’nde, erio onyunyunte.”
swahili: Kisha Isaki baba yake akamwambia, “Njoo hapa, mwanangu, unibusu.”

english: So he came near and kissed him. When Isaac smelled his clothing, he blessed him and said: “Ah, the smell of my son is like the smell of a field that the LORD has blessed.
ekegusii: Erio akamoika ang’e, akamonyunyunta. Isaka agatiokerera rimisu rie chianga chiaye, akamosesenia, akabora: “Naama! Rimisu ri’omwana one Esau nigo rigotioka buna rimisu ri’omogondo omuya, osesenirie n’Omonene!
swahili: Kwa hiyo akamwendea akambusu. Isaki aliposikia harufu ya nguo zake, akambariki, akasema, “Aha, harufu ya mwanangu ni kama harufu ya shamba ambalo Bwana amelibariki.

english: May God give to you the dew of heaven and the richness of the earth— an abundance of grain and new wine.
ekegusii: Tiga Nyasae agoitororere riime rikorwa igoro na obonoru bwe riroba, ne rigesa riao ribe rinyinge, na edivai boigo.
swahili: Mungu na akupe umande kutoka mbinguni na utajiri wa duniani: wingi wa nafaka na divai mpya.

english: May peoples serve you and nations bow down to you. May you be the master of your brothers, and may the sons of your mother bow down to you. May those who curse you be cursed, and those who bless you be blessed.” Esau’s Lost Hope
ekegusii: Abanto bagokorere emeremo, na ebisaku bikoe obonene. Obe omonene ase abamino bonsi, abana ba nyoko bagosike; oyorakoragererie, nere naragererigwe, na oyoragosesenie, nere nasesenigwe!” Esau Ogosorora Isaka Amosesenie
swahili: Mataifa na yakutumikie na mataifa yakusujudie. Uwe bwana juu ya ndugu zako, na wana wa mama yako wakusujudie. Walaaniwe wale wakulaanio, nao wale wakubarikio wabarikiwe.”

english: Take your weapons—your quiver and bow—and go out into the field to hunt some game for me.
ekegusii: Bono bogoria obota n’echinsara chiao, ogende borabu otware ching’iti, ondetere chinyama.
swahili: Sasa basi, chukua silaha zako, podo na upinde, uende nyikani, ukawinde nyama pori kwa ajili yangu.

english: As soon as Isaac had finished blessing him and Jacob had left his father’s presence, his brother Esau returned from the hunt.
ekegusii: Ekero Isaka konya aikire gosesenia Yakobo, na Yakobo karure ase obosio bwa Isaka ise, Esau omwabo akairana korwa ase obotwaari bwaye.
swahili: Baada ya Isaki kumaliza kumbariki na baada tu ya Yakobo kuondoka kwa baba yake, ndugu yake Esau akaingia kutoka mawindoni.

english: He too made some tasty food, brought it to his father, and said to him, “My father, sit up and eat of your son’s game, so that you may bless me.”
ekegusii: Nere boigo akaroisia endagera engiya, akarentera ise, akamoteebia: “Tata, inchwo orie endagera y’obotwari bwane, inche omwana oo, erinde onsesenie.”
swahili: Naye pia akaandaa chakula kitamu akamletea baba yake. Kisha akamwambia, “Baba yangu, keti ule sehemu ya mawindo yangu, ili upate kunibariki.”

english: But his father Isaac replied, “Who are you?” “I am Esau, your firstborn son,” he answered.
ekegusii: Isaka ise akamobooria: “Aye naye ng’o?” Ere akamoiraneria: “Ninche Esau omwana oo, okoira kwao ogotang’ani.”
swahili: Isaki baba yake akamuuliza, “Wewe ni nani?” Akajibu, “Mimi ni mwanao, mzaliwa wako wa kwanza, Esau.”

english: Isaac began to tremble violently and said, “Who was it, then, who hunted the game and brought it to me? Before you came in, I ate it all and blessed him—and indeed, he will be blessed!”
ekegusii: Erio Isaka agakumia mono na koiguswa, akabora: “Kai! Kai! Ning’o oria ocha ondetera endagera engiya, na inche naria yonsi ekero otaracha, namosesenia? Ee! Ee!, Nere bono oikire gosesenigwa!”
swahili: Isaki akatetemeka kwa nguvu sana, akasema, “Alikuwa nani basi, ambaye aliwinda mawindo akaniletea? Nilikula kabla tu hujaja na nikambariki, naye hakika atabarikiwa!”

english: When Esau heard his father’s words, he let out a loud and bitter cry and said to his father, “Bless me too, O my father!”
ekegusii: Ekero Esau achia koigwa amang’ana aya korwa ase ise, agakuura na korera ekerero ekenene mono ki’obororo, akamoteebia: “Nsesenie nainche boigo, Tata!”
swahili: Esau aliposikia maneno haya ya baba yake, akalia sauti kubwa na ya uchungu, na kumwambia baba yake, “Nibariki mimi, mimi pia, baba yangu!”

english: But Isaac replied, “Your brother came deceitfully and took your blessing.”
ekegusii: Korende Isaka akamoiraneria: “Oyomino nigo achicha nobong’ainereria, na ere bono oirire ogosesenigwa kwao.”
swahili: Lakini akasema, “Ndugu yako amekuja kwa udanganyifu na akachukua baraka yako.”

english: So Esau declared, “Is he not rightly named Jacob? For he has cheated me twice. He took my birthright, and now he has taken my blessing.” Then he asked, “Haven’t you saved a blessing for me?”
ekegusii: Esau akabora: “Inee! Tari korokwa Yakobo ase oboronge? Naki eye nengaki ya kabere ang’ainereirie. Ritang’ani akaira omwando one bw’okoiborwa kw’obotangi, naende bono oirire ogosesenigwa kwane!” Naende agwo kegima akamobooria ise iga: “Inee, tontigarereti ogosesenigwa?”
swahili: Esau akasema, “Si ndiyo sababu anaitwa Yakobo? Amenidanganya mara hizi mbili: Alichukua haki yangu ya kuzaliwa na sasa amechukua baraka yangu!” Kisha akauliza, “Hukubakiza hata baraka moja kwa ajili yangu?”

english: But Isaac answered Esau: “Look, I have made him your master and given him all his relatives as servants; I have sustained him with grain and new wine. What is left that I can do for you, my son?”
ekegusii: Isaka akamoiraneria: “Rora, bono naikire komokora obeire omonene oo, na abamwabo bonsi babe abasomba baye, naende namoeire endagera y’omogondo na edivai. Inki rende bono nkogokorera aye, omwana one?”
swahili: Isaki akamjibu Esau, “Nimemfanya yeye kuwa bwana juu yako, pia nimewafanya ndugu zako wote kuwa watumishi wake, nimemtegemeza kwa nafaka na divai mpya. Sasa nitaweza kukufanyia nini, mwanangu?”

english: Esau said to his father, “Do you have only one blessing, my father? Bless me too, O my father!” Then Esau wept aloud.
ekegusii: Esau akabooria ise: “Ogosesenia nokomo gwoka kwabwate, Tata? Nsesenia nainche boigo, Tata ominto.” Esau agaaka egakuura, na akarera nobororo.
swahili: Esau akamwambia baba yake, “Je, baba yangu una baraka moja tu? Unibariki mimi pia, baba yangu!” Kisha Esau akalia kwa sauti kubwa.

english: His father Isaac answered him: “Behold, your dwelling place shall be away from the richness of the land, away from the dew of heaven above.
ekegusii: Erio Isaka ise akamoiraneria, akamoteebia, “Rora, obomenyo bwao inabobe aare korwa ase obonoru bwe riroba, na aare korwa ase riimi rikorwa igoro.
swahili: Baba yake Isaki akamjibu, akamwambia, “Makao yako yatakuwa mbali na utajiri wa dunia, mbali na umande wa mbinguni juu.

english: Then prepare a tasty dish that I love and bring it to me to eat, so that I may bless you before I die.”
ekegusii: Erio ondoiserie endagera engiya, eria nyanchete, oyendetere indie, erinde ngosesenie konde moyo, ntarakwa.”
swahili: Uniandalie aina ya chakula kitamu nikipendacho uniletee nile, ili niweze kukubariki kabla sijafa.”

english: You shall live by the sword and serve your brother. But when you rebel, you will tear his yoke from your neck.”
ekegusii: Omoro oo bw’esegi nogere obe moyo, aye nomokorere oyomino emeremo; korende engaki neche orekong’ie, nobune rikorogoto erio akobekeire ase rigoti riao.”
swahili: Utaishi kwa upanga, nawe utamtumikia ndugu yako, lakini wakati utakapokuwa umejikomboa, utatupa nira yake kutoka shingoni mwako.” Yakobo Anakimbilia Kwa Labani

english: Esau held a grudge against Jacob because of the blessing his father had given him. And Esau said in his heart, “The days of mourning for my father are at hand; then I will kill my brother Jacob.”
ekegusii: Esau akagecha Yakobo ase engencho y’ogosesenigwa okwo ise amosesenetie, agateeba ase omoyo oye ime: “Amatuko ay’okomoreera Tata ng’ang’e are; erio nario ndaite Yakobo.”
swahili: Esau akawa na kinyongo dhidi ya Yakobo kwa ajili ya baraka ambazo baba yake alikuwa amembariki. Akasema moyoni mwake, “Siku za kuomboleza kwa ajili ya baba yangu zimekaribia, ndipo nitamuua ndugu yangu Yakobo.”

english: When the words of her older son Esau were relayed to Rebekah, she sent for her younger son Jacob and told him, “Look, your brother Esau is consoling himself by plotting to kill you.
ekegusii: Korende ekero Rebeka ateebigwa aya Esau, omwana oye omonene, agoteeba, agatoma omonto korangeria Yakobo, omwana oye omoke, akamoteebia: “Rora, momura omino Esau ogotianeire ng’a nkogoitare.
swahili: Rebeka alipokwisha kuambiwa yale aliyoyasema Esau mwanawe mkubwa, alimwita Yakobo mwanawe mdogo, akamwambia, “Ndugu yako Esau anajifariji kwa wazo la kukuua.

english: So now, my son, obey my voice and flee at once to my brother Laban in Haran.
ekegusii: Na bono, omwana one, igwa amang’ana aane, imoka otame gochia o Labani, momura ominto aaria Harani.
swahili: Sasa basi, mwanangu, fanya nisemalo: Kimbilia haraka kwa Labani ndugu yangu kule Harani.

english: Stay with him for a while, until your brother’s fury subsides—
ekegusii: Omenye aroro ase engaki enke, goika ekeririanda kia momura omino gekende.
swahili: Ukae naye kwa muda mpaka ghadhabu ya ndugu yako itulie.

english: until your brother’s rage against you wanes and he forgets what you have done to him. Then I will send for you and bring you back from there. Why should I lose both of you in one day?”
ekegusii: Ekero endamwamu yaye erakee, na ere ebire aya kwamokorerete, erio nintome abanto bache gokorangeria oirane korwa aroro. Nase ki ndakwerwe nainwe mwensi babere ase rituko erimo.” Isaka Ogotoma Yakobo ase Labani
swahili: Wakati ndugu yako atakapokuwa hana hasira nawe tena na amesahau uliyomtendea, nitakupelekea ujumbe urudi. Kwa nini niwapoteze wote wawili kwa siku moja?”

english: Then Rebekah said to Isaac, “I am weary of my life because of these Hittite women. If Jacob takes a Hittite wife from among them, what good is my life?”
ekegusii: Erio Rebeka agakwana na Isaka, akamoteebia: “Nigo ngechirie mono ase obogima bwane ase engencho y’abaiseke b’Abahiti. Onye Yakobo ogochia konyuoma oyomo bw’abaiseke b’Abahiti, koreng’ana buna aba bamenyete ase ensemo eye, rirorio obogima bwane inki borangwenere?”
swahili: Kisha Rebeka akamwambia Isaki, “Nimechukia kuishi kwa sababu ya hawa wanawake wa Kihiti. Ikiwa Yakobo ataoa mke miongoni mwa wanawake wa nchi hii, wanawake wa Kihiti kama hawa, sitakuwa na faida kuendelea kuishi.”

english: Now Rebekah was listening to what Isaac told his son Esau. So when Esau went into the field to hunt game and bring it back,
ekegusii: Ko bono, ekero Isaka are gokwana nomwana oye Esau, Rebeka nigo ategererete bobisi. Ase igo, ekero Esau agendete borabu gotwara ching’iti amorentere ise,
swahili: Basi Rebeka alikuwa akisikiliza Isaki alipokuwa akizungumza na mwanawe Esau. Esau alipoondoka kwenda nyikani kuwinda nyama pori na kuleta,

english: Rebekah said to her son Jacob, “Behold, I overheard your father saying to your brother Esau,
ekegusii: Rebeka agateebia Yakobo, omwana oye: “Naigure iso ogoteebia momura omino Esau:
swahili: Rebeka akamwambia Yakobo mwanawe, “Tazama, nimemsikia baba yako akimwambia ndugu yako Esau,

english: ‘Bring me some game and prepare me a tasty dish to eat, so that I may bless you in the presence of the LORD before I die.’
ekegusii: Ndetere chinyama chia borabu, ondoiserie endagera engiya indie, erio inyare kogosesenia ase obosio bw’Omonene, konde moyo, ntarakwa.
swahili: ‘Niletee mawindo, kisha ukaniandalie chakula kitamu nile, ili niweze kukubariki mbele za Bwana kabla sijafa.’

english: Now, my son, listen to my voice and do exactly as I tell you.
ekegusii: Ase igo, omwana one, ntegerera bono aya nkogoteebia.
swahili: Sasa, mwanangu, nisikilize kwa makini na ufanye yale ninayokuambia:

english: Go out to the flock and bring me two choice young goats, so that I can make them into a tasty dish for your father—the kind he loves.
ekegusii: Genda getii ase riicho, ondetere chimanwa chie chimbori ibere chingiya, na inche nimoroiserie iso endagera engiya, eria anchete.
swahili: Nenda sasa katika kundi ukaniletee wana-mbuzi wawili wazuri, ili niandalie chakula kitamu kwa ajili ya baba yako, kama vile anavyopenda.

english: So Isaac called for Jacob and blessed him. “Do not take a wife from the Canaanite women,” he commanded.
ekegusii: Erio Isaka akarangeria Yakobo, akamosesenia, akamoteebia: “Tobaisa konyuoma omoiseke bw’Abakaanani.
swahili: Basi Isaki akamwita Yakobo, akambariki na akamwamuru, akisema, “Usioe mwanamke wa Kikanaani.

english: Meanwhile Jacob left Beersheba and set out for Haran.
ekegusii: Yakobo akaimoka korwa Beeri‐Seba kogenda Harani.
swahili: Yakobo akatoka Beer-Sheba kwenda Harani.

english: On reaching a certain place, he spent the night there because the sun had set. And taking one of the stones from that place, he put it under his head and lay down to sleep.
ekegusii: Agaika aase gete, akaraara agwo botuko, ekiagera erioba konya riagure. Akabogoria rigena erimo ri’aase aria, agatoorera omotwe oye ase rigena riria, karaaire.
swahili: Alipofika mahali fulani, akalala hapo kwa sababu jua lilikuwa limetua. Akachukua jiwe moja la mahali pale, akaliweka chini ya kichwa chake akajinyoosha akalala usingizi.

english: And Jacob had a dream about a ladder that rested on the earth with its top reaching up to heaven, and God’s angels were going up and down the ladder.
ekegusii: Akaroota, akarora engaasi getenenirie korwa inse y’ense, keigete igoro, na abamalaika ba Nyasae bakoyeriinera na goikera.
swahili: Akaota ndoto ambayo aliona ngazi imesimamishwa juu ya ardhi, ncha yake ikiwa imefika mbinguni na malaika wa Mungu wakawa wakipanda na kushuka juu yake.

english: And there at the top the LORD was standing and saying, “I am the LORD, the God of your father Abraham and the God of Isaac. I will give you and your descendants the land on which you now lie.
ekegusii: Akarora Omonene oteneine ase obosio bwaye, okobora: “Inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae o Aburaamu, na Nyasae o Isaka. Ense eye oraire ninkoyee aye amo noroiboro rwao;
swahili: Juu yake alisimama Bwana, akasema, “Mimi ni Bwana, Mungu wa baba yako Abrahamu na Mungu wa Isaki. Nchi ambayo umelala juu yake, nitakupa wewe na uzao wako.

english: Your descendants will be like the dust of the earth, and you will spread out to the west and east and north and south. All the families of the earth will be blessed through you and your offspring.
ekegusii: narororwo inarobe oronge buna orotu rw’ense, naye norande gochia ensemo ya bosongo, na moocha, na sugusu, na Irianyi; na asore aye, na ase ororeeria rwao, chiamate chionsi chi’ense inachisesenigwe.
swahili: Uzao wako utakuwa kama mavumbi ya nchi, nawe utaenea upande wa magharibi na mashariki, kaskazini na kusini. Kupitia wewe na uzao wako mataifa yote ya duniani yatabarikiwa.

english: Look, I am with you, and I will watch over you wherever you go, and I will bring you back to this land. For I will not leave you until I have done what I have promised you.”
ekegusii: Rora, inche nimbe amo naye, ninkorende aande onsi ase orabe gokogenda, naende ninkoiranie gocha ase ense eye; naki tinkogotiga goika nagokoreire ayio nagoteebirie.”
swahili: Niko pamoja nawe nami nitakulinda kila uendako na nitakurudisha katika nchi hii. Sitakuacha mpaka nitakapofanya hayo niliyokuahidi.”

english: When Jacob woke up, he thought, “Surely the LORD is in this place, and I was unaware of it.”
ekegusii: Yakobo akaboka korwa ase chitoro chiaye, akabora: “Amaene, Omonene nao are aase aa, na inche tinamanyete.”
swahili: Yakobo alipoamka kutoka usingizini, akawaza, “Hakika Bwana yuko mahali hapa, wala mimi sikujua.”

english: And he was afraid and said, “How awesome is this place! This is none other than the house of God; this is the gate of heaven!” The Stone of Bethel
ekegusii: Ere akoboa, akabora: “Aa nase okoirokia! Aa takomocha koba enyomba ya Nyasae, aa nao egeita kia igoro.”
swahili: Kwa hiyo akaogopa, akasema, “Mahali hapa panatisha kama nini! Bila shaka hapa ndipo nyumba ya Mungu ilipo, hili ni lango la mbinguni.”

english: Early the next morning, Jacob took the stone that he had placed under his head, and he set it up as a pillar. He poured oil on top of it,
ekegusii: Yakobo akaboka mambia chuni, akaimokia rigena riria atoorerete omotwe rogoro, akaritenenia buna esiiro koba ekeinyorio, akaumora amaguta igoro yaye.
swahili: Asubuhi yake na mapema, Yakobo akalichukua lile jiwe aliloliweka chini ya kichwa chake, akalisimamisha kama nguzo na kumimina mafuta juu yake.

english: and he called that place Bethel, though previously the city had been named Luz.
ekegusii: Aase aria akaaroka Beteli. Korende ritang’ani omochie oria nigo ore korokwa Lusu.
swahili: Mahali pale akapaita Betheli, ingawa mji ule hapo kwanza uliitwa Luzu.

english: “Go at once to Paddan-aram, to the house of your mother’s father Bethuel, and take a wife from among the daughters of Laban, your mother’s brother.
ekegusii: Imoka, ogende Padan‐Aramu ase omochie o Betueli, sokoro yao, onyuome omokungu oyomo korwa ase abaiseke ba Labani, nyoko-rome.
swahili: Nenda mara moja mpaka Padan-Aramu, kwenye nyumba ya Bethueli baba wa mama yako. Uchukue mke kati ya binti za Labani ambaye ni ndugu wa mama yako.

english: Then Jacob made a vow, saying, “If God will be with me and watch over me on this journey, and if He will provide me with food to eat and clothes to wear,
ekegusii: Erio Yakobo akaria eira, okobora: “Nyasae karabe amo nainche, andende ase orogendo rwane na kong’a endagera nkoria, ne chianga nkobeeka,
swahili: Kisha Yakobo akaweka nadhiri, akisema, “Kama Mungu akiwa pamoja nami na kunilinda katika safari niendayo, akinipa chakula nile na nguo nivae

english: so that I may return safely to my father’s house, then the LORD will be my God.
ekegusii: na inche kondairane ase omochie o Tata nomorembe, eri’Omonene nabe Nyasae one;
swahili: na nirudi salama nyumbani kwa baba yangu, hapo ndipo Bwana atakuwa Mungu wangu,

english: And this stone I have set up as a pillar will be God’s house, and of all that You give me I will surely give You a tenth.”
ekegusii: ne rigena eri natenenia aa buna esiiro nigo rirabe enyomba yao, Nyasae. Na kende gionsi orang’e inche, amaene tinkomocha gokoa ensemo ya ikomi.”
swahili: nalo jiwe hili nililolisimamisha kama nguzo litakuwa nyumba ya Mungu na katika yote utakayonipa nitakutolea wewe sehemu ya kumi.”

english: May God Almighty bless you and make you fruitful and multiply you, so that you may become a company of peoples.
ekegusii: Na Nyasae Omobui nagosesenie, agokinie, na oroiboro rwao naromente robe omoganda omonene bw’ebisaku.
swahili: Mungu Mwenyezi na akubariki uwe na uzao uongezeke idadi yako upate kuwa jamii kubwa ya watu.

english: And may He give the blessing of Abraham to you and your descendants, so that you may possess the land where you dwell as a foreigner, the land God gave to Abraham.”
ekegusii: Ere nakoe ogosesenigwa kwa Aburaamu, aye amo na ororeeria rwao, erinde onyare koira ense eye ore omomenyi bono, eye Nyasae aete Aburaamu!”
swahili: Na akupe wewe na uzao wako baraka aliyopewa Abrahamu, upate kumiliki nchi unayoishi sasa kama mgeni, nchi ambayo Mungu alimpa Abrahamu.”

english: So Isaac sent Jacob to Paddan-aram, to Laban son of Bethuel the Aramean, the brother of Rebekah, who was the mother of Jacob and Esau. Esau Marries Mahalath
ekegusii: Naboigo Isaka agateebia Yakobo agende, na ere akagenda Padan‐Aramu ase Labani, mosinto o Betueli Omoaramu, Labani nere momura omwabo Rebeka, ng’ina Yakobo na Esau. Esau okonyuoma omokungu onde
swahili: Kisha Isaki akamuaga Yakobo, naye akaenda Padan-Aramu, kwa Labani mwana wa Bethueli Mwaramu, ndugu wa Rebeka, aliyekuwa mama wa Yakobo na Esau.

english: Now Esau learned that Isaac had blessed Jacob and sent him to Paddan-aram to take a wife there, commanding him, “Do not marry a Canaanite woman,”
ekegusii: Bono Esau akarora buna Isaka asesenirie Yakobo na komotoma agende Padan‐Aramu anyuome omokungu korwa aroro, ekiagera ekero amosesenetie, akamokania tabaisa konyuoma moiseke onde bwensi bw’Abakaanani!
swahili: Sasa Esau akajua kuwa Isaki amembariki Yakobo na kumtuma kwenda Padan-Aramu ili achukue mke huko na kwamba alipombariki alimwamuru akisema, “Usioe mke katika binti za Wakanaani,”

english: and that Jacob had obeyed his father and mother and gone to Paddan-aram.
ekegusii: Naende akarora ng’a Yakobo oigwereire ise na ng’ina ochiire Padan‐Aramu.
swahili: tena kwamba Yakobo amewatii baba yake na mama yake naye amekwenda Padan-Aramu.

english: And seeing that his father Isaac disapproved of the Canaanite women,
ekegusii: Ase igo, ekero Esau arooche ng’a Isaka ise tancheti abaiseke abwo b’Abakaanani,
swahili: Esau akatambua jinsi ambavyo baba yake Isaki anavyowachukia binti za Wakanaani.

english: Esau went to Ishmael and married Mahalath, the sister of Nebaioth and daughter of Abraham’s son Ishmael, in addition to the wives he already had. Jacob’s Ladder
ekegusii: nonya obwate abakungu bande, akagenda o Isumaeli, akanyuoma Mahalati, omoiseke o Isumaeli mosinto o Aburaamu, mosubati omwabo Nebayoti, abe omokungu oye amo nabakungu baria bande abwate ritang’ani. Okoroota kwa Yakobo agwo Beteli
swahili: Ndipo Esau akaenda kwa Ishmaeli, akamwoa Mahalati, ndugu wa Nebayothi na binti wa Ishmaeli mwana wa Abrahamu, kuongezea wale wake wengine aliokuwa nao. Ndoto Ya Yakobo Huko Betheli

english: Jacob resumed his journey and came to the land of the people of the east.
ekegusii: Erio Yakobo akagenderera norogendo rwaye, agaika ense y’abanto ba moocha.
swahili: Kisha Yakobo akaendelea na safari yake na akafika kwenye nchi za mataifa ya mashariki.

english: As soon as Jacob saw Rachel, the daughter of his mother’s brother Laban, with Laban’s sheep, he went up and rolled the stone away from the mouth of the well and watered his uncle’s sheep.
ekegusii: Bono ekero Yakobo achia korora Raeli, omoiseke o Labani, ng’ina rome, okorenta riicho ria Labani, akaimoka, agatigeria rigena riria korwa ase omonwa bw’ensoko, akanyoinsia ching’ondi chia Labani, ng’ina rome.
swahili: Yakobo alipomwona Raheli binti Labani, ndugu wa mama yake, pamoja na kondoo wa Labani, alikwenda na kulivingirisha jiwe kutoka mdomoni mwa kisima na kuwanywesha kondoo wa mjomba wake.

english: Then Jacob kissed Rachel and wept aloud.
ekegusii: Erio Yakobo akaagata Raeli, akarera na koiyeria amariga.
swahili: Kisha Yakobo akambusu Raheli na akaanza kulia kwa sauti.

english: He told Rachel that he was Rebekah’s son, a relative of her father, and she ran and told her father.
ekegusii: Agateebia Raeli, “Inche nomoigwa o iso, omwana o Rebeka.” Raeli akaminyoka, agateebia ise amang’ana ayio.
swahili: Yakobo alikuwa amemwambia Raheli kuwa yeye alikuwa jamaa ya baba yake, na kwamba ni mwana wa Rebeka. Basi Raheli alikimbia na kumweleza baba yake.

english: When Laban heard the news about his sister’s son Jacob, he ran out to meet him. He embraced him and kissed him and brought him to his home, where Jacob told him all that had happened. Jacob Marries Leah and Rachel
ekegusii: Ekero Labani achia koigwa amang’ana a Yakobo, omoigwa oye, akaminyoka gochia komoorotota, akamoagata n’amaiga amanene, akamoira gochia nka bwoye. Yakobo agateebia Labani amang’ana onsi.
swahili: Mara Labani aliposikia habari kuhusu Yakobo, mwana wa ndugu yake, aliharakisha kwenda kumlaki. Akamkumbatia na kumbusu, halafu akamleta nyumbani kwake, kisha Yakobo akamwambia mambo yote.

english: Then Laban declared, “You are indeed my own flesh and blood.” After Jacob had stayed with him a month,
ekegusii: Erio Labani akamoteebia: “Amaene, aye namanyinga omobere one.” Ere akamenya bwoye ase engaki y’omotienyi oyomo. Yakobo ogokorera Labani ase okonyora Raeli na Lea
swahili: Ndipo Labani akamwambia, “Wewe ni nyama yangu na damu yangu mwenyewe.” Yakobo Awaoa Lea Na Raheli Baada ya Yakobo kukaa kwa Labani mwezi mzima,

english: Laban said to him, “Just because you are my relative, should you work for nothing? Tell me what your wages should be.”
ekegusii: Labani agakwana na Yakobo, akamoteebia: “Nonya kore omoigwa one, tegwenereti onkorere emeremo bosa. Nteebia eng’eria yao ninki ndakoe!”
swahili: Labani akamwambia, “Kwa vile wewe ni jamaa yangu, ndiyo sababu unifanyie kazi bila ujira? Niambie ujira wako utakuwa nini.”

english: Now Laban had two daughters; the older was named Leah, and the younger was named Rachel.
ekegusii: Bono Labani nigo abwate abaiseke babere; omoiseke oria omonene nigo are korokwa Lea, na oria omoke Raeli.
swahili: Labani alikuwa na binti wawili, binti mkubwa aliitwa Lea na binti mdogo aliitwa Raheli.

english: Leah had weak eyes, but Rachel was shapely and beautiful.
ekegusii: Lea amaiso aye nigo areenge amatu, korende Raeli nigo areenge omonyakieni, naende omwasioku.
swahili: Lea alikuwa na macho dhaifu, lakini Raheli alikuwa na umbo la kupendeza na mzuri wa sura.

english: Since Jacob loved Rachel, he answered, “I will serve you seven years for your younger daughter Rachel.”
ekegusii: Yakobo konya omwanchire Raeli, na ase ayio agateebia Labani, “Ningokorere emiaka etano na ebere, erinde ong’e Raeli, omoiseke oo omoke.”
swahili: Yakobo akampenda Raheli, akamwambia Labani, “Nitakutumikia kwa miaka saba kwa ajili ya kumpata Raheli binti yako mdogo.”

english: Laban replied, “Better that I give her to you than to another. Stay here with me.”
ekegusii: Labani akamoiraneria, “Ayio mbuya. Tiga nkomoe aye kobua ’nkomoa omonto onde; menya aa bwone.”
swahili: Labani akasema, “Ni bora zaidi nikupe Raheli kuliko kumpa mtu mwingine yeyote. Kaa pamoja na mimi hapa.”

english: He looked and saw a well in the field, and near it lay three flocks of sheep, because the sheep were watered from this well. And a large stone covered the mouth of the well.
ekegusii: Agwo akarigereria akarora ensoko yaare ase egetii, na amaicho atato e ching’ondi araire ensoko eyio ensemo, ekiagera ase ensoko eyio nao amaicho are konywera amaache. Na ndiareenge aroro rigena rinene igoro y’omonwa bw’ensoko.
swahili: Huko akaona kisima katika shamba, pamoja na makundi matatu ya kondoo yamelala karibu na kisima hicho kwa sababu walikuwa wanakunywa maji kutoka kwenye kisimani hicho. Jiwe lililokuwa mdomoni mwa kisima lilikuwa kubwa.

english: So Jacob served seven years for Rachel, yet it seemed but a few days because of his love for her.
ekegusii: Ase igo, Yakobo akamokorera emiaka etano na ebere aegwe Raeli. Emiaka eyio ekarorekana asare buna namatuko makeigo, ekiagera nigo amwanchete Raeli mono.
swahili: Kwa hiyo Yakobo akatumika miaka saba ili kumpata Raheli, lakini ilionekana kwake kama siku chache tu kwa sababu ya upendo wake kwa Raheli.

english: Finally Jacob said to Laban, “Grant me my wife, for my time is complete, and I want to sleep with her.”
ekegusii: Erio Yakobo agateebia Labani: “Bono naikeranirie engaki yane, ing’a mokane, tobe nere.”
swahili: Ndipo Yakobo akamwambia Labani, “Nipe mke wangu. Muda wangu umekamilika, nami nataka nikutane naye kimwili.”

english: So Laban invited all the men of that place and prepared a feast.
ekegusii: Ase igo, Labani akarangeria abanto bonsi b’ensemo eria, agakorera omoyega.
swahili: Basi Labani akaalika watu wote wa mahali pale na akafanya karamu.

english: But when evening came, Laban took his daughter Leah and gave her to Jacob, and he slept with her.
ekegusii: Rigachia koba mogoroba Labani akaimokia Lea, omoiseke oye omonene, akamorentera Yakobo, erio Yakobo akaba nere.
swahili: Lakini ilipofika jioni, akamchukua Lea binti yake akampa Yakobo, naye Yakobo akakutana naye kimwili.

english: And Laban gave his servant girl Zilpah to his daughter Leah as her maidservant.
ekegusii: Ase ekero ekio Labani akarua omosomba oye omoiseke okorokwa Silpa, abe omokoreri o Lea, omwana oye.
swahili: Naye Labani akamtoa Zilpa, mtumishi wake wa kike, kuwa mtumishi wa Lea, binti yake.

english: When morning came, there was Leah! “What have you done to me?” Jacob said to Laban. “Wasn’t it for Rachel that I served you? Why have you deceived me?”
ekegusii: Bogachia gokia mambia, Yakobo akanyora ng’a ’Lea aetwe. Erio akabooria Labani: “Inki eke gwankorerete? Tinagokorerete, erinde ong’e Raeli? Naki gwakorete okang’aina?”
swahili: Kesho yake asubuhi, Yakobo akagundua kuwa amepewa Lea! Basi Yakobo akamwambia Labani, “Ni jambo gani hili ulilonitendea? Nilikutumikia kwa ajili ya Raheli, sivyo? Kwa nini umenidanganya?”

english: Laban replied, “It is not our custom here to give the younger daughter in marriage before the older.
ekegusii: Labani akamoiraneria: “Aiga seito intwe titori gokora bo, gosokia omoiseke omoke, na gotiga omonene.
swahili: Labani akajibu, “Si desturi yetu kumwoza binti mdogo kabla ya kumwoza binti mkubwa.

english: Finish this week’s celebration, and we will give you the younger one in return for another seven years of work.”
ekegusii: Tiga omoyega oyo bw’amatuko aya atano na abere oraera bw’oyio omonene, erio noegwe na oria omoke, naende aye onkorere emeremo emiaka ende etano na ebere.”
swahili: Maliza juma la arusi ya binti huyu, kisha pia nitakupa huyu binti mdogo, kwa kutumika miaka mingine saba.”

english: And Jacob did just that. He finished the week’s celebration, and Laban gave him his daughter Rachel as his wife.
ekegusii: Yakobo agancha ebe boigo, erio agaikerania amatuko ayio atano na abere. Erio Labani akamomoa Raeli, omoiseke oye omoke, abe mok’aye.
swahili: Naye Yakobo akafanya hivyo. Akamaliza juma na Lea, kisha Labani akampa Raheli binti yake kuwa mke wake.

english: Laban also gave his servant girl Bilhah to his daughter Rachel as her maidservant.
ekegusii: Labani akamoa Raeli, omwana oye, omokoreri, nere Bilia, omosomba oye omoiseke.
swahili: Labani akamtoa Bilha mtumishi wake wa kike kwa Raheli ili kuwa mtumishi wake.

english: When all the flocks had been gathered there, the shepherds would roll away the stone from the mouth of the well and water the sheep. Then they would return the stone to its place over the mouth of the well.
ekegusii: Agwo nao amaicho onsi areenge gosangererekana, na abarisia nigo baare korusia rigena riria korwa ase omonwa bw’ensoko banyoinsia ching’ondi, naende bariirania ase omonwa bw’ensoko.
swahili: Wakati kondoo wanapokuwa wamekusanyika hapo, wachungaji huvingirisha jiwe hilo kutoka kwenye mdomo wa kisima na kunywesha kondoo. Kisha hulirudisha jiwe mahali pake juu ya mdomo wa kisima.

english: Jacob slept with Rachel as well, and indeed, he loved Rachel more than Leah. So he worked for Laban another seven years. Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah
ekegusii: Ase igo, Yakobo akaba na Raeli; na agancha Raeli mono kegima kobua Lea. Erio Yakobo naende agakorera Labani emiaka ende etano na ebere. Abana ba Yakobo
swahili: Pia Yakobo akakutana na Raheli kimwili, naye akampenda Raheli zaidi kuliko Lea. Yakobo akamtumikia Labani kwa miaka mingine saba. Wana Wa Yakobo

english: When the LORD saw that Leah was unloved, He opened her womb; but Rachel was barren.
ekegusii: Ekero Omonene arooche ng’a Lea tanchiri, akamosesenia ase oroiboro rwa abana, korende Raeli ere nigo areenge omogomba.
swahili: Bwana alipoona kwamba Lea hapendwi, akampa watoto, lakini Raheli alikuwa tasa.

english: And Leah conceived and gave birth to a son, and she named him Reuben, for she said, “The LORD has seen my affliction. Surely my husband will love me now.”
ekegusii: Lea akaba morito, akaibora omwana omoisia, akamoroka Rubeni, naki nigo atebeete: “Omonene ororire buna ’nchayire. Korende ase engencho y’okoibora, bono omosacha one nanyanche.”
swahili: Lea akapata mimba akazaa mwana. Akamwita Reubeni, kwa maana alisema, “Ni kwa sababu Bwana ameona huzuni yangu. Hakika mume wangu sasa atanipenda.”

english: Again she conceived and gave birth to a son, and she said, “Because the LORD has heard that I am unloved, He has given me this son as well.” So she named him Simeon.
ekegusii: Naende Lea akaba morito, akaibora omwana omoisia, akabora: “Omonene ororire ng’a tinyanchiri, naende ong’eire omwana onde omoisia boigo,” akamoroka Simioni.
swahili: Akapata tena mimba, naye alipozaa mwana, akasema, “Kwa sababu Bwana alisikia kwamba sipendwi, amenipa tena huyu mwana.” Kwa hiyo akamwita Simeoni.

english: Once again Leah conceived and gave birth to a son, and she said, “Now at last my husband will become attached to me, because I have borne him three sons.” So he was named Levi.
ekegusii: Naende akaba morito, akaibora omwana omoisia, akabora: “Bono engaki eye omosacha one nabwatane amo nainche, ekiagera namoiboreire abana abaisia batato.” Ase ayio akamoroka Lawi.
swahili: Akapata tena mimba, naye alipozaa mwana, akasema, “Sasa afadhali mume wangu ataambatana na mimi, kwa sababu nimemzalia wana watatu.” Kwa hiyo akamwita Lawi.

english: And once more she conceived and gave birth to a son and said, “This time I will praise the LORD.” So she named him Judah. Then Leah stopped having children.
ekegusii: Akaba morito naende, akaibora omwana omoisia, akabora: “Engaki eye nintogie Omonene.” Ase ayio akamoroka Yuda. Erio Lea agatenena koibora.
swahili: Akapata tena mimba, naye alipozaa mwana, akasema, “Wakati huu nitamsifu Bwana.” Kwa hiyo akamwita Yuda. Kisha akaacha kuzaa watoto.

english: “My brothers,” Jacob asked the shepherds, “where are you from?” “We are from Haran,” they answered.
ekegusii: Yakobo akababooria: “Baminto, ng’ai seino?” Abarisia baria bakamoiraneria: “Seito naiga Harani.”
swahili: Yakobo aliwauliza wachungaji, “Ndugu zangu, ninyi mmetoka wapi?” Wakamjibu, “Tumetoka Harani.”

english: “Do you know Laban the grandson of Nahor?” Jacob asked. “We know him,” they replied.
ekegusii: Naende akababooria: “Inee! Momanyete Labani, mochokoro o Nahori?” Barabwo bakamoiraneria: “Ee, ntomomanyete.”
swahili: Aliwaambia, “Je, mnamjua Labani, mjukuu wa Nahori?” Wakamjibu, “Ndiyo, tunamfahamu.”

english: “Is he well?” Jacob inquired. “Yes,” they answered, “and here comes his daughter Rachel with his sheep.”
ekegusii: Naende akababooria: “Mbuya are?” Abarisia bakamoiraneria: “Ee, mbuya are; na rigereria, Raeli, omoiseke oye oyio ogocha ne ching’ondi!”
swahili: Kisha Yakobo akawauliza, “Je, yeye ni mzima?” Wakasema, “Ndiyo, ni mzima, na hapa yuaja Raheli binti yake akiwa na kondoo.”

english: “Look,” said Jacob, “it is still broad daylight; it is not yet time to gather the livestock. Water the sheep and take them back to pasture.”
ekegusii: Akabateebia: “Rigereria, bono mobaso, chinsa chi’ogosangereria amaicho tichiraika, nyoinsia ching’ondi, naende mochiire korisia.”
swahili: Akasema, “Tazama, jua bado liko juu, si wakati wa kukusanya mifugo. Nywesheni kondoo na mwarudishe malishoni.”

english: But they replied, “We cannot, until all the flocks have been gathered and the stone has been rolled away from the mouth of the well. Then we will water the sheep.”
ekegusii: Korende barabwo bakamoiraneria: “Titokonyara gokora bo goika ekero amaicho onsi arache asangererekane amo, erinde abarisia bamanye gotigeria rigena korwa ase omonwa bw’ensoko; erio tomanye konyoinsia ching’ondi.”
swahili: Walijibu, “Haiwezekani, mpaka kondoo wote wakusanyike na jiwe liwe limevingirishwa kutoka mdomo wa kisima. Ndipo tutanywesha kondoo.”

english: While he was still speaking with them, Rachel arrived with her father’s sheep, for she was a shepherdess.
ekegusii: Ekero areenge ogendererete gokwana nabarabwo, Raeli agacha obwate ching’ondi chia ise, naki nere orenge gochirisia.
swahili: Alipokuwa akizungumza nao, Raheli akaja pamoja na kondoo wa baba yake, kwa maana alikuwa mchunga kondoo.

english: Thus the heavens and the earth were completed in all their vast array.
ekegusii: Naboigo igoro na ense bigaikeranigwa.
swahili: Kwa hiyo mbingu na dunia zikakamilika, pamoja na vyote vilivyomo.

english: Now a river flowed out of Eden to water the garden, and from there it branched into four headwaters:
ekegusii: Orooche rogatuboka korwa ase omogondo o Edeni na rokayobekera amaache. Korwa agwo rokagabekana, rokaba chindooche inye.
swahili: Mto wa kunyeshea bustani ulitiririka toka Edeni, kuanzia hapa ukagawanyika kuwa mito minne.

english: The name of the first river is Pishon; it winds through the whole land of Havilah, where there is gold.
ekegusii: Orooche rwe ritang’ani rokarokwa Pisoni, orwo narwo roetanaine ense yonsi ya Havila.
swahili: Mto wa kwanza uliitwa Pishoni, nao huzunguka nchi yote ya Havila ambako kuna dhahabu.

english: And the gold of that land is pure, and bdellium and onyx are found there.
ekegusii: Aa noo Etaabu engiya kegima egotoka boigo namagena ande ye rigori rinene.
swahili: (Dhahabu ya nchi hiyo ni nzuri, bedola na vito shohamu pia hupatikana huko.)

english: The name of the second river is Gihon; it winds through the whole land of Cush.
ekegusii: Na orooche rwa kabere rokarokwa Gihoni, orwo narwo roetanaine ense yonsi ya Kusi.
swahili: Jina la mto wa pili ni Gihoni, ambao huzunguka nchi yote ya Kushi.

english: The name of the third river is Hiddekel; it runs along the east side of Assyria. And the fourth river is the Euphrates.
ekegusii: Na orooche rwa gatato rokarokwa Tigirisi, orwo rogoeta moocha y’Asuri. Na orooche rwa kane narororwo rokarokwa Eufarati.
swahili: Jina la mto wa tatu ni Tigrisi, unaopita mashariki ya Ashuru. Mto wa nne ni Frati.

english: Then the LORD God took the man and placed him in the Garden of Eden to cultivate and keep it.
ekegusii: Erio Omonene Nyasae akaira omonto oria, akamobeka ase omogondo o Edeni, ayoroiserie na koyorenda.
swahili: Bwana Mungu akamchukua huyo mtu, akamweka kwenye Bustani ya Edeni ailime na kuitunza.

english: And the LORD God commanded him, “You may eat freely from every tree of the garden,
ekegusii: Akamoteebia omonto oria, “Amatunda a kera omote ore ase omogondo oyo nonyare koyaria,
swahili: Bwana Mungu akamwagiza huyo mtu, akamwambia, “Uko huru kula matunda ya mti wowote katika bustani,

english: but you must not eat from the tree of the knowledge of good and evil; for in the day that you eat of it, you will surely die.”
ekegusii: gotatiga amatunda y’omote bw’okomanyera amaya na amabe toyaria, ekiagera rituko riria orayarie goika okwe.”
swahili: lakini kamwe usile matunda ya mti wa kujua mema na mabaya, kwa maana siku utakapokula matunda yake, hakika utakufa.”

english: The LORD God also said, “It is not good for the man to be alone. I will make for him a suitable helper.”
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene Nyasae agateeba: “Tai buya omonto oyo abe bweka, nimokorere omokonyi oramokoonye.”
swahili: Bwana Mungu akasema, “Si vyema huyu mtu awe peke yake. Nitamfanyia msaidizi wa kumfaa.”

english: And out of the ground the LORD God formed every beast of the field and every bird of the air, and He brought them to the man to see what he would name each one. And whatever the man called each living creature, that was its name.
ekegusii: Erio akaimokia amaroba korwa inse akaroisia kera eng’iti, ne chinyoni chionsi. Erio agachirenta ase omonto oria, arore buna agochiroka; naboigo kera egetongwa kianyorete erieta riaye.
swahili: Basi Bwana Mungu alikuwa amefanyiza kutoka ardhi wanyama wote wa porini na ndege wote wa angani. Akawaleta kwa huyu mtu aone atawaitaje, nalo jina lolote alilokiita kila kiumbe hai, likawa ndilo jina lake.

english: And by the seventh day God had finished the work He had been doing; so on that day He rested from all His work.
ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatano na kabere Nyasae agaikerania emeremo yaye yonsi; erio agatimoka.
swahili: Katika siku ya saba Mungu alikuwa amekamilisha kazi aliyokuwa akiifanya, hivyo siku ya saba akapumzika kutoka kazi zake zote.

english: The man gave names to all the livestock, to the birds of the air, and to every beast of the field. But for Adam no suitable helper was found.
ekegusii: Ase igo omonto oyio akaroka chinyoni chionsi n’echingiti chionsi; korende ase ebio bionsi ebiatongetwe, tarorekana mokonyi onde oye.
swahili: Hivyo Adamu akawapa majina wanyama wote wa kufugwa, ndege wa angani, na wanyama wote wa porini. Lakini kwa Adamu hakupatikana msaidizi wa kumfaa.

english: So the LORD God caused the man to fall into a deep sleep, and while he slept, He took one of the man’s ribs and closed up the area with flesh.
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene Nyasae akabeekera omonto oria chitoro chindito mono kegima, ekero araire akamorusia orobaru rwaye oromo, na akairaneria chinyama aase aria.
swahili: Hivyo Bwana Mungu akamfanya Adamu kulala usingizi mzito, naye alipokuwa amelala akachukua moja ya mbavu zake, akapafunika mahali pale kwa nyama.

english: And from the rib that the LORD God had taken from the man, He made a woman and brought her to him.
ekegusii: Akaroisia omokungu korwa ase orobaru akamoirera omonto oria.
swahili: Kisha Bwana Mungu akamfanya mwanamke kutoka kwenye ule ubavu aliouchukua kutoka kwa huyo mwanaume, akamleta huyo mwanamke kwa huyo mwanaume.

english: And the man said: “This is now bone of my bones and flesh of my flesh; she shall be called ‘woman,’ for out of man she was taken.”
ekegusii: Erio omonto oria agateeba, “Omoerio oyombwekaine oyo aa Oyo neriuga korwa ase amauga aane, ne chinyama korwa ase chinyama chiane. Oyo nigo ararokwe omokungu, ekiagera oyo nigo arusigwe ase omosacha.”
swahili: Huyo mwanaume akasema, “Huyu sasa ni mfupa wa mifupa yangu na nyama ya nyama yangu, ataitwa ‘mwanamke,’ kwa kuwa alitolewa katika mwanaume.”

english: For this reason a man will leave his father and mother and be united to his wife, and they will become one flesh.
ekegusii: Ekio nakio gekogera omonto agotiga ise na ng’ina obwatana na mokaye, na abwo babere baba omobere oyomo.
swahili: Kwa sababu hii mwanaume atamwacha baba yake na mama yake na kuambatana na mkewe, nao watakuwa mwili mmoja.

english: And the man and his wife were both naked, and they were not ashamed.
ekegusii: Omosacha na omokungu nigo baarenge getirianda, na tibaare kororerana obosooku.
swahili: Adamu na mkewe wote wawili walikuwa uchi, wala hawakuona aibu.

english: Then God blessed the seventh day and sanctified it, because on that day He rested from all the work of creation that He had accomplished. Man and Woman in the Garden
ekegusii: Nyasae agasesenia rituko ria gatano na kabere, akariatanana, akarikora richenu, ekiagera erio nario rituko atimogete korwa ase emeremo yaye yonsi y’obotongi, eyio konya akorire.
swahili: Mungu akaibariki siku ya saba akaifanya takatifu, kwa sababu katika siku hiyo alipumzika kutoka kazi zote za kuumba alizokuwa amefanya. Adamu Na Eva

english: This is the account of the heavens and the earth when they were created, in the day that the LORD God made them.
ekegusii: Oyo noro omogano igoro y’ense, na bionsi ebire imeo buna biatongetwe. Omogondo o Eden
swahili: Haya ndiyo maelezo ya mbingu na dunia wakati zilipoumbwa. Bwana Mungu alipoziumba mbingu na dunia,

english: Now no shrub of the field had yet appeared on the earth, nor had any plant of the field sprouted; for the LORD God had not yet sent rain upon the earth, and there was no man to cultivate the ground.
ekegusii: Ase engaki eria’Omonene atongete igoro na ense, kemeri kende tikiarenge komera korwa ase riroba, gose nyeni chinde, ekiagera Omonene Nyasae konya taratoma embura etwe ase ense, nonya ’monto onde tarengeo ore korema riroba.
swahili: hapakuwepo na mche wa shambani uliokuwa umejitokeza ardhini, wala hapakuwepo na mmea wa shamba uliokuwa umeota, kwa kuwa Bwana Mungu alikuwa hajanyeshea mvua juu ya nchi, na hapakuwepo mtu wa kuilima ardhi,

english: But springs welled up from the earth and watered the whole surface of the ground.
ekegusii: Korende obotooru nigo bware gotiira korwa inse na konyiyia riroba ri’ense yonsi.
swahili: lakini umande ulitokeza kutoka ardhini na kunyesha uso wote wa nchi:

english: Then the LORD God formed man from the dust of the ground and breathed the breath of life into his nostrils, and the man became a living being.
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene Nyasae akaimokia amaroba korwa inse akabomba na koroisia omonto korwa ase orotu rwe riroba, akamoutera omoika bw’obogima ase chimioro chiaye, erio omonto akaba n’obomooyo.
swahili: Bwana Mungu alimuumba mtu kutoka mavumbi ya ardhi, akampulizia pumzi ya uhai puani mwake, naye mtu akawa kiumbe hai.

english: And the LORD God planted a garden in Eden, in the east, where He placed the man He had formed.
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene Nyasae agasimeka ebimeri ase omogondo aaria Edeni, ensemo ya moocha, erio akabeeka omonto aroro, oria abombete na koroisia.
swahili: Basi Bwana Mungu alikuwa ameotesha bustani upande wa mashariki, katika Edeni, huko akamweka huyo mtu aliyemuumba.

english: Out of the ground the LORD God gave growth to every tree that is pleasing to the eye and good for food. And in the middle of the garden were the tree of life and the tree of the knowledge of good and evil.
ekegusii: Akameria emete korwa ase riroba, emete yonsi ekororwa yasanerwa kegima, eyio yarenge endagera engiya. Nyasae akabeeka omote bw’obogima gati‐gati y’omogondo oria, naende omote onde oyo bw’okomanyera amaya na amabe.
swahili: Bwana Mungu akafanya aina zote za miti ziote kutoka ardhini, miti yenye kupendeza macho na mizuri kwa chakula. Katikati ya bustani ulikuwepo mti wa uzima na mti wa kujua mema na mabaya.

english: When Rachel saw that she was not bearing any children for Jacob, she envied her sister. “Give me children, or I will die!” she said to Jacob.
ekegusii: Ekero Raeli arooche ng’a tari koiborera Yakobo abana, akarorera mosubati omwabo ribero, agateebia Yakobo: “Ing’a abana! Otabang’eti, rirorio nigo ndakwe!”
swahili: Raheli alipoona hamzalii Yakobo watoto, akamwonea ndugu yake wivu. Hivyo akamwambia Yakobo, “Nipe watoto, la sivyo nitakufa!”

english: And Leah’s servant Zilpah bore Jacob a son.
ekegusii: Erio Silpa, omosomba omoiseke o Lea, akaiborera Yakobo omwana omoisia.
swahili: Mtumishi wa Lea yaani Zilpa, akamzalia Yakobo mwana.

english: Then Leah said, “How fortunate!” So she named him Gad.
ekegusii: Lea akabora: “Ninde negesio.” Akamoroka Gadi.
swahili: Ndipo Lea akasema, “Hii ni bahati nzuri aje!” Kwa hiyo akamwita Gadi.

english: When Leah’s servant Zilpah bore Jacob a second son,
ekegusii: Silpa, omosomba o Lea, akaiborera Yakobo omwana omoisia o kabere.
swahili: Mtumishi wa kike wa Lea akamzalia Yakobo mwana wa pili.

english: Leah said, “How happy I am! For the women call me happy.” So she named him Asher.
ekegusii: Lea akabora: “Inche ninde nomogooko omonene, naki abakungu nabandoke Oyore n’omogooko.” Ase igo, akamoroka Aseri.
swahili: Ndipo Lea aliposema, “Jinsi gani nilivyo na furaha! Wanawake wataniita furaha.” Kwa hiyo akamwita Asheri.

english: Now during the wheat harvest, Reuben went out and found some mandrakes in the field. When he brought them to his mother, Rachel begged Leah, “Please give me some of your son’s mandrakes.”
ekegusii: Ase engaki ye rigesa ri’engano Rubeni akagenda akanyora amasooni ng’ombe getii, akayatwa, akayarentera Lea ng’ina.
swahili: Wakati wa kuvuna ngano, Reubeni akaenda shambani akakuta tunguja, ambazo alizileta kwa Lea mama yake. Raheli akamwambia Lea, “Tafadhali nakuomba unipe baadhi ya tunguja za mwanao.”

english: But Leah replied, “Is it not enough that you have taken away my husband? Now you want to take my son’s mandrakes as well?” “Very well,” said Rachel, “he may sleep with you tonight in exchange for your son’s mandrakes.”
ekegusii: Erio Raeli agasaba Lea amwatanere amasooni ng’ombe y’omwana oye, korende Lea akamoiraneria: “Inee! Nering’ana rike kwang’urire omosacha one, na bono korigetie koira amasooni ng’ombe ay’omwana one boigo?” Raeli akamoiraneria: “Reero nache araare naye, korang’e amasooni ng’ombe y’omwana oo.”
swahili: Lakini Lea akamwambia, “Haikukutosha kumtwaa mume wangu? Je, utachukua na tunguja za mwanangu pia?” Raheli akasema, “Vema sana! Yakobo atakutana nawe kimwili leo usiku, kwa malipo ya tunguja za mwanao.”

english: When Jacob came in from the field that evening, Leah went out to meet him and said, “You must come with me, for I have hired you with my son’s mandrakes.” So he slept with her that night. Issachar, Zebulun, and Dinah
ekegusii: Ekero Yakobo areenge koirana korwa mogondo mogoroba, Lea akagenda komoorotota, akamoteebia: “Reero goika oraare mwane, nakogorire namasooni ng’ombe ay’omwana one.” Ase obotuko Yakobo akaba nere.
swahili: Kwa hiyo Yakobo alipokuja kutoka shambani jioni ile, Lea akaenda kumlaki, akamwambia, “Lazima ukutane nami kimwili. Nimekukodisha kwa tunguja za mwanangu.” Kwa hiyo akakutana naye kimwili usiku ule.

english: And God listened to Leah, and she conceived and bore a fifth son to Jacob.
ekegusii: Nyasae akaigwa Lea, na ere akaba morito, akaiborera Yakobo omwana omoisia o gatano.
swahili: Mungu akamsikiliza Lea, naye akapata mimba akamzalia Yakobo mwana wa tano.

english: Then Leah said, “God has rewarded me for giving my maidservant to my husband.” So she named him Issachar.
ekegusii: Lea akabora: “Nyasae ong’eire eng’eria yane, ekiagera naete omosacha one omosomba one omoiseke.” Ase igo, Akaaroka omwana oria Isakaru.
swahili: Ndipo Lea akasema, “Mungu amenizawadia kwa kumpa mume wangu mtumishi wangu wa kike.” Kwa hiyo akamwita Isakari.

english: Again Leah conceived and bore a sixth son to Jacob.
ekegusii: Lea akaba morito naende, akaiborera Yakobo omwana omoisia o gatano na rimo.
swahili: Lea akapata mimba tena akamzalia Yakobo mwana wa sita.

english: Jacob became angry with Rachel and said, “Am I in the place of God, who has withheld children from you?”
ekegusii: Yakobo akabea Raeli mono, akamobooria: “Inee! Ninche inde ribaga ria Nyasae, oyogotangete tikwaegwa abana?”
swahili: Yakobo akamkasirikia, akamwambia, “Je, mimi ni badala ya Mungu, ambaye amekuzuia usizae watoto?”

english: “God has given me a good gift,” she said. “This time my husband will honor me, because I have borne him six sons.” And she named him Zebulun.
ekegusii: Erio Lea akabora: “Nyasae ong’eire ekeegwa ekiya; bono omosacha one nansike, ekiagera namoiboreire abana abaisia batano nomo.” Ase igo, akamoroka Sabuloni.
swahili: Ndipo Lea aliposema, “Mungu amenizawadia kwa zawadi ya thamani sana. Wakati huu mume wangu ataniheshimu kwa sababu nimemzalia wana sita.” Kwa hiyo akamwita Zabuloni.

english: After that, Leah gave birth to a daughter and named her Dinah. Joseph
ekegusii: Magega yaye akaibora omwana omoiseke, akamoroka Dina.
swahili: Baadaye akamzaa mtoto wa kike akamwita Dina.

english: Then God remembered Rachel. He listened to her and opened her womb,
ekegusii: Korende Nyasae akamoinyora Raeli, akaigwa ogosaba kwaye, na akaigora enda yaye;
swahili: Ndipo Mungu akamkumbuka Raheli, akasikia maombi yake na akafungua tumbo lake.

english: and she conceived and gave birth to a son. “God has taken away my shame,” she said.
ekegusii: ere akaba morito, akaibora omwana omoisia, akabora: “Nyasae onduseirie ogochaywa kwane.”
swahili: Akapata mimba na akamzaa mwana na kusema, “Mungu ameniondolea aibu yangu.”

english: She named him Joseph, and said, “May the LORD add to me another son.” Jacob Prospers
ekegusii: Akaroka omwana oria Yusufu, akabora: “Tiga Omonene karanche amentere omwana onde omoisia.” Yakobo Okogomba na Labani
swahili: Akamwita Yosefu na kusema, “ Bwana na anipe mwana mwingine.” Makundi Ya Yakobo Yaongezeka

english: Now after Rachel had given birth to Joseph, Jacob said to Laban, “Send me on my way so I can return to my homeland.
ekegusii: Ekero Raeli aiboire Yusufu, Yakobo agateebia Labani: “Ing’a ribaga ngende seito, ase ense yane.
swahili: Baada ya Raheli kumzaa Yosefu, Yakobo akamwambia Labani, “Nipe ruhusa nirudi katika nchi yangu.

english: Give me my wives and children for whom I have served you, that I may go on my way. You know how hard I have worked for you.”
ekegusii: Ing’a abakungu baane na abana baane, aba namenyire nkogokorera, ontige ’ngende seito; naki nomanyete emeremo nabeire nkogokorera.”
swahili: Nipe wake zangu na watoto, ambao nimetumika kuwapata, nami niende zangu. Unajua ni kazi kiasi gani ambayo nimekufanyia.”

english: But Laban replied, “If I have found favor in your eyes, please stay. I have learned by divination that the LORD has blessed me because of you.”
ekegusii: Labani akamoiraneria: “Oise kong’anchera nkwane iga, rigereria namanyire boronge ng’a Omonene onsesenirie mono ase engencho yao.
swahili: Lakini Labani akamwambia, “Ikiwa nimepata kibali machoni pako, tafadhali ukae. Nimegundua kwa njia ya uaguzi kwamba Bwana amenibariki kwa sababu yako.”

english: And he added, “Name your wages, and I will pay them.”
ekegusii: Bono nteebia eng’eria yao ey’oganetie, na inche ninkoyee.”
swahili: Akaongeza kumwambia, “Taja ujira wako nami nitakulipa.”

english: Then Jacob answered, “You know how I have served you and how your livestock have thrived under my care.
ekegusii: Yakobo akamoiraneria: “Aye omonyene nomanyete buna nabeire omokoreri oo, na amaicho ao buna abeire ase oborendi bwane.
swahili: Yakobo akamwambia, “Unajua jinsi ambavyo nimekutumikia na jinsi ambavyo wanyama wako walivyolishwa vizuri chini ya uangalizi wangu.

english: Then she said, “Here is my maidservant Bilhah. Sleep with her, that she may bear children for me, so that through her I too can build a family.”
ekegusii: Erio akamoiraneria: “Nimbwate omosomba one omoiseke, Bilia. Motware, erinde inyore abana korwa asare, barokwe abana baane, na goetera asare na inche inyore oroiboro.”
swahili: Ndipo Raheli akamwambia, “Hapa yupo Bilha, mtumishi wangu wa kike. Kutana naye kimwili ili aweze kunizalia watoto na kwa kupitia yeye mimi pia niweze kuwa na uzao.”

english: Indeed, you had very little before my arrival, but now your wealth has increased many times over. The LORD has blessed you wherever I set foot. But now, when may I also provide for my own household?”
ekegusii: Naki enibo yao nigo yareenge enke ritang’ani ekero ntaracha aa, korende bono yamentekanire mono kegima. Omonene ogosesenirie aye, aande onsi ase nabeire nkogenda kogokorera emeremo. Ko bono, inche indi ndabe nkoroisia amang’ana abwone inche omonyene?”
swahili: Kidogo ulichokuwa nacho kabla sijaja kimeongezeka sana, naye Bwana amekubariki popote nilipokuwa. Lakini sasa, ni lini nitashughulikia mambo ya nyumba yangu mwenyewe?”

english: “What can I give you?” Laban asked. “You do not need to give me anything,” Jacob replied. “If you do this one thing for me, I will keep on shepherding and keeping your flocks.
ekegusii: Labani akamobooria: “Ninki ndakoe rende?” Yakobo akamoiraneria: “Tinganeti ong’e kende. Oise gonkorera ring’ana eri ndagoteebie rioka, rirorio naende ningenderere korisia amaicho ao, na koyarenda.
swahili: Labani akamuuliza, “Nikupe nini?” Yakobo akamjibu, “Usinipe chochote lakini kama utanifanyia jambo hili moja, nitaendelea kuchunga na kuyaangalia makundi yako.

english: Let me go through all your flocks today and remove from them every speckled or spotted sheep, every dark-colored lamb, and every spotted or speckled goat. These will be my wages.
ekegusii: Tiga ng’ete reero ase amaicho ao onsi, ndusie korwao kera eng’ondi emechege na egesembe, na emaanwa y’eng’ondi emwamu, na kera embori nyankororo na nyankanga. Erinde echio nachio chirabe eng’eria yane.
swahili: Niruhusu nipite katika makundi yako yote leo niondoe humo kila kondoo mwenye mabakabaka au madoadoa, kila mwana-kondoo mweusi na kila mbuzi mwenye madoadoa au mabakabaka. Hawa watakuwa ujira wangu.

english: So my honesty will testify for me when you come to check on my wages in the future. If I have any goats that are not speckled or spotted, or any lambs that are not dark-colored, they will be considered stolen.”
ekegusii: Ase igo, amatuko agochia bosio, ekero orache korora eng’eria yane, oboronge bwane nabombeere kirori. Kera embori etari nyankanga gose nyankororo, na kera emaanwa y’eng’ondi etari emwamu, onye ekonyorekana ase ’nde, oyebare ng’a eyio nigo eibire.”
swahili: Uadilifu wangu utanishuhudia siku zijazo, kila utakapochunguza ujira ambao umenilipa mimi. Mbuzi yeyote wangu ambaye hana mabakabaka wala madoadoa, au mwana-kondoo ambaye si mweusi, atahesabika ameibwa.”

english: “Agreed,” said Laban. “Let it be as you have said.”
ekegusii: Labani agancha amang’ana ayio, agateeba: “Tiga abe buna gwateebire.”
swahili: Labani akasema, “Ninakubali na iwe kama ulivyosema.”

english: That very day Laban removed all the streaked or spotted male goats and every speckled or spotted female goat—every one that had any white on it—and every dark-colored lamb, and he placed them under the care of his sons.
ekegusii: Ase rituko erio erio Labani akarusia chigoree chiimarera ne chinkororo, ne chimbori chiaberi, echiare nyankanga ne chire nyankororo, na kera eyare nebimoa ebirabu ase omobere oye, na kera eng’ondi eyare emwamu. Echio chionsi agachia abana baye abamura bachirende.
swahili: Siku ile ile Yakobo akawaondoa beberu wote waliokuwa na mistari au madoadoa na mbuzi wake wote waliokuwa na mistari au madoadoa (wote waliokuwa na alama nyeupe juu yao) na wana-kondoo weusi wote, akawaweka chini ya uangalizi wa wanawe.

english: Then he put a three-day journey between himself and Jacob, while Jacob was shepherding the rest of Laban’s flocks.
ekegusii: Erio ageatanana korwa ase Yakobo oboare bw’orogendo rw’amatuko atato; na Yakobo agatigara okorisia riicho ria Labani eriatigarete.
swahili: Kisha Labani akamwacha Yakobo kwa mwendo wa safari ya siku tatu kati yake na Yakobo, wakati Yakobo akiendelea kuchunga lile kundi la Labani lililobaki.

english: Jacob, however, took fresh branches of poplar, almond, and plane trees, and peeled the bark, exposing the white inner wood of the branches.
ekegusii: Yakobo agatwa ebite ebibese biomopopla akabisata chinsemo, erinde emeng’ororia emerabu ekarorekana ase ebite biria.
swahili: Hata hivyo, Yakobo, akachukua fito mbichi zilizokatwa wakati huo huo za miti ya mlubna, mlozi na mwaramoni akazibambua ili mistari myeupe ionekane katika fito hizo.

english: Then he set the peeled branches in the watering troughs in front of the flocks coming in to drink. So when the flocks were in heat and came to drink,
ekegusii: Erio akabeeka ebite biria ase chintuba chi’amaache ase amaicho are gocha konywera. Na ekiagera ching’iti chiria chiare koa chiaberi amarieme, ekero chigocha konywa amaache,
swahili: Kisha akaweka fito alizozibambua kwenye mabirika yote ya kunyweshea mifugo, ili ziwe mbele ya makundi walipokuja kunywa maji. Wanyama walipokuja kunywa maji, hali wakiwa wanahitaji mbegu,

english: they mated in front of the branches. And they bore young that were streaked or speckled or spotted.
ekegusii: chirochio chikanyora amarieme bosio bw’ebite ebio, chikabiara chimanwa chire chimarera, ne chinkanga, ne chire nyankororo.
swahili: wakapandwa hizo fito zikiwa mbele yao. Wanyama waliopata mimba mbele ya hizo fito walizaa wanyama wenye mistari, madoadoa na mabakabaka.

english: So Rachel gave Jacob her servant Bilhah as a wife, and he slept with her,
ekegusii: Naboigo Yakobo akaegwa Bilia, omosomba omoiseke o Raeli, abe mokaye, na Yakobo akaba nere.
swahili: Hivyo Raheli akampa Yakobo Bilha awe mke wake. Yakobo akakutana naye kimwili,

english: Jacob set apart the young, but made the rest face the streaked dark-colored sheep in Laban’s flocks. Then he set his own stock apart and did not put them with Laban’s animals.
ekegusii: Na Yakobo agaatanana ching’ondi chimingichi, ne ching’ondi chiaberi agachisang’anania ne chimingichi chie riicho ria Labani echiareenge namagwari, na echiare chimwamu. Naboigo akenyorera amaicho aye ere omonyene, ayio atabegete amo naya Labani.
swahili: Yakobo akawatenga wadogo wa kundi peke yao, lakini akazielekeza nyuso za hao waliobaki kwenye wale wenye mistari na weusi waliokuwa mali ya Labani. Hivyo akatenga makundi yake mwenyewe, na wala hakuwachanganya na wanyama wa Labani.

english: Whenever the stronger females of the flock were in heat, Jacob would place the branches in the troughs, in full view of the animals, so that they would breed in front of the branches.
ekegusii: Kero kende gionsi chimbori gose ching’ondi echiare ne chinguru gochiaganirie amarieme, Yakobo nigo are kobeeka ebite biria bosio bwe ching’iti ase chintuba chiria chinyare konyora amarieme gochikorigereria ebite ebio.
swahili: Kila mara wanyama wenye nguvu walipohitaji mbegu, Yakobo aliweka zile fito kwenye mabirika mbele ya hao wanyama, ili wapandwe karibu na hizo fito,

english: But if the animals were weak, he did not set out the branches. So the weaker animals went to Laban and the stronger ones to Jacob.
ekegusii: Korende echiare chinyoro tare gochibekera ebite ebio. Ase igo, echiare chinyoro nigo chiare koba echia Labani, na echiare ne chinguru chiba echia Yakobo.
swahili: lakini ikiwa wanyama walikuwa wadhaifu hakuziweka hizo fito. Hivyo wanyama wadhaifu wakawa wa Labani, na wanyama wenye nguvu wakawa wa Yakobo.

english: Thus Jacob became exceedingly prosperous. He owned large flocks, maidservants and menservants, and camels and donkeys.
ekegusii: Ase igo, Yakobo akaba okomenteka koba omotenenku, akaba namaicho amange, na abasomba, abaiseke na abamura, ne chingamia, ne chitigere.
swahili: Kwa njia hii Yakobo akastawi sana, tena akawa na makundi makubwa, watumishi wa kike na wa kiume na ngamia na punda.

english: and Bilhah conceived and bore him a son.
ekegusii: Bilia akaba morito, akaiborera Yakobo omwana omoisia.
swahili: Bilha akapata mimba, naye akamzalia Yakobo mwana.

english: Then Rachel said, “God has vindicated me; He has heard my plea and given me a son.” So she named him Dan.
ekegusii: Erio Raeli akabora: “Nyasae ong’eire oboronge bwane, amaene, oigure ekerero kiane, ong’eire omwana omoisia.” Ase ayio akamoroka Dani.
swahili: Ndipo Raheli akasema, “Mungu amenipa haki yangu, amesikiliza maombi yangu na kunipa mwana.” Kwa sababu hiyo akamwita Dani.

english: And Rachel’s servant Bilhah conceived again and bore Jacob a second son.
ekegusii: Bilia, omosomba o Raeli, akaba morito naende, akaiborera Yakobo omwana omoisia o kabere.
swahili: Bilha mtumishi wa kike wa Raheli akapata mimba tena, akamzalia Yakobo mwana wa pili.

english: Then Rachel said, “In my great struggles, I have wrestled with my sister and won.” So she named him Naphtali. Gad and Asher
ekegusii: Raeli akabora: “Ase okoamererania okonene namenyire nkoamererania na mosubati ominto, nabuire.” Ase igo, akamoroka Nafutali.
swahili: Ndipo Raheli akasema, “Nilikuwa na mashindano makubwa na ndugu yangu, nami nimeshinda.” Kwa hiyo akamwita Naftali.

english: When Leah saw that she had stopped having children, she gave her servant Zilpah to Jacob as a wife.
ekegusii: Ekero Lea achia korora ng’a Bilia okoorire koibora abana, akaimokia Silpa, omosomba oye omoiseke, akamomoa Yakobo, abe mokaye.
swahili: Lea alipoona kuwa amekoma kuzaa watoto, alimchukua mtumishi wake wa kike Zilpa, naye akampa Yakobo awe mke wake.

english: Now Jacob heard that Laban’s sons were saying, “Jacob has taken away all that belonged to our father and built all this wealth at our father’s expense.”
ekegusii: Bono basinto ba Labani bakaigwekana kwemurungania bagoteeba ng’a: “Yakobo oirire enibo yonsi ya tata; na ase enibo eyio bwenyoreire obotenenku obwo bwonsi abwate.”
swahili: Yakobo akawasikia wana wa Labani wakisema, “Yakobo amechukua kila kitu kilichokuwa cha baba yetu naye amepata utajiri huu wote kutokana na vile vilivyokuwa mali ya baba yetu.”

english: When the flocks were breeding, I saw in a dream that the streaked, spotted, and speckled males were mating with the females.
ekegusii: “Ase engaki eria amaicho gachiire rieme nkarigereria, nkarora ase chindoto ng’a chigoree echiaete amaicho amarieme nigo chiare namagwari na ebisembe, ne chimechege.
swahili: “Wakati fulani majira ya kuzaliana niliota ndoto ambayo niliinua macho na kuona kwamba wale mabeberu waliokuwa wakipanda kundi walikuwa wa mistari, madoadoa na mabakabaka.

english: In that dream the angel of God said to me, ‘Jacob!’ And I replied, ‘Here I am.’
ekegusii: Erio omomalaika o Nyasae akandangeria ase chindoto: Yakobo! Nainche ngaitaba: ‘Nao inde aa!’”
swahili: Malaika wa Mungu akaniambia katika ndoto, ‘Yakobo.’ Nikamjibu, ‘Mimi hapa.’

english: ‘Look up,’ he said, ‘and see that all the males that are mating with the flock are streaked, spotted, or speckled; for I have seen all that Laban has done to you.
ekegusii: Aganteebia: “Imokereria amaiso ao igoro, origererie orore, ng’a chigoree echiaete amaicho amarieme nigo chiare namagwari, na ebisembe, ne chimechege, naki narorire onsi aya Labani abeire okogokorera.
