swahili: Akasema, ‘Inua macho yako uone wale mabeberu wote wanaopanda kundi wana mistari, madoadoa au mabakabaka, kwa maana nimeona yale yote ambayo Labani amekuwa akikutendea.

english: I am the God of Bethel, where you anointed the pillar and made a solemn vow to Me. Now get up and leave this land at once, and return to your native land.’”
ekegusii: Inche ninche Nyasae oria kwarooche aria Beteli, aria ase kwaumorerete rigena amaguta rikaba esiiro y’ekeinyorio, na okandiera eira. Bono imoka korwa ase ense eye, oirane gochia ase ense eria kwaiboreretwe.”
swahili: Mimi ndiye Mungu wa Betheli, ulikomiminia ile nguzo mafuta na pale mahali uliponiwekea nadhiri. Sasa ondoka katika nchi hii mara moja urudi katika nchi uliyozaliwa.’ ”

english: And Rachel and Leah replied, “Do we have any portion or inheritance left in our father’s house?
ekegusii: Erio Raeli na Lea bakamoiraneria: “Inee! Ntwe ntori na egetari gose omwando ase omochie o tata?
swahili: Ndipo Raheli na Lea wakajibu, “Je bado tu tunalo fungu lolote katika urithi wa nyumba ya baba yetu?

english: Are we not regarded by him as outsiders? Not only has he sold us, but he has certainly squandered what was paid for us.
ekegusii: Tatokorete buna abamenyi? Naki nigo atoonetie, naende akaria enibo eria yonsi.
swahili: Je, yeye hatuhesabu sisi kama wageni? Sio kwamba ametuuza tu, bali ametumia hata na vile vilivyolipwa kwa ajili yetu.

english: Surely all the wealth that God has taken away from our father belongs to us and to our children. So do whatever God has told you.”
ekegusii: Naki enibo eyio yonsi Nyasae arusirie korwa ase tata nigo etotungetie intwe na abana baito. Ase igo, ayio onsi Nyasae agoteebirie, yakore.”
swahili: Hakika utajiri wote ambao Mungu ameuchukua kutoka kwa baba yetu ni mali yetu na watoto wetu. Hivyo fanya lolote lile Mungu alilokuambia.”

english: Then Jacob got up and put his children and his wives on camels,
ekegusii: Ase igo, Yakobo akaimoka, akariinia abana baye na abakungu baye ase chingamia igoro;
swahili: Ndipo Yakobo akawapandisha watoto wake na wake zake juu ya ngamia,

english: and he drove all his livestock before him, along with all the possessions he had acquired in Paddan-aram, to go to his father Isaac in the land in Canaan.
ekegusii: akaira amaicho aye onsi, na enibo yaye yonsi eyio anyorete ase Padan-Aramu, erio akagenda ase ense ya Kaanani o Isaka ise.
swahili: naye akawaswaga wanyama wote mbele yake pamoja na vitu vyote alivyokuwa amechuma huko Padan-Aramu kwenda kwa baba yake Isaki katika nchi ya Kanaani.

english: Now while Laban was out shearing his sheep, Rachel stole her father’s household idols.
ekegusii: Ekero Labani konya achiire konacha ching’ondi chiaye amarionya, Raeli akaiba ebinyasae biaye bi’ogosasiimwa, ebiareenge nyomba mwaye.
swahili: Labani alipokuwa amekwenda kukata kondoo wake manyoya, Raheli aliiba miungu ya nyumba ya baba yake.

english: And Jacob saw from the countenance of Laban that his attitude toward him had changed.
ekegusii: Yakobo akanyora ng’a Labani oonchokire, tamorigereretie buya buna botambe.
swahili: Yakobo akatambua kwamba moyo wa Labani kwake haukuwa kama ulivyokuwa mwanzo.

english: Moreover, Jacob deceived Laban the Aramean by not telling him that he was running away.
ekegusii: Yakobo nigo agendete bobisi korwa o Labani Omoaramu, tamoteebetie ng’a nkogenda are sobo.
swahili: Zaidi ya hayo, Yakobo alimdanganya Labani Mwaramu kwa kutokumwambia kwamba anakimbia.

english: So he fled with all his possessions, crossed the Euphrates, and headed for the hill country of Gilead. Laban Pursues Jacob
ekegusii: Agatama amo nenibo yaye yonsi eye abwate, akaamboka orooche roria rware korokwa Eufarati, akagenda gochia ebitunwa bia Gileadi. Labani okobwatia Yakobo
swahili: Hivyo akakimbia pamoja na vitu vyote alivyokuwa navyo na kuvuka Mto Frati akaelekea nchi ya vilima katika Gileadi. Labani Amfuatilia Yakobo

english: On the third day Laban was informed that Jacob had fled.
ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatato Labani agateebigwa ng’a Yakobo otamire.
swahili: Siku ya tatu Labani akaambiwa kwamba Yakobo amekimbia.

english: So he took his relatives with him, pursued Jacob for seven days, and overtook him in the hill country of Gilead.
ekegusii: Erio Labani akaira abamwabo, bakamobwatia ase orogendo rw’amatuko atano na abere, akamoikeera ase ebitunwa bia Gileadi.
swahili: Akiwachukua jamaa zake, akamfuatia Yakobo kwa siku saba na kumkuta kwenye nchi ya vilima katika Gileadi.

english: But that night God came to Laban the Aramean in a dream and warned him, “Be careful not to say anything to Jacob, either good or bad.”
ekegusii: Korende Nyasae agaachera Labani Omoaramu ase chindoto botuko, akamoteebia: “Bwerende, tobaisa kwomania Yakobo, korende okwane nere ase obwororo.”
swahili: Ndipo Mungu akamjia Labani Mwaramu katika ndoto usiku na kumwambia, “Jihadhari usiseme neno lolote kwa Yakobo, liwe zuri au baya.”

english: Now Jacob had pitched his tent in the hill country of Gilead when Laban overtook him, and Laban and his relatives camped there as well.
ekegusii: Ekero Labani aikeereire Yakobo, Yakobo nere konya otenenirie eema yaye agwo ase ebitunwa bia Gileadi. Labani nere amo nabamwabo bagatenenia chiema chiabo agwo.
swahili: Yakobo alikuwa amepiga hema lake katika nchi ya vilima katika Gileadi wakati Labani alipomkuta, Labani na jamaa yake wakapiga kambi huko pia.

english: Then Laban said to Jacob, “What have you done? You have deceived me and carried off my daughters like captives of war!
ekegusii: Labani akabooria Yakobo: “Inki eke gwakorire iga? Ninki okong’ainera, na koira abana baane abasubati buna abasakorwa korwa ase esegi?
swahili: Ndipo Labani akamwambia Yakobo, “Umefanya nini? Umenidanganya na umewachukua binti zangu kama mateka katika vita.

english: Why did you run away secretly and deceive me, without even telling me? I would have sent you away with joy and singing, with tambourines and harps.
ekegusii: Nase ki gwatamete okeiberia, tigwanteebia? Inche anga nagokoobete nomochengo na amatera, na kobugia chikonu na amakano.
swahili: Kwa nini ulikimbia kwa siri na kunidanganya? Kwa nini hukuniambia ili nikuage kwa furaha na nyimbo za matari na vinubi?

english: But you did not even let me kiss my grandchildren and my daughters goodbye. Now you have done a foolish thing.
ekegusii: Naki otantigerete ribaga inyunyunte abachokoro baane na abana baane abasubati, mbaganerie amaya ase orogendo rwabo? Amaene, aye nigo gwankorerete egento ki’oboriri.
swahili: Hata hukuniruhusu niwabusu wajukuu zangu na kuwaaga binti zangu. Umefanya kitu cha kipumbavu.

english: I have power to do you great harm, but last night the God of your father said to me, ‘Be careful not to say anything to Jacob, either good or bad.’
ekegusii: Ninde nokobua gw’okogokorera amabe, korende Nyasae o iso nakwanete nainche ase obotuko bwaetete, agankurera aganteebia: Bwerende, tobaisa kwomania Yakobo, korende okwane nere ase obwororo.
swahili: Nina uwezo wa kukudhuru, lakini usiku uliopita Mungu wa baba yako alisema nami, akaniambia, ‘Jihadhari, usiseme neno lolote kwa Yakobo liwe zuri au baya.’

english: Then the LORD said to Jacob, “Go back to the land of your fathers and to your kindred, and I will be with you.”
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene agakwana na Yakobo, akamoteebia: “Irana gochia ase ense ye chisokoro chiao, ase eamate yao, na inche nimbe amo naye.”
swahili: Ndipo Bwana akamwambia Yakobo, “Rudi katika nchi ya baba zako na kwa watu wako, nami nitakuwa pamoja nawe.”

english: Now you have gone off because you long for your father’s house. But why have you stolen my gods?”
ekegusii: Na bono gwachiire, ekiagera ore namaiga amange ay’abaanto banka seino, korende naki gwakorete okaiba emegwekano y’enyasae yane?”
swahili: Sasa umeondoka kwa sababu umetamani kurudi nyumbani kwa baba yako. Lakini kwa nini umeiba miungu yangu?”

english: “I was afraid,” Jacob answered, “for I thought you would take your daughters from me by force.
ekegusii: Yakobo akamoiraneria, akamoteebia: “Nigo noboete, nkarengereria ng’a nobaise kong’ura abana bao abasubati.
swahili: Yakobo akamjibu Labani, “Niliogopa, kwa sababu nilifikiri ungeweza kuninyangʼanya binti zako kwa nguvu.

english: If you find your gods with anyone here, he shall not live! In the presence of our relatives, see for yourself if anything is yours, and take it back.” For Jacob did not know that Rachel had stolen the idols.
ekegusii: Onde bwensi oranyore obwate ebinyasae biao goika aitwe akwe. Tiga abaminto aba bare aa babe kirori. Rigia! Koranyore kende kiao kere ase ’nde, okeire.” Yakobo tamanyete ng’a Raeli obiibire.
swahili: Lakini kama ukimkuta yeyote aliye na miungu yako, hataishi. Mbele ya jamaa yetu, angalia mwenyewe uone kama kuna chochote chako hapa nilicho nacho, kama kipo, kichukue.” Basi Yakobo hakujua kwamba Raheli alikuwa ameiba hiyo miungu.

english: So Laban went into Jacob’s tent, then Leah’s tent, and then the tents of the two maidservants, but he found nothing. Then he left Leah’s tent and entered Rachel’s tent.
ekegusii: Erio Labani agasoa eema ya Yakobo, na eya Lea, na ey’abakungu baria babere abasomba, tanyora kende. Agasoka korwa ase eema ya Lea, agasoa eya Raeli.
swahili: Kwa hiyo Labani akaingia ndani ya hema la Yakobo na ndani ya hema la Lea na ndani ya hema la watumishi wawili wa kike, lakini hakukuta chochote. Baadaye alipotoka katika hema la Lea, akaingia hema la Raheli.

english: Now Rachel had taken Laban’s household idols, put them in the saddlebag of her camel, and was sitting on them. And Laban searched everything in the tent but found nothing.
ekegusii: Korende Raeli konya obisire ebinyasae ebio ase egeikaransero kiaye igoro y’engamia, akaba obiikaranserete. Labani akariga‐rigia eema ime, tabinyora.
swahili: Basi Raheli ndiye alikuwa amechukua ile miungu ya nyumbani kwao na kuiweka katika matandiko ya ngamia na kukalia. Labani akatafuta kila mahali kwenye hema lakini hakupata chochote.

english: Rachel said to her father, “Sir, do not be angry that I cannot stand up before you; for I am having my period.” So Laban searched, but could not find the household idols.
ekegusii: Raeli agateebia ise: “Tata, onyabere, tobaisa kombea, naki tinkonyara koimoka ase obosio bwao, ekiagera nimbwate engencho yaito intwe abakungu.” Nabo akariga‐rigia, korende tanyora chinyasae chiaye.
swahili: Raheli akamwambia baba yake, “Usikasirike, bwana wangu kwa kuwa siwezi kusimama ukiwepo, niko katika hedhi.” Labani akatafuta lakini hakuweza kuipata miungu ya nyumbani kwake.

english: Then Jacob became incensed and challenged Laban. “What is my crime?” he said. “For what sin of mine have you so hotly pursued me?
ekegusii: Erio Yakobo akabea mono, akomania Labani ase okomotogonyera na goteeba: “Nkomocha ki nakorire? Nebibe biane nakorire mbiribi, goika kwagerire nabeire nobororo engencho enga eye?
swahili: Yakobo akakasirika na kumshutumu Labani, akisema, “Uhalifu wangu ni nini?” Akamuuliza Labani, “Ni dhambi gani niliyofanya hata unaniwinda?

english: You have searched all my goods! Have you found anything that belongs to you? Put it here before my brothers and yours, that they may judge between the two of us.
ekegusii: Kwariga‐rigirie ase ebinto bionsi. Ngento ki kiao kwanyorao narentanire? Kebeke aiga ase obosio bw’abaminto na obw’abamino, batwatanane inche naye.
swahili: Sasa kwa kuwa umepekua vitu vyangu vyote umepata nini kilicho cha nyumbani mwako? Kiweke hapa mbele ya jamaa yako na yangu, nao waamue kati yetu sisi wawili.

english: I have been with you for twenty years now. Your sheep and goats have not miscarried, nor have I eaten the rams of your flock.
ekegusii: Bono inche namenyire bwoo emiaka emerongo ebere. Ching’ondi chiao gose chimbori, ekero chianga amarieme, ende terekereti; gose inche tinyenyeti chimingichi chinde chie riicho riao, na gochiria.
swahili: “Mpaka sasa nimekuwa pamoja nawe miaka ishirini. Kondoo wako na mbuzi wako hawajaharibu mimba, wala sijala kondoo dume kutoka makundi yako.

english: I did not bring you anything torn by wild beasts; I bore the loss myself. And you demanded payment from me for what was stolen by day or night.
ekegusii: Echiaitetwe ne chinyang’au tingochirentereti, ninche omonyene nachiakanete. Echiaibetwe mobaso gose botuko ogachinsaba korwa ase amaboko aane.
swahili: Sikukuletea mfugo aliyeraruliwa na wanyama pori, nilibeba hasara mimi mwenyewe. Tena ulinidai malipo kwa chochote kilichoibwa mchana au usiku.

english: So Jacob sent word and called Rachel and Leah to the field where his flocks were,
ekegusii: Ase igo, Yakobo akagania Raeli na Lea barangerigwe, erio Raeli na Lea bakagenda getii ase Yakobo areenge korisia amaicho aye.
swahili: Hivyo Yakobo akatuma ujumbe kwa Raheli na Lea waje machungani yalikokuwa makundi yake.

english: As it was, the heat consumed me by day and the frost by night, and sleep fled from my eyes.
ekegusii: Eye nero yareenge engencho yane: Riberera ri’omobaso boira rikaba rigonsamba, na obokendu boganchanda botuko, ne chitoro chikaera korwa ase amaiso aane.
swahili: Hii ndiyo iliyokuwa hali yangu: Niliumia kwa joto la mchana na baridi usiku, pia usingizi ulinipa.

english: Thus for twenty years I have served in your household—fourteen years for your two daughters and six years for your flocks—and you have changed my wages ten times!
ekegusii: Emiaka eye emerongo ebere imenyete bwoo, nabeire nkogokorera emiaka ikomi na ene ase okonyora abaiseke bao babere, na emiaka etano nomo ase okonyora amaicho ao, na aye kwabeire gokoonchora eng’eria yane ara ikomi.
swahili: Ilikuwa hivi kwa miaka ile ishirini niliyokuwa nyumbani kwako. Nilikutumikia miaka ile kumi na minne kwa ajili ya binti zako wawili, miaka sita kwa ajili ya makundi yako, nawe ulibadilisha ujira wangu mara kumi.

english: If the God of my father, the God of Abraham and the Fear of Isaac, had not been with me, surely by now you would have sent me away empty-handed. But God has seen my affliction and the toil of my hands, and last night He rendered judgment.” Jacob’s Covenant with Laban
ekegusii: Onye Nyasae o tata, Nyasae o Aburaamu, Nyasae oyio Isaka airogete ataarenge amo nainche, amaene, nanga nigo gwanseria bono inde namaboko amasa. Emechando na emeremo yane Nyasae oyerorire, Ase igo ere nagotogonyerete obotuko bwaetete.” Yakobo na Labani bagokora okobwatana
swahili: Kama Mungu wa baba yangu, Mungu wa Abrahamu na Hofu ya Isaki, hakuwa pamoja nami, hakika ungenifukuza mikono mitupu. Lakini Mungu ameona taabu yangu na kazi ngumu ya mikono yangu, naye usiku uliopita amekukemea.”

english: But Laban answered Jacob, “These daughters are my daughters, these sons are my sons, and these flocks are my flocks! Everything you see is mine! Yet what can I do today about these daughters of mine or the children they have borne?
ekegusii: Labani akairaneria Yakobo, akamoteebia: “Abasubati aba nabana baane, na abana babo nabarabwo nabana baane, na amaicho aya, naro nayaane, na bionsi ebio orooche nebiane. Bono ninki ndanyare gokorera abana baane na abana babo baiboire?
swahili: Labani akamjibu Yakobo, “Wanawake hawa ni binti zangu, watoto hawa ni watoto wangu na makundi haya ni makundi yangu. Vyote unavyoviona ni vyangu. Lakini hata hivyo ninaweza kufanya nini kuhusu hawa binti zangu, au kuhusu watoto waliowazaa?

english: Come now, let us make a covenant, you and I, and let it serve as a witness between you and me.”
ekegusii: Inchuo bono, tokore okobwatana, aye nainche, na korokwo inakobe kirori egati yao nainche.”
swahili: Njoo sasa na tufanye agano, wewe na mimi, na liwe kama shahidi kati yetu.”

english: So Jacob picked out a stone and set it up as a pillar,
ekegusii: Erio Yakobo akaimokia rigena, akaritenenia ribe esiiro y’ekeinyorio.
swahili: Hivyo Yakobo akachukua jiwe, akalisimamisha kama nguzo.

english: and he said to his relatives, “Gather some stones.” So they took stones and made a mound, and there by the mound they ate.
ekegusii: Yakobo agateebia abamwabo: “Sangereria amagena”, na barabwo bakayasangereria, bakayakora etui, bakariera endagera ase etui eyio.
swahili: Akawaambia jamaa yake, “Kusanyeni mawe.” Hivyo wakachukua mawe na kuyakusanya yakawa lundo, wakala chakula hapo karibu na hilo lundo.

english: Laban called it Jegar-sahadutha, and Jacob called it Galeed.
ekegusii: Labani akayeroka Yegari‐Sahaduta, korende Yakobo akayeroka Galeedi.
swahili: Labani akaliita Yegar-Sahadutha na Yakobo akaliita Galeedi.

english: Then Laban declared, “This mound is a witness between you and me this day.” Therefore the place was called Galeed.
ekegusii: Labani akabora: “Etui eye nero kirori egati yane naye reero iga.” Ase ayio akayeroka Galeedi.
swahili: Labani akasema, “Lundo hili ni shahidi kati yako na mimi leo.” Ndiyo maana likaitwa Galeedi.

english: It was also called Mizpah, because Laban said, “May the LORD keep watch between you and me when we are absent from each other.
ekegusii: Naende ekarokwa Misipa, naki nigo ateebete: “Omonene nere orabe ogotorigereria aye nainche, ekero torabe totarochaini.
swahili: Pia liliitwa Mispa, kwa sababu alisema, “ Bwana na aweke ulinzi kati yako na mimi wakati kila mmoja akiwa mbali na mwingine.

english: and he told them, “I can see from your father’s countenance that his attitude toward me has changed; but the God of my father has been with me.
ekegusii: Agwo Yakobo akabateebia: “Narorire ng’a iso tari kondigereria buya reero buna botambe. Korende Nyasae o tata nigo are amo nainche.
swahili: Akawaambia, “Naona moyo wa baba yenu kwangu sivyo kama ulivyokuwa mwanzoni, lakini Mungu wa baba yangu amekuwa pamoja nami.

english: If you mistreat my daughters or take other wives, although no one is with us, remember that God is a witness between you and me.”
ekegusii: Korabe gokobachanda abana baane abasubati, gose gokonyuoma abakungu bande abaao goetania barabwo, manya ng’a nonya monto onde taiyo oyarooche, rora, Nyasae nere kirori egati yao nainche.”
swahili: Kama ukiwatenda mabaya binti zangu au ukioa wake wengine zaidi ya binti zangu, hata ingawa hakuna hata mmoja aliye pamoja nasi, kumbuka kwamba Mungu ni shahidi kati yako na mimi.”

english: Laban also said to Jacob, “Here is the mound, and here is the pillar I have set up between you and me.
ekegusii: Erio Labani agateebia Yakobo: “Rigereria etui eye na esiiro eye, natenenirie egati yao nainche.
swahili: Pia Labani akamwambia Yakobo, “Hili ndilo lundo, na hii ndiyo nguzo niliyoisimamisha kati yako na mimi.

english: This mound is a witness, and this pillar is a witness, that I will not go past this mound to harm you, and you will not go past this mound and pillar to harm me.
ekegusii: Etui eye ebe kirori, na esiiro eye ebe kirori boigo, ng’a tingotamboka etui eye inchiche bwoo, gose aye togoetania etui eye na esiiro eye ochiche bwone, tokorerane amabe.
swahili: Lundo hili ni shahidi na nguzo hii ni shahidi, kwamba sitavuka lundo hili kuja upande wako kukudhuru, nawe kwamba hutavuka lundo hili na nguzo hii kuja upande wangu kunidhuru.

english: May the God of Abraham and the God of Nahor, the God of their father, judge between us.” So Jacob swore by the Fear of his father Isaac.
ekegusii: Nyasae o Aburaamu, Nyasae o Nahori, oyorenge Nyasae o ise obo, agambe ase egati yaito.” Ase igo, Yakobo agatiana ase Oyio Isaka ise airogete.
swahili: Mungu wa Abrahamu na Mungu wa Nahori, Mungu wa baba zao, aamue kati yetu.” Hivyo Yakobo akaapa kwa jina la Hofu ya baba yake Isaki.

english: Then Jacob offered a sacrifice on the mountain and invited his relatives to eat a meal. And after they had eaten, they spent the night on the mountain.
ekegusii: Yakobo akarua ekeng’wanso agwo ase egetunwa, akarangeria abanto baye bache koragera amo nere, bakaba aroro ase egetunwa obotuko obwo bwonsi.
swahili: Yakobo akatoa dhabihu juu ya kilima na akawaalika jamaa zake kula chakula. Baada ya kula, wakalala huko.

english: Early the next morning, Laban got up and kissed his grandchildren and daughters and blessed them. Then he left to return home.
ekegusii: Mambia chuni Labani akaimoka, akaagata abachokoro baye na abana baye abasubati, akabasesenia; erio akairana gocha bwoye.
swahili: Kesho yake asubuhi na mapema, Labani akawabusu wajukuu zake, binti zake na kuwabariki. Kisha akaondoka, akarudi nyumbani.

english: You know that I have served your father with all my strength.
ekegusii: Inwe ’momanyete ng’a nabeire ngokorera iso ne chinguru chiane chionsi;
swahili: Mnajua kwamba nimemtumikia baba yenu kwa nguvu zangu zote,

english: And although he has cheated me and changed my wages ten times, God has not allowed him to harm me.
ekegusii: nonya nabo, iso obeire okong’ainereria, na koonchora eng’eria yane ara ikomi, korende Nyasae tamoete ribaga gonkorera bobe.
swahili: hata hivyo baba yenu amenidanganya kwa kubadilisha ujira wangu mara kumi. Hata hivyo, Mungu hakumruhusu kunidhuru.

english: If he said, ‘The speckled will be your wages,’ then the whole flock bore speckled offspring. If he said, ‘The streaked will be your wages,’ then the whole flock bore streaked offspring.
ekegusii: Onye otebeete: ‘Echire nebisembe echio nachio chirabe eng’eria yao, amaicho onsi akabiara echire nebisembe, na ekero atebeete.’ Echire namagwari nachio echio chirabe eng’eria yao, amaicho onsi akabiara echire namagwari.
swahili: Kama alisema, ‘Wenye madoadoa watakuwa ujira wako,’ basi makundi yote yalizaa wenye madoadoa, kama alisema, ‘Wenye mistari watakuwa ujira wako,’ basi makundi yote yalizaa wenye mistari.

english: Thus God has taken away your father’s livestock and given them to me.
ekegusii: Naboigo Nyasae akarusia etugo ya iso, akayeng’a.”
swahili: Hivyo Mungu amechukua mifugo ya baba yenu na amenipa mimi.

english: Jacob also went on his way, and the angels of God met him.
ekegusii: Yakobo akagenderera norogendo rwaye, bakaumerana nabamalaika ba Nyasae.
swahili: Yakobo pia akaondoka akaenda zake, nao malaika wa Mungu wakakutana naye.

english: I am unworthy of all the kindness and faithfulness You have shown Your servant. Indeed, with only my staff I came across the Jordan, but now I have become two camps.
ekegusii: Inche tingwenereti nonya ng’ake obuya na obwegenwa bwonsi gwankorerete inche, omosomba oo, naki engaki naambogeete orooche rwa Yorodani nigo nabwate enyimbo yoka koboko kwane, na bono nabeire ebiombe bibere.
swahili: mimi sistahili fadhili na uaminifu wako wote ulionitendea mimi mtumishi wako. Nilikuwa na fimbo tu mkononi mwangu nilipovuka mto huu wa Yordani, lakini sasa ninayo makundi mawili.

english: Please deliver me from the hand of my brother Esau, for I am afraid that he may come and attack me and the mothers and children with me.
ekegusii: Koranche ontoorie bono korwa ase okoboko kw’oyominto Esau, ekiagera nairokire ng’a nabaise kong’ita, aite na abakungu na abana.
swahili: Nakuomba, uniokoe na mkono wa ndugu yangu Esau, kwa maana ninaogopa kuwa atakuja kunishambulia, pia mama pamoja na watoto wao.

english: But You have said, ‘I will surely make you prosper, and I will make your offspring like the sand of the sea, too numerous to count.’”
ekegusii: Korende aye ngwanteebetie: Ningokorere amaya, ninkore ororeeria rwao robe buna omokenye o nyancha, otanyare kobareka, ekiagera nomonge.”
swahili: Lakini umeshasema, ‘Hakika nitakufanya ustawi na kuufanya uzao wako kuwa mwingi kama mchanga wa baharini ambao hauwezi kuhesabika!’ ”

english: Jacob spent the night there, and from what he had brought with him, he selected a gift for his brother Esau:
ekegusii: Erio Yakobo akaraara aroro ase obotuko obwo; agachora korwa ase etugo eria abwate, echio aranyare koa Esau omwabo ebiegwa.
swahili: Akalala pale usiku ule, miongoni mwa vitu alivyokuwa navyo, akachagua zawadi kwa ajili ya Esau ndugu yake:

english: 200 female goats, 20 male goats, 200 ewes, 20 rams,
ekegusii: Agachoora chimbori chiaberi amagana abere, ne chigoree emerongo ebere, ne ching’ondi chiaberi amagana abere, ne chimingichi emerongo ebere,
swahili: Mbuzi waume ishirini na mbuzi wake 200, kondoo dume ishirini na kondoo wake 200.

english: 30 milk camels with their young, 40 cows, 10 bulls, 20 female donkeys, and 10 male donkeys.
ekegusii: ne chingamia chiare gokamwa emerongo etato, amo ne chimori chiabo, ne chiombe chiaberi emerongo ene, ne chieeri ikomi, ne chitigere chiaberi emerongo ebere, ne chitigere chinsacha ikomi.
swahili: Ngamia wake thelathini pamoja na ndama zao, ngʼombe wake arobaini na mafahali kumi, punda wake ishirini na punda waume kumi.

english: He entrusted them to his servants in separate herds and told them, “Go on ahead of me, and keep some distance between the herds.”
ekegusii: Akabeeka ching’iti echio ase amaboko ’abasomba baye, kera riicho akaribeeka ao, agateebia abasomba baye: “Eta motang’ane, na egati ya kera riicho motige ribaga.”
swahili: Akaviweka chini ya uangalizi wa watumishi wake, kila kundi peke yake na kuwaambia, “Nitangulieni na kuacha nafasi kati ya makundi.”

english: He instructed the one in the lead, “When my brother Esau meets you and asks, ‘To whom do you belong, where are you going, and whose animals are these before you?’
ekegusii: Agachiika omosomba oria bw’eritang’ani, akamoteebia: “Esau ominto, ekero araumerane naye, na gokoboria: Noyo ng’o ore? Ng’ai ogochia? Etugo eye otang’anetie, neya ng’o?.
swahili: Akamwagiza yule aliyetangulia kuwa, “Ndugu yangu Esau atakapokutana nawe na kukuuliza, ‘Wewe ni wa nani? Unakwenda wapi? Wanyama hawa wote mbele yako ni mali ya nani?’

english: then you are to say, ‘They belong to your servant Jacob. They are a gift, sent to my lord Esau. And behold, Jacob is behind us.’”
ekegusii: Erio omoiranerie, omoteebie: Ney’omosomba oo Yakobo, nekeegwa akorenteire aye omonene one Esau; ere omonyene ngotobwatia are korwa magega,”
swahili: Ndipo utakaposema, ‘Ni mali ya mtumishi wako Yakobo. Ni zawadi ambazo zimetumwa kwa bwana wangu Esau, naye anakuja nyuma yetu.’ ”

english: He also instructed the second, the third, and all those following behind the herds: “When you meet Esau, you are to say the same thing to him.
ekegusii: Agachiika naende oyo o kabere, na oyo o gatato, na abande bonsi abaare gotunyana amaicho, akabateebia: “Moteebie Esau amang’ana ayio ayio ekero mokoumerana nere.
swahili: Akamwagiza pia yule mtumishi wa kundi la pili, la tatu na yale mengine yote yaliyofuata akiwaambia, “Mtamwambia Esau maneno hayo hayo mtakapokutana naye.

english: When Jacob saw them, he said, “This is the camp of God.” So he named that place Mahanaim.
ekegusii: Na ekero Yakobo abarooche akabora: “Oyo nomoganda o Nyasae!” Ase igo, Akaaroka aase aria Mahanaimu.
swahili: Yakobo alipowaona, akasema, “Hii ni kambi ya Mungu!” Kwa hiyo akapaita mahali pale Mahanaimu.

english: You are also to say, ‘Look, your servant Jacob is right behind us.’” For he thought, “I will appease Esau with the gift that is going before me. After that I can face him, and perhaps he will accept me. ”
ekegusii: Naende momoteebie: Omosomba oo Yakobo ngotobwatia are korwa magega.” Ere nigo arengereretie ng’a: “Nimwororobie nebiegwa ebi namotang’aneirie; magega yaye nindore obosio bwaye, aande nanyanchere.”
swahili: Hakikisheni mmesema, ‘Mtumishi wako Yakobo anakuja nyuma yetu.’ ” Kwa kuwa alifikiri, “Nitaweza kumtuliza kwa zawadi hizi ninazotanguliza, hatimaye, nitakapomwona, huenda atanikubali.”

english: So Jacob’s gifts went on before him, while he spent the night in the camp. Jacob Wrestles with God
ekegusii: Naboigo ebiegwa biria bigatang’anigwa gochia bosio bwaye, ere omonyene akaraara obotuko obwo aase aria atenenetie eema yaye. Yakobo ogokinana na Nyasae, naende okorokwa Israeli
swahili: Kwa hiyo zawadi za Yakobo zilitangulia mbele yake, lakini yeye mwenyewe alilala kambini usiku ule. Yakobo Ashindana Mweleka Na Mungu

english: During the night Jacob got up and took his two wives, his two maidservants, and his eleven sons, and crossed the ford of the Jabbok.
ekegusii: Ase obotuko obwo Yakobo akaimoka, akaira abakungu baye babere, na abasomba baye babere abakungu, na abana baye ikomi nomo, akaamboka orooche rwa Yaboki.
swahili: Usiku ule Yakobo akaamka akawachukua wake zake wawili, watumishi wake wawili wa kike na wanawe kumi na mmoja na akavuka kivuko cha Yaboki.

english: He took them and sent them across the stream, along with all his possessions.
ekegusii: Akabaimokia, akabaambokia orooche, akaambokia na bionsi ebi areenge nabio.
swahili: Baada ya kuwavusha ngʼambo ya kijito, alivusha pia mali zake zote.

english: So Jacob was left all alone, and there a man wrestled with him until daybreak.
ekegusii: Yakobo agatigara ere bweka. Erio omonto oyomo agacha bagakinana nere, goika bogakiamoka.
swahili: Kwa hiyo Yakobo akaachwa peke yake na mtu mmoja akashikana naye mweleka mpaka mapambazuko.

english: When the man saw that he could not overpower Jacob, he struck the socket of Jacob’s hip and dislocated it as they wrestled.
ekegusii: Nere omonto oria, ekero arora ng’a tari kobua Yakobo, akamokuna enengo y’ebachwa, akamoteng’eria, kobagendererete gokinana.
swahili: Yule mtu alipoona kuwa hawezi kumshinda, aligusa kiungio cha nyonga ya Yakobo kwa hiyo nyonga yake ikateguka wakati alipokuwa akishikana mweleka na yule mtu.

english: Then the man said, “Let me go, for it is daybreak.” But Jacob replied, “I will not let you go unless you bless me.”
ekegusii: Erio akamoteebia: “Ntige ngende, ekiagera bwakiire.” Korende Yakobo akamoteebia: “Tingokoa ribaga ogende, otaransesenia.”
swahili: Ndipo yule mtu akasema, “Niache niende, kwa kuwa ni mapambazuko.” Lakini Yakobo akajibu, “Sitakuacha uende usiponibariki.”

english: “What is your name?” the man asked. “Jacob,” he replied.
ekegusii: Akamobooria: “Naki okorokwa?” Akamoiraneria: “Yakobo.”
swahili: Yule mtu akamuuliza, “Jina lako nani?” Akajibu, “Yakobo.”

english: Then the man said, “Your name will no longer be Jacob, but Israel, because you have struggled with God and with men, and you have prevailed.”
ekegusii: Erio akamoteebia: “Bono tokorokwa naende Yakobo, nigo orarokwe Israeli, ekiagera mwakinanire na Nyasae na abanto, na aye kwabuire.”
swahili: Ndipo yule mtu akasema, “Jina lako halitakuwa tena Yakobo, bali Israeli, kwa sababu umeshindana na Mungu na watu pia, nawe umeshinda.”

english: And Jacob requested, “Please tell me your name.” But he replied, “Why do you ask my name?” Then he blessed Jacob there.
ekegusii: Yakobo akamobooria: “Koranche, onteebie erieta riao.” Korende akamoteebia: “Nase ki okomboria erieta riane?” Agwo akamosesenia.
swahili: Yakobo akasema, “Tafadhali niambie jina lako.” Lakini akajibu, “Kwa nini kuniuliza Jina langu?” Ndipo akambariki huko.

english: Jacob sent messengers ahead of him to his brother Esau in the land of Seir, the country of Edom.
ekegusii: Yakobo agatoma abatomwa batang’ane kogenda ase Esau momura omwabo, baike ensemo ya Edomu, ase ense y’Edomu.
swahili: Yakobo akatuma wajumbe kumtangulia kwa Esau ndugu yake huko Seiri, katika nchi ya Edomu.

english: So Jacob named the place Peniel, saying, “Indeed, I have seen God face to face, and yet my life was spared.”
ekegusii: Yakobo Akaaroka aase aria Penieli, naki nigo ateebete: “Naroranire na Nyasae obosio ase obosio, na obogima bwane bwatoorigwe.”
swahili: Kwa hiyo Yakobo akapaita mahali pale Penieli, akasema, “Ni kwa sababu nimemwona Mungu uso kwa uso na bado maisha yangu yameokoka.”

english: The sun rose above him as he passed by Penuel, and he was limping because of his hip.
ekegusii: Erioba rikaorokera Yakobo kagoeta Penueli, akaba ogosegora, ekiagera ateng’eretigwe enengo y’ebachwa.
swahili: Jua lilikuwa linachomoza Yakobo alipoondoka Penueli, naye alikuwa akichechemea kwa sababu ya nyonga yake.

english: Therefore to this day the Israelites do not eat the tendon which is at the socket of the hip, because the socket of Jacob’s hip was struck near that tendon.
ekegusii: Ase ayio Abaisraeli tibari koria omoki bw’enengo y’ebachwa goika reero iga, ekiagera omonto oria namoteng’eretie Yakobo omoki bw’enengo y’ebachwa yaye.
swahili: Kwa hiyo mpaka leo Waisraeli hawali mshipa ulioungana na kiungio cha nyonga, kwa sababu kiungio cha nyonga ya Yakobo kiliteguliwa karibu na mshipa huo.

english: He instructed them, “You are to say to my master Esau, ‘Your servant Jacob says: I have been staying with Laban and have remained there until now.
ekegusii: Akabachiika bateebie Esau omonene oye iga: “Aya naro Yakobo, omosomba oo, agokwana: Nabeire nkomenya ase ense y’obogeni, ense ya Labani goika reero iga;
swahili: Akawaagiza akisema: “Hili ndilo mtakalomwambia bwana wangu Esau: ‘Mtumishi wako Yakobo anasema, nimekuwa nikiishi pamoja na Labani na nimekuwako huko mpaka sasa.

english: I have oxen, donkeys, flocks, menservants, and maidservants. I have sent this message to inform my master, so that I may find favor in your sight.’”
ekegusii: nanyorire chiombe, ne chitigere, ne ching’ondi, na abasomba, abamura na abaiseke. Na bono, omonene one, nigo natomire abanto nkomanyie amang’ana ayio, inyoore ogwancherwa ase obosio bwao.”
swahili: Ninao ngʼombe na punda, kondoo na mbuzi, watumishi wa kiume na wa kike. Sasa ninatuma ujumbe huu kwa bwana wangu, ili nipate kibali machoni pako.’ ”

english: When the messengers returned to Jacob, they said, “We went to your brother Esau, and now he is coming to meet you—he and four hundred men with him.”
ekegusii: Abatomwa baria, ekero bairanete ase Yakobo bakamoteebia: “Ntwaika o momura omino Esau, ere ngocha are gokorotota ore nabaanto amagana ane (400).”
swahili: Wajumbe waliporudi kwa Yakobo, wakamwambia, “Tulikwenda kuonana na ndugu yako Esau, naye sasa anakuja kukulaki akifuatana na wanaume 400.”

english: In great fear and distress, Jacob divided his people into two camps, as well as the flocks and herds and camels.
ekegusii: Erio Yakobo akaondoka mono na koumata, agaatanana abanto baria baarenge amo nere, ne ching’ondi, ne chiombe, ne chingamia, bikaba ebiombe bibere,
swahili: Kwa hofu kuu na huzuni, Yakobo akagawanya watu aliokuwa nao katika makundi mawili, pia akagawanya makundi ya kondoo na mbuzi, na vilevile ngʼombe na ngamia.

english: He thought, “If Esau comes and attacks one camp, then the other camp can escape.”
ekegusii: akarengereria ng’a: “Esau karache aumokere ekeombe kie ritang’ani na kogesiria, keria kende nagetooreke.”
swahili: Yakobo alifikiri, “Kama Esau akija na kushambulia kundi moja, kundi lililobaki litaweza likanusurika.”

english: Then Jacob declared, “O God of my father Abraham, God of my father Isaac, the LORD who told me, ‘Go back to your country and to your kindred, and I will make you prosper,’
ekegusii: Erio Yakobo agasaba, akabora: “Aye Nyasae o sokoro yane Aburaamu, Nyasae o Isaka tata, aye Omonene, gwanteebetie ng’a: Oirane gochia seino, na eamate yao, na inche ningokorere amaya.
swahili: Ndipo Yakobo akaomba, “Ee Mungu wa baba yangu Abrahamu, Mungu wa baba yangu Isaki, Ee Bwana, ambaye uliniambia, ‘Rudi katika nchi yako na jamaa yako, nami nitakufanya ustawi,’

english: Now Jacob looked up and saw Esau coming toward him with four hundred men. So he divided the children among Leah, Rachel, and the two maidservants.
ekegusii: Yakobo akaimokereria amaiso aye igoro, akarigereria, akarora Esau ogocha amo nabaanto amagana ane. Erio agaatanana abana, akaa kera omokungu abaye, Lea, na Raeli, na abakungu baria babere abasomba.
swahili: Yakobo akainua macho akamwona Esau akija na watu wake 400, kwa hiyo akawagawanya watoto kati ya Lea, Raheli na wale watumishi wake wawili wa kike.

english: But Jacob insisted, “No, please! If I have found favor in your sight, then receive this gift from my hand. For indeed, I have seen your face, and it is like seeing the face of God, since you have received me favorably.
ekegusii: Korende Yakobo akamoteebia: “Taibo, onye nanyorire ogwancherwa ase obosio bwao, koranche obwate ekeegwa eke korwa ase okoboko kwane; naki okorora obosio bwao nigo enga buna okorora obosio bwa Nyasae, ase ogwanchera kwanyancheire inche.
swahili: Yakobo akasema, “La hasha! Tafadhali, kama nimepata kibali machoni pako, upokee zawadi hii kutoka kwangu. Kwa maana kuuona uso wako, ni kama kuuona uso wa Mungu, kwa kuwa umenipokea kwa takabali kubwa.

english: Please accept my gift that was brought to you, because God has been gracious to me and I have all I need.” So Jacob pressed him until he accepted.
ekegusii: Koranche oire ebiegwa ebi nakorenteire, ekiagera Nyasae onkoreire obuya obonge, na inche nimbwate ebing’isaine.” Naboigo ere akaebereria Esau na ere agancha, akabiira.
swahili: Tafadhali ukubali zawadi iliyoletwa kwako, kwa kuwa Mungu amenineemesha na ninavyo vyote ninavyohitaji.” Kwa sababu Yakobo alisisitiza, Esau akapokea.

english: Then Esau said, “Let us be on our way, and I will go ahead of you.”
ekegusii: Erio Esau akamoteebia: “Eta, togende seito, na inche ningotang’ane.”
swahili: Ndipo Esau akasema, “Na tuendelee na safari, nitakuwa pamoja nawe.”

english: But Jacob replied, “My lord knows that the children are frail, and I must care for sheep and cattle that are nursing their young. If they are driven hard for even a day, all the animals will die.
ekegusii: Korende Yakobo akamoiraneria: “Omonene one, nomanyete ng’a abana nebing’werere mbwate, naende chimbori ne ching’ondi nigo chibwate chimanwa chikogonka, ne chiombe boigo. Ching’iti echio chiise koayererigwa ase rituko erimo, nigo chirakwe chionsi.
swahili: Lakini Yakobo akamwambia, “Bwana wangu unajua kwamba watoto ni wachanga na kwamba ni lazima nitunze hawa kondoo wake na ngʼombe wanaonyonyesha. Wakipelekwa kwa haraka hata kama ni kwa siku moja tu, wanyama wote watakufa.

english: Please let my lord go ahead of his servant. I will continue on slowly, at a comfortable pace for the livestock and children, until I come to my lord at Seir.”
ekegusii: Koranche, omonene one, oete otang’ane bosio bwane, inche omosomba oo; na inche nindaae ching’iti echio ng’ora ng’ora, buna orogendo rwabo rong’ana, na abana buna chinguru chiabo ching’ana, goika ng’ike bwoo, omonene one, aaria Edomu.”
swahili: Hivyo bwana wangu umtangulie mtumishi wako, wakati mimi nikija polepole kwa mwendo wa makundi yaliyo mbele yangu na mwendo wa watoto, mpaka nifike kwa bwana wangu huko Seiri.”

english: “Let me leave some of my people with you,” Esau said. But Jacob replied, “Why do that? Let me find favor in the sight of my lord.”
ekegusii: Erio Esau akamoteebia: “Ningotigere abanto bande ase aba inde nabwo.” Korende Yakobo akairaneria: “Bakore ki? Otatiga ndore ng’a nanyorire ogwancherwa ase obosio bwao, omonene one.”
swahili: Esau akamwambia, “Basi na niwaache baadhi ya watu wangu pamoja nawe.” Yakobo akauliza, “Lakini kwa nini ufanye hivyo, niache tu nipate kibali machoni pa bwana wangu.”

english: So that day Esau started on his way back to Seir,
ekegusii: Ase rituko erio erio Esau akabwatia enchera, akairana gochia Edomu.
swahili: Hivyo siku hiyo Esau akashika njia akarudi Seiri.

english: but Jacob went on to Succoth, where he built a house for himself and shelters for his livestock; that is why the place was called Succoth. Jacob Settles in Shechem
ekegusii: Korende Yakobo akagenderera, agaika Sukoti, akeagachera enyomba, akaagachera na amaicho aye ebigutu. Ase igo, aase aria akarokwa Sukoti.
swahili: Pamoja na hayo, Yakobo akaenda Sukothi, mahali alipojijengea makazi kwa ajili yake na mabanda kwa ajili ya mifugo yake. Hii ndiyo sababu sehemu ile inaitwa Sukothi.

english: After Jacob had come from Paddan-aram, he arrived safely at the city of Shechem in the land of Canaan, and he camped just outside the city.
ekegusii: Yakobo kairanire korwa Padan‐Aramu, agaika buya ase omorembe ase Sekemu, omochie omonene bw’ense ya Kaanani, agatenenia eema yaye isiko y’omochie oyio.
swahili: Baada ya Yakobo kutoka Padan-Aramu, alifika salama katika mji wa Shekemu huko Kanaani na kuweka kambi yake karibu na mji.

english: And the plot of ground where he pitched his tent, he purchased from the sons of Hamor, Shechem’s father, for a hundred pieces of silver.
ekegusii: Korwa ase basinto ba Hamori, ise Sekemu, Yakobo akagora oboremo obwo ase rigori rie chifeta rigana erimo, agwo ase atenenetie eema yaye.
swahili: Akanunua kiwanja kutoka kwa wana wa Hamori, baba wa Shekemu, kwa bei ya vipande mia vya fedha, ambapo alipiga hema lake.

english: He put the maidservants and their children in front, Leah and her children next, and Rachel and Joseph at the rear.
ekegusii: Akabeeka abakungu baria abasomba amo nabana babo batang’ane, na Lea amo nabana baye korwa magega yabo, na Raeli na Yusufu akababeeka magega kegima.
swahili: Akawaweka wale watumishi wa kike na watoto wao mbele, Lea na watoto wake wakafuata, Raheli na Yosefu wakaja nyuma.

english: There he set up an altar and called it El-Elohe-Israel.
ekegusii: Akaagacha agwo egesasiimero, agakeroka Eli‐Elohe‐Israeli.
swahili: Pale akajenga madhabahu na kupaita El-Elohe-Israeli.

english: But Jacob himself went on ahead and bowed to the ground seven times as he approached his brother.
ekegusii: Ere omonyene agatang’ana bosio bwabo, akaba okona‐gotung’ama inse chintunda isano na ibere goika agaika ase oyomwabo.
swahili: Yeye mwenyewe akatangulia mbele na kusujudu mara saba alipomkaribia ndugu yake.

english: Esau, however, ran to him and embraced him, threw his arms around his neck, and kissed him. And they both wept.
ekegusii: Esau akaminyoka gochia komorotota, akamoboania rigoti riaye, na komoagata, barabwo bakareererana.
swahili: Lakini Esau akamkimbilia Yakobo kumlaki na kumkumbatia, akamwangukia shingoni na kumbusu. Nao wakalia.

english: When Esau looked up and saw the women and children, he asked, “Who are these with you?” Jacob answered, “These are the children God has graciously given your servant.”
ekegusii: Ekero Esau achia koimokereria amaiso aye igoro, akarora abakungu na abana, akamobooria: “Aba nabang’o more komo?” Yakobo akamoiraneria: “Aba nabana Nyasae ang’eire inche, omosomba oo, ase obuya bwaye.”
swahili: Esau akainua macho akawaona wale wanawake na watoto. Akauliza, “Hawa uliofuatana nao ni nani?” Yakobo akamjibu, “Ni watoto ambao Mungu amempa mtumishi wako kwa neema.”

english: Then the maidservants and their children approached and bowed down.
ekegusii: Erio abakungu baria abasomba bagasuka gochia ang’e, kera oyomo nabana baye, bagatung’ama inse.
swahili: Kisha wale watumishi wa kike na watoto wao wakakaribia na kusujudu.

english: Leah and her children also approached and bowed down, and then Joseph and Rachel approached and bowed down.
ekegusii: Lea nere boigo agasuka gochia ang’e amo n’abana baye, nabarabwo bagatung’ama inse. Magega kegima Yusufu na Raeli bagasuka gochia ang’e, nabarabwo boigo bagatung’ama inse.
swahili: Kisha Lea na watoto wake wakaja na kusujudu. Mwisho wa wote wakaja Yosefu na Raheli, nao pia wakasujudu.

english: “What do you mean by sending this whole company to meet me?” asked Esau. “To find favor in your sight, my lord,” Jacob answered.
ekegusii: Naende Esau akamobooria: “Emeganda eye yonsi twaumerana gochia aa, neya ki?” Yakobo akamoiraneria: “Engencho yaye inyore ogwancherwa ase obosio bwao, aye omonene one.”
swahili: Esau akauliza, “Una maana gani kuhusu makundi hayo yote niliyokutana nayo?” Akasema, “Ni ili kupata kibali machoni pako, bwana wangu.”

english: “I already have plenty, my brother,” Esau replied. “Keep what belongs to you.”
ekegusii: Esau akamoiraneria: “Oyominto, echi mbwate nching’isaine. Echire echiao, kabe nachirochio.”
swahili: Lakini Esau akamwambia, “Ndugu yangu, tayari nina wingi wa mali. Ulivyo navyo viwe vyako mwenyewe.”

english: Now Dinah, the daughter Leah had borne to Jacob, went out to visit the daughters of the land.
ekegusii: Bono Dina, omoiseke o Lea, oyio Lea aiborerete Yakobo, akagenda kororana nabaiseke b’ense eria.
swahili: Basi Dina, binti wa Yakobo aliyezaliwa na Lea, akatoka nje kuwatembelea wanawake wa nchi ile.

english: You may settle among us, and the land will be open to you. Live here, move about freely, and acquire your own property.”
ekegusii: Inwe nabo moramenye egati yaito, aiga ase ense yaito ribaga ndireo ase more, moramenye na koonchoreria, mwenyorere enibo.”
swahili: Mwaweza kuishi katikati yetu, nchi ni wazi kwenu. Ishini ndani yake, fanyeni biashara humu na mjipatie mali.”

english: Then Shechem said to Dinah’s father and brothers, “Grant me this favor, and I will give you whatever you ask.
ekegusii: Sekemu agateebia ise Dina na bamura bamwabo: “Nyanchere aya naboria aase more, kende gionsi moramboorie nimbae.
swahili: Kisha Shekemu akamwambia baba yake Dina pamoja na ndugu zake, “Na nipate kibali machoni penu, nami nitawapa chochote mtakachosema.

english: Demand a high dowry and an expensive gift, and I will give you whatever you ask. Only give me the girl as my wife!” The Revenge of Dinah’s Brothers
ekegusii: Mboorie enibo ende yonsi na ebiegwa boigo, nimbae buna moraganie, kogicha mong’e omoiseke oyo abe mokane.”
swahili: Niambieni kiasi cha mahari na zawadi nitakayoileta, hata iwe kubwa kiasi gani, nami nitawalipa chochote mtakachodai. Nipeni tu huyu msichana awe mke wangu.”

english: But because Shechem had defiled their sister Dinah, Jacob’s sons answered him and his father Hamor deceitfully.
ekegusii: Erio abamura ba Yakobo bakairaneria Sekemu na Hamori ise ase okong’ainereria, ekiagera konya osaririe Dina, omoiseke omwabo.
swahili: Kwa sababu ndugu yao Dina alikuwa amenajisiwa, wana wa Yakobo wakajibu kwa udanganyifu walipozungumza na Shekemu pamoja na baba yake Hamori.

english: “We cannot do such a thing,” they said. “To give our sister to an uncircumcised man would be a disgrace to us.
ekegusii: Bakairaneria: “Titokonyara gokora ring’ana eri, komoa omonto otaarogeti, omoiseke ominto, ekiagera ayio nigo arabe aya obosooku ase tore.
swahili: Wakawaambia, “Hatuwezi kufanya jambo kama hili, hatuwezi kumtoa dada yetu kwa mtu ambaye hakutahiriwa. Hiyo itakuwa aibu kwetu.

english: We will consent to this on one condition, that you become circumcised like us—every one of your males.
ekegusii: Natonyare gwancha okoboria kwaino ase ring’ana erimo rioka, naende nario eri: Komoranche mobe buna intwe, kera omonto omosacha ore asemore aarokigwe.
swahili: Tutakuruhusu kwa sharti moja tu, kwamba mtakuwa kama sisi kwa kuwatahiri wanaume wenu wote.

english: Then we will give you our daughters and take your daughters for ourselves. We will dwell among you and become one people.
ekegusii: Erio ’natobae abaiseke baito, na intwe toire abaino, tomenye amo, tobe abanto abamo.
swahili: Kisha tutawapa binti zetu na sisi tutawachukua binti zenu. Tutaishi kwenu na tutakuwa watu wamoja nanyi.

english: But if you will not agree to be circumcised, then we will take our sister and go.”
ekegusii: Korende motancheti mwarokigwe, rirorio nigo torarusie omoiseke oito aa, togende nere.”
swahili: Lakini mkikataa kutahiriwa, tutamchukua ndugu yetu na kuondoka.”

english: Their offer seemed good to Hamor and his son Shechem.
ekegusii: Amang’ana abo akagwenera Hamori na omomura oye Sekemu.
swahili: Pendekezo lao likawa jema kwa Hamori na Shekemu mwanawe.

english: The young man, who was the most respected of all his father’s household, did not hesitate to fulfill this request, because he was delighted with Jacob’s daughter.
ekegusii: Omomura oyio tatebana gokora ring’ana riria, ekiagera omoiseke oria o Yakobo konya omogweneire. Bono Sekemu nigo asikire kobua abande bonsi ase eamate yabo.
swahili: Kijana mdogo, ambaye alikuwa ameheshimiwa kati ya wote walioishi nyumbani mwa baba yake, hakupoteza muda kufanya waliyoyasema, kwa sababu alikuwa amependezwa sana na binti Yakobo.

english: When Shechem son of Hamor the Hivite, the prince of the region, saw her, he took her and lay with her by force.
ekegusii: Ekero Sekemu, omwana o Hamori Omohivi, omonene bw’ense eria, amorooche, akamobwata, akaba nere, akamosareria obwekungi bwaye.
swahili: Ikawa Shekemu mwana wa Hamori Mhivi, mtawala wa eneo lile alipomwona, akamchukua na kumnajisi.

english: So Hamor and his son Shechem went to the gate of their city and addressed the men of their city:
ekegusii: Ase igo, Hamori na Sekemu, omomura oye, bakagenda ase egeita ki’omochie obo, bagakwana nabaanto babo, bakabateebia,
swahili: Kwa hiyo Hamori na Shekemu mwanawe walikwenda kwenye lango la mji kuzungumza na wenzao wa mjini.

english: “These men are at peace with us. Let them live and trade in our land; indeed, it is large enough for them. Let us take their daughters in marriage and give our daughters to them.
ekegusii: “Abanto aba babeire abasani baito, tiga bamenye ase ense yaito, babe abaonchoreria, ekiagera ense eye nenene, netoisane twensi, intwe amo na barabwo. Intwe ntonyuomerane na barabwo.
swahili: Wakasema, “Hawa watu ni marafiki kwetu, tuwaruhusu waishi katika nchi yetu na kufanya biashara ndani yake, nchi ina nafasi tele kwa ajili yao. Tunaweza kuoa binti zao. Nao wanaweza kuoa binti zetu.

english: But only on this condition will the men agree to dwell with us and be one people: if all our men are circumcised as they are.
ekegusii: Barabwo banchire komenya seito babe obomo naintwe, korende mbaganetie tokore ring’ana erimo, nario eri, ng’a kera omosacha ore ase tore aarokigwe buna barabwo baarogete.
swahili: Lakini watu hao watakuwa tayari kukubali kuishi nasi kama watu wamoja nao kwa sharti kwamba wanaume wetu watahiriwe, kama wao.

english: Will not their livestock, their possessions, and all their animals become ours? Only let us consent to them, and they will dwell among us.”
ekegusii: Amaicho abo, na enibo yabo, na etugo yabo yonsi, inee, tibikoba ebiaito? Tiga twancherane nabarabwo rioka, bamenye aa seito.”
swahili: Je, si mifugo yao, mali zao na wanyama wao wengine wote watakuwa wetu? Basi na tuwape kibali, nao wataishi miongoni mwetu.”

english: All the men who went out of the city gate listened to Hamor and his son Shechem, and every male of the city was circumcised.
ekegusii: Abanto bonsi abamenyete ase omochie oria, bakaigwera Hamori na omomura oye Sekemu, na kera omosacha oyomenyeteo akaarokigwa. Abamura ba Yakobo bagoakana abanto ba Sekemu egesiomba
swahili: Wanaume wote waliotoka nje ya lango la mji walikubaliana na Hamori na Shekemu mwanawe na kila mwanaume katika mji ule akatahiriwa.

english: Three days later, while they were still in pain, two of Jacob’s sons (Dinah’s brothers Simeon and Levi) took their swords, went into the unsuspecting city, and slaughtered every male.
ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatato ekero abwo baarogete baarenge koromwa mono, abamura babere ba Yakobo, Simioni na Lawi, bamura ba ng’ina omo na Dina, bakaimoka nemeyio ya birende, bagasoa ase omochie ime mobosokano, bagaita abasacha bonsi abaarengeo.
swahili: Baada ya siku tatu, wakati wote wakiwa wangali katika maumivu, wana wawili wa Yakobo, yaani Simeoni na Lawi, ndugu zake Dina, wakachukua panga zao na kuvamia mji ambao haukutazamia vita, wakaua kila mwanaume.

english: They killed Hamor and his son Shechem with their swords, took Dinah out of Shechem’s house, and went away.
ekegusii: Bagaita Hamori amo na Sekemu momura oye nemeyio ya birende, bakarusia Dina omwabo mwa Sekemu, bakagenda nere.
swahili: Wakawaua Hamori na Shekemu mwanawe kwa upanga kisha wakamchukua Dina kutoka nyumba ya Shekemu na kuondoka.

english: Jacob’s other sons came upon the slaughter and looted the city, because their sister had been defiled.
ekegusii: Erio abamura bande ba Yakobo bagachiera abwo baitetwe na bagasakora omochie, ekiagera konya basaririe omoiseke omwabo;
swahili: Wana wa Yakobo walipita juu ya maiti katika kuteka nyara mji ule ambamo dada yao alikuwa amenajisiwa.

english: They took their flocks and herds and donkeys, and everything else in the city or in the field.
ekegusii: bakaira ching’ondi, ne chiombe, ne chitigere, na bionsi ebiareenge ase omochie ime, na bionsi ebiareenge ase emegondo boigo.
swahili: Wakachukua kondoo na mbuzi, ngʼombe, punda na kila kitu kilichokuwa chao ndani ya mji ule na mashambani.

english: They carried off all their possessions and women and children, and they plundered everything in their houses.
ekegusii: Bagasakora enibo yabo yonsi, na abana babo, na abakungu babo, na bionsi ebiareenge ase chinyomba bakabiira.
swahili: Walichukua utajiri wao wote pamoja na wanawake na watoto wao, wakachukua nyara kila kitu ndani ya nyumba zao.

english: And his soul was drawn to Dinah, the daughter of Jacob. He loved the young girl and spoke to her tenderly.
ekegusii: Korende magega y’ayio agakorera Dina, omoiseke oyio o Yakobo, buya, akamwancha na gokwana nere amang’ana amaya.
swahili: Moyo wake ukavutwa sana kwa Dina binti Yakobo, akampenda huyu msichana na akazungumza naye kwa kumbembeleza.

english: Then Jacob said to Simeon and Levi, “You have brought trouble upon me by making me a stench to the Canaanites and Perizzites, the people of this land. We are few in number; if they unite against me and attack me, I and my household will be destroyed.”
ekegusii: Erio Yakobo agateebia Simioni na Lawi: “Inwe mwambekire ase emechando, mwankorire ogotioka okobe egati-gati y’abanto b’ebisaku bi’ense eye, Abakaanani na Abaperisi. Inche na abanto baane nabake tore; barabwo baise gosangererekana na kong’umokera nigo barang’ite na gonsiria amo nabaanto baane.”
swahili: Kisha Yakobo akawaambia Simeoni na Lawi, “Mmeleta taabu kwangu kwa kunifanya ninuke kama uvundo kwa Wakanaani na Waperizi, watu waishio katika nchi hii. Sisi ni wachache, kama wakiunganisha nguvu zao dhidi yangu na kunishambulia, mimi na nyumba yangu tutaangamizwa.”

english: But they replied, “Should he have treated our sister like a prostitute?”
ekegusii: Korende barabwo bakamoiraneria: “Inee! Nabo barabwo bagwenerete bakorere omoiseke ominto buna omokungu omotayayi?”
swahili: Lakini wakamjibu, “Je, ilikuwa vyema kumtendea dada yetu kama kahaba?”

english: So Shechem told his father Hamor, “Get me this girl as a wife.”
ekegusii: Sekemu agakwana na Hamori ise, akamoteebia: “Mborerie omoiseke oyo abe mokane!”
swahili: Shekemu akamwambia baba yake Hamori, “Nipatie msichana huyu awe mke wangu.”

english: Jacob heard that Shechem had defiled his daughter Dinah, but since his sons were with his livestock in the field, he remained silent about it until they returned.
ekegusii: Ekero Yakobo achia koigwa ng’a Sekemu osaririe Dina, omoiseke oye, abamura baye ngetii baarenge korisia, Ase igo Yakobo agakira‐kiri goika bakairana inka.
swahili: Yakobo aliposikia kwamba binti yake Dina amenajisiwa, wanawe walikuwa mashambani wakichunga mifugo yake, kwa hiyo akalinyamazia jambo hilo mpaka waliporudi nyumbani.

english: Meanwhile, Shechem’s father Hamor came to speak with Jacob.
ekegusii: Hamori, ise Sekemu, akaimoka akagenda o Yakobo gokwana nere.
swahili: Kisha Hamori baba yake Shekemu akaenda kuzungumza na Yakobo.

english: When Jacob’s sons heard what had happened, they returned from the field. They were filled with grief and fury, because Shechem had committed an outrage in Israel by lying with Jacob’s daughter—a thing that should not be done.
ekegusii: Abamura ba Yakobo, ekero bachia koigwa ayio, bagacha korwa getii, bare nobororo na ekeririanda ekenene mono, ekiagera Sekemu akorete obokayayu ase Abaisraeli ase okomotachera inse omoiseke o Yakobo, ring’ana ritagwenerete gokoreka.
swahili: Basi wana wa Yakobo walikuwa wamerudi kutoka mashambani mara tu waliposikia kilichotokea. Walikuwa wamejawa na huzuni na ghadhabu, kwa sababu Shekemu alikuwa amefanya jambo la aibu katika Israeli kwa kukutana kimwili na binti wa Yakobo, kitu ambacho hakingepasa kufanyika.

english: But Hamor said to them, “My son Shechem longs for your daughter. Please give her to him as his wife.
ekegusii: Hamori agakwana nabarabwo, akabora: “Omomura one Sekemu omwanchire omoiseke oino, bono komoranche, momomoe amonyuome.
swahili: Lakini Hamori akawaambia, “Moyo wa mwanangu Shekemu umeelekea kwa binti yenu. Tafadhali mpeni awe mke wake.

english: Intermarry with us; give us your daughters, and take our daughters for yourselves.
ekegusii: Tonyuomerane intwe nainwe, motoe abaiseke baino, naintwe tobae abaito.
swahili: Oaneni na sisi, tupeni binti zenu, nanyi mchukue binti zetu.

english: Then God said to Jacob, “Arise, go up to Bethel, and settle there. Build an altar there to the God who appeared to you when you fled from your brother Esau.”
ekegusii: Rituko erimo Nyasae agateebia Yakobo: “Imoka, otiire ogende omenye Beteli, oagachere Nyasae egesasiimero aroro, Nyasae, oyo okoorokerete ekero kware gotama korwa ase Esau momura omino.”
swahili: Kisha Mungu akamwambia Yakobo, “Panda uende Betheli ukakae huko na ukamjengee Mungu madhabahu huko, Yeye aliyekutokea ulipokuwa unamkimbia Esau ndugu yako.”

english: And God said to him, “Though your name is Jacob, you will no longer be called Jacob. Instead, your name will be Israel. ” So God named him Israel.
ekegusii: Agwo Nyasae akamoteebia, “Erieta riao n’Yakobo, bono tokorokwa Yakobo naende, korende nigo orarokwe Israeli.” Ase igo, akamoroka Israeli.
swahili: Mungu akamwambia, “Jina lako ni Yakobo, lakini hutaitwa tena Yakobo, jina lako utakuwa Israeli.” Kwa hiyo akamwita Israeli.

english: And God told him, “I am God Almighty. Be fruitful and multiply. A nation—even a company of nations—shall come from you, and kings shall descend from you.
ekegusii: Naende Nyasae akamoteebia, “Inche Nyasae Omobui, genderera gosarara, obuche. Egesaku na emeganda y’ebisaku nigo erarue asore, na abarwoti mbarue asore.
swahili: Mungu akamwambia, “Mimi ndimi Mungu Mwenyezi, ukazae na kuongezeka. Taifa na jamii ya mataifa itatoka kwako, nao wafalme watatoka viunoni mwako.

english: The land that I gave to Abraham and Isaac I will give to you, and I will give this land to your descendants after you.”
ekegusii: Na ense eye naete Aburaamu na Isaka, ninkoyee aye na ororeeria rwao rorache korwa magega yao.”
swahili: Nchi niliyowapa Abrahamu na Isaki nakupa wewe pia, nami nitawapa wazao wako baada yako.”

english: Then God went up from the place where He had spoken with him.
ekegusii: Erio Nyasae akaimoka akagenda igoro, akarwa asare, agwo ase areenge gokwana nere.
swahili: Kisha Mungu akapanda juu kutoka kwake mahali pale alipozungumza naye.

english: So Jacob set up a pillar in the place where God had spoken with him—a stone marker—and he poured out a drink offering on it and anointed it with oil.
ekegusii: Yakobo agatenenia rigena buna esiiro aase aria Nyasae akwanerete amo nere, akaumora ekeng’wanso gi’ekenyugwa amo namaguta igoro yaye.
swahili: Yakobo akasimamisha nguzo ya jiwe mahali pale Mungu alipozungumza naye, akamimina sadaka ya kinywaji juu yake, pia akamimina mafuta juu yake.

english: Jacob called the place where God had spoken with him Bethel. Benjamin Born, Rachel Dies
ekegusii: Igo Yakobo akaaroka aase aria Nyasae akwanerete amo nere Beteli. Ogokwa kwa Raeli
swahili: Yakobo akapaita mahali pale Mungu alipozungumza naye Betheli. Vifo Vya Raheli Na Isaki

english: Later, they set out from Bethel, and while they were still some distance from Ephrath, Rachel began to give birth, and her labor was difficult.
ekegusii: Erio bagachaaka orogendo rwabo korwa Beteli, ekero batigairie orogendo oroke baike Efarati, Raeli agachaaka kobina ase okoibora, akaba nobokong’u bw’okoibora.
swahili: Kisha wakaondoka Betheli. Walipokuwa umbali fulani kabla ya kufika Efrathi, Raheli akaanza kusikia uchungu na alipata shida kuu.

english: During her severe labor, the midwife said to her, “Do not be afraid, for you are having another son.”
ekegusii: Ekero areenge koromwa mono, omoiboria akamoteebia: “Toondoka, ekiagera naende nomwana omoisia oraibore.”
swahili: Alipokuwa katika shida hii katika kujifungua, mkunga akamwambia, “Usiogope, kwa sababu umempata mwana mwingine.”

english: And with her last breath—for she was dying—she named him Ben-oni. But his father called him Benjamin.
ekegusii: Agwo akaba okogireka ase ogokwa; na ekero areenge ang’e ase ogokwa, Akamoroka omwana oyio Ben‐Oni, korende ise akamoroka Benjamini.
swahili: Hapo alipopumua pumzi yake ya mwisho, kwa maana alikuwa akifa, akamwita mwanawe Benoni. Lakini babaye akamwita Benyamini.

english: So Rachel died and was buried on the way to Ephrath (that is, Bethlehem).
ekegusii: Erio Raeli agakwa, agatindekwa agwo ase enchera ekogenda Efarati, nao Bethlehemu.
swahili: Kwa hiyo Raheli akafa, akazikwa kando ya njia iendayo Efrathi (ndio Bethlehemu).

english: So Jacob told his household and all who were with him, “Get rid of the foreign gods that are among you. Purify yourselves and change your garments.
ekegusii: Erio Yakobo agateebia abanto baye amo naabwo bonsi baarenge komo: “Rusia emegwekano y’ebinyasae ebigeni b’ebisaku, ebi mobwate ase egati yaino, mwesibie inwe abanyene, moonchorerie chianga chiaino.
swahili: Hivyo Yakobo akawaambia watu wa nyumbani mwake pamoja na wote waliokuwa naye, “Iondoeni miungu ya kigeni ile iliyoko katikati yenu, jitakaseni na mkabadilishe nguo zenu.

english: Jacob set up a pillar on her grave; it marks Rachel’s tomb to this day. The Sons of Jacob (1 Chronicles 2:1–2)
ekegusii: Na Yakobo agatenenia rigena ri’ekeinyorio ase embeera ya Raeli, nao rire goika reero iga.
swahili: Juu ya kaburi lake, Yakobo akasimamisha nguzo, ambayo mpaka leo inatambulisha kaburi la Raheli.

english: Israel again set out and pitched his tent beyond the Tower of Eder.
ekegusii: Erio Israeli akaimoka, akagenda, agatenenia eema yaye ng’umbu y’omoorobiri o Ederi. Abamura ba Yakobo
swahili: Israeli akaendelea tena na safari yake na kupiga hema mbele mnara wa Ederi.

english: While Israel was living in that region, Reuben went in and slept with his father’s concubine Bilhah, and Israel heard about it. Jacob had twelve sons:
ekegusii: Engaki eria Israeli amenyete ase ense eria, Rubeni akagenda akaraara na Bilia, omokungu o ise, oria o sere-sere, na Israeli akaigwa amang’ana ayio. Abamura ba Yakobo nigo baarenge ikomi na babere.
swahili: Wakati Israeli alipokuwa akiishi katika nchi ile, Reubeni mwanawe alikutana kimwili na suria wa baba yake aitwaye Bilha, naye Israeli akasikia jambo hili. Yakobo alikuwa na wana kumi na wawili:

english: The sons of Leah were Reuben the firstborn of Jacob, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun.
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Lea nabwo aba: Rubeni, omwana omotangi o Yakobo, na Simioni, na Lawi, na Yuda, na Isakaru, na Sabuloni.
swahili: Wana wa Lea walikuwa: Reubeni mzaliwa wa kwanza wa Yakobo, Simeoni, Lawi, Yuda, Isakari na Zabuloni.

english: The sons of Rachel were Joseph and Benjamin.
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Raeli nabwo Yusufu na Benjamini.
swahili: Wana wa Raheli walikuwa: Yosefu na Benyamini.

english: The sons of Rachel’s maidservant Bilhah were Dan and Naphtali.
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Bilia, omoiseke omosomba o Raeli, nabwo Dani na Nafutali.
swahili: Wana waliozaliwa na Bilha mtumishi wa kike wa Raheli walikuwa: Dani na Naftali.

english: And the sons of Leah’s maidservant Zilpah were Gad and Asher. These are the sons of Jacob, who were born to him in Paddan-aram. The Death of Isaac
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Silpa, omoiseke omosomba o Lea, nabwo Gadi na Aseri. Aba nabwo abana abamura Yakobo aiboreretwe agwo Padan‐Aramu. Ogokwa kwa Isaka
swahili: Wana waliozaliwa na Zilpa mtumishi wa kike wa Lea walikuwa: Gadi na Asheri. Hawa walikuwa wana wa Yakobo, waliozaliwa kwake akiwa Padan-Aramu.

english: Jacob returned to his father Isaac at Mamre, near Kiriath-arba (that is, Hebron), where Abraham and Isaac had stayed.
ekegusii: Yakobo agaika ase omochie o Isaka ise aaria Mamure, ang’e na Kiriati-Ariba, nao Heburoni, agwo ase Aburaamu na Isaka bamenyete buna abamenyi.
swahili: Yakobo akarudi nyumbani kwa baba yake Isaki huko Mamre, karibu na Kiriath-Arba (yaani Hebroni), ambapo walikuwa wameishi Abrahamu na Isaki.

english: Then he breathed his last and died and was gathered to his people, old and full of years. And his sons Esau and Jacob buried him.
ekegusii: Erio Isaka ero agakwa, agasangerereka amo nabaanto baye, ore omogotu kegima, omonto bw’emiaka emenge, na abamura baye, Esau na Yakobo, bakamotindeka.
swahili: Kisha Isaki akapumua pumzi yake ya mwisho akafa, akakusanywa pamoja na watu wake akiwa mzee wa miaka mingi. Nao wanawe Esau na Yakobo wakamzika.

english: Then let us arise and go to Bethel. I will build an altar there to God, who answered me in my day of distress. He has been with me wherever I have gone.”
ekegusii: Toimoke totiire gochia Beteli, erinde ing’agachere Nyasae egesasiimero aroro, Nyasae oyonyigwete ekero keria nareenge nobokong’u, akaba amo nainche ase orogendo rwane rwonsi.”
swahili: Kisha njooni, twende Betheli, mahali nitakapomjengea Mungu madhabahu, aliyenijibu katika siku ya shida yangu, ambaye amekuwa pamoja nami popote nilipokwenda.”

english: So they gave Jacob all their foreign gods and all their earrings, and Jacob buried them under the oak near Shechem.
ekegusii: Barabwo bakaa Yakobo emegwekano y’ebinyasae ebigeni bionsi ebio babwate, na ebigera babeegete ase amato abo, na Yakobo akabitindeka inse y’omote okorokwa omwaloni, oyorenge ang’e na Sekemu.
swahili: Kwa hiyo wakampa Yakobo miungu yote ya kigeni waliyokuwa nayo, pamoja na pete zilizokuwa masikioni mwao. Yakobo akavizika chini ya mti wa mwaloni huko Shekemu.

english: As they set out, a terror from God fell over the surrounding cities, so that they did not pursue Jacob’s sons.
ekegusii: Ekero baimogete kogenda orogendo rwabo, okoondokia gokarua ase Nyasae, gokabwata abanto b’emechie eria yabaetanaine; Ase igo tibanyara komonyookia basinto ba Yakobo.
swahili: Kisha wakaondoka, na hofu ya Mungu ikawapata miji yote iliyowazunguka. Kwa hiyo hakuna aliyewafuatia wana wa Yakobo.

english: So Jacob and everyone with him arrived in Luz (that is, Bethel) in the land of Canaan.
ekegusii: Yakobo amo nabwo bonsi baarenge nere bagaika omochie o Lusu, Omochie oyio naende noro okorokwa Beteli, oyio ore ime y’ense ya Kaanani
swahili: Yakobo na watu wote waliokuwa pamoja naye wakafika Luzu (ndio Betheli), katika nchi ya Kanaani.

english: There Jacob built an altar, and he called that place El-bethel, because it was there that God had revealed Himself to Jacob as he fled from his brother.
ekegusii: Agwo akaagacha egesasiimero, Akaaroka aase aria Eli‐Beteli, ekiagera agwo nao Nyasae aorokerete Yakobo, ekero areenge gotama korwa ase oyomwabo.
swahili: Huko akajenga madhabahu na akapaita mahali pale El-Betheli, kwa sababu mahali pale ndipo Mungu alipojifunua kwake alipokuwa akimkimbia ndugu yake.

english: Now Deborah, Rebekah’s nurse, died and was buried under the oak below Bethel. So Jacob named it Allon-bachuth.
ekegusii: Agwo Debora, omoreri o Rebeka, agakwa, agatindekwa inse y’omote okorokwa omwaloni. Aase agwo akarokwa Aloni‐Bakuti.
swahili: Wakati huu Debora, mlezi wa Rebeka, akafa na akazikwa chini ya mti wa mwaloni ulioko chini ya Betheli. Kwa hiyo pakaitwa Alon-Bakuthi.

english: After Jacob had returned from Paddan-aram, God appeared to him again and blessed him.
ekegusii: Erio naende Nyasae akaorokera Yakobo, ekero Yakobo areenge korwa Padan‐Aramu, Nyasae akamosesenia.
swahili: Baada ya Yakobo kurudi kutoka Padan-Aramu, Mungu alimtokea tena na kumbariki.

english: This is the account of Esau (that is, Edom).
ekegusii: Oyo noro omooroberio bw’ororeeria rwa Esau, nere Edomu.
swahili: Hivi ndivyo vizazi vya Esau (yaani Edomu).

english: These are the names of Esau’s sons: Eliphaz son of Esau’s wife Adah, and Reuel son of Esau’s wife Basemath.
ekegusii: Aya naro amarieta a basinto b’Esau: Elifasi, omomura o Ada moga Esau, na Reueli, omomura o Basemati moga Esau.
swahili: Haya ndiyo majina ya wana wa Esau: Elifazi, mwana wa Esau ambaye mkewe Ada alimzalia; na Reueli, mwana wa Esau ambaye mkewe Basemathi alimzalia.

english: The sons of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zepho, Gatam, and Kenaz.
ekegusii: Na basinto b’Elifasi nabwo aba: Temani na Omari, na Sefo, na Gatamu, na Kenasi.
swahili: Wana wa Elifazi ni: Temani, Omari, Sefo, Gatamu na Kenazi.

english: Additionally, Timna, a concubine of Esau’s son Eliphaz, gave birth to Amalek. These are the grandsons of Esau’s wife Adah.
ekegusii: Timuna nigo areenge omokungu o sere‐sere o Elifasi, mosinto bw’Esau. Ere akaiborera Elifasi Amaleki. Aba nabwo baareenge abachokoro abamura b’Ada moga Esau.
swahili: Elifazi mwana wa Esau alikuwa pia na suria aliyeitwa Timna, ambaye alimzalia Amaleki. Hawa ndio waliokuwa wajukuu wa Ada mke wa Esau.

english: These are the sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah. They are the grandsons of Esau’s wife Basemath.
ekegusii: Aba nabwo basinto ba Reueli: Nahati, na Zera, na Sama, na Miza. Aba nabwo baarenge abachokoro abamura ba Basemati, moga Esau.
swahili: Wana wa Reueli ni: Nahathi, Zera, Shama na Miza. Hawa ndio waliokuwa wajukuu wa Basemathi mkewe Esau.

english: These are the sons of Esau’s wife Oholibamah (daughter of Anah and granddaughter of Zibeon) whom she bore to Esau: Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.
ekegusii: Na abana aba nabwo abamura ba Oholibama, moga Esau mosubati o Ana, mosinto o Sibeoni: Ere akaiborera Esau Yeusi, na Yalamu, na Kora.
swahili: Wana wa Oholibama binti Ana, mkewe Esau, aliyekuwa mjukuu wa Sibeoni, aliomzalia Esau ni: Yeushi, Yalamu na Kora.

english: These are the chiefs among the sons of Esau. The sons of Eliphaz the firstborn of Esau: Chiefs Teman, Omar, Zepho, Kenaz,
ekegusii: Aba nabwo baarenge abagaambi korwa ase ororeeria rw’Esau. Basinto b’Elifasi, omomura omotangi bw’Esau, nabwo aba: Omogambi Temani, na omogambi Omari, na omogambi Sefo, na omogambi Kenasi,
swahili: Hawa ndio waliokuwa wakuu miongoni mwa wazao wa Esau: Wakuu wa wana wa Elifazi, mzaliwa wa kwanza wa Esau ni: Temani, Omari, Sefo, Kenazi,

english: Korah, Gatam, and Amalek. They are the chiefs of Eliphaz in the land of Edom, and they are the grandsons of Adah.
ekegusii: na omogambi Kora, na omogambi Gatamu, na omogambi Amaleki. Aba nabwo baarenge abagaambi korwa ase ororeeria rw’Elifasi, ase ense y’Edomu. Barabwo nabachokoro abamura b’Ada.
swahili: Kora, Gatamu na Amaleki. Hawa ndio waliokuwa wakuu waliotoka kwa Elifazi huko Edomu, waliokuwa wajukuu wa kiume wa Ada.

english: These are the sons of Esau’s son Reuel: Chiefs Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah. They are the chiefs descended from Reuel in the land of Edom, and they are the grandsons of Esau’s wife Basemath.
ekegusii: Naba nabwo basinto ba Reueli, mosinto bw’Esau: Omogambi Nahati, na omogambi Zera, na omogambi Sama, na omogambi Miza. Aba nabwo baarenge abagaambi korwa ase ororeeria rwa Reueli ase ense y’Edomu. Aba nabwo abachokoro abamura ba Basemati, moga Esau.
swahili: Wakuu wa wana wa Reueli, mwana wa Esau ni: Nahathi, Zera, Shama na Miza. Hawa ndio wakuu waliotoka kwa Reueli huko Edomu, waliokuwa wajukuu wa kiume wa Basemathi mkewe Esau.

english: These are the sons of Esau’s wife Oholibamah: Chiefs Jeush, Jalam, and Korah. They are the chiefs descended from Esau’s wife Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah.
ekegusii: Naba nabwo abamura b’Oholibama, moga Esau: Omogambi Yeusi, na omogambi Yalamu, na omogambi Kora. Aba nabwo abagaambi baiboretwe na Oholibama, mosubati o Ana moga Esau.
swahili: Wakuu wa wana wa Esau ambao mkewe Oholibama alimzalia ni: Yeushi, Yalamu na Kora. Hawa ndio wakuu waliotoka kwa mke wa Esau, Oholibama binti Ana.

english: All these are the sons of Esau (that is, Edom), and they were their chiefs. The Descendants of Seir (1 Chronicles 1:38–42)
ekegusii: Aba nabwo basinto b’Esau, nere Edomu; naba nabwo abagaambi babo. Ororeeria rwa Edomu
swahili: Hawa ndio waliokuwa wana wa Esau (ndiye Edomu), na hawa ndio waliokuwa wakuu wao.

english: Esau took his wives from the daughters of Canaan: Adah daughter of Elon the Hittite, Oholibamah daughter of Anah and granddaughter of Zibeon the Hivite,
ekegusii: Esau akanyuoma abakungu baye korwa ase Abakaanani: Ada, omoiseke o Eloni, Omohiti, na Oholibama, omoiseke o Ana, mosinto o Sibeoni, Omohivi,
swahili: Esau akaoa wake kutoka miongoni mwa wanawake wa Kanaani: Ada binti wa Eloni Mhiti, Oholibama binti wa Ana, mjukuu wa kike wa Sibeoni Mhivi,

english: These are the sons of Seir the Horite, who were living in the land: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,
ekegusii: Aba nabwo basinto ba Edomu Omohori, ababiare b’ense eria: Lotani, na Sobali, na Sibeoni, na Ana,
swahili: Hawa ndio walikuwa wana wa Seiri, Mhori, waliokuwa wakiishi katika nchi ile: Lotani, Shobali, Sibeoni, Ana,

english: Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan. They are the chiefs of the Horites, the descendants of Seir in the land of Edom.
ekegusii: na Dishoni, na Eseri, na Disani. Aba nabwo baarenge abagaambi b’Abahori, basinto ba Edomu, ase ense y’Edomu.
swahili: Dishoni, Eseri na Dishani. Hawa ndio wana wa Seiri huko Edomu waliokuwa wakuu kwa Wahori.

english: The sons of Lotan were Hori and Hemam. Timna was Lotan’s sister.
ekegusii: Na basinto ba Lotani nabwo Hori na Hemamu, na mosubati omwabo Lotani nigo areenge korokwa Timuna.
swahili: Wana wa Lotani walikuwa: Hori na Homamu. Timna alikuwa dada yake Lotani.

english: These are the sons of Shobal: Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho, and Onam.
ekegusii: Naba nabwo basinto ba Sobali: Alivani, na Manahati, na Sefo, na Onamu.
swahili: Wana wa Shobali walikuwa: Alvani, Manahathi, Ebali, Shefo na Onamu.

english: These are the sons of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah. (This is the Anah who found the hot springs in the wilderness as he was pasturing the donkeys of his father Zibeon.)
ekegusii: Naba nabwo basinto ba Sibeoni: Aya na Ana. Ana oyo nere onyorete chinsoko chi’amaache are morero, ase erooro, ekero areenge korisia chitigere chia Sibeoni ise.
swahili: Wana wa Sibeoni walikuwa: Aiya na Ana. Huyu Ana ndiye aligundua chemchemi ya maji moto jangwani alipokuwa akichunga punda za Sibeoni baba yake.

english: These are the children of Anah: Dishon and Oholibamah daughter of Anah.
ekegusii: Na mosinto o Ana nere Dishoni, na omoiseke o Ana nere Oholibama.
swahili: Watoto wa Ana walikuwa: Dishoni na Oholibama binti wa Ana.

english: These are the sons of Dishon: Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.
ekegusii: Naba nabwo basinto ba Dishoni: Hemudani, na Esibani, na Itirani, na Kerani.
swahili: Wana wa Dishoni walikuwa: Hemdani, Eshbani, Ithrani na Kerani.

english: These are the sons of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan, and Akan.
ekegusii: Naba nabwo basinto b’Eseri: Bilihani, na Sawani, na Akani.
swahili: Wana wa Eseri walikuwa: Bilhani, Zaavani na Akani.

english: These are the sons of Dishan: Uz and Aran.
ekegusii: Na basinto ba Disani nabwo Usi na Arani.
swahili: Wana wa Dishani walikuwa: Usi na Arani.

english: These are the chiefs of the Horites: Chiefs Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,
ekegusii: Na abagaambi barwete ase Abahori nabwo aba: Omogambi Lotani, na omogambi Sobali, na omogambi Sibeoni, na omogambi Ana,
swahili: Hawa ndio waliokuwa wakuu wa Wahori: Lotani, Shobali, Sibeoni, Ana,

english: and Basemath daughter of Ishmael and sister of Nebaioth.
ekegusii: na Basemati, omoiseke o Isumaeli, omoiseke omwabo Nebayoti,
swahili: pia akaoa Basemathi binti wa Ishmaeli, dada yake Nebayothi.

english: Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan. They are the chiefs of the Horites, according to their divisions in the land of Seir. The Kings of Edom (1 Chronicles 1:43–54)
ekegusii: na omogambi Dishoni, na omogambi Eseri, na omogambi Disani. Aba nabwo abagaambi b’Abahori, koreng’ana nebisaku biabo, ase ense ya Edomu. Abarwoti b’Edomu
swahili: Dishoni, Eseri na Dishani. Hawa ndio walikuwa wakuu wa Wahori, kufuatana na makundi yao, katika nchi ya Seiri. Watawala Wa Edomu (1 Nyakati 1:43-54)

english: These are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom before any king reigned over the Israelites:
ekegusii: Na abarwoti abagamberete ense y’Edomu ritang’ani konya morwoti onde bwensi ataragaambera Abaisraeli nabwo aba:
swahili: Wafuatao ni wafalme waliotawala Edomu kabla ya mfalme yeyote wa Israeli kutawala:

english: Bela son of Beor reigned in Edom; the name of his city was Dinhabah.
ekegusii: Bela, mosinto o Beori, akaba okogaamba ase ense y’Edomu, na omochie oye nigo ore korokwa Dinihaba.
swahili: Bela mwana wa Beori alikuwa mfalme wa Edomu. Mji wake uliitwa Dinhaba.

english: When Bela died, Jobab son of Zerah from Bozrah reigned in his place.
ekegusii: Bela agakwa, na Yobabu mosinto o Zera, oyo orwete Bosira, akaba okogaamba ase ribaga riaye.
swahili: Bela alipofariki, Yobabu mwana wa Zera kutoka Bosra akawa mfalme baada yake.

english: When Jobab died, Husham from the land of the Temanites reigned in his place.
ekegusii: Yobabu nere agakwa, na Husamu bw’ense y’Abatemani akaba okogaamba ase ribaga riaye.
swahili: Yobabu alipofariki, Hushamu kutoka nchi ya Watemani akawa mfalme baada yake.

english: When Husham died, Hadad son of Bedad, who defeated Midian in the country of Moab, reigned in his place. And the name of his city was Avith.
ekegusii: Husamu nere agakwa, na Hadadi, mosinto o Bedadi, akaba okogaamba ase ribaga riaye; oyo nere obuete Abamidiani, ase ense ya Moabu na omochie oye nigo ore korokwa Aviti.
swahili: Hushamu alipofariki, Hadadi mwana wa Bedadi, aliyeshinda Midiani katika nchi ya Moabu, akawa mfalme baada yake. Mji wake uliitwa Avithi.

english: When Hadad died, Samlah from Masrekah reigned in his place.
ekegusii: Hadadi nere agakwa, na Samula, oyo orwete Masereka, akaba okogaamba ase ribaga riaye.
swahili: Hadadi alipofariki, Samla kutoka Masreka akawa mfalme baada yake.

english: When Samlah died, Shaul from Rehoboth on the Euphrates reigned in his place.
ekegusii: Samula nere agakwa, na Saulo, oyo orwete Rehoboti, omochie orenge orooche ensemo, akaba okogaamba ase ribaga riaye.
swahili: Samla alipofariki, Shauli kutoka Rehobothi ngʼambo ya Mto Frati akawa mfalme baada yake.

english: When Shaul died, Baal-hanan son of Achbor reigned in his place.
ekegusii: Saulo nere agakwa, na Baali‐Hanani mosinto o Akibori akaba okogaamba ase ribaga riaye.
swahili: Shauli alipofariki, Baal-Hanani mwana wa Akbori akawa mfalme baada yake.

english: When Baal-hanan son of Achbor died, Hadad reigned in his place. His city was named Pau, and his wife’s name was Mehetabel daughter of Matred, the daughter of Me-zahab.
ekegusii: Baali‐Hanani, mosinto o Akibori, nere agakwa, na Hadari akaba okogaamba ase ribaga riaye, na omochie oye nigo ore korokwa Pau, na mokaye nigo areenge korokwa Mehetabeli, mosubati o Matiredi, mosubati o Mesahabu.
swahili: Baal-Hanani mwana wa Akbori alipofariki, Hadadi akawa mfalme baada yake. Mji wake uliitwa Pau, na mkewe aliitwa Mehetabeli binti Matredi, binti Me-Zahabu.

english: And Adah bore Eliphaz to Esau, Basemath gave birth to Reuel,
ekegusii: Ada akamoiborera Esau omwana okorokwa Elifasi, na Basemati akaibora Reueli,
swahili: Ada akamzalia Esau Elifazi, Basemathi akamzaa Reueli,

english: These are the names of Esau’s chiefs, according to their families and regions, by their names: Chiefs Timna, Alvah, Jetheth,
ekegusii: Aya naro amarieta ’abagaambi barwete ase ororeeria rwa Esau, gotunyana chiamate chiabo, na aase bamenyete nigo are namarieta abo: Omogambi Timuna, na omogambi Aliva, na omogambi Yeteti,
swahili: Hawa ndio wakuu waliotokana na Esau, kwa majina, kufuatana na koo zao na nchi zao: Timna, Alva, Yethethi,

english: Oholibamah, Elah, Pinon,
ekegusii: na omogambi Oholibama, na omogambi Ela, na omogambi Pinoni,
swahili: Oholibama, Ela, Pinoni,

english: Kenaz, Teman, Mibzar,
ekegusii: na omogambi Kenasi, na omogambi Temani, na omogambi Mibusari,
swahili: Kenazi, Temani, Mibsari,

english: Magdiel, and Iram. These were the chiefs of Edom, according to their settlements in the land they possessed. Esau was the father of the Edomites.
ekegusii: na omogambi Magadieli, na omogambi Iramu. Aba nabwo abagaambi barwete ase ororeeria rw’Edomu, koreng’ana buna bamenyete chinsemo chiabo ase ense eria bairete ekaba eyabo. (Esau nere sokoro bw’Abaedomu).
swahili: Magdieli na Iramu. Hawa ndio walikuwa wakuu wa Edomu, kufuatana na makazi yao katika nchi waliyoimiliki. Huyu ndiye alikuwa Esau, baba wa Waedomu.

english: and Oholibamah gave birth to Jeush, Jalam, and Korah. These were the sons of Esau, who were born to him in the land of Canaan.
ekegusii: na Oholibama akaibora Yeusi, na Yalamu, na Kora. Aba nabwo abana abamura Esau aiboreretwe ase ense ya Kaanani.
