swahili: Oholibama akamzaa Yeushi, Yalamu na Kora. Hawa ndio wana wa Esau waliozaliwa kwake huko Kanaani.

english: Later, Esau took his wives and sons and daughters and all the people of his household, along with his livestock, all his other animals, and all the property he had acquired in Canaan, and he moved to a land far away from his brother Jacob.
ekegusii: Erio Esau akaimokia abakungu baye, na abana baye abamura na abaiseke, na abanto bonsi ababwate abwo bwoye, ne chiombe chiaye, ne ching’iti chiaye chionsi echi atugete, na enibo yaye yonsi eyaniberete ase ense ya Kaanani; akagenda agaika ase ense yareenge aare korwa ase Yakobo omwabo.
swahili: Esau akawachukua wake zake, watoto wake wa kiume na wa kike na wote wa nyumbani mwake, mifugo yake pamoja na wanyama wake wengine wote na mali yake yote ambayo alikuwa ameipata akiwa Kanaani, akahamia katika nchi iliyo mbali na Yakobo ndugu yake.

english: For their possessions were too great for them to dwell together; the land where they stayed could not support them because of their livestock.
ekegusii: Ekiagera babwate enibo enyinge tibare konyara komenya amo; na ense eria tiyare kobaisana bamenye babere bonsi ne chitugo chiabo.
swahili: Mali zao zilikuwa nyingi sana kiasi kwamba haikuwa rahisi wao kuishi pamoja, nchi waliyokuwa wakiishi isingewatosha wote kwa ajili ya mifugo yao.

english: So Esau (that is, Edom) settled in the area of Mount Seir.
ekegusii: Ase igo Esau, oyokorokwa naende Edomu, akaba okomenya ase ense y’ebitunwa bia Edomu.
swahili: Kwa hiyo Esau (ambaye ni Edomu) aliishi katika nchi ya kilima huko Seiri.

english: This is the account of Esau, the father of the Edomites, in the area of Mount Seir.
ekegusii: Oyo noro omooroberio bw’ororeeria rwa Esau ise Edomu, ase ense y’ebitunwa bia Edomu.
swahili: Hawa ndio wazao wa Esau, baba wa Waedomu, katika nchi ya kilima cha Seiri.

english: Now Jacob lived in the land where his father had resided, the land of Canaan.
ekegusii: Yakobo akaba okomenya ase ense y’Abakaanani, eyio ase ise nere areenge omenyete buna omomenyi.
swahili: Yakobo akaishi Kanaani katika nchi ambayo baba yake alikuwa ameishi.

english: He told his father and brothers, but his father rebuked him and said, “What is this dream that you have had? Will your mother and brothers and I actually come and bow down to the ground before you?”
ekegusii: Korende ekero ateebetie ise na bamura bamwabo amang’ana ayio, ise akamotogonyera, akamobooria: “nkoroota ki okwo okoroota? Inee! Inche na nyoko, na bamura bamino, amaene, nigo torache togotugamere togosasime aye?”
swahili: Alipomwambia baba yake pamoja na ndugu zake, baba yake akamkemea akisema, “Ni ndoto gani hii uliyoota? Hivi kweli mama yako na mimi na ndugu zako tutakuja kukusujudia wewe hadi nchi?”

english: And his brothers were jealous of him, but his father kept in mind what he had said. Joseph Sold into Egypt (Acts 7:9–14)
ekegusii: Abamwabo bakamobwaterwa ribero, korende ise ere akagacha ogokwana okwo ase enkoro yaye ime. Yusufu okoonigwa nabamwabo na koirwa Misiri
swahili: Ndugu zake wakamwonea wivu, lakini baba yake akaliweka jambo hilo moyoni. Yosefu Auzwa Na Ndugu Zake

english: Some time later, Joseph’s brothers had gone to pasture their father’s flocks near Shechem.
ekegusii: Erio abamwabo bakagenda korisia amaicho a ise ang’e na Sekemu.
swahili: Basi, ndugu zake walikuwa wamekwenda kuchunga makundi ya baba yao karibu na Shekemu,

english: Israel said to him, “Are not your brothers pasturing the flocks at Shechem? Get ready; I am sending you to them.” “I am ready,” Joseph replied.
ekegusii: Na Israeli akarangeria Yusufu, akamoteebia: “Inee! Abamino tibakari korisia amaicho aaria Sekemu? Inchuo bono ngotome gochia ase bakare.” Yusufu agaitaba: “Nao inde aa.”
swahili: naye Israeli akamwambia Yosefu, “Kama ujuavyo, ndugu zako wanachunga makundi huko karibu na Shekemu. Njoo, nitakutuma kwao.” Yosefu akajibu, “Vema sana, niko tayari.”

english: Then Israel told him, “Go now and see how your brothers and the flocks are faring, and bring word back to me.” So he sent him off from the Valley of Hebron. And when Joseph arrived in Shechem,
ekegusii: Ise akamoteebia: “Genda bono orore gose abamino mbuya bare amo namaicho, erinde ondetere amang’ana.” Ase igo, akamotoma korwa ase omweya o Heburoni, akageenda agaika Sekemu;
swahili: Kwa hiyo akamwambia, “Nenda uone kama mambo yote ni salama kwa ndugu zako na makundi, kisha uniletee habari.” Ndipo akamtuma Yosefu kutoka Bonde la Hebroni. Yosefu alipofika Shekemu,

english: a man found him wandering in the field and asked, “What are you looking for?”
ekegusii: omonto oyomo akamonyora, ekero areenge kona‐goetanana ase erooro, na omonto oyio akamobooria: “Inki okorigia?”
swahili: mtu mmoja akamkuta akizungukazunguka mashambani na akamuuliza, “Unatafuta nini?”

english: “I am looking for my brothers,” Joseph replied. “Can you please tell me where they are pasturing their flocks?”
ekegusii: Akamoiraneria: “Nabaminto nkorigia; koranche nteebie aase bakorisia amaicho.”
swahili: Akajibu, “Ninawatafuta ndugu zangu. Unaweza kuniambia wanachunga wapi makundi yao?”

english: “They have moved on from here,” the man answered. “I heard them say, ‘Let us go to Dothan.’” So Joseph set out after his brothers and found them at Dothan.
ekegusii: Omonto oria akabateebia: “Barure aa, bachiire, naki nigo nabaigwa bagoteebania: Tiga togende Dotani.” Erio Yusufu akababwatia korwa magega, akabanyora Dotani.
swahili: Yule mtu akajibu, “Wamehama hapa. Nilisikia wakisema, ‘Twende Dothani.’ ” Kwa hiyo Yosefu akawafuatilia ndugu zake na kuwakuta karibu na Dothani.

english: Now Joseph’s brothers saw him in the distance, and before he arrived, they plotted to kill him.
ekegusii: Barabwo bakamorora ere okare egeka, ritang’ani konya ataraika ang’e asebare, bakagaamba buna bamoite.
swahili: Ndugu zake walipomwona akiwa mbali, kabla hajawafikia, wakapanga shauri baya la kumuua.

english: “Here comes that dreamer!” they said to one another.
ekegusii: Barabwo bagateebania: “Omonyandooto oyio ogocha.
swahili: Wakaambiana, “Yule mwota ndoto anakuja!

english: This is the account of Jacob. When Joseph was seventeen years old, he was tending the flock with his brothers, the sons of his father’s wives Bilhah and Zilpah, and he brought their father a bad report about them.
ekegusii: Oyo noro omogano bw’ororeeria rwa Yakobo. Yusufu, ekero aikire emiaka ikomi, na etano na ebere, nigo areenge korisia amaicho amo na bamura bamwabo. Omosae oyio akaba ore amo nabamura bamwabo, abana ba Bilia na Silpa, abakungu ba ise. Yusufu akaba okorentera ise amang’ana igoro y’ogokora kwabo okobe.
swahili: Zifuatazo ni habari za Yakobo. Yosefu, kijana wa miaka kumi na saba, alikuwa akichunga makundi ya kondoo na mbuzi pamoja na ndugu zake wa mama wengine, yaani wana wa Bilha na wana wa Zilpa wake za baba yake, naye akawa akimletea baba yake taarifa mbaya kuhusu hao ndugu zake.

english: “Come now, let us kill him and throw him into one of the pits. We can say that a vicious animal has devoured him. Then we shall see what becomes of his dreams!”
ekegusii: Bono ntore ne ribaga; tiga tomoite, tomorute ase engoro eyemo ye chingoro chire aa, erio toteebe ng’a neng’iti y’orosana yamoriete, na torore chindoto echio chiaye buna chirabe.”
swahili: Njooni sasa, tumuue na kumtupa katika shimo mojawapo na tuseme kwamba mnyama mkali amemrarua. Kisha tutaona matokeo ya ndoto zake.”

english: When Reuben heard this, he tried to rescue Joseph from their hands. “Let us not take his life,” he said.
ekegusii: Rubeni ekero ayaigwete, akarigia komotooria korwa ase amaboko abo, akabakania: “Yaya! Titomoita akwe.”
swahili: Reubeni aliposikia jambo hili, akajaribu kumwokoa kutoka mikononi mwao akasema, “Tusiutoe uhai wake.

english: “Do not shed his blood. Throw him into this pit in the wilderness, but do not lay a hand on him.” Reuben said this so that he could rescue Joseph from their hands and return him to his father.
ekegusii: Naende akabateebia: “Timoitera amanyinga aye; morute ase engoro eyemo y’echi chire aa ase erooro, korende timorambora amaboko aino gochia asare ase okomoita.” Ere nigo abateebetie igo, erinde anyare komotooria korwa ase amaboko abo, amoiranie ase ise.
swahili: Tusimwage damu yoyote. Mtupeni katika shimo lililoko hapa jangwani, lakini msimguse.” Reubeni alisema hivyo ili amwokoe kutoka mikononi mwao, kisha amrudishe nyumbani kwa baba yake.

english: So when Joseph came to his brothers, they stripped him of his robe—the robe of many colors he was wearing—
ekegusii: Ekaba ekero Yusufu achia goika ase abamwabo, barabwo bakamorusia eanga eria engiya entambe abeegete,
swahili: Kwa hiyo Yosefu alipowafikia ndugu zake, walimvua lile joho lake, lile joho lililorembwa vizuri alilokuwa amevaa.

english: and they took him and threw him into the pit. Now the pit was empty, with no water in it.
ekegusii: bakamobwata, bakamoruta engoro ime. Engoro eyio nigo yareenge bosa, mache tareengeo.
swahili: Kisha wakamchukua wakamtupa katika shimo. Wakati huo shimo lilikuwa tupu, halikuwa na maji ndani yake.

english: And as they sat down to eat a meal, they looked up and saw a caravan of Ishmaelites coming from Gilead. Their camels were carrying spices, balm, and myrrh on their way down to Egypt.
ekegusii: Erio bagaikaransa inse koragera; bagachia koimokia amaiso abo korigereria, bakarora omoganda bw’Abaisumaeli ogocha korwa Gileadi. Barabwo nigo baare ne chingamia chiabo, chibogoretie ubani, na amaguta akogwenia, na manemane, ase orogendo rwabo baare kogenda Misiri.
swahili: Walipokaa ili wale chakula chao, wakainua macho wakaona msafara wa Waishmaeli ukija kutoka Gileadi. Ngamia wao walikuwa wamepakizwa mizigo ya vikolezo, uvumba na manemane, nao walikuwa njiani kuvipeleka Misri.

english: Then Judah said to his brothers, “What profit will we gain if we kill our brother and cover up his blood?
ekegusii: Agwo Yuda agateebia abamwabo: “Inki eratogwenere toite oyominto na kobisa ogokwa kwaye?
swahili: Yuda akawaambia ndugu zake, “Tutafaidi nini ikiwa tutamuua ndugu yetu na kuificha damu yake?

english: Come, let us sell him to the Ishmaelites and not lay a hand on him; for he is our brother, our own flesh.” And they agreed.
ekegusii: Tiga tomoonie ase Abaisumaeli aba, erinde titobaisa komoita namaboko aito, ekiagera noyominto, toiboire komo.” Na abamwabo bagancherana nere.
swahili: Njooni, tumuuze kwa hawa Waishmaeli. Tusimguse, kwa kuwa hata hivyo yeye ni ndugu yetu, nyama yetu na damu yetu wenyewe.” Ndugu zake wakakubali.

english: So when the Midianite traders passed by, his brothers pulled Joseph out of the pit and sold him for twenty shekels of silver to the Ishmaelites, who took him to Egypt.
ekegusii: Erio Abamidiani bagaeta aroro, baare gokora oboonchoreria; abamwabo bakarusia Yusufu korwa ase engoro eria, na komooneria Abaisumaeli ase chisekeli chi’echifeta emerongo ebere; barabwo bakamoira goika Misiri.
swahili: Kwa hiyo wale wafanyabiashara Wamidiani walipofika pale, ndugu zake wakamtoa Yosefu kutoka kwenye lile shimo, na kumuuza kwa shekeli ishirini za fedha kwa wale Waishmaeli, ambao walimpeleka Misri.

english: When Reuben returned to the pit and saw that Joseph was not there, he tore his clothes,
ekegusii: Rubeni agachia koirana korigereria ase engoro eria, akanyora Yusufu taiyo ase engoro, ere agatandora chianga chiaye,
swahili: Reubeni aliporudi kutazama kwenye lile shimo na kuona kwamba Yosefu hayupo, alirarua nguo zake.

english: Now Israel loved Joseph more than his other sons, because Joseph had been born to him in his old age; so he made him a robe of many colors.
ekegusii: Bono Israeli nigo anchete Yusufu kobua abana baye bande bonsi, ekiagera nigo areenge omwana oye bw’obogotu. Akamoroiseria eanga engiya entambe.
swahili: Basi, Israeli akampenda Yosefu kuliko yeyote miongoni mwa kaka zake, kwani ni mwanawe wa uzeeni, akamshonea joho lililorembwa vizuri sana.

english: returned to his brothers, and said, “The boy is gone! What am I going to do?” Jacob Mourns Joseph
ekegusii: akeonchora gochia ase abamwabo, akabateebia: “Omwana timonyoreti ase engoro. Ng’ai rende nkogenda?”
swahili: Akawarudia ndugu zake na kusema, “Kijana hayuko mle! Nielekee wapi sasa?”

english: Then they took Joseph’s robe, slaughtered a young goat, and dipped the robe in its blood.
ekegusii: Erio bakaimokia eanga ya Yusufu, na bakanyenya embori, bakaimokia eanga eria, bakayetobeka ase amanyinga;
swahili: Kisha wakalichukua lile joho la Yosefu, wakachinja mbuzi na kulichovya katika damu.

english: They sent the robe of many colors to their father and said, “We found this. Examine it to see whether it is your son’s robe or not.”
ekegusii: bakagenda n’eanga eria entambe bakayeirera ise, bakamobateebia: “Yemanye eanga eye gose ney’omwana oo gose tari ero.”
swahili: Wakalichukua lile joho lililorembwa vizuri na kulipeleka kwa baba yao na kusema, “Tumeliokota hili joho. Uchunguze uone kama ni la mwanao.”

english: His father recognized it and said, “It is my son’s robe! A vicious animal has devoured him. Joseph has surely been torn to pieces!”
ekegusii: Yakobo akayemanya, akabora: “Neanga y’omwana one, amaene neching’iti chi’orosana chiamoitire; Yusufu orirwe!”
swahili: Baba yao akalitambua akasema, “Hili ni joho la mwanangu! Mnyama mkali amemrarua. Hakika Yosefu ameraruliwa vipande vipande.”

english: Then Jacob tore his clothes, put sackcloth around his waist, and mourned for his son many days.
ekegusii: Erio Yakobo agatandora chianga chiaye, akeboyia chigunia kenema kiaye, akaba okomoreera omwana oye engaki entambe.
swahili: Kisha Yakobo akararua nguo zake, akavaa nguo ya gunia na kumwombolezea mwanawe kwa siku nyingi.

english: All his sons and daughters tried to comfort him, but he refused to be comforted. “No,” he said. “I will go down to Sheol mourning for my son.” So his father wept for him.
ekegusii: Abana baye, abamura na abaiseke bonsi, bakaimoka gochia komoremia, korende akaanga, taremigwa, agateeba: “Yaya, goika inkwe, ngende inse ase oboina nkona‐komoreera omwana one.” Ise akaba okona‐kweumia.
swahili: Wanawe wote na binti zake wakaja kumfariji, lakini hakukubali kufarijiwa. Akasema, “Hapana, nitamwombolezea mwanangu mpaka nimfikie kaburini.” Kwa hiyo baba yake akaendelea kumlilia.

english: Meanwhile, the Midianites sold Joseph in Egypt to Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh and captain of the guard.
ekegusii: Na Abamidiani baria bakamoonia aaria Misiri ase Potifari, omoteneneri bw’enka ya Farao na omotang’ani bw’abarendi baye bande.
swahili: Wakati ule ule, Wamidiani wakamuuza Yosefu huko Misri kwa Potifa, mmojawapo wa maafisa wa Farao, aliyekuwa mkuu wa ulinzi.

english: When Joseph’s brothers saw that their father loved him more than any of them, they hated him and could not speak a kind word to him.
ekegusii: Abamwabo ekero barooche ng’a ise nigo amwanchete ere kobua abamwabo bonsi, barabwo bakamogecha, tibare gokwana amang’ana y’omorembe amo nere.
swahili: Ndugu zake walipoona kwamba baba yao anampenda Yosefu kuliko yeyote mwingine miongoni mwao, walimchukia na hawakusema naye neno lolote jema.

english: Then Joseph had a dream, and when he told it to his brothers, they hated him even more.
ekegusii: Yusufu akaroota chindoto, na ekero ateebetie abamwabo chindoto echio, barabwo bakamenta mono komogecha.
swahili: Yosefu akaota ndoto, naye alipowaeleza ndugu zake, wakamchukia zaidi.

english: He said to them, “Listen to this dream I had:
ekegusii: Yusufu akabateebia: “Montegerere, moigwe okoroota oko narootete.
swahili: Akawaambia, “Sikilizeni ndoto niliyoota:

english: We were binding sheaves of grain in the field, and suddenly my sheaf rose and stood upright, while your sheaves gathered around and bowed down to mine.”
ekegusii: Nkarora ng’a intwe nigo twareenge mogondo tokoboa emesaima y’endagera, na omosaima one okaimoka ogatenena boronge, na emesaima yaino ekaba ekoyoetanana, egotugama inse ase omosaima one.”
swahili: Tulikuwa tukifunga miganda ya nafaka shambani, ghafula mganda wangu ukasimama wima, wakati miganda yenu ikiuzunguka na kuuinamia.”

english: “Do you intend to reign over us?” his brothers asked. “Will you actually rule us?” So they hated him even more because of his dream and his statements.
ekegusii: Abamwabo bakamobooria: “Inee! Aye nigo orengereretie ng’a nigo orabe omogambi oito, otogambere?” Ase igo, barabwo bakamenta komogecha mono ase engencho y’okoroota kwaye, na ase engencho y’amang’ana aye.
swahili: Ndugu zake wakamwambia, “Wewe unakusudia kututawala? Hivi kweli wewe utatutawala sisi?” Wakaongeza kumchukia zaidi kwa sababu ya ndoto yake pamoja na yale aliyowaambia.

english: Then Joseph had another dream and told it to his brothers. “Look,” he said, “I had another dream, and this time the sun and moon and eleven stars were bowing down to me.”
ekegusii: Naende akaroota konde, na okwo agateebia abamwabo, akabora: “Moigwe! Inche nigo narootete okoroota konde. Nkarora erioba, na omotienyi, ne ching’enang’eni ikomi nemo bigotugama inse ase obosio bwane.”
swahili: Kisha akaota ndoto nyingine, akawaambia ndugu zake akisema, “Sikilizeni, nimeota ndoto nyingine, wakati huu jua, mwezi na nyota kumi na moja zilikuwa zinanisujudia.”

english: About that time, Judah left his brothers and settled near a man named Hirah, an Adullamite.
ekegusii: Ekaba ase engaki eria Yuda agatigana n’abamwabo, agatirimboka, agaika ase omonto gete Omoadulamu ore korokwa Hira, bakabwatana nere.
swahili: Wakati ule, Yuda akawaacha ndugu zake, akaenda kuishi na Hira Mwadulami.

english: What he did was wicked in the sight of the LORD, so He put Onan to death as well.
ekegusii: Ayio akorete akaba amabe ase obosio bwa Nyasae Omobui, nere Omonene akamoita.
swahili: Alichofanya kilikuwa kiovu machoni pa Bwana, hivyo, pia Bwana akamuua Onani.

english: Then Judah said to his daughter-in-law Tamar, “Live as a widow in your father’s house until my son Shelah grows up.” For he thought, “He may die too, like his brothers.” So Tamar went to live in her father’s house.
ekegusii: Erio Yuda agateebia Tamari, moka momura oye: “Genda omenye buna omoboraka ase omochie o iso goika Sela omwana one akine”; naki nigo oboete ng’a nere nabaise gocha gokwa, buna abamwabo bakwete. Ase igo, Tamari akagenda akamenya o ise. Okomocha kwa Yuda
swahili: Kisha Yuda akamwambia Tamari mkwewe, “Ishi kama mjane nyumbani mwa baba yako mpaka mwanangu Shela atakapokua.” Kwa maana alifikiri, “Angeweza kufa pia kama ndugu zake.” Kwa hiyo Tamari alikwenda kuishi nyumbani kwa baba yake.

english: After a long time Judah’s wife, the daughter of Shua, died. When Judah had finished mourning, he and his friend Hirah the Adullamite went up to his sheepshearers at Timnah.
ekegusii: Magega ya amatuko make, moiseke o Sua, moka Yuda, agakwa; Yuda gakoorire okomoreera, agatiira gochia Timuna ase abanachi amarionya be ching’ondi chiaye, amo nomosani oye Hira Omoadulamu.
swahili: Baada ya muda mrefu mke wa Yuda binti wa Shua akafariki. Baada ya msiba, Yuda alikwenda Timna, kwa watu waliokuwa wakikata kondoo wake manyoya, naye alifuatana na rafiki yake Hira Mwadulami.

english: When Tamar was told, “Your father-in-law is going up to Timnah to shear his sheep,”
ekegusii: Ekero Tamari ateebetigwe ng’a ise biara ’nkogenda akare Timuna konacha ching’ondi chiaye amarionya,
swahili: Tamari alipoambiwa, “Baba mkwe wako yuko njiani kwenda Timna kukata kondoo wake manyoya,”

english: she removed her widow’s garments, covered her face with a veil to disguise herself, and sat at the entrance to Enaim, which is on the way to Timnah. For she saw that although Shelah had grown up, she had not been given to him as a wife.
ekegusii: akarusia chianga chiaye chi’ogokobania, akeboyia chianga na gwetuba obosio bwaye, agaikaransa geita ki’Enaimu, ang’e nenchera ekogenda Timuna; naki nigo arooche ng’a Sela obeire omonto omonene, na tamoeiri amotware.
swahili: alivua mavazi yake ya ujane, akajifunika kwa shela ili asifahamike, akaketi kwenye mlango wa Enaimu, ambao upo njiani kuelekea Timna. Akafanya hivyo kwa sababu aliona kwamba, ingawa Shela amekua, lakini alikuwa hajakabidhiwa kwake kuwa mkewe.

english: When Judah saw her, he thought she was a prostitute because she had covered her face.
ekegusii: Ekero Yuda amorooche, agakaga ng’a nomokuungu omotayayi, ekiagera nigo atubete obosio bwaye.
swahili: Yuda alipomwona alifikiri ni kahaba, kwa sababu alikuwa amefunika uso wake.

english: Not realizing that she was his daughter-in-law, he went over to her and said, “Come now, let me sleep with you.” “What will you give me for sleeping with you?” she inquired.
ekegusii: Yuda akagobera gochia asare enchera ensemo, akamoteebia: “Inyanchere ’mbe naye,” naki tamanyete gose moka momura oye orenge. Tamari akamobooria: “Inki orang’e, erinde osoe ase ’nde?”
swahili: Pasipo kutambua kwamba alikuwa mkwe wake, akamwendea kando ya njia na kumwambia, “Njoo sasa, nikutane na wewe kimwili.” Yule mkwewe akamuuliza, “Utanipa nini nikikutana nawe kimwili?”

english: “I will send you a young goat from my flock,” Judah answered. But she replied, “Only if you leave me something as a pledge until you send it.”
ekegusii: Akamoiraneria: “Ninche ngotomera emaanwa egoree korwa ase riicho riane.” Omokungu oria akamobooria: “Inee! Inki orang’e kebe intenenera goika kwayentomeire?”
swahili: Akamwambia, “Nitakutumia mwana-mbuzi kutoka kundi langu.” Akamuuliza, “Utanipa kitu chochote kama amana mpaka utakapompeleka?”

english: “What pledge should I give you?” he asked. She answered, “Your seal and your cord, and the staff in your hand.” So he gave them to her and slept with her, and she became pregnant by him.
ekegusii: Akamobooria: “Ngento ki origetie nkoe kebe intenenera?” Akamoiraneria: “Ebonyi yao ere nekemanyererio, na orokini rwao, na enyimbo yao obwate koboko.” Erio akamobia, akaraara nere, na ere akaba morito.
swahili: Akamuuliza, “Nikupe amana gani?” Akamjibu, “Pete yako na kamba yake pamoja na fimbo iliyo mkononi mwako.” Kwa hiyo akampa vitu hivyo kisha akakutana naye kimwili, naye akapata mimba yake.

english: Then Tamar got up and departed. And she removed her veil and put on her widow’s garments again.
ekegusii: Erio akaimoka akagenda, akarusia egietubo, akabeeka chianga chiaye chi’ogokobania.
swahili: Tamari akaondoka, akavua shela yake akavaa tena nguo zake za ujane.

english: There Judah saw the daughter of a Canaanite man named Shua, and he took her as a wife and slept with her.
ekegusii: Aroro Yuda akarora moiseke o Sua, omoiseke bw’Omokaanani gete, akamonyuoma. Bakaba bakorara amo,
swahili: Huko Yuda akakutana na binti wa Kikanaani aitwaye Shua, akamwoa na akakutana naye kimwili,

english: Now when Judah sent his friend Hirah the Adullamite with the young goat to collect the items he had left with the woman, he could not find her.
ekegusii: Yuda akaa omosani oye Omoadulamu emaanwa egoree airere omokungu oria, erinde ere airanie ebinto biria amoete bibe intenenera, korende tamonyora.
swahili: Wakati ule ule, Yuda akamtuma rafiki yake Mwadulami apeleke yule mwana-mbuzi ili arudishiwe amana yake kutoka kwa yule mwanamke, lakini yule rafiki yake hakumkuta yule mwanamke.

english: He asked the men of that place, “Where is the shrine prostitute who was beside the road at Enaim?” “No shrine prostitute has been here,” they answered.
ekegusii: Omoadulamu oria akabooria abanto b’aase aria: “Ng’ai are omokungu oria omotayayi, oyorenge aa Enaimu enchera ensemo?” Bakamokania: “Omokungu omotayayi tana koba aa.”
swahili: Akawauliza watu wanaoishi mahali pale, “Yuko wapi yule kahaba wa mahali pa kuabudia miungu aliyekuwa kando ya barabara hapa Enaimu?” Wakamjibu, “Hajawahi kuwepo mwanamke yeyote kahaba wa mahali pa kuabudia miungu hapa.”

english: So Hirah returned to Judah and said, “I could not find her, and furthermore, the men of that place said, ‘No shrine prostitute has been here.’”
ekegusii: Ase igo, akairana gochia ase Yuda, akabateebia: “Timonyoreti; naboigo nonya nabaanto b’aase aria nigo bankania ng’a mokuungu motayayi tana kobao.”
swahili: Kwa hiyo akamrudia Yuda na kumwambia, “Sikumpata. Zaidi ya hayo, watu wanaoishi mahali pale walisema ‘Hapakuwahi kuwepo mwanamke yeyote kahaba wa mahali pa kuabudia miungu hapa.’ ”

english: “Let her keep the items,” Judah replied. “Otherwise we will become a laughingstock. After all, I did send her this young goat, but you could not find her.”
ekegusii: Yuda akabora: “Tiga atware ebinto ebio namoete bibe intenenera, titobaisa gocha kororekana nobosooku. Rora, namotomerete emaanwa egoree, na aye tikwamonyorete.”
swahili: Kisha Yuda akasema, “Mwache avichukue vitu hivyo, ama sivyo tutakuwa kichekesho. Hata hivyo, nilimpelekea mwana-mbuzi, lakini hukumkuta.”

english: About three months later, Judah was told, “Your daughter-in-law Tamar has prostituted herself, and now she is pregnant.” “Bring her out!” Judah replied. “Let her be burned to death!”
ekegusii: Ekaba magega y’emetienyi etato Yuda ateebetigwe ng’a Tamari, moka momura oye, okorire obotomani bw’obotayayi; amo nayio morito are ase obotayayi. Erio Yuda akabora: “Mosokie isiko, asambwe nomorero.”
swahili: Baada ya miezi mitatu Yuda akaambiwa, “Tamari mkweo ana hatia ya kuwa kahaba, na matokeo yake ana mimba.” Yuda akasema, “Mtoeni nje na achomwe moto hadi afe!”

english: As she was being brought out, Tamar sent a message to her father-in-law: “I am pregnant by the man to whom these items belong.” And she added, “Please examine them. Whose seal and cord and staff are these?”
ekegusii: Gasokiigwe isiko agatoma abanto ase ise biara, bamoteebie: “Omonto omonyene ebinto ebi, nere ong’ete oborito obo.” Naende akabora: “Manya ebonyi eyio ere nekemanyererio, na orokini oro, na enyimbo eye, gose nebiang’o.”
swahili: Alipokuwa akitolewa nje, akatuma ujumbe kwa baba mkwe wake kusema, “Nina mimba ya mtu mwenye vitu hivi.” Akaongeza kusema, “Angalia kama utatambua kwamba pete hii na kamba yake pamoja na fimbo hii ni vya nani.”

english: Judah recognized the items and said, “She is more righteous than I, since I did not give her to my son Shelah.” And he did not have relations with her again. The Birth of Perez and Zerah
ekegusii: Erio Yuda akabimanya, akabora: “Ere nomooronge kombua, nigo akora ayio, ekiagera ntamoete Sela, omwana one, amotware.” Erio Yuda tarara nere naende.
swahili: Yuda akavitambua na kusema, “Yeye ana haki kuliko mimi, kwa kuwa sikumkabidhi kwa mwanangu Shela ili awe mkewe.” Tangu hapo hakukutana naye kimwili tena.

english: When the time came for Tamar to give birth, there were twins in her womb.
ekegusii: Ekero engaki yaye y’okoibora yachia goika, akarorekana ore ne chibarongo enda yaye ime.
swahili: Wakati ulipofika wa kujifungua, kukawa na wana mapacha tumboni mwake.

english: And as she was giving birth, one of them put out his hand; so the midwife took a scarlet thread and tied it around his wrist. “This one came out first,” she announced.
ekegusii: Ekero areenge koibora, omwana oyomo agatang’ania okoboko isiko, na omoiboria akamosibera okoboko okwo eusi embariri, agateeba: “Oyo nere otanga gosoka isiko.”
swahili: Alipokuwa akijifungua, mmoja akatoa mkono wake nje, kwa hiyo mkunga akachukua uzi mwekundu na kuufunga mkononi mwa yule mtoto, akasema, “Huyu ametoka kwanza.”

english: But when he pulled his hand back and his brother came out, she said, “You have broken out first!” So he was named Perez.
ekegusii: Kairanirie okoboko kwaye, rora, oyomwabo akaromeng’ana, agasoka isiko. Erio omoiboria agateeba: “Naki okoromeng’ana ne chinguru iga?” Ase ayio bakamoroka Peresi.
swahili: Lakini alipourudisha mkono wake ndugu yake akaanza kutoka, naye akasema, “Hivi ndivyo ulivyotoka kwa nguvu!” Akaitwa Peresi.

english: So she conceived and gave birth to a son, and Judah named him Er.
ekegusii: na moiseke o Sua akaba morito, akaibora omwana omoisia, akamoroka Eri.
swahili: akapata mimba, akamzaa mwana, ambaye alimwita Eri.

english: Then his brother came out with the scarlet thread around his wrist, and he was named Zerah.
ekegusii: Magega yaye oyomwabo agasoka ore neusi embariri koboko kwaye. Nere akarokwa Zera.
swahili: Kisha ndugu yake, aliyekuwa na uzi mwekundu mkononi, akatoka, naye akaitwa Zera.

english: Again she conceived and gave birth to a son, and she named him Onan.
ekegusii: Naende akaba morito, akaibora omwana omoisia, akamoroka Onani.
swahili: Akapata mimba tena, akamzaa mwana na kumwita Onani.

english: Then she gave birth to another son and named him Shelah; it was at Chezib that she gave birth to him.
ekegusii: Akaba morito naende, akaibora omwana omoisia, akamoroka Sela. Yuda nere nao areenge aria Kisibo ekero amoiborerete abana.
swahili: Akamzaa mwana mwingine tena, akamwita Shela. Huyu alimzalia mahali paitwapo Kezibu.

english: Now Judah acquired a wife for Er, his firstborn, and her name was Tamar.
ekegusii: Na Yuda akanyuomeria Eri, omwana oye omotangi, omokungu ore korokwa Tamari.
swahili: Yuda akampatia Eri, mzaliwa wake wa kwanza, mke aitwaye Tamari.

english: But Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wicked in the sight of the LORD; so the LORD put him to death.
ekegusii: Nere Eri, omomura omotangi o Yuda, nigo areenge omobe ase obosio bw’Omonene; ase ayio Omonene akamoita.
swahili: Lakini Eri, mzaliwa wa kwanza wa Yuda, alikuwa mwovu machoni pa Bwana, kwa hiyo Bwana akamuua.

english: Then Judah said to Onan, “Sleep with your brother’s wife. Perform your duty as her brother-in-law and raise up offspring for your brother.”
ekegusii: Erio Yuda agateebia Onani: “Motware moka momura omino, erinde omotenenerie egesaku.”
swahili: Kisha Yuda akamwambia Onani, “Kutana kimwili na mke wa ndugu yako, na utimize wajibu wako kwake kama mke wa ndugu yako, ili umpatie ndugu yako uzao.”

english: But Onan knew that the offspring would not belong to him; so whenever he would sleep with his brother’s wife, he would spill his seed on the ground so that he would not produce offspring for his brother.
ekegusii: Korende Onani akamanya ng’a abana abwo agochia koibora tibari gochia korokwa abaye. Kera engaki, arekoba na moka momura omwabo, ekero embego y’oroiboro ere nchera gocha, asomora aitera inse, ng’a erio tabaisa goteneneria oyomwabo egesaku.
swahili: Lakini Onani alijua kwamba uzao haungekuwa wake, kwa hiyo kila alipokutana kimwili na mke wa ndugu yake, alimwaga chini mbegu za kiume ili asimpatie ndugu yake uzao.

english: Meanwhile, Joseph had been taken down to Egypt, where an Egyptian named Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh and captain of the guard, bought him from the Ishmaelites who had taken him there.
ekegusii: Bono Yusufu agatirimbokigwa gochia Misiri; na Potifari, omoteneneri bw’enka ya Farao na omotang’ani bw’abarendi baye bande, omonto o Misiri, akamogora korwa ase Abaisumaeli, abwo bamotirimbogetie gochia aroro.
swahili: Wakati huu Yosefu alikuwa amechukuliwa mpaka Misri. Mmisri aliyeitwa Potifa aliyekuwa mmojawapo wa maafisa wa Farao, mkuu wa ulinzi, akamnunua Yosefu kutoka kwa Waishmaeli waliomleta Misri.

english: Although Potiphar’s wife spoke to Joseph day after day, he refused to go to bed with her or even be near her.
ekegusii: Akaba okonagokwana na Yusufu rituko ase rituko, korende Yusufu tamwanchera baraare komo, gose koba amo.
swahili: Ingawa yule mwanamke aliendelea kumshawishi Yosefu siku baada ya siku, Yosefu alikataa kukutana naye kimwili wala kukaa karibu naye.

english: One day, however, Joseph went into the house to attend to his work, and not a single household servant was inside.
ekegusii: Ekaba rituko erimo, ekero Yusufu asoete nyomba gokora emeremo yaye, gose monto onde bw’abaanto b’enyomba eria tareengeo,
swahili: Siku moja Yosefu akaingia ndani ya nyumba kufanya kazi zake, wala hapakuwepo na mfanyakazi yeyote ndani ya nyumba.

english: She grabbed Joseph by his cloak and said, “Sleep with me!” But leaving his cloak in her hand, he escaped and ran outside. Joseph Falsely Imprisoned
ekegusii: omokungu oria akamobwata eanga yaye eyare kwambara, akabateebia: “Rara nainche.” Korende Yusufu agatigera omokungu oria eanga yaye eyare kwambara, agatama gochia isiko.
swahili: Mke wa Potifa akashika vazi Yosefu alilokuwa amevaa, akamwambia, “Njoo tukutane kimwili!” Lakini Yosefu akaacha vazi lake mkononi mwa huyo mwanamke, akatoka nje ya nyumba akikimbia.

english: When she saw that he had left his cloak in her hand and had run out of the house,
ekegusii: Omokungu oria, ekero arooche ng’a Yusufu omotigeire eanga yaye koboko kwaye, na gotama gochia isiko,
swahili: Yule mwanamke alipoona kwamba Yosefu amemwachia vazi lake mkononi na kukimbilia nje ya nyumba,

english: she called her household servants. “Look,” she said, “this Hebrew has been brought to us to make sport of us. He came to me so he could sleep with me, but I screamed as loud as I could.
ekegusii: akarangeria abanto ba nyomba mwaye, akabateebia: “Rigereria, omosacha one otorenteire omonto oyo Omoiberania ase egati yaito atokorere echeche; nigo acha ase ’nde ng’a araare nainche, na inche nakuura neriogi rinene.
swahili: akawaita watumishi wake wa nyumbani, akawaambia, “Tazameni! Huyu Mwebrania ameletwa hapa kutudhihaki! Aliingia hapa ndani ili akutane nami kimwili, lakini nikapiga kelele.

english: When he heard me scream for help, he left his cloak beside me and ran out of the house.”
ekegusii: Na ekero aigwa ng’a nakuurire neriogi rinene, ontigera eanga yaye koboko kwane, otama gochia isiko.”
swahili: Aliposikia kelele za kuomba msaada, akaacha vazi lake kando yangu akakimbilia nje.”

english: So Potiphar’s wife kept Joseph’s cloak beside her until his master came home.
ekegusii: Akagacha eanga eria goika omosacha oye agacha inka,
swahili: Yule mwanamke akaliweka lile vazi karibu naye mpaka Potifa aliporudi nyumbani.

english: Then she told him the same story: “The Hebrew slave you brought us came to me to make sport of me,
ekegusii: akamoteebia amang’ana ayio ayio, agateeba: “Omoiberania oyo omosomba kwarenta aa nabo asoa ase ’nde gonkorera echeche.
swahili: Ndipo akamweleza kisa hiki, akisema: “Yule mtumwa wa Kiebrania uliyetuletea alinijia ili kunidhihaki.

english: but when I screamed for help, he left his cloak beside me and ran out of the house.”
ekegusii: Korende ekero nachaka gokuura na goaka eriogi ontigera eanga yaye koboko kwane, otama gochia isiko.” Yusufu okobekwa echela
swahili: Lakini mara nilipopiga kelele kuomba msaada, akaliacha vazi lake kando yangu akakimbia nje ya nyumba.”

english: When his master heard the story his wife told him, saying, “This is what your slave did to me,” he burned with anger.
ekegusii: Ekero omonene o Yusufu achia koigwa aya mokaye amoteebirie ng’a: “Aya naro omosomba oo ankorera”, akaba nekeririanda ekenene.
swahili: Potifa aliposikia kisa hiki mkewe alichomweleza, akisema, “Hivi ndivyo mtumwa wako alivyonitenda.” Hasira ya Potifa ikawaka.

english: And the LORD was with Joseph, and he became a successful man, serving in the household of his Egyptian master.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo areenge amo na Yusufu, na ere akanyora ogosesenigwa. Yusufu akamenya ase enka y’omonene oye, oria Omomisiri.
swahili: Bwana alikuwa pamoja na Yosefu, naye akastawi, Yosefu akaishi nyumbani kwa bwana wake Mmisri.

english: So Joseph’s master took him and had him thrown into the prison where the king’s prisoners were confined. While Joseph was there in the prison,
ekegusii: Omonene oyio akabwata Yusufu, akamobeka echela ime, aase abasomba b’omorwoti basibire, na ere akaba agwo echela ime.
swahili: Potifa akamchukua Yosefu na kumweka gerezani, mahali ambapo wahalifu wa mfalme walikuwa wamefungwa. Lakini wakati Yosefu alipokuwa huko gerezani,

english: the LORD was with him and extended kindness to him, granting him favor in the eyes of the prison warden.
ekegusii: Korende Omonene akaba ore amo na Yusufu, akamokorera obuya, akamoa ogwancherwa ase omonene bw’echela.
swahili: Bwana alikuwa pamoja naye, akamhurumia na kumpa kibali mbele ya msimamizi wa gereza.

english: And the warden put all the prisoners under Joseph’s care, so that he was responsible for all that was done in the prison.
ekegusii: Omonene oria akabeeka abasibwa bonsi abwo baarenge echela ime ase amaboko a Yusufu; na onsi ayare gokoreka ase echela, ere akaba okoyakora.
swahili: Kwa hiyo msimamizi wa gereza akamweka Yosefu awe mkuu wa wafungwa pamoja na kusimamia yote ambayo yalitendeka mle gerezani.

english: The warden did not concern himself with anything under Joseph’s care, because the LORD was with Joseph and gave him success in whatever he did.
ekegusii: Na omonene oria bw’echela tachia goitaa kende gionsi kiare ase amaboko a Yusufu, ekiagera Omonene nigo areenge amo nere, na ande onsi are gokora, Omonene nigo are koyasesenia.
swahili: Msimamizi wa gereza hakujishughulisha tena na kitu chochote kilichokuwa chini ya uangalizi wa Yosefu, kwa sababu Bwana alikuwa pamoja na Yosefu akimfanikisha kwa kila alichofanya.

english: When his master saw that the LORD was with him and made him prosper in all he did,
ekegusii: Ere nigo arooche ng’a Omonene nigo areenge amo na Yusufu, ogerire ebinto bionsi biasesenigwe ase amaboko aye.
swahili: Potifa alipoona kuwa Bwana alikuwa pamoja na Yosefu na kwamba Bwana alimfanikisha kwa kila kitu alichokifanya,

english: Joseph found favor in his sight and became his personal attendant. Potiphar put him in charge of his household and entrusted him with everything he owned.
ekegusii: Ase igo,, Yusufu aganchwa mono ase obosio bw’omonene oye Potifari na akamobeka koba omokoreri oye; na ere akamobeka abe omoteneneri bw’enka yaye yonsi, na omorigereria bw’ebinto bionsi ebi abwate.
swahili: Yosefu alipata kibali machoni pa Potifa, akamfanya mhudumu wake. Potifa akamweka kuwa msimamizi wa nyumba yake, naye akamkabidhi kuwa mwangalizi wa kila kitu alichokuwa nacho.

english: From the time that he put Joseph in charge of his household and all he owned, the LORD blessed the Egyptian’s household on account of him. The LORD’s blessing was on everything he owned, both in his house and in his field.
ekegusii: Korwa engaki eyio amobegete abe omoteneneri igoro y’enka yaye, na bionsi ebi abwate. Omonene agasesenia Omomisiri oria ase engencho ya Yusufu, na ogosesenia kw’Omonene gokaba ase ebinto bionsi abwate ase enyomba na emegondo.
swahili: Kuanzia wakati huo Potifa alipomweka Yosefu kuwa msimamizi wa nyumba na mali zake zote alizokuwa nazo, Bwana aliibariki nyumba ya Mmisri huyo kwa sababu ya Yosefu. Baraka ya Bwana ilikuwa juu ya kila kitu alichokuwa nacho Potifa, nyumbani na shambani.

english: So Potiphar left all that he owned in Joseph’s care; he did not concern himself with anything except the food he ate. Now Joseph was well-built and handsome,
ekegusii: Ase igo, agatiga bionsi ebiareenge nabio ase amaboko a Yusufu; gose taba ogwechandera gento kende gionsi otatiga endagera yoka eria areenge koria. Yusufu na moka Potifari Yusufu nigo areenge omonto omerete buya, naende omonyakieni.
swahili: Kwa hiyo Potifa akamwachia Yosefu uangalizi wa kila kitu alichokuwa nacho, Yosefu alipokuwa katika uongozi, Potifa hakuwa na sababu ya kujishughulisha na kitu chochote isipokuwa chakula alichokula. Yosefu alikuwa mwenye umbo zuri na sura ya kuvutia;

english: and after some time his master’s wife cast her eyes upon Joseph and said, “Sleep with me.”
ekegusii: Magega y’engaki gete moka omonene oye akarigereria Yusufu ase okomogania, akamoteebia: “Inchuo oraare nainche!”
swahili: baada ya kitambo mke wa Potifa akamtamani Yosefu, akamwambia, “Njoo, ukutane nami kimwili!”

english: But he refused. “Look,” he said to his master’s wife, “with me here, my master does not concern himself with anything in his house, and he has entrusted everything he owns to my care.
ekegusii: Korende ere akaanga, agateebia moka omonene oye: “Rora, omonene one techandereti gento kende gionsi ase enka yaye, na bionsi ebi abwate obibekire ase amaboko aane.
swahili: Lakini Yosefu akakataa. Akamwambia yule mwanamke, “Mimi nikiwa katika uongozi, bwana wangu hahusiki na kitu chochote katika nyumba hii, kila kitu alicho nacho amenikabidhi.

english: No one in this house is greater than I am. He has withheld nothing from me except you, because you are his wife. So how could I do such a great evil and sin against God?”
ekegusii: Onde tari ase enyomba yaye oeire okobua otatiga inche, gose tantangeti gento kende gionsi otatiga aye bweka, ekiagera aye mokaye ore. Naki rende ndanyare gokora ebibe ebinene buna ebi, imomochere Nyasae?”
swahili: Hapa nyumbani hakuna aliye mkuu kuliko mimi. Bwana wangu hakunizuilia kitu chochote isipokuwa wewe, kwa kuwa wewe ni mke wake. Nitawezaje basi kufanya uovu huu na kutenda dhambi dhidi ya Mungu?”

english: Now the serpent was more crafty than any beast of the field that the LORD God had made. And he said to the woman, “Did God really say, ‘You must not eat from any tree in the garden?’”
ekegusii: Bono eng’iti engenda inse nigo yarenge eng’aini kobua ching’iti chinde chionsi, echi Omonene Nyasae akorete. Engiti ekaboria omokungu: “Inee! Namaene ng’a Nyasae nigo abakanetie ng’a timoria amatunda ’omote onde bwonsi ore mogondo?”
swahili: Basi nyoka alikuwa mwerevu kuliko wanyama wote wa porini ambao Bwana Mungu aliwafanya. Nyoka akamwambia mwanamke, “Ati kweli Mungu alisema, ‘Kamwe msile matunda ya mti wowote wa bustanini’?”

english: “I heard Your voice in the garden,” he replied, “and I was afraid because I was naked; so I hid myself.”
ekegusii: Ere akamoiraneria: “Nigo naigwa eriogi riao ase omogondo, noboa ase ayio nebisa ekiagera igo nde getirianda.”
swahili: Naye akajibu, “Nilikusikia katika bustani nikaogopa kwa sababu nilikuwa uchi, hivyo nikajificha.”

english: “Who told you that you were naked?” asked the LORD God. “Have you eaten from the tree of which I commanded you not to eat?”
ekegusii: Omonene akamobooria: “Ing’o ogoteebia ng’a ngetirianda ore? Inee! Nkwarire amatunda y’omote oria nagokanetie ng’a toria?”
swahili: Mungu akamuuliza, “Ni nani aliyekuambia ya kuwa ulikuwa uchi? Je, umekula matunda ya mti niliokuamuru usile?”

english: And the man answered, “The woman whom You gave me, she gave me fruit from the tree, and I ate it.”
ekegusii: Omonto oria akamoiraneria: “Omokungu oyo kwang’ete ng’a abe amo nainche, nere ong’ete amatunda y’omote oyio, na inche nkaria.”
swahili: Adamu akasema, “Huyu mwanamke uliyenipa awe pamoja nami alinipa sehemu ya tunda kutoka kwenye huo mti, nami nikala.”

english: Then the LORD God said to the woman, “What is this you have done?” “The serpent deceived me,” she replied, “and I ate.” The Fate of the Serpent
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene Nyasae akabooria omokungu oria: “Ninki kiagera gwakora aya?” Omokungu oria akamoiraneria: “Neng’iti yang’ainete, nkaria.” Omonene okorua okoragereria
swahili: Ndipo Bwana Mungu akamuuliza mwanamke, “Ni nini hili ambalo umelifanya?” Mwanamke akajibu, “Nyoka alinidanganya, nami nikala.”

english: So the LORD God said to the serpent: “Because you have done this, cursed are you above all livestock and every beast of the field! On your belly will you go, and dust you will eat, all the days of your life.
ekegusii: Omonene Nyasae agateebia eng’iti eria, “Ekiagera gwakorire aya, aye bweka kwaragererigwe kobua ching’iti chionsi; aye nenda oragendere, na orotu orarie buna endagera ase obogima bwao bwonsi.
swahili: Hivyo Bwana Mungu akamwambia nyoka, “Kwa kuwa umefanya hili, “Umelaaniwa kuliko wanyama wote wa kufugwa na wa porini! Utatambaa kwa tumbo lako na kula mavumbi siku zote za maisha yako.

english: And I will put enmity between you and the woman, and between your seed and her seed. He will crush your head, and you will strike his heel. ” The Punishment of Mankind
ekegusii: Inche nimbeeke obobisa ase egati yao na omokungu oyo, na ase egati y’oroiboro rwao na oroiboro rwaye; noroiboro orwo narogosenyente omotwe oo, na aye nomoorome egetingiro kiaye.”
swahili: Nami nitaweka uadui kati yako na huyo mwanamke, na kati ya uzao wako na wake, yeye atakuponda kichwa, nawe utamuuma kisigino.”

english: To the woman He said: “I will sharply increase your pain in childbirth; in pain you will bring forth children. Your desire will be for your husband, and he will rule over you.”
ekegusii: Akaonchokera omokungu, akamoteebia, “Ninkomentere emechando emeenge ekero okoba morito, na ekero okoibora abana nonyore obororo; nonya nabo okogania kwao nigo korabe ase omosacha oo, na ere nakogaambere.”
swahili: Kwa mwanamke akasema, “Nitakuzidishia sana utungu wakati wa kuzaa kwako; kwa utungu utazaa watoto. Tamaa yako itakuwa kwa mumeo naye atakutawala.”

english: And to Adam He said: “Because you have listened to the voice of your wife and have eaten from the tree of which I commanded you not to eat, cursed is the ground because of you; through toil you will eat of it all the days of your life.
ekegusii: Erio agateebia Omosacha oria, “Ekiagera kwaigwerete mokao na okaria amatunda ’omote oria nagokanetie ng’a toria, riroba riaragererigwe ase engencho yao. Ase ogwechanda kwao norie okwama kwaeriroba amatuko onsi ay’obogima bwao.
swahili: Kwa Adamu akasema, “Kwa sababu umemsikiliza mke wako na ukala kutoka kwenye mti niliokuamuru, ‘Msile tunda lake,’ “Ardhi imelaaniwa kwa sababu yako, kwa kazi ngumu utakula chakula kitokacho humo siku zote za maisha yako.

english: Both thorns and thistles it will yield for you, and you will eat the plants of the field.
ekegusii: Riroba narikwamere amagwa na amageri, na aye norie okwama kw’ebimeri bi’orosana.
swahili: Itazaa miiba na mibaruti kwa ajili yako, nawe utakula mimea ya shambani.

english: By the sweat of your brow you will eat your bread, until you return to the ground— because out of it were you taken. For dust you are, and to dust you shall return.”
ekegusii: Goika okore omokia na goitera ebigeri gokora riroba riame kende gionsi omanye konyora endagera orie; goika oirane ase riroba, ekiagera agwo nao kwarwete. Naki aye norotu, naende noirane ase orotu.”
swahili: Kwa jasho la uso wako utakula chakula chako hadi utakaporudi ardhini, kwa kuwa ulitwaliwa kutoka humo, kwa kuwa wewe u mavumbi na mavumbini wewe utarudi.”

english: The woman answered the serpent, “We may eat the fruit of the trees of the garden,
ekegusii: Omokungu oria akairaneria eng’iti eria: “Amatunda a kera omote ore ase omogondo ’natonyare koyaria
swahili: Mwanamke akamjibu nyoka, “Tunaweza kula matunda ya miti iliyoko bustanini,

english: And Adam named his wife Eve, because she would be the mother of all the living. The Expulsion from Paradise
ekegusii: Adamu akaaroka mokaye Hawa, ekiagera ere nere ng’ina bw’abare moyo bonsi.
swahili: Adamu akamwita mkewe Eva, kwa kuwa atakuwa mama wa wote walio hai.

english: And the LORD God made garments of skin for Adam and his wife, and He clothed them.
ekegusii: Erio Omonene Nyasae akaroiseria Adamu na mokaye chingobo chi’amasankwa, erio agwo akababoyia. Adamu na Hawa bagoserigwa korwa ase omogondo o Edeni
swahili: Bwana Mungu akawatengenezea Adamu na mkewe mavazi ya ngozi, akawavika.

english: Then the LORD God said, “Behold, the man has become like one of Us, knowing good and evil. And now, lest he reach out his hand and take also from the tree of life, and eat, and live forever...”
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene Nyasae agateeba: “Rora, omonto oyo obeire buna oyomo oito ase okomanya amaya na amabe. Tabaisa gwancherwa gochia korambora okoboko kwaye atwe amatunda ’omote bw’obogima arie, erinde abe moyo kare na kare.”
swahili: Kisha Bwana Mungu akasema, “Sasa mtu huyu amekuwa kama mmoja wetu, kwa kujua mema na mabaya. Sharti asiruhusiwe kunyoosha mkono wake na kuchuma pia kutoka mti wa uzima akala, naye akaishi milele.”

english: Therefore the LORD God banished him from the Garden of Eden to work the ground from which he had been taken.
ekegusii: Ase ayio Omonene Nyasae akamoseeria korwa ase omogondo o Edeni, akamobeka areme riroba agwo ase arwete.
swahili: Hivyo Bwana Mungu akamfukuzia mbali kutoka Bustani ya Edeni, akalime ardhi ambamo alitolewa.

english: So He drove out the man and stationed cherubim on the east side of the Garden of Eden, along with a whirling sword of flame to guard the way to the tree of life.
ekegusii: Ase ensemo ya moocha y’omogondo o Edeni akabeeka ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba, n’omoyio o birende ogwoka omorero okona‐koonchaonchoka chinsemo chionsi. Erio korenda onde bwensi tacha ase omote bw’obogima.
swahili: Baada ya kumfukuzia mbali Adamu, Mungu akaweka makerubi mashariki ya Bustani ya Edeni, pamoja na upanga wa moto ukimulika huku na huko kulinda njia ya kuuendea mti wa uzima.

english: but about the fruit of the tree in the middle of the garden, God has said, ‘You must not eat of it or touch it, or you will die.’”
ekegusii: otatiga amatunda y’omote ore mogondo gati-gati. Nyasae nigo atokanetie titoria amatunda korwa ase omote oria gose koyakuna, toise gokora bo nigo torakwe.”
swahili: lakini Mungu alisema, ‘Kamwe msile tunda la mti ulio katikati ya bustani, wala kuugusa, la sivyo mtakufa.’ ”

english: “You will not surely die,” the serpent told her.
ekegusii: Eng’iti eria ekairaneria omokungu oria “Ayio tari bo ogokwa, timogokwa.
swahili: Lakini nyoka akamwambia mwanamke, “Hakika hamtakufa.

english: “For God knows that in the day you eat of it, your eyes will be opened and you will be like God, knowing good and evil.”
ekegusii: Nyasae nigo akwanete bo akiagera amanyete ng’a ekero moraarie amatunda y’omote oyio nigo morabwekane Nyasae mobe mokomanya amaya na amabe.”
swahili: Kwa maana Mungu anajua ya kuwa wakati mtakapoyala, macho yenu yatafumbuliwa, nanyi mtakuwa kama Mungu, mkijua mema na mabaya.”

english: When the woman saw that the tree was good for food and pleasing to the eyes, and that it was desirable for obtaining wisdom, she took the fruit and ate it. She also gave some to her husband who was with her, and he ate it.
ekegusii: Omokungu oria agachia korora omote oria buna ore omuya okoriegwa na okogwenera amaiso, na omote oria noyo bw’okoganigwa, ekiagera okobaa okomanya, agatwa amatunda aye, akaria. Erio agwo akairera omosacha oye amatunda ande nere akaria.
swahili: Mwanamke alipoona ya kuwa tunda la mti huo lilikuwa zuri kwa chakula na la kupendeza macho, tena linatamanika kwa kujipatia hekima, basi akachuma katika matunda yake, akala, pia akampa mumewe, aliyekuwa pamoja naye, naye akala.

english: And the eyes of both of them were opened, and they knew that they were naked; so they sewed together fig leaves and made coverings for themselves. God Arraigns Adam and Eve
ekegusii: Erio agwo nyuma ko barire, bakaegwa okomanya bakamanya ng’a ngetirianda bare; erio bagatabora amato y’omoko, bakayasonerania, erio bakeboyia.
swahili: Ndipo macho yao wote wawili yakafumbuliwa, wakajiona kwamba walikuwa uchi; hivyo wakashona majani ya mtini, wakajifunika.

english: Then the man and his wife heard the voice of the LORD God walking in the garden in the breeze of the day, and they hid themselves from the presence of the LORD God among the trees of the garden.
ekegusii: Emogoroba eria bakaigwa eriogi ri’Omonene Nyasae ogotaara ase omogondo, erio barabwo bakebisa mogondo gati y’emete.
swahili: Ndipo yule mwanaume na mkewe, waliposikia sauti ya Bwana Mungu alipokuwa akitembea bustanini jioni, wakajificha kutoka mbele za Bwana Mungu katikati ya miti ya bustani.

english: But the LORD God called out to the man, “Where are you?”
ekegusii: Korende Omonene Nyasae akarangeria omonto oria, akamobooria: “Ng’ai ore?”
swahili: Lakini Bwana Mungu akamwita Adamu, “Uko wapi?”

english: Some time later, the king’s cupbearer and baker offended their master, the king of Egypt.
ekegusii: Ase engaki gete, magega y’amang’ana ayio, omoteneneri bw’ebinyugwa bia Farao na omoteneneri oye bw’abaroisia emegati bakamoochera omonene obo, omorwoti o Misiri.
swahili: Baada ya muda, mnyweshaji na mwokaji wa mfalme wa Misri, wakamkosea bwana wao, mfalme wa Misri.

english: and on the vine were three branches. As it budded, its blossoms opened and its clusters ripened into grapes.
ekegusii: na omosabibu oyio nigo orenge ne chinsagia isato; bwango ogasomoria, ogasokia ebisicha, na okaama ebisago bi’amasabibu amatobu.
swahili: nao mzabibu ulikuwa na matawi matatu. Mara tu ulipoanza kuchipua, maua yalichanua na vishada vyake vikawa zabibu zilizoiva.

english: Pharaoh’s cup was in my hand, and I took the grapes, squeezed them into his cup, and placed the cup in his hand.”
ekegusii: Na egekombe kia Farao nigo nakebwate ase okoboko kwane; nkabogoria amasabibu aria, nkayamitera ase egekombe kia Farao, nkaa Farao egekombe eke koboko kwaye.”
swahili: Kikombe cha Farao kilikuwa mkononi mwangu, nikazitwaa zabibu, nikazikamua katika kikombe cha Farao, na nikaweka kikombe mkononi mwake.”

english: Joseph replied, “This is the interpretation: The three branches are three days.
ekegusii: Yusufu akamoteebia: “Engencho y’okoroota okwo nero eye: Chinsagia echio isato, ayio namatuko atato.
swahili: Yosefu akamwambia, “Hii ndiyo maana yake: Matawi matatu ni siku tatu.

english: Within three days Pharaoh will lift up your head and restore your position. You will put Pharaoh’s cup in his hand, just as you did when you were his cupbearer.
ekegusii: Magega y’amatuko atato Farao nakorusie aiga, akoe ogosika, akoiranie ase emeremo yao, na aye nobe gokomoa egekombe koboko kwaye, buna kware komoa agwo ritang’ani, ekero kwareenge omoteneneri bw’ebinyugwa biaye.
swahili: Katika siku hizi tatu, Farao atakutoa gerezani na kukuweka tena kwenye nafasi yako, nawe utaweka kikombe cha Farao mikononi mwake, kama vile ulivyokuwa unafanya ulipokuwa mnyweshaji wake.

english: But when it goes well for you, please remember me and show me kindness by mentioning me to Pharaoh, that he might bring me out of this prison.
ekegusii: Korende ekero oranyore amaya, ong’inyore nainche, ondorere amaabera. Koranche nagosabire onyatore ase Farao, ondusie ase enyomba eye,
swahili: Lakini wakati mambo yatakapokuwia mazuri, unikumbuke, unifanyie wema, useme mema juu yangu kwa Farao ili niondoke huku gerezani.

english: For I was kidnapped from the land of the Hebrews, and even here I have done nothing for which they should have put me in this dungeon.”
ekegusii: ekiagera nigo naibetwe korwa ase ense y’Abaiberania, nonya naa tinkoreti ing’ana rinde riibe riagwenerete kombeeka ase echela.”
swahili: Kwa maana nilichukuliwa kwa nguvu kutoka nchi ya Waebrania, na hata hapa nilipo sikufanya lolote linalostahili niwekwe gerezani.”

english: When the chief baker saw that the interpretation was favorable, he said to Joseph, “I too had a dream: There were three baskets of white bread on my head.
ekegusii: Ekero omoteneneri bw’abaroisia emegati arooche ng’a okoonchora okwo nigo kwabeete okuya, agateebia Yusufu: “Nainche boigo nigo narootete. Nkarora ng’a inyetwegete chinteru isato chire nemegati emerabu ase omotwe one.
swahili: Yule mwokaji mkuu alipoona kuwa Yosefu amefasiri ikiwa na maana nzuri, akamwambia Yosefu, “Mimi pia niliota ndoto: Kichwani mwangu kulikuwepo vikapu vitatu vya mikate.

english: In the top basket were all sorts of baked goods for Pharaoh, but the birds were eating them out of the basket on my head.”
ekegusii: Ase oroteru rwa igoro kegima yarengeo emegati y’ebisaku ao ao yaroiseretigwe Farao, korende chinyoni chigaacha chikayeria korwa ase oroteru igoro, oro netwegete ase omotwe one.”
swahili: Katika kikapu cha juu kulikuwa na aina zote za vyakula vilivyookwa kwa ajili ya Farao, lakini ndege walikuwa wakivila kutoka kwenye kikapu nilichokuwa nimebeba kichwani.”

english: Joseph replied, “This is the interpretation: The three baskets are three days.
ekegusii: Na Yusufu akamoiraneria: “Engencho y’okoroota okwo nero eye: Chinteru echio isato, ayio namatuko atato.
swahili: Yosefu akamwambia, “Hii ndiyo maana yake: Vikapu vitatu ni siku tatu.

english: Within three days Pharaoh will lift off your head and hang you on a tree. Then the birds will eat the flesh of your body.”
ekegusii: Magega y’amatuko atato Farao nakoimokie, agosunge ase omote igoro ne chinyoni nachirie chinyama chi’omobere oo.”
swahili: Katika siku hizi tatu, Farao atakata kichwa chako na kukutundika juu ya mti. Nao ndege watakula nyama ya mwili wako.”

english: Pharaoh was angry with his two officers, the chief cupbearer and the chief baker,
ekegusii: Ase igo, Farao akabeigwa n’abateneneri abwo babere, omoteneneri bw’ebinyugwa na omoteneneri bw’abaroisia emegati.
swahili: Farao akawakasirikia hawa maafisa wake wawili, mnyweshaji mkuu na mwokaji mkuu,

english: On the third day, which was Pharaoh’s birthday, he held a feast for all his officials, and in their presence he lifted up the heads of the chief cupbearer and the chief baker.
ekegusii: Rituko ria gatato, erio riaare ri’okoinyora okoiborwa gwa Farao, ere agakorera abasomba baye bonsi omoyega, akabarusia echela baria babere, omoteneneri bw’ebinyugwa na omoteneneri bw’abaroisia emegati, ase egati y’abasomba baye.
swahili: Mnamo siku ya tatu, ilikuwa kumbukumbu ya kuzaliwa kwa Farao, naye akawaandalia maafisa wake wote karamu. Akawatoa gerezani mnyweshaji mkuu na mwokaji mkuu, akawaweka mbele ya maafisa wake:

english: Pharaoh restored the chief cupbearer to his position, so that he once again placed the cup in Pharaoh’s hand.
ekegusii: Akairania omoteneneri bw’ebinyugwa ase emeremo yaye y’obonyoisia, na ere akaba okomoa Farao egekombe ase okoboko kwaye;
swahili: Ndipo akamrudisha mnyweshaji mkuu kwenye nafasi yake, ili aweke kikombe mikononi mwa Farao tena,

english: But Pharaoh hanged the chief baker, just as Joseph had described to them in his interpretation.
ekegusii: korende omoteneneri bw’abaroisia emegati ere akamosunga ase omote igoro, buna Yusufu abanorete chingencho chie chindoto chiabo.
swahili: lakini akamwangika yule mwokaji mkuu, sawasawa na jinsi Yosefu alivyowaambia katika tafsiri yake.

english: The chief cupbearer, however, did not remember Joseph; he forgot all about him.
ekegusii: Nonya nabo oyio omoteneneri bw’ebinyugwa taba okoinyora Yusufu, korende akamweba.
swahili: Pamoja na hayo, mnyweshaji mkuu hakumkumbuka Yosefu, bali alimsahau.

english: and imprisoned them in the house of the captain of the guard, the same prison where Joseph was confined.
ekegusii: Akababeeka barendwe ase enyomba yomotang’ani bw’abarendi, ase echela eyio Yusufu nere asibetwe.
swahili: akawaweka chini ya ulinzi katika nyumba ya mkuu wa kikosi cha ulinzi katika gereza lile lile alimofungwa Yosefu.

english: The captain of the guard assigned them to Joseph, and he became their personal attendant. After they had been in custody for some time,
ekegusii: Omotang’ani bw’abarendi akamobeka Yusufu abe okobarigereria na kobakorera, na barabwo bakabeera ase egesibo ase engaki enke.
swahili: Mkuu wa kikosi cha ulinzi akawakabidhi kwa Yosefu, naye akawahudumia. Walipokuwa wamekaa chini ya ulinzi kwa muda,

english: both of these men—the Egyptian king’s cupbearer and baker, who were being held in the prison—had a dream on the same night, and each dream had its own meaning.
ekegusii: Ase obotuko obomo bonsi babere, omoteneneri oria bw’ebinyugwa na omoteneneri bw’abaroisia emegati b’omorwoti o Misiri, abwo basibetwe echela, bakaba bakoroota chindoto. Kera oyomo akaroota okoroota kwaye okware nengencho eng’ao korwa ase okw’oyonde.
swahili: kila mmoja wa hao wawili waliokuwa wamewekwa gerezani, yaani mnyweshaji na mwokaji wa mfalme wa Misri, waliota ndoto usiku mmoja, na kila ndoto ilikuwa na maana yake tofauti.

english: When Joseph came to them in the morning, he saw that they were distraught.
ekegusii: Ekero Yusufu agendete mambia kobarigereria akabanyora nigo baichanete.
swahili: Yosefu alipowajia asubuhi yake, akawaona kwamba walikuwa na huzuni.

english: So he asked the officials of Pharaoh who were in custody with him in his master’s house, “Why are your faces so downcast today?”
ekegusii: Ase igo, akabooria abateneneri abwo ba Farao, abaarenge amo nere ase egesibo ase enyomba y’omonene oye, akabora: “Naki moichaanete iga reero?”
swahili: Ndipo Yosefu akawauliza maafisa hao wa Farao waliokuwa chini ya ulinzi pamoja naye nyumbani mwa bwana wake, akasema, “Mbona nyuso zenu zimejaa huzuni leo?”

english: “We both had dreams,” they replied, “but there is no one to interpret them.” Then Joseph said to them, “Don’t interpretations belong to God? Tell me your dreams.”
ekegusii: Barabwo bakamoiraneria: “Nigo twarootete chindoto, na onde tari oranyare kogoteebia engencho ye chindoto chiaito.” Yusufu akabateebia: “Nigoro ya Nyasae kobateebia engencho yaye. Komoranche, mochinteebie.”
swahili: Wakamjibu, “Sisi sote tuliota ndoto, lakini hapakuwa na mtu yeyote wa kuzifasiri.” Ndipo Yosefu akawaambia, “Je, kufasiri ndoto si kazi ya Mungu? Niambieni ndoto zenu.”

english: So the chief cupbearer told Joseph his dream: “In my dream there was a vine before me,
ekegusii: Omoteneneri bw’ebinyugwa agateebia Yusufu okoroota kwaye, akabora: “Ase okoroota kwane nigo narooche omosabibu ore ase obosio bwane,
swahili: Basi mkuu wa wanyweshaji akamweleza Yosefu ndoto yake. Akamwambia, “Katika ndoto yangu niliona mzabibu mbele yangu,

english: After two full years had passed, Pharaoh had a dream: He was standing beside the Nile,
ekegusii: Magega y’emiaka ebere koyaetire Farao akaroota chindoto ng’a oteneine engegu y’orooche rwa Naeli.
swahili: Baada ya miaka miwili kamili kupita, Farao aliota ndoto: Tazama alikuwa amesimama kando ya Mto Naili,

english: Pharaoh was once angry with his servants, and he put me and the chief baker in the custody of the captain of the guard.
ekegusii: Ekero aye Farao gwatobeete intwe abasomba bao, na gotosiekera, inche na omoteneneri bw’abaroisia emegati, ase echela eyere ase enyomba y’omotang’ani bw’abarendi,
swahili: Wakati fulani Farao aliwakasirikia watumishi wake, akanifunga mimi na mwokaji mkuu katika nyumba ya mkuu wa ulinzi.

english: One night both the chief baker and I had dreams, and each dream had its own meaning.
ekegusii: intwe ase obotuko obomo tokaroota chindoto twensi, kera oyomo okoroota kwaye kore nengencho yaye eng’ao.
swahili: Kila mmoja wetu aliota ndoto katika usiku mmoja na kila ndoto ilikuwa na maana yake tofauti.

english: Now a young Hebrew was there with us, a servant of the captain of the guard. We told him our dreams and he interpreted them for us individually.
ekegusii: Agwo amo naintwe narengeo omomura oyomo Omoiberania, omosomba bw’omotang’ani bw’abarendi. Tokamoteebia chindoto chiaito, na ere agatoteebia engencho ye chindoto chiria, agatobanorera kera oyomo engencho y’okoroota kwaye.
swahili: Basi kijana wa Kiebrania aliyekuwa pamoja nasi huko, alikuwa mtumishi wa mkuu wa kikosi cha ulinzi. Tulimweleza ndoto zetu, naye akatufasiria, akitupa kila mtu tafsiri ya ndoto yake.

english: And it happened to us just as he had interpreted: I was restored to my position, and the other man was hanged.” Joseph Interprets Pharaoh’s Dreams
ekegusii: Na buna ere atoteebetie engencho ye chindoto chiaito, naboigo abeete; inche nkairanigwa ase emeremo yane, na oria onde agasungwa ase omote igoro.”
swahili: Nayo mambo yakawa sawa kabisa na jinsi alivyotufasiria ndoto zetu: Mimi nilirudishwa kazini mwangu na huyo mtu mwingine akaangikwa.”

english: So Pharaoh sent for Joseph, who was quickly brought out of the dungeon. After he had shaved and changed his clothes, he went in before Pharaoh.
ekegusii: Erio Farao agatoma abanto korangeria Yusufu. Bakamorenta bwango korwa ase echela, na ere akagingirwa, akaonchoreria chianga chiaye, akagenda ase obosio bwa Farao.
swahili: Basi, Farao akatuma Yosefu aitwe, naye akatolewa kifungoni haraka. Baada ya kunyoa na kubadilisha nguo zake akaenda mbele ya Farao.

english: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “I had a dream, and no one can interpret it. But I have heard it said of you that when you hear a dream you can interpret it.”
ekegusii: Farao agateebia Yusufu: “Nigo narota okoroota, gose onde tari oranyare gonteebia engencho y’okoroota kwane. Inche naigure amang’ana ao ng’a gokwaigure chindoto, nabo okomanya engencho ye chindoto echio.”
swahili: Farao akamwambia Yosefu, “Nimeota ndoto, wala hakuna mtu hata mmoja anayeweza kuifasiri. Lakini nimesikia ikisemwa kwa habari yako kwamba unapoelezwa ndoto waweza kuifasiri.”

english: “I myself cannot do it,” Joseph replied, “but God will give Pharaoh a sound answer.”
ekegusii: Yusufu akairaneria Farao, akabora: “Tari inche, korende Nyasae orakoe aye Farao okoiraneria kw’omorembe.”
swahili: Yosefu akamjibu Farao, “Siwezi kuifasiri, lakini Mungu atampa Farao jibu analolihitaji.”

english: Then Pharaoh said to Joseph: “In my dream I was standing on the bank of the Nile,
ekegusii: Erio Farao agateebia Yusufu: “Ase okoroota kwane nigo narooche ng’a nteneine ase engegu y’orooche.
swahili: Kisha Farao akamwambia Yosefu, “Katika ndoto yangu nilikuwa nimesimama ukingoni mwa Mto Naili,

english: when seven cows, well-fed and sleek, came up from the river and began to graze among the reeds.
ekegusii: Nkarora chiombe isano na ibere, chinoru chingiya mono, chikorwa rooche, chikorisia amasangaka;
swahili: nikawaona ngʼombe saba, wazuri na wanono, wakijitokeza kutoka mtoni wakaja kujilisha kwenye matete.

english: After them, seven other cows—sickly, ugly, and thin—came up. I have never seen such ugly cows in all the land of Egypt!
ekegusii: naende nkarora chiombe chinde isano na ibere, chimbe mono chindeu, chikorwa rooche, chigochitunyana korwa magega. Ase ense yonsi ya Misiri tinana korora chiombe chimbe buna echio.
swahili: Baada ya hao, ngʼombe wengine saba wadhaifu wakatokea, wabaya sana na waliokonda. Kamwe sikuwahi kuona ngʼombe wabaya jinsi hiyo katika nchi yote ya Misri.

english: when seven cows, sleek and well-fed, came up from the river and began to graze among the reeds.
ekegusii: Akarora chiombe isano na ibere, chingiya mono chinoru, chikorwa rooche, chikorisia amasangaka.
swahili: wakati ngʼombe saba, wazuri na wanono, walitokea mtoni wakajilisha kwenye matete.

english: Then the thin, ugly cows devoured the seven well-fed cows that were there first.
ekegusii: Agwo chiombe chiria chimbe chindeu chikaria chiombe chiria isano na ibere chi’eritang’ani, chiare chingiya chinoru,
swahili: Hao ngʼombe waliokonda na wabaya sana wakawala wale ngʼombe saba walionona waliojitokeza kwanza.

english: When they had devoured them, however, no one could tell that they had done so; their appearance was as ugly as it had been before. Then I awoke.
ekegusii: korende ekero chiachirire tichiarorekana ng’a nchiachiria, nkarora nabo chire buna chiare ritang’ani. Erio nkaboka.
swahili: Lakini hata baada ya kuwala, hakuna mtu ambaye angeweza kusema kwamba wamekula, bado walionekana wabaya kama mwanzoni. Kisha nikaamka kutoka usingizini.

english: In my dream I also saw seven heads of grain, plump and ripe, growing on a single stalk.
ekegusii: Naende konararire nkarora ase okoroota kwane ebigara ebinene ebinoru bitano na bibere, bikinete ase oroboba oromo;
swahili: “Pia katika ndoto zangu niliona masuke saba ya nafaka, yamejaa na mazuri, yanakua katika bua moja.

english: After them, seven other heads of grain sprouted—withered, thin, and scorched by the east wind.
ekegusii: na ebigara ebiomo ebireu, ebiasusanirie nomwaga ore korwa moocha, bikaoroka korwa magega yabo,
swahili: Baada ya hayo masuke mengine saba yakachipua, yaliyonyauka, membamba na yamekaushwa na upepo wa mashariki.

english: And the thin heads of grain swallowed the seven plump ones. I told this dream to the magicians, but no one could explain it to me.”
ekegusii: na ebigara biria ebireu bikaria biria ebinoru bitano na bibere. Inche ngateebia abaringoria, korende onde tari onyarete gonteebia engencho y’okoroota kwane.”
swahili: Yale masuke membamba ya nafaka yakayameza yale masuke saba mazuri yaliyojaa nafaka. Nimewaeleza waaguzi, wala hakuna yeyote aliyeweza kunifasiria.”

english: At this, Joseph said to Pharaoh, “The dreams of Pharaoh are one and the same. God has revealed to Pharaoh what He is about to do.
ekegusii: Erio Yusufu agateebia Farao: “Chindoto chiao, aye Farao, nigo chire echimo. Nyasae okworokirie, aye Farao, aya agochia gokora iga bwango.
swahili: Ndipo Yosefu akamwambia Farao, “Ndoto za Farao ni ndoto iyo hiyo moja. Mungu amemfunulia Farao jambo analokusudia kufanya karibuni.

english: The seven good cows are seven years, and the seven ripe heads of grain are seven years. The dreams have the same meaning.
ekegusii: Chiombe chiria chingiya isano na ibere, eyio nemiaka etano na ebere, na ebigara biria ebiya bitano na bibere, eyio nemiaka etano na ebere; chindoto echio nechimo.
swahili: Ngʼombe saba wazuri ni miaka saba, nayo masuke saba mazuri yaliyojaa nafaka ni miaka saba, ni ndoto iyo hiyo moja.

english: Moreover, the seven thin, ugly cows that came up after them are seven years, and so are the seven worthless heads of grain scorched by the east wind—they are seven years of famine.
ekegusii: Ne chiombe chiria isano na ibere chimbe chindeu, chiachitunyanete chiria chinoru, eyio nemiaka etano na ebere, na ebigara biria bitano na bibere bitaamete, biasusanirie nomwaga ore korwa moocha, eyio nemiaka etano na ebere y’enchara.
swahili: Ngʼombe saba waliokonda na wabaya wale waliojitokeza baadaye ni miaka saba, vivyo hivyo masuke saba ya ngano yaliyodhoofika na kukaushwa na upepo wa mashariki, ni miaka saba ya njaa.

english: It is just as I said to Pharaoh: God has shown Pharaoh what He is about to do.
ekegusii: Aya naro buna nagoteebia aye Farao, ng’a Nyasae okworokirie aya agochia gokora iga bwango.
swahili: “Ni kama vile nilivyomwambia Farao: Mungu amemwonyesha Farao jambo analokusudia kufanya karibuni.

english: Behold, seven years of great abundance are coming throughout the land of Egypt,
ekegusii: Rora, ngochi-gocha ere emiaka etano na ebere y’omoigoto ase ense yonsi ya Misiri,
swahili: Miaka saba ya neema inakuja katika nchi yote ya Misri,

english: After them, seven other cows, sickly and thin, came up from the Nile and stood beside the well-fed cows on the bank of the river.
ekegusii: Naende akarora chiombe chinde isano na ibere, chimbe mono chindeu, chikorwa rooche, chigochitunyana korwa magega, chigatenena ase engegu y’orooche ang’e nase chiombe chiria chinde.
swahili: Baada yao ngʼombe wengine saba, wabaya na waliokonda, wakatokea mtoni Naili wakasimama kando ya wale wanono ukingoni mwa mto.

english: but seven years of famine will follow them. Then all the abundance in the land of Egypt will be forgotten, and the famine will devastate the land.
ekegusii: korende magega y’ayio neche emiaka ende etano na ebere y’enchara; na omoigoto oria bwonsi nigo ogochia kwebwa ase ense ya Misiri, ekiagera enchara eria nigo erarie ense eye.
swahili: lakini itafuata miaka saba ya njaa. Ndipo neema yote ya Misri itasahaulika na njaa itaikumba nchi.

english: The abundance in the land will not be remembered, since the famine that follows it will be so severe.
ekegusii: Omoigoto oria tokoinyorwa ase ense eye, ase engencho y’enchara eye erache gocha korwa magega yaye, ekiagera nigo erabe endito mono.
swahili: “Neema iliyokuwa katika nchi haitakumbukwa, kwa sababu njaa itakayofuata itakuwa kali mno.

english: Moreover, because the dream was given to Pharaoh in two versions, the matter has been decreed by God, and He will carry it out shortly.
ekegusii: Na bono Farao, okoroota kwao nigo gwachete eria kabere, aya nigo akoorokia ng’a Nyasae ochikiire amang’ana aya, na Nyasae nayaikeranie iga bwango.
swahili: Sababu ya ndoto kumjia Farao kwa namna mbili ni kwamba jambo hilo Mungu ameshaamua kwa hakika, naye Mungu atalifanya karibuni.

english: Now, therefore, Pharaoh should look for a discerning and wise man and set him over the land of Egypt.
ekegusii: “Ase ayio Farao, rigia omonto ore omomanyi na omong’aini, omobeke igoro y’ense yonsi ya Misiri.
swahili: “Basi sasa Farao na atafute mtu mwenye akili na hekima ili amweke kuwa msimamizi wa nchi ya Misri.

english: Let Pharaoh take action and appoint commissioners over the land to take a fifth of the harvest of Egypt during the seven years of abundance.
ekegusii: Na bono Farao, aya naro ogwenerete okore: Obeke abateneneri igoro y’ense eye bachoge ensemo ya isano y’endagera ase ense ya Misiri ase emiaka eye etano na ebere y’omoigoto.
swahili: Farao na aweke wenye amri nchini kote wakusanye sehemu ya tano ya mavuno ya Misri katika miaka hii saba ya neema.

english: Under the authority of Pharaoh, let them collect all the excess food from these good years, that they may come and lay up the grain to be preserved as food in the cities.
ekegusii: Tiga basangererie endagera eye yonsi y’emiaka eye emiya egocha, bayebeke erendwe ase emechie, ase okobua gwa Farao.
swahili: Wakusanye chakula chote katika miaka hii saba ya neema inayokuja na kuhifadhi nafaka chini ya mamlaka ya Farao, iwe akiba ya chakula katika miji.

english: This food will be a reserve for the land during the seven years of famine to come upon the land of Egypt. Then the country will not perish in the famine.” Joseph Given Charge of Egypt
ekegusii: Na endagera eye egachwe eche koegwa abanto emiaka eye etano na ebere y’enchara, erache gocha ase ense ya Misiri, abanto tibaabaisa gocha gosira ase enchara eyio.” Yusufu okoimokigwa konyora obonene ase Misiri
swahili: Chakula hiki kitakuwa akiba ya tahadhari kwa ajili ya nchi, ili kitumike katika ile miaka saba ya njaa itakayokuja Misri, ili nchi isiharibiwe na njaa.”

english: This proposal pleased Pharaoh and all his officials.
ekegusii: Amang’ana ayio akagwenera Farao amo nabasomba baye bonsi.
swahili: Mpango huu ulionekana mzuri kwa Farao na kwa maafisa wake wote.

english: So Pharaoh asked them, “Can we find anyone like this man, in whom the Spirit of God abides?”
ekegusii: Farao akabooria abasomba baye: “Inee! Ng’ai toranyore omonto onga buna oyo ore n’Omoika o Nyasae ime yaye?”
swahili: Hivyo Farao akawauliza, “Je tunaweza kumpata yeyote kama mtu huyu, ambaye Roho wa Mungu yumo ndani yake?”

english: Then Pharaoh said to Joseph, “Since God has made all this known to you, there is no one as discerning and wise as you.
ekegusii: Erio Farao agateebia Yusufu: “Ekiagera Nyasae okomanyirie amang’ana ayio onsi, onde tari aa omanyete, naende ore na obong’aini buna aye.
swahili: Ndipo Farao akamwambia Yosefu, “Maadamu Mungu amekufunulia yote haya, hakuna mwingine yeyote mwenye akili na hekima kama wewe.

english: And the cows that were sickly and thin devoured the seven sleek, well-fed cows. Then Pharaoh woke up,
ekegusii: Agwo chiombe chiria chimbe chindeu chikaria chiria chingiya chinoru. Erio Farao akaboka.
swahili: Wale ngʼombe wabaya na waliokonda wakawala wale saba wazuri na wanono. Kisha Farao akaamka.

english: You shall be in charge of my house, and all my people are to obey your commands. Only with regard to the throne will I be greater than you.”
ekegusii: Bono naye orabe omoteneneri bw’enka yane, na abanto baane bonsi nabakoigwere buna orabe gokobachika. Ase ekerogo kiane ki’obogaambi oka, nao ndabe omonene gokobua.”
swahili: Wewe utakuwa msimamizi wa jumba langu la kifalme, na watu wangu wote watatii amri zako. Ni kuhusu kiti cha ufalme tu nitakuwa mkuu kuliko wewe.” Yosefu Msimamizi Wa Misri

english: Pharaoh also told Joseph, “I hereby place you over all the land of Egypt.”
ekegusii: Farao agateebia Yusufu: “Rora nakobekire aye igoro y’ense yonsi ya Misiri.”
swahili: Kwa hiyo Farao akamwambia Yosefu, “Sasa nakuweka uwe msimamizi wa nchi yote ya Misri.”

english: Then Pharaoh removed the signet ring from his finger, put it on Joseph’s finger, clothed him in garments of fine linen, and placed a gold chain around his neck.
ekegusii: Erio Farao akarusia ebonyi yaye ere nekemanyererio korwa ase ekiara kiaye, akamoyebeekera Yusufu kiara kiaye, akamobekera na eanga engiya y’egatani, akamobekera ne chisonoi chi’etaabu igoti riaye.
swahili: Ndipo Farao akaivua pete yake ya muhuri kutoka kidoleni mwake na kuivalisha katika kidole cha Yosefu. Akamvika majoho mazuri ya kitani safi na mkufu wa dhahabu shingoni mwake.

english: He had Joseph ride in his second chariot, with men calling out before him, “Bow the knee!” So he placed him over all the land of Egypt.
ekegusii: Akamoriinia ase egari yaye ya kabere y’oborwoti. Abanto bagaaka eriogi, bakobora: “Tung’ama inse!” Naboigo akamobeka abe omogambi bw’ense yonsi ya Misiri.
swahili: Akampandisha katika gari lake la farasi kama msaidizi wake, watu wakatangulia wakishangilia, wakisema, “Fungueni njia!” Ndivyo Farao alivyomweka Yosefu kuwa msimamizi wa nchi yote ya Misri.

english: And Pharaoh declared to Joseph, “I am Pharaoh, but without your permission, no one in all the land of Egypt shall lift his hand or foot.”
ekegusii: Naende Farao agateebia Yusufu: “Ninche Farao. Otancheti aye, onde takoba ase ense yonsi ya Misiri oraimoke gokora gento.”
swahili: Kisha Farao akamwambia Yosefu, “Mimi ni Farao, lakini pasipo neno lako, hakuna mtu mwenye ruhusa kuinua mkono au mguu katika nchi yote ya Misri.”

english: Pharaoh gave Joseph the name Zaphenath-paneah, and he gave him Asenath daughter of Potiphera, priest of On, to be his wife. And Joseph took charge of all the land of Egypt. The Seven Years of Plenty
ekegusii: Farao Akaroka Yusufu Safenati‐Panea; akamonyuomeria omokungu, nere Asenati, omoiseke o Potifera, Omokuani bw’Oni. Yusufu akagenda aaria na aaria korigereria ense yonsi ya Misiri.
swahili: Farao akamwita Yosefu Safenath-Panea, pia akampa Asenathi binti Potifera, kuhani wa mji wa Oni, kuwa mke wake. Ndipo Yosefu akaitembelea nchi yote ya Misri.

english: Now Joseph was thirty years old when he entered the service of Pharaoh king of Egypt. And Joseph left Pharaoh’s presence and traveled throughout the land of Egypt.
ekegusii: Agwo Yusufu, ekero asoete gokorera Farao, omorwoti o Misiri, nigo arenge nemiaka emerongo etato. Na Yusufu akarua ase obosio bwa Farao, agaetanana ase ense yonsi ya Misri.
swahili: Yosefu alikuwa na miaka thelathini alipoingia katika utumishi wa Farao mfalme wa Misri. Naye Yosefu akatoka mbele ya Farao akasafiri katika nchi yote ya Misri.

english: During the seven years of abundance, the land brought forth bountifully.
ekegusii: Emiaka eria etano na ebere y’omoigoto egaika, ense ekaama endagera enyinge,
swahili: Katika ile miaka saba ya neema nchi ilizaa mazao kwa wingi sana.

english: During those seven years, Joseph collected all the excess food in the land of Egypt and stored it in the cities. In every city he laid up the food from the fields around it.
ekegusii: na Yusufu agasangereria endagera yonsi ase emiaka eria etano na ebere, ase ense ya Misiri, akayegacha ase emechie. Ase kera omochie akagacha endagera yonsi y’emegondo eria yayoetanaine.
swahili: Yosefu akakusanya chakula chote kilichozalishwa katika ile miaka saba ya neema nchini Misri, akakihifadhi katika ghala za miji. Katika kila mji kulihifadhiwa chakula kilichozalishwa katika mashamba yaliyouzunguka mji huo.

english: So Joseph stored up grain in such abundance, like the sand of the sea, that he stopped keeping track of it; for it was beyond measure.
ekegusii: Yusufu akagacha endagera ase obonge mono, ekaba enyinge buna omokenye bw’Enyancha, goika agatiga koyerenga, ekiagera tiyare konyara korengeka. Enchara egosoa Misiri
swahili: Yosefu alihifadhi nafaka nyingi, mfano wa mchanga wa bahari, ilikuwa nyingi mno kiasi kwamba walishindwa kuweka kumbukumbu kwa sababu akiba ilizidi sana kupita kipimo.

english: but he fell back asleep and dreamed a second time: Seven heads of grain, plump and ripe, came up on one stalk.
ekegusii: Akaraara naende, akaroota eria kabere, akarora ebigara bitano na bibere ebinene ebinoru, bikinete ase oroboba oromo.
swahili: Farao akaingia usingizini tena akaota ndoto ya pili: Akaona masuke saba ya nafaka, yenye afya na mazuri, yanakua katika bua moja.

english: Before the years of famine arrived, two sons were born to Joseph by Asenath daughter of Potiphera, priest of On.
ekegusii: Ritang’ani konya emiaka eria y’enchara etaracha, Asenati, mosubati o Potifera, Omokuani bw’Oni, akaiborera Yusufu abana abaisia babere.
swahili: Kabla ya miaka ya njaa kuanza, Asenathi binti Potifera, kuhani wa mji wa Oni, alikuwa amemzalia Yosefu wana wawili wa kiume.
