english: Joseph named the firstborn Manasseh, saying, “God has made me forget all my hardship and all my father’s household.”
ekegusii: Yusufu Akaaroka omwana oria omotangi Manase, agateeba: “Nyasae ogerire inyebe obokong’u bwonsi na abanto b’enka ya tata”
swahili: Yosefu akamwita mzaliwa wake wa kwanza Manase, akisema, “Ni kwa sababu Mungu amenifanya nisahau taabu zangu zote pamoja na jamaa yote ya nyumba ya baba yangu.”

english: And the second son he named Ephraim, saying, “God has made me fruitful in the land of my affliction.” The Famine Begins
ekegusii: Na omwana o kabere akamoroka Efraimu, agateeba: “Nyasae ong’eire oroiboro ase ense y’emechando yane.”
swahili: Mwana wa pili akamwita Efraimu, akisema, “Ni kwa sababu Mungu amenistawisha katika nchi ya mateso yangu.”

english: When the seven years of abundance in the land of Egypt came to an end,
ekegusii: Emiaka eria etano na ebere y’omoigoto ekaera ase ense ya Misiri,
swahili: Ile miaka saba ya neema huko Misri ikaisha,

english: the seven years of famine began, just as Joseph had said. And although there was famine in every country, there was food throughout the land of Egypt.
ekegusii: na emiaka eria etano na ebere y’enchara egachaka gocha, buna Yusufu abaanete. Enchara egacha ase chinse chionsi, korende ase ense yonsi ya Misiri endagera n’yareengeo.
swahili: nayo miaka ile saba ya njaa ikaanza, sawasawa na alivyosema Yosefu. Kulikuwa na njaa katika nchi nyingine zote, bali katika nchi yote ya Misri kulikuwa na chakula.

english: When extreme hunger came to all the land of Egypt and the people cried out to Pharaoh for food, he told all the Egyptians, “Go to Joseph and do whatever he tells you.”
ekegusii: Ekero enchara yariete abanto bonsi ba Misiri, barabwo bakamorera Farao abae endagera; na Farao agateebia Abamisiri bonsi: “Genda ase Yusufu, na rinde rionsi arabateebie, goika morikore.”
swahili: Wakati nchi yote ya Misri ilipopatwa na njaa, watu wakamlilia Farao ili awape chakula. Ndipo Farao alipowaagiza Wamisri wote, akisema, “Nendeni kwa Yosefu, nanyi mfanye anachowaambia.”

english: When the famine had spread over all the land, Joseph opened up all the storehouses and sold grain to the Egyptians; for the famine was severe in the land of Egypt.
ekegusii: Ase igo, ekero enchara yasoete ase ense eria engima, Yusufu akaigora ebiage bionsi, akaooneria Abamisiri endagera, ekiagera enchara nigo yabeete endito ase ense ya Misiri.
swahili: Wakati njaa ilipokuwa imeenea katika nchi yote, Yosefu akafungua ghala za vyakula na kuwauzia Wamisri nafaka, kwa sababu njaa ilikuwa kali mno katika nchi yote ya Misri.

english: And every nation came to Joseph in Egypt to buy grain, because the famine was severe over all the earth.
ekegusii: Abanto b’echinse chionsi bagacha Misiri kogora endagera korwa ase Yusufu, ekiagera enchara nigo yareenge endito ase ense engima.
swahili: Pia nchi nyingine zote zilikuja Misri kununua nafaka kutoka kwa Yosefu, kwa sababu njaa ilikuwa kali mno duniani kote.

english: After them, seven other heads of grain sprouted, thin and scorched by the east wind.
ekegusii: Magega yabo ebigara binde ebireu, ebiasusanirie nomwaga ore korwa moocha, bikaoroka.
swahili: Baadaye, masuke mengine saba yakachipua, yakiwa membamba yaliyonyaushwa na upepo wa mashariki.

english: And the thin heads of grain swallowed up the seven plump, ripe ones. Then Pharaoh awoke and realized it was a dream.
ekegusii: Agwo ebigara ebio ebireu bitano na bibere bikaria biria binde ebinene ebinoru. Farao akaboka, akanyora ng’a nigo are koroota.
swahili: Masuke yale membamba yakameza yale masuke saba yenye afya na yaliyojaa. Basi Farao akaamka kutoka usingizini, kumbe ilikuwa ndoto.

english: In the morning his spirit was troubled, so he summoned all the magicians and wise men of Egypt. Pharaoh told them his dreams, but no one could interpret them for him.
ekegusii: Ekero bwachia gokia mambia, akaba oichaanete, agatoma abanto barangerie abaringoria bonsi ba Misiri na abanto abang’aini bonsi abaarengeo. Farao akabateebia chindoto chiaye, korende onde tatogete ore konyara komoteebia engencho ye chindoto echio.
swahili: Asubuhi yake, alifadhaika akilini, hivyo akawaita waaguzi wote pamoja na watu wenye busara wa Misri. Walipokuja, Farao akawaeleza ndoto zake, lakini hakuna hata mmoja aliyeweza kumfasiria.

english: Then the chief cupbearer said to Pharaoh, “Today I recall my failures.
ekegusii: Erio omoteneneri bw’ebinyugwa agateebia Farao: “Bono nainyoire okomocha kwane.
swahili: Ndipo mnyweshaji mkuu alipomwambia Farao, “Leo nimekumbushwa kuhusu kosa langu.

english: When Jacob learned that there was grain in Egypt, he said to his sons, “Why are you staring at one another?”
ekegusii: Ekero Yakobo aigwete ng’a endagera nekare ase ense ya Misiri, akabooria abamura baye: “Inaki morigereranetie iga?”
swahili: Wakati Yakobo alipofahamu kuwa kuna nafaka huko Misri, akawaambia wanawe, “Mbona mnakaa tu hapa mnatazamana?”

english: “Not so, my lord,” they replied. “Your servants have come to buy food.
ekegusii: Bakamokania: “Tari bo, Omonene, intwe abasomba bao nigo twachire kogora endagera.
swahili: Wakamjibu, “Sivyo bwana wangu. Watumishi wako wamekuja kununua chakula.

english: We are all sons of one man. Your servants are honest men, not spies.”
ekegusii: Intwe twensi nabana b’omonto oyomo. Intwe abasomba bao nigo tore abanto abaronge, titori chirooti.”
swahili: Sisi sote ni wana wa baba mmoja. Watumishi wako ni watu waaminifu, wala sio wapelelezi.”

english: “No,” he told them. “You have come to see if our land is vulnerable.”
ekegusii: Akabakania: “Yaya, nigo mwachire koroota ense, na korora ense ase ere bosa etari na getango.”
swahili: Akawaambia, “La hasha! Mmekuja kuangalia mahali ambapo nchi yetu haina ulinzi.”

english: But they answered, “Your servants are twelve brothers, the sons of one man in the land of Canaan. The youngest is now with our father, and one is no more.”
ekegusii: Barabwo bakamoiraneria: “Intwe abasomba bao nigo tore abamura ikomi na babere, abana b’omonto oyomo, ase ense ya Kaanani; na bono omoke ominto tari aa, inka akare ase tata, na oyomo ere takaiyo.”
swahili: Lakini wakamjibu, “Watumishi wako walikuwa kumi na wawili, wana wa mtu mmoja ambaye anaishi katika nchi ya Kanaani. Sasa mdogo wetu wa mwisho yupo na baba yetu na mwingine alikufa.”

english: Then Joseph declared, “Just as I said, you are spies!
ekegusii: Korende Yusufu akabateebia “Nabo ere buna konya naikire kobateebia, ng’a inwe nechirooti more.
swahili: Yosefu akawaambia, “Ni sawa kabisa kama nilivyowaambia: Ninyi ni wapelelezi!

english: And this is how you will be tested: As surely as Pharaoh lives, you shall not leave this place unless your youngest brother comes here.
ekegusii: Ase amang’ana aya nimbateeme: Amaene, buna Farao are moyo, timokorua aa mogende, oria omino omoke ataracha aa.
swahili: Na hivi ndivyo mtakavyojaribiwa: Hakika kama Farao aishivyo, hamtaondoka mahali hapa mpaka ndugu yenu mdogo aje hapa.

english: Send one of your number to get your brother; the rest of you will be confined so that the truth of your words may be tested. If they are untrue, then as surely as Pharaoh lives, you are spies!”
ekegusii: Toma oyomo oino agende korenta oyio omino, na inwe abande motigare echela. Nabo morateemwe gose namaene mogoteeba. Onye taibo, amaene buna Farao are moyo, inwe nechirooti more.”
swahili: Tumeni mmoja wenu akamlete huyo ndugu yenu, wengine mtawekwa gerezani, ili maneno yenu yajaribiwe kuona kama mnasema kweli. La sivyo, hakika kama Farao aishivyo ninyi ni wapelelezi!”

english: So Joseph imprisoned them for three days,
ekegusii: Erio agasiekera bonsi amo echela ime ase amatuko atato.
swahili: Akawaweka wote chini ya ulinzi kwa siku tatu.

english: and on the third day he said to them, “I fear God. So do this and you will live:
ekegusii: Rituko ria gatato Yusufu akabateebia: “Mokore iga buna ndabateebie, nario morabe moyo; naki inche nomonto imoirogete Nyasae.
swahili: Siku ya tatu Yosefu akawaambia, “Fanyeni hili nanyi mtaishi, kwa maana namwogopa Mungu:

english: If you are honest, leave one of your brothers in custody while the rest of you go and take back grain to relieve the hunger of your households.
ekegusii: Onye inwe more abanto abaronge, tiga oyomo oino atigare aa ase echela, na inwe abande moirere abwo mwatigete inka endagera, ase engencho y’enchara;
swahili: Ikiwa ninyi ni watu waaminifu, mmoja wa ndugu zenu na abaki kifungoni, nanyi wengine pelekeni nafaka kwa jamaa yenu wanaoteseka kwa njaa.

english: “Look,” he added, “I have heard that there is grain in Egypt. Go down there and buy some for us, so that we may live and not die.”
ekegusii: Naende akabateebia: “Naigure ng’a endagera nekare Misiri, tirimboka gochiao, motogorere endagera toche koria, tobe moyo, titokwa.”
swahili: Akaendelea kuwaambia, “Nimesikia kuwa huko Misri kuna nafaka. Telemkeni huko mkanunue chakula kwa ajili yetu, ili tuweze kuishi wala tusife.”

english: Then bring your youngest brother to me so that your words can be verified, that you may not die.” And to this they consented.
ekegusii: erio morente oria omino omoke ase ’nde. Igo amang’ana aino aenekigwe ng’a namaene are, na inwe timobaisa gokwa. Barabwo bagakora bo.”
swahili: Lakini ni lazima mniletee ndugu yenu mdogo hapa, ili maneno yenu yathibitike na kwamba msife.” Wakakubali kufanya hivyo.

english: Then they said to one another, “Surely we are being punished because of our brother. We saw his anguish when he pleaded with us, but we would not listen. That is why this distress has come upon us.”
ekegusii: Erio bagateebania barabwo ase barabwo: “Amaene, ntwamocherete oyominto. Nigo twarooche ogochandeka kw’omoyo oye, na ekero atosororete titwamoigwete. Ase ayio nakio kiagerire obokong’u obo bwatonyorire.”
swahili: Wakaambiana wao kwa wao, “Hakika tunaadhibiwa kwa sababu ya ndugu yetu. Tuliona jinsi alivyohuzunika alipokuwa anatusihi kuponya maisha yake, lakini hatukumsikiliza, hiyo ndiyo sababu dhiki hii imetupata.”

english: And Reuben responded, “Didn’t I tell you not to sin against the boy? But you would not listen. Now we must account for his blood!”
ekegusii: Rubeni akabairaneria, “Tinabakanetie ng’a timomochera omosae oyo? Korende inwe mokanga, timwanyigwera. Ase igo, bono amanyinga aye aganigwe aakanwe.”
swahili: Reubeni akawajibu, “Sikuwaambieni msitende dhambi dhidi ya kijana? Lakini hamkunisikiliza! Sasa ni lazima tuadhibiwe kwa ajili ya damu yake.”

english: They did not realize that Joseph understood them, since there was an interpreter between them.
ekegusii: Barabwo tibamanya ng’a Yusufu nayaigwete, ekiagera omonogi nareengeo ore komoonchorera.
swahili: Hawakujua kuwa Yosefu angewaelewa, kwa sababu alitumia mkalimani.

english: And he turned away from them and wept. When he turned back and spoke to them, he took Simeon from them and had him bound before their eyes. Joseph’s Brothers Return to Canaan
ekegusii: Erio akarua ase bare, akagenda ensemo, akarera amariga; naende akairana, agakwana nabarabwo. Akarusia Simioni korwa ase bare, akamosiba korwa ase amasio abo.
swahili: Yosefu akajitenga nao akaanza kulia, kisha akawarudia na kuzungumza nao tena. Akataka Simeoni akamatwe na kufungwa mbele yao.

english: Then Joseph gave orders to fill their bags with grain, to return each man’s silver to his sack, and to give them provisions for their journey. This order was carried out,
ekegusii: Yusufu agachiika abanto baichorie chigunia chiabo endagera, na kera oyomo airanerigwe chitaabu chiaye, chibekwe egunia yaye ime, na aegwe endagera agochia koria inchera. Naboigo baabakorerete. Abamwabo Yusufu bakoirana gochia Kaanani
swahili: Yosefu akatoa amri ya kujaza magunia yao nafaka na kuweka fedha ya kila mmoja ndani ya gunia lake, kisha wapewe mahitaji ya njiani. Baada ya kufanyiwa hayo yote,

english: and they loaded the grain on their donkeys and departed.
ekegusii: Erio bakaberekia chitigere chiabo endagera, bakagenda.
swahili: wakapakiza nafaka juu ya punda zao, wakaondoka.

english: At the place where they lodged for the night, one of them opened his sack to get feed for his donkey, and he saw his silver in the mouth of the sack.
ekegusii: Ekero baigete ase bakorara botuko, oyomo obo agasansora egunia yaye arusie endagera ae etigere yaye, akarora chitaabu chiaye igoro y’endagera ase egunia yaye ime,
swahili: Walipofika mahali pa kulala huko njiani mmoja wao akafungua gunia lake ili amlishe punda wake, akakuta fedha yake kwenye mdomo wa gunia lake.

english: “My silver has been returned!” he said to his brothers. “It is here in my sack.” Their hearts sank, and trembling, they turned to one another and said, “What is this that God has done to us?”
ekegusii: agateebia abamwabo: “Ayee! Chibesa chiane nigo chiairanetigwe, rigereria, nao chire aa egunia yane ime!” Chinkoro chiabo chikagoyaana, bakarigererania na koiguswa, bagateeba: “Inki eke Nyasae atokoreire iga?”
swahili: Akawaambia ndugu zake, “Fedha yangu imerudishwa. Iko ndani ya gunia langu.” Mioyo yao ikazimia, na kila mmoja akamgeukia mwenzake wakitetemeka, wakaulizana, “Ni nini hiki Mungu alichotufanyia?”

english: When they reached their father Jacob in the land of Canaan, they described to him all that had happened to them:
ekegusii: Ekero baigete ase Yakobo ise, ase ense ya Kaanani, bakabateebia ayio onsi abanyorete, bakaboora,
swahili: Walipofika kwa Yakobo baba yao katika nchi ya Kanaani, wakamweleza mambo yote yaliyowapata. Wakasema,

english: So ten of Joseph’s brothers went down to buy grain from Egypt.
ekegusii: Ase igo, bamura bamwabo Yusufu ikomi bagatirimboka gochia Misiri kogora endagera.
swahili: Ndipo wale ndugu kumi wa Yosefu, wakateremka huko Misri kununua nafaka.

english: “The man who is lord of the land spoke harshly to us and accused us of spying on the country.
ekegusii: “Omonto oria omonene bw’ense eria nigo akwanete naintwe amang’ana amakong’u agatoroka ng’a intwe nechirooti, tokoroota ense.
swahili: “Huyo mtu ambaye ndiye bwana katika nchi hiyo alisema nasi kwa ukali, akatutendea kana kwamba sisi tulikuwa tunaipeleleza nchi.

english: But we told him, ‘We are honest men, not spies.
ekegusii: Korende tokamoteebia: Intwe nigo tore abanto abaronge, titori chirooti.
swahili: Lakini tulimwambia, ‘Sisi ni watu waaminifu, sio wapelelezi.

english: We are twelve brothers, sons of one father. One is no more, and the youngest is now with our father in the land of Canaan.’
ekegusii: Nigo tore abamura ikomi na babere, tata noyomo. Oyomo oito takaiyo, na omoke kegima nere okare ase tata inka, ase ense ya Kaanani.
swahili: Tulizaliwa ndugu kumi na wawili, wana wa baba mmoja. Mmoja alikufa, na mdogo wetu wa mwisho yupo na baba yetu huko Kanaani.’

english: Then the man who is lord of the land said to us, ‘This is how I will know whether you are honest: Leave one brother with me, take food to relieve the hunger of your households, and go.
ekegusii: Omonto oyio, omonene bw’ense eria, agatoteebia: Ase amang’ana aya naro ndamanyere gose nabaanto abaronge more: Tiga oyomo oino aiga ase ’nde, inwe abande genda, moire endagera ase engencho y’enchara ekare inka seino.
swahili: “Ndipo huyo mtu aliye bwana katika nchi hiyo alipotuambia, ‘Hivi ndivyo nitafahamu kuwa ninyi ni watu waaminifu: Mwacheni mmoja wa ndugu zenu pamoja nami hapa, kisha nendeni mpeleke chakula kwa ajili ya jamaa yenu inayoteseka kwa njaa.

english: But bring your youngest brother back to me so I will know that you are not spies but honest men. Then I will give your brother back to you, and you can trade in the land.’”
ekegusii: Genda mondetere oyio omino omoke, erio nario ndamanye ng’a timori chirooti, korende nabaanto abaronge. Erio nimbairanerie oyomino, na inwe inamonyore ribaga mobe mokoonchoreria ase ense eye.”
swahili: Lakini mleteni huyo ndugu yenu mdogo kwangu, ndipo nitajua kuwa ninyi sio wapelelezi, ila ni watu waaminifu. Kisha nitamrudisha ndugu yenu, nanyi mtaweza kufanya biashara katika nchi hii.’ ”

english: As they began emptying their sacks, there in each man’s sack was his bag of silver! And when they and their father saw the bags of silver, they were dismayed.
ekegusii: Ekaba ekero baumorete endagera korwa ase chigunia, bakanyora kera oyomo esaro ye chitaabu chiaye nao ere egunia yaye ime. Na ekero barabwo amo na ise barooche chisaro chi’echitaabu chiabo, bakaondoka.
swahili: Walipokuwa wanamimina nafaka kutoka kwenye magunia yao, ndani ya gunia la kila mtu kulikuwa na mfuko wa fedha! Wakati wao na baba yao walipoona mifuko ya fedha, wakaogopa.

english: Their father Jacob said to them, “You have deprived me of my sons. Joseph is gone and Simeon is no more. Now you want to take Benjamin. Everything is going against me!”
ekegusii: Yakobo ise akabateebia: “Mwang’urire abana baane, Yusufu taiyo, na Simioni taiyo, na bono morigetie koira Benjamini nere. Amang’ana aya onsi anyorire inche.”
swahili: Yakobo baba yao akawaambia, “Ninyi mmenipokonya watoto wangu. Yosefu hayupo na Simeoni hayupo tena na sasa mnataka kumchukua Benyamini. Kila kitu ni kinyume nami!”

english: Then Reuben said to his father, “You may kill my two sons if I fail to bring him back to you. Put him in my care, and I will return him.”
ekegusii: Erio Rubeni agateebia ise “Oite abana baane babere abamura onye tinkomoirania gocha asore. Mobeke ase amaboko aane na inche nimoiranie.”
swahili: Ndipo Reubeni akamwambia baba yake, “Waweza kuwaua wanangu wote wawili, ikiwa sitamrudisha Benyamini kwako. Mkabidhi Benyamini katika uangalizi wangu, nami nitamrudisha.”

english: But Jacob replied, “My son will not go down there with you, for his brother is dead, and he alone is left. If any harm comes to him on your journey, you will bring my gray hair down to Sheol in sorrow.”
ekegusii: Akamokania: “Omwana one tagotirimboka amo nainwe, ekiagera oyomwabo okuure na oyo nere otigarete bweka. Amabe aise gochia komonyoora agwo inchera, nigo moragere ngende ase oboina ne chimbuche chiane inde nomoichano.”
swahili: Lakini Yakobo akasema, “Mwanangu hatashuka huko pamoja nanyi; ndugu yake amekufa naye ndiye peke yake aliyebaki. Ikiwa atapatwa na madhara katika safari mnayoiendea, mtashusha kichwa changu chenye mvi kaburini kwa masikitiko.”

english: But Jacob did not send Joseph’s brother Benjamin with his brothers, for he said, “I am afraid that harm might befall him.”
ekegusii: Korende Yakobo tamwancherete Benjamini, omwabo Yusufu, kogende amo nabarabwo, ekiagera nigo aoboete ng’a aande nabaise gochia konyorwa n’amabe.
swahili: Lakini Yakobo hakumtuma Benyamini, ndugu yake Yosefu, pamoja na wengine, kwa sababu aliogopa asije akapatwa na madhara.

english: So the sons of Israel were among those who came to buy grain, since the famine had also spread to the land of Canaan.
ekegusii: Nabo basinto ba Israeli bakagenda amo nabaanto bande abachiete kogora endagera, ekiagera enchara yarenge ase ense ya Kaanani.
swahili: Hivyo wana wa Israeli walikuwa miongoni mwa wale waliokwenda Misri kununua nafaka, kwani njaa ilikuwa katika nchi ya Kanaani pia.

english: Now Joseph was the ruler of the land; he was the one who sold grain to all its people. So when his brothers arrived, they bowed down before him with their faces to the ground.
ekegusii: Yusufu nere orenge gabana igoro y’ense yonsi ya Misiri, naende nere orenge kooneria abanto bonsi b’ense eria endagera. Na abamwabo Yusufu, ekero baigete asare, bagatung’ama inse ase obosio bwaye.
swahili: Wakati huo Yosefu alikuwa mtawala wa nchi ya Misri, naye alikuwa ndiye aliwauzia watu wote nafaka. Kwa hiyo wakati ndugu zake Yosefu walipofika, wakamsujudia hadi nyuso zao zikagusa ardhi.

english: And when Joseph saw his brothers, he recognized them, but he treated them as strangers and spoke harshly to them. “Where have you come from?” he asked. “From the land of Canaan,” they replied. “We are here to buy food.”
ekegusii: Yusufu, ekero abarora, akabamanya, korende agekora buna tabamanyeti, agakwana nabarabwo amang’ana amakong’u. Akababooria: “Abanto aba, ng’ai mwarure?” Barabwo bakamoiraneria: “Nigo twarure ase ense ya Kaanani, twachire kogora endagera.”
swahili: Mara Yosefu alipowaona ndugu zake, akawatambua, lakini akajifanya mgeni na kuzungumza nao kwa ukali, akiwauliza, “Ninyi mnatoka wapi?” Wakamjibu, “Tumetoka katika nchi ya Kanaani kuja kununua chakula.”

english: Although Joseph recognized his brothers, they did not recognize him.
ekegusii: Nonya Yusufu omanyete abamwabo, barabwo tibamomanyete ere.
swahili: Ingawa Yosefu aliwatambua ndugu zake, wao hawakumtambua.

english: Joseph remembered his dreams about them and said, “You are spies! You have come to see if our land is vulnerable.”
ekegusii: Erio Yusufu akainyora chindoto chiria areenge kobarootera, akabateebia: “Inwe nechirooti more, nigo mwachire koroota ense eye, na korora ase ere bosa etari na getango.”
swahili: Ndipo Yosefu alipokumbuka ndoto zake kuwahusu wao, akawaambia, “Ninyi ni wapelelezi! Mmekuja kuangalia mahali ambapo nchi yetu haina ulinzi.”

english: Now the famine was still severe in the land.
ekegusii: Enchara ekaba enene ase ense.
swahili: Wakati huu njaa ilikuwa bado ni kali mno katika nchi.

english: If we had not delayed, we could have come and gone twice by now.”
ekegusii: Onye totatebanire nanga twairanire chintunda ibere.”
swahili: Hakika, kama hatukuchelewa kuondoka, tungekuwa tumekwenda na kurudi mara mbili.”

english: Then their father Israel said to them, “If it must be so, then do this: Put some of the best products of the land in your packs and carry them down as a gift for the man—a little balm and a little honey, spices and myrrh, pistachios and almonds.
ekegusii: Israeli ise akabateebia: “Onye naboigo are, bono mokore iga: Mobeke ebinto ebiya bi’ense eye yaito ase chigunia chiaino, moirere omonto oyio buna ebiegwa. Momoirere amaguta okogwenia make, na obooke boke, na ubani, na manemane, na amajozi.
swahili: Basi baba yao Israeli akawaambia, “Kama ni lazima iwe hivyo, basi fanyeni hivi: Wekeni baadhi ya mazao bora ya nchi katika mifuko yenu na mpelekeeni yule mtu kama zawadi, zeri kidogo, asali kidogo, vikolezo, manemane, kungu na lozi.

english: Take double the silver with you so that you may return the silver that was put back into the mouths of your sacks. Perhaps it was a mistake.
ekegusii: Mobogorie chitaabu ara kabere ase amaboko aino, moirane chitaabu chiria chiairanetigwe, echio chiabegetwe igoro y’endagera ase chigunia chiaino ime. Aande nigo chiebetwe chikabekwao.
swahili: Chukueni fedha mara mbili, kwa kuwa mtazirudisha zile fedha zilizowekwa midomoni mwa magunia yenu. Labda ziliwekwa kwa makosa.

english: Take your brother as well, and return to the man at once.
ekegusii: Moire na oyomino, mogende komo, mogende ase omonto oria naende.
swahili: Mchukueni ndugu yenu pia mrudi kwa huyo mtu mara moja.

english: May God Almighty grant you mercy before the man, that he may release your other brother along with Benjamin. As for me, if I am bereaved, I am bereaved.”
ekegusii: Nyasae Omobui abae ogwancherwa ase obosio bw’omonto oyio, erio abasiborere oria omino onde, erinde moirane nere amo na Benjamini. Onye inche ekongwenera nsirerwe nabana baane, tiga abe bo.”
swahili: Naye Mungu Mwenyezi awajalieni rehema mbele ya huyo mtu ili apate kumwachia yule ndugu yenu na Benyamini mweze kurudi pamoja. Kwangu mimi kama nikufiwa nimefiwa.”

english: So the men took these gifts, along with double the amount of silver, and Benjamin as well. Then they hurried down to Egypt and stood before Joseph. Joseph’s Hospitality to His Brothers
ekegusii: Ase igo, abanto abwo bakaimokia ebiegwa, bakaimokia ne chitaabu ara kabere; amo na Benjamini bakagenda, bagatirimboka gochia Misiri, bagachia bagatenena ase obosio bwa Yusufu.
swahili: Basi hao watu wakazichukua zile zawadi na zile fedha mara mbili pamoja na Benyamini. Wakafanya haraka kwenda Misri na walipofika wakajionyesha kwa Yosefu.

english: When Joseph saw Benjamin with his brothers, he said to the steward of his house, “Take these men to my house. Slaughter an animal and prepare it, for they shall dine with me at noon.”
ekegusii: Ekero Yusufu arooche Benjamini ore amo nabarabwo agateebia omoteneneri bw’enka yaye: “Barente abanto abwo nyomba, na onyenye emori, oyeroisie, ekiagera abanto abwo nigo bagocha koragera amo nainche endagera ya mobaso.”
swahili: Yosefu alipomwona Benyamini pamoja nao, akamwambia msimamizi wa nyumba yake, “Wachukue watu hawa nyumbani kwangu, mchinje mnyama na kuandalia chakula kwa kuwa watakula chakula cha mchana pamoja nami.”

english: The man did as Joseph had commanded and took the brothers to Joseph’s house.
ekegusii: Omonto oria agakora buna Yusufu amotebetie, agasoyia abanto abwo nyomba ime.
swahili: Yule Msimamizi akafanya kama Yosefu alivyomwambia na akawachukua wale watu nyumbani kwa Yosefu.

english: But the brothers were frightened that they had been taken to Joseph’s house. “We have been brought here because of the silver that was returned in our bags the first time,” they said. “They intend to overpower us and take us as slaves, along with our donkeys.”
ekegusii: Korende abanto aba bakaondoka, ekiagera bairetwe nyomba mwa Yusufu, bakaboora: “Nigo twarentirwe nyomba ime ase engencho ye chitaabu chiria chiabegetwe ase chigunia chiaito engaki eria entang’ani. Na bono nigo ararigie gotosoera, na atoimokere, atobwate, atokore tobe abasomba baye, aire ne chitigere chiaito.”
swahili: Basi watu hao wakaogopa walipopelekwa nyumbani kwa Yosefu. Wakafikiri, “Tumeletwa hapa kwa ajili ya zile fedha zilizorudishwa katika magunia yetu mara ile ya kwanza. Anataka kutushambulia na kutushinda, atuchukue sisi kama watumwa, na atwae hawa punda zetu.”

english: So they approached Joseph’s steward and spoke to him at the entrance to the house.
ekegusii: Ase igo, bakamoika ang’e omoteneneri oria bw’enka ya Yusufu, bakaba bagokwana nere gesieri ki’enyomba,
swahili: Hivyo wakamwendea msimamizi wa nyumba wa Yosefu na kuzungumza naye kwenye ingilio la nyumbani.

english: So when Jacob’s sons had eaten all the grain they had brought from Egypt, their father said to them, “Go back and buy us a little more food.”
ekegusii: Na ekero bakoorire endagera eria bagorete korwa Misiri, ise akabateebia: “Irana naende motogorere endagera nke toche koria.”
swahili: Hivyo wakati walikuwa wamemaliza kula nafaka yote waliyoileta kutoka Misri, Yakobo baba yao akawaambia, “Rudini Misri mkatununulie chakula kingine zaidi.”

english: “Please, sir,” they said, “we really did come down here the first time to buy food.
ekegusii: bakabateebia: “Koranche Omonene, otoigwe! Engaki eria entang’ani twachete aiga kogora endagera,
swahili: Wakasema, “Tafadhali bwana, tulikuja hapa mara ya kwanza kununua chakula.

english: But when we came to the place we lodged for the night, we opened our sacks and, behold, each of us found his silver in the mouth of his sack! It was the full amount of our silver, and we have brought it back with us.
ekegusii: ekero twairanete gochia seito, gotwaikire ase twaraarete botuko, togachia gosansora chigunia chiaito, tokanyora kera omonto chitaabu chiaye nao chire igoro y’endagera ase egunia yaye ime, chitaabu chionsi pi. Bono chitaabu echi chionsi ntwachirentana, naa tochibwate amo naintwe.
swahili: Lakini mahali pale tulipotua wakati wa jioni tulifungua magunia yetu, na kila mmoja wetu akakuta fedha zake, kwenye mdomo wa gunia lake kiasi kile kile tulicholeta. Kwa hiyo tumezirudisha.

english: We have brought additional silver with us to buy food. We do not know who put our silver in our sacks.”
ekegusii: Naende ntwarentana chitaabu chinde, echi togocha kogora endagera. Titomanyeti gose ning’o ochibegete ase chigunia chiaito ime.”
swahili: Pia tumeleta fedha nyingine kwa ajili ya kununulia chakula. Hatujui ni nani aliziweka fedha hizo katika magunia yetu.”

english: “It is fine,” said the steward. “Do not be afraid. Your God, the God of your father, gave you the treasure that was in your sacks. I received your silver.” Then he brought Simeon out to them.
ekegusii: Akabairaneria “Timoka, motoerere, timoondoka; Nyasae oino, oyore Nyasae o iso, nere obaete enibo eye ase chigunia chiaino; chitaabu chiaino inachinyorete.” Erio akarenta Simioni ase bare.
swahili: Akawaambia, “Vema, msiogope. Mungu wenu, Mungu wa baba yenu, amewapa ninyi hazina katika magunia yenu; mimi nilipokea fedha yenu.” Ndipo akawaletea Simeoni.

english: And the steward took the men into Joseph’s house, gave them water to wash their feet, and provided food for their donkeys.
ekegusii: Omonto oria akaira abanto baria nyomba mwa Yusufu, akabaa amaache bagesibia amagoro abo, akaa ne chitigere chiabo endagera.
swahili: Msimamizi akawapeleka wale watu katika nyumba ya Yosefu, akawapa maji ya kunawa miguu na kuwapa punda wao majani.

english: Since the brothers had been told that they were going to eat a meal there, they prepared their gift for Joseph’s arrival at noon.
ekegusii: Barabwo bakabeeka ebiegwa biabo ang’e, baganye Yusufu kagocha mobaso, ekiagera konya baigure ng’a nao bagocha koragerera endagera ya mobaso.
swahili: Wakaandaa zawadi zao ili wampe Yosefu wakati atakapofika adhuhuri, kwa kuwa walikuwa wamesikia kwamba watakula chakula huko.

english: When Joseph came home, they presented him with the gifts they had brought, and they bowed to the ground before him.
ekegusii: Na ekero Yusufu achete nyomba ime bakamoirera ebiegwa biria barentete, bagatung’ama inse ase obosio bwaye.
swahili: Yosefu alipokuja nyumbani, walimkabidhi zile zawadi walizokuwa nazo, ambazo walikuwa wamezileta mle nyumbani, nao wakamsujudia hadi nchi.

english: He asked if they were well, and then he asked, “How is your elderly father you told me about? Is he still alive?”
ekegusii: Akabakwania, akababooria: “Inee! Iso mbuya are, omogaka oria mwanteebia? Moyo are?”
swahili: Akawauliza kuhusu hali yao, kisha akawaambia, “Yule baba yenu mzee mliyeniambia habari zake, yu hali gani? Je, bado yu hai?”

english: “Your servant our father is well,” they answered. “He is still alive.” And they bowed down to honor him.
ekegusii: Bakamoiraneria: “Ee, omosomba oo tata mbuya are. Nabo moyo are.” Barabwo bagatureka emetwe yabo inse.
swahili: Wakamjibu, “Mtumishi wako baba yetu bado anaishi na ni mzima.” Kisha wakainama chini kumpa heshima.

english: When Joseph looked up and saw his brother Benjamin, his own mother’s son, he asked, “Is this your youngest brother, the one you told me about?” Then he declared, “May God be gracious to you, my son.”
ekegusii: Yusufu agachia koimokia amaiso aye, akarora Benjamini omwabo, omwana omwabo baruete enda eyemo nere, akababooria: “Oyo nere oria omoke omino, oria mwanteebia?” Akaonchokera Benjamini, akamoteebia: “Nyasae akoe obuya, omwana one!”
swahili: Alipotazama na kumwona Benyamini ndugu yake, mwana wa mama yake hasa, akauliza, “Je, huyu ndiye ndugu yenu wa mwisho, ambaye mlinieleza habari zake?” Ndipo akasema, “Mungu na akufadhili, mwanangu.”

english: But Judah replied, “The man solemnly warned us, ‘You will not see my face again unless your brother is with you.’
ekegusii: Korende Yuda akabateebia: Omonto oria nigo atochigete bokong’u, agatoteebia: Timogocha kondora obosio bwane oyio omino atacheti amo nainwe.
swahili: Lakini Yuda akamwambia, “Mtu yule alituonya kwa msisitizo, ‘Hamtauona uso wangu tena mpaka mje na ndugu yenu.’

english: Joseph hurried out because he was moved to tears for his brother, and he went to a private room to weep.
ekegusii: Erio Yusufu akaimoka, agasoa enyomba ende, ekiagera enkoro yaye nigo yaare namaiga ase omwana omwabo, aroro ase enyomba eyio akarera amariga.
swahili: Akiwa ameguswa sana kwa kumwona ndugu yake, Yosefu akatoka nje kwa haraka na kutafuta mahali pa kulilia. Akaingia kwenye chumba chake cha pekee na kulilia humo.

english: Then he washed his face and came back out. Regaining his composure, he said, “Serve the meal.”
ekegusii: Erio agesibia obosio, agasoka oremereretie. Naende akabora: “Renta endagera!”
swahili: Baada ya kunawa uso wake, akatoka nje na huku akijizuia akasema, “Pakueni chakula.”

english: They separately served Joseph, his brothers, and the Egyptians. They ate separately because the Egyptians would not eat with the Hebrews, since that was detestable to them.
ekegusii: Bakamobekera endagera bweka ao, na abamwabo boka ao, na Abamisiri baria konya bakoragera komo boka ao, ekiagera Abamisiri nigo bagechete Abaiberania, tibaare koria amo nabarabwo.
swahili: Wakampakulia Yosefu peke yake, ndugu zake peke yao na Wamisri waliokula pamoja naye peke yao, kwa sababu Wamisri wasingeweza kula pamoja na Waebrania, kwa maana ilikuwa ni chukizo kwa Wamisri.

english: They were seated before Joseph in order by age, from the firstborn to the youngest, and the men looked at one another in astonishment.
ekegusii: Abamwabo Yusufu bagaikaransigwa ase obosio bwaye, bakaroberigwa gochakera ase oria omonene kogenderera goika ase oria omoke. Bonsi kobaikaransire, bakarigererania, bagakumia.
swahili: Watu hao walikuwa wameketi mbele yake kwa mfuatano wa umri wao, kuanzia mzaliwa wa kwanza hadi mzaliwa wa mwisho, wakatazamana wao kwa wao kwa mshangao.

english: When the portions were served to them from Joseph’s table, Benjamin’s portion was five times larger than any of the others. So they feasted and drank freely with Joseph.
ekegusii: Bakaegwa endagera korwa ase emesa ya Yusufu, korende Benjamini ere akarenterwa enyinge kobua abwo bande, ebirengo bitano. Naboigo bakanywa, bakagoka amo nere.
swahili: Wakati walipelekewa sehemu ya chakula kutoka mezani mwa Yosefu, sehemu ya Benyamini ilikuwa mara tano zaidi ya sehemu ya wale wengine. Kwa hiyo wakanywa na kufurahi pamoja naye.

english: If you will send our brother with us, we will go down and buy food for you.
ekegusii: Koratoe oyominto agende amo naintwe, rirorio inatotirimboke tokogorere endagera.
swahili: Kama utakubali ndugu yetu aende pamoja nasi, tutakwenda kuwanunulia chakula.

english: But if you will not send him, we will not go; for the man told us, ‘You will not see my face again unless your brother is with you.’”
ekegusii: Korende onye togotomoa togende komo, rirorio titokogenda, ekiagera omonto oria nigo atoteebetie, “Timokondora obosio bwane motacheti noyio omino.”
swahili: Lakini ikiwa hutamruhusu aende, hatutakwenda, kwa sababu mtu yule alituambia, ‘Hamtauona uso wangu tena mpaka mje pamoja na ndugu yenu.’ ”

english: “Why did you bring this trouble upon me?” Israel asked. “Why did you tell the man you had another brother?”
ekegusii: Israeli akababooria: “Ninki mwankorera igo na gonchanda, goika mogateebia omonto oria ng’a mokare noyomino onde inka?”
swahili: Israeli akauliza, “Kwa nini mkaniletea taabu hii kwa kumwambia yule mtu mlikuwa na ndugu mwingine?”

english: They replied, “The man questioned us in detail about ourselves and our family: ‘Is your father still alive? Do you have another brother?’ And we answered him accordingly. How could we possibly know that he would say, ‘Bring your brother here’?”
ekegusii: Barabwo bakamoiraneria: “Omonto oria nigo atounetie mono amanye amang’ana aito na ay’eamate yaito, agatoboria: Iso moyo are? Mokare nonde omino? Na intwe tokamoiraneria buna atoboretie. Inee! Ntwamanyete aya agochia gokwana ng’a: Gachie morente oyomino?”
swahili: Wakamjibu, “Yule mtu alituhoji kwa undani sana habari zetu na za jamaa yetu. Alituuliza, ‘Je, baba yenu bado yungali hai? Je mnaye ndugu mwingine?’ Sisi tulimjibu maswali yake tu. Tungewezaje kujua kwamba angesema, ‘Mleteni mdogo wenu hapa’?”

english: And Judah said to his father Israel, “Send the boy with me, and we will go at once, so that we may live and not die—neither we, nor you, nor our children.
ekegusii: Yuda agateebia Israeli ise: “Mong’e omosae oyo agende amo nainche, erio toimoke togende aroro, erinde egere tobe moyo, titokwa, intwe, naye, amo nabana baito abake.
swahili: Ndipo Yuda akamwambia baba yake Israeli, “Mtume kijana pamoja nami, nasi tutaondoka mara, ili sisi na wewe pamoja na watoto wetu tuweze kuishi, wala tusife.

english: I will guarantee his safety. You may hold me personally responsible. If I do not bring him back and set him before you, then may I bear the guilt before you all my life.
ekegusii: Nerure imbe intenenera asare: korwa ase okoboko kwane oche komonsaba. Onye tinkomoirania gocha asore, rirorio ontige mbogorie okomocha okwo amatuko onsi ase obosio bwao.
swahili: Mimi mwenyewe nitakuhakikishia usalama wake, mimi mwenyewe nitawajibika kumrudisha. Ikiwa sitamrudisha kwako na kumweka mbele yako, nitakuwa mwenye lawama mbele yako maisha yangu yote.

english: Then Joseph instructed his steward: “Fill the men’s sacks with as much food as they can carry, and put each one’s silver in the mouth of his sack.
ekegusii: Erio Yusufu agachiika omoteneneri bw’enka yaye: “Ichoria chigunia chi’abaanto aba endagera, koreng’ana buna baranyare kobogoria, obeke ne chitaabu chia kera omonto igoro y’endagera ase egunia yaye ime.
swahili: Kisha Yosefu akampa yule msimamizi wa nyumbani mwake maagizo haya: “Jaza magunia ya watu hawa kiasi cha chakula ambacho wanaweza kuchukua, na uweke fedha ya kila mtu kwenye mdomo wa gunia lake.

english: “As you say,” replied the steward. “But only the one who is found with the cup will be my slave, and the rest of you shall be free of blame.”
ekegusii: Akabora: “Tiga abe buna mwateeba, omonto oranyorekane okebwate nigo arabe omosomba one, korende inwe abande inamobe motari na komocha.”
swahili: Akajibu, “Vema sana; na iwe kama msemavyo. Yeyote atakayekutwa nacho atakuwa mtumwa wangu, lakini ninyi wengine mtakuwa hamna lawama.”

english: So each one quickly lowered his sack to the ground and opened it.
ekegusii: Erio bagakora bwango, bagaikia kera omonto egunia yaye inse, na koyesansora.
swahili: Kila mmoja wao akafanya haraka kushusha gunia lake chini na kulifungua.

english: The steward searched, beginning with the oldest and ending with the youngest—and the cup was found in Benjamin’s sack.
ekegusii: Na omosomba oria agachaaka koriga‐rigia, agachakera ase omomura omonene, agachia gokoorera ase omoke, na egekombe gekanyorekana ase egunia ya Benjamini.
swahili: Ndipo msimamizi akaendelea kutafuta, akianzia kwa mkubwa wa wote na akaishia kwa mdogo wa wote. Basi kikombe kikapatikana katika gunia la Benyamini.

english: Then they all tore their clothes, loaded their donkeys, and returned to the city.
ekegusii: Erio bonsi bagatandora chianga chiabo; kera omonto akabeekera etigere yaye egurube, bakairana gochia ase omochie.
swahili: Kwa jambo hili, wakararua nguo zao. Ndipo wote wakapakiza mizigo yao juu ya punda zao na kurudi mjini.

english: When Judah and his brothers arrived at Joseph’s house, he was still there, and they fell to the ground before him.
ekegusii: Yuda na abamwabo, ekero bairanete ase omochie, bakanyora Yusufu nao are nyomba, barabwo bagatung’ama inse bakaumama, ase obosio bwaye.
swahili: Yosefu alikuwa bado yuko nyumbani mwake wakati Yuda na kaka zake walipoingia, wote wakajitupa chini mbele yake.

english: “What is this deed you have done?” Joseph declared. “Do you not know that a man like me can surely divine the truth?”
ekegusii: Yusufu akababooria: “Ing’ana ki eri mwakorire? Timomanyeti ng’a omonto buna inche nigo ndanyare gokora oboringoria imanye?”
swahili: Yosefu akawaambia, “Ni jambo gani hili mlilolifanya? Hamjui kuwa mtu kama mimi anaweza kufahamu mambo kwa njia ya kutabiri?”

english: “What can we say to my lord?” Judah replied. “How can we plead? How can we justify ourselves? God has exposed the iniquity of your servants. We are now my lord’s slaves—both we and the one who was found with the cup.”
ekegusii: Yuda akairaneria: “Ninki togoteeba asore, Omonene oito? Ninki togokwana? Gose inatonyare kweenekia ng’a nabaronge tore? Nyasae ororire ebibe biaito intwe abasomba bao; na bono, omonene oito, intwe amo nere, oyo egekombe kianyorekana ase okoboko kwaye, tiga tobe abasomba bao.”
swahili: Yuda akajibu, “Tutaweza kusema nini kwa bwana wangu? Tutaweza kuzungumza nini? Tutawezaje kuthibitisha kwamba hatuna hatia? Mungu amefunua hatia ya watumishi wako. Sasa sisi tu watumwa wa bwana wangu, sisi wenyewe pamoja na yule aliyepatikana na kikombe.”

english: But Joseph replied, “Far be it from me to do this. The man who was found with the cup will be my slave. The rest of you may return to your father in peace.” Judah Pleads for Benjamin
ekegusii: Yusufu akabora: “Yaya, tari bo; tingokora bo. Omonto oyo bweka egekombe kianyorekana koboko kwaye, nere orabe omosomba one, korende inwe abande, genda nomorembe seino ase iso.” Yuda ogosabera Benjamini
swahili: Lakini Yosefu alisema, “Liwe mbali nami kufanya jambo kama hili! Mtu yule tu aliyekutwa na kikombe ndiye atakayekuwa mtumwa wangu. Ninyi wengine, rudini kwa baba yenu kwa amani.”

english: Then Judah approached Joseph and said, “Sir, please let your servant speak personally to my lord. Do not be angry with your servant, for you are equal to Pharaoh himself.
ekegusii: Erio Yuda akamoika ang’e, akamoteebia: “Koranche, omonene one, ong’e inche, omosomba oo, ribaga ngoteebie ring’ana erimo. Tobaisa kombea inche, omosomba oo, naki aye nigo ore buna Farao.
swahili: Ndipo Yuda akamwendea na kumwambia: “Tafadhali bwana wangu, mruhusu mtumishi wako aseme neno kwa bwana wangu. Usimkasirikie mtumishi wako, ingawa wewe ni sawa na Farao mwenyewe.

english: My lord asked his servants, ‘Do you have a father or a brother?’
ekegusii: Aye omonene one, nigo gwatoboretie intwe abasomba bao: Inee! Mokare na iso gose onde omino?
swahili: Bwana wangu aliwauliza watumishi wake, ‘Mnaye baba au ndugu?’

english: Put my cup, the silver one, in the mouth of the youngest one’s sack, along with the silver for his grain.” So the steward did as Joseph had instructed.
ekegusii: Obeke na egekombe kiane keria kiaroisetigwe korwa ase chifeta, okebeke ime ase egunia y’omomura oria omoke kegima, amo ne chitaabu chiria achete nachio kogora endagera.” Ere agakora buna Yusufu amotebetie.
swahili: Kisha weka kikombe changu kile cha fedha kwenye mdomo wa gunia la yule mdogo wa wote pamoja na fedha zake ambazo angenunulia nafaka yake.” Naye akafanya kama Yosefu alivyosema.

english: And we answered, ‘We have an elderly father and a younger brother, the child of his old age. The boy’s brother is dead. He is the only one of his mother’s sons left, and his father loves him.’
ekegusii: Intwe togakoiraneria aye, omonene one: Ee, ntokare na tata, ere ogotire, nakabwate omwana omomura bw’obogotu bwaye, korende momura omwabo nakwete, oyo nere otigarete bweka ase ng’ina, na ise nigo amwanchete mono.
swahili: Nasi tukakujibu, ‘Tunaye baba yetu ambaye ni mzee; pia yupo mwanawe mdogo aliyezaliwa katika uzee wake. Ndugu yake amekufa, na huyu mdogo ndiye mwana pekee kwa mama yake aliyebaki, naye baba yake anampenda.’

english: Then you told your servants, ‘Bring him down to me so that I can see him for myself.’
ekegusii: Erio ogatoteebia intwe, abasomba bao: Gachie momondetere, ache aa imorore.
swahili: “Ndipo ulipowaambia watumishi wako, ‘Mleteni kwangu ili niweze kumwona kwa macho yangu mwenyewe.’

english: So we said to my lord, ‘The boy cannot leave his father. If he were to leave, his father would die.’
ekegusii: Na intwe togakoiraneria aye, omonene one, ng’a omosae oyo takonyara gotiga ise; aise komotiga, ise nigo arakwe.
swahili: Nasi tukamwambia bwana wangu, ‘Kijana hawezi kumwacha baba yake; akimwacha, baba yake atakufa.’

english: But you said to your servants, ‘Unless your younger brother comes down with you, you will not see my face again.’
ekegusii: Naye ogatoteebia intwe abasomba bao: Momura omino omoke atatirimbogeti amo nainwe, timogocha ase obosio bwane naende.
swahili: Lakini ukawaambia watumishi wako, ‘Ndugu yenu mdogo asiposhuka pamoja nanyi, hamtauona uso wangu tena.’

english: Now when we returned to your servant my father, we relayed your words to him.
ekegusii: “Ekero twairanete ase tata, omosomba oo, tokamoteebia amang’ana ao, omonene one.
swahili: Tuliporudi nyumbani kwa mtumwa wako baba yangu, tulimwambia lile bwana wangu alilokuwa amesema.

english: Then our father said, ‘Go back and buy us some food.’
ekegusii: Na ekero tata atoteebetie ng’a toirane tomogorere endagera inke,
swahili: “Ndipo baba yetu aliposema, ‘Rudini Misri mkanunue chakula kingine.’

english: But we answered, ‘We cannot go down there unless our younger brother goes with us. So if our younger brother is not with us, we cannot see the man.’
ekegusii: tokamoiraneria: Titokonyara gotirimboka gochia ase obosio bw’omonto oria, oyominto omoke atari amo naintwe, korende onye oyominto ogotirimboka amo naintwe, rirorio natogende.
swahili: Lakini tukamwambia, ‘Hatuwezi kushuka Misri mpaka ndugu yetu mdogo awe pamoja nasi ndipo tutakapokwenda. Hatutaweza kuuona uso wa yule mtu mpaka ndugu yetu mdogo awe pamoja nasi.’

english: And your servant my father said to us, ‘You know that my wife bore me two sons.
ekegusii: Erio omosomba oo tata agatoteebia: Momanyete ng’a omokungu one nigo anyiborerete abana abamura babere boka.
swahili: “Mtumwa wako baba yangu alituambia, ‘Mnajua mke wangu alinizalia wana wawili.

english: When one of them was gone, I said: “Surely he has been torn to pieces.” And I have not seen him since.
ekegusii: Oyomo nigo ansirerete, na inche ngateeba: Tekomocha koba ng’a neching’iti chi’orosana chiamoitete, tinana komoorora goika reero iga.
swahili: Mmojawapo alipotea, nami nikasema, “Hakika ameraruliwa vipande vipande.” Nami sijamwona tangu wakati huo.

english: Now if you also take this one from me and harm comes to him, you will bring my gray hair down to Sheol in sorrow.’
ekegusii: Onye mokoirana oyo nere korwa ase ’nde, na amabe achie komonyoora, rirorio nigo moragere inkwe ngende ase oboina ne chimbuche chiane, inde nomoichano.
swahili: Ikiwa mtaniondolea huyu tena na akapatwa na madhara, mtashusha kichwa changu chenye mvi kaburini nikiwa mwenye huzuni.’

english: At daybreak, the men were sent on their way with their donkeys.
ekegusii: Bogachia gokia mambia abanto baria bakaegwa ribaga baimokie chitigere chiabo, bagende sobo.
swahili: Kulipopambazuka, hao watu wakaruhusiwa kuondoka pamoja na punda zao.

english: So if the boy is not with us when I return to your servant, and if my father, whose life is wrapped up in the boy’s life,
ekegusii: “Na bono kondagende inka ase tata, omosomba oo, ntaireti omosae oyo amo naintwe, oyo tata nigo amwanchete mono, takorora buya.
swahili: “Hivyo sasa, kama kijana hatakuwa pamoja nasi nitakaporudi kwa mtumishi wako baba yangu, na kama baba yangu, ambaye maisha yake yamefungamanishwa na uhai wa kijana huyu,

english: sees that the boy is not with us, he will die. Then your servants will have brought the gray hair of your servant our father down to Sheol in sorrow.
ekegusii: Ekero ararore ng’a omosae oyo taiyo, nigo arakwe, na intwe, abasomba bao, nigo toragere agende ase oboina ne chimbuche chiaye, ore nomoichano.
swahili: akiona kijana hayupo nasi, atakufa. Watumishi wako watashusha kichwa chenye mvi cha baba yetu kaburini kwa huzuni.

english: Indeed, your servant guaranteed the boy’s safety to my father, saying, ‘If I do not return him to you, I will bear the guilt before you, my father, all my life.’
ekegusii: Naki inche, omosomba oo, nigo nebegete nkaba intenenera ase omosae oyo ase tata, nkamoteebia: Ntamoiraneti asore, nigo ndabe omomochi asore ase obogima bwane bwonsi.
swahili: Mtumwa wako alimhakikishia baba yangu usalama wa kijana. Nikamwambia, ‘Kama sikumrudisha kwako nitakuwa mwenye lawama mbele yako, baba yangu, maisha yangu yote!’

english: Now please let your servant stay here as my lord’s slave in place of the boy. Let him return with his brothers.
ekegusii: Na bono, omonene one, nagosoroire, ntige imbe omosomba oo ribaga ri’ omosae oyo; ere omotige agende amo nabamwabo inka.
swahili: “Sasa basi, tafadhali mruhusu mtumishi abaki hapa kama mtumwa wa bwana wangu badala ya kijana, naye kijana umruhusu arudi na ndugu zake.

english: For how can I go back to my father without the boy? I could not bear to see the misery that would overwhelm him.”
ekegusii: Naki ndakore ing’irane ase tata, omosae oyo atari amo nainche? Tinkoremereria korora emechando enga buna eyio ekomonyoora tata.”
swahili: Ninawezaje kurudi kwa baba yangu kama kijana hatakuwa pamoja nami? La hasha! Usiniache nikaone huzuni ile itakayompata baba yangu.”

english: They had not gone far from the city when Joseph told his steward, “Pursue the men at once, and when you overtake them, ask, ‘Why have you repaid good with evil?
ekegusii: Ekero bagendire egeka geke korwa ase omochie, Yusufu agateebia omoteneneri bw’enka yaye. “Imoka, obwatie abanto baria! Ekero orabanyore obaborie: Nase ki mogoakana amabe ase amaya?
swahili: Kabla hawajafika mbali kutoka mjini, Yosefu akamwambia mtumishi wake, “Wafuatilie wale watu mara moja, utakapowakuta, waambie, ‘Kwa nini mmelipiza wema kwa ubaya?

english: Is this not the cup my master drinks from and uses for divination? What you have done is wicked!’”
ekegusii: Inee! Egekombe eke mwaibete, tai kerokio omonene one akonywera? Naende nakio agokorera oboringoria. Mwakorire bobe ase ogokora iga.”
swahili: Je, kikombe hiki sicho anachonywea bwana wangu na pia hukitumia kwa kutabiri mambo yajayo? Hili ni jambo ovu mlilolitenda.’ ”

english: When the steward overtook them, he relayed these words to them.
ekegusii: Ekero abaikerete agakwana nabarabwo amang’ana aria aria.
swahili: Alipowafikia, akarudia maneno haya kwao.

english: “Why does my lord say these things?” they asked. “Your servants could not possibly do such a thing.
ekegusii: Barabwo bakamoiraneria: “Naki aye, Omonene oito, ogokwana amang’ana buna ayio?
swahili: Lakini wakamwambia mtumishi, “Kwa nini bwana wangu anasema maneno kama haya? Liwe mbali na watumishi wako wasije wakafanya jambo kama hilo!

english: We even brought back to you from the land of Canaan the silver we found in the mouths of our sacks. Why would we steal silver or gold from your master’s house?
ekegusii: Tari bo, intwe abasomba bao titware gokora bo. Inee! Chibesa chiria twanyorete igoro y’endagera ase chigunia chiaito ime, titwagochiiraneria naende korwa ase ense ya Kaanani? Naki tware gokora toibe efeta gose etaabu korwa ase enyomba y’omonene oo?
swahili: Hata hivyo tulikurudishia zile fedha kutoka nchi ya Kanaani ambazo tulizikuta kwenye midomo ya magunia yetu. Hivyo kwa nini tuibe fedha au dhahabu kutoka nyumbani kwa bwana wako?

english: If any of your servants is found to have it, he must die, and the rest will become slaves of my lord.”
ekegusii: Oyoranyorekane ore negekombe ekio ase egati yaito intwe abasomba bao, oyio akwe, naintwe boigo rirorio tobe abasomba bao, Omonene oito.”
swahili: Ikiwa yeyote miongoni mwa watumishi wako atapatikana nacho, auawe, na sisi wengine tutakuwa watumwa wa bwana wangu.”

english: Then Joseph could no longer control himself before all his attendants, and he cried out, “Send everyone away from me!” So none of them were with Joseph when he made himself known to his brothers.
ekegusii: Agwo Yusufu agasinywa gotanga okweigwa kwaye, ase obosio bw’abaanto bonsi abateneine ang’e nere, agaaka eriogi, akabora, “Barusie aa bonsi ase obosio bwane!” Ase igo, monto onde tareengeo ase obosio bwa Yusufu ekero emanyekanetie ase abamwabo,
swahili: Hapo Yosefu hakuweza kujizuia zaidi mbele ya wote waliokuwa wamesimama karibu naye, akapaza sauti, akasema, “Mwondoeni kila mtu mbele yangu!” Kwa hiyo hapakuwepo mtu yeyote pamoja na Yosefu alipojitambulisha kwa ndugu zake.

english: You shall settle in the land of Goshen and be near me—you and your children and grandchildren, your flocks and herds, and everything you own.
ekegusii: Aye nigo oramenye ase ensemo ya Goseni, nigo oramenye ang’e nainche, aye amo nabana bao, na abachokoro bao.
swahili: Nawe utaishi katika nchi ya Gosheni na kuwa karibu nami, wewe, watoto wako na wajukuu wako, makundi yako ya kondoo, mbuzi na ngʼombe, pamoja na vyote ulivyo navyo.

english: And there I will provide for you, because there will be five more years of famine. Otherwise, you and your household and everything you own will come to destitution.’
ekegusii: Agwo inche ninkoragerie, erinde tobaisa gocha gosoa ase okoremeerwa, aye amo nabaanto bao, na bionsi ebi ore nabio, ekiagera emiaka etano y’enchara netigarete.
swahili: Nitawatunza huko, kwa sababu bado iko miaka mingine mitano inayokuja ya njaa. La sivyo, wewe na nyumba yako na wote ulio nao mtakuwa fukara.’

english: Behold! You and my brother Benjamin can see that I, Joseph, am the one speaking with you.
ekegusii: “Na bono imorooche namaiso aino, na Benjamini boigo narooche namaiso aye, ng’a ninche omonyene ngokwana nainwe.
swahili: “Mnaweza kujionea wenyewe, hata ndugu yangu Benyamini, kwamba hakika ni mimi ninayezungumza nanyi.

english: Tell my father about all my splendor in Egypt and everything you have seen. And bring my father down here quickly.”
ekegusii: Moteebie tata obonene bwonsi mbwate aiga Misiri, na binde bionsi mwarorire. Mokore bwango, momorente gocha aa.”
swahili: Mwambieni baba yangu juu ya heshima yote niliyopewa huku Misri, na kuhusu kila kitu mlichokiona. Mleteni baba yangu huku haraka.”

english: Then Joseph threw his arms around his brother Benjamin and wept, and Benjamin wept as they embraced.
ekegusii: Erio akaboania Benjamini rigoti, akarera; Benjamini nere akarera kamoboanetie rigoti riaye.
swahili: Ndipo akamkumbatia Benyamini ndugu yake na kulia, naye Benyamini akamkumbatia akilia.

english: Joseph kissed each of his brothers as he wept over them. And afterward his brothers talked with him. Pharaoh Invites Jacob to Egypt
ekegusii: Yusufu akanyunyunta abamwabo bonsi, akarera ase bare. Na magega y’ayio abamwabo bakagosoria nere.
swahili: Pia akawabusu ndugu zake wote, huku akilia. Baada ya hayo ndugu zake wakazungumza naye.

english: When the news reached Pharaoh’s house that Joseph’s brothers had come, Pharaoh and his servants were pleased.
ekegusii: Ekero chinkuma chiaigwekanete ase enka ya Farao ng’a abamwabo Yusufu bachire, amang’ana ayio akagwenera Farao amo nabasomba baye bonsi.
swahili: Habari zilipofika kwenye jumba la Farao kwamba ndugu zake Yosefu wamefika, Farao na maafisa wake wote wakafurahi.

english: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “Tell your brothers, ‘Do as follows: Load your animals and return to the land of Canaan.
ekegusii: Farao agateebia Yusufu: “Bateebie abamino iga: Berekia ching’iti chiaino chigurube, moimoke mogende ase ense yaino ya Kaanani,
swahili: Farao akamwambia Yosefu, “Waambie ndugu zako, ‘Fanyeni hivi: Pakieni wanyama wenu mrudi mpaka nchi ya Kanaani,

english: Then bring your father and your families and return to me. I will give you the best of the land of Egypt, and you shall eat from the fat of the land.’
ekegusii: Morente iso na abanto b’enka yaye bache ase ’nde. Inche nimbae ebire ebiya bi’ense ya Misiri, na inwe namorie obonoru bw’ense eye.
swahili: mkamlete baba yenu na jamaa zenu kwangu. Nitawapa sehemu nzuri sana ya nchi ya Misri nanyi mtafurahia unono wa nchi.’

english: You are also directed to tell them: ‘Take wagons from the land of Egypt for your young children and your wives, and bring your father and come back.
ekegusii: Naende goika obateebie iga, Ira chigari korwa aa Misiri, ase okobogoreria abana baino abake, na abakungu baino, mobogorerie na iso, moche nabarabwo.
swahili: “Mnaagizwa pia kuwaambia, ‘Fanyeni hivi: Chukueni magari ya kukokotwa kutoka Misri, kwa ajili ya watoto wenu na wake zenu, mkamchukue baba yenu mje.

english: But he wept so loudly that the Egyptians heard him, and Pharaoh’s household soon heard of it.
ekegusii: korende ekero aagete eriogi ase okorera, Abamisiri amo nabaanto b’enka ya Farao bakamoigwa.
swahili: Naye akalia kwa sauti kubwa kiasi kwamba Wamisri walimsikia, hata watu wa nyumbani mwa Farao wakapata hizo habari.

english: But pay no regard to your belongings, for the best of all the land of Egypt is yours.’”
ekegusii: Timochandekera ebinto biaino, ebi moratige magega, ekiagera bionsi ebire ebiya mono ase ense ya Misiri nebiaino.”
swahili: Msijali kamwe kuhusu mali zenu, kwa sababu mema yote ya Misri yatakuwa yenu.’ ”

english: So the sons of Israel did as they were told. Joseph gave them wagons as Pharaoh had instructed, and he also gave them provisions for their journey.
ekegusii: Erio basinto ba Israeli bagakora buna bateebetigwe, na Yusufu akabaa chigari buna Farao achiigete, amo nendagera bagochia koria inchera.
swahili: Hivyo wana wa Israeli wakafanya hivyo. Yosefu akawapa magari ya kukokotwa, kama Farao alivyoagiza, pia akawapa mahitaji kwa ajili ya safari yao.

english: He gave new garments to each of them, but to Benjamin he gave three hundred shekels of silver and five sets of clothes.
ekegusii: Akaa kera oyomo eanga agochia koonchoreria, korende Benjamini ere akamoa chisekeli chi’echifeta amagana atato amo ne chianga isano, echi agochia koonchoreria.
swahili: Kila mmoja mavazi mapya, lakini Benyamini akampa shekeli 300 za fedha, na jozi tano za nguo.

english: And he sent to his father the following: ten donkeys loaded with the best of Egypt, and ten female donkeys loaded with grain and bread and provisions for his father’s journey.
ekegusii: Agatomera na ise chitigere ikomi chiabogoretie ebinto ebiya mono bia Misiri, ne chitigere chiaberi chiabogoretie endagera, na emegati, na endagera ende agochia koria inchera.
swahili: Hivi ndivyo vitu alivyotuma kwa baba yake: punda kumi waliochukua vitu vizuri vya Misri, punda wake kumi waliobeba nafaka, mikate na mahitaji mengine ya safari.

english: Then Joseph sent his brothers on their way, and as they were leaving, he said to them, “Do not quarrel on the way!” The Revival of Jacob
ekegusii: Erio agatigana nabamwabo bagende sobo, akabateebia: “Timobaisa kwomana inchera!”
swahili: Akaagana na ndugu zake walipokuwa wakiondoka, akawaambia, “Msigombane njiani!”

english: So the brothers went up out of Egypt and came to their father Jacob in the land of Canaan.
ekegusii: Barabwo bakarua Misiri, bagaika ense ya Kaanani ase Yakobo ise.
swahili: Basi wakatoka Misri na kufika kwa baba yao Yakobo katika nchi ya Kanaani.

english: “Joseph is still alive,” they said, “and he is ruler over all the land of Egypt!” But Jacob was stunned, for he did not believe them.
ekegusii: Agwo bakamanyia ise amang’ana ng’a Yusufu moyo are, naende nere omogambi ase ense yonsi ya Misiri. Yakobo agachia koyaigwa, akagoyaana ase omoyo oye, tanyara kwegena amang’ana abo.
swahili: Wakamwambia baba yao, “Yosefu angali hai! Ukweli ni kwamba yeye ndiye mtawala wa Misri yote.” Yakobo akapigwa na bumbuazi; hakuwasadiki.

english: However, when they relayed all that Joseph had told them, and when he saw the wagons that Joseph had sent to carry him back, the spirit of their father Jacob was revived.
ekegusii: Korende bakamoteebia amang’ana onsi Yusufu abateebetie. Ere agachia korora chigari chiria Yusufu amotomerete chigocha komoimokia, omoyo oye okaba nobogima oboyia.
swahili: Lakini walipokwisha kumweleza kila kitu ambacho Yosefu alikuwa amewaambia, na alipoona magari ya kukokotwa Yosefu aliyokuwa amempelekea ya kumchukua aende Misri, roho ya baba yao Yakobo ikahuishwa.

english: “Enough!” declared Israel. “My son Joseph is still alive! I will go to see him before I die.”
ekegusii: Israeli akabora: “Ayio aisanire. Yusufu, omwana one, moyo are. Nigo ndagende komoorora ritang’ani ntarakwa.”
swahili: Ndipo Israeli akasema, “Nimesadiki! Mwanangu Yosefu bado yu hai. Nitakwenda nikamwone kabla sijafa.”

english: Joseph said to his brothers, “I am Joseph! Is my father still alive?” But they were unable to answer him, because they were terrified in his presence.
ekegusii: Yusufu agateebia bamura bamwabo: “Ninche Yusufu. Tata moyo are?” Korende bamura bamwabo tibanyara komoiraneria, ekiagera basoetwe nobwoba obonene.
swahili: Yosefu akawaambia ndugu zake, “Mimi ni Yosefu! Je, baba yangu angali hai bado?” Lakini ndugu zake hawakuweza kumjibu, kwa sababu walipatwa na hofu kuu mbele yake.

english: Then Joseph said to his brothers, “Please come near me.” And they did so. “I am Joseph, your brother,” he said, “the one you sold into Egypt!
ekegusii: Erio Yusufu agateebia bamura bamwabo: “Inchuo ase ’nde ang’e!” Barabwo bakamoika ang’e. Naende akabateebia: “Ninche Yusufu omiino, oyo mwaoonetie gocha aa Misiri.
swahili: Ndipo Yosefu akawaambia ndugu zake, “Sogeeni karibu nami.” Waliposogea, akasema, “Mimi ni ndugu yenu Yosefu, yule ambaye mlimuuza Misri!

english: And now, do not be distressed or angry with yourselves that you sold me into this place, because it was to save lives that God sent me before you.
ekegusii: Korende timoichana, gose timwechanda ase emioyo yaino, ekiagera mwang’oonetie gocha aa. Naki Nyasae nere ontomete mbatang’anere gocha aa, erinde ntoorie obogima bw’abaanto.
swahili: Sasa, msihuzunike wala msijichukie wenyewe kwa kuniuza huku, kwa sababu ilikuwa ni ili kuokoa maisha ya watu ndiyo sababu Mungu alinituma niwatangulie ninyi.

english: For the famine has covered the land these two years, and there will be five more years without plowing or harvesting.
ekegusii: Omwaka oyo noyo o kabere enchara ere ase ense, naende netigarete emiaka etano abanto batareme gose kogesa.
swahili: Kwa miaka miwili sasa imekuwepo njaa katika nchi, pia kwa miaka mitano ijayo hapatakuwepo kulima wala kuvuna.

english: God sent me before you to preserve you as a remnant on the earth and to save your lives by a great deliverance.
ekegusii: Nyasae nigo antomete mbatang’anere inwe, erinde motigare ase ense, na koba moyo ase ogotooreka kw’abange.
swahili: Lakini Mungu alinitanguliza mbele yenu ili kuhifadhi mabaki kwa ajili yenu katika nchi, na kuokoa maisha yenu kwa wokovu mkuu.

english: Therefore it was not you who sent me here, but God, who has made me a father to Pharaoh—lord of all his household and ruler over all the land of Egypt. Joseph Sends for His Father
ekegusii: Ase igo,, tari inwe mwantomete gocha aa, korende Nyasae omonyene. Nere ombegete imbe ise Farao, n’Omonene ase enka yaye yonsi, na omogambi ase ense yonsi ya Misiri.
swahili: “Kwa hiyo basi, si ninyi mlionileta huku, bali ni Mungu. Alinifanya kuwa baba kwa Farao, bwana wa watu wa nyumbani mwake wote, na mtawala wa Misri yote.

english: Now return quickly to my father and tell him, ‘This is what your son Joseph says: God has made me lord of all Egypt. Come down to me without delay.
ekegusii: “Ayerera bwango, moirane gochia ase tata, momoteebie iga: Aya naro omwana oo Yusufu agoteeba: Nyasae ombekire koba Omonene ase ense yonsi ya Misiri; tirimboka gocha ase ’nde, totebana.
swahili: Sasa rudini haraka kwa baba yangu na mwambieni, ‘Hili ndilo mwanao Yosefu asemalo: Mungu amenifanya mimi kuwa bwana wa Misri yote. Shuka uje kwangu, wala usikawie.

english: So Israel set out with all that he had, and when he came to Beersheba, he offered sacrifices to the God of his father Isaac.
ekegusii: Ase igo, Israeli akaimoka, akagenda, akaira ebinto bionsi ebi abwate, agaika Beeri‐Seba, akaruera Nyasae o Isaka ise ekeng’wanso.
swahili: Hivyo Israeli akaondoka na vyote vilivyokuwa mali yake, naye alipofika Beer-Sheba, akamtolea dhabihu Mungu wa Isaki baba yake.

english: The sons of Simeon: Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jachin, Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanite woman.
ekegusii: Na abana abamura ba Simioni nabwo aba: Yemueli, na Yamini, na Ohadi, na Yakini, na Sohari, na Saulo, omwana bw’omokuungu Omokaanani.
swahili: Wana wa Simeoni ni: Yemueli, Yamini, Ohadi, Yakini, Sohari na Shauli mwana wa mwanamke Mkanaani.

english: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
ekegusii: Na abana abamura ba Lawi nabwo aba: Gerisoni, na Kohati, na Merari.
swahili: Wana wa Lawi ni: Gershoni, Kohathi na Merari.

english: The sons of Judah: Er, Onan, Shelah, Perez, and Zerah; but Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan. The sons of Perez: Hezron and Hamul.
ekegusii: Na abana abamura ba Yuda nabwo aba: Eri, na Onani, na Sela, na Peresu, na Zera; korende Eri na Onani bagakwera ase ense ya Kaanani. Na abana ba Peresu nabwo Hezironi na Hamuli.
swahili: Wana wa Yuda ni: Eri, Onani, Shela, Peresi na Zera (lakini Eri na Onani walifariki katika nchi ya Kanaani). Wana wa Peresi ni: Hesroni na Hamuli.

english: The sons of Issachar: Tola, Puvah, Job, and Shimron.
ekegusii: Na abana abamura ba Isakaru nabwo aba: Tola, na Pua, na Yobu, na Simuroni.
swahili: Wana wa Isakari ni: Tola, Puva, Yashubu na Shimroni.

english: The sons of Zebulun: Sered, Elon, and Jahleel.
ekegusii: Na abana abamura ba Sabuloni nabwo aba: Seredi na Eloni, na Yaleeli.
swahili: Wana wa Zabuloni ni: Seredi, Eloni na Yaleeli.

english: These are the sons of Leah born to Jacob in Paddan-aram, in addition to his daughter Dinah. The total number of sons and daughters was thirty-three. The Children of Zilpah
ekegusii: Aba nabwo abana abamura Lea aiborerete Yakobo agwo Padan‐Aramu. Na omoiseke oyomo aiborete, nere Dina. Abana baye bonsi amo nabachokoro, abamura na abaiseke, nigo baareenge emerongo etato na batato.
swahili: Hawa ndio wana wa Lea aliomzalia Yakobo huko Padan-Aramu pamoja na binti yake Dina. Jumla ya wanawe na binti zake walikuwa thelathini na watatu.

english: The sons of Gad: Ziphion, Haggi, Shuni, Ezbon, Eri, Arodi, and Areli.
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Gadi nabwo aba: Sifioni, na Hagi, na Suni, na Esiboni, na Eri, na Arodi, na Areli.
swahili: Wana wa Gadi ni: Sefoni, Hagi, Shuni, Esboni, Eri, Arodi na Areli.

english: The children of Asher: Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, Beriah, and their sister Serah. The sons of Beriah: Heber and Malchiel.
ekegusii: Na abana abamura b’Aseri nabwo aba: Imuna, na Isiva, na Isivi, na Beria, na omoiseke omwabo nere Sera. Na abamura ba Beria nabwo Heberi na Malikieli.
swahili: Wana wa Asheri ni: Imna, Ishva, Ishvi na Beria. Dada yao alikuwa Sera. Wana wa Beria ni: Heberi na Malkieli.

english: These are the sons of Jacob born to Zilpah—whom Laban gave to his daughter Leah—sixteen in all. The Children of Rachel
ekegusii: Aba nabwo abamura na abachokoro ba Silpa, oyio Labani aete Lea, omwana oye omosubati. Abwo Silpa aiborerete Yakobo, abanto ikomi na batano nomo.
swahili: Hawa ndio watoto Zilpa aliomzalia Yakobo, ambao Labani alimpa binti yake Lea; jumla yao walikuwa kumi na sita.

english: The sons of Jacob’s wife Rachel: Joseph and Benjamin.
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Raeli, moka Yakobo, nabwo Yusufu na Benjamini.
swahili: Wana wa Raheli mke wa Yakobo ni: Yosefu na Benyamini.

english: And that night God spoke to Israel in a vision: “Jacob, Jacob!” He said. “Here I am,” replied Jacob.
ekegusii: Nyasae akarangeria Israeli ase okorora ekero kia botuko, akabora: “Yakobo! Yakobo!” Ere agaitaba: “Nao inde aa.”
swahili: Mungu akanena na Israeli katika maono usiku na kusema, “Yakobo! Yakobo!” Akajibu, “Mimi hapa.”

english: Manasseh and Ephraim were born to Joseph in the land of Egypt by Asenath daughter of Potiphera, priest of On.
ekegusii: Yusufu akaiborerwa Manase na Efraimu, ase ense ya Misiri. Asenati, mosubati o Potifera, Omokuani bw’Oni, akamoiborera abana abwo abamura.
swahili: Huko Misri, Asenathi binti wa Potifera, aliyekuwa kuhani wa mji wa Oni, alimzalia Yosefu wana wawili, Manase na Efraimu.

english: The sons of Benjamin: Bela, Becher, Ashbel, Gera, Naaman, Ehi, Rosh, Muppim, Huppim, and Ard.
ekegusii: Na abana abamura ba Benjamini nabwo aba: Bela, na Bekeri, na Asibeli, na Gera, na Naamani, na Eki, na Roshi, na Mupimu, na Hupimu, na Aridi.
swahili: Wana wa Benyamini ni: Bela, Bekeri, Ashbeli, Gera, Naamani, Ehi, Roshi, Mupimu, Hupimu na Ardi.

english: These are the sons of Rachel born to Jacob—fourteen in all. The Children of Bilhah
ekegusii: Aba nabwo abamura na abachokoro Raeli aiborerete Yakobo, abanto ikomi na baane.
swahili: Hawa ndio wana wa Raheli aliomzalia Yakobo; jumla yao ni kumi na wanne.

english: The son of Dan: Hushim.
ekegusii: Omwana omomura o Dani nere Husimu.
swahili: Mwana wa Dani ni: Hushimu.

english: The sons of Naphtali: Jahzeel, Guni, Jezer, and Shillem.
ekegusii: Na abana abamura ba Nafutali nabwo aba: Yaseeli, na Guni, na Yaseri, na Silemu.
swahili: Wana wa Naftali ni: Yaseeli, Guni, Yeseri na Shilemu.

english: These are the sons of Jacob born to Bilhah, whom Laban gave to his daughter Rachel—seven in all.
ekegusii: Aba nabwo abamura na abachokoro abamura Bilia aiborerete Yakobo, abanto batano na babere.
swahili: Hawa walikuwa wana wa Bilha aliomzalia Yakobo, ambaye Labani alikuwa amempa Raheli binti yake; jumla yao walikuwa saba.

english: All those belonging to Jacob who came to Egypt—his direct descendants, besides the wives of Jacob’s sons—numbered sixty-six persons.
ekegusii: Abanto bonsi abagendete amo na Yakobo ase ense ya Misiri, abwo baiboretwe korwa asare, nigo baareenge emerongo etano nomo, na batano nomo. Abakungu b’abana abamura ba Yakobo, barabwo tibaabariri.
swahili: Wote waliokwenda Misri pamoja na Yakobo, waliokuwa wazao wake hasa pasipo kuhesabu wakwe zake, walikuwa watu sitini na sita.

english: And with the two sons who had been born to Joseph in Egypt, the members of Jacob’s family who went to Egypt were seventy in all. Jacob Arrives in Egypt
ekegusii: Na abana abamura ba Yusufu, abaiboreretwe agwo Misiri, mbabere baarenge. Abanto bonsi ba Yakobo abasoete Misiri nigo baarenge emerongo etano na ebere. Yusufu okorotota Israeli ise
swahili: Pamoja na wana wawili waliozaliwa na Yosefu huko Misri, jumla yote ya jamaa ya Yakobo, waliokwenda Misri, walikuwa sabini.

english: Now Jacob had sent Judah ahead of him to Joseph to get directions to Goshen. When Jacob’s family arrived in the land of Goshen,
ekegusii: Yakobo agatoma Yuda amotang’anere kogenda ase Yusufu, erinde aoroke ase obosio bwaye agwo Goseni, Naboigo bagaika ase ensemo ya Goseni.
swahili: Basi Yakobo akamtanguliza Yuda aende kwa Yosefu ili amwelekeze njia ya Gosheni. Walipofika nchi ya Gosheni,

english: Joseph prepared his chariot and went there to meet his father Israel. Joseph presented himself to him, embraced him, and wept profusely.
ekegusii: Erio Yusufu akabeeka egari yaye ang’e, akayeriina, akagenda korotota Israeli aria Goseni. Ekero achia goika asare akamoboania rigoti riaye engaki etari nke.
swahili: gari kubwa zuri la Yosefu liliandaliwa, naye akaenda Gosheni kumlaki baba yake Israeli. Mara Yosefu alipofika mbele yake, alimkumbatia baba yake, akalia kwa muda mrefu.

english: “I am God,” He said, “the God of your father. Do not be afraid to go down to Egypt, for I will make you into a great nation there.
ekegusii: Erio akamoteebia: “Inche ninche Nyasae, Nyasae o iso; tobaisa kwoboa gotirimboka gochia Misiri, ekiagera ningokore obe egesaku ekenene aroro.
swahili: Mungu akamwambia, “Mimi ndimi Mungu wa baba yako, usiogope kushuka Misri, kwa maana huko nitakufanya taifa kubwa.

english: Then Israel said to Joseph, “Finally I can die, now that I have seen your face and know that you are still alive!”
ekegusii: Israeli agateebia Yusufu: “Bono tiga inkwe, ekiagera nakororire obosio bwao, naende narorire ng’a moyo ore.”
swahili: Israeli akamwambia Yosefu, “Sasa niko tayari kufa, kwa kuwa nimejionea mwenyewe kwamba bado uko hai.”

english: Joseph said to his brothers and to his father’s household, “I will go up and inform Pharaoh: ‘My brothers and my father’s household from the land of Canaan have come to me.
ekegusii: Yusufu agateebia abamwabo na abanto b’enka ya ise: “Nkogenda inde ase Farao imoteebie: Abaminto na abanto b’enka ya tata, aba baarenge ase ense ya Kaanani, bachire ase ’nde.
swahili: Ndipo Yosefu akawaambia ndugu zake na watu wa nyumbani mwa baba yake, “Nitapanda kwa Farao na kumwambia, ‘Ndugu zangu na watu wa nyumbani mwa baba yangu, waliokuwa wakiishi katika nchi ya Kanaani, wamekuja kwangu.

english: The men are shepherds; they raise livestock, and they have brought their flocks and herds and all that they own.’
ekegusii: Na abanto abwo nabatugi be chitugo, na bono barentire chitugo chiabo, ching’ondi ne chiombe, na binde bionsi bare nabio.
swahili: Watu hao ni wachunga mifugo, huchunga mifugo, wamekuja na makundi ya kondoo, mbuzi na ngʼombe pamoja na kila kitu walicho nacho.’

english: When Pharaoh summons you and asks, ‘What is your occupation?’
ekegusii: Bono, Farao karabarangerie na kobaboria meremo ki monarete gokora,
swahili: Farao atakapowaita na kuwaulizeni, ‘Kazi yenu ni nini?’

english: you are to say, ‘Your servants have raised livestock ever since our youth—both we and our fathers.’ Then you will be allowed to settle in the land of Goshen, since all shepherds are detestable to the Egyptians.”
ekegusii: nigo moramoiranerie: Intwe abasomba bao nigo tore abatugi be chitugo korwa obwana bwaito goika reero; buna tore igo, nabo ne chisokoro chiaito chiareenge. Na igo namonyore ribaga komenya ase ensemo ya Goseni, ekiagera kera omorisia bwe chitugo nigo are okogechia ase Abamisiri.”
swahili: Mjibuni, ‘Watumwa wako wamekuwa wachunga mifugo tangu ujana wetu mpaka sasa, kama baba zetu walivyofanya.’ Ndipo mtakaporuhusiwa kukaa katika nchi ya Gosheni, kwa kuwa wachunga mifugo wote ni chukizo kwa Wamisri.”

english: I will go down with you to Egypt, and I will surely bring you back. And Joseph’s own hands will close your eyes.”
ekegusii: Inche nintirimboke amo naye goika Misiri, naende tinkomocha gokoirania; na Yusufu nabe okoirania amaiso ao kogw akuure.”
swahili: Nitashuka Misri pamoja nawe, nami hakika nitakurudisha tena Kanaani. Mikono ya Yosefu mwenyewe ndiyo itakayofunga macho yako.”

english: Then Jacob departed from Beersheba, and the sons of Israel took their father Jacob in the wagons Pharaoh had sent to carry him, along with their children and wives.
ekegusii: Erio Yakobo akaimoka korwa Beeri‐Seba, akagenda. Basinto ba Israeli bakabogoria Yakobo ise, amo nabana babo abake, na abakungu babo ase chigari chiria Farao abatomerete chibabogorie.
swahili: Ndipo Yakobo akaondoka Beer-Sheba nao wana wa Israeli wakamchukua baba yao Yakobo na watoto wao na wake zao katika magari ya kukokotwa yale Farao aliyokuwa amempelekea kumsafirisha.

english: They also took the livestock and possessions they had acquired in the land of Canaan, and Jacob and all his offspring went to Egypt. Those Who Went to Egypt (Exodus 1:1–7)
ekegusii: Bakaira chitugo chiabo ne chinibo chiabo echi baniberete ase ense ya Kaanani. Nabo bagaika Misiri, Yakobo na oroiboro rwaye rwonsi amo nere,
swahili: Wakachukua pia mifugo yao na mali walizokuwa wamezipata Kanaani, Yakobo na uzao wake wote wakashuka Misri.

english: Jacob took with him to Egypt his sons and grandsons, and his daughters and granddaughters—all his offspring. The Children of Leah
ekegusii: abana baye abamura na abamura babo; na abana baye abaiseke, na abaiseke b’abamura babo. Naboigo akaira oroiboro rwaye rwonsi, akagenda nabarabwo goika Misiri. Ororeeria rwa Israeli
swahili: Akawachukua wanawe na binti zake, wajukuu wake wa kiume na wa kike, yaani uzao wake wote mpaka Misri.

english: Now these are the names of the sons of Israel (Jacob and his descendants) who went to Egypt: Reuben, Jacob’s firstborn.
ekegusii: Aya naro amarieta Abaisraeli abwo bagendete Misiri: Yakobo na abana baye, nabwo aba: Rubeni, nere omotangi o Yakobo.
swahili: Haya ndiyo majina ya wana wa Israeli (Yakobo na wazao wake), waliokwenda Misri: Reubeni mzaliwa wa kwanza wa Yakobo.

english: The sons of Reuben: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.
ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Rubeni nabwo aba: Hanoki, na Palu, na Hezironi, na Karimi.
swahili: Wana wa Reubeni ni: Hanoki, Palu, Hesroni na Karmi.

english: So Joseph went and told Pharaoh: “My father and my brothers, with their flocks and herds and all they own, have come from the land of Canaan and are now in Goshen.”
ekegusii: Erio Yusufu akagenda agateebia Farao: “Tata na bamura baminto bachire korwa ase ense ya Kaanani, amo ne chitugo chiabo, ching’ondi ne chiombe, na binde bionsi bare nabio; barabwo nao bare ase ensemo ya Goseni.”
swahili: Yosefu akaenda na kumwambia Farao, “Baba yangu na ndugu zangu wamekuja kutoka nchi ya Kanaani wakiwa na makundi yao ya kondoo, mbuzi na ngʼombe, pamoja na kila kitu walicho nacho, nao sasa wapo huko Gosheni.”

english: Then Jacob blessed Pharaoh and departed from his presence.
ekegusii: Yakobo agasesenia Farao naende, akarua ase obosio bwaye.
swahili: Kisha Yakobo akambariki Farao, naye akaondoka mbele ya uso wake.

english: So Joseph settled his father and brothers in the land of Egypt and gave them property in the best part of the land, the district of Rameses, as Pharaoh had commanded.
ekegusii: Yusufu akaa ise amo na bamura bamwabo aase bakomenya, akabaa Ramesesi, orogongo oruya, ensemo engiya mono y’ense eria, buna Farao achiigete.
swahili: Ndipo Yosefu akawakalisha baba yake na ndugu zake katika nchi ya Misri na kuwapa milki katika sehemu bora sana ya nchi, wilaya ya Ramesesi, kama Farao alivyoelekeza.

english: Joseph also provided his father and brothers and all his father’s household with food for their families. The Famine Continues
ekegusii: Nere Yusufu akaba okorenda ise amo nabamwabo bonsi, akabaa endagera buna kera omonto abwate abanto baye bang’ana. Enchara ekomentekana, n’Abamisiri koonigwa ase Farao
swahili: Pia Yosefu akampa baba yake, na ndugu zake na wote wa nyumbani mwa baba yake vyakula, kwa kulingana na hesabu ya watoto wao. Uongozi Wa Yosefu Wakati Wa Njaa

english: There was no food, however, in all that region, because the famine was so severe; the lands of Egypt and Canaan had been exhausted by the famine.
ekegusii: Bono ase ense yonsi endagera tiyareengeo; na enchara nigo yareenge endito mono, konya yanyarire abanto ba Misiri na Abakaanani.
swahili: Hata hivyo, hapakuwepo chakula katika sehemu yote kwa kuwa njaa ilikuwa kali sana; Misri na Kanaani zote zikaharibiwa kwa sababu ya njaa.

english: Joseph collected all the money to be found in the land of Egypt and the land of Canaan in exchange for the grain they were buying, and he brought it into Pharaoh’s palace.
ekegusii: Yusufu agasangereria chitaabu chionsi echianyorekanete korwa ase ense ya Misiri na eya Kaanani ase okooneria abanto endagera, agachibeeka ase ekungo ya Farao.
swahili: Yosefu akakusanya fedha zote zilizopatikana kutoka mauzo ya nafaka huko Misri na Kanaani, akazileta kwenye jumba la kifalme la Farao.

english: When the money from the lands of Egypt and Canaan was gone, all the Egyptians came to Joseph and said, “Give us food. Why should we die before your eyes? For our funds have run out!”
ekegusii: Ekero chitaabu chionsi chiaerire ase ense ya Misiri na ase ense ya Kaanani, Abamisiri bagachiera Yusufu, bakamosaba, “Toe endagera, titobaisa gokwera ase obosio bwao, ekiagera chitaabu chiaito chiaerire.”
swahili: Fedha za watu wa Misri na Kanaani zilipokwisha, Wamisri wote wakamjia Yosefu na kumwambia, “Tupatie chakula. Kwa nini tufe mbele ya macho yako? Fedha zetu zimekwisha.”

english: “Then bring me your livestock,” said Joseph. “Since the money is gone, I will sell you food in exchange for your livestock.”
ekegusii: Yusufu akabairaneria, “Onye chitaabu chiaino chiaerire, ndetera chitugo chiaino, na inche mbae endagera morie.”
swahili: Yosefu akawaambia, “Basi leteni mifugo yenu, nitawauzia chakula kwa kubadilisha na mifugo yenu, kwa kuwa fedha zenu zimekwisha.”

english: So they brought their livestock to Joseph, and he gave them food in exchange for their horses, their flocks and herds, and their donkeys. Throughout that year he provided them with food in exchange for all their livestock.
ekegusii: Erio bakarentera Yusufu chitugo chiabo, na Yusufu akabaa endagera. Bakarentera Yusufu chibarasi chiabo, ne ching’ondi, ne chiombe, ne chitigere. Igo akaba okobarenda na kobaa endagera ase omwaka oyio oyomo, na barabwo bakamoa chitugo chiabo.
swahili: Kwa hiyo wakaleta mifugo yao kwa Yosefu, naye akawapa chakula kwa kubadilishana na farasi zao, kondoo na mbuzi zao, ngʼombe na punda zao. Katika mwaka huo wote Yosefu akawapa chakula kwa kubadilishana na mifugo yao yote.
