english: When that year was over, they came to him the second year and said, “We cannot hide from our lord that our money is gone and all our livestock belongs to you. There is nothing left for our lord except our bodies and our land.
ekegusii: Omwaka oria oyomo okaera. Naende omwaka o kabere bakamochiera, bakamoteebia: “Titokonyara gokobisa, Omonene oito, ng’a chitaabu chiaito chiaerire, ne chitugo chiaito chiabeire echiao. Titotigareti gento kende togokoa, omonene oito, otatiga emebere yaito na amaremo aito.
swahili: Mwaka ule ulipokwisha, wakamjia mwaka uliofuata na kumwambia, “Hatuwezi kuficha ukweli mbele za bwana wetu kwamba, kwa kuwa fedha zetu zimekwisha na wanyama wetu ni mali yako, sasa hakuna chochote kilichosalia kwa ajili ya bwana wetu isipokuwa miili yetu na ardhi yetu.

english: Why should we perish before your eyes—we and our land as well? Purchase us and our land in exchange for food. Then we, along with our land, will be slaves to Pharaoh. Give us seed that we may live and not die, and that the land may not become desolate.”
ekegusii: Nase ki torakwere ase obosio bwao, na amaremo aito asareke? Togore intwe, ogore na amaremo aito, na intwe tobe abasomba ba Farao, na amaremo aito abe ayaye. Toe chimbusuro tosimeke, titokwa, na amaremo aito abe bosa.”
swahili: Kwa nini tuangamie mbele ya macho yako, sisi pamoja na nchi yetu? Utununue sisi pamoja na ardhi yetu ili kubadilishana kwa chakula. Nasi pamoja na nchi yetu tutakuwa watumwa wa Farao. Tupe sisi mbegu ili tuweze kuishi wala tusife, nchi yetu isije ikawa ukiwa.”

english: And he chose five of his brothers and presented them before Pharaoh.
ekegusii: Agachora abamwabo batano, akabaira ase obosio bwa Farao.
swahili: Akachagua ndugu zake watano na kuwaonyesha kwa Farao.

english: So Joseph acquired for Pharaoh all the land in Egypt; the Egyptians, one and all, sold their fields because the famine was so severe upon them. The land became Pharaoh’s,
ekegusii: Erio Yusufu akagorera Farao amaremo onsi areenge Misiri, naki Abamisiri nigo baoonetie kera omonto oboremo bwaye, ekiagera enchara yareenge endito mono. Naboigo ense ekaba eya Farao.
swahili: Kwa hiyo Yosefu akamnunulia Farao nchi yote ya Misri. Wamisri, mmoja baada ya mwingine, waliuza mashamba yao, kwa sababu njaa ilikuwa kali sana kwao. Nchi ikawa mali ya Farao,

english: and Joseph reduced the people to servitude from one end of Egypt to the other.
ekegusii: Farao akang’anyia abanto abwo bamenye ase emechie, babe abasomba baye, bakore emeremo korwa ensemo eyemo ya Misiri goika eyende.
swahili: naye Yosefu akawafanya watu watumike kama watumwa, kuanzia upande mmoja wa Misri hadi upande mwingine.

english: However, he did not acquire the priests’ portion of the land, for it had been given to them by Pharaoh. They ate the rations that Pharaoh supplied; so they did not sell their land.
ekegusii: Korende Yusufu tagorete amaremo ’abakuani, ekiagera abwo konya bachikeirwe endagera baare konyora korwa ase Farao, nero baare koria. Ase igo, tibagwenerete koonia amaremo abo.
swahili: Hata hivyo, hakununua nchi ya makuhani, kwa sababu walikuwa wanapata mgawo wao wa kawaida kutoka kwa Farao, nao walikuwa na chakula cha kuwatosha kutokana na mgawo waliopewa na Farao. Hii ndiyo sababu hawakuuza ardhi yao.

english: Then Joseph said to the people, “Now that I have acquired you and your land for Pharaoh this day, here is seed for you to sow in the land.
ekegusii: Yusufu agateebia abanto: “Igwa! Reero nabagorire inwe amo namaremo aino, mobe enibo ya Farao. Bwata chimbusuro chiaino echi, chiire mochisimeke ase emegondo.
swahili: Yosefu akawaambia watu, “Kwa vile nimewanunua ninyi pamoja na nchi yenu leo kuwa mali ya Farao, hapa kuna mbegu kwa ajili yenu ili mweze kuziotesha.

english: At harvest time, you are to give a fifth of it to Pharaoh, and four-fifths will be yours as seed for the field and food for yourselves and your households and children.”
ekegusii: Engaki ye rigesa moruserie Farao ensemo ya isano. Chinsemo inye chintigari inachibe echiaino ase chimbusuro na endagera yaino inwe abanyene, na ey’abare ase chinka chiaino, na ey’abana baino.”
swahili: Lakini wakati mazao yatakapokuwa tayari, mpeni Farao sehemu ya tano. Sehemu hizo nne zitakazobaki mtaziweka kama mbegu kwa ajili ya mashamba na kwa ajili ya chakula chenu wenyewe na cha watu wa nyumbani mwenu na watoto wenu.”

english: “You have saved our lives,” they said. “We have found favor in our lord’s eyes, and we will be Pharaoh’s servants.”
ekegusii: Abanto abwo bakamoiraneria, “Gwatooririe obogima bwaito. Onye twanyorire ogwancherwa ase obosio bwao, Omonene oito, tiga tobe abasomba ba Farao.”
swahili: Wakamwambia, “Umeokoa maisha yetu. Basi na tupate kibali mbele ya macho ya bwana wetu; tutakuwa watumwa wa Farao.”

english: So Joseph established a law that a fifth of the produce belongs to Pharaoh, and it is in effect in the land of Egypt to this day. Only the priests’ land does not belong to Pharaoh. The Israelites Prosper in Goshen
ekegusii: Yusufu akabeeka ogochika ase ense ya Misiri, ng’a ensemo ya isano ebe eya Farao; na ogochika okwo ngokora kore emeremo nonya ngoika bono. Korende amaremo ’abakuani oka naro atabeete aya Farao. Okogania kw’omoerio kwa Yakobo
swahili: Basi Yosefu akaiweka iwe sheria kuhusu nchi ya Misri, ambayo inatumika mpaka leo, kwamba, sehemu ya tano ya mazao ni mali ya Farao. Ni nchi ya makuhani tu ambayo haikuwa ya Farao.

english: Now the Israelites settled in the land of Egypt, in the region of Goshen. They acquired property there and became fruitful and increased greatly in number.
ekegusii: Israeli na abana baye bakaba bakomenya ase ense ya Misiri, ensemo ya Goseni, bakayeira ekaba eyabo, bakamenteka na kobucha mono.
swahili: Basi Waisraeli wakaishi Misri katika nchi ya Gosheni. Wakapata mali huko wakastawi na kuongezeka kwa wingi sana.

english: And Jacob lived in the land of Egypt seventeen years, and the length of his life was 147 years.
ekegusii: Yakobo akamenya ase ense ya Misiri emiaka ikomi, na etano na ebere. Ase igo, agakoora emiaka rigana erimo, na emerongo ene, na etano na ebere (147) ase obogima bwaye.
swahili: Yakobo akaishi Misri miaka kumi na saba, nayo miaka ya maisha yake ilikuwa 147.

english: When the time drew near for Israel to die, he called his son Joseph and said to him, “If I have found favor in your eyes, put your hand under my thigh and promise to show me kindness and faithfulness. Do not bury me in Egypt,
ekegusii: Ekero engaki y’ogokwa gwa Israeli yabeete ang’e, ere akarangeria Yusufu, omwana oye, akamoteebia, “Onye nkonyora ogwancherwa ase obosio bwao, beeka okoboko kwao inse y’ekebono kiane, na ondiere eira, ng’a nonkorere amaabera na obwanchani. Tontindeka aa ase ense ya Misiri,
swahili: Wakati ulipokaribia wa Israeli kufa, akamwita mwanawe Yosefu na kumwambia, “Kama nimepata kibali machoni pake, weka mkono wako chini ya paja langu na uniahidi kuwa utanifanyia fadhili na uaminifu. Usinizike Misri,

english: “What is your occupation?” Pharaoh asked Joseph’s brothers. “Your servants are shepherds,” they replied, “both we and our fathers.”
ekegusii: Farao akababooria: “Emeremo yaino nereri?” Bakamoiraneria, “Intwe abasomba bao nigo tore abarisia be chitugo, buna nechisokooro chiaito chiareenge.”
swahili: Farao akawauliza hao ndugu zake, “Kazi yenu ni nini?” Wakamjibu, “Watumishi wako ni wachunga mifugo, kama vile baba zetu walivyokuwa.”

english: but when I lie down with my fathers, carry me out of Egypt and bury me with them.” Joseph answered, “I will do as you have requested.”
ekegusii: korende ekero ndakwe, tiga ndare ne chisokoro chiane. Ombogorie korwa aa Misiri, ontindeke aase barabwo batindegetwe.” Yusufu akamoiraneria, “Ninkore buna gwantebirie.”
swahili: lakini nitakapopumzika na baba zangu, unichukue kutoka Misri, ukanizike walipozikwa.” Yosefu akamwambia, “Nitafanya kama unavyosema.”

english: “Swear to me,” Jacob said. So Joseph swore to him, and Israel bowed in worship at the head of his bed.
ekegusii: Korende Israeli akamoteebia “Tiana ng’a nonkorere bo.” Ere agatiana. Erio Israeli agetureka ase ogotoorera omotwe borere bwaye.
swahili: Akamwambia, “Niapie.” Ndipo Yosefu akamwapia, naye Israeli akaabudu, akiwa ameegemea juu ya kichwa cha fimbo yake.

english: Then they said to Pharaoh, “We have come to live in the land for a time, because there is no pasture for the flocks of your servants, since the famine in the land of Canaan has been severe. So now, please allow your servants to settle in the land of Goshen.”
ekegusii: Naende bakabateebia: “Nigo twachire tobe abamenyi b’ense eye, ekiagera intwe, abasomba bao, titori nase tokorisia amaicho aito, ekiagera enchara nenene mono ase ense ya Kaanani. Ase igo, koranche otoe intwe, abasomba bao, ribaga tomenye ase ensemo ya Goseni.”
swahili: Pia wakamwambia Farao, “Tumekuja kukaa huku kwa muda mfupi, kwa sababu njaa ni kali huko Kanaani, na mifugo ya watumishi wako haina malisho. Kwa hiyo sasa, tafadhali uruhusu watumishi wako wakae huko Gosheni.”

english: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “Now that your father and brothers have come to you,
ekegusii: Erio Farao agakwana na Yusufu, akabateebia: “Narorire ng’a iso na abamino bagocheire.
swahili: Farao akamwambia Yosefu, “Baba yako na ndugu zako wamekuja kwako,

english: the land of Egypt is before you; settle your father and brothers in the best part of the land. They may dwell in the land of Goshen. And if you know of any talented men among them, put them in charge of my own livestock.”
ekegusii: Bono ense ya Misiri nigo ere ase obosio bwao; bae iso na bamura bamino ribaga bamenye aase are aagiya. Tiga bamenye ase ensemo ya Goseni, naende onye komanyete bande ase egati yabo abamanyete mono emeremo y’obotugi, obabeeke babe abateneneri ase chitugo chiane.” Yakobo ase obosio bwa Farao
swahili: nayo nchi ya Misri ipo mbele yako, uwakalishe baba yako na ndugu zako katika sehemu iliyo bora kupita zote katika nchi. Na waishi Gosheni. Kama unamfahamu yeyote miongoni mwao mwenye uwezo maalum, waweke wawe wasimamizi wa mifugo yangu.”

english: Then Joseph brought in his father Jacob and presented him before Pharaoh, and Jacob blessed Pharaoh.
ekegusii: Erio Yusufu akarenta Yakobo ise, akamoira ase obosio bwa Farao; na Yakobo agasesenia Farao.
swahili: Ndipo Yosefu akamleta Yakobo baba yake na kumtambulisha mbele ya Farao. Baada ya Yakobo kumbariki Farao,

english: “How many years have you lived?” Pharaoh asked.
ekegusii: Farao akabooria Yakobo: “Inee! Emiaka yao nerenga?”
swahili: Farao akamuuliza, “Je una umri gani?”

english: “My travels have lasted 130 years,” Jacob replied. “My years have been few and hard, and they have not matched the years of the travels of my fathers.”
ekegusii: Yakobo akamoiraneria: “Emiaka yane nakoorire ase ense eye nerigana erimo, na emerongo etato (130). Ase obogima bwane nigo nabeire nobokong’u, naende emiaka yane nemeke, teikereti eye chisokoro chiane chiakorete ase obogima bwabo.”
swahili: Naye Yakobo akamwambia Farao, “Siku za miaka ya kusafiri kwangu ni miaka 130. Miaka yangu imekuwa michache na ya taabu, wala haikufikia miaka ya kusafiri ya baba zangu.”

english: Some time later Joseph was told, “Your father is ill.” So he set out with his two sons, Manasseh and Ephraim.
ekegusii: Ekaba engaki magega y’ayio Yusufu ateebetigwe ng’a, “Iso nomorwaire.” Erio akaimokia abana baye babere abamura, Manase na Efraimu, bakagenda komoorora.
swahili: Baada ya muda Yosefu akaambiwa kwamba, “Baba yako ni mgonjwa.” Kwa hiyo akawachukua wanawe wawili Manase na Efraimu, pamoja naye.

english: Now Israel’s eyesight was poor because of old age; he could hardly see. Joseph brought his sons to him, and his father kissed them and embraced them.
ekegusii: Bono amaiso a Israeli konya abeire chinchingori ase engencho y’obogotu, tare korora buya. Igo Yusufu akamorentera abana abwo, na ere akabaagata na kobaboania.
swahili: Basi macho ya Israeli yalikuwa hayaoni vizuri kwa sababu ya uzee, naye aliona kwa shida. Kwa hiyo Yosefu akawaleta wanawe karibu na baba yake, Israeli akawabusu na akawakumbatia.

english: “I never expected to see your face again,” Israel said to Joseph, “but now God has let me see your children as well.”
ekegusii: Erio Israeli agateebia Yusufu: “Tinasemeretie ng’a kaa ninche korora obosio bwao naende, na bono Nyasae onyancheire narorire abana bao nabarabwo,”
swahili: Israeli akamwambia Yosefu, “Kamwe sikutazamia kuuona uso wako tena, lakini sasa Mungu ameniruhusu kuwaona watoto wako pia.”

english: Then Joseph removed his sons from his father’s knees and bowed facedown.
ekegusii: Yusufu akarusia abana korwa ase amagoro a ise, agatugama inse.
swahili: Ndipo Yosefu akawaondoa wanawe magotini mwa Israeli naye akasujudu hadi nchi.

english: And Joseph took both of them—with Ephraim in his right hand toward Israel’s left hand, and Manasseh in his left hand toward Israel’s right hand—and brought them close to him.
ekegusii: Erio Yusufu akabwata bonsi babere, Efraimu ase okoboko kwaye gw’okorio, akamobeka ensemo y’okobee ya Israeli, na Manase akamobwata ase okoboko kwaye gw’okobee, akamobeka ensemo y’okorio ya Israeli.
swahili: Yosefu akachukua wale wana wawili, Efraimu kwenye mkono wake wa kuume akimwelekeza kwenye mkono wa kushoto wa Israeli, na Manase katika mkono wake wa kushoto akimwelekeza kwenye mkono wa kuume wa Israeli, akawaleta karibu na babu yao.

english: But Israel stretched out his right hand and put it on the head of Ephraim, the younger; and crossing his hands, he put his left on Manasseh’s head, although Manasseh was the firstborn.
ekegusii: Israeli akarambora okoboko kwaye gw’okorio, agakobeeka igoro ase omotwe o Efraimu, nonya ere orenge omoke; agakorekania amaboko aye na kobeeka okoboko kwaye gw’okobee igoro ase omotwe o Manase, nere orenge omotangi.
swahili: Lakini Israeli akaupeleka mkono wake wa kuume, akauweka juu ya kichwa cha Efraimu, ingawa alikuwa ndiye mdogo, na mkono wake wa kushoto akaukatisha, akauweka juu ya kichwa cha Manase, ingawa Manase alikuwa ndiye mzaliwa wa kwanza.

english: Then he blessed Joseph and said: “May the God before whom my fathers Abraham and Isaac walked, the God who has been my shepherd all my life to this day,
ekegusii: Erio agasesenia Yusufu, akabora, “Nyasae o sokoro yane Aburaamu na o Isaka tata, oyio baare gotaara ase obosio bwaye; Nyasae oyo nere ondisirie ase obogima bwane bwonsi goika reero,
swahili: Ndipo akambariki Yosefu akisema, “Mungu ambaye baba zangu Abrahamu na Isaki walimtii, Mungu ambaye amekuwa mchungaji wa maisha yangu yote mpaka leo hii,

english: the angel who has redeemed me from all harm— may He bless these boys. And may they be called by my name and the names of my fathers Abraham and Isaac, and may they grow into a multitude upon the earth.”
ekegusii: omomalaika oria ontooretie korwa ase amabe onsi, asesenie abamura aba. Abana aba babe bagwatorwa ase erieta riane, na ase erieta ria sokoro yane Aburaamu, na eria Isaka tata; tiga bakine babe abanto abange ase ense.”
swahili: Malaika ambaye aliniokoa kutoka madhara yote, yeye na awabariki vijana hawa. Na waitwe kwa jina langu na kwa majina ya baba zangu Abrahamu na Isaki, wao na waongezeke kwa wingi katika dunia.”

english: When Joseph saw that his father had placed his right hand on Ephraim’s head, he was displeased and took his father’s hand to move it from Ephraim’s head to Manasseh’s.
ekegusii: Yusufu agachia korora ng’a ise obekire okoboko kwaye gw’okorio igoro ase omotwe o Efraimu, ayio tayancha. Akabwata okoboko gwa ise akorusie korwa ase omotwe o Efraimu, erio akobeke ase oyo o Manase.
swahili: Yosefu alipoona baba yake akiweka mkono wa kuume juu ya kichwa cha Efraimu, hakupendezwa, kwa hiyo akauchukua mkono wa baba yake kutoka kichwa cha Efraimu na kuuweka juu ya kichwa cha Manase.

english: “Not so, my father!” Joseph said. “This one is the firstborn; put your right hand on his head.”
ekegusii: Yusufu agateebia ise: “Taibo, tata, naki oyo nere omotangi; beeka okoboko kwao gw’okorio ase omotwe oye.”
swahili: Yosefu akamwambia, “Hapana, baba yangu, huyu ndiye mzaliwa wa kwanza; uweke mkono wako wa kuume juu ya kichwa chake.”

english: But his father refused. “I know, my son, I know!” he said. “He too shall become a people, and he too shall be great; nevertheless, his younger brother shall be greater than he, and his offspring shall become a multitude of nations.”
ekegusii: Korende ise akaanga, akabora: “Nimanyete, omwana one, nimanyete. Nere boigo nabe egesaku; ere boigo nabe omonene, korende oyomwabo omoke nabe omonene komobua, na oroiboro rwaye narobe egesaku kiabo ao boka.”
swahili: Lakini baba yake akakataa, akasema, “Ninajua, mwanangu, ninajua. Yeye pia atakuwa taifa, naye pia atakuwa mkuu. Hata hivyo, ndugu yake mdogo atakuwa mkuu kuliko yeye, nao wazao wake watakuwa kundi la mataifa.”

english: When Jacob was told, “Your son Joseph has come to you,” Israel rallied his strength and sat up in bed.
ekegusii: Yakobo nere ateebetigwe ng’a “Yusufu, omwana oo, ngocha are gokorora.” Erio Israeli agekomereria, akaboka, agaikaransa borere igoro.
swahili: Yakobo alipoambiwa, “Mwanao Yosefu amekujia kukuona,” Israeli akakusanya nguvu zake, akaketi kitandani.

english: So that day Jacob blessed them and said: “By you shall Israel pronounce this blessing: ‘May God make you like Ephraim and Manasseh.’” So he put Ephraim before Manasseh.
ekegusii: Rituko erio akabasesenia, akabora, “Ekero ogosesenigwa kogokwanwa ase Abaisraeli, abanto baatore amarieta aino na goteeba: Nyasae abakore mobe buna Efraimu na Manase.” Agwo agwo agatang’ania Efraimu ase obosio bwa Manase.
swahili: Akawabarikia siku ile na kusema, “Kwa jina lenu Israeli watatamka baraka hii: ‘Mungu na awafanye kama Efraimu na Manase.’ ” Kwa hiyo akamtanguliza Efraimu mbele ya Manase.

english: Then Israel said to Joseph, “Look, I am about to die, but God will be with you and bring you back to the land of your fathers.
ekegusii: Erio Israeli agateebia Yusufu: “Rora ng’ang’e inde gokwa. Nyasae nigo arabe amo nainwe, nabairanie gochia ase ense ye chisokoro chiaino.
swahili: Ndipo Israeli akamwambia Yosefu, “Mimi ninakaribia kufa, lakini Mungu atakuwa pamoja nanyi, na atawarudisha katika nchi ya baba zenu.

english: And to you, as one who is above your brothers, I give the ridge of land that I took from the Amorites with my sword and bow.”
ekegusii: Inche nakomentire ensemo y’ekenyoro ekeao kobua abamino. Eyio naurete Abaamori n’omoro one, na obota bwane.”
swahili: Kwako wewe, kama aliye juu ya ndugu zako, ninakupa sehemu moja zaidi ya ndugu zako, lile eneo nililoteka kwa Waamori kwa upanga wangu na upinde wangu.”

english: Jacob said to Joseph, “God Almighty appeared to me at Luz in the land of Canaan, and there He blessed me
ekegusii: Yakobo agateebia Yusufu: “Nyasae Omobui nang’orokerete aaria Lusu ase ense ya Kaanani, agansesenia,
swahili: Yakobo akamwambia Yosefu, “Mungu Mwenyezi alinitokea huko Luzu katika nchi ya Kanaani, huko akanibariki,

english: and told me, ‘Behold, I will make you fruitful and multiply you; I will make you a multitude of peoples, and will give this land to your descendants after you as an everlasting possession.’
ekegusii: aganteebia: Inche ninkomente, na oroiboro rwao robuche goika robe emeganda y’ebisaku. Ning’ee ororeeria rwao rorache korwa magega yao ense eye ebe omwando obo kare na kare.
swahili: naye akaniambia, ‘Nitakufanya ustawi na kuongezeka hesabu yako, nitakufanya kuwa jamii ya mataifa, nami nitakupa nchi hii uimiliki milele wewe na wazao wako baada yako.’

english: And now your two sons born to you in Egypt before I came to you here shall be reckoned as mine; Ephraim and Manasseh shall be mine, just as Reuben and Simeon are mine.
ekegusii: “Bono abana bao abamura babere kwaiborerete ase ense ya Misiri ritang’ani ntaracha aa, barabwo nabaane bararokwe. Efraimu na Manase nigo barabe abaane, buna Rubeni na Simioni bare abaane.
swahili: “Sasa basi, wanao wawili waliozaliwa kwako huku Misri kabla sijaja hapa kwako watahesabiwa kuwa ni wangu; Efraimu na Manase watakuwa wangu, kama vile Reubeni na Simeoni walivyo wangu.

english: Any children born to you after them shall be yours, and they shall be called by the names of their brothers in the territory they inherit.
ekegusii: Abana bao bande baiboire magega y’aba, barabwo nabao barabe; korende nigo baratorwe ase amarieta ’abamwabo, na komenya ase omwando obo.
swahili: Lakini watoto utakaowazaa baada yao watakuwa wako. Katika nchi watakayoirithi, watatambuliwa kwa jina la ndugu zao.

english: Now as for me, when I was returning from Paddan, to my sorrow Rachel died along the way in the land of Canaan, some distance from Ephrath. So I buried her there beside the road to Ephrath” (that is, Bethlehem).
ekegusii: Ekero nare korwa Padan‐Aramu, Raeli nyoko agankwera inchera gonkogenda Kaanani, ritang’ani ntaraika Efarati. Nkamotindeka agwo enchera ekogenda Efarati, nao Bethlehemu.”
swahili: Nilipokuwa ninarudi kutoka Padani, katika huzuni yangu Raheli alifariki katika nchi ya Kanaani tulipokuwa tungali tukisafiri, tukiwa karibu kufika Efrathi. Kwa hiyo nilimzika huko, kando ya njia iendayo Efrathi” (yaani Bethlehemu).

english: When Israel saw the sons of Joseph, he asked, “Who are these?”
ekegusii: Israeli, ekero arooche abana ba Yusufu, akamobooria: “Aba mbarabi?”
swahili: Wakati Israeli alipowaona wana wa Yosefu, akauliza, “Hawa ni nani?”

english: Joseph said to his father, “They are the sons God has given me in this place.” So Jacob said, “Please bring them to me, that I may bless them.”
ekegusii: Yusufu akamoiraneria: “Aba nabana baane Nyasae ang’erete aiga.” Erio Israeli akamoteebia, “Bandetere aiga ase ’nde, mbasesenie.”
swahili: Yosefu akamjibu baba yake, “Hawa ni wana ambao Mungu amenipa nikiwa huku.” Ndipo Israeli akasema, “Walete kwangu ili niwabariki.”

english: Then Jacob called for his sons and said, “Gather around so that I can tell you what will happen to you in the days to come:
ekegusii: Erio Yakobo akarangeria abamura baye, akabateebia: “Sangererekana aa ase ’nde, mbateebie amang’ana arabanyore ase amatuko agochi‐gocha.
swahili: Ndipo Yakobo akawaita wanawe na kusema: “Kusanyikeni kunizunguka ili niweze kuwaambia lile litakalowatokea siku zijazo.

english: The scepter will not depart from Judah, nor the staff from between his feet, until Shiloh comes and the allegiance of the nations is his.
ekegusii: Enyimbo y’obogaambi tekorua o Yuda, gose omobeeki amachiiko ase ororeeria rwaye, goika achiche oyo orabogorie obogaambi, oyo abanto b’ebisaku bionsi baraigwere.
swahili: Fimbo ya ufalme haitaondoka kwa Yuda, wala fimbo ya mtawala kati ya miguu yake, hadi aje yeye ambaye milki ni yake, ambaye utii wa mataifa ni wake.

english: He ties his donkey to the vine, his colt to the choicest branch. He washes his garments in wine, his robes in the blood of grapes.
ekegusii: Nigo arasibe etigere yaye ase omote bw’omosabibu, na emori y’etigere yaye ase chinsagia chi’omosabibu omuya. Nigo arasibie egetambaa kiaye akwambara nedivai, ne chianga chiaye n’amaache amonyinga y’amasabibu
swahili: Atamfunga punda wake katika mzabibu, naye mwana-punda wake kwenye tawi lililo bora zaidi; atafua mavazi yake katika divai, majoho yake katika damu ya mizabibu.

english: His eyes are darker than wine, and his teeth are whiter than milk.
ekegusii: Amaiso aye nigo arabe amabariri ase okonywa edivai, na amaino aye abe amarabu ase okonywa amabeere.
swahili: Macho yake yatakuwa mekundu kwa divai, meno yake yatakuwa meupe kwa maziwa.

english: Zebulun shall dwell by the seashore and become a harbor for ships; his border shall extend to Sidon.
ekegusii: “Sabuloni nigo aramenye ase enyancha mbarabare, agwo ase chimeeri chigotenenigwa, orobebe rwaye rosinyane norw’Abasidoni.
swahili: “Zabuloni ataishi pwani ya bahari na kuwa bandari za kuegesha meli; mpaka wake utapanuka kuelekea Sidoni.

english: Issachar is a strong donkey, lying down between the sheepfolds.
ekegusii: “Isakaru netigere ere ne chinguru, ekorara obweri bwe chitugo.
swahili: “Isakari ni punda mwenye nguvu ambaye amelala kati ya mizigo yake.

english: He saw that his resting place was good and that his land was pleasant, so he bent his shoulder to the burden and submitted to labor as a servant.
ekegusii: Akarora ng’a aase agotimokera naagiya, na ense eria nero ekomogwenera. Ase igo, agekumba abogorie egurube, akerua kogenderera nemeremo emekong’u.
swahili: Aonapo palivyo pazuri mahali pake pa kupumzika na jinsi nchi yake inavyopendeza, atainamisha bega lake kwenye mzigo na kujitolea kwa ajili ya kazi ngumu.

english: Dan shall provide justice for his people as one of the tribes of Israel.
ekegusii: “Dani nagambere abanto baye, buna egesaku ekemo ki’Abaisraeli.
swahili: “Dani atahukumu watu wake kwa haki kama mmoja wa makabila ya Israeli.

english: He will be a snake by the road, a viper in the path that bites the horse’s heels so that its rider tumbles backward.
ekegusii: Dani nabe eng’iti ekweriba inchera, ring’ere ase oboeto, rikoroma egetingiro ki’ebarasi, goika oyoyeriinete agwe masogota.
swahili: Dani atakuwa nyoka kando ya barabara, nyoka mwenye sumu kando ya njia, yule aumaye visigino vya farasi ili yule ampandaye aanguke chali.

english: I await Your salvation, O LORD.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ninganyete ogotooreka kwao nogosemeria!
swahili: “Ee Bwana, nautafuta wokovu wako.

english: Gad will be attacked by raiders, but he will attack their heels.
ekegusii: “Gadi namigwe nemeganda y’abauri, korende nere nabamige korwa magega.
swahili: “Gadi atashambuliwa ghafula na kundi la washambuliaji, lakini yeye atawageukia na kuwashinda kabisa.

english: Come together and listen, O sons of Jacob; listen to your father Israel.
ekegusii: “Inchuo montegerere, inwe abana ba Yakobo; montegerere inche Israeli iso.
swahili: “Kusanyikeni na msikilize, enyi wana wa Yakobo, msikilizeni baba yenu Israeli.

english: Asher’s food will be rich; he shall provide royal delicacies.
ekegusii: “Aseri natware endagera y’obonoru, narue endagera engiya eragwenere abarwoti.
swahili: “Chakula cha Asheri kitakuwa kinono, naye atatoa chakula kitamu kimfaacho mfalme.

english: Naphtali is a doe set free that bears beautiful fawns.
ekegusii: “Nafutali nengabi esiboire ekominyoka mono, nigo ekobiara chimanwa chingiya.
swahili: “Naftali ni kulungu jike aliyeachiwa huru azaaye watoto wazuri.

english: Joseph is a fruitful vine— a fruitful vine by a spring, whose branches scale the wall.
ekegusii: “Yusufu nomote omorere okwama ang’e nensoko; chinsagia chiaye nigo chikoranda enyasi igoro.
swahili: “Yosefu ni mzabibu uzaao, mzabibu uzaao ulio kando ya chemchemi, ambao matawi yake hutanda ukutani.

english: The archers attacked him with bitterness; they aimed at him in hostility.
ekegusii: Abaruti emegwe bakomoimokera ase okomogwera n’bororo, bakomoruta emegwe na komoorosia,
swahili: Kwa uchungu wapiga mshale walimshambulia, wakampiga mshale kwa ukatili.

english: Yet he steadied his bow, and his strong arms were tempered by the hands of the Mighty One of Jacob, in the name of the Shepherd, the Rock of Israel,
ekegusii: korende obota bwaye tibogosukigwa. Amaboko aye nigo are ne chinguru, naende namaango, goetera ase amaboko ’Omonyene Chinguru o Yakobo, oyore Omorisia na Egetare gia Israeli.
swahili: Lakini upinde wake ulibaki imara, mikono yake ikatiwa nguvu, na mkono wa Mwenye Nguvu wa Yakobo, kwa sababu ya Mchungaji, Mwamba wa Israeli,

english: by the God of your father who helps you, and by the Almighty who blesses you, with blessings of the heavens above, with blessings of the depths below, with blessings of the breasts and womb.
ekegusii: Nyasae o iso, nere oragokonye, Nyasae Omobui, nere oragosesenie nogosesenigwa gokorwa igoro, na ogosesenigwa gokorwa chindiba inse, na ogosesenigwa gokorwa inda na ase chimbeere.
swahili: kwa sababu ya Mungu wa baba yako, anayekusaidia, kwa sababu ya Mwenyezi, yeye anayekubariki kwa baraka za mbinguni juu, baraka za kilindi kilichoko chini, baraka za matitini na za tumbo la uzazi.

english: The blessings of your father have surpassed the blessings of the ancient mountains and the bounty of the everlasting hills. May they rest on the head of Joseph, on the brow of the prince of his brothers.
ekegusii: Ogosesenigwa gwa iso nkore ne chinguru ngoetanetie okw’ebitunwa bia kare, na obonene bw’ebigoro bia kare na kare. Ogosesenigwa okwo kobe egutwa ase omotwe o Yusufu, igoro y’egiototeri ki’oyore omogambi ase egati y’abamwabo.
swahili: Baraka za baba yako ni kubwa kuliko baraka za milima ya kale, nyingi kuliko vilima vya kale. Baraka hizo zote na zikae juu ya kichwa cha Yosefu, juu ya paji la yule mkuu miongoni mwa ndugu zake.

english: Benjamin is a ravenous wolf; in the morning he devours the prey, in the evening he divides the plunder.”
ekegusii: “Benjamini n’eseese y’orosana ekoria mono, engaki ya mambia yaria ebi’obotwari bwaye, na engaki ya mogoroba bwatanana ebiasakoire.”
swahili: “Benyamini ni mbwa mwitu mlafi mwenye njaa kuu; asubuhi hurarua mawindo yake, jioni hugawa nyara.”

english: These are the tribes of Israel, twelve in all, and this was what their father said to them. He blessed them, and he blessed each one with a suitable blessing. The Death of Jacob
ekegusii: Ebi nabio ebisaku bia Israeli ikomi na bibere; naya naro ise abateebetie ekero are kobasesenia na koa kera oyomo ogosesenigwa kwaye. Ogokwa kwa Yakobo
swahili: Haya yote ndiyo makabila kumi na mawili ya Israeli, na hivi ndivyo baba yao alivyowaambia alipowabariki, akimpa kila mmoja baraka inayomfaa. Kifo Cha Yakobo

english: Then Jacob instructed them, “I am about to be gathered to my people. Bury me with my fathers in the cave in the field of Ephron the Hittite.
ekegusii: Erio Israeli akabachiika, akabora: “Inche nkoirwa inde gosangererekana amo nabaanto baane. Montindeke ase chisokoro chiane chiatindegetwe ase rikuruma ri’oboremo bware bw’Efuroni Omohiti,
swahili: Ndipo alipowapa maelekezo haya: “Mimi niko karibu kukusanywa kwa watu wangu. Mnizike pamoja na baba zangu kwenye pango katika shamba la Efroni, Mhiti,

english: Reuben, you are my firstborn, my might, and the beginning of my strength, excelling in honor, excelling in power.
ekegusii: “Rubeni, aye nomwana one omotangi, aye nokobua kwane, na ogotongora gwe chinguru chiane. Noetanetie abamino ase okobua, nobaetanetie ase chinguru.
swahili: “Reubeni, wewe ni mzaliwa wangu wa kwanza, nguvu zangu, tunda la kwanza la nguvu zangu, umepita kwa heshima, umepita kwa uwezo.

english: The cave is in the field of Machpelah near Mamre, in the land of Canaan. This is the field Abraham purchased from Ephron the Hittite as a burial site.
ekegusii: rikuruma eri rire ase oboremo agwo Makipela, moocha ya Mamure, ase ense ya Kaanani. Oboremo boria Aburaamu agorete korwa ase Efuroni Omohiti bobe aase ogotindeka.
swahili: pango lililoko katika shamba la Makpela, karibu na Mamre huko Kanaani, ambalo Abrahamu alinunua kwa ajili ya mahali pa kuzikia kutoka kwa Efroni, Mhiti, pamoja na shamba.

english: There Abraham and his wife Sarah are buried, there Isaac and his wife Rebekah are buried, and there I buried Leah.
ekegusii: Agwo nao Aburaamu atindegetwe ase Sara mokaye ensemo; agwo nao Isaka na Rebeka mokaye batindegetwe, na agwo inche omonyene natindegete Lea.
swahili: Huko ndiko Abrahamu na Sara mkewe walikozikwa, huko akazikwa Isaki na Rebeka mkewe, na huko nilimzika Lea.

english: The field and the cave that is in it were purchased from the Hittites.”
ekegusii: Oboremo obwo amo ne rikuruma riria nigo biagoretwe korwa ase Abahiti.”
swahili: Shamba hilo na pango lililoko ndani yake lilinunuliwa kutoka kwa Wahiti.”

english: When Jacob had finished instructing his sons, he pulled his feet into the bed and breathed his last, and he was gathered to his people.
ekegusii: Ekero Yakobo akoorete gochiika abamura baye amang’ana aya, akaimokia amagoro aye, akayabeeka borere igoro; erio agakwa, erio agasangererekana amo nabaanto baye.
swahili: Baada ya Yakobo kumaliza kutoa maelekezo hayo kwa wanawe, akarudisha miguu yake kitandani, akapumua pumzi ya mwisho, na akakusanywa kwa watu wake.

english: Uncontrolled as the waters, you will no longer excel, because you went up to your father’s bed, onto my couch, and defiled it.
ekegusii: Aye nkwaberete buna amaache; korende togoetania abande, ekiagera nkwarinete borere bwa iso, okabosaria, ase igo okarenta obosooku.
swahili: Usiyezuiwa kama maji, basi hutakuwa mkuu tena, kwa kuwa ulipanda kwenye kitanda cha baba yako, kwenye kitanda changu na kukinajisi.

english: Simeon and Levi are brothers; their swords are weapons of violence.
ekegusii: “Simioni na Lawi naba ng’ina omo, ebirwanero biabo nebi’obotindi.
swahili: “Simeoni na Lawi ni wana ndugu: panga zao ni silaha za jeuri.

english: May I never enter their council; may I never join their assembly. For they kill men in their anger, and hamstring oxen on a whim.
ekegusii: Omoyo one tosoa ase obobisi bwabo, gose enkoro yane tesanga ase omosangererekano obo; naki ase endamwamu yabo mbaitete abanto, na ase obomwenu bwabo bakanacha chinteng’e chie chintang’ana.
swahili: Mimi na nisiingie katika baraza lao, nami nisiunganike katika kusanyiko lao, kwa kuwa wamewaua watu katika hasira yao, walikata mishipa ya miguu ya mafahali kama walivyopenda.

english: Cursed be their anger, for it is strong, and their wrath, for it is cruel! I will disperse them in Jacob and scatter them in Israel.
ekegusii: Endamwamu yabo eragererigwe, ekiagera nigo yareenge entindi, na ekeririanda kiabo, ekiagera tikiareenge namaabera. Nimbaatanane ase abana ba Yakobo, nimbasiarere ase abana ba Israeli.
swahili: Hasira yao na ilaaniwe, kwa kuwa ni kali mno, nayo ghadhabu yao ni ya ukatili! Nitawatawanya katika Yakobo Na kuwasambaza katika Israeli.

english: Judah, your brothers shall praise you. Your hand shall be on the necks of your enemies; your father’s sons shall bow down to you.
ekegusii: “Aye Yuda, abamino inabagotogie; okoboko kwao inakobwate ebigoti biababisa bao; abamura ba iso ng’a batugame bosio bwao na amasikani.
swahili: “Yuda, ndugu zako watakusifu; mkono wako utakuwa shingoni mwa adui zako; wana wa baba yako watakusujudia.

english: Judah is a young lion— my son, you return from the prey. Like a lion he crouches and lies down; like a lioness, who dares to rouse him?
ekegusii: Yuda, aye nendo ensae. Omwana one, gokorwa gotwara, nigo oratiire, na korara, na gotimoka buna endo, buna endo eaberi, ning’o orabe noboremu kogotura?
swahili: Ee Yuda, wewe ni mwana simba; unarudi toka mawindoni, mwanangu. Kama simba hunyemelea na kulala chini, kama simba jike: nani athubutuye kumwamsha?

english: And Adam had relations with his wife Eve, and she conceived and gave birth to Cain. “With the help of the LORD I have brought forth a man,” she said.
ekegusii: Bono Adamu akaba na mokaye Hawa, na ere akaba morito, akaibora omwana omoisia, akabora: “Nanyorire omwana omomura ase ogokonywa kw’Omonene.” Ase igo akamoroka Kaini.
swahili: Adamu akakutana kimwili na mkewe Eva, naye akapata mimba, akamzaa Kaini. Eva akasema, “Kwa msaada wa Bwana nimemzaa mwanaume.”

english: “What have you done?” replied the LORD. “The voice of your brother’s blood cries out to Me from the ground.
ekegusii: Naende Omonene akamoteebia: “Inki gekogera gwakora egookoroo eke ekebe iga? Eriogi ri’amanyinga a momura omino riarure ase riroba, riang’ikeire buna eriogi rikorigia egesiomba.
swahili: Bwana akasema, “Umefanya nini? Sikiliza! Damu ya ndugu yako inanililia mimi kutoka ardhini.

english: Now you are cursed and banished from the ground, which has opened its mouth to receive your brother’s blood from your hand.
ekegusii: Bono aye kwaragererigwe na tokogenderera korema korwa ase riroba. Rirorio nigo riaasamirie omonwa oye na konywa amanyinga y’omwana omino korwa ase okoboko kwao.
swahili: Sasa umelaaniwa na umehamishwa kutoka ardhi, ambayo imefungua kinywa chake na kupokea damu ya ndugu yako kutoka mkononi mwako.

english: When you till the ground, it will no longer yield its produce to you. You will be a fugitive and a wanderer on the earth.”
ekegusii: Ekero orabe gokorema riroba tirigokwamera endagera nonya ng’ake. Igo orabe omoomboganu na omoetanani ase ense.”
swahili: Utakapoilima ardhi, haitakupa tena mazao yake. Utakuwa mtu wa kutangatanga duniani asiye na utulivu.”

english: But Cain said to the LORD, “My punishment is greater than I can bear.
ekegusii: Erio Kaini agateebia Omonene: “Egesusuro kiane nekerito, tinkonyara gokebogoria.
swahili: Kaini akamwambia Bwana, “Adhabu yangu ni zaidi ya niwezavyo kustahimili.

english: Behold, this day You have driven me from the face of the earth, and from Your face I will be hidden; I will be a fugitive and a wanderer on the earth, and whoever finds me will kill me.”
ekegusii: Rora, reero gwanseririe korwa ase riroba eri, nimbiseke korwa ase obosio bwao, timborora naende. Nimbe omoomboganu na omoetanani ase ense, na onde bwensi orang’umere nigo arang’ite.”
swahili: Leo unanifukuza kutoka nchi, nami nitafichwa mbali na uwepo wako. Nitakuwa mtu wa kutangatanga asiyetulia duniani na yeyote anionaye ataniua.”

english: “Not so!” replied the LORD. “If anyone slays Cain, then Cain will be avenged sevenfold.” And the LORD placed a mark on Cain, so that no one who found him would kill him.
ekegusii: Korende Omonene akamoteebia: “Taibo! Onde bwensi oraite Kaini nigo araakanigwe egesiomba ara gatano na kabere.” Na Omonene akabeekera Kaini ekemanyererio ng’a onde bwensi oramoumere tabaisa komoita.
swahili: Lakini Bwana akamwambia, “La sivyo, ikiwa mtu yeyote atamuua Kaini atalipizwa kisasi mara saba zaidi.” Kisha Bwana akamwekea Kaini alama ili mtu yeyote ambaye angemwona asimuue.

english: So Cain went out from the presence of the LORD and settled in the land of Nod, east of Eden. The Descendants of Cain
ekegusii: Erio Kaini akarwa ase obosio bw’Omonene, akageenda, akamenya ase ense ekorokwa okoombogana ere moocha ya Edeni. Ororeeria rwa Kaini
swahili: Kwa hiyo Kaini akaondoka mbele za Bwana akaenda kuishi katika nchi ya Nodi, iliyoko mashariki ya Edeni.

english: And Cain had relations with his wife, and she conceived and gave birth to Enoch. Then Cain built a city and named it after his son Enoch.
ekegusii: Kaini akaba na mokaye, na ere akaba morito, akaibora Enoku; na Kaini akaagacha omochie, akayoroka Enoku, erieta ri’omwana oye.
swahili: Kaini akakutana kimwili na mkewe, naye akapata mimba na akamzaa Enoki. Wakati huo Kaini alikuwa anajenga mji, akauita Enoki jina la mtoto wake.

english: Now to Enoch was born Irad, and Irad was the father of Mehujael, and Mehujael was the father of Methusael, and Methusael was the father of Lamech.
ekegusii: Enoku akaibora Iradi, Iradi akaibora Metusaeli, Metusaeli akaibora Lameki.
swahili: Enoki akamzaa Iradi, Iradi akamzaa Mehuyaeli, Mehuyaeli akamzaa Methushaeli, na Methushaeli akamzaa Lameki.

english: And Lamech married two women, one named Adah and the other Zillah.
ekegusii: Lameki akanyuoma abakungu babere. Omokungu oyomo nigo are korokwa Ada, n’oyonde Zila.
swahili: Lameki alioa wanawake wawili, mmoja aliitwa Ada, na mwingine Sila.

english: Later she gave birth to Cain’s brother Abel. Now Abel was a keeper of sheep, while Cain was a tiller of the soil.
ekegusii: Naende akaibora omwana onde Abeli. Abeli akaba omorisia bwe ching’ondi, na Kaini akaba omoremi bw’omogondo.
swahili: Baadaye akamzaa Abeli ndugu yake. Basi Abeli akawa mfugaji, na Kaini akawa mkulima.

english: Adah gave birth to Jabal; he was the father of those who dwell in tents and raise livestock.
ekegusii: Ada akaibora Yabeli; oyo nere sokoro y’abare komenya ase ebigutu na babwate ching’iti chigotugwa.
swahili: Ada akamzaa Yabali ambaye ni baba wa wale walioishi katika mahema na kufuga wanyama.

english: And his brother’s name was Jubal; he was the father of all who play the harp and flute.
ekegusii: Na momura omwabo nigo are korokwa Yubali; oyio nere sokoro y’abanto baria baare kobugia amakano na ebiroria.
swahili: Kaka yake aliitwa Yubali, aliyekuwa baba wa wote wapigao zeze na filimbi.

english: And Zillah gave birth to Tubal-cain, a forger of every implement of bronze and iron. And the sister of Tubal-cain was Naamah.
ekegusii: Zila akaibora Tubali‐Kaini. Ere nigo areenge omoturi bw’ebinto bi’ebioma na ebie chitaai. Na omosubati omwabo nere Naama.
swahili: Pia Sila alikuwa na mtoto wa kiume aliyeitwa Tubali-Kaini ambaye alifua vifaa vya aina mbalimbali vya shaba na chuma. Naama alikuwa dada wa Tubali-Kaini.

english: Then Lamech said to his wives: “Adah and Zillah, hear my voice; wives of Lamech, listen to my speech. For I have slain a man for wounding me, a young man for striking me.
ekegusii: Lameki agateebia abakungu baye, inwe “Ada na Zila, igwa eriogi riane, inwe abakungu ba Lameki, tegerera buya moigwe buna ngoteeba, naitire omomura omoke ekiagera ong’akire na kombeeka rioote.
swahili: Lameki akawaambia wake zake, “Ada na Sila nisikilizeni mimi; wake wa Lameki sikieni maneno yangu. Nimemuua mtu kwa kunijeruhi, kijana mdogo kwa kuniumiza.

english: If Cain is avenged sevenfold, then Lamech seventy-sevenfold.” Seth and Enosh
ekegusii: Onye Kaini ogoakanerwa egesiomba ara gatano na kabere, amaene, Lameki ere naakanerwe ara emerongo etano na ebere, na gatano na kabere.” Seti na Enosu
swahili: Kama Kaini atalipizwa kisasi mara saba, basi Lameki itakuwa mara sabini na saba.”

english: And Adam again had relations with his wife, and she gave birth to a son and named him Seth, saying, “God has granted me another seed in place of Abel, since Cain killed him.”
ekegusii: Adamu na mokaye bakaibora omwana onde omomura, erio Hawa akamoroka Seti, agateeba: “Bono Nyasae ong’eire omwana onde omomura ribaga ri’Abeli, oria Kaini aitete”. Erio akamoroka Seti.
swahili: Adamu akakutana kimwili na mke wake tena, akamzaa mwana, akamwita Sethi, akisema, “Mungu amenijalia mwana mwingine badala ya Abeli, kwa kuwa Kaini alimuua.”

english: And to Seth also a son was born, and he called him Enosh. At that time men began to call upon the name of the LORD.
ekegusii: Seti nere akaibora omwana omomura, akamoroka Enosu. Erio agwo abanto bagachaaka korangeria erieta ri’Omonene ase okomosasiima.
swahili: Naye Sethi akamzaa mwana, akamwita Enoshi. Wakati huo watu wakaanza kuliitia jina la Bwana.

english: So in the course of time, Cain brought some of the fruit of the soil as an offering to the LORD,
ekegusii: Engaki egaika Kaini akarenta okwama kw’omogondo oye erio kobe ekengwanso ase Omonene.
swahili: Baada ya muda Kaini akaleta baadhi ya mazao ya shamba kama sadaka kwa Bwana.

english: while Abel brought the best portions of the firstborn of his flock. And the LORD looked with favor on Abel and his offering,
ekegusii: Abeli nere akareenta emanwa entangi enoru korwa ase riicho riaye. Na Omonene aganchera ekengwanso ki’Abeli,
swahili: Lakini Abeli akaleta fungu nono kutoka baadhi ya wazaliwa wa kwanza wa mifugo yake. Bwana akamkubali Abeli pamoja na sadaka yake,

english: but He had no regard for Cain and his offering. So Cain became very angry, and his countenance fell.
ekegusii: korende tagogetigwe nekengwanso gia Kaini. Ase igo, ayio akagera Kaini akagechigwa mono kegima, na obosio bwaye bokaonchoka, bokairura.
swahili: lakini Mungu hakumkubali Kaini pamoja na sadaka yake. Kwa hiyo Kaini akakasirika sana, uso wake ukawa na huzuni.

english: “Why are you angry,” said the LORD to Cain, “and why has your countenance fallen?
ekegusii: Na Omonene akamobooria: “Kaini, nase ki okobeera nendamwamu na obosio bwao bwairurire?
swahili: Kisha Bwana akamwambia Kaini, “Kwa nini umekasirika? Kwa nini uso wako una huzuni?

english: If you do what is right, will you not be accepted? But if you refuse to do what is right, sin is crouching at your door; it desires you, but you must master it.”
ekegusii: “Onye ndiria gwakora buya anga nigo agogete; korende bono aye gwakorire ebibe, ebibe nigo bikoganyererete gesieri; na birobio nigo bikoganetie. Korende nekogwenerete obibue kegima.”
swahili: Ukifanya lililo sawa, je, hutakubalika? Lakini usipofanya lililo sawa, dhambi inakuvizia mlangoni mwako, inakutamani wewe, lakini inakupasa uishinde.”

english: Then Cain said to his brother Abel, “Let us go out to the field.” And while they were in the field, Cain rose up against his brother Abel and killed him.
ekegusii: Erio Kaini agateebia Abeli omwabo: “Inchuo, togende getii.” Ekero baare agwo getii, Kaini akaimokera Abeli momura omwabo, akamoita.
swahili: Basi Kaini akamwambia ndugu yake Abeli, “Twende shambani.” Walipokuwa shambani, Kaini akamshambulia Abeli ndugu yake, akamuua.

english: And the LORD said to Cain, “Where is your brother Abel?” “I do not know!” he answered. “Am I my brother’s keeper?”
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene akabooria Kaini: “Ng’ai Abeli momura omino are?” Kaini akamoiraneria: “Inche tinkomanya. Inee! Ninche nkorenda oyominto?”
swahili: Kisha Bwana akamuuliza Kaini, “Ndugu yako Abeli yuko wapi?” Akamjibu, “Sijui, je, mimi ni mlinzi wa ndugu yangu?”

english: Then Joseph fell upon his father’s face, wept over him, and kissed him.
ekegusii: Erio Yusufu akagwera ise ase obosio bwaye, akarera na komonyunyunta.
swahili: Basi Yosefu akamwangukia baba yake, akalilia juu yake na akambusu.

english: When they reached the threshing floor of Atad, which is across the Jordan, they lamented and wailed loudly, and Joseph mourned for his father seven days.
ekegusii: Ekero baigete ase ekeooreri gi’Atadi ng’umbu y’orooche rwa Yorodani, bakaba bakorera ebirero ebinene mono. Agwo Yusufu akagenderera komoreera ise ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere.
swahili: Walipofika kwenye sakafu ya kupuria nafaka ya Atadi, karibu na Yordani, wakalia kwa sauti na kwa uchungu; Yosefu akapumzika huko kwa siku saba kumwombolezea baba yake.

english: When the Canaanites of the land saw the mourning at the threshing floor of Atad, they said, “This is a solemn ceremony of mourning by the Egyptians.” Thus the place across the Jordan is called Abel-mizraim.
ekegusii: Na Abakaanani abamenyete ase ense eria, ekero bachia korora ebirero agwo Atadi ase ekeooreri, bakaboora: “Ebirero ebi bi’Abamisiri nebinene mono.” Ase ayio, aase aria ng’umbu ya Yorodani akarokwa Abeli‐Misiri.
swahili: Wakanaani walioishi huko walipoona maombolezo yaliyofanyika katika sakafu ile ya kupuria ya Atadi, wakasema, “Wamisri wanafanya maombolezo makubwa.” Kwa hiyo mahali pale karibu na Yordani pakaitwa Abel-Mizraimu.

english: So Jacob’s sons did as he had charged them.
ekegusii: Naboigo basinto ba Yakobo bakorete buna ise abachiigete.
swahili: Hivyo wana wa Yakobo wakafanya kama baba yao alivyowaagiza:

english: They carried him to the land of Canaan and buried him in the cave at Machpelah in the field near Mamre, which Abraham had purchased from Ephron the Hittite as a burial site.
ekegusii: Bakamoimokia, bakamoira goika ase ense ya Kaanani. Erio bakamotindeka ase rikuruma riria riare, ase oboremo agwo Makipela, moocha ya Mamure, oboremo boria Aburaamu agorete korwa ase Efuroni Omohiti abe aase aye agotindeka abakuure.
swahili: Wakamchukua mpaka nchi ya Kanaani, wakamzika kwenye pango katika shamba la Makpela, karibu na Mamre, ambalo Abrahamu alilinunua kutoka kwa Efroni, Mhiti, pamoja na shamba liwe mahali pa kuzikia.

english: After Joseph had buried his father, he returned to Egypt with his brothers and all who had gone with him to bury his father. Joseph Comforts His Brothers
ekegusii: Yusufu, ekero akoorire gotindeka ise, akairana Misiri amo nabamwabo na bonsi abatiirete amo nere. Yusufu okoremia abamwabo
swahili: Baada ya Yosefu kumzika baba yake, akarudi Misri pamoja na ndugu zake na wale wote waliokuwa wamekwenda naye kumzika baba yake. Yosefu Awaondolea Ndugu Zake Mashaka

english: When Joseph’s brothers saw that their father was dead, they said, “What if Joseph bears a grudge? Then he will surely repay us for all the evil that we did to him.”
ekegusii: Ekero abamwabo Yusufu barooche ng’a ise okuure bagateebania. “Aande Yusufu nigo aratorege, arusie egesiomba ase amabe aria twamokorerete.”
swahili: Ndugu zake Yosefu walipoona kwamba baba yao amekufa, wakasema, “Itakuwaje kama Yosefu ataweka kinyongo dhidi yetu na kutulipa mabaya yote tuliyomtendea?”

english: So they sent word to Joseph, saying, “Before he died, your father commanded,
ekegusii: Ase ayio bagatoma abanto ase Yusufu komoteebia ng’a: “Iso nigo ateebete iga ritang’ani atarakwa.
swahili: Kwa hiyo wakampelekea Yosefu ujumbe, wakasema, “Kabla baba yako hajafa aliacha maagizo haya:

english: ‘This is what you are to say to Joseph: I beg you, please forgive the transgression and sin of your brothers, for they did you wrong.’ So now, Joseph, please forgive the transgression of the servants of the God of your father.” When their message came to him, Joseph wept.
ekegusii: Moteebie Yusufu iga: Nagosabire obaabere abamino amamocho abo na ebibe biabo bagokorerete. Nimanyete ng’a mbagokorerete bobe. Ase igo, bono twagosabire, otwabere ebibe biaito, naki intwe nabasomba ba Nyasae o iso.” Yusufu akarera ekero abamwabo bamoboretie amang’ana ayio.
swahili: ‘Hili ndilo mtakalomwambia Yosefu: Ninakuomba uwasamehe ndugu zako dhambi na mabaya kwa vile walivyokutenda vibaya.’ Sasa tafadhali samehe dhambi za watumishi wa Mungu wa baba yako.” Ujumbe huu ulipomfikia, Yosefu akalia.

english: His brothers also came to him, bowed down before him, and said, “We are your slaves!”
ekegusii: Erio abamwabo bagacha, bagatung’ama inse ase obosio bwaye, bakaboora: “Intwe iga nabasomba bao tore.”
swahili: Ndipo ndugu zake wakaja na kujitupa chini mbele yake. Wakasema, “Sisi ni watumwa wako.”

english: But Joseph replied, “Do not be afraid. Am I in the place of God?
ekegusii: Korende Yusufu akabateebia: “Timoiroka! Inee! Inche inde ribaga ria Nyasae?
swahili: Lakini Yosefu akawaambia, “Msiogope. Je, mimi ni badala ya Mungu?

english: And Joseph directed the physicians in his service to embalm his father Israel. So they embalmed him,
ekegusii: Agachiika abarwaria abaare komokorera, ng’a baake Israeli ise amafuta, tabaisa kogunda; naboigo abarwaria bamokorerete,
swahili: Ndipo Yosefu akawaagiza matabibu waliokuwa wakimhudumia, wamtie baba yake Israeli dawa ili asioze. Hivyo matabibu wakamtia dawa asioze,

english: As for you, what you intended against me for evil, God intended for good, in order to accomplish a day like this—to preserve the lives of many people.
ekegusii: Ekeene, inwe nabo mwarengereretie gonkorera amabe, korende Nyasae akayaonchora akaba amaya, na buna mwarorire reero iga, otooririe obogima bw’abaanto abange.
swahili: Mlikusudia kunidhuru, lakini Mungu alikusudia mema, ili litimie hili linalofanyika sasa, kuokoa maisha ya watu wengi.

english: Therefore do not be afraid. I will provide for you and your little ones.” So Joseph reassured his brothers and spoke kindly to them. The Death of Joseph
ekegusii: Gaki, bono timoiroka! Nimbaragerie inwe amo nabana baino.” Naboigo akaba okobaremia, agakwana nabarabwo amang’ana amaya. Ogokwa kwa Yusufu
swahili: Hivyo basi, msiogope. Mimi nitawatunza ninyi nyote pamoja na watoto wenu.” Akawahakikishia na kusema nao kwa wema. Kifo Cha Yosefu

english: Now Joseph and his father’s household remained in Egypt, and Joseph lived to the age of 110.
ekegusii: Yusufu akamenya Misiri, ere amo nabaanto bamwabo, agakoora emiaka rigana erimo, na ikomi (110).
swahili: Yosefu akakaa katika nchi ya Misri, yeye pamoja na jamaa yote ya baba yake. Akaishi miaka 110,

english: He saw Ephraim’s sons to the third generation, and indeed the sons of Machir son of Manasseh were brought up on Joseph’s knees.
ekegusii: Agwo akarora abana b’Efraimu na abachokoro baye goika ekiaare kia gatato, akarora na abana ba Makiri, omwana o Manase, baiboreretwe ase Yusufu.
swahili: naye akaona kizazi cha tatu cha watoto wa Efraimu. Pia akaona watoto wa Makiri mwana wa Manase, wakawekwa magotini mwa Yosefu walipozaliwa.

english: Then Joseph said to his brothers, “I am about to die, but God will surely visit you and bring you up from this land to the land He promised on oath to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.”
ekegusii: Yusufu agateebia abamwabo: “Ng’ang’e inde gokwa, korende amaene Nyasae nabanyorere enchera y’okobarusia ase ense eye, abatiirie mogende ase ense eria abarierete eira na gotiana, ng’a nae Aburaamu, na Isaka, na Yakobo.”
swahili: Ndipo Yosefu akawaambia ndugu zake, “Mimi ninakaribia kufa. Lakini kwa hakika Mungu atawasaidia na kuwachukueni kutoka nchi hii na kuwapeleka katika nchi aliyomwahidi kwa kiapo Abrahamu, Isaki na Yakobo.”

english: And Joseph made the sons of Israel take an oath and said, “God will surely attend to you, and then you must carry my bones up from this place.”
ekegusii: Yusufu agatiania abana ba Israeli agwo, akabora: “Bono, ekero Nyasae arabachere abakoonye, goika moire amauga aane; mogende naro.”
swahili: Naye Yosefu akawaapisha wana wa Israeli na kuwaambia, “Hakika Mungu atawasaidia, nanyi ni lazima mhakikishe mmepandisha mifupa yangu kutoka mahali hapa.”

english: So Joseph died at the age of 110. And they embalmed his body and placed it in a coffin in Egypt.
ekegusii: Erio Yusufu erio agakwa ore n’emiaka rigana erimo na ikomi (110). Bakamoaka amafuta, tabaisa kogunda, bakamobeeka ase esanduki ime aaria Misiri.
swahili: Kwa hiyo Yosefu akafa akiwa na umri wa miaka 110. Baada ya kumtia dawa ili asioze, akawekwa kwenye jeneza huko Misri.

english: taking the forty days required to complete the embalming. And the Egyptians mourned for him seventy days.
ekegusii: goika amatuko emerongo ene agaikerana. Ase amatuko ang’ana buna ayio naro egetondo kiare goakwa amariogo. Abamisiri bakamoreera Israeli amatuko emerongo etano na ebere.
swahili: wakatumia siku arobaini, kwa maana ndio muda uliotakiwa wa kutia dawa ili asioze. Nao Wamisri wakamwombolezea Yakobo kwa siku sabini.

english: When the days of mourning had passed, Joseph said to Pharaoh’s court, “If I have found favor in your eyes, please tell Pharaoh that
ekegusii: Ekero amatuko okomoreera Israeli aerete, Yusufu agakwana nabaanto b’enka ya Farao, akabora: “Onye nkonyora ogwancherwa ase amaiso aino, komoranche monteeberie Farao
swahili: Siku za kumwombolezea zilipokwisha, Yosefu akawaambia washauri wa Farao, “Kama nimepata kibali machoni penu semeni na Farao kwa ajili yangu. Mwambieni,

english: my father made me swear an oath when he said, ‘I am about to die. You must bury me in the tomb that I dug for myself in the land of Canaan.’ Now let me go and bury my father, and then return.”
ekegusii: ng’a tata nandierete omwando ogoteeba: Ng’ang’e inde gokwa, ong’ire ontindeke ase oboina boria naremete ase ense ya Kaanani. Momonsabere ribaga ngende gotindeka tata, erio ning’irane.”
swahili: ‘Baba yangu aliniapisha na kuniambia, “Mimi niko karibu kufa; unizike katika kaburi lile nililochimba kwa ajili yangu mwenyewe katika nchi ya Kanaani.” Sasa nakuomba uniruhusu niende kumzika baba yangu, nami nitarudi.’ ”

english: Pharaoh replied, “Go up and bury your father, as he made you swear to do.”
ekegusii: Farao akairaneria: “Tiira ochie gotindeka iso, buna akorierete omwando.”
swahili: Farao akasema, “Panda, uende kumzika baba yako, kama alivyokuapiza kufanya.”

english: Then Joseph went to bury his father, and all the servants of Pharaoh accompanied him—the elders of Pharaoh’s household and all the elders of the land of Egypt—
ekegusii: Erio Yusufu agatiira gochia gotindeka ise. Abasomba bonsi ba Farao bakagenda amo nere, na abagaaka bonsi b’enka yaye, na abagaaka bonsi ba Misiri,
swahili: Hivyo Yosefu akapanda kwenda kumzika baba yake. Maafisa wote wa Farao wakaenda pamoja naye, watu mashuhuri wa baraza lake na watu mashuhuri wote wa Misri.

english: along with all of Joseph’s household, and his brothers, and his father’s household. Only their children and flocks and herds were left in Goshen.
ekegusii: na bonsi ab’enka ya Yusufu, amo nabamwabo, na ab’enka ya ise. Abana babo boka bagatigara Goseni amo ne ching’ondi ne chiombe chiabo.
swahili: Hawa ni mbali na watu wote wa nyumbani kwa Yosefu, na ndugu zake, na wale wote wa nyumbani mwa baba yake. Ni watoto wao, makundi yao ya kondoo, mbuzi na ngʼombe tu waliobakia katika nchi ya Gosheni.

english: Chariots and horsemen alike went up with him, and it was an exceedingly large procession.
ekegusii: Naende Yusufu akaira amo nere chigari na abariini chibarasi; bakaba omoganda omonene mono.
swahili: Magari makubwa na wapanda farasi pia walipanda pamoja naye. Likawa kundi kubwa sana.

english: This is the book of the generations of Adam. In the day that God created man, He made him in His own likeness.
ekegusii: Oyo noro omoroberio bw’ororeeria rw’Adamu. Ekero keria Nyasae atongete Mwanyabaanto, akabaroisia ase omogwekano oye omonyene.
swahili: Hii ni orodha iliyoandikwa ya vizazi vya Adamu. Wakati Mungu alipomuumba Adamu, alimfanya kwa sura ya Mungu.

english: And after he had become the father of Kenan, Enosh lived 815 years and had other sons and daughters.
ekegusii: Magega y’okoiborwa gwa Kainani, Enosu nigo amenyete emiaka amagana atano na atato, na ikomi na etano (815), akaba ise bw’abana bande, abamura na abaiseke.
swahili: Baada ya kumzaa Kenani, Enoshi aliishi miaka 815, naye alikuwa na watoto wengine wa kiume na wa kike.

english: So Enosh lived a total of 905 years, and then he died.
ekegusii: Ase oboamo, Enosu nigo akoorete emiaka amagana kianda, na etano (905), erio agakwa.
swahili: Enoshi aliishi jumla ya miaka 905, ndipo akafa.

english: When Kenan was 70 years old, he became the father of Mahalalel.
ekegusii: Ekero Kainani konya emenyire emiaka emerongo etano na ebere, (70), akaibora Mahalaleli.
swahili: Kenani alipokuwa ameishi miaka sabini, akamzaa Mahalaleli.

english: And after he had become the father of Mahalalel, Kenan lived 840 years and had other sons and daughters.
ekegusii: Magega y’okoiborwa kwa Mahalaleli, Kainani nigo amenyete emiaka amagana atano na atato, na emerongo ene (840), akaba ise bw’abana bande, abamura na abaiseke.
swahili: Baada ya kumzaa Mahalaleli, Kenani aliishi miaka 840, akawa na watoto wengine wa kiume na wa kike.

english: So Kenan lived a total of 910 years, and then he died.
ekegusii: Ase oboamo, Kainani nigo amenyete emiaka amagana kianda, na ikomi (910), erio agakwa.
swahili: Kenani aliishi jumla ya miaka 910, ndipo akafa.

english: When Mahalalel was 65 years old, he became the father of Jared.
ekegusii: Ekero Mahalaleli emenyire emiaka emerongo etano nomo, na etano (65), akaibora Yaredi.
swahili: Mahalaleli alipokuwa ameishi miaka sitini na mitano, akamzaa Yaredi.

english: And after he had become the father of Jared, Mahalalel lived 830 years and had other sons and daughters.
ekegusii: Magega y’okoiborwa kwa Yaredi, Mahalaleli nigo amenyete emiaka amagana atano na atato, na emerongo etato (830), akaba ise bw’abana bande, abamura na abaiseke.
swahili: Baada ya kumzaa Yaredi, Mahalaleli aliishi miaka 830, akawa na watoto wengine wa kiume na wa kike.

english: So Mahalalel lived a total of 895 years, and then he died. God Takes Up Enoch (Hebrews 11:5)
ekegusii: Ase oboamo, Mahalaleli nigo amenyete emiaka amagana atano na atato, na emerongo kianda, na etano (895), erio agakwa.
swahili: Mahalaleli aliishi jumla ya miaka 895, ndipo akafa.

english: When Jared was 162 years old, he became the father of Enoch.
ekegusii: Ekero Yaredi amenyire emiaka rigana erimo, na emerongo etano nomo, na ebere (162), akaibora Enoku.
swahili: Yaredi alipokuwa ameishi miaka 162, akamzaa Enoki.

english: And after he had become the father of Enoch, Jared lived 800 years and had other sons and daughters.
ekegusii: Magega y’okoiborwa kwa Enoku, Yaredi nigo amenyete emiaka amagana atano na atato (800), akaba ise bw’abana bande, abamura na abaiseke.
swahili: Baada ya kumzaa Enoki, Yaredi aliishi miaka 800, naye akawa na watoto wengine wa kiume na wa kike.

english: Male and female He created them, and He blessed them. And in the day they were created, He called them “man.”
ekegusii: Ere akabatonga omosacha na omokungu, akabasesenia, akabaroka Mwanyabaanto.
swahili: Aliwaumba mwanaume na mwanamke, akawabariki. Walipokwisha kuumbwa, akawaita “mwanadamu.”

english: So Jared lived a total of 962 years, and then he died.
ekegusii: Ase oboamo, Yaredi nigo amenyete emiaka amagana kianda, na emerongo etano nomo, na ebere (962), erio agakwa.
swahili: Yaredi aliishi jumla ya miaka 962, ndipo akafa.

english: When Enoch was 65 years old, he became the father of Methuselah.
ekegusii: Ekero Enoku amenyire emiaka emerongo etano nomo, na etano (65), akaibora Metusela.
swahili: Enoki alipokuwa ameishi miaka sitini na mitano, akamzaa Methusela.

english: And after he had become the father of Methuselah, Enoch walked with God 300 years and had other sons and daughters.
ekegusii: Magega y’okoiborwa kwa Metusela, Enoku akaba ogotaara amo na Nyasae ase emiaka amagana atato (300), erio akaba ise bw’abana bande, abamura na abaiseke.
swahili: Baada ya kumzaa Methusela, Enoki alitembea na Mungu miaka 300, na akawa na watoto wengine wa kiume na wa kike.

english: Enoch walked with God, and then he was no more, because God had taken him away. From Methuselah to Noah
ekegusii: akaba ogotaara amo na Nyasae. Erio tachikororekana naende, ekiagera Nyasae nigo amoirete.
swahili: Enoki akatembea na Mungu, kisha akatoweka, kwa sababu Mungu alimchukua.

english: When Methuselah was 187 years old, he became the father of Lamech.
ekegusii: Ekero Metusela amenyire emiaka rigana erimo, na emerongo etano na etato, na etano na ebere (187), akaibora Lameki.
swahili: Methusela alipokuwa ameishi miaka 187, akamzaa Lameki.

english: And after he had become the father of Lamech, Methuselah lived 782 years and had other sons and daughters.
ekegusii: Magega y’okoiborwa kwa Lameki, Metusela nigo amenyete emiaka amagana atano na abere, na emerongo etano na etato, na ebere, (782), akaba ise bw’abana bande, abamura na abaiseke.
swahili: Baada ya kumzaa Lameki, Methusela aliishi miaka 782, akawa na watoto wengine wa kiume na wa kike.

english: So Methuselah lived a total of 969 years, and then he died.
ekegusii: Ase oboamo, Metusela nigo akoorete emiaka amagana kianda, na emerongo etano nomo, na kianda (969), erio agakwa.
swahili: Methusela aliishi jumla ya miaka 969, ndipo akafa.

english: When Lamech was 182 years old, he had a son.
ekegusii: Ekero Lameki amenyire emiaka rigana erimo na emerongo etano na etato, na ebere (182), akaba ise omwana omomura,
swahili: Lameki alipokuwa ameishi miaka 182, alimzaa mwana.

english: And he named him Noah, saying, “May this one comfort us in the labor and toil of our hands caused by the ground that the LORD has cursed.”
ekegusii: akamoroka Nuhu agateeba: “Oyo nere oratoremie intwe ase emeremo yaito, na obokong’u bwaito, ase riroba eri Omonene aragereretie.”
swahili: Akamwita jina lake Noa, akasema, “Yeye ndiye atakayetufariji katika kazi na maumivu makali ya mikono yetu yaliyosababishwa na ardhi iliyolaaniwa na Bwana.”

english: When Adam was 130 years old, he had a son in his own likeness, after his own image; and he named him Seth.
ekegusii: Ekero Adamu konya amenyire emiaka rigana erimo na emerongo etato (130), akaba ise bw’omwana omomura omobwekaine, ore ekieni kiaye ere omonyene, akamoroka Seti.
swahili: Adamu alipokuwa ameishi miaka 130, alikuwa na mwana aliyekuwa na sura yake, mwenye kufanana naye. Akamwita Sethi.

english: And after he had become the father of Noah, Lamech lived 595 years and had other sons and daughters.
ekegusii: Magega y’okoiborwa kwa Nuhu, Lameki akamenya emiaka amagana atano, na emerongo kianda, na etano (595), akaba ise bw’abana bande, abamura na abaiseke.
swahili: Baada ya Noa kuzaliwa, Lameki aliishi miaka 595, akawa na watoto wengine wa kiume na wa kike.

english: After Noah was 500 years old, he became the father of Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
ekegusii: Ekero Nuhu amenyire emiaka amagana atano (500), akaba ise bw’abana abamura, nabwo Shemu, na Hamu, na Yafeti.
swahili: Baada ya Noa kuishi miaka 500, aliwazaa Shemu, Hamu na Yafethi.

english: And after he had become the father of Seth, Adam lived 800 years and had other sons and daughters.
ekegusii: Magega y’okoiborwa gwa Seti, Adamu akagenderera komenya goika emiaka ende amagana atano na atato (800), erio akaba ise bw’abana baabande, abamura na abaiseke.
swahili: Baada ya Sethi kuzaliwa, Adamu aliishi miaka 800, akawa na watoto wengine wa kiume na wa kike.

english: So Adam lived a total of 930 years, and then he died.
ekegusii: Ase oboamo Adamu nigo amenyete, emiaka amagana kianda, na emerongo etato (930), erio agakwa.
swahili: Adamu aliishi jumla ya miaka 930, ndipo akafa.

english: When Seth was 105 years old, he became the father of Enosh.
ekegusii: Ekero Seti konya amenyire emiaka rigana erimo, na etano (105), akaibora Enosu.
swahili: Sethi alipokuwa ameishi miaka 105, akamzaa Enoshi.

english: And after he had become the father of Enosh, Seth lived 807 years and had other sons and daughters.
ekegusii: Magega y’okoiborwa kwa Enosu, Seti akamenya naende emiaka ende amagana atano na atato, na etano na ebere (807), akaba ise bw’abana bande, abamura na abaiseke.
swahili: Baada ya kumzaa Enoshi, Sethi aliishi miaka 807, akawa na watoto wengine wa kiume na wa kike.

english: So Seth lived a total of 912 years, and then he died.
ekegusii: Ase oboamo, Seti nigo akoorete emiaka amagana kianda, na ikomi na ebere (912), erio agakwa.
swahili: Sethi aliishi jumla ya miaka 912, ndipo akafa.

english: When Enosh was 90 years old, he became the father of Kenan.
ekegusii: Ekero Enosu amenyire emiaka emerongo kianda (90), akaba ise Kainani.
swahili: Enoshi alipokuwa ameishi miaka tisini, akamzaa Kenani.

english: Now when men began to multiply on the face of the earth and daughters were born to them,
ekegusii: Mwanyabaanto bakagenderera komentekana ase ense, na abana abaiseke bakaiborwa agwo ase baare.
swahili: Watu walipoanza kuongezeka idadi katika uso wa dunia na watoto wa kike wakazaliwa kwao,

english: And Noah had three sons: Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
ekegusii: Ere nabwate abana abamura batato, nabwo Shemu, na Hamu, na Yafeti.
swahili: Noa alikuwa na wana watatu: Shemu, Hamu na Yafethi.

english: Now the earth was corrupt in the sight of God, and full of violence.
ekegusii: Ense ekaba yasarekire ase obosio bwa Nyasae, egaichorwa nobotindi na okoregana kwegeitano.
swahili: Wakati huu dunia ilikuwa imejaa uharibifu na ukatili machoni pa Mungu.

english: And God looked upon the earth and saw that it was corrupt; for all living creatures on the earth had corrupted their ways. Preparing the Ark (Hebrews 11:7)
ekegusii: Nyasae akarora ng’a ense yatutukanire, ekiagera kera omonto obwatirie chinchera chi’obotutukanu ase ense. Nuhu okoagacha obwato
swahili: Mungu akaona jinsi dunia ilivyoharibika, kwa maana watu wote duniani walikuwa wameharibu njia zao.

english: Then God said to Noah, “The end of all living creatures has come before Me, because through them the earth is full of violence. Now behold, I will destroy both them and the earth.
ekegusii: Erio Nyasae agateebia Nuhu: “Narorire ng’a ninsirie Mwanyabaanto, ekiagera baichoirie obotindi na oboregani ense, ase igo nimbasirie amo nense yonsi.
swahili: Kwa hiyo Mungu akamwambia Noa, “Nitawaangamiza watu wote, kwa kuwa dunia imejaa ukatili kwa sababu yao. Hakika mimi nitaangamiza watu pamoja na dunia.

english: Make for yourself an ark of gopher wood; make rooms in the ark and coat it with pitch inside and out.
ekegusii: Eroiserie obwato obonene bw’emete y’ebirobo; obonachane nechitoto ime ebinyomba, na oboome eramu ime na isiko.
swahili: Kwa hiyo jitengenezee safina kubwa kwa mbao za mvinje, tengeneza vyumba ndani yake na uipake lami ndani na nje.

english: And this is how you are to build it: The ark is to be 300 cubits long, 50 cubits wide, and 30 cubits high.
ekegusii: Obwato obwo nigo oraboroisie iga: Obotambe bwaye nigo borabe obw’ebirengo bi’amaboko amagana atato, na obogare bwaye amaboko emerongo etano, na obotambe bwaye gochia igoro amaboko emerongo etato.
swahili: Hivi ndivyo utakavyoitengeneza: Safina iwe na urefu wa dhiraa 300, upana wake dhiraa hamsini na kimo chake dhiraa thelathini.

english: You are to make a roof for the ark, finish its walls a cubit from the top, place a door in the side of the ark, and build lower, middle, and upper decks.
ekegusii: Inse y’ekerama otige ribaga ri’okorenta oborabu ase obwato obwo, orikore obotambe gochia igoro obw’ekerengo gi’okoboko okomo, obeke egesieri rikere ensemo. Onachane obwato obwo ase amarongo atato.
swahili: Itengenezee paa na umalizie safina kwa kuacha nafasi ya dhiraa moja juu. Weka mlango ubavuni mwa safina, na uifanye ya ghorofa ya chini, ya kati na ya juu.

english: And behold, I will bring floodwaters upon the earth to destroy every creature under the heavens that has the breath of life. Everything on the earth will perish.
ekegusii: Naki rora, nindete etoigo igoro y’ense, ninsirie Mwanyabaanto na binde bionsi bire moyo; kera egento kere moyo ase ense goika gekwe.
swahili: Nitaleta gharika ya maji juu ya nchi ili kuangamiza uhai wote chini ya mbingu, kila kiumbe chenye pumzi ya uhai ndani yake. Kila kitu juu ya nchi kitaangamia.

english: But I will establish My covenant with you, and you will enter the ark—you and your sons and your wife and your sons’ wives with you.
ekegusii: Korende ninkore egeteebanio kiogotianania naye; aye nosoe ase obwato ime amo nabamura bao, na mokao, na baka bamura bao.
swahili: Lakini Mimi nitaweka Agano langu na wewe, nawe utaingia ndani ya Safina, wewe pamoja na mke wako, wanao na wake zao.

english: And you are to bring two of every living creature into the ark—male and female—to keep them alive with you.
ekegusii: Na orente ching’iti ase obwato ime, na chinde chionsi chire moyo, korwa ase kera egesaku, ibere ibere, chinsacha ne chinkuungu, chibe moyo amo naye.
swahili: Utaingiza ndani ya Safina kila aina ya kiumbe hai wawili wawili, wa kiume na wa kike, ili kuwahifadhi hai pamoja na wewe.

english: the sons of God saw that the daughters of men were beautiful, and they took as wives whomever they chose.
ekegusii: Abamura ba Nyasae bakarora abaiseke ba Mwanyabaanto ng’a nigo baare nebieni ebiya, bakanyuoma ase ogwechorera abakungu korwa ase abaiseke baria koreng’ana buna baabagogetie.
swahili: wana wa Mungu wakawaona kuwa hao binti za wanadamu walikuwa wazuri wa sura, wakaoa yeyote miongoni mwao waliyemchagua.

english: Two of every kind of bird and animal and crawling creature will come to you to be kept alive.
ekegusii: Ase kera egesaku gie chinyoni, ne ching’iti chionsi, na echikwagura igoro ase ense, ochirente ibere ibere amo naye, erinde chibe moyo.
swahili: Wawili wa kila aina ya ndege, wa kila aina ya mnyama na wa kila aina ya kitambaacho ardhini watakuja kwako ili wahifadhiwe hai.

english: You are also to take for yourself every kind of food that is eaten and gather it as food for yourselves and for the animals.”
ekegusii: Oire endagera egochia koriegwa, oyegache erio eyio nebe endagera yaino na ey’echingi’ti ne chinyoni.”
swahili: Utachukua kila aina ya chakula kitakacholiwa, na ukiweke akiba kama chakula kwa ajili yako na yao.”

english: So Noah did everything precisely as God had commanded him.
ekegusii: Nuhu nabo akorete igo; agakora ayio onsi koreng’ana buna Nyasae amochigeete.
swahili: Noa akafanya kila kitu kama vile Mungu alivyomwamuru.

english: So the LORD said, “My Spirit will not contend with man forever, for he is mortal; his days shall be 120 years.”
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene agateeba: “Omoika one tokonyara komenya ime ase Mwanyabaanto kare na kare, ekiagera ere nomobere ogokwa. Ase ayio emiaka yaye nigo erabe rigana erimo na emerongo ebere yoka.”
swahili: Ndipo Bwana akasema, “Roho yangu haitashindana na mwanadamu milele, kwa kuwa yeye ni wa kufa, siku zake zitakuwa miaka 120.”

english: The Nephilim were on the earth in those days—and afterward as well—when the sons of God had relations with the daughters of men. And they bore them children who became the mighty men of old, men of renown.
ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio, na kogenderera, amamonto namenyete ase ense, ekero abana abamura ba Nyasae baare konyuoma abaiseke ba Mwanyabaanto na koibora abana. Abwo nabwo baarenge amamonto yogokumia, are gotogigwa agwo kare.
swahili: Wanefili walikuwako duniani siku hizo, na baadaye, hao wana wa Mungu walipoingia kwa binti za wanadamu na kuzaa nao. Wanefili walikuwa mashujaa na watu waliojulikana wa zamani hizo.

english: Then the LORD saw that the wickedness of man was great upon the earth, and that every inclination of the thoughts of his heart was altogether evil all the time.
ekegusii: Omonene akarora ng’a obobe bwa Mwanyabaanto bwabeire obonge ase ense, na kera okoroberia na okorengereria gwe chinkoro chiabo nokobe botambe.
swahili: Bwana akaona jinsi uovu wa mwanadamu ulivyokuwa mkubwa duniani, na ya kuwa kila mwelekeo wa mawazo ya moyo wake wakati wote ulikuwa mbaya tu.

english: And the LORD regretted that He had made man on the earth, and He was grieved in His heart.
ekegusii: Ase ayi’Omonene akairianyeka, ekiagera atongete Mwanyabaanto ase ense, agaichana ase omoyo oye.
swahili: Bwana akasikitika kwamba alimuumba mwanadamu duniani, moyo wa Mungu ukajaa masikitiko.

english: So the LORD said, “I will blot out man, whom I have created, from the face of the earth—every man and beast and crawling creature and bird of the air—for I am grieved that I have made them.” Noah’s Favor with God
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene agateeba: “Ninsirie Mwanyabaanto abwo natongete mbarusie ase ense, gose tari Mwanyabaanto boka, korende ne ching’iti, na ebitongwa bikwagura, ne chinyoni chia igoro. Neitirie ekiagera natongete abanto abwo na ching’iti echio.”
swahili: Kwa hiyo Bwana akasema, “Nitamfutilia mbali mwanadamu niliyemuumba kutoka kwenye uso wa dunia, wanadamu na wanyama, pamoja na viumbe vitambaavyo na ndege wa angani. Kwa maana nasikitika kuwaumba.”

english: Noah, however, found favor in the eyes of the LORD.
ekegusii: Korende Nuhu akanyora ogwancherwa ase obosio bw’Omonene. Nuhu
swahili: Lakini Noa akapata kibali machoni pa Bwana.

english: This is the account of Noah. Noah was a righteous man, blameless in his generation; Noah walked with God.
ekegusii: Oyo noro omooroberio bw’ororeeria rwa Nuhu. Ere nigo areenge omonyaboronge na omoikeranu ase ekiaare kiaye; ere akaba ogotaara amo na Nyasae.
swahili: Hivi ndivyo vizazi vya Noa. Noa alikuwa mtu wa haki, na mkamilifu miongoni mwa watu wa wakati wake, tena alitembea na Mungu.

english: Then the LORD said to Noah, “Go into the ark, you and all your family, because I have found you righteous in this generation.
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene agateebia Nuhu: “Soa ase obwato ime amo nabaanto bao, ekiagera buna nakorigereirie, narorire ng’a ase ekegori eke naye bweka ore omonyaboronge ase obosio bwaane.
swahili: Ndipo Bwana akamwambia Noa, “Ingia katika safina wewe na jamaa yako yote, kwa sababu katika kizazi hiki nimeona ya kuwa wewe ni mwenye haki.

english: And after seven days the floodwaters came upon the earth.
ekegusii: Erio magega y’amatuko atano na abere, etoigo egacha ase ense.
swahili: Baada ya siku saba, maji ya gharika yakaja juu ya dunia.

english: In the six hundredth year of Noah’s life, on the seventeenth day of the second month, all the fountains of the great deep burst forth, and the floodgates of the heavens were opened.
ekegusii: Ase omwaka oria ekero konya Nuhu aikire emiaka amagana atano na rimo (600), ase rituko ria ikomi, na gatano na kabere ri’omotienyi o kabere, chinsoko chionsi chi’amaache chikabera ne chinguru korwa inse, na ebibao bia igoro bikaigoka,
swahili: Katika siku ya kumi na saba ya mwezi wa pili mwaka wa 600 wa kuishi kwake Noa, siku hiyo ndipo chemchemi zote hata zilizo chini sana ya ardhi zilibubujika kwa nguvu, na malango ya mafuriko ya mbinguni yakafunguliwa.

english: And the rain fell upon the earth for forty days and forty nights.
ekegusii: na embura egatwa igoro ase ense, rioka rioka ase amatuko emerongo ene, omobaso na obotuko.
swahili: Mvua ikanyesha juu ya nchi siku arobaini usiku na mchana.

english: On that very day Noah entered the ark, along with his sons Shem, Ham, and Japheth, and his wife, and the three wives of his sons—
ekegusii: Ase rituko erio erio Nuhu agasoa ase obwato ime amo na Shemu, na Hamu, na Yafeti, bamura baye, na mokaye, na baka bamura baye batato.
swahili: Siku hiyo Noa, na mkewe, na wanawe Shemu, Hamu na Yafethi pamoja na wake zao wakaingia katika ile safina.

english: they and every kind of wild animal, livestock, crawling creature, bird, and winged creature.
ekegusii: Amo nabarabwo, chigasoa ching’iti chi’orosana echia kera egesaku, ne ching’iti chigotugwa echia kera egesaku, na echikwagura echia kera egesaku, na kera enyoni y’egesaku kende gionsi.
swahili: Nao walikuwa pamoja na kila mnyama wa mwituni kufuatana na aina yake, wanyama wote wafugwao kufuatana na aina zao, kila kiumbe kitambaacho juu ya ardhi kwa aina yake, na kila ndege kufuatana na aina yake, naam kila kiumbe chenye mabawa.

english: They came to Noah to enter the ark, two by two of every creature with the breath of life.
ekegusii: Na chirochio chionsi echiare moyo chigasoa ibere ibere ase obwato amo na Nuhu.
swahili: Viumbe vyote vyenye pumzi ya uhai ndani yake vikaja kwa Noa viwili viwili, vikaingia katika safina.

english: And they entered, the male and female of every living thing, as God had commanded Noah. Then the LORD shut him in.
ekegusii: Ching’iti ne chinyoni chionsi chiasoete, chinsacha ne chinkuungu chire moyo chia kera egesaku, chigasoa buna Nyasae achiigete Nuhu, eri’Omonene akamosiekera egesieri.
swahili: Wanyama walioingia katika safina walikuwa wa kiume na wa kike, wa kila kiumbe chenye uhai kama Mungu alivyomwamuru Noa, ndipo Bwana akamfungia ndani.

english: For forty days the flood kept coming on the earth, and the waters rose and lifted the ark high above the earth.
ekegusii: Etoigo eria ekagenderera igoro y’ense ase engaki y’amatuko emerongo ene, ekagera amaache akamentekana mono, erio agacheng’enenia obwato na koboimokereria igoro mono kegima korwa ase ense.
swahili: Kwa siku arobaini mafuriko yaliendelea kujaa duniani na maji yalivyozidi kuongezeka, yaliinua safina juu sana kutoka kwenye uso wa nchi.

english: So the waters continued to surge and rise greatly on the earth, and the ark floated on the surface of the waters.
ekegusii: Amache aria akaba nechinguru, na akamenteka mono igoro y’ense, na obwato boria bogacheng’enena ase amaache ayio igoro.
swahili: Maji yakajaa na kuongezeka sana juu ya nchi, na safina ikaelea juu ya uso wa maji.

english: Finally, the waters completely inundated the earth, so that all the high mountains under all the heavens were covered.
ekegusii: Amache ayio akagenderera komenteka mono na akaba nechinguru chinene, erio agoichora igoro ase ense goika ebitunwa bionsi ebitambe mono kegima, biareenge kera ase inse y’erioba, bikarimera amaache ime.
swahili: Maji yakazidi kujaa juu ya nchi, yakaifunika milima yote mirefu chini ya mbingu yote.

english: You are to take with you seven pairs of every kind of clean animal, a male and its mate; a pair of every kind of unclean animal, a male and its mate;
ekegusii: Ekero ogosoa, oirane amo naye ching’iti chichenegete, isano na ibere isano na ibere, chinsacha ne chinkuungu; na ase kera eng’iti etachenegeti, ibere ibere, ensacha na enkuungu.
swahili: Uchukue wanyama saba walio safi wa kila aina, wa kiume na wa kike, na wanyama wawili wawili wa kila aina walio najisi wa kiume na wa kike.

english: The waters rose and covered the mountaintops to a depth of fifteen cubits.
ekegusii: Amache ayio akamenteka rioka rioka agoichora, agatiira goika ebirengo bi’amaboko ikomi na atano igoro y’ebitunwa bionsi.
swahili: Maji yakaendelea kujaa yakaifunika milima kwa kina cha zaidi ya dhiraa kumi na tano.

english: And every living thing that moved upon the earth perished—birds, livestock, animals, every creature that swarms upon the earth, and all mankind.
