ekegusii: Ne ching’iti chiria ne chinyoni chionsi echiare moyo, chiare gotaara ase ense, chigakwa; chinyoni, ne ching’iti chiatugire, ne ching’iti chi’orosana, na echikwagura, amo na Mwanyabaanto bonsi bagakwa.
swahili: Kila kiumbe hai kitambaacho juu ya nchi kikaangamia: Ndege, wanyama wa kufugwa, wanyama pori, viumbe vyote juu ya nchi na wanadamu wote.

english: Of all that was on dry land, everything that had the breath of life in its nostrils died.
ekegusii: Ebitongire bionsi biare koeyanera chimioro na bire moyo, na bionsi ebiareenge ase ense enyomo bigakwa.
swahili: Kila kiumbe juu ya nchi kavu chenye pumzi ya uhai kikafa.

english: And every living thing on the face of the earth was destroyed—man and livestock, crawling creatures and birds of the air; they were blotted out from the earth, and only Noah and those with him in the ark remained.
ekegusii: Nyasae agasiria ebinto bionsi biare moyo, ebiareenge igoro ase ense, Mwanyabaanto ne ching’iti chigotaara na amoogoro, na echikwagura, ne chinyoni chia igoro; na bionsi bigasirigwa korwa ase ense engima; Korende Nuhu bweka agatoorigwa amo nabwo baareenge amo nere ase obwato ime.
swahili: Kila kitu chenye uhai juu ya uso wa nchi kilifutiliwa mbali, watu, wanyama, viumbe vitambaavyo na ndege warukao angani wakafutiliwa mbali toka duniani. Waliobaki ni Noa peke yake na wale waliokuwa pamoja naye ndani ya safina.

english: and seven pairs of every kind of bird of the air, male and female, to preserve their offspring on the face of all the earth.
ekegusii: Naende oirane ne chinyoni chikoiruruka, isano na ibere isano na ibere, chinsacha ne chinkuungu. Okore ayio ase engencho y’okorenda kera egesaku erio kegenderere koba moyo ase ense.
swahili: Pia uchukue ndege saba walio safi wa kila aina, wa kiume na wa kike, ili kuhifadhi aina zao mbalimbali katika dunia yote.

english: For seven days from now I will send rain on the earth for forty days and forty nights, and I will wipe from the face of the earth every living thing I have made.”
ekegusii: Magega y’amatuko atano na abere nindete embura ase ense etwe amatuko emerongo ene, omobaso na obotuko, na kende gionsi nakorete kere moyo ase ense ningesirie kegima.”
swahili: Siku saba kuanzia sasa nitaleta mvua juu ya nchi kwa siku arobaini usiku na mchana, nami nitafutilia mbali kutoka uso wa nchi kila kiumbe hai nilichokiumba.”

english: And Noah did all that the LORD had commanded him.
ekegusii: Na Nuhu agakora ayio onsi buna Omonene amochiigete.
swahili: Noa akafanya yote kama Bwana alivyomwamuru.

english: Now Noah was 600 years old when the floodwaters came upon the earth.
ekegusii: Nuhu konya okorire emiaka amagana atano na rimo (600) engaki eyio etoigo yachete ase ense.
swahili: Noa alikuwa na miaka 600 gharika ilipokuja juu ya dunia.

english: And Noah and his wife, with his sons and their wives, entered the ark to escape the waters of the flood.
ekegusii: Nuhu agasoa ase obwato ime amo nabana baye abamura, na mokaye, na baka bamura baye, ase ogwetooria korwa ase etoigo eria.
swahili: Noa na mkewe na wanawe na wake zao wakaingia katika safina ili waepuke ile gharika.

english: The clean and unclean animals, the birds, and everything that crawls along the ground
ekegusii: Na ase ching’iti chichenegete, ne ching’iti chitachenegeti, ne chinyoni na ebitongwa bionsi ebikwagura igoro ase ense,
swahili: Jozi ya wanyama walio safi na walio najisi, ndege na viumbe vitambaavyo,

english: came to Noah to enter the ark, two by two, male and female, as God had commanded Noah.
ekegusii: chigasoa ase obwato amo na Nuhu ibere ibere, chinsacha ne chinkuungu, buna Nyasae achiigete Nuhu.
swahili: wa kiume na wa kike, walikuja kwa Noa wakaingia katika safina kama Mungu alivyomwamuru Noa.

english: But God remembered Noah and all the animals and livestock that were with him in the ark. And God sent a wind over the earth, and the waters began to subside.
ekegusii: Nyasae akamoinyora Nuhu ne ching’iti chionsi, echi’orosana, na echiatugire, echiareenge amo nere ase obwato ime. Erio agwo Nyasae akagusia omwaga ase ense, na amaache aria agakea.
swahili: Mungu akamkumbuka Noa na wanyama wote wa porini na wa kufugwa waliokuwa naye ndani ya safina, akatuma upepo ukavuma katika dunia, nayo maji yakaondoka.

english: Noah waited seven more days and again sent out the dove from the ark.
ekegusii: Erio akaganya amatuko ande atano na abere, naende ase egeka giakabere, agatoma riruma riria korwa ase obwato.
swahili: Noa akangojea siku saba zaidi kisha akamtoa tena hua kutoka safina.

english: And behold, the dove returned to him in the evening with a freshly plucked olive leaf in her beak. So Noah knew that the waters had receded from the earth.
ekegusii: Riruma riria rikairana chinsa chia mogoroba, ribogoretie rito ribese ri’omozeituni ase omonwa oye. Ase ayio Nuhu akamanya ng’a amaache akeanire korwa ase ense.
swahili: Wakati hua aliporejea kwa Noa jioni, alikuwa amechukua katika mdomo wake jani bichi la mzeituni, lililochumwa wakati ule ule! Ndipo Noa akajua ya kuwa maji yameondoka juu ya uso wa dunia.

english: And Noah waited seven more days and sent out the dove again, but this time she did not return to him. Exiting the Ark
ekegusii: Naende akaganya amatuko ande atano na abere, agatoma riruma riria, korende rirorio tirichieti koirana asare naende.
swahili: Akangojea siku saba zaidi na akamtuma tena hua, lakini wakati huu hua hakurudi tena kwa Noa.

english: In Noah’s six hundred and first year, on the first day of the first month, the waters had dried up from the earth. So Noah removed the covering from the ark and saw that the surface of the ground was dry.
ekegusii: Ase omwaka bw’amagana atano na rimo, na oyomo (601), rituko rie ritangani ri’omotienyi bw’eritang’ani, amaache agakama kegima korwa ase ense. Nuhu akarusia ekerama ki’obwato, akarigereria, akarora ng’a ense yakamokire.
swahili: Katika siku ya kwanza ya mwezi wa kwanza ya mwaka 601, wa kuishi kwake Noa, maji yalikuwa yamekauka duniani. Kisha Noa akafungua mlango wa safina akaona ya kuwa uso wa ardhi ulikuwa umekauka.

english: By the twenty-seventh day of the second month, the earth was fully dry.
ekegusii: Rituko ri’emerongo ebere, na gatano na kabere ri’omotienyi o kabere, ense ekaba yakamokire kegima.
swahili: Katika siku ya ishirini na saba ya mwezi wa pili dunia ilikuwa imekauka kabisa.

english: Then God said to Noah,
ekegusii: Erio Nyasae agateebia Nuhu,
swahili: Ndipo Mungu akamwambia Noa,

english: “Come out of the ark, you and your wife, along with your sons and their wives.
ekegusii: “Soka korwa ase obwato, aye na mokao, na abana bao abamura, na abakungu babo.
swahili: “Toka ndani ya safina, wewe na mkeo na wanao na wake zao.

english: Bring out all the living creatures that are with you—birds, livestock, and everything that crawls upon the ground—so that they can spread out over the earth and be fruitful and multiply upon it.”
ekegusii: Osooke amo na kera egetongwa kere moyo amo naye: chinyoni, ne ching’iti chigotaara, na echikwagura igoro ase ense, erinde chibiare chimenteke, chiichore ase ense.”
swahili: Utoe nje kila aina ya kiumbe hai aliye pamoja nawe: Ndege, wanyama na viumbe vyote vitambaavyo juu ya ardhi, ili wakazae, na kuongezeka na kuijaza tena dunia.”

english: So Noah came out, along with his sons and his wife and his sons’ wives.
ekegusii: Erio Nuhu agasoka amo na bamura baye, na mokaye, na baka bamura baye.
swahili: Kwa hiyo Noa akatoka nje pamoja na mkewe, wanawe na wake zao.

english: Every living creature, every creeping thing, and every bird—everything that moves upon the earth—came out of the ark, kind by kind. Noah Builds an Altar
ekegusii: Na kera eng’iti, na kera eyekwagura, na kera enyoni, na ebitongwa binde bionsi bigotaara ase ense bigasoka amo noroiboro rwabo, korwa ase obwato. Nuhu okorua ekeng’wanso
swahili: Wanyama wote na viumbe vyote vitambaavyo juu ya ardhi na ndege wote, kila kitu kiendacho juu ya nchi, aina moja baada ya nyingine vikatoka katika safina, kila aina ya kiumbe, kimoja baada ya kingine. Noa Atoa Dhabihu

english: The springs of the deep and the floodgates of the heavens were closed, and the rain from the sky was restrained.
ekegusii: Chinsoko chia amaache chiare kobera korwa inse amo na ebibao bia igoro bigasiekwa, na embura yaare gotwa egasira,
swahili: Zile chemchemi zilizo chini sana ya ardhi pamoja na malango ya mafuriko ya mbinguni yakawa yamefungwa nayo mvua ikawa imekoma kunyesha kutoka angani.

english: Then Noah built an altar to the LORD. And taking from every kind of clean animal and clean bird, he offered burnt offerings on the altar.
ekegusii: Erio Nuhu akaagachera Omonene egesasiimero, akarusia eyemo ase kera eng’iti, na ase kera enyoni echenegete, agachirua buna ekeng’wanso ki’ogosaambwa igoro ase egesasiimero keria.
swahili: Kisha Noa akamjengea Bwana madhabahu, akachukua baadhi ya wale wanyama na ndege wote walio safi, akatoa sadaka za kuteketezwa juu ya madhabahu.

english: When the LORD smelled the pleasing aroma, He said in His heart, “Never again will I curse the ground because of man, even though every inclination of his heart is evil from his youth. And never again will I destroy all living creatures as I have done.
ekegusii: Na ekero Omonene aigwete rimisu rigiya rikomogwenera, agateeba ase omoyo oye ime: “Tinkoragereria ense naende nonya ng’ake ase engencho ya Mwanyabaanto, naki ebirengererio bie chinkoro chia Mwanyabaanto nebibe korwa obwana bwabo; nonya nebitongwa bionsi bire moyo tingocha kobisiria naende buna nakorete.
swahili: Bwana akasikia harufu nzuri ya kupendeza, naye akasema moyoni mwake, “Kamwe sitailaani tena ardhi kwa sababu ya mwanadamu, hata ingawa kila mwelekeo wa moyo wake ni mbaya tangu ujana. Kamwe sitaangamiza tena viumbe hai vyote kama nilivyofanya.

english: As long as the earth endures, seedtime and harvest, cold and heat, summer and winter, day and night shall never cease.”
ekegusii: Engaki ense egendererete kobao, nebe engaki y’ogosimeka na ey’okogesa, engaki y’obokendu na ey’omobaso omoororo, engaki y’etoigo na ey’egurugura, omobaso na obotuko, tichikoera nonya ng’ake.”
swahili: “Kwa muda dunia idumupo, wakati wa kupanda na wa kuvuna, wakati wa baridi na wa joto, wakati wa kiangazi na wa masika, usiku na mchana kamwe havitakoma.”

english: The waters receded steadily from the earth, and after 150 days the waters had gone down.
ekegusii: na amaache akana gokeea ng’ora ng’ora korwa ase ense, na ekero amatuko rigana erimo, na emerongo etano (150) aerete, amaache aria agakea.
swahili: Maji yakaendelea kupungua taratibu katika nchi. Kunako mwisho wa siku ya 150, maji yalikuwa yamepungua,

english: On the seventeenth day of the seventh month, the ark came to rest on the mountains of Ararat.
ekegusii: Ase igo, rituko ria ikomi na gatano na kabere, ri’omotienyi o gatano na kabere, obwato bogeeterekerera igoro ase egetunwa egetambe ki’Ararati.
swahili: katika siku ya kumi na saba ya mwezi wa saba, safina ikatua katika milima ya Ararati.

english: And the waters continued to recede until the tenth month, and on the first day of the tenth month the tops of the mountains became visible. Noah Sends a Raven and a Dove
ekegusii: Na amaache akagenderera gokea goika omotienyi o ikomi. Ase rituko rie ritang’ani ri’omotienyi o ikomi ebichuria bi’ebitunwa bikarorekana.
swahili: Maji yakaendelea kupungua hadi mwezi wa kumi, na siku ya kwanza ya mwezi wa kumi, vilele vya milima vikaonekana.

english: After forty days Noah opened the window he had made in the ark
ekegusii: Magega y’amatuko emerongo ene kaerire Nuhu akaigora ekebao keria akorete ase obwato,
swahili: Baada ya siku arobaini Noa akafungua dirisha alilokuwa amelifanya katika safina

english: and sent out a raven. It kept flying back and forth until the waters had dried up from the earth.
ekegusii: agatoma ekegonkoru, na kerokio gekairuruka gochia aaria na aaria goika amaache agakama korwa ase ense.
swahili: na akamtoa kunguru, akawa akiruka kwenda na kurudi mpaka maji yalipokwisha kukauka juu ya nchi.

english: Then Noah sent out a dove to see if the waters had receded from the surface of the ground.
ekegusii: Erio Nuhu agatoma riruma, egere arore gose amaache akamire korwa ase ense,
swahili: Kisha akamtoa hua ili aone kama maji yameondoka juu ya uso wa ardhi.

english: But the dove found no place to rest her foot, and she returned to him in the ark, because the waters were still covering the surface of all the earth. So he reached out his hand and brought her back inside the ark.
ekegusii: korende riruma riria tirianyora aase rikogwa, ase igo rikairana ase obwato, ekiagera amaache nao areenge igoro y’ense engima. Ase igo, Nuhu akarambora okoboko kwaye, akabwata riruma riria akarisoyia obwato ime ase areenge.
swahili: Lakini hua hakupata mahali pa kutua kwa kuwa maji yalienea juu ya uso wa dunia yote, kwa hiyo akarudi kwa Noa ndani ya safina. Noa akanyoosha mkono akamchukua yule hua akamrudisha ndani ya safina.

english: And God blessed Noah and his sons and said to them, “Be fruitful and multiply and fill the earth.
ekegusii: Nyasae agasesenia Nuhu amo nabamura baye, akabateebia: “Moibore, momeneteke, moichore ase ense.
swahili: Ndipo Mungu akambariki Noa na wanawe, akiwaambia, “Zaeni mkaongezeke kwa idadi na mkaijaze tena dunia.

english: and with every living creature that was with you—the birds, the livestock, and every beast of the earth—every living thing that came out of the ark.
ekegusii: naende na kera egetongwa kere moyo kere amo nainwe, chinyoni chionsi ne ching’iti chigotugwa, ne ching’iti chionsi chi’orosana echio chire amo nainwe, chionsi echiasokire korwa ase obwato ime.
swahili: pia na kila kiumbe hai kilichokuwa pamoja nanyi: Ndege, wanyama wa kufugwa na wanyama wote wa porini, wale wote waliotoka katika safina pamoja nanyi, kila kiumbe hai duniani.

english: And I establish My covenant with you: Never again will all life be cut off by the waters of a flood; never again will there be a flood to destroy the earth.”
ekegusii: Ngokora nde okobwatana kw’ogotianania nainwe, ng’a kende gionsi kere moyo tigekomerwa naende n’amaache y’etoigo, gose etoigo tegocha koba naende egosaria ense magega y’ayio.”
swahili: Ninaweka Agano nanyi: Kamwe uhai hautafutwa tena kwa gharika, kamwe haitakuwepo tena gharika ya kuangamiza dunia.”

english: And God said, “This is the sign of the covenant I am making between Me and you and every living creature with you, a covenant for all generations to come:
ekegusii: Naende Nyasae agateeba: “Eke nakio ekemanyererio gi’okobwatana kwane kw’ogotianania nakorire egati yane nainwe, na kera egetongwa kere moyo amo nainwe, na ase ebiaare bigochiagocha.”
swahili: Mungu akasema, “Hii ni ishara ya Agano ninalofanya kati yangu na ninyi na kila kiumbe hai kilicho pamoja nanyi, Agano kwa vizazi vyote vijavyo:

english: I have set My rainbow in the clouds, and it will be a sign of the covenant between Me and the earth.
ekegusii: Erio naende Nyasae agateeba: “Inche nabekire omokubinyongo one ase amare, noro nobe ekemanyererio gi’okobwatana oko egati yane na ense.
swahili: Nimeweka upinde wangu wa mvua mawinguni, nao utakuwa ishara ya Agano nifanyalo kati yangu na dunia.

english: Whenever I form clouds over the earth and the rainbow appears in the clouds,
ekegusii: Ekero nkwara amare igoro y’ense, na omokubinyongo nobe okororekana ase amare.
swahili: Wakati wowote ninapotanda mawingu juu ya dunia na upinde wa mvua ukijitokeza mawinguni,

english: I will remember My covenant between Me and you and every living creature of every kind. Never again will the waters become a flood to destroy all life.
ekegusii: Erio nimbe nkoinyora okobwatana kwane, okwo nakorire egati yane nainwe, amo na kera egetongwa kere moyo. Amache takoba naende etoigo egoita ebitongwa bionsi bire moyo.
swahili: nitakumbuka Agano langu kati yangu na ninyi na viumbe vyote vilivyo hai vya kila aina. Kamwe maji hayatakuwa tena gharika ya kuangamiza uhai wote.

english: And whenever the rainbow appears in the clouds, I will see it and remember the everlasting covenant between God and every living creature of every kind that is on the earth.”
ekegusii: Ekero omokubinyongo okoba ase amare, na inche nkoyorigereria, ning’inyore okobwatana kwane gwa kare na kare, okwo nakorire egati yane, buna inche Nyasae na kera egetongwa kere moyo ase ense.”
swahili: Wakati wowote upinde wa mvua unapotokea mawinguni, nitauona na kukumbuka Agano la milele kati ya Mungu na viumbe vyote vilivyo hai vya kila aina duniani.”

english: So God said to Noah, “This is the sign of the covenant that I have established between Me and every creature on the earth.” Noah’s Shame and Canaan’s Curse
ekegusii: Nyasae agateebia Nuhu: “Eke nakio ekemanyererio gi’okobwatana okwo nakorire egati yane na ebitongwa bionsi bire moyo ase ense.” Abana ba Nuhu
swahili: Hivyo Mungu akamwambia Noa, “Hii ndiyo ishara ya Agano ambalo nimelifanya kati yangu na viumbe vyote vilivyo hai duniani.” Wana Wa Noa

english: The sons of Noah who came out of the ark were Shem, Ham, and Japheth. And Ham was the father of Canaan.
ekegusii: Abana ba Nuhu abarwete ase obwato nabwo aba: Shemu, na Hamu, na Yafeti. Hamu nere ise Kaanani.
swahili: Wana wa Noa waliotoka ndani ya safina ni: Shemu, Hamu na Yafethi. (Hamu ndiye alikuwa baba wa Kanaani.)

english: These three were the sons of Noah, and from them the whole earth was populated.
ekegusii: Aba batato nabwo baareenge abana ba Nuhu, na korwa ase abwo Mwanyabaanto bakaranda ase ense engima.
swahili: Hawa ndio waliokuwa wana watatu wa Noa, kutokana nao watu walienea katika dunia.

english: The fear and dread of you will fall on every living creature on the earth, every bird of the air, every creature that crawls on the ground, and all the fish of the sea. They are delivered into your hand.
ekegusii: Ching’iti chionsi chire ase ense chibooboe na kobairoka inwe; chinyoni chia igoro, ne ching’iti chikwagura igoro ase ense, ne chinswe chionsi chi’enyancha; echio chionsi chiabekirwe ase amaboko aino.”
swahili: Wanyama wote wa duniani, ndege wote wa angani, kila kiumbe kitambaacho juu ya ardhi, na samaki wote wa baharini wamekabidhiwa mikononi mwenu, nao watawaogopa na kuwahofu.

english: Now Noah, a man of the soil, proceeded to plant a vineyard.
ekegusii: Nuhu akaba omoremi, akaba oyo bw’eritang’ani gosimeka emesabibu, nero ekoroisigwa edivai.
swahili: Noa akawa mkulima, akawa mtu wa kwanza kupanda mizabibu.

english: But when he drank some of its wine, he became drunk and uncovered himself inside his tent.
ekegusii: Ere akanywa edivai; erio agatinda, akaraara ore getirianda ase eema yaye ime.
swahili: Alipokunywa huo mvinyo wake akalewa na akalala uchi kwenye hema lake.

english: And Ham, the father of Canaan, saw his father’s nakedness and told his two brothers outside.
ekegusii: Hamu, ise Kaanani, akamorora ore getirianda, agateebia bamura bamwabo babere baareenge isiko amang’ana aya arooche.
swahili: Hamu, baba wa Kanaani, akauona uchi wa baba yake na kuwaeleza ndugu zake wawili waliokuwa nje.

english: Then Shem and Japheth took a garment and placed it across their shoulders, and walking backward, they covered their father’s nakedness. Their faces were turned away so that they did not see their father’s nakedness.
ekegusii: Erio Shemu na Yafeti bakabogoria engobo, bakayebeeka amareko abo igoro, bakagenda kemagega‐magega, bakabisia ise obogetirianda bwaye. Amaiso abo nigo arigereretie aase bakorwa, na tibarora obogetirianda bwa ise.
swahili: Lakini Shemu na Yafethi wakachukua nguo wakaitanda mabegani mwao wote wawili, kisha wakaenda kinyumenyume, wakaufunika uchi wa baba yao. Nyuso zao zilielekea upande mwingine ili wasiuone uchi wa baba yao.

english: When Noah awoke from his drunkenness and learned what his youngest son had done to him,
ekegusii: Ekero Nuhu atindokire korwa ase okonywa kwaye kw’edivai, akamanya eke omwana oye omoke amokoreire,
swahili: Noa alipolevuka kutoka kwenye mvinyo wake na kujua lile ambalo mwanawe mdogo kuliko wote alilokuwa amemtendea,

english: he said, “Cursed be Canaan! A servant of servants shall he be to his brothers.” Shem’s Blessing and Noah’s Death
ekegusii: agateeba, “Kaanani aragererigwe; nigo arabe omosomba bw’abasomba ase abamwabo.”
swahili: akasema, “Alaaniwe Kanaani! Atakuwa mtumwa wa chini sana kuliko watumwa wote kwa ndugu zake.”

english: He also declared: “Blessed be the LORD, the God of Shem! May Canaan be the servant of Shem.
ekegusii: Naende agateeba, “Omonene, Nyasae o Shemu, nasesenigwe, na Kaanani abe omosomba oye.
swahili: Pia akasema, “Abarikiwe Bwana, Mungu wa Shemu! Kanaani na awe mtumwa wa Shemu.

english: May God expand the territory of Japheth; may he dwell in the tents of Shem, and may Canaan be his servant.”
ekegusii: Nyasae amentere Yafeti obomenyo, tiga amenye ase chiema chia Shemu, na Kaanani abe omosomba oye.”
swahili: Mungu na apanue mipaka ya Yafethi; Yafethi na aishi katika mahema ya Shemu, na Kanaani na awe mtumwa wake.”

english: After the flood, Noah lived 350 years.
ekegusii: Magega y’etoigo eria Nuhu akamenya naende emiaka amagana atato, na emerongo etano (350).
swahili: Baada ya gharika Noa aliishi miaka 350.

english: So Noah lived a total of 950 years, and then he died.
ekegusii: Nuhu nigo akoorete emiaka amagana kianda, na emerongo etano (950), erio agakwa.
swahili: Noa alikuwa na jumla ya miaka 950, ndipo akafa.

english: Everything that lives and moves will be food for you; just as I gave you the green plants, I now give you all things.
ekegusii: Kera egetongwa kere moyo na gekwagura inakebe endagera yaino; buna nabaete chinyeni na ebimeri binde bigokina, naboigo nabaeire nebio bionsi.
swahili: Kila kitu chenye uhai kiendacho kitakuwa chakula chenu. Kama vile nilivyowapa mimea mbalimbali, sasa nawapa kila kitu.

english: But you must not eat meat with its lifeblood still in it.
ekegusii: Korende timoria chinyama chire nobomoyo, engencho yaye echire namanyinga ime yabo.
swahili: “Lakini kamwe msile nyama ambayo bado ina damu ya uhai wake, kwa maana damu ni uhai.

english: And surely I will require the life of any man or beast by whose hand your lifeblood is shed. I will demand an accounting from anyone who takes the life of his fellow man:
ekegusii: Amaene, amanyinga y’obogima bwaino ninyaganie ’nyaakanwe; korwa ase kera eng’iti ninyaganie, na korwa ase kera omonto oyogoita oyomwabo ninyaganie ’nyaakanwe obogima bw’omonto oyio.
swahili: Hakika damu ya uhai wenu nitaidai. Nitaidai kutoka kwa kila mnyama. Kutoka kwa kila mwanadamu pia nitaidai kwa ajili ya uhai wa mtu mwenzake.

english: Whoever sheds the blood of man, by man his blood will be shed; for in His own image God has made mankind.
ekegusii: Onde bwensi oraitere amanyinga a Mwanyabaanto, amanyinga y’omonto oyio neere naiterwe na Mwanyabaanto, ekiagera Nyasae nigo atongete Mwanyabaanto ase omobwekano oye ere omonyene.
swahili: “Yeyote amwagaye damu ya mwanadamu, damu yake itamwagwa na mwanadamu, kwa kuwa katika mfano wa Mungu, Mungu alimuumba mwanadamu.

english: But as for you, be fruitful and multiply; spread out across the earth and multiply upon it.”
ekegusii: Nyasae agateeba: “Na inwe moibore, momenteke, mosaraare, na mobe abange ime ase ense.”
swahili: Kuhusu ninyi, zaeni mwongezeke kwa wingi, mzidi katika dunia na kuijaza.”

english: Then God said to Noah and his sons with him,
ekegusii: Erio naende Nyasae agateebia Nuhu amo nabamura baye,
swahili: Ndipo Mungu akamwambia Noa na wanawe pamoja naye:

english: “Behold, I now establish My covenant with you and your descendants after you,
ekegusii: “Rora, inche ngokora nde okobwatana kw’ogotianania nainwe, amo na ororeeria rwaino roraiborwe korwa magega yaino;
swahili: “Sasa mimi ninaweka Agano langu nanyi, pamoja na uzao wenu baada yenu,

english: This is the burden that Habakkuk the prophet received in a vision:
ekegusii: Aya naro amang’ana amakong’u omobani Habakuki aroche ase okorora. Habakuki okorera, ekiagera oboronge tiboiyo
swahili: Neno alilopokea nabii Habakuki. Lalamiko La Habakuki

english: They scoff at kings and make rulers an object of scorn. They laugh at every fortress and build up siege ramps to seize it.
ekegusii: Nigo bagochecheria abarwoti, na gosekerera abagaambi. Nigo bagochaaya kera eburi enkong’u, baagacha chiburi chiabo, babua bachiira.
swahili: Wanawabeza wafalme, na kuwadhihaki watawala. Wanaicheka miji yote iliyozungushiwa maboma; wanafanya malundo ya udongo na kuiteka hiyo miji.

english: Then they sweep by like the wind and pass on through. They are guilty; their own strength is their god.” Habakkuk’s Second Complaint (Psalms 11:1–7)
ekegusii: Erio baeta bwango buna omwaga, bagenderera gochia bosio; abanto abwo bare abamochi, ne chinguru chiabo nachio enyasae yabo.” Habakuki okorera ase Omonene naende
swahili: Kisha wanapita kasi kama upepo na kusonga mbele: watu wenye hatia, ambao nguvu zao ndio mungu wao.” Lalamiko La Pili La Habakuki

english: Are You not from everlasting, O LORD, my God, my Holy One? We will not die. O LORD, You have appointed them to execute judgment; O Rock, You have established them for correction.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, Nyasae one, Omochenu one, tari aye oreo korwa kare na kare? Ase ayio titogokwa. Aye Omonene, egetare giaito, aye kwabachikiire batogambie ekiina, kwababekire batoe egesusuro ki’ogotorongeyia.
swahili: Ee Bwana, je, wewe sio wa tangu milele? Mungu wangu, Uliye Mtakatifu wangu, hatutakufa. Ee Bwana, umewachagua wao ili watekeleze hukumu; Ee Mwamba, umewaamuru watuadhibu.

english: Your eyes are too pure to look upon evil, and You cannot tolerate wrongdoing. So why do You tolerate the faithless? Why are You silent while the wicked swallow up those more righteous than themselves?
ekegusii: Aye ore namaiso amaachenu mono atari korigereria amabe na aya atari ay’oboronge, naki orakore oremererie korora abanto batari abegenwa, na okire‐kiri ekero abakori amabe bagosiria abare abanyaboronge kobabua?
swahili: Macho yako ni safi mno hata yasiweze kuutazama uovu, wala huwezi kuvumilia makosa. Kwa nini basi unawavumilia wadanganyifu? Kwa nini unakuwa kimya wakati waovu wanawameza wale wenye haki kuliko wao wenyewe?

english: You have made men like the fish of the sea, like creeping things that have no ruler.
ekegusii: Aye gwakorire abanto babe buna chinswe chi’enyancha, na buna ebitongwa bikwagura bitabwati omogambi obo.
swahili: Umewafanya watu kama samaki baharini, kama viumbe wa bahari wasio na mtawala.

english: The foe pulls all of them up with a hook; he catches them in his dragnet, and gathers them in his fishing net; so he rejoices gladly.
ekegusii: Barabwo nigo bakobabwata nebigobanio biabo baabakurura nekeonga kiabo na kobasangereria ase ekeonga kiabo bakorubera; erio bagoka na gochenga.
swahili: Adui mwovu anawavuta wote kwa ndoana, anawakamata katika wavu wake, anawakusanya katika juya lake; kwa hiyo anashangilia na anafurahi.

english: Therefore he sacrifices to his dragnet and burns incense to his fishing net, for by these things his portion is sumptuous and his food is rich.
ekegusii: Ase ayio nigo bakorua ebing’wanso ase ekeonga kiabo na kogesambera ubani, ekiagera ebinto ebio nabio bikobanyorera ebinoru na endagera enyinge.
swahili: Kwa hiyo anatoa kafara kwa wavu wake, na kuchoma uvumba kwa juya lake, kwa kuwa kwa wavu wake anaishi kwa starehe, na anafurahia chakula kizuri.

english: Will he, therefore, empty his net and continue to slay nations without mercy?
ekegusii: Inee! Abwo nigo bagochia konakorusia abanto b’ebisaku ase ekeonga kiabo baabasirie batari namaabera?
swahili: Je, aendelee kuwatoa walio katika wavu wake, akiangamiza mataifa bila huruma?

english: How long, O LORD, must I call for help but You do not hear, or cry out to You, “Violence!” but You do not save?
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ngoika ririri ndabe nkorera ng’a onkonye, naye tori konyigwa? Gose ngoika ririri ndabe ngokorangeria ase engencho y’obotindi, naye tori gontooria?
swahili: Ee Bwana, hata lini nitakuomba msaada, lakini wewe husikilizi? Au kukulilia, “Udhalimu!” Lakini hutaki kuokoa?

english: Why do You make me see iniquity? Why do You tolerate wrongdoing? Destruction and violence are before me. Strife is ongoing, and conflict abounds.
ekegusii: Naki gwantigire narorire amabe buna aya? Naki ondigereretie ing’etananire nemechando? Ogosirigwa na ogokorerwa bobe nigo bire ase obosio bwane; amariomana na ogotaigwana nigo bireo.
swahili: Kwa nini unanifanya nitazame dhuluma? Kwa nini unavumilia makosa? Uharibifu na udhalimu viko mbele yangu; kuna mabishano na mapambano kwa wingi.

english: Therefore the law is paralyzed, and justice never goes forth. For the wicked hem in the righteous, so that justice is perverted. The LORD’s Answer
ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio amachiiko tari ne chinguru, na oboronge tibori gokorwa. Abakori amabe nigo baetanaine abanyaboronge, na ebiina nigo bikonachwa bobe. Omonene okoiraneria Habakuki
swahili: Kwa hiyo sheria imepotoshwa, nayo haki haipo kabisa. Waovu wanawazunguka wenye haki, kwa hiyo haki imepotoshwa. Jibu La Bwana

english: “Look at the nations and observe— be utterly astounded! For I am doing a work in your days that you would never believe even if someone told you.
ekegusii: “Rigereria morore ayare ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku, mokumie na goichanigwa. Ngochia gokora inde ring’ana ase amatuko aino, eri motegene moise koriteebigwa.
swahili: “Yatazame mataifa, uangalie na ushangae kabisa. Kwa sababu katika siku zako nitafanya kitu ambacho hungeamini, hata kama ungeambiwa.

english: For behold, I am raising up the Chaldeans — that ruthless and impetuous nation which marches through the breadth of the earth to seize dwellings not their own.
ekegusii: Naama! Nindete Abakalidayo, egesaku keria kere egetindi, naende kere ne chinkoro chigwoka, kegoeta ase chinse chionsi kemenye ase obomenyo botari obwabo.
swahili: Nitawainua Wakaldayo, watu hao wakatili na wenye haraka, ambao hupita dunia yote kuteka mahali pa kuishi pasipo pao wenyewe.

english: They are dreaded and feared; from themselves they derive justice and sovereignty.
ekegusii: Barabwo nabaanto bakoondokia na kwoboyia; oboronge bwabo na okobua kwabo nigo bikorwa ase barabwo abanyene.
swahili: Ni watu wanoogopwa na wanaotisha; wenyewe ndio sheria yao, na huinua heshima yao wenyewe.

english: Their horses are swifter than leopards, fiercer than wolves of the night. Their horsemen charge ahead, and their cavalry comes from afar. They fly like a vulture, swooping down to devour.
ekegusii: “Chibarasi chiabo nigo chikominyoka bwango kobua chingo, nigo chire chintindi kobua chisese chi’orosana chigotwara mogoroba; abariini babo be chibarasi nigo bagochararacharara. Ee, abariini babo be chibarasi nigo bakorwa aare, nigo bakoiruruka buna ekeongo kegochia kobwata eke gekoria.
swahili: Farasi wao ni wepesi kuliko chui, na wakali kuliko mbwa mwitu wakati wa machweo. Askari wapanda farasi wao huenda mbio; waendesha farasi wao wanatoka mbali. Wanaruka kasi kama tai ili kurarua;

english: All of them come bent on violence; their hordes advance like the east wind; they gather prisoners like sand.
ekegusii: “Abanto abwo bonsi nigo bagocha gokora ay’obotindi. Nigo bakorigereria gochia bosio bare nomokia buna omwaga okorwa moocha; nigo bagosangereria abasibwa abange buna omokenye.
swahili: wote wanakuja tayari kwa fujo. Makundi yao ya wajeuri yanasonga mbele kama upepo wa jangwani, na kukusanya wafungwa kama mchanga.

english: I will stand at my guard post and station myself on the ramparts. I will watch to see what He will say to me, and how I should answer when corrected.
ekegusii: Inche nintenene korenda, ee, nintenene igoro ase omoorobiri bw’ogotengera, ndore ay’Omonene aranteebie, na buna ndairanerie igoro y’okorera kwane.
swahili: Nitasimama katika zamu yangu, na kujiweka mwenyewe juu ya maboma; nitatazama nione atakaloniambia, na ni jibu gani nitakalotoa kuhusu lalamiko hili. Jibu La Bwana

english: You have plotted shame for your house by cutting off many peoples and forfeiting your life.
ekegusii: Aye kwarenteire enyomba yao obosooku ase ogoita abanto abange, na igo gwakorire ebibe bi’ogosiria obogima bwao aye omonyene.
swahili: Umefanya shauri la maangamizi ya watu wengi, ukiaibisha nyumba yako mwenyewe, na kupotewa na maisha yako.

english: For the stones will cry out from the wall, and the rafters will echo it from the woodwork.
ekegusii: Amagena ’enyasi naake eriogi na emiamba ye rirongo neyairanerie.
swahili: Mawe ya kuta yatapiga kelele, na mihimili ya kazi ya mbao itarudisha mwangwi wake.

english: Woe to him who builds a city with bloodshed and establishes a town by iniquity!
ekegusii: Obobe nobw’omonto oyio okoagacha omochie ase ogoitera amanyinga na kobeeka oboroso bw’omochie ase ogokora ebibe.
swahili: “Ole wake yeye ajengaye mji kwa kumwaga damu na kuusimamisha mji kwa uhalifu!

english: Is it not indeed from the LORD of Hosts that the labor of the people only feeds the fire, and the nations weary themselves in vain?
ekegusii: Abanto nigo bakwerosia gokora emeremo eyio erasambwe nomorero, na abanto b’ebisaku nigo bakwerosia gokora emeremo ere bosa. Rora, ayio nigo arure ase Nyasae bw’Emeganda.
swahili: Je, Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote hakuonyesha kwamba kazi ya wanadamu ni mafuta tu kwa ajili ya moto, na kwamba mataifa yanajichosha bure?

english: For the earth will be filled with the knowledge of the glory of the LORD as the waters cover the sea.
ekegusii: Ense neichorigwe nokomanya kw’obonene o Omonene buna chinyancha chiichire namaache.
swahili: Kwa kuwa dunia itajazwa na maarifa ya utukufu wa Bwana, kama maji yaifunikavyo bahari.

english: Woe to him who gives drink to his neighbors, pouring it from the wineskin until they are drunk, in order to gaze at their nakedness!
ekegusii: Obobe nobw’omonto oria okoa omonto onde ekenyugwa giochoganirie nobosongo kiamotindia, erinde anyare korigereria obogetirianda bwaye.
swahili: “Ole wake yeye awapaye jirani zake kileo, akiimimina kutoka kwenye kiriba cha mvinyo mpaka wamelewa, ili apate kutazama miili yao iliyo uchi.

english: You will be filled with shame instead of glory. You too must drink and expose your uncircumcision! The cup in the LORD’s right hand will come around to you, and utter disgrace will cover your glory.
ekegusii: Aye nigo gwaichoirwe nobosooku ribaga ri’ogosikwa. Aye kanywe, obe omonto otarogeti! Egekombe ki’egesusuro kere ase okoboko gw’okorio kw’Omonene nakegochere; na oboosoku mbotube obonene bwao.
swahili: Utajazwa na aibu badala ya utukufu. Sasa ni zamu yako! Kunywa na ujifunue! Kikombe kutoka kwenye mkono wa kuume wa Bwana kinakujia, na aibu itafunika utukufu wako.

english: For your violence against Lebanon will overwhelm you, and the destruction of animals will terrify you, because of your bloodshed against men and your violence against the land, the city, and all their dwellers.
ekegusii: Obobe bwakoretwe ase Lebanoni mbogotube, na ogosirigwa gwe ching’iti koria gwachiondogetie; aye noegwe egesusuro, ekiagera gwaiterete amanyinga ’abaanto, na ogakora amabe ase ense, na ase emechie, na ase abanto bamenyeteo.
swahili: Ukatili ulioifanyia Lebanoni utakufunika, na uharibifu uliowafanyia wanyama utakutisha. Kwa sababu umemwaga damu ya mtu; umeharibu nchi na miji na kila mmoja aliyeko ndani yake.

english: What use is an idol, that a craftsman should carve it— or an image, a teacher of lies? For its maker trusts in his own creation; he makes idols that cannot speak.
ekegusii: Omogwekano bw’ogosasimwa, mbitoki ki okorentera oyio okoyobomba? Oyio nomogwekano obombire ore omworokia omong’ainereria? Oyio oyoroisetie nigo asemeretie emeremo y’amaboko aye ere chinyasae chitari gokwana.
swahili: “Sanamu ina thamani gani, kwani mwanadamu ndiye alichonga? Ama kinyago kinachofundisha uongo? Kwa kuwa yeye aliyekitengeneza hutegemea kazi ya mikono yake mwenyewe; hutengeneza sanamu zisizoweza kuzungumza.

english: Woe to him who says to wood, ‘Awake!’ or to silent stone, ‘Arise!’ Can it give guidance? Behold, it is overlaid with gold and silver, yet there is no breath in it at all.”
ekegusii: Obobe nobwaye omonto oria ogoteebia egento kebaachire korwa ase omote: Boka! Na oteebia rigena ritanyare gokwana: Imoka! Inee! Ebinto ebio mbinyare gokworokereria enchera? Rora, ebio nigo bioomire ne chitaabu ne chifeta, korende omoika tori ime yabo.
swahili: Ole wake yeye auambiaye mti, ‘Uwe hai!’ Ama asemaye na jiwe lisilo na uhai, ‘Amka!’ Je, linaweza kuongoza? Limefunikwa kwa dhahabu na fedha; hakuna pumzi ndani yake.

english: Then the LORD answered me: “Write down this vision and clearly inscribe it on tablets, so that a herald may run with it.
ekegusii: Omonene akang’iraneria, aganteebia, “Riika okorora okwo ase ebao namariko amaya, erinde oyo okoyasoma ayasome buya.
swahili: Kisha Bwana akajibu: “Andika ufunuo huu, na ukaufanye wazi juu ya vibao, ili mpiga mbiu akimbie nao.

english: But the LORD is in His holy temple; let all the earth be silent before Him.
ekegusii: “Korende Omonene nao are ase Hekalu yaye Enchenu; tiga ense yonsi ekire‐kiri ase obosio bwaye.”
swahili: Lakini Bwana yuko katika Hekalu lake takatifu; dunia yote na inyamaze mbele yake.”

english: For the vision awaits an appointed time; it testifies of the end and does not lie. Though it lingers, wait for it, since it will surely come and will not delay.
ekegusii: Okorora okwo nigo koganyete engaki yaye eike. Nigo gokoayerera goikerane, tigokomocha goikerana. Nonya gokororekana ng’a gwatebanire, ekeene goika goikerane, tikogoteebana.
swahili: Kwa kuwa ufunuo huu unasubiri wakati uliokubalika; unazungumzia mambo ya mwisho, na kamwe hautakosea. Iwapo utakawia, wewe usubiri; kwa hakika utakuja na hautachelewa.

english: Look at the proud one; his soul is not upright — but the righteous will live by faith —
ekegusii: Rora, oyo okweimokereria igoro, omoyo oye tori omooronge, korende omonyene oboronge nabe moyo goetera ase okwegena kwaye. Okogambigwa kw’abatari abanyaboronge
swahili: “Tazama, amejaa majivuno; anavyovitamani si vya unyofu: lakini mwenye haki ataishi kwa imani yake:

english: and wealth indeed betrays him. He is an arrogant man never at rest. He enlarges his appetite like Sheol, and like Death, he is never satisfied. He gathers all the nations to himself and collects all the peoples as his own. Woe to the Chaldeans
ekegusii: “Edivai nigo ere buna omoonchoreria omong’ainereria; omonto omwerori tari kogenderera koba n’obotoereru. Okogania kwaye nigo gokogarea kwaba buna aase abakuure; nigo konga buna amakweri atari goisaneka. Nigo agosangereria abanto b’ebisaku bionsi gocha asare na gokora abanto b’echinse chionsi koba abaye.”
swahili: hakika mvinyo humsaliti; ni mwenye kiburi na hana amani. Kwa sababu ni mlafi kama kuzimu na kama kifo kamwe hatosheki; anajikusanyia mataifa yote na kuchukua watu wote mateka.

english: Will not all of these take up a taunt against him, speaking with mockery and derision: ‘Woe to him who amasses what is not his and makes himself rich with many loans! How long will this go on?’
ekegusii: Abanto aba bonsi nigo baramokorere echeche baroisie engero y’okomochecheria bateebe, “Obobe nobwaye oyo‐gosangereria amo ebinto bitari ebiaye, na bwetweka ebinto airete bibe ntenenera. Ngoika ririri aragenderere gokora igo?”
swahili: “Je, watu wote hawatamsuta kwa dhihaka na kumbeza, wakisema, “ ‘Ole wake yeye akusanyaye bidhaa zilizoibwa na kujifanyia utajiri kwa kutoza kwa nguvu! Ataendelea hivi kwa muda gani?’

english: Will not your creditors suddenly arise and those who disturb you awaken? Then you will become their prey.
ekegusii: Inee! Abanto baria kwairete ebinto biabo tibakogochera mobosokano, na bagochande, bakobwate bakoire ase obosomba.
swahili: Je, wadai wako hawatainuka ghafula? Je, hawataamka na kukufanya utetemeke? Kisha utakuwa mhanga kwao.

english: Because you have plundered many nations, the remnant of the people will plunder you— because of your bloodshed against man and your violence against the land, the city, and all their dwellers.
ekegusii: Ekiagera aye gwasakoire ebisaku ebinge, abanto b’ebisaku ebitigari mbagosakore aye; gwaiteire amanyinga ’abaanto abange, na ogakora ayare amabe ase ense na ase emechie, na ase bonsi abamenyeteo.
swahili: Kwa kuwa umeteka nyara mataifa mengi, watu waliobaki watakuteka nyara wewe. Kwa kuwa umemwaga damu ya mtu; umeharibu nchi na miji, na kila mmoja ndani yake.

english: Woe to him who builds his house by unjust gain, to place his nest on high and escape the hand of disaster!
ekegusii: Obobe nobwaye omonto oria okonyora ebitoki bi’obobe na kobirenta ase enyomba yaye, erinde bweagachera egeswa kiaye aase aimokererete igoro ng’a abe noborendi korwa ase okobua kw’amabe.
swahili: “Ole wake yeye ajengaye milki yake kwa mapato ya udhalimu, awekaye kiota chake juu, ili kukimbia makucha ya uharibifu!

english: This is a prayer of Habakkuk the prophet, according to Shigionoth:
ekegusii: Oko nogosaba kw’omobani Habakuki.
swahili: Sala ya nabii Habakuki iliyoimbwa kwa shigionothi.

english: The mountains saw You and quaked; torrents of water swept by. The deep roared with its voice and lifted its hands on high.
ekegusii: Ebitunwa nigo biakorooche, bikanyegerigwa, amaache e chiooro agaeta; chindiba chigaaka amariogi, chikaimokia amaboko abo gochia igoro.
swahili: milima ilikuona ikatetemeka. Mafuriko ya maji yakapita huko; vilindi vilinguruma na kuinua mawimbi yake juu.

english: Sun and moon stood still in their places at the flash of Your flying arrows, at the brightness of Your shining spear.
ekegusii: Ekero emegwe yao yarenge korunda na komesa, ne ritimo riao riarenge komekameka, na erioba na omotienyi bigatenena aase abo.
swahili: Jua na mwezi vilisimama kimya mbinguni katika mngʼao wa mishale yako inayoruka, na katika mngʼao wa mkuki wako umeremetao.

english: You marched across the earth with fury; You threshed the nations in wrath.
ekegusii: Aye nigo gwaetete ase ense kore nekeririanda, okamionogorera abanto b’ebisaku inse kore nendamwamu.
swahili: Kwa ghadhabu ulipita juu ya dunia, na katika hasira ulikanyaga mataifa.

english: You went forth for the salvation of Your people, to save Your anointed. You crushed the head of the house of the wicked and stripped him from head to toe. Selah
ekegusii: Aye nigo gwasogete ase ogotooria abanto bao, ee, okarentera omoakwa amaguta oo ogotooreka. Nigo gwasenyentete ekerama ki’enyomba y’omokori amabe, okayetagora korwa ase oboroso goika ase egechuria.
swahili: Ulikuja kuwaokoa watu wako, kumwokoa uliyemtia mafuta. Ulimponda kiongozi wa nchi ya uovu, ukamvua toka kichwani hadi wayo.

english: With his own spear You pierced his head, when his warriors stormed out to scatter us, gloating as though ready to secretly devour the weak.
ekegusii: Aye nigo kwabeetete emetwe y’abasikari babo namatimo abo abanyene, ekero batocherete buna ekembugumbugu kegocha gotoserebania bare nomochengo gotosiria buna abataka bagosirigwa bobisi.
swahili: Kwa mkuki wake mwenyewe ulitoboa kichwa chake wakati mashujaa wake walifurika nje kwa kishindo kututawanya, wakifurahi kama walio karibu kutafuna wale wanyonge waliokuwa mafichoni.

english: You trampled the sea with Your horses, churning the great waters.
ekegusii: Nigo gwaetete ase enyancha ne chibarasi chiao, ogaetera ase emerindo yarenge koeera ne chinguru.
swahili: Ulikanyaga bahari kwa farasi wako, ukisukasuka maji makuu.

english: I heard and trembled within; my lips quivered at the sound. Decay entered my bones; I trembled where I stood. Yet I must wait patiently for the day of distress to come upon the people who invade us. Habakkuk Rejoices
ekegusii: Ekero naigwete amang’ana ayio, enda yane egatengechigwa, ebikoba biane bikaiguswa ekero naigwete okoeera okwo, amauga ’omobere one akarwara na kogunda, ngatengechigwa aase nateneine. Nimbe ndemereretie ase rituko riria ri’emechando, ekero omobisa arache korwania egesaku giaito.
swahili: Nilisikia na moyo wangu ukagonga kwa nguvu, midomo yangu ikatetemeka kwa hofu niliposikia sauti; uchakavu ukanyemelea mifupa yangu, na miguu yangu ikatetemeka. Hata hivyo nitasubiri kwa uvumilivu siku ya maafa kuyajilia mataifa yaliyotuvamia.

english: Though the fig tree does not bud and no fruit is on the vines, though the olive crop fails and the fields produce no food, though the sheep are cut off from the fold and no cattle are in the stalls,
ekegusii: Emeko tegosicha, na emesabibu tekwama; emezeituni nigo erabe bosa tiyama, na emegondo tekwama chindagera. Amaicho e ching’ondi nasirigwe korwa ase ameri, na amaicho e chiombe takobao.
swahili: Ingawa mtini hauchanui maua na hakuna zabibu juu ya mizabibu, ingawaje mzeituni hauzai, na hata mashamba hayatoi chakula, iwapo hakuna kondoo katika banda, wala ngʼombe katika zizi,

english: yet I will exult in the LORD; I will rejoice in the God of my salvation!
ekegusii: Nonya naboigo ningokere Omonene, ninchengere Nyasae ore ogotooreka kwane.
swahili: hata hivyo nitashangilia katika Bwana, nitamfurahia Mungu Mwokozi wangu.

english: GOD the Lord is my strength; He makes my feet like those of a deer; He makes me walk upon the heights! For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments.
ekegusii: Nyasae oyore Omonene, nere chinguru chiane; nigo agokora amagoro aane abe amaango buna ay’ensune, nigo agontaaria ase ebitunwa biane igoro. Ase omoteria. Ogoteera kogoterwa ase okobugigwa kw’amakano aane.
swahili: Bwana Mwenyezi ni nguvu yangu; huifanya miguu yangu kama miguu ya ayala, huniwezesha kupita juu ya vilima. Kwa kiongozi wa uimbaji. Kwa vinanda vyangu vya nyuzi.

english: O LORD, I have heard the report of You; I stand in awe, O LORD, of Your deeds. Revive them in these years; make them known in these years. In Your wrath, remember mercy!
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, naigure chinkuma chiao, nairokire. Omonene, ogokora kwao tiga kobe okoyia ase emiaka eye, tiga komanyekane ase emiaka eye. Ekero ore nendamwamu oinyore amaabera.
swahili: Bwana, nimezisikia sifa zako; nami naogopa kwa matendo yako, Ee Bwana. Fufua kazi yako katikati ya miaka, katikati ya miaka tangaza habari yako; katika ghadhabu kumbuka rehema.

english: God came from Teman, and the Holy One from Mount Paran. Selah His glory covered the heavens, and His praise filled the earth.
ekegusii: Nyasae ngocha are korwa Temani ee, Ere oyore Omochenu ngocha are korwa ase egetunwa gia Parani. Obonene bwaye mbotube igoro chionsi, na ense neichorwe nogotogigwa kwaye.
swahili: Mungu alitoka Temani, yeye Aliye Mtakatifu kutoka Mlima Parani. Utukufu wake ulifunika mbingu, na sifa zake zikaifunika dunia.

english: His radiance was like the sunlight; rays flashed from His hand, where His power is hidden.
ekegusii: Okobara kwaye nigo konga buna okw’erioba, gokomoreka korwa ase okoboko kwaye, aroro agwo obobui bwaye nao bobisire.
swahili: Mngʼao wake ulikuwa kama jua lichomozalo; mionzi ilimulika kutoka mkononi mwake, ambako nguvu zake zilifichwa.

english: Plague went before Him, and fever followed in His steps.
ekegusii: Amarwaire agoita nigo atang’aine bosio bwaye, na amaakwa nigo akobwatia chimbaratero chiaye.
swahili: Tauni ilimtangulia; maradhi ya kuambukiza yalifuata nyayo zake.

english: He stood and measured the earth; He looked and startled the nations; the ancient mountains crumbled; the perpetual hills collapsed. His ways are everlasting.
ekegusii: Ekero agotenena, ense nigo agotengechigwa, na ekero akorigereria, abanto b’ebisaku nigo bakonyegerigwa. Ebitunwa biarengeo korwa kare nigo bikorimera gochia inse. Ere nigo agotaara ase chinchera chiaye chia kare.
swahili: Alisimama, akaitikisa dunia; alitazama, na kuyafanya mataifa yatetemeke. Milima ya zamani iligeuka mavumbi na vilima vilivyozeeka vikaanguka. Njia zake ni za milele.

english: I saw the tents of Cushan in distress; the curtains of Midian were trembling.
ekegusii: Nkarora chinyomba chire Kusani chichandegete, ne chieema chi’ense ya Midiani chikanyegerigwa.
swahili: Niliona watu wa Kushani katika dhiki, na makazi ya Midiani katika maumivu makali.

english: Were You angry at the rivers, O LORD? Was Your wrath against the streams? Did You rage against the sea when You rode on Your horses, on Your chariots of salvation?
ekegusii: Inee! Aye Omonene nigo ogechirie ne chindooche, gose endamwamu yao nigo ere igoro ase chirochio? Inee! Nigo ore nekeririanda ase chinyancha, ekiagera nigo gwachete ne chibarasi chiao koriinete chigari chiao chi’obobui?
swahili: Ee Bwana, uliikasirikia mito? Je, ghadhabu yako ilikuwa dhidi ya vijito? Je, ulighadhibikia bahari ulipoendesha farasi wako na magari yako ya ushindi?

english: You brandished Your bow; You called for many arrows. Selah You split the earth with rivers.
ekegusii: Obota bwao bwaorokigwe maiso marore amo nemegwe ye ring’ana riao kwarierete ebisaku eira. Nigo gwatandorete ense ne chindooche.
swahili: Uliufunua upinde wako na kuita mishale mingi. Uliigawa dunia kwa mito;

english: In the second year of the reign of Darius, on the first day of the sixth month, the word of the LORD came through Haggai the prophet to Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest, stating
ekegusii: Ase rituko rie ritang’ani, omotienyi o gatano na rimo, omwaka o kabere, ekero Dario arenge omorwoti, ring’ana ri’Omonene rigatomwa goetera ase Hagai omobani, rigacha ase Serubabeli mosinto o Sealitieli, oyorenge omogabana bw’Abayuda, na ase Yoshua Omokuani omonene, mosinto o Yehosadaki.
swahili: Katika mwaka wa pili wa utawala wa Mfalme Dario wa Uajemi, katika siku ya kwanza ya mwezi wa sita, neno la Bwana lilikuja kupitia kwa nabii Hagai kwenda kwa Zerubabeli mwana wa Shealtieli, mtawala wa Yuda na kwa Yoshua mwana wa kuhani mkuu Yehosadaki:

english: Therefore, on account of you the heavens have withheld their dew and the earth has withheld its crops.
ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio, riime rikorwa igoro riatangirwe na ense tekwama endagera.
swahili: Kwa hiyo, kwa sababu yenu mbingu zimezuia umande wake na ardhi mavuno yake.

english: I have summoned a drought on the fields and on the mountains, on the grain, new wine, and oil, and on whatever the ground yields, on man and beast, and on all the labor of your hands.” The People Obey
ekegusii: Narentire eguru‐gura ase ense, na ase ebitunwa, na ase endagera, na ase emesabibu, na ase emezeituni, na ase kende gionsi kegokina ase riroba. Boigo nayerentire ase abanto, na ase emeremo yonsi abanto bagokora.” Abanto bakoigwera ay’Omonene achigete
swahili: Niliita ukame mashambani na milimani, kwenye nafaka, mvinyo mpya, mafuta pamoja na chochote kinachozalishwa na ardhi, juu ya watu na ngʼombe, pamoja na kazi za mikono yenu.”

english: Then Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel and Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest, as well as all the remnant of the people, obeyed the voice of the LORD their God and the words of the prophet Haggai, because the LORD their God had sent him. So the people feared the LORD.
ekegusii: Erio Serubabeli, mosinto o Sealitieli, na Yoshua Omokuani omonene, mosinto o Yehosadaki, amo nabatigari bonsi b’abaanto bakaigwera eriogi ri’Omonene, Nyasae obo, na amang’ana ’omobani Hagai, oyio Omonene, Nyasae obo, atomete; abanto bakaba bakomoiroka Omonene.
swahili: Kisha Zerubabeli mwana wa Shealtieli, Yoshua kuhani mkuu mwana wa Yehosadaki, pamoja na mabaki yote ya watu wakaitii sauti ya Bwana Mungu wao pamoja na ujumbe wa nabii Hagai, kwa sababu alikuwa ametumwa na Bwana Mungu wao. Watu walimwogopa Bwana.

english: Haggai, the messenger of the LORD, delivered the message of the LORD to the people: “I am with you,” declares the LORD.
ekegusii: Erio Hagai, omotomwa bw’ Omonene, agakwana nabaanto amang’ana ’Omonene, akabateebia, “Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: Inche nigo inde amo nainwe.”
swahili: Kisha Hagai, mjumbe wa Bwana, akawapa watu ujumbe huu wa Bwana: “Mimi niko pamoja nanyi,” asema Bwana.

english: So the LORD stirred the spirit of Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and the spirit of Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest, as well as the spirit of all the remnant of the people. And they came and began the work on the house of the LORD of Hosts, their God,
ekegusii: Erio Omonene agasukia omoika o Serubabeli mosinto o Sealitieli, oyorenge omogabana bw’Abayuda, na oyo o Yoshua Omokuani omonene, mosinto o Yehosadaki, na oyo bw’abatigari bonsi b’abaanto. Bonsi amo bagacha bagakora emeremo ase enyomba y’Omonene bw’Emeganda, Nyasae obo.
swahili: Kwa hiyo Bwana akachochea roho ya Zerubabeli mwana wa Shealtieli, mtawala wa Yuda, na roho ya kuhani mkuu Yoshua mwana wa Yehosadaki, pamoja na roho za mabaki yote ya watu. Walikuja wakaanza kufanya kazi katika nyumba ya Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, Mungu wao,

english: on the twenty-fourth day of the sixth month, in the second year of King Darius.
ekegusii: Ayio nigo akorekanete ase rituko ri’emerongo ebere na kane, omotienyi o gatano na rimo, omwaka o kabere bw’okogamba kw’omorwoti Dario.
swahili: katika siku ya ishirini na nne mwezi wa sita, katika mwaka wa pili wa utawala wa Mfalme Dario.

english: that this is what the LORD of Hosts says: “These people say, ‘The time has not yet come to rebuild the house of the LORD.’”
ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteeba: “Abanto aba nigo bagokwana ng’a engaki teraika ekero enyomba y’Omonene egwenerete koagachwa naende.”
swahili: Hivi ndivyo asemavyo Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote: “Hawa watu husema, ‘Wakati haujawadia wa kujenga nyumba ya Bwana.’ ”

english: Then the word of the LORD came through Haggai the prophet, saying:
ekegusii: Erio ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha goetera ase Hagai omobani, rikaboria:
swahili: Kisha neno la Bwana likaja kupitia kwa nabii Hagai:

english: “Is it a time for you yourselves to live in your paneled houses, while this house lies in ruins?”
ekegusii: “Inee! Eye nero engaki inwe mogwenerete komenya ase chinyomba chinyasi chiabo chitubire ne chibao chingiya, ekero enyomba eye egendererete koba ritombe?”
swahili: “Je, ni wakati wenu ninyi wa kuishi katika nyumba zenu zilizojengwa vizuri, wakati hii nyumba ikibaki, gofu?”

english: Now this is what the LORD of Hosts says: “Consider carefully your ways.
ekegusii: Ase ayio bono, aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteeba: “Inwe rengereria buna chinchera chiaino chiabeire.
swahili: Sasa hili ndilo asemalo Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote: “Zitafakarini vyema njia zenu.

english: You have planted much but harvested little. You eat but never have enough. You drink but never have your fill. You put on clothes but never get warm. You earn wages to put into a bag pierced through.”
ekegusii: Nigo mokobusura chimbusuro chinyinge, korende mwagesa chinke; nigo mokoragera, korende timori koigota; nkonywa more, korende timori goisaneka; nigo mokobeeka chianga, korende timori koigwa riberera; oyo okonyora eng’eria, nigo akoyenyora erinde oyebeka ase omobuko obochogete.
swahili: Mmepanda vingi, lakini mmevuna haba. Mnakula lakini hamshibi, mnakunywa, lakini hamtosheki. Mnavaa nguo, lakini hamsikii joto. Mnapata mishahara, lakini inatoweka kama imewekwa kwenye mfuko uliotobokatoboka.”

english: This is what the LORD of Hosts says: “Consider carefully your ways.
ekegusii: Ase ayio, aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteeba: Rengereria buna amang’ana aino abeire.
swahili: Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote: “Zitafakarini vyema njia zenu.

english: Go up into the hills, bring down lumber, and build the house, so that I may take pleasure in it and be glorified, says the LORD.
ekegusii: Tiira gochia ase ebitunwa igoro, morente emete moagachere enyomba eye, erio nario ndagokigwe nero, naende inyeorokie ng’a inche ninde nobonene.” Nabo Omonene atebiire.
swahili: Pandeni milimani mkalete miti na kujenga nyumba, ili nipate kuifurahia, na nitukuzwe,” asema Bwana.

english: You expected much, but behold, it amounted to little. And what you brought home, I blew away. Why? declares the LORD of Hosts. Because My house still lies in ruins, while each of you is busy with his own house.
ekegusii: “Nigo mwasemeretie monyore ebinge, korende mokanyora ebike; na ekero mwabirentete inka, nkabirurukia bikagenda. Inche Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo nkobaboria: Nase ki yabeete bo? Nekiagera enyomba yane yatigirwe egendererete koba ritombe, na kera oyomo oino nigo echanderete enyomba yaye omonyene.
swahili: “Mlitarajia mengi, kumbe, yametokea kidogo. Ulichokileta nyumbani nilikipeperusha. Kwa nini?” asema Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote. “Ni kwa sababu ya nyumba yangu, inayobaki katika hali ya magofu, wakati kila mmoja wenu anajishughulisha na nyumba yake mwenyewe.

english: On the twenty-first day of the seventh month, the word of the LORD came through Haggai the prophet, saying:
ekegusii: Ase rituko ri’emerongo ebere na rimo, omotienyi o gatano na kabere, ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha goetera ase Hagai omobani, rigateba:
swahili: Katika siku ya ishirini na moja ya mwezi wa saba, neno la Bwana lilikuja kupitia nabii Hagai, kusema:

english: On the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month, in the second year of Darius, the word of the LORD came to Haggai the prophet, saying,
ekegusii: Ase rituko ri’emerongo ebere na kane, omotienyi o kianda, omwaka o kabere, bw’okogamba kw’omorwoti Dario, ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha ase Hagai omobani, rikamoteebia:
swahili: Katika siku ya ishirini na nne ya mwezi wa tisa, katika mwaka wa pili wa utawala wa Mfalme Dario, neno la Bwana lilikuja kwa nabii Hagai:

english: “This is what the LORD of Hosts says: ‘Ask the priests for a ruling.
ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteeba: Boria abakuani naki amachiiko agoteeba.
swahili: “Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote: ‘Ulizeni makuhani jinsi sheria inavyosema:

english: If a man carries consecrated meat in the fold of his garment, and it touches bread, stew, wine, oil, or any other food, does that item become holy?’” “No,” replied the priests.
ekegusii: Omonto aise kobogoria enyama enchenu ase omogo bw’eanga yaye akwambara, na akune nomogo bw’eanga eria omogati, gose endagera eiyekire, gose edivai, gose amaguta ’amazeituni, gose endagera ende yonsi, Inee, ekio giakunwa nkebe egechenu?” Abakuani bakairaneria, “Yaya.”
swahili: Kama mtu akibeba nyama iliyowekwa wakfu katika pindo la vazi lake, kisha lile pindo likagusa mkate au mchuzi, divai, mafuta au chakula kingine, je, kitu hicho kitakuwa kimewekwa wakfu?’ ” Makuhani wakajibu, “La hasha.”

english: So Haggai asked, “If one who is defiled by contact with a corpse touches any of these, does it become defiled?” “Yes, it becomes defiled,” the priests answered.
ekegusii: Naende Hagai akaboria, “Onye omonto obeire oyotachenegeti ase ogokuna egetondo karakune ekemo ase ebinto ebio, Inee, ekio nakebe egetachenegeti?” Abakuani bakairaneria, bagateeba, “Ee, nkebe egetachenegeti.”
swahili: Kisha Hagai akasema, “Je, kama mtu aliyetiwa unajisi kwa kugusa maiti akigusa mojawapo ya vitu hivi, kitu hicho kitakuwa kimetiwa unajisi?” Makuhani wakajibu, “Ndiyo, huwa kimenajisiwa.”

english: Then Haggai replied, “So it is with this people and this nation before Me, declares the LORD, and so it is with every work of their hands; whatever they offer there is defiled.
ekegusii: Erio Hagai akairaneria, agateeba, “Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: Naboigo nabaanto aba, na egesaku eke, bare ase obosio bwane, na kera omoremo bagokora namaboko abo nabo ore, na kende gionsi eke bakorua aroro nigo kere egetachenegeti. Omonene okoria eira y’okobasesenia
swahili: Kisha Hagai akasema, “ ‘Basi ndivyo walivyo machoni pangu hawa watu na taifa hili,’ asema Bwana. ‘Lolote wafanyalo na chochote watoacho hapo ni najisi.

english: Now consider carefully from this day forward: Before one stone was placed on another in the temple of the LORD,
ekegusii: “Ase ayio nigo nkobaboria ng’a korwa rituko ria reero mobe mokorengereria buna yarenge ekero keria rigena konya ritarabekwa igoro ase rigena rinde, ase okoagacha Hekalu y’Omonene.
swahili: “ ‘Sasa fikirini kwa uangalifu kuanzia leo na kuendelea: tafakarini jinsi mambo yalivyokuwa kabla halijawekwa jiwe moja juu ya lingine katika Hekalu la Bwana.

english: from that time, when one came expecting a heap of twenty ephahs of grain, there were but ten. When one came to the winepress to draw out fifty baths, there were but twenty.
ekegusii: Ninki kiabeete ase amatuko aria? Ekero omonto arenge kogenda ase etui y’emesaima ng’a anyore emesaima emerongo ebere, onyora ikomi yoka, na ekero arenge kogenda ase amasabibu akomiterwa ng’a anyore ebibekerero emerongo etano biichire edivai, onyora emerongo ebere bioka.
swahili: Wakati mtu alipoendea lundo la nafaka la vipimo ishirini, kulikuwa na vipimo kumi tu. Wakati mtu alipoendea pipa la mvinyo ili kuchota vipimo hamsini, kulikuwa na vipimo ishirini tu.

english: I struck you—all the work of your hands—with blight, mildew, and hail, but you did not turn to Me, declares the LORD.
ekegusii: Nigo nabaagete ase okobarentera oborwaire enyagetabo, na obw’okorigisia, na embura y’amagena ase chindagera chiaino mwakorerete emeremo. Nonya naboigo timwang’iranerete. Nabo Omonene atebiire.
swahili: Kazi zenu zote za mikono nilizipiga kwa ukame, ukungu na mvua ya mawe, lakini hata hivyo, hamkunigeukia mimi,’ asema Bwana.

english: Consider carefully from this day forward—from the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month, the day the foundation of the LORD’s temple was laid—consider carefully:
ekegusii: Korwa rituko ria reero, rituko ri’emerongo ebere na kane, omotienyi o kianda, ekero oboroso bwe Hekalu y’Omonene bwabegetwe, na kogenderera, morengererie buna arabe!
swahili: ‘Tangu leo na kuendelea, kuanzia siku hii ya ishirini na nne ya mwezi wa tisa, tafakarini siku ambayo msingi wa Hekalu la Bwana uliwekwa. Tafakarini:

english: Is there still seed in the barn? The vine, the fig, the pomegranate, and the olive tree have not yet yielded fruit. But from this day on, I will bless you.” Zerubbabel the LORD’s Signet Ring
ekegusii: Inee! Chimbusuro nchire ase ebiage? Inee! Emesabibu, na emeko, na emekomomanga, na emezeituni tiyangeti kwama? Korende korwa rituko ria reero nimbasesenie.” Eira y’Omonene ase Serubabeli
swahili: Je, bado kuna mbegu iliyobakia ghalani? Mpaka sasa, hakuna mzabibu au mtini, mkomamanga wala mzeituni uliozaa tunda. “ ‘Kuanzia leo na kuendelea, nitawabariki.’ ” Zerubabeli Pete Ya Muhuri Ya Bwana

english: “Speak to Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and also to the remnant of the people. Ask them,
ekegusii: “Kwana na Serubabeli mosinto o Sealitieli, omogabana bw’Abayuda, na Yoshua Omokuani omonene, mosinto o Yehosadaki, na abatigari bonsi b’abaanto, obaborie:
swahili: “Sema na Zerubabeli mwana wa Shealtieli, mtawala wa Yuda, kuhani mkuu Yoshua mwana wa Yehosadaki, na mabaki ya watu. Uwaulize,

english: For the second time that day, the twenty-fourth day of the month, the word of the LORD came to Haggai, saying,
ekegusii: Ase rituko riria ri’emerongo ebere na kane, omotienyi oria o kianda, ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha ase Hagai naende, rikamoteebia,
swahili: Neno la Bwana likamjia Hagai kwa mara ya pili katika siku ya ishirini na nne ya mwezi kusema:

english: “Tell Zerubbabel governor of Judah that I am about to shake the heavens and the earth:
ekegusii: “Kwana na Serubabeli, omogabana bw’Abayuda, omoteebie ng’a inche nintengechie igoro chionsi amo nense.
swahili: “Mwambie Zerubabeli mtawala wa Yuda kwamba nitazitikisa mbingu na nchi.

english: I will overturn royal thrones and destroy the power of the kingdoms of the nations. I will overturn chariots and their riders; horses and their riders will fall, each by the sword of his brother.
ekegusii: Ning’onchorane ebirogo bi’obonene bw’abarwoti, ninsirie chinguru chi’amarwoti ’abaanto b’ebisaku. Ning’onchorane chigari na abachiriini; chibarasi nchigwe amo nabachiriinete, kera omonto naite oyomwabo n’omoro.
swahili: Nitapindua viti vya enzi vya falme, na kuziharibu kabisa nguvu za falme za kigeni. Nitapindua magari ya vita pamoja na waendeshaji wake; farasi na wapanda farasi wataanguka, kila mmoja kwa upanga wa ndugu yake.

english: On that day, declares the LORD of Hosts, I will take you, My servant, Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, declares the LORD, and I will make you like My signet ring, for I have chosen you, declares the LORD of Hosts.”
ekegusii: Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo agoteeba iga: Ase rituko riria ninkoire aye Serubabeli omosomba one, mosinto o Sealitieli. Naende Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: Ningokore obe buna ebonyi ere nekemanyererio kiane, ekiagera nagochorire. Nabo Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteeba.”
swahili: “ ‘Katika siku ile,’ asema Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, ‘nitakuchukua wewe, mtumishi wangu Zerubabeli mwana wa Shealtieli,’ asema Bwana. ‘Nitakufanya kama pete yangu ya muhuri, kwa kuwa nimekuchagua,’ asema Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote.”

english: ‘Who is left among you who saw this house in its former glory? How does it look to you now? Does it not appear to you like nothing in comparison?’
ekegusii: Ning’o otigarete ase egati yaino oyo orooche obonene bw’enyomba eria entang’ani? Moise koreng’ania eye neria ya kare, naki eye ekororekana ase amaiso aino? Inee! Teri kororekana ase more ng’a negento bosa?
swahili: ‘Ni nani miongoni mwenu aliyebaki ambaye aliiona hii nyumba katika utukufu wake wa mwanzo? Sasa inaonekanaje kwenu? Je, haionekani kwenu kama si kitu?

english: But now be strong, O Zerubbabel, declares the LORD. Be strong, O Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest. And be strong, all you people of the land, declares the LORD. Work! For I am with you, declares the LORD of Hosts.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: Aye Serubabeli, obe omokong’u na aye Yoshua Omokuani omonene, mosinto o Yehosadaki, obe omokong’u, nainwe abanto bonsi abamore ase ense eye, mobe abakong’u ase ogokora emeremo, ekiagera inche Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo inde amo nainwe.
swahili: Lakini sasa uwe imara, ee Zerubabeli,’ asema Bwana. ‘Kuwa imara, ee kuhani mkuu Yoshua mwana wa Yehosadaki. Mwe imara, enyi watu wote wa nchi,’ asema Bwana, ‘na mfanye kazi. Kwa kuwa mimi nipo pamoja nanyi,’ asema Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote.

english: This is the promise I made to you when you came out of Egypt. And My Spirit remains among you; do not be afraid.”
ekegusii: Ekero mwaruete ase ense ya Misiri nigo nabarierete eira ng’a botambe nigo ndabe amo nainwe; ase ayio Omoika one nigo ogendererete komenya ase egati yaino; timoiroka.
swahili: ‘Hili ndilo nililoagana nanyi mlipotoka katika nchi ya Misri. Pia Roho wangu anadumu katikati yenu. Msiogope.’

english: For this is what the LORD of Hosts says: “Once more, in a little while, I will shake the heavens and the earth, the sea and the dry land.
ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteeba: Ara rimo naende, engaki enke yatigaire nintengechie igoro chionsi, na ense, na enyancha, amo nense enyomo.
swahili: “Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote: ‘Baada ya muda kidogo kwa mara nyingine nitazitikisa mbingu na nchi, bahari na nchi kavu.

english: I will shake all the nations, and they will come with all their treasures, and I will fill this house with glory, says the LORD of Hosts.
ekegusii: Naende Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo agoteeba iga: Boigo nintengechie ebisaku bionsi, erinde ayaganeirie nabaanto b’ebisaku bionsi aoroke, na inche ing’ichorie enyomba yane nobonene.
swahili: Nitatikisa mataifa yote, nacho kile kinachotamaniwa na mataifa yote kitakuja, nami nitaujaza utukufu katika nyumba hii,’ asema Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote.

english: The silver is Mine, and the gold is Mine, declares the LORD of Hosts.
ekegusii: Chifeta nechiane, ne chitaabu nechiane. Nabo Omonene bw’Emeganda atebiire.
swahili: ‘Fedha ni mali yangu na dhahabu ni mali yangu,’ asema Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote.

english: The latter glory of this house will be greater than the former, says the LORD of Hosts. And in this place I will provide peace, declares the LORD of Hosts.” Blessings for a Defiled People
ekegusii: Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo agoteeba ng’a obonene bw’enyomba eye ya bono nabobe obonene goetania obw’eria ya kare. Aase aiga nindete omorembe obe okogambao. Nabo Omonene bw’Emeganda atebiire.” Ogosemia korwa ase abakuani
swahili: ‘Utukufu wa nyumba hii ya sasa utakuwa mkubwa kuliko utukufu wa ile nyumba ya mwanzoni,’ asema Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote. ‘Na mahali hapa nitawapa amani,’ asema Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote.” Baraka Kwa Watu Waliotiwa Unajisi

english: For the law is only a shadow of the good things to come, not the realities themselves. It can never, by the same sacrifices offered year after year, make perfect those who draw near to worship.
ekegusii: Naki ayare ime y’amachiiko nekiriri gioka ki’amang’ana agochi‐gocha, gose tari ekieni ekenyene. Ase ayio, ebing’wanso biria biria biare koruegwa kera omwaka botambe tibiarenge konyara kobaikerania abwo baare kobirua.
swahili: Sheria ni kivuli tu cha mambo mema yajayo, wala si uhalisi wa mambo yenyewe. Kwa sababu hii, haiwezekani kamwe kwa njia ya dhabihu zitolewazo mwaka hadi mwaka kuwakamilisha wale wanaokaribia ili kuabudu.

english: And by that will, we have been sanctified through the sacrifice of the body of Jesus Christ once for all.
ekegusii: Ase ogwancha okwo twanyorire ogochenwa ase okoruegwa kw’omobere o Yeso Kristo ara rimo rioka.
swahili: Katika mapenzi hayo sisi tumetakaswa na kufanywa watakatifu kwa njia ya sadaka ya mwili wa Yesu Kristo alioutoa mara moja tu.

english: Day after day every priest stands to minister and to offer again and again the same sacrifices, which can never take away sins.
ekegusii: Kera Omokuani nigo are gotenena rituko ase rituko ase obokoreri bwaye na korua ebing’wanso biria, na birobio tibiare konyara korusia ebibe nonya ng’ake.
swahili: Kila kuhani husimama siku kwa siku akifanya huduma yake ya ibada, na kutoa tena na tena dhabihu zile zile ambazo haziwezi kamwe kuondoa dhambi.

english: But when this Priest had offered for all time one sacrifice for sins, He sat down at the right hand of God.
ekegusii: Korende ekero Kristo aruete ekeng’wanso ekemo gioka ase ebibe kerabe goika kare na kare, nigo aikaransete ensemo y’okoboko gw’okorio kwa Nyasae.
swahili: Lakini huyu kuhani akiisha kutoa dhabihu moja kwa ajili ya dhambi kwa wakati wote, aliketi mkono wa kuume wa Mungu.

english: Since that time, He waits for His enemies to be made a footstool for His feet,
ekegusii: Erio oganyete goika ababisa baye babekwe inse y’amagoro aye.
swahili: Tangu wakati huo anangoja mpaka adui zake wawekwe chini ya miguu yake,

english: because by a single offering He has made perfect for all time those who are being sanctified.
ekegusii: Naki ase okoruegwa okomo obaikeranirie ase amatuko onsi abwo bachenirwe.
swahili: kwa sababu kwa dhabihu moja amewafanya kuwa wakamilifu milele wale wote wanaotakaswa.

english: The Holy Spirit also testifies to us about this. First He says:
ekegusii: Naki Omoika Omochenu noro otobereire kirori. Naki ritang’ani nigo agoteeba iga:
swahili: Pia Roho Mtakatifu anatushuhudia kuhusu jambo hili. Kwanza anasema:

english: “This is the covenant I will make with them after those days, declares the Lord. I will put My laws in their hearts and inscribe them on their minds.”
ekegusii: “Oko nakwo okobwatana ndache kobwatana nabarabwo magega y’amatuko ayio, Omonene oteebire: Nimbeke amachiiko aane ase chinkoro chiabo ime, ninyarike ase ebirengererio biabo.”
swahili: “Hili ndilo Agano nitakalofanya nao baada ya siku hizo, asema Bwana. Nitaziweka sheria zangu mioyoni mwao, na kuziandika katika nia zao.”

english: Then He adds: “Their sins and lawless acts I will remember no more.”
ekegusii: Naende nigo agoteeba, “Ebibe biabo, na ogosaria kwabo tinkobiinyora naende nonya ng’ake.”
swahili: Kisha aongeza kusema: “Dhambi zao na kutokutii kwao sitakumbuka tena.”

english: And where these have been forgiven, an offering for sin is no longer needed. A Call to Persevere (Jude 1:17–23)
ekegusii: Gaki, okorusigwa kw’ebibe gokorabeo, rirorio ekerugwa ase engencho y’ebibe tigekobao naende. Tiga toike ang’e na kobwata okoorokia gwaito
swahili: Basi haya yakiisha kusamehewa, hakuna tena dhabihu yoyote inayotolewa kwa ajili ya dhambi. Wito Wa Kuvumilia

english: Therefore, brothers, since we have confidence to enter the Most Holy Place by the blood of Jesus,
ekegusii: Ase ayio, baminto, ntore noboremu bw’ogosoa Aase Aachenu goetera ase amanyinga a Yeso,
swahili: Kwa hiyo, ndugu zangu, kwa kuwa tunao ujasiri wa kupaingia Patakatifu pa Patakatifu kwa damu ya Yesu,

english: If it could, would not the offerings have ceased? For the worshipers would have been cleansed once for all, and would no longer have felt the guilt of their sins.
ekegusii: Onye mbianyarete, Inee, anga tibiatigetwe, tibikoruegwa? Naki onye abwo baare kobirua bakoorire gochenwa ara rimo, anga tibare kwerora ng’a mbare nebibe naende.
swahili: Kama dhabihu hizo zingeweza kuwakamilisha, hazingeendelea kutolewa tena. Kwa kuwa hao waabuduo wangekuwa wametakaswa mara moja tu, wala wasingejiona tena kuwa na dhambi.

english: by the new and living way opened for us through the curtain of His body,
ekegusii: ase enchera enyia ere moyo, eye atoigorerete, egoetera ase etoto, engencho yaye omobere oye.
swahili: kwa njia mpya iliyo hai tuliyofunguliwa kwa ajili yetu kupitia kwenye lile pazia, yaani, mwili wake,

english: and since we have a great priest over the house of God,
ekegusii: Naende ntore n’Omokuani Omonene igoro y’enyomba ya Nyasae.
swahili: basi kwa kuwa tunaye Kuhani Mkuu juu ya nyumba ya Mungu,

english: let us draw near with a sincere heart in full assurance of faith, having our hearts sprinkled to cleanse us from a guilty conscience and our bodies washed with pure water.
ekegusii: Ase ayio, toike ang’e ne chinkoro chire nekeene, tobe nobomaene oboikeranu ase okwegena, ne chinkoro chiaito chianyororokerigwe oborabu, tichigotogambia, twasibiigwe ase emebere yaito namaache amaya.
swahili: sisi na tumkaribie Mungu kwa moyo mnyofu kwa imani timilifu, mioyo yetu ikiwa imenyunyizwa damu ya Kristo na kuwa safi kutokana na dhamiri mbaya nayo miili yetu ikiwa imeoshwa kwa maji safi.

english: Let us hold resolutely to the hope we profess, for He who promised is faithful.
ekegusii: Tiga tobwate mono okoorokia kw’ogosemeria gwaito, totari konyegerigwa; ekiagera ere oyoriete eira nomwegenwa.
swahili: Tushike kwa uthabiti lile tumaini la ukiri wetu bila kuyumbayumba, kwa maana yeye aliyeahidi ni mwaminifu.

english: And let us consider how to spur one another on to love and good deeds.
ekegusii: Naende twechanderane intwe ase intwe, na kobeekana chinguru ase obwanchani, na ase ogokora okuya.
swahili: Tuangaliane na kuhimizana sisi kwa sisi katika upendo na katika kutenda mema.

english: Let us not neglect meeting together, as some have made a habit, but let us encourage one another, and all the more as you see the Day approaching.
ekegusii: Titotiga gosangererekana amo, buna engencho y’abande ere, korende toremanie intwe ase intwe, kobua mono ekiagera morooche ng’a Rituko riria riaikire ang’e.
swahili: Wala tusiache kukutana pamoja, kama wengine walivyo na desturi, bali tuhimizane sisi kwa sisi kadiri tuonavyo Siku ile inakaribia.

english: If we deliberately go on sinning after we have received the knowledge of the truth, no further sacrifice for sins remains,
ekegusii: Naki onye togokora ebibe moeneno magega gotwaikire komanya ekeene, keng’wanso kende tikeri ase engencho y’ebibe.
swahili: Kama tukiendelea kutenda dhambi kwa makusudi baada ya kupokea ufahamu wa ile kweli, haibaki tena dhabihu kwa ajili ya dhambi.

english: but only a fearful expectation of judgment and of raging fire that will consume all adversaries.
ekegusii: Korende eke totigaretie nobwoba bw’okoganya ekiina, na omorero omotindi ogwoka, ogocha gosiria abwo bakoengereria.
swahili: Lakini kinachobaki ni kungoja kwa hofu hukumu ya moto uwakao, utakaowaangamiza adui za Mungu.

english: Anyone who rejected the law of Moses died without mercy on the testimony of two or three witnesses.
ekegusii: Omonto oyorenge gochaaya amachiiko a Musa nigo arenge goitwa okwa, atari konyora amaabera, ase okoberwa kirori nabaanto babere gose batato.
swahili: Yeyote aliyeikataa sheria ya Mose alikufa pasipo huruma kwa ushahidi wa watu wawili au watatu.

english: How much more severely do you think one deserves to be punished who has trampled on the Son of God, profaned the blood of the covenant that sanctified him, and insulted the Spirit of grace?
ekegusii: Inee! Naki morooche? Omonto oria otanchete Omwana o Nyasae, na kobara amanyinga y’okobwatana, achenetwe naro, koba egento kia bosa, oria okoreire Omoika bw’amaabera obogeechi, tiyamogwenerete ere anyore egesusuro ekenene kobua?
swahili: Je, mnadhani ni adhabu kali kiasi gani anayostahili kupewa mtu aliyemkanyaga Mwana wa Mungu chini ya nyayo zake, yeye aliyeifanya damu ya Agano iliyomtakasa kuwa kitu najisi na kumtendea maovu Roho wa neema?

english: Instead, those sacrifices are an annual reminder of sins,
ekegusii: Korende ebing’wanso ebio nigo bikobainyoria igoro y’ebibe kera omwaka.
swahili: Lakini zile dhabihu zilikuwa ukumbusho wa dhambi kila mwaka,

english: For we know Him who said, “Vengeance is Mine; I will repay,” and again, “The Lord will judge His people.”
ekegusii: Naki ntomanyete ere oyokwanete, “Egesiomba nekiane, inche ning’akane,” naende, “Omonene nere oragambie abanto baye.”
swahili: Kwa kuwa tunamjua yeye aliyesema, “Ni juu yangu kulipiza kisasi; nitalipiza.” Tena asema, “Bwana atawahukumu watu wake.”

english: It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.
ekegusii: Okogwa ase amaboko a Nyasae ore moyo, eri nering’ana ri’okoondokia.
swahili: Ni jambo la kutisha kuanguka mikononi mwa Mungu aliye hai.

english: Remember the early days that you were in the light. In those days, you endured a great conflict in the face of suffering.
ekegusii: Korende moinyore amatuko e ritang’ani, magega komwabarerigwe omobaso igo mwaremereretie okoamererania okonene kw’ogochandwa.
swahili: Kumbukeni siku zile za kwanza, ambazo mkiisha kutiwa nuru mlistahimili mashindano makali ya maumivu.

english: Sometimes you were publicly exposed to ridicule and persecution; at other times you were partners with those who were so treated.
ekegusii: Engaki ende mokarorerigwa ase okoramwa na ogochandwa maiso marore, na engaki ende mokabwatana nabwo bakoreretwe ayio.
swahili: Wakati mwingine mlitukanwa na kuteswa hadharani; wakati mwingine mlikuwa radhi kuungana na wale waliofanyiwa hivyo.

english: You sympathized with those in prison and joyfully accepted the confiscation of your property, knowing that you yourselves had a better and permanent possession.
ekegusii: Naki mwabarorerete amaabera baria barenge ase ebisibo, mogancha nomogooko kourwa chinibo chiaino, ekiagera mwamanyete ng’a inwe abanyene more nenibo eyere engiya kobua, erabeo kare na kare.
swahili: Mliwahurumia wale waliokuwa kifungoni, mkikubali kwa furaha kunyangʼanywa mali zenu kwa maana mlijua kwamba mnayo mali iliyo bora zaidi idumuyo.

english: So do not throw away your confidence; it holds a great reward.
ekegusii: Ase ayio, timotuguta oboremu bwaino, ekiagera mbore neng’eria enene.
swahili: Kwa hiyo msiutupe ujasiri wenu, kwa maana una thawabu kubwa mno.

english: You need to persevere, so that after you have done the will of God, you will receive what He has promised.
ekegusii: Naki iigo ebagwenerete mobe noboremereria, erinde komwaikire gokora ogwancha kwa Nyasae monyore aya mwarieretwe eira.
swahili: Inawapasa kuvumilia ili mkiisha kufanya mapenzi ya Mungu mpate kile alichoahidi.

english: For, “In just a little while, He who is coming will come and will not delay.
ekegusii: “Naki nkere ekero egeke mono, ere oyore gocha nachiche, gose tagotebana gocha,
swahili: Kwa kuwa bado kitambo kidogo tu, “Yeye ajaye atakuja wala hatakawia.

english: But My righteous one will live by faith; and if he shrinks back, I will take no pleasure in him.”
ekegusii: korende omonyene oboronge one nabe moyo ase okwegena, na, karasukwane, omoyo one tokogokigwa nere.”
swahili: Lakini mwenye haki wangu ataishi kwa imani. Naye kama akisitasita, sina furaha naye.”
