english: But we are not of those who shrink back and are destroyed, but of those who have faith and preserve their souls.
ekegusii: Korende intwe titori ase abwo bagosukwana na gosira, korende ase abwo bare nokwegena ase okoegera emioyo yaito.
swahili: Lakini sisi hatumo miongoni mwa hao wanaositasita na kuangamia, bali tuko miongoni mwa hao wenye imani na hivyo tunaokolewa.

english: because it is impossible for the blood of bulls and goats to take away sins.
ekegusii: Naki amanyinga e chieeri na aye chimbori takonyara korusia ebibe.
swahili: kwa sababu haiwezekani damu ya mafahali na mbuzi kuondoa dhambi.

english: Therefore, when Christ came into the world, He said: “Sacrifice and offering You did not desire, but a body You prepared for Me.
ekegusii: Ase ayio, Kristo kagosoa ase ense nigo agoteeba, “Ebing’wanso na ebiruegwa tikwabiganetie, korende omobere kwandoiseirie.
swahili: Kwa hiyo, Kristo alipokuja duniani, alisema: “Dhabihu na sadaka hukuzitaka, bali mwili uliniandalia;

english: In burnt offerings and sin offerings You took no delight.
ekegusii: Ase ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa, na ebing’wanso bi’ebibe, tikwagogetigwe nabirobio.
swahili: sadaka za kuteketezwa na za dhambi hukupendezwa nazo.

english: Then I said, ‘Here I am, it is written about Me in the scroll: I have come to do Your will, O God.’”
ekegusii: Erio ngakwana: Nachire gokora ogwancha kwao, Nyasae, buna eriikire igoro yane ase egetabu.”
swahili: Ndipo niliposema, ‘Mimi hapa, nimekuja, imeandikwa kunihusu katika kitabu: Nimekuja kuyafanya mapenzi yako, Ee Mungu.’ ”

english: In the passage above He says, “Sacrifices and offerings, burnt offerings and sin offerings You did not desire, nor did You delight in them” (although they are offered according to the law).
ekegusii: Agwo ritang’ani nigo agoteeba, “Ebing’wanso, na ebirugwa, na ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa, na ebing’wanso bi’ebibe tikwabiganetie, gose tikwagogetigwe nabirobio”, nonya birobio biare korentwa buna amachiiko are goteeba.
swahili: Kwanza alisema, “Dhabihu na sadaka, sadaka za kuteketezwa na za dhambi hukuzitaka, wala hukupendezwa nazo” (ingawa sheria iliagiza zitolewe).

english: Then He adds, “Here I am, I have come to do Your will.” He takes away the first to establish the second.
ekegusii: Erio akabora, “Rora, nachire gokora ogwancha kwao.” Igo akarusia ebie ritang’ani, erinde abeeke egia kabere.
swahili: Kisha akasema “Mimi hapa, nimekuja kuyafanya mapenzi yako.” Aondoa lile Agano la kwanza ili kuimarisha la pili.

english: Now faith is the assurance of what we hope for and the certainty of what we do not see.
ekegusii: Gaki, okwegena nakwo okoba nobomaene ase amang’ana ayio asemeirie, nonya nekeene ki’ayio atari kororekana.
swahili: Basi imani ni kuwa na hakika ya mambo yatarajiwayo, na udhahiri wa mambo yasiyoonekana.

english: For he was looking forward to the city with foundations, whose architect and builder is God.
ekegusii: Naki igo aganyete omochie ore namaroso, oyo Nyasae aroseti na koagacha.
swahili: Kwa maana alikuwa akiutazamia mji wenye misingi ya kudumu ambao mwenye kuubuni na kuujenga ni Mungu.

english: By faith Sarah, even though she was barren and beyond the proper age, was enabled to conceive a child, because she considered Him faithful who had promised.
ekegusii: Ase okwegena Sara omonyene akanyora chinguru koba morito, nonya konya oeteire emiaka yaye, ekiagera amorooche ere oyomorierete eira, ng’a nomwegenwa are.
swahili: Kwa imani Abrahamu, ingawa alikuwa mzee wa umri, naye Sara mwenyewe aliyekuwa tasa, alipokea uwezo wa kuwa baba kwa sababu alimhesabu Mungu aliyemwahidi kuwa mwaminifu na kwamba angetimiza ahadi yake.

english: And so from one man, and he as good as dead, came descendants as numerous as the stars in the sky and as countless as the sand on the seashore.
ekegusii: Ase ayio, korwa ase omonto oria oyomo, nonya konya obeire buna oyokuure, abanto bakaiborwa abange buna ching’enang’eni chia igoro, na buna omokenye ore ase engegu y’enyancha, otanyare kobareka.
swahili: Hivyo kutokana na huyu huyu ambaye alikuwa sawa na mfu, wakazaliwa wazao wengi kama nyota za mbinguni na kama mchanga wa pwani usiohesabika.

english: All these people died in faith, without having received the things they were promised. However, they saw them and welcomed them from afar. And they acknowledged that they were strangers and exiles on the earth.
ekegusii: Aba bonsi bagakwa bare nokwegena, bataranyora ayabarieretwe eira, korende bakayarora korwa are, na koyakwania, bakaorokia ng’a nigo bare abamenyi na abaeti ase ense.
swahili: Watu hawa wote wakafa katika imani bila kuzipokea zile ahadi, lakini waliziona kwa mbali na kuzishangilia. Nao walikubali kwamba walikuwa wageni na wasiokuwa na maskani hapa duniani.

english: Now those who say such things show that they are seeking a country of their own.
ekegusii: Naki abagokwana amang’ana buna ayio nkoorokia bare maiso marore, ng’a nkorigia bare ense yabo abanyene.
swahili: Watu wasemao mambo kama haya, wanaonyesha wazi kwamba wanatafuta nchi yao wenyewe.

english: If they had been thinking of the country they had left, they would have had opportunity to return.
ekegusii: Onye barabwo mbainyorete ense eria ase baruete, anga mbanyorete ribaga koirana aroro.
swahili: Kwa kweli kama wangekuwa wanafikiri kuhusu nchi waliyoiacha, wangalipata nafasi ya kurudi huko.

english: Instead, they were longing for a better country, a heavenly one. Therefore God is not ashamed to be called their God, for He has prepared a city for them.
ekegusii: Korende bono mbaganetie ense ere engiya kobua, engencho yaye ense ya igoro. Ase ayio Nyasae takorora obosooku korokwa Nyasae obo, ekiagera obaroiseirie omochie.
swahili: Lakini badala yake walitamani nchi iliyo bora zaidi, yaani nchi ya mbinguni. Kwa hiyo Mungu haoni aibu kuitwa Mungu wao, kwa kuwa amekwisha kuandaa mji kwa ajili yao.

english: By faith Abraham, when he was tested, offered up Isaac on the altar. He who had received the promises was ready to offer his one and only son,
ekegusii: Ase okwegena Aburaamu, gachia goteemwa, akarua Isaka abe ekeng’wanso. Nere oyorieretwe chiira akarua omwana oye omomoima.
swahili: Kwa imani Abrahamu, alipojaribiwa na Mungu, alimtoa Isaki kuwa dhabihu. Yeye aliyekuwa amezipokea ahadi za Mungu alikuwa tayari kumtoa mwanawe, aliyekuwa mwanawe pekee awe dhabihu.

english: even though God had said to him, “Through Isaac your offspring will be reckoned.”
ekegusii: Ere nateebetigwe, “Ase Isaka oroiboro rwao narwatorwe.”
swahili: Ingawa Mungu alikuwa amemwambia Abrahamu, “Uzao wako utahesabiwa kupitia kwa Isaki,”

english: Abraham reasoned that God could raise the dead, and in a sense, he did receive Isaac back from death. The Faith of Isaac, Jacob, and Joseph (Genesis 27—50)
ekegusii: Akarengereria ng’a Nyasae nanyare komobokia korwa ase abakuure. Ase ayio akamonyora agwo agwo, buna omogwekano.
swahili: Abrahamu alihesabu kuwa Mungu angaliweza kumfufua Isaki kutoka kwa wafu. Na kwa kusema kwa mfano, alimpata tena Isaki kutoka kwa wafu.

english: This is why the ancients were commended.
ekegusii: Naki ase okwo abagaaka abakoro mbaberetwe kirori.
swahili: Maana baba zetu wa kale walipongezwa kwa haya.

english: By faith Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau concerning the future.
ekegusii: Ase okwegena Isaka agasesenia Yakobo na Esau ase amang’ana agochi‐gocha.
swahili: Kwa imani Isaki alimbariki Yakobo na Esau kuhusu maisha yao ya baadaye.

english: By faith Jacob, when he was dying, blessed each of Joseph’s sons and worshiped as he leaned on the top of his staff.
ekegusii: Ase okwegena Yakobo, ekero arenge ang’e nogokwa, agasesenia kera oyomo bw’abana ba Yusufu, agasasiima bwesiirerete enyimbo yaye.
swahili: Kwa imani Yakobo alipokuwa anakufa, alimbariki kila mmoja wa mtoto wa Yosefu, akamwabudu Mungu akiwa ameegemea juu ya kichwa cha fimbo yake.

english: By faith Joseph, when his end was near, spoke about the exodus of the Israelites and gave instructions about his bones. The Faith of Moses (Exodus 2—15; Acts 7:20–22)
ekegusii: Ase okwegena Yusufu, ekero abeire ang’e nomoerio bw’obogima bwaye, agakwana igoro y’okong’anyigwa kw’Abaisraeli, akabachikera amang’ana igoro y’amauga aye.
swahili: Kwa imani, Yosefu alipokaribia mwisho wa maisha yake, alinena habari za kutoka kwa wana wa Israeli huko Misri na akatoa maagizo kuhusu mifupa yake. Imani Ya Mose

english: By faith Moses’ parents hid him for three months after his birth, because they saw that he was a beautiful child, and they were unafraid of the king’s edict.
ekegusii: Ase okwegena Musa, ekero aiboretwe, akabiswa ase engaki y’emetienyi etato nabaibori baye, ekiagera baroche ng’a nomwana omuya, gose tibairogete ogochika kw’omorwoti.
swahili: Kwa imani, wazazi wa Mose walimficha kwa miezi mitatu baada ya kuzaliwa, kwa sababu waliona kuwa si mtoto wa kawaida, wala hawakuiogopa amri ya mfalme.

english: By faith Moses, when he was grown, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh’s daughter.
ekegusii: Ase okwegena Musa, kabeire omonto omonene, akaanga tarokwa omwana bw’omoiseke o Farao,
swahili: Kwa imani, Mose alipokuwa mtu mzima, alikataa kuitwa mwana wa binti Farao.

english: He chose to suffer oppression with God’s people rather than to experience the fleeting enjoyment of sin.
ekegusii: agachoora ng’a mbuya konyora emechando amo nabaanto ba Nyasae kobua kwegokia ase ebibe ase ekero egeke.
swahili: Akachagua kupata mateso pamoja na watu wa Mungu kuliko kujifurahisha kwa anasa za dhambi kwa kitambo kidogo tu.

english: He valued disgrace for Christ above the treasures of Egypt, for he was looking ahead to his reward.
ekegusii: Ere nigo abarete ogochaaywa ase engencho ya Kristo ng’a nobonda kobua chiniibo chia Misiri, ekiagera arigereretie eng’eria ere bosio.
swahili: Aliona kushutumiwa kwa ajili ya Kristo ni utajiri mkubwa zaidi kuliko hazina za Misri, maana alikuwa anatazamia kupata thawabu baadaye.

english: By faith Moses left Egypt, not fearing the king’s anger; he persevered because he saw Him who is invisible.
ekegusii: Ase okwegena akarua Misiri, tairoka endamwamu y’omorwoti, ekiagera aremereretie buna oyororire ere oyotari kororekana.
swahili: Kwa imani Mose aliondoka Misri bila kuogopa ghadhabu ya mfalme. Alivumilia kwa sababu alimwona yeye asiyeonekana kwa macho.

english: By faith he kept the Passover and the sprinkling of blood, so that the destroyer of the firstborn would not touch Israel’s own firstborn.
ekegusii: Ase okwegena akaroisia Epasaka na kogindia amanyinga, erinde oyoraache goita abana abatangi tabakuna, ne ching’iti chintangi boigo.
swahili: Kwa imani akaadhimisha Pasaka na kunyunyiza damu, ili yule mwenye kuwaangamiza wazaliwa wa kwanza asiwaguse wazaliwa wa Israeli. Imani Ya Mashujaa Wengine Wa Israeli

english: By faith the people passed through the Red Sea as on dry land; but when the Egyptians tried to follow, they were drowned. The Faith of Many (Joshua–Malachi)
ekegusii: Ase okwegena Abaisraeli bagaeta egati y’Enyancha Embariri buna ase ense enyomo. Korende Abamisiri barabwo bagachia goteema gokora bo, bakamerwa nenyancha.
swahili: Kwa imani, watu walivuka Bahari ya Shamu kama vile juu ya nchi kavu; lakini Wamisri walipojaribu kufanya hivyo, walitoswa ndani ya maji.

english: By faith we understand that the universe was formed at God’s command, so that what is seen was not made out of what was visible. The Faith of Abel, Enoch, Noah (Genesis 4—9)
ekegusii: Ase okwegena twamanyire ng’a ense nigo yatongetwe ase chinguru chi’ering’ana ria Nyasae, na igo ebinto bikororekana tibiakoretwe n’ebinto bire maiso marore.
swahili: Kwa imani tunafahamu kwamba ulimwengu uliumbwa kwa neno la Mungu, vitu vyote vinavyoonekana havikuumbwa kutoka kwa vitu vinavyoonekana. Mfano Wa Abeli, Enoki Na Noa

english: By faith the walls of Jericho fell, after the people had marched around them for seven days.
ekegusii: Ase okwegena chindwaki chia Yeriko chikagwa gachiaetananirwe ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere.
swahili: Kwa imani kuta za Yeriko zilianguka, baada ya watu kuzizunguka kwa siku saba.

english: By faith the prostitute Rahab, because she welcomed the spies in peace, did not perish with those who were disobedient.
ekegusii: Ase okwegena Rahabu, oria omotayayi, taitetwe amo nabwo bataigwerete, ekiagera aroisetie abanto baria chirooti nomorembe.
swahili: Kwa imani, Rahabu, yule kahaba, hakuangamizwa pamoja na wale waliomwasi Mungu, kwa kuwa aliwakaribisha wale wapelelezi.

english: And what more shall I say? Time will not allow me to tell of Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephthah, David, Samuel, and the prophets,
ekegusii: Naende inki ndakwane? Naki engaki tekong’isana gokwana igoro ya Gidioni, na Baraki, na Samusoni, na Yefita, na Daudi, na Samweli, na ababani.
swahili: Basi niseme nini zaidi? Sina wakati wa kusema habari za Gideoni, Baraka, Samsoni, Yeftha, Daudi, Samweli na manabii,

english: who through faith conquered kingdoms, administered justice, and gained what was promised; who shut the mouths of lions,
ekegusii: Abwo ase okwegena bakabua amarwoti, bagakora oboronge, bakanyoora ayabarieretwe chiira, bagasieka emenwa ye chindo.
swahili: ambao kwa imani walishinda milki za wafalme, walitekeleza haki, na wakapokea ahadi za Mungu; walifunga vinywa vya simba,

english: quenched the raging fire, and escaped the edge of the sword; who gained strength from weakness, became mighty in battle, and put foreign armies to flight.
ekegusii: Naende barabwo bakarimia chinguru chi’omorero, bagetooria korwa ase obwoge bw’omoro, bakabeekwa chinguru magega y’oboreu bwabo, bakaba abakong’u ase esegi, bagaseria emeganda y’abarwani y’ababisa.
swahili: wakazima makali ya miali ya moto, na wakaepuka kuuawa kwa upanga; udhaifu wao uligeuka kuwa nguvu; pia walikuwa hodari vitani na kuyafukuza majeshi ya wageni.

english: Women received back their dead, raised to life again. Others were tortured and refused their release, so that they might gain a better resurrection.
ekegusii: Abakungu bakanyora naende abakwete babo ase okobokigwa. Abande bagaitwa bobe goika bagakwa, tibancha gosiborwa, erinde banyore okobokigwa okore okuya kobua.
swahili: Wanawake walipokea watu wao waliokuwa wamekufa, wakafufuliwa. Lakini wengine waliteswa, nao wakakataa kufunguliwa, ili wapate ufufuo ulio bora zaidi.

english: Still others endured mocking and flogging, and even chains and imprisonment.
ekegusii: Abande bagachandeka ase ogochecherigwa na goakwa chinkini, naende bagasibwa nebinyuri na kobekwa chichela ime.
swahili: Wengine walidhihakiwa na kupigwa, hata walifungwa minyororo na kutiwa gerezani.

english: They were stoned, they were sawed in two, they were put to death by the sword. They went around in sheepskins and goatskins, destitute, oppressed, and mistreated.
ekegusii: Bagaakwa amagena, bagateemwa, bakanachwa ne chinseke, bagaitwa nemeyio ya birende. Naende bagaetanana beboetie chingobo chi’eching’ondi na echie chimbori, bakaba abaremerwa, bagachandwa na gokorwa bobe,
swahili: Walipigwa kwa mawe; walipasuliwa vipande viwili kwa msumeno; waliuawa kwa upanga. Walizungukazunguka wakiwa wamevaa ngozi za kondoo na mbuzi, wakiwa maskini, wakiteswa na kutendwa mabaya,

english: The world was not worthy of them. They wandered in deserts and mountains, and hid in caves and holes in the ground.
ekegusii: abanto ense etagwenere koba nabarabwo. Barabwo nigo barenge goetanana ase chirooro na ase ebitunwa, ase amabwago na amakuruma.
swahili: watu ambao ulimwengu haukustahili kuwa nao. Walizunguka majangwani na milimani, katika mapango na katika mahandaki ardhini.

english: These were all commended for their faith, yet they did not receive what was promised.
ekegusii: Abanto aba bonsi babereirwe kirori goetera ase okwegena kwabo, korende tibanyora ayabarieretwe eira,
swahili: Hawa wote walishuhudiwa vyema kwa sababu ya imani yao, lakini hakuna hata mmoja wao aliyepokea yale yaliyoahidiwa.

english: By faith Abel offered God a better sacrifice than Cain did. By faith he was commended as righteous when God gave approval to his gifts. And by faith he still speaks, even though he is dead.
ekegusii: Ase okwegena Abeli akaa Nyasae ekeng’wanso ekere ekiya kobua egia Kaini. Ase okwo akaberwa kirori ng’a ere nomonyene oboronge. Nyasae akamobera kirori ase ogwancha ebiegwa biaye. Abeli okuure, korende ase okwegena ngokwana are nonya ngoika bono.
swahili: Kwa imani Abeli alimtolea Mungu dhabihu bora zaidi kuliko Kaini. Kwa imani alishuhudiwa kuwa mwenye haki, Mungu mwenyewe akazishuhudia sadaka zake. Kwa imani bado ananena ingawa amekufa.

english: God had planned something better for us, so that together with us they would be made perfect.
ekegusii: ekiagera Nyasae natang’anete gotogachera intwe egento kere ekiya kobua, naki barabwo tibaikeranetigwe intwe totaiyo.
swahili: Kwa kuwa Mungu alikuwa ametangulia kutuwekea kitu kilicho bora zaidi ili wao wasikamilishwe pasipo sisi.

english: By faith Enoch was taken up so that he did not see death: “He could not be found, because God had taken him away.” For before he was taken, he was commended as one who pleased God.
ekegusii: Ase okwegena Enoku akang’anyigwa, tacha korora amakweri. Tarorekanete, ekiagera Nyasae namong’anyetie. Naki ritang’ani atarang’anyigwa konya obereirwe kirori ng’a namogwenerete Nyasae.
swahili: Kwa imani Enoki alitwaliwa kutoka maisha haya, kiasi kwamba hakuonja mauti. Hakuonekana, kwa sababu Mungu alikuwa amemchukua. Kwa kuwa kabla hajatwaliwa alikuwa ameshuhudiwa kuwa ni mtu aliyempendeza Mungu.

english: And without faith it is impossible to please God, because anyone who approaches Him must believe that He exists and that He rewards those who earnestly seek Him.
ekegusii: Korende omonto atari nokwegena takonyara komogwenera Nyasae. Naki oyogocha asare nagwenerete gwancha ng’a nareo, naende nigo akobaa eng’eria baria bakomorigia.
swahili: Lakini pasipo imani haiwezekani kumpendeza Mungu, kwa maana yeyote anayemjia Mungu lazima aamini kwamba yeye yuko na ya kuwa huwapa thawabu wale wamtafutao kwa bidii.

english: By faith Noah, when warned about things not yet seen, in godly fear built an ark to save his family. By faith he condemned the world and became heir of the righteousness that comes by faith. The Faith of Abraham and Sarah (Genesis 15—22; Romans 4:1–12)
ekegusii: Ase okwegena Nuhu, gaikire g okuurerwa na Nyasae ase amang’ana atararorekana, ase okoba namasikani amaya asare akaroisia obwato, erinde atoorie abanto b’enyomba yaye. Ase ayio, akagambia ense ekiina, na akaba omonyamwando bw’oboronge bokonyorekana ase okwegena.
swahili: Kwa imani, Noa alipoonywa na Mungu kuhusu mambo ambayo hayajaonekana bado, kwa kumcha Mungu alitengeneza safina ili kuokoa jamaa yake. Kwa imani yake aliuhukumu ulimwengu na akawa mrithi wa haki ipatikanayo kwa imani. Imani Ya Abrahamu

english: By faith Abraham, when called to go to a place he would later receive as his inheritance, obeyed and went, without knowing where he was going.
ekegusii: Ase okwegena Aburaamu akaigwera Nyasae ekero arangeretigwe kogenda goika aase aria achiete konyora abe omwando oye, akaimoka akagenda, tamanya aase agochia.
swahili: Kwa imani Abrahamu, alipoitwa aende mahali ambapo Mungu angempa baadaye kuwa urithi, alitii na akaenda, ingawa hakujua anakokwenda.

english: By faith he dwelt in the promised land as a stranger in a foreign country. He lived in tents, as did Isaac and Jacob, who were heirs with him of the same promise.
ekegusii: Ase okwegena akamenya ase ense eria engeni arieretwe eira, akamenya buna omomenyi ase chiema amo na Isaka na Yakobo, abarenge abanyamwando amo nere ase eira eria eria.
swahili: Kwa imani alifanya maskani yake katika nchi ya ahadi kama mgeni katika nchi ya kigeni; aliishi katika mahema, kama Isaki na Yakobo walivyofanya, waliokuwa pia warithi pamoja naye wa ahadi ile ile.

english: Therefore, since we are surrounded by such a great cloud of witnesses, let us throw off every encumbrance and the sin that so easily entangles, and let us run with endurance the race set out for us.
ekegusii: Ase ayio, ekiagera intwe tore nabarori abange buna igo, batoetanaine buna riire, totugute are kera egurube, na ebibe biria bitobwatete. Tominyoke noboremereria ase okoamererania koria kobekire bosio bwaito,
swahili: Kwa sababu hii, kwa kuwa tumezungukwa na wingu kubwa namna hii la mashahidi, basi na tuweke kando kila kitu kinachotuzuia na ile dhambi inayotuzinga kwa urahisi, nasi tupige mbio kwa saburi katika yale mashindano yaliyowekwa kwa ajili yetu.

english: Our fathers disciplined us for a short time as they thought best, but God disciplines us for our good, so that we may share in His holiness.
ekegusii: Naki ekeene, abatata baito b’ense nigo batorongeetie ase amatuko amake buna baroche buya, korende ere nigo agotorongeyia ase ogotokonya, erinde tobe ababwatani b’obochenu bwaye.
swahili: Baba zetu walituadibisha kwa kitambo kidogo kama wao wenyewe walivyoona vyema, lakini Mungu hutuadibisha kwa faida yetu ili tupate kushiriki utakatifu wake.

english: No discipline seems enjoyable at the time, but painful. Later on, however, it yields a harvest of righteousness and peace to those who have been trained by it.
ekegusii: Kera okorongeigwa ase engaki yaye gokororekana ng’a tikori egento ki’omogooko, korende neki’omoichano. Korende magega yaye abakonarire banyore okwama kw’omorembe na okw’oboronge.
swahili: Kuadibishwa wakati wowote hakuonekani kuwa kitu cha kufurahisha bali chenye maumivu kinapotekelezwa. Lakini baadaye huzaa matunda ya haki na amani kwa wale waliofunzwa nayo.

english: Therefore strengthen your limp hands and weak knees.
ekegusii: Ase ayio, mobeke chinguru amaboko ayio ororobire, na amaru ayagataire.
swahili: Kwa hiyo, itieni nguvu mikono yenu iliyo dhaifu na magoti yenu yaliyolegea.

english: Make straight paths for your feet, so that the lame may not be disabled, but rather healed. A Call to Holiness (1 Peter 1:13–21)
ekegusii: Mokorere amagoro aino chinchera chindonge, erinde ekere ekerema tikeotoranwa, korende kobua mono kegwenigwe. Ogokuurera kw’ogotaanga obuya bwa Nyasae
swahili: Sawazisheni mapito ya miguu yenu, ili kitu kilicho kiwete kisidhoofishwe bali kiponywe. Onyo Dhidi Ya Kuikataa Neema Ya Mungu

english: Pursue peace with everyone, as well as holiness, without which no one will see the Lord.
ekegusii: Kora omokia koba nomorembe nabaanto bonsi, na rigia obochenu, ekiagera onde tari orarore Omonene, atari naborobwo.
swahili: Tafuteni kwa bidii kuwa na amani na watu wote na huo utakatifu, ambao bila kuwa nao hakuna mtu atakayemwona Bwana.

english: See to it that no one falls short of the grace of God, and that no root of bitterness springs up to cause trouble and defile many.
ekegusii: Morigererie mono ng’a onde taremerwa obuya bwa Nyasae, “omori bw’obororo” tocha gokumbaria na kobachanda, na abanto abange batambokerigwe ogotacheneka ase oyio.
swahili: Angalieni sana mtu yeyote asiikose neema ya Mungu na kwamba shina la uchungu lisije likachipuka na kuwasumbua na watu wengi wakatiwa unajisi kwa hilo.

english: See to it that no one is sexually immoral, or is godless like Esau, who for a single meal sold his birthright.
ekegusii: Morigererie ng’a onde taba omotomani, gose oyotamosigeti Nyasae, buna Esau, oyoonetie omwando oye bw’okoiborwa kw’obotangi ase endagera eyemo.
swahili: Angalieni miongoni mwenu asiwepo mwasherati au mtu asiyemcha Mungu kama Esau, ambaye kwa ajili ya mlo mmoja aliuza haki ya uzaliwa wake wa kwanza.

english: For you know that afterward, when he wanted to inherit the blessing, he was rejected. He could find no ground for repentance, though he sought the blessing with tears. An Unshakable Kingdom (Exodus 20:18–21; Deuteronomy 5:22–33)
ekegusii: Naki mwamanyire buya ng’a ekero achiete korigia omwando bw’ogosesenigwa korwa magega, agakanigwa, naki tanyora ribaga ri’okoonchoka nonya oririgetie mono namariga.
swahili: Baadaye kama mnavyofahamu, alipotaka kurithi ile baraka, alikataliwa, maana hakupata nafasi ya kutubu, ingawa aliitafuta kwa machozi.

english: For you have not come to a mountain that can be touched and that is burning with fire; to darkness, gloom, and storm;
ekegusii: Naki timoraika ase egetunwa keranyare gokunwa, kegwoka omorero, gose omosunte, ne riire rimwamu, na ekembobe,
swahili: Hamjaufikia mlima ule uwezao kuguswa na ambao unawaka moto; wala kwenye giza, utusitusi na dhoruba;

english: to a trumpet blast or to a voice that made its hearers beg that no further word be spoken.
ekegusii: na egeturi ki’egetureeri, na eriogi ri’amang’ana. Abwo bayaigwete bagasorora tibateebigwa ing’ana rinde naende.
swahili: kwenye mlio wa tarumbeta, au kwenye sauti isemayo maneno ya kutisha kiasi ambacho wale walioisikia waliomba wasiambiwe neno jingine zaidi,

english: Let us fix our eyes on Jesus, the author and perfecter of our faith, who for the joy set before Him endured the cross, scorning its shame, and sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.
ekegusii: na korigereria Yeso, omochaki na omoikerania bw’okwegena gwaito. Ribaga ri’omogooko oyobegetwe bosio bwaye, akaremereria omosalaba na gochaaya obosooku, ere nigo aikaransete ensemo ya borio y’ekerogo ki’obonene kia Nyasae.
swahili: Basi na tumtazame sana Yesu mwanzilishi na mkamilishaji wa imani yetu, yeye ambaye kwa ajili ya furaha iliyowekwa mbele yake alistahimili msalaba, bila kujali aibu ya huo msalaba, naye ameketi mkono wa kuume wa kiti cha enzi cha Mungu.

english: For they could not bear what was commanded: “If even an animal touches the mountain, it must be stoned.”
ekegusii: Naki tibanyarete koremereria ring’ana riria riachiigetwe, “Nonya neng’iti eise gokuna egetunwa nabo eraakwe amagena.”
swahili: kwa sababu hawangeweza kustahimili neno lile lililoamriwa: “Hata kama mnyama atagusa mlima huu, atapigwa mawe.”

english: The sight was so terrifying that even Moses said, “I am trembling with fear.”
ekegusii: Aya arorekanete igo arenge ay’okwoboyia, goika Musa agateeba, “Nabwatirwe nomoondoko na okoiguswa.”
swahili: Waliyoyaona yalikuwa ya kutisha kiasi kwamba Mose alisema, “Ninatetemeka kwa hofu.”

english: Instead, you have come to Mount Zion, to the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem. You have come to myriads of angels
ekegusii: Korende inwe mwaikire egetunwa gekorokwa Sayoni, na omochie o Nyasae ore moyo, Yerusalemu ya igoro, na abamalaika abange batari kobareka,
swahili: Lakini ninyi mmekuja Mlima Sayuni, Yerusalemu ya mbinguni, mji wa Mungu aliye hai. Mmekuja penye kusanyiko kubwa la malaika maelfu kwa maelfu wasiohesabika wanaoshangilia,

english: in joyful assembly, to the congregation of the firstborn, enrolled in heaven. You have come to God the Judge of all, to the spirits of the righteous made perfect,
ekegusii: na omosangererekano bw’omoyega, na omosangererekano bw’abaiborwa b’eritang’ani, abwo amarieta abo ariikire igoro, na Nyasae oyore omogambi bw’abaanto bonsi, na emeika y’abanto abanyene oboronge abaikeraniigwe,
swahili: kwenye kanisa la wazaliwa wa kwanza wa Mungu, ambao majina yao yameandikwa mbinguni. Mmekuja kwa Mungu, mhukumu wa watu wote, kwenye roho za wenye haki waliokamilishwa,

english: to Jesus the mediator of a new covenant, and to the sprinkled blood that speaks a better word than the blood of Abel.
ekegusii: na Yeso oyore omobwatania bw’okobwatana okoyia, na amanyinga akonyororokerigwa ayagokwana buya kobua aria ay’Abeli.
swahili: kwa Yesu mpatanishi wa agano jipya, na kwa damu iliyonyunyizwa, ile inenayo mambo mema kuliko damu ya Abeli.

english: See to it that you do not refuse Him who speaks. For if the people did not escape when they refused Him who warned them on earth, how much less will we escape if we reject Him who warns us from heaven?
ekegusii: Rigereria, timomwanga ere oyogokwana. Naki onye baria tibetooretie baria bamwangete ere oyobakuurerete ase ense, kobua mono intwe titogwetooria onye tokomwanga ere oyogotokuurera korwa igoro.
swahili: Angalieni, msije mkamkataa yeye anenaye. Ikiwa wao hawakuepuka adhabu walipomkataa yeye aliyewaonya hapa duniani, sisi je, tutaokokaje tusipomsikiliza yeye anayetuonya kutoka mbinguni?

english: At that time His voice shook the earth, but now He has promised, “Once more I will shake not only the earth, but heaven as well.”
ekegusii: Na eriogi riaye ndiatengechetie ense ekero keria, korende bono oriire eira, ogoteeba, “Ara rimo naende nintengechie ense, gose tari ense yoka, korende na igoro boigo.”
swahili: Wakati ule sauti yake ilitetemesha dunia, lakini sasa ameahidi, “Kwa mara moja tena nitatetemesha si nchi tu bali na mbingu pia.”

english: The words “Once more” signify the removal of what can be shaken—that is, created things—so that the unshakable may remain.
ekegusii: Korende ring’ana eri, “Ara rimo naende”, nigo rikoorokia, ng’a ebinto biria bigotengechigwa nigo birang’anyigwe ekiagera biatongetwe, erinde ebitanyare gotengechigwa bibeo.
swahili: Maneno haya “kwa mara moja tena” yanaonyesha kuondoshwa kwa vile vitu vinavyoweza kutetemeshwa, yaani vile vitu vilivyoumbwa, kwa kusudi vile tu visivyoweza kutetemeshwa vibaki.

english: Therefore, since we are receiving an unshakable kingdom, let us be filled with gratitude, and so worship God acceptably with reverence and awe.
ekegusii: Gaki, ekiagera twanyorire oborwoti obotanyare gotengechigwa, tiga toiranerie ng’a mbuya mono na komokorera Nyasae ase okomogokia amo namasikani na okoiroka.
swahili: Kwa hiyo, kwa kuwa tunapokea ufalme ambao hauwezi kutetemeshwa, basi na tuwe na shukrani, na hivyo tumwabudu Mungu kwa namna inayompendeza, kwa unyenyekevu na uchaji,

english: “For our God is a consuming fire.”
ekegusii: Naki Nyasae oito nomorero okoria na gosiria.
swahili: kwa kuwa “Mungu wetu ni moto ulao.”

english: Consider Him who endured such hostility from sinners, so that you will not grow weary and lose heart. God Disciplines His Sons
ekegusii: Gaki, morengererie mono ere oyoremereretie oboengereria buna obwo bokorwa ase abanyene ebibe igoro yaye ere omonyene, timocha kwebutokania na gokwa emioyo yaino.
swahili: Mtafakarini sana yeye aliyestahimili upinzani mkuu namna hii kutoka kwa watu wenye dhambi, ili kwamba msije mkachoka na kukata tamaa.

english: In your struggle against sin, you have not yet resisted to the point of shedding your blood.
ekegusii: Timorarwana esegi goika mwaiteire amanyinga aino ase okoamererania nebibe,
swahili: Katika kushindana kwenu dhidi ya dhambi, bado hamjapigana kiasi cha kumwaga damu yenu.

english: And you have forgotten the exhortation that addresses you as sons: “My son, do not take lightly the discipline of the Lord, and do not lose heart when He rebukes you.
ekegusii: naende mwebire ogosorora koria kogokwana nainwe buna abana, “Omwana one, tochaya ogoakwa kw’Omonene kw’ogokorongeyia, gose tokwa omoyo karakoe egesusuro.
swahili: Nanyi mmesahau yale maneno ya kuwaonya yanayowataja ninyi kuwa wana, yakisema: “Mwanangu, usidharau adhabu ya Bwana, wala usikate tamaa akikukemea,

english: For the Lord disciplines the one He loves, and He chastises every son He receives.”
ekegusii: Naki ere oyo Omonene anchete nigo akomoorongeyia, na kong’wania bororo omwana oyo obeire oyoye.”
swahili: kwa sababu Bwana huwaadibisha wale awapendao, na humwadhibu kila mmoja anayemkubali kuwa mwana.”

english: Endure suffering as discipline; God is treating you as sons. For what son is not disciplined by his father?
ekegusii: Ekero mokorongeigwa moremererie Nyasae nigo akobakorera buna abana baye. Naki, mwana ki otari korongeigwa na ise?
swahili: Vumilieni taabu kwa ajili ya kufunzwa adabu. Mungu anawatendea ninyi kama watoto wake, kwa maana ni mtoto yupi asiyeadibishwa na mzazi wake?

english: If you do not experience discipline like everyone else, then you are illegitimate children and not true sons.
ekegusii: Korende onye mokoba motari nokorongeigwa oko bonsi babwataine nakorokwo, rirorio nigo more abana ebimeru gose tari abana ba boronge.
swahili: Kama hakuna kuadibishwa (ambalo ni fungu la watoto wote), basi ninyi ni watoto wa haramu wala si watoto halali.

english: Furthermore, we have all had earthly fathers who disciplined us, and we respected them. Should we not much more submit to the Father of our spirits and live?
ekegusii: Amo nayio ntwarenge nabatata baito b’ense eye, baare gotorongeyia, na barabwo ntwabasigete. Inee! Tari buya mono kobua kwebeka inse ya Tata bw’emeika yaito, na koba moyo?
swahili: Tena, sisi sote tunao baba wa kimwili, waliotuadibisha nasi tukawaheshimu kwa ajili ya hilo. Je, si inatupasa kujinyenyekeza zaidi kwa Baba wa roho zetu ili tuishi?

english: Continue in brotherly love.
ekegusii: Mogenderere nobwanchani inwe ase inwe.
swahili: Endeleeni kupendana kama ndugu.

english: We have an altar from which those who serve at the tabernacle have no right to eat.
ekegusii: Ntore negesasiimero aase baria bagokorera Eema batari ne ribaga koria ebinto bikoruegwa aroro.
swahili: Sisi tunayo madhabahu ambayo wale wanaohudumu katika hema hawana haki ya kula vile vitu vilivyowekwa juu yake.

english: Although the high priest brings the blood of animals into the Holy Place as a sacrifice for sin, the bodies are burned outside the camp.
ekegusii: Naki emebere ye ching’iti chiria amanyinga abo are korentwa ime Aase Aachenu n’Omokuani omonene ase engencho y’ebibe, nigo yare gosamberwa isiko y’omochie.
swahili: Kuhani mkuu huchukua damu ya wanyama na kuiingiza Patakatifu pa Patakatifu, kama sadaka ya dhambi, lakini miili ya hao wanyama huteketezwa nje ya kambi.

english: And so Jesus also suffered outside the city gate, to sanctify the people by His own blood.
ekegusii: Ase ayio, Yeso nere agachanderwa isiko y’egeita, erinde achene abanto namanyinga aye ere omonyene.
swahili: Vivyo hivyo, Yesu naye aliteswa nje ya lango la mji ili awatakase watu kwa damu yake mwenyewe.

english: Therefore let us go to Him outside the camp, bearing the disgrace He bore.
ekegusii: Ase ayio, togende asare isiko y’omochie, tobwatane nere ase okoramwa kwaye,
swahili: Kwa hiyo, basi na tumwendee nje ya kambi, tukiichukua aibu aliyobeba.

english: For here we do not have a permanent city, but we are looking for the city that is to come. Sacrifice, Obedience, and Prayer
ekegusii: ekiagera aiga titori nomochie oragenderere, korende nigo tokorigia oria orache gocha.
swahili: Kwa kuwa hapa hatuna mji udumuo, bali tunautafuta ule ujao.

english: Through Jesus, therefore, let us continually offer to God a sacrifice of praise, the fruit of lips that confess His name.
ekegusii: Gaki, goetera asare togenderere koa Nyasae ekeng’wanso gi’okomotogia, engencho yaye okwama kw’emenwa yaito eyekoorokia erieta riaye.
swahili: Basi kwa njia ya Yesu, tuzidi kumtolea Mungu dhabihu ya sifa, yaani matunda ya midomo inayolikiri Jina lake.

english: And do not neglect to do good and to share with others, for with such sacrifices God is pleased.
ekegusii: Timweba gokora amaya, na gosanga nabande, naki ebing’wanso binga buna ebi nabio bikomogwenera Nyasae.
swahili: Na msiache kutenda mema na kushirikiana vile vitu mlivyo navyo, kwa kuwa dhabihu kama hizo ndizo zinazompendeza Mungu.

english: Obey your leaders and submit to them, for they watch over your souls as those who must give an account. To this end, allow them to lead with joy and not with grief, for that would be of no advantage to you.
ekegusii: Moigwere abwo bakobatang’ana, na mobasike, ekiagera barabwo nigo barendete emioyo yaino buna abanto barache korua omobaro, erinde banyare gokora ayio ase omogooko. Onye bagocha koyakora ase okweumia anga taba na gokonywa konde ase more.
swahili: Watiini viongozi wenu na kujinyenyekeza chini ya mamlaka yao. Kwa maana wao wanakesha kwa ajili yenu kama watu watakaopaswa kutoa hesabu. Watiini ili wafanye kazi yao kwa furaha, wala si kama mzigo, maana hiyo haitakuwa na faida kwenu.

english: Pray for us; we are convinced that we have a clear conscience and desire to live honorably in every way.
ekegusii: Tosabere, naki ntore nobomaene ng’a chinkoro chiaito tichigotogambia, ntorigetie koba norogendo oruya ase amang’ana onsi.
swahili: Tuombeeni. Tuna hakika kuwa tunayo dhamiri safi na shauku ya kuishi kwa uadilifu kwa kila njia.

english: And I especially urge you to pray that I may be restored to you soon. Benediction and Farewell
ekegusii: Na inche nabasoroire mono kobua gokora ayio, erinde ng’iranigwe ase more bwango. Ogosesenigwa na ogokwania kw’ogokoorera
swahili: Ninawasihi zaidi mniombee ili nipate kurudishwa kwenu upesi. Maombi Ya Kuwatakia Baraka

english: Do not neglect to show hospitality to strangers, for by so doing some people have entertained angels without knowing it.
ekegusii: Timweba koroisia abageni, naki ase enchera eye abande mbaroisetie abamalaika, batamanyete.
swahili: Msisahau kuwakaribisha wageni, kwa kuwa kwa kufanya hivyo, watu wengine waliwakaribisha malaika pasipo kujua.

english: Now may the God of peace, who through the blood of the eternal covenant brought back from the dead our Lord Jesus, that great Shepherd of the sheep,
ekegusii: Bono Nyasae bw’omorembe oyomorentete naende korwa ase amakweri Omonene oito Yeso, oyore omorisia omonene bwe ching’ondi goetera ase amanyinga y’okobwatana gwa kare na kare,
swahili: Basi Mungu wa amani, ambaye kwa damu ya Agano la milele alimleta tena kutoka kwa wafu Bwana wetu Yesu, yule Mchungaji Mkuu wa kondoo,

english: equip you with every good thing to do His will. And may He accomplish in us what is pleasing in His sight through Jesus Christ, to whom be glory forever and ever. Amen.
ekegusii: ere abakore mobe abaikeranu ase kera ogokora okuya, monyare gokora obwanchani bwaye, naende akore ime yaino ayagwenerete ase obosio bwaye goetera ase Yeso Kristo. Asare ere obonene bwa kare na kare. Amina.
swahili: awafanye ninyi wakamilifu mkiwa mmekamilishwa katika kila jambo jema ili mpate kutenda mapenzi yake, naye atende ndani yetu kile kinachompendeza machoni Pake, kwa njia ya Yesu Kristo, ambaye utukufu una yeye milele na milele. Amen. Maneno Ya Mwisho Na Salamu

english: I urge you, brothers, to bear with my word of exhortation, for I have only written to you briefly.
ekegusii: Abaminto, nababoririe, moremererie ring’ana eri ri’ogosorora, ekiagera nabarikeire ase amang’ana amake.
swahili: Ndugu zangu, nawasihi mchukuliane na maneno yangu ya maonyo, kwa kuwa nimewaandikia waraka mfupi tu.

english: Be aware that our brother Timothy has been released. If he arrives soon, I will come with him to see you.
ekegusii: Manya ng’a oyominto Timotheo oikire gosiborwa. Amo nere ntoche kobarora karache bwango.
swahili: Nataka ninyi mjue kwamba ndugu yetu Timotheo amefunguliwa kutoka gerezani. Akifika mapema, nitakuja pamoja naye kuwaona.

english: Greet all your leaders and all the saints. Those from Italy send you greetings.
ekegusii: Nkwanerie abwo bonsi bakobatang’ana, na abachenu bonsi. Abwo baruete Italia baabakwanirie.
swahili: Wasalimuni viongozi wenu wote na watakatifu wote. Wale wa kutoka Italia wanawasalimu.

english: Grace be with all of you.
ekegusii: Obuya bobe amo nainwe mwensi. Amina.
swahili: Neema iwe nanyi nyote. Amen.

english: Remember those in prison as if you were bound with them, and those who are mistreated as if you were suffering with them.
ekegusii: Inyora abwo basibire ase echela, buna nainwe mosibire amo nabarabwo, naende barabwo mbakoreretwe bobe, ekiagera naboigo nainwe more nomobere.
swahili: Wakumbukeni wale waliofungwa gerezani kana kwamba ninyi mmefungwa pamoja nao. Pia wakumbukeni wale wanaotendewa vibaya, kana kwamba ni ninyi wenyewe mnateswa.

english: Marriage should be honored by all and the marriage bed kept undefiled, for God will judge the sexually immoral and adulterers. Christ’s Unchanging Nature
ekegusii: Okonyuomana gosikwe nabaanto bonsi, na ebiraarero bibe bitari nobosooku, naki abanyaka na abatomani Nyasae nabagaambie ekiina.
swahili: Ndoa na iheshimiwe na watu wote, nayo malazi yawe safi, kwa kuwa Mungu atawahukumu wazinzi na waasherati wote.

english: Keep your lives free from the love of money and be content with what you have, for God has said: “Never will I leave you, never will I forsake you.”
ekegusii: Timoba abanchi chitaabu, moisaneke nebi more nabio, ekiagera ere omonyene oteebire, “Tinkogotiga nonya ng’ake, gose tingokoremera.”
swahili: Yalindeni maisha yenu msiwe na tabia ya kupenda fedha, bali mridhike na vile mlivyo navyo, kwa sababu Mungu amesema, “Kamwe sitakuacha, wala sitakupungukia.”

english: So we say with confidence: “The Lord is my helper; I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?”
ekegusii: Ase ayio, ntonyare goteeba noboremu, “Omonene nere omokonyi one, tinkwoboa. Mwanyabaanto, inki arankorere?”
swahili: Kwa hiyo tunaweza kusema kwa ujasiri, “Bwana ni msaada wangu; sitaogopa. Mwanadamu anaweza kunitenda nini?”

english: Remember your leaders who spoke the word of God to you. Consider the outcome of their way of life and imitate their faith.
ekegusii: Inyora abwo baare kobatang’ana, abaabateebetie ring’ana ria Nyasae. Naende morengererie mono omoerio bw’obogima bwabo, mobe abegi b’okwegena kwabo.
swahili: Wakumbukeni viongozi wenu, wale waliowaambia neno la Mungu. Angalieni matokeo ya mwenendo wa maisha yao mkaiige imani yao.

english: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday and today and forever.
ekegusii: Yeso Kristo buna arenge igoro, na buna are reero, nabo arabe goika kare na kare.
swahili: Yesu Kristo ni yeye yule jana, leo na hata milele.

english: Do not be carried away by all kinds of strange teachings, for it is good for the heart to be strengthened by grace and not by foods of no value to those devoted to them.
ekegusii: Timoirwa bogeka namorokererio ao ao, ayare ay’ekegeni, ekiagera mbuya chinkoro chibekwe chinguru ase obuya, gose tari ase emeroberio y’okoria endagera ase eyio barabwo bagendererete neyio tibanyora gokonywa konde.
swahili: Msichukuliwe na kila aina ya mafundisho ya kigeni. Ni vyema mioyo yenu iimarishwe kwa neema, wala si kwa sheria kuhusu utaratibu wa vyakula, ambavyo havina faida kwa wale wanaozishika hizo sheria.

english: On many past occasions and in many different ways, God spoke to our fathers through the prophets.
ekegusii: Agwo kare, Nyasae nigo are gokwana n’echisokoro chiaito ebiro ebinge ne chinchera chinyinge goetera ase ababani,
swahili: Zamani Mungu alisema na baba zetu kwa njia ya manabii mara nyingi na kwa njia mbalimbali,

english: And: “In the beginning, O Lord, You laid the foundations of the earth, and the heavens are the work of Your hands.
ekegusii: Naende agateeba. “Naye Omonene, kwabegete oboroso bw’ense korwa omochakano, na igoro chionsi nemeremo y’amaboko ao.
swahili: Pia asema, “Hapo mwanzo, Ee Bwana, uliweka misingi ya dunia, nazo mbingu ni kazi ya mikono yako.

english: They will perish, but You remain; they will all wear out like a garment.
ekegusii: Ebio inabisire, korende aye nigo oragenderere kobao, birobio inabigote buna chianga,
swahili: Hizo zitatoweka, lakini wewe utadumu; zote zitachakaa kama vazi.

english: You will roll them up like a robe; like a garment they will be changed; but You remain the same, and Your years will never end.”
ekegusii: nobiringe buna egetambaa gi’okwambara, na birobio nabionchoke buna chianga. Korende aye naye oria oria ore buna kwarenge, na obogima bwao tibokoba nomoerio.”
swahili: Utazikungʼutakungʼuta kama joho, nazo zitachakaa kama vazi. Lakini wewe hubadiliki, nayo miaka yako haikomi kamwe.”

english: Yet to which of the angels did God ever say: “Sit at My right hand until I make Your enemies a footstool for Your feet”?
ekegusii: Nyasae tatebeti onde ase abamalaika baye: “Ikaransa ensemo y’okoboko kwane gw’okorio, goika mbabeeke ababisa bao babe inse y’amagoro ao”?
swahili: Je, ni kwa malaika yupi ambaye Mungu amepata kumwambia wakati wowote, “Keti mkono wangu wa kuume, hadi nitakapowaweka adui zako chini ya miguu yako”?

english: Are not the angels ministering spirits sent to serve those who will inherit salvation?
ekegusii: Abamalaika ngento ki gotatiga emeika y’ogokorera Nyasae, batomire gokorera baria barache konyora omwando bw’ogotooreka?
swahili: Je, malaika wote si roho watumikao, waliotumwa kuwahudumia wale watakaourithi wokovu?

english: But in these last days He has spoken to us by His Son, whom He appointed heir of all things, and through whom He made the universe.
ekegusii: korende ase amatuko aya y’omoerio okwanire naintwe goetera ase Omwana oye. Ere oyo Nyasae aragete koba omonyamwando bw’ebinto bionsi, na goetera asare agatonga ense.
swahili: lakini katika siku hizi za mwisho anasema nasi kwa njia ya Mwanawe, ambaye amemweka kuwa mrithi wa vitu vyote, na ambaye kupitia kwake aliuumba ulimwengu.

english: The Son is the radiance of God’s glory and the exact representation of His nature, upholding all things by His powerful word. After He had provided purification for sins, He sat down at the right hand of the Majesty on high.
ekegusii: Ere nigo agotobareria obonene bwa Nyasae, na buna Nyasae are, nere naboigo are, naende nigo akobogoria ebinto bionsi ne ring’ana riaye ri’okobua. Gaikire gokora ogosibigwa kw’ebibe, agaikaransa ensemo y’okoboko gw’okorio kw’Obonene igoro. Obonene bw’Omwana o Nyasae
swahili: Mwana ni mngʼao wa utukufu wa Mungu na mfano halisi wa nafsi yake, akivihifadhi vitu vyote kwa neno lake lenye uweza. Akiisha kufanya utakaso kwa ajili ya dhambi, aliketi mkono wa kuume wa Aliye Mkuu huko mbinguni.

english: So He became as far superior to the angels as the name He has inherited is excellent beyond theirs.
ekegusii: Omwana agakorwa koba omonene kobua abamalaika, buna erieta eri anyorete ri’omwando rire rinene kobua ayabo.
swahili: Kwa hiyo alifanyika bora kuliko malaika, kama jina alilorithi lilivyo bora kuliko lao.

english: For to which of the angels did God ever say: “You are My Son; today I have become Your Father”? Or again: “I will be His Father, and He will be My Son”?
ekegusii: Ekiagera Nyasae tatebetie momalaika onde bwensi, “Aye, naye Omwana one, reero nakoiboire”? Gose naende, “Inche nimbe asare ise, nere ase ’nde nabe Omwana one”?
swahili: Kwa maana ni malaika yupi ambaye wakati wowote Mungu alipata kumwambia, “Wewe ni Mwanangu; leo mimi nimekuzaa?” Au tena, “Mimi nitakuwa Baba yake, naye atakuwa Mwanangu?”

english: And again, when God brings His firstborn into the world, He says: “Let all God’s angels worship Him.”
ekegusii: Korende ekero Nyasae arenge ange gotoma Omwana oye omotangi gocha ase ense, nigo atebete: “Abamalaika bonsi ba Nyasae goika bamosasime.”
swahili: Tena, Mungu amletapo mzaliwa wake wa kwanza ulimwenguni, anasema, “Malaika wote wa Mungu na wamsujudu.”

english: Now about the angels He says: “He makes His angels winds, His servants flames of fire.”
ekegusii: Korende igoro y’abamalaika Nyasae nigo agoteeba, “Nyasae nigo agokora Abamalaika baye koba chimbeo, na abasomba baye koba ebibemberi b’omorero.”
swahili: Anenapo kuhusu malaika asema, “Huwafanya malaika wake kuwa pepo, watumishi wake kuwa miali ya moto.”

english: But about the Son He says: “Your throne, O God, endures forever and ever, and justice is the scepter of Your kingdom.
ekegusii: Korende igoro y’Omwana Nyasae agateeba, “Oboruoti bwao aye Nyasae, mbobeo kare na kare, nigo okogambera abanto bao ase oboronge.
swahili: Lakini kwa habari za Mwana asema, “Kiti chako cha enzi, Ee Mungu, kitadumu milele na milele, nayo haki itakuwa fimbo ya utawala ya ufalme wako.

english: You have loved righteousness and hated wickedness; therefore God, Your God, has anointed You above Your companions with the oil of joy.”
ekegusii: Nigo bwanchete oboronge, na kogechete ogosaria; ase ayio, Nyasae, oyore Nyasae oo, ogoakire amaguta, okorenteire omogooko kobua oyo bw’abande bamino.”
swahili: Umependa haki na kuchukia uovu; kwa hiyo Mungu, Mungu wako, amekuweka juu ya wenzako kwa kukupaka mafuta ya furaha.”

english: We must pay closer attention, therefore, to what we have heard, so that we do not drift away.
ekegusii: Ase ayio, netogwenerete gotegerera mono kobua na kobwata ayatwaigure, titocha gosira.
swahili: Kwa hiyo, imetupasa kuwa waangalifu sana kuhusu kile tulichosikia, ili tusije tukakiacha.

english: In bringing many sons to glory, it was fitting for God, for whom and through whom all things exist, to make the author of their salvation perfect through suffering.
ekegusii: Naki ase engencho ya Nyasae, na ase okobua kwaye, ebinto bionsi mbireo. Ase ayio yamogwenerete ere goikerania Omochaki bw’ogotooreka gwaito goetera ase emechando, erio aire abana abange ase obonene. Ekiagera Yeso nere okoraa gochia ogotoreka
swahili: Ili kuwaleta wana wengi katika utukufu, ilifaa kwamba Mungu, ambaye ni kwa ajili yake na kupitia kwake kila kitu kimekuwepo, amkamilishe mwanzilishi wa wokovu wao kwa njia ya mateso.

english: For both the One who sanctifies and those who are sanctified are of the same family. So Jesus is not ashamed to call them brothers.
ekegusii: Naki ere oyogochena amo nabwo bagochenwa nigo babwate ise oyomo. Nakio gekogera Yeso atari korora obosoku kobaroka abamwabo.
swahili: Yeye awafanyaye watu kuwa watakatifu, pamoja na hao ambao hufanywa watakatifu, wote hutoka katika jamaa moja. Hivyo Yesu haoni aibu kuwaita ndugu zake.

english: He says: “I will proclaim Your name to My brothers; I will sing Your praises in the assembly.”
ekegusii: Agateebia Nyasae, “Nindarie erieta riao ase abaminto, ase egati y’omosangererekano ningotogie ase ogoteera.”
swahili: Yeye husema, “Nitalitangaza jina lako kwa ndugu zangu; mbele ya kusanyiko nitaimba sifa zako.”

english: And again: “I will put My trust in Him.” And once again: “Here am I, and the children God has given Me.”
ekegusii: Naende nigo agoteeba, “Nimosemerie Nyasae.” Naende oteeba, “Rora, inche nao inde aiga amo nabana baria naetwe na Nyasae.”
swahili: Tena, “Nitaweka tumaini langu kwake.” Tena anasema, “Niko hapa, pamoja na watoto ambao Mungu amenipa.”

english: Now since the children have flesh and blood, He too shared in their humanity, so that by His death He might destroy him who holds the power of death, that is, the devil,
ekegusii: Ase ayio, ekiagera abana buna akobaroka babwataine ase amanyinga ne chinyama, Yeso naboigo abwataine nayio ayio, erio ase enchera y’amakweri asirie ere oyore nokobua igoro y’amakweri, engencho yaye Saitani,
swahili: Basi kwa kuwa watoto wana nyama na damu, yeye pia alishiriki katika ubinadamu wao, ili kwa kifo chake, apate kumwangamiza huyo mwenye nguvu za mauti, yaani ibilisi,

english: and free those who all their lives were held in slavery by their fear of death.
ekegusii: naende ase enchera eyio asibore abwo bonsi barenge abasomba ase obogima bwabo bwonsi, ekiagera bairogete amakweri.
swahili: na kuwaweka huru wale waliokuwa utumwani maisha yao yote kwa sababu ya kuogopa mauti.

english: For surely it is not the angels He helps, but the descendants of Abraham.
ekegusii: Naki ayio namaene, ere tagwechandera abamalaika, korende nigo agwechandera oroiboro rwa Aburaamu.
swahili: Kwa kuwa ni dhahiri kwamba hakuja kusaidia malaika, bali uzao wa Abrahamu.

english: For this reason He had to be made like His brothers in every way, so that He might become a merciful and faithful high priest in service to God, in order to make atonement for the sins of the people.
ekegusii: Ase ayio, yamogwenerete abe buna abamwabo ase amang’ana onsi, erinde anyare koba Omokuani omonene, Omonyene amaabera, na omwegenwa ase ogokorera Nyasae, na koba ekeng’wanso gi’okobwatania ase ebibe bia Mwanyabaanto.
swahili: Kwa sababu hii ilibidi afanane na ndugu zake kwa kila hali, ili apate kuwa Kuhani Mkuu mwenye huruma na mwaminifu katika kumtumikia Mungu, ili pia apate kufanya upatanisho kwa ajili ya dhambi za watu.

english: Because He Himself suffered when He was tempted, He is able to help those who are being tempted.
ekegusii: Ekiagera ere omonyene achandetwe na goteemwa, nanyare gokonya abwo bagoteemwa.
swahili: Kwa kuwa yeye mwenyewe aliteswa alipojaribiwa, aweza kuwasaidia wale wanaojaribiwa.

english: For if the message spoken by angels was binding, and every transgression and disobedience received its just punishment,
ekegusii: Ring’ana riria riakwanetwe gochia ase Chisokoro chiaito nabamalaika nigo riarenge eri’ekeene, na kera oyotaribwatetie gose korigwera nigo anyorete egesusuro keria kiamobwenerete.
swahili: Kwa kuwa kama ujumbe ulionenwa na malaika ulikuwa imara, na kila uasi na kutokutii kulipata adhabu ya haki,

english: how shall we escape if we neglect such a great salvation? This salvation was first announced by the Lord, was confirmed to us by those who heard Him,
ekegusii: Inee, naki intwe toranyare gwetooria onye twangire ogotooreka okonene buna oko? Ritang’ani Omonene naraaretie ogotooreka oko, naende baria bamoigwete batoenekeirie buna n’eriekeene.
swahili: je, sisi tutapaje kupona kama tusipojali wokovu mkuu namna hii? Wokovu huu, ambao mwanzo ulitangazwa na Bwana, ulithibitishwa kwetu na wale waliomsikia.

english: and was affirmed by God through signs, wonders, various miracles, and gifts of the Holy Spirit distributed according to His will. Jesus like His Brothers
ekegusii: Naende Nyasae akamenta oborori bwaye nebimanyererio, na amakumia, na ebikone bie chinguru ao ao amo na kogabera abanto ebiegwa bi’Omoika Omochenu koreng’ana nogwancha kwaye. Oria ogotoraa gochia ase ogotooreka
swahili: Pia Mungu aliushuhudia kwa ishara, maajabu na kwa miujiza mbalimbali, na karama za Roho Mtakatifu alizozigawa kulingana na mapenzi yake. Yesu Alifananishwa Na Ndugu Zake

english: For it is not to angels that He has subjected the world to come, about which we are speaking.
ekegusii: Naki tari inse y’abamalaika Nyasae abegete Ense eria egochi‐gocha, eyio togokwana.
swahili: Mungu hakuuweka ulimwengu ujao ambao tunanena habari zake chini ya malaika.

english: But somewhere it is testified in these words: “What is man that You are mindful of him, or the son of man that You care for him?
ekegusii: Korende nigo egotebekana aase gete ase amariiko: “Mwanyabaanto inki aisaine aye Nyasae ogendererete komorengereria? Mwanyabaanto inki aisaine aye okomorenda?
swahili: Lakini kuna mahali mtu fulani ameshuhudia akisema: “Mwanadamu ni kitu gani hata unamfikiria, binadamu ni nani hata unamjali?

english: You made him a little lower than the angels; You crowned him with glory and honor
ekegusii: Kwamokorire omoke kobua abamalaika ase ekero egeke, kwamobekeire egutwa y’obonene na amasikani.
swahili: Umemfanya chini kidogo kuliko malaika; ukamvika taji ya utukufu na heshima,

english: and placed everything under his feet.” When God subjected all things to him, He left nothing outside of his control. Yet at present we do not see everything subject to him.
ekegusii: Okabakora koba abateneneri igoro ase ebinto bionsi.” Naki ase okobeeka ebinto bionsi inse yaye tatigete gento kende atabegete inse yaye. Korende goika bono titorarora ere okogambera ebinto bionsi bibekire inse yaye.
swahili: nawe umeweka vitu vyote chini ya miguu yake.” Kwa kuweka vitu vyote chini yake, Mungu hakuacha kitu chochote ambacho hakukiweka chini ya mwanadamu. Lakini kwa sasa, hatuoni kwamba kila kitu kiko chini yake.

english: But we see Jesus, who was made a little lower than the angels, now crowned with glory and honor because He suffered death, so that by the grace of God He might taste death for everyone.
ekegusii: Korende twarorire Yeso oyio ase ekero egeke okoretwe koba omoke kobua abamalaika, erio goetera ase obuya bwa Nyasae akwe ase engencho ya kera omonto. Bono nigo tokomorora obekeirwe egutwa y’obonene na amasikani ase engencho y’ogochandwa kwaye kw’amakweri.
swahili: Lakini twamwona Yesu, aliyefanywa chini kidogo kuliko malaika, sasa akiwa amevikwa taji ya utukufu na heshima kwa sababu alistahimili mauti, ili kwamba kwa neema ya Mungu apate kuonja mauti kwa ajili ya kila mtu.

english: Therefore, holy brothers, who share in the heavenly calling, set your focus on Jesus, the apostle and high priest whom we confess.
ekegusii: Ase ayio, abaminto abachenu, ababwatani b’okorangerigwa gokorwa igoro, morengererie mono Yeso omotomwa na Omokuani Omonene bw’okoorokia gwaito.
swahili: Kwa hiyo ndugu watakatifu, mnaoshiriki mwito wa mbinguni, mtafakarini Yesu, mtume na Kuhani Mkuu wa ukiri wetu.

english: Therefore I was angry with that generation, and I said, ‘Their hearts are always going astray, and they have not known My ways.’
ekegusii: Ase ayio, nkagechigwa nekegori keria, ngateba: Botambe abanto aba nigo basirete ase chinkoro chiabo, ne chinchera chiane tibachimanyeti,
swahili: Hiyo ndiyo sababu nilikasirikia kizazi kile, nami nikasema, ‘Siku zote mioyo yao imepotoka, nao hawajazijua njia zangu.’

english: So I swore on oath in My anger, ‘They shall never enter My rest.’” The Peril of Unbelief
ekegusii: buna natianire ase endamwamu yane: Tibagosoa ense eria ase nare gocha kobaa ogotimoka.”
swahili: Hivyo nikatangaza kwa kiapo katika hasira yangu, ‘Kamwe hawataingia rahani mwangu.’ ”

english: See to it, brothers, that none of you has a wicked heart of unbelief that turns away from the living God.
ekegusii: Rigereria baminto, taba onde omo oino oyore nenkoro embe y’ogotegena, abaise kweatanana korwa ase Nyasae ore moyo.
swahili: Ndugu zangu, angalieni, asiwepo miongoni mwenu mtu mwenye moyo mwovu usioamini, unaojitenga na Mungu aliye hai.

english: But exhort one another daily, as long as it is called today, so that none of you may be hardened by sin’s deceitfulness.
ekegusii: Korende moremanie inwe ase inwe kera rituko, ekero gekorokwa ekia Reero, erinde ase, more onde takorwa koba omokong’u ase obong’ainereria bw’ebibe.
swahili: Lakini mtiane moyo mtu na mwenzake kila siku, maadamu iitwapo Leo, ili asiwepo hata mmoja wenu mwenye kufanywa mgumu kwa udanganyifu wa dhambi.

english: We have come to share in Christ if we hold firmly to the end the assurance we had at first.
ekegusii: Naki twabeire ababwatani na Kristo, gatorabwate bokong’u ogosemeria gwaito kw’eritang’ani goika omoerio.
swahili: Kwa kuwa tumekuwa washiriki wa Kristo, kama tukishikamana tu kwa uthabiti na tumaini letu la kwanza hadi mwisho.

english: As it has been said: “Today, if you hear His voice, do not harden your hearts, as you did in the rebellion.”
ekegusii: Agwo igo egokwanwa, “Reero, komoraigwe eriogi ria Nyasae, timokong’ia chinkoro chiaino’ buna ekero keria gi’okogechia.”
swahili: Kama ilivyonenwa: “Leo, kama mkiisikia sauti yake, msiifanye mioyo yenu migumu kama mlivyofanya wakati wa kuasi.”

english: For who were the ones who heard and rebelled? Were they not all those Moses led out of Egypt?
ekegusii: Naki mbarabi baria bamogechetie ekero baigwete? Tari baria bonsi barwete Misiri, baare koraagwa na Musa?
swahili: Basi ni nani waliosikia lakini bado wakaasi? Je, si wale wote waliotoka Misri wakiongozwa na Mose?

english: And with whom was God angry for forty years? Was it not with those who sinned, whose bodies fell in the wilderness?
ekegusii: Naende mbarabi abwo ere agechetigwe nabarabwo ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ene? Tari baria bakorete ebibe, abwo emebere yabo yagwete ase erooro?
swahili: Lakini ni nani aliowakasirikia miaka arobaini? Je, si wale waliofanya dhambi ambao miili yao ilianguka jangwani?

english: And to whom did He swear that they would never enter His rest? Was it not to those who disobeyed?
ekegusii: Naende nase barabi atianete ng’a tibagosoa ase ogotimoka kwaye? Tari ase baria bangete koigwera?
swahili: Ni nani hao ambao Mungu aliapa kuwa kamwe hawataingia rahani mwake isipokuwa ni wale waliokataa kutii?

english: So we see that it was because of their unbelief that they were unable to enter.
ekegusii: Na igo twarorire ng’a tibanyarete gosoa ase ense eria ase engencho y’ogotegena kwabo.
swahili: Hivyo tunaona kwamba hawakuweza kuingia kwa sababu ya kutokuamini kwao.

english: He was faithful to the One who appointed Him, just as Moses was faithful in all God’s house.
ekegusii: Ere nigo arenge omwegenwa asare ere oyomochorete, buna Musa boigo arenge omwegenwa ase enyomba yonsi ya Nyasae.
swahili: Alikuwa mwaminifu kwa yeye aliyemweka, kama vile Mose alivyokuwa mwaminifu katika nyumba yote ya Mungu.

english: For Jesus has been counted worthy of greater glory than Moses, just as the builder of a house has greater honor than the house itself.
ekegusii: Naki Yeso nigo abarirwe ng’a nemogwenerete abe nobonene mono kobua Musa, buna omoagachi enyomba are nogosikwa kobua enyomba enyene.
swahili: Yesu ameonekana anastahili heshima kubwa kuliko Mose, kama vile mjenzi wa nyumba alivyo wa heshima kubwa kuliko nyumba yenyewe.

english: And every house is built by someone, but God is the builder of everything.
ekegusii: (Kera enyomba nigo ekoagachwa nomonto, korende Nyasae nere omoagachi bw’ebinto bionsi.)
swahili: Kwa kuwa kila nyumba hujengwa na mtu fulani, lakini Mungu ni mjenzi wa kila kitu.

english: Now Moses was faithful as a servant in all God’s house, testifying to what would be spoken later.
ekegusii: Na Musa nigo arenge omwegenwa ase enyomba yonsi ya Nyasae buna omokoreri, erinde abe kirori ase amang’ana arache gokwanwa,
swahili: Basi Mose kama mtumishi alikuwa mwaminifu katika nyumba yote ya Mungu, akishuhudia kwa yale ambayo yangetamkwa baadaye.

english: But Christ is faithful as the Son over God’s house. And we are His house, if we hold firmly to our confidence and the hope of which we boast. Do Not Harden Your Hearts (Psalms 95:1–11)
ekegusii: korende Kristo nigo are omwegenwa buna Omwana igoro ase enyomba ya Nyasae. Intwe nenyomba yaye gatorabwate bokong’u oboremu na ogwetogia kw’ogosemeria goika omoerio. Ogotimoka kore ase Abanto ba Nyasae
swahili: Lakini Kristo ni mwaminifu kama Mwana katika nyumba ya Mungu. Sisi ndio nyumba yake, kama tutashikilia sana ujasiri wetu na tumaini tunalojivunia. Onyo Dhidi Ya Kutokuamini

english: Therefore, as the Holy Spirit says: “Today, if you hear His voice,
ekegusii: Ase ayio, buna Omoika Omochenu ogokwana, “Reero, komoraigwe eriogi riaye,
swahili: Kwa hiyo, kama Roho Mtakatifu asemavyo: “Leo, kama mkiisikia sauti yake,

english: do not harden your hearts, as you did in the rebellion, in the day of testing in the wilderness,
ekegusii: timokong’ia chinkoro chiaino, buna ekero keria gi’okogechia, ase rituko riria ri’ogoteemwa agwo ase erooro.
swahili: msiifanye mioyo yenu migumu, kama mlivyofanya katika uasi, wakati ule wa kujaribiwa jangwani,

english: where your fathers tested and tried Me, and for forty years saw My works.
ekegusii: Agwo chisokoro chiaino nchianteemete ase okondenga, naende nchiaroche ogokora kwane ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ene.
swahili: ambapo baba zenu walinijaribu na kunipima ingawa kwa miaka arobaini walikuwa wameyaona matendo yangu.

english: Therefore, while the promise of entering His rest still stands, let us be careful that none of you be deemed to have fallen short of it.
ekegusii: Gaki, onye eira eria y’ogosoa ase ogotimoka kwaye ereo, tiga toiroke ng’a onde omo oino tabaisa konyorekana ng’a omochire gokonyora.
swahili: Kwa hiyo, kwa kuwa bado ahadi ya kuingia rahani iko wazi, tujihadhari ili hata mmoja wenu asije akaikosa.

english: For whoever enters God’s rest also rests from his own work, just as God did from His.
ekegusii: Naki ere oyosoire ase ogotimoka kwa Nyasae, ere omonyene otimokire korwa ase emeremo yaye, buna Nyasae atimogete korwa ase eyaye.
swahili: kwa kuwa kila mmoja aingiaye katika raha ya Mungu pia hupumzika kutoka kazi zake mwenyewe, kama vile Mungu alivyopumzika kutoka kazi zake.

english: Let us, therefore, make every effort to enter that rest, so that no one will fall by following the same pattern of disobedience. The Living Word (2 Timothy 3:10–17)
ekegusii: Gaki, tokore omokia gosoa ase ogotimoka koria, erinde onde tacha kogwa ase ogotaigwera kogwekaine koria koria.
swahili: Basi, na tufanye bidii kuingia katika raha hiyo, ili kwamba asiwepo yeyote atakayeanguka kwa kufuata mfano wao wa kutokutii.

english: For the word of God is living and active. Sharper than any double-edged sword, it pierces even to dividing soul and spirit, joints and marrow. It judges the thoughts and intentions of the heart.
ekegusii: Naki ring’ana ria Nyasae nigo rire moyo, naende ndire ne chinguru, nigo rire nobwoge kobua omoyio o birende ore nobwoge chinsemo ibere. Nigo rikobeta ime na gwatanana omoyo na omoika, chinengo na emeseto, naende ndinyare komanya ebirengererio na okogania bire ime ase enkoro.
swahili: Kwa maana Neno la Mungu li hai tena lina nguvu. Lina makali kuliko upanga wowote wenye makali kuwili, hivyo linachoma hata kuzigawanya nafsi na roho, viungo na mafuta yaliyo ndani yake; tena li jepesi kuyatambua mawazo na makusudi ya moyo.

english: Nothing in all creation is hidden from God’s sight; everything is uncovered and exposed before the eyes of Him to whom we must give account.
ekegusii: Naki getongwa kende tikeri getari maiso marore asare, korende ebinto bionsi nigo bire aarabu naende bimaanoire ase amaiso aye, ere oyo torache koa omobaro. Yeso nere Omokuani Omonene Mono
swahili: Wala hakuna kiumbe chochote kilichofichika machoni pa Mungu. Kila kitu kimefunuliwa na kiko wazi machoni pake yeye ambaye kwake ni lazima tutatoa hesabu. Yesu Kristo Kuhani Mkuu Kuliko Wote

english: Therefore, since we have a great high priest who has passed through the heavens, Jesus the Son of God, let us hold firmly to what we profess.
ekegusii: Gaki, ekiagera tore n’Omokuani Omonene mono, oyosoete igoro, Yeso, Omwana o Nyasae, tobwate mono okoorokia gwaito.
swahili: Kwa kuwa tunaye Kuhani Mkuu kuliko wote ambaye ameingia mbinguni, Yesu Mwana wa Mungu, basi na tushikamane sana kwa uthabiti na ule ukiri wa imani yetu.

english: For we do not have a high priest who is unable to sympathize with our weaknesses, but we have one who was tempted in every way that we are, yet was without sin.
ekegusii: Naki titori n’Omokuani Omonene oyotanyare gotobogoreria oboreu bwaito, korende oyoteemetwe koreng’ana buna intwe ase amang’ana onsi, atakoreti ebibe.
swahili: Kwa kuwa hatuna Kuhani Mkuu asiyeweza kuchukuliana na sisi katika udhaifu wetu, lakini tunaye mmoja ambaye alijaribiwa kwa kila namna, kama vile sisi tujaribiwavyo: lakini yeye hakutenda dhambi.

english: Let us then approach the throne of grace with confidence, so that we may receive mercy and find grace to help us in our time of need.
ekegusii: Gaki, toike ang’e ase ekerogo ki’obonene aase obuya bore, erinde tonyore amaabera na obuya bw’ogotokonya ase engaki y’okoremerwa.
swahili: Basi na tukikaribie kiti cha rehema kwa ujasiri, ili tupewe rehema na kupata neema ya kutusaidia wakati wa mahitaji.

english: For we also received the good news just as they did; but the message they heard was of no value to them, since they did not share the faith of those who comprehended it.
ekegusii: Naki ekeene, intwe twaranderigwe amang’ana amaya buna barabwo. Korende ring’ana riria baigwete tiriabakonyete, ekiagera ekero baare koriigwa tiriasang’ananete nabarabwo ase okwegena.
swahili: Kwa maana sisi pia tumesikia Injili iliyohubiriwa kwetu, kama nao walivyosikia; lakini ujumbe ule waliousikia haukuwa na maana kwao, kwa sababu wale waliousikia hawakuuchanganya na imani.

english: Now we who have believed enter that rest. As for the others, it is just as God has said: “So I swore on oath in My anger, ‘They shall never enter My rest.’” And yet His works have been finished since the foundation of the world.
ekegusii: Naki intwe, abatwegenire, nigo torasoe ase ogotimoka okwo agoteeba, “Buna natianire ase endamwamu yane, Tibagosoa ase ogotimoka kwane nonya ng’ake”, nonya emeremo yaye yaerete korwa omochakano, ekero oboroso bw’ense bwabegetwe.
swahili: Sasa sisi ambao tumeamini tunaingia katika ile raha, kama vile Mungu alivyosema, “Kwa hiyo nikaapa katika hasira yangu, ‘Kamwe hawataingia rahani mwangu.’ ” Lakini kazi yake ilikamilika tangu kuumbwa kwa ulimwengu.

english: For somewhere He has spoken about the seventh day in this manner: “And on the seventh day God rested from all His works.”
ekegusii: Naki nigo ateebete aase gete igoro ye rituko ria gatano na kabere, “Nyasae nigo atimogete rituko ria gatano na kabere, agatiga emeremo yaye yonsi.”
swahili: Kwa maana mahali fulani amezungumza kuhusu siku ya saba, akisema: “Katika siku ya saba Mungu alipumzika kutoka kazi zake zote.”

english: And again, as He says in the passage above: “They shall never enter My rest.”
ekegusii: Naende aiga nigo agoteeba, “Tibagosoa ase ogotimoka kwane nonya ng’ake.”
swahili: Tena hapo juu asema, “Kamwe hawataingia rahani mwangu.”

english: Since, then, it remains for some to enter His rest, and since those who formerly heard the good news did not enter because of their disobedience,
ekegusii: Gaki, ase ayio ring’ana ndireo, ng’a mbare abanto barache gosoa. Abwo baranderetigwe amang’ana amaya ritang’ani bakamocha gosoa ase engencho y’ogotaigwera kwabo.
swahili: Kwa hiyo inabaki kuwa wazi kwa wengine kuingia, nao wale wa kwanza waliopokea Injili walishindwa kuingia kwa sababu ya kutokutii.

english: God again designated a certain day as “Today,” when a long time later He spoke through David as was just stated: “Today, if you hear His voice, do not harden your hearts.”
ekegusii: Naende obekire rituko gete, neri nario ria Reero. Aya nigo akwanete goetera ase Daudi magega y’engaki entambe, buna konya aikire gokwana, “Reero, komoraigwe eriogi riaye, timokong’ia chinkoro chiaino.”
swahili: Kwa hiyo Mungu ameweka siku nyingine, akaiita Leo, akisema kwa kinywa cha Daudi baadaye sana, kwa maneno yaliyotangulia kunenwa: “Leo, kama mkiisikia sauti yake, msiifanye mioyo yenu migumu.”

english: For if Joshua had given them rest, God would not have spoken later about another day.
ekegusii: Naki onye Yoshua nabaete ogotimoka, anga Nyasae magega yaye tare gokwana igoro ye rituko rinde.
swahili: Kwa maana kama Yoshua alikuwa amewapa raha, Mungu hangesema tena baadaye kuhusu siku nyingine.

english: There remains, then, a Sabbath rest for the people of God.
ekegusii: Ase igo, ogotimoka gw’esabato gwatigaire ase abanto ba Nyasae.
swahili: Kwa hiyo basi, imebaki raha ya Sabato kwa ajili ya watu wa Mungu;

english: Every high priest is appointed from among men to represent them in matters relating to God, to offer gifts and sacrifices for sins.
ekegusii: Naki kera Omokuani Omonene ore gochorwa korwa ase Mwanyabaanto nigo are kobekwa ase engencho ya Mwanyabaanto, kobatenenera ase ogokorera Nyasae, arue ebiegwa na ebing’wanso ase engencho y’ebibe.
swahili: Kwa maana kila kuhani mkuu anayechaguliwa miongoni mwa wanadamu anawekwa kuwawakilisha kwa mambo yanayomhusu Mungu, ili apate kutoa matoleo na dhabihu kwa ajili ya dhambi.

english: and was designated by God as high priest in the order of Melchizedek. Milk and Solid Food (1 Corinthians 3:1–9)
ekegusii: bwatoirwe na Nyasae ng’a n’Omokuani Omonene, koreng’ana buna Melkizedeki. Ogokuurera kw’ogoteatanana korwa ase Okwegena
swahili: Naye amewekwa na Mungu kuwa Kuhani Mkuu kwa mfano wa Melkizedeki. Wito Wa Kukua Kiroho

english: We have much to say about this, but it is hard to explain, because you are dull of hearing.
ekegusii: Igoro yaye ntore namang’ana amange tware gokwana korende naakong’u koyorokereria, ekiagera mwabeire aboro ase okoigwa.
swahili: Tunayo mengi ya kusema kuhusu habari ya ukuhani huu, lakini ni vigumu kuyaeleza, kwa sababu ninyi ni wazito wa kuelewa.

english: Although by this time you ought to be teachers, you need someone to reteach you the basic principles of God’s word. You need milk, not solid food!
ekegusii: Naki ekeene, inwe anga mwabeire aborokia, ekiagera ebiro ebinge biaetire, korende nebagwenerete oyonde aborokererie amorokererio e ritang’ani ay’amang’ana a Nyasae. Inwe nebagwenerete moegwe amabeere, gose tari endagera enkong’u.
swahili: Kwa hakika, ingawa mpaka wakati huu ingewapasa kuwa walimu, bado mnahitaji mtu wa kuwafundisha tena hatua za awali za kweli ya Neno la Mungu. Mnahitaji maziwa, wala si chakula kigumu!

english: For everyone who lives on milk is still an infant, inexperienced in the message of righteousness.
ekegusii: Naki oyokonyora amabeere oka tamanyeti mono ring’ana ri’oboronge, ekiagera nomwana omoke.
swahili: Kwa maana yeyote aishiye kwa kunywa maziwa bado yeye ni mtoto mchanga, hana ujuzi katika mafundisho kuhusu neno la haki.

english: But solid food is for the mature, who by constant use have trained their senses to distinguish good from evil.
ekegusii: Korende endagera enkong’u ney’abaanto abanene, ekiagera barabwo mbanaretie ebirengererio biabo, na igo mbamanye ogwatanana amaya na amabe.
swahili: Lakini chakula kigumu ni kwa ajili ya watu wazima, ambao kwa kujizoeza wamejifunza kupambanua kati ya mema na mabaya.

english: He is able to deal gently with those who are ignorant and misguided, since he himself is beset by weakness.
ekegusii: Na ere oranyare kobabogoreria ase obwororo abwo batamanyeti gento na batantanire, ekiagera nere omonyene nigo abuire noboreu.
swahili: Kwa kuwa yeye mwenyewe ni dhaifu, aweza kuwachukulia kwa upole wale wasiojua na kupotoka.

english: That is why he is obligated to offer sacrifices for his own sins, as well as for the sins of the people.
ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio yamogwenerete arue ekeng’wanso ase engencho y’ebibe biaye ere omonyene, buna are korua ase engencho y’ebibe bi’abaanto.
swahili: Hii ndiyo sababu inampasa kutoa dhabihu kwa ajili ya dhambi zake mwenyewe na vivyo hivyo kwa ajili ya dhambi za watu.

english: No one takes this honor upon himself; he must be called by God, just as Aaron was.
ekegusii: Monto onde tari bwenyoreire amasikani ayio ere omonyene, korende abe orangerigwe na Nyasae, buna Aroni arangeretigwe.
swahili: Hakuna anayejitwalia heshima hii mwenyewe; ni lazima aitwe na Mungu, kama vile Aroni alivyoitwa.

english: So also Christ did not take upon Himself the glory of becoming a high priest, but He was called by the One who said to Him: “You are My Son; today I have become Your Father.”
ekegusii: Naboigo na Kristo, ere teimokereretie igoro ere omonyene koba Omokuani Omonene, korende nigo abegetwe nere oyomotebetie, “Aye naye Omwana one, reero nakoiboire.”
swahili: Pia Kristo hakujitwalia utukufu yeye mwenyewe wa kuwa Kuhani Mkuu, bali Mungu alimwambia, “Wewe ni Mwanangu; leo mimi nimekuzaa.”

english: And in another passage God says: “You are a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.”
ekegusii: Naboigo akwanete aase aande, “Aye n’Omokuani o kare na kare, koreng’ana buna Melkizedeki.”
swahili: Pia mahali pengine asema, “Wewe ni kuhani milele, kwa mfano wa Melkizedeki.”

english: During the days of Jesus’ earthly life, He offered up prayers and petitions with loud cries and tears to the One who could save Him from death, and He was heard because of His reverence.
ekegusii: Ase amatuko ayio, ekero arenge ase omobere o Mwanyabaanto, Yeso agasaba na gosorora amo nokorera okonene, na amariga, asere oyorenge nokobua gw’okomotooria korwa ase amakweri, na akaigugwa ekiagera asigete Nyasae.
swahili: Katika siku za maisha ya Yesu hapa duniani, alimtolea maombi na dua pamoja na kulia sana na machozi, yeye awezaye kumwokoa na mauti, naye Mungu akamsikia kwa sababu ya kutii kwake kwa unyenyekevu.

english: Although He was a Son, He learned obedience from what He suffered.
ekegusii: Nonya orenge Omwana akeorokereria okoigwera ase emechando eyio yamonyorete,
swahili: Ingawa alikuwa Mwana, alijifunza utiifu kutokana na mateso aliyoyapata,

english: And having been made perfect, He became the source of eternal salvation to all who obey Him
ekegusii: na gaikeranigwe akaba engencho y’ogotooreka gwa kare na kare ase abanto bonsi abamoigwerete,
swahili: na akiisha kukamilishwa, akawa chanzo cha wokovu wa milele kwa wote wanaomtii.

english: Therefore let us leave the elementary teachings about Christ and go on to maturity, not laying again the foundation of repentance from dead works, and of faith in God,
ekegusii: Ase ayio, totige okworokereria kw’eritang’ani gwa Kristo, togenderere toikere oboikeranu. Titobeka naende oboroso bw’okoonchoka korwa ase ogokora gotari nobogima, na obw’okomwegena Nyasae,
swahili: Kwa hiyo, tukiachana na mafundisho yale ya awali kuhusu Kristo na tukisonga mbele ili tufikie utimilifu, sio kuweka tena msingi wa mafundisho ya kuzitubia kazi zisizo na uhai na imani katika Mungu,

english: For God is not unjust. He will not forget your work and the love you have shown for His name as you have ministered to the saints and continue to do so.
ekegusii: Naki Nyasae tari buna oyotari omooronge, goika ebe emeremo yaino, na obwachani boria mwaorogetie ase engencho y’erieta riaye ekero mwakorerete abachenu, na nonya mbono nkobakorera more.
swahili: Mungu si mdhalimu: yeye hataisahau kazi yenu na upendo ule mlioonyesha kwa ajili yake katika kuwahudumia watakatifu na hata sasa mnaendelea kuwahudumia.

english: We want each of you to show this same diligence to the very end, in order to make your hope sure.
ekegusii: Na intwe ntoganetie mono kera oyomo oino aorokie omokia oria goika omoerio, na igo amanye obomaene oboikeranu bw’ogosemeria kwaino.
swahili: Nasi twataka kila mmoja wenu aonyeshe bidii iyo hiyo ili mpate kujua uhakika kamili wa lile tumaini mpaka mwisho,

english: Then you will not be sluggish, but will imitate those who through faith and patience inherit what has been promised. God’s Unchangeable Promise
ekegusii: Timoba aboro, korende mobe abegi b’abaraire ayabarieretwe chiira, buna omwando, goetera ase okwegena na oboremereria. Eira ya Nyasae ney’obomaene
swahili: ili msije mkawa wavivu, bali mpate kuwaiga wale ambao kwa imani na saburi hurithi zile ahadi. Uhakika Wa Ahadi Ya Mungu

english: When God made His promise to Abraham, since He had no one greater to swear by, He swore by Himself,
ekegusii: Naki ekero Nyasae arierete Aburaamu eira agatiana; na ekiagera atarenge nonde omonene komobua asare ere aranyare gotiana, agetiania ere omonyene,
swahili: Mungu alipompa Abrahamu ahadi yake, kwa kuwa hakuwepo mwingine aliyekuwa mkuu kuliko yeye ambaye angeweza kuapa kwa jina lake, aliapa kwa nafsi yake,

english: saying, “I will surely bless you and multiply your descendants.”
ekegusii: agateeba, “Ekeene, ogosesenia ningosesenie, na okomenta ninkomentekie.”
swahili: akisema, “Hakika nitakubariki na kukupa wazao wengi.”

english: And so Abraham, after waiting patiently, obtained the promise.
ekegusii: Naboigo ase okoremereria Aburaamu akanyora ayarieretwe eira.
swahili: Abrahamu naye, baada ya kungoja kwa saburi, alipokea kile kilichoahidiwa.

english: Men swear by someone greater than themselves, and their oath serves as a confirmation to end all argument.
ekegusii: Naki abanto nigo bagotiana ase oyore omonene kobabua, na omoerio bw’okoamererania nemuma egokoora.
swahili: Wanadamu huapa kwa yeye aliye mkuu kuwaliko, nacho kiapo hicho huthibitisha kile kilichosemwa na hivyo humaliza mabishano yote.

english: So when God wanted to make the unchanging nature of His purpose very clear to the heirs of the promise, He guaranteed it with an oath.
ekegusii: Ase ayio, ekero Nyasae arigetie koborokia mono kegima abaraire omwando oria abarierete eira buna atanyare koonchora ayaroberetie, akabeeka emuma gati.
swahili: Mungu alipotaka kuonyesha kwa udhahiri zaidi ile asili ya kutokubadilika kwa ahadi yake kwa warithi wa ahadi, aliithitibisha kwa kiapo.

english: Thus by two unchangeable things in which it is impossible for God to lie, we who have fled to take hold of the hope set before us may be strongly encouraged.
ekegusii: Ase igo, ase ebinto bibere bitanyare koonchorwa, ime ase ebio Nyasae takonyara gokwana oborimo, intwe, abatwatameire obotamero, tonyore okoremigwa ogokong’u kobwata ogosemeria koria kwabekirwe bosio bwaito.
swahili: Mungu alifanya hivyo ili kwa vitu viwili visivyobadilika, yaani ahadi yake na kiapo chake, ambavyo kwavyo Mungu hawezi kusema uongo, sisi ambao tumemkimbilia ili tulishike lile tumaini lililowekwa mbele yetu tuwe na faraja thabiti.

english: We have this hope as an anchor for the soul, firm and secure. It enters the inner sanctuary behind the curtain,
ekegusii: Ogosemeria okwo tore nakorokwo buna ekeroochi ki’omoyo, okore ne chinguru, na gotari koonchoka, kogosoa aase are ime moino y’etoto.
