swahili: Tunalo tumaini hili kama nanga ya roho iliyo imara na thabiti. Tumaini hili huingia katika sehemu takatifu iliyopo nyuma ya pazia,

english: instruction about baptisms, the laying on of hands, the resurrection of the dead, and eternal judgment.
ekegusii: na okworokereria gwe chibatiso, na okobekerwa kw’amaboko, na okobokigwa kw’abakuure, na okogambigwa gwa kare na kare.
swahili: mafundisho kuhusu aina za ubatizo, kuwekea watu mikono, ufufuo wa wafu, na hukumu ya milele.

english: where Jesus our forerunner has entered on our behalf. He has become a high priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.
ekegusii: Aase aria Yeso asoete buna omotang’ani oito, na ase engencho yaito, ekero abeire Omokuani Omonene o kare na kare, koreng’ana buna Melkizedeki.
swahili: mahali ambapo Yesu mtangulizi wetu aliingia kwa niaba yetu. Yeye amekuwa Kuhani Mkuu milele, kwa mfano wa Melkizedeki.

english: And this we will do, if God permits.
ekegusii: Natokore ayio, Nyasae karatwanchere.
swahili: Mungu akitujalia tutafanya hivyo.

english: It is impossible for those who have once been enlightened, who have tasted the heavenly gift, who have shared in the Holy Spirit,
ekegusii: Abwo baikire konyora omobaso, na koigwa ekeegwa gekorwa igoro, na babeire ababwatani b’Omoika Omochenu,
swahili: Kwa kuwa ni vigumu kwa wale ambao wakati fulani walishapata nuru, ambao walishaonja kipawa cha mbinguni, ambao wamekwisha kushiriki katika Roho Mtakatifu,

english: who have tasted the goodness of the word of God and the powers of the coming age—
ekegusii: na koigwa obuya bw’ering’ana ria Nyasae amo nogokora gwe chinguru gw’ekero kegochi‐gocha,
swahili: ambao wameonja uzuri wa Neno la Mungu na nguvu za wakati ujao,

english: and then have fallen away—to be restored to repentance, because they themselves are crucifying the Son of God all over again and subjecting Him to open shame.
ekegusii: na magega y’ayio kobeatananire, tekonyarekana abwo bakorwe abayia naende ase okoonchorwa, ekiagera bamobambire naende Omwana o Nyasae barabwo abanyene, na komosookia maiso marore.
swahili: kisha wakianguka, kuwarejesha tena katika toba. Kwa kuwa wanamsulubisha Mwana wa Mungu mara ya pili na kumdhalilisha hadharani, nayo ikawa hasara kwao.

english: For land that drinks in the rain often falling on it and that produces a crop useful to those for whom it is tended receives the blessing of God.
ekegusii: Naki omogondo oyokonywa embura egotwa engaki ase engaki, na gokinia chinyeni, chigokonya abwo bakoyorema, nigo okonyora ogosesenigwa gokorwa ase Nyasae.
swahili: Ardhi ile ipokeayo mvua inyeshayo juu yake mara kwa mara hutoa mazao yanayowanufaisha wale ambao kwa ajili yao yalimwa, nayo nchi hiyo hupokea baraka kutoka kwa Mungu.

english: But land that produces thorns and thistles is worthless, and its curse is imminent. In the end it will be burned.
ekegusii: Korende korakinie amagwa na amageri, nigo oraangwe na koba ang’e nokorangererigwa, na omoerio oye nogosambwa.
swahili: Lakini ardhi ikizaa miiba na mibaruti, haina thamani na iko hatarini ya kulaaniwa. Mwisho wake ni kuchomwa moto.

english: Even though we speak like this, beloved, we are convinced of better things in your case—things that accompany salvation.
ekegusii: Korende abanchani, nonya togokwana ayio, ntore nobomaene igoro yaino, ng’a mwanyorire amang’ana amaya kobua, ayakorenta ogotooreka.
swahili: Ingawa tunasema hivi, ndugu zangu wapendwa, kwa upande wenu tuna hakika ya mambo mema zaidi, mambo yale yahusuyo wokovu.

english: This Melchizedek was king of Salem and priest of God Most High. He met Abraham returning from the slaughter of the kings and blessed him,
ekegusii: Naki Melkizedeki oyio nigo arenge omorwoti o Salemu, Omokuani o Nyasae Ore Igoro Mono. Ekero Aburaamu are koirana korwa ase ogoita abarwoti, Melkizedeki akaumerana nere, akamosesenia.
swahili: Kwa kuwa huyu Melkizedeki alikuwa mfalme wa Salemu na kuhani wa Mungu Aliye Juu Sana. Alipokutana na Abrahamu akirudi kutoka kuwashinda hao wafalme, Melkizedeki alimbariki,

english: For when Melchizedek met Abraham, Levi was still in the loin of his ancestor. A Superior Priesthood
ekegusii: ekiagera arenge ase ekebono gia sokororia yaye, ekero Melkizedeki aumeranete na Aburaamu.
swahili: kwa sababu Melkizedeki alipokutana na Abrahamu, Lawi alikuwa bado katika viuno vya baba yake wa zamani. Yesu Mfano Wa Melkizedeki

english: Now if perfection could have been attained through the Levitical priesthood (for on this basis the people received the law), why was there still need for another priest to appear—one in the order of Melchizedek and not in the order of Aaron?
ekegusii: Gaki, onye oboikeranu bware konyorekana ase obokuani bwa Lawi, naki ase obwo abanto banyorete amachiiko, inki kiagerete Omokuani onde abekwe, oyore koreng’ana buna Melkizedeki, na tatoretwe koreng’ana buna Aroni?
swahili: Kama ukamilifu ungeweza kupatikana kwa njia ya ukuhani wa Walawi (kwa kuwa katika msingi huo, sheria ilitolewa kwa watu), kwa nini basi imekuwepo haja ya kuja kuhani mwingine: kuhani kwa mfano wa Melkizedeki, wala si kwa mfano wa Aroni?

english: For when the priesthood is changed, the law must be changed as well.
ekegusii: Naki obokuani koboraonchorwe, goika okoonchorwa kw’amachiiko boigo kobeo.
swahili: Kwa kuwa yanapotokea mabadiliko ya ukuhani, pia lazima yawepo mabadiliko ya sheria.

english: He of whom these things are said belonged to a different tribe, from which no one has ever served at the altar.
ekegusii: Naki omonene oito, amang’ana aya akwanetwe igoro yaye, nigo arenge bw’ororeria ronde oroao, na onde tarenge korwa ase ororeria orwo ore gokorera ase egesasiimero.
swahili: Yeye ambaye mambo haya yanasemwa alikuwa wa kabila lingine, na hakuna mtu wa kabila hilo aliyewahi kuhudumu katika madhabahu.

english: For it is clear that our Lord descended from Judah, a tribe as to which Moses said nothing about priests.
ekegusii: Naki igo are maiso marore ng’a ere nigo arwete ase ororeria rwa Yuda. Na ekero Musa akwanete igoro y’ororeria orwo takwanete ing’ana rinde igoro y’abakuani.
swahili: Kwa maana ni dhahiri kwamba Bwana wetu alitoka katika uzao wa Yuda, tena kuhusu kabila hilo Mose hakusema lolote kwa habari za makuhani.

english: And this point is even more clear if another priest like Melchizedek appears,
ekegusii: Kerabe Omokuani onde oorokire oyore koreng’ana buna Melkizedeki amang’ana ayio nigo are maiso marore mono kobua.
swahili: Tena hayo tuliyosema yako wazi zaidi kama akitokea kuhani mwingine kama Melkizedeki,

english: one who has become a priest not by a law of succession, but by the power of an indestructible life.
ekegusii: Ere igo obeire Omokuani, tari ase ogochika kw’omooroberio bw’ogotunyana ororeria, korende nase chinguru chi’obogima botari nomoerio.
swahili: yeye ambaye amefanyika kuhani si kwa misingi ya sheria kama ilivyokuwa kwa baba zake, bali kwa misingi ya uwezo wa uzima usioharibika.

english: For it is testified: “You are a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.”
ekegusii: Naki obereirwe kirori ng’a. “Aye n’Omokuani o kare na kare, koreng’ana buna Melkizedeki.”
swahili: Kwa maana imeshuhudiwa kwamba: “Wewe ni kuhani milele, kwa mfano wa Melkizedeki.”

english: So the former commandment is set aside because it was weak and useless
ekegusii: Naki chinguru chi’ogochika koria kw’eritang’ani nigo chiasiretigwe ase engencho y’oboreu bwaye na ogotaisanera kwaye.
swahili: Kwa upande mmoja, ile amri ya mwanzo isiyofaa na dhaifu imebatilishwa

english: (for the law made nothing perfect), and a better hope is introduced, by which we draw near to God.
ekegusii: Naki rinde tiriri riaikeranetigwe namachiiko. Ribaga ri’ayio ogosemeria okore okuya mono kobua gokarentwa, na ase okwo twamoikire Nyasae ang’e.
swahili: (kwa maana sheria haikufanya kitu chochote kuwa kikamilifu). Kwa upande mwingine, tumeletewa tumaini lililo bora zaidi ambalo linatuleta karibu na Mungu.

english: and Abraham apportioned to him a tenth of everything. First, his name means “king of righteousness.” Then also, “king of Salem” means “king of peace.”
ekegusii: Na Aburaamu akamwatanera ensemo ya ikomi y’ebinto bionsi. Ritang’ani engencho y’erieta ria Melkizedeki nigo ere iga: “Omorwoti bw’oboronge”, naende nigo are omorwoti o Salemu, engencho yaye: “Omorwoti bw’omorembe”.
swahili: naye Abrahamu alimpa sehemu ya kumi ya kila kitu. Kwanza, jina hilo Melkizedeki maana yake ni “mfalme wa haki.” Na pia “mfalme wa Salemu” maana yake ni “mfalme wa amani.”

english: And none of this happened without an oath. For others became priests without an oath,
ekegusii: Kobua mono obokuani obo tibwarenge gokoreka botari nemuma.
swahili: Nalo tumaini hilo halikutolewa pasipo kiapo! Wengine walikuwa makuhani pasipo kiapo chochote,

english: but Jesus became a priest with an oath by the One who said to Him: “The Lord has sworn and will not change His mind: ‘You are a priest forever.’”
ekegusii: Naki abwo baare kobekwa ase obokuani tibare kobekwa amo nemuma, korende Yeso akabonyora amo nemuma goetera asare oyo omotebetie, “Omonene otianire, gose takoonchora ebirengererio biaye, Aye n’Omokuani o kare na kare.”
swahili: lakini Yesu alifanywa kuhani kwa kiapo wakati Mungu alimwambia: “ Bwana ameapa naye hatabadilisha mawazo yake: ‘Wewe ni kuhani milele.’ ”

english: Because of this oath, Jesus has become the guarantee of a better covenant.
ekegusii: Gaki, ase ekerengo eke Yeso obeire oyo bw’obomaene bw’okobwatana kore okuya kobua.
swahili: Kwa ajili ya kiapo hiki, Yesu amekuwa mdhamini wa agano lililo bora zaidi.

english: Now there have been many other priests, since death prevented them from continuing in office.
ekegusii: Baria barenge abakuani b’eritang’ani barenge abange, ekiagera batangetwe namakweri, tibagendererete,
swahili: Basi pamekuwepo na makuhani wengi wa aina hiyo, kwa kuwa kifo kiliwazuia kuendelea na huduma yao ya ukuhani.

english: But because Jesus lives forever, He has a permanent priesthood.
ekegusii: korende ere, ekiagera agendererete kare na kare, nare nobokuani botari koonchoka.
swahili: Lakini kwa sababu Yesu anaishi milele, anao ukuhani wa kudumu.

english: Therefore He is able to save completely those who draw near to God through Him, since He always lives to intercede for them.
ekegusii: Ase ayio, nare nokobua gw’okobatooria kegima abwo bagocha ase Nyasae goetera asare, ekiagera nigo are moyo botambe ase okobasabera.
swahili: Kwa hiyo anaweza kuwaokoa kabisa wale wanaomjia Mungu kupitia kwake, kwa sababu yeye adumu daima kuomba kwa ajili yao.

english: Such a high priest truly befits us—One who is holy, innocent, undefiled, set apart from sinners, and exalted above the heavens.
ekegusii: Naki nigo etogwenerete intwe tobe n’Omokuani Omonene buna oyo, oyore omochenu, otari na komocha, otari na kemoa, bwatananetwe korwa ase abanyene ebibe, oimokereretigwe igoro ya igoro.
swahili: Kwa kuwa ilitupasa tuwe na Kuhani Mkuu wa namna hii, yaani, aliye mtakatifu, asiye na lawama, asiye na dosari, aliyetengwa na wenye dhambi na kuinuliwa juu ya mbingu.

english: Unlike the other high priests, He does not need to offer daily sacrifices, first for His own sins and then for the sins of the people; He sacrificed for sin once for all when He offered up Himself.
ekegusii: Ere tagwenerete korua ebing’wanso kera rituko, buna abakuani bande abanene, ritang’ani ase engencho y’ebibe biaye omonyene, naende ase engencho y’ebibe bi’abaanto, ekiagera ayio nigo ayakorete ara rimo rioka ekero eruete ere omonyene.
swahili: Yeye hahitaji kutoa dhabihu siku kwa siku kwa ajili ya dhambi, kwanza kwa ajili ya dhambi zake mwenyewe, kisha kwa ajili ya dhambi za watu kama wale makuhani wakuu wengine. Yeye alitoa dhabihu kwa ajili ya dhambi zao mara moja tu, alipojitoa mwenyewe.

english: For the law appoints as high priests men who are weak; but the oath, which came after the law, appointed the Son, who has been made perfect forever.
ekegusii: Naki amachiiko nigo are kobeeka abanto abare noboreu babe abakuani abanene, korende ring’ana ri’emuma, eriachete magega y’amachiiko, riabekire Omwana, oyoikeranetigwe kare na kare.
swahili: Kwa kuwa sheria huwaweka makuhani wakuu watu ambao ni dhaifu; lakini lile neno la kiapo, lililokuja baada ya sheria, lilimweka Mwana, ambaye amefanywa kuwa mkamilifu milele.

english: Without father or mother or genealogy, without beginning of days or end of life, like the Son of God, he remains a priest for all time.
ekegusii: Ere tarenge na ise, gose na ng’ina, gose ne chisokoro chiaye; tarenge nomochakano bw’amatuko aye, gose nomoerio bw’obogima bwaye, korende ogwekanigwe n’Omwana o Nyasae. Igo agendererete koba Omokuani o kare na kare.
swahili: Hana Baba wala mama, hana ukoo, hana mwanzo wala mwisho wa siku zake. Kama Mwana wa Mungu, yeye adumu akiwa kuhani milele.

english: Consider how great Melchizedek was: Even the patriarch Abraham gave him a tenth of the plunder.
ekegusii: Gaki, rigereria buna omonto oyo arenge omonene! Aburaamu, omogaka oito o kare, akamoa ensemo ya ikomi y’ebinto asakorete korwa ase esegi.
swahili: Tazama jinsi alivyokuwa mkuu: Hata Abrahamu, baba yetu mkuu, alimpa sehemu ya kumi ya nyara zake.

english: Now the law commands the sons of Levi who become priests to collect a tenth from the people—that is, from their brothers—though they too are descended from Abraham.
ekegusii: Na ase abana b’ororeria rwa Lawi, baria baare konyora obokuani, mbaare nogochika korwa ase amachiiko koira ensemo ya ikomi korwa ase abanto bamwabo, nonya barabwo barenge ab’ororeria rwa Aburaamu.
swahili: Basi sheria inawaagiza wana wa Lawi ambao hufanyika makuhani kupokea sehemu ya kumi kutoka kwa watu ambao ni ndugu zao, ingawa ndugu zao ni wazao wa Abrahamu.

english: But Melchizedek, who did not trace his descent from Levi, collected a tenth from Abraham and blessed him who had the promises.
ekegusii: Korende Melkizedeki, nonya tarenge bw’ororeria rwabo, akaira ensemo ya ikomi korwa ase Aburaamu, na akamosesenia ere oyorenge ne chiira.
swahili: Huyu Melkizedeki, ingawa hakufuatia ukoo wake kutoka kwa Lawi, lakini alipokea sehemu ya kumi kutoka kwa Abrahamu na kumbariki yeye aliyekuwa na zile ahadi.

english: And indisputably, the lesser is blessed by the greater.
ekegusii: Okoamererania tikoiyo nonya ng’ake ng’a oria omoke osesenigwa noria omonene.
swahili: Wala hakuna shaka kwamba mdogo hubarikiwa na aliye mkuu kumliko yeye.

english: In the case of the Levites, mortal men collect the tenth; but in the case of Melchizedek, it is affirmed that he lives on.
ekegusii: Na ase ororeria rwa Lawi Mwanyabaanto, abakonyorekana namakweri, nkonyora bare ensemo ya ikomi, korende aiga ere oyogwatorwa ng’a moyo are nkoyenyora are.
swahili: Kwa upande mmoja, sehemu ya kumi hupokelewa na wale ambao hupatikana na kufa; lakini kwa upande mwingine hupokelewa na yeye ambaye hushuhudiwa kuwa yu hai.

english: And so to speak, Levi, who collects the tenth, paid the tenth through Abraham.
ekegusii: Igo nenyare gotebwa, ng’a goetera ase Aburaamu nonya Lawi, oyore konyora ensemo ya ikomi, nere naruete ensemo ya ikomi,
swahili: Mtu anaweza hata kusema kwamba Lawi, ambaye hupokea sehemu ya kumi, alitoa hiyo sehemu ya kumi kupitia kwa Abrahamu,

english: The point of what we are saying is this: We do have such a high priest, who sat down at the right hand of the throne of the Majesty in heaven,
ekegusii: Gaki, ring’ana rinene ri’ayio togokwana nario eri: Ntore n’Omokuani Omonene buna iga, oikaransete ensemo ya borio y’ekerogo ki’Obonene aria igoro,
swahili: Basi jambo tunalotaka kulisema ni hili: Tunaye Kuhani Mkuu ambaye ameketi mkono wa kuume wa kiti cha enzi cha Aliye Mkuu mbinguni,

english: For this is the covenant I will make with the house of Israel after those days, declares the Lord. I will put My laws in their minds and inscribe them on their hearts. And I will be their God, and they will be My people.
ekegusii: Naende Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: Oko nakwo okobwatana ndakore n’Abaisraeli magega y’amatuko aria: Nimbeke amachiiko aane ase ebirengererio biabo, ninyarike ase chinkoro chiabo ime; inche nimbe Nyasae obo, na barabwo mbabe abanto baane.
swahili: Hili ndilo agano nitakalofanya na nyumba ya Israeli baada ya siku zile, asema Bwana. Nitaziweka sheria zangu katika nia zao na kuziandika mioyoni mwao. Nitakuwa Mungu wao, nao watakuwa watu wangu.

english: No longer will each one teach his neighbor or his brother, saying, ‘Know the Lord,’ because they will all know Me, from the least of them to the greatest.
ekegusii: Barabwo tibakworokererania kera omonto nomogisangio oye, gose kera omonto noyomwabo, ogoteeba: Momanye omonene, ekiagera bonsi pi mbamanye inche, korwa omoke mono goika omonene mono.
swahili: Mtu hatamfundisha tena jirani yake, wala mtu kumfundisha ndugu yake akisema, ‘Mjue Bwana,’ kwa sababu wote watanijua mimi, tangu aliye mdogo kabisa kwao, hadi aliye mkuu sana.

english: For I will forgive their iniquities and will remember their sins no more.”
ekegusii: Naki nimbaabere obobe bwabo, na ebibe biabo tinkobiinyora naende.”
swahili: Kwa sababu nitasamehe uovu wao, wala sitazikumbuka dhambi zao tena!”

english: By speaking of a new covenant, He has made the first one obsolete; and what is obsolete and aging will soon disappear.
ekegusii: Ase ogokwana igoro y’okobwatana okoyia nigo akorire koria kw’eritang’ani kobe ogokoro, na koria kwabeire ogokoro na kogota, ng’ang’e kore gosira.
swahili: Kwa kuliita agano hili “jipya,” Mungu amefanya lile agano la kwanza kuwa kuukuu; nacho kitu kinachoanza kuchakaa na kuwa kikuukuu kiko karibu kutoweka.

english: and who ministers in the sanctuary and true tabernacle set up by the Lord, not by man.
ekegusii: omokoreri bw’aase aachenu na obw’Eema y’ekeene, eye Omonene aagachete, gose tari Mwanyabaanto.
swahili: yeye ahudumuye katika patakatifu, hema la kweli lililowekwa na Bwana, wala si na mwanadamu.

english: And since every high priest is appointed to offer both gifts and sacrifices, it was necessary for this One also to have something to offer.
ekegusii: Naki kera Omokuani omonene nigo are kobekwa ase okorua ebiegwa na ebing’wanso. Ase ayio yamogwenerete Omokuani oyo boigo abe negento akorua.
swahili: Kila kuhani mkuu huwekwa ili atoe sadaka na dhabihu. Vivyo hivyo, ilikuwa jambo muhimu kwa huyu Kuhani naye awe na kitu cha kutoa.

english: Now if He were on earth, He would not be a priest, since there are already priests who offer gifts according to the law.
ekegusii: Onye nabeete ase ense, anga tabeti Omokuani, ekiagera mbareo abare korua ebiegwa buna amachiiko achigete.
swahili: Kama angekuwa duniani, hangekuwa kuhani, kwa sababu tayari wapo watu watoao sadaka kama ilivyoelekezwa na sheria.

english: The place where they serve is a copy and shadow of what is in heaven. This is why Moses was warned when he was about to build the tabernacle: “See to it that you make everything according to the pattern shown you on the mountain.” The New Covenant (Jeremiah 31:26–40)
ekegusii: Abwo baare gokorera ayare omogwekano bw’amang’ana are igoro, na ekiriri ki’ayio. Naki ekero Musa arenge koroisia Eema eria, Nyasae akamoteebia, “Rigereria, okore ebinto bionsi ase omogwekano bw’oria kworogetigwe ase egetunwa.”
swahili: Wanahudumu katika patakatifu palipo mfano na kivuli cha mambo ya mbinguni. Hii ndiyo sababu Mose alionywa alipokaribia kujenga hema, akiambiwa: “Hakikisha kuwa unavitengeneza vitu vyote kwa mfano ulioonyeshwa kule mlimani.”

english: Now, however, Jesus has received a much more excellent ministry, just as the covenant He mediates is better and is founded on better promises.
ekegusii: Korende bono Kristo onyorire obokuani bore obuya kobua, koreng’ana buna ere are omobwatania bw’okobwatana okuya kobua, okwo kwagachetwe ase chiira chingiya kobua.
swahili: Lakini huduma aliyopewa Yesu ni bora zaidi kuliko yao, kama vile agano ambalo yeye ni mpatanishi wake lilivyo bora zaidi kuliko lile la zamani, nalo limewekwa misingi wa ahadi zilizo bora zaidi.

english: For if that first covenant had been without fault, no place would have been sought for a second.
ekegusii: Naki onye okobwatana koria kw’eritang’ani kwarenge tikori na komocha, anga ribaga tiriarigetigwe ase koria gwa kabere.
swahili: Kwa maana kama hapakuwa na kasoro katika lile agano la kwanza, pasingekuwa na haja ya kutafuta nafasi kwa ajili ya jingine.

english: But God found fault with the people and said: “Behold, the days are coming, declares the Lord, when I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah.
ekegusii: Naki Nyasae nigo akonyora okomocha ime yabo ekero agoteeba “Omonene oteebire iga: Rora, amatuko ngocha are ekero ndakorere abanto b’enyomba ya Israeli na ab’enyomba ya Yuda okobwatana okoyia.
swahili: Lakini Mungu aliona kosa kwa watu, naye akasema: “Siku zinakuja, asema Bwana, nitakapofanya agano jipya na nyumba ya Israeli na nyumba ya Yuda.

english: It will not be like the covenant I made with their fathers when I took them by the hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt, because they did not abide by My covenant, and I disregarded them, declares the Lord.
ekegusii: Okobwatana oko tigokoba buna koria nakorete ne chisokoro chiabo, ase rituko riria nababwatete amaboko abo ase okobarusia korwa ase ense ya Misiri. Ekiagera tibagendererete ase okobwatana kwane, inche tinabechanderete, Omonene oteebire.
swahili: Agano langu halitakuwa kama lile nililofanya na baba zao nilipowashika mkono kuwaongoza watoke nchi ya Misri, kwa sababu hawakuendelea kuwa waaminifu katika agano langu, nami nikawaacha, asema Bwana.

english: Now the first covenant had regulations for worship and also an earthly sanctuary.
ekegusii: Gaki, nonya okobwatana kw’eritang’ani kwarenge nemeroberio ase okomosasiima Nyasae, naende kwarenge nase aachenu ase ense eye.
swahili: Basi agano lile la kwanza lilikuwa na kanuni zake za kuabudu na pia patakatifu pake pa kidunia.

english: They consist only in food and drink and special washings—external regulations imposed until the time of reform. Redemption through His Blood
ekegusii: Ebinto ebi nigo biare ase okoria na okonywa, na ogosibigwa ao ao, amachiiko ase omobere ayabekire goika engaki y’okoroisigwa okoyia eike.
swahili: Lakini hizi zilishughulika tu na vyakula na vinywaji, pamoja na taratibu mbalimbali za kunawa kwa nje, kanuni kwa ajili ya mwili zilizowekwa hadi wakati utimie wa matengenezo mapya. Damu Ya Kristo

english: But when Christ came as high priest of the good things that have come, He went through the greater and more perfect tabernacle that is not made by hands and is not a part of this creation.
ekegusii: Korende Kristo oikire gocha, oyore Omokuani Omonene bw’amang’ana amaya agochi‐gocha. Agaeta ase eema ere enene na eng’ikeranu kobua, etakoretwe namaboko, engencho yaye etari egetongwa gi’ense eye.
swahili: Kristo alipokuja akiwa Kuhani Mkuu wa mambo mema ambayo tayari yameshawasili, alipitia kwenye hema iliyo kuu zaidi na bora zaidi, ambayo haikutengenezwa kwa mikono ya binadamu, hii ni kusema, ambayo si sehemu ya uumbaji huu.

english: He did not enter by the blood of goats and calves, but He entered the Most Holy Place once for all by His own blood, thus securing eternal redemption.
ekegusii: Ere tasoete namanyinga e chimbori na eye chimori, korende namanyinga aye omonyene, agasoa ara rimo rioka Aase Aachenu, na agatonyorera okoboorigwa gwa kare na kare.
swahili: Hakuingia kwa njia ya damu ya mbuzi na ya ndama; lakini aliingia Patakatifu pa Patakatifu mara moja tu kwa damu yake mwenyewe, akiisha kupata ukombozi wa milele.

english: For if the blood of goats and bulls and the ashes of a heifer sprinkled on those who are ceremonially unclean sanctify them so that their bodies are clean,
ekegusii: Naki onye amanyinga e chimbori na aye chieri, ne ribu ri’amatororo biare konyororokerigwa ase abatachenegeti mbinyare gochena ase ogosibigwa kw’omobere,
swahili: Damu ya mbuzi na ya mafahali, na majivu ya mitamba walivyonyunyiziwa wale waliokuwa najisi kwa taratibu za kiibada viliwatakasa, hata kuwaondolea uchafu wa nje.

english: how much more will the blood of Christ, who through the eternal Spirit offered Himself unblemished to God, purify our consciences from works of death, so that we may serve the living God!
ekegusii: tari mono kobua amanyinga a Kristo, ere ase Omoika o kare na kare akerua ere omonyene ase Nyasae koba ekeng’wanso getari na komocha, anyare gochena okomanya gwe chinkoro chiaito ime korwa ase emeremo ekwete, erinde tokorere Nyasae ore moyo?
swahili: Basi ni zaidi aje damu ya Kristo, ambaye kwa Roho wa milele alijitoa nafsi yake kwa Mungu kuwa sadaka isiyo na waa, itatusafisha dhamiri zetu kutokana na matendo yaletayo mauti, ili tupate kumtumikia Mungu aliye hai!

english: Therefore Christ is the mediator of a new covenant, so that those who are called may receive the promised eternal inheritance, now that He has died to redeem them from the transgressions committed under the first covenant.
ekegusii: Ase engencho eye ere nomobwatania bw’okobwatana okoyia, erinde abwo barangerigwe banyore omwando oria o kare na kare, oyo barieretwe eira, ekiagera amakweri aikire gokoreka ase okobabooria barabwo korwa ase ogosaria koria bakorete ase okobwatana kw’eritang’ani.
swahili: Kwa sababu hii Kristo ni mpatanishi wa agano jipya, ili kwamba wale walioitwa waweze kupokea ile ahadi ya urithi wa milele: kwa vile yeye alikufa awe ukombozi wao kutoka kwa dhambi walizozitenda chini ya agano la kwanza.

english: In the case of a will, it is necessary to establish the death of the one who made it,
ekegusii: Naki aase okoriera kw’omwando kore, goika amakweri aye, oyoriete, abeo.
swahili: Kwa habari ya wosia, ni muhimu kuthibitisha kifo cha yule aliyeutoa,

english: because a will does not take effect until the one who made it has died; it cannot be executed while he is still alive.
ekegusii: Naki okoriera kw’omwando nigo kogoikeranigwa ekero ki’amakweri, ekiagera onye oria oyoriete ore moyo, rirorio tikori na nguru.
swahili: kwa sababu wosia huwa na nguvu tu wakati mtu ameshakufa; kamwe hauwezi kutumika wakati yule aliyeuandika bado yuko hai.

english: That is why even the first covenant was not put into effect without blood.
ekegusii: Ase ayio, okobwatana koria kw’eritang’ani tigwachagete gotare namanyinga,
swahili: Hii ndiyo sababu hata lile agano la kwanza halikuweza kutekelezwa pasipo damu.

english: For when Moses had proclaimed every commandment of the law to all the people, he took the blood of calves and goats, along with water, scarlet wool, and hyssop, and sprinkled the scroll and all the people,
ekegusii: naki ekero kera richiko riaikire gokwanwa na Musa ase abanto bonsi, buna yachigetwe ase amachiiko, akabogoria amanyinga e chimori na aye chimbori amo namaache na amarionya amabariri, ne chinsagia chia hisopo, akanyororokeria egetabu enyene, na abanto bonsi,
swahili: Mose alipotangaza kila amri kwa watu wote, alichukua damu ya ndama na ya mbuzi, pamoja na maji, sufu nyekundu na matawi ya mti wa hisopo, akanyunyizia kile kitabu na watu wote.

english: A tabernacle was prepared. In its first room were the lampstand, the table, and the consecrated bread. This was called the Holy Place.
ekegusii: Naki eema eria ye ritang’ani yaroisetigwe. Ime ase eema eria mbiarengeo ekebekerero gie chitaaya, na emesa amo nemegati yarenge koruegwa ase Nyasae. Aase aria are korokwa Aase Aachenu.
swahili: Hema ilitengenezwa. Katika sehemu yake ya kwanza kulikuwa na kinara cha taa, meza na mikate iliyowekwa wakfu; hii sehemu iliitwa Mahali Patakatifu.

english: saying, “This is the blood of the covenant, which God has commanded you to keep.”
ekegusii: ogoteeba, “Aya namanyinga ’okobwatana oko Nyasae abachikerete inwe.”
swahili: Alisema, “Hii ndiyo damu ya agano, ambalo Mungu amewaamuru kulitii.”

english: In the same way, he sprinkled with blood the tabernacle and all the vessels used in worship.
ekegusii: Eema amo n’ebinto bionsi biare gokorerwa ase ogosasiima naboigo are kobinyororokereria amanyinga.
swahili: Vivyo hivyo alinyunyizia damu hiyo kwenye ile hema pamoja na kila kifaa kilichotumika ndani yake kwa taratibu za ibada.

english: According to the law, in fact, nearly everything must be purified with blood, and without the shedding of blood there is no forgiveness.
ekegusii: Amachiiko nigo are goteeba ng’a ang’e ebinto bionsi bichenwe namanyinga, na amanyinga ataiteiri, okwaberwa kw’ebibe tigokobao. Ebibe mbiarusetigwe ase okong’wanswa gwa Kristo.
swahili: Kwa kweli sheria hudai kwamba, karibu kila kitu kitakaswe kwa damu, wala pasipo kumwaga damu, hakuna msamaha wa dhambi.

english: So it was necessary for the copies of the heavenly things to be purified with these sacrifices, but the heavenly things themselves with better sacrifices than these.
ekegusii: Gaki, yagwenerete emegwekano y’ebinto bire igoro bichenwe ase ebing’wanso buna ebio, korende ebinto bia igoro ebinyene bichenwe nebing’wanso bire ebiya kobua ebi.
swahili: Kwa hiyo, ilikuwa muhimu kwa nakala za vitu vile vya mbinguni vitakaswe kwa dhabihu hizi, lakini vitu halisi vya mbinguni vilihitaji dhabihu bora kuliko hizi.

english: For Christ did not enter a man-made copy of the true sanctuary, but He entered heaven itself, now to appear on our behalf in the presence of God.
ekegusii: Naki Kristo tasoete Aase Aachenu akoretwe namaboko, naro omogwekano bw’Aachenu a ekeene, korende agasoa igoro aanyene, na bono nao akororekana ase obosio bwa Nyasae ase engencho yaito intwe.
swahili: Kwa maana Kristo hakuingia kwenye patakatifu palipofanywa kwa mikono ya mwanadamu, ambao ni mfano wa kile kilicho halisi. Yeye aliingia mbinguni penyewe, ili sasa aonekane mbele za Mungu kwa ajili yetu.

english: Nor did He enter heaven to offer Himself again and again, as the high priest enters the Most Holy Place every year with blood that is not his own.
ekegusii: Ere terua omonyene ekero ase ekero, buna Omokuani omonene are gosoa Aase Aachenu kera omwaka amo namanyinga atari ayaye.
swahili: Wala hakuingia mbinguni ili apate kujitoa mwenyewe mara kwa mara, kama vile kuhani mkuu aingiavyo Patakatifu pa Patakatifu kila mwaka kwa damu ambayo si yake mwenyewe.

english: Otherwise, Christ would have had to suffer repeatedly since the foundation of the world. But now He has appeared once for all at the end of the ages to do away with sin by the sacrifice of Himself.
ekegusii: Onye nabo, anga yamogwenerete achandwe ekero ase ekero korwa omochakano, ekero oboroso bw’ense bwabegetwe. Korende bono, ase amatuko ’omoerio bw’ense akaoroka ara rimo rioka ase okorusia ebibe ase okong’wanswa kwaye ere omonyene.
swahili: Ingekuwa hivyo, ingempasa Kristo kuteswa mara nyingi tangu kuumbwa kwa ulimwengu. Lakini sasa ametokea mara moja tu katika mwisho wa nyakati aiondoe dhambi kwa kujitoa mwenyewe kuwa dhabihu.

english: Just as man is appointed to die once, and after that to face judgment,
ekegusii: Buna abanto bagacheirwe ogokwa ara rimo, na magega y’ogokwa ekiina,
swahili: Kama vile mwanadamu alivyowekewa kufa mara moja tu na baada ya kufa akabili hukumu,

english: so also Christ was offered once to bear the sins of many; and He will appear a second time, not to bear sin, but to bring salvation to those who eagerly await Him.
ekegusii: naboigo Kristo nere, gakoorire koruegwa abe ekeng’wanso ara rimo ase okorusia ebibe bi’abaanto abange, narorekane eria kabere, tari ase okobogoria ebibe, korende ase okonyorera abamoganyete ogotooreka.
swahili: vivyo hivyo Kristo alitolewa mara moja tu kuwa dhabihu ili azichukue dhambi za watu wengi. Naye atakuja mara ya pili, sio kuchukua dhambi, bali kuwaletea wokovu wale wanaomngoja kwa shauku.

english: Behind the second curtain was a room called the Most Holy Place,
ekegusii: Na moino y’etoto eria ya kabere yarengeo eema ende yare korokwa Aase Aachenu Mono.
swahili: Nyuma ya pazia la pili, palikuwa na sehemu iliyoitwa Patakatifu pa Patakatifu,

english: containing the golden altar of incense and the gold-covered ark of the covenant. Inside the ark were the gold jar of manna, Aaron’s staff that had budded, and the stone tablets of the covenant.
ekegusii: Ime aroro mbiarengeo egesasiimero gi’etaabu ki’ogosambera ubani, na esanduki y’okobwatana yaoomire netaabu chinsemo chionsi. Ime ase esanduki eria mbiarengeo: Egetaabo gi’etaabu aase biabegetwe endagera yare korokwa mana, na enyimbo ya Aroni yasebogete, ne chibao chi’amagena aase amang’ana okobwatana kw’ogotianania ariikire.
swahili: ambapo palikuwa na yale madhabahu ya dhahabu ya kufukizia uvumba, na lile Sanduku la Agano lililofunikwa kwa dhahabu. Sanduku hili lilikuwa na gudulia la dhahabu lenye mana, ile fimbo ya Aroni iliyochipuka, na vile vibao vya mawe vya Agano.

english: Above the ark were the cherubim of glory, overshadowing the mercy seat. But we cannot discuss these things in detail now.
ekegusii: Igoro yaye yarengeo emegwekano y’ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba y’obonene yare kobekera egeikaransero ki’amaabera ekiriri. Bono titokonyara goteeba amang’ana ’ebinto ebi ekemo ekemo.
swahili: Juu ya lile Sanduku kulikuwa na makerubi ya Utukufu yakitilia kivuli kile kifuniko ambacho ndicho kiti cha rehema. Lakini hatuwezi kueleza vitu hivi kwa undani sasa.

english: When everything had been prepared in this way, the priests entered regularly into the first room to perform their sacred duties.
ekegusii: Ebinto ebi kobiaroisigwe igo, abakuani baare gosoa ase Eema ye ritang’ani ase amatuko onsi na goikerania obokoreri bwabo,
swahili: Basi vitu hivi vilipokuwa vimepangwa, makuhani waliingia daima katika sehemu ya kwanza ya hema ili kufanya taratibu zao za ibada.

english: But only the high priest entered the second room, and then only once a year, and never without blood, which he offered for himself and for the sins the people had committed in ignorance.
ekegusii: korende Eema ya kabere Omokuani Omonene ore gosoa bweka ara rimo kera omwaka, na tare konyara gosoa atari namanyinga, ayare korua ase engencho yaye ere omonyene na ase engencho y’amamocho ’abaanto.
swahili: Lakini ni kuhani mkuu peke yake aliyeingia ndani ya sehemu ya pili ya hema. Tena hii ilikuwa mara moja tu kwa mwaka, na hakuingia kamwe bila damu, ambayo alitoa kwa ajili yake mwenyewe na kwa ajili ya dhambi za watu walizotenda bila kukusudia.

english: By this arrangement the Holy Spirit was showing that the way into the Most Holy Place had not yet been disclosed as long as the first tabernacle was still standing.
ekegusii: Omoika Omochenu nigo okworokereria ring’ana eri, ng’a enchera y’ogosoa Aase Aachenu konya teraorokigwa ekero Eema ye ritang’ani ereo eteneine.
swahili: Kwa njia hii, Roho Mtakatifu alikuwa anaonyesha kwamba, maadamu ile hema ya kwanza ilikuwa bado imesimama, njia ya kuingia Patakatifu pa Patakafifu ilikuwa bado haijafunguliwa.

english: It is an illustration for the present time, because the gifts and sacrifices being offered were unable to cleanse the conscience of the worshiper.
ekegusii: Eyio nekiorokererio ase engaki eye ya bono, ekero ebiegwa na ebing’wanso bikorugwa, ebitanyare komoikerania oyokobirua erinde enkoro yaye temogambia.
swahili: Huu ulikuwa mfano kwa ajili ya wakati wa sasa, kuonyesha kwamba sadaka na dhabihu zilizokuwa zikitolewa hazikuweza kusafisha dhamiri ya mtu anayeabudu.

english: Israel was a luxuriant vine, yielding fruit for himself. The more his fruit increased, the more he increased the altars. The better his land produced, the better he made the sacred pillars.
ekegusii: Abaisraeli nigo banga buna omosabibu okororekana ore omuya mono okwama amasabibu. Buna koreng’ana okwama kwabo kwamentekanete, naboigo bagendererete koagacha ebisasimero ebinge; na buna bagendererete gotenenka, naboigo bagendererete gotenenia chisiiro bagosasiima.
swahili: Israeli alikuwa mzabibu uliostawi sana, alijizalia matunda mwenyewe. Kadiri matunda yake yalivyoongezeka, alijenga madhabahu zaidi; kadiri nchi yake ilivyostawi, alipamba mawe yake ya ibada.

english: I will chasten them when I please; nations will be gathered against them to put them in bondage for their double transgression.
ekegusii: Ekero ndaganie, nimbae egesusuro gi’okobarongeyia, erio abanto b’ebisaku ebiaao mbasangererekane amo, baabachere amo baabae egesusuro ase engencho y’ebibe biabo bibere.
swahili: Wakati nitakapopenda, nitawaadhibu; mataifa yatakusanywa dhidi yao ili kuwaweka katika vifungo kwa ajili ya dhambi zao mbili.

english: Ephraim is a well-trained heifer that loves to thresh; but I will place a yoke on her fair neck. I will harness Ephraim, Judah will plow, and Jacob will break the hard ground.
ekegusii: Abaefraimu nigo baarenge buna ritororo riorokereretigwe buya, rianchete koora, inche nigo nabegete rikorogoto ase ebigoti biabo ebiya. Bono nimbeekere Abaefraimu rikorogoto, nonya n’Abayuda goika babe bakorema, na Abayakobo goika babe bakobosa.
swahili: Efraimu ni mtamba wa ngʼombe aliyefundishwa ambaye hupenda kupura, hivyo nitamfunga nira juu ya shingo yake nzuri. Nitamwendesha Efraimu, Yuda lazima alime, naye Yakobo lazima avunjavunje mabonge ya udongo.

english: Sow for yourselves righteousness and reap the fruit of loving devotion; break up your unplowed ground. For it is time to seek the LORD until He comes and sends righteousness upon you like rain.
ekegusii: Ebusurere oboronge, mogese ayare ay’obwanchani, eremere chimbuna chiaino, ekiagera eye nero engaki y’okomorigia Omonene, erinde ache abatwerie oboronge buna embura egotwa.
swahili: Jipandieni wenyewe haki, vuneni matunda ya upendo usio na kikomo, vunjeni ardhi yenu isiyolimwa; kwa kuwa ni wakati wa kumtafuta Bwana, mpaka atakapokuja na kuwanyeshea juu yenu haki.

english: You have plowed wickedness and reaped injustice; you have eaten the fruit of lies. Because you have trusted in your own way and in the multitude of your mighty men,
ekegusii: Mwasimekire ayare amabe, mwagesire aya atari ay’oboronge, mwarire ayare okwama kw’oborimo. Nigo mwasemeretie ogokora kwaino, na obonge bw’abasikari baino chituoni.
swahili: Lakini mmepanda uovu, mkavuna ubaya, mmekula tunda la udanganyifu. Kwa sababu mmetegemea nguvu zenu wenyewe na wingi wa mashujaa wenu,

english: the roar of battle will rise against your people, so that all your fortresses will be demolished as Shalman devastated Beth-arbel in the day of battle, when mothers were dashed to pieces along with their children.
ekegusii: Ase ayio eriomana rie chiseegi ndibe ase egati y’abanto baino, ne chiburi chiaino chisarigwe, buna omorwoti Salimani asaretie Beti‐Aribeli ase rituko riria ri’esegi, abang’ina amo nabana babo banachanetwe bakaba ebing’ese.
swahili: mngurumo wa vita utainuka dhidi ya watu wako, ili kwamba ngome zako zote zitaharibiwa: kama Shalmani alivyoharibu Beth-Arbeli katika siku ile ya vita, wakati mama pamoja na watoto wao walipotupwa kwa nguvu ardhini.

english: Thus it will be done to you, O Bethel, because of your great wickedness. When the day dawns, the king of Israel will be utterly cut off.
ekegusii: Naboigo na abanto ba Beteli barabakore ase engencho y’obobe bwaino obonene. Kobogokiamoka omorwoti bw’Abaisraeli naitwe akwe.
swahili: Ndivyo itakavyotokea kwako, ee Betheli, kwa sababu uovu wako ni mkuu. Siku ile itakapopambazuka, mfalme wa Israeli ataharibiwa kabisa.

english: Their hearts are devious; now they must bear their guilt. The LORD will break down their altars and demolish their sacred pillars.
ekegusii: Nigo bare abang’ainereria ase chinkoro chiabo; ase ayio goika baegwe egesusuro gi’okomocha kwabo. Omonene natagore ebisasimero biabo, atagore ne chisiiro chiabo bagosasiima.
swahili: Moyo wao ni mdanganyifu, nao sasa lazima wachukue hatia yao. Bwana atabomoa madhabahu zao na kuharibu mawe yao ya ibada.

english: Surely now they will say, “We have no king, for we do not revere the LORD. What can a king do for us?”
ekegusii: Erio abanto abwo mbateebe, “Titobwati omorwoti, ekiagera titomoirogeti Omonene. Inee! Toraba nomorwoti, ngento ki aratokorere?”
swahili: Kisha watasema, “Hatuna mfalme kwa sababu hatukumheshimu Bwana. Lakini hata kama tungelikuwa na mfalme, angeweza kutufanyia nini?”

english: They speak mere words; with false oaths they make covenants. So judgment springs up like poisonous weeds in the furrows of a field.
ekegusii: Nigo bagokwana amang’ana atari nengencho, naende betiania ase oborimo ekero bagokora okobwatana kw’ogotianania; ase igo ekiina nigo gekobacheera buna ekemeri kere nobosongo ase emetaro ya mogondo.
swahili: Wanaweka ahadi nyingi, huapa viapo vya uongo wanapofanya mapatano; kwa hiyo mashtaka huchipuka kama magugu ya sumu katika shamba lililolimwa.

english: The people of Samaria will fear for the calf of Beth-aven. Indeed, its people will mourn with its idolatrous priests— those who rejoiced in its glory— for it has been taken from them into exile.
ekegusii: Abanto bamenyete Samaria mbatengechigwe ase engencho y’omogwekano bw’emori bagosasiima agwo Beti‐Aveni. Abwo bakoyosasiima mbarere, na abakuani baye mbeng’ererie, ekiagera obonene bwaye bwasirigwe.
swahili: Watu wanaoishi Samaria huogopa kwa ajili ya sanamu ya ndama ya Beth-Aveni. Watu wake wataiombolezea, vivyo hivyo kuhani wake wa kuabudu sanamu, wale waliokuwa wamefurahia fahari yake, kwa sababu itaondolewa kutoka kwao kwenda uhamishoni.

english: Yes, it will be carried to Assyria as tribute to the great king. Ephraim will be seized with shame; Israel will be ashamed of its wooden idols.
ekegusii: Omogwekano oyio noirwe Asuri, oegwe omorwoti Yarebu buna ekeegwa. Abaefraimu mbabe nobosooku, na Abaisraeli mbasookigwe boigo ase engencho y’emeroberio yabo abanyene.
swahili: Itachukuliwa kwenda Ashuru kama ushuru kwa mfalme mkuu. Efraimu atafedheheshwa; Israeli ataaibika kwa ajili ya sanamu zake za mti.

english: Samaria will be carried off with her king like a twig on the surface of the water.
ekegusii: Omorwoti o Samaria nasirigwe arueo buna riuro rigosira korwa ase amaache igoro.
swahili: Samaria na mfalme wake wataelea kama kijiti juu ya uso wa maji.

english: The high places of Aven will be destroyed— it is the sin of Israel; thorns and thistles will overgrow their altars. Then they will say to the mountains, “Cover us!” and to the hills, “Fall on us!”
ekegusii: Aase aimokererete igoro agosasimerwa agwo Aveni, ase Abaisraeli bakoreire ebibe, nasirigwe. Amagwa na amageri mbimere ase ebisasimero biabo; erio abanto abwo bateebie ebitunwa: “Totube”, na ebigoro: “Togwere”. Omonene okonachera Abaisraeli ekiina.
swahili: Mahali pa kuabudia sanamu pa uovu pataharibiwa: ndiyo dhambi ya Israeli. Miiba na mibaruti itaota na kufunika madhabahu zao. Kisha wataiambia milima, “Tufunikeni!” na vilima, “Tuangukieni!”

english: Since the days of Gibeah you have sinned, O Israel, and there you have remained. Did not the battle in Gibeah overtake the sons of iniquity?
ekegusii: Inwe Abaisraeli, nigo mwagendererete gokora ebibe korwa ase amatuko aria mwarenge Gibea, na goika bono nigo mogendererete gokora bo. Inee! Esegi y’okorusia egesiomba igoro y’abakori amabe tiyababuete agwo Gibea?
swahili: “Tangu siku za Gibea, mmetenda dhambi, ee Israeli, huko ndiko mlikobaki. Je, vita havikuwapata watenda mabaya huko Gibea?

english: When Israel was a child, I loved him, and out of Egypt I called My son.
ekegusii: “Ekero Israeli arenge omwana, nigo namwanchete, na korwa Misiri nkarangeria omwana one.
swahili: “Wakati Israeli alipokuwa mtoto, nilimpenda, nilimwita mwanangu kutoka Misri.

english: They will walk after the LORD; He will roar like a lion. When He roars, His children will come trembling from the west.
ekegusii: “Abanto abwo mbabwatie Omonene; ere narume buna endo, ee, narume, na abanto baye mbache korwa bosongo bakoiguswa.
swahili: Watamfuata Bwana; atanguruma kama simba. Wakati angurumapo, watoto wake watakuja wakitetemeka kutoka magharibi.

english: They will come trembling like birds from Egypt and like doves from the land of Assyria. Then I will settle them in their homes, declares the LORD.
ekegusii: Mbairuruke buna chinyoni korwa Misiri, bache bakoiguswa, na buna amaruma korwa ase ense y’Asuri. Nimbabeeke bamenye ase chinka chiabo.” Nabo Omonene ateebire. Abaisraeli amo Abayuda bakogaambigwa
swahili: Watakuja wakitetemeka kama ndege wakitoka Misri, kama hua wakitoka Ashuru. Nitawakalisha katika nyumba zao,” asema Bwana. Dhambi Ya Israeli

english: Ephraim surrounds Me with lies, the house of Israel with deceit; but Judah still walks with God and is faithful to the Holy One.
ekegusii: Abaefraimu nigo bang’etananire n’amang’ana ’oborimo, na Abaisraeli boigo n’amang’ana ’obong’ainereria; n’Abayuda nigo bagendererete gosaria ase Nyasae, oria ore Omochenu na Omwegenwa.
swahili: Efraimu amenizunguka kwa uongo, nyumba ya Israeli kwa udanganyifu. Naye Yuda ni mkaidi dhidi ya Mungu, hata kinyume cha yule mwaminifu Aliye Mtakatifu.

english: But the more I called Israel, the farther they departed from Me. They sacrificed to the Baals and burned incense to carved images.
ekegusii: Buna bagendererete korangerigwa, nabo bagendererete kona‐kwerusanania. Nigo babete bakorua ebing’wanso ase chinyasae Baali, na bagasamba ubani ase emegwekano baarenge gosasiima.
swahili: Lakini kadiri nilivyomwita Israeli, ndivyo walivyokwenda mbali nami. Walitoa dhabihu kwa Mabaali na kufukiza uvumba kwa vinyago.

english: It was I who taught Ephraim to walk, taking them in My arms, but they never realized that it was I who healed them.
ekegusii: Ninche norokereretie Abaefraimu gotaara, nkababogoria namaboko aane, korende abanto abwo tibamanyete ng’a nigo naganetie kobagwenia.
swahili: Mimi ndiye niliyemfundisha Efraimu kutembea, nikiwashika mikono; lakini hawakutambua kuwa ni mimi niliyewaponya.

english: I led them with cords of kindness, with ropes of love; I lifted the yoke from their necks and bent down to feed them.
ekegusii: Nigo nabang’usete ne chingori chinyororo, ee, ne chingori chi’obwanchani. Nigo nororobetie rikorogoto igoro ye chinsea chiabo, ngekumba gochia inse nkabarageria.
swahili: Niliwaongoza kwa kamba za huruma ya kibinadamu, kwa vifungo vya upendo; niliondoa nira shingoni mwao nami nikainama kuwalisha.

english: Will they not return to the land of Egypt and be ruled by Assyria because they refused to repent?
ekegusii: “Barabwo mbairane gochia ase ense ya Misiri, na Abaasuri mbaabagambere, ekiagera bangire koirana gocha ase ’nde.
swahili: “Je, hawatarudi Misri, nayo Ashuru haitawatawala kwa sababu wamekataa kutubu?

english: A sword will flash through their cities; it will destroy the bars of their gates and consume them in their own plans.
ekegusii: Omoro nogwere emechie yabo nobotindi, nosarie emekorogoto y’ebiita biabo na gosaria kende gionsi ase engencho y’emeroberio yabo abanyene.
swahili: Panga zitametameta katika miji yao, zitaharibu makomeo ya malango yao na kukomesha mipango yao.

english: My people are bent on turning from Me. Though they call to the Most High, He will by no means exalt them. God’s Love for Israel
ekegusii: Abanto baane nigo banchete gontiga, nonya bakorangerigwa gochia ase Oyore Igoro Mono, onde tari okomotogia, nonya noyomo.
swahili: Watu wangu wamedhamiria kuniacha. Hata kama wakimwita Yeye Aliye Juu Sana, kwa vyovyote hatawainua.

english: How could I give you up, O Ephraim? How could I surrender you, O Israel? How could I make you like Admah? How could I treat you like Zeboiim? My heart is turned within Me; My compassion is stirred!
ekegusii: “Inwe Abaefraimu, naki ndakore mbatige? Inwe Abaisraeli, naki ndakore mbatige morue asende? Naki ndakore mbatige buna natigete Adima? Naki ndakore mbakorere buna nakorerete Seboimu? Enkoro yane nigo egwoka, na amaabera aane onsi abokire ime yane.
swahili: “Efraimu, ninawezaje kukuacha? Ee Israeli, ninawezaje kukutoa? Nitawezaje kukutendea kama Adma? Nitawezaje kukufanya kama Seboimu? Moyo wangu umegeuka ndani yangu, huruma zangu zote zimeamshwa.

english: I will not execute the full fury of My anger; I will not turn back to destroy Ephraim. For I am God and not man— the Holy One among you— and I will not come in wrath.
ekegusii: Tinkobaa egesusuro konde nendamwamu egwoka, gose tingosiria Abaefraimu naende, ekiagera inche nigo ’nde Nyasae, tindi Mwanyabaanto. Inche nigo inde Omochenu imenyete ase egati yaino, na tingocha ase more inde nekeririanda.
swahili: Sitatimiza hasira yangu kali, wala sitageuka na kumharibu Efraimu. Kwa kuwa mimi ndimi Mungu, wala si mwanadamu, Aliye Mtakatifu miongoni mwenu. Sitakuja kwa ghadhabu.

english: Ephraim chases the wind and pursues the east wind all day long; he multiplies lies and violence; he makes a covenant with Assyria and sends olive oil to Egypt.
ekegusii: Abaefraimu nigo bakwerageria embeo, nigo bakobwatia embeo ya moocha omobaso bwonsi. Kera rituko nigo bakomenta gokwana oborimo, na gokora ay’obotindi. Nigo bakobwatana n’Abaasuri, babe bakoira amaguta ’amazeituni ase ense ya Misiri.
swahili: Efraimu anajilisha upepo; hufukuzia upepo wa mashariki kutwa nzima na kuzidisha uongo na jeuri. Anafanya mkataba na Ashuru na kutuma mafuta ya zeituni Misri.

english: I spoke through the prophets and multiplied their visions; I gave parables through the prophets.
ekegusii: “Nigo narenge gokwana nababani, nkaba nkobaorokeria amaroro amange ao ao, na goetera ase ababani nkaba ngokwana nabarabwo ase emereng’anio.
swahili: Niliongea na manabii, nikawapa maono mengi na kusema mifano kupitia wao.”

english: Is there iniquity in Gilead? They will surely come to nothing. Do they sacrifice bulls in Gilgal? Indeed, their altars will be heaps of stones in the furrows of the field.
ekegusii: Onye ebibe bire ime ya Gileadi, abanto b’aroro goika basire. Onye abanto ba Giligali bakoruera ebing’wanso bie chieri aroro ase ebisasimero biabo, birobio mbisarigwe bibe buna obonge bwa amagena ase emetaro y’emegondo.”
swahili: Je, Gileadi si mwovu? Watu wake hawafai kitu! Je, hawatoi dhabihu za mafahali huko Gilgali? Madhabahu zao zitakuwa kama malundo ya mawe katika shamba lililolimwa.

english: Jacob fled to the land of Aram and Israel worked for a wife— for a wife he tended sheep.
ekegusii: Yakobo nigo atamete gochia ase ense y’Aramu, ere Israeli agakora emeremo ase okonyora omokungu, ee, akarisia ching’ondi ase okonyora omokungu.
swahili: Yakobo alikimbilia katika nchi ya Aramu; Israeli alitumika ili apate mke, ili aweze kulipa kwa ajili yake alichunga kondoo.

english: But by a prophet the LORD brought Israel out of Egypt, and by a prophet he was preserved.
ekegusii: Goetera ase omobani Omonene akang’anyia Abaisraeli korwa ase ense ya Misiri, na goetera ase omobani abanto abwo bakaba barendire.
swahili: Bwana alimtumia nabii kumpandisha Israeli kutoka Misri, kwa njia ya nabii alimtunza.

english: Ephraim has provoked bitter anger, so his Lord will leave his bloodguilt upon him and repay him for his contempt.
ekegusii: Abaefraimu abwo bagechetie Omonene goika ere akaba nendamwamu enene mono; ase ayio Omonene obo nabeeke okomocha kw’ogoiterwa kw’amanyinga abo kobe igoro yabo; nabairanerie okogechia kwabo.
swahili: Lakini Efraimu amemchochea sana hasira; Bwana wake ataleta juu yake hatia yake ya kumwaga damu naye atamlipiza kwa ajili ya dharau yake.

english: The LORD also brings a charge against Judah. He will punish Jacob according to his ways and repay him according to his deeds.
ekegusii: Omonene nabwate amang’ana akwomania Abayuda, nae abanto ba Yakobo egesusuro koreng’ana ne chinchera chiabo, nabaakane koreng’ana nogokora kwabo.
swahili: Bwana analo shtaka dhidi ya Yuda, atamwadhibu Yakobo kwa kadiri ya njia zake na kumlipa kwa kadiri ya matendo yake.

english: In the womb he grasped his brother’s heel, and in his vigor he wrestled with God.
ekegusii: Ekero Yakobo arenge ase enda ya ng’ina, nigo abwatete egetingiro kia momura omwabo, na ekero abeete omonto omonene, agakinana na Nyasae.
swahili: Yakobo akiwa tumboni alishika kisigino cha kaka yake; kama mwanadamu, alishindana na Mungu.

english: Yes, he struggled with the angel and prevailed; he wept and sought His favor; he found Him at Bethel and spoke with Him there —
ekegusii: Ee, nigo akinanete nomomalaika, akamobua; akarera, akamosorora ng’a amororere amaabera. Agwo Beteli Yakobo akaumerana na Nyasae, erio agakwana naintwe.
swahili: Alishindana na malaika na kumshinda; alilia na kuomba upendeleo wake. Alimkuta huko Betheli na kuzungumza naye huko:

english: the LORD is the God of Hosts— the LORD is His name of renown.
ekegusii: Omonene nere Nyasae bw’Emeganda. Omonene nario erieta riaye.
swahili: Bwana Mungu Mwenye Nguvu Zote, Bwana ndilo jina lake!

english: But you must return to your God, maintaining love and justice, and always waiting on your God.
ekegusii: Ase ayio, aye irana ase Nyasae oo. Obwatie obwanchani na oboronge bwaye, erio obe komosemeretie Nyasae oo botambe. Okogaambigwa kogendererete
swahili: Lakini ni lazima urudi kwa Mungu wako; dumisha upendo na haki, nawe umngojee Mungu wako siku zote.

english: A merchant loves to defraud with dishonest scales in his hands.
ekegusii: Omoonchoreria nigo abwate ebirengero bi’obong’ainereria ase amaboko aye, nigo anchete gokora oborianania.
swahili: Mfanyabiashara hutumia vipimo vya udanganyifu; hupenda kupunja.

english: And Ephraim boasts: “How rich I have become! I have found wealth for myself. In all my labors, they can find in me no iniquity that is sinful.”
ekegusii: Abaefraimu nigo bagoteeba: “Amaene twabeire abanda, twenyoreire obotenenku; ase emeremo yaito yonsi monto onde tari oranyare gotosoera ng’a nigo twanyorire obonda obo ase enchera y’ebibe bi’oborianania.”
swahili: Efraimu hujisifu akisema, “Mimi ni tajiri sana; nimetajirika. Pamoja na utajiri wangu wote hawatakuta ndani yangu uovu wowote au dhambi.”

english: But I am the LORD your God ever since the land of Egypt. I will again make you dwell in tents, as in the days of the appointed feast.
ekegusii: Korende inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino, korwa ekero keria mwarenge Misiri, nimbabeeke momenye ase chiema naende, buna yarenge Amatuko Amanene aria achiikire.
swahili: “Mimi ndimi Bwana Mungu wenu niliyewaleta kutoka Misri; nitawafanya mkae tena kwenye mahema, kama vile katika siku za sikukuu zenu zilizoamriwa.

english: When Ephraim spoke, there was trembling; he was exalted in Israel. But he incurred guilt through Baal, and he died.
ekegusii: Ekero Abaefraimu baarenge gokwana, abanto nigo baarenge koiguswa; nigo beimokereretie igoro ase egati y’Abaisraeli; korende bakarenta okomocha ase ogosasiima enyasae Baali, na ase ayio bagakwa.
swahili: Wakati Efraimu alipozungumza, watu walitetemeka, alikuwa ametukuzwa katika Israeli. Lakini alikuwa na hatia ya kumwabudu Baali naye akafa.

english: Where is your king now to save you in all your cities, and the rulers to whom you said, “Give me a king and princes”?
ekegusii: Bono ng’ai omorwoti oino are, erinde abatoorie ase emechie yaino yonsi? Ng’ai abagaambi ebiina baino bare, inwe abamwateebete: Toe omorwoti na abagaambi batogambere?
swahili: Yuko wapi mfalme wako, ili apate kukuokoa? Wako wapi watawala wako katika miji yako yote ambao ulisema kuwahusu, ‘Nipe mfalme na wakuu’?

english: So in My anger I gave you a king, and in My wrath I took him away.
ekegusii: Nkabaa omorwoti inde nendamwamu, naende namorusirie inde nekeririanda.
swahili: Hivyo katika hasira yangu nilikupa mfalme na katika ghadhabu yangu nilimwondoa.

english: The iniquity of Ephraim is bound up; his sin is stored up.
ekegusii: “Obobe bw’Abaefraimu nigo bosibire amo, na ebibe biabo nigo birikire bigachire.
swahili: Kosa la Efraimu limehifadhiwa, dhambi zake zimewekwa katika kumbukumbu.

english: Labor pains come upon him, but he is an unwise son. When the time arrives, he fails to present himself at the opening of the womb.
ekegusii: Obororo bonga buna obw’omokuungu okobina aibore mbobachere, nigo bonga buna omwana otari nokomanya osinyirwe gosoka korwa ase enda ya ng’ina ekero engaki yaye yaikire.
swahili: Utungu kama wa mwanamke anayejifungua mtoto humjia, lakini yeye ni mtoto asiyekuwa na hekima; wakati utakapowadia hatatoka katika tumbo la mama yake.

english: I will ransom them from the power of Sheol; I will redeem them from Death. Where, O Death, are your plagues? Where, O Sheol, is your sting? Compassion is hidden from My eyes. Judgment on Samaria
ekegusii: Nimbaboorie korwa ase okobua gw’aase abakuure, na nimbatoorie korwa ase amakweri. Aye amakweri, amaako ao ng’ai are? Aye aase abakuure, ng’ai ogosiria kwao kore? Ogweitia gwasirire korwa ase amaiso aane?
swahili: “Nitawakomboa watu hawa kutoka nguvu za kaburi, nitawakomboa kutoka mautini. Yako wapi, ee mauti, mateso yako? Uko wapi, ee kuzimu, uharibifu wako? “Sitakuwa na huruma,

english: Although he flourishes among his brothers, an east wind will come— a wind from the LORD rising up from the desert. His fountain will fail, and his spring will run dry. The wind will plunder his treasury of every precious article.
ekegusii: Abaefraimu nabaisa koibora babuche ase egati y’abamwabo, omwaga korwa moocha noche, ee, omwaga o Omonene noche korwa ase erooro. Erio ebisima biabo bi’amaache biome, ne chinsoko chiabo chikame. Omwaga oyio nosirie kegima chinibo chiabo banchete.
swahili: hata ingawa Efraimu atastawi miongoni mwa ndugu zake. Upepo wa mashariki kutoka kwa Bwana utakuja, ukivuma kutoka jangwani, chemchemi yake haitatoa maji na kisima chake kitakauka. Ghala lake litatekwa hazina zake zote.

english: Samaria will bear her guilt because she has rebelled against her God. They will fall by the sword; their little ones will be dashed to pieces, and their pregnant women ripped open.
ekegusii: Abanto ba Samaria mbaegwe egesusuro, ekiagera basaririe ase Nyasae obo, mbaitwe nemioro, na abana babo banachanwe ebing’ese. Abakungu babo bare barito mbatandorwe chinda.”
swahili: Watu wa Samaria ni lazima wabebe hatia yao, kwa sababu wameasi dhidi ya Mungu wao. Wataanguka kwa upanga; watoto wao wadogo watatupwa kwa nguvu ardhini, wanawake wao walio na mimba watatumbuliwa.”

english: Now they sin more and more and make for themselves cast images, idols skillfully made from their silver, all of them the work of craftsmen. People say of them, “They offer human sacrifice and kiss the calves!”
ekegusii: Nigo bagendererete gokora ebibe goetania, bakaroisia emegwekano ye chifeta bagosasiima, eyio babombete nobong’aini. Eyio yonsi nemeremo yaroisirie nabaroisia b’ebinto. Nigo bagoteeba igoro y’abwo: “Abwo bakorua abanto baba ebing’wanso, nigo bakonyunyunta emegwekano eyio ye chimori.”
swahili: Sasa wanatenda dhambi zaidi na zaidi; wanajitengenezea sanamu kutokana na fedha yao, vinyago vilivyotengenezwa kwa uhodari, vyote kazi ya fundi stadi. Inasemekana kuhusu hawa watu, “Hutoa dhabihu za binadamu na kubusu sanamu za ndama.”

english: Therefore they will be like the morning mist, like the early dew that vanishes, like chaff blown from a threshing floor, like smoke through an open window.
ekegusii: Ase ayio abanto abwo nabasire buna ritaturi ria mambia, gose buna riime rigosira bwango, na buna omoiriro okoirurukigwa nomwaga korwa ase ekeooreri, gose buna erioki rigoetera ase ekebao riasira.
swahili: Kwa hiyo watakuwa kama ukungu wa asubuhi, kama umande wa alfajiri utowekao, kama makapi yapeperushwayo kutoka sakafu ya kupuria nafaka, kama moshi utorokao kupitia dirishani.

english: Yet I am the LORD your God ever since the land of Egypt; you know no God but Me, for there is no Savior besides Me.
ekegusii: “Inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino, korwa ekero mwarenge ase ense ya Misiri. Timwabeete momanyete enyasae ende yonsi otatiga inche; omotooria onde tari otatiga inche.
swahili: “Bali mimi ndimi Bwana Mungu wenu, niliyewaleta ninyi toka Misri. Msimkubali Mungu mwingine ila mimi, hakuna Mwokozi isipokuwa mimi.

english: I knew you in the wilderness, in the land of drought.
ekegusii: Ninche nabarendete ase erooro, ense eria enyomo pa egosamba.
swahili: Niliwatunza huko jangwani, katika nchi yenye joto liunguzalo.

english: When they had pasture, they became satisfied; when they were satisfied, their hearts became proud, and as a result they forgot Me.
ekegusii: Korende ekero banyorete endagera eisaine, bakaria bakaigota, erio bakaenena na kweimokereria igoro; ase ayio bakanyeba.
swahili: Nilipowalisha, walishiba, waliposhiba, wakajivuna, kisha wakanisahau mimi.

english: So like a lion I will pounce on them; like a leopard I will lurk by the path.
ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio nkaba buna endo ase bare, nkababoera ase chinchera chiabo buna engo ekoboera.
swahili: Kwa hiyo nitakuja juu yao kama simba, kama chui nitawavizia kando ya njia.

english: Like a bear robbed of her cubs I will attack them, and I will tear open their chests. There I will devour them like a lion, like a wild beast would tear them apart. Death and Resurrection (1 Corinthians 15:50–58)
ekegusii: Nimbaumokere buna edubu yaurirwe chimanwa chiaye, mbatandore ebikuba biabo, erinde mbaite mbarie buna endo ekoria, ee, nimbe buna eng’iti y’orosana mbatandorane.
swahili: Kama dubu aliyenyangʼanywa watoto wake, nitawashambulia na kurarua vifua vyenu. Kama simba nitawala; mnyama pori atawararua vipande vipande.

english: You are destroyed, O Israel, because you are against Me— against your helper.
ekegusii: “Inwe Abaisraeli mwesiririe inwe abanyene ase okoba mamincha yane, inche oyo narenge ooboseemiaka kwaino.
swahili: “Ee Israeli, umeangamizwa, kwa sababu wewe u kinyume nami, kinyume na msaidizi wako.

english: Return, O Israel, to the LORD your God, for you have stumbled by your iniquity.
ekegusii: Inwe Abaisraeli, irana ase Omonene Nyasae oino, ekiagera ebibe biaino nabio biabagochire na kobaiyeria.
swahili: Rudi, ee Israeli, kwa Bwana Mungu wako. Dhambi zako zimekuwa ndilo anguko lako!

english: Bring your confessions and return to the LORD. Say to Him: “Take away all our iniquity and receive us graciously, that we may present the fruit of our lips.
ekegusii: Irana ase Omonene, momoteebie amang’ana aya: Toruserie obobe bwaito bwonsi obwo twakorire, bwanchere ayare amaya, naintwe torue asore ogotogia kw’ebikoba biaito konga buna okoruegwa kw’ebing’wanso bie chieri.
swahili: Chukueni maneno pamoja nanyi, mkamrudie Bwana. Mwambieni: “Samehe dhambi zetu zote na utupokee kwa neema, ili tuweze kutoa matunda yetu kama sadaka za mafahali.

english: Assyria will not save us, nor will we ride on horses. We will never again say, ‘Our gods!’ to the work of our own hands. For in You the fatherless find compassion.” A Promise of God’s Blessing
ekegusii: Abaasuri tibakonyara gototooria; titokoriina chibarasi gose titokogenderera koroka emeremo y’amaboko aito Nyasae oito. Aye Omonene nigo okoorokia amaabera ase oyore entakana. Omonene okoriera Abaisraeli eira y’okobanyorera obogima oboyia
swahili: Ashuru hawezi kutuokoa, hatutapanda farasi wa vita. Kamwe hatutasema tena ‘Miungu yetu’ kwa kile ambacho mikono yetu wenyewe imetengeneza, kwa kuwa kwako wewe yatima hupata huruma.”

english: I will heal their apostasy; I will freely love them, for My anger has turned away from them.
ekegusii: “Ningwenie abwo batigire obwegenwa bwabo. Nimbanche nenkoro yane yonsi, ekiagera endamwamu yane yabatigire.
swahili: “Nitaponya ukaidi wao na kuwapenda kwa hiari yangu, kwa kuwa hasira yangu imeondoka kwao.

english: I will be like the dew to Israel; he will blossom like the lily and take root like the cedars of Lebanon.
ekegusii: Niimbe buna riime ase Abaisraeli, na barabwo mbasiche buna ebisicha ebiya, mbakinie emeri buna emete ya Lebanoni.
swahili: Nitakuwa kama umande kwa Israeli; atachanua kama yungiyungi. Kama mwerezi wa Lebanoni atashusha mizizi yake chini;

english: His shoots will sprout, and his splendor will be like the olive tree, his fragrance like the cedars of Lebanon.
ekegusii: Ebisabo biabo mbirande, na obwari bwabo nabobe buna obw’emezeituni, ne rimisu riabo ndiesiarere buna eri’emete ya Lebanoni.
swahili: matawi yake yatatanda. Fahari yake itakuwa kama mti wa mzeituni, harufu yake nzuri kama mwerezi wa Lebanoni.

english: They will return and dwell in his shade; they will grow grain and blossom like the vine. His renown will be like the wine of Lebanon.
ekegusii: Abwo baramenye inse ase ekiriri kiabo bairane, bagenderere koreereta buna ebimeri bia mogondo mbasiche, na obonene bwabo bobe buna obw’emesabibu ya Lebanoni.
swahili: Watu wataishi tena kwenye kivuli chake. Atastawi kama nafaka. Atachanua kama mzabibu, nao umaarufu wake utakuwa kama divai itokayo Lebanoni.

english: O Ephraim, what have I to do anymore with idols? It is I who answer and watch over him. I am like a flourishing cypress; your fruit comes from Me.
ekegusii: Inwe Abaefraimu, naki ngokora nemegwekano yaino mogosasiima? Ninche omonyene naigure ogosaba kwaino inwe Abaefraimu, nimbairanerie, naende ninche mbarendete. Inche nigo inde buna omotarakwa omobese; na okwama kwaino nigo gokonyorekana ime yane.” Amang’ana ay’ogokoorera
swahili: Ee Efraimu, nina shughuli gani tena na sanamu? Nitamjibu na kumtunza. Mimi ni kama msunobari wenye majani mabichi; kuzaa kwako matunda kunatoka kwangu.”

english: Whoever is wise, let him understand these things; whoever is discerning, let him know them. For the ways of the LORD are right, and the righteous walk in them but the rebellious stumble in them.
ekegusii: Oyore omong’aini, nere oramanye amang’ana aya; oyore nokomanya, nere orayarengererie. Chinchera chi’Omonene nigo chire chindonge, na abanyene oboronge nabwo baraetere aroro, korende abasaria nigo baragochwe bagwe ase chirochio.
swahili: Ni nani mwenye hekima? Atayatambua mambo haya. Ni nani mwenye ufahamu? Huyu atayaelewa. Njia za Bwana ni adili; wenye haki huenda katika njia hizo, lakini waasi watajikwaa ndani yake.

english: This is the word of the LORD that came to Hosea son of Beeri in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, and of Jeroboam son of Jehoash, king of Israel.
ekegusii: Eri nario ring’ana ri’Omonene riacherete Hosea, mosinto o Beeri, ase amatuko aria Usia, na Yotamu, na Ahasi, na Hezekia, baarenge abarwoti b’Abayuda, na ekero Yeroboamu, mosinto o Yehoasi, arenge omorwoti bw’Abaisraeli. Moka Hosea na abana baye
swahili: Neno la Bwana lililomjia Hosea mwana wa Beeri wakati wa utawala wa Uzia, Yothamu, Ahazi na Hezekia, wafalme wa Yuda, na wakati wa utawala wa Yeroboamu mwana wa Yehoashi, mfalme wa Israeli. Mke Wa Hosea Na Watoto

english: Yet the number of the Israelites will be like the sand of the sea, which cannot be measured or counted. And it will happen that in the very place where it was said to them, ‘You are not My people,’ they will be called ‘sons of the living God.’
ekegusii: Korende nonya naboigo, Abaisraeli nigo barabuche mono, babe buna omokenye o nyancha, tibakorengeka gose kobareka. Nebe ng’a ase barenge goteebigwa: Inwe timori abana baane, bono mbateebigwe: Inwe nabana ba Omonene Nyasae ore moyo.
swahili: “Hata hivyo Waisraeli watakuwa kama mchanga kando ya bahari, ambao hauwezi kupimika wala kuhesabiwa. Mahali pale walipoambiwa, ‘Ninyi si watu wangu,’ wao wataitwa ‘wana wa Mungu aliye hai.’

english: Then the people of Judah and of Israel will be gathered together, and they will appoint for themselves one leader, and will go up out of the land. For great will be the day of Jezreel.
ekegusii: Abayuda amo n’Abaisraeli mbasangererekane, erinde bechorere oyomo korwa ase egati yabo erio abe omotwe obo okobaraa, barue ase ense eye. Ee, rituko erio ria Yesireeli nigo rirabe rinene.
swahili: Watu wa Yuda na watu wa Israeli wataunganishwa tena, nao watamchagua kiongozi mmoja nao watakwea watoke katika nchi, kwa kuwa siku ya Yezreeli itakuwa kuu sana.

english: When the LORD first spoke through Hosea, He told him, “Go, take a prostitute as your wife and have children of adultery, because this land is flagrantly prostituting itself by departing from the LORD.”
ekegusii: Agwo ekero Omonene achagete gokwana goetera ase Hosea, Omonene akamoteebia iga: “Genda onyuome omokungu omotayayi, onyore abana b’obotayayi, ekiagera ense eye yantigire inche Omonene ase ogokora obotayayi obonene.”
swahili: Wakati Bwana alipoanza kuzungumza kupitia Hosea, Bwana alimwambia, “Nenda ukajitwalie mwanamke wa uzinzi na watoto wa uzinzi, kwa sababu nchi ina hatia ya uzinzi wa kupindukia kwa kumwacha Bwana.”

english: So Hosea went and married Gomer daughter of Diblaim, and she conceived and bore him a son.
ekegusii: Ase ayio Hosea akagenda, akanyuoma Gomeri, omoiseke o Dibulaimu, na omokungu oyio akaba morito, akamoiborera omwana omoisa.
swahili: Kwa hiyo alimwoa Gomeri binti Diblaimu, naye akachukua mimba na kumzalia Hosea mwana.

english: Then the LORD said to Hosea, “Name him Jezreel, for soon I will bring the bloodshed of Jezreel upon the house of Jehu, and I will put an end to the kingdom of Israel.
ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Hosea, “Moroke Yesireeli, ekiagera engaki netigarete enke, ndarue egesusuro ase ororeeria rwa Yehu, ndusie egesiomba ki’amanyinga aria abanto bamenyete Yesireeli baiterete. Ninsirie kegima oborwoti bw’Abaisraeli.
swahili: Kisha Bwana akamwambia Hosea, “Mwite Yezreeli, kwa kuwa kitambo kidogo nitaiadhibu nyumba ya Yehu kwa ajili ya mauaji ya kule Yezreeli, nami nitaukomesha ufalme wa Israeli.

english: And on that day I will break the bow of Israel in the Valley of Jezreel.”
ekegusii: Ase rituko erio nimbune amata ’Abaisraeli agwo ase ense omweremo ya Yesireeli.”
swahili: Katika siku ile nitavunja upinde wa Israeli katika Bonde la Yezreeli.”

english: Gomer again conceived and gave birth to a daughter, and the LORD said to Hosea, “Name her Lo-ruhamah, for I will no longer have compassion on the house of Israel, that I should ever forgive them.
ekegusii: Naende Gomeri akaba morito, akaibora omwana omoiseke. Erio Omonene agateebia Hosea, “Moroke Lo‐Ruhama, ekiagera tinkonyara kogenderera koba namaabera ase Abaisraeli, gose tinkobaabera nonya ng’ake.
swahili: Gomeri akachukua tena mimba akamzaa binti. Kisha Bwana akamwambia Hosea, “Mwite Lo-Ruhama, kwa maana sitaonyesha tena upendo kwa nyumba ya Israeli, kwamba nisije kabisa nikawasamehe.

english: Yet I will have compassion on the house of Judah, and I will save them—not by bow or sword or war, not by horses and cavalry, but by the LORD their God.”
ekegusii: Korende nindorere Abayuda amaabera. Inche Omonene, Nyasae obo, nimbatoorie ne chinguru chiane, gose tari ase okorwana namata, gose nemioro, gose ne chibarasi chi’esegi, gose nabariini be chibarasi.”
swahili: Hata hivyo nitaonyesha upendo kwa nyumba ya Yuda, nami nitawaokoa si kwa upinde, upanga au vita, wala kwa farasi na wapanda farasi, bali kwa njia ya Bwana Mungu wao.”

english: After she had weaned Lo-ruhamah, Gomer conceived and gave birth to a son.
ekegusii: Ekero Gomeri atachire Lo‐Ruhama, akaba morito naende, akaibora omwana onde omoisia.
swahili: Baada ya Gomeri kumwachisha Lo-Ruhama kunyonya, Gomeri alipata mwana mwingine.

english: And the LORD said, “Name him Lo-ammi, for you are not My people, and I am not your God.
ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Hosea, “Moroke Lo‐Ami, ekiagera inwe timori abana baane, na inche tinkoba Nyasae oino.” Abaisraeli bakoiranerigwa amaya abo
swahili: Kisha Bwana akasema, “Mwite Lo-Ami kwa maana ninyi si watu wangu, nami si Mungu wenu.

english: “Say of your brothers, ‘My people,’ and of your sisters, ‘My loved one.’
ekegusii: Mobaroke abamino abamura Ami, na abamino abasubati Ruhama. Gomeri otari omwegenwa okworokia ng’a Abaisraeli tibari abegenwa
swahili: “Waambie ndugu zako, ‘Watu wangu,’ na pia waambie dada zako, ‘Wapendwa wangu.’ Israeli Aadhibiwa Na Kurudishwa

english: And then I will expose her lewdness in the sight of her lovers, and no one will deliver her out of My hands.
ekegusii: Bono nimochabore chianga chiaye ase amasio ’abanchi baye, imotige ore getirianda, gose monto onde tari oranyare komotooria korwa ase okoboko kwane.
swahili: Basi sasa nitaufunua ufisadi wake mbele ya wapenzi wake; hakuna yeyote atakayemtoa mikononi mwangu.

english: I will put an end to all her exultation: her feasts, New Moons, and Sabbaths— all her appointed feasts.
ekegusii: Ninsirie kegima omogooko oye bwonsi, na Amatuko aye Amanene ay’Emetienyi Emeyia, ne Chisabato chiaye, na emeyega yaye echiikire.
swahili: Nitakomesha furaha na macheko yake yote: sikukuu zake za mwaka, sikukuu za Miandamo ya Mwezi, siku zake za Sabato, sikukuu zake zote zilizoamriwa.

english: I will destroy her vines and fig trees, which she thinks are the wages paid by her lovers. So I will make them into a thicket, and the beasts of the field will devour them.
ekegusii: Ninsirie emesabibu yaye, na emeko yaye, ebio akwanete igoro yabo, agateeba ng’a eyio nero eng’eria yaye abanchi baye bamoete. Inche ninsirie emete eyio ebe orosana, ne ching’iti chi’orosana chiyerie.
swahili: Nitaiharibu mizabibu yake na mitini yake, ambayo alisema yalikuwa malipo yake kutoka kwa wapenzi wake; nitaifanya kuwa kichaka, nao wanyama pori wataila.

english: I will punish her for the days of the Baals when she burned incense to them, when she decked herself with rings and jewelry, and went after her lovers. But Me she forgot,” declares the LORD. God’s Mercy to Israel
ekegusii: Ning’ee omokungu oyio egesusuro ase engencho y’amatuko ayio akorerete chinyasae chiria chia Baali emeyega, agachisambera ubani, naende agechabera ebigera bi’amato na ebinto binde bi’ogwechabera, ekero arenge gotunyana abanchi baye, korende akaanyeba.” Nabo Omonene agoteeba. Obwanchani Omonene ase abanto baye
swahili: Nitamwadhibu kwa ajili ya siku alizowafukizia uvumba Mabaali; alipojipamba kwa pete na kwa vito vya thamani, na kuwaendea wapenzi wake, lakini mimi alinisahau,” asema Bwana.

english: “Therefore, behold, I will allure her and lead her to the wilderness, and speak to her tenderly.
ekegusii: Ase ayio nimoebererie, imoire ase erooro, erinde nkwane nere amang’ana y’obwanchani.
swahili: “Kwa hiyo sasa nitamshawishi; nitamwongoza hadi jangwani na kuzungumza naye kwa upole.

english: There I will give back her vineyards and make the Valley of Achor into a gateway of hope. There she will respond as she did in the days of her youth, as in the day she came up out of Egypt.
ekegusii: Ekero ararue agwo nimoiranerie emegondo yaye y’emesabibu, naende ninkore Ebate y’Akori ebe egesieri ki’ogosemeria. Aroro agwo natere buna ekero keria arenge omoke, ekero aruete ase ense ya Misiri.
swahili: Huko nitamrudishia mashamba yake ya mizabibu, nami nitalifanya Bonde la Akori mlango wa matumaini. Huko ataimba kama alivyofanya katika siku za ujana wake, kama siku zile alizotoka Misri.

english: In that day,” declares the LORD, “you will call Me ‘my Husband,’ and no longer call Me ‘my Master.’
ekegusii: Inche Omonene nigo ngoteeba iga: “Ase rituko erio nondoke omosacha oo, gose tokogenderera kondoka Baali yao.
swahili: “Katika siku ile,” asema Bwana, “utaniita mimi ‘Mume wangu’; hutaniita tena mimi ‘Bwana wangu.’

english: For I will remove from her lips the names of the Baals; no longer will their names be invoked.
ekegusii: Nindusie amarieta e chinyasae Baali korwa ase omonwa bw’omokuungu oyio, tichiatorwa nonya ng’ake ase amarieta abo.”
swahili: Nitaondoa majina ya Mabaali kutoka midomoni mwake, wala hataomba tena kwa majina yao.

english: On that day I will make a covenant for them with the beasts of the field and the birds of the air and the creatures that crawl on the ground. And I will abolish bow and sword and weapons of war in the land, and will make them lie down in safety.
ekegusii: “Ase rituko riria, ninkore okobwatana ne ching’iti chi’orosana, ne chinyoni, ne ching’iti chikwagura inse, ase engencho y’abanto baane. Ninsirie korwa ase ense eye amata, na emioro, na esegi, ntige batimoke bare n’obotoereru.
swahili: Katika siku ile nitafanya Agano kwa ajili yao na wanyama wa kondeni, na ndege wa angani, na viumbe vile vitambaavyo ardhini. Upinde, upanga na vita, nitaondolea mbali katika nchi, ili kwamba wote waweze kukaa salama.

english: So I will betroth you to Me forever; I will betroth you in righteousness and justice, in loving devotion and compassion.
ekegusii: “Ninkoriere boko nkonyuome obe oyone goika kare na kare; ee, ninkoriere boko ase oboronge n’ekeene, na ase obwanchani botari koera, na ase amaabera.
swahili: Nitakuposa uwe wangu milele; nitakuposa kwa uadilifu na haki, kwa upendo na huruma.

english: Rebuke your mother, rebuke her, for she is not My wife, and I am not her husband. Let her remove the adultery from her face and the unfaithfulness from between her breasts.
ekegusii: Mosorore nyoko, ee, momosorore, ekiagera ere tari omokungu one, na inche tindi omosacha oye. Tiga atige obonyaka borue ase obosio bwaye, na obotomani borue ase egekuba kiaye.
swahili: “Mkemeeni mama yenu, mkemeeni, kwa maana yeye si mke wangu, nami si mume wake. Aondoe sura ya uzinzi katika uso wake na uzinzi kati ya matiti yake.

english: And I will betroth you in faithfulness, and you will know the LORD.”
ekegusii: Ee, ninkoriere boko ase obwegenwa, naye omanye ng’a ninche Omonene.
swahili: Nitakuposa kwa uaminifu, nawe utamkubali Bwana.

english: “On that day I will respond—” declares the LORD— “I will respond to the heavens, and they will respond to the earth.
ekegusii: Inche Omonene nigo ngoteeba iga: Ase rituko erio nebe ng’a ninyigwe ogosaba kwa igoro, na igoro nchiigwe ogosaba gw’ense.
swahili: “Katika siku ile nitajibu,” asema Bwana, “nitajibu kwa anga, nazo anga zitajibu kwa nchi;

english: And the earth will respond to the grain, to the new wine and oil, and they will respond to Jezreel.
ekegusii: Erio ense eiranerie erue endagera, na edivai, na amaguta ’amazeituni, na ebinto ebio mbiisanekie okogania kwa Yesireeli.
swahili: nayo nchi itajibu kwa nafaka, divai mpya na mafuta, navyo vitajibu kwa Yezreeli.

english: And I will sow her as My own in the land, and I will have compassion on ‘No Compassion.’ I will say to those called ‘Not My People,’ ‘You are My people,’ and they will say, ‘You are my God.’”
ekegusii: Nimosimeke Yesireeli ase ense eye abe oyone. Nimororere amaabera oyio otaroreretwe amaabera, ninteebie abwo batarenge abanto baane: Bono inwe nabaanto baane, na barabwo mbateebe: Aye naye Nyasae oito.”
swahili: Nitampanda katika nchi kwa ajili yangu mwenyewe; nami nitaonyesha pendo langu kwake yule ambaye nilimwita, ‘Si mpenzi wangu. ’ Nitawaambia wale walioitwa, ‘Sio watu wangu,’ ‘Ninyi ni watu wangu’; nao watasema, ‘Wewe ndiwe Mungu wangu.’ ”

english: Otherwise, I will strip her naked and expose her like the day of her birth. I will make her like a desert and turn her into a parched land, and I will let her die of thirst.
ekegusii: Atakoreti bo, nimochabore chianga chiaye, imotige getirianda abe bosa buna ase rituko riria aiboretwe. Nimokore abe buna erooro, na buna ense enyomo, nimotige akwe ase engencho y’erang’o.
swahili: Kama sivyo nitamvua nguo zake awe uchi na kumwacha uchi kama siku ile aliyozaliwa. Nitamfanya kama jangwa, nitamgeuza awe nchi ya kiu, nami nitamuua kwa kiu.

english: I will have no compassion on her children, because they are the children of adultery.
ekegusii: Tinkororera abana baye amaabera, ekiagera nigo bare abana b’omokuungu omotayayi.
swahili: Sitaonyesha upendo wangu kwa watoto wake, kwa sababu ni watoto wa uzinzi.

english: For their mother has played the harlot and has conceived them in disgrace. For she thought, ‘I will go after my lovers, who give me bread and water, wool and linen, oil and drink.’
ekegusii: Ng’ina nigo arenge omotayayi, ee, oyo obaiborete nigo arenge gokora amang’ana y’obosoku. Nigo ateebete iga: niimbe ngotunyana abanchi baane, abwo bakong’a endagera nkoria, na amaache, na amarionya e ching’ondi, na egatani, na amaguta, na edivai.
swahili: Mama yao amekosa uaminifu na amewachukua mimba katika aibu. Gomeri alisema, ‘Nitawaendea wapenzi wangu, ambao hunipa chakula changu na maji yangu, sufu yangu na kitani yangu, mafuta yangu na kinywaji changu.’

english: Therefore, behold, I will hedge up her path with thorns; I will enclose her with a wall, so she cannot find her way.
ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio nintiiche enchera yaye namagwa, ning’agache orwaki roramotange ase agoetera.
swahili: Kwa hiyo mimi Mungu nitaizuia njia yake kwa vichaka vya miiba, nitamjengea ukuta ili kwamba asiweze kutoka.
