english: Therefore I said, “Turn away from me, let me weep bitterly! Do not try to console me over the destruction of the daughter of my people.”
ekegusii: Ase ayio inche ngateeba: “Tobaisa kondigereria, ntige ndere nobororo ing’iyerie amariga; tobaisa gwechanda kondemia ase engencho y’ogosarigwa kw’omochie bw’abaanto baane.”
swahili: Kwa hiyo nilisema, “Geukia mbali nami, niache nilie kwa uchungu. Usijaribu kunifariji juu ya maangamizi ya watu wangu.”

english: For the Lord GOD of Hosts has set a day of tumult and trampling and confusion in the Valley of Vision— of breaking down the walls and crying to the mountains.
ekegusii: Omonene, Nyasae bw’Emeganda, ochorire engaki ere nobotantanu, na ogotiringerwa inse, na omoichano, na engaki eyio nigo erache igoro ye Rikura ri’Amaroro. Ase engaki eyio chindwaki nchitagorwe chigwe inse, na ebirero mbiigweke gochia ase ebitunwa.
swahili: Bwana, Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, anayo siku ya ghasia, ya kukanyaga, na ya kuogofya katika Bonde la Maono, siku ya kuangusha kuta na ya kupiga kelele mpaka milimani.

english: Elam takes up a quiver, with chariots and horsemen, and Kir uncovers the shield.
ekegusii: Abaelamu nigo babogoretie chinsara, bagacha amo nabariini chigari na abe chibarasi; na abanto ba Kiri bagasokia chinguba chiabo.
swahili: Elamu analichukua podo, pamoja na waendesha magari ya vita na farasi. Kiri anaifungua ngao.

english: Your choicest valleys are full of chariots, and horsemen are posted at the gates.
ekegusii: Amakura aino are amaya mono aichoirwe ne chigari, na abariini chibarasi mbateneine ase ebiita.
swahili: Mabonde yako yaliyo mazuri sana yamejaa magari ya vita, nao wapanda farasi wamewekwa kwenye malango ya mji;

english: He has uncovered the defenses of Judah. On that day you looked to the weapons in the House of the Forest.
ekegusii: Egekengero ki’Abayuda nigo kiarusetigweo kegima. Ase engaki eyio mokarigia ebirwanero biarenge kogachwa ase Enyomba ye Rinani.
swahili: ulinzi wa Yuda umeondolewa. Nawe ulitazama siku ile silaha katika Jumba la Kifalme la Mwituni,

english: You saw that there were many breaches in the walls of the City of David. You collected water from the lower pool.
ekegusii: Erio mokanyora ng’a obotandoku bwe chindwaki chi’Omochie o Daudi bwabeire obonge; inwe mogatanga amaache tarua ase Ritibo ria Maate.
swahili: mkaona kuwa Mji wa Daudi una matundu mengi katika ulinzi wake, mkaweka akiba ya maji kwenye Bwawa la Chini.

english: This is the burden against Tyre: Wail, O ships of Tarshish, for Tyre is laid waste, without house or harbor. Word has reached them from the land of Cyprus.
ekegusii: Aya naro amang’ana igoro ya Turo. Inwe abe chimeeri chia Tarisisi, rera, ekiagera Turo osarigwe, chinyomba tichiyo, gose ekiambokero. Abanto b’ense ya Kuporo baabamanyirie amang’ana ayio.
swahili: Neno kuhusu Tiro: Ombolezeni, enyi meli za Tarshishi! Kwa kuwa Tiro imeangamizwa, imeachwa bila nyumba wala bandari. Kuanzia nchi ya Kitimu neno limewajia.

english: Cultivate your land like the Nile, O Daughter of Tarshish; there is no longer a harbor.
ekegusii: Inwe abanto ba Tarisisi, menteka, moichore ase ense yaino, mobe buna amaache ’orooche rwa Naeli; kende tikeri kerabatange.
swahili: Ee Binti Tarshishi, pita katika nchi yako kama vile Mto Naili kwa kuwa huna tena bandari.

english: The LORD has stretched out His hand over the sea; He has made kingdoms tremble. He has given a command that the strongholds of Canaan be destroyed.
ekegusii: Omonene oramboire okoboko kwaye igoro y’enyancha, onyegeirie amarwoti; orure ogochika igoro ya Kaanani ng’a chiburi chiaye chitagorwe.
swahili: Bwana amenyoosha mkono wake juu ya bahari na kuzifanya falme zake zitetemeke. Ametoa amri kuhusu Kanaani kwamba ngome zake ziangamizwe.

english: He said, “You shall rejoice no more, O oppressed Virgin Daughter of Sidon. Get up and cross over to Cyprus— even there you will find no rest.”
ekegusii: Ere agateeba, “Aye omochie o Sidoni orenge buna omoiseke omwekuungi, korende bono gwakoreirwe bobe, tokonyara koba nomogooko naende. Imoka ogende Kuporo, nonya naroro tokonyara gotimoka.”
swahili: Alisema, “Usizidi kufurahi, ee Bikira Binti Sidoni, sasa umepondwa! “Simama, vuka uende Kitimu; hata huko hutapata pumziko.”

english: Look at the land of the Chaldeans — a people now of no account. The Assyrians destined it for the desert creatures; they set up their siege towers and stripped its palaces. They brought it to ruin.
ekegusii: Rigereria ense y’Abakalidayo! Abanto aba tibaarenge egesaku. Abaasuri nabwo barentete ching’iti chi’orosana komenya aroro. Abwo bakaagacha chindwaki chi’okoboera, bakaonchorana chinyomba chi’obogaambi. Chi’omochie oyio, bakayotagora okaba etui.
swahili: Tazama katika nchi ya Wakaldayo, watu hawa ambao sasa hawaonekani kama wapo! Waashuru wameifanya nchi hiyo kuwa mahali pa viumbe wa jangwani. Wamesimamisha minara yao ya vita kuuzunguka, wameziteka ngome zake na kuziacha tupu na kuufanya kuwa magofu.

english: Wail, O ships of Tarshish, for your harbor has been destroyed!
ekegusii: Inwe abe chimeeri chia Tarisisi rera, ekiagera chiburi chiaino chiatagoirwe.
swahili: Ombolezeni, enyi meli za Tarshishi; ngome yenu imeangamizwa!

english: At that time Tyre will be forgotten for seventy years—the span of a king’s life. But at the end of seventy years, it will happen to Tyre as in the song of the harlot:
ekegusii: Ase amatuko ayio omochie o Turo mbwebwe ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo etano na ebere, emiaka ereng’aine ey’obogima bw’omorwoti oyomo. Emiaka eyio emerongo etano na ebere ekoera, neebe ase Turo buna ariikire ase ogoteera kw’omotayayi;
swahili: Wakati huo Tiro utasahauliwa kwa miaka sabini, muda wa maisha ya mfalme. Lakini mwisho wa miaka hiyo sabini, itakuwa kwa Tiro kama ilivyo katika wimbo wa kahaba:

english: “Take up your harp, stroll through the city, O forgotten harlot. Make sweet melody, sing many a song, so you will be remembered.”
ekegusii: “Aye omokungu omotayayi konya kwebirwe, imokia obokano, oetanane ase omochie bwonsi, otere neriogi rigiya, otere amatera amange, erio nario orainyorwe.”
swahili: “Twaa kinubi, tembea mjini kote, ewe kahaba uliyesahauliwa; piga kinubi vizuri, imba nyimbo nyingi, ili upate kukumbukwa.”

english: And at the end of seventy years, the LORD will restore Tyre. Then she will return to hire as a prostitute and sell herself to all the kingdoms on the face of the earth.
ekegusii: Emiaka eyio emerongo etano na ebere koyaerire, Omonene nachiche korora omochie o Turo; omochie oyio noiranere chingencho chiaye chinkoro, ochake gokora obonyaka amo namarwoti onsi are ase ense.
swahili: Mwishoni mwa miaka sabini, Bwana atashughulika na Tiro. Naye atarudia ajira yake ya ukahaba, na atafanya biashara yake na falme zote juu ya uso wa dunia.

english: Yet her profits and wages will be set apart to the LORD; they will not be stored or saved, for her profit will go to those who live before the LORD, for abundant food and fine clothing.
ekegusii: Ebikonyorekana korwa ase oboonchoreria bwaye, na ebitoki bi’ogokora kwaye kw’obonyaka mbiatananwe ase Omonene, tibigosangererigwa na kogachwa. Ebio banyorire ase oboonchoreria nigo biranyorere abanto abwo bamenyete ase obosio vw’Omonene endagera eisaine, ne chianga chingiya chikobekwa.
swahili: Lakini faida na mapato yake yatawekwa wakfu kwa Bwana; hayatahifadhiwa wala kufichwa. Faida zake zitakwenda kwa wale wakaao mbele za Bwana kwa ajili ya chakula tele na mavazi mazuri.

english: Be silent, O dwellers of the coastland, you merchants of Sidon, whose traders have crossed the sea.
ekegusii: Inwe abamomenyete ase egesinka, tegerera mokire‐kiri! Abaonchoreria ba Sidoni, abwo bagotaara ne chimeeri, kare nigo baichorete ase ense yaino.
swahili: Nyamazeni kimya, enyi watu wa kisiwani, pia ninyi wafanyabiashara wa Sidoni, ambao mabaharia wamewatajirisha.

english: On the great waters came the grain of Shihor; the harvest of the Nile was the revenue of Tyre; she was the merchant of the nations.
ekegusii: Nigo bataarete ase chinyancha chinene, na ebitoki biaino nigo biarenge chimbusuro chia Sihori, na okwama kwe riranya ri’Orooche rwa Naeli. Ninwe mwarenge abaonchoreria b’ebisaku bionsi.
swahili: Kwenye maji makuu nafaka za Shihori zilikuja; mavuno ya Naili yalikuwa mapato ya Tiro, naye akawa soko la mataifa.

english: Be ashamed, O Sidon, the stronghold of the sea, for the sea has spoken: “I have not been in labor or given birth. I have not raised young men or brought up young women.”
ekegusii: Aye Sidoni, rora obosooku; enyancha ere neburi enkong’u y’enyancha yatebiire iga: “Inche tinana kobina, gose koibora, tinana korera abana abamura, gose gokinia abaiseke abekungi.”
swahili: Uaibishwe ee Sidoni, nawe ee ngome la bahari, kwa kuwa bahari imesema: “Sijapata kuwa na uchungu wa kuzaa wala sijapata kuzaa, wala sijapata kulea wana wala kutunza mabinti.”

english: When the report reaches Egypt, they will writhe in agony over the news of Tyre.
ekegusii: Ekero Abamisiri baraigwe amang’ana ayio igoro ya Turo, nigo baraichane mono.
swahili: Habari ifikapo Misri, watakuwa katika maumivu makuu kwa ajili ya taarifa kutoka Tiro.

english: Cross over to Tarshish; wail, O inhabitants of the coastland!
ekegusii: Inwe abamomenyete ase egesinka, amboka, mogende Tarisisi, morere!
swahili: Vukeni mpaka Tarshishi, ombolezeni, enyi watu wa kisiwani.

english: Is this your jubilant city, whose origin is from antiquity, whose feet have taken her to settle far away?
ekegusii: Inee! Oyo nomochie oria oino oichire nomogooko, omochie oyio oagachetwe ase chingaki chia kare, oyio amagoro ’abaanto baye abogoretie gochia komenya ase chinse chi’aare?
swahili: Je, huu ndio mji wenu uliojaa sherehe, mji wa zamani, zamani kabisa ambao miguu yake imeuchukua kufanya makao nchi za mbali sana?

english: Who planned this against Tyre, the bestower of crowns, whose traders are princes, whose merchants are renowned on the earth?
ekegusii: Ning’o oroberetie amang’ana aya onsi mamincha ya Turo? Omochie oyio orenge kobekera abarwoti chigutwa, na abaonchoreria baye nigo baarenge abagaambi, na abaoonia baye nigo basikire ase ense.
swahili: Ni nani amepanga hili dhidi ya Tiro, mji utoao mataji, ambao wafanyabiashara wake ni wana wa mfalme na wachuuzi wake ni watu mashuhuri wa dunia?

english: The LORD of Hosts planned it, to defile all its glorious beauty, to disgrace all the renowned of the earth.
ekegusii: Omonene bw’Emeganda nere oroberetie ayio ase okoiyeria inse oboenenu bw’obonene na gochaaya abanene bonsi b’ense.
swahili: Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote ndiye alipanga jambo hili, ili kukishusha kiburi cha utukufu wote na kuwanyenyekesha wale wote ambao ni mashuhuri duniani.

english: Behold, the LORD lays waste the earth and leaves it in ruins. He will twist its surface and scatter its inhabitants—
ekegusii: Naama! Omonene nasarie ense, ayetige ere bosa; nayeonchorane ayeumamie, na abanto bamenyeteo abasiarere gochia aaria na aaria.
swahili: Tazama, Bwana ataifanya dunia kuwa ukiwa na kuiharibu, naye atauharibu uso wake na kutawanya wakaao ndani yake:

english: The city of chaos is shattered; every house is closed to entry.
ekegusii: Omochie oyio obwate eburu‐buru otagoirwe; kera enyomba ereo yasiekirwe, monto onde tari ogosoa aroro.
swahili: Mji ulioharibiwa umekuwa ukiwa, mlango wa kila nyumba umefungwa.

english: In the streets they cry out for wine. All joy turns to gloom; rejoicing is exiled from the land.
ekegusii: Okorera okonene kwaigwekanire ase chinchera, ekiagera edivai teiyo; omogooko bwonsi oerire, na omochengo bw’ense osirire.
swahili: Barabarani wanalilia kupata mvinyo, furaha yote imegeuka kuwa majonzi, furaha yote imefukuziwa mbali na dunia.

english: The city is left in ruins; its gate is reduced to rubble.
ekegusii: Omochie osarigwe kegima; ebiita biatagoirwe na konacha‐nachanwa.
swahili: Mji umeachwa katika uharibifu, lango lake limevunjwa vipande.

english: So will it be on the earth and among the nations, like a harvested olive tree, like a gleaning after a grape harvest.
ekegusii: Amang’ana ayio naro arabinyore ebisaku bire ase ense; ense neebe buna ekero emezeituni ekonyegerigwa ase okoarora amatunda, na buna ogochorwa kw’amazeituni amatigari.
swahili: Ndivyo itakavyokuwa duniani na miongoni mwa mataifa, kama vile wakati mzeituni upigwavyo, au kama vile wakati masazo yabakiavyo baada ya zabibu kuvunwa.

english: They raise their voices, they shout for joy; from the west they proclaim the majesty of the LORD.
ekegusii: Erio abanto mbaake amariogi batere nomogooko, mbaake amariogi korwa bosongo batogie obonene bw’Omonene.
swahili: Wanainua sauti zao, wanapiga kelele kwa furaha, kutoka magharibi wanasifu kwa ukelele utukufu wa Bwana.

english: Therefore glorify the LORD in the east. Extol the name of the LORD, the God of Israel in the islands of the sea.
ekegusii: Ase ayio inwe abamore moocha, motogie Omonene; abamore ase ebisinka na ase chinse chire ang’e nenyancha, togia erieta ri’Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli.
swahili: Kwa hiyo upande wa mashariki mpeni Bwana utukufu, liadhimisheni jina la Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli, katika visiwa vya bahari.

english: From the ends of the earth we hear singing: “Glory to the Righteous One.” But I said, “I am wasting away! I am wasting away! Woe is me.” The treacherous betray; the treacherous deal in treachery.
ekegusii: Korwa chinsinyo chi’ense twaigure amatera ay’ogotogia obonene bw’Oyore Omonyene Oboronge. Korende nigo ngoteeba, “Naki nachandekire! Naki nachandekire! Obobe nobwane! Abakorekanu nigo bagendererete gokorekania, ee, nigo bagendererete gokorekania mono.”
swahili: Kutoka miisho ya dunia tunasikia uimbaji: “Utukufu kwa Yule Mwenye Haki.” Lakini nilisema, “Ninadhoofika, ninadhoofika! Ole wangu! Watenda hila wanasaliti! Kwa hila watenda hila wanasaliti!”

english: Terror and pit and snare await you, O dweller of the earth.
ekegusii: Inwe abamomenyete ase ense, obwoba, na eirima, na omoeto, nigo bibaganyete.
swahili: Hofu, shimo na mtego vinakungojea, ewe mtu ukaaye duniani.

english: Whoever flees the sound of panic will fall into the pit, and whoever climbs from the pit will be caught in the snare. For the windows of heaven are open, and the foundations of the earth are shaken.
ekegusii: Nebe ng’a oyogotama kaigure eriogi ri’okogosa nagwe ase eirima, na oyo orasoke korwa ase eirima eyio nabwatwe nomoeto, ekiagera chitirisa chia igoro chiaigoirwe, oboroso bw’ense bwanyegerigwe.
swahili: Kila akimbiaye asikiapo sauti ya hofu atatumbukia shimoni, naye yeyote apandaye kutoka shimoni, atanaswa kwenye mtego. Malango ya gharika ya mbinguni yamefunguliwa, misingi ya dunia inatikisika.

english: The earth is utterly broken apart, the earth is split open, the earth is shaken violently.
ekegusii: Ense yabwerekire, ee, yabwerekire kegima, yatandoirwe ebing’ese; ense yatengechigwe ne chinguru chintindi.
swahili: Dunia imepasuka, dunia imechanika, dunia imetikiswa kabisa.

english: The earth staggers like a drunkard and sways like a shack. Earth’s rebellion weighs it down, and it falls, never to rise again.
ekegusii: Ense yatindire buna oyotindire amarwa; nigo ekorunda‐rundigwa buna oborunda‐rundia bw’omote. Ogosaria kwaye kwayeritoereire, negwe, tekonyara koboka naende.
swahili: Dunia inapepesuka kama mlevi, inayumbayumba kama kibanda kwenye upepo; imelemewa sana na mzigo wa hatia ya uasi wake na ikianguka kamwe haitainuka tena.

english: In that day the LORD will punish the host of heaven above and the kings of the earth below.
ekegusii: Ase engaki eyi’Omonene narue egesusuro ase emeganda ere igoro, aaria igoro, narue egesusuro ase abarwoti b’ense, aiga ase ense.
swahili: Katika siku ile Bwana ataadhibu nguvu zilizoko mbinguni juu, na wafalme walioko duniani chini.

english: They will be gathered together like prisoners in a pit. They will be confined to a dungeon and punished after many days.
ekegusii: Barabwo mbasangererigwe amo buna abasibwa, babekwe ase engoro eyemo; mbasiekerwe buna abasibwa, na ekero amatuko amange aerire mbaegwe egesusuro.
swahili: Watakusanywa pamoja kama wafungwa waliofungwa gerezani, watafungiwa gerezani na kuadhibiwa baada ya siku nyingi.

english: The moon will be confounded and the sun will be ashamed; for the LORD of Hosts will reign on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem, and before His elders with great glory.
ekegusii: Erio omotienyi tokorua oborabu bwaye, na erioba tirikobara, ekiagera Omonene bw’Emeganda nabe okogaamba ase egetunwa gia Sayoni, na ase Yerusalemu, na ase abagaaka b’aroro naorokie obonene bwaye.
swahili: Mwezi utatiwa haya, nalo jua litaaibishwa; kwa maana Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote atawala juu ya Mlima Sayuni na katika Yerusalemu, tena mbele ya wazee wake kwa utukufu.

english: The earth will be utterly laid waste and thoroughly plundered. For the LORD has spoken this word.
ekegusii: Ense nesarigwe kegima ebe bosa, ekiagera n’Omonene oteebire ring’ana erio.
swahili: Dunia itaharibiwa kabisa na kutekwa nyara kabisa. Bwana amesema neno hili.

english: The earth mourns and withers; the world languishes and fades; the exalted of the earth waste away.
ekegusii: Ense nigo ekweumia na kogenderera gosira; oboiko bwonsi bwagoyire, ngochia gosira bore, na abare abanene b’ense baereirwe chinguru.
swahili: Dunia inakauka na kunyauka, dunia inanyongʼonyea na kunyauka, waliotukuzwa wa dunia wananyongʼonyea.

english: The earth is defiled by its people; they have transgressed the laws; they have overstepped the decrees and broken the everlasting covenant.
ekegusii: Ense yasarigwe nabaanto bamenyeteo; barabwo basaririe amachiiko, bangire koigwera emeroberio echiikire, naende basaririe okobwatana kw’ogotianania gwa kare na kare.
swahili: Dunia imetiwa unajisi na watu wake; wameacha kutii sheria, wamevunja amri na kuvunja agano la milele.

english: Therefore a curse has consumed the earth, and its inhabitants must bear the guilt; the earth’s dwellers have been burned, and only a few survive.
ekegusii: Ase ayio okoragererigwa nkogendererete gosiria ense; abanto bamenyeteo nigo bachandegete ase engencho y’okomocha kwabo kw’ebibe, basambirwe, na abanto abake boka batigaireo.
swahili: Kwa hiyo laana inaiteketeza dunia, watu wake lazima waichukue hatia yao. Kwa hiyo wakazi wa dunia wameteketezwa, nao waliosalia ni wachache sana.

english: The new wine dries up, the vine withers. All the merrymakers now groan.
ekegusii: Edivai enyia nigo ekobokia amagombo, na emesabibu yasusanire, na abanto bonsi baarenge nomogooko bw’enkoro nigo baichanete.
swahili: Divai mpya inakauka na mzabibu unanyauka, watu wote wafurahishao wanalia kwa huzuni.

english: The joyful tambourines have ceased; the noise of revelers has stopped; the joyful harp is silent.
ekegusii: Omogoko bw’eriogi rie chinchigiri oerire, na eriogi ri’abwo bagochenga riaerire, na omogooko bw’eriogi ri’amakano oerire.
swahili: Furaha ya matoazi imekoma, kelele za wenye furaha zimekoma, shangwe za kinubi zimenyamaza.

english: They no longer sing and drink wine; strong drink is bitter to those who consume it.
ekegusii: Bono abanto tibagenderereti goteera ekero bakonywa edivai; ebinyugwa bigotindia biabeire ebiroro ase abwo bakobinywa.
swahili: Hawanywi tena mvinyo pamoja na wimbo, kileo ni kichungu kwa wanywaji wake.

english: O LORD, You are my God! I will exalt You; I will praise Your name. For You have worked wonders— plans formed long ago— in perfect faithfulness.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, naye Nyasae one; ninkoimokererie igoro, nintogie erieta riao; aye gwakorire amang’ana ’ogokumia emeroberio yao korwa kare nigo ere ey’obwegenwa na ekeene.
swahili: Ee Bwana, wewe ni Mungu wangu, nitakutukuza na kulisifu jina lako, kwa maana katika ukamilifu wa uaminifu umetenda mambo ya ajabu, mambo yaliyokusudiwa tangu zamani.

english: For the hand of the LORD will rest on this mountain. But Moab will be trampled in his place as straw is trodden into the dung pile.
ekegusii: Okoboko kw’Omonene nkobeere igoro y’egetunwa eke, korende Abamoabu mbatiringerwe inse aase abo buna obonyansi obwomo bogotiringeranigwa ase engoro y’esike.
swahili: Mkono wa Bwana utatulia juu ya mlima huu, bali Moabu atakanyagwa chini kama majani makavu yakanyagwavyo kwenye shimo la mbolea.

english: He will spread out his hands within it, as a swimmer spreads his arms to swim. His pride will be brought low, despite the skill of his hands.
ekegusii: Barabwo mbarambore amaboko abo buna omonto akorambora amaboko aye ase ogoaka entimbu, korende Omonene nasirie oboenenu bwabo amo nobong’ainereria bw’emeremo y’amaboko abo.
swahili: Watakunjua mikono yao katikati yake, kama vile mwogeleaji akunjuavyo mikono yake ili aogelee. Mungu atashusha kiburi chao licha ya ujanja wa mikono yao.

english: The high-walled fortress will be brought down, cast to the ground, into the dust.
ekegusii: Natagore emerobiri emetambe y’ogwekengera ere ase chindwaki chiabo, nayeiyerie inse kegima, ee, negwe inse ase riroba.
swahili: Atabomoa kuta ndefu za maboma yako na kuziangusha chini, atazishusha chini ardhini, mpaka mavumbini kabisa.

english: Indeed, You have made the city a heap of rubble, the fortified town a ruin. The fortress of strangers is a city no more; it will never be rebuilt.
ekegusii: Aye gwatagoire omochie, kwayokorire obeire etui y’amagena, omochie oyio konya ogiteire chindwaki obeire ritongo. Gwasaririe chinyomba chinene chi’omochie bw’abamenyi, omochie oyio tokoagachwa naende.
swahili: Umeufanya mji kuwa lundo la kifusi, mji wenye ngome kuwa magofu, ngome imara ya wageni kuwa si mji tena, wala hautajengwa tena kamwe.

english: Therefore, a strong people will honor You. The cities of ruthless nations will revere You.
ekegusii: Ase ayio, abanto bare ne chinguru mbagotogie, emechie y’ebisaku ebitindi nekoiroke.
swahili: Kwa hiyo mataifa yenye nguvu yatakuheshimu, miji ya mataifa katili itakuheshimu wewe.

english: For You have been a refuge for the poor, a stronghold for the needy in distress, a refuge from the storm, a shade from the heat. For the breath of the ruthless is like rain against a wall,
ekegusii: Aye kwabeire egekengero egekong’u ase abataka, ee, kwabeire egekengero ase abaremeire ekero bare nemechando; kwabeire obotamero ase engaki y’embura omoubera, na ekiriri ekero ki’omobaso omoororo. Okogosa kw’abaanto abatindi nigo konga embura omoubera egotwoma enyasi,
swahili: Umekuwa kimbilio la watu maskini, kimbilio la mhitaji katika taabu yake, hifadhi wakati wa dhoruba na kivuli wakati wa hari. Kwa maana pumzi ya wakatili ni kama dhoruba ipigayo ukuta

english: like heat in a dry land. You subdue the uproar of foreigners. As the shade of a cloud cools the heat, so the song of the ruthless is silenced.
ekegusii: na buna omobaso bw’eguru‐gura. Aye gwakiririe amariogi ’ababisa; buna omobaso omoororo ogokendigwa ne riire, naboigo namatera ’abaanto abwo abatindi arakendigwe. Omonene okwarigania omoyega
swahili: na kama joto la jangwani. Wewe wanyamazisha makelele ya wageni; kama vile hari ipunguzwavyo na kivuli cha wingu, ndivyo wimbo wa wakatili unyamazishwavyo.

english: On this mountain the LORD of Hosts will prepare a banquet for all the peoples, a feast of aged wine, of choice meat, of finely aged wine.
ekegusii: Aiga ase egetunwa eke Omonene bw’Emeganda naroiserie abanto b’ebisaku bionsi omoyega bw’ebinto ebinoru, omoyega bw’edivai engiya mono, ee, oyo bw’ebinto ebinoru biichire emeseto, na edivai engiya ekenonoire.
swahili: Juu ya mlima huu Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote ataandaa karamu ya vinono kwa mataifa yote, karamu ya mvinyo wa zamani, nyama nzuri sana na divai zilizo bora sana.

english: On this mountain He will swallow up the shroud that enfolds all peoples, the sheet that covers all nations;
ekegusii: Aiga ase egetunwa eke Omonene nasarie na korusia egietubo getubete abanto bonsi, ee, egietubo ekio keramboire igoro y’ebisaku bionsi.
swahili: Juu ya mlima huu ataharibu sitara ihifadhiyo mataifa yote, kile kifuniko kifunikacho mataifa yote,

english: He will swallow up death forever. The Lord GOD will wipe away the tears from every face and remove the disgrace of His people from the whole earth. For the LORD has spoken.
ekegusii: Omonene nasirie amakweri goika kare na kare, natinyie amariga korwa ase amaiso ’abaanto bonsi, nasirie ogochaywa kw’abaanto baye korwa ase ense yonsi. Nab’Omonene atebiire.
swahili: yeye atameza mauti milele. Bwana Mwenyezi atafuta machozi katika nyuso zote; ataondoa aibu ya watu wake duniani kote. Bwana amesema hili.

english: And in that day it will be said, “Surely this is our God; we have waited for Him, and He has saved us. This is the LORD for whom we have waited. Let us rejoice and be glad in His salvation.”
ekegusii: Ase rituko erio mbateebe iga: “Rora, oyo nere Nyasae oito; oyo nere twakaganyire, erinde anyare gototooria. Oyo nere Omonene, twakaganyire; tiga togoke na gochenga, ekiagera otorenteire ogotooreka.” Omonene nae Abamoabu egesusuro
swahili: Katika siku ile watasema, “Hakika huyu ndiye Mungu wetu; tulimtumaini, naye akatuokoa. Huyu ndiye Bwana, tuliyemtumaini; sisi tushangilie na kufurahia katika wokovu wake.”

english: In that day this song will be sung in the land of Judah: We have a strong city; salvation is established as its walls and ramparts.
ekegusii: Ase rituko erio ogoteera oko ngoterwe ase ense y’Abayuda; “Intwe nigo tomenyete ase omochie omokong’u. Omonene otoeire ogotooreka kobe chindwaki ne chiburi chiaito.
swahili: Katika siku ile, wimbo huu utaimbwa katika nchi ya Yuda: Tuna mji ulio na nguvu, Mungu huufanya wokovu kuwa kuta zake na maboma yake.

english: Though grace is shown to the wicked man, he does not learn righteousness. In the land of righteousness he acts unjustly and fails to see the majesty of the LORD.
ekegusii: Omokori amabe naisa gwanchererigwa, takweorokereria oboronge; ekero are ase ense egokora oboronge nigo arakore ay’obokorekanu, takorora obonene bw’Omonene.
swahili: Ingawa neema yaonyeshwa kwa waovu, hawajifunzi haki, hata katika nchi ya unyofu huendelea kutenda mabaya wala hawazingatii utukufu wa Bwana.

english: O LORD, Your hand is upraised, but they do not see it. They will see Your zeal for Your people and be put to shame. The fire set for Your enemies will consume them!
ekegusii: Aye Omonene kwaramboire okoboko kwao, korende barabwo tibagokorora. Tiga barore risemi obwate ase abanto bao, erinde basooke; omorero osambete ababisa bao, tiga obasambe nabarabwo.
swahili: Ee Bwana, mkono wako umeinuliwa juu, lakini hawauoni. Wao na waone wivu wako kwa ajili ya watu wako tena waaibishwe, moto uliowekwa akiba kwa ajili ya adui zako na uwateketeze.

english: O LORD, You will establish peace for us. For all that we have accomplished, You have done for us.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, notorentere omorembe, ekiagera emeremo twabeire togokora, naye kwabeire gokoyetokorera.
swahili: Bwana, unaamuru amani kwa ajili yetu, yale yote tuliyoweza kuyakamilisha ni wewe uliyetenda kwa ajili yetu.

english: O LORD our God, other lords besides You have had dominion, but Your name alone do we confess.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, Nyasae oito, abanene bande babeire bagotogaambera, korende erieta riao rioka nario tomanyete.
swahili: Ee Bwana, Mungu wetu, mabwana wengine zaidi ya wewe wametutawala, lakini jina lako pekee ndilo tunaloliheshimu.

english: The dead will not live; the departed spirits will not rise. Therefore You have punished and destroyed them; You have wiped out all memory of them.
ekegusii: Barabwo bakuure, tibakoba moyo naende, babeire amarengari, tibakoboka; ase ayio kwabaeire egesusuro na kobasiria, kwabasiririe, tibakoinyorwa nonya ng’ake.
swahili: Wao sasa wamekufa, wala hawako tena hai, roho za waliokufa hazitarudi tena. Uliwaadhibu na kuwaangamiza, umefuta kumbukumbu lao lote.

english: You have enlarged the nation, O LORD; You have enlarged the nation. You have gained glory for Yourself; You have extended all the borders of the land.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, gwakorire egesaku eke kementekane; ee, gwakementekanirie; ase ayio aye gwatogigwe, kwagareeirie ense y’egesaku eke.
swahili: Umeliongeza hilo taifa, Ee Bwana, umeliongeza hilo taifa. Umejipatia utukufu kwa ajili yako mwenyewe, umepanua mipaka yote ya nchi.

english: O LORD, they sought You in their distress; when You disciplined them, they poured out a quiet prayer.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ekero baarenge nemechando nigo bakorigetie, ekero kwabaete egesusuro, nigo bagosabeete mono.
swahili: Bwana, walikujia katika taabu yao, wewe ulipowarudi, waliweza kuomba kwa kunongʼona tu.

english: As a woman with child about to give birth writhes and cries out in pain, so were we in Your presence, O LORD.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, nigo twabeete asore buna omokungu ore morito, okobina aibore, ekero engaki yaye yaikire, nigo akoromwa nobororo.
swahili: Kama mwanamke mwenye mimba aliyekaribia kuzaa anavyogaagaa na kulia kwa ajili ya maumivu yake, ndivyo tulivyokuwa mbele zako, Ee Bwana.

english: We were with child; we writhed in pain; but we gave birth to wind. We have given no salvation to the earth, nor brought any life into the world.
ekegusii: Intwe twabeire tore barito, twabeire tokobina na kweganchorana, korende ekero twaiborete tokaibora embeo bosa. Titorenteti ogotooreka konde ase ense, gose abanto tibaiboretwe ase ense.
swahili: Tulikuwa na mimba, tuligaagaa kwa maumivu, lakini tulizaa upepo. Hatukuleta wokovu duniani, hatujazaa watu katika ulimwengu huu.

english: Your dead will live; their bodies will rise. Awake and sing, you who dwell in the dust! For your dew is like the dew of the morning, and the earth will bring forth her dead.
ekegusii: Abanto baino bakwete mbabe moyo naende; emebere y’abakwete neboke. Inwe abwo moraire ase amaroba ime, boka, motere nomogooko! Riime riao nigo rire eri’oborabu; riroba ndibairanie abakwete. Ekiina na ogokorwa oboyia
swahili: Lakini wafu wenu wataishi, nayo miili yao itafufuka. Ninyi mnaokaa katika mavumbi, amkeni mkapige kelele kwa furaha. Umande wenu ni kama umande wa asubuhi, dunia itawazaa wafu wake.

english: Open the gates so a righteous nation may enter— one that remains faithful.
ekegusii: Igora ebiita bi’omochie oyio, erinde egesaku kere noboronge na obwegenwa kenyare gosoa imeo.
swahili: Fungua malango ili taifa lenye haki lipate kuingia, taifa lile lidumishalo imani.

english: Go, my people, enter your rooms and shut your doors behind you. Hide yourselves a little while until the wrath has passed.
ekegusii: Inwe abanto baane, inchwo mosoe ase chiero chiaino mwesiekere aroro; mwebise aroro ase engaki enke, goika endamwamu eyio ebe yaetire.
swahili: Nendeni, watu wangu, ingieni vyumbani mwenu na mfunge milango nyuma yenu, jificheni kwa kitambo kidogo mpaka ghadhabu yake ipite.

english: For behold, the LORD is coming out of His dwelling to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity. The earth will reveal her bloodshed and will no longer conceal her slain.
ekegusii: Rora, Omonene ngosoka are korwa aase aye, ae abanto bamenyete ase ense egesusuro ase engencho y’ebibe biabo. Okomocha kw’ogoiterwa kw’amanyinga ase ense nkobe maiso marore, na ense tekogenderera kobisa abanto abwo baitetwe.
swahili: Tazama, Bwana anakuja kutoka makao yake ili kuwaadhibu watu wa dunia kwa ajili ya dhambi zao. Dunia itadhihirisha umwagaji damu juu yake, wala haitaendelea kuwaficha watu wake waliouawa.

english: You will keep in perfect peace the steadfast of mind, because he trusts in You.
ekegusii: Omonto ore nebirengererio ebironge asore, aye Omonene nigo okomoa omorembe omoikeranu, ekiagera agosemeretie.
swahili: Utamlinda katika amani kamilifu yeye ambaye moyo wake ni thabiti kwa sababu anakutumaini wewe.

english: Trust in the LORD forever, because GOD the LORD is the Rock eternal.
ekegusii: Mosemerie Omonene botambe, ekiagera Omonene nere egetare gia kare na kare.
swahili: Mtumaini Bwana milele, kwa kuwa Bwana, Bwana, ni Mwamba wa milele.

english: For He has humbled those who dwell on high; He lays the lofty city low. He brings it down to the ground; He casts it into the dust.
ekegusii: Ere okeeirie abanto abwo beimokereretie igoro, otagoire omochie oria ochongororogete gochia igoro, oyoiyeirie inse kegima, ee, oyoiyeirie inse ase riroba.
swahili: Huwashusha wale wajikwezao, huushusha chini mji wenye kiburi, huushusha hadi ardhini na kuutupa chini mavumbini.

english: Feet trample it down— the feet of the oppressed, the steps of the poor.
ekegusii: Amagoro ’abaanto abataka nayotiringere inse, na ay’abaremerwa nayotache.”
swahili: Miguu huukanyaga chini, miguu ya hao walioonewa, hatua za hao maskini.

english: The path of the righteous is level; You clear a straight path for the upright.
ekegusii: Enchera y’abanyene oboronge nenteremu; naye okoyekora yaba enteremu.
swahili: Mapito ya wenye haki yamenyooka. Ewe uliye Mwenye Haki, waisawazisha njia ya mtu mnyofu.

english: Yes, we wait for You, O LORD; we walk in the path of Your judgments. Your name and renown are the desire of our souls.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, intwe nigo tokoganyete kogocha konacha ebiina biao; okona‐koinyora erieta riao nakwo kore okogania kw’emioyo yaito.
swahili: Naam, Bwana, tukienenda katika sheria zako, twakungojea wewe, jina lako na sifa zako ndizo shauku za mioyo yetu.

english: My soul longs for You in the night; indeed, my spirit seeks You at dawn. For when Your judgments come upon the earth, the people of the world learn righteousness.
ekegusii: Omoyo one nigo ogokogania ase obotuko, omoika ore ime yane nigo ogokorigia kobogokiamoka. Ekero orarente ebiina biao igoro ase ense, abanto bamenyeteo nigo bakweorokereria oboronge.
swahili: Nafsi yangu yakutamani wakati wa usiku, wakati wa asubuhi roho yangu yakuonea shauku. Wakati hukumu zako zinapokuja juu ya dunia, watu wa ulimwengu hujifunza haki.

english: In that day the LORD will take His sharp, great, and mighty sword, and bring judgment on Leviathan the fleeing serpent —Leviathan the coiling serpent—and He will slay the dragon of the sea.
ekegusii: Ase engaki eyi’Omonene nae Leviatani, eng’iti eria y’okwoboyia, enyango ekwemiina, egesusuro. Nayeite n’omoro oye ore omokong’u na omonene, na ore ne chinguru; boigo naite enchoka eria ere ime ase enyancha.
swahili: Katika siku ile, Bwana ataadhibu kwa upanga wake, upanga wake mkali, mkubwa na wenye nguvu, ataadhibu Lewiathani yule nyoka apitaye kwa mwendo laini, Lewiathani yule nyoka mwenye kujipinda; atamuua joka huyo mkubwa sana wa baharini.

english: For the fortified city lies deserted— a homestead abandoned, a wilderness forsaken. There the calves graze, and there they lie down; they strip its branches bare.
ekegusii: Omochie ogiteire chindwaki ong’anyirwe, otamirwe na gotigwa bosa, obeire buna erooro; agwo nao chimori chikorisia na korara, chiaba chikoria amato e chinsagia chireo.
swahili: Mji ulio na boma umebaki ukiwa, makao yaliyotelekezwa, yaliyoachwa kama jangwa. Huko ndama hulisha, huko hujilaza, wanakwanyua matawi yake.

english: When its limbs are dry, they are broken off. Women come and use them for kindling; for this is a people without understanding. Therefore their Maker has no compassion on them, and their Creator shows them no favor.
ekegusii: Ekero chinsagia chiomire, nigo chikobuneka, abakungu bacha bachiira bachiutera omorero. Abanto b’egesaku eke tibari nobong’aini, ase ayio oria obatongete takobarorera amabeebe, gose kobarorera amaabera.
swahili: Wakati vijiti vyake vimekauka, huvunjwa nao wanawake huja na kuwasha navyo moto. Kwa kuwa hili ni taifa lisilo na ufahamu, kwa hiyo yeye aliyewafanya hana huruma juu yao, Muumba wao hawaonyeshi fadhili.

english: In that day the LORD will thresh from the flowing Euphrates to the Wadi of Egypt, and you, O Israelites, will be gathered one by one.
ekegusii: Ase engaki eyi’Omonene nabaswage inwe Abaisraeli buna chinyeke chi’endagera na kobachora oyomo oyomo. Nigo arachakere ase orooche rwa Eufarati na goikera ase akarooche ka Misiri.
swahili: Katika siku ile Bwana atapura kutoka matiririko ya Mto Frati hadi Kijito cha Misri, nanyi ee Waisraeli, mtakusanywa mmoja mmoja.

english: And in that day a great ram’s horn will sound, and those who were perishing in Assyria will come forth with those who were exiles in Egypt. And they will worship the LORD on the holy mountain in Jerusalem.
ekegusii: Ekero engaki eyio eraike, engoma nebugigwe, na abanto abwo basirerete ase ense y’Abaasuri, na baria baseretigwe gochia ase ense ya Misiri, mbache gosasiima Omonene ase egetunwa egechenu agwo Yerusalemu.
swahili: Katika siku ile tarumbeta kubwa italia. Wale waliokuwa wakiangamia katika nchi ya Ashuru, nao wale waliokuwa uhamishoni katika nchi ya Misri watakuja na kumwabudu Bwana katika mlima mtakatifu huko Yerusalemu.

english: In that day: “Sing about a fruitful vineyard.
ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio omogondo bw’emesabibu ore nedivai enyinge nobeo. Notererwe ogoteera oko:
swahili: Katika siku ile: “Imbeni kuhusu shamba la mizabibu lililozaa:

english: I, the LORD, am its keeper; I water it continually. I guard it night and day so no one can disturb it;
ekegusii: “Inche Omonene, ninche inde omorendi bw’omogondo bw’emesabibu, nigo nkoyoitororera amaache kera engaki; nigo inyorendete obotuko na omobaso, erinde onde tabaisa koyosaria.
swahili: Mimi, Bwana, ninalitunza, nalinyweshea maji mfululizo. Ninalichunga usiku na mchana ili mtu yeyote asije akalidhuru.

english: I am not angry. If only thorns and briers confronted Me, I would march and trample them, I would burn them to the ground.
ekegusii: Inche tindi nendamwamu. Nonya amagwa na amageri are gocha kondwania nigo nare koyarwania na koyasambera amo.
swahili: Mimi sijakasirika. Licha pangekuwepo michongoma na miiba kunikabili! Ningepambana dhidi yake katika vita, ningeliichoma moto yote.

english: Or let them lay claim to My protection; let them make peace with Me— yes, let them make peace with Me.”
ekegusii: Tiga abanto babwaterere oborendi bwane mbarende ne chinguru chiane; tiga bakore omorembe nainche, ee, barabwo mbabe nomorembe nainche.”
swahili: Au niwaache waje kwangu kwa ajili ya kupata kimbilio, wao na wafanye amani nami, naam, wafanye amani nami.”

english: In the days to come, Jacob will take root. Israel will bud and blossom and fill the whole world with fruit.
ekegusii: Ase amatuko agochi‐gocha Omonene nae abanto b’ororeeria rwa Yakobo ribaga baseboke, ee, Abaisraeli mbasokie ebisicha na ebisebo, mbaame amatunda aichore ase ense yonsi.
swahili: Katika siku zijazo, Yakobo atatia mizizi, Israeli atatoa chipukizi na kuchanua maua, naye atajaza ulimwengu wote kwa matunda.

english: Has the LORD struck Israel as He struck her oppressors? Was she killed like those who slayed her?
ekegusii: Inee! Omonene naagete Abaisraeli buna aagete ababisa babo? Gose Abaisraeli mbaitetwe buna ababisa babo baitetwe?
swahili: Je, Bwana amempiga vile alivyowapiga wale waliompiga? Je, yeye ameuawa vile walivyouawa wale waliomuua yeye?

english: By warfare and exile You contended with her and removed her with a fierce wind, as on the day the east wind blows.
ekegusii: Aye nigo kwaamereranetie nabarabwo okabaa egesusuro ase ekerengo, okarenta omwaga omotindi korwa moocha, okabaseria.
swahili: Kwa vita na kwa kumfukuza unapingana naye: kwa mshindo wake mkali anamfukuza, kama siku ile uvumapo upepo wa mashariki.

english: Therefore Jacob’s guilt will be atoned for, and the full fruit of the removal of his sin will be this: When he makes all the altar stones like crushed bits of chalk, no Asherah poles or incense altars will remain standing.
ekegusii: Ase ayio, abanto b’ororeeria rwa Yakobo mbachenwe korwa ase ogosaria kwabo, na okorusigwa okwo kw’ebibe nkorente okwama ogoikeranu, ekero amagena onsi ay’ebisasimero arasenyentwe buna amagena ’echooka, na emete y’Asera, enyasae eria enkuungu, na ebisasimero bi’ogosambera ubani, biratagorwe bionsi.
swahili: Kwa hili, basi, hatia ya Yakobo itafanyiwa upatanisho, nalo hili litakuwa matunda ya utimilizo wa kuondolewa kwa dhambi yake: Wakati atakapoyafanya mawe yote ya madhabahu kuwa kama mawe ya chokaa yaliyopondwa vipande vipande, hakuna nguzo za Ashera au madhabahu za kufukizia uvumba zitakazobaki zimesimama.

english: Woe to the majestic crown of Ephraim’s drunkards, to the fading flower of his glorious splendor, set on the summit above the fertile valley, the pride of those overcome by wine.
ekegusii: Obobe nobwao aye ore egutwa y’oboenenu bw’abaanto ba Efraimu batindire. Nigo ore buna egesicha giasusanire, obwari bw’obonene bwao bwasirire. Nigo ore ase egetunwa igoro, igoro ye rikura ritobu ri’abwo babuirwe nedivai.
swahili: Ole kwa lile taji la maua, kiburi cha walevi wa Efraimu, kwa ua linalosinyaa, uzuri wa utukufu wake, uliowekwa kwenye kichwa cha bonde lenye rutuba: kwa ule mji, kiburi cha wale walioshushwa na mvinyo!

english: For they hear: “Order on order, order on order, line on line, line on line; a little here, a little there.”
ekegusii: Nigo agotoa ogochika igoro ase ogochika, ee, ogochika igoro ase ogochika; ring’ana igoro ase ring’ana, ee, ring’ana igoro ase ring’ana; aiga make, na aaria make.”
swahili: Kwa maana ni: Amri juu ya amri, amri juu ya amri, kanuni juu ya kanuni, kanuni juu ya kanuni; hapa kidogo, kule kidogo.”

english: Indeed, with mocking lips and foreign tongues, He will speak to this people
ekegusii: Ekeene, Omonene nakwane nabaanto aba goetera ase abanto b’ebisaku ebiao, abwo bagokwana omonwa omogeni.
swahili: Sawa kabisa, kwa midomo migeni na kwa lugha ngeni, Mungu atasema na watu hawa,

english: to whom He has said: “This is the place of rest, let the weary rest; this is the place of repose.” But they would not listen.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo atebeetie abanto abwo: “Aiga nase agotimokerwa, tiga abwo barosire batimokere aiga, erinde banyore chinguru naende.” Korende abanto abwo tibaigwerete.
swahili: wale ambao aliwaambia, “Hapa ni mahali pa kupumzika, waliochoka na wapumzike,” na, “Hapa ni mahali pa mapumziko,” lakini hawakutaka kusikiliza.

english: Then the word of the LORD to them will become: “Order on order, order on order, line on line, line on line; a little here, a little there,” so that they will go stumbling backward and will be injured, ensnared, and captured. A Cornerstone in Zion (1 Corinthians 3:10–15; Ephesians 2:19–22; 1 Peter 2:1–8)
ekegusii: Ase ayio ring’ana ri’Omonene ase bare nigo rirabe iga: “Ogochika igoro ase ogochika, ee, ogochika igoro ase ogochika; ring’ana igoro ase ring’ana, ee, ring’ana igoro ase ring’ana; aiga make, na aaria make,” erinde kobagotaara babe bakogwa kemagega‐magega, babutokane, babe bagotegwa na kobwatwa. Rigena ri’ekoona ria Sayoni
swahili: Hivyo basi, neno la Bwana kwao litakuwa: Amri juu ya amri, amri juu ya amri, kanuni juu ya kanuni, kanuni juu ya kanuni, hapa kidogo, kule kidogo: ili waende na kuanguka chali, wakijeruhiwa, wakinaswa na kukamatwa.

english: Therefore hear the word of the LORD, O scoffers who rule this people in Jerusalem.
ekegusii: Ase ayio, inwe abachecheria aba mokogaambera abanto ba Yerusalemu, igwa ring’ana ri’Omonene.
swahili: Kwa hiyo sikieni neno la Bwana, enyi watu wenye dharau mnaotawala watu hawa wa Yerusalemu.

english: For you said, “We have made a covenant with death; we have fashioned an agreement with Sheol. When the overwhelming scourge passes through it will not touch us, because we have made lies our refuge and falsehood our hiding place.”
ekegusii: Inwe nigo mogoteeba, “Intwe twakorire okobwatana kw’ogotianania namakweri, na twabwatanire nase abakuure; ekero emechando eyio emebe erache tegotoika ang’e, ekiagera twakorire oborimo bwabeire obotamero bwaito, na obong’ainereria bwabeire egekengero giaito.”
swahili: Ninyi mnajisifu, “Tumefanya agano na mauti, tumefanya mapatano na kuzimu. Wakati pigo lifurikalo litakapopita, haliwezi kutugusa sisi, kwa kuwa tumefanya uongo kuwa kimbilio letu na miungu ya uongo kuwa mahali petu pa kujificha.”

english: So this is what the Lord GOD says: “See, I lay a stone in Zion, a tested stone, a precious cornerstone, a sure foundation; the one who believes will never be shaken.
ekegusii: Ase ayio Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: “Rora inche nkobeeka nde rigena ri’oboroso ase Sayoni, rigena rikong’u riateemirwe, rigena ri’ekoona ri’engencho enene rire oboroso obokong’u; na onde bwensi orariegene, takorua aroro.
swahili: Kwa hiyo hivi ndivyo Bwana Mwenyezi asemavyo: “Tazama, ninaweka jiwe katika Sayuni, jiwe lililojaribiwa, jiwe la pembeni la thamani kwa ajili ya msingi thabiti. Yeye atumainiye kamwe hatatiwa hofu.

english: I will make justice the measuring line and righteousness the level. Hail will sweep away your refuge of lies, and water will flood your hiding place.
ekegusii: Ninkore ekeene kebe ekerengo gi’okorenga, na oboronge bobe ekebiro gekorenga. “Nindete embura y’amagena yabuse kegima oborimo bore obotamero bwaino, na emegoko ebonganie obwebiso bwaino.”
swahili: Nitaifanya haki kuwa kamba ya kupimia na uadilifu kuwa timazi; mvua ya mawe itafagia kimbilio lenu, huo uongo, nayo maji yatafurikia mahali penu pa kujificha.

english: Your covenant with death will be dissolved, and your agreement with Sheol will not stand. When the overwhelming scourge passes through, you will be trampled by it.
ekegusii: Erio okobwatana kw’ogotianania koria mwakorete namakweri ngosarigwe, na okobwatana kwaino mwakorete nase abakuure tigokogenderera kobao; ekero emechando eyio emebe erache, goika motiringerwe inse
swahili: Agano lenu na kifo litabatilishwa, patano lenu na kuzimu halitasimama. Wakati pigo lifurikalo litakapowakumba, litawaangusha chini.

english: As often as it passes through, it will carry you away; it will sweep through morning after morning, by day and by night.” The understanding of this message will bring sheer terror.
ekegusii: Buna koreng’ana emechando eyio eraabe ekona‐gocha nebanyore inwe, neebe ekona‐gocha emambia ase emambia, ee, omobaso na obotuko. Nigo eraabe emechando emebe y’okoondokia ase okoigwa amang’ana ayio atomirwe.
swahili: Kila mara lijapo litawachukua, asubuhi baada ya asubuhi, wakati wa mchana na wakati wa usiku, litawakumba tangu mwanzo hadi mwisho.” Kuuelewa ujumbe huu utaleta hofu tupu.

english: Behold, the Lord has one who is strong and mighty. Like a hailstorm or destructive tempest, like a driving rain or flooding downpour, he will smash that crown to the ground.
ekegusii: Rora, Omonene nabwate oyomo ore nokobua ne chinguru; oyio nigo anga buna embura y’amagena, na buna omwaga omotindi ogosaria, na buna omoubera ore nembura enyinge oraiyerie ebinto bionsi inse ne chinguru.
swahili: Tazama, Bwana anaye mmoja aliye na uwezo na nguvu. Kama dhoruba ya mvua ya mawe na upepo uharibuo, kama mvua inyeshayo kwa nguvu na mafuriko yashukayo, atakiangusha chini kwa nguvu.

english: Indeed, the bed is too short to stretch out on, and the blanket too small to wrap around you.
ekegusii: Oborere nigo bore obweng’e omonto agosinywa kwerambora igoro ase borobwo, na ekiebisio nigo kere ekenyerere mono omonto atanyare kwebisia.
swahili: Kitanda ni kifupi mno kujinyoosha juu yake, nguo ya kujifunikia ni nyembamba mno mtu hawezi kujifunikia.

english: For the LORD will rise up as at Mount Perazim. He will rouse Himself as in the Valley of Gibeon, to do His work, His strange work, and to perform His task, His disturbing task.
ekegusii: Omonene naimoke akore buna akorete ase egetunwa gia Perasimu; nabe nendamwamu buna abeete ase Rikura ria Gibeoni; nakore ogokora kwaye kore okogeni, nakore emeremo yaye ere ey’ogokumia.
swahili: Bwana atainuka kama alivyofanya kwenye Mlima Perasimu, ataghadhibika kama alivyofanya katika Bonde la Gibeoni: ili kufanya kazi yake, kazi yake ya ajabu, ili kutimiza kazi yake, kazi yake ngeni.

english: So now, do not mock, or your shackles will become heavier. Indeed, I have heard from the Lord GOD of Hosts a decree of destruction against the whole land. Listen and Hear
ekegusii: Ase ayio, bono timogenderera gochecheria, ebisibo biaino tibibaisa gokong’igwa, ekiagera naigure korwa ase Omonene, Nyasae bw’Emeganda, ogochika kw’ogosirigwa gw’ense engima, okwo gotanyare gotigwa. Obong’aini bwa Nyasae
swahili: Sasa acheni dharau zenu, la sivyo minyororo yenu itakuwa mizito zaidi. Bwana, Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, ameniambia habari za maangamizi yaliyoamriwa dhidi ya nchi yote.

english: Listen and hear my voice. Pay attention and hear what I say.
ekegusii: Tegerera moigwe eriogi riane; igwera amang’ana aane ngokwana!
swahili: Sikilizeni msikie sauti yangu, tegeni masikio na msikie niyasemayo.

english: Does the plowman plow for planting every day? Does he continuously loosen and harrow the soil?
ekegusii: Inee! Omonto okorema ng’a asimeke chimbusuro nigo akogenderera kona‐korema rioka? Inee! Omonto oyio nigo akogenderera kona‐koboosa rioka?
swahili: Wakati mkulima alimapo ili apande, je, hulima siku zote? Je, huendelea kubomoa ardhi na kusawazisha udongo?

english: When he has leveled its surface, does he not sow caraway and scatter cumin? He plants wheat in rows and barley in plots, and rye within its border.
ekegusii: Omonto oyio ekero akoorire koroisia riroba, Inee, tari kobusura obotu bw’ebinsari bikorokwa dili na komini; naende obusura engano ase chindwaro, na esairi aase aye, na engano ende ase chingito?
swahili: Akiisha kusawazisha shamba, je, hatapanyi mbegu za bizari na kutawanya jira? Je, hapandi ngano katika sehemu yake, shayiri katika eneo lake, na nafaka nyingine katika shamba lake?

english: For his God instructs and teaches him properly.
ekegusii: Nyasae oye nigo akomworokereria enchera engiya y’ogokora emeremo eyio.
swahili: Mungu wake humwelekeza na kumfundisha njia iliyo sahihi.

english: Surely caraway is not threshed with a sledge, and the wheel of a cart is not rolled over the cumin. But caraway is beaten out with a stick, and cumin with a rod.
ekegusii: Dili teri koorerwa nekeoorero gi’ekioma, gose komini teri koorwa namagoro e chigari, korende bionsi bibere nigo bigosusurerwa omote.
swahili: Iliki haipurwi kwa nyundo, wala gurudumu la gari halivingirishwi juu ya jira; iliki hupurwa kwa fimbo, na jira kwa ufito.

english: Grain for bread must be ground, but it is not endlessly threshed. Though the wheels of the cart roll over it, the horses do not crush it.
ekegusii: Ekero omonto akoora engano, Inee, nkoyesunyunta are? Yaya, tari kogenderera koyeoora naende, nigo arabaise koyesenyenta namagoro ’egari ekong’uswa ne chibarasi chiaye.
swahili: Nafaka lazima isagwe ili kutengeneza mkate, kwa hiyo mtu haendelei kuipura daima. Ingawa huendesha magurudumu ya gari lake la kupuria juu yake, farasi wake hawasagi.

english: This also comes from the LORD of Hosts, who is wonderful in counsel and excellent in wisdom.
ekegusii: Amorokererio ayio nigo akorwa ase Omonene bw’Emeganda; ere nigo are omosemia bw’ogokumia, na obong’aini bwaye nobonene mono.
swahili: Haya yote pia hutoka kwa Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, mwenye mashauri ya ajabu, na anayepita wote kwa hekima.

english: The majestic crown of Ephraim’s drunkards will be trampled underfoot.
ekegusii: Egutwa y’oboenenu y’abanto b’Efraimu batindire netiringwe namagoro;
swahili: Lile taji la maua, kiburi cha walevi cha Efraimu, kitakanyagwa chini ya nyayo.

english: The fading flower of his beautiful splendor, set on the summit above the fertile valley, will be like a ripe fig before the summer harvest: Whoever sees it will take it in his hand and swallow it.
ekegusii: na egesicha giasusanire kere obwari bw’obonene bwaye, ekio kere ase egetunwa igoro agwo ase rikura ritobu nkebe buna ogotongorwa kw’amako agotang’anera rigesa, ayio omonto akorora oyatwa, na ekero ayabeekire koboko oyaria.
swahili: Lile ua linalosinyaa, uzuri wa utukufu wake, uliowekwa kwenye kichwa cha bonde lenye rutuba, litakuwa kama tini iliyoiva kabla ya mavuno: mara mtu aionapo, huichuma na kuila.

english: On that day the LORD of Hosts will be a crown of glory, a diadem of splendor to the remnant of His people,
ekegusii: Ase engaki eyi’Omonene bw’Emeganda nabe egutwa y’obonene, na ekiore ki’obwari ase abanto baye abatigari,
swahili: Katika siku ile, Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote atakuwa taji la utukufu, taji zuri la maua kwa mabaki ya watu wake.

english: a spirit of justice to him who sits in judgment, and a strength to those who repel the onslaught at the gate.
ekegusii: naende nabe omoika bw’ogokora ayare ay’ekeene ase abwo bakogaamba ekiina, naende nabe chinguru chiabo abwo bagoseria ababisa agwo ase egeita. Isaya okobana igoro y’Abayuda
swahili: Atakuwa roho ya haki kwa yeye aketiye katika kiti cha hukumu, chanzo cha nguvu kwa wale wazuiao vita langoni.

english: These also stagger from wine and stumble from strong drink: Priests and prophets reel from strong drink and are befuddled by wine. They stumble because of strong drink, muddled in their visions and stumbling in their judgments.
ekegusii: Abanto aba nabarabwo batindire edivai; nigo bakoong’anya ase okonywa ebinyugwa bigotindia; abakuani na ababani batindire nebinyugwa bigotindia, na ekero bakorora amaroro nigo bakomocha, nigo bagotantana ekero bakonacha ebiina.
swahili: Hawa pia wanapepesuka kwa sababu ya mvinyo, wanayumbayumba kwa sababu ya kileo: Makuhani na manabii wanapepesuka kwa sababu ya kileo, wanachanganyikiwa kwa sababu ya mvinyo; wanapepesuka wanapoona maono, wanajikwaa wanapotoa maamuzi.

english: For all their tables are covered with vomit; there is not a place without filth.
ekegusii: Chimesa chiabo chionsi chiaichoire namaroki, na aase ande tari atari nobonyinyeri.
swahili: Meza zote zimejawa na matapishi wala hakuna sehemu hata ndogo isiyokuwa na uchafu.

english: Whom is He trying to teach? To whom is He explaining His message? To infants just weaned from milk? To babies removed from the breast?
ekegusii: Nigo bagoteeba: “Ning’o Isaya aganetie kworokereria obong’aini, na ning’o ere aranyare komanyia amang’ana aye amaya? Inee! Nabana abake abwo batachirwe, abwo batigigwe kogonka?
swahili: “Yeye anajaribu kumfundisha nani? Yeye anamwelezea nani ujumbe wake? Je, ni kwa watoto walioachishwa kunyonya? Je, ni wale ambao ndipo tu wametolewa matitini?

english: Woe to you, O Ariel, the city of Ariel where David camped! Year upon year let your festivals recur.
ekegusii: Obobe nobwao aye Arieli, Arieli, omochie ase Daudi arenge gotoora. Omwaka ase omwaka imogenderere korenda Amatuko aino Amanene, na emeyega yaino.
swahili: Ole wako, wewe Arieli, Arieli, mji alimokaa Daudi! Ongezeni mwaka kwa mwaka, na mzunguko wa sikukuu zenu uendelee.

english: For the LORD has poured out on you a spirit of deep sleep. He has shut your eyes, O prophets; He has covered your heads, O seers.
ekegusii: Omonene obaitereire inwe omoika bw’okorara chitoro chindito; oukoirie amaiso ’ababani, abwo bare amaiso aino, na otubire emetwe y’abarori, abwo bare emetwe yaino.
swahili: Bwana amewaleteeni usingizi mzito: Ameziba macho yenu (ninyi manabii); amefunika vichwa vyenu (ninyi waonaji).

english: And the entire vision will be to you like the words sealed in a scroll. If it is handed to someone to read, he will say, “I cannot, because it is sealed.”
ekegusii: Amaroro ayio onsi ay’obobani ebei re ase more buna amang’ana ’egetabu memumekeirie na kobekwa ekemanyererio. Ekero abanto bakoira egetabu eyio ase omonto omanyete gosoma, bamoteebia: “Soma amang’ana ’egetabu eke,” ere nigo agokana oteeba: “Tinkonyara, ekiagera amang’ana aya nigo abeire buna ey’egetabu kemumekeire ebekire ekemanyererio.”
swahili: Kwa maana kwenu ninyi, maono haya yote si kitu ila maneno yaliyotiwa lakiri katika kitabu. Kama mkimpa mtu yeyote awezaye kusoma kitabu hiki, nanyi mkamwambia, “Tafadhali kisome,” yeye atajibu, “Mimi siwezi, kwa kuwa kimetiwa lakiri.”

english: Or if the scroll is handed to one unable to read, he will say, “I cannot read.”
ekegusii: Naende bayea oyotamanyeti gosoma, bamoteebia: “Soma amang’ana ’egetabu eke,” nere nigo agokana, oteeba, “Timanyeti gosoma.”
swahili: Au kama mkimpa mtu yeyote kitabu hiki asiyeweza kusoma na kumwambia, “Tafadhali kisome,” atajibu, “Mimi sijui kusoma.”

english: Therefore the Lord said: “These people draw near to Me with their mouths and honor Me with their lips, but their hearts are far from Me. Their worship of Me is but rules taught by men.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: Abanto aba nigo bakong’ika ang’e ase ogokwana nemenwa yabo na gonsika nebikoba biabo, korende chinkoro chiabo nigo chire aare korwa ase ’nde, na okonyiroka kwabo nigo kore amachiiko Mwanyabaanto borokereretie.
swahili: Bwana anasema: “Watu hawa hunikaribia kwa vinywa vyao na kuniheshimu kwa midomo yao, lakini mioyo yao iko mbali nami. Ibada yao kwangu inatokana na maagizo waliyofundishwa na wanadamu.

english: Therefore I will again confound these people with wonder upon wonder. The wisdom of the wise will vanish, and the intelligence of the intelligent will be hidden. ”
ekegusii: Ase ayio, rora, ningenderere gokora amang’ana ay’ogokumia ase abanto aba, ee, amang’ana ayio nigo arabe ay’ogokumigwa na goichanwa; obong’aini bw’abaanto babo bare abang’aini mbosire, na okomanya kw’abamanyete mono nkobiswe. Ogosemeria kw’amatuko agochi‐gocha
swahili: Kwa hiyo mara nyingine tena nitawashangaza watu hawa, kwa ajabu juu ya ajabu. Hekima ya wenye hekima itapotea, nayo akili ya wenye akili itatoweka.”

english: Woe to those who dig deep to hide their plans from the LORD. In darkness they do their works and say, “Who sees us, and who will know?”
ekegusii: Obobe nobw’abaanto abwo bagokora emeroberio yabo erio bayebisa aase aatambe ng’a Omonene tayerora. Abanto abwo nigo bagokora ogokora kwabo ase chinchera chi’omosunte, erio bateeba, “Ning’o otorooche? Ning’o otomanyete?”
swahili: Ole kwa wale wanaokwenda kwenye vilindi virefu kumficha Bwana mipango yao, wafanyao kazi zao gizani na kufikiri, “Ni nani anayetuona? Ni nani atakayejua?”

english: You have turned things upside down, as if the potter were regarded as clay. Shall what is formed say to him who formed it, “He did not make me”? Can the pottery say of the potter, “He has no understanding”? Sanctification for the Godly
ekegusii: Inwe nigo mokoonchorana amang’ana bobe. Inee! Omokori chinyongo nareng’anigwe nesike? Egento keroisirie ngetebie oyokeroisetie, “Tari aye kwandoisetie”; gose egento omonto abombete nkemoteebie, “Tomanyeti kende”?
swahili: Mnapindua mambo juu chini, kana kwamba mfinyanzi aweza kufikiriwa kuwa kama udongo wa mfinyanzi! Je, kile kilichofinyangwa chaweza kumwambia yule aliyekifinyanga, “Wewe hukunifinyanga mimi?” Je, chungu kinaweza kumwambia mfinyanzi, “Wewe hujui chochote?”

english: In a very short time, will not Lebanon become an orchard, and the orchard seem like a forest?
ekegusii: Engaki netigarete enke, erio rinani ria Lebanoni riraonchorwe ribe omogondo okwama chindagera chinyinge; na omogondo oria orenge kwama chindagera chinyinge oonchorwe obe rinani.
swahili: Kwa muda mfupi sana, je, Lebanoni haitageuzwa kuwa shamba lenye rutuba, na shamba lenye rutuba liwe kama msitu?

english: On that day the deaf will hear the words of the scroll, and out of the deep darkness the eyes of the blind will see.
ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio emetino neebe ekoigwa amang’ana ariikire ase egetabu, na emeuko yarenge ekorora buna rikongori na omosunte, nerore buya namaiso abo.
swahili: Katika siku ile viziwi watasikia maneno ya kitabu, na katika utusitusi na giza macho ya kipofu yataona.

english: The humble will increase their joy in the LORD, and the poor among men will rejoice in the Holy One of Israel.
ekegusii: Erio abanto abaitongo nabanyore omogooko omoyia kobare ime ase Omonene, na abataka bare ase Mwanyabaanto mbagokere Omonene ore Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli.
swahili: Mara nyingine tena wanyenyekevu watafurahi katika Bwana, wahitaji watafurahi katika yeye Aliye Mtakatifu wa Israeli.

english: And I will constrain Ariel, and there will be mourning and lamentation; she will be like an altar hearth before Me.
ekegusii: Inche Omonene nindete emechando asore Arieli, okorera na okweumia mbibe ime yao, na aye omochie nobe ase ’nde Arieli bori.
swahili: Hata hivyo nitauzunguka Arieli kwa jeshi, utalia na kuomboleza, utakuwa kwangu kama mahali pa kuwashia moto madhabahuni.

english: For the ruthless will vanish, the mockers will disappear, and all who look for evil will be cut down—
ekegusii: Abakoirokia abande mbasirigwe, na abachecheria tibakobao; abwo bonsi bakorigia gokora amabe mbaitwe tibaabao.
swahili: Wakatili watatoweka na wenye kudhihaki watatokomea, nao wote wenye jicho la uovu watakatiliwa mbali,

english: those who indict a man with a word, who ensnare the mediator at the gate, and who with false charges deprive the innocent of justice.
ekegusii: Omonene nasirie abanto abwo bagosiria abande namang’ana abo, abwo bakobeeka omoeto ase oyo okogaamba ebiina agwo ase egeita, bakwana oborimo na koonchorana oboronge bw’omonto ore omooronge.
swahili: wale ambao kwa neno humfanya mtu kuwa mwenye hatia, wamtegeao mtego mtetezi katika mahakama, na kwa ushuhuda wa uongo humnyima haki yeye asiye na hatia.

english: Therefore the LORD who redeemed Abraham says of the house of Jacob: “No longer will Jacob be ashamed and no more will his face grow pale.
ekegusii: Ase ayio Omonene, oria obooretie Aburaamu, okwanire amang’ana aya igoro y’ororeeria rwa Yakobo, “Abanto ba Yakobo tibakogenderera koba nobosooku; amasio abo takoirura nonya ng’ake naende.
swahili: Kwa hiyo hili ndilo Bwana, aliyemkomboa Abrahamu, analosema kwa nyumba ya Yakobo: “Yakobo hataaibishwa tena, wala nyuso zao hazitabadilika sura tena.

english: For when he sees his children around him, the work of My hands, they will honor My name, they will sanctify the Holy One of Jacob, and they will stand in awe of the God of Israel.
ekegusii: Ekero abana babo bararore emeremo y’amaboko aane, eye nakorete ase egati yabo, mbachene erieta riane ime yabo, naende banche ng’a inche n’Omochenu o Yakobo inde, mbabe bateneine banyirogete inche Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli.
swahili: Wakati watakapoona watoto wao miongoni mwao, kazi ya mikono yangu, watalitakasa Jina langu takatifu; wataukubali utakatifu wa yeye Aliye Mtakatifu wa Yakobo, nao watamcha Mungu wa Israeli.

english: Then the wayward in spirit will come to understanding, and those who grumble will accept instruction.”
ekegusii: Erio abwo basirire ase omoika mbaegwe okomanya, na abwo bakwemurungania mbanche amorokererio.”
swahili: Wale wanaopotoka rohoni watapata ufahamu, nao wale wanaolalamika watayakubali mafundisho.”

english: I will camp in a circle around you; I will besiege you with towers and set up siege works against you.
ekegusii: Nintoore asore ngoetanane, ng’agache chiburi chi’okoboera na gokorwania.
swahili: Nitapiga kambi pande zote dhidi yako, nitakuzunguka kwa minara na kupanga mazingirwa yangu dhidi yako.

english: You will be brought low, you will speak from the ground, and out of the dust your words will be muffled. Your voice will be like a spirit from the ground; your speech will whisper out of the dust.
ekegusii: Erio abanto bamenyete ime yao mbaiyerigwe inse, babe bagokwana korwa riroba inse, na amang’ana abo naigweke korwa ase orotu ime ng’ora ng’ora, ee, amariogi abo narwe inse ye riroba buna eriogi ri’ekerecha, nigo barabe bakomonya korwa ase orotu ime.
swahili: Utakaposhushwa, utanena kutoka ardhini, utamumunya maneno yako kutoka mavumbini. Sauti yako itatoka katika nchi kama vile ya mzimu, utanongʼona maneno yako toka mavumbini.

english: But your many foes will be like fine dust, the multitude of the ruthless like blowing chaff. Then suddenly, in an instant,
ekegusii: Korende ababisa bao bare omoganda omonene mbairurukigwe buna orotu; na omoganda bw’abare abatindi noirurukigwe buna omoiriro gochia aare. Amang’ana ayio nigo arabe mobosokano, ee, nigo arabe mobosokano mono.
swahili: Lakini adui zako wengi watakuwa kama vumbi laini, kundi la wakatili watakuwa kama makapi yapeperushwayo. Naam, ghafula, mara moja,

english: you will be visited by the LORD of Hosts with thunder and earthquake and loud noise, with windstorm and tempest and consuming flame of fire.
ekegusii: Omonene bw’Emeganda naake abanto bao ne chinkoba, na omotengecho bw’ense, na egeturi ekenene, na ekerambauti, na embura omoubera, na amasaria ’omorero ogosamba.
swahili: Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote atakuja na ngurumo, tetemeko la ardhi, na kwa sauti kuu, atakuja na dhoruba, tufani na miali ya moto iteketezayo.

english: All the many nations going out to battle against Ariel— even all who war against her, laying siege and attacking her— will be like a dream, like a vision in the night,
ekegusii: Abanto abange b’ebisaku bionsi abwo bakorwania Arieli, ee, bonsi abakorwania omochie oyio, na gotagora chiburi chiaye, na koyorentera emechando, nigo barasirigwe, beebwe buna okorota gokwebwa, ee, buna okorora kwa botuko gokwebwa.
swahili: Kisha makundi ya mataifa yote yale yapiganayo dhidi ya Arieli, yale yanayomshambulia yeye na ngome zake, na kumzunguka kwa jeshi, watakuwa kama ilivyo ndoto, kama maono wakati wa usiku:

english: as when a hungry man dreams he is eating, then awakens still hungry; as when a thirsty man dreams he is drinking, then awakens faint and parched. So will it be for all the many nations who go to battle against Mount Zion.
ekegusii: Abanto b’ebisaku bionsi, abwo bakorwania Egetunwa gia Sayoni, nigo barabe buna omonto ore nenchara akorota ng’a nkoragera are, korende gakoboka bwenyora ore nenchara, gose buna oyore nerang’o akorota ng’a nkonywa are amaache, korende gakoboka bwenyora ore nerang’o. Ogokuurerwa gwachayetwe
swahili: kama vile mtu aliye na njaa aotavyo kuwa anakula, lakini huamka, bado njaa yake ingalipo, kama vile mtu mwenye kiu aotavyo kuwa anakunywa maji, lakini huamka akiwa anazimia, akiwa bado angali ana kiu. Hivyo ndivyo itakavyokuwa kwa makundi yote ya mataifa yanayopigana dhidi ya Mlima Sayuni.

english: Stop and be astonished; blind yourselves and be sightless; be drunk, but not with wine; stagger, but not from strong drink.
ekegusii: Tenena mokumie, ee, mokumie! Ekore mobe emeuko, mogenderere goukora! Etindie, korende tari ase okonywa edivai; ong’anya, korende tari ase okonywa ekenyugwa kegotindia.
swahili: Duwaeni na kushangaa, jifanyeni vipofu wenyewe na msione, leweni, lakini si kwa mvinyo, pepesukeni lakini si kwa kileo.

english: This is the message that was revealed to Isaiah son of Amoz concerning Judah and Jerusalem:
ekegusii: Ring’ana eri nario Isaya, mosinto bw’Amosi, aroche igoro ya Yuda na Yerusalemu:
swahili: Hili ndilo aliloliona Isaya mwana wa Amozi kuhusu Yuda na Yerusalemu:

english: Go into the rocks and hide in the dust from the terror of the LORD and the splendor of His majesty.
ekegusii: Inwe soa ase egetare ime, moreme chingoro mwebiseo, motame korwa ase okoirokia kw’Omonene, na korwa ase obonene bwaye bore obonene.
swahili: Ingieni kwenye miamba, jificheni ardhini kutokana na utisho wa Bwana na utukufu wa enzi yake!

english: The proud look of man will be humbled, and the loftiness of men brought low; the LORD alone will be exalted in that day.
ekegusii: Rituko ngocha rire ekero obomwenu bwa Mwanyabaanto borairanigwe inse, na oboenenu bwabo mbokeeigwe, na ase rituko eri’Omonene bweka naimokererigwe igoro.
swahili: Macho ya mtu mwenye majivuno yatanyenyekezwa na kiburi cha wanadamu kitashushwa, Bwana peke yake ndiye atakayetukuzwa siku hiyo.

english: For the Day of the LORD of Hosts will come against all the proud and lofty, against all that is exalted— it will be humbled—
ekegusii: Omonene bw’Emeganda ochikiire rituko erimo arasirie abwo bonsi bare abaenenu na abamwenu, na bonsi abakweimokereria igoro mbairanigwe inse.
swahili: Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote anayo siku aliyoiweka akiba kwa wote wenye kujivuna na wenye kiburi, kwa wote wanaojikweza (nao watanyenyekezwa),

english: against all the cedars of Lebanon, lofty and lifted up, against all the oaks of Bashan,
ekegusii: Rituko erio nisirie emecharake yonsi ya Lebanoni ere emetambe echongororogete gochia igoro mono; boigo ne Emealuni yonsi ya Basani,
swahili: kwa mierezi yote ya Lebanoni iliyo mirefu sana, na mialoni yote ya Bashani,

english: against all the tall mountains, against all the high hills,
ekegusii: na ebitunwa bionsi ebitambe, na ebigoro bionsi biimokererete igoro,
swahili: kwa milima yote mirefu na vilima vyote vilivyoinuka,

english: against every high tower, against every fortified wall,
ekegusii: na emerobiri yonsi emetambe, ne chindwaki chinkong’u,
swahili: kwa kila mnara ulio mrefu sana na kila ukuta wenye ngome,

english: against every ship of Tarshish, and against every stately vessel.
ekegusii: ne chimeeri chionsi chia Tarisisi, n’Echimeri chionsi chingiya.
swahili: kwa kila meli ya biashara, na kila chombo cha baharini cha fahari.

english: So the pride of man will be brought low, and the loftiness of men will be humbled; the LORD alone will be exalted in that day,
ekegusii: Obomwenu bwa Mwanyabaanto mbokeeigwe, na oboenenu bwabo mbosirigwe. Na ase rituko eri’Omonene bweka naimokererigwe igoro.
swahili: Majivuno ya mwanadamu yatashushwa, na kiburi cha wanadamu kitanyenyekezwa, Bwana peke yake ndiye atatukuzwa siku hiyo,

english: and the idols will vanish completely.
ekegusii: Emegwekano yonsi egosasimwa nesirigwe kegima.
swahili: nazo sanamu zitatoweka kabisa.

english: Men will flee to caves in the rocks and holes in the ground, away from the terror of the LORD and from the splendor of His majesty, when He rises to shake the earth.
ekegusii: Abanto mbasoe ase amakuruma ’ebitare, na ase chingoro chire ase riroba; mbatame korwa ase okoirokia kw’Omonene, na korwa ase obonene bwaye bore obonene, ekero araimoke kwoboyia ense.
swahili: Watu watakimbilia kwenye mapango ndani ya miamba, na kwenye mahandaki ardhini kutokana na utisho wa Bwana na utukufu wa enzi yake, ainukapo kuitikisa dunia.

english: In the last days the mountain of the house of the LORD will be established as the chief of the mountains; it will be raised above the hills, and all nations will stream to it.
ekegusii: Nebe ase amatuko ’agochi gocha, ng’a egetunwa ki’enyomba y’Omonene ngekong’igwe kebe eki’engencho enene kobua ebinde; naende keimokererigwe igoro geetanie ebigoro, na ebisaku bionsi mbiendoke gochiao.
swahili: Katika siku za mwisho mlima wa Hekalu la Bwana utaimarishwa kama mlima mkuu miongoni mwa milima yote, utainuliwa juu ya vilima, na mataifa yote yatamiminika huko.

english: In that day men will cast away to the moles and bats their idols of silver and gold— the idols they made to worship.
ekegusii: Ase rituko erio abanto mbatugute emegwekano yabo ye chifeta na eye chitaabu, ebinto ebio beroiseretie ase okobisasiima, mbabitugutere ching’uko na ebitabora mato.
swahili: Siku ile, watu watawatupia panya na popo sanamu zao za fedha na za dhahabu, walizozitengeneza ili waziabudu.

english: They will flee to caverns in the rocks and crevices in the cliffs, away from the terror of the LORD and from the splendor of His majesty, when He rises to shake the earth.
ekegusii: Erio basoe ase emienya y’ebitare, na ase obotandoku bw’aroro, mbatame korwa ase okoirokia kw’Omonene, na korwa ase obonene bwaye bore obonene mono, ekero araimoke kwoboyia ense.
swahili: Watakimbilia kwenye mapango miambani na kwenye nyufa za miamba kutokana na utisho wa Bwana na utukufu wa enzi yake, ainukapo kuitikisa dunia.

english: Put no more trust in man, who has only the breath in his nostrils. Of what account is he?
ekegusii: Ase ayio, batige Mwanyabaanto, abwo okoeyana kwabo gwe chimioro kore embeo bosa. Omonto, ninki aisaine?
swahili: Acheni kumtumainia mwanadamu, ambaye hana kitu ila pumzi katika pua zake. Yeye ana thamani gani?

english: And many peoples will come and say: “Come, let us go up to the mountain of the LORD, to the house of the God of Jacob. He will teach us His ways so that we may walk in His paths.” For the law will go forth from Zion, and the word of the LORD from Jerusalem.
ekegusii: Ee, abanto abange mbagendeo bateebanie: “Inchuo, totiire gochia ase egetunwa kia Omonene, togende ase enyomba ya Nyasae o Yakobo, erinde atworokererie chinchera chiaye, na intwe tonyare kobwatia oboeto bwaye.” Amachiiko ’Omonene nasoke korwa Sayoni, ne ring’ana riaye ndirue Yerusalemu.
swahili: Mataifa mengi yatakuja na kusema, “Njooni, twendeni mlimani mwa Bwana, kwenye nyumba ya Mungu wa Yakobo. Atatufundisha njia zake, ili tuweze kuenenda katika mapito yake.” Sheria itatoka Sayuni, neno la Bwana litatoka Yerusalemu.

english: Then He will judge between the nations and arbitrate for many peoples. They will beat their swords into plowshares and their spears into pruning hooks. Nation will no longer take up the sword against nation, nor train anymore for war. The Day of Reckoning
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene nanache ekiina ase egati y’ebisaku, nae abanto abange oboronge bwabo, barabwo mbature emioro yabo ebe amakombe akorema, na amatimo abo abe emeyio chinkuro; egesaku tigekoimokera egesaku kende nemioro, gose abanto tibakweorokereria korwana esegi naende.
swahili: Atahukumu kati ya mataifa na ataamua migogoro ya mataifa mengi. Watafua panga zao ziwe majembe, na mikuki yao kuwa miundu ya kukata matawi. Taifa halitainua upanga dhidi ya taifa jingine, wala hawatajifunza vita tena.

english: Come, O house of Jacob, let us walk in the light of the LORD.
ekegusii: Inwe abanto b’enyomba ya Yakobo inchwo totaare ase omobaso Omonene. Oboenenu mbosirigwe
swahili: Njooni, enyi nyumba ya Yakobo, tutembeeni katika nuru ya Bwana. Siku Ya Bwana

english: For You have abandoned Your people, the house of Jacob, because they are filled with influences from the east; they are soothsayers like the Philistines; they strike hands with the children of foreigners.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene kwangire abanto bao, abwo bare ab’ororeeria rwa Yakobo, ekiagera barabwo baichoirwe ne chingencho chi’abaanto ba moocha, na nigo bagokora oboringoria buna obw’Abafilisti; boigo babwatanire nabaanto b’echinse chingeni.
swahili: Umewatelekeza watu wako, nyumba ya Yakobo. Wamejaa ushirikina utokao Mashariki, wanapiga ramli kama Wafilisti na wanashikana mikono na wapagani.

english: Their land is full of silver and gold, with no limit to their treasures; their land is full of horses, with no limit to their chariots.
ekegusii: Ense yabo nigo eichire ne chifeta ne chitaabu, ne chinibo chiabo tichiri nomoerio. Ense yabo nigo eichire ne chibarasi, ne chigari chiabo tichikoera.
swahili: Nchi yao imejaa fedha na dhahabu, hakuna mwisho wa hazina zao. Nchi yao imejaa farasi, hakuna mwisho wa magari yao.

english: Their land is full of idols; they bow down to the work of their hands, to what their fingers have made.
ekegusii: Ense yabo nigo eichire nemegwekano y’ogosasimwa, nigo bagotung’ama inse basasiima emeremo y’amaboko abo, eyio bakorire nebiara biabo abanyene.
swahili: Nchi yao imejaa sanamu, wanasujudia kazi za mikono yao, vitu vile vidole vyao vimevitengeneza.

english: So mankind is brought low, and man is humbled— do not forgive them!
ekegusii: Ase enchera eyio abanto bonsi nigo barakeeigwe, tobaisa kobaabera nonya ngake aye Omonene.
swahili: Kwa hiyo mwanadamu atashushwa na binadamu atanyenyekezwa: usiwasamehe.

english: “Woe to the rebellious children,” declares the LORD, “to those who carry out a plan that is not Mine, who form an alliance, but against My will, heaping up sin upon sin.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: “Obobe nobwaino inwe abana baane abamore abasaria, aba mogokora emeroberio etari eyaane, nigo mogokora okobwatana okwo gotari okw’omoika one, na mwamenta ebibe igoro ase ebibe binde.
swahili: Bwana asema, “Ole kwa watoto wakaidi, kwa wale wanaotimiza mipango ambayo si yangu, wakifanya makubaliano, lakini si kwa Roho wangu, wakilundika dhambi juu ya dhambi,

english: They say to the seers, “Stop seeing visions!” and to the prophets, “Do not prophesy to us the truth! Speak to us pleasant words; prophesy illusions.
ekegusii: Nigo bagoteebia abarori b’amaroro: “Timobaisa korora amang’ana,” na bateebia ababani: “Timobaisa gotobaanera amang’ana amaronge; toteebie amang’ana amororo aya agotwansera, motobaanere ay’obong’ainereria.
swahili: Wanawaambia waonaji, “Msione maono tena!” Nako kwa manabii wanasema, “Msiendelee kutupatia maono ambayo ni ya kweli! Tuambieni mambo ya kupendeza, tabirini mambo ya uongo.

english: Get out of the way; turn off the road. Rid us of the Holy One of Israel!”
ekegusii: Karue inchera, gobera korwa ase oboeto, morusie ase tore Oyio ore Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli.”
swahili: Acheni njia hii, ondokeni katika mapito haya, nanyi acheni kutukabili pamoja na yeye Aliye Mtakatifu wa Israeli!”

english: Therefore this is what the Holy One of Israel says: “Because you have rejected this message, trusting in oppression and relying on deceit,
ekegusii: Ase ayio, Oyore Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli oteebire iga: “Inwe mwachayire ring’ana eri, mwanchire amang’ana ’obobe na obong’ainereria, naro mosemeretie.
swahili: Kwa hiyo, hili ndilo asemalo yeye Aliye Mtakatifu wa Israeli: “Kwa sababu mmekataa ujumbe huu, mkategemea uonevu na kutumainia udanganyifu,

english: this iniquity of yours is like a breach about to fail, a bulge in a high wall, whose collapse will come suddenly— in an instant!
ekegusii: Ase ayio, okomocha oko kw’ebibe nkobe ase more buna obotandoku bore ase orwaki orotambe rwekumbire, rore ang’e kogwa, na okogwa kwaye nigo korache bwango mobosokano.
swahili: dhambi hii itakuwa kwenu kama ukuta mrefu, wenye ufa na wenye kubetuka, ambao unaanguka ghafula, mara moja.

english: It will break in pieces like a potter’s jar, shattered so that no fragment can be found. Not a shard will be found in the dust large enough to scoop the coals from a hearth or to skim the water from a cistern.”
ekegusii: Okogwa okwo nkobe buna ogwatwa kw’enyongo y’omokori chinyongo egotinerwa inse, nonya norogio oromo rw’enyongo eyio tirori gotoka omonto araancharere omorero, gose arabuchere amaache korwa ase ensoko.”
swahili: Utavunjika vipande vipande kama chombo cha udongo ukipasuka pasipo huruma ambapo katika vipande vyake hakuna kipande kitakachopatikana kwa kuukulia makaa kutoka jikoni au kuchotea maji kisimani.”

english: For the Lord GOD, the Holy One of Israel, has said: “By repentance and rest you would be saved; your strength would lie in quiet confidence— but you were not willing.”
ekegusii: Aya nar’Nyasae, Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli agoteeba: “Komorang’iranere mobe abatoereru imotooreke; ase oboremereria na ogosemeria monyore chinguru.” Korende inwe mwangire gokora bo.
swahili: Hili ndilo Bwana Mwenyezi, yeye Aliye Mtakatifu wa Israeli, asemalo: “Katika kutubu na kupumzika ndio wokovu wenu, katika kutulia na kutumaini ndizo nguvu zenu, lakini hamkutaka.

english: “No,” you say, “we will flee on horses.” Therefore you will flee! “We will ride swift horses,” but your pursuers will be faster.
ekegusii: Nigo mogoteeba ng’a moriine chibarasi chikominyoka mono, motame. Ee, goika motame. Inwe moganetie gotama ne chibarasi chinyango, korende ababisa baino abwo bakobabwatia nigo bare abaminyoki kobabua.
swahili: Mlisema, ‘Hapana, tutakimbia kwa farasi.’ Kwa hiyo mtakimbia! Mlisema, ‘Tutakimbia kwa farasi waendao kasi.’ Kwa hiyo wanaowafukuza watakwenda kasi!

english: A thousand will flee at the threat of one; at the threat of five you will all flee, until you are left alone like a pole on a mountaintop, like a banner on a hill. God Will Be Gracious
ekegusii: Abanto baino elifu eyemo mbaserigwe ase okogoswa nomonto oyomo, gose nabaanto batano, goika abatigari baino babe buna omoenga oyomo ore ase egetunwa igoro, na buna ekemanyererio keimokereirie ase ekerogo igoro.
swahili: Watu 1,000 watakimbia kwa ajili ya kitisho cha mtu mmoja, kwa vitishio vya watu watano wote mtakimbia, hadi mtakapoachwa kama mlingoti wa bendera juu ya kilele cha mlima, kama bendera juu ya kilima.”

english: Therefore the LORD longs to be gracious to you; therefore He rises to show you compassion, for the LORD is a just God. Blessed are all who wait for Him.
ekegusii: Ase ayio Omonene nigo aganyete ng’a anyare kobakorera amaya; na ase ayio, neimokererie igoro mono goika abe okobarorera amaabera, ekiagera Omonene nigo are Nyasae bw’oboronge. Mbarenomogooko abanto bonsi abamoganyete. Nyasae nasesenie abanto baye
