swahili: Kama hema la mchunga mifugo, nyumba yangu imebomolewa na kutwaliwa kutoka kwangu. Kama mfumaji nimevingirisha maisha yangu, naye amenikatilia mbali kutoka kitanda cha mfumi. Mchana na usiku uliyakomesha maisha yangu.

english: I composed myself until the morning. Like a lion He breaks all my bones; from day until night You make an end of me.
ekegusii: Nigo nkorera ase obotuko bwonsi ng’a nkonywe; Omonene obunire amauga aane buna endo ekobuna ebi yaitire; ekero botaraira ere nigo akoeria obogima bwane.
swahili: Nilingoja kwa uvumilivu hadi mapambazuko, lakini alivunja mifupa yangu yote kama simba. Mchana na usiku uliyakomesha maisha yangu.

english: I chirp like a swallow or crane; I moan like a dove. My eyes grow weak as I look upward. O Lord, I am oppressed; be my security.”
ekegusii: Nigo nkorera buna egesingororo gose ebarara; nigo nkweumia buna riruma. Amaiso aane arosire ase okorigereria gochia igoro. Aye Omonene, nigo inde nemechando emenene, indwanerere!”
swahili: Nililia kama mbayuwayu au korongo, niliomboleza kama hua aombolezaye. Macho yangu yalififia nilipotazama mbinguni. Ee Bwana, ninataabika, njoo unisaidie!”

english: What can I say? He has spoken to me, and He Himself has done this. I will walk slowly all my years because of the anguish of my soul.
ekegusii: Inki bono ngokwana? Omonene nere okwanire nainche, nere omonyene okorire amang’ana aya. Ase igo nintaare inde nobokanyeku ase emiaka yane yonsi, ase engencho y’obororo bwonsi bw’omoyo one.
swahili: Lakini niseme nini? Amesema nami, naye yeye mwenyewe amelitenda hili. Nitatembea kwa unyenyekevu katika miaka yangu yote kwa sababu ya haya maumivu makali ya nafsi yangu.

english: O Lord, by such things men live, and in all of them my spirit finds life. You have restored me to health and have let me live.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ase okoba namang’ana buna ayio, abanto nigo bakoba moyo, na obogima bw’omoika one nao bore ase ayio, na bono ingwenie kegima na onkore imbe moyo.
swahili: Bwana, kwa mambo kama haya watu huishi, nayo roho yangu hupata uzima katika hayo pia. Uliniponya na kuniacha niishi.

english: Surely for my own welfare I had such great anguish; but Your love has delivered me from the pit of oblivion, for You have cast all my sins behind Your back.
ekegusii: Naama! Nigo narenge nobororo obonge, na obororo obwo bokandetera omorembe. Ase obwanchani bwao gwatooririe omoyo one korwa ase engoro y’obosareku; gwatugutire ebibe biane bionsi gochia magega yao.
swahili: Hakika ilikuwa ya faida yangu ndiyo maana nikapata maumivu makali. Katika upendo wako ukaniokoa kutoka shimo la uharibifu; umeziweka dhambi zangu zote nyuma yako.

english: For Sheol cannot thank You; Death cannot praise You. Those who descend to the Pit cannot hope for Your faithfulness.
ekegusii: Abare aase abakuure tibagokoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono, abwo bakuure tibakogotogia; abwo bakogenda ase chimbeera ime tibagosemeria obwegenwa bwao.
swahili: Kwa maana kaburi haliwezi kukusifu, mauti haiwezi kuimba sifa zako; wale washukao chini shimoni hawawezi kuutarajia uaminifu wako.

english: The living, only the living, can thank You, as I do today; fathers will tell their children about Your faithfulness.
ekegusii: Omonto ore moyo nere orakoiranerie ng’a mbuya mono, buna inche ngokoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono ase rituko ria reero; ise abana nere agokora obwegenwa bwao bwamanyekana ase abana baye.
swahili: Walio hai, walio hai: hao wanakusifu, kama ninavyofanya leo. Baba huwaambia watoto wao habari za uaminifu wako.

english: Then Hezekiah turned his face to the wall and prayed to the LORD,
ekegusii: Hezekia akaonchora obosio bwaye gochia ase enyasi, agasaba Omonene,
swahili: Hezekia akaelekeza uso wake ukutani, akamwomba Bwana:

english: The LORD will save me; we will play songs on stringed instruments all the days of our lives in the house of the LORD.
ekegusii: Omonene nantoorie; ase ayio ntobe togoteera amatera, ase okobugia amakano aane, ase obogima bwaito bwonsi, agwo ase enyomba y’Omonene.
swahili: Bwana ataniokoa, nasi tutaimba kwa vyombo vya nyuzi siku zote za maisha yetu katika Hekalu la Bwana.

english: Now Isaiah had said, “Prepare a lump of pressed figs and apply it to the boil, and he will recover.”
ekegusii: Bono Isaya konya oteebire iga: “Tiga baimokie ribomba ri’amako, baribeke ase rigumba ria Hezekia, erinde agwene.”
swahili: Isaya alikuwa amesema, “Tengenezeni dawa ya kubandika ya tini, mweke juu ya jipu, naye atapona.”

english: And Hezekiah had asked, “What will be the sign that I will go up to the house of the LORD?”
ekegusii: Boigo Hezekia konya oboririe iga: “Nkemanyererio ki gekonyorokia ng’a ningende ase enyomba y’Omonene?”
swahili: Hezekia alikuwa ameuliza, “Kutakuwa na ishara gani kwamba nitapanda kwenda Hekalu la Bwana?”

english: saying, “Please, O LORD, remember how I have walked before You faithfully and with wholehearted devotion; I have done what was good in Your sight.” And Hezekiah wept bitterly.
ekegusii: akabora, “bono Omonene nagosoroire, inyora buna nabeire ngokobwatia ase obwegenwa, na ase enkoro yane yonsi, naende nakorire ayare amaronge ase obosio bwao.” Erio. Hezekia akarera nobororo.
swahili: “Ee Bwana, kumbuka jinsi nilivyoenenda mbele zako kwa uaminifu na kujitoa kwa moyo wangu wote, na kufanya yaliyo mema machoni pako.” Naye Hezekia akalia kwa uchungu.

english: And the word of the LORD came to Isaiah, saying,
ekegusii: Erio ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha ase Isaya, rikamoteebia,
swahili: Ndipo neno la Bwana likamjia Isaya, kusema:

english: “Go and tell Hezekiah that this is what the LORD, the God of your father David, says: ‘I have heard your prayer; I have seen your tears. Behold, I will add fifteen years to your life.
ekegusii: “Irana oteebie Hezekia ng’a inche Omonene, Nyasae o Daudi sokoro yaye, nigo ngoteeba iga: Naigure ogosaba kwao, narorire amariga ao. Rora, nakomentire emiaka ikomi na etano ase obogima bwao.
swahili: “Nenda ukamwambie Hezekia, ‘Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana, Mungu wa baba yako Daudi: Nimeyasikia maombi yako na nimeona machozi yako. Nitakuongezea miaka kumi na mitano katika maisha yako.

english: And I will deliver you and this city from the hand of the king of Assyria. I will defend this city.
ekegusii: Ningotoorie aye amo nomochie oyo, korwa ase okoboko kw’omorwoti bw’Abaasuri; ning’egere omochie oyo.
swahili: Nami nitakuokoa wewe pamoja na mji huu mkononi mwa mfalme wa Ashuru. Nitaulinda mji huu.

english: This will be a sign to you from the LORD that He will do what He has promised:
ekegusii: “Eke nakio ekemanyererio asore korwa ase Omonene, ng’a naikeranie amang’ana ayio atebiire:
swahili: “ ‘Hii ndiyo ishara ya Bwana kwako ya kwamba Bwana atafanya kile alichoahidi:

english: I will make the sun’s shadow that falls on the stairway of Ahaz go back ten steps.’” So the sunlight went back the ten steps it had descended. Hezekiah’s Song of Thanksgiving
ekegusii: Rora, ase ekerengero gie chinsa ki’Ahasi ninkore omorengari oria otambeire ekero erioba riereerire oirane gochia magega ebitambokero ikomi.” Ase ayio erioba rikairania omorengari oye ebitambokero ikomi ase ekerengero keria.
swahili: Nitafanya kivuli cha jua kwenye ngazi iliyojengwa na Ahazi kirudi nyuma madaraja kumi.’ ” Hivyo jua likarudi nyuma madaraja kumi ambayo lilikuwa limeshuka.

english: This is a writing by Hezekiah king of Judah after his illness and recovery:
ekegusii: Magega Hezekia, omorwoti bw’Abayuda, kagwenire korwa ase oborwaire bwaye, akariika ogoteera oko:
swahili: Maandiko ya Hezekia mfalme wa Yuda baada ya kuugua kwake na kupona:

english: At that time Merodach-baladan son of Baladan king of Babylon sent letters and a gift to Hezekiah, for he had heard about Hezekiah’s illness and recovery.
ekegusii: Ase engaki eria omorwoti o Babiloni Merodaki‐Baladani, mosinto o Baladani, agatoma abanto bakaira riruube na ebiegwa ase Hezekia, ekiagera aigwete ng’a Hezekia nabeete omorwaire, naende ng’a konya ogwenire.
swahili: Wakati huo Merodaki-Baladani, mwana wa Baladani mfalme wa Babeli, akamtumia Hezekia barua na zawadi, kwa sababu alikuwa amesikia habari za kuugua na kupona kwake.

english: And Hezekiah welcomed the envoys gladly and showed them what was in his treasure house—the silver, the gold, the spices, and the precious oil, as well as his entire armory—all that was found in his storehouses. There was nothing in his palace or in all his dominion that Hezekiah did not show them.
ekegusii: Hezekia akabaroisia buya, erio akaborokia chimonga chiaye chionsi, ne chifeta, ne chitaabu, na ebinsari, na amaguta e rigori rinene, na ebirwanero biaye bionsi, na ebinto bionsi biagachire ase chinyomba chiaye. Tatigete gento kende gionsi ase enyomba yaye, gose ase chikungo chi’oborwoti bwaye, ataborogetie.
swahili: Hezekia akawapokea wale wajumbe kwa furaha na kuwaonyesha vitu vile vilivyokuwa katika ghala zake: yaani fedha, dhahabu, vikolezo na mafuta safi, ghala la silaha lote, na kila kitu kilichokuwa katika hazina zake. Hapakuwa na kitu chochote katika jumba lake la kifalme au katika ufalme wake wote ambacho Hezekia hakuwaonyesha.

english: Then the prophet Isaiah went to King Hezekiah and asked, “Where did those men come from, and what did they say to you?” “They came to me from a distant land,” Hezekiah replied, “from Babylon.”
ekegusii: Erio omobani Isaya agacha ase Hezekia, omorwoti akamobooria: “Ngento ki abanto aba bakwana? Ng’ai barwa bagacha asore?” Hezekia akamoiraneria: “Barabwo nigo barwa Babiloni, ense y’aare, bagacha ase ’nde.”
swahili: Ndipo nabii Isaya akaenda kwa Mfalme Hezekia na kumuuliza, “Watu hao walisema nini, na wametoka wapi?” Hezekia akamjibu, “Wametoka nchi ya mbali. Walikuja kwangu kutoka Babeli.”

english: “What have they seen in your palace?” Isaiah asked. “They have seen everything in my palace,” answered Hezekiah. “There is nothing among my treasures that I did not show them.”
ekegusii: Isaya akamobooria: “Ngento ki barora ase enyomba yao?” Hezekia akairaneria: “Nigo barora ebinto bionsi bire ase enyomba yane, tikeri nonya negento ekemo ase amagachero aane ntaborokia.”
swahili: Nabii akauliza, “Waliona nini katika jumba lako la kifalme?” Hezekia akajibu, “Waliona kila kitu katika jumba langu la kifalme. Hakuna kitu chochote katika hazina yangu ambacho sikuwaonyesha.”

english: Then Isaiah said to Hezekiah, “Hear the word of the LORD of Hosts:
ekegusii: Erio Isaya agateebia Hezekia: “Bono igwa ring’ana ri’Omonene bw’Emeganda:
swahili: Ndipo Isaya akamwambia Hezekia, “Sikia neno la Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote:

english: The time will surely come when everything in your palace and all that your fathers have stored up until this day will be carried off to Babylon. Nothing will be left, says the LORD.
ekegusii: Naama! Amatuko ngocha are, ekero ebinto bionsi bire ase enyomba yao, na ebinto bionsi chisokoro chiao chiagachete goika reero iga nabiimokigwe biirwe Babiloni. Nonya negento ekemo tikegotigara. Aya nar’Omonene atebiire.
swahili: Hakika wakati unakuja ambapo vitu vyote katika jumba lako la kifalme, na vyote ambavyo baba zako waliweka akiba mpaka siku hii, vitachukuliwa kwenda Babeli. Hakuna chochote kitakachosalia, asema Bwana.

english: And some of your descendants, your own flesh and blood, will be taken away to be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon.”
ekegusii: Boigo abana bande bao abamura, abwo kwaiboreirwe, inabairwe, bachie koba abakoreri ase enyomba y’omorwoti o Babiloni.”
swahili: Nao baadhi ya wazao wako, nyama yako na damu yako mwenyewe watakaozaliwa kwako, watachukuliwa mbali, nao watakuwa matowashi katika jumba la mfalme wa Babeli.”

english: But Hezekiah said to Isaiah, “The word of the LORD that you have spoken is good.” For he thought, “At least there will be peace and security in my lifetime.”
ekegusii: Erio Hezekia agateebia Isaya: “Ring’ana ri’Omonene aye gwakwanire nerigiya.” Naende akamoteebia: “Omorembe na okorendwa okuya nigo bigochia koba ase obogima bwane.”
swahili: Hezekia akamjibu Isaya, “Neno la Bwana ulilosema ni jema.” Kwa kuwa alifikiri, “Patakuwepo amani na usalama wakati wa uhai wangu.”

english: For behold, the Lord GOD of Hosts is about to remove from Jerusalem and Judah both supply and support: the whole supply of food and water,
ekegusii: Naama! Omonene, oyore Omonene bw’Emeganda, narusie korwa ase Yerusalemu, na korwa ase Abayuda, kera egento basemeretie na ebi begenete; narusieo endagera yonsi, na amaache onsi.
swahili: Tazama sasa, Bwana, Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, yu karibu kuwaondolea Yerusalemu na Yuda upatikanaji wa mahitaji na misaada, upatikanaji wote wa chakula na tegemeo lote la maji,

english: Tell the righteous it will be well with them, for they will enjoy the fruit of their labor.
ekegusii: Teebia abanyene oboronge ng’a amang’ana nabe amaya ase bare, barabwo mbarie okwama kw’ogokora kwabo.
swahili: Waambie wanyofu itakuwa heri kwao, kwa kuwa watafurahia tunda la matendo yao.

english: Woe to the wicked; disaster is upon them! For they will be repaid with what their hands have done.
ekegusii: Obobe nobwabo abakori amabe! Amang’ana nabe amabe ase bare, ekiagera aya amaboko abo abeire agokora, naro barakorerwe abanyene.
swahili: Ole kwa watu waovu! Maafa yapo juu yao! Watalipwa kwa ajili ya yale mikono yao iliyotenda.

english: Youths oppress My people, and women rule over them. O My people, your guides mislead you; they turn you from your paths.
ekegusii: Abanto baane nigo bagochandwa nabana, na abakungu nabwo bakobagaambera. Inwe abanto baane, abaraai baino baabatantanirie enchera, babasiririe ase enchera mogoeta. Omonene okonachera ebisaku ekiina
swahili: Vijana wanawatesa watu wangu, wanawake wanawatawala. Enyi watu wangu, viongozi wenu wanawapotosha, wanawapoteza njia.

english: The LORD arises to contend; He stands to judge the people.
ekegusii: Omonene obeire ang’e korenta ekiina, otenenire konachera ebisaku ekiina.
swahili: Bwana anachukua nafasi yake mahakamani, anasimama kuhukumu watu.

english: The LORD brings this charge against the elders and leaders of His people: “You have devoured the vineyard; the plunder of the poor is in your houses.
ekegusii: Omonene nachake kogambia abagaaka na abagaambi b’abaanto baye, ateebe, “Ninwe mwasaririe omogondo one bw’emesabibu, na ebisakorwa bi’abataka nigo bire ase chinyomba chiaino.
swahili: Bwana anaingia katika hukumu dhidi ya wazee na viongozi wa watu wake: “Ninyi ndio mlioharibu shamba langu la mizabibu, mali zilizonyangʼanywa maskini zimo nyumbani mwenu.

english: Why do you crush My people and grind the faces of the poor?” declares the Lord GOD of Hosts. A Warning to the Daughters of Zion
ekegusii: Inche Omonene bw’Emeganda, nigo nkoboria iga: Ninki mokorengereria goika mwasunyuntire abanto baane na gosia amasio ’abataka?” Ogokuurerwa kw’abakuungu ba Yerusalemu
swahili: Mnamaanisha nini kuwaponda watu wangu na kuzisaga nyuso za maskini?” asema Bwana, Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote.

english: The LORD also says: “Because the daughters of Zion are haughty— walking with heads held high and wanton eyes, prancing and skipping as they go, jingling the bracelets on their ankles—
ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteeba, “Abakungu ba Sayoni nigo bare aberori, nigo bagotaara basongorete amagoti, na bagoaka‐akania amaiso are nokogania okobe; nigo bagotira‐tiria kobakogenda na kwogia chinchigiri chire amagoro abo.
swahili: Bwana asema, “Wanawake wa Sayuni wana kiburi, wanatembea na shingo ndefu, wakikonyeza kwa macho yao, wanatembea kwa hatua za madaha, wakiwa na mapambo ya njuga kwenye vifundo vya miguu yao.

english: the Lord will bring sores on the heads of the daughters of Zion, and the LORD will make their foreheads bare. ”
ekegusii: Ase ayio Omonene nae abakungu ba Sayoni oborwaire bw’ogosunyora chitukia chiabo, naende abaasiorie chianga abatige bare getirianda.”
swahili: Kwa hiyo Bwana ataleta majipu kwenye vichwa vya wanawake wa Sayuni; Bwana atazifanya ngozi za vichwa vyao kuwa vipara.”

english: In that day the Lord will take away their finery: their anklets and headbands and crescents;
ekegusii: Ase rituko eri’Omonene nabaure ebinto bionsi bechaberete: ebitange bi’amagoro, na ebitinti, ne chisonoi chi’amagoti,
swahili: Katika siku ile Bwana atawanyangʼanya uzuri wao: bangili, tepe za kichwani, mikufu yenye alama za mwezi mwandamo,

english: the mighty man and the warrior, the judge and the prophet, the soothsayer and the elder,
ekegusii: Narusie korwao abanto bare chituoni na abarwani bande b’esegi, na abagaambi ebiina, na ababani, na abaringoria, na abagaaka,
swahili: shujaa na mtu wa vita, mwamuzi na nabii, mwaguzi na mzee,

english: their headdresses, ankle chains, and sashes; their perfume bottles and charms;
ekegusii: na ebinyuri bi’amagoro, ne chinkini chi’okweboeria, ne chichuba chire namaguta agotioka, na ebite bi’ogwekong’era,
swahili: vilemba, mikufu ya vifundo vya miguu, mshipi, chupa za manukato na hirizi,

english: their signet rings and nose rings;
ekegusii: ne chibonyi chire nebimanyererio, na ebigera bie chimioro,
swahili: pete zenye muhuri, pete za puani,

english: their festive robes, capes, cloaks, and purses;
ekegusii: ne chiganchwa chi’emeyega, ne chigoti chi’okwambara, na ebiambaro bi’amareko, na emebuko ya koboko,
swahili: majoho mazuri, mitandio, mavazi, kifuko cha kutilia fedha,

english: and their mirrors, linen garments, tiaras, and shawls.
ekegusii: na ebirore, ne chianga chi’egatani chie rigori rinene, na ebigogwa, na ebietubo.
swahili: vioo, mavazi ya kitani, taji na shali.

english: Instead of fragrance there will be a stench; instead of a belt, a rope; instead of styled hair, baldness; instead of fine clothing, sackcloth; instead of beauty, shame.
ekegusii: Ribaga ri’ogotioka okuya nobogundo borabeo, ne ribaga ri’orokini nengori eraabeo, ne ribaga ri’etukia eroisirie buya nerisio rirabeo, ne ribaga ri’okobeeka chiganchwa chi’emeyega mweboyie chigunia, obuya bwabo mboonchoke bobe obosoku.
swahili: Badala ya harufu ya manukato kutakuwa na uvundo; badala ya mishipi, ni kamba; badala ya nywele zilizotengenezwa vizuri, ni upara; badala ya mavazi mazuri, ni nguo za magunia; badala ya uzuri, ni alama ya aibu kwa chuma cha moto.

english: Your men will fall by the sword, and your warriors in battle.
ekegusii: Abanto baino mbaitwe nemioro, na abarwani baino chituoni mbakwere ase esegi.
swahili: Wanaume wako watauawa kwa upanga, nao mashujaa wako watauawa vitani.

english: And the gates of Zion will lament and mourn; destitute, she will sit on the ground.
ekegusii: Ebiita bi’omochie oyio mbirere na kobokia amagombo; n’omochie oyio nobe buna omokungu ourirwe kera egento oinkaransete amaroba igoro.
swahili: Malango ya Sayuni yataomboleza na kulia, ataketi mavumbini akiwa fukara.

english: the commander of fifty and the dignitary, the counselor, the cunning magician, and the clever enchanter.
ekegusii: na abatang’ani b’abarwani emerongo etano, na abanto abasike, na abasemia, na abaroisia abang’aini, na abaragori bamanyete oborogi mono.
swahili: jemadari wa kikosi cha watu hamsini na mtu mwenye cheo, mshauri, fundi stadi na mlozi mjanja.

english: “I will make mere lads their leaders, and children will rule over them.”
ekegusii: Omonene nabeeke abasae babe abanene babo, na abana abake baabagambere.
swahili: Nitawafanya wavulana wawe maafisa wao, watoto ndio watakaowatawala.

english: The people will oppress one another, man against man, neighbor against neighbor; the young will rise up against the old, and the base against the honorable.
ekegusii: Abanto mbachandane, kera omonto nabe ogochanda oyonde, na kera omonto nabe ogochanda omogisangio oye; omwana omoke naenenere omonto omogotu, na omonto otaroochi nchera nachaye omonto osikire.
swahili: Watu wataoneana wao kwa wao: mtu dhidi ya mtu, na jirani dhidi ya jirani yake. Kijana atainuka dhidi ya mzee, mtu mnyonge dhidi ya mtu mwenye heshima.

english: A man will seize his brother within his father’s house: “You have a cloak—you be our leader! Take charge of this heap of rubble.”
ekegusii: Engaki eyio omonto nabwate oyomwabo baiboire komo amoteebie, “Aye nobwate chianga okobeeka, ase ayio kabe omogambi oito, otenenere obogaambi obo bwanyegerigwe.”
swahili: Mtu atamkamata mmoja wa ndugu zake katika nyumba ya baba yake na kusema, “Unalo joho, sasa uwe kiongozi wetu, tawala lundo hili la magofu!”

english: On that day he will cry aloud: “I am not a healer. I have no food or clothing in my house. Do not make me leader of the people!”
ekegusii: Korende ase rituko erio oyio nakane ateebe: “Inche tinkonyara koba omogwenia; ase enyomba yane endagera teiyo, gose eanga, ase ayio timokonyara kombeeka imbe omoraai bw’abaanto.”
swahili: Lakini siku hiyo atapiga kelele akisema, “Sina uponyaji. Sina chakula wala mavazi katika nyumba yangu, msinifanye niwe kiongozi wa watu.”

english: For Jerusalem has stumbled and Judah has fallen because they spoke and acted against the LORD, defying His glorious presence.
ekegusii: Yerusalemu otagoirwe, na Abayuda bagure, ekiagera chinkwana chiabo na ogokora kwabo biabeire mamincha y’Omonene, basiereiri, Obonene bwa Nyasae gati yabo.
swahili: Yerusalemu inapepesuka, Yuda inaanguka; maneno yao na matendo yao ni kinyume na Bwana, wakiudharau uwepo wake uliotukuka.

english: The expression on their faces testifies against them, and like Sodom they flaunt their sin; they do not conceal it. Woe to them, for they have brought disaster upon themselves.
ekegusii: Okororekana kw’amaiso abo kwababereire kirori; nigo bakoraria ebibe biabo buna Abasodomu bakorete, tibari kobibisa. Obobe nobwabo! Barabwo abanyene berenteire obobe obwo.
swahili: Nyuso zao zinavyoonekana zinashuhudia dhidi yao, hujivunia dhambi yao kama Sodoma, wala hawaifichi. Ole wao! Wamejiletea maafa juu yao wenyewe.

english: “Comfort, comfort My people,” says your God.
ekegusii: Remia abanto baane! Ee, remia abanto baane! Nabo Nyasae oino atebiire.
swahili: Wafarijini, wafarijini watu wangu, asema Mungu wenu.

english: Behold, the Lord GOD comes with might, and His arm establishes His rule. His reward is with Him, and His recompense accompanies Him.
ekegusii: Rora, Omonene ngocha are ore nokobua, okoboko kwaye nkobe gokogaamba. Naama! Nigo agocha obwate eng’eria yaye, na ebiasakoire nigo bire ase obosio bwaye.
swahili: Tazameni, Bwana Mwenyezi anakuja na nguvu, nao mkono wake ndio utawalao kwa ajili yake. Tazameni, ujira wake u pamoja naye, nayo malipo yake yanafuatana naye.

english: He tends His flock like a shepherd; He gathers the lambs in His arms and carries them close to His heart. He gently leads the nursing ewes.
ekegusii: Narisie riicho riaye buna omorisia akorisia ching’ondi chiaye, nasangererie chimanwa chi’eching’ondi achiagate, nachibogorie ase egekuba kiaye, na echi chire ne chimanwa ching’are nachiraae ng’ora ng’ora. Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli tari koreng’anigwa na onde
swahili: Huchunga kundi lake kama mchungaji wa mifugo: Hukusanya wana-kondoo katika mikono yake na kuwachukua karibu na moyo wake, huwaongoza taratibu wale wanyonyeshao.

english: Who has measured the waters in the hollow of his hand, or marked off the heavens with the span of his hand? Who has held the dust of the earth in a basket, or weighed the mountains on a scale and the hills with a balance?
ekegusii: Ning’o orengire amaache e chinyancha noroe rw’okoboko kwaye? Ning’o oramboire ebiara bi’amaboko aye korenga igoro? Ning’o obekire orotu rw’ense ase ekerengero, gose ning’o orengire ebitunwa na ebigoro nekerengero?
swahili: Ni nani aliyepima maji ya bahari kwenye konzi ya mkono wake, au kuzipima mbingu kwa shibiri yake? Ni nani aliyeyashika mavumbi ya dunia katika kikapu, au kupima milima kwenye kipimio na vilima kwenye mizani?

english: Who has directed the Spirit of the LORD, or informed Him as His counselor?
ekegusii: Ning’o okoraa Omoika bw’Omonene, gose ning’o okomosemia na komoteebereria?
swahili: Ni nani aliyeyafahamu mawazo ya Bwana, au kumfundisha akiwa kama mshauri wake?

english: Whom did He consult to enlighten Him, and who taught Him the paths of justice? Who imparted knowledge to Him and showed Him the way of understanding?
ekegusii: Ning’Omonene akoboria amosemie amang’ana buya? Ning’o omworokereretie oboeto bw’oboronge, na komworokia okomanya, gose komworokia enchera y’okomanya?
swahili: Ni nani ambaye Bwana ametaka shauri kwake ili kumwelimisha, naye ni nani aliyemfundisha njia iliyo sawa? Ni nani aliyemfundisha maarifa au kumwonyesha mapito ya ufahamu?

english: Surely the nations are like a drop in a bucket; they are considered a speck of dust on the scales; He lifts up the islands like fine dust.
ekegusii: Naama! Ebisaku nigo binga buna entonyi y’amaache egotonya korwa ase enyongo. Nigo bireng’anirie norotu orosinini rore ase esani ekorengera; rora, nigo akoimokia ebisinka buna orotu orosinini.
swahili: Hakika mataifa ni kama tone ndani ya ndoo, ni kama vumbi jembamba juu ya mizani, huvipima visiwa kana kwamba vilikuwa vumbi laini.

english: Lebanon is not sufficient for fuel, nor its animals enough for a burnt offering.
ekegusii: Emete ye rinani ria Lebanoni tegoisana ebe chinko chigouterwa omorero, ne ching’iti chionsi chireo tichigoisana chibe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosaambwa.
swahili: Lebanoni hautoshi kwa moto wa madhabahuni, wala wanyama wake hawatoshi kwa sadaka za kuteketezwa.

english: All the nations are as nothing before Him; He regards them as nothingness and emptiness.
ekegusii: Ebisaku bionsi nigo bire bosa ase obosio bwaye, nigo abibarete buna negento bosa, bitaisaini kende.
swahili: Mbele yake mataifa yote ni kama si kitu, yanaonekana yasio na thamani na zaidi ya bure kabisa.

english: To whom will you liken God? To what image will you compare Him?
ekegusii: Nyasae, ning’o moramoreng’anie, gose mogwekano ki moramoreng’anie?
swahili: Basi, utamlinganisha Mungu na nani? Utamlinganisha na kitu gani?

english: To an idol that a craftsman casts and a metalworker overlays with gold and fits with silver chains?
ekegusii: Omogwekano bw’ogosasimwa nigo okobombwa nomooroisia ebinto, erio omoturi oyooma netaabu, naende oyoroiseria ebinyuri bi’efeta.
swahili: Kwa habari ya sanamu, fundi huisubu, naye mfua dhahabu huifunika kwa dhahabu na kuitengenezea mikufu ya fedha.

english: “Speak tenderly to Jerusalem, and proclaim to her that her forced labor has been completed; her iniquity has been pardoned. For she has received from the hand of the LORD double for all her sins.”
ekegusii: Kwana amang’ana ’obwororo ase Yerusalemu, moyorarerie ng’a emechando yaye yaerire, na ebibe biaye biabeirwe, naende ng’a Yerusalemu onyorire okwaberwa ara kabere korwa ase okoboko kw’Omonene ase ebibe biaye bionsi.
swahili: Sema na Yerusalemu kwa upole, umtangazie kwamba kazi yake ngumu imekamilika, kwamba dhambi yake imefanyiwa fidia, kwamba amepokea kutoka mkononi mwa Bwana maradufu kwa ajili ya dhambi zake zote.

english: To one bereft of an offering who chooses wood that will not rot, who seeks a skilled craftsman to set up an idol that will not topple?
ekegusii: Omonto ore omotaka otabwati ebinge akorua nigo agochora omote otari kogunda, origia omooroisia omong’aini omanyete kobaacha, ere omobaachera omogwekano otari gosuka.
swahili: Mtu aliye maskini sana asiyeweza kuleta sadaka kama hii huuchagua mti usiooza. Humtafuta fundi stadi wa kusimamisha sanamu ambayo haitatikisika.

english: Do you not know? Have you not heard? Has it not been declared to you from the beginning? Have you not understood since the foundation of the earth?
ekegusii: Inee! Timwana komanya? Timwana koigwa? Timwana goteebigwa amang’ana ayio korwa omochakano? Timwana koyamanya korwa omochakano bw’oboroso bw’ense?
swahili: Je, hujui? Je, hujasikia? Je, hujaambiwa tangu mwanzo? Je, hujafahamu tangu kuumbwa kwa dunia?

english: He sits enthroned above the circle of the earth; its dwellers are like grasshoppers. He stretches out the heavens like a curtain, and spreads them out like a tent to dwell in.
ekegusii: Ere nere oikaransete ase orosingo rw’ense, na abamenyete ase ense nigo banga buna ebisase; nere okorambora igoro chionsi buna egetambaa gekoramborwa, ee, nigo agochirambora buna eema ekomenywa ekoramborwa.
swahili: Anakaa kwenye kiti cha enzi juu ya duara ya dunia, nao watu wakaao ndani yake ni kama panzi. Huzitandaza mbingu kama chandarua, na kuzitandaza kama hema la kuishi.

english: He brings the princes to nothing and makes the rulers of the earth meaningless.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo agokeyia abagaambi baba bosa, na abagaambi ebiina b’ense boigo baba bosa.
swahili: Huwafanya wakuu kuwa si kitu, na kuwashusha watawala wa dunia hii kuwa kitu bure.

english: No sooner are they planted, no sooner are they sown, no sooner have their stems taken root in the ground, than He blows on them and they wither, and a whirlwind sweeps them away like stubble.
ekegusii: Abwo nigo banga buna ebimeri bisimekire masomberera, bitaireti emeri inse. Omonene nigo akobaguseria embeo, boma, na omoubera noro obairurukia buna okoirurukia obonyansi obwomo.
swahili: Mara baada ya kupandwa, mara baada ya kutiwa ardhini, mara baada ya kutoa mizizi yao ardhini, ndipo huwapulizia nao wakanyauka, nao upepo wa kisulisuli huwapeperusha kama makapi.

english: “To whom will you liken Me, or who is My equal?” asks the Holy One.
ekegusii: Oyore Omochenu nigo akoboria iga: “Ning’o rende moranyare kondeng’ania, ng’a imbe buna oyio?”
swahili: “Utanilinganisha mimi na nani? Au ni nani anayelingana nami?” asema yeye Aliye Mtakatifu.

english: Lift up your eyes on high: Who created all these? He leads forth the starry host by number; He calls each one by name. Because of His great power and mighty strength, not one of them is missing.
ekegusii: Rigereria gochia igoro morore! Ning’o otongete ebinto ebio bionsi? Nere oria okoraa emeganda y’ebitongwa ebio ase omobaro obo, na koroka kera ekemo erieta riaye. Okobua kwaye nokonene mono, ne chinguru chiaye nigo chire nokobua, ase ayio kende tikeremeti nonya nekemo.
swahili: Inueni macho yenu mtazame mbinguni: Ni nani aliyeumba hivi vyote? Ni yeye aletaye nje jeshi la nyota moja baada ya nyingine na kuziita kila moja kwa jina lake. Kwa sababu ya uweza wake mkuu na nguvu zake kuu, hakuna hata mojawapo inayokosekana.

english: Why do you say, O Jacob, and why do you assert, O Israel, “My way is hidden from the LORD, and my claim is ignored by my God”?
ekegusii: Inwe abanto ba Yakobo, inwe Abaisraeli, nase ki mogoteeba ng’a Omonene taroochi chinchera chiaino, naende ng’a ere Nyasae obarinire oboronge bwaino?
swahili: Kwa nini unasema, ee Yakobo, nanyi ee Israeli, kulalamika, “Njia yangu imefichwa Bwana asiione, Mungu wangu hajali shauri langu?”

english: Do you not know? Have you not heard? The LORD is the everlasting God, the Creator of the ends of the earth. He will not grow tired or weary; His understanding is beyond searching out.
ekegusii: Inee! Timwana komanya gose koigwa, ng’a Omonene nigo are Nyasae o kare na kare, na Omotongi bwe chinsinyo chi’ense? Ere tari kogoya gose korosa. Obong’aini bwaye tibokorigigwa bomanyekane buna bore.
swahili: Je wewe, hufahamu? Je wewe, hujasikia? Bwana ni Mungu wa milele, Muumba wa miisho ya dunia. Hatachoka wala kulegea, wala hakuna hata mmoja awezaye kuupima ufahamu wake.

english: He gives power to the faint and increases the strength of the weak.
ekegusii: Ere nigo akoa omonto oyo ogoyire chinguru, na oyo otari na nguru nigo akomomentera chinguru.
swahili: Huwapa nguvu waliolegea na huongeza nguvu za wadhaifu.

english: A voice of one calling: “Prepare the way for the LORD in the wilderness; make a straight highway for our God in the desert.
ekegusii: Igwa eriogi ri’oyogoaka egeturi ogoteeba: “Roisia enchera y’Omonene ase erooro; rongeyia enchera enene ase Omonene, Nyasae oito, agwo ase erooro.
swahili: Sauti ya mtu aliaye: “Itengenezeni jangwani njia ya Bwana, nyoosheni njia kuu nyikani kwa ajili ya Mungu wetu.

english: Even youths grow tired and weary, and young men stumble and fall.
ekegusii: Abasae mbagoye na korosa, na abamura mbagochwe bagwe inse,
swahili: Hata vijana huchoka na kulegea, nao vijana wanaume hujikwaa na kuanguka,

english: But those who wait upon the LORD will renew their strength; they will mount up with wings like eagles; they will run and not grow weary, they will walk and not faint.
ekegusii: korende abwo baganyete na gosemeri’Omonene mbaegwe chinguru chinyia, mbairuruke gochia igoro ne chimbaaba buna echi’ebiongo; mbabe bakominyoka batari korosa, mbabe bagotaara batari kogoya.
swahili: bali wale wamtumainio Bwana atafanya upya nguvu zao. Watapaa juu kwa mbawa kama tai; watapiga mbio wala hawatachoka, watatembea kwa miguu wala hawatazimia.

english: Every valley shall be lifted up, and every mountain and hill made low; the uneven ground will become smooth, and the rugged land a plain.
ekegusii: Kera rigoko nditichwe rimokerere igoro, na kera egetunwa na ekegoro nabiiranigwe inse, aase atareng’aini nareng’anigwe, na aase are ebitunwa‐tunwa naaranigwe.
swahili: Kila bonde litainuliwa, kila mlima na kilima kitashushwa; penye mabonde patanyooshwa, napo palipoparuza patasawazishwa.

english: And the glory of the LORD will be revealed, and all humanity together will see it. For the mouth of the LORD has spoken.” The Enduring Word (1 Peter 1:22–25)
ekegusii: Obonene bw’Omonene mboorokigwe, na Mwanyabaanto bonsi mbaborore bare amo. Omonene nere okwanire amang’ana ayio.”
swahili: Utukufu wa Bwana utafunuliwa, nao wanadamu wote watauona pamoja. Kwa maana kinywa cha Bwana kimenena.”

english: A voice says, “Cry out!” And I asked, “What should I cry out?” “All flesh is like grass, and all its glory like the flowers of the field.
ekegusii: Eriogi rigoteeba, “Raria amang’ana!” Na erinde rikoboria, “Mang’ana ki nkoraria?” “Raria ng’a Mwanyabaanto bonsi nigo banga buna obonyansi, obuya bwabo bwonsi nigo bonga egesicha kere mogondo.
swahili: Sauti husema, “Piga kelele.” Nami nikasema, “Nipige kelele gani?” “Wanadamu wote ni kama majani, nao utukufu wao wote ni kama maua ya kondeni.

english: The grass withers and the flowers fall when the breath of the LORD blows on them; indeed, the people are grass.
ekegusii: Obonyansi nigo bokwoma, na ebisicha boigo, ekero Omonene abiuteire omoika oye; naboigo na Mwanyabaanto banga buna obonyansi.
swahili: Majani hunyauka na maua huanguka, kwa sababu pumzi ya Bwana huyapuliza. Hakika wanadamu ni majani.

english: The grass withers and the flowers fall, but the word of our God stands forever.” Here Is Your God! (Romans 11:33–36)
ekegusii: Ee, obonyansi nigo bokwoma, na ebisicha boigo, korende ring’ana ria Nyasae oito nigo rirabeo goika kare na kare.”
swahili: Majani hunyauka na maua huanguka, lakini neno la Mungu wetu ladumu milele.”

english: Go up on a high mountain, O Zion, herald of good news. Raise your voice loudly, O Jerusalem, herald of good news. Lift it up, do not be afraid! Say to the cities of Judah, “Here is your God!”
ekegusii: Aye Sayoni, omoraria bw’amang’ana amaya, tiira gochia ase ebitunwa ebitambe igoro. Aye Yerusalemu, omoraria bw’amang’ana amaya, aka eriogi riao ne chinguru; ee, aka eriogi mono, toiroka; teebiaemechie y’Abayuda iga: “Rora Nyasae oino!”
swahili: Wewe uletaye habari njema Sayuni, panda juu ya mlima mrefu. Wewe uletaye habari njema Yerusalemu, inua sauti yako kwa kupiga kelele, inua sauti, usiogope; iambie miji ya Yuda, “Yuko hapa Mungu wenu!”

english: “Be silent before Me, O islands, and let the peoples renew their strength. Let them come forward and testify; let us together draw near for judgment.
ekegusii: “Inwe ebisinka ne chinse chire ang’e nenyancha, mokire‐kiri, montegerere, tiga abanto b’ebisaku banyore chinguru chinyia, tiga basuke gocha ang’e, bakwane; toche amo, toike ang’e ase ekiina.
swahili: “Nyamazeni kimya mbele zangu, enyi visiwa! Mataifa na wafanye upya nguvu zao! Wao na wajitokeze, kisha waseme, tukutane pamoja mahali pa hukumu.

english: Do not fear, for I am with you; do not be afraid, for I am your God. I will strengthen you; I will surely help you; I will uphold you with My right hand of righteousness.
ekegusii: Ase ayio timoiroka, inche nigo inde amo nainwe, timoichana, inche ninche Nyasae oino; nimbabeeke chinguru, mbakonye, nimbasiire nokoboko gw’okorio kw’oboronge bwane.
swahili: Hivyo usiogope, kwa maana niko pamoja nawe; usifadhaike, kwa maana mimi ni Mungu wako. Nitakutia nguvu na kukusaidia; nitakutegemeza kwa mkono wa kuume wa haki yangu.

english: Behold, all who rage against you will be ashamed and disgraced; those who contend with you will be reduced to nothing and will perish.
ekegusii: “Rora, abwo bonsi baabagechete mbasookigwe na gotantanigwa; abwo bakobaengereria mbabe bosa basirigwe.
swahili: “Wote walioona hasira dhidi yako hakika wataaibika na kutahayarika, wale wakupingao watakuwa kama vile si kitu, na kuangamia.

english: You will seek them but will not find them. Those who wage war against you will come to nothing.
ekegusii: Nigo morabarigie abwo bakobasoera, ko timokobanyora; abwo baarenge kobarwania nigo barabe bosa kegima.
swahili: Ingawa utawatafuta adui zako, hutawaona. Wale wanaopigana vita dhidi yako watakuwa kama vile si kitu kabisa.

english: For I am the LORD your God, who takes hold of your right hand and tells you: Do not fear, I will help you.
ekegusii: Ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino, nimbabwate amaboko aino a borio. Ninche nkobateebia inwe: Timoiroka, nimbakonye.
swahili: Kwa maana Mimi ndimi Bwana, Mungu wako, nikushikaye mkono wako wa kuume na kukuambia, Usiwe na hofu, nitakusaidia.

english: Do not fear, O worm of Jacob, O few men of Israel. I will help you,” declares the LORD. “Your Redeemer is the Holy One of Israel.
ekegusii: “Inwe ororeeria rwa Yakobo ronga buna rikonde, inwe ekeombe egeke ki’Abaisraeli, timoiroka! Inche Omonene nimbakonye. Ninche Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli inde Omobooria oino.” Nab’Omonene atebiire.
swahili: Usiogope, ee Yakobo uliye mdudu, ee Israeli uliye mdogo, kwa kuwa Mimi mwenyewe nitakusaidia,” asema Bwana, Mkombozi wako, yeye Aliye Mtakatifu wa Israeli.

english: Behold, I will make you into a threshing sledge, new and sharp, with many teeth. You will thresh the mountains and crush them, and reduce the hills to chaff.
ekegusii: “Rora, nimbakore inwe mobe egekorero gi’okoora, kere ekiya na kere namaara amoge; inwe moore ebitunwa, mobisamunyore, imokore ebigoro bibe buna omoiriro.
swahili: “Tazama, nitakufanya chombo cha kupuria, kipya na chenye makali, chenye meno mengi. Utaipura milima na kuiponda na kuvifanya vilima kuwa kama makapi.

english: You will winnow them, and a wind will carry them away; a gale will scatter them. But you will rejoice in the LORD; you will glory in the Holy One of Israel.
ekegusii: Mobisiare, na omwaga obirurukie gochia aare, erio ekembugu‐mbugu kebisiarere. Inwe abanyene mogoke ase Omonene na komwetogeria oyore Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli.
swahili: Utaipepeta, nao upepo utaichukua, dhoruba itaipeperushia mbali. Bali wewe utajifurahisha katika Bwana na katika utukufu wa yeye Aliye Mtakatifu wa Israeli.

english: The poor and needy seek water, but there is none; their tongues are parched with thirst. I, the LORD, will answer them; I, the God of Israel, will not forsake them.
ekegusii: “Ekero abataka na abaremeire barabe bakorigia amaache na tibayanyora, ekero chimeme chiabo chirabe chiabwatanire namang’ang’ura; inche Omonene nimbaigwe, inche Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli tinkobatiga.
swahili: “Maskini na wahitaji wanatafuta maji, lakini hayapo, ndimi zao zimekauka kwa kiu. Lakini Mimi Bwana nitawajibu, Mimi, Mungu wa Israeli, sitawaacha.

english: I will open rivers on the barren heights, and fountains in the middle of the valleys. I will turn the desert into a pool of water, and the dry land into flowing springs.
ekegusii: Nindete chindooche korwa ase ebigoro ebiomo, ne chinsoko nchituboke ase amagoko ime; ning’onchore erooro ebe ritibo ri’amaache, na ense enyomo ebe ne chinsoko chire namaache.
swahili: Nitaifanya mito itiririke juu ya vilima vilivyo kame, nazo chemchemi ndani ya mabonde. Nitaligeuza jangwa liwe mabwawa ya maji, nayo ardhi iliyokauka kuwa chemchemi za maji.

english: I will plant cedars in the wilderness, acacias, myrtles, and olive trees. I will set cypresses in the desert, elms and boxwood together,
ekegusii: Nimerie emecharake ase erooro, boigo nimerie aroro emekonge, na emeadasi, na emezeituni. Ee, nimerie emetarakwa na emete
swahili: Katika jangwa nitaotesha mwerezi, mshita, mhadasi na mzeituni. Nitaweka misunobari, mivinje na misanduku pamoja huko nyikani,

english: Who has aroused one from the east and called him to his feet in righteousness? He hands nations over to him and subdues kings before him. He turns them to dust with his sword, to windblown chaff with his bow.
ekegusii: “Ning’o orangeretie n’oboronge oyomo korwa moocha, oria oumeranete nobobui aande onsi ase agendete? Ere nigo akobeeka abanto b’ebisaku inse y’okobua kwaye, erinde atachere abarwoti inse y’amagoro aye; oyio nigo agoita abanto b’ebisaku n’omoro, obakora baba buna orotu, na ase obota bwaye nigo akobasiarera buna obonyansi obwomo.
swahili: “Ni nani aliyemchochea mmoja kutoka mashariki, akimwita katika haki kwa utumishi wake? Huyatia mataifa mikononi mwake, na kuwatiisha wafalme mbele zake. Huwafanya kuwa mavumbi kwa upanga wake, huwafanya makapi yapeperushwayo na upepo kwa upinde wake.

english: so that all may see and know, may consider and understand, that the hand of the LORD has done this and the Holy One of Israel has created it.” Meaningless Idols
ekegusii: ende egwekaine emeuru, na emebeno amo, erinde abanto mbarore na komanya, naende mbaarengererie bamanye bonsi amo, ng’a nokoboko kw’Omonene gwakorire ayio, ee, ere oyore Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli nere otongete ebio bionsi.” Omonene okoamererania ne chinyasae chi’oborimo
swahili: ili kwamba watu wapate kuona na kujua, wapate kufikiri na kuelewa, kwamba mkono wa Bwana umetenda hili, kwamba yeye Aliye Mtakatifu wa Israeli ndiye alilifanya.”

english: “Present your case,” says the LORD. “Submit your arguments,” says the King of Jacob.
ekegusii: Omonene, Omorwoti bw’abaanto ba Yakobo, nigo agoteeba iga: Renta amang’ana aino, renta oborori bwaino botoenekerie.
swahili: Bwana asema, “Leta shauri lako. Toa hoja yako,” asema Mfalme wa Yakobo.

english: “Let them come and tell us what will happen. Tell the former things, so that we may reflect on them and know the outcome. Or announce to us what is coming.
ekegusii: Tiga baborente bototeebie aya agochia koba; tiga bototeebie amang’ana a kare buna arenge, erinde tonyare koyarengereria na komanya buna aikeranetigwe, naende botoorokerie buna amang’ana agochia koba.
swahili: “Leteni sanamu zenu zituambie ni nini kitakachotokea. Tuambieni mambo ya zamani yalikuwa nini, ili tupate kuyatafakari na kujua matokeo yake ya mwisho. Au tutangazieni mambo yatakayokuja,

english: Tell us the things that are to come, so that we may know that you are gods. Yes, do something good or evil, that we may look on together in dismay.
ekegusii: Toteebie aya agochi‐gocha, erinde tomanye ng’a inwe ne chinyasae; kora amang’ana amaya, gose amabe erinde tokorora ayio tokumie.
swahili: tuambieni ni nini kitakachotokea baadaye, ili tupate kujua kuwa ninyi ni miungu. Fanyeni jambo lolote zuri au baya, ili tupate kutishika na kujazwa na hofu.

english: Behold, you are nothing and your work is of no value. Anyone who chooses you is detestable.
ekegusii: Naama! Inwe nigo more bosa kegima, na emeremo yaino nero mbosa kegima; oyo obachorire inwe na kobasasiima nigo are okogechia.
swahili: Lakini ninyi ni zaidi ya bure kabisa, na kazi zenu hazifai kitu kabisa; yeye awachaguaye ni chukizo sana.

english: I have raised up one from the north, and he has come— one from the east who calls on My name. He will march over rulers as if they were mortar, like a potter who treads the clay.
ekegusii: “Inarangeretie omonto korwa sugusu, ere ochire; ee, nigo namorusirie korwa moocha, ere narangerie erieta riane akonywe, natiringere abagaambi inse buna esike egotiringwa, na buna omokori chinyongo agotiringa esike.
swahili: “Nimemchochea mtu mmoja kutoka kaskazini, naye yuaja, mmoja toka mawio ya jua aliitaye Jina langu. Huwakanyaga watawala kana kwamba ni matope, kama mfinyanzi akanyagavyo udongo wa kufinyangia.

english: Who has declared this from the beginning, so that we may know, and from times past, so that we may say: ‘He was right’? No one announced it, no one foretold it, no one heard your words.
ekegusii: Ning’o obaanete amang’ana ayio agwo kare, erinde tonyare komanya ng’a amang’ana oyio ateebete n’ayoboronge? Onde tari nonya noyomo oyaorogetie na koyararia; onde tari oigwete komokoyakwana.
swahili: Ni nani aliyenena hili tokea mwanzoni, ili tupate kujua, au kabla, ili tuweze kusema, ‘Alikuwa sawa’? Hakuna aliyenena hili, hakuna aliyetangulia kusema hili, hakuna yeyote aliyesikia maneno kutoka kwenu.

english: I was the first to tell Zion: ‘Look, here they are!’ And I gave to Jerusalem a herald of good news.
ekegusii: Ninche Omonene nigo narenge omotang’ani goteebia Sayoni: Rigereria, morore abwo! Ninche narenterete Yerusalemu abwo bararetie amang’ana amaya.
swahili: Nilikuwa wa kwanza kumwambia Sayuni, ‘Tazama, wako hapa!’ Nilimpa Yerusalemu mjumbe wa habari njema.

english: When I look, there is no one; there is no counselor among them; when I ask them, they have nothing to say.
ekegusii: Korende ekero narigereretie tinaroche monto onde, nonya nase egati yabo mosemia onde tarengeo; ekero naboretie, onde tarengeo ongiraneretie.
swahili: Ninatazama, lakini hakuna yeyote: hakuna yeyote miongoni mwao awezaye kutoa shauri, hakuna yeyote wa kutoa jibu wakati ninapowauliza.

english: See, they are all a delusion; their works amount to nothing; their images are as empty as the wind.
ekegusii: Naama! Chinyasae echio chionsi mbosa. Emeremo eyio y’abanto nigo ere bosa kegima, ee, emegwekano eyio abanto babombete nigo enga embeo bosa.”
swahili: Tazama, wote ni ubatili! Matendo yao ni bure; vinyago vyao ni upepo mtupu na machafuko.

english: He pursues them, going on safely, hardly touching the path with his feet.
ekegusii: Nigo akobabwatia, oeta na orendire buya, ase chinchera atana goeta rinde.
swahili: Huwafuatia na kuendelea salama, katika njia ambayo miguu yake haijawahi kupita.

english: Who has performed this and carried it out, calling forth the generations from the beginning? I, the LORD—the first and the last— I am He.”
ekegusii: Ning’o okorete na goikerania aya? Ning’o orangeretie ebiaare bi’abaanto korwa omochakano? Ninche Omonene, ninche oyo bw’omochakano; ninche oyo bw’omoerio, ninche Ere.”
swahili: Ni nani aliyefanya jambo hili na kulitimiliza, akiita vizazi tangu mwanzo? Mimi, Bwana, ni wa kwanza nami nitakuwa pamoja na wa mwisho: mimi Bwana ndiye.”

english: The islands see and fear; the ends of the earth tremble. They approach and come forward.
ekegusii: Ebisinka ne chinse chire ang’e nenyancha chiarorire ayio chiamwoboire, chinsinyo chi’ense nigo chigotengechigwa; chiasukire gocha ang’e.
swahili: Visiwa vimeliona na kuogopa, miisho ya dunia inatetemeka. Wanakaribia na kuja mbele,

english: Each one helps the other and says to his brother, “Be strong!”
ekegusii: Kera omonto nigo agokonya omogisangio oye; oyomo oteebiaoyonde, “Kabe omoremu!”
swahili: kila mmoja humsaidia mwingine na kusema kwa ndugu yake, “Uwe hodari!”

english: The craftsman encourages the goldsmith, and he who wields the hammer cheers him who strikes the anvil, saying of the welding, “It is good.” He nails it down so it will not be toppled.
ekegusii: Omosenia bwe chibao nigo akobeeka omoturi bw’etaabu omokia, na omoturi ebioma obeeka omoturagi chinguru, oteeba, “Oborembo bw’okobwatania nobuya.” Erio babwatania omogwekano nemesumari tonyegera.
swahili: Fundi humtia moyo sonara, yeye alainishaye kwa nyundo humhimiza yeye agongeaye kwenye fuawe, Humwambia yeye aunganishaye, “Ni kazi njema.” Naye huikaza sanamu kwa misumari ili isitikisike.

english: “But you, O Israel, My servant, Jacob, whom I have chosen, descendant of Abraham My friend—
ekegusii: “Korende inwe Abaisraeli, abasomba baane, inwe nabaanto ba Yakobo nachorete, inwe nigo more ab’ororeeria rwa Aburaamu, omosani one.
swahili: “Lakini wewe, ee Israeli, mtumishi wangu, Yakobo, niliyemchagua, ninyi wazao wa Abrahamu rafiki yangu,

english: I brought you from the ends of the earth and called you from its farthest corners. I said, ‘You are My servant.’ I have chosen and not rejected you.
ekegusii: Nigo nabarusetie korwa ase chinsinyo chi’ense, nkabarangeria korwa ase chinsinyo chi’aare mono, nkabateebia: Inwe nabasomba baane, nabachorire, timbaangeti.
swahili: nilikuchukua toka miisho ya dunia, nilikuita kutoka pembe zake za mbali. Nilisema, ‘Wewe ni mtumishi wangu’; nimekuchagua, wala sikukukataa.

english: “Here is My Servant, whom I uphold, My Chosen One, in whom My soul delights. I will put My Spirit on Him, and He will bring justice to the nations.
ekegusii: “Rora, omosomba one oyio inche nabekire chinguru ime yaye; omochore one omoyo one ogokirie nere. Namobekeire Omoika one, nere oraarente oboronge ase abanto b’ebisaku.
swahili: “Huyu hapa mtumishi wangu, ninayemtegemeza, mteule wangu, ambaye ninapendezwa naye; nitaweka Roho yangu juu yake, naye ataleta haki kwa mataifa.

english: Sing to the LORD a new song— His praise from the ends of the earth— you who go down to the sea, and all that is in it, you islands, and all who dwell in them.
ekegusii: Moterere Omonene ogoteera okoyia; motogie korwa ase chinsinyo chi’ense! Inwe abaeti ase enyancha amo n’ebinto bionsi bire imeo, inwe abamomenyete ase ebisinka na ase chinse chire ang’e nenyancha, motogie Omonene!
swahili: Mwimbieni Bwana wimbo mpya, sifa zake toka miisho ya dunia, ninyi mshukao chini baharini, na vyote vilivyomo ndani yake, enyi visiwa na wote wakaao ndani yake.

english: Let the desert and its cities raise their voices; let the villages of Kedar cry aloud. Let the people of Sela sing for joy; let them cry out from the mountaintops.
ekegusii: Tiga erooro na emechie ereo biake amariogi, na abamenyete ase emechie ya Kedari boigo. Abanto bamenyete ase omochie o Sela mbatere nomogooko, baake eriogi korwa ase ebichuria bi’ebitunwa igoro.
swahili: Jangwa na miji yake na vipaze sauti zao; makao anamoishi Kedari na yashangilie. Watu wa Sela waimbe kwa furaha, na wapige kelele kutoka vilele vya milima.

english: Let them give glory to the LORD and declare His praise in the islands.
ekegusii: Abwo bonsi batogie Omonene na koraria obonene bwaye ase ebisinka na ase chinse chire ang’e nenyancha.
swahili: Wampe Bwana utukufu, na kutangaza sifa zake katika visiwa.

english: The LORD goes forth like a mighty one; He stirs up His zeal like a warrior. He shouts; yes, He roars in triumph over His enemies:
ekegusii: Omonene naoroke buna etuoni y’esegi, na buna omorwani esegi abokie omokia oye; nigo agoaka eriogi ri’esegi na kwoga mono, nigo akweorokia ng’a nare nokobua igore y’ababisa baye. Nyasae okoria eira ng’a nakonye abanto baye
swahili: Bwana ataenda kama mtu mwenye nguvu, kama shujaa atachochea shauku yake, kwa kelele ataamsha kilio cha vita, naye atashinda adui zake.

english: “I have kept silent from ages past; I have remained quiet and restrained. But now I will groan like a woman in labor; I will at once gasp and pant.
ekegusii: Inche nabeire nkirete‐kiri ase engaki entambe, nabeire ngendererete gwetanga na gokira; korende bono ning’ake eriogi buna eri’omokuungu okobina aibore; ning’use omoika na goita egekoe.
swahili: “Kwa muda mrefu nimenyamaza kimya, nimekaa kimya na kujizuia. Lakini sasa, kama mwanamke wakati wa kujifungua, ninapiga kelele, ninatweta na kushusha pumzi.

english: I will lay waste the mountains and hills and dry up all their vegetation. I will turn the rivers into dry land and drain the marshes.
ekegusii: Ninsarie kegima ebitunwa na ebigoro, ninyomie ebimeri biabo bionsi; ning’onchore chindooche chibe ense enyomo, ninkamie amatibo.
swahili: Nitaharibu milima na vilima na kukausha mimea yako yote; nitafanya mito kuwa visiwa na kukausha mabwawa.

english: I will lead the blind by a way they did not know; I will guide them on unfamiliar paths. I will turn darkness into light before them and rough places into level ground. These things I will do for them, and I will not forsake them.
ekegusii: “Nindaae abanto bare emeuko ase enchera batana komanya, nimbatang’ane ase oboeto batana komanya. Ning’onchore omosunte ore bosio bwabo obe oborabu, aase atareng’aini naaranigwe. Ayio naro ndabakorere, tingotiga goikerania amang’ana aane.
swahili: Nitawaongoza vipofu kwenye njia ambayo hawajaijua, kwenye mapito wasiyoyazoea nitawaongoza; nitafanya giza kuwa nuru mbele yao, na kufanya mahali palipoparuza kuwa laini. Haya ndiyo mambo nitakayofanya; mimi sitawaacha.

english: But those who trust in idols and say to molten images, ‘You are our gods!’ will be turned back in utter shame. Israel Is Deaf and Blind
ekegusii: Korende abanto basemeretie emegwekano egosasimwa mbairanigwe magega, basookigwe, ekiagera nigo bagoteebia emegwekano eyio ebombire; Inwe ninwe chinyasae chiaito.” Abaisraeli bagosinywa kweorokereria
swahili: Lakini wale wanaotumaini sanamu, wanaoviambia vinyago, ‘Ninyi ndio miungu yetu,’ watarudishwa nyuma kwa aibu kubwa. Israeli Kipofu Na Kiziwi

english: Listen, you deaf ones; look, you blind ones, that you may see!
ekegusii: “Inwe abamore emetino, tegerera moigwe, nainwe abamore emeuko, rigereria monyare korora!
swahili: “Sikieni, enyi viziwi; tazameni, enyi vipofu, mpate kuona!

english: Who is blind but My servant, or deaf like the messenger I am sending? Who is blind like My covenant partner, or blind like the servant of the LORD?
ekegusii: Ning’o ore omouko otatiga omosomba one? Ning’o ore omotino buna omonto one natomire? Ning’o ore omouko buna omwegenwa one, gose buna omosomba one inche Omonene?
swahili: Ni nani aliye kipofu isipokuwa mtumishi wangu, na kiziwi kama mjumbe ninayemtuma? Ni nani aliye kipofu kama yeye aliyejitoa kwangu, aliye kipofu kama mtumishi wa Bwana?

english: He will not cry out or raise His voice, nor make His voice heard in the streets.
ekegusii: Ere takorera, gose tagoaka eriogi rinene, gose takoritiga riigugwe ase chinchera.
swahili: Hatapaza sauti wala kupiga kelele, wala hataiinua sauti yake barabarani.

english: Though seeing many things, you do not keep watch. Though your ears are open, you do not hear.”
ekegusii: Omosomba one nigo akorora ebinto ebinge, korende tari kobirengereria ng’a nebi’engencho enene; nigo atinogete amato aye, korende tari koigwa.”
swahili: Mmeona vitu vingi, lakini hamkuzingatia; masikio yenu yako wazi, lakini hamsikii chochote.”

english: The LORD was pleased, for the sake of His righteousness, to magnify His law and make it glorious.
ekegusii: Ase engencho y’oboronge bwaye Omonene nigo agogete koa amachiiko aye okobua na ogosikwa.
swahili: Ilimpendeza Bwana kwa ajili ya haki yake kufanya sheria yake kuwa kuu na tukufu.

english: But this is a people plundered and looted, all trapped in caves or imprisoned in dungeons. They have become plunder with no one to rescue them, and loot with no one to say, “Send them back!”
ekegusii: Korende abanto aba baibirwe na gosakorwa, bonsi bategirwe na kogwa ase chiirima; nigo babisire ase chinyomba chi’obosibwa; bairirwe, onde tari orabatoorie, boosirwe, onde tari ogoteeba: “Tiga bairanigwe.”
swahili: Lakini hili ni taifa lililoibwa na kutekwa nyara, wote wamenaswa katika mashimo, au wamefichwa katika magereza. Wamekuwa nyara, wala hapana yeyote awaokoaye. Wamefanywa mateka, wala hapana yeyote asemaye, “Warudishe.”

english: Who among you will pay attention to this? Who will listen and obey hereafter?
ekegusii: Ning’o ase more oranyare gotegerera amang’ana aya, erio ayarengererie na koyaigwera ase chingaki chigochi‐gocha.
swahili: Ni nani miongoni mwenu atakayesikiliza hili, au atakayezingatia kwa makini katika wakati ujao?

english: Who gave Jacob up for spoil, and Israel to the plunderers? Was it not the LORD, against whom we have sinned? They were unwilling to walk in His ways, and they would not obey His law.
ekegusii: Ning’o oruete abanto b’ororeeria rwa Yakobo ase amaboko ’abasakori? Ning’o oruete Abaisraeli ase amaboko ’abauri? Inee! Tari Omonene oria twakorete ebibe asare? Tokaanga kobwatia chinchera chiaye, naende tokaanga koigwera amachiiko aye.
swahili: Ni nani aliyemtoa Yakobo kuwa mateka, na Israeli kwa wateka nyara? Je, hakuwa yeye, Bwana, ambaye tumetenda dhambi dhidi yake? Kwa kuwa hawakufuata njia zake, hawakutii sheria zake.

english: So He poured out on them His furious anger and the fierceness of battle. It enveloped them in flames, but they did not understand; it consumed them, but they did not take it to heart.
ekegusii: Ase ayio Omonene akaumora ekeririanda kiaye ase abanto, akabaumorera endamwamu yaye ekobera, na esegi entindi. Abanto bakaba bagosambwa nomorero ase chinsemo chionsi, ko tibamanyete kende, ee, omorero oria okabasamba, korende tibaarengereretie ayio ime ase chinkoro chiabo.
swahili: Hivyo akawamwagia hasira yake inayowaka, ukali wa vita. Iliwazunguka kwa miali ya moto, lakini hata hivyo hawakuelewa; iliwateketeza, lakini hawakuyatia moyoni.

english: A bruised reed He will not break and a smoldering wick He will not extinguish; He will faithfully bring forth justice.
ekegusii: Egetonto giatachetwe tagokebuna, gose orotambe rw’etaya rokoimoka erioki takororimia. Ase obwegenwa bwaye narente oboronge.
swahili: Mwanzi uliopondeka hatauvunja, na utambi unaofuka moshi hatauzima. Kwa uaminifu ataleta haki,

english: He will not grow weak or discouraged before He has established justice on the earth. In His law the islands will put their hope.”
ekegusii: Ere takorosa gose gokwa omoyo; goika abe orentire oboronge ase ense na kobokong’ia, na ebisinka, ne chinse chire ang’e nenyancha nchibe chiganyete amachiiko aye.”
swahili: hatazimia roho wala kukata tamaa, mpaka atakaposimamisha haki juu ya dunia. Visiwa vitaweka tumaini lao katika sheria yake.”

english: This is what God the LORD says— He who created the heavens and stretched them out, who spread out the earth and its offspring, who gives breath to the people on it and life to those who walk in it:
ekegusii: Nyasae, oyotongete igoro chionsi na gochirambora, oyo bwarete ense na bionsi ebikorwao, oyo oete abanto bareo obogima, na kobaa omoika abwo bagotaara aroro, nigo agoteeba iga:
swahili: Hili ndilo asemalo Mungu, Bwana, yeye aliyeziumba mbingu na kuzitanda, aliyeitandaza dunia na vyote vitokavyo humo, awapaye watu wake pumzi, na uzima kwa wale waendao humo:

english: “I, the LORD, have called you for a righteous purpose, and I will take hold of your hand. I will keep you and appoint you to be a covenant for the people and a light to the nations,
ekegusii: “Inche ninche Omonene, nakorangeirie ase oboronge; nakobwatire okoboko kwao nkorendete. Goetera asore ninkore okobwatana kw’ogotianania nabaanto, obe omobaso bw’abaanto b’ebisaku.
swahili: “Mimi, Bwana, nimekuita katika haki; nitakushika mkono wako. Nitakulinda na kukufanya kuwa Agano kwa ajili ya watu na nuru kwa Mataifa,

english: to open the eyes of the blind, to bring prisoners out of the dungeon and those sitting in darkness out from the prison house.
ekegusii: Oramokie amaiso ’emeuko, osibore abasibwa korwa ase echela, na abwo bamenyete ase omosunte korwa ase obosibwa bwabo.
swahili: kuwafungua macho wale wasioona, kuwaacha huru kutoka kifungoni waliofungwa jela, na kuwafungua kutoka gerezani wale wanaokaa gizani.

english: I am the LORD; that is My name! I will not yield My glory to another or My praise to idols.
ekegusii: “Inche ninche Omonene, erio nario erieta riane; tindi koa omonto onde obonene bwane; tinkoa emegwekano egosasimwa ogotogigwa kwane.
swahili: “Mimi ndimi Bwana; hilo ndilo Jina langu! Sitampa mwingine utukufu wangu wala sanamu sifa zangu.

english: Behold, the former things have happened, and now I declare new things. Before they spring forth I proclaim them to you.” A New Song of Praise (Psalms 98:1–9; Psalms 149:1–9)
ekegusii: Rora, amang’ana nateebete agwo kare aikeranire, na bono nigo nkobaraareria amang’ana amayia, nkobayamanyia atarakorekana.” Ogoteera kw’ogotogia
swahili: Tazama, mambo ya kwanza yametokea, nami natangaza mambo mapya; kabla hayajatokea nawatangazia habari zake.” Wimbo Wa Kumsifu Bwana

english: Now this is what the LORD says— He who created you, O Jacob, and He who formed you, O Israel: “Do not fear, for I have redeemed you; I have called you by your name; you are Mine!
ekegusii: Inwe abanto b’ororeeria rwa Yakobo, inwe Abaisraeli, aya nar’Omonene oria obatongete na kobabomba agoteeba; “Timoiroka, ekiagera inche nababooririe; nabarangeirie ase amarieta aino; inwe nabaane.
swahili: Lakini sasa hili ndilo asemalo Bwana, yeye aliyekuumba, ee Yakobo, yeye aliyekuhuluku, ee Israeli: “Usiogope kwa maana nimekukomboa, nimekuita wewe kwa jina lako, wewe u wangu.

english: “You are My witnesses,” declares the LORD, “and My servant whom I have chosen, so that you may consider and believe Me and understand that I am He. Before Me no god was formed, and after Me none will come.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: “Inwe nigo more birori baane, abasomba baane nachorire, erinde monyare komanya inche na konyegena, naende momanye ng’a inche ninche Ere. Enyasae ende teri yantang’anerete, ende teri erabombwe magega yane.
swahili: “Ninyi ni mashahidi wangu,” asema Bwana, “na mtumishi wangu niliyemchagua, ili mpate kunijua na kuniamini, na kutambua kwamba Mimi ndiye. Kabla yangu hakuna mungu aliyefanyizwa, wala hatakuwepo mwingine baada yangu.

english: I, yes I, am the LORD, and there is no Savior but Me.
ekegusii: Inche ninche Omonene, ninche bweka inde Omotooria, naende onde tari.
swahili: Mimi, naam mimi, ndimi Bwana, zaidi yangu hakuna mwokozi.

english: I alone decreed and saved and proclaimed— I, and not some foreign god among you. So you are My witnesses,” declares the LORD, “that I am God.
ekegusii: Nigo narentete ogotooreka, nkabarareria ayio, nainwe mokayaigwa, na enyasae engeni tiyarenge ase egati yaino; inwe nigo more birori baane ng’a inche ninche Nyasae.” Naboigo Omonene atebiire.
swahili: Nimedhihirisha, kuokoa na kutangaza: Mimi, wala si mungu mgeni katikati yenu. Ninyi ni mashahidi wangu,” asema Bwana, “kwamba Mimi ndimi Mungu.

english: Even from eternity I am He, and none can deliver out of My hand. When I act, who can reverse it?” A Way in the Wilderness
ekegusii: Ee, inche ninche Nyasae; nigo ngendererete koba oyio oyio. Omonto tari oranyare gotooria omonto onde korwa ase okoboko kwane, nigo ngokora emeremo, na onde tari oranyare koyetanga. Ogotoorigwa korwa Babiloni
swahili: Naam, tangu siku za kale, Mimi ndiye. Hakuna hata mmoja awezaye kuokoa kutoka mkononi wangu. Mimi ninapotenda, ni nani awezaye kutangua?” Huruma Za Mungu, Na Kukosa Uaminifu Kwa Israeli

english: Thus says the LORD your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel: “For your sake, I will send to Babylon and bring them all as fugitives, even the Chaldeans, in the ships in which they rejoice.
ekegusii: Aya nar’Omonene, Omobooria oino oyore Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli, agoteeba: “Ase engencho yaino nintome abasikari gochia Babiloni baserie abanto b’aroro, erinde batame; ee, Abakalidayo abwo baserigwe gochia ase chimeeri chiabo echio bagokerete.
swahili: Hili ndilo Bwana asemalo, Mkombozi wako, yeye Aliye Mtakatifu wa Israeli: “Kwa ajili yenu nitatumana Babeli na kuwaleta Wakaldayo wote kama wakimbizi, katika meli walizozionea fahari.

english: I am the LORD, your Holy One, the Creator of Israel, and your King.”
ekegusii: Inche ninche Omonene, Omochenu oino, ninche omotongi oino inwe Abaisraeli, ninche inde omorwoti oino.”
swahili: Mimi ndimi Bwana, yeye Aliye Mtakatifu wako, Muumba wa Israeli, Mfalme wako.”

english: Thus says the LORD, who makes a way in the sea and a path through the surging waters,
ekegusii: Omonene oroisetie enchera ase enyancha ime, ee, oboeto ase amaache amange are ne chinguru,
swahili: Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana, yeye aliyefanya njia baharini, mahali pa kupita kwenye maji mengi,

english: who brings out the chariots and horses, the armies and warriors together, to lie down, never to rise again; to be extinguished, snuffed out like a wick:
ekegusii: akarenta aroro chigari chi’esegi ne chibarasi, na abasikari amo ne chituoni chiabo, erio akabaiyeria inse, tibatenena naende; nigo basiretigwe bakarima buna orotambe rw’etaya. Aya nar’Omonene oyio agoteeba:
swahili: aliyeyakokota magari ya vita na farasi, jeshi pamoja na askari wa msaada, nao wakalala huko, wala hawatainuka tena kamwe, wakakomeshwa, na wakazimika kama utambi:

english: “Do not call to mind the former things; pay no attention to the things of old.
ekegusii: Timobaisa koinyora amang’ana a kare, gose korengereria igoro y’ebinto biaetire.
swahili: “Msiyakumbuke mambo yaliyopita, wala msiyatafakari mambo ya zamani.

english: Behold, I am about to do something new; even now it is coming. Do you not see it? Indeed, I will make a way in the wilderness and streams in the desert.
ekegusii: Naama! Ninkore ring’ana riyia; ring’ana erio riachakire kooroka; Inee! Timorirochi? Nindoisie enchera ase erooro, nintubokie chindooche ase ense enyomo,
swahili: Tazama, nitafanya jambo jipya! Sasa litachipuka, je, hamtalitambua? Nitafanya njia jangwani na vijito vya maji katika nchi kame.

english: When you pass through the waters, I will be with you; and when you go through the rivers, they will not overwhelm you. When you walk through the fire, you will not be scorched; the flames will not set you ablaze.
ekegusii: Ekero morabe mogoeta ase amaache ime, nimbe amo nainwe; namoba mogoeta ase chindooche, tichikobamera. Namoete ase omorero, timogosambwa, gose omorero ekebemberi tokobasiria.
swahili: Unapopita kwenye maji makuu, nitakuwa pamoja nawe, unapopita katika mito ya maji, hayatakugharikisha. Utakapopita katika moto, hutaungua, miali ya moto haitakuunguza.

english: The beasts of the field will honor Me, the jackals and the ostriches, because I provide water in the wilderness and rivers in the desert, to give drink to My chosen people.
ekegusii: erinde ching’iti chi’orosana amo nebibwe ne chisagero chinywe chintogie. Ekero ekio nintubokie amaache ase erooro, ne chindooche ase ense enyomo, ng’ee abanto baane, abwo nachorire, amaache banywe,
swahili: Wanyama wa mwituni wataniheshimu, mbweha na bundi, kwa sababu ninawapatia maji jangwani, na vijito katika nchi kame, ili kuwapa watu wangu maji, wale niliowachagua,

english: The people I formed for Myself will declare My praise. Israel’s Unfaithfulness (Judges 2:10–15; Jeremiah 2:23–37)
ekegusii: abanto abwo netongeire, erinde bararie ogotogigwa kwane. Ebibe bi’Abaisraeli
swahili: watu wale niliowaumba kwa ajili yangu, ili wapate kutangaza sifa zangu.

english: But you have not called on Me, O Jacob, because you have grown weary of Me, O Israel.
ekegusii: Inwe abanto b’ororeeria rwa Yakobo, timwandangeretie, ee, inwe Abaisraeli, timwanyechanderete.
swahili: “Hata hivyo hukuniita mimi, ee Yakobo, hujajitaabisha kwa ajili yangu, ee Israeli.

english: You have not brought Me sheep for burnt offerings, nor honored Me with your sacrifices. I have not burdened you with offerings, nor wearied you with frankincense.
ekegusii: Inwe timwandeterete ching’ondi chiaino chibe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosaambwa, gose timwansigete ase okonduera ebing’wanso biaino. Inche timbaroseti ase okonduera okoruegwa kw’endagera, gose timbachandeti ase ogonsambera ubani.
swahili: Hujaniletea kondoo kwa ajili ya sadaka za kuteketezwa, wala kuniheshimu kwa dhabihu zako. Sikukulemea kwa sadaka za nafaka wala kukuchosha kwa kuhitaji uvumba.

english: You have not bought Me sweet cane with your silver, nor satisfied Me with the fat of your sacrifices. But you have burdened Me with your sins; you have wearied Me with your iniquities.
ekegusii: Timwangorerete ebinto bigotioka buya ne chitaabu chiaino. Timwang’isanegetie nebitinya bi’ebing’wanso biaino. Taibo! Korende nigo mwandosirie nebibe biaino; mwanchandire nogosaria kwaino.
swahili: Hukuninunulia uvumba wowote wenye manukato, wala hukunipa kwa ukarimu mafuta ya wanyama wa dhabihu zako. Lakini umenilemea kwa dhambi zako, na kunitaabisha kwa makosa yako.

english: I, yes I, am He who blots out your transgressions for My own sake and remembers your sins no more.
ekegusii: Inche ninche bweka ngotinyia ogosaria kwao, ase engencho yane inche omonyene, na tinkoinyora ebibe biao.
swahili: “Mimi, naam mimi, ndimi nizifutaye dhambi zako, kwa ajili yangu mwenyewe, wala sizikumbuki dhambi zako tena.

english: Remind Me, let us argue the matter together. State your case, so that you may be vindicated.
ekegusii: Ong’inyorie, tokwane komo, aye na inche; okwane amang’ana ao, erinde onyore oboronge bwao.
swahili: Tafakari mambo yaliyopita, njoo na tuhojiane, leta shauri lako uweze kupewa haki yako.

english: Your first father sinned, and your spokesmen rebelled against Me.
ekegusii: Sokoro yao bw’eritang’ani nigo akorete ebibe, na abaarenge abakwani b’amang’ana ao bagasaria ase ’nde,
swahili: Baba yako wa kwanza alitenda dhambi, wasemaji wako wameasi dhidi yangu.

english: So I will disgrace the princes of your sanctuary, and I will devote Jacob to destruction and Israel to reproach.”
ekegusii: Ase ayio ngatiga abanene b’Aase Achenu bakaba abatachenegeti, nkarua abanto ba Yakobo bakaba okoragererigwa, ee, nkarua Abaisraeli ase ogochaywa.
swahili: Kwa hiyo nitawaaibisha wakuu wa Hekalu lako, nami nitamtoa Yakobo aangamizwe, na Israeli adhihakiwe.

english: For I am the LORD your God, the Holy One of Israel, your Savior; I give Egypt for your ransom, Cush and Seba in your place.
ekegusii: Inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino, ninche Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli, ninche Omotooria oino. Nigo naruete Abamisiri bakaba embooria ase engencho yaino, nkarua Abaetiopia na Abaseba ribaga riaino.
swahili: Kwa kuwa Mimi ndimi Bwana, Mungu wako, yeye Aliye Mtakatifu wa Israeli, Mwokozi wako. Ninaitoa Misri kuwa fidia yako, Kushi na Seba badala yako.

english: Because you are precious and honored in My sight, and because I love you, I will give men in exchange for you and nations in place of your life.
ekegusii: Inwe nigo more ab’engencho enene ase amaiso aane, mwabeire mosikire, nainche nigo mbanchete; ase ayio nindue abanto b’ebisaku basirigwe ribaga riaino, erinde obogima bwaino botoorigwe.
swahili: Kwa kuwa wewe ni wa thamani na wa kuheshimiwa machoni pangu, nami kwa kuwa ninakupenda, nitatoa watu badala yako na mataifa badala ya maisha yako.

english: Do not be afraid, for I am with you; I will bring your offspring from the east and gather you from the west.
ekegusii: Ase ayio, timoiroka, inche nigo inde amo nainwe. “Nindete abanto b’ororeeria rwaino korwa moocha, na korwa bosongo nimbasangererie.
swahili: Usiogope, kwa kuwa mimi nipo pamoja nawe, nitawaleta watoto wako kutoka mashariki, na kukukusanya kutoka magharibi.

english: I will say to the north, ‘Give them up!’ and to the south, ‘Do not hold them back!’ Bring My sons from afar, and My daughters from the ends of the earth—
ekegusii: Nintebie chinse chia sugusu: Tiga abanto baane barue agwo, ne chinse chia Irianyi: Timobatanga! Renta abamura baane korwa aare, na abaiseke baane korwa ase chinsinyo chi’ense.
swahili: Nitaiambia kaskazini, ‘Watoe!’ nayo kusini, ‘Usiwazuie.’ Walete wana wangu kutoka mbali, na binti zangu kutoka miisho ya dunia:

english: everyone called by My name and created for My glory, whom I have indeed formed and made.”
ekegusii: Kera omonto okorokwa ase erieta riane, oyio inche natongete anyore obonene bwane, kera oyomo oyio inche nabombete na komotonga, tiga ache.” Abaisraeli nigo bare birori ba Omonene
swahili: kila mmoja ambaye ameitwa kwa Jina langu, niliyemuumba kwa utukufu wangu, niliyemhuluku na kumfanya.”

english: Bring out a people who have eyes but are blind, and who have ears but are deaf.
ekegusii: Renta abanto bonsi bare emeuko nonya babwate amaiso, na abare emetino nonya babwate amato.
swahili: Uwaongoze wale wenye macho lakini hawaoni, wenye masikio lakini hawasikii.

english: All the nations gather together and the peoples assemble. Who among them can declare this, and proclaim to us the former things? Let them present their witnesses to vindicate them, so that others may hear and say, “It is true.”
ekegusii: Tiga abanto b’ebisaku bionsi bache amo, ee, tiga abanto bonsi basangererekane bache. Ning’o ore ase egati yabo oranyare koraria amang’ana aya? Ning’o oranyare gotworokia amang’ana ayabeete kare? Tiga barente birori biabo, erinde baorokie oboronge bwabo, na ekero baraigwe bateebe: “Nekeene mogoteeba.”
swahili: Mataifa yote yanakutanika pamoja, na makabila yanakusanyika. Ni nani miongoni mwao aliyetangulia kutuambia haya, na kututangazia mambo yaliyopita? Walete mashahidi wao ili kuwathibitisha kuwa walikuwa sahihi, ili wengine waweze kusikia, waseme, “Ni kweli.”

english: But now listen, O Jacob My servant, Israel, whom I have chosen.
ekegusii: “Aye Yakobo, omosomba one, aye Israeli nagochorire, bono igwa!
swahili: “Lakini sasa sikiliza, ee Yakobo, mtumishi wangu, Israeli, niliyemchagua.

english: Who fashions a god or casts an idol which profits him nothing?
ekegusii: Ning’o okwebaachera enyasae na kwebombera ogosasimwa bitari gokonya nonyang’ake?
swahili: Ni nani atengenezaye mungu na kusubu sanamu, ambayo haiwezi kumfaidia kitu chochote?

english: Behold, all his companions will be put to shame, for the craftsmen themselves are only human. Let them all assemble and take their stand; they will all be brought to terror and shame.
ekegusii: Naama! Abatunyani bonsi b’emegwekano eyio mbasookigwe, na abakoyeroisia nigo bare Mwanyabaanto. Abwo bonsi tiga basangererekane amo, bache bosio; bonsi amo nigo baraondoke, basooke.
swahili: Yeye pamoja na wenziwe wa aina yake wataaibishwa, mafundi wao si kitu ila ni wanadamu tu. Wote wakusanyike pamoja na kuwa na msimamo wao, watashushwa chini kwa hofu na kwa fedheha.

english: The blacksmith takes a tool and labors over the coals; he fashions an idol with hammers and forges it with his strong arms. Yet he grows hungry and loses his strength; he fails to drink water and grows faint.
ekegusii: Omoturi ebioma nigo akobogoria enturago yaye otura ekioma. Nigo agokebeeka igoro ase omorero bw’amakara, ogesamba, erio okebomba ase ogokebaraga nokoboko kwaye kore ne chinguru. Ekero agendererete koroisia omogwekano oyio, nigo akoba nenchara na erang’o ogoya.
swahili: Muhunzi huchukua kifaa na kukifanyia kazi kwenye makaa ya moto, hutengeneza sanamu kwa nyundo, huifanyiza kwa nguvu za mkono wake. Huona njaa na kupoteza nguvu zake, asipokunywa maji huzimia.

english: The woodworker extends a measuring line; he marks it out with a stylus; he shapes it with chisels and outlines it with a compass. He fashions it in the likeness of man, like man in all his glory, that it may dwell in a shrine.
ekegusii: Omosenia chibao nigo akorambora ekerengo, bwata omong’ororia nekaramu ase ebao. Erio oyesenia neranda, oyeng’ororia ekeringerera, naende oyebaacha yaba omogwekano bw’omonto omonyakieni, oyobeeka nyomba ime.
swahili: Seremala hupima kwa kutumia kamba na huuchora mstari kwa kalamu; huchonga kwa patasi na kutia alama kwa bikari. Huifanyiza katika umbo la binadamu, la mwanadamu katika utukufu wake wote, ili iweze kukaa katika sehemu yake ya ibada ya miungu.

english: He cuts down cedars or retrieves a cypress or oak. He lets it grow strong among the trees of the forest. He plants a laurel, and the rain makes it grow.
ekegusii: Omonto nigo akogenda ase rinani ogecha emecharake, gose bwechorera Emealuni, oyetiga egokina agwo ase rinani, gose bwesimekera omobunduki, embura yaba ekoyokinia.
swahili: Hukata miti ya mierezi, huchukua mtiriza au mwaloni. Huuacha ukue miongoni mwa miti ya msituni, au hupanda msunobari, nayo mvua huufanya ukue.

english: It serves as fuel for man. He takes some of it to warm himself, and he kindles a fire and bakes his bread; he even fashions it into a god and worships it; he makes an idol and bows down to it.
ekegusii: Omote oria gokinire nigo okoba chinko chi’omonto oria; ere nigo akonyonacha ekeng’ese outera omorero agwota na korugera endagera, na ekeng’ese kende okebacha kiaba enyasae agosasiima, nigo gekoba omogwekano ere oba okoyosasiima.
swahili: Ni kuni ya binadamu: yeye huchukua baadhi yake na kuota moto, huwasha moto na kuoka mkate. Lakini pia huutumia kumtengeneza mungu na akamwabudu, huitengeneza sanamu na kuisujudia.

english: He burns half of it in the fire, and he roasts meat on that half. He eats the roast and is satisfied. Indeed, he warms himself and says, “Ah! I am warm; I see the fire.”
ekegusii: Ase ekeng’ese kende omonto oria nigo agoutera omorero, osambera chinyama, ochiria na koigota, na ekero autire omorero oria nigo agoteeba, “Ee, bono nabeire ne riberera; omorero oyo nomuya!”
swahili: Sehemu ya kuni huziweka motoni, akapikia chakula chake, hubanika nyama na kula hadi ashibe. Huota moto na kusema, “Aha! Ninahisi joto, ninaona moto.”

english: From the rest he makes a god, his graven image. He bows down to it and worships; he prays to it and says, “Save me, for you are my god.”
ekegusii: Ekeng’ese egetigari ki’omote oria nigo agokebaacha ogekora enyasae, omogwekano agosasiima; nigo agotungama bosio bwaye oyosasiima oteeba, “Ntoorie, ekiagera naye enyasae yane!”
swahili: Mabaki yake hutengeneza mungu, sanamu yake; yeye huisujudia na kuiabudu. Huiomba na kusema, “Niokoe; wewe ni mungu wangu.”

english: They do not comprehend or discern, for He has shut their eyes so they cannot see and closed their minds so they cannot understand.
ekegusii: Abanto bagokora ayio nabariri, tibamanyeti kende. Amaiso abo aukoire, tibakonyara korora, na ebirengererio biabo biasarigwe, tibakonyara komanya.
swahili: Hawajui chochote, hawaelewi chochote, macho yao yamefungwa hata hawawezi kuona, akili zao zimefungwa hata hawawezi kufahamu.

english: And no one considers in his heart, no one has the knowledge or insight to say, “I burned half of it in the fire, and I baked bread on its coals; I roasted meat and I ate. Shall I make something detestable with the rest of it? Shall I bow down to a block of wood?”
ekegusii: Monto onde tari ase abwo okorengereria mono, gose ore nobong’aini na okomanya erinde ateebe: “Ekeng’ese ki’omote oyio nageutera omorero, nkayorugera endagera, boigo nkayosambera chinyama nkaria. Inee! Korwa ase ekio egetigari ningekore egento gi’okogechia? Ningekore enyasae ngosasiima, eroisirie korwa ase omote?”
swahili: Hakuna anayefikiri, hakuna mwenye maarifa wala ufahamu wa kusema, “Sehemu yake nilitumia kwa kuni; hata pia nilioka mkate juu ya makaa yake, nikabanika nyama na kuila. Je, nifanye machukizo kwa kile kilichobaki? Je, nisujudie gogo la mti?”

english: This is the word of the LORD, your Maker, who formed you from the womb and who will help you: “Do not be afraid, O Jacob My servant, Jeshurun, whom I have chosen.
ekegusii: Omonene, oria ogotongete ase enda ya nyoko, naende okogokonya, nigo agoteeba iga: Aye Yakobo, omosomba one, aye Yerusalemu, omochore one, toiroka.
swahili: Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana, yeye aliyekuhuluku, aliyekuumba tumboni, yeye atakayekusaidia: Usiogope, ee Yakobo, mtumishi wangu, Yeshuruni, niliyekuchagua.

english: He feeds on ashes. His deluded heart has led him astray, and he cannot deliver himself or say, “Is not this thing in my right hand a lie?” Jerusalem to Be Restored
ekegusii: Oyio nigo asemeretie ayare buna ribu; enkoro yaye yang’ainekire, yamosiririe, takonyara gwetooria na goteeba, “Egento eke mbwate koboko kwane gw’okorio neki’oborimo.” Omonene nere Omotongi na Omotooria
swahili: Hujilisha kwa majivu, moyo uliodanganyika humpotosha; hawezi kujiokoa mwenyewe, au kusema, “Je, kitu hiki kilichoko katika mkono wangu wa kuume si ni uongo?”

english: Remember these things, O Jacob, for you are My servant, O Israel. I have made you, and you are My servant; O Israel, I will never forget you.
ekegusii: “Inwe abanto ba Yakobo, inwe Abaisraeli, inyora amang’ana aya, ekiagera inwe nabasomba baane. Inwe Abaisraeli, tinkobeeba.
