ekegusii: Ekiagera Damesiki noro omochie omonene bw’Abasiiria, na Resini nere omogambi o Damesiki; na ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo etano nomo, na etano, Abaefraimu mbasenyentwe basirigwe kegima, tibagenderera koba egesaku.
swahili: kwa kuwa kichwa cha Aramu ni Dameski, na kichwa cha Dameski ni Resini peke yake. Katika muda wa miaka sitini na mitano, Efraimu atakuwa ameharibiwa kiasi kwamba hataweza tena kuwa taifa.

english: The head of Ephraim is Samaria, and the head of Samaria is the son of Remaliah. If you do not stand firm in your faith, then you will not stand at all.’” The Sign of Immanuel (Matthew 1:18–25)
ekegusii: Samaria noro omochie omonene bw’Abaefraimu, na mosinto o Remalia nere omogambi o Samaria. “Onye timori nokwegena timokogenderera kobao.” Ekemanyererio igoro ya Imanueli
swahili: Kichwa cha Efraimu ni Samaria, na kichwa cha Samaria ni mwana wa Remalia peke yake. Kama hamtasimama thabiti katika imani yenu, hamtaimarika kamwe.’ ”

english: Then the LORD said to me, “Take a large scroll and write on it with an ordinary stylus: Maher-shalal-hash-baz.
ekegusii: Omonene aganteebia, “Imokia ebao enene ekorikwa, orike amariko aya Mwanyabaanto baranyare gosoma buya, orike: Maheri‐Salali Hasi‐Basi.”
swahili: Bwana akaniambia, “Chukua gombo kubwa, uandike juu yake kwa kalamu ya kawaida jina: Maher-Shalal-Hash-Bazi.

english: Devise a plan, but it will be thwarted; state a proposal, but it will not happen. For God is with us. ” A Call to Fear God (Ecclesiastes 8:10–13)
ekegusii: Inchuo amo mosemanie, korende nigo korabe bosa; kwana ring’ana riaino, korende tirikoba, ekiagera Nyasae nigo are amo naintwe. Omonene ogokuurera omobani oria
swahili: Wekeni mikakati yenu, lakini itashindwa; fanyeni mipango yenu, lakini haitafanikiwa, kwa maana Mungu yu pamoja nasi. Mwogope Mungu

english: For this is what the LORD has spoken to me with a strong hand, instructing me not to walk in the way of this people:
ekegusii: Omonene akabeeka igoro ase ’nde okoboko kwaye kore ne chinguru, agakwana nainche, agankurera ng’a timbaisa kobwatia chinchera chi’abaanto aba, agateeba,
swahili: Bwana alisema nami mkono wake wenye nguvu ukiwa juu yangu, akinionya nisifuate njia za taifa hili. Akasema:

english: “Do not call conspiracy everything these people regard as conspiracy. Do not fear what they fear; do not live in dread.
ekegusii: “Timobaisa koroka emeroberio ng’a nemebe, eyio abanto aba bakoroka ng’a nemebe, gose timobaisa kwoboa amang’ana boboete, gose kende tikebaondokia inwe.
swahili: “Usiite fitina kila kitu ambacho watu hawa hukiita fitina, usiogope kile wanachokiogopa, wala usikihofu.

english: The LORD of Hosts is the One you shall regard as holy. Only He should be feared; only He should be dreaded.
ekegusii: Korende inwe tiga inche Omonene bw’Emeganda imbe nchenegete ase more; ninche bweka morairoke na konyoboa.
swahili: Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote ndiye peke yake ikupasaye kumheshimu kuwa mtakatifu, ndiye peke yake utakayemwogopa, ndiye peke yake utakayemhofu,

english: And He will be a sanctuary— but to both houses of Israel a stone of stumbling and a rock of offense, to the dwellers of Jerusalem a trap and a snare.
ekegusii: Ere nabe aase aino aachenu, korende ase ebisaku ebi bibere bi’Abaisraeli nabe rigena rikogocha, na egetare gekoiyeria inse, naende abe omoeto na oboreba ase abanto bamenyete Yerusalemu.
swahili: naye atakuwa mahali patakatifu; lakini kwa nyumba zote mbili za Israeli atakuwa jiwe lile linalosababisha watu kujikwaa na mwamba wa kuwaangusha. Kwa watu wa Yerusalemu, atakuwa mtego na tanzi.

english: Many will stumble over these; they will fall and be broken; they will be ensnared and captured.”
ekegusii: Abanto abange mbagochwe na kogwa, mbasenyentwe, mbategwe na kobwatwa.” Ogokuurerwa kw’ogotarigia ogosemigwa korwa ase abakuure
swahili: Wengi wao watajikwaa; wataanguka na kuvunjika, watategwa na kunaswa.”

english: Bind up the testimony and seal the law among my disciples.
ekegusii: Eboeranie oborori, na obeke amachiiko aane ekemanyererio, ime ase chinkoro chi’aborokigwa baane.
swahili: Funga ushuhuda na kutia muhuri sheria miongoni mwa wanafunzi wangu.

english: I will wait for the LORD, who is hiding His face from the house of Jacob. I will put my trust in Him.
ekegusii: Nimoganyete Omonene, oyio otubire obosio bwaye korwa ase ororeeria rwa Yakobo; nimbe imosemeretie.
swahili: Nitamngojea Bwana, ambaye ameificha nyumba ya Yakobo uso wake. Nitaliweka tumaini langu kwake.

english: Here am I, and the children the LORD has given me as signs and symbols in Israel from the LORD of Hosts, who dwells on Mount Zion. Darkness and Light
ekegusii: Naama! Inche amo nabana aba Omonene ang’eire nigo tore ebimanyererio na emegwekano ase egati y’Abaisraeli, ebio bikorwa ase Omonene bw’Emeganda, oyio omenyete ase Egetunwa gia Sayoni.
swahili: Niko hapa, pamoja na watoto ambao Bwana amenipa. Sisi ni ishara na mfano wake katika Israeli, kutoka kwa Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, anayeishi juu ya Mlima Sayuni.

english: When men tell you to consult the spirits of the dead and the spiritists who whisper and mutter, shouldn’t a people consult their God instead? Why consult the dead on behalf of the living?
ekegusii: Ekero abanto barabateebie: “Genda moboorie abwo bakorigia ogosemigwa korwa ase emeika y’abanto bakuure, naende moboorie abaragori, abwo bakomonyererana na okong’ung’ura,” inwe mobairanerie iga: “Inee! Tegwenereti abanto komorigia Nyasae obo? Naki eraabe ng’a toboorie emeika y’abakuure ase engencho y’abanto bare moyo?”
swahili: Wakati watu wanapowaambia ninyi kutafuta ushauri kwa waaguzi na wenye kuongea na mizimu, ambao hunongʼona na kunungʼunika, je, watu wasingeuliza kwa Mungu wao? Kwa nini watake shauri kwa wafu kwa ajili ya walio hai?

english: And I will appoint for Myself trustworthy witnesses—Uriah the priest and Zechariah son of Jeberekiah.”
ekegusii: Inche nkerigeria abanto abegenwa babe birori, nabwo Uria Omokuani, na Zakaria, mosinto o Yeberekia.
swahili: Nami nitawaita kuhani Uria, na Zekaria mwana wa Yeberekia kama mashahidi wangu waaminifu.”

english: To the law and to the testimony! If they do not speak according to this word, they have no light of dawn.
ekegusii: Moiranere amachiiko na oborori! Abanto batari gokwana koreng’ana namang’ana ayio, ekeene, omobaso o mambia torabaabarera. Engaki y’emechando
swahili: Kwa sheria na kwa ushuhuda! Kama hawatasema sawasawa na neno hili, hawana mwanga wa mapambazuko.

english: They will roam the land, dejected and hungry. When they are famished, they will become enraged; and looking upward, they will curse their king and their God.
ekegusii: Abanto mbaetanane ase ense yonsi, bare nemechando emenene mono, na enchara, na ekero babeire nenchara mbabe nekeririanda ekenene, baragererie omorwoti obo na Nyasae obo. Mbaonchore amasio abo barigererie gochia igoro,
swahili: Watazunguka katika nchi yote, wakiwa na dhiki na njaa. Watakapotaabika kwa njaa, watapatwa na hasira kali, nao, wakiwa wanatazama juu, watamlaani mfalme wao na Mungu wao.

english: Then they will look to the earth and see only distress and darkness and the gloom of anguish. And they will be driven into utter darkness.
ekegusii: naende baonchoke barigererie ense inse, korende nigo bararore obororo, na omosunte, na ogoichanigwa okonene, erio basoigwe ase omosunte ekerima.
swahili: Kisha wataangalia duniani na kuona tu dhiki na giza, hofu na huzuni tupu, nao watasukumiwa kwenye giza nene kabisa.

english: And I had relations with the prophetess, and she conceived and gave birth to a son. The LORD said to me, “Name him Maher-shalal-hash-baz.
ekegusii: Erio nkaba nomokuungu one orenge omobani, na ere akaba morito, akaibora omwana omoisia, n’Omonene aganteebia, “Moroke Maheri‐Salali Hasi‐Basi.
swahili: Kisha nikaenda kwa nabii mke, naye akapata mimba, akazaa mwana. Kisha Bwana akaniambia, “Mwite huyo mtoto Maher-Shalal-Hash-Bazi.

english: For before the boy knows how to cry ‘Father’ or ‘Mother,’ the wealth of Damascus and the plunder of Samaria will be carried off by the king of Assyria.”
ekegusii: Nebe ekero omwana oyio ataramanya gwatora Tata gose Baba, nonyore ng’a obotenenku bwonsi bwa Damesiki, na ebisakorwa bia Samaria, biaikire koirwa ase omorwoti bw’Abaasuri.” Omorwoti bw’Abaasuri ogocha
swahili: Kabla mtoto hajaweza kusema ‘Baba yangu’ au ‘Mama yangu,’ utajiri wa Dameski na nyara za Samaria zitachukuliwa na mfalme wa Ashuru.”

english: And the LORD spoke to me further:
ekegusii: Omonene agakwana eria kabere, aganteebia,
swahili: Bwana akasema nami tena:

english: “Because this people has rejected the gently flowing waters of Shiloah and rejoiced in Rezin and the son of Remaliah,
ekegusii: “Abanto aba bangire amaache a Silo akwongora ng’ora, bagokire na kobwatana na Resini, naende na mosinto o Remalia.
swahili: “Kwa sababu watu hawa wamekataa maji ya Shilo yatiririkayo taratibu wakamfurahia Resini na mwana wa Remalia,

english: the Lord will surely bring against them the mighty floodwaters of the Euphrates — the king of Assyria and all his pomp. It will overflow its channels and overrun its banks.
ekegusii: Ase ayio, rora inche Omonene nkorenta inde igoro y’abanto abwo amaache ’orooche are amange, naende are ne chinguru, ayio naro omorwoti bw’Abaasuri amo nobonene bwaye bwonsi. Amache ayio naichore aete chingegu igoro, aiteke gochia aande onsi.
swahili: kwa hiyo Bwana yu karibu kuleta dhidi yao mafuriko makubwa ya Mto: yaani mfalme wa Ashuru na fahari yake yote. Yatafurika juu ya mifereji yake yote, yatamwagikia juu ya kingo zake zote,

english: It will pour into Judah, swirling and sweeping over it, reaching up to the neck; its spreading streams will cover your entire land, O Immanuel!
ekegusii: Aro naminyoke ne chinguru igoro y’ense y’Abayuda, aichore, agenderere gochia bosio aike ase rigoti.” Ee, aye Imanueli, amaache ayio nigo ararambore chimbaaba chiaye atube obogare bw’ense yao.
swahili: na kufika hadi Yuda, yakizunguka kwa kasi juu yake, yakipita katikati na yakifika hadi shingoni. Mabawa yake yaliyokunjuliwa yatafunika upana wa nchi yako, Ee Imanueli!”

english: Huddle together, O peoples, and be shattered; pay attention, all you distant lands; prepare for battle, and be shattered; prepare for battle, and be shattered!
ekegusii: Inwe abanto aba, kora eburu‐buru, nonya naboigo goika mosenyentwe! Ee, inwe mwensi abamore ase chinse chi’aare, igwa ayio! Eboyie mokong’e, goika mosenyentwe! Ee, eboyie goika mosenyentwe!
swahili: Inueni kilio cha vita, enyi mataifa, na mkavunjwevunjwe! Sikilizeni, enyi nyote nchi za mbali. Jiandaeni kwa vita, nanyi mkavunjwevunjwe! Jiandaeni kwa vita, nanyi mkavunjwevunjwe!

english: Nevertheless, there will be no more gloom for those in distress. In the past He humbled the land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali, but in the future He will honor the Way of the Sea, beyond the Jordan, Galilee of the nations:
ekegusii: Omosunte tokogenderera koba ase ogochandeka kore bono. Amatuko a kare Omonene nigo atigete ense ya Sabuloni, na eya Nafutali, na chirochio chigachaywa, korende ase amatuko agochi‐gocha narente obonene bw’ogosikwa ase ense ere ang’e nenchera ekogenda ase enyancha, ng’umbu ya Yorodani, nero Galili, ense y’abanto b’ebisaku.
swahili: Hata hivyo, hapatakuwepo huzuni tena kwa wale waliokuwa katika dhiki. Wakati uliopita aliidhili nchi ya Zabuloni na nchi ya Naftali, lakini katika siku zijazo ataiheshimu Galilaya ya Mataifa, karibu na njia ya bahari, kando ya Yordani:

english: “The bricks have fallen, but we will rebuild with finished stone; the sycamores have been felled, but we will replace them with cedars.”
ekegusii: “Amaagacho ’amatabori agure inse, korende nigo torayaagache namagena abaachire. Emeko yagechirwe, korende ntosimeke emecharake ribaga ri’eyio.”
swahili: “Matofali yameanguka chini, lakini tutajenga tena kwa mawe yaliyochongwa, mitini imeangushwa, lakini tutapanda mierezi badala yake.”

english: The LORD has raised up the foes of Rezin against him and joined his enemies together.
ekegusii: Omonene oseegetire na korenta ababisa ba Resini bache kobarwania.
swahili: Lakini Bwana amemtia nguvu adui wa Resini dhidi yao na kuchochea watesi wao.

english: Aram from the east and Philistia from the west have devoured Israel with open mouths. Despite all this, His anger is not turned away; His hand is still upraised. Judgment against Israel’s Hypocrisy
ekegusii: Abasiiria bamenyete moocha, na Abafirisiti bamenyete bosongo, baasamirie emenwa yabo bamere Abaisraeli. Nonya ayio are bo, Omonene taratiga endamwamu yaye; nigo agendererete korambora okoboko kwaye kobaa egesusuro.
swahili: Waashuru kutoka upande wa mashariki na Wafilisti kutoka upande wa magharibi wameila Israeli kwa kinywa kilichopanuliwa. Hata kwa haya yote, hasira yake haijageukia mbali, mkono wake bado umeinuliwa juu.

english: But the people did not return to Him who struck them; they did not seek the LORD of Hosts.
ekegusii: Abanto tibamoiranerete oria obaete egesusuro, gose tibamorigetie Omonene bw’Emeganda.
swahili: Lakini watu hawajamrudia yeye aliyewapiga, wala hawajamtafuta Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote.

english: So the LORD will cut off Israel’s head and tail, both palm branch and reed in a single day.
ekegusii: Ase ayio ase rituko erimo rioka Omonene nanache omotwe bw’Abaisraeli na ekemincha, boigo nanache orosagia rw’omokendo na esaka.
swahili: Kwa hiyo Bwana atakatilia mbali kutoka Israeli kichwa na mkia, tawi la mtende na tete katika siku moja.

english: The head is the elder and honorable man, and the tail is the prophet who teaches lies.
ekegusii: Omogaka bw’amasikani nere omotwe, na omobani okworokereria oborimo nere ekemincha.
swahili: Wazee na watu mashuhuri ndio vichwa, nao manabii wanaofundisha uongo ndio mkia.

english: For those who guide this people mislead them, and those they mislead are swallowed up.
ekegusii: Abwo bakoraa abanto aba baabasirie, na abwo bakoraagwa nabaanto abwo mbasirigwe.
swahili: Wale wanaowaongoza watu hawa wanawapotosha, nao wale wanaoongozwa wamepotoka.

english: Therefore the Lord takes no pleasure in their young men; He has no compassion on their fatherless and widows. For every one of them is godless and wicked, and every mouth speaks folly. Despite all this, His anger is not turned away; His hand is still upraised. Judgment against Israel’s Unrepentance
ekegusii: Ase ayio Omonene tari nomogooko ase abasae babo, na tari namaabera ase chintakana na ababoraka babo, ekiagera kera omonto nomosaria ase Nyasae, na omokori amabe, na kera oyomo nigo agokwana ay’oboriri. Ase engencho y’ayio onsi Omonene taratiga endamwamu yaye; nigo agendererete korambora okoboko kwaye kobaa egesusuro.
swahili: Kwa hiyo Bwana hatawafurahia vijana, wala hatawahurumia yatima na wajane, kwa kuwa kila mmoja wao hamchi Mungu, nao ni waovu, na kila kinywa kinanena upotovu. Hata kwa haya yote, hasira yake haijageukia mbali, mkono wake bado umeinuliwa juu.

english: For wickedness burns like a fire that consumes the thorns and briers and kindles the forest thickets which roll upward in billows of smoke.
ekegusii: Obobe nigo bogosamba buna omorero; noro nigo ogosamba amageri na amagwa, nigo ogosamba rinani rinoru, riaerera ase erioki richongororogete gochia igoro.
swahili: Hakika uovu huwaka kama moto; huteketeza michongoma na miiba, huwasha moto vichaka vya msituni, hujiviringisha kuelekea juu kama nguzo ya moshi.

english: By the wrath of the LORD of Hosts the land is scorched, and the people are fuel for the fire. No man even spares his brother.
ekegusii: Endamwamu y’Omonene bw’Emeganda yasambire ense; abanto nigo banga buna chinko chigwokia omorero, na monto onde takororera oyomwabo amaabera.
swahili: Kwa hasira ya Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote nchi itachomwa kwa moto, nao watu watakuwa kuni za kuchochea moto. Hakuna mtu atakayemhurumia ndugu yake.

english: The people walking in darkness have seen a great light; on those living in the land of the shadow of death, a light has dawned.
ekegusii: Abanto abwo baarenge gotaara ase omosunte, bono barorire omobaso omonene; abwo bamenyete ase ense y’ekiriri ki’amakweri omobaso obabareire.
swahili: Watu wanaotembea katika giza wameona nuru kuu, wale wanaoishi katika nchi ya uvuli wa mauti, nuru imewazukia.

english: They carve out what is on the right, but they are still hungry; they eat what is on the left, but they are still not satisfied. Each one devours the flesh of his own offspring.
ekegusii: Abanto abwo nigo bakona‐gotaboria ebinto ase ensemo ya borio, korende nigo bagendererete koba nenchara; nigo bakwenyorera ebinto korwa ase ensemo ya bomosi, korende tibari koigota. Kera oyomo nigo akoria chinyama chi’omobere bw’oyomwabo.
swahili: Upande wa kuume watakuwa wakitafuna, lakini bado wataona njaa; upande wa kushoto watakuwa wakila, lakini hawatashiba. Kila mmoja atajilisha kwa nyama ya mtoto wake mwenyewe:

english: Manasseh devours Ephraim, and Ephraim Manasseh; together they turn against Judah. Despite all this, His anger is not turned away; His hand is still upraised.
ekegusii: Abanto ba Manase mbarie abaefraimu, na abaefraimu mbarie Abamanase, na abwo amo mbaonchokere Abayuda. Ase engencho y’ayi’Omonene taratiga endamwamu yaye; nigo agendererete korambora okoboko kwaye kobaa egesusuro.
swahili: Manase atamla Efraimu, naye Efraimu atamla Manase; nao pamoja watakuwa kinyume na Yuda. Hata kwa haya yote, hasira yake haijageukia mbali, mkono wake bado umeinuliwa juu.

english: You have enlarged the nation and increased its joy. The people rejoice before You as they rejoice at harvest time, as men rejoice in dividing the plunder.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene gwasesenirie egesaku, na kerokio kiabuchire, kwarure omogooko, na oro obeire omonge; abanto abwo nigo bare nomochengo ase obosio bwao, buna abanto bakoba nomochengo ase engaki ye rigesa, na buna bakogoka ekero bagwatanana ebisakorwa.
swahili: Umelikuza taifa, na kuzidisha furaha yao, wanafurahia mbele zako, kama watu wanavyofurahia wakati wa mavuno, kama watu wafurahivyo wagawanyapo nyara.

english: For as in the day of Midian You have shattered the yoke of their burden, the bar across their shoulders, and the rod of their oppressor.
ekegusii: Aye kwabunire rikorogoto riarenge ririto ase bare, kwabunire enyimbo eria yarenge goaka amareko abo, enyimbo eyio yarenge ey’abachandi babo, buna gwakorete ase engaki y’Abamidiani.
swahili: Kama vile siku ya kushindwa kwa Wamidiani, umevunja nira iliyowalemea, ile gongo mabegani mwao na fimbo yake yeye aliyewaonea.

english: For every trampling boot of battle and every garment rolled in blood will be burned as fuel for the fire.
ekegusii: Ebikoroto bi’abasikari bagotitiria aase esegi, ne chianga chionsi chiaakirwe amanyinga, ebio bionsi mbisambwe nomorero.
swahili: Kila kiatu cha askari kilichotumiwa vitani, na kila vazi lililovingirishwa katika damu vitawekwa kwa ajili ya kuchomwa, vitakuwa kuni za kuwasha moto.

english: For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given, and the government will be upon His shoulders. And He will be called Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace.
ekegusii: Omwana oiboirwe ase engencho yaito, intwe twaeirwe omwana omomura; obogaambi mbobe ase amareko aye, ere nigo ararokwe: “Omosemia bw’Ogokumia, Nyasae bw’Okobua, Tata o Kare na Kare, Omogambi bw’omorembe.”
swahili: Kwa maana, kwa ajili yetu mtoto amezaliwa, tumepewa mtoto mwanaume, nao utawala utakuwa mabegani mwake. Naye ataitwa Mshauri wa Ajabu, Mungu Mwenye Nguvu, Baba wa Milele, Mfalme wa Amani.

english: Of the increase of His government and peace there will be no end. He will reign on the throne of David and over his kingdom, to establish and sustain it with justice and righteousness from that time and forevermore. The zeal of the LORD of Hosts will accomplish this. Judgment against Israel’s Pride
ekegusii: Obogaambi bwaye nigo borabe obonene, na omorembe oye tokoba nomoerio igoro ase ekerogo ki’obonene gia Daudi na ase oborwoti bwaye. Obwo nigo borakong’igwe ase ekeene na oboronge, korwa bono na goika kare na kare. Risemi ri’Omonene bw’Emeganda ndikore amang’ana ayio. Omonene nae Abaisraeli egesusuro
swahili: Kuongezeka kwa utawala wake na amani hakutakuwa na mwisho. Atatawala katika kiti cha enzi cha Daudi na juu ya ufalme wake, akiuthibitisha na kuutegemeza kwa haki na kwa adili, tangu wakati huo na hata milele. Wivu wa Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote utatimiza haya. Hasira Ya Bwana Dhidi Ya Israeli

english: The Lord has sent a message against Jacob, and it has fallen upon Israel.
ekegusii: Omonene otomire ring’ana kogambia ororeeria rwa Yakobo, narirorio ndibaikere Abaisraeli.
swahili: Bwana ametuma ujumbe dhidi ya Yakobo, utamwangukia Israeli.

english: All the people will know it— Ephraim and the dwellers of Samaria. With pride and arrogance of heart they will say:
ekegusii: Abanto bonsi mbarimanye, nonya nabamenyete ase ense y’Abaefraimu, na ey’Abasamaria, abwo bagokwana noboenenu na obomwenu bwe chinkoro, bateeba,
swahili: Watu wote watajua hili: Efraimu na wakazi wa Samaria, wanaosema kwa kiburi na majivuno ya mioyo,

english: James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, To the twelve tribes of the Dispersion: Greetings. Rejoicing in Trials (Philippians 1:12–20)
ekegusii: Korwa ase Yakobo, omosomba o Nyasae na Omonene Yeso Kristo, nabakwanirie inwe abanto ba Nyasae, abamwatananekire gochia chinse chire ao ao. Okwegena na obong’aini
swahili: Yakobo, mtumwa wa Mungu na wa Bwana Yesu Kristo: Kwa makabila kumi na mawili yaliyotawanyika ulimwenguni: Salamu. Imani Na Hekima

english: But the one who is rich should exult in his low position, because he will pass away like a flower of the field.
ekegusii: na abakristo abanda, nabarabwo bagoke kobairanigwe inse, ekiagera nigo barasire buna egesicha ki’obonyansi.
swahili: Lakini yeye aliye tajiri afurahi kwa kuwa ameshushwa, kwa sababu atatoweka kama ua la shambani.

english: For the sun rises with scorching heat and withers the plant; its flower falls and its beauty is lost. So too, the rich man will fade away in the midst of his pursuits.
ekegusii: Naki erioba korikooroka nomobaso omoororo, nigo rigosamba na kwomia obonyansi. Egesicha ki’obonyansi kiaroroka, na obuya bw’ekieni kiaye bwasira. Naboigo nomonda nere arasire kagendererete kwerigeria. Gotema na gotemwa
swahili: Kwa maana jua kali lenye kuchoma huchomoza na kuliunguza, likayakausha majani, na ua lake likapukutika, nao uzuri wake huharibika. Vivyo hivyo tajiri naye atanyauka akiwa anaendelea na shughuli zake. Kujaribiwa

english: Blessed is the man who perseveres under trial, because when he has stood the test, he will receive the crown of life that God has promised to those who love Him. Good and Perfect Gifts
ekegusii: Nasesenirie omonto oria oremereretie ogoteemwa, ekiagera ekero aikire gwancherwa nanyore obogima buna egutwa y’obobui, obogima obwo Nyasae abarierete eira abwo bamwanchete.
swahili: Heri mtu anayevumilia wakati wa majaribu, kwa sababu akiisha kushinda hilo jaribio atapewa taji la uzima Mungu alilowaahidia wale wampendao.

english: When tempted, no one should say, “God is tempting me.” For God cannot be tempted by evil, nor does He tempt anyone.
ekegusii: Omonto karateemwe, tateeba “Nateemirwe na Nyasae” ekiagera Nyasae tagoteemwa namabe, gose tagoteema omonto.
swahili: Mtu anapojaribiwa asiseme, “Ninajaribiwa na Mungu.” Kwa maana Mungu hawezi kujaribiwa na maovu wala yeye hamjaribu mtu yeyote.

english: But each one is tempted when by his own evil desires he is lured away and enticed.
ekegusii: Korende kera omonto nigo agoteemwa ekero akong’uswa na kong’ainwa nokogania kwaye omonyene.
swahili: Lakini kila mtu hujaribiwa wakati anapovutwa na kudanganywa na tamaa zake mwenyewe zilizo mbaya.

english: Then after desire has conceived, it gives birth to sin; and sin, when it is full-grown, gives birth to death.
ekegusii: Na okogania koria okobe gokwabogoirie oborito kwaibora ebibe, na ebibe biria kobiakiinire, biarenta amakweri.
swahili: Basi ile tamaa mbaya ikishachukua mimba, huzaa dhambi, nayo ile dhambi ikikomaa, huzaa mauti.

english: Do not be deceived, my beloved brothers.
ekegusii: Abaminto abanchani, timong’aineka.
swahili: Ndugu zangu wapendwa, msidanganyike.

english: Every good and perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of the heavenly lights, with whom there is no change or shifting shadow.
ekegusii: Kera ekerugwa ekiya, na kera ekeegwa geikeranete nigo gekorwa ase Ise bw’emebaso. Asare koonchoka tikoiyo, gose ekiriri kende gekooncha‐onchoka.
swahili: Kila kitolewacho kilicho chema na kilicho kamili, hutoka juu, na hushuka kutoka kwa Baba wa mianga, ambaye kwake hakuna kubadilika, wala kivuli cha kugeukageuka.

english: He chose to give us birth through the word of truth, that we would be a kind of firstfruits of His creation. Hearing and Doing
ekegusii: Ase ogwancha kwaye ere omonyene agatoibora ase ring’ana riaye ri’ekeene, erinde tobe buna ogotongorwa konde kw’ebitongwa biaye. Okoigwa ring’ana na korikora
swahili: Kwa mapenzi yake mwenyewe alituzaa kwa neno la kweli, kusudi tuwe kama mazao ya kwanza katika viumbe vyake vyote. Kusikia Na Kutenda

english: My beloved brothers, understand this: Everyone should be quick to listen, slow to speak, and slow to anger,
ekegusii: Abaminto abanchani, momanye ring’ana eri: Kera omonto abe omwango ase okoigwa, korende abe bwe ng’ora ase ogokwana, na bwe ng’ora ase okoba nendamwamu,
swahili: Ndugu zangu wapendwa, fahamuni jambo hili: Kila mtu awe mwepesi wa kusikiliza, lakini asiwe mwepesi wa kusema wala wa kukasirika.

english: Consider it pure joy, my brothers, when you encounter trials of many kinds,
ekegusii: Abaminto, bara ng’a nomogooko bwoka komorasoe ase amateemwa are ao ao,
swahili: Ndugu zangu, hesabuni kuwa ni furaha tupu mnapopatwa na majaribu mbalimbali,

english: for man’s anger does not bring about the righteousness that God desires.
ekegusii: ekiagera endamwamu ya Mwanyabaanto teri gokora ayare boronge ase obosio bwa Nyasae.
swahili: Kwa maana hasira ya mwanadamu haitendi haki ya Mungu.

english: Therefore, get rid of all moral filth and every expression of evil, and humbly accept the word planted in you, which can save your souls.
ekegusii: Ase ayio, beka aare ogotacheneka gwonsi, na obonge bw’amabe, na ase obwororo mwanche ring’ana erio riasimekirwe ime yaino, eriranyare kobatooria.
swahili: Kwa hiyo, ondoleeni mbali uchafu wote na uovu ambao umezidi kuwa mwingi, mkalipokee kwa unyenyekevu lile Neno lililopandwa ndani yenu ambalo laweza kuokoa nafsi zenu.

english: Be doers of the word, and not hearers only. Otherwise, you are deceiving yourselves.
ekegusii: Timweng’aina inwe abanyene ase okoigwa ring’ana riaye rioka, korende ribeeke ase ebikorwa.
swahili: Basi kuweni watendaji wa Neno wala msiwe wasikiaji tu, huku mkijidanganya nafsi zenu.

english: For anyone who hears the word but does not carry it out is like a man who looks at his face in a mirror,
ekegusii: Naki omonto karabe omotegereri bw’ering’ana, gose tari omorikori, oyio nigo anga buna omonto oyokwerigereria obosio bwaye omonyene ase ekerore.
swahili: Kwa maana kama mtu ni msikiaji tu wa Neno wala hatendi kile linachosema, yeye ni kama mtu ajitazamaye uso wake kwenye kioo

english: and after observing himself goes away and immediately forgets what he looks like.
ekegusii: Igo akwerigereria, naende ogenda ase agochia, erio kegima bweba buna erora arenge.
swahili: na baada ya kujiona alivyo, huenda zake na mara husahau jinsi alivyo.

english: But the one who looks intently into the perfect law of freedom, and continues to do so—not being a forgetful hearer, but an effective doer—he will be blessed in what he does.
ekegusii: Korende oyorigereretie amachiiko amaikeranu ay’obosibore, na goikaransa aroro, na taba oyokoigwa na kweba, korende abe omokori okoyakora, oyio nabe oyosesenirie ase ogokora kwaye.
swahili: Lakini yeye anayeangalia kwa bidii katika sheria kamilifu, ile iletayo uhuru, naye akaendelea kufanya hivyo bila kusahau alichosikia, bali akalitenda, atabarikiwa katika kile anachofanya.

english: If anyone considers himself religious and yet does not bridle his tongue, he deceives his heart and his religion is worthless.
ekegusii: Omonto karekage ng’a nkomokorera are Nyasae, na ere tagambereti oromeme rwaye, korende nenkoro yaye akong’aina, igo okomokorera Nyasae kwaye nigo kore okwa bosa.
swahili: Kama mtu akidhani ya kuwa anayo dini lakini hauzuii ulimi wake kwa hatamu, hujidanganya moyoni mwake, wala dini yake mtu huyo haifai kitu.

english: Pure and undefiled religion before our God and Father is this: to care for orphans and widows in their distress, and to keep oneself from being polluted by the world.
ekegusii: Okomokorera Nyasae okore ogochenu, gotari na komocha ase obosio bwa Nyasae Tata noko: Gochia korora chintakana na ababoraka ase obokong’u bwabo, na kwerenda ere omonyene, na igo taba na kemoa gi’ense.
swahili: Dini iliyo safi, isiyo na uchafu, inayokubalika mbele za Mungu Baba yetu, ndiyo hii: Kuwasaidia yatima na wajane katika dhiki zao na kujilinda usitiwe madoa na dunia.

english: because you know that the testing of your faith develops perseverance.
ekegusii: ekiagera momanyete ng’a ekero okwegena kwaino kogoteemwa nigo mokweorokereria oboremereria.
swahili: kwa sababu mnajua ya kuwa kujaribiwa kwa imani yenu huleta saburi.

english: Allow perseverance to finish its work, so that you may be mature and complete, not lacking anything.
ekegusii: Tiga oboremereria obwo bobe nemeremo emeikeranu, erinde monyare koba abaikeranu, na abagima, motaremeiri na ing’ana rinde rionsi.
swahili: Saburi na iwe na kazi timilifu, ili mpate kuwa wakamilifu, mmekamilishwa, bila kupungukiwa na kitu chochote.

english: Now if any of you lacks wisdom, he should ask God, who gives generously to all without finding fault, and it will be given to him.
ekegusii: Korende onye monto onde oino oremeire obong’aini, tiga asabe Nyasae, ere nabomoe, ekiagera nigo akoa abanto bonsi ase obonge, gose tari gotogonyera onde.
swahili: Kama mtu yeyote miongoni mwenu amepungukiwa na hekima na amwombe Mungu, yeye awapaye watu wote kwa ukarimu wala hana kinyongo, naye atapewa.

english: But he must ask in faith, without doubting, because he who doubts is like a wave of the sea, blown and tossed by the wind.
ekegusii: Korende oyogosaba, tiga asabe ase okwegena, taba na tang’u‐tang’u, ekiagera oyore ne chitang’u‐tang’u nigo are buna emerindo y’enyancha ekona‐koirwa nomwaga gochia aaria na aaria.
swahili: Lakini anapoomba, lazima aamini wala asiwe na shaka, kwa sababu mtu aliye na shaka ni kama wimbi la bahari, lililochukuliwa na upepo na kutupwa huku na huku.

english: That man should not expect to receive anything from the Lord.
ekegusii: Naki omonto oria takaga ng’a nanyore egento korwa ase Omonene;
swahili: Mtu kama huyo asidhani ya kuwa atapata kitu chochote kutoka kwa Bwana.

english: He is a double-minded man, unstable in all his ways.
ekegusii: ere nigo are nemioyo ebere, na gotiting’ara ase chinchera chiaye chionsi. Obotaka na obonda
swahili: Yeye ni mtu mwenye nia mbili, mwenye kusitasita katika njia zake zote. Umaskini Na Utajiri

english: The brother in humble circumstances should exult in his high position.
ekegusii: Korende abakristo abare abataka bagoke, ekiagera Nyasae abaimokereirie igoro,
swahili: Ndugu asiye na cheo kikubwa yampasa ajivunie hali hiyo maana ametukuzwa.

english: My brothers, as you hold out your faith in our glorious Lord Jesus Christ, do not show favoritism.
ekegusii: Abaminto, komorabe mwegeenete Omonene oito Yeso Kristo, Omonene bw’obonene, timoba mogwanchereria abanto.
swahili: Ndugu zangu, kama waaminio katika imani ya Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo, Bwana wa utukufu, msiwe na upendeleo kwa watu.

english: Whoever keeps the whole law but stumbles at just one point is guilty of breaking all of it.
ekegusii: Naki monto onde bwensi obwatete amachiiko onsi, korende asarie erimo rioka, obeire omomochi ase onsi.
swahili: Kwa maana mtu yeyote anayeishika sheria yote lakini akajikwaa katika kipengele kimoja tu, ana hatia ya kuivunja sheria yote.

english: For He who said, “Do not commit adultery,” also said, “Do not murder.” If you do not commit adultery, but do commit murder, you have become a lawbreaker.
ekegusii: Naki ere oyotebete, “Totomana”, nere boigo agateeba, “Toita”. Gaki, onye totomaneti, korende gwaitire, igo kwabeire omosaria amachiiko.
swahili: Kwa sababu yeye aliyesema, “Usizini,” alisema pia, “Usiue.” Basi kama huzini lakini unaua, umekuwa mvunjaji wa sheria.

english: Speak and act as those who are going to be judged by the law that gives freedom.
ekegusii: Kwana bo, na kora boigo, buna abanto barache kogambigwa ase amachiiko obosibore.
swahili: Hivyo semeni na kutenda kama watu watakaohukumiwa kwa sheria ile iletayo uhuru.

english: For judgment without mercy will be shown to anyone who has not been merciful. Mercy triumphs over judgment. Faith and Works (Galatians 3:1–9)
ekegusii: Naki ekiina tikeri namaabera asere oyotari namaabera. Amaabera nigo agochenga igoro y’ekina. Okwegena n’ogokora
swahili: Kwa kuwa hukumu bila huruma itatolewa kwa mtu yeyote asiyekuwa na huruma. Huruma huishinda hukumu. Imani Na Matendo

english: What good is it, my brothers, if someone claims to have faith, but has no deeds? Can such faith save him?
ekegusii: Abaminto, ngokonywa ki omonto aranyore onye ogoteeba ng’a nare nokwegena, na ere tari nogokora? Inee! Okwegena koria nkonyare komotooria?
swahili: Ndugu zangu, yafaa nini ikiwa mtu atadai kuwa anayo imani lakini hana matendo? Je, imani kama hiyo yaweza kumwokoa?

english: Suppose a brother or sister is without clothes and daily food.
ekegusii: Onye oyomino, omosacha gose omokungu, ore bosa, na oremeire endagera ya kera rituko,
swahili: Ikiwa ndugu yako au dada hana mavazi wala chakula,

english: If one of you tells him, “Go in peace; stay warm and well fed,” but does not provide for his physical needs, what good is that?
ekegusii: na omonto onde oino amoteebie, “Genda nomorembe, bwote omorero, oigote”, korende tamoa ebiaganetie ase omobere oye, naki aramokonye?
swahili: mmoja wenu akamwambia, “Enenda zako kwa amani, ukaote moto na kushiba,” pasipo kumpatia yale mahitaji ya mwili aliyopungukiwa, yafaa nini?

english: So too, faith by itself, if it does not result in action, is dead.
ekegusii: Naboigo nokwegena gwoka gotari nogokora, nigo gokwete.
swahili: Vivyo hivyo, imani peke yake kama haikuambatana na matendo, imekufa.

english: But someone will say, “You have faith and I have deeds.” Show me your faith without deeds, and I will show you my faith by my deeds.
ekegusii: Aande gose omonto nateebe, “Aye nore nokwegena, na inche ninde nogokora.” Nimoiranerie, “Nyorokia okwegena kwao gotari nogokora, na inche nkworokie okwegena kwane ase ogokora kwane.”
swahili: Lakini mtu mwingine atasema, “Wewe unayo imani; mimi ninayo matendo.” Nionyeshe imani yako pasipo matendo nami nitakuonyesha imani yangu kwa matendo.

english: You believe that God is one. Good for you! Even the demons believe that—and shudder.
ekegusii: Aye mbwegenete ng’a Nyasae noyomo; gwakorire buya. Nonya nebirecha mbiegeneete boigo na koiguswa.
swahili: Unaamini kwamba kuna Mungu mmoja. Vyema! Hata mashetani yanaamini hivyo na kutetemeka.

english: Suppose a man comes into your meeting wearing a gold ring and fine clothes, and a poor man in shabby clothes also comes in.
ekegusii: Naki karasoe ase omosangererekano oino omonto obegete ebonyi y’etaabu ase ekiara kiaye, na bweboetie chianga chingiya, naende omonto onde asoe, oyore omotaka na bweboetie chianga chire ne riko,
swahili: Kwa maana kama akija mtu katika kusanyiko lenu akiwa amevaa pete ya dhahabu na mavazi mazuri, pia akaingia mtu maskini mwenye mavazi yaliyochakaa,

english: O foolish man, do you want evidence that faith without deeds is worthless?
ekegusii: Korende aye, omoriri, norigetie komanya ng’a okwegena gotari nogokora nigo kore bosa?
swahili: Ewe mpumbavu! Je, wataka kujua kwamba imani bila matendo haifai kitu?

english: Was not our father Abraham justified by what he did when he offered his son Isaac on the altar?
ekegusii: Inee! Sokoro yaito Aburaamu taetwe oboronge ase ogokora, ekero aruete Isaka, omwana oye, igoro ase egesasiimero?
swahili: Je, Abrahamu baba yetu hakuhesabiwa haki kwa kile alichotenda, alipomtoa mwanawe Isaki madhabahuni?

english: You see that his faith was working with his actions, and his faith was perfected by what he did.
ekegusii: Kwarorire ng’a okwegena kwaye amo nogokora mbiakorete emeremo, na okwegena koria kogaikeranigwa ase ogokora.
swahili: Unaona jinsi ambavyo imani yake na matendo yake vilikuwa vinatenda kazi pamoja, nayo imani yake ikakamilishwa na kile alichotenda.

english: And the Scripture was fulfilled that says, “Abraham believed God, and it was credited to him as righteousness,” and he was called a friend of God.
ekegusii: Amariko agaikeranigwa, aria agoteeba, “Aburaamu nigo amwegeenete Nyasae, na ase engencho eyio akabarwa koba omonyene oboronge.” Igo akarokwa omosani o Nyasae.
swahili: Kwa njia hiyo yakatimizwa yale Maandiko yasemayo, “Abrahamu alimwamini Mungu na ikahesabiwa kwake kuwa haki,” naye akaitwa rafiki wa Mungu.

english: As you can see, a man is justified by his deeds and not by faith alone.
ekegusii: Mwarorire ng’a Mwanyabaanto nigo akoegwa oboronge ase ogokora, gose tari ase okwegena gwoka.
swahili: Mnaona ya kwamba mtu huhesabiwa haki kwa yale anayotenda wala si kwa imani peke yake.

english: In the same way, was not even Rahab the prostitute justified by her actions when she welcomed the spies and sent them off on another route?
ekegusii: Naboigo na Rahabu, oria omotayayi, Inee, taetwe oboronge ase ogokora, ekero aroisetie baria batometwe, akabasokia isiko ase enchera ende eng’ao?
swahili: Vivyo hivyo, hata Rahabu, yule kahaba, hakuhesabiwa haki kwa yale aliyotenda alipowapokea wale wapelelezi na kuwaambia waende njia nyingine?

english: As the body without the spirit is dead, so faith without deeds is dead.
ekegusii: Naki buna omobere otari n’Omoika nigo okwete, naboigo nokwegena gotari nogokora nigo gokwete.
swahili: Kama vile ambavyo mwili pasipo roho umekufa, kadhalika nayo imani pasipo matendo imekufa.

english: If you lavish attention on the man in fine clothes and say, “Here is a seat of honor,” but say to the poor man, “You must stand” or “Sit at my feet,”
ekegusii: na inwe mwasika oria bweboetie chianga chingiya, na komoteebia “Ikaransa aye aiga aase aagiya” na goteebia oria omotaka, “Tenena aaria”, gose, “Ikaransa inse aa ase amagoro aane”,
swahili: nanyi mkampa heshima yule aliyevaa mavazi mazuri na kumwambia, “Keti hapa mahali pazuri,” lakini yule maskini mkamwambia, “Wewe simama pale,” au “Keti hapa sakafuni karibu na miguu yangu,”

english: have you not discriminated among yourselves and become judges with evil thoughts?
ekegusii: Inee, timokoreti ogwatananeka ase egati yaino inwe abanyene, na mwabeire abagaambi, more nebirengererio ebibe?
swahili: je, hamjawabagua na kuwa mahakimu mioyoni mwenu mkihukumu kwa mawazo yenu maovu?

english: Listen, my beloved brothers: Has not God chosen the poor of this world to be rich in faith and to inherit the kingdom He promised those who love Him?
ekegusii: Abaminto abanchani, tegerera! Inee! Nyasae tachorete abataka b’ense eye babe abanda ase okwegena, naende babe abanyamwando b’oborwoti obo abarierete eira, abwo bamwanchete?
swahili: Ndugu zangu, sikilizeni: Je, Mungu hakuwachagua wale walio maskini machoni pa ulimwengu kuwa matajiri katika imani na kuurithi Ufalme aliowaahidi wale wampendao?

english: But you have dishonored the poor. Is it not the rich who oppress you and drag you into court?
ekegusii: Korende inwe mwachayire oria omotaka. Inee! Baria abanda, tari barabwo baabaregete inwe, na kobakurura gochia ase ebigambero?
swahili: Lakini ninyi mmemdharau yule aliye maskini. Je, hao matajiri si ndio wanaowadhulumu na kuwaburuta mahakamani?

english: Are they not the ones who blaspheme the noble name by which you have been called?
ekegusii: Tari barabwo abwo bakorama erieta erio rigiya mwarokirwe inwe?
swahili: Je, si wao wanaolikufuru Jina lile lililo bora sana mliloitiwa?

english: If you really fulfill the royal law stated in Scripture, “Love your neighbor as yourself,” you are doing well.
ekegusii: Komoraikeranie ogochika gokorwa ase oborwoti buna koriikire ase amariiko, “Ancha omogisangio oo buna bweanchete”.
swahili: Kama kweli mnaitimiza ile sheria ya kifalme inayopatikana katika Maandiko isemayo, “Mpende jirani yako kama unavyoipenda nafsi yako,” mnafanya vyema.

english: But if you show favoritism, you sin and are convicted by the law as transgressors.
ekegusii: Korende onye more mogwanchereria abanto, mwakorire ebibe, na mwaenekigwe namachiiko ng’a nabasaria more.
swahili: Lakini kama mnakuwa na upendeleo kwa watu, mnatenda dhambi, na sheria inawahukumu kuwa ninyi ni wakosaji.

english: Not many of you should become teachers, my brothers, because you know that we who teach will be judged more strictly.
ekegusii: Abaminto, tegwenereti abange ase more babe aborokia, ekiagera momanyete ng’a intwe aborokia inatogambigwe ekiina egekong’u kobua.
swahili: Ndugu zangu, msiwe walimu wengi, kwa maana mnafahamu kwamba sisi tufundishao tutahukumiwa vikali zaidi.

english: Out of the same mouth come blessing and cursing. My brothers, this should not be!
ekegusii: Omonwa oria oria orua ogosesenia na okoragereria. Abaminto, amang’ana aya tagwenereti koba bo.
swahili: Katika kinywa kile kile hutoka baraka na laana. Ndugu zangu, haistahili kuwa hivyo.

english: Can both fresh water and salt water flow from the same spring?
ekegusii: Inee! Ensoko nenyare ase entuboka eyemo korenta amaache amaya, na amaache amaroro?
swahili: Je, chemchemi yaweza kutoa katika tundu moja maji matamu na maji ya chumvi?

english: My brothers, can a fig tree grow olives, or a grapevine bear figs? Neither can a salt spring produce fresh water. The Wisdom from Above
ekegusii: Abaminto, Inee, omoko nonyare kwama amazeituni, gose omosabibu bwame amako? Naboigo nensoko y’amaache are n’omonyoo tekonyara korenta amaache atari nomoonyo. Obong’aini bokorwa igoro
swahili: Je, ndugu zangu, mtini waweza kuzaa zeituni, au mzabibu kuzaa tini? Wala chemchemi ya maji ya chumvi haiwezi kutoa maji matamu. Aina Mbili Za Hekima

english: Who is wise and understanding among you? Let him show it by his good conduct, by deeds done in the humility that comes from wisdom.
ekegusii: Mbarabi ase more bare nobong’aini na obomanyi? Barobwo baorokie ogokora kwabo ase orogendo rwabo oruya, ase obwororo bokorwa ase obong’aini.
swahili: Ni nani aliye na hekima na ufahamu miongoni mwenu? Basi na aionyeshe hiyo kwa maisha yake mema na kwa matendo yake yaliyotendwa kwa unyenyekevu utokanao na hekima.

english: But if you harbor bitter jealousy and selfish ambition in your hearts, do not boast in it or deny the truth.
ekegusii: Korende onye more ne ribero rire nobororo, na okweancha ase chinkoro chiaino ime, timwetogia na gokwana oborimo igoro y’ekeene.
swahili: Lakini ikiwa mna wivu na ni wenye chuki na ugomvi mioyoni mwenu, msijisifu kwa ajili ya hayo wala msiikatae kweli.

english: Such wisdom does not come from above, but is earthly, unspiritual, demonic.
ekegusii: Obong’aini obo tari boria bogocha korwa igoro, korende nobw’ense, na obwe chingencho chia Mwanyabaanto, na saitani,
swahili: Hekima ya namna hiyo haishuki kutoka mbinguni, bali ni ya kidunia, isiyo ya kiroho, na ya kishetani.

english: For where jealousy and selfish ambition exist, there will be disorder and every evil practice.
ekegusii: ekiagera agwo ase ribero rire, na okweancha, agwo moroberio toiyo, korende kera ogokora okobe.
swahili: Kwa maana panapokuwa na wivu na ubinafsi, ndipo penye machafuko na uovu wa kila namna.

english: But the wisdom from above is first of all pure, then peace-loving, gentle, accommodating, full of mercy and good fruit, impartial, and sincere.
ekegusii: Korende obong’aini bokorwa igoro ritang’ani nigo bore obochenu, naende obw’omorembe, na obwororo, na obokanyeku. Igo boichire namaabera na okwama okuya, botari na gosiereria gose na bong’ainereria.
swahili: Lakini hekima itokayo mbinguni kwanza ni safi, kisha inapenda amani, tena ni ya upole, iliyo tayari kusikiliza wengine kwa unyenyekevu, iliyojaa huruma na matunda mema, isiyopendelea mtu, tena isiyokuwa na unafiki.

english: Peacemakers who sow in peace reap the fruit of righteousness.
ekegusii: Okwama kw’oboronge nigo kogosimekwa ase omorembe na baria bagokora omorembe.
swahili: Mavuno ya haki hupandwa katika amani na wale wafanyao amani.

english: We all stumble in many ways. If anyone is never at fault in what he says, he is a perfect man, able to control his whole body.
ekegusii: Naki intwe twensi nigo tokomocha ase chinchera chinyinge. Onye omonto takomocha ase ogokwana, oyio nomonto omoikeranu, oranyare kogambera omobere oye bwonsi boigo.
swahili: Sisi sote tunajikwaa katika mambo mengi. Ikiwa mtu yeyote hakosei kamwe katika yale anayosema, yeye ni mkamilifu, naye anaweza kuuzuia pia na mwili wake wote.

english: When we put bits into the mouths of horses to make them obey us, we can guide the whole animal.
ekegusii: Onye tokobekera chibarasi ebinto emenwa, ebi’ogochiraa, erinde chitoigwere, nigo tokoraa emebere yabo yonsi.
swahili: Tunapotia lijamu kwenye vinywa vya farasi ili kuwafanya watutii, tunaweza kuigeuza miili yao yote.

english: Consider ships as well. Although they are so large and are driven by strong winds, they are steered by a very small rudder wherever the pilot is inclined.
ekegusii: Morigererie chimeeri boigo, nonya chire chinene mono, na chikoirwa nomwaga omotindi, nigo chikoonchorwa nekeonchori egeke mono, aande onsi omogendia aganetie kogenda.
swahili: Au angalia pia meli, ingawa ni kubwa sana, nazo huchukuliwa na upepo mkali, lakini hugeuzwa kwa usukani mdogo sana, kokote anakotaka nahodha.

english: In the same way, the tongue is a small part of the body, but it boasts of great things. Consider how small a spark sets a great forest ablaze.
ekegusii: Naboigo na oromeme nekiimo egeke, na rororwo nigo rokweenenia ase amang’ana amanene. Rigereria buna ensase enke egosamba rinani rinene mono.
swahili: Vivyo hivyo ulimi ni kiungo kidogo sana katika mwili, lakini hujivuna majivuno makuu. Fikirini jinsi moto mdogo unavyoweza kuteketeza msitu mkubwa!

english: The tongue also is a fire, a world of wickedness among the parts of the body. It pollutes the whole person, sets the course of his life on fire, and is itself set on fire by hell.
ekegusii: Oromeme narwo omorero, na ense y’obobe. Ase ebiimo biaito bionsi oromeme narwo rokobeeka omobere bwonsi ebimoa, na gotongia omorero egesingo ki’obogima bwaito, na orwo oronyene nigo rwatongetwe nomorero o kare na kare.
swahili: Ulimi pia ni moto, ndio ulimwengu wa uovu kati ya viungo vya mwili. Ulimi huutia mwili wote wa mtu unajisi na kuuwasha moto mfumo mzima wa maisha yake, nao wenyewe huchomwa moto wa jehanamu.

english: All kinds of animals, birds, reptiles, and creatures of the sea are being tamed and have been tamed by man,
ekegusii: Naki kera egesaku gie ching’iti, ne chinyoni, ne ching’iti chigwekurura, na ebitongwa ebire amaache ime, nigo bitugire, na birobio nigo bitugire na Mwanyabaanto.
swahili: Kwa maana kila aina ya wanyama, ndege, wanyama watambaao na viumbe vya baharini vinafugika na vimefugwa na binadamu,

english: but no man can tame the tongue. It is a restless evil, full of deadly poison.
ekegusii: Korende oromeme, onde tari ase Mwanyabaanto oranyare korotuga. Rororwo nobobe, rotari kogamberwa, roichire nobosongo bokorenta amakweri.
swahili: lakini hakuna mtu awezaye kuufuga ulimi. Ni uovu usiotulia, umejaa sumu iletayo mauti.

english: With the tongue we bless our Lord and Father, and with it we curse men, who have been made in God’s likeness.
ekegusii: Ase orwo twatogia Omonene Tata, na ase orwo twaragereria Mwanyabaanto abatongetwe ase omogwekano o Nyasae.
swahili: Kwa ulimi tunamhimidi Bwana, yaani Baba yetu, na kwa huo twawalaani watu walioumbwa kwa mfano wa Mungu.

english: What causes conflicts and quarrels among you? Don’t they come from the passions at war within you?
ekegusii: Eseegi na okorwana ebire ase egati yaino, ng’ai bikorwa? Inee! Tibiri korwa agwo ase okogania kwaino okobe, ogokorwana nebiimo biaino?
swahili: Ni kitu gani kinachosababisha mapigano na ugomvi miongoni mwenu? Je, haya hayatokani na tamaa zenu zinazoshindana ndani yenu?

english: Humble yourselves before the Lord, and He will exalt you.
ekegusii: Mwekeyie ase obosio bw’Omonene, na ere nabaimokererie igoro. Okogambia oyomino
swahili: Jinyenyekezeni mbele za Bwana, naye atawainua. Onyo Kuhusu Kuhukumu Wengine

english: Brothers, do not slander one another. Anyone who speaks against his brother or judges him speaks against the law and judges it. And if you judge the law, you are not a practitioner of the law, but a judge of it.
ekegusii: Abaminto, timong’achana. Oyokong’acha oyomwabo, gose komogambia nigo akong’acha amachiiko na koyagambia, korende onye gokogambia amachiiko, rirorio tori omokori amachiiko, korende omogambia amachiiko.
swahili: Ndugu, msineneane mabaya ninyi kwa ninyi. Mtu yeyote anayesema mabaya dhidi ya ndugu yake au kumhukumu anasema dhidi ya sheria na kuihukumu. Unapoihukumu sheria, basi huishiki sheria bali umekuwa hakimu wa kuihukumu hiyo sheria.

english: There is only one Lawgiver and Judge, the One who is able to save and destroy. But who are you to judge your neighbor? Do Not Boast about Tomorrow (Proverbs 27:1)
ekegusii: Omorua amachiiko na omogambia noyomo bweka, nere oranyare gotooria na gosiria. Korende aye naye ng’o okogambia omogisangio oo? Ogokuurera kw’ogotaba noboenenu
swahili: Yuko Mtoa sheria mmoja tu na yeye peke yake ndiye Hakimu, ndiye awezaye kuokoa au kuangamiza. Lakini wewe ni nani hata umhukumu jirani yako? Kujivuna Kwa Ajili Ya Kesho

english: Come now, you who say, “Today or tomorrow we will go to this or that city, spend a year there, carry on business, and make a profit.”
ekegusii: Igwa bono inwe abamogoteeba, “Reero gose ankio inatogende omochie gete, na tobeere aroro omwaka omogima na kogora, na koonia, na konyora ebitoki.”
swahili: Basi sikilizeni ninyi msemao, “Leo au kesho tutakwenda katika mji huu ama ule tukae humo mwaka mmoja, tufanye biashara na kupata faida.”

english: You do not even know what will happen tomorrow! What is your life? You are a mist that appears for a little while and then vanishes.
ekegusii: Inwe timomanyeti ayarache abe ankio. Obogima bwaino ninki? Naki inwe neritaturi, rikororekana ase egeka egeke, naende riasira.
swahili: Lakini hamjui hata litakalotukia kesho. Maisha yenu ni nini? Ninyi ni ukungu ambao huonekana kwa kitambo kidogo kisha hutoweka.

english: Instead, you ought to say, “If the Lord is willing, we will live and do this or that.”
ekegusii: Ayamogwenerete goteeba naya, “Omonene karanche, natobe moyo, naende tokore iga gose iga”.
swahili: Badala yake, inawapasa kusema, “Kama Bwana akipenda, tutaishi na kufanya hili ama lile.”

english: As it is, you boast in your proud intentions. All such boasting is evil.
ekegusii: Korende bono iga mogwetogia ase oboenenu bwaino. Ogwetogia gwonsi konga buna okwo nokobe.
swahili: Kama ilivyo sasa, mnajisifu na kujigamba. Kujisifu kwa namna hiyo ni uovu.

english: Anyone, then, who knows the right thing to do, yet fails to do it, is guilty of sin.
ekegusii: Ase ayio, oyomanyete gokora amaya, ko tayakora, asare ere nebibe.
swahili: Basi mtu yeyote anayejua jema limpasalo kutenda, lakini asilitende, mtu huyo anatenda dhambi.

english: You crave what you do not have; you kill and covet, but are unable to obtain it. You quarrel and fight. You do not have, because you do not ask.
ekegusii: Nigo mokogania, korende timori na gento; moita na koba ne ribero, korende timokonyora gento. Nigo mogokora esegi na korwana, korende timori na gento, ekiagera timori gosaba.
swahili: Mnatamani lakini hampati, kwa hiyo mwaua. Mwatamani kupata lakini hampati vile mnavyotaka, kwa hiyo mnajitia katika magomvi na mapigano. Mmepungukiwa kwa sababu hammwombi Mungu.

english: And when you do ask, you do not receive, because you ask with wrong motives, that you may squander it on your pleasures.
ekegusii: Ngosaba more, ko timori koegwa, ekiagera nigo mogosaba bobe. Ayio mogosaba nigo moganetie gokorera ase okogania kwaino okobe.
swahili: Mnapoomba hampati kwa sababu mnaomba kwa nia mbaya, ili mpate kuvitumia hivyo mtakavyopata kwa tamaa zenu.

english: You adulteresses! Do you not know that friendship with the world is hostility toward God? Therefore, whoever chooses to be a friend of the world renders himself an enemy of God.
ekegusii: Inwe abamotari abegenwa, timomanyeti ng’a obosani bw’ense nobobisa ase Nyasae? Gaki, oyorigetie koba omosani bw’ense bwekorire koba omobisa o Nyasae.
swahili: Ninyi wanaume na wanawake wazinzi, hamjui ya kwamba urafiki na dunia ni uadui na Mungu? Kwa hiyo mtu yeyote anayetaka kuwa rafiki wa dunia hufanyika adui wa Mungu.

english: Or do you think the Scripture says without reason that the Spirit He caused to dwell in us yearns with envy?
ekegusii: Gose nigo mokagete ng’a namang’ana abosa, ekero amariiko agoteeba iga, “Omoika oyomenyete ime yaito nigo okogania ore ne risemi.”
swahili: Au mwadhani kwamba Andiko lasema bure kuwa huyo Roho ambaye Mungu amemweka ndani yetu hututamani kiasi cha kuona wivu?

english: But He gives us more grace. This is why it says: “God opposes the proud, but gives grace to the humble.” Drawing Near to God
ekegusii: Korende obuya obo, ere atoeire, nobonge kobua. Naki amariiko nigo agoteeba, “Nyasae nigo akwanga abare abaenenu, korende abare abaitongo nigo akobaa obuya.”
swahili: Lakini yeye hutupatia neema zaidi. Hii ndiyo sababu Andiko husema: “Mungu huwapinga wenye kiburi, lakini huwapa wanyenyekevu neema.”

english: Submit yourselves, then, to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.
ekegusii: Gaki, mwebeke inse ase Nyasae; korende mwange Saitani, na ere nabatame.
swahili: Basi mtiini Mungu. Mpingeni ibilisi, naye atawakimbia.

english: Draw near to God, and He will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners, and purify your hearts, you double-minded.
ekegusii: Moike Nyasae ang’e, na ere nabaike ang’e inwe. Inwe abanyene ebibe, mochene amaboko aino; inwe abanyene emioyo ebere, mochene chinkoro chiaino.
swahili: Mkaribieni Mungu, naye atawakaribia ninyi. Itakaseni mikono yenu ninyi wenye dhambi, na kuisafisha mioyo yenu ninyi wenye nia mbili.

english: Grieve, mourn, and weep. Turn your laughter to mourning, and your joy to gloom.
ekegusii: Eichanie na kweng’ereria, na korera. Ogoseka kwaino koonchorwe kobe okweng’ereria, na omogooko oino obe omoichano.
swahili: Huzunikeni, ombolezeni na kulia. Kicheko chenu na kigeuzwe kuwa kuomboleza, na furaha yenu kuwa huzuni.

english: Come now, you who are rich, weep and wail over the misery to come upon you.
ekegusii: Igwa bono, abamore abanda, rera na goaka egeturi ase engencho y’emechando yaino eyekobacheera.
swahili: Basi sikilizeni, ninyi matajiri, lieni na kuomboleza kwa ajili ya hali mbaya sana inayowajia.

english: Brothers, as an example of patience in affliction, take the prophets who spoke in the name of the Lord.
ekegusii: Abaminto, bwatia ababani baria bakwanete ase erieta ri’Omonene, babe ekiorokererio gi’okobogoria obokong’u, na eki’oboremereria.
swahili: Ndugu zangu, waangalieni manabii walionena kwa Jina la Bwana, ili kuwa mfano wa uvumilivu katika kukabiliana na mateso.

english: See how blessed we consider those who have persevered. You have heard of Job’s perseverance and have seen the outcome from the Lord. The Lord is full of compassion and mercy.
ekegusii: Rigereria, abwo baremereretie twabaabarire ng’a mbasesenirie. Mwaigwete amang’ana ’Ayubu buna aremereretie, na buna Omonene amokorerete ase omoerio. Naki Omonene nomonyene amabeebe amange na amaabera.
swahili: Kama mnavyojua, tunawahesabu kuwa wabarikiwa wale waliovumilia. Mmesikia habari za uvumilivu wake Ayubu na mmeona kile ambacho hatimaye Bwana alimtendea. Bwana ni mwingi wa huruma, na amejaa rehema.

english: Above all, my brothers, do not swear, not by heaven or earth or by any other oath. Simply let your “Yes” be yes, and your “No,” no, so that you will not fall under judgment. The Prayer of Faith
ekegusii: Korende abaminto, kobua ase onsi timotiana, ase igoro, gose ase ense, gose koria muma ende yonsi, korende “ee” yaino ebe “ee”, na “yaya” yaino ebe “yaya”, timocha kobekwa inse y’okogambigwa.
swahili: Zaidi ya yote, ndugu zangu, msiape, iwe kwa mbingu au kwa dunia, au kwa kitu kingine chochote. “Ndiyo” yenu na iwe ndiyo, na “Hapana” yenu iwe hapana, la sivyo mtahukumiwa. Maombi Ya Imani

english: Is any one of you suffering? He should pray. Is anyone cheerful? He should sing praises.
ekegusii: Omonto onde oino karanyorekane nemechando, tiga asabe. Onde omo oino, onye ore nomoyo bw’ogosasoka, tiga atogie ase ogoteera.
swahili: Je, mtu yeyote miongoni mwenu amepatwa na taabu? Basi inampasa aombe. Je, kuna yeyote mwenye furaha? Basi na aimbe nyimbo za kusifu.

english: Is any one of you sick? He should call the elders of the church to pray over him and anoint him with oil in the name of the Lord.
ekegusii: Onye omonto onde oino obeire omorwaire, tiga arangerie abagaaka b’ekanisa bamosabere na bamoake amaguta ase erieta ri’Omonene.
swahili: Je, kuna yeyote miongoni mwenu aliye mgonjwa? Basi inampasa awaite wazee wa kanisa wamwombee na kumpaka mafuta kwa Jina la Bwana.

english: And the prayer offered in faith will restore the one who is sick. The Lord will raise him up. If he has sinned, he will be forgiven.
ekegusii: Na ogosaba koria gw’okwegena nagotoorie omorwaire oria, n’Omonene namogwenie. Onye omonto oria okorire ebibe naaberwe.
swahili: Kule kuomba kwa imani kutamwokoa huyo mgonjwa, naye Bwana atamwinua na kama ametenda dhambi, atasamehewa.

english: Therefore confess your sins to each other and pray for each other so that you may be healed. The prayer of a righteous man has great power to prevail.
ekegusii: Orokerania ebibe biaino inwe ase inwe, na gosaberana, monyore okogwenigwa. Ogosaba kw’omonyene oboronge nigo kore nengencho enene mono gokorasabwe nomokia.
swahili: Kwa hiyo ungamianeni dhambi zenu ninyi kwa ninyi na kuombeana ili mpate kuponywa. Maombi ya mwenye haki yana nguvu tena yanafaa sana.

english: Elijah was a man just like us. He prayed earnestly that it would not rain, and it did not rain on the land for three and a half years.
ekegusii: Elija nigo arenge omonto bwe chingencho echimo naintwe, agasaba nomokia ng’a embura tetwa. Na embura tiyatwa igoro ase ense ase engaki y’emiaka etato na emetienyi etano nomo.
swahili: Eliya alikuwa mwanadamu kama sisi. Akaomba kwa bidii kwamba mvua isinyeshe, nayo haikunyesha juu ya nchi kwa muda wa miaka mitatu na miezi sita.

english: Again he prayed, and the heavens gave rain, and the earth yielded its crops. Restoring a Sinner
ekegusii: Agasaba naende, igoro ekarenta embura, na ense ekama okwama kwaye.
swahili: Kisha akaomba tena, nazo mbingu zikatoa mvua nayo ardhi ikatoa mazao yake.

english: My brothers, if one of you should wander from the truth and someone should bring him back,
ekegusii: Abaminto, onye omonto onde oino oteanire korwa ase ekeene, na monto onde amoiranie,
swahili: Ndugu zangu, yeyote miongoni mwenu akipotoka na kuicha kweli, naye akarejezwa na mtu mwingine,

english: Your riches have rotted and moths have eaten your clothes.
ekegusii: Chinibo chiaino chiagundire, ne chianga chiaino chiarirwe nebigwankwa.
swahili: Utajiri wenu umeoza na mavazi yenu yameliwa na nondo.

english: consider this: Whoever turns a sinner from the error of his way will save his soul from death and cover over a multitude of sins.
ekegusii: tiga ere amanye ng’a oyokoirania omonyene ebibe korwa ase enchera y’ogosira, ere natoorie omoyo oye korwa ase amakweri na atube obonge bw’ebibe.
swahili: hamna budi kujua kwamba yeyote amrejezaye mwenye dhambi kutoka upotovu wake, ataiokoa roho ya huyo mwenye dhambi kutoka mauti na kusitiri wingi wa dhambi.

english: Your gold and silver are corroded. Their corrosion will testify against you and consume your flesh like fire. You have hoarded treasure in the last days.
ekegusii: Chitaabu ne chifeta chiaino chiasoirwe noboboosu, na oboboosu obwo bwabeire kirori igoro yaino, na borobwo naborie emebere yaino buna omorero okoria. Mwegacheire emonga amatuko aya ay’omoerio.
swahili: Dhahabu yenu na fedha yenu vimeliwa na kutu. Kutu yake itashuhudia dhidi yenu nayo itaila miili yenu kama vile moto. Mmejiwekea hazina kwa ajili ya siku za mwisho.

english: Look, the wages you withheld from the workmen who mowed your fields are crying out against you. The cries of the harvesters have reached the ears of the Lord of Hosts.
ekegusii: Rigereria, mwabarinire abakoreri, abagesire emegondo yaino, eng’eria yabo. Bono eng’eria eria ekorera, na okorera kw’abagesi baria gwaikire ase amato ’Omonene bw’Emeganda.
swahili: Angalieni! Ule ujira wa vibarua waliolima mashamba yenu mliouzuia kwa hila unapiga kelele dhidi yenu na vilio vya wavunaji vimefika masikioni mwa Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote.

english: You have lived on earth in luxury and self-indulgence. You have fattened your hearts in the day of slaughter.
ekegusii: Igo momenyete ase ense eye ase okwegokia, na timwetangeti ase okogania kwaino. Mwenoririe ase chinkoro chiaino goika rituko ri’okonyenya.
swahili: Mmeishi duniani kwa anasa na kwa starehe, mmejinenepesha tayari kwa siku ya kuchinjwa.

english: You have condemned and murdered the righteous, who did not resist you. Patience in Suffering (Job 1:1–5)
ekegusii: Mwagambirie omonyene oboronge na komoita, na ere tabaamerereti inwe. Oboremereria na ogosaba
swahili: Mmewahukumu na kuwaua watu wenye haki, waliokuwa hawapingani nanyi. Uvumilivu Katika Mateso

english: Be patient, then, brothers, until the Lord’s coming. See how the farmer awaits the precious fruit of the soil—how patient he is for the fall and spring rains.
ekegusii: Ase ayio, baminto, remereria goika Omonene achiche. Rigereria, omoremi nigo akoganya okwama kw’omogondo okore ne rigori. Igo akoremereria ase ayio, goika anyore embura ye ritang’ani na ey’okwamia endagera.
swahili: Kwa hiyo, ndugu zangu, vumilieni hadi kuja kwake Bwana. Angalieni jinsi mkulima angojavyo ardhi itoe mavuno yake yaliyo ya thamani na jinsi anavyovumilia kwa ajili ya kupata mvua za kwanza na za mwisho.

english: You, too, be patient and strengthen your hearts, because the Lord’s coming is near.
ekegusii: Naboigo, nainwe remereria, kong’ia chinkoro chiaino, ekiagera ogocha kw’Omonene kwabeire ang’e.
swahili: Ninyi nanyi vumilieni, tena simameni imara, kwa sababu kuja kwa Bwana kumekaribia.

english: Do not complain about one another, brothers, so that you will not be judged. Look, the Judge is standing at the door!
ekegusii: Abaminto, timwemurunganerania, timocha kogambigwa. Rigereria, Omogambi nigo ateneine gesieri.
swahili: Ndugu zangu, msinungʼunikiane msije mkahukumiwa. Hakimu amesimama mlangoni!

english: After the time of Abimelech, a man of Issachar, Tola son of Puah, the son of Dodo, rose up to save Israel. He lived in Shamir, in the hill country of Ephraim.
ekegusii: Magega y’Abimeleki, Tola, mosinto o Pua o Dodo, omonto bw’egesaku gia Isakaru, akaimoka gotooria Abaisraeli. Ere nigo amenyete Samiri, ase ense y’ebitunwa ya Efraimu.
swahili: Baada ya Abimeleki, Tola mwana wa Pua mwana wa Dodo, mtu wa Isakari, aliyeishi huko Shamiri, katika nchi ya vilima ya Efraimu, akainuka kuokoa Israeli.

english: Then the Israelites cried out to the LORD, saying, “We have sinned against You, for we have indeed forsaken our God and served the Baals.”
ekegusii: Erio Abaisraeli bakarera ase Omonene, bagoteeba, “Twakorire ebibe ase ore, ekiagera twagotigire aye Nyasae oito, na gokorera chinyasae chiria Baali.”
swahili: Ndipo Waisraeli wakamlilia Bwana wakasema, “Tumetenda dhambi dhidi yako, kumwacha Mungu wetu na kutumikia Mabaali.”

english: The LORD replied, “When the Egyptians, Amorites, Ammonites, Philistines,
ekegusii: Omonene akabairaneria, “Inee! Tinababooretie korwa ase Abamisiri, n’Abaamoni, n’Abafilisti?
swahili: Bwana akawaambia, “Wakati Wamisri, Waamori, Waamoni, Wafilisti,

english: Sidonians, Amalekites, and Maonites oppressed you and you cried out to Me, did I not save you from their hands?
ekegusii: Boigo Abasidoni, n’Abaameleki, n’Abaamoni, abwo bonsi mbaabachaandete; mokarera ase ’nde, na inche ’nkabatooria korwa ase amaboko abo.
swahili: Wasidoni, Waamaleki na Wamaoni walipowaonea na ninyi mkanililia na kuomba msaada, je, sikuwaokoa kutoka mikononi mwao?

english: But you have forsaken Me and served other gods, so I will no longer save you.
ekegusii: Korende bono mwantigire inche na gokorera chinyasae ching’ao; ase ayio tintageti kobatooria naende.
swahili: Lakini ninyi mmeniacha mimi na kutumikia miungu mingine, kwa hiyo sitawaokoa tena.

english: Go and cry out to the gods you have chosen. Let them save you in your time of trouble.”
ekegusii: Genda, morere ase chinyasae chiria mogokorera, tiga chirochio chibatoorie bono ekero more ase emechando.”
swahili: Nendeni mkaililie ile miungu mlioichagua. Hiyo miungu na iwaokoe mnapokuwa katika taabu!”

english: “We have sinned,” the Israelites said to the LORD. “Deal with us as You see fit; but please deliver us today!”
ekegusii: Erio Abaisraeli bagateebia Omonene, “Twakorire ebibe, na bono tokorere buna oranche aye omonyene; twagosoroire, ototoorie reero, koranche.”
swahili: Lakini Waisraeli wakamwambia Bwana, “Tumetenda dhambi. Ututendee lile unaloona kuwa jema kwako, lakini twakusihi utuokoe sasa.”

english: So they put away the foreign gods from among them and served the LORD, and He could no longer bear the misery of Israel.
ekegusii: Ase igo bakarusia na gotuguta chinyasae chingeni echiarenge ase egati yabo, bagakorera Omonene. Na b’Omonene tare konyaara koremereria naende korora emechando y’Abaisraeli.
swahili: Nao wakaiondoa hiyo miungu migeni katikati yao nao wakamtumikia Bwana. Naye akahuzunika kwa sababu ya taabu ya Israeli.

english: Then the Ammonites were called to arms and camped in Gilead, and the Israelites assembled and camped at Mizpah.
ekegusii: Abaamoni bakarangerigwa goocha korwana, bagatoora agwo Gileadi, korende Abaisraeli bagasangererigwa, bagatoora agwo Misipa.
swahili: Ndipo Waamoni wakaitwa vitani na kupiga kambi huko Gileadi, Waisraeli wakakusanyika na kupiga kambi huko Mispa.

english: And the rulers of Gilead said to one another, “Whoever will launch the attack against the Ammonites will be the head of all who live in Gilead.”
ekegusii: Abanto ba Gileadi na abatang’ani babo bagakwana barabwo ase barabwo, “Ning’o oranche gochaaka korwania Abaamoni? Ere oyio nabe omogambi bw’ abanto bonsi ba Gileadi.”
swahili: Viongozi wa watu wa Gileadi wakaambiana wao kwa wao, “Yeyote yule atakayeanzisha mashambulizi dhidi ya Waamoni atakuwa kiongozi wa wote wakaao Gileadi.”

english: Tola judged Israel twenty-three years, and when he died, he was buried in Shamir. Jair
ekegusii: Ere akagambeera Abaisraeli ebiina ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ebere, n’etato. Erio agakwa, agatindekwa agwo Samiri.
swahili: Akaamua Israeli kwa miaka ishirini na mitatu. Ndipo akafa, naye akazikwa huko Shamiri. Yairi

english: Tola was followed by Jair the Gileadite, who judged Israel twenty-two years.
ekegusii: Magega yaye Yairi Omogileadi akaimoka. Nere akabagambera Abaisraeli ebiina ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ebere, n’ebere.
swahili: Baada yake akafuatiwa na Yairi, Mgileadi, ambaye aliamua Israeli kwa miaka ishirini na miwili.

english: He had thirty sons who rode on thirty donkeys. And they had thirty towns in the land of Gilead, which to this day are called Havvoth-jair.
ekegusii: Ere nigo abwate abana abamura emerongo etato, baare koriina chitigere emerongo etato. Boigo bakaba bakogambera emechie emerongo etato agwo ase ense ya Gileadi. Emechie eyio nigo ekorokwa Hawoti‐Yairi (Emechie ya Yairi) nonya ngoika reero iga.
swahili: Alikuwa na wana thelathini waliopanda punda thelathini. Nao walikuwa na miji thelathini iliyoko Gileadi, inayoitwa Hawoth-Yairi mpaka leo.

english: When Jair died, he was buried in Kamon. Oppression by the Philistines and Ammonites
ekegusii: Yairi agakwa, agatindekwa agwo Kamoni. Abafirisiti n’Abaamoni bagochaanda Abaisraeli
swahili: Yairi akafa, naye akazikwa huko Kamoni. Yefta

english: And again the Israelites did evil in the sight of the LORD. They served the Baals, the Ashtoreths, the gods of Aram, Sidon, and Moab, and the gods of the Ammonites and Philistines. Thus they forsook the LORD and did not serve Him.
ekegusii: Naende Abaisraeli bagakora ebibe ase obosio bw’Omonene; bagasasiima chinyasae chiria chiare korokwa Baali, na echinde chiare korokwa Asitaroti, amo ne’chinyasae chi’Abasiiria, n’Abasidoni, n’Abamoabu, n’Abaamoni, n’Abafilisti; naende bagatiga komokorera Omonene.
swahili: Wana wa Israeli wakatenda tena maovu machoni pa Bwana. Wakaabudu Mabaali na Maashtorethi, miungu ya Aramu, miungu ya Sidoni, miungu ya Moabu, miungu ya Waamoni na miungu ya Wafilisti. Kwa kuwa Waisraeli walimwacha Bwana wala hawakuendelea kumtumikia,

english: So the anger of the LORD burned against Israel, and He sold them into the hands of the Philistines and Ammonites,
ekegusii: Omonene akaba n’endamwamu enene ase Abaisraeli, akababeeka ase amaboko y’Abafilisti na ay’Abaamoni,
swahili: hivyo hasira ya Bwana ikawaka dhidi ya Israeli, naye akawatia mikononi mwa Wafilisti na Waamoni,

english: who that very year harassed and oppressed the Israelites, and did so for eighteen years to all the Israelites on the other side of the Jordan in Gilead, the land of the Amorites.
ekegusii: Ase omwaka oria barabwo bagachaanda Abaisraeli na kobakorera bobe. Ase engaki y’emiaka ikomi, na etano n’etato, bagachaanda Abaisraeli bonsi abamenyete moocha y’orooche rwa Yorodani ase ense y’Abaamoni ase Gileadi.
swahili: ambao waliwaonea na kuwatesa mwaka ule. Kwa miaka kumi na minane wakawatesa Waisraeli wote upande wa mashariki ya Mto Yordani katika Gileadi, nchi ya Waamori.

english: The Ammonites also crossed the Jordan to fight against Judah, Benjamin, and the house of Ephraim, and Israel was in deep distress.
ekegusii: Amo nayio, Abaamoni bakaamboka Yorodani gochia korwania Abayuda, n’Ababenjamini, n’Abaefraimu, goika Abaisraeli bagaachaandwa bobe mono.
swahili: Waamoni nao wakavuka Yordani ili kupigana na Yuda, Benyamini na nyumba ya Efraimu, nayo nyumba ya Israeli ikawa katika taabu kubwa.

english: Now Jephthah the Gileadite was a mighty man of valor; he was the son of a prostitute, and Gilead was his father.
ekegusii: Yefta Omogileadi nigo arenge omorwani etuoni. Ere nigo arenge omwana bw’omokuungu omotayayi, na ise Yefta nigo arenge korokwa Gileadi.
swahili: Basi Yefta Mgileadi alikuwa mtu shujaa. Baba yake alikuwa Gileadi, naye mama yake alikuwa kahaba.

english: And the elders of Gilead said to Jephthah, “The LORD is our witness if we do not do as you say.”
ekegusii: Abagaaka ba Gileadi bakamoiraneria, “’Ntokore buna gwateebire. Omonene nabe kirori ase egati yaito.”
swahili: Viongozi wa Gileadi wakamjibu Yefta, “ Bwana ndiye shahidi yetu. Kwa hakika tutafanya kama usemavyo.”

english: So Jephthah went with the elders of Gilead, and the people made him their leader and commander. And Jephthah repeated all his terms in the presence of the LORD at Mizpah.
ekegusii: Ase igo Yefta akageenda amo nabagaaka ba Gileadi, n’abanto baabo bakamobeeka akaba omogambi na omotang’ani obo. Yefta agakwana amang’ana aye onsi ase obosio bw’Omonene agwo Misipa.
swahili: Basi Yefta akaenda na viongozi wa Gileadi, nao watu wakamfanya kiongozi na jemadari wao. Naye akarudia maneno yake yote mbele za Bwana huko Mispa.

english: Then Jephthah sent messengers to the king of the Ammonites, saying, “What do you have against me that you have come to fight against my land?”
ekegusii: Erio Yefta agatoma abanto ase omorwoti bw’Abaamoni komoboria, “’Ndiomana ki obwate ase ’nde? Nase ki gwachire korwania ense yane?”
swahili: Ndipo Yefta akatuma wajumbe kwa mfalme wa Waamoni akisema, “Una nini juu yetu, hata umekuja kushambulia nchi yetu?”

english: The king of the Ammonites answered Jephthah’s messengers, “When Israel came up out of Egypt, they seized my land, from the Arnon to the Jabbok and all the way to the Jordan. Now, therefore, restore it peaceably.”
ekegusii: Omorwoti bw’Abaamoni akairaneria abanto abwo batometwe na Yefta, “Ekero Abaisraeli barwete Misiri ’mbairete orogongo rwane korwa orooche rw’Arinoni goika orwa Yaboki, na goika Yorodani. Ase ayio bono roiranie n’omorembe.”
swahili: Mfalme wa Waamoni akawajibu wajumbe wale wa Yefta, “Wakati Waisraeli walipopanda kutoka Misri, waliichukua nchi yangu kuanzia Arnoni mpaka Yaboki, hadi kufikia Yordani. Sasa rudisha kwa amani.”

english: Jephthah again sent messengers to the king of the Ammonites
ekegusii: Naende Yefta agatoma abanto eria kabere ase omorwoti bw’Abaamoni,
swahili: Yefta akarudisha wajumbe kwa mfalme wa Waamoni,

english: to tell him, “This is what Jephthah says: Israel did not take away the land of Moab or of the Ammonites.
ekegusii: bamoteebie “Oko nokoiraneria kwa Yefta: Abaisraeli tibaireti rogongo rw’Abamoabu, gose rw’Abaamoni,
swahili: kusema: “Hili ndilo asemalo Yefta, Israeli hawakuchukua nchi ya Moabu wala ya Waamoni.

english: But when Israel came up out of Egypt, they traveled through the wilderness to the Red Sea and came to Kadesh.
ekegusii: korende ekero barwete Misiri nigo baetete ase egati y’erooro gochia Enyancha Embariri, bagaika Kadeshi.
swahili: Lakini walipopanda kutoka Misri, Israeli walipitia katika jangwa hadi Bahari ya Shamu na wakafika Kadeshi.

english: Then Israel sent messengers to the king of Edom, saying, ‘Please let us pass through your land,’ but the king of Edom would not listen. They also sent messengers to the king of Moab, but he would not consent. So Israel stayed in Kadesh.
ekegusii: Korwa agwo, bagatoma abanto gochia ase omorwoti o Edomu bamoborie ribaga baetere ense yaye. Korende omorwoti o Edomu tanchete gotegerera amang’ana ayio. Naende bagatoma abanto ase omorwoti o Moabu, nere boigo tabaete ribaga. Ase ayio Abaisraeli bagatigara agwo Kadeshi.
swahili: Ndipo Israeli wakatuma wajumbe kwa mfalme wa Edomu, wakisema, ‘Tupe ruhusa kupita katika nchi yako,’ Lakini mfalme wa Edomu hakutusikia. Wakapeleka pia wajumbe kwa mfalme wa Moabu, naye akakataa. Kwa hiyo Israeli wakakaa huko Kadeshi.

english: Then Israel traveled through the wilderness and bypassed the lands of Edom and Moab. They came to the east side of the land of Moab and camped on the other side of the Arnon. But they did not enter the territory of Moab, since the Arnon was its border.
ekegusii: Erio bagaeta ime y’erooro, bagaetanana ense ya Edomu na ense ya Moabu, bagaika moocha y’ense ya Moabu, goika ng’umbu y’orooche rw’Arinoni. Bagatoora agwo, korende tibaambogete Arinoni, ekiagera oro norobebe rwa Moabu.
swahili: “Baadaye wakasafiri kupitia jangwa, wakiambaa na nchi za Edomu na Moabu, wakapitia upande wa mashariki wa nchi ya Moabu na kupiga kambi upande mwingine wa Arnoni. Hawakuingia katika nchi ya Moabu, kwa kuwa Arnoni ilikuwa mpaka wake.

english: And Israel sent messengers to Sihon king of the Amorites, who ruled in Heshbon, and said to him, ‘Please let us pass through your land into our own place.’
ekegusii: Erio Abaisraeli bagatoma abanto gochia ase Sihoni, omorwoti bw’Abaamori, agwo Hesiboni bamoborie ribaga baete ase ense yaye, bagende ase ense yabo abanyene.
swahili: “Kisha Israeli wakatuma wajumbe kwa Sihoni mfalme wa Waamori, aliyetawala Heshboni, na kumwambia, ‘Tupe ruhusa kupita katika nchi yako ili kufikia mahali petu.’

english: And Gilead’s wife bore him sons who grew up, drove Jephthah out, and said to him, “You shall have no inheritance in our father’s house, because you are the son of another woman.”
ekegusii: Omokungu omonyuome o Gileadi nere boigo akamoiborera abana abamura, na ekero barabwo babete abanto abanene bagaseeria Yefta korwa inka, bakamoteebia, “Aye tokonyaara konyora omwando ase enyomba ya tata, ekiagera nigo ore omwana bw’omokuungu omoao.”
swahili: Mke wa Gileadi akamzalia wana wengine, nao watoto hao walipokua, wakamfukuza Yefta na kumwambia, “Wewe huwezi kupata urithi katika jamii yetu, kwa sababu wewe ni mwana wa mwanamke mwingine.”

english: But Sihon would not trust Israel to pass through his territory. So he gathered all his people, encamped in Jahaz, and fought with Israel.
ekegusii: Korende Sihoni tabegenete Abaisraeli, na tabaete ribaga baete ase ense yaye. Agasangereria abarwani baye, na barabwo bagatoora agwo Yahasi, bakarwania Abaisraeli.
swahili: Hata hivyo, Sihoni hakuwaamini Waisraeli kupita katika nchi yake. Akaandaa jeshi lake lote na kupiga kambi huko Yahasa, nao wakapigana na Israeli.

english: Then the LORD, the God of Israel, delivered Sihon and all his people into the hand of Israel, who defeated them. So Israel took possession of all the land of the Amorites who inhabited that country,
ekegusii: Korende Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, akabeeka Sihoni amo n’abanto baye ase amaboko ya Abaisraeli, nabarabwo bakababua. Abaisraeli bakaira ense yonsi y’Abaamori baria bamenyete ase ense eria.
swahili: “Ndipo Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli, akamtia Sihoni na watu wake wote mikononi mwa Israeli, nao wakawashinda. Israeli wakaitwaa nchi yote ya Waamori, waliokuwa wakiishi katika nchi hiyo,

english: seizing all the land from the Arnon to the Jabbok and from the wilderness to the Jordan.
ekegusii: Bakaira ense yonsi y’Abaamori ekaba eyabo, korwa Arinoni goika Yaboki, na korwa erooro goika Yorodani.
swahili: wakiiteka nchi yote kuanzia Arnoni mpaka Yaboki, na kutoka jangwani mpaka Yordani.

english: Now since the LORD, the God of Israel, has driven out the Amorites from before His people Israel, should you now possess it?
ekegusii: Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, nere oseretie Abaamori ase engencho y’ abanto baye Abaisraeli. Inee! Aye bono nigo oganetie koira ense yabo?
swahili: “Basi kwa kuwa Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli, amewafukuza Waamori watoke mbele ya watu wake Israeli, wewe unayo haki gani ya kuitamalaki?

english: Do you not possess whatever your god Chemosh grants you? So also, we possess whatever the LORD our God has granted us.
ekegusii: Aye togotwara egento Kemosi, enyasae yao, yakoeire, kebe ekiao? Naboigo naintwe ’natoire ense y’ abanto bari’Omonene Nyasae aseretie korwa ase obosio bwaito.
swahili: Je, haikupasi kuchukua kile ambacho mungu wako Kemoshi amekupa? Vivyo hivyo, chochote kile Bwana Mungu wetu alichotupa sisi, tutakimiliki.

english: Are you now so much better than Balak son of Zippor, king of Moab? Did he ever contend with Israel or fight against them?
ekegusii: Bono aye nigo okorengereria ng’a n’omuya ore kobua Balaki, mosinto o Sipori, omorwoti bw’Abamoabu? Inee! Ere nomanete n’Abaisraeli nonya ng’ake? Gose narwanete esegi nabarabwo?
swahili: Je, wewe ni bora kuliko Balaki mwana wa Sipori, mfalme wa Moabu? Je, yeye alishagombana na Israeli au kupigana nao wakati wowote?

english: For three hundred years Israel has lived in Heshbon, Aroer, and their villages, as well as all the cities along the banks of the Arnon. Why did you not take them back during that time?
ekegusii: Ase engaki y’emiaka amagana atato Abaisraeli nigo bamenyete Hesiboni n’Aroeri, amo nebimechie bionsi biaetanaine emechie eyio, na emechie yonsi yaare ase chingegu chi’Arinoni. Nase ki motairete chinse echio ase engaki eyio yonsi?
swahili: Kwa maana kwa miaka 300 Israeli wameishi Heshboni na vijiji vyake, Aroeri na vijiji vyake, na katika miji yote iliyo kando ya Arnoni. Kwa nini wewe haukuyachukua wakati huo?

english: I have not sinned against you, but you have done me wrong by waging war against me. May the LORD, the Judge, decide today between the Israelites and the Ammonites.”
