ekegusii: Gidioni agatoma abanto ase ense yonsi y’ebitunwa bia Efraimu bateebe, “Tirimboka gochia maate, morwanie Abamidiani; mobwate ebiambokero bie chindooche goikera Beti‐Bara, amo nebia Yorodani.” Ase igo abanto ba Efraimu bagasangererigwa amo, bakabwata ebiambokero goikera Beti‐Bara, na ebia Yorodani boigo.
swahili: Gideoni akatuma wajumbe katika nchi yote ya vilima vya Efraimu akisema, “Teremkeni dhidi ya Wamidiani na mkazuie vivuko vya maji mbele yao hadi Beth-Bara na pia Yordani.” Hivyo watu wote wa Efraimu wakakutanika pamoja na kuzingira mto wa Yordani hadi Beth-Bara.

english: They also captured Oreb and Zeeb, the two princes of Midian; and they killed Oreb at the rock of Oreb and Zeeb at the winepress of Zeeb. So they pursued the Midianites and brought the heads of Oreb and Zeeb to Gideon on the other side of the Jordan.
ekegusii: Bakabwata abagaambi babere b’Abamidiani, Orebu na Seebu. Bagaitera Orebu ase Egetare kia Orebu, na Seebu bakamoitera ase ekemitero gi’edivai gia Seebu, na bakagenderera kobwatia Abamidiani. Omotwe bw’Orebu na oyo Seebu bakayeirera Gidioni aase arenge, moocha ya Yorodani.
swahili: Wakawakamata wakuu wawili wa Midiani, Orebu na Zeebu. Wakamuulia Orebu pale penye mwamba wa Orebu, na Zeebu wakamuulia penye shinikizo la kukamulia divai la Zeebu. Wakawafuatia Wamidiani na kuleta vichwa vya Orebu na Zeebu kwa Gideoni, huko ngʼambo ya Yordani.

english: Now, therefore, proclaim in the hearing of the people: ‘Whoever is fearful and trembling may turn back and leave Mount Gilead.’” So twenty-two thousand of them turned back, but ten thousand remained.
ekegusii: Ase ayio, raria ase abanto, obateebie: Onde bwensi ore n’obwoba n’omoondoko, airane gochia ’nka na arue egetunwa kia Gileadi.” Abanto chilifu emerongo ebere na ibere, bakairana, bakageenda, n’abanto chilifu ikomi bagatigara.
swahili: kwa hiyo sasa tangaza jeshi lote likiwa linasikia, kwamba: Yeyote anayeogopa na kutetemeka, yeye na arudi nyumbani, aondoke katika Mlima Gileadi.’ ” Hivyo watu 22,000 walirudi, wakabaki 10,000.

english: Then the LORD said to Gideon, “There are still too many people. Take them down to the water, and I will sift them for you there. If I say to you, ‘This one shall go with you,’ he shall go. But if I say, ‘This one shall not go with you,’ he shall not go.”
ekegusii: Naende Omonene agateebia Gidioni, “Nonya ’mbono abanto aba nigo bare abange mono; tiga batirimboke gochia rooche, na inche ’nkobaatananere aroro. Ase onde bwensi ’ndagoteebie: Omonto oyo nanyaare kogeenda amo naye, oyio agende; na ase onde bwensi ’ndagoteebie: Omonto oyo takogeenda amo naye, oyio takogeenda.”
swahili: Lakini Bwana akamwambia Gideoni, “Idadi ya jeshi bado ni kubwa. Wapeleke chini katika maji nami nitawajaribu huko kwa ajili yako. Kama nikikuambia, ‘Huyu atakwenda pamoja nawe,’ yeye atakwenda; lakini kama nikisema, ‘Huyu hatakwenda pamoja nawe,’ yeye hatakwenda.”

english: So Gideon brought the people down to the water, and the LORD said to him, “Separate those who lap the water with their tongues like a dog from those who kneel to drink.”
ekegusii: Ase igo Gidioni agatirimbokia abanto baria gochia rooche, n’Omonene akamoteebia, “Onde bwensi oraabe ogosiara amaache n’oromeme gochia monwa oye, buna esese egosiara, omobeeke ensemo eyemo; na onde bwensi oratung’ame inse namaru konywa amaache, omobeeke ensemo eng’ao.”
swahili: Hivyo Gideoni akalileta lile jeshi chini kwenye maji naye Bwana akamwambia Gideoni, “Watenge upande mmoja wale wote wanywao maji kwa ulimi, kama vile mbwa anywavyo, wale wote wapigao magoti ili kunywa wakipeleka mikono yao vinywani mwao, waweke upande mwingine.”

english: And the number of those who lapped the water with their hands to their mouths was three hundred men; all the others knelt to drink.
ekegusii: Abanto baria basiarete amaache ase okoyasiara gochia monwa n’ebiara bi’amaboko abo, nigo barenge amagana atato. Na abatigarete nigo batung’amete n’amaru inse, bakanywa.
swahili: Idadi ya wale waliokunywa kwa kuramba ramba walikuwa 300, lakini wengine wote katika jeshi walipiga magoti ili kunywa.

english: Then the LORD said to Gideon, “With the three hundred men who lapped the water I will save you and deliver the Midianites into your hand. But all the others are to go home.”
ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Gidioni, “Ase abanto aba amagana atato basiara amaache gochia monwa nimbatoorie inwe na kobeeka Abamidiani ase amaboko ao, korende tiga abanto bande bonsi bairane, kera oyomo ase enka yaye.”
swahili: Bwana akamwambia Gideoni, “Kwa hao watu 300 walioramba maji nitawaokoa ninyi, nami nitawatia Wamidiani mkononi mwako. Waache hao watu wengine wote warudi kila mmoja nyumbani mwake.”

english: So Gideon sent the rest of the Israelites to their tents but kept the three hundred men, who took charge of the provisions and rams’ horns of the others. And the camp of Midian lay below him in the valley. The Sword of Gideon
ekegusii: Nabo Gidioni akarusia ase bare endagera eye babwate amo n’ebitureri, agateebia Abaisraeli bonsi, otatiga abwo amagana atato, bairane ’nka. Egetwori ki’Abamidiani nigo kiarenge maate yabo ase ense omweya.
swahili: Hivyo Gideoni akawaacha wale Waisraeli wengine kila mmoja aende kwenye hema yake. Akabakia na wale 300, ambao walichukua vyakula na tarumbeta za wale wenzao. Basi kambi ya Wamidiani ilikuwa chini yake bondeni.

english: That night the LORD said to Gideon, “Get up and go down against the camp, for I have delivered it into your hand.
ekegusii: Ase obotuko bori’Omonene agateebia Gidioni, “Imoka, otirimboke gochia ase egetwori kiabo okeumokere, ekiagera nababeekire ase amaboko ao.
swahili: Usiku ule ule Bwana akamwambia Gideoni, “Ondoka, ushuke kambini, kwa kuwa nimeitia mkononi mwako.

english: Then the men of Ephraim said to Gideon, “Why have you done this to us? Why did you fail to call us when you went to fight against Midian?” And they contended with him violently.
ekegusii: Abanto ba Efraimu bakabooria Gidioni, “Nase ki otatorangeretie ekero kwagendete korwania Abamidiani? Inki eke gwatokoreire?” Naende bakamwomania, bare n’obotindi obonge mono.
swahili: Basi Waefraimu wakamuuliza Gideoni, “Mbona mmetutenda hivi? Kwa nini hukutuita ulipokwenda kupigana na Wamidiani?” Wakawalaumu kwa ukali sana.

english: Now Zebah and Zalmunna were in Karkor with their army of about fifteen thousand men—all that were left of the armies of the people of the east. A hundred and twenty thousand swordsmen had already fallen.
ekegusii: Bono Seba na Salimuna nigo barenge agwo Karikori amo n’abarwani babo chilifu ikomi na isano. Ase abarwani ba moocha nabwo boka batigarete. Abarwani chilifu rigana erimo, na merongo ebere, abarwanete n’emioro, konya baitirwe.
swahili: Wakati huu Zeba na Salmuna walikuwa Karkori wakiwa na jeshi lenye watu wapatao 15,000 wale wote waliokuwa wamesalia wa mataifa ya mashariki, kwa kuwa watu wapatao 120,000 wenye panga walikuwa wameuawa.

english: And Gideon went up by way of the caravan route east of Nobah and Jogbehah, and he attacked their army, taking them by surprise.
ekegusii: Gidioni agatiirera enchera abagendi banarete goeta, moocha ya Noba na Yogibea, akaumokera omoganda bw’abarwani ekero orenge n’obotoereru.
swahili: Basi Gideoni akakwea kwa njia ya wasafiri mashariki ya Noba na Yogbeha na kulishambulia jeshi ambalo halikushuku lolote.

english: When Zebah and Zalmunna fled, Gideon pursued and captured these two kings of Midian, routing their entire army.
ekegusii: Seba na Salimuna, abarwoti baria babere b’Abamidiani, bagatama, korende Gidioni akababwatia goika akababeeka biara. Erio akagosa abarwani bonsi na kobaserebania.
swahili: Zeba na Salmuna, hao wafalme wawili wa Midiani, wakakimbia lakini yeye Gideoni akawafuata na kuwakamata, akalishinda hilo jeshi lao lote.

english: After this, Gideon son of Joash returned from the battle along the Ascent of Heres.
ekegusii: Ekero Gidioni, mosinto o Yoashi, airanete korwa ase esegi agaetera ebitirimboko bia Heresi,
swahili: Gideoni mwana wa Yoashi akarudi kutoka vitani kwa kupitia Mwinuko wa Heresi.

english: There he captured a young man of Succoth and interrogated him. The young man wrote down for him the names of the seventy-seven leaders and elders of Succoth.
ekegusii: akabwata omomura omosae oyomo o Sukoti, akamoboora‐booria amang’ana, omomura oyio akamoriikera amarieta y’ abanto abanene, na abagaaka ba Sukoti, emerongo etano n’ebere, na batano na babere.
swahili: Akamkamata kijana mmoja wa Sukothi na kumuuliza maswali, naye yule kijana akamwandikia majina ya maafisa sabini wa Sukothi, ambao ni viongozi wa mji.

english: And Gideon went to the men of Succoth and said, “Here are Zebah and Zalmunna, about whom you taunted me, saying, ‘Are the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna already in your possession, that we should give bread to your weary men?’”
ekegusii: Erio Gidioni akageenda ase abanto ba Sukoti, akabateebia, “Rora aiga Seba na Salimuna, baria inwe mwanyomaneretie mogoteeba iga: Torabua Seba na Salimuna. Naki rende torakore toe abarwani bao, abwo bagoyire, emegati!”
swahili: Ndipo Gideoni akaja na kuwaambia watu wa Sukothi, “Tazama, hapa wapo Zeba na Salmuna mlionisimanga kwa ajili yao mkisema, ‘Je, mikono ya Zeba na Salmuna tayari mnayo sasa ili tuweze kulipatia jeshi lako mikate?’ ”

english: Then he took the elders of the city, and using the thorns and briers of the wilderness, he disciplined the men of Succoth.
ekegusii: Akaimokia amagwa y’orosana na amageri akabaaria abagaaka b’omochie oria.
swahili: Akawachukua hao viongozi wa mji na kuwafundisha watu wa Sukothi somo kwa kuwaadhibu kwa miiba na michongoma ya nyikani.

english: He also pulled down the tower of Penuel and killed the men of the city.
ekegusii: Erio agataagora omoorobiri agwo Penueli, na agaita abasacha b’omochie oria.
swahili: Pia akaubomoa mnara wa Penieli na kuwaua watu wa mji.

english: Next, Gideon asked Zebah and Zalmunna, “What kind of men did you kill at Tabor?” “Men like you,” they answered, “each one resembling the son of a king.”
ekegusii: Erio Gidioni akabooria Seba na Salimuna, “Inee! Abanto baria mwaitete agwo Tabori, ’nkieni ki barenge?” Bakamoiraneria, “Kera oyomo obo nigo akogwekaine. Nigo barorekanete buna bare abana b’omorwoti.”
swahili: Kisha akawauliza Zeba na Salmuna, “Ni watu wa aina gani mliowaua huko Tabori?” Wakajibu, “Ni watu kama wewe, kila mmoja wao akiwa na nafasi ya uana wa mfalme.”

english: “They were my brothers,” Gideon replied, “the sons of my mother! As surely as the LORD lives, if you had let them live, I would not kill you.”
ekegusii: Gidioni akabateebia, “Baria nigo barenge bamura baminto, abamura ba baba. Amaene, buna Omonene are moyo, onye ’mwabatigete babe moyo, inche nanga tinabaita inwe!”
swahili: Gideoni akajibu, “Hao walikuwa ndugu zangu, wana wa mama yangu hasa. Hakika kama aishivyo Bwana, kama mngekuwa mmewaacha hai, mimi nisingewaua ninyi.”

english: But Gideon answered them, “Now what have I accomplished compared to you? Are not the gleanings of Ephraim better than the grape harvest of Abiezer?
ekegusii: Ere akabairaneria, “Ngento ki nakorire inche kegwekaine eki mwakorire inwe? Inee! Ogochoora kw’amasabibu amatigari kw’Abaefraimu tikori okuya kobua rigesa ri’emesabibu n’abanto b’Abieseri?
swahili: Gideoni akawajibu, “Nilichofanya mimi ni nini kulinganisha na kile ninyi mlichofanya? Je, kuokoa masazo ya zabibu za Efraimu si bora kuliko mavuno kamili ya zabibu ya Abiezeri?

english: So he said to Jether, his firstborn, “Get up and kill them.” But the young man did not draw his sword; he was fearful because he was still a youth.
ekegusii: Naende agateebia Yeteri, omwana oye omomura omotangi, “Imoka, obaite!” Korende omwana oyio tang’usa omoyio oye o birende, ekiagera nigo arenge omosae omoke.
swahili: Akamgeukia Yetheri, mwanawe mzaliwa wa kwanza, akasema, “Waue hawa!” Lakini Yetheri hakuufuta upanga wake, kwa sababu aliogopa, kwa kuwa alikuwa bado kijana mdogo tu.

english: Then Zebah and Zalmunna said, “Get up and kill us yourself, for as the man is, so is his strength.” So Gideon got up and killed Zebah and Zalmunna, and he took the crescent ornaments from the necks of their camels. Gideon’s Ephod
ekegusii: Erio Seba na Salimuna bagateebia Gidioni, “Imoka aye omonyene, otoite, ekiagera buna omonto are, naboigo ne chinguru chiaye chire.” Ere akaimoka, agaita Seba na Salimuna; akarusia chisonoi chi’ogwechabera chiarenge ase amagoti ye’chingamia chiabo.
swahili: Zeba na Salmuna wakasema, “Njoo ufanye hivyo wewe mwenyewe. ‘Alivyo mtu, ndivyo zilivyo nguvu zake.’ ” Hivyo Gideoni akatoka mbele na kuwaua, naye akayaondoa mapambo kwenye shingo za ngamia zao. Kisibau Cha Gideoni

english: Then the Israelites said to Gideon, “Rule over us—you and your son and grandson—for you have saved us from the hand of Midian.”
ekegusii: Magega y’ayio Abaisraeli bagateebia Gidioni, “Gwatobooririe korwa ase amaboko y’Abamidiani; ase ayio kabe omogambi oito; na magega yao omwana oo na omochokoro oo ’nabatogambere.”
swahili: Waisraeli wakamwambia Gideoni, “Ututawale, wewe, wanao na wana wa wana wako, kwa kuwa umetuokoa kutoka mikononi mwa Wamidiani.”

english: But Gideon replied, “I will not rule over you, nor will my son. The LORD shall rule over you.”
ekegusii: Gidioni akabairaneria, “Inche tinkobagambera, gose omwana one takobagambera; Omonene nere orabagaambere.”
swahili: Lakini Gideoni akawaambia, “Mimi sitatawala juu yenu, wala wanangu hawatatawala juu yenu. Bwana ndiye atakayetawala juu yenu ninyi.”

english: Then he added, “Let me make a request of you, that each of you give me an earring from his plunder.” (For the enemies had gold earrings because they were Ishmaelites.)
ekegusii: Naende akabateebia, “Nkobasaba ’nde egento ekemo: Kera omonto ase more ang’e ebigera bire ase amato aye, biria asakorete.” (Abamidiani nigo babegete ebigera bie chitaabu, ekiagera n’Abaisumaeli barenge.)
swahili: Naye akasema, “Ninalo ombi moja, kwamba kila mmoja wenu anipatie kipuli kutoka kwenye fungu lake la nyara.” (Ilikuwa desturi ya Waishmaeli kuvaa vipuli vya dhahabu.)

english: “We will give them gladly,” they replied. So they spread out a garment, and each man threw an earring from his plunder onto it.
ekegusii: Barabwo bakamoiraneria, “Twanchire gokobia.” Erio bakaara egetambaa inse, na ase egetambaa ekio kera oyomo akabeeka ebigera biaye bi’amato ebio basakorete.
swahili: Wakajibu, “Tutafurahi kuvitoa.” Hivyo wakatanda vazi chini na kila mwanaume akatupia juu yake pete kutoka kwenye fungu lake la nyara.

english: The weight of the gold earrings he had requested was 1,700 shekels, in addition to the crescent ornaments, the pendants, the purple garments of the kings of Midian, and the chains from the necks of their camels.
ekegusii: Oborito bw’e’bigera biria asabeete aegwe nigo bwarenge koreng’ana chikiiro emerongo ebere. Amo n’ebio akaira chisonoi, n’ebigera, ne chianga chimonyinga, ebinto abarwoti b’Abamidiani barenge kobeeka, amo ne chisonoi chiria chiarenge ase amagoti ye’chingamia chiabo.
swahili: Uzito wa pete za dhahabu alizoomba zilifikia shekeli 1,700, bila kuhesabu mapambo mengine, pete za masikio na mavazi ya zambarau yaliyovaliwa na wafalme wa Midiani, au mikufu iliyokuwa kwenye shingo za ngamia zao.

english: From all this Gideon made an ephod, which he placed in Ophrah, his hometown. But soon all Israel prostituted themselves by worshiping it there, and it became a snare to Gideon and his household. Forty Years of Peace
ekegusii: Gidioni akaroisia egesibao ki’obokuani korwa ase chitaabu chiria, agakebeeka ase omochie oye bw’Ofura; n’Abaisraeli bonsi bagatiga koba abegenwa ase Omonene, bagasasiima egesibao keria. Kerokio gekaba kegotega Gidioni amo n’eamate yaye.
swahili: Gideoni akatengeneza kisibau kwa kutumia ile dhahabu, ambacho alikiweka katika mji wake, yaani, Ofra. Waisraeli wote wakafanya uasherati kwa kukiabudu huko, nacho kikawa mtego kwa Gideoni na jamaa yake.

english: In this way Midian was subdued before the Israelites and did not raise its head again. So the land had rest for forty years in the days of Gideon,
ekegusii: Nabo Abamidiani babuetwe n’Abaisraeli, na tibanyaara koimoka gokora kende. Na bono ense eria ekaba n’omorembe ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ene, goika Gidioni agakwa. Ogokwa kwa Gidioni
swahili: Hivyo Midiani ikashindwa mbele ya Israeli nayo haikuinua kichwa chake tena. Wakati wa siku za uhai wa Gideoni, nchi ikafurahia amani miaka arobaini. Kifo Cha Gideoni

english: and he—Jerubbaal son of Joash—returned home and settled down.
ekegusii: Yerubi‐Baali, mosinto o Yoashi, akairana ’nka, akamenya ase enyomba yaye omonyene.
swahili: Yerub-Baali mwana wa Yoashi akarudi kwenda kuishi katika nyumba yake.

english: God has delivered Oreb and Zeeb, the two princes of Midian, into your hand. What was I able to do compared to you?” When he had said this, their anger against him subsided.
ekegusii: Nyasae obeekire Orebu na Seebu, abagaambi b’Abamidiani, ase amaboko aino. Inche ’ngento ki nakorire kegwekaine eki mwakorire inwe?” Ekero baigwete aya Gidioni akwanete, endamwamu yabo y’okomobea egakenda.
swahili: Mungu amewatia Orebu na Zeebu, hao viongozi wa Wamidiani, mikononi mwenu. Je, mimi niliweza kufanya nini kulinganisha na mlichofanya ninyi?” Aliposema hili, hasira yao dhidi yake ikatulia.

english: Gideon had seventy sons of his own, since he had many wives.
ekegusii: Gidioni oyio nigo abwate abana abamura emerongo etano na babere, ekiagera nigo abwate abakungu abange.
swahili: Alikuwa na wana sabini wa kwake mwenyewe, kwa kuwa alikuwa na wake wengi.

english: His concubine, who dwelt in Shechem, also bore him a son, and he named him Abimelech. Gideon’s Death
ekegusii: Naboigo nabwate omokungu o sere-sere, oyi’omenyete Sekemu; nere akamoiborera omwana omomura, na Gidioni akamoroka Abimeleki.
swahili: Suria wake, aliyekuwa anaishi huko Shekemu, pia alimzalia mwana, ambaye alimwita Abimeleki.

english: Later, Gideon son of Joash died at a ripe old age and was buried in the tomb of his father Joash in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.
ekegusii: Gidioni, mosinto o Yoashi, agakwa ore n’obogotu obuya, agatindekwa ase embeera ya Yoashi ise yarenge agwo omochie bw’egesaku ki’Abieseri bw’Ofura.
swahili: Gideoni mwana wa Yoashi akafa akiwa na umri mzuri wa uzee, na akazikwa katika kaburi la Yoashi baba yake huko Ofra ya Waabiezeri.

english: And as soon as Gideon was dead, the Israelites turned and prostituted themselves with the Baals, and they set up Baal-berith as their god.
ekegusii: Magega y’ogokwa kwa Gidioni, Abaisraeli bagatiga koba abegenwa ase Omonene, na bagasasiima chinyasae chiria Baali. Bagachoora Baali‐Beriti ekaba enyasae yabo,
swahili: Mara tu alipofariki Gideoni, Waisraeli wakarudia hali ya uovu na kufanya uasherati kwa kuabudu Mabaali. Wakamsimamisha Baal-Berithi kuwa mungu wao na

english: The Israelites failed to remember the LORD their God who had delivered them from the hands of all their enemies on every side.
ekegusii: bakeba Omonene, Nyasae obo, oy’obatooretie korwa ase amaboko ’ababisa baabo baabaetanaine.
swahili: wala hawakumkumbuka Bwana Mungu wao, aliyewaokoa kutoka mikononi mwa adui zao wote kutoka kila upande.

english: They did not show kindness to the house of Jerubbaal (that is, Gideon) for all the good things he had done for Israel.
ekegusii: Tibakorerete abanto b’eamate ya Yerubi‐Baali (nere Gidioni) amaya, ase okoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono ase amaya onsi abakorerete Abaisraeli.
swahili: Pia wakashindwa kuitendea mema jamaa ya Yerub-Baali (yaani Gideoni) kwa ajili ya mambo yote mema aliyokuwa amefanya kwa ajili yao.

english: Then Gideon and his three hundred men came to the Jordan and crossed it, exhausted yet still in pursuit.
ekegusii: Bono Gidioni amo n’abanto baye amagana atato bagaacha Yorodani, bakaamboka. Nonya konya bagoyire, bakagenderera kobwatia ababisa babo.
swahili: Gideoni akiwa pamoja na wale watu 300 waliofuatana naye, wakiwa wamechoka na wenye njaa lakini bado wakiwafuatia, wakafika Yordani na kuuvuka.

english: So Gideon said to the men of Succoth, “Please give my troops some bread, for they are exhausted, and I am still pursuing Zebah and Zalmunna, the kings of Midian.”
ekegusii: Gidioni agateebia abanto ba Sukoti, “Komoranche moe abanto aba bagontunyana emegati. Barabwo bagoyire, nainche ’nkobwatia inde Seba na Salimuna, abarwoti b’Abamidiani, mbarwanie.”
swahili: Akawaambia watu wa Sukothi, “Tafadhali lipatieni jeshi langu mikate, kwa maana wamechoka, nami ningali ninawafuatia Zeba na Salmuna, wafalme wa Midiani.”

english: But the leaders of Succoth asked, “Are the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna already in your possession, that we should give bread to your army?”
ekegusii: Korende abatang’ani ba Sukoti bagateeba, “Naki rende torakore tobae abarwani bao emegati? Naye torabua Seba na Salimuna.”
swahili: Lakini maafisa wa Sukothi wakasema, “Je, mikono ya Zeba na Salmuna tayari mnayo sasa ili tuweze kulipatia jeshi lako mikate?”

english: “Very well,” Gideon replied, “when the LORD has delivered Zebah and Zalmunna into my hand, I will tear your flesh with the thorns and briers of the wilderness!”
ekegusii: Gidioni akairaneria, “Ekero Omonene arabeeke Seba na Salimuna ase amaboko ane, ning’arie chinyama chi’emebere yaino n’amagwa y’orosana na amageri.”
swahili: Gideoni akajibu, “Kwa ajili ya hilo tu, Bwana atakapowatia Zeba na Salmuna mkononi mwangu, nitaichana nyama ya miili yenu kwenye miiba ya nyikani na kwenye michongoma.”

english: From there he went up to Penuel and asked the same from them, but the men of Penuel gave the same response as the men of Succoth.
ekegusii: Erio Gidioni agatiga Sukoti, akageenda gochia Penueli na agwo akabooria abanto amang’ana aria aria, korende abanto ba Penueli bakamoiraneria buna abanto ba Sukoti bamoiraneretie.
swahili: Kutoka hapo alikwea mpaka Penieli na kutoa ombi lile lile, lakini nao watu wa Penieli wakamjibu kama watu wa Sukothi walivyokuwa wamemjibu.

english: So Gideon told the men of Penuel, “When I return in triumph, I will tear down this tower!”
ekegusii: Ase igo akabateebia, “Ekero ’ndachiche naende inde n’obobui, nintagore omoorobiri oyo.”
swahili: Hivyo akawaambia watu wa Penieli, “Nitakaporudi baada ya kushinda, nitaubomoa mnara huu.”

english: Now Abimelech son of Jerubbaal went to his mother’s brothers at Shechem and said to them and to all the clan of his mother,
ekegusii: Abimeleki, mosinto o Yerubi‐Baali, akageenda Sekemu, ase abaang’inarome, na ase abanto bonsi b’eamate ya ise ng’ina, akabateebia
swahili: Siku moja Abimeleki mwana wa Yerub-Baali akaenda kwa ndugu ya mama yake huko Shekemu na kuwaambia yeye na ukoo wote wa mama yake,

english: Then the trees said to the fig tree, ‘Come and reign over us.’
ekegusii: Erio emete egateebia omoko: Inchuo aye otogambere!
swahili: “Kisha miti ikauambia mtini, ‘Njoo na uwe mfalme wetu!’

english: But the fig tree replied, ‘Should I stop giving my sweetness and my good fruit, to hold sway over the trees?’
ekegusii: Korende omoko oria okairaneria: Nigo ’ngotiga obwansu bwane n’amatunda ane amaya, erinde ’ngambere emete ende?
swahili: “Lakini mtini ukaijibu, ‘Je, niache kutoa matunda yangu mazuri na matamu, ili niende nikawe juu ya miti?’

english: Then the trees said to the grapevine, ‘Come and reign over us.’
ekegusii: Emete egateebia omosabibu: Inchuo aye otogambere!
swahili: “Ndipo miti ikauambia mzabibu, ‘Njoo na uwe mfalme wetu.’

english: But the grapevine replied, ‘Should I stop giving my wine that cheers both God and man, to hold sway over the trees?’
ekegusii: Korende omosabibu okairaneria: Nigo ’ngotiga okorua edivai yane, eria ekogokia chinyasae na Mwanyabaanto, erinde ’ngambere emete ende?
swahili: “Lakini mzabibu ukaijibu, ‘Je, niache kutoa divai yangu inayofurahisha miungu na wanadamu ili nikawe juu ya miti?’

english: Finally all the trees said to the thornbush, ‘Come and reign over us.’
ekegusii: Erio emete yonsi egateebia egetutu ki’amagwa: Inchuo aye otogambere!
swahili: “Mwishoni miti yote ikauambia mti wa miiba, ‘Njoo na uwe mfalme wetu.’

english: But the thornbush replied, ‘If you really are anointing me as king over you, come and find refuge in my shade. But if not, may fire come out of the thornbush and consume the cedars of Lebanon.’
ekegusii: Na egetutu ki’amagwa gekairaneria emete yonsi: Onye ekeene mwanchire gonchoora imbe omogambi oino, inchwo mokenderere inse y’ekiriri kiane, korende onye taibo, tiga omorero osoke korwa ase chinsagia chiane chi’amagwa, osambe emecharake ya Lebanoni.
swahili: “Nao mti wa miiba ukaijibu, ‘Kama kweli mnataka niwe mfalme wenu, basi njooni mpate kupumzika chini ya kivuli changu. Lakini kama sivyo, moto na utoke kwenye mti wa miiba ukateketeze mierezi ya Lebanoni!’

english: Now if you have acted faithfully and honestly in making Abimelech king, if you have done well by Jerubbaal and his family, and if you have done to him as he deserves—
ekegusii: “Na bono, Inee, nigo ’mwakorete ayaare boronge na ay’obwegenwa ekero mwachoorete Abimeleki akaba omorwoti oino? Naende ’mwakorerete Yerubi‐Baali na ab’enyomba yaye boronge na ay’amogwenerete ase ogokora kwaye?
swahili: “Basi ikiwa mmetenda kwa uaminifu na heshima kumfanya Abimeleki kuwa mfalme, na kama mmetendea vyema Yerub-Baali na jamaa yake kama ilivyostahili:

english: for my father fought for you and risked his life to deliver you from the hand of Midian,
ekegusii: Inyora ng’a nigo arwanete esegi ase engencho yaino. Nigo ebeegete ang’e ase ogokwa ase okobatooria korwa ase Abamidiani.
swahili: kwa kuwa baba yangu aliwapigania ninyi na kuhatarisha nafsi yake na kuwaokoa ninyi kutoka mikononi mwa Wamidiani

english: but you have risen up against my father’s house this day and killed his seventy sons on a single stone, and you have made Abimelech, the son of his maidservant, king over the leaders of Shechem because he is your brother—
ekegusii: Reero inwe mwabeire mamincha y’enyomba ya tata, na mwaiteire abana baye abamura, abanto emerongo etano n’ebere, ase rigena erimo igoro, naende mwabeekire Abimeleki, omwana bw’omosomba oye omokungu, obeire omorwoti bw’ abanto ba Sekemu, ekiagera are momura omino.
swahili: (lakini leo mmeasi dhidi ya jamaa ya baba yangu, na kuwaua wanawe sabini juu ya jiwe moja, nanyi mkamfanya Abimeleki mwana wa mwanamke mtumwa kuwa mfalme juu ya Shekemu, kwa kuwa yeye ni ndugu yenu),

english: if you have acted faithfully and honestly toward Jerubbaal and his house this day, then may you rejoice in Abimelech, and he in you.
ekegusii: Onye reero mwakoreire Yerubi‐Baali amo nab’enyomba yaye ayaare boronge nay’obwegenwa, rirorio gookera Abimeleki, nere tiga abagookere.
swahili: nanyi kama basi mmemtendea Yerub-Baali na jamaa yake kwa heshima na uaminifu, basi Abimeleki na awe furaha yenu, nanyi mwe furaha yake pia!

english: “Please ask all the leaders of Shechem, ‘Is it better for you that seventy men, all the sons of Jerubbaal, rule over you, or just one man?’ Remember that I am your own flesh and blood.”
ekegusii: ng’a ’mbaborie abanto ba Sekemu, “Inki kere ekiya kobua, ng’a abana abamura emerongo etano n’ebere ba Yerubi‐Baali baabagaambere, gose omonto oyomo bweka abagaambere? Inyora boigo ng’a Abimeleki nigo are oyomino bw’amanyinga ayamo kegima.”
swahili: “Waulizeni watu wote wa Shekemu, ‘Lipi lililo bora kwenu: Kutawaliwa na wana wote sabini wa Yerub-Baali, au mtu mmoja peke yake?’ Kumbukeni kwamba, mimi ni mfupa wenu nyama yenu hasa.”

english: But if not, may fire come from Abimelech and consume the leaders of Shechem and Beth-millo, and may fire come from the leaders of Shechem and Beth-millo and consume Abimelech.”
ekegusii: Korende onye taibo, tiga omorero osoke korwa ase Abimeleki obasambe inwe abamomenyete Sekemu na Beti‐Milo, obasirie; naende tiga omorero osoke korwa ase more inwe abamomenyete Sekemu na Beti‐Milo, osambe Abimeleki, omosirie.”
swahili: Lakini kama sivyo, moto na utoke kwa Abimeleki na uwateketeze, ninyi watu wa Shekemu na Beth-Milo, nao moto utoke kwenu, watu wa Shekemu na Beth-Milo umteketeze Abimeleki!”

english: Then Jotham ran away, escaping to Beer, and he lived there for fear of his brother Abimelech. Gaal Conspires with the Shechemites
ekegusii: Erio Yotamu akamonyoka, agatama gochia Beeri, akamenya agwo, ekiagera airogete Abimeleki momura omwabo.
swahili: Ndipo Yothamu akakimbia, akatoroka akaenda Beeri, akaishi huko, kwa sababu alimwogopa ndugu yake Abimeleki.

english: After Abimelech had reigned over Israel for three years,
ekegusii: Abimeleki akagaambera Abaisraeli ase engaki y’emiaka etato.
swahili: Baada ya Abimeleki kutawala Israeli kwa muda wa miaka mitatu,

english: God sent a spirit of animosity between Abimelech and the leaders of Shechem and caused them to treat Abimelech deceitfully,
ekegusii: Erio Nyasae agatoma omoika omobe ase ogwatanan’Abimeleki n’abanto ba Sekemu, n’abanto aba bagakorera Abimeleki obong’ainereria.
swahili: Mungu akaruhusu roho mbaya kati ya Abimeleki na watu wa Shekemu, nao watu wa Shekemu wakamtendea Abimeleki kwa hila.

english: in order that the crime against the seventy sons of Jerubbaal might come to justice and their blood be avenged on their brother Abimelech and on the leaders of Shechem, who had helped him murder his brothers.
ekegusii: Aya nigo abeete bo, erinde obobe obwo bwakoreretwe abana abamura baria ba Yerubi‐Baali emerongo etano n’ebere boakanerwe egesiomba. Ase igo okomocha kw’ogoiterwa kw’amanyinga abo kogaakanerwa igoro y’Abimeleki, oyio obaitete, naende igoro y’ abanto ba Sekemu, abwo bamobegete chinguru chi’ogokora ayio.
swahili: Hili lilitokea ili ule ukatili waliotendewa hao wana sabini wa Yerub-Baali upatilizwe, na damu yao iwe juu ya Abimeleki ndugu yao aliyewaua, na pia iwe juu ya watu wa Shekemu, ambao walimsaidia kuua ndugu zake.

english: The leaders of Shechem set up an ambush against Abimelech on the hilltops, and they robbed all who passed by them on the road. So this was reported to Abimelech.
ekegusii: Abanto ba Sekemu bakabeeka abanto ase ebitunwa igoro baboere abanto bonsi barenge goeta ase chinchera chiria na kobaura ebinto biabo. Abimeleki agateebigwa amang’ana ayio.
swahili: Hivyo, kutokana na uadui juu yake watu wa Shekemu wakaweka watu wa kumvizia katika vilele vya milima. Wakawanyangʼanya watu wote waliopita karibu nao, nayo haya yakaarifiwa kwa Abimeleki.

english: Meanwhile, Gaal son of Ebed came with his brothers and crossed into Shechem, and the leaders of Shechem put their confidence in him.
ekegusii: Gaali, mosinto bw’Ebedi, agacha Sekemu amo n’abamura bamwabo, n’abanto ba Sekemu bakamwegena na komosemeria.
swahili: Basi Gaali mwana wa Ebedi akaenda pamoja na ndugu zake wakaingia Shekemu, nao watu wa huko wakamtumainia yeye.

english: And after they had gone out into the fields, gathered grapes from their vineyards, and trodden them, they held a festival and went into the house of their god; and as they ate and drank, they cursed Abimelech.
ekegusii: Barabwo bonsi bakageenda ase emegondo y’emesabibu, bagatora amasabibu, bakayamita, bakaroisia edivai na gokora omoyega omonene. Bagasoa ase enyomba y’enyasae yabo, bakaria na konywa, erio bakaragereria Abimeleki.
swahili: Wakaenda mashambani mwao kuvuna zabibu na kuzisindika hizo zabibu, wakafanya sikukuu katika hekalu la mungu wao. Wakati wakila na kunywa, wakamlaani Abimeleki.

english: Then Gaal son of Ebed said, “Who is Abimelech, and who is Shechem, that we should serve him? Is he not the son of Jerubbaal, and is not Zebul his officer? You are to serve the men of Hamor, the father of Shechem. Why should we serve Abimelech?
ekegusii: Gaali, mosinto bw’Ebedi agateeba, “Abimeleki nere ng’o? Naintwe, abanto ba Sekemu, ’mbanto ki tore? Nase ki togokorera Abimeleki? Ere mosinto o Yerubi‐Baali! Na Sebuli, nere omoteneneri bw’ abanto baye! Nase ki rende togokorera Abimeleki? Taibo, tobe abegenwa ase abanto barwete Hamori, sokoro y’ abanto ba Sekemu!
swahili: Gaali mwana wa Ebedi akasema, “Abimeleki ni nani, na Shekemu ni nani, hata tumtumikie? Je, yeye si mwana wa Yerub-Baali? Naye Zebuli si ndiye msaidizi wake? Basi watumikieni watu wa Hamori, babaye Shekemu. Kwa nini tumtumikie Abimeleki?

english: If only this people were under my authority, I would remove Abimelech; I would say to him, ‘Muster your army and come out!’” The Fall of Shechem
ekegusii: Onye abanto aba ’nkoba barenge ase oborendi bwane, anga ’narusia Abimeleki. Nigo nare komoteebia: Menta abarwani bao b’esegi, erio ochiche korwana!”
swahili: Laiti watu hawa wangekuwa chini ya amri yangu! Basi mimi ningemwondoa huyo Abimeleki. Ningemwambia Abimeleki, ‘Ondoa jeshi lako lote.’ ”

english: And when his mother’s brothers spoke all these words about him in the presence of all the leaders of Shechem, their hearts were inclined to follow Abimelech, for they said, “He is our brother.”
ekegusii: Ase ayio aba’ng’inarome bagakwana amang’ana ayio ase abanto ba Sekemu ase ogokoonya Abimeleki, na bonsi bakang’uswa bakaba ase ensemo yaye, naende bagateeba ng’a ere n’oyomwabo orenge.
swahili: Ndugu za mama yake walipowaeleza watu wote wa Shekemu, wakaelekea kumkubali Abimeleki, kwa kuwa walisema, “Yeye ni ndugu yetu.”

english: When Zebul the governor of the city heard the words of Gaal son of Ebed, he burned with anger.
ekegusii: Ekero Sebuli, omogambi bw’omochie oria, aigwete amang’ana a Gaali, mosinto bw’Ebedi, akaba n’endamwamu enene.
swahili: Zebuli aliyekuwa mtawala wa mji aliposikia aliyosema Gaali mwana wa Ebedi, akakasirika sana.

english: So he covertly sent messengers to Abimelech to say, “Look, Gaal son of Ebed and his brothers have come to Shechem and are stirring up the city against you.
ekegusii: Agatoma abanto gochia ase Abimeleki bobisi bamoteebie, “Gaali, mosinto bw’Ebedi, amo nabamura bamwabo bachire Sekemu, goseegeta abanto b’omochie babe mamincha yao.
swahili: Akatuma ujumbe uende kwa Abimeleki kwa siri na kusema, “Gaali mwana wa Ebedi na ndugu zake wamekuja Shekemu, na wanauchochea mji huu kinyume chako.

english: Now then, tonight you and the people with you are to come and lie in wait in the fields.
ekegusii: Ase ayio, aye amo n’abanto bao more komo, geenda botuko mwebise, moboe ase ebitii.
swahili: Sasa, basi, usiku huu wewe uondoke na watu wako ili mje kuwavizia mashambani.

english: And in the morning at sunrise, get up and advance against the city. When Gaal and his men come out against you, do to them whatever you are able.”
ekegusii: Ankio mambia, ekero erioba rigosoka, moimoke bwango, moumokere omochie. Erio ekero Gaali n’abanto baria bare komo bakobaachera kobarwania, mobakorere buna amaboko aino aranyare ekero ekio!”
swahili: Kisha asubuhi wakati wa kuchomoza jua, amka mapema na ujipange dhidi ya huo mji. Wakati yeye na jeshi lililo pamoja naye watakapotoka kukabiliana nanyi, mwaweza kuwatendea kwa kadiri mnavyoweza.”

english: So Abimelech and all his troops set out by night and lay in wait against Shechem in four companies.
ekegusii: Abimeleki amo n’abanto bonsi barenge komo bakaimoka botuko, bakebisa, bakaboera Sekemu, bare ebiombe bine.
swahili: Kwa hiyo Abimeleki pamoja na jeshi lake lote wakaondoka usiku na kujificha karibu na Shekemu wakiwa vikosi vinne.

english: Now Gaal son of Ebed went out and stood at the entrance of the city gate just as Abimelech and his men came out from their hiding places.
ekegusii: Gaali agasoka, agatenena ase egeita ki’omochie, na erio agwo Abimeleki amo n’abanto baye bakaimoka korwa ase baaboete.
swahili: Basi Gaali mwana wa Ebedi alikuwa ametoka nje akawa amesimama katika ingilio la mji wakati ule ule ambao Abimeleki na watu wake walipokuwa wanatoka sehemu zao za maficho.

english: When Gaal saw the people, he said to Zebul, “Look, people are coming down from the mountains!” But Zebul replied, “The shadows of the mountains look like men to you.”
ekegusii: Ekero Gaali arooche abanto, agateebia Sebuli, “Rigereria, abanto bagotirimboka korwa ebitunwa igoro.” Korende Sebuli agateeba, “Ebio n’ebiiriiri bi’ebitunwa kwarorire bikororekana buna abanto.”
swahili: Gaali alipowaona, akamwambia Zebuli, “Tazama, watu wanashuka kutoka kwenye vilele vya milima!” Zebuli akajibu, “Wewe unaona vivuli vya milima kana kwamba ni watu.”

english: Then Gaal spoke up again, “Look, people are coming down from the center of the land, and one company is coming by way of the Diviners’ Oak. ”
ekegusii: Gaali agakwana naende, agateeba, “Yaya, rigereria, abanto ’ngotirimboka bare korwa ase rigwamu ria gati‐gati, n’abanto b’ekeombe kende nigo bagoocha ase enchera ekorwa ase omote oria bw’abaringoria Omoaluni.”
swahili: Lakini Gaali akasema tena, “Tazama, watu wanashuka kutoka katikati ya nchi na kikosi kimoja kinakuja kutoka Tabur-Ezeri na kikosi kingine kutoka upande wa Elon-Meonenimu.”

english: “Where is your gloating now?” Zebul replied. “You said, ‘Who is Abimelech that we should serve him?’ Are these not the people you ridiculed? Go out now and fight them!”
ekegusii: Erio Sebuli akamoteebia, “Ng’ai are amang’ana ao ay’ogwetogia ekero gwateebete: Abimeleki nere ng’o? Nase ki tokomokorera? Aba tibari abanto baria gwachayete? Soka bono obarwanie.”
swahili: Ndipo Zebuli akamwambia, “Kuko wapi kujivuna kwako sasa, wewe uliyesema, ‘Huyo Abimeleki ni nani hata tumtumikie?’ Hawa si wale watu uliowadharau? Toka nje sasa ukapigane nao!”

english: So Gaal went out before the leaders of Shechem and fought against Abimelech,
ekegusii: Gaali agatang’ana abanto ba Sekemu, na barabwo bakageenda bakarwania Abimeleki.
swahili: Basi Gaali akatoka akawaongoza watu wa Shekemu kupigana na Abimeleki.

english: So they gave him seventy shekels of silver from the temple of Baal-berith, with which Abimelech hired some worthless and reckless men to follow him.
ekegusii: Abanto bakamoa chisekeli chi’echifeta emerongo etano n’ebere korwa ase enyomba ya Baali‐Beriti, na ase chitaabu echio akabagora abanto abatantanu bateechigeti: nabarabwo bakamotunyana.
swahili: Wakampa shekeli sabini za fedha kutoka hekalu la Baal-Berithi, naye Abimeleki akaitumia kuajiri watu ovyo wasiojali, wakawa ndio wafuasi wake.

english: but Abimelech pursued him, and Gaal fled before him. And many Shechemites fell wounded all the way to the entrance of the gate.
ekegusii: Abimeleki agaseeria Gaali, na ere agatama. Abange bagaitwa, bakarambereria inse goika ase egeita ki’omochie.
swahili: Abimeleki akamfukuza, watu wengi wakajeruhiwa katika kukimbia huko, njia nzima hadi kwenye ingilio la lango.

english: Abimelech stayed in Arumah, and Zebul drove Gaal and his brothers out of Shechem.
ekegusii: Abimeleki akaira na Aruma, na Sebuli agaseeria Gaali na abamura bamwabo, erio tibanyaara kogenderera komenya Sekemu.
swahili: Abimeleki akakaa Aruma, naye Zebuli akawafukuza Gaali na ndugu zake watoke Shekemu.

english: The next day the people of Shechem went out into the fields, and this was reported to Abimelech.
ekegusii: Rituko ria kabere abanto bagasoka ase egetii aarabu, n’Abimeleki agateebigwa amang’ana ayio.
swahili: Kesho yake watu wa Shekemu wakatoka wakaenda mashambani, Abimeleki akaambiwa juu ya jambo hili.

english: So he took his men, divided them into three companies, and lay in wait in the fields. When he saw the people coming out of the city, he rose up against them and attacked them.
ekegusii: Ere akaimoka n’abanto baye, akabaatanana ase ebiombe bitato, barabwo bakebisa na koboa ase egetii. Ekero arooche abanto bagosooka korwa ase omochie, agasooka korwa aase ebisete, akabaumokera na kobaita.
swahili: Hivyo akawachukua watu wake, akawagawanya katika vikosi vitatu na kuwaweka waviziao huko mashambani. Alipowaona watu wanatoka kwenda nje ya mji, akainuka dhidi yao na kuwashambulia.

english: Then Abimelech and the companies with him rushed forward and took their stand at the entrance of the city gate. The other two companies rushed against all who were in the fields and struck them down.
ekegusii: Abimeleki n’abanto b’ekeombe kiaye bakaayerera gochia gotenena ase egeita ki’omochie, korende abanto b’ebiombe biria bibere binde bakabarindokera na kobaumokera abanto bonsi barenge ase egetii, bakabaita.
swahili: Abimeleki pamoja na vile vikosi wakaharakisha kwenda mbele kwenye nafasi, mahali pa ingilio la lango la mji. Vile vikosi viwili vikawawahi wale waliokuwa mashambani na kuwaua.

english: And all that day Abimelech fought against the city until he had captured it and killed its people. Then he demolished the city and sowed it with salt.
ekegusii: Na ekero Abimeleki arwanetie omochie rituko riria rigima, akayobwata na agaita abanto abamenyeteo. Erio akayoiyeria na koyoitororera omonyoo.
swahili: Siku hiyo nzima Abimeleki akazidisha mashambulizi yake dhidi ya mji hadi akawa ameuteka na kuwaua watu wa huo mji. Kisha akauangamiza mji na kusambaza chumvi juu yake.

english: On hearing of this, all the leaders in the tower of Shechem entered the inner chamber of the temple of El-berith.
ekegusii: Ekero abanto bonsi b’Omorobiri o Sekemu baigwete amang’ana ayio, bakebisa ime ase ekenunchi kiarenge obotamero obokong’u agwo ase Hekalu ya Eli‐Beriti.
swahili: Kwa kusikia jambo hili watu wote katika mnara wa Shekemu, wakaingia kwenye ngome ya hekalu la El-Berithi.

english: And when Abimelech was told that all the leaders in the tower of Shechem were gathered there,
ekegusii: Abimeleki agateebigwa ng’a abanto bonsi b’Omorobiri o Sekemu nigo bagasangererekanete amo.
swahili: Abimeleki aliposikia kuwa wamekusanyika huko,

english: he and all his men went up to Mount Zalmon. Abimelech took his axe in his hand and cut a branch from the trees, which he lifted to his shoulder, saying to his men, “Hurry and do what you have seen me do.”
ekegusii: Erio agatiirera egetunwa gia Salimoni amo n’abanto baye bonsi. Akaimokia egesire, akageecha chinsagia chi’emete, agachibeeka ase amareko aye. Naende agateebia abanto baye, “Aya morarore inche ’ngokora, nainwe mokore boigo, na moyakore bwango!”
swahili: yeye na watu wake wote wakakwea kwenye Mlima Salmoni. Abimeleki akachukua shoka, akakata baadhi ya matawi, ambayo aliyachukua mabegani. Akawaagiza wale watu waliokuwa pamoja naye kuwa, “Fanyeni kile mlichoona mimi nikifanya!”

english: So each man also cut his own branch and followed Abimelech. Then they piled the branches against the inner chamber and set it on fire above them, killing everyone in the tower of Shechem, about a thousand men and women. Abimelech’s Punishment
ekegusii: Ase igo, kera oyomo ase abanto baria akageecha chinsagia chiaye; erio bagatunyan’Abimeleki, bakabeeka emete eria ang’e ase obotamero boria obokong’u, na kobotongia omorero, bakabosiria amo n’abanto bonsi b’omoorobiri oria. Abwo bonsi, abanto koreng’ana elifu eyemo, abasacha n’abakuungu, bagakwa.
swahili: Basi watu wote wakakata matawi na kumfuata Abimeleki. Wakayakusanya hayo matawi juu ya ngome na kuitia moto ili kuwachoma wale watu wote waliokuwa ndani yake. Hivyo watu wote katika mnara wa Shekemu, karibia watu 1,000 waume kwa wake, pia wakafa.

english: He went to his father’s house in Ophrah, and on one stone murdered his seventy brothers, the sons of Jerubbaal. But Jotham, the youngest son of Jerubbaal, survived, because he hid himself.
ekegusii: Magega y’ayio akageenda nyomba mwa ise agwo Ofura, na igoro ase rigena erimo akabaita abamura bamwabo aroro, abana ba Yerubi‐Baali, emerongo etano n’ebere. Yotamu bweka, omomura omoke kegima o Yerubi‐Baali, nere otigarete ore moyo. Ere konya bwebisire.
swahili: Akaenda nyumbani kwa baba yake huko Ofra, na juu ya jiwe moja wakawaua ndugu zake sabini, ambao ni wana wa Yerub-Baali. Lakini Yothamu, mwana mdogo wa wote wa Yerub-Baali, akaokoka kwa kujificha.

english: Then Abimelech went to Thebez, encamped against it, and captured it.
ekegusii: Magega y’ayio Abimeleki akageenda Tebesi, akayonaaria na koyoira.
swahili: Baadaye Abimeleki akaenda Thebesi na kuuzingira kwa jeshi na kuuteka.

english: But there was a strong tower inside the city, and all the men, women, and leaders of the city fled there. They locked themselves in and went up to the roof of the tower.
ekegusii: Korende omoorobiri omokong’u norenge ase omochie oria ime, n’abanto bonsi b’omochie, abasacha n’abakuungu, bagatama gochiao, bagesiekera imeo. Erio bakariina gochia kerama igoro.
swahili: Hata hivyo, ndani ya huo mji kulikuwa na mnara imara, ambako watu wote wa mji wanaume na wanawake, watu wote wa mji, walikimbilia ndani yake. Wakajifungia ndani yake na kupanda juu ya paa la mnara.

english: When Abimelech came to attack the tower, he approached its entrance to set it on fire.
ekegusii: Abimeleki agacha koumokera omoorobiri oyio, agaika ang’e n’egesieri kiaye ayosambe n’omorero,
swahili: Abimeleki akaja kwenye ule mnara na kuushambulia, lakini alipokaribia kwenye ingilio la mnara ili kuuchoma kwa moto,

english: But a woman dropped an upper millstone on Abimelech’s head, crushing his skull.
ekegusii: na omokungu oyomo akaruta ensio agosera, agaaka Abimeleki omotwe, agasenyenta ekeore kiaye.
swahili: mwanamke mmoja akaangusha sehemu ya juu ya jiwe la kusagia juu ya kichwa cha Abimeleki, likapasua fuvu la kichwa chake.

english: He quickly called his armor-bearer, saying, “Draw your sword and kill me, lest they say of me, ‘A woman killed him.’” So Abimelech’s armor-bearer ran his sword through him, and he died.
ekegusii: Erio Abimeleki akarangeria omosae obogoretie ebirwanero biaye, akamoteebia, “Somora omoyio oo o birende, ong’ite, abanto tibaabaisa goteeba ng’a: N’omokuungu omoita.” Erio omosae oria akamobeta omoyio oye, akamoita.
swahili: Akamwita kwa haraka kijana yule aliyechukua silaha zake, na kumwambia, “Chukua upanga wako na uniue, watu wasije wakasema kwamba, ‘Mwanamke amemuua.’ ” Basi yule kijana akamchoma upanga, naye akafa.

english: And when the Israelites saw that Abimelech was dead, they all went home.
ekegusii: Ekero Abaisraeli barooche ng’a Abimeleki okuure, bakairana ’nka, kera oyomo goika bwoye.
swahili: Waisraeli walipoona kuwa Abimeleki amekufa, kila mtu akaenda nyumbani kwake.

english: In this way God repaid the wickedness that Abimelech had done to his father in murdering his seventy brothers.
ekegusii: Naboigo ekaba ng’a Nyasae oakanire egesiomba ase engencho y’ebibe biria Abimeleki akorerete ise ase ogoita abana baye, abamura bamwabo omonyene, emerongo etano n’ebere.
swahili: Hivyo ndivyo Mungu alivyolipiza uovu ule ambao Abimeleki alikuwa ameutenda kwa baba yake kwa kuwaua ndugu zake sabini.

english: And God also brought all the wickedness of the men of Shechem back upon their own heads. So the curse of Jotham son of Jerubbaal came upon them.
ekegusii: Nyasae akagera abanto ba Sekemu bakanyora egesusuro as’engeencho y’obonyamuma b’abwo. Naboigo okoragereria kwa Yotamu, mosinto o Yerubi‐Baali, kogaikeranigwa igoro yabo.
swahili: Mungu akawapatiliza watu wa Shekemu uovu wao juu ya vichwa vyao, na juu yao ikaja laana ya Yothamu mwana wa Yerub-Baali.

english: Then all the leaders of Shechem and Beth-millo gathered beside the oak at the pillar in Shechem and proceeded to make Abimelech their king. Jotham’s Parable
ekegusii: Erio abanto bonsi ba Sekemu, na abwo ba Beti‐Milo, bagasangererekana amo agwo Sekemu ase Omoaluni ang’e nekeinyorio giatenenirieo, na agwo bakabeeka Abimeleki akaba omorwoti.
swahili: Ndipo watu wote wa Shekemu na Beth-Milo wakakusanyika pamoja chini ya mti mkubwa wa mwaloni penye nguzo iliyoko Shekemu wakamvika Abimeleki taji kuwa mfalme.

english: When this was reported to Jotham, he climbed to the top of Mount Gerizim, raised his voice, and cried out: “Listen to me, O leaders of Shechem, and may God listen to you.
ekegusii: Ekero Yotamu ateebetigwe amang’ana ayio, akageenda, agatenena ase egetunwa kia Gerisimu igoro, agaaka eriogi rinene agateeba, “Inwe abanto ba Sekemu, ntegerera, erinde Nyasae nere abategerere.
swahili: Yothamu alipoambiwa hayo, akapanda juu ya kilele cha mlima Gerizimu, akawapazia sauti yake akawaambia, “Nisikilizeni enyi watu wa Shekemu, ili Mungu naye apate kuwasikiliza ninyi.

english: One day the trees set out to anoint a king for themselves. They said to the olive tree, ‘Reign over us.’
ekegusii: Agwo kare ekaba ng’a emete ekageenda gochoora erwoti ekoyegambera. Egateebia omozeituni: Togambere!
swahili: Siku moja miti ilitoka ili kwenda kujitawazia mfalme. Ikauambia mzeituni, ‘Wewe uwe mfalme wetu.’

english: But the olive tree replied, ‘Should I stop giving my oil that honors both God and man, to hold sway over the trees?’
ekegusii: Omozeituni oria okairaneria: Inee! Nigo ’ngotiga amaguta ane ayakorenta ogosika ase chinyasae na ase Mwanyabaanto, erinde ’ngambere emete ende?
swahili: “Lakini mzeituni ukaijibu, ‘Je, niache kutoa mafuta yangu ambayo kwake miungu na wanadamu huheshimiwa, ili nikawe juu ya miti?’

english: Hear the word that the LORD speaks to you, O house of Israel.
ekegusii: Inwe Abaisraeli, igwa amang’an’Omonene agoteeba.
swahili: Sikieni lile ambalo Bwana, anena nanyi ee nyumba ya Israeli.

english: But the LORD is the true God; He is the living God and eternal King. The earth quakes at His wrath, and the nations cannot endure His indignation.
ekegusii: Korende Omonene nere Nyasae bw’ekeene, Nyasae ore moyo, Omorwoti o kare na kare. Ense nigo egotengechigwa ase endamwamu yaye, ebisaku tibikonyara koremereria ekeririanda kiaye.
swahili: Lakini Bwana ni Mungu wa kweli, yeye ndiye Mungu aliye hai, Mfalme wa milele. Anapokasirika, dunia hutetemeka, mataifa hayawezi kustahimili hasira yake.

english: Thus you are to tell them: “These gods, who have made neither the heavens nor the earth, will perish from this earth and from under these heavens.”
ekegusii: Mobateebie ng’a chinyasae chiria chitatongete igoro na ense nachisire, tichiba inse y’erioba. Ogoteera gw’okomotogia Nyasae
swahili: “Waambie hivi: ‘Miungu hii, ambayo haikuumba mbingu na dunia, itaangamia kutoka dunia na kutoka chini ya mbingu.’ ”

english: The LORD made the earth by His power; He established the world by His wisdom and stretched out the heavens by His understanding.
ekegusii: Omonene nere otongete ense ase okobua kwaye; agatonga ebinto bionsi bi’ense ase obong’aini bwaye, na akarambora igoro ase okomanya kwaye.
swahili: Lakini Mungu aliiumba dunia kwa uweza wake, akaweka misingi ya ulimwengu kwa hekima yake, na akazitandaza mbingu kwa ufahamu wake.

english: When He thunders, the waters in the heavens roar; He causes the clouds to rise from the ends of the earth. He generates the lightning with the rain and brings forth the wind from His storehouses.
ekegusii: Ase eriogi riaye amaache are igoro chionsi akoeera neriogi, nigo akorenta ritaturi korwa ase chinsinyo chi’ense. Nere okorenta chinkoba chire nembura, na omwaga ogusa korwa ase ebigancha biaye.
swahili: Atoapo sauti yake, maji yaliyo katika mbingu hunguruma; huyafanya mawingu yainuke kutoka miisho ya dunia. Hupeleka umeme wa radi pamoja na mvua, naye huuleta upepo kutoka ghala zake.

english: Every man is senseless and devoid of knowledge; every goldsmith is put to shame by his idols. For his molten images are a fraud, and there is no breath in them.
ekegusii: Kera omonto nigo are omoriri ase obong’aini bwaye, na kera omoturi nigo agosookigwa nemegwekano y’ogosasimwa aroisirie, ekiagera emegwekano yaye ney’obong’ainereria, tebwati omoika ime yabo.
swahili: Kila mmoja ni mjinga na hana maarifa, kila sonara ameaibishwa na sanamu zake. Vinyago vyake ni vya udanganyifu, havina pumzi ndani yavyo.

english: They are worthless, a work to be mocked. In the time of their punishment they will perish.
ekegusii: Eyio mbosa kegima, emeremo eyio nesekererwe. Ekero eraegwe egesusuro, nesirigwe kegima.
swahili: Havifai kitu, ni vitu vya kufanyia mzaha tu, hukumu yavyo itakapowadia, vitaangamia.

english: The Portion of Jacob is not like these, for He is the Maker of all things, and Israel is the tribe of His inheritance— the LORD of Hosts is His name. The Coming Captivity of Judah
ekegusii: Omonene oria ore egetari kia Yakobo tagwekaini emegwekano eyio. Ere nere otongete ebinto bionsi. Abaisraeli nigo bare egesaku kere omwando oye; Omonene bw’Emeganda nario erieta riaye. Okong’anyigwa kogocha
swahili: Yeye aliye Fungu la Yakobo sivyo alivyo, kwani ndiye Muumba wa vitu vyote, pamoja na Israeli, kabila la urithi wake: Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote ndilo jina lake. Maangamizi Yajayo

english: Gather up your belongings from this land, you who live under siege.
ekegusii: Inwe abwo mwaetananirwe nababisa, sangereria ebinto biaino morue aase agwo.
swahili: Kusanyeni mali na vitu vyenu mwondoke nchi hii, enyi mnaoishi katika hali ya kuzingirwa na jeshi.

english: For this is what the LORD says: “Behold, at this time I will sling out the inhabitants of the land and bring distress upon them so that they may be captured.”
ekegusii: Aya nar’Omonene agoteeba: “Ase engaki eye ninserie ne chinguru abwo bonsi bamenyete ase ense eye, nimbarentere ogoichana goika baigwe obororo.
swahili: Kwa kuwa hili ndilo asemalo Bwana: “Wakati huu, nitawatupa nje kwa nguvu wote waishio katika nchi hii; nitawataabisha ili waweze kutekwa.”

english: Woe to me because of my brokenness; my wound is grievous! But I said, “This is truly my sickness, and I must bear it.”
ekegusii: “Obobe nobwaito, ekiagera twasunyuntirwe. Amaote aito tari kogwenigwa. Intwe nigo twarengereretie: Ekeene, eye nemechando, korende goika toremererie.
swahili: Ole wangu mimi kwa ajili ya kuumia kwangu! Jeraha langu ni kubwa! Lakini nilisema, “Kweli hii ni adhabu yangu, nami sharti niistahimili.”

english: This is what the LORD says: “Do not learn the ways of the nations or be terrified by the signs in the heavens, though the nations themselves are terrified by them.
ekegusii: Aya nar’Omonene agoteeba: “Timobaisa kweorokereria chingencho chi’abaanto b’ebisaku, gose ebimanyererio bikorwa igoro tibibaisa kobaondokia, ebio nigo bikoondokia abanto b’ebisaku.
swahili: Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana: “Usijifunze njia za mataifa wala usitishwe na ishara katika anga, ingawa mataifa yanatishwa nazo.

english: My tent is destroyed, and all its ropes are snapped. My sons have departed from me and are no more. I have no one left to pitch my tent or set up my curtains.
ekegusii: Chiema chiaito chiasarekire; Chingori chi’ogochisibera chiabutoirwe. Abana baito basirire, tibari aande. Omonto tari ogotenenia chiema naende. Onde tari oratosungere ebitambaa bie chiema chiaito.
swahili: Hema langu limeangamizwa; kamba zake zote zimekatwa. Wana wangu wametekwa na hawapo tena; hakuna hata mmoja aliyebaki wa kusimamisha hema langu wala wa kusimamisha kibanda changu.

english: For the shepherds have become senseless; they do not seek the LORD. Therefore they have not prospered, and all their flock is scattered.
ekegusii: “Abarisia babeire abariri, tibari korigia oboraai korwa ase Omonene. Ase ayio, tibari kogenderera konyora amaya, riicho riabo rionsi riasiareirwe.
swahili: Wachungaji hawana akili wala hawamuulizi Bwana, hivyo hawastawi na kundi lao lote la kondoo limetawanyika.

english: Listen! The sound of a report is coming— a great commotion from the land to the north. The cities of Judah will be made a desolation, a haunt for jackals.
ekegusii: Tegerera moigwe! Ebirage bigocha. Rirorooche ri’omoganda omonene riaigurwe rigocha korwa sugusu, gocha gosaria emechie y’Abayuda ebe amaturi, ase chisese chi’orosana chiramenye.”
swahili: Sikilizeni! Taarifa inakuja: ghasia kubwa kutoka nchi ya kaskazini! Hii itafanya miji ya Yuda ukiwa, makao ya mbweha. Maombi Ya Yeremia

english: I know, O LORD, that a man’s way is not his own; no one who walks directs his own steps.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, nimanyete ng’a enchera y’omonto tekoraagwa nere omonyene, gose omogendi takonyara koraa orogendo rwaye ere omonyene.
swahili: Ninajua, Ee Bwana, kwamba maisha ya mwanadamu si yake mwenyewe; hawezi kuziongoza hatua zake mwenyewe.

english: Correct me, O LORD, but only with justice— not in Your anger, or You will bring me to nothing.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ondongeyie ase okong’a egesusuro, korende ase ekerengo kegwenerete gioka, gose tonkora bo ekero ore nendamwamu, ekiagera nigo orabaise gonsiria.
swahili: Unirudi, Ee Bwana, lakini kwa kipimo cha haki: si katika hasira yako, usije ukaniangamiza.

english: Pour out Your wrath on the nations that do not acknowledge You, and on the families that do not call on Your name. For they have devoured Jacob; they have consumed him and finished him off; they have devastated his homeland.
ekegusii: Itera endamwamu yao ase ebisaku bitakomanyeti na ase abanto batari korangeria erieta riao bakonywe. Barabwo basiririe abanto ba Yakobo, ee, baabamerire kegima na kobasiria, basaririe obomenyo bwabo bwabeire bosa.
swahili: Umwage ghadhabu yako juu ya mataifa wasiokujua wewe, juu ya mataifa wasioliitia jina lako. Kwa kuwa wamemwangamiza Yakobo; wamemwangamiza kabisa na kuiharibu nchi yake.

english: For the customs of the peoples are worthless; they cut down a tree from the forest; it is shaped with a chisel by the hands of a craftsman.
ekegusii: Chinyasae abanto b’ebisaku bagosasiima nigo chire echi’oborimo. Omote ore rinani ime nigo okogechwa, na omooroisia omong’aini oyobaacha negesire na oroisia emegwekano.
swahili: Kwa maana desturi za mataifa hazina maana, wanakata mti msituni, na fundi anauchonga kwa patasi.

english: They adorn it with silver and gold and fasten it with hammer and nails, so that it will not totter.
ekegusii: Abanto nigo bakoyeooma ne chifeta ne chitaabu, bayeakerania bokong’u nenyundo na emesumari, erinde tenyegerigwa.
swahili: Wanaparemba kwa fedha na dhahabu, wanakikaza kwa nyundo na misumari ili kisitikisike.

english: Like scarecrows in a cucumber patch, their idols cannot speak. They must be carried because they cannot walk. Do not fear them, for they can do no harm, and neither can they do any good.”
ekegusii: Emegwekano eyio yabo nigo enga buna ebinto bikogosa chinyoni chire ase emegondo y’amasosa. Emegwekano eyio tekonyara gokwana; nigo ekobogorigwa, ekiagera teri gotaara. Timobaisa koyeiroka, ekiagera tegokora bobe bonde bwensi, gose tekonyara gokora gento kende ekiya.”
swahili: Sanamu zao ni kama sanamu iliyowekwa shambani la matango kutishia ndege nazo haziwezi kuongea; sharti zibebwe sababu haziwezi kutembea. Usiziogope; haziwezi kudhuru, wala kutenda lolote jema.”

english: There is none like You, O LORD. You are great, and Your name is mighty in power.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, onde tari okogwekaine; aye naye Omonene, na erieta riao nigo rire nokobua okonene.
swahili: Hakuna aliye kama wewe, Ee Bwana; wewe ni mkuu, jina lako ni lenye nguvu katika uweza.

english: Who would not fear You, O King of nations? This is Your due. For among all the wise men of the nations, and in all their kingdoms, there is none like You.
ekegusii: Aye Omorwoti bw’ebisaku, ning’o otagwenereti gokoiroka. Aye nogwenerete oirokwe. Onde tari okogwekaine ase abang’aini bonsi b’ebisaku, gose ase amarwoti abo onsi.
swahili: Ni nani ambaye haimpasi kukuheshimu wewe, Ee Mfalme wa mataifa? Hii ni stahili yako. Miongoni mwa watu wote wenye hekima katika mataifa na katika falme zao zote, hakuna aliye kama wewe.

english: But they are altogether senseless and foolish, instructed by worthless idols made of wood!
ekegusii: Barabwo bonsi tibamanyeti gento, nabariri bare. Naki ogosemigwa korwa ase emegwekano eyio nemete bosa.
swahili: Wote hawana akili, tena ni wapumbavu, wanafundishwa na sanamu za miti zisizofaa lolote.

english: Hammered silver is brought from Tarshish, and gold from Uphaz— the work of a craftsman from the hands of a goldsmith. Their clothes are blue and purple, all fashioned by skilled workers.
ekegusii: Eyio nefeta eturire ekorwa Tarisisi, na etaabu ekorwa Ufasi. Nigo ere emeremo y’omooroisia omong’aini na omoturi bw’etaabu. Chianga emegwekano eyio ekobekerwa nigo chire chimbariri ne chimonyinga, chiroisirie nabaanto abang’aini.
swahili: Huleta fedha iliyofuliwa kutoka Tarshishi na dhahabu kutoka Ufazi. Kile ambacho fundi na sonara wametengeneza huvikwa mavazi ya rangi ya samawi na urujuani: vyote vikiwa vimetengenezwa na mafundi stadi.

english: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD:
ekegusii: Ring’ana rikarua ase Omonene rigacha ase ’nde inche Yeremia,
swahili: Hili ndilo neno lililomjia Yeremia kutoka kwa Bwana:

english: They have returned to the sins of their forefathers who refused to obey My words. They have followed other gods to serve them. The house of Israel and the house of Judah have broken the covenant I made with their fathers.
ekegusii: Abwo baonchokire bairaneire ebibe bie chisokoro chiabo, chiria chiangete koigwera amang’ana aane. Bairaneire gosasiima chinyasae ching’ao na gochikorera. Ee, Abaisraeli amo n’Abayuda basaririe okobwatana kw’ogotianania nakorete ne chisokoro chiabo.
swahili: Wamerudia dhambi za baba zao, waliokataa kusikiliza maneno yangu. Wameifuata miungu mingine kuitumikia. Nyumba zote mbili za Israeli na Yuda zimelivunja agano nililofanya na baba zao.

english: Therefore this is what the LORD says: ‘I am about to bring upon them a disaster that they cannot escape. They will cry out to Me, but I will not listen to them.
ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio inche Omonene nkobarentera inde ogosiria, na barabwo tibakonyara gwetooria, na ekero baraarere ase ’nde, tinkobaigwa.
swahili: Kwa hivyo, hili ndilo asemalo Bwana: ‘Nitaleta juu yao maafa ambayo hawawezi kuyakimbia. Hata kama wakinililia, sitawasikiliza.

english: Then the cities of Judah and the residents of Jerusalem will go and cry out to the gods to which they have been burning incense, but these gods certainly will not save them in their time of disaster.
ekegusii: Engaki eria abanto bare ase emechie y’Abayuda, na aba Yerusalemu nabasambere chinyasae echio ubani na korera ase chirochio ng’a chibakonye, korende tichikonyara kobatooria ekero ogosirigwa korabacheere.
swahili: Miji ya Yuda na watu wa Yerusalemu watakwenda kuililia miungu ambayo wameifukizia uvumba, lakini haitawasaidia kamwe wakati maafa yatakapowapiga.

english: Your gods are indeed as numerous as your cities, O Judah; the altars of shame you have set up—the altars to burn incense to Baal—are as many as the streets of Jerusalem.’
ekegusii: Inwe abanto ba Yuda, chinyasae chiaino nigo chire chinyinge buna emechie yaino ere emenge, na buna chinchera chia Yerusalemu chire chinyinge, naboigo nebisasimero bi’obosooku bire, biria mwaroiseretie Baali, enyasae eria mogosambera ubani.
swahili: Mnayo miungu mingi kama miji mliyo nayo, ee Yuda, nazo madhabahu mlizozijenga za kufukizia uvumba huyo mungu wa aibu Baali ni nyingi kama barabara za Yerusalemu.’

english: As for you, do not pray for these people. Do not raise up a cry or a prayer on their behalf, for I will not be listening when they call out to Me in their time of disaster.
ekegusii: Ase ayio, aye tobaisa gosabera abanto aba, gose korera ase ’nde ase engencho ya barabwo, ekiagera inche tinkobaigwa ekero barandangerie ase engencho y’emechando yabo.
swahili: “Wewe usiwaombee watu hawa wala kufanya maombezi yoyote au kunisihi kwa ajili yao, kwa sababu sitawasikiliza watakaponiita wakati wa taabu yao.

english: What right has My beloved in My house, having carried out so many evil schemes? Can consecrated meat avert your doom, so that you can rejoice?
ekegusii: Abanto aba nyanchete bakorire okogechia. Inki rende bagokora ase enyomba yane? Inee! Chiira bakoria, na ebing’wanso bakorua, nabinyare koonchora ogosirigwa kwabo gokobacheera? Ekero mwakorire ebibe, nario mokogoka?
swahili: “Mpenzi wangu anafanya nini hekaluni mwangu, anapofanya mashauri yake maovu na wengi? Je, nyama iliyowekwa wakfu yaweza kuondolea mbali adhabu yako? Unapojiingiza katika ubaya wako, ndipo unashangilia.”

english: The LORD once called you a flourishing olive tree, beautiful with well-formed fruit. But with a mighty roar He will set it on fire, and its branches will be consumed.
ekegusii: Agwo kare inche Omonene nigo nabaarogete “Omozeituni omobese obwate amazeituni amaya”, korende bono narentire okogukura okonene na koyotongia omorero, ne chinsagia chiaye chiyie chisareke.
swahili: Bwana alikuita mti wa mzeituni uliostawi ulio na matunda mazuri kwa sura. Lakini kwa ngurumo ya mawimbi makuu atautia moto, nayo matawi yake yatavunjika.

english: The LORD of Hosts, who planted you, has decreed disaster against you on account of the evil that the house of Israel and the house of Judah have brought upon themselves, provoking Me to anger by burning incense to Baal.” A Plot against Jeremiah (Jeremiah 18:18–23)
ekegusii: “Inche Omonene bw’Emeganda nabasimegete, korende bono nachiikire amabe abachere, ekiagera inwe Abaisraeli na Abayuda mwangechirie namabe aino ay’ogosamba ubani ase Baali nkaba nendamwamu.” Omoroberio bw’ogoita Yeremia
swahili: Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, aliyekupanda, ametamka maafa kwa ajili yako, kwa sababu nyumba ya Israeli na nyumba ya Yuda mmefanya maovu na kunikasirisha kwa kumfukizia Baali uvumba. Shauri Baya Dhidi Ya Yeremia

english: And the LORD informed me, so I knew. Then You showed me their deeds.
ekegusii: Omonene akamanyia igoro y’ebibe ebio, nainche nkabimanya; nere akanyorokia aya barenge gokora.
swahili: Kwa sababu Bwana alinifunulia hila zao mbaya, nilizifahamu, kwa kuwa wakati ule alinionyesha yale waliyokuwa wanayafanya.

english: For I was like a gentle lamb led to slaughter; I did not know that they had plotted against me: “Let us destroy the tree with its fruit; let us cut him off from the land of the living, that his name may be remembered no more.”
ekegusii: Korende inche nkaba buna emanwa y’eng’ondi enyororo ekoirwa konyenywa. Tinamanyete ng’a nigo baroberetie amabe ase ’nde. Bagakwana iga; “Tiga tosirie omote oyo amo namatunda aye. Tiga toyobutore orue ase ense y’abanto bare moyo, erinde erieta riaye risire kegima tiriinyorwa nonya ng’ake.”
swahili: Nilikuwa kama mwana-kondoo mpole aliyeongozwa machinjoni; mimi sikutambua kwamba walikuwa wamefanya shauri baya dhidi yangu, wakisema, “Sisi na tuuangamize mti na matunda yake; nasi tumkatilie mbali kutoka nchi ya walio hai, ili jina lake lisikumbukwe tena.”

english: “Listen to the words of this covenant and tell them to the men of Judah and the residents of Jerusalem.
ekegusii: riganteebia: “Igwa amang’ana ’okobwatana kw’ogotianania, kwana n’Abayuda na abanto bamenyete Yerusalemu,
swahili: “Sikia maneno ya agano hili, nawe uwaambie watu wa Yuda na wale waishio Yerusalemu.

english: O LORD of Hosts, who judges righteously, who examines the heart and mind, let me see Your vengeance upon them, for to You I have committed my cause.
ekegusii: “Aye Omonene bw’Emeganda okonacha ebiina ase oboronge; aye okoriga‐rigia ebirengererio bi’enkoro, tiga ndore gokorusia egesiomba ase bare, ekiagera nabekire amang’ana aane asore.”
swahili: Lakini, Ee Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, wewe uhukumuye kwa haki, nawe uchunguzaye moyo na akili, wacha nione ukiwalipiza wao kisasi, kwa maana kwako nimeweka shauri langu.

english: Therefore this is what the LORD says concerning the people of Anathoth who are seeking your life and saying, “You must not prophesy in the name of the LORD, or you will die by our hand.”
ekegusii: Ase ayio, aya nar’Omonene agoteeba igoro y’abanto b’Anatoti, abwo bakorigia kong’ita, bagoteeba ng’a timbaisa kobana ase erieta ri’Omonene, bateba ng’a inse gokora igo nigo barang’ite.
swahili: “Kwa hiyo hili ndilo Bwana asemalo kuhusu watu wa Anathothi wale wanaotafuta uhai wako wakisema, ‘Usitoe unabii kwa jina la Bwana, la sivyo utakufa kwa mikono yetu’:

english: So this is what the LORD of Hosts says: “I will punish them. Their young men will die by the sword, their sons and daughters by famine.
ekegusii: Ee, aya nar’Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteeba: “Nimbae egesusuro; abamura babo nabaitwe ase esegi, na abana babo, abamura na abaiseke, nabakwe nenchara.
swahili: kwa hiyo hili ndilo Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote asemalo: ‘Nitawaadhibu. Vijana wao waume watakufa kwa upanga, wana wao na binti zao kwa njaa.

english: There will be no remnant, for I will bring disaster on the people of Anathoth in the year of their punishment.”
ekegusii: Gose monto onde obo nonya noyomo tagotigara ore moyo, ekiagera ase omwaka bw’egesusuro kiabo nindetere abanto b’Anatoti amabe.”
swahili: Hawatasaziwa hata mabaki kwao, kwa sababu nitaleta maafa kwa watu wa Anathothi katika mwaka wa adhabu yao.’ ”

english: You must tell them that this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: Cursed is the man who does not obey the words of this covenant,
ekegusii: obateebie: Aya nar’Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, agoteeba: Aragererigwe omonto otari koigwera amang’ana ’okobwatana oko
swahili: Waambie kwamba hili ndilo asemalo Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli: ‘Amelaaniwa mtu ambaye hatayatii maneno ya agano hili,

english: which I commanded your forefathers when I brought them out of the land of Egypt, out of the iron furnace, saying, ‘Obey Me, and do everything I command you, and you will be My people, and I will be your God.’
ekegusii: nachigete chisokoro chiaino, ekero nachirusetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri, ense eria yarenge buna eriko rigosamba. Nigo nabateebeetie ng’a kobaranyigwere na bakore onsi aya nabachigete, erio nario baare gocha koba abanto baane, na inche imbe Nyasae obo.
swahili: maneno niliyowaamuru baba zenu nilipowatoa katika nchi ya Misri, kutoka tanuru la kuyeyushia vyuma.’ Nilisema, ‘Nitiini mimi na mfanye kila kitu ninachowaamuru, nanyi mtakuwa watu wangu, nami nitakuwa Mungu wenu.

english: This was in order to establish the oath I swore to your forefathers, to give them a land flowing with milk and honey, as it is to this day.” “Amen, LORD,” I answered.
ekegusii: Ase enchera eyio nigo nare konyara goikerania eira y’ogotiana narierete chisokoro chiabo ng’a nimbae ense entenenku ere namabeere na amooke, buna akoregete goika rituko ria reero.” Inche Yeremia nkairaneria, nkabora, “Ee, Omonene, tiga abe bo.”
swahili: Kisha nitatimiza kiapo nilichowaapia baba zenu, kuwapa nchi itiririkayo maziwa na asali,’ nchi ambayo mnaimiliki leo.” Nikajibu, “Amen, Bwana.”

english: Then the LORD said to me, “Proclaim all these words in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem, saying: Hear the words of this covenant and carry them out.
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene aganteebia, “Genda ase emechie y’Abayuda na ase chinchera chia Yerusalemu, orarie amang’ana aya onsi, oteebie abanto bategerere amang’ana ’okobwatana okwo na koyakora.
swahili: Bwana akaniambia, “Tangaza maneno haya yote katika miji ya Yuda na katika barabara za Yerusalemu: ‘Sikilizeni maneno ya agano hili na kuyafuata.

english: For from the time I brought your fathers out of the land of Egypt until today, I strongly warned them again and again, saying, ‘Obey My voice.’
ekegusii: Ekero narusetie chisokoro chiaino korwa ase ense ya Misiri, nigo nachikurerete mono ng’a chinyigwere, nonya ngoika rituko ria reero ningendererete gochikurera.
swahili: Tangu wakati ule niliwapandisha baba zenu kutoka Misri mpaka leo, niliwaonya tena na tena, nikisema “Nitiini mimi.”

english: Yet they would not obey or incline their ears, but each one followed the stubbornness of his evil heart. So I brought on them all the curses of this covenant I had commanded them to follow but they did not keep.”
ekegusii: Korende tichianyigwerete gose gontegerera. Kera omonto nigo akong’etie enkoro yaye, akagenderera gokora ebibe. Nigo nachichigeete chibwate okobwatana koria, korende chikaanga. Ase ayio nkabaikeraneria amang’ana onsi ay’okobwatana koria.”
swahili: Lakini hawakusikiliza wala kujali. Badala yake, walifuata ukaidi wa mioyo yao miovu. Hivyo nikaleta juu yao laana zote za agano nililokuwa nimewaamuru wao kulifuata, lakini wao hawakulishika.’ ”

english: And the LORD told me, “There is a conspiracy among the men of Judah and the residents of Jerusalem.
ekegusii: Naende Omonene aganteebia, Abayuda na abanto ba Yerusalemu bakorire omooroberio bw’ogokora mamincha yane.
swahili: Kisha Bwana akaniambia, “Kuna shauri baya linaloendelea miongoni mwa watu wa Yuda na wale wanaoishi Yerusalemu.

english: Righteous are You, O LORD, when I plead before You. Yet about Your judgments I wish to contend with You: Why does the way of the wicked prosper? Why do all the faithless live at ease?
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ekero nkoamererania naye, nigo okonyorekana kore omonyene oboronge. Nonya nabo, ngokwana inde naye igoro y’amang’ana ’oboronge. Nase ki chinchera chi’abakori amabe chikoba nogosesenigwa? Nase ki abanto abang’ainereria bagendererete koba buya?
swahili: Wewe daima u mwenye haki, Ee Bwana, niletapo mashtaka mbele yako. Hata hivyo nitazungumza nawe kuhusu hukumu yako: Kwa nini njia ya waovu inafanikiwa? Kwa nini wasio waaminifu wote wanaishi kwa raha?

english: Many shepherds have destroyed My vineyard; they have trampled My plot of ground. They have turned My pleasant field into a desolate wasteland.
ekegusii: Abarisia abange basaririe omogondo one bw’emesabibu, batiringeire inse omogondo one. Bakorire omogondo one oyorenge kongokia ogwekanire buna erooro ere bosa.
swahili: Wachungaji wengi wataliharibu shamba langu la mizabibu na kulikanyaga shamba langu; watalifanya shamba langu zuri kuwa jangwa la ukiwa.

english: They have made it a desolation; desolate before Me, it mourns. All the land is laid waste, but no man takes it to heart.
ekegusii: Bayotigire ore bosa, na ekiagera otigirwe ore bosa, nkorera ore ase ’nde. Ense yonsi yabeire erooro, korende omonto tari okorengereria amang’ana ayio.
swahili: Litafanywa kuwa jangwa, lililokauka na kuachwa ukiwa mbele zangu; nchi yote itafanywa jangwa kwa sababu hakuna hata mmoja anayejali.

english: Over all the barren heights in the wilderness the destroyers have come, for the sword of the LORD devours from one end of the earth to the other. No flesh has peace.
ekegusii: Abasaria batiirire gochia ase ebigoro bi’erooro. Omoro bw’Omonene nigo ogoita na gosaria korwa ensinyo eyemo y’ense goika ensinyo ende. Onde tari omenyete nomorembe.
swahili: Juu ya miinuko yote ilivyo kama jangwani mharabu atajaa, kwa maana upanga wa Bwana utawala, kuanzia ncha moja ya nchi hadi nyingine; hakuna hata mmoja atakayekuwa salama.

english: They have sown wheat but harvested thorns. They have exhausted themselves to no avail. Bear the shame of your harvest because of the fierce anger of the LORD.” A Message for Israel’s Neighbors (Amos 1:1–15)
ekegusii: Babusuire engano, korende mbagese amagwa. Babeire bakwerosia ase emeremo, korende tibanyoreti ebitoki. Mwanyorire obosooku ase ogotanyora rigesa, ekiagera Omonene abeire nendamwamu enene ase more.” Eira y’Omonene ase abagisangio b’Abaisraeli
swahili: Watapanda ngano lakini watavuna miiba; watajitaabisha lakini hawatafaidi chochote. Kwa hiyo beba aibu ya mavuno yako kwa sababu ya hasira kali ya Bwana Mungu.”

english: This is what the LORD says: “As for all My evil neighbors who attack the inheritance that I bequeathed to My people Israel, I am about to uproot them from their land, and I will uproot the house of Judah from among them.
ekegusii: Aya nar’Omonene agoteeba igoro y’abagisangio baane ababe, abwo bagosaria omwando oria naeire Abaisraeli: “Nimbarusie barue ase ense yabo, naende nindusie Abayuda barue ase egati yabo.
swahili: Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana: “Kwa habari ya majirani zangu wote wabaya wanaonyangʼanya urithi ambao ninawapa watu wangu Israeli, nitawangʼoa kutoka nchi zao, nami nitaingʼoa nyumba ya Yuda kutoka katikati yao.

english: But after I have uprooted them, I will once again have compassion on them and return each one to his inheritance and to his land.
ekegusii: Na magega y’ayio, ekero nabarusirie ase ense eyio, nimbarorere amaabera naende, mbairanie naende kera omonto ase omwando oye, na ase ense yaye.
swahili: Lakini baada ya kuwangʼoa, nitawahurumia tena na kumrudisha kila mmoja wao kwenye urithi wake mwenyewe na kwenye nchi yake mwenyewe.

english: And if they will diligently learn the ways of My people and swear by My name, saying, ‘As surely as the LORD lives’—just as they once taught My people to swear by Baal—then they will be established among My people.
ekegusii: Onye ekero ekio abanto abwo bakweorokereria chinchera chi’abaanto baane, na gotiana ase erieta riane, bagoteeba: Ekeene, buna Omonene are moyo, buna abwo kare borokereretie abanto baane gotiana ase erieta ri’enyasae Baali, erio nario ndabasesenie na kobairaneria amaya abo, ase egati y’abanto baane.
swahili: Ikiwa watajifunza vyema njia za watu wangu na kuapa kwa Jina langu, wakisema, ‘Hakika kama Bwana aishivyo,’ hata kama wakati fulani walifundisha watu wangu kuapa kwa Baali, ndipo watakapofanywa imara katikati ya watu wangu.

english: But if they will not obey, then I will uproot that nation; I will uproot it and destroy it, declares the LORD.”
ekegusii: Korende onye egesaku kende gionsi kegochia kwanga konyigwera, rirorio ninkerusieo ngesirie kegima. Ninche Omonene nakwanire.”
swahili: Lakini kama taifa lolote halitasikiliza na kutii, nitalingʼoa kabisa na kuliangamiza,” asema Bwana.

english: You planted them, and they have taken root. They have grown and produced fruit. You are ever on their lips, but far from their hearts.
ekegusii: Aye kwabasimekire, nabarabwo bairire emeri inse. Nigo bagokina, naende baama. Barabwo nigo bakomanyete ase emenwa yabo rioka, korende chinkoro chiabo nigo chire aare naye.
swahili: Umewapanda, nao wameota, wanakua na kuzaa matunda. Daima u midomoni mwao, lakini mbali na mioyo yao.

english: But You know me, O LORD; You see me and test my heart toward You. Drag away the wicked like sheep to the slaughter and set them apart for the day of carnage.
ekegusii: Korende aye Omonene nomanyete inche, nigo ondoche, na nigo ogoteema ebirengererio biane gose mbire asore. Barusieo abwo ababe buna ching’ondi chigochia konyenywa, obabeeke ensemo baganye rituko bagochia konyenywa.
swahili: Hata hivyo unanijua mimi, Ee Bwana; unaniona na kuyachunguza mawazo yangu kukuhusu wewe. Wakokote kama kondoo wanaokwenda kuchinjwa! Watenge kwa ajili ya siku ya kuchinjwa!

english: How long will the land mourn and the grass of every field be withered? Because of the evil of its residents, the animals and birds have been swept away, for the people have said, “He cannot see what our end will be.” God’s Answer to Jeremiah
ekegusii: Ngoika ririri ense erabe ekorera, na obonyansi bw’ebitii bobe bogendererete kwoma? Ching’iti ne chinyoni chiasirigwe ase engencho y’obobe bw’abaanto bamenyeteo, abwo bagoteeba: “Omonene takorora amatuko aito ay’omoerio.”
swahili: Je, nchi itakaa katika hali ya kuomboleza mpaka lini, na majani katika kila shamba kunyauka? Kwa sababu wale waishio ndani yake ni waovu, wanyama na ndege wameangamia. Zaidi ya hayo, watu wanasema, “ Bwana hataona yatakayotupata sisi.” Jibu La Mungu

english: “If you have raced with men on foot and they have worn you out, how can you compete with horses? If you stumble in a peaceful land, how will you do in the thickets of the Jordan?
ekegusii: “Onye gokorosa ase okoamererania nabaanto bakominyoka namagoro, naki rende oranyare gochia koamererania ne chibarasi chikominyoka? Na onye gokogwa ekero omenyete ase ense ere nomorembe, naki orakore ase amanani amanoru a Yorodani?
swahili: “Ikiwa umeshindana mbio na watu kwa mguu na wakakushinda, unawezaje kushindana na farasi? Ikiwa unajikwaa kwenye nchi ambayo ni salama, utawezaje kwenye vichaka kando ya Yordani?

english: Even your brothers— your own father’s household— even they have betrayed you; even they have cried aloud against you. Do not trust them, though they speak well of you.
ekegusii: Nonya nabamino, abanto b’eamate ya iso, babeire abang’ainereria asore, nigo bagokuura korwa magega yao. Nabaisa gokwana amang’ana amaya asore, tobaisa kobegena.” Omonene ore nomoichano ase engencho y’abanto baye
swahili: Ndugu zako, watu wa jamaa yako mwenyewe: hata wao wamekusaliti; wameinua kilio kikubwa dhidi yako. Usiwaamini, ingawa wanazungumza mema juu yako.

english: I have forsaken My house; I have abandoned My inheritance. I have given the love of My life into the hands of her enemies.
ekegusii: “Inche natigire abanto baane, natigire abanto bare omwando one. Nabekire abanchwa baane ase amaboko ’ababisa babo.
