ekegusii: Ning’onchore omochie oyo osareke kegima, oichanerwe. Kera omonto orabe ogoeta ase egati yaye naichanigwe mono na gokumia ase engencho y’ogosareka kwaye.
swahili: Nitauharibu mji huu na kuufanya kitu cha kudharauliwa. Wote wapitao karibu watashangaa na kuudhihaki kwa sababu ya majeraha yake yote.

english: I will make them eat the flesh of their sons and daughters, and they will eat one another’s flesh in the siege and distress inflicted on them by their enemies who seek their lives.’
ekegusii: Nintige abanto barie emebere y’abana babo, abamura na abaiseke, ee, kera omonto narie omobere bw’omogisangio oye ase engaki eyio y’emechando eria ababisa babo na abanto baria bakorigia gosiria obogima bwabo baraarente ase bare.”
swahili: Nitawafanya wao kula nyama ya wana wao na binti zao; kila mmoja atakula nyama ya mwenzake wakati wa dhiki ya kuzungukwa na jeshi lililowekwa juu yao na adui wanaotafuta uhai wao.’

english: These are the words of Jeremiah son of Hilkiah, one of the priests in Anathoth in the territory of Benjamin.
ekegusii: Aya akobwatia namang’ana a Yeremia, mosinto o Hilikia, oyo orenge oyomo bw’abakuani abarenge ase omochie bw’Anatoti, agwo ase orogongo rwa Benjamini.
swahili: Maneno ya Yeremia mwana wa Hilkia, mmoja wa makuhani katika mji wa Anathothi, katika nchi ya Benyamini.

english: See, I have appointed you today over nations and kingdoms to uproot and tear down, to destroy and overthrow, to build and plant.”
ekegusii: Naama! Rituko ria reero nakoeire okobua igoro y’ebisaku, na igoro y’amarwoti, obe kogosimora na gotagora, kogosaria na koonchorana, koagacha na gosimeka.” Amaroro abere
swahili: Tazama, leo nimekuweka juu ya mataifa na falme ili kungʼoa na kubomoa, kuharibu na kuangamiza, kujenga na kupanda.”

english: And the word of the LORD came to me, asking, “Jeremiah, what do you see?” “I see a branch of an almond tree,” I replied.
ekegusii: Ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha ase ’nde, riganteebia: “Yeremia, ngento ki orooche?” Nkamoiraneria, “Nigo ndoche orosagia ruo’mote okorokwa omolozi.”
swahili: Neno la Bwana likanijia kusema, “Je, Yeremia unaona nini?” Nami nikajibu, “Naona tawi la mti wa mlozi.”

english: “You have observed correctly,” said the LORD, “for I am watching over My word to accomplish it.”
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene aganteebia, “Kwarorire boronge, ekiagera inche nigo ntengerete, indore ng’a ring’ana riane riaikeranire ase ekeene.”
swahili: Bwana akaniambia, “Umeona vyema kwa maana ninaliangalia neno langu ili kuona kwamba limetimizwa.”

english: Again the word of the LORD came to me, asking, “What do you see?” “I see a boiling pot,” I replied, “and it is tilting toward us from the north.”
ekegusii: Naende ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha ase ’nde eria kabere, rikamboria: “Ngento ki orooche?” Nkairaneria, “Nigo ndonche enyongo egotogota; omonwa oye nigo orochie gocha aa korwa sugusu.”
swahili: Neno la Bwana likanijia tena, “Unaona nini?” Nikajibu, “Naona chungu kinachochemka, kikiwa kimeinama kutoka kaskazini.”

english: Then the LORD said to me, “Disaster from the north will be poured out on all who live in the land.
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene aganteebia, “Obobe nabotuboke korwa sugusu, erinde bobachere abanto bonsi bare ase ense eye.
swahili: Bwana akaniambia, “Kutoka kaskazini maafa yatamwagwa kwa wote waishio katika nchi.

english: For I am about to summon all the clans and kingdoms of the north,” declares the LORD. “Their kings will come and set up their thrones at the entrance of the gates of Jerusalem. They will attack all her surrounding walls and all the other cities of Judah.
ekegusii: Rora, inche Omonene nigo ngoteeba: Nkorangeria nde ebisaku bionsi bi’amarwoti a sugusu bichiche aa. Abarwoti babo mbatenenie ebirogo biabo bi’obonene agwo ase abanto bagosoera ase ebiita bia Yerusalemu, na ase chindwaki chiaye chinsemo chionsi, boigo nase emechie yonsi y’Abayuda.
swahili: Nitawaita watu wote wa falme za kaskazini,” asema Bwana. “Wafalme wao watakuja na kuweka viti vyao vya enzi katika maingilio ya malango ya Yerusalemu, watakuja dhidi ya kuta zake zote zinazouzunguka, na dhidi ya miji yote ya Yuda.

english: I will pronounce My judgments against them for all their wickedness, because they have forsaken Me to burn incense to other gods and to worship the works of their own hands.
ekegusii: Ninachere abanto b’aroro ekiina mbae egesusuro ase engencho y’obobe bwabo, ekiagera bantigire inche, basambeire chinyasae ching’ao ubani, naende basasimire emeremo y’amaboko abo.
swahili: Nitatoa hukumu zangu kwa watu wangu kwa sababu ya uovu wao wa kuniacha mimi, kwa kufukiza uvumba kwa miungu mingine na kuabudu kile ambacho mikono yao imekitengeneza.

english: Get yourself ready. Stand up and tell them everything that I command you. Do not be intimidated by them, or I will terrify you before them.
ekegusii: Korende aye kabe omoremu, oimoke, ogende obateebie amang’ana onsi nkogochika. Tobaisa koboboa. Oise koboboa, inche nigo ndakwoboyie ase amasio abo.
swahili: “Jiandae! Simama useme chochote nitakachokuamuru. Usiwaogope, la sivyo nitakufanya uwaogope wao.

english: Now behold, this day I have made you like a fortified city, an iron pillar, and bronze walls against the whole land—against the kings of Judah, its officials, its priests, and the people of the land.
ekegusii: Naama! Ase rituko ria reero nagokong’irie obe buna omochie ogiteire chindwaki, na buna esiiro y’ekioma, naende buna chindwaki chi’etai. Nigo orabe kogotenena bokong’u, tokobugwa nense eye yonsi, gose nabarwoti b’Abayuda, gose abanene b’oborwoti boria, gose abakuani b’aroro, gose abanto bonsi b’ense eye.
swahili: Leo nimekufanya mji wenye ngome, nguzo ya chuma, na ukuta wa shaba ili kusimama dhidi ya nchi yote: dhidi ya wafalme wa Yuda, maafisa wake, makuhani wake na watu wa nchi hiyo.

english: They will fight against you but will never overcome you, since I am with you to deliver you,” declares the LORD.
ekegusii: Barabwo mbakorwanie, korende tibagokobua, ekiagera inche nigo inde amo naye noboseemia. Nabo inche Omonene ngoteeba.”
swahili: Watapigana nawe lakini hawatakushinda, kwa kuwa niko pamoja nawe, nami nitakuokoa,” asema Bwana.

english: The word of the LORD came to Jeremiah in the thirteenth year of the reign of Josiah son of Amon king of Judah,
ekegusii: Ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha ase Yeremia ase omwaka o ikomi na gatato bw’okogamba kwa Yosia mosinto bw’Amoni, omorwoti bw’Abayuda.
swahili: Neno la Bwana lilimjia katika mwaka wa kumi na tatu wa utawala wa Yosia mwana wa Amoni mfalme wa Yuda,

english: and through the days of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah, until the fifth month of the eleventh year of Zedekiah son of Josiah king of Judah, when the people of Jerusalem went into exile.
ekegusii: Naende rikamocheera ekero Yehoyakimu, mosinto o Yosia, arenge omorwoti bw’Abayuda. Magega y’ayio Omonene akaba ogokwana nere ase chingaki chinyinge goika omoerio bw’omwaka o ikomi na rimo bw’okogamba gwa Zedekia mosinto o Yosia, omorwoti bw’Abayuda, na omoerio bw’omotienyi o gatano bw’omwaka oria, ekero abanto ba Yerusalemu boosetwe bakairwa ase obosomba. Yeremia okorangerigwa
swahili: na pia wakati wa utawala wa Yehoyakimu mwana wa Yosia mfalme wa Yuda, mpaka mwezi wa tano wa mwaka wa kumi na moja wa utawala wa Sedekia mwana wa Yosia mfalme wa Yuda, wakati watu wa Yerusalemu walipopelekwa uhamishoni. Wito Wa Yeremia

english: The word of the LORD came to me, saying:
ekegusii: Ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha ase ’nde riganteebia:
swahili: Neno la Bwana lilinijia, kusema,

english: “Before I formed you in the womb I knew you, and before you were born I set you apart and appointed you as a prophet to the nations.”
ekegusii: “Ekero konya ntaragotonga ase enda ya nyoko nakomanyete, na ekero konya otaraiborwa nagwatananete; nigo nagochorete obe omobani bw’ebisaku.”
swahili: “Kabla sijakuumba ndani ya tumbo la mama yako, nilikujua; kabla hujazaliwa nilikutenga kwa kazi maalum; nilikuweka uwe nabii kwa mataifa.”

english: “Ah, Lord GOD,” I said, “I surely do not know how to speak, for I am only a child!”
ekegusii: Erio nkamoiraneria, “Oo! Omonene! Inche tinkomanya gokwana, ekiagera inde omwana omoke.”
swahili: Nami nikasema, “Aa, Bwana Mwenyezi, sijui kusema, kwani mimi ni mtoto mdogo tu.”

english: But the LORD told me: “Do not say, ‘I am only a child.’ For to everyone I send you, you must go, and all that I command you, you must speak.
ekegusii: Korende Omonene aganteebia, “Tobaisa gokwana ng’a aye nomwana omoke ore, korende ase abanto bande bonsi ndagotome, goika ogende, na amang’ana ande onsi ndagochike, naro orabateebie.
swahili: Lakini Bwana akaniambia, “Usiseme, ‘Mimi ni mtoto mdogo tu.’ Utaenda popote nitakapokutuma na kunena lolote nitakalokuagiza.

english: Do not be afraid of them, for I am with you to deliver you,” declares the LORD.
ekegusii: Tobaisa kobairoka, ekiagera inche nigo inde amo naye kogokonya. Inche Omonene nakwanire.”
swahili: Usiwaogope, kwa maana niko pamoja nawe nikuokoe,” asema Bwana.

english: Then the LORD reached out His hand, touched my mouth, and said to me: “Behold, I have put My words in your mouth.
ekegusii: Omonene akarambora okoboko kwaye, agakuna omonwa one, aganteebia, “Rora, nabekire amang’ana aane ime ase omonwa oo.
swahili: Kisha Bwana akaunyoosha mkono wake na kugusa kinywa changu, akaniambia, “Sasa nimeyaweka maneno yangu kinywani mwako.

english: When Pashhur the priest, the son of Immer and the chief official in the house of the LORD, heard Jeremiah prophesying these things,
ekegusii: Ekero Pasuri Omokuani, mosinto o Imeri, oyorenge omoteneneri omonene bw’enyomba y’Omonene, aigwete Yeremia okobana amang’ana ayio,
swahili: Ikawa kuhani Pashuri mwana wa Imeri, mkuu wa maafisa wa Hekalu la Bwana, alipomsikia Yeremia akitoa unabii juu ya mambo haya,

english: For I have heard the whispering of many: “Terror is on every side! Report him; let us report him!” All my trusted friends watch for my fall: “Perhaps he will be deceived so that we may prevail against him and take our vengeance upon him.”
ekegusii: Nabeire nkoigwa abanto bakomonyererana, na obwoba nigo bore ase chinsemo chionsi. Barabwo bateba, “Tomosoere, ee, tiga tomosoere!” Nabo abasani baane bonsi, abwo twanchaine, basemeretie ng’a ingwe. Nigo bagoteeba, “Ande nabo araebererigwe, erinde tomobue, erio tweruserie egesiomba asare.”
swahili: Ninasikia minongʼono mingi, “Hofu iko pande zote! Mshtakini! Twendeni tumshtaki!” Rafiki zangu wote wananisubiri niteleze, wakisema, “Labda atadanganyika; kisha tutamshinda na kulipiza kisasi juu yake.”

english: But the LORD is with me like a fearsome warrior. Therefore, my persecutors will stumble and will not prevail. Since they have not succeeded, they will be utterly put to shame, with an everlasting disgrace that will never be forgotten.
ekegusii: Korende Omonene ore Omobui bw’esegi nigo are amo nainche. Ase ayio, abachandi baane nabagochwe na kogwa; barabwo tibakombua. Nabarore obosooku obonene, ekiagera tibakonyara kobua. Ogochaywa kwabo kwa botambe tigokwebwa.
swahili: Lakini Bwana yu pamoja nami kama shujaa mwenye nguvu; hivyo washtaki wangu watajikwaa na kamwe hawatashinda. Watashindwa, nao wataaibika kabisa; kukosa adabu kwao hakutasahauliwa.

english: O LORD of Hosts, who examines the righteous, who sees the heart and mind, let me see Your vengeance upon them, for to You I have committed my cause.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene bw’Emeganda, aye okorenga abanto ase oboronge, nigo omanyete chinkoro na ebirengererio. Ase ayio, nduserie egesiomba ase ababisa baane, ekiagera nabekire amang’ana aane asore.
swahili: Ee Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, wewe umjaribuye mwenye haki na kupima moyo na nia, hebu nione ukilipiza kisasi juu yao, kwa maana kwako nimeliweka shauri langu.

english: Sing to the LORD! Praise the LORD! For He rescues the life of the needy from the hands of evildoers.
ekegusii: Moterere Omonene, momotogie! Ere otooririe obogima bw’abaremerwa na kobarusia ase amaboko ’abakori amabe.
swahili: Mwimbieni Bwana! Mpeni Bwana sifa! Yeye huokoa uhai wa mhitaji kutoka mikononi mwa waovu.

english: Cursed be the day I was born! May the day my mother bore me never be blessed.
ekegusii: Riragererigwe rituko erio naiboretwe, rituko riria baba anyiborete ribe ritari nogosesenigwa.
swahili: Ilaaniwe siku niliyozaliwa! Nayo isibarikiwe ile siku mama yangu aliyonizaa!

english: Cursed be the man who brought my father the news, saying, “A son is born to you,” bringing him great joy.
ekegusii: Aragererigwe omonto oria orentete amang’ana ase tata, akamoteebia, “Kwaiboreirwe omwana omoisia”, na nigo akamogokia mono.
swahili: Alaaniwe mtu yule aliyemletea baba yangu habari, yule aliyemfanya afurahi sana, akisema, “Mtoto amezaliwa kwako, tena mtoto wa kiume!”

english: May that man be like the cities that the LORD overthrew without compassion. May he hear an outcry in the morning and a battle cry at noon,
ekegusii: Omonto oyio, tiga abe buna emechie eri’Omonene asiretie atari namaabera. Oyio tiga aigwe ebirero bi’obororo mambia, na amariogi’okogoswa mobaso gati,
swahili: Mtu huyo na awe kama miji ile ambayo Bwana Mungu aliiangamiza bila huruma. Yeye na asikie maombolezo asubuhi na kilio cha vita adhuhuri.

english: because he did not kill me in the womb so that my mother might have been my grave, and her womb forever enlarged.
ekegusii: ekiagera tang’itete ekero narenge ase enda ya baba. Onye nabeete bo anga baba nere obete embeera yane, enda yaye nanga nigo yagendererete koba enene botambe.
swahili: Kwa sababu hakuniua nikiwa tumboni, hivyo mama yangu angekuwa kaburi langu, nalo tumbo lake la uzazi lingebaki kuwa kubwa daima.

english: Why did I come out of the womb to see only trouble and sorrow, and to end my days in shame?
ekegusii: Nase ki nasogete korwa ase enda ya baba, korora emechando na obororo, na nkoba nobosooku ase amatuko amange?
swahili: Kwa nini basi nilitoka tumboni ili kuona taabu na huzuni, na kuzimaliza siku zangu katika aibu?

english: he had Jeremiah the prophet beaten and put in the stocks at the Upper Gate of Benjamin, which was by the house of the LORD.
ekegusii: agaaka Yeremia omobani, akamosiba ase rikorogoto ang’e n’Egeita kia Rogoro kia Benjamini, agwo ase enyomba y’Omonene.
swahili: akaamuru Yeremia nabii apigwe na kufungwa kwenye mkatale katika Lango la Juu la Benyamini huko Hekaluni la Bwana.

english: The next day, when Pashhur released Jeremiah from the stocks, Jeremiah said to him, “The LORD does not call you Pashhur, but Magor-missabib.
ekegusii: Rituko ria kabere, ekero Pasuri asiborete Yeremia korwa ase rikorogoto, Yeremia akamoteebia, “Omonene tagokoroka Pasuri, korende okorokire Omwoboyia ase chinsemo chionsi.
swahili: Siku ya pili Pashuri alipomwachia kutoka kwenye mkatale, Yeremia akamwambia, “ Bwana hakukuita jina lako kuwa Pashuri bali Magor-Misabibu.

english: For this is what the LORD says: ‘I will make you a terror to yourself and to all your friends. They will fall by the sword of their enemies before your very eyes. And I will hand Judah over to the king of Babylon, and he will carry them away to Babylon and put them to the sword.
ekegusii: Naki Omonene oteebire ng’a nagokore obe omwoboyia ase aye omonyene, na ase abasani bao bonsi, na ababisa babo mbaabaite nemioro ase obosio bwao. Omonene nabeeke Abayuda bonsi ase okoboko kw’omorwoti o Babiloni, nabaire gochia Babiloni ase obosomba na abaite nemioro,
swahili: Kwa kuwa hili ndilo asemalo Bwana: ‘Nitakufanya kuwa hofu kuu kwako wewe mwenyewe na rafiki zako wote, na kwa macho yako mwenyewe utawaona wakianguka kwa upanga wa adui zao. Nitawatia Yuda wote mikononi mwa mfalme wa Babeli, ambaye atawachukua na kuwapeleka Babeli, ama awaue kwa upanga.

english: I will give away all the wealth of this city—all its products and valuables, and all the treasures of the kings of Judah—to their enemies. They will plunder them, seize them, and carry them off to Babylon.
ekegusii: Nindue obotenenku bw’omochie oyio, ne chinibo chiaye chionsi, na ebinto bi’amagori amanene bireo ne chikungo chionsi chi’abarwoti b’Abayuda, mbibeeke ase amaboko ’ababisa babo, na abwo babisakore na kobiira Babiloni.
swahili: Nitatia utajiri wote wa mji huu kwa adui zao: yaani mazao yao yote, vitu vyao vyote vya thamani, na hazina zote za wafalme wa Yuda. Watavitwaa kwa nyara na kuvipeleka Babeli.

english: And you, Pashhur, and all who live in your house, will go into captivity. You will go to Babylon, and there you will die and be buried—you and all your friends to whom you have prophesied these lies.’” Jeremiah’s Complaint
ekegusii: Aye Pasuri, na abanto bonsi bamenyete ase enka yao, namwoswe, moirwe ase obosomba. Aye noirwe Babiloni, nokwereo na otindekweo, aye amo nabasani bao bonsi, abwo kwabeire gokobaanera amang’ana ’oborimo.” Yeremia okwemurungania ase Omonene
swahili: Nawe Pashuri pamoja na wote waishio katika nyumba yako mtakwenda uhamishoni Babeli. Mtafia humo na kuzikwa, wewe na rafiki zako wote ambao umewatabiria uongo.’ ” Malalamiko Ya Yeremia

english: You have deceived me, O LORD, and I was deceived. You have overcome me and prevailed. I am a laughingstock all day long; everyone mocks me.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, nigo kwang’ebereretie, okambua, na inche nkeeberereka. Igo ore ne chinguru kombua. Aye kwambuire. Abanto nigo bagonsekerera ase rituko rigima; kera omonto nigo agonchecheria.
swahili: Ee Bwana, umenidanganya, nami nikadanganyika; wewe una nguvu kuniliko, nawe umenishinda. Ninadharauliwa mchana kutwa, kila mmoja ananidhihaki.

english: For whenever I speak, I cry out; I proclaim violence and destruction. For the word of the LORD has become to me a reproach and derision all day long.
ekegusii: Ekero kende gionsi ngokwana, nigo nkorera, nigo ngoaka eriogi nteba, “Obotindi na ogosaria!” Botambe nigo ngochecherigwa na gosekererigwa ase engencho ye ring’ana riao, aye Omonene.
swahili: Kila ninenapo, ninapiga kelele nikitangaza ukatili na uharibifu. Kwa hiyo neno la Bwana limeniletea matukano na mashutumu mchana kutwa.

english: If I say, “I will not mention Him or speak any more in His name,” His message becomes a fire burning in my heart, shut up in my bones, and I become weary of holding it in, and I cannot prevail.
ekegusii: Ekero nateebete: “Bono tinkoinyora Omonene, gose gokwana ase erieta riaye nonya ng’ake,” rirorio rikaba ase enkoro yane na ase amauga aane buna omorero ogosamba osiekeireo. Nkarosa mono korikiria ime ase ’nde, tinanyarete gwetanga tindisokia.
swahili: Lakini kama nikisema, “Sitamtaja wala kusema tena kwa jina lake,” neno lake linawaka ndani ya moyo wangu kama moto, moto uliofungwa ndani ya mifupa yangu. Nimechoka sana kwa kulizuia ndani mwangu; kweli, siwezi kujizuia.

english: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD when King Zedekiah sent to him Pashhur son of Malchijah and the priest Zephaniah son of Maaseiah. They said,
ekegusii: Aya naro amang’an’Omonene arentete ase Yeremia, ekero Zedekia omorwoti amotomerete Pasuri, mosinto o Malikia, na Zefania Omokuani, mosinto o Maaseya, bakamoteebia,
swahili: Neno lilimjia Yeremia kutoka kwa Bwana wakati Mfalme Sedekia alipowatuma Pashuri mwana wa Malkiya, na kuhani Sefania mwana wa Maaseya kwake, kusema:

english: For I have set My face against this city to bring disaster and not good, declares the LORD. It will be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon, who will destroy it with fire.’ A Message to the House of David
ekegusii: Inche naonchoire obosio bwane korwania omochie oyo, tinkoyororera amaabera, korende ninyorentere amabe. Nobekwe ase okoboko kw’omorwoti o Babiloni, nere ayosambe nomorero.” Okogambigwa kw’enyomba y’omorwoti bw’Abayuda
swahili: Nimekusudia kuufanyia mji huu jambo baya, wala si jema. Utatiwa mikononi mwa mfalme wa Babeli, naye atauteketeza kwa moto, asema Bwana.’

english: Moreover, tell the house of the king of Judah to hear the word of the LORD.
ekegusii: “Kwana nabaanto b’enyomba y’omorwoti bw’Abayuda, obateebie: Igwa ring’ana ri’Omonene,
swahili: “Zaidi ya hayo, ambia nyumba ya mfalme ya Yuda, ‘Sikia neno la Bwana,

english: O house of David, this is what the LORD says: ‘Administer justice every morning, and rescue the victim of robbery from the hand of his oppressor, or My wrath will go forth like fire and burn with no one to extinguish it because of their evil deeds.
ekegusii: inwe abanto b’ororeria rwa Daudi. Aya nar’Omonene agoteeba: Mobe mokonacha ekiina kia boronge kera emambia; omonto oria ourererigwe momorusie ase okoboko kw’omochandi oye. Motakoreti bo, endamwamu yane enga buna omorero ogosamba nayoke, na onde takoyerimia. Ayio nakoreke ase engencho y’ogokora kwaino okobe.
swahili: Ewe nyumba ya Daudi, hili ndilo Bwana asemalo: “ ‘Hukumuni kwa haki kila asubuhi, mwokoeni mikononi mwa mdhalimu yeye aliyetekwa nyara, la sivyo ghadhabu yangu italipuka na kuwaka kama moto kwa sababu ya uovu mlioufanya: itawaka na hakuna wa kuizima.

english: Behold, I am against you who dwell above the valley, atop the rocky plateau— declares the LORD— you who say, “Who can come against us? Who can enter our dwellings?”
ekegusii: Inwe abanto momenyete ase rikura, nainwe abamomenyete ase amabwago ’ebitare bi’omweya, inche nabangire. Nabo inche Omonene natebiire. Inwe nigo mogokwana iga: Ning’o oranyare gotirimboka gocha aa gotorwania, gose ning’o oranyare gosoa aa ase tomenyete?
swahili: Niko kinyume nawe, ee Yerusalemu, wewe uishiye juu ya bonde hili kwenye uwanda wa juu wa miamba, asema Bwana, wewe usemaye, “Ni nani awezaye kuja kinyume chetu? Nani ataingia mahali pa kimbilio letu?”

english: I will punish you as your deeds deserve, declares the LORD. I will kindle a fire in your forest that will consume everything around you.’”
ekegusii: Inche nimbae egesusuro koreng’ana nokwama kw’ogokora kwaino. Nabo inche Omonene natebiire. Nintongie omorero ase rinani ri’omochie oyio, ninsambe ebinto bionsi biyoetanaine.”
swahili: Nitawaadhibu kama istahilivyo matendo yenu, asema Bwana. Nitawasha moto katika misitu yenu ambao utateketeza kila kitu kinachowazunguka.’ ”

english: “Please inquire of the LORD on our behalf, since Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon is waging war against us. Perhaps the LORD will perform for us something like all His past wonders, so that Nebuchadnezzar will withdraw from us.”
ekegusii: “Gaki kwana n’Omonene ribaga riaito, ekiagera Nebukadinesaro, omorwoti o Babiloni, ngocha are gotorwania esegi; ande Omonene nabo arabaise gotokorera amakumia aye, erinde omorwoti oyio atotige tatorwania.”
swahili: “Tuulizie sasa kwa Bwana, kwa sababu Nebukadneza mfalme wa Babeli anatushambulia. Labda Bwana atatenda maajabu kwa ajili yetu kama nyakati zilizopita, ili Nebukadneza atuondokee.”

english: But Jeremiah answered, “You are to tell Zedekiah that
ekegusii: Erio Yeremia akabairaneria, “Teebia Zedekia
swahili: Lakini Yeremia akawajibu, “Mwambieni Sedekia,

english: this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘I will turn against you the weapons of war in your hands, with which you are fighting the king of Babylon and the Chaldeans who besiege you outside the wall, and I will assemble their forces in the center of this city.
ekegusii: ng’a aya nar’Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, agoteeba: Naama! Ebirwanero ebio mobwate ase amaboko aino korwaneria omorwoti o Babiloni na Abakalidayo, abwo baabanaaririe isiko ye chindwaki, inche omonyene nimbionchore na mbisangererie amo gati‐gati y’omochie oyio.
swahili: ‘Hili ndilo Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli, asemalo: Ninakaribia kuwageuzia silaha za vita zilizo mikononi mwenu, ambazo mnatumia kupigana na mfalme wa Babeli na Wakaldayo ambao wako nje ya ukuta wakiwazunguka kwa jeshi. Nami nitawakusanya ndani ya mji huu.

english: And I Myself will fight against you with an outstretched hand and a mighty arm, with anger, fury, and great wrath.
ekegusii: Inche omonyene mbarwanie inwe nokoboko kwane kore ne chinguru, imbe nendamwamu, na obotindi, na okogechigwa okonene.
swahili: Mimi mwenyewe nitapigana dhidi yenu kwa mkono wangu ulionyooshwa na mkono wa nguvu, kwa hasira na ghadhabu kali na ukali mwingi.

english: I will strike down the residents of this city, both man and beast. They will die in a terrible plague.’
ekegusii: Ning’ite abanto abamenyete ase omochie oyio, ng’ite ne ching’iti chireo. Oborwaire bogoita mboite Mwanyabaanto ne ching’iti.”
swahili: Nitawaangamiza waishio katika mji huu, watu na wanyama, nao watauawa kwa tauni ya kutisha.

english: ‘After that,’ declares the LORD, ‘I will hand over Zedekiah king of Judah, his officers, and the people in this city who survive the plague and sword and famine, to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and to their enemies who seek their lives. He will put them to the sword; he will not spare them or show pity or compassion.’
ekegusii: Naende Omonene oteebire, “Magega y’ayio nimbeke Zedekia, omorwoti bw’Abayuda, na abasomba baye, na abanto b’omochie oyo, baria bataitwe noborwaire, gose nemioro, gose nenchara, mbabeeke ase okoboko kwa Nebukadinesaro, omorwoti o Babiloni, na ase amaboko ’ababisa babo. Abwo bakorigia obogima bwabo. Takobarorera amabeebe, gose kobatiga mobe moyo, gose kobarorera amaabera.
swahili: Baada ya hayo, nitamtia Sedekia mfalme wa Yuda, maafisa wake na watu wa mji huu ambao walinusurika tauni, upanga na njaa, mkononi mwa Nebukadneza mfalme wa Babeli, na kwa adui zao wale wanaotafuta uhai wao. Atawaua kwa upanga; hatakuwa na rehema juu yao au huruma wala kuwasikitikia,’ asema Bwana.

english: Furthermore, you are to tell this people that this is what the LORD says: ‘Behold, I set before you the way of life and the way of death.
ekegusii: “Otebie abanto aba ng’a aya nar’Omonene agoteeba: Rora, nabekire ase amasio aino enchera y’obogima na ey’amakweri.
swahili: “Zaidi ya hayo, waambie watu hawa, ‘Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana: Tazama, naweka mbele yenu njia ya uzima, na njia ya mauti.

english: Whoever stays in this city will die by sword and famine and plague, but whoever goes out and surrenders to the Chaldeans who besiege you will live; he will retain his life like a spoil of war.
ekegusii: Omonto orabeere ase omochie oyo ime naitwe nemioro, na enchara, na oborwaire; korende oyorasoke korwa imeo na kwerua ase amaboko ’Abakalidayo, abwo banaaretie omochie, oyio nere orabe moyo, na tabaisa goitwa ase esegi.
swahili: Yeyote atakayekaa katika mji huu atakufa kwa upanga, njaa au tauni. Lakini yeyote atakayetoka na kujisalimisha kwa Wakaldayo ambao wameuzunguka mji huu kwa jeshi, atanusurika, naye ataishi.

english: This is what the LORD says: “Go down to the palace of the king of Judah and proclaim this message there,
ekegusii: Aya nar’Omonene agoteeba: “Tirimboka gochia ase enyomba y’omorwoti bw’Abayuda, okwane amang’ana aya:
swahili: Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana: “Shuka kwenye jumba la kifalme la mfalme wa Yuda, utangaze ujumbe huu huko:

english: Do not weep for the dead king; do not mourn his loss. Weep bitterly for the one who is exiled, for he will never return to see his native land.
ekegusii: Timobaisa koreera omonto okuure, gose komobokeria amagombo; korende momoreere mono oyochiire aare, ekiagera oyio takoirana naende korora ense yaye ase aiboreretwe.
swahili: Usimlilie yeye aliyekufa, wala usimwombolezee; badala yake, afadhali umlilie kwa uchungu yule aliyepelekwa uhamishoni, kwa sababu kamwe hatairudia wala kuiona tena nchi yake alikozaliwa.

english: For this is what the LORD says concerning Shallum son of Josiah, king of Judah, who succeeded his father Josiah but has gone forth from this place: “He will never return,
ekegusii: Aya nar’Omonene agoteeba igoro ya Salumu, mosinto o Yosia, Salumu oria ogamberete Abayuda ribaga ria ise na akagenda agatiga aase aa: “Ere takoirana aiga nonya ng’ake,
swahili: Kwa kuwa hili ndilo asemalo Bwana kuhusu Shalumu mwana wa Yosia, aliyeingia mahali pa baba yake kuwa mfalme wa Yuda, lakini ameondoka mahali hapa: “Yeye kamwe hatarudi tena.

english: but he will die in the place to which he was exiled; he will never see this land again.” A Warning about Jehoiakim
ekegusii: korende aase airetwe obosomba, nao arakwere, gose takoirana gocha aa ase ense ayerore naende.” Obobani bwa Yeremia igoro ya Yehoyakimu
swahili: Atafia huko mahali walipompeleka kuwa mateka; hataiona tena nchi hii.”

english: “Woe to him who builds his palace by unrighteousness, and his upper rooms without justice, who makes his countrymen serve without pay, and fails to pay their wages,
ekegusii: Obobe nobw’omonto oyio okoagacha enyomba yaye ase chinchera chitari chia boronge, na ase oborianania koroisia chiero chinene chi’enyomba yaye; oyio ogokora omogisangio oye amokorere emeremo bosa, na tari komoakana eng’eria yaye.
swahili: “Ole wake yeye ajengaye jumba lake la kifalme kwa njia ya dhuluma, vyumba vyake vya juu kwa udhalimu, akiwatumikisha watu wa nchi yake pasipo malipo, bila kuwalipa kwa utumishi wao.

english: who says, ‘I will build myself a great palace, with spacious upper rooms.’ So he cuts windows in it, panels it with cedar, and paints it with vermilion.
ekegusii: Obobe nobwaye omonto oyio ogokwana: “Ninyeagachere enyomba enene, enachanire chiero chinene ase rirongo riaye. Nigo akobochora chitirisa chingare ase enyomba eria, naende ochabera chinyasi nemecharake na oyeaka erangi embariri ye rigori rinene.
swahili: Asema, ‘Nitajijengea jumba kuu la kifalme, na vyumba vya juu vyenye nafasi kubwa.’ Hivyo anaweka ndani yake madirisha makubwa, huweka kuta za mbao za mierezi, na kuipamba kwa rangi nyekundu.

english: Does it make you a king to excel in cedar? Did not your father have food and drink? He administered justice and righteousness, and so it went well with him.
ekegusii: Inee! Nigo okagete ng’a aye nomorwoti ore, ekiagera okoamererania nabande ase okoagachera emecharake? Inee! Iso tariete endagera na konywa, naende agakora ayare ay’ekeene na oboronge? Ee, ase engencho eyio amang’ana nigo abeete amaya asare.
swahili: “Je, inakufanya kuwa mfalme huko kuongeza idadi ya mierezi? Je, baba yako hakuwa na chakula na kinywaji? Alifanya yaliyo sawa na haki, hivyo yeye akafanikiwa katika yote.

english: He took up the cause of the poor and needy, and so it went well with him. Is this not what it means to know Me?” declares the LORD.
ekegusii: Ere nigo arenge konacha ebiina ebironge ase abataka na ase abaremerwa, ase igo amang’ana akaba amaya asare. Inee! Ase ogokora igo tari rirorio okomanya inche? Nab’Omonene akwanire.
swahili: Aliwatetea maskini na wahitaji, hivyo yeye akafanikiwa katika yote. Je, hiyo si ndiyo maana ya kunijua mimi?” asema Bwana.

english: “But your eyes and heart are set on nothing except your own dishonest gain, on shedding innocent blood, on practicing extortion and oppression.”
ekegusii: Amaiso ao na enkoro yao nigo bire ne ribero ri’okonyora ebitoki bia bosa, na ogoitera amanyinga ’omonto otari nokomocha, na kwenaria obourereria na obotindi.”
swahili: “Lakini macho yako na moyo wako vimeelekezwa tu katika mapato ya udhalimu, kwa kumwaga damu isiyo na hatia, kwa uonevu na ukatili.”

english: Therefore this is what the LORD says concerning Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah: “They will not mourn for him: ‘Alas, my brother! Alas, my sister!’ They will not mourn for him: ‘Alas, my master! Alas, his splendor!’
ekegusii: Ase ayio, aya nar’Omonene agoteeba igoro ya Yehoyakimu mosinto o Yosia, omorwoti bw’Abayuda: “Abanto tibakomoreera na gokwana: Obee! Momura ominto! Gose: Obee! Mosubati ominto! Onde tari oramoreere na gokwana: Obee! Omonene! Obee! Naki arenge Omonene!
swahili: Kwa hiyo hili ndilo asemalo Bwana kuhusu Yehoyakimu mwana wa Yosia mfalme wa Yuda: “Hawatamwombolezea wakisema: ‘Ole, ndugu yangu! Ole, umbu langu!’ Hawatamwombolezea wakisema: ‘Ole, bwana wangu! Ole, fahari yake!’

english: He will be buried like a donkey, dragged away and thrown outside the gates of Jerusalem.
ekegusii: Ere nigo aratindekwe buna etigere egotindekwa. Nigo arakururwe atugutwe isiko y’ebiita bia Yerusalemu.” Obobani bwa Yeremia igoro y’ogosirigwa kwa Yerusalemu
swahili: Atazikwa maziko ya punda: ataburutwa na kutupwa nje ya malango ya Yerusalemu.”

english: saying, ‘Hear the word of the LORD, O king of Judah, who sits on the throne of David—you and your officials and your people who enter these gates.
ekegusii: Aye omorwoti bw’Abayuda oikaransete ase ekerogo ki’oborwoti gia Daudi, aye amo nabasomba bao, na abanto bao mogosoera ebiita ebi, igwa ring’ana ri’Omonene.
swahili: ‘Sikia neno la Bwana, ee mfalme wa Yuda, wewe uketiye kwenye kiti cha enzi cha Daudi: wewe, maafisa wako na watu wako mnaopitia malango haya.

english: Go up to Lebanon and cry out; raise your voice in Bashan; cry out from Abarim, for all your lovers have been crushed.
ekegusii: Tiira gochia Lebanoni, morere, moake amariogi agwo Basani, morere korwa Abarimu, ekiagera abanchwa bao basirigwe.
swahili: “Panda Lebanoni ukapige kelele, sauti yako na isikike huko Bashani, piga kelele toka Abarimu, kwa kuwa wote waliojiunga nawe wameangamizwa.

english: I warned you when you were secure. You said, ‘I will not listen.’ This has been your way from youth, that you have not obeyed My voice.
ekegusii: Inche nigo nakwanete naye, ekero kwarenge nogosesenigwa, korende ogakana ogateba: “Inche tinkogotegerera.” Ayio naro kwabeire kogokora korwa oboke bwao; tikwarenge konyigwera.
swahili: Nilikuonya wakati ulipojisikia kwamba uko salama, lakini ulisema, ‘Mimi sitasikiliza!’ Hii imekuwa kawaida yako tangu ujana wako; hujanitii mimi.

english: The wind will drive away all your shepherds, and your lovers will go into captivity. Then you will be ashamed and humiliated because of all your wickedness.
ekegusii: Omwaga noirurukie abarisia bao bonsi, na abanchwa bao nabooswe, bairwe ase obosomba, erio aye norore obosooku na gotang’ang’a ase engencho y’ebibe biao bionsi.
swahili: Upepo utawaondoa wachungaji wako wote, na wale ulioungana nao wataenda uhamishoni. Kisha utaaibika na kufedheheka kwa sababu ya uovu wako wote.

english: O inhabitant of Lebanon, nestled in the cedars, how you will groan when pangs of anguish come upon you, agony like a woman in labor.” A Warning to Coniah
ekegusii: Inwe abanto ba Lebanoni, mwabeire more n’obotoereru ase ebiswa biaino ime, ase egati y’emecharake. Ekeene, namweumie ekero moraigwe obororo, obororo buna obw’omokuungu okobina aibore. Ekiina kia Nyasae igoro ya Konia
swahili: Wewe uishiye Lebanoni, wewe uliyetulia kwenye majengo ya mierezi, tazama jinsi utakavyoomboleza maumivu makali yatakapokupata, maumivu kama yale ya mwanamke mwenye utungu wa kuzaa!

english: “As surely as I live,” declares the LORD, “even if you, Coniah son of Jehoiakim king of Judah, were a signet ring on My right hand, I would pull you off.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: “Ekeene, buna inche inde moyo, nonya aye Konia omorwoti bw’Abayuda, kore mosinto o Yehoyakimu, kwarenge koba ebonyi ere nekemanyererio kiane ebekire ase okoboko kwane gw’okorio, nabo nare kogosomora.
swahili: “Hakika kama niishivyo,” asema Bwana, “hata kama wewe, Yekonia mwana wa Yehoyakimu mfalme wa Yuda, ungekuwa pete yangu ya muhuri katika mkono wangu wa kuume, bado ningekungʼoa hapo.

english: In fact, I will hand you over to those you dread, who want to take your life—to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and to the Chaldeans.
ekegusii: Naende ninkobeke ase amaboko abanto abwo bakorigia obogima bwao, abwo oirogete. Ninkobeke ase okoboko kwa Nebukadinesaro, omorwoti o Babiloni, na ase okoboko kw’Abakalidayo.
swahili: Nitakutia mikononi mwa wale wanaotafuta uhai wako, wale unaowaogopa, yaani Nebukadneza mfalme wa Babeli na kwa Wakaldayo.

english: I will hurl you and the mother who gave you birth into another land, where neither of you were born—and there you both will die.
ekegusii: Ningoserie ne chinguru amo na nyoko okoiborete, erinde mogende ase ense eng’ao ase motaiboreretwe, mokwereo.
swahili: Nitakutupa mbali wewe na mama aliyekuzaa mwende katika nchi nyingine, ambayo hakuna hata mmoja wenu aliyezaliwa huko, nanyi mtafia huko.

english: You will never return to the land for which you long.”
ekegusii: Na ase ense moraganie koirana gochiao, timokonyara.”
swahili: Kamwe hamtarudi katika nchi mliyotamani kuirudia.”

english: Is this man Coniah a despised and shattered pot, a jar that no one wants? Why are he and his descendants hurled out and cast into a land they do not know?
ekegusii: Inee! Omonto oyo Konia nigo abeire buna enyongo yatekire, egekorero onde ataganeti? Nase ki rende ere amo nabana baye barutirwe gochia ase ense batamanyeti?
swahili: Je, huyu mtu Yekonia ni chungu kilichodharauliwa, chungu kilichovunjika, chombo kisichotakiwa na mtu yeyote? Kwa nini yeye na watoto wake watupwe nje kwa nguvu, na kutupwa kwenye nchi wasioijua?

english: O land, land, land, hear the word of the LORD!
ekegusii: Aye ense, ense, ense! Igwa ring’ana ri’Omonene!
swahili: Ee nchi, nchi, nchi, sikia neno la Bwana!

english: This is what the LORD says: Administer justice and righteousness. Rescue the victim of robbery from the hand of his oppressor. Do no wrong or violence to the foreigner, the fatherless, or the widow. Do not shed innocent blood in this place.
ekegusii: Aya nar’Omonene agoteeba: Kora ayare ay’ekeene na oboronge, naende motoorie omonto ourererigwe korwa ase okoboko kw’omochandi oye. Timobaisa gokorera abamenyi ne chintakana bobe, gose ababoraka, gose koba abatindi ase bare, na aase aiga timobaisa goitera amanyinga ’omonto otari na komocha.
swahili: Hili ndilo Bwana asemalo: Tenda haki na adili. Mwokoe mkononi mwa mdhalimu yeye aliyetekwa nyara. Usimtendee mabaya wala ukatili mgeni, yatima au mjane, wala usimwage damu isiyo na hatia mahali hapa.

english: This is what the LORD says: “Enroll this man as childless, a man who will not prosper in his lifetime. None of his descendants will prosper to sit on the throne of David or to rule again in Judah.”
ekegusii: Aya nar’Omonene agoteeba: “Riika igoro y’omonto oyio ng’a tari nabana, obeire omonto otasesenetigwe ase obogima bwaye. Ororeria rwaye tirogotoka roraikaranse ase ekerogo ki’oborwoti gia Daudi agambere Abayuda.”
swahili: Hili ndilo Bwana asemalo: “Mwandike huyu mtu kama asiye na mtoto, mtu ambaye hatafanikiwa maisha yake yote, kwa maana hakuna mtoto wake atakayefanikiwa, wala kukaa kwenye kiti cha enzi cha Daudi wala kuendelea kutawala katika Yuda.”

english: For if you will indeed carry out these commands, then kings who sit on David’s throne will enter through the gates of this palace riding on chariots and horses—they and their officials and their people.
ekegusii: Ekeene, komoraigwe ring’ana eri, abarwoti mbagenderere goikaransa ase ekerogo ki’oborwoti gia Daudi, mbabe bagosoera ebiita bi’omochie bariinete chigari ne chibarasi, barabwo amo nabasomba babo, na abanto babo.
swahili: Kwa kuwa ukiwa mwangalifu kushika maagizo haya, ndipo wafalme watakaokalia kiti cha enzi cha Daudi watakapoingia kupitia malango ya jumba hili la kifalme, wakiwa wamepanda magari na farasi, huku wakifuatana na maafisa wao na watu wao.

english: But if you do not obey these words, then I swear by Myself, declares the LORD, that this house will become a pile of rubble.’” A Warning about the Palace
ekegusii: Korende onye timokoigwera amang’ana aya, inche omonyene netianirie ng’a enyomba eye nebe bosa. Nab’Omonene atebiire.”
swahili: Lakini kama hutayatii maagizo haya, asema Bwana, ninaapa kwa nafsi yangu kwamba jumba hili litakuwa gofu.’ ”

english: For this is what the LORD says concerning the house of the king of Judah: “You are like Gilead to Me, like the summit of Lebanon; but I will surely turn you into a desert, like cities that are uninhabited.
ekegusii: Aya nar’Omonene agoteeba igoro y’enyomba y’oborwoti bw’Abayuda: “Aye nigo ore ase ’nde buna Gileadi, na buna egetunwa kia Lebanoni, korende nonya naboigo, ekeene, ningokore obe buna erooro, na buna omochie otamenyiri nabaanto.
swahili: Kwa kuwa hili ndilo Bwana asemalo kuhusu jumba la kifalme la mfalme wa Yuda: “Ingawa uko kama Gileadi kwangu, kama kilele cha Lebanoni, hakika nitakufanya uwe kama jangwa, kama miji ambayo haijakaliwa na watu.

english: I will appoint destroyers against you, each man with his weapons, and they will cut down the choicest of your cedars and throw them into the fire.
ekegusii: Nintome abanto bache kogosiria; kera oyomo agochere obwate ebirwanero biaye bi’esegi, nabarabwo nabageche emete y’emecharake, eria ere emiya mono ase more, na bayerute ase omorero.
swahili: Nitawatuma waharabu dhidi yako, kila mtu akiwa na silaha zake, nao watazikata boriti zako nzuri za mierezi na kuzitupa motoni.

english: And many nations will pass by this city and ask one another, ‘Why has the LORD done such a thing to this great city?’
ekegusii: “Abanto b’ebisaku ebinge nabaetere ase omochie oyo, babe bakoborania: Nase ki Omonene akorire omochie oyo omonene osarekire iga?
swahili: “Watu kutoka mataifa mengi watapitia karibu na mji huu na kuulizana, ‘Kwa nini Bwana amefanya jambo la namna hii juu ya mji huu mkubwa?’

english: Then people will reply, ‘Because they have forsaken the covenant of the LORD their God and have worshiped and served other gods.’” A Warning about Shallum
ekegusii: Nabairanerigwe: Aya nigo akorekire, ekiagera abanto b’omochie oyo batigete okobwatana kw’ogotianania kw’Omonene, Nyasae obo, bakaonchokera gosasiima na gokorera chinyasae ching’ao.” Obobani bwa Yeremia igoro ya Salumu, nere Yehoahasi
swahili: Nalo jibu litakuwa: ‘Kwa sababu wameliacha agano la Bwana, Mungu wao, na wameabudu na kuitumikia miungu mingine.’ ”

english: “Woe to the shepherds who destroy and scatter the sheep of My pasture!” declares the LORD.
ekegusii: Obobe nobw’abarisia abwo bagosaria na goserebania ching’ondi chie riicho riane. Nab’Omonene atebiire.
swahili: “Ole wao wachungaji wanaoharibu na kutawanya kondoo wa malisho yangu!” asema Bwana.

english: For the land is full of adulterers— because of the curse, the land mourns and the pastures of the wilderness have dried up— their course is evil and their power is misused.
ekegusii: Ense eye nigo eichire nabatomani, nigo ekweumia ase engencho y’okoragererigwa, na amarisia ’erooro omire. Orogendo rw’abaanto nigo rore orobe, ne chinguru chiabo nigo chire ase ogokora aya atari amaronge.
swahili: Nchi imejaa wazinzi; kwa sababu ya laana, nchi imekauka na malisho yaliyoko nyikani yamekauka. Mwenendo wa manabii ni mbaya na mamlaka yao si ya haki.

english: “For both prophet and priest are ungodly; even in My house I have found their wickedness,” declares the LORD.
ekegusii: “Abaabani na abakuani tibamoirogeti Nyasae. Nonya nase enyomba yane obobe bwabo bwarorekanire.” Nab’Omonene atebiire.
swahili: “Nabii na kuhani wote si wacha Mungu; hata hekaluni mwangu ninaona uovu wao,” asema Bwana.

english: “Therefore their path will become slick; they will be driven away into the darkness and fall into it. For I will bring disaster upon them in the year of their punishment,” declares the LORD.
ekegusii: “Ase ayio chinchera chiabo nachibe ase bare buna chinchera chinterere ase omosunte, agwo ase baraserigwe gochia, bagweo. Nindete obobe igoro ase bare ase omwaka oria ndabae egesusuro.” Nabo inche Omonene natebiire.
swahili: “Kwa hiyo mapito yao yatakuwa utelezi, watafukuziwa mbali gizani na huko wataanguka. Nitaleta maafa juu yao katika mwaka wa kuadhibiwa kwao,” asema Bwana.

english: “Among the prophets of Samaria I saw an offensive thing: They prophesied by Baal and led My people Israel astray.
ekegusii: “Naroche oboriri ase ababani ba Samaria, nigo barenge kobana ase erieta ri’enyasae Baali, na gotantania abanto baane Abaisraeli.
swahili: “Miongoni mwa manabii wa Samaria nililiona jambo la kuchukiza: Walitabiri kwa Baali na kuwapotosha Israeli watu wangu.

english: And among the prophets of Jerusalem I have seen a horrible thing: They commit adultery and walk in lies. They strengthen the hands of evildoers, so that no one turns his back on wickedness. They are all like Sodom to Me; the people of Jerusalem are like Gomorrah.”
ekegusii: Korende narorire ababani ba Yerusalemu bakorire obobe goetania. Nigo bagokora obotomani na gosiarera oborimo. Nigo bakobeeka abakori amabe chinguru, erinde onde taonchoka na gotiga ebibe biaye. Bonsi babeire ase ’nde buna abanto ba Sodomu, na abanto bamenyete Yerusalemu babeire buna aba Gomora.”
swahili: Nako miongoni mwa manabii wa Yerusalemu nimeona jambo baya sana: Wanafanya uzinzi na kuenenda katika uongo. Wanatia nguvu mikono ya watenda mabaya, kwa ajili hiyo hakuna yeyote anayeachana na uovu wake. Wote wako kama Sodoma kwangu; watu na Yerusalemu wako kama Gomora.”

english: Therefore this is what the LORD of Hosts says concerning the prophets: “I will feed them wormwood and give them poisoned water to drink, for from the prophets of Jerusalem ungodliness has spread throughout the land.”
ekegusii: Aya nar’Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteeba igoro y’ababani abwo: “Naama! Nimbae ekemeri ekeroro barie, nimbae namaache are nobosongo banywe. Korwa ase ababani ba Yerusalemu, ogotamoiroka Nyasae gwesiareire ase ense yonsi.”
swahili: Kwa hiyo, hili ndilo Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote asemalo kuhusu manabii: “Nitawafanya wale chakula kichungu na kunywa maji yaliyotiwa sumu, kwa sababu kutokana na manabii wa Yerusalemu kutokumcha Mungu kumeenea katika nchi yote.”

english: This is what the LORD of Hosts says: “Do not listen to the words of the prophets who prophesy to you. They are filling you with false hopes. They speak visions from their own minds, not from the mouth of the LORD.
ekegusii: Aya nar’Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteeba: “Timobaisa koigwera amang’ana ’ababani abwo bakonakobaabaanera na kobaichoria nogosemeria kw’obong’ainereria. Barabwo nigo bagokwana amaroro aye chindoto chie chinkoro chiabo, gose tari ayakorwa ase omonwa one inche Omonene.
swahili: Hili ndilo Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote asemalo: “Msisikilize wanachowatabiria manabii, wanawajaza matumaini ya uongo. Wanasema maono kutoka akili zao wenyewe, hayatoki katika kinywa cha Bwana.

english: They keep saying to those who despise Me, ‘The LORD says that you will have peace,’ and to everyone who walks in the stubbornness of his own heart, ‘No harm will come to you.’
ekegusii: Abwo nigo bagendererete goteebia abanto baria bachayete ring’ana riane: Omonene oteebire ng’a namonyore omorembe. Naende bateebia baria bakobwatia obomwenu bwe chinkoro chiabo: Amabe tagocha ase more.”
swahili: Huendelea kuwaambia wale wanaonidharau mimi, ‘ Bwana asema: Mtakuwa na amani.’ Kwa wale wote wafuatao ugumu wa mioyo yao, wao husema, ‘Hakuna dhara litakalowapata.’

english: But which of them has stood in the council of the LORD to see and hear His word? Who has given heed to His word and obeyed it?
ekegusii: Ning’o ase egati y’ababani abwo otenenire ase ekegambero ki’Omonene koigwa na komanya ring’ana riaye? Gose ning’o otegereire ring’ana riaye na oriigure?
swahili: Lakini ni yupi miongoni mwao aliyesimama katika baraza la Bwana ili kuona au kusikia neno lake? Ni nani aliyesikiliza na kusikia neno lake?

english: Behold, the storm of the LORD has gone out with fury, a whirlwind swirling down upon the heads of the wicked.
ekegusii: Rora, omwaga omotindi okorwa ase Omonene, oichire nendamwamu yaye enga buna ekerambauti osokire; nigo egocha igoro ase emetwe y’abanyabibe.
swahili: Tazama, dhoruba ya Bwana itapasuka kwa ghadhabu, kisulisuli kitazunguka na kuanguka vichwani vya waovu.

english: Therefore this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says about the shepherds who tend My people: “You have scattered My flock and driven them away, and have not attended to them. Behold, I will attend to you for the evil of your deeds, declares the LORD.
ekegusii: Aya nar’Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, agoteeba igoro y’abarisia, abwo babekire korenda abanto baane: Inwe mwaserebanirie riicho riane, mwariseririe gochia aare, gose timwariechanderete. Naama! Nimbae inwe egesusuro ase engencho y’ogokora kwaino okobe.
swahili: Kwa hiyo hili ndilo Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli, analowaambia wachungaji wanaowachunga watu wangu: “Kwa sababu mmelitawanya kundi langu na kuwafukuzia mbali, wala hamkuwatunza, basi mimi nitawaadhibu kwa ajili ya uovu mliofanya,” asema Bwana.

english: The anger of the LORD will not turn back until He has fully accomplished the purposes of His heart. In the days to come you will understand this clearly.
ekegusii: Omonene takoonchoka atige endamwamu yaye, goika aikeranie okogania kw’ebirengererio biaye ase okonacha ekiina. Nigo morache komanya buya amang’ana ayio ase amatuko agocha.
swahili: Hasira ya Bwana haitageuka mpaka amelitimiza kusudi la moyo wake. Siku zijazo mtalifahamu kwa wazi.

english: I did not send these prophets, yet they have run with their message; I did not speak to them, yet they have prophesied.
ekegusii: “Inche tinatomete ababani abwo, korende nigo baminyogete boka abanyene; tinakwanete nabarabwo, korende nigo bagendererete kobana.
swahili: Mimi sikuwatuma manabii hawa, lakini bado wamekimbia wakitangaza ujumbe wao. Mimi sikusema nao, lakini wametabiri.

english: But if they had stood in My council, they would have proclaimed My words to My people and turned them back from their evil ways and deeds.”
ekegusii: Korende onye ababani abwo mbaigwerete ogosemia kwane, nanga mbaraaretie amang’ana aane ase abanto baane, na nigo barenge gocha koonchora abanto batige ebibe biabo na ogokora kwabo okobe.
swahili: Lakini kama wangesimama barazani mwangu, wangetangaza maneno yangu kwa watu wangu, nao wangewageuza kutoka njia zao mbaya na kutoka matendo yao maovu.”

english: “Am I only a God nearby,” declares the LORD, “and not a God far away?”
ekegusii: “Inee! Inche nigo inde Nyasae ore ang’e rioka? Tindi Nyasae ore aare boigo?
swahili: “Je, mimi ni Mungu aliyeko hapa karibu tu,” Bwana asema, “wala si Mungu aliyeko pia mbali?

english: “Can a man hide in secret places where I cannot see him?” declares the LORD. “Do I not fill the heavens and the earth?” declares the LORD.
ekegusii: Naende inche Omonene nigo ngoteeba: Inee! Omonto nanyare kwebisa aase are bobisi inche ntamorore? Tari inche oria inde aande onsi, igoro na ense?
swahili: Je, mtu yeyote aweza kujificha mahali pa siri ili nisiweze kumwona?” Bwana asema. “Je, mimi sikuijaza mbingu na nchi?” Bwana asema.

english: “I have heard the sayings of the prophets who prophesy lies in My name: ‘I had a dream! I had a dream!’
ekegusii: Naigure amang’ana ’ababani abwo bagokwana, abwo bakobana oborimo ase erieta riane, bagoteeba. Inche narotete, ee, narotete!
swahili: “Nimesikia wanayoyasema manabii, hao wanaotabiri uongo kwa jina langu. Wanasema, ‘Nimeota ndoto! Nimeota ndoto!’

english: How long will this continue in the hearts of these prophets who prophesy falsehood, these prophets of the delusion of their own minds?
ekegusii: Inee! Ngoika ririri oborimo boragenderere koba ime ase chinkoro chi’ababani abwo bakobana obong’ainereria bwe chinkoro chiabo?
swahili: Mambo haya yataendelea mpaka lini ndani ya mioyo ya hawa manabii wa uongo, ambao hutabiri maono ya uongo ya akili zao wenyewe?

english: They suppose the dreams that they tell one another will make My people forget My name, just as their fathers forgot My name through the worship of Baal.
ekegusii: Abaabani abwo barengereirie ng’a abanto baane nigo barebe erieta riane ase engencho ye chindoto chiabo babe bagoteebania buna chisokoro chiabo chiebete erieta riane, chikaonchokera Baali.
swahili: Wanadhani ndoto wanazoambiana wao kwa wao zitawafanya watu wangu walisahau jina langu, kama baba zao walivyolisahau jina langu kwa kumwabudu Baali.

english: Let the prophet who has a dream retell it, but let him who has My word speak it truthfully. For what is straw compared to grain?” declares the LORD.
ekegusii: Omobani oria obwate chindoto, tiga achikwane, korende oyobwate ring’ana riane, tiga arikwane ase obwegenwa. Inee! Omoiriro, ninki oisaine ekero okoreng’anigwa nengano? Nabo inche Omonene natebiire.
swahili: Mwache nabii aliye na ndoto aseme ndoto yake, lakini yule aliye na neno langu na aliseme kwa uaminifu. Kwa maana jani kavu lina uhusiano gani na ngano?” asema Bwana.

english: “Is not My word like fire,” declares the LORD, “and like a hammer that smashes a rock?”
ekegusii: Inee! Ring’ana riane tiriri buna omorero, naende buna enyundo egwatia ebitare? Nab’Omonene atebiire.
swahili: “Je, neno langu si kama moto,” asema Bwana, “na kama nyundo ivunjayo mwamba vipande vipande?

english: Then I Myself will gather the remnant of My flock from all the lands to which I have banished them, and I will return them to their pasture, where they will be fruitful and multiply.
ekegusii: Ase ayio inche omonyene ninsangererie abatigari be riicho riane, mbarusie korwa chinse chionsi agwo ase nabasiarerete gochia; nimbairanie gocha ase obweri bwabo, na barabwo nabaibore na komentekana.
swahili: “Mimi mwenyewe nitayakusanya mabaki ya kundi langu kutoka nchi zote ambazo nimewafukuzia, nami nitawarudisha katika malisho yao, mahali ambapo watazaa na kuongezeka idadi yao.

english: “Therefore behold,” declares the LORD, “I am against the prophets who steal from one another words they attribute to Me.”
ekegusii: Naende omonene oteebire: Inche nigo inde mamincha y’ababani abwo bakoiba na koura abande amang’ana aane.
swahili: “Kwa hiyo, niko kinyume na manabii wanaoibiana maneno kana kwamba ni yangu,” asema Bwana.

english: “Yes,” declares the LORD, “I am against the prophets who wag their own tongues and proclaim, ‘The LORD declares it.’”
ekegusii: Boigo inche nigo inde mamincha y’ababani abwo bagokwana amang’ana abo abanyene na goteeba ng’a Omonene oteebire bo.
swahili: “Naam, mimi niko kinyume na manabii wanaotikisa ndimi zao wenyewe na kusema, ‘ Bwana asema.’

english: “Indeed,” declares the LORD, “I am against those who prophesy false dreams and retell them to lead My people astray with their reckless lies. It was not I who sent them or commanded them, and they are of no benefit at all to these people,” declares the LORD. False Prophecies
ekegusii: Naende nigo inde mamincha y’ababani abwo bakobana chindoto chi’oborimo, naende bachiteebia abanto baane na igo baabasiria. Ase ayio tibari gokonya abanto aba nonya ng’ake. Inche Omonene nakwanire.” Egurube y’Omonene
swahili: Kweli, niko kinyume na hao wanaotabiri ndoto za uongo,” asema Bwana. “Wanazisimulia na kuwapotosha watu wangu kwa uongo wao bila kujali, lakini sikuwatuma wala sikuwaamuru. Hawawafaidi watu hawa hata kidogo,” asema Bwana. Maneno Ya Uongo Na Manabii Wa Uongo

english: “Now when this people or a prophet or priest asks you, ‘What is the burden of the LORD?’ you are to say to them, ‘What burden? I will forsake you, declares the LORD.’
ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: “Ekero oyomo bw’abaanto aba, gose omobani, gose Omokuani, arakoborie: Egurube y’Omonene nereri? Obairanerie, obateebie: Ninwe egurube yaye, ere nabaserie morueo.
swahili: “Wakati watu hawa, au nabii, au kuhani watakapokuuliza, ‘Mzigo wa Bwana ni nini?’ wewe utawaambia, ‘Ninyi ndio mzigo. Nami nitawavua kama vazi, asema Bwana.’

english: As for the prophet or priest or anyone who claims, ‘This is the burden of the LORD,’ I will punish that man and his household.
ekegusii: Omobani, gose Omokuani, gose omonto onde bwensi bw’abaanto aba karakwane Egurube y’Omonene, inche nimoe egesusuro, ere amo neamate yaye.
swahili: Nabii, kuhani, au mtu yeyote akisema, ‘Huu ndio mzigo wa Bwana,’ nitamwadhibu huyo na nyumba yake.

english: This is what each man is to say to his friend and to his brother: ‘What has the LORD answered?’ or ‘What has the LORD spoken?’
ekegusii: Inwe nigo mogwenerete koborania, kera omonto nomogisangio oye, na kera oyomo noyomwabo: Mang’ana ki Omonene airaneria? Gose: Narari akwanire?
swahili: Hivyo mnaambiana kila mmoja na mwenzake, au kwa mtu wa nyumba yao: ‘ Bwana amejibu nini?’ au ‘ Bwana amesema nini?’

english: But refer no more to the burden of the LORD, for each man’s word becomes the burden, so that you pervert the words of the living God, the LORD of Hosts, our God.
ekegusii: Korende timobaisa gwatora nonya ng’ake ring’ana eri: Egurube y’Omonene, ekiagera ring’ana ri’omonto nario rire egurube asare ere omonyene. Inwe mwasaririe na koonchorana amang’ana a Nyasae ore moyo, oyore Omonene bw’Emeganda. Nyasae oito.
swahili: Lakini kamwe msiseme tena, ‘Nina mzigo wa Bwana,’ kwa sababu kila neno la mtu binafsi linakuwa mzigo wake mwenyewe, na hivyo kupotosha maneno ya Mungu aliye hai, Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, Mungu wetu.

english: Thus you are to say to the prophet: ‘What has the LORD answered you?’ and ‘What has the LORD spoken?’
ekegusii: Amang’ana aya naro oraborie ababani abwo: Ninki Omonene akoiraneirie? Gose: Narari akwanire?
swahili: Hivi ndivyo utakavyoendelea kumuuliza nabii: ‘ Bwana amekujibu nini?’ au ‘Je, Bwana amesema nini?’

english: But if you claim, ‘This is the burden of the LORD,’ then this is what the LORD says: Because you have said, ‘This is the burden of the LORD,’ and I specifically told you not to make this claim,
ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteeba ng’a inwe moise kogenderera gokwana: Egurube y’Omonene, na kwanga koigwera, korende mogokwana amang’ana ayio Omonene abakanirie ng’a timobaisa gokwana bo,
swahili: Ingawa unadai, ‘Huu ndio mzigo wa Bwana,’ hili ndilo Bwana asemalo: Ulitumia maneno, ‘Huu ndio mzigo wa Bwana,’ hata ingawa nilikuambia kuwa kamwe usiseme, ‘Huu ni mzigo wa Bwana.’

english: therefore I will surely forget you and will cast you out of My presence, both you and the city that I gave to you and your fathers.
ekegusii: rirorio inche nimbaserie morue ase obosio bwane, inwe amo nomochie oyio nabaete inwe ne chisokoro chiaino.
swahili: Kwa hiyo, hakika nitakusahau na kukutupa mbali na uso wangu pamoja na mji niliowapa ninyi na baba zenu.

english: I will raise up shepherds over them who will tend them, and they will no longer be afraid or dismayed, nor will any go missing, declares the LORD.
ekegusii: Nimbabeekere abarisia, abwo barabarende, na abanto baane tibakoba nobwoba nonya ng’ake, gose tibakoondoka, gose onde takonyara gosira. Nab’Omonene atebiire.
swahili: Nitaweka wachungaji juu yao ambao watawachunga, nao hawataogopa tena au kutishwa, wala hatapotea hata mmoja,” asema Bwana.

english: And I will bring upon you everlasting shame and perpetual humiliation that will never be forgotten.”
ekegusii: Inche nindete igoro ase more ogochaywa, na obosooku, ebio bigenderere koba ase more kare na kare.”
swahili: Nitaleta juu yako fedheha ya kudumu: yaani aibu ya kudumu ambayo haitasahaulika.”

english: Behold, the days are coming, declares the LORD, when I will raise up for David a righteous Branch, and He will reign wisely as King and will administer justice and righteousness in the land.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: “Amatuko ngocha are ekero ndasebokie oyomo ore Omoseboka omooronge o Daudi. Oyio nabe omorwoti, oragambe nobong’aini na konacha ebiina bi’ekeene na ebi’oboronge ase ense.
swahili: Bwana asema, “Siku zinakuja, nitakapomwinulia Daudi Tawi lenye haki, Mfalme atakayetawala kwa hekima, na kutenda lililo haki na sawa katika nchi.

english: In His days Judah will be saved, and Israel will dwell securely. And this is His name by which He will be called: The LORD Our Righteousness.
ekegusii: Ase amatuko aye Abayuda nabatoorigwe na Abaisraeli bamenye ase obotoereru, na oyio narokwe: Omonene Nere Oboronge Bwaito.”
swahili: Katika siku zake, Yuda ataokolewa na Israeli ataishi salama. Hili ndilo jina atakaloitwa: Bwana Haki Yetu.

english: So behold, the days are coming, declares the LORD, when they will no longer say, ‘As surely as the LORD lives, who brought the Israelites up out of the land of Egypt.’
ekegusii: Ase ayio Omonene oteebire ng’a amatuko ngocha are, ekero abanto batakwane: “Ekeene, buna Omonene are moyo, oyio orusetie Abaisraeli korwa ase ense ya Misiri.”
swahili: “Hivyo basi, siku zinakuja, wakati ambapo watu hawatasema tena, ‘Hakika kama Bwana aishivyo, aliyewapandisha Waisraeli kutoka Misri,’

english: Instead they will say, ‘As surely as the LORD lives, who brought and led the descendants of the house of Israel up out of the land of the north and all the other lands to which He had banished them.’ Then they will dwell once more in their own land.” Lying Prophets
ekegusii: Ribaga ri’ayio nigo barakwane: “Ekeene, buna Omonene are moyo, oyio orusetie na koraa ororeria rw’Abaisraeli korwa ase ense ya sugusu, na korwa ase chinse chionsi agwo ase abaseretie gochia.” Erio mbamenye ase ense yabo abanyene. Obobani bwa Yeremia igoro y’ababani
swahili: bali watasema, ‘Hakika kama Bwana aishivyo, aliyewatoa wazao wa Israeli kutoka nchi ya kaskazini na nchi zote alizokuwa amewafukuzia,’ asema Bwana. Ndipo wataishi katika nchi yao wenyewe.” Manabii Wasemao Uongo

english: As for the prophets: My heart is broken within me, and all my bones tremble. I have become like a drunkard, like a man overcome by wine, because of the LORD, because of His holy words.
ekegusii: Amang’ana igoro y’ababani: Enkoro yane yairianyekire ime yane, amauga aane onsi atengechire; nabeire buna omonto otindire ase okonywa, na buna oyo edivai yabuire, ase engencho y’Omonene na ase amang’ana aye amaachenu.
swahili: Kuhusu manabii: Moyo wangu umevunjika ndani yangu; mifupa yangu yote inatetemeka. Nimekuwa kama mtu aliyelewa, kama mtu aliyelemewa na divai, kwa sababu ya Bwana na maneno yake matakatifu.

english: After Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had carried away Jeconiah son of Jehoiakim king of Judah, as well as the officials of Judah and the craftsmen and metalsmiths from Jerusalem, and had brought them to Babylon, the LORD showed me two baskets of figs placed in front of the temple of the LORD.
ekegusii: Magega Nebukadinesaro, omorwoti o Babiloni, kairire Yekonia, mosinto o Yehoyakimu, omorwoti bw’Abayuda, amo nabanene b’oborwoti boria, na abaroisia b’ebinto, na abaturi b’ebioma, gochia Babiloni, Omonene akanyorokia okorora oko: Bosio bwe Hekalu y’Omonene nkarora ebitonga bibere biarenge namako.
swahili: Baada ya Yekonia mwana wa Yehoyakimu mfalme wa Yuda, pamoja na maafisa, mafundi stadi na wahunzi wa Yuda, kuchukuliwa kutoka Yerusalemu kwenda Babeli na Nebukadneza mfalme wa Babeli kwenda uhamishoni huko Babeli, Bwana akanionyesha vikapu viwili vya tini vilivyowekwa mbele ya Hekalu la Bwana.

english: And I will send against them sword and famine and plague, until they have perished from the land that I gave to them and their fathers.’”
ekegusii: Nimbatomere chiseegi, baitwe nemioro, na abande bakwe nenchara na amarwaire. Mbasirigwe kegima, barue ase ense eyio nabaete barabwo ne chisokoro chiabo.
swahili: Nitautuma upanga, njaa na tauni dhidi yao hadi wawe wameangamia kutoka nchi niliyowapa wao na baba zao.’ ”

english: One basket had very good figs, like those that ripen early, but the other basket contained very poor figs, so bad they could not be eaten.
ekegusii: Egetonga ekemo nigo kiarenge namako amaya mono amatobu, aya atongoretwe, na egetonga kende nigo kiarenge namako amabe mono atarenge konyara koriegwa.
swahili: Kikapu kimoja kilikuwa na tini nzuri sana, kama zile za mavuno ya kwanza. Kikapu cha pili kilikuwa na tini dhaifu sana, mbovu mno zisizofaa kuliwa.

english: “Jeremiah,” the LORD asked, “what do you see?” “Figs!” I replied. “The good figs are very good, but the bad figs are very bad, so bad they cannot be eaten.”
ekegusii: Omonene akamboria, “Yeremia, ninki ekio orooche?” Nkamoiraneria, “Namako amaya, ee namaya mono, na ayande amabe, ee, namabe mono atanyare koriegwa.”
swahili: Kisha Bwana akaniuliza, “Je, Yeremia, unaona nini?” Nikamjibu, “Ninaona tini zile zilizo nzuri ni nzuri sana, lakini zilizo dhaifu ni mbovu mno zisizofaa kuliwa.”

english: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
ekegusii: Erio ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha ase ’nde, riganteebia,
swahili: Kisha neno la Bwana likanijia:

english: “This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘Like these good figs, so I regard as good the exiles from Judah, whom I have sent away from this place to the land of the Chaldeans.
ekegusii: “Aya nar’Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, agoteeba: Abayuda abwo narusirie aase aiga na kobaira ase obosomba ase ense y’Abakalidayo nimbaabare ng’a nabaya buna amako ayio are amaya.
swahili: “Hili ndilo Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli, asemalo: ‘Kama zilivyo hizi tini nzuri, ndivyo ninavyowaona kuwa bora watu wa uhamisho kutoka Yuda, niliowaondoa kutoka mahali hapa kwenda katika nchi ya Wakaldayo.

english: I will keep My eyes on them for good and will return them to this land. I will build them up and not tear them down; I will plant them and not uproot them.
ekegusii: Nimbarende na kobakorera amaya goika mbairanie naende ase ense eye. Nimbatenenie gose tinkobatagora, nimbasimeke gose tinkobasimora.
swahili: Macho yangu yatakuwa juu yao kwa ajili ya kuwapatia mema, nami nitawarudisha tena katika nchi hii. Nitawajenga wala sitawabomoa, nitawapanda wala sitawangʼoa,

english: I will give them a heart to know Me, that I am the LORD. They will be My people, and I will be their God, for they will return to Me with all their heart.
ekegusii: Nimbae chinkoro chi’okomanya ng’a inche ninche Omonene; nababe abanto baane, na inche nimbe Nyasae obo, ekiagera barabwo nabang’iranere ne chinkoro chiabo chionsi.”
swahili: nitawapa moyo wa kunifahamu mimi, kwamba mimi ndimi Bwana. Watakuwa watu wangu, nami nitakuwa Mungu wao, kwa maana watanirudia kwa moyo wao wote.

english: But like the bad figs, so bad they cannot be eaten,’ says the LORD, ‘so will I deal with Zedekiah king of Judah, his officials, and the remnant of Jerusalem—those remaining in this land and those living in the land of Egypt.
ekegusii: Aya nar’Omonene agoteeba: Korende Zedekia, omorwoti bw’Abayuda, amo nabanene b’oborwoti bwaye, na abanto ba Yerusalemu nigo baratigare ase ense eye, na baria bamenyete Misiri nimbakore babe buna amako ayio amabe atanyare koriegwa.
swahili: “ ‘Lakini kama zilivyo zile tini dhaifu, ambazo ni mbovu mno zisizofaa kuliwa,’ asema Bwana, ‘ndivyo nitakavyomtendea Sedekia mfalme wa Yuda, maafisa wake na mabaki wengine kutoka Yerusalemu, wawe wamebaki katika nchi hii, au wanaishi Misri.

english: I will make them a horror and an offense to all the kingdoms of the earth, a disgrace and an object of scorn, ridicule, and cursing wherever I have banished them.
ekegusii: Nindete amabe amanene igoro ase bare, na abanto b’amarwoti onsi mbaichanigwe na koondoka ekero barabarore, ekiagera nimbatige bachaywe na gosekererwa, naende babe omorabaaro ne ring’ana rigokwanwa bobe, na abanto mbabe bakoragereria ase erieta riabo.
swahili: Nitawafanya kuwa chukizo kabisa na kitu cha kulaumiwa katika mataifa yote ya dunia, watakuwa aibu na kitu cha kudharauliwa, chombo cha dhihaka na kulaaniwa, popote nitakapowafukuzia.

english: This is the word that came to Jeremiah concerning all the people of Judah in the fourth year of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah, which was the first year of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon.
ekegusii: Ase omwaka o kane bw’okogamba kwa Yehoyakimu mosinto o Yosia, omorwoti bw’Abayuda, ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha ase Yeremia, rikamoteebia amang’ana igoro y’Abayuda bonsi. (Oyio noro orenge omwaka omotang’ani bw’okogamba kwa Nebukadinesaro, omorwoti o Babiloni.)
swahili: Neno likamjia Yeremia kuhusu watu wote wa Yuda, katika mwaka wa nne wa utawala wa Yehoyakimu mwana wa Yosia mfalme wa Yuda, ambao ulikuwa mwaka wa kwanza wa utawala wa Nebukadneza mfalme wa Babeli.

english: Moreover, I will banish from them the sounds of joy and gladness, the voices of the bride and bridegroom, the sound of the millstones, and the light of the lamp.
ekegusii: Ninsirie korwa ase bare eriogi ri’omogooko na eri’omochengo, na eriogi ri’omonywomi na eri’omoriakari. Eriogi ri’orogena rogosia tirikoigugwa, gose oborabu bwe chitaaya tibokobao.
swahili: Nitawaondolea sauti ya shangwe na furaha, sauti ya bibi na bwana arusi, sauti ya mawe ya kusagia, na mwanga wa taa.

english: And this whole land will become a desolate wasteland, and these nations will serve the king of Babylon for seventy years.
ekegusii: Ense eye yonsi nesareke ebe amaturi na ebisaku ebi nabimokorere omorwoti o Babiloni ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo etano na ebere.
swahili: Nchi hii yote itakuwa ukiwa na isiyofaa kitu, nayo mataifa haya yatamtumikia mfalme wa Babeli kwa miaka sabini.”

english: But when seventy years are complete, I will punish the king of Babylon and that nation, the land of the Chaldeans, for their guilt, declares the LORD, and I will make it an everlasting desolation.
ekegusii: Magega y’emiaka emerongo etano na ebere koyaerire, ning’ee omorwoti o Babiloni amo negesaku kiaye, na ense y’Abakalidayo, egesusuro ase engencho y’ebibe biabo; ninkore ense eria ebe bosa kogenderera botambe. Nab’Omonene atebiire.
swahili: “Lakini miaka sabini itakapotimia, nitamwadhibu mfalme wa Babeli na taifa lake na nchi ya Wakaldayo kwa ajili ya hatia yao,” asema Bwana. “Nitaifanya kuwa ukiwa milele.

english: I will bring upon that land all the words I have pronounced against it, all that is written in this book, which Jeremiah has prophesied against all the nations.
ekegusii: Amang’ana onsi nakwanete igoro ya Babiloni, ayarikire ase egetabu eke, ayio Yeremia abaanete mamincha y’ebisaku bionsi, ninyarente igoro ase ense eria.
swahili: Nitaleta juu ya nchi hiyo mambo yote niliyosema dhidi yake, yote yaliyoandikwa katika kitabu hiki, na kutolewa unabii na Yeremia dhidi ya mataifa yote.

english: For many nations and great kings will enslave them, and I will repay them according to their deeds and according to the work of their hands.’” The Cup of God’s Wrath
ekegusii: Nimbaakane obobe bwabo na emeremo y’amaboko abo. Ebisaku ebinge na abarwoti abanene nabakore abanto ba Babiloni babe abasomba babo.” Nyasae okonachera ebisaku ekiina
swahili: Wao wenyewe watakuwa watumwa wa mataifa mengi na wafalme wakuu. Nitawalipizia sawasawa na matendo yao na kazi ya mikono yao.” Kikombe Cha Ghadhabu Ya Mungu

english: This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, said to me: “Take from My hand this cup of the wine of wrath, and make all the nations to whom I send you drink from it.
ekegusii: Aya nar’Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, antebirie: “Bogoria egekombe eke ki’edivai y’endamwamu korwa ase okoboko kwane, erio oe ebisaku bionsi ase ndagotome gochia, biyenywe.
swahili: Hili ndilo Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli, aliloniambia: “Chukua kutoka mkononi mwangu kikombe hiki kilichojaa divai ya ghadhabu yangu, na kuyanywesha mataifa yote ambayo ninakutuma kwao.

english: And they will drink and stagger and go out of their minds, because of the sword that I will send among them.”
ekegusii: Barabwo banywe, batinde bataba‐tabe, babe buna chiosi, ase engencho y’esegi ndarente igoro ase bare.”
swahili: Watakapoinywa, watapepesuka na kukasirika sana kwa sababu ya upanga nitakaoupeleka katikati yao.”

english: So I took the cup from the LORD’s hand and made all the nations drink from it, each one to whom the LORD had sent me,
ekegusii: Ase ayio nkaimokia egekombe keria korwa ase okoboko kw’Omonene, nkaa ebisaku bionsi ase antomete gochia, nkabinyoisia edivai eria y’endamwamu yaye.
swahili: Hivyo nikakichukua kikombe kutoka mkononi mwa Bwana, na kuyafanya mataifa yote aliyonituma kwao kukinywa:

english: to make them a ruin, an object of horror and contempt and cursing, as they are to this day—Jerusalem and the cities of Judah, its kings and officials;
ekegusii: Yerusalemu na emechie yonsi y’Abayuda, amo nabarwoti na abanene b’oborwoti bwabo, bakaegwa bakanywa edivai eria, erinde ense yabo esarigwe ebe bosa, na abanto bakorora ayio mbakumie baabachaye, na baragererie ase erieta riabo, buna ere goika reero iga.
swahili: Yaani Yerusalemu na miji ya Yuda, wafalme wake na maafisa wake, kuwafanya magofu na kuwa kitu cha kuchukiza, cha dhihaka na laana, kama walivyo leo;

english: Pharaoh king of Egypt, his officials, his leaders, and all his people;
ekegusii: Aba nabwo abanto bande banyosetigwe edivai eria: Farao, omorwoti o Misiri, na abasomba baye, na abanene b’oborwoti bwaye, amo nabaanto baye bonsi,
swahili: pia Farao mfalme wa Misri, watumishi wake, maafisa wake na watu wake wote,

english: So the prophet Jeremiah spoke to all the people of Judah and all the residents of Jerusalem as follows:
ekegusii: Yeremia omobani agakwana amang’ana ayio ase Abayuda bonsi na ase abanto bonsi ba Yerusalemu, akabateebia,
swahili: Hivyo nabii Yeremia akawaambia watu wote wa Yuda na wale wote waishio Yerusalemu:

english: all the mixed tribes; all the kings of Uz; all the kings of the Philistines: Ashkelon, Gaza, Ekron, and the remnant of Ashdod;
ekegusii: abanto bonsi abamenyete amo nabarabwo, na abarwoti bonsi b’ense ya Usi, na abarwoti b’Abafilisti baare ase emechie y’Asikeloni, na Gasa, na Ekironi, na abatigarete b’Asidodi;
swahili: pia wageni wote walioko huko; wafalme wote wa nchi ya Usi; wafalme wote wa Wafilisti (wale wa Ashkeloni, Gaza, Ekroni na watu walioachwa huko Ashdodi);

english: Edom, Moab, and the Ammonites;
ekegusii: abanto ba Edomu na Moabu, na ab’Amoni;
swahili: Edomu, Moabu na Amoni;

english: all the kings of Tyre and Sidon; the kings of the coastlands across the sea;
ekegusii: abarwoti bonsi ba Turo na Sidoni, na ab’ebisinka, na abe chinse chire ng’umbu mbarabare y’enyancha;
swahili: wafalme wote wa Tiro na Sidoni; wafalme wa nchi za pwani ngʼambo ya bahari;

english: Dedan, Tema, Buz, and all who cut the corners of their hair;
ekegusii: emechie ya Dedani, na Tema, na Busi, na abanto bonsi abwo bakonacha chitukia chiabo;
swahili: Dedani, Tema, Buzi na wote walio maeneo ya mbali;

english: all the kings of Arabia, and all the kings of the mixed tribes who dwell in the desert;
ekegusii: abarwoti bonsi b’Arabia na ab’ebisaku ebio bisang’anaine bimenyete ase erooro;
swahili: wafalme wote wa Arabuni na wafalme wote wa watu wageni wanaoishi katika jangwa;

english: all the kings of Zimri, Elam, and Media;
ekegusii: abarwoti bonsi ba Simuri, na Elamu, na Media;
swahili: wafalme wote wa Zimri, Elamu na Umedi;

english: all the kings of the north, both near and far, one after another—all the kingdoms on the face of the earth. And after all of them, the king of Sheshach will drink it too.
ekegusii: abarwoti bonsi ba sugusu, abare aare na abare ang’e, kera oyomo nanywe edivai eria, na oyonde amobwatie. Amarwoti onsi pi are ase ense nanywe edivai eyio. Erio omorwoti o Sesaki, noro Babiloni, nabe oyo bw’omoerio koyenywa.
swahili: na wafalme wote wa pande za kaskazini, wa karibu na wa mbali, mmoja baada ya mwingine; yaani falme zote juu ya uso wa dunia. Baada ya hao wote, mfalme wa Sheshaki atakunywa pia.

english: “Then you are to tell them that this is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: ‘Drink, get drunk, and vomit. Fall down and never get up again, because of the sword I will send among you.’
ekegusii: Erio ngateebigwa ng’a mbateebie amang’ana aya: “Aya nar’Omonene bw’Emeganda, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, agoteeba: Kanywe, motinde na moroke, mogwe inse na timoimoka naende, ase engencho y’esegi ndarente ase egati yaino.
swahili: “Kisha uwaambie, ‘Hili ndilo Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, Mungu wa Israeli, asemalo: Kunyweni, mlewe na mtapike; angukeni, wala msiinuke tena kwa sababu ya upanga nitakaotuma miongoni mwenu.’

english: If they refuse to take the cup from your hand and drink it, you are to tell them that this is what the LORD of Hosts says: ‘You most certainly must drink it!
ekegusii: Abanto abwo kobaraange kobogoria egekombe ekio korwa ase okoboko kwao na konywa edivai eria, obateebie ng’a aya nar’Omonene bw’Emeganda atebiire: Goika moyenywe.
swahili: Lakini kama wakikataa kupokea kikombe kutoka mikononi mwako na kunywa, waambie, ‘Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote: Ni lazima mnywe!

english: For behold, I am beginning to bring disaster on the city that bears My Name, so how could you possibly go unpunished? You will not go unpunished, for I am calling down a sword upon all the inhabitants of the earth, declares the LORD of Hosts.’
ekegusii: Naama! Inche nachakire korenta amabe igoro ase omochie oyio okorokwa ase erieta riane. Inee! Nigo mokorengereria ng’a nigo moratigwe timoegwa egesusuro? Goika monyore egesusuro, ekiagera nindete esegi erwanie abanto bonsi bamenyete ase ense.” Nab’Omonene bw’Emeganda atebiire.
swahili: Tazama, nimeanza kuleta maafa juu ya mji ulio na Jina langu, na je, kweli ninyi mtaepuka kuadhibiwa? Hamwezi kuepuka kuadhibiwa, kwa maana nitaleta vita juu ya wote waishio duniani, asema Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote.’

english: “From the thirteenth year of Josiah son of Amon king of Judah until this very day—twenty-three years—the word of the LORD has come to me, and I have spoken to you again and again, but you have not listened.
ekegusii: Ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ebere na etato, gochakera omwaka o ikomi na gatato bw’okogamba kwa Yosia mosinto bw’Amoni, omorwoti bw’Abayuda, goika rituko ria reero, ring’ana ri’Omonene riabeire rigochicha ase ’nde, na inche nabeire nkoribateebia inwe ntari gotiga, korende inwe mwabeire mokwanga koriigwera.
swahili: Kwa miaka ishirini na mitatu, kuanzia mwaka wa kumi na tatu wa utawala wa Yosia mwana wa Amoni mfalme wa Yuda, hadi siku hii ya leo, neno la Bwana limekuwa likinijia, nami nimesema nanyi mara kwa mara, lakini hamkusikiliza.

english: So you are to prophesy all these words against them and say to them: ‘The LORD will roar from on high; He will raise His voice from His holy habitation. He will roar loudly over His pasture; like those who tread the grapes, He will call out with a shout against all the inhabitants of the earth.
ekegusii: “Aye Yeremia, obaane amang’ana aya onsi igoro ase bare, obateebie: Omonene narume korwa igoro, naake eriogi riaye korwa ase obomenyo bwaye obochenu. Narume ne chinguru igoro ye riicho riaye; naake eriogi buna eri’abaanto bakomita amasabibu. Naake eriogi buna eri’ebanto bonsi bamenyete ase ense.
swahili: “Basi sasa toa unabii kwa maneno haya yote dhidi yao, uwaambie: “ ‘ Bwana atanguruma kutoka juu; atatoa sauti ya ngurumo kutoka makao yake matakatifu na kunguruma kwa nguvu sana dhidi ya nchi yake. Atapiga kelele kama wao wakanyagao zabibu, atapiga kelele dhidi ya wote waishio duniani.

english: The tumult will resound to the ends of the earth because the LORD brings a charge against the nations. He brings judgment on all mankind and puts the wicked to the sword,’” declares the LORD.
ekegusii: Eriogi riaye nariigweke ase chinsinyo chionsi chi’ense, ekiagera Omonene nabwate ekiina nebisaku bionsi. Narente abanto bonsi ase ekiina, abakori amabe nabaitwe nemioro. Inche Omonene nakwanire.”
swahili: Ghasia zitasikika hadi miisho ya dunia, kwa maana Bwana ataleta mashtaka dhidi ya mataifa; ataleta hukumu juu ya wanadamu wote na kuwaua waovu wote,’ ” asema Bwana.

english: This is what the LORD of Hosts says: “Behold! Disaster is spreading from nation to nation; a mighty storm is rising from the ends of the earth.”
ekegusii: Aya nar’Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteeba: “Rora, obobe naboche ase egesaku ekemo, bogende ase ekende, na ekembugu‐mbugu nageche korwa ase chinsinyo chi’ense.
swahili: Hili ndilo Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote asemalo: “Tazama! Maafa yanaenea kutoka taifa moja hadi jingine; tufani kubwa inainuka kutoka miisho ya dunia.”

english: Those slain by the LORD on that day will be spread from one end of the earth to the other. They will not be mourned, gathered, or buried. They will be like dung lying on the ground. The Cry of the Shepherds
ekegusii: Ase rituko riria emebere y’abanto baraitwe n’Omonene, nesiarerwe korwa ase ensinyo eyemo y’ense goika eyende. Abwo tibakoreerwa, gose gosangererigwa na gotindekwa. Nababe buna obwoyo ase ense.
swahili: Wakati huo, hao waliouawa na Bwana watatapakaa kila mahali, kuanzia mwisho mmoja wa dunia hadi mwisho mwingine. Hawataombolezewa wala kukusanywa au kuzikwa, lakini watakuwa kama mavi yaliyoenea juu ya ardhi.

english: Wail, you shepherds, and cry out; roll in the dust, you leaders of the flock. For the days of your slaughter have come; you will fall and be shattered like fine pottery.
