swahili: Shangwe na furaha vimetoweka kutoka bustani na mashamba ya Moabu. Nimekomesha kutiririka kwa divai kutoka mashinikizo; hakuna hata mmoja ayakanyagaye kwa kelele za shangwe. Ingawa kuna kelele, sio kelele za shangwe.

english: There is a cry from Heshbon to Elealeh; they raise their voices to Jahaz, from Zoar to Horonaim and Eglath-shelishiyah; for even the waters of Nimrim have dried up.
ekegusii: “Abanto ba Hesiboni na ab’Eleale nigo bakorera, na eriogi riabo riaigurwe goika Eleale na Yahasi; boigo ndigugwe korwa ase Soari goika Horonaimu na Egilati‐Selisia. Na amaache a Nimirimi nakame na gosira.
swahili: “Sauti ya kilio chao inapanda kutoka Heshboni hadi Eleale na Yahazi, kutoka Soari hadi Horonaimu na Eglath-Shelishiya, kwa kuwa hata maji ya Nimrimu yamekauka.

english: In Moab, declares the LORD, I will bring an end to those who make offerings on the high places and burn incense to their gods.
ekegusii: Ninsirie Abamoabu, abwo bakorua ebing’wanso agwo aase aimokererete igoro na gosamba ubani ase enyasae yabo.
swahili: Nitakomesha wale wote katika Moabu watoao sadaka mahali pa juu, na kufukiza uvumba kwa miungu yao,” asema Bwana.

english: Therefore My heart laments like a flute for Moab; it laments like a flute for the men of Kir-heres, because the wealth they acquired has perished.
ekegusii: “Ase igo enkoro yane nigo ekobareera Abamoabu na abanto ba Kireresi, ase eriogi buna eri’ekeroria. Obonda benyorerete bwasirigwe.
swahili: “Kwa hiyo moyo wangu unaomboleza kwa ajili ya Moabu kama filimbi; unaomboleza kama filimbi kwa ajili ya watu wa Kir-Haresethi. Utajiri waliojipatia umetoweka.

english: For every head is shaved and every beard is clipped; on every hand is a gash, and around every waist is sackcloth.
ekegusii: Kera omonto akigite etukia y’omotwe oye, ogingire ne chinderu chiaye boigo. Abanto bonsi nabeekebe amaboko abo, na kweboyia chigunia ebinema biabo.
swahili: Kila kichwa kimenyolewa na kila mwenye ndevu zimekatwa; kila mkono umekatwa na kila kiuno kimefunikwa kwa nguo ya gunia.

english: On all the rooftops of Moab and in the public squares, everyone is mourning; for I have shattered Moab like an unwanted jar,” declares the LORD.
ekegusii: Ase chinyomba chionsi chi’ense ya Moabu, na ase chinchera chiaye, okorera gw’okweumia gwoka nakoigweke aroro, ekiagera naatire ense ya Moabu buna enyongo egwatwa, eyio monto onde atari gwechandera. Nab’Omonene atebiire.
swahili: Juu ya mapaa yote katika Moabu na katika viwanja hakuna kitu chochote isipokuwa maombolezo, kwa kuwa nimemvunja Moabu kama gudulia ambalo hakuna mtu yeyote anayelitaka,” asema Bwana.

english: “How shattered it is! How they wail! How Moab has turned his back in shame! Moab has become an object of ridicule and horror to all those around him.”
ekegusii: Abanto nkorera bare, bagoteeba: Naki Abamoabu baitirwe na gosirigwa. Naki Abamoabu baonchoire amagega abo bare nobosooku, babeire egento ki’ogosekererigwa na eki’ogoichanerwa ase abanto bonsi abaabaetanaine.” Abamoabu tibagotooreka
swahili: “Tazama jinsi alivyovunjikavunjika! Jinsi wanavyolia kwa huzuni! Tazama jinsi Moabu anavyogeuka kwa aibu! Moabu amekuwa kitu cha kudhihakiwa, kitu cha kutisha kwa wale wote wanaomzunguka.”

english: Moab will be shattered; her little ones will cry out.
ekegusii: “Ense ya Moabu yasarigwe, abana baye nigo bakorera mono.
swahili: Moabu utavunjwa, wadogo wake watapiga kelele.

english: For this is what the LORD says: “Behold, an eagle swoops down and spreads his wings against Moab.
ekegusii: Aya nar’Omonene agoteeba: Egesaku gete nkeiruruke bwango buna ekeongo, kerambore chimbaaba chiaye igoro y’Abamoabu.
swahili: Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana: “Tazama! Tai anashuka chini, akitanda mabawa yake juu ya Moabu.

english: Kirioth has been taken, and the strongholds seized. In that day the heart of Moab’s warriors will be like the heart of a woman in labor.
ekegusii: Emechie amo ne chindwaki chire chinkong’u mbibwatwe. Ase rituko erio chinkoro chi’abasikari ba Moabu bare chituoni nachiondoke; barabwo babe buna abakungu bakobina ase okoibora.
swahili: Miji itatekwa na ngome zake zitatwaliwa. Katika siku hiyo, mioyo ya mashujaa wa Moabu itakuwa kama moyo wa mwanamke katika utungu wa kuzaa.

english: Moab will be destroyed as a nation because he vaunted himself against the LORD.
ekegusii: Abanto ba Moabu nabasirigwe kegima tibagenderera koba egesaku, ekiagera beimokereretie igoro mamincha y’Omonene.
swahili: Moabu ataangamizwa kama taifa kwa sababu amemdharau Bwana.

english: Terror and pit and snare await you, O dweller of Moab,” declares the LORD.
ekegusii: Inwe abamomenyete Moabu, omoondoko, na eirima, na omoeto, nigo bibaganyete. Omonene oteebire ayio.
swahili: Hofu kuu, shimo na mtego vinawangojea, enyi watu wa Moabu,” asema Bwana.

english: “Whoever flees the panic will fall into the pit, and whoever climbs from the pit will be caught in the snare. For I will bring upon Moab the year of their punishment,” declares the LORD.
ekegusii: Onde bwensi oratame ase engencho y’omoondoko nagwe ase eirima, na oyo orasoke korwa ase eirima nabwatwe nomoeto. Nindete ayio igoro y’Abamoabu ase omwaka ndabae egesusuro kiabo. Nab’Omonene atebiire.
swahili: “Yeyote atakayeikimbia hiyo hofu kuu ataanguka ndani ya shimo, yeyote atakayepanda kutoka shimoni, atanaswa katika mtego, kwa sababu nitaletea Moabu mwaka wa adhabu yake,” asema Bwana.

english: “Those who flee will stand helpless in Heshbon’s shadow, because fire has gone forth from Heshbon and a flame from within Sihon. It devours the foreheads of Moab and the skulls of the sons of tumult.
ekegusii: Abare gotama bagatenena ase ekiriri kia Hesiboni batari ne chinguru. Omorero okarua ase Hesiboni, chimeme chi’omorero korwa ase ense ya Sihoni, ogasaria amasio ’Abamoabu, na ogasamba ebiototeri bi’emetwe y’abanto banchete esegi.
swahili: “Katika kivuli cha Heshboni, wakimbizi wamesimama pasipo msaada, kwa kuwa moto umezimika huko Heshboni, mwali wa moto kutoka katikati ya Sihoni; unaunguza vipaji vya nyuso za Moabu, mafuvu yao wenye kujivuna kwa kelele.

english: Woe to you, O Moab! The people of Chemosh have perished; for your sons have been taken into exile and your daughters have gone into captivity.
ekegusii: Obobe nobwaino, inwe abanto ba Moabu! Abanto bagosasiima Kemosi basirigwe. Abana baino abamura boosirwe, na abaiseke baino bairirwe obosomba.
swahili: Ole wako, ee Moabu! Watu wa Kemoshi wameangamizwa; wana wako wamepelekwa uhamishoni na binti zako wamechukuliwa mateka.

english: Yet in the latter days I will restore Moab from captivity, ” declares the LORD. Here ends the judgment on Moab.
ekegusii: Korende ase amatuko agochi‐gocha ning’iranerie Abamoabu amaya abo. Nabo inche Omonene natebiire. Ayio naro arakoreke ase Abamoabu.
swahili: “Lakini nitarudisha mateka wa Moabu, katika siku zijazo,” asema Bwana. Huu ndio mwisho wa hukumu juu ya Moabu.

english: For on the ascent to Luhith they weep bitterly as they go, and on the descent to Horonaim cries of distress resound over the destruction:
ekegusii: Nigo bagotiira gochia Luhiti bakorera; ekero bagotirimboka korwa Horonaimu, eriogi ri’okorera kw’ogosirigwa nigo rikoigugwa.
swahili: Wanapanda kwenda njia ya kuelekea Luhithi, wakilia kwa uchungu wanapotembea, kwenye njia inayoshuka kwenda Horonaimu, kilio cha uchungu kwa ajili ya uharibifu kinasikika.

english: ‘Flee! Run for your lives! Become like a juniper in the desert. ’
ekegusii: Tama! Motoorie obogima bwaino, mobe buna etigere y’orosana etigarete yoka ase erooro.
swahili: Kimbieni! Okoeni maisha yenu, kuweni kama kichaka jangwani.

english: Because you trust in your works and treasures, you too will be captured, and Chemosh will go into exile with his priests and officials.
ekegusii: “Ekiagera inwe mosemeretie emeremo yaino, na obotenenku bwaino, inamwoswe moirwe ase obosomba, na enyasae eria Kemosi neirwe ase obosomba, amo nabakuani baye na abanene b’obogambi bwaye.
swahili: Kwa kuwa mmetumainia matendo yenu na mali zenu, ninyi pia mtachukuliwa mateka, naye Kemoshi atakwenda uhamishoni, pamoja na makuhani wake na maafisa wake.

english: The destroyer will move against every city, and not one town will escape. The valley will also be ruined, and the high plain will be destroyed, as the LORD has said.
ekegusii: Oyio ogosaria na gosiria nachiche ase kera omochie, mochie onde togotooreka. Rikura amo nense omweya nabisarigwe, buna Omonene atebiire.
swahili: Mharabu atakuja dhidi ya kila mji, wala hakuna mji utakaookoka. Bonde litaangamizwa na uwanda utaharibiwa, kwa sababu Bwana amesema.

english: Put salt on Moab, for she will be laid waste; her cities will become desolate, with no one to dwell in them.
ekegusii: “Kae ense ya Moabu chimbaaba, eirurukere etame; emechie yaye yonsi nesirigwe, ebe amaturi atamenyiri na monto.
swahili: Wekeni chumvi kwa ajili ya Moabu, kwa kuwa ataangamizwa; miji yake itakuwa ukiwa, pasipo kuwa na mtu atakayeishi ndani yake.

english: Concerning the Ammonites, this is what the LORD says: “Has Israel no sons? Is he without heir? Why then has Milcom taken possession of Gad? Why have his people settled in their cities?
ekegusii: Aya nar’Omonene agoteeba igoro y’Abaamoni: “Inee! Abaisraeli tibabwati abana? Tibabwati abakoira omwando? Nase ki enyasae Milikomu yairire omwando o Gadi, na abanto baye bamenyete ase emechie ya Gadi?
swahili: Kuhusu Waamoni: Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana: “Je, Israeli hana wana? Je, hana warithi? Kwa nini basi Moleki amechukua milki ya Gadi? Kwa nini watu wake wanaishi katika miji yake?

english: But I will strip Esau bare; I will uncover his hiding places, and he will be unable to conceal himself. His descendants will be destroyed along with his relatives and neighbors, and he will be no more.
ekegusii: Nachoboire abanto b’Esau na kobatiga bosa; nasioririe aase bakwebisa, bono tibakonyora aase bakwebisa. Abanto b’ororeria rwabo na abamwabo basirigwe, boigo nabaanto bamenyete ang’e, bonsi basirigwe gose nonya noyomo tatigareti.
swahili: Lakini nitamvua Esau nguo abaki uchi, nitayafunua maficho yake, ili asiweze kujificha. Watoto wake, jamaa na majirani wataangamia, naye hatakuwepo tena.

english: Abandon your orphans; I will preserve their lives. Let your widows trust in Me.”
ekegusii: Batige abana abwo batabwati abaise, inche nimbarende bagenderere koba moyo, na ababoraka baino, tiga bansemerie.”
swahili: Waache yatima wako; nitayalinda maisha yao. Wajane wako pia wanaweza kunitumaini mimi.”

english: For this is what the LORD says: “If those who do not deserve to drink the cup must drink it, can you possibly remain unpunished? You will not go unpunished, for you must drink it too.
ekegusii: Aya nar’Omonene agoteeba: “Onye abanto baria batagwenerete konywa egekombe ki’egesusuro bakenywerete, Inee, inwe nigo moratigwe timonyora egesusuro? Goika monyore egesusuro; ase ayio goika mokenywere.
swahili: Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana: “Kama wale wasiostahili kukinywea kikombe ni lazima wakinywe, kwa nini wewe usiadhibiwe? Hutakwepa kuadhibiwa, ni lazima ukinywe.

english: For by Myself I have sworn, declares the LORD, that Bozrah will become a desolation, a disgrace, a ruin, and a curse, and all her cities will be in ruins forever.”
ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: Inche omonyene natianire ng’a omochie o Bosira nobe bosa. Ekero abanto bakoyorora mbaondoke na koyochecheria, naende babe bakoragereria ase erieta riaye. Na emechie yaye yonsi nesirigwe ebe amaturi kogenderera botambe.”
swahili: Ninaapa kwa nafsi yangu,” asema Bwana, “kwamba Bosra utakuwa magofu na kitu cha kutisha, cha aibu na cha kulaania; miji yake yote itakuwa magofu milele.”

english: I have heard a message from the LORD; an envoy has been sent to the nations: “Assemble yourselves to march against her! Rise up for battle!”
ekegusii: Naigure amang’ana korwa ase Omonene; omonto otomirwe ase egati y’ebisaku, kobiteebia: “Sangererekana amo, mochiche korwania omochie o Bosira, imoka moyorwanie!
swahili: Nimesikia ujumbe kutoka kwa Bwana: Mjumbe alitumwa kwa mataifa kusema, “Jikusanyeni ili kuushambulia! Inukeni kwa ajili ya vita!”

english: “For behold, I will make you small among nations, despised among men.
ekegusii: Naki ningokore obe omoke ase egati y’ebisaku. Abanto bonsi nabagochaye.
swahili: “Sasa nitakufanya uwe mdogo miongoni mwa mataifa, aliyedharauliwa miongoni mwa watu.

english: The terror you cause and the pride of your heart have deceived you, O dwellers in the clefts of the rocks, O occupiers of the mountain summit. Though you elevate your nest like the eagle, even from there I will bring you down,” declares the LORD.
ekegusii: Okogosa kwao na oboenenu bw’enkoro yao biakong’ainire. Aye omenyete ime ase emienya y’ebitare, aye obwaterererete egetunwa egetambe, korende nonya koagachete egeswa kiao aaria igoro mono buna ekeongo, inche ninkorusie aroro ngotabokanie gocha inse. Nab’Omonene atebiire.
swahili: Vitisho vyako na kiburi cha moyo wako vimekudanganya, wewe unayeishi katika majabali ya miamba, wewe unayedumu katika miinuko ya kilima. Ujapojenga kiota chako juu sana kama cha tai, nitakushusha chini kutoka huko,” asema Bwana.

english: “Edom will become an object of horror. All who pass by will be appalled and will scoff at all her wounds.
ekegusii: “Edomu nosarigwe obe ekiorokererio gi’okoondokia. Kera omonto oraetere aase agwo naondoke na goichanigwa ase engencho y’amaakwa aye.
swahili: “Edomu atakuwa kitu cha kuogofya; wote wapitao karibu watashangaa na kuzomea kwa sababu ya majeraha yake yote.

english: As Sodom and Gomorrah were overthrown along with their neighbors,” says the LORD, “no one will dwell there; no man will abide there.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteeba ng’a koreng’ana buna Sodomu na Gomora na emechie yarenge ang’e noro yasiretigwe, naboigo Edomu orasirigwe; monto onde takomenya aroro, gose omoeti takogobera aroro.
swahili: Kama vile Sodoma na Gomora zilivyoangamizwa, pamoja na miji iliyokuwa jirani nayo,” asema Bwana, “vivyo hivyo hakuna mtu yeyote atakayeishi humo. Naam, hakuna mtu yeyote atakayekaa humo.

english: Behold, one will come up like a lion from the thickets of the Jordan to the watered pasture. For in an instant I will chase Edom from her land. Who is the chosen one I will appoint for this? For who is like Me, and who can challenge Me? What shepherd can stand against Me?”
ekegusii: Rora, buna koreng’ana endo egosoka korwa ase rinani rinoru ria Yorodani, erinde yagenda goita ching’ondi chire ime ase obweri obokong’u, naboigo na inche ndachiere Abaedomu mobosokano, mbaserie batame korwa aroro. Onde bwensi ndachore nimobeke abe omorisia igoro ase bare. Ning’o oranyare koreng’anigwa nainche? Ning’o orambekere rituko indue omobaro? Morisia ki oranyare kweegerera ase obosio bwane?
swahili: “Kama simba anayepanda kutoka vichaka vya Yordani kuja kwenye nchi ya malisho mengi, ndivyo nitamfukuza Edomu kutoka nchi yake ghafula. Ni nani aliye mteule nitakayemweka kwa ajili ya jambo hili? Ni nani aliye kama mimi, na ni nani awezaye kunipinga? Tena ni mchungaji yupi awezaye kusimama kinyume nami?”

english: Therefore, behold, the days are coming, declares the LORD, when I will sound the battle cry against Rabbah of the Ammonites. It will become a heap of ruins, and its villages will be burned. Then Israel will drive out their dispossessors, says the LORD.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: Rora, amatuko ngocha are inche ndarente esegi, na ekerero gi’esegi keigugwe ase omochie o Raba, ase ense y’Abaamoni. Omochie oyio otigare amaturi ore bosa, na emechie yaye esambwe nomorero. Erio Abaisraeli mbaire omwando korwa ase abwo baabayourete. Nab’Omonene atebiire.
swahili: Lakini siku zinakuja,” asema Bwana, “nitakapopiga kelele ya vita dhidi ya Raba mji wa Waamoni; utakuwa kilima cha magofu, navyo vijiji vinavyouzunguka vitateketezwa kwa moto. Kisha Israeli atawafukuza wale waliomfukuza,” asema Bwana.

english: Therefore hear the plans that the LORD has drawn up against Edom and the strategies He has devised against the people of Teman: Surely the little ones of the flock will be dragged away; certainly their pasture will be made desolate because of them.
ekegusii: Ase ayio tegerera moigwe omooroberio inche Omonene nakorire igoro y’Abaedomu, na okogania kwane mbwate igoro ase abanto ba Temani: Ekeene, nonya nabana babo mbakururwe buna chimanwa chi’eching’ondi chigokururwa chiairwa. Ekeene, ense yabo nebaichanere.
swahili: Kwa hiyo, sikia kile Bwana alichokipanga dhidi ya Edomu, kile alichokusudia dhidi ya wale waishio Temani: Aliye mchanga katika kundi ataburutwa mbali; yeye ataharibu kabisa malisho yao kwa sababu yao.

english: At the sound of their fall the earth will quake; their cry will resound to the Red Sea.
ekegusii: Ekero abanto b’Edomu baragwe, eriogi riabo naritengechie ense; na eriogi ri’okorera kwabo narigugwe gochia ase Enyancha Embariri.
swahili: Kwa sauti ya anguko lao, dunia itatetemeka. Kilio chao kitasikika hadi Bahari ya Shamu.

english: Look! An eagle will soar and swoop down, spreading its wings over Bozrah. In that day the hearts of Edom’s mighty men will be like the heart of a woman in labor. Judgment on Damascus (Isaiah 17:1–14)
ekegusii: Naama! Egesaku gete nkeimokerere igoro keiruruke bwango buna ekeongo, kerambore chimbaaba chiaye igoro y’omochie o Bosira. Ase rituko erio chinkoro chi’abasikari b’Edomu bare chituoni nachiondoke, na barabwo babe buna omokungu okobina ase okoibora.” Omonene okogambia Damesiki
swahili: Tazama! Tai atapaa juu angani na kuruka chini kwa ghafula, akitandaza mabawa yake juu ya Bosra. Katika siku hiyo, mioyo ya mashujaa wa Edomu itakuwa kama moyo wa mwanamke katika utungu wa kuzaa. Ujumbe Kuhusu Dameski

english: Concerning Damascus: “Hamath and Arpad are put to shame, for they have heard a bad report; they are agitated like the sea; their anxiety cannot be calmed.
ekegusii: Amang’ana igoro ya Damesiki naro aya: “Abanto ba Hamati na ab’Aripadi basookire, ekiagera baigure amang’ana amabe; chinkoro chiabo chiabeire nobwoba. Nigo bachandegete babeire buna enyancha yaburukanigwe etanyare gotoerera.
swahili: Kuhusu Dameski: “Hamathi na Arpadi imetahayarika, kwa kuwa wamesikia habari mbaya. Wamevunjika moyo na wametaabika kama bahari iliyochafuka.

english: Damascus has become feeble; she has turned to flee. Panic has gripped her; anguish and pain have seized her like a woman in labor.
ekegusii: Abanto ba Damesiki babeire aboro tibari na nguru; beonchoire gotama, ekiagera obwoba bwabasoire. Basoirwe nomoichano na ogochandeka buna omokungu okobina ase okoibora.
swahili: Dameski amedhoofika, amegeuka na kukimbia, hofu ya ghafula imemkamata sana; amepatwa na uchungu na maumivu, maumivu kama ya mwanamke katika utungu wa kuzaa.

english: How is the city of praise not forsaken, the town that brings Me joy?
ekegusii: Naki omochie oria omanyekanete mono, naende inche nagokerete, ong’anyirwe iga na otigirwe bosa?
swahili: Kwa nini mji ambao unajulikana haujaachwa, mji ambao ninaupenda?

english: For her young men will fall in the streets, and all her warriors will be silenced in that day,” declares the LORD of Hosts.
ekegusii: Ase ayio, ase rituko riria abamura b’omochie oyio nabaitwe bagwe ase chinchera chiaye, na abasikari baye bonsi mbaitwe. Nabo inche Omonene bw’Emeganda natebiire.
swahili: Hakika, vijana wake wanaume wataanguka barabarani; askari wake wote watanyamazishwa siku hiyo,” asema Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote.

english: “I will set fire to the walls of Damascus; it will consume the fortresses of Ben-hadad.” Judgment on Kedar and Hazor
ekegusii: Nintongie omorero ase chindwaki chia Damesiki, noro nosambe chinyomba chi’omorwoti Beni‐Hadadi.” Okogambigwa kw’egesaku gia Kedari na omochie o Hasori
swahili: “Nitatia moto kuta za Dameski; utaangamiza ngome za Ben-Hadadi.” Ujumbe Kuhusu Kedari Na Hazori

english: Concerning Kedar and the kingdoms of Hazor, which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon defeated, this is what the LORD says: “Rise up, advance against Kedar, and destroy the people of the east!
ekegusii: Aya nar’Omonene agoteeba igoro ya Kedari, na igoro y’amarwoti a Hasori, ayio Nebukadinesaro, omorwoti o Babiloni, abuete: “Imoka, mogende Kedari! Mosirie abanto ba moocha.
swahili: Kuhusu Kedari na falme za Hazori, ambazo Nebukadneza mfalme wa Babeli alizishambulia: Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana: “Inuka, ushambulie Kedari na kuwaangamiza watu wa mashariki.

english: They will take their tents and flocks, their tent curtains and all their goods. They will take their camels for themselves. They will shout to them: ‘Terror is on every side!’
ekegusii: Mosakore chiema chiabo na amaicho abo, na ebietubo bie chiema chiabo, na ebinto biabo bionsi; boigo moire chingamia chiabo. Morere igoro yabo, motebe: Obwoba nigo bore ase chinsemo chionsi.
swahili: Hema zao na makundi yao ya kondoo yatachukuliwa; vibanda vyao vitatwaliwa pamoja na mali zao zote na ngamia zao. Watu watawapigia kelele, ‘Hofu kuu iko kila upande!’

english: Wail, O Heshbon, for Ai has been destroyed; cry out, O daughters of Rabbah! Put on sackcloth and mourn; run back and forth within your walls, for Milcom will go into exile together with his priests and officials.
ekegusii: Inwe abanto ba Hesiboni, rera mono, ekiagera Ai osarigwe! Inwe abakungu ba Raba, rera! Mweboyie chigunia, mobokie amagombo, mobe mokominyoka gochia aaria na aaria ase chinka chionsi, ekiagera enyasae eyio Milikomu neirwe ase obosomba amo nabakuani baye, na abanene abakogamba nero.
swahili: “Lia kwa huzuni, ee Heshboni, kwa kuwa Ai umeangamizwa! Pigeni kelele, enyi wakazi wa Raba! Vaeni nguo za gunia na kuomboleza, kimbieni hapa na pale ndani ya kuta, kwa kuwa Moleki atakwenda uhamishoni, yeye pamoja na makuhani na maafisa wake.

english: Run! Escape quickly! Lie low, O residents of Hazor,” declares the LORD, “for Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon has drawn up a plan against you; he has devised a strategy against you.
ekegusii: “Inwe abanto ba Hasori, tama, mogende mwebise aase aakong’u, ekiagera Nebukadinesaro, omorwoti o Babiloni, okorire omooroberio bw’okobarwania, na nigo are nebirengererio bi’okobakora bobe. Nab’Omonene atebiire:
swahili: “Kimbieni haraka! Kaeni kwenye mapango marefu sana, ninyi mkaao Hazori,” asema Bwana. “Nebukadneza, mfalme wa Babeli amepanga shauri baya dhidi yenu; amebuni hila dhidi yenu.

english: Rise up, advance against a nation at ease, one that dwells securely,” declares the LORD. “They have no gates or bars; they live alone.
ekegusii: Imoka, mogende korwania egesaku ekio kemenyete ase obotoereru getechandereti ing’ana rinde, ekio getabwati ebiita gose emekorogoto y’ogosiekera, egesaku ekio kemenyete gioka. Nabo inche Omonene natebiire.
swahili: “Inuka na ulishambulie taifa lililo starehe, linaloishi kwa kujiamini,” asema Bwana, “taifa lisilo na malango wala makomeo; watu wake huishi peke yao.

english: Their camels will become plunder, and their large herds will be spoil. I will scatter to the wind in every direction those who shave their temples; I will bring calamity on them from all sides,” declares the LORD.
ekegusii: “Mosakore, moire chingamia chiabo, ne chiombe chiabo chibe echiaino. Abanto abwo bakogingira chitukia chiabo nimbaserie mbasiarere gochia ase kera ensemo y’ense. Nimbarentere emechando korwa ase kera ensemo. Nab’Omonene atebiire.
swahili: Ngamia wao watakuwa nyara, nayo makundi yao makubwa ya ngʼombe yatatekwa. Wale walio maeneo ya mbali nitawatawanya pande zote, nami nitaleta maafa juu yao kutoka kila upande,” asema Bwana.

english: “Hazor will become a haunt for jackals, a desolation forever. No one will dwell there; no man will abide there.” Judgment on Elam
ekegusii: Hasori nosareke, omenywe ne chisese chi’orosana, obe amaturi kogenderera botambe, gose monto onde takomenya aroro, gose omoeti takogobera aroro.” Omonene okogambia ense y’Elamu
swahili: “Hazori itakuwa makao ya mbweha, mahali pa ukiwa milele. Hakuna yeyote atakayeishi humo; hakuna mtu atakayekaa ndani yake.” Ujumbe Kuhusu Elamu

english: This is the word of the LORD that came to Jeremiah the prophet concerning Elam at the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah.
ekegusii: Ase omochakano bw’okogamba gwa Zedekia, omorwoti bw’Abayuda, ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha ase Yeremia omobani igoro y’ense y’Elamu, rikamoteebia,
swahili: Hili ndilo neno la Bwana lililomjia nabii Yeremia kuhusu Elamu, mapema katika utawala wa Sedekia mfalme wa Yuda:

english: This is what the LORD of Hosts says: “Behold, I will shatter Elam’s bow, the mainstay of their might.
ekegusii: “Aya nar’Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteeba: Rora, nimbune amata ’Abaelamu, ayio are chinguru chi’okobua kwabo.
swahili: Hili ndilo Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote asemalo: “Tazama, nitavunja upinde wa Elamu, ulio tegemeo la nguvu zao.

english: I will bring the four winds against Elam from the four corners of the heavens, and I will scatter them to all these winds. There will not be a nation to which Elam’s exiles will not go.
ekegusii: Nindete chimbeo inye korwa ase chinsemo inye chia igoro, erinde nsiarere abanto b’Elamu bagende ase chinsinyo echio chionsi; gose egesaku tikeri keratigare ekio abanto b’Elamu batatamere.
swahili: Nitaleta pepo nne dhidi ya Elamu toka pande nne za mbingu, nitawatawanya katika hizo pande nne, wala hapatakuwa na taifa ambalo watu wa Elamu waliofukuzwa hawatakwenda.

english: So I will shatter Elam before their foes, before those who seek their lives. I will bring disaster upon them, even My fierce anger,” declares the LORD. “I will send out the sword after them until I finish them off.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: Ningere abanto b’Elamu boboe ababisa babo, boigo boboe nabaanto baria bakorigia basirie obogima bwabo. Nimbarentere amabe, na endamwamu yane yoke igoro yabo. Nimbatunyanerie emioro, baitwe basirigwe kegima.
swahili: Nitamfadhaisha Elamu mbele ya adui zao, mbele yao wale wanaotafuta uhai wao; nitaleta maafa juu yao, naam, hasira yangu kali,” asema Bwana. “Nitawafuatia kwa upanga mpaka nitakapowamaliza.

english: I will set My throne in Elam, and destroy its king and officials,” declares the LORD.
ekegusii: Nimbeke oboikaranso bwane bw’obonene agwo ase ense y’Abaelamu, nsirie omorwoti obo amo nabanene babo b’oborwoti. Nab’Omonene atebiire.
swahili: Nitaweka kiti changu cha enzi huko Elamu na kumwangamiza mfalme wake na maafisa wake,” asema Bwana.

english: “Yet in the last days, I will restore Elam from captivity, ” declares the LORD.
ekegusii: Korende ase amatuko agochi‐gocha ning’iranerie Abaelamu amaya abo. Nab’Omonene atebiire.”
swahili: “Lakini nitarudisha mateka wa Elamu katika siku zijazo,” asema Bwana.

english: Why do you boast of your valleys— your valleys so fruitful, O faithless daughter? You trust in your riches and say, ‘Who can come against me?’
ekegusii: Inwe abaiseke baane ababiare motari abegenwa, nase ki mogwetogia ng’a amakura aino naichire chindagera? Inwe mwegenete obonda bwaino mogoteeba ng’a onde tari oranyare kobarwania.
swahili: Kwa nini unajivunia mabonde yako, kujivunia mabonde yako yaliyozaa sana? Ee binti usiye mwaminifu, unayeutumainia utajiri wako na kusema, ‘Ni nani atakayenishambulia?’

english: Behold, I am about to bring terror upon you, declares the Lord GOD of Hosts, from all those around you. You will each be driven headlong, with no one to regather the fugitives.
ekegusii: Omonene, Nyasae bw’Emeganda, oteebire iga: Rora, nindete omoondoko igoro ase more korwa ase abanto bonsi baabaetanaine. Inwe moserigwe, na kera omonto atame gochia bosio rioka, gose monto onde tagotoka orasangererie abwo batamire.
swahili: Nitaleta hofu kuu juu yako kutoka kwa wale wote wanaokuzunguka,” asema Bwana, Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote. “Kila mmoja wenu ataondolewa, wala hakuna hata mmoja atakayekusanya wakimbizi.

english: Yet afterward I will restore the Ammonites from captivity, ” declares the LORD. Judgment on Edom (Obadiah 1:1–14)
ekegusii: “Korende magega y’ayio ning’iranerie Abaamoni amaya abo. Inche Omonene nakwanire.” Omonene okogambia Abaedomu
swahili: “Lakini hatimaye, nitarudisha mateka wa Waamoni,” asema Bwana. Ujumbe Kuhusu Edomu

english: Concerning Edom, this is what the LORD of Hosts says: “Is there no longer wisdom in Teman? Has counsel perished from the prudent? Has their wisdom decayed?
ekegusii: Aya nar’Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteeba igoro y’Abaedomu: “Inee! Obong’aini mbwaerire korwa Temani? Ogosemia ngwasirire korwa ase abanyasemi? Obong’aini bwabo mbwasirire kegima?
swahili: Kuhusu Edomu: Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote: “Je, hakuna tena hekima katika Temani? Je, shauri limewapotea wenye busara? Je, hekima yao imechakaa?

english: Turn and run! Lie low, O dwellers of Dedan, for I will bring disaster on Esau at the time I punish him.
ekegusii: Inwe abanto momenyete Dedani, onchoka motame, mwebise aase aakong’u, ekiagera ning’ee ororeria rw’Esau emechando ase rituko erio ndamoe egesusuro.
swahili: Geuka na ukimbie, jifiche katika mapango marefu kabisa, wewe uishiye Dedani, kwa kuwa nitaleta maafa juu ya Esau wakati nitakapomwadhibu.

english: If grape gatherers came to you, would they not leave some gleanings? Were thieves to come in the night, would they not steal only what they wanted?
ekegusii: Inee! Abasangereria amasabibu baare gocha ase more, tibarenge kobatigera nonya naria agotigara? Na abaibi bagocha botuko tibarenge gosakora ebi baganetie bioka?
swahili: Je, kama wachuma zabibu wangekuja kwako, wasingebakiza zabibu chache? Kama wezi wangekujia usiku, je, si wangeiba tu kiasi ambacho wangehitaji?

english: “If you will return, O Israel, return to Me,” declares the LORD. “If you will remove your detestable idols from My sight and no longer waver,
ekegusii: Omonene oteebire iga: “Inwe Abaisraeli, onye morigetie koirana ase ’nde, ing’iranere. Motugute emegwekano yaino mogosasiima ere okogechia ase obosio bwane, motari nechitang’u‐tang’u.
swahili: “Ikiwa utataka kurudi, ee Israeli, nirudie mimi,” asema Bwana. “Ikiwa utaondoa sanamu zako za kuchukiza mbele ya macho yangu na usiendelee kutangatanga,

english: Then I said, “Ah, Lord GOD, how completely You have deceived this people and Jerusalem by saying, ‘You will have peace,’ while a sword is at our throats.”
ekegusii: Erio ngateba, “Aye Omonene, kwabang’ainire abanto aba ba Yerusalemu, ekiagera kwabateebeetie ng’a mbabe nomorembe, korende bono omoro obeire ang’e kobaita.”
swahili: Ndipo niliposema, “Aa, Bwana Mwenyezi, umewadanganyaje kabisa watu hawa na Yerusalemu kwa kusema, ‘Mtakuwa na amani,’ wakati upanga uko kwenye koo zetu!”

english: At that time it will be said to this people and to Jerusalem, “A searing wind from the barren heights in the desert blows toward the daughter of My people, but not to winnow or to sift;
ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio abanto aba amo naba Yerusalemu mbateebigwe ring’ana eri: “Omwaga ogosamba buna omorero noguse korwa ase ebigoro bi’erooro gochia ase abanto baane. Omwaga oyio tokoba oyo bw’okoirurera gose bw’ogosonga,
swahili: Wakati huo watu hawa na Yerusalemu wataambiwa, “Upepo wa moto kutoka miinuko iliyo kame katika jangwa unavuma kuelekea watu wangu, lakini sio kupepeta au kutakasa,

english: a wind too strong for that comes from Me. Now I also pronounce judgments against them.”
ekegusii: korende omwaga oyio ninyotome obe omotindi mono goetania. Bono ninche ndabanachere ekiina.” Abayuda bagoetananwa nababisa
swahili: upepo wenye nguvu sana kuliko wa kupepeta na kutakasa utakuja kwa amri yangu. Sasa natangaza hukumu zangu dhidi yao.”

english: Behold, he advances like the clouds, his chariots like the whirlwind. His horses are swifter than eagles. Woe to us, for we are ruined!
ekegusii: Rora, omobisa nigo agotochera buna amare, nigo abwate chigari chi’esegi chinga buna ekerambauti; chibarasi chiaye nigo chikominyoka chimbero kobua ekeongo. Obobe nobwaito! Ee, twasirigwe.
swahili: Tazama! Anakuja kama mawingu, magari yake yanakuja kama upepo wa kisulisuli, farasi wake wana mbio kuliko tai. Ole wetu! Tunaangamia!

english: Wash the evil from your heart, O Jerusalem, so that you may be saved. How long will you harbor wicked thoughts within you?
ekegusii: Inwe abanto ba Yerusalemu, chena chinkoro chiaino korwa ase obobe, erinde motoorigwe. Ngoika ririri moragenderere kogaacha ebirengererio bi’obobe ime yaino?
swahili: Ee Yerusalemu, usafishe uovu kutoka moyoni mwako na uokolewe. Utaendelea kuficha mawazo mapotovu mpaka lini?

english: For a voice resounds from Dan, proclaiming disaster from the hills of Ephraim.
ekegusii: Omonto orure ase orogongo rwa Dani, orentire amang’ana neriogi rinene, nigo akoraria obobe korwa ase ense y’Efraimu.
swahili: Sauti inatangaza kutoka Dani, ikipiga mbiu ya maafa kutoka vilima vya Efraimu.

english: Warn the nations now! Proclaim to Jerusalem: “A besieging army comes from a distant land; they raise their voices against the cities of Judah.
ekegusii: Kurera abanto b’ebisaku ng’a amabe ngocha are; raria ase Yerusalemu, motebe: Abagochia koboera ngocha bare korwa ase ense y’aare, bagoaka eriogi ase emechie y’Abayuda.
swahili: “Waambie mataifa jambo hili, piga mbiu hii dhidi ya Yerusalemu: ‘Jeshi la kuzingira linakuja kutoka nchi ya mbali, likipiga kelele ya vita dhidi ya miji ya Yuda.

english: They surround her like men guarding a field, because she has rebelled against Me,” declares the LORD.
ekegusii: Ekiagera Abayuda basaririe ase ’nde, ababisa babo mbaabaetanane buna abarendi b’omogondo bakoyoetanana. Omonene okwanire.
swahili: Wamemzunguka kama watu walindao shamba, kwa sababu amefanya uasi dhidi yangu,’ ” asema Bwana.

english: “Your ways and deeds have brought this upon you. This is your punishment; how bitter it is, because it pierces to the heart!” Lamentation for Judah
ekegusii: Chinchera chiaino, na ogokora kwaino, nabio biagerire amang’ana ayio abanyorire inwe. Oko nakwo ogosirigwa kwaino, na nigo kore nobororo obonge. Obororo obwo bwasoire ime ase chinkoro chiaino. Ogoichana kwa Yeremia ase abanto baye
swahili: “Mwenendo wako na matendo yako mwenyewe yameleta haya juu yako. Hii ndiyo adhabu yako. Tazama jinsi ilivyo chungu! Tazama jinsi inavyochoma moyo!”

english: My anguish, my anguish! I writhe in pain! Oh, the pain in my chest! My heart pounds within me; I cannot be silent. For I have heard the sound of the horn, the alarm of battle.
ekegusii: Obee! Obee! Obororo bw’enda yane bwabeire obonene. Enkoro yane nigo egontwoma mono, tinkonyara gokira; naigure eriogi ri’egetureeri, ogotaboborwa gw’esegi.
swahili: Ee mtima wangu, mtima wangu! Ninagaagaa kwa maumivu. Ee maumivu makuu ya moyo wangu! Moyo wangu umefadhaika ndani yangu, siwezi kunyamaza. Kwa sababu nimesikia sauti ya tarumbeta, nimesikia kelele ya vita.

english: and if you can swear, ‘As surely as the LORD lives,’ in truth, in justice, and in righteousness, then the nations will be blessed by Him, and in Him they will glory.”
ekegusii: Komoratiane ase ekeene na oboronge, mogoteeba: Ekeene, buna Omonene are moyo, rirorio abanto b’ebisaku bionsi mbesesenie ime yaye, naende mbetogie asare.”
swahili: ikiwa kwa kweli, kwa haki na kwa unyofu utaapa, ‘Kwa hakika kama vile Bwana aishivyo,’ ndipo mataifa yatakapobarikiwa naye na katika yeye watajitukuza.”

english: Disaster after disaster is proclaimed, for the whole land is laid waste. My tents are destroyed in an instant, my curtains in a moment.
ekegusii: Obobe nigo bokoromeng’ana obobe bonde, ense yonsi yasarigwe. Chiema chiane chiasarigwe mobosokano; ebietubo bie chiema chiane biatandoirwe.
swahili: Maafa baada ya maafa, nchi yote imekuwa magofu. Kwa ghafula mahema yangu yameangamizwa, makazi yangu kwa muda mfupi.

english: How long must I see the signal flag and hear the sound of the horn?
ekegusii: Ngoika ririri ndagenderere korora ekemanyererio gi’esegi, na koigwa eriogi ri’egetureeri rikobugigwa?
swahili: Hata lini nitaendelea kuona bendera ya vita na kusikia sauti za tarumbeta?

english: “For My people are fools; they have not known Me. They are foolish children, without understanding. They are skilled in doing evil, but they know not how to do good.”
ekegusii: “Abanto baane nigo bare abariri, tibamanyeti inche. Barabwo nigo bare buna abana batari nobong’aini, tibamanyeti gento kende. Nigo bare aboge mono ase ogokora ebibe, korende tibamanyeti gokora amaya.” Amaroro a Yeremia ay’ogosaria kogochi‐gocha
swahili: “Watu wangu ni wapumbavu, hawanijui mimi. Ni watoto wasio na akili, hawana ufahamu. Ni hodari kutenda mabaya, hawajui kutenda yaliyo mema.”

english: I looked at the earth, and it was formless and void; I looked to the heavens, and they had no light.
ekegusii: Nkarigereria ense, nkarora yabeire bosa, gento tikiarengeo; nkarigereria gochia igoro, na oborabu bonde tibwarengeo.
swahili: Niliitazama dunia, nayo haikuwa na umbo tena ni tupu; niliziangalia mbingu, mianga ilikuwa imetoweka.

english: I looked at the mountains, and behold, they were quaking; all the hills were swaying.
ekegusii: Nkarigereria gochia ase ebitunwa, nkarora birobio bigotengechigwa, na ebigoro bionsi bikonyegerigwa gochia aaria na aaria.
swahili: Niliitazama milima, nayo ilikuwa ikitetemeka, vilima vyote vilikuwa vikiyumbayumba.

english: I looked, and no man was left; all the birds of the air had fled.
ekegusii: Nkarigereria, nkarora omonto taiyo nonya noyomo; chinyoni chionsi konya chiatamire.
swahili: Nilitazama, wala watu hawakuwepo; kila ndege wa angani alikuwa ameruka zake.

english: I looked, and the fruitful land was a desert. All its cities were torn down before the LORD, before His fierce anger.
ekegusii: Nkarigereria, nkarora ense yarenge kwama, yabeire erooro, emechie yaye yonsi yasarigwe, ekaba amatombe ase obosio bw’Omonene, ase engencho y’endamwamu yaye enene.
swahili: Nilitazama, hata nchi iliyokuwa imestawi vizuri imekuwa jangwa, miji yake yote ilikuwa magofu mbele za Bwana, mbele ya hasira yake kali.

english: For this is what the LORD says: “The whole land will be desolate, but I will not finish its destruction.
ekegusii: Aya nar’Omonene agoteeba: “Ense yonsi nesarigwe etigare bosa, korende tinkoyesiria kegima.
swahili: Hivi ndivyo Bwana asemavyo: “Nchi yote itaharibiwa, ingawa sitaiangamiza kabisa.

english: Therefore the earth will mourn and the heavens above will grow dark. I have spoken, I have planned, and I will not relent or turn back.”
ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio ense nereere na kweumia, igoro nchionchoke chimwame ti, ekiagera ninche nakwanire, naganirie gokora ayio; tinkonyara gweitia gose koonchora ebirengererio biane.”
swahili: Kwa hiyo dunia itaomboleza na mbingu zilizo juu zitakuwa giza, kwa sababu nimesema nami sitarudi nyuma, nimeamua na wala sitageuka.”

english: Every city flees at the sound of the horseman and archer. They enter the thickets and climb among the rocks. Every city is abandoned; no inhabitant is left.
ekegusii: Abanto ba kera omochie mbatame ekero baraigwe amariogi ’abariini chibarasi na ay’abwo babwate amata, mbatame gochia ase amanani, bebise ase ebitare ime. Emechie yonsi netigare bosa, nonya nomonto oyomo tagotigara aroro.
swahili: Kwa sauti ya wapanda farasi na wapiga upinde kila mji unakimbia. Baadhi wanakimbilia vichakani, baadhi wanapanda juu ya miamba. Miji yote imeachwa, hakuna aishiye ndani yake.

english: For this is what the LORD says to the men of Judah and Jerusalem: “Break up your unplowed ground, and do not sow among the thorns.
ekegusii: Aya nar’Omonene agoteebia Abayuda na abamenyi ba Yerusalemu: “Chaka korema emegondo yaino na timobaisa kobusura ase amagwa ime.
swahili: Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana kwa watu wa Yuda na kwa Yerusalemu: “Vunjeni mabonge kwenye mashamba yenu, wala msipande katikati ya miiba.

english: And you, O devastated one, what will you do, though you dress yourself in scarlet, though you adorn yourself with gold jewelry, though you enlarge your eyes with paint? You adorn yourself in vain; your lovers despise you; they want to take your life.
ekegusii: Aye oyo gwatigirwe bosa na gwasarigwe, ninki orengereretie ekero okobeeka chianga chimonyinga, naende ogwechabera n’ebinto bie chitaabu, na gosata amaiso ao? Nigo ogwechabera bosa. Abanchi bao bagochayire, na nigo bakorigia gosiria obogima bwao.
swahili: Unafanya nini, ewe uliyeharibiwa? Kwa nini unajivika vazi jekundu na kuvaa vito vya dhahabu? Kwa nini unapaka macho yako rangi? Unajipamba bure. Wapenzi wako wanakudharau, wanautafuta uhai wako.

english: For I hear a cry like a woman in labor, a cry of anguish like one bearing her first child— the cry of the Daughter of Zion gasping for breath, stretching out her hands to say, “Woe is me, for my soul faints before the murderers!”
ekegusii: Naigure okorera buna okw’omokuungu okobina aibore; ekerero ekenene buna eki’oyo okoibora omwana omotangi. Okorera okwo nigo kore okorera gwa Sayoni, omoiseke one, ngwesacha are ang’use omoika, okorambora amaboko aye, okorera: “N akuure! Nkong’ita bare!”
swahili: Nasikia kilio kama cha mwanamke katika utungu wa kuzaa, kilio cha uchungu kama cha anayemzaa mtoto wake wa kwanza: kilio cha Binti Sayuni akitweta ili aweze kupumua, akiinua mikono yake, akisema, “Ole wangu! Ninazimia; maisha yangu yamekabidhiwa kwa wauaji.”

english: Circumcise yourselves to the LORD, and remove the foreskins of your hearts, O men of Judah and people of Jerusalem. Otherwise, My wrath will break out like fire and burn with no one to extinguish it, because of your evil deeds.” Disaster from the North
ekegusii: Inwe Abayuda na abanto ba Yerusalemu, earokie inwe abanyene, mwerue ase Omonene! Arokia chinkoro chiaino! Motakoreti bo, rirorio endamwamu yane nigo eraoroke igoro ase more buna omorero, na omonto tari orayerimie. Ayio onsi nigo arabe nase engencho y’ogokora kwaino okobe.” Abayuda bakogoswa negesusuro
swahili: Jitahirini katika Bwana, tahirini mioyo yenu, enyi wanaume wa Yuda na watu wa Yerusalemu, la sivyo ghadhabu yangu itatoka kwa nguvu na kuwaka kama moto kwa sababu ya uovu mliotenda, ikiwaka pasipo wa kuizima. Maafa Kutoka Kaskazini

english: Announce in Judah, proclaim in Jerusalem, and say: “Blow the ram’s horn throughout the land. Cry aloud and say, ‘Assemble yourselves and let us flee to the fortified cities.’
ekegusii: Teebia Abayuda, na morarie ase Yerusalemu: “Bugia egetureeri ase ense eye yonsi, moake eriogi rinene, motebe: Sangererekana amo, togende ase emechie egiteire chindwaki.
swahili: “Tangaza katika Yuda na upige mbiu katika Yerusalemu na kusema: ‘Piga tarumbeta katika nchi yote!’ Piga kelele na kusema: ‘Kusanyikeni pamoja! Tukimbilie katika miji yenye maboma!’

english: Raise a signal flag toward Zion. Seek refuge! Do not delay! For I am bringing disaster from the north, and terrible destruction.
ekegusii: Imokia ekemanyererio kiorokie enchera egochia Sayoni; tama motooreke, timobaisa goteebana, ekiagera nkorenta nde obobe na ogosaria okonene korwa sugusu.”
swahili: Onyesheni ishara ili kwenda Sayuni! Kimbilieni usalama pasipo kuchelewa! Kwa kuwa ninaleta maafa kutoka kaskazini, maangamizi ya kutisha.”

english: A lion has gone up from his thicket, and a destroyer of nations has set out. He has left his lair to lay waste your land. Your cities will be reduced to ruins and lie uninhabited.
ekegusii: Endo yaimokire korwa ase riraro riaye; oria ogosiria ebisaku oimokire, orure aase aye, akore ense yaino ebe bosa; emechie yaino nesarigwe ebe amaturi, atamenyiri nabaanto.
swahili: Simba ametoka nje ya pango lake, mharabu wa mataifa amejipanga. Ametoka mahali pake ili aangamize nchi yenu. Miji yenu itakuwa magofu pasipo mtu wa kuishi humo.

english: So put on sackcloth, mourn and wail, for the fierce anger of the LORD has not turned away from us.”
ekegusii: Ase ayio, eboyie chigunia, morere na kweng’ereria, ekiagera endamwamu enene y’Omonene nigo ere ase tore, teraonchoka etotige.
swahili: Hivyo vaeni nguo za magunia, ombolezeni na kulia kwa huzuni, kwa kuwa hasira kali ya Bwana haijaondolewa kwetu.

english: “In that day,” declares the LORD, “the king and officials will lose their courage. The priests will tremble in fear, and the prophets will be astounded.”
ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: “Ase rituko erio abarwoti amo nabanene b’oborwoti tibakoba noboremu, abakuani mbaondoke na ababani mbakumie.”
swahili: “Katika siku ile,” asema Bwana “mfalme na maafisa watakata tamaa, makuhani watafadhaika, na manabii watashangazwa mno.”

english: This is the word that the LORD spoke through Jeremiah the prophet concerning Babylon and the land of the Chaldeans:
ekegusii: Aya nar’Omonene akwanete goetera ase Yeremia omobani igoro y’omochie o Babiloni na ense engima y’Abakalidayo:
swahili: Hili ndilo neno alilosema Bwana kupitia nabii Yeremia kuhusu Babeli na nchi ya Wakaldayo:

english: Chaldea will be plundered; all who plunder her will have their fill,” declares the LORD. Babylon’s Fall Is Certain
ekegusii: Ense y’Abakalidayo nesakorwe, nabwo bonsi bakoyesakora nabaisaneke nebisakorwa ebio.” Nab’Omonene atebiire. Okogwa kwa Babiloni
swahili: Kwa hiyo Ukaldayo utatekwa nyara; wote wamtekao nyara watapata za kutosha,” asema Bwana.

english: “Because you rejoice, because you sing in triumph— you who plunder My inheritance— because you frolic like a heifer treading grain and neigh like stallions,
ekegusii: “Inwe aba mwasakorete omwando one, nonya mwagogete na gochenga, naende more nokogania buna ritororo riarisirie obonyansi, na mogokwana buna chibarasi chituoni,
swahili: “Kwa sababu hushangilia na kufurahi, wewe utekaye urithi wangu, kwa sababu unachezacheza kama mtamba anayepura nafaka, na kulia kama farasi dume,

english: your mother will be greatly ashamed; she who bore you will be disgraced. Behold, she will be the least of the nations, a wilderness, a dry land, and a desert.
ekegusii: nyoko nabe nobosooku obonene, ee, omochie oyo okoiborete noichanigwe. Rora, ase egati ye chinse chi’ense oyio obe omoke mono kobua, nobe erooro enyomo ere bosa.
swahili: mama yako ataaibika mno, yeye aliyekuzaa atatahayari. Atakuwa mdogo kuliko mataifa mengine yote, atakuwa nyika, nchi kame na jangwa.

english: Because of the wrath of the LORD, she will not be inhabited; she will become completely desolate. All who pass through Babylon will be horrified and will hiss at all her wounds.
ekegusii: Ase engencho y’endamwamu y’Omonene Babiloni nosirigwe kegima, gose tokomenywa rinde. Kera omonto orabe ogoeta Babiloni nakumie na goichana mono ase engencho y’amaakwa aye.
swahili: Kwa sababu ya hasira ya Bwana hatakaliwa na mtu, lakini ataachwa ukiwa kabisa. Wote watakaopita Babeli watatiwa hofu na kudhihaki kwa sababu ya majeraha yake yote.

english: Line up in formation around Babylon, all you who draw the bow! Shoot at her! Spare no arrows! For she has sinned against the LORD.
ekegusii: “Inwe mwensi momanyete gokumba amata, ebeke ang’e morwanie Babiloni ase chinsemo chiaye chionsi. Yorute chinsara, timotiga nonya neyemo, ekiagera okorire ebibe ase Omonene.
swahili: “Shikeni nafasi zenu kuzunguka Babeli, enyi nyote mvutao upinde. Mpigeni! Msibakize mshale wowote, kwa kuwa ametenda dhambi dhidi ya Bwana.

english: Raise a war cry against her on every side! She has thrown up her hands in surrender; her towers have fallen; her walls are torn down. Since this is the vengeance of the LORD, take out your vengeance upon her; as she has done, do the same to her.
ekegusii: Imoka, aka eriogi ri’esegi ase chinsemo chiaye chionsi. Babiloni bwerure omonyene; chiburi chiaye chiagure, chindwaki chiatagoirwe na koiyerigwa inse. Ekio negesiomba Omonene akorusia. Ase ayio, rusia egesiomba ase omochie oyio. Buna koreng’ana Babiloni okorete moyokore boigo.
swahili: Piga kelele dhidi yake kila upande! Anajisalimisha, minara yake inaanguka, kuta zake zimebomoka. Kwa kuwa hiki ni kisasi cha Bwana, mlipizeni kisasi; mtendeeni kama alivyowatendea wengine.

english: Cut off the sower from Babylon, and the one who wields the sickle at harvest time. In the face of the oppressor’s sword, each will turn to his own people, each will flee to his own land. Redemption for God’s People
ekegusii: Siria kegima korwa Babiloni omobusuri na oyokoimokia omoyio bwe rigesa, ekero engaki eyio yaikire. Ase engencho y’obwoba bw’omochandi, kera omomenyi nairane ase abanto baye, kera oyomo natame gochia ase ense yaye omonyene. Okoirana kw’Abaisraeli
swahili: Katilieni mbali mpanzi kutoka Babeli, pamoja na mvunaji na mundu wake akivuna. Kwa sababu ya upanga wa mdhalimu kila mmoja na arejee kwa watu wake mwenyewe, kila mmoja na akimbilie kwenye nchi yake mwenyewe.

english: Israel is a scattered flock, chased away by lions. The first to devour him was the king of Assyria; the last to crush his bones was Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon.”
ekegusii: “Abaisraeli nigo banga buna ching’ondi chigoserigwa ne chindo na goserebanigwa gochia aaria na aaria. Ritang’ani omorwoti bw’Abaasuri akababua na kobasiria, na bono omoerio Nebukadinesaro, omorwoti o Babiloni, otakunire amauga abo.
swahili: “Israeli ni kundi lililotawanyika ambalo simba wamelifukuzia mbali. Wa kwanza kumla alikuwa mfalme wa Ashuru, wa mwisho kuponda mifupa yake alikuwa Nebukadneza mfalme wa Babeli.”

english: Therefore this is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: “I will punish the king of Babylon and his land as I punished the king of Assyria.
ekegusii: Ase ayio, aya nar’Omonene bw’Emeganda, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, agoteeba: Naama! Nindetere omorwoti o Babiloni, amo nense yaye, egesusuro, buna nakorete ase omorwoti bw’Abaisraeli.
swahili: Kwa hiyo hili ndilo Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, Mungu wa Israeli, asemalo: “Nitamwadhibu mfalme wa Babeli na nchi yake kama nilivyomwadhibu mfalme wa Ashuru.

english: I will return Israel to his pasture, and he will graze on Carmel and Bashan; his soul will be satisfied on the hills of Ephraim and Gilead.
ekegusii: Ning’iranie Abaisraeli gocha ase obomenyo bwabo naende. Nabarabwo nabarie chindagera chiabo agwo ase egetunwa gia Karimeli, na ase orogongo rwa Basani, na okogania kwabo nagoisanekigwe agwo ase ebigoro bi’Efraimu, na ase Gileadi.
swahili: Lakini nitamrudisha Israeli katika malisho yake mwenyewe naye atalisha huko Karmeli na Bashani; njaa yake itashibishwa juu ya vilima vya Efraimu na Gileadi.

english: “Announce and declare to the nations; lift up a banner and proclaim it; hold nothing back when you say, ‘Babylon is captured; Bel is put to shame; Marduk is shattered, her images are disgraced, her idols are broken in pieces.’
ekegusii: “Kwana ase egati y’ebisaku, mobiraarerie! Imokereria igoro ebendera na morarie! Timobaisa kobisa amang’ana aya, korende motebe: Babiloni obwatirwe, enyasae Beli yasookigwe, na Merodaki yatirwe. Emegwekano egosasimwa ereo yasookigwe, ne chinyasae chi’aroro chiatirwe.
swahili: “Tangazeni na mhubiri katikati ya mataifa, twekeni bendera na mkahubiri; msiache kitu chochote, bali semeni, ‘Babeli utatekwa; Beli ataaibishwa, Merodaki atajazwa na hofu kuu. Sanamu zake zitaaibishwa na vinyago vyake vitajazwa hofu kuu.’

english: In those days and at that time, declares the LORD, a search will be made for Israel’s guilt, but there will be none, and for Judah’s sins, but they will not be found; for I will forgive the remnant I preserve. The Destruction of Babylon
ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: Ase amatuko ayio, na ase engaki eyio, ogosaria nakorigigwe ase Abaisraeli, ko tigokonyorekana, na ebibe ase Abayuda, ko tibikonyorekana, ekiagera inche Omonene ninyabere abanto abwo ndatigarie koba abatigari.” Nyasae okogambia Babiloni
swahili: Katika siku hizo, wakati huo,” asema Bwana, “uchunguzi utafanyika kwa ajili ya kosa la Israeli, lakini halitakuwepo, kwa ajili ya dhambi za Yuda, lakini haitapatikana hata moja, kwa kuwa nitawasamehe mabaki nitakaowaacha.

english: Go up against the land of Merathaim, and against the residents of Pekod. Kill them and devote them to destruction. Do all that I have commanded you,” declares the LORD.
ekegusii: Omonene oteebire, Genda morwanie ense ya Merataimu na abanto ba Pekodi. Mobabwatie korwa magega, mobaite na kobasiria kegima, mokore onsi aya nabachiikire.
swahili: “Shambulieni nchi ya Merathaimu na wale waishio huko Pekodi. Wafuatieni, waueni na kuwaangamiza kabisa,” asema Bwana. “Fanyeni kila kitu nilichowaamuru.

english: “The noise of battle is in the land— the noise of great destruction.
ekegusii: Eriogi ri’esegi riachire ase ense amo nogosirigwa okonene.
swahili: Kelele ya vita iko ndani ya nchi, kelele ya maangamizi makuu!

english: How the hammer of the whole earth lies broken and shattered! What a horror Babylon has become among the nations!
ekegusii: Naki enturago eria yaagete ense engima yaakirwe na gwateka! Naki Babiloni osirigwe, na abanto baichanigwe ase okoyorora igo!
swahili: Tazama jinsi nyundo ya dunia yote ilivyovunjika na kuharibika! Tazama jinsi Babeli ilivyokuwa ukiwa miongoni mwa mataifa!

english: I laid a snare for you, O Babylon, and you were caught before you knew it. You were found and captured because you challenged the LORD.
ekegusii: Aye Babiloni, nagotegire noboreba, kwabwatirwe, nonya tikwamanyete ayio; kwanyorirwe na kobwatwa, ekiagera nkwamorwanetie Omonene.
swahili: Nimetega mtego kwa ajili yako, ee Babeli, nawe ukakamatwa kabla haujafahamu; ulipatikana na ukakamatwa kwa sababu ulimpinga Bwana.

english: The LORD has opened His armory and brought out His weapons of wrath, for this is the work of the Lord GOD of Hosts in the land of the Chaldeans.
ekegusii: Omonene oigoire ase agachete ebirwanero biaye, na ase endamwamu yaye obisokirie, ekiagera Omonene, Nyasae bw’Emeganda, nabwate emeremo agokora ase ense y’Abakalidayo.
swahili: Bwana amefungua ghala lake la silaha na kuzitoa silaha za ghadhabu yake, kwa kuwa Bwana Mwenyezi Mwenye Nguvu Zote anayo kazi ya kufanya katika nchi ya Wakaldayo.

english: Come against her from the farthest border. Break open her granaries; pile her up like mounds of grain. Devote her to destruction; leave her no survivors.
ekegusii: Inchuo morwanie ense eyio korwa ase chinsemo chionsi, moigore ebiage biaye; mobeke ebinto bire imeo amo, bibe buna ebinge chi’endagera. Mosirie ense eyio kegima; timobaisa gotigaria nonya negento ekemo.
swahili: Njooni dhidi yake kutoka mbali. Zifungueni ghala zake za nafaka; mlundikeni kama lundo la nafaka. Mwangamizeni kabisa na msimwachie mabaki yoyote.

english: Kill all her young bulls; let them go down to the slaughter. Woe to them, for their day has come— the time of their punishment.
ekegusii: Moite abarwani babo b’esegi banga buna chieri, mobaite bonsi pi. Obobe nobwabo, ekiagera rituko ri’ogosirigwa kwabo riachire, eyio nengaki yabo y’okonyora egesusuro.
swahili: Waueni mafahali wake wachanga wote; waacheni washuke machinjoni! Ole wao! Kwa kuwa siku yao imewadia, wakati wao wa kuadhibiwa.

english: Listen to the fugitives and refugees from the land of Babylon, declaring in Zion the vengeance of the LORD our God, the vengeance for His temple.
ekegusii: Igwa eriogi ri’abaanto bagotama korwa ase ense ya Babiloni, bakoraria ase Sayoni igoro y’Omonene, Nyasae oito, buna akoruseria Hekalu yaye egesiomba.
swahili: Wasikilizeni watoro na wakimbizi kutoka Babeli wakitangaza katika Sayuni jinsi Bwana, Mungu wetu alivyolipiza kisasi, kisasi kwa ajili ya Hekalu lake.

english: Summon the archers against Babylon, all who string the bow. Encamp all around her; let no one escape. Repay her according to her deeds; do to her as she has done. For she has defied the LORD, the Holy One of Israel.
ekegusii: Rangeria abanto bamanyete korwanera amata bachiche korwania Babiloni. Moyoboere ase chinsemo chionsi, timotiga nonya nomonto oyomo atame atooreke. Yoakane koreng’ana nogokora kwaye. Buna koreng’ana oro okorete tiga okorerwe boigo, ekiagera omochie oyio oenenire ase Omonene, oyore Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli.
swahili: “Waiteni wapiga mishale dhidi ya Babeli, wote wale wavutao upinde. Pigeni kambi kumzunguka kabisa, asitoroke mtu yeyote. Mlipizeni kwa matendo yake; mtendeeni kama alivyotenda. Kwa kuwa alimdharau Bwana, yeye Aliye Mtakatifu wa Israeli.

english: For a nation from the north will come against her; it will make her land a desolation. No one will live in it; both man and beast will flee.” Hope for Israel and Judah
ekegusii: “Egesaku kiarure sugusu gocha korwania Babiloni. Nagesarie ense eyio ebe buna erooro, na monto onde takomenya aroro; abanto nabatame ne ching’iti boigo.” Abaisraeli bakoirana
swahili: Taifa kutoka kaskazini litamshambulia, na kuifanya nchi yake ukiwa. Hakuna hata mmoja atakayeishi ndani yake, watu na wanyama wataikimbia.

english: Therefore, her young men will fall in the streets, and all her warriors will be silenced in that day,” declares the LORD.
ekegusii: Ase rituko erio abamura b’omochie oyio, nabaitwe, bakwere agwo ase chinchera, na abarwani baye bonsi b’esegi nabasirigwe kegima. Nabo inche Omonene natebiire.
swahili: Kwa hiyo, vijana wake wanaume wataanguka barabarani; askari wake wote watanyamazishwa siku ile,” asema Bwana.

english: “Behold, I am against you, O arrogant one,” declares the Lord GOD of Hosts, “for your day has come, the time when I will punish you.
ekegusii: Naende inche Omonene, Nyasae bw’Emeganda, natebiire: Aye Babiloni ore omoenenu, igwa, inche nabeire mamincha yao; rituko riao riaikire, engaki eye ngokoa egesusuro.
swahili: “Tazama, niko kinyume nawe, ewe mwenye majivuno,” asema Bwana, Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, “kwa kuwa siku yako imewadia, yaani, wakati wako wa kuadhibiwa.

english: The arrogant one will stumble and fall with no one to pick him up. And I will kindle a fire in his cities to consume all those around him.”
ekegusii: Oyio ore omoenenu nagochwe na kogwa, gose monto onde takomogororokia. Nintongie omorero ase emechie y’ense eyio noro nosambe chinsemo chiaye chionsi.
swahili: Mwenye majivuno atajikwaa na kuanguka, wala hakuna yeyote atakayemuinua; nitawasha moto katika miji yake, utakaowateketeza wote wanaomzunguka.”

english: This is what the LORD of Hosts says: “The sons of Israel are oppressed, and the sons of Judah as well. All their captors hold them fast, refusing to release them.
ekegusii: Aya nar’Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteeba: Abaisraeli amo n’Abayuda nigo bachandire. Abanto abwo baabairete ase obosomba nigo baababwatete bokong’u, bangire kobaa ribaga bagende sobo.
swahili: Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote: “Watu wa Israeli wameonewa, nao watu wa Yuda pia. Wote waliowateka wamewashikilia sana, wanakataa kuwaachia waende.

english: Their Redeemer is strong; the LORD of Hosts is His name. He will fervently plead their case so that He may bring rest to the earth, but turmoil to those who live in Babylon.
ekegusii: Korende omobooria obo nigo are ne chinguru. Omonene bw’Emeganda nario erieta riaye. Ekeene, ere nabarwanerere, erinde arente obotoereru na omotimoko ase ense, korende narente omorero ase abanto bamenyete Babiloni.
swahili: Lakini Mkombozi wao ana nguvu; Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote ndilo jina lake. Atatetea kwa nguvu shauri lao ili alete raha katika nchi yao, lakini ataleta msukosuko kwa wale waishio Babeli.

english: A sword is against the Chaldeans, declares the LORD, against those who live in Babylon, and against her officials and wise men.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: Omoro obe igoro ase Abakalidayo, na igoro ase abanto bamenyete Babiloni, na igoro ase abanene b’oborwoti obwo, na igoro ase abanto abang’aini b’ense eyio!
swahili: “Upanga dhidi ya Wakaldayo!” asema Bwana, “dhidi ya wale waishio Babeli na dhidi ya maafisa wake na watu wenye busara!

english: A sword is against her false prophets, and they will become fools. A sword is against her warriors, and they will be filled with terror.
ekegusii: Omoro obe igoro ase abaringoria, erinde babe abariri! Omoro obe igoro ase abarwani baye bare chituoni, erinde basirigwe!
swahili: Upanga dhidi ya manabii wake wa uongo! Watakuwa wapumbavu. Upanga dhidi ya mashujaa wake! Watajazwa na hofu kuu

english: A sword is against her horses and chariots and against all the foreigners in her midst, and they will become like women. A sword is against her treasuries, and they will be plundered.
ekegusii: Omoro obe igoro ase chibarasi ne chigari chia Babiloni! Omoro obe igoro ase abasikari b’ense eng’ao, abare ase egati yabo, erinde obakore babe buna abakungu! Omoro obe igoro ase chinibo chiabo erinde chisakorwe!
swahili: Upanga dhidi ya farasi na magari yake ya vita pamoja na askari wake wote wa kigeni katika safu zake! Wao watakuwa kama wanawake. Upanga dhidi ya hazina zake! Hizo zitatekwa nyara.

english: A drought is upon her waters, and they will be dried up. For it is a land of graven images, and the people go mad over idols.
ekegusii: Egurugura nebe igoro ase chindooche chiaye, erinde chikame amaache! Ense eyio nigo eichire nemegwekano y’ogosasimwa, na abanto mbabe buna chibarimo ase ogosasiima emegwekano eyio!
swahili: Ukame juu ya maji yake! Nayo yatakauka. Kwa kuwa ni nchi ya sanamu, wao wanaenda wazimu kwa ajili ya sanamu.

english: So the desert creatures and hyenas will live there and ostriches will dwell there. It will never again be inhabited or lived in from generation to generation.
ekegusii: Ase ayio ching’iti chi’orosana, amo ne chinyang’au, ne chisagero nachimenye ase ense eyio. Abanto tibagocha komenyao nonya ng’ake, korwa ekiaare goika ekiaare kogenderera botambe.
swahili: “Kwa hiyo, viumbe vya jangwani na fisi wataishi humo, nao bundi watakaa humo. Kamwe haitakaliwa tena wala watu hawataishi humo kutoka kizazi hadi kizazi.

english: “In those days and at that time, declares the LORD, the children of Israel and the children of Judah will come together, weeping as they come, and will seek the LORD their God.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: “Ase amatuko ayio, na ase engaki eyio, Abaisraeli amo n’Abayuda nabache amo babe bakorera na kondigia inche, Nyasae obo.
swahili: “Katika siku hizo, wakati huo,” asema Bwana, “watu wa Israeli pamoja na watu wa Yuda wataenda wakilia ili kumtafuta Bwana Mungu wao.

english: As God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah along with their neighbors,” declares the LORD, “no one will dwell there; no man will abide there.
ekegusii: Buna yabeete ekero keria Nyasae asiretie emechie ya Sodomu na Gomora, amo nemechie yarenge ang’e neyio, naboigo monto onde takomenya Babiloni, gose Mwanyabaanto onde takomenya aroro. Nab’Omonene atebiire.
swahili: Kama vile Mungu alivyoangamiza Sodoma na Gomora pamoja na miji iliyokuwa jirani nayo,” asema Bwana, “vivyo hivyo hakuna mtu yeyote atakayeishi humo. Naam, hakuna mtu yeyote atakayekaa humo.

english: Behold, an army is coming from the north; a great nation and many kings are stirred up from the ends of the earth.
ekegusii: Naama! Abanto ngocha bare korwa sugusu, egesaku ekenene mono amo nabarwoti abange baseegetirwe korwa chinsinyo chi’ense.
swahili: “Tazama! Jeshi linakuja kutoka kaskazini; taifa kubwa na wafalme wengi wanaamshwa kutoka miisho ya dunia.

english: They grasp the bow and spear; they are cruel and merciless. Their voice roars like the sea, and they ride upon horses, lined up like men in formation against you, O Daughter of Babylon.
ekegusii: Abanto abwo nigo babwate amata na amatimo, nigo bare abatindi, abatari namaabera. Amariogi abo nigo akoeera buna okoeera kw’enyancha. Nigo bariinete chibarasi, berobeirie buna omonto bwebekire ang’e ase esegi, erinde baabarwanie inwe, abanto ba Babiloni.
swahili: Wamejifunga pinde na mikuki; ni wakatili na wasio na huruma. Wanatoa sauti kama bahari inayonguruma wanapoendesha farasi zao; wanakuja kama watu waliojipanga tayari kwa vita ili kukushambulia, ee Binti Babeli.

english: The king of Babylon has heard the report, and his hands hang limp. Anguish has gripped him, pain like that of a woman in labor.
ekegusii: “Omorwoti o Babiloni oigure amang’ana igoro yabo, amaboko aye aborirwe chinguru, omoichano omosoire, na obororo buna obw’omokuungu okobina aibore.
swahili: Mfalme wa Babeli amesikia habari kuwahusu, nayo mikono yake imelegea. Uchungu umemshika, maumivu kama ya mwanamke katika utungu wa kuzaa.

english: Behold, one will come up like a lion from the thickets of the Jordan to the watered pasture. For in an instant I will chase Babylon from her land. Who is the chosen one I will appoint for this? For who is like Me, and who can challenge Me? What shepherd can stand against Me?”
ekegusii: “Rora, buna koreng’ana endo egosoka korwa ase rinani rinoru ria Yorodani, erinde yagenda goita ching’ondi chire ime ase obweri obokong’u, naboigo na inche ndachiere abanto ba Babiloni mobosokano, mbaserie batame korwa aroro. Onde bwensi ndachore nimobeke abe omorisia igoro ase bare. Ning’o oranyare koreng’anigwa nainche? Ning’o orambekere rituko indue omobaro? Morisia ki oranyare kweegera ase obosio bwane?
swahili: Kama simba anayepanda kutoka vichaka vya Yordani kuja kwenye nchi ya malisho mengi, ndivyo nitamfukuza Babeli kutoka nchi yake ghafula. Ni nani aliye mteule, nitakayemweka kwa ajili ya jambo hili? Ni nani aliye kama mimi, na ni nani awezaye kunipinga? Tena ni mchungaji yupi awezaye kusimama kinyume nami?”

english: Therefore hear the plans that the LORD has drawn up against Babylon and the strategies He has devised against the land of the Chaldeans: Surely the little ones of the flock will be dragged away; certainly their pasture will be made desolate because of them.
ekegusii: Ase ayio, tegerera moigwe omooroberio inche Omonene nakorire igoro y’abanto ba Babiloni, na okogania kwane mbwate igoro y’ense y’Abakalidayo. Ekeene, nonya nabana babo mbakururwe buna chimanwa chi’eching’ondi chigokururwa chiairwa. Ee, ekeene, ense yabo nebaichanere.
swahili: Kwa hiyo, sikia kile Bwana alichokipanga dhidi ya Babeli, kile alichokusudia dhidi ya nchi ya Wakaldayo: Aliye mchanga katika kundi ataburutwa mbali. Yeye ataharibu kabisa malisho yao kwa sababu yao.

english: At the sound of Babylon’s capture the earth will quake; a cry will be heard among the nations.
ekegusii: Ekero Babiloni orabwatwe, ense netengechigwe, na eriogi riaye narigugwe ase egati y’ebisaku.”
swahili: Kwa sauti ya kutekwa kwa Babeli, dunia itatetemeka; kilio chake kitasikika pote miongoni mwa mataifa.

english: They will ask the way to Zion and turn their faces toward it. They will come and join themselves to the LORD in an everlasting covenant that will never be forgotten.
ekegusii: Barabwo mbaborie bamanye enchera ekogenda Sayoni, babe bakoonchora amasio abo gochia aroro, batebania: Inchuo tobwatane n’Omonene, tokore okobwatana kw’ogotianania nere, okwo koragenderere botambe gotanyare kwebwa.
swahili: Wataiuliza njia iendayo Sayuni na kuelekeza nyuso zao huko. Watakuja na kuambatana na Bwana katika agano la milele ambalo halitasahaulika.

english: My people are lost sheep; their shepherds have led them astray, causing them to roam the mountains. They have wandered from mountain to hill; they have forgotten their resting place.
ekegusii: “Abanto baane babeire buna ching’ondi chinsiru. Abarisia babo baabasiririe, ekiagera babeire bakona‐kobaong’anyia ase ebitunwa. Nigo bakona‐koong’anya buna ching’ondi, bakobaetanania korwa ase ebitunwa goika ase ebigoro; ase igo abanto baane bebire obweri bwabo.
swahili: “Watu wangu wamekuwa kondoo waliopotea; wachungaji wao wamewapotosha na kuwasababisha kuzurura juu ya milima. Walitangatanga juu ya mlima na kilima, na kusahau mahali pao wenyewe pa kupumzikia.

english: All who found them devoured them, and their enemies said, ‘We are not guilty, for they have sinned against the LORD, their true pasture, the LORD, the hope of their fathers.’
ekegusii: Abanto bande bonsi baabanyorete nigo baabakorete bobe. Ababisa babo babeire bagoteeba: Intwe titori nokomocha ase ogokora iga, ekiagera barabwo bakorire ebibe ase Omonene obo, oyore obomenyo bwabo bw’ekeene, Omonene oyio orenge ogosemeria gwe chisokoro chiabo.
swahili: Yeyote aliyewakuta aliwala; adui zao walisema, ‘Sisi hatuna hatia, kwa kuwa wao walitenda dhambi dhidi ya Bwana, malisho yao halisi, Bwana, aliye tumaini la baba zao.’

english: Flee from the midst of Babylon; depart from the land of the Chaldeans; be like the he-goats that lead the flock.
ekegusii: “Tama korwa Babiloni, morue ase ense y’Abakalidayo, mobe buna chigoree chigotang’ana bosio bwe riicho.
swahili: “Kimbieni kutoka Babeli; ondokeni katika nchi ya Wakaldayo tena kuweni kama mbuzi wale waongozao kundi.

english: For behold, I stir up and bring against Babylon an assembly of great nations from the land of the north. They will line up against her; from the north she will be captured. Their arrows will be like skilled warriors who do not return empty-handed.
ekegusii: Naama! Inche ngoseegeta nde omoganda bw’ebisaku ebinene, korwa ase ense ya sugusu, na barabwo bebeke ang’e korwania Babiloni bayobue korwa ensemo eria ya sugusu. Chinsara chiabo nigo chinga buna omorwani omong’aini ore neganga otari koirana bosa.
swahili: Kwa maana nitaamsha na kuleta dhidi ya Babeli muungano wa mataifa makubwa kutoka nchi ya kaskazini. Watashika nafasi zao dhidi yake, naye kutokea kaskazini atatekwa. Mishale yao itakuwa kama mishale ya mashujaa walio hodari, ambao hawawezi kurudi mikono mitupu.

english: This is what the LORD says: “Behold, I will stir up against Babylon and against the people of Leb-kamai the spirit of a destroyer.
ekegusii: Aya nar’Omonene agoteeba: “Rora, inche ninseegete omoika bw’ogosiria Babiloni na abanto bamenyete aroro bare mamincha yane.
swahili: Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana: “Tazama nitaamsha roho ya mwangamizi dhidi ya Babeli na watu wakaao Leb-Kamai.

english: “The LORD has brought forth our vindication; come, let us tell in Zion what the LORD our God has accomplished.”
ekegusii: “Omonene otorenteire oboronge bwaito. Inchuo torarie ase Sayoni emeremo y’Omonene, Nyasae oito.
swahili: “ ‘ Bwana amethibitisha haki yetu; njooni, tutangaze katika Sayuni kitu ambacho Bwana Mungu wetu amefanya.’

english: Sharpen the arrows! Fill the quivers! The LORD has aroused the spirit of the kings of the Medes, because His plan is aimed at Babylon to destroy her, for it is the vengeance of the LORD— vengeance for His temple.
ekegusii: “Tieria chinsara! Imokia chinguba! Omonene oseegetire emeika y’abarwoti b’Abamedi, ekiagera nigo aroberetie gosiria Babiloni. Ekio negesiomba Omonene akoruseria Hekalu yaye.
swahili: “Noeni mishale, chukueni ngao! Bwana amewaamsha wafalme wa Wamedi, kwa sababu nia yake ni kuangamiza Babeli. Bwana atalipiza kisasi, kisasi kwa ajili ya Hekalu lake.

english: Raise a banner against the walls of Babylon; post the guard; station the watchmen; prepare the ambush. For the LORD has both devised and accomplished what He spoke against the people of Babylon.
ekegusii: Tenenia ebendera ase chindwaki chia Babiloni! Kora oborendi bobe obokong’u ase okobeeka abarendi. Beka abanto bebise na koboa, ekiagera Omonene orobeirie na goikerania amang’ana aria akwanete ase abanto bamenyete Babiloni.
swahili: Twekeni bendera juu ya kuta za Babeli! Imarisheni ulinzi, wekeni walinzi, andaeni waviziao! Bwana atatimiza kusudi lake, amri yake juu ya watu wa Babeli.

english: You who dwell by many waters, rich in treasures, your end has come; the thread of your life is cut.
ekegusii: Aye omenyete aase amaache amange are, ore omonda bwe chinibo chinyinge, korende omoerio oo oikire, naboigo na okogania kwao okonge.
swahili: Wewe uishiye kando ya maji mengi na uliye na wingi wa hazina, mwisho wako umekuja, wakati wako wa kukatiliwa mbali.

english: The LORD of Hosts has sworn by Himself: “Surely I will fill you up with men as with locusts, and they will shout in triumph over you.” Praise to the God of Jacob (Isaiah 25:1–12)
ekegusii: Omonene bw’Emeganda bwetianirie ogoteeba: Ekeene, ninkorentere abanto abange mono buna chingige, bachiche gokorwania, na barabwo nabakobue na baake eriogi ri’obobui.” Amatera ay’okomotogia Omonene
swahili: Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote ameapa kwa nafsi yake mwenyewe: ‘Hakika nitakujaza na watu, kama kundi la nzige, nao watapiga kelele za ushindi juu yako.’

english: The LORD made the earth by His power; He established the world by His wisdom and stretched out the heavens by His understanding.
ekegusii: “Omonene nere otongete ense ase okobua kwaye, nere oyetenenetie goetera ase obong’aini bwaye, na ase okomanya kwaye akarambora igoro.
swahili: “Aliiumba dunia kwa uweza wake; akaweka misingi ya ulimwengu kwa hekima yake na akazitandaza mbingu kwa ufahamu wake.

english: When He thunders, the waters in the heavens roar; He causes the clouds to rise from the ends of the earth. He generates the lightning with the rain and brings forth the wind from His storehouses.
ekegusii: Ekero agokwana neriogi riaye, amaache are igoro nigo akoruma. Nigo agokora ritaturi riaimokerera igoro korwa ase chinsinyo chi’ense. Nigo akomesia na korenta embura, naende orenta omwaga ogusa korwa ase ebigachero biaye.
swahili: Atoapo sauti yake, maji yaliyo katika mbingu hunguruma, huyafanya mawingu yainuke kutoka miisho ya dunia. Hupeleka umeme wa radi pamoja na mvua, naye huuleta upepo kutoka ghala zake.

english: Every man is senseless and devoid of knowledge; every goldsmith is put to shame by his idols. For his molten images are a fraud, and there is no breath in them.
ekegusii: Kera omonto nigo are omoriri, tamanyeti gento, na kera omooroisia etaabu nigo agosookigwa nemegwekano yaye y’ogosasimwa, ekiagera emegwekano eyio ney’obong’ainereria, tebwati omoika ime yaye.
swahili: “Kila mtu ni mjinga na hana maarifa; kila sonara ameaibishwa na sanamu zake. Vinyago vyake ni vya udanganyifu, havina pumzi ndani yavyo.

english: They are worthless, a work to be mocked. In the time of their punishment they will perish.
ekegusii: Eyio nigo ere bosa, nesekererwe, ekero eraegwe egesusuro, nesirigwe.
swahili: Havifai kitu, ni vitu vya kufanyia mzaha, hukumu yavyo itakapowadia, vitaangamia.

english: The Portion of Jacob is not like these, for He is the Maker of all things, and of the tribe of His inheritance— the LORD of Hosts is His name. Babylon’s Punishment
ekegusii: Korende oyore egetari o Yakobo tagwekaini emegwekano eyio; nere otongete ebinto bionsi. Abaisraeli nigo bare egesaku ki’omwando oye; Omonene bw’Emeganda nario erieta riaye.” Babiloni nenturago y’Omonene
swahili: Yeye Aliye Fungu la Yakobo sivyo alivyo, kwani ndiye Muumba wa vitu vyote, pamoja na kabila la urithi wake: Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote ndilo jina lake.

english: I will send strangers to Babylon to winnow her and empty her land; for they will come against her from every side in her day of disaster.
ekegusii: Ase rituko riria ri’emechando nintomere abanto ba Babiloni abairuri baabairure, batige ense yabo ebe bosa.
swahili: Nitawatuma wageni Babeli kumpepeta na kuiharibu nchi yake; watampinga kila upande katika siku ya maafa yake.

english: “You are My war club, My weapon for battle. With you I shatter nations; with you I bring kingdoms to ruin.
ekegusii: “Aye nenturago na ekerwanero kiane gi’esegi; goetera asore ning’ake ebisaku bibe ebisamunye, ninsirie amarwoti.
swahili: “Wewe ndiwe rungu langu la vita, silaha yangu ya vita: kwa wewe navunjavunja mataifa, kwa wewe naangamiza falme,

english: With you I shatter the horse and rider; with you I shatter the chariot and driver.
ekegusii: Goetera asore ninsamunyore chibarasi na abanto bachiriinete; ninsamunyore ne chigari na abagochigendia.
swahili: kwa wewe navunjavunja farasi na mpanda farasi, kwa wewe navunjavunja gari la vita na mwendeshaji wake,

english: With you I shatter man and woman; with you I shatter the old man and the youth; with you I shatter the young man and the maiden.
ekegusii: Goetera asore ninsamunyore abasacha na abakungu, ninsamunyore abanto abagotu na abake, ninsamunyore abamura na abaiseke;
swahili: kwa wewe napondaponda mwanaume na mwanamke, kwa wewe napondaponda mzee na kijana, kwa wewe napondaponda kijana wa kiume na mwanamwali,

english: With you I shatter the shepherd and his flock; with you I shatter the farmer and his oxen; with you I shatter the governors and officials.
ekegusii: goetera asore ninsamunyore abarisia ne riicho riabo, ninsamunyore abaremi ne chiombe chiabo; boigo goetera asore ninsamunyore abagabana na abachiki.” Egesusuro kia Babiloni
swahili: kwa wewe nampondaponda mchungaji na kundi, kwa wewe nampondaponda mkulima na maksai, kwa wewe nawapondaponda watawala na maafisa.

english: Before your very eyes I will repay Babylon and all the dwellers of Chaldea for all the evil they have done in Zion,” declares the LORD.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: “Agwo ase amasio aino ning’akane Babiloni na Abakalidayo bonsi obobe bwabo bwonsi bakorete ase Sayoni.
swahili: “Mbele ya macho yako nitamlipiza Babeli na wote waishio Ukaldayo kwa ajili ya makosa yote waliyofanya katika Sayuni,” asema Bwana.

english: “Behold, I am against you, O destroying mountain, you who devastate the whole earth, declares the LORD. I will stretch out My hand against you; I will roll you over the cliffs and turn you into a charred mountain.
ekegusii: Aye egetunwa kegosiria, gwasiririe ense yonsi, rora, inche nabeire mamincha yao; nindambore okoboko kwane asore; nkobwate ngoturunkanie korwa ase emienya y’ebitare, erio nkoonchore obe egetunwa giasambirwe.
swahili: “Mimi niko kinyume nawe, ee mlima unaoharibu, wewe uangamizaye dunia yote,” asema Bwana. “Nitanyoosha mkono wangu dhidi yako, nikuvingirishe kutoka kwenye kilele cha mwamba, na kukufanya mlima ulioteketezwa kwa moto.

english: No one shall retrieve from you a cornerstone or a foundation stone, because you will become desolate forever,” declares the LORD.
ekegusii: Igena rinde tirikorusigwa asore ribe eri’ekoona, gose kobekwa ase oboroso, korende aye nosarigwe ogenderere koba ritongo kogenderera botambe.” Nab’Omonene atebiire.
swahili: Hakuna jiwe litakalochukuliwa kutoka kwako kwa ajili ya kufanywa jiwe la pembeni, wala jiwe lolote kwa ajili ya msingi, kwa maana utakuwa ukiwa milele,” asema Bwana.

english: “Raise a banner in the land! Blow the ram’s horn among the nations! Prepare the nations against her. Summon the kingdoms against her— Ararat, Minni, and Ashkenaz. Appoint a captain against her; bring up horses like swarming locusts.
ekegusii: “Tenenia ebendera y’esegi igoro ase ense! Bugia egetureeri ase egati y’ebisaku! Beka ebisaku ang’e birwanie Babiloni. Rangeria amarwoti ayorwanie, ee, rangeria Ararati, na Mini, na Asikenasi. Chora abatang’ani b’esegi bayoumokere. Renta chibarasi chinyinge buna chingige chikogosa.
swahili: “Twekeni bendera katika nchi! Pigeni tarumbeta katikati ya mataifa! Andaeni mataifa kwa ajili ya vita dhidi yake, iteni falme hizi dhidi yake: Ararati, Mini na Ashkenazi. Wekeni jemadari dhidi yake, pelekeni farasi wengi kama kundi la nzige.

english: Prepare the nations for battle against her— the kings of the Medes, their governors and all their officials, and all the lands they rule.
ekegusii: Beka ebisaku ang’e biche korwania Babiloni. Rangeria abarwoti b’Abamedi amo nabagabana na abakoonyi babo, na kera ense ere ase obogambi bwaye.
swahili: Andaeni mataifa kwa ajili ya vita dhidi yake, wafalme wa Wamedi, watawala wao na maafisa wao wote, pamoja na nchi zote wanazotawala.

english: The earth quakes and writhes because the LORD’s intentions against Babylon stand: to make the land of Babylon a desolation, without inhabitant.
ekegusii: Erio ense etengeche na koiguswa ase obororo, ekiagera omooroberio Omonene bw’ogosaria Babiloni noikeranigwe, na ere nasirie ense eyio ebe bosa temenywa na monto.
swahili: Nchi inatetemeka na kugaagaa, kwa kuwa makusudi ya Bwana dhidi ya Babeli yanasimama: yaani, kuangamiza nchi ya Babeli ili pasiwe na yeyote atakayeishi humo.

english: Do not let the archer bend his bow or put on his armor. Do not spare her young men; devote all her army to destruction!
ekegusii: Timobaisa gotiga abarwani bakumbe amata na korasa chinsara chiabo, gose kobeeka chigoti chi’ebioma. Timororera abamura b’aroro amaabera. Mosirie abarwani baye b’esegi bonsi pi.
swahili: Usimwache mpiga upinde afunge kamba upinde wake, wala usimwache avae silaha zake. Usiwaonee huruma vijana wake; angamiza jeshi lake kabisa.

english: The warriors of Babylon have stopped fighting; they sit in their strongholds. Their strength is exhausted; they have become like women. Babylon’s homes have been set ablaze, the bars of her gates are broken.
