swahili: Kama kweli mkibadili njia zenu na matendo yenu, mkatendeana haki kila mmoja na mwenzake,

english: if you no longer oppress the foreigner and the fatherless and the widow, and if you no longer shed innocent blood in this place or follow other gods to your own harm,
ekegusii: Motige gokorera bobe omonto omomenyi ore ase more, ne chintakana, na ababoraka, gose aase aiga timoitera amanyinga ’abaanto batari na komocha, naende motige gosasiima chinyasae ching’ao chiria chirabarentere ogosirigwa.
swahili: kama msipomwonea mgeni, yatima wala mjane, na kumwaga damu isiyo na hatia mahali hapa, nanyi kama msipofuata miungu mingine kwa madhara yenu wenyewe,

english: then I will let you live in this place, in the land that I gave to your fathers forever and ever.
ekegusii: Komoraonchoke, erio inche nimbatige mogenderere komenya aase aiga ase ense naete chisokoro chiaino agwo kare ng’a ebe eyabo kogenderera botambe.
swahili: ndipo nitawaacha mkae mahali hapa, katika nchi niliyowapa baba zenu milele na milele.

english: But look, you keep trusting in deceptive words to no avail.
ekegusii: “Bono inwe nigo mwegenete amang’ana ’obong’ainereria atari kobakonya.
swahili: Lakini tazama, mnatumainia maneno ya udanganyifu yasiyo na maana.

english: Will you steal and murder, commit adultery and perjury, burn incense to Baal, and follow other gods that you have not known,
ekegusii: Inee! Nigo mogochia kogenderera koiba, na goita, na gotomana, na gotiana ase oborimo, na gosamba ubani ase enyasae eria Baali, naende gosasiima chinyasae chinde ching’ao, echio motamanyeti.
swahili: “ ‘Je, mtaiba na kuua, mtazini na kuapa kwa uongo, na kufukiza uvumba kwa Baali, na kufuata miungu mingine ambayo hamkuijua,

english: “At that time,” declares the LORD, “the bones of the kings of Judah, the bones of the officials, the bones of the priests, the bones of the prophets, and the bones of the people of Jerusalem will be removed from their graves.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: “Ase engaki eyio amauga ’abarwoti b’Abayuda, na ay’abanene b’oborwoti obwo, na ay’abakuani, na ay’ababani, na aya bonsi abamenyete Yerusalemu, narusigwe ime ase chimbeera chiabo.
swahili: “ ‘Wakati huo, asema Bwana, mifupa ya wafalme na maafisa wa Yuda, mifupa ya makuhani na manabii, na mifupa ya watu wa Yerusalemu itaondolewa kutoka makaburi yao.

english: Therefore I will give their wives to other men and their fields to new owners. For from the least of them to the greatest, all are greedy for gain; from prophet to priest, all practice deceit.
ekegusii: Ase ayio ning’ee abanto abaao abakungu babo, na emegondo yabo ninyee abanto barababue. Abanto aba bonsi, korwa omoke goika omonene, nigo bare neribero ri’okonyora ebitoki bi’obong’ainereria. Abakuani na ababani boigo nigo bagokora amang’ana ’oborimo.
swahili: Kwa hiyo nitawapa watu wengine wake zao, na mashamba yao kwa wamiliki wengine. Kuanzia aliye mdogo kabisa hadi aliye mkubwa kabisa, wote wana tamaa ya kupata zaidi; manabii na makuhani wanafanana, wote wanafanya udanganyifu.

english: They dress the wound of the daughter of My people with very little care, saying, ‘Peace, peace,’ when there is no peace at all.
ekegusii: Batubire amaote ’abaanto baane rioka, bagoteeba: Omorembe, omorembe, na omorembe tori aande.
swahili: Wanafunga majeraha ya watu wangu bila uangalifu. Wanasema, “Amani, amani,” wakati hakuna amani.

english: Are they ashamed of the abomination they have committed? No, they have no shame at all; they do not even know how to blush. So they will fall among the fallen; when I punish them, they will collapse, says the LORD.
ekegusii: Inee! Ekero bakorete ebinto ebi bi’okogechia, m babete nobosooku? Yaya, tibabete nobosooku nonya ng’ake, gose tibaorogetie amasio are nobosooku. Ase engencho eyio nabagwe amo nabaanto baria bande baragwe; ekero ndarue egesusuro ase bare nabarabwo nabagwe. Ninche Omonene nakwanire.”
swahili: Je, wanaona aibu kwa ajili ya tabia yao inayochukiza mno? Hapana, hawana aibu hata kidogo, hawajui hata kuona haya. Kwa hiyo wataanguka miongoni mwa hao walioanguka, watashushwa chini watakapoadhibiwa, asema Bwana.

english: I will take away their harvest, declares the LORD. There will be no grapes on the vine, nor figs on the tree, and even the leaf will wither. Whatever I have given them will be lost to them.” The People Respond
ekegusii: Naende Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: “Nimbarusie mbasirie kegima. Amasabibu takonyorekana ase emesabibu yabo, gose amako ase emeko yabo. Nonya namato ’emete asusanire na kwoma. Ebinto nabaete konya biasirire korwa ase bare.”
swahili: “ ‘Nitayaondoa mavuno yao, asema Bwana. Hapatakuwepo zabibu kwenye mzabibu. Hapatakuwepo na tini kwenye mtini, majani yake yatanyauka. Kile nilichowapa watanyangʼanywa.’ ”

english: Why are we just sitting here? Gather together, let us flee to the fortified cities and perish there, for the LORD our God has doomed us. He has given us poisoned water to drink, because we have sinned against the LORD.
ekegusii: Nase ki toikaransete tokirete‐kiri? Inchuo tosangererekane amo, togende tosoe ase emechie egiteire chindwaki, erinde tokwere aroro. Omonene, Nyasae oito, otonacheire ekiina tosire, otoeire amaache abekire obosongo tonywe, ekiagera twakorire ebibe asare.
swahili: “Kwa nini tunaketi hapa? Kusanyikeni pamoja! Tukimbilie kwenye miji yenye maboma, tukaangamie huko! Kwa kuwa Bwana, Mungu wetu ametuhukumu kuangamia, na kutupa maji yenye sumu tunywe, kwa sababu tumemtenda dhambi.

english: We hoped for peace, but no good has come, for a time of healing, but there was only terror.
ekegusii: Nigo twasemeretie ng’a tonyore omorembe, korende amabe agacha. Tokagania togwenigwe, korende obwoba bogatochera.
swahili: Tulitegemea amani, lakini hakuna jema lililokuja, tulitegemea wakati wa kupona, lakini kulikuwa hofu tu.

english: The snorting of enemy horses is heard from Dan. At the sound of the neighing of mighty steeds, the whole land quakes. They come to devour the land and everything in it, the city and all who dwell in it.
ekegusii: Chibarasi chi’ababisa baito nigo chikwana korwa Dani, na ase amariogi ay’okwoga gwe chibarasi chiaberi, ense yonsi nigo ekonyegera. Nigo bagocha gosaria ense yaito na ebinto bireo; basarie omochie, basirie nabaanto bamenyeteo.
swahili: Mkoromo wa farasi za adui umesikika kuanzia Dani, kwa mlio wa madume yao ya farasi, nchi yote inatetemeka. Wamekuja kuangamiza nchi na vyote vilivyomo, mji na wote waishio ndani yake.”

english: “For behold, I will send snakes among you, vipers that cannot be charmed, and they will bite you,” declares the LORD. Jeremiah Weeps for His People
ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: “Rora nkobatomera nde ching’iti ching’enda inse chire nobosongo; amarubi atatangwe ase okoyaroga, nachirochio nachibarome.” Ogwechanda kwa Yeremia ase abanto baye
swahili: “Tazama, nitatuma nyoka wenye sumu kali katikati yenu, fira ambao hawawezi kulogwa, nao watawauma,” asema Bwana.

english: My sorrow is beyond healing; my heart is faint within me.
ekegusii: Obororo bwane nobonene mono, tibokogwenigwa. Narwarire ase enkoro yane ime.
swahili: Ee Mfariji wangu katika huzuni, moyo wangu umezimia ndani yangu.

english: Listen to the cry of the daughter of my people from a land far away: “Is the LORD no longer in Zion? Is her King no longer there?” “Why have they provoked Me to anger with their carved images, with their worthless foreign idols?”
ekegusii: Tegerera! Abanto baane nkorera bare korwa ase chinsemo chionsi chi’ense, bakoboria: “Inee! Omonene tari ase Sayoni? Omorwoti o Sayoni tari aroro?” Omonene nigo agoteeba; “Nase ki abanto bangechirie nabeire nendamwamu ase ogosasiima emegwekano yabo ebombire amo ne chinyasae chiabo chingeni?”
swahili: Sikia kilio cha watu wangu kutoka nchi ya mbali: “Je, Bwana hayuko Sayuni? Je, Mfalme wake hayuko tena huko?” “Kwa nini wamenikasirisha kwa vinyago vyao, kwa sanamu zao za kigeni zisizofaa?”

english: They will be exposed to the sun and moon, and to all the host of heaven which they have loved, served, followed, consulted, and worshiped. Their bones will not be gathered up or buried, but will become like dung lying on the ground.
ekegusii: Nasiarerwe inse y’erioba, na omotienyi ne ching’enang’eni chionsi, ebinto ebio abanto aba banchete gokorera, bakabirigia mono na kobitunyana, naende bakabisasiima. Amauga ayio tagosangererigwa amo, gose gotindekwa, korende nabe buna obwoyo bore ase riroba.
swahili: Itawekwa wazi kwa jua, na mwezi, na nyota zote za mbingu, ambazo walizipenda na kuzitumikia, na ambazo wamezifuata kutafuta ushauri na kuziabudu. Hawatakusanywa pamoja au kuzikwa, lakini watakuwa kama mavi yaliyotapakaa juu ya ardhi.

english: “The harvest has passed, the summer has ended, but we have not been saved.”
ekegusii: Abanto nigo bakorera: “Rigesa riaerire, egura gura yaerire, naintwe titotooregeti.”
swahili: “Mavuno yamepita, kiangazi kimekwisha, nasi hatujaokolewa.”

english: For the brokenness of the daughter of my people I am crushed. I mourn; horror has gripped me.
ekegusii: Ase engencho y’emechando y’abanto baane enkoro yane yachandekire. Nigo nkorera na kweumia, ekiagera naichoirwe nomoondoko.
swahili: Kwa kuwa watu wangu wamepondwa, nami nimepondeka pia; ninaomboleza, nayo hofu kuu imenishika.

english: Is there no balm in Gilead? Is no physician there? Why then has the health of the daughter of my people not been restored?
ekegusii: Inee! Amaguta akogwenia naborire Gileadi? Omorwaria tari aroro? Nase ki abanto baane bataragwenigwa?
swahili: Je, hakuna zeri ya kuponya katika Gileadi? Je, hakuna tabibu huko? Kwa nini basi hakuna uponyaji wa majeraha ya watu wangu?

english: And wherever I have banished them, the remnant of this evil family will choose death over life,” declares the LORD of Hosts.
ekegusii: Abanto abaratigare b’egesaku eke ekebe, baria bare moyo ase chinsemo chionsi ase nabaseretie gochia, mbaganie ogokwa kobua koba moyo. Inche Omonene bw’Emeganda nakwanire. Ebibe na egesusuro
swahili: Popote nitakapowafukuzia, mabaki wote wa kizazi hiki kiovu watatamani kufa kuliko kuishi, asema Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote.’ Dhambi Na Adhabu

english: So you are to tell them this is what the LORD says: “Do men fall and not get up again? Does one turn away and not return?
ekegusii: “Aye Yeremia, okwane nabarabwo, obateebie ng’a aya naro inche Omonene ngoteeba: Ekero abanto bakogwa, inee, tibari koimoka naende? Onye omonto oonchokire na otigire enchera, tari koonchoka oirana?
swahili: “Waambie, ‘Hivi ndivyo asemavyo Bwana: “ ‘Je, watu wanapoanguka hawainuki? Je, mtu anapopotea harudi?

english: Why then have these people turned away? Why does Jerusalem always turn away? They cling to deceit; they refuse to return.
ekegusii: Nase ki inwe abanto ba Yerusalemu mogendererete gontiga iga? Mwancheranire nokong’ainererigwa, na mwangire kong’iranera.
swahili: Kwa nini basi watu hawa walipotea? Kwa nini Yerusalemu inapotea kila mara? Wanangʼangʼania udanganyifu na wanakataa kurudi.

english: I have listened and heard; they do not speak what is right. No one repents of his wickedness, asking, ‘What have I done?’ Everyone has pursued his own course like a horse charging into battle.
ekegusii: Nabeire ngotegerera buya mono, korende timori gokwana ekeene. Onde tari ogweitia na koonchoka atige obobe bwaye na koboria: Ngento ki nakorire? Kera omonto nigo agendererete gokora buna anchete, ogwekanire ebarasi ekominyoka gochia ase okorwana esegi.
swahili: Nimewasikiliza kwa makini, lakini hawataki kusema lililo sawa. Hakuna anayetubia makosa yake akisema, “Nimefanya nini?” Kila mmoja hufuata njia yake mwenyewe kama farasi anayekwenda vitani.

english: Even the stork in the sky knows her appointed seasons. The turtledove, the swift, and the thrush keep their time of migration, but My people do not know the requirements of the LORD.
ekegusii: Nonya ne riagonga nigo rimanyete chingaki chiaye, boigo riruma, na egesingororo, na ekeongo nigo chikomanyereria chingaki chiabo chi’okoirana, korende abanto baane tibamanyeti emeroberio inche Omonene nachiikire.
swahili: Hata korongo aliyeko angani anayajua majira yake yaliyoamriwa, nao njiwa, mbayuwayu na koikoi hufuata majira yao ya kurudi. Lakini watu wangu hawajui Bwana anachotaka kwao.

english: How can you say, ‘We are wise, and the Law of the LORD is with us,’ when in fact the lying pen of the scribes has produced a deception?
ekegusii: Naki moranyare goteeba ng’a nabang’aini more, naende ng’a mobwate amachiiko o Omonene ase egati yaino? Rora aborokia b’amariko abare abang’ainereria barikire amachiiko o Omonene na koyaonchorana ase okong’ainereria.
swahili: “ ‘Mwawezaje kusema, “Sisi tuna busara kwa sababu tunayo sheria ya Bwana,” wakati ambapo kwa hakika kalamu ya uongo ya waandishi imeandika kwa udanganyifu?

english: The wise will be put to shame; they will be dismayed and trapped. Since they have rejected the word of the LORD, what wisdom do they really have?
ekegusii: Abanto abang’aini mbasookigwe mbaichanigwe na gotang’ang’a, ekiagera bangire ring’ana ri’Omonene. Mbong’aini ki bore ase bare?
swahili: Wenye hekima wataaibika, watafadhaika na kunaswa. Kwa kuwa wamelikataa neno la Bwana, hiyo hekima waliyo nayo ni ya namna gani?

english: Oh, that my head were a spring of water, and my eyes a fountain of tears! I would weep day and night over the slain daughter of my people.
ekegusii: Onye ndiria omotwe one ore koba buna ensoko y’amaache, na amaiso aane buna orooche rw’amariga, nigo nare korera omobaso na obotuko ase engencho y’ogoitwa kw’abaanto baane bakwete.
swahili: Laiti kichwa changu kingekuwa chemchemi ya maji na macho yangu yangekuwa kisima cha machozi! Ningelia usiku na mchana kwa kuuawa kwa watu wangu.

english: I will take up a weeping and wailing for the mountains, a dirge over the wilderness pasture, for they have been scorched so no one passes through, and the lowing of cattle is not heard. Both the birds of the air and the beasts have fled; they have gone away.
ekegusii: “Nindere ase engencho y’ebitunwa, ninyeumie ase engencho y’amarisia e chirooro, ekiagera biomire na gosareka. Monto onde tagoeta ase egati yabo, na amariogi e chiombe chikwana tari koigugwa; chinyoni ne ching’iti chi’orosana chiatamire chiachiire.
swahili: Nitalia na kuomboleza kwa ajili ya milima na kuomboleza kuhusu malisho ya jangwani. Yamekuwa ukiwa, wala hakuna apitaye humo, milio ya ngʼombe haisikiki. Ndege wa angani wametoroka na wanyama wamekimbia.

english: “And I will make Jerusalem a heap of rubble, a haunt for jackals; and I will make the cities of Judah a desolation, without inhabitant.”
ekegusii: “Ninsarie Yerusalemu obe ebinge chi’amaturi na amakuruma e chisese chi’orosana. Ninsarie emechie ya Yuda ebe bosa aase omonto atanyare komenya.”
swahili: “Nitaifanya Yerusalemu lundo la magofu, makao ya mbweha; nami nitaifanya miji ya Yuda kuwa ukiwa ili asiwepo atakayeishi humo.”

english: Who is the man wise enough to understand this? To whom has the mouth of the LORD spoken, that he may explain it? Why is the land destroyed and scorched like a desert, so no one can pass through it?
ekegusii: Aye Omonene ng’ai omonto omong’aini are oyoranyare komanya engencho y’amang’ana aya? Ning’o aye Omonene gwakwanire nere, oyio oranyare goteeba egekogera ense yabeire ritongo, na yasarekire buna erooro omonto atanyare goeta ase egati yaye?
swahili: Ni mtu yupi aliye na hekima ya kutosha ayaelewe haya? Ni nani aliyefundishwa na Bwana awezaye kuyaeleza haya? Kwa nini nchi imeharibiwa na kufanywa ukiwa kama jangwa ambapo hakuna awezaye kupita?

english: And the LORD answered, “It is because they have forsaken My law, which I set before them; they have not walked in it or obeyed My voice.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo akoiraneria: “Aya nigo akorekanire, ekiagera batigire ogochika kwane nabaete, bangire konyigwera na kobwatia chinchera chiane.
swahili: Bwana akasema, “Ni kwa sababu wameiacha sheria yangu, niliyoiweka mbele yao: hawajaniheshimu mimi wala kufuata sheria yangu.

english: Instead, they have followed the stubbornness of their hearts and gone after the Baals, as their fathers taught them.”
ekegusii: Basaririe na babwatirie ebirengererio bie chisokoro chiabo, batunyanire chinyasae chikorokwa Baali, buna chisokoro chiabo chiaborokereretie.
swahili: Badala yake wamefuata ukaidi wa mioyo yao, wamefuata Mabaali, kama vile baba zao walivyowafundisha.”

english: Therefore this is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: “Behold, I will feed this people wormwood and give them poisoned water to drink.
ekegusii: Ase ayio, aya nar’Omonene bw’Emeganda, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, agoteeba: Rora, nae abanto aba ebimeri ebiroro barie, na amaache are nobosongo banywe.
swahili: Kwa hiyo, hivi ndivyo asemavyo Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, Mungu wa Israeli: “Tazama, nitawafanya watu hawa wale chakula kichungu na kunywa maji yenye sumu.

english: I will scatter them among the nations that neither they nor their fathers have known, and I will send a sword after them until I have finished them off.”
ekegusii: Nimbaserie gochia ase ebisaku ebio barabwo gose chisokoro chiabo chitabimanyete, nimbatomere abasikari bare nemioro baabaite baabasirie kegima.” Abanto ba Yerusalemu bakorera ng’a bakonywe
swahili: Nitawatawanya katika mataifa ambayo wao wala baba zao hawakuwajua, nikiwafuata kwa upanga mpaka niwe nimewaangamiza kabisa.”

english: This is what the LORD of Hosts says: “Take note, and summon the wailing women; send for the most skillful among them.
ekegusii: Aya nar’Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteeba: “Rengereria amang’ana aya! Rangeria abakungu abamanyete kobokia amagombo bachiche! Toma abanto barangerie abakungu abegerete ayio bachiche!”
swahili: Hivi ndivyo asemavyo Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote: “Fikiri sasa! Waite wanawake waombolezao waje, waite wale walio na ustadi kuliko wote.

english: Let them come quickly and take up a lament over us, that our eyes may overflow with tears, and our eyelids may gush with water.
ekegusii: Abakungu abwo tiga baayerere gocha barere na kobokia amagombo ase tore, erinde amariga aiteke korwa ase amaiso aito, na amaiso aito aichorwe naro.
swahili: Nao waje upesi na kutuombolezea, mpaka macho yetu yafurike machozi na vijito vya maji vitoke kwenye kope zetu.

english: For the sound of wailing is heard from Zion: ‘How devastated we are! How great is our shame! For we have abandoned the land because our dwellings have been torn down.’”
ekegusii: Eriogi ri’okorera riaigwekanire korwa Sayoni, rikobora: Twasirigwe kegima! Twanyorire obosooku obonene. Goika torue ase ense yaito, ekiagera ababisa batagoire chinyomba chiaito.
swahili: Sauti ya kuomboleza imesikika kutoka Sayuni: ‘Tazama jinsi tulivyoangamizwa! Tazama jinsi aibu yetu ilivyo kubwa! Ni lazima tuihame nchi yetu kwa sababu nyumba zetu zimekuwa magofu.’ ”

english: If only I had a traveler’s lodge in the wilderness, I would abandon my people and depart from them, for they are all adulterers, a crowd of faithless people.
ekegusii: Onye ndiria nare konyora aase ngotimokera ase erooro, anga nagenda aare, ntige abanto baane, ekiagera bonsi nabatomani, bagosasiima emegwekano; barabwo nomoganda bw’abasigaani.
swahili: Laiti ningekuwa na nyumba ya kukaa wasafiri jangwani, ningewaacha watu wangu na kwenda mbali nao, kwa kuwa wote ni wazinzi, kundi la watu wadanganyifu.

english: Now, O women, hear the word of the LORD. Open your ears to the word of His mouth. Teach your daughters to wail, and one another to lament.
ekegusii: Inwe abakungu, igwera ring’ana ri’Omonene; amato aino tiga aigwe ring’ana akwanire. Orokereria abaiseke baino bamanye kobokia amagombo, na kera omokungu orokererie omogisangio oye amanye kweumia.
swahili: Basi, enyi wanawake, sikieni neno la Bwana; fungueni masikio yenu msikie maneno ya kinywa chake. Wafundisheni binti zenu kuomboleza; fundishaneni kila mmoja na mwenzake maombolezo.

english: For death has climbed in through our windows; it has entered our fortresses to cut off the children from the streets, the young men from the town squares.
ekegusii: Amakweri aeteire ase ebibao biaito, asoire ase chinyomba chiaito chi’obonene, aitire abana ase chinchera, na abasae ase chichiiro.
swahili: Mauti imeingia ndani kupitia madirishani, imeingia kwenye majumba yetu ya fahari; imewakatilia mbali watoto katika barabara na vijana waume kutoka viwanja vya miji.

english: Declare that this is what the LORD says: “The corpses of men will fall like dung upon the open field, like newly cut grain behind the reaper, with no one to gather it.”
ekegusii: Kwana: “Aya nar’Omonene agoteeba: Abanto mbakwe, na emebere yabo esiarerwe aande onsi, ebe buna esike ase emegondo, na buna emesaima yatigetwe nabagesi, onde takoyesangereria.”
swahili: Sema, “Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana: “ ‘Maiti za wanaume zitalala kama mavi katika mashamba, kama malundo ya nafaka nyuma ya mvunaji, wala hakuna anayekusanya.’ ”

english: This is what the LORD says: “Let not the wise man boast in his wisdom, nor the strong man in his strength, nor the wealthy man in his riches.
ekegusii: Aya nar’Omonene agoteeba: “Omonto omong’aini tabaisa gwetogeria obong’aini bwaye, gose oyore omonene obonene bwaye, gose oyore omonda obonda bwaye.
swahili: Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana: “Mwenye hekima asijisifu katika hekima yake, au mwenye nguvu ajisifu katika nguvu zake, wala tajiri ajisifu katika utajiri wake,

english: But let him who boasts boast in this, that he understands and knows Me, that I am the LORD, who exercises loving devotion, justice and righteousness on the earth— for I delight in these things,” declares the LORD.
ekegusii: Korende onye omonto origetie gwetogia, tiga etogie ng’a namanyete inche, ekiagera inche Omonene nigo inde nobwanchani botari koera. Ngokora ayare ay’ekeene na oboronge ase ense, ekiagera ayio naro akongokia. Ninche Omonene nakwanire.”
swahili: lakini yeye ajisifuye, na ajisifu kwa sababu hili: kwamba ananifahamu na kunijua mimi, kwamba mimi ndimi Bwana, nitendaye wema, hukumu na haki duniani, kwa kuwa napendezwa na haya,” asema Bwana.

english: “Behold, the days are coming,” declares the LORD, “when I will punish all who are circumcised yet uncircumcised:
ekegusii: Naende Omonene nigo agoteeba: “Rora, amatuko ngocha are, inche ndabae egesusuro abanto baria bonsi baarogete, ko nonya nabo nigo bare buna abatarogeti.
swahili: “Siku zinakuja, nitakapowaadhibu wale wote ambao wametahiriwa kimwili tu, asema Bwana,

english: Egypt, Judah, Edom, Ammon, Moab, and all the inhabitants of the desert who clip the hair of their temples. For all these nations are uncircumcised, and the whole house of Israel is uncircumcised in heart.”
ekegusii: Abanto abwo nabwo aba: Abamisiri, na Abayuda, na Abaedomu, na Abaamoni, na Abamoabu, amo nabaanto bonsi bamenyete ase erooro, abwo bakonacha chitukia chiabo mesia. Abanto aba bonsi b’ebisaku tibarogeti, boigo na Abaisraeli bonsi tibarogeti ase chinkoro chiabo ime.”
swahili: yaani Misri, Yuda, Edomu, Amoni, Moabu na wote wanaoishi jangwani sehemu za mbali. Kwa maana mataifa haya yote hayakutahiriwa mioyo yao, nayo nyumba yote ya Israeli haikutahiriwa.”

english: “They bend their tongues like bows; lies prevail over truth in the land. For they proceed from evil to evil, and they do not take Me into account,” declares the LORD.
ekegusii: Abanto abwo nigo bagokumba chimeme chiabo buna amata; oborimo nigo bomentete koba obonge kobua ekeene ase ense yabo. Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: “Nigo bagendererete komenta ebibe ase ebibe binde, gose tibamanyeti inche.”
swahili: “Huweka tayari ndimi zao kama upinde, ili kurusha uongo; wamekuwa na nguvu katika nchi lakini si katika ukweli. Wanatoka dhambi moja hadi nyingine, hawanitambui mimi,” asema Bwana.

english: “Let everyone guard against his neighbor; do not trust any brother, for every brother deals craftily, and every friend spreads slander.
ekegusii: Kera omonto goika erite korwa ase omogisangio oye, gose onde tabaisa kwegena oyomwabo, ekiagera kera oyomo nomoitania, are na kera omogisangio nigo agoetanana gokwana amang’ana ’obogenki.
swahili: “Jihadhari na rafiki zako; usiwaamini ndugu zako. Kwa kuwa kila ndugu ni mdanganyifu, na kila rafiki ni msingiziaji.

english: Each one betrays his friend; no one tells the truth. They have taught their tongues to lie; they wear themselves out committing iniquity.
ekegusii: Kera omonto nigo akong’aina omogisangio oye; nonya noyomo tari gokwana ekeene, ekiagera banaririe chimeme chiabo gokwana oborimo. Nigo bagokwana oborimo goika berosirie ase ogokora amabe.
swahili: Rafiki humdanganya rafiki, hakuna yeyote asemaye kweli. Wamefundisha ndimi zao kudanganya, wanajichosha wenyewe katika kutenda dhambi.

english: You dwell in the midst of deception; in their deceit they refuse to know Me,” declares the LORD.
ekegusii: Omonene oteebire ng’a ase omenyete abanto nigo bagokora oborianania ase oborianania bonde. Na obong’ainereria ase obong’ainereria bonde, bangire konyigwera.
swahili: Unakaa katikati ya udanganyifu; katika udanganyifu wao wanakataa kunitambua mimi,” asema Bwana.

english: Therefore this is what the LORD of Hosts says: “Behold, I will refine them and test them, for what else can I do because of the daughter of My people?
ekegusii: Ase ayio, aya nar’Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteeba: “Nimbanyititore ase okobachena na kobateema. Ngento ki rende ndanyare gokorera abanto baane?
swahili: Kwa hiyo hili ndilo asemalo Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote: “Tazama, nitawasafisha na kuwajaribu, kwani ni nini kingine niwezacho kufanya kwa sababu ya dhambi ya watu wangu?

english: Their tongues are deadly arrows; they speak deception. With his mouth a man speaks peace to his neighbor, but in his heart he sets a trap for him.
ekegusii: Chimeme chiabo nigo chinga buna chinsara chigoita, ekiagera nigo chigokwana amang’ana ’obong’ainereria. Kera omonto nigo agokwana amang’ana ’omorembe ase omogisangio oye ase ebikoba igoro, korende ime ase enkoro yaye nigo akoroberia komotegera omotego.
swahili: Ndimi zao ni mshale wenye sumu, hunena kwa udanganyifu. Kwa kinywa chake kila mmoja huzungumza maneno mazuri na jirani yake, lakini moyoni mwake humtegea mtego.

english: Should I not punish them for these things? declares the LORD. Should I not avenge Myself on such a nation as this?”
ekegusii: Inee! Tinkobaa egesusuro ase engencho y’amang’ana ayio? Tinkweruseria egesiomba ase egesaku kenga buna eke?” Nab’Omonene akwanire.
swahili: Je, nisiwaadhibu kwa ajili ya jambo hili?” asema Bwana. “Je, nisijilipizie kisasi kwa taifa kama hili?”

english: “Truly, truly, I tell you, whoever does not enter the sheepfold by the gate, but climbs in some other way, is a thief and a robber.
ekegusii: “Ekeene, ekeene, nabateebirie: Oyotasoereti egesieri ki’eero ye ching’ondi, korende aetere aao, oyio nomoibi naende nomokurumi.
swahili: “Amin, amin nawaambia, yeye asiyeingia katika zizi la kondoo kwa kupitia kwenye lango, lakini akwea kuingia ndani kwa njia nyingine, ni mwizi na mnyangʼanyi.

english: The thief comes only to steal and kill and destroy. I have come that they may have life, and have it in all its fullness.
ekegusii: Omoibi tagocha, otatiga aibe, na konyenya, na gosaria; inche nigo nachete erio babe nobogima, naende babe naborobwo ase obonge.
swahili: Mwizi huja ili aibe, kuua na kuangamiza. Mimi nimekuja ili wapate uzima kisha wawe nao tele.

english: I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down His life for the sheep.
ekegusii: Inche ninche Omorisia omuya; omorisia omuya nigo akorua obogima bwaye ase engencho ye ching’ondi.
swahili: “Mimi ndimi mchungaji mwema. Mchungaji mwema huutoa uhai wake kwa ajili ya kondoo.

english: The hired hand is not the shepherd, and the sheep are not his own. When he sees the wolf coming, he abandons the sheep and runs away. Then the wolf pounces on them and scatters the flock.
ekegusii: Omonto orikire, tari ere omorisia, gose ching’ondi tichiri echiaye; gakorora esese y’orosana egocha, nigo agotiga ching’ondi, otama, na esese y’orosana yachisakora, na gochiserebania.
swahili: Mtu wa kuajiriwa sio mchungaji mwenye kondoo. Amwonapo mbwa mwitu akija, yeye hukimbia na kuwaacha kondoo. Naye mbwa mwitu hulishambulia kundi na kulitawanya.

english: The man runs away because he is a hired servant and is unconcerned for the sheep.
ekegusii: Ere nigo agotama ekiagera nomorikwa, gose tarengerereti amang’ana e ching’ondi.
swahili: Yeye hukimbia kwa sababu ameajiriwa wala hawajali kondoo.

english: I am the good shepherd. I know My sheep and My sheep know Me,
ekegusii: Inche ninche omorisia omuya, na echire echiane ninchimanyete,
swahili: “Mimi ndimi mchungaji mwema. Ninawajua kondoo wangu nao kondoo wangu wananijua.

english: just as the Father knows Me and I know the Father. And I lay down My life for the sheep.
ekegusii: buna Tata amanyete inche, na inche nimomanyete Tata, na obogima bwane naborure ase engencho ye ching’ondi.
swahili: Kama vile Baba anavyonijua mimi, nami ninavyomjua Baba, nami nautoa uhai wangu kwa ajili ya kondoo.

english: I have other sheep that are not of this fold. I must bring them in as well, and they will listen to My voice. Then there will be one flock and one shepherd.
ekegusii: Naende ching’ondi chinde mbwate, chitari chie riicho eri, na chirochio nabo engwenerete gochirenta, na eriogi riane nachiriigwe. Igo nachibe riicho erimo na omorisia oyomo.
swahili: Ninao kondoo wengine ambao si wa zizi hili, inanipasa kuwaleta, nao wataisikia sauti yangu, hivyo patakuwa na kundi moja na mchungaji mmoja.

english: The reason the Father loves Me is that I lay down My life in order to take it up again.
ekegusii: Ase ayio Tata nanyanchete, ekiagera narure obogima bwane, erinde inyare koboirania naende.
swahili: Baba yangu ananipenda kwa kuwa ninautoa uhai wangu ili niupate tena.

english: No one takes it from Me, but I lay it down of My own accord. I have authority to lay it down and authority to take it up again. This charge I have received from My Father.”
ekegusii: Tari omonto okobonduera, korende ninche omonyene naborure. Ninde nokobua koborua; naende ninde nokobua koboirania. Ogochika oko nigo nakonyorire ase Tata one.”
swahili: Hakuna mtu aniondoleaye uhai wangu, bali ninautoa kwa hiari yangu mwenyewe. Ninao uwezo wa kuutoa uhai wangu na pia ninao uwezo wa kuutwaa tena. Amri hii nimepewa na Baba yangu.”

english: Again there was division among the Jews because of Jesus’ message.
ekegusii: Erio gokaba naende ogwatananekana ase Abayahudi ase engencho y’amang’ana aya.
swahili: Kwa maneno haya Wayahudi waligawanyika.

english: But the one who enters by the gate is the shepherd of the sheep.
ekegusii: Korende oyogosoera gesieri oyio nomorisia bwe ching’ondi.
swahili: Yeye anayeingia kwa kupitia kwenye lango ndiye mchungaji wa kondoo.

english: Many of them said, “He is demon-possessed and insane. Why would you listen to Him?”
ekegusii: Abange babo bakaboora, “Nigo abwatire nekerecha, naende nigo are ebarimo; nase ki mokomotegerera?”
swahili: Wengi wao wakasema, “Huyu amepagawa na pepo mchafu, naye amechanganyikiwa.”

english: But others replied, “These are not the words of a man possessed by a demon. Can a demon open the eyes of the blind?” Jesus at the Feast of Dedication
ekegusii: Abande bakaboora “Amang’ana aya tari ay’omonto obwatire nekerecha. Inee! Ekerecha nkenyare koramokia ’emeuko amaiso?” Yeso ore ase Rituko Rinene ri’okoinyora okoigorwa na ogosaberwa gwe Hekalu ya Yerusalemu
swahili: Wengine wakasema, “Haya si maneno ya mtu aliyepagawa na pepo mchafu. Je, pepo mchafu aweza kufungua macho ya kipofu?” Yesu Akataliwa Na Wayahudi

english: At that time the Feast of Dedication took place in Jerusalem. It was winter,
ekegusii: Ndiarenge Rituko Rinene ri’okoinyora okoigorwa na ogosaberwa gwe Hekalu aria Yerusalemu.
swahili: Wakati huo ilikuwa Sikukuu ya Kuwekwa wakfu kwa Hekalu huko Yerusalemu, nao ulikuwa wakati wa majira ya baridi.

english: and Jesus was walking in the temple courts in Solomon’s Colonnade.
ekegusii: Nigo kiarenge ekero ki’obokendu, na Yeso nigo arenge gotaara ase Hekalu ime, ase egoora ya Sulemani.
swahili: Naye Yesu alikuwa akitembea ndani ya Hekalu katika ukumbi wa Solomoni.

english: So the Jews gathered around Him and demanded, “How long will You keep us in suspense? If You are the Christ, tell us plainly.”
ekegusii: Erio Abayahudi bakamoetanana, bakamobooria, “Ngoika ririri oratoichanie emioyo yaito? Onye naye Kristo, toteebia maiso marore.”
swahili: Wayahudi wakamkusanyikia wakamuuliza, “Utatuweka katika hali ya mashaka mpaka lini? Kama wewe ndiye Kristo tuambie waziwazi.”

english: “I already told you,” Jesus replied, “but you did not believe. The works I do in My Father’s name testify on My behalf.
ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, “Nabatebirie, na inwe timori kwegena; emeremo eye ngokora ase erieta ria Tata one, nero ekombera kirori.
swahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Nimewaambia, lakini hamwamini. Mambo ninayoyatenda kwa jina la Baba yangu yananishuhudia.

english: But because you are not My sheep, you refuse to believe.
ekegusii: Korende inwe timori kwegena, ekiagera timori abamo ase ching’ondi chiane.
swahili: Lakini hamwamini, kwa sababu ninyi si wa kundi la kondoo wangu.

english: My sheep listen to My voice; I know them, and they follow Me.
ekegusii: Ching’ondi chiane nigo chikoigwa eriogi riane, na inche ninchimanyete, na chirochio nigo chigontunyana;
swahili: Kondoo wangu huisikia sauti yangu nami nawajua, nao hunifuata,

english: I give them eternal life, and they will never perish. No one can snatch them out of My hand.
ekegusii: inche nachieire obogima bwa kare na kare, na chirochio tichigosira nonya ng’ake, nonya nomonto tagochitaboria korwa ase okoboko kwane.
swahili: nami ninawapa uzima wa milele, hawataangamia kamwe wala hakuna mtu atakayewapokonya kutoka mikono yangu.

english: My Father who has given them to Me is greater than all. No one can snatch them out of My Father’s hand.
ekegusii: Tata one oching’eire nomonene kobua bonsi, na onde takonyara gochitaboria korwa ase okoboko gwa Tata.
swahili: Baba yangu aliyenipa hawa ni mkuu kuliko wote na hakuna awezaye kuwapokonya kutoka mikononi mwake.

english: The gatekeeper opens the gate for him, and the sheep listen for his voice. He calls his own sheep by name and leads them out.
ekegusii: Omorendi bw’egesieri nigo akomoigorera, ne ching’ondi nigo chikoigwa eriogi riaye; ere nigo akorangeria ching’ondi chiaye ase amarieta abo na gochiira isiko.
swahili: Mlinzi humfungulia lango na kondoo huisikia sauti yake. Huwaita kondoo wake kwa majina yao na kuwatoa nje ya zizi.

english: I and the Father are one.”
ekegusii: Inche na Tata nigo tore oyomo.” Obobisa bw’Abayahudi
swahili: Mimi na Baba yangu tu umoja.”

english: At this, the Jews again picked up stones to stone Him.
ekegusii: Erio Abayahudi bakaimokia amagena naende, erinde bamoake.
swahili: Kwa mara nyingine Wayahudi wakainua mawe ili wampige nayo,

english: But Jesus responded, “I have shown you many good works from the Father. For which of these do you stone Me?”
ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, “Naborokirie emeremo emiya emenge erwete ase Tata; nereri ase emeremo eyio mokong’akera amagena?”
swahili: lakini Yesu akawaambia, “Nimewaonyesha miujiza mingi mikubwa kutoka kwa Baba yangu. Ni ipi katika hiyo mnataka kunipiga mawe?”

english: “We are not stoning You for any good work,” said the Jews, “but for blasphemy, because You, who are a man, declare Yourself to be God.”
ekegusii: Abayahudi bakamoiraneria, “Titogokoaka amagena ase emeremo emiya, korende nase okorama, ekiagera aye nomonto ogwekora omonyene ng’a naye Nyasae.”
swahili: Wayahudi wakamjibu, “Hatukupigi mawe kwa sababu ya mambo mema uliyotenda, bali ni kwa kuwa umekufuru. Wewe ingawa ni mwanadamu unajifanya kuwa Mungu.”

english: Jesus replied, “Is it not written in your Law: ‘I have said you are gods’?
ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, “Tarikiri ase amachiiko aino ng’a: Inche nateebete ng’a inwe nigo more chinyasae?
swahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Je, haikuandikwa katika Sheria ya kwamba, ‘Nimesema kuwa, ninyi ni miungu?’

english: If he called them gods to whom the word of God came—and the Scripture cannot be broken—
ekegusii: Onye orogete baria chinyasae, abacheretwe ne ring’ana ria Nyasae (na amariiko takonyara gosareka),
swahili: Kama aliwaita ‘miungu,’ wale ambao neno la Mungu liliwafikia, nayo Maandiko hayawezi kutanguka,

english: then what about the One whom the Father sanctified and sent into the world? How then can you accuse Me of blasphemy for stating that I am the Son of God?
ekegusii: inee, nigo mogoteeba igoro yaye, ere oyo Tata aatananete akamotoma ase ense: Nkorama are, ekiagera nateba: Inche n’Omwana o Nyasae?
swahili: je, mwawezaje kusema kwamba yule ambaye Baba amemweka wakfu na kumtuma ulimwenguni anakufuru, kwa sababu nilisema, ‘Mimi ni Mwana wa Mungu?’

english: If I am not doing the works of My Father, then do not believe Me.
ekegusii: Onye tindi gokora emeremo ya Tata one, timonyegena.
swahili: Ikiwa sifanyi kazi za Baba yangu, basi msiniamini,

english: But if I am doing them, even though you do not believe Me, believe the works themselves, so that you may know and understand that the Father is in Me, and I am in the Father.”
ekegusii: Korende konda yekore, nonya timonyegeneti inche, egene emeremo eria, monyare komanya na kwegena ng’a Tata nigo are ime yane, na inche ime ase Tata.”
swahili: lakini ikiwa nazifanya kazi za Mungu, hata kama hamniamini mimi ziaminini hizo kazi, ili mpate kujua na kuelewa kwamba Baba yu ndani yangu, nami ndani yake.”

english: At this, they tried again to seize Him, but He escaped their grasp. John’s Testimony Confirmed
ekegusii: Bakarigia eria kabere komobwata, korende akarua ase amaboko abo.
swahili: Ndipo wakajaribu kumkamata kwa mara nyingine, lakini akaponyoka kutoka mikononi mwao.

english: When he has brought out all his own, he goes on ahead of them, and his sheep follow him because they know his voice.
ekegusii: Gakorusia isiko ching’ondi echire echiaye, nigo agochitang’ana, ne ching’ondi nigo chikomotunyana, ekiagera nchimanyete eriogi riaye.
swahili: Akiisha kuwatoa wote nje, hutangulia mbele yao na kondoo humfuata kwa kuwa wanaijua sauti yake.

english: Then Jesus went back across the Jordan to the place where John had first been baptizing, and He stayed there.
ekegusii: Akagenda naende ng’umbu ya Yorodani goika aase aria Yohana arenge kobatisera ritang’ani, akabeera aroro.
swahili: Akaenda tena ngʼambo ya Mto Yordani mpaka mahali pale ambapo Yohana alikuwa akibatiza hapo awali, naye akakaa huko.

english: Many came to Him and said, “Although John never performed a sign, everything he said about this man was true.”
ekegusii: Abanto abange bakamochiera, bakaboora, “Yohana takorete egekone kende gionsi, korende onsi aya Yohana ateebete igoro y’omonto oyo nigo are ay’ekeene.”
swahili: Watu wengi wakamjia, nao wakawa wakisema, “Yohana hakufanya muujiza wowote, lakini kila jambo alilosema kumhusu huyu mtu ni kweli.”

english: And many in that place believed in Jesus.
ekegusii: Abange bakamwegena aroro.
swahili: Nao wengi wakamwamini Yesu huko.

english: But they will never follow a stranger; in fact, they will flee from him because they do not recognize his voice.”
ekegusii: Omonto omoao tichikomotunyana nonya ng’ake, korende nigo chiramotame, ekiagera tichimanyeti eriogi ri’abaanto abaao.”
swahili: Lakini kondoo hawatamfuata mgeni bali watamkimbia, kwa sababu hawaijui sauti ya mgeni.”

english: Jesus spoke to them using this illustration, but they did not understand what He was telling them.
ekegusii: Omoreng’anio oyo Yeso akabateebia, korende barabwo tibamanyete amang’ana ayio abateebeetie. Omorisia omuya
swahili: Yesu alitumia mfano huu, lakini wao hawakuelewa hayo aliyokuwa akiwaambia.

english: So He said to them again, “Truly, truly, I tell you, I am the gate for the sheep.
ekegusii: Erio Yeso akabateebia naende, “Ekeene, ekeene, nabateebirie: Ninche inde egesieri gie ching’ondi.
swahili: Kwa hiyo Yesu akasema nao tena akawaambia, “Amin, amin nawaambia, mimi ndimi lango la kondoo.

english: All who came before Me were thieves and robbers, but the sheep did not listen to them.
ekegusii: Bonsi abantang’anerete nabaibi na abakurumi, korende ching’ondi tichiabaigwete.
swahili: Wote walionitangulia ni wevi na wanyangʼanyi, lakini kondoo hawakuwasikia.

english: I am the gate. If anyone enters through Me, he will be saved. He will come in and go out and find pasture.
ekegusii: Ninche inde egesieri; omonto karasoe goetera ase ’nde, natooreke, nasoe na gosoka, na konyora oborisia.
swahili: Mimi ndimi lango, yeyote anayeingia zizini kwa kupitia kwangu ataokoka, ataingia na kutoka, naye atapata malisho.

english: At this time a man named Lazarus was sick. He lived in Bethany, the village of Mary and her sister Martha.
ekegusii: Nabo omonto gete narenge omorwaire, erieta riaye Lazaro o Bethania, omonto bw’omochie o Mariamu na Martha mosubati omwabo.
swahili: Basi mtu mmoja jina lake Lazaro alikuwa mgonjwa. Yeye alikuwa akiishi Bethania kijiji cha Maria na Martha dada zake.

english: But if anyone walks at night, he will stumble, because he has no light.”
ekegusii: Korende omonto karagende botuko, igo akogochwa, ekiagera omobaso tori ime yaye.”
swahili: Lakini wale watembeao usiku hujikwaa kwa sababu hakuna nuru ndani yao.”

english: After He had said this, He told them, “Our friend Lazarus has fallen asleep, but I am going there to wake him up.”
ekegusii: Agakwana aya; erio magega ase aya akabateebia, “Lazaro omosani oito orarire, korende nkogenda nde inyare komotura.”
swahili: Baada ya kusema haya, Yesu akawaambia, “Rafiki yetu Lazaro amelala, lakini naenda kumwamsha.”

english: His disciples replied, “Lord, if he is sleeping, he will get better.”
ekegusii: Aborokigwa baye bakamoteebia, “Omonene, onye orarire, nagwene.”
swahili: Wanafunzi wakamwambia, “Bwana, kama amelala usingizi ataamka.”

english: They thought that Jesus was talking about actual sleep, but He was speaking about the death of Lazarus.
ekegusii: Korende Yeso nigo akwanete amang’ana ’amakweri aye; na barabwo bagakaga ng’a nigo agokwana amang’ana y’okorara chitoro.
swahili: Hata hivyo, Yesu alikuwa anazungumzia kuwa Lazaro amekufa, lakini wanafunzi wake hawakuelewa, walidhani kwamba anasema Lazaro amelala usingizi tu.

english: So Jesus told them plainly, “Lazarus is dead,
ekegusii: Erio agwo Yeso akabateebia maiso marore, “Lazaro okuure.
swahili: Kwa hiyo Yesu akawaambia waziwazi, “Lazaro amekufa.

english: and for your sake I am glad I was not there, so that you may believe. But let us go to him.”
ekegusii: Na inche nagokire ase engencho yaino, ekiagera ntarenge aroro, erinde monyare kwegena. Korende bono togende asare.”
swahili: Hata hivyo nafurahi kwa kuwa sikuwepo huko kabla ya Lazaro kufa, ili mpate kuamini. Lakini sasa twendeni kwake.”

english: Then Thomas called Didymus said to his fellow disciples, “Let us also go, so that we may die with Him.” Jesus Comforts Martha and Mary
ekegusii: Nabo Thomas, ore korokwa Barongo, agateebia aborokigwa bamwabo, “Togende naintwe, tokwe amo nere.”
swahili: Tomaso aliyeitwa Pacha akawaambia wanafunzi wenzake, “Sisi nasi twendeni tukafe pamoja naye.” Yesu Ndiye Ufufuo Na Uzima

english: When Jesus arrived, He found that Lazarus had already spent four days in the tomb.
ekegusii: Erio Yeso agachia goika aroro akanyora Lazaro ng’a oikire koba ase embeera amatuko ane.
swahili: Yesu alipowasili huko alikuta Lazaro amekuwa kaburini siku nne.

english: Now Bethany was near Jerusalem, a little less than two miles away,
ekegusii: Bethania nigo orenge ang’e na Yerusalemu, koreng’ana chimaeli ibere.
swahili: Basi Bethania ulikuwa karibu na Yerusalemu umbali wa karibu maili mbili,

english: and many of the Jews had come to Martha and Mary to console them in the loss of their brother.
ekegusii: Na abanto abange ase Abayahudi bagacha ase Martha na Mariamu, erinde baabaremie ase engencho y’ogokwa kw’oyomwabo.
swahili: na Wayahudi wengi walikuwa wamekuja kuwafariji Martha na Maria kwa ajili ya kufiwa na ndugu yao.

english: (Mary, whose brother Lazarus was sick, was to anoint the Lord with perfume and wipe His feet with her hair.)
ekegusii: Mariamu nere oyo oagete Omonene amaguta na komotinyia amagoro aye netukia yaye. Bono Lazaro momura omwabo nigo arenge omorwaire.
swahili: Huyu Maria, ambaye Lazaro kaka yake alikuwa mgonjwa, ndiye yule ambaye alimpaka Bwana mafuta na kuifuta miguu yake kwa nywele zake.

english: So when Martha heard that Jesus was coming, she went out to meet Him; but Mary stayed at home.
ekegusii: Nabo Martha agachia koigwa ng’a Yeso ngocha are, akagenda komoorotota, korende Mariamu nigo aikaransete nyomba ime.
swahili: Martha aliposikia kwamba Yesu anakuja, alitoka kwenda kumlaki, ila Maria alibaki nyumbani.

english: Martha said to Jesus, “Lord, if You had been here, my brother would not have died.
ekegusii: Erio Martha agateebia Yeso, “Omonene, onye naa kwarenge, momura ominto anga takwete.
swahili: Martha akamwambia Yesu, “Bwana, kama ungalikuwa hapa, ndugu yangu hangalikufa.

english: But even now I know that God will give You whatever You ask of Him.”
ekegusii: Korende nonya mbono namanyire ng’a kende gionsi orasabe Nyasae, Nyasae nakoe.”
swahili: Lakini sasa ninajua kuwa chochote utakachomwomba Mungu, atakupa.”

english: “Your brother will rise again,” Jesus told her.
ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Momura omino naboke.”
swahili: Yesu akamwambia, “Ndugu yako atafufuka.”

english: Martha replied, “I know that he will rise again in the resurrection at the last day.”
ekegusii: Martha akamoteebia, “Namanyire ng’a nache kobokigwa ase okobokigwa rituko ri’omoerio.”
swahili: Martha akamjibu, “Ninajua ya kuwa atafufuka wakati wa ufufuo wa wafu siku ya mwisho.”

english: Jesus said to her, “I am the resurrection and the life. Whoever believes in Me will live, even though he dies.
ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Inche ninche okobokigwa na obogima; oyonyegenire inche, naisa gokwa, nabe moyo.
swahili: Yesu akamwambia, “Mimi ndiye huo ufufuo na uzima. Yeye aniaminiye mimi, hata akifa atakuwa anaishi

english: And everyone who lives and believes in Me will never die. Do you believe this?”
ekegusii: Na onde bwensi ore moyo na onyegenire, tagokwa nonya ng’ake. Inee! Kwegenire aya?”
swahili: na yeyote aishiye na kuniamini hatakufa kabisa hata milele. Je, unasadiki haya?”

english: “Yes, Lord,” she answered, “I believe that You are the Christ, the Son of God, who was to come into the world.”
ekegusii: Akamoteebia, “Ee, Omonene; inche negenire ng’a aye naye Kristo, Omwana o Nyasae, oria ogocha ase ense.” Okobokigwa kwa Lazaro
swahili: Martha akamwambia, “Ndiyo Bwana, ninaamini ya kuwa wewe ndiwe Kristo, Mwana wa Mungu, yeye ajaye ulimwenguni.” Yesu Alia

english: After Martha had said this, she went back and called her sister Mary aside to tell her, “The Teacher is here and is asking for you.”
ekegusii: Naende gakwanire aya, akagenda, akarangeria Mariamu mosubati omwabo, agakwana ng’ora igo, “Omworokia ochire, ngokorangeria are.”
swahili: Baada ya kusema haya Martha alikwenda, akamwita Maria dada yake faraghani na kumwambia, “Mwalimu yuko hapa anakuita.”

english: And when Mary heard this, she got up quickly and went to Him.
ekegusii: Mariamu agachia koigwa, akaimoka bwango, akamochiera.
swahili: Maria aliposikia hivyo, akaondoka upesi akaenda mpaka alipokuwa Yesu.

english: So the sisters sent word to Jesus, “Lord, the one You love is sick.”
ekegusii: Nabo baria basubati bamwabo bagatoma amang’ana asare, bakaboora, “Omonene, ere oyobwanchete orwarire.”
swahili: Hivyo hawa dada wawili walituma ujumbe kwa Yesu kumwambia, “Bwana, yule umpendaye ni mgonjwa.”

english: Now Jesus had not yet entered the village, but was still at the place where Martha had met Him.
ekegusii: Na Yeso konya taraika omochie ime, korende nigo arenge aase aria arototeretwe na Martha.
swahili: Yesu alikuwa hajaingia kijijini, bali alikuwa bado yuko mahali pale alipokutana na Martha.

english: When the Jews who were in the house consoling Mary saw how quickly she got up and went out, they followed her, supposing she was going to the tomb to mourn there.
ekegusii: Erio Abayahudi baria barenge amo nere nyomba ime bakomoremia, bagachia korora Mariamu buna aimoka bwango na gosoka, bakamotunyana, bakagete ng’a nigo akogenda embeera erinde arere aroro.
swahili: Wale Wayahudi waliokuwa pamoja na Maria nyumbani wakimfariji walipoona ameondoka haraka na kutoka nje, walimfuata wakidhani ya kwamba alikuwa anakwenda kule kaburini kulilia huko.

english: When Mary came to Jesus and saw Him, she fell at His feet and said, “Lord, if You had been here, my brother would not have died.”
ekegusii: Erio Mariamu agachia goika aase aria Yeso arenge, akamorora, akagwa ase amagoro aye, akamoteebia, “Omonene, onye naa kwarenge, momura ominto anga takwete.”
swahili: Maria alipofika mahali pale Yesu alipokuwa, alipiga magoti miguuni Pake na kusema, “Bwana, kama ungalikuwa hapa, ndugu yangu hangalikufa.”

english: When Jesus saw her weeping, and the Jews who had come with her also weeping, He was deeply moved in spirit and troubled.
ekegusii: Erio Yeso agachia komoorora okorera, na Abayahudi baria bachete amo nere bakorera; agasogwa nobororo ase omoyo oye, agaichana.
swahili: Yesu alipomwona Maria akilia na wale Wayahudi waliokuja pamoja naye pia wakilia, Yesu alisikia uchungu moyoni, akafadhaika sana.

english: “Where have you put him?” He asked. “Come and see, Lord,” they answered.
ekegusii: Akababoria, “Ng’ai mwamobeka?” Bakamoteebia, “Omonene, inchwo orore!”
swahili: Akauliza, “Mmemweka wapi?” Wakamwambia, “Bwana, njoo upaone.”

english: Then the Jews said, “See how He loved him!”
ekegusii: Erio Abayahudi bakaboora, “Rora buna amwanchete.”
swahili: Ndipo Wayahudi wakasema, “Tazama jinsi alivyompenda Lazaro!”

english: But some of them asked, “Could not this man who opened the eyes of the blind also have kept Lazarus from dying?” Jesus Raises Lazarus (Acts 9:36–43)
ekegusii: Korende abande bakaboora, “Inee! Oyo oramogetie amaiso ’omouko oria, tare konyara kogwenia oyo takwa?”
swahili: Lakini wengine wakasema, “Je, yule aliyefungua macho ya kipofu, hakuweza kumfanya na huyu asife?” Yesu Amfufua Lazaro

english: Jesus, once again deeply moved, came to the tomb. It was a cave with a stone laid across the entrance.
ekegusii: Nabo Yeso oichanete naende ase omoyo oye, agaika ase embeera. Ero nigo yarenge rikuruma, naende rigena ndiabegetwe igoro yaye.
swahili: Yesu kwa mara nyingine akiwa amefadhaika sana, akafika penye kaburi. Hilo kaburi lilikuwa pango ambalo jiwe lilikuwa limewekwa kwenye ingilio lake.

english: “Take away the stone,” Jesus said. “Lord, by now he stinks,” said Martha, the sister of the dead man. “It has already been four days.”
ekegusii: Yeso akabora, “Tigeria rigena.” Martha, mosubati omwabo bw’oria okwete, akamoteebia, “Omonene, otiokire bono, ekiagera obeire egetondo ase amatuko ane.”
swahili: Yesu akasema, “Liondoeni hilo jiwe.” Martha ndugu yake yule aliyekuwa amekufa akasema, “Lakini Bwana, wakati huu atakuwa ananuka kwani amekwisha kuwa kaburini siku nne.”

english: When Jesus heard this, He said, “This sickness will not end in death. No, it is for the glory of God, so that the Son of God may be glorified through it.”
ekegusii: Yeso agachia koyaigwa, akabora, “Oborwaire obwo tari obw’amakweri, korende ase okoorokia obonene bwa Nyasae, erinde Omwana o Nyasae abakwe ase obwo.”
swahili: Lakini Yesu aliposikia hayo, akasema, “Ugonjwa huu hautaleta mauti bali umetokea ili kudhihirisha utukufu wa Mungu, ili Mwana wa Mungu apate kutukuzwa kutokana na ugonjwa huu.”

english: Jesus replied, “Did I not tell you that if you believed, you would see the glory of God?”
ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Tinagoteebia ng’a koregene norore obonene bwa Nyasae?”
swahili: Yesu akamwambia, “Sikukuambia kwamba kama ukiamini utauona utukufu wa Mungu?”

english: So they took away the stone. Then Jesus lifted His eyes upward and said, “Father, I thank You that You have heard Me.
ekegusii: Nabo bakarusia rigena riria. Yeso akaimokia amaiso aye igoro, akabora, “Tata, nakoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono, ekiagera okonyigwa.
swahili: Kwa hiyo wakaliondoa lile jiwe kutoka kaburini. Yesu akainua macho yake juu akasema, “Baba, ninakushukuru kwa kuwa wanisikia.

english: I knew that You always hear Me, but I say this for the benefit of the people standing here, so they may believe that You sent Me.”
ekegusii: Na inche nimanyete ng’a nigo okonyigwa amatuko onsi; korende ase engencho y’omoganda oyo ong’etanaine konya nakwanire aya, banyare gwancha ng’a naye gwantomete.”
swahili: Ninajua ya kuwa wewe hunisikia siku zote, lakini nimesema haya kwa ajili ya umati huu uliosimama hapa, ili wapate kuamini ya kuwa wewe umenituma.”

english: After Jesus had said this, He called out in a loud voice, “Lazarus, come out!”
ekegusii: Ekero akwanire igo, agaaka eriogi rinene, “Lazaro, soka isiko!”
swahili: Baada ya kusema haya, Yesu akapaza sauti yake akaita, “Lazaro, njoo huku!”

english: The man who had been dead came out with his hands and feet bound in strips of linen, and his face wrapped in a cloth. “Unwrap him and let him go,” Jesus told them. The Plot to Kill Jesus (Matthew 26:1–5; Mark 14:1–2; Luke 22:1–2)
ekegusii: Oria okwete agasoka, oboyirie egetambaa amagoro na amaboko; obosio bwaye boboyirie egetambaa. Yeso akabateebia, “Mosansore, momotige agende.” Abakuani abanene bakomoboera Yeso bamoite (Mat 26:1-5; Mar 14:1-2; Luk 22:1-2)
swahili: Yule aliyekuwa amekufa akatoka nje, mikono yake na miguu yake ikiwa imeviringishiwa vitambaa vya kitani na leso usoni pake. Yesu akawaambia, “Mfungueni, mwacheni aende zake.” Shauri La Kumuua Yesu (Mathayo 26:1-5; Marko 14:1-2; Luka 22:1-2)

english: Therefore many of the Jews who had come to Mary, and had seen what Jesus did, believed in Him.
ekegusii: Nabo abange ase Abayahudi abachete amo na Mariamu na korora aya Yeso akorete, bakamwegena.
swahili: Hivyo Wayahudi wengi waliokuwa wamekuja kumfariji Maria, walipoona yale Yesu aliyoyatenda wakamwamini.

english: But some of them went to the Pharisees and told them what Jesus had done.
ekegusii: Korende abande babo bakagenda ase Abafarisai, bakabateebia aya Yeso akorete.
swahili: Lakini baadhi yao wakaenda kwa Mafarisayo na kuwaambia mambo Yesu aliyoyafanya.

english: Then the chief priests and Pharisees convened the Sanhedrin and said, “What are we to do? This man is performing many signs.
ekegusii: Abakuani abanene na Abafarisai bagasangererekana ase ekegambero, bakaboora, “Ninki togokora? Ekiagera omonto oyo nigo agokora ebikone ebinge.
swahili: Kwa hiyo viongozi wa makuhani na Mafarisayo wakaita mkutano wa baraza. Wakaulizana, “Tufanyeje? Huyu mtu anafanya ishara nyingi.

english: If we let Him go on like this, everyone will believe in Him, and then the Romans will come and take away both our place and our nation.”
ekegusii: Toise komotiga iga, abanto bonsi mbamwegene; na Abarumi mbache, batoure Aase aito Aachenu na egesaku giaito.”
swahili: Kama tukimwacha aendelee hivi, kila mtu atamwamini, nao Warumi watakuja na kupaharibu mahali petu patakatifu na taifa letu.”

english: But one of them, named Caiaphas, who was high priest that year, said to them, “You know nothing at all!
ekegusii: Omonto oyomo ase bare, Kayafa, oyorenge Omokuani omonene ase omwaka oria, akabateebia, “Inwe timomanyeti kende gionsi.
swahili: Mmoja wao aliyeitwa Kayafa, ambaye alikuwa kuhani mkuu mwaka huo, akasema, “Ninyi hamjui kitu chochote!

english: Now Jesus loved Martha and her sister and Lazarus.
ekegusii: Na Yeso nigo anchete Martha, na mosubati omwabo, na Lazaro.
swahili: Pamoja na hivyo, ingawa Yesu aliwapenda Martha, Maria na Lazaro ndugu yao,

english: You do not realize that it is better for you that one man die for the people than that the whole nation perish.”
ekegusii: Gose timorengerereti ng’a mbuya omonto oyomo akwe ase engencho y’abanto, erinde egesaku ekegima tigesira.”
swahili: Hamjui kwamba ni afadhali mtu mmoja afe kwa ajili ya watu, kuliko taifa lote liangamie?”

english: Caiaphas did not say this on his own. Instead, as high priest that year, he was prophesying that Jesus would die for the nation,
ekegusii: Naende eri takwanete ase omoyo oye omonyene, korende ekiagera arenge Omokuani omonene ase omwaka oria, akabana ng’a Yeso nakwe ase engencho y’egesaku keria;
swahili: Hakusema haya kutokana na mawazo yake mwenyewe bali kama kuhani mkuu mwaka huo, alitabiri kuwa Yesu angelikufa kwa ajili ya taifa la Wayahudi,

english: and not only for the nation, but also for the scattered children of God, to gather them together into one.
ekegusii: gose tari ase engencho y’egesaku keria gioka, korende amo naya asangererie abana ba Nyasae baria baatananekire, babe abamo.
swahili: wala si kwa ajili ya taifa hilo pekee, bali pia kwa ajili ya watoto wa Mungu waliotawanyika, ili kuwaleta pamoja na kuwafanya wawe wamoja.

english: So from that day on they plotted to kill Him.
ekegusii: Nabo korwa rituko riria bakarengereria buna baranyare komoita.
swahili: Hivyo tangu siku hiyo wakawa wanafanya mipango ili wamuue Yesu.

english: As a result, Jesus no longer went about publicly among the Jews, but He withdrew to a town called Ephraim in an area near the wilderness. And He stayed there with the disciples.
ekegusii: Yeso tataarete naende maiso marore ase egati y’Abayahudi, korende akarua aria akagenda aase ang’e nerooro, goika omochie okorokwa Efraimu; akamenya aroro amo naborokigwa baye.
swahili: Kwa hiyo Yesu akawa hatembei hadharani miongoni mwa Wayahudi, bali alijitenga akaenda sehemu iliyo karibu na jangwa kwenye kijiji kiitwacho Efraimu. Akakaa huko na wanafunzi wake.

english: Now the Jewish Passover was near, and many people went up from the country to Jerusalem to purify themselves before the Passover.
ekegusii: Naende Epasaka y’Abayahudi nigo yarenge ang’e; abange bagatiira korwa chinka chiabo kogenda Yerusalemu gotang’anera Epasaka, erinde besibie.
swahili: Basi Pasaka ya Wayahudi ilipokuwa imekaribia, watu wengi walitoka vijijini wakaenda Yerusalemu kabla ya Pasaka ili wakajitakase.

english: They kept looking for Jesus and asking one another as they stood in the temple courts, “What do you think? Will He come to the feast at all?”
ekegusii: Nabo bakarigia Yeso, bagateebania barabwo ase barabwo, bagotenena ase Hekalu, “Naki morooche? Tagocha‐gocha ase rituko rinene nonya ng’ake?”
swahili: Watu wakawa wanamtafuta Yesu, nao waliposimama kwenye eneo la Hekalu waliulizana, Je, mtu huyu hatakuja kamwe kwenye Sikukuu?

english: But the chief priests and Pharisees had given orders that anyone who knew where He was must report it, so that they could arrest Him.
ekegusii: Bono abakuani abanene na Abafarisai bakarua ogochika ng’a onye monto onde omanyete aase are, arente amang’ana, banyare komobwata.
swahili: Viongozi wa makuhani na Mafarisayo walikuwa wametoa amri kuwa yeyote atakayejua mahali Yesu aliko, lazima atoe taarifa ili wapate kumkamata.

english: So on hearing that Lazarus was sick, He stayed where He was for two days,
ekegusii: Ekero achia koigwa ng’a nomorwaire, agateebana amatuko abere aria aase arenge.
swahili: baada ya kusikia kwamba Lazaro ni mgonjwa, aliendelea kukawia huko alikokuwa kwa siku mbili zaidi.

english: and then He said to the disciples, “Let us go back to Judea.”
ekegusii: Erio magega ase aya agateebia aborokigwa baye, “Togende Boyahudi naende.”
swahili: Ndipo akawaambia wanafunzi wake, “Haya, turudi Uyahudi.”

english: “Rabbi,” they replied, “the Jews just tried to stone You, and You are going back there?”
ekegusii: Aborokigwa bakamoteebia, “Rabii, moisonde Abayahudi nigo barenge gokorigia gokoaka amagena, na aye gokogenda aroro naende?”
swahili: Wanafunzi wake wakamwambia, “Rabi, Wayahudi walikuwa wanataka kukupiga mawe, nawe unataka kurudi huko?”

english: Jesus answered, “Are there not twelve hours of daylight? If anyone walks in the daytime, he will not stumble, because he sees by the light of this world.
ekegusii: Yeso akairaneria, “Chinsa chi’omobaso tichiri ikomi na ibere? Omonto karagende mobaso takogochwa, ekiagera aroche omobaso bw’ense eye.
swahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Si kuna saa kumi na mbili za mchana katika siku moja? Wala watembeao mchana hawawezi kujikwaa kwa maana wanaona nuru ya ulimwengu huu.

english: Six days before the Passover, Jesus came to Bethany, the hometown of Lazarus, whom He had raised from the dead.
ekegusii: Nabo amatuko atano na rimo ritang’ani ri’Epasaka Yeso agaika Bethania, agwo aase Lazaro arenge, oria okwete, akabokigwa na Yeso.
swahili: Siku sita kabla ya Pasaka, Yesu alikwenda Bethania mahali ambako Lazaro aliyekuwa amefufuliwa na Yesu alikuwa anaishi.

english: So the chief priests made plans to kill Lazarus as well,
ekegusii: Abakuani abanene bagakora ekiina baite Lazaro boigo,
swahili: Kwa hiyo viongozi wa makuhani wakafanya mpango wa kumuua Lazaro pia,

english: for on account of him many of the Jews were deserting them and believing in Jesus. The Triumphal Entry (Zechariah 9:9–13; Matthew 21:1–11; Mark 11:1–11; Luke 19:28–40)
ekegusii: ekiagera ase engencho yaye abange b’Abayahudi bakagenda bakamwegena Yeso. Yeso ogochengerwa kagosoa Yerusalemu (Mat 21:1-11; Mar 11:1-11; Luk 19:28-40)
swahili: kwa kuwa kutokana na habari za kufufuliwa kwake Wayahudi wengi walikuwa wanamwendea Yesu na kumwamini. Kuingia Kwa Yesu Yerusalemu Kwa Ushindi (Mathayo 21:1-11; Marko 1:1-11; Luka 19:28-40)

english: The next day the great crowd that had come to the feast heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem.
ekegusii: Rituko rikobwatia abanto abange abachete ase Rituko Rinene, kobachia koigwa ng’a Yeso ngocha are Yerusalemu,
swahili: Siku iliyofuata umati mkubwa uliokuwa umekuja kwenye Sikukuu walisikia kwamba Yesu angekuja Yerusalemu.

english: They took palm branches and went out to meet Him, shouting: “Hosanna!” “Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord!” “Blessed is the King of Israel!”
ekegusii: bakabogoria chinsagia chi’emekendo, bagasoka isiko kogenda komoorotota, bagaaka eriogi, bagateeba, “Hosana! Nasesenirie oyogocha ase erieta ri’Omonene, Omorwoti bw’Abaisraeli.”
swahili: Basi wakachukua matawi ya mitende, wakatoka kwenda kumlaki, huku wakipaza sauti wakisema, “Hosana!” “Amebarikiwa yeye ajaye kwa Jina la Bwana!” “Amebarikiwa Mfalme wa Israeli!”

english: Finding a young donkey, Jesus sat on it, as it is written:
ekegusii: Yeso akanyora emori y’etigere, akayeriina, buna yarigetwe,
swahili: Yesu akamkuta mwana-punda akampanda, kama ilivyoandikwa,

english: “Do not be afraid, O Daughter of Zion. See, your King is coming, seated on the colt of a donkey.”
ekegusii: “Inwe abanto ba Sayoni, timoiroka! Rigereria, Omorwoti oino ngocha are, igo ariinete emori y’etigere.”
swahili: “Usiogope, Ewe binti Sayuni; tazama, Mfalme wako anakuja, amepanda mwana-punda!”

english: At first His disciples did not understand these things, but after Jesus was glorified they remembered what had been done to Him, and they realized that these very things had also been written about Him.
ekegusii: Amang’ana aya aborokigwa baye tibayamanyete agwo ritang’ani, korende magega Yeso gatogigwe, erio bakainyora ng’a narikeire aya, naende ng’a mbamokorere aya.
swahili: Wanafunzi wake Yesu mwanzoni hawakuelewa mambo haya, lakini Yesu alipotukuzwa, ndipo walipokumbuka kuwa mambo haya yalikuwa yameandikwa kwa ajili yake na alitendewa yeye.

english: Meanwhile, many people continued to testify that they had been with Jesus when He called Lazarus from the tomb and raised him from the dead.
ekegusii: Nabo omoganda bw’abaanto abwo barenge amo nere ekero arangeretie Lazaro korwa ase embeera ime, na komobokia, bakaba bakomoorokia.
swahili: Wale waliokuwepo wakati Yesu alipomwita Lazaro kutoka kaburini na kumfufua kutoka kwa wafu, waliendelea kushuhudia.

english: That is also why the crowd went out to meet Him, because they heard that He had performed this sign.
ekegusii: Ekio nakio kiagerete omoganda okagenda komoorotota, ekiagera baigwete ng’a okorire egekone eke.
swahili: Ni kwa sababu pia walikuwa wamesikia kwamba alikuwa ametenda muujiza huu ndiyo maana umati wa watu ukaenda kumlaki.

english: Then the Pharisees said to one another, “You can see that this is doing you no good. Look how the whole world has gone after Him!” Jesus Predicts His Death
ekegusii: Erio Abafarisai bagateebania barabwo ase barabwo, “Mwarorire ng’a timokonyara gokora gento; ense yagendire komotunyana.” Okorigia kw’Abagiriki
swahili: Hivyo Mafarisayo walipoona hayo wakaambiana, “Mnaona, hamwezi kufanya lolote. Angalieni, ulimwengu wote unamfuata yeye!” Yesu Anatabiri Kifo Chake

english: So they hosted a dinner for Jesus there. Martha served, and Lazarus was among those reclining at the table with Him.
ekegusii: Bakamoroiseria endagera aria. Martha ere agakora emeremo eyio, korende Lazaro nigo arenge oyomo bwa baria baikaransete ase endagera amo nere.
swahili: Wakaandaa karamu kwa heshima ya Yesu. Martha akawahudumia wakati Lazaro alikuwa miongoni mwa waliokaa mezani pamoja na Yesu.

english: Now there were some Greeks among those who went up to worship at the feast.
ekegusii: Naende mbarenge Abagiriki bande ase abanto abwo batiirete kogenda gosasiima ase ekero kie Rituko Rinene.
swahili: Basi palikuwa Wayunani fulani miongoni mwa wale waliokuwa wamekwenda kuabudu wakati wa Sikukuu.

english: They came to Philip, who was from Bethsaida in Galilee, and requested of him, “Sir, we want to see Jesus.”
ekegusii: Barabwo bagachiera Filipo o Bethisaida bw’ensemo ya Galili, bakamosaba, bakobora, “Omosike, ntorigetie korora Yeso.”
swahili: Hawa wakamjia Filipo, ambaye alikuwa mwenyeji wa Bethsaida huko Galilaya, wakiwa na ombi. Wakamwambia, “Tungependa kumwona Yesu.”

english: Philip relayed this appeal to Andrew, and both of them went and told Jesus.
ekegusii: Filipo akagenda, agateebia Anderea; erio Anderea na Filipo bagateebia Yeso.
swahili: Filipo akaenda akamweleza Andrea, nao wote wawili wakamwambia Yesu.

english: But Jesus replied, “The hour has come for the Son of Man to be glorified.
ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, akabora, “Ensa yaikire, Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto abakwe.
swahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Saa imewadia ya Mwana wa Adamu kutukuzwa.

english: Truly, truly, I tell you, unless a kernel of wheat falls to the ground and dies, it remains only a seed; but if it dies, it bears much fruit.
ekegusii: Ekeene, ekeene, nabateebirie; Enyeke y’engano etagweti esoe inse ase riroba ekwe, nigo ekobao yoka; korende kerakwe, nigo ekwama okwama okonge.
swahili: Amin, amin nawaambia, mbegu ya ngano isipoanguka ardhini na kufa, hubakia kama mbegu peke yake. Lakini ikifa huzaa mbegu nyingi.

english: Whoever loves his life will lose it, but whoever hates his life in this world will keep it for eternal life.
ekegusii: Oyoranche obogima bwaye, nabosirie; oyorageche obogima bwaye ase ense eye, nabogache goika obogima bwa kare na kare.
swahili: Mtu yeyote anayependa maisha yake atayapoteza, naye ayachukiaye maisha yake katika ulimwengu huu atayaokoa hata kwa uzima wa milele.

english: If anyone serves Me, he must follow Me; and where I am, My servant will be as well. If anyone serves Me, the Father will honor him.
ekegusii: Omonto karankorere, antunyane; na aase inde inche, nomosomba one nao arabe; naende omonto karankorere, Tata namosike.
swahili: Mtu yeyote akinitumikia lazima anifuate, nami mahali nilipo ndipo mtumishi wangu atakapokuwa. Mtu akinitumikia, Baba yangu atamheshimu.

english: Now My soul is troubled, and what shall I say? ‘Father, save Me from this hour’? No, it is for this purpose that I have come to this hour.
ekegusii: “Bono omoyo one oichanire; ninki ngokwana? Tata, ontoorie korwa ase ense eye! Yaya, korende ase engencho y’ayio naikeire ensa eye.
swahili: “Sasa roho yangu imefadhaika sana. Niseme nini? ‘Baba, niokoe katika saa hii.’ Lakini ni kwa kusudi hili nimeufikia wakati huu.

english: Father, glorify Your name!” Then a voice came from heaven: “I have glorified it, and I will glorify it again.”
ekegusii: Tata, obake erieta riao!” Erio eriogi rigacha korwa igoro, rigateba, “Naribakire, na inche nindibake naende.”
swahili: Baba, litukuze jina lako.” Ndipo ikaja sauti kutoka mbinguni, “Nimelitukuza, nami nitalitukuza tena.”

english: The crowd standing there heard it and said that it had thundered. Others said that an angel had spoken to Him.
ekegusii: Nabo abanto abateneine ang’e bakaigwa, bakaboora ng’a kwabeire okogukura; abande bakaboora, “Nomomalaika ogokwana nere.”
swahili: Ule umati wa watu uliokuwa mahali pale uliisikia nao ukasema, “Hiyo ni sauti ya radi,” wengine wakasema, “Malaika ameongea naye.”

english: Then Mary took about a pint of expensive perfume, made of pure nard, and she anointed Jesus’ feet and wiped them with her hair. And the house was filled with the fragrance of the perfume.
ekegusii: Erio Mariamu akabogoria ekerengo ki’eratili eyemo y’amanukato e rigori rinene, agaaka Yeso amagoro, akayatinyia netukia yaye; enyomba egaichora rimisu ri’amaguta aria.
swahili: Kisha Maria akachukua chupa ya painti moja yenye manukato ya nardo safi ya thamani kubwa, akayamimina miguuni mwa Yesu na kuifuta kwa nywele zake. Nyumba nzima ikajaa harufu nzuri ya manukato.

english: In response, Jesus said, “This voice was not for My benefit, but yours.
ekegusii: Yeso akairaneria, akabora, “Eriogi eri tiricheti ase engencho yane, korende nase engencho yaino.
swahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Sauti hii imesikika kwa faida yenu, wala si kwa faida yangu.

english: Now judgment is upon this world; now the prince of this world will be cast out.
ekegusii: Bono ekiina gi’ense eye nkere; bono omogambi bw’ense eye natugutwe isiko.
swahili: Sasa ni saa ya hukumu kwa ajili ya ulimwengu huu, sasa mkuu wa ulimwengu huu atatupwa nje.

english: And I, when I am lifted up from the earth, will draw everyone to Myself.”
ekegusii: Na inche kondaimokererigwe igoro korwa ase ense, nimbang’use bonsi ase ’nde.”
swahili: Lakini mimi, nikiinuliwa kutoka nchi, nitawavuta watu wote waje kwangu.”

english: He said this to indicate the kind of death He was going to die.
ekegusii: Agakwana aya, erinde aorokie imakweri ki aranyare gokwa.
swahili: Yesu aliyasema haya akionyesha ni kifo gani atakachokufa.

english: The crowd replied, “We have heard from the Law that the Christ will remain forever. So how can you say that the Son of Man must be lifted up? Who is this Son of Man?”
ekegusii: Erio omoganda okamoiraneria, “Nigo tokoigwa ase amachiiko ng’a Kristo nigo arabeo goika kare na kare, na aye naki okobora ng’a nemogwenerete Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto aimokererigwe igoro? Oyo Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto nere ng’o?”
swahili: Ule umati wa watu ukapiga kelele ukasema, “Tumesikia kutoka Sheria kwamba ‘Kristo adumu milele,’ wewe wawezaje kusema, ‘Mwana wa Adamu hana budi kuinuliwa juu’? Huyu ‘Mwana wa Adamu’ ni nani?”

english: Then Jesus told them, “For a little while longer, the Light will be among you. Walk while you have the Light, so that darkness will not overtake you. The one who walks in the darkness does not know where he is going.
ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Omobaso nigo ore amo nainwe egeka egeke bosio. Genda ekero more nomobaso oria, omosunte tocha kobabua; ere oyokogenda ase omosunte ime tamanyeti aase akogenda.
swahili: Ndipo Yesu akawaambia, “Bado kitambo kidogo nuru ingalipo pamoja nanyi. Enendeni maadamu mna nuru, msije mkakumbwa na giza. Mtu anayetembea gizani hajui anakokwenda.

english: While you have the Light, believe in the Light, so that you may become sons of light.” After Jesus had spoken these things, He went away and was hidden from them. Belief and Unbelief
ekegusii: Ekero more nomobaso yuegene, erinde monyare koba abana b’omobaso.” Ekero Yeso akwanete ayio akagenda akebisa korwa ase bare. Ogotegena kw’abaanto ba Boyahudi, korende mbareo aborokigwa ba bobisi
swahili: Wekeni tumaini lenu katika nuru hiyo ili mpate kuwa wana wa nuru.” Baada ya kusema haya, Yesu aliondoka, akajificha wasimwone. Wayahudi Waendelea Kutokuamini

english: Although Jesus had performed so many signs in their presence, they still did not believe in Him.
ekegusii: Nonya okorete ebikone ebinge ase amasio abo, tibamwegenete,
swahili: Hata baada ya Yesu kufanya miujiza hii yote mbele yao, bado hawakumwamini.

english: This was to fulfill the word of Isaiah the prophet: “Lord, who has believed our message? And to whom has the arm of the Lord been revealed?”
ekegusii: erinde riikeranigwe ring’ana riria omobani Isaya ateebete, “Omonene, ning’o bwegenire amang’ana aito? Naende ning’o okoboko kw’Omonene kwamaanoreirwe?”
swahili: Hili lilikuwa ili kutimiza lile neno la nabii Isaya lililosema: “Bwana, ni nani aliyeamini ujumbe wetu, na mkono wa Bwana umefunuliwa kwa nani?”

english: For this reason they were unable to believe. For again, Isaiah says:
ekegusii: Nakio kiagerete tibanyara kwegena. Naki Isaya nigo ateebete naende,
swahili: Kwa hivyo hawakuamini, kwa sababu Isaya anasema mahali pengine:

english: But one of His disciples, Judas Iscariot, who was going to betray Him, asked,
ekegusii: Korende Yudasi Iskariota mosinto o Simioni, oyomo bw’aborokigwa ba Yeso oyoramorue, akabora,
swahili: Ndipo Yuda Iskariote mwana wa Simoni, mmoja wa wale wanafunzi ambaye ndiye angemsaliti Yesu, akasema,

english: “He has blinded their eyes and hardened their hearts, so that they cannot see with their eyes, and understand with their hearts, and turn, and I would heal them.”
ekegusii: “Obaukoirie amaiso, okorire chinkoro chiabo chiakong’ire, tibacha korora namaiso abo, na komanya ne chinkoro chiabo, baonchoke na inche mbagwenie.”
swahili: “Amewafanya vipofu, na kuifanya mioyo yao kuwa migumu, ili wasiweze kuona kwa macho yao, wala kuelewa kwa mioyo yao, wasije wakageuka nami nikawaponya.”

english: Isaiah said these things because he saw Jesus’ glory and spoke about Him.
ekegusii: Amang’ana ayio Isaya nigo ayakwanete, ekiagera aroche obonene bwaye; agaatora amang’ana aye.
swahili: Isaya alisema haya alipoona utukufu wa Yesu na kunena habari zake.

english: Nevertheless, many of the leaders believed in Him; but because of the Pharisees they did not confess Him, for fear that they would be put out of the synagogue.
ekegusii: Korende abange nonya nabanene bakamwegena, korende ase engencho y’Abafarisai tibamoorogetie, tibacha korusigwa ase esinagogi,
swahili: Lakini wengi miongoni mwa viongozi wa Wayahudi walimwamini, lakini kwa sababu ya Mafarisayo hawakukiri waziwazi kwa maana waliogopa kufukuzwa katika masinagogi.

english: For they loved praise from men more than praise from God.
ekegusii: ekiagera mbanchete ogotogia kw’abaanto kobua ogotogia kwa Nyasae. Okworokereria kwa Yeso maiso marore
swahili: Wao walipenda sifa za wanadamu kuliko sifa zitokazo kwa Mungu. Amwaminiye Yesu Hatabaki Gizani

english: Then Jesus cried out, “Whoever believes in Me does not believe in Me alone, but in the One who sent Me.
ekegusii: Yeso agaaka eriogi akabora, “Oyonyegenire inche, tanyegeneti inche omonyene, korende ere oyontomete.
swahili: Yesu akapaza sauti akasema, “Yeyote aniaminiye, haniamini mimi peke yangu, bali yeye aliyenituma.

english: And whoever sees Me sees the One who sent Me.
ekegusii: Na ere oyondoche inche nigo aroche ere oyontomete.
swahili: Yeyote anionaye mimi, amemwona yeye aliyenituma.

english: I have come into the world as a light, so that no one who believes in Me should remain in darkness.
ekegusii: Inche nachire imbe omobaso ase ense, erinde kera oyonyegenire, tamenya ase omosunte ime.
swahili: Mimi nimekuja kama nuru ulimwenguni, ili kwamba kila mtu aniaminiye asibaki gizani.

english: As for anyone who hears My words and does not keep them, I do not judge him. For I have not come to judge the world, but to save the world.
ekegusii: Naende omonto karaigwe amang’ana aane, ko tayabwata, inche tinkomogambia, ekiagera tincheti kogambia ense, korende nyetoorie.
swahili: “Mimi simhukumu mtu yeyote anayesikia maneno yangu na asiyatii, kwa maana sikuja kuuhukumu ulimwengu, bali kuuokoa.

english: There is a judge for the one who rejects Me and does not receive My words: The word that I have spoken will judge him on the last day.
ekegusii: Oyo oranyange na otancheti amang’ana aane, nare noyo oramogambie. Ring’ana riria nakwanete, nario riranyare komogambia ase rituko ri’omoerio.
swahili: Yuko amhukumuye yeye anikataaye mimi na kutokuyapokea maneno yangu, yaani, yale maneno niliyosema yenyewe yatamhukumu siku ya mwisho.

english: I have not spoken on My own, but the Father who sent Me has commanded Me what to say and how to say it.
ekegusii: Naki tinakwanete ase okobua kwane omonyene, korende Tata oyontomete onchikiire aya ngokwana.
swahili: Kwa maana sisemi kwa ajili yangu mwenyewe, bali Baba aliyenituma aliniamuru ni nini cha kusema na jinsi ya kukisema.

english: “Why wasn’t this perfume sold for three hundred denarii and the money given to the poor?”
ekegusii: “Nase ki amaguta aya ataoonigwa chidinari amagana atato, na echio chiegwe abataka?”
swahili: “Kwa nini manukato haya hayakuuzwa kwa dinari 300 na fedha hizo wakapewa maskini?”

english: And I know that His command leads to eternal life. So I speak exactly what the Father has told Me to say.”
ekegusii: Na inche namanyire ng’a ogochika kwaye nobogima bwa kare na kare. Ase ayio nigo ngokwana buna Tata antebetie.”
swahili: Nami ninajua amri zake huongoza hadi kwenye uzima wa milele. Hivyo lolote nisemalo, ndilo lile Baba aliloniambia niseme.”

english: Judas did not say this because he cared about the poor, but because he was a thief. As keeper of the money bag, he used to take from what was put into it.
ekegusii: Aya igo akwanete, tari ng’a arorerete abataka amaabera, korende nekiagera arenge omoibi, naende abwate esanduki ye chibesa, na igo anarete korusia echiabekire aroro.
swahili: Yuda alisema hivi si kwa kuwa aliwajali maskini, bali kwa kuwa alikuwa mwizi, kwani ndiye alikuwa akitunza mfuko wa fedha akawa anaiba kile kilichowekwa humo.

english: “Leave her alone,” Jesus replied. “She has kept this perfume in preparation for the day of My burial.
ekegusii: Erio Yeso agateeba, “Motige, agache aya goika rituko ri’ogotindekwa kwane.
swahili: Yesu akasema, “Mwacheni. Aliyanunua manukato hayo ili ayaweke kwa ajili ya siku ya maziko yangu.

english: The poor you will always have with you, but you will not always have Me.” The Plot to Kill Lazarus
ekegusii: Naki igo more nabataka amo nainwe amatuko onsi, korende timori nainche amatuko onsi.”
swahili: Maskini mtakuwa nao siku zote, lakini mimi hamtakuwa nami siku zote.” Shauri La Kumuua Lazaro

english: Meanwhile a large crowd of Jews learned that Jesus was there. And they came not only because of Him, but also to see Lazarus, whom He had raised from the dead.
ekegusii: Nabo omoganda omonene bw’Abayahudi bakamanya ng’a ere nao are aria; bagacha, tari ase engencho ya Yeso yoka, korende barore Lazaro, oyio Yeso abogetie korwa ase abakuure.
swahili: Umati mkubwa wa Wayahudi walipojua kwamba Yesu alikuwa huko Bethania, walikuja si tu kwa ajili ya Yesu, lakini pia kumwona Lazaro ambaye Yesu alikuwa amemfufua.

english: It was now just before the Passover Feast, and Jesus knew that His hour had come to leave this world and return to the Father. Having loved His own who were in the world, He loved them to the very end.
ekegusii: Ekero rituko rinene ri’Epasaka ritaraba, Yeso akamanya ng’a ensa yaye yaikire akorua ase ense eye na kogenda ase Ise, akaba nanchete abanto baye abarenge ase ense, naboigo akabancha goika omoerio.
swahili: Ilikuwa mara tu kabla ya Sikukuu ya Pasaka. Yesu alijua ya kuwa wakati wake wa kuondoka ulimwenguni ili kurudi kwa Baba umewadia. Alikuwa amewapenda watu wake waliokuwa ulimwenguni, naam, aliwapenda hadi kipimo cha mwisho.

english: Jesus told him, “Whoever has already bathed needs only to wash his feet, and he will be completely clean. And you are clean, though not all of you.”
ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Oyoikire gwesibia tagwenereti gwesibia naende, otatiga amagoro oka, korende obeire omochenu omobere bwonsi; na inwe mwabeire abachenu, korende tai mwensi.”
