swahili: Yesu akamjibu, “Mtu aliyekwisha kuoga anahitaji kunawa miguu tu, kwani mwili wake wote ni safi. Ninyi ni safi, ingawa si kila mmoja wenu.”

english: For He knew who would betray Him. That is why He said, “Not all of you are clean.”
ekegusii: Naki amomanyete oyogocha komorua; ase ayio agateeba, “Timori abachenu mwensi.”
swahili: Kwa kuwa yeye alijua ni nani ambaye angemsaliti, ndiyo sababu akasema si kila mmoja aliyekuwa safi.

english: When Jesus had washed their feet and put on His outer garments, He reclined with them again and asked, “Do you know what I have done for you?
ekegusii: Nabo agachia gokoora kobasibia amagoro abo na kobogoria chianga chiaye, agaikaransa naende, akabateebia, “Mwamanyire eki nabakorera?
swahili: Alipomaliza kuwanawisha miguu yao, alivaa tena mavazi yake, akarudi alikokuwa ameketi, akawauliza, “Je, mmeelewa nililowafanyia?

english: You call Me Teacher and Lord, and rightly so, because I am.
ekegusii: Inwe iga mokondoka Omworokia, naende Omonene; na igo mbuya mokobora, naki naboigo inde.
swahili: Ninyi mnaniita mimi ‘Mwalimu’ na ‘Bwana,’ hii ni sawa, maana ndivyo nilivyo.

english: So if I, your Lord and Teacher, have washed your feet, you also should wash one another’s feet.
ekegusii: Nabo onye inche, inde Omonene naende Omworokia, nabasibirie amagoro aino, nebagwenerete gosibania amagoro inwe ase inwe.
swahili: Kwa hiyo, ikiwa mimi niliye Bwana wenu na Mwalimu wenu nimewanawisha ninyi miguu, pia hamna budi kunawishana miguu ninyi kwa ninyi.

english: I have set you an example so that you should do as I have done for you.
ekegusii: Naki nabaeire ekiorokererio ekiya, erinde ayio nabakorera inwe, nainwe moyakore.
swahili: Mimi nimewawekea kielelezo kwamba imewapasa kutenda kama vile nilivyowatendea ninyi.

english: Truly, truly, I tell you, no servant is greater than his master, nor is a messenger greater than the one who sent him.
ekegusii: Ekeene, ekeene, nabateebirie: Omosomba tari omonene kobua omonene oye, gose omotomwa tari omonene kobua ere oyomotomete.
swahili: Amin, amin nawaambia, mtumishi si mkuu kuliko bwana wake, wala aliyetumwa si mkuu kuliko yule aliyemtuma.

english: I am not speaking about all of you; I know whom I have chosen. But this is to fulfill the Scripture: ‘The one who shares My bread has lifted up his heel against Me.’
ekegusii: Tindi gokwana ase more mwensi; nabamanyire aba nachorire, erinde amariiko anyare goikeranigwa, ayagoteeba: Oyokoria omogati amo nainche oimokereirie egetingiro kiaye igoro ase ’nde.
swahili: “Sisemi hivi kuhusu ninyi nyote. Ninawajua wale niliowachagua. Lakini ni ili Andiko lipate kutimia, kwamba, ‘Yeye aliyekula chakula changu, ameinua kisigino chake dhidi yangu.’

english: I am telling you now before it happens, so that when it comes to pass, you will believe that I am He.
ekegusii: Nabatebirie aya korwa bono ritang’ani ataraba, erio ekero arache koba monyare kwegena ng’a ninche ere.
swahili: “Ninawaambia mambo haya kabla hayajatukia, ili yatakapotukia mpate kuamini ya kuwa Mimi ndiye.

english: The evening meal was underway, and the devil had already put into the heart of Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot, to betray Jesus.
ekegusii: Ekero ki’endagera ya mogoroba, Saitani gaikire kobeeka Yudasi omwana o Simioni Iskariota enkoro y’okomorua,
swahili: Wakati alipokuwa akila chakula cha jioni na wanafunzi wake, ibilisi alikuwa amekwisha kutia ndani ya moyo wa Yuda Iskariote, mwana wa Simoni, wazo la kumsaliti Yesu.

english: Truly, truly, I tell you, whoever receives the one I send receives Me, and whoever receives Me receives the One who sent Me.”
ekegusii: Ekeene, ekeene, nabateebirie: Ere oyoramwanche onde bwensi oyo ndatome, onyanchire inche; nere oyoranyanche inche omwanchire ere oyontomete.” Yeso okoorokia oyo orache komorua (Mat 26:20-25; Mar 14:17-21; Luk 22:21-23)
swahili: Amin, amin nawaambia, yeyote anayempokea yule niliyemtuma anipokea mimi, naye anipokeaye mimi ampokea yeye aliyenituma mimi.” Yesu Anatabiri Kusalitiwa Kwake (Mathayo 26:20-25; Marko 14:17-21; Luka 22:21-23)

english: After Jesus had said this, He became troubled in spirit and testified, “Truly, truly, I tell you, one of you will betray Me.”
ekegusii: Agachia gokoora gokwana aya, Yeso agaichana ase omoika oye, akaorokia, agakwana, “Ekeene, ekeene, nabateebirie: Oyomo oino nandue.”
swahili: Baada ya kusema haya, Yesu alifadhaika sana moyoni, akasema, “Amin, amin nawaambia, mmoja wenu atanisaliti.”

english: The disciples looked at one another, perplexed as to which of them He meant.
ekegusii: Aborokigwa baye bakarigererania, bagasinywa komanya gose ning’o atora.
swahili: Wanafunzi wake wakatazamana bila kujua kuwa alikuwa anamsema nani.

english: One of His disciples, the one whom Jesus loved, was reclining at His side.
ekegusii: Narenge aroro oyomo bw’aborokigwa baye, oyobweegegete Yeso egekuba kiaye, oyo Yeso anchete.
swahili: Mmoja wa wanafunzi wake ambaye Yesu alimpenda sana, alikuwa ameegama kifuani mwa Yesu.

english: So Simon Peter motioned to him to ask Jesus which one He was talking about.
ekegusii: Nabo Simioni Petero akamoraga, akamobooria, “Moborie ning’o atora?”
swahili: Simoni Petro akampungia mkono yule mwanafunzi, akamwambia, “Muulize anamaanisha nani.”

english: Leaning back against Jesus, he asked, “Lord, who is it?”
ekegusii: Ere oria akamweegeka buna arenge ase egekuba kia Yeso, akamobooria, “Omonene, ning’o?”
swahili: Yule mwanafunzi akamwegemea Yesu, akamuuliza, “Bwana, tuambie, ni nani?”

english: Jesus answered, “It is the one to whom I give this morsel after I have dipped it.” Then He dipped the morsel and gave it to Judas son of Simon Iscariot.
ekegusii: Erio Yeso akairaneria, “Nomonto oria ngotongereria egesamunye ki’omogati na komoa.” Agatongereria Yudasi, mosinto o Simioni Iskariota, egesamunye, agakemoa.
swahili: Yesu akajibu, “Ni yule nitakayempa hiki kipande cha mkate baada ya kukichovya kwenye bakuli.” Hivyo baada ya kukichovya kile kipande cha mkate, akampa Yuda Iskariote, mwana wa Simoni.

english: And when Judas had taken the morsel, Satan entered into him. Then Jesus said to Judas, “What you are about to do, do quickly.”
ekegusii: Naende magega kanyorire egesamunye keria, Saitani akamosoa. Erio Yeso akamoteebia, “Aya ogokora, yakore bwango.”
swahili: Mara tu baada ya kukipokea kile kipande cha mkate, Shetani akamwingia. Yesu akamwambia Yuda, “Lile unalotaka kulitenda litende haraka.”

english: But no one at the table knew why Jesus had said this to him.
ekegusii: Onde tarenge ase baria baikaransete ase emesa omanyete engencho yagerete amotebetie iga.
swahili: Hakuna hata mmoja wa wale waliokuwa wameketi naye mezani aliyeelewa kwa nini Yesu alimwambia hivyo.

english: Since Judas kept the money bag, some thought that Jesus was telling him to buy what was needed for the feast, or to give something to the poor.
ekegusii: Ekiagera Yudasi arenge kobogoria esanduki ye chitaabu, baria bande bagakaga ng’a Yeso nigo are komoteebia, “Gora ebitorigetie ase Rituko Rinene”, gose ng’a abae abataka egento.
swahili: Kwa kuwa Yuda alikuwa mtunza fedha, wengine walifikiri Yesu alikuwa amemwambia akanunue vitu vilivyohitajika kwa ajili ya Sikukuu, au kuwapa maskini chochote.

english: Jesus knew that the Father had delivered all things into His hands, and that He had come from God and was returning to God.
ekegusii: Yeso omanyete ng’a Ise omoeire bionsi ase amaboko aye, naende ng’a nigo arwete ase Nyasae, naende nkoirana are ase Nyasae.
swahili: Yesu akijua ya kwamba Baba ameweka vitu vyote chini ya mamlaka yake na kwamba yeye alitoka kwa Mungu na alikuwa anarudi kwa Mungu,

english: As soon as he had received the morsel, Judas went out into the night. Love One Another (Romans 12:9–13; 1 John 3:11–24)
ekegusii: Nabo oyo, kanyorire egesamunye keria agasoka bwango; na igo bwarenge botuko. Ogochika okoyia kw’obwanchani
swahili: Mara tu baada ya kupokea ule mkate, Yuda akatoka nje. Wakati huo ulikuwa ni usiku. Yesu Atabiri Petro Kumkana (Mathayo 26:31-35; Marko 14:27-31; Luka 22:31-34)

english: When Judas had gone out, Jesus said, “Now the Son of Man is glorified, and God is glorified in Him.
ekegusii: Erio oyio gasokire, Yeso akabora, “Bono Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto obakirwe, na Nyasae obakirwe ime yaye.
swahili: Baada ya Yuda kutoka nje, Yesu akasema, “Sasa Mwana wa Adamu ametukuzwa, naye Mungu ametukuzwa ndani yake.

english: If God is glorified in Him, God will also glorify the Son in Himself—and will glorify Him at once.
ekegusii: Onye Nyasae okobakwa ime yaye, Nyasae boigo namobake ime yaye omonyene, na komobaka erio kegima.
swahili: Ikiwa Mungu ametukuzwa ndani ya Mwana, Mungu atamtukuza Mwana ndani yake mwenyewe naye atamtukuza mara.

english: Little children, I am with you only a little while longer. You will look for Me, and as I said to the Jews, so now I say to you: ‘Where I am going, you cannot come.’
ekegusii: Abana abake, nkere ekero egeke inde amo nainwe. Namondigie; korende buna natebeetie Abayahudi, ng’a aase ngochia inche, inwe timokonyara gochao, bono nabateebirie nainwe.
swahili: “Watoto wangu, mimi bado niko pamoja nanyi kwa kitambo kidogo. Mtanitafuta, na kama vile nilivyowaambia Wayahudi, vivyo hivyo sasa nawaambia na ninyi. Niendako, ninyi hamwezi kuja.

english: A new commandment I give you: Love one another. As I have loved you, so you also must love one another.
ekegusii: Ogochika okoyia nabaeire nakwo oko, mwanchane. Buna nabanchete inwe, nainwe mwanchane boigo.
swahili: “Amri mpya nawapa: Mpendane kama mimi nilivyowapenda ninyi, vivyo hivyo nanyi mpendane.

english: By this everyone will know that you are My disciples, if you love one another.” Jesus Predicts Peter’s Denial (Matthew 26:31–35; Mark 14:27–31; Luke 22:31–38)
ekegusii: Igo abanto bonsi nabamanye ng’a naborokigwa baane more, komorabe nobwanchani inwe ase inwe.” Ogokana gwa Petero gokobanwa (Mat 26:31-35; Mar 14:27-31; Luk 22:31-34)
swahili: Kama mkipendana ninyi kwa ninyi, kwa njia hii, watu wote watajua kuwa ninyi ni wanafunzi wangu.”

english: “Lord, where are You going?” Simon Peter asked. Jesus answered, “Where I am going, you cannot follow Me now, but you will follow later.”
ekegusii: Simioni Petero akamobooria, “Omonene, ng’ai okogenda?” Yeso akamoiraneria, “Aase ngochia tokonyara gontunyana bono, korende nontunyane magega.”
swahili: Simoni Petro akamuuliza, “Bwana, unakwenda wapi?” Yesu akamjibu, “Ninakokwenda huwezi kunifuata sasa, lakini utanifuata baadaye.”

english: “Lord,” said Peter, “why can’t I follow You now? I will lay down my life for You.”
ekegusii: Petero akamoteebia, “Omonene, nase ki ntanyare kogotunyana bono? Nindue obogima bwane ase engencho yao.”
swahili: Petro akamuuliza tena, “Bwana, kwa nini siwezi kukufuata sasa? Mimi niko tayari kuutoa uhai wangu kwa ajili yako.”

english: “Will you lay down your life for Me?” Jesus replied. “Truly, truly, I tell you, before the rooster crows, you will deny Me three times.
ekegusii: Yeso akamoiraneria, “Inee! Obogima bwao noborue ase engencho yane? Ekeene, ekeene, nagotebirie: Etuoni tekobuga goika gwankanire ara gatato.
swahili: Yesu akamjibu, “Je, ni kweli uko tayari kuutoa uhai wako kwa ajili yangu? Amin, amin nakuambia, kabla jogoo hajawika, utanikana mara tatu.”

english: So He got up from the supper, laid aside His outer garments, and wrapped a towel around His waist.
ekegusii: Akaimoka korwa ase endagera, akabeeka chianga chiaye ensemo, akabogoria egetambaa, akeboyia.
swahili: hivyo aliondoka chakulani, akavua vazi lake la nje, akajifunga kitambaa kiunoni.

english: After that, He poured water into a basin and began to wash the disciples’ feet and dry them with the towel that was around Him.
ekegusii: Erio akabeeka amaache ase esani, agachaaka gosibia aborokigwa baye amagoro abo, na koyatinyia negetambaa keria eboyetie.
swahili: Kisha akamimina maji kwenye sinia na kuanza kuwanawisha wanafunzi wake miguu na kuikausha kwa kile kitambaa alichokuwa amejifunga kiunoni.

english: He came to Simon Peter, who asked Him, “Lord, are You going to wash my feet?”
ekegusii: Nabo agaika ase Simioni Petero, Oyo akamoteebia, “Omonene! Aye ngosibia ore amagoro aane?”
swahili: Alipomfikia Simoni Petro, Petro akamwambia, “Bwana, je, wewe utaninawisha mimi miguu?”

english: Jesus replied, “You do not realize now what I am doing, but later you will understand.”
ekegusii: Yeso akairaneria, akamoteebia, “Aya ngokora inche, tokoyamanya bono, korende noyamanye magega.”
swahili: Yesu akamjibu, “Hivi sasa hutambui lile ninalofanya, lakini baadaye utaelewa.”

english: “Never shall You wash my feet!” Peter told Him. Jesus answered, “Unless I wash you, you have no part with Me.”
ekegusii: Petero akamokania, “Togonsibia amagoro aane nonya ng’ake.” Yeso akamoteebia, “Ntagosibeti, tori nobomo amo nainche.”
swahili: Petro akamwambia, “La, wewe hutaninawisha miguu kamwe.” Yesu akamjibu, “Kama nisipokunawisha, wewe huna sehemu nami.”

english: “Then, Lord,” Simon Peter replied, “not only my feet, but my hands and my head as well!”
ekegusii: Erio Simioni Petero akamoteebia, “Omonene, tari amagoro aane oka, korende nonya namaboko na omotwe one.”
swahili: Ndipo Simoni Petro akajibu, “Usininawishe miguu peke yake, Bwana, bali pamoja na mikono na kichwa pia!”

english: “Do not let your hearts be troubled. You believe in God; believe in Me as well.
ekegusii: “Timoichana ase chinkoro chiaino; momwegene Nyasae, nainche monyegene.
swahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Msifadhaike mioyoni mwenu, mnamwamini Mungu, niaminini na mimi pia.

english: Do you not believe that I am in the Father and the Father is in Me? The words I say to you, I do not speak on My own. Instead, it is the Father dwelling in Me, performing His works.
ekegusii: Tibwegeneti ng’a inche nigo inde ime ya Tata, na Tata ime yane? Amang’ana aya inche nkobateebia, tindi gokwana ase okobua kwane, korende n’Tata ore ime yane nigo agokora emeremo yaye.
swahili: Je, huamini ya kuwa mimi niko ndani ya Baba, naye Baba yuko ndani yangu? Maneno ninayowaambia siyasemi kwa ajili yangu mwenyewe, bali Baba akaaye ndani yangu ndiye atendaye hizi kazi.

english: Believe Me that I am in the Father and the Father is in Me—or at least believe on account of the works themselves.
ekegusii: Inyegene ng’a inche nigo inde ime ya Tata, na Tata ime yane; gose inyegene ase engencho y’emeremo emenyene.
swahili: Nisadiki mimi kwamba niko ndani ya Baba na Baba yuko ndani yangu, la sivyo, niaminini kwa sababu ya zile kazi nizitendazo.

english: Truly, truly, I tell you, whoever believes in Me will also do the works that I am doing. He will do even greater things than these, because I am going to the Father.
ekegusii: “Ekeene, ekeene, nabateebirie: Oyoranyegene inche, emeremo ngokora inche, nere nayekore; nakore naende emenene kobua eye, ekiagera nkogenda nde ase Tata.
swahili: Amin, amin nawaambia, yeyote aniaminiye mimi, kazi nizifanyazo yeye atazifanya, naam na kubwa kuliko hizi atazifanya, kwa sababu mimi ninakwenda kwa Baba.

english: And I will do whatever you ask in My name, so that the Father may be glorified in the Son.
ekegusii: Kende gionsi morasabe ase erieta riane, ekio nangekore, erinde Tata abakwe ime ase Omwana.
swahili: Nanyi mkiomba lolote kwa Jina langu, hilo nitalifanya, ili Baba apate kutukuzwa katika Mwana.

english: If you ask Me for anything in My name, I will do it. Jesus Promises the Holy Spirit (John 16:5–16)
ekegusii: Komorasabe kende gionsi ase erieta riane, ekio ningekore. Yeso okoriera aborokigwa baye eira ng’a nabatomere Omoika Omochenu
swahili: Kama mkiniomba lolote kwa Jina langu nitalifanya. Yesu Aahidi Roho Mtakatifu

english: If you love Me, you will keep My commandments.
ekegusii: “Komoranyanche namobwate amachiiko aane.
swahili: “Kama mnanipenda, mtazishika amri zangu.

english: And I will ask the Father, and He will give you another Advocate to be with you forever—
ekegusii: Naende inche ninsambe Tata, na ere nabae Omokonyi onde oyoramenye amo nainwe goika kare na kare,
swahili: Nami nitamwomba Baba, naye atawapa Msaidizi mwingine akae nanyi milele.

english: the Spirit of truth. The world cannot receive Him, because it neither sees Him nor knows Him. But you do know Him, for He abides with you and will be in you.
ekegusii: Omoika bw’ekeene. Ense etanyare komwancha, ekiagera temorochi, nonya nkomomanya. Korende inwe mwamomanyire, ekiagera namenyete amo nainwe, naende nabe ime yaino.
swahili: Huyo ndiye Roho wa kweli ambaye ulimwengu hauwezi kumpokea, kwa sababu haumwoni wala haumjui. Ninyi mnamjua kwa kuwa yuko pamoja nanyi naye anakaa ndani yenu.

english: I will not leave you as orphans; I will come to you.
ekegusii: “Tinkobatiga inwe buna chintakana; ninchiche ase more.
swahili: Sitawaacha ninyi yatima, naja kwenu.

english: In a little while the world will see Me no more, but you will see Me. Because I live, you also will live.
ekegusii: Nkere ekero egeke, ense etandore naende; korende inwe namondore, ekiagera inche moyo inde, na inwe namobe moyo.
swahili: Bado kitambo kidogo ulimwengu hautaniona tena, ila ninyi mtaniona, kwa kuwa mimi ni hai, ninyi nanyi mtakuwa hai.

english: In My Father’s house are many rooms. If it were not so, would I have told you that I am going there to prepare a place for you?
ekegusii: Ase enyomba ya Tata nere nobomenyo obonge; onye taibo, anga nabateebia. Nkogenda nde kobaroiseria aase.
swahili: Nyumbani kwa Baba yangu kuna makao mengi. Kama sivyo, ningeliwaambia. Naenda kuwaandalia makao.

english: On that day you will know that I am in My Father, and you are in Me, and I am in you.
ekegusii: Ase rituko riria namomanye ng’a inche nigo inde ime ase Tata, na inwe ime yane, na inche ime yaino.
swahili: Wakati huo mtajua ya kuwa mimi niko ndani ya Baba na ninyi mko ndani yangu na mimi niko ndani yenu.

english: Whoever has My commandments and keeps them is the one who loves Me. The one who loves Me will be loved by My Father, and I will love him and reveal Myself to him.”
ekegusii: Oyore namachiiko aane, na koyabwata, oyio nere onyanchete; ere oyonyanchete nanchwe na Tata one, na inche nimwanche na kweorokia asare.”
swahili: Yeyote mwenye amri zangu na kuzishika ndiye anipendaye, naye anipendaye atapendwa na Baba yangu, nami nitampenda na kujidhihirisha kwake.”

english: Judas (not Iscariot) asked Him, “Lord, why are You going to reveal Yourself to us and not to the world?”
ekegusii: Yudasi (tari oria o Iskariota) akamobooria, “Omonene, naki yaba ng’a norigetie kweorokia ase tore, gose tari ase ense?”
swahili: Ndipo Yuda, siyo Iskariote, akamwambia, “Bwana, itakuwaje kwamba utajidhihirisha kwetu na si kwa ulimwengu?”

english: Jesus replied, “If anyone loves Me, he will keep My word. My Father will love him, and We will come to him and make Our home with him.
ekegusii: Yeso akamoiraneria, “Omonto karanyanche, abwate ring’ana riane, naende Tata one namwanche, na intwe natoche asare, tokore obomenyo bwaito amo nere.
swahili: Yesu akamjibu, “Mtu yeyote akinipenda atalishika neno langu na Baba yangu atampenda, nasi tutakuja kwake na kufanya makao yetu kwake.

english: Whoever does not love Me does not keep My words. The word that you hear is not My own, but it is from the Father who sent Me.
ekegusii: Oyotanyancheti, tabwateti amang’ana aane; naende ring’ana mwaigure tari eriane, korende neria Tata oyontomete.
swahili: Mtu yeyote asiyenipenda hayashiki maneno yangu na maneno niliyowapa si yangu bali ni ya Baba aliyenituma.

english: All this I have spoken to you while I am still with you.
ekegusii: “Aya nabateebirie ekero inde ase more.
swahili: “Nimewaambia mambo haya yote wakati bado niko pamoja nanyi.

english: But the Advocate, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in My name, will teach you all things and will remind you of everything I have told you. Peace I Leave with You
ekegusii: Korende Omokonyi, Omoika Omochenu, oyo Tata aratome ase erieta riane, ere naborokererie onsi, na kobainyoria onsi aya nabateebirie.
swahili: Lakini huyo Msaidizi, yaani, huyo Roho Mtakatifu, ambaye Baba atamtuma kwenu kwa Jina langu, atawafundisha mambo yote na kuwakumbusha yote niliyowaambia.

english: Peace I leave with you; My peace I give to you. I do not give to you as the world gives. Do not let your hearts be troubled; do not be afraid.
ekegusii: Omorembe nabatigeire; omorembe one nabaeire; tinkoyobaa buna ense ekoyobaa. Timoichana ase chinkoro chiaino, gose timoba nobwoba.
swahili: Amani nawaachia, amani yangu nawapa, amani hii niwapayo si kama ile ulimwengu utoayo. Msifadhaike mioyoni mwenu, wala msiogope.

english: You heard Me say, ‘I am going away, and I am coming back to you.’ If you loved Me, you would rejoice that I am going to the Father, because the Father is greater than I.
ekegusii: Mwaigwete inche nkobateebia: Nkogenda nde, na ninchiche naende ase more. Onye mwanyanchete, anga mwagogete, ekiagera nkogenda nde ase Tata, ekiagera Tata nomonene kombua.
swahili: “Mlinisikia nikisema, ‘Ninakwenda zangu, lakini nitarudi tena.’ Kama kweli mngelinipenda mngelifurahi kwa kuwa naenda kwa Baba, kwani Baba ni mkuu kuniliko mimi.

english: And now I have told you before it happens, so that when it does happen, you will believe.
ekegusii: Na bono nabateebirie ritang’ani ataraba, erinde ekero akoba, mwegene.
swahili: Nimewaambia mambo haya kabla hayajatukia, ili yatakapotukia mpate kuamini.

english: And if I go and prepare a place for you, I will come back and welcome you into My presence, so that you also may be where I am.
ekegusii: Kondagende kobaroiseria aase, ninchiche naende, nimbaroisie ase ’nde, erinde ase ’nde inche, nainwe mobeo.
swahili: Nami nikienda na kuwaandalia makao, nitarudi tena na kuwachukua mkae pamoja nami, ili mahali nilipo, nanyi mpate kuwepo.

english: I will not speak with you much longer, for the prince of this world is coming, and he has no claim on Me.
ekegusii: Tingokwana nainwe amang’ana amange naende, ekiagera omonene bw’ense ngocha are. Tari nokobua ase ’nde;
swahili: Sitasema nanyi zaidi, kwa sababu yule mkuu wa ulimwengu huu anakuja, naye hana kitu kwangu,

english: But I do exactly what the Father has commanded Me, so that the world may know that I love the Father. Get up! Let us go on from here.
ekegusii: korende nigo ngokora buna Tata achigeete, erinde ense emanye ng’a nimwanchete Tata. Imoka, torue aa!
swahili: lakini ulimwengu upate kujua kuwa ninampenda Baba, nami hufanya vile Baba alivyoniamuru. “Haya inukeni; twendeni zetu.

english: You know the way to the place where I am going. ” The Way, the Truth, and the Life
ekegusii: Nase nkogenda inche, mwamanyire enchera.”
swahili: Ninyi mnajua njia ya kufika ninakokwenda.” Yesu Ndiye Njia Ya Kwenda Kwa Baba

english: “Lord,” said Thomas, “we do not know where You are going, so how can we know the way?”
ekegusii: Thomas akamobooria, “Omonene, titomanyeti aase ogochia, naki toramanye enchera?”
swahili: Tomaso akamwambia, “Bwana, sisi hatujui unakokwenda, tutaijuaje njia?”

english: Jesus answered, “I am the way and the truth and the life. No one comes to the Father except through Me.
ekegusii: Yeso akamoiraneria, “Inche ninche enchera, na ekeene, na obogima; monto onde tagocha ase Tata otatiga goetera ase ’nde.
swahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Mimi ndimi njia na kweli na uzima. Mtu hawezi kuja kwa Baba isipokuwa kwa kupitia kwangu.

english: If you had known Me, you would know My Father as well. From now on you do know Him and have seen Him.”
ekegusii: Onye imwamanyete inche, anga imwamomanyete Tata boigo; korwa bono mwamomanyire, naende mwamororire.”
swahili: Kama mngenijua mimi, mngemjua na Baba pia. Tangu sasa, mnamjua Baba yangu, tena mmemwona.”

english: Philip said to Him, “Lord, show us the Father, and that will be enough for us.”
ekegusii: Filipo akamoteebia, “Omonene, tworokie Tata, toisaneke.”
swahili: Filipo akamwambia, “Bwana, tuonyeshe Baba yako yatosha.”

english: Jesus replied, “Philip, I have been with you all this time, and still you do not know Me? Anyone who has seen Me has seen the Father. How can you say, ‘Show us the Father’?
ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Nabeire amo nainwe amatuko aya onsi, na aye tomanyeti, Filipo? Oyondorire inche, ororire na Tata; naki aye ogoteeba: Tworokie Tata?
swahili: Yesu akamjibu, “Filipo, nimekaa nanyi muda huu wote hata usinijue? Mtu yeyote aliyeniona mimi, amemwona Baba. Sasa wawezaje kusema, ‘Tuonyeshe Baba’?

english: “I am the true vine, and My Father is the keeper of the vineyard.
ekegusii: “Inche ninche omosabibu bw’ekeene, na Tata one nomooroiseria.
swahili: “Mimi ndimi mzabibu wa kweli na Baba yangu ndiye mkulima.

english: If you keep My commandments, you will remain in My love, just as I have kept My Father’s commandments and remain in His love.
ekegusii: Komorabwate amachiiko aane, namomenye ase obwanchani bwane, buna inche nabwatete amachiiko a Tata one na komenya ase obwanchani bwaye.
swahili: Mkizishika amri zangu mtakaa katika pendo langu, kama mimi nilivyozishika amri za Baba yangu na kukaa katika pendo lake.

english: I have told you these things so that My joy may be in you and your joy may be complete.
ekegusii: Aya nabateebirie, erinde omogooko one obe ime yaino, naende ng’a omogooko oino oikeranigwe.
swahili: Nimewaambia mambo haya ili furaha yangu iwe ndani yenu na furaha yenu iwe kamili.

english: This is My commandment, that you love one another as I have loved you.
ekegusii: “Richiko riane nario eri: Mwanchane buna nabanchete inwe.
swahili: Amri yangu ndiyo hii: Mpendane kama mimi nilivyowapenda ninyi.

english: Greater love has no one than this, that he lay down his life for his friends.
ekegusii: Onde tari ore nobwanchani obonene kobua obo, obw’omonto akorua obogima bwaye ase engencho y’abasani baye.
swahili: Hakuna mtu mwenye upendo mkuu kuliko huu, mtu kuutoa uhai wake kwa ajili ya rafiki zake.

english: You are My friends if you do what I command you.
ekegusii: Inwe nigo more abasani baane, komorakore aya nabachiikire.
swahili: Ninyi ni rafiki zangu mkifanya ninayowaamuru.

english: No longer do I call you servants, for a servant does not understand what his master is doing. But I have called you friends, because everything I have learned from My Father I have made known to you.
ekegusii: Tinkobaroka naende abasomba, ekiagera omosomba tamanyeti eki omonene oye agokora; korende inwe nabarokire abasani, ekiagera onsi aya naigwete korwa ase Tata nabaorokeirie.
swahili: Siwaiti ninyi watumishi tena, kwa sababu watumishi hawajui bwana wao analofanya, bali nimewaita ninyi rafiki, kwa maana nimewajulisha mambo yote niliyoyasikia kutoka kwa Baba yangu.

english: You did not choose Me, but I chose you. And I appointed you to go and bear fruit—fruit that will remain—so that whatever you ask the Father in My name, He will give you.
ekegusii: Tari inwe mwanchorire inche, korende ninche nabachorire inwe, nababekire mogende kwama, okwama kwaino goikaranse; erio rinde rionsi mogosaba Tata ase erieta riane, nigo arabae. Ense na Omoika bw’ekeene
swahili: Si ninyi mlionichagua, bali mimi ndiye niliyewachagua ninyi na kuwaweka mwende mkazae matunda, na matunda yenu yapate kudumu. Ili nalo lolote mtakalomwomba Baba katika Jina langu, awape ninyi.

english: This is My command to you: Love one another. The Hatred of the World
ekegusii: “Aya nabachiikire naro aya: mwanchane.
swahili: Amri yangu ndiyo hii: Mpendane. Ulimwengu Wawachukia Wanafunzi

english: If the world hates you, understand that it hated Me first.
ekegusii: Ense kerabageche, momanyete ng’a yangechire inche etarabagecha inwe.
swahili: “Kama ulimwengu ukiwachukia ninyi, kumbukeni kwamba ulinichukia mimi kabla yenu.

english: If you were of the world, it would love you as its own. Instead, the world hates you, because you are not of the world, but I have chosen you out of the world.
ekegusii: Onye nab’ense mware, anga ense ’yancha abare abaye, korende ekiagera inwe timori ab’ense, otatiga inche nabachorire korwa ase ense, ase ayio ense yabagechire.
swahili: Kama mngekuwa wa ulimwengu, ulimwengu ungeliwapenda kama vile unavyowapenda walio wake. Kwa sababu ninyi si wa ulimwengu, lakini mimi nimewachagua kutoka ulimwengu, hii ndiyo sababu ulimwengu unawachukia.

english: He cuts off every branch in Me that bears no fruit, and every branch that does bear fruit, He prunes to make it even more fruitful.
ekegusii: Kera orosagia ime ase ’nde orotameti, nigo akoronacha, na kera orokwama nigo akorososa, erinde romente kwama.
swahili: Kila tawi ndani yangu lisilozaa matunda, Baba yangu hulikata, nalo kila tawi lizaalo, hulisafisha ili lipate kuzaa matunda zaidi.

english: Remember the word that I spoke to you: ‘No servant is greater than his master.’ If they persecuted Me, they will persecute you as well; if they kept My word, they will keep yours as well.
ekegusii: Inyora ring’ana riria nabateebeetie: Omosomba tari omonene kobua omonene oye. Onye banchandete inche, nabaabachande nainwe; onye babwatete ring’ana riane nabwate neriaino.
swahili: Kumbukeni lile neno nililowaambia, ‘Hakuna mtumishi aliye mkuu kuliko bwana wake.’ Kama wamenitesa mimi, nanyi pia watawatesa. Kama wamelishika neno langu, watalishika na neno lenu pia.

english: But they will treat you like this because of My name, since they do not know the One who sent Me.
ekegusii: Korende aya onsi nabaabakorere ase engencho y’erieta riane, ekiagera tibamomanyeti oyontomete.
swahili: Watawatendea ninyi haya yote kwa ajili ya Jina langu, kwa sababu hawamjui yeye aliyenituma.

english: If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not be guilty of sin. Now, however, they have no excuse for their sin.
ekegusii: Onye ntachete gokwana nabarabwo, anga tibarenge nebibe, korende bono tibari nogwekengera ase ebibe biabo.
swahili: Kama sikuja na kusema nao wasingalikuwa na hatia ya dhambi. Lakini sasa hawana udhuru kwa ajili ya dhambi zao.

english: Whoever hates Me hates My Father as well.
ekegusii: Oyongechete inche, nigo amogechete na Tata one.
swahili: Yeyote anayenichukia mimi, anamchukia pia na Baba yangu.

english: If I had not done among them the works that no one else did, they would not be guilty of sin; but now they have seen and hated both Me and My Father.
ekegusii: Onye ntakorete emeremo ase bare eye monto onde atakoreti, anga tibabete nebibe, korende bono barorire, naende batogechire inche na Tata.
swahili: Kama sikuwa nimefanya miujiza ambayo haijapata kufanywa na mtu mwingine yeyote, wasingalikuwa na hatia ya dhambi. Lakini sasa wameiona miujiza hii na bado wakatuchukia mimi na Baba yangu.

english: But this is to fulfill what is written in their Law: ‘They hated Me without reason.’
ekegusii: Korende igo riikerane ring’ana eriarigetwe ase amachiiko abo: Nigo bangechete bosa.
swahili: Lakini hii ni kutimiza lile neno lililoandikwa kwenye Sheria kwamba, ‘Walinichukia pasipo sababu.’

english: When the Advocate comes, whom I will send to you from the Father—the Spirit of truth who proceeds from the Father—He will testify about Me.
ekegusii: Korende karache Omokonyi, oyo ndabatomere korwa ase Tata, Omoika bw’Ekeene okorwa ase Tata, ere nambere kirori.
swahili: “Lakini atakapokuja huyo Msaidizi nitakayemtuma kwenu kutoka kwa Baba, yaani, huyo Roho wa kweli atokaye kwa Baba, yeye atanishuhudia mimi.

english: And you also must testify, because you have been with Me from the beginning.
ekegusii: Na inwe boigo mwambereire birori, ekiagera korwa omochakano mwarenge amo nainche.
swahili: Ninyi nanyi itawapasa kushuhudia kwa sababu mmekuwa pamoja nami tangu mwanzo.

english: You are already clean because of the word I have spoken to you.
ekegusii: Inwe mwaikire koba abachenu ase engencho ye ring’ana nabateebirie.
swahili: Ninyi mmekwisha kuwa safi kwa sababu ya lile neno nililonena nanyi.

english: Remain in Me, and I will remain in you. Just as no branch can bear fruit by itself unless it remains in the vine, neither can you bear fruit unless you remain in Me.
ekegusii: Menya ime yane, na inche ime yaino. Buna orosagia rotanyare kwama rwoka oronyene, rotabeti ime ase omosabibu, naboigo nainwe motamenyeti ime yane.
swahili: Kaeni ndani yangu, nami nikae ndani yenu. Kama vile tawi lisivyoweza kuzaa matunda lisipokaa ndani ya mzabibu, vivyo hivyo ninyi msipokaa ndani yangu hamwezi kuzaa matunda.

english: I am the vine and you are the branches. The one who remains in Me, and I in him, will bear much fruit. For apart from Me you can do nothing.
ekegusii: Inche nomosabibu, na inwe nechinsagia. Oyo omenyete ime yane, na inche ime yaye, oyio name mono, ekiagera ntaiyo inche, timokonyara gokora kende gionsi.
swahili: “Mimi ni mzabibu, ninyi ni matawi. Akaaye ndani yangu, nami ndani yake, huyo huzaa sana, maana pasipo mimi ninyi hamwezi kufanya jambo lolote.

english: If anyone does not remain in Me, he is like a branch that is thrown away and withers. Such branches are gathered up, thrown into the fire, and burned.
ekegusii: Omonto otamenyeti ime yane, nigo aratugutwe isiko buna orosagia rwomete. Chinsagia chiomete nigo chigosangererigwa, na korutwa ase omorero, na koyia.
swahili: Mtu yeyote asipokaa ndani yangu, hutupwa nje kama tawi na kunyauka. Matawi kama hayo hukusanywa na kutupwa motoni, yakateketea.

english: If you remain in Me and My words remain in you, ask whatever you wish, and it will be done for you.
ekegusii: Komoramenye ime yane, na amang’ana aane karabe ime yaino, saba kera ekemoganetie na inwe namokorerwe.
swahili: Ninyi mkikaa ndani yangu na maneno yangu yakikaa ndani yenu, ombeni lolote mtakalo, nanyi mtatendewa.

english: This is to My Father’s glory, that you bear much fruit, proving yourselves to be My disciples. No Greater Love
ekegusii: Ase ayio Tata abakwe ekero mwamire mono; na inwe namobe aborokigwa baane.
swahili: Kwa hiyo Baba yangu hutukuzwa, kwa vile mzaavyo matunda mengi, nanyi mtakuwa wanafunzi wangu.

english: As the Father has loved Me, so have I loved you. Remain in My love.
ekegusii: Buna Tata anyanchete inche, na inche nabanchire inwe, menya ase obwanchani bwane.
swahili: “Kama vile Baba alivyonipenda mimi, hivyo ndivyo mimi nilivyowapenda ninyi. Basi kaeni katika pendo langu.

english: “I have told you these things so that you will not fall away.
ekegusii: “Amang’ana aya nabateebirie timocha kogochwa.
swahili: “Nimewaambia mambo haya yote ili msije mkaiacha imani.

english: in regard to righteousness, because I am going to the Father and you will no longer see Me;
ekegusii: ase amang’ana ’oboronge, ekiagera nkogenda nde ase Tata, gose timokondora naende;
swahili: kwa habari ya haki, kwa sababu ninakwenda kwa Baba, nanyi hamtaniona tena,

english: and in regard to judgment, because the prince of this world has been condemned.
ekegusii: ase amang’ana ’ekina, ekiagera omonene bw’ense eye okoorire kogambigwa.
swahili: kwa habari ya hukumu, kwa sababu yule mkuu wa ulimwengu huu amekwisha kuhukumiwa.

english: I still have much to tell you, but you cannot yet bear to hear it.
ekegusii: “Ninde nayande amange atigarete nkobateebia, korende timokonyara koyaremereria bono.
swahili: “Bado ninayo mambo mengi ya kuwaambia, lakini hamwezi kuyastahimili sasa.

english: However, when the Spirit of truth comes, He will guide you into all truth. For He will not speak on His own, but He will speak what He hears, and He will declare to you what is to come.
ekegusii: Korende ekero arache ere, Omoika bw’Ekeene, nobaraae ase onsi ayare ay’ekeene, ere tagokwana ayare ayaye, korende onsi ayaranyare koigwa nayakwane, naende amang’ana agochi‐gocha nabateebie engencho yaye.
swahili: Atakapokuja huyo Roho wa kweli atawaongoza awatie katika kweli yote. Yeye hatanena kwa ajili yake mwenyewe, bali atanena yale yote atakayosikia, naye atawaonyesha mambo yajayo.

english: He will glorify Me by taking from what is Mine and disclosing it to you.
ekegusii: Ere nambake inche, ekiagera nabogorie ayare ayane, nabayaorokerie.
swahili: Atanitukuza mimi, kwa maana atayachukua yaliyo yangu na kuwajulisha ninyi.

english: Everything that belongs to the Father is Mine. That is why I said that the Spirit will take from what is Mine and disclose it to you.
ekegusii: Onsi ayare aya Tata nayane; ase ayio ngateba ng’a nabogorie ayare ayane, nabayaorokerie. Yeso ogoakera aborokigwa baye ng’a batigare buya
swahili: Vyote alivyo navyo Baba ni vyangu. Ndiyo maana nimesema Roho atachukua yaliyo yangu na kuwajulisha ninyi.

english: In a little while you will see Me no more, and then after a little while you will see Me. ” Grief Will Turn to Joy
ekegusii: “Nkere ekero egeke, inwe motandore; naende nkere ekero egeke morandore, ekiagera nkogenda nde ase Tata.”
swahili: “Bado kitambo kidogo nanyi hamtaniona na tena bado kitambo kidogo nanyi mtaniona.” Huzuni Itageuka Kuwa Furaha

english: Then some of His disciples asked one another, “Why is He telling us, ‘In a little while you will not see Me, and then after a little while you will see Me’ and ‘Because I am going to the Father’?”
ekegusii: Nabo abande baborokigwa baye bagateebania, “Ing’ana ki eri agoteeba: Nkere ekero egeke, inwe motandore; naende nkere ekero egeke morandore; na: Nkogenda nde ase Tata?”
swahili: Baadhi ya wanafunzi wakaulizana, “Ana maana gani asemapo, ‘Bado kitambo kidogo nanyi hamtaniona na tena bado kitambo kidogo nanyi mtaniona’? Naye ana maana gani asemapo, ‘Kwa sababu ninakwenda kwa Baba’?”

english: They kept asking, “Why is He saying, ‘a little while’? We do not understand what He is saying.”
ekegusii: Nabo bagateeba, “Ing’ana ki eri agoteeba, ng’a nkere ekero egeke? Titomanyeti eri agokwana.”
swahili: Wakaendelea kuulizana, “Ana maana gani asemapo, ‘Kitambo kidogo’? Hatuelewi hilo analosema.”

english: Aware that they wanted to question Him, Jesus said to them, “Are you asking one another why I said, ‘In a little while you will not see Me, and then after a little while you will see Me’?
ekegusii: Yeso akamanya ng’a mbarigetie komoboria, akabateebia, “Inee! Nigo mokoborania inwe ase inwe ase erio natebiire: Nkere ekero egeke, inwe motandore, naende nkere ekero egeke morandore?
swahili: Yesu akatambua kuwa walitaka kumuuliza juu ya hilo, hivyo akawaambia, “Je, mnaulizana nina maana gani niliposema, ‘Bado kitambo kidogo nanyi hamtaniona na tena bado kitambo kidogo nanyi mtaniona’?

english: They will put you out of the synagogues. In fact, a time is coming when anyone who kills you will think he is offering a service to God.
ekegusii: Nabaabaserie korwa ase chisinagogi; nabo engaki neche ekero onde bwensi arabaite akage ng’a okoreire Nyasae emeremo.
swahili: Watawatenga na masinagogi. Naam, saa yaja ambayo mtu yeyote atakayewaua atadhani kwa kufanya hivyo anamtumikia Mungu.

english: Truly, truly, I tell you, you will weep and wail while the world rejoices. You will grieve, but your grief will turn to joy.
ekegusii: Ekeene, ekeene, nabateebirie: Inwe namorere na kweng’ereria, korende ense negoke; inwe namoichanigwe, korende ogoichana kwaino nakoonchoke koba omogooko.
swahili: Amin, amin nawaambia, ninyi mtalia na kuomboleza, lakini ulimwengu utafurahi. Ninyi mtahuzunika, lakini huzuni yenu itageuka kuwa furaha.

english: A woman has pain in childbirth because her time has come; but when she brings forth her child, she forgets her anguish because of her joy that a child has been born into the world.
ekegusii: Omokungu gakobina ase okoibora, nigo are nomoichano, ekiagera ensa yaye yaikire; korende gaikire koibora omwana, tari koinyora obororo bwaye naende, ase engencho y’omogooko bw’okoiborwa kw’omonto ase ense.
swahili: Mwanamke anapokuwa na utungu wa kuzaa huwa na maumivu kwa sababu saa yake imewadia. Lakini mtoto akiisha kuzaliwa, yule mwanamke husahau maumivu hayo kwa sababu ya furaha ya kuzaliwa mtoto ulimwenguni.

english: So also you have sorrow now, but I will see you again and your hearts will rejoice, and no one will take away your joy. Ask in My Name (Matthew 18:19–20)
ekegusii: Nabo nainwe bono nigo more nomoichano; korende nimbarore naende, ne chinkoro chiaino nachigoke, na omogooko oino onde tari orabaure.
swahili: Hivyo ninyi mna maumivu sasa, lakini nitawaona tena, nayo mioyo yenu itafurahi na furaha yenu hakuna awaondoleaye.

english: In that day you will no longer ask Me anything. Truly, truly, I tell you, whatever you ask the Father in My name, He will give you.
ekegusii: Ase rituko riria timokomboria ring’ana. Ekeene, ekeene, nabateebirie: Komorasabe Tata kende gionsi ase erieta riane nabae.
swahili: Katika siku hiyo hamtaniuliza neno lolote. Amin, amin nawaambia, kama mkimwomba Baba jambo lolote kwa jina langu, yeye atawapa.

english: Until now you have not asked for anything in My name. Ask and you will receive, so that your joy may be complete.
ekegusii: Goika reero timorasaba gento ase erieta riane; saba, namonyore, erinde omogooko oino obe omoikeranu.
swahili: Mpaka sasa hamjaomba jambo lolote kwa Jina langu. Ombeni nanyi mtapewa, ili furaha yenu ipate kuwa kamili. Amani Kwa Wanafunzi

english: I have spoken these things to you in figures of speech. An hour is coming when I will no longer speak to you this way, but will tell you plainly about the Father.
ekegusii: “Aya nakwanire nainwe ase emereng’anio; engaki neche ntakwane naende ase emereng’anio, korende nimborokie maiso marore amang’ana a Tata.
swahili: “Nimewaambia mambo haya kwa mafumbo. Saa yaja ambapo sitazungumza nanyi tena kwa mafumbo bali nitawaeleza waziwazi kuhusu Baba.

english: In that day you will ask in My name. I am not saying that I will ask the Father on your behalf.
ekegusii: Ase rituko riria namosabe ase erieta riane; tinkobateebia ng’a nimbasabere ase Tata,
swahili: Siku hiyo mtaomba kwa Jina langu. Wala sitawaambia kwamba nitamwomba Baba kwa ajili yenu,

english: For the Father Himself loves you, because you have loved Me and have believed that I came from God.
ekegusii: ekiagera Tata omonyene nigo abanchete inwe, ekiagera inwe mwanyanchire inche, na mwegenire ng’a inche nigo narwete ase Tata.
swahili: kwa maana Baba mwenyewe anawapenda, kwa sababu mmenipenda mimi na mmeamini kwamba nimetoka kwa Mungu.

english: I came from the Father and entered the world. In turn, I will leave the world and go to the Father.”
ekegusii: Narwete ase Tata, ngacha ase ense; naende ngotiga nde ense na nkoirana nde ase Tata.”
swahili: Nilitoka kwa Baba na kuja ulimwenguni, sasa naondoka ulimwenguni na kurudi kwa Baba.”

english: His disciples said, “See, now You are speaking plainly and without figures of speech.
ekegusii: Aborokigwa baye bakaboora, “Rora, bono ngokwana ore maiso marore, gose tori gokwana omobayeeno onde bwonsi.
swahili: Ndipo wanafunzi wake wakasema, “Sasa unazungumza waziwazi, wala si kwa mafumbo.

english: They will do these things because they have not known the Father or Me.
ekegusii: Naende ayio nabaabakorere, ekiagera tibamomanyeti Tata, nonya ninche.
swahili: Nao watawatenda haya kwa sababu hawamjui Baba wala mimi.

english: Now we understand that You know all things and that You have no need for anyone to question You. Because of this, we believe that You came from God.”
ekegusii: Bono twamanyire ng’a kwamanyire onsi, torigeti omonto akoborie. Ase ayio twegenire ng’a nigo kwarwete ase Nyasae.”
swahili: Sasa tumejua kwamba wewe unajua mambo yote, wala hakuna haja ya mtu kukuuliza maswali. Kwa jambo hili tunaamini kwamba ulitoka kwa Mungu.”

english: “Do you finally believe?” Jesus replied.
ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, “Inee! Igo bono mwegenire?
swahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Je, sasa mnaamini?

english: “Look, an hour is coming and has already come when you will be scattered, each to his own home, and you will leave Me all alone. Yet I am not alone, because the Father is with Me.
ekegusii: Rora engaki neche, ee nabo yaikire gocha, namwatananeke, kera oyomo ase mwaye, namontige inche bweka, korende tindi inche bweka, ekiagera Tata nigo are amo nainche.
swahili: Saa inakuja, naam, imekwisha kuwadia, mtakapotawanyika kila mmoja kwenda nyumbani kwake na kuniacha peke yangu. Lakini mimi siko peke yangu kwa sababu Baba yu pamoja nami.

english: I have told you these things so that in Me you may have peace. In the world you will have tribulation. But take courage; I have overcome the world!”
ekegusii: Aya nabateebirie, erinde monyare koba nomorembe ime yane. Ase ense namonyore emechando, korende remia emioyo; inche nabuire ense.”
swahili: Nimewaambia mambo haya, ili mpate kuwa na amani mkiwa ndani yangu. Ulimwenguni mtapata dhiki. Lakini jipeni moyo, kwa maana mimi nimeushinda ulimwengu.”

english: But I have told you these things so that when their hour comes, you will remember that I told you about them. I did not tell you these things from the beginning, because I was with you. The Promise of the Holy Spirit (John 14:15–26)
ekegusii: Korende nabateebirie aya, erio engaki eria egocha, moyainyore ng’a inche nabateebeetie. “Tinabateebeetie aya korwa omochakano, ekiagera narenge amo nainwe.
swahili: Lakini nimewaambia ninyi mambo haya, ili saa hiyo ikiwadia mpate kukumbuka ya kuwa nilikuwa nimewaambia. Sikuwaambia mambo haya tangu mwanzo kwa sababu nilikuwa pamoja nanyi. Kazi Ya Roho Mtakatifu

english: Now, however, I am going to Him who sent Me; yet none of you asks Me, ‘Where are You going?’
ekegusii: Korende bono nkogenda nde asare ere oyontomete; gose onde tari ase more okomboria: Ing’ai ogochia?
swahili: “Sasa mimi ninakwenda kwake yeye aliyenituma, lakini hakuna hata aniulizaye, ‘Unakwenda wapi?’

english: Instead, your hearts are filled with sorrow because I have told you these things.
ekegusii: Korende ekiagera nabateebirie aya, omoichano oichoire chinkoro chiaino.
swahili: Kwa sababu nimewaambia mambo haya, mioyo yenu imejawa na huzuni.

english: But I tell you the truth, it is for your benefit that I am going away. Unless I go away, the Advocate will not come to you; but if I go, I will send Him to you.
ekegusii: Korende inche nabateebirie erire ri’ekeene: Nebe buya ase more inche ngende, ekiagera ntagendeti, Omokonyi oria tagocha ase more; korende kondagende, nimotome ase more.
swahili: Lakini nawaambia kweli, yafaa mimi niondoke, kwa kuwa nisipoondoka, huyo Msaidizi hatakuja kwenu, lakini nikienda nitamtuma kwenu.

english: And when He comes, He will convict the world in regard to sin and righteousness and judgment:
ekegusii: Naende ekero arache ere, naenekerie ense ase amang’ana ’ebibe, naende oboronge, naende ekiina;
swahili: Naye atakapokuja, atauthibitishia ulimwengu kuhusu dhambi, haki na hukumu.

english: in regard to sin, because they do not believe in Me;
ekegusii: ase amang’ana ’ebibe, ekiagera tibanyegeneti inche;
swahili: Kwa habari ya dhambi, kwa sababu hawaniamini mimi,

english: When Jesus had spoken these things, He lifted up His eyes to heaven and said, “Father, the hour has come. Glorify Your Son, that Your Son may glorify You.
ekegusii: Ekero Yeso akwanete amang’ana ayio akaimokia amaiso aye, akarigereria igoro, akabora, “Tata, ensa yaikire. Mobake Omwana oo, erinde Omwana nere akobake aye,
swahili: Baada ya Yesu kusema haya, alitazama kuelekea mbinguni akawaombea na kusema: “Baba, saa imewadia. Umtukuze Mwanao, ili Mwanao apate kukutukuza wewe.

english: All I have is Yours, and all You have is Mine; and in them I have been glorified.
ekegusii: Na bonsi abare abaane nabao, na abare abao nabaane, na inche nabakirwe ime yabo.
swahili: Wote walio wangu ni wako na walio wako ni wangu, nami nimetukuzwa ndani yao.

english: I will no longer be in the world, but they are in the world, and I am coming to You. Holy Father, protect them by Your name, the name You gave Me, so that they may be one as We are one.
ekegusii: Inche tinkoba ase ense ime naende, korende aba nao bare ase ense ime, na inche ngocha nde ase ore. Tata Omochenu, obarende ase okobua kw’erieta riao baria kwang’ete, babe abamo buna intwe tore oyomo.
swahili: Mimi sasa simo tena ulimwenguni, lakini wao bado wamo ulimwenguni, nami naja kwako. Baba Mtakatifu, uwalinde kwa uweza wa jina lako ulilonipa, ili wawe na umoja kama sisi tulivyo wamoja.

english: While I was with them, I protected and preserved them by Your name, the name You gave Me. Not one of them has been lost, except the son of destruction, so that the Scripture would be fulfilled.
ekegusii: Ekero narenge amo nabarabwo ase ense, nigo nabarendete ase okobua kw’erieta riao baria kwang’ete. Igo nabaritete, gose tari nonya noyomo obo osirire, otatiga oria omwana bw’obosiru, erinde ririiko rinyare goikeranigwa.
swahili: Nilipokuwa pamoja nao, niliwalinda, wakawa salama kwa lile jina ulilonipa. Hakuna hata mmoja aliyepotea, isipokuwa yule aliyekusudiwa upotevu, ili Maandiko yapate kutimia.

english: But now I am coming to You; and I am saying these things while I am in the world, so that they may have My joy fulfilled within them.
ekegusii: Na bono ngocha nde ase ore, na aya nkoyakwana, inde ase ense ime, erinde omogooko one obe oikeranigwe ime yabo.
swahili: “Lakini sasa naja kwako, nami ninasema mambo haya wakati bado nikiwa ulimwenguni, ili wawe na furaha yangu kamili ndani yao.

english: I have given them Your word and the world has hated them; for they are not of the world, just as I am not of the world.
ekegusii: Inche nabaeire ring’ana riao; ense yabagechire, ekiagera barabwo tibari abanto b’ense, buna inche ntari oyo bw’ense.
swahili: Nimewapa neno lako, nao ulimwengu umewachukia kwa kuwa wao si wa ulimwengu kama mimi nisivyo wa ulimwengu huu.

english: I am not asking that You take them out of the world, but that You keep them from the evil one.
ekegusii: Tinsabeti ng’a obarusie korwa ase ense, korende obarende korwa ase oria omobe.
swahili: Siombi kwamba uwaondoe ulimwenguni, bali uwalinde dhidi ya yule mwovu.

english: They are not of the world, just as I am not of the world.
ekegusii: Barabwo tibari ab’ense, buna inche ntari oyo bw’ense.
swahili: Wao si wa ulimwengu huu, kama vile mimi nisivyo wa ulimwengu.

english: Sanctify them by the truth; Your word is truth.
ekegusii: Obachene ase ekeene; ring’ana riao nario ekeene.
swahili: Uwatakase kwa ile kweli, neno lako ndilo kweli.

english: As You sent Me into the world, I have also sent them into the world.
ekegusii: Buna gwantomete inche ime ase ense, na inche naboigo nabatomire barabwo ase ense ime.
swahili: Kama vile ulivyonituma mimi ulimwenguni, nami nawatuma vivyo hivyo.

english: For them I sanctify Myself, so that they too may be sanctified by the truth. Prayer for All Believers
ekegusii: Na ase engencho yabo nechenire, erinde nabarabwo bachenwe ase ekeene.
swahili: Kwa ajili yao najiweka wakfu ili wao nao wapate kutakaswa katika ile kweli. Yesu Awaombea Wote Wamwaminio

english: For You granted Him authority over all people, so that He may give eternal life to all those You have given Him.
ekegusii: buna kwamoete okobua igoro ase Mwanyabaanto bonsi, erinde bonsi aba kwamoeire, abae obogima bwa kare na kare.
swahili: Kwa kuwa umempa mamlaka juu ya wote wenye mwili ili awape uzima wa milele wale uliompa.

english: I am not asking on behalf of them alone, but also on behalf of those who will believe in Me through their message,
ekegusii: “Gose tari barabwo boka nasabeire, korende na baria baranyegene ase engencho ye ring’ana riabo,
swahili: “Siwaombei hawa peke yao, bali nawaombea na wale wote watakaoniamini kupitia neno lao

english: that all of them may be one, as You, Father, are in Me, and I am in You. May they also be in Us, so that the world may believe that You sent Me.
ekegusii: bonsi babe abamo, buna aye Tata ore ime ase ’nde, na inche ime yao, erinde na aba babe abamo ime yaito; ense enyare kwengena ng’a naye gwantomete.
swahili: ili wawe na umoja kama vile wewe Baba ulivyo ndani yangu na mimi nilivyo ndani yako, wao nao wawe ndani yetu, ili ulimwengu upate kuamini ya kuwa wewe ndiye uliyenituma mimi.

english: I have given them the glory You gave Me, so that they may be one as We are one—
ekegusii: Na obonene boria kwang’ete nabaeire, babe abamo, buna intwe tore oyomo;
swahili: Utukufu ule ulionipa nimewapa wao, ili wawe na umoja kama sisi tulivyo wamoja.

english: I in them and You in Me—that they may be perfectly united, so that the world may know that You sent Me and have loved them just as You have loved Me.
ekegusii: inche ime yabo, na aye ime yane, banyare goikerana babe abamo. Igo ense emanye ng’a naye gwantomete, okabancha barabwo, buna kwanyanchete inche.
swahili: Mimi ndani yako na wewe ndani yangu, ili wawe wamekamilika katika umoja na ulimwengu upate kujua ya kuwa umenituma, nami nimewapenda wao kama unavyonipenda mimi.

english: Father, I want those You have given Me to be with Me where I am, that they may see the glory You gave Me because You loved Me before the foundation of the world.
ekegusii: Tata, abwo kwang’ete, ninganetie babe amo nainche aase aande onsi inde, banyare korigereria obonene bwane kwang’ete, ekiagera nigo kwanyanchete ritang’ani ense etarabekwa oboroso.
swahili: “Baba, shauku yangu ni kwamba, wale ulionipa wawe pamoja nami pale nilipo, ili waweze kuuona utukufu wangu, yaani, utukufu ule ulionipa kwa kuwa ulinipenda hata kabla ya kuwekwa misingi ya ulimwengu.

english: Righteous Father, although the world has not known You, I know You, and they know that You sent Me.
ekegusii: Tata omonyene oboronge, ense tiyakomanyete, korende inche nakomanyete; na aba bamanyire ng’a naye gwantomete.
swahili: “Baba Mwenye Haki, ingawa ulimwengu haukujui, mimi ninakujua, nao wanajua ya kuwa umenituma.

english: And I have made Your name known to them and will continue to make it known, so that the love You have for Me may be in them, and I in them.”
ekegusii: Nabamanyetie erieta riao, naende nimbarimanyie, erinde obwanchani boria kwanyanchete inche bobe ime yabo, na inche imbe ime yabo.”
swahili: Nimefanya jina lako lijulikane kwao nami nitaendelea kufanya lijulikane, ili kwamba upendo ule unaonipenda mimi uwe ndani yao na mimi mwenyewe nipate kuwa ndani yao.”

english: Now this is eternal life, that they may know You, the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom You have sent.
ekegusii: Na obogima bwa kare na kare nabwo obo: bakomanye aye Nyasae bw’ekeene bweka, naende Yeso Kristo gwatomete.
swahili: Nao uzima wa milele ndio huu, wakujue wewe uliye Mungu wa pekee, wa kweli na Yesu Kristo uliyemtuma.

english: I have glorified You on earth by accomplishing the work You gave Me to do.
ekegusii: Inche nakobakire ase ense, emeremo eria kwang’ete gokora nayekoorire.
swahili: Nimekutukuza wewe duniani kwa kuitimiza ile kazi uliyonipa niifanye.

english: And now, Father, glorify Me in Your presence with the glory I had with You before the world existed. Prayer for the Disciples
ekegusii: Na bono Tata, ombake inche amo naye, ase obonene boria narenge nabwo amo naye ritang’ani ense etaratongwa.
swahili: Hivyo sasa, Baba, unitukuze mbele zako kwa ule utukufu niliokuwa nao pamoja na wewe kabla ulimwengu haujakuwepo. Yesu Awaombea Wanafunzi Wake

english: I have revealed Your name to those You have given Me out of the world. They were Yours; You gave them to Me, and they have kept Your word.
ekegusii: “Erieta riao nariorokeirie abanto baria kwang’ete korwa ase ense. Barabwo nigo barenge abao, okabang’a inche, ne ring’ana riao baribwatire.
swahili: “Nimelidhihirisha jina lako kwa wale ulionipa kutoka ulimwengu. Walikuwa wako, nawe ukanipa mimi, nao wamelitii neno lako.

english: Now they know that everything You have given Me comes from You.
ekegusii: Bono bamanyire ng’a onsi aya kwang’ete nigo akorwa ase ore.
swahili: Sasa wamejua ya kuwa vyote ulivyonipa vimetoka kwako,

english: For I have given them the words You gave Me, and they have received them. They knew with certainty that I came from You, and they believed that You sent Me.
ekegusii: Naki amang’ana kwang’ete nabayaeire, na barabwo bayabwatire, mbamanyete ekeene ng’a nigo narure ase ore, bakeegena ng’a naye gwantomete.
swahili: kwa kuwa maneno yale ulionipa nimewapa wao, nao wameyapokea na kujua kwamba kweli nimetoka kwako, nao wameamini kuwa wewe ulinituma.

english: I ask on their behalf. I do not ask on behalf of the world, but on behalf of those You have given Me; for they are Yours.
ekegusii: Inche nabasabeire barabwo; tindi gosabera ense, korende barabwo aba kwang’eire ekiagera barabwo nabao.
swahili: Ninawaombea wao. Mimi siuombei ulimwengu, bali nawaombea wale ulionipa kwa sababu wao ni wako.

english: After Jesus had spoken these words, He went out with His disciples across the Kidron Valley, where they entered a garden.
ekegusii: Yeso gakwanire amang’ana aya, akaimoka amo naborokigwa baye kogenda ng’umbu y’akarooche Kedron, aase omogondo orenge. Ere na aborokigwa baye bagasoa aroro.
swahili: Yesu alipomaliza kuomba, akaondoka na wanafunzi wake wakavuka Bonde la Kidroni. Upande wa pili palikuwa na bustani, yeye na wanafunzi wake wakaingia humo.

english: Then Simon Peter drew his sword and struck the servant of the high priest, cutting off his right ear. The servant’s name was Malchus.
ekegusii: Nabo Simioni Petero narenge nomoyio o birende, akayong’usa, agaaka omosomba bw’Omokuani omonene, akamobutora ogoto kwaye gw’okorio. Na omosomba oria erieta riaye nigo are korokwa Maliko.
swahili: Simoni Petro, aliyekuwa na upanga, akaufuta na kumkata sikio la kuume mtumishi wa kuhani mkuu. Jina la mtumishi huyo aliitwa Malko.

english: “Put your sword back in its sheath!” Jesus said to Peter. “Shall I not drink the cup the Father has given Me?”
ekegusii: Erio Yeso agateebia Petero, “Irania omoyio oo ase ekeraano kiaye. Inee! Egekombe eke Tata ang’eire, tinkenywera?”
swahili: Yesu akamwambia Petro, “Rudisha upanga wako kwenye ala yake. Je, hainipasi kukinywea kikombe alichonipa Baba?” Yesu Mbele Ya Kuhani Mkuu

english: Then the band of soldiers, with its commander and the officers of the Jews, arrested Jesus and bound Him.
ekegusii: Abarwani b’esegi amo nomotang’ani obo, na abarendi baria b’Abayahudi bakabwata Yeso, bakamosiba.
swahili: Hivyo wale askari, wakiwa pamoja na majemadari wao na maafisa wa Wayahudi, wakamkamata Yesu na kumfunga.

english: They brought Him first to Annas, who was the father-in-law of Caiaphas, the high priest that year.
ekegusii: Erio bakamoira ritang’ani ase Anasi oyorenge ise biara Kayafa, oria orenge Omokuani omonene omwaka oria.
swahili: Kwanza wakampeleka kwa Anasi, mkwewe Kayafa, aliyekuwa kuhani mkuu mwaka ule.

english: Caiaphas was the one who had advised the Jews that it would be better if one man died for the people. Peter’s First Denial (Matthew 26:69–70; Mark 14:66–68; Luke 22:54–57)
ekegusii: Na Kayafa nere oete Abayahudi amang’ana ng’a negwenerete omonto oyomo akwe ase engencho y’abanto. Petero ogokana Yeso, na Omokuani omonene okomoboria (Mat 26:59-75; Mar 14:54-72; Luk 22:55-71)
swahili: Kayafa ndiye alikuwa amewashauri Wayahudi kwamba imempasa mtu mmoja kufa kwa ajili ya watu. Petro Anamkana Yesu (Mathayo 26:69-70; Marko 14:55-64; Luka 22:66-71)

english: Now Simon Peter and another disciple were following Jesus. Since that disciple was known to the high priest, he also went with Jesus into the courtyard of the high priest.
ekegusii: Simioni Petero na omworokigwa onde bagatunyana Yeso. Omworokigwa oria onde nigo amanyekanete n’Omokuani omonene, agasoa amo na Yeso ase egoora y’Omokuani omonene,
swahili: Simoni Petro pamoja na mwanafunzi mwingine walikuwa wakimfuata Yesu. Huyu mwanafunzi mwingine alikuwa anafahamika kwa kuhani mkuu, hivyo aliingia ndani ya ukumbi pamoja na Yesu.

english: But Peter stood outside at the door. Then the disciple who was known to the high priest went out and spoke to the doorkeeper, and brought Peter in.
ekegusii: korende Petero agatenena gesieri isiko. Nabo omworokigwa oria onde, oyomanyekanete n’Omokuani omonene agasoka agakwana nomoiseke orenge korenda gesieri, akarenta Petero ime.
swahili: Lakini Petro alisimama nje karibu na lango, ndipo yule mwanafunzi mwingine, aliyejulikana na kuhani mkuu, akazungumza na msichana aliyekuwa analinda lango, akamruhusu Petro aingie ndani.

english: At this, the servant girl watching the door said to Peter, “Aren’t you also one of this man’s disciples?” “I am not,” he answered.
ekegusii: Erio omoiseke oria orenge korenda gesieri akaboria Petero, “Aye tori oyomo bw’aborokigwa baye omonto oyo?” Ere agakana, “Tari inche.”
swahili: Yule msichana akamuuliza Petro, “Je, wewe pia si mmoja wa wanafunzi wa mtu huyu?” Petro akajibu, “Sio mimi.”

english: Because it was cold, the servants and officers were standing around a charcoal fire they had made to keep warm. And Peter was also standing with them, warming himself. Jesus before the High Priest (Matthew 26:57–68; Mark 14:53–65; Luke 22:66–71)
ekegusii: Abasomba baria na abarwani nigo barenge bateneine, bautete omorero bw’amakara, ekiagera obokendu mbwarenge, bakaba ngwota bare omorero. Petero nere nigo arenge amo nabarabwo, ogwota omorero.
swahili: Wale watumishi na askari walikuwa wamesimama wakiota moto wa makaa kwa sababu palikuwa na baridi, Petro naye alikuwa amesimama pamoja nao akiota moto. Kuhani Mkuu Amhoji Yesu

english: Meanwhile, the high priest questioned Jesus about His disciples and His teaching.
ekegusii: Erio Omokuani omonene akaboria Yeso amang’ana igoro yaborokigwa baye, na amang’ana ’okworokereria kwaye.
swahili: Wakati huo kuhani mkuu akawa anamuuliza Yesu kuhusu wanafunzi wake na mafundisho yake.

english: Now Judas His betrayer also knew the place, because Jesus had often met there with His disciples.
ekegusii: Na Yudasi, oria omoruete naamanyete aase aria, ekiagera Yeso are kogenda aroro ekero ase ekero amo naborokigwa baye.
swahili: Basi Yuda, yule aliyemsaliti alipafahamu mahali hapo kwani Yesu alikuwa akikutana humo na wanafunzi wake mara kwa mara.

english: “I have spoken openly to the world,” Jesus answered. “I always taught in the synagogues and at the temple, where all the Jews come together. I said nothing in secret.
ekegusii: Yeso akamoiraneria, “Inche nakwanire nense maiso marore. Amatuko onsi nigo narenge kworokereria ase chisinagogi na ase Hekalu, aase Abayahudi bonsi baare gosangererekana, gose tintebeti ing’ana bobisi.
swahili: Yesu akamjibu, “Nimekuwa nikizungumza waziwazi mbele ya watu wote. Siku zote nimefundisha katika masinagogi na Hekaluni, mahali ambapo Wayahudi wote hukusanyika. Sikusema jambo lolote kwa siri.

english: Why are you asking Me? Ask those who heard My message. Surely they know what I said.”
ekegusii: Nase ki okomboria? Boria baria baigwete aya nakwanete nabarabwo; barabwo mbamanyete aya nabateebeetie.”
swahili: Mbona unaniuliza mimi maswali? Waulize wale walionisikia yale niliyowaambia. Wao wanajua niliyosema.”

english: When Jesus had said this, one of the officers standing nearby slapped Him in the face and said, “Is this how You answer the high priest?”
ekegusii: Gachia gokwana amang’ana aya, oyomo bw’abarendi baria oteneine ang’e, agaaka Yeso oroe, akabora, “Naboigo okoiraneria Omokuani omonene?”
swahili: Alipomaliza kusema hayo, mmoja wa askari aliyekuwa amesimama karibu naye, akampiga Yesu kofi usoni, kisha akasema, “Je, hivyo ndivyo unavyomjibu kuhani mkuu?”

english: Jesus replied, “If I said something wrong, testify as to what was wrong. But if I spoke correctly, why did you strike Me?”
ekegusii: Yeso akamoiraneria, “Onye nakwana bobe, orokia obobe boria, korende onye nakwana buya, ninki okong’akera?”
swahili: Yesu akamjibu akasema, “Kama nimesema jambo baya, shuhudia huo ubaya niliousema. Lakini kama nimesema yaliyo kweli, mbona umenipiga?”

english: Simon Peter was still standing and warming himself. So they asked him, “Aren’t you also one of His disciples?” He denied it and said, “I am not.”
ekegusii: Na Simioni Petero nigo arenge oteneine ogwota omorero. Bakamoteebia, “Aye boigo tori oyomo bw’aborokigwa baye?” Ere agakana, akabora, “Tari inche.”
swahili: Wakati huo Simoni Petro alikuwa amesimama akiota moto. Baadhi ya wale waliokuwepo wakamuuliza, “Je, wewe si mmoja wa wanafunzi wake?” Petro akakana, akasema, “Sio mimi.”

english: One of the high priest’s servants, a relative of the man whose ear Peter had cut off, asked, “Didn’t I see you with Him in the garden?”
ekegusii: Oyomo bw’abasomba b’Omokuani Omonene, omoamate bw’oria onachetwe ogoto na Petero, akabora, “Inche tinakorooche ime ase omogondo amo nere?”
swahili: Mmoja wa watumishi wa kuhani mkuu, ndugu yake yule mtu ambaye Petro alikuwa amemkata sikio, akamuuliza, “Je, mimi sikukuona kule bustanini ukiwa na Yesu?”

english: Peter denied it once more, and immediately a rooster crowed. Jesus before Pilate (Matthew 27:11–14; Luke 23:1–5)
ekegusii: Petero agakana naende. Erio kegima etuoni ekabuga. Yeso ase obosio bwa Pilato gabana o Rumi (Mat 27:1-2; 11—14; Mar 15:1-5; Luk 23:1-5)
swahili: Kwa mara nyingine tena Petro akakana, naye jogoo akawika wakati huo huo. Yesu Apelekwa Kwa Pilato (Mathayo 27:1-2, 11-14; Marko 15:1-5; Luka 23:1-5)

english: Then they led Jesus away from Caiaphas into the Praetorium. By now it was early morning, and the Jews did not enter the Praetorium, to avoid being defiled and unable to eat the Passover.
ekegusii: Erio bakaira Yeso korwa ase Kayafa goika enyomba enene y’ekegambero. Bokaba bogokiamoka, na barabwo abanyene tibasoa ime ase ekegambero, tibaabaisa gocha kobekwa ogotacheneka korende bararia Epasaka.
swahili: Ndipo Wayahudi wakamchukua Yesu kutoka kwa Kayafa na kumpeleka kwenye jumba la kifalme la mtawala wa Kirumi. Wakati huo ilikuwa ni alfajiri, ili kuepuka kuwa najisi kwa taratibu za ibada, Wayahudi hawakuingia ndani kwa sababu ya sheria za Kiyahudi. Wangehesabiwa kuwa najisi kama wangeingia nyumbani mwa mtu asiye Myahudi na wasingeruhusiwa kushiriki katika Sikukuu ya Pasaka.

english: So Pilate went out to them and asked, “What accusation are you bringing against this man?”
ekegusii: Erio Pilato akabachiera isiko, akababoria, “Ngosoera ki mobwate ase omonto oyo?”
swahili: Hivyo Pilato akatoka nje walikokuwa akawauliza, “Mmeleta mashtaka gani kumhusu mtu huyu?”

english: So Judas brought a band of soldiers and officers from the chief priests and Pharisees. They arrived at the garden carrying lanterns, torches, and weapons.
ekegusii: Nabo Yudasi gaikire konyora omoganda bw’abarwani, na abarendi baruete ase abakuani abanene na Abafarisai, akagenda aroro ne chitaaya na ebieri, na ebinto bi’esegi.
swahili: Hivyo Yuda akaja bustanini. Aliongoza kikosi cha askari wa Kirumi, na baadhi ya maafisa kutoka kwa viongozi wa makuhani na Mafarisayo. Nao walikuwa wamechukua taa, mienge na silaha.

english: “If He were not a criminal,” they replied, “we would not have handed Him over to you.”
ekegusii: Bakairaneria, “Onye oyo atarenge omokori amabe, anga titwamorenta ase ore.”
swahili: Wao wakamjibu, “Kama huyu mtu hakuwa mhalifu tusingemleta kwako.”

english: “You take Him and judge Him by your own law,” Pilate told them. “We are not permitted to execute anyone,” the Jews replied.
ekegusii: Erio Pilato akabateebia, “Moire inwe, momogambie ase ogochika kwaino.” Abayahudi bakamoteebia, “Intwe titori ne ribaga goita omonto.”
swahili: Pilato akawaambia, “Basi mchukueni ninyi mkamhukumu kwa kufuata sheria zenu.” Wayahudi wakamjibu, “Sisi haturuhusiwi kutoa hukumu ya kifo kwa mtu yeyote.”

english: This was to fulfill the word that Jesus had spoken to indicate the kind of death He was going to die.
ekegusii: Erio ring’ana ria Yeso riikeranigwe, eri akwanete ase okoorokia imakweri ki aranyare gokwa.
swahili: Walisema hivyo ili yale maneno aliyosema Yesu kuhusu kifo atakachokufa yapate kutimia.

english: Pilate went back into the Praetorium, summoned Jesus, and asked Him, “Are You the King of the Jews?”
ekegusii: Erio Pilato agasoa ekegambero naende, akarangeria Yeso, akamobooria, “Inee! Naye omorwoti bw’Abayahudi?”
swahili: Kwa hiyo Pilato akaingia ndani ya jumba la kifalme, akamwita Yesu, akamuuliza, “Wewe ndiye mfalme wa Wayahudi?”

english: “Are you saying this on your own,” Jesus asked, “or did others tell you about Me?”
ekegusii: Yeso akairaneria, “Naye gwateebire ayio aye omonyene, gose nabaanto bande bagotebirie amang’ana aya igoro yane?”
swahili: Yesu akamjibu, “Je, unauliza swali hili kutokana na mawazo yako mwenyewe, au uliambiwa na watu kunihusu mimi?”

english: “Am I a Jew?” Pilate replied. “Your own people and chief priests handed You over to me. What have You done?”
ekegusii: Pilato akairaneria, “Inee! Inche n’Omoyahudi nde? Abanto b’egesaku kiao na abakuani abanene bakorentire ase ’nde. Inki gwakorete?”
swahili: Pilato akamjibu, “Mimi si Myahudi, ama sivyo? Taifa lako mwenyewe na viongozi wa makuhani wamekukabidhi kwangu. Umefanya kosa gani?”

english: Jesus answered, “My kingdom is not of this world; if it were, My servants would fight to prevent My arrest by the Jews. But now My kingdom is not of this realm.”
ekegusii: Yeso akairaneria, “Oborwoti bwane tibori obw’ense eye. Onye oborwoti bwane mbwarenge obw’ense eye, abasomba baane anga mbandwanerera, tinyara kobekwa ase amaboko ’Abayahudi, korende bono oborwoti bwane tibori obw’aa.”
swahili: Yesu akajibu, “Ufalme wangu si wa ulimwengu huu. Ufalme wangu ungekuwa wa ulimwengu huu, wafuasi wangu wangenipigania ili nisitiwe mikononi mwa Wayahudi. Lakini kama ilivyo, ufalme wangu hautoki hapa ulimwenguni.”

english: “Then You are a king!” Pilate said. “You say that I am a king,” Jesus answered. “For this reason I was born and have come into the world, to testify to the truth. Everyone who belongs to the truth listens to My voice.”
ekegusii: Erio Pilato akamobooria, “Aye nomorwoti rende?” Yeso akairaneria, “Aye gwateebete ng’a inche nomorwoti. Inche nigo naiboretwe ase engencho y’aya, na ase engencho y’aya, ngacha ase ense, erinde imbe kirori ase ekeene. Kera oyore oyo bw’ekeene nigo akoigwa eriogi riane.”
swahili: Pilato akamuuliza, “Kwa hiyo wewe ni mfalme?” Yesu akajibu, “Wewe wasema kwamba mimi ni mfalme. Kwa kusudi hili nilizaliwa, na kwa ajili ya hili nilikuja ulimwenguni, ili niishuhudie kweli. Mtu yeyote aliye wa kweli husikia sauti yangu.”

english: “What is truth?” Pilate asked. And having said this, he went out again to the Jews and told them, “I find no basis for a charge against Him.
ekegusii: Pilato akamobooria, “Ekeene ngento ki?” Gakwanire ring’ana eri agachiera Abayahudi isiko eria kabere, akabateebia, “Inche tindochi bobe bonde asare.
swahili: Pilato akamuuliza Yesu, “Kweli ni nini?” Baada ya kusema haya Pilato akaenda nje tena akawaambia wale viongozi wa Wayahudi waliomshtaki Yesu, “Sioni kosa lolote alilotenda mtu huyu.

english: But it is your custom that I release to you one prisoner at the Passover. So then, do you want me to release to you the King of the Jews?”
ekegusii: Korende inwe more nengencho ng’a nabasiborera omonto oyomo ase ekero ki’Epasaka; nabo morigetie mbasiborere Omorwoti bw’Abayahudi?”
swahili: Lakini ninyi mna desturi yenu kwamba wakati wa Pasaka nimwachie huru mfungwa mmoja mnayemtaka. Je, mnataka niwafungulie huyu ‘Mfalme wa Wayahudi’?”

english: Jesus, knowing all that was coming upon Him, stepped forward and asked them, “Whom are you seeking?”
ekegusii: Nabo Yeso, kamanyete onsi ayagochia komonyoora, akaoroka, akababoria, “Ning’o mokorigia?”
swahili: Yesu akijua yale yote yatakayompata, akajitokeza mbele yao akawauliza, “Mnamtafuta nani?”

english: “Not this man,” they shouted, “but Barabbas!” (Now Barabbas was an insurrectionist.)
ekegusii: Erio bagaaka eriogi naende, bakaboora, “Tari oyo, korende Baraba!” Baraba ere nigo arenge omouri.
swahili: Wao wakapiga kelele wakisema, “Si huyu mtu, bali tufungulie Baraba!” Yule Baraba alikuwa mnyangʼanyi.

english: “Jesus of Nazareth,” they answered. Jesus said, “I am He.” And Judas His betrayer was standing there with them.
ekegusii: Bakamoiraneria, “Yeso Omonazareti.” Yeso akabateebia, “Ninche ere.” Yudasi nere oyomoruete nigo ateneine amo nabarabwo.
swahili: Wao wakamjibu, “Yesu wa Nazareti.” Yesu akawajibu, “Mimi ndiye.” Yuda, yule aliyemsaliti alikuwa amesimama pamoja nao.

english: When Jesus said, “I am He,” they drew back and fell to the ground.
ekegusii: Nabo ekero Yeso achia kobateebia, “Ninche ere,” bakairana magega, bagaaka inse.
swahili: Yesu alipowaambia, “Mimi ndiye,” walirudi nyuma na kuanguka chini!

english: So He asked them again, “Whom are you seeking?” “Jesus of Nazareth,” they answered.
ekegusii: Akababoria eria kabere, “Ning’o mokorigia?” Bakaboora, “Yeso Omonazareti.”
swahili: Akawauliza tena, “Mnamtafuta nani?” Nao wakamjibu, “Yesu wa Nazareti.”

english: “I told you that I am He,” Jesus replied. “So if you are looking for Me, let these men go.”
ekegusii: Yeso akairaneria, “Naikire kobateebia ng’a ninche ere; nabo onye mokondigia inche, batige aba bagende.”
swahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Nimekwisha kuwaambia kuwa, mimi ndiye; kwa hiyo kama mnanitafuta mimi, waacheni hawa watu waende zao.”

english: This was to fulfill the word He had spoken: “I have not lost one of those You have given Me.”
ekegusii: Erio riikeranigwe ring’ana riria akwanete, “Aba kwang’ete tinsireti nonya noyomo obo.”
swahili: Hii ilikuwa ili litimie lile neno alilosema, “Sikumpoteza hata mmoja miongoni mwa wale ulionipa.”

english: Then Pilate took Jesus and had Him flogged.
ekegusii: Erio Pilato akaira Yeso, akamoaka emecharichi.
swahili: Ndipo Pilato akamtoa Yesu akaamuru apigwe mijeledi.

english: So Pilate said to Him, “Do You refuse to speak to me? Do You not know that I have authority to release You and authority to crucify You?”
ekegusii: Erio Pilato akamobooria, “Togokwana nainche? Tomanyeti ng’a ninde nokobua gokobamba, naende ninde nokobua kogosibora?”
swahili: Pilato akamwambia, “Wewe unakataa kuongea na mimi? Hujui ya kuwa nina mamlaka ya kukuachia huru au kukusulubisha?”

english: Jesus answered, “You would have no authority over Me if it were not given to you from above. Therefore the one who handed Me over to you is guilty of greater sin.”
ekegusii: Yeso akamoiraneria, “Anga tori nokobua konde gwonsi, onye otaeiri korwa igoro; ase ayio ere oyombegete ase amaboko ao nare nebibe ebinene kobua.”
swahili: Ndipo Yesu akamwambia, “Wewe hungekuwa na mamlaka yoyote juu yangu kama hungepewa kutoka juu. Kwa hiyo yeye aliyenitia mikononi mwako ana hatia ya dhambi iliyo kubwa zaidi.”

english: From then on, Pilate tried to release Him, but the Jews kept shouting, “If you release this man, you are no friend of Caesar. Anyone who declares himself a king is defying Caesar.”
ekegusii: Korwa agwo Pilato akarigia komosibora, korende Abayahudi bagaaka eriogi, bakaboora, “Koramosibore, aye tori omosani o Kaisari; kera oyogwekora koba omorwoti nigo are mamincha ase Kaisari.”
swahili: Tangu wakati huo, Pilato akajitahidi kutafuta njia ya kumfungua Yesu, lakini Wayahudi wakazidi kupiga kelele wakisema, “Ukimwachia huyu mtu, wewe si rafiki wa Kaisari. Mtu yeyote anayedai kuwa mfalme anampinga Kaisari.”

english: When Pilate heard these words, he brought Jesus out and sat on the judgment seat at a place called the Stone Pavement, which in Hebrew is Gabbatha.
ekegusii: Erio ekero Pilato achia koigwa amang’ana aya, akarenta Yeso isiko, agaikaransa igoro ase ekerogo gi’ekina, aase akorokwa Atichire n’Amagena, naende ase Ekeiberania, Gabata.
swahili: Pilato aliposikia maneno haya akamtoa Yesu nje tena akaketi katika kiti chake cha hukumu, mahali palipoitwa Sakafu ya Jiwe, kwa Kiebrania paliitwa Gabatha

english: It was the day of Preparation for the Passover, about the sixth hour. And Pilate said to the Jews, “Here is your King!”
ekegusii: Nigo yarenge Okwearigania gw’Epasaka; naende nigo yarenge koreng’ana chinsa isano nemo. Agateebia Abayahudi, “Rora omorwoti oino!”
swahili: Basi ilikuwa siku ya Maandalio ya Pasaka, yapata kama saa sita hivi. Pilato akawaambia Wayahudi, “Huyu hapa mfalme wenu!”

english: At this, they shouted, “Away with Him! Away with Him! Crucify Him!” “Shall I crucify your King?” Pilate asked. “We have no king but Caesar,” replied the chief priests. The Crucifixion (Psalms 22:1–31; Matthew 27:32–44; Mark 15:21–32; Luke 23:26–43)
ekegusii: Korende barabwo bagaaka eriogi, “Morusie, morusie, mobambe!” Pilato akababoria, “Imobambe omorwoti oino?” Abakuani abanene bakairaneria, “Titori nomorwoti otatiga Kaisari.”
swahili: Wao wakapiga kelele, “Mwondoe! Mwondoe! Msulubishe!” Pilato akawauliza, “Je, nimsulubishe mfalme wenu?” Wale viongozi wa makuhani wakamjibu, “Sisi hatuna mfalme mwingine ila Kaisari.”

english: Then Pilate handed Jesus over to be crucified, and the soldiers took Him away.
ekegusii: Erio agwo akamobeka ase amaboko abo abambwe. Okobambwa kwa Yeso (Mat 27:32-44; Mar 15:21-32; Luk 23:26-43) Barabwo bakabwata Yeso.
swahili: Ndipo Pilato akamkabidhi Yesu kwao ili wamsulubishe. Kusulubiwa Kwa Yesu (Mathayo 27:32-44; Marko 15:21-32; Luka 23:26-43) Kwa hiyo askari wakamchukua Yesu.

english: Carrying His own cross, He went out to The Place of the Skull, which in Hebrew is called Golgotha.
ekegusii: Ere agasoka bwebogoreretie omosalaba oye, goika aase akorokwa Ekeore; ase Ekeiberania akorokwa Gologotha.
swahili: Yesu, akiwa ameubeba msalaba wake, akatoka kuelekea mahali palipoitwa Fuvu la Kichwa (kwa Kiebrania ni Golgotha).

english: There they crucified Him, and with Him two others, one on each side, with Jesus in the middle.
ekegusii: Bakamobamba aroro amo nabaanto bande babere, oyonde ensemo, na oyonde ensemo, na Yeso gati‐gati.
swahili: Hapo ndipo walipomsulubisha. Pamoja naye walisulubisha watu wengine wawili, mmoja kila upande wake, naye Yesu katikati.

english: Pilate also had a notice posted on the cross. It read: JESUS OF NAZARETH, THE KING OF THE JEWS.
ekegusii: Pilato akarika ekemanyererio, agakebeka igoro ase omosalaba. Igo kiarigetwe, “YESO OMONAZARETI, OMORWOTI BW’ABAYAHUDI.”
swahili: Pilato akaamuru tangazo liandikwe na liwekwe juu kwenye msalaba wa Yesu, likasema: “ Yesu wa Nazareti, Mfalme wa Wayahudi.”

english: The soldiers twisted together a crown of thorns, set it on His head, and dressed Him in a purple robe.
ekegusii: Abarwani bagatwang’a egutwa y’amagwa, bakamobekera ase omotwe, bakamobekera na eanga embariri,
swahili: Askari wakasokota taji ya miiba, wakamvika Yesu kichwani. Wakamvalisha joho la zambarau.

english: Many of the Jews read this sign, because the place where Jesus was crucified was near the city, and it was written in Hebrew, Latin, and Greek.
ekegusii: Nabo amariiko ayio abange b’Abayahudi mbayasomete, ekiagera aase aria Yeso abamberetwe nigo arenge ang’e nomochie; naro nigo arigetwe ase Ekeiberania, na Ekerumi, na Ekegiriki.
swahili: Kwa kuwa mahali hapo Yesu aliposulubiwa palikuwa karibu na mjini, Wayahudi wengi walisoma maandishi haya yaliyokuwa yameandikwa kwa lugha za Kiebrania, Kiyunani na Kilatini.

english: So the chief priests of the Jews said to Pilate, “Do not write, ‘The King of the Jews,’ but only that He said, ‘I am the King of the Jews.’”
ekegusii: Erio abakuani abanene na Abayahudi bagateebia Pilato, “Torika ng’a, n’Omorwoti bw’Abayahudi, korende ng’a nigo arenge kobora: Inche nomorwoti bw’Abayahudi.”
swahili: Viongozi wa makuhani wa Wayahudi wakapinga, wakamwambia Pilato, “Usiandike ‘Mfalme wa Wayahudi,’ bali andika kwamba mtu huyu alisema yeye ni mfalme wa Wayahudi.”

english: Pilate answered, “What I have written, I have written.”
ekegusii: Pilato akairaneria, “Aya nariikire, nariikire.” Ogokwa kwa Yeso (Mat 27:45-56; Mar 15:33-41; Luk 23:44-49)
swahili: Pilato akawajibu, “Nilichokwisha kuandika, nimeandika!” Mavazi Ya Yesu Yagawanywa

english: When the soldiers had crucified Jesus, they divided His garments into four parts, one for each soldier, with the tunic remaining. It was seamless, woven in one piece from top to bottom.
ekegusii: Erio abarwani kobaabambire Yeso, bakabogoria chianga chiaye, bagachiatanana chinsemo inye, kera omorwani anyore ensemo yaye. Bakabogoria eganchwa nero. Korende eganchwa eyio tiyasonire; igo yabwatanirie korwa igoro goika inse.
swahili: Askari walipokwisha kumsulubisha Yesu, walichukua nguo zake wakazigawa mafungu manne, kila askari fungu lake. Ila walikubaliana wasilichane lile vazi lake kwa maana lilikuwa halina mshono bali limefumwa tangu juu hadi chini.
