english: So they said to one another, “Let us not tear it. Instead, let us cast lots to see who will get it.” This was to fulfill the Scripture: “They divided My garments among them, and cast lots for My clothing.” So that is what the soldiers did.
ekegusii: Erio bagateebania, “Titoyetandora, korende toyeakere obomera, torore gose neya ng’o ekoba.” Erio ririiko riikerane, eri rigoteeba, “Mbaatananete chianga chiane, naende eganchwa yane mbayekorerete obomera.”
swahili: Wakaambiana, “Tusilichane ila tulipigie kura ili kuamua ni nani atalichukua.” Hili lilitukia ili Maandiko yapate kutimizwa yale yaliyosema, “Wanagawana nguo zangu, na vazi langu wanalipigia kura.” Hayo ndiyo waliyoyafanya wale askari.

english: Near the cross of Jesus stood His mother and her sister, as well as Mary the wife of Clopas and Mary Magdalene.
ekegusii: Naboigo abarwani bakorete. Korende ase omosalaba o Yeso ng’ina, na ng’ina moke, Mariamu moga Kiliopa, na Mariamu Magidalena bagatenenao.
swahili: Wakati huo huo karibu na msalaba wa Yesu walikuwa wamesimama mama yake, na dada wa mamaye, na Maria mke wa Klopa, na Maria Magdalene.

english: When Jesus saw His mother and the disciple whom He loved standing nearby, He said to His mother, “Woman, here is your son.”
ekegusii: Erio ekero Yeso achia korora ng’ina na omworokigwa oria anchete bateneine ang’e agateebia ng’ina, “Omong’ina, rora omwana oo!”
swahili: Yesu alipomwona mama yake mahali pale pamoja na yule mwanafunzi aliyempenda wamesimama karibu, akamwambia mama yake, “Mwanamke, huyo hapo ndiye mwanao,”

english: Then He said to the disciple, “Here is your mother.” So from that hour, this disciple took her into his home. The Death of Jesus (Psalms 22:1–31; Matthew 27:45–56; Mark 15:33–41; Luke 23:44–49)
ekegusii: Magega y’ayio agateebia omworokigwa oria, “Rora nyoko!” Erio korwa ensa eria omworokigwa oria akamoira bwoye.
swahili: kisha akamwambia yule mwanafunzi, “Nawe huyo hapo ndiye mama yako.” Tangu wakati huo yule mwanafunzi akamchukua mama yake Yesu nyumbani kwake. Kifo Cha Yesu (Mathayo 27:45-56; Marko 15:33-41; Luka 23:44-49)

english: After this, knowing that everything had now been accomplished, and to fulfill the Scripture, Jesus said, “I am thirsty.”
ekegusii: Magega ase aya Yeso, kamanyete ng’a onsi aikire gokorwa, erinde ririiko riikeranigwe, akabora, “Ninde nerang’o.”
swahili: Baada ya haya, Yesu hali akijua kuwa mambo yote yamemalizika, alisema ili kutimiza Maandiko, “Naona kiu.”

english: A jar of sour wine was sitting there. So they soaked a sponge in the wine, put it on a stalk of hyssop, and lifted it to His mouth.
ekegusii: Nkiarenge aroro egetaabo giaichire chinkama, erio bakabeeka esifunchi eichire chinkama igoro ase egetonto, bakamobekera monwa.
swahili: Hapo palikuwa na bakuli lililojaa siki. Kwa hiyo wakachovya sifongo kwenye hiyo siki, wakaiweka kwenye ufito wa mti wa hisopo, wakampelekea mdomoni.

english: And they went up to Him again and again, saying, “Hail, King of the Jews!” and slapping Him in the face.
ekegusii: bakamochiera, bakaboora, “Masoge, Omorwoti bw’Abayahudi!” Bakamoaka chindoe.
swahili: Wakawa wanapanda pale alipo tena na tena, wakisema, “Salamu! Mfalme wa Wayahudi!” Huku wakimpiga makofi usoni.

english: When Jesus had received the sour wine, He said, “It is finished.” And bowing His head, He yielded up His spirit. Jesus’ Side Is Pierced (Zechariah 12:10–14)
ekegusii: Erio Yeso agachia konyora chinkama, agateeba, “Yaikeranire!” Agatureka omotwe, agatweka mo. Yeso okobetwa ritimo na koirwa gotindekwa
swahili: Baada ya kuionja hiyo siki, Yesu akasema, “Imekwisha.” Akainamisha kichwa chake, akaitoa roho yake. Yesu Achomwa Mkuki Ubavuni

english: It was the day of Preparation, and the next day was a High Sabbath. In order that the bodies would not remain on the cross during the Sabbath, the Jews asked Pilate to have the legs broken and the bodies removed.
ekegusii: Igo riarenge rituko ri’Okwearigania, na Abayahudi tibarigetie emebere ebe ase emesalaba igoro ase rituko ri’Esabato, ekiagera Esabato eria nigo yarenge enene. Ase ayio bagasaba Pilato ng’a amagoro y’abaanto abwo baabambetwe abunwe, na emebere yabo erusigweo.
swahili: Kwa kuwa ilikuwa siku ya Maandalio ya Pasaka, Wayahudi hawakutaka miili ibaki msalabani siku ya Sabato, hasa kwa kuwa hiyo Sabato ingekuwa Sikukuu. Wakamwomba Pilato aamuru miguu ya wale waliosulubiwa ivunjwe ili wafe haraka miili iondolewe kwenye misalaba.

english: So the soldiers came and broke the legs of the first man who had been crucified with Jesus, and those of the other.
ekegusii: Erio abarwani bakagenda, bakabuna amagoro abo, oyo bw’eritang’ani, na oyo o kabere, abwo baabambetwe amo na Yeso.
swahili: Kwa hiyo askari wakaenda wakavunja miguu ya mtu wa kwanza aliyesulubiwa pamoja na Yesu na yule mwingine pia.

english: But when they came to Jesus and saw that He was already dead, they did not break His legs.
ekegusii: Bagachia gochiera Yeso, bakarora ng’a oikire gokwa, tibamobuna amagoro aye.
swahili: Lakini walipomkaribia Yesu, wakaona ya kuwa amekwisha kufa, hivyo hawakuvunja miguu yake.

english: Instead, one of the soldiers pierced His side with a spear, and immediately blood and water flowed out.
ekegusii: Korende oyomo bw’abarwani akamobeta ritimo rikere riaye, akaruao bwango amanyinga na amaache.
swahili: Badala yake mmoja wa wale askari akamchoma mkuki ubavuni na mara pakatoka damu na maji.

english: The one who saw it has testified to this, and his testimony is true. He knows that he is telling the truth, so that you also may believe.
ekegusii: Nere oyoyaroche akaba kirori, na oborori bwaye nobw’ekeene, nere omanyire ng’a igo agokwana ekeene, erinde inwe monyare kwegena.
swahili: Mtu aliyeona mambo hayo ndiye alitoa ushuhuda, nao ushuhuda wake ni kweli. Anajua kuwa anasema kweli, naye anashuhudia ili pia nanyi mpate kuamini.

english: Now these things happened so that the Scripture would be fulfilled: “Not one of His bones will be broken.”
ekegusii: Naki aya nigo akoregete erinde ririiko riikerane, eriateebete, “Riuga riaye tirikobunwa.”
swahili: Kwa maana mambo haya yalitukia ili Maandiko yapate kutimia, yale yasemayo, “Hakuna hata mfupa wake mmoja utakaovunjwa.”

english: Afterward, Joseph of Arimathea, who was a disciple of Jesus (but secretly for fear of the Jews), asked Pilate to let him remove the body of Jesus. Pilate gave him permission, so he came and removed His body.
ekegusii: Magega ase aya Yusufu bw’Arimathaya agasaba Pilato ribaga arusie omobere o Yeso. Ere nigo arenge omworokigwa o Yeso, korende bobisi, ekiagera airogete Abayahudi. Pilato akamoa ribaga. Igo agacha, akarusia omobere oye.
swahili: Baada ya mambo haya, Yosefu wa Arimathaya, aliyekuwa mfuasi wa Yesu, ingawa kwa siri kwa sababu ya kuwaogopa Wayahudi, alimwomba Pilato ruhusa ili kuuchukua mwili wa Yesu. Pilato alimruhusu, hivyo akaja, akauchukua.

english: Nicodemus, who had previously come to Jesus at night, also brought a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about seventy-five pounds.
ekegusii: Na Nikodemo oria omochierete botuko agwo ritang’ani, nere akagenda boigo, akarenta ebinto bisang’ananirie manemane na uudi, oborito bwaye chiratili rigana erimo.
swahili: Naye Nikodemo, yule ambaye kwanza alimwendea Yesu usiku, akaja, akaleta mchanganyiko wa manemane na manukato, yenye uzito wa zaidi ya kilo thelathini

english: Once again Pilate came out and said to the Jews, “Look, I am bringing Him out to you to let you know that I find no basis for a charge against Him.”
ekegusii: Pilato akaoroka naende isiko, akabateebia, “Rora, inche namorentire ase more, monyare komanya ng’a tindochi komocha konde asare.”
swahili: Pilato akatoka tena nje akawaambia wale waliokusanyika, “Tazameni, namkabidhi Yesu kwenu kuwajulisha kwamba mimi sikumwona ana hatia.”

english: So they took the body of Jesus and wrapped it in linen cloths with the spices, according to the Jewish burial custom.
ekegusii: Erio bakabogoria omobere o Yeso, bakayoboyia egetambaa ki’egatani, bakayoaka amaguta aria amanukato, buna yarenge engencho y’Abayahudi ase ogotindeka.
swahili: Wakauchukua mwili wa Yesu, wakaufunga katika sanda ya kitani safi pamoja na yale manukato, kama ilivyokuwa desturi ya Wayahudi.

english: Now there was a garden in the place where Jesus was crucified, and in the garden a new tomb in which no one had yet been laid.
ekegusii: Naende aase aria abamberetwe norengeo omogondo, na ime ase omogondo oboina oboyia, aase monto onde konya atarabekwa.
swahili: Basi palikuwa na bustani karibu na mahali pale aliposulubiwa, na pale ndani ya ile bustani palikuwa na kaburi jipya, ambalo halikuwa limezikiwa mtu bado.

english: And because it was the Jewish day of Preparation and the tomb was nearby, they placed Jesus there.
ekegusii: Na ase engencho y’Okwearigania kw’Abayahudi bakabeeka Yeso aroro, ekiagera oboina boria bwarenge ang’e.
swahili: Kwa hiyo, kwa kuwa ilikuwa siku ya Wayahudi ya Maandalio, nalo kaburi hilo lilikuwa karibu, wakamzika Yesu humo.

english: When Jesus came out wearing the crown of thorns and the purple robe, Pilate said to them, “Here is the man!”
ekegusii: Erio Yeso agasoka isiko, obekeire egutwa eria y’amagwa na eanga eria y’oborwoti embariri. Pilato akabateebia, “Rora omonto oyo!”
swahili: Kwa hiyo Yesu akatoka nje akiwa amevaa ile taji ya miiba na lile vazi la zambarau. Pilato akawaambia, “Tazameni, huyu hapa huyo mtu!”

english: As soon as the chief priests and officers saw Him, they shouted, “Crucify Him! Crucify Him!” “You take Him and crucify Him,” Pilate replied, “for I find no basis for a charge against Him.”
ekegusii: Erio abakuani abanene na abarendi bagachia komoorora, bagaaka eriogi, bakobora, “Mobambe! Mobambe!” Pilato akabateebia, “Moire inwe, momobambe, ekiagera inche tindochi okomocha asare.”
swahili: Wale viongozi wa makuhani na maafisa walipomwona, wakapiga kelele wakisema, “Msulubishe! Msulubishe!” Pilato akawaambia, “Mchukueni ninyi mkamsulubishe, mimi sioni hatia juu yake.”

english: “We have a law,” answered the Jews, “and according to that law He must die, because He declared Himself to be the Son of God.”
ekegusii: Abayahudi bakamoiraneria, “Intwe ntore nogochika, naende ase ogochika okwo nagwenerete akwe, ekiagera agwekora koba Omwana o Nyasae.”
swahili: Wayahudi wakamjibu, “Sisi tunayo sheria na kutokana na sheria hiyo, hana budi kufa kwa sababu yeye alijiita Mwana wa Mungu.”

english: When Pilate heard this statement, he was even more afraid,
ekegusii: Erio Pilato agachia koigwa ring’ana erio, akaba nobwoba kobua.
swahili: Pilato aliposikia haya, akaogopa zaidi.

english: and he went back into the Praetorium. “Where are You from?” he asked. But Jesus gave no answer.
ekegusii: Agasoa ase ekegambero, akaboria Yeso naende, “Ing’ai kwarure aye?” Korende Yeso tamoiraneria.
swahili: Akaingia tena ndani ya jumba la kifalme, akamuuliza Yesu, “Wewe umetoka wapi?” Lakini Yesu hakumjibu.

english: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
ekegusii: Agwo omochakano ndiarengeo Ring’ana, ne Ring’ana nigo riarenge amo na Nyasae, na rirorio Ring’ana nigo riarenge Nyasae.
swahili: Hapo mwanzo alikuwako Neno, huyo Neno alikuwa pamoja na Mungu, naye Neno alikuwa Mungu.

english: He was in the world, and though the world was made through Him, the world did not recognize Him.
ekegusii: Nao arenge ase ense ime, ense egatongwa goetera asere, na abanto b’ense tibamomanya.
swahili: Huyo Neno alikuwako ulimwenguni na ingawa ulimwengu uliumbwa kupitia kwake, haukumtambua.

english: He came to His own, and His own did not receive Him.
ekegusii: Agaacha ase abaye, na barabwo abaare abaye tibamwancha.
swahili: Alikuja kwa walio wake, lakini wao hawakumpokea.

english: But to all who did receive Him, to those who believed in His name, He gave the right to become children of God—
ekegusii: Korende bonsi abamoitabete na kwegena erieta riaye, akabaa okobua babe abana ba Nyasae.
swahili: Bali wote waliompokea, aliwapa uwezo wa kufanyika watoto wa Mungu, ndio wale waliaminio jina lake.

english: children born not of blood, nor of the desire or will of man, but born of God. The Word Became Flesh (Psalms 84:1–12)
ekegusii: Abwo baiboirwe, tari korwa ase amanyinga a Mwanyabaanto, gose tari ase ogwancha kw’omobere, gose tari ase ogwancha kw’omonto, korende nigo baiboirwe na Nyasae.
swahili: Hawa ndio wasiozaliwa kwa damu, wala kwa mapenzi ya mwili au kwa mapenzi ya mtu, bali kwa mapenzi ya Mungu.

english: The Word became flesh and made His dwelling among us. We have seen His glory, the glory of the one and only Son from the Father, full of grace and truth.
ekegusii: Na rirorio Ring’ana rigakoreka koba omobere, akamenya ase egati yaito. Tokarora obonene bwaye, obonene buna obw’Omwana omomoima oruure ase Tata, oichire nobuya na ekeene.
swahili: Neno alifanyika mwili, akakaa miongoni mwetu, nasi tukauona utukufu wake, utukufu kama wa Mwana pekee atokaye kwa Baba, amejaa neema na kweli.

english: John testified concerning Him. He cried out, saying, “This is He of whom I said, ‘He who comes after me has surpassed me because He was before me.’”
ekegusii: Yohana agakwana igoro yaye, agaaka egeturi, akabora, “Oyo nere nateebete igoro yaye ng’a: Oyorache magega yane nigo are omonene kombua, ekiagera nao arenge ritang’ani ase ’nde.”
swahili: Yohana alishuhudia habari zake, akapaza sauti, akisema, “Huyu ndiye yule niliyewaambia kwamba, ‘Yeye ajaye baada yangu ni mkuu kuniliko mimi, kwa kuwa alikuwepo kabla yangu.’ ”

english: From His fullness we have all received grace upon grace.
ekegusii: Na ase oboikeranu bwaye intwe twensi twanyorire obuya igoro ase obuya.
swahili: Kutokana na ukamilifu wake, sisi sote tumepokea neema juu ya neema.

english: For the law was given through Moses; grace and truth came through Jesus Christ.
ekegusii: Naki amachiiko arwerete ase amaboko a Musa, obuya na ekeene nigo biachete goetera ase Yeso Kristo.
swahili: Kwa kuwa sheria ilitolewa kwa mkono wa Mose, lakini neema na kweli imekuja kupitia Yesu Kristo.

english: No one has ever seen God, but the one and only Son, who is Himself God and is at the Father’s side, has made Him known. The Mission of John the Baptist (Isaiah 40:1–5; Matthew 3:1–12; Mark 1:1–8; Luke 3:1–20)
ekegusii: Monto onde tari ororire Nyasae kero kende gionsi; Omwana omomoima ore ase egekuba gia Tata, nere omoorokirie. Oborori bwa Yohana Omobatisi igoro ya Yeso (Mat 3:1-12; Mar 1:7-8; Luk 3:15-17)
swahili: Hakuna mtu yeyote aliyemwona Mungu wakati wowote, ila ni Mungu Mwana pekee, aliye kifuani mwa Baba ndiye ambaye amemdhihirisha. Ushuhuda Wa Yohana Mbatizaji (Mathayo 3:1-12; Marko 1:1-8; Luka 3:1-18)

english: And this was John’s testimony when the Jews of Jerusalem sent priests and Levites to ask him, “Who are you?”
ekegusii: Naende obo nabwo oborori bwa Yohana, ekero Abayahudi batomete abakuani na Abalawi korwa Yerusalemu bamoboorie, “Aye naye ng’o?”
swahili: Huu ndio ushuhuda wa Yohana wakati Wayahudi walipowatuma makuhani na Walawi kutoka Yerusalemu kumuuliza, “Wewe ni nani?”

english: He was with God in the beginning.
ekegusii: Oyio agwo omochakano nigo arenge amo na Nyasae.
swahili: Tangu mwanzo huyo Neno alikuwa pamoja na Mungu.

english: He did not refuse to confess, but openly declared, “I am not the Christ.”
ekegusii: Ere akaorokia, takaana, agateeba, “Inche tari Kristo.”
swahili: Yohana alikiri waziwazi pasipo kuficha akasema, “Mimi si Kristo.”

english: “Then who are you?” they inquired. “Are you Elijah?” He said, “I am not.” “Are you the Prophet?” He answered, “No.”
ekegusii: Bakamobooria, “Naki rende? Naye Elija?” Akaboora, “Inche tindi ere.” “Aye naye omobani oria?” Akairaneria, “Yaya.”
swahili: Wakamuuliza, “Wewe ni nani basi? Je, wewe ni Eliya?” Yeye akajibu, “Hapana, mimi siye.” “Je, wewe ni yule Nabii?” Akajibu, “Hapana.”

english: So they said to him, “Who are you? We need an answer for those who sent us. What do you say about yourself?”
ekegusii: Nabo bakamobooria, “Naye ng’o rende? Toe abatotomete okoiraneria. Naki ogweteeba?”
swahili: Ndipo wakasema, “Basi tuambie wewe ni nani ili tupate jibu la kuwapelekea wale waliotutuma. Wewe wasemaje juu yako mwenyewe?”

english: John replied in the words of Isaiah the prophet: “I am a voice of one calling in the wilderness, ‘Make straight the way for the Lord.’”
ekegusii: Akabora, “Inche neriogi ri’oyo ogoaka egeturi ase erooro: Rongeyia enchera y’Omonene, buna omobani Isaya ateebete.”
swahili: Akawajibu kwa maneno ya nabii Isaya, akisema, “Mimi ni sauti ya mtu aliaye nyikani, ‘Yanyoosheni mapito ya Bwana.’ ”

english: Then the Pharisees who had been sent
ekegusii: Na barabwo abatometwe nigo barwete ase Abafarisai.
swahili: Basi walikuwa wametumwa watu kutoka kwa Mafarisayo

english: asked him, “Why then do you baptize, if you are not the Christ, nor Elijah, nor the Prophet?”
ekegusii: Bakaboria Yohana, “Naki rende okobatisa, onye aye tori Kristo, gose Elija, gose omobani?”
swahili: wakamuuliza, “Kama wewe si Kristo, wala si Eliya na wala si yule Nabii, kwa nini basi unabatiza?”

english: “I baptize with water,” John replied, “but among you stands One you do not know.
ekegusii: Yohana akabairaneria, “Inche nigo nkobatisa ase amaache, korende egati yaino nateneineo oyomotamanyeti inwe.
swahili: Yohana akawajibu, “Mimi ninabatiza kwa maji, lakini katikati yenu yupo mtu msiyemjua.

english: He is the One who comes after me, the straps of whose sandals I am not worthy to untie.”
ekegusii: Nere oyoraache magega yane, inche tinyisaini nyesibore enuga y’egekoroto kiaye.”
swahili: Yeye ajaye baada yangu, sistahili hata kufungua kamba za viatu vyake.”

english: All this happened at Bethany beyond the Jordan, where John was baptizing. Jesus the Lamb of God (Matthew 3:13–17; Mark 1:9–11; Luke 3:21–22)
ekegusii: Aya nigo akoregete Bethania ng’umbu ya Yorodani, aase Yohana arenge kobatisera. Emanwa y’eng’ondi ya Nyasae
swahili: Mambo haya yote yalitukia huko Bethania, ngʼambo ya Mto Yordani, mahali Yohana alipokuwa akibatiza. Yesu Mwana-Kondoo Wa Mungu

english: The next day John saw Jesus coming toward him and said, “Look, the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!
ekegusii: Rituko ria kabere Yohana akarora Yeso ogocha asaare, akabora, “Rora, Emanwa y’Eng’ondi ya Nyasae, oyokorusia ebibe bi’ense!
swahili: Siku iliyofuata, Yohana alimwona Yesu akimjia akasema, “Tazama, Mwana-Kondoo wa Mungu aichukuaye dhambi ya ulimwengu!

english: Through Him all things were made, and without Him nothing was made that has been made.
ekegusii: Goetera ase are ebinto bionsi bigakoreka; gento kende gionsi tigiakoregete otatiga goetera ase are.
swahili: Vitu vyote viliumbwa kwa yeye, wala pasipo yeye hakuna chochote kilichoumbwa ambacho kimeumbwa.

english: This is He of whom I said, ‘A man who comes after me has surpassed me because He was before me.’
ekegusii: Oyo nere naare goteeba igoro yaye: Ngocha are omonto magega yane oyore omonene kombua, ekiagera nao arenge ritang’ani ase ’nde.
swahili: Huyu ndiye yule niliyewaambia kwamba, ‘Mtu anakuja baada yangu ambaye ni mkuu kuniliko mimi, kwa kuwa alikuwepo kabla yangu.’

english: I myself did not know Him, but the reason I came baptizing with water was that He might be revealed to Israel.”
ekegusii: Inche tinamomanyete; korende aorokigwe ase Abaisraeli, nabo ase ayio ngacha na kobatisa ase amaache.”
swahili: Mimi mwenyewe sikumfahamu, lakini sababu ya kuja nikibatiza kwa maji ni ili yeye apate kufunuliwa kwa Israeli.”

english: Then John testified, “I saw the Spirit descending from heaven like a dove and resting on Him.
ekegusii: Naende Yohana akaorokia, “Narorire Omoika ogoika korwa igoro buna riruma, okobeera igoro asare.
swahili: Kisha Yohana akatoa ushuhuda huu: “Nilimwona Roho akishuka kutoka mbinguni kama hua, akakaa juu yake.

english: I myself did not know Him, but the One who sent me to baptize with water told me, ‘The man on whom you see the Spirit descend and rest is He who will baptize with the Holy Spirit.’
ekegusii: Na inche tinamomanya, korende ere oyontomete kobatisa ase amaache, oyio nere ontebetie: Ere oyo oranyare korora Omoika ogoika na goikaransa igoro yaye, oyio nere okobatisa n’Omoika Omochenu.
swahili: Mimi nisingemtambua, lakini yeye aliyenituma nibatize kwa maji alikuwa ameniambia, ‘Yule mtu utakayemwona Roho akimshukia na kukaa juu yake, huyo ndiye atakayebatiza kwa Roho Mtakatifu.’

english: I have seen and testified that this is the Son of God. ” The First Disciples (Matthew 4:18–22; Mark 1:16–20; Luke 5:1–11)
ekegusii: Na inche narorire, naende naorokirie ng’a oyo nere Omwana o Nyasae.” Aborokigwa b’eritang’ani ba Yeso
swahili: Mimi mwenyewe nimeona jambo hili na ninashuhudia kuwa huyu ndiye Mwana wa Mungu.” Wanafunzi Wa Kwanza Wa Yesu

english: The next day John was there again with two of his disciples.
ekegusii: Naende rituko riare kobwatia Yohana nigo arenge oteneine amo na babere baborokigwa baye.
swahili: Siku iliyofuata, Yohana alikuwa huko tena pamoja na wanafunzi wake wawili.

english: When he saw Jesus walking by, he said, “Look, the Lamb of God!”
ekegusii: Akarigereria Yeso ogotaara, akabora, “Rora, Emanwa y’Eng’ondi ya Nyasae!”
swahili: Alipomwona Yesu akipita, akasema, “Tazama, Mwana-Kondoo wa Mungu!”

english: And when the two disciples heard him say this, they followed Jesus.
ekegusii: Aborokigwa baria babere bakamoigwa ogoteeba aya, bagatunyana Yeso.
swahili: Wale wanafunzi wawili walipomsikia Yohana akisema haya, wakamfuata Yesu.

english: Jesus turned and saw them following. “What do you want?” He asked. They said to Him, “Rabbi” (which means Teacher), “where are You staying?”
ekegusii: Yeso akeonchora, akabarora bakomotunyana, akababoria, “Ninki mokorigia?” Bakamoteebia, “Rabii” (okoonchorwa kwaye Omworokia), “nga’i omenyete?”
swahili: Yesu akageuka, akawaona wakimfuata akawauliza, “Mnataka nini?” Wakamwambia, “Rabi,” (maana yake Mwalimu), “Unaishi wapi?”

english: “Come and see,” He replied. So they went and saw where He was staying, and spent that day with Him. It was about the tenth hour.
ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Inchuo morore.” Bagaacha, bakarora aase amenyete, bakaba nere rituko riria; nigo chiarenge ang’e chinsa ikomi.
swahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Njooni, nanyi mtapaona!” Hivyo wakaenda na kupaona mahali alipokuwa anaishi, wakakaa naye siku ile, kwa kuwa ilikuwa yapata saa kumi.

english: In Him was life, and that life was the light of men.
ekegusii: Ime yaye nao bwarenge obogima; na obogima obwo nigo bwarenge oborabu ase mwanyabaanto.
swahili: Ndani yake ndimo ulimokuwa uzima na huo uzima ulikuwa nuru ya watu.

english: Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, was one of the two who heard John’s testimony and followed Jesus.
ekegusii: Anderea, momura omwabo Simioni Petero, nigo arenge oyomo bwa baria babere baigwete Yohana, na gotunyana Yeso.
swahili: Andrea nduguye Simoni Petro, alikuwa mmoja wa wale wawili waliosikia yale Yohana aliyokuwa amesema, naye ndiye alimfuata Yesu.

english: He first found his brother Simon and told him, “We have found the Messiah” (which is translated as Christ).
ekegusii: Oyo akanyora ritang’ani Simioni momura omwabo omonyene, akamoteebia, “Twanyorire Masihi” (okoonchorwa kwaye Kristo).
swahili: Kitu cha kwanza Andrea alichofanya ni kumtafuta Simoni nduguye na kumwambia, “Tumemwona Masiya” (yaani, Kristo).

english: Andrew brought him to Jesus, who looked at him and said, “You are Simon son of John. You will be called Cephas” (which is translated as Peter). Jesus Calls Philip and Nathanael
ekegusii: Akamoira ase Yeso. Yeso akamorigereria, akabora, “Aye Simioni, omwana o Yohana, norokwe Kefa” (okoonchorwa kwaye Petero, gose rigena). Yeso Okorangeria Filipo na Natanaeli
swahili: Naye akamleta kwa Yesu. Yesu akamwangalia na kusema, “Wewe ni Simoni mwana wa Yohana. Utaitwa Kefa” (ambalo limetafsiriwa Petro ). Yesu Awaita Filipo Na Nathanaeli

english: The next day Jesus decided to set out for Galilee. Finding Philip, He told him, “Follow Me.”
ekegusii: Rituko rikobwatia Yeso akarigia koimoka kogenda Galili. Akanyoora Filipo, akamoteebia, “Ntunyana.”
swahili: Siku iliyofuata Yesu aliamua kwenda Galilaya. Akamkuta Filipo, akamwambia, “Nifuate.”

english: Now Philip was from Bethsaida, the same town as Andrew and Peter.
ekegusii: Nere Filipo nigo arenge omonto o Bethisaida, omochie bw’Anderea na Petero.
swahili: Basi Filipo alikuwa mwenyeji wa Bethsaida, mji alikotoka Andrea na Petro.

english: Philip found Nathanael and told him, “We have found the One Moses wrote about in the Law, the One the prophets foretold—Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph.”
ekegusii: Filipo akanyoora Natanaeli, akamoteebia, “Twanyorire ere oyo amang’ana aye arigetwe na Musa ase amachiiko, naende nababani, Yeso omwana o Yusufu, omonto o Nazareti.”
swahili: Filipo naye akamkuta Nathanaeli na kumwambia, “Tumemwona yeye ambaye Mose aliandika habari zake katika Sheria na ambaye pia manabii waliandika kumhusu, yaani, Yesu wa Nazareti, mwana wa Yosefu.”

english: “Can anything good come from Nazareth?” Nathanael asked. “Come and see,” said Philip.
ekegusii: Natanaeli akamobooria, “Egento ekiya nakenyare korwa Nazareti?” Filipo akamoteebia, “Inchuo orore.”
swahili: Nathanaeli akauliza, “Nazareti! Je, kitu chochote chema chaweza kutoka Nazareti?” Filipo akamwambia, “Njoo uone.”

english: When Jesus saw Nathanael approaching, He said of him, “Here is a true Israelite, in whom there is no deceit.”
ekegusii: Yeso akarora Natanaeli ogocha asare, agakwana igoro yaye, “Rora oyo n’Omoisraeli ekeene, otari nobong’ainereria ime yaye!”
swahili: Yesu alipomwona Nathanaeli anakaribia, akanena habari zake akasema, “Tazama huyu ni Mwisraeli kweli kweli; hana hila ndani yake.”

english: “How do You know me?” Nathanael asked. Jesus replied, “Before Philip called you, I saw you under the fig tree.”
ekegusii: Natanaeli akamobooria, “Ing’ai kwamanyera?” Yeso akamoiraneria, “Ritang’ani Filipo atarakorangeria, ekero kwarenge inse ase omoko, konya nakororire.”
swahili: Nathanaeli akamuuliza, “Umenifahamuje?” Yesu akamjibu, “Nilikuona ulipokuwa bado uko chini ya mtini, kabla hata Filipo hajakuita.”

english: “Rabbi,” Nathanael answered, “You are the Son of God! You are the King of Israel!”
ekegusii: Natanaeli akamoiraneria, “Omworokia, aye n’Omwana o Nyasae, naye Omorwoti bw’Abaisraeli.”
swahili: Nathanaeli akamwambia, “Rabi, wewe ni Mwana wa Mungu! Wewe ni Mfalme wa Israeli!”

english: The Light shines in the darkness, and the darkness has not overcome it. The Witness of John
ekegusii: Noro omobaso obarire ase omosunte, erio omosunte toyorimia.
swahili: Nuru hungʼaa gizani nalo giza halikuishinda.

english: Jesus said to him, “Do you believe just because I told you I saw you under the fig tree? You will see greater things than these.”
ekegusii: Yeso akamoiraneria, “Inee! Kwegenire ekiagera nagoteebia ng’a nakorooche inse ase omoko? Norore amang’ana amanene kobua aya.”
swahili: Yesu akamwambia, “Unaamini kwa kuwa nilikuambia nilikuona ulipokuwa bado uko chini ya mtini? Basi utaona mambo makuu zaidi kuliko hilo.”

english: Then He declared, “Truly, truly, I tell you, you will all see heaven open and the angels of God ascending and descending on the Son of Man.”
ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Ekeene, ekeene, nabateebirie: Inamorore igoro akoigoka, na abamalaika ba Nyasae bakoriina na goika igoro ase Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto.”
swahili: Ndipo akawaambia, “Amin, amin nawaambia, ninyi mtaona mbingu ikifunguka na malaika wa Mungu wakipanda na kushuka juu ya Mwana wa Adamu.”

english: There came a man who was sent from God. His name was John.
ekegusii: Narengeo omonto oyomo, otometwe korwa ase Nyasae, erieta riaye Yohana.
swahili: Alikuja mtu mmoja aliyetumwa kutoka kwa Mungu, jina lake Yohana.

english: He came as a witness to testify about the Light, so that through him everyone might believe.
ekegusii: Oyo nigo achete abe kirori, erinde aorokie omobaso, bonsi banyare kwegena goetera asere.
swahili: Alikuja kama shahidi apate kuishuhudia hiyo nuru, ili kwa kupitia kwake watu wote waweze kuamini.

english: He himself was not the Light, but he came to testify about the Light.
ekegusii: Oyio tarenge omobaso oria, korende nigo achete aorokie omobaso.
swahili: Yeye mwenyewe hakuwa ile nuru, bali alikuja kuishuhudia hiyo nuru.

english: The true Light who gives light to every man was coming into the world.
ekegusii: Omobaso bw’ekeene, oria okobarera kera omonto, ngocha orenge ase ense.
swahili: Kwamba nuru halisi, imwangaziayo kila mtu ilikuwa inakuja ulimwenguni.

english: Early on the first day of the week, while it was still dark, Mary Magdalene went to the tomb and saw that the stone had been removed from the entrance.
ekegusii: Bono ase rituko rie ritang’ani ri’echuma Mariamu; Magidalena akagenda ase oboina kobogokiamoka, ekero botarakiamoka buya, akarora ng’a rigena riarusigwe korwa ase oboina.
swahili: Alfajiri na mapema siku ya kwanza ya juma, kulipokuwa kungali giza bado, Maria Magdalene alikwenda kaburini na kukuta lile jiwe limeondolewa penye ingilio.

english: Then the disciples returned to their homes.
ekegusii: Erio aborokigwa baria bakagenda chinsobo. Yeso okoorokera Mariamu Magidalena (Mar 16:9-11)
swahili: Kisha hao wanafunzi wakaondoka wakarudi nyumbani kwao. Yesu Anamtokea Maria Magdalene (Mathayo 28:9-10; Marko 16:9-11)

english: But Mary stood outside the tomb weeping. And as she wept, she bent down to look into the tomb,
ekegusii: Korende Mariamu nigo ateneine isiko ang’e noboina, okorera; nabo gakorera, agatung’ama, akarigereria ime ase oboina.
swahili: Lakini Maria Magdalene akasimama nje ya kaburi akilia. Alipokuwa akilia, akainama, kuchungulia mle kaburini,

english: and she saw two angels in white sitting where the body of Jesus had lain, one at the head and the other at the feet.
ekegusii: Erio akarora abamalaika babere, barenge ne chianga chindabu, baikaransete, oyomo ase omotwe, naende oyomo ase amagoro, agwo aase omobere o Yeso obegetwe.
swahili: naye akaona malaika wawili wamevaa mavazi meupe, wameketi pale mwili wa Yesu ulipokuwa umelazwa, mmoja upande wa kichwani na mwingine upande wa miguuni.

english: “Woman, why are you weeping?” they asked. “Because they have taken my Lord away,” she said, “and I do not know where they have put Him.”
ekegusii: Barabwo bakamobooria, “Omokungu, inki okorera?” Akabairaneria, “Nekiagera barusirie Omonene one, na timanyeti aase bamobeka.”
swahili: Wakamuuliza Maria, “Mwanamke, mbona unalia?” Akawaambia, “Nalia kwa kuwa wamemchukua Bwana wangu na sijui walikomweka.”

english: When she had said this, she turned around and saw Jesus standing there; but she did not recognize that it was Jesus.
ekegusii: Kagokwana aya akeonchora gochia magega, akarora Yeso oteneine, tamanya ng’a n’Yeso.
swahili: Baada ya kusema hayo, akageuka, akamwona Yesu amesimama, lakini hakumtambua.

english: “Woman, why are you weeping?” Jesus asked. “Whom are you seeking?” Thinking He was the gardener, she said, “Sir, if you have carried Him off, tell me where you have put Him, and I will get Him.”
ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Omong’ina, ninki okorera? Ning’o okorigia?” Ere agakaga ng’a nomorendi bw’omogondo, akamoteebia, “Omonene, onye naye kwamoira, nteebia aase kwamobeka, na inche nimorusie.”
swahili: Yesu akamwambia, “Mwanamke, mbona unalia? Unamtafuta nani?” Maria akidhani ya kuwa aliyekuwa anaongea naye ni mtunza bustani, kwa hiyo akamwambia, “Bwana, kama ni wewe umemchukua, tafadhali nionyeshe ulikomweka, nami nitamchukua.”

english: Jesus said to her, “Mary.” She turned and said to Him in Hebrew, “Rabboni!” (which means “Teacher”).
ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Mariamu.” Ere akeonchora, akamoteebia ase Ekeiberania, “Raboni!” (Okoonchorwa kwaye, Omworokia).
swahili: Yesu akamwita, “Maria!” Ndipo Maria akamgeukia Yesu na kusema naye kwa Kiebrania, “Rabboni!” (maana yake Mwalimu).

english: “Do not cling to Me,” Jesus said, “for I have not yet ascended to the Father. But go and tell My brothers, ‘I am ascending to My Father and your Father, to My God and your God.’”
ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Tonkuna, ekiagera tindagenda ase Tata one, korende genda ase abaminto, obateebie, ng’a nkogenda nde ase Tata one oyore Iso oino, ase Nyasae one oyore Nyasae oino.”
swahili: Yesu akamwambia, “Usinishike, kwa maana sijapaa kwenda kwa Baba. Lakini nenda kwa ndugu zangu ukawaambie, ‘Ninapaa kwenda kwa Baba yangu ambaye ni Baba yenu, kwa Mungu wangu ambaye ni Mungu wenu.’ ”

english: Mary Magdalene went and announced to the disciples, “I have seen the Lord!” And she told them what He had said to her. Jesus Appears to the Disciples (Luke 24:36–49; 1 John 1:1–4)
ekegusii: Mariamu Magidalena akagenda, agateebia aborokigwa amang’ana ng’a, “Narorire Omonene”, naende ng’a omotebirie aya. Yeso okoorokera abatomwa (Mat 28:16-20; Mar 16:14-18; Luk 24:36-49)
swahili: Kwa hiyo Maria Magdalene akaenda kuwatangazia wanafunzi wa Yesu, akisema, “Nimemwona Bwana!” Naye akawaambia kwamba Yesu alikuwa amemweleza mambo hayo yote. Yesu Awatokea Wanafunzi Wake (Mathayo 28:16-20; Marko 16:14-18; Luka 24:36-49)

english: It was the first day of the week, and that very evening, while the disciples were together with the doors locked for fear of the Jews, Jesus came and stood among them. “Peace be with you!” He said to them.
ekegusii: Ase omogoroba bwe rituko rie ritang’ani ri’echuma, na ebisieri kobiasiekirwe aase agwo aborokigwa barenge, ekiagera bairogete Abayahudi, Yeso agacha, agatenena gati‐gati akabateebia, “Omorembe obe ase more!”
swahili: Ikawa jioni ya ile siku ya kwanza ya juma, wanafunzi wake walikuwa pamoja, milango ikiwa imefungwa kwa kuwaogopa Wayahudi. Naye Yesu aliwatokea, akasimama katikati yao, akasema, “Amani iwe nanyi!”

english: So she came running to Simon Peter and the other disciple, the one whom Jesus loved. “They have taken the Lord out of the tomb,” she said, “and we do not know where they have put Him!”
ekegusii: Erio akagenda bwango goika ase Simioni Petero, na ase omworokigwa oria onde, oria Yeso anchete, akabateebia, “Barusirie Omonene korwa ase oboina, korende titomanyeti aase bamobeka.”
swahili: Hivyo akaja akikimbia kwa Simoni Petro pamoja na yule mwanafunzi mwingine ambaye Yesu alimpenda, na kusema, “Wamemwondoa Bwana kaburini, na hatujui walikomweka!”

english: After He had said this, He showed them His hands and His side. The disciples rejoiced when they saw the Lord.
ekegusii: Gakwanire aya, akaborokia amaboko aye ne rikere riaye. Erio aborokigwa bakagoka kobachia korora Omonene.
swahili: Baada ya kusema haya, akawaonyesha mikono yake na ubavu wake. Wanafunzi wake wakafurahi sana walipomwona Bwana.

english: Again Jesus said to them, “Peace be with you. As the Father has sent Me, so also I am sending you.”
ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia eria kabere, “Omorembe obe ase more! Buna Tata antomete, naboigo nainche nabatomire inwe.”
swahili: Yesu akawaambia tena, “Amani iwe nanyi! Kama vile Baba alivyonituma mimi, mimi nami nawatuma ninyi.”

english: When He had said this, He breathed on them and said, “Receive the Holy Spirit.
ekegusii: Gakwanire aya, akabautera omoika, akabateebia, “Nyora Omoika Omochenu.
swahili: Naye alipokwisha kusema haya, akawavuvia, akawaambia, “Pokeeni Roho Mtakatifu.

english: If you forgive anyone his sins, they are forgiven; if you withhold forgiveness from anyone, it is withheld.” Jesus Appears to Thomas
ekegusii: Bande bonsi morabere ebibe, baabeirwe; naende bande bonsi morasiekere ebibe, basiekeirwe.” Yeso okoorokera Thomas
swahili: Mkimwondolea mtu yeyote dhambi zake, zitaondolewa, na yeyote msiyemwondolea dhambi zake, hazitaondolewa.” Yesu Anamtokea Tomaso

english: Now Thomas called Didymus, one of the Twelve, was not with the disciples when Jesus came.
ekegusii: Ko Thomas, oyomo bwa baria ikomi na babere, oyokorokwa Barongo, tarenge amo nabarabwo ekero Yeso achete.
swahili: Lakini Tomaso, aliyeitwa Didimasi, yaani Pacha, mmoja wa wale kumi na wawili, hakuwa pamoja nao Yesu alipokuja.

english: So the other disciples told him, “We have seen the Lord!” But he replied, “Unless I see the nail marks in His hands, and put my finger where the nails have been, and put my hand into His side, I will never believe.”
ekegusii: Erio aborokigwa bande bakamoteebia, “Twarorire Omonene.” Korende ere akabateebia, “Ntarochi amaboko aye na ebimanyererio bi’emesumari, na kobeeka ekiara kiane aase emesumari yamobetete, na kobeeka okoboko kwane rikere riaye ime, tinkwegena nonya ng’ake.”
swahili: Hivyo wale wanafunzi wengine wakamwambia, “Tumemwona Bwana.” Lakini yeye akawaambia, “Nisipoona zile alama za misumari mikononi mwake, na kuweka kidole changu kwenye hizo alama za misumari na mkono wangu ubavuni mwake, sitaamini.”

english: Eight days later, His disciples were once again inside with the doors locked, and Thomas was with them. Jesus came and stood among them and said, “Peace be with you.”
ekegusii: Magega y’amatuko atano na atato aborokigwa baye nao barenge naende ase enyomba eria ime, na Thomas amo nabarabwo. Yeso agacha ekero ebisieri bisiekire, agatenena gati‐gati, akabora, “Omorembe obe ase more!”
swahili: Baada ya siku nane, wanafunzi wake walikuwa tena pamoja ndani ya nyumba, naye Tomaso alikuwa pamoja nao. Ndipo Yesu akaja milango ikiwa imefungwa na kusimama katikati yao akasema, “Amani iwe nanyi.”

english: Then Jesus said to Thomas, “Put your finger here and look at My hands. Reach out your hand and put it into My side. Stop doubting and believe.”
ekegusii: Erio agateebia Thomas, “Renta aiga ekiara kiao. Orore amaboko aane. Renta okoboko kwao, okobeke ase rikere riane; toba oyotegeneti, korende oyo bwegenete.”
swahili: Kisha akamwambia Tomaso, “Weka kidole chako hapa na uone mikono yangu, nyoosha mkono wako uguse ubavuni mwangu. Usiwe na shaka, bali uamini tu.”

english: Thomas replied, “My Lord and my God!”
ekegusii: Thomas akamoiraneria, “Omonene one, na Nyasae one!”
swahili: Tomaso akamwambia, “Bwana wangu na Mungu wangu!”

english: Jesus said to him, “Because you have seen Me, you have believed; blessed are those who have not seen and yet have believed.” The Purpose of John’s Book
ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Iga kwegena ekiagera kwandora; mbare nomogooko abatarochi ko begenire.” Engencho yagerete enchiri eye ekarikwa
swahili: Yesu akamwambia, “Umeamini kwa kuwa umeniona? Wamebarikiwa wale ambao hawajaona lakini wameamini.” Kusudi La Kitabu Hiki

english: Then Peter and the other disciple set out for the tomb.
ekegusii: Petero agasoka, akagenda amo nomworokigwa oria onde, bakabwatia enchera kogenda oboina.
swahili: Petro na yule mwanafunzi mwingine wakaondoka mara kuelekea kaburini.

english: Jesus performed many other signs in the presence of His disciples, which are not written in this book.
ekegusii: Nabo mbire ebikone binde ebinge Yeso akorete ase amasio y’aborokigwa baye bitarikiri ase egetabu eke,
swahili: Yesu alifanya miujiza mingine mingi mbele za wanafunzi wake, ambayo haikuandikwa katika kitabu hiki.

english: But these are written so that you may believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God, and that by believing you may have life in His name.
ekegusii: korende ebi biarikirwe, erinde monyare kwegena ng’a Yeso nere Kristo, Omwana o Nyasae; naende ase okwegena mobe nobogima ase erieta riaye.
swahili: Lakini haya yameandikwa ili mweze kuamini ya kuwa Yesu ndiye Kristo, Mwana wa Mungu, na kwa kumwamini mpate uzima katika jina lake.

english: The two were running together, but the other disciple outran Peter and reached the tomb first.
ekegusii: Bakaminyoka chimbero bonsi babere amo. Omworokigwa oria onde akaminyoka bwango kobua Petero, akaba oyo bw’eritang’ani goika ase oboina,
swahili: Wote wawili walikuwa wanakimbia, lakini yule mwanafunzi mwingine akakimbia mbio zaidi kuliko Petro, akatangulia kufika kaburini.

english: He bent down and looked in at the linen cloths lying there, but he did not go in.
ekegusii: agatung’ama, akarora ebitambaa bireo, korende tasoa ime.
swahili: Alipofika, akainama na kuchungulia mle kaburini, akaona vile vitambaa vya kitani mle ndani, lakini hakuingia.

english: Simon Peter arrived just after him. He entered the tomb and saw the linen cloths lying there.
ekegusii: Erio Simioni Petero agacha, akamotunyana, agasoa oboina ime, akarora ebitambaa bireo,
swahili: Ndipo Simoni Petro akaja, akimfuata nyuma akaenda moja kwa moja hadi ndani ya kaburi. Naye akaona vile vitambaa vya ile sanda vikiwa pale chini

english: The cloth that had been around Jesus’ head was rolled up, lying separate from the linen cloths.
ekegusii: na egetambaa keria ki’omotwe oye tikiabekire amo nebitambaa binde, korende nigo kiaringire, kebekire ao gioka.
swahili: na kile kitambaa kilichokuwa kichwani mwa Yesu. Kitambaa hicho kilikuwa kimekunjwa mahali pa peke yake, mbali na vile vitambaa vya kitani vya ile sanda.

english: Then the other disciple, who had reached the tomb first, also went in. And he saw and believed.
ekegusii: Erio agwo omworokigwa oria onde orenge bw’eritang’ani goika ase oboina agasoa, akarora, akeegena.
swahili: Kisha yule mwanafunzi aliyetangulia kufika kaburini naye akaingia ndani, akaona, akaamini,

english: For they still did not understand from the Scripture that Jesus had to rise from the dead. Jesus Appears to Mary Magdalene (Mark 16:9–11)
ekegusii: Naki konya tibaramanya ririiko, ng’a nemogwenerete koboka korwa ase abakuure.
swahili: (kwa kuwa mpaka wakati huo walikuwa bado hawajaelewa kutoka Maandiko kwamba ilikuwa lazima Yesu afufuke kutoka kwa wafu).

english: Later, by the Sea of Tiberias, Jesus again revealed Himself to the disciples. He made Himself known in this way:
ekegusii: Magega ase aya Yeso akeorokia naende ase aborokigwa baye ase enyancha ya Tiberia. Ayio nigo akorekanete iga:
swahili: Baada ya haya Yesu akawatokea tena wanafunzi wake kando ya Bahari ya Tiberia. Yeye alijionyesha kwao hivi:

english: Jesus told them, “Bring some of the fish you have just caught.”
ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Renta aiga echinde chie chinswe echi mwarubire bono.”
swahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Leteni baadhi ya hao samaki mliovua sasa hivi.”

english: So Simon Peter went aboard and dragged the net ashore. It was full of large fish, 153, but even with so many, the net was not torn.
ekegusii: Erio Simioni Petero akariina obwato ime, akang’usa ekeonga gochia engegu geichire chinswe chinene, rigana erimo, na emerongo etano, na isato; nonya chiarenge chinyinge buna iga, ekeonga tigiatandogete.
swahili: Simoni Petro akapanda kwenye mashua na kuukokota ule wavu pwani. Ulikuwa umejaa samaki wakubwa 153. Ingawa samaki walikuwa wengi kiasi hicho, ule wavu haukuchanika.

english: “Come, have breakfast,” Jesus said to them. None of the disciples dared to ask Him, “Who are You?” They knew it was the Lord.
ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Inchuo morie!” Gose onde tarenge ase aborokigwa baria orenge na boremu komoboria, “Aye naye ng’o?” Ekiagera mbamanyete ng’a n’Omonene.
swahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Njooni mpate kifungua kinywa.” Hakuna hata mmoja wa wanafunzi aliyethubutu kumuuliza, “Wewe ni nani?” Kwa sababu walijua ya kuwa ni Bwana.

english: Jesus came and took the bread and gave it to them, and He did the same with the fish.
ekegusii: Yeso akagenda akabogoria omogati, akabaa, ne chinswe boigo.
swahili: Yesu akaja, akachukua ule mkate, akawapa na vivyo hivyo akawagawia pia wale samaki.

english: This was now the third time that Jesus appeared to the disciples after He was raised from the dead. Jesus and Peter
ekegusii: Eke nekero kia gatato Yeso arorekanete ase aborokigwa baye magega y’okobokigwa korwa ase abakuure. Amang’ana y’omoerio a Yeso ase Petero
swahili: Hii ilikuwa mara ya tatu Yesu kuwatokea wanafunzi wake baada yake kufufuliwa kutoka kwa wafu. Yesu Amuuliza Petro Kama Anampenda

english: When they had finished eating, Jesus asked Simon Peter, “Simon son of John, do you love Me more than these?” “Yes, Lord,” he answered, “You know I love You.” Jesus replied, “Feed My lambs.”
ekegusii: Erio kobakoorire koragera, Yeso akaboria Simioni Petero, “Simioni mosinto o Yohana, nonyanchete kobua aba?” Akamoiraneria, “Ee, Omonene, aye nomanyete ng’a ningwanchete.” Akamoteebia, “Risia chimanwa chi’eching’ondi chiane.”
swahili: Walipokwisha kula, Yesu akamuuliza Simoni Petro, “Je, Simoni mwana wa Yohana, unanipenda kweli kuliko hawa?” Yeye akamjibu, “Ndiyo Bwana, wewe unajua ya kuwa ninakupenda.” Yesu akamwambia, “Lisha wana-kondoo wangu.”

english: Jesus asked a second time, “Simon son of John, do you love Me?” “Yes, Lord,” he answered, “You know I love You.” Jesus told him, “Shepherd My sheep.”
ekegusii: Akamoboria eria kabere, “Simioni mosinto o Yohana, nonyanchete?” Akamoiraneria, “Ee, Omonene, aye nomanyete ng’a ningwanchete.” Akamoteebia, “Risia ching’ondi chiane.”
swahili: Yesu akamwambia tena, “Simoni, mwana wa Yohana, wanipenda?” Petro akamjibu, “Ndiyo Bwana, wewe unajua ya kuwa ninakupenda.” Yesu akamwambia, “Chunga kondoo zangu.”

english: Jesus asked a third time, “Simon son of John, do you love Me?” Peter was deeply hurt that Jesus had asked him a third time, “Do you love Me?” “Lord, You know all things,” he replied. “You know I love You.” Jesus said to him, “Feed My sheep.
ekegusii: Akamoboria eria gatato, “Simioni mosinto o Yohana, nonyanchete inche?” Petero agaichana ekiagera amoboretie eria gatato, “Nonyanchete?” Akamoiraneria, “Omonene, aye nomanyete onsi, nomanyete ng’a ningwanchete.” Yeso akamoteebia, “Risia ching’ondi chiane.
swahili: Kwa mara ya tatu Yesu akamuuliza Petro, “Simoni mwana wa Yohana, unanipenda?” Petro akahuzunika sana kwa kuwa Yesu alimuuliza mara ya tatu, “Unanipenda?” Akamjibu, “Bwana, wewe unajua yote, unajua ya kuwa ninakupenda.” Yesu akamwambia, “Lisha kondoo wangu.

english: Truly, truly, I tell you, when you were young, you dressed yourself and walked where you wanted; but when you are old, you will stretch out your hands, and someone else will dress you and lead you where you do not want to go.”
ekegusii: Ekeene, ekeene, nagotebirie: Ekero kwarenge omosae, nigo kwarenge kweboyia, kwagenda aase origetie, korende ekero orache koba omogaka, norambore amaboko ao, na oyonde nagosibe, akoire aase otancheti.”
swahili: Amin, amin nakuambia, ulipokuwa kijana ulivaa na kwenda unakotaka, lakini utakapokuwa mzee utanyoosha mikono yako na mtu mwingine atakuvika na kukupeleka usipotaka kwenda.”

english: Jesus said this to indicate the kind of death by which Peter would glorify God. And after He had said this, He told him, “Follow Me.” Jesus and the Beloved Disciple
ekegusii: (Agakwana eri ase okworokia imakweri ki aramotogie Nyasae). Erio gakoorire gokwana aya, akamoteebia, “Ntunyana?”
swahili: Yesu alisema haya ili kuashiria ni kifo cha aina gani Petro atakachomtukuza nacho Mungu. Kisha Yesu akamwambia Petro, “Nifuate!”

english: Simon Peter, Thomas called Didymus, Nathanael from Cana in Galilee, the sons of Zebedee, and two other disciples were together.
ekegusii: Simioni Petero, na Thomas oyokorokwa Barongo, na Natanaeli o Kana ya Galili, na abamura ba Zebedi, na babere bande baborokigwa baye barenge amo.
swahili: Simoni Petro, Tomaso aitwaye Didimasi, yaani Pacha, Nathanaeli wa Kana ya Galilaya, wana wa Zebedayo na wanafunzi wengine wawili walikuwa pamoja.

english: Peter turned and saw the disciple whom Jesus loved following them. He was the one who had leaned back against Jesus at the supper to ask, “Lord, who is going to betray You?”
ekegusii: Petero akeonchora, akarora omworokigwa oria Yeso anchete okobatunyana; nere oria bweegegete egekuba kiaye ekero gi’okoria endagera ya mogoroba na gokwana, “Omonene, ning’o orakorue?”
swahili: Petro akageuka, akamwona yule mwanafunzi aliyependwa na Yesu akiwafuata. (Huyu ndiye yule mwanafunzi aliyeegama kifuani mwa Yesu walipokula naye chakula cha mwisho na kuuliza, “Bwana, ni nani atakayekusaliti?”)

english: When Peter saw him, he asked, “Lord, what about him?”
ekegusii: Petero agachia komoorora oyio, akaboria Yeso, “Omonene, noyo rende?”
swahili: Petro alipomwona huyo mwanafunzi, akamuuliza Yesu, “Bwana na huyu je?”

english: Jesus answered, “If I want him to remain until I return, what is that to you? You follow Me!”
ekegusii: Yeso akamoiraneria, “Kondarigie oyo abeo goika inchiche, inki ogwechandera ayio? Aye ntunyane inche.”
swahili: Yesu akamjibu, “Ikiwa nataka aishi mpaka nitakaporudi, inakuhusu nini? Wewe inakupasa unifuate!”

english: Because of this, the rumor spread among the brothers that this disciple would not die. However, Jesus did not say that he would not die, but only, “If I want him to remain until I return, what is that to you?”
ekegusii: Erio ring’ana eri rigasarera ase abamwabo ng’a omworokigwa oria tagokwa, korende Yeso tamotebetie ng’a tagokwa, otatiga, “Kondarigie abeo goika inchiche, inki ogwechandera ayio?” Amang’ana ’ogokoorera
swahili: Kwa sababu ya maneno haya ya Yesu, uvumi ukaenea miongoni mwa ndugu kwamba huyu mwanafunzi hangekufa. Lakini Yesu hakusema kuwa hangekufa. Yeye alisema tu kwamba, “Ikiwa nataka aishi mpaka nitakaporudi, inakuhusu nini?”

english: This is the disciple who testifies to these things and who has written them down. And we know that his testimony is true.
ekegusii: Oyo nomworokigwa oria orooche aya, na koyarika, naende twamanyire ng’a oborori bwaye nobw’ekeene.
swahili: Huyu ndiye yule mwanafunzi anayeshuhudia mambo haya na ndiye ambaye ameandika habari hizi. Nasi tunajua ya kuwa ushuhuda wake ni kweli.

english: There are many more things that Jesus did. If all of them were written down, I suppose that not even the world itself would have space for the books that would be written.
ekegusii: Nare naende ayande amange aya Yeso akorete; naro kararikwe erimo erimo, nigo ngokaga ng’a nonya nense yonsi tegoisana chibuku echiranyare korikwa chibekwe.
swahili: Lakini kuna mambo mengine mengi ambayo Yesu alifanya. Kama yote yangeliandikwa, nadhani hata ulimwengu wote usingekuwa na nafasi ya kutosha kuweka vitabu vyote ambavyo vingeandikwa. Amen.

english: Simon Peter told them, “I am going fishing.” “We will go with you,” they said. So they went out and got into the boat, but caught nothing that night.
ekegusii: Simioni Petero akabateebia, “Nkogenda nde koruba chinswe.” Bakamoteebia, “Naintwe natogende amo naye.” Bagasoka, bakariina obwato ime, korende obotuko boria tibanyora gento.
swahili: Simoni Petro akawaambia wenzake, “Mimi naenda kuvua samaki.” Nao wakamwambia, “Tutakwenda pamoja nawe.” Wakatoka, wakaingia ndani ya mashua, lakini usiku ule hawakupata chochote.

english: Early in the morning, Jesus stood on the shore, but the disciples did not recognize that it was Jesus.
ekegusii: Goika bogachia gokia mambia, Yeso agatenena ase engegu, korende aborokigwa tibamanya ng’a n’Yeso.
swahili: Mara baada ya kupambazuka, Yesu akasimama ufuoni, lakini wanafunzi hawakumtambua kwamba alikuwa Yesu.

english: So He called out to them, “Children, do you have any fish?” “No,” they answered.
ekegusii: Erio Yeso akababoria, “Abana, more neki mokoria?” Bakamoiraneria, “Yaya.”
swahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Wanangu, je, mna samaki wowote?” Wakamjibu, “La.”

english: He told them, “Cast the net on the right side of the boat, and you will find some.” So they cast it there, and they were unable to haul it in because of the great number of fish.
ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Ruta ekeonga ensemo ya borio y’obwato, na inwe namonyore chinswe.” Erio bagakeruta, korende tibanyara gokeng’usa ase engencho y’obonge bwe chinswe.
swahili: Akawaambia, “Shusheni nyavu upande wa kuume wa mashua yenu nanyi mtapata samaki.” Wakashusha nyavu na tazama wakapata samaki wengi mno hata wakashindwa kuvutia zile nyavu zilizojaa samaki ndani ya mashua.

english: Then the disciple whom Jesus loved said to Peter, “It is the Lord!” As soon as Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he put on his outer garment (for he had removed it) and jumped into the sea.
ekegusii: Omworokigwa oria Yeso anchete agateebia Petero, “Nere Omonene.” Erio Simioni Petero, agachia koigwa ng’a n’Omonene, akeboyia eanga yaye (ekiagera arenge getirianda), akeruta enyancha ime.
swahili: Yule mwanafunzi aliyependwa na Yesu akamwambia Petro, “Huyu ni Bwana!” Simoni Petro aliposikia haya, akajifunga nguo yake kwa kuwa alikuwa uchi, naye akajitosa baharini.

english: The other disciples came ashore in the boat. They dragged in the net full of fish, for they were not far from land, only about a hundred yards.
ekegusii: Korende aborokigwa bande bagacha ase obwato, bagakurura ekeonga geichire chinswe, ekiagera tibarenge are ase ense enyomo, ang’e chifuti amagana atato.
swahili: Wale wanafunzi wengine wakaja kwa ile mashua huku wakikokota ule wavu uliyojaa samaki, maana hawakuwa mbali na nchi kavu, ilikuwa yapata dhiraa 200

english: When they landed, they saw a charcoal fire there with fish on it, and some bread.
ekegusii: Erio kobachia goika engegu, bakarora omorero bw’amakara aroro, na enswe ebekire igoro yaye, na omogati.
swahili: Walipofika ufuoni, wakaona moto wa makaa na samaki wakiokwa juu yake na mikate.

english: On the third day a wedding took place at Cana in Galilee. Jesus’ mother was there,
ekegusii: Naende rituko ria gatato ’yarenge enyangi agwo Kana ya Galili, na ng’ina Yeso nao arenge.
swahili: Siku ya tatu kulikuwa na arusi katika mji wa Kana ya Galilaya, naye mama yake Yesu alikuwepo pale.

english: and said, “Everyone serves the fine wine first, and then the cheap wine after the guests are drunk. But you have saved the fine wine until now!”
ekegusii: akamoteebia, “Kera omonto ritang’ani nigo agochaaka nedivai ere engiya, goika abanto kobanyuure mono, erio orenta eyetari engiya; aye gese nigo ogachete edivai engiya goika bono.”
swahili: akamwambia, “Watu wote hutoa kwanza divai nzuri, kisha huleta ile divai hafifu wageni wakisha kunywa vya kutosha, lakini wewe umeiweka ile nzuri kupita zote mpaka sasa.”

english: Jesus performed this, the first of His signs, at Cana in Galilee. He thus revealed His glory, and His disciples believed in Him. Jesus Cleanses the Temple (Matthew 21:12–17; Mark 11:15–19; Luke 19:45–48)
ekegusii: Oyio noro omochakano bw’ebikone Yeso akorete, agwo Kana ya Galili, akaorokia obonene bwaye; aborokigwa baye bakamwegena.
swahili: Huu, ndio uliokuwa muujiza wa kwanza Yesu aliofanya Kana ya Galilaya. Hivyo Yesu alidhihirisha utukufu wake, nao wanafunzi wake wakamwamini. Yesu Atakasa Hekalu (Mathayo 21:12-13; Marko 11:15-17; Luka 19:45-46)

english: After this, He went down to Capernaum with His mother and brothers and His disciples, and they stayed there a few days.
ekegusii: Magega ase aya akagenda goika Kapernaumu, ere, na ng’ina, na abamwabo, na aborokigwa baye; bakamenya aroro amatuko amake. Yeso ogochena Hekalu (Mat 21:12-13; Mar 11:15-18; Luk 19:45-46)
swahili: Baada ya hayo, Yesu pamoja na mama yake, ndugu zake na wanafunzi wake, walishuka mpaka Kapernaumu, wakakaa huko siku chache.

english: When the Jewish Passover was near, Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
ekegusii: Naende Epasaka y’Abayahudi nigo yarenge ang’e, na Yeso agatiira goika Yerusalemu.
swahili: Ilipokaribia wakati wa Pasaka ya Wayahudi, Yesu alipanda kwenda Yerusalemu.

english: In the temple courts He found men selling cattle, sheep, and doves, and money changers seated at their tables.
ekegusii: Akarora ase Hekalu ime abanto barenge koonia chiombe, ne ching’ondi, na amaruma, na abaare koonchora chifeta, baikaransete.
swahili: Huko Hekaluni aliwakuta watu wakiuza ngʼombe, kondoo na njiwa, nao wengine walikuwa wameketi mezani wakibadili fedha.

english: So He made a whip out of cords and drove all from the temple courts, both sheep and cattle. He poured out the coins of the money changers and overturned their tables.
ekegusii: Agakora omocharichi bwe chingori, akabasokia bonsi korwa ase Hekalu, ne ching’ondi, ne chiombe; agaitera chitaabu chiabo abaare koonchora chitaabu, akaonchorana chimesa chiabo.
swahili: Akatengeneza mjeledi kutokana na kamba, akawafukuza wote kutoka kwenye eneo la Hekalu, pamoja na kondoo na ngʼombe. Akazipindua meza za wale wabadili fedha na kuzimwaga fedha zao.

english: To those selling doves He said, “Get these out of here! How dare you turn My Father’s house into a marketplace!”
ekegusii: Naende akabateebia baria barenge koonia amaruma, “Rusia ebinto ebi aa timokora enyomba ya Tata one koba enyomba y’okoonchoreria.”
swahili: Akawaambia wale waliokuwa wakiuza njiwa, “Waondoeni hapa! Mnathubutuje kuifanya nyumba ya Baba yangu kuwa mahali pa biashara?”

english: His disciples remembered that it is written: “Zeal for Your house will consume Me.”
ekegusii: Aborokigwa baye bakainyora ng’a neriikire, “Risemi ri’enyomba yao riandire.”
swahili: Wanafunzi wake wakakumbuka kuwa imeandikwa: “Wivu wa nyumba yako utanila.”

english: On account of this, the Jews demanded, “What sign can You show us to prove Your authority to do these things?”
ekegusii: Nabo Abayahudi bakamobooria, “Ngekone ki ogotworokia, ng’a nore noboronge bw’ogokora aya?”
swahili: Ndipo Wayahudi wakamuuliza, “Unaweza kutuonyesha ishara gani ili kuthibitisha mamlaka uliyo nayo ya kufanya mambo haya?”

english: Jesus answered, “Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up again.”
ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, “Tagora Hekalu eye, na inche ase amatuko atato ninyetenenie.”
swahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Libomoeni hili Hekalu, nami nitalijenga tena kwa siku tatu!”

english: and Jesus and His disciples had also been invited to the wedding.
ekegusii: Yeso nere konya orangeriigwe amo naborokigwa baye ase enyangi.
swahili: Yesu pamoja na wanafunzi wake walikuwa wamealikwa arusini pia.

english: “This temple took forty-six years to build,” the Jews replied, “and You are going to raise it up in three days?”
ekegusii: Abayahudi bakaboora, “Hekalu eye yaagachetwe ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ene na etano nomo, na aye oyetenenie ase amatuko atato?”
swahili: Wale Wayahudi wakamjibu, “Hekalu hili lilijengwa kwa muda wa miaka arobaini na sita, nawe wasema utalijenga kwa siku tatu?”

english: But Jesus was speaking about the temple of His body.
ekegusii: Korende ere nigo akwanete igoro ye Hekalu y’omobere oye.
swahili: Lakini yeye Hekalu alilozungumzia ni mwili wake.

english: After He was raised from the dead, His disciples remembered that He had said this. Then they believed the Scripture and the word that Jesus had spoken.
ekegusii: Nabo ekero abogetigwe korwa ase abakuure aborokigwa baye bakainyora ng’a nigo ateebete ring’ana eri, bakegena ririiko riria, ne ring’ana riria Yeso ateebete. Yeso namanyete chinkoro chi’abanto bonsi
swahili: Baada ya kufufuliwa kutoka kwa wafu, wanafunzi wake wakakumbuka yale aliyokuwa amesema. Ndipo wakayaamini Maandiko na yale maneno Yesu aliyokuwa amesema.

english: While He was in Jerusalem at the Passover Feast, many people saw the signs He was doing and believed in His name.
ekegusii: Goika agachia kobao Yerusalemu ekero ki’Epasaka ase Rituko Rinene, abanto abange bakariegena erieta riaye, kobarorire ebikone arenge gokora.
swahili: Ikawa Yesu alipokuwa Yerusalemu kwenye Sikukuu ya Pasaka, watu wengi waliona ishara na miujiza aliyokuwa akifanya, wakaamini katika jina lake.

english: But Jesus did not entrust Himself to them, for He knew them all.
ekegusii: Korende Yeso tegenete ase bare, ekiagera nabamanyete bonsi,
swahili: Lakini Yesu hakujiaminisha kwao kwa sababu aliwajua wanadamu wote.

english: He did not need any testimony about man, for He knew what was in a man.
ekegusii: naende ekiagera tarigetie onde amobere kirori igoro ya Mwanyabaanto; naki ere omonyene amanyete ayare ime ya Mwanyabaanto.
swahili: Hakuhitaji ushuhuda wa mtu yeyote kuhusu mtu, kwa kuwa alijua yote yaliyokuwa moyoni mwa mtu.

english: When the wine ran out, Jesus’ mother said to Him, “They have no more wine.”
ekegusii: Goika edivai egachia kobaremera, ng’ina Yeso akamoteebia, “Tibari nedivai.”
swahili: Divai ilipokwisha, mama yake Yesu akamwambia, “Wameishiwa na divai.”

english: “Woman, why does this concern us?” Jesus replied. “My hour has not yet come.”
ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Omong’ina, inki inche nde naye? Ensa yane teraika.”
swahili: Yesu akamwambia, “Mwanamke, nina nini nawe? Saa yangu haijawadia.”

english: His mother said to the servants, “Do whatever He tells you.”
ekegusii: Ng’ina agateebia abasomba, “Rinde rionsi arabateebie, morikore.”
swahili: Mama yake akawaambia wale watumishi, “Lolote atakalowaambia, fanyeni.”

english: Now six stone water jars had been set there for the Jewish rites of purification. Each could hold from twenty to thirty gallons.
ekegusii: Nchiarenge aroro chinsiongo isano nemo chi’amagena, chiabekire aroro ase engencho y’ogwesiberia kw’Abayahudi; kera eyemo nigo yarenge ekerengo gie chigalani emerongo ebere gose etato.
swahili: Basi ilikuwepo mitungi sita ya kuhifadhia maji iliyotengenezwa kwa mawe kwa ajili ya kujitakasa kwa desturi ya Kiyahudi; kila mtungi ungeweza kuchukua vipipa viwili au vitatu.

english: Jesus told the servants, “Fill the jars with water.” So they filled them to the brim.
ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Ichoria chinsiongo echi amaache.” Bagachiichoria goika igoro.
swahili: Yesu akawaambia wale watumishi, “Ijazeni hiyo mitungi maji.” Nao wakaijaza ile mitungi mpaka juu.

english: “Now draw some out,” He said, “and take it to the master of the banquet.” They did so,
ekegusii: Akabateebia, Bono taoria, “moirere omonene bw’omoyega.” Bakamoirera.
swahili: Kisha akawaambia, “Sasa choteni hayo maji kidogo, mpelekeeni mkuu wa meza.” Hivyo wakachota, wakampelekea.

english: and the master of the banquet tasted the water that had been turned into wine. He did not know where it was from, but the servants who had drawn the water knew. Then he called the bridegroom aside
ekegusii: Omonene bw’omoyega agachia koigwa amaache aria aonchoretwe koba edivai, tamanya aase yarwa, (korende abasomba ababuuchete amaache mbamanyete). Omonene oria bw’omoyega akarangeria omonywomi,
swahili: Yule mkuu wa meza akayaonja yale maji ambayo yalikuwa yamebadilika kuwa divai. Hakujua divai hiyo ilikotoka ingawa wale watumishi waliochota yale maji wao walifahamu. Basi akamwita bwana arusi kando

english: Now there was a man of the Pharisees named Nicodemus, a leader of the Jews.
ekegusii: Narengeo omonto oyomo bw’Abafarisai, erieta riaye Nikodemo, omonene bw’Abayahudi.
swahili: Basi palikuwa na mtu mmoja Farisayo, jina lake Nikodemo, mmoja wa Baraza la Wayahudi lililotawala.

english: “You are Israel’s teacher,” said Jesus, “and you do not understand these things?
ekegusii: Yeso akamoiraneria, akamoteebia, “Inee! Aye nomworokia bw’Abaisraeli, na aya toyamanyeti?
swahili: Yesu akamwambia, “Wewe ni mwalimu mashuhuri wa Waisraeli, nawe huelewi mambo haya?

english: Truly, truly, I tell you, we speak of what we know, and we testify to what we have seen, and yet you people do not accept our testimony.
ekegusii: Ekeene, nagotebirie: Eri tomanyete nario togokwana, na eri torooche twariorokia; na oborori bwaito timori kobwancha.
swahili: Amin, amin ninakuambia, sisi tunazungumza lile tunalolijua na tunashuhudia lile tuliloliona. Lakini ninyi watu hamkubali ushuhuda wetu.

english: If I have told you about earthly things and you do not believe, how will you believe if I tell you about heavenly things?
ekegusii: Onye nkobateebia amang’ana ense, na inwe timokoyeegena, naki moreegene kondabateebie amang’ana a igoro?
swahili: Nimewaambia mambo ya duniani, nanyi hamkuniamini, mtaniaminije basi nitakapowaambia mambo ya mbinguni?

english: No one has ascended into heaven except the One who descended from heaven—the Son of Man.
ekegusii: Naende monto onde tari ogendete igoro, otatiga ere oyoigete korwa igoro, Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto.
swahili: Hakuna mtu yeyote aliyekwenda mbinguni isipokuwa yeye aliyeshuka kutoka mbinguni, yaani, Mwana wa Adamu.

english: Just as Moses lifted up the snake in the wilderness, so the Son of Man must be lifted up,
ekegusii: Naende buna Musa aimokereretie eng’iti ase erooro, naboigo na Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto goika aimokererigwe igoro;
swahili: Kama vile Mose alivyomwinua yule nyoka kule jangwani, vivyo hivyo Mwana wa Adamu hana budi kuinuliwa juu.

english: that everyone who believes in Him may have eternal life.
ekegusii: erinde monto onde bwensi oyomwegenire tasira, korende abe nobogima bwa kare na kare.”
swahili: Ili kila mtu amwaminiye awe na uzima wa milele.

english: For God so loved the world that He gave His one and only Son, that everyone who believes in Him shall not perish but have eternal life.
ekegusii: “Naki Nyasae ayianchete ense, goika akarua Omwana oye omomoima, erinde monto onde bwensi oyomwegenire tasira, korende abe nobogima bwa kare na kare.
swahili: “Kwa maana jinsi hii Mungu aliupenda ulimwengu hata akamtoa Mwanawe wa pekee, ili kila mtu amwaminiye asipotee, bali awe na uzima wa milele.

english: For God did not send His Son into the world to condemn the world, but to save the world through Him.
ekegusii: Naki Nyasae tatomete Omwana oye ase ense agambie ense, korende ense etoorigwe nere.
swahili: Kwa maana Mungu hakumtuma Mwanawe kuuhukumu ulimwengu, bali kupitia kwake ulimwengu upate kuokolewa.

english: Whoever believes in Him is not condemned, but whoever does not believe has already been condemned, because he has not believed in the name of God’s one and only Son.
ekegusii: Oyomwegenire takogambigwa oyotegeneti oikire kogambigwa, ekiagera atariegeneti erieta ri’Omwana omomoima o Nyasae.
swahili: Yeyote amwaminiye hahukumiwi, lakini asiyeamini amekwisha kuhukumiwa, kwa sababu hakuliamini jina la Mwana pekee wa Mungu.

english: And this is the verdict: The Light has come into the world, but men loved the darkness rather than the Light because their deeds were evil.
ekegusii: Na eke nakio ekiina ng’a omobaso ochire ase ense, korende abanto bagancha omosunte kobua omobaso, ekiagera ogokora kwabo kwarenge okobe.
swahili: Hii ndiyo hukumu kwamba: Nuru imekuja ulimwenguni, nao watu wakapenda giza kuliko nuru kwa sababu matendo yao ni maovu.

english: He came to Jesus at night and said, “Rabbi, we know that You are a teacher who has come from God. For no one could perform the signs You are doing if God were not with him.”
ekegusii: Oyo nigo achete ase Yeso botuko, akamoteebia, “Rabii twamanyire ng’a nomworokia ore, kwarure ase Nyasae, ekiagera omonto onde tari oranyare gokora ebikone ebi ogokora aye, otatiga Nyasae abe amo nere.”
swahili: Huyu alimjia Yesu usiku akamwambia, “Rabi, tunajua kuwa wewe ni mwalimu uliyetumwa na Mungu, kwa maana hakuna mtu awezaye kufanya miujiza hii uifanyayo wewe, kama Mungu hayuko pamoja naye.”

english: Everyone who does evil hates the Light, and does not come into the Light for fear that his deeds will be exposed.
ekegusii: Naki kera oyogokora amabe nigo agechete omobaso, gose tagocha ase omobaso, ogokora kwaye tikobaisa koorokigwa.
swahili: Kwa kuwa kila atendaye maovu huchukia nuru, wala haji kwenye nuru ili matendo yake maovu yasifichuliwe.

english: But whoever practices the truth comes into the Light, so that it may be seen clearly that what he has done has been accomplished in God.” John’s Testimony about Jesus
ekegusii: Korende oyogokora ekeene nigo agocha ase omobaso, ogokora kwaye kororekane ng’a nigo gwakorirwe ase Nyasae.” Yohana Omobatisi na Yeso
swahili: Lakini yule aishiye kwa ukweli huja kwenye nuru, ili ionekane wazi kwamba matendo yake yametendeka katika Mungu.” Ushuhuda Wa Yohana Mbatizaji Kuhusu Yesu

english: After this, Jesus and His disciples went into the Judean countryside, where He spent some time with them and baptized.
ekegusii: Magega ase aya Yeso na aborokigwa baye bakagenda goika ense ya Boyahudi. Akabeera aroro amo nabarabwo, akabatisa.
swahili: Baada ya haya, Yesu na wanafunzi wake walikwenda katika nchi ya Uyahudi, nao wakakaa huko kwa muda na kubatiza.

english: Now John was also baptizing at Aenon near Salim, because the water was plentiful there, and people kept coming to be baptized.
ekegusii: Yohana nere nigo arenge kobatisera aria Ainoni, ang’e na Salimu, ekiagera amaache amange narengeo. Abanto bakamochiera bakabatiswa.
swahili: Yohana naye alikuwa akibatiza huko Ainoni karibu na Salimu kwa sababu huko kulikuwa na maji tele. Watu wazima wakamjia huko ili kubatizwa.

english: (For John had not yet been thrown into prison.)
ekegusii: Naki Yohana konya tarabekwa echela.
swahili: (Hii ilikuwa kabla Yohana hajatiwa gerezani).

english: Then a dispute arose between John’s disciples and a certain Jew over the issue of ceremonial washing.
ekegusii: Nabo okoamererania gokaoroka ase egati yaborokigwa ba Yohana na Omoyahudi oyomo ase amang’ana ogwesibia.
swahili: Mashindano yakazuka kati ya baadhi ya wanafunzi wa Yohana na Myahudi mmoja kuhusu suala la desturi ya kunawa kwa utakaso.

english: So John’s disciples came to him and said, “Look, Rabbi, the One who was with you beyond the Jordan, the One you testified about—He is baptizing, and everyone is going to Him.”
ekegusii: Bagachiera Yohana, bakamoteebia, “Omworokia, ere oyorenge amo naye ng’umbu ya Yorodani, oyio kwaorogetie aye, oyio nao are akobatisa, na abanto bonsi nkomochiera bare.”
swahili: Wakamwendea Yohana wakamwambia, “Rabi, yule mtu aliyekuwa pamoja nawe ngʼambo ya Mto Yordani, yule uliyeshuhudia habari zake, sasa anabatiza na kila mtu anamwendea!”

english: John replied, “A man can receive only what is given him from heaven.
ekegusii: Yohana akairaneria, “Omonto takonyara konyora ring’ana rinde rionsi otatiga aegwe korwa igoro.
swahili: Yohana akawajibu, “Hakuna mtu yeyote awezaye kupata kitu chochote isipokuwa kile tu alichopewa kutoka mbinguni.

english: You yourselves can testify that I said, ‘I am not the Christ, but am sent ahead of Him.’
ekegusii: Inwe abanyene mwambereire kirori ng’a nateebete: Inche tari Kristo, korende natomirwe imotang’anere.
swahili: Ninyi wenyewe ni mashahidi wangu kwamba nilisema, ‘Mimi si Kristo, ila nimetumwa nimtangulie.’

english: The bride belongs to the bridegroom. The friend of the bridegroom stands and listens for him, and is overjoyed to hear the bridegroom’s voice. That joy is mine, and it is now complete.
ekegusii: Oyore nomoriakari nere omonywomi, korende omong’wansi oye nigo agotenena na komoigwa, ogookera eriogi ri’omonywomi; naboigo omogooko one oikeranire bono.”
swahili: Bibi arusi ni wa bwana arusi. Lakini rafiki yake bwana arusi anayesimama karibu naye na kusikiliza kutoka kwake, hufurahi sana aisikiapo sauti ya bwana arusi. Kwa sababu hii furaha yangu imekamilika.

english: Jesus replied, “Truly, truly, I tell you, no one can see the kingdom of God unless he is born again. ”
ekegusii: Yeso akamoiraneria, “Ekeene, ekeene, nagotebirie: Omonto ataiboiri eria kabere, takonyara korora oborwoti bwa Nyasae.”
swahili: Yesu akamjibu, “Amin, amin nakuambia, hakuna mtu anayeweza kuuona Ufalme wa Mungu kama hajazaliwa mara ya pili.”

english: He must increase; I must decrease.
ekegusii: Ere goika amenteke, korende inche nkee. Oyochire korwa igoro
swahili: Yeye hana budi kuwa mkuu zaidi na mimi nizidi kuwa mdogo.” Yeye Aliyetoka Mbinguni

english: The One who comes from above is above all. The one who is from the earth belongs to the earth and speaks as one from the earth. The One who comes from heaven is above all.
ekegusii: “Oyochire korwa igoro, oyio nigo are igoro ase onsi; oyore bw’ense noyo bw’ense, nigo agokwana amang’ana ’ense; ere oyochire korwa igoro nigo are igoro ase onsi.
swahili: “Yeye ajaye kutoka juu yu juu ya yote, yeye aliye wa duniani ni wa dunia, naye huzungumza mambo ya duniani. Yeye aliyekuja kutoka mbinguni, yu juu ya yote.

english: He testifies to what He has seen and heard, yet no one accepts His testimony.
ekegusii: Nigo akoba kirori ase aya arorire na koyaigwa; gose onde tari oyobwanchire oborori bwaye.
swahili: Yeye hushuhudia yale aliyoyaona na kuyasikia, lakini hakuna yeyote anayekubali ushuhuda wake.

english: Whoever accepts His testimony has certified that God is truthful.
ekegusii: Oyobwanchire oborori bwaye oorokirie Nyasae maiso marore, ng’a noyo bw’ekeene.
swahili: Lakini yeyote anayekubali huo ushuhuda anathibitisha kwamba, Mungu ni kweli.

english: For the One whom God has sent speaks the words of God, for God gives the Spirit without limit.
ekegusii: Naki ere oyotometwe na Nyasae nigo agokwana amang’ana a Nyasae; naki Nyasae tari komoa Omoika ase ekerengo.
swahili: Yeye aliyetumwa na Mungu husema maneno ya Mungu, kwa kuwa Mungu humtoa Roho pasipo kipimo.

english: The Father loves the Son and has placed all things in His hands.
ekegusii: Tata omwanchire Omwana, omoeire bionsi ase amaboko aye.
swahili: Baba anampenda Mwana, naye ametia vitu vyote mikononi mwake.

english: Whoever believes in the Son has eternal life. Whoever rejects the Son will not see life. Instead, the wrath of God remains on him.”
ekegusii: Oyoramwegene Omwana nare nobogima bwa kare na kare; oyotaigwereti Omwana takorora obogima, korende endamwamu ya Nyasae nigo emoikaranserete.”
swahili: Yeyote anayemwamini Mwana ana uzima wa milele, lakini yeye asiyemwamini Mwana hatauona uzima, bali ghadhabu ya Mungu itakuwa juu yake.”

english: “How can a man be born when he is old?” Nicodemus asked. “Can he enter his mother’s womb a second time to be born?”
ekegusii: Nikodemo akamobooria, “Naki omonto aranyare koiborwa kabeire omogaka? Nanyaare gosoa enda ya ng’ina eria kabere aiborwe?”
swahili: Nikodemo akauliza, “Awezaje mtu kuzaliwa wakati akiwa mzee? Hakika hawezi kuingia mara ya pili kwenye tumbo la mama yake ili azaliwe!”

english: Jesus answered, “Truly, truly, I tell you, no one can enter the kingdom of God unless he is born of water and the Spirit.
ekegusii: Yeso akamoiraneria, “Ekeene, ekeene, nagotebirie: Omonto ataiboiri ase amaache na Omoika, takonyaara gosoa ase oborwoti bwa Nyasae.
swahili: Yesu akamwambia, “Amin, amin nakuambia, hakuna mtu yeyote anayeweza kuingia Ufalme wa Mungu kama hajazaliwa kwa maji na kwa Roho.

english: Flesh is born of flesh, but spirit is born of the Spirit.
ekegusii: Ekeiboire ase omobere n’omobere; na ekeiboire ase Omoika n’Omoika.
swahili: Mwili huzaa mwili, lakini Roho huzaa roho.

english: Do not be amazed that I said, ‘You must be born again.’
ekegusii: Tokumia ekiagera nagoteebia: Goika oiborwe naende.
swahili: Kwa hiyo usishangae ninapokuambia huna budi ‘kuzaliwa mara ya pili.’

english: The wind blows where it wishes. You hear its sound, but you do not know where it comes from or where it is going. So it is with everyone born of the Spirit.”
ekegusii: Embeo nigo ekogusa aase erigetie, na egeturi kiaye nigo ogokeigwa, korende tomanyeti aase ekorwa gose aase ekogenda; naboigo na kera omonto oiboirwe ase Omoika.”
swahili: Upepo huvuma popote upendapo. Mvumo wake unausikia lakini huwezi ukafahamu utokako wala uendako. Ndivyo ilivyo kwa kila mtu aliyezaliwa na Roho.”

english: “How can this be?” Nicodemus asked.
ekegusii: Nikodemo akamobooria, “Naki aranyare koba aya?”
swahili: Nikodemo akamuuliza, “Mambo haya yanawezekanaje?”

english: When Jesus realized that the Pharisees were aware He was gaining and baptizing more disciples than John
ekegusii: Nabo Omonene agachia komanya ng’a Abafarisai baigure ng’a Yeso okorire aborokigwa abange kobua Yohana, na kobatisa,
swahili: Mafarisayo wakasikia kwamba Yesu alikuwa anapata na kubatiza wanafunzi wengi zaidi kuliko Yohana,

english: Jesus answered, “If you knew the gift of God and who is asking you for a drink, you would have asked Him, and He would have given you living water.”
ekegusii: Yeso akamoiraneria, “Onye nkwamanya ekeegwa kia Nyasae, naende nere ng’o oyo okogosaba amaache anywe, anga nkwamosaba ere, na ere anga nakoa amaache are moyo.”
swahili: Yesu akajibu akamwambia, “Kama ungelijua karama ya Mungu, naye ni nani anayekuambia, Nipe maji ninywe, wewe ungelimwomba yeye, naye angelikupa maji yaliyo hai.”

english: “Sir,” the woman replied, “You have nothing to draw with and the well is deep. Where then will You get this living water?
ekegusii: Omokungu oria akamoteebia, “Omonene, tori negento gi’okobuuchera, na ensoko yachiire inse mono; ng’ai kwanyorire amaache aya are moyo?
swahili: Yule mwanamke akamjibu, “Bwana, wewe huna chombo cha kutekea maji na kisima hiki ni kirefu. Hayo maji ya uzima utayapata wapi?

english: Are You greater than our father Jacob, who gave us this well and drank from it himself, as did his sons and his livestock?”
ekegusii: Inee! Aye nomonene ore kobua sokoro yaito Yakobo, oyotoete ensoko eye, nere omonyene akanywa amaache aya, na abana baye bonsi, na etugo yaye?”
swahili: Kwani wewe ni mkuu kuliko baba yetu Yakobo ambaye alitupatia kisima hiki, ambacho yeye pamoja na watoto wake na mifugo yake walikitumia?”

english: Jesus said to her, “Everyone who drinks this water will be thirsty again.
ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Kera oyokonywa amaache aya naigwe erang’o naende;
swahili: Yesu akamjibu, “Kila mtu anayekunywa maji ya kisima hiki ataona kiu tena.

english: But whoever drinks the water I give him will never thirst. Indeed, the water I give him will become in him a fount of water springing up to eternal life.”
ekegusii: korende onde bwensi oyoranywe amaache aria ndamoe inche, takorang’a nonya ng’ake; korende amaache aria ndanyaare komoa, nabe ime yaye ensoko y’amaache agosoka na komoa obogima bwa kare na kare.”
swahili: Lakini yeyote anywaye maji nitakayompa hataona kiu kamwe. Maji nitakayompa yatakuwa ndani yake chemchemi ya maji, yakibubujika uzima wa milele.”

english: The woman said to Him, “Sir, give me this water so that I will not get thirsty and have to keep coming here to draw water.”
ekegusii: Omokungu oria akamoteebia, “Omonene, ing’a amaache ayio tindang’a, gose timbaisa gocha aiga kobuucha.”
swahili: Yule mwanamke akamwambia, “Bwana, tafadhali nipe maji hayo ili nisipate kiu tena na wala nisije tena hapa kuteka maji!”

english: Jesus told her, “Go, call your husband and come back.”
ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Genda, orangerie omosacha oo, oche nere aiga.”
swahili: Yesu akamjibu, “Nenda ukamwite mumeo, uje naye hapa.”

english: “I have no husband,” the woman replied. Jesus said to her, “You are correct to say that you have no husband.
ekegusii: Omokungu oria akamoiraneria, “Tindi nomosaacha.” Yeso akamoteebia, “Gwakwanire boronge ng’a tori nomosaacha,
swahili: Yule mwanamke akajibu, “Sina mume.” Yesu akamwambia, “Umesema kweli kuwa huna mume.

english: In fact, you have had five husbands, and the man you now have is not your husband. You have spoken truthfully.”
ekegusii: ekiagera kwabeire nabasaacha batano, na ere oyore nere bono tari omosacha oo, ase ayio gwakwanire ekeene.”
swahili: Kwa maana umeshakuwa na wanaume watano na mwanaume unayeishi naye sasa si mume wako! Umesema ukweli.”

english: “Sir,” the woman said, “I see that You are a prophet.
ekegusii: Omokungu oria akamoteebia, “Omonene, narorire ng’a nomobani ore.
swahili: Yule mwanamke akasema, “Bwana, naona bila shaka wewe ni nabii.

english: (although it was not Jesus who baptized, but His disciples),
ekegusii: (nonya Yeso omonyene tare kobatisa, otatiga aborokigwa baye),
swahili: ingawa kwa kweli si Yesu mwenyewe aliyekuwa akibatiza, ila ni wanafunzi wake.

english: Our fathers worshiped on this mountain, but you Jews say that the place where one must worship is in Jerusalem.”
ekegusii: Chisokoro chiaito nigo chiarenge gosasiima ase egetunwa eke, na inwe nigo mogoteeba ng’a Yerusalemu nao aase atogwenerete togosasiimera.”
swahili: Baba zetu waliabudu kwenye mlima huu, lakini ninyi Wayahudi mnasema ni lazima tukaabudu huko Yerusalemu.”

english: “Believe Me, woman,” Jesus replied, “a time is coming when you will worship the Father neither on this mountain nor in Jerusalem.
ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Aye omokungu, inyegene, ensa neche, motamosasiime Tata ase egetunwa eke, nonya nase Yerusalemu.
swahili: Yesu akamjibu, “Mwanamke, niamini, wakati unakuja ambapo hamtamwabudu Baba katika mlima huu, wala huko Yerusalemu.

english: You worship what you do not know; we worship what we do know, for salvation is from the Jews.
ekegusii: Inwe nigo mogosasiima eki motamanyeti; intwe nigo togosasiima eki tomanyete, ekiagera ogotooreka nigo gokorwa ase Abayahudi.
