swahili: Ninyi Wasamaria mnaabudu msichokijua. Sisi Wayahudi tunamwabudu Mungu tunayemjua kwa sababu wokovu unatoka kwa Wayahudi.

english: But a time is coming and has now come when the true worshipers will worship the Father in spirit and in truth, for the Father is seeking such as these to worship Him.
ekegusii: Korende ensa neche, na bono nere, ekero abasasiimi b’ekeene barasasiime Tata ase omoika na ekeene, ekiagera Tata nigo akorigia abanto buna abwo bamosasime.
swahili: Lakini saa yaja, tena ipo, ambapo wale waabuduo halisi, watamwabudu Baba katika roho na kweli. Watu wanaoabudu namna hii, ndio Baba anawatafuta.

english: God is Spirit, and His worshipers must worship Him in spirit and in truth.”
ekegusii: Nyasae n’Omoika, na abwo bakomosasiima nebagwenerete komosasiima ase omoika na ekeene.”
swahili: Mungu ni Roho na wote wanaomwabudu imewapasa kumwabudu katika roho na kweli.”

english: The woman said, “I know that Messiah” (called Christ) “is coming. When He comes, He will explain everything to us.”
ekegusii: Omokungu oria akamoteebia, “Namanyire ng’a ngocha are Masihi (oyokorokwa Kristo); karache ere, natoorokerie onsi.”
swahili: Yule mwanamke akamwambia, “Ninafahamu kwamba Masiya (aitwaye Kristo) anakuja. Yeye akija, atatueleza mambo yote.”

english: Jesus answered, “I who speak to you am He.” The Disciples Return and Marvel
ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Inche, oyo ngokwana naye, nere.”
swahili: Yesu akamwambia, “Mimi ninayezungumza nawe, ndiye.”

english: Just then His disciples returned and were surprised that He was speaking with a woman. But no one asked Him, “What do You want from her?” or “Why are You talking with her?”
ekegusii: Erio kegima aborokigwa baye bagaacha. Bagakumia ekiagera arenge gokwana nomokuungu; korende onde tamoboretie, “Inki okorigia?” Gose, “Naki ogokwana nere?”
swahili: Wakati huo wanafunzi wake wakarudi, wakashangaa sana kumwona akizungumza na mwanamke. Lakini hakuna aliyemuuliza, “Unataka nini kwake?” Au “Kwa nini unazungumza naye?”

english: Then the woman left her water jar, went back into the town, and said to the people,
ekegusii: Nabo omokungu oria agatiga enyongo yaye, akagenda omochie, agateebia abanto,
swahili: Yule mwanamke akaacha mtungi wake, akarudi mjini akawaambia watu,

english: “Come, see a man who told me everything I ever did. Could this be the Christ?”
ekegusii: “Inchuo, morore omonto ontebirie amang’ana onsi aya nakorire! Inee! Oyio tari ere Kristo?”
swahili: “Njooni mkamwone mtu aliyeniambia kila kitu nilichotenda! Je, yawezekana huyu ndiye Kristo?”

english: He left Judea and returned to Galilee.
ekegusii: akarua Boyahudi, akagenda Galili naende.
swahili: Bwana alipojua mambo haya, aliondoka Uyahudi akarudi tena Galilaya.

english: So they left the town and made their way toward Jesus.
ekegusii: Bakaimoka korwa omochie, bakamochiera.
swahili: Basi wakamiminika watu kutoka mjini wakamwendea Yesu.

english: Meanwhile the disciples urged Him, “Rabbi, eat something.”
ekegusii: Agwo ekero bataracha, aborokigwa bakamosorora bakaboora, “Rabii, ragera?”
swahili: Wakati huo wanafunzi wake walikuwa wakimsihi, “Rabi, kula angalau chochote.”

english: But He told them, “I have food to eat that you know nothing about.”
ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Inche ninde nendagera nkoria, eye motamanyeti inwe.”
swahili: Lakini yeye akawajibu, “Mimi ninacho chakula ambacho ninyi hamkifahamu.”

english: So the disciples asked one another, “Could someone have brought Him food?”
ekegusii: Aborokigwa baye bakaboorania, “Inee! Nomonto omorentera endagera?”
swahili: Basi wanafunzi wakaanza kuulizana, “Kuna mtu ambaye amemletea chakula?”

english: Jesus explained, “My food is to do the will of Him who sent Me and to finish His work.
ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Endagera yaane neye: ogokora ogwancha kwaye oyontomete na goikerania emeremo yaye.
swahili: Lakini Yesu akawajibu, “Chakula changu ni kufanya mapenzi ya Mungu ambaye amenituma na kuikamilisha kazi yake.

english: Do you not say, ‘There are still four months until the harvest’? I tell you, lift up your eyes and look at the fields, for they are ripe for harvest.
ekegusii: Inwe timori goteeba: Yatigaire emetienyi ene, erio rigesa riiche? Rora nabateebirie: Imokia amaiso aino, morigererie emegondo, ng’a yaikire koba emerabu ang’e ase rigesa.
swahili: Je, ninyi hamsemi, ‘Bado miezi minne tuvune?’ Inueni macho yenu myaangalie mashamba jinsi mazao yalivyo tayari kuvunwa!

english: Already the reaper draws his wages and gathers a crop for eternal life, so that the sower and the reaper may rejoice together.
ekegusii: Oyo okogesa nkonyora are eng’eria na gosangereria amatunda ase obogima bwa kare na kare, erinde oyo okobusura na ere oyokogesa bagoke amo.
swahili: Mvunaji tayari anapokea mshahara wake, naye anakusanya mazao kwa ajili ya uzima wa milele. Ili yeye apandaye na yeye avunaye wafurahi pamoja.

english: For in this case the saying ‘One sows and another reaps’ is true.
ekegusii: Naki ring’ana riria: Oyomo obusura, na oyonde okogesa, nigo rire ekeene.
swahili: Hivyo kule kusema, ‘Mmoja hupanda na mwingine huvuna,’ ni kweli kabisa.

english: I sent you to reap what you have not worked for; others have done the hard work, and now you have taken up their labor.” Many Samaritans Believe
ekegusii: Inche nabatomete mogese aya motakorerete emeremo; abande bakorire emeremo, na inwe mwasoire ase emeremo yabo.”
swahili: Niliwatuma mkavune mazao ambayo hamkupanda, wengine walifanya kazi ngumu, nanyi mmevuna faida ya taabu yao.” Wasamaria Wengi Waamini

english: Many of the Samaritans from that town believed in Jesus because of the woman’s testimony, “He told me everything I ever did.”
ekegusii: Naende ase omochie oria Abasamaria abange bakamwegena ase engencho y’oborori bw’omokuungu oria ekero abateebetie ng’a, “Onteebirie amang’ana onsi aya nakorire.”
swahili: Wasamaria wengi katika mji ule wakamwamini Yesu kwa sababu ya ushuhuda wa yule mwanamke alipowaambia kwamba, “Ameniambia kila kitu nilichotenda.”

english: Now He had to pass through Samaria.
ekegusii: Naende yamogwenerete goika aete Samaria.
swahili: Wakati huo ilimlazimu apitie Samaria.

english: So when the Samaritans came to Him, they asked Him to stay with them, and He stayed two days.
ekegusii: Nabo ekero Abasamaria baria bachia komochiera, bakamosorora aikaranse amo nabarabwo; akabeera aroro amatuko abere.
swahili: Hivyo wale Wasamaria walipomjia, wakamsihi akae kwao. Naye akakaa huko siku mbili.

english: And many more believed because of His message.
ekegusii: Abanto abange kobua bakeegena ase engencho ye ring’ana riaye;
swahili: Kwa sababu ya neno lake, watu wengi wakaamini.

english: They said to the woman, “We now believe not only because of your words; we have heard for ourselves, and we know that this man truly is the Savior of the world.” Jesus Heals the Official’s Son (Matthew 8:5–13; Luke 7:1–10)
ekegusii: bagateebia omokungu oria, “Bono twegenire, tari ase engencho y’amang’ana ao, korende ekiagera tweigwereire intwe abanyene, naende twamanyire ekeene ng’a oyo n’Omotooria bw’ense.” Yeso okogwenia omwana omomura bw’omosomba bw’omorwoti
swahili: Wakamwambia yule mwanamke, “Sasa tunaamini, wala si kwa sababu ya maneno yako tu, bali kwa kuwa tumemsikia sisi wenyewe. Tumejua hakika kweli ya kwamba huyu ndiye Kristo, Mwokozi wa ulimwengu.” Yesu Amponya Mwana Wa Afisa

english: After two days, Jesus left for Galilee.
ekegusii: Magega y’amatuko abere akaimoka akagenda Galili.
swahili: Baada ya zile siku mbili, Yesu aliondoka kwenda Galilaya.

english: Now He Himself had testified that a prophet has no honor in his own hometown.
ekegusii: Naki Yeso omonyene aorogetie ng’a omobani tari gosikwa ase ense yaye omonyene.
swahili: (Basi Yesu mwenyewe alikuwa amesema kwamba nabii hapati heshima katika nchi yake mwenyewe.)

english: Yet when He arrived, the Galileans welcomed Him. They had seen all the great things He had done in Jerusalem at the feast, for they had gone there as well.
ekegusii: Nabo ekero achia goika Galili, Abagalili bakamoroisia, ekiagera baroche amang’ana onsi ayakorete Yerusalemu ekero kie rituko rinene; naki nabarabwo boigo mbagendete ase rituko rinene.
swahili: Alipofika Galilaya, Wagalilaya walimkaribisha, kwani walikuwa wameona yale aliyoyatenda huko Yerusalemu wakati wa Sikukuu ya Pasaka. Kwa maana wao pia walikuwa wamehudhuria hiyo Sikukuu.

english: So once again He came to Cana in Galilee, where He had turned the water into wine. And there was a royal official whose son lay sick at Capernaum.
ekegusii: Agaika naende Kana ya Galili, agwo ase aonchorete amaache koba edivai. Narengeo omonto omosike ase Kapernaumu, oyorenge n’omwana omorwaire.
swahili: Hivyo Yesu akaja tena mpaka Kana ya Galilaya, kule alikokuwa amebadili maji kuwa divai. Huko kulikuwepo na afisa mmoja wa mfalme, ambaye mwanawe alikuwa mgonjwa huko Kapernaumu.

english: When he heard that Jesus had come from Judea to Galilee, he went and begged Him to come down and heal his son, who was about to die.
ekegusii: Oyio agachia koigwa ng’a Yeso ochire korwa Boyahudi goika Galili, akamochiera, akamosorora achiche agwenie omwana oye, ekiagera konya oisire gokwa.
swahili: Huyo mtu aliposikia kwamba Yesu alikuwa amewasili Galilaya kutoka Uyahudi, alimwendea na kumwomba ili aje kumponya mwanawe, aliyekuwa mgonjwa karibu ya kufa.

english: Jesus said to him, “Unless you people see signs and wonders, you will never believe.”
ekegusii: Nabo Yeso akamoteebia, “Motarochi ebikone na amakumia, timori kwegena nonya ng’ake.”
swahili: Yesu akamwambia, “Ninyi watu msipoona ishara na miujiza kamwe hamtaamini.”

english: “Sir,” the official said, “come down before my child dies.”
ekegusii: Omosike oria akamoteebia, “Omonene, tirimboka ritang’ani omwana one atarakwa.”
swahili: Yule afisa wa mfalme akamwambia, “Bwana, tafadhali shuka kabla mwanangu hajafa.”

english: So He came to a town of Samaria called Sychar, near the plot of ground that Jacob had given to his son Joseph.
ekegusii: Igo agaika omochie o Samaria, okorokwa Sikari, ang’e nomogondo oria Yakobo aete Yusufu omwana oye;
swahili: Akafika kwenye mji mmoja wa Samaria uitwao Sikari, karibu na lile shamba ambalo Yakobo alimpa mwanawe Yosefu.

english: “Go,” said Jesus. “Your son will live.” The man took Jesus at His word and departed.
ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Genda, omwana oo nabe moyo.” Omonto oria akegena ring’ana riria ateebetigwe na Yeso, akabwatia enchera yaye.
swahili: Yesu akamjibu, “Enenda zako, mwanao yu hai.” Yule afisa akaamini yale maneno Yesu aliyomwambia, akaondoka akaenda zake.

english: And while he was still on the way, his servants met him with the news that his boy was alive.
ekegusii: Ekero arenge gotirimboka abasomba baaye bagaacha komorootota, bakamoteebia, “Omwana oo moyo are.”
swahili: Alipokuwa bado yuko njiani, akakutana na watumishi wake wakamwambia kwamba mwanawe yu mzima.

english: So he inquired as to the hour when his son had recovered, and they told him, “The fever left him yesterday at the seventh hour. ”
ekegusii: Erio akababoria amang’ana ensa achaagete koba buya. Bakamoteebia, “Niigoro, chinsa isano na ibere esosera yamotigete.”
swahili: Akawauliza saa ambayo alianza kupata nafuu. Wakamwambia, “Jana yapata saa saba, homa ilimwacha.”

english: Then the father realized that this was the very hour in which Jesus had told him, “Your son will live.” And he and all his household believed.
ekegusii: Erio ise akamanya ng’a nensa eria eria ateebetigwe na Yeso, “Omwana oo nabe moyo!” Akeegena ere, na enyomba yaye yonsi.
swahili: Ndipo baba wa huyo mtoto akakumbuka kuwa huo ndio wakati ambapo Yesu alikuwa amemwambia, “Mwanao yu hai.” Kwa hiyo yeye pamoja na wote wa nyumbani mwake wakamwamini Yesu.

english: This was now the second sign that Jesus performed after coming from Judea into Galilee.
ekegusii: Eke nakio egekone gia kabere Yeso akorete korwa ekero arwete Boyahudi kogenda Galili.
swahili: Hii ilikuwa ishara ya pili ambayo Yesu alifanya aliporudi Galilaya kutoka Uyahudi.

english: Since Jacob’s well was there, Jesus, weary from His journey, sat down by the well. It was about the sixth hour.
ekegusii: agwo yarengeo ensoko ya Yakobo. Nabo Yeso, konya orosire ase orogendo rwaye, agaikaransa iga ase ensoko. Konya chiabeire ang’e chinsa isano nemo.
swahili: Huko ndiko kulikokuwa na kile kisima cha Yakobo. Naye Yesu alikuwa amechoka kwa kuwa alikuwa ametoka safarini. Akaketi karibu na hicho kisima. Ilikuwa yapata saa sita mchana.

english: When a Samaritan woman came to draw water, Jesus said to her, “Give Me a drink.”
ekegusii: Omokungu o Samaria agacha kobuucha amaache. Yeso akamoteebia, “Ing’a amaache inywe.”
swahili: Mwanamke mmoja Msamaria akaja kuteka maji, Yesu akamwambia, “Naomba maji ninywe.”

english: (His disciples had gone into the town to buy food.)
ekegusii: Naki aborokigwa baye konya bachiire omochie kogora endagera.
swahili: (Wakati huo wanafunzi wake walikuwa wamekwenda mjini kununua chakula.)

english: “You are a Jew,” said the woman. “How can You ask for a drink from me, a Samaritan woman?” (For Jews do not associate with Samaritans.)
ekegusii: Nabo omokungu oria bw’Abasamaria akamobooria, “Naki yaba aye Omoyahudi ogonsaba amaache, na inche nomokuungu bw’Abasamaria?” (Abayahudi tibari gosanga n’Abasamaria).
swahili: Yule mwanamke Msamaria akamjibu, “Wewe ni Myahudi na mimi ni Msamaria. Yawezekanaje uniombe nikupe maji ya kunywa?” (Wayahudi walikuwa hawashirikiani kabisa na Wasamaria.)

english: Some time later there was a feast of the Jews, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
ekegusii: Magega ase aya ndiarenge Rituko Rinene ri’Abayahudi; Yeso agatiira kogenda Yerusalemu.
swahili: Baada ya haya, kulikuwa na Sikukuu ya Wayahudi, naye Yesu akapanda kwenda Yerusalemu.

english: so the Jews said to the man who had been healed, “This is the Sabbath! It is unlawful for you to carry your mat.”
ekegusii: Abayahudi bagateebia omonto oria ogwenetigwe, “Reero n’Esabato, tari boronge ase ore gwetweka egesero kiao.”
swahili: Kwa hiyo Wayahudi wakamwambia yule mtu aliyeponywa, “Leo ni Sabato, si halali wewe kubeba mkeka wako.”

english: But he answered, “The man who made me well told me, ‘Pick up your mat and walk.’”
ekegusii: Akabairaneria, “Ere oyonkora koba omogima nere onteebia: Etweke egesero kiao, ogende.”
swahili: Yeye akawajibu, “Yule mtu aliyeniponya aliniambia, ‘Chukua mkeka wako na uende.’ ”

english: “Who is this man who told you to pick it up and walk?” they asked.
ekegusii: Bakamobooria, “Oria ogoteebia: Etweke egesero kiao ogende, nere ng’o?”
swahili: Wakamuuliza, “Ni mtu gani huyo aliyekuambia uchukue mkeka wako uende?”

english: But the man who was healed did not know who it was, for Jesus had slipped away while the crowd was there.
ekegusii: Korende oria ogwenetigwe tamomanyete gose ning’o. Yeso nigo erusananetie, ekiagera abanto abange barenge aase aria.
swahili: Basi yule mtu aliyeponywa hakufahamu ni nani aliyemponya, kwa sababu Yesu alikuwa amejiondoa katika ule umati wa watu uliokuwa hapo.

english: Afterward, Jesus found the man at the temple and said to him, “See, you have been made well. Stop sinning, or something worse may happen to you.”
ekegusii: Magega ase aya Yeso akamonyora ore Hekalu ime, akamoteebia. “Rora, kwabeire omogima; tokora ebibe naende, ring’ana rire riibe kobua tiricha gokonyoora.”
swahili: Baadaye Yesu akamkuta yule mtu aliyemponya ndani ya Hekalu na kumwambia, “Tazama umeponywa, usitende dhambi tena. La sivyo, lisije likakupata jambo baya zaidi.”

english: And the man went away and told the Jews that it was Jesus who had made him well. The Father and the Son
ekegusii: Omonto oria akagenda, agateebia Abayahudi amang’ana, ng’a Yeso nere omokorete koba omogima.
swahili: Yule mtu akaenda, akawaambia wale Wayahudi kuwa ni Yesu aliyemponya. Uzima Kupitia Mwana

english: Now because Jesus was doing these things on the Sabbath, the Jews began to persecute Him.
ekegusii: Ase ayio Abayahudi bagachaaka gochanda Yeso, bakarigia komoita, ekiagera akora aya ase rituko ri’Esabato.
swahili: Kwa hiyo Wayahudi wakaanza kumsumbua Yesu, kwa sababu alikuwa anafanya mambo kama hayo siku ya Sabato.

english: But Jesus answered them, “To this very day My Father is at His work, and I too am working.”
ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, “Tata ngokora are emeremo nonya ngoika bono, na inche ngokora nde emeremo.”
swahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Baba yangu anafanya kazi yake daima hata siku hii ya leo, nami pia ninafanya kazi.”

english: Because of this, the Jews tried all the harder to kill Him. Not only was He breaking the Sabbath, but He was even calling God His own Father, making Himself equal with God.
ekegusii: Nabo ekiagera ase aya Abayahudi bakamenta korigia komoita, ekiagera tasaretie Esabato yoka, korende amo naya narogete Nyasae ng’a n’Ise, ogwekora koreng’ana buna Nyasae. Buna Ise agokora na Omwana naboigo agokora
swahili: Maneno haya yaliwaudhi sana viongozi wa Wayahudi. Wakajaribu kila njia wapate jinsi ya kumuua, kwani si kwamba alivunja Sabato tu, bali alikuwa akimwita Mungu Baba yake, hivyo kujifanya sawa na Mungu. Mamlaka Ya Mwana Wa Mungu

english: So Jesus replied, “Truly, truly, I tell you, the Son can do nothing by Himself, unless He sees the Father doing it. For whatever the Father does, the Son also does.
ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Ekeene, ekeene, nabateebirie: Omwana takonyara gokora ring’ana ere bweka, otatiga riria aroche Ise agokora; naki onsi aya agokora ere, ayio naro n’Omwana agokora.
swahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Amin, amin nawaambia, Mwana hawezi kufanya jambo lolote peke yake, yeye aweza tu kufanya lile analomwona Baba yake akifanya, kwa maana lolote afanyalo Baba, Mwana pia hufanya vivyo hivyo.

english: Now there is in Jerusalem near the Sheep Gate a pool with five covered colonnades, which in Hebrew is called Bethesda.
ekegusii: Naende aaria Yerusalemu ase Egeita gie Ching’ondi ndiarengeo ritibo rikorokwa ase Ekeiberania Betiseda, na rirorio ndiabwate ebisoero bitano.
swahili: Huko Yerusalemu, karibu na mlango uitwao Mlango wa Kondoo, palikuwa na bwawa moja lililoitwa kwa Kiebrania Bethzatha, ambalo lilikuwa limezungukwa na kumbi tano.

english: The Father loves the Son and shows Him all He does. And to your amazement, He will show Him even greater works than these.
ekegusii: Tata nigo amwanchete Omwana, na komworokia onsi ayagokora omonyene; na emeremo emenene kobua eye iga namworokie, erinde inwe monyaare gokumia.
swahili: Baba ampenda Mwana na kumwonyesha yale ambayo yeye Baba mwenyewe anayafanya, naye atamwonyesha kazi kuu kuliko hizi ili mpate kushangaa.

english: For just as the Father raises the dead and gives them life, so also the Son gives life to whom He wishes.
ekegusii: Na buna Tata akobokia ebitondo obia obogima, naboigo n’Omwana akobaa obogima aba arigetie.
swahili: Hakika kama vile Baba awafufuavyo wafu na kuwapa uzima, vivyo hivyo Mwana huwapa uzima wale anaopenda.

english: Furthermore, the Father judges no one, but has assigned all judgment to the Son,
ekegusii: Naki Tata tari kogambia monto onde bwensi, korende oeire Omwana obogambi bwonsi,
swahili: Wala Baba hamhukumu mtu yeyote, lakini hukumu yote amempa Mwana,

english: so that all may honor the Son just as they honor the Father. Whoever does not honor the Son does not honor the Father who sent Him.
ekegusii: erinde bonsi basike Omwana buna basigete Tata. Oyotasigeti Omwana tasigeti Tata oyo omotomete.
swahili: ili wote wamheshimu Mwana kama vile wanavyomheshimu Baba. Yeyote asiyemheshimu Mwana, hamheshimu Baba aliyemtuma.

english: Truly, truly, I tell you, whoever hears My word and believes Him who sent Me has eternal life and will not come under judgment. Indeed, he has crossed over from death to life.
ekegusii: Ekeene, ekeene, nabateebirie: Oyokoigwa ring’ana riane, na komwegena ere oyontomete nare nobogima bwa kare na kare, gose tagoika ase ekiina, korende oetire korwa ase amakweri, oikire ase obogima.
swahili: “Amin, amin nawaambia, yeyote anayesikia maneno yangu na kumwamini yeye aliyenituma, anao uzima wa milele, naye hatahukumiwa, bali amepita kutoka mautini, na kuingia uzimani.

english: Truly, truly, I tell you, the hour is coming and has now come when the dead will hear the voice of the Son of God, and those who hear will live.
ekegusii: “Ekeene, ekeene, nabateebirie: Ensa ngocha ere, na bono nereo, ebitondo biraigwe eriogi ri’Omwana o Nyasae, na baria barariigwe nababe moyo.
swahili: Amin, amin nawaambia, saa yaja, nayo saa ipo, wafu watakapoisikia sauti ya Mwana wa Mungu, nao watakaoisikia watakuwa hai.

english: For as the Father has life in Himself, so also He has granted the Son to have life in Himself.
ekegusii: Naki buna Tata are nobogima ime yaye omonyene; naboigo oeire na Omwana koba nobogima ime yaye omonyene.
swahili: Kama vile Baba alivyo na uzima ndani yake, vivyo hivyo amempa Mwana kuwa na uzima ndani yake.

english: And He has given Him authority to execute judgment, because He is the Son of Man.
ekegusii: Omoeire okobua kw’ogokora ekiina, ekiagera ere n’Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto.
swahili: Naye amempa Mwanawe mamlaka ya kuhukumu kwa kuwa yeye ni Mwana wa Adamu.

english: Do not be amazed at this, for the hour is coming when all who are in their graves will hear His voice
ekegusii: Timokumia ase aya! Naki ensa ngocha ere, ekero abanto bonsi bare ase chimbeera ime baraigwe eriogi riaye,
swahili: “Msishangae kusikia haya, kwa maana saa inakuja ambapo wale walio makaburini wataisikia sauti yake.

english: and come out—those who have done good to the resurrection of life, and those who have done evil to the resurrection of judgment.
ekegusii: na barabwo inabasoke, baria abaare gokora amaya ase okobokigwa kw’obogima, na baria abaare gokora amabe ase okobokigwa gw’ekiina. Oborori igoro ya Yeso
swahili: Nao watatoka nje, wale waliotenda mema watafufuka wapate uzima na wale waliotenda maovu, watafufuka wahukumiwe. Shuhuda Kuhusu Yesu

english: On these walkways lay a great number of the sick, the blind, the lame, and the paralyzed.
ekegusii: Ime ase ebio mbarenge abanto abange abarwaire baare koraara, emeuko, ebirema, na amagata, [baganyete amaache aturubanigwe.
swahili: Hapa palikuwa na idadi kubwa ya wasiojiweza, yaani, vipofu, viwete, na waliopooza [wakingojea maji yatibuliwe.

english: I can do nothing by Myself; I judge only as I hear. And My judgment is just, because I do not seek My own will, but the will of Him who sent Me. Testimonies about Jesus
ekegusii: “Inche omonyene tinkonyaara gokora kende gionsi. Buna nkoigwa nabo nkogamba, na ekiina kiane nigo kere boronge, ekiagera tindi korigia ogwancha kwane, korende nogwancha gwa Tata oyontomete.
swahili: “Mimi siwezi kufanya jambo lolote peke yangu. Ninavyosikia ndivyo ninavyohukumu, nayo hukumu yangu ni ya haki kwa kuwa sitafuti kufanya mapenzi yangu mwenyewe, bali mapenzi yake yeye aliyenituma.

english: If I testify about Myself, My testimony is not valid.
ekegusii: Inche kondeorokie omonyene, oborori bwane tibori obw’ekeene.
swahili: “Kama ningejishuhudia mimi mwenyewe, ushuhuda wangu si kweli.

english: There is another who testifies about Me, and I know that His testimony about Me is valid.
ekegusii: Nare oyonde oy’okombera kirori; na inche namanyire ng’a oborori bwaye agonteeba nobw’ekeene.
swahili: Lakini yuko mwingine anishuhudiaye na ninajua kwamba ushuhuda wake ni wa kweli.

english: You have sent to John, and he has testified to the truth.
ekegusii: Inwe mwatomete abanto ase Yohana, na oborori bwaye nobw’ekeene.
swahili: “Mlituma wajumbe kwa Yohana, naye akashuhudia juu ya kweli.

english: Even though I do not accept human testimony, I say these things so that you may be saved.
ekegusii: Korende inche tindi konyora oborori korwa ase abanto; korende nigo ngokwana aya, erinde inwe motooreke.
swahili: Si kwamba naukubali ushuhuda wa mwanadamu, la, bali ninalitaja hili kusudi ninyi mpate kuokolewa.

english: John was a lamp that burned and gave light, and you were willing for a season to bask in his light.
ekegusii: Ere nigo arenge etaaya egwoka na komoreka, na inwe mwanchire gosasokera omobaso oye ase ekero egeke.
swahili: Yohana alikuwa taa iliyowaka na kutoa nuru, nanyi kwa muda mlichagua kuifurahia nuru yake.

english: But I have testimony more substantial than that of John. For the works that the Father has given Me to accomplish—the very works I am doing—testify about Me that the Father has sent Me.
ekegusii: Korende oborori inde nabwo nobonene kobua boria bwa Yohana, naki emeremo eria naetwe na Tata inyekoore. Emeremo eyio ngokora, yambereire kirori, ng’a Tata nere ontomete.
swahili: “Lakini ninao ushuhuda mkuu zaidi kuliko wa Yohana. Kazi zile nizifanyazo, zinashuhudia juu yangu, zile ambazo Baba amenituma nizikamilishe, naam, ishara hizi ninazofanya, zinashuhudia kuwa Baba ndiye alinituma.

english: And the Father who sent Me has Himself testified about Me. You have never heard His voice nor seen His form,
ekegusii: Nere Tata oyontomete obeire kirori ase ’nde. Eriogi riaye timwana koriigwa kero kende gionsi, gose ekieni kiaye timwana gokerora
swahili: Naye Baba mwenyewe ameshuhudia juu yangu. Hamjapata kamwe kuisikia sauti yake wala kuona umbo lake,

english: nor does His word abide in you, because you do not believe the One He sent. The Witness of Scripture (Luke 16:19–31)
ekegusii: naende ring’ana riaye timori narirorio ime yaino, ekiagera timomwegeneti ere oyotomirwe nere.
swahili: wala hamna neno lake ndani yenu, kwa sababu hamkumwamini yeye aliyetumwa naye.

english: You pore over the Scriptures because you presume that by them you possess eternal life. These are the very words that testify about Me,
ekegusii: Igo mokorigarigia mono amariiko, ekiagera mokagete ng’a nigo more nobogima bwa kare na kare ime y’aro; na ayio naro are kirori ase ’nde,
swahili: Ninyi mnachunguza Maandiko mkidhani ya kuwa ndani yake mna uzima wa milele, maandiko haya ndiyo yanayonishuhudia Mimi.

english: yet you refuse to come to Me to have life.
ekegusii: ko mwangire gocha ase ’nde monyare koba nobogima.
swahili: Lakini mnakataa kuja kwangu ili mpate uzima.

english: I do not accept glory from men,
ekegusii: Tindi konyora obonene korwa ase abanto.
swahili: “Mimi sitafuti kutukuzwa na wanadamu.

english: but I know you, that you do not have the love of God within you.
ekegusii: Korende nabamanyire inwe ng’a timori nobwanchani bwa Nyasae ime yaino.
swahili: Lakini ninajua kwamba hamna upendo wa Mungu mioyoni mwenu.

english: I have come in My Father’s name, and you have not received Me; but if someone else comes in his own name, you will receive him.
ekegusii: Inche nachire ase erieta ria Tata one, na inwe timori konyancha; oyonde karaache ase erieta riaye omonyene, oyio namomwanche.
swahili: Mimi nimekuja kwa jina la Baba yangu, nanyi hamnipokei, lakini mtu mwingine akija kwa jina lake mwenyewe, mtampokea.

english: How can you believe if you accept glory from one another, yet do not seek the glory that comes from the only God?
ekegusii: Naki moranyare kwegena, inwe abamokoenana obonene inwe ase inwe, na obonene boria bokorwa ase Nyasae ore bweka, timori koborigia?
swahili: Ninyi mwawezaje kuamini ikiwa mnapeana utukufu ninyi kwa ninyi, lakini hamna bidii kupata utukufu utokao kwa Mungu?

english: Do not think that I will accuse you before the Father. Your accuser is Moses, in whom you have put your hope.
ekegusii: Timokaga ng’a inche nimbasoere ase Tata; nare oyo okobasoera, nere Musa, oyomosemeretie inwe.
swahili: “Lakini msidhani kuwa mimi nitawashtaki mbele za Baba, mshtaki wenu ni Mose, ambaye mmemwekea tumaini lenu.

english: If you had believed Moses, you would believe Me, because he wrote about Me.
ekegusii: Naki onye mwamwegenete Musa anga mwanyegena nainche, ekiagera nere origete amang’ana igoro yane.
swahili: Kama mngelimwamini Mose, mngeliniamini na mimi kwa maana aliandika habari zangu.

english: But since you do not believe what he wrote, how will you believe what I say?”
ekegusii: Korende onye timwegeneti amariiko aye, naki moregene amang’ana aane?”
swahili: Lakini ikiwa hamwamini aliyoandika Mose, mtaaminije ninayoyasema?”

english: One man there had been an invalid for thirty-eight years.
ekegusii: Narenge aroro omonto gete oyorenge noborwaire bw’emiaka emerongo etato, na etano na etato.
swahili: Mtu mmoja alikuwako huko ambaye alikuwa ameugua kwa miaka thelathini na minane.

english: When Jesus saw him lying there and realized that he had spent a long time in this condition, He asked him, “Do you want to get well?”
ekegusii: Yeso agachia komorora oraire, konya omanyire ng’a obeire engencho eye amatuko amange, akamobooria, “Norigetie koba omogima?”
swahili: Yesu alipomwona akiwa amelala hapo, naye akijua kuwa amekuwa hapo kwa muda mrefu, akamwambia, “Je, wataka kuponywa?”

english: “Sir,” the invalid replied, “I have no one to help me into the pool when the water is stirred. While I am on my way, someone else goes in before me.”
ekegusii: Omorwaire oria akamoiraneria, “Omonene, tindi nomonto okombeka ase ritibo, ekero amaache agoturubanigwa; korende ekero ngochicha inche, omonto onde asoa ritang’ani ase ’nde.”
swahili: Yule mgonjwa akamjibu, “Bwana, mimi sina mtu wa kuniingiza bwawani maji yanapotibuliwa. Nami ninapotaka kutumbukia bwawani, mtu mwingine huingia kabla yangu.”

english: Then Jesus told him, “Get up, pick up your mat, and walk.”
ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Tenena, etweke egesero kiao, ogende.”
swahili: Yesu akamwambia, “Inuka! Chukua mkeka wako na uende.”

english: Immediately the man was made well, and he picked up his mat and began to walk. Now this happened on the Sabbath day,
ekegusii: Erio kegima omonto oria akaba omogima, agetweka egesero kiaye, akagenda. Nabo yarenge Esabato rituko riria.
swahili: Mara yule mtu akapona, akachukua mkeka wake, akaanza kutembea. Basi siku hiyo ilikuwa siku ya Sabato.

english: After this, Jesus crossed to the other side of the Sea of Galilee (that is, the Sea of Tiberias).
ekegusii: Magega ase aya Yeso akagenda ng’umbu y’enyancha ya Galili, nero enyancha ya Tiberia.
swahili: Baada ya haya, Yesu alikwenda ngʼambo ya Bahari ya Galilaya, ambayo pia huitwa Bahari ya Tiberia.

english: “Have the people sit down,” Jesus said. Now there was plenty of grass in that place, so the men sat down, about five thousand of them.
ekegusii: Yeso akabora, “Ikaransia abanto.” Mbwarenge aroro obonyansi obonge aase aria. Igo abasacha bagaikaransa, barabwo nigo barenge chilifu isaano.
swahili: Yesu akasema, “Waketisheni watu chini.” Palikuwa na majani mengi katika eneo lile, nao watu wakaketi. Palikuwa na wanaume wapatao 5,000.

english: Then Jesus took the loaves and the fish, gave thanks, and distributed to those who were seated as much as they wanted.
ekegusii: Yeso akabogoria emegati; kayesesenirie, akagabera abaikaransete; naboigo ne chinswe chiria, koreng’ana buna barigetie.
swahili: Ndipo Yesu akachukua ile mikate, akamshukuru Mungu na kuwagawia wale watu waliokuwa wameketi. Akafanya vivyo hivyo na wale samaki. Kila mtu akapata kadiri alivyotaka.

english: And when everyone was full, He said to His disciples, “Gather the pieces that are left over, so that nothing will be wasted.”
ekegusii: Kobachia koigota, agateebia aborokigwa baye, “Sangereria ebisamunye biatigaire, gento tigesira.”
swahili: Watu wote walipokwisha kula na kushiba, akawaambia wanafunzi wake, “Kusanyeni vipande vilivyobaki vya ile mikate, kisipotee chochote.”

english: So they collected them and filled twelve baskets with the pieces of the five barley loaves left over by those who had eaten.
ekegusii: Nabo bakabisangereria, bagaichoria ebitonga ikomi na bibere ase ebisamunye bi’emegati etano y’esairi, ebiatigaretigwe na baria bariete.
swahili: Hivyo wakavikusanya, wakajaza vikapu kumi na viwili kwa vipande vya ile mikate mitano ya shayiri na samaki wale wawili wadogo vilivyobakishwa na waliokula.

english: When the people saw the sign that Jesus had performed, they began to say, “Truly this is the Prophet who is to come into the world.”
ekegusii: Ekero abanto baria bachia korora egekone keria Yeso akorete, bakaboora, “Oyo ekeene nomobani oria orenge gocha ase ense!” Yeso ogweatanana na gotaara ase enyancha igoro (Mat 14:22-27; Mar 6:45-52)
swahili: Baada ya watu kuona muujiza ule Yesu aliofanya, walianza kusema, “Hakika huyu ndiye Nabii ajaye ulimwenguni!”

english: Then Jesus, realizing that they were about to come and make Him king by force, withdrew again to a mountain by Himself. Jesus Walks on Water (Matthew 14:22–33; Mark 6:45–52)
ekegusii: Nabo Yeso namanyete ng’a mbarigetie gocha komoira, erinde bamobeeke abe omorwoti. Ase ayio akerusanania, akagenda naende egetunwa ere bweka.
swahili: Yesu akijua kwamba walitaka kuja kumfanya awe mfalme wao, kwa nguvu, akajitenga nao akaenda milimani peke yake. Yesu Atembea Juu Ya Maji (Mathayo 14:22-33; Marko 6:45-52)

english: When evening came, His disciples went down to the sea,
ekegusii: Rigachia koba mogoroba, aborokigwa baye bagatirimboka gochia nyancha,
swahili: Ilipofika jioni, wanafunzi wake waliteremka kwenda baharini.

english: got into a boat, and started across the sea to Capernaum. It was already dark, and Jesus had not yet gone out to them.
ekegusii: bakariina obwato ime, bagachaaka kwamboka enyancha kogenda Kapernaumu. Naende omosunte konya obeire, na Yeso konya taracha ase bare.
swahili: Wakaingia kwenye mashua, wakaanza kuvuka bahari kwenda Kapernaumu. Wakati huu kulikuwa tayari giza na Yesu alikuwa hajajumuika nao.

english: A strong wind was blowing, and the sea grew agitated.
ekegusii: Enyancha egachaaka koimoka ase engencho y’omwaga omonge orenge kogusa.
swahili: Bahari ikachafuka kwa sababu upepo mkali ulikuwa unavuma.

english: When they had rowed about three or four miles, they saw Jesus approaching the boat, walking on the sea—and they were terrified.
ekegusii: Nabo kabang’usire obwato chimaeli isato gose inye bakarora Yeso ogotaara ase enyancha igoro, ogoika ang’e ase obwato. Erio bakairoka,
swahili: Wanafunzi walipokuwa wamekwenda mwendo wa karibu maili tatu au nne, walimwona Yesu akitembea juu ya maji akikaribia mashua, nao wakaogopa sana.

english: A large crowd followed Him because they saw the signs He was performing on the sick.
ekegusii: Omoganda omonene okamotunyana, ekiagera baroche ebikone abakorerete abarwaire.
swahili: Umati mkubwa wa watu uliendelea kumfuata, kwa sababu waliona ishara nyingi za miujiza alizofanya kwa wagonjwa.

english: But Jesus spoke up: “It is I; do not be afraid.”
ekegusii: korende Yeso akabateebia, “Ninche. Timoiroka!”
swahili: Lakini Yesu akawaambia, “Ni mimi. Msiogope.”

english: Then they were willing to take Him into the boat, and at once the boat reached the shore where they were heading. Jesus the Bread of Life
ekegusii: Bagancha komosoyia obwato ime, erio kegima obwato bogaika ase barenge kogenda. Abanto bakorigia Yeso
swahili: Ndipo wakamkaribisha kwa furaha ndani ya mashua, na mara wakafika ufuoni walikokuwa wakienda. Watu Wanamtafuta Yesu

english: The next day, the crowd that had remained on the other side of the sea realized that only one boat had been there, and that Jesus had not boarded it with His disciples, but they had gone away alone.
ekegusii: Ankio yaye omoganda oteneine ng’umbu y’enyancha bakarora ng’a obwato bonde tibwarenge aroro, otatiga boria obomo bwoka, naende ng’a Yeso tasoete ase obwato boria amo naborokigwa baye, korende naborokigwa baye bagendete boka.
swahili: Siku iliyofuata, wale watu waliokuwa wamebaki ngʼambo waliona kwamba palikuwepo na mashua moja tu na kwamba Yesu hakuwa ameondoka pamoja na wanafunzi wake, ila walikuwa wameondoka peke yao.

english: However, some boats from Tiberias landed near the place where the people had eaten the bread after the Lord had given thanks.
ekegusii: Korende amaato ande agacha korwa Tiberia ang’e nase aria bariete emegati ekero Omonene ayesesenetie.
swahili: Lakini zikaja mashua nyingine kutoka Tiberia zikafika karibu na mahali pale walipokula mikate baada ya Bwana kumshukuru Mungu.

english: So when the crowd saw that neither Jesus nor His disciples were there, they got into the boats and went to Capernaum to look for Him.
ekegusii: Ekero omoganda ochia korora ng’a Yeso tari aroro, nonya naborokigwa baye, barabwo abanyene bagasoa amaato ime, bakagenda Kapernaumu, bakorigia Yeso. Yeso nomogati bw’obogima
swahili: Mara wale watu wakatambua kwamba Yesu hakuwepo hapo, wala wanafunzi wake. Wakaingia kwenye mashua hizo, wakaenda Kapernaumu ili kumtafuta Yesu. Yesu Ni Mkate Wa Uzima

english: When they found Him on the other side of the sea, they asked Him, “Rabbi, when did You get here?”
ekegusii: Goika bagachia komoorora ng’umbu y’enyancha bakamobooria, “Omworokia, indi gwachete aa?”
swahili: Walipomkuta Yesu ngʼambo ya bahari wakamuuliza, “Rabi, umefika lini huku?”

english: Jesus replied, “Truly, truly, I tell you, it is not because you saw these signs that you are looking for Me, but because you ate the loaves and had your fill.
ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, “Ekeene, ekeene, nabateebirie: Iga mokondigia, tari ekiagera mwaroche ebikone, korende nekiagera mwariete emegati eria, mokaigota.
swahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Amin, amin nawaambia, ninyi hamnitafuti kwa kuwa mliona ishara na miujiza, bali kwa sababu mlikula ile mikate mkashiba.

english: Do not work for food that perishes, but for food that endures to eternal life, which the Son of Man will give you. For on Him God the Father has placed His seal of approval.”
ekegusii: Timokorera endagera egosareka korende, endagera ekobao goika obogima bwa kare na kare, eye Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto aranyare kobaa, ekiagera Nyasae Tata obekire ekemanyererio kiaye asare.”
swahili: Msishughulikie chakula kiharibikacho, bali chakula kidumucho hata uzima wa milele, ambacho Mwana wa Adamu atawapa. Yeye ndiye ambaye Mungu Baba amemtia muhuri.”

english: Then they inquired, “What must we do to perform the works of God?”
ekegusii: Nabo bakamobooria, “Ninki togokora tonyare gokora emeremo ya Nyasae?”
swahili: Ndipo wakamuuliza, “Tufanye nini ili tupate kuitenda kazi ya Mungu?”

english: Jesus replied, “The work of God is this: to believe in the One He has sent.”
ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, “Eye nero emeremo ya Nyasae, ng’a momwegene ere oyotomirwe nere.”
swahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Kazi ya Mungu ndiyo hii: Mwaminini yeye aliyetumwa naye.”

english: Then Jesus went up on the mountain and sat down with His disciples.
ekegusii: Yeso agatiira gochia egetunwa, agaikaransa aroro amo naborokigwa baye.
swahili: Kisha Yesu akapanda mlimani akaketi huko pamoja na wanafunzi wake.

english: So they asked Him, “What sign then will You perform, so that we may see it and believe You? What will You do?
ekegusii: Bakamoteebia, “Mbikone ki ogokora, erinde torore tokwegene? Meremo ki ogokora?
swahili: Hivyo wakamuuliza, “Utafanya ishara gani ya muujiza, ili tuione tukuamini? Utafanya jambo gani?

english: Our fathers ate the manna in the wilderness, as it is written: ‘He gave them bread from heaven to eat.’ ”
ekegusii: Chisokoro chiaito nchiariete mana ase erooro, buna yarigetwe: Nabaete omogati korwa igoro bakaria.”
swahili: Baba zetu walikula mana jangwani, kama ilivyoandikwa, ‘Aliwapa mikate kutoka mbinguni ili wale.’ ”

english: Jesus said to them, “Truly, truly, I tell you, it was not Moses who gave you the bread from heaven, but it is My Father who gives you the true bread from heaven.
ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Ekeene, ekeene, nabateebirie: Tari Musa obaete omogati oria orwete igoro, korende n’Tata one ore kobaa omogati bw’ekeene okorwa igoro.
swahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Amin, amin nawaambia, si Mose aliyewapa mikate kutoka mbinguni, bali Baba yangu ndiye anawapa mkate wa kweli kutoka mbinguni.

english: For the bread of God is He who comes down from heaven and gives life to the world.”
ekegusii: Naki omogati o Nyasae noria ogoika korwa igoro na koa ense obogima.”
swahili: Kwa maana mkate wa Mungu ni yule ashukaye kutoka mbinguni na kuupa ulimwengu uzima.”

english: “Sir,” they said, “give us this bread at all times.”
ekegusii: Nabo bakamoteebia, “Omonene, amatuko onsi otoe omogati oyio.”
swahili: Wakamwambia, “Bwana, kuanzia sasa tupatie huo mkate siku zote.”

english: Jesus answered, “I am the bread of life. Whoever comes to Me will never hunger, and whoever believes in Me will never thirst.
ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Inche nomogati bw’obogima; ere oyogocha ase ’nde takoigwa enchara nonya ng’ake, na ere oyoranyegene takorang’a nonya ng’ake.
swahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Mimi ndimi mkate wa uzima. Yeye ajaye kwangu, hataona njaa kamwe na yeye aniaminiye, hataona kiu kamwe.

english: But as I stated, you have seen Me and still you do not believe.
ekegusii: Korende nabateebirie ng’a mwandorire, ko timonyegeneti.
swahili: Lakini kama nilivyowaambia, mmeniona lakini bado hamwamini.

english: Everyone the Father gives Me will come to Me, and the one who comes to Me I will never drive away.
ekegusii: Bonsi aba Tata akong’a nabache ase ’nde, na ere oyogocha ase ’nde tinkomotuguta isiko nonya ng’ake.
swahili: Wale wote anipao Baba watakuja kwangu na yeyote ajaye kwangu, sitamfukuzia nje kamwe.

english: For I have come down from heaven, not to do My own will, but to do the will of Him who sent Me.
ekegusii: Naki naikire korwa igoro, tari ase ogokora ogwancha kwane omonyene, korende ogwancha kwaye oyontomete.
swahili: Kwa kuwa nimeshuka kutoka mbinguni si ili kufanya mapenzi yangu, bali mapenzi yake yeye aliyenituma.

english: And this is the will of Him who sent Me, that I shall lose none of those He has given Me, but raise them up at the last day.
ekegusii: Naende ogwancha kwaye Tata oyontomete nakwo oko, ng’a ase bonsi ang’eire tinsiria nonya noyomo, korende mbabokie ase rituko ri’omoerio.
swahili: Haya ndiyo mapenzi yake yeye aliyenituma, kwamba, nisimpoteze hata mmoja wa wale alionipa, bali niwafufue siku ya mwisho.

english: Now the Jewish Feast of the Passover was near.
ekegusii: Na Epasaka, rituko rinene ri’Abayahudi, nigo yarenge ang’e.
swahili: Pasaka ya Wayahudi ilikuwa imekaribia.

english: For it is My Father’s will that everyone who looks to the Son and believes in Him shall have eternal life, and I will raise him up at the last day.”
ekegusii: Nogwancha kwaye oyontomete nakwo oko, ng’a kera oyokorigereria Omwana na komwegena, nabe nobogima bwa kare na kare, na inche nimobokie ase rituko ri’omoerio.”
swahili: Kwa maana mapenzi ya Baba yangu ni kwamba kila mmoja amtazamaye, Mwana na kumwamini awe na uzima wa milele, nami nitawafufua siku ya mwisho.”

english: At this, the Jews began to grumble about Jesus because He had said, “I am the bread that came down from heaven.”
ekegusii: Abayahudi bakamwemurunganeria, ekiagera ateebete, “Inche nomogati oigete korwa igoro.”
swahili: Wayahudi wakaanza kunungʼunika kwa kuwa alisema, “Mimi ndimi mkate ulioshuka kutoka mbinguni.”

english: They were asking, “Is this not Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? How then can He say, ‘I have come down from heaven?’”
ekegusii: Bakaboora, “Oyo tari Yeso, omwana o Yusufu? Ntomanyete ise na ng’ina. Naki rende akobora: Naikire korwa igoro?”
swahili: Wakasema, “Huyu si Yesu, mwana wa Yosefu, ambaye baba yake na mama yake tunawajua? Anawezaje basi sasa kusema, ‘Nimeshuka kutoka mbinguni’?”

english: “Stop grumbling among yourselves,” Jesus replied.
ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, “Timwemurunganerania inwe ase inwe.
swahili: Hivyo Yesu akawaambia, “Acheni kunungʼunikiana ninyi kwa ninyi.

english: “No one can come to Me unless the Father who sent Me draws him, and I will raise him up at the last day.
ekegusii: Omonto onde tari oranyare gocha ase ’nde, atang’usiri na Tata oyontomete, na inche nimobokie ase rituko ri’omoerio.
swahili: Hakuna mtu awezaye kuja kwangu kama asipovutwa na Baba aliyenituma, nami nitamfufua siku ya mwisho.

english: It is written in the Prophets: ‘And they will all be taught by God.’ Everyone who has heard the Father and learned from Him comes to Me—
ekegusii: Nerikire nababani: Bonsi naborokererigwe na Nyasae. Kera oyoigure na kworokererigwa na Tata, nigo agocha ase ’nde.
swahili: Imeandikwa katika Manabii, ‘Wote watafundishwa na Mungu.’ Yeyote amsikilizaye Baba na kujifunza kutoka kwake, huyo huja kwangu.

english: not that anyone has seen the Father except the One who is from God; only He has seen the Father.
ekegusii: Tari ng’a monto ororire Tata, otatiga ere oyorure ase Nyasae, oyio nere ororire Tata.
swahili: Hakuna mtu yeyote aliyemwona Baba isipokuwa yeye atokaye kwa Mungu, yeye ndiye peke yake aliyemwona Baba.

english: Truly, truly, I tell you, he who believes has eternal life.
ekegusii: Ekeene, ekeene, nabateebirie: Ere oyonyegenete inche nare nobogima bwa kare na kare.
swahili: Amin, amin nawaambia, yeye anayeamini anao uzima wa milele.

english: I am the bread of life.
ekegusii: Inche nomogati bw’obogima.
swahili: Mimi ni mkate wa uzima.

english: Your fathers ate the manna in the wilderness, yet they died.
ekegusii: Chisokoro chiaino nchiariete mana ase erooro, na barabwo bagakwa.
swahili: Baba zenu walikula mana jangwani, lakini wakafa.

english: When Jesus looked up and saw a large crowd coming toward Him, He said to Philip, “Where can we buy bread for these people to eat?”
ekegusii: Nabo Yeso agachia koimokia amaiso aye, akarora omoganda omonene ogocha asare, akaboria Filipo, “Ng’ai togochia kogora emegati, aba banyare koria?”
swahili: Yesu alipotazama na kuuona ule umati mkubwa wa watu ukimjia, akamwambia Filipo, “Tutanunua wapi mikate ili watu hawa wale?”

english: This is the bread that comes down from heaven, so that anyone may eat of it and not die.
ekegusii: Oyo noro omogati oikire korwa igoro ng’a monto onde bwensi orayorie, tagokwa.
swahili: Lakini hapa kuna mkate utokao mbinguni, ambao mtu yeyote akiula, hatakufa.

english: I am the living bread that came down from heaven. If anyone eats of this bread, he will live forever. And this bread, which I will give for the life of the world, is My flesh.”
ekegusii: Inche nomogati bw’obogima oyoigete korwa igoro; omonto kararie omogati oyio, nabe moyo goika kare na kare; na omogati ndarue inche, ase engencho y’obogima bw’ense, nomobere one.”
swahili: Mimi ni mkate wa uzima ule uliotoka mbinguni. Mtu yeyote akiula mkate huu, ataishi milele. Mkate huu ni mwili wangu, ambao nitautoa kwa ajili ya uzima wa ulimwengu.”

english: At this, the Jews began to argue among themselves, “How can this man give us His flesh to eat?”
ekegusii: Erio Abayahudi bakaamererania barabwo ase barabwo, bakaboora, “Naki omonto oyo aranyare gotoa omobere oye toyorie?”
swahili: Ndipo Wayahudi wakaanza kuhojiana vikali wao kwa wao wakisema, “Mtu huyu awezaje kutupatia mwili wake tuule?”

english: So Jesus said to them, “Truly, truly, I tell you, unless you eat the flesh and drink the blood of the Son of Man, you have no life in you.
ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Ekeene, ekeene nabateebirie: Motarieti omobere oye Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto na konywa amanyinga aye, timori nobogima ime yaino.
swahili: Hivyo Yesu akawaambia, “Amin, amin nawaambia, msipoula mwili wa Mwana wa Adamu na kuinywa damu yake, hamna uzima ndani yenu.

english: Whoever eats My flesh and drinks My blood has eternal life, and I will raise him up at the last day.
ekegusii: Oyokoria omobere one na konywa amanyinga aane nare nobogima bwa kare na kare, na inche nimobokie ase rituko ri’omoerio,
swahili: Mtu yeyote aulaye mwili wangu na kunywa damu yangu, anao uzima wa milele. Nami nitamfufua siku ya mwisho.

english: For My flesh is real food, and My blood is real drink.
ekegusii: ekiagera omobere one nendagera y’ekeene, na amanyinga aane nekenyugwa gi’ekeene.
swahili: Kwa maana mwili wangu ni chakula cha kweli na damu yangu ni kinywaji cha kweli.

english: Whoever eats My flesh and drinks My blood remains in Me, and I in him.
ekegusii: Oyokoria omobere one na konywa amanyinga aane nigo akomenya ime yane, na inche ime yaye.
swahili: Yeyote alaye mwili wangu na kunywa damu yangu, atakaa ndani yangu nami nitakaa ndani yake.

english: Just as the living Father sent Me and I live because of the Father, so also the one who feeds on Me will live because of Me.
ekegusii: Buna Tata are moyo antomete, na inche inde moyo ase engencho ya Tata, naboigo oyokondia, nabe moyo ase engencho yane.
swahili: Kama vile Baba aliye hai alivyonituma mimi, na kama nami ninavyoishi kwa sababu ya Baba, hivyo anilaye mimi ataishi kwa sababu yangu.

english: This is the bread that came down from heaven. Unlike your fathers, who ate the manna and died, the one who eats this bread will live forever.” Many Disciples Turn Back (Matthew 8:18–22; Luke 9:57–62; Luke 14:25–33)
ekegusii: Oyio nomogati oigete korwa igoro, tari buna chisokoro chiaino chiariete mana, bagakwa; oyorarie omogati oyio nabe moyo goika kare na kare.”
swahili: Huu ndio mkate ushukao kutoka mbinguni, si kama ule mkate baba zenu waliokula nao wakafa. Lakini yeye aulaye mkate huu ataishi milele.”

english: Jesus said this while teaching in the synagogue in Capernaum.
ekegusii: Amang’ana aya nigo ayakwanete ase esinagogi, kaare kworokereria aria Kapernaumu. Abande ase aborokigwa bakaba ne chitang’u‐tang’u
swahili: Yesu alisema maneno haya alipokuwa akifundisha katika sinagogi huko Kapernaumu. Wafuasi Wengi Wamwacha Yesu

english: But He was asking this to test him, for He knew what He was about to do.
ekegusii: Igo amoboretie aya, erinde amoteeme, ekiagera namanyete ere omonyene eki arakore.
swahili: Aliuliza swali hili kumpima, kwa maana alishajua la kufanya.

english: On hearing it, many of His disciples said, “This is a difficult teaching. Who can accept it?”
ekegusii: Abange ase aborokigwa baye ekero bariigwa, bakaboora, “Ring’ana eri nerikong’u, ning’o oranyare koritegerera?”
swahili: Wengi wa wafuasi wake waliposikia jambo hili wakasema, “Mafundisho haya ni magumu. Ni nani awezaye kuyapokea?”

english: Aware that His disciples were grumbling about this teaching, Jesus asked them, “Does this offend you?
ekegusii: Ko Yeso akamanya ase omoyo oye ng’a aborokigwa baye bemurunganeirie ring’ana eri, akababoria, “Ring’ana eri ndiabagochire?
swahili: Yesu alipojua kwamba wafuasi wake wananungʼunika kuhusu mafundisho yake, akawaambia, “Je, jambo hili limewaudhi?

english: Then what will happen if you see the Son of Man ascend to where He was before?
ekegusii: Naki erabe rende, komorarore Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto okogenda aaria aase arenge ritang’ani?
swahili: Ingekuwaje basi kama mngemwona Mwana wa Adamu akipaa kwenda zake huko alipokuwa kwanza?

english: The Spirit gives life; the flesh profits nothing. The words I have spoken to you are spirit and they are life.
ekegusii: Omoika noro okobeeka obogima, omobere togwenereti gento; amang’ana nabateebirie n’Omoika, naende nobogima.
swahili: Roho ndiye atiaye uzima, mwili haufai kitu. Maneno haya niliyowaambia ni Roho tena ni uzima.

english: However, there are some of you who do not believe.” (For Jesus had known from the beginning which of them did not believe and who would betray Him.)
ekegusii: Korende mbare abande ase egati yaino bategeneti.” Naki Yeso amanyete korwa omochakano mbarabi abategeneti, naende ning’o orache komorua.
swahili: Lakini baadhi yenu hamwamini.” Kwa maana Yesu alifahamu tangu mwanzo wale ambao hawangemwamini miongoni mwao na yule ambaye angemsaliti.

english: Then Jesus said, “This is why I told you that no one can come to Me unless the Father has granted it to him.”
ekegusii: Akabora, “Eke nakio gekogera nabateebia, ng’a omonto onde tari oranyare gocha ase ’nde, otatiga oeirwe na Tata one.”
swahili: Akaendelea kusema, “Hii ndiyo sababu niliwaambia kwamba hakuna mtu awezaye kuja kwangu isipokuwa amejaliwa na Baba yangu.”

english: So Jesus asked the Twelve, “Do you want to leave too?”
ekegusii: Erio Yeso akaboria baria ikomi na babere, “Nainwe boigo morigetie kogenda?”
swahili: Hivyo Yesu akawauliza wale wanafunzi wake kumi na wawili, “Je, ninyi pia mnataka kuondoka?”

english: Simon Peter replied, “Lord, to whom would we go? You have the words of eternal life.
ekegusii: Simioni Petero akamoiraneria, “Omonene! Togende ase ng’o? Aye nore namang’ana y’obogima bwa kare na kare.
swahili: Simoni Petro akamjibu, “Bwana, tuondoke twende kwa nani? Wewe unayo maneno ya uzima wa milele.

english: We believe and know that You are the Holy One of God. ”
ekegusii: Na intwe twegenire na komanya ng’a aye naye Omochenu o Nyasae.”
swahili: Tunaamini na kujua kuwa wewe ndiwe Aliye Mtakatifu wa Mungu.”

english: Philip answered, “Two hundred denarii would not buy enough bread for each of them to have a small piece.”
ekegusii: Filipo akamoiraneria, “Emegati ye chidinari amagana abere tekobaisana, kera oyomo anyore moke igo.”
swahili: Filipo akamjibu, “Hata fedha kiasi cha dinari mia mbili, hazitoshi kununua mikate ya kuwapa watu hawa ili kila mtu apate kidogo.”

english: Jesus answered them, “Have I not chosen you, the Twelve? Yet one of you is a devil!”
ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, “Inee! Tinabachorete inwe ikomi na babere, na oyomo oino Saitani?”
swahili: Ndipo Yesu akajibu, “Je, sikuwachagua ninyi kumi na wawili? Lakini mmoja wenu ni ibilisi.”

english: He was speaking about Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot. For although Judas was one of the Twelve, he was later to betray Jesus.
ekegusii: Nigo akwanete igoro ya Yudasi, omwana o Simioni Iskariota, ekiagera oyo nere orache komorua; na ere noyomo bwa baria ikomi na babere.
swahili: (Hapa alikuwa anasema juu ya Yuda, mwana wa Simoni Iskariote. Ingawa alikuwa mmoja wa wale kumi na wawili, ndiye ambaye baadaye angemsaliti Yesu.)

english: One of His disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, said to Him,
ekegusii: Oyomo bw’aborokigwa baye, Anderea, momura omwabo Simioni Petero, akamoteebia,
swahili: Mmoja wa wanafunzi wake aitwaye Andrea, ndugu yake Simoni Petro, akamwambia,

english: “Here is a boy with five barley loaves and two small fish. But what difference will these make among so many?”
ekegusii: “Nare aa omosae, obwate emegati etano y’esairi ne chinswe ibere, korende ebi inki biraisane ase abanto abange buna aba?”
swahili: “Hapa kuna mvulana mmoja mwenye mikate mitano ya shayiri na samaki wawili wadogo. Lakini hivi vitatosha nini kwa umati huu wote?”

english: After this, Jesus traveled throughout Galilee. He did not want to travel in Judea, because the Jews there were trying to kill Him.
ekegusii: Magega ase aya Yeso akaba ogotaara ase Galili; naki tarigetie gotaara ase Boyahudi, ekiagera Abayahudi nigo barenge korigia komoita.
swahili: Baada ya mambo haya, Yesu alikwenda sehemu mbalimbali za Galilaya. Hakutaka kwenda Uyahudi kwa sababu Wayahudi huko walitaka kumuua.

english: But after His brothers had gone up to the feast, He also went—not publicly, but in secret.
ekegusii: Goika ekero abamwabo bachia gotiira, nere boigo agatiira gochia ase Rituko Rinene, tari maiso marore, korende ase bobisi.
swahili: Lakini ndugu zake walipokwisha kuondoka kwenda kwenye Sikukuu, yeye pia alikwenda lakini kwa siri.

english: So the Jews were looking for Him at the feast and asking, “Where is He?”
ekegusii: Nabo Abayahudi bakamorigia ase rituko erio bakobora, “Ng’ai are oyio?”
swahili: Wayahudi walikuwa wakimtafuta huko kwenye Sikukuu na kuulizana, “Yuko wapi huyu mtu?”

english: Many in the crowds were whispering about Him. Some said, “He is a good man.” But others replied, “No, He deceives the people.”
ekegusii: Okwemurungania okonene gokaba ase egati y’omoganda ase engencho yaye. Abande bakaboora, “Nigo are omonto omuya,” na abande bakaboora, “Taibo, korende nigo agotantania omoganda.”
swahili: Kulikuwa na minongʼono iliyoenea kumhusu Yesu katika umati wa watu, wakati wengine wakisema, “Ni mtu mwema.” Wengine walikuwa wakisema, “La, yeye anawadanganya watu.”

english: Yet no one would speak publicly about Him for fear of the Jews.
ekegusii: Korende omonto tari omwatorete maiso marore ase engencho y’okoiroka Abayahudi. Yeso okworokereria agwo Yerusalemu ng’a ere nigo arwete ase Nyasae
swahili: Lakini hakuna mtu yeyote aliyemsema waziwazi kumhusu kwa sababu ya kuwaogopa Wayahudi. Yesu Afundisha Kwenye Sikukuu

english: About halfway through the feast, Jesus went up to the temple courts and began to teach.
ekegusii: Goika egachia koba gati‐gati ye Rituko Rinene Yeso agatiira, agasoa Hekalu ime akorokereria.
swahili: Ilipokaribia katikati ya Sikukuu, Yesu alipanda kwenda Hekaluni na kuanza kufundisha.

english: The Jews were amazed and asked, “How did this man attain such learning without having studied?”
ekegusii: Abayahudi bagakumia ase aya, bakaboora, “Naki amanyete chisemi, na ere tasometigwe?”
swahili: Wayahudi wakastaajabia mafundisho yake wakasema, “Mtu huyu amepataje kujua mambo haya bila kufundishwa?”

english: “My teaching is not My own,” Jesus replied. “It comes from Him who sent Me.
ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, “Okworokereria kwane tari okwane, korende nokwaye ere oyontomete.
swahili: Ndipo Yesu akawajibu, “Mafundisho yangu si yangu mwenyewe, bali yanatoka kwake yeye aliyenituma.

english: If anyone desires to do His will, he will know whether My teaching is from God or whether I speak on My own.
ekegusii: Omonto karanche gokora ogwancha kwaye, namanye gose okworokereria oko nigo gokorwa ase Nyasae, gose nigo ngokwana ase okobua kwane omonyene.
swahili: Mtu yeyote akipenda kufanya mapenzi ya Mungu, atajua kama mafundisho yangu yanatoka kwa Mungu au ninasema kwa ajili yangu mwenyewe.

english: He who speaks on his own authority seeks his own glory, but He who seeks the glory of the One who sent Him is a man of truth; in Him there is no falsehood.
ekegusii: Ere oyogokwana ase okobua kwaye omonyene nigo akorigia obonene bwaye omonyene; korende ere oyokorigia obonene bw’oria omotomete, nigo are oyo bw’ekeene, na asare obong’ainereria tiboiyo.
swahili: Wale wanenao kwa ajili yao wenyewe hufanya hivyo kwa kutaka utukufu wao wenyewe. Lakini yeye atafutaye utukufu wa yule aliyemtuma ni wa kweli, wala hakuna uongo ndani yake.

english: Has not Moses given you the law? Yet not one of you keeps it. Why are you trying to kill Me?”
ekegusii: Inee! Musa tabaete amachiiko? Korende onde oino tari oyobwatete amachiiko. Nase ki mokorigia kong’ita?”
swahili: Je, Mose hakuwapa ninyi sheria? Lakini hakuna hata mmoja wenu anayeishika hiyo sheria. Kwa nini mnataka kuniua?”

english: However, the Jewish Feast of Tabernacles was near.
ekegusii: Naende rituko rinene ri’Ebigutu ri’Abayahudi nigo riarenge ang’e.
swahili: Sikukuu ya Vibanda ya Wayahudi ilikuwa imekaribia.

english: “You have a demon,” the crowd replied. “Who is trying to kill You?”
ekegusii: Omoganda okairaneria, “Nore nekerecha! Ning’o okorigia kogoita?”
swahili: Ule umati wa watu ukamjibu, “Wewe una pepo mchafu! Ni nani anayetaka kukuua?”

english: Jesus answered them, “I did one miracle, and you are all amazed.
ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, “Nakorete ogokora okomo, na inwe mwensi nigo mogokumetie.
swahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Nimefanya muujiza mmoja na nyote mkastaajabu.

english: But because Moses gave you circumcision, you circumcise a boy on the Sabbath (not that it is from Moses, but from the patriarchs.)
ekegusii: Musa akabaa okwaroka (tari ng’a nigo korwete ase Musa, korende ase chisokoro chiaino), na inwe nigo mogosara omonto ase rituko ri’Esabato.
swahili: Lakini kwa kuwa Mose aliwaamuru tohara (ingawa kwa kweli haikutoka kwa Mose bali kwa baba zenu wakuu), mnamtahiri mtoto hata siku ya Sabato.

english: If a boy can be circumcised on the Sabbath so that the law of Moses will not be broken, why are you angry with Me for making the whole man well on the Sabbath?
ekegusii: Gaki onye omonto okwarokigwa rituko ri’Esabato, erinde amachiiko a Musa tasareka; naki mokombea ekiagera nakora omobere bwonsi bw’omonto koba omogima kegima rituko ri’Esabato?
swahili: Ikiwa mtoto aweza kutahiriwa siku ya Sabato kusudi sheria ya Mose isivunjwe, kwa nini mnanikasirikia kwa kumponya mtu mwili wake wote siku ya Sabato?

english: Stop judging by outward appearances, and start judging justly.” Is Jesus the Christ?
ekegusii: Timogamba ekiina ase engencho y’ekieni, korende nacha ekiina ase oboronge.”
swahili: Acheni kuhukumu mambo kwa jinsi mnavyoona tu, bali hukumuni kwa haki.” Je, Yesu Ndiye Kristo?

english: Then some of the people of Jerusalem began to say, “Isn’t this the man they are trying to kill?
ekegusii: Abande ase abanto ba Yerusalemu bakaboora, “Oyo tari ere omonto oria bakorigia goita?
swahili: Ndipo baadhi ya watu wa Yerusalemu wakawa wanasema, “Tazameni, huyu si yule mtu wanayetaka kumuua?

english: Yet here He is, speaking publicly, and they are not saying anything to Him. Have the rulers truly recognized that this is the Christ?
ekegusii: Nao are aa gokwana maiso marore gose tibari komoteebia ing’ana? Aande gose abanene bamanyire bori ng’a nere Kristo?
swahili: Mbona yuko hapa anazungumza hadharani na wala hawamwambii neno lolote? Je, inawezekana viongozi wanafahamu kuwa huyu ndiye Kristo?

english: But we know where this man is from. When the Christ comes, no one will know where He is from.”
ekegusii: Na oyo twamomanyire aase arure, korende Kristo karache, onde tari oramanye aase akorwa.”
swahili: Tunafahamu huyu mtu anakotoka, lakini Kristo atakapokuja, hakuna yeyote atakayejua atokako.”

english: Then Jesus, still teaching in the temple courts, cried out, “You know Me, and you know where I am from. I have not come of My own accord, but He who sent Me is true. You do not know Him,
ekegusii: Erio Yeso agaaka eriogi riaye ase Hekalu ime, okworokereria, okobora, “Inche momanyete, na aase narure mwaamanyire, naende tinyerenteti inche omonyene, korende ere oyontomete noyo bw’ekeene, oyio motamanyeti inwe.
swahili: Ndipo Yesu, akaendelea kufundisha Hekaluni, akisema, “Ninyi mnanifahamu na kujua nitokako. Mimi sikuja kwa ajili yangu mwenyewe, bali yeye aliyenituma ni wa kweli na ninyi hammjui.

english: but I know Him, because I am from Him and He sent Me.”
ekegusii: Korende inche nimomanyete, ekiagera naruete asare, nere ontomire.”
swahili: Mimi namjua kwa kuwa nimetoka kwake, naye ndiye alinituma.”

english: So Jesus’ brothers said to Him, “Leave here and go to Judea, so that Your disciples there may see the works You are doing.
ekegusii: Bamura bamwabo bakamoteebia, “Imoka korwa aiga, ogende Boyahudi, erinde aborokigwa bao banyare korora emeremo yao ogokora.
swahili: Hivyo ndugu zake Yesu wakamwambia, “Ondoka hapa uende Uyahudi ili wanafunzi Wako wapate kuona miujiza unayofanya.

english: So they tried to seize Him, but no one laid a hand on Him, because His hour had not yet come.
ekegusii: Igo bakarigia komobwata, korende onde tari oramborete okoboko kwaye, erinde amobwate, ekiagera ensa yaye konya teraika.
swahili: Ndipo wakatafuta kumkamata, lakini hakuna mtu yeyote aliyethubutu kumshika kwa sababu saa yake ilikuwa bado haijawadia.

english: Many in the crowd, however, believed in Him and said, “When the Christ comes, will He perform more signs than this man?”
ekegusii: Abanto abange ase omoganda bakamwegena, bakaboora, “Inee! Kristo ekero arachiche nakore ebikone ebinge mono kobua ebi iga oyo akorire?”
swahili: Nao watu wengi wakamwamini, wakasema, “Je, Kristo atakapokuja, atafanya miujiza mikuu zaidi kuliko aliyoifanya mtu huyu?” Walinzi Wanatumwa Kumkamata Yesu

english: When the Pharisees heard the crowd whispering these things about Jesus, they and the chief priests sent officers to arrest Him.
ekegusii: Abafarisai bakaigwa omoganda okwemurungania igoro yaye. Erio abakuani abanene na Abafarisai bagatoma abarendi erinde bamobwate.
swahili: Mafarisayo wakasikia watu wakinongʼona mambo kama hayo kuhusu Yesu, ndipo wao pamoja na viongozi wa makuhani wakatuma walinzi wa Hekalu waende kumkamata.

english: So Jesus said, “I am with you only a little while longer, and then I am going to the One who sent Me.
ekegusii: Erio Yeso akabora, “Nkere ekero egeke inde amo nainwe, erio ningende asare ere oyontomete.
swahili: Yesu akasema, “Mimi bado niko pamoja nanyi kwa kitambo kidogo, kisha nitarudi kwake yeye aliyenituma.

english: You will look for Me, but you will not find Me; and where I am, you cannot come.”
ekegusii: Namondigie, korende timokonyoora; na aase ndabe inche, timokonyara gochao.”
swahili: Mtanitafuta lakini hamtaniona, nami niliko ninyi hamwezi kuja.”

english: At this, the Jews said to one another, “Where does He intend to go that we will not find Him? Will He go where the Jews are dispersed among the Greeks, and teach the Greeks?
ekegusii: Nabo Abayahudi bagateebania barabwo ase barabwo, “Oyo ng’ai aragende goika intwe titomonyoora? Nigo aragende ase Abagiriki abwo abaatananekire na kworokereria Abagiriki abwo?
swahili: Wayahudi wakaulizana wao kwa wao, “Huyu mtu anataka kwenda wapi ambako hatuwezi kumfuata? Je, anataka kwenda kwa Wayunani ambako baadhi ya watu wetu wametawanyikia, akawafundishe Wayunani?

english: What does He mean by saying, ‘You will look for Me, but you will not find Me,’ and, ‘Where I am, you cannot come’?” Living Water
ekegusii: Ing’ana ki erio akwana: Namondigie, korende timokoonyora, na aase ndabe inche, timokonyara gochao?” Amache are moyo
swahili: Yeye ana maana gani anaposema, ‘Mtanitafuta lakini hamtaniona,’ na, ‘nami niliko ninyi hamwezi kuja’?” Mito Ya Maji Ya Uzima

english: On the last and greatest day of the feast, Jesus stood up and called out in a loud voice, “If anyone is thirsty, let him come to Me and drink.
ekegusii: Nase rituko ri’omoerio, Rituko riria Rinene, Yeso agatenena, agakwana neriogi rinene akabora, “Onye omonto ore nerang’o, tiga ache ase ’nde anywe!
swahili: Siku ile ya mwisho ya Sikukuu, siku ile kuu, wakati Yesu akiwa amesimama huko, akapaza sauti yake akasema, “Kama mtu yeyote anaona kiu na aje kwangu anywe.

english: Whoever believes in Me, as the Scripture has said: ‘Streams of living water will flow from within him.’”
ekegusii: Oyonyegenire inche, buna amariiko agoteeba, chindooche chi’amaache are moyo nachirue ase enkoro yaye.”
swahili: Yeyote aniaminiye mimi, kama Maandiko yasemavyo, vijito vya maji ya uzima vitatiririka ndani mwake.”

english: He was speaking about the Spirit, whom those who believed in Him were later to receive. For the Spirit had not yet been given, because Jesus had not yet been glorified. Division over Jesus
ekegusii: Ring’ana eri nigo arikwanete igoro y’Omoika, ekiagera baria bamwegenire nabayonyore magega, ekiagera Omoika Omochenu konya toraruegwa, ekiagera Yeso konya taraegwa obonene.
swahili: Yesu aliposema haya alimaanisha Roho Mtakatifu ambaye wote waliomwamini wangempokea, kwani mpaka wakati huo, Roho alikuwa hajatolewa, kwa kuwa Yesu alikuwa bado hajatukuzwa. Mgawanyiko Miongoni Mwa Watu

english: For no one who wants to be known publicly acts in secret. Since You are doing these things, show Yourself to the world.”
ekegusii: Naki monto onde tari ogokora ring’ana bobisi onye ere omonyene origetie komanyekana. Kogokora aya eorokie ase ense.”
swahili: Mtu anayetaka kujulikana hafanyi mambo yake kwa siri. Kama unafanya mambo haya, jionyeshe kwa ulimwengu.”

english: On hearing these words, some of the people said, “This is truly the Prophet.”
ekegusii: Nabo abanto bande ase omoganda bagachia koigwa amang’ana ayio, bakaboora, “Oyo ase ekeene nomobani oria.”
swahili: Waliposikia maneno hayo, baadhi ya watu miongoni mwa ule umati wakasema, “Hakika huyu ndiye yule Nabii.”

english: Others declared, “This is the Christ.” But still others asked, “How can the Christ come from Galilee?
ekegusii: Abande bakaboora, “Oyo nere Kristo.” Korende abande bakaboora, “Inee! Kristo nigo ararwe Galili?
swahili: Wengine wakasema, “Huyu ndiye Kristo!” Lakini wengine wakauliza, “Je, Kristo kwao ni Galilaya?

english: Doesn’t the Scripture say that the Christ will come from the line of David and from Bethlehem, the village where David lived? ”
ekegusii: Ririko tiriri goteeba ng’a Kristo nigo ararwe ase oroiboro rwa Daudi, naende ase Bethlehemu, agachie karia Daudi amenyete?”
swahili: Je, Maandiko hayasemi kwamba Kristo atakuja kutoka jamaa ya Daudi na kutoka Bethlehemu, mji alioishi Daudi?”

english: So there was division in the crowd because of Jesus.
ekegusii: Erio ogwatananekana kogasoa ase omoganda ase engencho yaye.
swahili: Kwa hiyo watu wakagawanyika kwa ajili ya Yesu.

english: Some of them wanted to seize Him, but no one laid a hand on Him. The Unbelief of the Jewish Leaders
ekegusii: Abande ase barabwo bakarigia komobwata; korende monto onde taramborete okoboko kwaye erinde amobwate.
swahili: Baadhi yao walitaka kumkamata, lakini hakuna aliyethubutu kumgusa. Kutokuamini Kwa Viongozi Wa Wayahudi

english: Then the officers returned to the chief priests and Pharisees, who asked them, “Why didn’t you bring Him in?”
ekegusii: Abarendi baria bakairana ase abakuani abanene na Abafarisai, na barabwo bakababoria, “Naki motamorenta?”
swahili: Hatimaye wale walinzi wa Hekalu wakarudi kwa viongozi wa makuhani na Mafarisayo waliokuwa wamewatuma ili kumkamata Yesu, wakaulizwa, “Mbona hamkumkamata?”

english: “Never has anyone spoken like this man!” the officers answered.
ekegusii: Abarendi baria bakairaneria, “Tana gokwana monto onde bwensi buna oyo agokwana!”
swahili: Wale walinzi wakajibu, “Kamwe hajanena mtu yeyote kama yeye anenavyo.”

english: “Have you also been deceived?” replied the Pharisees.
ekegusii: Erio Abafarisai bakabairaneria, Inee! Nainwe boigo mwatantanigwe?
swahili: Mafarisayo wakajibu, “Je, nanyi pia mmedanganyika?

english: “Have any of the rulers or Pharisees believed in Him?
ekegusii: Ning’o ase abanene baito omwegenire, gose ase Abafarisai?
swahili: Je, kuna kiongozi yeyote au mmoja wa Mafarisayo ambaye amemwamini?

english: But this crowd that does not know the law, they are under a curse.”
ekegusii: Korende omoganda oyio, otamanyeti amachiiko, oragererigwe.
swahili: Lakini huu umati wa watu wasiojua Sheria ya Mose, wamelaaniwa.”

english: For even His own brothers did not believe in Him.
ekegusii: Naki nonya mbamura bamwabo tibamwegenete.
swahili: Hata ndugu zake mwenyewe hawakumwamini.

english: Nicodemus, who had gone to Jesus earlier and who himself was one of them, asked,
ekegusii: Nikodemo, oria omochierete botuko, oyorenge oyomo ase bare, akababoria,
swahili: Ndipo Nikodemo, yule aliyekuwa amemwendea Yesu siku moja usiku, ambaye alikuwa mmoja wao akauliza,

english: “Does our law convict a man without first hearing from him to determine what he has done?”
ekegusii: “Inee! Ogochika gwaito nkonachera kore omonto ekiina ritang’ani totaramoigwa na komanya egiakora?”
swahili: “Je, sheria zetu zinaturuhusu kumhukumu mtu kabla ya kumsikiliza na kufahamu alilotenda?”

english: “Aren’t you also from Galilee?” they replied. “Look into it, and you will see that no prophet comes out of Galilee.”
ekegusii: Bakairaneria, “Inee! Naye boigo Galili kwarwa? Rigia, orore ng’a mobani takorwa Galili.” [
swahili: Wakamjibu, “Je, wewe pia unatoka Galilaya? Chunguza nawe utaona kwamba hakuna nabii atokae Galilaya!” [

english: Then each went to his own home.
ekegusii: Bakagenda kera omonto bwoye.
swahili: Kisha wakaondoka, kila mtu akarudi nyumbani kwake.

english: Therefore Jesus told them, “Although your time is always at hand, My time has not yet come.
ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Ekero kiane tikeraika, korende ekero kiaino botambe nkereo.
swahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Wakati wangu bado haujawadia, lakini wakati wenu upo siku zote.

english: The world cannot hate you, but it hates Me, because I testify that its works are evil.
ekegusii: Ense tekonyara kobagecha inwe, korende nigo engechete inche, ekiagera inche nkoyeorokia ng’a emeremo yaye nemebe.
swahili: Ulimwengu hauwezi kuwachukia ninyi, lakini unanichukia mimi kwa sababu ninawashuhudia kwamba matendo yao ni maovu.

english: Go up to the feast on your own. I am not going up to this feast, because My time has not yet come.”
ekegusii: Genda inwe abanyene ase rituko rinene; tindi gotiira gochia ase Rituko Rinene, ekiagera ekero kiane tikeraika.”
swahili: Ninyi nendeni kwenye Sikukuu, lakini mimi sitahudhuria Sikukuu hii kwa sababu wakati wangu haujawadia.”

english: Having said this, Jesus remained in Galilee.
ekegusii: Agachia gokoora kobateebia aya, agatigara Galili.
swahili: Akiisha kusema hayo, akabaki Galilaya. Yesu Kwenye Sikukuu Ya Vibanda

english: But Jesus went to the Mount of Olives.
ekegusii: Korende Yeso akagenda ase egetunwa ki’Emezeituni.
swahili: Lakini Yesu akaenda katika Mlima wa Mizeituni.

english: Then Jesus straightened up and asked her, “Woman, where are your accusers? Has no one condemned you?”
ekegusii: Yeso akagororoka tarora monto onde otatiga omokungu oria, akamobooria, “Omokungu, ng’ai abasoeri bao bare? Onde tari ogokogambia?”
swahili: Yesu akainuka na kumwambia, “Wako wapi wale waliokuwa wanakuhukumu kuwa mwenye hatia?”

english: “No one, Lord,” she answered. “Then neither do I condemn you,” Jesus declared. “Now go and sin no more.” Jesus the Light of the World (1 John 1:5–10)
ekegusii: Akamoiraneria, “Onde tari, Omonene.” Yeso akamoteebia, “Na inche tingokogambia. Genda, korende tokora ebibe naende.”] Omobaso bw’ense
swahili: Yule mwanamke akajibu, “Hakuna hata mmoja Bwana.” Yesu akamwambia, “Hata mimi sikuhukumu. Nenda zako, kuanzia sasa usitende dhambi tena.” ] Yesu Nuru Ya Ulimwengu

english: Once again, Jesus spoke to the people and said, “I am the light of the world. Whoever follows Me will never walk in the darkness, but will have the light of life.”
ekegusii: Yeso agakwana nabarabwo naende, akabora, “Inche nomobaso bw’ense; oyogontunyana takogenda ase omosunte, korende nabe nomobaso bw’obogima.”
swahili: Kisha Yesu akasema nao tena akawaambia, “Mimi ni nuru ya ulimwengu. Mtu yeyote akinifuata hatatembea gizani kamwe, bali atakuwa na nuru ya uzima.”

english: So the Pharisees said to Him, “You are testifying about Yourself; Your testimony is not valid.”
ekegusii: Erio Abafarisai bakamoteebia, “Aye nigo okwebera kirori omonyene, na oborori bwao tibori obw’ekeene.”
swahili: Mafarisayo wakamwambia, “Ushuhuda wako haukubaliki kwa kuwa unajishuhudia mwenyewe.”

english: Jesus replied, “Even if I testify about Myself, My testimony is valid, because I know where I came from and where I am going. But you do not know where I came from or where I am going.
ekegusii: Yeso akairaneria, “Nonya ngwekwana inche omonyene, oborori bwane nobw’ekeene, ekiagera namanyire aase narure, na aase nkogenda; korende inwe timomanyeti aase narure, gose aase ngochia.
swahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Hata kama najishuhudia mwenyewe, ushuhuda wangu ni kweli kwa sababu najua nilikotoka na ninakokwenda. Lakini ninyi hamjui nilikotoka wala ninakokwenda.

english: You judge according to the flesh; I judge no one.
ekegusii: Inwe nigo mokogambia ase okobwatia amang’ana a Mwanyabaanto; inche tindi kogambia omonto.
swahili: Ninyi mnahukumu kwa kufuata vipimo vya kibinadamu, mimi simhukumu mtu yeyote.

english: But even if I do judge, My judgment is true, because I am not alone; I am with the Father who sent Me.
ekegusii: Naende ninsa kogamba, okogamba kwane nogw’ekeene, ekiagera tari inche bweka nkogamba, korende ninche na Tata oyontomete.
swahili: Lakini hata kama nikihukumu, uamuzi wangu ni sahihi kwa sababu sitoi hukumu yangu peke yangu, bali niko pamoja na Baba, aliyenituma.

english: Even in your own Law it is written that the testimony of two men is valid.
ekegusii: Naende ase amachiiko aino nigo ariikire ng’a oborori bw’abaanto babere nobw’ekeene,
swahili: Imeandikwa katika Sheria yenu kwamba, ushahidi wa watu wawili ni thabiti.

english: I am One who testifies about Myself, and the Father, who sent Me, also testifies about Me.”
ekegusii: Inche ninche nkweorokia omonyene, nere Tata oyontomete nigo akong’orokia.”
swahili: Mimi najishuhudia mwenyewe, naye Baba aliyenituma hunishuhudia.”

english: “Where is Your Father?” they asked Him. “You do not know Me or My Father,” Jesus answered. “If you knew Me, you would know My Father as well.”
ekegusii: Erio bakamobooria, “Ng’ai Iso are?” Yeso akairaneria, “Timokomanya inche, nonya n’Tata timokomomanya, onye momanyete inche, anga mwamomanyire na Tata one.”
swahili: Ndipo wakamuuliza, “Huyo Baba yako yuko wapi?” Yesu akawajibu, “Ninyi hamnifahamu mimi ni nani, wala hammfahamu Baba yangu. Kama mngenifahamu mimi, mngemfahamu na Baba yangu.”

english: Early in the morning He went back into the temple courts. All the people came to Him, and He sat down to teach them.
ekegusii: Mambia chuni agasoa naende Hekalu ime. Abanto bonsi bakamochiera, na ere agaikaransa, akaborokereria.
swahili: Alfajiri na mapema Yesu akaja tena Hekaluni, watu wote wakakusanyika, akakaa akaanza kuwafundisha.

english: He spoke these words while teaching in the temple courts, near the treasury. Yet no one seized Him, because His hour had not yet come.
ekegusii: Amang’ana aya Yeso nigo ayakwanete, gakworokereria ase Hekalu, ase enyomba y’ekebekerero gi’esadaka; omonto tari omobwatete, ekiagera ensa yaye konya teraika. Ekiina kegochia komonyoora Yeso
swahili: Yesu alisema maneno haya alipokuwa akifundisha katika chumba cha hazina Hekaluni. Lakini hakuna mtu aliyemkamata kwa kuwa saa yake ilikuwa haijawadia. Yesu Atabiri Kifo Chake Mwenyewe

english: Again He said to them, “I am going away, and you will look for Me, but you will die in your sin. Where I am going, you cannot come.”
ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia naende, “Inche nkogenda nde, na inwe namondigie, namokwe ase ebibe biaino; aase nkogenda inche, timokonyara gochao.”
swahili: Yesu akawaambia tena, “Ninaenda zangu, nanyi mtanitafuta, lakini mtakufa katika dhambi zenu. Niendako mimi ninyi hamwezi kuja.”

english: So the Jews began to ask, “Will He kill Himself, since He says, ‘Where I am going, you cannot come’?”
ekegusii: Abayahudi bakaboora, “Inee! Nigo areite, ekiagera akobora: Aase nkogenda inche, timokonyara gochao?”
swahili: Ndipo wale Wayahudi wakasema, “Je, atajiua? Je, hii ndiyo sababu amesema, ‘Niendako mimi ninyi hamwezi kuja’?”

english: Then He told them, “You are from below; I am from above. You are of this world; I am not of this world.
ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Inwe naba inse; inche noyo o igoro; inwe nab’ense eye; inche tindi oyo bw’ense eye.
swahili: Akawaambia, “Ninyi mmetoka chini, mimi nimetoka juu. Ninyi ni wa ulimwengu huu, mimi si wa ulimwengu huu.

english: That is why I told you that you would die in your sins. For unless you believe that I am He, you will die in your sins.”
ekegusii: Ase ayio nabateebia ng’a namokwe ase ebibe biaino. Onye timokwegena ng’a inche nere, namokwe ase ebibe biaino.”
swahili: Niliwaambia kuwa mtakufa katika dhambi zenu, kwa maana msipoamini ya kwamba ‘Mimi Ndiye,’ mtakufa katika dhambi zenu.”

english: “Who are You?” they asked. “Just what I have been telling you from the beginning,” Jesus replied.
ekegusii: Nabo bakamobooria, “Naye ng’o?” Yeso akabairaneria, “Nonya nayio nabateebirie inwe korwa omochakano.
swahili: Wakamuuliza, “Wewe ni nani?” Naye Yesu akawajibu, “Mimi ndiye yule ambaye nimekuwa nikiwaambia tangu mwanzo.

english: “I have much to say about you and much to judge. But the One who sent Me is truthful, and what I have heard from Him, I tell the world.”
ekegusii: Ninde namange ngokwana na kogamba ase engencho yaino, korende ere oyontomete noyo bw’ekeene; na inche aya naigwete korwa asare, naro nkoorokia ase ense.”
swahili: Nina mambo mengi ya kusema juu yenu na mengi ya kuwahukumu. Lakini yeye aliyenituma ni wa kweli, nami nanena na ulimwengu niliyoyasikia kutoka kwake.”

english: They did not understand that He was telling them about the Father.
ekegusii: Tibamanya ng’a nigo are gokwana ase bare aya Ise.
swahili: Hawakuelewa kuwa alikuwa akiwaambia juu ya Baba yake wa Mbinguni.

english: So Jesus said, “When you have lifted up the Son of Man, then you will know that I am He, and that I do nothing on My own, but speak exactly what the Father has taught Me.
ekegusii: Erio Yeso akabateebia, “Ekero mwakoorire koimokereria igoro Omwana‐o‐mwanya banto, erio namomanye ng’a ninche ere, naende tindi gokora kende ase okobua kwane omonyene, korende buna Tata anyorokereretie, nabo ngokwana.
