swahili: Kisha Yesu akawaambia, “Mtakapokwisha kumwinua juu Mwana wa Adamu, ndipo mtakapojua kuwa, ‘Mimi ndiye yule niliyesema na kwamba mimi sitendi jambo lolote peke yangu bali ninasema yale tu ambayo Baba yangu amenifundisha.

english: He who sent Me is with Me. He has not left Me alone, because I always do what pleases Him.” The Truth Will Set You Free (2 John 1:4–6)
ekegusii: Ere oyontomete nigo are amo nainche, tantigeti inche bweka, ekiagera botambe nigo ngokora ayakomogwenera.”
swahili: Yeye aliyenituma yu pamoja nami, hajaniacha, kwa kuwa siku zote nafanya mapenzi yake.’ ”

english: The scribes and Pharisees, however, brought to Him a woman caught in adultery. They made her stand before them
ekegusii: Aborokia b’amariiko na Abafarisai bakarenta omokungu obwatetwe ase obotomani. Kabamobekire gati‐gati,
swahili: Walimu wa sheria na Mafarisayo wakamleta mwanamke mmoja aliyefumaniwa akizini. Wakamsimamisha katikati ya umati wa watu wote.

english: As Jesus spoke these things, many believed in Him.
ekegusii: Gakwanire aya, abange bakamwegena. Okoengererania n’Abayahudi
swahili: Wengi waliomsikia Yesu akisema maneno haya wakamwamini. Wanafunzi Wa Kweli

english: So He said to the Jews who had believed Him, “If you continue in My word, you are truly My disciples.
ekegusii: Nabo Yeso agateebia Abayahudi baria bamwegenete, “Komoramenye ase ring’ana riane, nigo more aborokigwa baane b’ekeene,
swahili: Kisha Yesu akawaambia wale Wayahudi waliomwamini, “Kama mkidumu katika maneno yangu, mtakuwa wanafunzi wangu kweli kweli.

english: Then you will know the truth, and the truth will set you free.”
ekegusii: naende namomanye ekeene, na kerokio nakebasibore.”
swahili: Ndipo mtaijua kweli nayo kweli itawaweka huru.”

english: “We are Abraham’s descendants,” they answered. “We have never been slaves to anyone. How can You say we will be set free?”
ekegusii: Bakamoiraneria, “Igo tore oroiboro rwa Aburaamu, na titoraba abasomba b’omonto kero kende gionsi, inaki rende ogoteeba: Namokorwe abasibore?”
swahili: Wao wakamjibu, “Sisi tu wazao wa Abrahamu, nasi hatujawa watumwa wa mtu yeyote. Wawezaje kusema kwamba tutawekwa huru?”

english: Jesus replied, “Truly, truly, I tell you, everyone who sins is a slave to sin.
ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, “Ekeene, ekeene, nabateebirie: Onde bwensi ogokora ebibe, oyio nomosomba bw’ebibe,
swahili: Yesu akajibu, “Amin, amin nawaambia, kila atendaye dhambi ni mtumwa wa dhambi.

english: A slave is not a permanent member of the family, but a son belongs to it forever.
ekegusii: naende omosomba tari komenya nyomba botambe, korende omobiare nigo akomenya botambe.
swahili: Mtumwa hakai nyumbani anakotumika siku zote, lakini mwana hukaa nyumbani daima.

english: So if the Son sets you free, you will be free indeed.
ekegusii: Gaki Omwana karabasibore, namobe abasibore kegima.
swahili: Hivyo Mwana akiwaweka huru mtakuwa huru kweli kweli.

english: I know you are Abraham’s descendants, but you are trying to kill Me because My word has no place within you.
ekegusii: Namanyire ng’a nigo more oroiboro rwa Aburaamu; korende nigo mokorigia kong’ita, ekiagera ring’ana riane tirinyoreti ibaga ime yaino.
swahili: Ninajua ya kuwa ninyi ni wazao wa Abrahamu, lakini mnatafuta wasaa wa kuniua kwa sababu ndani yenu hamna nafasi ya neno langu.

english: I speak of what I have seen in the presence of the Father, and you do what you have heard from your father.”
ekegusii: Aya narorire ase Tata naro ngokwana; nainwe naboigo ayamwarorire ase iso oino, naro mogokora.”
swahili: Ninasema yale niliyoyaona mbele za Baba yangu, nanyi inawapa kufanya yale mliyosikia kutoka kwa baba yenu.” Yesu Na Abrahamu

english: “Abraham is our father,” they replied. “If you were children of Abraham,” said Jesus, “you would do the works of Abraham.
ekegusii: Bakamoiraneria, “Tata oito nere Aburaamu.” Yeso akabateebia, “Onye nabana ba Aburaamu mware, anga mwakora emeremo ya Aburaamu.
swahili: Wakajibu, “Baba yetu ni Abrahamu.” Yesu akawaambia, “Kama mngekuwa wazao wa Abrahamu mngefanya mambo yale aliyofanya Abrahamu.

english: and said, “Teacher, this woman was caught in the act of adultery.
ekegusii: bakamoteebia, “Omworokia, omokungu oyo nigo abwatwa kagokora obotomani.
swahili: Wakamwambia Yesu, “Mwalimu, huyu mwanamke amekutwa akizini.

english: But now you are trying to kill Me, a man who has told you the truth that I heard from God. Abraham never did such a thing.
ekegusii: Korende bono morigetie kong’ita, ninche oyo nabateebirie ekeene keria naigure korwa ase Nyasae. Aburaamu takorete igo.
swahili: Lakini sasa ninyi mnatafuta kuniua, mtu ambaye nimewaambia kweli ile niliyosikia kutoka kwa Mungu, Abrahamu hakufanya jambo la namna hii.

english: You are doing the works of your father.” “We are not illegitimate children,” they declared. “Our only Father is God Himself.”
ekegusii: Inwe nigo mogokora emeremo ya iso oino.” Bakamoteebia, “Intwe titoiboiri ase obonyaka; nigo tore na Tata oyomo, nere Nyasae.”
swahili: Ninyi mnafanya mambo afanyayo baba yenu.” Wakamjibu, “Sisi hatukuzaliwa kwa uzinzi. Tunaye Baba mmoja, Mungu pekee.”

english: Jesus said to them, “If God were your Father, you would love Me, for I have come here from God. I have not come on My own, but He sent Me.
ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Onye Nyasae n’Iso oino are, anga imonyanchete inche; naki narure ase Nyasae, na igo nachire; gose tinyerenteti inche omonyene, korende nere ontomire.
swahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Kama Mungu angekuwa Baba yenu, mngenipenda, kwa maana nilitoka kwa Mungu na sasa niko hapa. Sikuja kwa ajili yangu mwenyewe, ila yeye alinituma.

english: Why do you not understand what I am saying? It is because you are unable to accept My message.
ekegusii: Naki motamanyeti amang’ana aane aya ngokwana? Nekiagera motancheti koigwa ring’ana riane.
swahili: Kwa nini hamwelewi ninayowaambia? Ni kwa sababu hamwezi kusikia nisemacho.

english: You belong to your father, the devil, and you want to carry out his desires. He was a murderer from the beginning, refusing to uphold the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he lies, he speaks his native language, because he is a liar and the father of lies.
ekegusii: Inwe n’aba iso oino Saitani, na ogwancha kwaino nogokora okogania gwa iso. Ere nigo arenge omoiti korwa omochakano, gose tatenenete ase ekeene, ekiagera ekeene tikeri ime yaye. Kagokwana oborimo, nigo agokwana ayare ayaye omonyene, ekiagera nomonyaborimo, na ise bw’oborimo.
swahili: Ninyi ni watoto wa baba yenu ibilisi, nanyi mnataka kutimiza matakwa ya baba yenu. Yeye alikuwa muuaji tangu mwanzo, wala hakushikana na kweli maana hamna kweli ndani yake. Asemapo uongo husema yaliyo yake mwenyewe kwa maana yeye ni mwongo na baba wa huo uongo.

english: But because I speak the truth, you do not believe Me!
ekegusii: Ekiagera inche ngokwana ekeene, timori konyegena.
swahili: Lakini kwa sababu nimewaambia kweli hamkuniamini!

english: Which of you can prove Me guilty of sin? If I speak the truth, why do you not believe Me?
ekegusii: Ning’o ase egati yaino okong’orokia ng’a ninde nebibe? Kongokwana ekeene, naki inwe motakonyegena?
swahili: Je, kuna yeyote miongoni mwenu awezaye kunithibitisha kuwa mwenye dhambi? Kama nawaambia yaliyo kweli, mbona hamniamini?

english: Whoever belongs to God hears the words of God. The reason you do not hear is that you do not belong to God.” Before Abraham Was Born, I Am
ekegusii: Oyore o Nyasae nigo akoigwa amang’ana a Nyasae; nakio gekogera inwe motari koyaigwa: nekiagera motari aba Nyasae.”
swahili: Yeye atokaye kwa Mungu husikia kile Mungu asemacho. Sababu ya ninyi kutosikia ni kwa kuwa hamtokani na Mungu.” Maelezo Ya Yesu Kuhusu Yeye Mwenyewe

english: The Jews answered Him, “Are we not right to say that You are a Samaritan and You have a demon?”
ekegusii: Abayahudi bakamoiraneria, “Titori gokwana boronge ng’a aye nigo ore Omosamaria, naende nigo obwatire nekerecha?”
swahili: Wayahudi wakamjibu Yesu, “Je, hatuko sahihi tunaposema ya kwamba wewe ni Msamaria na ya kwamba una pepo mchafu?”

english: “I do not have a demon,” Jesus replied, “but I honor My Father, and you dishonor Me.
ekegusii: Yeso akairaneria, “Inche timbwatiri nekerecha, korende nigo nsigete Tata one, na inwe timonsigeti.
swahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Mimi sina pepo mchafu, bali ninamheshimu Baba yangu, nanyi mnanidharau.

english: In the Law Moses commanded us to stone such a woman. So what do You say?”
ekegusii: Nabo ase amachiiko Musa atochigeete kobaaka amagena abakungu banga buna oyo, naki aye ogoteeba igoro asare?”
swahili: Katika sheria, Mose alituamuru kuwapiga kwa mawe wanawake wa namna hii, mpaka wafe. Sasa wewe wasemaje?”

english: I do not seek My own glory. There is One who seeks it, and He is the Judge.
ekegusii: Inche tindi korigia obonene bwane; nare oyomo oyokoborigia, nere orabe omogambi.
swahili: Lakini mimi sitafuti utukufu wangu mwenyewe, bali yuko anayetaka kunitukuza, naye ndiye mwamuzi.

english: Truly, truly, I tell you, if anyone keeps My word, he will never see death.”
ekegusii: Ekeene, ekeene, nabateebirie: Omonto karabwate ring’ana riane, takorora amakweri nonya ng’ake.”
swahili: Amin, amin nawaambia, mtu yeyote akilitii neno langu hataona mauti milele.”

english: “Now we know that You have a demon!” declared the Jews. “Abraham died, and so did the prophets, yet You say that anyone who keeps Your word will never taste death.
ekegusii: Nabo Abayahudi bakamoteebia, “Bono twamanyire ng’a nigo obwatire nekerecha, Aburaamu okuure, na ababani, na aye nigo ogoteeba: Omonto karabwate ring’ana riane, takoigwa amakweri nonya ng’ake.
swahili: Ndipo Wayahudi wakamwambia, “Sasa tumejua kwamba una pepo mchafu. Ikiwa Abrahamu alikufa na vivyo hivyo manabii, nawe unasema ‘Mtu akitii neno langu hatakufa milele.’

english: Are You greater than our father Abraham? He died, as did the prophets. Who do You claim to be?”
ekegusii: Aye nomonene kobua sokoro yaito Aburaamu, oyo okuure? Naende nababani bakuure. Naye kogwekora obe ng’o?”
swahili: Je, wewe ni mkuu kuliko baba yetu Abrahamu ambaye alikufa na manabii ambao nao pia walikufa? Hivi wewe unajifanya kuwa nani?”

english: Jesus answered, “If I glorify Myself, My glory means nothing. The One who glorifies Me is My Father, of whom you say ‘He is our God.’
ekegusii: Yeso akairaneria, “Kondetogie inche omonyene, obonene bwane tibori gento; oyogontogia n’Tata one, oyo mogoteeba ng’a nere Nyasae oino.
swahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Kama nikijitukuza utukufu wangu hauna maana. Baba yangu, huyo ambaye ninyi mnadai kuwa ni Mungu wenu, ndiye anitukuzaye mimi.

english: You do not know Him, but I know Him. If I said I did not know Him, I would be a liar like you. But I do know Him, and I keep His word.
ekegusii: Na inwe timomanyeti, korende inche nimomanyete. Kondatebe ng’a timomanyeti nimbe omonyaborimo buna inwe, korende nimomanyete, naende ring’ana riaye nindibwatete.
swahili: Ingawa hamkumjua, mimi ninamjua. Kama ningesema simjui, ningekuwa mwongo kama ninyi, lakini mimi ninamjua na ninalitii neno lake.

english: Your father Abraham rejoiced that he would see My day. He saw it and was glad.”
ekegusii: Aburaamu sokoro yaino nigo agogete ng’a nanyare korora rituko riane; akarirora, akagoka.”
swahili: Baba yenu Abrahamu alishangilia kwamba angaliiona siku yangu, naye akaiona na akafurahi.”

english: Then the Jews said to Him, “You are not yet fifty years old, and You have seen Abraham?”
ekegusii: Erio Abayahudi bakamoteebia, “Torakoora emiaka emerongo etano, na Aburaamu kwamororire?”
swahili: Wayahudi wakamwambia, “Wewe hujatimiza hata miaka hamsini, wewe wasema umemwona Abrahamu?”

english: “Truly, truly, I tell you,” Jesus declared, “before Abraham was born, I am! ”
ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Ekeene, ekeene, nabateebirie: Ritang’ani Aburaamu atarabao, inche nao naare.”
swahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Amin, amin nawaambia, kabla Abrahamu hajakuwako, ‘Mimi niko.’ ”

english: At this, they picked up stones to throw at Him. But Jesus was hidden and went out of the temple area.
ekegusii: Erio bakaimokia amagena bamorute, korende Yeso akebisa, agasoka korwa ase Hekalu.
swahili: Ndipo wakaokota mawe ili kumpiga, lakini Yesu akajificha, naye akatoka Hekaluni.

english: They said this to test Him, in order to have a basis for accusing Him. But Jesus bent down and began to write on the ground with His finger.
ekegusii: Bagateeba ring’ana eri ase okomoteema, banyore enchera bakomosoera. Korende Yeso agekumba, akarika nekiara kiaye inse.
swahili: Walimuuliza swali hili kama mtego ili wapate sababu ya kumshtaki. Lakini Yesu akainama akaanza kuandika ardhini kwa kidole chake.

english: When they continued to question Him, He straightened up and said to them, “Let him who is without sin among you be the first to cast a stone at her.”
ekegusii: Barabwo kobamentire komoboria, akagororoka, akabateebia, “Ere oyotari nebibe ase egati yaino abe oyo bw’eritang’ani komoruta rigena.”
swahili: Walipoendelea kumuulizauliza akainuka, akawaambia, “Kama kuna mtu yeyote miongoni mwenu ambaye hana dhambi na awe wa kwanza kumtupia jiwe.”

english: And again He bent down and wrote on the ground.
ekegusii: Agekumba naende, akarika nekiara kiaye inse.
swahili: Akainama tena na kuandika ardhini.

english: When they heard this, they began to go away one by one, beginning with the older ones, until only Jesus was left, with the woman standing there.
ekegusii: Barabwo bagachia koyaigwa, bagasoka oyomo ase oyomo, abagaaka nabwo bachaagete. Yeso bweka agatigara, na omokungu oria oteneine gati‐gati.
swahili: Waliposikia haya, wakaanza kuondoka mmoja mmoja, wakianzia wazee, hadi Yesu akabaki peke yake na yule mwanamke akiwa amesimama mbele yake.

english: Now as Jesus was passing by, He saw a man blind from birth,
ekegusii: Yeso agachia goeta akarora omonto orenge omouko korwa okoiborwa kwaye.
swahili: Yesu alipokuwa akipita, akamwona mtu aliyekuwa kipofu tangu kuzaliwa.

english: “How then were your eyes opened?” they asked.
ekegusii: Nabo bakamobooria, “Amaiso ao naki rende aramogetigwe?”
swahili: Wakamuuliza, “Basi macho yako yalifumbuliwaje?”

english: He answered, “The man they call Jesus made some mud and anointed my eyes, and He told me to go to Siloam and wash. So I went and washed and received my sight.”
ekegusii: Ere akairaneria, “Omonto okorokwa Yeso okorete etintira, akang’aka amaiso aane, aganteebia: Genda ase ritibo ria Siloamuu, bwesibie; nabo nkagenda ngesibia, nkanyara korora.”
swahili: Yeye akawajibu, “Yule mtu aitwaye Yesu alitengeneza tope, akanipaka machoni mwangu, naye akaniambia nenda ukanawe katika Bwawa la Siloamu, ndipo nikanawa nami nikapata kuona!”

english: “Where is He?” they asked. “I do not know,” he answered. The Pharisees Investigate the Healing
ekegusii: Bakamobooria, “Ng’ai are oyio?” Akabora, “Timanyeti.”
swahili: Wale wakamuuliza, “Yeye huyo mtu yuko wapi?” Akawajibu, “Sijui.” Mafarisayo Wachunguza Kuponywa Kwa Kipofu

english: They brought to the Pharisees the man who had been blind.
ekegusii: Bakamoira oria orenge omouko ritang’ani ase Abafarisai.
swahili: Wakamleta kwa Mafarisayo yule mtu aliyekuwa kipofu hapo awali.

english: Now the day on which Jesus had made the mud and opened his eyes was a Sabbath.
ekegusii: Nigo riarenge rituko ri’Esabato ekero Yeso akorete etintira na komoramokia amaiso.
swahili: Basi siku hiyo Yesu alipotengeneza tope na kuyafungua macho ya huyo mtu ilikuwa Sabato.

english: So the Pharisees also asked him how he had received his sight. The man answered, “He put mud on my eyes, and I washed, and now I can see.”
ekegusii: Erio Abafarisai nabarabwo bakamobooria naende buna anyorete okorora. Akabateebia, “Nigo abegete etintira igoro ase amaiso aane, ngesibia, na bono nkorora nde.”
swahili: Mafarisayo nao wakaanza kumuuliza alivyopata kuponywa. Naye akawaambia, “Alinipaka tope kwenye macho yangu, nikanawa na sasa ninaona.”

english: Because of this, some of the Pharisees said, “This man is not from God, for He does not keep the Sabbath.” But others said, “How can a sinful man perform such signs?” And there was division among them.
ekegusii: Erio abande b’Abafarisai bakaboora, “Omonto oyo tarwete ase Nyasae, ekiagera tabwateti Esabato.” Abande bakaboora, “Naki omonto omonyene ebibe aranyare gokora ebikone buna ebi?” Ogwatananekana gokaba ase egati yabo.
swahili: Baadhi ya Mafarisayo wakasema, “Huyu mtu hatoki kwa Mungu, kwa sababu hashiki Sabato.” Lakini wengine wakasema, “Awezaje mtu mwenye dhambi kufanya miujiza kama hii?” Wakagawanyika.

english: So once again they asked the man who had been blind, “What do you say about Him, since it was your eyes He opened?” “He is a prophet,” the man replied.
ekegusii: Bakaboria omouko oria eria kabere, “Aye naki okobora asare, ekiagera akoramokia amaiso?” Akabora, “Nigo are omobani.”
swahili: Hivyo wakamwambia tena yule mtu aliyekuwa kipofu, “Wewe ndiwe uliyefumbuliwa macho, wasemaje kuhusu mtu huyo?” Maana macho yako ndiyo yaliyofumbuliwa. Yeye akawajibu, “Yeye ni nabii.”

english: The Jews still did not believe that the man had been blind and had received his sight until they summoned his parents
ekegusii: Erio Abayahudi tibeegena amang’ana aye, ng’a nigo arenge omouko, naende anyarete korora, goika bakarangeria abaibori baye oria onyorete okorora,
swahili: Wale Wayahudi hawakuamini ya kuwa mtu huyo alikuwa kipofu, akapata kuona, mpaka walipowaita wazazi wake.

english: and asked, “Is this your son, the one you say was born blind? So how is it that he can now see?”
ekegusii: bakababoria, “Oyo nere omwana oino mogoteeba ng’a nigo aiboretwe ore omouko? Naki akora orora bono?”
swahili: Wakawauliza, “Je, huyu ni mtoto wenu, ambaye mnasema alizaliwa kipofu? Imekuwaje basi sasa anaona?”

english: and His disciples asked Him, “Rabbi, who sinned, this man or his parents, that he was born blind?”
ekegusii: Aborokigwa baye bakamobooria, “Rabii, ning’o okorete ebibe, nomonto oyo, gose nabaibori baye, goika akaiborwa ore omouko?”
swahili: Wanafunzi wake wakamuuliza, “Rabi, ni nani aliyetenda dhambi, ni huyu mtu au wazazi wake hata azaliwe kipofu?”

english: His parents answered, “We know he is our son, and we know he was born blind.
ekegusii: Abaibori baye bakairaneria, “Twamanyire ng’a oyo nomwana oito, naende ng’a nigo aiboretwe ore omouko;
swahili: Wazazi wake wakajibu, “Tunajua ya kuwa huyu ni mtoto wetu na ya kuwa alizaliwa kipofu.

english: But how he can now see or who opened his eyes, we do not know. Ask him. He is old enough to speak for himself.”
ekegusii: korende buna anyara korora bono, titomanyeti, gose ning’o omoramokia amaiso, titomanyeti. Ere nomonto omogima, moborie omonyene, nekwanere.”
swahili: Lakini sisi hatujui ni kwa jinsi gani kwamba sasa anaona, wala hatujui ni nani aliyemfungua macho yake. Muulizeni, yeye ni mtu mzima na anaweza kujieleza mwenyewe.”

english: His parents said this because they were afraid of the Jews. For the Jews had already determined that anyone who confessed Jesus as the Christ would be put out of the synagogue.
ekegusii: Abaibori baye nigo bakwanete aya ase okoiroka Abayahudi, ekiagera Abayahudi konya babwatanire, ng’a monto onde bwensi oramoorokie ng’a nere Kristo aserigwe korwa ase esinagogi.
swahili: Wazazi wake walisema hivi kwa sababu waliwaogopa Wayahudi kwani walikuwa wamekubaliana kuwa mtu yeyote atakayemkiri Yesu kuwa ndiye Kristo atafukuzwa kutoka sinagogi.

english: That was why his parents said, “He is old enough. Ask him.”
ekegusii: Nero engencho yagerete abaibori baye bakaboora, “Ere nomonto omogima, moborie.”
swahili: Kwa hiyo wazazi wake wakasema, “Yeye ni mtu mzima. Muulizeni.”

english: So a second time they called for the man who had been blind and said, “Give glory to God! We know that this man is a sinner.”
ekegusii: Erio eria kabere bakarangeria omonto oria orenge omouko, bakamoteebia, “Moe Nyasae ogotogia; intwe twamanyire ng’a omonto oyio nomonyene ebibe.”
swahili: Hivyo kwa mara ya pili wakamwita yule aliyekuwa kipofu, nao wakamwambia, “Mpe Mungu utukufu! Sisi tunafahamu kuwa mtu huyu aliyekuponya ni mwenye dhambi.”

english: He answered, “Whether He is a sinner I do not know. There is one thing I do know: I was blind, but now I see!”
ekegusii: Erio omonto oria akairaneria, “Onye ere nomonyene ebibe, timanyeti; ring’ana erimo namanyire, inche nigo narenge omouko, korende bono nkorora nde.”
swahili: Akawajibu, “Mimi sijui kama yeye ni mwenye dhambi. Lakini jambo moja ninalojua, nilikuwa kipofu na sasa ninaona.”

english: “What did He do to you?” they asked. “How did He open your eyes?”
ekegusii: Bakamobooria, “Naki agokorerete? Naki akoramogetie amaiso?”
swahili: Wakamuuliza, “Alikufanyia nini? Aliyafumbuaje macho yako?”

english: He replied, “I already told you, and you did not listen. Why do you want to hear it again? Do you also want to become His disciples?”
ekegusii: Akabairaneria, “Naikire kobateebia, ko timontegerereti. Naki morigetie koyaigwa eria kabere? Inwe boigo morigetie koba aborokigwa baye?”
swahili: Akawajibu, “Tayari nimekwisha kuwaambia, nanyi hamtaki kunisikiliza. Mbona mnataka kusikia tena? Je, ninyi nanyi mnataka kuwa wanafunzi wake?”

english: Then they heaped insults on him and said, “You are His disciple; we are disciples of Moses.
ekegusii: Erio bakamorama, bakaboora, “Naye ore omworokigwa oye, korerende intwe nigo tore aborokigwa ba Musa.
swahili: Ndipo wakamtukana na kusema, “Wewe ndiwe mwanafunzi wake, Sisi ni wanafunzi wa Mose.

english: We know that God spoke to Moses, but we do not know where this man is from.”
ekegusii: Intwe twamanyire ng’a Nyasae nigo arenge gokwana na Musa, korende oyo titomanyeti aase arure.”
swahili: Tunajua kwamba Mungu alisema na Mose, lakini kwa habari ya mtu huyu hatujui atokako.”

english: Jesus answered, “Neither this man nor his parents sinned, but this happened so that the works of God would be displayed in him.
ekegusii: Yeso akairaneria, “Oyo takorete ebibe, nonya nabaibori baye, korende aya akorekire, erinde emeremo ya Nyasae eorokigwe asare.
swahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Huyu mtu wala wazazi wake hawakutenda dhambi. Alizaliwa kipofu ili kazi za Mungu zidhihirishwe katika maisha yake.

english: “That is remarkable indeed!” the man said. “You do not know where He is from, and yet He opened my eyes.
ekegusii: Omonto oria akairaneria, “Ring’ana eri neri’ogokumia, ng’a inwe timomanyeti aase arure, na ere ondamokirie amaiso.
swahili: Yule mtu akawajibu, “Hili ni jambo la ajabu! Hamjui anakotoka, naye amenifungua macho yangu!

english: We know that God does not listen to sinners, but He does listen to the one who worships Him and does His will.
ekegusii: Twamanyire ng’a Nyasae tari koigwa abanyene ebibe; korende omonto karabe omosasimi Nyasae, na gokora ogwancha kwaye, oyio nere Nyasae akoigwa.
swahili: Tunajua ya kuwa Mungu hawasikilizi wenye dhambi, lakini huwasikiliza wote wanaomcha na kumtii.

english: Never before has anyone heard of opening the eyes of a man born blind.
ekegusii: Korwa omochakano teraigugwa ng’a omonto oramokirie amaiso ’omouko oiboretwe engencho eye.
swahili: Tangu zamani hatujasikia kwamba mtu amemponya yeyote aliyezaliwa kipofu.

english: If this man were not from God, He could do no such thing.”
ekegusii: Onye oyo tarwete ase Nyasae, anga takonyara gokora gento.”
swahili: Kama huyu mtu hakutoka kwa Mungu, asingeweza kufanya lolote.”

english: They replied, “You were born in utter sin, and you are instructing us?” And they threw him out. Spiritual Blindness
ekegusii: Bakamoiraneria, “Aye nigo kwaiboretwe ase ebibe ebinene, na intwe ngotworokereria ore?” Bakamosokia isiko.
swahili: Wao wakamjibu, “Wewe ulizaliwa katika dhambi kabisa, nawe unajaribu kutufundisha?” Wakamfukuza atoke nje. Upofu Wa Kiroho

english: When Jesus heard that they had thrown him out, He found the man and said, “Do you believe in the Son of Man?”
ekegusii: Yeso akaigwa ng’a bamosokirie isiko, akamorora, akamobooria, “Aye kwamwegenire Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto?”
swahili: Yesu aliposikia kuwa wamemfukuzia nje yule mtu aliyemfumbua macho, alimkuta akamuuliza, “Je, unamwamini Mwana wa Adamu?”

english: “Who is He, Sir?” he replied. “Tell me so that I may believe in Him.”
ekegusii: Ere akairaneria, “Ning’o oyio, Omonene, inyare komwegena?”
swahili: Yule mtu akamjibu, “Yeye ni nani, Bwana? Niambie ili nipate kumwamini.”

english: “You have already seen Him,” Jesus answered. “He is the One speaking with you.”
ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Kwamororire, naende nere oyogokwana naye nere oyio.”
swahili: Yesu akamjibu, “Umekwisha kumwona, naye anayezungumza nawe, ndiye.”

english: “Lord, I believe,” he said. And he worshiped Jesus.
ekegusii: Akabora, “Omonene, negenire”; akamosasiima.
swahili: Yule mtu akasema, “Bwana, naamini.” Naye akamwabudu.

english: Then Jesus declared, “For judgment I have come into this world, so that the blind may see and those who see may become blind.”
ekegusii: Yeso akabora, “Inche nigo nachire ase ense eye ase ekiina, erinde abatari korora barore, na barabwo abakorora babe emeuko.”
swahili: Yesu akasema, “Nimekuja ulimwenguni humu kwa ajili ya kuhukumu, ili wale walio vipofu wapate kuona, nao wale wanaoona, wawe vipofu.”

english: While it is daytime, we must do the works of Him who sent Me. Night is coming, when no one can work.
ekegusii: Netogwenerete tokore emeremo yaye oyontomete ekero rire mobaso; obotuko ngocha bore, omonto atanyare gokora emeremo.
swahili: Yanipasa kuzifanya kazi zake yeye aliyenituma wakati bado ni mchana, kwa kuwa usiku waja ambapo hakuna mtu awezaye kufanya kazi.

english: Some of the Pharisees who were with Him heard this, and they asked Him, “Are we blind too?”
ekegusii: Abande ase Abafarisai abarenge amo nere bakaigwa aya, bakamobooria, “Inee! Naintwe nigo tore emeuko?”
swahili: Baadhi ya Mafarisayo waliokuwa karibu naye wakamsikia na kumwambia, “Je, kweli sisi ni vipofu?”

english: “If you were blind,” Jesus replied, “you would not be guilty of sin. But since you claim you can see, your guilt remains.”
ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, “Onye mwarenge emeuko, anga timori nebibe; korende bono nigo mogoteeba: Nkorora tore; gaki ebibe biaino biagendereire kobao.
swahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Kama mngekuwa vipofu kweli, msingekuwa na hatia ya dhambi, lakini kwa kuwa mnasema, ‘Tunaona,’ basi mna hatia.

english: While I am in the world, I am the light of the world.”
ekegusii: Ekero inde ase ense, inche nomobaso bw’ense.”
swahili: Wakati niko ulimwenguni, mimi ni nuru ya ulimwengu.”

english: When Jesus had said this, He spit on the ground, made some mud, and applied it to the man’s eyes.
ekegusii: Agachia gokoora gokwana aya, agatwera amate inse, agakora etintira ase amate aria, agaaka omouko oria amaiso netintira eria,
swahili: Baada ya kusema haya, akatema mate ardhini, akatengeneza tope kwa mate na kumpaka yule mtu kipofu machoni.

english: Then He told him, “Go, wash in the Pool of Siloam” (which means “Sent”). So the man went and washed, and came back seeing.
ekegusii: akamoteebia, “Genda bwesibie ase ritibo ria Siloamuu” (okoonchorwa kwaye, oyotomirwe). Erio akagenda agesibia, akairana okorora.
swahili: Kisha akamwambia, “Nenda ukanawe katika bwawa la Siloamu.” (Siloamu maana yake ni aliyetumwa.) Ndipo yule kipofu akaenda, akanawa, naye akarudi akiwa anaona.

english: At this, his neighbors and those who had formerly seen him begging began to ask, “Isn’t this the man who used to sit and beg?”
ekegusii: Nabo abagisangio baye, na baria bamorooche ekero arenge omosabereri bakaboora, “Inee! Oyo tari ere oria orenge oikaransete gosaberera?”
swahili: Majirani zake na wale wote waliokuwa wamemwona hapo awali akiombaomba wakaanza kuuliza, “Je, huyu si yule aliyekuwa akiketi akiombaomba?”

english: Some claimed that he was, but others said, “No, he just looks like him.” But the man kept saying, “I am the one.”
ekegusii: Abande bakaboora, “Nere”; abande bakaboora, “Yaya, nigo agwekaine nere.” Ere omonyene akabora, “Ninche ere.”
swahili: Wengine wakasema, “Ndiye.” Wengine wakasema, “Siye, bali wamefanana.” Lakini yeye akawaambia, “Mimi ndiye.”

english: “I loathe my own life; I will express my complaint and speak in the bitterness of my soul.
ekegusii: “Omoyo one ogechire obogima bwane; nimbe nobosibore gokwana na kwemurungania, ninkwane nobororo bore ase omoyo one.
swahili: “Nayachukia sana haya maisha yangu; kwa hiyo nitatoa malalamiko yangu kwa wazi bila kujizuia, nami nitanena kutokana na uchungu wa moyo wangu.

english: Did You not pour me out like milk, and curdle me like cheese?
ekegusii: Inee! Tari aye kwang’umorete buna amabeere, na okambomba buna ekerimu kiabwatanire?
swahili: Je, wewe hukunimimina mimi kama maziwa, na kunigandisha kama jibini,

english: You clothed me with skin and flesh, and knit me together with bones and sinews.
ekegusii: Aye okaboyia omobere one risankwa okayobekera chinyama, okayobwatania namauga na emekia.
swahili: ukanivika ngozi na nyama, na kuniunga pamoja kwa mifupa na mishipa?

english: You have granted me life and loving devotion, and Your care has preserved my spirit.
ekegusii: Aye kwang’eire obogima na konyorokia obwanchani bwao botari koera; na oborendi bwao nigo borendete omoika one.
swahili: Umenipa uhai na kunitendea wema, katika uangalizi wako umeilinda roho yangu.

english: Yet You concealed these things in Your heart, and I know that this was in Your mind:
ekegusii: Nonya nabo nigo obisete amang’ana ayio ase enkoro yao, nimanyete ng’a oko nakwo kwarenge okogania kwao.
swahili: “Lakini hili ndilo ulilolificha moyoni mwako, nami ninajua kuwa hili lilikuwa katika nia yako:

english: If I sinned, You would take note, and would not acquit me of my iniquity.
ekegusii: Inse gokora ebibe, aye nigo ondigereretie, na totiga kong’a egesusuro ase engencho y’ebibe biane.
swahili: Kama nilifanya dhambi, ungekuwa umeniona, wala usingeacha kosa langu lipite bila kuadhibiwa.

english: If I am guilty, woe to me! And even if I am righteous, I cannot lift my head. I am full of shame and aware of my affliction.
ekegusii: Obobe nobwane onye inde omokori amabe; na onye inde omonyaboronge tinkonyara gwetogia; nigo ing’ichire nobosooku, ase ayio aye origererie emechando yane.
swahili: Kama nina hatia, ole wangu! Hata kama ningekuwa sina hatia, siwezi kukiinua kichwa changu, kwa kuwa nimejawa na aibu, na kuzama katika mateso yangu.

english: Should I hold my head high, You would hunt me like a lion, and again display Your power against me.
ekegusii: Kondaimokererie omotwe one igoro, aye nigo okondigia buna endo egotwara orotwari, erinde ogenderere koorokia amakumia ao igoro yane.
swahili: Kama nikiinua kichwa changu juu, unaninyatia kama simba, na kuonyesha tena uwezo wa kutisha dhidi yangu.

english: You produce new witnesses against me and multiply Your anger toward me. Hardships assault me in wave after wave.
ekegusii: Aye nigo okomenta oborori bwao igoro yane, na kwamentera ekeririanda igoro yane. Nigo okona‐kondetera ababisa bakondwania.
swahili: Wewe waleta mashahidi wapya dhidi yangu na kuzidisha hasira yako juu yangu; nazo nguvu zako zinanijia wimbi moja baada ya jingine.

english: Why then did You bring me from the womb? Oh, that I had died, and no eye had seen me!
ekegusii: “Nase ki kwandusetie ase enda ya baba? Naki anga yare koba buya onye nakwete ekero monto onde atarandora,
swahili: “Kwa nini basi ulinitoa tumboni? Ninatamani ningekufa kabla jicho lolote halijaniona.

english: If only I had never come to be, but had been carried from the womb to the grave.
ekegusii: imbe buna tinarengeo, anga nigo narusetigwe ase enda ya baba ntindekwe.
swahili: Laiti nisingekuwako kamwe, au ningekuwa nimechukuliwa moja kwa moja kutoka tumboni kwenda kaburini!

english: I will say to God: Do not condemn me! Let me know why You prosecute me.
ekegusii: Ninkwane, nteebie Nyasae: Tobaisa kongambia; imanyie egekogera aye okondwania iga.
swahili: Nitamwambia Mungu: Usinihukumu, bali niambie una mashtaka gani dhidi yangu.

english: Are my days not few? Withdraw from me, that I may have a little comfort,
ekegusii: Inee! Amatuko y’obogima bwane tari amake? Intige, imbe n’obotoereru ase engaki eye enke,
swahili: Je, siku zangu chache si zimekaribia kuisha? Niachie ili niweze kupata muda mfupi wa kufurahi

english: before I go—never to return— to a land of darkness and gloom,
ekegusii: ekero ntaragenda aase ntanyare koirana korwao rinde, ense eria y’omosunte ekerima na ey’ekiriri ki’amakweri,
swahili: kabla sijaenda mahali ambapo hakuna kurudi tena, katika nchi ya giza na uvuli wa mauti,

english: to a land of utter darkness, of deep shadow and disorder, where even the light is like darkness.”
ekegusii: ense emwamu ti buna omosunte ekerima; naende ey’ekiriri ki’amakweri na obotantanu, agwo oborabu bwaye bore obomwamu ti buna obw’obotuko gati.”
swahili: nchi ya giza kuu sana, yenye uvuli wa giza na machafuko, mahali ambapo hata nuru ni giza.”

english: Does it please You to oppress me, to reject the work of Your hands and favor the schemes of the wicked?
ekegusii: Inee! Nigo ogokirie ase ogonchanda na gochaaya emeremo y’amaboko ao, na gwanchera ogosemania kw’abakori amabe?
swahili: Je, inakupendeza wewe kunionea, kuikataa kwa dharau kazi ya mikono yako, huku wewe ukitabasamu juu ya mipango ya waovu?

english: Do You have eyes of flesh? Do You see as man sees?
ekegusii: Inee! Amaiso ao naya Mwanyabaanto are? Gose nigo okorora buna Mwanyabaanto akorora?
swahili: Je, wewe una macho ya kimwili? Je, wewe huona kama mwanadamu aonavyo?

english: Are Your days like those of a mortal, or Your years like those of a man,
ekegusii: Inee! Amatuko ao nabo ang’ana buna aya Mwanyabaanto, gose emiaka yao buna ey’omonto,
swahili: Je, siku zako ni kama zile za mwanadamu, au miaka yako ni kama ile ya mtu,

english: that You should seek my iniquity and search out my sin—
ekegusii: goika okona‐gotuka okomocha kwane na korigia ebibe biane?
swahili: ili kwamba utafute makosa yangu na kuichunguza dhambi yangu;

english: though You know that I am not guilty, and there is no deliverance from Your hand?
ekegusii: Nonya nabo nomanyete ng’a inche tindi nokomocha, na onde tari orantoorie korwa ase okoboko kwao?
swahili: ingawa wajua kuwa mimi sina hatia, na hakuna awezaye kunitoa mkononi mwako?

english: Your hands shaped me and altogether formed me. Would You now turn and destroy me?
ekegusii: “Amaboko ao naro ambombete, akandoisia; na bono kwang’onchokeire na gonsiria.
swahili: “Mikono yako ndiyo iliyoniumba na kunifanya. Je, sasa utageuka na kuniangamiza?

english: Please remember that You molded me like clay. Would You now return me to dust?
ekegusii: Inyora ng’a naye kwambombete buna esike. Inee! Nigo okong’irania imbe orotu naende?
swahili: Kumbuka kuwa ulinifinyanga kama udongo wa mfinyanzi. Je, sasa utanifanya kuwa mavumbi tena?

english: Then Zophar the Naamathite replied:
ekegusii: Erio Sofari Omonaama agakwana, akabora:
swahili: Ndipo Sofari Mnaamathi akajibu:

english: If He comes along to imprison you, or convenes a court, who can stop Him?
ekegusii: Karaete asibe abanto, gose kobagambia, ning’o oramotange?
swahili: “Kama akija na kukufunga gerezani, na kuitisha mahakama, ni nani awezaye kumpinga?

english: Surely He knows the deceit of men. If He sees iniquity, does He not take note?
ekegusii: Ere nigo amanyete abanto batagwenereti. Ekero akorora amabe agokorwa, Inee, takorengereria igoro y’ayio?
swahili: Hakika anawatambua watu wadanganyifu; naye aonapo uovu, je, haangalii?

english: But a witless man can no more become wise than the colt of a wild donkey can be born a man!
ekegusii: Onye omoriri okonyara koba omong’aini, rirorio emori y’etigere y’orosana nenyare koiborwa ebe omonto.
swahili: Mpumbavu aweza kuwa mwenye hekima, endapo mtoto wa punda-mwitu atazaliwa mwanadamu.

english: As for you, if you direct your heart and lift up your hands to Him,
ekegusii: “Oise kwebeeka ang’e ase enkoro yao gokora amaronge, na orambore amaboko ao gochia ase Nyasae;
swahili: “Hata sasa ukiutoa moyo wako kwake na kumwinulia mikono yako,

english: if you put away the iniquity in your hand, and allow no injustice to dwell in your tents,
ekegusii: onye kogotuguta ebibe bire ase amaboko ao, na togotiga obobe bomenye ase eema yao,
swahili: ukiiondolea mbali ile dhambi iliyo mkononi mwako wala usiuruhusu uovu ukae hemani mwako,

english: then indeed you will lift up your face without shame; you will stand firm and unafraid.
ekegusii: amaene, rirorio norigererie otari na komocha, naende norendwe buya tokoba nobwoba.
swahili: ndipo utainua uso wako bila aibu; utasimama imara bila hofu.

english: For you will forget your misery, recalling it only as waters gone by.
ekegusii: Nigo orebe emechando yao, buna amaache aetire, takoinyorwa naende.
swahili: Hakika utaisahau taabu yako, utaikumbuka tu kama maji yaliyokwisha kupita.

english: Your life will be brighter than noonday; its darkness will be like the morning.
ekegusii: Na obogima bwao nigo borarabe se kobua erioba ria mobaso gati; omosunte oye nigo oraonchoke obe buna ekero bogokia mambia.
swahili: Maisha yako yatangʼaa kuliko adhuhuri, nalo giza litakuwa kama alfajiri.

english: You will be secure, because there is hope, and you will look around and lie down in safety.
ekegusii: Aye nomenye kore noboremu, ekiagera ogosemeria nkoreo; norendwe na gotimoka ase obotoereru.
swahili: Utakuwa salama, kwa kuwa lipo tumaini; utatazama pande zote na kupumzika kwa salama.

english: You will lie down without fear, and many will court your favor.
ekegusii: Ekero okorara, monto onde tagokwoboyia; abanto abange mbache asore bagosorore ng’a banyore ogwancherwa.
swahili: Utalala, wala hakuna atakayekuogofya, naam, wengi watajipendekeza kwako.

english: “Should this stream of words go unanswered and such a speaker be vindicated?
ekegusii: “Inee! Amang’ana aya amange natigwe tairanerigwa? Na omonto obwate amang’ana amange buna iga nabarerwe oboronge?
swahili: “Je, maneno haya yote yapite bila kujibiwa? Je, huyu mnenaji athibitishwe kuwa na haki?

english: But the eyes of the wicked will fail, and escape will elude them; they will hope for their last breath.”
ekegusii: Korende abakori amabe mbabe bakouna‐una ase omosunte, tibakorora omobaso. Tibagotooreka nonya ng’ake; ogosemeria kwabo ngosire pi.”
swahili: Bali macho ya waovu hayataona, wokovu utawaepuka; tarajio lao litakuwa ni hangaiko la mtu anayekata roho.”

english: Should your babbling put others to silence? Will you scoff without rebuke?
ekegusii: Inee! Amang’ana ao atari nengencho nagere abanto bakire‐kiri? Na ekero ogokwana amang’ana ay’ogochecheria, monto onde takogosookia?
swahili: Je, maneno yako ya upuzi yawafanye watu wanyamaze kimya? Je, mtu asikukemee unapofanya dhihaka?

english: You have said, ‘My doctrine is sound, and I am pure in Your sight.’
ekegusii: Aye nigo ogoteeba ng’a amang’ana ogokwana nay’ekeene, naende ng’a nigo ochenegete ase amaiso a Nyasae.
swahili: Unamwambia Mungu, ‘Imani yangu ni kamili nami ni safi mbele zako.’

english: But if only God would speak and open His lips against you,
ekegusii: Korende onye ndiria Nyasae are gokwana na akoorokie buna ore,
swahili: Aha! Laiti kwamba Mungu angesema, kwamba angefungua midomo yake dhidi yako,

english: and disclose to you the secrets of wisdom, for true wisdom has two sides. Know then that God exacts from you less than your iniquity deserves.
ekegusii: erinde akomaanorere orore obobisi bw’obong’aini! Ere nigo abwate obomanyi botari korengeka. Ase ayio manya ng’a nigo akoeire egesusuro egeke, tari buna okomocha kwao kogwenerete.
swahili: naye akufunulie siri za hekima, kwa kuwa hekima ya kweli ina pande mbili. Ujue hili: Mungu amesahau hata baadhi ya dhambi zako.

english: Can you fathom the deep things of God or discover the limits of the Almighty?
ekegusii: “Inee! Nonyare komanya ebinto bia Nyasae bibisekanete? Nonyare komanya oboikeranu bw’Omonguru?
swahili: “Je, waweza kujua siri za Mungu? Je, waweza kuyachunguza mambo yote kumhusu Mwenyezi?

english: They are higher than the heavens—what can you do? They are deeper than Sheol—what can you know?
ekegusii: Onye bore obonene gochia igoro, inki oranyare gokora? Onye bore obotambe inse gochia aase abakuure, inki oranyare komanya?
swahili: Ni juu mno kuliko mbingu: waweza kufanya nini? Kina chake ni kirefu kuliko kuzimu: wewe waweza kujua nini?

english: Their measure is longer than the earth and wider than the sea.
ekegusii: Obotambe bwaye nigo boetanetie obw’ense, na obogare bwaye mboetanetie obw’enyancha.
swahili: Kipimo chake ni kirefu kuliko dunia, nacho ni kipana kuliko bahari.

english: Then Job answered:
ekegusii: Erio Ayubu akairaneria, akabora:
swahili: Ndipo Ayubu akajibu:

english: The life of every living thing is in His hand, as well as the breath of all mankind.
ekegusii: Obogima bwa kera egetongwa kere moyo na omoika o Mwanyabaanto, nigo bire ase okoboko kwaye.
swahili: Mkononi mwake kuna uhai wa kila kiumbe, na pumzi ya wanadamu wote.

english: Does not the ear test words as the tongue tastes its food?
ekegusii: Inee! Amang’ana ogoto gokoigwa, tikori koyateema buna oromeme rokomena rwaigwa endagera?
swahili: Je, sikio haliyajaribu maneno kama vile ulimi uonjavyo chakula?

english: Wisdom is found with the elderly, and understanding comes with long life.
ekegusii: Obong’aini nigo bore ase abanto abanene, na okomenya emiaka emenge nakwo okomanya.
swahili: Je, hekima haipatikani katikati ya wazee? Je, maisha marefu hayaleti ufahamu?

english: Wisdom and strength belong to God; counsel and understanding are His.
ekegusii: Korende Nyasae nigo are nobong’aini na okobua, boigo nare nogosemia na obomanyi.
swahili: “Hekima na nguvu ni vya Mungu; shauri na ufahamu ni vyake yeye.

english: What He tears down cannot be rebuilt; the man He imprisons cannot be released.
ekegusii: Ere aise gotagora, onde tari oraagache naende; aise gosiekera omonto, onde tari oramoigorere.
swahili: Kile anachokibomoa hakiwezi kujengeka tena; mtu aliyefungiwa naye hawezi kufunguliwa.

english: If He holds back the waters, they dry up, and if He releases them, they overwhelm the land.
ekegusii: Aise gotanga amaache, ense igo erome pa, na ekero akoyarenta nigo akoonchorana ense.
swahili: Akizuia maji, huwa pana ukame; akiyaachia maji, huharibu nchi.

english: True wisdom and power belong to Him. The deceived and the deceiver are His.
ekegusii: Chinguru na obong’aini nigo bikorwa asare. Abwo bakong’aineka na abakong’ainereria nigo bare ase okoboko kwaye.
swahili: Kwake kuna nguvu na ushindi; adanganywaye na adanganyaye, wote wawili ni wake.

english: He leads counselors away barefoot and makes fools of judges.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo akoombogania abare abasemia obatiga getirianda, nigo agokora abagaambi ebiina baba abariri.
swahili: Yeye huwaondoa washauri wakiwa wametekwa nyara, naye huwapumbaza wanaotoa maamuzi.

english: He loosens the bonds placed by kings and fastens a belt around their waists.
ekegusii: Nigo agosibora chinkini chi’abarwoti, erio obaboyia ebibarachi.
swahili: Huondoa pingu zilizofungwa na wafalme, na kuwafunga mishipi ya kiunoni.

english: He leads priests away barefoot and overthrows the established.
ekegusii: Ere nigo akoombogania abakuani, obatiga getirianda, na oonchorana abanto bare nokobua.
swahili: Huwaondoa makuhani wakiwa wametekwa nyara, na kuwaangusha waliojiimarisha muda mrefu.

english: “Truly then you are the people with whom wisdom itself will die!
ekegusii: Ekeene, inwe ninwe abanto bori, ekero morakwe, obong’aini nigo borasire.
swahili: “Bila shaka ninyi ndio watu, nayo hekima itakoma mtakapokufa!

english: He deprives the trusted of speech and takes away the discernment of elders.
ekegusii: Abanto abwo basemeirie nigo akobaura amang’ana bagokwana, na oura abanto abagotu ogosemia.
swahili: Hunyamazisha midomo ya washauri wanaoaminika, na kuondoa busara ya wazee.

english: He pours out contempt on nobles and disarms the mighty.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo akorentera abagaambi ogochaywa, na abanto bare nokobua nigo akobaura chinguru.
swahili: Huwamwagia dharau wanaoheshimika, na kuwavua silaha wenye nguvu.

english: He reveals the deep things of darkness and brings deep shadows into light.
ekegusii: Ere nigo akoorokia obobisi ase omosunte, erio okora obobisi boria bore ase omosunte bwaba oborabu.
swahili: Hufunua mambo ya ndani ya gizani, na kuyaleta nuruni yale yaliyositirika sana.

english: He makes nations great and destroys them; He enlarges nations, then disperses them.
ekegusii: Nigo agokinia ebisaku, naende obisiria; nigo akobikora biabucha, naende obing’anyia.
swahili: Huyafanya mataifa yatukuke na kuyaangamiza; hufanya mataifa kuwa makubwa, naye huyatawanya.

english: He deprives the earth’s leaders of reason and makes them wander in a trackless wasteland.
ekegusii: Ere nigo akorusia obong’aini ase abatang’ani b’abaanto bare ase ense, erio obatiga bakoombogana erooro bosa.
swahili: Huwaondolea viongozi wa nchi akili zao; huwapeleka watangetange nyikani pasipo na njia.

english: They grope in the darkness without light; He makes them stagger like drunkards.
ekegusii: Abanto abwo nigo bagotaba‐taba ase omosunte borabu botaiyo, na ogera baong’anya buna omonto otindire.
swahili: Hupapasa gizani pasipokuwa na mwanga; huwafanya wapepesuke kama walevi.

english: But I also have a mind; I am not inferior to you. Who does not know such things as these?
ekegusii: Korende nainche nabo inde nokomanya buna inwe, gose timombueti. Ning’o otamanyeti amang’ana buna ayio?
swahili: Lakini mimi ninao ufahamu kama ninyi; mimi si duni kwenu. Ni nani asiyejua mambo haya yote?

english: I am a laughingstock to my friends, though I called on God, and He answered. The righteous and upright man is a laughingstock.
ekegusii: Abasani baane nigo bagonchecheria, inche oyo narenge korangeria Nyasae, na ere akaba okong’iraneria, inche omonyaboronge ntari na komocha, bono nigo ngochecherigwa.
swahili: “Nimekuwa mtu wa kuchekwa na rafiki zangu, ingawa nilimwita Mungu naye akanijibu: mimi ni mtu wa kuchekwa tu, ingawa ni mwadilifu na nisiye na hatia!

english: The one at ease scorns misfortune as the fate of those whose feet are slipping.
ekegusii: Omonto otari na mechando ende, nigo agochaaya emechando, nigo are ang’e gotindachera inse abwo batererigwe.
swahili: Wanadamu wakiwa katika utulivu huwa na dharau kwa wale wenye msiba kana kwamba ndiyo haki ya wale ambao miguu yao inateleza.

english: The tents of robbers are safe, and those who provoke God are secure— those who carry their god in their hands.
ekegusii: Chinka chi’abauri nigo chigendererete koba nomorembe, na abwo bagechete Nyasae nigo barendire buya, na enyasae yabo nigo ere ase amaboko abo.
swahili: Hema za wanyangʼanyi hazisumbuliwi, wale wanaomghadhibisha Mungu wako salama: wale wamchukuao mungu wao mikononi mwao.

english: But ask the animals, and they will instruct you; ask the birds of the air, and they will tell you.
ekegusii: Bono boria ching’iti, nchikworokererie; boria chinyoni chia igoro chigoteebie amang’ana;
swahili: “Lakini ulizeni wanyama, nao watawafundisha, au ndege wa angani, nao watawaambia;

english: Or speak to the earth, and it will teach you; let the fish of the sea inform you.
ekegusii: gose kwana ne riroba, ndikworokererie, ne chinswe chia nyancha, nchikoraarerie.
swahili: au zungumzeni na dunia, nayo itawafundisha, au acheni samaki wa baharini wawape taarifa.

english: Which of all these does not know that the hand of the LORD has done this?
ekegusii: Ning’o otamanyeti amang’ana aya onsi ng’a okoboko kw’Omonene nakwo gwakorire aya?
swahili: Ni nani miongoni mwa hawa wote asiyejua kwamba mkono wa Bwana ndio uliofanya hili?

english: “Indeed, my eyes have seen all this; my ears have heard and understood.
ekegusii: Naama! Amang’ana aya onsi nayarorire neriso riane, nayaigure nogoto kwane, nayamanyire.
swahili: “Macho yangu yameona hili lote, masikio yangu yamesikia na kulielewa.

english: Surely He would rebuke you if you secretly showed partiality.
ekegusii: Ekeene ere nabatogonyere Onye mogokora ogwanchereria bobisi.
swahili: Hakika angewakemea kama mkiwapendelea watu kwa siri.

english: Would His majesty not terrify you? Would the dread of Him not fall upon you?
ekegusii: Inee! Obonene bwaye tibokobaboyia, na okogosa kwaye kobaondokie?
swahili: Je, huo ukuu wake haungewatisha ninyi? Je, hofu yake isingewaangukia ninyi?

english: Your maxims are proverbs of ashes; your defenses are defenses of clay.
ekegusii: Emereng’anio y’obong’aini bwaino nigo ere bosa buna ribu, ne chiburi chiaino nigo chigiteire esike.
swahili: Maneno yenu ni mithali za majivu; utetezi wenu ni ngome za udongo wa mfinyanzi.

english: Be silent, and I will speak. Then let come to me what may.
ekegusii: Inwe kira‐kiri, montige nkwane, na kende gionsi kegochia konyora, tiga kenyore.
swahili: “Nyamazeni kimya nipate kusema; kisha na yanipate yatakayonipata.

english: Why do I put myself at risk and take my life in my own hands?
ekegusii: Nase ki ndabeeke enyama y’omobere one ase amaino aane? Ting’egerereti obogima bwane.
swahili: Kwa nini nijiweke mwenyewe kwenye hatari na kuyaweka maisha yangu mikononi mwangu?

english: Though He slay me, I will hope in Him. I will still defend my ways to His face.
ekegusii: Omonene naisa kong’ita, ningenderere komosemeria, nonya nabo goika ndete amang’ana aane ase obosio bwaye.
swahili: Ingawa ataniua, bado nitamtumaini; hakika nitazitetea njia zangu mbele zake.

english: Moreover, this will be my salvation, for no godless man can appear before Him.
ekegusii: Ayio nabe ogotooreka kwane ng’a omonto otamoirogeti Nyasae tagocha ase obosio bwaye.
swahili: Naam, hili litanigeukia kuwa wokovu wangu, kwa maana hakuna mtu asiyemcha Mungu atakayethubutu kuja mbele yake!

english: Listen carefully to my words; let my declaration ring in your ears.
ekegusii: Tegerera onyigwe, tiga ogotebereria kwane gosoe ase amato aino.
swahili: Sikilizeni maneno yangu kwa makini; nayo masikio yenu yaingize kile nisemacho.

english: Behold, now that I have prepared my case, I know that I will be vindicated.
ekegusii: Rora, naroisirie amang’ana aane, namanyire ng’a nimbarerwe oboronge.
swahili: Sasa kwamba nimekwisha kutayarisha mambo yangu, ninajua mimi nitahesabiwa kuwa na haki.

english: Can anyone indict me? If so, I will be silent and die.
ekegusii: Ning’o oreo ogochia koamererania nainche? Onye oreo, rirorio inche nigo ndakire‐kiri inkwe.
swahili: Je, kuna yeyote anayeweza kuleta mashtaka dhidi yangu? Kama ndivyo, nitanyamaza kimya na nife.

english: What you know, I also know; I am not inferior to you.
ekegusii: Aya momanyete, nainche ninyamanyete; inwe timombueti kende.
swahili: Hayo mnayoyajua mimi pia ninayajua; mimi si mtu duni kuliko ninyi.

english: Only grant these two things to me, so that I need not hide from You:
ekegusii: Bono nigo ngokoboria onkorere ebinto bibere, nario ntebise korwa ase obosio bwao:
swahili: “Ee Mungu, unijalie tu mimi haya mambo mawili, nami sitajificha uso wako:

english: Withdraw Your hand from me, and do not let Your terror frighten me.
ekegusii: Rusia okoboko kwao korwa ase ’nde, na okogosa kwao tikogenderera konyoboyia.
swahili: Ondoa mkono wako uwe mbali nami, nawe uache kuniogofya kwa hofu zako kuu.

english: Then call me, and I will answer, or let me speak, and You can reply.
ekegusii: Erio aye ondangerie, na inche ng’itabe, gose ing’a ribaga nkwane, naye ong’iranerie.
swahili: Niite kwenye shauri nami nitajibu, au niache niseme, nawe upate kujibu.

english: How many are my iniquities and sins? Reveal to me my transgression and sin.
ekegusii: Amamocho aane, na ebibe biane, mbirenga bire? Imanyie ogosaria kwane, na ebibe biane.
swahili: Ni makosa na dhambi ngapi nilizotenda? Nionyeshe kosa langu na dhambi yangu.

english: Why do You hide Your face and consider me as Your enemy?
ekegusii: Nase ki okobisa obosio bwao na kombara ng’a nomobisa oo inde?
swahili: Kwa nini kuuficha uso wako na kunihesabu mimi kuwa adui yako?

english: Would You frighten a windblown leaf? Would You chase after dry chaff?
ekegusii: Inee! Nigo orasegenyie rito eriomo rikona‐koirwa nembeo? Gose aye nigo ogochia gotunya omoiriro korwa magega?
swahili: Je, utaliadhibu jani lipeperushwalo na upepo? Je, utayasaka makapi makavu?

english: For You record bitter accusations against me and bequeath to me the iniquities of my youth.
ekegusii: Ekiagera gwanchikeire amang’ana ’obororo, naende kwang’akanire amabe ’obosae bwane.
swahili: Kwa kuwa unaandika mambo machungu dhidi yangu na kunifanya nizirithi dhambi za ujana wangu.

english: You put my feet in the stocks and stand watch over all my paths; You set a limit for the soles of my feet.
ekegusii: Aye gwasoirie amagoro aane ase rikorogoto, nigo origereretie orogendo rwane rwonsi; aye kwabeekire orobebe ase chimbaratero chiane chigotacha.
swahili: Umeifunga miguu yangu kwenye pingu. Unazichunga kwa makini njia zangu zote kwa kutia alama kwenye nyayo za miguu yangu.

english: So man wastes away like something rotten, like a moth-eaten garment.
ekegusii: Omonto nigo agosira oruao buna egento ekegundo, na buna eanga yarirwe nebigwankwa.
swahili: “Hivyo mwanadamu huangamia kama kitu kilichooza, kama vazi lililoliwa na nondo.

english: Yet I desire to speak to the Almighty and argue my case before God.
ekegusii: Korende nigo nganetie nkwane n’Omonguru; mbeke amang’ana aane ase Nyasae, erinde ng’amereranie nere,
swahili: Lakini ninayo shauku ya kuzungumza na Mwenyezi na kuhojiana shauri langu na Mungu.

english: You, however, smear with lies; you are all worthless physicians.
ekegusii: Korende inwe nabatongi oborimo, inwe mwensi nabarwaria bare bosa, motari kogwenia.
swahili: Ninyi, hata hivyo, hunipakaza uongo; ninyi ni matabibu wasiofaa kitu, ninyi nyote!

english: If only you would remain silent; for that would be your wisdom!
ekegusii: Onye ndiria mware gokira‐kiri! Okwo nanga nigo kwaba obong’aini bwaino.
swahili: Laiti wote mngenyamaza kimya! Kwa kuwa kwenu hilo lingekuwa hekima.

english: Hear now my argument, and listen to the plea of my lips.
ekegusii: Bono tegerera moigwe amang’ana ngwekwanera, naende tegerera moigwe ogosorora gokorwa ase omonwa one.
swahili: Sikieni sasa hoja yangu; sikilizeni kusihi kwangu.

english: Will you speak wickedly on God’s behalf or speak deceitfully for Him?
ekegusii: Inee! Inwe nigo mokorwanerera Nyasae ase ogokwana oborimo? Naende mokomorwanerera ase obong’ainereria?
swahili: Je, mtazungumza kwa uovu kwa niaba ya Mungu? Je, mtazungumza kwa udanganyifu kwa niaba yake?

english: Would you show Him partiality or argue in His defense?
ekegusii: Inee! Inwe nigo more nogwanchereria asare? Nigo moganetie korwanerera Nyasae ase ekegambero?
swahili: Mtamwonyesha upendeleo? Mtamtetea Mungu kwenye mashtaka yake?

english: Would it be well when He examined you? Could you deceive Him like a man?
ekegusii: Inee! Amang’ana nabe amaya ase more Omonene karabarenge abamanye buna more? Gose mokagete ng’a nigo moramong’aine buna abanto bakong’ainana?
swahili: Je, ingekuwa vyema Mungu akiwahoji ninyi? Je, mngeweza kumdanganya kama ambavyo mngeweza kuwadanganya wanadamu?

english: “Man, who is born of woman, is short of days and full of trouble.
ekegusii: “Mwanyabaanto okoiborwa nomokuungu, amatuko aye namake; ayio aichire nemechando.
swahili: “Mwanadamu aliyezaliwa na mwanamke siku zake ni chache nazo zimejaa taabu.

english: But a man dies and is laid low; he breathes his last, and where is he?
ekegusii: Korende omonto nigo agokwa, bwarerigwa riroba inse; omonto nigo agotiga koeyana, ng’ai agochia?
swahili: Lakini mwanadamu hufa, na huo ndio mwisho wake; hutoa pumzi ya mwisho, naye hayuko tena!

english: As water disappears from the sea and a river becomes parched and dry,
ekegusii: “Buna koreng’ana amaache e chinyancha agosira pi, naboigo naye chindooche agokama chioma pa,
swahili: Kama vile maji yatowekavyo katika bahari, au mkondo wa mto ukaushwavyo na kuwa mkavu,

english: so a man lies down and does not rise. Until the heavens are no more, he will not be awakened or roused from sleep.
ekegusii: naboigo na Mwanyabaanto kararire, tagotenena naende; tagoturwa goika ekero igoro na ense bitabeo; tagotaboborwa korwa ase chitoro chiaye.
swahili: ndivyo mwanadamu alalavyo chini asiamke; hadi mbingu zitakapokuwa hazipo tena, wanadamu hawataamka au kuamshwa kutoka kwenye usingizi wao.

english: If only You would hide me in Sheol and conceal me until Your anger has passed! If only You would appoint a time for me and then remember me!
ekegusii: “Naki anga yaba buya, onye nkwambisa agwo aase abakuure; onye kwandenda aase are bobisi, goika endamwamu yao ebe yaetire, onye gwanchikera engaki na kong’inyora!
swahili: “Laiti kama ungenificha kaburini, na kunisitiri hadi hasira yako ipite! Laiti ungeniwekea wakati, na kisha ukanikumbuka!

english: When a man dies, will he live again? All the days of my hard service I will wait, until my renewal comes.
ekegusii: Inee! Omonto gakuure, nairane koba moyo naende? Inche ase amatuko aane onsi inchikeire, nimbe nganyete, goika ogosiborwa kwane goche.
swahili: Je, kama mtu akifa, aweza kuishi tena? Siku zote za kazi zangu ngumu nitangojea kufanywa upya kwangu.

english: You will call, and I will answer; You will desire the work of Your hands.
ekegusii: Aye korandangerie, na inche ningoitabere, ekiagera noganie emeremo y’amaboko ao.
swahili: Utaniita nami nitakuitika; utakionea shauku kiumbe ambacho mikono yako ilikiumba.

english: For then You would count my steps, but would not keep track of my sin.
ekegusii: Bono aye nigo okobara amatambokero aane, gose tori korigereria ebibe biane.
swahili: Hakika ndipo utakapozihesabu hatua zangu, lakini hutazifuatia dhambi zangu.

english: My transgression would be sealed in a bag, and You would cover over my iniquity.
ekegusii: Ogosaria kwane kware komumekerigwa egunia ime, aye nigo kware gotuba ebibe biane.
swahili: Makosa yangu yatafungiwa kwa lakiri kwenye mfuko, nawe utazifunika dhambi zangu.

english: But as a mountain erodes and crumbles and a rock is dislodged from its place,
ekegusii: “Buna egetunwa gekogwa na giasamunyokana, na egetare giasukigwa korwa aase aye;
swahili: “Lakini kama mlima umomonyokavyo na kufikichika na kama vile mwamba uondolewavyo mahali pake,

english: as water wears away the stones and torrents wash away the soil, so You destroy a man’s hope.
ekegusii: buna amaache agwata amagena asamunyokana, ne chiooro chiaira amaroba aera, naboigo aye ogosiria ogosemeria kwa Mwanyabaanto.
swahili: kama maji yamalizavyo mawe, na mafuriko yachukuavyo udongo, ndivyo unavyoharibu tegemeo la mwanadamu.

english: Like a flower, he comes forth, then withers away; like a fleeting shadow, he does not endure.
ekegusii: Ere nigo akororekana buna egesicha giasichire na giasira bwango, nigo agoeta bwango buna omorengari, tari kogenderera kobao.
swahili: Huchanua kama ua kisha hunyauka; huwa kama kivuli kipitacho upesi, wala hadumu.

english: You forever overpower him, and he passes on; You change his countenance and send him away.
ekegusii: Aye nigo ogendererete kobua omonto, na ere nigo agoeta osira, nigo okoonchora ekieni kiaye kwamosiria.
swahili: Humshinda mara moja kwa daima, naye hutoweka; waibadilisha sura yake na kumwondoa.

english: If his sons receive honor, he does not know it; if they are brought low, he is unaware.
ekegusii: Abana baye nigo bakoegwa ogosikwa, korende ere tari komanya ayio; nigo bakourwa ogosikwa kwabo na gokoigwa, korende ere tari komanya ayio.
swahili: Kama wanawe wakipewa heshima, yeye hafahamu; kama wakidharauliwa, yeye haoni.

english: He feels only the pain of his own body and mourns only for himself.”
ekegusii: Ere nigo akoigwa obororo ase omobere oye, na oba okona‐kwereera omonyene.”
swahili: Yeye hasikii kingine isipokuwa maumivu ya mwili wake mwenyewe, naye huomboleza kwa ajili yake mwenyewe.”

english: Do You open Your eyes to one like this? Will You bring him into judgment before You?
ekegusii: Inee! Aye nigo okorigereria omonto buna oyio? Nigo okondeta ase obosio bwao na kongambia ekiina?
swahili: Je, unamwekea jicho lako mtu kama huyo? Je, utamleta mbele yako katika hukumu?

english: Who can bring out clean from unclean? No one!
ekegusii: Ning’o oranyare korenta egento gechenegete korwa ase egetachenegeti? Onde taiyo, nonya noyomo.
swahili: Ni nani awezaye kutoa kitu safi kutoka kitu najisi? Hakuna awezaye!

english: Since his days are determined and the number of his months is with You, and since You have set limits that he cannot exceed,
ekegusii: Omonto nigo abareire amatuko aye, na omobaro bw’emetienyi yaye naye kwayochikire, naende kwamobeekeire chimbebe atanyare goetania.
swahili: Siku za mwanadamu zimewekewa mpaka; umekwisha kutangaza idadi ya miezi yake na kuweka mpaka ambao hawezi kuuvuka.

english: look away from him and let him rest, so he can enjoy his day as a hired hand.
ekegusii: Tiga komorigereria, motige anyore obotoereru, erinde agokere amatuko aye buna omonto orikire emeremo.
swahili: Hivyo angalia mbali umwache, hadi awe amekamilisha muda wake kama mtu aliyeajiriwa.

english: For there is hope for a tree: If it is cut down, it will sprout again, and its tender shoots will not fail.
ekegusii: “Ogosemeria nkoreo ase omote, ekero ogechirwe noseboke naende, na emeseboko eyio tegosira.
swahili: “Kwa maana lipo tumaini kwa mti; kama ukikatwa utachipuka tena, nayo machipukizi yake mapya hayatakoma.

english: If its roots grow old in the ground and its stump dies in the soil,
ekegusii: Emeri y’omote oyio neisa kogota ime ase riroba, na egetugi kiaye nkegote gesire ime ase riroba,
swahili: Mizizi yake yaweza kuchakaa ardhini na kisiki chake kufa udongoni,

english: at the scent of water it will bud and put forth twigs like a sapling.
ekegusii: nonya naboigo, ekero embura eratwe, nigo keraseboke na gosokia ebisabo buna ekemeri ekeyia.
swahili: lakini kwa kupata dalili ya maji utachipua na kutoa machipukizi kama mche.

english: Then Eliphaz the Temanite replied:
ekegusii: Erio Elifasi Omotemani akairaneria, akabora:
swahili: Kisha Elifazi Mtemani akajibu:

english: Both the gray-haired and the aged are on our side— men much older than your father.
ekegusii: Abanto bamerire chimbuche amo nabakoorire emiaka emenge nao bare aa amo naintwe, barabwo mbabuete iso ase emiaka.
swahili: Wale wenye mvi na wazee wako upande wetu, watu ambao ni wazee hata kuliko baba yako.

english: Are the consolations of God not enough for you, even words spoken gently to you?
ekegusii: “Inee! Okoremia koria Nyasae akoeire tikogoisaini? Gose ring’ana ri’oboitongo agokwana naye nigo rire bosa asore?
swahili: Je, faraja za Mungu hazikutoshi, au maneno yaliyosemwa kwako kwa upole si kitu?

english: Why has your heart carried you away, and why do your eyes flash,
ekegusii: Nase ki enkoro yao ere morero, na amaiso ao akomogora,
swahili: Kwa nini moyo wako unakudanganya, na kwa nini macho yako yanangʼaa,

english: as you turn your spirit against God and pour such words from your mouth?
ekegusii: goika omoyo oo obeire mamincha ya Nyasae, na bono aye ngosokia ore amang’ana aya korwa ase omonwa oo?
swahili: ili kwamba upate kutoa hasira yako dhidi ya Mungu, na kumwaga maneno kama hayo kutoka kinywani mwako?

english: What is man, that he should be pure, or one born of woman, that he should be righteous?
ekegusii: Inee! Mwanyabaanto ninki are goika anyare koba oyochenegete? Gose ere oyio oiboire nomokuungu ng’a anyare koba omonyaboronge?
swahili: “Mwanadamu ni kitu gani, hata aweze kuwa safi, au yeye aliyezaliwa na mwanamke, hata aweze kuwa mwadilifu?

english: If God puts no trust in His holy ones, if even the heavens are not pure in His eyes,
ekegusii: Rora, Nyasae tari gosemeria nonya nabachenu baye, na igoro chionsi tichichenegeti ase obosio bwaye.
swahili: Kama Mungu hawaamini watakatifu wake, kama hata mbingu zenyewe si safi machoni pake,

english: how much less man, who is vile and corrupt, who drinks injustice like water?
ekegusii: Onye nabo, naki rende ase omonto oyio ogokora ay’okogechia na gosaria, oyio okonywa ebibe buna amaache?
swahili: sembuse mwanadamu ambaye ni mwovu na mpotovu, ambaye hunywa uovu kama anywavyo maji!

english: Listen to me and I will inform you. I will describe what I have seen,
ekegusii: “Integerera oigwe, na inche nkworokie; amang’ana narorire ninyararie.
swahili: “Nisikilize mimi nami nitakueleza, acha nikuambie yale niliyoyaona,

english: what was declared by wise men and was not concealed from their fathers,
ekegusii: Ayio abanto abang’aini bateebeetigwe ne chisokoro chiabo, nabarabwo tibayabisete.
swahili: ambayo watu wenye hekima wameyanena, bila kuficha lolote walilopokea toka kwa baba zao

english: to whom alone the land was given when no foreigner passed among them.
ekegusii: Barabwo bakaegwa ense eria, na abanto b’ense engeni tibaetete aroro.
swahili: (wakati ambao wao peke yao ndio walipewa nchi, hakuna mgeni aliyepita miongoni mwao):

english: “Does a wise man answer with empty counsel or fill his belly with the hot east wind?
ekegusii: “Inee! Omonto omong’aini nagwenerete airanerie amang’ana are buna omwaga okogusa, na goichoria enda yaye nomwaga okogusa korwa moocha?
swahili: “Je, mtu mwenye hekima hujibu kwa mawazo matupu, au kujaza tumbo lake kwa upepo wenye joto wa mashariki?

english: A wicked man writhes in pain all his days; only a few years are reserved for the ruthless.
ekegusii: “Omokori amabe nigo akogenderera gochandeka nobororo ase amatuko aye onsi, na omochandi boigo ase emiaka ere achikeretwe.
swahili: Mtu mwovu siku zake zote hupata mateso, miaka yote aliwekewa mkorofi.

english: Sounds of terror fill his ears; in his prosperity the destroyer attacks him.
ekegusii: Amariogi ay’okwoboyia nigo agosoa ase amato aye; na ekero are n’obotoereru, oyo ogosiria nigo akomocheera.
swahili: Sauti za kutisha hujaa masikioni mwake; katika kufanikiwa kwake, wanyangʼanyi humshambulia.

english: He despairs of his return from darkness; he is marked for the sword.
ekegusii: Ere tari koba nogosemeria ng’a gose narue ase omosunte naende, ekiagera omoro nigo omoganetie.
swahili: Hukata tamaa kuokoka gizani; amewekwa kwa ajili ya upanga.

english: He wanders about as food for vultures; he knows the day of darkness is at hand.
ekegusii: Omonto oyio nigo akoba okoombogana korigia endagera, oboria: Ng’ai ere? Nigo amanyete ng’a rituko ri’omosunte riamoikeire ang’e.
swahili: Hutangatanga, akitafuta chakula; anajua kwamba siku ya giza iko karibu.

english: Distress and anguish terrify him, overwhelming him like a king poised to attack.
ekegusii: Emechando na obwoba nigo bikomoondokia. Ebio nigo bikomorwania na komobua, ne chinguru buna echi’omorwoti bwebekire ang’e korwana esegi.
swahili: Taabu na maumivu makuu vinamtia hofu; humshinda kama mfalme aliye tayari kwa vita,

english: For he has stretched out his hand against God and has vaunted himself against the Almighty,
ekegusii: “Ere oramboire okoboko kwaye mamincha ya Nyasae, naende oba nomokia gokora ay’oboenenu ase obosio bw’Omonguru.
swahili: kwa sababu amemkunjia Mungu ngumi yake na kujigamba dhidi ya Mwenyezi,

english: rushing headlong at Him with a thick, studded shield.
ekegusii: Oyio nigo akobogoria ching’aya chiaye chikumbire, ominyoka ore nebigoti ebikong’u ochia korwania Omonene.
swahili: kwa kiburi akishambulia dhidi ya Mungu akiwa na ngao nene, iliyo imara.

english: Though his face is covered with fat and his waistline bulges with flesh,
ekegusii: Nigo atubire obosio bwaye namaguta ’obonoru, naende onorire ase ebibono biaye.
swahili: “Ingawa uso wake umefunikwa na mafuta kwa unene na kiuno chake kimevimba kwa kunenepa,

english: he will dwell in ruined cities, in abandoned houses destined to become rubble.
ekegusii: “Oyio obeire omenyete ase emechie yasaretigwe agwo ase chinyomba chitamenyiri nonde, echio konya chiarurwe ase ogosarigwa chibe amatombe.
swahili: ataishi katika miji ya magofu, na katika nyumba ambazo haziishi mwanadamu yeyote, nyumba zinazokuwa vifusi.

english: He will no longer be rich; his wealth will not endure. His possessions will not overspread the land.
ekegusii: Omonto oyio takoba omonda, obotenenku bwaye tibokogenderera kobao, gose tibokobucha ase ense.
swahili: Hatatajirika tena, nao utajiri wake hautadumu, wala mali zake hazitakuwa nyingi juu ya nchi.

english: Should he argue with useless words or speeches that serve no purpose?
ekegusii: Inee! Nemogwenerete koamererania ne chinkwana chitari nengencho, gose amang’ana atari korenta buya bonde?
swahili: Je, aweza kubishana juu ya maneno yasiyofaa, kwa hotuba zisizo na maana?

english: He will not escape from the darkness; the flame will wither his shoots, and the breath of God’s mouth will carry him away.
ekegusii: Tagotooreka korwa ase omosunte; omorero mbwomie emeseboka egoseboka, ere omonyene nasire ase omoika bw’Omonene.
swahili: Hatatoka gizani; mwali wa moto utanyausha machipukizi yake, nayo pumzi ya kinywa cha Mungu itamwondolea mbali.

english: Let him not deceive himself with trust in emptiness, for emptiness will be his reward.
ekegusii: Tabaisa kweng’aina ase ogosemeria amang’ana abosa, ekiagera obosa obwo nabwo borabe eng’eria yaye.
swahili: Asijidanganye mwenyewe kutumainia ubatili, kwa kuwa hatapata malipo yoyote.

english: It will be paid in full before his time, and his branch will not flourish.
ekegusii: Naakanwe obosa obwo ritang’ani engaki yaye etaraika, na nigo arabe buna orosagia rwaye rotarasicha.
swahili: Atakuwa amelipwa kikamilifu kabla ya wakati wake, nayo matawi yake hayatastawi.

english: He will be like a vine stripped of its unripe grapes, like an olive tree that sheds its blossoms.
ekegusii: Oyio nigo arabe buna omosabibu okoarora amasabibu ataratoba, na buna omozeituni okoarora ebisicha biaye.
swahili: Atafanana na mzabibu uliopukutishwa matunda yake kabla hayajaiva, kama mzeituni unaodondosha maua yake.

english: For the company of the godless will be barren, and fire will consume the tents of bribery.
ekegusii: Ebiombe bi’abatamoirogete Nyasae nigo biragombae, na omorero nosambe emechie y’abanchete amaaki.
swahili: Kwa kuwa jamii ya wasiomcha Mungu watakuwa tasa, nao moto utateketeza hema za wale wanaopenda rushwa.

english: They conceive trouble and give birth to evil; their womb is pregnant with deceit.”
ekegusii: Abanto abwo nigo bakoroberia amabe, barenta ogosaria; okwama kwabo bakorenta nokw’obong’ainereria.”
swahili: Hutunga mimba ya madhara na kuzaa uovu; matumbo yao huumba udanganyifu.”

english: But you even undermine the fear of God and hinder meditation before Him.
ekegusii: Aye nigo ogosiria okomoiroka Nyasae, naende gwatanga ogosaba ase obosio bwaye.
swahili: Lakini unadhoofisha hata uchaji wa Mungu na kuzuia ibada mbele za Mungu.

english: For your iniquity instructs your mouth, and you choose the language of the crafty.
ekegusii: Ebibe biao biorokereirie omonwa oo amang’ana ogokwana, aye gwachorire gokwana amang’ana y’obong’ainereria.
swahili: Dhambi yako inasukuma kinywa chako, nawe umechagua ulimi wa hila.

english: Your own mouth, not mine, condemns you; your own lips testify against you.
ekegusii: Tari inche ngokonachera ekiina, korende amang’ana aya ogokwana, ee, aya ogokwana nomonwa oo akobereire kirori.
swahili: Kinywa chako mwenyewe kinakuhukumu, wala si changu; midomo yako mwenyewe inashuhudia dhidi yako.

english: Were you the first man ever born? Were you brought forth before the hills?
ekegusii: “Inee! Naye ore omonto bw’eritang’ani koiborwa? Gose naye gwatongetwe ritang’ani ebitunwa bitarabao?
swahili: “Je, wewe ni mtu wa kwanza kuzaliwa? Ulizaliwa kabla ya vilima?

english: Do you listen in on the council of God or limit wisdom to yourself?
ekegusii: Inee! Kwana koigwa emeroberio y’obobisi bwa Nyasae? Aye nigo kwenyoreire obong’aini aye bweka?
swahili: Je, wewe husikiliza mashauri ya siri ya Mungu? Je, wewe unaizuia hekima iwe yako mwenyewe?

english: What do you know that we do not? What do you understand that is not clear to us?
ekegusii: Inee! Aye ninki omanyete intwe totamanyeti? Mbong’aini ki omanyete intwe totamanyeti?
swahili: Wewe unajua kitu gani tusichokijua sisi? Unafahamu kitu gani tusichokifahamu sisi?

english: Then Job answered:
ekegusii: Erio Ayubu akairaneria, akabora:
swahili: Kisha Ayubu akajibu:

english: They open their mouths against me and strike my cheeks with contempt; they join together against me.
ekegusii: Abanto nigo banyansameretie emenwa yabo, bang’akire chindoe ase chinsea. Bakondama; nigo bagosangererekana amo ng’a bankore bobe.
swahili: Watu wamenifumbulia vinywa vyao kunidhihaki; hunipiga shavuni mwangu kwa dharau, na kuungana pamoja dhidi yangu.

english: God has delivered me to unjust men; He has thrown me to the clutches of the wicked.
ekegusii: Nyasae ondure ase abanto batamoirogeti, ombekire ase amaboko abakori amabe.
swahili: Mungu amenigeuzia kwa watu wabaya, na kunitupa katika makucha ya waovu.

english: I was at ease, but He shattered me; He seized me by the neck and crushed me. He has set me up as His target;
ekegusii: Inche nigo narenge inde n’obotoereru, korende ere agansenyenta, ee, Nyasae akambwata ebigoti, akambutorana ebing’ese, bono onkorire nabeire ekerenga kiaye gekoraswa.
swahili: Mambo yote yalikuwa mazuri, lakini alinivunjavunja; amenikamata shingo na kuniponda. Amenifanya mimi kuwa shabaha yake;

english: His archers surround me. He pierces my kidneys without mercy and spills my gall on the ground.
ekegusii: Abaruti emegwe baye bang’etananire aande onsi, ombetire chinyigo chiane, tandorereti amaabera; oumoire amaache endorwe yane igoro ase riroba.
swahili: wapiga upinde wake wananizunguka. Bila huruma, huchoma figo zangu, na kuimwaga nyongo yangu juu ya nchi.

english: He breaks me with wound upon wound; He rushes me like a mighty warrior.
ekegusii: Ong’akire amaakwa igoro ase amaakwa ande; nigo akondindokera buna omorwani esegi ore ne chinguru.
swahili: Huniponda tena na tena; hunishambulia kama shujaa wa vita.

english: I have sewn sackcloth over my skin; I have buried my horn in the dust.
ekegusii: Bono natubire omobere one negunia, ne chinguru chiane nachitugutire ime ase orotu.
swahili: “Nimejishonea nguo ya gunia juu ya mwili wangu nami nimekizika kipaji cha uso wangu kwenye vumbi.

english: My face is red with weeping, and deep shadows ring my eyes;
ekegusii: Amaiso aane abariirire ase obosio bwane, na ekiriri kiarorekanire ase obosio bwane,
swahili: Uso wangu umekuwa mwekundu kwa kulia, macho yangu yamepigwa na giza kuu.

english: yet my hands are free of violence and my prayer is pure.
ekegusii: nonya tindakora bobe bonde namaboko aane, na ogosaba kwane kore ogoikeranu.
swahili: Hata hivyo mikono yangu haijafanya jeuri, na maombi yangu ni safi.

english: O earth, do not cover my blood; may my cry for help never be laid to rest.
ekegusii: Aye riroba, tobaisa gotuba amanyinga aane, na ekerero kiane tikenyora ase kegotimokera.
swahili: “Ee nchi, usiifunike damu yangu, nacho kilio changu kisinyamazishwe kamwe.

english: Even now my witness is in heaven, and my advocate is on high.
ekegusii: Rora, Kirori one igoro are nonya mbono, ee, Oyokondwanerera igoro are.
swahili: Hata sasa shahidi wangu yuko mbinguni; wakili wangu yuko juu.

english: “I have heard many things like these; miserable comforters are you all.
ekegusii: Inche naigure amang’ana amange buna ayio, inwe mwensi nigo more abaremia mogonchanda.
swahili: “Nimepata kusikia mambo mengi kama haya, nanyi nyote ni wafariji wenye kutaabisha!

english: My friends are my scoffers as my eyes pour out tears to God.
ekegusii: Nonya nabasani baane nigo bagonsekerera, inche nigo nkoiyeria amariga ndigereretie Nyasae.
swahili: Mwombezi wangu ni rafiki yangu macho yangu yamwagapo machozi kwa Mungu;

english: Oh, that a man might plead with God as he pleads with his neighbor!
ekegusii: Kirori one nansororere ase Nyasae, buna omonto agosororera omonto onde.
swahili: kwa niaba ya mtu anamsihi Mungu kama mtu anavyosihi kwa ajili ya rafiki yake.

english: For when only a few years are past I will go the way of no return.
ekegusii: Emiaka emeke netigarete, inche mbwatie enchera ekogenda aase ntanyare koirana korwao naende.
swahili: “Ni miaka michache tu itapita kabla sijaenda safari ambayo sitarudi.

english: Is there no end to your long-winded speeches? What provokes you to continue testifying?
ekegusii: Inee! Amang’ana ayio anga buna omwaga okogusa aerire? Gose nkere egekogoseegeta oiranerie ayande?
swahili: Je, maneno yenu mengi yasiyo na maana hayana mwisho? Mna nini hata mwendelee kushindana kwa maneno?

english: I could also speak like you if you were in my place; I could heap up words against you and shake my head at you.
ekegusii: Onye ndiria obogima bwaino bware koba ribaga ri’obwane, nanga nigo nakwana buna inwe; nigo nare gokwana amang’ana amange mamincha yaino na gosingisia omotwe one.
swahili: Mimi pia ningeweza kuzungumza kama ninyi, kama mngekuwa katika hali yangu; ningeweza kutoa hotuba nzuri dhidi yenu, na kuwatikisia ninyi kichwa changu.

english: But I would encourage you with my mouth, and the consolation of my lips would bring relief.
ekegusii: Amang’ana nare ngokwana korwa ase omonwa one, nigo are kobabeeka chinguru; ee, amabeebe ay’ebikoba igoro nigo are kobaremia.
swahili: Lakini kinywa changu kingewatia moyo; faraja kutoka midomoni mwangu, ingewaletea nafuu.

english: Even if I speak, my pain is not relieved, and if I hold back, how will it go away?
ekegusii: Ninsa koba ngokwana, obororo bwane tibogokea; na ninsa koremereria nkire, emechando yane tegokea nonya ng’ake.
swahili: “Lakini kama nikisema, maumivu yangu bado hayatulizwi; nami kama nikijizuia, wala hayaondoki.

english: Surely He has now exhausted me; You have devastated all my family.
ekegusii: Ekeene, Nyasae okoorire chinguru chiane, na osiririe abanto bonsi b’enka yane.
swahili: Ee Mungu, hakika umenichakaza; umewaangamiza kabisa watu wa nyumbani mwangu wote.

english: You have bound me, and it has become a witness; my frailty rises up and testifies against me.
ekegusii: Ere okorire omobere one obeire nemenia, na eyio yambereire kirori; oboreu bwane bwaorokeire ase obosio bwane kombera kirori.
swahili: Umenikunjakunja, nalo limekuwa ushahidi; nako kukonda kwangu kumeongezeka sana na kushuhudia dhidi yangu.

english: His anger has torn me and opposed me; He gnashes His teeth at me. My adversary pierces me with His eyes.
ekegusii: Omonene obeire nendamwamu ase ’nde, ontandoranire, naende ongechire; oromananirie amaino aye ase ’nde; omochandi one omogoreirie inche amaiso bobe.
swahili: Mungu amenishambulia na kunirarua katika hasira yake, na kunisagia meno yake; adui yangu hunikazia macho yake makali.

english: “My spirit is broken; my days are extinguished; the grave awaits me.
ekegusii: “Omoika ong’ereire, amatuko aane aikeire omoerio; oboina mbonganyete.
swahili: Moyo wangu umevunjika, siku zangu zimefupishwa, kaburi linaningojea.

english: But come back and try again, all of you. For I will not find a wise man among you.
ekegusii: Korende inwe mwensi, moirane gocha; tinkonyara konyora nonya nomonto oyomo ase egati yaino ore omong’aini.
swahili: “Lakini ninyi njooni, ninyi nyote, jaribuni tena! Sitampata mtu mwenye hekima miongoni mwenu.

english: My days have passed; my plans are broken off— even the desires of my heart.
ekegusii: Amatuko aane aetire, emeroberio yane yasarekire, nonya nokogania gw’enkoro yane.
swahili: Siku zangu zimepita, mipango yangu imevunjika, vivyo hivyo shauku za moyo wangu.

english: They have turned night into day, making light seem near in the face of darkness.
ekegusii: Abanto abwo baonchoire obotuko bwabeire omobaso; nigo bagoteeba ng’a omobaso nigo ore ang’e, korende omosunte noreo.
swahili: Watu hawa hufanya usiku kuwa mchana, kwenye giza wao husema, ‘Mwanga u karibu.’

english: If I look for Sheol as my home, if I spread out my bed in darkness,
ekegusii: Nonya inde nogosemeria, aase abakuure nao obomenyo bwane, nindambore oborere bwane ase omosunte ime.
swahili: Kama nyumba pekee ninayoitarajia ni kaburi, kama nikikitandika kitanda changu gizani,

english: and say to corruption, ‘You are my father,’ and to the worm, ‘My mother,’ or ‘My sister,’
