ekegusii: Ninteebie oboina: Naye tata Ninteebie amakonde: Ninwe baba na abaiseke baminto.
swahili: kama nikiuambia uharibifu, ‘Wewe u baba yangu,’ na kuliambia buu, ‘Wewe u mama yangu’ au ‘Dada yangu,’

english: where then is my hope? Who can see any hope for me?
ekegusii: Inee! Ng’ai rende ogosemeria kwane kore? Ning’o oranyare gokorora?
swahili: liko wapi basi tarajio langu? Ni nani awezaye kuona tarajio lolote kwa ajili yangu?

english: Will it go down to the gates of Sheol? Will we go down together into the dust?”
ekegusii: Ogosemeria okwo nigo koragende gochia aase abakuure. Nintirimboke amo nakorokwo gochia gotimoka ase riroba ime.”
swahili: Je, litashuka chini hadi kwenye malango ya mauti? Je, tutashuka pamoja mavumbini?”

english: Surely mockers surround me, and my eyes must gaze at their rebellion.
ekegusii: Ekeene, abachecheria bang’etananire, na amaiso aane nigo agendererete korora okogechia kwabo.
swahili: Hakika wenye mizaha wamenizunguka; macho yangu yamebaki kutazama uadui wao. Ayubu Anaomba Msaada

english: Give me, I pray, the pledge You demand. Who else will be my guarantor?
ekegusii: Aye omonyene obe ntenenera ase ’nde, imbe asore. Inee! Ning’o rende oranyare kwerua abe ntenenera ase ’nde?
swahili: “Ee Mungu, nipe dhamana unayodai. Ni nani mwingine atakayeweka dhamana kwa ajili yangu?

english: You have closed their minds to understanding; therefore You will not exalt them.
ekegusii: Aye gwasiekire ebirengererio biabo tibiba nokomanya, ase ayio tokobaimokereria igoro na kobaa okobua.
swahili: Umezifunga akili zao zisipate ufahamu, kwa hiyo hutawaacha wapate ushindi.

english: If a man denounces his friends for a price, the eyes of his children will fail.
ekegusii: Omonto ogosigaana abasani ase okwenyorera chinibo chiabo, amaiso abana babo nigo araukore.
swahili: Kama mtu akiwashutumu rafiki zake ili apate ujira, macho ya watoto wake yatashindwa kuona.

english: He has made me a byword among the people, a man in whose face they spit.
ekegusii: Omonene onkorire nabeire ring’ana abanto bakorabaara, nabeire oyo abanto bagochaaya ase ogotwa amate.
swahili: “Mungu amenifanya kitu cha dhihaka kwa kila mtu, mtu ambaye watu humtemea mate usoni.

english: My eyes have grown dim with grief, and my whole body is but a shadow.
ekegusii: Emechando yagerire amaiso aane abeire orotutu, na ebiimo biane bionsi biabeire buna omorengari bosa.
swahili: Macho yangu yamefifia kwa ajili ya majonzi; umbile langu lote ni kama kivuli.

english: The upright are appalled at this, and the innocent are stirred against the godless.
ekegusii: Abanto abaronge bakumirie amang’ana aya, ee, omonto otari na komocha oimokire gokorera bobe oria otamoirogeti Nyasae.
swahili: Watu wanyofu wanatishwa na hili; watu wasio na hatia wanasimama dhidi ya wasiomcha Mungu.

english: Yet a righteous one holds to his way, and the one with clean hands grows stronger.
ekegusii: Korende omonyene oboronge nabwaterere enchera yaye, na oyio obwate amaboko achenegete nagenderere koba ne chinguru.
swahili: Hata hivyo, waadilifu watazishika njia zao, nao wale wenye mikono safi wataendelea kupata nguvu.

english: Then Bildad the Shuhite replied:
ekegusii: Bilidadi Omosua akairaneria, akabora:
swahili: Bildadi Mshuhi akajibu:

english: A noose is hidden in the ground, and a trap lies in his path.
ekegusii: Engori y’ogotegerwa nebiswe ase riroba ase agotacha, na omotego otegwe ase enchera agoeta.
swahili: Kitanzi kimefichwa ardhini kwa ajili yake; mtego uko kwenye njia yake.

english: Terrors frighten him on every side and harass his every step.
ekegusii: Nabe okogoswa na kwoboigwa korwa ase chinsemo chionsi, nkomoseria atame namagoro.
swahili: Vitisho vimemtia hofu kila upande, na adui zake humwandama kila hatua.

english: His strength is depleted, and calamity is ready at his side.
ekegusii: Enchara nemorie goika chinguru chiaye chiere, na emechando nemobeere ang’e komoiyeria.
swahili: Janga linamwonea shauku; maafa yako tayari kwa ajili yake aangukapo.

english: It devours patches of his skin; the firstborn of death devours his limbs.
ekegusii: Oborwaire mbokoore risankwa ri’omobere oye, oborwaire obotang’ani bw’amakweri mbogundie ebiimo biaye.
swahili: Nayo yatakula sehemu ya ngozi yake; mzaliwa wa kwanza wa mauti atakula maungo yake.

english: He is torn from the shelter of his tent and is marched off to the king of terrors.
ekegusii: Nataboranwe ne chinguru korwa ase obomenyo konya asemeretie, erio airwe ase omorwoti bw’okwoboyia okonge.
swahili: Atangʼolewa kutoka usalama wa hema lake, na kupelekwa kwa mfalme wa vitisho.

english: Fire resides in his tent; burning sulfur rains down on his dwelling.
ekegusii: Enka yaye nebe bosa abanto abaao mbabe bakomenya aroro; amagena omorero nasiarerwe ase enka yaye.
swahili: Moto utakaa katika hema lake; moto wa kiberiti utamwagwa juu ya makao yake.

english: The roots beneath him dry up, and the branches above him wither away.
ekegusii: Emeri yaye ’nyome inse ye riroba, ne chinsagia chiaye nachisusane.
swahili: Mizizi yake chini itakauka na matawi yake juu yatanyauka.

english: The memory of him perishes from the earth, and he has no name in the land.
ekegusii: Oyio takoinyorwa ase ense nonya ng’ake, gose nonya nerieta riaye tirikogenderera koinyorwa agwo ase enchera.
swahili: Kumbukumbu lake litatoweka katika dunia, wala hatakuwa na jina katika nchi.

english: He is driven from light into darkness and is chased from the inhabited world.
ekegusii: Ere narusigwe korwa ase oborabu arutwe gochia ase omosunte; naende aserigwe korwa ase ense.
swahili: Ameondolewa nuruni na kusukumiwa gizani, naye amefukuzwa mbali atoke duniani.

english: He has no offspring or posterity among his people, no survivor where he once lived.
ekegusii: Takoba nomwana gose abanto b’ororeria rwaye ase egati y’abanto bamwabo, gose monto onde oye tagotigara ore moyo agwo ase amenyete.
swahili: Hana mtoto wala mzao miongoni mwa watu wake, wala aliyenusurika mahali alipoishi.

english: “How long until you end these speeches? Show some sense, and then we can talk.
ekegusii: “Inee! Ngoika ririri ogochia korigia amang’ana agokwanwa? Yarengererie, magega yaye naintwe tokwane.
swahili: “Je, ni lini utafika mwisho wa maneno haya? Uwe mwenye busara, nasi ndipo tutakapoweza kuongea.

english: Those in the west are appalled at his fate, while those in the east tremble in horror.
ekegusii: Abanto bamenyete bosongo mbakumie igoro ye rituko ri’ogosirigwa kwaye, na abamenyete moocha mbaondokigwe namang’ana ayio.
swahili: Watu wa magharibi watashangaa yaliyompata; watu wa mashariki watapatwa na hofu.

english: Surely such is the dwelling of the wicked and the place of one who does not know God.”
ekegusii: Ekeene, obomenyo bw’abatamoirogeti Nyasae nabo bore igo, na aase ay’abataganeti komomanya Nyasae nabo are igo.”
swahili: Hakika ndivyo yalivyo makao ya mtu mwovu; ndivyo palivyo mahali pake mtu asiyemjua Mungu.”

english: Why are we regarded as cattle, as stupid in your sight?
ekegusii: Nase ki tokobarwa koba buna ching’iti? Nase ki tokobarwa koba abanto batamanyeti gento kende?
swahili: Kwa nini sisi tunafikiriwa kama wanyama, na kuonekana wajinga machoni pako?

english: You who tear yourself in anger— should the earth be forsaken on your account, or the rocks be moved from their place?
ekegusii: Inee! Aye nigo ogwetandora ase engencho y’endamwamu yao, ense nigo egochia gotigwa bosa ase engencho yao? Gose egetare ngetigerigwe korwa aase aye?
swahili: Wewe unayejirarua mwenyewe vipande vipande katika hasira yako, je, dunia iachwe kwa ajili yako wewe? Au ni lazima miamba iondolewe mahali pake?

english: Indeed, the lamp of the wicked is extinguished; the flame of his fire does not glow.
ekegusii: “Amaene, omobaso bw’omokori amabe norime, gose amasase aye takobara.
swahili: “Taa ya mwovu imezimwa, nao mwali wa moto wake umezimika.

english: The light in his tent grows dark, and the lamp beside him goes out.
ekegusii: Oborabu bore ase obomenyo bwaye nigo borabe omosunte, na etaya yaye ere asare nerimigwe.
swahili: Mwanga hemani mwake umekuwa giza; taa iliyo karibu naye imezimika.

english: His vigorous stride is shortened, and his own schemes trip him up.
ekegusii: Amatambokero aye are ne chinguru nakeeigwe, na emeroberio yaye emoiyerie inse.
swahili: Nguvu za hatua zake zimedhoofishwa; shauri lake baya litamwangusha.

english: For his own feet lead him into a net, and he wanders into its mesh.
ekegusii: Amagoro aye nabwatwe nomotego, abe ogotaara ase egati ye chiirima.
swahili: Miguu yake imemsukumia kwenye wavu, naye anatangatanga kwenye matundu ya wavu.

english: A trap seizes his heel; a snare grips him.
ekegusii: Omotego nomobwate ase egetingiro na omoeto nomobwate omong’userere bokong’u.
swahili: Tanzi litamkamata kwenye kisigino; mtego utamshikilia kwa nguvu.

english: He tears me down on every side until I am gone; He uproots my hope like a tree.
ekegusii: Korwa ase chinsemo chionsi ong’iyeirie, bono inche nasirigwe; osimoire ogosemeria kwane buna omote ogosimorwa.
swahili: Amenibomoa kila upande hadi nimeisha; amelingʼoa tegemeo langu kama mti.

english: His anger burns against me, and He counts me among His enemies.
ekegusii: Obeire nekeririanda ekenene ase ’nde, na ombarire ng’a nomobisa oye inde.
swahili: Hasira yake imewaka juu yangu; amenihesabu kuwa miongoni mwa adui zake.

english: His troops advance together; they construct a ramp against me and encamp around my tent.
ekegusii: Ebiombe bi’abarwani baye b’esegi nigo bigocha bire amo, biabekire eburi ase ngoetera; biatoorire biang’etananire ase chinsemo chionsi chi’Obomenyo bwane.
swahili: Majeshi yake yananisogelea kwa nguvu; yamenizingira, yamepiga kambi kulizunguka hema langu.

english: He has removed my brothers from me; my acquaintances have abandoned me.
ekegusii: “Nyasae ogerire abaminto bantigire, bambeereire aare, na abanto twamanyaine bantigire, babeire buna tibamanyeti.
swahili: “Amewatenga ndugu zangu mbali nami; wale tunaojuana nao wamefarakana nami kabisa.

english: My kinsmen have failed me, and my friends have forgotten me.
ekegusii: Abanto baminto bantigire, na abasani twanchaine mono banyebire.
swahili: Watu wa jamaa yangu wamekwenda mbali; rafiki zangu wamenisahau.

english: My guests and maidservants count me as a stranger; I am a foreigner in their sight.
ekegusii: Abageni bamenyete mwane banyebire; na abasomba baane abaiseke bambarire buna omoeti; nabeire omomenyi ase amaiso abo.
swahili: Wageni wangu na watumishi wangu wa kike wananiona kama mgeni; wananitazama kama mgeni.

english: I call for my servant, but he does not answer, though I implore him with my own mouth.
ekegusii: Ekero nkorangeria omosomba one, ere tari kong’itabera, otatiga ekero namosoroire, nario rioka agocha.
swahili: Namwita mtumishi wangu, wala haitiki, ingawa namwomba kwa kinywa changu mwenyewe.

english: My breath is repulsive to my wife, and I am loathsome to my own family.
ekegusii: Omoika okorwa ase omonwa one nigo ogotiokera omokungu one bobe; nigo inde okogechia ase abamura baminto torwete enda eyemo.
swahili: Pumzi ya kinywa changu ni kinyaa kwa mke wangu; nimekuwa chukizo mno kwa ndugu zangu mwenyewe.

english: Even little boys scorn me; when I appear, they deride me.
ekegusii: Nonya n’abana abake banchayire; ekero ngotenena nigo bagonkwana bobe.
swahili: Hata watoto wadogo hunidhihaki; ninapojitokeza, hunifanyia mzaha.

english: All my best friends despise me, and those I love have turned against me.
ekegusii: Abasani abagisangio banyinyerire na kogechigwa nainche; nabwo nanchete bang’onchokeire na gonkora bobe.
swahili: Rafiki zangu wa moyoni wote wananichukia kabisa; wale niwapendao wamekuwa kinyume nami.

english: “How long will you torment me and crush me with your words?
ekegusii: “Inee! Ngoika ririri morabe mokogechia omoyo one na mogonsenyenta namang’ana aino?
swahili: “Je, mtaendelea kunitesa mpaka lini, na kuniponda kwa maneno yenu?

english: My skin and flesh cling to my bones; I have escaped by the skin of my teeth.
ekegusii: Amauga ’omobere one atongononire ase risankwa ne chinyama, natigeirwe egesabo getubete amaino gioka.
swahili: Mimi nimebaki mifupa na ngozi tu; nimeponea nikiwa karibu kufa.

english: Have pity on me, my friends, have pity, for the hand of God has struck me.
ekegusii: Inwe abasani baane, ndorera amabeebe, ndorera amabeebe, ekiagera okoboko kwa Nyasae kwang’akire!
swahili: “Nihurumieni, rafiki zangu, kuweni na huruma, kwa kuwa mkono wa Mungu umenipiga.

english: Why do you persecute me as God does? Will you never get enough of my flesh?
ekegusii: Nase ki nainwe mogonchanda buna Nyasae anchandire? Inee! Timoisanegeti ase ogonchanda omobere one?
swahili: Kwa nini mnanifuatia kama Mungu afanyavyo? Hamtosheki kamwe na mwili wangu?

english: I wish that my words were recorded and inscribed in a book,
ekegusii: “Naki yare koba buya onye amang’ana aane narikwa bono! Yare koba buya arikwe ase egetabu,
swahili: “Laiti maneno yangu yangewekwa kwenye kumbukumbu, laiti kwamba yangeandikwa kwenye kitabu,

english: by an iron stylus on lead, or chiseled in stone forever.
ekegusii: ee, arikwe nekaramu eroisirie korwa ase risasi, ekioma egekong’u, amang’erwe ase egetare abeo kare na kare.
swahili: kwamba yangechorwa kwenye risasi kwa kifaa cha chuma, au kuyachonga juu ya mwamba milele!

english: But I know that my Redeemer lives, and in the end He will stand upon the earth.
ekegusii: “Korende nimanyete ng’a Omobooria one moyo are, omoerio nigo aratenene igoro ye riroba.
swahili: Ninajua kwamba Mkombozi wangu yu hai, naye kwamba mwishoni atasimama juu ya nchi.

english: Even after my skin has been destroyed, yet in my flesh I will see God.
ekegusii: Nyuma risankwa ri’omobere one korirabe riasarekire, erio nindore Nyasae ’nde ase omobere one.
swahili: Nami baada ya ngozi yangu kuharibiwa, bado nikiwa na mwili huu nitamwona Mungu;

english: I will see Him for myself; my eyes will behold Him, and not as a stranger. How my heart yearns within me!
ekegusii: Nimwerorere inche omonyene; amaiso aane namorigererie, ayane, tari ay’omonto omoao. “Nimoganetie mono ase enkoro yane ime.
swahili: mimi nitamwona kwa macho yangu mwenyewe: mimi, wala si mwingine. Tazama jinsi moyo wangu unavyomtamani sana!

english: If you say, ‘Let us persecute him, since the root of the matter lies with him, ’
ekegusii: Moise goteeba: Nase nchera ki tokomochanda? Nigo mokorengereria ng’a ninche nagerire amabe onsi anyorire?
swahili: “Kama mkisema, ‘Tazama tutakavyomwinda, maadamu mzizi wa tatizo uko ndani yake,’

english: then you should fear the sword yourselves, because wrath brings punishment by the sword, so that you may know there is a judgment.”
ekegusii: Inwe iroka ogoitwa n’omoro, ekiagera oyore nekeririanda nigo akoegwa egesusuro ki’ogoitwa nemioro; erio monyare komanya ng’a okogambigwa nkoreo.”
swahili: ninyi wenyewe uogopeni upanga, kwa kuwa ghadhabu italeta adhabu kwa upanga, nanyi ndipo mtakapojua kwamba kuna hukumu.”

english: Ten times now you have reproached me; you shamelessly mistreat me.
ekegusii: Mwabeire mogonchecheria ara ikomi. Inee! Timori korora obosooku gonkorera bobe iga?
swahili: Mara kumi hizi mmenishutumu; bila aibu mnanishambulia.

english: Even if I have truly gone astray, my error concerns me alone.
ekegusii: Ee, nonya ekeene nakorire okomocha, okomocha okwo nokwane inche omonyene.
swahili: Kama ni kweli nimepotoka, kosa langu ninabaki kuhusika nalo mwenyewe.

english: If indeed you would exalt yourselves above me and use my disgrace against me,
ekegusii: Inwe onye mogwetogia ng’a nabaya more kombua na kong’enekeria igo kobwatekana nogochaywa kwane,
swahili: Kama kweli mngejitukuza wenyewe juu yangu, na kutumia unyonge wangu dhidi yangu,

english: then understand that it is God who has wronged me and drawn His net around me.
ekegusii: rirorio momanye ng’a Nyasae orentire amabe aya ase ’nde, na ontegire noboreba bwaye.
swahili: basi jueni kuwa Mungu amenitendea yaliyo mabaya, naye amekokota wavu wake kunizunguka.

english: Though I cry out, ‘Violence!’ I get no response; though I call for help, there is no justice.
ekegusii: Rora, nigo nkorera mono ngoteeba: Nakoreirwe bobe, korende tindi koiranerigwa; nigo nkorangeria neriogi rinene ng’a nkonywe, korende ekeene, oboronge tibori gokorwa.
swahili: “Ingawa ninalia, ‘Nimetendewa mabaya!’ sipati jibu; ingawa ninaomba msaada, hakuna haki.

english: He has blocked my way so I cannot pass; He has veiled my paths with darkness.
ekegusii: Nyasae oagachire orwaki aase ngoeta, obeekire omosunte ase ebinchera ngoeta.
swahili: Yeye ameizuia njia yangu hivyo siwezi kupita; ameyafunika mapito yangu na giza.

english: He has stripped me of my honor and removed the crown from my head.
ekegusii: Ong’urire obonene bwane. Orusirie egutwa korwa ase omotwe one.
swahili: Amenivua heshima yangu, na kuniondolea taji kichwani pangu.

english: There was a man in the land of Uz whose name was Job. And this man was blameless and upright, fearing God and shunning evil.
ekegusii: Ase ense ya Usi narengeo omonto ore korokwa Ayubu. Omonto oyio nigo arenge omwegenwa, na nigo abwate enkoro endonge; nigo amoirogete Nyasae, agetanga korwa ase ogokora amabe.
swahili: Katika nchi ya Usi paliishi mtu ambaye aliitwa Ayubu. Mtu huyu alikuwa hana hatia, naye alikuwa mkamilifu; alimcha Mungu na kuepukana na uovu.

english: Have You not placed a hedge on every side around him and his household and all that he owns? You have blessed the work of his hands, and his possessions have increased in the land.
ekegusii: Aye nigo omorendete na komokengera ase chinsemo chionsi, ere amo nabaanto b’enyomba yaye yonsi, na gento kende gionsi abwate. Ee, nigo osesenetie emeremo yaye yonsi agokora, naende gwakorire enibo yaye yamentekanire mono ase ense.
swahili: Je, wewe hukumjengea boma pande zote yeye na wa nyumbani mwake pamoja na kila kitu alicho nacho? Kazi za mikono yake umezibariki na hivyo makundi yake ya kondoo na mbuzi pamoja na ya wanyama yameenea katika nchi nzima.

english: But stretch out Your hand and strike all that he has, and he will surely curse You to Your face.”
ekegusii: Bono aye rambora okoboko kwao, okune ebinto bionsi abwate obisirie, ekeene, ere goika akoragererie agwo ase obosio bwao.”
swahili: Lakini nyoosha mkono wako na kupiga kila kitu alicho nacho, naye kwa hakika atakulaani mbele za uso wako.”

english: “Very well,” said the LORD to Satan. “Everything he has is in your hands, but you must not lay a hand on the man himself.” Then Satan went out from the presence of the LORD. Job Loses His Children and Possessions
ekegusii: Agwo Omonene agateebia Saitani, igo mbuya, “Rora, ebinto bionsi Ayubu abwate bono nigo bire inse y’okobua kwao, korende ere omonyene tobaisa komokuna.” Erio Saitani akarua agwo ase obosio bw’Omonene, akagenda. Abana b’Ayubu bagosirigwa amo nenibo yaye
swahili: Bwana akamwambia Shetani, “Vema sana, kwa hiyo, kila kitu alicho nacho kiko mikononi mwako, lakini juu ya huyo mtu mwenyewe usimguse hata kwa kidole.” Ndipo Shetani akatoka mbele za Bwana.

english: One day, while Job’s sons and daughters were eating and drinking wine in their oldest brother’s house,
ekegusii: Rituko erimo ekero abana b’Ayubu, abamura na abaiseke, babwate omoyega bw’okoria na konywa edivai ase enyomba ya momura omwabo omonene,
swahili: Siku moja watoto wa Ayubu walipokuwa wakifanya karamu wakila na kunywa divai katika nyumba ya ndugu yao mkubwa,

english: a messenger came and reported to Job: “While the oxen were plowing and the donkeys were grazing nearby,
ekegusii: omonto obwate amang’ana akaminyoka gochia ase Ayubu, akamoteebia, “Chiombe nigo chiarenge korema, ne chitigere nigo chiarenge korisia ang’e ase chiombe chiria.
swahili: akaja mjumbe kwa Ayubu na kusema, “Maksai walikuwa wakilima na punda walikuwa wakilisha karibu nao,

english: the Sabeans swooped down and took them away. They put the servants to the sword, and I alone have escaped to tell you!”
ekegusii: Abanto ba Seba bacha mobasokano, baira chitugo chionsi, naende baita abasomba nemioro; ninche bweka natigara inde moyo, natama gocha kogoteebia.”
swahili: Waseba wakawashambulia na kuchukua mifugo. Kisha wakawaua watumishi kwa upanga, nami ndimi peke yangu niliyenusurika kukuletea habari!”

english: While he was still speaking, another messenger came and reported: “The fire of God fell from heaven. It burned and consumed the sheep and the servants, and I alone have escaped to tell you!”
ekegusii: Ekero oyio agendererete gokwana, omonto onde agacha, agateeba, “Omorero o Nyasae nigo ogwa korwa igoro, osamba ching’ondi chiayia chiaera, naende boigo osamba abasomba bayia baera; ninche bweka natigara, natama gocha kogoteebia.”
swahili: Alipokuwa bado ananena, mjumbe mwingine akaja na kusema, “Moto wa Mungu ulishuka kutoka mbinguni na kuteketeza kondoo na watumishi, nami ndimi peke yangu niliyenusurika kukuletea habari!”

english: While he was still speaking, another messenger came and reported: “The Chaldeans formed three bands, raided the camels, and took them away. They put the servants to the sword, and I alone have escaped to tell you!”
ekegusii: Na ekero noyio agendererete gokwana, omonto onde agacha, agateebia Ayubu, “Abakalidayo nigo bachicha bare ebiombe bitato, baumokera chingamia, bachiira, naende baita abasomba bande nemioro; ninche bweka natigara inde moyo, natama gocha kogoteebia.”
swahili: Alipokuwa bado ananena, mjumbe mwingine akaja na kusema, “Wakaldayo waliunda vikosi vitatu vya uvamizi na kuwaangukia ngamia wako na kuwachukua wakaondoka nao. Wakawaua watumishi kwa upanga, nami ndimi peke yangu niliyenusurika kukuletea habari.”

english: While he was still speaking, another messenger came and reported: “Your sons and daughters were eating and drinking wine in their oldest brother’s house,
ekegusii: Ekero noyio agendererete gokwana, omonto onde agacha, agateebia Ayubu, “Abana bao, abamura na abaiseke, nigo babwate omoyega bw’okoria na konywa edivai ase enyomba ya momura omwabo omonene;
swahili: Alipokuwa bado ananena, mjumbe mwingine akaja na kusema, “Wana wako na binti zako walipokuwa wakifanya karamu, wakila na kunywa divai katika nyumba ya ndugu yao mkubwa,

english: when suddenly a mighty wind swept in from the desert and struck the four corners of the house. It collapsed on the young people and they are dead, and I alone have escaped to tell you!”
ekegusii: bono omwaga bw’echinguru ocha korwa ase erooro, onyegeria chikoona inye chi’enyomba eria, erinde yagwera abana abwo abasae, bakuure bonsi; ninche bweka natigara inde moyo, natama gocha kogoteebia.”
swahili: ghafula upepo wenye nguvu ukavuma kutoka jangwani, nao ukaipiga nyumba hiyo pembe zake nne. Ikawaangukia hao watoto nao wamekufa, nami ndimi peke yangu niliyenusurika kukuletea habari!”

english: He had seven sons and three daughters,
ekegusii: Ere nabwate abana abamura batano na babere, na abaiseke batato.
swahili: Alikuwa na wana saba na binti watatu,

english: Then Job stood up, tore his robe, and shaved his head. He fell to the ground and worshiped,
ekegusii: Erio Ayubu akaimoka, agatandora eanga yaye, agakigita etukia yaye, erio agatung’ama inse, agasasiima,
swahili: Ndipo Ayubu akasimama, akararua joho lake na kunyoa nywele zake. Kisha akaanguka chini katika kuabudu

english: saying: “Naked I came from my mother’s womb, and naked I will return. The LORD gave, and the LORD has taken away. Blessed be the name of the LORD.”
ekegusii: agateeba, “Nigo narwete ase enda ya baba inde getirianda, naende nigo ndairane korwa ase ense inde getirianda. Omonene nere oruete, naende oirire. Erieta riaye ritogigwe.”
swahili: na kusema: “Nilitoka tumboni mwa mama yangu uchi, nami nitaondoka uchi, Bwana alinipa, naye Bwana ameviondoa, jina la Bwana litukuzwe.”

english: In all this, Job did not sin or charge God with wrongdoing.
ekegusii: Ase amang’ana ayio onsi Ayubu takorete ebibe, gose tabeekerete Nyasae obobe.
swahili: Katika mambo haya yote, Ayubu hakutenda dhambi kwa kumlaumu Mungu kwa kufanya ubaya.

english: and he owned 7,000 sheep, 3,000 camels, 500 yoke of oxen, 500 female donkeys, and a very large number of servants. Job was the greatest man of all the people of the East.
ekegusii: Naende nabwate ching’ondi chilifu isano na ibere (7,000), ne chingamia chilifu isato (3,000), ne chiombe elifu eyemo (1,000), ne chitigere chiaberi amagana atano (500); naende nabwate abasomba abange mono. Ase ayio omonto oyio nigo arenge omonda mono kobua abanto bonsi bamenyete ase ense ya Moocha.
swahili: naye alikuwa na kondoo elfu saba, ngamia elfu tatu, jozi mia tano za maksai, na punda mia tano, tena alikuwa na idadi kubwa ya watumishi. Alikuwa mtu mkuu sana miongoni mwa watu wa Mashariki.

english: Job’s sons would take turns holding feasts in their homes, and they would invite their three sisters to eat and drink with them.
ekegusii: Abamura ba Ayubu nigo banarete gokora emeyega ase chibisi, kera oyomo ase rituko riaye ase enyomba yaye. Nigo barenge korangeria abaiseke bamwabo baria batato bacha koragera na konywa amo nabarabwo kera engaki.
swahili: Wanawe walikuwa na desturi ya kufanya karamu katika nyumba zao kwa zamu, nao wangewaalika umbu zao watatu ili kula na kunywa pamoja nao.

english: And when the days of feasting were over, Job would send for his children to purify them, rising early in the morning to offer burnt offerings for all of them. For Job thought, “Perhaps my children have sinned and cursed God in their hearts.” This was Job’s regular practice. Satan’s First Attack
ekegusii: Nyuma ya kera omoyega koerire, mambia chuni Ayubu nigo arenge korangeria abana baye nakobaruera ekeng’wanso ase kera oyomo ase okobachena. Nigo arenge gokora igo, ekiagera arenge korengereria, oteeba, “Ande nebe ng’a onde bw’abana baane okorire ebibe, oramire Nyasae ase enkoro yaye ime.” Naboigo Ayubu arenge gokora botambe.
swahili: Wakati kipindi cha karamu kilimalizika, Ayubu angetuma waitwe na kuwafanyia utakaso. Angetoa dhabihu ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa kwa ajili ya kila mmoja wao asubuhi na mapema, akifikiri, “Pengine wanangu wametenda dhambi na kumlaani Mungu mioyoni mwao.” Hii ilikuwa ndiyo desturi ya kawaida ya Ayubu. Jaribu La Kwanza La Ayubu

english: One day the sons of God came to present themselves before the LORD, and Satan also came with them.
ekegusii: Bono ekaba ng’a rituko erimo ekero abamura ba Nyasae bachete kweorokia ase obosio bw’Omonene, Saitani nere agacha agwo ase baare.
swahili: Siku moja wana wa Mungu walikwenda kujionyesha mbele za Bwana. Shetani naye akaja pamoja nao.

english: “Where have you come from?” said the LORD to Satan. “From roaming through the earth,” he replied, “and walking back and forth in it.”
ekegusii: Erio Omonene akaboria Saitani, “Naye ng’ai okorwa?” Saitani akamoiraneria, “Nigo nkorwa ase etaaro yane, nkona‐goetanana ase ense yonsi, naende nabo nkonagotiira na gotirimboka aroro.”
swahili: Bwana akamwambia Shetani, “Umetoka wapi?” Shetani akamjibu Bwana, “Natoka kuzunguka pote duniani, nikitembea huku na huko humo.”

english: Then the LORD said to Satan, “Have you considered My servant Job? For there is no one on earth like him, a man who is blameless and upright, who fears God and shuns evil.”
ekegusii: Agw’Omonene akabooria Saitani, “Ayubu, omosomba one, kwarorire buna are? Monto onde tari ase ense onga buna ere; nigo are omwegenwa, na obwate enkoro endonge; ere nigo anyirogete inche Nyasae, naende nigo etangete korwa ase ogokora amabe.”
swahili: Ndipo Bwana akamwambia Shetani, “Je, umemwangalia huyo mtumishi wangu Ayubu? Hakuna mtu mwingine duniani aliye kama yeye, asiye na hatia, ni mnyofu, mwenye kumcha Mungu, na kuepukana na uovu.”

english: Satan answered the LORD, “Does Job fear God for nothing?
ekegusii: Erio Saitani akairaneria, agateebia Omonene, “Inee! Ayubu nigo agosigete aye Nyasae ngencho etaiyo?
swahili: Shetani akamjibu Bwana, “Je, Ayubu anamcha Mungu bure?

english: Then Zophar the Naamathite replied:
ekegusii: Erio Sofari Omonaama akairaneria, akabora:
swahili: Ndipo Sofari Mnaamathi akajibu:

english: His sons will seek the favor of the poor, for his own hands must return his wealth.
ekegusii: Abana baye mbabe bagosaberera korwa ase abataka, na amaboko aye nairanie obotenenku bwaye bwonsi.
swahili: Watoto wake watalipa yote baba yao aliyowadhulumu maskini, nayo mikono yake itarudisha mali yote aliyonyangʼanya watu.

english: The youthful vigor that fills his bones will lie down with him in the dust.
ekegusii: Amauga aye nigo aichire ne chinguru chi’oboke bwaye, korende chinguru echio nigo chiraraare nere ase riroba.
swahili: Nguvu za ujana zilizoijaza mifupa yake, zitalala naye mavumbini.

english: Though evil is sweet in his mouth and he conceals it under his tongue,
ekegusii: “Nonya obobe bore obwansu ase omonwa oye ime, nabobise inse y’oromeme rwaye,
swahili: “Ingawa uovu ni mtamu kinywani mwake naye huuficha chini ya ulimi wake,

english: though he cannot bear to let it go and keeps it in his mouth,
ekegusii: nonya obwatererete obobe obwo bokong’u, takobotiga, korende nabogache ase omonwa oye ime,
swahili: ingawa hawezi kukubali kuuachia uende, lakini huuweka kinywani mwake.

english: yet in his stomach his food sours into the venom of cobras within him.
ekegusii: endagera eyio nigo erarore se ase enda yaye, ebe buna obosongo bw’eng’iti engenda inse ime yaye.
swahili: Hata hivyo chakula chake kitakuwa kichungu tumboni mwake, nacho kitakuwa sumu kali ya nyoka ndani yake.

english: He swallows wealth but vomits it out; God will force it from his stomach.
ekegusii: Ere nigo akomera chinibo, naende ochiroka; Nyasae nigo agochiseria korwao.
swahili: Atatema mali alizozimeza; Mungu atalifanya tumbo lake kuzitapika.

english: He will suck the poison of cobras; the fangs of a viper will kill him.
ekegusii: Omonto oyio nanyunyunte obosongo bw’eng’iti nomonwa, na obosongo bokorwa ase oromeme rw’eng’iti eria mbomoite.
swahili: Atanyonya sumu za majoka; meno ya nyoka mwenye sumu kali yatamuua.

english: He will not enjoy the streams, the rivers flowing with honey and cream.
ekegusii: Ere takwegokia ase okorora chindooche, chinsoko chiichire namooke na amabeere.
swahili: Hatafurahia vijito, mito inayotiririsha asali na siagi.

english: He must return the fruit of his labor without consuming it; he cannot enjoy the profits of his trading.
ekegusii: Ebinto akoreire emeremo emekong’u nabiiranie, takobimera, gose takonyara kwegokeria ebitoki biria anyorire.
swahili: Vile alivyovitaabikia atavirudisha bila kuvila; hatafurahia faida itokanayo na biashara yake.

english: For he has oppressed and forsaken the poor; he has seized houses he did not build.
ekegusii: Ekiagera obeire ogokorera abataka bobe na kobatiga bare bosa, naende obeire okoira ne chinguru enyomba ende yonsi ere ataagachete.
swahili: Kwa kuwa aliwaonea maskini na kuwaacha pasipo kitu; amenyangʼanya kwa nguvu nyumba asizozijenga.

english: “So my anxious thoughts compel me to answer, because of the turmoil within me.
ekegusii: “Bono ebirengererio bire ime yane bianchandire, ase ayio biagerire imbe omwango koiraneria.
swahili: “Mawazo yanayonisumbua yananisukuma kujibu, kwa sababu nimehangaika sana.

english: Because his appetite is never satisfied, he cannot escape with his treasure.
ekegusii: Ekeene, ribero ri’omonto oyio riagerire taba n’obotoereru, takonyara kogaacha gento kende gekomogokia.
swahili: “Hakika hatakuwa na raha katika kutamani kwake sana; hawezi kujiokoa mwenyewe kwa hazina zake.

english: Nothing is left for him to consume; thus his prosperity will not endure.
ekegusii: Ekero arageire tari gotigaria kende, ase ayio obotenenku bwaye tibokogenderera.
swahili: Hakuna chochote kitakachosalia kwa ajili yake ili ale; kufanikiwa kwake hakutadumu.

english: In the midst of his plenty, he will be distressed; the full force of misery will come upon him.
ekegusii: Nebe ekero agendererete gotenenka mono nachandwe, na obokong’u obonge mbomochere.
swahili: Katikati ya wingi wa ustawi wake, dhiki itampata; taabu itamjia kwa nguvu zote.

english: When he has filled his stomach, God will vent His fury upon him, raining it down on him as he eats.
ekegusii: Nebe ng’a ekero aisire koigota, Nyasae namotomere ekeririanda gi’okogechigwa kwaye; egesusuro ekio nigo keramochere ekero agendererete koragera.
swahili: Atakapokuwa amelijaza tumbo lake, Mungu ataionyesha ghadhabu kali dhidi yake, na kumnyeshea mapigo juu yake.

english: Though he flees from an iron weapon, a bronze-tipped arrow will pierce him.
ekegusii: Nabe ogotama korwa ase ekerwanero gi’ekioma, abetwe nensara y’etai.
swahili: Ijapokuwa aikimbia silaha ya chuma, mshale wa shaba utamchoma.

english: It is drawn out of his back, the gleaming point from his liver. Terrors come over him.
ekegusii: Ensara eyio eng’uswe korwa ase omobere oye, ee, ensonga ekomesa nesokere ase endorwe yaye, erio ekeondoko ki’amakweri nakemosoe.
swahili: Atauchomoa katika mgongo wake, ncha ingʼaayo kutoka ini lake. Vitisho vitakuja juu yake;

english: Total darkness is reserved for his treasures. A fire unfanned will consume him and devour what is left in his tent.
ekegusii: Omosunte ekerima nigo ogacheire chinibo chiaye; omorero otautiri nonde nomosirie, na ebitigarete ase obomenyo bwaye mbisambwe biere.
swahili: giza nene linavizia hazina zake. Moto usiopepewa na mtu utamteketeza, na kuangamiza yaliyosalia nyumbani mwake.

english: The heavens will expose his iniquity, and the earth will rise up against him.
ekegusii: Igoro neorokie ebibe biaye maiso marore, na ense nemoimokere komorwania.
swahili: Mbingu zitaweka wazi hatia yake, nayo nchi itainuka kinyume chake.

english: The possessions of his house will be removed, flowing away on the day of God’s wrath.
ekegusii: Ebinto asangereretie ase enyomba yaye mbiirwe; bionsi nigo birairwe ase rituko ri’endamwamu ya Nyasae.
swahili: Mafuriko yataichukua nyumba yake, maji yaendayo kasi katika siku ya ghadhabu ya Mungu.

english: This is the wicked man’s portion from God, the inheritance God has appointed him.”
ekegusii: “Eke nakio egetari ki’omokori amabe gekorwa ase Nyasae, naende oyio noro omwando oye Nyasae amochikerete.”
swahili: Hili ndilo fungu Mungu alilowagawia waovu, urithi uliowekwa kwa ajili yao na Mungu.”

english: I have heard a rebuke that insults me, and my understanding prompts a reply.
ekegusii: Naigure ogokuurerwa gw’okonyomania ng’a inche nomomochi, korende omoika bw’okomanya ore ime yane ogerire ing’iranerie.
swahili: Ninasikia makaripio ambayo yananivunjia heshima, nao ufahamu wangu unanisukuma kujibu.

english: Do you not know that from antiquity, since man was placed on the earth,
ekegusii: Inee! Aye tikwana komanya ng’a korwa kare, ekero Mwanyabaanto babeegetwe ase ense,
swahili: “Hakika unajua jinsi ilivyokuwa tangu zamani, tangu zamani mwanadamu alipowekwa duniani,

english: the triumph of the wicked has been brief and the joy of the godless momentary?
ekegusii: omochengo bw’abakori amabe noyo bw’engaki enke, na omogooko bw’abatamoirogeti Nyasae nomweng’e?
swahili: macheko ya mtu mwovu ni ya muda mfupi, nayo furaha ya wasiomcha Mungu hudumu kwa kitambo tu.

english: Though his arrogance reaches the heavens, and his head touches the clouds,
ekegusii: Ere naisa koba nobonene boigete igoro, na omotwe oye oike ase amare,
swahili: Ingawa kujikweza kwake hufikia mbinguni na kichwa chake hugusa mawingu,

english: he will perish forever, like his own dung; those who had seen him will ask, ‘Where is he?’
ekegusii: goika asire kare na kare, buna obonyira bwaye bogosira. Abwo bamorooche mbaborie; Omonto oria, ng’ai are?
swahili: ataangamia milele kama mavi yake mwenyewe. Wale waliomwona watauliza, ‘Yuko wapi?’

english: He will fly away like a dream, never to be found; he will be chased away like a vision in the night.
ekegusii: Nigo arasire buna chindoto, takonyorekana, ee, nigo aragikerigwe buna amaroro a botuko.
swahili: Kama ndoto hutoweka, wala hapatikani tena, amefukuziwa mbali kama maono ya usiku.

english: The eye that saw him will see him no more, and his place will no longer behold him.
ekegusii: Eriso riarenge komoorora, tirikomoorora naende, gose aase aye takomorigereria naende.
swahili: Jicho lililomwona halitamwona tena; mahali pake hapatamwona tena.

english: Then Job answered:
ekegusii: Bono Ayubu akairaneria, akabora:
swahili: Ndipo Ayubu akajibu:

english: Their bulls breed without fail; their cows bear calves and do not miscarry.
ekegusii: Chiombe chiabo nigo chikonyora amarieme buya, naende chiabiara chitari korekera.
swahili: Madume yao ya ngʼombe huvyaza bila kushindwa kamwe; ngʼombe wao huzaa wala hawaharibu mimba.

english: They send forth their little ones like a flock; their children skip about,
ekegusii: Abana babo nigo bagotomwa isiko banga buna amaicho, nigo bakoba bagotenga.
swahili: Huwatoa watoto wao nje kama kundi; wadogo wao huchezacheza.

english: singing to the tambourine and lyre and making merry at the sound of the flute.
ekegusii: Nigo bagotera bakobugia chinchigiri na amakano, naende bagokera amariogi ’ebiroria.
swahili: Huimba nyimbo kwa matari na kwa kinubi, nao huifurahia sauti ya filimbi.

english: They spend their days in prosperity and go down to Sheol in peace.
ekegusii: Nigo bakogenderera kwegokia nobotenenku bwabo; bakwa bagenda aase abakuure bare nomorembe.
swahili: Huitumia miaka yao katika mafanikio nao hushuka kaburini kwa amani.

english: Yet they say to God: ‘Leave us alone! For we have no desire to know Your ways.
ekegusii: Barobwo nigo bagoteebia Nyasae: totige intwe! Titoganeti komanya chinchera chiao.
swahili: Lakini humwambia Mungu, ‘Tuache sisi!’ Hatuna haja ya kufahamu njia zako.

english: Who is the Almighty, that we should serve Him, and what would we gain if we pray to Him?’
ekegusii: Oria Omobui ninki are goika tomokorere? Mbitoki ki toranyore ase okomosaba?
swahili: Mwenyezi ni nani hata tumtumikie? Tutapata faida gani kumwomba?

english: Still, their prosperity is not in their own hands, so I stay far from the counsel of the wicked.
ekegusii: Rora, ogosesenigwa kwabo tikori ase amaboko abo; ogosemia kw’abakori amabe nigo kore aare nainche.
swahili: Lakini kufanikiwa kwao hakupo mikononi mwao wenyewe, hivyo najitenga mbali na shauri la waovu.

english: How often is the lamp of the wicked put out? Does disaster come upon them? Does God, in His anger, apportion destruction?
ekegusii: “Inee! Ng’ara karenga chitaaya chi’abakori amabe chikorimigwa? Ng’ara karenga emechando ekobacheera? Inee! Ara karenga Nyasae akobaa emechando ase engencho y’endamwamu yaye?
swahili: “Lakini ni mara ngapi taa ya waovu huzimwa? Ni mara ngapi maafa huwajia, yale yawapatayo ambayo Mungu huwapangia katika hasira yake?

english: Are they like straw before the wind, like chaff swept away by a storm?
ekegusii: Gose barabwo nkoirurukigwa bare buna chimboba, na buna omoiriro okoirurukigwa nomwaga?
swahili: Ni mara ngapi huwa kama majani makavu mbele ya upepo, kama makapi yachukuliwayo na dhoruba?

english: It is said that God lays up one’s punishment for his children. Let God repay the man himself, so he will know it.
ekegusii: “Inwe nigo mogoteeba ng’a Nyasae nigo akogachera abana ebibe bi’abaise. Tiga Omonene aakane abanto abanyene ebibe biabo, erio nario baranyare kobimanya.
swahili: Imesemekana, ‘Mungu huiweka akiba adhabu ya mtu kwa ajili ya wanawe.’ Mungu na amlipe mtu mwenyewe, ili apate kulijua!

english: “Listen carefully to my words; let this be your consolation to me.
ekegusii: Tegerera mono moigwe amang’ana aane, ayio naro arabe okoremia kwaino ase ’nde.
swahili: “Yasikilizeni maneno yangu kwa makini; hii na iwe faraja mnayonipa mimi.

english: Let his eyes see his own destruction; let him drink for himself the wrath of the Almighty.
ekegusii: Tiga barore ogosirigwa kwabo namaiso abo, naende banyoosigwe endamwamu y’Omonguru.
swahili: Macho yake mwenyewe na yaone maangamizi yake; yeye na ainywe ghadhabu ya Mwenyezi.

english: For what does he care about his household after him, when the number of his months has run out?
ekegusii: Ekero emetienyi yabo yaerire na bakuure, Inee, mbabe bagwechandera chinka chiabo?
swahili: Kwani anajali nini kuhusu jamaa anayoiacha nyuma, miezi yake aliyopangiwa ifikapo mwisho?

english: Can anyone teach knowledge to God, since He judges those on high?
ekegusii: Onde nare oranyare kworokereria Nyasae obong’aini, ere oria okogambia abwo bare igoro mono?
swahili: “Je, yuko mtu yeyote awezaye kumfundisha Mungu maarifa, iwapo yeye ndiye ahukumuye hata walio juu ya wote?

english: One man dies full of vigor, completely secure and at ease.
ekegusii: “Omonto oyomo nigo agokwa ore nobotenenku obonge, ore n’obotoereru bwonsi na orendire buya,
swahili: Mtu mmoja hufa akiwa na nguvu zake kamili, akiwa salama na mwenye raha kamili,

english: His body is well nourished, and his bones are rich with marrow.
ekegusii: ebirandi biaye biichire namabeere, na amauga ’omobere oye aichire nemeseto.
swahili: mwili wake ukiwa umenawiri, nayo mifupa yake ikiwa imejaa mafuta ndani yake.

english: Yet another man dies in the bitterness of his soul, having never tasted prosperity.
ekegusii: Omonto onde igo agokwa ore nobororo bw’omoyo oye, atana konyora amaya nonya ng’ake.
swahili: Mtu mwingine hufa katika uchungu wa nafsi, akiwa hajafurahia kamwe jambo lolote zuri.

english: But together they lie down in the dust, and worms cover them both.
ekegusii: Abwo bonsi nigo bakobeekwa ase riroba bareng’anetie, bagunda, na amakonde abatuba.
swahili: Hao wote hulala mavumbini, nao mabuu huwafunika wote.

english: Behold, I know your thoughts full well, the schemes by which you would wrong me.
ekegusii: “Rora, nimanyete ebirengererio biaino, na emeroberio yaino y’ogonkora bobe.
swahili: “Ninayajua kikamilifu yale mnayoyafikiri, mipango ambayo kwayo mngenitendea mabaya.

english: For you say, ‘Where now is the nobleman’s house, and where are the tents in which the wicked dwell?’
ekegusii: Inwe nigo mokoboria: Ng’ai enyomba y’omochandi oria ere? Naende: Ng’ai obomenyo bw’abakori amabe bore?
swahili: Mwasema, ‘Iko wapi sasa nyumba ya huyo mtu mkuu, mahema ambayo watu waovu walikaa?’

english: Have you never asked those who travel the roads? Do you not accept their reports?
ekegusii: “Inee! Inwe timori koboria abaeti chinchera, naende mwanchera oborori bwabo,
swahili: Je, hamkuwahi kuwauliza hao wanaosafiri? Je, hamkutafakari taarifa zao:

english: Bear with me while I speak; then, after I have spoken, you may go on mocking.
ekegusii: Remereria, erinde nkwane; na ngokoora gokwana, mogenderere gonchecheria.
swahili: Nivumilieni ninapozungumza, nami nikishazungumza, endeleeni kunidhihaki.

english: Indeed, the evil man is spared from the day of calamity, delivered from the day of wrath.
ekegusii: ng’a omokori amabe nigo akorendwa ekero emechando yachire, naende atoorigwe ase rituko ri’endamwamu?
swahili: kwamba mtu mwovu huepushwa kutoka siku ya maafa, kwamba huokolewa kutoka siku ya ghadhabu?

english: Who denounces his behavior to his face? Who repays him for what he has done?
ekegusii: Ning’o oranyare koorokeria omokori amabe chinchera chiaye? Ning’o oramoakane amabe ayio akorire?
swahili: Ni nani hulaumu matendo yake mbele ya uso wake? Ni nani ampatilizaye kwa yale aliyoyatenda?

english: He is carried to the grave, and watch is kept over his tomb.
ekegusii: Ekero arabeekwe ase oboina, oboina boria nigo boraarendwe.
swahili: Hupelekwa kaburini, nao ulinzi ukawekwa kwenye kaburi lake.

english: The clods of the valley are sweet to him; everyone follows behind him, and those before him are without number.
ekegusii: Amaroba erigoko nabe amansu asare; abanto bonsi mbamotunyane korwa magega, na omobaro bw’abamotang’anerete tori kobareka.
swahili: Udongo ulio bondeni ni mtamu kwake; watu wote watamfuata, nao umati wa watu usiohesabika umemtangulia.

english: So how can you comfort me with empty words? For your answers remain full of falsehood.”
ekegusii: “Nase ki rende mokondemia namang’ana abosa? Ayatigaire ase amairanerio aino nigo are oborimo bwoka.”
swahili: “Hivyo ninyi mnawezaje kunifariji kwa upuzi wenu? Hakuna kilichosalia cha majibu yenu isipokuwa uongo!”

english: Is my complaint against a man? Then why should I not be impatient?
ekegusii: Inee! Inche Mwanyabaanto nkwemurunganeria? Nase ki rende ndaremererie tinyemurungania?
swahili: “Je, kwani malalamiko yangu yanaelekezwa kwa mwanadamu? Kwa nini nisikose subira?

english: Look at me and be appalled; put your hand over your mouth.
ekegusii: Indigererie na moichanigwe; erio motube emenwa yaino namaboko, mokire.
swahili: Niangalieni mkastaajabu; mkaweke mkono juu ya vinywa vyenu.

english: When I remember, terror takes hold, and my body trembles in horror.
ekegusii: Ekero nkoinyora amang’ana aya, obwoba nigo bogonsoa, na omobere one oiguswa.
swahili: Ninapowaza juu ya hili, ninaogopa, nao mwili wangu unatetemeka.

english: Why do the wicked live on, growing old and increasing in power?
ekegusii: Nase ki abakori amabe bakogenderera koba moyo na kwegotera bare ne chinguru na okobua?
swahili: Kwa nini waovu wanaendelea kuishi, wakifikia umri wa uzee na kuendelea kuwa na nguvu?

english: Their descendants are established around them, and their offspring before their eyes.
ekegusii: Abana babo nigo bakoba nokogenderera okuya amo nabarabwo, na ororeria rwabo boigo.
swahili: Huwaona watoto wao wakithibitika wakiwa wamewazunguka, wazao wao mbele za macho yao.

english: Their homes are safe from fear; no rod of punishment from God is upon them.
ekegusii: Chinka chiabo nigo chire buya, bwoba tiboiyo, gose Nyasae tari kobaa egesusuro.
swahili: Nyumba zao zi salama wala hakuna hofu; fimbo ya Mungu haiko juu yao.

english: Then Eliphaz the Temanite replied:
ekegusii: Erio Elifasi Omotemani akairaneria, akabora:
swahili: Ndipo Elifazi Mtemani akajibu:

english: Therefore snares surround you, and sudden peril terrifies you;
ekegusii: Ase ayio emeeto yagoetananire, na obwoba bwa mobosokano nkogochanda bore.
swahili: Ndiyo sababu mitego imekuzunguka pande zote, hatari ya ghafula inakutia hofu,

english: it is so dark you cannot see, and a flood of water covers you.
ekegusii: Oborabu bwao bwabekirwe omosunte, goika tori korora, na amaache amange agotubire.
swahili: ndiyo sababu ni giza sana huwezi kuona, tena ndiyo sababu mafuriko ya maji yamekufunika.

english: Is not God as high as the heavens? Look at the highest stars, how lofty they are!
ekegusii: “Inee! Nyasae tari aaria igoro mono? Rigereria ching’enang’eni chia igoro buna chire aare mono!
swahili: “Je, Mungu hayuko katika mbingu za juu? Juu kuliko nyota zilizo juu sana!

english: Yet you say: ‘What does God know? Does He judge through thick darkness?
ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio aye nigo ogoteeba: Inki Nyasae amanyete? Nanyare konacha ekiina goetera ase omosunte ekerima?
swahili: Hivyo wewe wasema, ‘Mungu anajua nini?’ Je, yeye huhukumu katika giza kama hilo?

english: Thick clouds veil Him so He does not see us as He traverses the vault of heaven. ’
ekegusii: Amare amarito nigo amotubete, takonyara korora, naende nigo agotaara ase obokumbe bwa igoro.
swahili: Mawingu mazito ni pazia lake, hivyo hatuoni sisi atembeapo juu ya anga la dunia.

english: Will you stay on the ancient path that wicked men have trod?
ekegusii: “Inee! Nenchera enkoro ogochia kobwatia, eria abakori amabe babwatetie?
swahili: Je, utaifuata njia ya zamani, ambayo watu waovu waliikanyaga?

english: They were snatched away before their time, and their foundations were swept away by a flood.
ekegusii: Abwo nigo bataboretigwe engaki yabo konya etaraika; na oboroso bwabo bokairwa buna omogooko okoira.
swahili: Waliondolewa kabla ya wakati wao, misingi yao ikachukuliwa na mafuriko.

english: They said to God, ‘Depart from us. What can the Almighty do to us?’
ekegusii: Barabwo nigo bateebeetie Nyasae: Karue ase tore! Naende bakaboora: Inee! Ngento ki Omobui oyio aratokorere?
swahili: Walimwambia Mungu, ‘Tuache sisi! Huyo Mwenyezi aweza kutufanyia nini?’

english: But it was He who filled their houses with good things; so I stay far from the counsel of the wicked.
ekegusii: Nonya naboigo Nyasae konya oichoirie chinyomba chiabo n’ebinto ebiya. Ogosemia kw’abakori amabe tiga kobe aare nainche.
swahili: Lakini ndiye alizijaza nyumba zao na vitu vizuri, hivyo ninajitenga mbali na mashauri ya waovu.

english: The righteous see it and are glad; the innocent mock them:
ekegusii: Ekero abanyaboronge bakorora ayio, nigo bakogoka; ee, abwo batari na komocha nigo bagosekerera abakori amabe na kobachecheria,
swahili: “Wenye haki wanaona maangamizi yao na kufurahi, nao wasio na hatia huwadhihaki, wakisema,

english: “Can a man be of use to God? Can even a wise man benefit Him?
ekegusii: “Inee! Nenyarekane ng’a omonto abe nengencho ase Nyasae? Ekeene, omonto oria ore nobong’aini nigo akwegwenera ere bweka omonyene.
swahili: “Je, mwanadamu aweza kuwa wa faida kwa Mungu? Je, hata mtu mwenye hekima aweza kumfaidi?

english: ‘Surely our foes are destroyed, and fire has consumed their excess.’
ekegusii: bateba: Amaene, ababisa baito basirigwe kegima, na ebinto biabo biatigarete biasambirwe nomorero.
swahili: ‘Hakika adui zetu wameangamizwa, nao moto umeteketeza mali zao.’

english: Reconcile now and be at peace with Him; thereby good will come to you.
ekegusii: “Obwatane na Nyasae, nario orabe nomorembe; korakore igo, nonyore amaya.
swahili: “Mjue sana Mungu ili uwe na amani, ndipo mema yatakapokujia.

english: Receive instruction from His mouth, and lay up His words in your heart.
ekegusii: Ancha amorokererio akorwa ase omonwa oye; gacha amang’ana aye ime ase enkoro yao.
swahili: Uyapokee mafundisho toka kinywani mwake, na maneno yake uyaweke moyoni mwako.

english: If you return to the Almighty, you will be restored. If you remove injustice from your tents
ekegusii: Korairanere Omobui, noiranerigwe amaya ao; korende oserie obobe korwa ase obomenyo bwao.
swahili: Kama ukimrudia Mwenyezi, utarudishwa upya: Kama ukiuondoa uovu uwe mbali na hema lako,

english: and consign your gold to the dust and the gold of Ophir to the stones of the ravines,
ekegusii: Otugute chitaabu chiao ime ase amaroba, ne chitaabu chikorwa Ofiri ochibeke ase egati y’amagena ’ebirooche,
swahili: kama dhahabu yako ukiihesabu kama mavumbi, dhahabu yako ya Ofiri kama miamba ya mabondeni,

english: then the Almighty will be your gold and the finest silver for you.
ekegusii: erinde Omobui bweka abe etaabu yao, na efeta yao ere nengencho enene.
swahili: ndipo Mwenyezi atakuwa dhahabu yako, naye atakuwa fedha yako iliyo bora.

english: Surely then you will delight in the Almighty and lift up your face to God.
ekegusii: Rirorio nobe gokwegokia ase Omobui oria, onyare korigereria Nyasae.
swahili: Hakika ndipo utakapojifurahisha kwa Mwenyezi, nawe utamwinulia Mungu uso wako.

english: You will pray to Him, and He will hear you, and you will fulfill your vows.
ekegusii: Na ekero orabe gokomosaba, nakoigwe; naye nonyare goakana chiira chiao chi’ogotiana.
swahili: Utamwomba yeye, naye atakusikia, nawe utazitimiza nadhiri zako.

english: Your decisions will be carried out, and light will shine on your ways.
ekegusii: Erio ekero orabe gokoroberia gokora gento kende gionsi, ekio nkebe bo, na oborabu mbomoreke chinchera chiao.
swahili: Utakusudia jambo nalo litatendeka, nao mwanga utaangazia njia zako.

english: When men are brought low and you say, ‘Lift them up!’ then He will save the lowly.
ekegusii: Nyasae nigo agokeyia abaenenu, korende abare abaitongo obatooria.
swahili: Watu watakaposhushwa, nawe ukasema, ‘Wainue!’ ndipo atamwokoa aliyevunjika moyo.

english: Does it delight the Almighty that you are righteous? Does He profit if your ways are blameless?
ekegusii: Inee! Omogoko onde nore ase Omonguru ng’a nomonyaboronge ore? Gose inki aranyore onye aye kogokora chinchera chiao chibe ching’ikeranu?
swahili: Je, Mwenyezi angefurahia nini kama ungekuwa mwadilifu? Au je, yeye angepata faida gani kama njia zako zingekuwa kamilifu?

english: He will deliver even one who is not innocent, rescuing him through the cleanness of your hands.”
ekegusii: Ere nigo agotooria omonto ore nokomocha, omonto buna oyio nigo aratoorigwe goetera ase amaboko ao achenegete.”
swahili: Atamwokoa hata yule ambaye ana hatia, ataokolewa kwa sababu ya usafi wa mikono yako.”

english: Is it for your reverence that He rebukes you and enters into judgment against you?
ekegusii: Inee! Nigo okagete ng’a nekiagera omoirogete, nakio gekogera agokoa egesusuro na gokorenta ase ekiina?
swahili: “Je, ni kwa ajili ya utaua wako ndiyo maana anakukemea na kuleta mashtaka dhidi yako?

english: Is not your wickedness great? Are not your iniquities endless?
ekegusii: Inee! Amabe gwakorire tari amanene? Ekeene, ebibe biao tibiri nomoerio.
swahili: Je, uovu wako si mkuu? Dhambi zako si hazina mwisho?

english: For you needlessly demanded security from your brothers and deprived the naked of their clothing.
ekegusii: Aye kwairire bosa ebinto abamino baruete bibe ntenenera, naende kwabachaboire chianga, kwabatigire gesobono.
swahili: Umedai dhamana kwa ndugu zako bila sababu; umewavua watu nguo zao, ukawaacha uchi.

english: You gave no water to the weary and withheld food from the famished,
ekegusii: Oyo konya orosire tomoeti amaache anywe, na oyo orenge nenchara okamorina endagera.
swahili: Hukumpa maji aliyechoka, nawe ulimnyima chakula mwenye njaa,

english: while the land belonged to a mighty man, and a man of honor lived on it.
ekegusii: Omonto obwate okobua nigo akoira ense yaba eyaye, na oyio oeirwe ogosikwa nere okoyemenya.
swahili: ingawa ulikuwa mtu mwenye uwezo ukimiliki nchi: mtu uliyeheshimiwa, ukiishi ndani yake.

english: You sent widows away empty-handed, and the strength of the fatherless was crushed.
ekegusii: Aye kwabeire kogoseria ababoraka bare namaboko amasa na kobuna amaboko e chintakana.
swahili: Umewafukuza wajane mikono mitupu na kuzivunja nguvu za yatima.

english: Then Job answered:
ekegusii: Ayubu akairaneria, akabora,
swahili: Ndipo Ayubu akajibu:

english: Yet He knows the way I have taken; when He has tested me, I will come forth as gold.
ekegusii: Korende ere namanyete chinchera chiane ngoetera. Ekero arakoore gonteema, nimbioke buna etaabu ekobioka korwa riko.
swahili: Lakini anaijua njia niiendeayo; akiisha kunijaribu, nitatoka kama dhahabu.

english: My feet have followed in His tracks; I have kept His way without turning aside.
ekegusii: Inche natachire bokong’u ase amabarato aye, nabeire ndendete chinchera chiaye, gose tindi koonchoka nchitige.
swahili: Nyayo zangu zimefuata hatua zake kwa karibu; nimeishika njia yake bila kukengeuka.

english: I have not departed from the command of His lips; I have treasured the words of His mouth more than my daily bread.
ekegusii: Tinana gotiga kobwata amachiiko akwanete; nimbwatetie amang’ana ere akwanete, gose tari aya naroberetie inche omonyene.
swahili: Sijaziacha amri zilizotoka midomoni mwake; nimeyathamini maneno ya kinywa chake kuliko chakula changu cha kila siku.

english: But He is unchangeable, and who can oppose Him? He does what He desires.
ekegusii: Korende ere tari koonchoka, ning’o oranyare komoonchorana? Egento aganirie gokora, nigo akogekora.
swahili: “Lakini yeye husimama peke yake; ni nani awezaye kumpinga? Yeye hufanya lolote atakalo.

english: For He carries out His decree against me, and He has many such plans.
ekegusii: Aya achiikire igoro yane, goika ayaikeranie, na amange buna ayio nigo agachire ase ebirengererio biaye.
swahili: Hutimiliza maagizo yake dhidi yangu, na bado anayo mipango mingi kama hiyo ambayo ameiweka akiba.

english: Therefore I am terrified in His presence; when I consider this, I fear Him.
ekegusii: Ase ayio nabeire nobwoba koba ase obosio bwaye, na ekero nkoyarengereria nigo nkomwoboa.
swahili: Hiyo ndiyo sababu ninaingiwa na hofu mbele zake; nifikiriapo haya yote ninamwogopa.

english: God has made my heart faint; the Almighty has terrified me.
ekegusii: Nyasae ogoyirie omoyo one, ee, Omobui ongosire,
swahili: Mungu ameufanya moyo wangu kuzimia; yeye Mwenyezi amenitia hofu.

english: Yet I am not silenced by the darkness, by the thick darkness that covers my face.
ekegusii: ere tantigete ase omosunte nsire, nonya noria ekerima otubete obosio bwane.
swahili: Hata hivyo sijanyamazishwa na giza, wala kwa giza nene linalofunika uso wangu.

english: “Even today my complaint is bitter. His hand is heavy despite my groaning.
ekegusii: Nonya ngoika reero okwemurungania kwane nigo kore okororo se; ogoakwa kwane nigo kore okorito kobua okweng’ereria kwane.
swahili: “Hata leo malalamiko yangu ni chungu; mkono wake ni mzito juu yangu hata nikiugua.

english: If only I knew where to find Him, so that I could go to His seat.
ekegusii: Onye ndiria nare komanya aase ndamonyore, rirorio nigo nare kogenda goika ase obomenyo bwaye bore.
swahili: Laiti ningefahamu mahali pa kumwona; laiti ningeweza kwenda mahali akaapo!

english: I would plead my case before Him and fill my mouth with arguments.
ekegusii: Nigo narenge komoteebia amang’ana aane, ing’ichorie omonwa one namang’ana nkoamererania nere.
swahili: Ningeliweka shauri langu mbele zake, na kukijaza kinywa changu na hoja.

english: I would learn how He would answer, and consider what He would say.
ekegusii: Igo nigo nare komanya eki akong’iraneria, na komanya ayarenge gonteebia.
swahili: Ningejua kwamba angenijibu nini, na kuelewa lile ambalo angelisema.

english: Would He contend with me in His great power? No, He would certainly take note of me.
ekegusii: Inee! Nyasae nkoamererania arenge nainche ase okobua kwaye kore okonene? Yaya, nigo arenge gontegerera.
swahili: Je, angenipinga kwa nguvu nyingi? La, asingenigandamiza.

english: Then an upright man could reason with Him, and I would be delivered forever from my Judge.
ekegusii: Agwo omonto omonyaboronge nigo are konyara koamererania nere, rirorio nigo nare gotigwa kegima noyokongambia.
swahili: Hapo mtu mwadilifu angeweka shauri lake mbele zake, nami ningeokolewa milele na mhukumu wangu.

english: If I go east, He is not there, and if I go west, I cannot find Him.
ekegusii: Rora, nabeire nkogenda gochia bosio, korende ere taiyo; naende nabeire nkoirana gochia magega, korende tindi komoorora.
swahili: “Lakini nikienda mashariki, hayupo; nikienda magharibi, simpati.

english: When He is at work in the north, I cannot behold Him; when He turns to the south, I cannot see Him.
ekegusii: Nigo nkomorigeria ensemo y’okobee, korende ere nigo akwebisa; naonchoka gochia ase ensemo y’okorio, korende tindi komoorora.
swahili: Anapokuwa kazini pande za kaskazini, simwoni; akigeukia kusini, nako simwoni hata kidogo.

english: “Why does the Almighty not reserve times for judgment? Why may those who know Him never see His days?
ekegusii: Nase ki Omonguru atabegeti chingaki chi’ekina? Naende nase ki baria bamwanchete batararora rituko riria riaye?
swahili: “Kwa nini Mwenyezi asiweke nyakati kwa ajili ya hukumu? Kwa nini wale wamjuao wazitafute siku kama hizo bila mafanikio?

english: Without clothing, they wander about naked. They carry the sheaves, but still go hungry.
ekegusii: Abataka baria bakona‐koong’anya bare getirianda, nigo bakobogoria emesaima bare nenchara.
swahili: Kwa kukosa nguo, hutembea uchi; hubeba miganda ya ngano, lakini huwa na njaa.

english: They crush olives within their walls; they tread the winepresses, but go thirsty.
ekegusii: Nigo bakomita amaguta ’amazeituni, boigo edivai korende nonya naboigo nigo bare nerang’o.
swahili: Hukamua zeituni katika mawe ya kusagia; hukanyaga mashinikizo, lakini wanaona kiu.

english: From the city, men groan, and the souls of the wounded cry out, yet God charges no one with wrongdoing.
ekegusii: Abanto bachandegete ase omochie nigo bakweumia, abanto baakire chingoma nigo bakorera, nonya naboigo Nyasae tari gotegerera ogosaba kwabo.
swahili: Kilio cha huzuni cha wanaokufa kinapaa kutoka mjini, nazo nafsi za waliojeruhiwa zinalilia msaada. Lakini Mungu hamlaumu mtu yeyote kwa kutenda mabaya.

english: Then there are those who rebel against the light, not knowing its ways or staying on its paths.
ekegusii: Abanto bande bangire oborabu, nonya ne chinchera chi’oborabu tibachimanyeti, gose tibari kobwatia chinchera chi’oborabu obwo.
swahili: “Wako wale wanaoiasi nuru, wasiofahamu njia zake wala hawakai katika mapito yake.

english: When daylight is gone, the murderer rises to kill the poor and needy; in the night he is like a thief.
ekegusii: Omoiti nigo akoboka mambia chuni ng’a aite abataka na abachandegete, na ase obotuko emeremo yaye neyoboibi.
swahili: Wakati mwanga wa mchana unapotoweka, muuaji huinuka naye huwaua maskini na mhitaji; wakati wa usiku hunyemelea kama mwizi.

english: The eye of the adulterer watches for twilight. Thinking, ‘No eye will see me,’ he covers his face.
ekegusii: Eriso ri’omotomani nigo rikoganya kobwairire, ere oteeba: Onde tari ondoche, erio otuba obosio bwaye bwekona.
swahili: Jicho la mzinzi hungojea wakati wa giza, naye hufikiri, ‘Hakuna jicho litakaloniona,’ naye huuficha uso wake.

english: In the dark they dig through houses; by day they shut themselves in, never to experience the light.
ekegusii: Omosunte gosoire, abaibi nigo bakobochora chinyomba basoa ime. Barabwo mobaso nigo bagwesiekerera bebisa; tibamanyeti oborabu.
swahili: Katika giza, huvunja majumba, lakini wakati wa mchana hujifungia ndani; hawataki kufanya lolote nuruni.

english: For to them, deep darkness is their morning; surely they are friends with the terrors of darkness!
ekegusii: Omosunte ekerima nigo onga buna emambia ase bare; barabwo nigo bare abasani b’okwoboyia kw’omosunte.
swahili: Kwa wote hawa, giza nene ndiyo asubuhi yao; hujifanya rafiki na vitisho vya gizani.

english: They are but foam on the surface of the water; their portion of the land is cursed, so that no one turns toward their vineyards.
ekegusii: Inwe nigo mogoteeba: Omokori amabe nigo akoirwa bwango ne chiooro, na egetari kiaye ase ense eye nigo keragereirie, ere takonyara koirana ase emegondo yaye y’emesabibu.
swahili: “Lakini wao ni povu juu ya maji; sehemu yao juu ya nchi imelaaniwa, hivyo hakuna hata mmoja aendaye kwenye shamba la mizabibu.

english: As drought and heat consume the melting snow, so Sheol steals those who have sinned.
ekegusii: Buna koreng’ana egurugura ne riberera bigokoora amaache ’amagena ’embura, naboigo nabaanto bakorire ebibe barairwe gochia aase abakuure.
swahili: Kama vile joto na hari vinyakuavyo theluji iliyoyeyuka, ndivyo kuzimu kuwanyakuavyo waliotenda dhambi.

english: Men move boundary stones; they pasture stolen flocks.
ekegusii: Abanto nigo bagotigeria chimbebe, baira amaicho e chitugo nechinguru, bachia koyarisia aba ayabo.
swahili: Watu husogeza mawe ya mpaka; huchunga makundi ya wanyama waliyonyangʼanya kwa nguvu.

english: The womb forgets them; the worm feeds on them; they are remembered no more. So injustice is like a broken tree.
ekegusii: Chinda chi’abaiborete nchibange pi; amakonde nabarie baere, tibakoinyorwa nonya ng’ake; igo oyogokora amabe nabunwe buna omote.
swahili: Tumbo lililowazaa huwasahau, nao huwa karamu ya mabuu; watu waovu hawakumbukwi tena, lakini huvunjika kama mti.

english: They prey on the barren and childless, and show no kindness to the widow.
ekegusii: Omokori amabe nigo akoibera omokungu omogomba; gose tari gokorera omoboraka amaya.
swahili: Huwafanya mawindo wanawake tasa na wasio na watoto, nao hawaonyeshi huruma kwa wajane.

english: Yet by His power, God drags away the mighty; though rising up, they have no assurance of life.
ekegusii: Nonya naboigo Nyasae ase okobua kwaye nigo akoa omokori amabe chinguru; ekero erusirie moyo, nigo agotenena naende.
swahili: Lakini Mungu huwakokota wenye nguvu kwa uwezo wake; ingawa wamestawi, hawana hakika ya maisha.

english: He gives them a sense of security, but His eyes are on their ways.
ekegusii: Nabo Nyasae akomorenda buya na komokonya, na nigo akoba origereretie mono chinchera chiaye.
swahili: Aweza akawaacha wakapumzika wakijihisi salama, lakini macho yake yanaona njia zao.

english: They are exalted for a moment, then they are gone; they are brought low and gathered up like all others; they are cut off like heads of grain.
ekegusii: Ase engaki enke nabo abakori amabe bagokinigwa, erio bwango basirigwa; nigo bakogwa inse, bakwa buna abande, babutorwa buna ebigara bikobutorwa ekero bikogeswa.
swahili: Kwa kitambo kidogo hutukuka, hatimaye hutoweka; hushushwa na kukusanywa kama wengine wote, hukatwa kama masuke ya nafaka.

english: If this is not so, then who can prove me a liar and reduce my words to nothing?”
ekegusii: Onye amang’ana ayio tari bo, ning’o oranyare kong’enekia ng’a nomorimo inde, naende aorokie ng’a amang’ana nakwanire nigo are bosa.
swahili: “Kama hili sivyo, ni nani awezaye kunithibitisha kuwa mwongo, na kuyafanya maneno yangu kuwa si kitu?”

english: They drive away the donkey of the fatherless and take the widow’s ox in pledge.
ekegusii: Barobwo nigo bakoira chitigere chie chintakana, baira chiombe chi’ababoraka koba intenenera.
swahili: Huwanyangʼanya yatima punda wao, na kumchukua rehani fahali wa mjane.

english: They push the needy off the road and force all the poor of the land into hiding.
ekegusii: Nigo bagotwoma abaremeire korwa inchera, bagera abataka bonsi b’ense eyio bachia kwebisa amo.
swahili: Humsukuma mhitaji kutoka njia, na kuwafanya maskini wote wa nchi kulazimika kujificha.

english: Indeed, like wild donkeys in the desert, the poor go to work foraging for food; the wasteland is food for their children.
ekegusii: Rora, abataka abwo babeire buna chitigere chi’orosana chire ase erooro; nigo bagokora emeremo emekong’u ase okonyora ebi bakoria. Ase ekerubo ekiomo nao bakorigeria abana babo endagera.
swahili: Kama punda-mwitu jangwani, maskini huzunguka katika kazi zao za kutafuta chakula; mahali palipo jangwa huwapa chakula cha watoto wao.

english: They gather fodder in the fields and glean the vineyards of the wicked.
ekegusii: Nigo bakogesera omonto onde chindagera chi’echitugo chiaye, naende basangereria amasabibu agotigwa ase omogondo bw’omokori amabe.
swahili: Hukusanya chakula mashambani na kuokota masazo katika mashamba ya mizabibu ya waovu.

english: Without clothing, they spend the night naked; they have no covering against the cold.
ekegusii: Nigo bakorara gesobono ase obotuko bwonsi, batabwati eki bakwebisia, gose tibabwati eki bakobeeka ekero ki’embeo.
swahili: Kwa kukosa nguo, usiku kucha hukaa uchi; hawana chochote cha kujifunika baridi.

english: Drenched by mountain rains, they huddle against the rocks for want of shelter.
ekegusii: Emebere yabo nigo enyiete nembura egotwa ase ebitunwa, erio bamigererania ase chingako chi’ebitare koigama aroro.
swahili: Hutota kwa mvua za mlimani, nao huikumbatia miamba kwa ajili ya kukosa pa kujisitiri.

english: The fatherless infant is snatched from the breast; the nursing child of the poor is seized for a debt.
ekegusii: Abande nigo bagotaboria chintakana korwa ase chimbeere chi’abang’ina, na baira abana ebing’werere b’abataka babe intenenera.
swahili: Mtoto yatima hupokonywa matitini; mtoto wachanga wa maskini hunyakuliwa kwa ajili ya deni.

english: Then Bildad the Shuhite replied:
ekegusii: Bilidadi Omosua akairaneria, akabora:
swahili: Ndipo Bildadi Mshuhi akajibu:

english: “Dominion and awe belong to God; He establishes harmony in the heights of heaven.
ekegusii: “Obonene na okoirokia nigo bire ase Nyasae, nigo agokora omorembe aaria igoro mono.
swahili: “Mamlaka na kuheshimiwa ni vyake Mungu; yeye huthibitisha amani katika mbingu juu.

english: Can His troops be numbered? On whom does His light not rise?
ekegusii: Inee! Ning’o oranyare kobara emeganda yaye? Ning’o omobaso oye otari kobarera?
swahili: Je, majeshi yake yaweza kuhesabika? Ni nani asiyeangaziwa na nuru yake?

english: How then can a man be just before God? How can one born of woman be pure?
ekegusii: Naki rende omonto aranyare koba omonyaboronge ase obosio bwa Nyasae? Naki omonto oiboire nomokuungu aranyare koba oyochenegete?
swahili: Mtu awezaje kuwa mwadilifu mbele za Mungu? Awezaje mtu aliyezaliwa na mwanamke kuwa safi?

english: If even the moon does not shine, and the stars are not pure in His sight,
ekegusii: Rora, nonya nomotienyi tori noborabu asare, gose ching’enang’eni tichiikeraneti ase amaiso aye.
swahili: Ikiwa hata mwezi sio mwangavu nazo nyota si safi machoni pake,

english: how much less man, who is but a maggot, and the son of man, who is but a worm!”
ekegusii: Onye nabo, naki rende ase omonto oyio onga buna rikonde; na Mwanyabaanto oyio onga buna enyongore.”
swahili: sembuse mtu ambaye ni funza: mwanadamu ambaye ni buu tu!”

english: He has inscribed a horizon on the face of the waters at the boundary between light and darkness.
ekegusii: Ong’ororirie ekeringerera kere orobebe rw’amaache ase ogwatanana oborabu korwa ase omosunte.
swahili: Amechora mstari wa upeo juu ya uso wa maji, ameweka mpaka wa nuru na giza.

english: The foundations of heaven quake, astounded at His rebuke.
ekegusii: Chisiiro chia igoro nigo chigotengecha, chiakumia ase ogotogonyera kwaye.
swahili: Nguzo za mbingu nazo zatetemeka, zinatishika anapozikemea.

english: By His power He stirred the sea; by His understanding He shattered Rahab.
ekegusii: Ere ase okobua kwaye nigo agoturubania enyancha, na ase chisemi chiaye akanachana Rahabu, eng’iti enene y’enyancha.
swahili: Kwa nguvu zake aliisukasuka bahari; kwa hekima yake alimkata Rahabu vipande vipande.

english: By His breath the skies were cleared; His hand pierced the fleeing serpent.
ekegusii: Nyasae nigo akoeyana, na omoika oye omechiera igoro, ere nigo aitete nokoboko kwaye engiti eria yare gotama.
swahili: Aliisafisha anga kwa pumzi yake; kwa mkono wake alimchoma joka aendaye mbio.

english: Indeed, these are but the fringes of His ways; how faint is the whisper we hear of Him! Who then can understand the thunder of His power?”
ekegusii: Naama! Echi nechinsinyo chie chinchera chiaye, aya tokoigugwa nokomonyerera ogosinini. Korende ning’o oranyare komanya okobua kwaye konga buna enkoba egoaka.”
swahili: Haya ni mambo madogo tu katika matendo yake; tazama jinsi ulivyo mdogo mnongʼono tunaousikia kumhusu! Ni nani basi awezaye kuelewa ngurumo za nguvu zake?”

english: “How you have helped the powerless and saved the arm that is feeble!
ekegusii: “Naki ere buya aye gwakonyire omonto otari nokobua! Ee, aye gwatooririe omonto omoreu otari ne chinguru.
swahili: “Tazama jinsi ulivyomsaidia mtu asiye na uwezo! Jinsi ulivyouokoa mkono ulio dhaifu!

english: How you have counseled the unwise and provided fully sound insight!
ekegusii: Naki ere buya gwasemirie omonto otari nobong’aini, na gwakwanire amang’ana aichire ne chisemi chingiya!
swahili: Ni shauri gani ulilompa yeye asiye na hekima? Nayo ni busara gani kubwa uliyoonyesha!

english: To whom have you uttered these words? And whose spirit spoke through you?
ekegusii: Nase chinguru chia ng’o gwakwanire amang’ana buna aya? Na ngoetera ase omoika o ng’o kwayakwanire?
swahili: Ni nani aliyekusaidia kutamka maneno hayo? Nayo ni roho ya nani iliyosema kutoka kinywani mwako?

english: The dead tremble— those beneath the waters and those who dwell in them.
ekegusii: “Emeika y’abanto bakwete nigo ekoiguswa; boigo namaache na ebimenyete imeo.
swahili: “Wafu wako katika maumivu makuu, wale walio chini ya maji na wale waishio ndani yake.

english: Sheol is naked before God, and Abaddon has no covering.
ekegusii: Aase abakuure nigo aasie ase obosio bwa Nyasae; ee, aase agwo ogosiria tabwati kemumeko.
swahili: Mauti iko wazi mbele za Mungu; Uharibifu haukufunikwa.

english: He stretches out the north over empty space; He hangs the earth upon nothing.
ekegusii: Nyasae nigo aramborete ensemo ya sugusu aase arenge bosa, nigo asungete ense aase bosa etabwateti aande.
swahili: Hutandaza anga la kaskazini mahali patupu; naye huiningʼiniza dunia mahali pasipo na kitu.

english: He wraps up the waters in His clouds, yet the clouds do not burst under their own weight.
ekegusii: Ere nigo aochoganetie amaache amo, akayaboerania amare amanetu ime; na amare ayio tari gotandoka.
swahili: Huyafungia maji kwenye mawingu yake, hata hivyo mawingu hayapasuki kwa uzito wake.

english: He covers the face of the full moon, spreading over it His cloud.
ekegusii: Nigo atubete ekerogo kiaye ki’obonene, akagetuba namare aye.
swahili: Huufunika uso wa mwezi mpevu, akitandaza mawingu juu yake.

english: Job continued his discourse:
ekegusii: Ayubu akagenderera gokwana emerabaaro yaye akabora:
swahili: Ndipo Ayubu akaendelea na hoja yake, akasema:

english: Will he delight in the Almighty? Will he call upon God at all times?
ekegusii: Omonto oyio nagokigwe ase Omobui? Nabe okorangeria Nyasae ase chingaki chionsi?
swahili: Je, anaweza kumfurahia Mwenyezi? Je, atamwita Mungu nyakati zote?

english: I will instruct you in the power of God. I will not conceal the ways of the Almighty.
ekegusii: Nimborokererie igoro y’okobua kwa Nyasae; amang’ana onsi igoro y’Omonguru tinkoyabisa.
swahili: “Nitawafundisha juu ya uweza wa Mungu; njia za Mwenyezi sitazificha.

english: Surely all of you have seen it for yourselves. Why then do you keep up this empty talk?
ekegusii: Rora, inwe mwensi mweroreire ayio; bono, nase ki rende mogokwana amang’ana abosa?
swahili: Ninyi nyote mmeona hili wenyewe. Ni ya nini basi mazungumzo haya yasiyo na maana?

english: This is the wicked man’s portion from God— the heritage the ruthless receive from the Almighty.
ekegusii: Ekio nakio egetari Nyasae akoa omokori amabe, na omwando Omobui akoa abwo bagochanda abanto.
swahili: “Hili ndilo fungu ambalo Mungu humpa mtu mwovu, urithi ule mtu mdhalimu anapokea kutoka kwa Mwenyezi:

english: Though his sons are many, they are destined for the sword; and his offspring will never have enough food.
ekegusii: Abana b’omokori amabe nabaisa komentekana, nigo bareo ase ogocha goitwa n’omoro, abanto b’ororeria rwaye tibakonyora endagera eisaine.
swahili: Hata kama watoto wake watakuwa wengi kiasi gani, fungu lao ni kuuawa kwa upanga; wazao wake hawatakuwa kamwe na chakula cha kuwatosha.

english: His survivors will be buried by the plague, and their widows will not weep for them.
ekegusii: Abatigari baye nigo oborwaire borabaite, na abakungu baratigwe bare ababoraka, tibakonyara kobareera.
swahili: Tauni itawazika wale watakaonusurika miongoni mwao, nao wajane wao hawatawaombolezea.

english: Though he heaps up silver like dust and piles up a wardrobe like clay,
ekegusii: Omonto oyio naisa gosangereria chifeta chinyinge buna orotu naende atumbe chianga chibe chinyinge mono;
swahili: Ajapokusanya fedha nyingi kama mavumbi, na mavazi kama malundo ya udongo wa mfinyanzi,

english: what he lays up, the righteous will wear, and his silver will be divided by the innocent.
ekegusii: nonya ochitumbire igo, nomonto omooronge orachibeeke, na abatari na komocha baatanane chifeta chiaye.
swahili: yale yote mtu mwovu aliyojiwekea akiba, mwenye haki atayavaa, naye asiye na hatia ataigawanya fedha yake.

english: The house he built is like a moth’s cocoon, like a hut set up by a watchman.
ekegusii: Enyomba omonto oyio araagache nigo erabe buna ey’oronyambobe, na buna ekegutu omorendi akoagacha.
swahili: Nyumba aijengayo ni kama utando wa buibui, kama kibanda alichotengeneza mlinzi.

english: He lies down wealthy, but will do so no more; when he opens his eyes, all is gone.
ekegusii: Omonto oyio nigo akogenda korara ore omonda, korende takoba bo rinde; ekero akoramokia amaiso kabokire anyore obotenenku bwaye bwasirire.
swahili: Yeye hulala akiwa tajiri, lakini ndiyo mara ya mwisho; afunguapo macho yake, yote yametoweka.

english: “As surely as God lives, who has deprived me of justice— the Almighty, who has embittered my soul—
ekegusii: Ekeene, buna Nyasae are moyo, oyo ong’urire ebiantungetie, na buna Omonguru aeire omoyo one obororo,
swahili: “Hakika kama Mungu aishivyo, aliyeninyima haki yangu, Mwenyezi ambaye amenifanya nionje uchungu wa nafsi,

english: Terrors overtake him like a flood; a tempest sweeps him away in the night.
ekegusii: Obwoba obonene bonga buna eooro nigo bokomocheera; erio ekembugu‐mbugu kiamocheera botuko kiamoira.
swahili: Vitisho humjia kama mafuriko; dhoruba humkumba ghafula usiku.

english: The east wind carries him away, and he is gone; it sweeps him out of his place.
ekegusii: Omwaga okorwa moocha nigo okomoirurukia; omorusia aase aye, omosiria kegima.
swahili: Upepo mkali wa mashariki humchukua, naye hutoweka; humzoa kutoka mahali pake.

english: It hurls itself against him without mercy as he flees headlong from its power.
ekegusii: Nyasae nigo akomoruta emegwe atari namaabera, nere otama bokong’u korua ase okoboko kwaye.
swahili: Humvurumisha bila huruma, huku akikimbia kasi kukwepa nguvu zake.

english: It claps its hands at him and hisses him out of his place.
ekegusii: Abanto nigo bagoaka chinkobi igoro yaye, bamoseria neriogi ri’okomwogerera, orua aase aye.
swahili: Upepo humpigia makofi kwa dharau, na kumfukuza atoke mahali pake.

english: as long as my breath is still within me and the breath of God remains in my nostrils,
ekegusii: naende omoika bw’obomoyo ogendererete koba ime yane, na omoika o Nyasae ore ase chimioro chiane,
swahili: kwa muda wote nitakaokuwa na uhai ndani yangu, nayo pumzi ya Mungu ikiwa puani mwangu,

english: my lips will not speak wickedness, and my tongue will not utter deceit.
ekegusii: omonwa one togokwana aya atari a boronge, gose oromeme rwane ay’obong’ainereria.
swahili: midomo yangu haitanena uovu, wala ulimi wangu hautatamka udanganyifu.

english: I will never say that you are right; I will maintain my integrity until I die.
ekegusii: Abe aare korwa ase ’nde kobabara ng’a nabanyaboronge more; goika ogokwa kwane ningenderere goteeba ng’a tindi nokomocha.
swahili: Sitakubaliana nanyi kabisa kuwa mko sahihi; hadi nife, sitakana uadilifu wangu.

english: I will cling to my righteousness and never let go. As long as I live, my conscience will not accuse me. The Wicked Man’s Portion
ekegusii: Nimbwaterere bokong’u oboronge bwane, tinkobotiga, enkoro yane tekongambia ase amatuko ande inde moyo.
swahili: Nitadumisha haki yangu wala sitaiacha; dhamiri yangu haitanisuta muda wote ninaoishi.

english: May my enemy be like the wicked and my opponent like the unjust.
ekegusii: Tiga omobisa one abarwe buna omokori amabe, na oyore mamincha yane buna oyotari omonyaboronge.
swahili: “Watesi wangu wawe kama waovu, nao adui zangu wawe kama wasio haki!

english: For what is the hope of the godless when he is cut off, when God takes away his life?
ekegusii: Ngosemeria ki omonto otamoirogeti Nyasae abwate, ekero arakwe, ekero Nyasae aramoure obogima bwaye?.
swahili: Kwa maana mtu asiyemcha Mungu analo tegemeo gani anapokatiliwa mbali, Mungu anapouondoa uhai wake?

english: Will God hear his cry when distress comes upon him?
ekegusii: Inee, ekero emechando eramochere Nyasae, namoigwe gose?
swahili: Je, Mungu husikiliza kilio chake, shida zimjiapo?

english: “Surely there is a mine for silver and a place where gold is refined.
ekegusii: “Ekeene, ribwago ase chifeta chigokunywa korwa ndire, na aase abanto bagosiberia chitaabu nare.
swahili: “Kuna machimbo ya fedha, na mahali dhahabu isafishwapo.

english: He hews out channels in the rocks, and his eyes spot every treasure.
ekegusii: Nigo akorema emetaro ime ase ebitare, na amaiso aye arora kera egento kie rigori rinene.
swahili: Hutoboa shimo refu la kupenya chini kwa chini kwenye miamba; macho yake huona hazina zake zote.

english: He stops up the sources of the streams to bring what is hidden to light.
ekegusii: Nigo akogita chindooche, otanga amaache tagoeta, erio egento kebisekanete ime, okerenta aase aarabu.
swahili: Hutafuta vyanzo vya mito na kuvileta vitu vilivyofichika katika nuru.

english: But where can wisdom be found, and where does understanding dwell?
ekegusii: Korende ng’ai obong’aini boranyorekane? Na ng’ai okomanya komenyete?
swahili: “Lakini hekima inaweza kupatikana wapi? Ufahamu unakaa wapi?

english: No man can know its value, nor is it found in the land of the living.
