ekegusii: “Mwanyabaanto tamanyeti rigori ri’obong’aini; borobwo tibori konyorekana ase ense emenyire nabare moyo.
swahili: Mwanadamu hatambui thamani yake; haiwezi kupatikana katika nchi ya walio hai.

english: The ocean depths say, ‘It is not in me,’ while the sea declares, ‘It is not with me.’
ekegusii: Chindiba nigo chigokana chiateeba: Tibori ase ’nde aa, na enyancha nigo egoteeba: Tibori aiga ase ’nde.
swahili: Kilindi husema, ‘Haiko ndani yangu’; bahari nayo husema, ‘Haiko pamoja nami.’

english: It cannot be bought with gold, nor can its price be weighed out in silver.
ekegusii: Tibokogorwa chitaabu, gose chifeta tichikorengwa koba rigori riaye.
swahili: Haiwezi kununuliwa kwa dhahabu safi kuliko zote, wala thamani yake haiwezi kupimwa kwa fedha.

english: It cannot be valued in the gold of Ophir, in precious onyx or sapphire.
ekegusii: Tibokoreng’anigwa ne chitaabu chikorwa Ofiri, gose namagena e rigori rinene akorokwa oiniki na safiro.
swahili: Haiwezi kununuliwa kwa dhahabu ya Ofiri, kwa shohamu ya thamani kubwa au yakuti samawi ya thamani kubwa.

english: Neither gold nor crystal can compare to it, nor jewels of fine gold be exchanged for it.
ekegusii: Chitaabu na ebirore ebiya tibikoreng’anigwa naborobwo, gose tibokoonchorerigwa n’ebinto bi’ogwechabera, biroisirie korwa ase chitaabu chichenire.
swahili: Dhahabu wala mawe maangavu haviwezi kulinganishwa nayo, wala haiwezi hubadilishwa na vito vya dhahabu.

english: Coral and quartz are unworthy of mention; the price of wisdom is beyond rubies.
ekegusii: Amakorongote na ebirore bichenire tibigwatorwa. Rigori ri’obong’aini nigo rire rinene kobua eri’amagena erigori rinene akomeka‐meka.
swahili: Marijani na yaspi hazistahili kutajwa; thamani ya hekima ni zaidi ya akiki nyekundu.

english: Topaz from Cush cannot compare to it, nor can it be valued in pure gold.
ekegusii: Topasio, rigena rie rigori rinene rikorwa Ethiopia, tirikoboreng’anigwa, gose tibokoreng’anigwa netaabu echenire.
swahili: Yakuti manjano ipatikanayo Kushi haiwezi kulinganishwa nayo, wala haiwezi kununuliwa kwa dhahabu safi.

english: Iron is taken from the earth, and copper is smelted from ore.
ekegusii: Ebioma nigo bigokunywa korwa riroba inse, ne chitaai nigo chikonyorwa ase amagena ’ebitare anyititorwa.
swahili: Chuma hupatikana ardhini, nayo shaba huyeyushwa kutoka mawe ya madini.

english: From where then does wisdom come, and where does understanding dwell?
ekegusii: “Bono rende, obong’aini ng’ai bokorwa? Na ng’ai okomanya komenyete?
swahili: “Ni wapi basi hekima itokako? Ufahamu hukaa wapi?

english: It is hidden from the eyes of every living thing and concealed from the birds of the air.
ekegusii: Nigo bobisire korwa ase amaiso ’ebitongwa bionsi bire moyo; ee, nigo botubire chinyoni tichiborora.
swahili: Imefichika machoni pa kila kitu kilicho hai, imesitiriwa hata kwa ndege wa angani.

english: Abaddon and Death say, ‘We have heard a rumor about it.’
ekegusii: Aase ay’obosareku na amakweri nigo bigoteeba: Intwe twaigure chinkuma chiaye.
swahili: Uharibifu na Mauti husema, ‘Ni uvumi wake tu uliotufikia masikioni mwetu.’

english: But God understands its way, and He knows its place.
ekegusii: “Nyasae bweka namanyete enchera y’obong’aini, namanyete aase aye.
swahili: Mungu anaifahamu njia ya kuiendea hekima na ndiye peke yake anayefahamu inakokaa,

english: For He looks to the ends of the earth and sees everything under the heavens.
ekegusii: Ere nigo arigereretie goika chinsinyo chionsi chi’ense, aroche kera egento kere inse y’erioba.
swahili: kwa maana yeye huitazama miisho ya dunia na huona kila kitu chini ya mbingu.

english: When God fixed the weight of the wind and measured out the waters,
ekegusii: Ekero Nyasae arengete chinguru chi’omwaga, na akarenga obonge bw’amaache,
swahili: Alipofanyiza nguvu za upepo na kuyapima maji,

english: when He set a limit for the rain and a path for the thunderbolt,
ekegusii: ekero abegete ogochika ase embura, na akaroisia enchera y’okomesa gw’enkoba,
swahili: alipofanya maagizo kwa ajili ya mvua na njia kwa ajili ya umeme wa radi,

english: then He looked at wisdom and appraised it; He established it and searched it out.
ekegusii: nario aroche obong’aini naende akaboraria; akaboikerania na koboenekia ase abanto.
swahili: ndipo alipoitazama hekima na kuikadiria thamani yake, akaithibitisha na kuihakikisha.

english: And He said to man, ‘Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom, and to turn away from evil is understanding.’”
ekegusii: “Erio Nyasae agateebia Mwanyabaanto: Naama! Okomoiroka Omonene, okwo nakwo obong’aini; na ogweatanana korwa ase ebibe, okwo nakwo okomanya.”
swahili: Naye Mungu akamwambia mwanadamu, ‘Kumcha Bwana: hiyo ndiyo hekima, nako kujitenga na uovu ndio ufahamu.’ ”

english: Man puts an end to the darkness; he probes the farthest recesses for ore in deepest darkness.
ekegusii: Abanto nigo bagotongia chitaaya ime aaria, basiria omosunte; erio baba bakoriga‐rigia amagena ase ebinunchi bire ase omosunte ekerima.
swahili: Mwanadamu hukomesha giza; huyatafuta hadi sehemu iliyo mbali, kwa ajili ya kuchimbua mawe yenye madini katika giza jeusi sana.

english: Far from human habitation he cuts a shaft in places forgotten by the foot of man. Far from men he dangles and sways.
ekegusii: Abanto nigo bagokunya chingoro chintambe gochia inse. Abwo nigo bakoba bebirwe nabaanto bagotaara igoro ye riroba, nigo bagotirimbokigwa basung’unaine bairwa aare korwa ase abanto.
swahili: Huchimba shimo jembamba mbali na makao ya watu, mahali paliposahaulika na nyayo za wanadamu; mbali na wanadamu huningʼinia na kupembea kwa kamba.

english: Food may come from the earth, but from below it is transformed as by fire.
ekegusii: Ase riroba igoro nao endagera ekwama ime y’ense inse aroro aonchoranwa aba buna omorero ogosamba oonchorana.
swahili: Ardhi, ambako chakula hutoka, chini hugeuzwa kwa moto;

english: Its rocks are the source of sapphires, containing flecks of gold.
ekegusii: Aroro agwo nao are amagena e rigori rinene akorokwa safiro, amo namagena e chitaabu.
swahili: yakuti samawi hutoka katika miamba yake, nalo vumbi lake lina vipande vya dhahabu.

english: No bird of prey knows that path; no falcon’s eye has seen it.
ekegusii: Enchera ekogenda aase agwo enyoni ende yonsi egotwara orotwari teyemanyeti, gose ekebaki tikiana koyerora.
swahili: Hakuna ndege awindaye aijuaye njia ile iliyofichika, wala hakuna jicho la mwewe lililoiona.

english: Proud beasts have never trodden it; no lion has ever prowled over it.
ekegusii: Eng’iti y’orosana eng’enenu tiyana koyetacha, gose endo tiyana goetera aroro.
swahili: Wanyama wa porini wanaotamba hawajawahi kupakanyaga, wala simba azungukaye huko.

english: The miner strikes the flint; he overturns mountains at their base.
ekegusii: “Mwanyabaanto nigo agokunya egetare ekiomo pa, erio osensema ebitunwa korwa inse obionchorana.
swahili: Mikono ya mwanadamu hushambulia miamba migumu sana, na kuiacha wazi mizizi ya milima.

english: And Job continued his discourse:
ekegusii: Erio Ayubu agachaaka gokwana naende. Ayubu
swahili: Ayubu akaendelea na hoja yake, akasema:

english: The voices of the nobles were hushed, and their tongues stuck to the roofs of their mouths.
ekegusii: Amariogi ’abagaambi nigo arenge gokea, chimeme chiabo chiabwatana namang’ang’ura abo.
swahili: wenye vyeo wakanyamazishwa, nazo ndimi zao zikagandamana na makaakaa ya vinywa vyao.

english: For those who heard me called me blessed, and those who saw me commended me,
ekegusii: Ekero abanto barenge konyigwa, nigo barenge kondoka oyosesenirie, ekero baare kondora, baba birori ase ’nde,
swahili: Yeyote aliyenisikia alinena mema juu yangu, nao walioniona walinisifu,

english: because I rescued the poor who cried out and the fatherless who had no helper.
ekegusii: ekiagera nigo nabeete ngotooria abataka abwo barenge korera, ne chintakana chitabwate onde ogochikonya.
swahili: kwa sababu nilimwokoa maskini aliyeomba msaada, naye yatima aliyekuwa hana wa kumsaidia.

english: The dying man blessed me, and I made the widow’s heart sing for joy.
ekegusii: Ogosesenigwa kw’omonto konya obeire ang’e gosira nigo gwanchicherete, nkagera ababoraka bagateera nechinkoro chire nomogooko.
swahili: Mtu aliyekuwa karibu kufa alinibariki, nami niliufanya moyo wa mjane kuimba.

english: I put on righteousness, and it clothed me; justice was my robe and my turban.
ekegusii: Nigo neboyetie oboronge, naborobwo bogantuba; ekeene kiane nigo kiarenge buna omwambaro na ekegogwa.
swahili: Niliivaa haki kama vazi langu; uadilifu ulikuwa joho langu na kilemba changu.

english: I served as eyes to the blind and as feet to the lame.
ekegusii: Ninche narenge eriso ase emeuko, na okogoro ase ebirema.
swahili: Nilikuwa macho ya kipofu na miguu kwa kiwete.

english: I was a father to the needy, and I took up the case of the stranger.
ekegusii: Ninche narenge ise bw’abataka: na omonto ochandegete ntamanyete, nigo namwechanderete.
swahili: Nilikuwa baba kwa mhitaji; nilimtetea mgeni.

english: I shattered the fangs of the unjust and snatched the prey from his teeth.
ekegusii: Nigo nabunete chinsea chi’abatari abanyaboronge, ngatooria korwa ase emenwa yabo abwo konya babwatirwe.
swahili: Niliyavunja meno makali ya waovu, na kuwapokonya wahanga kwenye meno yao.

english: So I thought: ‘I will die in my nest and multiply my days as the sand.
ekegusii: Erio nkaba nkorengereria ng’a amatuko aane nigo arabe amange buna omokenye, erio ngokwa imbe ase egeswa kiane.
swahili: “Nikafikiri, ‘Nitafia katika nyumba yangu mwenyewe, nazo siku zangu zitakuwa nyingi kama chembechembe za mchanga.

english: My roots will spread out to the waters, and the dew will rest nightly on my branches.
ekegusii: Nigo narenge buna omote emeri yaye ekoranda yaika ase chindooche; chinsagia chiane chikagenderera gotoora riime ase obotuko bwonsi;
swahili: Mizizi yangu itafika mpaka kwenye maji, nao umande utakaa juu ya matawi yangu usiku kucha.

english: “How I long for the months gone by, for the days when God watched over me,
ekegusii: Onye ndiria obogima bwane bware koba buna bwarenge ase amatuko a kare, amatuko aria Nyasae andendete!
swahili: “Tazama jinsi ninavyoitamani miezi iliyopita, zile siku ambazo Mungu alikuwa akinilinda,

english: My glory is ever new within me, and my bow is renewed in my hand.’
ekegusii: obonene bwane nigo bwarenge kona‐koba oboyia ase ’nde, na obota bwane bokona‐konyora chinguru chinyia ase amaboko aane.
swahili: Utukufu wangu utabakia kuwa mpya ndani yangu, upinde wangu daima utaendelea kuwa mpya mkononi mwangu.’

english: Men listened to me with expectation, waiting silently for my counsel.
ekegusii: Ekero narenge korua ogosemia, abanto nigo barenge gontegerera, bakira‐kiri.
swahili: “Watu walinisikiliza kwa tumaini, wakingojea ushauri wangu kwa utulivu.

english: After my words, they spoke no more; my speech settled on them like dew.
ekegusii: Ekero nakoorire gokwana, monto onde tarenge komenta ing’ana rinde, ekiagera amang’ana aane nigo arenge kobagwera buna amatoima ’embura.
swahili: Baada ya mimi kuzungumza, hawakusema zaidi; maneno yangu yaliingia masikioni mwao kwa makini.

english: They waited for me as for rain and drank in my words like spring showers.
ekegusii: Nigo barenge koba baganyete buna embura ekoganywa; bakaba bagwasamia emenwa yabo buna embura y’okwamia endagera egwasamerwa.
swahili: Waliningojea kama manyunyu ya mvua na kuyapokea maneno yangu kama ardhi inyonyavyo mvua ya vuli.

english: If I smiled at them, they did not believe it; the light of my countenance was precious.
ekegusii: Ekero konya berusirie moyo nigo narenge kobasekera; obwasioku bw’obosio bwane tibabosieereretie.
swahili: Walipokata tamaa niliwaonyesha uso wa furaha; nuru ya uso wangu ilikuwa ya thamani kwao.

english: I chose their course and presided as chief. So I dwelt as a king among his troops, as a comforter of the mourners.
ekegusii: Inche nigo nachorete enchera bagwenerete kobwatia, naende nkabeera egati yabo buna omogambi; nigo namenyete ase bare buna omorwoti akomenya nabarwani baye b’esegi, naende buna omonto okoremia baria bakorera.
swahili: Niliwachagulia njia na kukaa kama mkuu wao; niliishi kama mfalme katikati ya majeshi yake; nikawa kama yeye anayewafariji waombolezaji.

english: when His lamp shone above my head, and by His light I walked through the darkness,
ekegusii: Engaki eria etaya yaye yarenge komorekera omotwe one, na ase oborabu bwaye nkaba ngotaara ase omosunte.
swahili: wakati taa yake iliniangazia kichwani changu, na kwa mwanga wake Mungu nikapita katikati ya giza!

english: when I was in my prime, when the friendship of God rested on my tent,
ekegusii: Ase amatuko aria nakinete inde ne chinguru, na obosani bwa Nyasae bwagendererete kobeera ase obomenyo bwane.
swahili: Natamani siku zile nilizokuwa katika ustawi wangu, wakati urafiki wa Mungu wa ndani ulipoibariki nyumba yangu,

english: when the Almighty was still with me and my children were around me,
ekegusii: Engaki eria Omonguru nigo arenge amo nainche, na abana baane nigo bang’etanaine;
swahili: wakati Mwenyezi alikuwa pamoja nami, nao watoto wangu walikuwa wamenizunguka,

english: when my steps were bathed in cream and the rock poured out for me streams of oil!
ekegusii: nigo narenge gwesibia amagoro aane namabeere, emezeituni ekamera ase egetare, nkanyora chindooche chi’amaguta ’amazeituni.
swahili: wakati njia yangu ilikuwa imenyweshewa siagi, nao mwamba ukanimiminia vijito vya mafuta ya zeituni.

english: When I went out to the city gate and took my seat in the public square,
ekegusii: Ekero narenge kogenda ase egeita ki’omochie, goikaransa ase ekerogo kiane agwo ase ekeraario,
swahili: “Wakati nilipokwenda kwenye lango la mji na kuketi katika kiwanja,

english: the young men saw me and withdrew, and the old men rose to their feet.
ekegusii: abasae abaare kondora nigo barenge kogobera, na abanto abagotu batenena konyorokia amasikani.
swahili: vijana waliniona wakakaa kando, nao wazee walioketi wakasimama;

english: The princes refrained from speaking and covered their mouths with their hands.
ekegusii: Abagaambi b’abaanto nigo baare gokira tibagokwana, batuba emenwa yabo namaboko.
swahili: wakuu wakaacha kuzungumza na kuziba vinywa vyao kwa mikono yao;

english: On another day the sons of God came to present themselves before the LORD, and Satan also came with them to present himself before Him.
ekegusii: Naende ekaba ng’a rituko erimo, ekero abamura ba Nyasae bachete kweorokia ase obosio bw’Omonene, Saitani nere agacha agwo ase barenge kweorokia ase obosio bw’Omonene.
swahili: Siku nyingine wana wa Mungu walikuja kujionyesha mbele za Bwana. Shetani naye akaja pamoja nao kujionyesha mbele zake.

english: “You speak as a foolish woman speaks,” he told her. “Should we accept from God only good and not adversity?” In all this, Job did not sin in what he said. Job’s Three Friends
ekegusii: Korende Ayubu akairaneria mokaye, akamoteebia, “Aye nigo ogokwana buna omokungu onde bwensi omoriri agokwana. Onye tokonyora amaya korwa ase Nyasae, Inee, titokonyora amabe naro korwa asare?” Ase amang’ana ayio onsi Ayubu takorete ebibe ase ogokwana kwaye. Abasani b’Ayubu bagocha
swahili: Akamjibu, “Unazungumza kama vile ambavyo mwanamke mpumbavu yeyote angenena. Je, tupokee mema mikononi mwa Mungu, nasi tusipokee na udhia?” Katika mambo haya yote, Ayubu hakutenda dhambi katika kusema kwake. Marafiki Watatu Wa Ayubu

english: Now when Job’s three friends—Eliphaz the Temanite, Bildad the Shuhite, and Zophar the Naamathite—heard about all this adversity that had come upon him, each of them came from his home, and they met together to go and sympathize with Job and comfort him.
ekegusii: Ayubu nabwate abasani batato: Elifasi korwa Temani, na Bilidadi korwa Sua, na Sofari korwa Naama. Ekero barabwo baigwete igoro y’emechando eria Ayubu anyorete, bagachikana ng’a kera oyomo arue bwoye, baumerane amo, bagende komwechandera na komoremia.
swahili: Basi marafiki watatu wa Ayubu, ndio Elifazi Mtemani, na Bildadi Mshuhi na Sofari Mnaamathi, waliposikia juu ya taabu yote iliyompata Ayubu, wakajipanga toka manyumbani mwao, nao wakakutana pamoja kwa makubaliano kwenda kumtuliza katika taabu hiyo na kumfariji.

english: When they lifted up their eyes from afar, they could barely recognize Job. They began to weep aloud, and each man tore his robe and threw dust in the air over his head.
ekegusii: Bagachia komoorora korwa aare, tibanyara komomanya gose nere. Bagachaaka goaka amariogi bakorera; bagatandora chianga chiabo, bagesiarera ebuse gochia igoro na ase emetwe yabo.
swahili: Walipomwona kwa mbali, ilikuwa vigumu kumtambua. Wakaanza kulia kwa sauti kubwa, wakayararua majoho yao na kujirushia mavumbi juu ya vichwa vyao.

english: Then they sat on the ground with him for seven days and seven nights, but no one spoke a word to him because they saw how intense his suffering was.
ekegusii: Abanto abwo bagaikaransa inse agwo amo nere ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere, omobaso na obotuko; agwo onde tabeete ogokwana ing’ana rinde rionsi ase Ayubu, ekiagera baroche ng’a emechando yaye nigo yarenge emenene mono.
swahili: Kisha wakaketi chini kwenye udongo pamoja na Ayubu kwa siku saba usiku na mchana. Hakuna yeyote aliyesema naye neno, kwa sababu waliona jinsi mateso yake yalivyokuwa makubwa.

english: “Where have you come from?” said the LORD to Satan. “From roaming through the earth,” he replied, “and walking back and forth in it.”
ekegusii: Erio Omonene akaboria Saitani, “Naye ng’ai okorwa?” Saitani akamoiraneria, “Nigo nkorwa ase etaaro yane, nkona‐goetanana ase ense yonsi, naende nabo nkonagotiira na gotirimboka aroro.”
swahili: Bwana akamuuliza Shetani, “Umetoka wapi?” Shetani akamjibu Bwana “Natoka kuzunguka pote duniani, nikitembea huku na huko humo.”

english: Then the LORD said to Satan, “Have you considered My servant Job? For there is no one on earth like him, a man who is blameless and upright, who fears God and shuns evil. He still retains his integrity, even though you incited Me against him to ruin him without cause.”
ekegusii: Agwo Omonene akaboria Saitani, “Ayubu, omosomba one, kwarorire buna are? Monto onde tari ase ense onga buna ere; nigo are omwegenwa na obwate enkoro endonge; ere nigo anyirogete inche Nyasae, naende nigo etangete korwa ase ogokora amabe. Nonya kwang’ebereretie komochanda ngencho ende etaiyo, ere nigo agendererete koba omwegenwa.”
swahili: Bwana akamwambia Shetani, “Je, umemwangalia huyo mtumishi wangu Ayubu? Hakuna mtu mwingine duniani aliye kama yeye, mtu asiye na hatia, ni mnyofu, mwenye kumcha Mungu na kuepukana na uovu. Naye bado anadumisha uadilifu wake, ingawa ulinichochea dhidi yake, ili nimwangamize pasipo sababu.”

english: “Skin for skin!” Satan replied. “A man will give up all he owns in exchange for his life.
ekegusii: Erio Saitani akairaneri’Omonene, akamoteebia, “Risankwa ase risankwa; omonto nigo ararue gento kende gionsi abwate ase ogotooria obogima bwaye.
swahili: Shetani akamjibu Bwana, “Ngozi kwa ngozi! Mwanadamu atatoa vyote alivyo navyo kwa ajili ya uhai wake.

english: But stretch out Your hand and strike his flesh and bones, and he will surely curse You to Your face.”
ekegusii: Bono aye rambora okoboko kwao, okune amauga ’omobere oye, amo ne chinyama, omokore bobe, ekeene, ere nigo arakoragereria agwo ase obosio bwao.”
swahili: Lakini nyoosha mkono wako na kuipiga nyama yake na mifupa yake, naye kwa hakika atakulaani mbele za uso wako.”

english: “Very well,” said the LORD to Satan. “He is in your hands, but you must spare his life.”
ekegusii: Naende Omonene agateebia Saitani ayio namaya, “Rora, Ayubu nigo are inse y’okobua kwao, korende omotige abe moyo.”
swahili: Bwana akamwambia Shetani, “Vema sana, kwa hiyo, yeye yumo mikononi mwako, lakini lazima umwachie uhai wake.”

english: So Satan went out from the presence of the LORD and infected Job with terrible boils from the soles of his feet to the crown of his head.
ekegusii: Erio Saitani akarua agwo ase Omonene, akageenda, akarentera Ayubu amagumba, gochakera chimbaratero goikera ase omotwe igoro.
swahili: Basi Shetani akatoka mbele za Bwana naye akampiga Ayubu kwa majipu mabaya tangu nyayo za miguu yake hadi utosi wa kichwa.

english: And Job took a piece of broken pottery to scrape himself as he sat among the ashes.
ekegusii: Ayubu akaba ogoikaransa ase ribu, akaimokia orogio, akana‐kweageria amaote aye.
swahili: Ndipo Ayubu akachukua kigae na kujikuna nacho huku akiketi kwenye majivu.

english: Then Job’s wife said to him, “Do you still retain your integrity? Curse God and die!”
ekegusii: Erio mokaye akamobooria, “Inee, nonya ngoika bono nigo ogendererete koba omwegenwa ase Omonene? Ragereria Nyasae, erio okwe!”
swahili: Mke wake akamwambia, “Je, bado unashikamana na uadilifu wako? Mlaani Mungu nawe ukafe!”

english: “But now they mock me, men younger than I am, whose fathers I would have refused to entrust with my sheep dogs.
ekegusii: Korende bono abanto bare abake ase ’nde, nigo bagonsekerera, abwo abaise babo batagwenereti kende, anga ntababegete nonya nase egati ye chisese chikorenda amaicho aane.
swahili: “Lakini sasa watu wadogo kwa umri kuniliko wananidhihaki, watu ambao baba zao ningekataa kwa dharau kuwaweka pamoja na mbwa wangu wa kulinda kondoo.

english: They abhor me and keep far from me; they do not hesitate to spit in my face.
ekegusii: Barabwo nigo bangechete, bantamire; tibetangeti gontwera amate obosio bwane.
swahili: Wananichukia sana na kujitenga nami, wala hawasiti kunitemea mate usoni.

english: Because God has unstrung my bow and afflicted me, they have cast off restraint in my presence.
ekegusii: Nyasae ong’urire chinguru, naende onkorire koba omoitongo, na abanto abwo babeire abaremu ase ogonkorera bobe.
swahili: Sasa kwa kuwa Mungu ameilegeza kamba ya upinde wangu na kunitesa, wamekuwa huru kunitendea waonavyo.

english: The rabble arises at my right; they lay snares for my feet and build siege ramps against me.
ekegusii: Ekeombe ki’abanto abasaria nigo bagontubokera korwa ensemo yane ya borio, erio baminyokia gonseria; nigo bagokora emeroberio emenge y’ogonsiria.
swahili: Kuume kwangu kundi linashambulia; wao huitegea miguu yangu tanzi, na kunizingira.

english: They tear up my path; they profit from my destruction, with no one to restrain them.
ekegusii: Basaririe enchera yane ngoetera; abwo batabwate ogosemia konde abanyene, nigo bagokonya abande ase ogonsiria.
swahili: Huizuia njia yangu, nao hufanikiwa katika kuniletea maafa, nami sina yeyote wa kunisaidia.

english: They advance as through a wide breach; through the ruins they keep rolling in. Job’s Prosperity Becomes Calamity
ekegusii: Nigo bagoeta aase omogwa omogare banchichera ne chinguru, erio bang’umokera goetera ase omogwa oyio baabagoire.
swahili: Wananijia kama watu wapitao katika ufa mpana; katikati ya magofu huja na kunishambulia.

english: Terrors are turned loose against me; they drive away my dignity as by the wind, and my prosperity has passed like a cloud.
ekegusii: Obwoba obonene bwanchicheire; ogosikwa kwane gwasirigwe buna omwaga ogosiria, na obotenenku bwane bwasirire pi buna amare agosira.
swahili: Vitisho vimenifunika; heshima yangu imetoweshwa kama kwa upepo, salama yangu imetoweka kama wingu.

english: And now my soul is poured out within me; days of affliction grip me.
ekegusii: Na bono omoyo one oberire ime yane; amatuko ’emechando ambwatereire bokong’u.
swahili: “Sasa maisha yangu yamefikia mwisho; siku za mateso zimenikamata.

english: Night pierces my bones, and my gnawing pains never rest.
ekegusii: Amauga omobere one nigo akonyatia botuko bokia, na obororo bokondia tibori gokenda.
swahili: Usiku mifupa yangu inachoma; maumivu yanayonitafuna hayatulii kamwe.

english: With great force He grasps my garment; He seizes me by the collar of my tunic.
ekegusii: Oborwaire bwane bwabeire ne chinguru bwaonchoire risankwa ri’omobere one, bono nigo ring’usererete buna rigoti ri’eanga yane.
swahili: Kwa uwezo wake mkuu Mungu huwa kwangu kama nguo; hushikamana nami kama ukosi wa vazi langu.

english: He throws me into the mud, and I have become like dust and ashes.
ekegusii: Nyasae ontugutire ase etintira ime, nabeire buna orotu ne ribu.
swahili: Yeye amenitupa kwenye matope, nami nimekuwa kama mavumbi na majivu.

english: What use to me was the strength of their hands, since their vigor had left them?
ekegusii: Abanto abwo chinguru chiabo chiaerire ase obogotu, ngokonywa ki ndanyore korwa ase amaboko abo?
swahili: Nguvu za mikono yao zingekuwa na faida gani kwangu, kwa kuwa nguvu zao zilikuwa zimewaishia?

english: I cry out to You for help, but You do not answer; when I stand up, You merely look at me.
ekegusii: Nigo nkorera asore, korende aye tori kong’iraneria; nigo nteneine asore, korende aye nigo onsonchete rioka.
swahili: “Ee Bwana, ninakulilia wewe lakini hunijibu; ninasimama, nawe unanitazama tu.

english: You have ruthlessly turned on me; You oppose me with Your strong hand.
ekegusii: Aye kwabeire omotindi ase ’nde; nigo okondwania nokoboko kwao kore ne chinguru.
swahili: Wewe unanigeukia bila huruma; unanishambulia kwa nguvu za mkono wako.

english: You snatch me up into the wind and drive me before it; You toss me about in the storm.
ekegusii: Aye nigo onyimokereretie igoro kwambekire ase omwaga na kondiinia igoro yaye. Aye nigo okona‐konduchania gochia aaria na aaria, naba bosa ase omwaga omotindi.
swahili: Unaninyakua na kunipeperusha kwa upepo; umenirusha huku na huko kwenye dhoruba kali.

english: Yes, I know that You will bring me down to death, to the place appointed for all the living.
ekegusii: Ee, namanyire ng’a nong’ire aase abakuure, ase enyomba eria echikeire abare moyo bonsi.
swahili: Ninajua utanileta mpaka kifoni, mahali ambapo wenye uhai wote wamewekewa.

english: Yet no one stretches out his hand to a ruined man when he cries for help in his distress.
ekegusii: Inee! Omonto karagwe takorambora okoboko kwaye, na ase emechando yaye arere akonywe?
swahili: “Hakika hakuna yeyote amshambuliaye mhitaji, anapoomba msaada katika shida yake.

english: Have I not wept for those in trouble? Has my soul not grieved for the needy?
ekegusii: Inee! Tinarerete ase engencho y’abwo barenge ase emechando? Omoyo one tochandekerete abataka?
swahili: Je, sikulia kwa ajili ya wale waliokuwa katika taabu? Je, nafsi yangu haikusononeka kwa ajili ya maskini?

english: But when I hoped for good, evil came; when I looked for light, darkness fell.
ekegusii: Korende ekero nasemeretie konyora amaya, amabe agacha, na ekero nabeete nsemeretie konyora oborabu, omosunte ogaacha.
swahili: Lakini nilipotazamia mema, mabaya yalinijia; nilipotafuta nuru, ndipo giza lilipokuja.

english: I am churning within and cannot rest; days of affliction confront me.
ekegusii: Enkoro yane nigo ere nemechando mono, teri n’obotoereru, amatuko ’emechando anchicheire.
swahili: Kusukwasukwa ndani yangu kamwe hakutulii; siku za mateso zinanikabili.

english: I go about blackened, but not by the sun. I stand up in the assembly and cry for help.
ekegusii: Nigo nkona‐koong’anya inde nemechando ntarochi omobaso; nigo ngotenena ase omosangererekano, narera ng’a nkonywe.
swahili: Ninazunguka nikiwa nimeungua, lakini si kwa jua; ninasimama katika kusanyiko nikiomba msaada.

english: I have become a brother of jackals, a companion of ostriches.
ekegusii: Inche nabeire oyomwabo chisese chi’orosana, na omogisangio bwe chisagero.
swahili: Nimekuwa ndugu wa mbweha, rafiki wa mabundi.

english: Gaunt from poverty and hunger, they gnawed the dry land, and the desolate wasteland by night.
ekegusii: Ase engencho y’okoremerwa na enchara babeire ebigonkobe, nigo bakona‐kogokona namaino abo riroba eriomo pa, erio riasaregete.
swahili: Wakiwa wamekonda kutokana na kupungukiwa na kwa njaa, walizurura usiku katika nchi kame iliyo ukiwa.

english: My skin grows black and peels, and my bones burn with fever.
ekegusii: Risankwa riane riaonchokire riamwamire ti, na nigo rikona‐kobutoka, na amauga aane nigo akoyia buna omorero.
swahili: Ngozi yangu imekuwa nyeusi nayo inachunika; mifupa yangu inaungua kwa homa.

english: My harp is tuned to mourning and my flute to the sound of weeping.
ekegusii: Obokano bwane bw’ebirigisa nigo bokominwa bwaba obw’ebirero, na ekeroria kiane kiaonchoirwe kobugigwa ase abanto bakorera.
swahili: Kinubi changu kimegeuka kuwa maombolezo, nayo filimbi yangu imekuwa sauti ya kilio.

english: They plucked mallow among the shrubs, and the roots of the broom tree were their food.
ekegusii: Nigo bakona‐gosangereria ebimeri bie chinsana, na baremora emeri y’emete enga buna ebisanka.
swahili: Katika vichaka walikusanya mimea ya chumvi, nacho chakula chao kilikuwa mizizi ya mti wa mfagio.

english: They were banished from among men, shouted down like thieves,
ekegusii: Abwo nigo bagoserigwa korwa ase egati y’abanto, baakerwa amariogi korwa magega na kwogererwa buna abaibi.
swahili: Walifukuzwa mbali na watu wao, wakipigiwa kelele kama wevi.

english: so that they lived on the slopes of the wadis, among the rocks and in holes in the ground.
ekegusii: Ase igo bagenda komenya ase amakuruma are ase amagoko, na ase chingoro inse y’ense, na ase ebitare.
swahili: Walilazimika kuishi katika mikondo ya vijito vilivyokauka, kwenye majabali na mahandaki.

english: They cried out among the shrubs and huddled beneath the nettles.
ekegusii: Ime ase ebitutu nigo bakwogererana, inse y’amase akorura nao bagosangererekana amo.
swahili: Kwenye vichaka walilia kama punda, na walijisongasonga pamoja kwenye vichaka.

english: A senseless and nameless brood, they were driven off the land.
ekegusii: Barabwo nabana b’abaanto abariri na ab’abakayayu; nigo baseretigwe nemecharichi barue ase ense.
swahili: Wao ni watoto wa wapumbavu wenye asili ya ubaya, waliofukuzwa watoke katika nchi.

english: And now they mock me in song; I have become a byword among them.
ekegusii: Na bono inche nabeire engero egoterwa ase bare, ee, nabeire ase bare ring’ana rikorabaarwa.
swahili: “Nao sasa wana wao wananidhihaki katika nyimbo; nimekuwa kitu cha dhihaka kwao.

english: “I have made a covenant with my eyes. How then could I gaze with desire at a virgin?
ekegusii: Inche nakorire okobwatana kw’ogotianania namaiso aane ng’a tinkorigereria omoiseke omwekungi ase okomogania.
swahili: “Nimefanya agano na macho yangu yasimtazame msichana kwa kumtamani.

english: then may my own wife grind grain for another, and may other men sleep with her.
ekegusii: rirorio tiga omokungu one abe ogoseera omonto omoao obosie, naende abasacha bande babe bakoba nere.
swahili: basi mke wangu na asage nafaka ya mwanaume mwingine, nao wanaume wengine walale naye.

english: For that would be a heinous crime, an iniquity to be judged.
ekegusii: Okwo nigo kware koba ogosaria okobe mono goetania, na kware koegwa egesusuro nabagaambi ebiina bonsi.
swahili: Kwa kuwa hilo lingekuwa aibu, naam, dhambi ya kuhukumiwa.

english: For it is a fire that burns down to Abaddon; it would root out my entire harvest.
ekegusii: Boigo nigo kware koba omorero ogosamba gochia aase ay’ogosiria na koria ebinto biane bionsi kobikoora.
swahili: Ni moto uwakao kwa Uharibifu; ungekuwa umengʼoa mavuno yangu.

english: If I have rejected the cause of my manservant or maidservant when they made a complaint against me,
ekegusii: Inse kwanga koroisia amang’ana omosomba one, omosacha gose omokungu, ekero baremurunganie igoro yane,
swahili: “Kama ningewanyima haki watumishi wangu wanaume au vijakazi wangu, walipokuwa na manungʼuniko dhidi yangu,

english: what will I do when God rises to judge? How will I answer when called to account?
ekegusii: ninki ndakore ekero Nyasae aranyimokere? Ninki ndamoiranerie ekero arabe okorua egesusuro ki’ebibe biane?
swahili: nitafanya nini Mungu atakaponikabili? Nitamjibu nini nitakapoitwa kutoa hesabu?

english: Did not He who made me in the womb also make them? Did not the same One form us in the womb?
ekegusii: Inee! Oyio ontongete ase enda ya baba, tari ere otongete oyio boigo? Tari ere oyomo otobombete ase enda ime?
swahili: Je, yeye aliyeniumba tumboni mwa mama yangu, si ndiye aliwaumba? Je, si ni yeye huyo mmoja aliyetuumba sote ndani ya mama zetu?

english: If I have denied the desires of the poor or allowed the widow’s eyes to fail,
ekegusii: Inche tinarinete omotaka egento aganetie, gose tinatigete omoboraka kwerusia moyo;
swahili: “Ikiwa nimewanyima maskini haja zao, au kuyaacha macho ya wajane yadhoofike,

english: if I have eaten my morsel alone, not sharing it with the fatherless—
ekegusii: tinarenge koria endagera yane inche bweka, nigo naete nentakana nero, ekayeria.
swahili: kama nimekula chakula changu mwenyewe, bila kuwashirikisha yatima;

english: though from my youth I reared him as would a father, and from my mother’s womb I guided the widow—
ekegusii: Oyio inche nabeete ise korwa obosae bwaye, na korwa okoiborwa kwaye nkaba nkomorera na komoraa.
swahili: lakini tangu ujana wangu nimemlea yatima kama ambavyo baba angefanya, nami tangu kuzaliwa kwangu nimewaongoza wajane:

english: if I have seen one perish for lack of clothing, or a needy man without a cloak,
ekegusii: Inee! Monto onde nare ochandegete ase okoborwa chianga, gose omotaka otabwati ekiebisio, ntakonyete?
swahili: kama nilimwona yeyote akiteseka kwa kukosa nguo, au mtu mhitaji asiye na mavazi

english: For what is the allotment of God from above, or the heritage from the Almighty on high?
ekegusii: Naki rende egetari kiane gekorwa ase Nyasae o igoro kerabe? Na omwando one okorwa ase Omobui ore igoro, naki orabe?
swahili: Kwa kuwa fungu la mwanadamu ni gani kutoka kwa Mungu juu, urithi wake kutoka kwa Mungu Mwenye Nguvu Aliye juu?

english: if his heart has not blessed me for warming him with the fleece of my sheep,
ekegusii: Barabwo nigo bansesenetie, ekiagera nabaete chingobo chi’amarionya e ching’ondi chikorwa ase amaicho aane.
swahili: ambaye wala moyo wake haukunibariki kwa kumpatia joto kwa mavazi ya manyoya ya kondoo zangu,

english: if I have lifted up my hand against the fatherless because I saw that I had support in the gate,
ekegusii: Onye nakorerete entakana bobe ekiagera namanyete ng’a ekegambero agwo ase egeita ngenkonye,
swahili: na kama nimeinua mkono wangu dhidi ya yatima, nikijua kuwa nina ushawishi mahakamani,

english: then may my arm fall from my shoulder and be torn from its socket.
ekegusii: rirorio tiga amareko aane ongoke agwe inse, ne chinengo chi’amaboko aane chisomoke.
swahili: basi mkono wangu na unyofoke toka begani mwangu, nao na uvunjike kutoka kiungio chake.

english: For calamity from God terrifies me, and His splendor I cannot overpower.
ekegusii: Nigo nare gocha kwoboigwa nemechando korwa ase Nyasae; na tinare konyara gotenena bosio bw’obonene bwaye.
swahili: Kwa kuwa niliogopa uharibifu kutoka kwa Mungu, nami kwa kuuogopa utukufu wake sikuweza kufanya mambo kama hayo.

english: If I have put my trust in gold or called pure gold my security,
ekegusii: Tinasemeretie etaabu, nonya netaabu echenire;
swahili: “Kama nimeweka tumaini langu kwenye dhahabu, au kuiambia dhahabu safi, ‘Wewe ndiwe salama yangu,’

english: if I have rejoiced in my great wealth because my hand had gained so much,
ekegusii: tinagokerete gose gochengera obotenenku bwane obonge, gose ebinto nenyorerete namaboko aane.
swahili: kama nimefurahia wingi wa utajiri wangu, ustawi ambao mikono yangu ilikuwa imepata,

english: if I have beheld the sun in its radiance or the moon moving in splendor,
ekegusii: Tinarigereretie erioba ekero riabarete, gose omotienyi ekero omesete,
swahili: kama nimelitazama jua katika kungʼaa kwake au mwezi ukienda kwa fahari yake,

english: so that my heart was secretly enticed and my hand threw a kiss from my mouth,
ekegusii: goika enkoro yane ekaebererigwa bobisi ase okobisasiima, gose tinanyunyuntete okoboko kwane ase okobisika.
swahili: hivyo moyo wangu kushawishiwa kwa siri, au kubusu mkono wangu kwa kuviheshimu,

english: this would also be an iniquity to be judged, for I would have denied God on high.
ekegusii: Onye nakorete ayio nigo nare koegwa egesusuro nabagaambi ebiina, ekiagera ayio nokomokana Nyasae ore igoro.
swahili: basi hiyo pia ingekuwa dhambi ya kuhukumiwa, kwa kuwa ningekuwa si mwaminifu kwa Mungu aishiye juu sana.

english: If I have rejoiced in my enemy’s ruin, or exulted when evil befell him—
ekegusii: Inee! Nagokerete ogosirigwa kw’omobisa one? Gose netogetie ekero amabe amocherete?
swahili: “Kama nimeshangilia msiba wa adui yangu, au kutazama kwa furaha taabu iliyomjia,

english: Does not disaster come to the unjust and calamity to the workers of iniquity?
ekegusii: Inee! Emechando teri konyora abatari abanyaboronge, na ogosirigwa gwachera abagokora ebibe?
swahili: Je, si uharibifu kwa watu waovu, maangamizi kwa wale watendao mabaya?

english: I have not allowed my mouth to sin by asking for his life with a curse—
ekegusii: Yaya, tinatigete omonwa one okore ebibe ase okomoragereria na komoganeria amakweri.
swahili: lakini sikuruhusu kinywa changu kufanya dhambi kwa kuomba laana dhidi ya maisha yake;

english: if the men of my house have not said, ‘Who is there who has not had his fill?’—
ekegusii: Abanto bonsi bamenyete aa bwone babeire birori ng’a kera omonto obeire oisanegete nendagera nkomoa.
swahili: kama watu wa nyumbani mwangu kamwe hawakusema, ‘Ni nani ambaye hajashibishwa na nyama ya Ayubu?’

english: but no stranger had to lodge on the street, for my door has been open to the traveler—
ekegusii: Nigo narenge koigorera abaeti ebisieri biane basoa; gose motaari onde tabeete okorara isiko botuko.
swahili: Lakini hakuna mgeni aliyelala njiani, kwa maana mlango wangu ulikuwa wazi kwa msafiri;

english: if I have covered my transgressions like Adam by hiding my guilt in my heart,
ekegusii: Tinatubete ogosaria kwane buna engencho ya Mwanyabaanto ere, gose ebibe biane ase egekuba kiane ime.
swahili: kama nimeifunika dhambi yangu kama wanadamu wengine wafanyavyo, kwa kuficha hatia yangu moyoni mwangu,

english: because I greatly feared the crowds and the contempt of the clans terrified me, so that I kept silent and would not go outside—
ekegusii: Tinairogete omoganda omonene bw’abaanto, gose kwoboa abaamate abwo barenge gonchaya, erinde imbe nkirete na kobeera nyomba ime.
swahili: kwa sababu ya kuogopa umati wa watu, na hivyo kuwa na hofu ya kudharauliwa na jamaa, nikanyamaza kimya nisitoke nje ya mlango:

english: (Oh, that I had one to hear me! Here is my signature. Let the Almighty answer me; let my accuser compose an indictment.
ekegusii: “Naki yare koba buya onye nanyora omonto okonyigwa. Inche nakoorire amang’ana aane! Oria Omonguru nang’iranerie! Ninganetie ndore amang’ana omobisa one andikerete ase okonyomania.
swahili: (“Laiti kama angekuwepo mtu wa kunisikia! Tazama sasa ninatia sahihi kwenye utetezi wangu: Mwenyezi na anijibu; mshtaki wangu na aweke mashtaka yake kwenye maandishi.

english: Surely I would carry it on my shoulder and wear it like a crown.
ekegusii: Ekeene, nigo nare koyabogoria igoro ase amareko aane; nanga nigo nayesiberania abe buna egutwa ase ’nde.
swahili: Hakika ningeyavaa begani mwangu, ningeyavaa kama taji.

english: I would give account of all my steps; I would approach Him like a prince.)—
ekegusii: Nanga namoteebia igoro y’orogendo rwane rwonsi; nigo nare komochiera inde buna omogambi.
swahili: Ningempa hesabu ya kila hatua yangu, ningemwendea kama mwana wa mfalme.)

english: if my land cries out against me and its furrows weep together,
ekegusii: “Inee! Oboremo bwane bwanakondeera? Gose emeng’ororia ye chintinde yana‐korererana?
swahili: “Kama nchi yangu inalia dhidi yangu, na mifereji yake yote imelowana kwa machozi,

english: if I have devoured its produce without payment or broken the spirit of its tenants,
ekegusii: Onye nabeire nkoria okwama kwaye ntari goakana na kogera abanyene bakwe,
swahili: kama nimekula mazao yake bila malipo, au kuvunja mioyo ya wapangaji wake,

english: Does He not see my ways and count my every step?
ekegusii: Inee! Nyasae tarochi chinchera chiane chionsi na kobara amatambokero aane onsi?
swahili: Je, yeye hazioni njia zangu na kuihesabu kila hatua yangu?

english: then let briers grow instead of wheat and stinkweed instead of barley.” Thus conclude the words of Job.
ekegusii: rirorio tiga amagwa amereo ribaga ri’engano, na amabanchore ribaga ri’esairi.” Amang’ana ’Ayubu aereire aa.
swahili: basi miiba na iote badala ya ngano, na magugu badala ya shayiri.” Mwisho wa maneno ya Ayubu.

english: If I have walked in falsehood or my foot has rushed to deceit,
ekegusii: Inee! Nabeire ngotaara ase chinchera chi’obong’ainereria, gose amagoro aane naminyokeire ay’oborimo?
swahili: “Kama nimeishi katika uongo au mguu wangu umekimbilia udanganyifu,

english: let God weigh me with honest scales, that He may know my integrity.
ekegusii: Tiga ndengwe ase ekerengo ekeronge, na Nyasae amanye oboikeranu bwane.
swahili: Mungu na anipime katika mizani za uaminifu, naye atajua kwamba sina hatia:

english: If my steps have turned from the path, if my heart has followed my eyes, or if impurity has stuck to my hands,
ekegusii: Onye nagobeire korwa ase enchera, na enkoro yane yabeire ekobwatia okogania kw’amaiso aane, na onye komocha konde kwabwatereire amaboko aane,
swahili: kama hatua zangu zimepotoka kutoka kwenye njia, kama moyo wangu umeongozwa na macho yangu, au kama mikono yangu imetiwa unajisi,

english: then may another eat what I have sown, and may my crops be uprooted.
ekegusii: rirorio inche nsimeke endagera, na omonto omoao ayeire, na kende gionsi kiane keramere gesimorwe.
swahili: basi wengine na wale nilichokipanda, nayo yale yote niliyootesha na yangʼolewe.

english: If my heart has been enticed by my neighbor’s wife, or I have lurked at his door,
ekegusii: Onye omoyo one obeire okoebererigwa na gwancha omokungu omoao, na igo nabeire nkoboera omonto onde ase egesieri kiaye imosirie,
swahili: “Kama moyo wangu umeshawishiwa na mwanamke, au kama nimevizia mlangoni mwa jirani yangu,

english: So these three men stopped answering Job, because he was righteous in his own eyes.
ekegusii: Bono ekiagera Ayubu arenge omonyaboronge ase amaiso aye ere omonyene, abanto baria batato bagatiga komoiraneria.
swahili: Basi watu hawa watatu wakaacha kumjibu Ayubu, kwa kuwa alikuwa mwadilifu machoni pake mwenyewe.

english: Therefore I say, ‘Listen to me; I too will declare what I know.’
ekegusii: Nigo nkoboria, montegerere, erinde nkwane ayare ase ebirengererio biane.
swahili: “Kwa hiyo nasema: Nisikilizeni mimi; mimi nami nitawaambia lile ninalojua.

english: Indeed, I waited while you spoke; I listened to your reasoning; as you searched for words,
ekegusii: Naama! Nigo nategererete mono ekero mwarenge gokwana; nkaba ndemereretie koigwa chinkwana chiaino chi’obong’aini, ekero mwarenge koriga‐rigia ng’a mang’ana ki mwagwenerete gokwana.
swahili: Nilingojea mlipokuwa mnaongea, nilizisikiliza hoja zenu; mlipokuwa mkitafuta maneno ya kusema,

english: I paid you full attention. But no one proved Job wrong; not one of you rebutted his arguments.
ekegusii: Ee, nigo nabategererete mono, korende onde tarenge ase more obuete Ayubu, gose onde tanyarete koiraneria amang’ana aye.
swahili: niliwasikiliza kwa makini. Lakini hakuna hata mmoja wenu aliyethibitisha kwamba Ayubu amekosa; hakuna hata mmoja wenu aliyeweza kujibu hoja zake.

english: So do not claim, ‘We have found wisdom; let God, not man, refute him.’
ekegusii: Inwe erende mono, timobaisa goteeba: Intwe twanyorire obong’aini. Nyasae nere orabue Ayubu na amoiyerie, tari Mwanyabaanto.
swahili: Msiseme, ‘Tumepata hekima; Mungu na amthibitishe kuwa mwongo, wala si mwanadamu.’

english: But Job has not directed his words against me, and I will not answer him with your arguments.
ekegusii: Ayubu takwanete nainche amang’ana ande ay’okweegerera, na inche tinkomoiraneria buna inwe.
swahili: Lakini Ayubu hajayapanga maneno yake dhidi yangu, nami sitamjibu kwa kutumia hoja zenu.

english: Job’s friends are dismayed, with no more to say; words have escaped them.
ekegusii: Bono batang’ang’ire, tibakonyara kong’iraneria nonya ng’ake; tibabwati ring’ana bagokwana.
swahili: “Wametiwa hofu na hawana la zaidi la kusema; maneno yamewaishia.

english: Must I wait, now that they are silent, now that they stand and no longer reply?
ekegusii: Inee! Nainche nigo nkogenderera koganya, ekiagera tibari gokwana, na ekiagera bateneine agwo batari koiraneria?
swahili: Je, ningoje sasa kwa sababu wamekuwa kimya, kwa vile sasa wanasimama bila kuwa na la kujibu?

english: I too will answer; yes, I will declare what I know.
ekegusii: Inche ngokwana inde ayane, erinde ng’orokie ayare ase ebirengererio biane.
swahili: Mimi nami nitakuwa na la kusema; mimi nami nitasema lile nilijualo.

english: For I am full of words, and my spirit within me compels me.
ekegusii: Inche nimbwate amang’ana amange nganetie gokwana, ekiagera omoika ore ime yane onsukirie.
swahili: Kwa kuwa nimejawa na maneno, nayo Roho iliyomo ndani yangu yanisukuma;

english: Behold, my belly is like unvented wine; it is about to burst like a new wineskin.
ekegusii: Rora, enda yane nigo enga buna edivai ekunekire mono, buna ebirandi biroisirie korwa ase amasankwa amayia bire ang’e kworeka.
swahili: ndani yangu niko kama chupa iliyojazwa divai, kama kiriba kipya cha divai kilicho tayari kupasuka.

english: This kindled the anger of Elihu son of Barachel the Buzite, of the family of Ram. He burned with anger against Job for justifying himself rather than God,
ekegusii: Erio Elihu akaba nendamwamu ase Ayubu, ekiagera ekorete omonyakeene kobua Nyasae. Elihu oyio nigo arenge mosinto o Barakeli Omobusi, na oyo bw’eamate ya Ramu.
swahili: Lakini Elihu mwana wa Barakeli, wa kabila la Buzi wa jamaa ya Ramu, akamkasirikia sana Ayubu, kwa sababu ya kujihesabia haki mwenyewe badala ya Mungu.

english: I must speak and find relief; I must open my lips and respond.
ekegusii: Goika nkwane, erio nario ndanyore obotoereru; goika imaanore omonwa nkwane, ing’iranerie.
swahili: Ni lazima niseme ili niweze kutulia; ni lazima nifumbue midomo yangu nipate kujibu.

english: I will be partial to no one, nor will I flatter any man.
ekegusii: Inche tinkonyara gwanchereria monto onde bwensi, gose gokwana amang’ana ay’okweansia.’
swahili: Sitampendelea mtu yeyote, wala sitajipendekeza kwa mtu yeyote;

english: For I do not know how to flatter, or my Maker would remove me in an instant.
ekegusii: Inche timanyeti gokwana amang’ana ’okweansia, inse gokora bo, Omotongi one nigo aransirie bwango.
swahili: kwa kuwa kama ningekuwa stadi wa kujipendekeza, Muumba wangu angeniondolea mbali kwa upesi.

english: and he burned with anger against Job’s three friends because they had failed to refute Job, and yet had condemned him.
ekegusii: Boigo akaba nendamwamu ase abasani baria batato b’Ayubu, ekiagera batanyorete amang’ana bakoiraneria, nonya bateebeete ng’a Ayubu nomomochi.
swahili: Pia aliwakasirikia hao rafiki watatu wa Ayubu, kwa sababu hawakuweza kupata njia ya kuthibitisha ya kuwa hayo maneno ya Ayubu hayakuwa ya kweli, nao bado walikuwa wamemlaumu.

english: Now Elihu had waited to speak to Job because the others were older than he.
ekegusii: Elihu akaba okoganya baria batato barakwana n’Ayubu, ekiagera ere arenge omoke ase emiaka.
swahili: Basi Elihu alikuwa amesubiri kwanza waongee na Ayubu kwa sababu walikuwa na umri mkubwa kumliko yeye.

english: But when he saw that the three men had no further reply, his anger was kindled.
ekegusii: Na ekero aroche ng’a baria batato tibabwate ing’ana baare koiraneria, akaba nendamwamu. Elihu
swahili: Lakini alipoona watu hao watatu hawakuwa na kitu zaidi cha kusema, hasira yake ikaamka.

english: So Elihu son of Barachel the Buzite declared: “I am young in years, while you are old; that is why I was timid and afraid to tell you what I know.
ekegusii: Elihu mosinto o Barakeli Omobusi, agateeba: Inche nigo inde omoke ase emiaka, korende inwe nabakoro more; ayio naro agerete nkaba nobwoba, ngakira‐kiri, na tinakwana ay’ebirengererio biane ase more.
swahili: Basi Elihu mwana wa Barakeli wa kabila la Buzi akasema: “Mimi ni mdogo kwa umri, nanyi ni wazee; ndiyo sababu niliogopa, sikuthubutu kuwaambia kile ninachojua.

english: I thought that age should speak, and many years should teach wisdom.
ekegusii: Korende ngateeba: Tiga abanto b’amatuko amange bakwane, abanyamiaka menge borokererie obong’aini.
swahili: Nilifikiri, ‘Yafaa umri useme, nao wingi wa miaka ungefundisha hekima.’

english: But there is a spirit in a man, the breath of the Almighty, that gives him understanding.
ekegusii: Korende omoika nore ime ase Mwanyabaanto, omoika oyio bw’Omonguru noro okobaa okomanya.
swahili: Lakini ni Roho iliyoko ndani ya mwanadamu, pumzi ya Mwenyezi, ndiyo impayo yeye ufahamu.

english: It is not only the old who are wise, or the elderly who understand justice.
ekegusii: Bono tari ng’a nabaanto b’emiaka emenge bare abang’aini, gose tari ng’a nabagotu bamanyete ayare boronge.
swahili: Sio wazee peke yao walio na hekima, sio wenye umri mkubwa peke yao wanaofahamu lililo sawa.

english: “But now, O Job, hear my speech, and listen to all my words.
ekegusii: Aye Ayubu, bono inyigwe, ntegerera ase onsi aya ngokwana.
swahili: “Lakini Ayubu, sasa, sikiliza maneno yangu; zingatia kila kitu nitakachosema.

english: Yet God finds occasions against me; He counts me as His enemy.
ekegusii: Naama! Nyasae onyorire amasoero ase ’nde, na ombarire ng’a nomobisa oye inde.
swahili: Lakini bado Mungu amepata dosari kwangu, naye ananiona kama adui yake.

english: He puts my feet in the stocks; He watches over all my paths.’
ekegusii: Osoirie amagoro aane ase rikorogoto, na nigo akoba ondigereretie ase oboeto bwane bwonsi.
swahili: Ananifunga miguu kwa pingu, tena anaziangalia njia zangu zote kwa karibu.’

english: Behold, you are not right in this matter. I will answer you, for God is greater than man.
ekegusii: “Naama! Nigo ngokoiraneria ng’a ase amang’ana aya tokwaneti ekeene; Nyasae nigo are omonene goetania Mwanyabaanto.
swahili: “Lakini mimi ninakuambia, katika jambo hili wewe una makosa, kwa maana Mungu ni mkuu kuliko mwanadamu.

english: Why do you complain to Him that He answers nothing a man asks?
ekegusii: Nase ki okoamererania nere kogoteeba ng’a ere takoiraneria amang’ana aya nonya nerimo?
swahili: Kwa nini unamlalamikia kwamba yeye hamjibu mwanadamu?

english: For God speaks in one way and in another, yet no one notices.
ekegusii: Ekeene, Nyasae nigo agokwana ase enchera eyemo, gose ibere; nonya nabo monto onde tari okomotegerera.
swahili: Kwa kuwa Mungu husema, wakati huu kwa njia moja, au wakati mwingine kwa njia nyingine, ingawa mwanadamu anaweza asielewe.

english: In a dream, in a vision in the night, when deep sleep falls upon men as they slumber on their beds,
ekegusii: Nigo agokwana ase chindoto na amaroro a botuko, na ekero abanto bararire chitoro chindito, na ekero basundokire ase amarere abo.
swahili: Mungu husema na mwanadamu katika ndoto, katika maono ya usiku, wakati usingizi mzito uwaangukiapo wanadamu wasinziapo vitandani mwao,

english: He opens their ears and terrifies them with warnings
ekegusii: Erio agwo otinora amato abanto, na obarentera ogokuurera gw’okoondokia
swahili: anaweza akasemea masikioni mwao, na kuwatia hofu kwa maonyo,

english: to turn a man from wrongdoing and keep him from pride,
ekegusii: ng’a anyare koonchora omonto atige ogokora kwaye okobe, na atange oboenenu bw’omonto.
swahili: ili kumgeuza mtu kutoka kwenye kutenda mabaya na kumwepusha na kiburi,

english: to preserve his soul from the Pit and his life from perishing by the sword.
ekegusii: Nigo agotanga omonto tagenda ase oboina, naende orenda obogima bwaye tibosirigwa n’omoro.
swahili: kuiokoa nafsi yake na shimo, uhai wake usiangamizwe kwa upanga.

english: A man is also chastened on his bed with pain and constant distress in his bones,
ekegusii: Omonto nigo akonyora egesusuro gi’okomoorongeyia, ekero are nobororo ase oborere bwaye, na amauga aye agendererete komwatia.
swahili: Mtu anaweza kutiwa adabu kwa maumivu kitandani mwake, kwa dhiki za mfululizo katika mifupa yake,

english: Behold, I will open my mouth; my address is on the tip of my tongue.
ekegusii: Rora, bono namumoire omonwa one, na oromeme rwane rwachakire gokwana.
swahili: Karibu nitafungua kinywa changu; maneno yangu yapo katika ncha ya ulimi wangu.

english: so that he detests his bread, and his soul loathes his favorite food.
ekegusii: Omoyo oye ogecha endagera, nonya endagera ere engiya mono.
swahili: kiasi kwamba maisha yake yenyewe yanakataa chakula nayo nafsi yake ikakichukia kabisa hata chakula kizuri.

english: His flesh wastes away from sight, and his hidden bones protrude.
ekegusii: Chinyama chi’omobere oye nigo chikoera, tichikororekana, na amauga aye atongonona.
swahili: Nyama ya mwili wake huisha kwa kukonda, nayo mifupa yake ambayo mwanzoni ilikuwa imefichika, sasa inatokeza nje.

english: He draws near to the Pit, and his life to the messengers of death.
ekegusii: Ere omonyene nigo agosuka gochia ang’e noboina, na obogima bwaye gochia ase abagosiria obogima.
swahili: Nafsi yake inakaribia kaburi, nao uhai wake karibu na wajumbe wa kifo.

english: Yet if there is a messenger on his side, one mediator in a thousand, to tell a man what is right for him,
ekegusii: “Onye omomalaika nkoba arenge asare, oyomo bwa baria chilifu bagokora okobwatania asare, erinde amworokie ayare ay’oboronge,
swahili: “Kama bado kuna malaika upande wake kama mtetezi, mmoja miongoni mwa elfu, wa kumwambia mwanadamu lililo jema kwake,

english: to be gracious to him and say, ‘Spare him from going down to the Pit; I have found his ransom,’
ekegusii: erio amororere amaabera, ateebe: Tooria omonto oyo tabaisa gotirimboka gochia ase oboina, ekiagera inche namonyoreire embooria.
swahili: kumwonea huruma na kusema, ‘Mwokoe asije akatumbukia shimoni; nimepata ukombozi kwa ajili yake’:

english: then his flesh is refreshed like a child’s; he returns to the days of his youth.
ekegusii: Omobere oye oiranigwe obe buna oyo bw’obosae bwaye, naende aonchorwe abe buna ekero arenge ne chinguru.
swahili: ndipo nyama ya mwili wake hufanywa mpya kama ya mtoto; hurudishwa upya kama siku za ujana wake.

english: He prays to God and finds favor; he sees God’s face and shouts for joy, and God restores His righteousness to that man.
ekegusii: Ekero arabe ogosaba Nyasae, nere namororere amaabera; omonto oyio nachiche ase obosio bwaye ore nomogooko, na Nyasae nairanie oboronge bw’omonto oyio.
swahili: Humwomba Mungu, akapata kibali kwake, huuona uso wa Mungu na kushangilia kwa furaha; Mungu humrudisha katika hali yake ya uadilifu.

english: Then he sings before men with these words: ‘I have sinned and perverted what was right; yet I did not get what I deserved.
ekegusii: Omonto oyio natere ase amasio ’abaanto, ateebe: Nigo nakorete ebibe, nkaonchorana aya arenge amaronge, gose tinanyorete egesusuro buna nagwenerete.
swahili: Ndipo huja mbele za watu na kusema, ‘Nilitenda dhambi na kupotosha kilichokuwa haki, lakini sikuadhibiwa kama nilivyostahili.

english: He redeemed my soul from going down to the Pit, and I will live to see the light.’
ekegusii: Ere obooririe omoyo one togenda ase oboina, bono obogima bwane mborore oborabu.
swahili: Alinikomboa nafsi yangu nisitumbukie shimoni, nami nitaishi ili kuufurahia mwanga.’

english: Behold, all these things God does to a man, two or even three times,
ekegusii: Rora, Nyasae nigo agokora amang’ana ayio onsi ase omonto ara kabere, gose ara gatato,
swahili: “Mungu hufanya haya yote kwa mwanadamu; mara mbili hata mara tatu,

english: My words are from an upright heart, and my lips speak sincerely what I know.
ekegusii: Amang’ana aane nigo akoorokia oboronge bore ime ase enkoro yane, na ase omonwa one nigo ngokwana aya imanyete.
swahili: Maneno yangu yanatoka katika moyo mnyofu; midomo yangu hunena kwa uaminifu yale niyajuayo.

english: to bring back his soul from the Pit, that he may be enlightened with the light of life.
ekegusii: erinde amoiranie korwa ase oboina, ng’a oyio anyare komorekerwa noborabu bw’obogima.
swahili: ili aigeuze nafsi yake toka shimoni, ili nuru ya uzima imwangazie.

english: Pay attention, Job, and listen to me; be silent, and I will speak.
ekegusii: “Aye Ayubu, ntegerera, okire‐kiri, inche nkwane.
swahili: “Ayubu, zingatia, nisikilize mimi; nyamaza, nami nitanena.

english: But if you have something to say, answer me; speak up, for I would like to vindicate you.
ekegusii: Onye kobwate ing’ana rinde okong’iraneria, kwana, ekiagera nigo nganetie gokoa oboronge bwao.
swahili: Kama unalo lolote la kusema, unijibu; sema, kwa maana ninataka uonekane huna hatia.

english: But if not, then listen to me; be quiet, and I will teach you wisdom.”
ekegusii: Onye tobwati kende, kira‐kiri ontegerere, na inche ninkworokererie obong’aini.”
swahili: Lakini kama huna la kusema, basi nisikilize mimi; nyamaza, nami nitakufundisha hekima.”

english: The Spirit of God has made me, and the breath of the Almighty gives me life.
ekegusii: Omoika o Nyasae noro ontongete, na omoika bw’obomoyo bw’Omonguru noro okong’a obogima.
swahili: Roho wa Mungu ameniumba; pumzi ya Mwenyezi hunipa uhai.

english: Refute me if you can; prepare your case and confront me.
ekegusii: Bono ing’iranerie onye gokonyara; beka amang’ana ao ang’e, otenene bokong’u!
swahili: Unijibu basi, kama unaweza; jiandae kunikabili mimi.

english: I am just like you before God; I was also formed from clay.
ekegusii: Rora, inche nigo inde buna aye ase obosio bwa Nyasae; inche boigo nigo natongetwe korwa ase riroba.
swahili: Mimi ni kama wewe mbele za Mungu; mimi pia nimetolewa kwenye udongo.

english: Surely no fear of me should terrify you; nor will my hand be heavy upon you.
ekegusii: Rora, inche tindi kende ogwenerete konyoboa; gose tindi gochia koba buna egurube endito asore.
swahili: Huna sababu ya kuniogopa, wala mkono wangu haupaswi kukulemea.

english: Surely you have spoken in my hearing, and I have heard these very words:
ekegusii: “Ekeene, gwakwanire ase ntegererete, na inche naigure amang’ana ao.
swahili: “Lakini umesema nikiwa ninakusikia, nami nilisikia maneno yenyewe:

english: ‘I am pure, without transgression; I am clean, with no iniquity in me.
ekegusii: Aye nigo ogoteeba iga: Inche nigo nchenegete, tindi nogosaria konde, na bibe tibiri ime yane.
swahili: ‘Mimi ni safi na sina dhambi; mimi ni safi na sina hatia.

english: Then Elihu continued:
ekegusii: Erio Elihu akagenderera gokwana, akabora:
swahili: Kisha Elihu akasema:

english: Therefore listen to me, O men of understanding. Far be it from God to do wrong, and from the Almighty to act unjustly.
ekegusii: “Ase ayio, inwe abanto abamore nokomanya, inyigwa! Nyasae tabaisa gokagerwa ng’a nakore amabe. Inee! Ere Omonguru nakore ebibe?
swahili: “Hivyo nisikilizeni mimi, ninyi watu wenye ufahamu. Kamwe Mungu hatendi uovu, Mwenyezi hafanyi kosa.

english: For according to a man’s deeds He repays him; according to a man’s ways He brings consequences.
ekegusii: Ere nigo agoakana omonto koreng’ana buna emeremo yaye ere; nabo akoa omonto eng’eria buna orogendo rwaye rore.
swahili: Humlipa mwanadamu kwa ajili ya lile alilotenda; huleta juu yake kile ambacho matendo yake yanastahili.

english: Indeed, it is true that God does not act wickedly, and the Almighty does not pervert justice.
ekegusii: Ekeene, Nyasae tagokora ayare amabe; ee, ere Omonguru tari gosaria ayare ay’ekeene.
swahili: Ni jambo lisiloweza kufikiriwa kwamba Mungu angefanya makosa, kwamba Mwenyezi angepotosha hukumu.

english: Who gave Him charge over the earth? Who appointed Him over the whole world?
ekegusii: Ning’o oete Nyasae okobua gw’okogambera ense? Ning’o obeegete ense yonsi koba eyaye?
swahili: Je, ni nani aliyemtawaza juu ya dunia? Ni nani aliyemweka kuwa mwangalizi wa ulimwengu wote?

english: If He were to set His heart to it and withdraw His Spirit and breath,
ekegusii: Ere aise koirania omoika oye, ee, airanie gochia asare omoika bw’obogima,
swahili: Kama lilikuwa kusudi la Mungu, naye akaiondoa Roho yake na pumzi yake,

english: all flesh would perish together and mankind would return to the dust.
ekegusii: Mwanyabaanto bonsi pi goika bakwe, bairane ase amaroba.
swahili: wanadamu wote wangeliangamia kwa pamoja, na mtu angerudi mavumbini.

english: If you have understanding, hear this; listen to my words.
ekegusii: “Onye more nokomanya, igwa aya; tegerera moigwe aya ngoteeba:
swahili: “Kama ninyi mnaufahamu, sikieni hili; sikilizeni hili nisemalo.

english: Could one who hates justice govern? Will you condemn the just and mighty One,
ekegusii: Inee! Omonto ogechete ekeene nanyare kogamba? Nonachere ekiina omonyene oboronge oyore nokobua?
swahili: Je, yeye aichukiaye haki aweza kutawala? Je, utamhukumu mwenye haki, Aliye na Nguvu Zote?

english: who says to kings, ‘You are worthless!’ and to nobles, ‘You are wicked,’
ekegusii: Nonyare goteebia omorwoti: Aye nigo ore omonto bosa, gose noteebie abanene basikire: Inwe nabakori amabe?
swahili: Je, si ni yeye awaambiaye wafalme, ‘Ninyi hamfai kitu,’ nao watu mashuhuri, ‘Ninyi ni waovu,’

english: who is not partial to princes and does not favor rich over poor? For they are all the work of His hands.
ekegusii: Nyasae tari gwanchereria abagaambi, gose tari kobara abanda ng’a mbare nengencho enene kobua abataka, ekiagera abwo bonsi nigo bare emeremo y’amaboko aye.
swahili: yeye asiyependelea wakuu, wala haonyeshi upendeleo kwa matajiri kuliko maskini, kwa kuwa wote ni kazi ya mikono yake?

english: “Hear my words, O wise men; give ear to me, O men of learning.
ekegusii: “Inwe abanto abang’aini, igwa amang’ana aane! Inwe abamanyi chisemi, ntegerera!
swahili: “Sikieni maneno yangu, enyi watu wenye hekima; nisikilizeni mimi, ninyi watu wenye maarifa.

english: They die in an instant, in the middle of the night. The people convulse and pass away; the mighty are removed without human hand.
ekegusii: Abanto nigo bagokwa ara rimo; nigo bakonyegerigwa botuko gati, basira kegima, baria bare nokobua nigo bagosirigwa ko tari namaboko a Mwanyabaanto.
swahili: Wanakufa ghafula, usiku wa manane; watu wanatikiswa nao hupita; wenye nguvu huondolewa bila mkono wa mwanadamu.

english: For His eyes are on the ways of a man, and He sees his every step.
ekegusii: Nyasae nigo arigereretie chinchera chi’omonto; ere nigo aroche amatambokero aye onsi.
swahili: “Macho yake yanazitazama njia za wanadamu; anaona kila hatua yao.

english: There is no darkness or deep shadow where the workers of iniquity can hide.
ekegusii: Aase aamwamu tari, gose omosunte ekerima, ase omokori amabe aranyare kwebisa.
swahili: Hakuna mahali penye giza nene, wala uvuli mkubwa, ambapo watenda mabaya wanaweza kujificha.

english: For God need not examine a man further or have him approach for judgment.
ekegusii: Nyasae taganeti engaki entambe korigereria, goika abeeke omonto ase ekiina.
swahili: Mungu hana haja ya kumchunguza mtu sana, ili apate kuja mbele zake kwa hukumu.

english: He shatters the mighty without inquiry and sets up others in their place.
ekegusii: Ere nigo agosenyenta abare nokobua atari kona‐kouna‐unia, erio abeeke abande aase abo.
swahili: Bila kuuliza huwapondaponda wenye nguvu nyingi na kuwaweka wengine mahali pao.

english: Therefore, He recognizes their deeds; He overthrows them in the night and they are crushed.
ekegusii: Ekiagera ere namanyete emeremo yabo, nigo akobaonchorana botuko baitwa kegima.
swahili: Kwa sababu huyaangalia matendo yao yote, huwaondoa usiku, nao wakaangamia.

english: He strikes them for their wickedness in full view,
ekegusii: Nyasae nigo akobaita maiso marore, ase engencho y’ebibe biabo,
swahili: Anawaadhibu kwa ajili ya uovu wao mahali ambapo kila mmoja ataweza kuwaona,

english: because they turned aside from Him and had no regard for any of His ways.
ekegusii: na ekiagera baonchokire na gotiga komobwatia, gose tibari korengereria igoro ye chinchera chiaye nonya ng’ake.
swahili: kwa sababu wameacha kumfuata Mungu, nao hawakuiheshimu njia yake hata moja.

english: They caused the cry of the poor to come before Him, and He heard the outcry of the afflicted.
ekegusii: Abwo bagerire ekerero ki’abataka giaikire asare, nere oigure ekerero ki’abagokorerwa bobe.
swahili: Wamesababisha kilio cha maskini kifike mbele zake, hivyo akasikia kilio cha wahitaji.

english: But when He remains silent, who can condemn Him? When He hides His face, who can see Him? Yet He watches over both man and nation,
ekegusii: “Inee! Nyasae karakire‐kiri ning’o oramonachere ekiina? Karabise obosio bwaye, ning’o oranyare komorigereria, gokerabe egesaku gete gose omonto gete,
swahili: Lakini kama akinyamaza kimya, ni nani awezaye kumhukumu? Kama akiuficha uso wake, ni nani awezaye kumwona? Ikiwa ni taifa au mtu mmoja, kwake ni sawa,

english: For the ear tests words as the mouth tastes food.
ekegusii: Amang’ana amato akoigwa, nigo akoyateema, buna oromeme rokomena endagera.
swahili: Kwa kuwa sikio huyajaribu maneno kama vile ulimi uonjavyo chakula.

english: that godless men should not rule or lay snares for the people.
ekegusii: ekero ararusie okogamba korwa ase abatamoirogeti na abatange tibaaba emeribo ase abanto?
swahili: ili kumzuia mtu mwovu kutawala, au wale ambao huwategea watu mitego.

english: Suppose someone says to God, ‘I have endured my punishment; I will offend no more.
ekegusii: “Inee! Monto onde nare oteebirie Nyasae: Inche naremereirie egesusuro gi’okondongeyia, nonya tinkorereti monto onde bobe.
swahili: “Kama mwanadamu akimwambia Mungu, ‘Nimekosa lakini sitatenda dhambi tena.

english: Teach me what I cannot see; if I have done wrong, I will not do it again.’
ekegusii: Bono inyorokererie aya ntamanyeti, na onye nakorire ebibe, tingwancha kobikora naende.
swahili: Nifundishe nisichoweza kuona; kama nimekukosea, sitafanya hivyo tena.’

english: Should God repay you on your own terms when you have disavowed His? You must choose, not I; so tell me what you know.
ekegusii: Nigo okagete ng’a Nyasae nigo aragoakane buna oranche, ekiagera gwakanire ande onsi? Aye goika ochore, gose tari inche; ase ayio, kwana aya omanyete.
swahili: Je basi, Mungu atakulipa kwa masharti yako, wakati wewe umekataa kutubu? Yakupasa wewe uamue, wala si mimi; sasa niambie lile ulijualo.

english: Men of understanding will declare to me, and the wise men who hear me will say:
ekegusii: “Abanto abare nokomanya, na kera omonto omong’aini orabe okonyigwa, nigo baranteebie:
swahili: “Wanadamu wenye ufahamu husema, wenye hekima wanaonisikia huniambia,

english: ‘Job speaks without knowledge; his words lack insight.’
ekegusii: Ayubu nigo agokwana atari na semi; na amang’ana aye tari ay’obong’aini.
swahili: ‘Ayubu huongea bila maarifa; maneno yake hayana busara.’

english: If only Job were tried to the utmost for answering like a wicked man.
ekegusii: Nigo yagwenerete Ayubu ateemwe goika omoerio, ekiagera nigo akoiraneria buna abakori amabe bakoiraneria.
swahili: Laiti Ayubu angejaribiwa hadi kikomo cha mwisho, kwa sababu anajibu kama mtu mwovu!

english: For he adds rebellion to his sin; he claps his hands among us and multiplies his words against God.”
ekegusii: Ere nigo akomenta ogosaria ase ebibe biaye, naende nigo agotoakera chinkobi ase ogotochaya na gokwana amang’ana amange are mamincha ya Nyasae.”
swahili: Kwenye dhambi yake huongeza uasi; kwa dharau hupiga makofi miongoni mwetu, na kuzidisha maneno yake dhidi ya Mungu.”

english: Let us choose for ourselves what is right; let us learn together what is good.
ekegusii: Tochore ayare amaronge; intwe amo toteeme komanya ayare amaronge.
swahili: Tujichagulie wenyewe yaliyo sawa, nasi tujifunze pamoja yaliyo mema.

english: For Job has declared, ‘I am righteous, yet God has deprived me of justice.
ekegusii: Ayubu nigo agoteeba: Inche nomonyene oboronge, korende Nyasae ong’urire oboronge bwane.
swahili: “Ayubu anasema, ‘Mimi sina hatia, lakini Mungu ameninyima haki yangu.

english: Would I lie about my case? My wound is incurable, though I am without transgression.’
ekegusii: Nonya inde omonyene oboronge, nabarirwe ng’a nomonyaborimo inde; amaote aane takonyara kogwena, nonya gosaria konde tikori ime ase ’nde.
swahili: Ingawa niko sawa, ninaonekana mwongo; nami ingawa sina kosa, kidonda changu hakiponi.’

english: What man is like Job, who drinks up derision like water?
ekegusii: “Inee! Monto ki onga buna Ayubu, oyio okonywa ogochaywa, ogokomera buna amaache?
swahili: Ni mtu gani aliye kama Ayubu, anywaye dharau kama maji?

english: He keeps company with evildoers and walks with wicked men.
ekegusii: Ere oyio ogosanga nabanyabibe na gotaara nabakori amabe.
swahili: Ashirikianaye na watenda mabaya na kuchangamana na watu waovu.

english: For he has said, ‘It profits a man nothing that he should delight in God.’
ekegusii: Naende ere oteebire ng’a kobwatana na Nyasae, ayio tari komokonya gento kende.
swahili: Kwa kuwa anasema, ‘Haimfaidi mwanadamu kitu chochote anapojitahidi kumpendeza Mungu.’

english: And Elihu went on to say:
ekegusii: Elihu akagenderera gokwana, akabora:
swahili: Ndipo Elihu akasema:

english: But no one asks, ‘Where is God my Maker, who gives us songs in the night,
ekegusii: Korende monto onde tari okobooria: Ng’ai Nyasae, oria ontongete, are, oyio okogera amatera ay’ogotogia aterwa botuko?
swahili: Lakini hakuna asemaye, ‘Yuko wapi Mungu Muumba wangu, yeye anifanyaye niimbe usiku,

english: who teaches us more than the beasts of the earth and makes us wiser than the birds of the air?’
ekegusii: Ere nigo agotworokereria kobua ching’iti chi’ense, na otokora twaba nobong’aini kobua chinyoni.
swahili: yeye atufundishaye sisi zaidi kuliko wanyama wa dunia, na kutufanya wenye hekima kuliko ndege wa angani?’

english: There they cry out, but He does not answer, because of the pride of evil men.
ekegusii: Abanto nigo bakorera, korende Nyasae tari koiraneria, ase engencho y’ogokora okobe kw’oboenenu kwa’ banyabibe.
swahili: Yeye hajibu wakati watu waliapo kwa sababu ya kiburi cha watu waovu.

english: Surely God does not listen to empty pleas, and the Almighty does not take note of it.
ekegusii: Ekeene, Nyasae tari koigwa okorera gotari ogw’ekeene, gose ere Omonguru takogwechandera.
swahili: Naam, Mungu hasikilizi maombi yao ya ubatili; Mwenyezi hayazingatii.

english: How much less, then, when you say that you do not see Him, that your case is before Him and you must wait for Him,
ekegusii: “Nonya kogoteeba ng’a tori komoorora, ere tagokoigwa; ekiina kiao nigo kere ase obosio bwaye, bono nigo omoganyete nogosemeria.
swahili: Si zaidi sana kwamba hatakusikiliza wewe usemapo humwoni, tena ya kwamba shauri lako liko mbele zake na wewe lazima umngojee,

english: and further, that in His anger He has not punished or taken much notice of folly!
ekegusii: Korende bono nigo okorengereria ng’a Nyasae tari korua egesusuro ase engencho y’endamwamu yaye, naende ng’a ere tari gwechandera ogosaria.
swahili: pia zaidi, kwamba hasira yake kamwe haiadhibu wala haangalii uovu hata kidogo?

english: So Job opens his mouth in vain and multiplies words without knowledge.”
ekegusii: Ayio naro akogera aye Ayubu ogokwana amang’ana atari nengencho, nigo okomenta gokwana amang’ana atari ay’obong’aini.”
swahili: Hivyo Ayubu hufumbua kinywa chake kwa maneno yasiyo na maana; anaongea maneno mengi bila maarifa.”

english: “Do you think this is just? You say, ‘I am more righteous than God.’
ekegusii: Aye Ayubu, nigo okorengereria ng’a ayio nekeene? Gose nigo ogoteeba ng’a nomonyaboronge ore ase obosio bwa Nyasae?
swahili: “Je, unadhani hili ni haki? Wewe unasema, ‘Nina haki mbele za Mungu.’

english: For you ask, ‘What does it profit me, and what benefit do I gain apart from sin?’
ekegusii: Naende nigo okoboria ng’a mbuya ki oboronge bokogokorera kobua ogokora ebibe?
swahili: Bado unamuuliza, ‘Ni faida gani nimepata, na imenifaidi nini kwa kutokutenda dhambi?’

english: I will reply to you and to your friends as well.
ekegusii: Bono ngokoiraneria nde aye amo nabasani bao abamore komo.
swahili: “Ningependa nikujibu wewe pamoja na marafiki zako walio pamoja nawe.

english: Look to the heavens and see; gaze at the clouds high above you.
ekegusii: Rigereria gochia igoro, orore; rora amare buna are igoro mono kogoetania.
swahili: Tazama juu mbinguni ukaone; yaangalie mawingu yaliyo juu sana juu yako.

english: If you sin, what do you accomplish against Him? If you multiply your transgressions, what do you do to Him?
ekegusii: Aye noisa gokora ebibe, ninki ayio arakore ase Nyasae? Na ogosaria nagoisa komentekana mono, ninki okwo koramokorere?
swahili: Je, ukitenda dhambi, inamdhuruje Mungu? Kama dhambi zako zikiwa nyingi, hilo linamfanyia nini Mungu?

english: If you are righteous, what do you give Him, or what does He receive from your hand?
ekegusii: Onye kore omonyene oboronge, ngento ki okoa Nyasae, gose ninki akonyora korwa ase okoboko kwao?
swahili: Kama wewe ni mwadilifu, unampa nini, au yeye anapokea nini mkononi kwako?

english: Your wickedness affects only a man like yourself, and your righteousness only a son of man.
ekegusii: Amabe ao ogokora nigo akorenta emechando ase omonto onde onga buna aye, na oboronge bwao nabo boragere omonto onde anyore ayare amaya.
swahili: Uovu wako unamdhuru tu mtu mwingine kama wewe, nayo haki yako inawafaa wanadamu tu.

english: Men cry out under great oppression; they plead for relief from the arm of the mighty.
ekegusii: Ekiagera ogokorerwa bobe kwabuchire, abanto nigo bakorera mono ng’a bakonywe; nigo bakorangeria bakonywe korwa ase amaboko ay’abare nokobua.
swahili: “Wanadamu hulia kwa kulemewa na mateso; huomba msaada kutoka mkono wenye nguvu.

english: And Elihu continued:
ekegusii: Elihu akagenderera gokwana, akabora,
swahili: Elihu akaendelea kusema:

english: He opens their ears to correction and commands that they turn from iniquity.
ekegusii: Nigo agotinora amato abo baigwa ogokuurerwa, na obachika baonchoke, batige gokora amabe.
swahili: Huwafanya wao kusikia maonyo, na huwaagiza kutubu uovu wao.

english: If they obey and serve Him, then they end their days in prosperity and their years in happiness.
ekegusii: Kobaraigwere na komokorera, rirorio mbabe bagoseseneka ase amatuko abo onsi, naende babe bakwegokia ase obogima bwabo.
swahili: Kama wakitii na kumtumikia, wataishi siku zao zilizobaki katika mafanikio, na miaka yao katika utoshelevu.

english: But if they do not obey, then they perish by the sword and die without knowledge.
ekegusii: Korende onye tibakoigwera, nigo baraitwe nemioro, erio bakwe batamanyeti kende.
swahili: Lakini wasiposikiliza, wataangamia kwa upanga, nao watakufa pasipo maarifa.

english: The godless in heart harbor resentment; even when He binds them, they do not cry for help.
ekegusii: Abatamoirogete Nyasae nigo bagachete endamwamu ime ase chinkoro chiabo; barabwo tibari korera barigie bakonywe, ekero Nyasae akobaa egesusuro.
swahili: “Wasiomcha Mungu moyoni mwao huficha chuki; hata anapowafunga, hawamwombi msaada.

english: They die in their youth, among the male shrine prostitutes.
ekegusii: Barabwo nigo bagokwa ekero bare abake, obogima bwabo nigo bogosirigwa buna obw’abanyaka.
swahili: Wanakufa wangali vijana, miongoni mwa wanaume hanithi wa mahali pa kuabudia miungu.

english: God rescues the afflicted by their affliction and opens their ears in oppression.
ekegusii: Nyasae nigo agotooria abataka goetera ase emechando yabo, otinora amato abo goetera ase ogokorerwa bobe kwabo.
swahili: Bali wao wanaoteseka huwaokoa katika mateso yao, na kuzungumza nao katika dhiki zao.

english: Indeed, He drew you from the jaws of distress to a spacious and broad place, to a table full of richness.
ekegusii: Ee, nigo akoebereretie, agakorusia korwa ase chimbanderana, agakorenta aase aagare, ase komigwa gotaiyo; boigo chindagera kwabeekeretwe emesa nigo chiarenge chinoru.
swahili: “Yeye anakubembeleza utoke katika mataya ya dhiki, ili kukuweka mahali palipo na nafasi mbali na kizuizi, hadi kwenye meza yako ya faraja iliyojaa vyakula vizuri.

english: But now you are laden with the judgment due the wicked; judgment and justice have seized you.
ekegusii: Korende bono aye nigo okonacherwa ekiina buna eki’abakori amabe, ekiina na ayare ay’ekeene mbikonyore.
swahili: Lakini sasa umelemewa na hukumu kwa ajili ya uovu; hukumu na haki vimekukamata.

english: Be careful that no one lures you with riches; do not let a large bribe lead you astray.
ekegusii: Bono erende, endamwamu tebaisa gokoebereria na kogokora obe omochecheria, tobaisa gwancha obonge bw’embooria bogosirie.
swahili: Uwe mwangalifu ili yeyote asikushawishi kwa utajiri; usipotoshwe kwa fungu kubwa la rushwa.

english: Can your wealth or all your mighty effort keep you from distress?
ekegusii: Inee! Obotenenku bwao mbonyare kogotanga korwa ase emechando? Gose okobua kwao ne chinguru chiao mbinyare?
swahili: Je, utajiri wako hata nguvu zako nyingi vinaweza kukusaidia usiingie kwenye dhiki?

english: “Bear with me a little longer, and I will show you that there is more to be said on God’s behalf.
ekegusii: Indemereria ake igo, inche nkworokie amang’ana; nimbwate ring’ana ngokwana ribaga ria Nyasae.
swahili: “Nivumilie kidogo zaidi nami nitakuonyesha kwamba yako mengi zaidi ya kusemwa kwa ajili ya Mungu.

english: Do not long for the night, when people vanish from their homes.
ekegusii: Tobaisa kogania ng’a obotuko boria boche, obwo abanto baraitwe basirigwe.
swahili: Usiutamani usiku uje, ili uwaburute watu mbali na nyumba zao.

english: Be careful not to turn to iniquity, for this you have preferred to affliction.
ekegusii: Bwerende, tobaisa koirana gokora amabe, ekiagera nigo gwanchire gokora ayio kobua konyora emechando.
swahili: Jihadhari usigeukie uovu, ambao unaupenda zaidi kuliko mateso.

english: Behold, God is exalted in His power. Who is a teacher like Him?
ekegusii: Rora, Nyasae nigo agokora amanene ase okobua kwaye. Inee! Ning’o okworokereria buna ere?
swahili: “Mungu ametukuzwa katika nguvu zake. Ni nani aliye mwalimu kama yeye?

english: Who has appointed His way for Him, or told Him, ‘You have done wrong’?
ekegusii: Ning’o ochikeire Nyasae enchera yaye? Gose ning’o oranyare komoteebia: Aye gwakorire bobe?
swahili: Ni nani aliyemwelekeza katika njia zake, au kumwambia, ‘Wewe umetenda yasiyo sawa’?

english: Remember to magnify His work, which men have praised in song.
ekegusii: Inyora gotogia emeremo yaye, eyio abanto babeire bagoteera na koyetogia.
swahili: Kumbuka kuzitukuza kazi zake, ambazo watu wamezisifu katika wimbo.

english: All mankind has seen it; men behold it from afar.
ekegusii: Abanto bonsi bayerorire, ee, Mwanyabaanto mbayerigereretie korwa aare.
swahili: Wanadamu wote wameiona; watu wanaikazia macho kwa mbali.

english: Indeed, God is great—beyond our knowledge; the number of His years is unsearchable.
ekegusii: Rora, Nyasae nigo are omonene mono, na intwe titomomanyeti; omobaro bw’emiaka yaye temanyekaneti.
swahili: Tazama jinsi Mungu alivyo mkuu, kupita ufahamu wetu! Hesabu ya miaka yake haitafutiki.

english: For He draws up drops of water which distill the rain from the mist,
ekegusii: Ere nigo akong’usa chintonyi chi’amaache gochia igoro, na chirochio chiatwa buna embura chiaba riime.
swahili: “Yeye huvuta juu matone ya maji, ayachujayo kama mvua kutoka kwenye vijito;

english: which the clouds pour out and shower abundantly on mankind.
ekegusii: Embura eyio nigo egotwa gocha ase ense, yatwera Mwanyabaanto ase obonge.
swahili: mawingu huangusha chini maji yake, nayo mvua nyingi huwanyeshea wanadamu.

english: Furthermore, who can understand how the clouds spread out, how the thunder roars from His pavilion?
ekegusii: Inee! Monto onde nanyare komanya buna amare agwesiarera, gose buna okogukura gw’enkoba gokorua ase obomenyo bwa Nyasae?
swahili: Ni nani ajuaye jinsi ayatandazavyo mawingu, jinsi angurumavyo kutoka hemani mwake.

english: I get my knowledge from afar, and I will ascribe justice to my Maker.
