ekegusii: Inche nindusie chisemi chiane korwa aare, ing’orokie ng’a Omotongi one nere omonyene oboronge.
swahili: Ninayapata maarifa yangu kutoka mbali, nami nitamhesabia haki Muumba wangu.

english: See how He scatters His lightning around Him and covers the depths of the sea.
ekegusii: Rora, nigo agosiarera okomesa kwamoetanana, naende otuba enkori y’enyancha.
swahili: Tazama jinsi anavyotandaza umeme wa radi kumzunguka, naye huvifunika vilindi vya bahari.

english: For by these He judges the nations and provides food in abundance.
ekegusii: Ase enchera eyio nigo akonachera abanto ekiina; naende nigo akobaa chindagera ase obonge.
swahili: Hivi ndivyo atawalavyo mataifa, na kuwapa chakula kwa wingi.

english: He fills His hands with lightning and commands it to strike its mark.
ekegusii: Ere nigo amumegete amaboko aye ase okomesa, erio ochika goake ase ekerenga kere.
swahili: Huujaza mkono wake kwa umeme wa radi, na kuuagiza kulenga shabaha yake.

english: The thunder declares His presence; even the cattle regard the rising storm.
ekegusii: Ekerundo gi’okomesa nigo gekoraria igoro ya Nyasae, nonya ne ching’iti nigo chikomanya ng’a ekerundo ngocha kere.
swahili: Ngurumo zake hutangaza dhoruba inayokuja; hata mifugo hujulisha kukaribia kwake.

english: For truly my words are free of falsehood; one perfect in knowledge is with you.
ekegusii: Ekeene, amang’ana aane tari ay’oborimo; inche oyo nteneine aiga amo naye nomoikeranu inde ase okomanya.
swahili: Uwe na hakika kwamba maneno yangu si ya uongo; mmoja aliye mkamilifu katika maarifa yuko pamoja na wewe.

english: Indeed, God is mighty, but He despises no one; He is mighty in strength of understanding.
ekegusii: Rora, Nyasae nigo are Omonguru, ere tachayeti onde; nigo are nokobua ase chinguru na obong’aini.
swahili: “Mungu ni mwenye nguvu, lakini hamdharau mwanadamu; ni mwenye nguvu, naye ni thabiti katika shauri lake.

english: He does not keep the wicked alive, but He grants justice to the afflicted.
ekegusii: Ere tagotiga omokori amabe agenderere koba moyo, korende nigo akoa abachandire oboronge bwabo.
swahili: Hawaachi waovu waendelee kuishi, bali huwapa walioteswa haki yao.

english: He does not take His eyes off the righteous, but He enthrones them with kings and exalts them forever.
ekegusii: Tari gotiga korigereria abanyene oboronge, korende nigo akobabeeka amo nabarwoti ase ebirogo bi’obonene. Ee, nigo akobakinia bagenderera kobeera aroro,
swahili: Yeye haondoi macho yake kwa wenye haki; huwaketisha penye viti vya enzi pamoja na wafalme na kuwatukuza milele.

english: And if men are bound with chains, caught in cords of affliction,
ekegusii: na onye bagosibwa chingataare na baba bare ase emechando, gose kobwatwa ase emeeto y’emechando,
swahili: Lakini ikiwa watu wamefungwa kwenye minyororo, wakiwa wameshikiliwa na kamba za mateso,

english: then He tells them their deeds and how arrogantly they have transgressed.
ekegusii: Nyasae nigo akobaorokeria ayabakorire, na ogosaria kwabo, boigo obaorokeria buna bakororekana abaenenu.
swahili: huwaonyesha yale waliyoyatenda, kwamba wametenda dhambi kwa majivuno.

english: “At this my heart also pounds and leaps from its place.
ekegusii: “Ayio nigo akogera enkoro yane yaiguswa, yatuma gocha ase omoyo.
swahili: “Kwa hili moyo wangu unatetemeka, nao unaruka kutoka mahali pake.

english: By the breath of God the ice is formed and the watery expanses are frozen.
ekegusii: Nyasae nigo akorua omoika bw’obokeng’entu obwatania amaache, na amaache oyarenta abwatana oma pa.
swahili: Pumzi ya Mungu hutoa barafu, eneo kubwa la maji huganda.

english: He loads the clouds with moisture; He scatters His lightning through them.
ekegusii: Nigo agoichoria amare amarito namaache, amare nigo agosiarera chinkoba chiaye.
swahili: Huyasheheneza mawingu kwa maji, naye husambaza umeme wake wa radi kupitia hayo.

english: They swirl about, whirling at His direction, accomplishing all that He commands over the face of all the earth.
ekegusii: Amare nigo agoetanana gochia aaria na aaria, akoraagwa nere, goikerania aya onsi ere achiikire akore ase ense.
swahili: Nayo mawingu huzungukazunguka pande zote kwa amri yake, juu ya uso wa dunia yote, kufanya lolote ayaamuruyo.

english: Whether for punishment or for His land, He accomplishes this in His loving devotion.
ekegusii: Nyasae nigo agokora ayio aba bo, ase okorua ebisusuro bi’okorongeyia, gose ase engencho y’obwanchani bwaye.
swahili: Huleta mawingu ili kuadhibu wanadamu, au kuinyeshea dunia yake na kuonyesha upendo wake.

english: Listen to this, O Job; stand still and consider the wonders of God.
ekegusii: Aye Ayubu, igwa aya; karategerera, orengererie igoro y’emeremo y’ogokumia ya Nyasae.
swahili: “Ayubu, sikiliza hili; nyamaza na uyafikiri maajabu ya Mungu.

english: Do you know how God dispatches the clouds or makes the lightning flash?
ekegusii: Inee! Nomanyete buna Nyasae agokora ochika ayio, naende buna agokora okomesa kwamoreka goetera ase amare,
swahili: Je, unajua jinsi Mungu anavyoyaongoza mawingu, na kufanya umeme wake wa radi utoe mwanga?

english: Do you understand how the clouds float, those wonders of Him who is perfect in knowledge?
ekegusii: Inee! Nomanyete buna areng’anetie amare, eyio ere emeremo y’ogokumia y’oria ore nobong’aini oboikeranu?
swahili: Je, wajua jinsi mawingu yanavyokaa yakiwa yametulia, hayo maajabu yake yeye aliye mkamilifu katika maarifa?

english: You whose clothes get hot when the land lies hushed under the south wind,
ekegusii: Inee! Nomanyete egekogera chianga chiao chigosamba ne riberera, ekero ense egotoererigwa nomwaga okogusa korwa Irianyi?
swahili: Wewe unayeshindwa na joto katika nguo zako wakati nchi imenyamazishwa kimya bila upepo wa kusini,

english: can you, like Him, spread out the skies to reflect the heat like a mirror of bronze?
ekegusii: Inee! Nonyare korambora igoro buna ere ayeramborete, igoro eria ere enkong’u buna ekerore gi’ekioma?
swahili: je, waweza kuungana naye katika kuzitandaza anga, zilizo ngumu kama kioo cha shaba ya kuyeyushwa?

english: Teach us what we should say to Him; we cannot draw up our case when our faces are in darkness.
ekegusii: Tworokererie aya togochia gokwana asare; titokonyara konyora amang’ana togochia gokwana, ekiagera tore ase omosunte.
swahili: “Tuambieni yatupasayo kumwambia; hatuwezi kutayarisha shauri letu kwa sababu ya ujinga wetu.

english: Listen closely to the thunder of His voice and the rumbling that comes from His mouth.
ekegusii: Tegerera oigwe okogukura kw’eriogi riaye, na okoruma gokorwa ase omonwa oye.
swahili: Sikiliza! Sikiliza ngurumo ya sauti yake, sauti ya ngurumo itokayo kinywani mwake.

english: Should He be told that I want to speak? Would a man ask to be swallowed up?
ekegusii: Inee! Nyasae nigo agochia goteebigwa ng’a inche ninganetie gokwana? Onde nare oganetie ere amosirie?
swahili: Je, aambiwe kwamba nataka kuongea? Je, yuko mtu ambaye angeomba kumezwa?

english: Now no one can gaze at the sun when it is bright in the skies after the wind has swept them clean.
ekegusii: “Abanto tibakonyara korigereria amasase ’erioba, kabarire igoro ekero amare abisirwe nomwaga.
swahili: Basi hakuna awezaye kulitazama jua, jinsi linavyongʼaa angani, upepo ukishafagia mawingu.

english: Out of the north He comes in golden splendor; awesome majesty surrounds Him.
ekegusii: Oborabu bokomeka‐meka nigo bokorwa sugusu; ee, Nyasae nigo eboetie nobonene bw’ogosikwa gw’okoondokia.
swahili: Kutoka kaskazini yeye huja na fahari kuu; Mungu huja katika utukufu wa kutisha.

english: The Almighty is beyond our reach; He is exalted in power! In His justice and great righteousness He does not oppress.
ekegusii: Oyio Omobui, intwe titokonyara komoorora buna are; nigo abwate okobua okonene, naende nigo are omonyene ekeene, ere nigo are omonyene oboronge mono, takorega onde.
swahili: Yeye Mwenyezi hatuwezi kumfikia, naye ametukuzwa katika uweza; katika hukumu zake na haki yake kuu, hataonea.

english: Therefore, men fear Him, for He is not partial to the wise in heart.”
ekegusii: Ase ayio Mwanyabaanto nigo bamoirogete; ere tari gosika oyokwerengereria ng’a nomong’aini are.”
swahili: Kwa hiyo, wanadamu mheshimuni, kwa kuwa yeye hamstahi yeyote anayejidhania kuwa ana hekima.”

english: He unleashes His lightning beneath the whole sky and sends it to the ends of the earth.
ekegusii: Nigo agotoma okoruma okwo korwa igoro gocha ase ense yonsi; okomesa kwaye gwe chinkoba nigo kogochera chinsinyo chi’ense.
swahili: Huuachilia umeme wake wa radi chini ya mbingu yote na kuupeleka hata miisho ya dunia.

english: Then there comes a roaring sound; He thunders with His majestic voice. He does not restrain the lightning when His voice resounds.
ekegusii: Erio eriogi riaye rikoruma, ere nigo akogukura neriogi ri’obonene, gose tari gotanga okomesa ekero eriogi riaye ri’okogukura riaigurwe.
swahili: Baada ya hayo huja sauti ya ngurumo yake; Mungu hunguruma kwa sauti yake ya fahari. Wakati sauti yake ingurumapo tena, huuachilia umeme wake wa radi.

english: God thunders wondrously with His voice; He does great things we cannot comprehend.
ekegusii: Nyasae nigo akogukura neriogi riaye ase enchera y’ogokumia mono, nigo agokora amang’ana amanene, ayio totanyare komanya.
swahili: Sauti ya Mungu hunguruma kwa namna za ajabu; yeye hutenda mambo makuu kupita ufahamu wetu.

english: For He says to the snow, ‘Fall on the earth,’ and to the gentle rain, ‘Pour out a mighty downpour.’
ekegusii: Ere nigo agoteebia amagena ’embura: Kagwe igoro ase ense; na otoma omonyirira na embura enene ere ne chinguru.
swahili: Huiambia theluji, ‘Anguka juu ya dunia,’ nayo manyunyu ya mvua, ‘Uwe mvua ya nguvu.’

english: He seals up the hand of every man, so that all men may know His work.
ekegusii: Nyasae nigo agotanga emeremo y’amaboko a kera omonto, erinde abanto bonsi banyare komanya emeremo yaye.
swahili: Ili wanadamu wote aliowaumba wapate kujua kazi zake, yeye humzuilia kila mtu shughuli zake.

english: The wild animals enter their lairs; they settle down in their dens.
ekegusii: Erio ching’iti chi’orosana chiagenda kwebisa, chiagenderera kobeera ase amakuruma abo.
swahili: Wanyama hujificha; hubakia kwenye mapango yao.

english: The tempest comes from its chamber, and the cold from the driving north winds.
ekegusii: Ekembugu‐mbugu nigo kegosoka korwa ase chiero chiaye agwo Irianyi, na omwaga ore nobokendu orua sugusu oseria amare.
swahili: Dhoruba hutoka katika chumba chake, baridi hutoka katika upepo uendao kasi.

english: Then the LORD answered Job out of the whirlwind and said:
ekegusii: Omonene akairaneria Ayubu korwa ase ekembugu‐mbugu ime, akamoteebia:
swahili: Kisha Bwana akamjibu Ayubu kutoka upepo wa kisulisuli. Akasema:

english: when I fixed its boundaries and set in place its bars and doors,
ekegusii: naende nkabeekera enyancha chimbebe chiaye, boigo nkayebekera emekorogoto na ebisieri,
swahili: nilipoamuru mipaka yake, na kuiweka milango yake na makomeo mahali pake,

english: and I declared: ‘You may come this far, but no farther; here your proud waves must stop’?
ekegusii: ngateba: Aa nao oraikere, korende togoetania, naiga nao emerindo yao eimokererete igoro eratangerwe.
swahili: niliposema, ‘Unaweza kufika mpaka hapa wala si zaidi; hapa ndipo mawimbi yako yenye kiburi yatakapokomea’?

english: In your days, have you commanded the morning or assigned the dawn its place,
ekegusii: Inee! Ase obogima bwao bwonsi kwana gochika emambia ebeo? Kwana kworokia amasase a mambia aase akomoreka,
swahili: “Umepata kuiamrisha asubuhi ipambazuke, au kuyaonyesha mapambazuko mahali pake,

english: that it might spread to the ends of the earth and shake the wicked out of it?
ekegusii: erinde ense yonsi ekiamoke, ebwatwe ase chinsinyo chiaye, na abakori amabe banyegerigwe barueo?
swahili: yapate kushika miisho ya dunia, na kuwakungʼuta waovu waliomo?

english: The earth takes shape like clay under a seal; its hills stand out like the folds of a garment.
ekegusii: Ense nigo ekoonchorwa yarorekana buna amaroba abeire inse y’ebonyi ere nekemanyererio, na ebinto bionsi nigo bikororekana buna chianga chire n’ebieni ao ao.
swahili: Dunia hubadilika kama udongo wa mfinyanzi chini ya lakiri; sura yake hukaa kama ile ya vazi.

english: Light is withheld from the wicked, and their upraised arm is broken.
ekegusii: Oborabu nigo bogotangwa korwa ase abakori amabe, ne chinguru chiabo chi’okweenenia nigo chikobunwa chiasirigwa.
swahili: Waovu huzuiliwa nuru yao, nao mkono wao ulioinuliwa huvunjwa.

english: Have you journeyed to the vents of the sea or walked in the trenches of the deep?
ekegusii: Inee! Kwana gosoa ime ase chinsoko chi’enyancha, gose kwana gotaara ase enkoro ye chindiba?
swahili: “Je, umepata kufika kwenye chemchemi za bahari? Au kutembea mahali pa ndani pa vilindi?

english: Have the gates of death been revealed to you? Have you seen the gates of the shadow of death?
ekegusii: Kwana kworokigwa ebiita bi’amakweri, gose korora ebisieri bi’ekiriri ki’amakweri?
swahili: Umewahi kuonyeshwa malango ya mauti? Umewahi kuiona milango ya uvuli wa mauti?

english: Have you surveyed the extent of the earth? Tell Me, if you know all this.
ekegusii: Kwana korengereria igoro y’obogare bw’ense? Onye komanyete ayio onsi, yararie!
swahili: Je, wewe unafahamu ukubwa wa dunia? Niambie kama unajua haya yote.

english: Where is the way to the home of light? Do you know where darkness resides,
ekegusii: Enchera ekogenda ase oborabu bore, ng’ai ere? Nomanyete ase omosunte omenyete,
swahili: “Njia ya kufika kwenye makao ya nuru ni ipi? Nako maskani mwa giza ni wapi?

english: “Who is this who obscures My counsel by words without knowledge?
ekegusii: Aye naye ng’o okorenta omosunte ase ogosemia ase ogokwana amang’ana atari ay’obong’aini?
swahili: “Nani huyu atiaye mashauri yangu giza kwa maneno yasiyo na maarifa?

english: so you can lead it back to its border? Do you know the paths to its home?
ekegusii: erinde ogende oyoire ase ribebe riaye? Naende nomanyete ebinchera bigochia ase enyomba yaye?
swahili: Je, unaweza kuvirudisha kwenye makao yake? Unajua njia za kufika maskani mwake?

english: Surely you know, for you were already born! And the number of your days is great!
ekegusii: Ee, aye nomanyete, ekiagera nigo kwaiboretwe kare, na emiaka yao nemenge.
swahili: Hakika unajua, kwa kuwa ulikuwa umeshazaliwa! Kwani umeishi miaka mingi!

english: Have you entered the storehouses of snow or observed the storehouses of hail,
ekegusii: Inee! Kwana gosoa ime ase ebigachero bi’obokeng’entu, gose ebigachero bi’amagena ’embura?
swahili: “Je, umeshawahi kuingia katika ghala za theluji, au kuona ghala za mvua ya mawe,

english: which I hold in reserve for times of trouble, for the day of war and battle?
ekegusii: Amagena ayio ngachete goika ase engaki y’emechando, amatuko aria arabe ay’esegi na okorwana konde.
swahili: ambazo nimeziweka akiba kwa ajili ya wakati wa taabu, na kwa ajili ya wakati wa vita na mapigano?

english: In which direction is the lightning dispersed, or the east wind scattered over the earth?
ekegusii: Inchera ki ekogenda aase oborabu bokoruerwa, gose ekogenda aase omwaga okorwa moocha bwesiarera ense yonsi?
swahili: Ni ipi njia iendayo mahali umeme wa radi unapotawanyiwa, au mahali upepo wa mashariki unaposambaziwa juu ya dunia?

english: Who cuts a channel for the flood or clears a path for the thunderbolt,
ekegusii: Ning’o oremete omotaro ase chiooro chi’embura chigoeta, gose enchera ase chinkoba chikogukura goeta,
swahili: Ni nani aliyepasua mifereji kwa ajili ya maji mengi ya mvua yaendayo kasi na njia ya umeme wa radi,

english: to bring rain on a barren land, on a desert where no man lives,
ekegusii: echio chikogera embura yatwa aase monto atamenyeti, ase erooro monto ataiyo?
swahili: ili kusababisha mvua kunyeshea mahali pasipokaliwa na mtu, jangwa lisilo na yeyote ndani yake,

english: to satisfy the parched wasteland and make it sprout with tender grass?
ekegusii: Embura eyio nigo ekoigotia ense ere bosa etamenyiri, yagera yamera obonyansi.
swahili: ili kuitosheleza nchi ya ukiwa na jangwa, na majani yaanze kumea ndani yake?

english: Does the rain have a father? Who has begotten the drops of dew?
ekegusii: Inee! Embura nebwate ise? Gose ning’o okoibora amatoima e riime?
swahili: Je, mvua ina baba? Ni nani baba azaaye matone ya umande?

english: From whose womb does the ice emerge? Who gives birth to the frost from heaven,
ekegusii: Nkorwa ase enda ya ng’o obokeng’entu bokorwa? Ning’o okoibora obokendu bokorwa igoro?
swahili: Barafu inatoka tumbo la nani? Ni nani azaaye ukungu kutoka mbinguni,

english: Now brace yourself like a man; I will question you, and you shall inform Me.
ekegusii: Tenena okong’e buna omosacha, inche ninkoborie, naye ong’iranerie.
swahili: Jikaze kama mwanaume; nitakuuliza swali, nawe unijibu.

english: when the waters become hard as stone and the surface of the deep is frozen?
ekegusii: Amache nigo akobwatana oma pa buna rigena, ne chinyancha chioma pa chiaba buna egetare.
swahili: wakati maji yawapo magumu kama jiwe, wakati uso wa vilindi vya maji unapoganda?

english: Can you bind the chains of the Pleiades or loosen the belt of Orion?
ekegusii: Inee! Nonyare gosiberania egetuse gie ching’enang’eni gekorokwa Abaiseke batano na babere bamwabo? Gose bwororobie egetuse keria gekorokwa Orioni?
swahili: “Je, waweza kuufunga mnyororo wa Kilimia? Waweza kulegeza kamba za Orioni?

english: Can you bring forth the constellations in their seasons or lead out the Bear and her cubs?
ekegusii: Nonyare koraa ching’enang’eni chioroke ase chingaki chiabo? Gose nonyare koraa egetuse gie ching’enang’eni gekorokwa Edubu ne chimanwa chiaye?
swahili: Waweza kuyaongoza makundi ya nyota kwa majira yake, au kuongoza Dubu na watoto wake?

english: Do you know the laws of the heavens? Can you set their dominion over the earth?
ekegusii: Nomanyete emeroberio ya igoro echiikire? Nonyare koroberia okogamba kwabo igoro ase ense?
swahili: Je, unajua sheria zinazotawala mbingu? Waweza kuweka utawala wa Mungu duniani?

english: Can you command the clouds so that a flood of water covers you?
ekegusii: Nonyare goaka eriogi riao riike ase amare ogere embura enyinge egotwere?
swahili: “Waweza kuiinua sauti yako mpaka mawinguni, na kujifunika mwenyewe na gharika ya maji?

english: Can you send the lightning bolts on their way? Do they report to you, ‘Here we are’?
ekegusii: Nonyare gotoma chinkoba chigende aase gete, erio chigoteebie: Ee, nao tore aa?
swahili: Je, wewe hutuma umeme wa radi kwenye njia zake? Je, hutoa taarifa kwako kukuambia, ‘Sisi tuko hapa’?

english: Who has put wisdom in the heart or given understanding to the mind?
ekegusii: Ning’o okobeeka obong’aini ase enkoro ime, gose okomanya ase omoyo ime?
swahili: Ni nani aliyeujalia moyo hekima au kuzipa akili ufahamu?

english: Who has the wisdom to count the clouds? Or who can tilt the water jars of the heavens
ekegusii: Ning’o oranyare koba nobong’aini abare amare? Gose ning’o oranyare koberereka chinyongo chi’amaache chia igoro,
swahili: Nani mwenye hekima ya kuyahesabu mawingu? Ni nani awezaye kuinamisha magudulia ya mbinguni

english: when the dust hardens into a mass and the clods of earth stick together?
ekegusii: ekero riroba riabwatanire riomire pa, na amagakara abwatanire amo.
swahili: wakati mavumbi yawapo magumu, na mabonge ya udongo kushikamana pamoja?

english: Can you hunt the prey for a lioness or satisfy the hunger of young lions
ekegusii: Inee! Nonyare gotwarera endo ebi ekoria, gose koigotia chindo chinsae chiganetie endagera,
swahili: “Je, utamwindia simba jike mawindo, na kuwashibisha simba wenye njaa

english: Where were you when I laid the foundations of the earth? Tell Me, if you have understanding.
ekegusii: Ng’ai kwarenge ekero nabegete oboroso bw’ense? Ntebie onye aye kore omong’aini.
swahili: “Ulikuwa wapi nilipoweka misingi ya dunia? Niambie, kama unafahamu.

english: when they crouch in their dens and lie in wait in the thicket?
ekegusii: ekero chire ase amakuruma abo chieringanetie ase okoboera, gose gochiramaime agwo ase chiebisete?
swahili: wakati wao wamejikunyata mapangoni mwao, au wakivizia kichakani?

english: Who provides food for the raven when its young cry out to God as they wander about for lack of food?
ekegusii: Ning’o okoa ekegonkoru endagera yaye, ekero amage aye akorera ase Nyasae na goetanana onsi korigia endagera?
swahili: Ni nani ampaye kunguru chakula wakati makinda yake yanamlilia Mungu, yakizungukazunguka kwa ajili ya kukosa chakula?

english: Who fixed its measurements? Surely you know! Or who stretched a measuring line across it?
ekegusii: Ning’o obegete ebirengo biaye? Ntebie onye komanyete. Gose ning’o oramborete engori y’okoyerenga?
swahili: Ni nani aliyeweka alama vipimo vyake? Hakika wewe unajua! Ni nani aliyenyoosha kamba ya kupimia juu yake?

english: On what were its foundations set, or who laid its cornerstone,
ekegusii: Ng’ai amaroso aye aterekereretwe? Gose ning’o obegete rigena riaye ri’ekoona,
swahili: Je, misingi yake iliwekwa juu ya nini, au ni nani aliyeweka jiwe la pembeni,

english: while the morning stars sang together and all the sons of God shouted for joy?
ekegusii: ekero ching’enang’eni chia mambia chiaterete amo, na abana bonsi ba Nyasae baagete eriogi ri’omogooko?
swahili: wakati nyota za asubuhi zilipoimba pamoja, na malaika wote walipokuwa wakipiga kelele kwa furaha?

english: Who enclosed the sea behind doors when it burst forth from the womb,
ekegusii: Ning’o osiegete ebisieri bi’enyancha, ekero yarindoretie buna ndiria yarenge ime ase enda y’ense?
swahili: “Ni nani aliyeifungia bahari milango ilipopasuka kutoka tumbo,

english: when I made the clouds its garment and thick darkness its blanket,
ekegusii: Ekero keria naroisetie amare abe chianga chiaye, na nkayeboyia omosunte ekerima,
swahili: nilipoyafanya mawingu kuwa vazi lake, na kuyafungia katika giza nene,

english: “Do you know when mountain goats give birth? Have you watched the doe bear her fawn?
ekegusii: “Inee! Nomanyete chingaki ekero chimbori chi’orosana chikobiara? Gose ekero chinsune chikobiara?
swahili: “Je, wajua ni wakati gani mbuzi wa mlimani wanapozaa? Je, watambua ni wakati gani kulungu jike azaapo mtoto wake?

english: Can you hold him to the furrow with a harness? Will he plow the valleys behind you?
ekegusii: Inee! Nonyare koyesiba ne chingori eete ase emeng’ororia ye chintinde? Gose ebutorane chintinde ase rikura riao?
swahili: Je, waweza kumfungia kwenye matuta kwa kamba? Je, atalima mabonde nyuma yako?

english: Can you rely on his great strength? Will you leave your hard work to him?
ekegusii: Inee! Noyesemerie ekiagera ere ne chinguru chinyinge? Nonyare gotiga emeremo yao, ng’a ero ekoyekorere?
swahili: Je, utamtumainia kwa ajili ya nguvu zake nyingi? Utamwachia yeye kazi zako nzito?

english: Can you trust him to bring in your grain and gather it to your threshing floor?
ekegusii: Inee! Nigo oyiegenete ng’a neirane na ekorentere endagera ase ekeoreri kiao?
swahili: Utaweza kumwamini akuletee nafaka yako nyumbani kutoka shambani na kuikusanya kwenye sakafu yako ya kupuria?

english: The wings of the ostrich flap joyfully, but cannot match the pinions and feathers of the stork.
ekegusii: “Esagero nigo egosamunsa chimbaaba chiaye chioga; korende, Inee, chimbaaba echio nchibwate obwanchani?
swahili: “Mbuni hupigapiga mabawa yake kwa furaha, lakini hayawezi kulinganishwa na mabawa na manyoya ya korongo.

english: For she leaves her eggs on the ground and lets them warm in the sand.
ekegusii: Esagero eaberi nigo egotiga amagena aye ase amaroba ime anyora riberera korwao.
swahili: Huyataga mayai yake juu ya ardhi, na kuyaacha yapate joto mchangani,

english: She forgets that a foot may crush them, or a wild animal may trample them.
ekegusii: Ero nigo ekoyeba, tekomanya ng’a naatwe namagoro, naende ng’a gose eng’iti y’orosana neyatache.
swahili: bila kujali kuwa mguu waweza kuyaponda, kwamba baadhi ya wanyama wa porini wanaweza kuyakanyaga.

english: She treats her young harshly, as if not her own, with no concern that her labor was in vain.
ekegusii: Nigo ere entindi mono ase ebichuchu biaye, yabikorera biaba buna mbitari ebiaye; teri gwechandera oroiboro rwaye,
swahili: Yeye huyafanyia makinda yake ukatili kama vile si yake; hajali kwamba taabu yake inaweza ikawa bure,

english: For God has deprived her of wisdom; He has not endowed her with understanding.
ekegusii: ekiagera Nyasae nigo ayerinete obong’aini, gose tayeete okomanya.
swahili: kwa kuwa Mungu hakumjalia hekima, wala hakumpa fungu la akili njema.

english: Yet when she proudly spreads her wings, she laughs at the horse and its rider.
ekegusii: Ekero ekoimokerera igoro, egwesamunsa eminyoke, nigo egosekerera ebarasi na oyo oyerinete.
swahili: Lakini akunjuapo mabawa yake kukimbia, humcheka farasi pamoja na yeye aliyempanda.

english: Do you give strength to the horse or adorn his neck with a mane?
ekegusii: “Inee! Naye okoa ebarasi chinguru? Naye oboetie ebigoti biaye namanya?
swahili: “Je, wewe humpa farasi nguvu au kuivika shingo yake manyoya marefu?

english: Can you count the months they are pregnant? Do you know the time they give birth?
ekegusii: Nonyare komanya omobaro bw’emetienyi chigokoora, naende nomanyete chingaki chikobiara?
swahili: Je, waweza kuhesabu miezi hadi wazaapo? Je, unajua majira yao ya kuzaa?

english: Do you make him leap like a locust, striking terror with his proud snorting?
ekegusii: Naye oyeete chinguru egocharokera buna engige? Eriogi egochuria nigo rire ri’okoirokia.
swahili: Je, wewe humfanya farasi aruke kama nzige, akistaajabisha kwa tishio la mlio wake wa majivuno?

english: He paws in the valley and rejoices in his strength; he charges into battle.
ekegusii: Nigo egokura‐kura riroba ase ense omweya, yagokera chinguru chiaye. Erio yaminyoka koumerana nabare nebirwanero bi’esegi.
swahili: Huparapara bila woga, akizifurahia nguvu zake, husonga mbele kukabiliana na silaha.

english: He laughs at fear, frightened of nothing; he does not turn back from the sword.
ekegusii: Ero nigo egosekerera obwoba, teri koondokigwa na kende; gose teri koonchoka etame korwa ase emioro.
swahili: Huicheka hofu, haogopi chochote, wala haukimbii upanga.

english: A quiver rattles at his side, along with a flashing spear and lance.
ekegusii: Chinsara nigo chikorutwa chiaba chikwoga goeta igoro yaye, na amatimo akomesa, ne chisimisi boigo.
swahili: Podo hutoa sauti kando yake, pamoja na mkuki unaongʼaa na fumo.

english: Trembling with excitement, he devours the distance; he cannot stand still when the ram’s horn sounds.
ekegusii: Nigo egotitiria riroba ere nobotindi na ekeririanda, gose teri gotegerera ekire, ekero egetureri gekobugigwa.
swahili: Bila woga na kwa ghadhabu huimeza nchi, wala tarumbeta iliapo yeye hawezi kusimama.

english: At the blast of the horn, he snorts with fervor. He catches the scent of battle from afar— the shouts of captains and the cry of war.
ekegusii: Ekero egetureeri gekobugigwa, nigo ekwana eriogi riaye ri’okoega‐ega. Nigo ekoigwa omonyonko bw’esegi korwa aare, na buna abachiki b’esegi bagochika, na okwoga gw’esegi.
swahili: Asikiapo sauti ya baragumu yeye hulia, ‘Aha!’ Hunusa harufu ya vita toka mbali, sauti ya mtoa amri na ukelele wa vita.

english: Does the hawk take flight by your understanding and spread his wings toward the south?
ekegusii: “Inee! Nobong’aini bwao bokogera ekebaki kiairuruka igoro, naende kiarambora chimbaaba chiaye koiruruka gochia Irianyi?
swahili: “Je, mwewe huruka kwa hekima yako na kuyakunjua mabawa yake kuelekea kusini?

english: Does the eagle soar at your command and make his nest on high?
ekegusii: Inee! Naye ogochika ekeongo kiairuruka gochia igoro, kiaagacha egeswa kiaye aase a igoro mono?
swahili: Je, tai hupaa juu kwa amri yako na kujenga kiota chake mahali pa juu?

english: He dwells on a cliff and lodges there; his stronghold is on a rocky crag.
ekegusii: Ekeongo nigo gekomenya ase egetare; ase omwenya bw’egetare, aase gekonyora oborendi obuya.
swahili: Huishi juu ya miamba mirefu na kukaa huko usiku; majabali yenye ncha kali ndiyo ngome yake.

english: From there he spies out food; his eyes see it from afar.
ekegusii: Korwa aaria igoro nigo kegotengera ebi kegotwara, amaiso aye nigo akobirora korwa aare.
swahili: Kutoka huko hutafuta chakula chake; macho yake hukiona kutoka mbali.

english: They crouch down and bring forth their young; they deliver their newborn.
ekegusii: Nigo chigwekumba chiabiara chimanwa chiabo, na ekero chiabiarire, obororo bw’okobina bwasira.
swahili: Wao hujiinamisha na kuzaa watoto wao; utungu wa kuzaa unakoma.

english: His young ones feast on blood; and where the slain are, there he is.”
ekegusii: Amage aye nigo akonywa amanyinga, na aase emebere ekwete ere, nao ekeongo kere.”
swahili: Makinda yake hujilisha damu, na pale palipo na machinjo, ndipo yeye alipo.”

english: Their young ones thrive and grow up in the open field; they leave and do not return.
ekegusii: Chimanwa chiabo nigo chikoba ne chinguru chiakinera ase orosana. Nigo chikogenda kegima, tichiri koirana.
swahili: Watoto wao hustawi na kuongezeka nguvu nyikani; huenda zao wala hawarudi tena.

english: Who set the wild donkey free? Who released the swift donkey from the harness?
ekegusii: “Ning’o otigire etigere y’orosana esiboire? Gose ning’o bwororobirie ebisibo bi’etigere ere enyango?
swahili: “Ni nani aliyemwachia punda-mwitu awe huru? Ni nani aliyezifungua kamba zake?

english: I made the wilderness his home and the salt flats his dwelling.
ekegusii: Inche nayeeire ekerubo ekiomo kebe enka yaye, na ense ere nomonyo, emenyeo.
swahili: Nimempa nchi isiyokaliwa na watu kuwa masikani yake, nchi ya chumvi kuwa makao yake.

english: He scorns the tumult of the city and never hears the shouts of a driver.
ekegusii: Ero nigo egochaaya eriogi rire ase omochie, teri koigwa okwoga kw’omotemi onde bwensi.
swahili: Huzicheka ghasia za mji, wala hasikii kelele za mwendesha gari.

english: He roams the mountains for pasture, searching for any green thing.
ekegusii: Nigo ekona‐kogenda aaria na aaria ase ebitunwa ekorisia, yaba ekorigia kera ekemeri ekebese.
swahili: Huzunguka vilimani kwa ajili ya malisho na kutafuta kila kitu kibichi.

english: Will the wild ox consent to serve you? Will he stay by your manger at night?
ekegusii: “Inee! Eng’era nayanche egokorere emeremo? Nenyare korara ase obweri bwao botuko?
swahili: “Je, nyati atakubali kukutumikia? Atakaa karibu na hori lako usiku?

english: After this, Job opened his mouth and cursed the day of his birth.
ekegusii: Nyuma y’amang’ana ayio onsi Ayubu agachaaka gokwana, akaragereria rituko riria aiboretwe.
swahili: Baada ya jambo hili, Ayubu akafumbua kinywa chake na kuilaani siku ya kuzaliwa kwake.

english: For that night did not shut the doors of the womb to hide the sorrow from my eyes.
ekegusii: ekiagera borobwo tibwatangete baba tanyibora, gose tibwatangete emechando korwa ase amaiso aane.
swahili: kwa sababu huo usiku haukunifungia mlango wa tumbo la mama yangu, ili kuyaficha macho yangu kutokana na taabu.

english: Why did I not perish at birth; why did I not die as I came from the womb?
ekegusii: Ninki kiagerete tinakwera inda ya baba? Ninki kiagerete tinakwa ekero keria nasogete korwao?
swahili: “Kwa nini sikuangamia wakati wa kuzaliwa? Kwa nini sikufa nilipokuwa ninatoka tumboni?

english: Why were there knees to receive me, and breasts that I should be nursed?
ekegusii: Ninki kiagerete baba akaang’agata? Ninki kiagerete akangonkia amabeere aye?
swahili: Kwa nini pakawa na magoti ya kunipokea na matiti ili nipate kunyonyeshwa?

english: For now I would be lying down in peace; I would be asleep and at rest
ekegusii: Onye nakwete, anga nindaire ntoererete, anga nindaire chitoro ntimogete,
swahili: Kwa maana sasa ningekuwa nimepumzika kwa amani. Ningekuwa nimelala na kupumzika

english: with kings and counselors of the earth, who built for themselves cities now in ruins,
ekegusii: buna abarwoti b’ense amo nabasemia babo bakaraire, abwo beagacherete amaagacho ’obosareku.
swahili: pamoja na wafalme na washauri wa dunia, waliojijengea mahali ambapo sasa ni magofu,

english: or with princes who had gold, who filled their houses with silver.
ekegusii: Inche anga nigo inde buna abanene batenengete ne chitaabu, baichoretie chinyomba chiabo ne chifeta.
swahili: pamoja na watawala waliokuwa na dhahabu, waliozijaza nyumba zao kwa fedha.

english: Or why was I not hidden like a stillborn child, like an infant who never sees daylight?
ekegusii: Nigo nanga nabeete buna enda erekeire egatindekwa, na buna abana bataroche omobaso.
swahili: Au kwa nini sikufichwa ardhini kama mtoto aliyezaliwa mfu, kama mtoto mchanga ambaye kamwe hakuuona mwanga?

english: There the wicked cease from raging, and there the weary find rest.
ekegusii: Aroro agwo abakori amabe tibari gochanda abande, boigo abarosire kobaikire aroro, nigo bagotimoka.
swahili: Huko waovu huacha kusumbua na huko waliochoka hupumzika.

english: The captives enjoy their ease; they do not hear the voice of the oppressor.
ekegusii: Ekero abasibwa baikire aroro, nigo bakoba bagotimoka amo, tibari koigwa amariogi y’abarendi babo bakobabetereria nobotindi.
swahili: Wafungwa nao hufurahia utulivu wao, hawasikii tena sauti ya kukemea ya kiongozi wa watumwa.

english: Both small and great are there, and the slave is freed from his master.
ekegusii: Abanto batasikiri na abasikire nigo bareng’anetie aroro; omosomba nigo are omosibore korwa ase oyorenge omonene oye.
swahili: Wadogo na wakubwa wamo humo, na mtumwa ameachiwa huru kutoka kwa bwana wake.

english: And this is what he said:
ekegusii: Ayubu agateeba,
swahili: Kisha akasema:

english: Why is light given to the miserable, and life to the bitter of soul,
ekegusii: “Nase ki oyochandegete akoegwa korora omobaso? Nase ki oria obwate obororo ase enkoro akoegwa obogima?
swahili: “Mbona nuru inawaangazia wale walio taabuni, na hao wenye uchungu kupewa uhai,

english: who long for death that does not come, and search for it like hidden treasure,
ekegusii: Abwo baganyete amakweri, korende tibari koyanyora; nigo bakoyarigia kobua korigia chinibo chibisire.
swahili: wale wanaotamani kifo ambacho hakiji, wale watafutao kufa zaidi ya kutafuta hazina iliyofichwa,

english: who rejoice and greatly exult when they can find the grave?
ekegusii: Abanto abwo bakogoka mono na gochenga, ee, nabo bakogoka kobabeire ang’e kogenda ase chimbeera na gotubererwa.
swahili: ambao hujawa na furaha, na hushangilia wafikapo kaburini?

english: Why is life given to a man whose way is hidden, whom God has hedged in?
ekegusii: Nase ki omobaso oorokire ase omonto chinchera chiaye chibisire, oyio Nyasae agiteire chinsemo chionsi?
swahili: Kwa nini uhai hupewa mtu ambaye njia yake imefichika, ambaye Mungu amemzungushia boma?

english: I sigh when food is put before me, and my groans pour out like water.
ekegusii: Obororo bw’emechando yane bwabeire buna endagera nkoria, na ebirero biane nigo bigoiteka buna amaache.
swahili: Kwa maana kulia kwangu kwa uchungu kwanijia badala ya chakula; kusononeka kwangu kunamwagika kama maji.

english: For the thing I feared has overtaken me, and what I dreaded has befallen me.
ekegusii: Naki ring’ana riria inyoboete rianchicheire, na riria rikoondokia rianyorire.
swahili: Lile nililokuwa naliogopa limenijia; lile nililokuwa ninalihofia limenipata.

english: I am not at ease or quiet; I have no rest, for trouble has come.”
ekegusii: Inche timbwati omorembe gose botoereru bonde; timbwati ogotimoka, korende emechando nigo egendererete konagocha.”
swahili: Sina amani, wala utulivu; sina pumziko, bali taabu tu.”

english: “May the day of my birth perish, and the night it was said, ‘A boy is conceived.’
ekegusii: Rituko riria naiboretwe, tiga risire riebwe kegima, boigo obotuko boria amang’ana aya akwanetwe: Omwana omoisia otongirwe enda ime.
swahili: “Siku ya kuzaliwa kwangu na ipotelee mbali, nao usiku ule iliposemekana, ‘Mtoto wa kiume amezaliwa!’

english: If only that day had turned to darkness! May God above disregard it; may no light shine upon it.
ekegusii: Tiga rituko riria ribe omosunte; Nyasae ore igoro tabaisa koriechandera, gose omobaso tobaisa koribarera.
swahili: Siku ile na iwe giza; Mungu juu na asiiangalie; nayo nuru isiiangazie.

english: May darkness and gloom reclaim it, and a cloud settle over it; may the blackness of the day overwhelm it.
ekegusii: Tiga omosunte na ekiriri ekemwamu biritube. Tiga amare aritube, na kende gionsi egekorenta obomwamu ase rituko kerioboyie.
swahili: Giza na kivuli kikuu kiikalie tena; wingu na likae juu yake; weusi na uifunike nuru yake.

english: If only darkness had taken that night away! May it not appear among the days of the year; may it never be entered in any of the months.
ekegusii: Omosunte ekerima otube obotuko boria, tibobaisa kobarwa amo namatuko ande ay’omwaka, gose kobarwa amo namatuko ande ay’emetienyi.
swahili: Usiku ule na ushikwe na giza kuu; usihesabiwe katika siku za mwaka, wala usihesabiwe katika siku za mwezi wowote.

english: Behold, may that night be barren; may no joyful voice come into it.
ekegusii: Ee, obotuko boria tiga bogombae; eriogi ri’omogooko tiribaisa koigugwa ase borobwo.
swahili: Usiku ule na uwe tasa; sauti ya furaha na isisikike ndani yake.

english: May it be cursed by those who curse the day — those prepared to rouse Leviathan.
ekegusii: Boragererigwe nabwo bamanyete koragereria amatuko, abwo baganyete korenta Leviatani eng’iti enene y’okwoboyia.
swahili: Wale wazilaanio siku wailaani hiyo siku, wale walio tayari kumwamsha Lewiathani.

english: May its morning stars grow dark; may it wait in vain for daylight; may it not see the breaking of dawn.
ekegusii: Ching’enang’eni chiaye chia ituko ria mambia chibe omosunte; obotuko tiga bochie koganya ng’a bokie, korende tibokia rinde, gose tibobaisa korora ogokiamoka kwa mambia,
swahili: Nyota zake za alfajiri na ziwe giza; nao ungojee mwanga bila mafanikio, wala usiuone mwonzi wa kwanza wa mapambazuko,

english: And the LORD said to Job:
ekegusii: Naende Omonene akagenderera gokwana, agateebia Ayubu,
swahili: Bwana akamwambia Ayubu:

english: Then adorn yourself with majesty and splendor, and clothe yourself with honor and glory.
ekegusii: Aye echabere nobonene na obwari, eboyie ogosikwa na okobua.
swahili: Basi jivike mwenyewe utukufu na fahari, nawe uvae heshima na enzi.

english: Unleash the fury of your wrath; look on every proud man and bring him low.
ekegusii: Siara ekeririanda gi’okogechigwa kwao, erio origererie kera omonto ore omoenenu, omokeyie.
swahili: Fungulia ukali wa ghadhabu yako, mtafute kila mwenye kiburi umshushe,

english: Look on every proud man and humble him; trample the wicked where they stand.
ekegusii: Ee, rigereria oyio ore omoenenu, omokeyie, na abakori amabe obatindachere inse agwo ase bateneine.
swahili: mwangalie kila mtu mwenye kiburi na umnyenyekeze, waponde waovu mahali wasimamapo.

english: Bury them together in the dust; imprison them in the grave.
ekegusii: Abwo bonsi babise ime ase amaroba; obwateranie bokong’u amasio abo ime y’ense inse.
swahili: Wazike wote mavumbini pamoja; wafunge nyuso zao kaburini.

english: Then I will confess to you that your own right hand can save you.
ekegusii: Igo inche ninyancherane naye, ng’a okoboko kwao gw’okorio ngokoe okobua.
swahili: Ndipo mimi mwenyewe nitakukubalia kuwa mkono wako mwenyewe wa kuume unaweza kukuokoa.

english: Look at Behemoth, which I made along with you. He feeds on grass like an ox.
ekegusii: “Rigereria engubo! Eyio natongete buna nagotongete aye. Nigo ekorisia obonyansi buna eng’ombe.
swahili: “Mwangalie mnyama aitwaye Behemothi, niliyemuumba kama nilivyokuumba wewe, anayekula majani kama ngʼombe.

english: See the strength of his loins and the power in the muscles of his belly.
ekegusii: Rora, chinguru chiaye nigo chire ase ekeneema kiaye, na okobua kwaye nigo kore ase chinyama chi’enda yaye.
swahili: Tazama basi nguvu alizo nazo kwenye viuno vyake, uwezo alio nao kwenye misuli ya tumbo lake!

english: His tail sways like a cedar; the sinews of his thighs are tightly knit.
ekegusii: Ekemincha kiaye nigo kere egekong’u pa buna omocharake, na emekia y’amariagati aye nigo esisekaine amo.
swahili: Mkia wake hutikisika kama mwerezi; mishipa ya mapaja yake imesukwa pamoja.

english: His bones are tubes of bronze; his limbs are rods of iron.
ekegusii: Amauga aye nigo are amakong’u buna emebirangwa eroisirie korwa ase etai; ee, amauga ’omobere oye nigo anga buna emeriibo y’ebioma.
swahili: Mifupa yake ni bomba za shaba, maungo yake ni kama fito za chuma.

english: He is the foremost of God’s works; only his Maker can draw the sword against him.
ekegusii: “Ero negetongwa ki’ogokumia inche Nyasae natongete; inche nayetongete, nayeete amaino anga buna emioro.
swahili: Yeye ni wa kwanza miongoni mwa kazi za Mungu, lakini Muumba wake anaweza kumsogelea kwa upanga wake.

english: “Will the faultfinder contend with the Almighty? Let him who argues with God give an answer.”
ekegusii: “Inee! Omonto okona‐korigia amamocho naamereranie n’Omonguru? Aye okona‐koamererania na Nyasae, iraneria rende.” Ayubu
swahili: “Je, mwenye kushindana na Mwenyezi aweza kumsahihisha? Mwenye kumlaumu Mungu na ajibu.”

english: The hills yield him their produce, while all the beasts of the field play nearby.
ekegusii: Endagera ekoria nigo ekwama ase ebitunwa igoro, agwo ase ching’iti chi’orosana chikogosoreria.
swahili: Vilima humletea yeye mazao yake, nao wanyama wote wa porini hucheza karibu naye.

english: He lies under the lotus plants, hidden among the reeds of the marsh.
ekegusii: Nigo ekorara ase ekiriri ki’omote okorokwa lotusi, yebisa na gokenderera ime ase ebitonto bire ase etente.
swahili: Hulala chini ya mimea ya yungiyungi, katika maficho ya matete kwenye matope.

english: The lotus plants conceal him in their shade; the willows of the brook surround him.
ekegusii: Omote oyio noro ore ekiriri kiaye; ee, emete enga buna emesobeti nigo eyeetanaine.
swahili: Hiyo mimea ya yungiyungi humficha kwenye vivuli vyake; miti mirefu karibu na kijito humzunguka.

english: Though the river rages, Behemoth is unafraid; he remains secure, though the Jordan surges to his mouth.
ekegusii: Rora, nonya orooche rore nemerindo, ero teri kwoboa; nonya orooche rwa Yorodani rokominyoka gocha ase omonwa oye, nigo ere noboremu.
swahili: Wakati mto ufurikapo, yeye hapati mshtuko wa hofu; yeye yu salama, hata kama Yordani ingefurika hadi kwenye kinywa chake.

english: Can anyone capture him as he looks on, or pierce his nose with a snare?
ekegusii: Inee! Omonto nanyare koyebwata ekero ere ase riraro riaye? Gose nabochore chimioro chiaye ayesibe nengori?”
swahili: Je, mtu yeyote anaweza kumkamata yeye akiwa macho, au kumnasa kwa mtego na kutoboa pua yake?

english: Then Job answered the LORD:
ekegusii: Erio Ayubu akairaneri’Omonene, agateeba:
swahili: Ndipo Ayubu akamjibu Bwana:

english: “Behold, I am insignificant. How can I reply to You? I place my hand over my mouth.
ekegusii: “Naama! Inche ting’isaini kende, ngento ki ndanyare gokoiraneria? Natubire omonwa one nokoboko kwane.
swahili: “Mimi sistahili kabisa: ninawezaje kukujibu wewe? Nauweka mkono wangu juu ya kinywa changu.

english: I have spoken once, but I have no answer— twice, but I have nothing to add.” The LORD Challenges Job Again
ekegusii: Inche nakwanire rimo, tinkomenta gento; ee, nakwanire kabere, korende tinkogenderera goetania ayio.” Omonene
swahili: Nimesema mara moja, lakini sina jibu; naam, nimesema mara mbili, lakini sitasema tena.”

english: Then the LORD answered Job out of the whirlwind and said:
ekegusii: Erio korwa ase ekembugu‐mbugu ime Omonene akairaneria Ayubu, akamoteebia:
swahili: Ndipo Bwana akasema na Ayubu kutoka upepo wa kisulisuli:

english: “Now brace yourself like a man; I will question you, and you shall inform Me.
ekegusii: “Tenena okong’e buna omosacha, inche ngokoboria nde, naye ong’iranerie.
swahili: “Jikaze kama mwanaume; nitakuuliza maswali, nawe yakupasa unijibu.

english: Would you really annul My justice? Would you condemn Me to justify yourself?
ekegusii: Inee! Nonyare kombara ng’a nomomochi inde? Norigetie kongambia inche, erinde obarerwe oboronge?
swahili: “Je, utabatilisha hukumu yangu? Utanilaumu mimi ili kujihesabia haki mwenyewe?

english: Do you have an arm like God’s? Can you thunder with a voice like His?
ekegusii: Aye nobwate okoboko buna okwane inche Nyasae? Nonyare kogukura neriogi riao buna inche nkogukura?
swahili: Je, una mkono kama wa Mungu, nawe waweza kutoa sauti ya ngurumo kama yake?

english: “Can you pull in Leviathan with a hook or tie down his tongue with a rope?
ekegusii: Inee! Aye nonyare kong’usa Leviatani, eng’iti enene y’okwoboyia, korwa rooche nendobio. Gose nonyare gosiba oromeme rwaye nengori?
swahili: “Je, waweza kumvua Lewiathani kwa ndoano ya samaki, au kufunga ulimi wake kwa kamba?

english: No one is so fierce as to rouse Leviathan. Then who is able to stand against Me?
ekegusii: Onde tari ore omotindi oraremererie ayechegie. Ning’o rende oranyare gotenena ase obosio bwane?
swahili: Hakuna yeyote aliye mkali athubutuye kumchokoza. Ni nani basi awezaye kusimama dhidi yangu?

english: Who has given to Me that I should repay him? Everything under heaven is Mine.
ekegusii: Ning’o ong’eire egento ritang’ani ng’a nainche imogeakane? Gento kende gionsi kere inse y’erioba nekiane.
swahili: Ni nani mwenye madai dhidi yangu ili nipate kumlipa? Kila kitu kilicho chini ya mbingu ni mali yangu.

english: I cannot keep silent about his limbs, his power and graceful form.
ekegusii: “Inche tingotiga ting’orokia buna ebiimo biaye bire, naende buna okobua ne chinguru chiaye bire, na buna amauga ’omobere oye aagachegete buya.
swahili: “Sitashindwa kunena juu ya maungo yake, nguvu zake na umbo lake zuri.

english: Who can strip off his outer coat? Who can approach him with a bridle?
ekegusii: Ning’o oranyare koyiaboria risankwa riaye? Ning’o oranyare gosoyia okoboko kwaye gati‐gati y’amaino aye?
swahili: Ni nani awezaye kumvua gamba lake la nje? Ni nani awezaye kumsogelea na lijamu?

english: Who can open his jaws, ringed by his fearsome teeth?
ekegusii: Ning’o oraasamie omonwa oye? Amaino aye nigo are ay’okwoboyia mono.
swahili: Nani athubutuye kuufungua mlango wa kinywa chake, kilichozungukwa na meno yake ya kutisha pande zote?

english: His rows of scales are his pride, tightly sealed together.
ekegusii: Obonene bwaye namagonko aye anga buna chinguba, achokaine chindwaro; nigo abwataine amo, buna ayanantirie.
swahili: Mgongo wake una safu za ngao zilizoshikamanishwa imara pamoja;

english: One scale is so near to another that no air can pass between them.
ekegusii: Rigonko erimo nigo risoaine nerinde ang’e kegima, nonya nembeo tekonyara gosoera gati yabo.
swahili: kila moja iko karibu sana na mwenzake, wala hakuna hewa iwezayo kupita kati yake.

english: They are joined to one another; they clasp and cannot be separated.
ekegusii: Nigo erinde ribwatanirie nerinde; naro nigo asoaine, takonyara gwatananwa.
swahili: Zimeunganishwa imara kila moja na nyingine; zimengʼangʼaniana pamoja wala haziwezi kutenganishwa.

english: His snorting flashes with light, and his eyes are like the rays of dawn.
ekegusii: Ekero egwasimora, chinsase nigo chigosoka chiamoreka, amaiso aye nigo anga buna amasase agosakia mambia.
swahili: Akipiga chafya mwanga humetameta; macho yake ni kama mionzi ya mapambazuko.

english: Firebrands stream from his mouth; fiery sparks shoot forth!
ekegusii: Chinsase chi’omorero nigo chikorwa ase omonwa oye; ee, chinsase nigo chigotaroka korwa asere.
swahili: Mienge iwakayo humiminika kutoka kinywani mwake; cheche za moto huruka nje.

english: Can you put a cord through his nose or pierce his jaw with a hook?
ekegusii: Nonyare gosoyia engori ime ase chimioro chiaye, gose kobochora orosea rwaye nendobio?
swahili: Waweza kupitisha kamba puani mwake, au kutoboa taya lake kwa kulabu?

english: Smoke billows from his nostrils as from a boiling pot over burning reeds.
ekegusii: Erioki nigo rigosoka korwa ase chimioro chiaye, buna enyongo ekobera egosokia omwoki bw’amaache.
swahili: Moshi hufuka kutoka puani mwake, kama kutoka kwenye chungu kinachotokota kwa moto wa matete.

english: His breath sets coals ablaze, and flames pour from his mouth.
ekegusii: Omoika bw’omonwa oye nigo ogosoka buna ekebemberi ki’omorero, na omorero nigo ogosoka korwa ase omonwa oye,
swahili: Pumzi yake huwasha makaa ya mawe, nayo miali ya moto huruka kutoka kinywani mwake.

english: Strength resides in his neck, and dismay leaps before him.
ekegusii: Rigoti riaye nigo ribwate chinguru, na okoondokia nigo kore bosio bwaye.
swahili: Nguvu hukaa katika shingo yake; utisho hutangulia mbele yake.

english: The folds of his flesh are tightly joined; they are firm and immovable.
ekegusii: Emenia y’omobere oye nigo ekinyaine amo; nigo yesibete bokong’u ase omobere oye, tekonyarwa kobwatokanigwa.
swahili: Mikunjo ya nyama yake imeshikamana imara pamoja; iko imara na haiwezi kuondolewa.

english: His chest is as hard as a rock, as hard as a lower millstone!
ekegusii: Enkoro yaye nenkong’u buna rigena, ee, nenkong’u buna orogena rogosia.
swahili: Kifua chake ni kigumu kama mwamba, kigumu kama jiwe la chini la kusagia.

english: When Leviathan rises up, the mighty are terrified; they withdraw before his thrashing.
ekegusii: Ekero ekoimoka gotenena, abanto chituoni nigo bakwoboa mono; ekero ekorindoka gocha nigo bagotang’ang’a.
swahili: Ainukapo, mashujaa wanaogopa; hurudi nyuma mbele yake anapokwenda kwa kishindo.

english: The sword that reaches him has no effect, nor does the spear or dart or arrow.
ekegusii: Nerutwa omoro oyegwere, tori koyekorera kende, nonya ne ritimo, gose ensara, gose esimisi.
swahili: Upanga unaomfikia haumdhuru, wala mkuki au mshale wala fumo.

english: He regards iron as straw and bronze as rotten wood.
ekegusii: Ekioma nigo kenga risakwe asere, na etai nigo enga omote ogundire.
swahili: Chuma hukiona kama unyasi, na shaba kama mti uliooza.

english: No arrow can make him flee; slingstones become like chaff to him.
ekegusii: Ensara tekoyioboyia etame; amagena ’enduruche akorutwa nigo anga buna amasakwe.
swahili: Mishale haimfanyi yeye akimbie; mawe ya kombeo kwake ni kama makapi.

english: A club is regarded as straw, and he laughs at the sound of the lance.
ekegusii: Chinungu nigo chinga buna amasakwe asere; ekero amatimo akwoga gocha nigo egoseka.
swahili: Rungu kwake huwa kama kipande cha jani kavu; hucheka sauti za kugongana kwa mkuki.

english: Will he beg you for mercy or speak to you softly?
ekegusii: Inee! Nenyare gokoboria amang’ana amange ase oboitongo? Gose nenyare gokwana naye amang’ana amororo?
swahili: Je, ataendelea kukuomba umhurumie? Atasema nawe maneno ya upole?

english: His undersides are jagged potsherds, spreading out the mud like a threshing sledge.
ekegusii: Ase enda yaye nigo ebwate ebigionkorio ebioge; nigo egotiga ebimanyerererio buna ebi’egari y’okoorera egokurura ase etintira.
swahili: Sehemu zake za chini kwenye tumbo zina menomeno na mapengo kama vigae vya chungu, zikiacha mburuzo kwenye matope kama chombo chenye meno cha kupuria.

english: He makes the depths seethe like a cauldron; he makes the sea like a jar of ointment.
ekegusii: Nigo egoserokia amaache korwa ase chindiba inse, nigo egokora amaache ’enyancha aba buna amaguta aburukanirie.
swahili: Huvisukasuka vilindi kama sufuria kubwa ichemkayo, na kukoroga bahari kama chungu cha marhamu.

english: He leaves a glistening wake behind him; one would think the deep had white hair!
ekegusii: Enchera yaeteire nigo ekogenderera komesa, enyancha inse nigo egokagwa ng’a nechimbuche.
swahili: Anapopita nyuma yake huacha mkondo unaometameta; mtu angedhani vilindi vilikuwa na mvi.

english: Nothing on earth is his equal— a creature devoid of fear!
ekegusii: Getongwa kende tikeri igoro ase ense kenga ero, ekio giatongetwe getari kwoboa.
swahili: Hakuna chochote duniani kinacholingana naye: yeye ni kiumbe kisicho na woga.

english: He looks down on all the haughty; he is king over all the proud.”
ekegusii: Nigo ekorigereria kera egento kere igoro mono etari gokioboa, nigo ere omorwoti bw’ebitongwa bionsi bire noboenenu.”
swahili: Yeye huwatazama chini wale wote wenye kujivuna; yeye ni mfalme juu ya wote wenye kiburi.”

english: Will he make a covenant with you to take him as a slave for life?
ekegusii: Ero nekore okobwatana amo naye, ng’a ebe omosomba oo kogenderera botambe?
swahili: Je, atafanya agano nawe ili umtwae awe mtumishi wako maisha yake yote?

english: Can you pet him like a bird or put him on a leash for your maidens?
ekegusii: Inee! Nokore egosori nero buna orakore nenyoni? Gose oyebeke ekorere abasomba bao abaiseke egosori?
swahili: Je, utamfuga na kumfanya rafiki kama ndege, au kumfunga kamba kwa ajili ya wasichana wako?

english: Will traders barter for him or divide him among the merchants?
ekegusii: Inee! Abaoonia mbakorerane rigori igoro yaye, gose bayebutorane ase okoyeonerania?
swahili: Je, wafanyabiashara watabadilishana bidhaa kwa ajili yake? Watamgawanya miongoni mwa wafanyao biashara?

english: Can you fill his hide with harpoons or his head with fishing spears?
ekegusii: Nonyare kobochora riiyo riaye ne ritimo rikobeta chinswe? Gose ritimo erio ndibete omotwe oye riyobochore?
swahili: Je, waweza kuijaza ngozi yake kwa vyuma vyenye ncha kali, au kichwa chake kwa mkuki wa kuvulia samaki?

english: If you lay a hand on him, you will remember the battle and never repeat it!
ekegusii: Rambora okoboko kwao oyebwate, erio oteeme gokora esegi nero. Tokoiranera eria kabere.
swahili: Kama ukiweka mkono wako juu yake, utavikumbuka hivyo vita na kamwe hutarudia tena!

english: Surely hope of overcoming him is false. Is not the sight of him overwhelming?
ekegusii: “Ekero omonto agoteema igo, nigo ogosemeria kwaye kogosira kegima; nonya nase okoyerora rioka, omonto nigo akwerusia moyo.
swahili: Tumaini lolote la kumtiisha ni kujidanganya; kule kumwona tu kunamwangusha mtu chini.

english: Then Job replied to the LORD:
ekegusii: Erio Ayubu akairaneri’Omonene, akabora. Abuyu
swahili: Ndipo Ayubu akamjibu Bwana:

english: After Job had prayed for his friends, the LORD restored his prosperity and doubled his former possessions.
ekegusii: Erio magega Ayubu gasabeire abasani baria baye, Omonene akairaneria Ayubu amaya aye, akamoa ebinto ara kabere kobua ebi abwate ritang’ani.
swahili: Baada ya Ayubu kuwaombea rafiki zake, Bwana akamwondoa kwenye uteka, akamfanikisha tena naye akampa mara mbili ya vile alivyokuwa navyo hapo mwanzoni.

english: All his brothers and sisters and prior acquaintances came and dined with him in his house. They consoled him and comforted him over all the adversity that the LORD had brought upon him. And each one gave him a piece of silver and a gold ring.
ekegusii: Erio abamura bamwabo Ayubu, na abasubati bamwabo, na abasani baye bonsi abamomanyete agwo ritang’ani, bagacha asare, bakaragera amo nere nyomba mwaye. Bakamororera amabebe na komoremia ase engencho y’amabe aria onsi Omonene amorenterete, na kera oyomo akamoa chitaabu na ebonyi eroisirie korwa ase etaabu.
swahili: Ndipo ndugu zake wote waume kwa wake na kila mtu aliyemfahamu mwanzoni, wakaja wakala pamoja naye katika nyumba yake. Wakamfariji na kumtuliza moyo juu ya taabu yote Bwana aliyoileta juu yake, nao kila mmoja akampa kipande cha fedha na pete ya dhahabu.

english: So the LORD blessed Job’s latter days more than his first. He owned 14,000 sheep, 6,000 camels, 1,000 yoke of oxen, and 1,000 female donkeys.
ekegusii: Omonene agasesenia amatuko a magega ay’Ayubu kobua aye ritang’ani. Boigo Ayubu akanyora ching’ondi chilifu ikomi na inye, ne chingamia chilifu isano nemo, ne chiombe chilifu ibere, ne chitigere chiaberi elifu eyemo.
swahili: Bwana akaibariki sehemu ya mwisho ya maisha ya Ayubu kuliko ile ya kwanza. Alikuwa na kondoo elfu kumi na nne, ngamia elfu sita, jozi za mafahali elfu moja, na punda wa kike elfu moja.

english: And he also had seven sons and three daughters.
ekegusii: Boigo akaegwa abamura batano na babere, na abaiseke batato.
swahili: Tena alikuwa na wana saba na binti watatu.

english: He named his first daughter Jemimah, his second Keziah, and his third Keren-happuch.
ekegusii: Akaroka omoiseke omotang’ani Yemima, na oyo o kabere Kesia, na oyo o gatato Kereni‐Hapuki.
swahili: Binti wa kwanza aliitwa Yemima, wa pili Kesia na wa tatu Keren-Hapuki.

english: No women as beautiful as Job’s daughters could be found in all the land, and their father granted them an inheritance among their brothers.
ekegusii: Ase ense eyio yonsi bakungu bande tibarengeo baare abanyabieni buna abaiseke b’Ayubu, na ise akabaa omwando amo nabamura bamwabo.
swahili: Hapakuwepo mahali popote katika nchi ile yote palipopatikana wanawake wazuri kama binti za Ayubu; naye baba yao akawapa urithi pamoja na ndugu zao.

english: After this, Job lived 140 years and saw his children and their children to the fourth generation.
ekegusii: Na magega y’ayio Ayubu akagenderera koba moyo ase engaki y’emiaka rigana erimo, na emerongo ene, akarora abana baye, na abachokoro, na abachokororia, goika ekiaare gia kane.
swahili: Baada ya hili Ayubu akaishi miaka 140; akawaona wanawe na wana wa wanawe hata kizazi cha nne.

english: And so Job died, old and full of years.
ekegusii: Na Ayubu agakwa kabeire omogotu mono.
swahili: Hivyo Ayubu akafa, akiwa mzee aliyekuwa ameshiba siku.

english: “I know that You can do all things and that no plan of Yours can be thwarted.
ekegusii: “Nimanyete ng’a aye nonyare gokora ebinto bionsi, naende ng’a aya kwaganirie gokora takonyara gotangwa taba.
swahili: “Ninajua ya kuwa unaweza kufanya mambo yote, wala hakuna mpango wako unaoweza kuzuilika.

english: You asked, ‘Who is this who conceals My counsel without knowledge?’ Surely I spoke of things I did not understand, things too wonderful for me to know.
ekegusii: Ninche ng’o mbwate ogosemia gotari nobong’aini? Ase ayio nakwanire aya ntamanyeti, amang’ana ’ogokumia ansinyire komanya.
swahili: Uliuliza, ‘Ni nani huyu afichaye mashauri yangu bila maarifa?’ Hakika nilisema juu ya mambo niliyokuwa siyaelewi, mambo ya ajabu mno kwangu mimi kuyajua.

english: You said, ‘Listen now, and I will speak. I will question you, and you shall inform Me.’
ekegusii: Koranche, ontegerere nkwane, nkoborie, naye onteebie buna are.
swahili: “Ulisema, ‘Sikiliza sasa, nami nitanena; nitakuuliza swali, nawe yakupasa kunijibu.’

english: My ears had heard of You, but now my eyes have seen You.
ekegusii: Nabeire nkoigwa igoro yao ase okoigwa namato rioka, korende bono amaiso aane akororire.
swahili: Masikio yangu yalikuwa yamesikia habari zako, lakini sasa macho yangu yamekuona.

english: Therefore I retract my words, and I repent in dust and ashes.” The LORD Rebukes Job’s Friends
ekegusii: Ase ayio nechayire inche omonyene, naende neakire orotu ne ribu ase ogweitia na goonchoka.” Omoerio
swahili: Kwa hiyo najidharau mwenyewe, na kutubu katika mavumbi na majivu.” Mwisho: Marafiki Wa Ayubu Wanafedheheshwa

english: After the LORD had spoken these words to Job, He said to Eliphaz the Temanite, “My wrath is kindled against you and your two friends. For you have not spoken about Me accurately, as My servant Job has.
ekegusii: Omonene gakwanire amang’ana ayio n’Ayubu, agakwana n’Elifasi Omotemani, akamoteebia, “Nabeire nendamwamu asore na ase abasani bao baria babere, ekiagera inwe timokwaneti ayare ay’oboronge igoro yane buna Ayubu, omosomba one, akwanete.
swahili: Baada ya Bwana kusema mambo haya yote na Ayubu, akamwambia Elifazi Mtemani, “Nina hasira juu yako na juu ya rafiki zako wawili, kwa sababu hamkusema yaliyo sawa kwa habari yangu, kama alivyosema mtumishi wangu Ayubu.

english: So now, take seven bulls and seven rams, go to My servant Job, and sacrifice a burnt offering for yourselves. Then My servant Job will pray for you, for I will accept his prayer and not deal with you according to your folly. For you have not spoken accurately about Me, as My servant Job has.”
ekegusii: Ase igo bono ira ase Ayubu, omosomba one, chieri isano na ibere, ne chimingichi isano na ibere; mochirue chibe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa ase engencho yaino inwe abanyene. Ayubu, omosomba one, nabasabere, ekiagera inche nigo ndanchere ogosaba kwaye ase engencho yaino, timbaisa kobakorera buna oboriri bwaino bore. Inwe timokwaneti igoro yane amang’ana are ay’oboronge buna Ayubu, omosomba one, akwanete.”
swahili: Basi sasa chukueni mafahali saba na kondoo dume saba mkamwendee mtumishi wangu Ayubu nanyi mkatoe sadaka za kuteketezwa kwa ajili yenu wenyewe. Mtumishi wangu Ayubu ataomba kwa ajili yenu, nami nitayakubali maombi yake ili nisiwatendee sawasawa na upumbavu wenu. Ninyi hamkusema yaliyo sawa kwa habari yangu, kama alivyosema mtumishi wangu Ayubu.”

english: So Eliphaz the Temanite, Bildad the Shuhite, and Zophar the Naamathite went and did as the LORD had told them; and the LORD accepted Job’s request. The LORD Blesses Job
ekegusii: Ase igo Elifasi Omotemani, na Bilidadi Omosua, na Sofari Omonama, bakagenda bagakora buna Omonene abachigete, n’Omonene aganchera ogosaba kw’Ayubu.
swahili: Kwa hiyo Elifazi Mtemani, Bildadi Mshuhi, na Sofari Mnaamathi wakafanya kama Bwana alivyowaambia; naye Bwana akayakubali maombi ya Ayubu.

english: Then Eliphaz the Temanite replied:
ekegusii: Bono Elifasi Omotemani akairaneria, akabora:
swahili: Ndipo Elifazi Mtemani akajibu:

english: The lion may roar, and the fierce lion may growl, yet the teeth of the young lions are broken.
ekegusii: Nonya bakoruma buna endo ere entindi, bakirigwe, na amaino e chindo chinsae nigo akobunwa.
swahili: Simba anaweza kunguruma na kukoroma, lakini bado meno ya simba mkubwa huvunjika.

english: The old lion perishes for lack of prey, and the cubs of the lioness are scattered.
ekegusii: Endo engotu nekwe ase okoborwa chinyama ekoria. Ne chimanwa chi’endo eaberi nigo chigosererebekana.
swahili: Simba anaweza kuangamia kwa kukosa mawindo, nao wana wa simba jike hutawanyika.

english: Now a word came to me secretly; my ears caught a whisper of it.
ekegusii: Ring’ana ndire rianchicherete bobisi, nigo nariigwete rikomonyerera.
swahili: “Neno lililetwa kwangu kwa siri, masikio yangu yakasikia mnongʼono wake.

english: In disquieting visions in the night, when deep sleep falls on men,
ekegusii: Ekero abanto bararire chitoro chindito na inche narenge nebirengererio na korora amaroro,
swahili: Katikati ya ndoto za kutia wasiwasi wakati wa usiku, hapo usingizi mzito uwapatapo wanadamu,

english: fear and trembling came over me and made all my bones shudder.
ekegusii: obwoba bokambwata amo nokoiguswa, na amauga onsi ay’omobere one agachaaka gotengechigwa.
swahili: hofu na kutetemeka kulinishika na kufanya mifupa yangu yote itetemeke.

english: Then a spirit glided past my face, and the hair on my body bristled.
ekegusii: Embeo egaeta ase obosio bwane, na amarionya ’omobere one agatenena.
swahili: Kuna roho aliyepita mbele ya uso wangu, nazo nywele za mwili wangu zikasimama.

english: It stood still, but I could not discern its appearance; a form loomed before my eyes, and I heard a whispering voice:
ekegusii: Omogwekano bw’egento gete ogatenena ase obosio bwane, korende tinanyarete komanya ng’a ngento ki gose nkieni ki; erio nkaigwa eriogi eriororo rigoteeba:
swahili: Yule roho akasimama, lakini sikuweza kutambua kilikuwa kitu gani. Umbo fulani lilisimama mbele ya macho yangu, kukawa na ukimya kisha nikasikia sauti:

english: ‘Can a mortal be more righteous than God, or a man more pure than his Maker?
ekegusii: Inee! Mwanyabaanto nanyare koba omooronge kobua Nyasae? Nanyare koba oyochenegete kobua Omotongi oye?
swahili: ‘Je, binadamu aweza kuwa mwadilifu kuliko Mungu? Je, mtu aweza kuwa safi kuliko Muumba wake?

english: If God puts no trust in His servants, and He charges His angels with error,
ekegusii: Rora, Nyasae tari gosemeria nonya nabasomba baye; ere nigo akobabeekeera abamalaika baye obobe.
swahili: Kama Mungu hawaamini watumishi wake, kama yeye huwalaumu malaika zake kwa kukosea,

english: how much more those who dwell in houses of clay, whose foundations are in the dust, who can be crushed like a moth!
ekegusii: Onye naboigo, naki rende arasemerie abwo bamenyete ase chinyomba chi’amaroba, abwo amaroso abo abekire ase riroba? Barabwo nigo bagoakwa na komionogorwa buna ebigwankwa.
swahili: ni mara ngapi zaidi wale waishio katika nyumba za udongo wa mfinyanzi, ambazo misingi yake ipo mavumbini, ambao wamepondwa kama nondo!

english: “If one ventures a word with you, will you be wearied? Yet who can keep from speaking?
ekegusii: Inee! Omonto arateema gokwana naye, nogechigwe nere? Nonya naboigo, monto ki oranyare gokira‐kiri takwana?
swahili: “Kama mtu akithubutu kuzungumza nawe, kutakukasirisha? Lakini ni nani awezaye kujizuia asiseme?

english: They are smashed to pieces from dawn to dusk; unnoticed, they perish forever.
ekegusii: Abanto nabo baranyare koba moyo ase engaki ya mambia, korende omogoroba otaraika, kwanyora baitirwe, basirire goika kare na kare, na onde tari okobechandera.
swahili: Kati ya mawio na machweo huvunjwa vipande vipande; bila yeyote kutambua, huangamia milele.

english: Are not their tent cords pulled up, so that they die without wisdom?’
ekegusii: Bionsi ebi’abaanto abwo basemeretie nigo bigosira kegima. Nigo bagokwa bataraikera komanya obong’aini bonde bwonsi.
swahili: Je, kamba za hema yao hazikungʼolewa, hivyo hufa bila hekima?’

english: Surely you have instructed many, and have strengthened their feeble hands.
ekegusii: Rora, aye kworokereirie abanto abange, na amaboko atabwate chinguru kwayakong’irie.
swahili: Fikiri jinsi ambavyo umewafundisha watu wengi, jinsi ambavyo umeitia nguvu mikono iliyokuwa dhaifu.

english: Your words have steadied those who stumbled; you have braced the knees that were buckling.
ekegusii: Amang’ana ao abeire akoremia oyo konya osinyirwe kogenderera, na aye gwakong’irie amaru aye arenge koiguswa.
swahili: Maneno yako yamewategemeza wale waliojikwaa; umeyatia nguvu magoti yaliyokuwa dhaifu.

english: But now trouble has come upon you, and you are weary. It strikes you, and you are dismayed.
ekegusii: Bono naye emechando yacheire, na tori noboremu bonde bwonsi, yagokunire na aye kwegosire.
swahili: Lakini sasa hii taabu imekujia wewe, nawe unashuka moyo; imekupiga wewe, nawe unafadhaika.

english: Is your reverence not your confidence, and the uprightness of your ways your hope?
ekegusii: Aye buna omoirogete Nyasae, tori noboremu? Naende buna chinchera chiao chire chindonge, tori nogosemeria?
swahili: Je, kumcha Mungu kwako hakupaswi kuwa ndiyo matumaini yako na njia zako kutokuwa na lawama ndilo taraja lako?

english: Consider now, I plead: Who, being innocent, has ever perished? Or where have the upright been destroyed?
ekegusii: Bono rengereria, indi yabeete ng’a omonto omoikeranu nasiretigwe? Naende indi yabeete ng’a abanto abaronge mbatugutetwe?
swahili: “Fikiri sasa: Ni mtu yupi asiye na hatia ambaye aliwahi kuangamia? Ni wapi wanyofu waliwahi kuangamizwa?

english: As I have observed, those who plow iniquity and those who sow trouble reap the same.
ekegusii: Aya naroche naya: Baria bakorema obosareku, na baria bagosimeka emechando, nabagese ayio ayio.
swahili: Kwa jinsi ambavyo mimi nimechunguza, wale walimao ubaya na wale hupanda uovu, huvuna hayo hayo hayo.

english: By the breath of God they perish, and by the blast of His anger they are consumed.
ekegusii: Nyasae nigo akobaeyanera basira, na ase okogusa kw’endamwamu yaye baerigwa.
swahili: Kwa pumzi ya Mungu huangamizwa; kwa mshindo wa hasira zake huangamia.

english: “Call out if you please, but who will answer? To which of the holy ones will you turn?
ekegusii: Bono rangeria! Inee! Onde nareo oragoitabere? Ase abwo abachenu, ning’o oraonchokere?
swahili: “Ita kama unataka, lakini ni nani atakayekujibu? Ni yupi kati ya hao watakatifu utakayemgeukia?

english: He gives rain to the earth and sends water upon the fields.
ekegusii: Nigo akorua embura yatwa igoro ase ense, na emegondo yanyora amaache.
swahili: Yeye huipa nchi mvua, huyapeleka maji kunyesha mashamba.

english: He sets the lowly on high, so that mourners are lifted to safety.
ekegusii: Ere nigo akoimokereria abanto abaitongo igoro, na abwo bachandegete bakorera, nigo akobabeka ase oborendi obuya.
swahili: Huwainua juu wanyonge, nao wale waombolezao huinuliwa wakawa salama.

english: He thwarts the schemes of the crafty, so that their hands find no success.
ekegusii: Nyasae nigo agosaria emeroberio y’abang’ainereria, erinde emeremo bagokora namaboko abo tegoikerana buna baganetie.
swahili: Huipinga mipango ya wenye hila, ili mikono yao isifikie ufanisi.

english: He catches the wise in their craftiness, and sweeps away the plans of the cunning.
ekegusii: Ere nigo akobwata abare nobong’aini ase obong’ainereria bwabo, emeroberio yabo y’ogotega nigo egosirigwa bwango.
swahili: Yeye huwanasa wenye hekima katika hila yao, nayo mipango ya wadanganyifu huifagilia mbali.

english: They encounter darkness by day and grope at noon as in the night.
ekegusii: Abanto abwo nigo bakobwatwa nomosunte mobaso gati, bataba‐taba mobaso gati buna nobotuko bore.
swahili: Giza huwapata wakati wa mchana; wakati wa adhuhuri hupapasa kama vile usiku.

english: He saves the needy from the sword in their mouth and from the clutches of the powerful.
ekegusii: Korende Nyasae nigo agotooria abataka korwa ase emenwa egoita, na abaremeire korwa ase abwo bare ne chinguru.
swahili: Humwokoa mhitaji kutokana na upanga ulioko kinywani mwao; huwaokoa kutokana na makucha ya wenye nguvu.

english: So the poor have hope, and injustice shuts its mouth.
ekegusii: Ase ayio abaremerwa mbabe nogosemeria, korende abakori amabe nigo barakirigwe‐kiri.
swahili: Kwa hiyo maskini analo tarajio, nao udhalimu hufumba kinywa chake.

english: Blessed indeed is the man whom God corrects; so do not despise the discipline of the Almighty.
ekegusii: Nasesenirie omonto oyio Nyasae akoa egesusuro ase okomoorongeyia; ase ayio tobaisa gochaaya ogoaka, gw’okorongeyia kw’oyore Omonguru.
swahili: “Heri mtu yule ambaye Mungu humrudi; kwa hiyo usidharau adhabu yake Mwenyezi.

english: For He wounds, but He also binds; He strikes, but His hands also heal.
ekegusii: Ere nigo akorenta amaote, naende oyaboa; ere nigo agoaka chingoma, naende okoboko kwaye kwagwenia.
swahili: Kwa kuwa hutia jeraha, lakini pia huyafunga; huumiza, lakini mikono yake pia huponya.

english: He will rescue you from six calamities; no harm will touch you in seven.
ekegusii: Ere nagotoorie korwa ase emechando etano nomo, ee, nonya nkorwa ase etano na ebere, na amabe tagokonyora.
swahili: Kutoka majanga sita atakuokoa; naam, hata katika saba hakuna dhara litakalokupata wewe.

english: For resentment kills a fool, and envy slays the simple.
ekegusii: Ekeene, ogwechanda nigo kogoita omoriri, na emoko nigo egoita oyo otari omong’aini.
swahili: Kuweka uchungu moyoni humuua mpumbavu, nao wivu humchinja mjinga.

english: In famine He will redeem you from death, and in battle from the stroke of the sword.
ekegusii: Ekero ki’enchara nagotoorie korwa ase amakweri, na ekero gi’esegi korwa ase abwo bagoita nemioro.
swahili: Wakati wa njaa atakukomboa wewe na kifo, naye katika vita atakukomboa na pigo la upanga.

english: You will be hidden from the scourge of the tongue, and will not fear havoc when it comes.
ekegusii: Ekero abanto bakogokwana bobe nobiswe, na ekero amabe agoita arache, toyoboa.
swahili: Utalindwa kutokana na kichapo cha ulimi, wala hutakuwa na sababu ya kuogopa maangamizi yatakapokujia.

english: You will laugh at destruction and famine, and need not fear the beasts of the earth.
ekegusii: Ekero ogosiria na enchara birache, aye nobe gokobisekerera, gose tokwoboa ching’iti chintindi chire ase ense.
swahili: Utayacheka maangamizo na njaa, wala hutakuwa na sababu ya kuwaogopa wanyama wakali wa mwituni.

english: For you will have a covenant with the stones of the field, and the wild animals will be at peace with you.
ekegusii: Nonya namagena are mogondo, nobwatane naro, ne ching’iti chi’orosana nobe nomorembe nachirochio.
swahili: Kwa kuwa utakuwa na agano na mawe ya mashamba, nao wanyama wa mwitu watakuwa na amani nawe.

english: You will know that your tent is secure, and find nothing amiss when inspecting your home.
ekegusii: Erio nonyare korora ng’a obomenyo bwao mborendire buya, na ekero orabe gokorata ase ameri e chitugo chiao, nonyore ng’a ende tesireti korwao.
swahili: Utajua ya kwamba hema lako li salama; utahesabu mali zako wala hutakuta chochote kilichopungua.

english: You will know that your offspring will be many, your descendants like the grass of the earth.
ekegusii: Norore buna abana bao babeire abange, na ororeria rwao ndobuche robe oronge buna obonyansi bore ase ense.
swahili: Utajua ya kuwa watoto wako watakuwa wengi, nao wazao wako wengi kama majani ya nchi.

english: You will come to the grave in full vigor, like a sheaf of grain gathered in season.
ekegusii: Nogende ase embeera kore nobogotu obuya, buna emesaima y’endagera ekorentwa ekero engaki yabo yaikire.
swahili: Utaingia kaburini ukiwa na umri wa uzee mtimilifu, kama masuke ya ngano yakusanywapo kwa wakati wake.

english: Indeed, we have investigated, and it is true! So hear it and know for yourself.”
ekegusii: “Naama! Twabeire togokora obotuki ase amang’ana ayio; naro nay’ekeene. Ase ayio bono igwa amang’ana ayio, oyagache ase omoyo oo.”
swahili: “Tumelichunguza hili, nalo ni kweli. Hivyo lisikie na ulitendee kazi.”

english: I have seen a fool taking root, but suddenly his house was cursed.
ekegusii: Nabeire nkorora omonto omoriri okogenderera bokong’u, korende mobosokano nkaragereria enka yaye.
swahili: Mimi mwenyewe nimemwona mpumbavu akistawi, lakini ghafula nyumba yake ikawa imelaaniwa.

english: His sons are far from safety, crushed in court without a defender.
ekegusii: Abana baye tibakonyora ogokonywa, nigo bakomionogorerwa geita, gose monto onde tari okobatooria.
swahili: Watoto wake wako mbali na usalama, hushindwa mahakamani bila mtetezi.

english: The hungry consume his harvest, taking it even from the thorns, and the thirsty pant after his wealth.
ekegusii: Abanto bare nenchara nabwo bakoria endagera eye omonto oria akogesa, abwo nigo bakoyerusia nonya egiteire namagwa; abasaneri nigo bagosanera obotenenku bwaye.
swahili: Wenye njaa huyala mavuno yake, wakiyatoa hata katikati ya miiba, nao wenye kiu huitamani sana mali yake.

english: For distress does not spring from the dust, and trouble does not sprout from the ground.
ekegusii: Obobe tibori korwa ase riroba, gose emechando teri komera korwa inse ase riroba,
swahili: Kwa maana taabu haioti kutoka kwenye udongo, wala udhia hauchipui kutoka ardhini.

english: Yet man is born to trouble as surely as sparks fly upward.
ekegusii: korende Mwanyabaanto nigo akoiborwa ase okonyora emechando, buna chinsase chi’omorero chigotaroka gochia igoro.
swahili: Lakini mwanadamu huzaliwa ili kutaabika, kwa hakika kama cheche za moto zirukavyo kuelekea juu.

english: However, if I were you, I would appeal to God and lay my cause before Him—
ekegusii: Yare koba ng’a ninche nanga nigo narigia Nyasae, nere bweka nare goteebia amang’ana aane.
swahili: “Lakini ingekuwa ni mimi, ningemlalamikia Mungu, ningeliweka shauri langu mbele zake.

english: the One who does great and unsearchable things, wonders without number.
ekegusii: Nyasae nigo agokora amang’ana amanene atari komanyekana buna are, boigo namakumia atanyare kobareka.
swahili: Yeye hutenda maajabu yasiyoweza kutambuliwa, miujiza isiyoweza kuhesabika.

english: Then Job replied:
ekegusii: Erio Ayubu akairaneria, agateeba:
swahili: Kisha Ayubu akajibu:

english: It still brings me comfort, and joy through unrelenting pain, that I have not denied the words of the Holy One.
ekegusii: Ayio nigo are kogera ndemigwe; nigo narenge kogoka ntari koigwa obororo bw’okoromwa oko okonene. Ekiagera tinkaneti amang’ana a Nyasae ore Omochenu.
swahili: Ndipo bado ningekuwa na hii faraja, furaha yangu katika maumivu makali: kwamba sikuwa nimeyakana maneno yake yeye Aliye Mtakatifu.

english: What strength do I have, that I should still hope? What is my future, that I should be patient?
ekegusii: Chinguru chiane inki chiisaine imbe nokoganya kore nogosemeria? Na omoerio one naki ogochia koba, ngenderere koremereria?
swahili: “Ninazo nguvu gani, hata niendelee kutumaini? Matazamio yangu ya mbele ni nini, hata niendelee kuwa mvumilivu?

english: Is my strength like that of stone, or my flesh made of bronze?
ekegusii: Inee! Chinguru chiane nigo chire chinkong’u buna echi’amagena? Gose omobere one nigo ore omokong’u buna etai?
swahili: Je, mimi nina nguvu za jiwe? Je, mwili wangu ni shaba?

english: Is there any help within me now that success is driven from me?
ekegusii: Ekeene gokonywa konde gwonsi tikori ime yane, amagenderero nabwate naurirwe.
swahili: Je, ninao uwezo wowote wa kujisaidia mimi mwenyewe, wakati ambapo mafanikio yamefukuziwa mbali nami?

english: A despairing man should have the kindness of his friend, even if he forsakes the fear of the Almighty.
ekegusii: Oyotakororera omosani oye amaabera oyio, rirorio otigire koiroka Omobui.
swahili: “Mtu anayekata tamaa angetazamia moyo wa kujitoa wa rafiki zake, hata kama akiacha uchaji wa Mwenyezi.

english: But my brothers are as faithless as wadis, as seasonal streams that overflow,
ekegusii: Abaminto bakorire obong’ainereria babeire buna chintuboka chi’amaache, na buna chiooro chi’emegoko chigoeta chiaera.
swahili: Lakini ndugu zangu sio wa kutegemewa, ni kama vijito vya msimu, ni kama vijito ambavyo hufurika

english: darkened because of the ice and the inflow of melting snow,
ekegusii: Barabwo nigo banga buna chindooche chiamerire amaache ’obokendu abwataine, na amagena ’embura are imeo.
swahili: wakati vimefunikwa barafu iyeyukayo, ambavyo hujazwa na theluji inayoyeyuka,

english: but ceasing in the dry season and vanishing from their channels in the heat.
ekegusii: Ekero ki’omobaso chiasunkera chiakea; na omorakera ogocha chiasira kegima korwa aase abo.
swahili: lakini hukauka majira ya ukame, na wakati wa hari hutoweka katika mikondo yake.

english: Caravans turn aside from their routes; they go into the wasteland and perish.
ekegusii: Abagendi babwate chitugo chiabo nigo bakogobera korigia amaache, tibakoyanyora; ase igo bakwera ase erooro.
swahili: Misafara hugeuka kutoka njia zake; hukwea kwenda kwenye nchi ya ukiwa na kuangamia.

english: The caravans of Tema look for water; the travelers of Sheba hope to find it.
ekegusii: Abagendi ba Tema nigo bakoriga‐rigia amaache, naboigo abaonchoreria ba Seba basemeria koyanyora.
swahili: Misafara ya Tema inatafuta maji, wafanyabiashara wa Sheba wanaosafiri hutazama kwa matarajio.

english: “If only my grief could be weighed and placed with my calamity on the scales.
ekegusii: Onye ndiria obororo bwane bwarenge korengwa, na emechando yane yonsi ebeekwe ase ekerengo erengwe!
swahili: “Laiti uchungu wangu ungeweza kupimwa, nayo taabu yangu yote ingewekwa kwenye mizani!

english: They are confounded because they had hoped; their arrival brings disappointment.
ekegusii: Abwo nigo bagoichana, ekiagera tibanyorete eki basemeretie; ekero bachete aase agwo, bakanyora ng’a nigo bang’ainetwe.
swahili: Wamedhikika, kwa sababu walikuwa na matumaini; wanafika huko, lakini wanahuzunika kwa kukosa walichotarajia.

english: For now you are of no help; you see terror, and you are afraid.
ekegusii: Nabogio nainwe mwabeire ase ’nde buna chintuboka chiria; mwarorire emechando yane, mwakumirie na kwoboa.
swahili: Sasa nanyi mmethibitika kwamba hamna msaada wowote; mnaona jambo la kutisha, nanyi mnaogopa.

english: Have I ever said, ‘Give me something; offer me a bribe from your wealth;
ekegusii: Inee! Inche nateebirie onde ng’a andetere ekeegwa? Gose naboririe onde ng’a arue embooria korwa ase chinibo chiaye?
