swahili: Je, nimewahi kusema, ‘Toeni kitu kwa ajili yangu, au mnilipie fidia kutoka mali zenu,

english: deliver me from the hand of the enemy; redeem me from the grasp of the ruthless’?
ekegusii: Gose nateebirie onde ng’a antoorie korwa ase okoboko kw’omobisa one? Gose nateebirie onde ng’a amboorie korwa ase amaboko ’abachandi baane?
swahili: au niokoeni mikononi mwa adui, au nikomboeni kutoka makucha ya wasio na huruma’?

english: Teach me, and I will be silent. Help me understand how I have erred.
ekegusii: Inyorokererie, na inche ninkire‐kiri imanyie amamocho nakorire.
swahili: “Nifundisheni, nami nitanyamaza kimya; nionyesheni nilikokosea.

english: How painful are honest words! But what does your argument prove?
ekegusii: Naki amang’ana ’ekeene agwansa! Korende amang’ana ayio aino ay’obong’ainereria, inki agokonya?
swahili: Tazama yalivyo ya kuumiza maneno ya kweli! Lakini mabishano yenu yanathibitisha nini?

english: Do you intend to correct my words, and treat as wind my cry of despair?
ekegusii: Inee! Nigo mokorengereria ng’a amang’ana ’omonto bwerusirie moyo nigo anga buna omwaga?
swahili: Je, mna maana ya kuyasahihisha ninayosema, na kuyafanya maneno ya mtu anayekata tamaa kama upepo?

english: You would even cast lots for an orphan and barter away your friend.
ekegusii: Onye naboigo, rirorio monyare goaka obomera igoro ye chintakana, monyare gokorera abasani baino amagori amake ase okobaoonia.
swahili: Mngeweza hata kupiga kura kwa ajili ya yatima, na kubadilishana rafiki yenu na mali.

english: But now, please look at me. Would I lie to your face?
ekegusii: Bono, komoranche mondigererie; ninde nobomaene kegima, tingokwana oborimo ase more.
swahili: “Lakini sasa kuweni na huruma mkaniangalie mimi. Je, ningeweza kusema uongo mbele zenu?

english: Reconsider; do not be unjust. Reconsider, for my righteousness is at stake.
ekegusii: Nabasoroire, irana, timobaisa gokora ing’ana rinde riibe. Bono irana naende, ekiagera ring’ana riane neri’oboronge.
swahili: Tulizeni hasira, msiwe wadhalimu; angalieni tena, kwa maana nimehatarisha uadilifu wangu.

english: For then it would outweigh the sand of the seas— no wonder my words have been rash.
ekegusii: Ebio nigo biare ebirito kobua omokenye ore ase enyancha; ase ayio nabeire omwango ase ogokwana ayio.
swahili: Kwa kuwa hakika ingekuwa nzito kuliko mchanga wa bahari zote, kwa hiyo si ajabu maneno yangu yamekuwa ya haraka.

english: Is there iniquity on my tongue? Can my mouth not discern malice?
ekegusii: Inee! Amang’ana aane ngokwana nay’oborimo? Inee! Tinkonyara gokwana inyatanane ayare amabe?
swahili: Je, pana uovu wowote midomoni mwangu? Je, kinywa changu hakiwezi kupambanua hila?

english: For the arrows of the Almighty have pierced me; my spirit drinks in their poison; the terrors of God are arrayed against me.
ekegusii: Nyasae Omonguru ombetire chinsara chiaye, na omoika one ong’usire obosongo bwabo; okogosa kwa Nyasae kwarobeire kondwania.
swahili: Mishale ya Mwenyezi iko ndani yangu, roho yangu inakunywa sumu yake; vitisho vya Mungu vimejipanga dhidi yangu.

english: Does a wild donkey bray over fresh grass, or an ox low over its fodder?
ekegusii: Inee! Etigere y’orosana nkwana ere, ekero egotakuna obonyansi? Gose eng’ombe nkwana ere, ekero egendererete korisia?
swahili: Je, punda-mwitu hulia akiwa na majani, au ngʼombe dume hulia akiwa na chakula?

english: Is tasteless food eaten without salt, or is there flavor in the white of an egg?
ekegusii: Onye endagera tebekiri omonyoo okoyiansia, neriegwe? Inee! Omochununu bwe rigena ri’engoko nobwate obwansu?
swahili: Je, chakula kisicho na ladha huliwa bila chumvi, au upo utamu katika ute mweupe wa yai?

english: My soul refuses to touch them; they are loathsome food to me.
ekegusii: Chindagera echio omoyo one ochiangire, chiabeire chindagera chikongechia.
swahili: Ninakataa kuvigusa; vyakula vya aina hii hunichukiza.

english: If only my request were granted and God would fulfill my hope:
ekegusii: Naki nanga yaba buya onye nanyora aya nkobooria, onye Nyasae nanchera aya nganetie!
swahili: “Laiti ningepata haja yangu, kwamba Mungu angenijalia hilo nililotarajia,

english: that God would be willing to crush me, to unleash His hand and cut me off!
ekegusii: Nigo nganetie Nyasae anche ang’ake ansegenye, arambore okoboko kwaye ang’ite nkwe!
swahili: kwamba Mungu angekuwa radhi kuniponda, kuuachia mkono wake na kunikatilia mbali!

english: “Is not man consigned to labor on earth? Are not his days like those of a hired hand?
ekegusii: “Ekero omonto are ase ense, nigo abwate obogima buna obw’oyokorwana esegi. Amatuko y’obogima bwaye nigo anga buna ay’omorikwa emeremo.
swahili: “Je, mwanadamu hana kazi ngumu duniani? Siku zake si kama zile za mtu aliyeajiriwa?

english: He never returns to his house; his place remembers him no more.
ekegusii: Oyio takoirana gocha mwaye, na aase aye taakomonyoora naende.
swahili: Kamwe harudi tena nyumbani mwake; wala mahali pake hapatamjua tena.

english: Therefore I will not restrain my mouth; I will speak in the anguish of my spirit; I will complain in the bitterness of my soul.
ekegusii: Ase ayio, tinkonyara gokira tinkwana, nimbe ngokwana emechando y’omoyo one na kwemurungania nobororo ase omoyo one.
swahili: “Kwa hiyo sitanyamaza; nitanena kutokana na maumivu makuu ya roho yangu, nitalalama kwa uchungu wa nafsi yangu.

english: Am I the sea, or the monster of the deep, that You must keep me under guard?
ekegusii: “Nase ki obegete oborendi igoro yane? Inche nenyancha inde, gose neng’iti enene mono ya nyancha?
swahili: Je, mimi ni bahari, au mnyama mkubwa mno akaaye vilindini, hata uniweke chini ya ulinzi?

english: When I think my bed will comfort me and my couch will ease my complaint,
ekegusii: Ekero nkorengereria ng’a oborere bwane mbonyare kondemia, na ebirengererio biane mbinyare gonkeaneria obororo bwane,
swahili: Ninapofikiri kwamba kitanda changu kitanifariji, nacho kiti changu cha fahari kitapunguza malalamiko yangu,

english: then You frighten me with dreams and terrify me with visions,
ekegusii: erio aye nigo okongosa ase ogontomera chindoto na kong’a obwoba goetera ase amaroro.
swahili: ndipo wanitisha kwa ndoto na kunitia hofu kwa maono,

english: so that I would prefer strangling and death over my life in this body.
ekegusii: Ase igo nachorire ng’a ng’entwe inkwe, ekiagera amakweri namaya kobua obororo bore ase omobere one.
swahili: hivyo ninachagua kujinyonga na kufa, kuliko huu mwili wangu.

english: I loathe my life! I would not live forever. Leave me alone, for my days are but a breath.
ekegusii: Nagechire obogima bwane; tinganeti kogenderera koba moyo. Takondosia namange; amatuko aane nigo are buna embeo bosa.
swahili: Ninayachukia maisha yangu; nisingetamani kuendelea kuishi. Niache; siku zangu ni ubatili.

english: What is man that You should exalt him, that You should set Your heart upon him,
ekegusii: “Inee! Omonto ninki aisaine, goika okomokora koba oyo bw’engencho enene, naende oba komorengereretie mono?
swahili: “Mwanadamu ni kitu gani hata umjali kiasi hiki, kwamba unamtia sana maanani,

english: that You attend to him every morning, and test him every moment?
ekegusii: Nigo okomorigereria kera emambia, naende nigo okomorenga kera engaki.
swahili: kwamba unamwangalia kila asubuhi na kumjaribu kila wakati?

english: Will You never look away from me, or leave me alone to swallow my spittle?
ekegusii: Inee! Nengaki eng’ana naki ogochia koba gokona‐kondigereria? Naki otagontiga, erinde inyore obosibore imere amate?
swahili: Je, hutaacha kamwe kunitazama, au kuniacha japo kwa kitambo kidogo tu?

english: Like a slave he longs for shade; like a hireling he waits for his wages.
ekegusii: Buna koreng’ana omosomba akogania anyore aase agokenderera, na buna koreng’ana omonto orikire emeremo akogania aegwe eng’eria yaye,
swahili: Kama mtumwa anavyovionea shauku vivuli vya jioni, au mtu aliyeajiriwa anavyoungojea mshahara wake,

english: If I have sinned, what have I done to You, O watcher of mankind? Why have You made me Your target, so that I am a burden to You?
ekegusii: Aye omorigereria bw’abaanto, onye ngokora ebibe, ninki nagokoreire? Nase ki gwankorire nabeire ekerenga kiao? Nase ki nabeire buna egurube endito asore?
swahili: Ikiwa nimetenda dhambi, nimekufanyia nini, Ewe mlinzi wa wanadamu? Kwa nini umeniweka niwe shabaha yako? Je, nimekuwa mzigo kwako?

english: Why do You not pardon my transgression and take away my iniquity? For soon I will lie down in the dust; You will seek me, but I will be no more.”
ekegusii: Nase ki otakonyabera ogosaria kwane, erinde otige ebibe biane kegima? Bono inche nkogenda inde korara ime ye riroba; aye nigo orabe gokondigia, korende tokonyora aande.”
swahili: Kwa nini husamehi makosa yangu na kuachilia dhambi zangu? Kwa kuwa hivi karibuni nitalala mavumbini; nawe utanitafuta, wala sitakuwepo.”

english: So I am allotted months of futility, and nights of misery are appointed me.
ekegusii: naboigo nainche ngendererete koba nobobe omotienyi ase omotienyi, na obotuko ase obotuko nigo inde ase emechando.
swahili: ndivyo nilivyogawiwa miezi ya ubatili, nami nimeandikiwa huzuni usiku hata usiku.

english: When I lie down I think: ‘When will I get up?’ But the night drags on, and I toss and turn until dawn.
ekegusii: Ekero nararire nigo nkobooria: Indi bogocha gokia mboke? Obotuko bwatambeire mono. Agwo naba nkona‐kweonchaonchora bokia goika mambia.
swahili: Wakati nilalapo ninawaza, ‘Itachukua muda gani kabla sijaamka?’ Usiku huwa mrefu, nami najigeuzageuza hadi mapambazuko.

english: My flesh is clothed with worms and encrusted with dirt; my skin is cracked and festering.
ekegusii: Amakonde ne riko biatubire omobere one; omobere one nigo okona‐gosaboka amasabo, erio otandoka, na obogundo bwaruao.
swahili: Mwili wangu umevikwa mabuu na uchafu, ngozi yangu imetumbuka na kutunga usaha. Ayubu Anamlilia Mungu

english: My days are swifter than a weaver’s shuttle; they come to an end without hope.
ekegusii: Amatuko ’obogima bwane nigo agoeta bwango kobua egekorero gi’okoroisia egetambaa, nigo akoera ntabwati gosemeria konde.
swahili: “Siku zangu zinapita upesi kuliko mtande wa kufuma, nazo zinafikia mwisho wake bila matumaini.

english: Remember that my life is but a breath. My eyes will never again see happiness.
ekegusii: “Manya ng’a obogima bwane nigo bore buna embeo bosa; amaiso aane takorora amaya naende.
swahili: Kumbuka, Ee Mungu, maisha yangu ni kama pumzi; macho yangu kamwe hayataona tena raha.

english: The eye that beholds me will no longer see me. You will look for me, but I will be no more.
ekegusii: Omonto ondoche bono takondora naende nonya ng’ake, bono aye nondoche, korende bwango nimbe tindio.
swahili: Lile jicho linaloniona sasa halitaniona tena; utanitafuta, wala sitakuwepo.

english: As a cloud vanishes and is gone, so he who goes down to Sheol does not come back up.
ekegusii: Buna koreng’ana riire rigokubakubana riasira, naboigo noyokogenda aase abakuure atakoirana korwao.
swahili: Kama vile wingu liondokavyo na kutoweka, vivyo hivyo yeye ashukaye kaburini harudi tena.

english: Then Bildad the Shuhite replied:
ekegusii: Erio Bilidadi Omosua akairaneria, akabora:
swahili: Kisha Bildadi Mshuhi akajibu:

english: Will they not teach you and tell you, and speak from their understanding?
ekegusii: Inee! Amang’ana ’obong’aini chisokoro chiria chiakwanete, takonyara gokworokereria, erinde bwegere?
swahili: Je, hawatakufundisha na kukueleza? Je, hawataleta maneno kutoka kwenye kufahamu kwao?

english: Does papyrus grow where there is no marsh? Do reeds flourish without water?
ekegusii: “Inee! Amauncho nanyare komera ase entente etari? Gose ebitonto nabimere ase amaache atari?
swahili: Je, mafunjo yaweza kumea mahali pasipo na matope? Matete yaweza kustawi bila maji?

english: While the shoots are still uncut, they dry up quicker than grass.
ekegusii: Ekero bigendererete gosicha, engaki y’okobitema etaraika, nigo birasusane bitige ebimeri binde.
swahili: Wakati bado yanaendelea kukua kabla ya kukatwa, hunyauka haraka kuliko majani mengine.

english: Such is the destiny of all who forget God; so the hope of the godless will perish.
ekegusii: Naboigo nabaanto bonsi abebire Nyasae bakoba, ogosemeria kw’omonto otamoirogeti Nyasae nagosire.
swahili: Huu ndio mwisho wa watu wote wanaomsahau Mungu; vivyo hivyo matumaini ya wasiomjali Mungu huangamia.

english: His confidence is fragile; his security is in a spider’s web.
ekegusii: Aya asemeretie nasirigwe kegima, na aya egenete nigo are buna enyomba y’oronyambobe.
swahili: Lile analolitumainia huvunjika upesi; lile analolitegemea ni utando wa buibui.

english: He leans on his web, but it gives way; he holds fast, but it does not endure.
ekegusii: Ere nigo agwesiirera ase enyomba yaye, korende tekogenderera gotenena, nigo ayesemeretie, korende tekogenderera kobao.
swahili: Huutegemea utando wake, lakini hausimami; huungʼangʼania, lakini haudumu.

english: He is a well-watered plant in the sunshine, spreading its shoots over the garden.
ekegusii: “Nabo akoreereta buna ekemeri kere ase omobaso, ekio gekoranda ase omogondo bwonsi;
swahili: Yeye ni kama mti ulionyeshewa vizuri wakati wa jua, ukieneza machipukizi yake bustanini;

english: His roots wrap around the rock heap; he looks for a home among the stones.
ekegusii: emeri yaye nigo egwesiserania ase etui y’amagena; buna eyekwemigereria ase egati y’amagena y’egetare.
swahili: huifunganisha mizizi yake kwenye lundo la mawe, na kutafuta nafasi katikati ya mawe.

english: If he is uprooted from his place, it will disown him, saying, ‘I never saw you.’
ekegusii: Geise gosirigwa korwa aase aye, aase aria nigo aragekanie ng’a tana gokerora.
swahili: Unapongʼolewa kutoka mahali pake, ndipo mahali pale huukana na kusema, ‘Mimi kamwe sikukuona.’

english: Surely this is the joy of his way; yet others will spring from the dust.
ekegusii: Ee, oyio noro omogooko ere abwate ase obogima bwaye, naende abande mbache babe ase ribaga riaye.
swahili: Hakika uhai wake hunyauka, na kutoka udongoni mimea mingine huota.

english: “How long will you go on saying such things? The words of your mouth are a blustering wind.
ekegusii: “Ngoika ririri orabe kogokwana amang’ana aya, na amang’ana ’omonwa oo abe buna omwaga omonene?
swahili: “Hata lini wewe utasema mambo kama haya? Maneno yako ni kama upepo mkuu.

english: Behold, God does not reject the blameless, nor will He strengthen the hand of evildoers.
ekegusii: “Rora, Nyasae takonyara kwanga na gotiga omonto omoikeranu; gose tagokonya abakori amabe.
swahili: “Hakika Mungu hamkatai mtu asiye na hatia, wala kuitia nguvu mikono ya mtenda mabaya.

english: He will yet fill your mouth with laughter, and your lips with a shout of joy.
ekegusii: Ekeene, nagoichorie namaseko, na omonwa oo otere nomochengo.
swahili: Bado atakijaza kinywa chako na kicheko, na midomo yako na kelele za shangwe.

english: Your enemies will be clothed in shame, and the tent of the wicked will be no more.”
ekegusii: Abanto abakogechete mbarenterwe obosooku, na obomenyo bw’abakori amabe tibokogenderera kobao.”
swahili: Adui zako watavikwa aibu, nazo hema za waovu hazitakuwepo tena.”

english: Does God pervert justice? Does the Almighty pervert what is right?
ekegusii: Inee! Nyasae nanyare koonchorana ekeene? Gose Omonguru naonchorane ayare ay’oboronge?
swahili: Je, Mungu hupotosha hukumu? Je, Mwenyezi hupotosha kile kilicho haki?

english: When your children sinned against Him, He gave them over to their rebellion.
ekegusii: Onye abana bao bakorete ebibe asare, ere obaeire egesusuro ase engencho y’okomocha kwabo.
swahili: Watoto wako walipomtenda dhambi, aliwapa adhabu ya dhambi yao.

english: But if you would earnestly seek God and ask the Almighty for mercy,
ekegusii: Korende aye korarigie Nyasae na gosaba ase oboitongo ase ere Omonyanguru,
swahili: Lakini ukimtafuta Mungu, nawe ukamsihi Mwenyezi,

english: if you are pure and upright, even now He will rouse Himself on your behalf and restore your righteous estate.
ekegusii: korabe oyochenegete na ore nenkoro endonge, ekeene, rirorio ere nagochandekere, nakoroiserie obomenyo, na oboronge bogenderere kobao.
swahili: ikiwa wewe ni safi na mnyofu, hata sasa atainuka mwenyewe kwa niaba yako, na kukurudisha katika mahali pako pa haki.

english: Though your beginnings were modest, your latter days will flourish.
ekegusii: Eki kwabwate ritang’ani kerorekane kere egeke, koreng’anigwa neki oramenterwe magega.
swahili: Ijapokuwa mwanzo wako ulikuwa mdogo, lakini mwisho wako utakuwa wa mafanikio.

english: Please inquire of past generations and consider the discoveries of their fathers.
ekegusii: “Korende boria omanye ay’ebigori bia kare, bweigwere aya chisokoro chiao chianyorete.
swahili: “Ukaulize vizazi vilivyotangulia na uone baba zao walijifunza nini,

english: For we were born yesterday and know nothing; our days on earth are but a shadow.
ekegusii: Intwe nigo tonga buna abaiborwa igoro totamanyeti kende, naki amatuko aito tomenyete ase ense nigo anga buna omorengari ogosira.
swahili: kwa kuwa sisi tumezaliwa jana tu na hatujui lolote, nazo siku zetu duniani ni kama kivuli tu.

english: He does great things beyond searching out, and wonders without number.
ekegusii: Nigo agokora amang’ana amanene aetanetie obomanyi bwonsi, na amakumia amange atari kobareka.
swahili: Hutenda maajabu yasiyopimika, miujiza isiyoweza kuhesabiwa.

english: Were He to pass by me, I would not see Him; were He to move, I would not recognize Him.
ekegusii: Rora! Ere nigo akong’ika ang’e oeta, tinkomoorora; nigo akong’etania, tinkomomanyereria.
swahili: Anapopita karibu nami, siwezi kumwona; apitapo mbele yangu, simtambui.

english: If He takes away, who can stop Him? Who dares to ask Him, ‘What are You doing?’
ekegusii: Ere nigo akoira eki aganetie. Ning’o oranyare komotanga? Ning’o oranyare komobooria ng’a ninki ekio agokora?
swahili: Anapochukua kwa ghafula, ni nani awezaye kumzuia? Ni nani awezaye kumwambia, ‘Unafanya nini?’

english: God does not restrain His anger; the helpers of Rahab cower beneath Him.
ekegusii: Nyasae tari gotigeria endamwamu yaye, abanto abagokonya Rahabu, nigo bagotung’ama inse asare baumama.
swahili: Mungu hataizuia hasira yake; hata jeshi kubwa la Rahabu lenye nguvu linajikunyata miguuni pake.

english: How then can I answer Him or choose my arguments against Him?
ekegusii: Naki rende ndakore imanye gochora amang’ana agwenerete, erinde inyare koiraneria Omonene.
swahili: “Ni vipi basi mimi nitaweza kubishana naye? Nawezaje kupata maneno ya kuhojiana naye?

english: For even if I were right, I could not answer. I could only beg my Judge for mercy.
ekegusii: Nonya inche nare koba tindi nokomocha, tinarenge komoiraneria; nigo narenge gosaba amaabera korwa ase omonsoeri.
swahili: Ingawa sikuwa na hatia, sikuweza kumjibu; ningeweza tu kumsihi Mhukumu wangu anihurumie.

english: If I summoned Him and He answered me, I do not believe He would listen to my voice.
ekegusii: Onye narenge komorangeria, na ere ang’itabere, rirorio tinarenge kwegena ng’a nategererete eriogi riane.
swahili: Hata kama ningemwita kwenye shauri, naye akakubali, siamini kama angenisikiliza.

english: For He would crush me with a tempest and multiply my wounds without cause.
ekegusii: Ere ong’akire nomwaga ore nomoubera, na omentire amaote aane ngencho ende etaiyo.
swahili: Yeye angeniangamiza kwa dhoruba na kuongeza majeraha yangu pasipo na sababu.

english: He does not let me catch my breath, but overwhelms me with bitterness.
ekegusii: Tang’eti ribaga nkoeyanera, korende omenteire obororo obonge mono.
swahili: Asingeniacha nipumue bali angenifunika kabisa na huzuni kuu.

english: If it is a matter of strength, He is indeed mighty! If it is a matter of justice, who can summon Him?
ekegusii: Onye namang’ana e chinguru, rora ere nigo are ne chinguru. Onye igoro y’oboronge, monto ki oranyare koamererania nere?
swahili: Kama ni suala la nguvu, yeye ni mwenye nguvu! Kama ni suala la haki, ni nani awezaye kumwita mahakamani?

english: “Yes, I know that it is so, but how can a mortal be righteous before God?
ekegusii: Ekeene, namanyire ng’a ayio nabo are, korende naki omonto aranyare koba omonyaboronge ase obosio bwa Nyasae?
swahili: “Naam, najua hili ni kweli. Lakini mwanadamu awezaje kuwa mwadilifu mbele za Mungu?

english: Even if I were righteous, my mouth would condemn me; if I were blameless, it would declare me guilty.
ekegusii: Nonya nare koba omonyaboronge, amang’ana ngokwana nigo are kongambia; nonya nare koba ng’a tindi na komocha, aya nigo are kombera kirori ng’a nomokori amabe inde.
swahili: Hata kama sikuwa na hatia, kinywa changu kingenihukumu; kama sikuwa na kosa, kingenitangaza kuwa mwenye hatia.

english: Though I am blameless, I have no concern for myself; I despise my own life.
ekegusii: Inche tindi na komocha. Tinyemanyeti; tinkobara obogima bwane ng’a negento.
swahili: “Ingawa mimi sina kosa, haileti tofauti katika nafsi yangu; nauchukia uhai wangu.

english: It is all the same, and so I say, ‘He destroys both the blameless and the wicked.’
ekegusii: Mang’ana taiyo. Ase ayio nigo ngoteeba: Ere nigo agosiria omonyaboronge na omokori amabe amo.
swahili: Hayo yote ni sawa; ndiyo sababu nasema, ‘Yeye huwaangamiza wasio na makosa pamoja na waovu.’

english: When the scourge brings sudden death, He mocks the despair of the innocent.
ekegusii: Ekero ebiku bikorenta amakweri a mobosokano, na abanto batari na komocha banyorwe namaakwa, ere nigo akobachecheria.
swahili: Wakati pigo liletapo kifo cha ghafula, yeye hudhihaki kule kukata tamaa kwa yule asiye na kosa.

english: The earth is given into the hand of the wicked; He blindfolds its judges. If it is not He, then who is it?
ekegusii: Ense nigo ebeekire inse y’amaboko ’abakori amabe, Nyasae otubire amasio ’abagaambi ebiina. Onye tari ere, ning’o rende okorire ayio?
swahili: Wakati nchi inapoangukia mikononi mwa waovu, yeye huwafunga macho mahakimu wake. Kama si yeye, basi ni nani?

english: My days are swifter than a runner; they flee without seeing good.
ekegusii: Amatuko aane nigo agoeta bwango kobua omominyoki okominyoka; nigo akoera bwango, tari korora maya ande.
swahili: “Siku zangu zapita mbio kuliko mkimbiaji; zinapita upesi bila kuona furaha hata kidogo.

english: They sweep by like boats of papyrus, like an eagle swooping down on its prey.
ekegusii: Ee, nigo agoeta bwango buna obwato obonyerere bw’ebirigisa, buna ensoti egotaboria ebiekoria biaye.
swahili: Zinapita upesi kama mashua ya mafunjo, mfano wa tai ayashukiaye mawindo kwa ghafula.

english: If I were to say, ‘I will forget my complaint and change my expression and smile,’
ekegusii: Inse goteeba ng’a nyebe ogwechanda kwane, na ntige omoichano one inyeremie,
swahili: Kama nikisema, ‘Nitayasahau malalamiko yangu, nitabadili sura ya uso wangu na kutabasamu,’

english: I would still dread all my sufferings; I know that You will not acquit me.
ekegusii: nigo ndabe nobwoba igoro y’emechando yane yonsi, ekiagera nimanyete ng’a aye goika ombare ng’a nomomochi inde.
swahili: bado ninahofia mateso yangu yote, kwa kuwa ninajua hutanihesabu kuwa sina hatia.

english: Since I am already found guilty, why should I labor in vain?
ekegusii: Inche goika mbarwe ng’a nomokori amabe inde. Nase ki rende ngwechanda nemeremo ere bosa?
swahili: Kwa kuwa nimeonekana mwenye hatia, kwa nini basi nitaabishwe bure?

english: If one wished to contend with God, he could not answer Him one time out of a thousand.
ekegusii: Omonene karaamereranie nomonto amang’ana elifu eyemo, omonto takonyara komoiraneria nonya nerimo.
swahili: Ingawa mtu angetaka kushindana naye, asingaliweza kumjibu Mungu hata mara moja miongoni mwa elfu moja.

english: If I should wash myself with snow and cleanse my hands with lye,
ekegusii: Ninsa gwesibia namaache arabete buna amagena ’embura, na goisaba nesabuni,
swahili: Hata kama ningejiosha kwa sabuni na kutakasa mikono yangu kwa magadi,

english: then You would plunge me into the pit, and even my own clothes would despise me.
ekegusii: nigo orantugute ime ase engoro, ne chianga chiane chigechigwe ase engencho yane.
swahili: wewe ungenitupa kwenye shimo la utelezi kiasi kwamba hata nguo zangu zingenichukia sana.

english: For He is not a man like me, that I can answer Him, that we can take each other to court.
ekegusii: Nyasae tari omonto buna inche, erinde imoiranerie, na ngende nere ase ekegambero.
swahili: “Yeye si mwanadamu kama mimi ili niweze kumjibu, ili kwamba tuweze kushindana naye mahakamani.

english: Nor is there a mediator between us, to lay his hand upon us both.
ekegusii: Monto onde tari orabe omogayani oito, oyio oratogambie inche nere.
swahili: Laiti angelikuwepo mtu wa kutupatanisha kati yetu, aweke mkono wake juu yetu sote wawili,

english: Let Him remove His rod from me, so that His terror will no longer frighten me.
ekegusii: Tiga ere arusie enyimbo yaye korwa ase ’nde; okogosa kwaye tikobaisa kong’ondokia.
swahili: mtu angeliiondoa fimbo ya Mungu juu yangu, ili utisho wake usiendelee kunitia hofu.

english: Then I would speak without fear of Him. But as it is, I am on my own.
ekegusii: Erio inyare gokwana ntari nobwoba ase engencho yaye, nimanyete ng’a tindi nokomocha.
swahili: Ndipo ningenena naye, bila kumwogopa, lakini kama ilivyo kwangu sasa, sitaweza.

english: God is wise in heart and mighty in strength. Who has resisted Him and prospered?
ekegusii: Omonene nigo are nobong’aini ase enkoro yaye, na omonyene chinguru, monto ki oratoorigwe onye takomoigwera?
swahili: Hekima yake ni kubwa sana na ana uwezo mwingi mno. Ni nani aliyempinga naye akawa salama?

english: He moves mountains without their knowledge and overturns them in His anger.
ekegusii: Ekero Omonene akoba nendamwamu nigo akoonchorana ebitunwa, obitigeria korwa aase abo, na abanto tibari komanya ayio.
swahili: Aiondoa milima bila yenyewe kujua na kuipindua kwa hasira yake.

english: He shakes the earth from its place, so that its foundations tremble.
ekegusii: Nigo agotengechia ense yarwa aase aye, erio chintenenero chiaye chianyegerigwa.
swahili: Aitikisa dunia kutoka mahali pake na kuzifanya nguzo zake zitetemeke.

english: He commands the sun not to shine; He seals off the stars.
ekegusii: Nigo agochika erioba tirigosoka; ne ching’enang’eni ochibeeka ekemanyererio.
swahili: Husema na jua, nalo likaacha kuangaza; naye huizima mianga ya nyota.

english: He alone stretches out the heavens and treads on the waves of the sea.
ekegusii: Nere bweka oramborete igoro chionsi, agachiaara, nere ogotaara igoro ase emerindo y’enyancha.
swahili: Yeye peke yake huzitandaza mbingu na kuyakanyaga mawimbi ya bahari.

english: He is the Maker of the Bear and Orion, of the Pleiades and the constellations of the south.
ekegusii: Nyasae nere otongete ching’enang’eni chia igoro Edubu. Orioni, boigo neching’enang’eni chiinde chikorokwa Abaiseke batano na babere bamwabo, boigo na Amakundia a Irianyi.
swahili: Yeye ndiye Muumba wa nyota za Dubu, na Orioni, Kilimia, na makundi ya nyota za kusini.

english: This is the word of the LORD that came to Joel son of Pethuel:
ekegusii: Eri nario ring’ana ri’Omonene riachete ase Yoel, mosinto o Petueli. Abanto bakoreera ogosirigwa kw’ebimeri
swahili: Neno la Bwana ambalo lilimjia Yoeli mwana wa Pethueli. Uvamizi Wa Nzige

english: The field is ruined; the land mourns. For the grain is destroyed, the new wine is dried up, and the oil fails.
ekegusii: Emegondo yatigaire bosa; riroba nigo rikorera ekiagera endagera yasirigwe, edivai tekobao na amaguta ’emezeituni akeeire kegima.
swahili: Mashamba yameharibiwa, ardhi imekauka; nafaka imeharibiwa, mvinyo mpya umekauka, mafuta yamekoma.

english: Be dismayed, O farmers, wail, O vinedressers, over the wheat and barley, because the harvest of the field has perished.
ekegusii: Inwe abaremi ichana na gosooka, nainwe abaroiseria b’emesabibu, rera, ekiagera engano na esairi biasirigwe amo nokwama gwonsi kw’emegondo.
swahili: Kateni tamaa, enyi wakulima, lieni, enyi mlimao mizabibu; huzunikeni kwa ajili ya ngano na shayiri, kwa sababu mavuno ya shambani yameharibiwa.

english: The grapevine is dried up, and the fig tree is withered; the pomegranate, palm, and apple— all the trees of the orchard—are withered. Surely the joy of mankind has dried up. A Call to Repentance (Amos 5:4–15; Zephaniah 2:1–3; Luke 13:1–5)
ekegusii: Emesabibu yomire, na emeko boigo. Emekomomanga, na emekendo, na emete y’amapera, ee, emete ende yonsi y’emegondo yomire. Ogochenga kwaerire ase egati y’abanto.
swahili: Mzabibu umekauka na mtini umenyauka; mkomamanga, mtende na mtofaa, miti yote shambani, imekauka. Hakika furaha yote ya mwanadamu imeondoka. Wito Wa Toba

english: Put on sackcloth and lament, O priests; wail, O ministers of the altar. Come, spend the night in sackcloth, O ministers of my God, because the grain and drink offerings are withheld from the house of your God.
ekegusii: Inwe abakuani, eboyie chigunia, morere, nainwe abakoreri b’egesasiimero, bokia amagombo! Eboyie chigunia, morere ase Hekalu ime ase obotuko bwonsi, ekiagera okoruegwa kw’endagera na ogw’ekenyugwa biaborire, ase enyomba ya Nyasae.
swahili: Vaeni nguo ya gunia, enyi makuhani, muomboleze; pigeni yowe, enyi mnaohudumu madhabahuni. Njooni, vaeni nguo ya gunia usiku kucha, enyi mnaohudumu mbele za Mungu wangu; kwa kuwa sadaka za nafaka na sadaka za kinywaji zimezuiliwa kufika katika nyumba ya Mungu wenu.

english: Consecrate a fast; proclaim a solemn assembly! Gather the elders and all the residents of the land to the house of the LORD your God, and cry out to the LORD.
ekegusii: Raria engaki y’okweng’ata; rangeria omosangererekano bw’ogosasiima! Sangereria abagaaka na abanto bonsi b’ense eye, bache ase enyomba y’Omonene, Nyasae oino, erinde morere ase Omonene.
swahili: Tangazeni saumu takatifu; liiteni kusanyiko takatifu. Iteni wazee na wote waishio katika nchi waende katika nyumba ya Bwana Mungu wenu, wakamlilie Bwana.

english: Alas for the day! For the Day of the LORD is near, and it will come as destruction from the Almighty.
ekegusii: Obobe nobwaito, ekiagera rituko ri’Omonene nigo rire ang’e, riraarente ogosirigwa korwa ase Omonguru.
swahili: Ole kwa siku hiyo! Kwa kuwa siku ya Bwana iko karibu; itakuja kama uharibifu kutoka kwa Mwenyezi.

english: Has not the food been cut off before our very eyes— joy and gladness from the house of our God?
ekegusii: Endagera yasiriigwe torigereretie na amaiso aito. Omogooko na amaseko arusiigwe korwa ase enyomba ya Nyasae.
swahili: Je, chakula hakikukatiliwa mbali mbele ya macho yetu: furaha na shangwe kutoka nyumba ya Mungu wetu?

english: The seeds lie shriveled beneath the clods; the storehouses are in ruins; the granaries are broken down, for the grain has withered away.
ekegusii: Chimbusuro chagundeire riroba ime; ebiage biatigaire bosa na ebigancha biasarekire, ekiagera endagera ekogachwa yaborire.
swahili: Mbegu zinakauka chini ya mabonge ya udongo. Ghala zimeachwa katika uharibifu, ghala za nafaka zimebomolewa, kwa maana hakuna nafaka.

english: How the cattle groan! The herds wander in confusion because they have no pasture. Even the flocks of sheep are suffering.
ekegusii: Rigereria chitugo buna chikwana chichandegete, amaicho e chiombe achandekire, ekiagera obonyansi bwaborire chikorisia, nonya namaicho e ching’ondi achandekire.
swahili: Jinsi gani ngʼombe wanavyolia! Makundi ya mifugo yanahangaika kwa sababu hawana malisho; hata makundi ya kondoo yanateseka.

english: To You, O LORD, I call, for fire has consumed the open pastures and flames have scorched all the trees of the field.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, inche nigo nkorera asore, ekiagera omorero bwomirie obonyansi ase ebitii, n’echimeme chi’omorero chiasiririe emete y’orosana.
swahili: Kwako, Ee Bwana, naita, kwa kuwa moto umeteketeza malisho ya mbugani na miali ya moto imeunguza miti yote shambani.

english: Hear this, O elders; and give ear, all who dwell in the land. Has anything like this ever happened in your days or in the days of your fathers?
ekegusii: Inwe abagaaka, igwa amang’ana aya! Inwe abanto bonsi abamomenyete ase ya Yuda, tegerera moigwe! Inee! Amang’ana buna aya anagokorekana ase amatuko aino, gose ase amatuko e chisokoro chiaino?
swahili: Sikilizeni hili, enyi wazee; sikilizeni, ninyi nyote mnaoishi katika nchi. Je, jambo kama hili lilishawahi kutokea katika siku zenu au katika siku za babu zenu?

english: Even the beasts of the field pant for You, for the streams of water have dried up, and fire has consumed the open pastures.
ekegusii: Nonya ne ching’iti chi’orosana nigo chikorera asore, ekiagera chindooche chiakamire, amaache taiyo, ee, omorero oria osambire amarisio ’erooro.
swahili: Hata wanyama wa porini wanakuonea shauku; vijito vya maji vimekauka, na moto umeteketeza malisho yote ya mbugani.

english: Tell it to your children; let your children tell it to their children, and their children to the next generation.
ekegusii: Yateebie abana baino amang’ana aya, na abana baino bayateebie abana babo, na abana babo bayateebie ekegori kende.
swahili: Waelezeni watoto wenu, na watoto wenu wawaambie watoto wao, na watoto wao kwa kizazi kitakachofuata.

english: What the devouring locust has left, the swarming locust has eaten; what the swarming locust has left, the young locust has eaten; and what the young locust has left, the destroying locust has eaten.
ekegusii: Ogosongerera ase obonge gw’echingige, chiagwereire ebimeri, biria chinyanchaba chiatigaretie, chingige chikayeria, na eye chingige chiatigaretie, ebisase bikayeria, na eye ebisase biatigaretie, chingeeti chikayeria.
swahili: Kilichosazwa na kundi la tunutu nzige wakubwa wamekula, kilichosazwa na nzige wakubwa parare wamekula, kilichosazwa na parare madumadu wamekula.

english: Wake up, you drunkards, and weep; wail, all you drinkers of wine, because of the sweet wine, for it has been cut off from your mouth.
ekegusii: Inwe abamwatindire nebinyugwa ebiroro, boka morere! Inwe mwensi aba mokonywa edivai, bokia amagombo, ase engencho amasabibu onsi y’okoroisia edivai enyia, asarigwe.
swahili: Amkeni, enyi walevi, mlie! Pigeni yowe enyi wanywaji wote wa mvinyo, pigeni yowe kwa sababu ya mvinyo mpya, kwa kuwa mmenyangʼanywa kutoka midomoni mwenu.

english: For a nation has invaded My land, powerful and without number; its teeth are the teeth of a lion, and its fangs are the fangs of a lioness.
ekegusii: Risaga ri’echingige chinyinge riaumokeire ense yaito, nigo rire n’echinguru chi’ogokumia na nigo rire rinene mono; amaino aye nigo agwekaine ay’Endo, na amagegu aye nigo anga buna ay’endo eaberi.
swahili: Taifa limevamia nchi yangu, lenye nguvu tena lisilo na idadi; lina meno ya simba, magego ya simba jike.

english: It has laid waste My grapevine and splintered My fig tree. It has stripped off the bark and thrown it away; the branches have turned white. A Call to Mourning
ekegusii: Giasaririe emesabibu yaito, kiabunire emeko yaito; kiayesaboire, na gotuguta amasabo inse, ne chinsagia chi’emete eyio chiarabire se.
swahili: Limeharibu mizabibu yangu na kuangamiza mitini yangu. Limebambua magome yake na kuyatupilia mbali, likayaacha matawi yake yakiwa meupe.

english: Wail like a virgin dressed in sackcloth, grieving for the husband of her youth.
ekegusii: Rera na kobokia amagombo buna omoiseke omwekungi obegete chianga chi’echigunia, okwereirwe nomosaacha bw’oboke bwaye.
swahili: Omboleza kama bikira aliyevaa nguo ya gunia anayehuzunika kwa ajili ya mume wa ujana wake.

english: Grain and drink offerings have been cut off from the house of the LORD; the priests are in mourning, those who minister before the LORD.
ekegusii: Okoruegwa kw’endagera na ogw’ekenyugwa biatangirwe, tibirentwa ase enyomba y’Omonene. Abakuani abare abakoreri b’Omonene nigo bakorera.
swahili: Sadaka za nafaka na sadaka za kinywaji zimekatiliwa mbali kutoka nyumba ya Bwana. Makuhani wanaomboleza, wale wanaohudumu mbele za Bwana.

english: Blow the ram’s horn in Zion; sound the alarm on My holy mountain! Let all who dwell in the land tremble, for the Day of the LORD is coming; indeed, it is near—
ekegusii: Bugia egetureeri ase Sayoni, ee, bugia egetureeri ki’ogotabobora ase egetunwa egechenu. Tiga abanto bonsi ba Yuda baiguswe, ekiagera rituko ri’Omonene ngocha rire; nigo rire ang’e.
swahili: Pigeni tarumbeta katika Sayuni; pigeni mbiu katika mlima wangu mtakatifu. Wote waishio katika nchi na watetemeke, kwa kuwa siku ya Bwana inakuja. Iko karibu,

english: Before them the earth quakes; the heavens tremble. The sun and moon grow dark, and the stars lose their brightness.
ekegusii: Ense nigo egotengecha bosio bwabo, na igoro yanyegerigwa. Erioba na omotienyi nabibekwe omosunte; ne ching’enang’eni tichikobara.
swahili: Mbele yao dunia inatikisika, anga linatetemeka, jua na mwezi vinatiwa giza, na nyota hazitoi mwanga wake tena.

english: The LORD raises His voice in the presence of His army. Indeed, His camp is very large, for mighty are those who obey His command. For the Day of the LORD is great and very dreadful. Who can endure it? Return with All Your Heart
ekegusii: Eriogi ri’Omonene nigo rikoigugwa bosio bw’omoganda oye bw’esegi, ekiagera omoganda oye bw’esegi oyio okomoigwera nigo ore omonene mono; Rituko ri’Omonene nigo rire eri’okoirokia. Ning’o oranyare koriremereria? Okorangerigwa kw’ogoonchoka
swahili: Bwana anatoa mshindo wa ngurumo mbele ya jeshi lake; majeshi yake hayana idadi, ni wenye nguvu nyingi wale ambao hutii agizo lake. Siku ya Bwana ni kuu, ni ya kutisha. Ni nani anayeweza kuistahimili? Rarueni Mioyo Yenu

english: “Yet even now,” declares the LORD, “return to Me with all your heart, with fasting, weeping, and mourning.”
ekegusii: Omonene oteebire, “Nonya mbono ng’iranere ne chinkoro chiaino chionsi, ase okweng’ata, na okorera, na okweng’ereria.
swahili: “Hata sasa,” asema Bwana, “nirudieni kwa mioyo yenu yote, kwa kufunga, kwa kulia na kuomboleza.”

english: So rend your hearts and not your garments, and return to the LORD your God. For He is gracious and compassionate, slow to anger, abounding in loving devotion. And He relents from sending disaster.
ekegusii: Tandora chinkoro chiaino ase ogweitia, gose tari ogotandora chianga chiaino.” Irana gochia ase Omonene, Nyasae oino, ekiagera ere nomuya na omonyamaabera; ere tari omwango ase okoba nendamwamu; obwanchani bwaye nobwa botambe, nigo akoonchoka otiga kobarentera amabe.
swahili: Rarueni mioyo yenu na siyo mavazi yenu. Mrudieni Bwana, Mungu wenu, kwa maana yeye ndiye mwenye neema na mwingi wa huruma, si mwepesi wa hasira, ni mwingi wa upendo, huona huruma, hujizuia kuleta maafa.

english: Who knows? He may turn and relent and leave a blessing behind Him— grain and drink offerings for the LORD your God.
ekegusii: Ning’o omanyete, ande gose Omonene naonchoke atige kobarentera amabe, korende abatigere ogosesenigwa, erinde moruere Omonene, Nyasae oino, okoruegwa kw’endagera, na ogw’ekenyugwa?
swahili: Ni nani ajuaye? Yeye aweza kugeuka na kuwa na huruma na kuacha baraka nyuma yake: sadaka za nafaka na sadaka za vinywaji kwa ajili ya Bwana Mungu wenu.

english: Blow the ram’s horn in Zion, consecrate a fast, proclaim a sacred assembly.
ekegusii: Bugia egetureeri ase Sayoni; raria engaki y’okweng’ata, rangeria omosangererekano bw’ogosasiima!
swahili: Pigeni tarumbeta katika Sayuni, tangazeni saumu takatifu, liiteni kusanyiko takatifu.

english: Gather the people, sanctify the congregation, assemble the aged, gather the children, even those nursing at the breast. Let the bridegroom leave his room, and the bride her chamber.
ekegusii: Sangereria abanto amo, ochene omosangererekano oyio; sangereria abagaaka, sangereria nabana, nonya nabakogonka. Tiga nonya mbaria banyuomanire bwango iga basoke korwa mwabo,
swahili: Wakusanyeni watu, wekeni wakfu kusanyiko; waleteni pamoja wazee, wakusanyeni watoto, wale wanyonyao maziwa. Bwana arusi na atoke chumbani mwake na bibi arusi naye atoke katika chumba chake.

english: Let the priests who minister before the LORD weep between the portico and the altar, saying, “Spare Your people, O LORD, and do not make Your heritage a reproach, an object of scorn among the nations. Why should they say among the peoples, ‘Where is their God?’” Restoration Promised
ekegusii: Abakuani abwo bakomokorera Omonene tiga barere ase egati y’egesona na egesasiimero, bakwane iga, “Aye Omonene, rorera abanto bao amaabera; totiga abanto abwo bare omwando oo bachecherigwe, bakwanwe bobe ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku. Nase ki abanto baraborie: Ng’ai Nyasae obo are”? Nyasae okoirania obotobu ase ense
swahili: Makuhani, ambao wanahudumu mbele za Bwana, na walie katikati ya ukumbi wa Hekalu na madhabahu. Waseme, “Wahurumie watu wako, Ee Bwana. Usifanye urithi wako kitu cha kudharauliwa, neno la dhihaka kati ya mataifa. Kwa nini wasemezane miongoni mwao, ‘Yuko wapi Mungu wao?’ ” Jibu La Bwana

english: Then the LORD became jealous for His land, and He spared His people.
ekegusii: Erio Omonene akaba ne risemi ase engencho y’ense yaye, akarorera abanto baye amabeebe.
swahili: Kisha Bwana atakuwa na wivu kwa ajili ya nchi yake na kuwa na huruma juu ya watu wake.

english: And the LORD answered His people: “Behold, I will send you grain, new wine, and oil, and by them you will be satisfied. I will never again make you a reproach among the nations.
ekegusii: Omonene akairaneria abanto baye, akabateebia, Rora, nkobatomera nde endagera, na edivai, na amaguta, na inwe namoisaneke; tinkobatiga mogenderere gochaywa ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku.
swahili: Bwana atawajibu: “Ninawapelekea nafaka, mvinyo mpya na mafuta, vya kuwatosha ninyi hadi mridhike kabisa; kamwe sitawafanya tena kitu cha kudharauliwa na mataifa.

english: a day of darkness and gloom, a day of clouds and blackness. Like the dawn overspreading the mountains a great and strong army appears, such as never was of old, nor will ever be in ages to come.
ekegusii: Nigo rirabe rituko ri’omosunte na eri’amataturi, rituko ri’amare na omosunte ekerima. Omoganda omonene bw’echingige nochiche, nigo orarande buna omosunte igoro ase ebitunwa. Omogwekano bw’amang’ana ayio tana koba korwa kare, gose takoba nonya ng’ake ase ebigori bigochi‐gocha.
swahili: siku ya giza na huzuni, siku ya mawingu na utusitusi. Kama mapambazuko yasambaavyo toka upande huu wa milima hata upande mwingine jeshi kubwa na lenye nguvu linakuja. Jambo kama hili halijakuwepo tangu zamani wala halitakuwepo tena kamwe kwa vizazi vijavyo.

english: The northern army I will drive away from you, banishing it to a barren and desolate land, its front ranks into the Eastern Sea, and its rear guard into the Western Sea. And its stench will rise; its foul odor will ascend. For He has done great things.
ekegusii: Ninserie omoganda bw’echingige okorwa sugusu orue ase more, obeere are korwa ase more, ninyoserie ogende ase ense enyomo ere bosa, ensemo etang’aine egende gochia ase Enyancha y’omonyo, na ensemo ekorwa magega egende gochia ase Enyancha ya Mediterania. Ogotioka kw’ebitondo biabo nkoimokerere igoro, ekiagera okorire ayare amanene mono.
swahili: “Nitafukuza jeshi la kaskazini likae mbali nanyi, nikilisukuma ndani ya jangwa, askari wa safu za mbele wakienda ndani ya bahari ya mashariki na wale wa safu za nyuma katika bahari ya magharibi. Uvundo wake utapaa juu; harufu yake itapanda juu.” Hakika ametenda mambo makubwa.

english: Do not be afraid, O land; rejoice and be glad, for the LORD has done great things.
ekegusii: Aye ense, toiroka! Korende goka na gochenga, ekiagera Omonene okorire ayare amanene.
swahili: Usiogope, ee nchi; furahi na kushangilia. Hakika Bwana ametenda mambo makubwa.

english: Do not be afraid, O beasts of the field, for the open pastures have turned green, the trees bear their fruit, and the fig tree and vine yield their best.
ekegusii: Inwe ching’iti chi’orosana, timoiroka, ekiagera amarisio are ase erooro amerire obonyansi; emete yamire amatunda, emeko na emesabibu yamire okwama kwabo okonene.
swahili: Msiogope, enyi wanyama pori, kwa kuwa mbuga za malisho yenu zinarudia ubichi. Miti nayo inazaa matunda, mtini na mzabibu inatoa utajiri wake.

english: Be glad, O children of Zion, and rejoice in the LORD your God, for He has given you the autumn rains for your vindication. He sends you showers, both autumn and spring rains, as before.
ekegusii: Inwe abanto ba Sayoni, goka, mochenge ase ay’Omonene, Nyasae oino abakoreire, ekiagera obaeire embura entang’ani ebaisaine; nere okobatweria embura botambe, eye ritang’ani na ey’okwamia endagera.
swahili: Furahini, enyi watu wa Sayuni, shangilieni katika Bwana Mungu wenu, kwa kuwa amewapa mvua za vuli kwa kipimo cha haki. Anawapelekea mvua nyingi, mvua ya vuli na ya masika, kama mwanzoni.

english: The threshing floors will be full of grain, and the vats will overflow with new wine and oil.
ekegusii: Ebiooreri bikoorerwa mbiichorwe ne chindagera; na ebimitero mbiichore nedivai na amaguta goika biiteke.
swahili: Sakafu za kupuria zitajaa nafaka, mapipa yatafurika mvinyo mpya na mafuta.

english: I will repay you for the years eaten by locusts— the swarming locust, the young locust, the destroying locust, and the devouring locust — My great army that I sent against you.
ekegusii: Nimbairanerie ebi’emiaka eria biasaretigwe, ne chingige, na ebisase, ne chingeeti, omoganda oyio omonene natomete gocha ase egati yaino.
swahili: “Nitawalipa kwa ajili ya miaka ile iliyoliwa na nzige: parare, madumadu na tunutu, jeshi langu kubwa ambalo nililituma katikati yenu.

english: You will have plenty to eat, until you are satisfied. You will praise the name of the LORD your God, who has worked wonders for you. My people will never again be put to shame.
ekegusii: Bono monyore endagera enyinge mokoria moigote, erio motogie erieta ri’Omonene, Nyasae oino, oyio obakoreire amakumia. Abanto baane tibagochaywa naende.
swahili: Mtakuwa na wingi wa vyakula mpaka mshibe, na mtalisifu jina la Bwana Mungu wenu, ambaye amefanya maajabu kwa ajili yenu; kamwe watu wangu hawataaibishwa tena.

english: Then you will know that I am present in Israel and that I am the LORD your God, and there is no other. My people will never again be put to shame. I Will Pour Out My Spirit (Acts 2:14–36)
ekegusii: Erio namomanye ng’a inche nigo inde ase egati yaino inwe Abaisraeli, naende ng’a inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino, naende Nyasae onde omoao tari. Abanto baane tibagochaywa naende. Rituko ri’Omonene
swahili: Ndipo mtakapojua kwamba mimi niko katika Israeli kwamba mimi ndimi Bwana Mungu wenu, na kwamba hakuna mwingine; kamwe watu wangu hawataaibika tena. Siku Ya Bwana

english: And afterward, I will pour out My Spirit on all people. Your sons and daughters will prophesy, your old men will dream dreams, your young men will see visions.
ekegusii: Nebe ase amatuko agochi‐gocha, nimbaiterere abanto bonsi Omoika one; abana baino, abamura na abaiseke, inabaabaane, na abagaaka baino nabarote chindoto, na abamura baino nabarore amaroro.
swahili: “Hata itakuwa, baada ya hayo, nitamimina Roho wangu juu ya wote wenye mwili. Wana wenu na binti zenu watatabiri, wazee wenu wataota ndoto, na vijana wenu wataona maono.

english: Even on My menservants and maidservants, I will pour out My Spirit in those days.
ekegusii: Naboigo ase amatuko ayio nimbaiterere abasomba baane, abasacha na abakungu, Omoika one.
swahili: Hata juu ya watumishi wangu, wanaume kwa wanawake, katika siku zile nitamimina Roho wangu.

english: Before them a fire devours, and behind them a flame scorches. The land before them is like the Garden of Eden, but behind them, it is like a desert wasteland— surely nothing will escape them.
ekegusii: Buna koreng’ana omorero ogosamba noboigo omoganda oyio ogosaria kera egento kere bosio bwaye, na magega gotiga kera egento gekoyia; ekero chitaraeta, ense eyio nigo enga buna omogondo o Eden, korende ekero chiaetire yatigara erooro bosa ase echio kende tikeri kerachitamboke.
swahili: Mbele yao moto unateketeza, nyuma yao miali ya moto inawaka kwa nguvu. Mbele yao nchi iko kama bustani ya Edeni, nyuma yao ni jangwa lisilofaa: hakuna kitu kinachowaepuka.

english: I will show wonders in the heavens and on the earth, blood and fire and columns of smoke.
ekegusii: Ning’orokie ebikone igoro na ase ense; amanyinga, na omorero, ne rikundesi ri’erioki.
swahili: Nami nitaonyesha maajabu katika mbingu na duniani: damu, moto na mawimbi ya moshi.

english: The sun will be turned to darkness and the moon to blood before the coming of the great and awesome Day of the LORD.
ekegusii: Erioba narionchoke ribe omosunte, na omotienyi noonchoke obe buna amanyiga, ekero rituko riria ri’Omonene, erire rinene, na eri’okoondokia, ritaracha.
swahili: Jua litageuzwa kuwa giza na mwezi kuwa mwekundu kama damu, kabla ya kuja siku ya Bwana ile kuu na ya kutisha.

english: And everyone who calls on the name of the LORD will be saved; for on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem there will be deliverance, as the LORD has promised, among the remnant called by the LORD.
ekegusii: Naende nebe ng’a kera oyorarangerie erieta ri’Omonene natoorigwe, ekiagera ase egetunwa gia Sayoni, na ime ya Yerusalemu, mbabe aroro abanto baratooreke, buna Omonene atebiire, na ase egati y’abwo baratigare nigo barabe abwo Omonene achorire.
swahili: Na kila mtu atakayeliitia jina la Bwana ataokolewa. Kwa maana juu ya Mlima Sayuni na katika Yerusalemu kutakuwepo wokovu, kama Bwana alivyosema, miongoni mwa walionusurika ambao Bwana awaita.

english: Their appearance is like that of horses, and they gallop like swift steeds.
ekegusii: Okororekana kwabo nigo konga buna ogwe chibarasi; nigo chikominyoka buna chibarasi chi’okorwana esegi.
swahili: Wanaonekana kama farasi; wanakwenda mbio kama askari wapanda farasi.

english: With a sound like that of chariots they bound over the mountaintops, like the crackling of fire consuming stubble, like a mighty army deployed for battle.
ekegusii: Ekero chigoeta igoro ase ebitunwa, ebititiro biabo nigo binga buna ebie chigari, naende nigo binga buna ogotoreka kw’omorero ogosamba amasakwe; chirochio nigo chire buna abasikari bare ne chinguru baroberigwe.
swahili: Wanatoa sauti kama magari ya vita, wanaporukaruka juu ya vilele vya milima, kama mlio wa miali ya moto ilayo mabua, kama jeshi kubwa lililojipanga kwa ajili ya vita.

english: Nations writhe in horror before them; every face turns pale.
ekegusii: Ekero chigocha abanto nigo bagoichorwa nobwoba, amaiso ’abaanto bonsi nigo akoonchoka arachoka.
swahili: Wanapoonekana, mataifa yanakuwa katika maumivu makuu; kila uso unabadilika rangi.

english: They charge like mighty men; they scale the walls like men of war. Each one marches in formation, not swerving from the course.
ekegusii: Nigo chikominyoka gochia korwana esegi buna abasikari chituoni; nigo chikoriina chindwaki igoro buna abasikari. Kera eyemo nigo eragenderere gochia bosio, ende teri eragobere esire enchera ebwatetie.
swahili: Wanashambulia kama wapiganaji wa vita; wanapanda kuta kama askari. Wote wanatembea katika safu, hawapotoshi safu zao.

english: They do not jostle one another; each proceeds in his path. They burst through the defenses, never breaking ranks.
ekegusii: Tichikomigererania, kera eyemo nigo egoeta omong’ororia oye; nigo chigoeta gati‐gati y’ebirwanero, tichigotangeka.
swahili: Hakuna anayemsukuma mwenzake; kila mmoja anakwenda mbele moja kwa moja. Wanapita katika vizuizi bila kuharibu safu zao.

english: They storm the city; they run along the wall; they climb into houses, entering through windows like thieves.
ekegusii: Nigo chikorindokera omochie, na kominyoka ase chindwaki igoro; nigo chikoriina ase chinyomba chisoa ime na chietera ase chitirisa buna abaibi.
swahili: Wanaenda kasi kuingia mjini; wanakimbia ukutani. Wanaingia ndani ya nyumba; kwa kuingilia madirishani kama wevi.

english: “Yes, in those days and at that time, when I restore Judah and Jerusalem from captivity,
ekegusii: “Rora, ase amatuko ayio, na ase engaki eyio, inche Omonene ning’iranerie Abayuda, na abanto ba Yerusalemu, bare ase obosomba, amaya abo.
swahili: “Katika siku hizo na wakati huo, nitakaporejesha neema ya Yuda na Yerusalemu,

english: Beat your plowshares into swords and your pruning hooks into spears. Let the weak say, ‘I am strong!’
ekegusii: Tura amakombe aino abe emioro, na emeyio yaino chinkuro ebe amatimo! Tiga oyore omworo atebe, “Nainche nigo inde etuoni.”
swahili: Majembe yenu yafueni yawe panga na miundu yenu ya kukatia iwe mikuki. Aliye dhaifu na aseme, “Mimi nina nguvu!”

english: Come quickly, all you surrounding nations, and gather yourselves. Bring down Your mighty ones, O LORD.
ekegusii: Inwe abanto b’ebisaku momenyete ase chinsemo chionsi, ayerera bwango mooche, sangererekana amo agwo ase rikura. Aye Omonene, renta abarwani bao b’esegi babaumokere!
swahili: Njooni haraka, ninyi mataifa yote kutoka pande zote, kusanyikeni huko. Shusha wapiganaji wako, Ee Bwana!

english: Let the nations be roused and advance to the Valley of Jehoshaphat, for there I will sit down to judge all the nations on every side.
ekegusii: Tiga abanto b’ebisaku baseegetane, bache ase Rikura ri’ekiina ria Yehosafati. Aroro agwo nao ndanachere abanto b’ebisaku bionsi baabaetanaine ekiina.
swahili: “Mataifa na yaamshwe; na yasonge mbele kuelekea Bonde la Yehoshafati, kwa kuwa nitaketi mahali pale kuhukumu mataifa yote yaliyoko kila upande.

english: Swing the sickle, for the harvest is ripe. Come, trample the grapes, for the winepress is full; the wine vats overflow because their wickedness is great.
ekegusii: Ekiagera obobe bwabo bwabeire obonene, soyia emeyio chinkuro mogondo, mobagese, ekiagera rigesa riaikire. Soa ime mobatindache, buna ekemitero gi’edivai giaichoire. Chinyongo chiaichoire na goiteka
swahili: Tia mundu, kwa kuwa mavuno yamekomaa. Njooni, mkanyage zabibu, kwa kuwa shinikizo la kukamua zabibu limejaa na mapipa yanafurika: kwa kuwa uovu wao ni mkubwa!”

english: Multitudes, multitudes in the valley of decision! For the Day of the LORD is near in the valley of decision.
ekegusii: Emeganda na emeganda nigo ere ase Rikura ri’ekiina, ekiagera agwo ase Rikura ri’ekiina nao rituko ri’Omonene rirache bwango.
swahili: Umati mkubwa, umati mkubwa katika bonde la uamuzi! Kwa kuwa siku ya Bwana ni karibu katika bonde la uamuzi.

english: The sun and moon will grow dark, and the stars will no longer shine.
ekegusii: Erioba na omotienyi mbibekwe omosunte, ne ching’enang’eni tichikobara. Nyasae nasesenie abanto baye
swahili: Jua na mwezi vitatiwa giza, na nyota hazitatoa mwanga wake tena.

english: The LORD will roar from Zion and raise His voice from Jerusalem; heaven and earth will tremble. But the LORD will be a refuge for His people, a stronghold for the people of Israel. Blessings for God’s People
ekegusii: Omonene narume korwa Sayoni, aake eriogi riaye korwa Yerusalemu; igoro na ense nchitengechigwe. Korende Omonene nabe obotamero bw’abaanto baye, na eburi enkong’u y’Abaisraeli.
swahili: Bwana atanguruma kutoka Sayuni na mshindo wa ngurumo kutoka Yerusalemu; dunia na mbingu vitatikisika. Lakini Bwana atakuwa kimbilio la watu wake, ngome imara kwa ajili ya watu wa Israeli. Baraka Kwa Watu Wa Mungu

english: Then you will know that I am the LORD your God, who dwells in Zion, My holy mountain. Jerusalem will be holy, never again to be overrun by foreigners.
ekegusii: “Erio namomanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino, imenyete Sayoni, egetunwa kiane egechenu. Yerusalemu nobe omochie omochenu, na abanto b’ebisaku ebigeni tibagosoa aroro nonya ng’ake.
swahili: “Ndipo mtakapojua kwamba Mimi, Bwana Mungu wenu, nakaa Sayuni, mlima wangu mtakatifu. Yerusalemu utakuwa mtakatifu; kamwe wageni hawatavamia tena.

english: And in that day the mountains will drip with sweet wine, and the hills will flow with milk. All the streams of Judah will run with water, and a spring will flow from the house of the LORD to water the Valley of Acacias.
ekegusii: “Ase rituko erio ebitunwa mbitonyie edivai enyansu, na ebigoro mbiichore amabeere, ne chindooche chionsi chi’Abayuda nachiichorwe namaache. Ensoko netuboke korwa ase enyomba y’Omonene, enyiyie ense omweya ya Sitimu.
swahili: “Katika siku hiyo milima itadondosha divai mpya, na vilima vitatiririka maziwa; mabonde yote ya Yuda yatatiririka maji. Chemchemi itatiririka kutoka kwenye nyumba ya Bwana na kunywesha Bonde la Shitimu.

english: Egypt will become desolate, and Edom a desert wasteland, because of the violence done to the people of Judah, in whose land they shed innocent blood.
ekegusii: “Ense ya Misiri nesarigwe ebe bosa, na Edomu nero nebe erooro ere bosa, ekiagera abanto b’aroro mbakorerete Abayuda amabe; nigo baiterete ase ense yabo amanyinga ’abaanto batarenge na komocha.
swahili: Lakini Misri itakuwa ukiwa, Edomu itakuwa jangwa tupu, kwa sababu ya jeuri waliofanya kwa watu wa Yuda, ambao katika nchi yao walimwaga damu isiyo na hatia.

english: I will gather all the nations and bring them down to the Valley of Jehoshaphat. There I will enter into judgment against them concerning My people, My inheritance, Israel, whom they have scattered among the nations as they divided up My land.
ekegusii: Ninsangererie abanto b’ebisaku bionsi, mbatirimbokie gochia ase Rikura ri’ekegambero ria Jehoshaphat; aroro agwo nimbanachere ekiina, ase onsi eria bakorerete abanto bane. Ekiagera mbasiarerete Abaisraeli, gochia ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku, naende baatananire ense yane Israeli.
swahili: nitayakusanya mataifa yote na kuyaleta katika Bonde la Yehoshafati Hapo nitaingia kwenye hukumu dhidi yao kuhusu urithi wangu, watu wangu Israeli, kwa kuwa waliwatawanya watu wangu miongoni mwa mataifa na kuigawa nchi yangu.

english: But Judah will be inhabited forever, and Jerusalem from generation to generation.
ekegusii: Korende ense y’Abayuda nemenywe kare na kare, na Yerusalemu boigo, ekiaare ase ekiaare.
swahili: Yuda itakaliwa na watu milele na Yerusalemu itadumu vizazi vyote.

english: For I will avenge their blood, which I have not yet avenged. ” For the LORD dwells in Zion.
ekegusii: Nimbae egesusuro baria baiterete amanyinga y’abanto ba Yuda gose tinkobatigera abamochi. Inche Omonene Nyasae nigo ngendererete komenya Sayoni.”
swahili: Hatia yao ya damu, ambayo sijasamehe, nitasamehe.” Bwana anakaa Sayuni!

english: They cast lots for My people; they bartered a boy for a prostitute and sold a girl for wine to drink.
ekegusii: Baakeire abanto baane obomera, erio korigia ning’o okoira abooswa baoonirie abana abamura, erinde banyore abakungu abatayayi, na baoonirie abana abaiseke, erinde banyore edivai bakonywa.
swahili: Wanawapigia kura watu wangu na kuwauza wavulana ili kupata makahaba; waliwauza wasichana ili wapate kunywa mvinyo.

english: Now what do you have against Me, O Tyre, Sidon, and all the regions of Philistia? Are you rendering against Me a recompense? If you retaliate against Me, I will swiftly and speedily return your recompense upon your heads.
ekegusii: “Inwe Turo na Sidoni, ne chingongo chionsi chi’Abafilisti, ngento ki mogonkorera? Inee! Nigo moganetie kong’iraneria egento? Moise korusia egesiomba igoro yane, nimbairanerie ogokora kwaino kobe igoro yaino bwango mono.
swahili: “Sasa una nini dhidi yangu, ee Tiro na Sidoni, nanyi nchi zote za Ufilisti? Je, mnanilipiza kwa yale niliyoyafanya? Kama mnalipa, mimi nitalipiza juu ya vichwa vyenu kwa kasi na kwa haraka yale mliyoyatenda.

english: For you took My silver and gold and carried off My finest treasures to your temples.
ekegusii: Inwe mwaimokirie chifeta ne chitaabu chiane, na mwairire ebinto biane ebiya bingwenerete gochia ase chikalu chiaino.
swahili: Kwa kuwa mlichukua fedha na dhahabu yangu pia mkabeba hazina zangu nzuri sana mkapeleka kwenye mahekalu yenu.

english: You sold the people of Judah and Jerusalem to the Greeks, to send them far from their homeland.
ekegusii: Mwarusirie Abayuda na abanto ba Yerusalemu korwa ase chingongo chiabo, mwabaoonirie ase Abagiriki.
swahili: Mliwauza watu wa Yuda na Yerusalemu kwa Wayunani, ili kwamba mpate kuwapeleka mbali na nchi yao.

english: Behold, I will rouse them from the places to which you sold them; I will return your recompense upon your heads.
ekegusii: Korende bono nimbarangerie barue aase aria mwabaoonetie gochia, erinde mbairanerie inwe ogokora kwaino kobe igoro yaino.
swahili: “Tazama nitawaamsha kutoka zile sehemu mlizowauza, nami nitawalipiza juu ya vichwa vyenu kile mlichofanya.

english: I will sell your sons and daughters into the hands of the people of Judah, and they will sell them to the Sabeans—to a distant nation.” Indeed, the LORD has spoken.
ekegusii: Inche Omonene, ning’oonie abana baino, abamura na abaiseke, ase Abayuda, na barabwo baabaoonie ase abanto ba Seba, abwo bamenyete aare mono. Ninche Omonene nakwanire ayio.”
swahili: Nitawauza wana wenu na binti zenu kwa watu wa Yuda, nao watawauza kwa Waseba, taifa lililo mbali.” Bwana amesema.

english: Proclaim this among the nations: “Prepare for war; rouse the mighty men; let all the men of war advance and attack!
ekegusii: Raria amang’ana aya ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku: Ebeke ang’e ase esegi! Seegeta abarwani chituoni! Tiga abarwani bonsi bachiche bebeke ang’e basuke motwe.
swahili: Tangazeni hili miongoni mwa mataifa: Jiandaeni kwa vita! Amsha askari! Wanaume wote wapiganaji wasogee karibu na kushambulia.

english: Now the word of the LORD came to Jonah son of Amittai, saying,
ekegusii: Ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha ase Yona mosinto bw’Amitai, rikamoteebia:
swahili: Neno la Bwana lilimjia Yona mwana wa Amitai:

english: Then the men were even more afraid and said to him, “What have you done?” The men knew that he was fleeing from the presence of the LORD, because he had told them. Jonah Cast into the Sea
ekegusii: Erio Jona akabateebia ng’a nigo are gotama korwa ase Omonene Nyasae. Ekero baigwete ayio, abanto baria bakairoka mono, bakamobooria, “Mang’ana ki aya gwakorire?”.
swahili: Hili liliwaogopesha nao wakamuuliza, “Umefanya nini?” (Walijua alikuwa anamkimbia Bwana, kwa sababu alishawaambia hivyo.)

english: Now the sea was growing worse and worse, so they said to Jonah, “What must we do to you to calm this sea for us?”
ekegusii: Ase chingaki echio chionsi enyancha nigo yagendererete gosareka mono. Erio abanto baria bakabooria Jona, “Ngento ki tokogokorera, erinde enyancha etotoerere?”
swahili: Bahari ilikuwa inazidi kuchafuka. Kwa hiyo walimuuliza, “Tukutendee nini ili kufanya bahari itulie kwa ajili yetu?”

english: “Pick me up,” he answered, “and cast me into the sea, so it may quiet down for you. For I know that I am to blame for this violent storm that has come upon you.”
ekegusii: Ere akabairaneria, akabateebia, “Inyimokie, mondute ase enyancha ime; ero netoerere ase more, ekiagera namanyire ng’a ninche nagerire ekembugu‐mbugu kiabacheire.”
swahili: Akawajibu, “Niinueni mnitupe baharini, nayo itakuwa shwari. Ninajua mawimbi haya makubwa yamewatokea kwa ajili ya kosa langu.”

english: Nevertheless, the men rowed hard to get back to dry land, but they could not, for the sea was raging against them more and more.
ekegusii: Nonya naboigo abanto baria bagateema ne chinguru gosukia emeeri eria gochia ase engegu, korende tibanyarete, ekiagera ekembugu‐mbugu keria nigo kiagendererete koburukania enyancha mono goetania.
swahili: Badala yake, wale watu walijitahidi kupiga makasia wawezavyo ili wapate kurudi pwani. Lakini hawakuweza, kwa kuwa bahari ilizidi kuchafuka kuliko mwanzo.

english: So they cried out to the LORD: “Please, O LORD, do not let us perish on account of this man’s life! Do not charge us with innocent blood! For You, O LORD, have done as You pleased.”
ekegusii: Ase ayio abanto baria bakarera ase Omonene, bagateeba, “Aye Omonene, totoa egesusuro ki’ogokwa ase engencho y’ogosiria obogima bw’omonto oyo. Ekiagera aye Omonene gwakorire buna bwanchete.”
swahili: Ndipo wakamlilia Bwana, “Ee Bwana, tafadhali usituue kwa kuondoa uhai wa mtu huyu. Usituhesabie hatia kwa kuutoa uhai wa mtu asiyekuwa na hatia, kwa kuwa wewe, Ee Bwana, umefanya kama ilivyokupendeza.”

english: At this, they picked up Jonah and cast him into the sea, and the raging sea grew calm.
ekegusii: Erio bakaimokia Yona, bakamoruta ase enyancha ime; na agwo kegima enyancha egatoerera.
swahili: Kisha walimchukua Yona, wakamtupa baharini nayo bahari iliyokuwa imechafuka ikatulia.

english: Then the men feared the LORD greatly, and they offered a sacrifice to the LORD and made vows to Him.
ekegusii: Eke gekagera abanto baria bakairoka Omonene mono, bakamoruera ekeng’wanso na koria chiira chi’okomokorera.
swahili: Katika jambo hili watu wakamwogopa Bwana sana, wakamtolea Bwana dhabihu na kumwekea nadhiri.

english: Now the LORD had appointed a great fish to swallow Jonah, and Jonah spent three days and three nights in the belly of the fish.
ekegusii: Ase ogochika kw’Omonene enswe enene ekamera Yona, na Yona akabeera ime ase enda y’enswe eria amatuko atato, omobaso na obotuko.
swahili: Lakini Bwana akamwandaa nyangumi kummeza Yona, naye Yona alikuwa ndani ya tumbo la nyangumi kwa siku tatu, usiku na mchana.

english: “Get up! Go to the great city of Nineveh and preach against it, because its wickedness has come up before Me.”
ekegusii: “Imoka ogende Ninawi, omochie oria omonene, oake eriogi ri’okoyokuurera, ekiagera ogokora kwaye okobe gwaikire ase obosio bwane.”
swahili: “Nenda katika mji mkubwa wa Ninawi ukahubiri juu yake, kwa sababu uovu wake umekuja juu mbele zangu.”

english: Jonah, however, got up to flee to Tarshish, away from the presence of the LORD. He went down to Joppa and found a ship bound for Tarshish. So he paid the fare and went aboard to sail for Tarshish, away from the presence of the LORD. The Great Storm (Acts 27:13–26)
ekegusii: Korende Yona akaimoka, agatama gochia Tarisisi ng’a arue ase obosio Omonene. Agatirimboka gochia Yopa, na agwo akanyora emeeri ekogenda Tarisisi. Erio agaakana chitaabu chi’orogendo, agasoa ime, akagenda amo nabaanto bande gotama gochia Tarisisi ng’a arue ase obosio Omonene.
swahili: Lakini Yona alimkimbia Bwana na kuelekea Tarshishi. Alishuka mpaka Yafa, ambapo alikuta meli iliyokuwa imepangwa kuelekea bandari ile. Baada ya kulipa nauli, akapanda melini na kuelekea Tarshishi ili kumkimbia Bwana.

english: Then the LORD hurled a great wind upon the sea, and such a violent storm arose that the ship was in danger of breaking apart.
ekegusii: Korende Omonene akagusia omwaga omonene mono igoro ase enyancha, na ekembugu‐mbugu gie chinguru kegacha ase enyancha, na emeeri ekaba ang’e kobuneka.
swahili: Ndipo Bwana akatuma upepo mkali baharini, nayo dhoruba kali sana ikavuma hata meli ikawa hatarini kuvunjika.

english: The sailors were afraid, and each cried out to his own god. And they threw the ship’s cargo into the sea to lighten the load. But Jonah had gone down to the lowest part of the vessel, where he lay down and fell into a deep sleep.
ekegusii: Erio abagendia b’emeeri bakaondoka, na kera oyomo akarangeria enyasae yaye ng’a emokonye. Abanto abwo bakaimokia chigurube chiarenge ase emeeri ime, bagachituguta gochia ase enyancha ime, ng’a nario emeeri eragusue. Bono Yona ere konya otirimbokire gochia nyaro ime y’emeeri, na aroro nigo araire chitoro chinene mono.
swahili: Mabaharia wote waliogopa na kila mmoja akamlilia mungu wake mwenyewe. Nao wakatupa mizigo baharini ili meli ipungue uzito. Lakini Yona alikuwa ameteremkia chumba cha ndani ya meli, mahali ambapo alilala na kupatwa na usingizi mzito.

english: The captain approached him and said, “How can you sleep? Get up and call upon your God. Perhaps this God will consider us, so that we may not perish.”
ekegusii: Omochiki bw’emeeri akagenda asare akamobooria, “Naki oraire chitoro iga okirete‐kiri? Imoka orangerie Nyasae oo! Ande Nyasae oyio nabo arabaise gotorengereria atokonye titosira.”
swahili: Nahodha akamwendea na kusema, “Wewe unawezaje kulala? Amka ukamwite mungu wako! Huenda akatuangalia, tusiangamie.”

english: “Come!” said the sailors to one another. “Let us cast lots to find out who is responsible for this calamity that is upon us.” So they cast lots, and the lot fell on Jonah.
ekegusii: Abanto baria bagateebania, “Tiga toake obomera tomanye gose ning’o ogerire amabe aya atocheire.” Erio bagaaka obomera, na obomera obwo bokagwera Yona.
swahili: Kisha mabaharia wakasemezana wao kwa wao, “Njooni, tupige kura tumtafute anayehusika na maafa haya.” Wakapiga kura, kura ikamwangukia Yona.

english: “Tell us now,” they demanded, “who is to blame for this calamity that is upon us? What is your occupation, and where have you come from? What is your country, and who are your people?”
ekegusii: Ase ayio abanto baria bakamobooria, “Toteebie gose ning’o ogerire amabe aya atonyorire. Meremo ki ogokora aye? Ng’ai kwarure? Ense yao nereri? Ngesaku ki ore?”
swahili: Kwa hiyo walimuuliza, “Tuambie, ni nani anayehusika kwa kutuletea tatizo hili lote? Unafanya kazi gani? Umetoka wapi? Nchi yako ni ipi? Wewe ni kutoka taifa lipi?”

english: “I am a Hebrew,” replied Jonah. “I worship the LORD, the God of the heavens, who made the sea and the dry land.”
ekegusii: Ere akabairaneria, “Inche n’Omoiberania inde, na nigo inyirogete Omonene, Nyasae o igoro, oyo otongete enyancha na ense enyomo.”
swahili: Akajibu, “Mimi ni Mwebrania, nami namwabudu Bwana, Mungu wa Mbinguni, aliyeumba bahari na nchi kavu.”

english: From inside the fish, Jonah prayed to the LORD his God,
ekegusii: Ekero Yona arenge ime ase enda y’enswe eria, akaba ogosa Omonene, Nyasae oye,
swahili: Akiwa ndani ya tumbo la nyangumi, Yona alimwomba Bwana Mungu wake.

english: And the LORD commanded the fish, and it vomited Jonah onto dry land.
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene akayechiika enswe eria emoroke Yona, igoro ase engegu, nero egakora boigo.
swahili: Basi Bwana akamwamuru yule nyangumi, naye akamtapika Yona katika nchi kavu.

english: saying: “In my distress I called to the LORD, and He answered me. From the belly of Sheol I called for help, and You heard my voice.
ekegusii: agateeba, “Ekero narenge ase emechando, aye Omonene, ngakorangeria naye okangiraneria inche. Korwa ase endiba y’ense y’abakuure ’nkarera onkoye naye okanyigwa inche.
swahili: Akasema: “Katika shida yangu nalimwita Bwana, naye akanijibu. Kutoka kina cha kaburi niliomba msaada, nawe ukasikiliza kilio changu.

english: For You cast me into the deep, into the heart of the seas, and the current swirled about me; all Your breakers and waves swept over me.
ekegusii: Aye nigo kwandutete gochia ase chindiba, inse kegima y’enyancha, ne chiooro chi’enyancha chiang’etananete inche. Na emerindo yao yonsi emetindi ekaimokerera igoro egantuba.
swahili: Ulinitupa kwenye kilindi, ndani kabisa ya moyo wa bahari, mikondo ya maji ilinizunguka, mawimbi yako yote na viwimbi vilipita juu yangu.

english: At this, I said, ‘I have been banished from Your sight; yet I will look once more toward Your holy temple.’
ekegusii: Ase ayio inche nkarengereria ng’a natugutirwe korwa ase obosio bwao, naende ng’a tikonyara koyerora Hekalu yao Enchenu.
swahili: Nikasema, ‘Nimefukuziwa mbali na uso wako, hata hivyo nitatazama tena kuelekea Hekalu lako takatifu.’

english: The waters engulfed me to take my life; the watery depths closed around me; the seaweed wrapped around my head.
ekegusii: Amache agacha agantuba naende agantokeria inche; enyancha egantuba inche kegima enderema ya nyancha ekarandererwa omotwe one.
swahili: Maji yaliyonimeza yalinitisha, kilindi kilinizunguka; mwani ulijisokota kichwani pangu.

english: To the roots of the mountains I descended; the earth beneath me barred me in forever! But You raised my life from the pit, O LORD my God!
ekegusii: Nigo nagendete inse kegima goika ase emeri y’ebitunwa agwo ase ense eyio ebisiekero bi’ebiita biaye bigosieka kare na kare. Nonya naboigo, aye Omonene, Nyasae one, nigo kwangiranetie korwa ase chindiba inde moyo.
swahili: Nilizama chini sana mpaka pande za mwisho za milima, makomeo ya hiyo nchi yalinifungia hata milele. Lakini uliuleta uhai wangu kutoka shimoni, Ee Bwana Mungu wangu.

english: As my life was fading away, I remembered the LORD. My prayer went up to You, to Your holy temple.
ekegusii: Ekero obomoyo bwane bwachagete gosoka gochia aria are erio aye Omonene ngasaba gocha ase ore na korwa ime y’Hekalu yao enchenu okanyigwa inche.
swahili: “Wakati uhai wangu ulipokuwa unatoka, nilikukumbuka wewe, Bwana, nayo maombi yangu yalikufikia wewe, katika Hekalu lako takatifu.

english: Those who cling to worthless idols forsake His loving devotion.
ekegusii: Abanto abwo bagosasiima emegwekano eyio ere bosa barabwo batigire oboigweri gocha ase ore.
swahili: “Wale watu wanaongʼangʼana na sanamu zisizofaa hupoteza neema ile ambayo ingekuwa yao.

english: But I, with the voice of thanksgiving, will sacrifice to You. I will fulfill what I have vowed. Salvation is from the LORD!”
ekegusii: Korende inche ningoterere ’ngokobaka aye; nikoruere aye ekengwanso na goikerania aria nakoriereire chiira. Ogotooreka nigo gokorwa ase Omonene!”
swahili: Lakini mimi, kwa wimbo wa shukrani, nitakutolea dhabihu. Lile nililowekea nadhiri nitalitimiza. Wokovu watoka kwa Bwana.”

english: Then the word of the LORD came to Jonah a second time:
ekegusii: Nainde, Omonene agakwana na Yona.
swahili: Ndipo neno la Bwana likamjia Yona mara ya pili:

english: When God saw their actions—that they had turned from their evil ways—He relented from the disaster He had threatened to bring upon them.
ekegusii: Nyasae akarora aria bakorete; akarora nga batigire chinchera chiabo chi’ebibe. Erio ere agaonchoreria ebirengererio biaye naende agatiga kobaa egesusuro keria ere atebeete nga nabae.
swahili: Mungu alipoona walivyofanya na jinsi walivyogeuka kutoka njia zao mbaya, akawa na huruma wala hakuleta maangamizi juu yao kama alivyokuwa ameonya.

english: “Get up! Go to the great city of Nineveh and proclaim to it the message that I give you.”
ekegusii: Ere agateeba, “Imoka ogende Ninawi, omochie oria omonene, erio obararerie abanto amang’ana ayio nakoeire.”
swahili: “Ondoka uende katika mji mkubwa wa Ninawi, ukautangazie ujumbe ninaokupa.”

english: This time Jonah got up and went to Nineveh, in accordance with the word of the LORD. Now Nineveh was an exceedingly great city, requiring a three-day journey.
ekegusii: Ase ayio Yona akamoigwera Omonene akagenda Ninawi omochie omogare kegima, akaira amatuko atato koyotara bwonsi.
swahili: Yona akalitii neno la Bwana naye akaenda Ninawi. Basi Ninawi ulikuwa mji maarufu sana, ilichukua siku tatu kuuzunguka.

english: On the first day of his journey, Jonah set out into the city and proclaimed, “Forty more days and Nineveh will be overturned!”
ekegusii: Yona agachaaka gotara ime y’omochie oria, nyuma y’ogotara ase rituko rigima, ere agaaka eriogi agateeba “Atigaire amatuko emerongo ene oka, erio Ninawi esarigwe!”
swahili: Siku ya kwanza, Yona aliingia mjini. Akatangaza: “Baada ya siku arobaini Ninawi utaangamizwa.”

english: And the Ninevites believed God. They proclaimed a fast and dressed in sackcloth, from the greatest of them to the least.
ekegusii: Abanto ba Ninawi bakegena amang’ana a Nyasae, bagaetia buna kera oyomo eng’ate, na abanto bonsi pi, korwa omonene kegima goika omoke, bakeboyia chigunia koorokia buna beitirie.
swahili: Watu wa Ninawi wakamwamini Mungu, wakatangaza kufunga, watu wote kuanzia mkubwa sana hadi yule mdogo kabisa, wakavaa nguo za gunia.

english: When word reached the king of Nineveh, he got up from his throne, took off his royal robe, covered himself with sackcloth, and sat in ashes.
ekegusii: Ekero amang’ana ayio aigete ase omorwoti, ere akaimoka korwa ase ekerogo kiaye ki’obonene, akarusia engobo yaye y’obonene, akeboyia chigunia, agaikaransa inse ase ribu igoro.
swahili: Habari zilipomfikia mfalme wa Ninawi, aliondoka kwenye kiti chake cha enzi, akavua majoho yake ya kifalme, akajifunika nguo ya gunia kisha akaketi chini mavumbini.

english: Then he issued a proclamation in Nineveh: “By the decree of the king and his nobles: Let no man or beast, herd or flock, taste anything at all. They must not eat or drink.
ekegusii: Erio agatoma okoraria gochia ase abanto ba Ninawi: “Oko n’ogochika korwa ase omorwoti n’abanene baye: onde tabaisa koria kende; abanto bonsi, chiombe, amo n’echingondi tibiancheiri koria gose konywa.
swahili: Ndipo akatoa tangazo katika Ninawi yote: “Kwa amri ya mfalme na wakuu wake: “Msiruhusu mtu yeyote au mnyama, makundi ya ngʼombe au wanyama wengine wafugwao, kuonja kitu chochote, msiwaruhusu kula wala kunywa.

english: Furthermore, let both man and beast be covered with sackcloth, and have everyone call out earnestly to God. Let each one turn from his evil ways and from the violence in his hands.
ekegusii: Abanto bonsi pi amo n’echingiti babeke chianga chi’echigunia. Kera oyomo goika amosabe Nyasae ase ekeene naende boigo goika atige chinchera chiaye chi’obobe namakora aye y’ebibe.
swahili: Bali wanadamu na wanyama wafunikwe kwa nguo za gunia. Kila mmoja afanye hima kumwomba Mungu. Waziache njia zao mbaya na udhalimu ulio mikononi mwao.

english: Who knows? God may turn and relent; He may turn from His fierce anger, so that we will not perish.”
ekegusii: Kero kende Nyasae nabo abaise koonchoreria ebirengererio biaye; kero kende nabaise gotiga koba n’ekeririanda, naitwe titogokwa!”
swahili: Ni nani ajuaye? Huenda Mungu akaghairi kwa huruma yake akaacha hasira yake kali ili tusiangamie.”

english: Jonah, however, was greatly displeased, and he became angry.
ekegusii: Yona akagechigwa namang’ana ayio, akaba nendamwamu.
swahili: Lakini Yona alichukizwa sana akakasirika.

english: But the LORD said, “You cared about the plant, which you neither tended nor made grow. It sprang up in a night and perished in a night.
ekegusii: Omonene akamoteebia, “Aye kwaroreire omobono oyo amaabera, nonya tikwaywechanderete ase ogokora emeremo asoro, gose ase okoyokinia; nigo omerete ase obotuko obomo, naende ogasira ase obotuko obomo.
swahili: Lakini Bwana akamwambia, “Wewe unakasirika kwa ajili ya mzabibu huu, nawe hukuusababisha kuota wala kuutunza. Uliota usiku mmoja, nao ukafa usiku mmoja.

english: So should I not care about the great city of Nineveh, which has more than 120,000 people who cannot tell their right hand from their left, and many cattle as well?”
ekegusii: Inee! Inche tingwenereti koba namabeebe ase Ninawi, omochie oyio omonene, agwo ase abanto goetania chilifu rigana erimo na emerongo ebere (120,000) bamenyeteo? Abanto abwo tibamanyete gwatanana ayare ensemo ya borio na ayare ase eya bomosi. Boigo omochie oyio nobwate ching’iti chinyinge mono chitugireo.”
swahili: Lakini Ninawi ina zaidi ya watu 120,000 ambao hawawezi kupambanua kulia au kushoto, pamoja na ngʼombe wengi. Je, hainipasi kufikiri juu ya mji ule mkubwa?”

english: So he prayed to the LORD, saying, “O LORD, is this not what I said while I was still in my own country? This is why I was so quick to flee toward Tarshish. I knew that You are a gracious and compassionate God, slow to anger, abounding in loving devotion—One who relents from sending disaster.
ekegusii: Erio agasaba Omonene, agateeba, “Aye Omonene, Inee, amang’ana aya tari aro nateebete ekero narenge ase ense yane? Naende nakio kiagerete ngatama gochia Tarisisi, ekiagera nigo namanyete ng’a aye nigo ore Nyasae oichire nobuya na amaabera; tori omwango bw’okoba nendamwamu, na obwanchani bwao obonene nigo bogendererete botambe, naende nigo okoonchora ebirengererio biao, tokobakorera amabe.
swahili: Akamwomba Bwana, “Ee Bwana, hili si lile nililolisema nilipokuwa ningali nyumbani? Hii ndiyo sababu niliharikisha kukimbilia Tarshishi. Nikifahamu kuwa wewe ni Mungu mwenye neema na huruma, si mwepesi wa hasira na umejaa upendo, ni Mungu ambaye hughairi katika kupeleka maafa.

english: And now, O LORD, please take my life from me, for it is better for me to die than to live.”
ekegusii: Ase ayio, aye Omonene, bono nagosoroire ng’a orusieo obogima bwane ontige inkwe, ekiagera nigo ere buya ase ’nde gokwa kobua kogenderera koba moyo.”
swahili: Sasa, Ee Bwana, niondolee uhai wangu, kwa kuwa ni afadhali mimi nife kuliko kuishi.”
