english: But the LORD replied, “Have you any right to be angry?”
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene akamobooria, “Inee! Igo mboronge ogokora ase okogechigwa igo?”
swahili: Lakini Bwana akamjibu, “Je unayo haki yoyote kukasirika?”

english: Then Jonah left the city and sat down east of it, where he made himself a shelter and sat in its shade to see what would happen to the city.
ekegusii: Bono Yona agasoka korwa ase omochie oria, agaikaransa ase ensemo ya moocha y’omochie. Agwo akeagachera ekegutu, agaikaransa imeo gokenderera koganya arore ayare gochia gokorekana ase omochie oria.
swahili: Yona akatoka nje akaketi mahali upande wa mashariki wa mji. Hapo akajitengenezea kibanda, akaketi kwenye kivuli chake na kungojea ni nini kitakachotokea katika mji.

english: So the LORD God appointed a vine, and it grew up to provide shade over Jonah’s head to ease his discomfort, and Jonah was greatly pleased with the plant.
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene Nyasae akameria omobono ogakina, na Yona agakenderera inse yaye, agatimoka korwa ase okorosa kwaye. Ase ayio akagokigwa mono nomobono oria.
swahili: Ndipo Bwana, Mungu akaweka tayari mzabibu na kuufanya uote, kumpa Yona kivuli kilichomfunika kichwa ili kuondoa taabu yake, naye Yona akafurahi sana kwa ajili ya ule mzabibu.

english: When dawn came the next day, God appointed a worm that attacked the plant so that it withered.
ekegusii: Korende rituko ria kabere mambia, Nyasae agachiika rikonde rikaria omobono oria, erinde ogasusana.
swahili: Lakini kesho yake asubuhi na mapema Mungu akaamuru buu, autafune mzabibu huo nao ukanyauka.

english: As the sun was rising, God appointed a scorching east wind, and the sun beat down on Jonah’s head so that he grew faint and wished to die, saying, “It is better for me to die than to live.”
ekegusii: Ekero erioba riatiirire gocha igoro, Nyasae akarenta omwaga okagusa korwa moocha orenge nomobaso omoororo se, na omobaso oria ogasamba Yona bobe ase omotwe goika akagireka. Erio akagania akwe, agateeba, “Nigo ere buya ase ’nde gokwa kobua kogenderera koba moyo.”
swahili: Wakati jua lilipochomoza, Mungu akautuma upepo wa hari wa mashariki, nalo jua likawaka juu ya kichwa cha Yona mpaka akazimia. Akatamani kufa, naye akasema, “Ni afadhali mimi nife kuliko kuishi.”

english: Then God asked Jonah, “Have you any right to be angry about the plant?” “I do,” he replied. “I am angry enough to die!”
ekegusii: Korende Nyasae akaboria Yona, “Inee! Mboronge igo aye okogechigwa ase engencho y’omobono oyio?” Yona akairaneria, akamoteebia, “Ee, nigo inde noboronge kogechigwa, nonya ngoika ogokwa.”
swahili: Lakini Mungu alimwambia Yona, “Je, unayo haki kukasirika kuhusu mzabibu huo?” Akasema, “Ndiyo, ninayo haki. Nimekasirika kiasi cha kufa.”

english: Now Adoni-zedek king of Jerusalem heard that Joshua had captured Ai and devoted it to destruction —doing to Ai and its king as he had done to Jericho and its king—and that the people of Gibeon had made peace with Israel and were living near them.
ekegusii: Adoni‐Sedeki, omorwoti o Yerusalemu, akaigwa ng’a Yoshua obuire omochie o Ai na oyosiririe kegima, oitire na omorwoti bw’aroro, buna akorete Yeriko na omorwoti bw’aroro. Naboigo akaigwa buna Abagibeoni bakorire omorembe na kobwatana n’Abaisraeli, naende ng’a banyorire ribaga komenya ase egati yabo.
swahili: Baada ya haya Adoni-Sedeki mfalme wa Yerusalemu alisikia kuwa Yoshua alikuwa ameteka mji wa Ai na kuuangamiza kabisa, tena alikuwa ameua mfalme wake, kama alivyofanya huko Yeriko na mfalme wake, tena ya kuwa watu wa Gibeoni walikuwa wamefanya mapatano ya amani na Waisraeli, na walikuwa wakiishi karibu yao.

english: And the LORD threw them into confusion before Israel, who defeated them in a great slaughter at Gibeon, pursued them along the ascent to Beth-horon, and struck them down as far as Azekah and Makkedah.
ekegusii: Omonene akabatantania na kobaondokia ase amasio ’Abaisraeli, nabarabwo bakabaita ogoita okonene agwo Gibeoni, akababwatia gochia egetirimboko kia Beti‐Horoni, naende akababwatia na kobaita goika omochie bw’Aseka na oyo o Makeda.
swahili: Bwana akawafadhaisha mbele ya Waisraeli, nao wakawashinda kwa ushindi mkuu huko Gibeoni. Israeli wakawafukuza kuelekea njia iendayo Beth-Horoni wakiwaua mpaka kufikia njia iendayo Azeka na Makeda.

english: As they fled before Israel along the descent from Beth-horon to Azekah, the LORD cast down on them large hailstones from the sky, and more of them were killed by the hailstones than by the swords of the Israelites.
ekegusii: Ekero Abaamori barenge gotama Abaisraeli, na kobaikire egetirimboko gekorua Beti‐Horoni, Nyasae akabaiyereria amagena ’embura amanene mono korwa igoro ase enchera yabo goika omochie bw’Aseka, nabarabwo bagakwa. Abwo baitetwe namagena ’embura nigo barenge abange kobua abwo baitetwe n’Abaisraeli.
swahili: Walipokuwa wakikimbia mbele ya Israeli kwenye barabara iteremkayo kutoka Beth-Horoni hadi Azeka, Bwana akawavumishia mawe makubwa ya mvua kutoka mbinguni, na wengi wao wakauawa na hayo mawe kuliko wale waliouawa kwa upanga wa Waisraeli.

english: On the day that the LORD gave the Amorites over to the Israelites, Joshua spoke to the LORD in the presence of Israel: “O sun, stand still over Gibeon, O moon, over the Valley of Aijalon.”
ekegusii: Ase rituko riri’Omonene abegeete Abaamori ase amaboko ’Abaisraeli, Yoshua agakwana n’Omonene. Ekero Abaisraeli bategererete, akabora, “Aye erioba, tenena, okire‐kiri igoro ya Gibeoni, naye omotienyi boigo, igoro ye Rikura ri’Ayaloni!”
swahili: Katika siku ile ambayo Bwana aliwapeana Waamori kwa Israeli, Yoshua akanena na Bwana akiwa mbele ya Waisraeli akasema: “Wewe jua, simama juu ya Gibeoni, wewe mwezi, tulia juu ya Bonde la Aiyaloni.”

english: So the sun stood still and the moon stopped until the nation took vengeance upon its enemies. Is this not written in the Book of Jashar? “So the sun stopped in the middle of the sky and delayed going down about a full day.”
ekegusii: Erio erioba rigatenena rigakira‐kiri, na omotienyi boigo, goika abanto bakeruseria egesiomba ase ababisa babo. Aya nigo ariikire ase “Egetabu ki’oyore omooronge.” Erioba rigatenena rigakira‐kiri aaria igoro gati‐gati kegima, ang’e rituko rigima, na tiriaayerera kogwa.
swahili: Hivyo jua likasimama, nao mwezi ukatulia, hadi taifa hilo lilipokwisha kujilipizia kisasi kwa adui wake, kama ilivyoandikwa katika Kitabu cha Yashari. Jua likasimama kimya katikati ya mbingu, likachelewa kuzama muda wa siku moja nzima.

english: There has been no day like it before or since, when the LORD listened to the voice of a man, because the LORD fought for Israel.
ekegusii: Ituko rinde tiriana koba buna erio nonya ng’ake, ritang’ani ri’ayio, gose magega y’ayio, ekero Omonene aigwerete Mwanyabaanto. Nyasae nigo arwanererete Abaisraeli.
swahili: Haijakuwepo siku nyingine kama hiyo kabla au baada, siku ambayo Bwana alimsikiliza mwanadamu. Hakika Bwana alikuwa akiwapigania Israeli.

english: Then Joshua returned with all Israel to the camp at Gilgal. The Victory at Makkedah
ekegusii: Magega y’ayio Yoshua na Abaisraeli bonsi bakairana Giligali ase batoorete.
swahili: Ndipo Yoshua akarudi kambini huko Gilgali pamoja na Israeli yote. Wafalme Watano Wa Waamori Wauawa

english: Now the five kings had fled and hidden in the cave at Makkedah.
ekegusii: Abarwoti baria batano bagatama, bakebisa ase rikuruma ria Makeda.
swahili: Basi wale wafalme watano wakawa wamekimbia kujificha kwenye pango huko Makeda.

english: And Joshua was informed: “The five kings have been found; they are hiding in the cave at Makkedah.”
ekegusii: Ekero Yoshua atebetigwe ng’a abarwoti baria barorekanire bebisete agwo ase rikuruma riria,
swahili: Yoshua alipoambiwa kuwa wafalme hao watano wamekutwa wakiwa wamejificha ndani ya pango huko Makeda,

english: So Joshua said, “Roll large stones against the mouth of the cave, and post men there to guard them.
ekegusii: agachiika, agateeba, “Turunkania amagena amanene, mosieke egesoero kie rikuruma, naende mobeeke abanto barende aroro.
swahili: akasema, “Vingirisheni mawe makubwa kwenye mdomo wa hilo pango, tena wekeni walinzi wa kulilinda.

english: But you, do not stop there. Pursue your enemies and attack them from behind. Do not let them reach their cities, for the LORD your God has delivered them into your hand.”
ekegusii: Korende inwe abande, timobaisa kobeera aroro, mobwatie ababisa baino, mobaumokere korwa magega, na kobaita. Timobatiga basoe emechie yabo, ekiagera Omonene, Nyasae oino, obabekire ase amaboko aino.”
swahili: Lakini msiwaache! Wafuatieni adui zenu, washambulieni kutoka nyuma, wala msiwaache wafike kwenye miji yao, kwa kuwa Bwana Mungu wenu amewatia mkononi mwenu.”

english: So Adoni-zedek and his people were greatly alarmed, because Gibeon was a great city, like one of the royal cities; it was larger than Ai, and all its men were mighty.
ekegusii: Bono omorwoti oria amo nabaanto baye bakaondoka mono; ekiagera Gibeoni nigo orenge omochie omonene buna omochie onde bwonsi obwate omorwoti; nomonene orenge kobua Ai, na abarwani baye bonsi b’esegi nigo barenge ne chinguru chi’okorwana.
swahili: Yeye na watu wake wakataharuki mno kwa kuwa Gibeoni ulikuwa mji mkubwa kama mmojawapo ya miji ya kifalme; ulikuwa mkubwa kuliko Ai, nao watu wake wote walikuwa mashujaa wa vita.

english: So Joshua and the Israelites continued to inflict a terrible slaughter until they had finished them off, and the remaining survivors retreated to the fortified cities.
ekegusii: Yoshua na Abaisraeli bakabaita ogoita okonene, goika bakabasiria bonsi otatiga abanto bake boka, abwo batamerete emechie yagiteire chindwaki.
swahili: Hivyo Yoshua pamoja na Waisraeli wakawaangamiza kabisa karibu wote, lakini wachache waliosalia walifika kwenye miji yao yenye maboma.

english: The whole army returned safely to Joshua in the camp at Makkedah, and no one dared to utter a word against the Israelites.
ekegusii: Erio abanto bonsi bakairana buya ase Yoshua agwo Makeda erio batoorete. Onde tarenge noboremu gokwana mamincha y’Abaisraeli naende.
swahili: Basi jeshi lote likarudi salama kwa Yoshua huko kambini Makeda, na hakuna yeyote aliyetoa neno kinyume cha Waisraeli.

english: Then Joshua said, “Open the mouth of the cave and bring those five kings out to me.”
ekegusii: Erio Yoshua agateeba, “Igora egesoero kie rikuruma na mondetere abarwoti baria batano korwa aroro.”
swahili: Ndipo Yoshua akasema, “Haya fungueni mdomo wa pango, mniletee hao wafalme watano.”

english: So they brought the five kings out of the cave—the kings of Jerusalem, Hebron, Jarmuth, Lachish, and Eglon.
ekegusii: Aya agakoreka. Bakarusia abarwoti baria batano korwa ase rikuruma: omorwoti o Yerusalemu, na oyo o Heburoni, na oyo o Yerimuti, na oyo o Lakisi, na oyo bw’Egiloni, bakabarenta ase Yoshua.
swahili: Kwa hiyo wakawatoa hao wafalme watano nje ya pango: wafalme wa Yerusalemu, Hebroni, Yarmuthi, Lakishi na Egloni.

english: When they had brought the kings to Joshua, he summoned all the men of Israel and said to the army commanders who had accompanied him, “Come here and put your feet on the necks of these kings.” So the commanders came forward and put their feet on their necks.
ekegusii: Ekero abarwoti baria barentetwe ase Yoshua, ere akarangeria Abaisraeli bonsi amo, agateebia abatang’ani b’abarwani, abwo bagendete amo nere ase esegi, “Inchuo aiga ang’e, motache abarwoti aba ebigoti biabo.” Erio barabwo bagaika ang’e, bakabatacha.
swahili: Walipokuwa wamewaleta hawa wafalme kwa Yoshua, akawaita watu wote wa Israeli, na kuwaambia majemadari wa vita waliokwenda pamoja naye, “Njooni hapa mweke nyayo zenu juu ya shingo za hawa wafalme.” Basi wakaja wakaweka nyayo zao shingoni.

english: “Do not be afraid or discouraged,” Joshua said. “Be strong and courageous, for the LORD will do this to all the enemies you fight.”
ekegusii: Naende Yoshua agateebia abatang’ani baria b’abarwani, “Timoiroka, timokwa emioyo; mobe noboremu na gotenena bokong’u, ekiagera naboigo Omonene arakore ababisa bonsi morarwanie.”
swahili: Yoshua akawaambia, “Msiogope, wala msivunjike moyo. Kuweni hodari na wenye ushujaa. Hili ndilo Bwana atakalowatendea adui zenu wote mnaokwenda kupigana nao.”

english: After this, Joshua struck down and killed the kings, and he hung their bodies on five trees and left them there until evening.
ekegusii: Magega y’ayio Yoshua agaita abarwoti baria, akabatonga ase emete etano; agwo bagasung’unana goika mogoroba.
swahili: Ndipo Yoshua akawapiga na kuwaua wale wafalme na kuwatundika juu ya miti mitano, nao wakaachwa wakiningʼinia juu ya ile miti hadi jioni.

english: At sunset Joshua ordered that they be taken down from the trees and thrown into the cave in which they had hidden. Then large stones were placed against the mouth of the cave, and the stones are there to this day.
ekegusii: Ekero erioba rikogwa Yoshua agachiika ng’a ebitondo bi’abaanto baria bisungorwe, bitugutwe ase rikuruma riria bebisete, na abanto bagakora bo. Naende bakabeeka amagena amanene ase egesoero kie rikuruma, nao are goika reero iga.
swahili: Wakati wa kuzama jua Yoshua akaamuru, nao wakawashusha kutoka kwenye ile miti na kuwatupa kwenye lile pango ambalo walikuwa wamejificha. Kwenye mdomo wa lile pango wakaweka mawe makubwa, ambayo yapo hadi leo.

english: On that day Joshua captured Makkedah and put it to the sword, along with its king. He devoted to destruction everyone in the city, leaving no survivors. So he did to the king of Makkedah as he had done to the king of Jericho. Conquest of the Southern Cities
ekegusii: Ase rituko riria Yoshua akaumokera na kobwata omochie o Makeda, agaita na gosiria nemioro abanto bonsi pi abarenge imeo, amo nomorwoti obo. Onde tatooregete nonya noyomo. Agakora omorwoti o Makeda buna akorete omorwoti o Yeriko.
swahili: Siku ile Yoshua akateka Makeda. Akamuua kila mmoja katika ule mji, pamoja na mfalme wake kwa upanga. Hakubakiza mtu yeyote. Akamfanyia mfalme wa Makeda kama vile alivyokuwa amemfanyia mfalme wa Yeriko. Israeli Yaangamiza Miji Ya Kusini

english: Then Joshua and all Israel with him moved on from Makkedah to Libnah and fought against Libnah.
ekegusii: Magega y’ayio Yoshua amo n’Abaisraeli bonsi bakarua Makeda, bakagenda korwania Libuna.
swahili: Ndipo Yoshua akaondoka Makeda akiwa pamoja na Israeli yote mpaka mji wa Libna na kuushambulia.

english: Therefore Adoni-zedek king of Jerusalem sent word to Hoham king of Hebron, Piram king of Jarmuth, Japhia king of Lachish, and Debir king of Eglon, saying,
ekegusii: Adoni‐Sedeki, omurwoti o Yerusalemu, agatoma abanto gochia ase Hohamu, omorwoti o Heburoni, na Piramu, omorwoti o Yarimuti, na Yafia, omorwoti o Lakisi, na Debiri, omorwoti bw’Egiloni, akabateebia,
swahili: Hivyo Adoni-Sedeki mfalme wa Yerusalemu akaomba msaada kwa Hohamu mfalme wa Hebroni, Piramu mfalme wa Yarmuthi, Yafia mfalme wa Lakishi, na Debiri mfalme wa Egloni.

english: And the LORD also delivered that city and its king into the hand of Israel, and Joshua put all the people to the sword, leaving no survivors. And he did to the king of Libnah as he had done to the king of Jericho.
ekegusii: Omonene akabeeka omochie oyio amo nomorwoti oye ase amakobo ’Abaisraeli. Bagaita nemioro abanto bonsi pi b’omochie oyio; onde tatooregete nonya noyomo. Naende agakora omorwoti bw’aroro buna akorete omorwoti o Yeriko.
swahili: Bwana pia akautia huo mji wa Libna pamoja na mfalme wake mikononi mwa Israeli. Yoshua akaangamiza ule mji na kila mtu aliyekuwa ndani yake kwa upanga. Hakubakiza huko mtu yeyote. Akamfanyia mfalme wa Libna kama alivyokuwa amemfanyia mfalme wa Yeriko.

english: And Joshua and all Israel with him moved on from Libnah to Lachish. They laid siege to it and fought against it.
ekegusii: Erio Yoshua akaimoka amo n’Abaisraeli bonsi korwa Libuna, bakagenda Lakisi, bakayoetanana na koyoumokera.
swahili: Kisha Yoshua akaondoka Libna kwenda Lakishi akiwa pamoja na Israeli yote; wakajipanga dhidi yake na kuushambulia.

english: And the LORD delivered Lachish into the hand of Israel, and Joshua captured it on the second day. He put all the people to the sword, just as he had done to Libnah.
ekegusii: Na Omonene akabeeka Lakisi ase amaboko ’Abaisraeli, erio bakayobwata rituko ria kabere, bagaita nemioro abanto bonsi b’omochie, buna bakorete agwo Libuna.
swahili: Bwana akautia Lakishi mikononi mwa Israeli, Yoshua akauteka siku ya pili. Yoshua akauangamiza mji na kila kilichokuwa ndani yake kwa upanga, kama tu vile alivyokuwa ameufanyia mji wa Libna.

english: At that time Horam king of Gezer went to help Lachish, but Joshua struck him down along with his people, leaving no survivors.
ekegusii: Erio Horamu, omorwoti o Geseri, agatiira gokonya Lakisi, korende Yoshua akamoita ere amo nabarwani baye; onde tatigarete ore moyo.
swahili: Wakati huo huo, Horamu mfalme wa Gezeri alikuwa amepanda ili kusaidia Lakishi, lakini Yoshua akamshinda pamoja na jeshi lake, hadi hapakubakia mtu yeyote.

english: So Joshua moved on from Lachish to Eglon, and all Israel with him. They laid siege to it and fought against it.
ekegusii: Yoshua na Abaisraeli bonsi bakarua Lakisi, bakagenda Egiloni, bakayoetanana na koyoumokera.
swahili: Ndipo Yoshua akaondoka Lakishi kwenda Egloni akiwa pamoja na Israeli yote; wakajipanga dhidi yake na kuushambulia.

english: That day they captured Eglon and put it to the sword, and Joshua devoted to destruction everyone in the city, just as he had done to Lachish.
ekegusii: Rituko erio erio bakayobwata, bagaita nemioro abanto b’aroro, buna bakorete omochie o Lakisi.
swahili: Wakauteka mji huo siku ile ile, wakaupiga kwa upanga na kumwangamiza kila mmoja aliyekuwa ndani yake, kama vile walivyokuwa wameufanyia Lakishi.

english: Then Joshua and all Israel with him went up from Eglon to Hebron and fought against it.
ekegusii: Korwa Egiloni Yoshua na Abaisraeli bonsi bagatiira, bagaika Heburoni bayorwanie.
swahili: Kisha Yoshua akapanda kutoka Egloni kwenda Hebroni akiwa pamoja na Israeli yote na kuushambulia.

english: They captured it and put to the sword its king, all its villages, and all the people. Joshua left no survivors, just as he had done at Eglon; he devoted to destruction Hebron and everyone in it.
ekegusii: Bakayobwata na bagaita nemioro omorwoti oye na kera omonto bw’omochie oyio amo nabwo b’emechie ende yarenge ang’e Yoshua agasiria omochie oyio kegima, buna akorete omochie bw’Egiloni; tatigete nonya noyomo abe moyo.
swahili: Wakauteka mji na kuupiga kwa upanga, pamoja na mfalme wake, vijiji vyake na kila mmoja aliyekuwa ndani yake. Hawakubakiza mtu yeyote. Kama vile huko Egloni, waliuangamiza kabisa pamoja na kila mmoja aliyekuwa ndani yake.

english: Finally Joshua and all Israel with him turned toward Debir and fought against it.
ekegusii: Magega y’ayio Yoshua na Abaisraeli bonsi bakairana Debiri, akaumokera omochie oyio.
swahili: Ndipo Yoshua na Israeli wote wakageuka na kuushambulia Debiri.

english: And they captured Debir, its king, and all its villages. They put them to the sword and devoted to destruction everyone in the city, leaving no survivors. Joshua did to Debir and its king as he had done to Hebron and as he had done to Libnah and its king.
ekegusii: Akayobwata amo nomorwoti oye na emechie yonsi yarenge ang’e. Bagaita nemioro abanto abarenge imeo, tibatigaretie nonya noyomo abe moyo. Agakora omochie o Debiri na omorwoti bw’aroro buna akorete omochie o Heburoni, na omochie o Libuna, na abarwoti b’emechie eyio.
swahili: Wakauteka mji, mfalme wake na vijiji vyake, na kuupiga kwa upanga. Kila mmoja aliyekuwa ndani yake wakamwangamiza kabisa. Hawakubakiza mtu yeyote. Wakaufanyia Debiri na mfalme wake kama vile walivyokuwa wameifanyia miji ya Libna na Hebroni na wafalme wao.

english: “Come up and help me. We will attack Gibeon, because they have made peace with Joshua and the Israelites.”
ekegusii: “Tiira gocha aa, monkonye, torwanie Abagibeoni, ekiagera barabwo bakorire omorembe na kobwatana na Yoshua na Abaisraeli.”
swahili: Akawaambia, “Njooni mnisaidie kuipiga Gibeoni, kwa sababu imefanya mapatano ya amani na Yoshua na Waisraeli.”

english: So Joshua conquered the whole region—the hill country, the Negev, the foothills, and the slopes, together with all their kings—leaving no survivors. He devoted to destruction everything that breathed, just as the LORD, the God of Israel, had commanded.
ekegusii: Naboigo Yoshua akaira ense eria engima. Akabua na goita abarwoti bonsi b’ense y’ebitunwa, na eye Negebu, na ey’omwenya, na ey’ebitirimboko. Agaita abanto bonsi pi, tatigaretie nonya noyomo, buna achigetwe n’Omonene Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli.
swahili: Hivyo Yoshua akalishinda eneo hilo lote, ikiwa ni pamoja na nchi ya vilima, na Negebu, na sehemu ya magharibi chini ya vilima, materemko ya milima, pamoja na wafalme wake wote. Hakubakiza mtu yeyote. Akaangamiza kabisa kila kitu chenye pumzi, kama vile Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli, alivyokuwa ameamuru.

english: Joshua conquered the area from Kadesh-barnea to Gaza, and the whole region of Goshen as far as Gibeon.
ekegusii: Yoshua akabua abanto bonsi korwa Kadeshi‐Barinea goika Gasa, na akaira ense yonsi ya Goseni goika Gibeoni.
swahili: Yoshua akawashinda kuanzia Kadesh-Barnea hadi Gaza na kutoka eneo lote la Gosheni hadi Gibeoni.

english: And because the LORD, the God of Israel, fought for Israel, Joshua captured all these kings and their land in one campaign.
ekegusii: Nabo Yoshua akabua abarwoti abwo bonsi, ne chinse chiabo, ase engaki eyemo, ekiagera Omonene Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, nigo arwanerete Abaisraeli.
swahili: Wafalme hawa wote pamoja na nchi zao Yoshua aliwashinda kwa wakati mmoja, kwa sababu Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli, aliwapigania Israeli.

english: Then Joshua returned with all Israel to the camp at Gilgal.
ekegusii: Magega y’ayio Yoshua na Abaisraeli bonsi bakairana Giligali ase batoorete.
swahili: Ndipo Yoshua akarudi pamoja na Israeli yote kwenye kambi huko Gilgali.

english: So the five kings of the Amorites—the kings of Jerusalem, Hebron, Jarmuth, Lachish, and Eglon—joined forces and advanced with all their armies. They camped before Gibeon and made war against it.
ekegusii: Erio abarwoti abwo batano b’Abaamori: oyo o Yerusalemu, na oyo o Heburoni, na oyo o Yarimuti, na oyo o Lakisi, na oyo bw’Egiloni, bagasangererekana amo, bagatiira amo nabarwani babo bonsi, bagaetanana Gibeoni na koyoumokera.
swahili: Ndipo hao wafalme watano wa Waamori, ambao ni wafalme wa Yerusalemu, Hebroni, Yarmuthi, Lakishi na Egloni, wakaunganisha majeshi yao. Wakapanda na vikosi vyao vyote, nao wakajipanga dhidi ya Gibeoni na kuishambulia.

english: Then the men of Gibeon sent word to Joshua in the camp at Gilgal: “Do not abandon your servants. Come quickly and save us! Help us, because all the kings of the Amorites from the hill country have joined forces against us.”
ekegusii: Erio Abagibeoni bagatoma abanto ase Yoshua agwo Giligali ase atoorete komoteebia, “Tototiga intwe abasomba bao! Ayerera, otiire gocha aa, otokonye na gototooria, ekiagera abarwoti bonsi b’Abaamori, abwo bamenyete ase ense y’ebitunwa, basangererekanire gotorwania.”
swahili: Nao Wagibeoni wakatuma ujumbe kwa Yoshua kwenye kambi ya Gilgali na kumwambia, “Usiwatelekeze watumishi wako. Panda haraka uje kwetu kutuokoa! Tusaidie, kwa sababu wafalme wote wa Waamori wakaao kwenye nchi ya vilima wameunganisha majeshi yao pamoja dhidi yetu.”

english: So Joshua and his whole army, including all the mighty men of valor, came from Gilgal.
ekegusii: Ase igo Yoshua na abarwani baye bonsi amo ne chituoni chi’esegi bagatiira korwa Giligali.
swahili: Basi Yoshua akaondoka Gilgali pamoja na jeshi lake lote, wakiwepo watu wote mashujaa wa vita.

english: The LORD said to Joshua, “Do not be afraid of them, for I have delivered them into your hand. Not one of them shall stand against you.”
ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Yoshua, “Tobairoka, nabekire abanto aba ase okoboko kwao, onde tari oranyare gokobua.”
swahili: Bwana akamwambia Yoshua, “Usiwaogope watu hao, nimewatia mkononi mwako. Hakuna yeyote atakayeweza kushindana nawe.”

english: After marching all night from Gilgal, Joshua caught them by surprise.
ekegusii: Obotuko obogima Yoshua agataara korwa Giligali, akaumokera Abaamori mobosokano.
swahili: Baada ya Yoshua kutembea usiku kucha kutoka Gilgali, akawashambulia ghafula.

english: Now when Jabin king of Hazor heard about these things, he sent word to Jobab king of Madon; to the kings of Shimron and Achshaph;
ekegusii: Yabini, omorwoti o Hasori, akaigwa amang’ana ayio. Erio agatoma amang’ana ase Yobabu, omorwoti o Madoni, na ase abarwoti ba Simuroni na ase Akisafu,
swahili: Ikawa Yabini mfalme wa Hazori aliposikia habari za mambo haya, akatuma ujumbe kwa Yobabu mfalme wa Madoni, na kwa mfalme wa Shimroni, na kwa mfalme wa Akishafu,

english: At that time Joshua turned back and captured Hazor and put its king to the sword, because Hazor was formerly the head of all these kingdoms.
ekegusii: Magega y’ayio Yoshua akairana gochia Hasori, akayobwata, agaita omorwoti bw’aroro n’omoro. (Engaki eria Hasori nigo orenge omochie omonene bw’amarwoti aria onsi).
swahili: Wakati huo Yoshua akarudi na kuuteka mji wa Hazori na kumuua mfalme wake kwa upanga. (Hazori ulikuwa mji mkuu wa falme hizo zote.)

english: The Israelites put everyone in Hazor to the sword, devoting them to destruction. Nothing that breathed remained, and Joshua burned down Hazor itself.
ekegusii: Bagaita bonsi abarenge ase omochie oyio ime, bakabasiria kegima, tibatigaria nonya noyomo ore moyo, na omochie obo bakayosamba nomorero.
swahili: Kila aliyekuwa ndani yake wakamuua kwa upanga. Wakawaangamiza kabisa, wala hawakusaza chochote chenye pumzi na akauchoma Hazori kwenyewe kwa moto.

english: Joshua captured all these kings and their cities and put them to the sword. He devoted them to destruction, as Moses the LORD’s servant had commanded.
ekegusii: Nabo Yoshua akaira emechie yonsi y’abarwoti baria, na abarwoti abanyene amo na bonsi abarengeo akabaita nemioro, akabasiria kegima, buna Musa, omosomba bw’Omonene, konya achiikire.
swahili: Yoshua akaiteka hii miji yote ya kifalme pamoja na wafalme wake na kuwapiga kwa upanga. Akawaangamiza kabisa wote, jinsi Mose mtumishi wa Bwana alivyowaagiza.

english: Yet Israel did not burn any of the cities built on their mounds, except Hazor, which Joshua burned.
ekegusii: Abaisraeli tibasambete emechie eyio yaagachetwe ase ebigoro igoro, otatiga Hazori bwoka, noro Yoshua asambete.
swahili: Lakini Israeli hawakuichoma moto hata mojawapo ya miji iliyojengwa katika vilima vyao vidogo isipokuwa mji wa Hazori ambao Yoshua aliuchoma moto.

english: The Israelites took for themselves all the plunder and livestock of these cities, but they put all the people to the sword until they had completely destroyed them, not sparing anyone who breathed.
ekegusii: Abaisraeli bagasakora ebinto bionsi bi’emechie eyio, ne chitugo chionsi bakaira chikaba echiabo. Korende bagaita abanto bonsi nemioro, bakabasiria kegima, tibatigaria nonya noyomo ore moyo.
swahili: Waisraeli wakajichukulia nyara zote na mifugo yote ya miji hii, bali waliwaua watu wote kwa upanga hadi walipowaangamiza kabisa, pasipo kumbakiza yeyote mwenye pumzi.

english: As the LORD had commanded His servant Moses, so Moses commanded Joshua. That is what Joshua did, leaving nothing undone of all that the LORD had commanded Moses. Joshua Takes the Whole Land
ekegusii: Bun’Omonene achigete Musa, omosomba oye, naboigo Musa achigete Yoshua. Na Yoshua agakora ayio onsi, tatigete kende gionsi ase ayio onsi Omonene achigete Musa. Yoshua okoira ense eria
swahili: Kama vile Bwana alivyomwagiza Mose mtumishi wake, vivyo hivyo Mose alimwagiza Yoshua, naye Yoshua akafanya kama vivyo, hakukosa kufanya lolote katika yale yote Bwana aliyomwagiza Mose.

english: So Joshua took this entire region: the hill country, all the Negev, all the land of Goshen, the western foothills, the Arabah, and the mountains of Israel and their foothills,
ekegusii: Yoshua akaira ense eria engima: Ense y’ebitunwa, na Negebu engima, na ense yonsi ya Goseni, na ense omweya, na Ekerubo Ekiomo, amo nebitunwa bi’Abaisraeli na ense omweya y’aroro.
swahili: Yoshua akaiteka nchi hii yote: nchi ya vilima, Negebu yote, eneo yote ya Gosheni, shefela ya upande wa magharibi, Araba na milima ya Israeli pamoja na shefela zao,

english: from Mount Halak, which rises toward Seir, as far as Baal-gad in the Valley of Lebanon at the foot of Mount Hermon. He captured all their kings and struck them down, putting them to death.
ekegusii: Akaira ense eria yonsi gochakeera egetunwa kia Halaki agwo Irianyi, kegotiirerwa gochia Edomu na goikera Baali‐Gadi agwo sugusu ase ebate ya Lebanoni, inse y’egetunwa kia Herimoni. Agoosa abarwoti bonsi b’agwo, akabaaka na kobaita.
swahili: kuanzia Mlima Halaki ambao umeinuka kuelekea Seiri hadi Baal-Gadi katika Bonde la Lebanoni chini ya Mlima Hermoni. Akawateka wafalme wake wote, akawapiga na kuwaua.

english: Joshua waged war against all these kings for a long period of time.
ekegusii: Yoshua konya obeire okorwania abarwoti abwo ase engaki entambe.
swahili: Yoshua akapigana vita dhidi ya wafalme hawa wote kwa muda mrefu.

english: No city made peace with the Israelites except the Hivites living in Gibeon; all others were taken in battle.
ekegusii: Omochie onde tori, nonya noyomo, okorete omorembe na kobwatana n’Abaisraeli, otatiga Gibeoni ase Abahivi bamenyete. Emechie ende yonsi nigo yabuetwe ase esegi eria.
swahili: Hakuna mji wowote katika eneo hili uliofanya mkataba wa amani na Israeli, isipokuwa hao Wahivi wa Gibeoni. Wengine wote walishindwa katika vita.

english: to the kings of the north in the mountains, in the Arabah south of Chinnereth, in the foothills, and in Naphoth-dor to the west;
ekegusii: na ase abarwoti bamenyete sugusu, ase ense y’ebitunwa, na ase Ekerubo Ekiomo, Irianyi ya Galili, na ase ense omweya amo nabwo b’engegu, ang’e na Dori, ensemo ya bosongo.
swahili: na pia kwa wafalme wa upande wa kaskazini wale waliokuwa milimani, katika Araba upande wa kusini mwa Kinerethi, kwenye shefela, upande wa magharibi na katika miinuko ya Nafoth-Dori upande wa magharibi;

english: For it was of the LORD to harden their hearts to engage Israel in battle, so that they would be set apart for destruction and would receive no mercy, being annihilated as the LORD had commanded Moses.
ekegusii: Omonene nere okong’etie chinkoro chiabo ng’a barwanie Abaisraeli, erinde barabwo abanyene basirigwe kegima batari kororerwa amaabera. Nab’Omonene konya achiikire Musa.
swahili: Kwa maana Bwana mwenyewe ndiye aliifanya mioyo yao iwe migumu, ili kupigana vita dhidi ya Israeli ili apate kuwafutilia mbali pasipo huruma, kama Bwana alivyomwagiza Mose.

english: At that time Joshua proceeded to eliminate the Anakim from the hill country of Hebron, Debir, and Anab, and from all the hill country of Judah and of Israel. Joshua devoted them to destruction, along with their cities.
ekegusii: Ase engaki eria Yoshua akagenda gosiria Abanaki, abamenyete ase ense y’ebitunwa, na ase Heburoni, na Debiri, na Anabu, na ase ense yonsi y’ebitunwa bi ’Abayuda na ebi’Abaisraeli, Yoshua akabasiria kegima amo nemechie yabo.
swahili: Wakati huo Yoshua akaenda kuwaangamiza Waanaki kutoka nchi ya vilima: kuanzia Hebroni, Debiri na Anabu, na kutoka nchi yote ya vilima ya Yuda na kutoka nchi yote ya vilima ya Israeli. Yoshua akawaangamiza kabisa pamoja na miji yao.

english: No Anakim were left in the land of the Israelites; only in Gaza, Gath, and Ashdod did any survive.
ekegusii: Abanaki bande tibatigarete ase ense y’Abaisraeli nonya noyomo. Ase Gati, na Asidodi nao bake batigarete.
swahili: Hawakubaki Waanaki wowote katika nchi ya Israeli, ila tu katika nchi ya Gaza, Gathi na Ashdodi.

english: So Joshua took the entire land, in keeping with all that the LORD had spoken to Moses. And Joshua gave it as an inheritance to Israel according to the allotments to their tribes. Then the land had rest from war.
ekegusii: Yoshua akaira ense eria engima, buna Omonene konya achiikire Musa. Akayea Abaisraeli ebe omwando obo, akayiatananera kera egesaku ensemo yaye. Na bono ense eria ekaba nomorembe etari nesegi.
swahili: Hivyo Yoshua akaiteka nchi hiyo yote kama vile Bwana alivyokuwa amemwagiza Mose, naye Yoshua akawapa Israeli kuwa urithi wao, kulingana na walivyogawanyika katika kabila zao. Ndipo nchi ikawa na amani bila vita.

english: to the Canaanites in the east and west; to the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, and Jebusites in the hill country; and to the Hivites at the foot of Hermon in the land of Mizpah.
ekegusii: Naboigo agatoma amang’ana ase Abakanaani ba moocha na bosongo, ase Abaamori na Abahiti, na Abaperisi, na Abayebusi ase ense y’ebitunwa, amo n’Abahivi abamenyete ang’e na Herimoni, egetunwa gi’ense ya Misipa.
swahili: kwa Wakanaani upande wa mashariki na magharibi; kwa Waamori, Wahiti, Waperizi na Wayebusi katika nchi ya vilima; na kwa Wahivi chini ya Hermoni katika eneo ya Mispa.

english: So these kings came out with all their armies, a multitude as numerous as the sand on the seashore, along with a great number of horses and chariots.
ekegusii: Barabwo bagacha nabarwani babo bonsi, omoganda bw’abaanto abange buna omokenye bw’engegu y’enyancha. Nigo barenge ne chibarasi ne chigari chinyinge mono.
swahili: Wakaja na vikosi vyao vyote na hesabu kubwa ya farasi na magari ya kuvutwa na farasi, jeshi kubwa, kama wingi wa mchanga ulio pwani ya bahari.

english: All these kings joined forces and encamped at the waters of Merom to fight against Israel.
ekegusii: Abarwoti abwo bonsi bakabwatana, bakagenda bagatoora amo, ang’e ne chinsoko chia Meromu, ase okorwania Abaisraeli.
swahili: Wafalme hawa wote wakaunganisha majeshi yao na kupiga kambi pamoja kwenye Maji ya Meromu, ili kupigana dhidi ya Israeli.

english: Then the LORD said to Joshua, “Do not be afraid of them, for by this time tomorrow I will deliver all of them slain before Israel. You are to hamstring their horses and burn up their chariots.”
ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Yoshua, “Toiroka abanto aba, ekiagera ankio, engaki buna eye, nimbarue bonsi bakwe ase amaboko ’Abaisraeli. Nainwe monache chibarasi chiabo chinteng’e na mosambe chigari chiabo nomorero.”
swahili: Bwana akamwambia Yoshua, “Usiwaogope, kwa sababu kesho saa kama hii nitawatia wote mikononi mwa Israeli, wakiwa wameuawa. Utakata mishipa ya nyuma ya miguu ya farasi wao na kuyachoma moto magari yao ya vita.”

english: So by the waters of Merom, Joshua and his whole army came upon them suddenly and attacked them,
ekegusii: Yoshua amo nabarwani baye bonsi bakabachiera mobosokano, bakabarwania agwo Meromu, ase chinsoko chiarenge.
swahili: Hivyo Yoshua pamoja na jeshi lake lote wakaja dhidi yao ghafula kwenye Maji ya Meromu kuwashambulia,

english: and the LORD delivered them into the hand of Israel, who struck them down and pursued them all the way to Greater Sidon and Misrephoth-maim, and eastward as far as the Valley of Mizpeh. They struck them down, leaving no survivors.
ekegusii: Na Omonene akababeeka ase amaboko ’Abaisraeli, nabarabwo bakabaumokera na kobaseria gochia Sidoni, omochie omonene, na Misirefoti‐Maimu, na goika ebate ya Misipa, ensemo ya moocha. Bakabaita; monto tatigara nonya noyomo.
swahili: naye Bwana akawatia mikononi mwa Israeli. Wakawashinda na kuwafukuza hadi Sidoni Kuu na kuwafikisha Misrefoth-Maimu, hadi Bonde la Mispa upande wa mashariki, hadi pakawa hakuna yeyote aliyebaki.

english: Joshua treated them as the LORD had told him; he hamstrung their horses and burned up their chariots.
ekegusii: Yoshua akabakora buna Omonene amochigeete; akanacha chibarasi chiabo chinteng’e agasamba chigari chiabo nomorero.
swahili: Yoshua akawatendea kama Bwana alivyoamuru. Akakata mishipa ya nyuma ya miguu ya farasi wao na kuchoma moto magari yao ya vita.

english: Now these are the kings of the land whom the Israelites struck down and whose lands they took beyond the Jordan to the east, from the Arnon Valley to Mount Hermon, including all the Arabah eastward:
ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakabua abarwoti na bakaira ense yarenge ng’umbu, moocha ya Yorodani, korwa rigoko ri’Arinoni goika egetunwa kia Herimoni, amo n’Ekerubo Ekiomo, ensemo ya moocha. Abarwoti abwo nabwo aba:
swahili: Hawa ndio wafalme wa nchi ambao Waisraeli waliwashinda na kuitwaa nchi yao upande wa mashariki mwa Yordani, kuanzia Bonde la Arnoni mpaka Mlima Hermoni, pamoja na eneo lote la upande wa mashariki ya Araba:

english: the king of Jerusalem, one; the king of Hebron, one;
ekegusii: na oyo o Yerusalemu, na oyo o Heburoni,
swahili: mfalme wa Yerusalemu mmoja mfalme wa Hebroni mmoja

english: the king of Jarmuth, one; the king of Lachish, one;
ekegusii: na oyo o Yarimuti, na oyo o Lakisi,
swahili: mfalme wa Yarmuthi mmoja mfalme wa Lakishi mmoja

english: the king of Eglon, one; the king of Gezer, one;
ekegusii: na oyo bw’Egiloni, na oyo o Geseri,
swahili: mfalme wa Egloni mmoja mfalme wa Gezeri mmoja

english: the king of Debir, one; the king of Geder, one;
ekegusii: na oyo o Debiri, na oyo o Gederi,
swahili: mfalme wa Debiri mmoja mfalme wa Gederi mmoja

english: the king of Hormah, one; the king of Arad, one;
ekegusii: na oyo o Horima, na oyo bw’Aradi,
swahili: mfalme wa Horma mmoja mfalme wa Aradi mmoja

english: the king of Libnah, one; the king of Adullam, one;
ekegusii: na oyo o Libuna, na oyo bw’Adulamu,
swahili: mfalme wa Libna mmoja mfalme wa Adulamu mmoja

english: the king of Makkedah, one; the king of Bethel, one;
ekegusii: na oyo o Makeda, na oyo o Beteli,
swahili: mfalme wa Makeda mmoja mfalme wa Betheli mmoja

english: the king of Tappuah, one; the king of Hepher, one;
ekegusii: na oyo o Tapua, na oyo o Heferi,
swahili: mfalme wa Tapua mmoja mfalme wa Heferi mmoja

english: the king of Aphek, one; the king of Lasharon, one;
ekegusii: na oyo bw’Afeki, na oyo o Lasaroni,
swahili: mfalme wa Afeki mmoja mfalme wa Lasharoni mmoja

english: the king of Madon, one; the king of Hazor, one;
ekegusii: na oyo o Madoni, na oyo o Hasori,
swahili: mfalme wa Madoni mmoja mfalme wa Hazori mmoja

english: Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived in Heshbon. He ruled from Aroer on the rim of the Arnon Valley, along the middle of the valley, up to the Jabbok River (the border of the Ammonites), that is, half of Gilead,
ekegusii: Oyomo obo nere Sihoni, omorwoti bw’Abaamori. Ere nigo amenyete Hesiboni, akagamba korwa Aroeri ore ensinyo ye rigoko ri’Arinoni, na korwa gati‐gati ye rigoko riria goika orooche rwa Yaboki, orore ribebe ri’Abaamoni. Ense eyio nekeng’ese kia Gileadi.
swahili: Sihoni mfalme wa Waamori, ambaye alitawala huko Heshboni. Alitawala kuanzia Aroeri kwenye ukingo wa Bonde la Arnoni, kuanzia katikati ya bonde, hadi kwenye Mto Yaboki, ambao ni mpaka wa Waamoni. Hii ilijumlisha nusu ya Gileadi.

english: the king of Shimron-meron, one; the king of Achshaph, one;
ekegusii: na oyo o Simuroni‐Meroni, na oyo bw’Akisafu,
swahili: mfalme wa Shimron-Meroni mmoja mfalme wa Akishafu mmoja

english: the king of Taanach, one; the king of Megiddo, one;
ekegusii: na oyo o Taanaki, na oyo o Megido
swahili: mfalme wa Taanaki mmoja mfalme wa Megido mmoja

english: the king of Kedesh, one; the king of Jokneam in Carmel, one;
ekegusii: na oyo o Kedesi, na oyo o Yokinamu, ang’e na Karimeli,
swahili: mfalme wa Kedeshi mmoja mfalme wa Yokneamu katika Karmeli mmoja

english: the king of Dor in Naphath-dor, one; the king of Goiim in Gilgal, one;
ekegusii: na oyo o Dori, ase orogongo rwa Dori, na oyo o Goimu ase Giligali,
swahili: mfalme wa Dori (katika Nafoth-Dori) mmoja mfalme wa Goimu katika Gilgali mmoja

english: and the king of Tirzah, one. So there were thirty-one kings in all.
ekegusii: na oyo o Tirisa. Abarwoti abwo bonsi nigo barenge emerongo etato nomo (31).
swahili: mfalme wa Tirsa mmoja wafalme jumla yao ilikuwa thelathini na mmoja.

english: as well as the Arabah east of the Sea of Chinnereth to the Sea of the Arabah (the Salt Sea ), eastward through Beth-jeshimoth, and southward below the slopes of Pisgah.
ekegusii: Naende akaba okogamba ase rikura ria Yorodani, moocha y’enyancha ya Galili goika Beti‐Yesimoti, ensemo ya moocha y’Enyancha y’omonyoo, eyere ase orogongo rwa Araba, gochia Irianyi goika ebitirimboko bi’egetunwa gia Pisiga.
swahili: Pia alitawala Araba ya mashariki kuanzia Bahari ya Kinerethi hadi Bahari ya Araba (yaani Bahari ya Chumvi ), hadi Beth-Yeshimothi, kisha kuelekea kusini chini ya materemko ya Pisga.

english: And Og king of Bashan, one of the remnant of the Rephaim, who lived in Ashtaroth and Edrei.
ekegusii: Naende bakabua Ogi, omorwoti o Basani, oyorenge oyomo bw’Abarefai abwo batigarete. Ere nigo amenyete ase Asitaroti na Edirei,
swahili: Nayo nchi ya Ogu mfalme wa Bashani, aliyekuwa mmoja wa mabaki ya Warefai, aliyetawala Ashtarothi na Edrei.

english: He ruled over Mount Hermon, Salecah, all of Bashan up to the border of the Geshurites and Maacathites, and half of Gilead to the border of Sihon king of Heshbon.
ekegusii: akaba okogamba ase egetunwa kia Herimoni, na ase Saleka, na ase Basani engima goika orobebe rw’Abagesuri na Abamaaka, amo nekeng’ese kende kia Gileadi goika orogongo rwa Sihoni, omorwoti o Hesiboni.
swahili: Naye alitawala katika Mlima Hermoni, Saleka, Bashani yote hadi mpaka wa watu wa Geshuri, na watu wa Maaka na nusu ya Gileadi, hadi kwenye mpaka wa Sihoni mfalme wa Heshboni.

english: Moses, the servant of the LORD, and the Israelites had struck them down and given their land as an inheritance to the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh. The Kings Defeated West of the Jordan
ekegusii: Abarwoti abwo konya babuirwe na Musa omosomba bw’Omonene amo n’Abaisraeli. Musa, omosomba bw’Omonene, konya oeire Abareubeni na Abagadi, amo nekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase, ense eria ebe eyabo. Abarwoti babuetwe na Yoshua
swahili: Mose, mtumishi wa Bwana, na Waisraeli wakawashinda. Naye Mose mtumishi wa Bwana akawapa Wareubeni, Wagadi na nusu ya kabila la Manase nchi ya hao wafalme ili iwe milki yao.

english: And these are the kings of the land that Joshua and the Israelites conquered beyond the Jordan to the west, from Baal-gad in the Valley of Lebanon to Mount Halak, which rises toward Seir (according to the allotments to the tribes of Israel, Joshua gave them as an inheritance
ekegusii: Yoshua na Abaisraeli bakabua na goita abarwoti bonsi abamenyete bosongo ya Yorodani, gochakera Baali‐Gadi ase ebate ya Lebanoni goikera egetunwa kia Halaki, kegotiirerwa gochia Edomu. Yoshua agaatananera kera egesaku ki’Abaisraeli ense eria ekaba eyabo.
swahili: Hawa ndio wafalme wa nchi ambao Yoshua na Waisraeli waliwashinda upande wa magharibi mwa Yordani, kuanzia Baal-Gadi katika Bonde la Lebanoni hadi kufikia Mlima Halaki, unaoinuka ukielekea Seiri. (Yoshua alitoa nchi zao kwa makabila ya Israeli iwe urithi wao sawasawa na mgawanyiko wa makabila yao:

english: the hill country, the foothills, the Arabah, the slopes, the wilderness, and the Negev—the lands of the Hittites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites):
ekegusii: Ense eria ekabwaterania ense y’ebitunwa, na ense omweya, na Ekerubo Ekiomo, na ebitirimboko bi’ebitunwa, amo nerooro, na Negebu, na ense y’Abahiti, na ey’Abaamori, na ey’Abakanaani, na ey’Abaperisi, na ey’Abahivi, na ey’Abayebusi. Abarwoti abwo babuetwe nabwo aba:
swahili: nchi ya vilima, shefela, upande wa magharibi, Araba, materemko ya milima, jangwa, na Negebu; nchi za Wahiti, Waamori, Wakanaani, Waperizi, Wahivi na Wayebusi):

english: the king of Jericho, one; the king of Ai, which is near Bethel, one;
ekegusii: Omoruoto o Yeriko, na oyo bwa Ai, ang’e na Beteli,
swahili: mfalme wa Yeriko mmoja mfalme wa Ai (karibu na Betheli) mmoja

english: Now Joshua was old and well along in years, and the LORD said to him, “You are old and well along in years, but very much of the land remains to be possessed.
ekegusii: Bono Yoshua konya ogotire mono. Omonene akamoteebia, “Aye bono kwagotire mono, korende ensemo enene y’ense netigarete etarairwa.
swahili: Yoshua alipokuwa mzee na umri wake ukiwa umesogea sana, Bwana akamwambia, “Wewe ni mzee sana, na bado kumesalia sehemu kubwa sana za nchi ambazo ni za kutwaliwa.

english: and all the cities of Sihon king of the Amorites who reigned in Heshbon, as far as the border of the Ammonites;
ekegusii: amo nemechie yonsi ya Sihoni, omorwoti bw’Abaamori, oria orenge kogambera Hesiboni, goikera orogongo rw’Abaamoni.
swahili: nayo miji yote ya Sihoni mfalme wa Waamori, aliyetawala Heshboni, hadi mpakani mwa Waamoni.

english: also Gilead and the territory of the Geshurites and Maacathites, all of Mount Hermon, and all Bashan as far as Salecah—
ekegusii: Naende ekabwaterania Gileadi na orogongo rw’Abagesuri na orw’Abamaaka, amo negetunwa gionsi kia Herimoni, na Basani yonsi goika Saleka,
swahili: Vilevile ilijumlisha Gileadi, eneo la Wageshuri na Wamaaka, mlima wote wa Hermoni na Bashani yote ikienea hadi Saleka:

english: the whole kingdom of Og in Bashan, who had reigned in Ashtaroth and Edrei and had remained as a remnant of the Rephaim. Moses had struck them down and dispossessed them,
ekegusii: na ime ase Basani oborwoti bwonsi bwa Ogi, oyo orenge kogambera Asitaroti na Edirei. (Ogi nere oyo otigarete korwa ase Abarefai.) Abwo Musa konya abuire na kobaseria.
swahili: yaani ufalme wote wa Ogu katika Bashani, aliyekuwa ametawala katika Ashtarothi na Edrei, na ndiye pekee alisalia kwa Warefai. Mose alikuwa amewashinda na kuteka nchi yao.

english: but the Israelites did not drive out the Geshurites or the Maacathites. So Geshur and Maacath dwell among the Israelites to this day.
ekegusii: Abaisraeli tibaseretie Abagesuri na Abamaaka: barabwo nigo bamenyete ase egati y’Abaisraeli goika reero iga.
swahili: Lakini Waisraeli hawakuwafukuza watu wa Geshuri na wa Maaka, kwa hiyo wanaendelea kuishi miongoni mwa Waisraeli mpaka leo hii.

english: To the tribe of Levi, however, Moses had given no inheritance. The offerings made by fire to the LORD, the God of Israel, are their inheritance, just as He had promised them. Reuben’s Inheritance
ekegusii: Abanto b’egesaku kia Lawi Musa tabaete ensemo ende yonsi ebe omwando obo. Barabwo nigo barabe bakonyora omwando obo obatungetie korwa ase ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa, egekoruegwa ase egesasiimero kia Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, buna Omonene atebeetie Musa.
swahili: Lakini kwa kabila la Lawi, Mose hakupeana urithi, kwa kuwa sadaka za kuteketezwa kwa moto zilizotolewa kwa Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli, ndizo zilizokuwa urithi wao, kama alivyowaahidi.

english: This is what Moses had given to the clans of the tribe of Reuben:
ekegusii: Musa konya oeire kera eamate y’egesaku kia Rubeni ensemo y’ense kobwatekana n’enyomba yabo.
swahili: Haya ndiyo maeneo ambayo Mose alikuwa amewapa kabila la Reubeni ukoo kwa ukoo:

english: The territory from Aroer on the rim of the Arnon Valley, along with the city in the middle of the valley, to the whole plateau beyond Medeba,
ekegusii: Orogongo rwabo nigo rwabwateranetie omochie bw’Aroeri, ang’e ne rigoko ri’Arinoni, amo nomochie ore gati‐gati ye rigoko, na ense eimokererete igoro ere enteremu, yaetanaine Medeba,
swahili: Eneo la Aroeri lililo ukingoni mwa Bonde la Arnoni, na kuanzia mji ulio katikati ya bonde, pia uwanda wote wa juu kupita Medeba

english: to Heshbon and all its cities on the plateau, including Dibon, Bamoth-baal, Beth-baal-meon,
ekegusii: na Hesiboni, na emechie yonsi ase ense eimokererete igoro ere enteremu; Diboni, na Bamoti‐Baali, na Beti‐Baali‐Meoni;
swahili: hadi Heshboni na miji yake yote kwenye uwanda wa juu, ikijumlishwa miji ya Diboni, Bamoth-Baali, Beth-Baal-Meoni,

english: Jahaz, Kedemoth, Mephaath,
ekegusii: Yahasi na Kedemoti, na Mefaati;
swahili: Yahasa, Kedemothi, Mefaathi,

english: Kiriathaim, Sibmah, Zereth-shahar on the hill in the valley,
ekegusii: Kiriataimu, na Sibuma, na Sereti‐Sahari, oyore ase ekegoro kie rigoko;
swahili: Kiriathaimu, Sibma, Sereth-Shahari juu ya kilima kilicho katika bonde,

english: This is the land that remains: All the territory of the Philistines and the Geshurites,
ekegusii: Chinsemo chiatigaire nachio echi: Chinsemo chionsi chi’Abafilisti, na ense yonsi y’Abagesuri.
swahili: “Nchi iliyosalia ni hii: maeneo yote ya Wafilisti na Wageshuri:

english: Beth-peor, the slopes of Pisgah, and Beth-jeshimoth—
ekegusii: Beti‐Peori amo nebitirimboko bi’egetunwa gia Pisiga, na Beti‐Yesimoti;
swahili: Beth-Peori, materemko ya Pisga na Beth-Yeshimothi:

english: all the cities of the plateau and all the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon until Moses killed him and the chiefs of Midian (Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba), the princes of Sihon who lived in the land.
ekegusii: emechie yonsi y’ense eimokererete igoro ere enteremu, na oborwoti bwonsi bwa Sihoni, omorwoti bw’Abaamori, oyio konya ogambeire Hesiboni. Musa konya omobuire ere amo nabanene bonsi b’Abamidiani: Evi, na Rekemu, na Suri, na Huri, na Reba. Abwo bonsi barenge kogamba inse ya Sihoni bamenyete ase ense eria.
swahili: miji yote ya uwanda wa juu na eneo lote la utawala wa Sihoni mfalme wa Waamori, aliyetawala katika Heshboni. Mose alikuwa amemshinda Sihoni, pia watawala wakuu wa Wamidiani, ambao ni Evi, Rekemu, Suri, Huri na Reba, waliokuwa wameungana na Sihoni, ambao waliishi katika nchi ile.

english: The Israelites also killed the diviner Balaam son of Beor along with the others they put to the sword.
ekegusii: Baalamu, omoringoria, mosinto o Beori, nigo arenge oyomo bw’abwo Abaisraeli baitete nemioro.
swahili: Pamoja na wale waliouawa katika vita, Waisraeli walikuwa wamemuua kwa upanga Balaamu mwana wa Beori aliyekuwa mchawi.

english: And the border of the Reubenites was the bank of the Jordan. This was the inheritance of the clans of the Reubenites, including the cities and villages. Gad’s Inheritance
ekegusii: Orooche rwa Yorodani nigo rwarenge orobebe rwa bosongo rw’orogongo rw’egesaku kia Rubeni. Emechie eyio amo nebichie biabo nigo yaatananetwe ase kera eamate y’egesaku kia Rubeni, ekaba omwando obo.
swahili: Mpaka wa Wareubeni ulikuwa ni ukingo wa Mto Yordani. Miji hii na vijiji vyake ndiyo iliyokuwa urithi wa Wareubeni ukoo kwa ukoo.

english: This is what Moses had given to the clans of the tribe of Gad:
ekegusii: Musa konya oeire kera eamate y’egesaku kia Gadi ensemo y’ense eria ebe omwando obo.
swahili: Haya ndiyo maeneo ambayo Mose alikuwa amewapa kabila la Gadi, ukoo kwa ukoo:

english: The territory of Jazer, all the cities of Gilead, and half the land of the Ammonites as far as Aroer, near Rabbah;
ekegusii: Orogongo rwabo nigo rwabwateranetie Yaeseri na emechie yonsi ya Gileadi, na ekeng’ese gi’ense y’Abaamoni goika Aroeri, oyore moocha ya Raba,
swahili: Nchi ya Yazeri, miji yote ya Gileadi na nusu ya nchi ya Amoni iliyoenea hadi Aroeri, karibu na Raba;

english: the territory from Heshbon to Ramath-mizpeh and Betonim, and from Mahanaim to the border of Debir;
ekegusii: na ense korwa Hesiboni goika Ramati‐Misipa na Betonimu, na korwa Mahanaimu goika orobebe rwa Debiri.
swahili: na kuanzia Heshboni mpaka Ramath-Mispa na Betonimu, na kutoka Mahanaimu hadi eneo la Debiri;

english: and in the valley, Beth-haram, Beth-nimrah, Succoth, and Zaphon, with the rest of the kingdom of Sihon king of Heshbon (the territory on the east side of the Jordan up to the edge of the Sea of Chinnereth ).
ekegusii: Ase riranya ria Yorodani orogongo rwabo nigo rwabwateranetie Beti‐Haramu na Beti‐Nimura, na Sukoti, na Safoni, na ensemo eye yatigarete ey’oborwoti bwa Sihoni o Hesiboni. Orooche rwa Yorodani narwo rwarenge orobebe rwabo rwa bosongo gochia sugusu goika enyancha ya Galili.
swahili: na katika bonde, Beth-Haramu, Beth-Nimra, Sukothi na Safoni na sehemu iliyobaki ya eneo la utawala wa Sihoni mfalme wa Heshboni (upande wa mashariki mwa Mto Yordani, eneo inayoishia kwenye Bahari ya Kinerethi ).

english: This was the inheritance of the clans of the Gadites, including the cities and villages. Manasseh’s Eastern Inheritance
ekegusii: Emechie eyio amo nebichie biabo nigo yaatananetwe ase kera eamate y’egesaku kia Gadi ebe omwando obo. Orogongo rw’ Egesaku kia Manase
swahili: Miji hii na vijiji vyake ilikuwa urithi wa kabila la Gadi ukoo kwa ukoo.

english: This is what Moses had given to the clans of the half-tribe of Manasseh, that is, to half the tribe of the descendants of Manasseh:
ekegusii: Musa konya oeire kera eamate y’ekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase ensemo y’ense eyio, koreng’ana ne’nka yabo.
swahili: Haya ndiyo maeneo ambayo Mose alikuwa amewapa hiyo nusu ya kabila la Manase, yaani kwa nusu ya jamaa ya uzao wa Manase, ukoo kwa ukoo:

english: from the Shihor east of Egypt to the territory of Ekron on the north (considered to be Canaanite territory)—that of the five Philistine rulers of Gaza, Ashdod, Ashkelon, Gath, and Ekron, as well as that of the Avvites;
ekegusii: (Ense yonsi gochakeera orooche rwa Sihori, moocha ya Misiri, goikera orobebe rw’Ekironi aria sugusu nigo ebarire ng’a ney’Abakanaani. Abagaambi batano b’Abafilisti nigo bamenyete Gasa, na Asidodi, na Asikeloni, na Gati, na Ekironi.) Naende nero ense y’Abaavi,
swahili: kutoka Mto Shihori ulioko mashariki mwa Misri, kuelekea kaskazini kwenye eneo la Ekroni, ambayo yote ilihesabika kama ya Wakanaani (maeneo yale matano ya watawala wa Kifilisti, ambayo ni Gaza, Ashdodi, Ashkeloni, Gathi na Ekroni: ndiyo nchi ya Waavi);

english: The territory from Mahanaim through all Bashan—all the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, including all the towns of Jair that are in Bashan, sixty cities;
ekegusii: Orogongo rwabo nigo rwachakerete Mahanaimu, na nigo rwabwateranetie Basani engima oborwoti bwonsi bw’Ogi, omorwoti o Basani, amo nemechie yonsi emerongo etano nomo ya Yairi agwo Basani.
swahili: Eneo lililoenea kuanzia Mahanaimu, na kujumlisha Bashani yote, ufalme wote wa Ogu mfalme wa Bashani, makazi yote ya Yairi huko Bashani, miji sitini,

english: half of Gilead; and Ashtaroth and Edrei, the royal cities of Og in Bashan. All this was for the clans of the descendants of Machir son of Manasseh, that is, half of the descendants of Machir.
ekegusii: Orogongo rwabo nigo rwabwateranetie naende ekeng’ese kia Gileadi amo n’Asitaroti, na Edirei, emechie emenene y’oborwoti bw’Ogi, omorwoti o Basani. Eyio nigo yarwetwe ase kera eamate y’ekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Makiri, mosinto o Manase, ekaba omwando obo.
swahili: nusu ya Gileadi, na Ashtarothi na Edrei (miji ya kifalme ya Ogu katika Bashani). Hii ilikuwa kwa ajili ya wazao wa Makiri mwana wa Manase, kwa ajili ya nusu ya wana wa Makiri, ukoo kwa ukoo.

english: These were the portions Moses had given them on the plains of Moab beyond the Jordan, east of Jericho.
ekegusii: Eyio nero emiando Musa aatananete agwo ase ebirubo ebiomo bia Moabu, moocha ya Yorodani, kororia Yeriko.
swahili: Huu ndio urithi alioupeana Mose wakati alipokuwa katika tambarare za Moabu, ngʼambo ya Yordani mashariki mwa Yeriko.

english: To the tribe of Levi, however, Moses had given no inheritance. The LORD, the God of Israel, is their inheritance, just as He had promised them.
ekegusii: Korende Musa taete egesaku kia Lawi ensemo ende yonsi ebe omwando obo. Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, nere obete omwando obo, buna abateebeetie.
swahili: Lakini kwa kabila la Walawi, Mose hakuwapa urithi; Bwana Mungu, Mungu wa Israeli ndiye urithi wao, kama alivyowaahidi.

english: to the south, all the land of the Canaanites, from Mearah of the Sidonians to Aphek, as far as the border of the Amorites;
ekegusii: na gochia Irianyi ense yonsi y’Abakanaani, korwa Meara eyare kogamberwa n’Abasidoni, goika Afeki na goika orobebe rw’Abaamori;
swahili: kuanzia kusini, nchi yote ya Wakanaani, kuanzia Ara ambayo ni ya Wasidoni, ikienea hadi Afeki, na eneo la Waamori,

english: the land of the Gebalites; and all Lebanon to the east, from Baal-gad below Mount Hermon to Lebo-hamath.
ekegusii: ense y’Abagebali amo na Lebanoni yonsi gochia moocha, na korwa Baali‐Gadi inse y’egetunwa kia Herimoni goika enchera ekogenda Hamati.
swahili: eneo la Wagebali; Lebanoni yote kuelekea mashariki, kuanzia Baal-Gadi chini ya Mlima Hermoni hadi Lebo-Hamathi.

english: All the inhabitants of the hill country from Lebanon to Misrephoth-maim—all the Sidonians—I Myself will drive out before the Israelites. Be sure to divide it by lot as an inheritance to Israel, as I have commanded you.
ekegusii: Abasidoni abwo bonsi bamenyete ase ense y’ebitunwa egati y’egetunwa kia Lebanoni na omochie o Misirefoti‐Maimu, inche omonyene nimbaserie barue bosio bw’Abaisraeli. Aye goika bwatananere Abaisraeli ense eyio ebe omwando obo, ase okoyeakera obomera, buna nagochigeete.
swahili: “Na kuhusu wakaaji wote katika maeneo ya milima, kuanzia Lebanoni hadi Misrefoth-Maimu, pamoja na eneo lote la Wasidoni, mimi mwenyewe nitawafukuza watoke mbele ya Waisraeli. Hakikisha umegawa nchi hii kwa Israeli kuwa urithi, kama nilivyokuagiza,

english: Now therefore divide this land as an inheritance to the nine tribes and the half-tribe of Manasseh.” The Inheritance East of the Jordan (Numbers 32:1–42; Deuteronomy 3:12–22)
ekegusii: Ase igo bono atanana ense eye ase egati y’ebisaku kianda amo nekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase, ebe omwando obo.” Chingongo chia Rubeni, na Gadi, na Manase, moocha ya Yorodani
swahili: sasa basi, ligawanye eneo hili kwa yale makabila tisa na ile nusu ya kabila la Manase kuwa urithi.” Mgawanyo Wa Nchi Mashariki Mwa Yordani

english: The other half of Manasseh, along with the Reubenites and Gadites, had received the inheritance Moses had given them beyond the Jordan to the east, just as Moses the servant of the LORD had assigned to them:
ekegusii: Abanto b’egesaku kia Rubeni, na ekia Gadi, amo nekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase, konya bairire ense ere ng’umbu, moocha ya Yorodani ekaba, omwando obo. Eyio nero Musa, omosomba bw’Omonene, konya abaeire.
swahili: Ile nusu nyingine ya Manase, Wareubeni na Wagadi, walishapokea urithi Mose aliokuwa amewapa mashariki mwa Yordani, sawasawa na mtumishi wa Bwana alivyowagawia.

english: The area from Aroer on the rim of the Arnon Valley, along with the city in the middle of the valley, the whole plateau of Medeba as far as Dibon,
ekegusii: Ense yabo nigo yachakerete korwa Aroeri, ang’e ne rigoko ri’Arinoni, na omochie ore gati‐gati ye rigoko riria, ekabwaterania nense eimokererete igoro ere enteremu, korwa Medeba goika Diboni,
swahili: Eneo lao lilienea toka Aroeri, iliyoko ukingoni mwa Bonde la Arnoni kuanzia mji ulio katikati ya bonde, likijumlisha nchi ya uwanda wa juu wote wa Medeba mpaka Diboni,

english: Now these are the portions that the Israelites inherited in the land of Canaan, as distributed by Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun, and the heads of the families of the tribes of Israel.
ekegusii: Echi nachio chingongo Abaisraeli baatananeretwe ase ense ya Kaanani, chibe emiando yabo. Eleazari, Omokuani, amo na Yoshua, mosinto o Nuni, na abateneneri be chiamate chi’ebisaku bi’Abaisraeli bakabaatananera ense ase ogoaka obomera.
swahili: Basi haya ndiyo maeneo Waisraeli waliyopokea kama urithi katika nchi ya Kanaani, ambayo kuhani Eleazari, Yoshua mwana wa Nuni na viongozi wa koo za kabila za Israeli waliwagawia.

english: Now behold, as the LORD promised, He has kept me alive these forty-five years since He spoke this word to Moses, while Israel wandered in the wilderness. So here I am today, eighty-five years old,
ekegusii: Bono rora, emiaka emerongo ene, na etano, yaetire korwa rituko riri’Omonene atebeetie Musa amang’ana ayio, ase engaki eria Abaisraeli baetete ase erooro, n’Omonene ondendire ngendererete koba moyo. Na bono, rora, nabeire nemiaka emerongo etano na etato, na etano,
swahili: “Sasa basi, kama vile Bwana alivyoahidi, ameniweka hai kwa miaka arobaini na mitano tangu wakati alipomwambia Mose jambo hili, wakati Waisraeli wakiwa wanazunguka jangwani. Hivyo mimi hapa leo, nina umri wa miaka themanini na mitano!

english: still as strong today as I was the day Moses sent me out. As my strength was then, so it is now for war, for going out, and for coming in.
ekegusii: na inche nigo inde ne chinguru ching’ana buna chiria nabwate rituko riria Musa antomete. Nonya ndero nabo inde ne chinguru chi’okogenda korwana esegi na echi’okoirana.
swahili: Bado ninazo nguvu kama siku ile Mose aliponituma. Bado ninazo nguvu za kwenda vitani sasa kama vile nilivyokuwa wakati ule.

english: Now therefore give me this hill country that the LORD promised me on that day, for you yourself heard then that the Anakim were there, with great and fortified cities. Perhaps with the LORD’s help I will drive them out, as the LORD has spoken.”
ekegusii: Ase igo, bono ing’a ense eye y’ebitunwa, eye Omonene andierete eira ase rituko riria ng’a nang’e. Nkwaigwete aye omonyene ng’a Abanaki nigo bamenyeteo, na buna emechie yabo yarenge emenene, naende yagiteire chindwaki. Aande nab’Omonene arabe amo nainche, erinde imbaserie, buna Omonene ateebete.”
swahili: Basi nipe nchi hii ya vilima, ambayo Bwana aliniahidi siku ile. Wewe mwenyewe ulisikia wakati ule kwamba Waanaki walikuwako huko na miji yao ilikuwa mikubwa na yenye maboma, lakini, kwa msaada wa Bwana, nitawafukuza watoke huko kama vile alivyonena.”

english: Then Joshua blessed Caleb son of Jephunneh and gave him Hebron as his inheritance.
ekegusii: Erio Yoshua agasesenia Kalebu, mosinto o Yefune, akamoa omochie o Heburoni okaba omwando oye.
swahili: Ndipo Yoshua akambariki Kalebu mwana wa Yefune, na akampa Hebroni kama urithi wake.

english: Therefore Hebron belongs to Caleb son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite as an inheritance to this day, because he wholly followed the LORD, the God of Israel.
ekegusii: Naboigo Kalebu, mosinto o Yefune, Omokenisi, akaegwa Heburoni, okaba omwando oye. Nonya ndero iga ororeria rwaye narwo royobwate, ekiagera ere aigwerete Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli.
swahili: Hivyo Hebroni imekuwa mali ya Kalebu mwana wa Yefune Mkenizi tangu wakati ule, kwa sababu alimwandama Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli, kwa moyo wote.

english: (Hebron used to be called Kiriath-arba, after Arba, the greatest man among the Anakim.) Then the land had rest from war.
ekegusii: Kare Heburoni nigo orenge korokwa Kiriati‐Ariba. Ariba nigo arenge omonto omonene ase Abanaki. Na bono ense eria ekaba nomorembe, etari nesegi.
swahili: (Hebroni uliitwa Kiriath-Arba hapo mwanzo, kutokana na huyo Arba ambaye alikuwa mtu mkuu kupita wote miongoni mwa Waanaki.) Kisha nchi ikawa na amani bila vita.

english: Their inheritance was assigned by lot for the nine and a half tribes, as the LORD had commanded through Moses.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo achigete Musa ng’a obomera boakwe ekero agwatanana ense ase ebisaku biria kianda, amo na keria kende ekeng’ese.
swahili: Urithi wao uligawanywa kwa kura kwa yale makabila tisa na nusu, kama Bwana alivyoamuru Mose.

english: For Moses had given the inheritance east of the Jordan to the other two and a half tribes. But he granted no inheritance among them to the Levites.
ekegusii: Naki Musa konya oeire ebisaku binde bibere na ekeng’ese ense ere ng’umbu, moocha ya Yorodani, ebe omwando obo, korende Abalawi barabwo tibaetwe ense ase egati yabo, ebe omwando obo.
swahili: Mose alikuwa amewapa yale makabila mawili na nusu urithi wao upande wa mashariki mwa Yordani, lakini Walawi hawakupewa urithi miongoni mwa hao wengine,

english: The descendants of Joseph became two tribes, Manasseh and Ephraim. And no portion of the land was given to the Levites, except for cities in which to live, along with pasturelands for their flocks and herds.
ekegusii: Ororeria rwa Yusufu nigo rwarenge ebisaku bibere: Manase na Efraimu. Abalawi tibaetwe orogongo, otatiga baetwe emechie bakomenya, amo nebitii ase chitugo chiabo chiare korisia na ase baare kobeeka ebinto biabo.
swahili: kwa kuwa wana wa Yosefu walikuwa makabila mawili; Manase na Efraimu. Walawi hawakupata mgawo wa ardhi, bali walipewa miji tu kwa ajili ya kuishi, pamoja na maeneo ya malisho kwa ajili ya makundi yao ya kondoo, mbuzi na ngʼombe wao.

english: So the Israelites did as the LORD had commanded Moses, and they divided the land. Caleb Requests Hebron
ekegusii: Naboigo Abaisraeli baatananete ense ase ogoaka obomera, buna Omonene achigete Musa. Kalebu okoegwa Heburoni
swahili: Kwa hiyo Waisraeli wakagawana ile nchi, kama vile Bwana alivyomwagiza Mose. Kalebu Anapewa Mji Wa Hebroni

english: Then the sons of Judah approached Joshua at Gilgal, and Caleb son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite said to him, “You know what the LORD said to Moses the man of God at Kadesh-barnea about you and me.
ekegusii: Engaki eyio abanto bande b’egesaku kia Yuda bakagenda ase Yoshua agwo Giligali. Oyomo bw’abwo, Kalebu, mosinto o Yefune, Omokenisi, akamoteebia, “Nomanyete ay’Omonene atebeetie Musa, omonto oria o Nyasae, igoro yane naye, ekero twarenge Kadeshi‐Barinea.
swahili: Kisha watu wa Yuda wakamwendea Yoshua huko Gilgali, naye Kalebu mwana wa Yefune yule Mkenizi, akamwambia, “Unajua jambo ambalo Bwana alimwambia Mose mtu wa Mungu huko Kadesh-Barnea kukuhusu wewe na mimi.

english: I was forty years old when Moses the servant of the LORD sent me from Kadesh-barnea to spy out the land, and I brought back to him an honest report.
ekegusii: Inche konya nakoorire emiaka emerongo ene ekero Musa, omosomba bw’Omonene, antomete korwa Kadeshi‐Barinea koroota ense eye, na inche nkamorentera amang’ana ’ekeene.
swahili: Nilikuwa na umri wa miaka arobaini, wakati Mose mtumishi wa Bwana, aliponituma kutoka Kadesh-Barnea kuipeleleza hiyo nchi. Nami nikamletea taarifa kama kulingana na nilivyosadiki moyoni.

english: Although my brothers who went with me made the hearts of the people melt with fear, I remained loyal to the LORD my God.
ekegusii: Abanto baria twagendete komo bakagera abanto bakerusia moyo, korende inche nkaba omwegenwa ase okoigwera Omonene, Nyasae one.
swahili: Lakini ndugu zangu tuliopanda nao waliifanya mioyo ya watu iyeyuke kwa hofu. Bali mimi, nilimfuata Bwana Mungu wangu kwa moyo wote.

english: On that day Moses swore to me, saying, ‘Surely the land on which you have set foot will be an inheritance to you and your children forever, because you have wholly followed the LORD my God.’
ekegusii: Rituko riria Musa akandiera eira na gotiana, agateeba: Ekeene, ense eyio amagoro ao atachete nigo erabe omwando oo, na oyo bw’ororeria rwao botambe, ekiagera kwaigwerete Omonene, Nyasae one.
swahili: Hivyo katika siku ile, Mose akaniapia, ‘Nchi ambayo umeikanyaga kwa miguu yako itakuwa urithi wako na wa watoto wako milele, kwa sababu umemfuata Bwana Mungu wangu kwa moyo wote.’

english: Now the allotment for the clans of the tribe of Judah extended to the border of Edom, to the Wilderness of Zin at the extreme southern boundary:
ekegusii: Chiamate chi’egesaku kia Yuda nigo chiaetwe orogongo rwabo ase ensemo ya Irianyi, ang’e norobebe rwa Edomu, ase erooro ya Sini ere Irianyi kegima.
swahili: Mgawo kwa kabila la Yuda, ulienea ukoo kwa ukoo, ukishuka kufikia eneo la Edomu, hadi Jangwa la Sini mwisho kabisa upande wa kusini.

english: The border curled westward from Baalah to Mount Seir, ran along the northern slope of Mount Jearim (that is, Chesalon), went down to Beth-shemesh, and crossed to Timnah.
ekegusii: rogaetanana bosongo ya Baala gochia egetunwa gia Edomu, naende sugusu y’egetunwa kia Yearimu (nakio Kesaloni), na maate gochia Beti‐Semesi na rokabwatia Timuna.
swahili: Kisha ukapinda upande wa magharibi kutoka Baala hadi Mlima Seiri, ukafuatia sambamba mteremko wa kaskazini mwa Mlima Yearimu (yaani Kesaloni), ukaendelea chini hadi Beth-Shemeshi na kukatiza hadi Timna.

english: Then it went out to the northern slope of Ekron, curved toward Shikkeron, proceeded to Mount Baalah, went on to Jabneel, and ended at the Sea.
ekegusii: Orobebe rokagenderera gochia sugusu ase egetunwa gi’Ekironi, rokaonchoka gochia Sikironi, rokabwatia egetunwa kia Baala, naende rogaika Yabuneli, na omoerio rogaika Enyancha Enene,
swahili: Ukaelekea hadi kwenye mteremko wa kaskazini mwa Ekroni, ukageuka kuelekea Shikeroni, ukapita hadi Mlima Baala na kufika Yabineeli. Mpaka ule ukaishia baharini.

english: And the western border was the coastline of the Great Sea. These are the boundaries around the clans of the descendants of Judah. Caleb’s Portion and Conquest (Judges 1:8–26)
ekegusii: eyarenge orobebe rwa bosongo. Abanto be chiamate chia Yuda nabwo bamenyete ase orogongo orwo. Kalebu okobua Heburoni na Debiri
swahili: Mpaka wa magharibi ni pwani ya Bahari Kuu. Hii ndiyo mipaka ya watu wa Yuda kwa koo zao. Nchi Aliyopewa Kalebu (Waamuzi 1:11-15)

english: According to the LORD’s command to him, Joshua gave Caleb son of Jephunneh a portion among the sons of Judah—Kiriath-arba, that is, Hebron. (Arba was the forefather of Anak.)
ekegusii: Kalebu, mosinto o Yefune, akaegwa orogongo rwaye ase egati y’abanto b’egesaku kia Yuda, buna Omonene achigete Yoshua. Akaegwa Kiriati‐Ariba, (nao Heburoni). Ariba nere orenge sokoro y’Anaki.
swahili: Kwa kufuata maagizo ya Bwana kwake, Yoshua alimpa Kalebu mwana wa Yefune sehemu katika Yuda: Kiriath-Arba, yaani Hebroni (Arba alikuwa baba wa zamani wa Anaki).

english: And Caleb drove out from there the three sons of Anak—the descendants of Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai, the children of Anak.
ekegusii: Kalebu agaseria abanto batato b’ororeria rw’Anaki korwa ase omochie oyio. Abanaki abwo nabwo aba: Sesai, na Ahimani, na Talimai.
swahili: Kutoka Hebroni Kalebu alifukuza hao wana watatu wa Anaki, nao ni Sheshai, Ahimani na Talmai, wazao wa Anaki.

english: From there he marched against the inhabitants of Debir (formerly known as Kiriath-sepher).
ekegusii: Korwa agwo agatiira kogenda korwania abanto ba Debiri. (Kare omochie oyio nigo ore korokwa Kiriati‐Seferi).
swahili: Kutoka hapo akaondoka kupigana dhidi ya watu walioishi Debiri (jina la Debiri hapo kwanza uliitwa Kiriath-Seferi).

english: And Caleb said, “To the man who strikes down Kiriath-sepher and captures it, I will give my daughter Acsah in marriage.”
ekegusii: Kalebu akabora, “Onde bwensi oranyare kobua na koira omochie o Kiriati‐Seferi nimoe omoiseke one Asika, abe mokaye.”
swahili: Kalebu akasema, “Nitamwoza binti yangu Aksa kwa mtu atakayeweza kupigana na kuteka Kiriath-Seferi.”

english: So Othniel son of Caleb’s brother Kenaz captured the city, and Caleb gave his daughter Acsah to him in marriage.
ekegusii: Otinieli, mosinto o Kenasi, momura omwabo Kalebu, akaira omochie oyio, na Kalebu akamoa omoiseke oye, akaba mokaye.
swahili: Basi Othnieli mwana wa Kenazi, ndugu yake Kalebu, akauteka; hivyo Kalebu akamtoa Aksa binti yake aolewe naye.

english: One day Acsah came to Othniel and urged him to ask her father for a field. When she got off her donkey, Caleb asked her, “What do you desire?”
ekegusii: Ekero Asika achete bw’Otinieli, akamobooria asabe ise amoe oboremo. Asika akaayerera goika korwa ase etigere igoro. Erio Kalebu akamobooria, “Inki otagete?”
swahili: Siku moja Aksa alipokuja kwa Othnieli, alimsihi Othnieli amwombe baba yake, Kalebu, shamba. Aksa aliposhuka kutoka juu ya punda wake, Kalebu akamuuliza, “Je, wataka nikufanyie nini?”

english: “Give me a blessing,” she answered. “Since you have given me land in the Negev, give me springs of water as well.” So Caleb gave her both the upper and lower springs. The Cities of Judah
ekegusii: Asika akairaneria, “Nekeegwa ntagete, ekiagera ngwansogetie okang’ira ase ense enyomo ya Negebu. Ase ayio, ong’e chinsoko chi’amaache.” Kalebu akamoa chinsoko chia rogoro amo nechia maate. Emechie y’Abayuda
swahili: Akamjibu, “Naomba unifanyie jambo moja la hisani. Kwa kuwa umenipa ardhi huko Negebu, nipe pia chemchemi za maji.” Basi Kalebu akampa chemchemi za juu na za chini. Miji Ya Yuda

english: Their southern border started at the bay on the southern tip of the Salt Sea,
ekegusii: Orobebe rwabo rwa Irianyi nigo rwachakerete ase ensinyo y’Enyancha y’omonyoo ensemo ya Irianyi,
swahili: Mpaka wao wa kusini ulianzia kwenye ghuba iliyoko kwenye ncha ya kusini mwa Bahari ya Chumvi,

english: This is the inheritance of the clans of the tribe of Judah.
ekegusii: Oyo noro omwando bwe chiamate chi’egesaku kia Yuda.
swahili: Huu ndio urithi wa kabila la Yuda, ukoo kwa ukoo:

english: These were the southernmost cities of the tribe of Judah in the Negev toward the border of Edom: Kabzeel, Eder, Jagur,
ekegusii: Emechie yabo eyarenge ensinyo kegima ya Irianyi ang’e norobebe rw’Edomu, nigo yarenge: Kabuseli, na Ederi, na Yaguri,
swahili: Miji ya kusini kabisa ya kabila la Yuda katika Negebu kuelekea mpaka wa Edomu ilikuwa: Kabseeli, Ederi, Yaguri,

english: Kinah, Dimonah, Adadah,
ekegusii: Na Kina, na Dimona, na Adada,
swahili: Kina, Dimona, Adada,

english: Kedesh, Hazor, Ithnan,
ekegusii: na Kedesi, na Hazori, na Itinani,
swahili: Kedeshi, Hazori, Ithnani,

english: Ziph, Telem, Bealoth,
ekegusii: na Sifu, na Telemu, na Bealoti,
swahili: Zifu, Telemu, Bealothi,

english: Hazor-hadattah, Kerioth-hezron (that is, Hazor),
ekegusii: na Hasori‐Hadata, na Kerioti‐Hezironi (noro Hasari),
swahili: Hazor-Hadata, Kerioth-Hezroni (yaani Hazori),

english: Amam, Shema, Moladah,
ekegusii: na Amamu, na Sema, na Molada,
swahili: Amamu, Shema, Molada,

english: Hazar-gaddah, Heshmon, Beth-pelet,
ekegusii: na Hasari‐Gada, na Hesimoni, na Beti‐Peleti,
swahili: Hasar-Gada, Heshmoni, Beth-Peleti,

english: Hazar-shual, Beersheba, Biziothiah,
ekegusii: na Hasari‐Saulo, na Beeri‐Seba, na Bisiotia,
swahili: Hasar-Shuali, Beer-Sheba, Biziothia,

english: Baalah, Iim, Ezem,
ekegusii: na Baala, na Iyimu, na Esemu,
swahili: Baala, Iyimu, Esemu,

english: proceeded south of the Ascent of Akrabbim, continued on to Zin, went over to the south of Kadesh-barnea, ran past Hezron up to Addar, and curved toward Karka.
ekegusii: rokagenderera gochia Irianyi y’egetunwa ki’Ebiuge, na goetera Sini gochia Irianyi ya Kadeshi‐Barinea, naende rogaeta Hezironi, rogatiira gochia Adari, rokaonchoka rogaika Karika,
swahili: ukakatiza kusini mwa Akrabimu, ukaendelea hadi Sini ukaenda hadi kusini mwa Kadesh-Barnea. Tena ukapitia Hesroni ukapanda hadi Adari na ukapinda hadi Karka.

english: Eltolad, Chesil, Hormah,
ekegusii: na Elitoladi, na Kesili, na Horima,
swahili: Eltoladi, Kesili, Horma,

english: Ziklag, Madmannah, Sansannah,
ekegusii: na Sikilagi, na Madimana, na Sanisana,
swahili: Siklagi, Madmana, Sansana,

english: Lebaoth, Shilhim, Ain, and Rimmon—twenty-nine cities in all, along with their villages.
ekegusii: na Lebaoti, na Silihimu, na Aini, na Rimoni, emechie emerongo ebere na kianda, amo nebichie biabo.
swahili: Lebaothi, Shilhimu, Aini na Rimoni; hiyo yote ni miji ishirini na tisa, pamoja na vijiji vyake.

english: These were in the foothills: Eshtaol, Zorah, Ashnah,
ekegusii: Ase ense omweya nero Esitaoli, na Sora, na Asina,
swahili: Kwenye shefela ya magharibi: Eshtaoli, Sora, Ashna,

english: Zanoah, En-gannim, Tappuah, Enam,
ekegusii: na Sanoa, na Eni‐Ganimu, na Tapua, na Enamu,
swahili: Zanoa, En-Ganimu, Tapua, Enamu,

english: Jarmuth, Adullam, Socoh, Azekah,
ekegusii: na Yarimuti, na Adulamu, na Soko, na Aseka,
swahili: Yarmuthi, Adulamu, Soko, Azeka,

english: Shaaraim, Adithaim, and Gederah (or Gederothaim)—fourteen cities, along with their villages.
ekegusii: na Saaraimu, na Aditaimu, na Gedera, na Gederotaimu, emechie ikomi na ene, amo nebichie biabo.
swahili: Shaaraimu, Adithaimu na Gedera (au Gederothaimu); yote ni miji kumi na minne, pamoja na vijiji vyake.

english: Zenan, Hadashah, Migdal-gad,
ekegusii: Naende yarengeo Senani, na Hadasa, na Migidali‐Gadi,
swahili: Senani, Hadasha, Migdal-Gadi,

english: Dilan, Mizpeh, Joktheel,
ekegusii: na Diliani, na Misipe, na Yokiteli,
swahili: Dileani, Mispa, Yoktheeli,

english: Lachish, Bozkath, Eglon,
ekegusii: na Lakisi, na Bosikati, na Egiloni,
swahili: Lakishi, Boskathi, Egloni,

english: It proceeded to Azmon, joined the Brook of Egypt, and ended at the Sea. This was their southern border.
ekegusii: rokagenderera gochia Asimoni rokabwatia orooche rw’orobebe rwa Misiri goika Enyancha Enene ase rwatwomerete. Oro narwo orobebe rw’Abayuda, ensemo ya Irianyi.
swahili: Kisha ukaendelea mpaka Azmoni na kuunganika na Kijito cha Misri, na kuishia baharini. Huu ndio mpaka wao wa upande wa kusini.

english: Cabbon, Lahmas, Chitlish,
ekegusii: na Kaboni, na Lamasi, na Kitilisi,
swahili: Kaboni, Lamasi, Kitlishi,

english: Gederoth, Beth-dagon, Naamah, and Makkedah—sixteen cities, along with their villages.
ekegusii: na Gederoti, na Beti‐Dagoni, na Naama, na Makeda, emechie ikomi, na etano nomo, amo nebichie biabo.
swahili: Gederothi, Beth-Dagoni, Naama na Makeda; yote ni miji kumi na sita pamoja na vijiji vyake.

english: Libnah, Ether, Ashan,
ekegusii: Naende yarengeo Libuna, na Eteri, na Asani,
swahili: Libna, Etheri, Ashani,

english: Iphtah, Ashnah, Nezib,
ekegusii: na Yifuta, na Asina, na Nesibu,
swahili: Yifta, Ashna, Nesibu,

english: Keilah, Achzib, and Mareshah—nine cities, along with their villages.
ekegusii: na Keila, na Akisibu, na Maresa, emechie kianda, amo nebichie biabo.
swahili: Keila, Akzibu na Maresha; yote ni miji tisa pamoja na vijiji vyake.

english: Ekron, with its towns and villages;
ekegusii: Norengeo Ekironi, amo nemechie na ebichie biaye;
swahili: Ekroni, pamoja na viunga vyake na vijiji vyake;

english: from Ekron to the sea, all the cities near Ashdod, along with their villages;
ekegusii: na korwa Ekironi gochia Enyancha Enene emechie yonsi yarengeo ensemo y’Asidodi, amo nebichie biaye.
swahili: magharibi ya Ekroni, maeneo yote yaliyokuwa karibu na Ashdodi, pamoja na vijiji vyake;

english: Ashdod, with its towns and villages; Gaza, with its towns and villages, as far as the Brook of Egypt and the coastline of the Great Sea.
ekegusii: Naende yarengeo Asidoli na Gasa amo nemechie na ebichie biabo, goika orooche orore orobebe rwa Misiri, naende goika engegu y’Enyancha Enene.
swahili: Ashdodi, miji yake na vijiji vyake na Gaza viunga vyake na vijiji vyake, hadi kufikia Kijito cha Misri na Pwani ya Bahari Kuu.

english: These were in the hill country: Shamir, Jattir, Socoh,
ekegusii: Na ase ense y’ebitunwa nigo yarengeo: Samiri, na Yatiri, na Soko,
swahili: Katika nchi ya vilima: Shamiri, Yatiri, Soko,

english: Dannah, Kiriath-sannah (that is, Debir),
ekegusii: na Dana, na Kiriati‐Sana (noro Debiri),
swahili: Dana, Kiriath-Sana (yaani Debiri),

english: The eastern border was the Salt Sea as far as the mouth of the Jordan. The northern border started from the bay of the sea at the mouth of the Jordan,
ekegusii: Orobebe rwa moocha nigo rwabwatetie Enyancha y’omonyoo goika ensemo yaye ya sugusu ase orooche rwa Yorodani ronuchete. Orobebe rwa sugusu nigo rwachakerete aroro,
swahili: Mpaka wa upande wa mashariki ni Bahari ya Chumvi ukienea mahali Mto Yordani unapoingilia. Mpaka wa upande wa kaskazini ulianzia penye ghuba ya bahari mahali Mto Yordani unapoingilia,

english: Anab, Eshtemoh, Anim,
ekegusii: na Anabu, na Esitemoa, na Animu,
swahili: Anabu, Eshtemoa, Animu,

english: Goshen, Holon, and Giloh—eleven cities, along with their villages.
ekegusii: na Goseni, na Holoni, na Gilo, emechie ikomi nomo, amo nebichie biabo.
swahili: Gosheni, Holoni na Gilo; miji kumi na mmoja pamoja na vijiji vyake.

english: Arab, Dumah, Eshan,
ekegusii: Naende yarengeo Arabu, na Duma, na Esani,
swahili: Arabu, Duma, Ashani,

english: Janim, Beth-tappuah, Aphekah,
ekegusii: na Yanumu, na Beti‐Tapua, na Afeka,
swahili: Yanimu, Beth-Tapua, Afeka,

english: Humtah, Kiriath-arba (that is, Hebron), and Zior—nine cities, along with their villages.
ekegusii: na Humuta, na Kiriati‐Ariba (noro Heburoni), na Sihori, emechie kianda, amo nebichie biabo.
swahili: Humta, Kiriath-Arba (yaani Hebroni), na Siori; miji tisa pamoja na vijiji vyake.

english: Maon, Carmel, Ziph, Juttah,
ekegusii: Naende yarengeo Maoni, na Karimeli, na Sifu, na Yuta,
swahili: Maoni, Karmeli, Zifu, Yuta,

english: Jezreel, Jokdeam, Zanoah,
ekegusii: na Yesireeli, na Yokidamu, na Sanoa,
swahili: Yezreeli, Yokdeamu, Zanoa,

english: Kain, Gibeah, and Timnah—ten cities, along with their villages.
