ekegusii: na Kaini, na Gibea, na Timuna, emechie ikomi, amo nebichie biabo.
swahili: Kaini, Gibea na Timna; miji kumi pamoja na vijiji vyake.

english: Halhul, Beth-zur, Gedor,
ekegusii: Naende yarengeo Halihuli, na Beti‐Suri, na Gedori,
swahili: Halhuli, Beth-Suri, Gedori,

english: Maarath, Beth-anoth, and Eltekon—six cities, along with their villages.
ekegusii: na Maarati, na Beti‐Anoti, na Elitekoni, emechie etano nomo, amo nebichie biabo.
swahili: Maarathi, Beth-Anothi na Eltekoni; miji sita pamoja na vijiji vyake.

english: went up to Beth-hoglah, proceeded north of Beth-arabah, and went up to the Stone of Bohan son of Reuben.
ekegusii: rokagenderera gochia Beti‐Hogila, rogaeta sugusu ya Beti‐Araba. Erio rogaika Rigena ria Bohani, mosinto o Rubeni,
swahili: ukapanda hadi Beth-Hogla, na kuendelea kaskazini mwa Beth-Araba hadi kwenye Jiwe la Bohani mwana wa Reubeni.

english: Kiriath-baal (that is, Kiriath-jearim), and Rabbah—two cities, along with their villages.
ekegusii: Naende yarengeo Kiriati‐Baali (noro Kiriati‐Yearimu), na Raba, emechie ebere, amo nebichie biabo.
swahili: Kiriath-Baali (yaani Kiriath-Yearimu) na Raba; miji miwili pamoja na vijiji vyake.

english: These were in the wilderness: Beth-arabah, Middin, Secacah,
ekegusii: Na aria ase erooro nigo yarengeo: Beti‐Araba, na Midini, na Sekaka,
swahili: Huko jangwani: Beth-Araba, Midini, Sekaka,

english: Nibshan, the City of Salt, and En-gedi—six cities, along with their villages.
ekegusii: na Nibusani, na Omochie bw’Omonyoo, na Eni‐Gedi, emechie etano nomo, amo nebichie biabo.
swahili: Nibshani, Mji wa Chumvi, na En-Gedi; miji sita pamoja na vijiji vyake.

english: But the descendants of Judah could not drive out the Jebusites living in Jerusalem. So to this day the Jebusites live there among the descendants of Judah.
ekegusii: Korende Abayuda tibanyarete goseria Abayebusi, abamenyete Yerusalemu. Ase igo Abayebusi nigo bamenyete amo n’Abayuda goika reero iga.
swahili: Yuda hakuweza kuwafukuza Wayebusi, waliokuwa wakiishi Yerusalemu; hadi leo Wayebusi huishi huko pamoja na watu wa Yuda.

english: Then the border went up to Debir from the Valley of Achor, turning north to Gilgal, which faces the Ascent of Adummim south of the ravine. It continued along the waters of En-shemesh and came out at En-rogel.
ekegusii: na rokagenda korwa ebate eria y’Akori goika Debiri, naende rokaonchoka sugusu gochia Giligali kororia Adumini, Irianyi y’ebate eria. Naende rokagenderera goika chinsoko chia Eni‐Semesi rogaika ase ensoko ya Eni‐Rogeli. Erio rokagenderera goika chinsoko chia Eni‐Semesi, na goika ensoko ya Eni‐Rogeli.
swahili: Kisha mpaka ulipanda hadi Debiri kutoka Bonde la Akori na kugeuka kaskazini hadi Gilgali inayotazamana na materemko ya Adumimu, kusini mwa bonde. Ukaendelea sambamba hadi maji ya En-Shemeshi na kutokeza huko En-Rogeli.

english: From there the border went up the Valley of Hinnom along the southern slope of the Jebusites (that is, Jerusalem) and ascended to the top of the hill that faces the Valley of Hinnom on the west, at the northern end of the Valley of Rephaim.
ekegusii: Erio rokagenderera gochia rikura ria mosinto o Hinomu, Irianyi y’egetunwa kia Yebusi, nao Yerusalemu. Magega y’ayio rogatiira gochia egetunwa igoro, ekio kerochie Rikura ria Hinomu, ensemo ya bosongo, sugusu y’ense omweremo ya Refaimu.
swahili: Kisha ukapanda kwa kufuata Bonde la Ben-Hinomu sambamba na mteremko wa kusini wa mji mkubwa wa Wayebusi (yaani Yerusalemu). Kutoka hapo ukapanda juu ya kilima magharibi ya Bonde la Hinomu mwisho wa ncha ya kaskazini mwa Bonde la Warefai.

english: From the hilltop the border curved to the spring of the Waters of Nephtoah, proceeded to the cities of Mount Ephron, and then bent around toward Baalah (that is, Kiriath-jearim).
ekegusii: Korwa egetunwa igoro orobebe rogatirimboka gochia ensoko ya Nefitoa, na korwa agwo rogaikera emechie ang’e negetunwa gia Efuroni. Agwo rokaonchoka gochia Baala, (noro Kiriati‐Yearimu),
swahili: Kutoka juu ya kilima mpaka ule ukaendelea hadi kwenye chemchemi ya maji ya Neftoa, ukatokea kwenye miji ya Mlima Efroni na kuteremka kuelekea Baala (yaani Kiriath-Yearimu).

english: The allotment for the descendants of Joseph extended from the Jordan at Jericho to the waters of Jericho on the east, through the wilderness that goes up from Jericho into the hill country of Bethel.
ekegusii: Orobebe rw’orogongo roria obomera bwagwerete ororeria rwa Yusufu rogaachakera orooche rwa Yorodani, ang’e na Yeriko, moocha ye chinsoko chi’aroro goika erooro, rogatiira korwa Yeriko goetera ase erooro gochia ase ense y’ebitunwa ya Beteli.
swahili: Mgawanyo wa Yosefu ulianzia Yordani ya Yeriko, mashariki mwa miji ya Yeriko na kutoka hapo ulipanda kupitia jangwani na kuingia katika nchi ya vilima ya Betheli.

english: But they did not drive out the Canaanites who lived in Gezer. So the Canaanites dwell among the Ephraimites to this day, but they are forced laborers.
ekegusii: Korende barabwo tibaseretie Abakaanani abwo bamenyete Geseri. Ase ayio Abakaanani nao bamenyete amo n’Abaefraimu, naboigo nao bare nonya ngoika reero iga. Korende mbakoretwe bakaba abasomba babo bogokora emeremo emekong’u.
swahili: Hawakuwatoa Wakanaani waishio Gezeri; mpaka leo Wakanaani wanaishi miongoni mwa watu wa Efraimu lakini wanatakiwa kufanya kazi ngumu za kulazimishwa.

english: It went on from Bethel (that is, Luz) and proceeded to the border of the Archites in Ataroth.
ekegusii: Korwa Beteli rokagenda Lusu, rogatiira gochia Ataroti ase Abaariki bamenyete.
swahili: Ukaendelea kutoka Betheli (ndiyo Luzu), ukavuka kuingia eneo la Waariki huko Atarothi,

english: Then it descended westward to the border of the Japhletites as far as the border of Lower Beth-horon and on to Gezer, and it ended at the Sea.
ekegusii: Erio rogatirimboka gochia ase ense y’Abayafeleti goika Beti‐Horoni ya maate, na goika Geseri, naende rogatwomera Enyancha Enene.
swahili: ukateremkia kuelekea magharibi hadi eneo la Wayafleti ukienea hadi eneo la Beth-Horoni ya Chini hadi Gezeri, ukiishia baharini.

english: So Ephraim and Manasseh, the sons of Joseph, received their inheritance.
ekegusii: Orogongo orwo narwo omwando bw’ebisaku bia Manase na Efraimu, ebi’ororeria rwa Yusufu.
swahili: Kwa hiyo Manase na Efraimu, wazao wa Yosefu, walipokea urithi wao.

english: This was the territory of the descendants of Ephraim by their clans: The border of their inheritance went from Ataroth-addar in the east to Upper Beth-horon
ekegusii: Oro narwo orogongo rwe chiamate chi’egesaku gi’Efraimu: Orobebe rwabo rwa moocha rogaachakeera Ataroti‐Adari, rokagenderera goika Beti‐Horoni ya rogoro,
swahili: Hili ndilo lilikuwa eneo la Efraimu, ukoo kwa ukoo: Mpaka wa urithi wao ulianzia Ataroth-Adari upande wa mashariki hadi Beth-Horoni ya Juu,

english: and out toward the Sea. From Michmethath on the north it turned eastward toward Taanath-shiloh and passed by it to Janoah on the east.
ekegusii: na korwa aroro goika Enyancha Enene. Mikimetati noro orenge orobebe rw’ensemo ya sugusu. Korwa Mikimetati orobebe rokaonchoka gochia moocha, rogaika Taanati‐Silo, rogaeta ase omochie oyio, rokagenderera gochia moocha, rogaika Yanoa.
swahili: na kuendelea mpaka baharini. Kutoka Mikmeta upande wa kaskazini ulipinda kuelekea mashariki hadi Taanath-Shilo, ukiupita hadi Yanoa upande wa mashariki.

english: From Janoah it went down to Ataroth and Naarah, and then reached Jericho and came out at the Jordan.
ekegusii: Korwa Yanoa rogatirimboka gochia Ataroti na Naara, erio rogatwomera Yeriko, na korwa aroro rogaika Yorodani.
swahili: Kisha uliteremka kutoka Yanoa hadi Atarothi na Naara, ukagusa Yeriko na kutokea katika Mto Yordani.

english: From Tappuah the border went westward to the Brook of Kanah and ended at the Sea. This was the inheritance of the clans of the tribe of Ephraim,
ekegusii: Korwa Tapua rokagenderera gochia bosongo, rogaika akarooche ga Kana, naende rogaika Enyancha Enene ase rwatwomerete. Oro narwo orogongo chiamate chi’ebisaku bi’Efraimu chianyorete, rokaba omwando obo,
swahili: Kutoka Tapua mpaka ulikwenda magharibi hadi Bonde la Kana na kuishia baharini. Huu ulikuwa ndio urithi wa kabila la Waefraimu, ukoo kwa ukoo.

english: along with all the cities and villages set apart for the descendants of Ephraim within the inheritance of Manasseh.
ekegusii: amo nemechie na ebichie barabwo baatananeretwe, ebiarenge ase orogongo rw’egesaku kia Manase.
swahili: Pia ulijumuisha miji yote na vijiji vyake ambavyo vilitengwa kwa ajili ya Waefraimu ndani ya urithi wa kabila la Manase.

english: Now this was the allotment for the tribe of Manasseh as Joseph’s firstborn son, namely for Machir the firstborn of Manasseh and father of the Gileadites, who had received Gilead and Bashan because Machir was a man of war.
ekegusii: Orogongo oro narwo rwaetwe egesaku kia Manase, omwana omomura omotangi o Yusufu ase ogoakerwa obomera, Makiri, ise Gileadi, nigo arenge omwana omomura omotangi o Manase. Ororeria rwaye rokaegwa Gileadi na Basani, ekiagera Makiri nigo arenge omonto etuoni y’esegi.
swahili: Huu ndio mgawo wa kabila la Manase kama mzaliwa wa kwanza wa Yosefu, yaani kwa ajili ya Makiri, mzaliwa wa kwanza wa Manase. Makiri alikuwa baba wa Wagileadi, ambao walipokea Gileadi na Bashani kwa sababu Wamakiri walikuwa askari wakuu.

english: Ephraim’s territory was to the south, and Manasseh’s was to the north, having the Sea as its border and adjoining Asher on the north and Issachar on the east.
ekegusii: Ensemo ya Irianyi nense y’Efraimu, na ensemo ya sugusu neya Manase yarenge. Enyancha Enene nero yarenge orobebe rwabo ensemo ya bosongo. Ensemo ya sugusu bagasinyana nabaanto b’Aseri, na ensemo ya moocha naba Isakaru.
swahili: Nchi ya kusini ilikuwa ya Efraimu, na ile iliyokuwa upande wa kaskazini ilikuwa ya Manase. Eneo la Manase lilifika bahari na ikapakana na Asheri upande wa kaskazini, na Isakari upande wa mashariki.

english: Within Issachar and Asher, Manasseh was assigned Beth-shean, Ibleam, Dor (that is, Naphath), Endor, Taanach, and Megiddo, each with their surrounding settlements.
ekegusii: Ase orogongo rwa Isakaru na orw’Aseri Manase akaegwa Beti‐Sehani, na Ibileamu, amo nebichie biabo. Naende akaegwa abanto ba Dori, na Eni‐Dori, na Taanaki, na Megido, amo nebichie b’emechie eyio, na Nafati, ensemo ya gatato.
swahili: Katika Isakari na Asheri Manase alikuwa na miji pia: Beth-Shani, Ibleamu na watu wa Dori, Endori, Taanaki na Megido, pamoja na vijiji vyote vinavyohusika na miji hiyo (ya tatu katika orodha ni Nafothi).

english: But the descendants of Manasseh were unable to occupy these cities, because the Canaanites were determined to stay in this land.
ekegusii: Abanto ba Manase tibanyarete goseria Abakanaani b’emechie eyio. Ase igo Abakanaani bakagenderera komenya ase ense eria.
swahili: Lakini Wamanase hawakuweza kuimiliki miji hii, kwa kuwa Wakanaani walikazana kuishi katika maeneo hayo.

english: However, when the Israelites grew stronger, they put the Canaanites to forced labor; but they failed to drive them out completely.
ekegusii: Ekero Abaisraeli babete ne chinguru kobua bakaa Abakaanani baria emeremo emekong’u, korende tibaabaseretie kegima.
swahili: Hata hivyo, Waisraeli walivyoendelea kupata nguvu waliwatumikisha Wakanaani na kuwatia katika kazi za kulazimishwa, lakini hawakuwafukuza kabisa. Kabila La Yosefu Lakataa

english: Then the sons of Joseph said to Joshua, “Why have you given us only one portion as an inheritance? We have many people, because the LORD has blessed us abundantly.”
ekegusii: Abanto b’egesaku kia Yusufu bagakwana na Yoshua, bakamoteebia, “Nase ki gwatoeire ensemo eyemo yoka ebe omwando oito? Intwe nigo tore abanto abange, ekiagera Omonene otosesenirie.”
swahili: Watu wa Yosefu wakamwambia Yoshua, “Kwa nini umetupa sisi mgawo mmoja tu na sehemu moja tu kuwa urithi? Sisi tu watu wengi sana, na Bwana ametubariki kwa wingi.”

english: Joshua answered them, “If you have so many people that the hill country of Ephraim is too small for you, go to the forest and clear for yourself an area in the land of the Perizzites and the Rephaim.”
ekegusii: Yoshua akabairaneria, “Onye more abange igo, na ensemo y’ebitunwa bi’Efraimu tebaisaini, tiira gochia rinani, morirabie, na momenye aroro ase ense y’Abaperisi na ey’Abarefai.”
swahili: Yoshua akajibu, “Kama ninyi ni wengi sana, na kama nchi ya vilima ya Efraimu ni ndogo sana kwenu, pandeni msituni mkafyeke eneo kwa ajili yenu wenyewe huko kwenye nchi ya Waperizi na Warefai.”

english: “The hill country is not enough for us,” they replied, “and all the Canaanites who live in the valley have iron chariots, both in Beth-shean with its towns and in the Valley of Jezreel.”
ekegusii: Barabwo bakairaneria, “Ense eria y’ebitunwa tegotoisana, na Abakanaani abamenyete ase ense omweya nigo babwate chigari chi’ebioma, abwo bamenyete Beti‐Sehani na ebichie bire inse yabo, amo nabwo bamenyete ase ense omweremo ya Yesireeli boigo.”
swahili: Watu wa Yosefu wakajibu, “Hiyo nchi ya vilima haitutoshi, nao Wakanaani wote wanaoishi katika tambarare wanayo magari ya vita ya chuma, wote wa Beth-Shani na miji yake, na wale walio katika Bonde la Yezreeli.”

english: So Joshua said to the house of Joseph—to Ephraim and Manasseh—“You have many people and great strength. You shall not have just one allotment,
ekegusii: Yoshua agateebia abanto b’ebisaku bi’Efraimu na Manase (abw’ororeria rwa Yusufu), “Amaene, inwe nabaanto abange more, naende nigo more ne chinguru. Ase ayio, ensemo eyemo yoka tekobaisana ase okomenya.
swahili: Lakini Yoshua akanena na nyumba ya Yosefu, yaani Efraimu na Manase: “Ninyi ni wengi sana na wenye nguvu sana. Hamtakuwa na mgawo mmoja tu,

english: because the hill country will be yours as well. It is a forest; clear it, and its farthest limits will be yours. Although the Canaanites have iron chariots and although they are strong, you can drive them out.”
ekegusii: Ense y’ebitunwa nabo erabe eyaino. Nonya ere ne rinani, genda moyerabie, moyeire engima ebe eyaino, korwa ensemo eyemo goika eyende. Goika moserie Abakanaani korwa aroro nonya babwate chigari chi’ebioma, naende bare ne chinguru.”
swahili: bali pia nchi hii ya kilima yenye msitu. Ifyekeni, nayo mipaka yake itakuwa yenu umbali mtakaoweza kufika. Ingawa Wakanaani wana magari ya chuma, nao wana nguvu, mwaweza kuwafukuza humo.”

english: So this allotment was for the rest of the descendants of Manasseh—the clans of Abiezer, Helek, Asriel, Shechem, Hepher, and Shemida. These are the other male descendants of the clans of Manasseh son of Joseph.
ekegusii: Abanto be chiamate chinde chi’egesaku kia Manase bakaegwa chingongo chiabo. Aba nabwo barenge b’ororeria rw’Abieseri na Heleki, na Asirieli, na Sekemu, na Heferei, na Shemida. Aba nabwo abamura b’ororeria rwa Manase, mosinto o Yusufu, naende barenge abateneneri be chiamate chiabo.
swahili: Kwa hiyo mgawo huu ulikuwa kwa ajili ya watu wa Manase waliokuwa wamebaki, ambao ni koo za Abiezeri, Heleki, Asirieli, Shekemu, Heferi na Shemida. Hawa ndio wanaume wale wengine wa uzao wa Manase mwana wa Yosefu kwa koo zao.

english: But Zelophehad son of Hepher (the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh) had no sons but only daughters. These are the names of his daughters: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
ekegusii: Korende Selofehadi, mosinto o Heferi, o Gileadi, o Makiri, o Manase, taiborete abana abamura, otatiga abaiseke boka. Amarieta ’abaiseke aba naro aya: Mala, na Nuhu, na Hogila, na Milka, na Tirisa.
swahili: Basi Selofehadi mwana wa Heferi, mwana wa Gileadi, mwana wa Makiri, mwana wa Manase hakuwa na wana waume ila mabinti tu, ambao majina yao yalikuwa Mahla, Noa, Hogla, Milka na Tirsa.

english: They approached Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun, and the leaders, and said, “The LORD commanded Moses to give us an inheritance among our brothers.” So Joshua gave them an inheritance among their father’s brothers, in keeping with the command of the LORD.
ekegusii: Barabwo bakagenda ase Eleazari, Omokuani, na Yoshua, mosinto o Nuni, na ase abatang’ani abanene, bakaboora, “Omonene nachigete Musa ng’a intwe toegwe orogongo ororabe omwando oito ase egati y’abaminto.” Ase ayio bakaegwa omwando ase egati y’abamwabo ise, buna Omonene achigete.
swahili: Wakamwendea kuhani Eleazari, Yoshua mwana wa Nuni, na viongozi, wakasema: “ Bwana alimwagiza Mose atupatie urithi miongoni mwa ndugu zetu.” Kwa hiyo Yoshua akawapa urithi pamoja na ndugu wa baba yao, kufuatana na agizo la Bwana.

english: Thus ten shares fell to Manasseh, in addition to the land of Gilead and Bashan beyond the Jordan,
ekegusii: Ase igo abanto ba Manase bakaegwa chinsemo ikomi, amo nense eria ya Gileadi, na Basani, ng’umbu ya Yorodani,
swahili: Fungu la Manase lilikuwa na sehemu kumi za nchi, licha ya Gileadi na Bashani mashariki mwa Yordani,

english: because the daughters of Manasseh received an inheritance among his sons. And the land of Gilead belonged to the rest of the sons of Manasseh.
ekegusii: ekiagera abaiseke abwo b’ororeria rwa Manase nigo baetwe omwando ase egati y’abamura b’orororeria rwaye. Abana bande b’ororeria rwa Manase konya baeirwe ense ya Gileadi.
swahili: kwa sababu wale binti za kabila la Manase walipokea urithi miongoni mwa wana wa kiume. Nchi ya Gileadi ilikuwa mali ya wazao wa Manase waliobaki.

english: Now the border of Manasseh went from Asher to Michmethath near Shechem, then southward to include the inhabitants of En-tappuah.
ekegusii: Orogongo rwa Manase rogaachakera Aseri, rogaika Mikemetati, moocha ya Sekemu. Erio rokagenda gochia Irianyi ase abanto b’Eni‐Tapua.
swahili: Eneo la Manase lilienea kuanzia Asheri hadi Mikmeta mashariki mwa Shekemu. Mpaka ule ulielekea upande wa kusini kutoka pale kujumuisha watu walioishi En-Tapua.

english: The region of Tappuah belonged to Manasseh, but Tappuah itself, on the border of Manasseh, belonged to Ephraim.
ekegusii: (Ense ya Tapua neya Manase yarenge, korende omochie o Tapua, ase orobebe rwa Manase, okaegwa Efraimu.)
swahili: (Nchi ya Tapua ilikuwa mali ya Manase, lakini Tapua yenyewe iliyo mpakani mwa nchi ya Manase ilikuwa ya Waefraimu.)

english: From there the border continued southward to the Brook of Kanah. There were cities belonging to Ephraim among the cities of Manasseh, but the border of Manasseh was on the north side of the brook and ended at the Sea.
ekegusii: Erio orobebe rogatirimboka gochia akarooche ga Kana. Emechie yarenge Irianyi y’akarooche aka neya Efraimu, nonya yarenge ase orogongo rwa Manase. Orobebe rwa Manase rokagenderera goika sugusu y’akarooche, rogatwomera Enyancha Enene.
swahili: Kisha mpaka ule uliendelea kuelekea kusini hadi Bonde la Kana. Kulikuwepo miji ya Efraimu iliyokuwa miongoni mwa miji ya Manase, lakini mpaka wa Manase ulikuwa upande wa kaskazini wa lile bonde na kuishia kwenye bahari.

english: Then the whole congregation of Israel assembled at Shiloh and set up the Tent of Meeting there. And though the land was subdued before them,
ekegusii: Ekero Abaisraeli babuete ense eria, omoganda obo bwonsi ogasangererekana agwo Silo, na agwo bagatenenia Eema y’Omosangererekano.
swahili: Kusanyiko lote la Waisraeli likakusanyika huko Shilo na kusimamisha Hema la Kukutania. Nchi ikawa chini ya utawala wao,

english: And Joshua cast lots for them in the presence of the LORD at Shiloh, where he distributed the land to the Israelites according to their divisions. Benjamin’s Inheritance
ekegusii: Yoshua akabaakera obomera ase okobori’Omonene aria Silo, agaatananera Abaisraeli ense eyio, kera egesaku ensemo yaye. Orogongo rw’egesaku kia Benjamini
swahili: Basi Yoshua akawapigia kura huko Shilo mbele za Bwana, na hapo akagawanya ile nchi kwa Waisraeli kufuatana na mgawanyo wa kabila zao. Mgawo Kwa Benyamini

english: The first lot came up for the clans of the tribe of Benjamin. Their allotted territory lay between the tribes of Judah and Joseph:
ekegusii: Obomera bw’eritang’ani bokagwera chiamate chi’egesaku kia Benjamini. Orogongo rwabo rokaba egati y’orogongo rw’egesaku kia Yuda na orw’ekia Yusufu.
swahili: Kura iliangukia kabila la Benyamini, ukoo kwa ukoo. Eneo lao walilogawiwa lilikuwa kati ya kabila la Yuda na la Yosefu.

english: On the north side their border began at the Jordan, went up past the northern slope of Jericho, headed west through the hill country, and came out at the wilderness of Beth-aven.
ekegusii: Ensemo ya sugusu orobebe rwabo rogaachakera orooche rwa Yorodani, rogatiira gochia egetirimboko sugusu ya Yeriko, naende gochia bosongo goetera ense y’ebitunwa, rogaika erooro ya Beti‐Aveni.
swahili: Upande wa kaskazini mpaka wao ulianzia pale Yordani, kupitia kaskazini ya mteremko wa Yeriko na kuendelea magharibi kuingia katika nchi ya vilima, ukitokea kwenye jangwa la Beth-Aveni.

english: From there the border crossed over to the southern slope of Luz (that is, Bethel) and went down to Ataroth-addar on the hill south of Lower Beth-horon.
ekegusii: Na korwa aroro rokagenderera goika ebitirimboko bia Lusu (noro Beteli), rogatirimboka goika Ataroti Adari ase egetunwa kere, Irianyi ya Beti‐Horoni maate.
swahili: Kutoka hapo ulikatiza kwenye mteremko wa kusini mwa Luzu (yaani Betheli) na kushuka hadi Ataroth-Adari katika kilima kusini mwa Beth-Horoni ya Chini.

english: On the west side the border curved southward from the hill facing Beth-horon on the south and came out at Kiriath-baal (that is, Kiriath-jearim), a city of the sons of Judah. This was the western side.
ekegusii: Orobebe rokagenderera na rokaonchoka gochia Irianyi, bosongo y’egetunwa keria kerochie Beti‐Horoni, rogaika Kiriati‐Baali (noro Kiriati‐Yearimu), omochie bw’egesaku kia Yuda. Oro nigo rwarenge orobebe rwabo rwa bosongo.
swahili: Kutoka kilima kinachotazamana na Beth-Horoni upande wa kusini mpaka ule ukazunguka kusini kufuatia upande wa magharibi, na ukatokezea Kiriath-Baali (yaani Kiriath-Yearimu), mji wa watu wa Yuda. Huu ndio uliokuwa upande wa magharibi.

english: On the south side the border began at the outskirts of Kiriath-jearim and extended westward to the spring at the Waters of Nephtoah.
ekegusii: Orobebe rwa Irianyi nigo rwachakerete ensinyo ya Kiriati‐Yearimu, rokagenderera gochia ensemo ya bosongo, rogaika ase chinsoko chia Nefitoa.
swahili: Upande wa kusini mpaka ulianzia kwenye viunga vya Kiriath-Yearimu kwa upande wa magharibi, nao ukatokeza kwenye chemchemi ya maji ya Neftoa.

english: Then it went down to the foot of the hill that faces the Valley of Hinnom at the northern end of the Valley of Rephaim and ran down the Valley of Hinnom toward the southern slope of the Jebusites and downward to En-rogel.
ekegusii: Korwa agwo rogatirimboka rogaika ensinyo y’egetunwa kerochie Rikura ria Beni‐Hinomu, rire ensemo ya sugusu y’ense omweremo ya Refaimu. Erio rokagenda gochia Irianyi goetera Rikura ria Hinomu, Irianyi y’esagamo y’Abayebusi gochia Eni‐Rogeli.
swahili: Mpaka ukateremka hadi shefela inayotazamana na Bonde la Ben-Hinomu, kaskazini mwa Bonde la Refaimu. Ukaendelea chini kwenye Bonde la Hinomu sambamba na mteremko wa kusini mwa mji mkubwa wa Wayebusi na kisha hadi En-Rogeli.

english: From there it curved northward and proceeded to En-shemesh and on to Geliloth facing the Ascent of Adummim, and continued down to the Stone of Bohan son of Reuben.
ekegusii: Naende rokagenderera gochia sugusu rogaika Eni‐Semesi, naende goika Geliloti kororia egetirimboko ki’Adumimi. Erio rogatirimboka gochia Rigena ria Bohani, mosinto o Rubeni,
swahili: Kisha ukapinda kuelekea kaskazini, ukaenda hadi En-Shemeshi na kuendelea mpaka Gelilothi, inayotazamana na Njia ya Adumimu, ukateremka hadi kwenye Jiwe la Bohani mwana wa Reubeni.

english: Then it went on to the northern slope of Beth-arabah and went down into the valley.
ekegusii: rogaeta sugusu y’esagamo ere igoro y’Ekerubo Ekiomo, naende rogatirimboka goika Ekerubo keria Ekiomo.
swahili: Ukaendelea upande wa mteremko wa kaskazini wa Beth-Araba ukateremka hadi Araba.

english: The border continued to the northern slope of Beth-hoglah and came out at the northern bay of the Salt Sea, at the mouth of the Jordan. This was the southern border.
ekegusii: Korwa agwo orobebe rokagenderera gochia esagamo ya Beti‐Hogila, rogaika ensemo ya sugusu y’Enyancha y’omonyoo ase orooche rwa Yorodani ronuchete. Oro narwo orobebe rwa Irianyi.
swahili: Kisha ukaenda mpaka kwenye mteremko wa kaskazini wa Beth-Hogla na kujitokeza kwenye ghuba ya kaskazini ya Bahari ya Chumvi, kwenye maingilio ya Yordani upande wa kusini. Huo ulikuwa mpaka wa kusini.

english: there were still seven tribes of Israel who had not yet received their inheritance.
ekegusii: Korende ebisaku bitano na bibere mbiatigarete bitatananeretwe ensemo y’ense ebe omwando obo.
swahili: lakini palikuwa bado makabila saba ya Israeli ambayo yalikuwa hayajapokea urithi wao.

english: On the east side the border was the Jordan. These were the borders around the inheritance of the clans of the tribe of Benjamin.
ekegusii: Yorodani narwo orobebe rwa moocha. Echio nachio chimbebe chiaetanaine orogongo orwo chiamate chi’egesaku kia Benjamini chianyorete rokaba omwando obo.
swahili: Nayo Yordani ikawa ndio mpaka wa upande wa mashariki. Hii ilikuwa ndiyo mipaka iliyoonyesha urithi wa koo za Benyamini pande zote.

english: These were the cities of the clans of the tribe of Benjamin: Jericho, Beth-hoglah, Emek-keziz,
ekegusii: Emechie ye chiamate chi’egesaku kia Benjamini nigo yarenge: Yeriko, na Beti‐Hogila, na Emeki‐Kesisi,
swahili: Kabila ya Benyamini, ukoo kwa ukoo, ilikuwa na miji mikubwa ifuatayo: Yeriko, Beth-Hogla, Emeki-Kesisi,

english: Beth-arabah, Zemaraim, Bethel,
ekegusii: na Beti‐Araba, na Semaraimu, na Beteli,
swahili: Beth-Araba, Semaraimu, Betheli,

english: Avvim, Parah, Ophrah,
ekegusii: na Avimu, na Para, na Ofura,
swahili: Avimu, Para na Ofra,

english: Chephar-ammoni, Ophni, and Geba—twelve cities, along with their villages.
ekegusii: na Kefari‐Amoni, na Ofuni, na Geba, emechie ikomi na ebere, amo nebichie biabo.
swahili: Kefar-Amoni, Ofni, na Geba; miji kumi na miwili pamoja na vijiji vyake.

english: Gibeon, Ramah, Beeroth,
ekegusii: Naende yarenge Gibeoni, na Rama, na Beroti,
swahili: Gibeoni, Rama na Beerothi,

english: Mizpeh, Chephirah, Mozah,
ekegusii: na Misipa, na Kefira, na Mosa,
swahili: Mispa, Kefira, Moza,

english: Rekem, Irpeel, Taralah,
ekegusii: na Rekemu, na Iripeli, na Tarala,
swahili: Rekemu, Irpeeli, Tarala,

english: Zelah, Haeleph, Jebus (that is, Jerusalem), Gibeah, and Kiriath-jearim —fourteen cities, along with their villages. This was the inheritance of the clans of the tribe of Benjamin.
ekegusii: na Zela, na Elefu, na Yebusi (noro Yerusalemu), na Gibea, na Kiriati‐Yearimu, emechie ikomi na ene, amo nebichie biabo. Oyo noro orenge omwando bwe chiamate chi’egesaku kia Benjamini.
swahili: Zela, Elefu, mji wa Wayebusi (yaani Yerusalemu), Gibea na Kiriathi; miji kumi na minne pamoja na vijiji vyake. Huu ndio uliokuwa urithi wa Benyamini kwa ajili ya koo zake.

english: So Joshua said to the Israelites, “How long will you put off entering and possessing the land that the LORD, the God of your fathers, has given you?
ekegusii: Ase igo Yoshua agateebia Abaisraeli, “Inee! Ngoika ririri moratebaane kogenda koira ense eye Omonene, Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiaino, abaeire?
swahili: Hivyo Yoshua akawaambia Waisraeli, “Je, mtasubiri hata lini ili kuingia kumiliki nchi ambayo Bwana, Mungu wa baba zenu, amewapa?

english: Appoint three men from each tribe, and I will send them out to survey the land and map it out, according to the inheritance of each. Then they will return to me
ekegusii: Nchorere abanto batato korwa ase kera egesaku, na inche nimbatome bataare ase ense engima, bayiate na kworokia ase okorika chinsemo chigwenerete koba omwando bwa kera egesaku. Erio bandetere amang’ana.
swahili: Chagueni watu watatu kutoka kwenye kila kabila. Nitawatuma hao watu kukagua hiyo nchi na kuniandikia mapendekezo ya mgawanyo wa urithi wa kila kabila. Nao watanirudia.

english: and divide the land into seven portions. Judah shall remain in their territory in the south, and the house of Joseph shall remain in their territory in the north.
ekegusii: Ense yatananwe ase chinsemo isano na ibere. Abayuda nigo baragenderere komenya ase orogongo rwabo agwo ensemo ya Irianyi, na Abayusufu ase orwabo, ensemo ya sugusu.
swahili: Mtaigawanya hiyo nchi katika sehemu saba. Yuda atabaki katika eneo lake upande wa kusini na nyumba ya Yosefu katika nchi yake upande wa kaskazini.

english: When you have mapped out the seven portions of land and brought it to me, I will cast lots for you here in the presence of the LORD our God.
ekegusii: Morike mworokie omooroberio oyio bw’ogwaterana ense ase chinsemo isano na ibere, moyorente ase ’nde, na inche nimbaakere obomera ase okobori’Omonene, Nyasae oito.
swahili: Baada ya kuandika maelezo ya hizo sehemu saba za nchi, yaleteni kwangu, nami nitawapigia kura kwa kura mbele za Bwana Mungu wetu.

english: The Levites, however, have no portion among you, because their inheritance is the priesthood of the LORD. And Gad, Reuben, and half the tribe of Manasseh have already received the inheritance that Moses the servant of the LORD gave them beyond the Jordan to the east.”
ekegusii: Abalawi barabwo tibakoegwa egetari gi’ense amo nainwe, ekiagera egetari kiabo nokomokorera Omonene ase emeremo y’obokuani. Egesaku kia Gadi, na ekia Rubeni na ekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase barabwo konya baeirwe omwando obo moocha ya Yorodani, omwando oria Musa, omosomba Omonene, abaatananerete.”
swahili: Hata hivyo, Walawi hawatakuwa na sehemu miongoni mwenu, kwa maana huduma ya ukuhani kwa Bwana ndio urithi wao. Nao Gadi, Reubeni na nusu ya kabila la Manase wameshapata urithi wao upande wa mashariki mwa Yordani, ambako Mose mtumishi wa Bwana aliwapa.”

english: As the men got up to go out, Joshua commanded them to map out the land, saying, “Go and survey the land, map it out, and return to me. Then I will cast lots for you here in Shiloh in the presence of the LORD.”
ekegusii: Abanto aba bakagenda gwata ense buna Yoshua abachiigete na kobateebereria, “Genda motaare ase ense engima, mworokie ase okorika buna ense eyio ere. Erio moirane ase ’nde, na inche nimbaakere obomera ase okobori’Omonene aiga Silo.”
swahili: Watu hao walipokuwa wanaondoka kwenda kuandika vizuri kuhusu hiyo nchi, Yoshua akawaagiza, “Nendeni mkakague hiyo nchi na mwandike maelezo kuihusu. Kisha mrudi kwangu, nami nitawapigia kura hapa Shilo mbele za Bwana.”

english: So the men departed and went throughout the land, mapping it city by city into seven portions. Then they returned with the document to Joshua at the camp in Shiloh.
ekegusii: Bono abanto abwo bakagenda, bagaetanana ense eria engima, bakarika ase okworokia buna bayiatete ense ase chinsemo isano na ibere kobwatekana nemechie yonsi. Erio bakairana ase Yoshua ase egetwori agwo Silo
swahili: Ndipo hao watu walipoondoka na kupita katika ile nchi. Wakaandika maelezo yake kwenye kitabu, mji kwa mji, katika sehemu saba na kurudisha taarifa kwa Yoshua huko kambini Shilo.

english: The second lot came out for the clans of the tribe of Simeon: Their inheritance lay within the territory of Judah
ekegusii: Obomera bwa kabere bokagwera chiamate chi’egesaku gia Simioni. Omwando obo nigo orenge gati‐gati y’omwando bw’egesaku kia Yuda.
swahili: Kura ya pili ikaangukia kabila la Simeoni, ukoo kwa ukoo. Urithi wao ulikuwa ndani ya eneo la Yuda.

english: The third lot came up for the clans of the tribe of Zebulun: The border of their inheritance stretched as far as Sarid.
ekegusii: Obomera bwa gatato bokagwera chiamate chi’egesaku gia Sabuloni. Orogongo rwabeete omwando obo rogaikera Saridi.
swahili: Kura ya tatu ikaangukia kabila la Zabuloni, ukoo kwa ukoo: Mpaka wa urithi wao uliendelea hadi Saridi.

english: It went up westward to Maralah, reached Dabbesheth, and met the brook east of Jokneam.
ekegusii: Korwa agwo orobebe rwabo rogatiira gochia bosongo, rogaika Marala, rogatwomera Dabeseti ne rigoko rire moocha ya Yokinamu.
swahili: Kuelekea upande wa magharibi ukafika Marala, ukagusa Dabeshethi, na kuendelea mpaka kwenye bonde karibu na Yokneamu.

english: From Sarid it turned eastward along the border of Chisloth-tabor and went on to Daberath and up to Japhia.
ekegusii: Korwa Saridi rokagenderera goika Kisiloti‐Tabori, naende goika Daberati, erio rogatiira goika Yafia.
swahili: Ukageuka mashariki, kuanzia Saridi kuelekea mawio ya jua hadi kwenye nchi ya Kisiloth-Tabori, na kwenda hadi Daberathi, kupanda Yafia.

english: From there it crossed eastward to Gath-hepher and to Eth-kazin; it extended to Rimmon and curved around toward Neah.
ekegusii: Korwa agwo rokagenderera gochia moocha, rogaika Gati‐Heferi na Eta‐Kasini, rokagenda gochia Rimoni, rokaonchoka gochia Nea.
swahili: Kisha ukaendelea mashariki hadi Gath-Heferi na kufika Eth-Kasini, ukatokea Rimoni na kugeuka kuelekea Nea.

english: Then the border circled around the north side of Neah to Hannathon and ended at the Valley of Iphtah-el.
ekegusii: Ensemo ya sugusu orobebe rokaonchokera Hanatoni, rogaikera ense omweremo ya Ifuta‐Eli.
swahili: Huko mpaka ukazungukia upande wa kaskazini hadi Hanathoni na kuishia katika Bonde la Ifta-Eli.

english: It also included Kattath, Nahalal, Shimron, Idalah, and Bethlehem. There were twelve cities, along with their villages.
ekegusii: Amo neyio orogongo rwabo rokabwaterania Katati, na Nahalali, na Simuroni, na Idala, na Bethlehemu, emechie ikomi na ebere, amo nebichie biabo.
swahili: Miji mingine iliyojumuishwa ni Katathi, Nahalali, Shimroni, Idala na Bethlehemu. Kulikuwa na miji kumi na miwili pamoja na vijiji vyake.

english: This was the inheritance of the clans of the tribe of Zebulun, including these cities and their villages. Issachar’s Inheritance
ekegusii: Emechie eyio, amo nebichie biabo, nigo biarenge omwando bwe chiamate chi’egesaku gia Sabuloni. Orogongo rw’egesaku gia Isakaru
swahili: Miji hii na vijiji vyake ilikuwa ndio urithi wa Zabuloni, ukoo kwa ukoo. Mgawo Kwa Isakari

english: The fourth lot came out for the clans of the tribe of Issachar:
ekegusii: Obomera bwa kane bokagwera chiamate chi’egesaku gia Isakaru.
swahili: Kura ya nne ikamwangukia Isakari, ukoo kwa ukoo.

english: Their territory included Jezreel, Chesulloth, Shunem,
ekegusii: Ensemo yabo nigo yabwateranetie Yesireeli, na Kesuloti, na Sunemu,
swahili: Eneo lao lilijumuisha: Yezreeli, Kesulothi, Shunemu,

english: Hapharaim, Shion, Anaharath,
ekegusii: na Hafaraimu, na Sihoni, na Anaharati,
swahili: Hafaraimu, Shioni, Anaharathi,

english: and included Beersheba (or Sheba), Moladah,
ekegusii: Emechie banyorete ase omwando obo nero: Beeri‐Seba, na Seba, na Molada,
swahili: Ulijumuisha: Beer-Sheba (au Sheba), Molada,

english: Rabbith, Kishion, Ebez,
ekegusii: na Rabiti, na Kisioni, na Ebesi,
swahili: Rabithi, Kishioni, Ebesi,

english: Remeth, En-gannim, En-haddah, and Beth-pazzez.
ekegusii: na Remeti, na Eni‐Ganimu, na Eni‐Hada, na Beti‐Pasesi.
swahili: Remethi, En-Ganimu, En-Hada na Beth-Pasesi.

english: The border reached Tabor, Shahazumah, and Beth-shemesh, and ended at the Jordan. There were sixteen cities, along with their villages.
ekegusii: Orobebe rwabo rogatwomera boigo Tabori na Sahasuma, na Beti‐Semesi, rokanacha Yorodani. Orogongo oro rokabwaterania emechie ikomi, na etano nomo, amo nebichie biabo.
swahili: Mpaka ule ukagusa Tabori, Shahasuma na Beth-Shemeshi, na ukaishia kwenye Yordani. Ilikuwa miji kumi na sita, pamoja na vijiji vyake.

english: This was the inheritance of the clans of the tribe of Issachar, including these cities and their villages. Asher’s Inheritance
ekegusii: Emechie eyio, amo nebichie biabo, nero omwando bwe chiamate ch’egesaku gia Isakaru. Orogongo rw’egesaku gi’Aseri
swahili: Miji hii pamoja na vijiji vyake ilikuwa urithi wa kabila la Isakari, ukoo kwa ukoo. Mgawo Kwa Asheri

english: The fifth lot came out for the clans of the tribe of Asher:
ekegusii: Obomera bwa gatano bokagwera chiamate chi’egesaku gi’Aseri.
swahili: Kura ya tano ikaangukia kabila la Asheri, ukoo kwa ukoo.

english: Their territory included Helkath, Hali, Beten, Achshaph,
ekegusii: Ensemo yabo nigo yabwateranetie Helikati, na Hali, na Beteni, na Akisafu,
swahili: Eneo lao lilijumuisha: Helkathi, Hali, Beteni, Akishafu,

english: Allammelech, Amad, and Mishal. On the west the border touched Carmel and Shihor-libnath,
ekegusii: na Alameleki, na Amadi, na Misali. Ensemo ya bosongo orobebe rwabo rogatwomera Karimeli na Sihori‐Libinati.
swahili: Alameleki, Amadi na Mishali. Upande wa magharibi mpaka uligusa Karmeli na Shihor-Libnathi.

english: then turned eastward toward Beth-dagon, touched Zebulun and the Valley of Iphtah-el, and went north to Beth-emek and Neiel, passing Cabul on the left.
ekegusii: Erio rokaonchoka gochia moocha, rokagenderera goika Beti‐Dagoni, rogatwomera Sabuloni na ense yo’mweremo o Ifuta‐Eli, ensemo ya sugusu, rogaika Beti‐Emeki na Neieli. Erio rokagenderera gochia sugusu goika Kabuli,
swahili: Tena ukageuka mashariki kuelekea Beth-Dagoni, ukagusa Zabuloni na Bonde la Ifta-Eli, ukaenda upande wa kaskazini hadi Beth-Emeki na Neyeli, ukipitia Kabul upande wa kushoto.

english: It went on to Ebron, Rehob, Hammon, and Kanah, as far as Greater Sidon.
ekegusii: na Eburoni, na Rehobu, na Hamoni, na Kana, rogaika Sidoni, Omochie omonene.
swahili: Ukaendelea hadi Abdoni, Rehobu, Hamoni na Kana, na kufika Sidoni Kuu.

english: The border then turned back toward Ramah as far as the fortified city of Tyre, turned toward Hosah, and came out at the Sea in the region of Achzib,
ekegusii: Erio orobebe rokaonchoka gochia Rama, rogaika omochie omonene o Turo, oyogiteire chindwaki, rokaonchoka gochia Hosa, na rokanucha Enyancha Enene. Naende orogongo orwo rokabwaterania engegu y’ensemo y’Akisibu,
swahili: Mpaka huo ukageukia nyuma kuelekea Rama na kwenda hadi kwenye mji wenye ngome wa Tiro, ukageuka kuelekea Hosa na kutokeza baharini katika eneo la Akzibu,

english: Hazar-shual, Balah, Ezem,
ekegusii: na Hasari‐Suali, na Bala, na Esemu,
swahili: Hasar-Shuali, Bala, Esemu,

english: Ummah, Aphek, and Rehob. There were twenty-two cities, along with their villages.
ekegusii: na Uma, na Afeki, na Rehobu, emechie emerongo ebere, na ebere, amo nebichie biabo.
swahili: Uma, Afeki na Rehobu. Ilikuwepo miji ishirini na miwili, pamoja na vijiji vyake.

english: This was the inheritance of the clans of the tribe of Asher, including these cities and their villages. Naphtali’s Inheritance
ekegusii: Emechie eyio, amo nebichie biabo, nero omwando bwe chiamate chi’egesaku gi’Aseri. Orogongo rw’egesaku kia Nafutali
swahili: Miji hii pamoja na vijiji vyake ilikuwa ndio urithi wa kabila la Asheri, ukoo kwa ukoo. Mgawo Kwa Naftali

english: The sixth lot came out for the clans of the tribe of Naphtali:
ekegusii: Obomera bwa gatano na rimo bokagwera chiamate chi’egesaku kia Nafutali.
swahili: Kura ya sita ikaangukia kabila la Naftali, ukoo kwa ukoo:

english: Their border started at Heleph and the great tree of Zaanannim, passing Adami-nekeb and Jabneel as far as Lakkum and ending at the Jordan.
ekegusii: Orobebe rwabo rogaachaka korwa Helefu ase Omoaluni orenge, agwo Sananimu, na korwa Adami‐Nekebu, na Yabuneli, rogaika Lakumu, rogatwomera Yorodani.
swahili: Mpaka wao uliendelea kutoka Helefi na kwenye mti mkubwa ulio katika Saananimu, ukipitia Adami-Nekebu na Yabineeli hadi Lakumu, na kuishia katika Mto Yordani.

english: Then the border turned westward to Aznoth-tabor and ran from there to Hukkok, touching Zebulun on the south side, Asher on the west, and Judah at the Jordan on the east.
ekegusii: Erio orobebe rokaonchoka gochia bosongo goika Asinoti‐Tabori, na korwa agwo rokagenderera goika Hukoki, rogatwomera orogongo rw’egesaku gia Sabuloni ensemo ya Irianyi, na orw’egia Aseri ensemo ya bosongo, na orw’ekia Yuda ensemo ya moocha ase Yorodani.
swahili: Mpaka ukaendelea magharibi kupitia Aznoth-Tabori na kutokea Hukoki. Ukagusa Zabuloni upande wa kusini, Asheri upande wa magharibi, na Yordani upande wa mashariki.

english: The fortified cities were Ziddim, Zer, Hammath, Rakkath, Chinnereth,
ekegusii: Emechie yabo yagiteire chindwaki nero: Sidimu, na Seri, na Hamati, na Rakati, na Galili,
swahili: Miji yenye ngome ilikuwa Sidimu, Seri, Hamathi, Rakathi, Kinerethi,

english: Adamah, Ramah, Hazor,
ekegusii: na Adama, na Rama, na Hasori,
swahili: Adama, Rama, Hazori,

english: Kedesh, Edrei, En-hazor,
ekegusii: na Kedesi na Edirei, na Eni‐Hasori,
swahili: Kedeshi, Edrei, na En-Hasori,

english: Iron, Migdal-el, Horem, Beth-anath, and Beth-shemesh. There were nineteen cities, along with their villages.
ekegusii: na Yironi, na Migidali‐Eli, na Horemu, na Beti‐Anati, na Beti‐Semesi, emechie ikomi na kianda, amo nebichie biabo.
swahili: Ironi, Migdal-Eli, Horemu, Beth-Anathi na Beth-Shemeshi. Kulikuwa na miji kumi na tisa na vijiji vyake.

english: This was the inheritance of the clans of the tribe of Naphtali, including these cities and their villages. Dan’s Inheritance
ekegusii: Emechie eyio, amo nebichie biabo, nero omwando bwe chiamate chi’egesaku kia Nafutali. Orogongo rw’egesaku gia Dani
swahili: Miji hiyo pamoja na vijiji vyake ndio iliyokuwa urithi wa kabila la Naftali, ukoo kwa ukoo. Mgawo Kwa Dani

english: Eltolad, Bethul, Hormah,
ekegusii: na Elitoladi, na Betuli, na Horima,
swahili: Eltoladi, Bethuli, Horma,

english: The seventh lot came out for the clans of the tribe of Dan:
ekegusii: Obomera bwa gatano na kabere bokagwera chiamate chi’egesaku gia Dani.
swahili: Kura ya saba ikaangukia kabila la Dani, ukoo kwa ukoo.

english: The territory of their inheritance included Zorah, Eshtaol, Ir-shemesh,
ekegusii: Omwando obo okabwaterania Sora, na Esitaoli, na Iri‐Semesi,
swahili: Eneo la urithi wao lilijumuisha: Sora, Eshtaoli, Iri-Shemeshi,

english: Shaalabbin, Aijalon, Ithlah,
ekegusii: na Saalabini, na Ayaloni, na Itila,
swahili: Shaalabini, Aiyaloni, Ithla,

english: Elon, Timnah, Ekron,
ekegusii: na Eloni, na Timuna, na Ekironi,
swahili: Eloni, Timna, Ekroni,

english: Eltekeh, Gibbethon, Baalath,
ekegusii: na Eliteke, na Gibetoni, na Baalati,
swahili: Elteke, Gibethoni, Baalathi,

english: Jehud, Bene-berak, Gath-rimmon,
ekegusii: na Yehudi, na Bene‐Beraki, na Gati‐Rimoni,
swahili: Yehudi, Bene-Beraki, Gath-Rimoni,

english: Me-jarkon, and Rakkon, including the territory across from Joppa.
ekegusii: na Me‐Yarikoni, na Rakoni, amo nense erochie Yafo.
swahili: Me-Yarkoni na Rakoni, pamoja na eneo linalotazamana na Yafa.

english: (Later, when the territory of the Danites was lost to them, they went up and fought against Leshem, captured it, and put it to the sword. So they took possession of Leshem, settled there, and renamed it after their father Dan.)
ekegusii: Ekero abanto b’egesaku gia Dani basiretie ense yabo, bakagenda Lesemu, bakayoumokera, bakayoira na bagaita abanto b’agwo nemioro. Bagasakora chinibo chiarengeo, bakamenya omochie oyio. Erio bakaonchora erieta ri’omochie oyio Lesemu, bakayoroka Dani, erieta ria sokoro yabo Dani.
swahili: (Lakini Wadani walipata shida kulimiliki eneo lao; kwa hiyo walipanda kuishambulia Leshemu, wakaitwaa, wakawaua watu wake kwa upanga na kuukalia. Walikaa Leshemu na kuuita Dani kufuatana na jina la baba yao.)

english: This was the inheritance of the clans of the tribe of Dan, including these cities and their villages. Joshua’s Inheritance
ekegusii: Emechie eyio, amo nebichie biabo, nero omwando bwe chiamate chi’egesaku gia Dani. Omwando o Yoshua
swahili: Miji hii na vijiji vyake ndio iliyokuwa urithi wa kabila la Dani, ukoo kwa ukoo. Mgawo Kwa Yoshua

english: When they had finished distributing the land into its territories, the Israelites gave Joshua son of Nun an inheritance among them,
ekegusii: Abaisraeli kobakoorire gwatanana ense eria ase chinsemo ao ao, bakaa Yoshua, mosinto o Nuni, ensemo ase egati yabo, ebe omwando oye.
swahili: Walipomaliza kugawanya nchi katika migawo kulingana na sehemu zao zilizowaangukia, Waisraeli wakampa Yoshua mwana wa Nuni urithi katikati yao,

english: Ziklag, Beth-marcaboth, Hazar-susah,
ekegusii: na Sikilagi, na Beti‐Marikaboti, na Hasari‐Susa,
swahili: Siklagi, Beth-Markabothi, Hasar-Susa,

english: as the LORD had commanded. They gave him the city of Timnath-serah in the hill country of Ephraim, as he requested. He rebuilt the city and settled in it.
ekegusii: Na buna Omonene achigete bakamoa omochie oria aboretie, noro Timunati‐Sera ase ense y’ebitunwa y’Efraimu. Erio Yoshua akaagacha omochie oria okaba omoyia, akamenya aroro.
swahili: kama vile Bwana alivyokuwa ameamuru. Walimpa mji alioutaka, ambao ni Timnath-Sera ulio katika nchi ya vilima ya Efraimu. Naye akajenga mji, akakaa huko.

english: These are the inheritances that Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun, and the heads of the families distributed by lot to the tribes of Israel at Shiloh before the LORD at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting. So they finished dividing up the land.
ekegusii: Eyio nero emiando Eleazari, Omokuani, na Yoshua, mosinto o Nuni, amo nabateneneri be chiamate chi’ebisaku bi’Abaisraeli, baatananete ase ogoaka obomera aria Silo, ase okobori’Omonene, ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano. Nabo bagakoora emeremo y’ogwatanana ense eria.
swahili: Haya ndiyo maeneo ambayo kuhani Eleazari, Yoshua mwana wa Nuni, na viongozi wa koo za kabila za Israeli waliyoyagawanya kwa kura huko Shilo mbele za Bwana penye ingilio la Hema la Kukutania. Hivyo wakamaliza kuigawanya nchi.

english: Beth-lebaoth, and Sharuhen—thirteen cities, along with their villages.
ekegusii: na Beti‐Lebaoti, na Saruheni, emechie ikomi na etato, amo nebichie biabo.
swahili: Beth-Lebaothi na Sharuheni; hii ilikuwa miji kumi na mitatu pamoja na vijiji vyake.

english: Ain, Rimmon, Ether, and Ashan—four cities, along with their villages,
ekegusii: Naende yarenge Aini, na Rimoni, na Eteri, na Asani, emechie ene, amo nebichie biabo.
swahili: Pia Aini, Rimoni, Etheri, na Ashani; hii ilikuwa miji minne na vijiji vyake,

english: and all the villages surrounding these cities as far as Baalath-beer (Ramah of the Negev). This was the inheritance of the clans of the tribe of Simeon.
ekegusii: Amo neyio bakanyora ebichie bionsi biaetanaine emechie eyio goika Baalati‐Beeri (noro Rama‐Negebu). Oyio noro orenge bwe chiamate chi’egesaku gia Simioni.
swahili: pamoja na vijiji vyote vinavyoizunguka miji hii mpaka Baalath-Beeri (ambayo ndiyo Rama iliyo katika Negebu). Huu ulikuwa ni urithi wa kabila la Simeoni ukoo kwa ukoo.

english: The inheritance of the Simeonites was taken from the territory of Judah, because the share for Judah’s descendants was too large for them. So the Simeonites received an inheritance within Judah’s portion. Zebulun’s Inheritance
ekegusii: Omwando bw’egesaku gia Simioni nigo orenge ensemo y’oyio bw’egesaku kia Yuda, ekiagera ensemo y’egesaku kia Yuda nigo yarenge enene mono ase bare. Ayio naro agerete egesaku gia Simioni gekaegwa omwando obo korwa ase omwando bw’egesaku kia Yuda. Orogongo rw’egesaku gia Sabuloni
swahili: Urithi wa Wasimeoni ulitolewa kutoka fungu la Yuda, kwa kuwa fungu la Yuda lilikuwa kubwa kuliko walivyohitaji. Hivyo kabila la Simeoni lilipewa urithi wao ndani ya eneo la Yuda. Mgawo Kwa Zabuloni

english: Now after the death of His servant Moses, the LORD spoke to Joshua son of Nun, Moses’ assistant, saying,
ekegusii: Ekero Musa, omosomba bw’Omonene, konya akuure, Omonene agakwana na Yoshua, mosinto o Nuni, oyio orenge omokonyi o Musa,
swahili: Baada ya kifo cha Mose mtumishi wa Bwana, Bwana akamwambia Yoshua mwana wa Nuni, msaidizi wa Mose:

english: Then Joshua commanded the officers of the people:
ekegusii: Erio Yoshua agachiika abatang’ani b’abaanto
swahili: Ndipo Yoshua akawaagiza maafisa wa watu akisema,

english: “Go through the camp and tell the people, ‘Prepare your provisions, for within three days you will cross the Jordan to go in and take possession of the land that the LORD your God is giving you to possess.’”
ekegusii: ng’a baete egati y’ebitwori bachiike abanto ng’a beroiserie endagera, ekiagera ritang’ani amatuko atato ataraera inabamboke orooche oro rwa Yorodani, baire ense eyi’Omonene, Nyasae obo, abaeire ebe eyabo.
swahili: “Pitieni katika kambi yote mkawaambie watu, ‘Wekeni tayari mahitaji yenu. Siku tatu kuanzia sasa mtavuka hii Yordani ili kuingia na kuimiliki nchi ambayo Bwana Mungu wenu anawapa iwe yenu wenyewe.’ ”

english: But to the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, Joshua said,
ekegusii: Yoshua agateebia abanto b’egesaku kia Rubeni, na ekia Gadi, amo nekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase,
swahili: Lakini kwa Wareubeni, Wagadi na nusu ya kabila la Manase, Yoshua akasema,

english: “Remember what Moses the servant of the LORD commanded you when he said, ‘The LORD your God will give you rest, and He will give you this land.’
ekegusii: “Inyora ring’ana riria Musa, omosomba bw’Omonene, abachigete ekero abateebeetie ng’a Omonene, Nyasae oino, nabae obotoereru ase ense eyio arabae momenye.
swahili: “Kumbukeni agizo lile Mose mtumishi wa Bwana alilowapa: ‘ Bwana Mungu wenu anawapa ninyi raha, naye amewapa nchi hii.’

english: Your wives, your young children, and your livestock may remain in the land that Moses gave you on this side of the Jordan. But all your mighty men of valor must be armed for battle to cross over ahead of your brothers and help them,
ekegusii: Abakungu baino na abana baino nabatigare, amo namaicho aino, ase ense eye Musa abaete ng’umbu ya Yorodani. Inwe abanyene abamore chituoni chi’esegi goika mwamboke mobogoretie ebirwanero biaino, motang’ane abamino.
swahili: Wake zenu, watoto wenu na mifugo yenu watakaa katika nchi ile Mose aliyowapa mashariki ya Yordani, lakini mashujaa wenu wote, wakiwa wamevikwa silaha kikamilifu lazima wavuke mbele ya ndugu zenu. Imewapasa kuwasaidia ndugu zenu hadi

english: until the LORD gives them rest as He has done for you, and your brothers also possess the land that the LORD your God is giving them. Then you may return to the land of your inheritance and take possession of that which Moses the servant of the LORD gave you on the east side of the Jordan.”
ekegusii: Mobakoonye goika Omonene abae barabwo obotoereru, buna abaete inwe, nabarabwo mbaire ense eyi’Omonene, Nyasae oino, arabae. Erio momanye koirana ase ense yaino, eye Musa, omosomba bw’Omonene, abaete ng’umbu ya Yorodani.”
swahili: Bwana awape nao raha, kama alivyokwisha kufanya kwa ajili yenu hadi wao pia watakapokuwa wamemiliki nchi ile Bwana Mungu wenu anayowapa. Baada ya hilo, mwaweza kurudi na kukalia nchi yenu wenyewe, ambayo Mose mtumishi wa Bwana aliwapa mashariki mwa Yordani kuelekea linakochomoza jua.”

english: So they answered Joshua, “Everything you have commanded us we will do, and everywhere you send us we will go.
ekegusii: Barabwo bakairaneria Yoshua, “Onsi ayagwatochikiire natoyakore, na aase aande onsi oratotome natogende.
swahili: Ndipo wakamjibu Yoshua, “Chochote ambacho umetuagiza tutafanya na popote utakapotutuma tutakwenda.

english: Just as we obeyed Moses in all things, so we will obey you. And may the LORD your God be with you, as He was with Moses.
ekegusii: Buna tware koigwera Musa, naye natokoigwere. Omonene, Nyasae oo, abe amo naye buna abeete na Musa.
swahili: Kama vile tulivyomtii Mose kikamilifu, ndivyo tutakavyokutii wewe. Bwana Mungu wako na awe pamoja nawe tu kama vile alivyokuwa pamoja na Mose.

english: Anyone who rebels against your order and does not obey your words, all that you command him, will be put to death. Above all, be strong and courageous!”
ekegusii: Monto onde bwensi oraange koigwera amachiiko ao na taigwa amang’ana ande onsi orachiike, goika aitwe akwe. Aye otenene bokong’u, obe omoremu!”
swahili: Yeyote atakayeasi neno lako na kuacha kuyatii maneno yako, au chochote utakachowaamuru, atauawa. Uwe imara na hodari tu!”

english: “Moses My servant is dead. Now therefore arise, you and all these people, and cross over the Jordan into the land that I am giving to the children of Israel.
ekegusii: akamoteebia, “Musa, omosomba one, okuure. Imoka, bwamboke orooche oro rwa Yorodani, aye na Abaisraeli aba bonsi, mosoe ase ense eria ngochia kobaa.
swahili: “Mtumishi wangu Mose amekufa. Sasa basi, wewe pamoja na watu wote hawa, jiandaeni kuvuka huu Mto Yordani kuingia nchi ambayo karibu nitawapa wana wa Israeli.

english: I have given you every place where the sole of your foot will tread, just as I promised to Moses.
ekegusii: Nabaeire aase onsi morataare namagoro aino, buna narierete Musa eira ng’a nimbayee.
swahili: Kila mahali nyayo za miguu yenu zitakapokanyaga nimewapa, kama vile nilivyomwahidi Mose.

english: Your territory shall extend from the wilderness and Lebanon to the great River Euphrates—all the land of the Hittites—and west as far as the Great Sea.
ekegusii: Orogongo rwaino nigo rorachaakere erooro ya Irianyi, roikere Lebanoni ensemo ya sugusu, naende rochakeere orooche oronene rw’Eufarati, robwateranie ense yonsi y’Abahiti roikere Enyancha Enene ya bosongo.
swahili: Nchi yenu itaenea kuanzia jangwa hili hadi Lebanoni, tena kuanzia mto mkubwa wa Frati, yaani nchi yote ya Wahiti, hadi Bahari ile Kubwa iliyoko upande wa magharibi.

english: No one shall stand against you all the days of your life. As I was with Moses, so will I be with you; I will never leave you nor forsake you.
ekegusii: Ase obogima bwao bwonsi, omonto tari orakobue. Buna narenge amo na Musa, nimbe amo naye botambe, tinkogotiga nonya ng’ake.
swahili: Hakuna mtu yeyote atakayeweza kushindana na wewe siku zote za maisha yako. Kama vile nilivyokuwa pamoja na Mose, ndivyo nitakavyokuwa pamoja na wewe, sitakuacha wala sitakupungukia.

english: Be strong and courageous, for you shall give these people the inheritance of the land that I swore to their fathers I would give them.
ekegusii: Obe omokong’u na omoremu, ekiagera naye oraikie abanto aba, baire ense eyio narierete chisokoro chiabo eira na gotiana ng’a nimbayee.
swahili: “Uwe hodari na shujaa, kwa sababu wewe ndiwe utakayewaongoza watu hawa kuirithi nchi niliyowaapia baba zao kuwapa.

english: Above all, be strong and very courageous. Be careful to observe all the law that My servant Moses commanded you. Do not turn from it to the right or to the left, so that you may prosper wherever you go.
ekegusii: Otenene bokong’u rioka, na obe omoremu! Orende na obwate boronge amachiiko onsi aya omosomba one Musa agochigete. Tobaisa koyatiga, na koonchoka gochia aande onsi ensemo y’okorio gose ey’okobee; erio nario orasesenigwe aande onsi ase ogochia.
swahili: Uwe hodari na uwe na ushujaa mwingi. Uwe na bidii kutii sheria yote aliyokupa Mose mtumishi wangu, usiiache kwa kugeuka kuelekea kuume au kushoto, ili upate kufanikiwa popote uendako.

english: This Book of the Law must not depart from your mouth; meditate on it day and night, so that you may be careful to do everything written in it. For then you will prosper and succeed in all you do.
ekegusii: Amang’ana y’egetabu eke ki’amachiiko oyakwane botambe nomonwa oo, oyairanerere omobaso na obotuko, obwate na okore onsi ayarikireo. Erio nario orasesenigwe mono ase chinchera chiao chionsi na kogenderera.
swahili: Usiache Kitabu hiki cha Sheria kiondoke kinywani mwako; yatafakari maneno yake usiku na mchana, ili upate kuwa mwangalifu kufanya kila kitu sawasawa na yote yaliyoandikwa ndani yake. Ndipo utakapofanikiwa na kisha utastawi.

english: Have I not commanded you to be strong and courageous? Do not be afraid; do not be discouraged, for the LORD your God is with you wherever you go.” Joshua Takes Charge
ekegusii: Inee! Tari inche nagochikiire ng’a otenene bokung’u, obe omoremu? Ase ayio, toondoka, tobaisa gokwa omoyo, ekiagera inche Omonene, Nyasae oo, nigo inde amo naye aande onsi orabe gokogenda.” Yoshua ogochika abanto
swahili: Je, si mimi niliyekuamuru? Uwe hodari na shujaa. Usihofu wala usivunjike moyo, kwa kuwa Bwana Mungu wako atakuwa pamoja nawe kokote uendako.”

english: Then the LORD said to Joshua,
ekegusii: Omonene agakwana na Yoshua, akamoteebia,
swahili: Ndipo Bwana akamwambia Yoshua,

english: “Tell the Israelites to designate the cities of refuge, as I instructed you through Moses,
ekegusii: “Kwana n’Abaisraeli, obateebie ng’a bachore emechie y’obotamero, buna nabateebetie goetera ase Musa.
swahili: “Waambie Waisraeli, watenge miji mikubwa ya kukimbilia, kama nilivyokuagiza kupitia Mose,

english: so that anyone who kills another unintentionally or accidentally may flee there. These will be your refuge from the avenger of blood.
ekegusii: Omonto karaite omonto onde mosiabano atancheti, anyare gotamera oyomo bw’emechie eyio ase ogwetooria korwa ase oyomwabo oria oitetwe oganetie korusia egesiomba.
swahili: ili mtu yeyote atakayemuua mtu kwa bahati mbaya na pasipo kukusudia aweze kukimbilia huko na kujiepusha na mlipiza kisasi wa damu.

english: When someone flees to one of these cities, stands at the entrance of the city gate, and states his case before its elders, they are to bring him into the city and give him a place to live among them.
ekegusii: Omonto oria omoiti, ekero aratamere oyomo bw’emechie eyio goika agende atenene ase egeita ki’omochie oyio, akwane amang’ana aye nabatang’ani b’omochie oria. Barabwo bamosoyie ase omochie bamoe aase akomenya ase egati yabo.
swahili: “Anapokimbilia mojawapo ya hii miji mikubwa atasimama kwenye maingilio ya lango la mji mkuu na kueleza wazee wa mji kuhusu shauri lake. Kisha watampokea katika mji wao na kumpa mahali pa kuishi nao.

english: Now if the avenger of blood pursues him, they must not surrender the manslayer into his hand, because that man killed his neighbor accidentally without prior malice.
ekegusii: Onye omonto oria oganetie korusia egesiomba okomobwatia gochiao, abanto b’omochie oyio tibakorua omoiti oria ase amaboko aye, ekiagera aitete omoamate oye mosiabano, atamogechete.
swahili: Kama mlipiza kisasi wa damu akimfuatilia, wasimkabidhi yule mshtakiwa, kwa sababu alimuua jirani yake bila kukusudia, na bila kuwa na nia ya kudhuru.

english: He is to stay in that city until he stands trial before the assembly and until the death of the high priest serving at that time. Then the manslayer may return to his own home in the city from which he fled.”
ekegusii: Omonto oria namenye ase omochie oria goika ere arentwe bosio bw’omosangererekano agambigwe na goika Omokuani Omonene bw’engaki eria akwe. Magega y’ayio arue ase omochie oria atamerete, airane nka ase omochie oye.”
swahili: Huyu aliyeua atakaa kwenye mji mkubwa huo mpaka awe amesimama kukabili mashtaka yake mbele ya kusanyiko na mpaka kuhani mkuu anayehudumu kwa wakati huo atakapokufa. Ndipo atakapoweza kurudi nyumbani kwake katika mji ambao aliukimbia.”

english: So they set apart Kedesh in Galilee in the hill country of Naphtali, Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim, and Kiriath-arba (that is, Hebron) in the hill country of Judah.
ekegusii: Ase igo bagaatanana Kedesi o Galili, ase ense y’ebitunwa ya Nafutali, na Sekemu ase ense y’ebitunwa y’Efraimu, na Kiriati‐Ariba (nao Heburoni), ase ense y’ebitunwa ya Yuda.
swahili: Basi wakatenga Kedeshi katika Galilaya kwenye nchi ya vilima ya Naftali, Shekemu katika nchi ya vilima ya Efraimu, na Kiriath-Arba (yaani Hebroni) kwenye nchi ya vilima ya Yuda.

english: And beyond the Jordan, east of Jericho, they designated Bezer on the wilderness plateau from the tribe of Reuben, Ramoth in Gilead from the tribe of Gad, and Golan in Bashan from the tribe of Manasseh.
ekegusii: Ngumbu ya moocha ya Yorodani ase erooro moocha ya Yeriko, bagachora Beseri ase orogongo rwa Rubeni, na Ramoti o Gileadi, ase orogongo rw’egesaku kia Gadi, na Golani o Basani ase orogongo rw’egesaku kia Manase.
swahili: Katika upande wa mashariki mwa Yordani ya Yeriko wakatenga Bezeri katika jangwa katika uwanda wa juu katika kabila la Reubeni, Ramothi katika Gileadi katika kabila la Gadi, na Golani huko Bashani katika kabila la Manase.

english: These are the cities appointed for all the Israelites and foreigners among them, so that anyone who kills a person unintentionally may flee there and not die by the hand of the avenger of blood prior to standing trial before the assembly.
ekegusii: Emechie eyio nero yachoretwe ebe obotamero ase Abaisraeli, na ase abamenyi abaare ase egati yabo. Onde bwensi orenge goita omonto mosiabano atame gochia aroro, erinde taitwa noria oganetie korusia egesiomba, ataratenena ase omosangererekano amang’ana aye agambwe.
swahili: Mwisraeli yeyote au mgeni yeyote aishiye miongoni mwao aliyemuua mtu kwa bahati mbaya, angeweza kukimbilia katika miji mikubwa hiyo iliyotengwa na asiuawe na mlipiza kisasi wa damu kabla hajasimama kukabili mashtaka mbele ya kusanyiko.

english: Now the family heads of the Levites approached Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun, and the heads of the other tribes of Israel
ekegusii: Abateneneri be chiamate chi’Abalawi bagaacha ase Eleazari, Omokuani, na Yoshua, mosinto o Nuni, na ase abateneneri be chiamate chi’ebisaku bionsi bi’Abaisraeli,
swahili: Basi viongozi wa jamaa ya Walawi, wakamwendea kuhani Eleazari, Yoshua mwana wa Nuni, na viongozi wa jamaa nyingine za makabila ya Israeli

english: to the descendants of Aaron from the Kohathite clans of the Levites, because the first lot fell to them:
ekegusii: Obomera bw’eritang’ani bokagwera abanto b’ororeria rwa Aroni, eamate eyemo y’Abakohati, abarenge Abalawi.
swahili: (miji hii walipewa wazao wa Aroni ambao walitokana na koo za Wakohathi wa Walawi, kwa sababu kura ya kwanza iliwaangukia):

english: They gave them Kiriath-arba (that is, Hebron), with its surrounding pasturelands, in the hill country of Judah. (Arba was the father of Anak.)
ekegusii: Barabwo bakaegwa Kiriati‐Ariba (noro Heburoni), ase ense y’ebitunwa ya Yuda, amo namarisio aetanaineo. (Ariba nigo arenge sokoro y’Anaki.)
swahili: Waliwapa Kiriath-Arba (yaani Hebroni), pamoja na sehemu zake za malisho zilizoizunguka, katika nchi ya vilima ya Yuda. (Arba alikuwa baba wa Anaki.)

english: But they had given the fields and villages around the city to Caleb son of Jephunneh as his possession.
ekegusii: Korende emegondo amo nebichie bi’omochie oyio konya baeire Kalebu, mosinto o Yefune, bikaba omwando oye.
swahili: Lakini mashamba na vijiji vilivyozunguka mji mkubwa walikuwa wamempa Kalebu mwana wa Yefune kuwa milki yake.

english: So to the descendants of Aaron the priest they gave these cities, together with their pasturelands: Hebron, a city of refuge for the manslayer, Libnah,
ekegusii: Eye nero emechie abanto b’ororeria rwa Aroni Omokuani baetwe: Heburoni, omochie oyio abaiti ba mosiabano baare gotamera, na Libuna,
swahili: Kwa hiyo wazao wa kuhani Aroni wakapewa Hebroni (mji mkuu wa makimbilio kwa ajili ya yeyote aliyeshtakiwa kwa mauaji), Libna,

english: Ain, Juttah, and Beth-shemesh—nine cities from these two tribes, together with their pasturelands.
ekegusii: na Aini, na Yuta, na Beti‐Semesi, emechie kianda, amo namarisio arengeo, korwa ase ebisaku ebio bibere.
swahili: Aini, Yuta na Beth-Shemeshi, pamoja na sehemu zake za malisho, ilikuwa miji tisa kutoka kwa makabila haya mawili.

english: And from the tribe of Benjamin they gave them Gibeon, Geba,
ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku kia Benjamini bakaegwa Gibeoni, na Geba,
swahili: Kutoka kabila la Benyamini wakawapa Gibeoni, Geba,

english: Anathoth, and Almon—four cities, together with their pasturelands.
ekegusii: na Anatoti, na Alamoni, emechie ene, amo namarisio arengeo.
swahili: Anathothi na Almoni, pamoja na sehemu zake za malisho, ilikuwa miji minne.

english: In all, thirteen cities, together with their pasturelands, were given to the priests, the descendants of Aaron.
ekegusii: Emechie yonsi abanto b’ororeria rwa Abakuani baetwe nigo yarenge ikomi na etato; bakayeegwa, amo namarisio arengeo.
swahili: Miji yote waliyopewa makuhani, wazao wa Aroni, ilikuwa kumi na mitatu, pamoja na sehemu zake za malisho.

english: at Shiloh in the land of Canaan and said to them, “The LORD commanded through Moses that we be given cities in which to live, together with pasturelands for our livestock.”
ekegusii: bagakwana nabarabwo agwo Silo, bakabateebia, “Omonene nigo achigete goetera ase Musa ng’a toegwe emechie ase tokomenya, amo namarisio, ase chitugo chiaito chirarisie.”
swahili: huko Shilo katika Kanaani na kuwaambia, “ Bwana aliamuru kupitia Mose kuwa mtupe miji ya kuishi yenye sehemu za malisho kwa mifugo yetu.”

english: The remaining Kohathite clans of the Levites were allotted these cities: From the tribe of Ephraim
ekegusii: Abanto be chiamate chinde chi’Abakohati, abarenge Abalawi, bakaegwa emechie korwa ase egesaku gi’Efraimu, buna obomera bwabagwerete.
swahili: Koo nyingine za Wakohathi, ambao pia ni Walawi, walipewa miji kutoka kabila la Efraimu:

english: they were given Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim (a city of refuge for the manslayer), Gezer,
ekegusii: Bakaegwa Sekemu, omochie oyomo abaiti ba mosiabano baare gotamera, ase ense y’ebitunwa y’Efraimu, na Geseri,
swahili: Katika nchi ya vilima ya Efraimu walipewa Shekemu (mji mkubwa wa makimbilio kwa yeyote anayeshtakiwa kwa mauaji) na Gezeri,

english: Kibzaim, and Beth-horon—four cities, together with their pasturelands.
ekegusii: na Kibusaimu, na Beti‐Horoni, emechie ene, amo namarisio arengeo.
swahili: Kibsaimu na Beth-Horoni, pamoja na sehemu zake za malisho, ilikuwa miji minne.

english: From the tribe of Dan they were given Elteke, Gibbethon,
ekegusii: Na korwa ase egesaku gia Dani bakaegwa Eliteke, na Gibetoni,
swahili: Pia kutoka kabila la Dani wakapokea Elteke, Gibethoni,

english: Aijalon, and Gath-rimmon—four cities, together with their pasturelands.
ekegusii: na Ayaloni, na Gati‐Rimoni, emechie ene, amo namarisio arengeo.
swahili: Aiyaloni na Gath-Rimoni pamoja na sehemu zake za malisho, ilikuwa miji minne

english: And from the half-tribe of Manasseh they were given Taanach and Gath-rimmon—two cities, together with their pasturelands.
ekegusii: Na korwa ase ekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase bakaegwa Taanaki na Gati‐Rimoni, emechie ebere, amo namarisio arengeo.
swahili: Kutoka nusu ya kabila la Manase, wakapokea Taanaki na Gath-Rimoni pamoja na sehemu zake za malisho, ilikuwa miji miwili.

english: In all, ten cities, together with their pasturelands, were given to the rest of the Kohathite clans.
ekegusii: Abanto be chiamate echio chi’Abakohati nigo baetwe emechie eyio ikomi, amo namarisio arengeo.
swahili: Miji yote hii kumi pamoja na sehemu zake za malisho ilipewa koo za Wakohathi zilizobaki.

english: This is what the Levite clans of the Gershonites were given: From the half-tribe of Manasseh they were given Golan in Bashan, a city of refuge for the manslayer, and Beeshterah—two cities, together with their pasturelands.
ekegusii: Abagerisoni, chiamate chinde chi’Abalawi, bakaegwa korwa ase ekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase Golani o Basani, omochie abaiti ba mosiabano baare gotamera, na Besitera, emechie ebere, amo namarisio arengeo.
swahili: Koo za Walawi za Wagershoni walipewa: kutoka nusu ya kabila la Manase, Golani katika Bashani (mji mkuu wa makimbilio kwa yeyote aliyeshtakiwa kwa mauaji) na Beeshtera, pamoja na sehemu zake za malisho, ilikuwa miji miwili;

english: From the tribe of Issachar they were given Kishion, Daberath,
ekegusii: Na korwa ase egesaku gia Isakaru bakaegwa Kisioni, na Daberati,
swahili: kutoka kabila la Isakari walipewa, Kishioni, Daberathi,

english: Jarmuth, and En-gannim—four cities, together with their pasturelands.
ekegusii: na Yarimuti na Eni‐Ganimu, emechie ene, amo namarisio arengeo.
swahili: Yarmuthi na En-Ganimu, pamoja na sehemu zake za malisho, ilikuwa miji minne

english: So by the command of the LORD, the Israelites gave the Levites these cities and their pasturelands out of their own inheritance:
ekegusii: Ase igo Abaisraeli bakaa Abalawi emechie gete amo namarisio arengeo korwa ase emiando yabo, koreng’ana buna Omonene achigete.
swahili: Hivyo kama vile Bwana alivyoamuru, Waisraeli wakawapa Walawi miji ifuatayo pamoja na sehemu zake za malisho kutoka urithi wao wenyewe.

english: From the tribe of Asher they were given Mishal, Abdon,
ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku gi’Aseri bakaegwa Misali, na Abidoni,
swahili: kutoka kabila la Asheri walipewa, Mishali, Abdoni,

english: Helkath, and Rehob—four cities, together with their pasturelands.
ekegusii: na Helikati, na Rehobo, emechie ene, amo namarisio arengeo.
swahili: Helkathi na Rehobu, pamoja na sehemu zake za malisho, ilikuwa miji minne.

english: And from the tribe of Naphtali they were given Kedesh in Galilee (a city of refuge for the manslayer), Hammoth-dor, and Kartan—three cities, together with their pasturelands.
ekegusii: Na korwa ase egesaku kia Nafutali bakaegwa Kedesi o Galili, omochie abaiti ba mosiabano baare gotamera, na Hamoti‐Dori, na Karitani, emechie etato, amo namarisio arengeo.
swahili: Kutoka kabila la Naftali walipewa, Kedeshi katika Galilaya (mji wa makimbilio kwa ajili ya yeyote anayeshtakiwa kwa mauaji), Hamoth-Dori na Kartani, pamoja na sehemu zake za malisho, ilikuwa miji mitano.

english: In all, thirteen cities, together with their pasturelands, were given to the Gershonite clans.
ekegusii: Nabo abanto be chiamate chionsi chi’Abagerisoni baetwe emechie ikomi na etato, amo namarisio arengeo.
swahili: Miji yote ya koo za Wagershoni ilikuwa kumi na mitatu, pamoja na sehemu zake za malisho.

english: This is what the Merarite clan (the rest of the Levites) were given: From the tribe of Zebulun they were given Jokneam, Kartah,
ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku gia Sabuloni, Abalawi abatigarete, chiamate chia Merari, bakaegwa emechie ya Yokinamu, na Karita,
swahili: Koo za Wamerari (Walawi waliobaki) walipewa: kutoka kabila la Zabuloni, Yokneamu, Karta,

english: Dimnah, and Nahalal—four cities, together with their pasturelands.
ekegusii: na Dimuna, na Nahalali, emechie ene, amo namarisio arengeo.
swahili: Dimna na Nahalali, pamoja na sehemu zake za malisho, ilikuwa miji minne;

english: From the tribe of Reuben they were given Bezer, Jahaz,
ekegusii: Na korwa ase egesaku kia Rubeni bakaegwa Beseri, na Yahasi,
swahili: kutoka kabila la Reubeni walipewa Bezeri, Yahasa,

english: Kedemoth, and Mephaath—four cities, together with their pasturelands.
ekegusii: na Kedemoti, na Mefaati, emechie ene, amo namarisio arengeo.
swahili: Kedemothi na Mefaathi, pamoja na sehemu zake za malisho, ilikuwa miji minne;

english: And from the tribe of Gad they were given Ramoth in Gilead, a city of refuge for the manslayer, Mahanaim,
ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku kia Gadi bakaegwa Ramoti o Gileadi, omochie abaiti ba mosiabano baare gotamera, na Mahanaimu,
swahili: kutoka kabila la Gadi walipewa, Ramothi katika Gileadi (mji wa makimbilio kwa ajili ya yeyote anayeshtakiwa kwa ajili ya mauaji), Mahanaimu,

english: Heshbon, and Jazer—four cities in all, together with their pasturelands.
ekegusii: na Hesiboni, na Yaeseri, emechie ene, amo namarisio arengeo.
swahili: Heshboni na Yazeri, pamoja na sehemu zake za malisho, ilikuwa miji minne.

english: The first lot came out for the Kohathite clans. The Levites who were descendants of Aaron the priest received thirteen cities by lot from the tribes of Judah, Simeon, and Benjamin.
ekegusii: Obomera bokagwera chiamate chi’Abakohati buna iga: Abalawi abarenge b’ororeria rwa Aroni, Omokuani, bakanyora emechie ikomi na etato korwa ase egesaku kia Yuda, na egia Simioni, na ekia Benjamini, buna obomera bwabagwerete.
swahili: Kura ya kwanza ikaangukia Wakohathi, ukoo kwa ukoo. Walawi waliokuwa wazao wa kuhani Aroni walipewa miji kumi na mitatu kutoka makabila ya Yuda, Simeoni na Benyamini.

english: In all, twelve cities were allotted to the clans of Merari, the remaining Levite clans.
ekegusii: Nabo abanto b’eamate ya Merari, abatigarete ase chiamate chi’Abalawi, baetwe emechie ikomi na ebere, buna obomera bwabagwerete.
swahili: Miji yote waliyopewa koo za Wamerari, waliokuwa mabaki ya Walawi, ilikuwa ni kumi na miwili.

english: For the Levites, then, there were forty-eight cities in all, together with their pasturelands, within the territory of the Israelites.
ekegusii: Emechie yonsi y’Abalawi eyarenge ase egati y’omwando bw’Abaisraeli nigo yarenge emerongo ene, na etano na etato, amo namarisio arengeo.
swahili: Miji yote ya Walawi katika eneo lililoshikwa na Waisraeli lilikuwa arobaini na minane, pamoja na sehemu zake za malisho.

english: Each of these cities had its own surrounding pasturelands; this was true for all the cities.
ekegusii: Kera omochie bw’eyio nigo orenge namarisio aetanaineo, Nabo arenge ase emechie eyio yonsi. Abaisraeli bakoira ense eria
swahili: Kila mmoja wa miji hii ulikuwa na sehemu ya malisho kuuzunguka; ndivyo ilivyokuwa kwa miji hii yote.

english: Thus the LORD gave Israel all the land He had sworn to give their fathers, and they took possession of it and settled in it.
ekegusii: Ase ig’Omonene akaa Abaisraeli ense eyio yonsi arierete chisokoro chiabo eira ng’a nabayee; barabwo kobayeeirwe bakamenya aroro.
swahili: Kwa hiyo Bwana akawapa Israeli nchi yote aliyokuwa ameapa kuwapa baba zao, nao wakaimiliki na kukaa humo.

english: And the LORD gave them rest on every side, just as He had sworn to their fathers. None of their enemies could stand against them, for the LORD delivered all their enemies into their hand.
ekegusii: Omonene akabaa obotoereru ase chinsemo chionsi, buna arierete chisokoro chiabo eira ase ogotiana. Onde tarenge ase ababisa babo obabuete, ekiagera Omonene abegete ababisa babo bonsi ase amaboko abo.
swahili: Bwana akawapa pumziko kila upande, kama vile alivyokuwa amewaapia baba zao, hakuna hata mmoja wa adui zao aliyeweza kusimama mbele yao, Bwana akawatia adui zao wote mikononi mwao.

english: Not one of all the LORD’s good promises to the house of Israel had failed; everything was fulfilled.
ekegusii: Nab’Omonene aikeranetie chiira chionsi chingiya echi abarierete Abaisraeli. Ende teri etaikeranetigwe.
swahili: Hakuna hata mojawapo ya ahadi nzuri ya Bwana kwa nyumba ya Israeli ambayo haikutimia; kila moja ilitimia.

english: The remaining descendants of Kohath received ten cities by lot from the tribes of Ephraim, Dan, and the half-tribe of Manasseh.
ekegusii: Na Abakohati abatigarete bakanyora emechie ikomi korwa ase chiamate chi’egesaku ki’Efraimu na ekia Dani, na ekeng’ese kia Manase, buna obomera bwabagwerete.
swahili: Wazao wengine waliobaki wa Wakohathi walipewa miji kumi kutoka koo za makabila ya Efraimu, Dani na nusu ya Manase.

english: The descendants of Gershon received thirteen cities by lot from the tribes of Issachar, Asher, Naphtali, and the half-tribe of Manasseh in Bashan.
ekegusii: Abagerisoni bakanyora emechie ikomi na etato korwa ase chiamate chi’egesaku gia Isakaru, na egi’Aseri, na ekia Nafutali, na ekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase agwo Basani, buna obomera bwabagwerete.
swahili: Wazao wa Gershoni walipewa miji kumi na mitatu kutoka koo za makabila ya Isakari, Asheri, Naftali na nusu ya Manase huko Bashani.

english: And the descendants of Merari received twelve cities from the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and Zebulun.
ekegusii: Abamerari bakanyora emechie ikomi na ebere ase chiamate chiabo korwa ase chiamate chi’egesaku kia Rubeni, na ekia Gadi, na egia Sabuloni.
swahili: Wazao wa Merari, ukoo kwa ukoo, walipewa miji kumi na miwili kutoka makabila ya Reubeni, Gadi na Zabuloni.

english: So the Israelites allotted to the Levites these cities, together with their pasturelands, as the LORD had commanded through Moses.
ekegusii: Nabo Abaisraeli baete Abalawi emechie eyio amo namarisio arengeo, ase ogoaka obomera, buna Omonene konya achiikire goetera ase Musa.
swahili: Kwa hiyo Waisraeli wakawapa Walawi miji hii pamoja na sehemu zake za malisho, kama vile Bwana alivyokuwa ameamuru kupitia kwa Mose.

english: From the tribes of Judah and Simeon, they designated these cities by name
ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku kia Yuda, na egia Simioni bakarua emechie eyio egwatorwa aiga.
swahili: Kutoka makabila ya Yuda na Simeoni waligawa miji ifuatayo kwa majina

english: Then Joshua summoned the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh
ekegusii: Erio Yoshua akarangeria abanto b’egesaku kia Rubeni, na ekia Gadi, amo nekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase,
swahili: Ndipo Yoshua akawaita Wareubeni, Wagadi na nusu ya kabila la Manase,

english: And when they came to Geliloth near the Jordan in the land of Canaan, the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh built an imposing altar there by the Jordan.
ekegusii: Ekero abanto abwo b’egesaku kia Rubeni na ekia Dani amo nekeng’ese gi’ekia Manase baigete Yorodani mbarabare ase ensemo ya Kaanani bakaagacha aroro egesasiimero ekenene kiare kororekana korwa are.
swahili: Walipofika Gelilothi karibu na Yordani, katika nchi ya Kanaani, Wareubeni, Wagadi na nusu ya kabila la Manase wakajenga madhabahu ya fahari kubwa huko kando ya Yordani.

english: Then the Israelites received the report: “Behold, the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh have built an altar on the border of the land of Canaan, at Geliloth near the Jordan on the Israelite side.”
ekegusii: Abaisraeli bande bakaigwa amang’ana aya agokwanwa, “Naama! Abanto b’egesaku kia Rubeni, na ekia Gadi, amo nekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase baagachire egesasiimero aria Geliloti, ensemo ya bosio bw’ense ya Kaanani, ang’e na Yorodani, erochie ensemo y’Abaisraeli.”
swahili: Waisraeli wengine waliposikia kwamba Wareubeni, Wagadi na ile nusu ya kabila la Manase walikuwa wamejenga madhabahu kwenye mpaka wa Kanaani huko Gelilothi karibu na Yordani kwenye upande wa Israeli,

english: And when they heard this, the whole congregation of Israel assembled at Shiloh to go to war against them.
ekegusii: Ekero Abaisraeli baigwete amang’ana ayio, omoganda obo bwonsi ogasangererekana agwo Silo, erinde ogende kobarwania esegi.
swahili: kusanyiko lote la Israeli wakakusanyika huko Shilo ili wakapigane vita dhidi yao.

english: The Israelites sent Phinehas son of Eleazar the priest to the land of Gilead, to the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh.
ekegusii: Erio Abaisraeli bagatoma Finehasi, mosinto bw’Eleazari, Omokuani, gochia ase abanto b’egesaku kia Rubeni na ekia Dani amo nekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase, ase ense ya Gileadi.
swahili: Kwa hiyo Waisraeli wengine wakamtuma Finehasi mwana wa kuhani Eleazari katika nchi ya Gileadi, kwa Wareubeni, Wagadi na hiyo nusu ya kabila la Manase.

english: With him they sent ten chiefs—one family leader from each tribe of Israel, each the head of a family among the clans of Israel.
ekegusii: Amo na Finehasi bagatoma abatang’ani ikomi, oyomo bwa kera egesaku ki’Abaisraeli; kera oyomo nigo arenge omoteneneri bw’eamate ase egesaku kiaye.
swahili: Wakatuma pamoja naye watu kumi ambao ni viongozi, mmoja kwa kila kabila la Israeli, kila mmoja aliyekuwa kiongozi katika mgawanyiko wa jamaa miongoni mwa koo za Israeli.

english: They went to the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh in the land of Gilead and said to them,
ekegusii: Ekero barabwo baigete ase ense ya Gileadi, ase abanto b’egesaku kia Rubeni, na ekia Gadi, na ekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase, bagakwana nabarabwo, bakabateebia,
swahili: Walipofika Gileadi, kwa Wareubeni, Wagadi na nusu ya kabila la Manase, wakawaambia:

english: “This is what the whole congregation of the LORD says: ‘What is this breach of faith you have committed today against the God of Israel by turning away from the LORD and building for yourselves an altar, that you might rebel against the LORD this day?
ekegusii: “Intwe nigo togokwana ribaga ri’omosangererekano bwonsi bw’Omonene. Nase ki motari nobwegenwa ase Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli? Mwatigire Omonene reero ase okweagachera egesasiimero, mwabeire mamincha y’Omonene.
swahili: “Kusanyiko lote la Bwana lasema: ‘Je, mmewezaje kuacha kumwamini Mungu wa Israeli jinsi hii? Mmewezaje kumwacha Bwana na kujijengea madhabahu dhidi yake na kumwasi?
