ekegusii: Chinchera chikogenda Sayoni nigo chiichanete, ekiagera onde tari ogocha ase Amatuko Amanene achiikire; ebiita biaye bionsi nigo bitigarete bosa, na abakuani baye bonsi nigo baichanete. Abaiseke baye abekungi nigo baumatete, na omochie omonyene nigo ore nobororo obonge.
swahili: Barabara zielekeazo Sayuni zaomboleza, kwa kuwa hakuna yeyote anayekuja kwenye sikukuu zake zilizoamriwa. Malango yake yote yamekuwa ukiwa, makuhani wake wanalia kwa uchungu, wanawali wake wanahuzunika, naye yuko katika uchungu wa maumivu makuu.

english: Her foes have become her masters; her enemies are at ease. For the LORD has brought her grief because of her many transgressions. Her children have gone away as captives before the enemy.
ekegusii: Ababisa baye babeire abanene baye, ee, ababisa baye nigo bagendererete goseseneka. Omonene oyotomeire emechando ase engencho y’ogosaria kwaye okonge, na ababisa baye bairire abana baye ase obosomba.
swahili: Adui zake wamekuwa mabwana zake, watesi wake wana raha. Bwana amemletea huzuni kwa sababu ya dhambi zake nyingi. Watoto wake wamekwenda uhamishoni, mateka mbele ya adui.

english: All the splendor has departed from the Daughter of Zion. Her princes are like deer that find no pasture; they lack the strength to flee in the face of the hunter.
ekegusii: Ogosikwa gwonsi kwarure ase abanto ba Sayoni; abagaambi baye babeire buna chingabi chitabwati ase chikorisia; batamire korwa ase abakobabwatia, tibari ne chinguru.
swahili: Fahari yote imeondoka kutoka kwa Binti Sayuni. Wakuu wake wako kama ayala ambaye hapati malisho, katika udhaifu wamekimbia mbele ya anayewasaka.

english: In the days of her affliction and wandering Jerusalem remembers all the treasures that were hers in days of old. When her people fell into enemy hands she received no help. Her enemies looked upon her, laughing at her downfall.
ekegusii: Ekero abanto ba Yerusalemu baarenge nemechando na obokong’u, bakaba bakoinyora ebinto ebiya mono baarenge nabio ase amatuko a kare. Agwo ekero bagwete ase amaboko y’abachandi, onde tarenge ore kobakonya, abachandi babo bakobachecheria ase engencho y’okogwa kwabo.
swahili: Katika siku za mateso yake na kutangatanga, Yerusalemu hukumbuka hazina zote ambazo zilikuwa zake siku za kale. Wakati watu wake walipoanguka katika mikono ya adui, hapakuwepo na yeyote wa kumsaidia. Watesi wake walimtazama na kumcheka katika maangamizi yake.

english: Jerusalem has sinned greatly; therefore she has become an object of scorn. All who honored her now despise her, for they have seen her nakedness; she herself groans and turns away.
ekegusii: Abanto ba Yerusalemu bakorire ebibe ebinene; ase ayio babeire okogechia, bonsi abaabasigete baabachayire, ekiagera barorire obogetirianda bwabo. Ee, omochie omonyene nkweumia ore, bweonchoire gochia magega.
swahili: Yerusalemu ametenda dhambi sana kwa hiyo amekuwa najisi. Wote waliomheshimu wanamdharau, kwa maana wameuona uchi wake. Yeye mwenyewe anapiga kite na kugeukia mbali.

english: Her uncleanness stains her skirts; she did not consider her end. Her downfall was astounding; there was no one to comfort her. Look, O LORD, on my affliction, for the enemy has triumphed!
ekegusii: Riko riaye nigo riarenge ase chianga chiaye, tarengereretie igoro y’omoerio oye. Ase ayio okogwa kwaye gokaba ogw’okoondokia, tarenge nonde okomoremia. “Aye Omonene, rigereria emechando yane, ekiagera omobisa one ngwetogia are!”
swahili: Uchafu wake umegandamana na nguo zake; hakuwaza juu ya maisha yake ya baadaye. Anguko lake lilikuwa la kushangaza, hapakuwepo na yeyote wa kumfariji. “Tazama, Ee Bwana, teso langu, kwa maana adui ameshinda.”

english: How the Lord has covered the Daughter of Zion with the cloud of His anger! He has cast the glory of Israel from heaven to earth. He has abandoned His footstool in the day of His anger.
ekegusii: Naki Omonene atubire omochie o Sayoni nomosunte, ekero arenge n’endamwamu! Otugutire obonene bokomeka‐meka bw’Abaisraeli korwa igoro gocha inse aa. Ere tainyoreti egeteni ki’amagoro aye, ase rituko ri’endamwamu yaye.
swahili: Tazama jinsi Bwana alivyomfunika Binti Sayuni kwa wingu la hasira yake! Ameitupa chini fahari ya Israeli kutoka mbinguni mpaka duniani, hakukumbuka kiti chake cha kuwekea miguu katika siku ya hasira yake.

english: The elders of the Daughter of Zion sit on the ground in silence. They have thrown dust on their heads and put on sackcloth. The young women of Jerusalem have bowed their heads to the ground.
ekegusii: Abagaaka b’omochie o Sayoni nigo baikaransete inse bakirete‐kiri, besiarerete ebuse ase emetwe yabo na kweboyia chigunia, abaiseke abekungi ba Yerusalemu nigo baturegete emetwe yabo gochia inse.
swahili: Wazee wa Binti Sayuni wanaketi chini kimya, wamenyunyiza mavumbi kwenye vichwa vyao na kuvaa nguo za gunia. Wanawali wa Yerusalemu wamesujudu hadi ardhini.

english: My eyes fail from weeping; I am churning within. My heart is poured out in grief over the destruction of the daughter of my people, because children and infants faint in the streets of the city.
ekegusii: Amaiso aane arosire ase okoiyeria amariga, omoyo one oonchokanire, na enkoro yane yachandekire ase engencho y’ogosaria kw’omochie bw’abaanto bane, ekiagera abana, nonya nabakogonka, nigo bakona‐kogireka ase chinchera chi’omochie.
swahili: Macho yangu yamedhoofika kwa kulia, nina maumivu makali ndani, moyo wangu umemiminwa ardhini kwa sababu watu wangu wameangamizwa, kwa sababu watoto na wanyonyao wanazimia kwenye barabara za mji.

english: They cry out to their mothers: “Where is the grain and wine?” as they faint like the wounded in the streets of the city, as their lives fade away in the arms of their mothers.
ekegusii: Barabwo nigo bakoboria abang’ina: “Ng’ai endagera ere, na edivai?” Nigo bakona‐kogireka na korara ase chinchera chi’omochie buna abaakirwe chingoma, batweka mo ase amaboko ’abang’ina.
swahili: Wanawaambia mama zao, “Wapi mkate na divai?” wazimiapo kama watu waliojeruhiwa katika barabara za mji, maisha yao yadhoofikavyo mikononi mwa mama zao.

english: What can I say for you? To what can I compare you, O Daughter of Jerusalem? To what can I liken you, that I may console you, O Virgin Daughter of Zion? For your wound is as deep as the sea. Who can ever heal you?
ekegusii: Aye omochie o Yerusalemu, ninki ndagoteebie? Ninki ndakoreng’anie? Mang’ana ki anga buna ayao ndagoteebie, erinde nkoremie, aye Sayoni ore buna omoiseke omwekuungi? Ogosarigwa kwao nokonene buna enyancha ere enene, ning’o oranyare gokogwenia?
swahili: Ninaweza kusema nini kwa ajili yako? Nikulinganishe na nini, ee Binti Yerusalemu? Nitakufananisha na nini, ili nipate kukufariji, ee Bikira Binti Sayuni? Jeraha lako lina kina kama bahari. Ni nani awezaye kukuponya?

english: The visions of your prophets were empty and deceptive; they did not expose your guilt to ward off your captivity. The burdens they envisioned for you were empty and misleading.
ekegusii: Abaabani bao nigo bakobarorera amaroro ’obong’ainereria are bosa, tibakoorokeretie obobe bwao, erinde nario orairanerigwe amaya ao; korende aya amaroro abo ayakworogetie, nigo arenge ay’oborimo, agerete ogatantanigwa.
swahili: Maono ya manabii wako yalikuwa ya uongo na yasiyofaa kitu, hawakuifunua dhambi yako ili kukuzuilia kwenda utumwani. Maneno waliyokupa yalikuwa ya uongo na ya kupotosha.

english: All who pass by clap their hands at you in scorn. They hiss and shake their heads at the Daughter of Jerusalem: “Is this the city that was called the perfection of beauty, the joy of all the earth?”
ekegusii: Abanto bonsi abagoeta inchera nigo bagoaka chinkobi ase okogochaaya, nigo bakobugia emeroria na gosingiseria omochie o Yerusalemu emetwe, bakobora: “Inee! Omochie oyio noro orenge korokwa omoikeranu bw’obosiani, na omogooko bw’ense yonsi?”
swahili: Wote wapitiao njia yako wanakupigia makofi, wanakudhihaki na kutikisa vichwa vyao kwa Binti Yerusalemu: “Huu ndio ule mji ulioitwa mkamilifu wa uzuri, furaha ya dunia yote?”

english: All your enemies open their mouths against you. They hiss and gnash their teeth, saying, “We have swallowed her up. This is the day for which we have waited. We have lived to see it!”
ekegusii: Ababisa bao bonsi baasamirie emenwa yabo gokobugeria emeroria na gokoriananeria amaino, bakobora: “Twayosaririe! Ee, rituko eri nario twaganetie, bono twariikeire, twarirorire!”
swahili: Adui zako wote wanapanua vinywa vyao dhidi yako, wanadhihaki na kusaga meno yao na kusema, “Tumemmeza. Hii ndiyo siku tuliyoingojea, tumeishi na kuiona.”

english: The LORD has done what He planned; He has accomplished His decree, which He ordained in days of old; He has overthrown you without pity. He has let the enemy gloat over you and exalted the horn of your foes.
ekegusii: Omonene okorire aya achiigete ng’a ayakore, oikeranirie ring’ana riaye aroberetie agwo kare, otagoire atari namaabera, otigire ababisa bao bagochenga igoro yao, ere okinirie ching’unchara chi’ababisa bao.
swahili: Bwana amefanya lile alilolipanga; ametimiza neno lake aliloliamuru siku za kale. Amekuangusha bila huruma, amewaacha adui wakusimange, ametukuza pembe ya adui yako.

english: The hearts of the people cry out to the Lord. O wall of the Daughter of Zion, let your tears run down like a river day and night. Give yourself no relief, and your eyes no rest.
ekegusii: Chinkoro chiabo nigo chikorera ase Omonene. Ee, aye orwaki rw’omochie o Sayoni, tiga amariga ao aiteke buna orooche, omobaso na obotuko! Tobaisa korosa, gose gotimokia amaiso ao.
swahili: Mioyo ya watu inamlilia Bwana. Ee ukuta wa Binti Sayuni, machozi yako na yatiririke kama mto usiku na mchana; usijipe nafuu, macho yako yasipumzike.

english: Arise, cry out in the night from the first watch of the night. Pour out your heart like water in the presence of the Lord. Lift up your hands to Him for the lives of your children who are fainting from hunger on the corner of every street.
ekegusii: Imoka, orere botuko bokie! Ekero oborendi bw’obotuko bogochaka, oumore ayare ase enkoro yao ime ase obosio bw’Omonene, buna okoumora amaache! Rambora amaboko ao asare osabere obogima bw’abana bao, abwo bagoyire nenchara ase amatabekania e chinchera chionsi.
swahili: Inuka, lia usiku, zamu za usiku zianzapo; mimina moyo wako kama maji mbele za Bwana. Mwinulie yeye mikono yako kwa ajili ya maisha ya watoto wako, ambao wanazimia kwa njaa kwenye kila mwanzo wa barabara.

english: Without pity the Lord has swallowed up all the dwellings of Jacob. In His wrath He has demolished the fortified cities of the Daughter of Judah. He brought to the ground and defiled her kingdom and its princes.
ekegusii: Omonene oiyeirie inse obomenyo bwonsi bw’abaanto ba Yakobo atari namaabera, otagoire chiburi chi’ense y’Abayuda, ekero arenge nendamwamu; osiririe oborwoti, na ourire abanene baye amasikani.
swahili: Bila huruma Bwana ameyameza makao yote ya Yakobo; katika ghadhabu yake amebomoa ngome za Binti Yuda. Ameuangusha ufalme wake na wakuu wake chini kwa aibu.

english: Look, O LORD, and consider: Whom have You ever treated like this? Should women eat their offspring, the infants they have nurtured? Should priests and prophets be killed in the sanctuary of the Lord?
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, rigereria orore! Ning’o gwakorerete buna ayio? Inee! Abakungu mbarie oroiboro rwabo, abana abwo barerete ase amaboko abo? Inee! Abakuani na ababani mbaiterwe agwo Aase Aachenu a Omonene?
swahili: “Tazama, Ee Bwana, ufikirie: Ni nani ambaye umepata kumtendea namna hii? Je, wanawake wakule wazao wao, watoto waliowalea? Je, kuhani na nabii auawe mahali patakatifu pa Bwana?

english: Both young and old lie together in the dust of the streets. My young men and maidens have fallen by the sword. You have slain them in the day of Your anger; You have slaughtered them without compassion.
ekegusii: Abamura na abagaaka nigo baraire ase chinchera inse, abaiseke bane, na abamura bane, baitirwe nemioro; ase rituko ri’endamwamu yao kwabaitire otari namaabera.
swahili: “Vijana na wazee hujilaza pamoja katika mavumbi ya barabarani, wavulana wangu na wasichana wameanguka kwa upanga. Umewaua katika siku ya hasira yako, umewachinja bila huruma.

english: You summoned my attackers on every side, as for the day of an appointed feast. In the day of the LORD’s anger no one escaped or survived; my enemy has destroyed those I nurtured and reared.
ekegusii: Buna ase rituko ri’omoyega omonene okarangeria ababisa bane bakanyoboyia korwa chinsemo chionsi; ase rituko ri’endamwamu y’Omonene onde tatooregete, gose gotigara, ase abwo nabogoretie na kobareera. Ababisa bane baabasiririe.
swahili: “Kama ulivyoita siku ya karamu, ndivyo ulivyoagiza hofu kuu dhidi yangu kila upande. Katika siku ya hasira ya Bwana hakuna yeyote aliyekwepa au kupona; wale niliowatunza na kuwalea, adui yangu amewaangamiza.”

english: In fierce anger He has cut off every horn of Israel and withdrawn His right hand at the approach of the enemy. He has burned in Jacob like a flaming fire that consumes everything around it.
ekegusii: Obutoire ching’unchara chionsi chi’Abaisraeli ore nendamwamu yaye entindi, orusirie okoboko kwaye gw’okorio korwa ase bare ase amasio ’ababisa babo: ere osambire abanto ba Yakobo buna omorero ekebemberi ogosamba ase chinsemo chionsi.
swahili: Katika hasira kali amevunja kila pembe ya Israeli. Ameuondoa mkono wake wa kuume alipokaribia adui. Amemteketeza Yakobo kama moto uwakao ule uteketezao kila kitu kinachouzunguka.

english: He has bent His bow like an enemy; His right hand is positioned. Like a foe He has killed all who were pleasing to the eye; He has poured out His wrath like fire on the tent of the Daughter of Zion.
ekegusii: Ere otingire obota bwaye buna omobisa agotinga, otenenire na kobong’usa nokoboko kwaye gw’okorio buna omochandi; agaita bonsi aba twetogeretie. Igoro y’obomenyo bw’abaanto ba Sayoni, oumoire ekeririanda kiaye kere buna omorero.
swahili: Ameupinda upinde wake kama adui, mkono wake wa kuume uko tayari. Kama vile adui amewachinja wote waliokuwa wanapendeza jicho, amemwaga ghadhabu yake kama moto juu ya hema la Binti Sayuni.

english: The Lord is like an enemy; He has swallowed up Israel. He has swallowed up all her palaces and destroyed her strongholds. He has multiplied mourning and lamentation for the Daughter of Judah.
ekegusii: Omonene obeire buna omobisa, osiririe Abaisraeli; osiririe chinyomba chiaye chionsi chi’oborwoti, otagoire chiburi chiaye chinkong’u; naende omenteire abanto ba Yuda okorera na okweumia.
swahili: Bwana ni kama adui; amemmeza Israeli. Amemeza majumba yake yote ya kifalme na kuangamiza ngome zake. Ameongeza huzuni na maombolezo kwa ajili ya Binti Yuda.

english: He has laid waste His tabernacle like a garden booth; He has destroyed His place of meeting. The LORD has made Zion forget her appointed feasts and Sabbaths. In His fierce anger He has despised both king and priest.
ekegusii: Ere oiyeirie inse orobago rwaye rore buna orw’omogondo, ee, osaririe aase emesangererekano y’ogosasiima ekobeera. Omonene otigire abanto bebire Amatuko Amanene ne Chisabato agwo Sayoni, na ase okogechigwa kwaye okonene bwangire omorwoti na Omokuani.
swahili: Ameharibu maskani yake kama bustani, ameharibu mahali pake pa mkutano. Bwana amemfanya Sayuni kusahau sikukuu zake zilizoamriwa na Sabato zake; katika hasira yake kali amewadharau mfalme na kuhani.

english: The Lord has rejected His altar; He has abandoned His sanctuary; He has delivered the walls of her palaces into the hand of the enemy. They have raised a shout in the house of the LORD as on the day of an appointed feast.
ekegusii: Omonene bwangire egesasiimero kiaye, otigire Aase aye Aachenu asarigwe; otigire chindwaki chiaye ase amaboko ’ababisa. Abanto bakuurire ime ase enyomba y’Omonene, buna nase rituko ri’omosangererekano bw’ogosasiima.
swahili: Bwana amekataa madhabahu yake na kuacha mahali patakatifu pake. Amemkabidhi adui kuta za majumba yake ya kifalme; wamepiga kelele katika nyumba ya Bwana kama katika siku ya sikukuu iliyoamriwa.

english: The LORD determined to destroy the wall of the Daughter of Zion. He stretched out a measuring line and did not withdraw His hand from destroying. He made the ramparts and walls lament; together they waste away.
ekegusii: Omonene onachire ase ebirengererio biaye gosaria chindwaki chi’omochie o Sayoni, oramboire engori y’okorengera. Tagotanga okoboko kwaye tayosaria; otigire chiburi ne chindwaki chikweumia, chionsi amo nigo chiumatete.
swahili: Bwana alikusudia kuangusha ukuta uliomzunguka Binti Sayuni. Ameinyoosha kamba ya kupimia na hakuuzuia mkono wake usiangamize. Alifanya maboma na kuta ziomboleze, vyote vikaharibika pamoja.

english: Her gates have sunk into the ground; He has destroyed and shattered their bars. Her king and her princes are exiled among the nations, the law is no more, and even her prophets find no vision from the LORD.
ekegusii: Ebiita biaye biarimeire ase riroba, emekorogoto yaye yabunirwe na gosarigwa. Omorwoti oye, na abagaambi baye, nigo bamenyete ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku bitabwati amachiiko, na ababani baye tibari konyora amaroro korwa ase Omonene.
swahili: Malango yake yamezama ardhini, makomeo yake ameyavunja na kuyaharibu. Mfalme wake na wakuu wake wamepelekwa uhamishoni miongoni mwa mataifa, sheria haipo tena, na manabii wake hawapati tena maono kutoka kwa Bwana.

english: I am the man who has seen affliction under the rod of God’s wrath.
ekegusii: Inche nomonto narorire emechando inse y’endamwamu y’Omonene ere buna enyimbo.
swahili: Mimi ndiye mtu aliyeona mateso kwa fimbo ya ghadhabu yake.

english: He is a bear lying in wait, a lion hiding in ambush.
ekegusii: Nigo amboerete buna edubu, enyang’au entindi, ekoboera, na buna endo eboerete eite.
swahili: Kama dubu aviziaye, kama simba mafichoni,

english: He forced me off my path and tore me to pieces; He left me without help.
ekegusii: Oonchoranire chinchera chiane na kombutorana ebing’ese, ontigire ntang’ang’ete bosa.
swahili: ameniburuta kutoka njia, akanirarua na kuniacha bila msaada.

english: He bent His bow and set me as the target for His arrow.
ekegusii: Otingire obota bwaye, na ombekire imbe ekerenga akoruta chinsara.
swahili: Amevuta upinde wake na kunifanya mimi niwe lengo kwa ajili ya mishale yake.

english: He pierced my kidneys with His arrows.
ekegusii: Ere ondasire ne chinsara chi’egochi yaye, chiasoire ase chinyigo chiane.
swahili: Alinichoma moyo wangu kwa mishale iliyotoka kwenye podo lake.

english: I am a laughingstock to all my people; they mock me in song all day long.
ekegusii: Inche nabeire oyo ogosekererwa nabaanto bane bonsi, na engeero y’ogochaaya kwabo omobaso boira.
swahili: Nimekuwa kichekesho kwa watu wangu wote, wananidhihaki kwa wimbo mchana kutwa.

english: He has filled me with bitterness; He has intoxicated me with wormwood.
ekegusii: Ong’ichoirie nobororo, ong’eire ekenyugwa ekeroro nanyure.
swahili: Amenijaza kwa majani machungu na kunishibisha kwa nyongo.

english: He has ground my teeth with gravel and trampled me in the dust.
ekegusii: Obunire amaino aane ase ogontakunia chinche chi’amagena, ontubire neribu.
swahili: Amevunja meno yangu kwa changarawe, amenikanyagia mavumbini.

english: My soul has been deprived of peace; I have forgotten what prosperity is.
ekegusii: Aye kwarusirie omorembe ase omoyo one, na inche nebire ayare ay’omogooko.
swahili: Amani yangu imeondolewa, nimesahau kufanikiwa ni nini.

english: So I say, “My strength has perished, along with my hope from the LORD.” The Prophet’s Hope
ekegusii: Ngateeba, “Chinguru chiane chiaerire, na ogosemeria kwane ase Omonene boigo.”
swahili: Kwa hiyo nasema, “Fahari yangu imeondoka na yale yote niliyokuwa nimetarajia kutoka kwa Bwana.”

english: Remember my affliction and wandering, the wormwood and the gall.
ekegusii: Inyora emechando yane, na obokong’u bwane, buna nanyure ay’obororo na obosongo.
swahili: Nayakumbuka mateso yangu na kutangatanga kwangu, uchungu na nyongo.

english: He has driven me away and made me walk in darkness instead of light.
ekegusii: Ontang’anire na kong’etia ase omosunte, gose tari ase omobaso
swahili: Amenifukuzia mbali na kunifanya nitembee gizani wala si katika nuru;

english: Surely my soul remembers and is humbled within me.
ekegusii: Omoyo one nigo ogendererete koyainyora, na bwekeeirie ime yane.
swahili: Ninayakumbuka vyema, nayo nafsi yangu imezimia ndani yangu.

english: Yet I call this to mind, and therefore I have hope:
ekegusii: Korende amang’ana aya nigo nkoyainyora ase omoyo one, ase ayio ninde nogosemeria.
swahili: Hata hivyo najikumbusha neno hili na kwa hiyo ninalo tumaini.

english: Because of the loving devotion of the LORD we are not consumed, for His mercies never fail.
ekegusii: Nobwanchani bw’Omonene botari koera ng’a titosiriri, ekiagera amaabera aye tari koera;
swahili: Kwa sababu ya upendo mkuu wa Bwana, hatuangamii, kwa kuwa huruma zake hazikomi kamwe.

english: They are new every morning; great is Your faithfulness!
ekegusii: nigo bire ebiyia ase kera emambia, ee, obwegenwa bwao nigo bore obonene.
swahili: Ni mpya kila asubuhi, uaminifu wako ni mkuu.

english: “The LORD is my portion,” says my soul, “therefore I will hope in Him.”
ekegusii: Omonene nere egetari kiane, ayio naro omoyo one ontebirie, ase ayio nimosemeretie.
swahili: Nimeiambia nafsi yangu, “ Bwana ni fungu langu, kwa hiyo nitamngojea.”

english: The LORD is good to those who wait for Him, to the soul who seeks Him.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo are omuya ase onde bwensi omoganyete, ee, nomuya ase oyo okomorigia.
swahili: Bwana ni mwema kwa wale ambao tumaini lao ni kwake, kwa yule ambaye humtafuta;

english: It is good to wait quietly for the salvation of the LORD.
ekegusii: Nigo ere buya ase omonto okoba n’obotoereru na koganya ogotooreka gokorwa ase Omonene.
swahili: ni vyema kungojea kwa utulivu kwa ajili ya wokovu wa Bwana.

english: It is good for a man to bear the yoke while he is still young.
ekegusii: Nigo ere buya ase omonto okobogoria rikorogoto ekero are omoke.
swahili: Ni vyema mtu kuchukua nira bado angali kijana.

english: Let him sit alone in silence, for God has disciplined him.
ekegusii: Tiga aikaranse ao bweka akire‐kiri, ekiagera Omonene nere omotwekire egurube eyio.
swahili: Na akae peke yake awe kimya, kwa maana Bwana ameiweka juu yake.

english: Let him bury his face in the dust— perhaps there is still hope.
ekegusii: Tiga abeete omonwa oye ase riroba akire‐kiri, aande nabo ogosemeria korabeo.
swahili: Na azike uso wake mavumbini bado panawezekana kuwa na matumaini.

english: Indeed, He keeps turning His hand against me all day long.
ekegusii: Ekeene, nigo akona‐koonchora okoboko kwaye igoro yane, ekero ase ekero omobaso boira.
swahili: hakika, amegeuza mkono wake dhidi yangu tena na tena, mchana kutwa.

english: Let him offer his cheek to the one who would strike him; let him be filled with reproach.
ekegusii: Tiga aonchore orosea rwaye gochia ase oyio okomoaka, na oyio aisaneke noborami.
swahili: Na atoe shavu lake kwa yule ampigaye, na ajazwe na aibu.

english: For the Lord will not cast us off forever.
ekegusii: Omonene tagotuguta omonto goika kare na kare.
swahili: Kwa kuwa watu hawakatiliwi mbali na Bwana milele.

english: Even if He causes grief, He will show compassion according to His abundant loving devotion.
ekegusii: Nonya omobekire ase omoichano, namororere amaabera naende, ase engencho y’obwanchani bwaye obonene bwa botambe.
swahili: Ingawa huleta huzuni, ataonyesha huruma, kwa kuwa upendo wake usiokoma ni mkuu.

english: For He does not willingly afflict or grieve the sons of men.
ekegusii: Ere tari gwancha gochanda Mwanyabaanto, gose kobaichania.
swahili: Kwa maana hapendi kuwaletea mateso au huzuni watoto wa wanadamu.

english: To crush underfoot all the prisoners of the land,
ekegusii: Omonto ogotiringera inse abasibwa bonsi bare ase ense,
swahili: Kuwaponda chini ya nyayo wafungwa wote katika nchi,

english: to deny a man justice before the Most High,
ekegusii: gose koonchorana oboronge bw’omonto ase obosio bw’Oyore Igoro Mono,
swahili: Kumnyima mtu haki zake mbele za Aliye Juu Sana,

english: to subvert a man in his lawsuit— of these the Lord does not approve. God’s Justice
ekegusii: gose gokorekania ekiina ki’omonto onde bwensi. Inee! Ayi’Omonene nkoyaanchera are?
swahili: kumnyima mtu haki: Je, Bwana asione mambo kama haya?

english: Who has spoken and it came to pass, unless the Lord has ordained it?
ekegusii: Ning’o okwanete ring’ana, na rirorio rigakoreka, onye Omonene tarichiigete rikorwe?
swahili: Nani awezaye kusema nalo likatendeka kama Bwana hajaamuru?

english: Do not both adversity and good come from the mouth of the Most High?
ekegusii: Inee! Amabe na amaya, tari korwa ase omonwa bw’Oyore Igoro Mono?
swahili: Je, si ni kwenye kinywa cha Aliye Juu Sana ndiko yatokako maafa na mambo mema?

english: Why should any mortal man complain, in view of his sins?
ekegusii: Nase ki rende Mwanyabaanto ore moyo akwemurunganeria? Nase ki akwemurungania ekero akonyora egesusuro ase engencho y’ebibe biaye.
swahili: Mwanadamu yeyote aliye hai aweza kulalamika wakati anapoadhibiwa kwa ajili ya dhambi zake?

english: He has worn away my flesh and skin; He has shattered my bones.
ekegusii: Otigire chinyama chi’omobere one, ne risankwa, bigosareka; obunire amauga aane.
swahili: Amefanya ngozi yangu na nyama yangu kuchakaa na ameivunja mifupa yangu.

english: Let us examine and test our ways, and turn back to the LORD.
ekegusii: Tiga twetuke intwe abanyene na toteeme chinchera chiaito, erio tomoiranere Omonene!
swahili: Tuzichunguze njia zetu na kuzijaribu, na tumrudie Bwana Mungu.

english: Let us lift up our hearts and hands to God in heaven:
ekegusii: Tiga toimokererie chinkoro chiaito igoro, na amaboko aito, gochia ase Nyasae ore igoro, totebe:
swahili: Tuinue mioyo yetu pamoja na mikono yetu kwa Mungu mbinguni, na tuseme:

english: “We have sinned and rebelled; You have not forgiven.”
ekegusii: “Intwe twasaririe asore, twabeire abatari abaigweri, naye togotwabera.
swahili: “Tumetenda dhambi na kuasi nawe hujasamehe.

english: You have covered Yourself in anger and pursued us; You have killed without pity.
ekegusii: “Aye gwetubire endamwamu na gwatochandire, gwaitire, gose tobeti namaabera.
swahili: “Umejifunika mwenyewe kwa hasira na kutufuatilia; umetuchinja bila huruma.

english: You have covered Yourself with a cloud that no prayer can pass through.
ekegusii: Aye omonyene gwetubire riire, ng’a ogosaba gwaito tikogoika ang’e.
swahili: Unajifunika mwenyewe kwa wingu, ili pasiwe na ombi litakaloweza kupenya.

english: You have made us scum and refuse among the nations.
ekegusii: Aye gwatokorire twabeire eubi na abaangire, ase egati y’ebisaku bi’ense.
swahili: Umetufanya takataka na uchafu miongoni mwa mataifa.

english: All our enemies open their mouths against us.
ekegusii: “Ababisa baito bonsi baasamirie emenwa yabo gotosekerera.
swahili: “Adui zetu wote wamefumbua vinywa vyao wazi dhidi yetu.

english: Panic and pitfall have come upon us— devastation and destruction.
ekegusii: Obwoba ne chiirima biatocheire amo nogosaria na ogosirigwa.
swahili: Tumeteseka kwa hofu kuu na shida ya ghafula, uharibifu na maangamizi.”

english: Streams of tears flow from my eyes over the destruction of the daughter of my people.
ekegusii: Amaiso aane nigo agoitera amariga amange buna amaache a rooche, ase engencho y’ogosirigwa kw’omochie bw’abaanto bane.
swahili: Vijito vya machozi vinatiririka kutoka machoni mwangu, kwa sababu watu wangu wameangamizwa.

english: My eyes overflow unceasingly, without relief,
ekegusii: “Amaiso aane abeire agoitera amariga atari gokama, gose korosa,
swahili: Macho yangu yatatiririka machozi bila kukoma, bila kupata nafuu,

english: He has besieged me and surrounded me with bitterness and hardship.
ekegusii: Onsibire ase eburi ime na ong’etananeirie obororo na obokong’u.
swahili: Amenizingira na kunizunguka kwa uchungu na taabu.

english: until the LORD looks down from heaven and sees.
ekegusii: goika ekero Omonene ararigererie korwa igoro na arore ayio onsi.
swahili: hadi Bwana atazame chini kutoka mbinguni na kuona.

english: My eyes bring grief to my soul because of all the daughters of my city.
ekegusii: Amaiso aane agerire nabeire nomoichano ase omoyo one ase engencho y’abaiseke bonsi b’omochie one.
swahili: Lile ninaloliona huniletea huzuni nafsini kwa sababu ya wanawake wote wa mji wangu.

english: Without cause my enemies hunted me like a bird.
ekegusii: “Nigo narenge korigigwa buna enyoni nabwo baarenge ababisa bane engencho ende etaiyo.
swahili: Wale waliokuwa adui zangu bila sababu wameniwinda kama ndege.

english: They dropped me alive into a pit and cast stones upon me.
ekegusii: Bakanduta ase engoro ime inde moyo, na konduta amagena.
swahili: Walijaribu kukomesha maisha yangu ndani ya shimo na kunitupia mawe;

english: The waters flowed over my head, and I thought I was going to die.
ekegusii: Amaache agaichora agaeta ase omotwe one igoro, ngateeba: Omoerio one oikire.
swahili: maji yalifunika juu ya kichwa changu, nami nikafikiri nilikuwa karibu kukatiliwa mbali.

english: I called on Your name, O LORD, out of the depths of the Pit.
ekegusii: “Aye Omonene, nigo narangeretie erieta riao korwa ase engoro entambe,
swahili: Nililiitia jina lako, Ee Bwana, kutoka vina vya shimo.

english: You heard my plea: “Do not ignore my cry for relief.”
ekegusii: na aye okaigwa okorera kwane; toticha amato ao ase ogwechanda kwane ekero nkorera.
swahili: Ulisikia ombi langu: “Usikizibie masikio yako kilio changu nikuombapo msaada.”

english: You drew near when I called on You; You said, “Do not be afraid.”
ekegusii: Aye nigo kwang’igete ang’e ase rituko riria narerete asore, oganteebia: Toondoka!
swahili: Ulikuja karibu nilipokuita, nawe ukasema, “Usiogope.”

english: You defend my cause, O Lord; You redeem my life.
ekegusii: “Aye Omonene, kwarwanereire omoyo one na gwatooririe obogima bwane.
swahili: Ee Bwana, ulichukua shauri langu, ukaukomboa uhai wangu.

english: You have seen, O LORD, the wrong done to me; vindicate my cause!
ekegusii: Kwarorire obobe obo nakoreirwe, onache ekiina kiane ase oboronge.
swahili: Umeona, Ee Bwana, ubaya niliotendewa. Tetea shauri langu!

english: He has made me dwell in darkness like those dead for ages.
ekegusii: Ombekire imenye ase omosunte, buna abanto baria bakwete kare.
swahili: Amenifanya niishi gizani kama wale waliokufa.

english: You have seen all their malice, all their plots against me.
ekegusii: Aye kwarorire buna ababisa bane baganetie korusia egesiomba, na buna bakorire emeroberio emebe ase ’nde.
swahili: Umeona kina cha kisasi chao, mashauri yao yote mabaya dhidi yangu.

english: O LORD, You have heard their insults, all their plots against me—
ekegusii: “Aye Omonene, noigwete okorama kwabo, na emeroberio yabo yonsi igoro yane.
swahili: Ee Bwana, umesikia matukano yao, mashauri yao yote mabaya dhidi yangu:

english: the slander and murmuring of my assailants against me all day long.
ekegusii: Aya abwo bakondwania bagokwana na korengereria, nigo bare mamincha yane omobaso boira.
swahili: kile adui zangu wanachonongʼona na kunungʼunikia dhidi yangu mchana kutwa.

english: When they sit and when they rise, see how they mock me in song.
ekegusii: Rora, ekero abwo baikaransete, na ekero bakoimoka, ninche engeero yabo bagochaaya.
swahili: Watazame! Wakiwa wameketi au wamesimama, wananidhihaki katika nyimbo zao.

english: You will pay them back what they deserve, O LORD, according to the work of their hands.
ekegusii: “Aye Omonene, nobaakane koreng’ana nogokora kw’amaboko abo.
swahili: Uwalipe kile wanachostahili, Ee Bwana, kwa yale ambayo mikono yao imetenda.

english: Put a veil of anguish over their hearts; may Your curse be upon them!
ekegusii: Otube chinkoro chiabo nomosunte; okoragereria kwao kobe igoro yabo.
swahili: Weka pazia juu ya mioyo yao, laana yako na iwe juu yao!

english: You will pursue them in anger and exterminate them from under Your heavens, O LORD.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, babwatie nendamwamu yao, obasirie, basire korwa inse y’erioba!”
swahili: Wafuatilie katika hasira na uwaangamize kutoka chini ya mbingu za Bwana.

english: He has walled me in so I cannot escape; He has weighed me down with chains.
ekegusii: Onsiekeire ase chinsemo chionsi, tinkonyara gosoka; onsibeire ebinyuri ebirito.
swahili: Amenizungushia ukuta ili nisiweze kutoroka, amenifunga kwa minyororo mizito.

english: Even when I cry out and plead for help, He shuts out my prayer.
ekegusii: Nonya nkorera neriogi rinene ng’a nkonywe, ere bwangire koigwa ogosaba kwane.
swahili: Hata ninapoita au kulia ili kuomba msaada, anakataa kupokea maombi yangu.

english: He has barred my ways with cut stones; He has made my paths crooked.
ekegusii: Oribirie chinchera chiane namagena abaachire, oonchoranire oboeto bwane.
swahili: Ameizuia njia yangu kwa mapande ya mawe, amepotosha njia zangu.

english: How the gold has become tarnished, the pure gold has become dull! The gems of the temple lie scattered on every street corner.
ekegusii: Naki etaabu yasiririe obomeka‐meku bwaye! Naki etaabu echenire yaonchokire! Amagena aya Aase Aachenu asiareirwe ase amatabekania e chinchera chionsi.
swahili: Jinsi dhahabu ilivyopoteza mngʼao wake, dhahabu iliyo safi haingʼai! Vito vya thamani vimetawanywa kwenye mwanzo wa kila barabara.

english: The hands of compassionate women have cooked their own children, who became their food in the destruction of the daughter of my people.
ekegusii: Amaboko ’abakuungu abare namayianda aiyekire abana babo abanyene; abwo nigo babete endagera yabo, ekero omochie bw’abaanto bane orenge gosirigwa.
swahili: Kwa mikono yao wenyewe wanawake wenye huruma wanapika watoto wao wenyewe, waliokuwa chakula chao watu wangu walipoangamizwa.

english: The LORD has exhausted His wrath; He has poured out His fierce anger; He has kindled a fire in Zion, and it has consumed her foundations.
ekegusii: Omonene oumoire okogechigwa kwaye, ee, oumoire endamwamu yaye entindi; na ase Sayoni otongirie omorero, osambire amaroso aye.
swahili: Bwana ametoa nafasi kamilifu ya ghadhabu yake; ameimwaga hasira yake kali. Amewasha moto katika Sayuni ambao umeteketeza misingi yake.

english: The kings of the earth did not believe, nor any people of the world, that an enemy or a foe could enter the gates of Jerusalem.
ekegusii: Abarwoti b’ense, na abanto bonsi bamenyeteo, tibegenete ng’a omochandi, gose omobisa onde bwensi, nkonyara arenge gosoa ase ebiita bia Yerusalemu.
swahili: Wafalme wa dunia hawakuamini, wala mtu yeyote wa duniani, kwamba adui na watesi wangeweza kuingia kwenye malango ya Yerusalemu.

english: But this was for the sins of her prophets and the guilt of her priests, who shed the blood of the righteous in her midst.
ekegusii: Ayio nigo akoregete ase engencho y’ebibe bi’ababani baye, na ebi’abakuani baye, abwo baiterete amanyinga ’abanyene oboronge, agwo ase omochie ime.
swahili: Lakini hili lilitokea kwa sababu ya dhambi za manabii wake, na maovu ya makuhani wake, waliomwaga ndani yake damu ya wenye haki.

english: They wandered blind in the streets, defiled by this blood, so that no one dared to touch their garments.
ekegusii: Barabwo bakaba bakoong’anya ase chinchera bare buna emeuko bakaba bakwegindia amanyinga, na onde tarenge gokuna chianga chiabo.
swahili: Sasa wanapapasa papasa barabarani kama watu ambao ni vipofu. Wamenajisiwa kabisa kwa damu, hata hakuna anayethubutu kugusa mavazi yao.

english: “Go away! Unclean!” men shouted at them. “Away, away! Do not touch us!” So they fled and wandered. Among the nations it was said, “They can stay here no longer.”
ekegusii: Abanto bakagobera, bakaboora: “Karue aa! Inwe timochenegeti! Karue aa! Karue aa! Timokuna abanto!” Ase ayio barabwo bagatama na koombogana. Abanto b’ebisaku bakabakwana bakaboora, “Tibakogenderera komenya ase tore.”
swahili: Watu wanawapigia kelele, “Ondokeni! Ninyi ni najisi! Ondokeni! Ondokeni! Msituguse!” Wanapokimbia na kutangatanga huku na huko, watu miongoni mwa mataifa wanasema, “Hawawezi kukaa hapa zaidi.”

english: The presence of the LORD has scattered them; He regards them no more. The priests are shown no honor; the elders find no favor.
ekegusii: Okobea kw’Omonene kwabasiareire, takobechandera naende; abakuani tibasigetwe, na abagaaka tibaroreretwe amaabera.
swahili: Bwana mwenyewe amewatawanya; hawaangalii tena. Makuhani hawaonyeshwi heshima, wazee hawakubaliki.

english: All the while our eyes were failing as we looked in vain for help. We watched from our towers for a nation that could not save us.
ekegusii: Amaiso aito arosire ase okorigereria, na okoganya bosa ng’a natokonywe; korwa ase ebitengero biaito, nigo twaganyete egesaku getanyare gototooria.
swahili: Zaidi ya hayo, macho yetu yalichoka, kwa kutazamia bure msaada; tuliangalia kutoka minara yetu kwa taifa lisiloweza kutuokoa.

english: They stalked our every step, so that we could not walk in our streets. Our end drew near, our time ran out, for our end had come!
ekegusii: Ababisa baito nigo batoboerete, titwarenge konyara gotaara ase chinchera chiaito. Engaki yaito nigo ere ang’e koera; amatuko aito abarirwe; ee, omoerio oito oikire.
swahili: Watu walituvizia katika kila hatua hata hatukuweza kutembea katika barabara zetu. Mwisho wetu ulikuwa karibu, siku zetu zilikuwa zimetimia, kwa maana mwisho wetu ulikuwa umefika.

english: Those who chased us were swifter than the eagles in the sky; they pursued us over the mountains and ambushed us in the wilderness.
ekegusii: Abachandi baito nigo baare abaango kobua ebiongo bikoiruruka, nigo batoseretie gochia ase ebitunwa igoro, bagatoboera ase erooro.
swahili: Waliotufuatia walikuwa wepesi kuliko tai angani; walitusaka juu milimani na kutuvizia jangwani.

english: How the precious sons of Zion, once worth their weight in pure gold, are now esteemed as jars of clay, the work of a potter’s hands!
ekegusii: Abamura ba Sayoni abare nengencho enene, abwo bareng’anirie ne chitaabu chingiya, naki yabeire ng’a bareng’anigwe ne chinyongo chi’amaroba, echire emeremo y’amaboko ’abakori chinyongo?
swahili: Wana wa Sayuni wenye thamani, ambao mwanzo uzito wa thamani yao ulikuwa wa dhahabu, sasa wanaangaliwa kama vyungu vya udongo, kazi ya mikono ya mfinyanzi!

english: The LORD’s anointed, the breath of our life, was captured in their pits. We had said of him, “Under his shadow we will live among the nations.”
ekegusii: Omoakwa amaguta Omonene, oyio orenge omoika bw’obogima bwaito, akabwatwa ne chiirima chiabo, oyio nere twateebete ng’a ase ekiriri kiaye nao toramenye ase egati y’ebisaku.
swahili: Mpakwa mafuta wa Bwana, pumzi ya uhai wetu hasa, alinaswa katika mitego yao. Tulifikiri kwamba chini ya kivuli chake tungeliweza kuishi miongoni mwa mataifa.

english: So rejoice and be glad, O Daughter of Edom, you who dwell in the land of Uz. Yet the cup will pass to you as well; you will get drunk and expose yourself.
ekegusii: Inwe abanto ba Edomu, inwe abamomenyete ase ense ya Usi, goka na gochenga! Nonya nasemore egekombe nkebaikere, monywe motinde goika motigare getirianda.
swahili: Shangilia na ufurahi, ee Binti Edomu, wewe unayeishi nchi ya Usi. Lakini kwako pia kikombe kitapitishwa, Utalewa na kuvuliwa nguo ubaki uchi.

english: O Daughter of Zion, your punishment is complete; He will not prolong your exile. But He will punish your iniquity, O Daughter of Edom; He will expose your sins.
ekegusii: Inwe abanto ba Sayoni, egesusuro ki’ebibe biaino giaikeranigwe. Omonene takogenderera gokoira ase obosomba; korende inwe abanto ba Edomu, Omonene nabae egesusuro ase engencho y’ebibe biaino, ee, naorokie ebibe biaino maiso marore.
swahili: Ee Binti Sayuni, adhabu yako itaisha, hatarefusha muda wako wa kukaa uhamishoni. Lakini, ee Binti Edomu, ataadhibu dhambi yako, na atafunua uovu wako.

english: Even jackals offer their breasts to nurse their young, but the daughter of my people has become cruel, like an ostrich in the wilderness.
ekegusii: Nonya ne chisese chi’orosana nkogonkia chire chimanwa chiabo, korende abakungu b’omochie bw’abaanto bane babeire abatindi, buna chisagero chire ase erooro.
swahili: Hata mbweha hutoa matiti yao kunyonyesha watoto wao, lakini watu wangu wamekuwa wasio na huruma kama mbuni jangwani.

english: The nursing infant’s tongue clings in thirst to the roof of his mouth. Little children beg for bread, but no one gives them any.
ekegusii: Chimeme chi’abana bakogonka chiabwatanire namang’ang’ura ase engencho y’erang’o; abana abake nigo bagosaba endagera, korende monto onde tari okobaa.
swahili: Kwa sababu ya kiu ulimi wa mtoto mchanga umegandamana na kaakaa la kinywa chake, watoto huomba mkate, lakini hakuna yeyote awapaye.

english: Those who once ate delicacies are destitute in the streets; those brought up in crimson huddle in ash heaps.
ekegusii: Abanto abwo baarenge koria endagera engiya mono bakwereire ase chinchera; na abwo barenge kweboyia chianga chimonyinga, nigo baraire ase ebinge bi’eribu.
swahili: Wale waliokula vyakula vya kifahari ni maskini barabarani. Wale waliokuzwa wakivaa nguo za zambarau sasa wanalalia majivu.

english: The punishment of the daughter of my people is greater than that of Sodom, which was overthrown in an instant without a hand turned to help her.
ekegusii: Aya nigo abanyorete, ekiagera ebibe biakorire ase omochie bw’abaanto bane nigo biarenge ebinene kobua ebi’abaanto ba Sodomu, omochie oyio nigo oonchoranetwe ase etagika eyemo, na okoboko kw’onde tikwayokunete.
swahili: Adhabu ya watu wangu ni kubwa kuliko ile ya Sodoma, ambayo ilipinduliwa ghafula bila kuwepo mkono wa msaada.

english: Her dignitaries were brighter than snow, whiter than milk; their bodies were more ruddy than rubies, their appearance like sapphires.
ekegusii: Abagaambi baye nigo baarenge komeka-meka kobua amagena ’embura, nigo baarenge abarabu se kobua amabeere, emebere yabo nigo yarenge emebariri kobua amagena amabariri, na okororekana kwabo nigo kwarenge buna safiro, rigena rie rigori rinene.
swahili: Wakuu wao walikuwa wamengʼaa kuliko theluji na weupe kuliko maziwa, miili yao ilikuwa myekundu kuliko marijani, kuonekana kwao kama yakuti samawi.

english: But now their appearance is blacker than soot; they are not recognized in the streets. Their skin has shriveled on their bones; it has become as dry as a stick.
ekegusii: Bono amaiso abo abeire amamwamuti kobua embiro, tibari komanywa agwo ase chinchera; amasankwa ’emebere yabo abwatanire namauga abo, omire pa buna amasabo amomo.
swahili: Lakini sasa ni weusi kuliko masizi; hawatambulikani barabarani. Ngozi yao imeshikamana juu ya mifupa yao, imekuwa mikavu kama fimbo.

english: Those slain by the sword are better off than those who die of hunger, who waste away, pierced with pain because the fields lack produce.
ekegusii: Mbare negesio abwo bagokwa ase ogoitwa nemioro kobua abwo enchara egoita, ekiagera barabwo nigo bakogenderera korea na korea, ase okoborwa gw’okwama kw’emegondo.
swahili: Wale waliouawa kwa upanga ni bora kuliko wale wanaokufa njaa; wanateseka kwa njaa, wanatokomea kwa kukosa chakula kutoka shambani.

english: Remember, O LORD, what has happened to us. Look and see our disgrace!
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, inyora aya atonyorire, origererie orore ogochaywa gwaito.
swahili: Kumbuka, Ee Bwana, yaliyotupata, tazama, nawe uione aibu yetu.

english: Our skin is as hot as an oven with fever from our hunger.
ekegusii: Amasankwa ’emebere yaito nigo are ne riberera buna erie riko, ekiagera enchara nigo egotosamba buna omorero.
swahili: Ngozi yetu ina joto kama tanuru, kwa sababu ya fadhaa itokanayo na njaa.

english: Women have been ravished in Zion, virgins in the cities of Judah.
ekegusii: Abakungu baito bare Sayoni bakoreirwe amabe, boigo nabaiseke abekungi abare ase emechi y’Abayuda.
swahili: Wanawake wametendwa jeuri katika Sayuni, na mabikira katika miji ya Yuda.

english: Princes have been hung up by their hands; elders receive no respect.
ekegusii: Abagaambi baito babwatirwe na gosungwa, na abagaaka baito tibasikiri.
swahili: Wakuu wametungikwa juu kwa mikono yao, wazee hawapewi heshima.

english: Young men toil at millstones; boys stagger under loads of wood.
ekegusii: Abamura baito nabwo bakobogoria chingena chigoserwa, na abana abake nigo bakoritoerwa ase okobogoria chinko, bagwa.
swahili: Vijana wanataabika kwenye mawe ya kusagia, wavulana wanayumbayumba chini ya mizigo ya kuni.

english: The elders have left the city gate; the young men have stopped their music.
ekegusii: Abagaaka tibari goikaransa geita ki’omochie, na abamura batigire kobugia amakano abo.
swahili: Wazee wameondoka langoni la mji, vijana wameacha kuimba nyimbo zao.

english: Joy has left our hearts; our dancing has turned to mourning.
ekegusii: Omogoko bwe chinkoro chiaito osirire; ogotenga gwaito kwaonchokire kwabeire ebirero.
swahili: Furaha imeondoka mioyoni mwetu, kucheza kwetu kumegeuka maombolezo.

english: The crown has fallen from our head. Woe to us, for we have sinned!
ekegusii: Chigutwa chiarenge ase emetwe yaito chiagure inse. Obobe nobwaito, ekiagera twakorire ebibe!
swahili: Taji imeanguka kutoka kichwani petu. Ole wetu, kwa maana tumetenda dhambi!

english: Because of this, our hearts are faint; because of these, our eyes grow dim—
ekegusii: Ase engencho y’ayio chinkoro chiaito chiarwarire, na ase engencho y’ayio amaiso aito abeire orotutu.
swahili: Kwa sababu hiyo, mioyo yetu inazimia, kwa sababu ya hayo, macho yetu yamefifia,

english: because of Mount Zion, which lies desolate, patrolled by foxes.
ekegusii: Ekiagera egetunwa gia Sayoni giatigaire kere bosa, chisese chi’orosana nao chigotaara.
swahili: kwa ajili ya Mlima Sayuni, ambao unakaa ukiwa, nao mbweha wanatembea juu yake.

english: You, O LORD, reign forever; Your throne endures from generation to generation.
ekegusii: Korende aye Omonene nigo oragaambe kare na kare, ekerogo kiao ki’obogaambi nigo kerabeo ebiaare ase ebiaare.
swahili: Wewe, Ee Bwana unatawala milele, kiti chako cha enzi chadumu kizazi hadi kizazi.

english: Our inheritance has been turned over to strangers, our houses to foreigners.
ekegusii: Omwando oito oeirwe abanto abaao, chinyomba chiaito chiaeirwe abamenyi.
swahili: Urithi wetu umegeuziwa kwa wageni, na nyumba zetu kwa wageni.

english: Why have You forgotten us forever? Why have You forsaken us for so long?
ekegusii: Naki gwatwebire kogenderera botambe? Naki gwatotigire ase engaki entambe iga?
swahili: Kwa nini watusahau siku zote? Kwa nini umetuacha kwa muda mrefu?

english: Restore us to Yourself, O LORD, so we may return; renew our days as of old,
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, toiranie gocha asore, erinde toiranigwe, onchora amatuko aito oyakore abe amayia, abe buna aria a kare!
swahili: Turudishe kwako mwenyewe, Ee Bwana, ili tupate kurudi. Zifanye mpya siku zetu kama siku za kale,

english: unless You have utterly rejected us and remain angry with us beyond measure.
ekegusii: Gose ngwatotangire kegima? Nigo ogendererete kogechigwa mono naintwe?
swahili: isipokuwa uwe umetukataa kabisa na umetukasirikia pasipo kipimo.

english: We have become fatherless orphans; our mothers are widows.
ekegusii: Twabeire buna chintakana, chitari nabaise, abaababa nigo banga buna ababoraka.
swahili: Tumekuwa yatima wasio na baba, mama zetu wamekuwa kama wajane.

english: We must buy the water we drink; our wood comes at a price.
ekegusii: Amaache tokonywa goika toakane chitaabu, ne chinko togwota nigo tokogora.
swahili: Ni lazima tununue maji tunayokunywa, kuni zetu zapatikana tu kwa kununua.

english: We are closely pursued; we are weary and find no rest.
ekegusii: Abachandi baito nigo batobwatete amogoti, nigo tokorosa mono, titori konyora ogotimoka.
swahili: Wanaotufuatilia wapo kwenye visigino vyetu, tumechoka na hakuna pumziko.

english: We submitted to Egypt and Assyria to get enough bread.
ekegusii: Twaramboreire Abamisiri na Abaasuri amaboko batoe endagera egotoisana.
swahili: Tumejitolea kwa Misri na Ashuru tupate chakula cha kutosha.

english: Our fathers sinned and are no more, but we bear their punishment.
ekegusii: Chisokoro chiaito nigo chiakorete ebibe, bono tichiyo; goika tobogorie egesusuro ki’ebibe biabo.
swahili: Baba zetu walitenda dhambi na hawapo tena, na sisi tunachukua adhabu yao.

english: Slaves rule over us; there is no one to deliver us from their hands.
ekegusii: Abasomba nabwo bagotogaambera, na onde tari ogototooria korwa ase amaboko abo.
swahili: Watumwa wanatutawala na hakuna wa kutuokoa mikononi yao.

english: We get our bread at the risk of our lives because of the sword in the wilderness.
ekegusii: Nigo tokonyora endagera yaito ase okobeeka obogima bwaito ase emechando, ekiagera emioro nere ase erooro.
swahili: Tunapata chakula chetu kwa kuhatarisha maisha yetu kwa sababu ya upanga jangwani.

english: Now Aaron’s sons Nadab and Abihu took their censers, put fire in them and added incense, and offered unauthorized fire before the LORD, contrary to His command.
ekegusii: Nadabu na Abihu, abamura ba Aroni, kera oyomo akaimokia orogio rwaye, akabeeka omorero ase orogio orwo, na akabeeka ekoroso igoro ase omorero oyio, bakarentera Omonene omorero orenge bw’engencho eng’ao, oyi’Omonene atabachiigete.
swahili: Nadabu na Abihu, wana wa Aroni, wakachukua vyetezo vyao, wakaweka moto ndani yake na kuongeza uvumba; kisha wakamtolea Bwana moto usio halali, kinyume na agizo la Mungu.

english: You must distinguish between the holy and the common, between the clean and the unclean,
ekegusii: Inwe goika momanye gwaatanana egento egechenu kere ekia Omonene korwa ase ekio getaatananiri koba egechenu, na egento gechenegete korwa ase egetachenegeti.
swahili: Ni lazima mtenganishe kilicho kitakatifu na kile kilicho cha kawaida, kati ya yaliyo najisi na yaliyo safi,

english: so that you may teach the Israelites all the statutes that the LORD has given them through Moses.”
ekegusii: Mworokererie Abaisraeli amachiiko onsi aya inche Omonene nabachiikire goetera ase Musa.”
swahili: na lazima mwafundishe Waisraeli amri zote ambazo Bwana aliwapa kupitia Mose.”

english: And Moses said to Aaron and his remaining sons, Eleazar and Ithamar, “Take the grain offering that remains from the offerings made by fire to the LORD and eat it without leaven beside the altar, because it is most holy.
ekegusii: Musa agateebia Aroni na abamura baye abatigarete, Eleazari na Itamari, “Imokia okoruegwa kw’endagera, okwo gotigarete korwa ase okwo gwasambirwe n’omorero ase Omonene, mokorie gotabeekiri memera, agwo ase egesasiimero ensemo, ekiagera okoruegwa okwo nogochenu mono.
swahili: Mose akamwambia Aroni pamoja na wanawe waliosalia, Eleazari na Ithamari, “Chukueni sadaka ya nafaka iliyobaki kutoka sadaka zilizotolewa kwa Bwana kwa moto, muile hapo kando ya madhabahu ikiwa imeandaliwa bila chachu, kwa sababu ni takatifu sana.

english: You shall eat it in a holy place, because it is your share and your sons’ share of the offerings made by fire to the LORD; for this is what I have been commanded.
ekegusii: Mokoriere agwo Aase gete are aachenu. Ekio negetari kiao, na eki’abamura bao, gekorusigwa korwa ase okoruegwa kw’endagera kogosaambwa n’omorero ase Omonene. Ayio nar’Omonene anchiigete.
swahili: Mtaila katika mahali patakatifu kwa sababu ni fungu lenu na fungu la wana wenu la sadaka zilizotolewa kwa Bwana kwa moto, kwa maana hivyo ndivyo nilivyoamriwa.

english: And you and your sons and daughters may eat the breast of the wave offering and the thigh of the contribution in a ceremonially clean place, because these portions have been assigned to you and your children from the peace offerings of the sons of Israel.
ekegusii: Korende ritaana rigosungusigwa, na ekenama gekoruegwa, aye amo nabana bao, abamura na abaiseke, mwaeirwe ribaga kobiriera agwo aase achenire. Ebinto ebio aye na abana bao mwabieirwe korwa ase ebing’wanso bi’omorembe bikoruegwa n’Abaisraeli.
swahili: Lakini wewe na wanao na binti zako mwaweza kula kidari kile kilichoinuliwa na paja lile lililotolewa. Mtavila mahali safi pa kawaida ya ibada; mmepewa wewe na watoto wako kuwa fungu lenu la sadaka za amani za Waisraeli.

english: They are to bring the thigh of the contribution and the breast of the wave offering, together with the fat portions of the offerings made by fire, to wave as a wave offering before the LORD. It will belong permanently to you and your children, as the LORD has commanded.”
ekegusii: Ekenama gekoruegwa, ne ritaana riria rigosungusigwa, birentwe amo nebitinya bikoruegwa ebing’wanso bigosaambwa n’omorero, bisungusigwe bibe ebing’wanso bi’ogosungusigwa ase obosio bw’Omonene. Ebio nabibe egetari kiao amo neki’abamura bao kogenderera botaambe, buna Omonene achiigete.”
swahili: Paja lile lililotolewa na kidari kile kilichoinuliwa lazima viletwe pamoja na sehemu za mafuta ya sadaka za kuteketezwa kwa moto, ili kuinuliwa mbele za Bwana kama sadaka ya kuinuliwa. Hili litakuwa fungu lako la kawaida na wanao, kama Bwana alivyoagiza.”

english: Later, Moses searched carefully for the goat of the sin offering, and behold, it had been burned up. He was angry with Eleazar and Ithamar, Aaron’s remaining sons, and asked,
ekegusii: Musa agatuka mono komanya inaki embori y’ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe yabeete, akamanya ng’a embori eria nigo yasaambetwe. Ase ayio akaba nendamwamu enene ase Eliezeri na Itamari, abamura ba Aroni, baria batigarete, akabateebia.
swahili: Mose alipouliza kuhusu mbuzi atolewaye kwa ajili ya sadaka ya dhambi, na kukuta kwamba ameteketezwa, aliwakasirikia Eleazari na Ithamari, wana wa Aroni waliobaki, akawauliza,

english: “Why didn’t you eat the sin offering in the holy place? For it is most holy; it was given to you to take away the guilt of the congregation by making atonement for them before the LORD.
ekegusii: “Nase ki motarierete ekeng’wanso keria ki’ebibe agwo aase are aachenu? Ekio negento egechenu mono mwaeirwe, erinde moruserie omoganda ebibe biabo, na gokora okobwatanigwa ase bare ase obosio bw’Omonene.
swahili: “Kwa nini hamkula sadaka ya dhambi katika eneo la mahali patakatifu? Ni takatifu sana. Mlipewa ninyi ili kuondoa hatia ya jumuiya kwa ajili ya kuwafanyia upatanisho mbele za Bwana.

english: Since its blood was not brought inside the holy place, you should have eaten it in the sanctuary area, as I commanded.”
ekegusii: Rora, amanyinga aye tairetwe agwo Aase Aachenu; nigo yabagwenerete mokeriere agwo aase achenire.”
swahili: Kwa kuwa damu yake haikuletwa ndani ya Mahali Patakatifu, mngemla mbuzi huyo katika sehemu ya mahali patakatifu kama nilivyoagiza.”

english: But Aaron replied to Moses, “Behold, this very day they presented their sin offering and their burnt offering before the LORD. Since these things have happened to me, if I had eaten the sin offering today, would it have been acceptable in the sight of the LORD?”
ekegusii: Aroni akairaneria Musa, “Rora, rituko ria reero abanto barure ekeng’wanso kiabo ki’ebibe, na eki’ogosaambwa, ase obosio bw’Omonene, korende nonya naboigo nomanyete emechando eye nanyorire. Onye inaria ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe rituko ria reero, Inee, nanga nancherwa ase obosio bw’Omonene?”
swahili: Aroni akamjibu Mose, “Leo wanangu wametoa sadaka zao za dhambi na sadaka zao za kuteketezwa mbele za Bwana, lakini mambo kama haya yamenitokea mimi. Je, Bwana angependezwa kama ningekuwa nimekula sadaka ya dhambi leo?”

english: So fire came out from the presence of the LORD and consumed them, and they died in the presence of the LORD.
ekegusii: Na omorero ogaika korwa ase Omonene, okabasamba, barabwo bakayia, bagakwera agwo ase obosio bw’Omonene.
swahili: Hivyo moto ukaja kutoka kwa uwepo wa Bwana na kuwaramba, nao wakafa mbele za Bwana.

english: And when Moses heard this explanation, he was satisfied.
ekegusii: Ekero Musa aigwete amang’ana ayio agaisaneka.
swahili: Mose aliposikia haya, akaridhika.

english: Then Moses said to Aaron, “This is what the LORD meant when He said: ‘To those who come near Me I will show My holiness, and in the sight of all the people I will reveal My glory.’” But Aaron remained silent.
ekegusii: Erio Musa agateebia Aroni, “Aya nar’Omonene atebiire, ng’a ere neorokie koba omochenu ase abanto abwo bakomoika ang’e, na ase amaiso b’abaanto bonsi naorokie obonene bwaye.” Aroni agakira‐kiri.
swahili: Kisha Mose akamwambia Aroni, “Hili ndilo alilonena Bwana wakati aliposema: “ ‘Miongoni mwa wale watakaonikaribia nitajionyesha kuwa mtakatifu; machoni pa watu wote nitaheshimiwa.’ ” Aroni akanyamaza.

english: Moses summoned Mishael and Elzaphan, sons of Aaron’s uncle Uzziel, and said to them, “Come here; carry the bodies of your cousins outside the camp, away from the front of the sanctuary.”
ekegusii: Erio Musa akarangeria Mishaeli na Elisafani, basinto ba Usieli, ise moke Aroni, akabateebia, “Inchuo mobogorie emebere y’abamino, abana ba iso moke, moyerusie korwa ase Obomenyo Obochenu, moyeire isiko y’egetwori.”
swahili: Mose akawaita Mishaeli na Elisafani, wana wa Uzieli mjomba wake Aroni, akawaambia, “Njooni hapa. Ondoeni miili ya binamu zenu mbele ya mahali patakatifu, mkaipeleke nje ya kambi.”

english: So they came forward and carried them, still in their tunics, outside the camp, as Moses had directed.
ekegusii: Barabwo bagaacha, bakabogoria emebere eria eboyirie chiganchwa chiabo, bakayeira isiko y’egetwori, buna Musa abateebeetie.
swahili: Hivyo wakaja na kuwaondoa, wakiwa bado wamevalia makoti yao ya ibada, wakawapeleka nje ya kambi, kama Mose alivyoamuru.

english: Then Moses said to Aaron and his sons Eleazar and Ithamar, “Do not let your hair become disheveled and do not tear your garments, or else you will die, and the LORD will be angry with the whole congregation. But your brothers, the whole house of Israel, may mourn on account of the fire that the LORD has ignited.
ekegusii: Musa agateebia Aroni amo n’Eleazari na Itamari, abamura ba Aroni, “Timobaisa gotiga chitukia chiaino chitachanuiri, gose timobaisa gotandora chianga chiaino ase okobaichanera. Moise gokora igo, goika mokwe, na endamwamu entindi y’Omonene echiche igoro y’omoganda bwonsi. Korende Abaisraeli bamino bonsi barabwo mbabe bakorera ase engencho y’ogosamba ogotindi Omonene arentire.
swahili: Ndipo Mose akamwambia Aroni pamoja na wanawe, Eleazari na Ithamari, “Msifunue vichwa vyenu wala msirarue mavazi yenu, la sivyo mtakufa na Bwana ataikasirikia jumuiya nzima. Lakini ndugu zenu, nyumba yote ya Israeli, wanaweza kuwaombolezea wale ambao Bwana amewaangamiza kwa moto.

english: You shall not go outside the entrance to the Tent of Meeting, or you will die, for the LORD’s anointing oil is on you.” So they did as Moses instructed. Restrictions for Priests
ekegusii: Timobaisa gosoka isiko goetania egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano. Moise gokora igo, goika mokwe, ekiagera mwatananirwe ase ogoakwa amaguta ’Omonene.” Barabwo bagakora buna Musa abateebetie. Amachiiko ase abakuani
swahili: Msitoke nje ya ingilio la Hema la Kukutania, la sivyo mtakufa, kwa sababu mafuta ya Bwana ya upako yako juu yenu.” Hivyo wakafanya kama vile Mose alivyosema.

english: Then the LORD said to Aaron,
ekegusii: Omonene agakwana na Aroni, akamoteebia,
swahili: Kisha Bwana akamwambia Aroni,

english: “You and your sons are not to drink wine or strong drink when you enter the Tent of Meeting, or else you will die; this is a permanent statute for the generations to come.
ekegusii: “Aye amo nabamura bao timobaisa konywa edivai, gose ekenyugwa kegotindia, ekero mogosoa ase Eema y’Omosangererekano. Moise gokora igo, goika mokwe. Okwo nogochika koragenderere ase more ebiaare ase ebiaare.
swahili: “Wewe na wanao msinywe mvinyo wala kinywaji kingine kilichochachuka wakati mwingiapo katika Hema la Kukutania, la sivyo mtakufa. Hili litakuwa Agizo la kudumu kwa vizazi vijavyo.

english: The LORD spoke again to Moses and Aaron, telling them,
ekegusii: Omonene agakwana na Musa na Aroni, akabateebia,
swahili: Bwana akawaambia Mose na Aroni,

english: But the following among all the teeming life and creatures in the water are detestable to you: everything in the seas or streams that does not have fins and scales.
ekegusii: Korende ebitongwa binde bionsi bire moyo ime ase chinyancha, gose ase chindooche, bigotaara bire amaicho bitabwati chingondo chinga buna chimbaaba, na amagoocho, timobiria; ebio nokogechia ase more.
swahili: Lakini viumbe wote ndani ya bahari au vijito wasio na mapezi na magamba, wakiwa miongoni mwa makundi au viumbe wote ndani ya maji, hao ni machukizo kwenu.

english: They shall be an abomination to you; you must not eat their meat, and you must detest their carcasses.
ekegusii: Ebio nabigenderere koba okogechia ase more, chinyama chiabo timochiria, na echikwete ase echio timochiria, ekiagera echio nokogechia ase more.
swahili: Nao watakuwa machukizo kwenu. Msile nyama yao, nayo mizoga yao itakuwa machukizo.

english: Everything in the water that does not have fins and scales shall be detestable to you.
ekegusii: Kera egento kere ime ase chinyancha ne chindooche getabwati chingondo chinga buna chimbaaba, na amagoocho, ekio nokogechia ase more.
swahili: Chochote kinachoishi ndani ya maji ambacho hakina mapezi na magamba kitakuwa chukizo kwenu.

english: Additionally, you are to detest the following birds, and they must not be eaten because they are detestable: the eagle, the bearded vulture, the black vulture,
ekegusii: Nase chinyoni chiraabe okogechia ase more motarie nachio echi: Ekeongo, na ensoti, na obotere;
swahili: “ ‘Wafuatao ndio ndege watakaokuwa machukizo kwenu, hivyo msiwale kwa sababu ni chukizo: tai, furukombe, kipungu,

english: the kite, any kind of falcon,
ekegusii: amakoru na ebisaku biamwabo;
swahili: mwewe mwekundu, aina zote za mwewe mweusi,

english: any kind of raven,
ekegusii: ebigonkoru na ebisaku biamwabo bionsi;
swahili: aina zote za kunguru,

english: the ostrich, the screech owl, the gull, any kind of hawk,
ekegusii: esagero, na omoyaaye, na enyakoboke, na ebisaku biamwabo;
swahili: mbuni, kiruka-njia, dudumizi, kipanga, shakwe, aina zote za kipanga,

english: the little owl, the cormorant, the great owl,
ekegusii: enyakweumia, na endubi, na ebaraara;
swahili: bundi, mnandi, bundi mkubwa,

english: the white owl, the desert owl, the osprey,
ekegusii: etibibi, na egetekere, na ensoti;
swahili: mumbi, mwari, nderi,

english: the stork, any kind of heron, the hoopoe, and the bat.
ekegusii: riagonga, na omoneke, na ebisaku biamwabo; enteema bobe na egetabora mato.
swahili: korongo, koikoi wa aina yoyote, hudihudi na popo.

english: “Say to the Israelites, ‘Of all the beasts of the earth, these ones you may eat:
ekegusii: Kwana n’Abaisraeli, mobateebie: Ase ching’iti chire ase ense, echi nachio moraarie chinyama chiabo:
swahili: “Waambieni Waisraeli: ‘Kati ya wanyama wote waishio juu ya nchi, hawa ndio mtakaowala:

english: All flying insects that walk on all fours are detestable to you.
ekegusii: Ebitongwa ebisinini bionsi bire moyo bire ne chimbaaba na amagoro ane, ebio mbibe okogechia ase more.
swahili: “ ‘Wadudu wote warukao ambao hutembea kwa miguu minne watakuwa chukizo kwenu.

english: However, you may eat the following kinds of flying insects that walk on all fours: those having jointed legs above their feet for hopping on the ground.
ekegusii: Korende ebitongwa ebio ebisinini bibwate chimbaaba na amagoro ane inamorie ebio bigotaroka nebirenge.
swahili: Lakini wako viumbe wenye mabawa ambao hutembea kwa miguu minne mtakaowala: wale wenye vifundo katika miguu yao ya kurukaruka juu ya ardhi.

english: Of these you may eat any kind of locust, katydid, cricket, or grasshopper.
ekegusii: Ebisaku bionsi bie chingige, na ebi’amabururu, na ebisase, ebio nabio moraarie.
swahili: Miongoni mwa hawa, mtakula nzige wa aina zote, senene, parare au panzi.

english: All other flying insects that have four legs are detestable to you.
ekegusii: Korende ebinde bionsi ase ebitongwa ebio ebisinini bibwate chimbaaba na amagoro ane, ebio mbibe okogechia ase more.
swahili: Lakini viumbe wengine wote wenye mabawa na wenye miguu minne ni machukizo kwenu. Wanyama Ambao Ni Najisi

english: These creatures will make you unclean. Whoever touches their carcasses will be unclean until evening,
ekegusii: Ase ebitongwa ebio nigo moresoyie ase ogotacheneka. Monto onde bwensi orakune ebikwete ase ebio nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio,
swahili: “ ‘Mtajinajisi kwa wanyama hawa. Yeyote agusaye mizoga yao atakuwa najisi mpaka jioni.

english: and whoever picks up one of their carcasses must wash his clothes, and he will be unclean until evening.
ekegusii: na onde bwensi oraimokie egekwete korwa ase ebio nigo arasibie chianga chiaye, ere nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio.
swahili: Yeyote atakayebeba mizoga ya viumbe hawa ni lazima afue nguo zake, naye atakuwa najisi mpaka jioni.

english: Every animal with hooves not completely divided or that does not chew the cud is unclean for you. Whoever touches any of them will be unclean.
ekegusii: Kera eng’iti ebwate ebitaago, korende tibiatananegeti kegima, naende teri koria eng’ang’ura, eyio nebe eyetachenegeti ase more. Moonto onde bwensi orakune ching’iti echio nabe oyotachenegeti.
swahili: “ ‘Kila mnyama mwenye ukwato ulioachana lakini haukugawanyika kabisa, au yule asiyecheua, huyo ni najisi kwenu; yeyote agusaye mzoga wowote wa hao atakuwa najisi.

english: All the four-footed animals that walk on their paws are unclean for you; whoever touches their carcasses will be unclean until evening,
ekegusii: Ching’iti chiria chikogendera ebisonsogoro ase echio chibwate amagoro ane tichichenegeti ase more. Monto onde bwensi orakune echikwete ase echio nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio.
swahili: Miongoni mwa wanyama wote watembeao kwa miguu minne, wale watembeao kwa vitanga vyao ni najisi kwenu; yeyote agusaye mizoga yao atakuwa najisi mpaka jioni.

english: and anyone who picks up a carcass must wash his clothes, and he will be unclean until evening. They are unclean for you.
ekegusii: Na monto onde bwensi oraimokie eyekwete ase echio nasibie chianga chiaye, nere nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio. Ching’iti echio nachibe chitachenegeti ase more.
swahili: Yeyote atakayebeba mizoga yao ni lazima afue nguo zake, naye atakuwa najisi mpaka jioni. Wanyama hawa ni najisi kwenu.

english: The following creatures that move along the ground are unclean for you: the mole, the mouse, any kind of great lizard,
ekegusii: Ase ching’iti chinke chigoetanana ase ense, echio nchibe chitachenegeti ase more; Ekenyamunyonge, na embeba, na ekiigo ekenene, amo nebisaku biamwabo;
swahili: “ ‘Kuhusu wanyama watambaao juu ya ardhi, hawa ni najisi kwenu: kicheche, panya, aina yoyote ya mijusi mikubwa,

english: You may eat any animal that has a split hoof completely divided and that chews the cud.
ekegusii: Eng’iti ende yonsi ebwate ebitaago biatananegete kegima, naende ekoria eng’ang’ura, nero moraarie.
swahili: Mwaweza kula mnyama yeyote mwenye kwato zilizogawanyika sehemu mbili na ambaye hucheua.

english: the gecko, the monitor lizard, the common lizard, the skink, and the chameleon.
ekegusii: ekiigo egeke, na eng’oina, na ensagara, enke na enene, amo n’enyambu.
swahili: guruguru, kenge, mijusi ya ukutani, goromoe na kinyonga.

english: These animals are unclean for you among all the crawling creatures. Whoever touches them when they are dead shall be unclean until evening.
ekegusii: Ase ching’iti echio chinke echio nchibe chitachenegeti ase more. Monto onde bwensi orachikune ekero chi akuure nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio.
swahili: Hao wote watambaao juu ya ardhi ni najisi kwenu. Yeyote agusaye mizoga yao atakuwa najisi mpaka jioni.

english: When one of them dies and falls on something, that article becomes unclean; any article of wood, clothing, leather, sackcloth, or any implement used for work must be rinsed with water and will remain unclean until evening; then it will be clean.
ekegusii: Ching’iti echio chiise kogwera egento kende gionsi ekero chi akuure, egento ekio nakebe egetachenegeti, onye negento keroisirie korwa ase emete, gose gokeraabe eanga, gose risankwa, gose esaro, gose egento kende gionsi kegokorerwa emeremo. Egento ekio kebekwe ime ase amaache, naende kebe getachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio; erio nakebe giachenekire.
swahili: Ikiwa mmoja wao atakufa na kuangukia juu ya kitu fulani, chombo hicho, hata kikiwa cha matumizi gani, kitakuwa najisi, kiwe kimetengenezwa kwa mti, nguo, ngozi au gunia. Kiweke ndani ya maji; kitakuwa najisi mpaka jioni, kisha kitakuwa safi tena.

english: If any of them falls into a clay pot, everything in it will be unclean; you must break the pot.
ekegusii: Onye eyemo ye ching’iti echio ekogwera enyongo, gose gento kende keroisirie korwa ase amaroba, ekere ime yaye nakebe egetachenegeti, na egento ekio goika giatwe.
swahili: Ikiwa mmoja wa wanyama aliyekufa ataangukia ndani ya chungu, kila kilichomo katika chungu hicho kitakuwa najisi, nawe ni lazima uvunje chungu hicho.

english: Any food coming into contact with water from that pot will be unclean, and any drink in such a container will be unclean.
ekegusii: Endagera ende yonsi ekoriegwa nebe eyetachenegeti onye amaache akoumorwa korwa ase enyongo buna eyio akoyekuna, na ekenyugwa kende gionsi kere ime y’enyongo buna eyio nkebe getachenegeti.
swahili: Chakula chochote ambacho chaweza kuliwa lakini kikawa kimeingia maji kutoka kwenye chungu hicho ni najisi, na kitu chochote cha majimaji ambacho chaweza kunyweka kutoka kwenye chungu hicho ni najisi.

english: Anything upon which one of their carcasses falls will be unclean. If it is an oven or cooking pot, it must be smashed; it is unclean and will remain unclean for you.
ekegusii: Gento kende gionsi keragwerwe neyemo ye ching’iti echio ekwete inakebe getachenegeti; onye ne riko rikoroisia emegati, gose neri’ endagera, erio riatwe, riabeire eritachenegeti ase more.
swahili: Chochote ambacho mzoga wa mmojawapo utaangukia kitakuwa najisi. Jiko au chungu cha kupikia ni lazima kivunjwe. Ni najisi, nawe ni lazima uvihesabu kuwa najisi.

english: Nevertheless, a spring or cistern containing water will remain clean, but one who touches a carcass in it will be unclean.
ekegusii: Ensoko gose aase amaache akogachwa nabigenderere koba ebichenegete, korende ebinto binde bionsi ebiaao biise gokuna ching’iti echio chikwete mbibe ebitachenegeti.
swahili: Lakini chemchemi au kisima, mahali pa kuchota maji, patakuwa safi, lakini yeyote atakayegusa moja ya mizoga hii ni najisi.

english: If a carcass falls on any seed for sowing, the seed is clean;
ekegusii: Onye eng’iti eyemo y’echio ekwete keragwere embusuro egosimekwa, embusuro eyio negenderere koba echenegete.
swahili: Kama mzoga ukianguka juu ya mbegu zozote ambazo ni za kupanda, zinabaki safi.

english: but if water has been put on the seed and a carcass falls on it, it is unclean for you.
ekegusii: Korende onye embusuro eyio yainekirwe ase amaache ime, na egwerwe neyemo ye ching’iti echio ekwete, rirorio nebe etachenegeti.
swahili: Lakini kama mbegu imetiwa maji na mzoga ukaanguka juu yake, hiyo mbegu ni najisi kwenu.

english: If an animal that you may eat dies, anyone who touches the carcass will be unclean until evening.
ekegusii: Eng’iti ende yonsi yancheire koriegwa kerakwe, na omonto orayekune, rirorio omonto oyio nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio.
swahili: “ ‘Kama mnyama ambaye mnaruhusiwa kumla akifa, yeyote atakayeugusa mzoga wake atakuwa najisi mpaka jioni.

english: But of those that only chew the cud or only have a divided hoof, you are not to eat the following: The camel, though it chews the cud, does not have a divided hoof; it is unclean for you.
ekegusii: Korende ase ching’iti chikoria eng’ang’ura gose chibwate ebitaago biatananegete timoria engamia, ekiagera nigo ekoria eng’ang’ura, korende tebwati ebitaago biatananegete; ase ayio techenegeti.
swahili: “ ‘Kuna wanyama wengine ambao hucheua tu au wenye kwato zilizogawanyika tu, lakini hao kamwe msiwale. Ngamia ingawa hucheua hana kwato zilizogawanyika; kwa kawaida ya ibada hiyo ni najisi kwenu.

english: Whoever eats from the carcass must wash his clothes and will be unclean until evening, and anyone who picks up the carcass must wash his clothes and will be unclean until evening.
ekegusii: Moonto onde bwensi oraarie enyama y’eng’iti eyio ekwete nasibie chianga chiaye, naende nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio, na onde bwensi oraimokie eng’iti eyio ekwete, nasibie chianga chiaye, ere nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio.
swahili: Yeyote atakayekula sehemu ya mzoga huo ni lazima afue nguo zake, naye atakuwa najisi mpaka jioni. Yeyote atakayebeba mzoga huo ni lazima afue nguo zake, naye atakuwa najisi mpaka jioni.

english: Every creature that moves along the ground is detestable; it must not be eaten.
ekegusii: “Ebitongwa ebike bionsi bigoetanana ase ense nigo bire okogechia, tibiriegwa.
swahili: “ ‘Kila kiumbe kitambaacho juu ya ardhi ni chukizo; kisiliwe.

english: Do not eat any creature that moves along the ground, whether it crawls on its belly or walks on four or more feet; for such creatures are detestable.
ekegusii: Egetongwa kende gionsi egeke kegwekururera enda, gose gekogendera amagoro ane, gose amange, ase ebio bigoetanana ase ense, nigo bire okogechia, timobaisa kobiria.
swahili: Msile kiumbe chochote kitambaacho juu ya ardhi, kiwe kitambaacho kwa tumbo lake, au kitambaacho kwa miguu minne au kwa miguu mingi; ni chukizo.

english: Do not defile yourselves by any crawling creature; do not become unclean or defiled by them.
ekegusii: Timobaisa gwekora okogechia ase engencho y’ebitongwa ebio bigoetanana, gose gwesoyia ase ogotacheneka ase engencho ya birobio. Moise gokora igo, namobe abatachenegeti.
swahili: Msijitie unajisi kwa chochote katika viumbe hivi. Msijitie unajisi kwa viumbe hivyo au kutiwa unajisi navyo.

english: For I am the LORD your God; consecrate yourselves, therefore, and be holy, because I am holy. You must not defile yourselves by any creature that crawls along the ground.
ekegusii: Inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino; ase ayio mweatanane inwe abanyene, mobe abachenu, ekiagera inche nomochenu inde. Timobaisa gwesoyia ase ogotacheneka ase engencho y’egetongwa kende gionsi egeke ase ebio bigoetanana ase ense.
swahili: Mimi ndimi Bwana Mungu wenu; jitakaseni mwe watakatifu, kwa sababu mimi ni mtakatifu. Msijitie unajisi wenyewe kwa kiumbe chochote kile kiendacho juu ya ardhi.

english: For I am the LORD, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt so that I would be your God; therefore be holy, because I am holy.
ekegusii: Inche ninche Omonene, nabarusetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri imbe Nyasae oino. Ase ayio, mobe abachenu, ekiagera inche nomochenu inde.”
swahili: Mimi ndimi Bwana niliyewapandisha mtoke Misri ili niwe Mungu wenu. Kwa hiyo kuweni watakatifu kwa sababu Mimi ni mtakatifu.

english: This is the law regarding animals, birds, all living creatures that move in the water, and all creatures that crawl along the ground.
ekegusii: Oko nakwo ogochika gotenenerete ching’iti ne chinyoni, na kera egetongwa kere moyo kegoetanana ase amaache ime, na ebitongwa ebisinini bigoetanana ase ense,
swahili: “ ‘Haya ndiyo masharti kuhusu wanyama, ndege, kila kiumbe hai kiendacho ndani ya maji, na kila kiumbe kiendacho juu ya ardhi.

english: You must distinguish between the unclean and the clean, between animals that may be eaten and those that may not.’”
ekegusii: na igo momanye gwaatanana ebichenegete korwa ase ebitachenegeti, ne ching’iti chire moyo chiancheire koriegwa korwa ase echitancheiri koriegwa.
swahili: Ni lazima mpambanue kati ya kilicho najisi na kilicho safi, kati ya viumbe hai vinavyoweza kuliwa na vile visivyoweza kuliwa.’ ”

english: The rock badger, though it chews the cud, does not have a divided hoof; it is unclean for you.
ekegusii: Timoria egesengi, ekiagera nigo gekoria eng’ang’ura, korende tikebwati ebitaago biatananegete; ase ayio tigechenegeti.
swahili: Pelele ingawa hucheua hana kwato zilizogawanyika; huyo ni najisi kwenu.

english: The rabbit, though it chews the cud, does not have a divided hoof; it is unclean for you.
ekegusii: Timoria egesusu, ekiagera nigo gekoria eng’ang’ura, korende tikebwati ebitaago biatananegete; ase ayio tigechenegeti.
swahili: Sungura ingawa hucheua hana kwato zilizogawanyika; huyo ni najisi kwenu.

english: And the pig, though it has a split hoof completely divided, does not chew the cud; it is unclean for you.
ekegusii: Naende timoria embeche, ekiagera nigo ebwate ebitaago biatananegete kegima, korende teri koria eng’ang’ura; eyio techenegeti.
swahili: Naye nguruwe ingawa anazo kwato zilizogawanyika sehemu mbili, hacheui; huyo ni najisi kwenu.

english: You must not eat their meat or touch their carcasses; they are unclean for you.
ekegusii: Timoria chinyama chie ching’iti echio, gose timokuna emebere yabo ekwete, ekiagera echio tichichenegeti.
swahili: Kamwe msile nyama yao wala kugusa mizoga yao; wao ni najisi kwenu.

english: Of all the creatures that live in the water, whether in the seas or in the streams, you may eat anything with fins and scales.
ekegusii: Monyare koria chinswe chire ase chinyancha ne chindooche ime, echibwate chingondo chinga buna chimbaaba, na amagoocho.
swahili: “ ‘Kuhusu viumbe wote wanaoishi ndani ya maji ya bahari na vijito, mtakula wale wote wenye mapezi na magamba.

english: “Say to the Israelites, ‘A woman who becomes pregnant and gives birth to a son will be unclean for seven days, as she is during the days of her menstruation.
ekegusii: “oteebie Abaisraeli ng’a omokungu karabe morito na aibore omwana omoisia nabe oyotachenegeti ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere, amatuko ang’ana buna ekero abwate omotienyi abe oyotachenegeti.
swahili: “Waambie Waisraeli: ‘Mwanamke ambaye atapata mimba na kuzaa mtoto wa kiume atakuwa najisi kwa kawaida ya ibada kwa siku saba, kama anavyokuwa najisi wakati wa siku zake za hedhi.

english: The woman shall continue in purification from her bleeding for thirty-three days. She must not touch anything sacred or go into the sanctuary until the days of her purification are complete.
ekegusii: Erio omokungu oria aganye ase engaki y’amatuko emerongo etato na atato, goika amanyinga akame, na ere omonyene nabe oyochenegete. Tabaisa gokuna gento kende gionsi gechenegete, gose gosoa Aase Aachenu, goika amatuko aye ay’ogochenwa aere.
swahili: Kisha ni lazima huyo mwanamke asubiri kwa siku thelathini na tatu, ndipo atakaswe kutoka damu kwake. Hataruhusiwa kugusa kitu chochote kilicho kitakatifu au kuingia mahali patakatifu, mpaka siku za kutakaswa kwake zimetimia.

english: If, however, she gives birth to a daughter, the woman will be unclean for two weeks as she is during her menstruation. Then she must continue in purification from her bleeding for sixty-six days.
ekegusii: Korende karaibore omwana egesagane, nabe oyotachenegeti ase chichuma ibere, buna ekero abwate omotienyi, naende aganye ase engaki y’amatuko emerongo etano nomo, na atano na rimo, goika amanyinga aye akame, na ere omonyene nabe oyochenegete.
swahili: Kama akimzaa mtoto wa kike, mwanamke huyo atakuwa najisi kwa majuma mawili, kama wakati wake wa hedhi. Kisha atasubiri kwa siku sitini na sita, ndipo atatakaswa kutoka damu kwake.

english: When the days of her purification are complete, whether for a son or for a daughter, she is to bring to the priest at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting a year-old lamb for a burnt offering and a young pigeon or a turtledove for a sin offering.
ekegusii: “Ekero amatuko ’omokuungu oyio ay’ogochenwa aerire, karabe nomwana omoisia aiboire, gose egesagane, omokungu oyio arente eng’ondi yakoorire omwaka oyomo ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosaambwa, ne riige rie riruma, gose riruma, ribe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe. Abirente ase Omokuani agwo ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano.
swahili: “ ‘Siku zake za utakaso kwa ajili ya mwana au binti zitakapotimia, mwanamke huyo atamletea kuhani kwenye ingilio la Hema la Kukutania mwana-kondoo mwenye umri wa mwaka mmoja kwa ajili ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa, na kinda la njiwa au hua kwa ajili ya sadaka ya dhambi.
