swahili: Aroni ataweka mikono yake miwili juu ya kichwa cha mbuzi aliye hai na kuungama juu yake uovu wote na uasi wa Waisraeli, yaani dhambi zao zote, ili kuziweka juu ya kichwa cha huyo mbuzi. Atamwachia huyo mbuzi akimbilie jangwani kwa uangalizi wa mtu aliyepewa wajibu huo.

english: The goat will carry on itself all their iniquities into a solitary place, and the man will release it into the wilderness.
ekegusii: Naboigo embori eria ebogorie ebibe biabo bionsi, egende nabio gochia ase erooro ase abanto batamanyeti.
swahili: Yule mbuzi atachukua juu yake dhambi zao zote mpaka mahali pasipo na watu; naye yule mtu atamwachia akimbilie jangwani.

english: Then Aaron is to enter the Tent of Meeting, take off the linen garments he put on before entering the Most Holy Place, and leave them there.
ekegusii: “Magega y’ayio Aroni asoe Eema y’Omosangererekano, arusie chianga chi’egatani chiria abegete ritang’ani atarasoa Aase Aachenu, achitigeo.
swahili: “Kisha Aroni ataenda ndani ya Hema la Kukutania na kuvua yale mavazi ya kitani aliyoyavaa kabla ya kuingia katika Patakatifu pa Patakatifu, naye atayaacha pale.

english: He is to bathe himself with water in a holy place and put on his own clothes. Then he must go out and sacrifice his burnt offering and the people’s burnt offering to make atonement for himself and for the people.
ekegusii: Erio esibie omobere oye namaache agwo aase gete are aachenu, naende abeeke chianga chiaye chia botaambe. Magega y’ayio asoke, arue ekeng’wanso ki’ogosaambwa ase engencho yaye ere omonyene amo neki’abaanto bonsi na akore okobwatanigwa asere omonyene na ase abanto.
swahili: Ataoga kwa maji katika mahali patakatifu na kuvaa mavazi yake ya kawaida. Kisha atatoka na kutoa dhabihu ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa kwa ajili yake na sadaka ya kuteketezwa kwa ajili ya watu, ili kufanya upatanisho kwa ajili yake mwenyewe, na kwa ajili ya watu.

english: He is also to burn the fat of the sin offering on the altar.
ekegusii: Naende asaambere ebitinya bi’ekeng’wanso keria ki’ebibe ase egesasiimero.
swahili: Pia atachoma mafuta ya mnyama wa sadaka ya dhambi juu ya madhabahu.

english: The man who released the goat as the scapegoat must wash his clothes and bathe himself with water; afterward he may reenter the camp.
ekegusii: Omonto oyio oirete embori eria ase erooro ase Asaseli, asibie chianga chiaye, esibie nomobere namaache; magega y’ayio amanye gosoa ase egetwori.
swahili: “Yule mtu anayemwachia yule mbuzi wa kubebeshwa dhambi ni lazima afue nguo zake na kuoga kwa maji; baadaye anaweza kuingia kambini.

english: The bull for the sin offering and the goat for the sin offering, whose blood was brought into the Most Holy Place to make atonement, must be taken outside the camp; and their hides, flesh, and dung must be burned up.
ekegusii: Eeri eria amo nembori eria chiaruetwe chibe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, echio amanyinga abo arentwe ime y’Aase Aachenu Mono akore okobwatanigwa, chiirwe isiko y’egetwori. Riiyo ne risankwa, amo ne chinyama ne chisike chiabo, bisaamberwe aroro n’omorero.
swahili: Yule fahali na mbuzi waliotolewa kwa ajili ya sadaka za dhambi, ambao damu yao ilikuwa imeletwa Patakatifu pa Patakatifu kwa ajili ya kufanya upatanisho, ni lazima watolewe nje ya kambi. Ngozi zao, nyama, na matumbo pamoja na mavi vitateketezwa kwa moto.

english: The one who burns them must wash his clothes and bathe himself with water, and afterward he may reenter the camp.
ekegusii: Omonto oria orasaambe ebinto ebio nigo arasibie chianga chiaye, esibie nomobere namaache; magega y’ayio amanye gosoa ase egetwori. Okorendwa kw’erituko ri’Okobwatanigwa
swahili: Mtu atakayevichoma ni lazima afue nguo zake na aoge kwa maji; baadaye ataweza kuingia kambini.

english: This is to be a permanent statute for you: On the tenth day of the seventh month, you shall humble yourselves and not do any work—whether the native or the foreigner who resides among you—
ekegusii: “Oyo noro omooroberio ochikiire ase more moragenderere korenda botaambe. Rituko ria ikomi, ase omotienyi o gatano na kabere, inamobe mokweng’ata na gweitia; timokora emeremo ende yonsi, inwe abanyene, gose abamenyi bamenyete ase egati yaino.
swahili: “Hili litakuwa agizo la kudumu kwa ajili yenu: Katika siku ya kumi ya mwezi wa saba ni lazima mfunge, wala msifanye kazi yoyote, iwe mzawa au mgeni anayeishi miongoni mwenu,

english: This is how Aaron is to enter the Holy Place: with a young bull for a sin offering and a ram for a burnt offering.
ekegusii: Igo arasoe ime y’Aase Aachenu Mono magega karentire eeri ensae ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, na emingichi ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosaambwa.
swahili: “Hivi ndivyo Aroni atakavyoingia katika mahali patakatifu: atachukua fahali mchanga kwa ajili ya sadaka ya dhambi, na kondoo dume kwa ajili ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa.

english: because on this day atonement will be made for you to cleanse you, and you will be clean from all your sins before the LORD.
ekegusii: Ase rituko erio okobwatanigwa ngokorwe ase more ase okobasibia korwa ase ebibe biaino bionsi, nainwe namocheneke ase obosio bwane inche Omonene.
swahili: kwa sababu siku hii upatanisho utafanyika kwa ajili yenu ili kuwatakasa. Kisha mtakuwa safi mbele za Bwana kutokana na dhambi zenu zote.

english: It is a Sabbath of complete rest for you, that you may humble yourselves; it is a permanent statute.
ekegusii: Rituko erio naribe richenu mono ase more, rituko ri’ogotimoka, na inwe namweng’ate. Oyio nomoroberio ochiikirwe oragenderere botaambe.
swahili: Ni Sabato ya mapumziko, na lazima mfunge; ni agizo la kudumu.

english: The priest who is anointed and ordained to succeed his father as high priest shall make atonement. He will put on the sacred linen garments
ekegusii: Omokuani oakirwe amaguta na gwatananwa abe Omokuani ribaga ria ise, nere orakore okobwatanigwa okwo. Ere nigo arabeeke chianga chiria chinchenu chi’egatani,
swahili: Kuhani ambaye ametiwa mafuta na kuwekwa wakfu ili kuingia mahali pa baba yake kama kuhani mkuu atafanya upatanisho. Atavaa mavazi matakatifu ya kitani,

english: and make atonement for the Most Holy Place, the Tent of Meeting, and the altar, and for the priests and all the people of the assembly.
ekegusii: na akore okobwatanigwa ase Aase Aachenu Mono, na ase Eema y’Omosangererekano, naende akore okobwatanigwa ase abakuani, na ase omosangererekano bw’Abaisraeli.
swahili: na kufanya upatanisho kwa ajili ya Patakatifu pa Patakatifu, Hema la Kukutania na madhabahu, na pia kwa ajili ya makuhani, pamoja na jumuiya yote ya watu.

english: This is to be a permanent statute for you, to make atonement once a year for the Israelites because of all their sins.” And all this was done as the LORD had commanded Moses.
ekegusii: Omoroberio oyio ochiikirwe ase more oragenderere botaambe, ng’a okobwatanigwa kobe kogokorerwa ase Abaisraeli ara rimo ase omwaka ase okobachena korwa ase ebibe biabo bionsi.” Musa agakora buna Omonene amochiigete.
swahili: “Hili litakuwa agizo la kudumu kwa ajili yenu: Upatanisho utafanywa mara moja tu kwa mwaka kwa ajili ya dhambi zote za Waisraeli.” Ndivyo ilivyofanyika, kama vile Bwana alivyomwamuru Mose.

english: He is to wear the sacred linen tunic, with linen undergarments. He must tie a linen sash around him and put on the linen turban. These are holy garments, and he must bathe himself with water before he wears them.
ekegusii: “Ritang’ani Aroni atarasoa Aase Aachenu Mono, goika esibie omobere oye namaache, amanye kobeeka chianga chiria chinchenu: Eganchwa erobekanirie eigete inse, ne chisirwari, na orokini, na ekegogwa, bionsi biroisirie korwa ase egatani.
swahili: Atavaa koti takatifu la kitani, pamoja na nguo za ndani za kitani; atafunga mshipi wa kitani kiunoni, na kuvaa kilemba cha kitani. Haya ni mavazi matakatifu, kwa hiyo ni lazima aoge kwa maji kabla ya kuyavaa mavazi hayo.

english: And he shall take from the congregation of Israel two male goats for a sin offering and one ram for a burnt offering.
ekegusii: “Erio Aroni aegwe korwa ase omoganda bw’Abaisraeli chigoree ibere chibe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, na emingichi eyemo ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosaambwa.
swahili: Atachukua mbuzi dume wawili kutoka kwa jumuiya ya Israeli kwa ajili ya sadaka ya dhambi, na kondoo dume kwa ajili ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa.

english: Aaron is to present the bull for his sin offering and make atonement for himself and his household.
ekegusii: Ritang’ani arue eeri ebe ekeng’wanso ase ogokora okobwatanigwa asere omonyene, na ase abanto b’enka yaye, erinde baaberwe.
swahili: “Aroni atamtoa huyo fahali kwa ajili ya sadaka yake ya dhambi ili afanye upatanisho kwa ajili yake mwenyewe na nyumba yake.

english: Then he shall take the two goats and present them before the LORD at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.
ekegusii: Naende arente chigoree chiria ibere ase obosio bwane inche Omonene agwo ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano.
swahili: Kisha atawachukua wale mbuzi dume wawili na kuwaleta mbele za Bwana kwenye ingilio la Hema la Kukutania.

english: After Aaron casts lots for the two goats, one for the LORD and the other for the scapegoat,
ekegusii: Agwo Aroni aake obomera igoro ye chigoree chiria ibere, obomera obomo ase ’nde, na obonde ase Asaseli.
swahili: Aroni atapiga kura kwa ajili ya hao mbuzi wawili, mmoja kwa ajili ya Bwana na mwingine kwa ajili ya kubebeshwa dhambi.

english: he shall present the goat chosen by lot for the LORD and sacrifice it as a sin offering.
ekegusii: Egoree eria eraabe yagwereirwe nobomera ase ’nde, Aroni ayerente ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe.
swahili: Aroni atamleta yule mbuzi ambaye kura ya Bwana imemwangukia na kumtoa dhabihu kwa ajili ya sadaka ya dhambi.

english: If anyone from the house of Israel or a foreigner living among them eats any blood, I will set My face against that person and cut him off from among his people.
ekegusii: “Onde bwensi ase Abaisraeli, gose omomenyi omenyete ase egati yabo, oraarie amanyinga ande onsi, inche Omonene nimbe mamincha y’omonto oyio, na inche nimwatanane korwa ase abanto baye.
swahili: “ ‘Mwisraeli yeyote au mgeni anayeishi miongoni mwao ambaye atakunywa damu yoyote, nitakuwa kinyume cha mtu huyo atakayekunywa damu na kumkatilia mbali na watu wake.

english: For the life of the flesh is in the blood, and I have given it to you to make atonement for your souls upon the altar; for it is the blood that makes atonement for the soul.
ekegusii: Obomoyo bwa kera omobere nigo bore ime ase amanyinga; nabaeire amanyinga moyanyororokererie ase egesasiimero akore okobwatanigwa ase obomoyo bwaino; amanyinga naro agokora okobwatanigwa, ekiagera obomoyo bore imeo.
swahili: Kwa kuwa uhai wa kiumbe uko ndani ya damu, nami nimewapa hiyo damu ili mfanyie upatanisho kwa ajili yenu wenyewe juu ya madhabahu; damu ndiyo ifanyayo upatanisho kwa ajili ya maisha ya mtu.

english: Therefore I say to the Israelites, ‘None of you may eat blood, nor may any foreigner living among you eat blood.’
ekegusii: Ase ayio natebirie Abaisraeli ng’a monto onde bwensi obo, gose omomenyi omenyete ase egati yabo, tabaisa koria amanyinga ande onsi.
swahili: Kwa hiyo, ninawaambia Waisraeli, “Hakuna hata mmoja wenu anayeruhusiwa kunywa damu, wala mgeni anayeishi miongoni mwenu haruhusiwi kunywa damu.”

english: And if any Israelite or foreigner living among them hunts down a wild animal or bird that may be eaten, he must drain its blood and cover it with dirt.
ekegusii: “Omonto onde bwensi ase Abaisraeli, gose omomenyi omenyete ase egati yabo, oraite eng’iti y’orosana, gose enyoni eyancheire koriegwa, goika aitere amanyinga aye inse, erio ayatube amaroba.
swahili: “ ‘Mwisraeli yeyote au mgeni anayeishi miongoni mwenu ambaye atamwinda mnyama au ndege anayeruhusiwa kuliwa ni lazima aimwage damu na kuifunika kwa udongo,

english: For the life of all flesh is its blood. Therefore I have told the Israelites, ‘You must not eat the blood of any living thing, because the life of all flesh is its blood; whoever eats it must be cut off.’
ekegusii: Obomoyo bwa kera omobere nigo bore ase amanyinga. Ase engencho eyio nateebirie Abaisraeli ng’a tibaria amanyinga y’eng’iti ende yonsi, ekiagera obomoyo bwa kera egetongwa nigo bore ase amanyinga aye. Omonto onde bwensi oraarie amanyinga nigo araatananwe korwa ase abanto baye.
swahili: kwa sababu uhai wa kila kiumbe ni katika damu yake. Ndiyo sababu nimewaambia Waisraeli, “Kamwe msinywe damu ya kiumbe chochote, kwa sababu uhai wa kila kiumbe ni katika damu yake; yeyote atakayekunywa damu ni lazima akatiliwe mbali.”

english: And any person, whether native or foreigner, who eats anything found dead or mauled by wild beasts must wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he will be unclean until evening; then he will be clean.
ekegusii: “Omonto onde bwensi, omobiare gose omomenyi omenyete ase egati yaino, oraarie eng’iti ekwete yoka enyene, gose eyeitire ne ching’iti chinde chi’orosana, goika asibie chianga chiaye, esibie nomobere namaache; nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio, erio abe ochenekire.
swahili: “ ‘Mtu yeyote, awe mzawa au mgeni, ambaye atakula mzoga wa kitu chochote ama kilichouawa na wanyama mwitu ni lazima afue nguo zake na aoge kwa maji, naye atakuwa najisi kwa kawaida ya ibada mpaka jioni, kisha atakuwa safi.

english: But if he does not wash his clothes and bathe himself, then he shall bear his iniquity.”
ekegusii: Korende onye tagosibia chianga chiaye na gwesibia omobere, rirorio nabogorie obobe bwaye.”
swahili: Lakini kama hakufua nguo zake na kuoga, atakuwa na hatia kwa kosa hilo.’ ”

english: “Speak to Aaron, his sons, and all the Israelites and tell them this is what the LORD has commanded:
ekegusii: “Teebia Aroni na abamura baye amo n’Abaisraeli bonsi ng’a inche Omonene nachiikire iga:
swahili: “Sema na Aroni na wanawe, pamoja na Waisraeli wote, uwaambie: ‘Hili ndilo Bwana aliloagiza:

english: ‘Anyone from the house of Israel who slaughters an ox, a lamb, or a goat in the camp or outside of it
ekegusii: Onye omonto onde bwensi okonyenyera eng’ombe, gose emaanwa y’eng’ondi, gose embori, ase egetwori, gose isiko y’egetwori,
swahili: Mwisraeli yeyote atakayetoa dhabihu ya maksai, mwana-kondoo au mbuzi ndani ya kambi au nje yake,

english: instead of bringing it to the entrance to the Tent of Meeting to present it as an offering to the LORD before His tabernacle—that man shall incur bloodguilt. He has shed blood and must be cut off from among his people.
ekegusii: atayerenteti agwo ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano ebe ekeng’wanso ase ’nde, bosio bw’Obomenyo bwane, rirorio okomocha kw’ogoitera amanyinga nakobarerwe omonto oyio. Ere oiteire amanyinga, ase igo naatananwe korwa ase abanto baye.
swahili: badala ya kuileta kwenye ingilio la Hema la Kukutania ili kuileta kama sadaka kwa Bwana mbele ya Maskani ya Bwana, mtu huyo atahesabiwa kuwa na hatia ya kumwaga damu; ni lazima akatiliwe mbali na watu wake.

english: For this reason the Israelites will bring to the LORD the sacrifices they have been offering in the open fields. They are to bring them to the priest at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting and offer them as sacrifices of peace to the LORD.
ekegusii: Bono Abaisraeli tibakonyara gokora buna baarenge gokora agwo ritang’ani, tibakonyenyera ching’iti chi’ebing’wanso biabo orosana isiko; goika bachindetere inche Omonene, bachiire ase Omokuani agwo ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano, bachinyeenyereo chibe ebing’wanso bi’omorembe ase ’nde.
swahili: Hii ni ili Waisraeli wamletee Bwana dhabihu wanazozifanya sasa mahali pa wazi mashambani. Ni lazima wazilete kwa makuhani, yaani kwa Bwana, katika ingilio la Hema la Kukutania, na kutoa dhabihu kama sadaka za amani.

english: The priest will then sprinkle the blood on the altar of the LORD at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting and burn the fat as a pleasing aroma to the LORD.
ekegusii: Na Omokuani asiarere amanyinga ase egesasiimero kiane agwo ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano, naende asaambe ebitinya bibe rimisu rigiya rikongwenera.
swahili: Kuhani atanyunyiza damu kwenye madhabahu ya Bwana katika ingilio la Hema la Kukutania, na kuyateketeza mafuta ya hiyo dhabihu kuwa harufu nzuri ya kumpendeza Bwana.

english: They must no longer offer their sacrifices to the goat demons to which they have prostituted themselves. This will be a permanent statute for them for the generations to come.’
ekegusii: Abaisraeli tibaabaisa konyenyera ebing’wanso biabo isiko aande na kobirua ase ebirecha, na igo babe abatari abegenwa ase ’nde. Oyio nobe omooroberio ochikiire oragenderere botaambe, ebiaare ase ebiaare.
swahili: Hawatatoa kamwe dhabihu zao kwa sanamu za mbuzi ambazo wamekuwa wakijifanyia nazo ukahaba. Hili litakuwa agizo la kudumu kwao na kwa ajili ya vizazi vijavyo.’

english: Tell them that if anyone from the house of Israel or any foreigner living among them offers a burnt offering or a sacrifice
ekegusii: “Ase igo obateebie ng’a monto onde bwensi ase Abaisraeli, gose omomenyi omenyete ase egati yabo, kararue ekeng’wanso kegosaambwa ekegima, gose ekeng’wanso kende gionsi,
swahili: “Waambie: ‘Mwisraeli yeyote au mgeni yeyote anayeishi miongoni mwao atakayetoa sadaka ya kuteketezwa au dhabihu

english: but does not bring it to the entrance to the Tent of Meeting to sacrifice it to the LORD, that man must be cut off from his people. Laws against Eating Blood
ekegusii: na omonto oyio atakerenteti ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano na gokerua ase ’nde, nigo araatananwe korwa ase abanto baye.
swahili: bila kuileta kwenye ingilio la Hema la Kukutania ili kutoa dhabihu kwa Bwana, mtu huyo ni lazima akatiliwe mbali na watu wake.

english: You must not have sexual relations with your son’s daughter or your daughter’s daughter, for that would shame your family.
ekegusii: Tobaisa koraara nomochokoro oo, oyo bw’omwana oo omomura, gose oyo bw’omwana oo omosubati. Ayio nigo arakorentere obosooku.
swahili: “ ‘Usikutane kimwili na binti wa mwanao ama binti wa binti yako; utajivunjia heshima.

english: You must not have sexual relations with the daughter of your father’s wife, born to your father; she is your sister.
ekegusii: Tobaisa koraara nomoiseke o nyoko moke, moga iso; oyio nomoiseke omino iso aiborete.
swahili: “ ‘Usikutane kimwili na binti wa mke wa baba yako, aliyezaliwa na baba yako; huyo ni dada yako.

english: You must not have sexual relations with your father’s sister; she is your father’s close relative.
ekegusii: Tobaisa koraara nomoiseke omwabo iso; oyio nyoko moke, omwabo iso.
swahili: “ ‘Usikutane kimwili na dada wa baba yako; ni ndugu wa karibu wa baba yako.

english: You must not have sexual relations with your mother’s sister, for she is your mother’s close relative.
ekegusii: Tobaisa koraara nomoiseke omwabo nyoko; oyio nyoko moke, omwabo nyoko.
swahili: “ ‘Usikutane kimwili na dada wa mama yako, kwa sababu ni ndugu wa mama yako wa karibu.

english: You must not dishonor your father’s brother by approaching his wife to have sexual relations with her; she is your aunt.
ekegusii: Tobaisa koraara na moga iso moke omwabo iso; okwo nokorentera iso moke obosooku, ekiagera omokungu oyio nyoko moke are.
swahili: “ ‘Usimvunjie heshima ndugu wa baba yako, kwa kukutana kimwili na mke wake; yeye ni shangazi yako.

english: You must not have sexual relations with your daughter-in-law. She is your son’s wife; you are not to have sexual relations with her.
ekegusii: Tobaisa koraara na moka momura oo; obwo nobosooku, ekiagera n’omokuungu bw’omwana oo omomura.
swahili: “ ‘Usikutane kimwili na mkwe wako, yeye ni mke wa mwanao; usiwe na mahusiano kama hayo naye.

english: You must not have sexual relations with your brother’s wife; that would shame your brother.
ekegusii: Tobaisa koraara na moka momura omino; okwo nokomorentera momura omino obosooku.
swahili: “ ‘Usikutane kimwili na mke wa kaka yako; utamvunjia heshima kaka yako.

english: You must not have sexual relations with both a woman and her daughter. You are not to marry her son’s daughter or her daughter’s daughter and have sexual relations with her. They are close relatives; it is depraved.
ekegusii: Tobaisa koraara nomoiseke bw’omokuungu kwabeire nere, gose tobaisa gotwara omochokoro oye, omoiseke bw’omwana oye omosubati, gose oyo bw’omomura oye, ekiagera abwo nabaanto abamo. Obwo nobonyaka obobe.
swahili: “ ‘Usikutane kimwili na mwanamke kisha na binti yake. Usikutane kimwili na binti wa mwanawe au binti wa binti yake; hao ni ndugu zake wa karibu. Huo ni uovu.

english: You must not take your wife’s sister as a rival wife and have sexual relations with her while your wife is still alive.
ekegusii: Tobaisa koira mokoyoo, omwabo mokao, ekero mokao are moyo; ayio nabaise korenta obobisa.
swahili: “ ‘Usimchukue dada wa mke wako kuwa mke mwenza, na kukutana naye kimwili wakati bado mke wako anaishi.

english: You must not approach a woman to have sexual relations with her during her menstrual period.
ekegusii: “Tobaisa koraara n’omokuungu ekero abwate omotienyi, ekiagera ere tachenegeti ase ekero ekio.
swahili: “ ‘Usimsogelee mwanamke ili kukutana naye kimwili wakati wa unajisi wa siku zake za mwezi.

english: “Speak to the Israelites and tell them: I am the LORD your God.
ekegusii: “Teebia Abaisraeli ng’a nateebire iga: Inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino.
swahili: “Sema na Waisraeli uwaambie: ‘Mimi ndimi Bwana Mungu wenu.

english: You must not lie carnally with your neighbor’s wife and thus defile yourself with her.
ekegusii: Tobaisa koraara n’omokuungu bw’omosaacha onde na gwesoyia ase ogotacheneka nere.
swahili: “ ‘Usikutane kimwili na mke wa jirani yako na kujitia naye unajisi.

english: You must not give any of your children to be sacrificed to Molech, for you must not profane the name of your God. I am the LORD.
ekegusii: Tobaisa korua omwana onde oo abe ekeng’wanso ase enyasae Moleki, ekiagera okwo nokorentera erieta ria Nyasae oo obosooku. Inche ninche Omonene.
swahili: “ ‘Usimtoe mtoto wako yeyote awe kafara kwa mungu Moleki, kwani hutalinajisi kamwe jina la Mungu wako. Mimi ndimi Bwana.

english: You must not lie with a man as with a woman; that is an abomination.
ekegusii: Tobaisa koraara nomonto omosacha buna okoraara n’omokuungu; obwo nobonyaka obobe bw’okogechia.
swahili: “ ‘Usikutane kimwili na mwanaume kama mtu akutanaye na mwanamke; hilo ni chukizo.

english: You must not lie carnally with any animal, thus defiling yourself with it; a woman must not stand before an animal to mate with it; that is a perversion.
ekegusii: Tobaisa koraara neng’iti ende yonsi na gwesoyia ase ogotacheneka nero. Na omokungu tabaisa kwerua koraara neng’iti ende yonsi. Obwo nobonyaka obobe kegima bw’okogechia.
swahili: “ ‘Usikutane kimwili na mnyama na kujitia unajisi kwake. Mwanamke asijipeleke kwa mnyama ili kukutana naye kimwili; huo ni upotovu.

english: Do not defile yourselves by any of these practices, for by all these things the nations I am driving out before you have defiled themselves.
ekegusii: “Inwe timobaisa gwekora abatachenegeti ase ogokora buna okwo. Ase enchera eyio abanto b’ebisaku mbesoetie ase ogotacheneka, na bono inche Omonene nkobaseria inde baabatigere inwe ense eyio.
swahili: “ ‘Msijitie unajisi kwa njia yoyote katika hizi, kwa sababu hivi ndivyo mataifa nitakayoyafukuza mbele yenu yalivyojitia unajisi.

english: Even the land has become defiled, so I am punishing it for its sin, and the land will vomit out its inhabitants.
ekegusii: Ogokora kwabo gokarentera ense eria ogotacheneka, na inche nkayea egesusuro ase engencho y’ogosaria okwo, na ense eyio ekaanga tiyatwara abanto bamenyeteo, korende ekabaseria.
swahili: Hata nchi ilitiwa unajisi, hivyo nikaiadhibu kwa dhambi zake, nayo nchi ikawatapika wakazi wake.

english: But you are to keep My statutes and ordinances, and you must not commit any of these abominations—neither your native-born nor the foreigner who lives among you.
ekegusii: Ase igo inwe mwensi, ababiare gose abamenyi bamenyete ase egati yaino, goika morende amachiiko aane na kobwata aya onsi nabachiikire, gose timobaisa gokora kende gionsi gi’okogechia okwo abanto b’ebisaku bakorete.
swahili: Lakini ni lazima uzitunze amri zangu na sheria zangu. Mzawa na wageni waishio miongoni mwenu kamwe wasifanye mambo yoyote ya machukizo haya,

english: For the men who were in the land before you committed all these abominations, and the land has become defiled.
ekegusii: Abanto bamenyete ase ense eria ritang’ani riaino nigo bakorete okogechia okwo gwonsi, na igo ense eria ekaba etachenegeti.
swahili: kwa kuwa mambo haya yote yalifanywa na watu walioishi katika nchi hii kabla yenu, na nchi ikawa najisi.

english: So if you defile the land, it will vomit you out as it spewed out the nations before you.
ekegusii: Moise gokora ayio, ense eyio nigo erabaange morue aroro, buna yangete abanto b’ebisaku, abwo baabatang’anerete komenyao,
swahili: Kama mkiinajisi nchi, itawatapika kama ilivyowatapika mataifa yaliyowatangulia.

english: Therefore anyone who commits any of these abominations must be cut off from among his people.
ekegusii: ekiagera monto onde bwensi orakore okogechia konde gwonsi buna okwo, oyio naatananwe korwa ase abanto baye.
swahili: “ ‘Kila mtu atakayefanya mojawapo ya machukizo haya, watu hao ni lazima wakatiliwe mbali na watu wao.

english: You must not follow the practices of the land of Egypt, where you used to live, and you must not follow the practices of the land of Canaan, into which I am bringing you. You must not walk in their customs.
ekegusii: Timobaisa gokora buna abanto ba Misiri bagokora, agwo ase mwamenyete, gose buna abanto ba Kaanani bagokora, ense eyio nkobaira mochie komenya, gose timobaisa kobwatia chingencho chiabo.
swahili: Msifanye kama wafanyavyo huko Misri, mahali mlipokuwa mnaishi, wala msifanye kama wanavyofanya katika nchi ya Kanaani, mahali ninapowapeleka. Msifuate matendo yao.

english: You must keep My charge not to practice any of the abominable customs that were practiced before you, so that you do not defile yourselves by them. I am the LORD your God.”
ekegusii: “Ase ayio, moigwere amang’ana aya onsi nabachiikire, na moyakore. Timobaisi kwenaria chingencho chi’okogechia chiakoretwe nabaanto abwo baabatang’anerete komenya ase ense eyio. Moise gokora igo, inamwesoyie ase ogotacheneka ase chingencho echio. Inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino.”
swahili: Shikeni maagizo yangu, wala msifuate desturi za machukizo yoyote yaliyofanywa kabla hamjafika katika nchi hii, na kujitia unajisi kwa hayo. Mimi ndimi Bwana Mungu wako.’ ”

english: You are to practice My judgments and keep My statutes by walking in them. I am the LORD your God.
ekegusii: Moigwere amachiiko aane, na mokore aya nkobachika. Inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino.
swahili: Ni lazima mzitii sheria zangu, na mwe waangalifu kuzifuata amri zangu. Mimi ndimi Bwana Mungu wenu.

english: Keep My statutes and My judgments, for the man who does these things will live by them. I am the LORD.
ekegusii: Ee, mokore aya nkobachika, na mobwate amachiiko aane. Omonto karakore amang’ana ayio nabe moyo. Inche ninche Omonene.
swahili: Zishikeni amri zangu na sheria zangu, kwa maana mtu anayezitii ataishi kwa hizo. Mimi ndimi Bwana.

english: None of you are to approach any close relative to have sexual relations. I am the LORD.
ekegusii: “Monto onde bwensi tabaisa koraara n’omokuungu ore omoamate omwabo. Okwo nokorentera omoamate omwabo obosooku. Inche ninche Omonene.
swahili: “ ‘Hakuna mtu awaye yote atakayemsogelea ndugu wa karibu ili kukutana naye kimwili. Mimi ndimi Bwana.

english: You must not expose the nakedness of your father by having sexual relations with your mother. She is your mother; you must not have sexual relations with her.
ekegusii: Tobaisa koraara na nyoko. Okwo nokomorentera iso obosooku. Torentera nyoko obosooku.
swahili: “ ‘Usimvunjie heshima baba yako kwa kukutana kimwili na mama yako. Yeye ni mama yako; usiwe na mahusiano kama hayo naye.

english: You must not have sexual relations with your father’s wife; it would dishonor your father.
ekegusii: Tobaisa koraara na nyoko moke, moga iso. Okwo nokomorentera iso obosooku.
swahili: “ ‘Usikutane kimwili na mke wa baba yako; hiyo itamvunjia heshima baba yako.

english: You must not have sexual relations with your sister, either your father’s daughter or your mother’s daughter, whether she was born in the same home or elsewhere.
ekegusii: Tobaisa koraara na moiseke omino, omoiseke o iso gose oyo o nyoko, onye moiboire komo ase enyomba eyemo, gose oiboire ase enyomba ende.
swahili: “ ‘Usikutane kimwili na dada yako, wala binti wa baba yako, au binti wa mama yako, awe amezaliwa katika nyumba hiyo au mahali pengine.

english: You must not strip your vineyard bare or gather its fallen grapes. Leave them for the poor and the foreigner. I am the LORD your God.
ekegusii: Timobaisa gochoora amasabibu atigarete, gose agwete inse, ase emegondo yaino y’emesabibu; ayio motigere abataka na abamenyi. Inche ninche Omonene Nyasae oino.
swahili: Usirudi mara ya pili katika shamba lako la mizabibu, wala usiokote zabibu zilizoanguka chini. Ziache kwa ajili ya maskini na mgeni. Mimi ndimi Bwana Mungu wako.

english: You must not steal. You must not lie or deceive one another.
ekegusii: “Timoiba, gose timong’ainana, gose timoteebania oborimo.
swahili: “ ‘Usiibe. “ ‘Usiseme uongo. “ ‘Msidanganyane.

english: You must not swear falsely by My name and so profane the name of your God. I am the LORD.
ekegusii: Timobaisa gotiana ogotiana kw’oborimo ase erieta riane. Moise gokora igo, nigo moraarentere erieta riane obosooku. Inche ninche Omonene Nyasae.
swahili: “ ‘Usiape kwa uongo kwa Jina langu, na hivyo kulinajisi jina la Mungu wako. Mimi ndimi Bwana.

english: You must not defraud your neighbor or rob him. You must not withhold until morning the wages due a hired hand.
ekegusii: “Tobaisa korianania omogisangio oo, gose komourereria. Tobaisa gotanga eng’eria y’omonto origete okogokorera emeremo, tebeera ase ore goika mambia.
swahili: “ ‘Usimdhulumu wala kumwibia jirani yako. “ ‘Usishikilie mshahara wa kibarua usiku kucha hadi asubuhi.

english: You must not curse the deaf or place a stumbling block before the blind, but you shall fear your God. I am the LORD.
ekegusii: Tobaisa koragereria omonto omotino, gose kobeeka ekegocha bosio bw’omonto omouko, korende omoiroke Nyasae oo. Inche ninche Omonene.
swahili: “ ‘Usimlaani kiziwi, wala usiweke kikwazo mbele ya kipofu, lakini umche Mungu wako. Mimi ndimi Bwana.

english: You must not pervert justice; you must not show partiality to the poor or favoritism to the rich; you are to judge your neighbor fairly.
ekegusii: “Timokora ayatari boronge ekero ebiina bikogambwa; timobaisa gwanchereria omotaka, gose koiroka omonda, korende monache ebiina ebironge ase abagisangio baino.
swahili: “ ‘Usipotoshe haki; usionyeshe kumpendelea maskini, wala upendeleo kwa mwenye cheo, bali mwamulie jirani yako kwa haki.

english: You must not go about spreading slander among your people. You must not endanger the life of your neighbor. I am the LORD.
ekegusii: Tobaisa goeta‐eta ase egati y’abanto bamino gokwana obogenki; tobaisa kogera oyomino aitwe ase okoba kirori bw’oborimo. Inche ninche Omonene.
swahili: “ ‘Usieneze uchochezi miongoni mwa watu wako. “ ‘Usifanye kitu chochote kile kinachohatarisha maisha ya jirani yako. Mimi ndimi Bwana.

english: You must not harbor hatred against your brother in your heart. Directly rebuke your neighbor, so that you will not incur guilt on account of him.
ekegusii: “Tobaisa kogecha oyomino ime ase enkoro yao, korende omokuurere maiso marore, erinde tokora ebibe ase engencho yaye.
swahili: “ ‘Usimchukie ndugu yako moyoni mwako. Karipia jirani yako kwa uwazi ili usishiriki hatia yake.

english: Do not seek revenge or bear a grudge against any of your people, but love your neighbor as yourself. I am the LORD. Keep My Statutes
ekegusii: Tobaisa kweruseria egesiomba, gose kogenderera kogecha monto onde bwensi ase egesaku kiao, korende ancha omogisangio oo buna bweanchete aye omonyene. Inche ninche Omonene.
swahili: “ ‘Usijilipizie kisasi wala kuwa na kinyongo dhidi ya mmoja wa jamaa yako, lakini mpende jirani yako kama unavyojipenda wewe mwenyewe. Mimi ndimi Bwana.

english: You are to keep My statutes. You shall not crossbreed two different kinds of livestock; you shall not sow your fields with two kinds of seed; and you shall not wear clothing made of two kinds of material.
ekegusii: “Mobwate amachiiko aane. Timobaisa gotiga chitugo chiaino chieenane amarieme ne chitari egesaku ekemo. Timobaisa kobusura chimbusuro chi’ebisaku bibere ase omogondo oyomo, timobeeka chianga chiroisirie korwa ase chiusi ao ao.
swahili: “ ‘Mtazishika amri zangu. “ ‘Usiwaache wanyama wako wa kufugwa wakazaana na wengine wa aina tofauti. “ ‘Usipande mbegu za aina mbili katika shamba lako. “ ‘Usivae nguo iliyofumwa kwa nyuzi za aina mbili tofauti.

english: “Speak to the whole congregation of Israel and tell them: Be holy because I, the LORD your God, am holy.
ekegusii: Teebia omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli: Mobe abachenu, ekiagera inche Omonene, Nyasae oino, nigo inde omochenu,
swahili: “Sema na kusanyiko lote la Israeli na uwaambie: ‘Kuweni watakatifu, kwa kuwa mimi, Bwana Mungu wenu, ni mtakatifu.

english: If a man lies carnally with a slave girl promised to another man but who has not been redeemed or given her freedom, there must be due punishment. But they are not to be put to death, because she had not been freed.
ekegusii: “Omonto aise koraara nomoiseke ore omosomba na oriereirwe boko nomonto omoao, na omoiseke oria taraboorigwa, gose taranyora obosibore, barabwo babere nigo baraegwe egesusuro, ko tibagoitwa, ekiagera omoiseke oyio taranyora obosibore.
swahili: “ ‘Kama mwanaume anakutana kimwili na mwanamke ambaye ni msichana mtumwa aliyeposwa na mwanaume mwingine, lakini ambaye hajakombolewa wala hajapewa uhuru, lazima iwepo adhabu inayofaa. Hata hivyo hawatauawa, kwa sababu msichana alikuwa bado hajaachwa huru.

english: The man, however, must bring a ram to the entrance to the Tent of Meeting as his guilt offering to the LORD.
ekegusii: Omonto oyio arente emingichi eyemo ase ’nde inche Omonene, agwo ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano, ebe ekeng’wanso gi’okomocha kwaye.
swahili: Lakini huyo mtu lazima alete kondoo dume kwenye ingilio la Hema la Kukutania kwa ajili ya sadaka ya hatia kwa Bwana.

english: The priest shall make atonement on his behalf before the LORD with the ram of the guilt offering for the sin he has committed, and he will be forgiven the sin he has committed.
ekegusii: Ase okorua emingichi eria y’ekeng’wanso gi’okomocha, Omokuani akore okobwatanigwa ase omonto oyio ase obosio bwane, ase engencho y’ebibe biria akorire, na omonto oyio naaberwe ase ebibe ebio akorire.
swahili: Kupitia kwa huyo kondoo dume wa sadaka ya hatia, kuhani atafanya upatanisho kwa ajili yake mbele za Bwana kwa ajili ya dhambi aliyotenda, naye atasamehewa dhambi yake.

english: When you enter the land and plant any kind of tree for food, you shall regard the fruit as forbidden. For three years it will be forbidden to you and must not be eaten.
ekegusii: “Ekero moraike ase ense ya Kaanani na mosimeke emete y’ebisaku ao ao ekwama amatunda, timobaisa koria amatunda ’emete eyio ase engaki y’emiaka etato ye ritang’ani, korende moyebare ng’a nekanire.
swahili: “ ‘Mtakapoingia katika hiyo nchi na kupanda aina yoyote ya mti wa matunda, hesabuni matunda yake kama yaliyokatazwa. Kwa miaka mitatu mtayahesabu kwamba yamekatazwa; hayaruhusiwi kuliwa.

english: In the fourth year all its fruit must be consecrated as a praise offering to the LORD.
ekegusii: Ase omwaka o kane amatunda ’emete eyio aatananwe abe amaachenu ase ’nde inche Omonene, moyang’e ase okong’iraneria ng’a mbuya mono na gontogia.
swahili: Katika mwaka wa nne matunda yote ya mti huo yatakuwa matakatifu, sadaka ya sifa kwa Bwana.

english: But in the fifth year you may eat its fruit; thus your harvest will be increased. I am the LORD your God.
ekegusii: Korende ase omwaka o gatano inamorie amatunda ’emete eyio. Komorakore igo, emete inayame amatunda amange ase more. Inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino.
swahili: Bali katika mwaka wa tano mnaweza kula matunda ya mti huo. Kwa njia hii mavuno yenu yataongezewa. Mimi ndimi Bwana Mungu wako.

english: You must not eat anything with blood still in it. You must not practice divination or sorcery.
ekegusii: “Timobaisa koria enyama ende yonsi ebwate amanyinga ime yaye. Timobaisa gwancha oboragori, gose oborogi bonde bwonsi.
swahili: “ ‘Msile nyama yoyote yenye damu ndani yake. “ ‘Msifanye uaguzi wala uchawi.

english: You must not cut off the hair at the sides of your head or clip off the edges of your beard.
ekegusii: Timobaisa konacha chitukia chiaino, gose chinderu chiaino mesia.
swahili: “ ‘Msikate nywele za kichwa denge, wala kunyoa pembe za ndevu zenu.

english: You must not make any cuts in your bodies for the dead or put tattoo marks on yourselves. I am the LORD.
ekegusii: Timobaisa gwesaraga emebere yaino ase okoreera abakuure, gose gwesamba kobeeka ekemanyererio kende gionsi. Inche ninche Omonene.
swahili: “ ‘Msichanje chale miili yenu kwa ajili ya mfu, wala msijichore alama juu ya miili yenu. Mimi ndimi Bwana.

english: You must not defile your daughter by making her a prostitute, or the land will be prostituted and filled with depravity.
ekegusii: “Tobaisa korentera omoiseke oo obosooku ase okomoira abe omotayayi ase chie Hekalu, ense yonsi nigo erabaise gokora obotayayi na goichorwa nobonyaka.
swahili: “ ‘Usimdhalilishe binti yako kwa kumfanya kahaba, la sivyo nchi itageukia ukahaba na kujaa uovu.

english: Each of you must respect his mother and father, and you must keep My Sabbaths. I am the LORD your God.
ekegusii: Kera oyomo oino asike ng’ina na ise, naende morende Chisabato chiane. Inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino.
swahili: “ ‘Kila mmoja wenu ni lazima amheshimu mama yake na baba yake, na pia ni lazima kuzishika Sabato zangu. Mimi ndimi Bwana Mungu wenu.

english: You must keep My Sabbaths and have reverence for My sanctuary. I am the LORD.
ekegusii: Morende Chisabato chiane, naende mosike Obomenyo bwane Obochenu. Inche ninche Omonene.
swahili: “ ‘Shika Sabato zangu na kuheshimu mahali pangu patakatifu. Mimi ndimi Bwana.

english: You must not turn to mediums or spiritists; do not seek them out, or you will be defiled by them. I am the LORD your God.
ekegusii: “Timorigia ogosemigwa korwa ase abanto abakoboria amang’ana korwa ase emeika y’abanto bakwete, gose timogenda ase abaragori. Moise gokora igo, nigo moraabe abatachenegeti goetera ase bare. Inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino.
swahili: “ ‘Msiende kwa waaguzi, wala msitafute wapunga pepo, kwa maana watawanajisi. Mimi ndimi Bwana Mungu wako.

english: You are to rise in the presence of the elderly, honor the aged, and fear your God. I am the LORD.
ekegusii: “Otenene ase omonto omogotu ore ne chimbuche, ase okomosika; omoiroke Omonene oo. Inche ninche Omonene.
swahili: “ ‘Uwapo mbele ya mzee, simama ili kuonyesha heshima kwa wazee, nawe umche Mungu wako. Mimi ndimi Bwana.

english: When a foreigner resides with you in your land, you must not oppress him.
ekegusii: “Timobaisa kobakorera bobe abamenyi bamenyete ase ense yaino.
swahili: “ ‘Wakati mgeni anaishi pamoja nawe katika nchi yako, usimnyanyase.

english: You must treat the foreigner living among you as native-born and love him as yourself, for you were foreigners in the land of Egypt. I am the LORD your God.
ekegusii: Mokorere abamenyi bamenyete ase egati yaino buna mogokorera ababiare, mobanche buna mweanchete inwe abanyene, ekiagera nainwe nabo mwareenge abamenyi ase ense ya Misiri. Inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino.
swahili: Mgeni anayeishi pamoja nawe ni lazima umtendee kama mmoja wa wazawa wa nchi yako. Mpende kama unavyojipenda mwenyewe, kwa maana ulikuwa mgeni katika nchi ya Misri. Mimi ndimi Bwana Mungu wako.

english: You must not use dishonest measures of length, weight, or volume.
ekegusii: “Timokorerana oborianania ase ebirengo binde bionsi, ebi’obotaambe, gose ebi’oborito, gose ebi’obonge.
swahili: “ ‘Usitumie vipimo vya udanganyifu unapopima urefu, kupima uzito, wala kupima wingi.

english: You shall maintain honest scales and weights, an honest ephah, and an honest hin. I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt.
ekegusii: Mokorere ekerengo kia boronge; motware amagena ay’okorenga aboronge, na ebimunu bi’okorenga bia boronge, na ebituba bi’okorenga bia boronge. Inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino, nabarusetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri.
swahili: Tumia mizani halali, mawe ya kupimia uzito halali, efa halali, na hini halali. Mimi ndimi Bwana Mungu wako, ambaye alikutoa katika nchi ya Misri.

english: You must keep all My statutes and all My ordinances and follow them. I am the LORD.”
ekegusii: Mobwate amachiiko aane onsi aya nabachiikire. Inche ninche Omonene.”
swahili: “ ‘Shika amri zangu zote na sheria zangu zote, nawe uzifuate. Mimi ndimi Bwana.’ ”

english: Do not turn to idols or make for yourselves molten gods. I am the LORD your God.
ekegusii: “Timontiga na koonchokera emegwekano y’ogosasiimwa, gose timwekorera chinyasae korwa ase ebioma binyititoire na kobombwa. Inche ninche Omonene Nyasae oino.
swahili: “ ‘Msiabudu sanamu, wala msijitengenezee miungu ya shaba. Mimi ndimi Bwana Mungu wenu.

english: When you sacrifice a peace offering to the LORD, you shall offer it for your acceptance.
ekegusii: “Onye moganetie korua ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe ase ’nde inche Omonene, mobwate emeroberio yachiikirwe, erio nario ekeng’wanso ekio kerancherwe.
swahili: “ ‘Mnapotoa dhabihu ya sadaka ya amani kwa Bwana, toeni kwa namna ambayo itakubaliwa kwa niaba yenu.

english: It shall be eaten on the day you sacrifice it, or on the next day; but what remains on the third day must be burned up.
ekegusii: Chinyama chi’ekeng’wanso ekio chiriegwe ase rituko erio erio eng’iti yanyenywa, gose rituko ria kabere, korende echiratigare ase rituko ria gatato chisambwe n’omorero.
swahili: Sadaka hiyo italiwa siku iyo hiyo mnayoitoa, au kesho yake; chochote kitakachobaki hadi siku ya tatu lazima kiteketezwe kwa moto.

english: If any of it is eaten on the third day, it is tainted and will not be accepted.
ekegusii: Chiise koriegwa ase rituko ria gatato, ekeng’wanso ekio inakebe okogechia, tikegwancherwa.
swahili: Kama sehemu yoyote ya sadaka hiyo italiwa siku ya tatu, itakuwa si safi, nayo haitakubaliwa.

english: Whoever eats it will bear his iniquity, for he has profaned what is holy to the LORD. That person must be cut off from his people. Love Your Neighbor (Romans 13:8–10)
ekegusii: Monto onde bwensi orakerie ekero ekio nabarerwe obobe bwaye, ekiagera okorire egento giatananetwe ase ’nde kebe egetari egechenu. Omonto oyio naatananwe korwa ase abanto baye.
swahili: Yeyote atakayekula atawajibishwa, kwa sababu amenajisi kitu kilicho kitakatifu kwa Bwana; mtu huyo lazima akatiliwe mbali na watu wake.

english: When you reap the harvest of your land, you are not to reap to the very edges of your field or gather the gleanings of your harvest.
ekegusii: “Ekero mokogesa emegondo yaino, timogesa moikie ase chingito kegima, gose timoirana gochora ebitigari ase emegondo.
swahili: “ ‘Wakati uvunapo mavuno ya nchi yako, usivune hadi kwenye mipaka ya shamba lako, wala usikusanye mabaki ya mavuno yako.

english: Then the LORD called to Moses and spoke to him from the Tent of Meeting, saying,
ekegusii: Omonene akarangeria Musa, agakwana nere korwa ase Eema y’Omosangererekano, akamoteebia.
swahili: Bwana akamwita Mose na kusema naye kutoka kwenye Hema la Kukutania, akamwambia,

english: If, however, one’s offering is a burnt offering from the flock—from the sheep or goats—he is to present an unblemished male.
ekegusii: “Onye omonto okorua ekeng’wanso ki’ogosaambwa, korwa ase amaicho ye ching’ondi, gose chimbori, nigo araarente emingichi, gose egoree, etari na kemocho ase omobere oye.
swahili: “ ‘Kama sadaka ni ya kuteketezwa kutoka kwenye kundi la kondoo au mbuzi, atamtoa mnyama dume asiye na dosari.

english: He shall slaughter it on the north side of the altar before the LORD, and Aaron’s sons the priests are to sprinkle its blood against the altar on all sides.
ekegusii: Erio ayenyeenyere ase ensemo ya sugusu y’egesasiimero, agwo ase obosio bwane inche Omonene, na abakuani, abamura ba Aroni, basiarere amanyinga aria ase egesasiimero chinsemo chionsi.
swahili: Atamchinjia upande wa kaskazini wa madhabahu mbele za Bwana, nao wana wa Aroni walio makuhani watanyunyizia damu yake pande zote za madhabahu.

english: He is to cut the animal into pieces, and the priest shall arrange them, including the head and fat, atop the burning wood that is on the altar.
ekegusii: Naende anachane eng’iti eria ebitari, na Omokuani oria otenenerete, abichooke buya, amo nomotwe n’ebitinya, igoro ase chinko chiria chire ase omorero bw’egesasiimero,
swahili: Atamkata vipande vipande, naye kuhani atavipanga, pamoja na kichwa na mafuta ya mnyama juu ya zile kuni zinazowaka juu ya madhabahu.

english: The entrails and legs must be washed with water, and the priest shall bring all of it and burn it on the altar; it is a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, a pleasing aroma to the LORD.
ekegusii: korende chinyama chianda na ebirenge bisibigwe namaache. Erio Omokuani arue bionsi na kobisaambera ase egesasiimero. Ekio n’ekengwanso ki’ogosaambwa n’omorero, kere ne rimisu rigiya rikongwenera inche Omonene.
swahili: Ataosha sehemu za ndani na miguu kwa maji, naye kuhani atavileta vyote na kuvichoma juu ya madhabahu. Hii ni sadaka ya kuteketezwa, sadaka iliyotolewa kwa moto, harufu nzuri ya kumpendeza Bwana.

english: If, instead, one’s offering to the LORD is a burnt offering of birds, he is to present a turtledove or a young pigeon.
ekegusii: “Onye omonto okomoruera Omonene ekeng’wanso ki’ogosaambwa gekorusigwa korwa ase chinyoni, rirorio omonto oyio arente amaruma gose amage amaruma.
swahili: “ ‘Kama sadaka ya kuteketezwa inayotolewa kwa Bwana ni ndege, atamtoa hua au kinda la njiwa.

english: Then the priest shall bring it to the altar, twist off its head, and burn it on the altar; its blood should be drained out on the side of the altar.
ekegusii: Omokuani arente enyoni eyio ase egesasiimero, na amiine omotwe oye, ayobutore. Erio ayosaambe ase egesasiimero. Anyititorere amanyinga ase egesasiimero ensemo,
swahili: Kuhani atamleta kwenye madhabahu, naye atamvunja shingo na kumnyofoa kichwa na kumchoma juu ya madhabahu. Damu yake itachuruzishwa ubavuni mwa madhabahu.

english: And he is to remove the crop with its contents and throw it to the east side of the altar, in the place for ashes.
ekegusii: korende emboochero yaye, amo neubi ere imeo, abitugute ensemo ya moocha y’egesasiimero, ase ribu rigotugutwa.
swahili: Ataondoa kifuko cha chakula pamoja na uchafu wake na kuvitupa upande wa mashariki wa madhabahu, mahali pale penye majivu.

english: He shall tear it open by its wings, without dividing the bird completely. And the priest is to burn it on the altar atop the burning wood. It is a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, a pleasing aroma to the LORD.
ekegusii: Erio ataandorane egekuba, korende tarusia chimbaaba, ayesaambere ase egesasiimero, igoro ye chinko chiria chire ase omorero. Ekio n’ekengwanso ki’ogosaambwa n’omorero, kere ne rimisu rigiya rikongwenera inche Omonene.
swahili: Atampasua na kumweka wazi katika mabawa yake, lakini asimwachanishe kabisa, kisha kuhani ataichoma juu ya zile kuni zinazowaka juu ya madhabahu. Hii ni sadaka ya kuteketezwa, sadaka iliyotolewa kwa moto, harufu nzuri ya kumpendeza Bwana.

english: “Speak to the Israelites and tell them: When any of you brings an offering to the LORD, you may bring as your offering an animal from the herd or the flock.
ekegusii: “Kwana n’Abaisraeli, obateebie ng’a ekero omonto onde bwensi akorwa ase egati yabo akondeetera inche Omonene eng’iti y’ekeng’wanso, ayerusie korwa ase chiombe gose ching’ondi, gose chimbori.
swahili: “Sema na Waisraeli na uwaambie, ‘Yeyote miongoni mwenu aletapo sadaka ya mnyama kwa Bwana, alete mnyama kama sadaka yake kutoka kundi lake la ngʼombe au la kondoo na mbuzi.

english: If one’s offering is a burnt offering from the herd, he is to present an unblemished male. He must bring it to the entrance to the Tent of Meeting for its acceptance before the LORD.
ekegusii: Onye ekeng’wanso ki’ogosaambwa gekorwa ase amaicho chiombe, igo keraabe eki’eeri etari na kemocho ase omobere oye, ayerente agwo ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano, erinde inche ’mwanchere.
swahili: “ ‘Kama sadaka hiyo ni ya kuteketezwa kutoka kwenye kundi la ngʼombe, atamtoa ngʼombe dume asiye na dosari. Ni lazima amlete kwenye ingilio la Hema la Kukutania ili aweze kukubalika kwa Bwana.

english: He is to lay his hand on the head of the burnt offering, so it can be accepted on his behalf to make atonement for him.
ekegusii: Omonto oria goika abeeke okoboko kwaye igoro ase omotwe bw’eng’iti eria ekoruegwa ekeng’wanso ki’ogosaambwa, erinde yancherwe ase okobwatania omonto oria amo n’ Omonene Nyasae.
swahili: Ataweka mkono wake juu ya kichwa cha sadaka ya kuteketezwa, nayo itakubaliwa kwa niaba yake ili kufanya upatanisho kwa ajili yake.

english: And he shall slaughter the young bull before the LORD, and Aaron’s sons the priests are to present the blood and sprinkle it on all sides of the altar at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.
ekegusii: Erio omonto oria onyeenyete eeri eria ensae agwo ase obosio bwane inche Omonene, na abakuani, abamura ba Aroni, barente amanyinga bayasiarere chinsemo chionsi chi’egesasiimero kere agwo ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano.
swahili: Atamchinja yule fahali mchanga mbele za Bwana, kisha wana wa Aroni walio makuhani wataleta damu na kuinyunyiza pande zote za madhabahu yaliyo penye ingilio la Hema la Kukutania.

english: Next, he is to skin the burnt offering and cut it into pieces.
ekegusii: Naende arusie riiyo ri’eng’iti eria ekoruegwa ekeng’wanso, ayenachane ebitari,
swahili: Ataichuna hiyo sadaka ya kuteketezwa na kuikata vipande vipande.

english: The sons of Aaron the priest shall put a fire on the altar and arrange wood on the fire.
ekegusii: na abamura ba Aroni Omokuani baute omorero ase egesasiimero, bachooke chinko ase omorero oyio.
swahili: Wana wa Aroni kuhani wataweka moto juu ya madhabahu na kupanga kuni juu ya huo moto.

english: Then Aaron’s sons the priests are to arrange the pieces, including the head and the fat, atop the burning wood on the altar.
ekegusii: Naende abakuani, abamura ba Aroni, babeeke ebitari biria, amo nomotwe n’ebitinya, igoro ase chinko chiria chire ase omorero bw’egesasiimero.
swahili: Kisha wana wa Aroni walio makuhani watapanga vile vipande vya nyama, pamoja na kichwa na mafuta ya huyo mnyama juu ya zile kuni zinazowaka juu ya madhabahu.

english: The entrails and legs must be washed with water, and the priest shall burn all of it on the altar as a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, a pleasing aroma to the LORD.
ekegusii: Korende chinyama chi’enda, amo nebirenge bia magega, bisibigwe namaache. Omokuani oria otenenerete asaambe eng’iti eria yonsi ase egesasiimero, ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosaambwa n’omorero, kere ne rimisu rigiya rikongwenera inche Omonene.
swahili: Ataziosha sehemu za ndani na miguu yake kwa maji, naye kuhani atavichoma vyote juu ya madhabahu. Hii ni sadaka ya kuteketezwa, sadaka iliyotolewa kwa moto, yenye harufu nzuri ya kumpendeza Bwana.

english: Then the LORD said to Moses,
ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa.
swahili: Bwana akamwambia Mose,

english: If a man commits adultery with another man’s wife—with the wife of his neighbor—both the adulterer and the adulteress must surely be put to death.
ekegusii: “Onye omonto ogotomana n’omokuungu bw’omonto onde, abwo babere, omosacha oria amo n’omokuungu oria, goika baitwe bakwe.
swahili: “ ‘Ikiwa mtu atazini na mke wa mtu mwingine, yaani mke wa jirani yake, wazinzi hao wawili lazima wauawe.

english: If a man lies with his father’s wife, he has uncovered his father’s nakedness. Both must surely be put to death; their blood is upon them.
ekegusii: Onye omonto okoraara n’omokuungu ore moga ise, igo orenteire ise obosooku; abwo bonsi babere goika baitwe bakwe. Okomocha kw’ogoiteka kw’amanyinga abo nigo koraabe okwabo.
swahili: “ ‘Kama mtu atakutana kimwili na mke wa baba yake, hakumheshimu baba yake. Mwanaume huyo na mwanamke huyo wote wauawe; damu yao itakuwa juu ya vichwa vyao wenyewe.

english: If a man lies with his daughter-in-law, both must surely be put to death. They have acted perversely; their blood is upon them.
ekegusii: Onye omonto okoraara na moka momura oye, abwo bonsi babere goika baitwe bakwe; bakorire okogechia. Okomocha kw’ogoiteka kw’amanyinga abo nigo koraabe okwabo.
swahili: “ ‘Ikiwa mtu atakutana kimwili na mke wa mwanawe, lazima wote wawili wauawe. Walichokifanya ni upotovu; damu yao itakuwa juu ya vichwa vyao wenyewe.

english: If a man lies with a man as with a woman, they have both committed an abomination. They must surely be put to death; their blood is upon them.
ekegusii: Onye omosacha okoraara nomosaacha onde buna akoraara n’omokuungu, abwo bonsi babere bakorire okogechia okobe; goika baitwe bakwe, na okomocha kw’ogoiteka kw’amanyinga abo nigo koraabe okwabo.
swahili: “ ‘Kama mwanaume akikutana kimwili na mwanaume mwenzake kama vile mwanaume afanyavyo na mwanamke, wanaume hao wawili wamefanya lililo chukizo sana. Lazima wauawe; nayo damu yao itakuwa juu ya vichwa vyao wenyewe.

english: If a man marries both a woman and her mother, it is depraved. Both he and they must be burned in the fire, so that there will be no depravity among you.
ekegusii: Onye omonto okonyuoma omokungu aire na ng’ina biara abasang’ananie, obwo nobonyaka obobe. Omosacha oria amo nabakungu baria babere basambwe n’omorero bakwe, erinde obonyaka buna obwo tiboba ase egati yaino.
swahili: “ ‘Ikiwa mwanaume ataoa binti pamoja na mama yake, huo ni uovu. Wote watatu ni lazima wachomwe moto, ili kwamba pasiwepo na uovu katikati yenu.

english: If a man lies carnally with an animal, he must be put to death. And you are also to kill the animal.
ekegusii: Onye omonto okoraara neng’iti, omonto oyio aitwe akwe, n’eng’iti eyio eitwe ekwe.
swahili: “ ‘Kama mwanaume akikutana kimwili na mnyama, ni lazima auawe, na pia ni lazima mnyama huyo auawe.

english: If a woman approaches any animal to mate with it, you must kill both the woman and the animal. They must surely be put to death; their blood is upon them.
ekegusii: Onye omokungu ogoika eng’iti ende yonsi ang’e, na koraara nero, omokungu oyio goika aitwe akwe, n’engiti eyio eitwe ekwe. Okomocha kw’ogoiteka kw’amanyinga abo nigo koraabe okwabo.
swahili: “ ‘Kama mwanamke atamsogelea mnyama kukutana naye kimwili, muueni mwanamke huyo pamoja na mnyama pia. Lazima wauawe; damu yao itakuwa juu ya vichwa vyao wenyewe.

english: If a man marries his sister, whether the daughter of his father or of his mother, and they have sexual relations, it is a disgrace. They must be cut off in the sight of their people. He has uncovered the nakedness of his sister; he shall bear his iniquity.
ekegusii: “Onye omonto okoira omoiseke omwabo, oyo o ise gose o ng’ina, nabwo barorane bare getirianda, obwo nobosooku obonene. Barabwo goika baatananwe barusigwe ase amasio y’abanto b’egesaku kiabo. Omonto oyio orenteire omoiseke omwabo obosooku. Obobe bw’ogosaria okwo nigo boraabe igoro y’omonto oyio.
swahili: “ ‘Ikiwa mtu anamwoa dada yake, binti aliyezaliwa na baba yake au mama yake, nao wakakutana kimwili, ni aibu. Lazima wakatiliwe mbali machoni pa watu wao. Huyo mwanaume amemwaibisha dada yake, hivyo atawajibika kwa ajili ya uovu huo.

english: If a man lies with a menstruating woman and has sexual relations with her, he has exposed the source of her flow, and she has uncovered the source of her blood. Both of them must be cut off from among their people.
ekegusii: Onye omonto omosacha okoraara n’omokuungu ekero abwate omotienyi, omonto oyio orenteire omokungu oyio obosooku ase okorora ensoko y’amanyinga aye, nere oorokirie ase amanyinga agoiteka korwa; abwo babere baatananwe korwa ase abanto b’egesaku kiabo.
swahili: “ ‘Ikiwa mwanaume atalala na mwanamke aliye katika hedhi yake na kukutana naye kimwili, amefunua mtiririko wa hedhi yake, naye huyo mwanamke amejifunua uchi wake. Wote wawili lazima wakatiliwe mbali na watu wao.

english: You must not have sexual relations with the sister of your mother or your father, for it is exposing one’s own kin; both shall bear their iniquity.
ekegusii: “Tobaisa koraara nomoiseke omwabo nyoko, gose omoiseke omwabo iso; obwo nobonyaka obobe, ekiagera abwo nabanyako moke. Obobe bw’ogosaria okwo nigo boraabe igoro yabo.
swahili: “ ‘Usikutane kimwili na dada wa mama yako wala wa baba yako, kwa maana hilo litamwaibisha jamaa wa karibu; ninyi wawili mtawajibika kwa ajili ya uovu huo.

english: “Tell the Israelites, ‘Any Israelite or foreigner living in Israel who gives any of his children to Molech must be put to death. The people of the land are to stone him.
ekegusii: “Kwana n’Abaisraeli, obateebie: Monto onde bwensi oino, gose omomenyi omenyete ase egati yaino, orarue omwana onde oye ase enyasae Moleki, goika aitwe akwe. Omoganda oino bwonsi omoake amagena.
swahili: “Sema na wana wa Israeli: ‘Mwisraeli yeyote au mgeni anayeishi katika Israeli ambaye atamtoa yeyote miongoni mwa watoto wake kuwa sadaka kwa mungu Moleki, mtu huyo lazima auawe. Watu wa jumuiya hiyo watampiga kwa mawe.

english: If a man lies with his uncle’s wife, he has uncovered the nakedness of his uncle. They will bear their sin; they shall die childless.
ekegusii: Onye omonto okoraara na moga ise moke, omwabo ise, igo orenteire ise moke obosooku. Egesusuro ki’ogosaria kw’ebibe biabo nigo keraabe ekiabo, na barabwo nigo barakwe bataiboreti bana.
swahili: “ ‘Ikiwa mwanaume atakutana kimwili na shangazi yake, amemwaibisha mjomba wake. Nao watawajibika kwa ajili ya uovu huo; watakufa bila kuzaa mtoto.

english: If a man marries his brother’s wife, it is an act of impurity. He has uncovered the nakedness of his brother; they shall be childless. Distinguish between Clean and Unclean
ekegusii: Onye omonto okoira moka momura omwabo, okwo nogosaria, ere orenteire momura omwabo obosooku. Barabwo nigo baragombae.
swahili: “ ‘Ikiwa mwanaume ataoa mke wa ndugu yake, hili ni tendo chafu; amemwaibisha ndugu yake. Nao hawatazaa mtoto.

english: You are therefore to keep all My statutes and ordinances, so that the land where I am bringing you to live will not vomit you out.
ekegusii: “Ase ayio mobwate amachiiko aane na emeroberio yonsi nabachiikire, na moyakore, erio ense eria ase nkobaira mogochia komenya tebaanga gose tebaseria korwa aroro.
swahili: “ ‘Zishikeni amri na sheria zangu zote na kuzifuata, ili nchi ninayowaleta kuishi isiwatapike.

english: You must not follow the statutes of the nations I am driving out before you. Because they did all these things, I abhorred them.
ekegusii: Timochia kobwatia chingencho chi’abaanto b’egesaku keria ngochia goseria kerue ase amasio aino; barabwo nigo bakorete amang’ana ayio onsi, na ase engencho y’ayio nkagechigwa nabarabwo.
swahili: Kamwe msiishi kwa kufuata desturi za mataifa nitakayoyafukuza mbele yenu. Kwa sababu walifanya mambo haya yote, nami nikachukizwa sana nao.

english: But I have told you that you will inherit their land, since I will give it to you as an inheritance—a land flowing with milk and honey. I am the LORD your God, who has set you apart from the peoples.
ekegusii: Korende inabarierete inwe eira ng’a nimbae ense yabo ebe omwando oino, ense entenenku ere namabeere na amooke. Inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino, nabaatananire inwe korwa ase ebisaku binde.
swahili: Lakini niliwaambia ninyi, “Mtaimiliki nchi yao; nitawapa ninyi kuwa urithi, nchi inayotiririka maziwa na asali.” Mimi ndimi Bwana Mungu wenu, ambaye amewatenga kutoka mataifa.

english: You are therefore to distinguish between clean and unclean animals and birds. Do not become contaminated by any animal or bird, or by anything that crawls on the ground; I have set these apart as unclean for you.
ekegusii: Inwe goika momanye gwaatanana ching’iti chichenegete korwa ase echitachenegeti, ne chinyoni chichenegete korwa ase echitachenegeti. Timobaisa gwesoyia ase ogotacheneka ase okoria ching’iti gose chinyoni chitachenegeti, gose timoria ching’iti chinde chionsi chikwagura ase ense, echi naatananire chibe chitachenegeti ase more.
swahili: “ ‘Kwa hiyo, ninyi lazima mweze kutofautisha kati ya wanyama walio safi na wasio safi, pia kati ya ndege wasio safi na walio safi. Msijitie unajisi kutokana na mnyama yeyote, au ndege, wala kitu chochote kitambaacho juu ya ardhi, vile ambavyo nimevitenga kuwa najisi kwa ajili yenu.

english: You are to be holy to Me because I, the LORD, am holy, and I have set you apart from the nations to be My own.
ekegusii: Inwe mobe abachenu baane, ekiagera inche Omonene nigo inde omochenu, nabaatananire korwa ase ebisaku binde, erinde mobe abaane.
swahili: Mtakuwa watakatifu kwangu, kwa sababu Mimi, Bwana, ni mtakatifu, nami nimewatenga kutoka mataifa kuwa wangu mwenyewe.

english: A man or a woman who is a medium or spiritist must surely be put to death. They shall be stoned; their blood is upon them.’”
ekegusii: “Omosacha, gose omokungu, orarigie ogosemigwa korwa ase emeika y’abanto bakwete, gose oyore omoorogi, goika aitwe akwe. Abanto abwo baakwe amagena bakwe; okomocha kw’ogoiteka kw’amanyinga abo nakobe okwabo.”
swahili: “ ‘Mwanaume au mwanamke ambaye ni mchawi, mwaguzi au mwenye kupunga pepo miongoni mwenu lazima auawe. Mtawapiga kwa mawe; nayo damu yao itakuwa juu ya vichwa vyao wenyewe.’ ”

english: And I will set My face against that man and cut him off from his people, because by giving his offspring to Molech, he has defiled My sanctuary and profaned My holy name.
ekegusii: Inche omonyene nimbe nendamwamu ase omonto oyio, ekiagera orure omwana onde oye ase enyasae Moleki. Nimwatanane korwa ase abanto baye, ekiagera ogerire Obomenyo bwane Obochenu bobe obotachenegeti, na orenteire erieta riane richenu obosooku.
swahili: Mimi nitauelekeza uso wangu dhidi ya mtu huyo, nami nitamkatilia mbali na watu wake. Kwa maana kwa kumtoa mmoja wa watoto wake kwa mungu Moleki, amenajisi madhabahu yangu na kulinajisi Jina langu takatifu.

english: And if the people of the land ever hide their eyes and fail to put to death the man who gives one of his children to Molech,
ekegusii: Onye abanto b’ense yaino bakoombia, tibaita omonto oyio orure oyomo bw’abana baye ase enyasae Moleki,
swahili: Ikiwa watu wa jumuiya watafumba macho wakati mtu huyo anapomtoa mmoja wa watoto wake kwa mungu Moleki, nao wakaacha kumuua,

english: then I will set My face against that man and his family and cut off from among their people both him and all who follow him in prostituting themselves with Molech.
ekegusii: erio inche omonyene nimbe nendamwamu ase omonto oyio na eamate yaye. Nimwatanane amo nabaanto bonsi bamobwatirie, ekiagera bakoonchokera enyasae eria Moleki, ase okoyesasiima, bakaba abatari abegenwa ase ’nde; nimbasirie korwa ase abanto baye.”
swahili: mimi nitauelekeza uso wangu dhidi ya mtu huyo pamoja na jamaa yake, nami nitawakatilia mbali yeye na watu wote waliofanya ukahaba na Moleki.

english: Whoever turns to mediums or spiritists to prostitute himself with them, I will also set My face against that person and cut him off from his people.
ekegusii: “Onye omonto okorigia ogosemigwa korwa ase abanto bakoboria amang’ana korwa ase emeika y’abanto bakwete, gose kogenda ase abarogi, taba omwegenwa ase ’nde, korende abe ogosasiima emeika eyio, inche nimbe nendamwamu ase omonto oyio, na imwatanane korwa ase abanto baye.
swahili: “ ‘Mimi nitauelekeza uso wangu dhidi ya mtu anayeenda kwa waaguzi na wenye pepo, na hivyo kujifanyia ukahaba kwa kuwafuata, nami nitamkatilia mbali na watu wake.

english: Consecrate yourselves, therefore, and be holy, because I am the LORD your God.
ekegusii: Eatanane, mwerue mobe abachenu, ekiagera inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino.
swahili: “ ‘Jitakaseni basi, nanyi kuweni watakatifu, kwa sababu mimi ndimi Bwana Mungu wenu.

english: And you shall keep My statutes and practice them. I am the LORD who sanctifies you.
ekegusii: Mobwate amachiiko aane na koyakora; inche ninche Omonene, nkobachena.
swahili: Shikeni amri zangu na kuzifuata. Mimi ndimi Bwana, niwafanyaye ninyi watakatifu.

english: If anyone curses his father or mother, he must be put to death. He has cursed his father or mother; his blood shall be upon him. Punishments for Sexual Immorality (Proverbs 5:1–23; 1 Corinthians 5:1–8)
ekegusii: “Kera omonto okoragereria ise gose ng’ina, oyio goika akwe. Ekiagera oragereirie ise na ng’ina, okomocha kw’ogoiteka kw’amanyinga aye nigo koraabe okwaye.
swahili: “ ‘Ikiwa mtu yeyote atamlaani baba yake au mama yake, lazima auawe. Amemlaani baba yake au mama yake, nayo damu yake itakuwa juu ya kichwa chake mwenyewe.

english: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Speak to Aaron’s sons, the priests, and tell them that a priest is not to defile himself for a dead person among his people,
ekegusii: Omonene agakwana na Musa, akamoteebia, “Kwana nabakuani, abamura ba Aroni, obateebie ng’a Omokuani tabaisa gwesoyia ase ogotacheneka ase ogokuna egetondo ki’omonto okuure ase egati y’abanto baye.
swahili: Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Sema na makuhani, wana wa Aroni, uwaambie: ‘Kamwe kuhani asijitie unajisi kwa utaratibu wa kiibada kwa ajili ya mtu wake yeyote anayekufa,

english: The priest who is highest among his brothers, who has had the anointing oil poured on his head and has been ordained to wear the priestly garments, must not let his hair hang loose or tear his garments.
ekegusii: “Oyore Omokuani omonene ase abamwabo, oyio onyororokeretigwe amaguta akweakwa ase omotwe oye, naende bwatananirwe ase okobeeka chianga chi’obokuani, ere tatiga etukia yaye esang’ang’are, gose tatandora chianga chiaye ase okoreera omonto okuure.
swahili: “ ‘Kuhani mkuu, yule miongoni mwa ndugu zake ambaye amekwisha kutiwa mafuta kwa kumiminiwa juu ya kichwa chake, na ambaye amewekwa wakfu kuvaa mavazi ya ukuhani, kamwe asiache nywele zake bila kufunikwa, wala asirarue nguo zake.

english: He must not go near any dead body; he must not defile himself, even for his father or mother.
ekegusii: Tabaisa gosoa enyomba ase abanto babekire omobere bw’omonto okuure gose gwesoyia ase ogotacheneka, naba ise gose ng’ina.
swahili: Kamwe asiingie mahali palipo maiti ndani. Kamwe asijitie unajisi, hata kwa ajili ya baba yake au mama yake,

english: He must not leave or desecrate the sanctuary of his God, for the consecration of the anointing oil of his God is on him. I am the LORD.
ekegusii: Tasoka korwa ase Obomenyo Obochenu, gose gokora Obomenyo obo Obochenu bwa Nyasae oye bobe obotachenegeti, ekiagera amaguta aagetwe nigo amwatananete ere agenderere koba oyone, inche Nyasae oye. Inche ninche Omonene.
swahili: wala asiondoke mahali patakatifu pa Mungu wake au kupanajisi, kwa sababu amewekwa wakfu kwa mafuta ya Mungu wake. Mimi ndimi Bwana.

english: The woman he marries must be a virgin.
ekegusii: Ere anyuome omoiseke ore omwekuungi.
swahili: “ ‘Mwanamke kuhani atakayemwoa lazima awe bikira.

english: He is not to marry a widow, a divorced woman, or one defiled by prostitution. He is to marry a virgin from his own people,
ekegusii: Tabaisa konyuoma omokungu omoboraka, gose oyobatiganire nomosaacha oye, gose oyotari omwekuungi, gose ore omotayayi, korende anyuome omoiseke omwekuungi korwa ase abanto b’egesaku kiaye.
swahili: Kamwe asimwoe mjane, au mwanamke aliyepewa talaka, wala mwanamke aliyejinajisi kwa ukahaba, bali atamwoa tu bikira kutoka miongoni mwa watu wake,

english: so that he does not defile his offspring among his people, for I am the LORD who sanctifies him.” Restrictions against Those with Blemishes
ekegusii: Erio nario abana baye barabe abachenu, tibasareka ase egati y’abanto baye, ekiagera inche ninche Omonene, ninche nkobachena.”
swahili: na hivyo hatawatia unajisi watoto wake miongoni mwa watu wake. Mimi ndimi Bwana, nimfanyaye mtakatifu.’ ”

english: Then the LORD said to Moses,
ekegusii: Omonene agakwana na Musa naende, akamoteebia,
swahili: Bwana akamwambia Mose,

english: “Say to Aaron, ‘For the generations to come, none of your descendants who has a physical defect may approach to offer the food of his God.
ekegusii: “Kwana na Aroni, omoteebie ng’a onde bwensi ore ekerema tabaisa goika ang’e kondeetera inche, Nyasae oye, okoruegwa kw’endagera. Okwo nogochika koragenderere botaambe ase ororeeria rwaye ebiaare ase ebiaare.
swahili: “Mwambie Aroni: ‘Kwa vizazi vijavyo, hakuna mzao wako mwenye dosari atakayekaribia kutoa chakula cha Mungu wake.

english: No man who has any defect may approach—no man who is blind, lame, disfigured, or deformed;
ekegusii: Omonto ore na kemocho ase omobere oye tabaisa goika ang’e, onye ore omouko, gose rigata, gose ore na kemocho ase obosio bwaye, gose ore nekiimo ekemo egetambe goetania ekende,
swahili: Hakuna mtu mwenye dosari yoyote awezaye kukaribia: hakuna mtu aliye kipofu au kiwete, au aliyeharibika uso au asiye na viungo kamili,

english: no man who has a broken foot or hand,
ekegusii: gose omonto ore na kemocho ase okoboko gose ase okogoro,
swahili: hakuna mtu mwenye mguu au mkono uliolemaa,

english: except for his immediate family—his mother, father, son, daughter, or brother,
ekegusii: Nare ne ribaga gwesoyia ase ogotacheneka ase abanto aba: Ng’ina na ise, na omwana oye, omomura gose omoiseke, na momura omwabo;
swahili: isipokuwa jamaa wake wa karibu, kama vile mama yake au baba yake, mwanawe au binti yake, ndugu yake,

english: or who is a hunchback or dwarf, or who has an eye defect, a festering rash, scabs, or a crushed testicle.
ekegusii: gose omonto ore nesukubi ase omogongo oye, gose ore oboengere, gose oyore na kemocho ase eriso, gose oyo obosisa boriete, gose oborwaire bonde ase risankwa, gose omosacha chingetia chiaye chisaregete.
swahili: au mwenye kibiongo au aliyedumaa, au aliye na tatizo la macho, au aliye na uvimbe wenye usaha au majipu, au aliyehasiwa.

english: No descendant of Aaron the priest who has a defect shall approach to present the offerings made by fire to the LORD. Since he has a defect, he is not to come near to offer the food of his God.
ekegusii: Omonto onde bwensi ase ororeeria rwa Aroni Omokuani ore na kemocho ase omobere oye tabaisa goika ang’e kondeetera inche Omonene okoruegwa kw’endagera kogosaambwa n’omorero, ekiagera oyio ore na kemocho ase omobere oye tagoika ang’e andeetere inche, Nyasae oye, okoruegwa kw’endagera kogosaambwa n’omorero.
swahili: Hakuna mzao wa kuhani Aroni mwenye kilema chochote atakayekaribia kutoa sadaka kwa Bwana ya kuteketezwa kwa moto. Kama ana kilema, kamwe asikaribie kutoa chakula cha Mungu wake.

english: He may eat the most holy food of his God as well as the holy food,
ekegusii: Ere nabe ne ribaga ri’okoria okoruegwa kw’endagera gokoruegwa ase ’nde inche Nyasae oye, okoruegwa okore ogochenu, amo nokore ogochenu mono.
swahili: Anaweza kula chakula kitakatifu sana cha Mungu wake, pia hata chakula kitakatifu.

english: but because he has a defect, he must not go near the veil or approach the altar, so as not to desecrate My sanctuaries. For I am the LORD who sanctifies them.’”
ekegusii: Korende ekiagera are na kemocho ase omobere oye, tagoika ang’e netoto enachete Obomenyo Obochenu, gose tagocha aike ang’e negesasiimero. Aise goika ang’e, nigo aragere Obomenyo bwane Obochenu bobe botachenegeti. Inche ninche Omonene, ninche nkobachena.”
swahili: Lakini kwa sababu ya kilema chake, kamwe asikaribie karibu na pazia wala kukaribia madhabahu, asije akanajisi mahali patakatifu pangu. Mimi ndimi Bwana, niwafanyaye watakatifu.’ ”

english: Moses told this to Aaron and his sons and to all the Israelites.
ekegusii: Amang’ana ayio naro Musa atebeetie Aroni, amo nabamura ba Aroni, na Abaisraeli bonsi.
swahili: Basi Mose akamwambia Aroni jambo hili na wanawe, pamoja na Waisraeli wote.

english: or his unmarried sister who is near to him, since she has no husband.
ekegusii: boigo na omoiseke omwabo ore omwekuungi, oyo otaraba nomosaacha; asare nigo are ne ribaga gwesoyia ase ogotacheneka.
swahili: au dada yake asiyeolewa ambaye anamtegemea kwa kuwa hana mume, kwa ajili ya hao aweza kujitia unajisi.

english: He is not to defile himself for those related to him by marriage, and so profane himself.
ekegusii: Ekiagera Omokuani are omotang’ani ase abanto baye, tabaisa gwesoyia ase ogotacheneka.
swahili: Kamwe asijitie unajisi mwenyewe kutokana na wale watu ambao anahusiana nao kwa kuoana, na hivyo kujitia unajisi.

english: Priests must not make bald spots on their heads, shave off the edges of their beards, or make cuts in their bodies.
ekegusii: “Omokuani tabaisa kogingira ensemo ende y’etukia y’omotwe oye, gose konacha chinderu chiaye mesia, gose gwesaraga omobere.
swahili: “ ‘Kamwe makuhani wasinyoe nywele za vichwa vyao wala wasinyoe pembeni mwa ndevu zao, au kuweka chale kwenye miili yao.

english: They must be holy to their God and not profane the name of their God. Because they present to the LORD the offerings made by fire, the food of their God, they must be holy.
ekegusii: Abakuani mbabe abachenu ase ’nde inche Omonene obo, na tibarentera erieta riane obosooku, ekiagera nabwo bakorua okoruegwa kw’endagera kogosaambwa n’omorero ase ’nde inche Omonene. Ase ayio goika babe abachenu.
swahili: Lazima wawe watakatifu kwa Mungu wao, na kamwe wasilinajisi jina la Mungu wao. Kwa sababu ndio wanaotoa sadaka za kuteketezwa kwa moto kwa Bwana, chakula cha Mungu wao, hivyo lazima wawe watakatifu.

english: A priest must not marry a woman defiled by prostitution or divorced by her husband, for the priest is holy to his God.
ekegusii: Omokuani tabaisa konyuoma omokungu omotayayi, gose oyotari omwekuungi, gose oyobatiganire nomosaacha oye, ekiagera Omokuani nigo achenegete ase Omonene oye.
swahili: “ ‘Kamwe wasioe wanawake waliojinajisi kwa ukahaba, au waliopewa talaka na waume wao, kwa sababu makuhani ni watakatifu kwa Mungu wao.

english: You are to regard him as holy, since he presents the food of your God. He shall be holy to you, because I the LORD am holy—I who set you apart.
ekegusii: Goika omobare ng’a nomochenu, ekiagera nere okorua okoruegwa kw’endagera ase ’nde inche Omonene oo; nabe omochenu ase ore, ekiagera inche Omonene nomochenu inde, ninche nkobachena.
swahili: Waoneni kuwa watakatifu, kwa sababu ndio wanaotoa chakula cha Mungu wenu. Kumbukeni kuwa ni watakatifu, kwa sababu Mimi Bwana ni mtakatifu, Mimi niwafanyaye ninyi kuwa watakatifu.

english: If a priest’s daughter defiles herself by prostituting herself, she profanes her father; she must be burned in the fire.
ekegusii: Onye omwana omoiseke bw’Omokuani ogwesaria ase okoba omotayayi, igo orenteire ise obosooku; omoiseke oyio goika asambwe n’omorero akwe.
swahili: “ ‘Ikiwa binti wa kuhani anajitia unajisi kwa kufanya ukahaba, anamwaibisha baba yake; lazima achomwe kwa moto.

english: No one outside a priest’s family may eat the sacred offering, nor may the guest of a priest or his hired hand eat it.
ekegusii: “Omonto otari bw’eamate y’Omokuani tabaisa koria ebinto ebichenu. Omomenyi omenyete amo n’Omokuani, gose omonto orikire komokorera emeremo, abwo tibaabaisa koria ebinto ebichenu.
swahili: “ ‘Hakuna mtu yeyote asiye wa jamaa ya kuhani anayeruhusiwa kula sadaka takatifu, hata mgeni wa kuhani au mfanyakazi wake haruhusiwi kuila.

english: But if a priest buys a slave with his own money, or if a slave is born in his household, that slave may eat his food.
ekegusii: Omosomba onde bwensi Omokuani agorete ne chitaabu chiaye omonyene, gose omosomba oiboreire ase enka yaye, abwo nabarie endagera eria Omokuani akoegwa.
swahili: Lakini ikiwa kuhani amenunua mtumwa kwa fedha, au mtumwa amezaliwa katika nyumba ya kuhani huyo, mtumwa huyo aweza kula chakula cha huyo kuhani.

english: If the priest’s daughter is married to a man other than a priest, she is not to eat of the sacred contributions.
ekegusii: Omoiseke bw’Omokuani karanyuomwe nomonto otari Omokuani tabaisa koria ebinto ebichenu bikoruegwa bibe ebing’wanso.
swahili: Ikiwa binti wa kuhani ameolewa na mtu asiye kuhani, binti huyo haruhusiwi kula chochote cha matoleo matakatifu.

english: But if a priest’s daughter with no children becomes widowed or divorced and returns to her father’s house, she may share her father’s food as in her youth. But no outsider may share it.
ekegusii: Korende omosubati bw’Omokuani osogete otigirwe ore omoboraka, gose batiganire nomosaacha oye, na tabwati omwana, na bono oiranire gocha o ise komenyao buna ekero areenge omoke, nanyare koria endagera eria ya ise. Korende omonto otari bw’eamate y’Omokuani tabaisa koria endagera eria.
swahili: Lakini ikiwa binti wa kuhani amekuwa mjane au amepewa talaka, naye hana watoto, na akarudi kuishi na jamaa ya baba yake kama wakati wa usichana wake, binti huyo anaweza kula chakula cha baba yake. Hata hivyo, mtu asiyeruhusiwa hawezi kula chochote katika chakula hiki.

english: If anyone eats a sacred offering in error, he must add a fifth to its value and give the sacred offering to the priest.
ekegusii: “Omonto onde bwensi otari bw’eamate y’Omokuani oraarie ebinto biria ebichenu ase ogotamanya, goika airanie egento egechenu ase Omokuani, buna keria airete, na ameente ensemo ya isano ye rigori ri’egento ekio.
swahili: “ ‘Ikiwa mtu yeyote amekula sadaka takatifu kwa makosa, lazima atoe malipo ya sadaka hiyo kwa kuhani na kuongeza sehemu ya tano ya thamani ya sadaka hiyo.

english: The priests must not profane the sacred offerings that the Israelites present to the LORD
ekegusii: Abakuani tibaabaisa gokora ebinto ebi ebichenu Abaisraeli bagwaatanana na kobirua ase Omonene bibe ebitachenegeti,
swahili: Kamwe makuhani wasiinajisi sadaka takatifu ambayo Waisraeli wameitoa kwa Bwana

english: by allowing the people to eat the sacred offerings and thus to bear the punishment for guilt. For I am the LORD who sanctifies them.” Worthy Offerings
ekegusii: na igo bakogera abanto babogorie ebibe biabo, na okomocha kwabo, ase okoria ebinto ebichenu baruete. Inche ninche Omonene, ninche nkobachena.”
swahili: kwa kuwaruhusu kuzila sadaka hizo takatifu, na hivyo kuwaletea hatia ya kudaiwa malipo. Mimi ndimi Bwana niwafanyaye watakatifu.’ ” Dhabihu Zisizokubalika

english: “Speak to Aaron and his sons and all the Israelites and tell them, ‘Any man of the house of Israel or any foreign resident who presents a gift for a burnt offering to the LORD, whether to fulfill a vow or as a freewill offering,
ekegusii: “Teebia Aroni na abamura baye, na Abaisraeli bonsi, ng’a ekero omonto onde bwensi bw’Abaisraeli, gose omomenyi omenyete ase egati yabo, aganetie konduera inche Omonene ekeng’wanso ki’ogosaambwa, keraabe nase engencho y’eira, gose neki’ogwancha kwaye,
swahili: “Sema na Aroni na wanawe, na Waisraeli wote uwaambie: ‘Ikiwa mmoja wenu, aliye Mwisraeli au mgeni anayeishi katika nchi ya Israeli, atatoa matoleo kwa ajili ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa kwa moto kwa Bwana, iwe kutimiza nadhiri au kuwa sadaka ya hiari,

english: must offer an unblemished male from the cattle, sheep, or goats in order for it to be accepted on your behalf.
ekegusii: goika arue eeri, gose egoree, gose emingichi, chitari na kemocho ase emebere yabo, erio nario ekeng’wanso kerancherwe.
swahili: lazima mtoe mnyama dume asiye na dosari, akiwa ngʼombe, mbuzi au kondoo, ili aweze kukubalika kwa niaba yako.

english: “Tell Aaron and his sons to treat with respect the sacred offerings that the Israelites have consecrated to Me, so that they do not profane My holy name. I am the LORD.
ekegusii: “Kwana na Aroni na abamura baye, obateebie ng’a barende na bakore amasikani ase ebinto ebichenu, biria Abaisraeli bagwaatanana ase ’nde, erio tibaabaisa korenta obosooku ase erieta riane richenu. Inche ninche Omonene.
