ekegusii: Enyama eyio keraakune gento kende gionsi getachenegeti esambwe n’omorero, eyie eere. “Onye enyama echenegete, kera omonto ochenekire nare ne ribaga ri’okoyeria,
swahili: “ ‘Nyama ile inayogusa chochote ambacho ni najisi kwa kawaida ya ibada kamwe haitaliwa, ni lazima iteketezwe kwa moto. Kuhusu nyama nyingine, mtu yeyote aliye safi kwa kawaida ya ibada anaweza kuila.

english: The guilt offering must be slaughtered in the place where the burnt offering is slaughtered, and the priest shall sprinkle its blood on all sides of the altar.
ekegusii: Aase agwo eng’iti y’ekeng’wanso ki’ogosaambwa ekonyeenyerwa nao eng’iti y’ekeng’wanso gi’okorongeyia okomocha eranyenyerwe. Amanyinga aye asiarerwe ase egesasiimero chinsemo chionsi.
swahili: Sadaka ya hatia itachinjiwa mahali pale ambapo sadaka ya kuteketezwa huchinjiwa, nayo damu yake itanyunyizwa pande zote za madhabahu.

english: But if anyone who is unclean eats meat from the peace offering that belongs to the LORD, that person must be cut off from his people.
ekegusii: korende oyotachenegeti takoria enyama y’ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe gekoruegwa ase Omonene. Aise gokora igo, nigo araatananwe korwa ase abanto baye.
swahili: Lakini kama mtu yeyote najisi akila nyama yoyote ya sadaka ya amani iliyotolewa kwa Bwana, huyo mtu lazima akatiliwe mbali na watu wake.

english: If one touches anything unclean, whether human uncleanness, an unclean animal, or any unclean, detestable thing, and then eats any of the meat of the peace offering that belongs to the LORD, that person must be cut off from his people.” Fat and Blood Forbidden
ekegusii: “Naende omonto karakune egento getachenegeti, gokeraabe egetachenegeti kere ase omonto, gose ase eng’iti, gose okogechia konde gwonsi, na arie enyama y’ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe gekoruegwa ase Omonene, omonto oyio nigo araatananwe korwa ase abanto baye.”
swahili: Kama mtu yeyote akigusa kitu kilicho najisi, iwe ni uchafu wa mwanadamu, au mnyama najisi, au kitu chochote kilicho najisi, kitu cha kuchukiza, kisha akala nyama yoyote ya sadaka ya amani iliyotolewa kwa Bwana, mtu huyo ni lazima akatiliwe mbali na watu wake.’ ” Kula Mafuta Na Kunywa Damu Kwakatazwa

english: “Speak to the Israelites and say, ‘You are not to eat any of the fat of an ox, a sheep, or a goat.
ekegusii: “Kwana n’Abaisraeli, obateebie ng’a tibaabaisa koria ebitinya binde bionsi, ebi’eng’ombe, gose ebi’eng’ondi, gose ebi’embori.
swahili: “Waambie Waisraeli: ‘Msile mafuta yoyote ya ngʼombe, kondoo wala mbuzi.

english: The fat of an animal found dead or mauled by wild beasts may be used for any other purpose, but you must not eat it.
ekegusii: Ebitinya bi’eng’iti egokwa yoka enyene, na ebi’eng’iti egoitwa neyende, ebio nabikorerwe emeremo emeao, korende tibikoriegwa nonya ng’ake.
swahili: Mafuta ya mnyama aliyekutwa amekufa au ameraruliwa na mnyama pori yanaweza kutumika kwa kazi nyingine yoyote, lakini kamwe msiyale.

english: If anyone eats the fat of an animal from which an offering made by fire may be presented to the LORD, the one who eats it must be cut off from his people.
ekegusii: Monto onde bwensi oraarie ebitinya bi’eng’iti yarurwe ekeng’wanso kegosaambwa n’omorero ase ’nde inche Omonene, oyio nigo eraatananwe korwa ase abanto baye.
swahili: Mtu yeyote alaye mafuta ya mnyama ambaye ametolewa sadaka kwa Bwana kwa moto ni lazima akatiliwe mbali na watu wake.

english: You must not eat the blood of any bird or animal in any of your dwellings.
ekegusii: Naende timoria amanyinga e chinyoni, gose aye ching’iti aande onsi ase moramenye.
swahili: Popote mtakapoishi, kamwe msinywe damu ya ndege yeyote wala ya mnyama.

english: If anyone eats blood, that person must be cut off from his people.’” The Priests’ Portion
ekegusii: Monto onde bwensi oraarie amanyinga ande onsi, oyio nigo araatananwe korwa ase abanto baye.”
swahili: Ikiwa mtu yeyote atakunywa damu, mtu huyo lazima akatiliwe mbali na watu wake.’ ” Fungu La Makuhani

english: Then the LORD said to Moses,
ekegusii: Naende Omonene agateebia Musa,
swahili: Bwana akamwambia Mose,

english: “Speak to the Israelites and say, ‘Anyone who presents a peace offering to the LORD must bring it as his sacrifice to the LORD.
ekegusii: “Kwana n’Abaisraeli, obateebie ng’a omonto onde bwensi orarue ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe, arue korwa ase ekeng’wanso ekio gentungetie inche Omonene.
swahili: “Waambie Waisraeli: ‘Mtu yeyote aletaye sadaka ya amani kwa Bwana ataleta sehemu ya sadaka hiyo kama dhabihu yake kwa Bwana.

english: And all the fat from it shall be offered: the fat tail, the fat that covers the entrails,
ekegusii: Ebitinya biaye bionsi birusigwe na koruegwa; omokera n’ebitinya bitubete chinyama chi’enda,
swahili: Mafuta yake yote yatatolewa sadaka: mafuta ya mkia na mafuta yale yanayofunika sehemu za ndani,

english: With his own hands he is to bring the offerings made by fire to the LORD; he shall bring the fat, together with the breast, and wave the breast as a wave offering before the LORD.
ekegusii: Arente namaboko aye omonyene ekeng’wanso kiaye kegosaambwa n’omorero ase ’nde inche Omonene; arente ebitinya amo ne ritaana, ne ritaana erio risungusigwe ribe ekeng’wanso kegosungusigwa ase obosio bwane inche Omonene.
swahili: Ataleta sadaka kwa mikono yake mwenyewe iliyotolewa kwa Bwana kwa moto; ataleta mafuta ya huyo mnyama pamoja na kidari, naye atainua hicho kidari mbele za Bwana kuwa sadaka ya kuinuliwa.

english: The priest is to burn the fat on the altar, but the breast belongs to Aaron and his sons.
ekegusii: Omokuani asaambere ebitinya ase egesasiimero, korende ritaana ribe eria Aroni na abamura baye.
swahili: Kuhani atayateketeza hayo mafuta juu ya madhabahu, lakini kidari kitakuwa cha Aroni na wanawe.

english: And you are to give the right thigh to the priest as a contribution from your peace offering.
ekegusii: Ekenama kia borio okee Omokuani buna ekeegwa korwa ase ebing’wanso biaino bi’omorembe.
swahili: Paja la kulia la sadaka zako za amani utampa kuhani kama matoleo.

english: The son of Aaron who presents the blood and fat of the peace offering shall have the right thigh as a portion.
ekegusii: Omokuani, omomura o Aroni, oyio oraabe okorua amanyinga ’ekeng’wanso ekio ki’omorembe amo nebitinya, nere oraire ekenama keria kia borio kebe egetari kiaye.
swahili: Mwana wa Aroni atoaye damu na mafuta ya sadaka ya amani ndiye atakayepewa paja hilo la kulia kuwa fungu lake.

english: I have taken from the sons of Israel the breast of the wave offering and the thigh of the contribution of their peace offerings, and I have given them to Aaron the priest and his sons as a permanent portion from the sons of Israel.’”
ekegusii: Korwa ase ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe gekoruegwa n’Abaisraeli narusirie ritaana rigosungusigwa amo nekenama kia borio, nabieire Aroni Omokuani na abamura baye. Ebio nabio Abaisraeli barabe bakoa abakuani, bibe ebitari biabo botaambe.
swahili: Kutoka kwenye sadaka za amani za Waisraeli, mimi Mungu nimepokea kidari kile kilichoinuliwa pamoja na lile paja lililotolewa, nami nimevitoa kwa kuhani Aroni na wanawe kuwa fungu lao la kawaida kutoka kwa Waisraeli.’ ”

english: This is the portion of the offerings made by fire to the LORD for Aaron and his sons since the day they were presented to serve the LORD as priests.
ekegusii: “Ekio negetari kemotungetie Aroni na abamura baye korwa ase ebing’wanso bigosaambwa n’omorero ase ’nde; nigo kiabeete ekiabo korwa rituko riria baatananetwe bakaba abakuani bagonkorera inche Omonene.
swahili: Hii ndiyo sehemu ya sadaka zilizotolewa kwa Bwana kwa moto, ambazo zilitengwa kwa ajili ya Aroni na wanawe siku ile walipowekwa wakfu ili kumtumikia Bwana katika kazi ya ukuhani.

english: On the day they were anointed, the LORD commanded that this be given them by the sons of Israel. It is a permanent portion for the generations to come.
ekegusii: Rituko riria baagetwe amaguta inche ngachiika ng’a egetari ekio korwa ase Abaisraeli kebe ekiabo kogenderera botaambe, ebiaare ase ebiaare.”
swahili: Siku ile walipotiwa mafuta, Bwana aliagiza kwamba Waisraeli wawape hili kama fungu lao la kawaida kwa vizazi vijavyo.

english: This is the law of the burnt offering, the grain offering, the sin offering, the guilt offering, the ordination offering, and the peace offering,
ekegusii: Oko nakwo ogochika igoro y’ekeng’wanso ki’ogosaambwa, na okoruegwa kw’endagera, na ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, na egi’okorongeyia okomocha, na eki’ogosungusigwa, na eki’omorembe.
swahili: Basi haya ndiyo masharti kuhusu sadaka ya kuteketezwa, sadaka ya nafaka, sadaka ya dhambi, sadaka ya hatia, sadaka ya kuwekwa wakfu, na sadaka ya amani,

english: which the LORD gave Moses on Mount Sinai on the day He commanded the Israelites to present their offerings to the LORD in the Wilderness of Sinai.
ekegusii: Ogochika okwo nakwo Omonene aete Musa ase egetunwa gia Sinai, agwo ase erooro ya Sinai, ase rituko riria achiigete Abaisraeli bamoruere Omonene ebing’wanso biabo.
swahili: ambayo Bwana alimpa Mose juu ya Mlima Sinai siku ile alipowaagiza Waisraeli walete sadaka zao kwa Bwana, katika Jangwa la Sinai.

english: both kidneys with the fat on them near the loins, and the lobe of the liver, which is to be removed with the kidneys.
ekegusii: ne chinyigo chionsi ibere amo nebitinya bichitubete bire ang’e nomogongo, n’ebitinya bie riini birusigwe amo ne chinyigo.
swahili: figo zote mbili pamoja na mafuta yanayozizunguka yaliyo karibu na kiuno na yale yanayofunika ini, ambayo yataondolewa pamoja na hizo figo.

english: The priest shall burn them on the altar as an offering made by fire to the LORD; it is a guilt offering.
ekegusii: Omokuani abisaambere ase egesasiimero, bibe ekeng’wanso kegosaambwa n’omorero ase Omonene. Ekio n’ekengwanso gi’okorongeyia okomocha.
swahili: Kuhani atayateketeza juu ya madhabahu kuwa sadaka iliyotolewa kwa Bwana kwa moto. Hii ni sadaka ya hatia.

english: Every male among the priests may eat of it. It must be eaten in a holy place; it is most holy.
ekegusii: Abanto bagwenerete kobwaterana ase okorua ekengwanso ekio, kera omosacha bw’enka y’Omokuani. Oyio nakeriere agwo Aase achenu, ekiagera agwo nase achenu mono kegima.
swahili: Mwanaume yeyote katika jamaa ya kuhani aweza kuila, lakini lazima iliwe mahali patakatifu; ni takatifu sana.

english: The guilt offering is like the sin offering; the same law applies to both. It belongs to the priest who makes atonement with it.
ekegusii: “Ogochika gw’okorua ekeng’wanso gi’okorongeyia okomocha, nigo kore okomo nogw’ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe. Omokuani oria ogokora okobwatanigwa nakerokio aire chinyama chi’ekeng’wanso eke chibe echiaye.
swahili: “ ‘Sheria hii ya sadaka ya hatia ni sawasawa na ile ya sadaka ya dhambi: Nyama ya yule mnyama aliyetolewa sadaka ni ya yule kuhani anayesimamia ibada ya upatanisho.

english: As for the priest who presents a burnt offering for anyone, the hide of that offering belongs to him.
ekegusii: Omokuani okorua ekeng’wanso ki’ogosaambwa ase engencho y’omonto onde, Omokuani oyio omonyene aire risankwa ri’ekeng’wanso keria ribe eriaye.
swahili: Kuhani anayetoa sadaka ya kuteketezwa kwa ajili ya mtu yeyote anaweza kuichukua ngozi ya mnyama yule aliyetolewa iwe yake.

english: Likewise, every grain offering that is baked in an oven or cooked in a pan or on a griddle belongs to the priest who presents it,
ekegusii: Kera okoruegwa kw’endagera ’echinyeke koroiseirie riiko, na kende gionsi ekeroiseirie ase orogio, gose ase egetega, okwo ’nakobe okw’Omokuani oria okoruete ase ’nde inche Omonene.
swahili: Kila sadaka ya nafaka iliyookwa jikoni au kupikwa katika sufuria au katika kikaangio itakuwa ya kuhani anayeitoa.

english: Next, Moses took the anointing oil and anointed the tabernacle and everything in it; and so he consecrated them.
ekegusii: Musa akaimokia amaguta akweakwa, agaaka Obomenyo Obochenu, na kera egento kiareenge imeo, akabiaatanana bikaba ebichenu.
swahili: Ndipo Mose akachukua mafuta ya upako na kuipaka maskani na kila kitu kilichokuwamo ndani yake, kisha akaviweka wakfu.

english: He sprinkled some of the oil on the altar seven times, anointing the altar and all its utensils, and the basin with its stand, to consecrate them.
ekegusii: Akanyororokeria egesasiimero namaguta akweakwa ara gatano na kabere, naende agaaka egesasiimero amaguta aria, agaaka nebikorero bionsi, na egetuba amo nenterekerero yaye ase okobiaatanana bibe ebichenu.
swahili: Akanyunyiza baadhi ya mafuta juu ya madhabahu mara saba, akaipaka madhabahu mafuta na vyombo vyake vyote pamoja na sinia na kinara chake, ili kuviweka wakfu.

english: He also poured some of the anointing oil on Aaron’s head and anointed him to consecrate him.
ekegusii: Akaumora amaguta akweakwa igoro ase omotwe o Aroni, na akamoaka amaguta ase okomwaatanana na komochena.
swahili: Akamimina sehemu ya hayo mafuta ya upako kichwani mwa Aroni, akamtia mafuta ili kumweka wakfu.

english: Then Moses presented Aaron’s sons, put tunics on them, wrapped sashes around them, and tied headbands on them, just as the LORD had commanded him. The Priests’ Sin Offering
ekegusii: Naende Musa akarenta abamura ba Aroni, akababeekera chiganchwa, akababoeria chinkini na akababeekera ebigogwa ebike ase emetwe yabo, buna Omonene amochiigete.
swahili: Kisha akawaleta wana wa Aroni mbele, akawavika makoti, akawafunga mishipi na kuwavika vilemba, kama Bwana alivyomwagiza Mose.

english: Moses then brought the bull near for the sin offering, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on its head.
ekegusii: Musa akarenta eeri ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, erio Aroni amo nabamura baye bakabeeka amaboko abo igoro ase omotwe bw’eeri eyio.
swahili: Kisha akamtoa fahali kwa ajili ya sadaka ya dhambi, nao Aroni na wanawe wakaweka mikono yao juu ya kichwa chake.

english: Moses slaughtered the bull, took some of the blood, and applied it with his finger to all four horns of the altar, purifying the altar. He poured out the rest of the blood at the base of the altar and consecrated it so that atonement could be made on it.
ekegusii: Eeri eyio ekanyenywa, erio Musa agatobeka ekiara kiaye ase amanyinga y’eeri eyio, akayagindia ase emegwekano yonsi ye ching’unchara ere ase chikoona chi’egesasiimero, na agachena egesasiimero; na amanyinga aria atigarete akayaumora ase egesasiimero inse, akagiaatanana na kogechena, na igo akagekorera okobwatanigwa.
swahili: Mose akamchinja yule fahali na akachukua sehemu ya hiyo damu, kisha kwa kidole chake akaitia kwenye pembe zote za madhabahu ili kutakasa madhabahu. Akaimwaga damu iliyobaki chini ya madhabahu. Kwa hiyo akayaweka wakfu ili kufanya upatanisho kwa ajili ya madhabahu.

english: Moses also took all the fat that was on the entrails, the lobe of the liver, and both kidneys and their fat, and burned it all on the altar.
ekegusii: Akaimokia ebitinya bionsi biareenge ase chinyama chi’enda, n’ebitinya bie riini, ne chinyigo chionsi ibere amo nebitinya bichitubete, Erio Musa akabisaambera ase egesasiimero.
swahili: Pia Mose akachukua mafuta yote yanayozunguka sehemu za ndani, mafuta yanayofunika ini, figo zote mbili pamoja na mafuta yake, akayateketeza juu ya madhabahu.

english: But the bull with its hide, flesh, and dung he burned outside the camp, as the LORD had commanded him. The Priests’ Burnt Offering
ekegusii: Korende ebiatigarete korwa ase eeri eria, riiyo riaye, ne chinyama, na esike, akabisokia isiko y’egetwori akabisaambera aroro, buna Omonene amochiigete.
swahili: Lakini fahali, ikiwa pamoja na ngozi yake na nyama yake na sehemu zake za ndani na matumbo, akaiteketeza nje ya kambi, kama Bwana alivyomwagiza Mose.

english: Then Moses presented the ram for the burnt offering, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on its head.
ekegusii: Erio akarenta emingichi ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosaambwa, na Aroni amo nabamura baye bakabeeka amaboko abo ase omotwe bw’emingichi eyio.
swahili: Kisha Mose akamleta kondoo dume kwa ajili ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa, naye Aroni na wanawe wakaweka mikono yao juu ya kichwa chake.

english: Moses slaughtered the ram and sprinkled the blood on all sides of the altar.
ekegusii: Emingichi eyio ekanyenywa, na Musa agasiara amanyinga y’emingichi eyio ase egesasiimero chinsemo chionsi.
swahili: Ndipo Mose akamchinja yule kondoo dume na kunyunyiza damu yake pande zote za madhabahu.

english: “Take Aaron and his sons, their garments, the anointing oil, the bull of the sin offering, the two rams, and the basket of unleavened bread,
ekegusii: “Ira Aroni na abamura baye amo ne chianga chiabo chi’obokuani, na amaguta akweakwa, na eeri ekoruegwa ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, ne chimingichi ibere, na egetonga kere n’emegati etabeekiri memera.
swahili: “Waletee Aroni na wanawe mavazi yao, mafuta ya upako, fahali kwa ajili ya sadaka ya dhambi, kondoo dume wawili na kikapu chenye mikate iliyotengenezwa bila chachu.

english: After that, Moses presented the other ram, the ram of ordination, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on its head.
ekegusii: Musa akarenta emingichi ya kabere, eyio yaruetwe ase ogwaatanana abakuani ase emeremo emechenu, Aroni na abamura baye bakabeeka amaboko abo igoro ase omotwe bw’emingichi eyio.
swahili: Kisha akaleta kondoo dume mwingine, ndiye kondoo dume kwa ajili ya kuwaweka wakfu, naye Aroni na wanawe wakaweka mikono yao juu ya kichwa chake.

english: Moses slaughtered the ram and took some of its blood and put it on Aaron’s right earlobe, on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot.
ekegusii: Emingichi eyio ekanyenywa, na Musa akaimokia amanyinga make, akagindia mesia y’ogoto kwa borio kwa Aroni, na ekiara ekenene gi’okoboko kwaye kwa borio, na ekiara ekenene gi’okogoro kwaye kwa borio.
swahili: Mose akamchinja yule kondoo dume, akaichukua sehemu ya damu yake na kuipaka juu ya ncha ya sikio la kuume la Aroni, na juu ya kidole gumba cha mkono wake wa kuume na juu ya kidole kikubwa cha mguu wake wa kuume.

english: Moses also presented Aaron’s sons and put some of the blood on their right earlobes, on the thumbs of their right hands, and on the big toes of their right feet. Then he sprinkled the blood on all sides of the altar.
ekegusii: Boigo abamura ba Aroni bakarentwa na Musa akagindia amanyinga mesia y’amato abo a borio, na ebiara ebinene bi’amaboko abo a borio, na ebiara ebinene bi’amagoro abo a borio. Erio amanyinga aria atigarete akayasiarera ase egesasiimero chinsemo chionsi.
swahili: Pia Mose akawaleta hao wana wa Aroni mbele, akaipaka sehemu ya hiyo damu kwenye ncha za masikio yao ya kuume, juu ya vidole gumba vya mikono yao ya kuume, na juu ya vidole vikubwa vya miguu yao ya kuume. Kisha akanyunyiza damu pande zote za madhabahu.

english: And Moses took the fat—the fat tail, all the fat that was on the entrails, the lobe of the liver, and both kidneys with their fat—as well as the right thigh.
ekegusii: Akaimokia ebitinya, na omokera, n’ebitinya bionsi bie chinyama chi’enda, n’ebitinya bie riini, ne chinyigo ibere, amo nebitinya bichitubete, na ekenama kia borio.
swahili: Akachukua mafuta ya mnyama, mafuta ya mkia, mafuta yote yanayozunguka sehemu za ndani, mafuta yanayofunika ini, figo zote mbili pamoja na mafuta yake, na paja la kulia.

english: And from the basket of unleavened bread that was before the LORD, he took one cake of unleavened bread, one cake of bread made with oil, and one wafer, and he placed them on the fat portions and on the right thigh.
ekegusii: Naende korwa ase egetonga keria kiareenge agwo ase obosio bw’Omonene akarusia omogati oyomo otabeekiri memera, ne rindasi erimo, na omogati oyomo omoo, erio akabibeeka igoro ase ebitinya ebio na ekenama ekio kia borio.
swahili: Kisha kutoka kwenye kikapu cha mikate iliyotengenezwa bila chachu, kilichokuwa mbele za Bwana, akachukua andazi moja, na jingine lililotengenezwa kwa mafuta, na mkate mwembamba; akaviweka hivi vyote juu ya mafungu ya mafuta ya mnyama, na juu ya lile paja la kulia.

english: He put all these in the hands of Aaron and his sons and waved them before the LORD as a wave offering.
ekegusii: Akabeeka ebinto ebio bionsi ase amaboko Aroni, na ay’abamura baye, akabisungusia bibe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosungusigwa ase obosio bw’Omonene.
swahili: Akaviweka hivi vyote mikononi mwa Aroni na wanawe, na kuviinua mbele za Bwana kuwa sadaka ya kuinuliwa.

english: Then Moses took these from their hands and burned them on the altar with the burnt offering. This was an ordination offering, a pleasing aroma, an offering made by fire to the LORD.
ekegusii: Naende Musa akabirusia korwa ase amaboko abo, akabisaambera ase egesasiimero amo n’ekengwanso ki’ogosaambwa, bibe ekeng’wanso gi’okobaaatanana. Eke n’ekengwanso kegosaambwa n’omorero ase Omonene, kere ne rimisu rigiya rikomogwenera.
swahili: Kisha Mose akavichukua kutoka mikononi mwao na kuviteketeza juu ya madhabahu ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa kuwa sadaka ya kuwekwa wakfu, harufu nzuri ya kupendeza, sadaka iliyotolewa kwa Bwana kwa moto.

english: He also took the breast—Moses’ portion of the ram of ordination—and waved it before the LORD as a wave offering, as the LORD had commanded him.
ekegusii: Erio Musa akaimokia ritaana, akarisungusia ribe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosungusigwa ase Omonene. Nigo riabeete egetari kiaye kiarusetigwe korwa ase emingichi eria yaruetwe ase ogwaatanana abakuani. Ase igo Musa agakora buna Omonene amochiigete.
swahili: Kisha akachukua kidari, kilicho fungu la Mose la kondoo dume kwa ajili ya kuwekwa wakfu, na kukiinua mbele za Bwana kama sadaka ya kuinuliwa, kama Bwana alivyomwagiza Mose.

english: and assemble the whole congregation at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.”
ekegusii: Naende orangerie omoganda bwonsi osangererekane ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano.”
swahili: Kisha kusanya mkutano wote kwenye ingilio la Hema la Kukutania.”

english: Next, Moses took some of the anointing oil and some of the blood that was on the altar and sprinkled them on Aaron and his garments, and on his sons and their garments. So he consecrated Aaron and his garments, as well as Aaron’s sons and their garments.
ekegusii: Musa akaimokia amaguta akweakwa amo namanyinga areenge igoro ase egesasiimero, akanyororokeria Aroni amo ne chianga chiaye, akanyororokeria na abamura ba Aroni amo ne chianga chiabo. Naboigo agaatanana Aroni na abamura baye amo ne chianga chiabo ase emeremo emechenu.
swahili: Kisha Mose akachukua sehemu ya mafuta ya upako, na sehemu ya damu kutoka kwenye madhabahu, na kuvinyunyiza juu ya Aroni na mavazi yake, na juu ya wanawe na mavazi yao. Kwa hiyo akamweka Aroni na mavazi yake wakfu, pamoja na wanawe na mavazi yao.

english: And Moses said to Aaron and his sons, “Boil the meat at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting and eat it there with the bread that is in the basket of ordination offerings, as I commanded, saying, ‘Aaron and his sons are to eat it.’
ekegusii: Erio Musa agateebia Aroni na abamura baye, “Iyekera enyama eyio agwo ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano, na moyeriere aroro, moyerie amo n’emegati eria ere ime ase egetonga gi’okoruegwa ase ogwatananwa kw’abakuani! Naboigo inche nachiigete, ngateeba: Aroni amo nabamura baye mbayerie.
swahili: Kisha Mose akamwambia Aroni na wanawe, “Pika hiyo nyama kwenye ingilio la Hema la Kukutania, na uile hapo pamoja na mkate kutoka kwenye kikapu cha sadaka ya kuweka wakfu, kama nilivyoagiza, nikisema, ‘Aroni na wanawe wataila.’

english: Then you must burn up the remainder of the meat and bread.
ekegusii: Korende enyama amo n’emegati biratigare mobisaambe n’omorero.
swahili: Kisha teketeza nyama na mikate iliyobaki.

english: You must not go outside the entrance to the Tent of Meeting for seven days, until the days of your ordination are complete; for it will take seven days to ordain you.
ekegusii: Inwe timobaisa gosoka isiko goetania egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano, korende mobeereo ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere, goika amatuko ’ogwaatananwa kwaino aere.
swahili: Msitoke kwenye ingilio la Hema la Kukutania kwa muda wa siku saba, mpaka siku zenu za kuwekwa wakfu ziwe zimetimia, kwa kuwa muda wenu wa kuwekwa wakfu utakuwa siku saba.

english: What has been done today has been commanded by the LORD in order to make atonement on your behalf.
ekegusii: Buna akorirwe ase rituko ria reero, naboigo Omonene achiikire akorwe kogenderera ase ogokora okobwatanigwa ase more, erinde mwaberwe.
swahili: Lile lililofanyika leo liliagizwa na Bwana ili kufanya upatanisho kwa ajili yenu.

english: You must remain at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting day and night for seven days and keep the LORD’s charge so that you will not die, for this is what I have been commanded.”
ekegusii: Inwe nigo moraabeere agwo ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano, omobaso na obotuko, ase amatuko atano na abere, mobe mogokora ay’Omonene achiikire. Motakoreti ayio, inwe nigo morakwe.”
swahili: Lazima mkae kwenye ingilio la Hema la Kukutania usiku na mchana kwa siku saba, na kufanya lile Bwana analolitaka, ili kwamba msife; kwa kuwa hilo ndilo nililoamriwa.”

english: So Aaron and his sons did everything the LORD had commanded through Moses.
ekegusii: Ase igo Aroni na abamura baye bagakora onsi ay’Omonene achiigete goetera ase Musa.
swahili: Kwa hiyo Aroni na wanawe wakafanya kila kitu Bwana alichoamuru kupitia kwa Mose.

english: So Moses did as the LORD had commanded him, and the assembly gathered at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.
ekegusii: Musa agakora buna Omonene amochiigete, na ekero omoganda bwonsi osangererekanete ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano,
swahili: Mose akafanya kama Bwana alivyomwagiza, na mkutano ukakusanyika kwenye ingilio la Hema la Kukutania.

english: And Moses said to them, “This is what the LORD has commanded to be done.”
ekegusii: Musa akayoteebia. “Aya nar’Omonene achiikire akorwe.”
swahili: Mose akaliambia kusanyiko, “Hili ndilo Bwana ameagiza lifanyike.”

english: Then Moses presented Aaron and his sons and washed them with water.
ekegusii: Musa akarenta Aroni na abamura baye, akabasibia namaache.
swahili: Kisha Mose akamleta Aroni na wanawe mbele, akawaosha kwa maji.

english: He put the tunic on Aaron, tied the sash around him, clothed him with the robe, and put the ephod on him. He tied the woven band of the ephod around him and fastened it to him.
ekegusii: Akabeekera Aroni eganchwa erobekanirie eigete inse, na eganchwa eria ende, akamoboeria norokini. Naende akamobeekera egesibao ki’obokuani, akamoboeria norokini rw’egesibao roroisirie nomonto omong’aini.
swahili: Akamvika Aroni koti, akamfunga mshipi, akamvika joho na kumvalisha kisibau. Pia akafunga kisibau juu yake na kukifunga kiunoni mwake kwa mshipi wake uliosokotwa kwa ustadi.

english: Then he put the breastpiece on him and placed the Urim and Thummim in the breastpiece.
ekegusii: Erio akamobeekera egesembe, na ime ase egesembe ekio akabeeka Urimu na Tumimu (omobaso na oboikeranu).
swahili: Akaweka kifuko cha kifuani juu yake, na kuweka Urimu na Thumimu kwenye hicho kifuko.

english: Moses also put the turban on Aaron’s head and set the gold plate, the holy diadem, on the front of the turban, as the LORD had commanded him.
ekegusii: Akamobeekera ekegogwa ase omotwe oye, na bosio ase ekegogwa ekio agasiberania ekemanyererio egechenu gi’etaabu kiareenge kworokia ng’a bwatananirwe. Ase igo Musa agakora buna Omonene amochiigete.
swahili: Kisha akamvika Aroni kilemba kichwani pake, akaweka lile bamba la dhahabu, yaani ile taji takatifu, upande wa mbele wa kilemba, kama Bwana alivyomwagiza Mose.

english: On the eighth day Moses summoned Aaron and his sons and the elders of Israel.
ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatano na gatato Musa akarangeria Aroni amo nabamura baye, na abagaaka b’Abaisraeli.
swahili: Katika siku ya nane, Mose akawaita Aroni na wanawe, na wazee wa Israeli.

english: On the altar he burned the fat, the kidneys, and the lobe of the liver from the sin offering, as the LORD had commanded Moses.
ekegusii: Ebitinya ne chinyigo, n’ebitinya bie riini, ebiarusetie ase ekeng’wanso keria ki’ebibe, akabisaambera ase egesasiimero, buna Omonene achiigete Musa.
swahili: Juu ya madhabahu akateketeza mafuta, figo na mafuta yanayofunika ini kutoka kwenye hiyo sadaka ya dhambi, kama Bwana alivyomwagiza Mose.

english: But he burned up the flesh and the hide outside the camp.
ekegusii: Korende chinyama ne riiyo akabisamba n’omorero isiko y’egetwori.
swahili: Akateketeza nyama na ngozi nje ya kambi.

english: Then Aaron slaughtered the burnt offering. His sons brought him the blood, and he sprinkled it on all sides of the altar.
ekegusii: Magega y’ayio akanyenya eng’iti y’ekeng’wanso ki’ogosaambwa, na abamura baye bakamorentera amanyinga ’ekeng’wanso ekio, nere akayasiarera ase egesasiimero chinsemo chionsi.
swahili: Kisha Aroni akachinja sadaka ya kuteketezwa. Wanawe wakamletea damu, naye akainyunyiza pande zote za madhabahu.

english: They brought him the burnt offering piece by piece, including the head, and he burned them on the altar.
ekegusii: Abamura baye bakamorentera ekeng’wanso ki’ogosaambwa, egetari ase egetari, amo nomotwe, na ere akabisaambera ase egesasiimero.
swahili: Wakamletea sadaka ya kuteketezwa kipande kwa kipande, pamoja na kichwa, naye akaviteketeza juu ya madhabahu.

english: He washed the entrails and the legs and burned them atop the burnt offering on the altar.
ekegusii: Agasibia chinyama chi’enda amo nebirenge, erio akabisaambera amo n’ekengwanso ki’ogosaambwa ase egesasiimero.
swahili: Akasafisha sehemu za ndani na miguu, akaviteketeza juu ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa juu ya madhabahu.

english: Aaron then presented the people’s offering. He took the male goat for the people’s sin offering, slaughtered it, and offered it for sin like the first one.
ekegusii: Erio Aroni akarenta ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe bi’abaanto. Akaimokia embori y’ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe bi’abaanto, akayenyenya, akayerua buna aruete eria ye ritang’ani ase engencho y’ebibe biaye omonyene.
swahili: Kisha Aroni akaleta sadaka ile iliyokuwa kwa ajili ya watu. Akachukua yule mbuzi wa sadaka ya dhambi kwa ajili ya watu, akamchinja na kumtoa kwa ajili ya sadaka ya dhambi, kama alivyofanya kwa ile ya kwanza.

english: He presented the burnt offering and offered it according to the ordinance.
ekegusii: Naende akarenta eng’iti y’ekeng’wanso ki’ogosaambwa, akayerua buna konya achikirwe.
swahili: Aroni akaleta sadaka ya kuteketezwa na kuitoa kama ilivyoelekezwa.

english: Next he presented the grain offering, took a handful of it, and burned it on the altar in addition to the morning’s burnt offering.
ekegusii: Akarenta okoruegwa kw’endagera, akaimokia obosie boichire roe, akabosaambera ase egesasiimero amo n’ekengwanso ki’ogosaambwa kia mambia.
swahili: Pia akaleta sadaka ya nafaka, akachukua konzi moja na kuiteketeza juu ya madhabahu, pamoja na sadaka ya kuteketezwa ya asubuhi.

english: Then he slaughtered the ox and the ram as the people’s peace offering. His sons brought him the blood, and he sprinkled it on all sides of the altar.
ekegusii: Akanyenya boigo eeri amo nemingichi, chikaba ebing’wanso bi’omorembe ase engencho y’abanto. Abamura baye bakamorentera amanyinga ’ebing’wanso ebio, nere akayasiarera ase egesasiimero chinsemo chionsi.
swahili: Akachinja maksai na kondoo dume kama sadaka ya amani kwa ajili ya watu. Wanawe Aroni wakampa ile damu, naye akainyunyiza kwenye madhabahu pande zote.

english: They also brought the fat portions from the ox and the ram—the fat tail, the fat covering the entrails, the kidneys, and the lobe of the liver—
ekegusii: Ebitinya bi’eeri eyio, na omokera bw’emingichi n’ebitinya bitubete chinyama chi’enda, ne chinyigo, n’ebitinya bie riini,
swahili: Lakini sehemu zile za mafuta ya yule maksai na kondoo dume, yaani mafuta ya mkia, mafuta yaliyofunika tumbo, ya figo na yaliyofunika ini,

english: He said to Aaron, “Take for yourself a young bull for a sin offering and a ram for a burnt offering, both without blemish, and present them before the LORD.
ekegusii: Naende agateebia Aroni, “Chora eeri ensae na emori, chionsi ibere chitari na kemocho ase emebere yabo, ochirue ase Omonene. Eeri eria ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, na emingichi ebe eki’ogosaambwa.
swahili: Akamwambia Aroni, “Chukua ndama dume kwa ajili ya sadaka yako ya dhambi, na kondoo dume kwa sadaka yako ya kuteketezwa, wote wawili wasiwe na dosari, nao uwalete mbele za Bwana.

english: and placed these on the breasts. Aaron burned the fat portions on the altar,
ekegusii: ebitinya ebio bionsi bakabibeeka igoro ase amataana, na Aroni akabisaambera ase egesasiimero,
swahili: hivi vyote wakaviweka juu ya vidari, kisha Aroni akayateketeza hayo mafuta ya wanyama juu ya madhabahu.

english: but he waved the breasts and the right thigh as a wave offering before the LORD, as Moses had commanded.
ekegusii: korende amataana na ebinema bia borio akabisungusia bibe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosungusigwa ase Omonene, buna Musa achiigete.
swahili: Aroni akaviinua vile vidari na paja la kulia mbele za Bwana ili viwe sadaka ya kuinuliwa, kama Mose alivyoagiza.

english: Aaron lifted up his hands toward the people and blessed them. And having made the sin offering, the burnt offering, and the peace offering, he stepped down.
ekegusii: Aroni gakoorire korua ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, na eki’ogosaambwa, na eki’omorembe, akaimokia amaboko aye igoro ase abanto, akabasesenia, naende agaika gocha inse.
swahili: Kisha Aroni akainua mikono yake kuwaelekea watu na kuwabariki. Naye baada ya kutoa dhabihu ya sadaka ya dhambi, sadaka ya kuteketezwa, na sadaka ya amani, akashuka chini.

english: Moses and Aaron then entered the Tent of Meeting. When they came out, they blessed the people, and the glory of the LORD appeared to all the people.
ekegusii: Erio Musa na Aroni bagasoa ase Eema y’Omosangererekano ime, naende ekero basokire korwa aroro, bagasesenia abanto, na obonene bw’Omonene bokaorokera abanto bonsi.
swahili: Kisha Mose na Aroni wakaingia kwenye Hema la Kukutania. Walipotoka nje, wakawabariki watu. Nao utukufu wa Bwana ukawatokea watu wote.

english: Fire came out from the presence of the LORD and consumed the burnt offering and the fat portions on the altar. And when all the people saw it, they shouted for joy and fell facedown.
ekegusii: Omorero ogaika korwa ase Omonene mobosokano, ogasamba ekeng’wanso ki’ogosaambwa amo nebitinya biareenge ase egesasiimero, na ebinto ebio bikayia bikaera. Ekero abanto bonsi baroche amang’ana ayio bagaaka amariogi, bagatung’ama inse, bakaumama.
swahili: Moto ukaja kutoka uwepo wa Bwana, ukairamba ile sadaka ya kuteketezwa, pamoja na sehemu ya mafuta yaliyokuwa juu ya madhabahu. Watu wote walipoona jambo hili, wakapiga kelele kwa furaha na kusujudu.

english: Then speak to the Israelites and say, ‘Take a male goat for a sin offering, a calf and a lamb—both a year old and without blemish—for a burnt offering,
ekegusii: Naende oteebie Abaisraeli ng’a bachore egoree ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, na emori amo nemaanwa y’eng’ondi echiakoorire omwaka oyomo, chionsi chitari na kemocho ase emebere yabo, chibe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosaambwa,
swahili: Kisha waambie Waisraeli: ‘Chukueni mbuzi dume kwa ajili ya sadaka ya dhambi, na ndama na mwana-kondoo, wote wawili wawe wa umri wa mwaka mmoja, na wasio na dosari, kwa ajili ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa,

english: an ox and a ram for a peace offering to sacrifice before the LORD, and a grain offering mixed with oil. For today the LORD will appear to you.’”
ekegusii: na eng’ombe amo nemingichi chibe ebing’wanso bi’omorembe ase obosio bw’Omonene. Naboigo barue okoruegwa kw’endagera gwochoganirie namaguta, ekiagera ase rituko ria rero Omonene nabaorokere.”
swahili: na pia maksai na kondoo dume kwa ajili ya sadaka ya amani, ili kutoa dhabihu mbele za Bwana, pamoja na sadaka ya nafaka iliyochanganywa na mafuta. Kwa kuwa leo Bwana atawatokea.’ ”

english: So they took what Moses had commanded to the front of the Tent of Meeting, and the whole congregation drew near and stood before the LORD.
ekegusii: Abanto bakarenta ebinto ebio bionsi Musa abachiigete, bakabibeeka bosio bw’Eema y’Omosangererekano, na omoganda bwonsi ogaika ang’e, ogatenena agwo ase obosio bw’Omonene.
swahili: Wakavileta vile vitu Mose alivyowaagiza mbele ya Hema la Kukutania, nalo kusanyiko lote likakaribia na kusimama mbele za Bwana.

english: And Moses said, “This is what the LORD has commanded you to do, so that the glory of the LORD may appear to you.”
ekegusii: Erio Musa agateeba: “Eke naki’Omonene abachiigete mokore, erio obonene bw’Omonene mbobaorokere.”
swahili: Ndipo Mose akasema, “Hili ndilo Bwana alilowaagiza mlifanye, ili utukufu wa Bwana upate kuonekana kwenu.”

english: Then Moses said to Aaron, “Approach the altar and sacrifice your sin offering and your burnt offering to make atonement for yourself and for the people. And sacrifice the people’s offering to make atonement for them, as the LORD has commanded.”
ekegusii: Erio Musa agateebia Aroni, “Suka gochia ang’e ase egesasiimero, na orue ekeng’wanso kiao ki’ebibe na eki’ogosaambwa, okore okobwatanigwa ase ore aye omonyene, na ase abanto, erinde mwaberwe. Naende orue ekeng’wanso ekio abanto barentire, na okore okobwatanigwa ase bare, buna Omonene achiigete.”
swahili: Mose akamwambia Aroni, “Njoo madhabahuni ili utoe dhabihu yako ya sadaka ya dhambi na sadaka yako ya kuteketezwa, ufanye upatanisho kwa ajili yako mwenyewe na kwa ajili ya watu. Kisha utoe sadaka ya upatanisho kwa ajili ya watu, kama vile Bwana alivyoagiza.”

english: So Aaron approached the altar and slaughtered the calf as a sin offering for himself.
ekegusii: Ase ayio Aroni agasuka gochia ang’e ase egesasiimero, akanyenya emori eria ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe biaye omonyene,
swahili: Hivyo Aroni akaja madhabahuni na kumchinja yule ndama kuwa sadaka ya dhambi kwa ajili yake mwenyewe.

english: The sons of Aaron brought the blood to him, and he dipped his finger in the blood and applied it to the horns of the altar. And he poured out the rest of the blood at the base of the altar.
ekegusii: na abamura baye bakamorentera amanyinga y’ekeng’wanso ekio, ere agatobeka ekiara kiaye ase amanyinga aria, erio akayagindia ase emegwekano ye ching’unchara ere ase chikoona chi’egesasiimero, na amanyinga atigarete akayaumora ase egesasiimero inse.
swahili: Wanawe wakamletea damu, naye akachovya kidole chake katika hiyo damu, akaitia kwenye pembe za madhabahu, nayo damu iliyobaki akaimwaga chini ya madhabahu.

english: After this, the Lord appointed seventy-two others and sent them two by two ahead of Him to every town and place He was about to visit.
ekegusii: Magega ase aya Omonene agachora abande emerongo etano na ebere na babere (72), akabatoma babere babere bamotang’anere kogenda kera omochie na kera aase arengereretie kogenda ere omonyene.
swahili: Baada ya hayo, Bwana akawachagua wengine sabini na wawili, akawatuma wawili wawili katika kila mji na kila sehemu aliyokusudia kwenda baadaye.

english: But if you enter a town and they do not welcome you, go into the streets and declare,
ekegusii: Kero kende gionsi mogosoa omochie, na barabwo batabaariganeti, soka korwa aroro, eta ase chinchera chiaye, motebe:
swahili: Lakini mkiingia katika mji, nao hawakuwakaribisha, tokeni mwende katika barabara zake mkaseme:

english: ‘Even the dust of your town that clings to our feet, we wipe off as a testimony against you. Yet be sure of this: The kingdom of God is near.’
ekegusii: Nonya norotu rw’omochie oino rwabwatereire amagoro aito twarwabusire ase more, korende manya aya, ng’a oborwoti bwa Nyasae bwaikire ang’e.
swahili: ‘Hata mavumbi ya mji wenu yaliyoshikamana na miguu yetu, tunayakungʼuta dhidi yenu. Lakini mjue kwamba Ufalme wa Mungu umekaribia.’

english: I tell you, it will be more bearable on that day for Sodom than for that town. Woe to the Unrepentant (Matthew 11:20–24)
ekegusii: Nabateebirie, nabe aororo ase Sodomu ase rituko riria kobua omochie oria.” Okoragererigwa ase emechie etari nokwegena (Mat 11:20-24)
swahili: Ninawaambia, itakuwa rahisi zaidi kwa Sodoma kustahimili katika siku ile kuliko mji ule. Onyo Kwa Miji Isiyotubu (Mathayo 11:20-24)

english: Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the miracles that were performed in you had been performed in Tyre and Sidon, they would have repented long ago, sitting in sackcloth and ashes.
ekegusii: “Obobe nobwao, Korasini! Obobe nobwao, Bethisaida! Ekiagera onye mbiakoregete ase Turo na Sidoni ebikone bie chinguru ebiakoregete ase more, abanto b’aroro anga mbaonchogete kare na goikaransa babegete chianga chi’echigunia na beagete ribu.
swahili: “Ole wako Korazini! Ole wako Bethsaida! Kwa kuwa kama miujiza iliyofanyika kwenu ingefanyika Tiro na Sidoni, miji hiyo ingekuwa imetubu zamani, kwa kuvaa magunia na kujipaka majivu.

english: But it will be more bearable for Tyre and Sidon at the judgment than for you.
ekegusii: Korende nebe aororo ase Turo na Sidoni ase rituko riria ri’ekiina kobua ase more.
swahili: Lakini itakuwa rahisi zaidi kwa Tiro na Sidoni kustahimili katika siku ya hukumu, kuliko ninyi.

english: And you, Capernaum, will you be lifted up to heaven? No, you will be brought down to Hades!
ekegusii: Naye Kapernaumu, noimokererigwe igoro? Noche goikigwa goika Eora y’amakweri.
swahili: Nawe, Kapernaumu, je, utainuliwa hadi mbinguni? La hasha, utashushwa mpaka kuzimu.”

english: Whoever listens to you listens to Me; whoever rejects you rejects Me; and whoever rejects Me rejects the One who sent Me.” The Joyful Return
ekegusii: “Oyorabaigwere inwe, nanyigwere nainche, na ere oyorabaange inwe, onyangire nainche, na ere oyoranyange inche, omwangire ere oyontomete.” Okoirana kwa baria emerongo etano na ebere
swahili: “Yeye awasikilizaye ninyi anisikiliza mimi; naye awakataaye ninyi amenikataa mimi. Lakini yeye anikataaye mimi amkataa yeye aliyenituma.”

english: The seventy-two returned with joy and said, “Lord, even the demons submit to us in Your name.”
ekegusii: Baria emerongo etano na ebere na babere (72) bakairana nomogooko, bagateeba, “Omonene, nonya nebirecha biatoigwereire ase erieta riao.”
swahili: Wale sabini na wawili wakarudi kwa furaha, na kusema, “Bwana, hata pepo wachafu wanatutii kwa jina lako.”

english: So He told them, “I saw Satan fall like lightning from heaven.
ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Naroche Saitani okogwa korwa igoro buna okomesa.
swahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Nilimwona Shetani akianguka kutoka mbinguni kama umeme wa radi.

english: Behold, I have given you authority to tread on snakes and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy. Nothing will harm you.
ekegusii: Rora, nabaeire okobua gotindacha ching’iti chionsi, na ebiuge, ne chinguru chionsi chi’oria omobisa; gose gento kende tikeri kerabaite.
swahili: Tazama nimewapa mamlaka ya kukanyaga nyoka na nge na juu ya nguvu zote za adui; wala hakuna kitu chochote kitakachowadhuru.

english: And He told them, “The harvest is plentiful, but the workers are few. Ask the Lord of the harvest, therefore, to send out workers into His harvest.
ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Rigesa nerinene, korende abakori emeremo nabake; gaki mosabe Omonene bwe rigesa atome abakori emeremo ase rigesa riaye.
swahili: Akawaambia, “Mavuno ni mengi, lakini watendakazi ni wachache. Kwa hiyo mwombeni Bwana wa mavuno, ili apeleke watendakazi katika shamba lake la mavuno.

english: Nevertheless, do not rejoice that the spirits submit to you, but rejoice that your names are written in heaven.” Jesus’ Prayer of Thanksgiving (Matthew 11:25–30)
ekegusii: Nonya nabo timogoka ase aya, ng’a ebirecha biabaigwereire, korende goka ekiagera amarieta aino arikirwe igoro.” Yeso okoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono (Mat 11:25-27; 13:16-17)
swahili: Basi, msifurahi kwa kuwa pepo wachafu wanawatii, bali furahini kwa kuwa majina yenu yameandikwa mbinguni.” Yesu Anashangilia (Mathayo 11:25-27; 13:16-17)

english: At that time Jesus rejoiced in the Holy Spirit and declared, “I praise You, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, because You have hidden these things from the wise and learned, and revealed them to little children. Yes, Father, for this was well-pleasing in Your sight.
ekegusii: Ase ekero keria Yeso agasasoka ase Omoika Omochenu, akabora, “Nakobakire aye Tata, Omonene o igoro na ense, ng’a kwabisire amang’ana aya ase abare nobong’aini ne chisemi, na koyamaanora ase abana abake. Ee, Tata, oko nakwo kwarenge ogwancha kwao okuya.
swahili: Wakati huo Yesu akashangilia katika Roho Mtakatifu, akasema, “Nakuhimidi Baba, Bwana wa mbingu na nchi, kwa kuwa umewaficha mambo haya wenye hekima na wenye elimu, nawe ukawafunulia watoto wadogo. Naam, Baba, kwa kuwa hivyo ndivyo ilivyokupendeza.

english: All things have been entrusted to Me by My Father. No one knows who the Son is except the Father, and no one knows who the Father is except the Son and those to whom the Son chooses to reveal Him.”
ekegusii: Naeirwe ebinto bionsi na Tata one; monto onde tari omomanyete Omwana gose nere ng’o, otatiga Tata, gose Tata nere ng’o, otatiga Omwana, na onde bwensi Omwana anchire komoorokeria.”
swahili: “Nimekabidhiwa vitu vyote na Baba yangu. Hakuna mtu amjuaye Mwana ni nani ila Baba, wala hakuna amjuaye Baba ni nani ila Mwana na yeyote ambaye Mwana anapenda kumfunulia.”

english: Then Jesus turned to the disciples and said privately, “Blessed are the eyes that see what you see.
ekegusii: Akaonchokera aborokigwa baye, akabateebia bobisi, “Nasesenirie amaiso aya arorire ayamwarorire inwe!
swahili: Basi Yesu akawageukia wanafunzi wake akanena nao faraghani, akawaambia, “Heri macho yanayoona yale mambo mnayoyaona.

english: For I tell you that many prophets and kings desired to see what you see but did not see it, and to hear what you hear but did not hear it.” The Parable of the Good Samaritan
ekegusii: Naki nabateebirie, ababani abange na abarwoti bakarigia korora ayamwarorire inwe, tibayarora, na koigwa aya mwaigure, tibayaigwa.” Omoreng’anio bwo’mosamaria omuya (Mat 22:34-40; Mar 12:28-31)
swahili: Kwa maana nawaambia, manabii wengi na wafalme walitamani kuona yale mnayoyaona lakini hawakuyaona, na walitamani kusikia yale mnayoyasikia lakini hawakuyasikia.” Mfano Wa Msamaria Mwema

english: One day an expert in the law stood up to test Him. “Teacher,” he asked, “what must I do to inherit eternal life?”
ekegusii: Na rora, omworokia bw’amachiiko agatenena okomoteema, okobora, “Omworokia, inki ndakore nyore obogima bwa kare na kare?”
swahili: Wakati huo mtaalamu mmoja wa sheria alisimama ili kumjaribu Yesu, akamuuliza, “Mwalimu, nifanye nini ili niurithi uzima wa milele?”

english: “What is written in the Law?” Jesus replied. “How do you read it?”
ekegusii: Ere akamobooria, “Ase amachiiko inki keriikire? Naki ogosoma?”
swahili: Yesu akamjibu, “Imeandikwaje katika Sheria? Kwani unasoma nini humo?”

english: He answered, “‘Love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your strength and with all your mind’ and ‘Love your neighbor as yourself.’ ”
ekegusii: Akairaneria, “Mwanche Omonene Nyasae oo nenkoro yao yonsi, na omoyo oo bwonsi, ne chinguru chiao chionsi, na obong’aini bwao bwonsi, na omogisangio oo buna bweanchete.”
swahili: Akajibu, “ ‘Mpende Bwana Mungu wako kwa moyo wako wote, kwa roho yako yote, kwa nguvu zako zote, na kwa akili zako zote’; tena, ‘Mpende jirani yako kama unavyojipenda mwenyewe.’ ”

english: “You have answered correctly,” Jesus said. “Do this and you will live.”
ekegusii: Akamoteebia, “Kwairaneirie buya. Kora iga, nario oramenye amatuko amange.”
swahili: Yesu akamwambia, “Umejibu vyema. Fanya hivyo nawe utaishi.”

english: But wanting to justify himself, he asked Jesus, “And who is my neighbor?”
ekegusii: Omonto oria akarigia gwekora omonyene oboronge, akaboria Yeso, “Omogisangio one nere ng’o?”
swahili: Lakini yule mtaalamu wa sheria, akitaka kujionyesha kuwa mwenye haki, akamuuliza Yesu, “Jirani yangu ni nani?”

english: Go! I am sending you out like lambs among wolves.
ekegusii: Bwatia enchera; rigereria, nabatomire inwe buna chimanwa chi’eching’ondi gati‐gati ye chisese chi’orosana.
swahili: Haya! nendeni. Ninawatuma kama wana-kondoo katikati ya mbwa mwitu.

english: Jesus took up this question and said, “A man was going down from Jerusalem to Jericho when he fell into the hands of robbers. They stripped him, beat him, and went away, leaving him half dead.
ekegusii: Yeso akairaneria, “Narenge omonto ore gotirimboka korwa Yerusalemu kogenda Yeriko. Ere akaumera abauri, na barabwo bakamoumokera, bakamorusia chianga, bakamoaka chingoma, bakagenda, bakamotiga oisire gokwa.
swahili: Yesu akamjibu akasema, “Mtu mmoja alikuwa akiteremka kutoka Yerusalemu kwenda Yeriko, naye akaangukia mikononi mwa wanyangʼanyi. Wakampiga, wakaondoka, wakamwacha akiwa karibu kufa.

english: Now by chance a priest was going down the same road, but when he saw him, he passed by on the other side.
ekegusii: Ekaba agwo Omokuani oyomo akaoroka, ogoeta ase enchera eria, akamorora, agaeta ensemo.
swahili: Kuhani mmoja alikuwa akipitia njia ile, alipomwona huyo mtu, akapita upande mwingine, akamwacha hapo barabarani.

english: So too, when a Levite came to that spot and saw him, he passed by on the other side.
ekegusii: Na Omolawi boigo agachia goika aase aria, akamorora; nere agaeta ensemo.
swahili: Vivyo hivyo, Mlawi mmoja naye alipofika mahali pale, alimwona, akapita upande mwingine, akamwacha hapo barabarani

english: But when a Samaritan on a journey came upon him, he looked at him and had compassion.
ekegusii: Korende Omosamaria oyomo, kagoeta, agacha aase arenge; ere agachia komoorora, akamororera amaabera.
swahili: Lakini Msamaria mmoja aliyekuwa akisafiri alipomwona, alimhurumia.

english: He went to him and bandaged his wounds, pouring on oil and wine. Then he put him on his own animal, brought him to an inn, and took care of him.
ekegusii: Nabo akamoika ang’e, akamoboa chingoma chiaye, akamoaka amaguta na edivai; akamoriinia ase etigere yaye igoro, akamoira ase enyomba y’abageni, akamorwaria.
swahili: Akaenda alipokuwa na akasafisha majeraha yake kwa divai na mafuta, kisha akayafunga. Ndipo akampandisha kwenye punda wake, akampeleka mpaka kwenye nyumba ya wageni na kumtunza.

english: The next day he took out two denarii and gave them to the innkeeper. ‘Take care of him,’ he said, ‘and on my return I will repay you for any additional expense.’
ekegusii: Goika mambia yaye akarua chisiringi ibere, akaa omonyene enyomba, akamoteebia: Morende buya; na kende gionsi orarue kobua, kondairane naende, ningoakane.
swahili: Kesho yake, yule Msamaria akachukua dinari mbili akampa yule mwenye nyumba ya wageni na kusema, ‘Mtunze, nami nirudipo nitakulipa gharama yoyote ya ziada uliyotumia kwa ajili yake.’

english: Which of these three do you think was a neighbor to the man who fell into the hands of robbers?”
ekegusii: Naki rende orooche ase aba iga batato, norori orenge omoamate oye ere oyogwete ase amaboko y’abauri?”
swahili: “Ni yupi basi miongoni mwa hawa watatu wewe unadhani ni jirani yake yule mtu aliyeangukia mikononi mwa wanyangʼanyi?”

english: “The one who showed him mercy,” replied the expert in the law. Then Jesus told him, “Go and do likewise.” Martha and Mary
ekegusii: Akabora, “Noria omoororerete amaabera.” Yeso akamoteebia, “Genda naye okore boigo.” Yeso ogosoa ase enka ya Martha na Mariamu
swahili: Yule mtaalamu wa sheria akajibu, “Ni yule aliyemhurumia.” Ndipo Yesu akamwambia, “Nenda, ukafanye vivyo hivyo.” Yesu Awatembelea Martha Na Maria

english: As they traveled along, Jesus entered a village where a woman named Martha welcomed Him into her home.
ekegusii: Ekero bare kogenda orogendo rwabo, agasoa ase agachie akamo, na omokungu oyomo, erieta riaye Martha, akamoarigania nyomba mwaye.
swahili: Ikawa Yesu na wanafunzi wake walipokuwa wakienda Yerusalemu, akaingia kwenye kijiji kimoja ambapo mwanamke mmoja aliyeitwa Martha alimkaribisha nyumbani kwake.

english: She had a sister named Mary, who sat at the Lord’s feet listening to His message.
ekegusii: Ere narenge nomosubati omwabo ore korokwa Mariamu oyio oikaransete ase amagoro a Yeso, koigwa amang’ana aye.
swahili: Martha alikuwa na mdogo wake aliyeitwa Maria, ambaye aliketi chini miguuni mwa Bwana akisikiliza yale aliyokuwa akisema.

english: Carry no purse or bag or sandals. Do not greet anyone along the road.
ekegusii: Timobogoria ekemoya, gose esaro, gose ebikoroto; gose timokwania monto nchera.
swahili: Msichukue mkoba, wala mfuko, wala viatu, na msimsalimu mtu yeyote njiani.

english: But Martha was distracted by all the preparations to be made. She came to Jesus and said, “Lord, do You not care that my sister has left me to serve alone? Tell her to help me!”
ekegusii: Korende Martha nigo arenge gochandeka ase ogokora okonge, akamochiera, akabora, “Omonene, torochi aye buna oyominto antigire ngokora kera egento inche bweka? Moteebie ankonye.”
swahili: Lakini Martha alikuwa akihangaika na maandalizi yote yaliyokuwa yafanyike. Martha akaja kwa Yesu na kumuuliza, “Bwana, hujali kwamba ndugu yangu ameniachia kazi zote mwenyewe? Basi mwambie anisaidie.”

english: “Martha, Martha,” the Lord replied, “you are worried and upset about many things.
ekegusii: Omonene akamoiraneria, “Martha, Martha, nigo okwerosia na gweichania ase engencho y’ebinto ebinge,
swahili: Lakini Bwana akamjibu, “Martha, Martha, mbona unasumbuka na kuhangaika na mengi?

english: But only one thing is necessary. Mary has chosen the good portion, and it will not be taken away from her.”
ekegusii: korende egento ekemo gioka keganeirie. Mariamu ochorire ensemo ere engiya, eye ataurwe nonde.”
swahili: Lakini kunahitajika kitu kimoja tu. Maria amechagua kile kilicho bora, wala hakuna mtu atakayemwondolea.”

english: Whatever house you enter, begin by saying, ‘Peace to this house.’
ekegusii: Na enyomba ende yonsi morasoe, ritang’ani mobore: Omorembe obe ase enyomba eye.
swahili: “Mkiingia katika nyumba yoyote, kwanza semeni, ‘Amani iwe kwenu.’

english: If a man of peace is there, your peace will rest on him; if not, it will return to you.
ekegusii: Onye omonto bw’omorembe oreo, omorembe oino noikaranse asare; korende onye taibo, nobairanere inwe.
swahili: Kama kuna mtu wa amani humo, basi amani yenu itakuwa juu yake. La sivyo, itawarudia.

english: Stay at the same house, eating and drinking whatever you are offered. For the worker is worthy of his wages. Do not move around from house to house.
ekegusii: Mobeere ase enyomba eyio, morie na konywa ebi bakobaa, ekiagera omokori emeremo nagwenerete aegwe eng’eria yaye. Timoetanana enyomba ase enyomba.
swahili: Kaeni katika nyumba hiyo, mkila na kunywa kile watakachowapa, kwa sababu kila mtendakazi anastahili malipo yake. Msihamehame kutoka nyumba hadi nyumba.

english: If you enter a town and they welcome you, eat whatever is set before you.
ekegusii: Na omochie onde bwonsi morasoe, na abanto b’omochie oyio baabaariganie, karie eki barabae.
swahili: “Mkienda katika mji na watu wake wakawakaribisha, kuleni chochote kiwekwacho mbele yenu,

english: Heal the sick who are there and tell them, ‘The kingdom of God is near you.’
ekegusii: Mogwenie abarwaire abareo, mobateebie: Oborwoti bwa Nyasae bwabaikeire ang’e.
swahili: waponyeni wagonjwa waliomo na waambieni: ‘Ufalme wa Mungu umekaribia.’

english: One day in a place where Jesus had just finished praying, one of His disciples requested, “Lord, teach us to pray, just as John taught his disciples.”
ekegusii: Ngosaba arenge aase gete. Gakoorire, oyomo bw’aborokigwa baye akamoteebia, “Omonene, twegerie ogosaba buna Yohana aegeretie aborokigwa baye.”
swahili: Siku moja, Yesu alikuwa mahali fulani akiomba. Alipomaliza kuomba, mmoja wa wanafunzi wake akamwambia, “Bwana, tufundishe kuomba, kama vile Yohana alivyowafundisha wanafunzi wake.”

english: For everyone who asks receives; he who seeks finds; and to him who knocks, the door will be opened.
ekegusii: Ekiagera kera oyogosaba, nigo akoegwa, na ere oyokorigia, nigo akonyora, na ere oyogotura, nigo akoigorerwa.
swahili: Kwa kuwa kila aombaye hupewa; naye kila atafutaye hupata; na kila abishaye hufunguliwa mlango.

english: What father among you, if his son asks for a fish, will give him a snake instead?
ekegusii: Naki monto onde nare ase more oyore ise, na omwana oye amosabe omogati, Inee, namoe rigena? Gose karamosabe enswe, ase ribaga ri’enswe namoe eng’iti?
swahili: “Je, kuna yeyote miongoni mwenu ambaye mtoto wake akimwomba samaki, atampa nyoka badala yake?

english: Or if he asks for an egg, will give him a scorpion?
ekegusii: Gose karamosabe rigena ri’engoko namoe riagaga?
swahili: Au mtoto akimwomba yai atampa nge?

english: So if you who are evil know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father in heaven give the Holy Spirit to those who ask Him!” A House Divided (Matthew 12:22–30; Mark 3:20–27)
ekegusii: Onye inwe, abamore ababe, momanyete koa abana baino ebiegwa ebiya, Inee, Iso oino ore igoro takomenta mono kobaa bonsi, abakomosaba, Omoika Omochenu?” Yeso na Beelizebuli (Mat 12:22-30; Mar 3:22-27)
swahili: Basi ikiwa ninyi mlio waovu, mnajua kuwapa watoto wenu vitu vizuri, si zaidi sana Baba yenu aliye mbinguni atawapa Roho Mtakatifu wale wamwombao!” Yesu Na Beelzebuli (Mathayo 12:22-30; Marko 3:20-27)

english: One day Jesus was driving out a demon that was mute. And when the demon was gone, the man who had been mute spoke. The crowds were amazed,
ekegusii: Bono ngoseria arenge ekerecha ekio giakorete omonto oyomo koba rimama. Ekero ekerecha keria giasogete, omonto oria rimama agakwana; abanto bagakumia.
swahili: Basi Yesu alikuwa anamtoa pepo mchafu kutoka kwa mtu aliyekuwa bubu. Yule pepo mchafu alipomtoka yule mtu aliyekuwa bubu, akaanza kuongea, nao umati wa watu ukashangaa.

english: but some of them said, “It is by Beelzebul, the prince of the demons, that He drives out demons.”
ekegusii: Abande babo bagateeba, “Nase Beelizebuli, omonene bw’ebirecha, akorusia ebirecha.”
swahili: Lakini wengine wakasema, “Anatoa pepo wachafu kwa uwezo wa Beelzebuli, yule mkuu wa pepo wachafu wote.”

english: And others tested Him by demanding a sign from heaven.
ekegusii: Abande ase okomoteema bakarigia aborokie egekone buna ekemanyererio korwa igoro.
swahili: Wengine ili kumjaribu wakataka awaonyeshe ishara kutoka mbinguni.

english: Knowing their thoughts, Jesus said to them, “Every kingdom divided against itself will be laid waste, and a house divided against a house will fall.
ekegusii: Ere konya omanyire ebirengererio biabo, akabateebia, “Kera oborwoti kobwatananekanire borobwo obonyene nigo b’ogosareka, na enyomba yaatananekire ero enyene nigo ekogwa.
swahili: Yesu akajua mawazo yao, naye akawaambia, “Kila ufalme ukigawanyika dhidi yake wenyewe huangamia. Nayo nyumba iliyogawanyika dhidi yake yenyewe itaanguka.

english: If Satan is divided against himself, how can his kingdom stand? After all, you say that I drive out demons by Beelzebul.
ekegusii: Naboigo Saitani karaatananeke ere omonyene, oborwoti bwaye naki boratenene? Naki inwe iga mogoteeba ng’a nigo ngoseria ebirecha ase Beelizebuli.
swahili: Kama Shetani amegawanyika mwenyewe, ufalme wake utasimamaje? Nawaambia haya kwa sababu ninyi mnadai ya kuwa mimi ninatoa pepo wachafu kwa uwezo wa Beelzebuli.

english: And if I drive out demons by Beelzebul, by whom do your sons drive them out? So then, they will be your judges.
ekegusii: Na inche onye ngoseria ebirecha ase Beelizebuli, Inee, abana baino nase ng’o bakobiseria? Ase engencho eyio, barabwo nababe abagaambi baino.
swahili: Kama mimi natoa pepo wachafu kwa nguvu za Beelzebuli, wafuasi wenu nao je, wao hutoa pepo wachafu kwa uwezo wa nani? Hivyo basi, wao ndio watakaowahukumu.

english: So Jesus told them, “When you pray, say: ‘Father, hallowed be Your name. Your kingdom come.
ekegusii: Akabateebia, Komogosaba, teba iga: Tata, Erieta riao risikwe, Oborwoti bwao boche,
swahili: Akawaambia, “Mnapoomba, semeni: “ ‘Baba yetu (uliye mbinguni), jina lako litukuzwe, ufalme wako uje. (Mapenzi yako yafanyike hapa duniani kama huko mbinguni.)

english: But if I drive out demons by the finger of God, then the kingdom of God has come upon you.
ekegusii: Korende kondaserie ebirecha ase ekiara kia Nyasae, nabo oborwoti bwa Nyasae bwabacheire.
swahili: Lakini kama mimi ninatoa pepo wachafu kwa kidole cha Mungu, basi Ufalme wa Mungu umewajia.

english: When a strong man, fully armed, guards his house, his possessions are secure.
ekegusii: Omonto bw’echinguru ore n’ebinto bi’esegi, gakorenda enyomba yaye, enibo yaye nigo ekoba ase omorembe,
swahili: “Mtu mwenye nguvu aliyejifunga silaha anapoilinda nyumba yake, mali yake iko salama.

english: But when someone stronger attacks and overpowers him, he takes away the armor in which the man trusted, and then he divides up his plunder.
ekegusii: korende oyore ne chinguru kobua, ere karamochiere na komobua, nigo akomoura ebinto biaye bi’esegi bionsi ebiegenerete, na ebisakorwa biaye obiatanana.
swahili: Lakini mtu mwenye nguvu zaidi kumliko akimshambulia na kumshinda, yeye humnyangʼanya silaha zake zote alizozitegemea, na kuchukua nyara.

english: He who is not with Me is against Me, and he who does not gather with Me scatters. An Unclean Spirit Returns (Matthew 12:43–45)
ekegusii: Omonto otari amo nainche nigo are mamincha ase ’nde, na ere oyotari gosangereria amo nainche nigo agoserebania. Okoirana kw’omoika bw’ebirecha (Mat 12:43-45)
swahili: “Mtu asiyekuwa pamoja nami yu kinyume nami, na mtu ambaye hakusanyi pamoja nami, hutawanya. Kurudi Kwa Pepo Mchafu (Mathayo 12:43-45)

english: When an unclean spirit comes out of a man, it passes through arid places seeking rest and does not find it. Then it says, ‘I will return to the house I left.’
ekegusii: “Ekero ekerecha ki’eubi kiarure ase omonto, nigo kegoeta gati aase atari namaache, gekorigia aase kegotimokera; getanyoreti kiabora: Ning’irane ase enyomba yane ase narwete.
swahili: “Pepo mchafu amtokapo mtu, hutangatanga katika sehemu zisizo na maji akitafuta mahali pa kupumzika, lakini hapati. Ndipo husema, ‘Nitarudi kwenye nyumba yangu nilikotoka.’

english: On its return, it finds the house swept clean and put in order.
ekegusii: Gakegocha, kiayenyora yaabusirwe, yaroisigwe.
swahili: Naye arudipo na kuikuta ile nyumba imefagiliwa na kupangwa vizuri,

english: Then it goes and brings seven other spirits more wicked than itself, and they go in and dwell there. And the final plight of that man is worse than the first.” True Blessedness
ekegusii: Erio kiagenda, kiarentana ebirecha bitano na bibere binde ebire ebibe gokebua kerokio ekenyene. Birobio bigosoa na komenya aroro; okoba kw’omoerio kw’omonto oyio kwaba okobe kobua okwe ritang’ani.” Ogosesenigwa gwekeene
swahili: ndipo huenda na kuchukua pepo wachafu wengine saba wabaya kuliko yeye mwenyewe, nao huingia na kukaa humo. Nayo hali ya mwisho ya yule mtu huwa ni mbaya kuliko ile ya kwanza.”

english: As Jesus was saying these things, a woman in the crowd raised her voice and said, “Blessed is the womb that bore You, and blessed are the breasts that nursed You!”
ekegusii: Ekero agokwana aya, omokungu oyomo ase omoganda agaaka eriogi, akamoteebia, “Nesesenirie enda yakobogoretie, ne chimbeere kwagongete!”
swahili: Ikawa Yesu alipokuwa akisema hayo, mwanamke mmoja katikati ya ule umati wa watu akapaza sauti akasema, “Limebarikiwa tumbo lililokuzaa na matiti uliyonyonya!”

english: But He replied, “Blessed rather are those who hear the word of God and obey it.” The Sign of Jonah (Jonah 3:1–10; Matthew 12:38–42)
ekegusii: Korende Yeso akabora, “Mbuya kobua, basesenirie abakoigwa ring’ana ria Nyasae na koribwata!” Ogokuurerwa ase ogotarigia ebikone (Mat 12:38-42; Mar 8:12)
swahili: Yesu akajibu, “Wamebarikiwa zaidi wale wanaolisikia neno la Mungu na kulitii.” Ishara Ya Yona (Mathayo 12:38-42)

english: As the crowds were increasing, Jesus said, “This is a wicked generation. It demands a sign, but none will be given it except the sign of Jonah.
ekegusii: Ekero emeganda yamentekanete, agachaaka gokwana, “Ekegori eke nekegori ekebe, gekorigia egekone buna ekemanyererio, korende tigekoegwa egekone otatiga eki’omobani Yona.
swahili: Umati wa watu ulipokuwa unazidi kuongezeka, Yesu akaendelea kusema, “Hiki ni kizazi kiovu. Kinatafuta ishara, lakini hakitapewa ishara yoyote isipokuwa ile ya Yona.

english: Give us each day our daily bread.
ekegusii: Otoe kera rituko endagera yaito.
swahili: Utupatie kila siku riziki yetu.

english: For as Jonah was a sign to the Ninevites, so the Son of Man will be a sign to this generation.
ekegusii: Naki buna Yona abeete ekemanyererio ase abanto ba Ninawi, naboigo Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto arache koba ase ekegori eke.
swahili: Kwa maana kama vile Yona alivyokuwa ishara kwa watu wa Ninawi, ndivyo Mwana wa Adamu atakavyokuwa ishara kwa kizazi hiki.

english: The Queen of the South will rise at the judgment with the men of this generation and condemn them; for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon, and now One greater than Solomon is here.
ekegusii: Enting’ana ya Irianyi netenene ase rituko ri’ekiina amo nabaanto b’ekegori eke; ere nabanachere ekiina, ekiagera nigo arwete ase chinsinyo chi’ense anyare koigwa obong’aini bwa Sulemani; na rora, oyobuete Sulemani naiga are.
swahili: Malkia wa Kusini atasimama wakati wa hukumu na kuwahukumu watu wa kizazi hiki. Kwa kuwa yeye alikuja kutoka miisho ya dunia ili kuisikiliza hekima ya Solomoni. Na hapa yupo aliye mkuu kuliko Solomoni.

english: The men of Nineveh will stand at the judgment with this generation and condemn it; for they repented at the preaching of Jonah, and now One greater than Jonah is here. The Lamp of the Body (Matthew 6:22–24)
ekegusii: Abanto ba Ninawi nabatenene ase rituko ri’ekiina amo nabaanto b’ekegori eke, na barabwo nabakenachere ekiina ekegori eke, ekiagera baonchogete ase okorandia kwa Yona; na rora, oyobuete Yona naiga are. Amorokererio korwa ase etaya (Mat 5:15; 6:22-23)
swahili: Siku ya hukumu, watu wa Ninawi watasimama pamoja na kizazi hiki na kukihukumu; kwa maana wao walitubu waliposikia mahubiri ya Yona. Na tazama, hapa yupo yeye aliye mkuu kuliko Yona. Taa Ya Mwili (Mathayo 5:15; 6:22-23)

english: No one lights a lamp and puts it in a cellar or under a basket. Instead, he sets it on a stand, so those who enter can see the light.
ekegusii: “Omonto gatongirie etaaya tari koyebeeka ase ekenunchi gose ayemumeke negetonga, korende nigo akoyebeeka igoro ase ekebekerero, erinde abagosoa barore oborabu.
swahili: “Hakuna mtu yeyote awashaye taa na kuiweka mahali palipofichika au kuifunikia chini ya bakuli. Badala yake huiweka juu ya kinara chake, ili watu wote wanaoingia waone nuru.

english: Your eye is the lamp of your body. When your eyes are good, your whole body also is full of light. But when they are bad, your body is full of darkness.
ekegusii: Etaaya y’omobere oo neriiso riao; ekero eriso riao rire rigiya, omobere oo bwonsi nigo oichire noborabu; korende ekero eriiso riao rire riibe, omobere oo bwonsi nigo oichire nomosunte.
swahili: Jicho lako ni taa ya mwili wako. Kama jicho lako ni zima, mwili wako wote pia umejaa nuru. Lakini kama jicho ni bovu, mwili wako wote pia umejaa giza.

english: Be careful, then, that the light within you is not darkness.
ekegusii: Gaki renda, oborabu obwo bore ime yao tibocha koba omosunte.
swahili: Kwa hiyo, hakikisha kwamba nuru iliyoko ndani yako isiwe giza.

english: So if your whole body is full of light, with no part of it in darkness, you will be radiant, as though a lamp were shining on you.” Woes to Pharisees and Experts in the Law (Matthew 23:1–36)
ekegusii: Nabo omobere oo bwonsi korabe noborabu, ensemo ende teba omosunte, omobere oo noichore noborabu kegima, buna etaya ase amasase aye egwoka oborabu.” Yeso ogokwana obobe igoro y’Abafarisai na aborokia b’amachiiko (Mat 23:1-36; Mar 12:38-40; Luk 20:45-47)
swahili: Basi ikiwa mwili wako wote umejaa nuru, bila sehemu yake yoyote kuwa gizani, basi utakuwa na nuru kama vile taa ikuangazavyo kwa nuru yake.” Yesu Awashutumu Mafarisayo Na Wanasheria (Mathayo 23:1-36; Marko 12:38-40)

english: As Jesus was speaking, a Pharisee invited Him to dine with him; so He went in and reclined at the table.
ekegusii: Ekero arenge gokwana, Omofarisai oyomo akamorangeria aragere amo nere. Agasoa, agaikaransa koragera.
swahili: Yesu alipomaliza kuzungumza, Farisayo mmoja alimwalika nyumbani mwake kwa chakula. Yesu akaingia na kuketi katika sehemu yake mezani.

english: But the Pharisee was surprised to see that Jesus did not first wash before the meal.
ekegusii: Omofarisai oria agachia korora, agakumia ekiagera ataisabete ritang’ani atararagera.
swahili: Yule Farisayo akashangaa kwamba Yesu hakunawa kwanza kabla ya kula.

english: “Now then,” said the Lord, “you Pharisees clean the outside of the cup and dish, but inside you are full of greed and wickedness.
ekegusii: Omonene akamoteebia, “Bono inwe Abafarisai iga mogosibia egekombe na esani korwa isiko, korende ime yaino nigo moichire obouri na obobe.
swahili: Ndipo Bwana akamwambia, “Sasa, enyi Mafarisayo, mnasafisha kikombe na sahani kwa nje, lakini ndani mmejaa unyangʼanyi na uovu.

english: And forgive us our sins, for we also forgive everyone who sins against us. And lead us not into temptation. ’” Ask, Seek, Knock (Matthew 7:7–12)
ekegusii: Otwabere ebibe biaito, ekiagera intwe tokwabera kera oyomo otokorire bobe. Totoira ase ogoteemwa. Ogosaba gw’okogenderera, na omoreng’anio bw’omosani ore gosaba omogati botuko gati (Mat 7:7-11)
swahili: Utusamehe dhambi zetu, kwa kuwa na sisi huwasamehe wote wanaotukosea. Wala usitutie majaribuni (bali utuokoe kutoka kwa yule mwovu).’ ”

english: You fools! Did not the One who made the outside make the inside as well?
ekegusii: Inwe abariri, ere oyokorete egia isiko, tari ere okorete nekia ime nakerokio?
swahili: Enyi wapumbavu! Hamjui kuwa yeye aliyetengeneza nje ndiye alitengeneza na ndani pia?

english: But give as alms the things that are within you, and you will see that everything is clean for you.
ekegusii: Korende karue esadaka y’ebire ime; naende rora, ebinto bionsi nebichenu ase more.
swahili: Basi toeni sadaka ya vile mlivyo navyo, na tazama, vitu vyote vitakuwa safi kwenu.

english: Woe to you Pharisees! You pay tithes of mint, rue, and every herb, but you disregard justice and the love of God. You should have practiced the latter without neglecting the former.
ekegusii: “Korende obobe nobwaino Abafarisai, ekiagera mokorua ensemo ya ikomi ye chiarare, na kera egesaku gie chinyeni, mogotiga oboronge na obwanchani bwa Nyasae. Naro aya nabagwenerete moyakore, motari gotiga ayande.
swahili: “Lakini ole wenu, Mafarisayo, kwa maana mnampa Mungu zaka za mnanaa, mchicha na kila aina ya mboga, lakini mnapuuza haki na upendo wa Mungu. Iliwapasa kufanya haya ya pili bila kupuuza hayo ya kwanza.

english: Woe to you Pharisees! You love the chief seats in the synagogues and the greetings in the marketplaces.
ekegusii: Obobe nobwaino, Abafarisai! Ekiagera mwanchete goikaransa ebirogo bia bosio ase chisinagogi, na gokwanigwa namasikani ase chichiiro.
swahili: “Ole wenu Mafarisayo, kwa sababu ninyi mnapenda kukalia viti vya mbele katika masinagogi, na kusalimiwa kwa heshima masokoni.

english: Woe to you! For you are like unmarked graves, which men walk over without even noticing.”
ekegusii: Obobe nobwaino! Ekiagera mogwekaine chimbeera chitari kororekana, na abanto baeta igoro yaye batamanyeti.”
swahili: “Ole wenu, kwa sababu ninyi ni kama makaburi yasiyokuwa na alama, ambayo watu huyakanyaga pasipo kujua.”

english: One of the experts in the law told Him, “Teacher, when You say these things, You insult us as well.”
ekegusii: Omworokia oyomo bw’amachiiko akairaneria, akamoteebia, “Omworokia, kogoteeba aya, nigo ogotochaaya naintwe.”
swahili: Mtaalamu mmoja wa sheria akamjibu, akasema, “Mwalimu, unaposema mambo haya, unatutukana na sisi pia.”

english: “Woe to you as well, experts in the law!” He replied. “You weigh men down with heavy burdens, but you yourselves will not lift a finger to lighten their load.
ekegusii: Agateeba, “Nainwe aborokia b’amachiiko, obobe nobwaino! Ekiagera mogotweka abanto chigurube chindito, na inwe abanyene timori gokuna chigurube echio nonya nase ekemo ki’ebiara biaino.
swahili: Yesu akamjibu, “Nanyi wataalamu wa sheria, ole wenu, kwa sababu mnawatwika watu mizigo mizito ambayo hawawezi kubeba, wala ninyi wenyewe hamwinui hata kidole kimoja kuwasaidia.

english: Woe to you! You build tombs for the prophets, but it was your fathers who killed them.
ekegusii: Obobe nobwaino! Ekiagera mokoagacha chimbeera chi’ababani, abwo chisokoro chiaino chiaitete.
swahili: “Ole wenu, kwa sababu ninyi mnajenga makaburi ya manabii waliouawa na baba zenu.

english: So you are witnesses consenting to the deeds of your fathers: They killed the prophets, and you build their tombs.
ekegusii: Naboigo inwe mwabeire abarori na gwanchera ogokora gwe chisokoro chiaino, ekiagera nabwo baabaitete, na inwe mokoagacha chimbeera chiabo.
swahili: Hivyo ninyi mwashuhudia na mnathibitisha kile baba zenu walichofanya. Wao waliwaua manabii, nanyi mnawajengea makaburi.

english: Because of this, the wisdom of God said, ‘I will send them prophets and apostles; some of them they will kill and others they will persecute.’
ekegusii: Nase ayio obong’aini bwa Nyasae nigo bwateebete: Nintome ase bare ababani na abatomwa; baite abande babo na kobachanda,
swahili: Kwa sababu ya jambo hili, Mungu katika hekima yake alisema, ‘Tazama, nitatuma kwao manabii na mitume, nao watawaua baadhi yao na wengine watawatesa.’

english: Then Jesus said to them, “Suppose one of you goes to his friend at midnight and says, ‘Friend, lend me three loaves of bread,
ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Ning’o ase more ore nomosani oramochiere botuko gati amoteebie: Mosani, ing’a singo emegati etato,
swahili: Kisha akawaambia, “Ni nani miongoni mwenu mwenye rafiki yake, naye akamwendea usiku wa manane na kumwambia, ‘Rafiki, nikopeshe mikate mitatu.

english: As a result, this generation will be charged with the blood of all the prophets that has been shed since the foundation of the world,
ekegusii: erinde amanyinga y’ababani bonsi, ayaitegete korwa omochakano bw’ense naganigwe korwa ase ekegori eke,
swahili: Kwa hiyo kizazi hiki kitawajibika kwa ajili ya damu ya manabii iliyomwagwa tangu kuwekwa misingi ya ulimwengu,

english: from the blood of Abel to the blood of Zechariah, who was killed between the altar and the sanctuary. Yes, I tell you, all of it will be charged to this generation.
ekegusii: korwa amanyinga y’Abeli goika amanyinga a Zakaria; oria oiteretwe gati y’egesasiimero ne Hekalu. Ee, nabateebirie, narigigwe korwa ase ekegori eke.
swahili: tangu damu ya Abeli mpaka damu ya Zekaria, aliyeuawa kati ya madhabahu na mahali patakatifu. Naam, nawaambia, kizazi hiki kitawajibika kwa haya yote.

english: Woe to you experts in the law! For you have taken away the key to knowledge. You yourselves have not entered, and you have hindered those who were entering.”
ekegusii: Obobe nobwaino, inwe aborokia b’amachiiko! Ekiagera mwarusirie ekeigorero gie chisemi; inwe abanyene timwasoa, na baria abaare gosoa mwabatangire.”
swahili: “Ole wenu ninyi wataalamu wa sheria, kwa sababu mmeuondoa ufunguo wa maarifa. Ninyi wenyewe hamkuingia, na wale waliokuwa wanaingia mkawazuia.”

english: As Jesus went on from there, the scribes and Pharisees began to oppose Him bitterly and to ply Him with questions about many things,
ekegusii: Agachia gosoka korwa aroro, aborokia b’amariiko na Abafarisai bagachaaka komomiga namaborio amakong’u, na komochegia akwane igoro y’ebinto ebinge;
swahili: Yesu alipoondoka huko, walimu wa sheria na Mafarisayo wakaanza kumpinga vikali na kumsonga kwa maswali,

english: waiting to catch Him in something He might say.
ekegusii: bakomotega, banyore ring’ana korwa ase omonwa oye, erinde banyare komosoera.
swahili: wakivizia kumkamata kwa kitu atakachosema ili wamshtaki.

english: because a friend of mine has come to me on a journey, and I have nothing to set before him.’
ekegusii: ekiagera omosani one ochire ase ’nde korwa orogendo, na inche tindi na gento nkomoa;
swahili: Kwa sababu rafiki yangu amekuja kutoka safarini, nami sina kitu cha kumpa.’

english: And suppose the one inside answers, ‘Do not bother me. My door is already shut, and my children and I are in bed. I cannot get up to give you anything.’
ekegusii: na oria ore ime namoiranerie, na goteeba: Tondosia, egesieri giasiekirwe, na inche amo nabana baane twararire borere, tinkonyara koimoka nkoe?
swahili: “Kisha yule aliyeko ndani amjibu, ‘Usinisumbue. Mlango umefungwa, nami na watoto wangu tumelala. Siwezi kuamka nikupe chochote.’

english: I tell you, even though he will not get up to provide for him because of his friendship, yet because of the man’s persistence, he will get up and give him as much as he needs.
ekegusii: Nabatebirie, nataimoka amoe ekiagera nomosani oye, korende ekiagera oria tari gotiga ogosaba, naimoke na komoa ebio bionsi arigetie.
swahili: Nawaambia, ingawa huyo mtu hataamka na kumpa hiyo mikate kwa sababu ni rafiki yake, lakini kwa sababu ya kuendelea kwake kuomba, ataamka na kumpa kiasi anachohitaji.

english: So I tell you: Ask, and it will be given to you; seek, and you will find; knock, and the door will be opened to you.
ekegusii: Na inche nkobateebia nde inwe: Saba, namoegwe; rigia, namonyore; tura, namoigorerwe.
swahili: “Kwa hiyo nawaambia: Ombeni nanyi mtapewa; tafuteni nanyi mtapata; bisheni nanyi mtafunguliwa mlango.

english: In the meantime, a crowd of many thousands had gathered, so that they were trampling one another. Jesus began to speak first to His disciples: “Beware of the leaven of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy.
ekegusii: Ekero ekio omosangererekano bw’abaanto chilifu chinyinge bagachia gosangerereka goika bagatachana. Yeso agachaaka goteebia aborokigwa baye ritang’ani, Mwerende nememera y’Abafarisai, engencho yaye nobong’ainereria.
swahili: Wakati huo, umati mkubwa wa watu maelfu, walipokuwa wamekusanyika hata wakawa wanakanyagana, Yesu akaanza kuzungumza kwanza na wanafunzi wake, akawaambia: “Jihadharini na chachu ya Mafarisayo, yaani, unafiki wao.

english: And everyone who speaks a word against the Son of Man will be forgiven, but whoever blasphemes against the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven.
ekegusii: Na kera oyomo orakwane ring’ana riibe igoro ase Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto, naaberwe; korende ere oyorarame Omoika Omochenu takwaberwa.
swahili: Naye kila atakayenena neno baya dhidi ya Mwana wa Adamu atasamehewa, lakini yeyote atakayemkufuru Roho Mtakatifu hatasamehewa.

english: When you are brought before synagogues, rulers, and authorities, do not worry about how to defend yourselves or what to say.
ekegusii: Naende kobakobaira ase chisinagogi, na ase abagaambi, na ase abare nokobua, timochandeka buna morachie koiraneria gose buna morakwane,
swahili: “Watakapowapeleka katika masinagogi, na mbele ya watawala na wenye mamlaka, msiwe na wasiwasi kuhusu namna mtakavyojitetea au mtakavyosema.

english: For at that time the Holy Spirit will teach you what you should say.” The Parable of the Rich Fool
ekegusii: ekiagera Omoika Omochenu noborokererie ensa eyio eyio ayamogwenerete gokwana. Okogania ebiabande, na omoreng’anio bw’omonda omoriri
swahili: Kwa maana Roho Mtakatifu atawafundisha wakati huo huo mnachopaswa kusema.” Mfano Wa Tajiri Mpumbavu

english: Someone in the crowd said to Him, “Teacher, tell my brother to divide the inheritance with me.”
ekegusii: Omonto oyomo ase omoganda akamoteebia, “Omworokia, teebia momura ominto anyatanere omwando oito.”
swahili: Mtu mmoja katika umati wa watu akamwambia Yesu, “Mwalimu, mwambie ndugu yangu tugawane naye urithi wetu.”

english: But Jesus replied, “Man, who appointed Me judge or executor between you?”
ekegusii: Akamoboria, “Omonto oyo, ning’o ombekire koba omogambi gose omwatanani igoro ase more?”
swahili: Lakini Yesu akamwambia, “Rafiki, ni nani aliyeniweka mimi kuwa hakimu wenu au msuluhishi juu yenu?”

english: And He said to them, “Watch out! Guard yourselves against every form of greed, for one’s life does not consist in the abundance of his possessions.”
