ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Rigereria, erende korwa ase okogania okobe, ekiagera obogima bw’omonto tibori ase obonge bw’enibo yaye abwate.”
swahili: Ndipo Yesu akawaambia, “Jihadharini! Jilindeni na aina zote za choyo. Kwa maana maisha ya mtu hayatokani na wingi wa mali alizo nazo.”

english: Then He told them a parable: “The ground of a certain rich man produced an abundance.
ekegusii: Akabateebia omoreng’anio, akabora, “Omogondo bw’omonto omonda okama mono.
swahili: Kisha akawaambia mfano huu: “Shamba la mtu mmoja tajiri lilizaa sana.

english: So he thought to himself, ‘What shall I do, since I have nowhere to store my crops?’
ekegusii: Agachaaka korengereria ase omoyo oye ime: Inki ngokora, ekiagera tindi nase nkobeeka okwama kwane?
swahili: Akawaza moyoni mwake, ‘Nifanye nini? Sina mahali pa kuhifadhi mavuno yangu.’

english: Then he said, ‘This is what I will do: I will tear down my barns and will build bigger ones, and there I will store up all my grain and my goods.
ekegusii: Akabora: Ninkore iga: Nintagore ebiage biane, mbiagache ebinene kobua, na aroro ningache endagera yane yonsi, na ebinto biane.
swahili: “Ndipo huyo tajiri akasema, ‘Nitafanya hivi: Nitabomoa ghala zangu za nafaka na kujenga nyingine kubwa zaidi na huko nitayahifadhi mavuno yangu yote na vitu vyangu.

english: Then I will say to myself, “You have plenty of good things laid up for many years. Take it easy. Eat, drink, and be merry!”’
ekegusii: Erio ninteebie omoyo one: Aye omoyo, nore nenibo enyinge kwegacheire emonga y’emiaka emenge; timoka, orie, onywe, ogoke.
swahili: Nami nitaiambia nafsi yangu, “Nafsi, unavyo vitu vingi vizuri ulivyojiwekea akiba kwa miaka mingi. Pumzika; kula, unywe, ufurahi.” ’

english: There is nothing concealed that will not be disclosed, and nothing hidden that will not be made known.
ekegusii: Korende ing’ana rinde tiriri rimumekeirie, ritache koorokigwa, gose eribisekanete ritache komanyekana.
swahili: Hakuna jambo lolote lililositirika ambalo halitafunuliwa, au lililofichwa ambalo halitajulikana.

english: But God said to him, ‘You fool! This very night your life will be required of you. Then who will own what you have accumulated?’
ekegusii: Korende Nyasae akamoteebia: Omoriri oyo, obotuko obo omoyo oo oraganigwa, na enibo kwegacheire ang’e, neya ng’o erabe?
swahili: “Lakini Mungu akamwambia, ‘Mpumbavu wewe! Usiku huu uhai wako unatakiwa. Sasa hivyo vitu ulivyojiwekea akiba vitakuwa vya nani?’

english: This is how it will be for anyone who stores up treasure for himself but is not rich toward God.” Do Not Worry (Matthew 6:25–34)
ekegusii: Naboigo are ere oyokwegachera emonga omonyene, na ere tari omonda ase Nyasae.” Ogwechanda na okomosemeria Nyasae (Mat 6:25-34)
swahili: “Hivyo ndivyo ilivyo kwa wale wanaojiwekea mali lakini hawajitajirishi kwa Mungu.” Msiwe Na Wasiwasi (Mathayo 6:25-34)

english: Then Jesus said to His disciples, “Therefore I tell you, do not worry about your life, what you will eat, or about your body, what you will wear.
ekegusii: Agateebia aborokigwa baye, “Ase aya nabateebirie, timochandeka igoro y’obogima bwaino, eki morarie; gose ase emebere yaino, eki morabeeke.
swahili: Kisha Yesu akawaambia wanafunzi wake: “Kwa hiyo nawaambia, msisumbukie maisha yenu kwamba mtakula nini; au msumbukie miili yenu kwamba mtavaa nini.

english: For life is more than food, and the body more than clothes.
ekegusii: Ekiagera obogima nobonene kobua endagera, na omobere nomonene kobua chianga.
swahili: Maisha ni zaidi ya chakula, na mwili ni zaidi ya mavazi.

english: Consider the ravens: They do not sow or reap, they have no storehouse or barn; yet God feeds them. How much more valuable you are than the birds!
ekegusii: Rigereria ebigonkoru, tibiri gosimeka, tibiri kogesa, tibiri nemonga gose ekiage, korende Nyasae nigo akobirageria. Na inwe imobuete rigori rie chinyoni!
swahili: Fikirini ndege! Wao hawapandi wala hawavuni, hawana ghala wala popote pa kuhifadhi nafaka; lakini Mungu huwalisha. Ninyi ni wa thamani zaidi kuliko ndege!

english: Who of you by worrying can add a single hour to his life?
ekegusii: Ning’o ore ase more oranyare gwechanda komenta ekerengo gi’okoboko okomo ase obotambe bwaye?
swahili: Ni nani miongoni mwenu ambaye kwa kujitaabisha kwake anaweza kujiongezea hata saa moja zaidi katika maisha yake?

english: So if you cannot do such a small thing, why do you worry about the rest?
ekegusii: Ase ayio, onye timori konyara gokora nonya ne ring’ana erire riike buna eri, nase ki mogwechandera amang’ana ande?
swahili: Kama hamwezi kufanya jambo dogo kama hilo, kwa nini basi kuyasumbukia hayo mengine?

english: Consider how the lilies grow: They do not labor or spin. Yet I tell you, not even Solomon in all his glory was adorned like one of these.
ekegusii: Rigereria ebisicha buna bigokina; tibiri gokora emeremo gose gwesisa, korende nabateebirie, nonya n’Sulemani ase obonene bwaye bwonsi tabegete chianga buna ekemo ki’ebi.
swahili: “Angalieni maua jinsi yameavyo: Hayafanyi kazi wala hayafumi. Lakini nawaambia, hata Solomoni katika fahari yake yote hakuvikwa vizuri kama mojawapo ya hayo maua.

english: If that is how God clothes the grass of the field, which is here today and tomorrow is thrown into the furnace, how much more will He clothe you, O you of little faith!
ekegusii: Onye Nyasae okoboyia obonyansi bw’egetii oboreo reero, na ankio botugutwe ase omorero, Inee, takomenta kobaboyia inwe abamore nokwegena ogoke?
swahili: Basi ikiwa Mungu huyavika hivi majani ya shambani, ambayo leo yapo, na kesho yanatupwa motoni, si atawavika ninyi vizuri zaidi, enyi wa imani haba!

english: And do not be concerned about what you will eat or drink. Do not worry about it.
ekegusii: Inwe, timorigia eki morarie, gose eki moranywe; gose timoba nomoyo bw’ogwechanda.
swahili: Wala msisumbuke mioyoni mwenu mtakula nini au mtakunywa nini. Msiwe na wasiwasi juu ya haya.

english: What you have spoken in the dark will be heard in the daylight, and what you have whispered in the inner rooms will be proclaimed from the housetops. Fear God Alone (Matthew 10:26–31)
ekegusii: Nabo onsi aya mogokwana ase omosunte, naigugwe ase omobaso; naro aya mokomonyererana ase ebinyomba ime nararigwe igoro ase ebirama. Oyogwenerete koirokwa (Mat 10:28-33)
swahili: Kwa hiyo, lolote mlilosema gizani litasikiwa nuruni. Na kile mlichonongʼona masikioni mkiwa kwenye vyumba vya ndani, kitatangazwa juu ya paa.

english: For the Gentiles of the world strive after all these things, and your Father knows that you need them.
ekegusii: Naki abanto b’ebisaku bi’ense nigo bakorigia ebinto ebio bionsi, korende Iso oino omanyire ng’a moganetie ebio bionsi,
swahili: Watu wa mataifa ya duniani husumbuka sana kuhusu vitu hivi vyote, lakini Baba yenu anafahamu kuwa mnahitaji haya yote.

english: But seek His kingdom, and these things will be added unto you. Treasures in Heaven (Matthew 6:19–21)
ekegusii: Korende rigia oborwoti bwa Nyasae, na ebinto ebio namomenterwe inwe.
swahili: Bali utafuteni Ufalme wa Mungu, na haya yote atawapa pia. Utajiri Wa Mbinguni (Mathayo 6:19-21)

english: Do not be afraid, little flock, for your Father is pleased to give you the kingdom.
ekegusii: “Timoiroka inwe abamore omoganda omoke, ekiagera Iso oino ororire buya kobaa oborwoti.
swahili: “Msiogope enyi kundi dogo, kwa maana Baba yenu ameona vyema kuwapa ninyi Ufalme.

english: Sell your possessions and give to the poor. Provide yourselves with purses that will not wear out, an inexhaustible treasure in heaven, where no thief approaches and no moth destroys.
ekegusii: Oonia ebio more nabio, morue ebiegwa; mwekorere ebimoya bitari kogota amo nenibo etari gokea igoro, aase omoibi atagoika, gose ebigwankwa gosaria.
swahili: Uzeni mali zenu mkawape maskini. Jifanyieni mifuko isiyochakaa, mkajiwekee hazina mbinguni isiyokwisha, mahali ambapo mwizi hakaribii wala nondo haharibu.

english: For where your treasure is, there your heart will be also. Readiness at Any Hour (Matthew 24:36–51; Mark 13:32–37)
ekegusii: Ekiagera aase chinibo chiaino chire nao chinkoro chiaino chikoba. Okogania gw’okorenda, na omoreng’anio bw’abasomba abegenwa na abatari abegenwa
swahili: Kwa sababu mahali hazina yako ilipo, hapo ndipo moyo wako utakapokuwa pia. Kukesha

english: Be dressed for service and keep your lamps burning.
ekegusii: “Tiga ebinema biaino biboyigwe, ne chitaaya chiaino chioke;
swahili: “Kuweni tayari mkiwa mmevikwa kwa ajili ya huduma na taa zenu zikiwa zinawaka,

english: Then you will be like servants waiting for their master to return from the wedding banquet, so that when he comes and knocks, they can open the door for him at once.
ekegusii: na inwe mobe buna abanto baganyete omonene obo, gakoirana korwa ase omoyega bw’enyangi, erinde kagocha na gotura, erio kegima bamoigorere.
swahili: kama watumishi wanaomngojea bwana wao arudi kutoka kwenye karamu ya arusi, ili ajapo na kubisha mlango waweze kumfungulia mara.

english: Blessed are those servants whom the master finds on watch when he returns. Truly I tell you, he will dress himself to serve and will have them recline at the table, and he himself will come and wait on them.
ekegusii: Mbasesenirie abasomba baria ekero omonene obo agocha abanyore barendete. Ekeene nabateebirie: Neboyie, abaikaransie ase endagera, ache abakorere.
swahili: Heri wale watumishi ambao bwana wao atakapokuja atawakuta wakiwa wanakesha. Amin, nawaambia, atajifunga mkanda wake na kuwaketisha ili wale, naye atakuja na kuwahudumia.

english: Even if he comes in the second or third watch of the night and finds them alert, those servants will be blessed.
ekegusii: Naende karache ase oborendi bwa kabere gose oborendi bwa gatato, abanyore barendete, mbare nomogooko abasomba baria.
swahili: Itakuwa heri kwa watumwa hao ikiwa bwana wao atakapokuja atawakuta wamekesha hata kama atakuja mnamo usiku wa manane, au karibu na mapambazuko.

english: But understand this: If the homeowner had known at what hour the thief was coming, he would not have let his house be broken into.
ekegusii: Korende manya aya, onye omonyene enyomba namanyete ensa omoibi agocha, anga narendete, taiberwa.
swahili: Lakini fahamuni jambo hili: Kama mwenye nyumba angalijua saa mwizi atakuja, asingaliiacha nyumba yake kuvunjwa.

english: I tell you, My friends, do not be afraid of those who kill the body and after that can do no more.
ekegusii: Nabatebirie inwe abasani baane, timoiroka abwo bagoita omobere, na magega ase ayio tibari negento baranyare gokora kobua.
swahili: “Nawaambieni rafiki zangu, msiwaogope wale wauao mwili, lakini baada ya hilo hawawezi kufanya lolote zaidi.

english: You also must be ready, because the Son of Man will come at an hour you do not expect.”
ekegusii: Nainwe nabo, mobe ang’e, ekiagera ensa motakagereti, nero Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto arache.”
swahili: Ninyi nanyi hamna budi kuwa tayari, kwa sababu Mwana wa Adamu atakuja saa msiyotazamia.” Mtumishi Mwaminifu Na Yule Asiye Mwaminifu (Mathayo 24:45-51)

english: “Lord,” said Peter, “are You addressing this parable to us, or to everyone else as well?”
ekegusii: Petero akamobooria, “Omonene, nintwe ogoteebia omoreng’anio oyo, gose nase abanto bonsi?”
swahili: Ndipo Petro akamuuliza, “Bwana, mfano huu unatuambia sisi peke yetu au watu wote?”

english: And the Lord answered, “Who then is the faithful and wise manager, whom the master puts in charge of his servants to give them their portion at the proper time?
ekegusii: Omonene akabora, “Ning’o rende ore omosomba omwegenwa, naende ore omong’aini, omonene oye arabeeke igoro ase enyomba yaye yonsi, ae abanto endagera ekerengo kiabo ase ekero kegwenerete?
swahili: Yesu akamjibu, “Ni yupi basi wakili mwaminifu na mwenye busara, ambaye bwana wake atamfanya msimamizi juu ya watumishi wake wote, ili awape watumishi wengine chakula chao wakati unaofaa?

english: Blessed is that servant whose master finds him doing so when he returns.
ekegusii: Nasesenirie omosomba oria ekero omonene oye arache amonyore ogokora bo.
swahili: Heri mtumishi yule ambaye bwana wake atakaporudi atamkuta akifanya hivyo.

english: Truly I tell you, he will put him in charge of all his possessions.
ekegusii: Ekeene nabateebirie, namobeke igoro ase ebi abwate bionsi.
swahili: Amin nawaambia, atamweka mtumishi huyo kuwa msimamizi wa mali yake yote.

english: But suppose that servant says in his heart, ‘My master will be a long time in coming,’ and he begins to beat the menservants and maidservants, and to eat and drink and get drunk.
ekegusii: Korende omosomba oria karateebe ase omoyo oye ime: Omonene one otebanire gocha, naende achake goaka abasomba bande, abasacha na abakungu, na koria, na konywa, na gotinda,
swahili: Lakini kama yule mtumishi atasema moyoni mwake, ‘Bwana wangu anakawia kurudi,’ kisha akaanza kuwapiga wale watumishi wa kiume na wa kike, na kula na kunywa na kulewa.

english: The master of that servant will come on a day he does not expect and at an hour he does not anticipate. Then he will cut him to pieces and assign him a place with the unbelievers.
ekegusii: omonene bw’omosomba oria nachiche rituko atakagereti, na ensa atamanyeti, nigo aramonachane abe ebing’ese, namoe ensemo yaye amo nabategeneti.
swahili: Basi bwana wa mtumishi huyo atakuja siku asiyodhani na saa asiyoijua. Atamkata vipande vipande na kumweka katika sehemu moja pamoja na wale wasioamini.

english: That servant who knows his master’s will but does not get ready or follow his instructions will be beaten with many blows.
ekegusii: Naende omosomba oria omanyete ogwancha kw’omonene oye, na tebeka ang’e, gose gokora ogwancha kwaye, naakwe ebiranya ebiroro,
swahili: “Yule mtumishi anayefahamu vyema mapenzi ya bwana wake na asijiandae wala kufanya kama apendavyo bwana wake, atapigwa kwa mapigo mengi.

english: But the one who unknowingly does things worthy of punishment will be beaten with few blows. From everyone who has been given much, much will be required; and from him who has been entrusted with much, even more will be demanded. Not Peace but Division (Micah 7:1–6; Matthew 10:34–39)
ekegusii: korende oria otamanyeti, ko ere okorire ayagwenerete ogoakwa, naakwe ebiranya ebiororo. Kera oyoeirwe ebinge, korwa asare ere nabiganigwe ebinge; na ere oyoeirwe ebinge kobua, korwa asare nabiganigwe ebinge kobua. Ebimanyererio bi’ebiro (Mat 10:34-36; 16:1-4; Mar 8:11-13)
swahili: Lakini yeyote ambaye hakujua naye akafanya yale yastahiliyo kupigwa, atapigwa kidogo. Yeyote aliyepewa vitu vingi, atadaiwa vingi; na yeyote aliyekabidhiwa vingi, kwake vitatakiwa vingi. Yesu Kuleta Mafarakano (Mathayo 10:34-36)

english: I have come to ignite a fire on the earth, and how I wish it were already kindled!
ekegusii: “Nigo nachire gotongia omorero ase ense; onye ngwoka ore, anga ninki ndigetie naende?
swahili: “Nimekuja kuleta moto duniani; laiti kama ungekuwa tayari umewashwa!

english: But I will show you whom you should fear: Fear the One who, after you have been killed, has authority to throw you into hell. Yes, I tell you, fear Him!
ekegusii: Korende nimbakuurere oyo morairoke: Moiroke oria ore nokobua, magega ase ogoita omonto omoruta ase omorero o kare na kare. Ee, nabateebirie, moiroke oria!
swahili: Lakini nitawaambia nani wa kumwogopa: Mwogopeni yule ambaye baada ya kuua mwili, ana mamlaka ya kuwatupa motoni. Naam, nawaambia, mwogopeni huyo!

english: But I have a baptism to undergo, and how distressed I am until it is accomplished!
ekegusii: Ninde nebatiso nkobatiswa, naende ninchandeke mono goika eikeranigwe!
swahili: Lakini ninao ubatizo ambao lazima nibatizwe, nayo dhiki yangu ni kuu mpaka ubatizo huo ukamilike!

english: Do you think that I have come to bring peace to the earth? No, I tell you, but division.
ekegusii: Inee! Mokagete ng’a nigo nachire ng’ee ense omorembe? Nabatebirie, taibo, korende nogwatanana.
swahili: Mnadhani nimekuja kuleta amani duniani? La, nawaambia sivyo, nimekuja kuleta mafarakano.

english: From now on, five in one household will be divided, three against two and two against three.
ekegusii: Naki korwa bono ase enyomba nababe abanto batano baatananeke, batato ase babere, naende babere ase batato.
swahili: Kuanzia sasa, kutakuwa na watu watano katika nyumba moja, watatu dhidi ya wawili, na wawili dhidi ya watatu.

english: They will be divided, father against son and son against father, mother against daughter and daughter against mother, mother-in-law against daughter-in-law and daughter-in-law against mother-in-law. ” Interpreting the Present Time (Matthew 16:1–4; Mark 8:11–13)
ekegusii: Mbaatananeke, ise na omwana omomura, na omwana omomura na ise, ng’ina na omwana omoiseke, na omwana omoiseke na ng’ina; ng’ina biara, na moka momura oye, moka momura oye na ng’ina biara.”
swahili: Watafarakana baba dhidi ya mwanawe na mwana dhidi ya babaye, mama dhidi ya bintiye na binti dhidi ya mamaye, naye mama mkwe dhidi ya mkwewe na mkwe dhidi ya mama mkwe wake.” Kutambua Majira (Mathayo 16:2-3)

english: Then Jesus said to the crowds, “As soon as you see a cloud rising in the west, you say, ‘A shower is coming,’ and that is what happens.
ekegusii: Naende agateebia emeganda, “Ekero mokorora riire rikoimoka bosongo, erio mwateeba bwango: Embura netwe; yaba bo.
swahili: Pia Yesu akauambia ule umati wa watu, “Mwonapo wingu likitokea magharibi, mara mwasema, ‘Mvua itanyesha,’ nayo hunyesha.

english: And when the south wind blows, you say, ‘It will be hot,’ and it is.
ekegusii: Naende ekero mokorora embeo ekorwa Irianyi mwabora. Nebe eguru‐gura; yaba bo.
swahili: Nanyi mwonapo upepo wa kusini ukivuma, ninyi husema, ‘Kutakuwa na joto,’ na huwa hivyo.

english: You hypocrites! You know how to interpret the appearance of the earth and sky. Why don’t you know how to interpret the present time? Reconciling with an Adversary (Matthew 5:21–26)
ekegusii: Inwe abang’ainereria! Imomanyete ense na igoro, buna bikororekana, korende naki rende, motamanyeti ekero eke?
swahili: Enyi wanafiki! Mnajua jinsi ya kutambua kuonekana kwa dunia na anga. Inakuwaje basi kwamba mnashindwa kutambua wakati huu wa sasa?

english: And why don’t you judge for yourselves what is right?
ekegusii: “Naende naki ase emioyo yaino motari gwatanana ayare boronge?
swahili: “Kwa nini hamwamui wenyewe lililo haki?

english: Make every effort to reconcile with your adversary while you are on your way to the magistrate. Otherwise, he may drag you off to the judge, and the judge may hand you over to the officer, and the officer may throw you into prison.
ekegusii: Nabo ekero okogenda nomogosoeri oo ase omogambi, kora omokia kobwatana nere komore ’nchera, tachicha kogokurura ase omogambi, na omogambi oria akobeke ase amaboko ’omorendi bw’echela, na omorendi oria akorute echela.
swahili: Uwapo njiani na mshtaki wako kwenda kwa hakimu, jitahidi kupatana naye mkiwa njiani. La sivyo, atakupeleka kwa hakimu, naye hakimu atakukabidhi kwa afisa, naye afisa atakutupa gerezani.

english: I tell you, you will not get out until you have paid the very last penny. ”
ekegusii: Nagotebirie, tokorwa agwo nonya ng’ake goika oakane kegima ebesa y’omoerio.”
swahili: Nakuambia, hautatoka humo hadi uwe umelipa senti ya mwisho.”

english: Are not five sparrows sold for two pennies? Yet not one of them is forgotten by God.
ekegusii: Inee! Chinchiro isano tichiri koonigwa ase chitaabu ibere? Naende nonya nakamo kabo tikari kwebwa ase obosio bwa Nyasae.
swahili: Mnajua kwamba shomoro watano huuzwa kwa senti mbili? Lakini Mungu hamsahau hata mmoja wao.

english: And even the very hairs of your head are all numbered. So do not be afraid; you are worth more than many sparrows. Confessing Christ (Matthew 10:32–33)
ekegusii: Nonya nechitukia chi’emetwe yaino chiabarirwe chionsi. Timoiroka; inwe imobuete rigori rie chinchiro chinyinge.
swahili: Naam, hata nywele za vichwa vyenu zote zimehesabiwa. Hivyo msiogope, kwa maana ninyi ni wa thamani kubwa kuliko shomoro wengi.

english: I tell you, everyone who confesses Me before men, the Son of Man will also confess him before the angels of God.
ekegusii: Inche nigo nkobateebia, kera oyomo oranyatore ase Mwanyabaanto, Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto nere namwatore ase abamalaika ba Nyasae;
swahili: “Ninawaambia kwamba yeyote atakayenikiri mbele ya watu, Mwana wa Adamu naye atamkiri mbele za malaika wa Mungu.

english: But whoever denies Me before men will be denied before the angels of God.
ekegusii: korende oyorankaane ase Mwanyabaanto, nere nakaanwe ase abamalaika ba Nyasae.
swahili: Lakini yeye atakayenikana mimi mbele ya watu, Mwana wa Adamu naye atamkana mbele ya malaika wa Mungu.

english: At that time some of those present told Jesus about the Galileans whose blood Pilate had mixed with their sacrifices.
ekegusii: Ekero ekio mbachete aroro abanto bamotebetie amang’ana igoro y’Abagalili, baria Pilato asang’ananetie amanyinga abo nebing’wanso biabo.
swahili: Wakati huo huo, kulikuwa na watu waliomwambia Yesu habari za Wagalilaya ambao Pilato aliwaua, na damu ya hao watu akaichanganya na dhabihu yao waliyokuwa wanatoa.

english: One Sabbath Jesus was teaching in one of the synagogues,
ekegusii: Akaba okworokereria ase esinagogi eyemo ase rituko ri’Esabato.
swahili: Basi Yesu alikuwa akifundisha katika sinagogi mojawapo siku ya Sabato.

english: and a woman there had been disabled by a spirit for eighteen years. She was hunched over and could not stand up straight.
ekegusii: Naende rora, narengeo omokungu obwatire nekerecha ki’oboreu ase emiaka ikomi na etano na etato, na ere konya okogotaire, taare konyara kwerambora nonya ng’ake.
swahili: Wakati huo huo akaja mwanamke mmoja aliyekuwa na pepo mchafu, naye alikuwa amepinda mgongo kwa muda wa miaka kumi na minane, wala alikuwa hawezi kunyooka wima.

english: When Jesus saw her, He called her over and said, “Woman, you are set free from your disability.”
ekegusii: Ekero Yeso achia komoorora, akamorangeria, akamoteebia, “Aye omokungu, gwasiboirwe korwa ase oboreu bwao.”
swahili: Yesu alipomwona, akamwita, akamwambia, “Mwanamke, uwe huru, umepona ugonjwa wako.”

english: Then He placed His hands on her, and immediately she straightened up and began to glorify God.
ekegusii: Akabeka amaboko aye igoro asare, na ere akaramboka erio kegima, akamotogia Nyasae.
swahili: Yesu alipomwekea mikono yake, mara akasimama wima akaanza kumtukuza Mungu.

english: But the synagogue leader was indignant that Jesus had healed on the Sabbath. “There are six days for work,” he told the crowd. “So come and be healed on those days and not on the Sabbath.”
ekegusii: Korende omotang’ani bw’esinagogi eria akabea, ekiagera Yeso agwenia omonto ase rituko ri’Esabato, agateebia abanto, “Nare amatuko atano na rimo agwenerete Mwanyabaanto bakore emeremo; ase ayio, inchwo ase amatuko ayio mogwenigwe, korende tari ase rituko ri’Esabato.”
swahili: Lakini kiongozi wa sinagogi akakasirika kwa sababu Yesu alikuwa ameponya mtu siku ya Sabato. Akaambia ule umati wa watu, “Kuna siku sita ambazo watu wanapaswa kufanya kazi. Katika siku hizo, njooni mponywe, lakini si katika siku ya Sabato.”

english: “You hypocrites!” the Lord replied. “Does not each of you on the Sabbath untie his ox or donkey from the stall and lead it to water?
ekegusii: Korende Omonene akamoiraneria, “Inwe abang’ainereria, Inee, kera oyomo oino tari gosibora eng’ombe yaye gose etigere yaye korwa bweri ase rituko ri’Esabato, ogenda nero koyenyoisia?
swahili: Lakini Bwana akamjibu, “Enyi wanafiki! Je, kila mmoja wenu hamfungulii ngʼombe wake au punda wake kutoka zizini akampeleka kumnywesha maji siku ya Sabato?

english: Then should not this daughter of Abraham, whom Satan has kept bound for eighteen long years, be released from her bondage on the Sabbath day?”
ekegusii: Oyo nenyaroka ya Aburaamu; ekiagera Saitani omosibire emiaka eye ikomi na etano na etato, temogwenereti asiborwe korwa ase egesibo eke ase rituko ri’Esabato?”
swahili: Je, huyu mwanamke, ambaye ni binti wa Abrahamu, aliyeteswa na Shetani akiwa amemfunga kwa miaka yote hii kumi na minane, hakustahili kufunguliwa kutoka kifungo hicho siku ya Sabato?”

english: When Jesus said this, all His adversaries were humiliated. And the whole crowd rejoiced at all the glorious things He was doing. The Parable of the Mustard Seed (Matthew 13:31–32; Mark 4:30–34)
ekegusii: Naende ekero are gokwana aya, abanto bonsi abare koamererania nere bagasookigwa. Abanto bonsi bakagoka ase engencho y’amang’ana onsi amanene akorire. Omoreng’anio bw’entetere y’omote onga buna omosabisabi na oyo bw’ememera (Mat 13:31-33; Mar 4:30-32)
swahili: Aliposema haya, wapinzani wake wakaaibika, lakini watu wakafurahi kwa ajili ya mambo ya ajabu aliyoyafanya. Mfano Wa Punje Ya Haradali (Mathayo 13:31-32; Marko 4:30-32)

english: Then Jesus asked, “What is the kingdom of God like? To what can I compare it?
ekegusii: Naende akabora, “Oborwoti bwa Nyasae nigo boreng’anirie naki? Ninki nkoboreng’ania?
swahili: Kisha Yesu akauliza, “Ufalme wa Mungu unafanana na nini? Nitaufananisha na nini?

english: It is like a mustard seed that a man tossed into his garden. It grew and became a tree, and the birds of the air nested in its branches.” The Parable of the Leaven (Matthew 13:33)
ekegusii: Mboreng’anie nentetere y’omote onga buna omosabisabi omonto abogoretie, akayesimeka ase omogondo oye; egakina, ekaba omote. Chinyoni chia igoro chikaroisia ebiswa ase chinsagia chiaye.”
swahili: Umefanana na punje ya haradali ambayo mtu aliichukua na kuipanda katika shamba lake. Nayo ikakua, ikawa mti nao ndege wa angani wakatengeneza viota vyao kwenye matawi yake.” Mfano Wa Chachu (Mathayo 13:33)

english: To this He replied, “Do you think that these Galileans were worse sinners than all the other Galileans, because they suffered this fate?
ekegusii: Akabairaneria, akabateebia, “Mokagete ng’a Abagalili abwo nigo barenge abanyene ebibe kobua Abagalili bande bonsi, ekiagera banyorete emechando buna eyio?
swahili: Yesu akawauliza, “Mnadhani kwamba hawa Wagalilaya ambao walikufa kifo cha namna hiyo walikuwa na dhambi kuwazidi Wagalilaya wengine wote?

english: Again He asked, “To what can I compare the kingdom of God?
ekegusii: Agakwana eria kabere, “Ninki nkoreng’ania oborwoti bwa Nyasae?
swahili: Yesu akauliza tena, “Nitaufananisha Ufalme wa Mungu na nini?

english: It is like leaven that a woman took and mixed into three measures of flour, until all of it was leavened.” The Narrow Door (Matthew 7:13–14)
ekegusii: Igo boreng’anirie nememera omokungu abogoretie, akayebeka ase ebirengo bitato bi’obosie, goika bionsi bikabota.” Egesieri ekegote gochia ase obogima (Mat 7:13-14,21-23)
swahili: Unafanana na chachu ambayo mwanamke aliichukua akaichanganya katika kiasi kikubwa cha unga mpaka wote ukaumuka.” Mlango Mwembamba (Mathayo 7:13-14, 21-23)

english: Then Jesus traveled throughout the towns and villages, teaching as He made His way toward Jerusalem.
ekegusii: Ekero arenge kogenda Yerusalemu, agaeta ase emechie na ebichie okworokereria.
swahili: Yesu akapita katika miji na vijiji, akifundisha wakati alisafiri kwenda Yerusalemu.

english: “Lord,” someone asked Him, “will only a few people be saved?” Jesus answered,
ekegusii: Omonto oyomo akamobooria, “Omonene, barabwo abaratoorigwe nabake?” Akabateebia,
swahili: Mtu mmoja akamuuliza, “Bwana, ni watu wachache tu watakaookolewa?”

english: “Make every effort to enter through the narrow door. For many, I tell you, will try to enter and will not be able.
ekegusii: “Teema mono gosoa ase egesieri kere ekegote, ekiagera nabateebirie: Abanto abange nabarigie gosoa, na barabwo tibakonyara.
swahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Jitahidini sana kuingia kupitia mlango mwembamba, kwa maana nawaambia wengi watajaribu kuingia, lakini hawataweza.

english: After the master of the house gets up and shuts the door, you will stand outside knocking and saying, ‘Lord, open the door for us.’ But he will reply, ‘I do not know where you are from.’
ekegusii: Ekero omonyene enyomba araimoke na gosieka egesieri, inwe namochake gotenena isiko na gotura gesieri, mokobora, Omonene, toigorere, na ere nabairanerie: Timbamanyeti aase mokorwa.
swahili: Wakati mwenye nyumba atakapoondoka na kufunga mlango, mtasimama nje mkibisha mlango na kusema, ‘Bwana! Tufungulie mlango!’ “Lakini yeye atawajibu, ‘Siwajui ninyi, wala mtokako.’

english: Then you will say, ‘We ate and drank with you, and you taught in our streets.’
ekegusii: Erio namochake goteeba: Nigo tware koria na konywa ase obosio bwao, naye nkworokereria kwarenge ase chinchera chiaito.
swahili: “Ndipo mtamjibu, ‘Tulikula na kunywa pamoja nawe, tena ulifundisha katika mitaa yetu.’

english: And he will answer, ‘I tell you, I do not know where you are from. Depart from me, all you evildoers.’
ekegusii: Korende ere natebe: Nabatebirie, timbamanyeti aase mokorwa; karue ase ’nde, inwe mwensi abakori amabe.
swahili: “Lakini yeye atawajibu, ‘Siwajui ninyi, wala mtokako. Ondokeni kwangu, ninyi watenda maovu!’

english: There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth when you see Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and all the prophets in the kingdom of God, but you yourselves are thrown out.
ekegusii: Erio namobe nokorera na okoriania amaino, ekero morarore Aburaamu, na Isaka, na Yakobo, na ababani bonsi ase oborwoti bwa Nyasae, na inwe abanyene namotugutwe isiko.
swahili: “Ndipo kutakuwako kilio na kusaga meno, mtakapowaona Abrahamu, Isaki, Yakobo na manabii wote wakiwa katika Ufalme wa Mungu, lakini ninyi mkiwa mmetupwa nje.

english: People will come from east and west and north and south, and will recline at the table in the kingdom of God.
ekegusii: Naende mbache abanto korwa moocha na bosongo, na korwa sugusu na Irianyi, na barabwo mbaikaranse ase oborwoti bwa Nyasae.
swahili: Watu watatoka mashariki na magharibi, kaskazini na kusini, nao wataketi kwenye sehemu walizoandaliwa karamuni katika Ufalme wa Mungu.

english: No, I tell you. But unless you repent, you too will all perish.
ekegusii: Nabatebirie, taibo; korende motaonchogeti mwensi namosire boigo.
swahili: La hasha! Ninyi nanyi msipotubu, mtaangamia vivyo hivyo.

english: And indeed, some who are last will be first, and some who are first will be last.” Lament over Jerusalem (Matthew 23:37–39)
ekegusii: Na rora, mbare ab’omoerio barache koba ab’eritang’ani, naende mbare ab’eritang’ani barache koba ab’omoerio.” Obobisa bwa Herode
swahili: Tazama, kunao walio wa mwisho watakaokuwa wa kwanza, nao wa kwanza watakaokuwa wa mwisho.” Yesu Aomboleza Kwa Ajili Ya Yerusalemu (Mathayo 23:37-39)

english: At that very hour, some Pharisees came to Jesus and told Him, “Leave this place and get away, because Herod wants to kill You.”
ekegusii: Ekero keria abande b’Abafarisai bakamochiera, bakamoteebia, “Imoka korwa aa, ogende, ekiagera Herode narigetie kogoita.”
swahili: Wakati huo huo baadhi ya Mafarisayo wakamwendea Yesu na kumwambia, “Ondoka hapa uende mahali pengine kwa maana Herode anataka kukuua.”

english: But Jesus replied, “Go tell that fox, ‘Look, I will keep driving out demons and healing people today and tomorrow, and on the third day I will reach My goal.’
ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Genda moteebie ekebwe ekio: Rora ngoseria nde ebirecha, ngokora nde emeremo y’okogwenia abanto reero na ankio, ne rituko ria gatato ninkoore emeremo yane.
swahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Nendeni mkamwambie yule mbweha, ‘Ninafukuza pepo wachafu na kuponya wagonjwa leo na kesho, nami siku ya tatu nitaikamilisha kazi yangu.’

english: Nevertheless, I must keep going today and tomorrow and the next day, for it is not admissible for a prophet to perish outside of Jerusalem.
ekegusii: Korende ningwenerete kobwatia enchera yane reero, na ankio, na ankio ende, naki temogwenereti omobani asirere isiko ya Yerusalemu. Ogoichanerwa kwa Yerusalemu (Mat 23:37-39)
swahili: Sina budi kuendelea na safari yangu leo, kesho na kesho kutwa: kwa maana haiwezekani nabii kufa mahali pengine isipokuwa Yerusalemu.

english: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, who kills the prophets and stones those sent to her, how often I have longed to gather your children together as a hen gathers her chicks under her wings, but you were unwilling!
ekegusii: “Aye Yerusalemu, Yerusalemu, ogoita ababani na kobaaka amagena abatomirwe ase ore! Ng’ara karenga narigirie gosangereria abana bao buna engoko egosangereria ebichuchu biaye aase chimbaaba chiaye ime, korende timwancha!
swahili: “Ee Yerusalemu, Yerusalemu, uwauaye manabii na kuwapiga mawe wale waliotumwa kwako! Mara ngapi nimetamani kuwakusanya watoto wako pamoja, kama vile kuku akusanyavyo vifaranga wake chini ya mabawa yake, lakini hukutaka!

english: Look, your house is left to you desolate. And I tell you that you will not see Me again until you say, ‘Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord.’ ”
ekegusii: Rora, enyomba yaino mwatigeirwe ere ritombe; na inche nabateebirie ng’a timokondora nonya ng’ake, goika ekero keria morache goteeba: Nasesenirie oyogocha ase erieta ri ’Omonene.”
swahili: Tazama nyumba yenu imeachwa ukiwa. Ninawaambia, hamtaniona tena mpaka wakati ule mtakaposema, ‘Amebarikiwa yeye ajaye kwa jina la Bwana.’ ”

english: Or those eighteen who were killed when the tower of Siloam collapsed on them: Do you think that they were more sinful than all the others living in Jerusalem?
ekegusii: Gose baria ikomi na batano na batato bagweretwe norwaki orotambe ase Siloamu, rokabaita, mokagete ng’a nigo barenge abasaria kobua abanto bonsi abamenyete Yerusalemu?
swahili: Au wale watu kumi na wanane waliokufa walipoangukiwa na mnara huko Siloamu: mnadhani wao walikuwa waovu kuliko watu wote waliokuwa wanaishi Yerusalemu?

english: No, I tell you. But unless you repent, you too will all perish.” The Parable of the Barren Fig Tree (Isaiah 5:1–7)
ekegusii: Nabatebirie, taibo; korende motaonchogeti mwensi, namosire boigo.” Omoreng’anio bw’omoko omogomba
swahili: Nawaambia, la hasha! Ninyi nanyi msipotubu, wote mtaangamia vivyo hivyo.” Mfano Wa Mti Usiozaa Matunda

english: Then Jesus told this parable: “A man had a fig tree that was planted in his vineyard. He went to look for fruit on it, but did not find any.
ekegusii: Agakwana omoreng’anio oyo, “Omonto oyomo narenge nomoko osimekire ase omogondo oye bw’emesabibu; akagenda korigia amatunda ase omoko oria, korende tanyora gento.
swahili: Kisha Yesu akawaambia mfano huu: “Mtu mmoja alikuwa na mtini uliopandwa katika shamba lake la mizabibu, akaja ili kutafuta tini kwenye mti huo, lakini hakupata hata moja.

english: So he said to the keeper of the vineyard, ‘Look, for the past three years I have come to search for fruit on this fig tree and haven’t found any. Therefore cut it down! Why should it use up the soil?’
ekegusii: Agateebia omooroiseria bw’omogondo bw’emesabibu: Rora, emiaka eye etato nachire korigia amatunda ase omoko oyo, na tindanyora gento. Yonache! Nase ki ogosaria riroba?
swahili: Hivyo akamwambia mtunza shamba: ‘Tazama, kwa muda wa miaka mitatu sasa nimekuwa nikija kutafuta matunda kwenye mtini huu, nami sikupata hata moja. Ukate! Kwa nini uendelee kuharibu ardhi?’

english: ‘Sir,’ the man replied, ‘leave it alone again this year, until I dig around it and fertilize it.
ekegusii: Akamoiraneria: Omonene, yotige omwaka oyo naende, goika nyoburugere na koyobekera obwoyo.
swahili: “Yule mtunza shamba akamjibu, ‘Bwana, uache tena kwa mwaka mmoja zaidi, nami nitaupalilia na kuuwekea mbolea.

english: If it bears fruit next year, fine. But if not, you can cut it down.’” Jesus Heals a Disabled Woman
ekegusii: Noro korame amatunda, mbuya; onye taibo, erio oyonache.” Omokungu ogwenetigwe rituko ri’Esabato
swahili: Kama ukizaa matunda mwaka ujao, vyema, la sivyo uukate.’ ” Yesu Amponya Mwanamke Kilema Siku Ya Sabato

english: One Sabbath, Jesus went to eat in the home of a leading Pharisee, and those in attendance were watching Him closely.
ekegusii: Rituko erimo ri’Esabato, ekero asoete ase enyomba y’omonto oyomo, omonene bw’Abafarisai, arie endagera, nigo barenge bamorigereretie.
swahili: Ikawa siku moja Yesu alipokuwa amekwenda kula chakula kwa mmoja wa viongozi wa Mafarisayo siku ya Sabato, watu walikuwa wakimchunguza kwa bidii.

english: But when you are invited, go and sit in the last place, so that your host will come and tell you, ‘Friend, move up to a better place.’ Then you will be honored in front of everyone at the table with you.
ekegusii: Korende gokorangerigwa, genda oikaranse magega, erinde kagocha oyokorangeretie, agoteebie: Mosani, tigera gocha aa aase e ritang’ani. Erio nobe nogosikwa ase amasio abo bonsi abaikaransete amo naye.
swahili: Badala yake, unapoalikwa, chagua nafasi ya chini, ili yule mwenyeji wako atakapokuona atakuja na kukuambia, ‘Rafiki yangu, nenda kwenye nafasi iliyo bora zaidi.’ Kwa jinsi hii utakuwa umepewa heshima mbele ya wageni wenzako wote.

english: For everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, and the one who humbles himself will be exalted.”
ekegusii: Ekiagera kera oyokweimokereria igoro nairanigwe inse, na ere oyokweirania inse naimokererigwe igoro.”
swahili: Kwa maana kila mtu ajikwezaye atashushwa, naye ajishushaye atakwezwa.”

english: Then Jesus said to the man who had invited Him, “When you host a dinner or a banquet, do not invite your friends or brothers or relatives or rich neighbors. Otherwise, they may invite you in return, and you will be repaid.
ekegusii: Agateebia oria omorangeretie, “Kogokora endagera ya mambia gose eya mogoroba, torangeria abasani bao, gose abamino, gose eamate yao, gose abagisangio bao abanda; baabaise gokorangeria banyare gokoakana.
swahili: Kisha Yesu akamwambia yule aliyewaalika, “Uandaapo karamu ya chakula cha mchana au cha jioni, usialike rafiki zako au ndugu zako au jamaa zako au majirani zako walio matajiri tu. Ukifanya hivyo, wao nao wanaweza kukualika kwao, nawe ukawa umelipwa kile ulichofanya na kupata thawabu yako.

english: But when you host a banquet, invite the poor, the crippled, the lame, and the blind,
ekegusii: Korende kogokora omoyega, barangerie abataka, na ebirema, na amagata, na emeuko;
swahili: Bali ufanyapo karamu, waalike maskini, vilema na vipofu,

english: and you will be blessed. Since they cannot repay you, you will be repaid at the resurrection of the righteous.” The Parable of the Banquet (Matthew 22:1–14)
ekegusii: aye nosesenigwe, ekiagera tibari na gento bagokoakana. Naki aye noche goakanwa ase okobokigwa kw’abanyene oboronge.” Omoreng’anio bw’omoyega omonene
swahili: nawe utabarikiwa kwa sababu hawa hawana uwezo wa kukulipa. Mungu atakulipa wakati wa ufufuo wa wenye haki.” Mfano Wa Karamu Kuu (Mathayo 22:1-10)

english: When one of those reclining with Him heard this, he said to Jesus, “Blessed is everyone who will eat at the feast in the kingdom of God.”
ekegusii: Ekero oyomo ase abwo baikaransete ase endagera amo nere achia koyaigwa akamoteebia, “Nasesenirie oyoranyare koria omogati ase oborwoti bwa Nyasae!”
swahili: Mmoja wa wale waliokuwa pamoja naye mezani aliposikia hivi akamwambia Yesu, “Amebarikiwa mtu yule atakayekula katika karamu ya Ufalme wa Mungu!”

english: But Jesus replied, “A certain man prepared a great banquet and invited many guests.
ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Omonto oyomo okorete omoyega omonene; akarangeria abanto abange.
swahili: Yesu akamjibu, “Mtu mmoja alikuwa anaandaa karamu kubwa, akaalika watu wengi.

english: When it was time for the banquet, he sent his servant to tell those who had been invited, ‘Come, for everything is now ready.’
ekegusii: Ekero ki’omoyega agatoma omosomba oye kogenda goteebia baria konya barangerigwe: Inchuo, ekiagera ebinto bionsi biabeire ang’e.
swahili: Wakati wa karamu ulipofika, akamtuma mtumishi wake akawaambie wale walioalikwa, ‘Karibuni, kila kitu ki tayari sasa.’

english: But one after another they all began to make excuses. The first one said, ‘I have bought a field, and I need to go see it. Please excuse me.’
ekegusii: Bagachaaka bonsi korigia chintamero. Oyo bw’eritang’ani akamoteebia: Nagorire omogondo, nindigetie kogenda koyorora; nagosabire, onyabere.
swahili: “Lakini wote, kila mmoja, wakaanza kutoa udhuru: Wa kwanza akasema, ‘Nimenunua shamba, lazima niende kuliona. Tafadhali niwie radhi.’

english: Another said, ‘I have bought five yoke of oxen, and I am going to try them out. Please excuse me.’
ekegusii: Oyonde akabora: Nagorire chintang’ana amachoki atano, nkogenda nde gochiteema; nagosabire, onyabere.
swahili: “Mwingine akasema, ‘Ndipo tu nimenunua jozi tano za ngʼombe wa kulimia, nami ninakwenda kuwajaribu, tafadhali niwie radhi.’

english: Right there before Him was a man with dropsy.
ekegusii: Na rora, ase obosio bwaye narengeo omonto oyomo orenge noborwaire bw’okobimbia omobere.
swahili: Papo hapo mbele yake palikuwa na mtu mmoja mwenye ugonjwa wa kuvimba mwili.

english: Still another said, ‘I have married a wife, so I cannot come.’
ekegusii: Oyonde akabora: Nanyuomire omokungu, na ase engencho eye tinkonyara gocha.
swahili: Naye mwingine akasema, ‘Nimeoa mke, kwa hiyo siwezi kuja.’

english: The servant returned and reported all this to his master. Then the owner of the house became angry and said to his servant, ‘Go out quickly into the streets and alleys of the city, and bring in the poor, the crippled, the blind, and the lame.’
ekegusii: Omosomba oria agacha, akorokia omonene oye amang’ana aya. Erio oria omonyene enyomba akabea, agateebia omosomba oye: Soka bwango, ogende ase chinchera na ebinchera bi’emechie, orente abataka, na ebirema, na emeuko, na amagata.
swahili: “Yule mtumishi akarudi, akampa bwana wake taarifa. Ndipo yule mwenye nyumba akakasirika, akamwagiza yule mtumishi wake, akisema, ‘Nenda upesi kwenye mitaa na vichochoro vya mjini uwalete maskini, vilema, vipofu na viwete.’

english: ‘Sir,’ the servant replied, ‘what you ordered has been done, and there is still room.’
ekegusii: Na omosomba oria akabora: Omonene, ayio gwachika aikire gokoreka, ko nonya mbono ribaga ndireo.
swahili: “Yule mtumishi akamwambia, ‘Bwana, yale uliyoniagiza nimefanya, lakini bado ipo nafasi.’

english: So the master told his servant, ‘Go out to the highways and hedges and compel them to come in, so that my house will be full.
ekegusii: Omonene oria agateebia omosomba oye: Genda ase chinchera ne chimbebe, obabetererie basoe, erinde enyomba yane enyare goichora.
swahili: “Ndipo yule bwana akamwambia mtumishi wake, ‘Nenda kwenye barabara na vijia vilivyoko nje ya mji na uwalazimishe watu waingie ili nyumba yangu ipate kujaa.

english: For I tell you, not one of those men who were invited will taste my banquet.’” The Cost of Discipleship (Matthew 8:18–22; Luke 9:57–62; John 6:59–66)
ekegusii: Ekiagera nagotebirie ng’a ase abanto baria barangeretigwe onde tari nonya noyomo oranyare koigwa omoyega one.” Rigori ri’okoba omworokigwa
swahili: Kwa maana nawaambia, hakuna hata mmoja wa wale walioalikwa atakayeionja karamu yangu.’ ” Gharama Ya Kuwa Mwanafunzi (Mathayo 10:37-38)

english: Large crowds were now traveling with Jesus, and He turned and said to them,
ekegusii: Emeganda emenge nigo yarenge amo na Yeso; ere akeonchora, akabateebia,
swahili: Umati mkubwa wa watu ulikuwa ukisafiri pamoja na Yesu, naye akageuka, akawaambia,

english: “If anyone comes to Me and does not hate his father and mother and wife and children and brothers and sisters—yes, even his own life—he cannot be My disciple.
ekegusii: “Omonto kagocha ase ’nde, nere atagecheti ise na ng’ina, na mokaye, na abana baye, na abamura bamwabo, na abasubati bamwabo, ee, nonya nobogima bwaye, takonyara koba omworokigwa one.
swahili: “Mtu yeyote anayekuja kwangu hawezi kuwa mwanafunzi wangu kama hatanipenda mimi zaidi ya baba yake na mama yake, mke wake na watoto wake, ndugu zake na dada zake, naam, hata maisha yake mwenyewe.

english: And whoever does not carry his cross and follow Me cannot be My disciple.
ekegusii: Naende monto onde bwensi otabogoreti omosalaba oye na gontunyana, takonyara koba omworokigwa one.
swahili: Yeyote asiyeuchukua msalaba wake na kunifuata hawezi kuwa mwanafunzi wangu.

english: Which of you, wishing to build a tower, does not first sit down and count the cost to see if he has the resources to complete it?
ekegusii: Naki ning’o ase more, onye origetie koagacha oboagacho, otaikaranse ritang’ani kobara rigori ri’oboagacho obo, gose nabwate ebinto biisaine kobokoora?
swahili: “Ni nani miongoni mwenu ambaye kama anataka kujenga nyumba, hakai kwanza chini na kufanya makisio ya gharama aone kama ana fedha za kutosha kukamilisha?

english: Otherwise, if he lays the foundation and is unable to finish the work, everyone who sees it will ridicule him,
ekegusii: Aise gosinywa gokoora oboagacho boria kabekire oboroso, abanto bonsi bachake komosekerera,
swahili: La sivyo, akiisha kuweka msingi, naye akiwa hana uwezo wa kuikamilisha, wote waionao wataanza kumdhihaki,

english: So Jesus asked the experts in the law and the Pharisees, “Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath or not?”
ekegusii: Yeso agateebia abanto b’amachiiko na Abafarisai, akababoria, “Inee! Mboronge kogwenia ase rituko ri’Esabato, gose taibo?”
swahili: Yesu akawauliza wale Mafarisayo na walimu wa sheria, “Je, ni halali kuponya watu siku ya Sabato au la?”

english: saying, ‘This man could not finish what he started to build.’
ekegusii: bagokwana: Omonto oyo nigo achagete oboagacho, korende tabokoora.
swahili: wakisema, ‘Mtu huyu alianza kujenga lakini hakuweza kukamilisha.’

english: Or what king on his way to war with another king will not first sit down and consider whether he can engage with ten thousand men the one coming against him with twenty thousand?
ekegusii: Gose morwoti ki, gakogenda korwana nomorwoti onde, otaikaranse ritang’ani na korengereria onye ere amo nabaanto chilifu ikomi nanyare koumerana nere oyokomocheera nabaanto chilifu emerongo ebere?
swahili: “Au ni mfalme gani atokaye kwenda kupigana vita na mfalme mwingine, ambaye hakai chini kwanza na kufikiri iwapo akiwa na jeshi la watu 10,000 ataweza kupigana na yule anayekuja na jeshi la watu 20,000?

english: And if he is unable, he will send a delegation while the other king is still far off, to ask for terms of peace.
ekegusii: Onye taibo, nigo agotoma abanto korigia enchera y’omorembe, omonto oria gakare aare.
swahili: Kama hawezi, basi wakati yule mwingine akiwa bado yuko mbali, yeye hutuma ujumbe wa watu na kuomba masharti ya amani.

english: In the same way, any one of you who does not give up everything he has cannot be My disciple. Good Salt (Matthew 5:13–16; Mark 9:49–50)
ekegusii: Nabo kera oyomo oino otatigeti ebinto bionsi are nabio, takonyara koba omworokigwa one.
swahili: Vivyo hivyo, yeyote miongoni mwenu ambaye hawezi kuacha vyote alivyo navyo, hawezi kuwa mwanafunzi wangu. Chumvi Isiyofaa (Mathayo 5:13; Marko 9:50)

english: Salt is good, but if the salt loses its savor, with what will it be seasoned?
ekegusii: “Omonyo nomuya, korende omonyoo korasirie obwansu bwaye, ninki orabekwe bwanse?
swahili: “Chumvi ni nzuri, lakini chumvi ikiwa imepoteza ladha yake, itafanywaje ili iweze kukolea tena?

english: It is fit neither for the soil nor for the manure pile, and it is thrown out. He who has ears to hear, let him hear.”
ekegusii: Togwenereti riroba gose etui; abanto nigo bakoyotuguta isiko. Oyore namato akoigwera, tiga aigwe.”
swahili: Haifai ardhi wala kwa lundo la mbolea, bali hutupwa nje. “Mwenye masikio ya kusikia, na asikie.”

english: But they remained silent. Then Jesus took hold of the man, healed him, and sent him on his way.
ekegusii: Bagakira. Akamobwata, akamogwenia, akamoa ribaga agende.
swahili: Wakakaa kimya. Hivyo Yesu akamshika yule mgonjwa mkono na kumponya, akamruhusu aende zake.

english: And He asked them, “Which of you whose son or ox falls into a pit on the Sabbath day will not immediately pull him out?”
ekegusii: Akababoria, “Ning’o ase more ore netigere gose eng’ombe yagure ase engoro, otari koyerusia erio kegima ase rituko ri’Esabato?”
swahili: Kisha akawauliza, “Kama mmoja wenu angekuwa na mtoto au ngʼombe wake aliyetumbukia katika kisima siku ya Sabato, je, hamtamvuta mara moja na kumtoa?”

english: And they were unable to answer these questions. The Parable of the Guests
ekegusii: Barabwo tibanyara komoiraneria ase amang’ana aria. Oboitongo na okoroisia abageni
swahili: Nao hawakuwa na la kusema. Unyenyekevu Na Ukarimu

english: When Jesus noticed how the guests chose the places of honor, He told them a parable:
ekegusii: Agateebia baria barangeretigwe omoreng’anio, gachia korora buna bachorire ebirogo bi’eritang’ani, akabateebia,
swahili: Alipoona jinsi wageni walivyokuwa wanachagua mahali pa heshima wakati wa kula, akawaambia mfano huu:

english: “When you are invited to a wedding banquet, do not sit in the place of honor, in case someone more distinguished than you has been invited.
ekegusii: “Gokorangerigwa nomonto ase omoyega bw’enyangi, toikaransa ase ekerogo kie ritang’ani; onye omonto bw’amasikani kobua aye orangeretigwe nere,
swahili: “Mtu akikualika arusini, usikae mahali pa mgeni wa heshima kwa kuwa inawezekana amealikwa mtu mheshimiwa kuliko wewe.

english: Then the host who invited both of you will come and tell you, ‘Give this man your seat.’ And in humiliation, you will have to take the last place.
ekegusii: oria obarangeretie inwe babere nache kogoteebia aye: Motigerere oyo ekerogo eke; erio nochake koba nobosooku gokoiranigwa goikaransa magega.
swahili: Kama mkifanya hivyo yule aliyewaalika ninyi wawili atakuja na kukuambia, ‘Mpishe huyu mtu kiti chako.’ Ndipo kwa aibu utalazimika kukaa katika nafasi ya chini kabisa.

english: Now all the tax collectors and sinners were gathering around to listen to Jesus.
ekegusii: Nabo abarusia ebango na abanyene ebibe bonsi nigo baare komoika Yeso ang’e komotegerera.
swahili: Basi watoza ushuru na wenye dhambi wote walikuwa wanakusanyika ili wapate kumsikiliza Yesu.

english: In the same way, I tell you, there is joy in the presence of God’s angels over one sinner who repents.” The Parable of the Prodigal Son (Deuteronomy 21:18–21)
ekegusii: Naboigo, nabateebirie, nore omogooko ase abamalaika ba Nyasae ase omonyene ebibe oyomo oonchokire.” Omwana omomura omoria bobe
swahili: Vivyo hivyo, nawaambia, kuna furaha mbele ya malaika wa Mungu juu ya mwenye dhambi mmoja atubuye.” Mfano Wa Mwana Mpotevu

english: Then Jesus said, “There was a man who had two sons.
ekegusii: Naende agateeba, “Omonto oyomo narenge nabamura babere.
swahili: Yesu akaendelea kusema: “Kulikuwa na mtu mmoja aliyekuwa na wana wawili.

english: The younger son said to him, ‘Father, give me my share of the estate.’ So he divided his property between them.
ekegusii: Oria omoke agateebia ise: Tata, ing’a ensemo y’enibo entungetie. Ise akabaatanera ebinto biaye.
swahili: Yule mdogo akamwambia baba yake, ‘Baba, nipe urithi wangu.’ Hivyo akawagawia wanawe mali yake.

english: After a few days, the younger son got everything together and journeyed to a distant country, where he squandered his wealth in wild living.
ekegusii: Magega y’amatuko atai mange oria omoke agasangereria ebinto biaye bionsi, akaimoka akagenda orogendo gochia ense y’aare; agasiarera agwo enibo yaye ase ogokora kw’obokayayu.
swahili: “Baada ya muda mfupi, yule mdogo akakusanya vitu vyote alivyokuwa navyo, akaenda nchi ya mbali, na huko akaitapanya mali yake kwa maisha ya anasa.

english: After he had spent all he had, a severe famine swept through that country, and he began to be in need.
ekegusii: Gakoorire bionsi, enchara enene egasoa ase ense eria, ere akaremerwa.
swahili: Baada ya kutumia kila kitu alichokuwa nacho, kukawa na njaa kali katika nchi ile yote, naye akawa hana chochote.

english: So he went and hired himself out to a citizen of that country, who sent him into his fields to feed the pigs.
ekegusii: Akagenda akabwatana nomonto oyomo bw’abanyene ense eria; ere akamoira ebitii biaye korageria chimbeche.
swahili: Kwa hiyo akaenda akaajiriwa na mwenyeji mmoja wa nchi ile ambaye alimpeleka shambani kwake kulisha nguruwe.

english: He longed to fill his belly with the pods the pigs were eating, but no one would give him a thing.
ekegusii: Akaba nkogania are koigotia enda yaye ase amasabo aria chimbeche chiarenge koria; monto onde tarenge komoa gento.
swahili: Akatamani kujishibisha kwa maganda waliyokula wale nguruwe, wala hakuna mtu aliyempa chochote.

english: Finally he came to his senses and said, ‘How many of my father’s hired servants have plenty of food? But here I am, starving to death!
ekegusii: Goika agachia kweiranerera kweboria ere omonyene, akabora: Abasomba b’eng’eria ba tata mbarenga bakare koria endagera na gotigaria, na inche aiga ngokwa nenchara!
swahili: “Lakini alipozingatia moyoni mwake, akasema, ‘Ni watumishi wangapi walioajiriwa na baba yangu ambao wana chakula cha kuwatosha na kusaza, bali mimi hapa nakufa kwa njaa!

english: I will get up and go back to my father and say to him, “Father, I have sinned against heaven and against you.
ekegusii: Ninyimoke, ngende ase tata, imoteebie: Tata, namochire ase oyore igoro na ase obosio bwao,
swahili: Nitaondoka na kurudi kwa baba yangu na kumwambia: Baba, nimetenda dhambi mbele za Mungu na mbele yako.

english: I am no longer worthy to be called your son. Make me like one of your hired servants.”’
ekegusii: tingwenereti naende ndokwe omwana oo, tiga imbe buna oyomo bw’abasomba bao b’eng’eria.
swahili: Sistahili tena kuitwa mwanao; nifanye kama mmoja wa watumishi wako.’

english: So the Pharisees and scribes began to grumble: “This man welcomes sinners and eats with them.”
ekegusii: Abafarisai na aborokia b’amariiko bakemurungania, bakaboora, “Oyo nigo akoroisia abanyene ebibe, na koria amo nabarabwo.”
swahili: Lakini Mafarisayo na walimu wa sheria wakanungʼunika wakisema, “Huyu mtu anawakaribisha wenye dhambi na kula nao.”

english: So he got up and went to his father. But while he was still in the distance, his father saw him and was filled with compassion. He ran to his son, embraced him, and kissed him.
ekegusii: Akaimoka, akagenda ase ise. Agachia koba okare are, ise akamorora, akamororera amaabera, akaminyoka, akamoboania rigoti, akamonyunyunta mono.
swahili: Basi akaondoka, akaenda kwa baba yake. “Lakini alipokuwa bado yuko mbali, baba yake akamwona, moyo wake ukajawa na huruma. Akamkimbilia mwanawe, akamkumbatia na kumbusu.

english: The son declared, ‘Father, I have sinned against heaven and against you. I am no longer worthy to be called your son. ’
ekegusii: Omwana oria akamoteebia: Tata, namochire ase oyore igoro na ase obosio bwao, tingwenereti naende ndokwe omwana oo.
swahili: “Yule mwana akamwambia baba yake, ‘Baba, nimekosa mbele za Mungu na mbele yako. Sistahili kuitwa mwanao tena.’

english: But the father said to his servants, ‘Quick! Bring the best robe and put it on him. Put a ring on his finger and sandals on his feet.
ekegusii: Korende ise agateebia abasomba baye: Renta bwango eganchwa ere engiya, momobekere; mobekere nebonyi ase ekiara kiaye, na ebikoroto ase amagoro aye.
swahili: “Lakini baba yake akawaambia watumishi, ‘Leteni upesi joho lililo bora sana, tieni pete kidoleni mwake na viatu miguuni mwake.

english: Bring the fattened calf and kill it. Let us feast and celebrate.
ekegusii: Nyerente emori eria ere enoru, moyenyenye, torie na kogoka,
swahili: Leteni ndama aliyenona, mkamchinje ili tuwe na karamu, tule na kufurahi.

english: For this son of mine was dead and is alive again! He was lost and is found!’ So they began to celebrate.
ekegusii: ekiagera oyo omwana one konya okuure, naende moyo are; konya osirire, korende bono ororekanire. Bagachaaka gochenga.
swahili: Kwa maana huyu mwanangu alikuwa amekufa na sasa yu hai tena; alikuwa amepotea na sasa amepatikana!’ Nao wakaanza kufanya tafrija.

english: Meanwhile the older son was in the field, and as he approached the house, he heard music and dancing.
ekegusii: “Nabo oria omomura oye omonene nigo arenge mogondo; agachia goika ang’e nenyomba, akaigwa egeturi ki’ogoteera na ogotenga.
swahili: “Wakati huo, yule mwana mkubwa alikuwa shambani. Alipokaribia nyumbani, akasikia sauti ya nyimbo na watu wakicheza.

english: So he called one of the servants and asked what was going on.
ekegusii: Akarangeria oyomo bw’abasomba, akamobooria amang’ana ayio, engencho yaye inki.
swahili: Akamwita mmoja wa watumishi na kumuuliza, ‘Kuna nini?’

english: ‘Your brother has returned,’ he said, ‘and your father has killed the fattened calf, because he has him back safe and sound.’
ekegusii: Ere akamoiraneria: Momura omino ochire, na iso omonyenyeire emori enoru, ekiagera amonyora ore omogima.
swahili: Akamwambia, ‘Ndugu yako amekuja, naye baba yako amemchinjia ndama aliyenona kwa sababu mwanawe amerudi nyumbani akiwa salama na mzima.’

english: The older son became angry and refused to go in. So his father came out and pleaded with him.
ekegusii: Korende akabea, tarigia gosoa. Erio ise agasoka, akamosorora,
swahili: “Yule mwana mkubwa akakasirika, akakataa kuingia ndani. Basi baba yake akatoka nje na kumsihi.

english: But he answered his father, ‘Look, all these years I have served you and never disobeyed a commandment of yours. Yet you never gave me even a young goat so I could celebrate with my friends.
ekegusii: korende ere akamoiraneria: Rora, inche nagokoreire emiaka eye emenge, tinsareti ogochika kwao kero kende gionsi; korende tikwana kong’a emanwa y’embori, erinde ingoke amo nabasani baane.
swahili: Lakini yeye akamjibu baba yake, ‘Tazama! Miaka yote hii nimekutumikia na hata siku moja sijaacha kutii amri zako, lakini hujanipa hata mwana-mbuzi ili nifurahi na rafiki zangu.

english: Then Jesus told them this parable:
ekegusii: Erio akabateebia omoreng’anio oyo:
swahili: Ndipo Yesu akawaambia mfano huu:

english: But when this son of yours returns from squandering your wealth with prostitutes, you kill the fattened calf for him!’
ekegusii: Korende ochia gocha omwana oo oyo, oriire ebinto biao nabakuungu abatayayi, kwamonyenyeire emori enoru.
swahili: Lakini huyu mwanao ambaye ametapanya mali yako kwa makahaba aliporudi nyumbani, wewe umemchinjia ndama aliyenona!’

english: ‘Son, you are always with me,’ the father said, ‘and all that is mine is yours.
ekegusii: Ise akamoteebia: Omwana one, aye amatuko onsi nigo ore amo nainche, na ebinto bionsi inde nabirobio nebiao.
swahili: “Baba yake akamjibu, ‘Mwanangu, umekuwa nami siku zote na vyote nilivyo navyo ni vyako.

english: But it was fitting to celebrate and be glad, because this brother of yours was dead and is alive again; he was lost and is found.’”
ekegusii: Mboronge gokora omogooko na gochenga, ekiagera oyo momura omino konya okuure, na bono moyo are; konya osirire, na bono ororekanire.”
swahili: Lakini ilitubidi tufurahi na kushangilia kwa sababu huyu ndugu yako alikuwa amekufa na sasa yu hai; alikuwa amepotea naye amepatikana.’ ”

english: “What man among you, if he has a hundred sheep and loses one of them, does not leave the ninety-nine in the pasture and go after the one that is lost, until he finds it?
ekegusii: “Monto ki oino oyore ne ching’ondi rigana erimo, na eyemo esire, tagotiga chiria emerongo kianda na kianda ase erooro, na gochia korigia eria yasirire, goika ayenyore?
swahili: “Ikiwa mmoja wenu ana kondoo mia moja, naye akapoteza mmoja wao, je, hawaachi wale tisini na tisa nyikani na kwenda kumtafuta huyo aliyepotea mpaka ampate?

english: And when he finds it, he joyfully puts it on his shoulders,
ekegusii: Nabo kayenyorire ayebeka amareko aye nomogooko.
swahili: Naye akishampata, humbeba mabegani mwake kwa furaha

english: comes home, and calls together his friends and neighbors to tell them, ‘Rejoice with me, for I have found my lost sheep!’
ekegusii: Na ekero akoirana inka, narangerie abasani baye na abagisangio baye, abateebie: Goka amo nainche, ekiagera nanyorire eng’ondi yane eria yasirete.
swahili: na kwenda nyumbani. Kisha huwaita rafiki zake na majirani, na kuwaambia, ‘Furahini pamoja nami; nimempata kondoo wangu aliyepotea.’

english: In the same way, I tell you that there will be more joy in heaven over one sinner who repents than over ninety-nine righteous ones who do not need to repent. The Parable of the Lost Coin
ekegusii: Naboigo nabateebirie, nobe omogooko igoro ase omonyene ebibe oyomo oonchokire, kobua ase abanyene oboronge emerongo kianda na kianda, abatarigeti okoonchoka. Ebesa ensiru
swahili: Nawaambieni, vivyo hivyo kutakuwa na furaha zaidi mbinguni kwa sababu ya mwenye dhambi mmoja atubuye, kuliko kwa wenye haki tisini na tisa ambao hawana haja ya kutubu.” Mfano Wa Sarafu Iliyopotea

english: Or what woman who has ten silver coins and loses one of them does not light a lamp, sweep her house, and search carefully until she finds it?
ekegusii: “Gose mokuungu ki ore ne chisiringi ikomi chi’echifeta, na eyemo esire, tagotongia etaya na kwabusa enyomba, arigie nomokia goika ayenyore?
swahili: “Au ikiwa mwanamke ana sarafu za fedha kumi, naye akapoteza moja, je, hawashi taa na kufagia nyumba na kuitafuta kwa bidii mpaka aipate?

english: And when she finds it, she calls together her friends and neighbors to say, ‘Rejoice with me, for I have found my lost coin.’
ekegusii: Kayenyorire, narangerie abasani baye na abagisangio baye, abateebie: Goka amo nainche, ekiagera nanyorire esiringi eria nasiria.
swahili: Naye akiisha kuipata, huwaita rafiki zake na majirani na kuwaambia, ‘Furahini pamoja nami; nimeipata ile sarafu yangu ya fedha iliyopotea.’

english: Jesus also said to His disciples, “There was a rich man whose manager was accused of wasting his possessions.
ekegusii: Naende agateebia aborokigwa baye, Narenge omonto omonda, orenge nomorendi. Oyio agasoerwa asare ng’a osiareire enibo yaye.
swahili: Yesu akawaambia wanafunzi wake, “Palikuwa na tajiri mmoja na msimamizi wake. Ilisemekana kwamba huyo msimamizi alikuwa anatumia vibaya mali ya tajiri yake.

english: Whoever is faithful with very little will also be faithful with much, and whoever is dishonest with very little will also be dishonest with much.
ekegusii: Oyore omwegenwa ase ekere egeke, nabo are omwegenwa ase ekere ekenene; na oyotari omooronge ase ekere egeke, naboigo tari omooronge ase ekere ekenene.
swahili: “Yeyote aliye mwaminifu katika mambo madogo, pia ni mwaminifu hata katika mambo makubwa, naye mtu ambaye si mwaminifu katika mambo madogo pia si mwaminifu katika mambo makubwa.

english: So if you have not been faithful with worldly wealth, who will entrust you with true riches?
ekegusii: Onye timobeti abegenwa ase enibo y’ense eye etari boronge, ning’o oranyare kobegena koba nenibo y’ekeene?
swahili: Ikiwa hamkuwa waaminifu katika mali ya kidunia, ni nani atakayewaaminia mali ya kweli?

english: And if you have not been faithful with the belongings of another, who will give you belongings of your own?
ekegusii: Onye timobeti abegenwa ase ekio ki’omonto onde, ning’o oranyare kobaa ekio ekere kiaino abanyene?
swahili: Nanyi kama hamkuwa waaminifu na mali ya mtu mwingine, ni nani atakayewapa iliyo yenu wenyewe?

english: No servant can serve two masters. Either he will hate the one and love the other, or he will be devoted to the one and despise the other. You cannot serve both God and money.” The Law and the Prophets
ekegusii: Mosomba onde tari oranyaare gokorera abanene babere, ekiagera nageeche oyomo, na anche oyonde, gose nabwatane noyomo, na achaaye oyonde. Timokonyara gokorera Nyasae na enibo. Ogotogonyerwa kw’Abafarisai
swahili: “Hakuna mtumishi awezaye kuwatumikia mabwana wawili. Kwa kuwa atamchukia huyu na kumpenda yule mwingine, au atashikamana sana na huyu na kumdharau yule mwingine. Hamwezi kumtumikia Mungu pamoja na Mali.”

english: The Pharisees, who were lovers of money, heard all of this and were scoffing at Jesus.
ekegusii: Abafarisai abarenge abanchi enibo bakaigwa amang’ana aya onsi, bakamosekereria.
swahili: Mafarisayo, waliokuwa wapenda fedha, waliyasikia hayo yote na wakamcheka kwa dharau.

english: So He said to them, “You are the ones who justify yourselves before men, but God knows your hearts. For what is prized among men is detestable before God.
ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Inwe nabaanto mogwetogia ng’a nigo more abanyene oboronge ase obosio bwa Mwanyabaanto, korende Nyasae omanyire chinkoro chiaino, ekiagera ekeimokererete igoro ase Mwanyabaanto, Nyasae nigo akegechete.
swahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Ninyi mnajionyesha kuwa wenye haki mbele za wanadamu, lakini Mungu anaijua mioyo yenu. Kwa maana vile vitu ambavyo wanadamu wanavithamini sana, kwa Mungu ni machukizo. Sheria Na Ufalme Wa Mungu

english: The Law and the Prophets were proclaimed until John. Since that time, the gospel of the kingdom of God is being preached, and everyone is forcing his way into it.
ekegusii: “Amachiiko narengeo, na ababani boigo, goika ekero kia Yohana. Korwa ekero keria amang’ana amaya ay’oborwoti bwa Nyasae nkorandigwa are, na kera omonto nigo akobosoa ne chinguru.
swahili: “Sheria na Manabii vilihubiriwa mpaka kuja kwa Yohana Mbatizaji. Tangu wakati huo habari njema za Ufalme wa Mungu zinahubiriwa, na kila mmoja hujiingiza kwa nguvu.

english: But it is easier for heaven and earth to pass away than for a single stroke of a pen to drop out of the Law.
ekegusii: Korende naango kobua igoro na ense goeta, kobua enuguta eyemo y’amachiiko korua aroro.
swahili: Lakini ni rahisi zaidi mbingu na dunia kupita kuliko hata herufi moja kuondoka katika Sheria.

english: Anyone who divorces his wife and marries another woman commits adultery, and he who marries a divorced woman commits adultery. The Rich Man and Lazarus (John 5:39–47)
ekegusii: “Kera oyogotiga mokaye na konyuoma oyonde otomanire, nere oyokonyuoma oyotigirwe nomosaacha oye, noyio otomanire. Omonto omonda na omosabi Lazaro
swahili: “Mtu yeyote amwachaye mkewe na kumwoa mwanamke mwingine anazini, naye mwanaume amwoaye mwanamke aliyetalikiwa anazini. Tajiri Na Lazaro

english: Now there was a rich man dressed in purple and fine linen, who lived each day in joyous splendor.
ekegusii: “Narenge omonto gete omonda, orenge kweboyia chianga chimonyinga na echi’egatani engiya, na kwegokia kera rituko ase okoria.
swahili: “Palikuwa na mtu mmoja tajiri aliyevaa nguo za rangi ya zambarau na kitani safi, ambaye aliishi kwa anasa kila siku.

english: So he called him in to ask, ‘What is this I hear about you? Turn in an account of your management, for you cannot be manager any longer.’
ekegusii: Akamorangeria, akamoteebia: Ninki eke naigure ase ore? Orokia amang’ana y’oborendi bwao, ekiagera tokonyara kogenderera koba omorendi.
swahili: Hivyo huyo tajiri akamwita na kumuuliza, ‘Ni mambo gani haya ninayoyasikia kukuhusu? Toa taarifa ya usimamizi wako, kwa sababu huwezi kuendelea kuwa msimamizi.’

english: And a beggar named Lazarus lay at his gate, covered with sores
ekegusii: Na ase egesieri kiaye narengeo omonto oyomo omotaka, erieta riaye Lazaro, orenge namaote amange.
swahili: Hapo penye mlango wake aliishi maskini mmoja, jina lake Lazaro, mwenye vidonda mwili mzima.

english: and longing to be fed with the crumbs that fell from the rich man’s table. Even the dogs came and licked his sores.
ekegusii: Ere nigo arenge kogania kweigotia namatori are kogwa korwa ase emesa y’omonda oria, ne chisese nachirochio chicha chiamomena amaote aye.
swahili: Huyo Lazaro alitamani kujishibisha kwa makombo yaliyoanguka kutoka mezani kwa yule tajiri. Hata mbwa walikuwa wakija na kuramba vidonda vyake.

english: One day the beggar died and was carried by the angels to Abraham’s side. And the rich man also died and was buried.
ekegusii: Omotaka oria agakwa, akabogorigwa nabamalaika, akabeekwa ase egekuba kia Aburaamu. Na oria omonda agakwa boigo, agatindekwa,
swahili: “Wakati ukafika yule maskini akafa, nao malaika wakamchukua akae pamoja na Abrahamu. Yule tajiri naye akafa na akazikwa.

english: In Hades, where he was in torment, he looked up and saw Abraham from afar, with Lazarus by his side.
ekegusii: na ekero aare agwo aase Eora y’amakweri akaimokia amaiso aye, akarora Aburaamu okare aare, na Lazaro ore ase egekuba kiaye.
swahili: Kule kuzimu alipokuwa akiteseka, alitazama juu, akamwona Abrahamu kwa mbali, naye Lazaro alikuwa karibu yake.

english: So he cried out, ‘Father Abraham, have mercy on me and send Lazarus to dip the tip of his finger in water and cool my tongue. For I am in agony in this fire.’
ekegusii: Akarera, akabora: Tata Aburaamu, indorera amaabera, toma Lazaro atobeke ekiara kiaye mesia ase amaache, akendie oromeme rwane, ekiagera nachandekire ase omorero oyo.
swahili: Hivyo yule tajiri akamwita, ‘Baba Abrahamu, nihurumie na umtume Lazaro achovye ncha ya kidole chake ndani ya maji aupoze ulimi wangu, kwa sababu nina maumivu makuu kwenye moto huu.’

english: But Abraham answered, ‘Child, remember that during your lifetime you received your good things, while Lazarus received bad things. But now he is comforted here, while you are in agony.
ekegusii: Aburaamu akabora: Omwana one, inyora buna kwanyorete amaya ao ase obogima bwao, na Lazaro boigo akanyora amabe, korende ere bono aiga oremiigwe, na aye ngochandeka ore.
swahili: “Lakini Abrahamu akamjibu, ‘Mwanangu, kumbuka kwamba wakati wa uhai wako ulipata mambo mazuri, lakini Lazaro alipata mambo mabaya. Lakini sasa anafarijiwa hapa na wewe uko katika maumivu makuu.

english: And besides all this, a great chasm has been fixed between us and you, so that even those who wish cannot cross from here to you, nor can anyone cross from there to us.’
ekegusii: Na kobua aya onsi, egati yaito na inwe eoromomo nereo yabeekirwe, erinde abanto abarigetie korua aiga bamboke gocha ase ore tibanyara, gose baria bare agwo tibanyara kwamboka gocha ase tore.
swahili: Zaidi ya hayo, kati yetu na ninyi huko kumewekwa shimo kubwa, ili wale wanaotaka kutoka huku kuja huko wasiweze, wala mtu yeyote asiweze kuvuka kutoka huko kuja kwetu.’

english: ‘Then I beg you, father,’ he said, ‘send Lazarus to my father’s house,
ekegusii: Akabora: Nagosabire tata, omotome ase enyomba ya tata,
swahili: “Akasema, ‘Basi, nakuomba, umtume Lazaro aende nyumbani kwa baba yangu,

english: for I have five brothers. Let him warn them, so that they will not also end up in this place of torment.’
ekegusii: ekiagera ninkare nabamura baminto batano; tiga agende abakuurere, erinde barabwo tibacha aa ase emechando.
swahili: maana ninao ndugu watano. Awaonye, ili wasije nao wakafika mahali hapa pa mateso.’

english: But Abraham replied, ‘They have Moses and the prophets; let your brothers listen to them.’
ekegusii: Aburaamu akabora: Mbare na Musa na ababani; tiga baigwere barabwo.
swahili: “Abrahamu akamjibu, ‘Ndugu zako wana Maandiko ya Mose na Manabii, wawasikilize hao.’

english: The manager said to himself, ‘What shall I do, now that my master is taking away my position? I am too weak to dig and too ashamed to beg.
ekegusii: Omorendi oria akabora ase omoyo oye: Ninki ndakore, ekiagera omonene one ondusirie ase oborendi bwane? Tindi ne chinguru chi’okorema; ogosaba nobosooku ase ’nde.
swahili: “Yule msimamizi akawaza moyoni mwake, ‘Nitafanya nini sasa? Bwana wangu ananiondoa katika kazi yangu. Sina nguvu za kulima, nami ninaona aibu kuombaomba.

english: ‘No, father Abraham,’ he said, ‘but if someone is sent to them from the dead, they will repent.’
ekegusii: Akabora: Yaya, tata Aburaamu, korende oyomo korwa ase abakuure aise kobachiera, inabaonchoke.
swahili: “Yule tajiri akasema, ‘Hapana, baba Abrahamu, lakini mtu kutoka kwa wafu akiwaendea, watatubu.’

english: Then Abraham said to him, ‘If they do not listen to Moses and the prophets, they will not be persuaded even if someone rises from the dead.’”
ekegusii: Akamoteebia: Bataigwereti Musa na ababani, naisa koboka omonto korwa ase abakuure, tibakoebererigwa banche.”
swahili: “Abrahamu akamwambia, ‘Kama wasipowasikiliza Mose na Manabii, hawataweza kushawishika hata kama mtu akifufuka kutoka kwa wafu.’ ”

english: I know what I will do, so that after my removal from management, people will welcome me into their homes.’
ekegusii: Namanyire eke ndakore, erinde abanto bandoisie ase chinyomba chiabo, ekero nkorusigwa ase oborendi.
swahili: Najua nitakalofanya ili nikiachishwa kazi yangu hapa, watu wanikaribishe nyumbani kwao.’

english: And he called in each one of his master’s debtors. ‘How much do you owe my master?’ he asked the first.
ekegusii: Erio akarangeria abasiira b’omonene oye, oyomo ase oyomo, akaboria oyo bw’eritang’ani: Ninki oriete ki’omonene one?
swahili: “Kwa hiyo akawaita wadeni wote wa bwana wake, mmoja mmoja. Akamuuliza wa kwanza, ‘Deni lako kwa bwana wangu ni kiasi gani?’

english: ‘A hundred measures of olive oil,’ he answered. ‘Take your bill,’ said the manager. ‘Sit down quickly, and write fifty.’
ekegusii: Akairaneria: Ebirengo rigana erimo bi’amaguta. Akamoteebia: Bogoria ekaratasi yao, ikaransa bwango, oriike emerongo etano.
swahili: “Akajibu, ‘Galoni 800 za mafuta ya mizeituni.’ “Msimamizi akamwambia, ‘Chukua hati ya deni lako, ibadilishe upesi, uandike galoni 400.’

english: Then he asked another, ‘And how much do you owe?’ ‘A hundred measures of wheat,’ he replied. ‘Take your bill and write eighty,’ he told him.
ekegusii: Naende akaboria oyonde: Naye ninki oriete? Akairaneria: Ebirengo rigana erimo bi’engano. Akamoteebia: Bogoria ekaratasi yao, orike emerongo etano na etato.
swahili: “Kisha akamuuliza wa pili, ‘Wewe deni lako ni kiasi gani?’ “Akajibu, ‘Vipimo 1,000 vya ngano.’ “Yule msimamizi akamwambia, ‘Chukua hati yako, andika vipimo 800!’

english: The master commended the dishonest manager because he had acted shrewdly. For the sons of this age are more shrewd in dealing with their own kind than are the sons of light.
ekegusii: Omonene oria agatogia omorendi otarenge omooronge, ekiagera akorete ase obong’aini. Naki abana b’ense eye nabang’aini kobua abana b’omobaso, ase ekegori kiabo abanyene. Enchera engiya y’ogokorera enibo emeremo
swahili: “Yule bwana akamsifu yule msimamizi dhalimu kwa jinsi alivyotumia ujanja. Kwa maana watu wa dunia hii wana ujanja zaidi wanapojishughulisha na mambo ya dunia kuliko watu wa nuru.

english: I tell you, use worldly wealth to make friends for yourselves, so that when it is gone, they will welcome you into eternal dwellings.
ekegusii: Nkobateebia nde inwe: Ekorere abasani nenibo y’ense eye etari boronge, erinde ekero egochia gokea, baabaroisie inwe ase obomenyo bwa kare na kare.
swahili: Nawaambia, tumieni mali ya kidunia kujipatia marafiki, ili itakapokwisha, mkaribishwe katika makao ya milele.

english: Jesus said to His disciples, “It is inevitable that stumbling blocks will come, but woe to the one through whom they come!
ekegusii: Yeso agateebia aborokigwa baye, “Amang’ana ’okogocha takomocha kooroka, korende obobe nobwaye omonto oria okoyarenta!
swahili: Yesu akawaambia wanafunzi wake, “Mambo yanayosababisha watu watende dhambi hayana budi kutukia. Lakini ole wake mtu yule anayeyasababisha.

english: So you also, when you have done everything commanded of you, should say, ‘We are unworthy servants; we have only done our duty.’” The Ten Lepers (2 Kings 5:1–14)
ekegusii: Naboigo nainwe, komorakore onsi aya mwachiikirwe, teba: ‘Intwe nabasomba bataisaneti; twakorire aya atogwenerete gokora.’” Yeso okogwenia abanto ikomi abarenge noborwaire bwa ukoma
swahili: Vivyo hivyo nanyi mkiisha kufanya mliyoagizwa, semeni, ‘Sisi tu watumishi tusiostahili; tumefanya tu yale tuliyopaswa kufanya.’ ” Yesu Atakasa Wakoma Kumi

english: While Jesus was on His way to Jerusalem, He was passing between Samaria and Galilee.
ekegusii: Ase enchera ekogenda Yerusalemu Yeso ngoeta arenge egati ya Samaria na Galili.
swahili: Yesu alipokuwa njiani akienda Yerusalemu, alipitia mpakani mwa Samaria na Galilaya.

english: As He entered one of the villages, He was met by ten lepers. They stood at a distance
ekegusii: Ekero are gosoa omochie oyomo, akaumerana nabaanto ikomi abarenge noborwaire bwa ukoma, bateneine are;
swahili: Alipokuwa akiingia kwenye kijiji kimoja, watu kumi waliokuwa na ukoma wakakutana naye. Wakasimama mbali,

english: and raised their voices, shouting, “Jesus, Master, have mercy on us!”
ekegusii: na barabwo bagaaka eriogi bakaboora, “Yeso, Omonene, tororere amaabera!”
swahili: wakapaza sauti, wakasema, “Yesu, Bwana, tuhurumie!”

english: When Jesus saw them, He said, “Go, show yourselves to the priests.” And as they were on their way, they were cleansed.
ekegusii: Agachia kobarora, akabateebia, “Genda mweorokie ase abakuani.” Kobakogenda bagasibeka.
swahili: Alipowaona akawaambia, “Nendeni mkajionyeshe kwa makuhani.” Nao walipokuwa njiani wakienda, wakatakasika.

english: When one of them saw that he was healed, he came back, praising God in a loud voice.
ekegusii: Oyomo obo agachia korora ng’a osibekire, akairana okomobaaka Nyasae ase eriogi rinene,
swahili: Mmoja wao alipoona kwamba amepona, akarudi kwa Yesu, akimsifu Mungu kwa sauti kuu.

english: He fell facedown at Jesus’ feet in thanksgiving to Him—and he was a Samaritan.
ekegusii: akagwa ase amagoro a Yeso, okomoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono, na ere n’Omosamaria orenge.
swahili: Akajitupa miguuni mwa Yesu akamshukuru. Yeye alikuwa Msamaria.

english: “Were not all ten cleansed?” Jesus asked. “Where then are the other nine?
ekegusii: Yeso akabora, “Tari bonsi ikomi basibeka? Baria kianda, ng’ai bare?
swahili: Yesu akauliza, “Je, hawakutakaswa wote kumi? Wako wapi wale wengine tisa?

english: Was no one found except this foreigner to return and give glory to God?”
ekegusii: Onde tanyorekanete oiranete komotogia Nyasae, otatiga omogeni oyo?”
swahili: Hakuna hata mmoja aliyeonekana kurudi ili kumshukuru Mungu isipokuwa huyu mgeni?”

english: Then Jesus said to him, “Rise and go; your faith has made you well! ” The Coming of the Kingdom (Genesis 19:24–29)
ekegusii: Akamoteebia, “Tenena, ogende; okwegena kwao gwakogwenirie.” Ogocha kw’oborwoti (Mat 24:26-28,37-41)
swahili: Yesu akamwambia, “Inuka na uende zako, imani yako imekuponya.” Kuja Kwa Ufalme Wa Mungu (Mathayo 24:23-28, 37-41)

english: It would be better for him to have a millstone hung around his neck and to be thrown into the sea than to cause one of these little ones to stumble.
ekegusii: Anga mbuya kobua ase omonto oria asungerwe orogena rogosia ase rigoti riaye, arutwe enyancha ime, kobua aragere oyomo bw’aba abake akore ebibe.
swahili: Ingekuwa heri kama mtu huyo angefungiwa jiwe la kusagia shingoni na kutoswa baharini, kuliko kumsababisha mmojawapo wa hawa wadogo kutenda dhambi.

english: When asked by the Pharisees when the kingdom of God would come, Jesus replied, “The kingdom of God will not come with observable signs.
ekegusii: Yeso agachia koborigwa n’Abafarisai, “Oborwoti bwa Nyasae indi borache?” Akabairaneria, “Oborwoti bwa Nyasae tibori gocha ase ebimanyererio bikororekana,
swahili: Yesu alipoulizwa na Mafarisayo Ufalme wa Mungu utakuja lini, yeye akawajibu, “Ufalme wa Mungu hauji kwa kuchunguza kwa bidii,

english: Nor will people say, ‘Look, here it is,’ or ‘There it is.’ For you see, the kingdom of God is in your midst. ”
ekegusii: gose tibakobora: Rora naiga bore, gose: Naaria! Rora, oborwoti bwa Nyasae nigo bore ime ase more.”
swahili: wala watu hawatasema, ‘Huu hapa,’ au ‘Ule kule,’ kwa maana Ufalme wa Mungu umo ndani yenu.”

english: Then He said to the disciples, “The time is coming when you will long to see one of the days of the Son of Man, but you will not see it.
ekegusii: Agateebia aborokigwa baye, “Amatuko nache morarigie korora rituko erimo ri’amatuko y’Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto, korende timokorirora.
swahili: Kisha Yesu akawaambia wanafunzi wake, “Wakati utafika ambapo mtatamani kuiona moja ya siku ya Mwana wa Adamu, lakini hamtaiona.

english: People will tell you, ‘Look, there He is!’ or ‘Look, here He is!’ Do not go out or chase after them.
ekegusii: Naende nabaabateebie: Rora aaria, gose: Rora aiga! Timogenda, gose timobatunyana.
swahili: Watu watawaambia, ‘Yule kule!’ Au, ‘Huyu hapa!’ Msiwakimbilie.

english: For just as the lightning flashes and lights up the sky from one end to the other, so will be the Son of Man in His day.
ekegusii: Naki buna okomesa gokomesa korwa igoro ensemo eyemo goika ensemo ende, nabo Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto araache koba ase rituko riaye.
