swahili: Kwa maana kama vile umeme wa radi umulikavyo katika anga kuanzia mwisho mmoja hadi mwingine, ndivyo atakavyokuwa Mwana wa Adamu katika siku yake.

english: But first He must suffer many things and be rejected by this generation.
ekegusii: Korende ritang’ani nagwenerete konyora ogochandwa okonge, na kwangwa nekegori eke.
swahili: Lakini kwanza itampasa kuteseka katika mambo mengi na kukataliwa na kizazi hiki.

english: Just as it was in the days of Noah, so also will it be in the days of the Son of Man:
ekegusii: Naende buna yabeete ase amatuko a Nuhu, naboigo eraabe nase amatuko y’Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto.
swahili: “Kama ilivyokuwa siku za Noa, ndivyo itakavyokuwa katika siku za Mwana wa Adamu.

english: People were eating and drinking, marrying and being given in marriage, up to the day Noah entered the ark. Then the flood came and destroyed them all.
ekegusii: Barenge koria, bakonywa, bakonyuoma, bakonyuomerigwa, goika rituko riria Nuhu asoete ase obwato; etoigo egaacha, egasiria bonsi.
swahili: Watu walikuwa wakila na kunywa, wakioa na kuolewa, mpaka siku ile Noa alipoingia katika safina. Ndipo gharika ikaja na kuwaangamiza wote.

english: It was the same in the days of Lot: People were eating and drinking, buying and selling, planting and building.
ekegusii: Naboigo buna yabeete ase amatuko a Loti: Barenge koria na konywa, bakogora, koonia, bagosimeka, bakoagacha.
swahili: “Ndivyo ilivyokuwa katika siku za Loti: Watu walikuwa wakila na kunywa, wakinunua na kuuza, wakilima na kujenga.

english: But on the day Lot left Sodom, fire and sulfur rained down from heaven and destroyed them all.
ekegusii: Korende ase rituko riria Loti aruete Sodomu omorero na ekebiriti bigatwa korwa igoro, bigasiria bonsi.
swahili: Lakini siku ile Loti alipoondoka Sodoma, ikanyesha mvua ya moto na kiberiti kutoka mbinguni ukawaangamiza wote.

english: Watch yourselves. If your brother sins, rebuke him; and if he repents, forgive him.
ekegusii: Erende; oyomino karakore ebibe, mokanie; karaonchoke, mwabere.
swahili: Kwa hiyo, jilindeni. “Kama ndugu yako akikukosea mwonye, naye akitubu, msamehe.

english: It will be just like that on the day the Son of Man is revealed.
ekegusii: Naboigo erache koba ase rituko riria Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto araoroke.
swahili: “Hivyo ndivyo itakavyokuwa siku ile Mwana wa Adamu atakapofunuliwa.

english: On that day, let no one on the housetop come down to retrieve his possessions. Likewise, let no one in the field return for anything he has left behind.
ekegusii: Ase rituko riria oyore kerama igoro, na ebinto biaye bire nyomba ime, taika abibogorie; nere oyore mogondo naboigo tairana inka.
swahili: Siku hiyo, mtu yeyote aliye juu ya dari ya nyumba yake, hata vitu vyake vikiwa ndani ya hiyo nyumba, asishuke kuvichukua. Vivyo hivyo mtu aliye shambani asirudi nyumbani kuchukua chochote.

english: Remember Lot’s wife!
ekegusii: Moinyore moka Loti.
swahili: Mkumbukeni mke wa Loti!

english: Whoever tries to save his life will lose it, but whoever loses his life will preserve it.
ekegusii: Oyorarigie koegera obogima bwaye nabosirie, korende oyorasirie obogima bwaye nabonyoore.
swahili: Mtu yeyote anayejaribu kuyaokoa maisha yake atayapoteza, na yeyote atakayeyapoteza maisha yake atayaokoa.

english: I tell you, on that night two people will be in one bed: One will be taken and the other left.
ekegusii: Nabatebirie, obotuko boria abanto babere nababe ase oborere obomo, oyomo nairwe, na oyonde natigwe.
swahili: Nawaambia, usiku huo watu wawili watakuwa wamelala kitanda kimoja; naye mmoja atatwaliwa na mwingine ataachwa.

english: Two women will be grinding grain together: One will be taken and the other left.”
ekegusii: Abakungu babere nababe bagoseera ase orogena oromo; oyomo nairwe, na oyonde natigwe. [
swahili: Wanawake wawili watakuwa wanasaga nafaka pamoja; naye mmoja atatwaliwa na mwingine ataachwa. [

english: “Where, Lord?” they asked. Jesus answered, “Wherever there is a carcass, there the vultures will gather.”
ekegusii: Bakamobooria, “Ng’ai Omonene?” Akabairaneria, “Ase ribego rire nao chinsoti chigosangererekana.”
swahili: Kisha wakamuuliza, “Haya yatatukia wapi Bwana?” Akawaambia, “Pale ulipo mzoga, huko ndiko tai watakapokusanyika.”

english: Even if he sins against you seven times in a day, and seven times returns to say, ‘I repent,’ you must forgive him.” The Power of Faith (Matthew 17:19–20)
ekegusii: Naende karakore ebibe ase ore ara gatano na kabere ase rituko erimo, karakoiranere ara gatano na kabere na goteeba: Naonchokire, mwabere.”
swahili: Kama akikukosea mara saba kwa siku moja na mara saba kwa siku moja akaja kwako akisema, ‘Ninatubu,’ msamehe.” Imani

english: The apostles said to the Lord, “Increase our faith!”
ekegusii: Abatomwa bakamoteebia, “Omonene, tomentere okwegena gwaito.”
swahili: Mitume wake wakamwambia Bwana, “Tuongezee imani.”

english: And the Lord answered, “If you have faith the size of a mustard seed, you can say to this mulberry tree, ‘Be uprooted and planted in the sea,’ and it will obey you.
ekegusii: Omonene akabora, “Onye mwarenge nokwegena koreng’aine buna entetere y’omote onga buna omosabisabi, anga mwateebia omokenene oyo: Simoka, bwesimeke nyancha, noro anga nobaigwera.
swahili: Bwana akawajibu, “Kama mkiwa na imani ndogo kama punje ya haradali, mngeweza kuuambia mti huu wa mkuyu, ‘Ngʼoka ukaote baharini,’ nao ungewatii. Wajibu Wa Mtumishi

english: Which of you whose servant comes in from plowing or shepherding in the field will say to him, ‘Come at once and sit down to eat’?
ekegusii: “Korende ning’o ase more oyore nomosomba okorema, gose okorisia ching’ondi, oramoteebie ekero akorwa mogondo agosoa nyomba: Inchuo bwango oikaranse, orie endagera?
swahili: “Ikiwa mmoja wenu ana mtumishi anayelima shambani au anayechunga kondoo, je, mtumishi huyo arudipo atamwambia, ‘Karibu hapa keti ule chakula?’

english: Instead, won’t he tell him, ‘Prepare my meal and dress yourself to serve me while I eat and drink; and afterward you may eat and drink’?
ekegusii: Inee! Takomoteebia: Ebeke ang’e, ondoiserie endagera goika indie inywe, na magega yaye, naye orie na konywa?
swahili: Je, badala yake, hatamwambia, ‘Niandalie chakula, nile, jifunge unitumikie ninapokula na kunywa; baadaye waweza kula na kunywa?’

english: Does he thank the servant because he did what he was told?
ekegusii: Gose nkomoteebia are omosomba oria ng’a mbuya mono, ekiagera akora eki achikwa?
swahili: Je, huyo mtu atamshukuru mtumishi huyo kwa kutimiza yale aliyoamriwa?

english: Then Jesus told them a parable about their need to pray at all times and not lose heart:
ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia omoreng’anio ng’a nebagwenerete komosaba Nyasae botambe, tibakwa emioyo,
swahili: Kisha Yesu akawapa wanafunzi wake mfano ili kuwaonyesha kuwa yawapasa kuomba pasipo kukata tamaa.

english: “Two men went up to the temple to pray. One was a Pharisee and the other a tax collector.
ekegusii: “Abanto babere bagatiira gochia Hekalu gosaba; oyomo n’Omofarisai na oyonde omorusia ebango.
swahili: “Watu wawili walikwenda Hekaluni kusali, mmoja wao alikuwa Farisayo na mwingine alikuwa mtoza ushuru.

english: The Pharisee stood by himself and prayed, ‘God, I thank You that I am not like the other men—swindlers, evildoers, adulterers—or even like this tax collector.
ekegusii: Oria Omofarisai agatenena, agasaba iga ase omoyo oye: Nyasae, nakoiraneirie ng’a mbuya mono, ekiagera inche tindi buna abanto bande, abauri, abatari boronge, abatomani, gose buna oyo omorusia ebango.
swahili: Yule Farisayo, akasimama, akasali hivi na kuomba kwake mwenyewe: ‘Mungu, nakushukuru kwa sababu mimi si kama watu wengine ambao ni wanyangʼanyi, wadhalimu, na wazinzi, wala kama huyu mtoza ushuru.

english: I fast twice a week and pay tithes of all that I acquire.’
ekegusii: Igo nkweng’ata ara kabere ase echuma; ’ndua ensemo ya ikomi y’okonyora kwane gwonsi.
swahili: Mimi nafunga mara mbili kwa juma, na natoa sehemu ya kumi ya mapato yangu.’

english: But the tax collector stood at a distance, unwilling even to lift up his eyes to heaven. Instead, he beat his breast and said, ‘God, have mercy on me, a sinner!’
ekegusii: Na oria omorusia ebango agatenena are, tarigia nonya nkoimokia amaiso aye igoro, korende ageaka‐aka egekuba kiaye, okobora: Nyasae, indorera amaabera inche omonyene ebibe!
swahili: “Lakini yule mtoza ushuru akasimama mbali, wala hakuthubutu hata kuinua uso wake kutazama mbinguni, bali alijipigapiga kifuani na kusema: ‘Mungu, nihurumie, mimi mwenye dhambi.’

english: I tell you, this man, rather than the Pharisee, went home justified. For everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, but the one who humbles himself will be exalted.” Jesus Blesses the Children (Matthew 19:13–15; Mark 10:13–16)
ekegusii: Nabatebirie inwe: Omonto oria nigo aigete bwoye konya obareirwe oboronge kobua oria onde, ekiagera oyokweimokereria igoro nairanigwe inse, na ere oyokweirania inse naimokererigwe igoro.” Yeso ogosesenia abana abake (Mat 19:13-15; Mar 10:13-16)
swahili: “Nawaambia, huyu mtoza ushuru alirudi nyumbani akiwa amehesabiwa haki mbele za Mungu zaidi ya yule Farisayo. Kwa maana yeyote ajikwezaye atashushwa, na yeyote ajishushaye atakwezwa.” Yesu Awabariki Watoto Wadogo (Mathayo 19:13-15; Marko 10:13-16)

english: Now people were even bringing their babies to Jesus for Him to place His hands on them. And when the disciples saw this, they rebuked those who brought them.
ekegusii: Bakamorentera abana ebing’werere, erinde abakune; korende aborokigwa baye bagachia kobarora, bakabatanga.
swahili: Pia, watu walikuwa wakimletea Yesu watoto wachanga ili awaguse. Wanafunzi wake walipoona hivyo, wakawakemea.

english: But Jesus called the children to Him and said, “Let the little children come to Me, and do not hinder them! For the kingdom of God belongs to such as these.
ekegusii: Korende Yeso akabarangeria bache asare, ogoteeba, “Batige abana bache ase ’nde, timobaisa kobatanga, ekiagera abare buna aba, oborwotinbwa Nyasae nobwabo.
swahili: Lakini Yesu akawaita wale watoto waje kwake, akasema, “Waacheni watoto wadogo waje kwangu, wala msiwazuie, kwa maana Ufalme wa Mungu ni wa wale walio kama hawa.

english: Truly I tell you, anyone who does not receive the kingdom of God like a little child will never enter it.” The Rich Young Ruler (Matthew 19:16–30; Mark 10:17–31)
ekegusii: Ekeene nabateebirie: Onde bwensi otancheti oborwoti bwa Nyasae buna omwana omoke, takobosoa nonya ng’ake.” Obogima bwa kare na kare, na obobe bw’obotenenku (Mat 19:16-30; Mar 10:17-31)
swahili: Amin, nawaambia, mtu yeyote asiyeupokea Ufalme wa Mungu kama mtoto mdogo, hatauingia kamwe.” Mtawala Tajiri (Mathayo 19:16-30; Marko 10:17-31)

english: Then a certain ruler asked Him, “Good Teacher, what must I do to inherit eternal life?”
ekegusii: Na omogambi gete akamobooria, “Omworokia omuya, ninki ndakore inyare koba nomwando bw’obogima bwa kare na kare?”
swahili: Mtawala mmoja akamuuliza Yesu, “Mwalimu mwema, nifanye nini ili niurithi uzima wa milele?”

english: “Why do you call Me good?” Jesus replied. “No one is good except God alone.
ekegusii: Yeso akamoiraneria, “Naki okondoka omuya? Onde tari omuya otatiga Nyasae bweka.
swahili: Yesu akamjibu, “Mbona unaniita mwema? Hakuna yeyote aliye mwema ila Mungu peke yake.

english: “In a certain town there was a judge who neither feared God nor respected men.
ekegusii: akabora, “Narenge omogambi ase omochie gete, otasigete Nyasae, gose taare koyiera monto.
swahili: Akawaambia, “Katika mji mmoja alikuwepo hakimu ambaye hakumwogopa Mungu wala kumjali mtu.

english: You know the commandments: ‘Do not commit adultery, do not murder, do not steal, do not bear false witness, honor your father and mother.’ ”
ekegusii: Kwamanyire amachiiko; Totomana, Toita, Toiba, Toteba oborimo, sika iso na nyoko.”
swahili: Unazijua amri: ‘Usizini, usiue, usiibe, usishuhudie uongo, waheshimu baba yako na mama yako.’ ”

english: “All these I have kept from my youth,” he said.
ekegusii: Akabora, “Ayio onsi ninyabwatete korwa obwana bwane.”
swahili: Akajibu, “Amri hizi zote nimezishika tangu nikiwa mtoto.”

english: On hearing this, Jesus told him, “You still lack one thing: Sell everything you own and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven. Then come, follow Me.”
ekegusii: Ekero Yeso achia koigwa aya, akamoteebia, “Egento ekemo ngekoremete; oonie ebio ore nabio bionsi ogabere abataka, na aye nobe nenibo igoro. Erio ochiche ontunyane.”
swahili: Yesu aliposikia haya, akamwambia, “Bado kuna jambo moja ulilopungukiwa. Nenda ukauze kila kitu ulicho nacho, uwape maskini, nawe utakuwa na hazina mbinguni. Kisha njoo, unifuate.”

english: But when the ruler heard this, he became very sad, because he was extremely wealthy.
ekegusii: Korende ekero achia koigwa aya akaba nomoichano, ekiagera arenge omonda mono.
swahili: Aliposikia jambo hili, alisikitika sana kwa maana alikuwa mtu mwenye mali nyingi.

english: Seeing the man’s sadness, Jesus said, “How hard it is for the rich to enter the kingdom of God!
ekegusii: Nabo Yeso akamorigereria, akabora, “Nabe aakong’u ase abare abanda gosoa ase oborwoti bwa Nyasae!
swahili: Yesu akamtazama, akasema, “Tazama jinsi ilivyo vigumu kwa tajiri kuingia katika Ufalme wa Mungu!

english: Indeed, it is easier for a camel to pass through the eye of a needle than for a rich man to enter the kingdom of God.”
ekegusii: Naki naororo engamia goeta ase ekebao gi’esiindani, kobua omonda gosoa ase oborwoti bwa Nyasae.”
swahili: Hakika ni rahisi zaidi kwa ngamia kupita kwenye tundu la sindano kuliko mtu tajiri kuingia katika Ufalme wa Mungu.”

english: Those who heard this asked, “Who then can be saved?”
ekegusii: Na abwo abayaigwete bakaboora, “Ning’o rende oranyare gotooreka?”
swahili: Wale waliosikia haya wakauliza, “Ni nani basi awezaye kuokoka?”

english: But Jesus said, “What is impossible with man is possible with God.”
ekegusii: Akabora, “Aya takonyarekana ase Mwanyabaanto, nigo akonyarekana ase Nyasae.”
swahili: Yesu akajibu, “Yasiyowezekana kwa wanadamu yanawezekana kwa Mungu.”

english: “Look,” said Peter, “we have left all we had to follow You.”
ekegusii: Petero akabora, “Rora, intwe twatigire chinka chiaito, twagotunyanire aye.”
swahili: Ndipo Petro akamjibu, “Tazama, tumeacha vyote tulivyokuwa navyo tukakufuata!”

english: “Truly I tell you,” Jesus replied, “no one who has left home or wife or brothers or parents or children for the sake of the kingdom of God
ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Ekeene nabateebirie: Monto onde tari otigire enyomba, gose mokaye, gose abamwabo, gose abaibori, gose abana, ase engencho y’oborwoti bwa Nyasae,
swahili: Yesu akajibu, “Amin, nawaambia, hakuna hata mtu aliyeacha nyumba yake, au mke, au ndugu, au wazazi au watoto kwa ajili ya Ufalme wa Mungu

english: And there was a widow in that town who kept appealing to him, ‘Give me justice against my adversary.’
ekegusii: Na ase omochie oyio narengeo omoboraka orenge komochiera botambe, ogoteeba: Ngambera boronge ase omosiira one.
swahili: Katika mji huo alikuwako mjane mmoja ambaye alikuwa akija kwake mara kwa mara akimwomba, ‘Tafadhali nipatie haki kati yangu na adui yangu.’

english: will fail to receive many times more in this age—and in the age to come, eternal life.” The Third Prediction of the Passion (Matthew 20:17–19; Mark 10:32–34)
ekegusii: otanyore kobua ara aange bono, naende ase ense egochi‐gocha obogima bwa kare na kare.” Obobani bwa gatato bwa Yeso igoro y’ogokwa kwaye (Mat 20:17-19; Mar 10:32-34)
swahili: ambaye hatapewa mara nyingi zaidi ya hivyo katika maisha haya, na hatimaye kupata uzima wa milele ujao.” Yesu Atabiri Kifo Chake Mara Ya Tatu (Mathayo 20:17-19; Marko 10:32-34)

english: Then Jesus took the Twelve aside and said to them, “Look, we are going up to Jerusalem, and everything the prophets have written about the Son of Man will be fulfilled.
ekegusii: Erio Yeso akaira baria ikomi na babere, akabateebia, “Rora, ngotiira tore kogenda Yerusalemu, naende amang’ana onsi ayariikeretwe Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto nababani naikeranigwe.
swahili: Yesu akawachukua wale wanafunzi wake kumi na wawili kando na kuwaambia, “Tunapanda kwenda Yerusalemu, na kila kitu kilichoandikwa na manabii kumhusu Mwana wa Adamu kitatimizwa.

english: He will be delivered over to the Gentiles and will be mocked and insulted and spit upon.
ekegusii: Naki nabekwe ase amaboko y’abanto b’Ebisaku, nakorerwe echeche, na gokorerwa bobe, na gotwerwa amate;
swahili: Kwa kuwa atatiwa mikononi mwa watu wasiomjua Mungu, nao watamdhihaki, watamtukana na kumtemea mate, watampiga mijeledi na kumuua.

english: But the disciples did not understand any of these things. The meaning was hidden from them, and they did not comprehend what He was saying. Jesus Heals a Blind Beggar (Matthew 20:29–34; Mark 10:46–52)
ekegusii: Korende tibamanya nonya nering’ana erimo ase aya. Ring’ana eri rikabiseka ase bare, na tibamanya ayateebetwe. Yeso okogwenia omonto omouko (Mat 20:29-34; Mar 10:46-52)
swahili: Wanafunzi wake hawakuelewa mambo haya, kwa kuwa maana yake ilikuwa imefichika kwao, nao hawakujua Yesu alikuwa anazungumzia nini. Yesu Amponya Kipofu Karibu Na Yeriko (Mathayo 20:29-34; Marko 10:46-52)

english: As Jesus drew near to Jericho, a blind man was sitting beside the road, begging.
ekegusii: Ekero achia goika ang’e na Yeriko omonto oyomo omouko naikaransete enchera ensemo ogosaba ebiegwa.
swahili: Yesu alipokuwa anakaribia Yeriko, kipofu mmoja alikuwa ameketi kando ya njia akiomba msaada.

english: When he heard the crowd going by, he asked what was happening.
ekegusii: Agachia koigwa omoganda ogoeta, akaboria, “Inki ekio?”
swahili: Kipofu huyo aliposikia umati wa watu ukipita, akauliza, “Kuna nini?”

english: “Jesus of Nazareth is passing by,” they told him.
ekegusii: Bakamoiraneria, “Yeso o Nazareti ogoeta.”
swahili: Wakamwambia, “Yesu wa Nazareti anapita.”

english: So he called out, “Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on me!”
ekegusii: Agaaka eriogi, akabora, “Yeso, omwana o Daudi, indorera amaabera!”
swahili: Akapaza sauti, akasema, “Yesu, Mwana wa Daudi, nihurumie!”

english: Those who led the way admonished him to be silent, but he cried out all the louder, “Son of David, have mercy on me!”
ekegusii: Nabwo batang’aine bakamokania, bakamoteebia akire, korende ere akamenta mono goaka eriogi, “Omwana o Daudi, indorera amaabera!”
swahili: Wale waliokuwa wametangulia mbele wakamkemea, wakamwambia akae kimya. Lakini yeye akapaza sauti zaidi, “Mwana wa Daudi, nihurumie!”

english: For a while he refused, but later he said to himself, ‘Though I neither fear God nor respect men,
ekegusii: Omogambi oria ase ekero egeke tancha; magega agateeba ase omoyo oye: Nonya inche tinsigeti Nyasae, gose tindi koyiera monto,
swahili: “Kwa muda mrefu yule hakimu alikataa. Lakini hatimaye akasema moyoni mwake, ‘Ijapokuwa simwogopi Mungu wala simjali mwanadamu,

english: Jesus stopped and directed that the man be brought to Him. When he had been brought near, Jesus asked him,
ekegusii: Yeso agatenena, agachiika arentwe asare. Agachia komoika ang’e, akamobooria,
swahili: Yesu akasimama, akawaamuru wamlete huyo mtu kwake. Alipokaribia, Yesu akamuuliza,

english: “What do you want Me to do for you?” “Lord,” he said, “let me see again.”
ekegusii: “Ninki origetie ngokorere?” Akamoiraneria, “Omonene, inyare korora.”
swahili: “Unataka nikufanyie nini?” Akajibu, “Bwana, nataka kuona.”

english: “Receive your sight!” Jesus replied. “Your faith has healed you.”
ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Oegwe okorora; okwegena kwao gwakogwenirie.”
swahili: Yesu akamwambia, “Basi upate kuona. Imani yako imekuponya.”

english: Immediately he received his sight and followed Jesus, glorifying God. And all the people who saw this gave praise to God.
ekegusii: Erio kegima akaba nkorora are, akamotunyana, okomotogia Nyasae; na abanto bonsi bagachia korora aya, bakamotogia Nyasae.
swahili: Akapata kuona saa ile ile, akamfuata Yesu, huku akimsifu Mungu. Watu wote walipoona mambo hayo, nao wakamsifu Mungu.

english: yet because this widow keeps pestering me, I will give her justice. Then she will stop wearing me out with her perpetual requests.’”
ekegusii: korende ekiagera omoboraka oyo andosirie, nimogambere boronge, tacha kondosia ase ogonchichera botambe.”
swahili: lakini kwa kuwa huyu mjane ananisumbuasumbua, nitahakikisha amepata haki yake ili asiendelee kunichosha kwa kunijia mara kwa mara!’ ”

english: And the Lord said, “Listen to the words of the unjust judge.
ekegusii: Omonene akabora, “Igwa aya omogambi otari omooronge agoteeba.
swahili: Bwana akasema, “Sikilizeni asemavyo huyu hakimu dhalimu.

english: Will not God bring about justice for His elect who cry out to Him day and night? Will He continue to defer their help?
ekegusii: Inee! Nyasae takobanyorera oboronge abachore baye, abakomoreera omobaso na obotuko? Na ere takoba omoremereria ase bare?
swahili: Je, Mungu hatawatendea haki wateule wake wanaomlilia usiku na mchana? Je, atakawia kuwasaidia?

english: I tell you, He will promptly carry out justice on their behalf. Nevertheless, when the Son of Man comes, will He find faith on earth?” The Pharisee and the Tax Collector
ekegusii: Nabatebirie nabanyorere oboronge ase obwango. Korende Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto kagocha, Inee, nanyore okwegena ase ense?” Omoreng’anio bw’Omofarisai na omorusia ebango
swahili: Ninawaambia, atawapatia haki upesi. Lakini je, Mwana wa Adamu atakapokuja ataikuta imani duniani?” Mfano Wa Farisayo Na Mtoza Ushuru

english: To some who trusted in their own righteousness and viewed others with contempt, He also told this parable:
ekegusii: Akabateebia omoreng’anio oyo ase abanto baare gwekaga ng’a nabanyene oboronge, bagochaaya abande bonsi:
swahili: Yesu akatoa mfano huu kwa wale waliojiamini kuwa wao ni wenye haki na kuwadharau wengine:

english: Then Jesus entered Jericho and was passing through.
ekegusii: Yeso agasoa Yeriko, akaba ngoeta are egati‐gati yaye.
swahili: Yesu akaingia Yeriko, naye alikuwa anapita katikati ya huo mji.

english: For the Son of Man came to seek and to save the lost.” The Parable of the Ten Minas (Matthew 25:14–30)
ekegusii: Naki Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto nigo achete korigia egiasirete na kogetooria.” Omoreng’anio bwe chiropia
swahili: Kwa maana Mwana wa Adamu amekuja kutafuta na kuokoa kile kilichopotea.” Mfano Wa Fedha (Mathayo 25:14-30)

english: While the people were listening to this, Jesus proceeded to tell them a parable, because He was near Jerusalem and they thought the kingdom of God would appear imminently.
ekegusii: Abanto baria bagachia koigwa aya, Yeso akamenta kobateebia omoreng’anio, ekiagera konya oikire ang’e na Yerusalemu, na barabwo bagakaga ng’a oborwoti bwa Nyasae nigo borarorekane ekero ekio kegima.
swahili: Walipokuwa wanasikiliza haya, Yesu akaendelea kuwaambia mfano, kwa sababu alikuwa anakaribia Yerusalemu na watu walikuwa wakidhani ya kuwa Ufalme wa Mungu ulikuwa unakuja saa iyo hiyo.

english: So He said, “A man of noble birth went to a distant country to lay claim to his kingship and then return.
ekegusii: Nabo akabora, “Omonto oyomo omosike akagenda ense y’aare, erinde anyare kwenyorera oborwoti, naende airane.
swahili: Hivyo akawaambia: “Mtu mmoja mwenye cheo kikubwa alisafiri kwenda nchi ya mbali ili akapokee madaraka ya kuwa mfalme, kisha arudi.

english: Beforehand, he called ten of his servants and gave them ten minas. ‘Conduct business with this until I return,’ he said.
ekegusii: Akarangeria abanto ikomi korwa ase abasomba baye, akabaa ebirengo ikomi bie chiropia, akabateebia: Biire mobionchorerie goika ekero nkoirana.
swahili: Hivyo akawaita kumi miongoni mwa watumishi wake, na akawapa kila mmoja fungu la fedha. Akawaambia, ‘Fanyeni biashara na fedha hizi mpaka nitakaporudi.’

english: But his subjects hated him and sent a delegation after him to say, ‘We do not want this man to rule over us.’
ekegusii: Abanto b’ense yaye bakamogecha, bagatoma abatomwa komotunyana na komoteebia, Titorigeti omonto oyo atogambere.
swahili: “Lakini raiya wa nchi yake walimchukia wakapeleka ujumbe na kusema, ‘Hatutaki huyu mtu awe mfalme wetu.’

english: When he returned from procuring his kingship, he summoned the servants to whom he had given the money, to find out what each one had earned.
ekegusii: “Ekero achia koirana, kanyorire oborwoti, agachiika abasomba baria aete chiropia barangerigwe, erinde anyare komanya ebitoki banyorire ase okoonchoreria kwabo.
swahili: “Hata hivyo alirudi akiwa amekwisha kupokea mamlaka ya ufalme, akawaita wale watumishi wake aliokuwa amewaachia fedha, ili afahamu ni faida kiasi gani kila mmoja wao aliyopata kwa kufanya biashara.

english: The first servant came forward and said, ‘Master, your mina has produced ten more minas.’
ekegusii: Oyo bw’eritang’ani agacha, okobora: Omonene, ekerengo kiao kiarentire ebirengo ikomi binde.
swahili: “Wa kwanza akaja na kusema, ‘Bwana, kutokana na fedha uliyoniachia, nimepata faida mara kumi zaidi.’

english: His master replied, ‘Well done, good servant! Because you have been faithful in a very small matter, you shall have authority over ten cities.’
ekegusii: Akamoteebia: Gwakorire buya, aye omosomba omuya! Ekiagera kwabeire omwegenwa ase egento kere egeke, nabo nobe nokobua igoro ase emechie ikomi.
swahili: “Yule bwana akamjibu, ‘Umefanya vizuri mtumishi mwema! Kwa sababu umekuwa mwaminifu katika wajibu mdogo sana, nakupa mamlaka juu ya miji kumi.’

english: The second servant came and said, ‘Master, your mina has made five minas.’
ekegusii: Na oyo o kabere agacha, akabora: Omonene, ekerengo kiao kiarentire ebirengo bitano.
swahili: “Wa pili naye akaja. Akasema, ‘Bwana, fedha yako imeleta faida mara tano zaidi.’

english: And to this one he said, ‘You shall have authority over five cities.’
ekegusii: Akamoteebia nere boigo: Aye nobe igoro ase emechie etano.
swahili: “Bwana wake akajibu, ‘Nakupa mamlaka juu ya miji mitano.’

english: And there was a man named Zacchaeus, a chief tax collector, who was very wealthy.
ekegusii: Narenge aroro omonto oyomo ore korokwa Zakayo, omonene bw’abarusia ebango; ere nomonda orenge.
swahili: Tazama, palikuwa na mtu mmoja mkuu wa watoza ushuru naye alikuwa tajiri, jina lake Zakayo.

english: Then another servant came and said, ‘Master, here is your mina, which I have laid away in a piece of cloth.
ekegusii: Naende oyonde agacha, akabora: Omonene, eke nakio ekerengo kiao nagachete ase egetambaa;
swahili: “Kisha akaja yule mtumishi mwingine, akasema, ‘Bwana, hii hapa fedha yako. Niliitunza vizuri kwenye kitambaa.

english: For I was afraid of you, because you are a harsh man. You withdraw what you did not deposit and reap what you did not sow.’
ekegusii: nigo nakoirogete, ekiagera aye nigo ore omonto omokong’u. Nigo okobogoria eki otagachete, na kogesa eki otasimegete.
swahili: Nilikuogopa, kwa sababu wewe ni mtu mgumu. Unachukua ambapo hukuweka kitu, na unavuna mahali ambapo hukupanda kitu.’

english: His master replied, ‘You wicked servant, I will judge you by your own words. So you knew that I am a harsh man, withdrawing what I did not deposit and reaping what I did not sow?
ekegusii: Akamoteebia: Ase enkwana y’omonwa oo ninkogambie, aye omosomba omobe. Nkwamanyete ng’a inche nomonto omokong’u, nkobogoria eki ntagachete, na kogesa eki ntasimegete.
swahili: “Bwana wake akamjibu, ‘Nitakuhukumu kwa maneno yako mwenyewe, wewe mtumishi mwovu! Kama ulifahamu kwamba mimi ni mtu mgumu, nichukuaye mahali ambapo sikuweka kitu na kuvuna mahali ambapo sikupanda,

english: Why then did you not deposit my money in the bank, and upon my return I could have collected it with interest?’
ekegusii: Naki rende otabeegete chitaabu chiane ase aba bakorua ebitoki, ninche ngocha anga nachinyora amo nebitoki?
swahili: kwa nini basi hukuweka fedha zangu kwa watoa riba, ili nitakaporudi nichukue iliyo yangu na riba yake?’

english: Then he told those standing by, ‘Take the mina from him and give it to the one who has ten minas.’
ekegusii: Agateebia abarengeo: Moure ekerengo kiaye, moe oria oyore nebirengo ikomi.
swahili: “Ndipo akawaambia wale waliokuwa wamesimama karibu, ‘Mnyangʼanyeni fungu lake la fedha, mkampe yule mwenye kumi.’

english: ‘Master,’ they said, ‘he already has ten!’
ekegusii: (Bakamoteebia: Omonene, oyo nare nebirengo ikomi).
swahili: “Wakamwambia, ‘Bwana, mbona; tayari anayo mafungu kumi!’

english: He replied, ‘I tell you that everyone who has will be given more; but the one who does not have, even what he has will be taken away from him.
ekegusii: Nabatebirie: Kera oyore negento naegwe, korende ere oyotari negento, nonya nkeria abwate naurwe.
swahili: “Akawajibu, ‘Nawaambia kwamba kila aliye na kitu, ataongezewa. Lakini yule asiye na kitu, hata alicho nacho atanyangʼanywa.

english: And these enemies of mine who were unwilling for me to rule over them, bring them here and slay them in front of me.’” The Triumphal Entry (Zechariah 9:9–13; Matthew 21:1–11; Mark 11:1–11; John 12:12–19)
ekegusii: Korende baria ababisa baane batarigeti mbagambere, barente aiga, mobaite ase obosio bwane.” Yeso ogochengerwa kagosoa Yerusalemu (Mat 21:1-11; Mar 11:1-11; Yoh 12:12-19)
swahili: Lakini wale adui zangu ambao hawakutaka mimi niwe mfalme juu yao. Waleteni hapa mkawaue mbele yangu.’ ” Yesu Aingia Yerusalemu Kwa Ushindi (Mathayo 21:1-11; Marko 11:1-11; Yohana 12:12-19)

english: After Jesus had said this, He went on ahead, going up to Jerusalem.
ekegusii: Gakoorire gokwana amang’ana aya, agatang’ana gotiira kogenda Yerusalemu.
swahili: Baada ya Yesu kusema haya, alitangulia kupanda kwenda Yerusalemu.

english: As He approached Bethphage and Bethany at the Mount of Olives, He sent out two of His disciples,
ekegusii: Agachia goika Betifage na Bethania, ase egetunwa ki’Emezeituni, agatoma babere baborokigwa baye,
swahili: Naye alipokaribia Bethfage na Bethania kwenye mlima uitwao Mlima wa Mizeituni, aliwatuma wanafunzi wake wawili, akawaambia,

english: He was trying to see who Jesus was, but could not see over the crowd because he was small in stature.
ekegusii: Akarigia korora Yeso, gose ’monto ki; ko tanyara ase engencho y’omoganda, ekiagera arenge omweng’e.
swahili: Yeye alikuwa akijitahidi kumwona Yesu ni mtu wa namna gani. Lakini kutokana na umati mkubwa wa watu hakuweza kwa sababu alikuwa mfupi wa kimo.

english: saying, “Go into the village ahead of you, and as you enter it, you will find a colt tied there, on which no one has ever sat. Untie it and bring it here.
ekegusii: akabateebia, Genda goika agachie karia mokoorokera; kamwasoire ime, inamorore emori y’etigere esibire, etana koriinwa na monto; moyesibore moyendetere.
swahili: “Nendeni katika kijiji kilichoko mbele yenu. Na mtakapokuwa mnaingia kijijini, mtamkuta mwana-punda amefungwa hapo, ambaye hajapandwa na mtu bado. Mfungueni, mkamlete hapa.

english: If anyone asks, ‘Why are you untying it?’ tell him, ‘The Lord needs it.’”
ekegusii: Naende omonto karababorie: Naki, mokoyesibora? Momoteebie iga, “Omonene nayeganetie.”
swahili: Kama mtu akiwauliza, ‘Mbona mnamfungua?’ Mwambieni, ‘Bwana anamhitaji.’ ”

english: So those who were sent went out and found it just as Jesus had told them.
ekegusii: Nabo baria batometwe bakagenda, bakayenyora buna abateebeetie.
swahili: Wale waliotumwa wakaenda, wakakuta kila kitu kama vile Yesu alivyokuwa amewaambia.

english: As they were untying the colt, its owners asked, “Why are you untying the colt?”
ekegusii: Ekero baare gosibora emori eria y’etigere, abanyene bakababoria, “Nase ki mogosibora emori?”
swahili: Walipokuwa wanamfungua yule mwana-punda, wenyewe wakawauliza, “Mbona mnamfungua huyo mwana-punda?”

english: “The Lord needs it,” they answered.
ekegusii: Bakaboora, “Omonene nayeganetie.”
swahili: Wale wanafunzi wakajibu, “Bwana anamhitaji.”

english: Then they led the colt to Jesus, threw their cloaks over it, and put Jesus on it.
ekegusii: Bakayerenta ase Yeso; bakaara chianga chiabo igoro ase emori eria, bakariinia Yeso igoro aseero.
swahili: Wakamleta kwa Yesu, nao baada ya kutandika mavazi yao juu ya huyo mwana-punda, wakampandisha Yesu juu yake.

english: As He rode along, the people spread their cloaks on the road.
ekegusii: Ere gakogenda, bakaara chianga chiabo inchera.
swahili: Alipokuwa akienda akiwa amempanda, watu wakatandaza mavazi yao barabarani.

english: And as He approached the descent from the Mount of Olives, the whole multitude of disciples began to praise God joyfully in a loud voice for all the miracles they had seen:
ekegusii: Agachia goika egetirimboko ki’egetunwa ki’Emezeituni, omoganda bwonsi bw’aborokigwa baye bagachaaka kogooka na komobaka Nyasae ase eriogi rinene ase ebikone bie chinguru bionsi barorire,
swahili: Alipokaribia mahali yanapoanzia materemko ya Mlima wa Mizeituni, umati wote wa wafuasi wake wakaanza kumsifu Mungu kwa furaha kwa sauti kuu kwa ajili ya matendo yote ya miujiza waliyoyaona. Wakasema:

english: “Blessed is the King who comes in the name of the Lord!” “Peace in heaven and glory in the highest!”
ekegusii: bakobora, “Nasesenirie Omorwoti oyogocha ase erieta ri’Omonene! Omorembe igoro, na obonene bore igoro mono!”
swahili: “Amebarikiwa Mfalme ajaye kwa Jina la Bwana!” “Amani mbinguni na utukufu huko juu sana.”

english: But some of the Pharisees in the crowd said to Him, “Teacher, rebuke Your disciples!”
ekegusii: Abande ase Abafarisai abarenge ase omosangererekano bakamoteebia, “Omworokia, togonyera aborokigwa bao!”
swahili: Baadhi ya Mafarisayo waliokuwamo miongoni mwa ule umati wa watu wakamwambia, “Mwalimu, waamuru wanafunzi wako wanyamaze.”

english: So he ran on ahead and climbed a sycamore tree to see Him, since Jesus was about to pass that way.
ekegusii: Agatang’ana bwango, akariina igoro ase omoko anyare komorora, ekiagera ngoetera arenge ase enchera eria.
swahili: Kwa hiyo akatangulia mbio mbele ya umati wa watu akapanda juu ya mkuyu ili amwone Yesu, kwa sababu angeipitia njia ile.

english: “I tell you,” He answered, “if they remain silent, the very stones will cry out.” Jesus Weeps over Jerusalem (Isaiah 29:1–16)
ekegusii: Akairaneria, “Nabatebirie: Aba nabaisa gokira, amagena aya naake eriogi.” Yeso ogwechandera Yerusalemu
swahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Nawaambia ninyi, kama hawa wakinyamaza, mawe yatapiga kelele.” Yesu Anaulilia Mji Wa Yerusalemu

english: As Jesus approached Jerusalem and saw the city, He wept over it
ekegusii: Ere agachia goika ang’e akarora omochie, akayoiyereria amariga,
swahili: Alipokaribia Yerusalemu na kuuona mji, aliulilia,

english: and said, “If only you had known on this day what would bring you peace! But now it is hidden from your eyes.
ekegusii: okobora, “Onye nkwamanya reero ayare korenta omorembe! Korende bono abisekire ase amaiso ao!
swahili: akisema, “Laiti ungalijua hata wewe leo yale ambayo yangeleta amani, lakini sasa yamefichika machoni pako.

english: For the days will come upon you when your enemies will barricade you and surround you and hem you in on every side.
ekegusii: Naki amatuko nagochere, ababisa bao barakoagachere orwaki bagoetanane, bagotangerane ase chinsemo chionsi,
swahili: Hakika siku zinakujia, ambazo adui zako watakuzingira, nao watakuzunguka pande zote na kukuzuilia ndani.

english: They will level you to the ground—you and the children within your walls. They will not leave one stone on another, because you did not recognize the time of your visitation from God. ” Jesus Cleanses the Temple (Matthew 21:12–17; Mark 11:15–19; John 2:12–25)
ekegusii: na bakoiyerie inse, na abana bao ime ase ore. Tibagotiga ime ase ore riigena erimo igoro ase erinde, ekiagera otamanyeti engaki y’ogocherwa kwao.” Yeso ogochena Hekalu (Mat 21:12-17; Mar 11:15-19)
swahili: Watakuponda chini, wewe na watoto walioko ndani ya kuta zako. Nao hawataacha hata jiwe moja juu ya jingine, kwa sababu hukutambua wakati wa kujiliwa kwako.” Yesu Atakasa Hekaluni (Mathayo 21:12-17; Marko 11:15-19; Yohana 2:13-22)

english: Then Jesus entered the temple courts and began to drive out those who were selling there.
ekegusii: Agasoa Hekalu ime, agachaaka gosokia baria barenge koonia aroro,
swahili: Ndipo akaingia eneo la Hekalu, akaanza kuwafukuza wale waliokuwa wakiuza vitu humo.

english: He declared to them, “It is written: ‘My house will be a house of prayer.’ But you have made it ‘a den of robbers.’ ”
ekegusii: akabateebia, “Neriikire: Enyomba yane nebe enyomba y’ogosaba, korende inwe mwayekorire koba ribwago ri’abauri.”
swahili: Naye akawaambia, “Imeandikwa, ‘Nyumba yangu itakuwa nyumba ya sala,’ lakini ninyi mmeifanya kuwa ‘pango la wanyangʼanyi.’ ”

english: Jesus was teaching at the temple every day, but the chief priests, scribes, and leaders of the people were intent on killing Him.
ekegusii: Akaba okworokereria kera rituko ase Hekalu. Abakuani abanene, na aborokia b’amariiko, na abanene b’abaanto bakarigia komoita;
swahili: Kila siku alikuwa akifundisha Hekaluni. Lakini viongozi wa makuhani, walimu wa sheria na viongozi wa watu walikuwa wakitafuta njia ili kumuua.

english: Yet they could not find a way to do so, because all the people hung on His words.
ekegusii: na barabwo tibanyora eki bagokora, ekiagera abanto bonsi bamotegererete.
swahili: Lakini hawakupata nafasi kwa sababu watu wote walimfuata wakiyasikiliza maneno yake kwa usikivu mwingi.

english: When Jesus came to that place, He looked up and said, “Zacchaeus, hurry down, for I must stay at your house today.”
ekegusii: Ekero Yeso achia goika aase aria, akarigereria igoro, akamoteebia, “Zakayo, ika bwango, ekiagera reero ningwenerete goikaransa nyomba mwao.”
swahili: Yesu alipofika pale chini ya huo mkuyu, akatazama juu, akamwambia, “Zakayo, shuka upesi, kwa maana leo nitakuwa mgeni nyumbani kwako!”

english: So Zacchaeus hurried down and welcomed Him joyfully.
ekegusii: Agaika bwango, akamoroisia nomogooko.
swahili: Hivyo Zakayo akashuka upesi, akamkaribisha Yesu nyumbani kwake kwa furaha kubwa.

english: And all who saw this began to grumble, saying, “He has gone to be the guest of a sinful man!”
ekegusii: Ekero abanto bachia korora aya, bakemurungania bonsi, bakobora, “Osoire koba omogeni bw’omonyene ebibe.”
swahili: Watu wote walipoona hivyo, wakaanza kunungʼunika wakisema, “Amekwenda kuwa mgeni wa ‘mtu mwenye dhambi.’ ”

english: But Zacchaeus stood up and said to the Lord, “Look, Lord, half of my possessions I give to the poor, and if I have cheated anyone, I will repay it fourfold.”
ekegusii: Zakayo agatenena, agateebia Omonene, “Rora, Omonene, ekeng’ese ki’enibo yane ning’ee abataka; naende onye naureretie omonto egento nimoiranerie ara kane.”
swahili: Lakini Zakayo akasimama na kumwambia Bwana, “Tazama, Bwana! Sasa hivi nusu ya mali yangu ninawapa maskini, nami kama nimemdhulumu mtu yeyote kitu chochote, nitamrudishia mara nne ya hicho kiwango.”

english: Jesus said to him, “Today salvation has come to this house, because this man too is a son of Abraham.
ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Reero ogotooreka gwaikire enyomba eye, ekiagera oyo boigo nomwana o Aburaamu.
swahili: Ndipo Yesu akamwambia, “Leo, wokovu umeingia nyumbani humu, kwa sababu huyu naye ni mwana wa Abrahamu.

english: Many have undertaken to compose an account of the things that have been fulfilled among us,
ekegusii: Abanto abange beruete koriika ebirage bi’amang’ana aria aikeranetigwe egati yaito.
swahili: Kwa kuwa watu wengi wamekaa ili kuandika habari za mambo yaliyotukia katikati yetu,

english: And at the hour of the incense offering, the whole congregation was praying outside.
ekegusii: Na omoganda bwonsi bw’abaanto nigo orenge isiko gosaba ekero ki’ogosamba ubani.
swahili: Nao wakati wa kufukiza uvumba ulipowadia, wale wote waliokuwa wamekusanyika ili kuabudu walikuwa nje wakiomba.

english: Just then an angel of the Lord appeared to Zechariah, standing at the right side of the altar of incense.
ekegusii: Zakaria akaorokerwa nomomalaika bw’Omonene, oteneine ensemo ya borio y’egesasiimero ki’ogosambera ubani.
swahili: Ndipo malaika wa Bwana, akiwa amesimama upande wa kuume wa madhabahu ya kufukizia uvumba, akamtokea Zekaria.

english: When Zechariah saw him, he was startled and gripped with fear.
ekegusii: Ere agaichana gachia komorora, na omoondoko okamobwata.
swahili: Zekaria alipomwona huyo malaika, akafadhaika sana, akajawa na hofu.

english: But the angel said to him, “Do not be afraid, Zechariah, because your prayer has been heard. Your wife Elizabeth will bear you a son, and you are to give him the name John.
ekegusii: Korende omomalaika oria akamoteebia, Toiroka, Zakaria, ekiagera ogosaba kwao kwaigurwe, na mokao Elisabeti nakoiborere omwana omoisia, na erieta riaye nomoroke Yohana.
swahili: Lakini malaika akamwambia, “Usiogope, Zekaria, kwa maana Mungu amesikia maombi yako. Mkeo Elizabeti atakuzalia mtoto wa kiume, nawe utamwita jina lake Yohana.

english: He will be a joy and delight to you, and many will rejoice at his birth,
ekegusii: Aye nobe nomogooko na ogosasooka, na abanto abange nabagokere okoiborwa kwaye,
swahili: Yeye atakuwa furaha na shangwe kwako, nao watu wengi watashangilia kwa sababu ya kuzaliwa kwake.

english: for he will be great in the sight of the Lord. He shall never take wine or strong drink, and he will be filled with the Holy Spirit even from his mother’s womb.
ekegusii: ekiagera nabe omonene ase obosio bw’Omonene. Takonywa edivai gose ekenyugwa kegotindia; ere naichorwe n’Omoika Omochenu, nonya nkorwa enda ya ng’ina.
swahili: Kwa kuwa atakuwa mkuu mbele za Bwana, kamwe hataonja mvinyo wala kinywaji chochote cha kulevya, naye atajazwa Roho Mtakatifu hata kabla ya kuzaliwa kwake.

english: Many of the sons of Israel he will turn back to the Lord their God.
ekegusii: Naonchore abange b’Abaisraeli gocha ase Omonene, Nyasae obo.
swahili: Naye atawageuza wengi wa wana wa Israeli warudi kwa Bwana Mungu wao.

english: And he will go on before the Lord in the spirit and power of Elijah, to turn the hearts of the fathers to their children and the disobedient to the wisdom of the righteous—to make ready a people prepared for the Lord.”
ekegusii: Ere natang’ane bosio bwaye ase omoika ne chinguru chi’Elija, aonchore chinkoro chi’abaise ase abana baabo, na aonchore abamochi ase obong’aini bw’abanyene oboronge, abeekere ang’e Omonene abanto baroisiigwe.
swahili: Naye atatangulia mbele za Bwana katika roho na nguvu ya Eliya, ili kuigeuza mioyo ya baba kuwaelekea watoto wao, na wasiotii warejee katika hekima ya wenye haki, ili kuliweka tayari taifa lililoandaliwa kwa ajili ya Bwana.”

english: “How can I be sure of this?” Zechariah asked the angel. “I am an old man, and my wife is well along in years.”
ekegusii: Zakaria agateebia omomalaika, “Naki ndakore imanye ayio? Ekiagera inche nomogotu, na mokane nagendererete kogota.”
swahili: Zekaria akamuuliza malaika, “Jambo hilo linawezekanaje? Mimi ni mzee na mke wangu pia ana umri mkubwa.”

english: “I am Gabriel,” replied the angel. “I stand in the presence of God, and I have been sent to speak to you and to bring you this good news.
ekegusii: Omomalaika akamoiraneria, “Ninche Gabirieli, ngotenena ase obosio bwa Nyasae; ninche natomwa nkwane naye, ngoteebie amang’ana aya amaya.
swahili: Malaika akamjibu, akamwambia, “Mimi ni Gabrieli, nisimamaye mbele za Mungu, nami nimetumwa kwako ili nikuambie habari hizi njema.

english: just as they were handed down to us by the initial eyewitnesses and servants of the word.
ekegusii: Nigo barigete buna intwe twatebetigwe nabwo barenge abarori korwa omochakano na abakori emeremo be ring’ana batorenteire.
swahili: kama vile yalivyokabidhiwa kwetu na wale waliokuwa mashahidi walioyaona na watumishi wa Bwana,

english: And now you will be silent and unable to speak until the day this comes to pass, because you did not believe my words, which will be fulfilled at their proper time.”
ekegusii: Korende bono aye ekiagera otegena amang’ana aane ayio agochia kooroka chingaki chiaye rora aye nobe rimama, tonyara gokwana goika rituko riria ayio agocha kooroka.”
swahili: Basi sasa kwa kuwa hujaamini maneno yangu ambayo yatatimizwa kwa wakati wake, utakuwa bubu hadi siku ile mambo haya yatakapotukia.”

english: Meanwhile, the people were waiting for Zechariah and wondering why he took so long in the temple.
ekegusii: Chingaki echio abanto baria baganyete Zakaria, bagakumia ase ogotebana kwaye ime ase Hekalu.
swahili: Wakati huo watu walikuwa wanamngojea Zekaria nje huku wakishangaa kukawia kwake mle Hekaluni.

english: When he came out and was unable to speak to them, they realized he had seen a vision in the temple. He kept making signs to them but remained speechless.
ekegusii: Ekero asogete isiko, tanyarete gokwana nabarabwo; erio barabwo bakamanya ng’a nigo arora okorora aria Hekalu ime. Ere nigo arenge kobateeberia nokoboko, akagenderera koba rimama.
swahili: Alipotoka akawa hawezi kusema nao, wao wakatambua kuwa ameona maono ndani ya Hekalu. Lakini kwa kuwa alikuwa bubu, akawa anawaashiria kwa mikono.

english: And when the days of his service were complete, he returned home.
ekegusii: Ekero amatuko aye y’ogokora emeremo aerete, ere akagenda bwoye.
swahili: Muda wake wa kuhudumu Hekaluni ulipomalizika, akarudi nyumbani kwake.

english: After these days, his wife Elizabeth became pregnant and for five months remained in seclusion. She declared,
ekegusii: Magega y’amatuko aria mokaye Elisabeti akaba morito, akebisa emetienyi etano, ogoteeba,
swahili: Baada ya muda usio mrefu, Elizabeti mkewe akapata mimba, naye akajitenga kwa miezi mitano.

english: “The Lord has done this for me. In these days He has shown me favor and taken away my disgrace among the people.” Gabriel Foretells Jesus’ Birth
ekegusii: “Igo nabo Omonene ankoreire ase amatuko aya andigereretie, na konduseria obosooku bwane ase amasio y’abanto.” Obobani bw’okoiborwa kwa Yeso
swahili: Akasema, “Hili ndilo Bwana alilonitendea aliponiangalia kwa upendeleo na kuniondolea aibu yangu mbele ya watu.” Kuzaliwa Kwa Yesu Kwatabiriwa

english: In the sixth month, God sent the angel Gabriel to a town in Galilee called Nazareth,
ekegusii: Omotienyi bw’etano nomo omomalaika Gabirieli agatomwa na Nyasae kogenda omochie o Galili, okorokwa Nazareti,
swahili: Mwezi wa sita baada ya Elizabeti kupata mimba, Mungu alimtuma malaika Gabrieli aende Galilaya katika mji wa Nazareti,

english: to a virgin pledged in marriage to a man named Joseph, who was of the house of David. And the virgin’s name was Mary.
ekegusii: ase omoiseke omwekungi oriereire boko nomosaacha, erieta riaye Yusufu, bw’eamate ya Daudi, na erieta ri’omoiseke oria Mariamu.
swahili: kwa mwanamwali bikira aliyekuwa ameposwa na mtu mmoja jina lake Yosefu wa nyumba ya Daudi. Jina la huyu mwanamwali bikira ni Maria.

english: The angel appeared to her and said, “Greetings, you who are highly favored! The Lord is with you. ”
ekegusii: Agacha asare, akabora, “Mbuya ore aye, oyobwanchererie. Omonene nigo are amo naye.”
swahili: Naye malaika akaja kwake akamwambia: “Salamu, wewe uliyebarikiwa, Bwana yu pamoja nawe!”

english: Mary was greatly troubled at his words and wondered what kind of greeting this might be.
ekegusii: Mariamu agaichana mono ase ring’ana eri, erio ere akebooria, “Ngokwania ki oko?”
swahili: Maria akafadhaishwa sana na maneno haya, akajiuliza moyoni, “Salamu hii ni ya namna gani?”

english: Therefore, having carefully investigated everything from the beginning, it seemed good also to me to write an orderly account for you, most excellent Theophilus,
ekegusii: Naboigo nainche narorire buya, magega konatukire amang’ana onsi boronge korwa ritang’ani, gokoriikera aye Theofilo bw’amasikani,
swahili: mimi nami baada ya kuchunguza kila kitu kwa uangalifu kuanzia mwanzo, niliamua kukuandikia habari za mambo hayo, ewe mtukufu Theofilo,

english: So the angel told her, “Do not be afraid, Mary, for you have found favor with God.
ekegusii: Omomalaika akamoteebia, Toiroka Mariamu, ekiagera kwanyorire ogwancherwa ase Nyasae.
swahili: Ndipo malaika akamwambia, “Usiogope, Maria, umepata kibali kwa Mungu.

english: Behold, you will conceive and give birth to a son, and you are to give Him the name Jesus.
ekegusii: Rora, nobe morito, noibore omwana omoisia, nomoroke erieta riaye Yeso.
swahili: Tazama, utachukua mimba, nawe utamzaa mtoto mwanaume na utamwita jina lake Yesu.

english: He will be great and will be called the Son of the Most High. The Lord God will give Him the throne of His father David,
ekegusii: Oyio nabe omonene, narokwe Omwana o Nyasae ore Igoro Mono; n’Omonene namoe ekerogo ki’obonene gia Daudi sokoro yaye;
swahili: Yeye atakuwa mkuu, naye ataitwa Mwana wa Aliye Juu Sana. Bwana Mungu atampa kiti cha enzi cha Daudi baba yake.

english: and He will reign over the house of Jacob forever. His kingdom will never end!”
ekegusii: nagaambere enyomba ya Yakobo goika kare na kare; nonya noborwoti bwaye tibokoba nomoerio.
swahili: Ataimiliki nyumba ya Yakobo milele, na ufalme wake hautakuwa na mwisho.”

english: “How can this be,” Mary asked the angel, “since I am a virgin?”
ekegusii: Mariamu akabooria omomalaika oria, “Naki rirabe ring’ana eri, ekiagera tindaba nomosaacha?”
swahili: Maria akamuuliza huyo malaika, “Maadamu mimi ni bikira, jambo hili litawezekanaje?”

english: The angel replied, “The Holy Spirit will come upon you, and the power of the Most High will overshadow you. So the Holy One to be born will be called the Son of God.
ekegusii: Omomalaika akamoteebia, “Omoika Omochenu nogochere, ne chinguru chiaye Oyore Igoro Mono nachikobekere ekiriri. Ase ayio, oyoraiborwe narokwe Omochenu, Omwana o Nyasae.
swahili: Malaika akamjibu, “Roho Mtakatifu atakujilia juu yako, nazo nguvu zake Yeye Aliye Juu Sana zitakufunika kama kivuli. Kwa hiyo mtoto atakayezaliwa atakuwa mtakatifu, naye ataitwa Mwana wa Mungu.

english: Look, even Elizabeth your relative has conceived a son in her old age, and she who was called barren is in her sixth month.
ekegusii: Rora, Elisabeti omoamate oo, nere boigo nare noborito bw’omwana omoisia ase obogotu bwaye; na omotienyi oyo noyo bw’etano nomo asare ere oyorogetwe omogomba.
swahili: Tazama, jamaa yako Elizabeti amechukua mimba katika uzee wake, na huu ni mwezi wake wa sita, yeye aliyeitwa tasa.

english: For no word from God will ever fail. ”
ekegusii: Naki ing’ana tiriri ritanyarekane ase Nyasae.”
swahili: Kwa maana kwa Mungu hakuna lisilowezekana.”

english: “I am the Lord’s servant,” Mary answered. “May it happen to me according to your word.” Then the angel left her. Mary Visits Elizabeth
ekegusii: Mariamu akabora, “Rora, inche nomosomba bw’Omonene; abe ase ’nde buna ring’ana riao.” Omomalaika akaimoka akarua asare. Mariamu ogochia gokwania Elisabeti, naende ogotogia Nyasae
swahili: Maria akasema, “Tazama, mimi ni mtumishi wa Bwana. Na iwe kwangu kama ulivyosema.” Kisha malaika akaondoka, akamwacha. Maria Aenda Kumtembelea Elizabeti

english: In those days Mary got ready and hurried to a town in the hill country of Judah,
ekegusii: Mariamu akaimoka ase amatuko ayio, akagenda bwango ase ebitunwa goika omochie oyomo o Yuda,
swahili: Wakati huo Maria akajiandaa, akaharakisha kwenda katika mji mmoja kwenye vilima vya Uyahudi.

english: so that you may know the certainty of the things you have been taught. Gabriel Foretells John’s Birth
ekegusii: erinde onyare komanya oboene bw’amang’ana aria kwegeretigwe. Obobani igoro yokoiborwa kwa Yohana Omobatisi
swahili: ili upate kujua ukweli kuhusu yale uliyofundishwa. Kuzaliwa Kwa Yohana Mbatizaji Kwatabiriwa

english: where she entered the home of Zechariah and greeted Elizabeth.
ekegusii: agasoa nyomba mwa Zakaria, agakwania Elisabeti.
swahili: Akaingia nyumbani kwa Zekaria na kumsalimu Elizabeti.

english: When Elizabeth heard Mary’s greeting, the baby leaped in her womb, and Elizabeth was filled with the Holy Spirit.
ekegusii: Ekaba Elisabeti agachia koigwa ogokwania kwa Mariamu, omwana omoke agatuma ase enda yaye ime; Elisabeti agaichorwa n’Omoika Omochenu,
swahili: Naye Elizabeti aliposikia salamu ya Maria, mtoto aliyekuwa tumboni mwake akaruka. Elizabeti akajazwa na Roho Mtakatifu,

english: In a loud voice she exclaimed, “Blessed are you among women, and blessed is the fruit of your womb!
ekegusii: agaaka eriogi ase chinguru, agakwana, “Gwaseseniigwe aye ase abakungu, na oroiboro rw’enda yao rwasesenigwe.
swahili: akapaza sauti kwa nguvu akasema, “Umebarikiwa wewe miongoni mwa wanawake, naye mtoto utakayemzaa amebarikiwa.

english: And why am I so honored, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?
ekegusii: Ng’ai ring’ana eri riarure, ng’ina Omonene one anchicheire inche?
swahili: Lakini ni kwa nini mimi nimepata upendeleo kiasi hiki, hata mama wa Bwana wangu afike kwangu?

english: For as soon as the sound of your greeting reached my ears, the baby in my womb leaped for joy.
ekegusii: Ekiagera rora, eriogi ri’ogokwania kwao riachia gosoa ase amato aane, omwana omoke otuma ase omosasoko ase enda yane ime.
swahili: Mara tu niliposikia sauti ya salamu yako, mtoto aliyeko tumboni mwangu aliruka kwa furaha.

english: Blessed is she who has believed that the Lord’s word to her will be fulfilled.” Mary’s Song (1 Samuel 2:1–11)
ekegusii: Nasesenirie oyobwegenete ng’a amang’ana ayio ateebigwe n’Omonene naikeranigwe.”
swahili: Amebarikiwa yeye aliyeamini kwamba lile Bwana alilomwambia litatimizwa.” Wimbo Wa Maria Wa Sifa

english: Then Mary said: “My soul magnifies the Lord,
ekegusii: Mariamu agateeba, “Omoyo one otogirie Omonene,
swahili: Naye Maria akasema: “Moyo wangu wamwadhimisha Bwana,

english: and my spirit rejoices in God my Savior!
ekegusii: omoika one ogokeire Nyasae, Omotoria one,
swahili: nayo roho yangu inamfurahia Mungu Mwokozi wangu,

english: For He has looked with favor on the humble state of His servant. From now on all generations will call me blessed.
ekegusii: ekiagera origereirie obwororo bw’omoiseke omosomba oye. Naki ekeene, korwa reero ebigori bionsi nabindoke omosesenigwa,
swahili: kwa kuwa ameangalia kwa fadhili unyonge wa mtumishi wake. Hakika tangu sasa vizazi vyote vitaniita aliyebarikiwa,

english: For the Mighty One has done great things for me. Holy is His name.
ekegusii: ekiagera ere oyore ne chinguru onkoreire amanene, na erieta riaye nerichenu.
swahili: kwa maana yeye Mwenye Nguvu amenitendea mambo ya ajabu: jina lake ni takatifu.

english: In the time of Herod king of Judea there was a priest named Zechariah, who belonged to the priestly division of Abijah, and whose wife Elizabeth was a daughter of Aaron.
ekegusii: Ekero Herode arenge omorwoti o Boyahudi, narenge Omokuani oyomo, erieta riaye Zakaria, oyo orongebw’ororeria rwa Abiya. Mokaye nigo arenge korokwa Elisabeti oyio orenge omoiseke bw’ororeria rw’ Omokuani Aroni.
swahili: Wakati wa Herode mfalme wa Uyahudi, palikuwa na kuhani mmoja jina lake Zekaria, ambaye alikuwa wa ukoo wa kikuhani wa Abiya. Elizabeti mkewe alikuwa pia mzao wa Aroni.

english: His mercy extends to those who fear Him, from generation to generation.
ekegusii: Amaabera aye nigo are ase abwo bamoirogete korwa ebigori goika ebigori.
swahili: Rehema zake huwaendea wale wamchao, kutoka kizazi hadi kizazi.

english: He has performed mighty deeds with His arm; He has scattered those who are proud in the thoughts of their hearts.
ekegusii: Okorire ogokora gwe chinguru, oserebanirie abaenenu ase ebirengererio bie chinkoro chiabo.
swahili: Kwa kuwa ametenda mambo ya ajabu kwa mkono wake; amewatawanya wale wenye kiburi ndani ya mioyo yao.

english: He has brought down rulers from their thrones, but has exalted the humble.
ekegusii: Okeeirie abanene korwa ase ebirogo biabo bi’obonene, oimokereirie igoro abaitongo.
swahili: Amewashusha watawala toka kwenye viti vyao vya enzi, lakini amewainua wanyenyekevu.

english: He has filled the hungry with good things, but has sent the rich away empty.
ekegusii: Abare nenchara obaigotirie amaya; abanyene enibo obaseririe bare namaboko amasa.
swahili: Amewashibisha wenye njaa kwa vitu vizuri, bali matajiri amewafukuza mikono mitupu.

english: He has helped His servant Israel, remembering to be merciful,
ekegusii: Okonyire Israeli, omosomba oye, ase okoinyora amaabera aye,
swahili: Amemsaidia mtumishi wake Israeli, kwa kukumbuka ahadi yake ya kumrehemu

english: as He promised to our fathers, to Abraham and his descendants forever.”
ekegusii: buna atebeetie chisokoro chiaito, Aburaamu na oroiboro rwaye, goika kare na kare.”
swahili: Abrahamu na uzao wake milele, kama alivyowaahidi baba zetu.”

english: Mary stayed with Elizabeth for about three months and then returned home. The Birth of John the Baptist
ekegusii: Mariamu akamenya nere emetienyi etato, akairana sobo. Okoiborwa kwa Yohana Omobatisi
swahili: Maria akakaa na Elizabeti karibu miezi mitatu, kisha akarudi nyumbani kwake. Kuzaliwa Kwa Yohana Mbatizaji

english: When the time came for Elizabeth to have her child, she gave birth to a son.
ekegusii: Engaki yokoibora kwa Elisabeti egaika, ere akaibora omwana omoisia.
swahili: Ulipowadia wakati wa Elizabeti kujifungua, alizaa mtoto mwanaume.

english: Her neighbors and relatives heard that the Lord had shown her great mercy, and they rejoiced with her.
ekegusii: Abairi na eamate yaye bakaigwa ng’a Omonene omororeire amaabera amange, bakagoka amo nere.
swahili: Majirani zake na jamii zake wakasikia jinsi Bwana alivyomfanyia rehema kuu, nao wakafurahi pamoja naye.

english: On the eighth day, when they came to circumcise the child, they were going to name him after his father Zechariah.
ekegusii: Rituko ria gatano na gatato bakaira omwana komwarokia, bakarigia bamoroke erieta ria ise, Zakaria,
swahili: Siku ya nane wakaja kumtahiri mtoto, wakataka yule mtoto aitwe Zekaria, ambalo ndilo jina la baba yake.

english: Both of them were righteous in the sight of God, walking blamelessly in all the commandments and decrees of the Lord.
ekegusii: Na bonsi babere nigo barenge abanyene oboronge ase obosio bwa Nyasae; nigo babwatetie amachiiko ne chinchera chionsi chi’Omonene batari na komocha.
swahili: Zekaria na Elizabeti mkewe wote walikuwa watu wanyofu mbele za Mungu, wakizishika amri zote za Bwana na maagizo yote bila lawama.

english: But his mother replied, “No! He shall be called John.”
ekegusii: korende ng’ina akairaneria, akabora, “Taibo; nigo ararokwe Yohana.”
swahili: Lakini mama yake akakataa na kusema, “Hapana! Jina lake ataitwa Yohana.”

english: They said to her, “There is no one among your relatives who bears this name.”
ekegusii: Bakamoteebia, “Tari nonya noyomo ase eamate yao okorokwa erieta erio.”
swahili: Wakamwambia, “Hakuna mtu yeyote katika jamaa yako mwenye jina kama hilo.”

english: So they made signs to his father to find out what he wanted to name the child.
ekegusii: Bakorokia ise ase ogokwana kw’ebimanyererio bi’amaboko, komoboria buna arigetie arokwe.
swahili: Basi wakamfanyia Zekaria baba yake ishara ili kujua kwamba yeye angependa kumpa mtoto jina gani.

english: Zechariah asked for a tablet and wrote, “His name is John.” And they were all amazed.
ekegusii: Agasaba ebao y’okorika, akarika “Yohana, nario erieta riaye.” Bagakumia bonsi.
swahili: Akaomba wampe kibao cha kuandikia na kwa mshangao wa kila mtu akaandika: “Jina lake ni Yohana.”

english: Immediately Zechariah’s mouth was opened and his tongue was released, and he began to speak, praising God.
ekegusii: Erio kegima agasiborwa omonwa na oromeme rwaye, agakwana, ogotogia Nyasae.
swahili: Papo hapo kinywa chake kikafunguliwa na ulimi wake ukaachiwa, akawa anaongea akimsifu Mungu.

english: All their neighbors were filled with awe, and people throughout the hill country of Judea were talking about these events.
ekegusii: Obwoba bogasoa ase abairi babo bonsi. Amang’ana aya onsi agasaarera ase ense yonsi y’ebitunwa bia Boyahudi.
swahili: Majirani wote wakajawa na hofu ya Mungu, na katika nchi yote ya vilima vya Uyahudi watu walikuwa wakinena juu ya mambo haya yote.

english: And all who heard this wondered in their hearts and asked, “What then will this child become?” For the Lord’s hand was with him. Zechariah’s Song
ekegusii: Na bonsi abayaigwete bakayabeeka ase chinkoro chiabo ime, bakaboora, “Mwana ki rende arabe oyo?” Naki okoboko kw’Omonene nigo kwarenge amo nere.
swahili: Kila aliyesikia habari hizi alishangaa akauliza, “Je, mtoto huyu atakuwa mtu wa namna gani?” Maana mkono wa Bwana ulikuwa pamoja naye. Unabii Wa Zekaria

english: Then his father Zechariah was filled with the Holy Spirit and prophesied:
ekegusii: Zakaria ise agaichorwa n’Omoika Omochenu, akabana, okobora,
swahili: Zekaria, baba yake, akajazwa na Roho Mtakatifu, naye akatoa unabii, akisema:

english: “Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel, because He has visited and redeemed His people.
ekegusii: “Omonene, Nyasae o Israeli, atogigwe, ekiagera obacheire abanto baye na kobabooria.
swahili: “Ahimidiwe Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli, kwa kuwa amewajilia watu wake na kuwakomboa.

english: He has raised up a horn of salvation for us in the house of His servant David,
ekegusii: Naende ototeneneirie Omotooria bw’okobua ase eamate ya Daudi, omosomba oye.
swahili: Naye ametusimamishia pembe ya wokovu katika nyumba ya Daudi mtumishi wake,

english: But they had no children, because Elizabeth was barren, and they were both well along in years.
ekegusii: Barabwo tibarenge nomwana, ekiagera Elisabeti nigo arenge omogomba, na barabwo bonsi babere konya bagotire mono.
swahili: Lakini walikuwa hawana watoto, kwa sababu Elizabeti alikuwa tasa; nao wote wawili walikuwa wazee sana.

english: as He spoke through His holy prophets, those of ages past,
ekegusii: Buna ateebete korwa omochakano goetera ase emenwa y’ababani baye abachenu,
swahili: kama alivyonena kwa vinywa vya manabii wake watakatifu tangu zamani,

english: salvation from our enemies and from the hand of all who hate us,
ekegusii: ng’a natotoorigwe korwa ase ababisa baito, na korwa ase amaboko abo bonsi abatogechete,
swahili: kwamba atatuokoa kutoka kwa adui zetu, na kutoka mikononi mwao wote watuchukiao:

english: to show mercy to our fathers and to remember His holy covenant,
ekegusii: erinde abarorere amaabera chisokoro chiaito, na koinyora okobwatana kwaye ogochenu.
swahili: ili kuonyesha rehema kwa baba zetu na kukumbuka Agano lake takatifu,

english: the oath He swore to our father Abraham, to grant us
ekegusii: Emuma eria arierete sokoro yaito Aburaamu,
swahili: kiapo alichomwapia baba yetu Abrahamu:

english: deliverance from hostile hands, that we may serve Him without fear,
ekegusii: ng’a natoe ribaga ri’okomosasiima totari nobwoba, gatoratoorigwe korwa ase amaboko y’ababisa baito,
swahili: kutuokoa kutoka mikononi mwa adui zetu, tupate kumtumikia yeye pasipo hofu

english: in holiness and righteousness before Him all the days of our lives.
ekegusii: ase obochenu na ase oboronge ase obosio bwaye amatuko aito onsi.
swahili: katika utakatifu na haki mbele zake, siku zetu zote.

english: And you, child, will be called a prophet of the Most High; for you will go on before the Lord to prepare the way for Him,
ekegusii: Naye, Omwana, norokwe omobani bw’Oyore Igoro Mono, ekiagera notang’ane ase obosio bw’Omonene. Oroisie chinchera chiaye,
swahili: “Nawe mtoto wangu, utaitwa nabii wa Aliye Juu Sana; kwa kuwa utamtangulia Bwana na kuandaa njia kwa ajili yake,

english: to give to His people the knowledge of salvation through the forgiveness of their sins,
ekegusii: omanyie abanto baye ogotooreka ase okwaberwa kw’ebibe biabo.
swahili: kuwajulisha watu wake juu ya wokovu utakaopatikana kwa kusamehewa dhambi zao,

english: because of the tender mercy of our God, by which the Dawn will visit us from on high,
ekegusii: Ase amaabera aye Nyasae oito, ekero amasase a igoro aratochere,
swahili: kwa ajili ya wingi wa rehema za Mungu wetu, nuru itokayo juu itatuzukia

english: to shine on those who live in darkness and in the shadow of death, to guide our feet into the path of peace.”
ekegusii: ababerere abamenyete ase omosunte na ase ekiriri ki’amakweri, na koraa amagoro aito ase enchera y’omorembe.”
swahili: ili kuwaangazia wale waishio gizani na katika uvuli wa mauti, kuiongoza miguu yetu katika njia ya amani.”

english: One day while Zechariah’s division was on duty and he was serving as priest before God,
ekegusii: Na ekero riika ria Zakaria ri’ogokora emeremo y’obokuani ase obosio bwa Nyasae riarenge,
swahili: Siku moja ilipokuwa zamu ya kikundi cha Zekaria, yeye akifanya kazi ya ukuhani Hekaluni mbele za Mungu,

english: And the child grew and became strong in spirit; and he lived in the wilderness until the time of his public appearance to Israel.
ekegusii: Omwana oria agakiina, akamenteka chinguru ase omoika, akaba ase erooro goika rituko riria aorogete ase Abaisraeli.
swahili: Yule mtoto akakua na kuongezeka nguvu katika roho; akaishi nyikani hadi siku ile alipojionyesha hadharani kwa Waisraeli.

english: he was chosen by lot, according to the custom of the priesthood, to enter the temple of the Lord and burn incense.
ekegusii: kobwatekana nengencho y’obokuani, obomera bokamogwera asoe ase Hekalu y’Omonene asambe ubani.
swahili: alichaguliwa kwa kura kwa kufuata desturi za ukuhani, kuingia Hekaluni mwa Bwana ili kufukiza uvumba.

english: One day as Jesus was teaching the people in the temple courts and proclaiming the gospel, the chief priests and scribes, together with the elders, came up to Him.
ekegusii: Rituko erimo ekero Yeso arenge kworokereria abanto Hekalu ime, na korandia enchiri, abakuani abanene na aborokia b’amariiko amo nabagaaka bakamoorokera,
swahili: Siku moja, Yesu alipokuwa akifundisha watu Hekaluni na kuhubiri habari njema, viongozi wa makuhani, walimu wa sheria, pamoja na wazee wa watu wakamjia.

english: At harvest time, he sent a servant to the tenants to collect his share of the fruit of the vineyard. But the tenants beat the servant and sent him away empty-handed.
ekegusii: Ekero kie rigesa agatoma omosomba ase abaremi baria, erinde bamoe ensemo yaye y’amatunda y’emesabibu. Abaremi bakamoaka, bakamoseria atari na gento.
swahili: Wakati wa mavuno ulipofika, akamtuma mtumishi wake kwa hao wapangaji ili wampe sehemu ya mavuno ya shamba la mizabibu. Lakini wale wakulima wakampiga, wakamfukuza mikono mitupu.

english: So he sent another servant, but they beat him and treated him shamefully, sending him away empty-handed.
ekegusii: Naende agatoma omosomba onde; bakamoaka oyio boigo, bakamokora bobe, bakamoseria atari na gento.
swahili: Akamtuma mtumishi mwingine, huyo naye wakampiga, wakamfanyia mambo ya aibu na kumfukuza.

english: Then he sent a third, but they wounded him and threw him out.
ekegusii: Agatoma naende oyo o gatato, bakamoaka chingoma, bakamotuguta isiko.
swahili: Bado akamtuma na mwingine wa tatu, huyu pia wakamjeruhi na kumtupa nje ya shamba.

english: ‘What shall I do?’ asked the owner of the vineyard. ‘I will send my beloved son. Perhaps they will respect him.’
ekegusii: Oria omonyene omogondo bw’emesabibu akabora: Inki ndakore? Nintome omwana one, omwanchwa one, aande ere inabamosike.
swahili: “Basi yule mwenye shamba la mizabibu akasema, ‘Nifanye nini? Nitamtuma mwanangu mpendwa, huenda yeye watamheshimu.’

english: But when the tenants saw the son, they discussed it among themselves and said, ‘This is the heir. Let us kill him, and the inheritance will be ours.’
ekegusii: Korende abaremi baria bagachia komoorora, bagateebania barabwo ase barabwo: Oyo nere omonyamwando, tomoite gaki, omwando onyare koba oyoito.
swahili: “Lakini wale wapangaji walipomwona, wakasemezana wao kwa wao. Wakasema, ‘Huyu ndiye mrithi. Basi na tumuue ili urithi uwe wetu.’

english: So they threw him out of the vineyard and killed him. What then will the owner of the vineyard do to them?
ekegusii: Bakamotuguta isiko korwa ase omogondo bw’emesabibu, bakamoita. Naki rende oria omonyene omogondo bw’emesabibu arabakore?
swahili: Kwa hiyo wakamtupa nje ya shamba la mizabibu, wakamuua.” “Sasa basi yule mwenye shamba la mizabibu atawafanyia nini wapangaji hawa?

english: He will come and kill those tenants, and will give the vineyard to others.” And when the people heard this, they said, “May such a thing never happen!”
ekegusii: Nachiche asirie abaremi baria, na omogondo oria bw’emesabibu nayoe abande.” Bagachia koigwa aya, bakaboora, “Taba bo.”
swahili: Atakuja na kuwaua hao wapangaji, na kuwapa wapangaji wengine hilo shamba la mizabibu.” Watu waliposikia hayo wakasema, “Mungu apishie mbali jambo hili lisitokee!”

english: But Jesus looked directly at them and said, “Then what is the meaning of that which is written: ‘The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone’?
ekegusii: Akabarigereria, akabora, Engencho yaye ninki, ring’ana eri ririikeire: Rigena abaagachi bangete riabeire rigena rinene ri’ekoona?
swahili: Lakini Yesu akawakazia macho, akasema, “Basi ni nini maana ya yale yaliyoandikwa: “ ‘Jiwe walilolikataa waashi, limekuwa jiwe kuu la pembeni’?

english: Everyone who falls on this stone will be broken to pieces, but he on whom it falls will be crushed.” Paying Taxes to Caesar (Matthew 22:15–22; Mark 12:13–17)
ekegusii: Kera omonto oragwe igoro ase rigena erio nabunanekane, na ere oyo riragwere narimosenyente.
swahili: Kila mtu aangukaye juu ya jiwe hilo atavunjika vipande vipande, lakini yule litakayemwangukia atasagwa kabisa.”

english: When the scribes and chief priests realized that Jesus had spoken this parable against them, they sought to arrest Him that very hour. But they were afraid of the people.
ekegusii: Aborokia b’amariiko na abakuani abanene bakarigia komobwata ensa eyio eyio, ekiagera bamanyete ng’a omoreng’anio oria nabwo akobayeena, korende bakairoka abanto. Riborio igoro y’okoa Kaisari ebango (Mat 22:15-22; Mar 12:13-17)
swahili: Walimu wa sheria na viongozi wa makuhani wakatafuta njia ya kumkamata mara moja, kwa sababu walifahamu kwamba amesema mfano huo kwa ajili yao. Lakini waliwaogopa watu. Kumlipa Kaisari Kodi (Mathayo 22:15-22; Marko 12:13-17)

english: “Tell us,” they said, “by what authority are You doing these things, and who gave You this authority?”
ekegusii: bakamoteebia, “Toteebie nase okobua ki ogokora aya? Ning’o okoete okobua oko?”
swahili: Wakamuuliza, “Tuambie, unafanya mambo haya kwa mamlaka gani? Ni nani aliyekupa mamlaka haya?”

english: So they watched Him closely and sent spies who pretended to be sincere. They were hoping to catch Him in His words in order to hand Him over to the rule and authority of the governor.
ekegusii: Erio bakamoboera Yeso, bagatoma chirooti, na barabwo bagekora buna nabanyene oboronge, erinde bamobwate ase ogokwana kwaye, bamobeke ase okobua kwa gabana na obogambi bwaye.
swahili: Kwa hiyo wakawa wanamchunguza na kutuma wapelelezi waliojifanya kuwa wenye haki ili wapate kumtega kwa maneno asemayo, ili wamtie katika uwezo na mamlaka ya mtawala.

english: “Teacher,” they inquired, “we know that You speak and teach correctly. You show no partiality, but teach the way of God in accordance with the truth.
ekegusii: Bakamobooria, “Omworokia, twamanyire ng’a nigo ogokwana na kworokereria ayare boronge, gose tori koyiera monto, korende ase ekeene nigo okworokereria enchera ya Nyasae.
swahili: Hivyo wale wapelelezi wakamuuliza, “Mwalimu, tunajua unasema na kufundisha yaliyo kweli wala humpendelei mtu, bali wafundisha njia ya Mungu katika kweli.

english: Is it lawful for us to pay taxes to Caesar or not?”
ekegusii: Inee! Mboronge koa Kaisari ebango, gose taibo?”
swahili: Je, ni halali sisi kulipa kodi kwa Kaisari, au la?”

english: But Jesus saw through their duplicity and said to them,
ekegusii: Korende akamanya obong’ainereria bwabo, akabateebia,
swahili: Lakini Yesu akatambua hila yao, kwa hiyo akawaambia,

english: “Show Me a denarius. Whose image and inscription are on it?” “Caesar’s,” they answered.
ekegusii: “Inyorokie ebesa! Ekieni eke na amariiko aya nebiang’o?” Bakaboora, “Nebia Kaisari.”
swahili: “Nionyesheni dinari. Je, sura hii na maandishi haya yaliyoko juu yake ni vya nani?”

english: So Jesus told them, “Give to Caesar what is Caesar’s, and to God what is God’s.”
ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Nabo, ebia Kaisari moe Kaisari, na ebia Nyasae moe Nyasae.”
swahili: Wakamjibu, “Ni vya Kaisari.” Akawaambia, “Basi mpeni Kaisari kilicho cha Kaisari, naye Mungu mpeni kilicho cha Mungu.”

english: And they were unable to trap Him in His words before the people; and amazed at His answer, they fell silent. The Sadducees and the Resurrection (Matthew 22:23–33; Mark 12:18–27)
ekegusii: Tibanyaara komobwata ase ring’ana riaye ase obosio bw’abaanto; bagakumia ase okoiraneria kwaye, bagakira. Riborio igoro y’okobokigwa (Mat 22:23-33; Mar 12:18-27)
swahili: Wakashindwa kumkamata kwa yale aliyokuwa amesema hadharani. Nao wakashangazwa mno na majibu yake, wakanyamaza kimya. Ufufuo Na Ndoa (Mathayo 22:23-33; Marko 12:18-27)

english: Then some of the Sadducees, who say there is no resurrection, came to question Him.
ekegusii: Erio abande ase Abasadukai bakamochiera, baria bakoboora ng’a okobokigwa tikori,
swahili: Baadhi ya Masadukayo, wale wasemao kwamba hakuna ufufuo wa wafu, wakamjia Yesu na kumuuliza,

english: “Teacher,” they said, “Moses wrote for us that if a man’s brother dies and leaves a wife but no children, the man is to marry his brother’s widow and raise up offspring for him.
ekegusii: bakamobooria, “Omworokia, Musa natoriikerete ng’a momura omwabo omonto karakwe, na ere nare nomokuungu, korende tari nabana, nagwenerete momura omwabo atware omokungu oria, atenenerie momura omwabo egesaku.
swahili: “Mwalimu, Mose alituandikia kwamba kama ndugu wa mtu akifa na kumwacha mkewe bila mtoto, basi huyo mtu inampasa amwoe huyo mjane ili amzalie ndugu yake watoto.

english: Now there were seven brothers. The first one married a wife, but died childless.
ekegusii: Bono mbarenge abamura ba ise omo batano na babere. Oyo bw’eritang’ani akanyuoma omokungu, agakwa, tatiga abana;
swahili: Basi palikuwepo ndugu saba. Yule wa kwanza akaoa, akafa bila kuzaa mtoto.

english: “I will also ask you a question,” Jesus replied. “Tell Me:
ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Nainche nkobaboria nde inwe ring’ana erimo, monteebie:
swahili: Akawajibu, “Nami nitawauliza swali.

english: and the third married the widow, and in the same way all seven died, leaving no children.
ekegusii: nonya noyo o gatato akamotwara. Naboigo bonsi batano na babere bagakwa, tibatiga abana.
swahili: naye wa tatu pia akamwoa. Vivyo hivyo ndugu wote saba wakawa wamemwoa huyo mwanamke, na wote wakafa pasipo yeyote kupata mtoto.

english: And last of all, the woman died.
ekegusii: Magega y’ayio omokungu oria nere agakwa.
swahili: Mwishowe, yule mwanamke naye akafa.

english: So then, in the resurrection, whose wife will she be? For all seven were married to her.”
ekegusii: Inee! Ase okobokigwa mokang’o arabe? Ekiagera bonsi batano na babere mbamotwarete.”
swahili: Sasa basi, siku ya ufufuo huyo mwanamke atakuwa mke wa nani, maana aliolewa na ndugu wote saba?”

english: Jesus answered, “The sons of this age marry and are given in marriage.
ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Abana b’ense eye nigo bakonyuoma na konyuomwa;
swahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Katika maisha haya watu huoa na kuolewa.

english: But those who are considered worthy to share in the age to come and in the resurrection from the dead will neither marry nor be given in marriage.
ekegusii: korende barabwo abaabarirwe bagwenerete konyora ense eria, na kobokigwa korwa ase abakuure, tibakonyuoma, gose tibakonyuomwa.
swahili: Lakini wale ambao wamehesabiwa kwamba wanastahili kupata nafasi katika ulimwengu ule na katika ufufuo wa wafu, hawaoi wala hawaolewi.

english: In fact, they can no longer die, because they are like the angels. And since they are sons of the resurrection, they are sons of God.
ekegusii: Naende tibagokwa, ekiagera nigo barabe koreng’ana buna abamalaika, na abana ba Nyasae bare, ekiagera nabana b’okobokigwa.
swahili: Hawa hawawezi kufa tena, kwa maana wao ni kama malaika. Wao ni watoto wa Mungu, kwa sababu ni watoto wa ufufuo.

english: Even Moses demonstrates that the dead are raised, in the passage about the burning bush. For he calls the Lord ‘the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.’
ekegusii: Nonya Musa naorokereretie ng’a abakuure nkobokigwa bare. Ayio nabo ateebete agwo ase ring’ana ri’egetutu, ekero agwatora Omonene ng’a nere Nyasae o Aburaamu, na Nyasae o Isaka, na Nyasae o Yakobo.
swahili: Hata Mose alidhihirisha kuwa wafu wanafufuka, kwa habari ya kile kichaka kilichokuwa kikiwaka moto bila kuteketea, alipomwita Bwana, ‘Mungu wa Abrahamu, Mungu wa Isaki, na Mungu wa Yakobo.’

english: He is not the God of the dead, but of the living, for to Him all are alive.”
ekegusii: Nabo ere tari Nyasae bw’abakuure, korende Nyasae bw’abare moyo, ekiagera bonsi nigo bare moyo asare.”
swahili: Yeye si Mungu wa wafu, bali wa walio hai, kwa kuwa kwake wote ni hai.”

english: Some of the scribes answered, “Teacher, You have spoken well!”
ekegusii: Abande ase aborokia b’amariiko bakairaneria, “Omworokia, gwakwanire buya.”
swahili: Baadhi ya walimu wa sheria wakasema, “Mwalimu, umesema sawasawa kabisa!”

english: John’s baptism—was it from heaven, or from men?”
ekegusii: Ebatiso ya Yohana, niigoro yarwete, gose nase Mwanyabaanto?”
swahili: Je, ubatizo wa Yohana ulitoka mbinguni au kwa wanadamu?”

english: And they did not dare to question Him any further. Whose Son Is the Christ? (Matthew 22:41–46; Mark 12:35–37)
ekegusii: Naki monto onde taaba okomoboria ring’ana magega ase aya. Riborio igoro ya Kristo (Mat 22:41-46; Mar 12:35-37)
swahili: Baada ya hayo hakuna mtu aliyethubutu kumuuliza maswali tena. Kristo Ni Mwana Wa Nani? (Mathayo 22:41-46; Marko 12:35-37)

english: Then Jesus declared, “How can it be said that the Christ is the Son of David?
ekegusii: Akabateebia, Naki abanto bagoteeba ng’a Kristo nomwana o Daudi?
swahili: Kisha Yesu akawaambia, “Imekuwaje basi wao husema Kristo ni Mwana wa Daudi?

english: For David himself says in the book of Psalms: ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at My right hand
ekegusii: Naki Daudi nigo agoteeba ase Egetabu gia Zaburi, Omonene agateebia Omonene one, Ikaransa ensemo y’okoboko kwane gw’okorio,
swahili: Daudi mwenyewe anasema katika Kitabu cha Zaburi: “ ‘Bwana alimwambia Bwana wangu: “Keti mkono wangu wa kuume,

english: until I make Your enemies a footstool for Your feet.”’
ekegusii: goika mbeeke ababisa bao babe inse y’amagoro ao.
swahili: hadi nitakapowaweka adui zako chini ya miguu yako.” ’

english: Thus David calls Him ‘Lord.’ So how can He be David’s son?” Beware of the Scribes (Mark 12:38–40)
ekegusii: Daudi nigo akomoroka Omonene, naki rende aba omwana oye? Ogokuurerwa igoro yaborokia b’amariiko (Mat 23:1-36; Mar 12:38-40; Luk 11:37-54)
swahili: Ikiwa Daudi anamwita yeye ‘Bwana,’ basi atakuwaje mwanawe?” Yesu Awashutumu Walimu Wa Sheria (Mathayo 23:1-36; Marko 12:38-40)

english: In the hearing of all the people, Jesus said to His disciples,
ekegusii: Ekero abanto bonsi bamotegererete agateebia aborokigwa baye,
swahili: Wakati watu wote walikuwa wanamsikiliza, Yesu akawaambia wanafunzi wake,

english: “Beware of the scribes. They like to walk around in long robes, and they love the greetings in the marketplaces, the chief seats in the synagogues, and the places of honor at banquets.
ekegusii: “Mwerende korwa ase aborokia b’amariiko, abanchete gotaara beboyetie chianga chintambe, na gokwanigwa ase chichiiro, na goikaransa aase e ritang’ani ase chisinagogi, na aase e ritang’ani ase emeyega,
swahili: “Jihadharini na walimu wa sheria. Wao hupenda kutembea wakiwa wamevaa mavazi marefu, na kusalimiwa kwa heshima masokoni. Hupenda kukaa kwenye viti vya mbele katika masinagogi, na kukaa kwenye nafasi za heshima katika karamu.

english: They defraud widows of their houses, and for a show make lengthy prayers. These men will receive greater condemnation.”
ekegusii: abakourereria chinyomba chiababoraka, na ase obong’ainereria basaba ogosaba ogotambe. Abwo nabanyore ekiina kere ekenene kobua.”
swahili: Wao hula nyumba za wajane, na ili waonekane kuwa wema, wanasali sala ndefu. Watu kama hawa watapata hukumu iliyo kuu sana.”
