english: They deliberated among themselves and said, “If we say, ‘From heaven,’ He will ask, ‘Why did you not believe him?’
ekegusii: Bagateebania barabwo ase barabwo, bakobora, “Toise goteeba: Niigoro yarwete, nigo aratoborie: Naki motamwegenete rende?
swahili: Wakahojiana wao kwa wao wakisema, “Kama tukisema, ‘Ulitoka mbinguni,’ atatuuliza, ‘Mbona hamkumwamini?’

english: But if we say, ‘From men,’ all the people will stone us, for they are convinced that John was a prophet.”
ekegusii: Korende toise goteeba: Nase Mwanyabaanto yarwete, abanto bonsi nabatoake amagena; ekiagera banchire ng’a Yohana nomobani orenge.”
swahili: Lakini tukisema, ‘Ulitoka kwa wanadamu,’ watu wote watatupiga mawe, kwa sababu wanaamini kwamba Yohana alikuwa nabii.”

english: So they answered that they did not know where it was from.
ekegusii: Bakairaneria, “Titomanyeti aase yarwete.”
swahili: Basi wakajibu, “Hatujui ulikotoka.”

english: And Jesus replied, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I am doing these things.” The Parable of the Wicked Tenants (Matthew 21:33–46; Mark 12:1–12)
ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Nonya ninche tinkobateebia inwe nase okobua ki ngokorera aya.” Omoreng’anio bw’omogondo bw’emesabibu (Mat 21:33-46; Mar 12:1-12)
swahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Wala mimi sitawaambia ni kwa mamlaka gani ninatenda mambo haya.” Mfano Wa Wapangaji Waovu (Mathayo 21:33-46; Marko 12:1-12)

english: Then He proceeded to tell the people this parable: “A man planted a vineyard, rented it out to some tenants, and went away for a long time.
ekegusii: Agachaaka goteebia abanto omoreng’anio oyo: “Omonto akarema omogondo, agasimeka emesabibu imeo, akaywatananera abaremi, akagenda orogendo ase engaki entambe.
swahili: Akaendelea kuwaambia watu mfano huu: “Mtu mmoja alipanda shamba la mizabibu, akalikodisha kwa wakulima fulani, kisha akasafiri kwa muda mrefu.

english: Then Jesus looked up and saw the rich putting their gifts into the treasury,
ekegusii: Yeso akaimokia amaiso aye, akarora abanto abanda bakobeeka ebiegwa biabo ase ekebekerero gi’esadaka.
swahili: Yesu alipoinua macho yake, aliwaona matajiri wakiweka sadaka zao kwenye sanduku la hazina ya Hekalu.

english: Then He told them, “Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom.
ekegusii: Erio akabateebia, “Egesaku nakeimoke korwana negesaku kende, na oborwoti naborwane noborwoti bonde;
swahili: Kisha akawaambia: “Taifa litainuka dhidi ya taifa jingine, na ufalme mmoja dhidi ya ufalme mwingine.

english: There will be great earthquakes, famines, and pestilences in various places, along with fearful sights and great signs from heaven.
ekegusii: emetengecho emenene y’ense nebe chinsemo ne chinsemo, na enchara, na emechando emenene; nabe namang’ana y’ogoichania, na ebimanyererio ebinene bikorwa igoro.
swahili: Kutakuwa na mitetemeko mikubwa ya ardhi, na njaa kali, na magonjwa ya kuambukiza katika sehemu mbalimbali. Pia kutakuwa na matukio ya kutisha na ishara kuu kutoka mbinguni.

english: But before all this, they will seize you and persecute you. On account of My name they will deliver you to the synagogues and prisons, and they will bring you before kings and governors.
ekegusii: Korende ritang’ani ase aya onsi nabababwaate na kobachanda, nabaabaire ase chisinagogi, na ase chichela, namoirwe ase abarwoti na ase abagabana ase engencho y’erieta riane.
swahili: “Lakini kabla yote hayajatokea, watawakamata ninyi na kuwatesa. Watawatia mikononi mwa wakuu wa masinagogi na kuwafunga magerezani. Nanyi mtapelekwa mbele ya wafalme na watawala kwa ajili ya Jina langu.

english: This will be your opportunity to serve as witnesses.
ekegusii: Eke nekero kiaino koba kirori.
swahili: Hii itawapa nafasi ya kushuhudia.

english: So make up your mind not to worry beforehand how to defend yourselves.
ekegusii: Manya gaki ase emioyo yaino, ng’a timorengereria ritang’ani eki morairanerie,
swahili: Lakini kusudieni mioyoni mwenu msisumbuke awali kuhusu mtakalosema mbele ya mashtaka.

english: For I will give you speech and wisdom that none of your adversaries will be able to resist or contradict.
ekegusii: ekiagera inche nimbae chinkwana na obong’aini, abachandi baino batanyare gokana gose koamererania nabio.
swahili: Kwa maana nitawapa maneno na hekima ambayo hakuna hata adui yenu mmoja atakayeweza kushindana nayo wala kuipinga.

english: You will be betrayed even by parents and brothers and relatives and friends, and some of you will be put to death.
ekegusii: Na inwe namoruegwe nabaibori baino, na bamura bamino, na eamate yaino, na abasani baino, na barabwo nababeeke abande baino ase ogoitwa.
swahili: Mtasalitiwa hata na wazazi, ndugu, jamaa na marafiki, na baadhi yenu watawaua.

english: And you will be hated by everyone because of My name.
ekegusii: Inamogechwe nabaanto bonsi ase engencho y’erieta riane.
swahili: Mtachukiwa na watu wote kwa ajili ya Jina langu.

english: Yet not even a hair of your head will perish.
ekegusii: Korende nonya nagatukia akamo k’emetwe yaino tikagosira.
swahili: Lakini hapatakuwa na unywele mmoja wa kichwa chenu utakaoangamia.

english: By your patient endurance you will gain your souls. The Destruction of Jerusalem (Matthew 24:15–25; Mark 13:14–23)
ekegusii: Na ase okoremereria kwaino namonyoore obogima bwaino.
swahili: Kwa kuvumilia mtaokoa roho zenu. Kuharibiwa Kwa Yerusalemu Kwatabiriwa (Mathayo 24:15-21; Marko 13:14-19)

english: and He saw a poor widow put in two small copper coins.
ekegusii: Akarora omoboraka oyomo omotaka, okobeeka ebisabwa bibere bie chitaai.
swahili: Akamwona pia mjane mmoja maskini akiweka humo sarafu mbili ndogo za shaba.

english: But when you see Jerusalem surrounded by armies, you will know that her desolation is near.
ekegusii: “Korende, komorarore Yerusalemu oetananirwe nemeganda y’abarwani b’esegi, erio momanye ng’a ogosareka kwaye gwaikire ang’e.
swahili: “Mtakapoona mji wa Yerusalemu umezungukwa na majeshi, basi fahamuni kwamba kuharibiwa kwake kumekaribia.

english: Then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains, let those in the city get out, and let those in the country stay out of the city.
ekegusii: Erio abare Boyahudi tiga batame gochia ase ebitunwa, na abare ime ase omochie basoke isiko, na abare isiko tibasoa aroro,
swahili: Wakati huo, wale walio Uyahudi wakimbilie milimani, walio mjini Yerusalemu watoke humo, nao wale walioko mashambani wasiingie mjini.

english: For these are the days of vengeance, to fulfill all that is written.
ekegusii: ekiagera aya namatuko egesiomba, onsi ayarigetwe anyare goikerana.
swahili: Kwa sababu huu utakuwa ni wakati wa adhabu ili kutimiza yote yaliyoandikwa.

english: How miserable those days will be for pregnant and nursing mothers! For there will be great distress upon the land and wrath against this people.
ekegusii: Nabe aakong’u ase abare barito na abakogonkia ase amatuko aria, ekiagera nebe emechando emenene igoro ase ense, na endamwamu ase egesaku eke.
swahili: Ole wao wenye mimba na wale wanaonyonyesha watoto siku hizo! Kutakuwa na dhiki kuu katika nchi na ghadhabu juu ya hawa watu.

english: They will fall by the edge of the sword and be led captive into all the nations. And Jerusalem will be trodden down by the Gentiles, until the times of the Gentiles are fulfilled. The Return of the Son of Man (Matthew 24:26–31; Mark 13:24–27)
ekegusii: Barabwo nabagwe ase chinsonga chi’emioro, nabooswe bairwe ase ebisaku bionsi, na Yerusalemu notachwe nabaanto b’Ebisaku, goika ebiro biabo biikeranigwe. Omoerio bw’ense (Mat 24:29-31; Mar 13:24-27)
swahili: Wataanguka kwa makali ya upanga, na wengine watachukuliwa kuwa mateka katika mataifa yote. Nao mji wa Yerusalemu utakanyagwa na watu wa Mataifa hadi muda wa hao watu wa Mataifa utimie. Kuja Kwa Mwana Wa Adamu (Mathayo 24:29-35; Marko 13:24-31)

english: There will be signs in the sun and moon and stars, and on the earth dismay among the nations, bewildered by the roaring of the sea and the surging of the waves.
ekegusii: “Naende nabibe ebimanyererio ase erioba, na omotienyi, ne ching’enang’eni, na ase ense emechando ase ebisaku, nabatang’ang’e ase okoeera kw’enyancha na emerindo yaye.
swahili: “Kutakuwa na ishara katika jua, mwezi na nyota. Hapa duniani, mataifa yatakuwa katika dhiki na fadhaa kutokana na ngurumo na misukosuko ya bahari.

english: Men will faint from fear and anxiety over what is coming upon the earth, for the powers of the heavens will be shaken.
ekegusii: Abanto mbakwe ekeondoko na okoiroka kobaganyete ayagoochera ense, ekiagera chinguru chia igoro nachitengechigwe.
swahili: Watu watazimia roho kutokana na hofu kuu na kuyaona yale mambo yanayotokea duniani, kwa maana nguvu za angani zitatikisika.

english: At that time they will see the Son of Man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.
ekegusii: Erio nabanyare korora Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto ogochaase riire ase chinguru na obonene obonge.
swahili: Wakati huo ndipo watakapomwona Mwana wa Adamu akija mawinguni pamoja na uweza na utukufu mkuu.

english: When these things begin to happen, stand up and lift up your heads, because your redemption is drawing near.” The Lesson of the Fig Tree (Matthew 24:32–35; Mark 13:28–31)
ekegusii: Nabo karachake koba ayio, rigereria igoro, ekiagera okoboorigwa kwaino gwaikire ang’e.” Amorokererio korwa ase Omoko (Mat 24:32-35; Mar 13:28-31)
swahili: Mambo haya yatakapoanza kutendeka, simameni na mkaviinue vichwa vyenu, kwa sababu ukombozi wenu umekaribia.”

english: Then Jesus told them a parable: “Look at the fig tree and all the trees.
ekegusii: Akabateebia omoreng’anio, “Rigereria omoko na emete ende yonsi;
swahili: Akawaambia mfano huu: “Uangalieni mtini na miti mingine yote.

english: “Truly I tell you,” He said, “this poor widow has put in more than all the others.
ekegusii: Erio akabora, “Ekeene nabateebirie, Omoboraka oyo omotaka obekire ebinge kobua bonsi,
swahili: Yesu akasema, “Amin, nawaambia, huyu mjane maskini ameweka humo zaidi ya watu wengine wote.

english: When they sprout leaves, you can see for yourselves and know that summer is near.
ekegusii: ekero egochaka goseboka mwarora na komanya ase emioyo yaino ng’a egura gura ng’ang’e ere.
swahili: Inapochipua majani, ninyi wenyewe mnaweza kuona na kutambua wenyewe ya kuwa wakati wa kiangazi umekaribia.

english: So also, when you see these things happening, know that the kingdom of God is near.
ekegusii: Nainwe boigo komorarore ayio agokoreka, momanye ng’a oborwoti bwa Nyasae ng’ang’e bore.
swahili: Vivyo hivyo, myaonapo mambo haya yakitukia, mnatambua kwamba Ufalme wa Mungu umekaribia.

english: Truly I tell you, this generation will not pass away until all these things have happened.
ekegusii: Ekeene nabateebirie: Ekegori eke tikegoeta nonya ng’ake goika aya onsi aikeranire.
swahili: “Amin, nawaambia, kizazi hiki hakitapita hadi mambo haya yote yawe yametimia.

english: Heaven and earth will pass away, but My words will never pass away. Be Watchful for the Day
ekegusii: Igoro na ense nabiete, korende amang’ana aane takonyara goeta nonya ng’ake.
swahili: Mbingu na nchi zitapita, lakini maneno yangu hayatapita kamwe.” Siku Ya Mwisho Itakuja Ghafula

english: But watch yourselves, or your hearts will be weighed down by dissipation, drunkenness, and the worries of life—and that day will spring upon you suddenly like a snare.
ekegusii: “Nabo mwerende chinkoro chiaino tichicha koengerwa nokoria bobe na ogotinda, na okwerosia kw’obogima obo, rituko riria ribachere mobosokano, buna omoeto okobwata.
swahili: “Jihadharini mioyo yenu isije ikalemewa na anasa, ulevi na fadhaa za maisha haya, nayo siku ile ikawakuta ninyi bila kutazamia kama vile mtego unasavyo.

english: For it will come upon all who dwell on the face of all the earth.
ekegusii: Naki naboigo eranyaare goochera abanto bonsi abamenyete igoro ase ense yonsi.
swahili: Kwa maana kama vile mtego unasavyo, ndivyo siku hiyo itakavyowapata wanadamu wote waishio katika uso wa dunia yote.

english: So keep watch at all times, and pray that you may have the strength to escape all that is about to happen and to stand before the Son of Man.”
ekegusii: Ase ayio, renda kera ekero na gosaba, monyoore chinguru chi’ogoeta ase aya onsi araache koba, naende gotenena ase obosio bw’Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto.”
swahili: Kesheni daima na mwombe ili mweze kuokoka na yale yote yatakayotokea na kusimama mbele ya Mwana wa Adamu.”

english: Every day Jesus taught at the temple, but every evening He went out to spend the night on the Mount of Olives.
ekegusii: Na kera rituko nigo arenge kworokereria Hekalu ime, korende botuko ogenda isiko obeera ase egetunwa ki’Emezeituni.
swahili: Kila siku Yesu alikuwa akifundisha Hekaluni, na jioni ilipofika, alikwenda zake kwenye Mlima wa Mizeituni na kukaa huko usiku kucha.

english: And early in the morning all the people would come to hear Him at the temple.
ekegusii: Abanto bonsi bakamochiera mambia chuni aria Hekalu ime, erinde banyaare komoigwa.
swahili: Nao watu wote walikuja asubuhi na mapema Hekaluni ili kumsikiliza.

english: For they all contributed out of their surplus, but she out of her poverty has put in all she had to live on.” Temple Destruction and Other Signs (Matthew 24:1–8; Mark 13:1–8)
ekegusii: ekiagera aba bonsi babeekire korwa ase obonge bwe chinibo chiabo, korende oyo ase obotaka bwaye obeekire ebinto bionsi ebiarenge nabio.” Yeso okobana ogotagorwa gwe Hekalu (Mat 24:1-2; Mar 13:1-2)
swahili: Hawa watu wengine wote wametoa sadaka kutokana na wingi wa mali zao. Lakini huyu mjane ametoa kutokana na umaskini wake vyote alivyokuwa navyo, hata kile alichohitaji ili kuishi.” Dalili Za Siku Za Mwisho (Mathayo 24:1-2; Marko 13:1-2)

english: As some of the disciples were remarking how the temple was adorned with beautiful stones and consecrated gifts, Jesus said,
ekegusii: Ekero abanto bande barenge gokwana amang’ana igoro ye Hekalu, buna echabeire namagena amaya na ebiegwa, agateeba.
swahili: Baadhi ya wanafunzi wake wakawa wanamwonyesha jinsi Hekalu lilivyopambwa kwa mawe mazuri na kwa vitu vilivyotolewa kuwa sadaka kwa Mungu. Lakini Yesu akawaambia,

english: “As for what you see here, the time will come when not one stone will be left on another; every one will be thrown down.”
ekegusii: “Aya morooche; amatuko nache ritatigare rigena erimo igoro ase erinde eritatagorwe.” Amabe agochi‐gocha (Mat 24:3-25; Mar 13:3-23)
swahili: “Kuhusu haya mnayoyaona hapa, wakati utafika ambapo hakuna jiwe moja litakalobaki juu ya jingine, bali kila moja litabomolewa.” Mateso (Mathayo 24:3-14; Marko 13:3-13)

english: “Teacher,” they asked, “when will these things happen? And what will be the sign that they are about to take place?”
ekegusii: Erio bakamobooria, “Omworokia, aya indi arabe rende? Naende ninki ekemanyererio kiaye ekero aya onsi araabe ang’e goikerana?”
swahili: Wakamuuliza, “Mwalimu, mambo haya yatatukia lini? Ni dalili gani itaonyesha kwamba yanakaribia kutendeka?”

english: Jesus answered, “See to it that you are not deceived. For many will come in My name, claiming, ‘I am He,’ and, ‘The time is near.’ Do not follow them.
ekegusii: Akabora, “Mwerende, timong’ainwa, ekiagera abange nabaache ase erieta riane babore: Ninche ere! Nengaki yaikire! Nabo, timobabwatia abwo.
swahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Jihadharini msije mkadanganywa. Maana wengi watakuja kwa Jina langu, wakidai, ‘Mimi ndiye,’ na, ‘Wakati umekaribia.’ Msiwafuate.

english: When you hear of wars and rebellions, do not be alarmed. These things must happen first, but the end is not imminent.” Witnessing to All Nations (Matthew 24:9–14; Mark 13:9–13)
ekegusii: Na inwe ekero moraigwe amang’ana y’esegi na eburu‐buru, timogoswa, ekiagera aya bori nache kooroka ritang’ani, korende omoerio toraba ang’e.”
swahili: Lakini msikiapo habari za vita na machafuko, msiogope. Kwa maana hayo ni lazima yatokee kwanza, ila ule mwisho hautakuja wakati huo.”

english: Now the Feast of Unleavened Bread, called the Passover, was approaching,
ekegusii: Rituko Rinene ri’Emegati etabekiri memera, rikorokwa Epasaka, rigaika.
swahili: Wakati huu Sikukuu ya Mikate Isiyotiwa Chachu, iitwayo Pasaka, ilikuwa imekaribia.

english: He answered, “When you enter the city, a man carrying a jug of water will meet you. Follow him to the house he enters,
ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Rora, ekero mwasoire omochie, namoumerane nomosaacha obogoretie enyongo ere namaache; momotunyane goika enyomba agosoa,
swahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Tazameni, mtakapokuwa mkiingia mjini, mtakutana na mwanaume amebeba mtungi wa maji. Mfuateni mpaka kwenye nyumba atakayoingia.

english: and say to the owner of that house, ‘The Teacher asks: Where is the guest room, where I may eat the Passover with My disciples?’
ekegusii: moteebie omonyene enyomba: Omworokia nkoboria are: Ng’ai enyomba y’abageni ere, inyare koriera Epasaka amo naborokigwa baane?
swahili: Nanyi mwambieni mwenye nyumba, ‘Mwalimu anauliza: Kiko wapi chumba cha wageni, ambamo mimi na wanafunzi wangu tutakula Pasaka?’

english: And he will show you a large upper room, already furnished. Make preparations there.”
ekegusii: Omonto oria naboorokie akanyomba akanene ka irongo karoisirie; agwo moariganie.”
swahili: Atawaonyesha chumba kikubwa ghorofani, kikiwa kimepambwa vizuri. Andaeni humo.”

english: When the hour had come, Jesus reclined at the table with His apostles.
ekegusii: Erio ensa egachia goika ang’e, agaikaransa amo nabatomwa.
swahili: Wakati ulipowadia, Yesu akaketi mezani pamoja na wale mitume wake.

english: And He said to them, “I have eagerly desired to eat this Passover with you before My suffering.
ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Ninganetie mono koria Epasaka eye amo nainwe ritang’ani ntarachaandwa,
swahili: Kisha akawaambia, “Nimetamani sana kuila Pasaka hii pamoja nanyi kabla ya kuteswa kwangu.

english: For I tell you that I will not eat it again until it is fulfilled in the kingdom of God.”
ekegusii: ekiagera nabateebirie, tinkoyeria naende goika yaikeranigwe ase oborwoti bwa Nyasae.” Endagera y’omoerio (Mat 26:20-30; Mar 14:22-26; 1 Abakr 11:23-25)
swahili: Kwa maana, nawaambia, sitaila tena Pasaka mpaka itakapotimizwa katika Ufalme wa Mungu.”

english: After taking the cup, He gave thanks and said, “Take this and divide it among yourselves.
ekegusii: Akabogoria egekombe, na ekero airaneirie ng’a mbuya mono, akabora, “Bogoria eke, mosaange inwe ase inwe;
swahili: Akiisha kukichukua kikombe, akashukuru, akasema, “Chukueni hiki mnywe wote.

english: For I tell you that I will not drink of the fruit of the vine from now on until the kingdom of God comes.”
ekegusii: naki nabateebirie, korwa bono tinkonywa okwama kw’omosabibu goika oborwoti bwa Nyasae boche.”
swahili: Kwa maana nawaambia tangu sasa sitakunywa tena katika uzao wa mzabibu, hadi Ufalme wa Mungu utakapokuja.”

english: And He took the bread, gave thanks and broke it, and gave it to them, saying, “This is My body, given for you; do this in remembrance of Me.”
ekegusii: Akabogoria omogati, na ekero airaneirie ng’a mbuya mono, akayosamunyora, akabaa, akabora, “Oyo nomobere one orurwe ase engencho yaino. [Kora iga ase okong’inyora.”
swahili: Kisha akachukua mkate, akashukuru, akaumega, na kuwapa, akisema, “Huu ni mwili wangu unaotolewa kwa ajili yenu. Fanyeni hivi kwa ukumbusho wangu.”

english: and the chief priests and scribes were looking for a way to put Jesus to death; for they feared the people. Judas Agrees to Betray Jesus (Matthew 26:14–16; Mark 14:10–11)
ekegusii: Abakuani abanene na aborokia b’amariiko bakarigia enchera y’okomoita, ekiagera nigo bairogete abanto.
swahili: Viongozi wa makuhani na walimu wa sheria walikuwa wanatafuta njia ya kumuua Yesu, kwa sababu waliwaogopa watu.

english: In the same way, after supper He took the cup, saying, “This cup is the new covenant in My blood, which is poured out for you.
ekegusii: Naboigo akabogoria egekombe magega ase okoria, akabora, “Egekombe eke nokobwatana okoyia ase amanyinga aane, aitekire ase engencho yaino.]
swahili: Vivyo hivyo baada ya kula, akakitwaa kikombe, akisema, “Kikombe hiki ni agano jipya katika damu yangu, imwagikayo kwa ajili yenu.

english: Look! The hand of My betrayer is with Mine on the table.
ekegusii: Korende rigereria, okoboko kwaye ere oyokondua nigo kore amo nainche ase emesa.
swahili: Lakini mkono wake huyo atakayenisaliti uko hapa mezani pamoja nami.

english: Indeed, the Son of Man will go as it has been determined, but woe to that man who betrays Him.”
ekegusii: Ekiagera Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto nkogenda are buna yachiigetwe; korende obobe nobwaye omonto oria okomorua!”
swahili: Mwana wa Adamu anaenda zake kama ilivyokusudiwa. Lakini ole wake mtu huyo amsalitiye.”

english: Then they began to question among themselves which of them was going to do this. Who Is the Greatest?
ekegusii: Na barabwo bagachaaka koborania barabwo ase barabwo, gose ning’o ase bare orakore ring’ana eri. Obonene bw’ekeene
swahili: Wakaanza kuulizana wenyewe ni nani miongoni mwao angeweza kufanya jambo hilo. Mabishano Kuhusu Ukuu

english: A dispute also arose among the disciples as to which of them would be considered the greatest.
ekegusii: Gokaba okoamererania ase egati yabo, gose ning’o ase bare obarirwe koba omonene kobua abande.
swahili: Pia yakazuka mabishano katikati ya wanafunzi kwamba ni nani aliyeonekana kuwa mkuu kuliko wote miongoni mwao.

english: So Jesus declared, “The kings of the Gentiles lord it over them, and those in authority over them call themselves benefactors.
ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Abarwoti b’abaanto b’ebisaku nigo bakogambera abanto; naende abare nokobua igoro ase bare barokwa Abakori Abaya.
swahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Wafalme na watu wa Mataifa huwatawala watu kwa nguvu. Nao wenye mamlaka juu yao hujiita ‘Wafadhili.’

english: But you shall not be like them. Instead, the greatest among you should be like the youngest, and the one who leads like the one who serves.
ekegusii: Korende ase more inwe taibo, otatiga oyore omonene oino nabe buna oyore omoke; na ere oyokobatang’ana nabe buna omokoreri abande.
swahili: Lakini ninyi msifanane nao. Bali yeye aliye mkuu kuliko wote miongoni mwenu, inampasa kuwa kama yeye aliye mdogo wa wote, naye atawalaye na awe kama yeye ahudumuye.

english: For who is greater, the one who reclines at the table or the one who serves? Is it not the one who reclines? But I am among you as one who serves.
ekegusii: Inee! Ning’o ore omonene, noyoikaransete ase endagera, gose noyogokorera? Tari ere oyogoikaransa ase endagera? Korende inche nigo inde ase egati yaino buna omokoreri.
swahili: Kwani ni nani aliye mkuu? Ni yule aketiye mezani au ni yule ahudumuye? Si ni yule aliyekaa mezani? Lakini mimi niko miongoni mwenu kama yule ahudumuye.

english: You are the ones who have stood by Me in My trials.
ekegusii: “Inwe ninwe mwabeire mogendererete amo nainche ase ogoteemwa kwane,
swahili: Ninyi mmekuwa pamoja nami katika majaribu yangu.

english: And I bestow on you a kingdom, just as My Father has bestowed one on Me,
ekegusii: na inche nabaeire inwe oborwoti buna Tata ang’ete,
swahili: Nami kama Baba yangu alivyonipa ufalme, kadhalika mimi nami ninawapa ninyi,

english: Then Satan entered Judas Iscariot, who was one of the Twelve.
ekegusii: Saitani agasoa Yudasi okorokwa Iskariota. Yudasi nigo arenge oyomo bwa baria ikomi na babere.
swahili: Shetani akamwingia Yuda, aliyeitwa Iskariote, mmoja wa wale Kumi na Wawili.

english: so that you may eat and drink at My table in My kingdom, and sit on thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel. Jesus Predicts Peter’s Denial (Matthew 26:31–35; Mark 14:27–31; John 13:36–38)
ekegusii: monyaare koria na konywa ase emesa yane ase oborwoti bwane, na goikaransa ase ebirogo bi’obonene, na kogambia abanto b’ebisaku ikomi na bibere bi’Abaisraeli.” Ogokana gwa Petero gokobanwa (Mat 26:31-35; Mar 14:27-31; Yoh 13:36-38)
swahili: ili mpate kula na kunywa mezani pangu katika karamu ya ufalme wangu, na kukaa katika viti vya enzi, mkihukumu makabila kumi na mawili ya Israeli.” Yesu Atabiri Kuwa Petro Atamkana

english: Simon, Simon, Satan has asked to sift each of you like wheat.
ekegusii: Akabora, “Simioni, Simioni, rora Saitani nabarigetie abaire anyaare kobasoonga buna engano,
swahili: Yesu akasema, “Simoni, Simoni, sikiliza, Shetani ameomba kuwapepeta ninyi wote kama ngano.

english: But I have prayed for you, Simon, that your faith will not fail. And when you have turned back, strengthen your brothers.”
ekegusii: korende nagosabeire, erinde okwegena kwao tikoera, na aye gokwaonchokire, obeeke abamiino chinguru.”
swahili: Lakini nimekuombea wewe Simoni ili imani yako isishindwe, nawe ukiisha kunirudia, uwaimarishe ndugu zako.”

english: “Lord,” said Peter, “I am ready to go with You even to prison and to death.”
ekegusii: Akamoteebia, “Omonene nigo inde ang’e kogenda amo naye echela, nonya nase ogokwa.”
swahili: Petro akajibu, “Bwana, niko tayari kwenda pamoja nawe gerezani na hata kifoni.”

english: But Jesus replied, “I tell you, Peter, the rooster will not crow today until you have denied three times that you know Me.”
ekegusii: Akabora, “Nagotebirie Petero, reero etuoni etarabuga nonkane ara gatato ng’a tomanyeti.”
swahili: Yesu akamjibu, “Ninakuambia Petro, kabla jogoo hajawika usiku wa leo, utakana mara tatu kwamba hunijui mimi.” Mfuko, Mkoba Na Upanga

english: Then Jesus asked them, “When I sent you out without purse or bag or sandals, did you lack anything?” “Nothing,” they answered.
ekegusii: Akababoria, “Inee! Ekero nabatomete motari nebimoya, ne chisaaro, na ebikoroto, imwaremeretwe na gento?” Bakamoiraneria, “Yaya”.
swahili: Kisha Yesu akawauliza, “Nilipowatuma bila mfuko, wala mkoba, wala viatu, mlipungukiwa na kitu chochote?” Wakajibu, “La, hatukupungukiwa na kitu chochote.”

english: “Now, however,” He told them, “the one with a purse should take it, and likewise a bag; and the one without a sword should sell his cloak and buy one.
ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Korende bono oyore nekemoya akebogorie, na esaro boigo, na ere oyotari nomoyio o birende aoonie eganchwa yaye, agore oyomo.
swahili: Akawaambia, “Lakini sasa, aliye na mfuko na auchukue, na aliye na mkoba vivyo hivyo. Naye asiye na upanga, auze joho lake anunue mmoja.

english: For I tell you that this Scripture must be fulfilled in Me: ‘And He was numbered with the transgressors.’ For what is written about Me is reaching its fulfillment.”
ekegusii: Naki nabateebirie, eriarigetwe ndigwenerete goikeranigwa ase ’nde. Ere nigo abareranetigwe amo nabasaria, ekiagera ayarigetwe igoro ase ’nde aikeranigwe.”
swahili: Kwa sababu, nawaambia, andiko hili lazima litimizwe juu yangu, kwamba, ‘Alihesabiwa pamoja na wakosaji’; kwa kweli yaliyoandikwa kunihusu mimi hayana budi kutimizwa.”

english: So they said, “Look, Lord, here are two swords.” “That is enough,” He answered. Jesus Prays on the Mount of Olives (Matthew 26:36–46; Mark 14:32–42)
ekegusii: Bagateeba, “Omonene, rora ntore nemeyio ya birende ebere aa.” Akabateebia, “Nabo aisanire.” Yeso ore Gethisemane (Mat 26:36-46; Mar 14:32-42)
swahili: Wanafunzi wake wakamwambia, “Bwana, tazama hapa kuna panga mbili.” Akawajibu, “Inatosha.” Yesu Aomba Kwenye Mlima Wa Mizeituni (Mathayo 26:36-46; Marko 14:32-42)

english: Jesus went out as usual to the Mount of Olives, and the disciples followed Him.
ekegusii: Agasooka, akagenda goika egetunwa ki’Emezeituni, buna engencho yaye yarenge, na aborokigwa baye bakamotunyana.
swahili: Yesu akatoka, akaenda kwenye Mlima wa Mizeituni kama ilivyokuwa kawaida yake, nao wanafunzi wake wakamfuata.

english: And Judas went to discuss with the chief priests and temple officers how he might betray Jesus to them.
ekegusii: Akagenda agakwana nabakuani abanene na abatang’ani b’abarendi buna aranyare komobeeka ase amaboko abo.
swahili: Yuda akaenda kwa viongozi wa makuhani na kwa maafisa wa walinzi wa Hekalu, akazungumza nao jinsi ambavyo angeweza kumsaliti Yesu.

english: When He came to the place, He told them, “Pray that you will not enter into temptation.”
ekegusii: Agachia goika aase aria akabateebia, “Saba, erinde timosoa ase ogoteemwa.”
swahili: Walipofika huko, akawaambia wanafunzi wake, “Ombeni, msije mkaingia majaribuni.”

english: And He withdrew about a stone’s throw beyond them, where He knelt down and prayed,
ekegusii: Ageatanana korwa ase bare, ekerengo gi’okoruta rigena, akabeeka amaru inse, agasaba,
swahili: Akajitenga nao kama umbali wa kutupa jiwe, akapiga magoti, akaomba

english: “Father, if You are willing, take this cup from Me. Yet not My will, but Yours be done.”
ekegusii: ogoteeba, “Tata, koranche, onduserie egekombe eke, korende tari buna ndigetie inche, korende buna origetie aye, bikoreke.”
swahili: akisema, “Baba, kama ni mapenzi yako, niondolee kikombe hiki. Lakini si kama nipendavyo, bali mapenzi yako yatendeke.”

english: Then an angel from heaven appeared to Him and strengthened Him.
ekegusii: Omomalaika akamoorokera korwa, igoro, akamobeka chinguru.
swahili: Malaika kutoka mbinguni akamtokea, akamtia nguvu.

english: And in His anguish, He prayed more earnestly, and His sweat became like drops of blood falling to the ground.
ekegusii: Na ere ekiagera arenge nomoichano mono, akamenta ogosaba nomokia; ebigeri biaye bikaba buna amatoima y’amanyinga agoiteka inse.
swahili: Naye akiwa katika maumivu makuu, akaomba kwa bidii, nalo jasho lake likawa kama matone ya damu yakidondoka ardhini.

english: When Jesus rose from prayer and returned to the disciples, He found them asleep, exhausted from sorrow.
ekegusii: Agachia koimoka korwa ase ogosaba agachiera aborokigwa baye, akabanyora bararire ase ogoichana.
swahili: Baada ya kuomba, akawarudia wanafunzi wake akawakuta wamelala, wakiwa wamechoka kutokana na huzuni.

english: “Why are you sleeping?” He asked. “Get up and pray so that you will not enter into temptation.” The Betrayal of Jesus (Matthew 26:47–56; Mark 14:43–52; John 18:1–14)
ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Inaki mwararire? Boka, mosabe, erinde timosoa ase ogoteemwa.” Okobwatwa kwa Yeso (Mat 26:47-56; Mar 14:43-50; Yoh 18:2-11)
swahili: Naye akawauliza, “Mbona mmelala? Amkeni, mwombe ili msije mkaingia majaribuni.” Yesu Akamatwa (Mathayo 26:47-56; Marko 14:43-50; Yohana 18:3-11)

english: While He was still speaking, a crowd arrived, led by the man called Judas, one of the Twelve. He approached Jesus to kiss Him.
ekegusii: Ekero arenge gokwana, rora, omoganda ogaacha, na oria okorokwa Yudasi, oyomo bwa baria ikomi na babere, obatang’aine. Ere akamoika Yeso ang’e komonyunyunta.
swahili: Yesu alipokuwa bado anazungumza, umati mkubwa wa watu ukaja. Uliongozwa na Yuda, ambaye alikuwa mmoja wa wale wanafunzi Kumi na Wawili. Akamkaribia Yesu ili ambusu.

english: But Jesus asked him, “Judas, are you betraying the Son of Man with a kiss?”
ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Yudasi, nkomorua ore Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto ase okomonyunyunta?”
swahili: Lakini Yesu akamwambia, “Yuda, je, unamsaliti Mwana wa Adamu kwa busu?”

english: Those around Jesus saw what was about to happen and said, “Lord, should we strike with our swords?”
ekegusii: Na abwo barenge amo nere bagachia korora ayakorigia koba, bakaboora, “Omonene, inatorwane nomoyio o birende?”
swahili: Wafuasi wa Yesu walipoona yale yaliyokuwa yanakaribia kutokea, wakasema, “Bwana, tuwakatekate kwa panga zetu?”

english: They were delighted and agreed to give him money.
ekegusii: Bakagoka bakabwatana nere komoa chiropia.
swahili: Wakafurahi na wakakubaliana kumpa fedha.

english: And one of them struck the servant of the high priest, cutting off his right ear.
ekegusii: Oyomo obo agaaka omosomba bw’Omokuani omonene, akamobutora ogoto gw’okorio.
swahili: Mmoja wao akampiga mtumishi wa kuhani mkuu kwa upanga, akamkata sikio la kuume.

english: But Jesus answered, “No more of this!” And He touched the man’s ear and healed him.
ekegusii: Yeso akabora, “Tiga tokora igo.” Akamokuna ogoto, akamogwenia.
swahili: Lakini Yesu akasema, “Acheni!” Akaligusa lile sikio la yule mtu na kumponya.

english: Then Jesus said to the chief priests, temple officers, and elders who had come for Him, “Have you come out with swords and clubs as you would against an outlaw?
ekegusii: Yeso agateebia abakuani abanene, na abanene b’abarendi be Hekalu, na abagaaka, baria bamoocherete, “Iga mwachire nemeyio ya birende ne chinungu buna mogochiera omouri.
swahili: Kisha Yesu akawaambia wale viongozi wa makuhani, maafisa wa walinzi wa Hekalu, pamoja na wazee waliokuwa wamekuja kumkamata, “Mmekuja na panga na marungu, kana kwamba mimi ni mnyangʼanyi?

english: Every day I was with you in the temple courts, and you did not lay a hand on Me. But this hour belongs to you and to the power of darkness.” Peter Denies Jesus (Matthew 26:69–75; Mark 14:66–72; John 18:15–18)
ekegusii: Ekero narenge amo nainwe ase Hekalu kera rituko timwaramborete amaboko mombwate, korende bono ensa eye neyaino, ekero omosunte okogamba.” Petero okomokana Yeso (Mat 26:57-58,69-75; Mar 14:53-54,66-72; Yoh 18:12-18,25-27)
swahili: Siku kwa siku nilikuwa pamoja nanyi Hekaluni lakini hamkunikamata. Lakini hii ni saa yenu, wakati giza linatawala!” Petro Amkana Yesu (Mathayo 26:57-75; Marko 14:53-72; Yohana 18:12-27)

english: Then they seized Jesus, led Him away, and took Him into the house of the high priest. And Peter followed at a distance.
ekegusii: Bakamobwata, bakamoira, bakagenda nere nyomba ime ase Omokuani omonene. Na Petero akamotunyana korwa magega ore egeka.
swahili: Kisha wakamkamata Yesu, wakamchukua, wakaenda naye mpaka nyumbani kwa kuhani mkuu. Lakini Petro akafuata kwa mbali.

english: When those present had kindled a fire in the middle of the courtyard and sat down together, Peter sat down among them.
ekegusii: Bagachia gouta omorero egati y’egoora, bagaikaransa amo, na Petero agaikaransa ase egati yabo.
swahili: Walipokwisha kuwasha moto katikati ya ua na kuketi pamoja, Petro naye akaketi pamoja nao.

english: A servant girl saw him seated in the firelight and looked intently at him. “This man also was with Him,” she said.
ekegusii: Erio omoiseke oyomo akamorora oikaransete ang’e nomorero, akamobeta amaiso akabora, “Oyo nere igo arenge amo nere.”
swahili: Mtumishi mmoja wa kike akamwona kwa mwanga wa moto akiwa ameketi pale. Akamtazama sana, akasema, “Huyu mtu pia alikuwa pamoja na Yesu!”

english: But Peter denied it. “Woman, I do not know Him,” he said.
ekegusii: Agakana, akabora, “Omokungu, timomanyeti.”
swahili: Lakini Petro akakana, akasema, “Ewe mwanamke, hata simjui!”

english: A short time later, someone else saw him and said, “You also are one of them.” But Peter said, “Man, I am not.”
ekegusii: Naende ake omonto onde akamorora, akabora, “Aye noyomo obo ore.” Petero akabora, “Omonto oyo, tai inche.”
swahili: Baadaye kidogo, mtu mwingine alimwona Petro akasema, “Wewe pia ni mmoja wao!” Petro akajibu, “Wewe mtu, mimi sio mmoja wao!”

english: About an hour later, another man insisted, “Certainly this man was with Him, for he too is a Galilean.”
ekegusii: Na magega y’ensa eyemo, omonto onde akabetereria mono, akabora, “Ekeene, oyo nigo arenge amo nere, ekiagera nere n’Omogalili.”
swahili: Baada ya muda wa kama saa moja hivi, mtu mwingine akazidi kusisitiza, “Kwa hakika huyu mtu naye alikuwa pamoja na Yesu, kwa maana yeye pia ni Mgalilaya.”

english: Judas consented, and began to look for an opportunity to betray Jesus to them in the absence of a crowd. Preparing the Passover (Matthew 26:17–19; Mark 14:12–16)
ekegusii: Agancha, akarigia ribaga akomoruera ase bare emeganda etaiyo. Okwearigania kw’Endagera y’omoerio (Mat 26:17-19; Mar 14:12-16)
swahili: Naye akakubali, akaanza kutafuta wakati uliofaa wa kumsaliti Yesu kwao, wakati ambapo hakuna umati wa watu. Maandalizi Ya Pasaka (Mathayo 26:17-25; Marko 14:12-21; Yohana 13:21-30)

english: “Man, I do not know what you are talking about,” Peter replied. While he was still speaking, the rooster crowed.
ekegusii: Petero akabora, “Omonto oyo, timanyeti eri ogokwana.” Erio kegima kagokwana, etuoni ekabuga.
swahili: Petro akajibu, “Wewe mtu, mimi sijui unalosema!” Wakati huo huo, akiwa bado anazungumza, jogoo akawika.

english: And the Lord turned and looked at Peter. Then Peter remembered the word that the Lord had spoken to him: “Before the rooster crows today, you will deny Me three times.”
ekegusii: Omonene akeonchora, akarigereria Petero. Petero akainyora ring’ana ri’Omonene, buna amoteebetie, “Reero, ritang’ani etuoni etarabuga nonkaane ara gatato.”
swahili: Naye Bwana akageuka, akamtazama Petro. Ndipo Petro akakumbuka lile neno ambalo Bwana alimwambia: “Kabla jogoo hajawika leo, utanikana mara tatu.”

english: And he went outside and wept bitterly. The Soldiers Mock Jesus (Isaiah 50:4–11; Matthew 27:27–31; Mark 15:16–20; John 19:1–15)
ekegusii: Agasoka isiko, akarera nobororo. Yeso ogosekererigwa na goakwa (Mat 26:67-68; Mar 14:65)
swahili: Naye akaenda nje, akalia kwa majonzi. Walinzi Wamdhihaki Yesu Na Kumpiga (Mathayo 26:67-68; Marko 14:65)

english: The men who were holding Jesus began to mock Him and beat Him.
ekegusii: Abanto baria babwatete Yeso, bakamosekereria, na komoaka.
swahili: Watu waliokuwa wanamlinda Yesu wakaanza kumdhihaki na kumpiga.

english: They blindfolded Him and kept demanding, “Prophesy! Who hit You?”
ekegusii: Bakamotuba amaiso, bakamobooria, “Bana! Ning’o ogoaka?”
swahili: Wakamfunga kitambaa machoni na kumuuliza, “Tabiri! Tuambie ni nani aliyekupiga?”

english: And they said many other blasphemous things against Him. Jesus before the Sanhedrin (Matthew 26:57–68; Mark 14:53–65; John 18:19–24)
ekegusii: Bakamokwana bobe amang’ana ande amange ay’okomorama. Yeso ase obosio bw’abakuani abanene (Mat 26:59-66; Mar 14:55-64; Yoh 18:19-24)
swahili: Wakaendelea kumtukana kwa matusi mengi. Yesu Apelekwa Mbele Ya Baraza (Mathayo 26:59-66; Marko 14:55-64; Yohana 18:28-38)

english: At daybreak the council of the elders of the people, both the chief priests and scribes, met together. They led Jesus into their Sanhedrin and said,
ekegusii: Ekero bwachia gokia, abagaaka b’abaanto, na abakuani abanene, na aborokia b’amariiko bagasangererekana amo, bakamorenta ase ekegambero kiabo, bakoboora,
swahili: Kulipopambazuka, baraza la wazee wa watu, yaani viongozi wa makuhani na walimu wa sheria, wakakutana pamoja, naye Yesu akaletwa mbele yao.

english: “If You are the Christ, tell us.” Jesus answered, “If I tell you, you will not believe.
ekegusii: “Onye aye naye Kristo, toteebie.” Korende akabateebia, “Ninsa kobateebia, timokonyaara gwancha;
swahili: Wakamwambia, “Kama wewe ndiye Kristo, tuambie.” Yesu akawajibu, “Hata nikiwaambia hamtaamini.

english: And if I ask you a question, you will not answer.
ekegusii: naende nimbaboria, timokong’iraneria.
swahili: Nami nikiwauliza swali, hamtanijibu.

english: But from now on the Son of Man will be seated at the right hand of the power of God.”
ekegusii: Korende korwa bono Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto naikaranse ensemo y’okoboko gw’okorio kw’obonene bwa Nyasae.”
swahili: Lakini kuanzia sasa, Mwana wa Adamu ataketi mkono wa kuume wa Mungu Mwenye Nguvu.”

english: Then came the day of Unleavened Bread on which the Passover lamb was to be sacrificed.
ekegusii: Rituko ri’Emegati etabekiri memera rigaika, eri’emanwa y’eng’ondi y’Epasaka egwenerete konyenywa.
swahili: Basi ikawadia siku ya Mikate Isiyotiwa Chachu, siku ambayo mwana-kondoo wa Pasaka huchinjwa.

english: So they all asked, “Are You then the Son of God?” He replied, “You say that I am.”
ekegusii: Bakaboora bonsi, “Aye naye Omwana o Nyasae.” Akabateebia, “Inwe mwateebire ng’a ninche ere.”
swahili: Wote wakauliza, “Wewe basi ndiwe Mwana wa Mungu?” Yeye akawajibu, “Ninyi mwasema kwamba mimi ndiye.”

english: “Why do we need any more testimony?” they declared. “We have heard it for ourselves from His own lips.”
ekegusii: Bakaboora, “Mborori ki torigetie goetania obo? Naki intwe abanyene twaigure amang’ana korwa ase omonwa oye.”
swahili: Kisha wakasema, “Tuna haja gani tena ya ushahidi zaidi? Tumesikia wenyewe kutoka kinywani mwake.”

english: Jesus sent Peter and John, saying, “Go and prepare for us to eat the Passover.”
ekegusii: Erio Yeso agatoma Petero na Yohana, akabora, “Genda motoroiserie Epasaka, erinde toyerie.”
swahili: Hivyo Yesu akawatuma Petro na Yohana, akisema, “Nendeni mkatuandalie chakula cha Pasaka ili tuweze kuila.”

english: “Where do You want us to prepare it?” they asked.
ekegusii: Bakamobooria, “Ng’ai origetie toyeroiserie?”
swahili: Wakamuuliza, “Unataka tukuandalie wapi?”

english: Then the whole council rose and led Jesus away to Pilate.
ekegusii: Bakaimoka bonsi, bakaira Yeso ase Pilato.
swahili: Kisha umati wote wa watu ukainuka na kumpeleka Yesu kwa Pilato.

english: Meanwhile, the chief priests and scribes stood there, vehemently accusing Him.
ekegusii: Abakuani abanene na aborokia b’amariiko bagatenena, bakomosoera ne chinguru.
swahili: Wakati huo viongozi wa makuhani na walimu wa sheria walikuwepo wakitoa mashtaka yao kwa nguvu sana.

english: And even Herod and his soldiers ridiculed and mocked Him. Dressing Him in a fine robe, they sent Him back to Pilate.
ekegusii: Herode na abarwani baye bakamochaya, bakamosekereria, bakamobekera chianga chingiya mono, akamoirania ase Pilato.
swahili: Herode na askari wake wakamdhihaki Yesu na kumfanyia mzaha. Wakamvika vazi zuri sana, wakamrudisha kwa Pilato.

english: That day Herod and Pilate became friends; before this time they had been enemies. The Crowd Chooses Barabbas (Matthew 27:15–23; Mark 15:6–11)
ekegusii: Erio Herode na Pilato abwo barenge ababisa agwo ritang’ani bakabwatana korwa rituko riria bakaba abasani. Pilato, na Baraba, na Yeso (Mat 27:15-26; Mar 15:6-15; Yoh 18:39—19:16)
swahili: Siku hiyo, Herode na Pilato wakawa marafiki; kabla ya jambo hili walikuwa na uadui kati yao. Yesu Ahukumiwa Kifo (Mathayo 27:15-26; Marko 15:6-15; Yohana 18:39–19:16)

english: Then Pilate called together the chief priests, the rulers, and the people,
ekegusii: Pilato akarangeria amo abakuani abanene, na abagaambi, na abanto,
swahili: Basi Pilato akawaita pamoja viongozi wa makuhani, viongozi wengine na watu,

english: and said to them, “You brought me this man as one who was inciting the people to rebellion. I have examined Him here in your presence and found Him not guilty of your charges against Him.
ekegusii: akabateebia, “Mwandeterete omonto oyo, buna oyo baonchoire abanto; naunirie amang’ana aye ase amasio aino, na tindochi bobe ase omonto oyo ase aria mwamosoerete,
swahili: akawaambia, “Ninyi mlimleta huyu mtu kwangu kana kwamba ni mtu anayewachochea watu ili waasi. Nimemhoji mbele yenu nami nimeona hakuna msingi wowote wa mashtaka yenu dhidi yake.

english: Neither has Herod, for he sent Him back to us. As you can see, He has done nothing deserving of death.
ekegusii: nonya n’Herode tarochi, ekiagera omoiranirie gocha ase tore. Rora, ere takorete gento kemogwenerete akwe.
swahili: Wala Herode hakumwona na kosa lolote, ndiyo sababu amemrudisha kwetu. Kama mnavyoona, mtu huyu hakufanya jambo lolote linalostahili kifo.

english: Therefore I will punish Him and release Him.”
ekegusii: Erio konamoakire, nimosibore.”
swahili: Kwa hiyo nitaamuru apigwe mijeledi na kumwachia.” [

english: But they all cried out in unison: “Away with this man! Release Barabbas to us!”
ekegusii: Bagaaka eriogi bonsi amo, bakaboora, “Morusie oyo, tosiborere Baraba!”
swahili: Ndipo watu wote wakapiga kelele kwa pamoja, “Mwondoe mtu huyo! Tufungulie Baraba!”

english: (Barabbas had been imprisoned for an insurrection in the city, and for murder.)
ekegusii: (Ere nomonto obegetwe ase echela ase engencho y’eriomana riakoregete ase omochie ime, na ase oboiti.)
swahili: (Baraba alikuwa amefungwa gerezani kwa sababu ya maasi yaliyokuwa yametokea mjini, na kwa ajili ya uuaji.)

english: And they began to accuse Him, saying, “We found this man subverting our nation, forbidding payment of taxes to Caesar, and proclaiming Himself to be Christ, a King.”
ekegusii: Bagachaaka komosoera, bakobora, “Twanyorire omonto oyo oonchoire ense yaito, otokanirie titoa Kaisari ebango, okobora ng’a ere omonyene nere Kristo omorwoti.”
swahili: Nao wakaanza kumshtaki wakisema: “Tumemwona huyu mtu akipotosha taifa letu, akiwazuia watu wasilipe kodi kwa Kaisari na kujiita kuwa yeye ni Kristo, mfalme.”

english: Wanting to release Jesus, Pilate addressed them again,
ekegusii: Nabo eria kabere Pilato agakwana nabarabwo, akarigia gosibora Yeso.
swahili: Pilato, akitaka kumwachia Yesu, akasema nao tena.

english: but they kept shouting, “Crucify Him! Crucify Him!”
ekegusii: Korende barabwo bagaaka eriogi, bakaboora, “Mobambe, mobambe!”
swahili: Lakini wao wakaendelea kupiga kelele wakisema, “Msulubishe! Msulubishe!”

english: A third time he said to them, “What evil has this man done? I have found in Him no offense worthy of death. So after I punish Him, I will release Him.”
ekegusii: Ere akabateebia eria gatato, “Nase ki? Mbobe ki akorete oyo? Tindochi nonya ne ring’ana erimo asare rigwenerete akwe. Ase igo, nanchire komoaka na komosibora.”
swahili: Kwa mara ya tatu, Pilato akawauliza, “Kwani amefanya kosa gani huyu mtu? Sikuona kwake sababu yoyote inayostahili adhabu ya kifo. Kwa hiyo nitaamuru apigwe mijeledi, na kisha nitamwachia.”

english: But they were insistent, demanding with loud voices for Jesus to be crucified. And their clamor prevailed.
ekegusii: Korende bakagenderera kobora ase eriogi rinene ng’a goika abambwe. Eriogi riabo rikabua.
swahili: Lakini watu wakazidi kupiga kelele kwa nguvu zaidi, wakidai kwamba Yesu asulubiwe. Hivyo, kelele zao zikashinda.

english: So Pilate sentenced that their demand be met.
ekegusii: Pilato akanacha amang’ana akoreke buna barigetie.
swahili: Kwa hiyo Pilato akatoa hukumu kwamba madai yao yatimizwe.

english: As they had requested, he released the one imprisoned for insurrection and murder, and handed Jesus over to their will. The Crucifixion (Psalms 22:1–31; Matthew 27:32–44; Mark 15:21–32; John 19:16–27)
ekegusii: Agasibora ere oyobegetwe echela ase eriomana na oboiti, oyobarigetie; akarua Yeso ase bare buna ogwancha kwabo kwarenge. Okobambwa kwa Yeso (Mat 27:32-44; Mar 15:21-32; Yoh 19:17-27)
swahili: Akamfungua yule mtu aliyekuwa amefungwa gerezani kwa kuhusika katika uasi dhidi ya serikali na mauaji. Akamkabidhi Yesu mikononi mwao, wamfanyie watakavyo. Kusulubiwa Kwa Yesu (Mathayo 27:32-44; Marko 15:21-32; Yohana 19:17-27)

english: As the soldiers led Him away, they seized Simon of Cyrene on his way in from the country, and put the cross on him to carry behind Jesus.
ekegusii: Bagachia komoira, bakabwata Simioni Omokurene, oyorenge korwa borabu, bakamotweka omosalaba, ayobogorie magega ya Yeso.
swahili: Walipokuwa wakienda naye, wakamkamata mtu mmoja aitwaye Simoni mwenyeji wa Kirene, aliyekuwa anapita zake kuingia mjini kutoka shambani. Wakambebesha msalaba, wakamlazimisha auchukue nyuma ya Yesu.

english: A great number of people followed Him, including women who kept mourning and wailing for Him.
ekegusii: Omoganda bw’abaanto okamotunyana, na abakungu baare kweaka‐aka, na komweng’erereria.
swahili: Idadi kubwa ya watu wakamfuata Yesu, wakiwamo wanawake waliokuwa wakimlilia na kumwombolezea.

english: But Jesus turned to them and said, “Daughters of Jerusalem, do not weep for Me, but weep for yourselves and for your children.
ekegusii: Yeso akabeonchorera, akabora, “Abaiseke ba Yerusalemu, timondeera inche, korende ereere inwe abanyene, na abana baino.
swahili: Yesu akawageukia, akawaambia, “Enyi binti za Yerusalemu, msinililie mimi bali jililieni ninyi wenyewe na watoto wenu.

english: Look, the days are coming when people will say, ‘Blessed are the barren women, the wombs that never bore, and breasts that never nursed!’
ekegusii: Naki amatuko naache ekero abanto barateebe: Mbasesenirie abare abagomba, ne chinda chitaiboreti, ne chimbeere chitana kogonkwa!
swahili: Kwa maana wakati utafika mtakaposema, ‘Wamebarikiwa wanawake tasa, ambao matumbo yao hayakuzaa, wala matiti yao hayakunyonyesha!’

english: So Pilate asked Him, “Are You the King of the Jews?” “You have said so,” Jesus replied.
ekegusii: Pilato akamobooria, “Naye Omorwoti bw’Abayahudi?” Yeso akaimoiraneria, “Naye gwateebire.”
swahili: Basi Pilato akamuuliza Yesu, “Wewe ndiye mfalme wa Wayahudi?” Yesu akajibu, “Wewe wasema.”

english: At that time ‘they will say to the mountains, “Fall on us!” and to the hills, “Cover us!”’
ekegusii: Erio nabachaake goteebia ebitunwa: Togwere, na ebigoro: Totube.
swahili: Ndipo “ ‘wataiambia milima, “Tuangukieni!” na vilima, “Tufunikeni!” ’

english: For if men do these things while the tree is green, what will happen when it is dry?”
ekegusii: Onye bagokora aya ekero omote ore omobese, naki eraabe ekero bwomire?”
swahili: Kwa maana kama wamefanya hivi kwa mti mbichi, kwa mti mkavu itakuwaje?”

english: Two others, who were criminals, were also led away to be executed with Jesus.
ekegusii: Abande babere abasaria bakairwa, baitwe amo nere.
swahili: Watu wengine wawili wahalifu, walipelekwa pamoja na Yesu ili wakasulubiwe.

english: When they came to the place called The Skull, they crucified Him there, along with the criminals, one on His right and the other on His left.
ekegusii: Bagachia goika aase akorokwa Ekeore, bakamobamba aroro, na baria abasaria, oyomo ensemo y’okoboko gw’okorio, na oyonde ensemo y’okoboko gw’okobee.
swahili: Walipofika mahali paitwapo Fuvu la Kichwa, hapo ndipo walipomsulubisha Yesu pamoja na hao wahalifu, mmoja upande wake wa kuume na mwingine upande wake wa kushoto.

english: Then Jesus said, “Father, forgive them, for they do not know what they are doing.” And they divided up His garments by casting lots.
ekegusii: Yeso akabora, “Tata, baabere, ekiagera tibamanyeti eke bagokora.” Bakagabana chianga chiaye, bagachiakera obomera.
swahili: Yesu akasema, “Baba, wasamehe, kwa maana hawajui walitendalo!” Wakagawana nguo zake kwa kupiga kura.

english: The people stood watching, and the rulers sneered at Him, saying, “He saved others; let Him save Himself if He is the Christ of God, the Chosen One.”
ekegusii: Abanto bagatenena, bakarigereria. Na barabwo abanyene bakamokorera echeche, bakaboora, “Natooretie abande, tiga etoorie ere omonyene, onye oyo nere Kristo o Nyasae, Omochore oye.”
swahili: Watu wakasimama hapo wakimwangalia, nao viongozi wa Wayahudi wakamdhihaki wakisema, “Aliokoa wengine! Ajiokoe mwenyewe basi, kama yeye ndiye Kristo wa Mungu, Mteule wake.”

english: The soldiers also mocked Him and came up to offer Him sour wine.
ekegusii: Abarwani boigo bakamosekereria, bakamochiera, bakamoa chinkama,
swahili: Askari nao wakaja, wakamdhihaki. Wakamletea siki ili anywe,

english: “If You are the King of the Jews,” they said, “save Yourself!”
ekegusii: bakaboora, “Onye aye naye Omorwoti bw’Abayahudi, etoorie.”
swahili: na wakamwambia, “Kama wewe ni Mfalme wa Wayahudi, jiokoe mwenyewe.”

english: Above Him was posted an inscription: THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS.
ekegusii: Igoro asare nkiarengeo ekemanyererio keriikire ase omonwa bw’Ekegiriki, na Ekerumi, na Ekeiberania “OYO NERE OMORWOTI BW’ABAYAHUDI.”
swahili: Kwenye msalaba juu ya kichwa chake, kulikuwa na maandishi haya: Huyu ndiye Mfalme wa Wayahudi. Maandishi haya yalikuwa yameandikwa kwa lugha za Kiyunani, Kilatini na Kiebrania.

english: One of the criminals who hung there heaped abuse on Him. “Are You not the Christ?” he said. “Save Yourself and us!”
ekegusii: Oyomo bwa baria abasaria baabambetwe akamorama, akabora, “Inee! Tari aye Kristo? Etoorie aye omonyene, naintwe ototoorie.”
swahili: Mmoja wa wale wahalifu waliosulubiwa pamoja naye akamtukana, akasema: “Wewe si ndiye Kristo? Jiokoe mwenyewe na utuokoe na sisi.”

english: Then Pilate said to the chief priests and the crowds, “I find no basis for a charge against this man.”
ekegusii: Pilato agateebia abakuani abanene na emeganda, “Inche tindochi komocha konde ase omonto oyo.”
swahili: Pilato akawaambia viongozi wa makuhani na watu wote waliokuwepo, “Sioni sababu ya kutosha kumshtaki mtu huyu!”

english: But the other one rebuked him, saying, “Do you not even fear God, since you are under the same judgment?
ekegusii: Oyo o kabere akamokania, akabora, “Aye tori komoiroka nonya Nyasae, aye kore ase ekiina keria keria?
swahili: Lakini yule mhalifu mwingine akamkemea mwenzake, akasema, “Je, wewe humwogopi Mungu, wakati uko kwenye adhabu iyo hiyo?

english: We are punished justly, for we are receiving what our actions deserve. But this man has done nothing wrong.”
ekegusii: Intwe ekeene mboronge; ekiagera twaeirwe eng’eria ya boronge y’ogokora gwaito, korende oyo takoreti gento kende kebe.”
swahili: Sisi tumehukumiwa kwa haki kwa kuwa tunapata tunayostahili kwa ajili ya matendo yetu. Lakini huyu mtu hajafanya kosa lolote.”

english: Then he said, “Jesus, remember me when You come into Your kingdom!”
ekegusii: Erio agateebia Yeso, “Yeso, ong’inyore ekero ogocha ase oborwoti bwao!”
swahili: Kisha akasema, “Yesu, unikumbuke utakapokuja katika Ufalme wako.”

english: And Jesus said to him, “Truly I tell you, today you will be with Me in Paradise.” The Death of Jesus (Psalms 31:1–24; Matthew 27:45–56; Mark 15:33–41; John 19:28–30)
ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Ekeene nagotebirie: Reero nobe amo nainche Paradiso.” Ogokwa kwa Yeso (Mat 27:45-56; Mar 15:33-41; Yoh 19:28-30)
swahili: Yesu akamjibu, “Amin, nakuambia, leo hii utakuwa pamoja nami Paradiso.” Kifo Cha Yesu (Mathayo 27:45-56; Marko 15:33-41; Yohana 19:28-30)

english: It was now about the sixth hour, and darkness came over all the land until the ninth hour.
ekegusii: Bono nigo chiarenge ang’e chinsa isano nemo, omosunte okaba igoro ase ense yonsi goika chinsa kianda,
swahili: Ilikuwa kama saa sita mchana, nalo giza likafunika nchi yote hadi saa tisa,

english: The sun was darkened, and the veil of the temple was torn down the middle.
ekegusii: ekero omobaso orimire. Na egetambaa gi’okonacha Hekalu kegatandoka gati‐gati.
swahili: kwa sababu jua liliacha kutoa nuru. Pazia la Hekalu likachanika vipande viwili.

english: Then Jesus called out in a loud voice, “Father, into Your hands I commit My Spirit.” And when He had said this, He breathed His last.
ekegusii: Yeso akarera ase eriogi rinene, akabora, “Tata, ase amaboko ao nabekire omoika one!” Magega gakwanire aya agatweka mo.
swahili: Yesu akapaza sauti yake akasema, “Baba, mikononi mwako naikabidhi roho yangu.” Baada ya kusema haya, akakata roho.

english: When the centurion saw what had happened, he gave glory to God, saying, “Surely this was a righteous man. ”
ekegusii: Omotang’ani bw’abarwani rigana agachia korora aya, agatogia Nyasae, akabora, “Ekeene, omonto oyo nigo arenge omonyene oboronge.”
swahili: Yule jemadari alipoona yaliyotukia, akamsifu Mungu, akasema, “Hakika, mtu huyu alikuwa mwenye haki.”

english: And when all the people who had gathered for this spectacle saw what had happened, they returned home beating their breasts.
ekegusii: Naende emeganda yonsi, abasangererekanete korora aya, kobachia korora ayakoreka, bakairana chinka chiabo, bakweaka ebikuba.
swahili: Watu wote waliokuwa wamekusanyika hapo kushuhudia tukio hili walipoyaona hayo, wakapigapiga vifua vyao kwa huzuni na kwenda zao.

english: But all those who knew Jesus, including the women who had followed Him from Galilee, stood at a distance watching these things. The Burial of Jesus (Isaiah 53:9–12; Matthew 27:57–61; Mark 15:42–47; John 19:38–42)
ekegusii: Abasani baye bonsi na abakungu abamotunyanete korwa Galili, bagatenenera are, bakarora ayio. Ogotindekwa kwa Yeso (Mat 27:57-61; Mar 15:42-47; Yoh 19:38-42)
swahili: Lakini wale wote waliomfahamu, pamoja na wale wanawake waliokuwa wamemfuata kutoka Galilaya, walisimama kwa mbali wakiyatazama mambo haya. Maziko Ya Yesu (Mathayo 27:57-61; Marko 15:42-47; Yohana 19:38-42)

english: But they kept insisting, “He stirs up the people all over Judea with His teaching. He began in Galilee and has come all the way here.” Jesus before Herod
ekegusii: Barabwo bakamobetereria, bakaboora, “Oburukanirie abanto, goetera ase amorokererio aye ase Boyahudi yonsi, korwa Galili ase achaakerete na goika bono oikire aiga.” Yeso ase obosio bwa Herode
swahili: Lakini wao wakakazana kusema, “Anawachochea watu kwa mafundisho yake katika Uyahudi yote, tangu Galilaya alikoanzia, hadi sehemu hii!” Yesu Apelekwa Kwa Herode

english: Now there was a Council member named Joseph, a good and righteous man,
ekegusii: Rora, narengeo omonto oyomo, erieta riaye Yusufu, omonto bw’Arimathaya, omochie o Boyahudi, ere nomonto bw’ekegambero kiabo, omonto omuya, naende omooronge.
swahili: Basi kulikuwa na mtu mmoja mwema na mwenye haki, jina lake Yosefu. Yeye alikuwa mjumbe wa Baraza la Wayahudi,

english: who had not consented to their decision or action. He was from the Judean town of Arimathea, and was waiting for the kingdom of God.
ekegusii: Ere tanchete amang’ana abo, nonya nogokora kwabo, nigo aganyete oborwoti bwa Nyasae.
swahili: lakini yeye hakuwa amekubaliana na maamuzi na vitendo vya viongozi wenzake. Huyu alikuwa mwenyeji wa Arimathaya huko Uyahudi, naye alikuwa anaungojea Ufalme wa Mungu kwa matarajio makubwa.

english: He went to Pilate to ask for the body of Jesus.
ekegusii: Omonto oyo agachiera Pilato, akamosaba aegwe omobere o Yeso.
swahili: Yosefu alikwenda kwa Pilato, akaomba apewe mwili wa Yesu.

english: Then he took it down, wrapped it in a linen cloth, and placed it in a tomb cut into the rock, where no one had yet been laid.
ekegusii: Akayoikia, akayoboyia egetambaa ki’egatani, akayobeeka ase oboina bwabaachetwe ase egetare, aase monto onde atana kobekwa.
swahili: Akaushusha kutoka msalabani, akaufunga katika kitambaa cha kitani safi, na kuuweka katika kaburi lililochongwa kwenye mwamba, ambalo halikuwa limezikiwa mtu mwingine bado.

english: It was Preparation Day, and the Sabbath was beginning.
ekegusii: Nigo riarenge rituko ri’Okwearigania, na Esabato egachaaka gosoa.
swahili: Ilikuwa Siku ya Maandalizi, nayo Sabato ilikuwa karibu kuanza.

english: The women who had come with Jesus from Galilee followed, and they saw the tomb and how His body was placed.
ekegusii: Abakungu abaachete amo nere korwa Galili, nigo batunyanete korwa magega, bakarigereria oboina na buna omobere oye bwareretigwe.
swahili: Wale wanawake waliokuwa wamekuja pamoja na Yesu wakimfuata kutoka Galilaya wakamfuata Yosefu, wakaliona kaburi na jinsi mwili wa Yesu ulivyolazwa.

english: Then they returned to prepare spices and perfumes. And they rested on the Sabbath, according to the commandment.
ekegusii: Bakairana, bakaroisia amanukato na amaguta ye rimisu rigiya. Ne rituko ri’Esabato bagatimoka buna yachiigetwe.
swahili: Kisha wakarudi nyumbani, wakaandaa manukato na marhamu ya kuupaka huo mwili. Lakini wakapumzika siku ya Sabato kama ilivyoamriwa.

english: When Pilate heard this, he asked if the man was a Galilean.
ekegusii: Pilato agachia koigwa ring’ana eri, akaboria, “Omonto oyo n’Omogalili?”
swahili: Pilato aliposikia hayo akauliza, “Huyu mtu ni Mgalilaya?”

english: And learning that Jesus was under Herod’s jurisdiction, he sent Him to Herod, who himself was in Jerusalem at that time.
ekegusii: Agachia komanya ng’a nigo are inse ase obogambi bwa Herode, akamotoma gochia ase Herode. Na Herode omonyene nigo arenge Yerusalemu ase amatuko aria.
swahili: Alipofahamu kwamba Yesu alikuwa chini ya mamlaka ya Herode, akampeleka kwa Herode, ambaye wakati huo alikuwa pia Yerusalemu.

english: When Herod saw Jesus, he was greatly pleased. He had wanted to see Him for a long time, because he had heard about Him and was hoping to see Him perform a miracle.
ekegusii: Ekero Herode achia korora Yeso akagokigwa mono, ekiagera korwa kare nigo arigetie komoorora, ekiagera aigwete chinkuma chiaye, naende nigo asemeretie korora egekone kegokorwa nere.
swahili: Herode alipomwona Yesu alifurahi sana, kwa sababu kwa muda mrefu alikuwa amesikia mambo mengi kumhusu yeye. Pia alitarajia kumwona akifanya miujiza kadha wa kadha.

english: Herod questioned Jesus at great length, but He gave no answer.
ekegusii: Akamoboria amaborio ase engaki entambe, korende Yeso tamoiraneria ing’ana rinde rionsi.
swahili: Herode akamuuliza maswali mengi, lakini Yesu hakumjibu lolote.

english: On the first day of the week, very early in the morning, the women came to the tomb, bringing the spices they had prepared.
ekegusii: Korende rituko rie ritang’ani ri’echuma, kobogokiamoka, abakungu baria bakagenda ase oboina, bakaira amanukato aria, ayababegete ang’e.
swahili: Mnamo siku ya kwanza ya juma, alfajiri na mapema, wale wanawake walichukua yale manukato waliyokuwa wameyaandaa, wakaenda kaburini.

english: It was Mary Magdalene, Joanna, Mary the mother of James, and the other women with them who told this to the apostles.
ekegusii: Na baria bateebetie abatomwa amang’ana aya nabwo aba: Mariamu Magidalena, na Yoana, na Mariamu ng’ina Yakobo na abakungu bande abarenge amo nabarabwo.
swahili: Basi Maria Magdalene, Yoana, na Maria mama yake Yakobo, pamoja na wanawake wengine waliofuatana nao ndio waliwaelezea mitume habari hizi.

english: But their words seemed like nonsense to them, and they did not believe the women.
ekegusii: Amang’ana abo akarorekana koba ng’a naya bosa ase bare, gose tibayancha. [
swahili: Lakini hawakuwasadiki hao wanawake, kwa sababu maneno yao yalionekana kama upuzi.

english: Peter, however, got up and ran to the tomb. And after bending down and seeing only the linen cloths, he went away, wondering to himself what had happened. The Road to Emmaus (Mark 16:12–13)
ekegusii: Korende Petero akaimoka, akagenda bwango ase oboina, agatung’ama, akarigereria ime, akarora ebitambaa biria bireo bioka, akairana bwoye, okumetie ase aya akorekire.] Yeso okororekana ase enchera ekogenda Emau (Mar 16:12-13)
swahili: Hata hivyo, Petro akainuka na kukimbia kwenda kule kaburini. Alipoinama kuchungulia, akaona vile vitambaa vya kitani, ila hakuona kitu kingine. Naye akaenda zake akijiuliza nini kilichotokea. Njiani Kwenda Emau (Marko 16:12-13)

english: That same day two of them were going to a village called Emmaus, about seven miles from Jerusalem.
ekegusii: Rituko riria babere ase bare nkogenda baare ase omochie okorokwa Emau, orenge oboare korwa Yerusalemu ang’e chimaeli isano na isato.
swahili: Ikawa siku iyo hiyo, wanafunzi wawili wa Yesu walikuwa njiani wakienda kijiji kilichoitwa Emau, yapata maili saba kutoka Yerusalemu.

english: They were talking with each other about everything that had happened.
ekegusii: Na barabwo ngokwana baare barabwo ase barabwo igoro ase aya onsi akorekire.
swahili: Walikuwa wakizungumza wao kwa wao kuhusu mambo yote yaliyotukia.

english: And as they talked and deliberated, Jesus Himself came up and walked along with them.
ekegusii: Kabagokwana na koborania, Yeso omonyene agaika ang’e, akagenda amo nabarabwo.
swahili: Walipokuwa wakizungumza na kujadiliana, Yesu mwenyewe akaja akatembea pamoja nao,

english: But their eyes were kept from recognizing Him.
ekegusii: Amaiso abo agatubwa, tibanyara komomanya.
swahili: lakini macho yao yakazuiliwa ili wasimtambue.

english: He asked them, “What are you discussing so intently as you walk along?” They stood still, with sadness on their faces.
ekegusii: Akababoria, “Mang’ana ki aya mokoborania ase orogendo rwaino?” Bagatenena, baichanete.
swahili: Akawauliza, “Ni mambo gani haya mnayozungumza wakati mnatembea?” Wakasimama, nyuso zao zikionyesha huzuni.

english: One of them, named Cleopas, asked Him, “Are You the only visitor to Jerusalem who does not know the things that have happened there in recent days?”
ekegusii: Oyomo obo, erieta riaye Kiliopa, akamoiraneria, “Inee! Naye bweka ore omogeni ase Yerusalemu, otamanyeti ayare ime yaye amatuko aya?”
swahili: Mmoja wao, aliyeitwa Kleopa, akamuuliza, “Je, wewe ndiye peke yako mgeni huku Yerusalemu ambaye hufahamu mambo yaliyotukia humo siku hizi?”

english: “What things?” He asked. “The events involving Jesus of Nazareth,” they answered. “This man was a prophet, powerful in speech and action before God and all the people.
ekegusii: Akababoria, “Mang’ana ki?” Bakamoteebia, “Amang’ana a Yeso Omonazareti, oyorenge omobani, omonyene chinguru ase ogokora na ase ring’ana, ase obosio bwa Nyasae, na ase abanto bonsi;
swahili: Akawauliza, “Mambo gani?” Wakamjibu, “Mambo ya Yesu wa Nazareti. Yeye alikuwa nabii, mwenye uwezo mkuu katika maneno yake na matendo yake, mbele za Mungu na mbele ya wanadamu wote.

english: They found the stone rolled away from the tomb,
ekegusii: Bakanyoora rigena riria riatigerigwe korwa ase oboina,
swahili: Wakakuta lile jiwe limevingirishwa kutoka kwenye kaburi,

english: Our chief priests and rulers delivered Him up to the sentence of death, and they crucified Him.
ekegusii: na buna abakuani abanene na abanene baito bamoruete ase ekiina ki’ogokwa, bakamobaamba.
swahili: Viongozi wa makuhani na viongozi wetu walimtoa ahukumiwe kufa, nao wakamsulubisha.

english: But we were hoping He was the One who would redeem Israel. And besides all this, it is the third day since these things took place.
ekegusii: Korende intwe nigo twasemeretie ng’a nere oraboorie Abaisraeli. Kobua aya onsi, reero nerituko ria gatato korwa ekero ayio akorekanete.
swahili: Lakini tulikuwa tumetegemea kwamba yeye ndiye angelikomboa Israeli. Zaidi ya hayo, leo ni siku ya tatu tangu mambo haya yatokee.

english: Furthermore, some of our women astounded us. They were at the tomb early this morning,
ekegusii: Naende abakungu bande ba seito nigo batoichanetie. Abwo barenge ase oboina mambia,
swahili: Isitoshe, baadhi ya wanawake katika kundi letu wametushtusha. Walikwenda kaburini leo alfajiri,

english: but they did not find His body. They came and told us they had seen a vision of angels, who said that Jesus was alive.
ekegusii: na ekero batanyorete omobere oye, bakairana, bakaboora ng’a baorokeirwe nabamalaika ababatebetie ng’a moyo are.
swahili: lakini hawakuukuta mwili wake. Walirudi wakasema wameona maono ya malaika ambao waliwaambia kwamba Yesu yu hai.

english: Then some of our companions went to the tomb and found it just as the women had described. But Him they did not see.”
ekegusii: Naende abande abarenge amo naintwe bakagenda ase oboina, bakarora buna abakungu bateebete, korende ere tibamorora.”
swahili: Kisha baadhi ya wenzetu walikwenda kaburini wakalikuta kama vile wale wanawake walivyokuwa wamesema, lakini yeye hawakumwona.”

english: Then Jesus said to them, “O foolish ones, how slow are your hearts to believe all that the prophets have spoken!
ekegusii: Ere akabateebia, “Inwe abanto abariri, nabanyene chinkoro chinyoro ase okwegena onsi aya ababani bateebete.
swahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Ninyi ni wajinga kiasi gani, nanyi ni wazito mioyoni mwenu kuamini mambo yote yaliyonenwa na manabii!

english: Was it not necessary for the Christ to suffer these things and then to enter His glory?”
ekegusii: Inee! Tiyamogwenerete Kristo konyora emechando eye ritang’ani atarasoa ase obonene bwaye?”
swahili: Je, haikumpasa Kristo kuteswa kwa njia hiyo na kisha aingie katika utukufu wake?”

english: And beginning with Moses and all the Prophets, He explained to them what was written in all the Scriptures about Himself.
ekegusii: Agachaakera korwa Musa na ababani bonsi akabateebereria korwa ase amariiko onsi amang’ana ariikire igoro yaye.
swahili: Naye akianzia na Sheria ya Mose na Manabii wote, akawafafanulia jinsi Maandiko yalivyosema kumhusu yeye.

english: As they approached the village where they were headed, He seemed to be going farther.
ekegusii: Bagaika omochie oria ase baare kogenda, na ere agekora buna nigo arigetie kobaetania.
swahili: Nao walipokaribia kile kijiji walichokuwa wakienda, Yesu akawa kama anaendelea mbele.

english: But they pleaded with Him, “Stay with us, for it is nearly evening and the day is almost over.” So He went in to stay with them.
ekegusii: Bakamosorora, bakaboora, “Kabe amo naintwe, ekiagera bwairire, na omobaso oerire bono.” Agasoa koba amo nabarabwo.
swahili: Lakini wao wakamsihi sana akae nao, wakisema, “Kaa hapa nasi, kwa maana sasa ni jioni na usiku unaingia.” Basi akaingia ndani kukaa nao.

english: but when they entered, they did not find the body of the Lord Jesus.
ekegusii: korende ekero basoa, tibanyoora omobere Omonene Yeso.
swahili: lakini walipoingia ndani, hawakuuona mwili wa Bwana Yesu.

english: While He was reclining at the table with them, He took bread, spoke a blessing and broke it, and gave it to them.
ekegusii: Ekero aikaransire amo nabarabwo koragera, akabogoria omogati, akayosesenia, akayosamunyora, akabaa.
swahili: Alipokuwa mezani pamoja nao, akachukua mkate, akashukuru, akaumega, akaanza kuwagawia.

english: Then their eyes were opened and they recognized Jesus—and He disappeared from their sight.
ekegusii: Erio amaiso abo akaramokigwa, bakamomanya; na agwo kegima agasira, tarorekana ase bare.
swahili: Ndipo macho yao yakafumbuliwa, nao wakamtambua, naye akatoweka machoni pao. Hawakumwona tena.

english: They asked each other, “Were not our hearts burning within us as He spoke with us on the road and opened the Scriptures to us?”
ekegusii: Bakaboorania, “Inee! Emioyo yaito tiyarenge gwoka ekero aba ngokwana are naintwe inchera na gotworokereria amariiko?”
swahili: Wakaulizana wao kwa wao, “Je, mioyo yetu haikuwakawaka kwa furaha ndani yetu alipokuwa anazungumza nasi njiani na kutufafanulia Maandiko?”

english: And they got up that very hour and returned to Jerusalem. There they found the Eleven and those with them, gathered together
ekegusii: Bakaimoka ensa eria eria, bakairana Yerusalemu, bakanyoora baria ikomi nomo basangererekanete, na baria abarenge amo nabarabwo,
swahili: Wakaondoka mara, wakarudi Yerusalemu. Wakawakuta wale wanafunzi kumi na mmoja na wale waliokuwa pamoja nao, wamekusanyika

english: and saying, “The Lord has indeed risen and has appeared to Simon!”
ekegusii: bakaboora, “Ekeene, Omonene obokire, oorokeire Simioni.”
swahili: wakisema, “Ni kweli! Bwana amefufuka, naye amemtokea Simoni.”

english: Then the two told what had happened on the road, and how they had recognized Jesus in the breaking of the bread. Jesus Appears to the Disciples (John 20:19–23; 1 John 1:1–4)
ekegusii: Na barabwo bakabateebia aya akoreka inchera, buna emanyekania ase bare ase ogosamunyora omogati. Yeso okoorokera abatomwa (Mat 28:16-20; Mar 16:14-18; Yoh 20:19-23)
swahili: Kisha wale wanafunzi wawili wakaeleza yaliyotukia njiani na jinsi walivyomtambua Yesu alipoumega mkate. Yesu Awatokea Wanafunzi Wake (Mathayo 28:16-20; Marko 16:14-18; Yohana 20:19-23; Matendo 1:6-8)

english: While they were describing these events, Jesus Himself stood among them and said, “Peace be with you.”
ekegusii: Ekero baare gokwana iga, Yeso omonyene agatenena egati yabo, akabateebia, “Omorembe obe ase more!”
swahili: Walipokuwa bado wanazungumza hayo, Yesu mwenyewe akasimama katikati yao, akasema, “Amani iwe nanyi!”

english: But they were startled and frightened, thinking they had seen a spirit.
ekegusii: Bakegosa, bagasogwa nomoondoko, bagakaga ng’a nerirengari barorire.
swahili: Wakashtuka na kuogopa wakidhani kwamba wameona mzuka.

english: “Why are you troubled,” Jesus asked, “and why do doubts arise in your hearts?
ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Inaki mogoichana? Naende inaki ogosiereria kwaimokire ase chinkoro chiaino?
swahili: Lakini Yesu akawauliza, “Kwa nini mnaogopa? Kwa nini mna shaka mioyoni mwenu?

english: Look at My hands and My feet. It is I Myself. Touch Me and see—for a spirit does not have flesh and bones, as you see I have.”
ekegusii: Rora amaboko aane na amagoro aane, ng’a ninche omonyene; mbwata‐bwate, morore, ekiagera rirengari tiriri nomobere na amauga buna mondoche inche inde nabio.”
swahili: Tazameni mikono yangu na miguu yangu, mwone kuwa ni mimi hasa. Niguseni mwone; kwa maana mzuka hauna nyama na mifupa, kama mnionavyo kuwa navyo.”

english: While they were puzzling over this, suddenly two men in radiant apparel stood beside them.
ekegusii: Ekero baichanete ase aya, rora, abanto babere bagatenena ang’e ase bare, beboyetie chianga chikomeka‐meka.
swahili: Walipokuwa wanashangaa juu ya jambo hili, ghafula watu wawili waliokuwa wamevaa mavazi yanayongʼaa kama umeme wakasimama karibu nao.

english: And when He had said this, He showed them His hands and feet.
ekegusii: Ekero akoorire gokwana aya akaborokia amaboko aye na amagoro aye.
swahili: Aliposema haya, akawaonyesha mikono na miguu yake.

english: While they were still in disbelief because of their joy and amazement, He asked them, “Do you have anything here to eat?”
ekegusii: Ekero bataregena ase engencho y’omogooko, na ogokumia, akababoria, “More na gento mokoria aa?”
swahili: Wakashindwa kuamini kwa ajili ya furaha na mshangao waliokuwa nao. Akawauliza, “Mna chakula chochote hapa?”

english: So they gave Him a piece of broiled fish,
ekegusii: Bakamoa egesamunye gi’enswe gesambire na obooke boke.
swahili: Wakampa kipande cha samaki aliyeokwa,

english: and He took it and ate it in front of them.
ekegusii: Akabibogoria, akabiria ase amaiso abo.
swahili: naye akakichukua na kukila mbele yao.

english: Jesus said to them, “These are the words I spoke to you while I was still with you: Everything must be fulfilled that is written about Me in the Law of Moses, the Prophets, and the Psalms.”
ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Aya naro amang’ana aane nare kona‐kobateebia ekero narenge amo nainwe, buna onsi agwenerete goikeranigwa, ayarigetwe igoro yane ase amachiiko a Musa, na ase ababani, na ase Zaburi.”
swahili: Akawaambia, “Haya ndiyo yale niliyowaambia nilipokuwa bado niko pamoja nanyi, kwamba yote yaliyoandikwa kunihusu mimi katika Sheria ya Mose, Manabii na Zaburi hayana budi kutimizwa.”

english: Then He opened their minds to understand the Scriptures.
ekegusii: Erio akaigora chinkoro chiabo, banyare komanya amariiko.
swahili: Ndipo akafungua fahamu zao ili waweze kuyaelewa Maandiko.

english: And He told them, “This is what is written: The Christ will suffer and rise from the dead on the third day,
ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Naboigo yarigetwe ng’a nemogwenerete Kristo gochandwa, na koboka korwa ase abakuure ase rituko ria gatato;
swahili: Akawaambia, “Haya ndiyo yaliyoandikwa: Kristo atateswa na siku ya tatu atafufuka kutoka kwa wafu.

english: and in His name repentance and forgiveness of sins will be proclaimed to all nations, beginning in Jerusalem.
ekegusii: na ebisaku bionsi mbiranderigwe ase erieta riaye okoonchoka na okorusigwa kw’ebibe, gochaakera Yerusalemu.
swahili: Toba na msamaha wa dhambi zitatangaziwa mataifa yote kupitia jina lake kuanzia Yerusalemu.

english: You are witnesses of these things.
ekegusii: Inwe mbirori b’amang’ana aya.
swahili: Ninyi ni mashahidi wa mambo haya. Kuahidiwa Kwa Roho Mtakatifu

english: And behold, I am sending the promise of My Father upon you. But remain in the city until you have been clothed with power from on high.” The Ascension (Mark 16:19–20; Acts 1:6–11)
ekegusii: Rigereria, nintome ase more aya Tata abarierete eira, korende ikaransa ase omochie oyo Yerusalemu goika mobekwe chinguru chikorwa igoro.” Yeso okogenda igoro (Mar 16:19-20)
swahili: “Tazama nitawatumia ahadi ya Baba yangu; lakini kaeni humu mjini hadi mtakapovikwa uwezo utokao juu.” Kupaa Kwa Yesu Mbinguni (Marko 16:19-20; Matendo 1:9-11)

english: As the women bowed their faces to the ground in terror, the two men asked them, “Why do you look for the living among the dead?
ekegusii: Abakungu baria bagasogwa nomoondoko, bagatung’ama inse. Abanto baria bakabateebia, “Nase ki mokorigia oyore moyo ase ebitondo? [Tari aa, korende obokire.]
swahili: Wale wanawake, wakiwa na hofu, wakainamisha nyuso zao mpaka chini. Lakini wale watu wakawaambia, “Kwa nini mnamtafuta aliye hai miongoni mwa wafu?

english: When Jesus had led them out as far as Bethany, He lifted up His hands and blessed them.
ekegusii: Akabatang’ana gochia isiko goika Bethania; akaimokia amaboko aye, akabasesenia.
swahili: Akiisha kuwaongoza mpaka kwenye viunga vya Bethania, akainua mikono yake juu na kuwabariki.

english: While He was blessing them, He left them and was carried up into heaven.
ekegusii: Kabasesenirie ageatanana korwa ase bare akabogorigwa gochia igoro.
swahili: Alipokuwa anawabariki, akawaacha, akachukuliwa mbinguni.

english: And they worshiped Him and returned to Jerusalem with great joy,
ekegusii: Na barabwo bakamosasiima, bakairana Yerusalemu nomogooko omonene;
swahili: Kisha wakamwabudu na kurudi Yerusalemu wakiwa wamejawa na furaha kuu.

english: praising God continually in the temple.
ekegusii: bakaba botambe ime ase Hekalu, bakomotogia Nyasae.
swahili: Nao wakadumu ndani ya Hekalu wakimtukuza Mungu. Amen.

english: He is not here; He has risen! Remember how He told you while He was still in Galilee:
ekegusii: Inyora buna abatebeetie ekero arenge Galili,
swahili: Hayuko hapa; amefufuka! Kumbukeni alivyowaambia alipokuwa bado yuko pamoja nanyi huko Galilaya kwamba:

english: ‘The Son of Man must be delivered into the hands of sinful men, and be crucified, and on the third day rise again.’”
ekegusii: ng’a nemogwenerete Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto abekwe ase amaboko y’abanto abanyene ebibe, na kobambwa, na ase rituko ria gatato nabooke.”
swahili: ‘Ilikuwa lazima Mwana wa Adamu atiwe mikononi mwa watu wenye dhambi na waovu ili asulubiwe, na siku ya tatu afufuke.’ ”

english: Then they remembered His words.
ekegusii: Bakainyora amang’ana aye.
swahili: Ndipo wakayakumbuka maneno ya Yesu.

english: And when they returned from the tomb, they reported all these things to the Eleven and to all the others.
ekegusii: Bakairana korwa ase oboina, bagateebia baria ikomi nomo na baria abande bonsi amang’ana ayio onsi.
swahili: Waliporudi kutoka huko kaburini, wakawaeleza wale wanafunzi kumi na mmoja pamoja na wengine wote mambo haya yote.

english: Now in those days a decree went out from Caesar Augustus that a census should be taken of the whole empire.
ekegusii: Ase amatuko aria, ogochika gokarua ase Kaisari Augusto, ng’a omobaro bw’abaanto oriikwe ase ense yonsi.
swahili: Siku zile Kaisari Augusto alitoa amri kwamba watu wote waandikishwe katika ulimwengu wa Kirumi.

english: But the angel said to them, “Do not be afraid! For behold, I bring you good news of great joy that will be for all the people:
ekegusii: Omomalaika akabateebia, “Timoiroka, ekiagera nabarenteire amang’ana amaya ay’omogooko omonene, oraabe ase abanto bonsi,
swahili: Lakini malaika akawaambia: “Msiogope. Kwa maana tazama nawaletea habari njema za furaha itakayokuwa kwa watu wote.

english: Today in the city of David a Savior has been born to you. He is Christ the Lord!
ekegusii: naki reero ase Omochie o Daudi oiboirwe Omotooria ase engencho yaino, nere Kristo Omonene.
swahili: Leo katika mji wa Daudi kwa ajili yenu amezaliwa Mwokozi, ndiye Kristo Bwana.

english: And this will be a sign to you: You will find a baby wrapped in swaddling cloths and lying in a manger.”
ekegusii: Na eke nekemanyererio ase more: Namonyore omwana ekeng’werere obekeire chianga chi’obwana, bwareirie ase orotuba.”
swahili: Hii ndiyo itakayokuwa ishara kwenu: Mtamkuta mtoto mchanga amefunikwa nguo za kitoto na kulazwa katika hori ya kulia ngʼombe.”

english: And suddenly there appeared with the angel a great multitude of the heavenly host, praising God and saying:
ekegusii: Bwango igo mbarengeo amo nomomalaika oria omoganda o igoro, bagotogia Nyasae, bakoboora,
swahili: Ghafula pakawa na jeshi kubwa la mbinguni pamoja na huyo malaika wakimsifu Mungu wakisema,

english: “Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace to men on whom His favor rests!”
ekegusii: “Obonene ase Nyasae ore Igoro Mono, na ase ense omorembe, ase abanto abwo bancheirwe nere.”
swahili: “Atukuzwe Mungu juu mbinguni, na duniani iwe amani kwa watu aliowaridhia.”

english: When the angels had left them and gone into heaven, the shepherds said to one another, “Let us go to Bethlehem and see this thing that has happened, which the Lord has made known to us.”
