ekegusii: Ekero abamalaika abwo bachia koimoka kogenda igoro, abarisia baria bagateebania, “Gaki togende goika Bethlehemu, torore ring’ana eri riakorekire, eri Omonene atomanyirie.”
swahili: Hao malaika walipokwisha kuondoka na kwenda zao mbinguni, wale wachungaji wakasemezana wao kwa wao, “Twendeni Bethlehemu tukaone mambo haya ya ajabu yaliyotukia, ambayo Bwana ametuambia habari zake.”

english: So they hurried off and found Mary and Joseph and the Baby, who was lying in the manger.
ekegusii: Bakagenda nomoayerero, bakanyora Mariamu na Yusufu, na omwana oria ekeng’werere bwareirie ase orotuba.
swahili: Hivyo wakaenda haraka Bethlehemu, wakawakuta Maria na Yosefu na yule mtoto mchanga akiwa amelala katika hori la kulia ngʼombe.

english: After they had seen the Child, they spread the message they had received about Him.
ekegusii: Bagachia komorora, bakaorokia ring’ana bateebetigwe igoro y’omwana oyio.
swahili: Walipomwona yule mtoto, wakawaeleza yale waliyokuwa wameambiwa kuhusu huyo mtoto.

english: And all who heard it were amazed at what the shepherds said to them.
ekegusii: Bonsi abaigwete bagakumia ase aria bateebetigwe nabarisia.
swahili: Nao wote waliosikia habari hizi wakastaajabia yale waliyoambiwa na wale wachungaji wa kondoo.

english: But Mary treasured up all these things and pondered them in her heart.
ekegusii: Korende Mariamu akagacha amang’ana aya onsi, okoyarengereria ase enkoro yaye.
swahili: Lakini Maria akayaweka mambo haya yote moyoni mwake na kuyatafakari.

english: This was the first census to take place while Quirinius was governor of Syria.
ekegusii: Oyo noro orenge omobaro bw’eritang’ani oriigetwe ekero Kurenio arenge gabana o Siiria.
swahili: (Orodha hii ndiyo ya kwanza iliyofanyika wakati Krenio alikuwa mtawala wa Shamu ).

english: The shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all they had heard and seen, which was just as the angel had told them. Jesus Presented at the Temple
ekegusii: Abarisia bakairana, bagotogia Nyasae na komobaka ase amang’ana onsi baigwete, na ayabaroche, buna bateebetigwe. Yeso Okorokwa Erieta
swahili: Wale wachungaji wakarudi, huku wakimtukuza Mungu na kumsifu kwa ajili ya mambo yote waliyokuwa wameambiwa na kuyaona.

english: When the eight days until His circumcision had passed, He was named Jesus, the name the angel had given Him before He had been conceived.
ekegusii: Rigachia goika rituko ria gatano na gatato, rituko ri’okomwarokia, akarokwa erieta riaye Yeso, riria riatoretwe nomomalaika ritang’ani atarabogorigwa oborito. Okoirwa kwa Yeso ase Hekalu
swahili: Hata zilipotimia siku nane, ulikuwa ndio wakati wa kumtahiri mtoto, akaitwa Yesu, jina alilokuwa amepewa na malaika kabla hajatungwa mimba. Yesu Apelekwa Hekaluni

english: And when the time of purification according to the Law of Moses was complete, His parents brought Him to Jerusalem to present Him to the Lord
ekegusii: Na ekero amatuko ogwesibia kwabo achia goika, ayachikiire ase amachiiko a Musa, bakamoira Yerusalemu, bamobeke ase Omonene
swahili: Ulipotimia wakati wa utakaso wake Maria kwa mujibu wa Sheria ya Mose, basi Yosefu na Maria walimpeleka mtoto Yerusalemu, ili kumweka wakfu kwa Bwana

english: (as it is written in the Law of the Lord: “Every firstborn male shall be consecrated to the Lord” ),
ekegusii: (buna ariikire ase amachiiko y’Omonene, “Kera omoisia omotangi okoigora enda ya ng’ina narokwe omochenu ase Omonene”),
swahili: (kama ilivyoandikwa katika Sheria ya Bwana, kwamba, “Kila mtoto wa kiume kifungua mimba atawekwa wakfu kwa Bwana”),

english: and to offer the sacrifice specified in the Law of the Lord: “A pair of turtledoves or two young pigeons.” The Prophecy of Simeon
ekegusii: barue ekeng’wanso buna ariikire ase amachiiko o Omonene, “Amaruma abere, gose amage ’amaruma abere.”
swahili: na pia kutoa dhabihu kulingana na yale yaliyonenwa katika Sheria ya Bwana: “Hua wawili au makinda mawili ya njiwa.”

english: Now there was a man in Jerusalem named Simeon, who was righteous and devout. He was waiting for the consolation of Israel, and the Holy Spirit was upon him.
ekegusii: Rora narengeo omonto Yerusalemu, erieta riaye Simioni. Oyio nigo arenge omonto omooronge, na nigo asigete Nyasae, ere nigo aganyete ogosemeria kw’Abaisraeli; na Omoika Omochenu nigo orenge igoro asare.
swahili: Basi alikuwako huko Yerusalemu mtu mmoja jina lake Simeoni, ambaye alikuwa mwenye haki na mcha Mungu, akitarajia faraja ya Israeli, na Roho Mtakatifu alikuwa juu yake.

english: The Holy Spirit had revealed to him that he would not see death before he had seen the Lord’s Christ.
ekegusii: Ere nigo aorokereretigwe n’Omoika Omochenu, ng’a takorora amakweri atararora Kristo Omonene.
swahili: Roho Mtakatifu alikuwa amemfunulia kuwa hatakufa kabla hajamwona Kristo wa Bwana.

english: Led by the Spirit, he went into the temple courts. And when the parents brought in the child Jesus to do for Him what was customary under the Law,
ekegusii: Nabo akaraagwa n’Omoika gocha ase Hekalu ime; na ekero abaibori bachia korenta omwana Yeso, bamokorere buna yarenge engencho y’amachiiko,
swahili: Simeoni, akiwa ameongozwa na Roho Mtakatifu, alikwenda Hekaluni. Wazazi walipomleta mtoto Yesu ili kumfanyia kama ilivyokuwa desturi ya Sheria,

english: Simeon took Him in his arms and blessed God, saying:
ekegusii: Simioni akamonyora, akamoagata ase amaboko aye, agatogia Nyasae, akabora,
swahili: ndipo Simeoni akampokea mtoto mikononi mwake na kumsifu Mungu, akisema:

english: “Sovereign Lord, as You have promised, You now dismiss Your servant in peace.
ekegusii: “Omonene, bono otige omosomba oo agende nomorembe, koreng’ana nering’ana riao.
swahili: “Bwana Mwenyezi, kama ulivyoahidi, sasa wamruhusu mtumishi wako aende zake kwa amani.

english: And everyone went to his own town to register.
ekegusii: Abanto bonsi bakagenda koriikwa, kera omonto ase omochie oye.
swahili: Kila mtu alikwenda kuandikishwa katika mji wake alikozaliwa.

english: For my eyes have seen Your salvation,
ekegusii: Ekiagera amaiso aane arorire ogotooreka kwao,
swahili: Kwa maana macho yangu yameuona wokovu wako,

english: which You have prepared in the sight of all people,
ekegusii: oko kwabekire ase amaiso y’abanto bonsi,
swahili: ulioweka tayari machoni pa watu wote,

english: a light for revelation to the Gentiles, and for glory to Your people Israel.”
ekegusii: omobaso okomorekera abanto b’Ebisaku, na obonene bw’abaanto bao Abaisraeli.”
swahili: nuru kwa ajili ya ufunuo kwa watu wa Mataifa na kwa ajili ya utukufu kwa watu wako Israeli.”

english: The Child’s father and mother were amazed at what was spoken about Him.
ekegusii: Ise na ng’ina bagakumia ase aria akwanwa igoro asare.
swahili: Naye Yosefu na mama yake mtoto wakastaajabu kwa yale yaliyokuwa yamesemwa kumhusu huyo mtoto.

english: Then Simeon blessed them and said to His mother Mary: “Behold, this Child is appointed to cause the rise and fall of many in Israel, and to be a sign that will be spoken against,
ekegusii: Simioni akabasesenia, agateebia Mariamu ng’ina, “Rora, Omwana oyo otenenigwe ase ogosira na ogotoreka ase abange b’Abaisraeli, abe ekiorokererio kerabe kegokwanwa mamincha,
swahili: Kisha Simeoni akawabariki, akamwambia Maria mama yake, “Mtoto huyu amewekwa kwa makusudi ya kuanguka na kuinuka kwa wengi katika Israeli. Atakuwa ishara ambayo watu watanena dhidi yake,

english: so that the thoughts of many hearts will be revealed— and a sword will pierce your soul as well.” The Prophecy of Anna
ekegusii: erinde ebirengererio bie chinkoro chinyinge biorokigwe. Boigo omoro nokobete omoyo oo.”
swahili: ili mawazo ya mioyo mingi yadhihirike. Nao upanga utauchoma moyo wako.”

english: There was also a prophetess named Anna, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Asher, who was well along in years. She had been married for seven years,
ekegusii: Narengeo omokungu omobani, Anna, omoiseke o Fanueli, bw’egesaku ki’Asheri. Ere nomong’ina bw’amatuko amange, obete nomosaacha oye emiaka etano na ebere magega y’okoera kw’oboiseke bwaye.
swahili: Tena alikuwako Hekaluni nabii mmoja mwanamke, jina lake Ana binti Fanueli, wa kabila la Asheri. Alikuwa mzee sana; naye alikuwa ameolewa na kuishi na mume kwa miaka saba tu, kisha mumewe akafa.

english: and then was a widow to the age of eighty-four. She never left the temple, but worshiped night and day, fasting and praying.
ekegusii: Ere agatigara ore omoboraka goika emiaka emerongo etano etato na ene (84), atana korua ase Hekalu ime, korende akaba okweng’ata, na ogosaba, na ogosasiima obotuko na omobaso.
swahili: Hivyo alikuwa mjane na umri wake ulikuwa miaka themanini na minne. Yeye hakuondoka humo Hekaluni usiku wala mchana, bali alikuwa akimwabudu Mungu, akifunga na kuomba.

english: Coming forward at that moment, she gave thanks to God and spoke about the Child to all who were waiting for the redemption of Jerusalem. The Return to Nazareth (Matthew 2:19–23)
ekegusii: Ase ekero keria ere akaoroka, agatogia Nyasae, agateebia abanto bonsi abarenge baganyete okoboorigwa kwa Yerusalemu amang’ana igoro y’Omwana oria. Koirana gochia Nazareti
swahili: Wakati huo huo, Ana alikuja akaanza kusifu, akimshukuru Mungu na kusema habari za huyo mtoto kwa watu wote waliokuwa wakitarajia ukombozi wa Yerusalemu.

english: When Jesus’ parents had done everything required by the Law of the Lord, they returned to Galilee, to their own town of Nazareth.
ekegusii: Barabwo bagachia gokoora goikerania onsi koreng’ana namachiiko Omonene, bakairana Galili goika omochie obo Nazareti.
swahili: Yosefu na Maria walipokuwa wamekamilisha mambo yote yaliyotakiwa na Sheria ya Bwana, walirudi mjini kwao Nazareti huko Galilaya.

english: So Joseph also went up from Nazareth in Galilee to Judea, to the city of David called Bethlehem, since he was from the house and line of David.
ekegusii: Na Yusufu nere akaimoka korwa Galili korwa ase omochie o Nazareti, agatiira kogenda Boyahudi, goika Omochie o Daudi, okorokwa Bethlehemu, ekiagera nigo arenge oyo bw’enyomba na eamate ya Daudi,
swahili: Hivyo Yosefu akapanda kutoka mji wa Nazareti ulioko Galilaya kwenda Uyahudi, mpaka Bethlehemu, mji wa Daudi, kwa sababu yeye alikuwa wa ukoo na wa nyumba ya Daudi.

english: And the Child grew and became strong. He was filled with wisdom, and the grace of God was upon Him. The Boy Jesus at the Temple
ekegusii: Omwana oria agakiina, akamenteka chinguru, agaichorwa nobong’aini ne chisemi; na akanyora ogwancherwa ase Nyasae. Omwana Yeso ase Hekalu
swahili: Naye yule mtoto akakua na kuongezeka nguvu, akiwa amejaa hekima, na neema ya Mungu ilikuwa juu yake. Kijana Yesu Hekaluni

english: Every year His parents went to Jerusalem for the Feast of the Passover.
ekegusii: Nabo abaibori baye barenge kogenda Yerusalemu kera omwaka ase rituko rinene ri’Epasaka.
swahili: Kila mwaka Yosefu na Maria mama yake Yesu walikuwa na desturi ya kwenda Yerusalemu kwa ajili ya Sikukuu ya Pasaka.

english: And when He was twelve years old, they went up according to the custom of the Feast.
ekegusii: Goika agachia koba nemiaka ikomi na ebere, bagatiira kogenda aroro, buna yarenge engencho ye Rituko Rinene.
swahili: Yesu alipokuwa na umri wa miaka kumi na miwili, walipanda kwenda kwenye Sikukuu hiyo kama ilivyokuwa desturi.

english: When those days were over and they were returning home, the boy Jesus remained behind in Jerusalem, but His parents were unaware He had stayed.
ekegusii: Ekero Epasaka yaera, ekero barenge koirana, omwana Yeso agatigara magega agwo Yerusalemu, na abaibori baye tibamanya.
swahili: Baada ya Sikukuu kumalizika, wakati Yosefu na Maria mama yake walipokuwa wakirudi nyumbani, Yesu alibaki Yerusalemu lakini hawakutambua.

english: Assuming He was in their company, they traveled on for a day before they began to look for Him among their relatives and friends.
ekegusii: Barabwo bagakaga ng’a nigo are ase omoganda obo, bakagenda orogendo rw’omobaso oyomo, bakamorigia ase abairi babo boigo nabasani.
swahili: Wao wakidhani kuwa yuko miongoni mwa wasafiri, walienda mwendo wa kutwa nzima. Ndipo wakaanza kumtafuta miongoni mwa jamaa zao na marafiki.

english: When they could not find Him, they returned to Jerusalem to search for Him.
ekegusii: Ekero batamonyorete, bakairana Yerusalemu, bakamorigia.
swahili: Walipomkosa walirudi Yerusalemu ili kumtafuta.

english: Finally, after three days they found Him in the temple courts, sitting among the teachers, listening to them and asking them questions.
ekegusii: Ase rituko riagatato bakamonyora Hekalu ime, oikaransete gati ase aborokia, obategererete na kobaboria amaborio.
swahili: Baada ya siku tatu wakamkuta ndani ya Hekalu, akiwa ameketi katikati ya walimu wa sheria, akiwasikiliza na kuwauliza maswali.

english: And all who heard Him were astounded at His understanding and His answers.
ekegusii: Na bonsi abamoigwete bagakumia ase okomanya kwaye na okoiraneria kwaye.
swahili: Wote waliomsikia walistaajabishwa na uwezo wake mkubwa wa kuelewa, na majibu aliyoyatoa.

english: When His parents saw Him, they were astonished. “Child, why have You done this to us?” His mother asked. “Your father and I have been anxiously searching for You.”
ekegusii: Abaibori baye bagachia komoorora bagaichana mono. Ng’ina akamoteebia, “Omwana one, naki gwatokorire iga? Rora, iso na inche twarenge gokorigia nomoichano.”
swahili: Yosefu na Maria mama yake walipomwona walishangaa. Mama yake akamuuliza, “Mwanangu, mbona umetufanyia hivi? Tazama, mimi na baba yako tumekuwa tukikutafuta kwa wasiwasi mkubwa kila mahali.”

english: “Why were you looking for Me?” He asked. “Did you not know that I had to be in My Father’s house?”
ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Naki mokondigia? Timomanyeti ng’a nengwenerete koba ase enyomba ya Tata one?”
swahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Kwa nini kunitafuta? Hamkujua kwamba imenipasa kuwa katika nyumba ya Baba yangu?”

english: He went there to register with Mary, who was pledged to him in marriage and was expecting a child.
ekegusii: erinde ariikwe amo na Mariamu, ekiagera konya omoriereire boko, na Mariamu nigo arenge morito.
swahili: Alikwenda huko kujiandikisha pamoja na Maria, ambaye alikuwa amemposa naye alikuwa mjamzito.

english: But they did not understand the statement He was making to them.
ekegusii: Tibamanya ring’ana riria abateebia.
swahili: Lakini wao hawakuelewa maana ya lile alilowaambia.

english: Then He went down to Nazareth with them and was obedient to them. But His mother treasured up all these things in her heart.
ekegusii: Agatirimboka amo nabarabwo, agaika Nazareti, akaba nkobaigwera are. Ng’ina akagacha amang’ana aya onsi ase enkoro yaye ime.
swahili: Ndipo akashuka pamoja nao hadi Nazareti, naye alikuwa mtiifu kwao. Lakini mama yake akayaweka moyoni mwake mambo haya yote.

english: And Jesus grew in wisdom and stature, and in favor with God and man.
ekegusii: Yeso akamenteka gokina ase obong’aini ne chisemi, na ase omobere, akanyora ogwancherwa ase Nyasae na Mwanyabaanto.
swahili: Naye Yesu akakua katika hekima na kimo, akimpendeza Mungu na wanadamu.

english: While they were there, the time came for her Child to be born.
ekegusii: Ekero barenge aroro engaki yaye y’okoibora egaika.
swahili: Wakiwa Bethlehemu, wakati wa Maria wa kujifungua ukawa umetimia,

english: And she gave birth to her firstborn, a Son. She wrapped Him in swaddling cloths and laid Him in a manger, because there was no room for them in the inn. The Shepherds and the Angels
ekegusii: Akaibora omwana oye omoisia omotangi, akamobekera chianga chi’obwana, akamwareria ase orotuba chiombe chiare koriera, ekiagera batanyorete ribaga ase enyomba y’abageni. Abarisia na Abamalaika
swahili: naye akamzaa mwanawe, kifungua mimba. Akamfunika nguo za kitoto na kumlaza katika hori ya kulia ngʼombe, kwa sababu hapakuwa na nafasi katika nyumba ya wageni. Wachungaji Na Malaika

english: And there were shepherds residing in the fields nearby, keeping watch over their flocks by night.
ekegusii: Ase ense eyio mbarengeo abarisia baikaransete ase ebitii, bakorenda amaicho abo botuko.
swahili: Katika eneo lile walikuwako wachungaji waliokuwa wakikaa mashambani, wakilinda makundi yao ya kondoo usiku.

english: Just then an angel of the Lord stood before them, and the glory of the Lord shone around them, and they were terrified.
ekegusii: Omomalaika bw’Omonene akabaorokera, na obonene bw’Omonene bokabaabarera; bagasogwa nomoondoko omonge.
swahili: Ghafula tazama, malaika wa Bwana akawatokea, nao utukufu wa Bwana ukawangʼaria kotekote, wakaingiwa na hofu.

english: In the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar, while Pontius Pilate was governor of Judea, Herod tetrarch of Galilee, his brother Philip tetrarch of Ituraea and Trachonitis, and Lysanias tetrarch of Abilene,
ekegusii: Ase omwaka o ikomi na gatano bw’okogamba gwa Kaisari Tiberio, Pontio Pilato orenge gabana o Boyahudi, na Herode omorwoti o Galili, na Filipo momura omwabo arenge omorwoti o Iturea na ense ya Tarakoniti, na Lusania omorwoti o Abileni,
swahili: Katika mwaka wa kumi na tano wa utawala wa Kaisari Tiberio, Pontio Pilato akiwa mtawala wa Uyahudi, Herode akiwa mfalme wa Galilaya, Filipo ndugu yake akiwa mfalme wa Iturea na nchi ya Trakoniti, na Lisania akiwa mfalme wa Abilene,

english: The crowds asked him, “What then should we do?”
ekegusii: Emeganda eria ekamoboria, “Ninki rende torakore?”
swahili: Ule umati wa watu ukamuuliza, “Inatupasa tufanyeje basi?”

english: John replied, “Whoever has two tunics should share with him who has none, and whoever has food should do the same.”
ekegusii: Akabairaneria, “Oyore ne chianga ibere ae ere oyotari nero; na oyore nendagera akore boigo.”
swahili: Yohana akawaambia, “Aliye na kanzu mbili amgawie asiye nayo, naye aliye na chakula na afanye vivyo hivyo.”

english: Even tax collectors came to be baptized. “Teacher,” they asked, “what should we do?”
ekegusii: Abarusia ebango bagacha erinde babatiswe, bakamobooria, “Omworokia, inki rende naintwe torakore?”
swahili: Watoza ushuru nao wakaja ili wabatizwe, wakamuuliza, “Bwana na sisi inatupasa tufanyeje?”

english: “Collect no more than you are authorized,” he answered.
ekegusii: Akabairaneria, “Timorusia kobua ebi mwachigetwe.”
swahili: Akawaambia, “Msichukue zaidi ya kiwango mlichopangiwa.”

english: Then some soldiers asked him, “And what should we do?” “Do not take money by force or false accusation,” he said. “Be content with your wages.”
ekegusii: Abasikari nabarabwo bakamobooria, “Naintwe inki torakore?” Akabairaneria, “Timourereria monto onde ase chinguru gose ase obosoeri bw’oborimo; naende moisaneke neng’eria yaino.”
swahili: Askari nao wakamuuliza, “Je, nasi inatupasa tufanye nini?” Akawaambia, “Msimdhulumu mtu wala msimshtaki mtu kwa uongo, bali mridhike na mishahara yenu.”

english: The people were waiting expectantly and were all wondering in their hearts if John could be the Christ.
ekegusii: Ekero abanto baganyete na konakorengereria, bonsi bakeboria ase chinkoro chiabo ime gose Yohana nere Kristo.
swahili: Watu walikuwa na matazamio makubwa. Wakawa wanajiuliza mioyoni mwao iwapo Yohana angeweza kuwa ndiye Kristo.

english: John answered all of them: “I baptize you with water, but One more powerful than I will come, the straps of whose sandals I am not worthy to untie. He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and with fire.
ekegusii: Yohana akairaneria abwo bonsi, “Inche nigo nkobabatisa ase amaache, korende oyore ne chinguru kombua ngocha are, ting’isaini gosibora chiusi chi’ebikoroto biaye; oyio nere orabaabatise ase Omoika Omochenu na ase omorero.
swahili: Yohana akawajibu akawaambia, “Mimi nawabatiza kwa maji. Lakini atakuja aliye na nguvu kuniliko mimi, ambaye sistahili hata kufungua kamba za viatu vyake. Yeye atawabatiza kwa Roho Mtakatifu na kwa moto.

english: His winnowing fork is in His hand to clear His threshing floor and to gather the wheat into His barn; but He will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire.”
ekegusii: Oroteru rwaye nigo rore koboko kwaye, ere naabuse ekeooreri kiaye, nasangererie engano ase ekiage kiaye, korende omoiriro nayosambe ase omorero otakorimeka.”
swahili: Pepeto lake liko mkononi, tayari kusafisha sakafu yake ya kupuria na kuikusanya ngano ghalani, lakini makapi atayateketeza kwa moto usiozimika.”

english: With these and many other exhortations, John proclaimed the good news to the people.
ekegusii: Nabo ase ogokuurera okonge Yohana akaranderia abanto amang’ana amaya.
swahili: Basi, kwa maonyo mengine mengi Yohana aliwasihi na kuwahubiria watu Habari Njema.

english: But when he rebuked Herod the tetrarch regarding his brother’s wife Herodias and all the evils he had done,
ekegusii: Korende Yohana agatogonyera Herode omorwoti, ase engencho y’okonyuoma Herodia, moka momura omwabo, na ase engencho y’amabe onsi Herode akorire,
swahili: Lakini Yohana alipomkemea Mfalme Herode kuhusu uhusiano wake na Herodia, mke wa ndugu yake, na maovu mengine aliyokuwa amefanya,

english: during the high priesthood of Annas and Caiaphas, the word of God came to John son of Zechariah in the wilderness.
ekegusii: ekero ki’obokuani obonene bw’Anasi na Kayafa, ring’ana ria Nyasae rigaikera Yohana, omwana o Zakaria, ase erooro.
swahili: nao Anasi na Kayafa wakiwa makuhani wakuu, neno la Mungu likamjia Yohana, mwana wa Zekaria huko jangwani.

english: Herod added this to them all: He locked John up in prison. The Baptism of Jesus (Matthew 3:13–17; Mark 1:9–11; John 1:29–34)
ekegusii: Korende Herode agakora rinene kobua, ase okoruta ase Yohana echela. Okobatiswa kwa Yeso (Mat 3:13-17; Mar 1:9-11)
swahili: Herode aliongezea jambo hili kwa hayo mengine yote: alimfunga Yohana gerezani. Kubatizwa Kwa Bwana Yesu (Mathayo 3:13-17; Marko 1:9-11)

english: When all the people were being baptized, Jesus was baptized too. And as He was praying, heaven was opened,
ekegusii: Egachia koba abanto bonsi kobaabatisirwe, na Yeso boigo kabatisirwe, na ekero agosaba, igoro akamaanoka.
swahili: Baada ya watu wote kubatizwa, Yesu naye akabatizwa. Naye alipokuwa akiomba, mbingu zilifunguka.

english: and the Holy Spirit descended on Him in a bodily form like a dove. And a voice came from heaven: “You are My beloved Son; in You I am well pleased.” The Genealogy of Jesus (Ruth 4:18–22; Matthew 1:1–17)
ekegusii: Omoika Omochenu ogaika igoro asare ase omogwekano bwe riruma, eriogi rikarwa igoro, rigoteeba, “Aye naye Omwana one omwanchwa, ngokirie naye.” Chisokoro ne chisokoororia chia Yeso (Mat 1:1-17)
swahili: Roho Mtakatifu akashuka juu yake kwa umbo kama la hua, nayo sauti kutoka mbinguni ikasema: “Wewe ni Mwanangu mpendwa; nami nimependezwa nawe sana.” Ukoo Wa Bwana Yesu (Mathayo 1:1-17)

english: Jesus Himself was about thirty years old when He began His ministry. He was regarded as the son of Joseph, the son of Heli,
ekegusii: Yeso nere ekero achagete kworokereria, emiaka yaye igo yarenge ang’e emerongo etato, agakagwa ng’a mosinto o Yusufu, o Eli,
swahili: Yesu alikuwa na umri wa miaka thelathini alipoanza huduma yake. Alikuwa akidhaniwa kuwa mwana wa Yosefu, Yosefu alikuwa mwana wa Eli,

english: He went into all the region around the Jordan, preaching a baptism of repentance for the forgiveness of sins,
ekegusii: Akagenda chinse chionsi chi’ensemo ya Yorodani, okorandia ebatiso y’okoonchoka ekorenta okwaberwa kw’ebibe.
swahili: Akaenda katika nchi yote kandokando ya Mto Yordani, akihubiri ubatizo wa toba kwa ajili ya msamaha wa dhambi.

english: the son of Melea, the son of Menna, the son of Mattatha, the son of Nathan, the son of David,
ekegusii: o Melea, o Mainani, o Mattatha, o Nathani, o Daudi,
swahili: Melea alikuwa mwana wa Mena, Mena alikuwa mwana wa Matatha, Matatha alikuwa mwana wa Nathani, Nathani alikuwa mwana wa Daudi,

english: as it is written in the book of the words of Isaiah the prophet: “A voice of one calling in the wilderness, ‘Prepare the way for the Lord, make straight paths for Him.
ekegusii: Buna eriikire ase egetabu y’amang’ana ’omobani Isaya, “Eriogi ri’oyogoaka egeturi ase erooro, Roisia enchera y’Omonene, rongeyia oboeto bwaye.
swahili: Kama ilivyoandikwa katika kitabu cha nabii Isaya: “Sauti ya mtu aliaye nyikani, ‘Itengenezeni njia ya Bwana, yanyoosheni mapito yake.

english: Every valley shall be filled in, and every mountain and hill made low. The crooked ways shall be made straight, and the rough ways smooth.
ekegusii: Kera rigooko nariichorigwe, na kera ekegoro na egetunwa nabikeeigwe; aare bogeka inarongeigwe, na enchera ere ebitunwa‐tunwa nereng’anigwe;
swahili: Kila bonde litajazwa, kila mlima na kilima vitashushwa. Njia zilizopinda zitanyooshwa, na zilizoparuza zitasawazishwa.

english: And all humanity will see God’s salvation.’”
ekegusii: na abanto bonsi nabarore ogotooreka gokorwa ase Nyasae.”
swahili: Nao watu wote watauona wokovu wa Mungu.’ ”

english: Then John said to the crowds coming out to be baptized by him, “You brood of vipers, who warned you to flee from the coming wrath?
ekegusii: Nabo agateebia emeganda eyachete, erinde ebatiswe nere, “Inwe oroiboro rwe ching’iti, ning’o obakuureire ng’a motame korwa ase endamwamu egochi‐gocha?
swahili: Yohana akauambia ule umati wa watu uliokuwa unakuja ili kubatizwa naye, “Ninyi watoto wa nyoka! Ni nani aliyewaonya kuikimbia ghadhabu inayokuja?

english: Produce fruit, then, in keeping with repentance. And do not begin to say to yourselves, ‘We have Abraham as our father.’ For I tell you that out of these stones God can raise up children for Abraham.
ekegusii: Gaki, ama okwama kogwenerete okoonchoka, gose timochaaka kobora emioyo yaino ime: Ntore na sokoro yaito, nere Aburaamu. Naki nabateebirie ng’a Nyasae nare nokobua ase amagena aya gokorera Aburaamu abana.
swahili: Basi zaeni matunda yastahiliyo toba. Wala msianze kusema mioyoni mwenu kuwa, ‘Sisi tunaye Abrahamu, baba yetu.’ Kwa maana nawaambia kuwa Mungu anaweza kumwinulia Abrahamu watoto kutoka mawe haya.

english: The axe lies ready at the root of the trees, and every tree that does not produce good fruit will be cut down and thrown into the fire.”
ekegusii: Nonya mbono egesire kiabekirwe ase emeri y’emete; nabo kera omote otameti okwama okuya nonachwe, otugutwe ase omorero.”
swahili: Hata sasa shoka limeshawekwa tayari kwenye shina la kila mti. Basi kila mti usiozaa matunda mazuri hukatwa na kutupwa motoni.”

english: Then Jesus, full of the Holy Spirit, returned from the Jordan and was led by the Spirit into the wilderness,
ekegusii: Na Yeso oichire n’Omoika Omochenu, akairana korwa Yorodani, agatang’anwa n’Omoika kogenda ase erooro,
swahili: Yesu, akiwa amejaa Roho Mtakatifu, akarudi kutoka Yordani. Akaongozwa na Roho Mtakatifu hadi nyikani,

english: For it is written: ‘He will command His angels concerning You to guard You carefully;
ekegusii: ekiagera neriikire: Ere nagochikere abamalaika baye bakorende,
swahili: kwa maana imeandikwa: “ ‘Atakuagizia malaika zake ili wakulinde;

english: and they will lift You up in their hands, so that You will not strike Your foot against a stone.’ ”
ekegusii: naende: Nabakoimokie ase amaboko abo, erinde tobaisa kogochwa okogoro kwao ne rigena.
swahili: nao watakuchukua mikononi mwao, usije ukajikwaa mguu wako katika jiwe.’ ”

english: But Jesus answered, “It also says, ‘Do not put the Lord your God to the test.’ ”
ekegusii: Yeso akamoiraneria, “Neteebire, Toteema Omonene Nyasae oo.”
swahili: Yesu akamjibu, “Imesemwa, ‘Usimjaribu Bwana Mungu wako.’ ”

english: When the devil had finished every temptation, he left Him until an opportune time. Jesus Begins His Ministry (Isaiah 9:1–7; Matthew 4:12–17; Mark 1:14–15)
ekegusii: Saitani agachia gokoora ogoteema kwaye gwonsi, akaimoka korwa asare, akamotiga ase egeka. Yeso ogochaka emeremo Galili (Mat 4:12-17; Mar 1:14-15)
swahili: Ibilisi alipomaliza kila jaribu, akamwacha Yesu mpaka wakati mwingine ufaao. Mwanzo Wa Huduma Ya Galilaya (Mathayo 4:12-17; Marko 1:14-15)

english: Jesus returned to Galilee in the power of the Spirit, and the news about Him spread throughout the surrounding region.
ekegusii: Yeso akairana gochia Galili ne chinguru chi’Omoika, chinkuma chigasarera ase chinsemo chionsi chi’ense eria.
swahili: Kisha Yesu akarudi mpaka Galilaya, akiwa amejaa nguvu za Roho Mtakatifu, nazo habari zake zikaenea katika sehemu zote za nchi za kandokando.

english: He taught in their synagogues and was glorified by everyone. The Rejection at Nazareth (Isaiah 61:1–11; Matthew 13:53–58; Mark 6:1–6)
ekegusii: Ere akorokereria ase chisinagogi chiabo, ogotogigwa nabaanto bonsi. Yeso okwangwa Nazareti (Mat 13:53-58; Mar 6:1-6)
swahili: Akaanza kufundisha kwenye masinagogi yao, na kila mmoja akamsifu. Yesu Akataliwa Nazareti (Mathayo 13:53-58; Marko 6:1-6)

english: Then Jesus came to Nazareth, where He had been brought up. As was His custom, He entered the synagogue on the Sabbath. And when He stood up to read,
ekegusii: Akagenda Nazareti, aria ase arereretwe; na ase rituko ri’Esabato agasoa ase esinagogi yabo, buna engencho yaye yarenge, agatenena gosoma.
swahili: Yesu akaenda Nazareti, alipolelewa, na siku ya Sabato alikwenda katika sinagogi kama ilivyokuwa desturi yake. Akasimama ili asome,

english: the scroll of the prophet Isaiah was handed to Him. Unrolling it, He found the place where it was written:
ekegusii: Akaegwa egetabu y’omobani Isaya. Nabo akaigora egetabu eyio, akanyora aase ariikire,
swahili: naye akapewa kitabu cha nabii Isaya, akakifungua na kukuta mahali palipoandikwa:

english: “The Spirit of the Lord is on Me, because He has anointed Me to preach good news to the poor. He has sent Me to proclaim liberty to the captives and recovery of sight to the blind, to release the oppressed,
ekegusii: Omoika bw’Omonene nigo ore igoro yane, ekiagera ong’akire amaguta koranderia abataka amang’ana amaya. Ontomire koranderia abasibwa ogosiborwa, na koa abare emeuko banyare korora naende, na gosibora abasionoirwe.
swahili: “Roho wa Bwana yu juu yangu, kwa sababu amenitia mafuta kuwahubiria maskini habari njema. Amenituma kuwatangazia wafungwa kufunguliwa kwao, na vipofu kupata kuona tena, kuwaweka huru wanaoonewa,

english: to proclaim the year of the Lord’s favor.”
ekegusii: Na korandia omwakabwo Omonene bwancheretwe.
swahili: na kutangaza mwaka wa Bwana uliokubalika.”

english: where for forty days He was tempted by the devil. He ate nothing during those days, and when they had ended, He was hungry.
ekegusii: agateemwa na Saitani ase engaki y’amatuko emerongo ene. Na amatuko aria tariete gento. Goika agachia koera, akaigwa enchara.
swahili: mahali ambako kwa siku arobaini alikuwa akijaribiwa na ibilisi. Kwa siku zote hizo hakula chochote, hivyo baada ya muda huo akaona njaa.

english: Then He rolled up the scroll, returned it to the attendant, and sat down. The eyes of everyone in the synagogue were fixed on Him,
ekegusii: Akamumekeria egetabu eria akayea omokori emeremo bw’esinagogi, agaikaransa. Abanto bonsi abarenge ase esinagogi bakamobeta amaiso.
swahili: Kisha akakifunga kitabu, akamrudishia mtumishi na akaketi. Watu wote waliokuwamo katika sinagogi wakamkazia macho.

english: and He began by saying, “Today this Scripture is fulfilled in your hearing.”
ekegusii: Agachaaka kobateebia, “Reero ririiko eri riaikeranigwe ase more buna mwarigwa rigosomwa.”
swahili: Ndipo akaanza kwa kuwaambia, “Leo Andiko hili limetimia mkiwa mnasikia.”

english: All spoke well of Him and marveled at the gracious words that came from His lips. “Isn’t this the son of Joseph?” they asked.
ekegusii: Bonsi bakamokwana buya bagakumia amang’ana obuya aruete ase omonwa oye, bagateebania, “Oyo tari ere omwana o Yusufu?”
swahili: Wote waliokuwako wakamsifu na kuyastaajabia maneno yake yaliyojaa neema, wakaulizana, “Je, huyu si mwana wa Yosefu?”

english: Jesus said to them, “Surely you will quote this proverb to Me: ‘Physician, heal yourself! Do here in Your hometown what we have heard that You did in Capernaum.’”
ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Ekeene, namonteebie omoreng’anio oyo: Omogwenia, egwenie aye omonyene; amang’ana onsi twaigure akorekire Kapernaumu, yakore aiga ase ense yao.”
swahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Bila shaka mtatumia mithali hii: ‘Tabibu, jiponye mwenyewe! Mambo yale tuliyosikia kwamba uliyafanya huko Kapernaumu, yafanye na hapa kwenye mji wako.’ ”

english: Then He added, “Truly I tell you, no prophet is accepted in his hometown.
ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Ekeene nabateebirie: Omobani tari oranyare gwanchwa ase ense yaye omonyene.
swahili: Yesu akasema, “Amin, nawaambia, hakuna nabii anayekubalika katika mji wake mwenyewe.

english: But I tell you truthfully that there were many widows in Israel in the time of Elijah, when the sky was shut for three and a half years and great famine swept over all the land.
ekegusii: Korende ekeene nabateebirie ng’a mbarenge ababoraka abange ase Israeli ase amatuko ’Elija, ekero igoro yasiegetwe emiaka etato na emetienyi etano nomo, ekero enchara enene yasoete ase ense yonsi;
swahili: Lakini ukweli ni kwamba palikuwa na wajane wengi katika Israeli wakati wa Eliya, mbingu zilipofungwa kwa miaka mitatu na miezi sita pakawa na njaa kuu katika nchi nzima.

english: Yet Elijah was not sent to any of them, but to the widow of Zarephath in Sidon.
ekegusii: na Elija tatometwe ase oyomo obo, otatiga ase omokungu oyorenge omoboraka agwo Sarefata, ase ense ya Sidoni.
swahili: Hata hivyo Eliya hakutumwa hata kwa mmoja wao, bali kwa mjane mmoja wa Sarepta katika nchi ya Sidoni.

english: And there were many lepers in Israel in the time of Elisha the prophet. Yet not one of them was cleansed—only Naaman the Syrian.”
ekegusii: Naende mbarenge ase Abaisraeli abanto abange abaare noborwaire bwa ukoma ase ekero ki’omobani Elisha; onde tari osibegete otatiga Naamani, omonto o Siiria.”
swahili: Pia palikuwa na wengi wenye ukoma katika Israeli katika siku za nabii Elisha, lakini hakuna hata mmoja wao aliyetakaswa, isipokuwa Naamani mtu wa Shamu.”

english: On hearing this, all the people in the synagogue were enraged.
ekegusii: Bagachia koigwa aya, bonsi ase esinagogi bagaichorwa nendamwamu.
swahili: Watu wote katika sinagogi waliposikia maneno haya, wakakasirika sana.

english: They got up, drove Him out of the town, and led Him to the brow of the hill on which the town was built, in order to throw Him over the cliff.
ekegusii: Bakaimoka bakamosokia isiko y’omochie, bakamoira goika igoro y’egetunwa keria omochie obo oagachire erio, banyare komoturunkania.
swahili: Wakasimama, wakamtoa nje ya mji, wakamchukua hadi kwenye kilele cha mlima mahali ambapo mji huo ulikuwa umejengwa, ili wamtupe chini kutoka kwenye mteremko mkali.

english: The devil said to Him, “If You are the Son of God, tell this stone to become bread.”
ekegusii: Saitani akamoteebia, “Onye kore Omwana o Nyasae, teebia rigena eri ribe omogati.”
swahili: Ibilisi akamwambia, “Ikiwa wewe ni Mwana wa Mungu, amuru jiwe hili liwe mkate.”

english: But Jesus passed through the crowd and went on His way. Jesus Expels an Unclean Spirit (Mark 1:21–28)
ekegusii: Korende ere agaeta egati‐gati yabo, akagenda. Okogwenigwa kw’omonto obwatire nekerecha ki’eubi (Mar 1:21-28)
swahili: Lakini yeye akapita papo hapo katikati ya huo umati wa watu akaenda zake. Yesu Atoa Pepo Mchafu (Marko 1:21-28)

english: Then He went down to Capernaum, a town in Galilee, and on the Sabbath He began to teach the people.
ekegusii: Agatirimboka goika Kapernaumu, omochie o Galili. Akaba nkoborokereria are rituko ri’Esabato.
swahili: Kisha Yesu akashuka kwenda Kapernaumu, mji wa Galilaya, na katika siku ya Sabato akawa anafundisha.

english: They were astonished at His teaching, because His message had authority.
ekegusii: Bagakumia mono ase okworokereria kwaye, ekiagera ring’ana riaye riarenge nokobua.
swahili: Wakashangazwa sana na mafundisho yake, maana maneno yake yalikuwa na mamlaka.

english: In the synagogue there was a man possessed by the spirit of an unclean demon. He cried out in a loud voice,
ekegusii: Naende ase esinagogi narengeo omonto obwatire n’Omoika bw’ekerecha ki’eubi. Ere agaaka eriogi ase chinguru, akabora,
swahili: Ndani ya sinagogi palikuwa na mtu aliyekuwa amepagawa na pepo mchafu. Naye akapiga kelele kwa nguvu akisema,

english: “Ha! What do You want with us, Jesus of Nazareth? Have You come to destroy us? I know who You are—the Holy One of God!”
ekegusii: “Ah! Totige intwe Inki tore naye, Yeso o Nazareti? Ngwachire gotosiria? Nakomanyire aye, Omochenu o Nyasae.”
swahili: “Tuache! Tuna nini nawe, Yesu wa Nazareti? Je, umekuja kutuangamiza? Ninakujua wewe ni nani. Wewe ndiwe Aliye Mtakatifu wa Mungu!”

english: But Jesus rebuked the demon. “Be silent!” He said. “Come out of him!” At this, the demon threw the man down before them all and came out without harming him.
ekegusii: Yeso akagetogonyera, akabora, “Kira, omorwe!” Ekerecha keria gekamoiyeria agwo gati‐gati, gekamorwa, tikiamokorera gento.
swahili: Basi Yesu akamkemea yule pepo mchafu, akisema, “Nyamaza kimya! Nawe umtoke!” Yule pepo mchafu akamwangusha yule mtu chini mbele yao wote, akatoka pasipo kumdhuru.

english: All the people were overcome with amazement and asked one another, “What is this message? With authority and power He commands the unclean spirits, and they come out!”
ekegusii: Bagakumia bonsi, bagateebania barabwo ase barabwo, “Ing’ana ki eri? Naki ase chinguru na okobua kiagochika ebirecha bi’eubi, na birobio biasoka.”
swahili: Watu wote wakashangaa, wakaambiana, “Mafundisho haya ni ya namna gani? Anawaamuru pepo wachafu kwa mamlaka na nguvu, nao wanatoka!”

english: And the news about Jesus spread throughout the surrounding region. Jesus Heals at Peter’s House (Matthew 8:14–17; Mark 1:29–34)
ekegusii: Chinkuma chiaye chigasarera ase chinsemo chionsi chi’ense eria. Yeso okogwenia aaria mwa Simioni (Mat 8:14-17; Mar 1:29-39)
swahili: Habari zake zikaanza kuenea kila mahali katika sehemu ile. Yesu Awaponya Wengi (Mathayo 8:14-17; Marko 1:29-34)

english: After Jesus had left the synagogue, He went to the home of Simon, whose mother-in-law was suffering from a high fever. So they appealed to Jesus on her behalf,
ekegusii: Akaimoka korwa ase esinagogi, agasoa ase enyomba ya Simioni. Nabo ng’ina biara Simioni konya orwarire esosera; bakamosaba ase engencho yaye.
swahili: Yesu akatoka katika sinagogi, akaenda nyumbani kwa Simoni. Basi huko alimkuta mama mkwe wa Simoni akiwa ameshikwa na homa kali, nao wakamwomba Yesu amsaidie.

english: and He stood over her and rebuked the fever, and it left her. And she got up at once and began to serve them.
ekegusii: Agatenena ang’e nere, agatogonyera esosera eria; ekamotiga. Bwango ere akaimoka akabakorera.
swahili: Hivyo Yesu akamwinamia na kukemea ile homa, nayo ikamwacha. Akaamka saa ile ile, naye akaanza kuwahudumia.

english: But Jesus answered, “It is written: ‘Man shall not live on bread alone.’ ”
ekegusii: Yeso akamoiraneria, “Neriikire. Omonto takoba moyo ase omogati bwoka.”
swahili: Yesu akajibu akamwambia, “Imeandikwa: ‘Mtu haishi kwa mkate tu.’ ”

english: At sunset, all who were ill with various diseases were brought to Jesus, and laying His hands on each one, He healed them.
ekegusii: Goika erioba rigachia kogwa bakarenta asare abanto bonsi abarenge nabarwaire bare namarwaire ao ao, na ere akabeeka amaboko aye igoro ase kera oyomo, akabagwenia.
swahili: Jua lilipokuwa linatua, watu wakamletea Yesu watu wote waliokuwa na maradhi mbalimbali, naye akaweka mikono yake juu ya kila mgonjwa, naye akawaponya.

english: Demons also came out of many people, shouting, “You are the Son of God!” But He rebuked the demons and would not allow them to speak, because they knew He was the Christ. Jesus Preaches in Judea (Mark 1:35–39)
ekegusii: Ebirecha bigasoka korwa ase abange, bigaaka eriogi, bikabora, “Aye naye Omwana o Nyasae.” Akabitogonyera, tabitiga bikwane, ekiagera biamanyete ng’a nere Kristo. Yeso okorandia ase esinagogi
swahili: Pepo wachafu pia wakawatoka watu wengi, nao walipokuwa wakitoka wakapiga kelele, wakisema: “Wewe ni Mwana wa Mungu!” Lakini Yesu akawakemea na kuwazuia wasiseme, kwa maana walimjua kuwa yeye ndiye Kristo.

english: At daybreak, Jesus went out to a solitary place, and the crowds were looking for Him. They came to Him and tried to keep Him from leaving.
ekegusii: Goika ekaba mobaso, agasoka, akagenda aase atari nabaanto. Na abanto bakamoriga‐rigia, bakamoikera, bakarigia komotanga taimoka korwa ase bare.
swahili: Kesho yake, kulipopambazuka, Yesu alikwenda mahali pa faragha. Watu wengi wakawa wanamtafuta kila mahali, nao walipomwona wakajaribu kumzuia asiondoke.

english: But Jesus told them, “I must preach the good news of the kingdom of God to the other towns as well, because that is why I was sent.”
ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Nengwenerete korandia amang’ana amaya ay’oborwoti bwa Nyasae ase emechie ende boigo, ekiagera natometwe ase engencho eyio.”
swahili: Lakini yeye akawaambia, “Imenipasa kuhubiri habari njema za Ufalme wa Mungu katika miji mingine pia, kwa maana kwa kusudi hili nilitumwa.”

english: And He continued to preach in the synagogues of Judea.
ekegusii: Akaba nkorandia are ase chisinagogi chia Boyahudi.
swahili: Naye aliendelea kuhubiri katika masinagogi ya Uyahudi.

english: Then the devil led Him up to a high place and showed Him in an instant all the kingdoms of the world.
ekegusii: Saitani akamoira aase aimokererete igoro, akamworokia amarwoti onsi ay’ense ase egeka ekemo,
swahili: Ibilisi akampeleka hadi juu ya mlima mrefu akamwonyesha milki zote za dunia kwa mara moja.

english: “I will give You authority over all these kingdoms and all their glory,” he said. “For it has been relinquished to me, and I can give it to anyone I wish.
ekegusii: akamoteebia, “Ninkoe okobua oko gwonsi, na obonene bwaye, ekiagera nabieirwe, na inche iga nkoa oyo ngwancha.
swahili: Akamwambia, “Nitakupa mamlaka juu ya milki hizi na fahari zake zote, kwa maana zimekabidhiwa mkononi mwangu nami ninaweza kumpa yeyote ninayetaka.

english: So if You worship me, it will all be Yours.”
ekegusii: Nabo koransasiime, bionsi nabibe ebiao.”
swahili: Hivyo ikiwa utanisujudia na kuniabudu, vyote vitakuwa vyako.”

english: But Jesus answered, “It is written: ‘Worship the Lord your God and serve Him only.’ ”
ekegusii: Yeso akamoiraneria, “Neriikire: Mosasiime Omonene Nyasae oo, omokorere ere bweka.”
swahili: Yesu akamjibu, “Imeandikwa: ‘Mwabudu Bwana Mungu wako na umtumikie yeye peke yake.’ ”

english: Then the devil led Him to Jerusalem and set Him on the pinnacle of the temple. “If You are the Son of God,” he said, “throw Yourself down from here.
ekegusii: Saitani akamoira goika Yerusalemu, akamotenenia igoro ase egechuria gie Hekalu egetambe mono, akamoteebia, Onye kore Omwana o Nyasae, etugute gochia inse korwa aa,
swahili: Kisha ibilisi akampeleka mpaka Yerusalemu, akamweka juu ya mnara mrefu wa Hekalu, akamwambia, “Kama wewe ndiwe Mwana wa Mungu, jitupe chini kutoka hapa,

english: On one occasion, while Jesus was standing by the Lake of Gennesaret with the crowd pressing in on Him to hear the word of God,
ekegusii: Ekaba abanto nkomomiga baare, erinde baigwe ring’ana ria Nyasae, agatenena ase engegu y’enyancha ya Genesareti,
swahili: Siku moja Yesu alipokuwa amesimama karibu na Ziwa la Genesareti, watu wengi wakiwa wanasongana kumzunguka ili wapate kusikia neno la Mungu,

english: and so were his partners James and John, the sons of Zebedee. “Do not be afraid,” Jesus said to Simon. “From now on you will catch men.”
ekegusii: naboigo Yakobo na Yohana, abana ba Zebedi, abarenge ababwatani ba Simioni. Yeso agateebia Simioni, “Toiroka; korwa bono nobe omorubi bw’abaanto.”
swahili: Vivyo hivyo wenzake Simoni, yaani Yakobo na Yohana, wana wa Zebedayo, walishangazwa pia. Ndipo Yesu akamwambia Simoni, “Usiogope, tangu sasa utakuwa mvuvi wa watu.”

english: And when they had brought their boats ashore, they left everything and followed Him. The Leper’s Prayer (Leviticus 14:1–32; Matthew 8:1–4; Mark 1:40–45)
ekegusii: Naende kobarentire amaato abo gochia engegu, bagatiga bionsi, bakamotunyana. Yeso Okogwenia omonto orenge noborwaire bwa ukoma (Mat 8:1-4; Mar 1:40-45)
swahili: Hivyo wakasogeza mashua zao mpaka ufuoni mwa bahari, wakaacha kila kitu na kumfuata. Yesu Amtakasa Mtu Mwenye Ukoma (Mathayo 8:1-4; Marko 1:40-45)

english: While Jesus was in one of the towns, a man came along who was covered with leprosy. When he saw Jesus, he fell facedown and begged Him, “Lord, if You are willing, You can make me clean.”
ekegusii: Ekero arenge ase omochie oyomo, rora, narengeo omonto omosacha oichire noborwaire bwa ukoma. Ere agachia korora Yeso, akagwa maumama, akamosorora, okomoteebia, “Omonene, onye ngwancha, nonyare gonsibia.”
swahili: Ikawa siku moja Yesu alipokuwa katika mji fulani, mtu mmoja mwenye ukoma mwili mzima akamjia. Alipomwona Yesu, alianguka chini mpaka uso wake ukagusa ardhi, akamsihi akisema, “Bwana, ukitaka, waweza kunitakasa.”

english: Jesus reached out His hand and touched the man. “I am willing,” He said. “Be clean!” And immediately the leprosy left him.
ekegusii: Yeso akarambora okoboko kwaye, akamokuna, akamoteebia, “Nanchire; sibeka.” Erio agwo oborwaire bwaye bwa ukoma bokamorua.
swahili: Yesu akanyoosha mkono wake, akamgusa yule mtu, akamwambia, “Nataka. Takasika!” Na mara ukoma wake ukatakasika.

english: “Do not tell anyone,” Jesus instructed him. “But go, show yourself to the priest and present the offering Moses prescribed for your cleansing, as a testimony to them.”
ekegusii: Akamoteebia, “Toteebia monto onde ing’ana, korende genda, bweorokie ase Omokuani, orue ekeng’wanso ase ogosibeka kwao buna Musa achiigete, kebe kirori ase abanto.”
swahili: Yesu akamwagiza akisema, “Usimwambie mtu yeyote, bali nenda ukajionyeshe kwa kuhani na ukatoe sadaka alizoagiza Mose kwa utakaso wako, ili kuwa ushuhuda kwao.”

english: But the news about Jesus spread all the more, and great crowds came to hear Him and to be healed of their sicknesses.
ekegusii: Korende chinkuma chiaye chikamenteka gokuma. Emeganda emenge egasangererekana gocha komoigwa, na kogwenigwa amarwaire abo.
swahili: Lakini habari zake Yesu zikazidi sana kuenea kotekote kuliko wakati mwingine wowote. Makutano makubwa ya watu yalikuwa yakikusanyika ili kumsikiliza na kuponywa magonjwa yao.

english: Yet He frequently withdrew to the wilderness to pray. Jesus Heals a Paralytic (Matthew 9:1–8; Mark 2:1–12)
ekegusii: Korende ere akerusanania, akagenda aase atari nabaanto, agasaba. Yeso okogwenia omonto orenge rigata (Mat 9:1-8; Mar 2:1-12)
swahili: Lakini mara kwa mara Yesu alijitenga nao ili kwenda mahali pa faragha kuomba. Yesu Amponya Mtu Mwenye Kupooza (Mathayo 9:1-8; Marko 2:1-12)

english: One day Jesus was teaching, and the Pharisees and teachers of the law were sitting there. People had come from Jerusalem and from every village of Galilee and Judea, and the power of the Lord was present for Him to heal the sick.
ekegusii: Rituko erimo ri’amatuko aria ekero arenge kworokereria, Abafarisai na aborokia b’amachiiko barenge aroro baikaransete. Abwo baruete ase kera omochie o Galili na Boyahudi, na korwa Yerusalemu. Na okobua kw’Omonene nigo kwarenge amo nere anyare kogwenia.
swahili: Siku moja Yesu alipokuwa akifundisha, Mafarisayo na walimu wa sheria, waliokuwa wametoka kila kijiji cha Galilaya na kutoka Uyahudi na Yerusalemu, walikuwa wameketi huko. Nao uweza wa Bwana ulikuwa juu yake kuponya wagonjwa.

english: Just then some men came carrying a paralyzed man on a mat. They tried to bring him inside to set him before Jesus,
ekegusii: Na rigereria, abanto mbabogoretie noborere omonto orenge rigata, bakarigia komoira nyomba ime na komobeka ase obosio bwaye.
swahili: Wakaja watu wamembeba mgonjwa aliyepooza kwenye mkeka. Wakajaribu kumwingiza ndani ili wamweke mbele ya Yesu.

english: but they could not find a way through the crowd. So they went up on the roof and lowered him on his mat through the tiles into the middle of the crowd, right in front of Jesus.
ekegusii: Ekiagera batanyorete ribaga ri’okomoira ime ase engencho y’omoganda oria bw’abaanto, bakariina kerama igoro, bakamoikia korwa kerama noborere bwaye goika gati‐gati ase obosio bwa Yeso.
swahili: Walipokuwa hawawezi kufanya hivyo kwa sababu ya umati wa watu, wakapanda juu ya paa, wakaondoa baadhi ya matofali, wakamteremsha yule mgonjwa kwa mkeka wake hadi katikati ya ule umati pale mbele ya Yesu.

english: He saw two boats at the edge of the lake. The fishermen had left them and were washing their nets.
ekegusii: Akarora amaato abere ateneine engegu y’enyancha, na abarubi basokire korwa aroro, ngosibia bare ebionga biabo.
swahili: akaona mashua mbili ukingoni mwa ziwa, zikiwa zimeachwa hapo na wavuvi waliokuwa wanaosha nyavu zao.

english: When Jesus saw their faith, He said, “Friend, your sins are forgiven.”
ekegusii: Agachia korora okwegena kwabo, akamoteebia, “Mosani, ebibe biao biabeirwe.”
swahili: Yesu alipoiona imani yao, akamwambia yule mgonjwa, “Rafiki, dhambi zako zimesamehewa.”

english: But the scribes and Pharisees began thinking to themselves, “Who is this man who speaks blasphemy? Who can forgive sins but God alone?”
ekegusii: Aborokia baria b’amariiko na Abafarisai bagachaaka korengereria, bakobora, “Ning’o oyo ogokwana okorama? Ning’o oranyare kwabera ebibe, otatiga oyomo, nere Nyasae?”
swahili: Mafarisayo na wale walimu wa sheria wakaanza kuuliza, “Ni nani mtu huyu anayesema maneno ya kukufuru? Ni nani awezaye kusamehe dhambi isipokuwa Mungu peke yake?”

english: Knowing what they were thinking, Jesus replied, “Why are you thinking these things in your hearts?
ekegusii: Yeso akamanya ebirengererio biabo, akairaneria, “Naki mokorengereria ase chinkoro chiaino?
swahili: Yesu akijua mawazo yao akawauliza, “Kwa nini mnawaza hivyo mioyoni mwenu?

english: Which is easier: to say, ‘Your sins are forgiven,’ or to say, ‘Get up and walk?’
ekegusii: Ndiriri rire eriango, goteeba: Ebibe biao biabeirwe, gose goteeba: Imoka, ogende?
swahili: Je, ni lipi lililo rahisi zaidi, kumwambia, ‘Umesamehewa dhambi zako,’ au kusema, ‘Inuka, uende’?

english: But so that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on the earth to forgive sins...” He said to the paralytic, “I tell you, get up, pick up your mat, and go home.”
ekegusii: Korende monyare komanya ng’a Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto nare nokobua ase ense gw’okwabera ebibe.” Erio agwo agateebia oria rigata, “Nagoteebirie: Imoka, bwetweke oborere bwao, ogende bwoo.”
swahili: Lakini ili mpate kujua kwamba Mwana wa Adamu anayo mamlaka duniani kusamehe dhambi…” Akamwambia yule aliyepooza, “Nakuambia, inuka, chukua mkeka wako, uende nyumbani kwako.”

english: And immediately the man stood up before them, took what he had been lying on, and went home glorifying God.
ekegusii: Erio kegima agatenena ase obosio bwabo, akabogoria ekeraarero kiaye arenge koraarera, akagenda bwoye, ogotogia Nyasae.
swahili: Mara yule mtu aliyekuwa amepooza akasimama mbele yao wote, akachukua mkeka wake, akaenda zake nyumbani, huku akimtukuza Mungu.

english: Everyone was taken with amazement and glorified God. They were filled with awe and said, “We have seen remarkable things today.” Jesus Calls Levi (Matthew 9:9–13; Mark 2:13–17)
ekegusii: Ogokumia gokabwata bonsi, bagatogia Nyasae; bagaichorwa nokoiroka, bakaboora, “Twarorire amakumia reero.” Yeso okorangeria Lawi (Mat 9:9-13; Mar 2:13-17)
swahili: Kila mmoja akashangaa na kumtukuza Mungu. Wakajawa na hofu ya Mungu, wakasema, “Leo tumeona mambo ya ajabu.” Yesu Amwita Lawi (Mathayo 9:9-13; Marko 2:13-17)

english: After this, Jesus went out and saw a tax collector named Levi sitting at the tax booth. “Follow Me,” He told him,
ekegusii: Magega ase aya akaimoka, akarora omorusia ebango, erieta riaye Lawi, oikaransete aase bakoruseria ebango, akamoteebia, “Ntunyana!”
swahili: Baada ya haya, Yesu alitoka na kumwona mtoza ushuru mmoja jina lake Lawi akiwa amekaa forodhani, mahali pake pa kutoza ushuru. Akamwambia, “Nifuate.”

english: and Levi got up, left everything, and followed Him.
ekegusii: Agatiga bionsi, akaimoka, akamotunyana.
swahili: Naye Lawi akaacha kila kitu, akaondoka, akamfuata.

english: Then Levi hosted a great banquet for Jesus at his house. A large crowd of tax collectors was there, along with others who were eating with them.
ekegusii: Nere Lawi akamokorera omoyega omonene nyomba mwaye, naende mbarengeo omoganda bw’abarusia ebango na abanto bande baikaransete amo nabarabwo ase endagera.
swahili: Kisha Lawi akamfanyia Yesu karamu kubwa nyumbani kwake, nao umati mkubwa wa watoza ushuru na watu wengine walikuwa wakila pamoja nao.

english: Jesus got into the boat belonging to Simon and asked him to put out a little from shore. And sitting down, He taught the people from the boat.
ekegusii: Akariina obwato obomo obwarenge bwa Simioni akamobooria abotigerie are ake korwa ase engegu. Agaikaransa, akorokereria omoganda korwa ase obwato.
swahili: Akaingia katika mojawapo ya hizo mashua ambayo ilikuwa ya Simoni, akamwomba aisogeze ndani ya maji kidogo kutoka ufuoni. Kisha akaketi na kufundisha watu akiwa mle ndani ya mashua.

english: But the Pharisees and their scribes complained to Jesus’ disciples, “Why do you eat and drink with tax collectors and sinners?”
ekegusii: Abafarisai na aborokia b’amariiko babo bakemurunganeria aborokigwa baye, bakaboora, “Nase ki mokoria na konywa amo nabarusia ebango na abanyene ebibe?”
swahili: Lakini Mafarisayo na walimu wa sheria waliokuwa wa dhehebu lao wakawalalamikia wanafunzi wa Yesu, wakisema, “Mbona mnakula na kunywa pamoja na watoza ushuru na ‘wenye dhambi’?”

english: Jesus answered, “It is not the healthy who need a doctor, but the sick.
ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, “Abare buya tibari korigia omogwenia, otatiga abarwarete.
swahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Wenye afya hawahitaji tabibu, bali walio wagonjwa.

english: I have not come to call the righteous, but sinners, to repentance.” Questions about Fasting (Matthew 9:14–15; Mark 2:18–20)
ekegusii: Tincheti korangeria ababoronge korende abanyene ebibe baonchoke.” Riborio igoro y’okweng’ata (Mat 9:14-17; Mar 2:18-22)
swahili: Sikuja kuwaita wenye haki, bali wenye dhambi wapate kutubu.” Yesu Aulizwa Kuhusu Kufunga (Mathayo 9:14-17; Marko 2:18-22)

english: Then they said to Him, “John’s disciples and those of the Pharisees frequently fast and pray, but Yours keep on eating and drinking.”
ekegusii: Bakamoteebia, “Aborokigwa ba Yohana nigo bakweng’ata ebiro ebinge na gosaba, na aborokigwa b’Abafarisai nabo bagokora, korende abao nigo bakoria na konywa.”
swahili: Wakamwambia Yesu, “Wanafunzi wa Yohana na wa Mafarisayo mara kwa mara hufunga na kuomba, lakini wanafunzi wako wanaendelea kula na kunywa.”

english: Jesus replied, “Can you make the guests of the bridegroom fast while He is with them?
ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Inee! Inamonyare gotiga abachire ase enyangi beng’ate ekero omonywomi are amo nabarabwo?
swahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Je, mnaweza kuwafanya wageni wa bwana arusi kufunga wakati yuko pamoja nao?

english: But the time will come when the bridegroom will be taken from them; then they will fast.” The Patches and the Wineskins (Matthew 9:16–17; Mark 2:21–22)
ekegusii: Korende amatuko nache, barache kourwa omonywomi, erio nario barache kweng’ata ase amatuko aria.”
swahili: Lakini wakati utafika ambapo bwana arusi ataondolewa kwao. Hapo ndipo watakapofunga.”

english: He also told them a parable: “No one tears a piece of cloth from a new garment and sews it on an old one. If he does, he will tear the new garment as well, and the patch from the new will not match the old.
ekegusii: Akabateebia omoreng’anio: “Onde tari ogotandora ekeraka ki’eanga enyia na gokebeeka ase eanga engotu; aise gokora bo, natandore eria enyia, na ekeraka keria ki’eanga enyia tigekobwatana neanga eria engotu.
swahili: Yesu akawapa mfano huu, akawaambia: “Hakuna mtu achanaye kiraka kutoka kwenye nguo mpya na kukishonea kwenye nguo iliyochakaa. Akifanya hivyo, atakuwa amechana nguo mpya, na kile kiraka hakitalingana na ile nguo iliyochakaa.

english: And no one pours new wine into old wineskins. If he does, the new wine will burst the skins, the wine will spill, and the wineskins will be ruined.
ekegusii: Gose onde tari okobeeka edivai enyia ase ebirandi ebigotu biroisirie korwa ase amasankwa, gose edivai eria enyia nayaate ebirandi biria; edivai enyene eiteke, na ebirandi bitandoke.
swahili: Hakuna mtu awekaye divai mpya kwenye viriba vikuukuu. Akifanya hivyo, hiyo divai mpya itavipasua hivyo viriba, nayo yote itamwagika.

english: Instead, new wine is poured into new wineskins.
ekegusii: Korende edivai enyia negwenerete ebeekwe ase ebirandi ebiya.
swahili: Divai mpya lazima iwekwe kwenye viriba vipya.

english: And no one after drinking old wine wants new, for he says, ‘The old is better.’”
ekegusii: Gose omonto tari onyure edivai yaroisetigwe kare, naende arigie edivai enyia, ekiagera nigo agoteeba: Eria ya kare nengiya kobua.”
swahili: Wala hakuna mtu anayependelea divai mpya baada ya kunywa divai ya zamani, bali husema, ‘Ile ya zamani ni nzuri zaidi.’ ”

english: When Jesus had finished speaking, He said to Simon, “Put out into deep water and let down your nets for a catch.”
ekegusii: Goika agachia gokoora ogokwana kwaye, agateebia Simioni, “Sukia obwato goika endiba, moikie ebionga biaino ase okoruba.”
swahili: Alipomaliza kunena, akamwambia Simoni, “Sasa peleka mashua hadi kilindini kisha mshushe nyavu zenu mkavue samaki.”

english: “Master,” Simon replied, “we have worked hard all night without catching anything. But because You say so, I will let down the nets.”
ekegusii: Simioni akamoiraneria, “Omonene, nabo twakorire emeremo obotuko obogima, titonyoreti gento, korende ase ring’ana riao natoikie ebionga.”
swahili: Simoni akamjibu, “Bwana, tumefanya kazi ya kuchosha usiku kucha na hatukuvua chochote. Lakini, kwa neno lako nitazishusha nyavu.”

english: When they had done so, they caught such a large number of fish that their nets began to tear.
ekegusii: Kobakorire iga, bakanyora chinswe chinyinge mono, na ekero ebionga biabo biachaaka gotandoka,
swahili: Nao walipozishusha nyavu zao, wakavua samaki wengi sana, nyavu zao zikajaa zikaanza kukatika.

english: So they signaled to their partners in the other boat to come and help them, and they came and filled both boats so full that they began to sink.
ekegusii: bagasuma abagisangio babo, abarenge ase obwato bwa kabere, bache kobakonya. Bagacha, bagaichoria amaato onsi abere, goika agachaaka korimera.
swahili: Wakawaashiria wavuvi wenzao kwenye ile mashua nyingine ili waje kuwasaidia. Wakaja, wakajaza mashua zote mbili samaki hata zikaanza kuzama.

english: When Simon Peter saw this, he fell at Jesus’ knees. “Go away from me, Lord,” he said, “for I am a sinful man.”
ekegusii: Korende Simioni Petero, agachia korora aya, akagwa ase amaru a Yeso, akabora, “Omonene, karue ase ’nde, ekiagera inche nomonto omonyene ebibe!”
swahili: Simoni Petro alipoona haya yaliyotukia, alianguka miguuni mwa Yesu na kumwambia, “Bwana, ondoka kwangu. Mimi ni mtu mwenye dhambi!”

english: For he and his companions were astonished at the catch of fish they had taken,
ekegusii: Naki igo akumetie, ere na bonsi abarenge amo nere, ase oborubi bwe chinswe barubete;
swahili: Kwa kuwa yeye na wavuvi wenzake walikuwa wameshangazwa sana na wingi wa samaki waliokuwa wamepata.

english: One Sabbath Jesus was passing through the grainfields, and His disciples began to pick the heads of grain, rub them in their hands, and eat them.
ekegusii: Rituko ri’Esabato Yeso ngoeta arenge ase emegondo y’engano; aborokigwa baye bakabutora ebigara, bakabibunga namaboko abo, bakaria.
swahili: Ikawa siku moja ya Sabato Yesu alikuwa akipita katika mashamba ya nafaka, nao wanafunzi wake wakaanza kuvunja masuke ya nafaka, wakayafikicha kwa mikono yao na kula punje zake.

english: And after looking around at all of them, He said to the man, “Stretch out your hand.” He did so, and it was restored.
ekegusii: Akabarigereria bonsi, agateebia omonto oria, “Rambora okoboko kwao!” Agakora bo; okoboko kwaye gokagwenigwa.
swahili: Akawatazama watu wote waliokuwepo, kisha akamwambia yule aliyepooza mkono, “Nyoosha mkono wako!” Akaunyoosha na mkono wake ukaponywa kabisa.

english: But the scribes and Pharisees were filled with rage and began to discuss with one another what they might do to Jesus. The Twelve Apostles (Matthew 10:1–4; Mark 3:13–19)
ekegusii: Na barabwo bagaichorwa nokobea, bagateebania barabwo ase barabwo, buna baramokore Yeso. Yeso ogochora abatomwa ikomi na babere (Mat 10:1-4; Mar 3:13-19)
swahili: Wale wakuu wakakasirika sana, wakashauriana wao kwa wao ni nini watakachomtendea Yesu. Yesu Achagua Mitume Kumi Na Wawili (Mathayo 10:1-4; Marko 3:13-19)

english: In those days Jesus went out to the mountain to pray, and He spent the night in prayer to God.
ekegusii: Ase amatuko aria akaimoka akagenda ase egetunwa gosaba; akabao obotuko bwonsi ase ogosaba Nyasae.
swahili: Ikawa katika siku hizo Yesu alikwenda mlimani kuomba, akakesha usiku kucha akimwomba Mungu.

english: When daylight came, He called His disciples to Him and chose twelve of them, whom He also designated as apostles:
ekegusii: Bogachia gokia mambia akarangeria aborokigw baye, agachora korwa ase bare ikomi na babere, abwo arogete abatomwa.
swahili: Kulipopambazuka, akawaita wanafunzi wake, naye akachagua kumi na wawili, ambao pia aliwaita mitume:

english: Simon, whom He named Peter, and his brother Andrew; James and John; Philip and Bartholomew;
ekegusii: Simioni nere arogete Petero, na Anderea momura omwabo; Yakobo na Yohana, Filipo na Baritholomayo,
swahili: Simoni aliyemwita Petro, Andrea nduguye, Yakobo, Yohana, Filipo, Bartholomayo,

english: Matthew and Thomas; James son of Alphaeus and Simon called the Zealot;
ekegusii: na Matayo na Thomas, Yakobo bw’Alufayo, na Simioni oyomo bw’Abazelote,
swahili: Mathayo, Tomaso, Yakobo mwana wa Alfayo, Simoni aliyeitwa Zelote,

english: Judas son of James, and Judas Iscariot, who became a traitor. Jesus Heals the Multitudes (Matthew 4:23–25; Mark 3:7–12)
ekegusii: na Yuda o Yakobo, na Yudasi Iskariota, nere oyo omoruete.
swahili: Yuda mwana wa Yakobo, na Yuda Iskariote ambaye alikuwa msaliti. Yesu Aponya Wengi (Mathayo 4:23-25)

english: Then Jesus came down with them and stood on a level place. A large crowd of His disciples was there, along with a great number of people from all over Judea, Jerusalem, and the sea coast of Tyre and Sidon.
ekegusii: Agatirimboka amo nabarabwo, agatenena aase ateremu, amo nomoganda bw’aborokigwa baye; na omoganda bw’abaanto abaruete Boyahudi yonsi, na Yerusalemu, na engegu ya Turo na Sidoni, bagacha komoigwa na kogwenigwa amarwaire abo.
swahili: Akashuka pamoja nao, akasimama mahali penye uwanja tambarare. Hapo palikuwa na idadi kubwa ya wanafunzi wake na umati mkubwa wa watu kutoka sehemu zote za Uyahudi, kutoka Yerusalemu, na kutoka pwani ya Tiro na Sidoni.

english: They had come to hear Him and to be healed of their diseases, and those troubled by unclean spirits were healed.
ekegusii: Bagacha koigwa amang’ana aye boigo nakogwenigwa amarwaire abo, na abwo bachandire nebirecha bi’eubi bakagwenigwa.
swahili: Walikuwa wamekuja kumsikiliza na kuponywa magonjwa yao. Wale waliokuwa wakiteswa na pepo wachafu akawaponya.

english: The entire crowd was trying to touch Him, because power was coming from Him and healing them all. The Beatitudes (Psalms 1:1–6; Matthew 5:3–12)
ekegusii: Omoganda bwonsi okarigia komokuna, ekiagera chinguru chiare korua asare, chikabagwenia bonsi. Ogosesenigwa na okoragererigwa (Mat 5:1-12)
swahili: Watu wote walikuwa wanajitahidi kumgusa kwa sababu nguvu zilikuwa zikimtoka na kuwaponya wote. Baraka Na Ole (Mathayo 5:1-12)

english: But some of the Pharisees asked, “Why are you doing what is unlawful on the Sabbath?”
ekegusii: Korende abande ase Abafarisai bakababoria, “Naki mogokora aya’atagwenereti gokorwa ase rituko ri’Esabato?”
swahili: Baadhi ya Mafarisayo wakawauliza, “Mbona mnafanya mambo yasiyo halali kufanywa siku ya Sabato?”

english: Looking up at His disciples, Jesus said: “Blessed are you who are poor, for yours is the kingdom of God.
ekegusii: Yeso akaimokia amaiso aye ase aborokigwa baye, akabora, Imosesenirie inwe abamore abataka, ekiagera oborwoti bwa Nyasae nobwaino.
swahili: Akawatazama wanafunzi wake, akasema: “Mmebarikiwa ninyi mlio maskini, kwa sababu Ufalme wa Mungu ni wenu.

english: Blessed are you who hunger now, for you will be filled. Blessed are you who weep now, for you will laugh.
ekegusii: Imosesenirie inwe abamore nenchara bono, ekiagera namoigotigwe. “Imosesenirie inwe abamokorera bono, ekiagera namoseke.
swahili: Mmebarikiwa ninyi mlio na njaa sasa, kwa sababu mtashibishwa. Mmebarikiwa ninyi mnaolia sasa, kwa sababu mtacheka.

english: Blessed are you when people hate you, and when they exclude you and insult you and reject your name as evil because of the Son of Man.
ekegusii: “Imosesenirie inwe ekero Mwanyabaanto bakobagecha, na kobarusanania, na kobachaya, na gosaria amarieta aino buna nababe more, ase engencho y’Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto.
swahili: Mmebarikiwa ninyi, watu watakapowachukia, watakapowatenga na kuwatukana na kulikataa jina lenu kama neno ovu, kwa ajili ya Mwana wa Adamu.

english: Rejoice in that day and leap for joy, because great is your reward in heaven. For their fathers treated the prophets in the same way. Woes to the Satisfied (Amos 6:1–7)
ekegusii: Goka ase rituko riria, na gochenga, ekiagera ekeene eng’eria yaino nenene igoro; naki chisokoro chiabo nabo chiakorerete ababani engencho eyio eyio.
swahili: “Furahini na kurukaruka kwa shangwe, kwa sababu thawabu yenu ni kubwa mbinguni, kwa kuwa hivyo ndivyo baba zao walivyowatenda manabii.

english: But woe to you who are rich, for you have already received your comfort.
ekegusii: “Korende obobe nobwaino inwe abanda, ekiagera mwanyorire omogooko oino.
swahili: “Lakini ole wenu ninyi mlio matajiri, kwa sababu mmekwisha kupokea faraja yenu.

english: Woe to you who are well fed now, for you will hunger. Woe to you who laugh now, for you will mourn and weep.
ekegusii: “Obobe nobwaino inwe abamoigotete bono, ekiagera namoche koba nenchara. “Obobe nobwaino inwe abamogoseka bono, ekiagera namoche goichana na korera.
swahili: Ole wenu ninyi mlioshiba sasa, maana mtaona njaa. Ole wenu ninyi mnaocheka sasa, maana mtaomboleza na kulia.

english: Woe to you when all men speak well of you, for their fathers treated the false prophets in the same way. Love Your Enemies (Matthew 5:38–48)
ekegusii: “Obobe nobwaino inwe, ekero abanto bakobatogia, ekiagera chisokoro chiabo nabo chiakorerete ababani b’oborimo engencho eyio eyio. Obwanchani ase ababisa (Mat 5:38-48)
swahili: Ole wenu watu watakapowasifu, kwani ndivyo baba zao walivyowasifu manabii wa uongo. Wapendeni Adui Zenu (Mathayo 5:38-48)

english: But to those of you who will listen, I say: Love your enemies, do good to those who hate you,
ekegusii: “Korende nabateebirie inwe abamokoigwa: Ancha ababisa baino, bakorere amaya abwo baabagechete,
swahili: “Lakini nawaambia ninyi mnaonisikia: Wapendeni adui zenu. Watendeeni mema wanaowachukia.

english: bless those who curse you, pray for those who mistreat you.
ekegusii: basesenie abwo bakobaragereria, basabere abwo bakobakorera bobe.
swahili: Wabarikini wale wanaowalaani, waombeeni wale wanaowatendea mabaya.

english: If someone strikes you on one cheek, turn to him the other also. And if someone takes your cloak, do not withhold your tunic as well.
ekegusii: Oyo okogoaka orosea oromo, moonchorere noronde, na ere oyogokoura eanga ya isiko, tomorina neya ime.
swahili: Kama mtu akikupiga shavu moja, mgeuzie na la pili pia. Mtu akikunyangʼanya koti lako, usimzuie kuchukua joho pia.

english: Jesus replied, “Have you not read what David did when he and his companions were hungry?
ekegusii: Yeso akairaneria, “Timwana gosoma aya Daudi akorete, ekero arenge nenchara, ere na abarenge amo nere,
swahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Je, ninyi hamjasoma kamwe alivyofanya Daudi wakati yeye na wenzake walikuwa na njaa?

english: Give to everyone who asks you, and if anyone takes what is yours, do not demand it back.
ekegusii: Moe kera oyokogosaba; na oyogokoura ebinto biao tomoboria naende.
swahili: Mpe kila akuombaye, na kama mtu akichukua mali yako usitake akurudishie.

english: Do to others as you would have them do to you.
ekegusii: Naende buna morigetie abanto babakorere inwe, nainwe mobakorere bo.
swahili: Watendeeni wengine kama ambavyo mngetaka wawatendee ninyi.

english: If you love those who love you, what credit is that to you? Even sinners love those who love them.
ekegusii: “Komoranche abaabanchete inwe, imbuya ki moranyore? Ekiagera nonya nabanyene ebibe nigo banchete abwo baabanchete.
swahili: “Kama mkiwapenda tu wale wanaowapenda, mwapata sifa gani? Hata ‘wenye dhambi’ huwapenda wale wawapendao.

english: If you do good to those who do good to you, what credit is that to you? Even sinners do the same.
ekegusii: Komorabakorere amaya abwo abakobakorera inwe amaya, imbuya ki moranyore? Ekiagera nonya nabanyene ebibe nabo bagokora.
swahili: Tena mkiwatendea mema wale tu wanaowatendea ninyi mema, mwapata sifa gani? Hata ‘wenye dhambi’ hufanya vivyo hivyo.

english: And if you lend to those from whom you expect repayment, what credit is that to you? Even sinners lend to sinners, expecting to be repaid in full.
ekegusii: Naende komorarue singo ase abanto mosemeretie konyora egento korwa ase bare naende, imbuya ki moranyore? Ekiagera nonya nabanyene ebibe nigo bakorua singo ase abanyene ebibe, erinde banyore koreng’ana.
swahili: Tena mnapowakopesha wale tu mnaotegemea wawalipe, mwapata sifa gani? Hata ‘wenye dhambi’ huwakopesha ‘wenye dhambi’ wenzao wakitarajia kulipwa mali yao yote.

english: But love your enemies, do good to them, and lend to them, expecting nothing in return. Then your reward will be great, and you will be sons of the Most High; for He is kind to the ungrateful and wicked.
ekegusii: Korende mwanche ababisa baino, bakorere amaya, na korua singo, motari korengereria konyora egento gi’okoiranerigwa, eng’eria yaino nebe enene, na inwe namobe abana b’Oyore Igoro Mono, ekiagera ere nomuya ase abanto batari nokoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono, nonya nase abang’iti.
swahili: Lakini wapendeni adui zenu, watendeeni mema, wakopesheni bila kutegemea kurudishiwa mlichokopesha. Ndipo thawabu yenu itakapokuwa kubwa, nanyi mtakuwa wana wa Aliye Juu Sana, kwa sababu yeye ni mwema kwa watu wasio na shukrani na kwa wale waovu.

english: Be merciful, just as your Father is merciful. Judging Others (Matthew 7:1–6; Romans 14:1–12)
ekegusii: Mobe namaabera, buna Iso oino are namaabera. Igoro y’okogambia abande (Mat 7:1-5)
swahili: Kuweni na huruma, kama Baba yenu alivyo na huruma. Kuwahukumu Wengine (Mathayo 7:1-5)

english: Do not judge, and you will not be judged. Do not condemn, and you will not be condemned. Forgive, and you will be forgiven.
ekegusii: “Timogambia, nainwe timokogambigwa; timonachera, nainwe timokonacherwa; abera, nainwe namwaberwe;
swahili: “Msihukumu, nanyi hamtahukumiwa. Msilaumu, nanyi hamtalaumiwa. Sameheni, nanyi mtasamehewa.

english: Give, and it will be given to you. A good measure, pressed down, shaken together, and running over will be poured into your lap. For with the measure you use, it will be measured back to you.”
ekegusii: karue, nainwe namoegwe. Ekerengo ekiya keigateire, keinyageire, geichire, nakio abanto barabae inwe ase amaboko aino, ekiagera ekerengo keria mokorengera, nakio morache korengerwa nainwe.”
swahili: Wapeni watu vitu, nanyi mtapewa. Kipimo cha kujaa na kushindiliwa na kusukwasukwa hata kumwagika, ndicho watu watakachowapa vifuani mwenu. Kwa kuwa kipimo kile mpimacho, ndicho mtakachopimiwa.”

english: Jesus also told them a parable: “Can a blind man lead a blind man? Will they not both fall into a pit?
ekegusii: Akabateebia omoreng’anio, “Inee! Omouko nonyare koraa omouko onde? Tibakogwa bonsi babere ase engoro?
swahili: Pia akawapa mfano akasema, “Je, kipofu aweza kumwongoza kipofu? Je, wote wawili hawatatumbukia shimoni?

english: He entered the house of God, took the consecrated bread and gave it to his companions, and ate what is lawful only for the priests to eat.”
ekegusii: buna asoete ase enyomba ya Nyasae, akabogoria na koria emegati yarenge koruegwa ase Nyasae, etare boronge koriegwa nonde otatiga nabakuani boka, naende akaa abwo barenge amo nere?”
swahili: Aliingia ndani ya nyumba ya Mungu, akaichukua na kuila ile mikate iliyowekwa wakfu, ambayo ni halali kuliwa na makuhani peke yao. Naye pia akawapa wenzake.”

english: A disciple is not above his teacher, but everyone who is fully trained will be like his teacher.
ekegusii: Omworokigwa tari omonene kobua omworokia oye, korende kera oyomo gakoorire kworokererigwa nabe buna omworokia oye.
swahili: Mwanafunzi hawezi kumzidi mwalimu wake, ila yule aliyehitimu aweza kuwa kama mwalimu wake.

english: Why do you look at the speck in your brother’s eye, but fail to notice the beam in your own eye?
ekegusii: Inaki okorigereria ekeogoto kere ase eriso ri’oyomino, na omoribo ore ase eriso riao ime toyorochi?
swahili: “Mbona unatazama kibanzi kilicho ndani ya jicho la ndugu yako, wala huoni boriti iliyo ndani ya jicho lako mwenyewe?

english: How can you say, ‘Brother, let me take the speck out of your eye,’ while you yourself fail to see the beam in your own eye? You hypocrite! First take the beam out of your own eye, and then you will see clearly to remove the speck from your brother’s eye. A Tree and Its Fruit (Matthew 7:15–23; Matthew 12:33–37)
ekegusii: Gose naki orateebie oyomino: Oyominto, ntige nkorusie ekeogoto kere ase eriso riao ime, na aye omonyene torochi omoriibo ore ase eriso riao? Aye omong’ainereria, rusia ritang’ani omoribo ore ase eriso riao, nario orarore buya omanye korusia ekeogoto kere ase eriso ri’oyomino.
swahili: Utawezaje kumwambia ndugu yako, ‘Ndugu yangu, acha nitoe kibanzi kilicho ndani ya jicho lako,’ wakati wewe mwenyewe huoni boriti iliyo ndani ya jicho lako? Ewe mnafiki, ondoa boriti ndani ya jicho lako kwanza, ndipo utaweza kuona dhahiri jinsi ya kuondoa kibanzi kilicho ndani ya jicho la ndugu yako. Mti Na Mazao Yake (Mathayo 7:16-20; Marko 12:33-35)

english: No good tree bears bad fruit, nor does a bad tree bear good fruit.
ekegusii: “Naki tori omote omuya okwama amatunda amabe, gose omote omobe okwama amatunda amaya.
swahili: “Hakuna mti mzuri uzaao matunda mabaya, wala hakuna mti mbaya uzaao matunda mazuri.

english: For each tree is known by its own fruit. Indeed, figs are not gathered from thornbushes, nor grapes from brambles.
ekegusii: Kera omote nigo okomanyekana ase amatunda aye. Naki ase emetobo abanto tibari gotwa amako, gose ase emenyenya tibari gotwa amasabibu.
swahili: Kila mti hujulikana kwa matunda yake. Kwa maana watu hawachumi tini kwenye miiba, wala zabibu kwenye michongoma.

english: The good man brings good things out of the good treasure of his heart, and the evil man brings evil things out of the evil treasure of his heart. For out of the overflow of the heart, the mouth speaks. The House on the Rock (Matthew 7:24–27)
ekegusii: Omonto omuya ase emonga engiya y’enkoro yaye nigo akorua ayare amaya; na omonto omobe ase emonga yaye embe nigo akorua ayare amabe, ekiagera ebiichire ase enkoro, nabio omonwa ogokwana. Amaroso abere (Mat 7:24-27)
swahili: Vivyo hivyo mtu mwema hutoa mambo mema kutoka kwenye hazina ya moyo wake, naye mtu mwovu hutoa mambo maovu kutoka kwenye hazina ya moyo wake. Kwa kuwa mtu hunena kwa kinywa chake yale yaliyoujaza moyo wake. Mjenzi Mwenye Busara Na Mjenzi Mpumbavu (Mathayo 7:24-27)

english: Why do you call Me ‘Lord, Lord,’ but not do what I say?
ekegusii: “Nase ki mokondoka Omonene Nyasae, na inwe timori gokora aya ngoteeba?
swahili: “Kwa nini mnaniita, ‘Bwana, Bwana,’ nanyi hamfanyi ninayowaambia?

english: I will show you what he is like who comes to Me and hears My words and acts on them:
ekegusii: Kera omonto ogocha ase ’nde, na koigwa amang’ana aane, na koyakora, nimborokie buna are:
swahili: Nitawaonyesha jinsi alivyo mtu yule anayekuja kwangu na kusikia maneno yangu na kuyatenda.

english: He is like a man building a house, who dug down deep and laid his foundation on the rock. When the flood came, the torrent crashed against that house but could not shake it, because it was well built.
ekegusii: Nigo agwekaine nomonto oagachete enyomba, agakunya gochia inse mono, akabeeka oboroso bwaye igoro ase egetare. Ekero etoigo yachia gocha, eooro egaaka enyomba eria ne chinguru, tiyanyara koyenyegeria, ekiagera oboroso bwaye bwaagachetwe igoro ase egetare.
swahili: Yeye ni kama mtu aliyejenga nyumba, akachimba chini sana, na kuweka msingi kwenye mwamba. Mafuriko yalipokuja, maji ya ghafula yaliipiga ile nyumba, lakini haikutikisika, kwa sababu ilikuwa imejengwa vizuri.

english: But the one who hears My words and does not act on them is like a man who built his house on ground without a foundation. The torrent crashed against that house, and immediately it fell—and great was its destruction!”
ekegusii: Nere oyokoigwa otari gokora iga, nigo agwekaine nomonto oagachete enyomba igoro ase amaroba, etabegetwe oboroso. Nabo eooro ekayeaka ne chinguru, ekagwa bwango, na okogwa kw’enyomba eria gokaba okonene.”
swahili: Lakini yeye anayesikia maneno yangu wala asiyatende, ni kama mtu aliyejenga nyumba juu ya ardhi bila kuweka msingi. Mafuriko yalipoikumba nyumba ile, ikaanguka mara na kubomoka kabisa.”

english: Then Jesus declared, “The Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath.” Jesus Heals on the Sabbath (Matthew 12:9–14; Mark 3:1–6)
ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto nere Omonene bw’Esabato.”
swahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Mwana wa Adamu ndiye Bwana wa Sabato.” Mtu Aliyepooza Mkono Aponywa (Mathayo 12:9-14; Marko 3:1-6)

english: On another Sabbath Jesus entered the synagogue and was teaching, and a man was there whose right hand was withered.
ekegusii: Esabato ende agasoa ase esinagogi, akaorokereria. Narengeo omonto agwo, okoboko kwaye gw’okorio kwagataete.
swahili: Ikawa siku nyingine ya Sabato, Yesu aliingia ndani ya sinagogi na akawa anafundisha. Huko palikuwa na mtu ambaye mkono wake wa kuume ulikuwa umepooza.

english: Looking for a reason to accuse Jesus, the scribes and Pharisees were watching Him closely to see if He would heal on the Sabbath.
ekegusii: Aborokia b’amariiko na Abafarisai bakamotega korora gose namogwenie ase rituko ri’Esabato, banyare komosoera.
swahili: Mafarisayo na walimu wa sheria walikuwa wakitafuta sababu ya kumshtaki Yesu. Kwa hivyo wakawa wanamwangalia sana ili waone kama ataponya katika siku ya Sabato.

english: But Jesus knew their thoughts and said to the man with the withered hand, “Get up and stand among us.” So he got up and stood there.
ekegusii: Korende akamanya ebirengererio biabo, agateebia omonto oria okoboko kwaye kwagataete, “Imoka, otenene gati aa!” Akaimoka agatenena.
swahili: Lakini Yesu alijua mawazo yao, hivyo akamwambia yule mwenye mkono uliopooza, “Inuka usimame mbele ya watu wote.” Hivyo yule mtu akainuka, akasimama mbele yao wote.

english: Then Jesus said to them, “I ask you, which is lawful on the Sabbath: to do good or to do evil, to save life or to destroy it?”
ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Nkobaboria nde ring’ana erimo: Mboronge rituko ri’Esabato gokora amaya gose amabe, gotooria obogima gose kobosiria?”
swahili: Ndipo Yesu akawaambia wale walimu wa sheria na Mafarisayo, “Nawauliza ninyi, ni lipi lililo halali siku ya Sabato? Ni kutenda mema au kutenda mabaya? Ni kuokoa maisha au kuyaangamiza?”

english: When Jesus had concluded His discourse in the hearing of the people, He went to Capernaum.
ekegusii: Magega Yeso gakorire gokwana amang’ana onsi aria arigetie abanto baigwe, agasoa Kapernaumu.
swahili: Baada ya Yesu kumaliza kusema haya yote watu wakiwa wanamsikiliza, akaingia Kapernaumu.

english: And when the messengers returned to the house, they found the servant in good health. Jesus Raises a Widow’s Son
