ekegusii: Nabo baria batometwe bagachia koirana nyomba mwaye, bakanyora omosomba oria otimokire. Yeso okobokia omwana omomura bw’omoboraka
swahili: Nao wale watu waliokuwa wametumwa kwa Yesu waliporudi nyumbani walimkuta yule mtumishi amepona. Yesu Amfufua Mwana Wa Mjane

english: Soon afterward, Jesus went to a town called Nain. His disciples went with Him, accompanied by a large crowd.
ekegusii: Magega ase aya akagenda omochie okorokwa Naini; aborokigwa baye bakagenda amo nere, na abanto abange.
swahili: Baadaye kidogo, Yesu alikwenda katika mji mmoja ulioitwa Naini. Nao wanafunzi wake na umati mkubwa wa watu walikwenda pamoja naye.

english: As He approached the town gate, He saw a dead man being carried out, the only son of his mother, and she was a widow. And a large crowd from the town was with her.
ekegusii: Nabo, agachia goika ang’e ase egeita ki’omochie, rora, agwo nkiarengeo egetondo kebogoirie gocha isiko, omwana omomoima ase ng’ina, na ng’ina nomoboraka orenge, na abanto abange b’omochie mbarenge amo nere.
swahili: Alipokaribia lango la mji, alikutana na watu waliokuwa wamebeba maiti wakitoka nje ya mji. Huyu aliyekufa alikuwa mwana pekee wa mwanamke mjane. Umati mkubwa wa watu wa mji ule ulikuwa pamoja na huyo mwanamke.

english: When the Lord saw her, He had compassion on her and said, “Do not weep.”
ekegusii: Na ekero Omonene achia komoorora akamororera amaabera, akamoteebia, “Torera!”
swahili: Bwana Yesu alipomwona yule mjane, moyo wake ulimhurumia, akamwambia, “Usilie.”

english: Then He went up and touched the coffin, and those carrying it stood still. “Young man,” He said, “I tell you, get up!”
ekegusii: Akagenda ang’e, agakuna esanduki; baria babogoretie esanduki bagatenena. Erio agakwana, “Omomura, nagotebirie, imoka!”
swahili: Kisha akasogea mbele akaligusa lile jeneza na wale waliokuwa wamelibeba wakasimama kimya. Akasema, “Kijana, nakuambia inuka.”

english: And the dead man sat up and began to speak! Then Jesus gave him back to his mother.
ekegusii: Omonto oria egetondo akaboka, agaikaransa, agachaaka gokwana. Yeso akamomoa ng’ina.
swahili: Yule aliyekuwa amekufa akaketi akaanza kuongea, naye Yesu akamkabidhi kwa mama yake.

english: A sense of awe swept over all of them, and they glorified God. “A great prophet has appeared among us!” they said. “God has visited His people!”
ekegusii: Omoondoko okabwata bonsi, bagatogia, Nyasae, bakaboora, “Omobani omonene oorokire ase egati yaito!” Na “Nyasae ocheire abanto baye!”
swahili: Watu wote wakajawa na hofu ya Mungu, nao wakamtukuza Mungu wakisema, “Nabii mkuu ametokea miongoni mwetu, Mungu amekuja kuwakomboa watu wake.”

english: And the news about Jesus spread throughout Judea and all the surrounding region. John’s Inquiry (Matthew 11:1–6)
ekegusii: Chinkuma chiaye chigasarera ase ense yonsi ya Boyahudi, na ense yonsi yaetanaine. Abatomwa korwa ase Yohana omobatisi (Mat 11:2-19)
swahili: Habari hizi za mambo aliyoyafanya Yesu zikaenea Uyahudi wote na sehemu zote za jirani. Yesu Na Yohana Mbatizaji (Mathayo 11:2-19)

english: So John called two of his disciples and sent them to ask the Lord, “Are You the One who was to come, or should we look for someone else?”
ekegusii: erio Yohana akarangeria babere ase aborokigwa baye, akabatoma ase Omonene komoboria, “Aye naye oria ogocha, gose toganye omoao?”
swahili: na kuwatuma kwa Bwana ili kumuuliza, “Wewe ndiye yule aliyekuwa aje, au tumngojee mwingine?”

english: There a highly valued servant of a centurion was sick and about to die.
ekegusii: Omosomba oyomo bw’omotang’ani bw’abarwani rigana konya onyarekire nigo arenge ang’e nogokwa; ere nomonto anchete mono.
swahili: Mtumishi wa jemadari mmoja wa Kirumi, ambaye bwana wake alimthamini sana, alikuwa mgonjwa sana karibu kufa.

english: When the men came to Jesus, they said, “John the Baptist sent us to ask, ‘Are You the One who was to come, or should we look for someone else?’”
ekegusii: Ekero abanto abwo baikire asare, bakamoteebia, “Yohana Omobatisi ototomire ase ore, okobora: Aye naye oria ogocha, gose toganye omoao?”
swahili: Wale watu walipofika kwa Yesu wakamwambia, “Yohana Mbatizaji ametutuma tukuulize, ‘Wewe ndiye yule aliyekuwa aje, au tumngojee mwingine?’ ”

english: At that very hour Jesus healed many people of their diseases, afflictions, and evil spirits, and He gave sight to many who were blind.
ekegusii: Ase engaki eria Yeso akagwenia abanto abange abarenge namarwaire, na emechando, na babwatire n’Omoika omobe; na abange abarenge emeuko akabaramokia amaiso abo, bakarora.
swahili: Wakati huo huo, Yesu aliwaponya wengi waliokuwa na magonjwa, maradhi na pepo wachafu, na pia akawafungua vipofu wengi macho wakapata kuona.

english: So He replied, “Go back and report to John what you have seen and heard: The blind receive sight, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised, and the good news is preached to the poor.
ekegusii: Akabairaneria, akabateebia, “Genda moteebie Yohana ayamwarora na aya mwaigwa: Abarenge emeuko nkorora bare, abarenge amagata ngotaara bare, abarenge noborwaire bwa ukoma basibekire, abarenge emetino nkoigwa bare, abare ebitondo nkobokigwa bare, na abataka nkoranderigwa bare amang’ana amaya.
swahili: Hivyo akawajibu wale wajumbe, “Rudini mkamwambie Yohana yote mnayoyaona na kuyasikia: Vipofu wanapata kuona, viwete wanatembea, wenye ukoma wanatakaswa, viziwi wanasikia, wafu wanafufuliwa na maskini wanahubiriwa habari njema.

english: After John’s messengers had left, Jesus began to speak to the crowds about John: “What did you go out into the wilderness to see? A reed swaying in the wind?
ekegusii: Na abatomwa baria ba Yohana bachia kogenda, agachaaka goteebia omoganda igoro ya Yohana, “Inki mwachiete korora aria ase erooro? Egetonto gekonyegerigwa nembeo?
swahili: Wajumbe wa Yohana walipoondoka, Yesu akaanza kusema na makutano kuhusu Yohana Mbatizaji. Akawauliza, “Mlipokwenda kule nyikani, mlikwenda kuona nini? Je, ni unyasi ukipeperushwa na upepo?

english: Otherwise, what did you go out to see? A man dressed in fine clothes? Look, those who wear elegant clothing and live in luxury are found in palaces.
ekegusii: Ninki mwachiete korora? Nomonto oboyirie chianga chinterere? Rigereria, abakweboyia chianga chingiya mono, na koria obwansu bw’omogooko, nigo bare ase chinyomba chi’abarwoti.
swahili: Kama sivyo, mlikwenda kuona nini basi? Mtu aliyevaa mavazi ya kifahari? La hasha, watu wanaovaa mavazi ya kifahari na kuishi maisha ya anasa wako katika majumba ya kifalme.

english: What then did you go out to see? A prophet? Yes, I tell you, and more than a prophet.
ekegusii: Ninki mwachiete korora? Omobani? Ee, nabateebirie: Oyore omonene kobua omobani,
swahili: Lakini mlikwenda kuona nini? Mlikwenda kumwona nabii? Naam, nawaambia, yeye ni zaidi ya nabii.

english: This is the one about whom it is written: ‘Behold, I will send My messenger ahead of You, who will prepare Your way before You.’
ekegusii: ekiagera oyio nere amang’ana aya ariikire igoro yaye, “Rigereria, inche natomire omotomwa one ase obosio bwao, oyo oratang’ane koroisia enchera yao.
swahili: Huyu ndiye ambaye habari zake zimeandikwa: “ ‘Tazama, nitamtuma mjumbe wangu mbele yako, atakayetengeneza njia mbele yako.’

english: I tell you, among those born of women there is no one greater than John, yet even the least in the kingdom of God is greater than he.”
ekegusii: Nigo nkobateebia: Ase baria baiboire nabakungu, mobani onde taratoka ore omonene kobua Yohana, korende oyore omoke ase oborwoti bwa Nyasae nomonene komobua.”
swahili: Nawaambia, miongoni mwa wale waliozaliwa na wanawake, hakuna aliye mkuu kuliko Yohana. Lakini yeye aliye mdogo kabisa katika Ufalme wa Mungu ni mkuu kuliko Yohana.”

english: All the people who heard this, even the tax collectors, acknowledged God’s justice. For they had received the baptism of John.
ekegusii: (Abanto bonsi na abarusia ebango bagachia koigwa aya, bakaorokia oboronge bwa Nyasae, ekiagera baabatisetwe ase ebatiso ya Yohana;
swahili: (Watu wote hata watoza ushuru waliposikia maneno ya Yesu, walikubali kwamba mpango wa Mungu ni haki, maana walikuwa wamebatizwa na Yohana.

english: When the centurion heard about Jesus, he sent some Jewish elders to ask Him to come and heal his servant.
ekegusii: Agachia koigwa amang’ana igoro ya Yeso, agatoma asare abagaaka b’Abayahudi komoboria ache agwenie omosomba oye.
swahili: Jemadari huyo aliposikia habari za Yesu, aliwatuma wazee wa Kiyahudi kwake, wakamwomba aje kumponya mtumishi wa huyo jemadari.

english: But the Pharisees and experts in the law rejected God’s purpose for themselves, because they had not been baptized by John.
ekegusii: korende Abafarisai na abanto b’amachiiko bagakana omooroberio o Nyasae ase bare abanyene, ekiagera tibaabatisetwe na Yohana.)
swahili: Lakini Mafarisayo na wataalamu wa sheria walikataa mpango wa Mungu kwao kwa kutokubali kubatizwa na Yohana.)

english: “To what, then, can I compare the men of this generation? What are they like?
ekegusii: Yeso akagenderera gokwana akabora, “Ninki ndagwekanie abanto b’ekegori eke? Barabwo ninki bagwekaine?
swahili: Yesu akawauliza, “Niwafananishe na nini watu wa kizazi hiki? Wanafanana na nini?

english: They are like children sitting in the marketplace and calling out to one another: ‘We played the flute for you, and you did not dance; we sang a dirge, and you did not weep.’
ekegusii: Nigo bagwekaine nabana baikaransete ase echiiro, bakorangerania, bakobora, “Twababugeirie ebiroria, na inwe timotengeti; tweumirie, na inwe timorereti.
swahili: Wao ni kama watoto waliokaa sokoni wakiitana wao kwa wao, wakisema: “ ‘Tuliwapigia filimbi, lakini hamkucheza; tuliwaimbia nyimbo za maombolezo, lakini hamkulia.’

english: For John the Baptist came neither eating bread nor drinking wine, and you say, ‘He has a demon!’
ekegusii: Naki Yohana Omobatisi nigo achete, tare koria omogati, gose tare konywa edivai; na inwe mogoteeba: Nabwatire nekerecha.
swahili: Kwa maana Yohana Mbatizaji alikuja, alikuwa hali mkate wala hanywi divai, nanyi mkasema, ‘Yeye ana pepo mchafu.’

english: The Son of Man came eating and drinking, and you say, ‘Look at this glutton and drunkard, a friend of tax collectors and sinners!’
ekegusii: Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto ochire, okoria na konywa, na inwe mogoteeba: Rora, nomonto omoribobe, ogotinda edivai, omosani bw’ababarusia ebango na abanyene ebibe!
swahili: Mwana wa Adamu alikuja akila na kunywa, nanyi mnasema: ‘Tazameni huyu mlafi na mlevi, rafiki wa watoza ushuru na “wenye dhambi.” ’

english: But wisdom is vindicated by all her children.” A Sinful Woman Anoints Jesus (Matthew 26:6–13; Mark 14:3–9; John 12:1–8)
ekegusii: Korende obong’aini bwa Nyasae bwamanyekanire koba oboronge ase abana baye bonsi.” Yeso okwabera omokungu omonyabibe
swahili: Nayo hekima huthibitishwa kuwa kweli na watoto wake wote.” Yesu Apakwa Mafuta Na Mwanamke Mwenye Dhambi

english: Then one of the Pharisees invited Jesus to eat with him, and He entered the Pharisee’s house and reclined at the table.
ekegusii: Omonto oyomo bw’Abafarisai akamoarigania ache koria endagera amo nere. Agasoa ase enyomba y’Omofarisai oria, agaikaransa ase endagera.
swahili: Basi Farisayo mmoja alimwalika Yesu nyumbani kwake kwa chakula. Hivyo Yesu akaenda nyumbani mwa yule Farisayo na kukaa katika nafasi yake mezani.

english: When a sinful woman from that town learned that Jesus was dining there, she brought an alabaster jar of perfume.
ekegusii: Na rora, omokungu oyomo ase omochie oria, oyorenge omonyene ebibe, agachia konyora amang’ana ng’a oikaransire ase enyomba y’Omofarisai oria, akarenta echuba ye rigena rirabu ere namaguta e rimisu rigiya,
swahili: Naye mwanamke mmoja kwenye ule mji, ambaye alikuwa mwenye dhambi, alipojua kwamba Yesu alikuwa akila chakula nyumbani kwa yule Farisayo, akaleta chupa ya marhamu yenye manukato.

english: As she stood behind Him at His feet weeping, she began to wet His feet with her tears and wipe them with her hair. Then she kissed His feet and anointed them with the perfume.
ekegusii: agatenena korwa magega, ang’e namagoro aye, okorera. Agachaaka komoiyereria amariga aye ase amagoro aye, na koyatinyia netukia y’omotwe oye, okonyunyunta amagoro aye, na koyaaka amaguta aria.
swahili: Yule mwanamke akasimama nyuma ya miguu ya Yesu akilia. Akailowanisha miguu yake kwa machozi yake, kisha akaifuta kwa nywele zake, akaibusu na kuimiminia manukato.

english: When the Pharisee who had invited Jesus saw this, he said to himself, “If this man were a prophet, He would know who this is and what kind of woman is touching Him—for she is a sinner!”
ekegusii: Omofarisai, oria omoariganetie, agachia koyarora akeboria ase omoyo oye ime, ogoteeba, “Omonto oyo, onye nomobani orenge, anga namomanya oyo ng’a nere ng’o, gose mokuungu ki oyo okomokuna, ng’a nomonyene ebibe.”
swahili: Yule Farisayo aliyemwalika Yesu alipoona yanayotendeka, akawaza moyoni mwake, “Kama huyu mtu angekuwa nabii, angejua kwamba ni nani anayemgusa, na kwamba yeye ni mwanamke wa namna gani, na ya kuwa huyu mwanamke ni mwenye dhambi.”

english: They came to Jesus and pleaded with Him earnestly, “This man is worthy to have You grant this,
ekegusii: Na barabwo bagachia goika ase Yeso, bakamosorora, bakaboora, “Nagwenerete omokorere ring’ana eri,
swahili: Wale wazee walipofika kwa Yesu, wakamsihi sana amsaidie yule jemadari wakisema, “Mtu huyu anastahili wewe umfanyie jambo hili,

english: But Jesus answered him, “Simon, I have something to tell you.” “Tell me, Teacher,” he said.
ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Simioni, ninde ne ring’ana nkogoteebia.” Akabora, “Omworokia, kwana.”
swahili: Yesu akanena akamwambia, “Simoni, nina jambo la kukuambia.” Simoni akajibu, “Mwalimu, sema.”

english: “Two men were debtors to a certain moneylender. One owed him five hundred denarii, and the other fifty.
ekegusii: “Omonto oyomo omorua singo orenge nabasira babere; oyomo omoriete esira ye chidinari amagana atano (500), na oyo o kabere emerongo etano (50).
swahili: “Palikuwa na mtu mmoja aliyewakopesha watu wawili fedha: Mmoja alidaiwa dinari 500 na mwingine dinari hamsini.

english: When they were unable to repay him, he forgave both of them. Which one, then, will love him more?”
ekegusii: Barabwo tibarenge na gento bagoakana. Akabaabera bonsi babere. Gaki, ase abwo, ning’o oramwanche kobua?”
swahili: Wote wawili walipokuwa hawawezi kulipa, aliyafuta madeni yao wote wawili. Sasa ni yupi kati yao atakayempenda yule aliyewasamehe zaidi?”

english: “I suppose the one who was forgiven more,” Simon replied. “You have judged correctly,” Jesus said.
ekegusii: Simioni akairaneria, “Igo ndabore ng’a, noria bwaberetwe ebinge.” Yeso akamoteebia, “Kwanachire boronge.”
swahili: Simoni akajibu, “Nadhani ni yule aliyesamehewa deni kubwa zaidi.” Naye Yesu akamwambia, “Umehukumu kwa usahihi.”

english: And turning toward the woman, He said to Simon, “Do you see this woman? When I entered your house, you did not give Me water for My feet, but she wet My feet with her tears and wiped them with her hair.
ekegusii: Akaonchoka gochia ase omokungu oria, agateebia Simioni, “Kwarorire omokungu oyo? Inasoa mwao, tikwang’a amaache ay’ogwesibia amagoro, korende oyo osibirie amagoro aane namariga aye, na koyatinyia netukia y’omotwe oye.
swahili: Kisha akamgeukia yule mwanamke, akamwambia Simoni, “Je, unamwona mwanamke huyu? Nilipoingia nyumbani mwako, hukunipa maji ya kunawa miguu yangu, lakini huyu ameninawisha miguu kwa machozi yake, na kunifuta kwa nywele zake.

english: You did not greet Me with a kiss, but she has not stopped kissing My feet since I arrived.
ekegusii: Tonyunyunteti, korende ere korwa ekero nasoete aa tatigeti konyunyunta amagoro aane.
swahili: Hukunisalimu kwa busu, lakini huyu mwanamke hajaacha kuibusu miguu yangu tangu nilipoingia.

english: You did not anoint My head with oil, but she has anointed My feet with perfume.
ekegusii: Tong’ageti omotwe one amaguta, korende ere ong’akire amagoro aane amaguta agotioka buya.
swahili: Hukunipaka mafuta kichwani mwangu, lakini yeye ameipaka miguu yangu manukato.

english: Therefore I tell you, because her many sins have been forgiven, she has loved much. But he who has been forgiven little loves little.”
ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio nagotebirie, obwanchani bwaye bworokirie ng’a ebibe biaye ebinge biabeirwe; ere oyokwaberwa ebike nigo anchete ake.”
swahili: Kwa hiyo, nakuambia, dhambi zake zilizokuwa nyingi zimesamehewa, kwani ameonyesha upendo mwingi. Lakini yule aliyesamehewa kidogo, hupenda kidogo.”

english: Then Jesus said to her, “Your sins are forgiven.”
ekegusii: Agateebia omokungu oria, “Kwabeirwe ebibe biao.”
swahili: Kisha akamwambia yule mwanamke, “Dhambi zako zimesamehewa.”

english: But those at the table began to say to themselves, “Who is this who even forgives sins?”
ekegusii: Na baria baikaransete amo nere bagachaaka goteeba ase emioyo yabo ime, “Nere ng’o oyo oranyare kwabera ebibe?”
swahili: Lakini wale waliokuwa wameketi pamoja naye chakulani wakaanza kusemezana wao kwa wao, “Huyu ni nani ambaye hata anasamehe dhambi?”

english: for he loves our nation and has built our synagogue.”
ekegusii: ekiagera nanchete abanto baito, naende natoagacherete esinagogi yaito.”
swahili: kwa sababu analipenda taifa letu tena ametujengea sinagogi.”

english: And Jesus told the woman, “Your faith has saved you; go in peace.”
ekegusii: Agateebia omokungu oria, “Okwegena kwao kwagotooririe; genda nomorembe.”
swahili: Yesu akamwambia yule mwanamke, “Imani yako imekuokoa; nenda kwa amani.”

english: So Jesus went with them. But when He was not far from the house, the centurion sent friends with the message: “Lord, do not trouble Yourself, for I am not worthy to have You come under my roof.
ekegusii: Yeso akagenda amo nabarabwo. Goika agachia koba tari are ase enyomba yaye, oria omotang’ani bw’abarwani agatoma abasani asare, okomoteebia, “Omonene, tibwerosia, ekiagera inche ting’isaini aye orasoe inse y’ekerama kiane.
swahili: Hivyo Yesu akaongozana nao, lakini alipokuwa hayuko mbali na nyumbani, yule jemadari akatuma rafiki zake kumwambia Yesu, “Bwana, usijisumbue, kwani mimi sistahili wewe kuingia chini ya dari yangu.

english: That is why I did not consider myself worthy to come to You. But just say the word, and my servant will be healed.
ekegusii: Ase ayio nigo neroche ng’a ting’isaini gocha ase ore; korende kwana ring’ana rioka, na omosomba one nagwene.
swahili: Ndiyo maana sikujiona hata ninastahili kuja kwako wewe. Lakini sema neno tu, naye mtumishi wangu atapona.

english: For I myself am a man under authority, with soldiers under me. I tell one to go, and he goes; and another to come, and he comes. I tell my servant to do something, and he does it.”
ekegusii: Naki inche nomonto mbekire inse ase okobua, naende ninde nabasikari inse yane. Kondateebie oyo: Genda, ogenda, na oyonde: Inchuo, ocha; na omosomba one: Kora iga, okora.”
swahili: Kwa kuwa mimi mwenyewe ni mtu niliyewekwa chini ya mamlaka, nikiwa na askari chini yangu. Nikimwambia huyu, ‘Nenda,’ yeye huenda; na mwingine nikimwambia, ‘Njoo,’ yeye huja. Nikimwambia mtumishi wangu, ‘Fanya hivi,’ yeye hufanya.”

english: When Jesus heard this, He marveled at the centurion. Turning to the crowd following Him, He said, “I tell you, not even in Israel have I found such great faith.”
ekegusii: Yeso agachia koigwa aya, agakumia asare, akeonchorera omoganda orenge komotunyana, akabora, “Nabatebirie: Nonya nase Abaisraeli tindanyora okwegena okore buna oko.”
swahili: Yesu aliposikia maneno haya, alishangazwa naye sana. Akaugeukia ule umati wa watu uliokuwa unamfuata, akawaambia, “Sijaona imani kubwa namna hii hata katika Israeli.”

english: Soon afterward, Jesus traveled from one town and village to another, preaching and proclaiming the good news of the kingdom of God. The Twelve were with Him,
ekegusii: Magega ase aya, akaba ngoetanana are ase emechie na ebichie, okorandia na kobateebia amang’ana amaya ay’oborwoti bwa Nyasae. Na baria ikomi na babere nigo barenge amo nere,
swahili: Baada ya haya Yesu alikwenda, akawa anazunguka katika miji na vijiji akihubiri habari njema za Ufalme wa Mungu. Wale wanafunzi wake kumi na wawili walikuwa pamoja naye,

english: He replied, “The knowledge of the mysteries of the kingdom of God has been given to you, but to others I speak in parables, so that, ‘though seeing, they may not see; though hearing, they may not understand.’
ekegusii: Agateeba, “Inwe mwaeirwe komanya obobisi bw’oborwoti bwa Nyasae; korende abande nabateebigwe ase emereng’anio, erinde okong’ereria bariingererie, korende tibarora, naende ogotegerera bategerere, korende tibaigwa.
swahili: Naye akasema, “Ninyi mmepewa kufahamu siri za Ufalme wa Mungu, lakini kwa wengine nazungumza kwa mifano, ili, “ ‘ingawa wanatazama, wasione; ingawa wanasikiliza, wasielewe.’

english: Now this is the meaning of the parable: The seed is the word of God.
ekegusii: Omoreng’anio noro oyo: Embusuro nering’ana ria Nyasae.
swahili: “Maana ya mfano huu ni hii: Mbegu ni neno la Mungu.

english: The seeds along the path are those who hear, but the devil comes and takes away the word from their hearts, so that they may not believe and be saved.
ekegusii: Baria b’enchera ensemo, nabwo baikire koriigwa; erio Saitani ochicha, na korusia ring’ana riria ase chinkoro chiabo, erinde tibacha kwegena batooreke.
swahili: Zile zilizoanguka kando ya njia ni wale ambao husikia neno, naye ibilisi anakuja na kuliondoa neno kutoka mioyoni mwao, ili wasije wakaamini na kuokoka.

english: The seeds on rocky ground are those who hear the word and receive it with joy, but they have no root. They believe for a season, but in the time of testing, they fall away.
ekegusii: Na baria bare ase egetare nabwo baria bakoigwa ring’ana, baribwata nomogooko, korende barabwo tibari nemeri, begena ase ekero egeke, na ekero ki’ogoteemwa beatanana.
swahili: Zile mbegu zilizoanguka kwenye mwamba ni wale ambao hulipokea neno kwa furaha wanapolisikia, lakini hawana mizizi. Wanaamini kwa muda mfupi, lakini wakati wa kujaribiwa huiacha imani.

english: The seeds that fell among the thorns are those who hear, but as they go on their way, they are choked by the worries, riches, and pleasures of this life, and their fruit does not mature.
ekegusii: Na echio chiagwete ase amagwa, aba nabwo bakoriigwa, na barabwo kobakogenderera bamigwa nokorengereria kw’enibo, na omogooko bw’ense eye, tibakwama ase ogoikerania.
swahili: Zile mbegu zilizoanguka kwenye miiba ni mfano wa wale wanaosikia, lakini wanapoendelea husongwa na masumbufu ya maisha haya, utajiri na anasa, nao hawakui.

english: But the seeds on good soil are those with a noble and good heart, who hear the word, cling to it, and by persevering produce a crop. The Lesson of the Lamp (Mark 4:21–25)
ekegusii: Na echinde chire ase amaroba amaya; aba nabwo bare ne chinkoro chingiya naende echi’ekeene, bakoigwa ring’ana, baribwata, bama okwama noboremereria. Okworokereria korwa ase etaya (Mat 4:21-25)
swahili: Lakini zile mbegu zilizoanguka kwenye udongo mzuri ni mfano wa wale ambao hulisikia neno la Mungu na kulishika kwa moyo mnyofu wa utiifu, nao kwa kuvumilia kwingi huzaa matunda. Mfano Wa Taa (Marko 4:21-25)

english: No one lights a lamp and covers it with a jar or puts it under a bed. Instead, he sets it on a stand, so those who enter can see the light.
ekegusii: “Omonto onde tari ogotongia etaya na koyemumeka negento, gose koyebeeka nyaro y’oborere; korende nigo akoyebeeka igoro ase ekebekerero kiaye, erinde abagosoa barore oborabu.
swahili: “Hakuna mtu awashaye taa na kuificha ndani ya gudulia au kuiweka mvunguni mwa kitanda. Badala yake, huiweka juu ya kinara, ili wale waingiao ndani waone mwanga.

english: For there is nothing hidden that will not be disclosed, and nothing concealed that will not be made known and brought to light.
ekegusii: Ekiagera ring’ana tiriri ribisegete, ritache koorokigwa, gose eria bobisi ritache komanyekana maiso marore.
swahili: Kwa maana hakuna jambo lolote lililofichika ambalo halitafichuliwa, wala lolote lililositirika ambalo halitajulikana na kuwekwa wazi.

english: Pay attention, therefore, to how you listen. Whoever has will be given more, but whoever does not have, even what he thinks he has will be taken away from him.” Jesus’ Mother and Brothers (Matthew 12:46–50; Mark 3:31–35)
ekegusii: Mwerende gaki inwe buna mokoigwa, ekiagera ere oyobwate naegwe, korende oyotabwati, naurwe nonya nkeria arengereretie abwate.” Obomwabo bw’ekeene (Mat 12:46-50; Mar 3:31-35)
swahili: Kwa hiyo, kuweni waangalifu mnavyosikia. Kwa maana yeyote aliye na kitu atapewa zaidi. Lakini yule asiye na kitu, hata kile anachodhani anacho atanyangʼanywa.” Mama Yake Yesu Na Ndugu Zake (Mathayo 12:46-50; Marko 3:31-35)

english: Then Jesus’ mother and brothers came to see Him, but they were unable to reach Him because of the crowd.
ekegusii: Ng’ina na bamura bamwabo bakamochiera, korende tibanyara komoika ang’e ase engencho y’omoganda.
swahili: Wakati mmoja mama yake Yesu na ndugu zake walikuja kumwona, lakini hawakuweza kumfikia kwa sababu ya msongamano wa watu.

english: as well as some women who had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities: Mary called Magdalene, from whom seven demons had gone out,
ekegusii: na abakungu bande ababwatire n’emeika emebe bakagwenigwa nere: Mariamu ore korokwa Magidalena, oria orusetigwe ebirecha bitano na bibere,
swahili: pia baadhi ya wanawake waliokuwa wametolewa pepo wachafu na kuponywa magonjwa. Miongoni mwao alikuwepo Maria Magdalene, aliyetolewa pepo wachafu saba;

english: He was told, “Your mother and brothers are standing outside, wanting to see You.”
ekegusii: Akairerwa amang’ana agateebigwa, “Nyoko na bamura bamino mbateneine isiko, baganetie kororana naye.”
swahili: Mtu mmoja akamwambia, “Mama yako na ndugu zako wako nje wanataka kukuona.”

english: But He replied, “My mother and brothers are those who hear the word of God and carry it out.” Jesus Calms the Storm (Psalms 107:1–43; Matthew 8:23–27; Mark 4:35–41)
ekegusii: Korende akabateebia, “Baba na bamura baminto nabwo aba abakoigwa ring’ana ria Nyasae na korikora.” Yeso ogotoereria omwaga (Mat 8:23-27; Mar 4:35-41)
swahili: Yesu akamjibu, “Mama yangu na ndugu zangu ni wale wote wanaolisikia neno la Mungu na kulifanya.” Yesu Atuliza Dhoruba (Mathayo 8:23-27; Marko 4:35-41)

english: One day Jesus said to His disciples, “Let us cross to the other side of the lake.” So He got into a boat with them and set out.
ekegusii: Rituko erimo akariina obwato, ere na aborokigwa baye, akabateebia, “Twamboke gochia ng’umbu y’enyancha.” Bakamanora.
swahili: Siku moja Yesu alipanda ndani ya mashua pamoja na wanafunzi wake, akawaambia, “Tuvukeni twende mpaka ngʼambo ya ziwa.” Nao wakaondoka.

english: As they sailed, He fell asleep, and a windstorm came down on the lake, so that the boat was being swamped, and they were in great danger.
ekegusii: Kobachia kogenda, akarara chitoro; omwaga ogaacha, na emerindo ase enyancha, obwato bogaachaka goichorwa namaache, bakaba ase emechando.
swahili: Hivyo walipokuwa wakienda, akalala usingizi. Dhoruba kali ikatokea mle ziwani, hata mashua ikawa inajaa maji, nao walikuwa katika hatari kubwa.

english: The disciples went and woke Him, saying, “Master, Master, we are perishing!” Then Jesus got up and rebuked the wind and the raging waters, and they subsided, and all was calm.
ekegusii: Bakamochiera, bakamotura, bakaboora, “Omonene Nyasae, ngosira tore!” Erio ere akaboka, agatogonyera omwaga na emerindo y’amaache, na birobio bigakira, gokaba ogotoerera.
swahili: Wanafunzi wake wakamwendea na kumwamsha, wakisema, “Bwana, Bwana, tunaangamia!” Yeye akaamka, akaukemea ule upepo na yale mawimbi; dhoruba ikakoma, nako kukawa shwari.

english: “Where is your faith?” He asked. Frightened and amazed, they asked one another, “Who is this? He commands even the winds and the water, and they obey Him!” The Demons and the Pigs (Matthew 8:28–34; Mark 5:1–20)
ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Okwegena kwaino, ng’ai kore?” Bakairoka, bagakumia bagateebania, “Oyo nere ng’o, ogochika nonya nomwaga na enyancha, bikomoigwera?” Yeso okogwenia Omogeraseni obwatire nebirecha (Mat 8:28-34; Mar 5:1-20)
swahili: Akawauliza wanafunzi wake, “Imani yenu iko wapi?” Kwa woga na mshangao wakaulizana, “Huyu ni nani, ambaye anaamuru hata upepo na maji, navyo vikamtii?” Yesu Amponya Mtu Mwenye Pepo Mchafu (Mathayo 8:28-34; Marko 5:1-20)

english: Then they sailed to the region of the Gerasenes, across the lake from Galilee.
ekegusii: Bagaika engegu y’ense y’Abageraseni, erigereretie Galili.
swahili: Basi wakafika katika nchi ya Wagerasi, ambayo iko upande wa pili wa ziwa kutoka Galilaya.

english: When Jesus stepped ashore, He was met by a demon-possessed man from the town. For a long time this man had not worn clothing or lived in a house, but he stayed in the tombs.
ekegusii: Agachia goika engegu, akaumerana nomonto oyomo bw’omochie oria, obwatire nebirecha; na ase amatuko amange tarenge kweboyia chianga, tarenge komenya nyomba, otatiga ase chimbeera.
swahili: Yesu aliposhuka kutoka mashua na kukanyaga ufuoni, alikutana na mtu mmoja wa mji ule aliyekuwa amepagawa na pepo mchafu, naye kwa muda mrefu alikuwa havai nguo wala kuishi nyumbani, bali aliishi makaburini.

english: When the man saw Jesus, he cried out and fell down before Him, shouting in a loud voice, “What do You want with me, Jesus, Son of the Most High God? I beg You not to torture me!”
ekegusii: Agachia korora Yeso, agaaka egeturi, akagwa ase obosio bwaye, agakwana neriogi rinene, okobora, “Inaki inde naye, Yeso, Omwana o Nyasae Ore Igoro Mono? Nagosabire, tonchanda.”
swahili: Alipomwona Yesu, alipiga kelele, akajitupa chini mbele yake na kusema kwa sauti kuu, “Una nini nami, Yesu, Mwana wa Mungu Aliye Juu Sana? Nakuomba, usinitese!”

english: For Jesus had commanded the unclean spirit to come out of the man. Many times it had seized him, and though he was bound with chains and shackles, he had broken the chains and been driven by the demon into solitary places.
ekegusii: Naki konya ochikiire ekerecha keria ki’eubi gesoke korwa ase omonto oria. (Ekiagera ebiro ebinge nigo kiare komobwata; nonya orenge gosibwa nebinyuri ne chingataare na korendwa, nigo arenge kobutora ebisibo biria oirwa nekerecha keria goika ase erooro.)
swahili: Wakati huo Yesu alikuwa amemwamuru yule pepo mchafu amtoke huyo mtu. Mara nyingi huyo pepo mchafu alimpagaa, na hata alipofungwa kwa minyororo mikono na miguu na kuwekwa chini ya ulinzi, alikata hiyo minyororo na kupelekwa na huyo pepo mchafu kwenda nyikani.

english: Joanna the wife of Herod’s household manager Chuza, Susanna, and many others. These women were ministering to them out of their own means. The Parable of the Sower (Matthew 13:1–23; Mark 4:1–20)
ekegusii: na Yoana moka Kusa, omorendi bwe Herode, na Susana, na abande abange. Abwo nigo barenge kobakorera ne chinibo chiabo. Omoreng’anio bw’omobusuri (Mat 13:1-9; Mar 4:1-9)
swahili: Yoana mkewe Kuza, msimamizi wa nyumba ya watu wa nyumbani mwa Herode; Susana; na wengine wengi waliokuwa wakimhudumia kwa mali zao.

english: “What is your name?” Jesus asked. “Legion,” he replied, because many demons had gone into him.
ekegusii: Yeso akamobooria, “Naki okorokwa?” Akairaneria, “Elegioni”, ekiagera ebirecha ebinge biamosoete.
swahili: Yesu akamuuliza, “Jina lako ni nani?” Akamjibu, “Legioni,” kwa kuwa alikuwa ameingiwa na pepo wachafu wengi mno.

english: And the demons kept begging Jesus not to order them to go into the Abyss.
ekegusii: Bikamosorora tabichika bigende goika ase eora entambe.
swahili: Wale pepo wachafu wakamsihi sana asiwaamuru kwenda katika Shimo.

english: There on the hillside a large herd of pigs was feeding. So the demons begged Jesus to let them enter the pigs, and He gave them permission.
ekegusii: Ndiarengeo riicho rinene rie chimbeche, chiare korisia ase egetunwa, bikamosorora abie ribaga bichisoe. Akabia ribaga.
swahili: Palikuwa na kundi kubwa la nguruwe hapo likilisha kando ya kilima. Wale pepo wachafu wakamsihi Yesu awaruhusu wawaingie hao nguruwe, naye akawaruhusu.

english: Then the demons came out of the man and went into the pigs, and the herd rushed down the steep bank into the lake and was drowned.
ekegusii: Ebirecha biria bigasoka korwa ase omonto oria, bigasoa chimbeche. Riicho riria rigatirimboka bwango gochia ase egeturunkano goika chikagwa enyancha ime, chikarimera.
swahili: Wale pepo wachafu walipomtoka yule mtu, wakawaingia wale nguruwe, nalo kundi lote likateremkia gengeni kwa kasi, likatumbukia ziwani na kuzama.

english: When those tending the pigs saw what had happened, they ran off and reported this in the town and countryside.
ekegusii: Abarisia bagachia korora ayio, bagatama, bakararia amang’ana ase omochie na ebichie.
swahili: Wale watu waliokuwa wakichunga lile kundi la nguruwe walipoona yaliyotukia, wakakimbia, wakaeneza habari hizi mjini na mashambani.

english: So the people went out to see what had happened. They came to Jesus and found the man whom the demons had left, sitting at Jesus’ feet, clothed and in his right mind; and they were afraid.
ekegusii: Abanto bagasoka barore amang’ana aorokire; bagachiera Yeso, bakarora omonto oria orusetigwe ebirecha biria oikaransete ase amagoro a Yeso obegete chianga, ore nebirengererio ebironge, bakairoka.
swahili: Nao watu wakatoka kwenda kujionea wenyewe yaliyotukia. Walipofika hapo alipokuwa Yesu, wakamkuta yule mtu aliyetokwa na pepo wachafu amekaa karibu na Yesu, akiwa amevaa nguo na mwenye akili timamu! Wakaogopa.

english: Meanwhile, those who had seen it reported how the demon-possessed man had been healed.
ekegusii: Na baria bayaroche bakabateebia buna oria obwatire nebirecha agwenetigwe.
swahili: Wale walioyaona mambo hayo wakawaeleza watu wengine jinsi yule mtu aliyekuwa amepagawa na pepo wachafu alivyoponywa.

english: Then all the people of the region of the Gerasenes asked Jesus to depart from them, because great fear had taken hold of them. So He got into the boat and started back.
ekegusii: Naboigo abanto bonsi b’ense y’Abageraseni bakamobooria arue ase bare, ekiagera basoetwe nokoiroka okonene. Erio akariina obwato, akairana.
swahili: Ndipo watu wote wa nchi ile ya Wagerasi wakamwomba Yesu aondoke kwao, kwa sababu walikuwa wamejawa na hofu. Basi akaingia katika mashua, akaondoka zake.

english: The man whom the demons had left begged to go with Jesus. But He sent him away, saying,
ekegusii: Na omonto oria orusetigwe ebirecha akamosorora abe amo nere, korende Yeso akamokania, akabora,
swahili: Yule mtu aliyetokwa na pepo wachafu akamsihi Yesu afuatane naye, lakini Yesu akamuaga, akamwambia:

english: “Return home and describe how much God has done for you.” So the man went away and proclaimed all over the town how much Jesus had done for him. The Healing Touch of Jesus (Matthew 9:18–26; Mark 5:21–43)
ekegusii: “Irana nka bwoo orarie amang’ana amanene aya Nyasae agokoreire.” Akagenda bwoye, akararia ase omochie omogima amang’ana amanene aya Yeso amokoreire. Omoiseke o Yairo okobokigwa, na omokungu oyorenge noborwaire bw’okorua amanyinga okogwenigwa (Mat 9:18-26; Mar 5:21-43)
swahili: “Rudi nyumbani ukawaeleze mambo makuu Mungu aliyokutendea.” Kwa hiyo yule mtu akaenda, akatangaza katika mji wote mambo makuu ambayo Yesu alimtendea. Msichana Afufuliwa, Na Mwanamke Aponywa (Mathayo 9:18-26; Marko 5:21-43)

english: While a large crowd was gathering and people were coming to Jesus from town after town, He told them this parable:
ekegusii: Ekero omoganda omonene osangererekanete, na abanto ba kera omochie bakamochiera, agakwana ase omoreng’anio:
swahili: Umati mkubwa wa watu ulipokuwa ukija kwa Yesu kutoka kila mji, akawaambia mfano huu:

english: When Jesus returned, the crowd welcomed Him, for they had all been waiting for Him.
ekegusii: Yeso agachia koirana, omosangererekano okamogokera, ekiagera abanto bonsi bamoganyete.
swahili: Basi Yesu aliporudi, umati mkubwa wa watu ukampokea kwa furaha, kwani walikuwa wakimngojea.

english: Just then a synagogue leader named Jairus came and fell at Jesus’ feet. He begged Him to come to his house,
ekegusii: Omonto oyomo, erieta riaye Yairo, omotang’ani bw’esinagogi, agacha, akagwa ase amagoro a Yeso, akamosorora asoe nyomba mwaye,
swahili: Kisha mtu mmoja, jina lake Yairo, aliyekuwa kiongozi wa sinagogi, akaja na kuanguka miguuni mwa Yesu, akimwomba afike nyumbani kwake,

english: because his only daughter, who was about twelve, was dying. As Jesus went with him, the crowds pressed around Him,
ekegusii: ekiagera narenge nomoiseke, omwana omomoima, konya okoorire emiaka ikomi na ebere, na ere nigo arenge ang’e ogokwa. Ekero Yeso arenge kogenda abanto bakaba bakomomiga‐miga.
swahili: kwa kuwa binti yake wa pekee, mwenye umri wa miaka kumi na miwili, alikuwa anakufa. Yesu alipokuwa akienda, umati wa watu ukamsonga sana.

english: including a woman who had suffered from bleeding for twelve years. She had spent all her money on physicians, but no one was able to heal her.
ekegusii: Naende omokungu oyomo oyorenge noborwaire bw’okorua amanyinga ase engaki y’emiaka ikomi na ebere, konya oonirie ebinto bionsi ebiarenge nabio ase abarwaria, tanyara kogwenigwa nonde.
swahili: Katika umati huo palikuwa na mwanamke mmoja aliyekuwa na tatizo la kutokwa damu kwa muda wa miaka kumi na miwili. Tena alikuwa amegharimia yote aliyokuwa nayo kwa ajili ya matibabu, wala hakuna yeyote aliyeweza kumponya.

english: She came up behind Jesus and touched the fringe of His cloak, and immediately her bleeding stopped.
ekegusii: Ere agatunyana Yeso korwa magega, agakuna omokoba bw’eanga yaye; erio kegima amanyinga aye agakama.
swahili: Huyo mwanamke akaja kwa nyuma ya Yesu na kugusa upindo wa vazi lake. Mara kutokwa damu kwake kukakoma.

english: “Who touched Me?” Jesus asked. But they all denied it. “Master,” said Peter, “the people are crowding and pressing against You.”
ekegusii: Yeso akabooria, “Ning’o onkuna?” Ekero abanto bonsi bagakana, Petero na baria barenge amo nere bakamoteebia, “Omonene, omoganda nigo ogoetanaine na gokomiga.”
swahili: Yesu akauliza, “Ni nani aliyenigusa?” Watu wote walipokana, Petro akasema, “Bwana, huu umati wa watu unakusonga na kukusukuma kila upande.”

english: But Jesus declared, “Someone touched Me, for I know that power has gone out from Me.”
ekegusii: Yeso agateeba, “Omonto onkunire, ekiagera naigure ng’a chinguru chiandure.”
swahili: Lakini Yesu akasema, “Kuna mtu aliyenigusa, kwa maana nimetambua kuwa nguvu zimenitoka.”

english: Then the woman, seeing that she could not escape notice, came trembling and fell down before Him. In the presence of all the people, she explained why she had touched Him and how she had immediately been healed.
ekegusii: Omokungu oria ekero achia korora ng’a tabisekaneti, agacha okoiguswa, akamogwera, na ase amasio ’abaanto bonsi akamworokia engencho yagera omokuna, naende buna agwenetigwe ara rimo.
swahili: Yule mwanamke alipofahamu ya kuwa hawezi kuendelea kujificha, alikuja akitetemeka, akaanguka miguuni mwa Yesu. Akaeleza mbele ya watu wote kwa nini alimgusa na jinsi alivyoponywa mara.

english: “Daughter,” said Jesus, “your faith has healed you. Go in peace.”
ekegusii: Akamoteebia, “Omoiseke one, okwegena kwao gwakogwenirie; genda nomorembe.”
swahili: Basi Yesu akamwambia, “Binti, imani yako imekuponya. Nenda kwa amani.”

english: While He was still speaking, someone arrived from the house of the synagogue leader. “Your daughter is dead,” he told Jairus. “Do not bother the Teacher anymore.”
ekegusii: Erio kagokwana, omonto agacha korwa ase enyomba y’oria omotang’ani bw’esinagogi, akamoteebia, “Enyaroka yao yakuure, torosia omworokia naende.”
swahili: Yesu alipokuwa bado anasema, akaja mtumishi kutoka nyumbani kwa Yairo, yule kiongozi wa sinagogi, kumwambia, “Binti yako amekwisha kufa. Usiendelee kumsumbua Mwalimu.”

english: “A farmer went out to sow his seed. And as he was sowing, some seed fell along the path, where it was trampled, and the birds of the air devoured it.
ekegusii: “Omobusuri akamanora kogenda kobusura embusuro yaye: Ekero akobusura, echinde chikagwa enchera ensemo, chigatiringwa namagoro, chinyoni chia igoro chigachiria.
swahili: “Mpanzi alitoka kwenda kupanda mbegu zake. Alipokuwa akitawanya mbegu, nyingine zilianguka kando ya njia; zikakanyagwa, nao ndege wa angani wakazila.

english: But Jesus overheard them and said to Jairus, “Do not be afraid; just believe, and she will be healed.”
ekegusii: Yeso agachia koigwa aya, erio akamoiraneria, “Toiroka; egene rioka, ere nagwenigwe.”
swahili: Yesu aliposikia jambo hili, akamwambia Yairo, “Usiogope. Amini tu, naye binti yako atapona.”

english: When He entered the house, He did not allow anyone to go in with Him except Peter, John, James, and the child’s father and mother.
ekegusii: Agachia goika nyomba, tancha monto onde asoe amo nere otatiga Petero, na Yohana, na Yakobo, na ise na ng’ina b’omwana oria.
swahili: Walipofika nyumbani kwa Yairo, hakumruhusu mtu yeyote aingie ndani naye isipokuwa Petro, Yakobo na Yohana, pamoja na baba na mama wa yule binti.

english: Meanwhile, everyone was weeping and mourning for her. But Jesus said, “Stop weeping; she is not dead but asleep.”
ekegusii: Na abanto bonsi nigo barenge komoreera, bakweng’ereria, korende Yeso akabora, “Timorera, ekiagera takweti, korende nigo araire.”
swahili: Wakati ule ule watu wote walikuwa wakilia na kuomboleza kwa ajili ya huyo binti. Yesu akawaambia, “Acheni kulia. Huyu binti hajafa, ila amelala.”

english: And they laughed at Him, knowing that she was dead.
ekegusii: Bakamosekerera, bamanyete ng’a okuure.
swahili: Wao wakamcheka kwa dharau, wakijua kuwa amekwisha kufa.

english: But Jesus took her by the hand and called out, “Child, get up!”
ekegusii: Korende ere akamobwata okoboko kwaye, agateeba, “Omwana, imoka!”
swahili: Yesu akamshika yule binti mkono na kuita, “Binti, amka!”

english: Her spirit returned, and at once she got up. And He directed that she be given something to eat.
ekegusii: Omoika oye okairana, agatenena erio kegima Yeso akabachiika bamoe endagera arie.
swahili: Roho yake ikamrudia, naye akainuka mara moja. Akaamuru apewe kitu cha kula.

english: Her parents were astounded, but Jesus ordered them not to tell anyone what had happened.
ekegusii: Abaibori baye bagakumia, mono, korende akabachiika tibateebia monto ayakoreka.
swahili: Wazazi wake wakastaajabu sana, lakini Yesu akawakataza wasimwambie mtu yeyote juu ya yale yaliyotukia.

english: Some fell on rocky ground, and when it came up, the seedlings withered because they had no moisture.
ekegusii: Na echinde chikagwa ase egetare, chikamera, chikooma ase okomocha amaache.
swahili: Mbegu nyingine zilianguka penye miamba, nazo zilipoota, hiyo mimea ikakauka kwa kukosa unyevu.

english: Other seed fell among thorns, which grew up with it and choked the seedlings.
ekegusii: Na echinde chikagwa ase amagwa ime, na amagwa aria agakina amo na chirochio, agachimiga.
swahili: Nazo mbegu nyingine zilianguka kwenye miiba, nayo ile miiba ikakua pamoja nazo, na kuisonga hiyo mimea.

english: Still other seed fell on good soil, where it sprang up and produced a crop—a hundredfold.” As Jesus said this, He called out, “He who has ears to hear, let him hear.”
ekegusii: Na echinde chikagwa ase amaroba amaya, chikamera, chikama rigana.” Ekero are kobateebia aya, agaaka eriogi, akabora, “Oyore namato akoigwera, tiga aigwe.” Ogotebereria kw’omoreng’anio oria (Mat 13:10-23; Mar 4:10-20)
swahili: Mbegu nyingine zilianguka kwenye udongo mzuri. Zikaota na kuzaa mara mia moja zaidi ya mbegu alizopanda.” Baada ya kusema haya, Yesu akapaza sauti, akasema, “Mwenye masikio ya kusikia, na asikie.”

english: Then His disciples asked Him what this parable meant.
ekegusii: Aborokigwa baye bakamobooria, “Omoreng’anio oyio ninki ogoteeba?”
swahili: Wanafunzi wake wakamuuliza maana ya mfano huo.

english: Then Jesus called the Twelve together and gave them power and authority over all demons, and power to cure diseases.
ekegusii: Akarangeria baria ikomi na babere akabaa chinguru na okobua igoro ase ebirecha bionsi na ase okogwenia amarwaire.
swahili: Yesu kisha akawaita wale kumi na wawili pamoja, akawapa mamlaka na uwezo wa kutoa pepo wachafu wote na kuponya magonjwa yote,

english: Then the apostles returned and reported to Jesus all that they had done. Taking them away privately, He withdrew to a town called Bethsaida.
ekegusii: Abatomwa baria ekero bachia koirana bagateebia Yeso amang’ana onsi ayabakorire. Erio akagenda amo nabarabwo bobisi akabaira, gochia ase omochie okorokwa Bethisaida.
swahili: Mitume wake waliporudi, wakamweleza Yesu yote waliyofanya. Akawachukua, akaenda nao faraghani mpaka mji uitwao Bethsaida.

english: But the crowds found out and followed Him. He welcomed them and spoke to them about the kingdom of God, and He healed those who needed healing.
ekegusii: Emeganda egachia korora, ekamotunyana, na ere akabaroisia, agakwana nabarabwo amang’ana ’oborwoti bwa Nyasae, akagwenia abarenge nokogania gw’okogwenigwa.
swahili: Lakini umati wa watu ukafahamu alikokwenda, ukamfuata. Akawakaribisha na kunena nao kuhusu Ufalme wa Mungu na kuwaponya wale wote waliokuwa wanahitaji uponyaji.

english: As the day neared its end, the Twelve came to Jesus and said, “Dismiss the crowd so they can go to the surrounding villages and countryside for lodging and provisions. For we are in a desolate place here.”
ekegusii: Rigachaaka kogoroba, na baria ikomi na babere bakamochiera, bakamoteebia, “Tiga omoganda ogende goika ase ebichie ne chinsemo chietanaine, banyore aase bakorara amo nendagera, ekiagera aiga nigo tore aase erooro.”
swahili: Ilipokaribia jioni, wale mitume kumi na wawili wakaenda kwa Yesu na kumwambia, “Waage makutano ili waende vijijini jirani na mashambani, ili wapate chakula na mahali pa kulala, kwa maana hapa tuko nyikani.”

english: But Jesus told them, “You give them something to eat.” “We have only five loaves of bread and two fish,” they answered, “unless we go and buy food for all these people.”
ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Inwe bae endagera!” Bakaboora, “Titobwati kende kobua emegati etano ne chinswe ibere. Gose togende kogorera abanto aba bonsi endagera?”
swahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Ninyi wapeni chakula.” Nao wakajibu, “Hatuna zaidi ya mikate mitano na samaki wawili. Labda twende tukanunue chakula cha kuwatosha watu hawa wote.”

english: (There were about five thousand men.) He told His disciples, “Have them sit down in groups of about fifty each.”
ekegusii: Naki mbarengeo abasacha chilifu isano iga. Agateebia aborokigwa baye, “Baikaransie abanto aba ase ebiombe, na kera ekeombe koreng’ana emerongo etano.”
swahili: Walikuwako wanaume wapatao 5,000. Yesu akawaambia wanafunzi wake, “Waketisheni katika makundi ya watu hamsini hamsini.”

english: They did so, and everyone was seated.
ekegusii: Bagakora boigo, bakabaikaransia bonsi.
swahili: Wanafunzi wakafanya hivyo, wakawaketisha wote.

english: Taking the five loaves and the two fish and looking up to heaven, Jesus spoke a blessing and broke them. Then He gave them to the disciples to set before the people.
ekegusii: Akabogoria emegati eria etano ne chinswe chiria ibere, akarigereria igoro, akabisesenia, akabisamunyora, akaa aborokigwa babiterekere abanto.
swahili: Yesu akaichukua ile mikate mitano na wale samaki wawili, akatazama mbinguni, akavibariki na kuvimega. Kisha akawapa wanafunzi ili wawagawie watu.

english: They all ate and were satisfied, and the disciples picked up twelve basketfuls of broken pieces that were left over. Peter’s Confession of Christ (Matthew 16:13–20; Mark 8:27–30; John 6:67–71)
ekegusii: Bonsi bakaria, bakaigota. Na ebisamunye biria biatigarete bigasangererigwa, bigaichora ebitonga ikomi na bibere. Okoorokia gwa Petero ng’a Yeso nere Kristo (Mat 16:13-19; Mar 8:27-29)
swahili: Wote wakala, wakashiba. Nao wanafunzi wakakusanya vipande vilivyosalia, wakajaza vikapu kumi na viwili. Petro Amkiri Yesu Kuwa Ndiye Kristo (Mathayo 16:13-19; Marko 8:27-29)

english: One day as Jesus was praying in private and the disciples were with Him, He questioned them: “Who do the crowds say I am?”
ekegusii: Engaki eyemo ekero Yeso are gosaba are ere bweka, aborokigwa baye nigo barenge ange nere, akababooria, “Abanto nigo bakobora ng’a ninche ng’o?”
swahili: Wakati mmoja, Yesu alipokuwa akiomba faraghani, nao wanafunzi wake wakiwa pamoja naye, akawauliza, “Watu husema mimi ni nani?”

english: They replied, “Some say John the Baptist; others say Elijah; and still others, that a prophet of old has arisen.”
ekegusii: Bakairaneria, “Yohana Omobatisi; abande Elija, na abande ng’a oyomo ase ababani abakoro obokire.”
swahili: Wakamjibu, “Baadhi husema wewe ni Yohana Mbatizaji, wengine husema ni Eliya, na bado wengine husema kwamba ni mmoja wa manabii wa kale amefufuka kutoka kwa wafu.”

english: And He sent them out to proclaim the kingdom of God and to heal the sick.
ekegusii: Akabatoma korandia oborwoti bwa Nyasae na kogwenia abarwaire.
swahili: kisha akawatuma waende wakahubiri Ufalme wa Mungu na kuponya wagonjwa.

english: “But what about you?” Jesus asked. “Who do you say I am?” Peter answered, “The Christ of God.” Christ’s Passion Foretold (Matthew 16:21–23; Mark 8:31–33)
ekegusii: Akababoria, “Nainwe nigo mokobora ng’a ninche ng’o?” Petero akairaneria, “Kristo o Nyasae.” Yeso okobana ogokwa na okoboka kwaye (Mat 16:20-21; Mar 8:30-31)
swahili: Kisha akawauliza, “Je, ninyi mnasema mimi ni nani?” Petro akajibu, “Wewe ndiwe Kristo wa Mungu.”

english: Jesus strictly warned them not to tell this to anyone.
ekegusii: Akabachiika na kobakania tibateebia monto ring’ana eri,
swahili: Yesu akawakataza wasimwambie mtu yeyote jambo hilo.

english: “The Son of Man must suffer many things,” He said. “He must be rejected by the elders, chief priests, and scribes, and He must be killed and on the third day be raised to life.” Take Up Your Cross (Matthew 16:24–28; Mark 8:34–38)
ekegusii: ogoteeba, “Negwenerete Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto anyore ogochandeka ase chinchera chinyinge, na kwangwa nabagaaka, na abakuani abanene, na aborokia b’amariiko, naende aitwe, na ase rituko ria gatato naboke.” Okorangerigwa kw’ogwekeyia omonyene (Mat 16:24-28; Mar 8:34—9:1)
swahili: Yesu akasema, “Imempasa Mwana wa Adamu kupata mateso mengi na kukataliwa na wazee, viongozi wa makuhani, na walimu wa sheria, na itampasa auawe, lakini siku ya tatu kufufuliwa kutoka mauti.”

english: Then Jesus said to all of them, “If anyone wants to come after Me, he must deny himself and take up his cross daily and follow Me.
ekegusii: Agateebia bonsi, “Oyorigetie gontunyana, tiga ekaane ere omonyene, etweke omosalaba oye kera rituko antunyane.
swahili: Kisha akawaambia wote, “Mtu yeyote akitaka kunifuata, ni lazima ajikane mwenyewe, auchukue msalaba wake kila siku, anifuate.

english: For whoever wants to save his life will lose it, but whoever loses his life for My sake will save it.
ekegusii: Naki onde bwensi orarigie koegera obogima bwaye oyio nabosirie; na oyorasirie obogima bwaye ase engencho yane, oyio naboegere.
swahili: Kwa maana yeyote anayetaka kuyaokoa maisha yake atayapoteza, lakini yeyote atakayeyapoteza maisha yake kwa ajili yangu atayaokoa.

english: What does it profit a man to gain the whole world, yet lose or forfeit his very self?
ekegusii: Ekiagera inki eragwenere omonto karanyore ense yonsi, ko esirie gose gwesaria ere omonyene?
swahili: Je, itamfaidi nini mtu kuupata ulimwengu wote, lakini akapoteza au kuangamiza nafsi yake?

english: If anyone is ashamed of Me and My words, the Son of Man will be ashamed of him when He comes in His glory and in the glory of the Father and of the holy angels.
ekegusii: Naki kera omonto orandorere obosooku inche na amang’ana aane, Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto kagocha ase obonene bwaye, namororere obosooku ase Ise na ase abamalaika abachenu.
swahili: Mtu yeyote akinionea aibu mimi na maneno yangu, Mwana wa Adamu naye atamwonea aibu atakapokuja katika utukufu wake na katika utukufu wa Baba, pamoja na malaika watakatifu.

english: But I tell you truthfully, some who are standing here will not taste death before they see the kingdom of God.” The Transfiguration (Matthew 17:1–13; Mark 9:1–13; 2 Peter 1:16–21)
ekegusii: Korende nabateebirie ekeene, mbare abanto ase aba bateneine aa, abataigwe amakweri nonya ng’ake, goika barore oborwoti bwa Nyasae.” Okoonchoka ekieni kwa Yeso (Mat 17:1-8; Mar 9:2-8)
swahili: Amin, nawaambia, wako baadhi ya watu waliosimama hapa ambao hawataonja mauti kabla ya kuuona Ufalme wa Mungu.” Bwana Yesu Abadilika Sura (Mathayo 17:1-8; Marko 9:2-8)

english: About eight days after Jesus had said these things, He took with Him Peter, John, and James, and went up on a mountain to pray.
ekegusii: Agachia koba amatuko ang’e atano na atato magega ase amang’ana aya, akaira Petero, na Yohana, na Yakobo, agatiira gochia egetunwa igoro gosaba.
swahili: Yapata siku nane baada ya Yesu kusema hayo, aliwachukua Petro, Yakobo na Yohana, akaenda nao mlimani kuomba.

english: And as He was praying, the appearance of His face changed, and His clothes became radiantly white.
ekegusii: Na ekero arenge gosaba, ekieni ki’obosio bwaye gekaonchoka, ne chianga chiaye chikaba chindabu, chikameka‐meka.
swahili: Alipokuwa akiomba, sura ya uso wake ikabadilika, nayo mavazi yake yakametameta kama mwanga wa umeme wa radi.

english: “Take nothing for the journey,” He told them, “no staff, no bag, no bread, no money, no second tunic.
ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Timobogoria gento ase orogendo rwaino, nonya nenyimbo, gose esaro, gose omogati, gose chitaabu; naende timoba ne chianga ibere.
swahili: Akawaagiza akisema, “Msichukue chochote safarini: sio fimbo, wala mkoba, wala mkate, wala fedha, hata msichukue kanzu ya ziada.

english: Suddenly two men, Moses and Elijah, began talking with Jesus.
ekegusii: Na agwo, abanto babere bakarorekana bagakwana nere, nabwo Musa na Elija.
swahili: Ghafula wakawaona watu wawili, ndio Mose na Eliya, wakizungumza naye.

english: They appeared in glory and spoke about His departure, which He was about to accomplish at Jerusalem.
ekegusii: Abwo barorekanete ase obonene, na gokwana amang’ana ay’ogokwa kwaye, aya agwenerete goikerania Yerusalemu.
swahili: Walionekana katika utukufu wakizungumza na Yesu kuhusu kifo chake ambacho kingetokea huko Yerusalemu.

english: Meanwhile Peter and his companions were overcome by sleep, but when they awoke, they saw Jesus’ glory and the two men standing with Him.
ekegusii: Petero na baria barenge amo nere, konya babwatirwe ne chitoro, korende nigo bategesetie, bakarora obonene bwaye, na abanto baria babere bateneine amo nere.
swahili: Petro na wenzake walikuwa wamelala usingizi mzito. Walipoamka, wakaona utukufu wa Yesu na wale watu wawili waliokuwa wamesimama pamoja naye.

english: As Moses and Elijah were leaving, Peter said to Jesus, “Master, it is good for us to be here. Let us put up three shelters —one for You, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.” (He did not know what he was saying.)
ekegusii: Ekero abanto aba baare korua asare, Petero agateebia Yeso, “Omonene, imbuya intwe koba aiga; tokore ebigutu bitato, ekemo ekiao, na ekemo ekia Musa, na ekemo eki’Elija”; tamanyete aya agokwana.
swahili: Mose na Eliya walipokuwa wanaondoka, Petro akamwambia Yesu, “Bwana, ni vizuri tukae hapa! Tutajenga vibanda vitatu: kimoja chako, kingine cha Mose na kingine cha Eliya.” Lakini Petro alikuwa hajui asemacho.

english: While Peter was speaking, a cloud appeared and enveloped them, and they were afraid as they entered the cloud.
ekegusii: Ekero agokwana amang’ana aya riire rigacha rikababisia, bakairoka kobachia gosoa ase riire.
swahili: Alipokuwa bado anazungumza, pakatokea wingu, likawafunika, nao wakaogopa walipoingia mle kwenye wingu.

english: And a voice came from the cloud, saying, “This is My Son, whom I have chosen. Listen to Him!”
ekegusii: Eriogi rigasoka korwa ase riire riria rigoteeba, “Oyo n’Omwana one, Omochorwa one; moigwere ere!”
swahili: Sauti ikatoka kwenye lile wingu ikisema, “Huyu ni Mwanangu mpendwa, niliyemchagua. Msikieni yeye.”

english: After the voice had spoken, only Jesus was present with them. The disciples kept this to themselves, and in those days they did not tell anyone what they had seen. The Boy with an Evil Spirit (Matthew 17:14–18; Mark 9:14–29)
ekegusii: Ekero eriogi riakwanire, Yeso akarorekana ore bweka. Na barabwo bagakira, tibateebia monto ase amatuko aria ring’ana rinde rionsi ri’ayio baroche. Yeso okogwenia omomura obwatire nekerecha (Mat 17:14-18; Mar 9:14-27)
swahili: Baada ya sauti hiyo kusema, walimkuta Yesu akiwa peke yake. Wale wanafunzi wakalihifadhi jambo hili, wala kwa wakati huo hawakumwambia mtu yeyote yale waliyokuwa wameyaona. Kuponywa Kwa Kijana Mwenye Pepo Mchafu (Mathayo 17:1-8; Marko 9:2-8)

english: The next day, when they came down from the mountain, Jesus was met by a large crowd.
ekegusii: Rituko ria kabere ekero baare gotirimboka korwa ase egetunwa, omoganda omonene okaumerana nere.
swahili: Kesho yake waliposhuka kutoka mlimani, alikutana na umati mkubwa wa watu.

english: Suddenly a man in the crowd cried out, “Teacher, I beg You to look at my son, for he is my only child.
ekegusii: Naende rora, omonto oyomo ase omoganda oria agaaka egeturi, okobora, “Omworokia, nagosabire, origererie omomura one, ekiagera ere nomwana one omomoima.
swahili: Mtu mmoja katika ule umati wa watu akapaza sauti, akasema, “Mwalimu, naomba umwangalie mwanangu, kwani ndiye mtoto wangu wa pekee.

english: A spirit keeps seizing him, and he screams abruptly. It throws him into convulsions so that he foams at the mouth. It keeps mauling him and rarely departs from him.
ekegusii: Na rora ekerecha nigo gekomobwata, na ere bwango nigo akorera, naende kemogaragaria, erinde asokia amasombogoku, korende tikeri komorua otatiga ase okomosionora mono.
swahili: Mara kwa mara pepo mchafu humpagaa na kumfanya apige kelele, kisha humwangusha na kumtia kifafa hata akatokwa na povu kinywani. Huyo pepo mchafu anamtesa sana, na hamwachi ila mara chache.

english: Whatever house you enter, stay there until you leave that area.
ekegusii: Naende enyomba ende yonsi morasoe, mobeere aroro goika moruo.
swahili: Katika nyumba yoyote mwingiayo, kaeni humo hadi mtakapoondoka katika mji huo.

english: I begged Your disciples to drive it out, but they were unable.”
ekegusii: Nasaba aborokigwa bao bageserie, korende tibanyara.”
swahili: Niliwaomba wanafunzi wako wamtoe huyo pepo mchafu, lakini hawakuweza.”

english: “O unbelieving and perverse generation!” Jesus replied. “How long must I remain with you and put up with you? Bring your son here.”
ekegusii: Yeso akairaneria, “Inwe ekegori getari nokwegena, naende ekebe, nimbe amo nainwe goika ririri, na koremereria nainwe? Renta omomura oo aiga.”
swahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Enyi kizazi kisichoamini na kilichopotoka! Nitakaa nanyi na kuwavumilia mpaka lini? Mlete mwanao hapa.”

english: Even while the boy was approaching, the demon slammed him to the ground in a convulsion. But Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit, healed the boy, and gave him back to his father. The Second Prediction of the Passion (Matthew 17:22–23; Mark 9:30–32)
ekegusii: Agachia koba nkomochiera are ekerecha keria gekamoigusia na komoiyeria. Yeso agakania ekerecha keria, akagwenia omomura oria, akamoirania ase ise.
swahili: Hata yule mtoto alipokuwa akija, yule pepo mchafu akamwangusha, akamtia kifafa. Lakini Yesu akamkemea yule pepo mchafu amtoke, akamponya yule mtoto, na akamrudisha kwa baba yake.

english: And they were all astonished at the greatness of God. While everyone was marveling at all that Jesus was doing, He said to His disciples,
ekegusii: Abanto bonsi bagakumia ase okobua kwa Nyasae. Obobani bwa kabere bwa Yeso igoro y’ogokwa kwaye (Mat 17:22-23; Mar 9:30-32) Korende ekero bonsi babete nogokumia ase amang’ana onsi akorete, agateebia aborokigwa baye,
swahili: Watu wote wakastaajabia uweza mkuu wa Mungu. Wakati bado watu walikuwa wanastaajabia hayo yote aliyokuwa akiyafanya Yesu, yeye akawaambia wanafunzi wake:

english: “Let these words sink into your ears: The Son of Man is about to be delivered into the hands of men.”
ekegusii: “Tiga amang’ana aya asoe ase amato aino, ekiagera Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto ngochia are kobekwa ase amaboko ’abaanto.”
swahili: “Sikilizeni kwa makini haya nitakayowaambia sasa: Mwana wa Adamu atasalitiwa na kutiwa mikononi mwa watu.”

english: But they did not understand this statement. It was veiled from them so that they could not comprehend it, and they were afraid to ask Him about it. The Greatest in the Kingdom (Matthew 18:1–5; Mark 9:33–41)
ekegusii: Korende tibamanya ring’ana riria, rikaba ndiabiseka ase bare, erinde tibarimanya. Bakaba nobwoba komoboria engencho ye ring’ana riria. Okworokereria igoro y’oboitongo (Mat 18:1-5; Mar 9:33-37)
swahili: Lakini wao hawakuelewa alimaanisha nini. Maana ya maneno hayo ilifichika kwao, hivyo hawakuyaelewa, nao wakaogopa kumuuliza maana yake. Ni Nani Atakayekuwa Mkubwa Kuliko Wote (Mathayo 18:1-5; Marko 9:33-37)

english: Then an argument started among the disciples as to which of them would be the greatest.
ekegusii: Okoengererania kogatuboka ase egati yabo ng’a ning’o ase bare ore omonene kobua abande.
swahili: Kukazuka mabishano miongoni mwa wanafunzi kuhusu ni nani miongoni mwao atakayekuwa mkuu kuliko wote.

english: But Jesus, knowing the thoughts of their hearts, had a little child stand beside Him.
ekegusii: Korende ekero Yeso achia komanya ebirengererio bie chinkoro chiabo, akabogoria omwana, akamobeka ang’e asare,
swahili: Lakini Yesu akayatambua mawazo yao, naye akamchukua mtoto mdogo, akamsimamisha kando yake.

english: And He said to them, “Whoever welcomes this little child in My name welcomes Me, and whoever welcomes Me welcomes the One who sent Me. For whoever is the least among all of you, he is the greatest.”
ekegusii: akabateebia, “Onde bwensi oramwanche omwana oyo ase erieta riane, onyanchire inche; na oyoranyanche inche, omwanchire ere oyontomete. Ekiagera ere oyore omoke ase egati yaino, oyio nere omonene.” Okworokereria igoro y’okobogorerania (Mar 9:38-40)
swahili: Kisha akawaambia, “Yeyote amkaribishaye mtoto huyu mdogo kwa Jina langu, anikaribisha mimi, na yeyote atakayenikaribisha mimi, atakuwa amemkaribisha yeye aliyenituma. Kwa maana yeye aliye mdogo miongoni mwenu, ndiye aliye mkuu kuliko wote.”

english: “Master,” said John, “we saw someone driving out demons in Your name, and we tried to stop him, because he does not accompany us.”
ekegusii: Yohana akairaneria, “Omworokia, ntwarora omonto ogoseria ebirecha ase erieta riao, tokamokania, ekiagera tabwataini naintwe.”
swahili: Yohana akasema, “Bwana, tumemwona mtu akitoa pepo wachafu kwa jina lako, nasi tukamzuia, kwa sababu yeye si mmoja wetu.”

english: If anyone does not welcome you, shake the dust off your feet when you leave that town, as a testimony against them.”
ekegusii: Naende abatabaroiseti, komogosoka korwa omochie oria, mokong’onte orotu rw’amagoro aino, erinde robe kirori ase bare.”
swahili: Kama watu wasipowakaribisha, mnapoondoka katika mji wao, kungʼuteni mavumbi kutoka kwenye miguu yenu ili kuwa ushuhuda dhidi yao.”

english: “Do not stop him,” Jesus replied, “for whoever is not against you is for you.” The Samaritans Reject Jesus
ekegusii: Korende Yeso akamoteebia, “Timomokania, ekiagera oyo otari mamincha yaino nigo are ensemo yaino.” Yeso okomanora kogenda Yerusalemu. Abasamaria abatakoroisia abageni
swahili: Yesu akasema, “Msimzuie, kwa sababu yeyote ambaye si kinyume nanyi, yu upande wenu.” Yesu Akataliwa Samaria

english: As the day of His ascension approached, Jesus resolutely set out for Jerusalem.
ekegusii: Ekero amatuko aye aika ang’e kogenda igoro, akamanora kogenda Yerusalemu.
swahili: Wakati ulipokaribia wa yeye kuchukuliwa mbinguni, alikaza uso wake kwenda Yerusalemu.

english: He sent messengers on ahead, who went into a village of the Samaritans to make arrangements for Him.
ekegusii: Agatoma abatomwa komotang’anera, bagende na gosoa ase agachie k’Abasamaria, bamoroiserie aase.
swahili: Akatuma watu wamtangulie, nao wakaenda katika kijiji kimoja cha Samaria kumwandalia kila kitu;

english: But the people there refused to welcome Him, because He was heading for Jerusalem.
ekegusii: Abanto b’omochie oria tibamoroisia, ekiagera arenge kogenda Yerusalemu.
swahili: lakini watu wa kijiji kile hawakumkaribisha kwa sababu alikuwa anakwenda zake Yerusalemu.

english: When the disciples James and John saw this, they asked, “Lord, do You want us to call down fire from heaven to consume them?”
ekegusii: Aborokigwa baye Yakobo na Yohana bagachia korora, aya, bakaboora, “Omonene, norigetie toborie omorero oike korwa igoro obasirie?”
swahili: Wanafunzi wake, yaani Yakobo na Yohana, walipoona hayo, wakasema: “Bwana, unataka tuagize moto kutoka mbinguni ili uwaangamize?”

english: But Jesus turned and rebuked them.
ekegusii: Akeonchora, akabakania.
swahili: Yesu akageuka na kuwakemea,

english: And He and His disciples went on to another village. The Cost of Discipleship (Matthew 8:18–22; Luke 14:25–33; John 6:59–66)
ekegusii: Erio Bakagenda ase agachie kande. Amateemwa ase abwo barigetie koba aborokigwa (Mat 8:19-22)
swahili: nao wakaenda kijiji kingine. Gharama Ya Kumfuata Yesu (Mathayo 8:19-22)

english: As they were walking along the road, someone said to Jesus, “I will follow You wherever You go.”
ekegusii: Ekero baare kogenda nchera omonto oyomo akamoteebia, “Ningotunyane aande onsi ase okogenda.”
swahili: Walipokuwa njiani wakienda, mtu mmoja akamwambia Yesu, “Nitakufuata kokote uendako.”

english: Jesus replied, “Foxes have dens and birds of the air have nests, but the Son of Man has no place to lay His head.”
ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Ebibwe mbire namakuruma, ne chinyoni chia igoro nchire nebiswa, korende Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto tari nase akobeeka omotwe oye.”
swahili: Yesu akamjibu, “Mbweha wana mapango, nao ndege wa angani wana viota, lakini Mwana wa Adamu hana mahali pa kulaza kichwa chake.”

english: Then He said to another man, “Follow Me.” The man replied, “Lord, first let me go and bury my father.”
ekegusii: Agateebia oyonde, “Ntunyana!” Ere akabora, “Omonene, ritang’ani ing’a ribaga ngende gotindeka tata”.
swahili: Yesu akamwambia mtu mwingine, “Nifuate.” Mtu huyo akamjibu, “Bwana, niruhusu kwanza nikamzike baba yangu.”

english: So they set out and went from village to village, preaching the gospel and healing people everywhere. Herod Tries to See Jesus (Matthew 14:1–12; Mark 6:14–29)
ekegusii: Bakagenda, bagaetanana ase emechie, bakorandia enchiri, na kogwenia abanto chinsemo chionsi. Ogoichana kwa Herode (Mat 14:1-2; Mar 6:14-16)
swahili: Hivyo wale wanafunzi wakaondoka wakaenda kutoka kijiji hadi kijiji, wakihubiri habari njema na kuponya wagonjwa kila mahali. Herode Afadhaika (Mathayo 14:1-12; Marko 6:14-29)

english: But Jesus told him, “Let the dead bury their own dead. You, however, go and proclaim the kingdom of God.”
ekegusii: Akamoteebia, “Tiga abakuure batindeke abakuure babo, korende aye genda orandie oborwoti bwa Nyasae.”
swahili: Yesu akamwambia, “Waache wafu wawazike wafu wao, bali wewe nenda ukautangaze Ufalme wa Mungu.”

english: Still another said, “I will follow You, Lord; but first let me bid farewell to my family.”
ekegusii: Naende oyonde nere akabora, “Omonene, ningotunyane, korende ritang’ani ing’a ribaga mbaakere ng’a batigare buya abanto b’enyomba yane.”
swahili: Mtu mwingine akamwambia, “Bwana, nitakufuata lakini naomba kwanza nikawaage jamaa yangu.”

english: Then Jesus declared, “No one who puts his hand to the plow and then looks back is fit for the kingdom of God.”
ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Omonto tari orabeeke okoboko kwaye ase obokombe bwe chieri, naende arigererie magega, oragwenere ase oborwoti bwa Nyasae.”
swahili: Yesu akamwambia, “Mtu yeyote atiaye mkono wake kulima, kisha akatazama nyuma, hafai kwa Ufalme wa Mungu.”

english: When Herod the tetrarch heard about all that was happening, he was perplexed. For some were saying that John had risen from the dead,
ekegusii: Bono Herode omorwoti akaigwa onsi ayakorekire, agaichanigwa mono, ekiagera abande baare goteeba ng’a Yohana obokiigwe korwa ase abakuure,
swahili: Basi Mfalme Herode, mtawala wa Galilaya, alisikia habari za yote yaliyotendeka. Naye akafadhaika, kwa kuwa baadhi ya watu walikuwa wakisema Yohana Mbatizaji amefufuliwa kutoka kwa wafu.

english: others that Elijah had appeared, and still others that a prophet of old had arisen.
ekegusii: na abande ng’a n’Elija oorokire, na abande ng’a noyomo bw’ababani abakoro obokire.
swahili: Wengine wakasema Eliya amewatokea, na wengine wakasema kwamba mmoja wa manabii wa kale amefufuka.

english: “I beheaded John,” Herod said, “but who is this man I hear such things about?” And he kept trying to see Jesus. The Feeding of the Five Thousand (Matthew 14:13–21; Mark 6:30–44; John 6:1–15)
ekegusii: Herode agateeba, “Yohana inamonachete omotwe, korende ning’o oyo rende naigure amang’ana are buna aya?” Akarigia komorora. Okoragerigwa kw’abaanto chilifu isano (Mat 14:13-21; Mar 6:30-44; Yoh 6:1-13)
swahili: Herode akasema, “Yohana nilimkata kichwa. Lakini ni nani huyu ambaye ninasikia mambo kama haya kumhusu?” Akatamani sana kumwona. Yesu Awalisha Wanaume 5,000 (Mathayo 14:13-21; Marko 6:30-44; Yohana 6:1-14)

english: This is the burden of the word of the LORD to Israel through Malachi:
ekegusii: Aya naro amang’an’Omonene atomerete Abaisraeli goetera ase Malaki. Obwanchani bw’Omonene ase Abaisraeli
swahili: Ujumbe: Neno la Bwana kwa Israeli kupitia kwa Malaki. Yakobo Alipendwa, Esau Alichukiwa

english: “Oh, that one of you would shut the temple doors, so that you would no longer kindle useless fires on My altar! I take no pleasure in you,” says the LORD of Hosts, “and I will accept no offering from your hands.
ekegusii: Naende Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo agoteeba iga: Onye ndiria arenge gotoka omonto nonya noyomo korwa ase more asieke ebisieri bie Hekalu, erinde timobaisa kogenderera gouta omorero ase egesasiimero kiane bosa, ekiagera tingokiri nainwe, gose tingwancha ebing’wanso korwa ase amaboko aino.
swahili: “Laiti mmoja wenu angalifunga milango ya Hekalu, ili msije mkawasha moto usiokuwa na faida juu ya madhabahu yangu! Sina furaha nanyi,” asema Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, “nami sitaikubali sadaka toka mikononi mwenu.

english: For My name will be great among the nations, from where the sun rises to where it sets. In every place, incense and pure offerings will be presented in My name, because My name will be great among the nations,” says the LORD of Hosts.
ekegusii: Korwa ekero erioba rigosoka goika ekero rikorimera, erieta riane nigo rigendererete koba rinene ase egati y’ abanto b’ebisaku, na ase kera aase ubani egosambwa ase erieta riane, na okoruegwa gochenegete gokorentwa. Ee, erieta riane nigo rigendererete koba rinene ase egati y’ abanto b’ebisaku. Nabo Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteeba.
swahili: Jina langu litakuwa kuu miongoni mwa mataifa, kuanzia mawio ya jua hata machweo yake. Kila mahali uvumba na sadaka safi zitaletwa kwa Jina langu, kwa sababu Jina langu litakuwa kuu miongoni mwa mataifa,” asema Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote.

english: “But you profane it when you say, ‘The table of the Lord is defiled, and as for its fruit, its food is contemptible.’
ekegusii: “Korende inwe nigo mokorikora ribe eritachenegeti ekero mogoteeba ng’a emesa y’ane yakorirwe koba eyetachenegeti na gochaaya okoruegwa gokorentwa aroro.
swahili: “Lakini mnalinajisi Jina langu kwa kusema kuhusu meza ya Bwana, ‘Imetiwa unajisi pamoja na chakula chake. Ni ya kudharauliwa.’

english: You also say: ‘Oh, what a nuisance!’ And you turn up your nose at it,” says the LORD of Hosts. “You bring offerings that are stolen, lame, or sick! Should I accept these from your hands?” asks the LORD.
ekegusii: Inwe nigo mogoteeba: Amang’ana aya atorosirie, naende mwagenderera gonchaaya inche Omonene bw’Emeganda. Nigo mokondetera eng’iti eurereirie, gose eye eremarete, gose erwarete, ebe ekeng’wanso. Inee! Ninyare gwanchera ebinto buna ebio korwa ase amaboko aino?” Nabo Omonene akoboria.
swahili: Nanyi mnasema, ‘Mzigo gani huu!’ Nanyi mnaidharau kwa kiburi,” asema Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote. “Wakati mnapowaleta wanyama mliopokonya kwa nguvu, walio vilema au walio wagonjwa na kuwatoa kama dhabihu, je, niwakubali kutoka mikononi mwenu?” asema Bwana.

english: “But cursed is the deceiver who has an acceptable male in his flock and vows to give it, but sacrifices a defective animal to the Lord. For I am a great King,” says the LORD of Hosts, “and My name is to be feared among the nations.
ekegusii: “Oragereriigwe omonto oria omong’ainereria obwate emingichi ase riicho riaye, eyio ariete eira ng’a ayerue, korende orenta ase ’nde inche Omonene eng’iti eng’ao ere n’ekemocho ase omobere oye. Inche nigo inde omorwoti omonene, na erieta riane nigo rire eri’okoirokwa ase egati y’ abanto b’ebisaku.” Nabo Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteeba.
swahili: “Amelaaniwa yeye adanganyaye, aliye na mnyama wa kiume anayekubalika katika kundi lake na kuweka nadhiri ya kumtoa, lakini akatoa dhabihu ya mnyama aliye na dosari kwa Bwana. Kwa kuwa mimi ni Mfalme Mkuu, nalo Jina langu linapaswa kuogopwa miongoni mwa mataifa,” asema Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote.

english: “I have loved you,” says the LORD. But you ask, “How have You loved us?” “Was not Esau Jacob’s brother?” declares the LORD. “Yet Jacob I have loved,
ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: “Inche nimbanchete inwe.” Korende inwe nigo mokoboria: “Inaki otwanchete?” Omonene nigo akoiraneria, “Inee! Esau tarenge oyomwabo Yakobo? Inche nigo namwanchete Yakobo,
swahili: Bwana asema, “Nimewapenda ninyi.” “Lakini ninyi mnauliza, ‘Wewe umetupendaje?’ ” Bwana asema, “Je, Esau hakuwa ndugu yake Yakobo? Hata hivyo nimempenda Yakobo,

english: but Esau I have hated, and I have made his mountains a wasteland and left his inheritance to the desert jackals. ”
ekegusii: na nkaba ’ngechete Esau na ’ngasaria ense yaye y’ebitunwa ekaba erooro, na omwando oye ’nkaa chisese chi’orosana chikamenyao.”
swahili: lakini nikamchukia Esau, nami nimeifanya milima yake kuwa ukiwa, na urithi wake nimewapa mbweha wa jangwani.”

english: Though Edom may say, “We have been devastated, but we will rebuild the ruins,” this is what the LORD of Hosts says: “They may build, but I will demolish. They will be called the Land of Wickedness, and a people with whom the LORD is indignant forever.
ekegusii: Abaedomu kobarateebe: “Nonya twaakirwe, ngochia tore koagaacha naende aase aria asaretigwe agatigara bosa.” Korende Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo agoteeba iga: “Nabo baranyare koagaacha naende, korende inche goika ’ntagore amaagacho ayio, erinde ense eyio erokwe ey’abakori amabe, abwo inche Omonene inde nendamwamu ase bare kogenderera botambe.”
swahili: Edomu anaweza kusema, “Ingawa tumepondapondwa, tutajenga upya magofu.” Lakini hili ndilo Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote asemalo: “Wanaweza kujenga, lakini nitabomoa. Wataitwa Nchi Ovu, watu ambao siku zote wapo chini ya ghadhabu ya Bwana.

english: You will see this with your own eyes, and you yourselves will say, ‘The LORD is great—even beyond the borders of Israel.’” The Polluted Offerings
ekegusii: Namwerorere amang’ana ayio namaiso aino; erio moteebe: “Omonene nigo are omonene nonya nisiko y’ense y’Abaisraeli.” Omonene ogotogonyera abakuani
swahili: Mtayaona kwa macho yenu wenyewe na kusema, ‘ Bwana ni mkuu, hata nje ya mipaka ya Israeli!’ Dhabihu Zilizo Na Mawaa

english: “A son honors his father, and a servant his master. But if I am a father, where is My honor? And if I am a master, where is your fear of Me?” says the LORD of Hosts to you priests who despise My name. “But you ask, ‘How have we despised Your name?’
ekegusii: Omonene Nyasae bw’Emeganda nigo agoteeba iga: “Omwana nigo asigete ise, na omosomba nairogete omonene oye. Onye inche inde iso oino, amasikani aino ase ’nde, ng’ai are? Na onye inde omonene, okonyiroka kwaino, ng’ai kore? Inwe abakuani nigo mochaayete erieta riane, naende nigo mokoboria: Nase enchera ki tochaayete erieta riao?
swahili: “Mwana humheshimu baba yake, naye mtumishi humheshimu bwana wake. Kama mimi ni baba, iko wapi heshima ninayostahili? Kama mimi ni bwana, iko wapi heshima ninayostahili?” asema Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote. “Ni ninyi, enyi makuhani, mnaolidharau Jina langu. “Lakini mnauliza, ‘Tumelidharau Jina lako kwa namna gani?’

english: By presenting defiled food on My altar. But you ask, ‘How have we defiled You?’ By saying that the table of the LORD is contemptible.
ekegusii: Nimbatebie: Nigo mokorenta ase egesasiimero kiane okoruegwa kw’endagera gotari ogochenu. Erio mwaboria: Nase inchera ki twagokorire oyotachenegeti. Nimbairanerie: Nase okorengereria ng’a emesa y’ane inche Omonene ney’ogochaaywa.
swahili: “Mnatoa sadaka chakula kilichotiwa unajisi juu ya madhabahu yangu. “Lakini ninyi mnauliza, ‘Tumekutia unajisi kwa namna gani?’ “Kwa kusema kuwa meza ya Bwana ni ya kudharauliwa.

english: When you offer blind animals for sacrifice, is it not wrong? And when you present the lame and sick ones, is it not wrong? Try offering them to your governor! Would he be pleased with you or show you favor?” asks the LORD of Hosts.
ekegusii: Inee! Ekero mokorua eng’iti eukorete koba ekeng’wanso, ayio tari bobe? Gose ekero mokorua eye eremarete, gose endwaire, ayio tari bobe? Moraisa korua eng’iti buna eyio ase omogabana oino, Inee, nagokigwe nainwe, gose abanchererie?” Nabo Omonene bw’Emeganda akoboria.
swahili: Wakati mletapo dhabihu za wanyama walio vipofu, je, hilo si kosa? Mnapoleta dhabihu zilizo vilema au wanyama wagonjwa, je, hilo si kosa? Jaribuni kuvitoa kwa mtawala wenu! Je, angefurahishwa nanyi? Je, atawakubalia?” asema Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote.

english: “But ask now for God’s favor. Will He be gracious? Since this has come from your hands, will He show you favor?” asks the LORD of Hosts.
ekegusii: “Inwe abakuani, sorora Nyasae, erinde atororere amaabera. Inee! Naroreire onde bwensi oino amaabera, ekero mokorua okoruegwa konga buna okwo korwa ase amaboko aino?” Nabo Omonene bw’Emeganda akoboria.
swahili: “Basi mwombeni Mungu awe na neema kwetu. Je, kwa sadaka kama hizo kutoka mikononi mwenu, atawapokea?” asema Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote.

english: “And now this decree is for you, O priests:
ekegusii: “Bono inwe abakuani, amang’ana aya nigo achiikirwe ase more.
swahili: “Sasa onyo hili ni kwa ajili yenu, enyi makuhani.

english: Do we not all have one Father? Did not one God create us? Why then do we break faith with one another so as to profane the covenant of our fathers?
ekegusii: Inee! Intwe twensi titobwati Tata oyomo? Tari ere Nyasae oyomo ototongete? Nase ki rende totari abegenwa intwe ase intwe? Nase ki togosaria okobwatana kw’ogotianania okwo Nyasae akorete ne chisokoro chiaito?
swahili: Je, sote hatuna Baba mmoja? Hatukuumbwa na Mungu mmoja? Kwa nini basi tunalinajisi Agano la baba zetu kwa kukosa uaminifu kila mmoja kwa mwenzake?

english: Judah has broken faith; an abomination has been committed in Israel and in Jerusalem. For Judah has profaned the LORD’s beloved sanctuary by marrying the daughter of a foreign god.
ekegusii: Abayuda bakorire aya atari ay’obwegenwa, na ay’okogechia akorirwe ase egati y’Abaisraeli, na ase Yerusalemu, ekiagera Abayuda baturutumbire Obomenyo Obochenu bw’Omonene, banyuomire abaiseke b’ abanto bagosasiima enyasae engeni.
swahili: Yuda amevunja uaminifu. Jambo la kuchukiza limetendeka katika Israeli na katika Yerusalemu: Yuda amepanajisi mahali patakatifu apendapo Bwana, kwa kuoa binti wa mungu mgeni.

english: As for the man who does this, may the LORD cut off from the tents of Jacob everyone who is awake and aware—even if he brings an offering to the LORD of Hosts.
ekegusii: Omonene nasirie korwa ase chinyomba chia Yakobo onde bwensi ogokora amang’ana ayio karabe Omwarimu gose omworokigwa, nonya noyokorenta ekeng’wanso ase Omonene bw’Emeganda.
