swahili: Kwa maana kwa mtu yeyote atendaye jambo hili, Bwana na amkatilie mbali kutoka hema za Yakobo, hata kama huwa anamletea Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote sadaka.

english: And this is another thing you do: You cover the altar of the LORD with tears, with weeping and groaning, because He no longer regards your offerings or receives them gladly from your hands.
ekegusii: Amang’ana ande mogokora naya: Nigo mogotuba egesasiimero kia Omonene n’amariga aino, mwaba mokorera na kweumia, na ase ayio Omonene tagwanchera ebing’wanso bikorwa ase amaboko aino nonya ng’ake, gose takogokigwa nabirobio.
swahili: Kitu kingine mnachokifanya: Mnaifurikisha madhabahu ya Bwana kwa machozi. Mnalia na kuugua kwa sababu yeye haziangalii tena sadaka zenu wala hazikubali kwa furaha kutoka mikononi mwenu.

english: Yet you ask, “Why?” It is because the LORD has been a witness between you and the wife of your youth, against whom you have broken faith, though she is your companion and your wife by covenant.
ekegusii: Inwe nigo mokoboria: “Nase ki atari kobianchera?” Nekiagera Omonene arenge kirori ase egati yao na omokungu bw’obosae bwao, oyio aye otari omwegenwa ase are, nonya ore omokiare oo, na omokungu oo ase okobwatana kw’ogotianania.
swahili: Mnauliza, “Kwa nini?” Ni kwa sababu Bwana ni shahidi kati yako na mke wa ujana wako, kwa sababu umevunja uaminifu naye, ingawa yeye ni mwenzako, mke wa agano lako la ndoa.

english: Has not the LORD made them one, having a portion of the Spirit? And why one? Because He seeks godly offspring. So guard yourselves in your spirit and do not break faith with the wife of your youth.
ekegusii: Omonto oyomo takorete bo, oria omoika ogendererete gotigara ime yaye. Ninki oria oyomo aganetie? Nigo aganetie ororeria rwatananwe robe orwa Nyasae. Ase engencho eyio, mwerende mono, erinde onde tabaisa koba oyo otari omwegenwa ase omokungu bw’obosae bwaye.
swahili: Je, Bwana hakuwafanya wao kuwa mmoja? Katika mwili na katika roho wao ni wa Mungu. Kwa nini wawe mmoja? Kwa sababu Mungu alikuwa akitafuta mzao mwenye kumcha Mungu. Kwa hiyo jihadharini wenyewe katika roho zenu, mtu asivunje uaminifu kwa mke wa ujana wake.

english: “For I hate divorce,” says the LORD, the God of Israel. “He who divorces his wife covers his garment with violence,” says the LORD of Hosts. So guard yourselves in your spirit and do not break faith.
ekegusii: Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, nigo agoteeba iga: “Inche nigo ngechete ogotigana, naende nigo ngechete ng’a omonto nigo agwetuba obotindi buna agwetuba eyanga.” Nabo Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteeba. Ase engencho eyio mwerende timobasa koba abatari abegenwa. Rituko ri’ekiina nigo rire ang’e
swahili: “Ninachukia kuachana,” asema Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli, “pia nachukia mtu anayejivika jeuri kama vazi,” asema Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote. Kwa hiyo jihadharini wenyewe katika roho zenu, wala msije mkavunja uaminifu. Siku Ya Hukumu

english: You have wearied the LORD with your words; yet you ask, “How have we wearied Him?” By saying, “All who do evil are good in the sight of the LORD, and in them He delights,” or, “Where is the God of justice?”
ekegusii: Inwe mwarosirie Omonene n’amang’ana aino. Nigo mokoboria: “Inaki twamorosirie?” Nekiagera mogoteeba ng’a kera omonto ogokora ebibe nigo are omuya ase obosio bw’Omonene, naende ng’a Omonene nigo akogokigwa nere. Naende mwaboria; “Ng’ai Nyasae oyio okonacha ebiina are?”
swahili: Mmemchosha Bwana kwa maneno yenu. Nanyi mnauliza, “Tumemchosha kwa namna gani?” Mmemchosha kwa kusema, “Wote watendao mabaya ni wema machoni pa Bwana, naye anapendezwa nao” au “Mungu wa haki yuko wapi?”

english: If you do not listen, and if you do not take it to heart to honor My name,” says the LORD of Hosts, “I will send a curse among you, and I will curse your blessings. Yes, I have already begun to curse them, because you are not taking it to heart.
ekegusii: Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo agoteeba iga: Onye timogotegerera amang’ana ayio na koyabeka ase chinkoro chiaino ime, erinde mosike erieta riane, rirorio nindete okoragererigwa ase more, ndagererie ogosesenigwa kwaino. Ee, naikire koragereria ogosesenigwa okwo, ekiagera timori kobeeka amang’ana ayio ase chinkoro chiaino.
swahili: Kama hamtasikiliza, na kama hamtaki kuielekeza mioyo yenu kuheshimu Jina langu, nitatuma laana juu yenu, nami nitalaani baraka zenu. Naam, nimekwisha kuzilaani, kwa sababu hamkuielekeza mioyo yenu kuniheshimu mimi,” Asema Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote.

english: Behold, I will rebuke your descendants, and I will spread dung on your faces, the waste from your feasts, and you will be carried off with it.
ekegusii: Nintogonyere ororeria rwaino, nintube amaiso aino n’esike ye ching’iti echio mokorua chibe ebing’wanso. Abanto mbaabarente baababeeke ase esike eyio.
swahili: “Kwa sababu yenu nitawakatilia mbali wazao wenu. Nitazipaka nyuso zenu mavi, mavi ya dhabihu zenu. Nanyi mtafukuzwa pamoja nazo mtoke mbele zangu.

english: Then you will know that I have sent you this commandment so that My covenant with Levi may continue,” says the LORD of Hosts.
ekegusii: Erio nario moramanye ng’a inche nabachiikerete amang’ana ayio, erinde okobwatana kwane kw’ogotianania nakorete na Lawi kogenderere kobao botambe. Nabo Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteeba.
swahili: Nanyi mtajua kuwa nimewapelekea onyo hili ili kwamba Agano langu na Lawi lipate kuendelea,” asema Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote.

english: “My covenant with him was one of life and peace, which I gave to him; it called for reverence, and he revered Me and stood in awe of My name.
ekegusii: “Okobwatana kw’ogotianania nakorete nere nokw’obogima na omorembe. Okwo nigo namoete, erinde anyiroke. Ere akanyiroka, akaba okoiguswa ase engencho y’erieta riane.
swahili: “Agano langu lilikuwa pamoja naye, agano la uhai na amani, nami nilimpa yote, ili aniche na kuniheshimu, naye akaniheshimu na kusimama akilicha Jina langu.

english: True instruction was in his mouth, and nothing false was found on his lips. He walked with Me in peace and uprightness, and he turned many from iniquity.
ekegusii: Amorokererio amaronge nigo arenge ase omonwa oye, na obobe tibwanyorekanete ase ebikoba biaye. Nigo abeete ogotaara nainche ase omorembe na oboronge, na akaonchora abanto abange korwa ase ebibe.
swahili: Fundisho la kweli lilikuwa kinywani mwake, wala hakuna uongo wowote uliopatikana katika midomo yake. Alitembea nami katika amani na unyofu, naye akawageuza wengi kutoka dhambini.

english: For the lips of a priest should preserve knowledge, and people should seek instruction from his mouth, because he is the messenger of the LORD of Hosts.
ekegusii: Ebikoba bi’Omokuani goika birende chisemi, na abanto barigie okworokererigwa korwa ase omonwa oye, ekiagera nigo are omotomwa one inche Omonene bw’Emeganda.
swahili: “Kwa maana yapasa midomo ya kuhani kuhifadhi maarifa. Tena kutoka kinywani mwake watu wangepaswa kutafuta mafundisho, kwa sababu yeye ni mjumbe wa Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote.

english: But you have departed from the way, and your instruction has caused many to stumble. You have violated the covenant of Levi,” says the LORD of Hosts.
ekegusii: “Korende inwe mwagobeire korwa ase enchera, mwagerire abanto abange bagochirwe ase engencho y’amorokererio aino; ase igo mwasaririe okobwatana kw’ogotianania okwo nakorete na Lawi. Nabo Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteeba.
swahili: Lakini mmegeuka mkaiacha njia, na kwa mafundisho yenu mmesababisha wengi kujikwaa. Mmevunja agano na Lawi,” asema Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote.

english: “So I in turn have made you despised and humiliated before all the people, because you have not kept My ways, but have shown partiality in matters of the law.” Judah’s Unfaithfulness
ekegusii: Inwe mwangire kobwatia chinchera chiane; nigo mogwanchereria abanto ekero mokworokereria amachiiko. Ase ayio nimbatige mochaaywe na gokeeigwa ase amasio y’ abanto bonsi.” Abanto batari abegenwa ase Nyasae
swahili: “Kwa hiyo nimewasababisha ninyi kudharauliwa na kufedheheshwa mbele ya watu wote, kwa sababu hamkufuata njia zangu, bali mmeonyesha upendeleo katika mambo ya sheria.” Yuda Si Mwaminifu

english: “Behold, I will send My messenger, who will prepare the way before Me. Then the Lord whom you seek will suddenly come to His temple—the Messenger of the covenant, in whom you delight—see, He is coming,” says the LORD of Hosts.
ekegusii: Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo agoteeba iga: “Rora, nintome omotomwa one andoiserie enchera, n’Omonene oyio mokorigia nache mobosokano ase Hekalu yaye; nere omotomwa bw’okobwatana kw’ogotianania oyio moganetie. Ee, ngocha are.”
swahili: “Angalieni, nitamtuma mjumbe wangu, atakayeiandaa njia mbele yangu. Ndipo ghafula Bwana mnayemtafuta atakuja hekaluni mwake. Mjumbe wa Agano, ambaye mnamwonea shauku, atakuja,” asema Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote.

english: Bring the full tithe into the storehouse, so that there may be food in My house. Test Me in this,” says the LORD of Hosts. “See if I will not open the windows of heaven and pour out for you blessing without measure.
ekegusii: Inwe renta ensemo ya ikomi eng’ikeranu ase ekungo y’enyomba y’ane, erinde endagera ebe ase enyomba y’ane. Ase enchera eyio inwe monteeme gose tinkobaigorera ebibao bia igoro mbaumorere ogosesenigwa okonge mono gotari korengeka. Nabo inche Omonene bw’Emeganda ngoteeba.
swahili: Leteni zaka kamili ghalani, ili kuwe na chakula katika nyumba yangu. Nijaribuni katika hili,” asema Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, “nanyi mwone kama sitawafungulia madirisha ya mbinguni na kuwamwagieni baraka nyingi mpaka mkose nafasi ya kutosha.

english: I will rebuke the devourer for you, so that it will not destroy the fruits of your land, and the vine in your field will not fail to produce fruit,” says the LORD of Hosts.
ekegusii: Nintogonyere ebigosaria okwama kwe riroba riaino, tibigosaria, gose amasabibu aino takoaroroka kaare amarere. Nabo inche Omonene bw’Emeganda ngoteeba.
swahili: Nami kwa ajili yenu nitamkemea yeye alaye, wala hataharibu mazao ya ardhi yenu, wala mzabibu wenu hautapukutisha matunda yake kabla ya wakati wake,” asema Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote.

english: “Then all the nations will call you blessed, for you will be a land of delight,” says the LORD of Hosts. The Book of Remembrance
ekegusii: Erio abanto b’ebisaku bionsi inabaabaroke abasesenirie, ekiagera ense yaino n’ebe y’okogokia. Nabo inche Omonene bw’Emeganda ngoteeba.” Eira ya Nyasae y’amaabera
swahili: “Ndipo mataifa yote yatawaita mliobarikiwa, kwa maana nchi yenu itakuwa ya kupendeza sana,” asema Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote.

english: “Your words against Me have been harsh,” says the LORD. “Yet you ask, ‘What have we spoken against You?’
ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: “Inwe mwakwanire amang’ana amakong’u igoro y’ane. Korende nigo mokoboria: Mang’ana ki amakong’u twakwanire igoro yao?
swahili: “Mmesema vitu vigumu dhidi yangu,” asema Bwana. “Hata hivyo mnauliza, ‘Tumesema nini dhidi yako?’

english: You have said, ‘It is futile to serve God. What have we gained by keeping His requirements and walking mournfully before the LORD of Hosts?
ekegusii: Inwe mwateebire: Okomokorera Nyasae, ayio namang’ana abosa. Mbuya ki twanyorire ase okobwata amachiiko aye, gose ase ogotaara ase obosio bw’Omonene bw’Emeganda tore nomoichano?
swahili: “Mmesema, ‘Ni bure kumtumikia Mungu. Tumepata faida gani kwa kushika maagizo yake na kwenda kama waombolezaji mbele za Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote?

english: So now we call the arrogant blessed. Not only do evildoers prosper, they even test God and escape.’”
ekegusii: Bono nigo tokoroka abwo bare abaenenu ng’a mbasesenirie. Abakori amabe nabwo bagendererete konyora amaya; tari ayio oka, korende nonya nekero bagoteema Nyasae nigo bagokonywa.”
swahili: Lakini sasa wenye kiburi wanabarikiwa. Hakika watenda mabaya wanastawi, pia hata wale wanaoshindana na Mungu ndio wanaosalimika.’ ”

english: At that time those who feared the LORD spoke with one another, and the LORD listened and heard them. So a scroll of remembrance was written before Him regarding those who feared the LORD and honored His name.
ekegusii: Erio abanto abwo bamoirogete Omonene bakaba bagokwana barabwo ase barabwo; Omonene agategerera, akaigwa amang’ana abo, na egetabu y’ekeinyorio ekarikwa ase obosio bwaye ase okoinyora abwo bamoirogete na barengereretie igoro y’erieta riaye.
swahili: Ndipo wale waliomcha Bwana wakasemezana wao kwa wao, naye Bwana akasikiliza na akasikia. Kitabu cha kumbukumbu kikaandikwa mbele yake kuhusu wale ambao walimcha Bwana na kuliheshimu jina lake.

english: “They will be Mine,” says the LORD of Hosts, “on the day when I prepare My treasured possession. And I will spare them as a man spares his own son who serves him.
ekegusii: Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo agoteeba iga: “Abanto aba mbabe abanto bane bori ase rituko erio ndakore ring’ana, nimbarorere amaabera buna omonto akorora amaabera ase omwana oye okomokorera.
swahili: “Nao watakuwa watu wangu,” asema Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, “katika siku ile nitakapowafanya watu kuwa hazina yangu. Nitawahurumia, kama vile kwa huruma mtu amhurumiavyo mwanawe anayemtumikia.

english: So you will again distinguish between the righteous and the wicked, between those who serve God and those who do not.”
ekegusii: Erio imorore ogwatananeka ase egati y’omonyaboronge na omokori amabe, na ase egati y’oyogonkorera inche Nyasae na oria otari gonkorera.”
swahili: Kwa mara nyingine tena utaona tofauti kati ya wenye haki na waovu, kati ya wale wanaomtumikia Mungu na wale wasiomtumikia.

english: But who can endure the day of His coming? And who can stand when He appears? For He will be like a refiner’s fire, like a launderer’s soap.
ekegusii: Korende ning’o oranyare gotenena koremereria rituko ri’Omonene, na ning’o oranyare gotenena ase ogwekengera ekero akooroka? Ere nigo anga buna omorero bw’omoturi ebioma, na buna esabuni y’omosibia chianga.
swahili: Lakini ni nani atakayeweza kustahimili hiyo siku ya kuja kwake? Ni nani awezaye kusimama atakapotokea? Kwa kuwa atakuwa kama moto wa mfua fedha au kama sabuni ya afuaye nguo.

english: And He will sit as a refiner and purifier of silver; He will purify the sons of Levi and refine them like gold and silver. Then they will present offerings to the LORD in righteousness.
ekegusii: Ere naikaranse buna oyo ogosamba na gosibia chifeta. Ere nachene Abalawi, abasibie buna chitaabu ne chifeta chigosibigwa, erinde banyare korua ebing’wanso bi’oboronge ase Omonene.
swahili: Ataketi kama mfuaji na asafishaye fedha. Atawatakasa Walawi, naye atawasafisha kama dhahabu na fedha. Kisha Bwana atakuwa na watu watakaoleta sadaka katika haki,

english: Then the offerings of Judah and Jerusalem will please the LORD, as in days of old and years gone by.
ekegusii: Erio ebing’wanso bi’Abayuda, na ebi’ abanto ba Yerusalemu, bigokie Omonene, buna ase amatuko aria a kare, na ase emiaka ya kare.
swahili: nazo sadaka za Yuda na Yerusalemu zitakubalika kwa Bwana, kama katika siku zilizopita, kama katika miaka ya zamani.

english: “Then I will draw near to you for judgment. And I will be a swift witness against sorcerers and adulterers and perjurers, against oppressors of the widowed and fatherless, and against those who defraud laborers of their wages and deny justice to the foreigner but do not fear Me,” says the LORD of Hosts. Robbing God
ekegusii: Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo agoteeba iga: “Nimbaike ang’e ase okonacha ekiina. Nimbe kirori omwango igoro y’abarogi na abatomani, na abagotiana oborimo, na abagokorera abarikwa emeremo bobe ase okobarina ching’eria chiabo, na abagokorera ababoraka ne chintakana bobe, na abakoonchorana oboronge bw’abamenyi, korende tibanyirogeti. Ogoakana ensemo ya ikomi
swahili: “Basi nitakuja karibu nanyi ili kuhukumu. Nami nitakuwa mwepesi kushuhudia dhidi ya wachawi, wazinzi, waapao kwa uongo, wanaopunja vibarua malipo yao, wanaowaonea wajane na yatima, na wanaowanyima wageni haki, lakini hawaniogopi mimi,” asema Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote. Kumwibia Mungu

english: “Because I, the LORD, do not change, you descendants of Jacob have not been destroyed.
ekegusii: “Inche Omonene tindi koonchoka, na ase engencho eyio, inwe ab’ororeria rwa Yakobo timwasiretigwe.
swahili: “Mimi Bwana sibadiliki. Kwa hiyo ninyi, enyi uzao wa Yakobo, hamjaangamizwa.

english: Yet from the days of your fathers, you have turned away from My statutes and have not kept them. Return to Me, and I will return to you,” says the LORD of Hosts. “But you ask, ‘How can we return?’
ekegusii: Korwa ase amatuko e chisokoro chiaino inwe mwagoberete mogatiga emeroberio y’ane echiikire, timwayebwatete. Bono inche Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo ngoteeba iga: Ing’iranera, nainche nimbairanere. Korende inwe nigo mokoboria: Tokoiranere ase inchera ki?
swahili: Tangu wakati wa baba zenu mmegeukia mbali na amri zangu nanyi hamkuzishika. Nirudieni mimi, nami nitawarudia ninyi,” asema Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote. “Lakini mnauliza, ‘Tutarudi kwa namna gani?’

english: Will a man rob God? Yet you are robbing Me! But you ask, ‘How do we rob You?’ In tithes and offerings.
ekegusii: Inee! Omonto nanyare konyibera inche Nyasae ebiane? Korende inwe mwanyibeire ebiane. Inwe nigo mokoboria: Ninki twakoibeire? Mwanyibeire ensemo ya ikomi na okoruegwa konde.
swahili: “Je, mwanadamu atamwibia Mungu? Hata hivyo mnaniibia mimi. “Lakini mnauliza, ‘Tunakuibia kwa namna gani?’ “Mnaniibia zaka na dhabihu.

english: You are cursed with a curse, yet you—the whole nation—are still robbing Me.
ekegusii: Mwaragererigwe nokoragererigwa, ekiagera inwe egesaku eke gionsi mwanyibeire ebiane.
swahili: Mko chini ya laana, ninyi taifa lote, kwa sababu mnaniibia mimi.

english: “For behold, the day is coming, burning like a furnace, when all the arrogant and every evildoer will be stubble; the day is coming when I will set them ablaze,” says the LORD of Hosts. “Not a root or branch will be left to them.”
ekegusii: Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo agoteeba iga: “Rora, rituko ngocha rire rigosamba buna omorero o riko. Erio abanto abaenenu bonsi, na abakori amabe bonsi, ’mbabe buna obonyansi obwomo, n’erituko erio rigocha nigo rirabasambe kegima, tirigotiga omori gose orosagia.
swahili: “Hakika siku inakuja, itawaka kama tanuru. Wote wenye kiburi na kila mtenda mabaya watakuwa mabua makavu, na siku ile inayokuja itawawasha moto,” asema Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote. “Hakuna mzizi wala tawi litakalosalia kwao.

english: “But for you who fear My name, the sun of righteousness will rise with healing in its wings, and you will go out and leap like calves from the stall.
ekegusii: Korende ase more inwe abamoirogete erieta riane, erioba ri’oboronge ’ndioroke rire nokogwenia inse ye chimbaaba chiaye. Inwe inamosoke mobe mogotiratiria buna chimori ekero chigosokigwa korwa ase obweri.
swahili: Bali kwenu ninyi mnaoliheshimu Jina langu, jua la haki litawazukia, lenye kuponya katika mabawa yake. Nanyi mtatoka nje na kurukaruka kama ndama aliyeachiwa kutoka zizini.

english: Then you will trample the wicked, for they will be ashes under the soles of your feet on the day I am preparing,” says the LORD of Hosts.
ekegusii: Ase rituko erio ’ndakore ring’ana erio, inwe imotiringe abakori amabe n’amagoro aino, na barabwo ’mbabe buna ribu.” Nabo Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteeba.
swahili: Kisha ninyi mtawakanyaga waovu, nao watakuwa majivu chini ya nyayo za miguu yenu siku ile nitakayofanya mambo haya,” asema Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote.

english: “Remember the law of My servant Moses, the statutes and ordinances I commanded him for all Israel at Horeb.
ekegusii: “Inwe inyora amachiiko a Musa, omosomba one, na emeroberio yonsi namochiigete agwo ase egetunwa kia Horebu, oborokererie Abaisraeli bonsi.
swahili: “Kumbukeni sheria ya mtumishi wangu Mose, amri na sheria nilizompa huko Horebu kwa ajili ya Israeli wote.

english: Behold, I will send you Elijah the prophet before the coming of the great and awesome Day of the LORD.
ekegusii: “Rora, nimbatomere Elija omobani atang’anere rituko riria rinene ri’Omonene ri’okoondokia ritaracha.
swahili: “Tazama, nitawapelekea nabii Eliya kabla ya kuja siku ile iliyo kuu na ya kutisha ya Bwana.

english: And he will turn the hearts of the fathers to their children, and the hearts of the children to their fathers. Otherwise, I will come and strike the land with a curse.”
ekegusii: Ere nairanie chinkoro chi’abaise gochia ase abana babo, na echi’abana gochia ase abaise, erinde ekero ’ndache timbaisa goaka ense eye nokoragererigwa.”
swahili: Ataigeuza mioyo ya baba iwaelekee watoto wao, na mioyo ya watoto iwaelekee baba zao, la sivyo nitakuja na kuipiga nchi kwa laana.”

english: And calling His twelve disciples to Him, Jesus gave them authority over unclean spirits, so that they could drive them out and heal every disease and sickness.
ekegusii: Yeso akarangeria aborokigwa baye ikomi na babere bache asare, akabaa okobua ase ebirecha ebibe na kobiseria, na kogwenia amarwaire onsi na oboreu bwonsi.
swahili: Ndipo Yesu akawaita wanafunzi wake kumi na wawili, naye akawapa mamlaka juu ya pepo wachafu, ili waweze kuwatoa na kuponya kila ugonjwa na maradhi ya kila aina.

english: Take no bag for the road, or second tunic, or sandals, or staff; for the worker is worthy of his provisions.
ekegusii: gose esaro ase orogendo, gose chianga ibere, gose ebikoroto, nonya nenyimbo, ekiagera omokori emeremo nagwenerete endagera yaye.
swahili: Msichukue mkoba wa safari, wala kanzu mbili, wala jozi ya pili ya viatu, wala fimbo, kwa maana mtendakazi anastahili posho yake.

english: Whatever town or village you enter, find out who is worthy there and stay at his house until you move on.
ekegusii: Na omochie onde bwonsi morasoe, na ase ekenyoro gionsi, morigie ning’o ogwenerete aroro, mobeere nere goika moruo.
swahili: “Mji wowote au kijiji chochote mtakapoingia, tafuteni humo mtu anayestahili, nanyi kaeni kwake mpaka mtakapoondoka.

english: As you enter the home, greet its occupants.
ekegusii: Ekero mogosoa enyomba eria, yekwanie.
swahili: Mkiingia kwenye nyumba, itakieni amani.

english: If the home is worthy, let your peace rest on it; but if it is not, let your peace return to you.
ekegusii: Onye enyomba eria egwenerete, tiga omorembe oino oyeikere; ko onye tegwenereti, omorembe oino nobairanere inwe.
swahili: Kama nyumba hiyo inastahili, amani yenu na iwe juu yake. La sivyo, amani yenu na iwarudie ninyi.

english: And if anyone will not welcome you or heed your words, shake the dust off your feet when you leave that home or town.
ekegusii: Onye onde tari orabaroisie inwe, gose koigwa amang’ana aino, kamokorua enyomba eria gose omochie oria, orotu rw’amagoro aino morokong’ontereo.
swahili: Kama mtu yeyote hatawakaribisha ninyi, wala kusikiliza maneno yenu, kungʼuteni mavumbi kutoka kwenye miguu yenu mtakapokuwa mnatoka kwenye nyumba hiyo au mji huo.

english: Truly I tell you, it will be more bearable for Sodom and Gomorrah on the day of judgment than for that town. Sheep among Wolves (2 Timothy 1:3–12)
ekegusii: Nekeene nabateebirie: Nebe aororo ase Sodomu na Gomora ase rituko ri’ekiina kobua ase omochie oria. Ogochandwa kogochia gocha
swahili: Amin, nawaambia, itakuwa rahisi zaidi kwa miji ya Sodoma na Gomora kustahimili katika hukumu kuliko mji huo. Mateso Yanayokuja (Marko 13:9-13; Luka 21:12-17)

english: Behold, I am sending you out like sheep among wolves; therefore be as shrewd as snakes and as innocent as doves.
ekegusii: “Rigereria, nabatomire inwe buna ching’ondi gati‐gati ye chisese chi’orosana. Ase ayio mobe abang’aini buna ching’iti, na abororo buna amaruma.
swahili: “Tazama, ninawatuma kama kondoo katikati ya mbwa mwitu. Kwa hiyo mwe werevu kama nyoka na wapole kama hua.

english: But beware of men; for they will hand you over to their councils and flog you in their synagogues.
ekegusii: Inwe mwerende ase Mwanyabaanto, ekiagera barabwo nabaabaire ase ebigambero, babang’wanie emecharichi ase chisinagogi chiabo.
swahili: “Jihadharini na wanadamu; kwa maana watawapeleka katika mabaraza yao na kuwapiga kwenye masinagogi yao.

english: On My account, you will be brought before governors and kings as witnesses to them and to the Gentiles.
ekegusii: Na inwe namoirwe ase abagabana na ase abarwoti ase engencho y’ane, koba kirori ase bare na ase abanto b’Ebisaku.
swahili: Nanyi mtaburutwa mbele ya watawala na wafalme kwa ajili yangu, ili kuwa ushuhuda kwao na kwa watu wa Mataifa.

english: But when they hand you over, do not worry about how to respond or what to say. In that hour you will be given what to say.
ekegusii: Ekero bakobaira, timoichana buna mogochia koiraneria, gose eki mogochia gokwana, ekiagera ase ekero keria inamoegwe aya morakwane;
swahili: Lakini watakapowapeleka humo, msisumbuke kufikiria mtakalosema, kwa maana mtapewa la kusema wakati huo.

english: These are the names of the twelve apostles: first Simon, called Peter, and his brother Andrew; James son of Zebedee, and his brother John;
ekegusii: Na amarieta abotomwa baria ikomi na babere naro aya: Oyo bw’eritang’ani, Simioni, oyio ore korokwa naende Petero, na Anderea momura omwabo; Yakobo, omwana o Zebedi na Yohana momura omwabo;
swahili: Haya ndiyo majina ya hao mitume kumi na wawili: wa kwanza, Simoni aitwaye Petro, na Andrea nduguye; Yakobo mwana wa Zebedayo, na Yohana nduguye;

english: For it will not be you speaking, but the Spirit of your Father speaking through you.
ekegusii: inaki tari inwe morakwane, korende n’Omoika o Iso oino orakwane goetera ase more.
swahili: Kwa sababu si ninyi mtakaokuwa mkinena, bali ni Roho wa Baba yenu atakayekuwa akinena kupitia kwenu.

english: Brother will betray brother to death, and a father his child; children will rise against their parents and have them put to death.
ekegusii: Na momura omwabo omonto narue oyomwabo, erinde aitwe, na ise nomwana oye, na abana nabaimokere abaibori babo babaite,
swahili: “Ndugu atamsaliti ndugu yake ili auawe, naye baba atamsaliti mtoto wake. Watoto nao wataasi dhidi ya wazazi wao na kusababisha wauawe.

english: You will be hated by everyone because of My name, but the one who perseveres to the end will be saved.
ekegusii: na inwe namogechwe n’abanto bonsi ase engencho y’erieta riane, korende oyoraaremererie goika omoerio, oyio natooreke.
swahili: Watu wote watawachukia kwa ajili ya Jina langu. Lakini yule atakayevumilia hadi mwisho ataokolewa.

english: When they persecute you in one town, flee to the next. Truly I tell you, you will not reach all the towns of Israel before the Son of Man comes.
ekegusii: Ekero barabwo barabachande ase omochie oyomo, motame gochia ase oyonde; nekeene nabateebirie: Timogokoora emechie y’Abaisraeli Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto ataracha.
swahili: Wakiwatesa katika mji mmoja, kimbilieni mji mwingine. Amin, amin nawaambia, hamtamaliza miji yote ya Israeli kabla Mwana wa Adamu kuja.

english: A disciple is not above his teacher, nor a servant above his master.
ekegusii: “Omworokigwa tari omonene kobua Omworokia oye, gose omosomba tari omonene kobua omonene oye.
swahili: “Mwanafunzi hawezi kumzidi mwalimu wake, wala mtumishi hamzidi bwana wake.

english: It is enough for a disciple to be like his teacher, and a servant like his master. If the head of the house has been called Beelzebul, how much more the members of his household! Fear God Alone (Luke 12:4–7)
ekegusii: Yamoisanire omworokigwa koba buna Omworokia oye, na omosomba buna omonene oye. Inee! Onye bamorogete omonyene enyomba Beelizebuli, tibakobachecheria baria b’enyomba yaye mono komobua ere? Oyogwenerete koirokwa (Luk 12:2-9)
swahili: Yatosha mwanafunzi kuwa kama mwalimu wake, na mtumishi kuwa kama bwana wake. Ikiwa mkuu wa nyumba ameitwa Beelzebuli, je, si watawaita zaidi wale wa nyumbani mwake! Anayestahili Kuogopwa (Luka 12:2-9)

english: So do not be afraid of them. For there is nothing concealed that will not be disclosed, and nothing hidden that will not be made known.
ekegusii: “Ase ayio, timoiroka baria, ekiagera ing’ana rinde tiriri ribisire ritache koorokigwa, gose erikenganete ritache komanyekana.
swahili: “Kwa hiyo msiwaogope hao, kwa maana hakuna kilichofichika ambacho hakitafunuliwa, wala hakuna siri ambayo haitajulikana.

english: What I tell you in the dark, speak in the daylight; what is whispered in your ear, proclaim from the housetops.
ekegusii: Eri nkobateebia ase omosunte ime, ritebe ase omobaso; na eri mokoigwa rikomonywa, rirarie igoro ase ebirama.
swahili: Ninalowaambia gizani, ninyi lisemeni mchana peupe. Na lile mnalosikia likinongʼonwa masikioni mwenu, lihubirini juu ya nyumba.

english: Do not be afraid of those who kill the body but cannot kill the soul. Instead, fear the One who can destroy both soul and body in hell.
ekegusii: Timoiroka abagoita omobere, abatanyare goita omoyo; kobua moiroke oyo oranyare goita omobere na omoyo ase omorero o kare na kare.
swahili: Msiwaogope wale wauao mwili lakini hawawezi kuua roho. Afadhali mwogopeni yeye awezaye kuiangamiza roho na mwili katika jehanamu.

english: Are not two sparrows sold for a penny? Yet not one of them will fall to the ground apart from the will of your Father.
ekegusii: Inee! Chinchiro ibere tichiri koonigwa ase ebesa eyemo? Naende nonya nakamo kabo tigakogwa inse, Iso oino atancheti.
swahili: Je, shomoro wawili hawauzwi kwa senti moja tu? Lakini hakuna hata mmoja wao atakayeanguka chini pasipo Baba yenu kujua.

english: Philip and Bartholomew; Thomas and Matthew the tax collector; James son of Alphaeus, and Thaddaeus;
ekegusii: Filipo na Batholomayo; Thomas na Matayo, omorusia ebango; Yakobo bw’Alufayo na Tadayo;
swahili: Filipo, na Bartholomayo; Tomaso, na Mathayo mtoza ushuru; Yakobo mwana wa Alfayo, na Thadayo;

english: And even the very hairs of your head are all numbered.
ekegusii: Korende nonya nechitukia chionsi chi’emetwe yaino chiabarirwe.
swahili: Hata nywele za vichwa vyenu zote zimehesabiwa.

english: So do not be afraid; you are worth more than many sparrows. Confessing Christ (Luke 12:8–12)
ekegusii: Ase ayio, timoiroka; inwe imobuete rigori rie chinchiro chinyinge.
swahili: Hivyo msiogope; kwa maana ninyi ni wa thamani kubwa kuliko shomoro wengi.

english: Therefore everyone who confesses Me before men, I will also confess him before My Father in heaven.
ekegusii: Inaki kera omonto oranyatore ase Mwanyabaanto, nainche boigo nimwatore ase Tata one ore igoro,
swahili: “Kila mtu atakayenikiri mbele ya watu, mimi nami nitamkiri yeye mbele za Baba yangu aliye mbinguni.

english: But whoever denies Me before men, I will also deny him before My Father in heaven. Not Peace but a Sword (Micah 7:1–6; Luke 12:49–53)
ekegusii: korende oyorankane ase Mwanyabaanto, nainche nimokane ase Tata one ore igoro. Tari omorembe korende n’omoyio (Luk 12:51-53; 14:26-27)
swahili: Lakini yeyote atakayenikana mimi mbele ya watu, mimi nami nitamkana mbele za Baba yangu aliye mbinguni.” Sikuleta Amani, Bali Upanga (Luka 12:51-53; 14:26-27)

english: Do not assume that I have come to bring peace to the earth; I have not come to bring peace, but a sword.
ekegusii: “Timokaga ng’a nigo naachire korenta omorembe ase ense; tincheti korenta omorembe, korende omoro bw’eseegi.
swahili: “Msidhani kwamba nimekuja kuleta amani duniani. Sikuja kuleta amani bali upanga.

english: For I have come to turn ‘a man against his father, a daughter against her mother, a daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law.
ekegusii: Eke nacheire nakio eke: nogwatanana omonto na ise, omwana omoiseke na ng’ina, na moka momura na ng’ina biara.
swahili: Kwa maana nimekuja kumfitini “ ‘mtu na babaye, binti na mamaye, mkwe na mama mkwe wake;

english: A man’s enemies will be the members of his own household.’
ekegusii: Na abanto b’enyomba y’omonto inababe ababisa baye.
swahili: nao adui za mtu watakuwa ni wale watu wa nyumbani kwake.’

english: Anyone who loves his father or mother more than Me is not worthy of Me; anyone who loves his son or daughter more than Me is not worthy of Me;
ekegusii: Oyo bwanchete ise gose ng’ina kombua, oyio tangwenereti, na oyo bwanchete omwana oye omomura gose omoiseke kombua, oyio tangwenereti.
swahili: “Yeyote ampendaye baba yake au mama yake kuliko anavyonipenda mimi, hastahili kuwa wangu. Yeyote ampendaye mwanawe au binti yake kuliko anavyonipenda mimi, hastahili kuwa wangu.

english: and anyone who does not take up his cross and follow Me is not worthy of Me.
ekegusii: Na oyo otabogoreti omosalaba oye na gontunyana, tangwenereti.
swahili: Tena yeyote asiyeuchukua msalaba wake na kunifuata, hastahili kuwa wangu.

english: Whoever finds his life will lose it, and whoever loses his life for My sake will find it. The Reward of Service (2 Kings 4:8–17)
ekegusii: Oyorarigie koegera obogima bwaye nabosirie, na oyorasirie obogima bwaye ase engencho y’ane nabonyore. Eng’eria
swahili: Kwa maana yeyote anayetaka kuyaokoa maisha yake atayapoteza, lakini yeyote atakayeyapoteza maisha yake kwa ajili yangu atayapata. Watakaopokea Thawabu (Marko 9:41)

english: Simon the Zealot, and Judas Iscariot, who betrayed Jesus. The Ministry of the Twelve (Mark 6:7–13; Luke 9:1–6)
ekegusii: Simioni omoKaanani, na Yudasi Iskariota, ere oria omoruete. Emeremo ya baria ikomi na babere (Mar 6:7-13; Luk 9:1-6)
swahili: Simoni Mkananayo, na Yuda Iskariote aliyemsaliti Yesu.

english: He who receives you receives Me, and he who receives Me receives the One who sent Me.
ekegusii: “Oyobanchire inwe, onyanchire na inche, na oyo oranyanche inche, omwanchire ere oyontomete.
swahili: “Mtu yeyote atakayewapokea ninyi atakuwa amenipokea mimi, na yeyote atakayenipokea mimi atakuwa amempokea yeye aliyenituma.

english: Whoever receives a prophet because he is a prophet will receive a prophet’s reward, and whoever receives a righteous man because he is a righteous man will receive a righteous man’s reward.
ekegusii: Oyobwanchire omobani ekiagera ere nomobani, nanyore eng’eria y’omobani; na oyo bwanchire omonto omooronge ekiagera ere nomonto omooronge, nanyore eng’eria y’omonto omooronge.
swahili: Mtu yeyote anayempokea nabii kwa kuwa ni nabii atapokea thawabu ya nabii, naye mtu anayempokea mwenye haki kwa kuwa ni mwenye haki atapokea thawabu ya mwenye haki.

english: And if anyone gives even a cup of cold water to one of these little ones because he is My disciple, truly I tell you, he will never lose his reward.”
ekegusii: Inaki onde bwensi oramoe oyomo obo bw’aba abake egekombe kiamaache amakendu ekiagera are omworokigwa one, nekeene nabatebirie: Takoyesiria eng’eria yaye nonya ng’ake.”
swahili: Kama yeyote akimpa hata kikombe cha maji baridi mmoja wa hawa wadogo kwa kuwa ni mwanafunzi wangu, amin, nawaambia, hataikosa thawabu yake.”

english: These twelve Jesus sent out with the following instructions: “Do not go onto the road of the Gentiles or enter any town of the Samaritans.
ekegusii: Aba ikomi na babere Yeso akabatoma, akabachiika, “Timogenda enchera ende yonsi y’ abanto b’Ebisaku, timosoa nonya nomochie onde bwonsi bw’Abasamaria,
swahili: Hawa kumi na wawili, Yesu aliwatuma akawaagiza: “Msiende miongoni mwa watu wa Mataifa, wala msiingie mji wowote wa Wasamaria.

english: Go rather to the lost sheep of Israel.
ekegusii: korende mbuya mochiere ching’ondi chinsiru chi’enyomba ya Israeli.
swahili: Lakini afadhali mshike njia kuwaendea kondoo wa nyumba ya Israeli waliopotea.

english: As you go, preach this message: ‘The kingdom of heaven is near.’
ekegusii: Na inwe ase okogenda kwaino, randia, moteebe: Oborwoti bwa igoro bwaikire ang’e.
swahili: Wakati mnapokwenda, hubirini mkisema, ‘Ufalme wa Mbinguni umekaribia.’

english: Heal the sick, raise the dead, cleanse the lepers, drive out demons. Freely you have received; freely give.
ekegusii: Abarwaire bagwenie, abakuure babokie, abare noborwaire bwa ukoma basibie, na ebirecha birusie. Mwaeirwe bosa, nainwe karue bosa.
swahili: Ponyeni wagonjwa, fufueni wafu, takaseni wenye ukoma, toeni pepo wachafu. Mmepata bure, toeni bure.

english: Do not carry any gold or silver or copper in your belts.
ekegusii: Timobogoria chitaabu, gose chifeta, gose chitaai ase ebimoya biaino,
swahili: Msichukue dhahabu, wala fedha, wala shaba kwenye vifuko vyenu.

english: After Jesus had finished instructing His twelve disciples, He went on from there to teach and preach in their cities.
ekegusii: Ekero Yeso akoorire gochiika aborokigwa baye ikomi na babere, akaimoka korwa aria, akagenda kworokereria na korandia ase emechie yabo. Abatomwa korwa ase Yohana Omobatisi (Luk 7:18-35)
swahili: Baada ya Yesu kumaliza kutoa maagizo kwa wanafunzi wake kumi na wawili, aliondoka hapo akaenda kufundisha na kuhubiri katika miji yao.

english: This is the one about whom it is written: ‘Behold, I will send My messenger ahead of You, who will prepare Your way before You.’
ekegusii: Inaki oyio nere amang’ana aya ariikire igoro yaye: Rigereria, natomire omotomwa one ase obosio bwao, oyo oratang’ane koroisia enchera yao!
swahili: Huyu ndiye ambaye habari zake zimeandikwa: “ ‘Tazama nitamtuma mjumbe wangu mbele yako, atakayetengeneza njia mbele yako.’

english: Truly I tell you, among those born of women there has risen no one greater than John the Baptist. Yet even the least in the kingdom of heaven is greater than he.
ekegusii: Nekeene nabateebirie inwe ng’a ase baria baiboire nomokuungu, mobani onde taratoka ore omonene kobua Yohana Omobatisi; korende oyore omoke ase oborwoti bwa igoro nomonene komobua.
swahili: Amin, nawaambia, miongoni mwa wale waliozaliwa na wanawake, hajatokea mtu aliye mkuu kuliko Yohana Mbatizaji. Lakini aliye mdogo kabisa katika Ufalme wa Mbinguni ni mkuu kuliko Yohana.

english: From the days of John the Baptist until now, the kingdom of heaven has been subject to violence, and the violent lay claim to it.
ekegusii: Korwa amatuko a Yohana Omobatisi goika bono oborwoti bwa igoro nigo bogosogwa neburuburu, na abwo abanyaburuburu nigo bakobosoa ne chinguru.
swahili: Tangu siku za Yohana Mbatizaji hadi sasa, Ufalme wa Mbinguni hupatikana kwa nguvu, nao wenye nguvu wanauteka.

english: For all the Prophets and the Law prophesied until John.
ekegusii: Inaki ababani bonsi mbaabanete, na amachiiko boigo, goika ekero kia Yohana.
swahili: Kwa maana manabii wote na Sheria walitabiri mpaka wakati wa Yohana.

english: And if you are willing to accept it, he is the Elijah who was to come.
ekegusii: Na inwe onye morigetie gwancha, ere nere Elija otebetwe ore gocha.
swahili: Ikiwa mko tayari kukubali hilo, yeye ndiye yule Eliya ambaye manabii walikuwa wamesema angekuja.

english: He who has ears, let him hear.
ekegusii: Oyore namato akoigwera, tiga aigwe.
swahili: Yeye aliye na masikio, na asikie.

english: To what can I compare this generation? They are like children sitting in the marketplaces and calling out to others:
ekegusii: Korende inaki ndakegwekanie ekegori eke? Nigo kegwekaine abana baikaransete ase chichiiro, bakorangeria abagisangio babo, bagoteeba;
swahili: “Lakini kizazi hiki nikifananishe na nini? Kinafanana na watoto waliokaa sokoni wakiwaita wenzao na kuwaambia,

english: ‘We played the flute for you, and you did not dance; we sang a dirge, and you did not mourn.’
ekegusii: “Twababugeirie ebiroria, na inwe timotengeti; tweumirie, na inwe timorereti”.
swahili: “ ‘Tuliwapigia filimbi, lakini hamkucheza; tuliwaimbia nyimbo za maombolezo, lakini hamkuomboleza.’

english: For John came neither eating nor drinking, and they say, ‘He has a demon!’
ekegusii: Inaki Yohana nigo achete, tare koria gose tare konywa: bagateeba; Nare nekerecha.
swahili: Kwa maana Yohana Mbatizaji alikuja, alikuwa hali wala hanywi, nao wanasema, ‘Yeye ana pepo mchafu.’

english: The Son of Man came eating and drinking, and they say, ‘Look at this glutton and drunkard, a friend of tax collectors and sinners!’ But wisdom is vindicated by her actions.” Woe to the Unrepentant (Luke 10:13–16)
ekegusii: Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto nigo achete okoria na konywa, na barabwo bateebire: Rora, rinyandambe na omotindu bw’edivai, omosani bw’abarusia ebango na abanyene ebibe! Na obong’aini bwa Nyasae bwamanyekanire koba oboronge ase abana baye bonsi. Obobe bw’emechie eria etegeneti (Luk 10:13-15)
swahili: Mwana wa Adamu alikuja akila na kunywa, nao wanasema, ‘Tazameni huyu mlafi na mlevi, rafiki wa watoza ushuru na “wenye dhambi.” ’ Lakini hekima huthibitishwa kuwa kweli kwa matendo yake.” Onyo Kwa Miji Isiyotubu (Luka 10:13-15)

english: Meanwhile John heard in prison about the works of Christ, and he sent his disciples
ekegusii: Ekero Yohana achia koigwa aaria ase echela ebitage bia Kristo, agatoma aborokigwa baye komoboria,
swahili: Yohana aliposikia akiwa gerezani mambo ambayo Kristo alikuwa akiyafanya, aliwatuma wanafunzi wake

english: Then Jesus began to denounce the cities in which most of His miracles had been performed, because they did not repent.
ekegusii: Erio Yeso agachaaka gotogonyera emechie eria, aase ebikone biaye ebinge bie chinguru biakorekire, ekiagera etaonchogete:
swahili: Ndipo Yesu akaanza kushutumu miji ambamo alifanya miujiza yake mingi kuliko kwingine, kwa maana watu wake hawakutubu.

english: “Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the miracles that were performed in you had been performed in Tyre and Sidon, they would have repented long ago in sackcloth and ashes.
ekegusii: “Obobe nobwao, Korasini! Obobe nobwao, Bethisaida! Ekiagera onye ebikone bie chinguru biakoregete ase more mbiakorekanete ase Turo na Sidoni, anga abanto b’aroro mbaonchogete kare, ase okobeeka chianga chi’echigunia, na kweaka riibu.
swahili: “Ole wako, Korazini! Ole wako Bethsaida! Kwa maana kama miujiza iliyofanyika kwenu, ingefanyika Tiro na Sidoni, miji hiyo ingekuwa imetubu zamani kwa kuvaa magunia na kujipaka majivu.

english: But I tell you, it will be more bearable for Tyre and Sidon on the day of judgment than for you.
ekegusii: Korende nabateebirie inwe, n’ebe aororo ase Turo na Sidoni ase rituko ri’ekiina kobua ase more.
swahili: Lakini nawaambia, itakuwa rahisi zaidi kwa Tiro na Sidoni kustahimili katika siku ya hukumu, kuliko ninyi.

english: And you, Capernaum, will you be lifted up to heaven? No, you will be brought down to Hades! For if the miracles that were performed in you had been performed in Sodom, it would have remained to this day.
ekegusii: N’aye Kapernaumu, noimokererigwe igoro? Noche goikigwa goika Eora y’Amakweri, ekiagera onye ebikone bie chinguru ebiakoregete ase ore mbiakoregete ase Sodomu, anga omochie oyio noteneine goika reero.
swahili: Nawe Kapernaumu, je, utainuliwa hadi mbinguni? La hasha, utashushwa mpaka kuzimu. Miujiza iliyofanyika kwako ingefanyika huko Sodoma, mji huo ungalikuwepo hadi leo.

english: But I tell you that it will be more bearable for Sodom on the day of judgment than for you.” Rest for the Weary (Luke 10:21–24)
ekegusii: Korende nabateebirie inwe ng’a n’ebe aororo ase ense ya Sodomu ase rituko ri’ekiina kobua ase ore.” Inchwo ase inde monyore ogotimoka (Luk 10:21)
swahili: Lakini nakuambia kwamba, itakuwa rahisi zaidi kwa Sodoma kustahimili katika siku ya hukumu kuliko wewe.” Hakuna Amjuaye Baba Ila Mwana (Luka 10:21-22)

english: At that time Jesus declared, “I praise You, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, because You have hidden these things from the wise and learned, and revealed them to little children.
ekegusii: Ase ekero keria Yeso agakwana, “Nakobaakire aye Tata, Omonene o igoro na ense, ng’a kwababisire abare nobong’aini ne chisemi amang’ana aya, na kwayamaanoire ase abana abake.
swahili: Wakati huo Yesu alisema, “Nakuhimidi Baba, Bwana wa mbingu na nchi, kwa kuwa umewaficha mambo haya wenye hekima na wenye elimu, nawe ukawafunulia watoto wadogo.

english: Yes, Father, for this was well-pleasing in Your sight.
ekegusii: Ee, Tata, oko nakwo kwarenge ogwancha kwao okuya. Obotomwa bwa Yeso omonyene (Luk 10:22)
swahili: Naam, Baba, kwa kuwa hivyo ndivyo ilivyokupendeza.

english: All things have been entrusted to Me by My Father. No one knows the Son except the Father, and no one knows the Father except the Son and those to whom the Son chooses to reveal Him.
ekegusii: “Naeirwe ebinto bionsi na Tata one; monto onde tari omomanyete Omwana otatiga Tata; na onde tari omomanyete Tata otatiga Omwana, na ere oria Omwana agochora komomaanorera.
swahili: “Nimekabidhiwa vitu vyote na Baba yangu: Hakuna mtu amjuaye Mwana ila Baba, wala hakuna amjuaye Baba ila Mwana na yeyote ambaye Mwana anapenda kumfunulia. Yesu Awaita Waliolemewa Na Mizigo

english: Come to Me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest.
ekegusii: Inchuo ase ’nde inwe mwensi aba mwarosigwe ase emeremo emerito, na abwo mwabunekire ne chigurube, na inche nimbatimokie.
swahili: “Njooni kwangu, ninyi nyote mnaotaabika na kulemewa na mizigo, nami nitawapumzisha.

english: Take My yoke upon you and learn from Me; for I am gentle and humble in heart, and you will find rest for your souls.
ekegusii: Bogoria rikorogoto riane, mwegere ase ’nde, ekiagera inche nomokanyeku na omoitongo ase enkoro, na inwe namonyore ogotimoka ase emioyo yaino,
swahili: Jifungeni nira yangu, mjifunze kutoka kwangu, kwa maana mimi ni mpole na mnyenyekevu wa moyo, nanyi mtapata raha nafsini mwenu.

english: to ask Him, “Are You the One who was to come, or should we look for someone else?”
ekegusii: “Aye naye oria ogocha, gose toganye omoao?”
swahili: ili wakamuulize, “Wewe ndiye yule aliyekuwa aje, au tumngojee mwingine?”

english: For My yoke is easy and My burden is light.”
ekegusii: ekiagera rikorogoto riane neriororo, na egurube y’ane nengusu.”
swahili: Kwa maana nira yangu ni laini na mzigo wangu ni mwepesi.”

english: Jesus replied, “Go back and report to John what you hear and see:
ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, akabateebia, “Genda moteebie Yohana aya mwaigwa na korora:
swahili: Yesu akajibu, “Rudini mkamwambie Yohana yale mnayosikia na kuyaona:

english: The blind receive sight, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised, and the good news is preached to the poor.
ekegusii: Abarenge emeuko nkorora bare, abarenge amagata ngotaara bare, abarenge noborwaire bwa ukoma basibekire, abarenge emetino nkoigwa bare, abare ebitondo nkobokigwa bare, na abataka nkoranderigwa bare amang’ana amaya.
swahili: Vipofu wanapata kuona, viwete wanatembea, wenye ukoma wanatakaswa, viziwi wanasikia, wafu wanafufuliwa, na maskini wanahubiriwa habari njema.

english: As John’s disciples were leaving, Jesus began to speak to the crowds about John: “What did you go out into the wilderness to see? A reed swaying in the wind?
ekegusii: Na ekero bachia kogenda, Yeso agachaaka gokwana nemeganda igoro ya Yohana, Inki mwachiete korora aria ase erooro? Negetonto gekonyegerigwa nomwaga?
swahili: Wale wanafunzi wa Yohana walipokuwa wanaondoka, Yesu akaanza kusema na makutano kuhusu Yohana Mbatizaji. Akawauliza, “Mlipokwenda kule nyikani, mlikwenda kuona nini? Je, ni unyasi ukipeperushwa na upepo?

english: Otherwise, what did you go out to see? A man dressed in fine clothes? Look, those who wear fine clothing are found in kings’ palaces.
ekegusii: Gose inki mwachiete korora isiko? Omonto bweboyetie chianga chinterere? Rigereria, abakweboyia chianga chinterere nigo bamenyete ase chinyomba chi’abarwoti.
swahili: Kama sivyo, mlikwenda kuona nini basi? Mtu aliyevaa mavazi ya kifahari? La hasha, watu wanaovaa mavazi ya kifahari wako katika majumba ya wafalme.

english: What then did you go out to see? A prophet? Yes, I tell you, and more than a prophet.
ekegusii: Nase ki rende mwasogete isiko? Korora omobani? Ee, nabateebirie, oyore omonene kobua omobani.
swahili: Basi mlikwenda kuona nini? Mlikwenda kumwona nabii? Naam, nawaambia, yeye ni zaidi ya nabii.

english: At that time Jesus went through the grainfields on the Sabbath. His disciples were hungry and began to pick the heads of grain and eat them.
ekegusii: Ase ekero keria Yeso ngoeta arenge gati y’emegondo ase rituko ri’Esabato, aborokigwa baye mbarenge nenchara, bagachaaka kobutora ebigara, bakoria.
swahili: Wakati huo Yesu alipitia kwenye mashamba ya nafaka siku ya Sabato. Wanafunzi wake walikuwa na njaa, nao wakaanza kuvunja masuke ya nafaka na kuyala.

english: and a man with a withered hand was there. In order to accuse Jesus, they asked Him, “Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath?”
ekegusii: Na rora, narengeo omonto, okoboko kwaye kwagataete. Bakaboria Yeso, “Inee! Mboronge kogwenia ase rituko ri’Esabato?” Nigo bamoboretie igo erio banyare komosoera.
swahili: na huko alikuwepo mtu aliyepooza mkono. Wakitafuta sababu ya kumshtaki Yesu, wakamuuliza, “Je, ni halali kuponya siku ya Sabato?”

english: He replied, “If one of you has a sheep and it falls into a pit on the Sabbath, will he not take hold of it and lift it out?
ekegusii: Nere akababoria, “Ning’o ase more ore neng’ondi eyemo, na eng’ondi eyio onye yagure ime ase engoro rituko ri’Esabato, takoyebwata ayerusieo?
swahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Ni nani miongoni mwenu, mwenye kondoo wake ambaye huyo kondoo akitumbukia shimoni siku ya Sabato hatamtoa?

english: How much more valuable is a man than a sheep! Therefore it is lawful to do good on the Sabbath.”
ekegusii: Inee! Omonto tabueti rigori ri’eng’ondi? Ase igo mboronge gokora amaya ase rituko ri’Esabato.”
swahili: Mtu ana thamani kubwa kuliko kondoo. Kwa hiyo ni halali kutenda mema siku ya Sabato.”

english: Then Jesus said to the man, “Stretch out your hand.” So he stretched it out, and it was restored to full use, just like the other.
ekegusii: Erio agateebia omonto oria, “Rambora okoboko kwao.” Agakorambora; gokagwena, gokaba okogima buna okonde.
swahili: Ndipo akamwambia yule mtu, “Nyoosha mkono wako.” Akaunyoosha, nao ukaponywa ukawa mzima kama ule mwingine.

english: But the Pharisees went out and plotted how they might kill Jesus. God’s Chosen Servant (Isaiah 42:1–9)
ekegusii: Korende Abafarisai bagasoka isiko, bakagaamba igoro ya Yeso buna barakore bamoite. Omosomba omochore
swahili: Lakini Mafarisayo wakatoka nje, wakafanya shauri baya juu ya Yesu jinsi watakavyoweza kumuua. Mtumishi Aliyechaguliwa Na Mungu

english: Aware of this, Jesus withdrew from that place. Large crowds followed Him, and He healed them all,
ekegusii: Ekero Yeso achia komanya aya, akarua aroro. Abanto abange bakamotunyana, akabagwenia bonsi.
swahili: Lakini Yesu alipoyatambua mawazo yao, akaondoka mahali hapo. Watu wengi wakamfuata, naye akawaponya wagonjwa wao wote,

english: warning them not to make Him known.
ekegusii: Akabachika tibatebia abande igoro yaye.
swahili: akiwakataza wasiseme yeye ni nani.

english: This was to fulfill what was spoken through the prophet Isaiah:
ekegusii: Eri nigo riabeete, erinde rinyare goikerana eriatebetwe nomobani Isaya,
swahili: Hii ilikuwa ili litimie lile neno lililonenwa kwa kinywa cha nabii Isaya kusema:

english: “Here is My Servant, whom I have chosen, My beloved, in whom My soul delights. I will put My Spirit on Him, and He will proclaim justice to the nations.
ekegusii: “Rora, omosomba one oyo nachoorire, omwanchwa one, omoyo one ogokirie nere. Nimobekere Omoika one, nere naraarerie abanto b’Ebisaku ekiina.
swahili: “Tazama mtumishi wangu niliyemchagua, mpendwa wangu, ninayependezwa naye. Nitaweka Roho wangu juu yake, naye atatangaza haki kwa mataifa.

english: He will not quarrel or cry out; no one will hear His voice in the streets.
ekegusii: Takwomana, gose tagoaka eriogi; nonya nomonto takoigwa eriogi riaye ase chinchera chinene.
swahili: Hatagombana wala hatapiga kelele, wala hakuna atakayesikia sauti yake njiani.

english: When the Pharisees saw this, they said to Him, “Look, Your disciples are doing what is unlawful on the Sabbath.”
ekegusii: Korende ekero Abafarisai bachia korora aya, bakamoteebia, “Rigereria, aborokigwa bao buna bagokora eritari boronge gokorwa ase rituko ri’Esabato.”
swahili: Lakini Mafarisayo walipoona jambo hili, wakamwambia, “Tazama! Wanafunzi wako wanafanya jambo lisilo halali kufanywa siku ya Sabato.”

english: A bruised reed He will not break, and a smoldering wick He will not extinguish, till He leads justice to victory.
ekegusii: Egetonto giatachetwe tagokebuna, gose orotambe rw’etaya rokoimoka erioki, takororimia, goika arete oboronge ase okobua;
swahili: Mwanzi uliopondeka hatauvunja, na utambi unaofuka moshi hatauzima, mpaka atakapoifanya haki ishinde.

english: In His name the nations will put their hope.” A House Divided (Mark 3:20–27; Luke 11:14–23)
ekegusii: na ase erieta riaye abanto b’Ebisaku mbasemerie.” Yeso na Beelizebuli (Mar 3:20-30; Luk 11:14-23; 12:10)
swahili: Katika Jina lake mataifa wataweka tumaini lao.” Yesu Na Beelzebuli (Marko 3:20-30; Luka 11:14-23)

english: Then a demon-possessed man who was blind and mute was brought to Jesus, and He healed the man so that he could speak and see.
ekegusii: Ekero ekio akarenterwa omonto obwatire nekerecha; ere nomouko orenge, naende nigo arenge rimama. Akamogwenia, goika oria orenge omouko ne rimama agakwana na korora.
swahili: Kisha wakamletea mtu aliyekuwa amepagawa na pepo mchafu, na alikuwa kipofu na bubu. Yesu akamponya, hata akaweza kusema na kuona.

english: The crowds were astounded and asked, “Could this be the Son of David?”
ekegusii: Abanto bonsi bagakumia, bakaboorania, “Inee! Oyo nanyare koba omwana o Daudi?”
swahili: Watu wote wakashangaa na kusema, “Je, yawezekana huyu ndiye Mwana wa Daudi?”

english: But when the Pharisees heard this, they said, “Only by Beelzebul, the prince of demons, does this man drive out demons.”
ekegusii: Korende Abafarisai bagachia koyaigwa, bagateeba, “Oyo tari korusia ebirecha otatiga ase chinguru chia Beelizebuli omonene bw’ebirecha.”
swahili: Lakini Mafarisayo waliposikia jambo hili wakasema, “Mtu huyu anatoa pepo wachafu kwa uwezo wa Beelzebuli, mkuu wa pepo wachafu.”

english: Knowing their thoughts, Jesus said to them, “Every kingdom divided against itself will be laid waste, and every city or household divided against itself will not stand.
ekegusii: Yeso Konya omanyire ebirengererio biabo, akabateebia, “Kera oborwoti kobwatananekire borobwo obonyene tibogotenena; na kera omochie na enyomba kobiatananekanire, birobio ebinyene tibigotenena;
swahili: Yesu alijua walichokuwa wakiwaza, hivyo akawaambia, “Kila ufalme ukigawanyika dhidi yake wenyewe huangamia. Hali kadhalika kila mji au watu wa nyumba moja waliogawanyika dhidi yao wenyewe hawawezi kusimama.

english: If Satan drives out Satan, he is divided against himself. How then can his kingdom stand?
ekegusii: na Saitani karaserie Saitani, igo bweatananire ere omonyene, Inee, oborwoti bwaye, naki boratenene?
swahili: Kama Shetani akimtoa Shetani, atakuwa amegawanyika yeye mwenyewe. Basi ufalme wake utawezaje kusimama?

english: And if I drive out demons by Beelzebul, by whom do your sons drive them out? So then, they will be your judges.
ekegusii: Na inche, onye ngoseeria ebirecha ase Beelizebuli, Inee, abana baino nase ng’o bakobiseeria? Ase engencho eyio, barabwo inababe abagaambi baino.
swahili: Nami kama natoa pepo wachafu kwa nguvu za Beelzebuli, watu wenu je, wao hutoa pepo wachafu kwa uwezo wa nani? Hivyo basi, wao ndio watakaowahukumu.

english: But if I drive out demons by the Spirit of God, then the kingdom of God has come upon you.
ekegusii: Korende onye ngoseeria ebirecha ase Omoika o Nyasae, igo oborwoti bwa Nyasae bwabacheire.
swahili: Lakini kama mimi ninatoa pepo wachafu kwa Roho wa Mungu, basi Ufalme wa Mungu umekuja juu yenu.

english: Or again, how can anyone enter a strong man’s house and steal his possessions, unless he first ties up the strong man? Then he can plunder his house.
ekegusii: Gose inaki omonto aranyare gosoa ase enyomba y’omonto omonyene chinguru na gosakora ebinto biaye, atamosibeti ritang’ani omonto oria omonyene chinguru? Erio magega anyare gosakora enyomba yaye.
swahili: “Au tena, mtu awezaje kuingia katika nyumba ya mtu mwenye nguvu na kuteka nyara mali zake asipomfunga kwanza yule mwenye nguvu? Akishamfunga, ndipo hakika anaweza kuteka nyara mali zake.

english: Jesus replied, “Have you not read what David did when he and his companions were hungry?
ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Timwana gosoma aya Daudi akorete, ekero arenge nenchara, ere na abarenge amo nere,
swahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Je, hamjasoma alichofanya Daudi na wenzake walipokuwa na njaa?

english: He who is not with Me is against Me, and he who does not gather with Me scatters. The Unpardonable Sin (Mark 3:28–30)
ekegusii: Omonto otari amo nainche nigo are mamincha ase ’nde. Nere oyotari gosangereria amo nainche nigo agoserebania.
swahili: “Mtu asiyekuwa pamoja nami yu kinyume nami, na mtu ambaye hakusanyi pamoja nami, hutawanya.

english: Therefore I tell you, every sin and blasphemy will be forgiven men, but the blasphemy against the Spirit will not be forgiven.
ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio nabateebirie, kera ebibe na okorama Mwanyabaanto nabaaberwe, korende onye bagochecheria Omoika tibakwaberwa.
swahili: Kwa hiyo nawaambia, kila dhambi na kufuru watu watasamehewa, lakini mtu atakayemkufuru Roho Mtakatifu hatasamehewa.

english: Whoever speaks a word against the Son of Man will be forgiven, but whoever speaks against the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven, either in this age or in the one to come. Good and Bad Fruit (Luke 6:43–45)
ekegusii: Na omonto onde bwensi orakwane ring’ana riibe ase Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto, naaberwe; korende onde bwensi orakwane ring’ana riibe igoro ase Omoika Omochenu takwaberwa ase ense eye, nonya nase eria egochi‐gocha. Omote na amatunda aye
swahili: Mtu yeyote atakayesema neno dhidi ya Mwana wa Adamu atasamehewa, lakini yeyote anenaye neno dhidi ya Roho Mtakatifu hatasamehewa, iwe katika ulimwengu huu au katika ulimwengu ujao. Mti Na Matunda Yake (Luka 6:43-45)

english: Make a tree good and its fruit will be good, or make a tree bad and its fruit will be bad; for a tree is known by its fruit.
ekegusii: “Kora omote obe omuya, na amatunda aye abe amaya; gose kora omote obe omobe, na amatunda aye abe amabe; naki omote nigo okomanyekana ase okwama kwaye.
swahili: “Ufanye mti kuwa mzuri, nayo matunda yake yatakuwa mazuri. Au ufanye mti kuwa mbaya, na matunda yake yatakuwa mabaya. Kwa maana mti hutambulika kwa matunda yake.

english: You brood of vipers, how can you who are evil say anything good? For out of the overflow of the heart, the mouth speaks.
ekegusii: Inwe oroiboro rwe ching’iti! Naki moranyare gokwana amaya ekero more ababe? Ekiagera ebiichire ase enkoro, nabio omonwa ogokwana.
swahili: Enyi uzao wa nyoka! Mnawezaje kunena mambo mema, wakati ninyi ni waovu? Kwa maana kinywa cha mtu huyanena yale yaliyoujaza moyo wake.

english: The good man brings good things out of his good store of treasure, and the evil man brings evil things out of his evil store of treasure.
ekegusii: Omonto omuya, ase emonga yaye engiya nigo akorua amaya, na omonto omobe, ase emonga yaye embe nigo akorua amabe.
swahili: Mtu mwema hutoa yaliyo mema kutoka hazina ya mambo mema yaliyohifadhiwa ndani yake, naye mtu mwovu hutoa yaliyo maovu kutoka hazina ya mambo maovu yaliyohifadhiwa ndani yake.

english: But I tell you that men will give an account on the day of judgment for every careless word they have spoken.
ekegusii: Korende nabateebirie, ng’a ase kera ring’ana ritari nengencho Mwanyabaanto barakwane, ase rituko ri’ekiina ’nabache korua omobaro.
swahili: Lakini nawaambia, katika siku ya hukumu watu watatoa hesabu kuhusu kila neno lisilo maana walilonena.

english: For by your words you will be acquitted, and by your words you will be condemned.” The Sign of Jonah (Jonah 3:1–10; Luke 11:29–32)
ekegusii: Inaki ase amang’ana ao noegwe oboronge, na ase amang’ana ao nogaambigwe.” Yeso okwanga koorokia egekone (Mar 8:11-12; Luk 11:29-32)
swahili: Kwa maana kwa maneno yako utahesabiwa haki, na kwa maneno yako utahukumiwa.” Ishara Ya Yona (Marko 8:11-12; Luka 11:29-32)

english: Then some of the scribes and Pharisees said to Him, “Teacher, we want to see a sign from You.”
ekegusii: Erio abande ase aborokia b’amariiko na Abafarisai bakamoteebia, “Omwarimu, ntorigetie torore egekone buna ekemanyererio korwa ase ore.”
swahili: Kisha baadhi ya Mafarisayo na walimu wa sheria wakamwambia, “Mwalimu, tunataka kuona ishara kutoka kwako.”

english: Jesus replied, “A wicked and adulterous generation demands a sign, but none will be given it except the sign of the prophet Jonah.
ekegusii: Korende akabairaneria, “Ekegori ekebe ki’obotomani kerigetie egekone, korende tigekoegwa egekone otatiga eki’omobani Yona.
swahili: Lakini yeye akawajibu, “Kizazi kiovu na cha uzinzi kinaomba ishara! Lakini hakitapewa ishara yoyote isipokuwa ile ishara ya nabii Yona.

english: He entered the house of God, and he and his companions ate the consecrated bread, which was not lawful for them to eat, but only for the priests.
ekegusii: buna asoete ase enyomba ya Nyasae, akaria emegati yarenge korugwa ase Nyasae, nero tiyarenge boronge asare ayerie, gose ase abwo barenge amo nere, otatiga ase abakuani boka?
swahili: Aliingia katika nyumba ya Mungu, akala mikate iliyowekwa wakfu, yeye na wenzake, jambo ambalo halikuwa halali kwao kufanya, isipokuwa makuhani peke yao.

english: For as Jonah was three days and three nights in the belly of the great fish, so the Son of Man will be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.
ekegusii: Inaki buna Yona abeete ime ase enda y’enswe enene ase engaki y’emebaso etato na amatuko atato, nabo na Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto nere arabe ime ase enkoro y’ense emebaso etato na amatuko atato.
swahili: Kwa maana kama vile Yona alivyokuwa ndani ya tumbo la nyangumi kwa siku tatu, usiku na mchana, vivyo hivyo Mwana wa Adamu atakuwa katika moyo wa nchi siku tatu, usiku na mchana.

english: The men of Nineveh will stand at the judgment with this generation and condemn it; for they repented at the preaching of Jonah, and now One greater than Jonah is here.
ekegusii: Abanto ba Ninawi nabatenene ase rituko ri’ekiina amo n’abanto b’ekegori eke, na barabwo nabakenachere ekiina, ekiagera barabwo nigo baonchogete ase okorandia kwa Yona, na rora, oyobuete Yona naiga are.
swahili: Siku ya hukumu watu wa Ninawi watasimama pamoja na kizazi hiki na kukihukumu; kwa maana wao walitubu waliposikia mahubiri ya Yona. Na tazama, hapa yupo yeye aliye mkuu kuliko Yona.

english: The Queen of the South will rise at the judgment with this generation and condemn it; for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon, and now One greater than Solomon is here. An Unclean Spirit Returns (Luke 11:24–26)
ekegusii: Enting’ana ya Irianyi netenene ase ekiina amo n’abanto b’ekegori eke; ere nabanachere ekiina, ekiagera arwete ase chinsinyo chi’ense anyare koigwa obong’aini bwa Sulemani, na rora, oyobuete Sulemani naiga are. Okoirana kw’ebirecha (Luk 11:24-26)
swahili: Malkia wa Kusini atasimama wakati wa hukumu na kukihukumu kizazi hiki. Kwa kuwa yeye alikuja kutoka miisho ya dunia ili kuisikiliza hekima ya Solomoni. Na hapa yupo aliye mkuu kuliko Solomoni.” Mafundisho Kuhusu Pepo Mchafu (Luka 11:24-26)

english: When an unclean spirit comes out of a man, it passes through arid places seeking rest and does not find it.
ekegusii: “Ekero ekerecha ki’eubi kiarure ase omonto, nigo kegoeta gati aase atari namaache, kiarigia aase kegotimokera, korende tigekonyora.
swahili: “Pepo mchafu amtokapo mtu, hutangatanga katika sehemu zisizo na maji akitafuta mahali pa kupumzika, lakini hapati.

english: Then it says, ‘I will return to the house I left.’ On its return, it finds the house vacant, swept clean, and put in order.
ekegusii: Erio kiabora: ‘Ning’irane ase enyomba y’ane aase narwete.’ Gakegocha kiayenyora nenchwa, yaabusirwe, yaroisigwe.
swahili: Ndipo husema, ‘Nitarudi kwenye nyumba yangu nilikotoka.’ Naye arudipo huikuta ile nyumba ikiwa tupu, imefagiliwa na kupangwa vizuri.

english: Then it goes and brings with it seven other spirits more wicked than itself, and they go in and dwell there; and the final plight of that man is worse than the first. So will it be with this wicked generation.” Jesus’ Mother and Brothers (Mark 3:31–35; Luke 8:19–21)
ekegusii: Erio kiagenda, kiarentana ebirecha binde bitano na bibere (7), ebire ebibe kobua kerokio ekenyene. Nabirobio biasoa na komenya aroro; okoba kw’omoerio kw’omonto oyio kwaba okobe kobua okwe ritang’ani. Naboigo erache koba ase ekegori eke ekebe.” Abamwabo Yeso b’ekeene (Mar 3:31-35; Luk 8:19-21)
swahili: Kisha huenda na kuwaleta pepo wachafu wengine saba wabaya kuliko yeye mwenyewe, nao huingia na kukaa humo. Nayo hali ya mwisho ya yule mtu huwa ni mbaya kuliko ile ya kwanza. Ndivyo itakavyokuwa kwa kizazi hiki kiovu.” Mama Na Ndugu Zake Yesu (Marko 3:31-35; Luka 8:19-21)

english: While Jesus was still speaking to the crowds, His mother and brothers stood outside, wanting to speak to Him.
ekegusii: Ekero arenge gokwana n’abanto, rora, ng’ina na bamura bamwabo nigo bateneine isiko, barigetie gokwana nere.
swahili: Wakati alikuwa angali anazungumza na makutano, mama yake na ndugu zake wakasimama nje wakitaka kuongea naye.

english: Someone told Him, “Look, Your mother and brothers are standing outside, wanting to speak to You.”
ekegusii: Omonto oyomo akamoteebia, “Rora, nyoko na bamura bamino mbateneine isiko, barigetie gokwana naye.”
swahili: Ndipo mtu mmoja akamwambia, “Tazama, mama yako na ndugu zako wamesimama nje, wanataka kuongea na wewe.”

english: But Jesus replied, “Who is My mother, and who are My brothers?”
ekegusii: Korende akairaneria oria omotebetie, akabora, “Baba nere ng’o? Na bamura baminto mbarabi?”
swahili: Lakini yeye akamjibu na kumwambia yule mtu, “Mama yangu ni nani, nao ndugu zangu ni nani?”

english: Pointing to His disciples, He said, “Here are My mother and My brothers.
ekegusii: Akarambora okoboko kwaye ase aborokigwa baye, akabora, “Rora baba na bamura baminto!
swahili: Akawanyooshea mkono wanafunzi wake, akasema, “Hawa hapa ndio mama yangu na ndugu zangu!

english: Or haven’t you read in the Law that on the Sabbath the priests in the temple break the Sabbath and yet are innocent?
ekegusii: Gose timwana gosoma ase amachiiko buna ase rituko ri’ Esabato abakuani be Hekalu nigo bagosaria Esabato, na barabwo tibakoba nokomocha?
swahili: Au hamjasoma katika Sheria kwamba siku ya Sabato makuhani huvunja sheria ya Sabato Hekaluni lakini hawahesabiwi kuwa na hatia?

english: For whoever does the will of My Father in heaven is My brother and sister and mother.”
ekegusii: Ekiagera oyorakore ogwancha gwa Tata one ore igoro, oyio nere momura ominto, na mosubati ominto, na baba.”
swahili: Kwa maana yeyote afanyaye mapenzi ya Baba yangu wa mbinguni, huyo ndiye ndugu yangu, na dada yangu na mama yangu.”

english: But I tell you that something greater than the temple is here.
ekegusii: Inche nabateebirie, nkere aiga egento ekenene kobua Hekalu.
swahili: Nawaambia wazi kwamba, yeye aliye mkuu kuliko Hekalu yupo hapa.

english: If only you had known the meaning of ‘I desire mercy, not sacrifice,’ you would not have condemned the innocent.
ekegusii: Korende onye mwamanyete engencho y’amang’ana aya: Inche nigo ndigetie amaabera, gose tari ekeng’wanso, anga timwagambia abatari nokomocha,
swahili: Kama mngekuwa mmejua maana ya maneno haya, ‘Nataka rehema, wala si dhabihu,’ msingewalaumu watu wasio na hatia,

english: For the Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath.” Jesus Heals on the Sabbath (Mark 3:1–6; Luke 6:6–11)
ekegusii: ekiagera Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto nere omonene bw’Esabato.” Okogwenigwa kw’omonto ogataete okoboko (Mar 3:1-6; Luk 6:6-11)
swahili: kwa maana Mwana wa Adamu ndiye Bwana wa Sabato.” Yesu Anamponya Mtu Aliyepooza Mkono (Marko 3:1-6; Luka 6:6-11)

english: Moving on from there, Jesus entered their synagogue,
ekegusii: Akarua aroro, agasoa ase esinagogi yabo.
swahili: Yesu akaondoka mahali hapo, akaingia ndani ya sinagogi lao,

english: That same day Jesus went out of the house and sat by the sea.
ekegusii: Ase rituko riria riria Yeso akarua nyomba agaikaransa ase enyancha mbarabare.
swahili: Siku iyo hiyo Yesu akatoka nje ya nyumba, akaketi kando ya bahari.

english: Then the disciples came to Jesus and asked, “Why do You speak to the people in parables?”
ekegusii: Aborokigwa baye bagaacha, bakamoboria, “Nase ki kware gokwana nabarabwo ase emebayeeno?”
swahili: Wanafunzi wake wakamwendea, wakamuuliza, “Kwa nini unasema na watu kwa mifano?”

english: He replied, “The knowledge of the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven has been given to you, but not to them.
ekegusii: Akabairaneria, Inwe mwaeirwe komanya obobisi bw’oborwoti bwa igoro, korende barabwo tibaeiri.
swahili: Akawajibu, “Ninyi mmepewa kuzifahamu siri za Ufalme wa Mbinguni, lakini wao hawajapewa.

english: Whoever has will be given more, and he will have an abundance. Whoever does not have, even what he has will be taken away from him.
ekegusii: Inaki oyore na gento naegwe, nere namenteranigwe; korende oyotabwati gento naurwe nonya nkeria abwate.
swahili: Kwa maana yule aliye na kitu atapewa zaidi, naye atakuwa navyo tele. Lakini yule asiye na kitu, hata kile alicho nacho atanyangʼanywa.

english: This is why I speak to them in parables: ‘Though seeing, they do not see; though hearing, they do not hear or understand.’
ekegusii: Eke nakio gekogera ngokwana nabarabwo ase emebayeeno, ekiagera okorigereria ’nabarigererie, korende tibakorora, na ogotegerera nabategerere, korende tibakoigwa, nonya nokomanya, tibakomanya.
swahili: Hii ndiyo sababu nasema nao kwa mifano: “Ingawa wanatazama, hawaoni; wanasikiliza, lakini hawasikii, wala hawaelewi.

english: In them the prophecy of Isaiah is fulfilled: ‘You will be ever hearing but never understanding; you will be ever seeing but never perceiving.
ekegusii: Ase barabwo obobani bwa Isaya bwaikeranire, obogoteeba: Okoigwa namoigwe, korende timokomanya nonya ng’ake, na okorigereria namorigererie, korende timokorora nonya ng’ake.
swahili: Kwao unatimia ule unabii wa Isaya aliposema: “ ‘Hakika mtasikiliza lakini hamtaelewa; na pia mtatazama lakini hamtaona.

english: For this people’s heart has grown callous; they hardly hear with their ears, and they have closed their eyes. Otherwise they might see with their eyes, hear with their ears, understand with their hearts, and turn, and I would heal them.’
ekegusii: Inaki chinkoro chi’ abanto aba chiabeire chinyoro, na amato abo nigo are amarito ase okoigwa, na amaiso abo bayamiamirie, tibacha korora namaiso abo gose koigwa namato abo, gose bamanye ne chinkoro chiabo, baonchoke, na inche mbagwenie.
swahili: Kwa kuwa mioyo ya watu hawa imekuwa migumu; hawasikii kwa masikio yao, na wamefumba macho yao. Wasije wakaona kwa macho yao, na wakasikiliza kwa masikio yao, wakaelewa kwa mioyo yao, na kugeuka nami nikawaponya.’

english: But blessed are your eyes because they see, and your ears because they hear.
ekegusii: Korende amaiso aino nasesenirie, ekiagera nkorora are, na amato aino, ekiagera nkoigwa are.
swahili: Lakini heri macho yenu kwa sababu yanaona, na heri masikio yenu kwa sababu yanasikia.

english: For truly I tell you, many prophets and righteous men longed to see what you see but did not see it, and to hear what you hear but did not hear it. The Parable of the Sower Explained (Mark 4:13–20; Luke 8:11–15)
ekegusii: Nekeene nabateebirie: Abaabani abange na abanyene oboronge mbaganetie korora aya morooche inwe, tibayarora, na koigwa aya mokoigwa inwe, tibayaigwa. Ogotebereria kw’omobayeeno bw’omobusuri (Mar 4:13-20; Luk 8:11-15)
swahili: Amin, nawaambia, manabii wengi na wenye haki walitamani kuona yale mnayoyaona lakini hawakuyaona, na walitamani kusikia yale mnayoyasikia lakini hawakuyasikia. Maelezo Ya Mfano Wa Mbegu (Marko 4:13-20; Luka 8:11-15)

english: Consider, then, the parable of the sower:
ekegusii: “Gaki, igwa omobayeeno bw’omobusuri.
swahili: “Sikilizeni basi maana ya ule mfano wa mpanzi:

english: When anyone hears the message of the kingdom but does not understand it, the evil one comes and snatches away what was sown in his heart. This is the seed sown along the path.
ekegusii: Ekero omonto akoigwa ring’ana ri’oborwoti, na ere takorimanya, nigo agocha oria omobe, otaboria riria riasimekirwe ase enkoro yaye, oyo nere obusuirwe ase enchera ensemo.
swahili: Mtu yeyote anaposikia neno la Ufalme naye asilielewe, yule mwovu huja na kunyakua kile kilichopandwa moyoni mwake. Hii ndiyo ile mbegu iliyopandwa kando ya njia.

english: Such large crowds gathered around Him that He got into a boat and sat down, while all the people stood on the shore.
ekegusii: Emeganda emenene ekamosangererekanera, goika ere akariina obwato ime, agaikaransa aroro, na omoganda bwonsi ogatenena ase engegu.
swahili: Umati mkubwa mno wa watu ukakusanyika kumzunguka, hata ikabidi aingie katika chombo na kuketi humo, nao watu wote wakawa wamesimama ukingoni mwa bahari.

english: The seed sown on rocky ground is the one who hears the word and at once receives it with joy.
ekegusii: Na oyo obusuirwe ase egetare nere oria okoigwa ring’ana, erio kegima oribwata nomogooko,
swahili: Ile mbegu iliyopandwa kwenye sehemu yenye mawe ni mtu yule ambaye hulisikia neno na mara hulipokea kwa furaha.

english: But since he has no root, he remains for only a season. When trouble or persecution comes because of the word, he quickly falls away.
ekegusii: korende tari nemeri ime yaye, ogenderera ekero egeke; na ekero emechando egochi‐gocha, gose okorosigwa ase engencho ye ring’ana, erio bwango ogwa korwa ase okwegena kwaye.
swahili: Lakini kwa kuwa hana mizizi yenye kina ndani yake, lile neno hudumu kwa muda mfupi tu. Kisha dhiki au mateso yanapoinuka kwa ajili ya lile neno, yeye mara huchukizwa.

english: The seed sown among the thorns is the one who hears the word, but the worries of this life and the deceitfulness of wealth choke the word, and it becomes unfruitful.
ekegusii: Na oyo obusuirwe ase amagwa, oyo nere okoigwa ring’ana; okorengereria gw’ense na obong’ainereria bw’eniibo biaba nkomiga bire ring’ana, riaba tirikwama.
swahili: Ile mbegu iliyopandwa katika miiba ni yule mtu alisikiaye neno, lakini masumbufu ya maisha haya na udanganyifu wa mali hulisonga lile neno na kulifanya lisizae matunda.

english: But the seed sown on good soil is the one who hears the word and understands it. He indeed bears fruit and produces a crop—a hundredfold, sixtyfold, or thirtyfold.” The Parable of the Weeds (Ezekiel 17:1–10)
ekegusii: Na oyo obusuirwe ase amaroba amaya, nere oria okoigwa ring’ana, orimanya; nere ekeene bwama okwama. Oyomo bwama rigana, na oyonde emerongo etano nomo, na oyonde emerongo etato.” Omobayeeno bw’amabanchore
swahili: Lakini ile mbegu iliyopandwa kwenye udongo mzuri ni yule mtu ambaye hulisikia neno na kulielewa. Naye hakika huzaa matunda, akizaa mara mia, au mara sitini, au mara thelathini ya mbegu iliyopandwa.” Mfano Wa Magugu

english: Jesus put before them another parable: “The kingdom of heaven is like a man who sowed good seed in his field.
ekegusii: Akabateebia omobayeeno onde, agateeba, “Oborwoti bwa igoro nigo bogwekaine nomonto obusurete embusuro engiya ase omogondo oye;
swahili: Yesu akawaambia mfano mwingine, akasema: “Ufalme wa Mbinguni unaweza kufananishwa na mtu aliyepanda mbegu nzuri katika shamba lake.

english: But while everyone was asleep, his enemy came and sowed weeds among the wheat, and slipped away.
ekegusii: korende ekero abanto bararire, omobisa oye agacha akabusura amabanchore ime ase engano, akagenda.
swahili: Lakini wakati kila mtu alipokuwa amelala, adui yake akaja na kupanda magugu katikati ya ngano, akaenda zake.

english: When the wheat sprouted and bore grain, then the weeds also appeared.
ekegusii: Egachia komera ekama chinyeke, erio amabanchore naro akarorekana.
swahili: Ngano ilipoota na kutoa masuke, magugu nayo yakatokea.

english: The owner’s servants came to him and said, ‘Sir, didn’t you sow good seed in your field? Where then did the weeds come from?’
ekegusii: Erio abasomba b’omonyene enyomba bagaacha, bakamobooria: Omonene, tikwabusurete embusuro engiya ase omogondo oo? Inaki rende ororekanire namabanchore?
swahili: “Watumishi wa yule mwenye shamba wakamjia na kumwambia, ‘Bwana, si tulipanda mbegu nzuri shambani mwako? Basi, magugu yametoka wapi?’

english: ‘An enemy did this,’ he replied. So the servants asked him, ‘Do you want us to go and pull them up?’
ekegusii: Akabateebia: Nomobisa okorete ayio. Abasomba bakamobooria: Inee! Norigetie tochie toyasimore?
swahili: “Akawajibu, ‘Adui ndiye alifanya jambo hili.’ “Wale watumishi wakamuuliza, ‘Je, unataka twende tukayangʼoe?’

english: ‘No,’ he said, ‘if you pull the weeds now, you might uproot the wheat with them.
ekegusii: Akabakania: Yaya; moise koyasimora amabanchore namoiye engano amo naro.
swahili: “Lakini akasema, ‘Hapana, msiyangʼoe, kwa maana wakati mkingʼoa magugu mnaweza mkangʼoa na ngano pamoja nayo.

english: And He told them many things in parables, saying, “A farmer went out to sow his seed.
ekegusii: Akabateebia amang’ana amange ase emebayeeno, okobora, “Omobusuri akamanora kogenda kobusura.
swahili: Ndipo akawaambia mambo mengi kwa mifano, akisema: “Mpanzi alitoka kwenda kupanda mbegu zake.

english: Let both grow together until the harvest. At that time I will tell the harvesters: First collect the weeds and tie them in bundles to be burned; then gather the wheat into my barn.’” The Parable of the Mustard Seed (Mark 4:30–34; Luke 13:18–19)
ekegusii: Bitige bikiine bionsi bibere goika rigesa, na ekero kie rigesa ninteebie abakogesa: Ritang’ani sangereria amabanchore, moyaboe emesaima monyare koyasamba; korende engano moyesangererie gochia kiage kiane.” Omobayeeno bw’entetere y’Omosirapi na oyo bw’ememera (Mar 4:30-34; Luk 13:18-21)
swahili: Acheni ngano na magugu vikue vyote pamoja mpaka wakati wa mavuno. Wakati huo nitawaambia wavunaji wayakusanye magugu kwanza, wayafunge matita matita ili yachomwe moto; kisha wakusanye ngano na kuileta ghalani mwangu.’ ” Mfano Wa Mbegu Ya Haradali (Marko 4:30-32; Luka 13:18-19)

english: He put before them another parable: “The kingdom of heaven is like a mustard seed that a man planted in his field.
ekegusii: Akabateebia omobayeeno onde, agateeba, “Oborwoti bwa igoro nigo bogwekaine nentetere y’omosirapi omonto abogoretie, akayesimeka ase omogondo oye;
swahili: Akawaambia mfano mwingine, akasema, “Ufalme wa Mbinguni ni kama punje ya haradali, ambayo mtu aliichukua, akaipanda shambani mwake.

english: Although it is the smallest of all seeds, yet it grows into the largest of garden plants and becomes a tree, so that the birds of the air come and nest in its branches.” The Parable of the Leaven (Luke 13:20–21)
ekegusii: ero nenke mono kobua chimbusuro chionsi, korende koyakiinire yaba enene kobua ebimeri bionsi, eba omote, goika chinyoni chia igoro chichia koroisia ebiswa ase chinsagia chiaye.”
swahili: Ingawa mbegu hiyo ni ndogo kuliko mbegu zote, lakini inapokua ni mmea mkubwa kuliko yote ya bustanini, nao huwa mti mkubwa, hadi ndege wa angani wanakuja na kutengeneza viota katika matawi yake.” Mfano Wa Chachu (Luka 13:20-21)

english: He told them still another parable: “The kingdom of heaven is like leaven that a woman took and mixed into three measures of flour, until all of it was leavened.” I Will Open My Mouth in Parables (Psalms 78:1–72)
ekegusii: Akabateebia omobayeeno onde, “Oborwoti bwa igoro nigo bogwekaine nememera omokungu abogoretie, akayebeka ase ebirengo bitato bi’obosie, goika bionsi bikabota.”
swahili: Akawaambia mfano mwingine, “Ufalme wa Mbinguni unafanana na chachu ambayo mwanamke aliichukua akaichanganya katika kiasi kikubwa cha unga mpaka wote ukaumuka.” Sababu Ya Yesu Kutumia Mifano (Marko 4:33-34)

english: Jesus spoke all these things to the crowds in parables. He did not tell them anything without using a parable.
ekegusii: Aya onsi Yeso nigo ayakwanete ase emeganda eria ase emereng’anio; na tabateebeetie ring’ana otatiga ase emebayeeno,
swahili: Yesu alinena mambo haya yote kwa makutano kwa mifano. Wala hakuwaambia lolote pasipo mfano.

english: So was fulfilled what was spoken through the prophet: “I will open My mouth in parables; I will utter things hidden since the foundation of the world.” The Parable of the Weeds Explained (Zephaniah 1:1–6)
