ekegusii: erinde rinyare goikeranigwa eriatebetwe nomobani, “Nimaanore omonwa one ase emebayeeno, inyatore ayabisegete korwa ogotongwa gw’ense.” Omobayeeno bw’amabanchore ogotebererigwa
swahili: Hii ilikuwa ili kutimiza lile lililonenwa kwa kinywa cha nabii aliposema: “Nitafungua kinywa changu niseme nao kwa mifano; nitahubiri mambo yaliyofichika tangu kuumbwa kwa misingi ya ulimwengu.” Ufafanuzi Wa Mfano Wa Magugu

english: Then Jesus dismissed the crowds and went into the house. His disciples came to Him and said, “Explain to us the parable of the weeds in the field.”
ekegusii: Erio Yeso agatiga emeganda, akagenda nyomba. Aborokigwa baye bakamochiera, bakobora, “Totebererie omobayeeno bw’amabanchore a mogondo.”
swahili: Kisha Yesu akaagana na makutano, akaingia nyumbani. Wanafunzi wake wakamjia wakamwambia, “Tueleze maana ya ule mfano wa magugu shambani.”

english: He replied, “The One who sows the good seed is the Son of Man.
ekegusii: Akairaneria, “Oyogosimeka embusuro engiya n’Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto;
swahili: Akawaambia, “Aliyepanda mbegu nzuri ni Mwana wa Adamu.

english: The field is the world, and the good seed represents the sons of the kingdom. The weeds are the sons of the evil one,
ekegusii: omogondo nense; embusuro eyio engiya nabana b’oborwoti; na amabanchore nabwo abana boria omobe.
swahili: Shamba ni ulimwengu na mbegu nzuri ni wana wa Ufalme. Magugu ni wana wa yule mwovu.

english: and the enemy who sows them is the devil. The harvest is the end of the age, and the harvesters are angels.
ekegusii: Omobisa oria oyasimegete nere Saitani; rigesa nomoerio bw’ense, na abaraache kogesa nabamalaika.
swahili: Yule adui aliyepanda magugu ni ibilisi. Mavuno ni mwisho wa dunia, nao wavunaji ni malaika.

english: And as he was sowing, some seed fell along the path, and the birds came and devoured it.
ekegusii: Ekero are kobusura, chimbusuro chinde chikagwa ase enchera ensemo, chinyoni chigaacha, chigachiria,
swahili: Alipokuwa akitawanya mbegu, nyingine zilianguka kando ya njia, nao ndege wakaja na kuzila.

english: As the weeds are collected and burned in the fire, so will it be at the end of the age.
ekegusii: Buna amabanchore agosangererigwa asambwa nomorero, naboigo nomoerio bw’ense orache koba.
swahili: “Kama vile magugu yangʼolewavyo na kuchomwa motoni, ndivyo itakavyokuwa wakati wa mwisho wa dunia.

english: The Son of Man will send out His angels, and they will weed out of His kingdom every cause of sin and all who practice lawlessness.
ekegusii: Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto natome abamalaika baye, na barabwo nabasangererie na kobarusia korwa ase oborwoti bwaye abakogera abande bagochwe, na abagokora ebibe bonsi,
swahili: Mwana wa Adamu atawatuma malaika zake, nao watakusanya kutoka Ufalme wake kila kitu kinachosababisha dhambi na watenda maovu wote.

english: And they will throw them into the fiery furnace, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
ekegusii: nababatugute ase eriiko ri’omorero. Aroro agwo abanto inababe nekerero na okoriania amaino.
swahili: Nao watawatupa katika tanuru la moto ambako kutakuwa na kilio na kusaga meno.

english: Then the righteous will shine like the sun in the kingdom of their Father. He who has ears, let him hear. The Parables of the Treasure and the Pearl
ekegusii: Erio abanyene oboronge nabagirigente buna erioba ase oborwoti bwa Ise obo. Oyore namato akoigwera, tiga aigwe. Emereng’anio y’eniibo, eruru, na ekeonga
swahili: Ndipo wenye haki watangʼaa kama jua katika Ufalme wa Baba yao. Yeye aliye na masikio, na asikie. Mfano Wa Hazina Iliyofichwa Na Lulu

english: The kingdom of heaven is like treasure hidden in a field. When a man found it, he hid it again, and in his joy he went and sold all he had and bought that field.
ekegusii: “Oborwoti bwa igoro nigo bogwekaine neniibo yabisire ase omogondo, eye omonto anyorete, akayebisa; erio ase omogooko oye akagenda, akaoonia ebi abwate bionsi, akagora omogondo oria.
swahili: “Ufalme wa Mbinguni unafanana na hazina iliyofichwa shambani, ambayo mtu mmoja alipoiona akaificha tena. Kisha katika furaha yake, akaenda akauza vyote alivyokuwa navyo, akalinunua lile shamba.”

english: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like a merchant in search of fine pearls.
ekegusii: “Naende oborwoti bwa igoro mbogwekanirie nomonto omoonchoreria, okorigia chiruru chingiya.
swahili: “Tena, Ufalme wa Mbinguni unafanana na mfanyabiashara aliyekuwa akitafuta lulu safi.

english: When he found one very precious pearl, he went away and sold all he had and bought it. The Parable of the Net
ekegusii: Ere agachia korora eruru eyemo ye rigori rinene, akaimoka akagenda, akaoonia ebi abwate bionsi, akayegora.
swahili: Alipoipata lulu moja ya thamani kubwa, alikwenda akauza vyote alivyokuwa navyo akainunua.” Mfano Wa Wavu

english: Once again, the kingdom of heaven is like a net that was cast into the sea and caught all kinds of fish.
ekegusii: “Naende oborwoti bwa igoro nigo bonga buna ekeonga ekiarutetwe ase enyancha ime, kegasangereria chinswe chia kera egesaku.
swahili: “Tena, Ufalme wa Mbinguni ni kama wavu wa kuvua samaki uliotupwa baharini ukavua samaki wa kila aina.

english: When it was full, the men pulled it ashore. Then they sat down and sorted the good fish into containers, but threw the bad away.
ekegusii: Ekero giaichoire, abanto bagakeng’usa gocha engegu; bagaikaransa, bagasangereria chiria chingiya ase amakuru, na chiria chimbe bagachituguta.
swahili: Ulipojaa, wavuvi wakavuta pwani, wakaketi na kukusanya samaki wazuri kuwaweka kwenye vyombo safi, lakini wale samaki wabaya wakawatupa.

english: So will it be at the end of the age: The angels will come and separate the wicked from the righteous,
ekegusii: Naboigo eraache koba ase omoerio bw’ense. Abamalaika nabaoroke bache gwatanana baria ababe korwa ase abanyene oboronge,
swahili: Hivi ndivyo itakavyokuwa wakati wa mwisho wa dunia. Malaika watakuja na kuwatenganisha watu waovu na watu wenye haki.

english: Some fell on rocky ground, where it did not have much soil. It sprang up quickly because the soil was shallow.
ekegusii: na echinde chikagwa ase egetare, aase amaroba arenge amake; chikamera bwango, ekiagera amaroba arenge amake.
swahili: Nyingine zilianguka kwenye ardhi yenye mwamba isiyo na udongo wa kutosha. Zikaota haraka, kwa kuwa udongo ulikuwa haba.

english: and throw them into the fiery furnace, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
ekegusii: babatugute ase eriiko ri’omorero. Aroro agwo abanto inababe nekerero na okoriania amaino.”
swahili: Nao watawatupa hao waovu katika tanuru la moto ambako kutakuwa na kilio na kusaga meno.”

english: Have you understood all these things?” “Yes,” they answered.
ekegusii: Yeso akababoria, “Mwamanyire aya onsi?” Bakamoiraneria, “Ee.”
swahili: Yesu akauliza, “Je, mmeyaelewa haya yote?” Wakamjibu, “Ndiyo.”

english: Then He told them, “For this reason, every scribe who has been discipled in the kingdom of heaven is like a homeowner who brings out of his storeroom new treasures as well as old.” The Rejection at Nazareth (Mark 6:1–6; Luke 4:16–30)
ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Ase engencho eyio kera Omwarimu bw’amariiko oyokorirwe koba omworokigwa bw’oborwoti bwa igoro, obeire omogwekano bw’omonyene enyomba, oyokorua ase emonga yaye ebinto ebiyia na ebikoro.” Yeso okwangwa Nazareti (Mar 6:1-6; Luk 4:16-30)
swahili: Akawaambia, “Basi kila mwalimu wa sheria aliyefundishwa elimu ya Ufalme wa Mbinguni ni kama mwenye nyumba anayetoa kutoka ghala yake mali mpya na mali ya zamani.” Yesu Akataliwa Nazareti (Marko 6:1-6; Luka 4:16-30)

english: When Jesus had finished these parables, He withdrew from that place.
ekegusii: Ekero Yeso akoorire emebayeeno eyio, akarua aroro, akagenda aase aande.
swahili: Yesu alipomaliza kutoa mifano hii, akaondoka.

english: Coming to His hometown, He taught the people in their synagogue, and they were astonished. “Where did this man get such wisdom and miraculous powers?” they asked.
ekegusii: Agachia goika ense yaye omonyene, akaborokereria ase esinagogi yabo, goika bagakumia, bagateebania, “Oyo ng’ai anyorire obong’aini obo na ogokora oko gwe chinguru?
swahili: Alipofika mji wa kwao, akawafundisha watu katika sinagogi lao. Nao wakastaajabu, wakauliza, “Mtu huyu amepata wapi hekima hii na uwezo huu wa kufanya miujiza?”

english: “Isn’t this the carpenter’s son? Isn’t His mother’s name Mary, and aren’t His brothers James, Joseph, Simon, and Judas?
ekegusii: Oyo tari omwana bw’omobaachi? Ngi’na tari oria okorokwa Mariamu? Na bamura bamwabo tibari Yakobo, na Yusufu na Simioni, na Yuda?
swahili: “Huyu si yule mwana wa seremala? Mama yake si yeye aitwaye Maria, nao ndugu zake si Yakobo, Yosefu, Simoni na Yuda?

english: Aren’t all His sisters with us as well? Where then did this man get all these things?”
ekegusii: Na basubati bamwabo bonsi tibari aa seito? Gaki oyo ng’ai ayanyorire aya onsi?”
swahili: Nao dada zake wote, hawako hapa pamoja nasi? Mtu huyu amepata wapi basi mambo haya yote?”

english: And they took offense at Him. But Jesus said to them, “Only in his hometown and in his own household is a prophet without honor.”
ekegusii: Bakagechigwa asare. Korende Yeso akabateebia, “Omobani takoborwa ogosikwa otatiga ase abanto baye na ime ase ense yaye.”
swahili: Wakachukizwa naye. Lakini Yesu akawaambia, “Nabii hakosi heshima, isipokuwa katika nchi yake na nyumbani kwake.”

english: And He did not do many miracles there, because of their unbelief.
ekegusii: Ere takorete amakumia amange agwo, ekiagera batarenge nokwegena.
swahili: Naye hakufanya miujiza mingi huko kwa sababu ya kutokuamini kwao.

english: But when the sun rose, the seedlings were scorched, and they withered because they had no root.
ekegusii: Omobaso ogachia kobara, chigasusana, na ekiagera chitarenge nemeri, chikooma.
swahili: Lakini jua lilipozidi, mimea ikanyauka na kukauka kwa kuwa mizizi yake haikuwa na kina.

english: Other seed fell among thorns, which grew up and choked the seedlings.
ekegusii: Na echinde chikagwa ase amagwa ime, na amagwa aria agakiina, agachimiga.
swahili: Mbegu nyingine zilianguka kwenye miiba, nayo miiba hiyo ikakua, ikaisonga hiyo mimea.

english: Still other seed fell on good soil and produced a crop—a hundredfold, sixtyfold, or thirtyfold.
ekegusii: Na echinde chikagwa ase amaroba amaya, chikaama echinde rigana, na echinde emerongo etano nomo, na echinde emerongo etato.
swahili: Mbegu nyingine zilianguka kwenye udongo mzuri ambapo zilitoa mazao, nyingine mara mia moja, nyingine mara sitini, na nyingine mara thelathini.

english: He who has ears, let him hear.” The Purpose of Jesus’ Parables (Isaiah 6:1–13; Mark 4:10–12; Luke 8:9–10)
ekegusii: Oyore namato akoigwera, tiga aigwe!” Ekerenga ki’ogokwana ase emebayeeno (Mar 4:10-12; Luk 8:9-10)
swahili: Mwenye masikio ya kusikia, na asikie.” Sababu Ya Kufundisha Kwa Mifano (Marko 4:10-12; Luka 8:9-10)

english: At that time Herod the tetrarch heard the reports about Jesus
ekegusii: Ekero keria Herode omorwoti o Galili akaigwa chinkuma igoro ya Yeso;
swahili: Wakati huo, Mfalme Herode, mtawala wa Galilaya, alisikia habari za Yesu,

english: and sent to have John beheaded in the prison.
ekegusii: Agatoma omonto ase echela ime anache Yohana omotwe.
swahili: Hivyo akaagiza Yohana Mbatizaji akatwe kichwa mle gerezani.

english: John’s head was brought in on a platter and presented to the girl, who carried it to her mother.
ekegusii: Omotwe oye okarentwa ase esani, okaegwa omoiseke oria, na ere akayoira ase ng’ina.
swahili: Kichwa chake kikaletwa kwenye sinia, akapewa yule binti, naye akampelekea mama yake.

english: Then John’s disciples came and took his body and buried it. And they went and informed Jesus. The Feeding of the Five Thousand (Mark 6:30–44; Luke 9:10–17; John 6:1–15)
ekegusii: Aborokigwa baye bagachia bakabogoria omobere, bakayotindeka, bakagenda, bagateebia Yeso amang’ana ayio. Okoragerigwa kw’ abanto chilifu isano (Mar 6:30-44; Luk 9:10-17; Yoh 6:1-13)
swahili: Wanafunzi wa Yohana wakaja na kuuchukua mwili wake kwenda kuuzika. Kisha wakaenda wakamwambia Yesu. Yesu Alisha Wanaume 5,000 (Marko 6:30-44; Luka 9:10-17; Yohana 6:1-14)

english: When Jesus heard about John, He withdrew by boat privately to a solitary place. But the crowds found out about it and followed Him on foot from the towns.
ekegusii: Bono ekero Yeso achia koigwa aya, akarua agwo nobwato, akagenda ere bweka aase abanto batari. Korende ekero emeganda yachia koigwa aya, bakamotunyana namagoro korwa ase emechie.
swahili: Yesu aliposikia yaliyokuwa yametukia, aliondoka kwa chombo akaenda mahali pasipo na watu ili awe peke yake. Lakini watu walipopata habari, wakamfuata kwa miguu kupitia nchi kavu kutoka miji.

english: When He stepped ashore and saw a large crowd, He had compassion on them and healed their sick.
ekegusii: Ekero Yeso aikire engegu, akarora omoganda omonene, akabarorera amaabera, akagwenia abarwaire babo.
swahili: Yesu alipofika kando ya bahari, aliona makutano makubwa ya watu, akawahurumia na akawaponya wagonjwa wao.

english: When evening came, the disciples came to Him and said, “This is a desolate place, and the hour is already late. Dismiss the crowds so they can go to the villages and buy themselves some food.”
ekegusii: Ekero riachia koba mogoroba, aborokigwa baye bakamochiera, bakaboora, “Aase aa negesomo, ngochia koira bore, batige abanto bagende ebinyoro begorere endagera.”
swahili: Ilipofika jioni, wanafunzi wake walienda kwake, wakamwambia, “Mahali hapa ni nyikani, na muda sasa umekwisha. Waage makutano ili waende zao vijijini wakajinunulie chakula.”

english: “They do not need to go away,” Jesus replied. “You give them something to eat.”
ekegusii: Yeso akabora, “Tibagwenereti kogenda; inwe bae endagera barie.”
swahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Hakuna sababu ya wao kuondoka. Ninyi wapeni chakula.”

english: “We have here only five loaves of bread and two fish,” they answered.
ekegusii: Barabwo bakamoteebia, “Titobwati gento aiga, otatiga emegati etano ne chinswe ibere.”
swahili: Wakamjibu, “Tuna mikate mitano na samaki wawili tu.”

english: “Bring them here to Me,” Jesus said.
ekegusii: Akabora, “Bindetere aiga.”
swahili: Akawaambia, “Nileteeni hivyo vitu hapa.”

english: And He directed the crowds to sit down on the grass. Taking the five loaves and the two fish and looking up to heaven, He spoke a blessing. Then He broke the loaves and gave them to the disciples, and the disciples gave them to the people.
ekegusii: Agachiika emeganda eikaranse inse ase obonyansi; akabogoria emegati eria etano ne chinswe chiria ibere, akarigereria igoro, akabisesenia, agasamunyora emegati, akaa aborokigwa emegati eria, na aborokigwa bakayea emeganda.
swahili: Yesu akaagiza makutano wakae chini kwenye nyasi. Akaichukua ile mikate mitano na wale samaki wawili, akainua macho yake akatazama mbinguni, akavibariki na kuimega ile mikate. Kisha akawapa wanafunzi, nao wanafunzi wakawagawia makutano.

english: and said to his servants, “This is John the Baptist; he has risen from the dead! That is why miraculous powers are at work in him.”
ekegusii: agateebia abasomba baye, “Oyo nere Yohana Omobatisi, obokiigwe korwa ase abakuure, eke nakio gekogera chinguru echio chigokora emeremo asare.”
swahili: akawaambia watumishi wake, “Huyu ni Yohana Mbatizaji; amefufuka kutoka kwa wafu! Hii ndiyo sababu nguvu za kutenda miujiza zinafanya kazi ndani yake.”

english: They all ate and were satisfied, and the disciples picked up twelve basketfuls of broken pieces that were left over.
ekegusii: Bakaria bonsi, bakaigota. Bagasangereria ebisamunye bi’emegati ebiatigarete, ebitonga ikomi na bibere biichire.
swahili: Wote wakala, wakashiba. Nao wanafunzi wakakusanya vipande vilivyosalia, wakajaza vikapu kumi na viwili.

english: About five thousand men were fed, in addition to women and children. Jesus Walks on Water (Mark 6:45–52; John 6:16–21)
ekegusii: Na abwo bariete nigo barenge abasacha ange chilifu isano (5,000), otatiga abakungu na abana. Yeso ogotaara enyancha igoro (Mar 6:45-52; Yoh 6:16-21)
swahili: Idadi ya watu waliokula walikuwa wanaume wapatao 5,000, bila kuhesabu wanawake na watoto. Yesu Atembea Juu Ya Maji (Marko 6:45-52; Yohana 6:15-21)

english: Immediately Jesus made the disciples get into the boat and go on ahead of Him to the other side, while He dismissed the crowds.
ekegusii: Erio agachiika aborokigwa baye bariine obwato, bamotang’anere kogenda ng’umbu ende, goika akaa emeganda ribaga egende.
swahili: Mara Yesu akawaambia wanafunzi wake waingie kwenye mashua watangulie kwenda ngʼambo ya bahari, wakati yeye alikuwa akiwaaga wale makutano.

english: After He had sent them away, He went up on the mountain by Himself to pray. When evening came, He was there alone,
ekegusii: Na nyuma kaeire emeganda ribaga kogenda, akariina ebitunwa igoro ere bweka gochia gosaba. Riachia koba mogoroba akaba agwo bweka.
swahili: Baada ya kuwaaga, akaenda zake mlimani peke yake kuomba. Jioni ilipofika, Yesu alikuwa huko peke yake.

english: but the boat was already far from land, buffeted by the waves because the wind was against it.
ekegusii: Korende obwato konya bwaikire enyancha gati bokorunda‐rundigwa nemerindo, ekiagera omwaga nigo obatangete.
swahili: Wakati huo ile mashua ilikuwa mbali kutoka nchi kavu ikisukwasukwa na mawimbi, kwa sababu upepo ulikuwa wa mbisho.

english: During the fourth watch of the night, Jesus went out to them, walking on the sea.
ekegusii: Na ekero kiabotuko ange gokiamoka, Yeso agacha ase bare, ogotaara ase enyancha igoro.
swahili: Wakati wa zamu ya nne ya usiku, Yesu akawaendea wanafunzi wake akiwa anatembea juu ya maji.

english: When the disciples saw Him walking on the sea, they were terrified. “It’s a ghost!” they said, and cried out in fear.
ekegusii: Korende ekero aborokigwa bachia komorora ogotaara ase enyancha igoro, bakaondoka, bakaboora, “Eri nerirengari!” Bagaaka eriogi ase okoiroka.
swahili: Wanafunzi wake walipomwona akitembea juu ya maji, waliingiwa na hofu kuu, wakasema, “Ni mzimu.” Wakapiga yowe kwa kuogopa.

english: But Jesus spoke up at once: “Take courage! It is I. Do not be afraid.”
ekegusii: Erio kegima Yeso agakwana nabarabwo, akabora, “Remia chinkoro! Ninche. Timoiroka!”
swahili: Lakini mara Yesu akasema nao, akawaambia, “Jipeni moyo! Ni mimi. Msiogope.”

english: “Lord, if it is You,” Peter replied, “command me to come to You on the water.”
ekegusii: Petero akamoiraneria, “Omonene, onye naye, ’nchiike nchiche agwo ase ore igoro ase amaache.”
swahili: Petro akamjibu, “Bwana, ikiwa ni wewe, niambie nije kwako nikitembea juu ya maji.”

english: “Come,” said Jesus. Then Peter got down out of the boat, walked on the water, and came toward Jesus.
ekegusii: Akamoteebia, “Inchuo!” Petero agaika korwa ase obwato, agataara igoro ase amaache, gochia ase Yeso.
swahili: Yesu akamwambia, “Njoo.” Basi Petro akatoka kwenye chombo, akatembea juu ya maji kumwelekea Yesu.

english: Now Herod had arrested John and bound him and put him in prison on account of Herodias, his brother Philip’s wife,
ekegusii: Inaki Herode konya obwatire Yohana, omosibire, omobekire echela ase engencho ya Herodia, moka Filipo, momura omwabo,
swahili: Herode alikuwa amemkamata Yohana, akamfunga na kumweka gerezani kwa sababu ya Herodia, mke wa Filipo, ndugu yake,

english: But when he saw the strength of the wind, he was afraid, and beginning to sink, cried out, “Lord, save me!”
ekegusii: Korende ekero achia korora omwaga bw’echinguru, akairoka, agachaaka korimera amaache ime, agaaka eriogi, agateeba, “Omonene ntooria!”
swahili: Lakini alipoona upepo mkali aliingiwa na hofu, naye akaanza kuzama, huku akipiga kelele, “Bwana, niokoe!”

english: Immediately Jesus reached out His hand and took hold of Peter. “You of little faith,” He said, “why did you doubt?”
ekegusii: Erio kegima Yeso akarambora okoboko kwaye, akamobwata akamoteebia, “Aye omonto bw’okwegena ogoke, nase ki okwoboa?”
swahili: Mara Yesu akaunyoosha mkono wake na kumshika, akamwambia, “Wewe mwenye imani haba, kwa nini uliona shaka?”

english: And when they had climbed back into the boat, the wind died down.
ekegusii: Ekero bachia koriina obwato ime, omwaga ogakira.
swahili: Nao walipoingia ndani ya mashua, upepo ukakoma.

english: Then those who were in the boat worshiped Him, saying, “Truly You are the Son of God!” Jesus Heals at Gennesaret (Mark 6:53–56)
ekegusii: N’abwo abarenge ase obwato ime bakamosasiima, bagateeba, “Ekeene, aye n’Omwana o Nyasae.” Abanto ba Genesareti bakogwenigwa (Mar 6:53-56)
swahili: Ndipo wote waliokuwa ndani ya ile mashua wakamwabudu Yesu, wakisema, “Hakika, wewe ndiwe Mwana wa Mungu.” Yesu Awaponya Wagonjwa Genesareti (Marko 6:53-56)

english: When they had crossed over, they landed at Gennesaret.
ekegusii: Ekero bambokire, bagaika ense ya Genesareti.
swahili: Walipokwisha kuvuka, wakafika nchi ya Genesareti.

english: And when the men of that place recognized Jesus, they sent word to all the surrounding region. People brought all the sick to Him
ekegusii: Ekero abanto b’orogongo roria bachia komomanya, bagatoma amang’ana ase chinsemo chionsi, bamorentere bonsi abarenge abarwaire;
swahili: Watu wa eneo lile walipomtambua Yesu, walipeleka habari sehemu zote za jirani. Watu wakamletea wagonjwa wao wote,

english: and begged Him just to let them touch the fringe of His cloak. And all who touched Him were healed.
ekegusii: bakamosorora ng’a abae ribaga bakune nonya nomokoba bw’eyanga yaye; na bonsi abayokunete bakagwenigwa.
swahili: wakamsihi awaruhusu wagonjwa waguse tu pindo la vazi lake, nao wote waliomgusa, wakaponywa.

english: because John had been telling him, “It is not lawful for you to have her.”
ekegusii: ekiagera Yohana amotebetie, “Teri boronge ase ore komenyana nere.”
swahili: kwa kuwa Yohana alikuwa amemwambia Herode: “Si halali kwako kuwa na huyo mwanamke.”

english: Although Herod wanted to kill John, he was afraid of the people, because they regarded John as a prophet.
ekegusii: Goika akarigia komoita, korende akairoka abanto, ekiagera konya banchire ng’a Yohana n’omobani orenge.
swahili: Herode alitaka sana kumuua Yohana, lakini akaogopa watu, kwa maana walimtambua kuwa ni nabii.

english: On Herod’s birthday, however, the daughter of Herodias danced before them and pleased Herod
ekegusii: Rigachia goika rituko ri’okoinyora okoiborwa kwaye Herode, omoiseke bwe Herodia agatenga gati‐gati y’ abanto, akagokia Herode.
swahili: Katika siku ya kuadhimisha sikukuu ya kuzaliwa kwa Herode, binti wa Herodia alicheza mbele ya watu waliohudhuria, akamfurahisha sana Herode,

english: so much that he promised with an oath to give to her whatever she asked.
ekegusii: Erio Herode agatiana ase okomoriera eira ng’a namoe kende gionsi araborie.
swahili: kiasi kwamba aliahidi kwa kiapo kumpa huyo binti chochote angeomba.

english: Prompted by her mother, she said, “Give me here on a platter the head of John the Baptist.”
ekegusii: Kobwatekana n’obosemia bwa ng’ina omoiseke oria agateeba, “Ing’a omotwe o Yohana Omobatisi aiga ase esani.”
swahili: Huyo binti, akiwa amechochewa na mama yake, akasema, “Nipe kichwa cha Yohana Mbatizaji kwenye sinia.”

english: The king was grieved, but because of his oaths and his guests, he ordered that her wish be granted
ekegusii: Omorwoti agaichana, korende ase engencho ye chiira chiaye na abageni baye ase omoyega, agachiika ayoegwe.
swahili: Mfalme akasikitika, lakini kwa sababu ya viapo alivyoapa mbele ya wageni, akaamuru kwamba apatiwe ombi lake.

english: Then some Pharisees and scribes came to Jesus from Jerusalem and asked,
ekegusii: Ekero ekio Abafarisai na aborokia b’amariiko bakarwa Yerusalemu, bagachiera Yeso, bakamoboria,
swahili: Ndipo baadhi ya Mafarisayo na walimu wa sheria wakamjia Yesu kutoka Yerusalemu na kumuuliza,

english: Jesus called the crowd to Him and said, “Listen and understand.
ekegusii: Akarangeria abanto bache asare, akabateebia, “Igwa na manya:
swahili: Yesu akaita ule umati wa watu, akawaambia, “Sikilizeni na mwelewe:

english: A man is not defiled by what enters his mouth, but by what comes out of it.”
ekegusii: Tari ekio kegosoa omonwa gekobekera omonto ogotacheneka, korende egekorwa ase omonwa nakio ekio gekobekera omonto ogotacheneka.”
swahili: kinachomfanya mtu kuwa najisi mbele za Mungu si kile kiingiacho kinywani mwake, bali ni kile kitokacho kinywani mwake.”

english: Then the disciples came to Him and said, “Are You aware that the Pharisees were offended when they heard this?”
ekegusii: Ekero ekio aborokigwa baye bagaacha, bakamoboria, “Inee! Kwamanyire ng’a Abafarisai, ekero baigwete ring’ana riria, mbagechetigwe?”
swahili: Kisha wanafunzi wake wakamjia na kumuuliza, “Je, unajua kwamba Mafarisayo walichukizwa sana waliposikia yale uliyosema?”

english: But Jesus replied, “Every plant that My heavenly Father has not planted will be pulled up by its roots.
ekegusii: Akairaneria, “Kera ekemeri getasimekiri na Tata one ore igoro ngesimorwe.
swahili: Akawajibu, “Kila pando ambalo Baba yangu wa mbinguni hakulipanda, litangʼolewa.

english: Disregard them! They are blind guides. If a blind man leads a blind man, both will fall into a pit.”
ekegusii: Batige; barabwo nabaraai emeuko. Omouko oise koraa omouko onde, nigo baragwe ase engoro bonsi babere.”
swahili: Waacheni; wao ni viongozi vipofu, wanaoongoza vipofu. Kama kipofu akimwongoza kipofu mwenzake, wote wawili watatumbukia shimoni.”

english: Peter said to Him, “Explain this parable to us.”
ekegusii: Korende Petero akamoteebia, “Totebererie omobayeeno oyio.”
swahili: Petro akasema, “Tueleze maana ya huu mfano.”

english: “Do you still not understand?” Jesus asked.
ekegusii: Akabora, “Inee! Nonya mbono nainwe timori nobong’aini?
swahili: Yesu akawauliza, “Je, bado ninyi hamfahamu?

english: “Do you not yet realize that whatever enters the mouth goes into the stomach and then is eliminated?
ekegusii: Timomanyeti ng’a kende gionsi kegosoa ase omonwa nigo kegoeta enda, kiagwa kebara?
swahili: Je, hamwelewi kwamba chochote kiingiacho kinywani huenda tumboni, na hatimaye hutolewa nje kikiwa uchafu?

english: But the things that come out of the mouth come from the heart, and these things defile a man.
ekegusii: Korende ebikorwa ase omonwa nigo bikorwa ase enkoro; nabio bikobekera omonto ogotacheneka.
swahili: Lakini kitokacho kinywani hutoka moyoni, na hiki ndicho kimtiacho mtu unajisi.

english: For out of the heart come evil thoughts, murder, adultery, sexual immorality, theft, false testimony, and slander.
ekegusii: Inaki ase enkoro nao bikorwa ebirengerio ebibe, oboiti, obotomani, obonyaka, oboibi, amang’ana y’oborimo, na okorama.
swahili: Kwa maana ndani ya moyo hutoka mawazo mabaya, uuaji, uzinzi, uasherati, wizi, ushahidi wa uongo na masingizio.

english: “Why do Your disciples break the tradition of the elders? They do not wash their hands before they eat.”
ekegusii: “Nase ki aborokigwa bao bagosaria chingencho chi’abagaaka? Inaki kobakoragera tibari goisaaba amaboko abo buna egwenerete.”
swahili: “Mbona wanafunzi wako wanakiuka mapokeo ya wazee? Kwa maana wao hawanawi mikono yao kabla ya kula!”

english: These are what defile a man, but eating with unwashed hands does not defile him.” The Faith of the Canaanite Woman (Mark 7:24–30)
ekegusii: Ayio naro akobekera omonto ogotacheneka korende okoria namaboko ataisaabiri tikori kobekera omonto ogotacheneka.” Okwegena kw’omokuungu bw’Ebisaku (Mar 7:24-30)
swahili: Haya ndiyo yamtiayo mtu unajisi; lakini kula bila kunawa mikono hakumtii mtu unajisi.” Imani Ya Mwanamke Mkanaani (Marko 7:24-30)

english: Leaving that place, Jesus withdrew to the district of Tyre and Sidon.
ekegusii: Yeso akarua aroro, akagenda chinsemo chia Turo na Sidoni.
swahili: Yesu aliondoka mahali pale, akaenda sehemu za Tiro na Sidoni.

english: And a Canaanite woman from that region came to Him, crying out, “Lord, Son of David, have mercy on me! My daughter is miserably possessed by a demon.”
ekegusii: Na rora, omokungu o Kaanani korwa ase ensemo eria akaoroka, agakaa eriogi, akabora, “Omonene, omwana o Daudi, indorere amaabera; enyaroka y’ane yachandirwe mono nekerecha.”
swahili: Mwanamke mmoja Mkanaani aliyeishi sehemu jirani na hizo akaja kwake akilia, akasema, “Nihurumie, Ee Bwana, Mwana wa Daudi! Binti yangu amepagawa na pepo mchafu, na anateseka sana.”

english: But Jesus did not answer a word. So His disciples came and urged Him, “Send her away, for she keeps crying out after us.”
ekegusii: Korende tamoiraneria ing’ana. Aborokigwa baye bagaacha, bakamosorora, bakaboora, “Mokanie, agende, ekiagera akona‐gototunyana ogotoakera eriogi.”
swahili: Lakini Yesu hakumjibu neno. Hivyo wanafunzi wake wakamwendea na kumsihi sana, wakisema, “Mwambie aende zake, kwa maana anaendelea kutupigia kelele.”

english: He answered, “I was sent only to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.”
ekegusii: Akairaneria, “Nigo natometwe ase ching’ondi chinsiru chi’enyomba ya Israeli chioka.”
swahili: Yesu akajibu, “Nimetumwa tu kwa ajili ya kondoo wa Israeli waliopotea.”

english: The woman came and knelt before Him. “Lord, help me!” she said.
ekegusii: Korende omokungu oria akamochiera agatugama inse ase are, akabora, “Omonene, nkonya.”
swahili: Lakini yule mwanamke akaja, akapiga magoti mbele ya Yesu, akasema, “Bwana, nisaidie!”

english: But Jesus replied, “It is not right to take the children’s bread and toss it to the dogs.”
ekegusii: Yeso akairaneria, “Tari buya kobogoria endagera y’abana na koyerutera chisese.”
swahili: Yesu akajibu, “Si haki kuchukua chakula cha watoto na kuwatupia mbwa.”

english: “Yes, Lord,” she said, “even the dogs eat the crumbs that fall from their master’s table.”
ekegusii: Omokungu oria akabora, “Ee, Omonene, korende nonya ne chisese nkoria chire amatori ayakogwa korwa ase chimesa chi’abanene babo.”
swahili: Yule mwanamke akajibu, “Ndiyo, Bwana, lakini hata mbwa hula makombo yanayoanguka kutoka kwenye meza za bwana zao.”

english: “O woman,” Jesus answered, “your faith is great! Let it be done for you as you desire.” And her daughter was healed from that very hour. The Feeding of the Four Thousand (2 Kings 4:42–44; Mark 8:1–10)
ekegusii: Erio Yeso akamoiraneria, “Aye omong’ina, okwegena kwao nokonene! Tiga abe buna oganetie.” Na ekero ekio enyaroka yaye ekagwenigwa. Abange bakogwenigwa (Mar 7:31-37)
swahili: Ndipo Yesu akamwambia, “Mwanamke, imani yako ni kubwa! Iwe kwako kama unavyotaka.” Naye binti yake akapona tangu saa ile. Yesu Aponya Watu Wengi

english: Moving on from there, Jesus went along the Sea of Galilee. Then He went up on a mountain and sat down.
ekegusii: Yeso akarua aroro akagenderera, agacha ensemo y’enyancha ya Galili, akariina ebitunwa igoro, agaikaransa aroro.
swahili: Yesu akaondoka na kwenda kando ya Bahari ya Galilaya. Kisha akapanda mlimani, akaketi huko.

english: Jesus replied, “And why do you break the command of God for the sake of your tradition?
ekegusii: Akabairaneria, Nase ki inwe mogosaria ogochika kwa Nyasae ase chingencho chiaino?
swahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Mbona ninyi mnavunja amri ya Mungu kwa ajili ya mapokeo yenu?

english: Large crowds came to Him, bringing the lame, the blind, the crippled, the mute, and many others, and laid them at His feet, and He healed them.
ekegusii: Emeganda emenge ekamochiera, ekarenta amagata, na ebirema, na emeuko, na amamama, na abande abange, bakababeeka ase amagoro a Yeso, na ere akabagwenia.
swahili: Umati mkubwa wa watu ukamjia, wakiwaleta vilema, vipofu, viwete, bubu na wengine wengi, wakawaweka miguuni pake; naye akawaponya.

english: The crowd was amazed when they saw the mute speaking, the crippled restored, the lame walking, and the blind seeing. And they glorified the God of Israel.
ekegusii: Goika emeganda egakumia ekero bachia korora abarenge amamama bagokwana, abarenge ebirema babeire buya, abarenge amagata bakogenda, na abarenge emeuko bakorora; bakamotogia Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli. Okoragerigwa kw’ abanto chilifu inye (Mar 8:1-10)
swahili: Hao watu wakashangaa walipoona bubu wakisema, vilema wakipona, viwete wakitembea na vipofu wakiona, wakamtukuza Mungu wa Israeli. Yesu Alisha Watu Elfu Nne (Marko 8:1-10)

english: Then Jesus called His disciples to Him and said, “I have compassion for this crowd, because they have already been with Me three days and have nothing to eat. I do not want to send them away hungry, or they may faint along the way.”
ekegusii: Erio Yeso akarangeria aborokigwa baye bache asare, akabora, “Inche naroreire emeganda amaabera, ekiagera babeire amo nainche amatuko atato, batari nendagera; na tindigeti kobatiga bagende nenchara, baabaise kogoya inchera.”
swahili: Kisha Yesu akawaita wanafunzi wake, akawaambia, “Ninauhurumia huu umati wa watu, kwa sababu sasa wamekuwa pamoja nami kwa muda wa siku tatu, na hawana chakula chochote. Nami sipendi kuwaaga wakiwa na njaa, wasije wakazimia njiani.”

english: The disciples replied, “Where in this desolate place could we find enough bread to feed such a large crowd?”
ekegusii: Aborokigwa baye bakamoteebia, “Aa nerooro, ng’ai toranyore emegati emenge eraisane abanto abange buna aba baigote?”
swahili: Wanafunzi wake wakasema, “Tutapata wapi mikate ya kutosha kuwalisha umati huu wa watu mkubwa namna hii, nasi tuko nyikani?”

english: “How many loaves do you have?” Jesus asked. “Seven,” they replied, “and a few small fish.”
ekegusii: Yeso akababoria, “Emegati nerenga mobwate?” Bakamoiraneria, “Netano na ebere, ne chinswe chinsinini nke igo.”
swahili: Yesu akawauliza, “Mnayo mikate mingapi?” Wakamjibu, “Tunayo mikate saba na visamaki vichache.”

english: And He instructed the crowd to sit down on the ground.
ekegusii: Agachiika omoganda oikaranse inse.
swahili: Yesu akawaambia ule umati wa watu waketi chini.

english: Taking the seven loaves and the fish, He gave thanks and broke them. Then He gave them to the disciples, and the disciples gave them to the people.
ekegusii: Akabogoria emegati eria etano n’ebere, ne chinswe chiria. Ekero airaneirie ng’a mbuya mono, akabisamunyora, akaa aborokigwa, na barabwo bakayea emeganda eria.
swahili: Kisha akachukua ile mikate saba na wale samaki, naye akiisha kumshukuru Mungu, akavimega na kuwapa wanafunzi wake, nao wakawapa ule umati wa watu.

english: They all ate and were satisfied, and the disciples picked up seven basketfuls of broken pieces that were left over.
ekegusii: Bakaria bonsi, bakaigota; bagasangereria ebisamunye bi’emegati ebiatigarete, ebitonga bitano na bibere biichire.
swahili: Wote wakala na kushiba. Baadaye wanafunzi wakakusanya vipande vilivyosalia, wakajaza vikapu saba.

english: A total of four thousand men were fed, in addition to women and children.
ekegusii: Na abwo bariete nigo barenge abasacha chilifu inye, otatiga abakungu na abana.
swahili: Idadi ya watu walikuwa wanaume 4,000, bila kuhesabu wanawake na watoto.

english: After Jesus had dismissed the crowds, He got into the boat and went to the region of Magadan.
ekegusii: Erio Yeso gatigire emeganda egende, akariina obwato ime, akagenda chinsemo chia Magadani.
swahili: Baada ya kuaga ule umati wa watu, Yesu aliingia katika mashua, akaenda sehemu za Magadani.

english: For God said, ‘Honor your father and mother’ and ‘Anyone who curses his father or mother must be put to death.’
ekegusii: Inaki Nyasae nigo achiigete, agateeba: Sika iso na nyoko, na: Oyorakwane bobe ase ise, gose ase ng’ina, ogokwa nakwe.
swahili: Kwa maana Mungu alisema, ‘Waheshimu baba yako na mama yako,’ na, ‘Yeyote amtukanaye baba yake au mama yake, na auawe.’

english: But you say that if anyone says to his father or mother, ‘Whatever you would have received from me is a gift devoted to God,’
ekegusii: Korende inwe moteba: Oyoratebie ise gose ng’ina: Bionsi ebi anga kwanyora korwa ase ’nde biaeirwe Nyasae, ere temogwenereti gosika ise.
swahili: Lakini ninyi mwafundisha kwamba mtu akimwambia baba yake au mama yake, ‘Kile ambacho ningeweza kukusaidia kimewekwa wakfu kwa Mungu,’

english: he need not honor his father or mother with it. Thus you nullify the word of God for the sake of your tradition.
ekegusii: Ase chingencho chiaino chia kare nigo mogosaria ring’ana ria Nyasae.
swahili: basi hana tena sababu ya kumheshimu baba yake nacho. Basi kwa ajili ya mafundisho yenu mnavunja amri ya Mungu.

english: You hypocrites! Isaiah prophesied correctly about you:
ekegusii: Inwe abang’ainereria! Mbuya Isaya abanete igoro ase more, ekero ateebete:
swahili: Ninyi wanafiki! Isaya alikuwa sawa alipotabiri juu yenu kwamba:

english: ‘These people honor Me with their lips, but their hearts are far from Me.
ekegusii: Abanto aba nigo bansigete ase ebikoba biabo igoro, korende chinkoro chiabo nigo chire aare korwa ase ’nde.
swahili: “ ‘Watu hawa huniheshimu kwa midomo yao, lakini mioyo yao iko mbali nami.

english: They worship Me in vain; they teach as doctrine the precepts of men.’ ” What Defiles a Man (Mark 7:14–23)
ekegusii: Abwo nigo bagonsasiima ogosasiima kwa bosa kobakworokereria amorokererio ayare amachiiko a Mwanyabaanto oka.
swahili: Huniabudu bure; nayo mafundisho yao ni maagizo ya wanadamu tu.’ ” Vitu Vitiavyo Unajisi (Marko 7:14-23)

english: Then the Pharisees and Sadducees came and tested Jesus by asking Him to show them a sign from heaven.
ekegusii: Abafarisai na Abasadukai bagaacha ase ogoteema Yeso, bakamosaba aborokie egekone buna ekemanyererio korwa igoro.
swahili: Mafarisayo na Masadukayo wakamjia Yesu na kumjaribu kwa kumwomba awaonyeshe ishara kutoka mbinguni.

english: Or the seven loaves for the four thousand, and how many basketfuls you gathered?
ekegusii: Nonya nemegati eria etano n’ebere ase baria chilifu inye, na ebitonga mbirenga mwasangereretie?
swahili: Au ile mikate saba iliyolisha watu 4,000 na idadi ya vikapu vingapi vya mabaki mlivyokusanya?

english: How do you not understand that I was not telling you about bread? But beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and Sadducees.”
ekegusii: Inaki inwe motari komanya ng’a tindi gokwana igoro y’emegati? Mwerende nememera y’Abafarisai na Abasadukai.”
swahili: Inakuwaje mnashindwa kuelewa kwamba nilikuwa sisemi nanyi habari za mikate? Jilindeni na chachu ya Mafarisayo na Masadukayo.”

english: Then they understood that He was not telling them to beware of the leaven used in bread, but of the teaching of the Pharisees and Sadducees. Peter’s Confession of Christ (Mark 8:27–30; Luke 9:18–20; John 6:67–71)
ekegusii: Erio bakamanya ng’a tare kobateebia okwerenda nememera y’emegati, korende nokworokereria kw’Abafarisai na Abasadukai. Okoorokia gwa Petero ng’a Yeso nere Kristo (Mar 8:27-30; Luk 9:18-21)
swahili: Ndipo wakaelewa kwamba alikuwa hasemi juu ya chachu ya kutengeneza mikate, bali juu ya mafundisho ya Mafarisayo na Masadukayo. Petro Amkiri Yesu Kuwa Ni Mwana Wa Mungu (Marko 8:27-30; Luka 9:18-21)

english: When Jesus came to the region of Caesarea Philippi, He questioned His disciples: “Who do people say the Son of Man is?”
ekegusii: Bono ekero Yeso acha ensemo ya Kaisaria Filipi, akaboria aborokigwa baye, “Inee! Abanto nigo bakobora ng’a Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto nere ng’o?”
swahili: Basi Yesu alipofika katika eneo la Kaisaria-Filipi, akawauliza wanafunzi wake, “Watu husema kwamba mimi Mwana wa Adamu ni nani?”

english: They replied, “Some say John the Baptist; others say Elijah; and still others, Jeremiah or one of the prophets.”
ekegusii: Bakamoiraneria, “Abande nigo bagoteeba: Yohana Omobatisi; na abande: Elija; na abande: Yeremia gose oyomo bw’ababani.”
swahili: Wakamjibu, “Baadhi husema ni Yohana Mbatizaji; wengine husema ni Eliya; na bado wengine husema ni Yeremia au mmojawapo wa manabii.”

english: “But what about you?” Jesus asked. “Who do you say I am?”
ekegusii: Yeso akababoria, “Nainwe mokobora ng’a ninche ning’o?”
swahili: Akawauliza, “Je, ninyi mnasema mimi ni nani?”

english: Simon Peter answered, “You are the Christ, the Son of the living God.”
ekegusii: Simioni Petero akamoiraneria, “Aye naye Kristo, Omwana o Nyasae ore moyo.”
swahili: Simoni Petro akamjibu, “Wewe ndiwe Kristo, Mwana wa Mungu aliye hai.”

english: Jesus replied, “Blessed are you, Simon son of Jonah! For this was not revealed to you by flesh and blood, but by My Father in heaven.
ekegusii: Yeso akamoiraneria, “Nosesenirie aye Simioni, mosinto o Yona, ekiagera eri tomaanoreiri nomobere na amanyinga, korende na Tata one ore igoro.
swahili: Naye Yesu akamwambia, “Heri wewe, Simoni Bar-Yona, kwa maana hili halikufunuliwa kwako na mwanadamu, bali na Baba yangu aliye mbinguni.

english: And I tell you that you are Peter, and on this rock I will build My church, and the gates of Hades will not prevail against it.
ekegusii: Na inche nagotebirie, ng’a aye naye Petero, na igoro ase egetare eke ning’agache ekanisa y’ane, ne chinguru chi’amakweri tichikoyebua.
swahili: Nami nakuambia, wewe ndiwe Petro na juu ya mwamba huu nitalijenga kanisa langu, hata malango ya Kuzimu hayataweza kulishinda.

english: I will give you the keys of the kingdom of heaven. Whatever you bind on earth will be bound in heaven, and whatever you loose on earth will be loosed in heaven.”
ekegusii: Inche ninkoe ebigorero bi’oborwoti bwa igoro, na ande onsi orasibe ase ense nabe asibirwe na igoro, na ande onsi orasibore ase ense nabe asiboirwe na igoro.”
swahili: Nitakupa funguo za Ufalme wa mbinguni, na lolote utakalolifunga duniani litakuwa limefungwa Mbinguni, nalo lolote utakalofungua duniani litakuwa limefunguliwa mbinguni.”

english: But He replied, “When evening comes, you say, ‘The weather will be fair, for the sky is red,’
ekegusii: Akabairaneria, “Rikoba mogoroba, mwaboora: Reero nerakeere, ekiagera igoro abariirire.
swahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Ifikapo jioni, mnasema, ‘Hali ya hewa itakuwa nzuri, kwa kuwa anga ni nyekundu.’

english: Then He admonished the disciples not to tell anyone that He was the Christ. Christ’s Passion Foretold (Mark 8:31–33; Luke 9:21–22)
ekegusii: Erio akabatianera bokong’u aborokigwa baye ng’a tibateebia onde nere Kristo. Yeso okobana ogokwa na okoboka kwaye (Mar 8:31-33; Luk 9:22)
swahili: Kisha akawakataza wanafunzi wake wasimwambie mtu yeyote kwamba yeye ndiye Kristo. Yesu Anatabiri Juu Ya Kifo Chake (Marko 8:31–9:1; Luka 9:22-27)

english: From that time on Jesus began to show His disciples that He must go to Jerusalem and suffer many things at the hands of the elders, chief priests, and scribes, and that He must be killed and on the third day be raised to life.
ekegusii: Korwa ekero ekio Yeso agachaaka kworokereria aborokigwa baye ng’a nemogwenerete kogenda Yerusalemu, agwo ase aranyare gochandwa mono ase amaboko y’abagaaka, na abakuani abanene, na aborokia b’amariiko, na goitwa; ase rituko ria gatato naboke.
swahili: Tangu wakati huo, Yesu alianza kuwaeleza wanafunzi wake kwamba hana budi kwenda Yerusalemu na kupata mateso mengi mikononi mwa wazee, viongozi wa makuhani, na walimu wa sheria, na kwamba itampasa auawe lakini siku ya tatu kufufuliwa.

english: Peter took Him aside and began to rebuke Him. “Far be it from You, Lord!” he said. “This shall never happen to You!”
ekegusii: Petero akamoira ensemo, agachaaka komokania, akabora, “Omonene, ayio tabaisa gokonyora! Takoba ase ore buna ayio.”
swahili: Petro akamchukua kando, akaanza kumkemea akisema, “Haiwezekani, Bwana! Jambo hili kamwe halitakupata!”

english: But Jesus turned and said to Peter, “Get behind Me, Satan! You are a stumbling block to Me. For you do not have in mind the things of God, but the things of men.” Take Up Your Cross (Mark 8:34–38; Luke 9:23–27)
ekegusii: Korende Yeso akeonchora, agateebia Petero, “Irana magega y’ane, Saitani! Aye nigo origetie koba egetango ase inde, ekiagera ebirengererio biao tibiri ase ensemo ya Nyasae, korende nase Mwanyabaanto.” Okorangerigwa kw’ogwekeyia omonyene (Mar 8:34; 9:1; Luk 9:23-27)
swahili: Lakini Yesu akageuka na kumwambia Petro, “Rudi nyuma yangu, Shetani! Wewe ni kikwazo kwangu. Moyo wako hauwazi yaliyo ya Mungu, bali ya wanadamu.”

english: Then Jesus told His disciples, “If anyone wants to come after Me, he must deny himself and take up his cross and follow Me.
ekegusii: Erio Yeso agateebia aborokigwa baye, “monto onde bwensi origetie koba omotunyani one, tiga ekaane ere omonyene, etweke omosalaba oye, antunyane.
swahili: Ndipo Yesu akawaambia wanafunzi wake, “Mtu yeyote akitaka kunifuata, ni lazima ajikane mwenyewe, auchukue msalaba wake, anifuate.

english: For whoever wants to save his life will lose it, but whoever loses his life for My sake will find it.
ekegusii: Inaki onde bwensi orarigie koegerera obogima bwaye, oyio nabosirie; na oyorasirie obogima bwaye ase engencho y’ane, oyio naboegerere.
swahili: Kwa maana yeyote anayetaka kuyaokoa maisha yake atayapoteza, lakini yeyote atakayeyapoteza maisha yake kwa ajili yangu atayapata.

english: What will it profit a man if he gains the whole world, yet forfeits his soul? Or what can a man give in exchange for his soul?
ekegusii: Ninki eragwenere omonto konyora ense yonsi, ko asirie omoyo oye? Gose omonto inki ararue ase ribaga ri’omoyo oye?
swahili: Kwa maana, je, itamfaidi nini mtu kuupata ulimwengu wote, lakini akayapoteza maisha yake? Au mtu atatoa nini badala ya nafsi yake?

english: For the Son of Man will come in His Father’s glory with His angels, and then He will repay each one according to what he has done.
ekegusii: Ekiagera Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto naoroke nabamalaika baye ore nobonene bwa Ise, na ekero ekio ng’ae kera omonto koreng’ana buna are gokora.
swahili: Kwa maana Mwana wa Adamu atakuja katika utukufu wa Baba yake pamoja na malaika zake, naye ndipo atakapomlipa kila mtu kwa kadiri ya matendo yake.

english: Truly I tell you, some who are standing here will not taste death before they see the Son of Man coming in His kingdom.”
ekegusii: Nekeene nabateebirie: Abanto mbare aiga ase aba bateneine, barabwo bataigwe amakweri nonya ng’ake goika barore Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto ogocha ase oborwoti bwaye.”
swahili: Nawaambia kweli, baadhi yenu hapa hawataonja mauti kabla ya kumwona Mwana wa Adamu akija katika Ufalme wake.”

english: and in the morning, ‘Today it will be stormy, for the sky is red and overcast.’ You know how to interpret the appearance of the sky, but not the signs of the times.
ekegusii: Na mambia mwaboora: Reero netwe ey’omwaga, ekiagera igoro yababariirire na gosung’unana. Inwe imomanyete korora obosio bwa igoro, korende timomanyeti ebimanyererio bi’ebiro.
swahili: Nanyi wakati wa asubuhi mnasema, ‘Leo kutakuwa na dhoruba, kwa sababu anga ni nyekundu na mawingu yametanda.’ Mnajua jinsi ya kupambanua kule kuonekana kwa anga, lakini hamwezi kupambanua dalili za nyakati.

english: A wicked and adulterous generation demands a sign, but none will be given it except the sign of Jonah.” Then He left them and went away. The Leaven of the Pharisees and Sadducees (Mark 8:14–21; Luke 12:1–3)
ekegusii: Ekegori egeturutumbu geteegeneti kerigetie egekone, korende tigekoegwa egekone otatiga ekia Yona.” Erio akabatiga, akagenda. Yeso ogotogonyera obouko bw’aborokigwa (Mar 8:14-21)
swahili: Kizazi kiovu na cha uzinzi kinatafuta ishara, lakini hakitapewa ishara yoyote isipokuwa ishara ya Yona.” Yesu akawaacha, akaenda zake. Chachu Ya Mafarisayo Na Masadukayo (Marko 8:14-21)

english: When they crossed to the other side, the disciples forgot to take bread.
ekegusii: Ekero aborokigwa baika ng’umbu, konya beebire koirana emegati.
swahili: Wanafunzi wake walipofika ngʼambo ya bahari, walikuwa wamesahau kuchukua mikate.

english: “Watch out!” Jesus told them. “Beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and Sadducees.”
ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Rigereria, mwerende nememera y’Abafarisai na Abasadukai.”
swahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Jihadharini. Jilindeni na chachu ya Mafarisayo na ya Masadukayo.”

english: They discussed this among themselves and concluded, “It is because we did not bring any bread.”
ekegusii: Bakaboorania, bagoteeba, “Titwarentete emegati.”
swahili: Wakajadiliana wao kwa wao, wakisema, “Ni kwa sababu hatukuleta mikate.”

english: Aware of their conversation, Jesus said, “You of little faith, why are you debating among yourselves about having no bread?
ekegusii: Korende Yeso, konya omanyire aya, akabora, “Inwe abamore nokwegena ogoke, inki gekogera mokona‐koborania ng’a timori nemegati?
swahili: Yesu, akifahamu majadiliano yao, akauliza, “Enyi wa imani haba! Mbona mnajadiliana miongoni mwenu kuhusu kutokuwa na mikate?

english: Do you still not understand? Do you not remember the five loaves for the five thousand, and how many basketfuls you gathered?
ekegusii: Timokomanya gose koinyora emegati eria etano ase baria chilifu isano, na ebitonga mbirenga mwasangereretie?
swahili: Je, bado hamwelewi? Je, hamkumbuki ile mikate mitano iliyolisha watu 5,000 na idadi ya vikapu vingapi vya mabaki mlivyokusanya?

english: After six days Jesus took with Him Peter, James, and John the brother of James, and led them up a high mountain by themselves.
ekegusii: Na nyuma y’amatuko atano na rimo Yeso akaira Petero, na Yakobo, na Yohana momura omwabo Yakobo, bakagenda nabarabwo igoro ase egetunwa egetambe barabwo boka.
swahili: Siku sita baada ya jambo hili, Yesu akawachukua Petro, Yakobo na Yohana ndugu yake Yakobo, akawapeleka juu ya mlima mrefu peke yao.

english: The disciples asked Him, “Why then do the scribes say that Elijah must come first?”
ekegusii: Aborokigwa baye bakamobooria, “Nase ki rende aborokia b’amariiko bagoteeba ng’a negwenerete Elija ache ritang’ani?”
swahili: Wale wanafunzi wakamuuliza, “Kwa nini basi walimu wa sheria husema kwamba ni lazima Eliya aje kwanza?”

english: Jesus replied, “Elijah does indeed come, and he will restore all things.
ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, “Nekeene, n’Elija ogochia gocha ritang’ani, na ere naroisie onsi.
swahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Ni kweli, Eliya lazima aje kwanza, naye atatengeneza mambo yote.

english: But I tell you that Elijah has already come, and they did not recognize him, but have done to him whatever they wished. In the same way, the Son of Man will suffer at their hands.”
ekegusii: Korende nabateebirie ng’a Elija oikire gocha; na barabwo tibamomanyete, korende bakamokorera onsi aya barigetie. Naboigo n’Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto nachie konyora emechando ase amaboko abo.”
swahili: Lakini nawaambia, Eliya amekwisha kuja, nao hawakumtambua, bali walimtendea kila kitu walichotaka. Vivyo hivyo Mwana wa Adamu pia atateswa mikononi mwao.”

english: Then the disciples understood that He was speaking to them about John the Baptist. The Boy with a Demon (Mark 9:14–29; Luke 9:37–42)
ekegusii: Erio aborokigwa baye bakamanya ng’a ere nigo are kobateebia igoro ya Yohana Omobatisi. Yeso okogwenia omomura obwatire nekerecha (Mar 9:14-29; Luk 9:37-43)
swahili: Ndipo wale wanafunzi wakaelewa kuwa alikuwa anazungumza nao habari za Yohana Mbatizaji. Yesu Amponya Kijana Mwenye Pepo (Marko 9:14-29; Luka 9:37-43)

english: When they came to the crowd, a man came up to Jesus and knelt before Him.
ekegusii: Ekero bachia goika ase omoganda, omonto oyomo akamochiera agwo, akamotung’amera, akabora,
swahili: Walipofika penye umati wa watu, mtu mmoja akamjia Yesu na kupiga magoti mbele yake, akasema,

english: “Lord, have mercy on my son,” he said. “He has seizures and is suffering terribly. He often falls into the fire or into the water.
ekegusii: “Omonene, ororere omomura one amaabera, ekiagera nare nendurume, nigo achandegete mono. Inaki ere, kero kende nigo akogwa ase omorero ime, na kero kende ase amaache ime.
swahili: “Bwana, mhurumie mwanangu. Yeye ana kifafa na anateseka sana. Mara kwa mara huanguka kwenye moto au kwenye maji.

english: I brought him to Your disciples, but they could not heal him.”
ekegusii: Namorenta ase aborokigwa bao, tibanyara komogwenia.”
swahili: Nilimleta kwa wanafunzi wako, lakini hawakuweza kumponya.”

english: “O unbelieving and perverse generation!” Jesus replied. “How long must I remain with you? How long must I put up with you? Bring the boy here to Me.”
ekegusii: Yeso akairaneria, “Inwe ekegori getari nokwegena, naende ekebe, nimbe amo nainwe goika ririri? Nindemererie nainwe goika ririri? Mondetere aiga.”
swahili: Yesu akajibu, “Enyi kizazi kisichoamini na kilichopotoka! Nitakaa nanyi mpaka lini? Nitawavumilia mpaka lini? Mleteni mvulana hapa kwangu.”

english: Then Jesus rebuked the demon, and it came out of the boy, and he was healed from that moment. The Power of Faith (Luke 17:5–10)
ekegusii: Yeso agatogonyera ekerecha, na kerokio kegatiga omwana oria na ere akagwenigwa ekero keria.
swahili: Yesu akamkemea yule pepo mchafu, akamtoka yule kijana, naye akapona saa ile ile.

english: Afterward the disciples came to Jesus privately and asked, “Why couldn’t we drive it out?”
ekegusii: Erio aborokigwa bagachiera Yeso bobisi, bakaboora, “Ninki kiagera intwe titwanyara korusia ekerecha keria?”
swahili: Kisha wanafunzi wakamwendea Yesu wakiwa peke yao, wakamuuliza, “Kwa nini sisi hatukuweza kumtoa?”

english: There He was transfigured before them. His face shone like the sun, and His clothes became as white as the light.
ekegusii: Akaonchoka ekieni kiaye ase bare, obosio bwaye bokagirigenta buna erioba, ne chianga chiaye chikaraba buna omobaso.
swahili: Wakiwa huko, Yesu alibadilika sura mbele yao. Uso wake ukangʼaa kama jua na nguo zake zikawa na weupe wa kuumiza macho.

english: “Because you have so little faith,” He answered. “For truly I tell you, if you have faith the size of a mustard seed, you can say to this mountain, ‘Move from here to there,’ and it will move. Nothing will be impossible for you.” The Second Prediction of the Passion (Mark 9:30–32; Luke 9:43–45)
ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Nase engencho y’okwegena kwaino kore ogoke. Ekeene nabateebirie: Moise koba nokwegena koreng’aine buna entetere y’Omosirapi, inamoteebie egetunwa eke: Karue agwo, ogende aaria, na kerokio inakeruo, tirikoba ring’ana ritanyarekane ase more. [
swahili: Akawajibu, “Kwa sababu ya imani yenu ndogo. Ninawaambia kweli, mkiwa na imani ndogo kama punje ya haradali, mtauambia mlima huu, ‘Ondoka hapa uende pale,’ nao utaondoka. Wala hakutakuwa na jambo lisilowezekana kwenu. [

english: When they gathered together in Galilee, Jesus told them, “The Son of Man is about to be delivered into the hands of men.
ekegusii: Ekero basangererekanete Galili, Yeso akabateebia, “Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto ngochia are kobekwa ase amaboko y’ abanto.
swahili: Siku moja walipokuwa pamoja huko Galilaya, Yesu akawaambia, “Mwana wa Adamu atasalitiwa na kutiwa mikononi mwa watu.

english: They will kill Him, and on the third day He will be raised to life.” And the disciples were deeply grieved. The Temple Tax
ekegusii: Barabwo inabamoite, ne rituko ria gatato nabooke.” Bagaichana mono. Yeso ogoakana ebango ye Hekalu
swahili: Nao watamuua, lakini siku ya tatu atafufuliwa.” Wanafunzi wakahuzunika sana. Yesu Na Petro Watoa Kodi Ya Hekalu

english: After they had arrived in Capernaum, the collectors of the two-drachma tax came to Peter and asked, “Does your Teacher pay the two drachmas?”
ekegusii: Kobaikire Kapernaumu, abaare korusia ebango ye Hekalu bagachiera Petero, bakamobooria, “Inee! Omworokia oino nkorua are ebango?”
swahili: Baada ya Yesu na wanafunzi wake kufika Kapernaumu, wakusanya kodi ya Hekalu wakamjia Petro na kumuuliza, “Je, Mwalimu wenu halipi kodi ya Hekalu?”

english: “Yes,” he answered. When Peter entered the house, Jesus preempted him. “What do you think, Simon?” He asked. “From whom do the kings of the earth collect customs and taxes: from their own sons, or from others?”
ekegusii: Akabairaneria, “Ee, nkorua are.” Goika agasoa nyomba, Yeso agatang’ana gokwana na Petero, akamobooria, “Inki okorengereria Simioni? Nase ng’o abarwoti b’ense bakorusia ebango n’echoogo? Nkorwa ase abana babo, gose nase abanto bande?”
swahili: Petro akajibu, “Ndiyo, yeye hulipa.” Petro aliporudi nyumbani, Yesu akawa wa kwanza kulizungumzia, akamuuliza, “Unaonaje Simoni? Wafalme wa dunia hupokea ushuru na kodi kutoka kwa nani? Je, ni kutoka kwa watoto wao au kutoka kwa watu wengine?”

english: “From others,” Peter answered. “Then the sons are exempt,” Jesus declared.
ekegusii: Na ekero Petero amoiraneria, “Nkorwa ase abande,” Yeso akamoteebia, “Rirorio abana babo barabwo nabasibore.
swahili: Petro akamjibu, “Kutoka kwa watu wengine.” Yesu akamwambia, “Kwa hiyo watoto wao wamesamehewa.

english: “But so that we may not offend them, go to the sea, cast a hook, and take the first fish you catch. When you open its mouth, you will find a four-drachma coin. Take it and give it to them for My tax and yours.”
ekegusii: Korende titobaisa kobagechia, genda nyancha orute endobio na enswe eraache ritang’ani oyebwate; na ekero okoyiasamia omonwa oye norore egesamunye kiebesa kereo, okerusie, obae abwo ase engencho y’ane amo naye.”
swahili: Lakini ili tusije tukawaudhi, nenda baharini ukatupe ndoana. Mchukue samaki wa kwanza utakayemvua. Fungua kinywa chake nawe utakuta humo fedha, ichukue ukalipe kodi yako na yangu.”

english: Suddenly Moses and Elijah appeared before them, talking with Jesus.
ekegusii: Na rora, Musa na Elija bakabaorokera, bagakwana nere.
swahili: Ghafula wakawatokea mbele yao Mose na Eliya, wakizungumza na Yesu.

english: Peter said to Jesus, “Lord, it is good for us to be here. If You wish, I will put up three shelters —one for You, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.”
ekegusii: Petero agateebia Yeso, “Omonene, mbuya intwe koba aiga; onye ngwancha, ninkore aiga ebigutu bitato, ekemo ekiao, ekemo ekia Musa, na ekemo eki’Elija.”
swahili: Ndipo Petro akamwambia Yesu, “Bwana, ni vyema sisi tukae hapa. Ukitaka, nitafanya vibanda vitatu: kimoja chako, kingine cha Mose na kingine cha Eliya.”

english: While Peter was still speaking, a bright cloud enveloped them, and a voice from the cloud said, “This is My beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased. Listen to Him!”
ekegusii: Ekero arenge gokwana, rora, riire rirabu rikababisia, na eriogi rikarwa ase riire riria, rigateba, “Oyo n’Omwana one omwanchwa, ngokirie nere; moigwere ere.”
swahili: Petro alipokuwa angali ananena, ghafula wingu lililongʼaa likawafunika, na sauti ikatoka kwenye hilo wingu ikisema, “Huyu ni Mwanangu mpendwa. Ninapendezwa naye sana. Msikieni yeye.”

english: When the disciples heard this, they fell facedown in terror.
ekegusii: Ekero aborokigwa bachia koigwa aya, bakagwa inse maumama, bakabwatwa nomoondoko omonene.
swahili: Wanafunzi waliposikia haya, wakaanguka chini kifudifudi, wakajawa na hofu.

english: Then Jesus came over and touched them. “Get up,” He said. “Do not be afraid.”
ekegusii: Korende Yeso agacha akabakuna, akabora, “Imoka, timobaisa kwoboa.”
swahili: Lakini Yesu akaja na kuwagusa, akawaambia, “Inukeni na wala msiogope.”

english: And when they looked up, they saw no one except Jesus.
ekegusii: Ekero bachia koimokia amaiso abo, tibarora monto otatiga Yeso bweka.
swahili: Walipoinua macho yao, hawakumwona mtu mwingine yeyote isipokuwa Yesu.

english: As they were coming down the mountain, Jesus commanded them, “Do not tell anyone about this vision until the Son of Man has been raised from the dead.”
ekegusii: Kobagotirimboka korwa ase egetunwa, Yeso akabatianera, akabora, “Timoteebia monto onde okorora oko goika Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto aboke korwa ase abakuure.”
swahili: Walipokuwa wakishuka kutoka mlimani, Yesu akawaagiza, “Msimwambie mtu yeyote mambo mliyoyaona hapa, mpaka Mwana wa Adamu atakapofufuliwa kutoka kwa wafu.”

english: At that time the disciples came to Jesus and asked, “Who then is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven?”
ekegusii: Ase engaki eria aborokigwa bagaacha ase Yeso, bakamobooria, “Ning’o ore omonene kobua abande ase oborwoti bwa igoro?”
swahili: Wakati huo, wanafunzi wakamjia Yesu na kumuuliza, “Je, nani aliye mkuu kuliko wote katika Ufalme wa Mbinguni?”

english: See that you do not look down on any of these little ones. For I tell you that their angels in heaven always see the face of My Father in heaven.
ekegusii: “Rigereria, timobaisa gochaaya oyomo bw’aba abake; naki nabateebirie inwe, nonya nabamalaika babo igoro tibanagotiga korigereria obosio bwa Tata one ore igoro. [
swahili: “Angalia ili usimdharau mmojawapo wa hawa wadogo, kwa maana nawaambia, malaika wao mbinguni daima wanauona uso wa Baba yangu aliye mbinguni. [

english: What do you think? If a man has a hundred sheep and one of them goes astray, will he not leave the ninety-nine on the hills and go out to search for the one that is lost?
ekegusii: “Inki mokorengereria? Omonto obwate ching’ondi rigana erimo, na eyemo kerasire; Inee, tagotiga chiria emerongo kianda na kianda ase ebitunwa, achie korigia eria yasirire?
swahili: “Mwaonaje? Ikiwa mtu ana kondoo mia moja, na mmoja wao akapotea, je, hatawaacha wale tisini na tisa vilimani na kwenda kumtafuta huyo mmoja aliyepotea?

english: And if he finds it, truly I tell you, he rejoices more over that one sheep than over the ninety-nine that did not go astray.
ekegusii: Kayenyorire, nekeene nabateebirie: Nagoke ase eria kobua ase chiria emerongo kianda na kianda chitasirete.
swahili: Naye akishampata, amin, nawaambia, hufurahi zaidi kwa ajili ya huyo kondoo mmoja kuliko wale tisini na tisa ambao hawakupotea.

english: In the same way, your Father in heaven is not willing that any of these little ones should perish. A Brother Who Sins (Deuteronomy 19:15–21)
ekegusii: Naboigo, tari ogwancha gwa iso oino ore igoro ng’a oyomo bw’aba abake asire. Buna orakore ase oyomino okorire bobe (Luk 17:3)
swahili: Vivyo hivyo, Baba yenu wa mbinguni hapendi hata mmojawapo wa hawa wadogo apotee. Ndugu Yako Akikukosea

english: If your brother sins against you, go and confront him privately. If he listens to you, you have won your brother over.
ekegusii: “Oyomino karakore ebibe, genda omoteebie okomocha kwaye, aye nere, inwe mweka. Karagotegerere, igo kwamonyorire.
swahili: “Kama ndugu yako akikukosea, nenda ukamwonyeshe kosa lake, kati yenu ninyi wawili peke yenu. Kama akikusikiliza, utakuwa umempata tena ndugu yako.

english: But if he will not listen, take one or two others along, so that ‘every matter may be established by the testimony of two or three witnesses.’
ekegusii: Korende atagotegerereti, ira omonto oyomo, gose babere, mogende asare mwensi, ng’a kera ring’ana rinyare gwancheranwa ase oborori bwa babere gose batato.
swahili: Lakini kama hatakusikiliza, nenda na mtu mwingine mmoja au wawili ili kila neno lithibitishwe kwa ushahidi wa mashahidi wawili au watatu.

english: If he refuses to listen to them, tell it to the church. And if he refuses to listen even to the church, regard him as you would a pagan or a tax collector.
ekegusii: Ere atabategerereti abwo, teebia ekanisa; naende ataigwereti ekanisa nero, ase ore aye tiga abe buna omonto bw’ense, na buna omorusia ebango.
swahili: Kama akikataa kuwasikiliza hao, liambie kanisa. Naye kama akikataa hata kulisikiliza kanisa, basi awe kwenu kama mtu asiyeamini au mtoza ushuru.

english: Truly I tell you, whatever you bind on earth will be bound in heaven, and whatever you loose on earth will be loosed in heaven. Ask in My Name (John 16:23–33)
ekegusii: Nekeene nabateebirie: Ande onsi morasibe ase ense, nabe asibirwe na igoro; na ande onsi morasibore ase ense, nabe asiboirwe na igoro. Ogosaba kw’obomo
swahili: “Amin, nawaambia, lolote mtakalolifunga duniani litakuwa limefungwa mbinguni, na lolote mtakalolifungua duniani litakuwa limefunguliwa mbinguni.

english: Again, I tell you truly that if two of you on the earth agree about anything you ask for, it will be done for you by My Father in heaven.
ekegusii: “Naende nabateebirie: Onye babere ase more bagwancherana ase ense igoro yering’ana rinde rionsi barasabe, inabakorerwe rirorio na Tata one ore igoro.
swahili: “Tena nawaambia, ikiwa wawili wenu watakubaliana duniani kuhusu jambo lolote watakaloomba, watafanyiwa na Baba yangu aliye mbinguni.

english: Jesus invited a little child to stand among them.
ekegusii: Akarangeria omwana, akamobeka gati‐gati yaabo,
swahili: Yesu akamwita mtoto mdogo na kumsimamisha katikati yao.

english: For where two or three gather together in My name, there am I with them.” The Unforgiving Servant (Romans 12:14–21)
ekegusii: Inaki ase bare babere gose batato basangererekanire ase erieta riane, nainche nao inde agwo gati‐gati yabo.” Omobayeeno bw’omosomba otari koiraneria ng’a mbuya mono (Luk 17:4)
swahili: Kwa kuwa wanapokusanyika pamoja watu wawili au watatu kwa Jina langu, mimi niko papo hapo pamoja nao.” Kusamehe

english: Then Peter came to Jesus and asked, “Lord, how many times shall I forgive my brother who sins against me? Up to seven times?”
ekegusii: Erio Petero agacha, akamobooria, “Omonene, ng’ara karenga oyominto arankorere bobe, na inche ’mwabere? Ngoika chintunda isano na ibere gose?”
swahili: Ndipo Petro akamjia Yesu na kumuuliza, “Bwana, ndugu yangu anikosee mara ngapi nami nimsamehe? Je, hata mara saba?”

english: Jesus answered, “I tell you, not just seven times, but seventy-seven times!
ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Tindi goteeba omwabere chintunda isano na ibere, mwabere nonya ne chintunda isano na ibere ara emerongo etano n’ebere.
swahili: Yesu akamjibu, “Sikuambii hata mara saba, bali hata saba mara sabini. Mfano Wa Mtumishi Asiyesamehe

english: Because of this, the kingdom of heaven is like a king who wanted to settle accounts with his servants.
ekegusii: “Ase ayio, oborwoti bwa igoro nigo bogwekaine nomorwoti origetie gokora omobaro bw’abasomba baye.
swahili: “Kwa hiyo Ufalme wa Mbinguni unaweza kufananishwa na mfalme aliyetaka kufanya hesabu zake za fedha na watumishi wake.

english: As he began the settlements, a debtor was brought to him owing ten thousand talents.
ekegusii: Ekero achaakire gokora omobaro akarenterwa omosomba oyomo omoriete chitalanta chilifu ikomi.
swahili: Alipoanza kufanya hesabu zake, mtu mmoja aliyekuwa anadaiwa talanta 10,000, aliletwa kwake.

english: Since the man was unable to pay, the master ordered that he be sold to pay his debt, along with his wife and children and everything he owned.
ekegusii: Ekero asinyetwe goakana, omonene oye agachiika aoonigwe, ere na mokaye, na abana baye, na ebi abwate bionsi, na esiira eria eakanwe.
swahili: Kwa kuwa alikuwa hawezi kulipa deni hilo, bwana wake akaamuru kwamba auzwe, yeye, mkewe, watoto wake na vyote alivyokuwa navyo, ili lile deni lipate kulipwa.

english: Then the servant fell on his knees before him. ‘Have patience with me,’ he begged, ‘and I will pay back everything.’
ekegusii: Omosomba oria akagwa inse, akamosorora, agateeba: Omonene one, ing’ira ng’ora, na inche ningoakane bionsi.
swahili: “Yule mtumishi akampigia magoti, akamsihi yule bwana akisema, ‘Naomba univumilie, nami nitakulipa deni lako lote.’

english: His master had compassion on him, forgave his debt, and released him.
ekegusii: Omonene bw’omosomba oria agasogwa namaabera, akamosibora, akamwabera ase esiira yaye.
swahili: Yule bwana wa huyo mtumishi akamwonea huruma, akafuta deni lake lote, akamwacha aende zake.

english: But when that servant went out, he found one of his fellow servants who owed him a hundred denarii. He grabbed him and began to choke him, saying, ‘Pay back what you owe me!’
ekegusii: Korende omosomba oyio, ekero achia korua aroro, akarora ase abasomba bande oyomo omoriete chidinari rigana erimo, akamobwata ebigoti, akabora: Ng’akane ebi kwariete.
swahili: “Lakini yule mtumishi alipokuwa anatoka nje, akakutana na mtumishi mwenzake aliyekuwa amemkopesha dinari mia moja. Akamkamata, akamkaba koo akimwambia, ‘Nilipe kile ninachokudai!’

english: So his fellow servant fell down and begged him, ‘Have patience with me, and I will pay you back.’
ekegusii: Omosomba oria agatung’ama inse, akamosorora, agateeba: Ing’ira ng’ora, na inche ningoakane.
swahili: “Yule mtumishi mwenzake akapiga magoti akamsihi akisema, ‘Naomba univumilie, nami nitakulipa deni lako lote.’

english: “Truly I tell you,” He said, “unless you change and become like little children, you will never enter the kingdom of heaven.
ekegusii: akabora, “Ekeene nabateebirie: Motaonchogeti mobe buna omwana, timogosoa ase oborwoti bwa igoro nonya ng’ake.
swahili: Naye akasema: “Amin, nawaambia, msipookoka na kuwa kama watoto wadogo, kamwe hamtaingia katika Ufalme wa Mbinguni.

english: But he refused. Instead, he went and had the man thrown into prison until he could pay his debt.
ekegusii: Akanga, agachia akamoruta echela ime goika aakane esira eria.
swahili: “Lakini akakataa. Badala yake, alienda akamtupa gerezani hata atakapolipa hilo deni.

english: When his fellow servants saw what had happened, they were greatly distressed, and they went and recounted all of this to their master.
ekegusii: Ekero abasomba bande bachia korora aya akoreka, bagaichana mono, bakagenda, bagateebia omonene obo onsi ayakorekire.
swahili: Watumishi wenzake walipoona haya yaliyotukia wakaudhika sana, nao wakaenda na kumwambia bwana wao kila kitu kilichokuwa kimetukia.

english: Then the master summoned him and declared, ‘You wicked servant! I forgave all your debt because you begged me.
ekegusii: Erio omonene oye akamorangeria, akamoteebia: Aye omosomba omobe! Inche ngakwabera esira yonsi, ekiagera gwansororete.
swahili: “Yule bwana akamwita yule mtumishi akamwambia, ‘Wewe mtumishi mwovu! Mimi nilikusamehe deni lako lote uliponisihi.

english: Shouldn’t you have had mercy on your fellow servant, just as I had on you?’
ekegusii: Inee! Aye tikwagwenerete kwabera omosomba oria onde, buna nainche nakwaberete?
swahili: Je, haikukupasa kumhurumia mtumishi mwenzako kama mimi nilivyokuhurumia wewe?’

english: In anger his master turned him over to the jailers to be tortured, until he should repay all that he owed.
ekegusii: Omonene oye akabea mono, akamobeka ase abarendi b’echela, goika aakane ebi ariete bionsi.
swahili: Kwa hasira, yule bwana wake akamtia yule mtumishi mikononi mwa askari wa gereza ili ateswe mpaka atakapolipa yote aliyokuwa anadaiwa.

english: That is how My heavenly Father will treat each of you unless you forgive your brother from your heart.”
ekegusii: Naboigo na Tata one ore igoro arabakorere nainwe, onye timokwabera abamino ase chinkoro chiaino ime.”
swahili: “Hivi ndivyo Baba yangu wa mbinguni atakavyomfanyia kila mmoja wenu ikiwa hatamsamehe ndugu yake kutoka moyoni mwake.”

english: Therefore, whoever humbles himself like this little child is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven.
ekegusii: Gaki, onde bwensi oyo orekeyie omonyene koba buna omwana oyo, oyio nere ore omonene kobua abande ase oborwoti bwa igoro.
swahili: Kwa hiyo mtu yeyote anyenyekeaye kama huyu mtoto, ndiye aliye mkuu kuliko wote katika Ufalme wa Mbinguni.

english: And whoever welcomes a little child like this in My name welcomes Me. Temptations and Trespasses (Mark 9:42–48; Luke 17:1–4)
ekegusii: “Onde bwensi oraariganie omwana oyomo buna oyo ase erieta riane, oyio onyariganirie inche. Ogotemwa gokora ebibe (Mar 9:42-48; Luk 17:1-2)
swahili: “Yeyote amkaribishaye mtoto mdogo kama huyu kwa Jina langu, anikaribisha mimi.

english: But if anyone causes one of these little ones who believe in Me to stumble, it would be better for him to have a large millstone hung around his neck and to be drowned in the depths of the sea.
ekegusii: “Onde bwensi oramochere oyomo bw’aba abake, abanyegenete, anga mbuya kobua ase omonto oria asungerwe orogena rogosia ase rigoti riaye, arutwe ase endiba y’enyancha.
swahili: Lakini kama mtu yeyote akimsababisha mmojawapo wa hawa wadogo wanaoniamini kutenda dhambi, ingekuwa bora kwake afungiwe jiwe kubwa la kusagia shingoni mwake, na kutoswa katika kilindi cha bahari. Kujaribiwa Ili Kutenda Dhambi (Marko 9:42-48; Luka 17:1-2)

english: Woe to the world for the causes of sin. These stumbling blocks must come, but woe to the man through whom they come!
ekegusii: “Obobe nobw’ense ase engencho y’amateemwa ayakorenta ebibe! Inaki amateemwa takomocha kobao, korende obobe nobwaye omonto oyio okorenta ogoteemwa!
swahili: “Ole kwa ulimwengu kwa sababu ya yale mambo yanayosababisha watu kutenda dhambi! Mambo hayo lazima yawepo, lakini ole wake mtu yule ambaye huyasababisha.

english: If your hand or your foot causes you to sin, cut it off and throw it away. It is better for you to enter life crippled or lame than to have two hands and two feet and be thrown into the eternal fire.
ekegusii: Na onye okoboko kwao gokogera okore ebibe, gose nokogoro kwao, konache, ogotugute are; mbuya ase ore osoe ase obogima kore omonungu, gose egesegora, kobua koba namaboko abere, na amagoro abere, na gotugutwa ase omorero o kare na kare.
swahili: Ikiwa mkono wako au mguu wako unakusababisha utende dhambi, ukate na uutupe mbali. Ni afadhali kwako kuingia katika uzima ukiwa huna mkono mmoja au mguu mmoja, kuliko kuwa na mikono miwili au miguu miwili, na kutupwa katika moto wa milele.

english: And if your eye causes you to sin, gouge it out and throw it away. It is better for you to enter life with one eye than to have two eyes and be thrown into the fire of hell. The Parable of the Lost Sheep (Luke 15:1–7)
ekegusii: Onye neriso riao rikogera okore ebibe, orirusie, oritugute are; mbuya ase ore osoe ase obogima kore egetong’o kobua koba namaiso abere na gotugutwa ase omorero o kare na kare.
swahili: Nalo jicho lako likikusababisha kutenda dhambi, lingʼoe, ulitupe mbali. Ni afadhali kwako kuingia katika uzima ukiwa na jicho moja, kuliko kuwa na macho mawili lakini ukatupwa katika moto wa jehanamu. Mfano Wa Kondoo Aliyepotea (Luka 15:3-7)

english: When Jesus had finished saying these things, He left Galilee and went into the region of Judea beyond the Jordan.
ekegusii: Ekero Yeso achia gokoora gokwana amang’ana ayio, akarua Galili, agasoa ensemo ya Boyahudi ng’umbu ya Yorodani;
swahili: Yesu alipomaliza kusema maneno haya, aliondoka Galilaya, akaenda sehemu za Uyahudi, ngʼambo ya Mto Yordani.

english: His disciples said to Him, “If this is the case between a man and his wife, it is better not to marry.”
ekegusii: Aborokigwa bakamoteebia, “Amang’ana igoro y’omonto na mok’aye k’arabe engencho eye, tegwenereti konywoma.”
swahili: Wanafunzi wake wakamwambia, “Kama hali ndiyo hii kati ya mume na mke, ni afadhali mtu asioe!”

english: “Not everyone can accept this word,” He replied, “but only those to whom it has been given.
ekegusii: Korende akabateebia, “Tari bonsi baranyare gwancha ring’ana eri, otatiga abwo baeirwe.
swahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Si watu wote wanaoweza kupokea neno hili, isipokuwa wale tu waliojaliwa na Mungu.

english: For there are eunuchs who were born that way; others were made that way by men; and still others live like eunuchs for the sake of the kingdom of heaven. The one who can accept this should accept it.” Jesus Blesses the Children (Mark 10:13–16; Luke 18:15–17)
ekegusii: Inaki mbare abagomba abaiboretwe bo, naende mbare abagomba aba abanto bagombaetie, naende mbare abagomba abekorete abanyene koba abagomba ase engencho y’oborwoti bwa igoro. Oyoranyare gwancha ring’ana eri, tiga arianche.” Yeso ogosesenia abana abake (Mar 10:13-16; Luk 18:15-17)
swahili: Kwa maana wengine ni matowashi kwa sababu wamezaliwa hivyo; wengine wamefanywa matowashi na wanadamu; na wengine wamejifanya matowashi kwa ajili ya Ufalme wa Mbinguni. Yeye awezaye kulipokea neno hili na alipokee.” Yesu Awabariki Watoto Wadogo (Marko 10:13-16; Luka 18:15-17)

english: Then the little children were brought to Jesus for Him to place His hands on them and pray for them. And the disciples rebuked those who brought them.
ekegusii: Erio abana abake bakarentwa ase Yeso, erinde ababeekere amaboko aye na kobasabera. Aborokigwa baye bagatanga abanto,
swahili: Kisha watoto wadogo wakaletwa kwa Yesu ili aweke mikono yake juu yao na awaombee. Lakini wanafunzi wake wakawakemea wale waliowaleta.

english: But Jesus said, “Let the little children come to Me, and do not hinder them! For the kingdom of heaven belongs to such as these.”
ekegusii: korende Yeso agateeba, “Batige abana bache ase ’nde, timobaisa kobatanga, ekiagera abare buna aba, oborwoti bwa igoro n’obwabo.”
swahili: Yesu akasema, “Waacheni watoto wadogo waje kwangu, wala msiwazuie, kwa maana Ufalme wa Mbinguni ni wa wale walio kama hawa.”

english: And after He had placed His hands on them, He went on from there. The Rich Young Man (Mark 10:17–31; Luke 18:18–30)
ekegusii: Akababeekera amaboko aye, akaimoka korwa aroro, akagenda. Omomura omonda (Mar 10:17-22; Luk 18:18-23)
swahili: Naye akaweka mikono yake juu yao, na akaondoka huko. Kijana Tajiri (Marko 10:17-31; Luka 18:18-30)

english: Just then a man came up to Jesus and inquired, “Teacher, what good thing must I do to obtain eternal life?”
ekegusii: Na rora, omonto oyomo akamochiera, akamobooria, “Omworokia ’mboseera ki ndakore ’nyore obogima bwa kare na kare?”
swahili: Mtu mmoja akamjia Yesu na kumuuliza, “Mwalimu mwema, nifanye jambo gani jema ili nipate uzima wa milele?”

english: “Why do you ask Me about what is good?” Jesus replied. “There is only One who is good. If you want to enter life, keep the commandments.”
ekegusii: Akamoteebia, “Nase ki okomboria ninki kere ekiya? Nareo oyomo bweka oyore omuya. Onye korigetie gosoa ase obogima, bwata amachiiko.”
swahili: Yesu akamjibu, “Mbona unaniuliza habari ya mema? Aliye mwema ni Mmoja tu. Lakini ukitaka kuingia uzimani, zitii amri.”

english: “Which ones?” the man asked. Jesus answered, “‘Do not murder, do not commit adultery, do not steal, do not bear false witness,
ekegusii: Akamoboria, “Ayare buna arari?” Yeso akamoiraneria, “Toita, Totomana, Toiba, Toteba oborimo,
swahili: Yule mtu akamuuliza, “Amri zipi?” Yesu akamjibu, “Usiue, usizini, usiibe, usishuhudie uongo,

english: honor your father and mother, and love your neighbor as yourself.’ ”
ekegusii: sika iso na nyoko; naende: Ancha omogisangio oo buna bweanchete.”
swahili: waheshimu baba yako na mama yako, na umpende jirani yako kama nafsi yako.”

english: Large crowds followed Him, and He healed them there.
ekegusii: na emeganda emenene ekamotunyana, akabagwenia aroro.
swahili: Umati mkubwa wa watu ukamfuata, naye akawaponya huko.

english: “All these I have kept,” said the young man. “What do I still lack?”
ekegusii: Omomura oria akamoteebia, “Ayio onsi nayabwatire; ing’ana ki rimochete?”
swahili: Yule kijana akasema, “Hizi zote nimezishika. Je, bado nimepungukiwa na nini?”

english: Jesus told him, “If you want to be perfect, go, sell your possessions and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven. Then come, follow Me.”
ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Onye korigetie koba omoikeranu, gachie, oonie ebio ore nabio bionsi, oe abataka, na aye n’obe neniibo igoro; erio oche ontunyane.”
swahili: Yesu akamwambia, “Kama ukitaka kuwa mkamilifu, nenda, ukauze vitu vyote ulivyo navyo, na hizo fedha uwape maskini, nawe utakuwa na hazina mbinguni. Kisha njoo, unifuate.”

english: When the young man heard this, he went away in sorrow, because he had great wealth.
ekegusii: Ekero achia koigwa ring’ana riria, omomura oria akagenda nobororo, ekiagera arenge neniibo enyinge.
swahili: Yule kijana aliposikia hayo, akaenda zake kwa huzuni, kwa sababu alikuwa na mali nyingi. Hatari Za Utajiri

english: Then Jesus said to His disciples, “Truly I tell you, it is hard for a rich man to enter the kingdom of heaven.
ekegusii: Erio Yeso agateebia aborokigwa baye, “Nekeene nabateebirie: Nabe aakong’u ase omonto omonda gosoa ase oborwoti bwa igoro.
swahili: Ndipo Yesu akawaambia wanafunzi wake, “Amin, nawaambia, itakuwa vigumu kwa mtu tajiri kuingia katika Ufalme wa Mbinguni.

english: Again I tell you, it is easier for a camel to pass through the eye of a needle than for a rich man to enter the kingdom of God.”
ekegusii: Naende nabateebirie inwe, naororo engamia goeta ase ekebao gi’esindani, kobua omonto omonda gosoa ase oborwoti bwa Nyasae.”
swahili: Tena nawaambia, ni rahisi zaidi kwa ngamia kupita kwenye tundu la sindano kuliko mtu tajiri kuingia katika Ufalme wa Mungu.”

english: When the disciples heard this, they were greatly astonished and asked, “Who then can be saved?”
ekegusii: Ekero aborokigwa bachia koigwa aya, bagakumia mono, bagateeba, “Ning’o rende oranyare gotooreka?”
