swahili: Wanafunzi wake waliposikia haya, walishangaa sana na kuuliza, “Ni nani basi awezaye kuokoka?”

english: Jesus looked at them and said, “With man this is impossible, but with God all things are possible.”
ekegusii: Korende Yeso akabarigereria, akabateebia, “Aya takonyarekana ase Mwanyabaanto, korende ase Nyasae onsi nigo akonyarekana.”
swahili: Lakini Yesu akawatazama, akawaambia, “Kwa mwanadamu jambo hili haliwezekani, lakini mambo yote yanawezekana kwa Mungu.”

english: “Look,” Peter replied, “we have left everything to follow You. What then will there be for us?”
ekegusii: Erio Petero akamoiraneria, “Rora, intwe twatigire bionsi, twagotunyanire, inki rende toranyore?”
swahili: Ndipo Petro akamjibu, “Tazama, sisi tumeacha kila kitu na kukufuata! Tutapata nini basi?”

english: Jesus said to them, “Truly I tell you, in the renewal of all things, when the Son of Man sits on His glorious throne, you who have followed Me will also sit on twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.
ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Nekeene nabateebirie: Ase ense enyia, ekero Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto agochi‐gocha gaikaransete ase ekerogo kiaye ki’obonene, inwe abamwantunyanire inamoche goikaransera ebirogo bi’obonene ikomi na bibere, mokogaambera ebisaku ikomi na bibere bi’Abaisraeli.
swahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Amin, nawaambia, wakati wa kufanywa upya vitu vyote, Mwana wa Adamu atakapoketi kwenye kiti chake kitukufu cha enzi, ninyi mlionifuata pia mtaketi katika viti vya enzi kumi na viwili, mkiyahukumu makabila kumi na mawili ya Israeli.

english: And everyone who has left houses or brothers or sisters or father or mother or wife or children or fields for the sake of My name will receive a hundredfold and will inherit eternal life.
ekegusii: Na onde bwensi otigete chinyomba, gose bamura bamwabo, gose basubati bamwabo, gose ise, gose ng’ina, gose abana, gose emegondo ase engencho y’erieta riane, namenteranigwe ara rigana, na obogima bwa kare na kare nabonyore.
swahili: Kila mtu aliyeacha nyumba, au ndugu zake wa kiume au wa kike, baba au mama, watoto au mashamba kwa ajili yangu, atapokea mara mia zaidi ya hayo, na ataurithi uzima wa milele.

english: Then some Pharisees came and tested Him by asking, “Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife for any reason?”
ekegusii: Abafarisai bakamochiera, bakamoteema ase okomoboria, “Inee! Mboronge omonto atige mok’aye ase ring’ana rinde rionsi?”
swahili: Baadhi ya Mafarisayo wakamjia ili kumjaribu, wakamuuliza, “Ni halali mtu kumwacha mke wake kwa sababu yoyote?”

english: But many who are first will be last, and the last will be first.
ekegusii: Korende abange abare ab’eritang’ani inababe abamagega, na abamagega inababe ab’eritang’ani.
swahili: Lakini wengi walio wa kwanza watakuwa wa mwisho, na walio wa mwisho watakuwa wa kwanza.

english: Jesus answered, “Have you not read that from the beginning the Creator ‘made them male and female,’
ekegusii: Akabairaneria, “Timwana gosoma buna ere oyobatongete korwa omochakano, nere obatongete omosacha na omokungu,
swahili: Akawajibu, “Je, hamkusoma kwamba hapo mwanzo Muumba aliwaumba mwanaume na mwanamke,

english: and said, ‘For this reason a man will leave his father and mother and be united to his wife, and the two will become one flesh’?
ekegusii: agateeba: Ase engencho eyio omonto natige ise na ng’ina, abwatane na mok’aye, na abwo babere nigo barabe omobere oyomo?
swahili: naye akasema, ‘Kwa sababu hii mwanaume atamwacha baba yake na mama yake, naye ataambatana na mkewe, na hao wawili watakuwa mwili mmoja’?

english: So they are no longer two, but one flesh. Therefore what God has joined together, let man not separate.”
ekegusii: Ase igo tibakoba babere naende, korende omobere oyomo. Naboigo, ebi Nyasae abwatanirie, Mwanyabaanto tabiatanana.”
swahili: Hivyo si wawili tena, bali mwili mmoja. Kwa hiyo alichokiunganisha Mungu, mwanadamu asikitenganishe.”

english: “Why then,” they asked, “did Moses order a man to give his wife a certificate of divorce and send her away? ”
ekegusii: Bakamobooria, “Nase ki rende Musa achiigete komoa omokungu riruube ri’ogotigana, na komotiga?”
swahili: Wakamuuliza, “Kwa nini basi Mose aliagiza mtu kumpa mkewe hati ya talaka na kumwacha?”

english: Jesus replied, “Moses permitted you to divorce your wives because of your hardness of heart; but it was not this way from the beginning.
ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Nase engencho y’obokong’u bwe chinkoro chiaino Musa abaete ribaga gotiga abakungu baino, korende ayio tarenge bo korwa omochakano.
swahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Mose aliwaruhusu kuwaacha wake zenu kwa sababu ya ugumu wa mioyo yenu. Lakini tangu mwanzo haikuwa hivyo.

english: Now I tell you that whoever divorces his wife, except for sexual immorality, and marries another woman, commits adultery. ”
ekegusii: Korende inche nabateebirie, oyoratige mok’aye, otatiga ase engencho y’obotomani, na konyuoma oyonde, oyio otomanire; naende oy’oranyuome omokungu oyotigirwe, otomanire.”
swahili: Mimi nawaambia, yeyote amwachaye mkewe isipokuwa kwa sababu ya uasherati naye akaoa mke mwingine, anazini. Naye amwoaye yule mwanamke aliyeachwa pia anazini.”

english: This is the record of the genealogy of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham:
ekegusii: Oyo noro omoroberio bw’echisokoro chia Yeso Kristo korwa ase ororeria rwa Daudi, oyio orenge korwa ase ororeria rwa Aburaamu.
swahili: Habari za ukoo wa Yesu Kristo mwana wa Daudi, mwana wa Abrahamu:

english: Hezekiah was the father of Manasseh, Manasseh the father of Amon, Amon the father of Josiah,
ekegusii: na Hezekia akaibora Manase, na Manase akaibora Amoni, na Amoni akaibora Yosia,
swahili: Hezekia akamzaa Manase, Manase akamzaa Amoni, Amoni akamzaa Yosia,

english: and Josiah the father of Jeconiah and his brothers at the time of the exile to Babylon.
ekegusii: na Yosia akaibora Yekonia na abamwabo ase chingaki chiria Abaisraeli basakoretwe na kong’anyigwa gochia Babiloni.
swahili: wakati wa uhamisho wa Babeli, Yosia alimzaa Yekonia na ndugu zake.

english: After the exile to Babylon: Jeconiah was the father of Shealtiel, Shealtiel the father of Zerubbabel,
ekegusii: Na magega ko Abaisraeli basakoirwe na kong’anyigwa gochia Babiloni Yekonia akaibora Salatieli, na Salatieli akaibora Serubabeli,
swahili: Baada ya uhamisho wa Babeli: Yekonia alimzaa Shealtieli, Shealtieli akamzaa Zerubabeli,

english: Zerubbabel the father of Abiud, Abiud the father of Eliakim, and Eliakim the father of Azor.
ekegusii: na Serubabeli akaibora Abihudi, na Abihudi akaibora Eliakimu, na Eliakimu akaibora Azoro,
swahili: Zerubabeli akamzaa Abiudi, Abiudi akamzaa Eliakimu, Eliakimu akamzaa Azori,

english: Azor was the father of Zadok, Zadok the father of Achim, and Achim the father of Eliud.
ekegusii: na Azoro akaibora Zadoki, na Zadoki akaibora Akimu, na Akimu akaibora Eliudi,
swahili: Azori akamzaa Sadoki, Sadoki akamzaa Akimu, Akimu akamzaa Eliudi,

english: Eliud was the father of Eleazar, Eleazar the father of Matthan, Matthan the father of Jacob,
ekegusii: na Eliudi akaibora Eleazari, na Eleazari akaibora Matani, na Matani akaibora Yakobo,
swahili: Eliudi akamzaa Eleazari, Eleazari akamzaa Matani, Matani akamzaa Yakobo,

english: and Jacob the father of Joseph, the husband of Mary, of whom was born Jesus, who is called Christ.
ekegusii: na Yakobo akaibora Yusufu, omosacha o Mariamu oyo oiborete Yeso, oyio okorokwa Kristo.
swahili: naye Yakobo akamzaa Yosefu ambaye alikuwa mumewe Maria, mama yake Yesu, aitwaye Kristo.

english: In all, then, there were fourteen generations from Abraham to David, fourteen from David to the exile to Babylon, and fourteen from the exile to the Christ. The Birth of Jesus (Isaiah 7:10–16; Luke 2:1–7)
ekegusii: Na ebigori bionsi korwa Aburaamu goika Daudi nigo biarenge ebigori ikomi na bine: na korwa Daudi goika ogosakorwa na okong’anyigwa kwa Abaisraeli gochia Babiloni, n’ebigori ikomi na bine: na korwa ogosakorwa na okong’anyigwa kwa Abaisraeli gochia Babiloni goika Kristo, nebigori ikomi na bine. Okoiborwa kwa Yeso (Luk 2:1-7)
swahili: Hivyo, kulikuwepo na jumla ya vizazi kumi na vinne tangu Abrahamu mpaka Daudi, vizazi kumi na vinne tangu Daudi hadi wakati wa uhamisho kwenda utumwani Babeli, na vizazi kumi na vinne tangu wakati wa uhamisho kwenda utumwani Babeli hadi Kristo. Kuzaliwa Kwa Yesu Kristo (Luka 2:1-7)

english: This is how the birth of Jesus Christ came about: His mother Mary was pledged in marriage to Joseph, but before they came together, she was found to be with child through the Holy Spirit.
ekegusii: Okoiborwa kwa Yeso Kristo nigo kwarenge iga: Ekero Mariamu ng’ina konya ariereirwe boko na Yusufu, na konya bataramenyana buna omosacha n’omokuungu, Mariamu akarorekana ore morito ase chinguru chi’Omoika Omochenu.
swahili: Basi Kuzaliwa kwake Yesu Kristo kulikuwa hivi: Maria mama yake alikuwa ameposwa na Yosefu, lakini kabla hawajakutana kimwili, Maria alionekana kuwa na mimba kwa uweza wa Roho Mtakatifu.

english: Because Joseph her husband was a righteous man and was unwilling to disgrace her publicly, he resolved to divorce her quietly.
ekegusii: Yusufu nigo arenge omonto omooronge, na tarigetie komoa obosooku, maiso marore, ase igo akaroberia amotige bobisi.
swahili: Kwa kuwa Yosefu, mwanaume aliyekuwa amemposa alikuwa mtu mwadilifu, hakutaka kumwaibisha Maria hadharani, aliazimu kumwacha kwa siri.

english: Abraham was the father of Isaac, Isaac the father of Jacob, and Jacob the father of Judah and his brothers.
ekegusii: Korwa ase Aburaamu goika omorwoti Daudi akaibora Isaka, na Isaka akaibora Yakobo, na Yakobo akaibora Yuda na abamwabo,
swahili: Abrahamu akamzaa Isaki, Isaki akamzaa Yakobo, Yakobo akawazaa Yuda na ndugu zake,

english: But after he had pondered these things, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in a dream and said, “Joseph, son of David, do not be afraid to embrace Mary as your wife, for the One conceived in her is from the Holy Spirit.
ekegusii: Korende ekero arenge orengereretie aya, rora, omomalaika bw’Omonene akamochiera ase chindoto akamoteebia. “Aye Yusufu, korwa ase ororeria rwa Daudi, toiroka koira Mariamu abe mokao, ekiagera nigo abeire morito ase okobua kw’Omoika Omochenu.
swahili: Lakini mara alipoazimu kufanya jambo hili, malaika wa Bwana akamtokea katika ndoto na kusema, “Yosefu mwana wa Daudi, usiogope kumchukua Maria awe mke wako, kwa maana mimba aliyo nayo ni kwa uweza wa Roho Mtakatifu.

english: She will give birth to a Son, and you are to give Him the name Jesus, because He will save His people from their sins.”
ekegusii: Ere naibore omwana omoisia, nomoroke erieta riaye Yeso, ekiagera nere oratoorie abanto baye korwa ase ebibe biabo.”
swahili: Naye atamzaa mwana, nawe utamwita Jina lake Yesu, kwa maana yeye ndiye atakayewaokoa watu wake kutoka dhambi zao.”

english: All this took place to fulfill what the Lord had said through the prophet:
ekegusii: Aya onsi nigo abeire, erinde riikerane ring’ana riria riakwanetwe n’Omonene goetera ase omonwa bw’omobani:
swahili: Haya yote yalitukia ili litimie lile Bwana alilokuwa amenena kupitia nabii, akisema:

english: “Behold, the virgin will be with child and will give birth to a son, and they will call Him Immanuel” (which means, “God with us” ).
ekegusii: “Rigereria, omoiseke omwekungi nabe morito, erio aibore omwana omoisia, na erieta riaye narokwe Imanueli” (engencho yaye: Nyasae nare naintwe).
swahili: “Tazama, bikira atachukua mimba, naye atamzaa mwana, nao watamwita Jina lake Imanueli”: maana yake, “Mungu pamoja nasi.”

english: When Joseph woke up, he did as the angel of the Lord had commanded him, and embraced Mary as his wife.
ekegusii: Na Yusufu agachia kobooka korwa ase chitoro, akanywoma Mariam buna omomalaika bw’Omonene konya amoteebirie akore.
swahili: Yosefu alipoamka kutoka usingizini, akafanya kama vile alivyoagizwa na malaika wa Bwana, akamchukua Maria kuwa mke wake.

english: But he had no union with her until she gave birth to a Son. And he gave Him the name Jesus.
ekegusii: Korende konya tibaramanyana kemobere nyuma ataraibora omwana oye omoisia. Naende Yusufu akamoroka erieta riaye Yeso.
swahili: Lakini hawakukutana kimwili mpaka Maria alipojifungua mwanawe kifungua mimba akamwita Jina lake Yesu.

english: Judah was the father of Perez and Zerah by Tamar, Perez the father of Hezron, and Hezron the father of Ram.
ekegusii: na Yuda akaibora Peresu na Zera ase Tamari, na Peresu akaibora Hezironi, na Hezironi akaibora Aramu,
swahili: Yuda akawazaa Peresi na Zera, ambao mama yao alikuwa Tamari, Peresi akamzaa Hesroni, Hesroni akamzaa Aramu,

english: Ram was the father of Amminadab, Amminadab the father of Nahshon, and Nahshon the father of Salmon.
ekegusii: na Aramu akaibora Aminadabu, na Aminadabu akaibora Nashoni, na Nashoni akaibora Salimoni,
swahili: Aramu akamzaa Aminadabu, Aminadabu akamzaa Nashoni, Nashoni akamzaa Salmoni,

english: Salmon was the father of Boaz by Rahab, Boaz the father of Obed by Ruth, Obed the father of Jesse,
ekegusii: na Salimoni akaibora Boazi ase Rahabu, na Boazi akaibora Obedi ase Rutu, na Obedi akaibora Yese,
swahili: Salmoni akamzaa Boazi, na mama yake Boazi alikuwa Rahabu, Boazi akamzaa Obedi, ambaye mama yake alikuwa Ruthu, Obedi akamzaa Yese,

english: and Jesse the father of David the king. Next: David was the father of Solomon by Uriah’s wife,
ekegusii: na Yese akaibora omorwoti Daudi. Na Daudi akaibora Sulemani ase oyio orenge omokungu o Uria,
swahili: Yese akamzaa Daudi ambaye alikuwa mfalme. Daudi akamzaa Solomoni, ambaye mama yake ni yule aliyekuwa mke wa Uria.

english: Solomon the father of Rehoboam, Rehoboam the father of Abijah, and Abijah the father of Asa.
ekegusii: na Sulemani akaibora Rehoboamu, na Rehoboamu akaibora Abiya, na Abiya akaibora Asa,
swahili: Solomoni akamzaa Rehoboamu, Rehoboamu akamzaa Abiya, Abiya akamzaa Asa,

english: Asa was the father of Jehoshaphat, Jehoshaphat the father of Joram, and Joram the father of Uzziah.
ekegusii: na Asa akaibora Yehosafati, na Yehosafati akaibora Yoramu, na Yoramu akaibora Usia,
swahili: Asa akamzaa Yehoshafati, Yehoshafati akamzaa Yoramu, Yoramu akamzaa Uzia,

english: Uzziah was the father of Jotham, Jotham the father of Ahaz, and Ahaz the father of Hezekiah.
ekegusii: na Usia akaibora Yotamu na Yotamu akaibora Ahasi, na Ahasi akaibora Hezekia,
swahili: Uzia akamzaa Yothamu, Yothamu akamzaa Ahazi, Ahazi akamzaa Hezekia,

english: “For the kingdom of heaven is like a landowner who went out early in the morning to hire workers for his vineyard.
ekegusii: “Inaki oborwoti bwa igoro nigo bogwekaine n’omonto omonyene enyomba oyosoogete mambia chuni kogenda koriika abaremi ase omogondo oye bw’emesabibu.
swahili: “Kwa maana Ufalme wa Mbinguni unafanana na mtu mwenye shamba aliyetoka alfajiri ili kwenda kuajiri vibarua kufanya kazi katika shamba lake la mizabibu.

english: So when the original workers came, they assumed they would receive more. But each of them also received a denarius.
ekegusii: Bono ekero ab’eritang’ani bacha, bagakaga ng’a barabwo nabaegwe kobua abande, bakanyora nabarabwo kera oyomo edinari eyemo.
swahili: Hivyo wale walioajiriwa kwanza walipofika, walidhani watalipwa zaidi. Lakini kila mmoja wao pia alipokea dinari moja.

english: On receiving their pay, they began to grumble against the landowner.
ekegusii: Erio kabaeirwe, bakaba nkwemurungania bare ase omonyene enyomba,
swahili: Walipoipokea, wakaanza kulalamika dhidi ya yule mwenye shamba,

english: ‘These men who were hired last worked only one hour,’ they said, ‘and you have made them equal to us who have borne the burden and the scorching heat of the day.’
ekegusii: bakaboora: Abwo ba magega nigo bakora emeremo y’ensa eyemo yoka, na aye kwabatoreng’aneria naintwe abatwaremereretie emechando ne riberera ri’omobaso bwonsi?
swahili: wakisema, ‘Hawa watu walioajiriwa mwisho wamefanya kazi kwa muda wa saa moja tu, nawe umewafanya sawa na sisi ambao tumestahimili taabu na joto lote la mchana kutwa?’

english: But he answered one of them, ‘Friend, I am not being unfair to you. Did you not agree with me on one denarius?
ekegusii: Ere akairaneria oyomo obo: Omosani, tingokorereti bobe. Titwancheranete naye ase edinari eyemo?
swahili: “Yule mwenye shamba akamjibu mmoja wao, ‘Rafiki, sijakudhulumu. Je, hukukubaliana nami kwa ujira wa kawaida wa dinari moja?

english: Take your pay and go. I want to give this last man the same as I gave you.
ekegusii: Bwata ekere ekiao, ogende; nindigetie koa oyo o magega koreng’ana naye.
swahili: Chukua ujira wako na uende. Mimi nimeamua kumlipa huyu mtu aliyeajiriwa mwisho kama nilivyokupa wewe.

english: Do I not have the right to do as I please with what is mine? Or are you envious because I am generous?’
ekegusii: Inee! Tindi neribaga gokora buna ndigetie omonyene n’ebinto biane? Gose naki okorigereria neriso riibe, ekiagera inche inde omuya?
swahili: Je, sina haki yangu kufanya kile nitakacho na mali yangu mwenyewe? Au unaona wivu kwa kuwa nimekuwa mkarimu?’

english: So the last will be first, and the first will be last.” The Third Prediction of the Passion (Mark 10:32–34; Luke 18:31–34)
ekegusii: Naboigo abamagega inababe ab’eritang’ani, na ab’eritang’ani inababe abamagega.” Yeso ogokwana eriagatato igoro y’ogokwa kwaye (Mar 10:32-34; Luk 18:31-34)
swahili: “Vivyo hivyo, wa mwisho watakuwa wa kwanza, na wa kwanza watakuwa wa mwisho.” Yesu Atabiri Tena Kuhusu Kifo Chake (Marko 10:32-34; Luka 18:31-34)

english: As Jesus was going up to Jerusalem, He took the twelve disciples aside and said,
ekegusii: Nabo, ekero Yeso arenge gotiira gochia Yerusalemu, akabaira aborokigwa baye ikomi na babere ensemo.
swahili: Basi Yesu alipokuwa anapanda kwenda Yerusalemu, aliwachukua kando wale wanafunzi wake kumi na wawili na kuwaambia,

english: “Look, we are going up to Jerusalem, and the Son of Man will be delivered over to the chief priests and scribes. They will condemn Him to death
ekegusii: Kobare inchera, akabateebia, “Rora, ngotiira tore gochia Yerusalemu, na Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto naruugwe ase amaboko y’abakuani abanene na aborokia b’amariiko, na barabwo ’nabamonachere ekiina ki’ogokwa,
swahili: “Tunapanda kwenda Yerusalemu, na Mwana wa Adamu atatiwa mikononi mwa viongozi wa makuhani na walimu wa sheria. Nao watamhukumu kifo

english: and will deliver Him over to the Gentiles to be mocked and flogged and crucified. And on the third day He will be raised to life.” A Mother’s Request (Mark 10:35–45)
ekegusii: naende nabamorue ase amaboko y’ abanto b’Ebisaku; nakorerwe echeche, naende naakwe emecharichi na kobambwa; na ase rituko ria gatato nabokigwe.” Okoboria koegwa ogosika gw’ense eye (Mar 10:35-40)
swahili: na kumtia mikononi mwa watu wa Mataifa ili wamdhihaki na kumpiga mijeledi na kumsulubisha msalabani. Naye atafufuliwa siku ya tatu!” Ombi La Mama Yake Yakobo Na Yohana (Marko 10:35-45)

english: He agreed to pay them a denarius for the day and sent them into his vineyard.
ekegusii: Agancherana nabaremi kobaakana edinari eyemo ase rituko, erio akabaira ase omogondo oye bw’emesabibu.
swahili: Baada ya kukubaliana na hao vibarua kuwalipa ujira wa dinari moja kwa siku, akawapeleka kwenye shamba lake la mizabibu.

english: Then the mother of Zebedee’s sons came to Jesus with her sons and knelt down to make a request of Him.
ekegusii: Erio ng’ina abana ba Zebedi akamochiera Yeso amo nabana baye, akamotung’amera na komosaba ring’ana.
swahili: Kisha mama yao wana wa Zebedayo akamjia Yesu pamoja na wanawe, naye akapiga magoti mbele yake, akamwomba Yesu amfanyie jambo fulani.

english: “What do you want?” He inquired. She answered, “Declare that in Your kingdom one of these two sons of mine may sit at Your right hand, and the other at Your left.”
ekegusii: Yeso akamobooria, “Inki origetie?” Akamoiraneria, “Chiika ng’a abana bane babere baikaranse, oyomo ensemo y’okoboko kwao gw’okorio, n’oyonde ensemo y’okoboko kwao gw’okobee ase oborwoti bwao.”
swahili: Yesu akamuuliza, “Unataka nini?” Akajibu, “Tafadhali, wajalie wanangu hawa ili mmoja aketi upande wako wa kuume, na mwingine upande wako wa kushoto katika Ufalme wako.”

english: “You do not know what you are asking,” Jesus replied. “Can you drink the cup I am going to drink?” “We can,” the brothers answered.
ekegusii: Yeso akairaneria, “Inwe timomanyeti eri mogosaba. Inee! Namonyare konywera egekombe ’ndache konywera inche?” Bakamoteebia, “Natonyare.”
swahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Ninyi hamjui mnaloliomba. Je, mnaweza kukinywea kikombe nitakachonywea mimi?” Wakajibu, “Tunaweza.”

english: “You will indeed drink My cup,” Jesus said. “But to sit at My right or left is not Mine to grant. These seats belong to those for whom My Father has prepared them.”
ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Egekombe ’nkonywera inche, namokenywere, korende ribaga ri’ogoikaransa ensemo y’okoboko kwane gw’okorio ney’okobee, tindi nokobua gw’okobaa, otatiga abwo bagacheire na Tata one nabwo barariegwe.” Obonene bw’ekeene (Mar 10:41-45)
swahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Kwa kweli kikombe changu mtakinywea, lakini kuketi upande wangu wa kuume au wa kushoto si langu mimi kuwapa. Nafasi hizo ni za wale ambao wameandaliwa na Baba yangu.”

english: When the ten heard about this, they were indignant with the two brothers.
ekegusii: Ekero baria ikomi bachia koigwa aya, bakababea abamura baria babere.
swahili: Wale wanafunzi wengine kumi waliposikia haya, waliwakasirikia hao ndugu wawili.

english: But Jesus called them aside and said, “You know that the rulers of the Gentiles lord it over them, and their superiors exercise authority over them.
ekegusii: Korende Yeso akabarangeria bache asare, akabora, “Mwamanyire ng’a abagaambi b’Ebisaku bakogaambera abanto, na abanene babo nigo bare n’okobua igoro ase bare.
swahili: Lakini Yesu akawaita wote pamoja na kuwaambia, “Mnafahamu kuwa watawala wa watu wa Mataifa huwatawala kwa nguvu, nao wenye vyeo huonyesha mamlaka yao.

english: It shall not be this way among you. Instead, whoever wants to become great among you must be your servant,
ekegusii: Korende ase more inwe, ayio takoba bo. Korende, oyorarigie koba omonene ase more, goika abe omokoreri oino;
swahili: Isiwe hivyo kwenu. Badala yake, yeyote anayetaka kuwa mkuu miongoni mwenu hana budi kuwa mtumishi wenu,

english: and whoever wants to be first among you must be your slave—
ekegusii: na oyorarigie koba omotang’ani ase more, goika abe omosomba oino,
swahili: naye anayetaka kuwa wa kwanza miongoni mwenu hana budi kuwa mtumwa wenu:

english: just as the Son of Man did not come to be served, but to serve, and to give His life as a ransom for many.” The Blind Men by the Road (Mark 10:46–52; Luke 18:35–43)
ekegusii: buna Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto atachete gokorerwa, korende gokorera, na korua obogima bwaye, erinde bobe embooria y’abange.” Yeso okogwenia abanto babere emeuko (Mar 10:46-52; Luk 18:35-43)
swahili: kama vile ambavyo Mwana wa Adamu hakuja ili kutumikiwa, bali kutumika na kuutoa uhai wake uwe fidia kwa ajili ya wengi.” Yesu Awaponya Vipofu Wawili (Marko 10:46-52; Luka 18:35-43)

english: As they were leaving Jericho, a large crowd followed Him.
ekegusii: Ekero baare korua Yeriko, omoganda omonene okamotunyana.
swahili: Yesu na wanafunzi wake walipokuwa wakiondoka Yeriko, umati mkubwa wa watu ulimfuata.

english: About the third hour he went out and saw others standing in the marketplace doing nothing.
ekegusii: Agasoka chinsa isato, akarora abande bateneine echiiro, batari nemeremo,
swahili: “Mnamo saa tatu akatoka tena, akawakuta wengine wamesimama sokoni bila kazi.

english: And there were two blind men sitting beside the road. When they heard that Jesus was passing by, they cried out, “Lord, Son of David, have mercy on us!”
ekegusii: Rora, abanto babere emeuko baikaransete ase enchera ensemo, na ekero bachia koigwa Yeso ogoeta, bagaaka eriogi, bakaboora, “Omonene omwana o Daudi! Tororere amaabera.”
swahili: Vipofu wawili walikuwa wameketi kando ya barabara. Waliposikia kwamba Yesu alikuwa anapita, wakapiga kelele wakisema, “Bwana, Mwana wa Daudi, tuhurumie!”

english: The crowd admonished them to be silent, but they cried out all the louder, “Lord, Son of David, have mercy on us!”
ekegusii: Omoganda oria okabatogonyera ng’a banyare gokira, korende bakamenta kwoga mono, bakaboora, “Omonene, tororere amaabera, aye Omwana o Daudi.”
swahili: Ule umati wa watu ukawakemea na kuwaambia wanyamaze, lakini wao wakazidi kupaza sauti, wakisema, “Bwana, Mwana wa Daudi, tuhurumie.”

english: Jesus stopped and called them. “What do you want Me to do for you?” He asked.
ekegusii: Yeso agatenena, akabarangeria, akababoria, “Ninki morigetie mbakorere?”
swahili: Yesu akasimama na kuwaita, akawauliza, “Mnataka niwafanyie nini?”

english: “Lord,” they answered, “let our eyes be opened.”
ekegusii: Bakamoiraneria, “Omonene, otoramokie amaiso aito.”
swahili: Wakamjibu, “Bwana, tunataka kuona.”

english: Moved with compassion, Jesus touched their eyes, and at once they received their sight and followed Him.
ekegusii: Yeso agasogwa namaabera, agakuna amaiso abo. Erio kegima bakarora, bakamotunyana.
swahili: Yesu akawahurumia na kuwagusa macho yao. Mara macho yao yakapata kuona, nao wakamfuata.

english: ‘You also go into my vineyard,’ he said, ‘and I will pay you whatever is right.’
ekegusii: akabateebia nabarabwo: Genda nainwe ase omogondo one bw’emesabibu na inche nimbae ekebagwenerete. Bakagenda.
swahili: Akawaambia, ‘Ninyi nanyi nendeni mkafanye kazi katika shamba langu la mizabibu, nami nitawalipa chochote kilicho haki yenu.’

english: So they went. He went out again about the sixth hour and the ninth hour and did the same thing.
ekegusii: Agasoka naende chinsa isano nemo, ne chinsa kianda, agakora boigo.
swahili: Kwa hiyo wakaenda. “Akatoka tena mnamo saa sita na pia saa tisa akafanya vivyo hivyo.

english: About the eleventh hour he went out and found still others standing around. ‘Why have you been standing here all day long doing nothing?’ he asked.
ekegusii: Goika chinsa ikomi nemo agasoka, akarora abande bateneine, akababoria nabarabwo: Ninki mwatenenera aa bwaira, motari nameremo?
swahili: Mnamo saa kumi na moja akatoka tena akawakuta wengine bado wamesimama bila kazi. Akawauliza, ‘Kwa nini mmesimama hapa kutwa nzima pasipo kufanya kazi?’

english: ‘Because no one has hired us,’ they answered. So he told them, ‘You also go into my vineyard.’
ekegusii: Bakamoiraneria: Ekiagera monto onde tatoriigeti. Akabateebia: Genda nainwe boigo ase omogondo one bw’emesabibu.
swahili: “Wakamjibu, ‘Ni kwa sababu hakuna yeyote aliyetuajiri.’ “Akawaambia, ‘Ninyi nanyi nendeni mkafanye kazi katika shamba langu la mizabibu.’

english: When evening came, the owner of the vineyard said to his foreman, ‘Call the workers and pay them their wages, starting with the last ones hired and moving on to the first.’
ekegusii: Ekero riagorobire, omonyene omogondo agateebia omoteneneri oye: Rangeria abaremi, obae eng’eria yabo, ochaakere korwa abamagega goika ab’eritang’ani.
swahili: “Ilipofika jioni, yule mwenye shamba la mizabibu akamwambia msimamizi, ‘Waite hao vibarua na uwalipe ujira wao, ukianzia na wale walioajiriwa mwisho na kuishia na wale walioajiriwa kwanza.’

english: The workers who were hired about the eleventh hour came and each received a denarius.
ekegusii: Ekero baria barigetwe chinsa ikomi nemo baachete, bakanyora kera oyomo edinari eyemo.
swahili: “Wale vibarua walioajiriwa mnamo saa kumi na moja, wakaja na kila mmoja wao akapokea dinari moja.

english: As they approached Jerusalem and came to Bethphage on the Mount of Olives, Jesus sent out two disciples,
ekegusii: Ekero bachia goika ang’e na Yerusalemu, bagaika Betifage, ase egetunwa ki’Emezeituni. Erio Yeso agatoma aborokigwa baye babere,
swahili: Walipokaribia Yerusalemu, wakafika Bethfage katika Mlima wa Mizeituni. Ndipo Yesu akawatuma wanafunzi wake wawili,

english: When Jesus had entered Jerusalem, the whole city was stirred and asked, “Who is this?”
ekegusii: Ekero achia gosoa Yerusalemu, omochie omogima ogasega‐sega, abanto bakabooria, “Ning’o oyio?”
swahili: Yesu alipoingia Yerusalemu, mji wote ukataharuki, watu wakauliza, “Huyu ni nani?”

english: The crowds replied, “This is Jesus, the prophet from Nazareth in Galilee.” Jesus Cleanses the Temple (Mark 11:15–19; Luke 19:45–48; John 2:12–25)
ekegusii: Emeganda ekairaneria, “Oyio nere Yeso, omobani o Nazareti ya Galili.” Yeso ogochena Hekalu (Mar 11:15-19; Luk 19:45-48; Yoh 2:13-22)
swahili: Ule umati wa watu ukajibu, “Huyu ni Yesu, yule nabii kutoka Nazareti katika Galilaya.” Yesu Atakasa Hekalu (Marko 11:15-19; Luka 19:45-48; Yohana 2:13-22)

english: Then Jesus entered the temple courts and drove out all who were buying and selling there. He overturned the tables of the money changers and the seats of those selling doves.
ekegusii: Erio Yeso agasoa ase Hekalu ya Nyasae, akabasokia isiko bonsi abarenge koonia na kogora ime ase Hekalu, akaonchorana chimesa chi’abaare koonchoreria chitaabu, na ebirogo bi’abaare koonia amaruma.
swahili: Yesu akaingia katika eneo la Hekalu na kuwafukuza wote waliokuwa wakinunua na kuuza vitu Hekaluni. Akazipindua meza za wale waliokuwa wakibadilisha fedha, na pia viti vya wale waliokuwa wakiuza njiwa.

english: And He declared to them, “It is written: ‘My house will be called a house of prayer.’ But you are making it ‘a den of robbers.’ ”
ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Neriikire: Enyomba y’ane nerokwe enyomba y’ogosaba, na inwe mwayekorire koba ribwago ri’abauri.”
swahili: Akawaambia, “Imeandikwa, ‘Nyumba yangu itaitwa nyumba ya sala,’ lakini ninyi mmeifanya kuwa pango la wanyangʼanyi.”

english: The blind and the lame came to Him at the temple, and He healed them.
ekegusii: Emeuko na amagata bakamochiera aria ase Hekalu, na ere akabagwenia.
swahili: Vipofu na vilema wakamwendea kule Hekaluni, naye akawaponya.

english: But the chief priests and scribes were indignant when they saw the wonders He performed and the children shouting in the temple courts, “Hosanna to the Son of David!”
ekegusii: Korende abakuani abanene na aborokia b’amariiko bakabea, ekero bachia korora ebirage bi’ogokumia akorete, na abana bagoaka eriogi ase Hekalu ime, bakobora, “Hosana ase Omwana o Daudi!”
swahili: Lakini viongozi wa makuhani na walimu wa sheria walipoona mambo ya ajabu aliyofanya na kuwasikia watoto wakishangilia katika eneo la Hekalu wakisema, “Hosana Mwana wa Daudi,” walikasirika.

english: “Do you hear what these children are saying?” they asked. “Yes,” Jesus answered. “Have you never read: ‘From the mouths of children and infants You have ordained praise’?”
ekegusii: Bakamobooria, “Kwaigure abana buna bakobora?” Yeso akabateebia, Ee; timwana gosoma: Nase emenwa y’abana na ey’abakogonka kwerenteire ogotogia ogoikeranu?
swahili: Wakamuuliza Yesu, “Je, unasikia hayo hawa wanayosema?” Akawajibu, “Naam; kwani hamkusoma, “ ‘Midomoni mwa watoto wachanga na wanyonyao umeamuru sifa’?”

english: Then He left them and went out of the city to Bethany, where He spent the night. The Barren Fig Tree (Mark 11:12–14; Mark 11:20–25)
ekegusii: Akabatiga, agasoka korwa ase omochie, akagenda Bethania, akarara aroro. Omoko omogomba (Mar 11:12-14,20-26)
swahili: Akawaacha, akatoka nje ya mji, akaenda hadi Bethania, akalala huko. Mtini Wanyauka (Marko 11:12-14, 20-24)

english: In the morning, as Jesus was returning to the city, He was hungry.
ekegusii: Mambia gakoirana omochie, akaigwa enchara.
swahili: Asubuhi na mapema, Yesu alipokuwa akirudi mjini, alikuwa na njaa.

english: Seeing a fig tree by the road, He went up to it but found nothing on it except leaves. “May you never bear fruit again!” He said. And immediately the tree withered.
ekegusii: Akarora omoko oyomo ase enchera ensemo, akayochiera, tarora gento asoro otatiga amato oka. Akayoteebia, “Korwa bono tokwama amatunda nonya ndinde.” Erio kegima omoko oyio okoma.
swahili: Akauona mtini kando ya barabara, naye akaukaribia, lakini hakupata tunda lolote ila majani. Ndipo akauambia, “Wewe usizae matunda tena kamwe!” Papo hapo ule mtini ukanyauka.

english: saying to them, “Go into the village ahead of you, and at once you will find a donkey tied there, with her colt beside her. Untie them and bring them to Me.
ekegusii: akabateebia, “Genda ase ekenyoro keria kere bosio bwaino, erio kegima namorore etigere esibire, na emori yaye amo nero; mochisibore mochindetere.
swahili: akawaambia, “Nendeni katika kijiji kilichoko mbele yenu, nanyi mtamkuta punda amefungwa hapo, na mwana-punda pamoja naye. Wafungueni na mniletee.

english: When the disciples saw this, they marveled and asked, “How did the fig tree wither so quickly?”
ekegusii: Ekero aborokigwa bachia korora ogokora oko, bagakumia, bakabooria, “Inaki bono omoko oyo bwoma bwango iga?”
swahili: Wanafunzi wake walipoona jambo hili, wakashangaa, wakamuuliza, “Imekuwaje mtini huu kunyauka ghafula?”

english: “Truly I tell you,” Jesus replied, “if you have faith and do not doubt, not only will you do what was done to the fig tree, but even if you say to this mountain, ‘Be lifted up and thrown into the sea,’ it will happen.
ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, “Nekeene nabateebirie; Komorabe nokwegena motabeti na tangutangu chinde, tari erio ri’omoko rioka morakore, korende ’namoteebie egetunwa eke: Tegoka, otugutwe enyancha ime, na rikoreke.
swahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Amin, nawaambia, kama mkiwa na imani wala msiwe na shaka, si kwamba mtaweza kufanya tu yale yaliyofanyika kwa huu mtini, bali hata mkiuambia huu mlima, ‘Ngʼoka, ukatupwe baharini,’ litafanyika.

english: If you believe, you will receive whatever you ask for in prayer.” Jesus’ Authority Challenged (Mark 11:27–33; Luke 20:1–8)
ekegusii: Kende gionsi moraborie ase ogosaba, komoregeene namokenyore.” Riborio igoro y’okobua kwa Yeso (Mar 11:27-33; Luk 20:1-8)
swahili: Yoyote mtakayoyaomba mkisali na mkiamini, mtayapokea.” Wahoji Kuhusu Mamlaka Ya Yesu (Marko 11:27-33; Luka 20:1-8)

english: When Jesus returned to the temple courts and began to teach, the chief priests and elders of the people came up to Him. “By what authority are You doing these things?” they asked. “And who gave You this authority?”
ekegusii: Ekero achia gosoa Hekalu ime na kworokereria, agachierwa nabakuani abanene na etureti y’abanto, bakamobooria, “Nase okobua ki ogokora amang’ana aya? Ning’o okoete okobua oko?”
swahili: Yesu alipoingia Hekaluni, viongozi wa makuhani na wazee wa watu wakamjia alipokuwa anafundisha na kusema, “Unafanya mambo haya kwa mamlaka gani? Na ni nani aliyekupa mamlaka hayo?”

english: “I will also ask you one question,” Jesus replied, “and if you answer Me, I will tell you by what authority I am doing these things.
ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, “Nainche boigo nimbaboorie ring’ana erimo, komorang’iranerie, nainche boigo nimbateebie nase okobua ki ngokora aya.
swahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Nami nitawauliza swali moja. Kama mkinijibu, nami nitawaambia ni kwa mamlaka gani ninafanya mambo haya.

english: What was the source of John’s baptism? Was it from heaven or from men?” They deliberated among themselves and said, “If we say, ‘From heaven,’ He will ask, ‘Why then did you not believe him?’
ekegusii: Inee! Ebatiso ya Yohana, ng’ai yarwete? Igoro yarwete, gose nase Mwanyabaanto?” Bagateebania barabwo ase barabwo, bakaboora, “Toise goteeba: Niigoro yarwete, igo aratoborie: Inaki rende motamwegenete?
swahili: Ubatizo wa Yohana, ulitoka wapi? Je, ulitoka mbinguni au kwa wanadamu?” Wakahojiana wao kwa wao na kusema, “Tukisema ulitoka mbinguni atatuuliza, ‘Mbona basi hamkumwamini?’

english: But if we say, ‘From men,’ we are afraid of the people, for they all regard John as a prophet.”
ekegusii: Naende toise goteeba: Nase Mwanyabaanto yarwete, nkoiroka tore omoganda, ekiagera abanto bonsi banchete ng’a Yohana nomobani orenge.”
swahili: Lakini tukisema, ‘Ulitoka kwa wanadamu,’ tunawaogopa hawa watu, maana wote wanamtambua Yohana kuwa ni nabii.”

english: So they answered, “We do not know.” And Jesus replied, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I am doing these things. The Parable of the Two Sons
ekegusii: Bakamoiraneria, “Titomanyeti.” Ere akabateebia, “Nonya ninche tinkobateebia inwe nase kobua ki ngokora aya. Omobayeeno bw’abana babere abamura
swahili: Kwa hiyo wakamjibu Yesu, “Sisi hatujui.” Naye akawaambia, “Wala mimi sitawaambia ni kwa mamlaka gani ninatenda mambo haya.” Mfano Wa Wana Wawili

english: But what do you think? There was a man who had two sons. He went to the first one and said, ‘Son, go and work today in the vineyard.’
ekegusii: “Inaki morooche? Omonto gete narenge nabana babere abamura. Akamochiera oria bw’eritang’ani, akamoteebia: Omwana one, genda reero okore emeremo ase omogondo bw’emesabibu.
swahili: “Lakini mwaonaje? Mtu mmoja alikuwa na wana wawili. Akamwendea yule wa kwanza akamwambia, ‘Mwanangu, nenda ukafanye kazi kwenye shamba la mizabibu leo.’

english: ‘I will not,’ he replied. But later he changed his mind and went.
ekegusii: Akamoiraneria: Tindigeti kogenda, korende magega yaye akaonchoka, akagenda.
swahili: “Yule mwanawe akamjibu ‘Mimi sitakwenda.’ Baadaye akabadili mawazo yake akaenda.

english: If anyone questions you, tell him that the Lord needs them, and he will send them right away.”
ekegusii: Na omonto karabateebie ring’ana, momoteebie: Omonene nachiganetie; erio kegima nachitome.”
swahili: Kama mtu yeyote akiwasemesha lolote, mwambieni kwamba Bwana ana haja nao, naye atawaruhusu mwalete mara.”

english: Then the man went to the second son and told him the same thing. ‘I will, sir,’ he said. But he did not go.
ekegusii: Akamochiera oy’okabere, akamoteebia boigo. Nere akamoiraneria: Nkogenda inde, omonene; ko tagenda.
swahili: “Kisha yule baba akamwendea yule mwanawe mwingine akamwambia vilevile. Yeye akajibu, ‘Nitakwenda, bwana,’ lakini hakwenda.

english: Which of the two did the will of his father?” “The first, ” they answered. Jesus said to them, “Truly I tell you, the tax collectors and prostitutes are entering the kingdom of God before you.
ekegusii: Inee! Norori ase baria babere okorete ogwancha gwa ise?” Bakaboora, “Noria bw’eritang’ani.” Yeso akabateebia, “Nekeene nabateebirie ng’a abarusia ebango na abakungu abatayayi nkobatang’anera bare gosoa ase oborwoti bwa Nyasae.
swahili: “Ni yupi kati yao hao wawili aliyetimiza kile alichotaka baba yake?” Wakamjibu, “Ni yule wa kwanza.” Yesu akawaambia, “Amin, amin nawaambia, watoza ushuru na makahaba wanawatangulia kuingia katika Ufalme wa Mungu.

english: For John came to you in a righteous way and you did not believe him, but the tax collectors and prostitutes did. And even after you saw this, you did not repent and believe him. The Parable of the Wicked Tenants (Mark 12:1–12; Luke 20:9–18)
ekegusii: Inaki Yohana nigo achete ase more ase enchera y’oboronge, timwamwegena; korende abarusia ebango na abakungu abatayayi bakamwegena; na inwe nonya nekero mwaroche ayio, timwaonchoka na komwegena. Omobayeeno bw’omogondo bw’emesabibu (Mar 12:1-12; Luk 20:9-19)
swahili: Kwa maana Yohana alikuja kwenu kuwaonyesha njia ya haki, lakini hamkumsadiki, lakini watoza ushuru na makahaba wakamsadiki. Nanyi hata mlipoona hayo, baadaye hamkutubu na kumsadiki. Mfano Wa Wapangaji Waovu (Marko 12:1-12; Luka 20:9-19)

english: Listen to another parable: There was a landowner who planted a vineyard. He put a wall around it, dug a winepress in it, and built a tower. Then he rented it out to some tenants and went away on a journey.
ekegusii: “Tegerera omobayeeno onde. Narenge omonto omonyene omochie; ere akarema omogondo, agasimeka emesabibu imeo, akayoetananeria orobago, agakuunya ime aroro egeteera akomitera amasabibu, akaagaacha orwaki, akaywatananera abaremi, akagenda orogendo.
swahili: “Sikilizeni mfano mwingine: Kulikuwa na mtu mmoja mwenye shamba ambaye alipanda shamba la mizabibu. Akajenga ukuta kulizunguka, akatengeneza shinikizo ndani yake na akajenga mnara wa ulinzi. Kisha akalikodisha hilo shamba la mizabibu kwa wakulima fulani, naye akaondoka, akasafiri kwenda nchi nyingine.

english: When the harvest time drew near, he sent his servants to the tenants to collect his share of the fruit.
ekegusii: Ekero engaki y’amatunda yachia goika ang’e, agatoma abasomba baye ase abaremi, banyore amatunda aye.
swahili: Wakati wa mavuno ulipokaribia, akawatuma watumishi wake kwa hao wapangaji ili kukusanya matunda yake.

english: But the tenants seized his servants. They beat one, killed another, and stoned a third.
ekegusii: Abaremi bakabwata abasomba baye, oyomo bakamoaka, oyonde bakamoita, na oyonde bakamoaka amagena.
swahili: “Wale wapangaji wakawakamata wale watumishi, wakampiga mmoja, wakamuua mwingine, na yule wa tatu wakampiga mawe.

english: Again, he sent other servants, more than the first group. But the tenants did the same to them.
ekegusii: Naende agatoma abasomba bande, abange kobua baria b’eritang’ani; bakabakorera boigo.
swahili: Kisha akawatuma kwao watumishi wengine, wengi kuliko wale wa kwanza, nao wale wapangaji wakawatendea vilevile.

english: Finally, he sent his son to them. ‘They will respect my son,’ he said.
ekegusii: Omoerio oye agatoma omwana oye ase bare, ogoteeba: Inabasike omwana one.
swahili: Mwisho wa yote, akamtuma mwanawe kwao, akisema, ‘Watamheshimu mwanangu.’

english: But when the tenants saw the son, they said to one another, ‘This is the heir. Come, let us kill him and take his inheritance.’
ekegusii: Korende abaremi baria, ekero bachia korora omwana oria, bagateebania barabwo ase barabwo: Oyo nere omonyamwando; gaki tomoite, omwando oye toyoire.
swahili: “Lakini wale wapangaji walipomwona mwanawe, wakasemezana wao kwa wao, ‘Huyu ndiye mrithi. Njooni tumuue, ili tuchukue urithi wake.’

english: So they seized him and threw him out of the vineyard and killed him.
ekegusii: Bakamobwata, bakamotuguta isiko korwa ase omogondo bw’emesabibu, bakamoita.
swahili: Hivyo wakamchukua, wakamtupa nje ya shamba la mizabibu, wakamuua.

english: This took place to fulfill what was spoken through the prophet:
ekegusii: Aya onsi agakoreka, erinde anyare goikeranigwa ayatebetwe nomobani, ogoteeba,
swahili: Haya yalitukia ili litimie lile lililonenwa na nabii, akisema:

english: Therefore, when the owner of the vineyard returns, what will he do to those tenants?”
ekegusii: Inee! Karache omonyene omogondo, naki arakore abaremi baria?”
swahili: “Kwa hiyo, huyo mwenye shamba la mizabibu atakapokuja, atawafanyia nini hao wakulima?”

english: “He will bring those wretches to a wretched end,” they replied, “and will rent out the vineyard to other tenants who will give him his share of the fruit at harvest time.”
ekegusii: Bakamoteebia, “Igo araite abamwamu baria ogoita okobe, na aatananere abaremi bande omogondo oria bw’emesabibu, abarache komoa amatunda ekero amire.”
swahili: Wakamjibu, “Kwa huzuni kuu atawaangamiza kabisa hao wadhalimu na kulipangisha shamba lake la mizabibu kwa wakulima wengine ambao watampatia fungu lake la matunda wakati wa mavuno.”

english: Jesus said to them, “Have you never read in the Scriptures: ‘The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone. This is from the Lord, and it is marvelous in our eyes’?
ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, Timwana gosoma ase amariiko: Rigena riria abaagachi bangete riabeire rigena rinene ri’ekoona. Ring’ana eri nigo riarure ase Omonene, na rirorio nogokumia ase amaiso aito?
swahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Je, hamjasoma katika Maandiko kwamba: “ ‘Jiwe walilolikataa waashi limekuwa jiwe kuu la pembeni. Bwana ndiye alitenda jambo hili, nalo ni la ajabu machoni petu’?

english: Therefore I tell you that the kingdom of God will be taken away from you and given to a people who will produce its fruit.
ekegusii: Ase engencho eye nabateebirie, ng’a oborwoti bwa Nyasae naborusigwe ase more, boegwe egesaku egekwama amatunda aye. [
swahili: “Kwa hiyo ninawaambia, Ufalme wa Mungu utaondolewa kwenu na kupewa watu wengine wawezao kuzaa matunda yake.

english: He who falls on this stone will be broken to pieces, but he on whom it falls will be crushed. ”
ekegusii: Oyoragwe igoro ase rigena eri nabunekane, na ere oyo rigena riria riragwere inarimosenyente.]
swahili: Yeye aangukaye juu ya jiwe hili atavunjika vipande vipande, lakini yule litakayemwangukia atasagwa kabisa.”

english: When the chief priests and Pharisees heard His parables, they knew that Jesus was speaking about them.
ekegusii: Ekero abakuani abanene na Abafarisai bachia koigwa emebayeeno yaye, bakamanya ng’a nabwo agoteeba.
swahili: Viongozi wa Makuhani na Mafarisayo waliposikia mifano ya Yesu, walitambua kuwa alikuwa akiwasema wao.

english: Although they wanted to arrest Him, they were afraid of the crowds, because the people regarded Him as a prophet.
ekegusii: Korende ekero bachia korigia komobwata, bakairoka emeganda, ekiagera abanto konya banchire ng’a ere nomobani.
swahili: Wakatafuta njia ya kumkamata, lakini wakaogopa umati wa watu, kwa kuwa watu walimwona Yesu kuwa ni nabii.

english: “Say to the Daughter of Zion, ‘See, your King comes to you, gentle and riding on a donkey, on a colt, the foal of a donkey.’”
ekegusii: “Teebia abanto ba Sayoni, Rigereria, Omorwoti oino nkobaachera are, nomokanyeku, oriinire etigere, nase emori y’etigere, akamori g’etigere.”
swahili: “Mwambieni Binti Sayuni, ‘Tazama, mfalme wako anakuja kwako, ni mnyenyekevu, naye amepanda punda, juu ya mwana-punda, mtoto wa punda.’ ”

english: So the disciples went and did as Jesus had directed them.
ekegusii: Aborokigwa bakagenda, bagakora buna Yeso abachiigete.
swahili: Wale wanafunzi wakaenda, wakafanya kama Yesu alivyokuwa amewaagiza.

english: They brought the donkey and the colt and laid their cloaks on them, and Jesus sat on them.
ekegusii: Bakamorentera etigere amo nemori yaye, bakaara chianga chiabo igoro ya chirochio, na Yeso akayeriina.
swahili: Wakamleta yule punda na mwana-punda, nao wakatandika mavazi yao juu ya hao punda, naye Yesu akaketi juu yake.

english: A massive crowd spread their cloaks on the road, while others cut branches from the trees and spread them on the road.
ekegusii: Na abange b’emeganda bakaara chianga chiabo inchera; abande bakanacha chinsagia chi’emete bagachiaara nchera.
swahili: Umati mkubwa wa watu ukatandaza mavazi yao barabarani, na wengine wakakata matawi kutoka kwenye miti, wakayatandaza barabarani.

english: The crowds that went ahead of Him and those that followed were shouting: “Hosanna to the Son of David!” “Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord!” “Hosanna in the highest!”
ekegusii: Emeganda eria yatang’aine, na eyare komotunyana, bagaaka eriogi, bagateeba, “Hosana ase Omwana o Daudi! Nasesenirie oyio ogocha ase erieta ri’Omonene! Hosana, aye ore igoro mono!”
swahili: Ule umati wa watu uliomtangulia na ule uliomfuata ukapiga kelele ukisema, “Hosana, Mwana wa Daudi!” “Amebarikiwa yeye ajaye kwa Jina la Bwana!” “Hosana juu mbinguni!”

english: Once again, Jesus spoke to them in parables:
ekegusii: Naende Yeso agakwana nabarabwo ase emebayeeno akabora,
swahili: Yesu akasema nao tena kwa mifano, akawaambia,

english: So the servants went out into the streets and gathered everyone they could find, both evil and good, and the wedding hall was filled with guests.
ekegusii: Abasomba baria bagasoka, bagaika ase chinchera, bagasangereria abanyorete bonsi, ababe na abaya; igo enyomba y’enyangi egaichorwa nabageni.
swahili: Wale watumishi wakaenda barabarani, wakawakusanya watu wote waliowaona, wema na wabaya. Ukumbi wa arusi ukajaa wageni.

english: But when the king came in to see the guests, he spotted a man who was not dressed in wedding clothes.
ekegusii: “Korende ekero omorwoti achia gosoa korigereria abageni, akarora omonto oyomo aroro otabegete eyanga y’enyangi.
swahili: “Lakini mfalme alipoingia ndani ili kuwaona wageni, akamwona mle mtu mmoja ambaye hakuwa amevaa vazi la arusi.

english: ‘Friend,’ he asked, ‘how did you get in here without wedding clothes?’ But the man was speechless.
ekegusii: Akamoboria: Mosani, naki gwakorete ogasoa aiga, na aye otari neyanga y’enyangi? Agakira‐kiri.
swahili: Mfalme akamuuliza, ‘Rafiki, uliingiaje humu bila vazi la arusi?’ Yule mtu hakuwa na la kusema.

english: Then the king told the servants, ‘Tie him hand and foot, and throw him into the outer darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.’
ekegusii: Erio omorwoti agateebia abakoreri: Moboe amaboko na amagoro, momotugute ase omosunte isiko; aroro abanto inababe nekerero na okoriania amaino.
swahili: “Ndipo mfalme akawaambia watumishi wake, ‘Mfungeni mikono na miguu mkamtupe nje, kwenye giza. Huko kutakuwa na kilio na kusaga meno.’

english: For many are called, but few are chosen.” Paying Taxes to Caesar (Mark 12:13–17; Luke 20:19–26)
ekegusii: Inaki abarangerigwe nabaange, korende abachorirwe nabake.” Riborio igoro y’okoa Kaisari ebango (Mar 12:13-17; Luk 20:20-26)
swahili: “Kwa maana walioitwa ni wengi, lakini walioteuliwa ni wachache.” Kulipa Kodi Kwa Kaisari (Marko 12:13-17; Luka 20:20-26)

english: Then the Pharisees went out and conspired to trap Jesus in His words.
ekegusii: Erio Abafarisai bakagenda, bakaroberia buna bagochia gotega Yeso ase amang’ana aye.
swahili: Ndipo Mafarisayo wakatoka nje wakaandaa mpango wa kumtega Yesu katika maneno yake.

english: They sent their disciples to Him along with the Herodians. “Teacher,” they said, “we know that You are honest and that You teach the way of God in accordance with the truth. You seek favor from no one, because You pay no attention to external appearance.
ekegusii: Bagatoma aborokigwa babo ase are, amo n’Abaherode, bakaboora, “Omworokia, twamanyire ng’a nigo ore omonto bw’ekeene, na enchera ya Nyasae nigo okoyiorokereria ase ekeene, gose tori koyiera monto; ekiagera torengerereti obonene bw’ abanto.
swahili: Wakatuma wanafunzi wao kwake pamoja na Maherode. Nao wakasema, “Mwalimu, tunajua kwamba wewe ni mtu mwadilifu na unafundisha njia ya Mungu katika kweli bila kuyumbishwa na mtu wala kuonyesha upendeleo.

english: So tell us what You think: Is it lawful to pay taxes to Caesar or not?”
ekegusii: Gaki toteebie naki orooche aye? Mboronge komoa Kaisari ebango, gose taibo.”
swahili: Tuambie basi, wewe unaonaje? Je, ni halali kulipa kodi kwa Kaisari, au la?”

english: But Jesus knew their evil intent and said, “You hypocrites, why are you testing Me?
ekegusii: Korende Yeso, konya omanyire obong’ainereria bwabo, akabora, “Inaki mogonteema, inwe abang’ainereria?
swahili: Lakini Yesu, akijua makusudi yao mabaya, akawaambia, “Enyi wanafiki, kwa nini mnajaribu kunitega?

english: Show Me the coin used for the tax.” And they brought Him a denarius.
ekegusii: Inyorokie ebesa y’ebango.” Bakamorentera ebesa.
swahili: Nionyesheni hiyo sarafu inayotumika kwa kulipia kodi.” Wakamletea dinari.

english: “The kingdom of heaven is like a king who prepared a wedding banquet for his son.
ekegusii: “Oborwoti bwa igoro nigo bogwekaine nomorwoti okorete omoyega bw’enyangi y’omwana oye.
swahili: “Ufalme wa Mbinguni unaweza kufananishwa na mfalme mmoja aliyemwandalia mwanawe karamu ya arusi.

english: “Whose image is this,” He asked, “and whose inscription?”
ekegusii: Yeso akababoria, “Ekieni eke na amariiko aya nebiang’o?”
swahili: Naye akawauliza, “Sura hii ni ya nani? Na maandishi haya ni ya nani?”

english: “Caesar’s,” they answered. So Jesus told them, “Give to Caesar what is Caesar’s, and to God what is God’s.”
ekegusii: Bakamoiraneria, “Nebia Kaisari.” Erio akabateebia, “Nabo, ebire ebia Kaisari moe Kaisari, na ebia Nyasae moe Nyasae.”
swahili: Wakamjibu, “Ni vya Kaisari.” Basi Yesu akawaambia, “Mpeni Kaisari kilicho cha Kaisari, naye Mungu mpeni kilicho cha Mungu.”

english: And when they heard this, they were amazed. So they left Him and went away. The Sadducees and the Resurrection (Mark 12:18–27; Luke 20:27–40)
ekegusii: Ekero bachia koigwa ring’ana riria, bagakumia; bakamotiga, bakagenda. Riborio igoro y’okobokigwa (Mar 12:18-27; Luk 20:27-40)
swahili: Waliposikia hili, wakashangaa. Hivyo wakamwacha, wakaenda zao. Ndoa Na Ufufuo (Marko 12:18-27; Luka 20:27-40)

english: That same day the Sadducees, who say there is no resurrection, came to Jesus and questioned Him.
ekegusii: Rituko erio erio Abasadukai bakamochiera, baria bagoteeba ng’a okobokigwa tikoiyo, bakamobooria,
swahili: Siku hiyo hiyo Masadukayo, wale wasemao kwamba hakuna ufufuo wa wafu, wakamjia Yesu na kumuuliza swali, wakisema,

english: “Teacher,” they said, “Moses declared that if a man dies without having children, his brother is to marry the widow and raise up offspring for him.
ekegusii: bakobora, “Omworokia, Musa nateebete: Omonto karakwe, na ere tari n’abana, momura omwabo atware omoboraka oria, atenenerie momura omwabo egesaku.
swahili: “Mwalimu, Mose alisema, ‘Kama mtu akifa bila kuwa na watoto, ndugu yake inampasa amwoe huyo mjane ili ampatie watoto huyo nduguye aliyekufa.’

english: Now there were seven brothers among us. The first one married and died without having children. So he left his wife to his brother.
ekegusii: Bono mbarenge abamura ba ise oyomo batano na babere egati yaito. Oyo bw’eritang’ani akanyuoma, erio agakwa, na ekiagera atarenge nabana, agatigera momura omwabo mok’aye.
swahili: Basi palikuwa na ndugu saba miongoni mwetu. Yule wa kwanza akaoa mke, naye akafa, na kwa kuwa hakuwa na watoto, akamwachia nduguye yule mjane.

english: The same thing happened to the second and third brothers, down to the seventh.
ekegusii: Naboigo noyo o kabere akamotwara, na oyo o gatato, goika bonsi batano na babere bakaera.
swahili: Ikatokea vivyo hivyo kwa yule ndugu wa pili, na wa tatu, hadi wote saba.

english: And last of all, the woman died.
ekegusii: Omoerio o bonsi omokungu oria nere agakwa.
swahili: Hatimaye, yule mwanamke naye akafa.

english: In the resurrection, then, whose wife will she be of the seven? For all of them were married to her.”
ekegusii: Inee! Ase okobokigwa, mokang’o arabe ase baria batano na babere; naki bonsi mbameny’anete nere?”
swahili: Sasa basi, siku ya ufufuo, yeye atakuwa mke wa nani miongoni mwa wale ndugu saba, kwa kuwa wote walikuwa wamemwoa huyo mwanamke?”

english: Jesus answered, “You are mistaken because you do not know the Scriptures or the power of God.
ekegusii: Korende Yeso akabairaneria, “Mwasirire inwe, ekiagera timomanyeti amariiko, nonya nokobua kwa Nyasae.
swahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Mwapotoka kwa sababu hamjui Maandiko wala uweza wa Mungu.

english: He sent his servants to call those he had invited to the banquet, but they refused to come.
ekegusii: Agatoma abasomba baye batuunye baria konya barangerigwe ase enyangi, korende barabwo bakaanga gocha.
swahili: Akawatuma watumishi wake kuwaita wale waliokuwa wamealikwa karamuni, lakini wakakataa kuja.

english: In the resurrection, people will neither marry nor be given in marriage. Instead, they will be like the angels in heaven.
ekegusii: Inaki ase okobokigwa tibakonyuoma gose tibakonyuomwa, korende nigo barabe buna abamalaika ba Nyasae bare igoro.
swahili: Wakati wa ufufuo, watu hawataoa wala kuolewa, bali watakuwa kama malaika wa mbinguni.

english: But concerning the resurrection of the dead, have you not read what God said to you:
ekegusii: Na ase okobokigwa kw’abakuure timwana gosoma eri mwatebetigwe na Nyasae:
swahili: Lakini kuhusu ufufuo wa wafu, hamjasoma kile Mungu alichowaambia, kwamba,

english: ‘I am the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob’? He is not the God of the dead, but of the living.”
ekegusii: Inche ninche Nyasae o Aburaamu, na Nyasae o Isaka, na Nyasae o Yakobo? Ere tari Nyasae bw’abakuure, korende Nyasae bw’abare moyo.”
swahili: ‘Mimi ni Mungu wa Abrahamu, Mungu wa Isaki, na Mungu wa Yakobo’? Yeye si Mungu wa wafu, bali ni Mungu wa walio hai.”

english: When the crowds heard this, they were astonished at His teaching. The Greatest Commandment (Deuteronomy 6:1–19; Mark 12:28–34)
ekegusii: Ekero omoganda ochia koigwa aya, ogakumia ase okworokereria kwaye. Ogochika kore okonene kobua ayande (Mar 12:28-34)
swahili: Ule umati wa watu uliposikia hayo, ulishangaa sana kwa mafundisho yake. Amri Kuu Kuliko Zote (Marko 12:28-34; Luka 10:25-28)

english: And when the Pharisees heard that Jesus had silenced the Sadducees, they themselves gathered together.
ekegusii: Korende Abafarisai, ekero bachia koigwa ng’a Yeso obakiririe Abasadukai, bagasangererekana amo.
swahili: Mafarisayo waliposikia kwamba Yesu alikuwa amewanyamazisha Masadukayo, Mafarisayo wakakusanyika pamoja.

english: One of them, an expert in the law, tested Him with a question:
ekegusii: Oyomo ase barabwo, omonto bw’amachiiko, akamobooria ase okomoteema,
swahili: Mmoja wao, mtaalamu wa sheria, akamuuliza swali ili kumjaribu, akisema,

english: “Teacher, which commandment is the greatest in the Law?”
ekegusii: “Omworokia, ngochiika ki kore okonene ase amachiiko onsi?”
swahili: “Mwalimu, ni amri ipi katika Sheria iliyo kuu kuliko zote?”

english: Jesus declared, “‘Love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your mind.’
ekegusii: Akamoteebia, “Mwanche Omonene Nyasae oo nenkoro yao yonsi, na omoyo oo bwonsi, na obong’aini bwao bwonsi.
swahili: Yesu akamjibu, “ ‘Mpende Bwana Mungu wako kwa moyo wako wote na kwa roho yako yote na kwa akili zako zote.’

english: This is the first and greatest commandment.
ekegusii: Oko nakwo ogochika okonene, naende nakwo kw’eritang’ani.
swahili: Hii ndiyo amri iliyo kuu, tena ni ya kwanza.

english: And the second is like it: ‘Love your neighbor as yourself.’
ekegusii: Nogwa kabere gokoreng’aine noko: Mwanche omogisangio oo buna bweanchete aye omonyene.
swahili: Nayo ya pili ni kama hiyo, nayo ni hii: ‘Mpende jirani yako kama nafsi yako.’

english: Again, he sent other servants and said, ‘Tell those who have been invited that I have prepared my dinner. My oxen and fattened cattle have been killed, and everything is ready. Come to the wedding banquet.’
ekegusii: Naende agatoma abasomba bande, agateeba: Bateebie abarangerigwe: Rigereria, naroisirie endagera y’ane, chieri amo n’echimori chiane chianyenyirwe, na bionsi biabeire ang’e; inchwo ase omoyega bw’enyangi.
swahili: “Kisha akawatuma watumishi wengine akisema, ‘Waambieni wale walioalikwa kwamba nimeandaa chakula. Nimekwisha kuchinja mafahali wangu na vinono, karamu iko tayari. Karibuni kwa karamu ya arusi.’

english: All the Law and the Prophets hang on these two commandments.” Whose Son Is the Christ? (Mark 12:35–37; Luke 20:41–44)
ekegusii: Ase amachiiko aya abere naro atenenerete amachiiko onsi na ababani.” Riborio igoro ya Kristo (Mar 12:35-37; Luk 20:41-44)
swahili: Amri hizi mbili ndizo msingi wa Sheria na Manabii.” Swali Kuhusu Mwana Wa Daudi (Marko 12:35-37; Luka 20:41-44)

english: While the Pharisees were assembled, Jesus questioned them:
ekegusii: Abafarisai kobasangererekanire amo, Yeso akababoria,
swahili: Wakati Mafarisayo walikuwa wamekusanyika pamoja, Yesu akawauliza,

english: “What do you think about the Christ? Whose son is He?” “David’s,” they answered.
ekegusii: “Inaki inwe mokorengereria ase Kristo? Nomwana o ng’o are?” Bakamoiraneria, “Nomwana o Daudi.”
swahili: “Mnaonaje kuhusu Kristo? Yeye ni mwana wa nani?” Wakamjibu, “Yeye ni mwana wa Daudi.”

english: Jesus said to them, “How then does David in the Spirit call Him ‘Lord’? For he says:
ekegusii: Akababoria, Inki rende gekogera Daudi, akoraagwa n’Omoika, akamoroka Omonene, okobora:
swahili: Akawaambia, “Inakuwaje basi kwamba Daudi, akinena kwa kuongozwa na Roho, anamwita Kristo ‘Bwana’? Kwa maana asema,

english: ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at My right hand until I put Your enemies under Your feet.”’
ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Omonene one: Ikaransa ensemo y’okoboko kwane gw’okorio, goika ’mbeke ababisa bao babe inse y’amagoro ao?
swahili: “ ‘ Bwana alimwambia Bwana wangu: “Keti mkono wangu wa kuume, hadi nitakapowaweka adui zako chini ya miguu yako.” ’

english: So if David calls Him ‘Lord,’ how can He be David’s son?”
ekegusii: Gaki, onye Daudi okomooroka Kristo, naki rende arabe omwana oye?
swahili: Kama basi Daudi anamwita yeye ‘Bwana,’ awezaje kuwa mwanawe?”

english: No one was able to answer a word, and from that day on no one dared to question Him any further.
ekegusii: Onde tarenge ore konyara komoiraneria ing’ana; nonya nkorwa rituko riria monto onde tarenge na boremu komoboria maborio ande.
swahili: Hakuna mtu aliyeweza kumjibu Yesu neno. Tena tangu siku hiyo hakuna aliyethubutu kumuuliza tena maswali.

english: But they paid no attention and went away, one to his field, another to his business.
ekegusii: Korende bagachaaya amang’ana aya, bakagenda, oyomo ase omogondo oye, na oyonde ase oboonchoreria bwaye;
swahili: “Lakini hawakuzingatia, wakaenda zao: huyu shambani mwake na mwingine kwenye biashara zake.

english: The rest seized his servants, mistreated them, and killed them.
ekegusii: na abatigarete bakabwata abasomba baye, bakabakorera bobe bakabaita.
swahili: Wengine wao wakawakamata wale watumishi wake, wakawatesa na kuwaua.

english: The king was enraged, and he sent his troops to destroy those murderers and burn their city.
ekegusii: Omorwoti oria akaba nendamwamu, agatoma emeganda y’abarwani, egasiria abaiti baria, na koyosamba omochie obo nomorero.
swahili: Yule mfalme akakasirika sana, akapeleka jeshi lake likawaangamiza wale wauaji na kuuteketeza mji wao kwa moto.

english: Then he said to his servants, ‘The wedding banquet is ready, but those I invited were not worthy.
ekegusii: Erio agateebia abasomba baye: Ekeene enyangi yabeire ang’e, korende abaariganetigwe tibagwenereti.
swahili: “Kisha akawaambia watumishi wake, ‘Karamu ya arusi imeshakuwa tayari, lakini wale niliowaalika hawakustahili kuja.

english: Go therefore to the crossroads and invite to the banquet as many as you can find.’
ekegusii: Gaki, genda ase chinchera chinene, aba moranyore bonsi mobarangerie gocha ase omoyega bw’enyangi.
swahili: Kwa hiyo nendeni katika njia panda mkamwalike karamuni yeyote mtakayemwona.’

english: Then Jesus spoke to the crowds and to His disciples:
ekegusii: Naende Yeso agateebia emeganda na aborokigwa baye,
swahili: Kisha Yesu akauambia umati wa watu pamoja na wanafunzi wake:

english: Nor are you to be called instructors, for you have one Instructor, the Christ.
ekegusii: Gose timobaisa korokwa abanene, ekiagera Omonene oino noyomo, nere Kristo.
swahili: Wala msiitwe ‘Mwalimu,’ kwa maana mnaye mwalimu mmoja tu, ndiye Kristo.

english: The greatest among you shall be your servant.
ekegusii: Nere oyore omonene mono kobua ase more, nigo arabe omokoreri oino,
swahili: Yeye aliye mkuu kuliko ninyi nyote miongoni mwenu atakuwa mtumishi wenu.

english: For whoever exalts himself will be humbled, and whoever humbles himself will be exalted.
ekegusii: na oyo okweimokereria igoro nairanigwe inse, na ere oyokweirania inse naimokererigwe igoro.
swahili: Kwa kuwa yeyote anayejikweza atashushwa, na yeyote anayejinyenyekeza atakwezwa.

english: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You shut the kingdom of heaven in men’s faces. You yourselves do not enter, nor will you let in those who wish to enter.
ekegusii: “Korende obobe nobwaino, aborokia b’amariiko na Abafarisai, abang’ainereria! Ekiagera mwasiekeire abanto oborwoti bwa igoro; naki inwe abanyene timori gosoa, na baria barigeti gosoa, timori kobaa ribaga basoe. [
swahili: “Lakini ole wenu, walimu wa sheria na Mafarisayo, enyi wanafiki! Kwa maana mnawafungia watu milango ya Ufalme wa Mbinguni. Ninyi wenyewe hamuingii humo, nao wale wanaotaka kuingia mnawazuia. [

english: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You traverse land and sea to win a single convert, and when he becomes one, you make him twice as much a son of hell as you are.
ekegusii: Obobe nobwaino, aborokia b’amariiko na Abafarisai, abang’ainereria! Ekiagera nigo mogosiongorokana enyancha na ense enyomo korigia omotunyani oyomo, na ekero abeire omotunyani, mwagera oba omwana bw’omorero o kare na kare ara kabere kobua inwe abanyene.
swahili: “Ole wenu walimu wa sheria na Mafarisayo, enyi wanafiki! Ninyi mnasafiri baharini na nchi kavu ili kumfanya mtu mmoja mwongofu, lakini baada ya kumpata, mnamfanya mwana wa jehanamu mara mbili kuliko ninyi!

english: Woe to you, blind guides! You say, ‘If anyone swears by the temple, it means nothing; but if anyone swears by the gold of the temple, he is bound by his oath.’
ekegusii: “Obobe nobwaino, abaraai emeuko, inwe abamogoteeba: Onde bwensi kararie emuma ase Hekalu, tari gento, korende onde bwensi kararie emuma ase etaabu ye Hekalu, bwesibire n’emuma yaye.
swahili: “Ole wenu, viongozi vipofu! Ninyi mwasema, ‘Mtu akiapa kwa Hekalu, kiapo hicho si kitu; lakini mtu akiapa kwa dhahabu ya Hekalu, amefungwa kwa kiapo chake.’

english: You blind fools! Which is greater: the gold, or the temple that makes it sacred?
ekegusii: Inwe abariri emeuko! Nkereki kere ekenene kobua: netaabu, gose ne Hekalu egokora etaabu ebe enchenu?
swahili: Ninyi vipofu wapumbavu! Ni kipi kilicho kikuu zaidi: ni ile dhahabu, au ni lile Hekalu linaloifanya hiyo dhahabu kuwa takatifu?

english: And you say, ‘If anyone swears by the altar, it means nothing; but if anyone swears by the gift on it, he is bound by his oath.’
ekegusii: Inwe nigo mogoteeba: Onde bwensi kararie emuma ase egesasiimero tari gento; korende onde bwensi kararie emuma ase ekeng’wanso kere igoro ase egesasiimero bwesibire nemuma yaye.
swahili: Pia mnasema, ‘Mtu akiapa kwa madhabahu, si kitu; lakini mtu akiapa kwa sadaka iliyo juu ya madhabahu, amefungwa kwa kiapo chake’

english: You blind men! Which is greater: the gift, or the altar that makes it sacred?
ekegusii: Inwe emeuko! Nkere ki kere ekenene kobua: nesadaka, gose negesasiimero kegokora esadaka ebe enchenu?
swahili: Ninyi vipofu! Ni kipi kikuu zaidi: ni sadaka, au ni madhabahu yanayoifanya hiyo sadaka kuwa takatifu?

english: “The scribes and Pharisees sit in Moses’ seat.
ekegusii: “Aborokia b’amariiko na Abafarisai baikaransire ase ekerogo kia Musa.
swahili: “Walimu wa sheria na Mafarisayo wameketi katika kiti cha Mose,

english: So then, he who swears by the altar swears by it and by everything on it.
ekegusii: Gaki, oyorarie emuma ase egesasiimero nigo ararie ase ekio, na ase ebinto bionsi ebire igoro yaye.
swahili: Kwa hiyo, mtu aapaye kwa madhabahu, huapa kwa hayo madhabahu na vitu vyote vilivyo juu yake.

english: And he who swears by the temple swears by it and by the One who dwells in it.
ekegusii: Na oyo orarie emuma ase Hekalu, nigo ararie ase eyio na ase oyo omenyete imeo.
swahili: Naye mtu aapaye kwa Hekalu, huapa kwa hilo Hekalu na kwa huyo akaaye ndani yake.

english: And he who swears by heaven swears by God’s throne and by the One who sits on it.
ekegusii: Na oyo orarie emuma ase igoro, nigo ararie ase ekerogo ki’obonene kia Nyasae na ase oria ogeikaranserete.
swahili: Naye aapaye kwa mbingu, huapa kwa kiti cha enzi cha Mungu na kwa yeye aketiye juu ya kiti hicho.

english: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You pay tithes of mint, dill, and cumin. But you have disregarded the weightier matters of the law: justice, mercy, and faithfulness. You should have practiced the latter, without neglecting the former.
ekegusii: “Obobe nobwaino, aborokia b’amariiko na Abafarisai, abang’ainereria ekiagera nigo mokorua ensemo ya ikomi ye chiarare, na ebinsari, ne chinyeni chinde, na mwatiga amang’ana ayare amanene y’ogochika na oboronge, na amaabera, na okwegena. Naro ayio nabagwenerete moyakore, amo na gotatiga ayande.
swahili: “Ole wenu walimu wa sheria na Mafarisayo, ninyi wanafiki! Kwa maana mnatoa zaka ya mnanaa, bizari na jira, lakini mmeacha mambo makuu zaidi ya sheria, yaani haki, huruma na uaminifu. Iliwapasa kufanya haya makuu ya sheria bila kupuuza hayo matoleo.

english: You blind guides! You strain out a gnat but swallow a camel.
ekegusii: Inwe abaraai emeuko, mwakenonora egechuni, mwamera engamia!
swahili: Ninyi viongozi vipofu, mnachuja kiroboto lakini mnameza ngamia!

english: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You clean the outside of the cup and dish, but inside they are full of greed and self-indulgence.
ekegusii: “Obobe nobwaino, aborokia b’amariiko na Abafarisai, abang’ainereria! Ekiagera nigo mogosibia egekombe na esani korwa isiko, korende ime biaichoire nobouri na okogania gotari nekerengo.
swahili: “Ole wenu, walimu wa sheria na Mafarisayo, ninyi wanafiki! Kwa maana mnasafisha kikombe na sahani kwa nje, lakini ndani mmejaa unyangʼanyi na kutokuwa na kiasi.

english: Blind Pharisee! First clean the inside of the cup and dish, so that the outside may become clean as well.
ekegusii: Aye Omofarisai omouko! Sibia ritang’ani egekombe na esani ime, erio nonya nisiko binyare koba ebirabu.
swahili: Ewe Farisayo kipofu! Safisha ndani ya kikombe na sahani kwanza, ndipo nje itakuwa safi pia.

english: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You are like whitewashed tombs, which look beautiful on the outside, but on the inside are full of dead men’s bones and every kind of impurity.
ekegusii: “Obobe nobwaino, aborokia b’amariiko na Abafarisai, abang’ainereria! Ekiagera nigo mogwekaine nechimbeera chiakire echooka; na chirochio isiko chirorekana ng’a nechingiya, korende ime nigo chiichire namauga y’ebitondo, na euramba yonsi.
swahili: “Ole wenu, walimu wa sheria na Mafarisayo, ninyi wanafiki! Mnafanana na makaburi yaliyopakwa chokaa, ambayo yanapendeza kwa nje, lakini ndani yamejaa mifupa ya wafu na kila aina ya uchafu.

english: In the same way, on the outside you appear to be righteous, but on the inside you are full of hypocrisy and wickedness.
ekegusii: Nainwe nabo more, isiko mwarorekana ase abanto ng’a nabaronge more, korende ime yaino mwaichoirwe nobong’ainereria na ebibe ebinge.
swahili: Vivyo hivyo, kwa nje ninyi mnaonekana kwa watu kuwa wenye haki, lakini kwa ndani mmejaa unafiki na uovu.

english: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You build tombs for the prophets and decorate the monuments of the righteous.
ekegusii: “Obobe nobwaino, aborokia b’amariiko na Abafarisai, abang’ainereria! Ekiagera nigo mokoagaacha chimbeera chi’ababani, na kobaria chimbeera chi’abaronge,
swahili: “Ole wenu, walimu wa sheria na Mafarisayo, ninyi wanafiki! Mnajenga makaburi ya manabii na kuyapamba makaburi ya wenye haki.

english: So practice and observe everything they tell you. But do not do what they do, for they do not practice what they preach.
ekegusii: Gaki, amang’ana onsi bakobateebia, moyanare na koyabwata; korende, timokora buna barabwo bagokora.
swahili: hivyo inawapasa kuwatii na kufanya kila kitu wanachowaambia. Lakini msifuate yale wanayotenda, kwa sababu hawatendi yale wanayohubiri.

english: And you say, ‘If we had lived in the days of our fathers, we would not have been partners with them in shedding the blood of the prophets.’
ekegusii: mogoteeba: Onye ntwarengeo kare ase amatuko ye chisokoro chiaito, anga titwabwatanete nabarabwo ase ogoitera amanyinga y’ababani.
swahili: Nanyi mwasema, ‘Kama tungaliishi wakati wa baba zetu, tusingalikuwa tumeshiriki katika kumwaga damu ya manabii!’

english: So you testify against yourselves that you are the sons of those who murdered the prophets.
ekegusii: Igo mwetebire inwe abanyene, ng’a inwe nabana babo more, baria baitete ababani.
swahili: Hivyo mnajishuhudia wenyewe kwamba ninyi ni wana wa wale waliowaua manabii.

english: Fill up, then, the measure of the sin of your fathers.
ekegusii: Gaki bono, ichoria ekerengo gie chisokoro chiaino.
swahili: Haya basi, kijazeni kipimo cha dhambi ya baba zenu!

english: You snakes! You brood of vipers! How will you escape the sentence of hell?
ekegusii: Inwe ching’iti, oroiboro rw’echinchoka, naki morakore motame ekiina ki’omorero o kare na kare!
swahili: “Ninyi nyoka, ninyi uzao wa nyoka wenye sumu! Mtaiepukaje hukumu ya jehanamu?

english: Because of this, I am sending you prophets and wise men and teachers. Some of them you will kill and crucify, and others you will flog in your synagogues and persecute in town after town.
ekegusii: Ase ayio natomire ababani ase more, na abanto abang’aini, na aborokia b’amariiko; abande babo inamobaite na kobaabamba, na abande babo inamobang’wanie emecharichi ase chisinagogi chiaino, na kobachanda omochie ase omochie.
swahili: Kwa sababu hii, tazameni, natuma kwenu manabii na wenye hekima na walimu. Baadhi yao mtawaua na kuwasulubisha, na wengine wao mtawapiga mijeledi katika masinagogi yenu na kuwafuatia kutoka mji mmoja hadi mji mwingine.

english: And so upon you will come all the righteous blood shed on earth, from the blood of righteous Abel to the blood of Zechariah son of Berechiah, whom you murdered between the temple and the altar.
ekegusii: Erio nario arabachere amanyinga onsi ayaboronge ayaitegete ase ense, korwa amanyinga y’Abeli, oria omonyene oboronge, goika amanyinga a Zakaria, omwana o Barakia, oria mwaiterete gati ye Hekalu na egesasiimero.
swahili: Hivyo ile damu ya wenye haki wote iliyomwagwa hapa duniani, tangu damu ya Abeli, ambaye alikuwa hana hatia, hadi damu ya Zekaria mwana wa Barakia, mliyemuua kati ya patakatifu na madhabahu, itawajia juu yenu.

english: Truly I tell you, all these things will come upon this generation. Lament over Jerusalem (Luke 13:31–35)
ekegusii: Ekeene nabateebirie ng’a amang’ana aya onsi naache igoro ase ekegori eke. Yeso ogwechandera omochie o Yerusalemu (Luk 13:34-35)
swahili: Amin, nawaambia, haya yote yatakuja juu ya kizazi hiki. Yesu Aililia Yerusalemu (Luka 13:34-35)

english: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, who kills the prophets and stones those sent to her, how often I have longed to gather your children together, as a hen gathers her chicks under her wings, but you were unwilling!
ekegusii: “Aye Yerusalemu, Yerusalemu, omochie ogoita ababani na kobaaka amagena abatomirwe ase ore! Ng’ara karenga narigirie gosangereria abana bao, buna engoko egosangereria ebichuchu biaye ase chimbaaba chiaye ime, korende timwancha!
swahili: “Ee Yerusalemu, Yerusalemu, uwauaye manabii na kuwapiga mawe wale waliotumwa kwako! Mara ngapi nimetamani kuwakusanya watoto wako pamoja, kama vile kuku akusanyavyo vifaranga wake chini ya mabawa yake, lakini hukutaka!

english: Look, your house is left to you desolate.
ekegusii: Rora, enyomba yaino mwatigeirwe ritombe.
swahili: Tazama nyumba yenu imeachwa ukiwa.

english: For I tell you that you will not see Me again until you say, ‘Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord.’ ”
ekegusii: Na inche nabateebirie, timokondora naende nonya ng’ake goika ekero keria morache goteeba: Nasesenirie oyogocha ase erieta ri’Omonene.”
swahili: Kwa maana nawaambia, hamtaniona tena tangu sasa mpaka mtakaposema, ‘Amebarikiwa yeye ajaye kwa Jina la Bwana.’ ”

english: They tie up heavy, burdensome loads and lay them on men’s shoulders, but they themselves are not willing to lift a finger to move them.
ekegusii: Inaki nigo bakoboa chigurube chindito, bachitweka ase amareko y’abanto, korende barabwo abanyene tibari gwancha gochitigeria nekiara kiabo.
swahili: Wao hufunga mizigo mikubwa na kuiweka mabegani mwa watu, lakini wao wenyewe hawako radhi hata kuinua kidole ili kuisogeza.

english: All their deeds are done for men to see. They broaden their phylacteries and lengthen their tassels.
ekegusii: Na ogokora kwabo gwonsi nigo bagokora ng’a barorwe nabaanto; nigo bakogareyia ebitinti biabo biriikire amariiko, naende batambeyia emebareero y’ogochabera chianga chiabo.
swahili: “Wao hutenda mambo yao yote ili waonekane na watu. Hupanua vikasha vyao vyenye maandiko ya sheria na kurefusha matamvua ya mavazi yao.

english: They love the places of honor at banquets, the chief seats in the synagogues,
ekegusii: Naende nigo banchete aase amasikani ase emeyega, na goikaransa aase ebirogo bi’amasikani ase chisinagogi,
swahili: Wanapenda kukalia viti vya heshima katika karamu, na vile viti maalum sana katika masinagogi.

english: the greetings in the marketplaces, and the title of ‘Rabbi’ by which they are addressed.
ekegusii: na gokwanigwa n’amasikani ase chichiiro, na korokwa Omwarimu n’abanto.
swahili: Hupenda kusalimiwa masokoni na kutaka watu wawaite ‘Rabi.’

english: But you are not to be called ‘Rabbi,’ for you have one Teacher, and you are all brothers.
ekegusii: Korende inwe timobaisa korokwa Omworokia, ekiagera Omwarimu oino noyomo, na inwe mwensi nabamo.
swahili: “Lakini ninyi msiitwe ‘Rabi,’ kwa sababu mnaye Bwana mmoja na ninyi nyote ni ndugu.

english: And do not call anyone on earth your father, for you have one Father, who is in heaven.
ekegusii: Naende timobaisa koroka monto ase ense tata, ekiagera Iso oino noyomo, oyore igoro.
swahili: Nanyi msimwite mtu yeyote ‘Baba,’ hapa duniani, kwa maana mnaye Baba mmoja, naye yuko mbinguni.

english: As Jesus left the temple and was walking away, His disciples came up to Him to point out its buildings.
ekegusii: Yeso agatiga Hekalu, akaba nkogenda are, na aborokigwa baye bakamochiera komworokia amaagacho ye Hekalu.
swahili: Yesu akatoka Hekaluni na alipokuwa akienda zake, wanafunzi wake wakamwendea ili kumwonyesha majengo ya Hekalu.

english: At that time many will fall away and will betray and hate one another,
ekegusii: Na ekero ekio abanto abange inabagwe korwa ase okwegena kwabo, inabasigaanane na kobeekana ase ababisa babo, naende nabagechane,
swahili: Wakati huo, wengi wataacha imani yao, nao watasalitiana kila mmoja na mwenzake na kuchukiana.

english: and many false prophets will arise and mislead many.
ekegusii: na ababani b’oborimo abange mbaimoke, baraae abange na kobasiria.
swahili: Watatokea manabii wengi wa uongo, nao watawadanganya watu wengi.

english: Because of the multiplication of wickedness, the love of most will grow cold.
ekegusii: Nase engencho y’okomenteka kw’ebibe, obwanchani bw’abange ’nabokende.
swahili: Kwa sababu ya kuongezeka kwa uovu upendo wa watu wengi utapoa,

english: But the one who perseveres to the end will be saved.
ekegusii: Korende oy’oraaremererie goika omoerio, oyio natooreke.
swahili: lakini yule atakayevumilia hadi mwisho ataokolewa.

english: And this gospel of the kingdom will be preached in all the world as a testimony to all nations, and then the end will come. The Abomination of Desolation (Mark 13:14–23; Luke 21:20–24)
ekegusii: Naende, amang’ana aya amaya y’oborwoti narandigwe ase ense yonsi koba kirori ase ebisaku bionsi; erio omoerio ochiche. Okogechia kw’ogosaria
swahili: Injili ya Ufalme itahubiriwa ulimwenguni kote kuwa ushuhuda kwa mataifa yote. Ndipo mwisho utakapokuja.

english: So when you see standing in the holy place ‘the abomination of desolation,’ described by the prophet Daniel (let the reader understand),
ekegusii: Gaki, naboigo kamogocha korora okogechia kw’ogosaria gwatebetwe nomobani Danieli, kogotenena Aase Aachenu (oy’ogosoma amanye),
swahili: “Hivyo mtakapoona lile ‘chukizo la uharibifu’ lililonenwa na nabii Danieli limesimama mahali patakatifu (asomaye na afahamu),

english: then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains.
ekegusii: erio abare Boyahudi batame gochia ase ebitunwa.
swahili: basi wale walioko Uyahudi wakimbilie milimani.

english: Let no one on the housetop come down to retrieve anything from his house.
ekegusii: Ere oyore kerama igoro taika kogenda kobogoria gento ekere nyomba mwaye,
swahili: Yeyote aliye juu ya dari ya nyumba asishuke ili kuchukua chochote kutoka ndani ya nyumba.

english: And let no one in the field return for his cloak.
ekegusii: na ere oyore mogondo tairana nyomba kobogoria eyanga yaye.
swahili: Aliye shambani asirudi nyumbani kuchukua vazi lake.

english: How miserable those days will be for pregnant and nursing mothers!
ekegusii: Korende nebe aakong’u ase abare morito na abakogonkia ase amatuko aria.
swahili: Ole wao wenye mimba na wale wanaonyonyesha watoto siku hizo!

english: “Do you see all these things?” He replied. “Truly I tell you, not one stone here will be left on another; every one will be thrown down.”
ekegusii: Korende akabairaneria, “Inee! Mwarorire aya onsi? Nekeene nabateebirie: Tirigotigara rigena erimo aiga igoro ase erinde, eritatagorwe.” Amabe agochi‐gocha (Mar 13:3-23; Luk 21:7-24)
