swahili: Ndipo Yesu akawauliza, “Je, mnayaona haya yote? Amin, nawaambia, hakuna hata jiwe moja hapa litakalobaki juu ya jingine, bali kila moja litabomolewa.” Ishara Za Nyakati Za Mwisho (Marko 13:3-23; Luka 21:7-24)

english: Pray that your flight will not occur in the winter or on the Sabbath.
ekegusii: Korende saba ng’a ogotama kwaino tikoba ekero gi’etoigo, gose ase rituko ri’Esabato,
swahili: Ombeni ili kukimbia kwenu kusiwe wakati wa baridi au siku ya Sabato.

english: For at that time there will be great tribulation, unmatched from the beginning of the world until now, and never to be seen again.
ekegusii: ekiagera agwo n’ebe emechando emenene, etana koba korwa omochakano bw’ense goika bono, gose tekoba bo naende nonya ng’ake.
swahili: Kwa maana wakati huo kutakuwa na dhiki kuu ambayo haijapata kuwako tangu mwanzo wa dunia mpaka sasa: wala haitakuwako tena kamwe.

english: If those days had not been cut short, nobody would be saved. But for the sake of the elect, those days will be cut short.
ekegusii: Naende onye amatuko ayio atanachetwe, anga monto onde bwensi tatooregete; korende ase engencho y’abachore amatuko ayio nanachwe.
swahili: Kama siku hizo zisingefupishwa, hakuna hata mtu mmoja ambaye angeokoka. Lakini kwa ajili ya wateule, siku hizo zitafupizwa.

english: At that time, if anyone says to you, ‘Look, here is the Christ!’ or ‘There He is!’ do not believe it.
ekegusii: Na ekero ekio omonto karabateebie: Rora, Kristo naa are! Gose: Ooria! Timwancha.
swahili: Wakati huo kama mtu yeyote akiwaambia, ‘Tazama, Kristo huyu hapa!’ Au, ‘Kristo yuko kule,’ msisadiki.

english: For false Christs and false prophets will appear and perform great signs and wonders that would deceive even the elect, if that were possible.
ekegusii: Inaki nabaoroke abakristo b’oborimo, na ababani b’oborimo, nabaorokie ebikone ebinene na amakumia, goika keranyarekane, nabang’aine nonya nabachore.
swahili: Kwa maana watatokea makristo wa uongo na manabii wa uongo, nao watafanya ishara kubwa na maajabu mengi ili kuwapotosha, ikiwezekana, hata wale wateule hasa.

english: So if they tell you, ‘There He is in the wilderness,’ do not go out; or, ‘Here He is in the inner rooms,’ do not believe it.
ekegusii: Gaki, kobarabateebie: Rora, oyo ore ase erooro, timosoka isiko; kobarabateebie: Oyo ore ebinunchi bia bobisi, timwancha.
swahili: “Kwa hiyo mtu yeyote akiwaambia, ‘Yule kule nyikani,’ msiende huko. Au akisema, ‘Yuko kwenye chumba,’ msisadiki.

english: For just as the lightning comes from the east and flashes as far as the west, so will be the coming of the Son of Man.
ekegusii: Inaki buna okomesa gokorwa moocha kwabara gochia bosongo, naboigo ogocha kw’Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto korache koba.
swahili: Kwa maana kama vile umeme utokeavyo mashariki na kuonekana hata magharibi, ndivyo itakavyokuwa kuja kwake Mwana wa Adamu.

english: Wherever there is a carcass, there the vultures will gather.
ekegusii: Inaki aase ribego rire, nao chinsoti chigosangererekana. Ogocha kw’omwana Omwanyabaanto (Mar 13:24-27; Luk 21:25-28)
swahili: Kwa maana popote ulipo mzoga, huko ndiko wakusanyikapo tai. Kuja Kwa Mwana Wa Adamu (Marko 13:24-31; Luka 21:25-33)

english: Immediately after the tribulation of those days: ‘The sun will be darkened, and the moon will not give its light; the stars will fall from the sky, and the powers of the heavens will be shaken. ’
ekegusii: Korende bwango magega y’emechando y’amatuko aria, erioba narionchoke ribe omosunte, na omotienyi tokobara, ne ching’enang’eni nachigwe korwa igoro, ne chinguru chia igoro nachitengechigwe.
swahili: “Mara baada ya dhiki ya siku zile, “ ‘jua litatiwa giza, nao mwezi hautatoa nuru yake; nazo nyota zitaanguka kutoka angani, na nguvu za anga zitatikisika.’

english: While Jesus was sitting on the Mount of Olives, the disciples came to Him privately. “Tell us,” they said, “when will these things happen, and what will be the sign of Your coming and of the end of the age?”
ekegusii: Gaikaransire ase egetunwa ki’Emezeituni, aborokigwa baye bakamochiera bobisi, bakamoboria, “Toteebie, aya indiriri arabe? Naende ninki ekemanyererio ki’ogocha kwao, na ay’omoerio bw’ense?”
swahili: Yesu alipokuwa ameketi kwenye Mlima wa Mizeituni, wanafunzi wake wakamjia faraghani, wakamuuliza, “Tuambie, mambo haya yatatukia lini, nayo dalili ya kuja kwako na ya mwisho wa dunia ni gani?”

english: At that time the sign of the Son of Man will appear in heaven, and all the tribes of the earth will mourn. They will see the Son of Man coming on the clouds of heaven, with power and great glory.
ekegusii: Erio nario ekemanyererio ki’Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto kerache kororekana igoro, na ebisaku bionsi bi’ense nario biraarere; naende nabarore omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto ogocha ase amare a igoro ne chinguru, na obonene obonge.
swahili: “Ndipo itakapotokea ishara ya Mwana wa Adamu angani, na makabila yote ya dunia yataomboleza. Nao watamwona Mwana wa Adamu akija juu ya mawingu ya angani, katika uwezo na utukufu mkuu.

english: And He will send out His angels with a loud trumpet call, and they will gather His elect from the four winds, from one end of the heavens to the other. The Lesson of the Fig Tree (Mark 13:28–31; Luke 21:29–33)
ekegusii: Erio natome abamalaika baye na egeturi ekenene ki’egetuureri, na barabwo mbasangererie abachoore baye korwa ase chinsinyo inye, korwa ensinyo eyemo ya igoro goika eyende. Amorokererio korwa ase omoko (Mar 13:28-37; Luk 21:29-36; 17:26-30)
swahili: Naye atawatuma malaika zake kwa sauti kuu ya tarumbeta, nao watawakusanya wateule wake kutoka pande zote nne za dunia, kutoka mwisho mmoja wa mbingu hadi mwisho mwingine.

english: Now learn this lesson from the fig tree: As soon as its branches become tender and sprout leaves, you know that summer is near.
ekegusii: Eorokererie omobayeeno oyo korwa ase omoko: Orosagia rwaye korwachaakire koorokia amato aye, mwamanyire ng’a nekero ki’ogoseboka, egura gura ng’ang’e ere.
swahili: “Basi jifunzeni somo hili kutokana na mtini: Matawi yake yanapoanza kuchipua na kutoa majani, mnatambua kwamba wakati wa kiangazi umekaribia.

english: So also, when you see all these things, you will know that He is near, right at the door.
ekegusii: Naboigo nainwe komokorora aya aorokire, momanye ng’a omoerio obeire ang’e na gesieri.
swahili: Vivyo hivyo, myaonapo mambo haya yote, mnatambua kwamba wakati u karibu, hata malangoni.

english: Truly I tell you, this generation will not pass away until all these things have happened.
ekegusii: Nekeene nabateebirie: Ekegori eke tikegoeta nonya ng’ake goika aya onsi anyare koba.
swahili: Amin, nawaambia, kizazi hiki hakitapita hadi mambo haya yote yawe yametimia.

english: Heaven and earth will pass away, but My words will never pass away. Readiness at Any Hour (Genesis 6:1–7; Mark 13:32–37; Luke 12:35–48)
ekegusii: Igoro na ense nabiete, korende amang’ana aane takonyara goeta nonya ng’ake. Onde taiyo omanyete rituko nonya n’ensa
swahili: Mbingu na nchi zitapita, lakini maneno yangu hayatapita kamwe. Hakuna Ajuaye Siku Wala Saa (Marko 13:32-37; Luka 17:26-30, 34-36)

english: No one knows about that day or hour, not even the angels in heaven, nor the Son, but only the Father.
ekegusii: Korende amang’ana ye rituko riria, na ensa eria onde tari omanyete, nonya nabamalaika ba igoro, nonya n’Omwana, otatiga Tata bweka.
swahili: “Kwa habari ya siku ile na saa, hakuna ajuaye, hata malaika walio mbinguni wala Mwana, ila Baba peke yake.

english: As it was in the days of Noah, so will it be at the coming of the Son of Man.
ekegusii: Korende buna amatuko aria a Nuhu abeete, naboigo ogocha kw’Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto korache koba.
swahili: Kama ilivyokuwa wakati wa Noa, ndivyo itakavyokuwa kuja kwake Mwana wa Adamu.

english: For in the days before the flood, people were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, up to the day Noah entered the ark.
ekegusii: Inaki buna barenge ase amatuko aria etoigo etaracha, baare koria, bakonywa, bakonyuoma, bakonyuomerigwa, goika rituko riria Nuhu asoete ase obwato,
swahili: Kwa maana siku zile kabla ya gharika, watu walikuwa wakila na kunywa, wakioa na kuolewa, mpaka siku ile Noa alipoingia katika safina.

english: And they were oblivious, until the flood came and swept them all away. So will it be at the coming of the Son of Man.
ekegusii: na barabwo tibamanya goika etoigo egaacha, ekabasiria bonsi; naboigo ogocha kw’Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto koraache koba.
swahili: Nao hawakujua lolote mpaka gharika ilipokuja ikawakumba wote. Hivyo ndivyo itakavyokuwa atakapokuja Mwana wa Adamu.

english: Jesus answered, “See to it that no one deceives you.
ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, Mwerende, monto onde tabang’aina.
swahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Jihadharini, mtu yeyote asiwadanganye.

english: Two men will be in the field: one will be taken and the other left.
ekegusii: Engaki eyio abanto babere inababe mogondo; oyomo nairwe, na oyomo natigwe.
swahili: Watu wawili watakuwa shambani, naye mmoja atatwaliwa na mwingine ataachwa.

english: Two women will be grinding at the mill: one will be taken and the other left.
ekegusii: Abakungu babere inababe bagoseera orogena oromo; oyomo nairwe, na oyomo natigwe.
swahili: Wanawake wawili watakuwa wanasaga pamoja, naye mmoja atatwaliwa na mwingine ataachwa.

english: Therefore keep watch, because you do not know the day on which your Lord will come.
ekegusii: Ase ayio, renda, ekiagera timomanyeti ituko ki Omonene oino agocha.
swahili: “Basi kesheni, kwa sababu hamjui ni siku gani atakapokuja Bwana wenu.

english: But understand this: If the homeowner had known in which watch of the night the thief was coming, he would have kept watch and would not have let his house be broken into.
ekegusii: Korende manya aya, onye omonyene enyomba namanyete nkero ki ase obotuko omoibi agocha, anga narendete taiberwa.
swahili: Lakini fahamuni jambo hili: Kama mwenye nyumba angejua ni wakati gani wa usiku ambao mwizi atakuja, angekesha na hangekubali nyumba yake kuvunjwa.

english: For this reason, you also must be ready, because the Son of Man will come at an hour you do not expect.
ekegusii: Ase ayio nainwe, kabe ang’e; naki ase ensa eria motakagereti nario Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto araache. Abasomba abegenwa na abatari abegenwa (Luk 12:42-46)
swahili: Kwa hiyo ninyi pia hamna budi kuwa tayari, kwa sababu Mwana wa Adamu atakuja saa msiyotazamia. Mfano Wa Mtumishi Mwaminifu (Luka 12:41-48)

english: Who then is the faithful and wise servant, whom the master has put in charge of his household, to give the others their food at the proper time?
ekegusii: Ning’o rende ore omosomba omwegenwa, naende ore omong’aini, obegetwe nomonene oye igoro ase enyomba yaye, ae abanto endagera ase ekero kegwenerete?
swahili: “Ni nani basi aliye mtumishi mwaminifu na mwenye busara, ambaye bwana wake amemweka kusimamia watumishi wengine katika nyumba yake, ili awape chakula chao kwa wakati unaofaa?

english: Blessed is that servant whose master finds him doing so when he returns.
ekegusii: Nasesenirie omosomba oria, ekero omonene oye arache amonyore ogokora bo.
swahili: Heri mtumishi yule ambaye bwana wake atakaporudi atamkuta akifanya hivyo.

english: Truly I tell you, he will put him in charge of all his possessions.
ekegusii: Nekeene nabateebirie ng’a namobeke igoro ase ebi abwate bionsi.
swahili: Amin, nawaambia, atamweka mtumishi huyo kuwa msimamizi wa mali yake yote.

english: But suppose that servant is wicked and says in his heart, ‘My master will be away a long time.’
ekegusii: Korende omosomba oria omobe, karateebe ase omoyo oye ime: Omonene one otebanire goocha,
swahili: Lakini kama huyo mtumishi ni mwovu, naye akasema moyoni mwake, ‘Bwana wangu atakawia muda mrefu,’

english: And he begins to beat his fellow servants and to eat and drink with drunkards.
ekegusii: achaake goaka abasomba b’omonene oye, na koria na konywa amo nabagotinda,
swahili: kisha akaanza kuwapiga watumishi wenzake, na kula na kunywa pamoja na walevi.

english: For many will come in My name, claiming, ‘I am the Christ,’ and will deceive many.
ekegusii: Inaki abange inabaache ase erieta riane, babore: Inche ninche Kristo; baraae abange na kobasiria.
swahili: Kwa maana wengi watakuja kwa Jina langu, wakidai, ‘Mimi ndiye Kristo,’ nao watawadanganya wengi.

english: The master of that servant will come on a day he does not expect and at an hour he does not anticipate.
ekegusii: omonene bw’omosomba oria nigo araache rituko atakagereti, na ensa atamanyeti;
swahili: Basi bwana wa mtumishi huyo atakuja siku asiyodhani na saa asiyoijua.

english: Then he will cut him to pieces and assign him a place with the hypocrites, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
ekegusii: ere namonachane abe ebing’ese namobeeke amo nabang’ainereria. Aroro abanto ’mbabe nekerero na okoriania amaino.
swahili: Atamkata vipande vipande na kumweka katika sehemu moja pamoja na wanafiki, mahali ambako kutakuwa ni kulia na kusaga meno.

english: You will hear of wars and rumors of wars, but see to it that you are not alarmed. These things must happen, but the end is still to come.
ekegusii: Na inwe inamoigwe esegi, ne chinkuma, chi’esegi; rigereria timoichanigwa, ekiagera ekeene, aya onsi nabe; korende omoerio toracha.
swahili: Mtasikia habari za vita na matetesi ya vita. Angalieni msitishike, kwa maana haya hayana budi kutukia. Lakini ule mwisho bado.

english: Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom. There will be famines and earthquakes in various places.
ekegusii: Inaki egesaku nakeimoke korwana negesaku kende, na oborwoti inaborwane noborwoti bonde; enchara na emetengecho y’ense inabibe ase chinsemo ne chinsemo.
swahili: Taifa litainuka dhidi ya taifa, na ufalme dhidi ya ufalme. Kutakuwa na njaa na mitetemeko ya ardhi sehemu mbalimbali.

english: Then they will deliver you over to be persecuted and killed, and you will be hated by all nations because of My name.
ekegusii: Erio inabaabarue monyare gochandwa na goitwa, na inwe inamwangwe nebisaku bionsi ase engencho y’erieta riane.
swahili: “Ndipo mtasalitiwa, ili mteswe na kuuawa, nanyi mtachukiwa na mataifa yote kwa ajili yangu.

english: “At that time the kingdom of heaven will be like ten virgins who took their lamps and went out to meet the bridegroom.
ekegusii: Ase chingaki echio, oborwoti bwa igoro nigo boragwekanigwe n’abaiseke ikomi ababogoretie chitaaya chiabo, bagasoka gochia korotota omonywomi.
swahili: “Wakati huo, Ufalme wa Mbinguni utakuwa kama wanawali kumi waliochukua taa zao na kwenda kumlaki bwana arusi.

english: But while they were on their way to buy it, the bridegroom arrived. Those who were ready went in with him to the wedding banquet, and the door was shut.
ekegusii: Na ekero bachia kogenda kogora, omonywomi agacha, na baria bebegete ang’e bagasoa amo nere ase omoyega bw’enyangi; na egesieri kegasiekwa.
swahili: “Nao walipokuwa wakienda kununua mafuta, bwana arusi akafika. Wale wanawali waliokuwa tayari wakaingia ndani pamoja naye kwenye karamu ya arusi na mlango ukafungwa.

english: Later the other virgins arrived and said, ‘Lord, lord, open the door for us!’
ekegusii: Naende magega yaye abaiseke baria bande bagaacha, bakaboora: Omonene, toigorere!
swahili: “Baadaye wale wanawali wengine nao wakaja, wakaita, ‘Bwana! Bwana! Tufungulie mlango!’

english: But he replied, ‘Truly I tell you, I do not know you.’
ekegusii: Korende akabairaneria: Nekeene nabateebirie: Timbamanyeti inwe.
swahili: “Lakini yeye bwana arusi akawajibu, ‘Amin, amin nawaambia, siwajui ninyi!’

english: Therefore keep watch, because you do not know the day or the hour. The Parable of the Talents (Luke 19:11–27)
ekegusii: Yeso agakoora ogoteeba “Ase igo renda, ekiagera timomanyeti rituko, nonya nensa. Omobayeeno bwe chitalanta
swahili: “Kwa hiyo kesheni, kwa sababu hamjui siku wala saa. Mfano Wa Watumishi Watatu Na Talanta (Luka 19:11-27)

english: For it is just like a man going on a journey, who called his servants and entrusted them with his possessions.
ekegusii: “Ase chingaki echio nigo erache koba buna omonto ore kogenda orogendo, akarangeria abasomba baye, akabeeka enibo yaye ase bare.
swahili: “Tena, Ufalme wa Mbinguni ni kama mtu aliyetaka kusafiri, naye akawaita watumishi wake na kuweka mali yake kwenye uangalizi wao.

english: To one he gave five talents, to another two talents, and to another one talent—each according to his own ability. And he went on his journey.
ekegusii: Akaa oyomo chitalanta isano, na oyonde ibere, na oyonde eyemo, kera omonto koreng’ana nokonyara kwaye. Erio akagenda.
swahili: Mmoja akampa talanta tano, mwingine talanta mbili, na mwingine talanta moja. Kila mmoja alipewa kwa kadiri ya uwezo wake. Kisha yeye akasafiri.

english: The servant who had received the five talents went at once and put them to work and gained five more.
ekegusii: Oria oetwe chitalanta isano akagenda erio kegima, agachionchoreria, akanyora ebitoki, chitalanta chinde isano.
swahili: Yule aliyepewa talanta tano akaenda mara moja akafanya nazo biashara akapata talanta nyingine tano zaidi.

english: Likewise, the one with the two talents gained two more.
ekegusii: Naboigo noria oetwe chitalanta ibere akanyora ebitoki, chitalanta chinde ibere.
swahili: Yule aliyepewa talanta mbili akafanya vivyo hivyo, akapata nyingine mbili zaidi.

english: But the servant who had received the one talent went off, dug a hole in the ground, and hid his master’s money.
ekegusii: Korende oria oetwe etalanta eyeemo akagenda, agakuunya inse, akabisa ebesa y’omonene oye.
swahili: Lakini yule mtumishi aliyekuwa amepokea talanta moja, alikwenda akachimba shimo ardhini na kuificha ile fedha ya bwana wake.

english: After a long time the master of those servants returned to settle accounts with them.
ekegusii: Magega y’amatuko amange omonene bw’abasomba baria agacha, akarigia gokora omobaro nabarabwo.
swahili: “Baada ya muda mrefu, yule bwana wa wale watumishi akarudi na kufanya hesabu nao.

english: Five of them were foolish, and five were wise.
ekegusii: Batano ase barabwo nigo barenge abariri, na batano abang’aini.
swahili: Watano wao walikuwa wapumbavu na watano walikuwa wenye busara.

english: The servant who had received the five talents came and presented five more. ‘Master,’ he said, ‘you entrusted me with five talents. See, I have gained five more.’
ekegusii: Oria oetwe chitalanta isano agacha ne chitalanta chinde isano, akabora: Omonene, nkwang’ete chitalanta isano, rora nanyorire ebitoki, chitalanta chinde isano.
swahili: Yule mtumishi aliyepokea talanta tano akaja, akaleta nyingine tano zaidi. Akasema, ‘Bwana uliweka kwenye uangalizi wangu talanta tano. Tazama, nimepata faida ya talanta tano zaidi.’

english: His master replied, ‘Well done, good and faithful servant! You have been faithful with a few things; I will put you in charge of many things. Enter into the joy of your master!’
ekegusii: Omonene oye akamoteebia: Gwakorire buya aye, omosomba omuya naende omwegenwa; kwabeire omwegenwa ase ebire ebike, ninkobeke igoro ase ebire ebinge. Soa ase omogooko bw’omonene oo.
swahili: “Bwana wake akamwambia, ‘Umefanya vizuri sana, mtumishi mwema na mwaminifu! Umekuwa mwaminifu kwa vitu vichache; nami nitakuweka kuwa msimamizi wa vitu vingi. Njoo ushiriki katika furaha ya bwana wako!’

english: The servant who had received the two talents also came and said, ‘Master, you entrusted me with two talents. See, I have gained two more.’
ekegusii: Naende oria oetwe chitalanta ibere agacha, akabora: Omonene, nkwang’ete chitalanta ibere, rora, nanyorire ebitoki, chitalanta chinde ibere.
swahili: “Yule mwenye talanta mbili naye akaja. Akasema, ‘Bwana, uliweka kwenye uangalizi wangu talanta mbili. Tazama nimepata hapa talanta mbili zaidi.’

english: His master replied, ‘Well done, good and faithful servant! You have been faithful with a few things; I will put you in charge of many things. Enter into the joy of your master!’
ekegusii: Omonene akamoteebia: Gwakorire buya aye, omosomba omuya naende omwegenwa; kwabeire omwegenwa ase ebire ebike, ninkobeke igoro ase ebire ebinge. Soa ase omogooko bw’omonene oo.
swahili: “Bwana wake akajibu, ‘Umefanya vizuri sana, mtumishi mwema na mwaminifu. Umekuwa mwaminifu kwa vitu vichache; nami nitakuweka kuwa msimamizi wa vitu vingi. Njoo ushiriki katika furaha ya bwana wako!’

english: Finally, the servant who had received the one talent came and said, ‘Master, I knew that you are a hard man, reaping where you have not sown and gathering where you have not scattered seed.
ekegusii: Na oria oetwe etalanta eyemo agacha, akabora: Omonene, nakomanyete ng’a nigo ore omonto omokong’u, okogesa aase otasimegete, na gosangereria aase otabusurete;
swahili: “Kisha yule mtumishi aliyepokea talanta moja akaja, akasema, ‘Bwana, nilijua kwamba wewe ni mtu mgumu, unayevuna mahali usipopanda na kukusanya mahali usipotawanya mbegu.

english: So I was afraid and went out and hid your talent in the ground. See, you have what belongs to you.’
ekegusii: erio nkoboa, nkagenda nkabisa etalanta yao inse. Nero eye.
swahili: Kwa hiyo niliogopa, nikaenda, nikaificha talanta yako ardhini. Tazama, hii hapa ile iliyo mali yako.’

english: ‘You wicked, lazy servant!’ replied his master. ‘You knew that I reap where I have not sown and gather where I have not scattered seed.
ekegusii: Korende omonene oye akamoiraneria: Aye omosomba omobe naende omworo! Nkwamanyete ng’a nigo nkogesa aase ntasimegete, naende nigo ngosangereria aase ntabusureti?
swahili: “Bwana wake akajibu, ‘Wewe mtumishi mwovu na mvivu! Ulijua kwamba ninavuna mahali nisipopanda na kukusanya mahali nisipotawanya mbegu.

english: Then you should have deposited my money with the bankers, and on my return I would have received it back with interest.
ekegusii: Gaki nkwagwenerete kobeeka chitaabu chiane ase abakorua efaida, na inche ngocha, anga nanyora echiane amo nefaida y’ane.
swahili: Vyema basi, ingekupasa kuweka fedha yangu kwa watoa riba, ili nirudipo, nichukue ile iliyo yangu na faida yake.

english: Therefore take the talent from him and give it to the one who has ten talents.
ekegusii: Bono moure etalanta yaye, moe oria obwate chitalanta ikomi.
swahili: “ ‘Basi mnyangʼanyeni hiyo talanta, mkampe yule mwenye talanta kumi.

english: For everyone who has will be given more, and he will have an abundance. But the one who does not have, even what he has will be taken away from him.
ekegusii: Inaki kera oyore negento naegwe, naende amenteranigwe; korende ere oyotari negento, nonya nkeria abwate naurwe.
swahili: Kwa maana kila mtu aliye na kitu atapewa zaidi, naye atakuwa navyo tele. Lakini yule asiye na kitu, hata kile alicho nacho atanyangʼanywa.

english: The foolish ones took their lamps but did not take along any extra oil.
ekegusii: Na ekero baria abariri baimogetie chitaaya chiabo, korende tibaimokia y’ogochi komenta;
swahili: Wale wapumbavu walichukua taa zao lakini hawakuchukua mafuta ya akiba,

english: And throw that worthless servant into the outer darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.’ The Sheep and the Goats
ekegusii: Na omosomba oria otagwenereti, motugute isiko ase omosunte, aroro narere na koriania amaino. Okogambigwa kw’omoerio
swahili: Nanyi mtupeni huyo mtumishi asiyefaa nje, kwenye giza, mahali ambako kutakuwa na kilio na kusaga meno.’ Kondoo Na Mbuzi

english: When the Son of Man comes in His glory, and all the angels with Him, He will sit on His glorious throne.
ekegusii: “Ekero Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto agochi‐goocha ase obonene bwaye, na abamalaika bonsi amo nere, erio naikaranse ase ekerogo kiaye ki’obonene.
swahili: “Mwana wa Adamu atakapokuja katika utukufu wake na malaika wote watakatifu pamoja naye, ndipo atakapoketi juu ya kiti cha enzi cha utukufu wake.

english: All the nations will be gathered before Him, and He will separate the people one from another, as a shepherd separates the sheep from the goats.
ekegusii: Ebisaku bionsi nabisangererie ase obosio bwaye; ere naatanane abanto buna omorisia agwatanana ching’ondi ne chimbori.
swahili: Mataifa yote watakusanyika mbele zake, naye atawatenga kama mchungaji anavyotenga kondoo na mbuzi.

english: He will place the sheep on His right and the goats on His left.
ekegusii: Ching’ondi nachibeeke ensemo y’okoboko kwaye gw’okorio, korende chimbori ensemo y’okoboko kwaye gw’okobee.
swahili: Atawaweka kondoo upande wake wa kuume, na mbuzi upande wake wa kushoto.

english: Then the King will say to those on His right, ‘Come, you who are blessed by My Father, inherit the kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world.
ekegusii: Erio Omorwoti nateebie abare ensemo y’okoboko kwaye gw’okorio: Inchuo inwe abamwasesenetigwe na Tata one, soa ase omwando bw’oborwoti mwaroiseretigwe korwa ogotongwa gw’ense,
swahili: “Ndipo Mfalme atawaambia wale walioko upande wake wa kuume, ‘Njooni, ninyi mliobarikiwa na Baba yangu; urithini Ufalme ulioandaliwa kwa ajili yenu tangu kuumbwa kwa ulimwengu.

english: For I was hungry and you gave Me something to eat, I was thirsty and you gave Me something to drink, I was a stranger and you took Me in,
ekegusii: ekiagera inarenge nenchara, mokang’a endagera; inarenge nerang’o, mokang’a nkanywa; inarenge omogeni, mokandoisia;
swahili: Kwa maana nilikuwa na njaa mkanipa chakula, nilikuwa na kiu mkaninywesha, nilikuwa mgeni mkanikaribisha,

english: I was naked and you clothed Me, I was sick and you looked after Me, I was in prison and you visited Me.’
ekegusii: inarenge getirianda, mokamboyia; inarwarete, mogaacha kondora; inasibetwe echela, moganchichera.
swahili: nilikuwa uchi mkanivika, nilikuwa mgonjwa mkanitunza, nami nilikuwa kifungoni mkaja kunitembelea.’

english: Then the righteous will answer Him, ‘Lord, when did we see You hungry and feed You, or thirsty and give You something to drink?
ekegusii: Erio abanyene oboronge nabamoiranerie: A! Omonene, indi twakorooche kore nenchara, togakorageria? Gose indi twakorooche kore nerang’o, togakoa okanywa?
swahili: “Ndipo wale wenye haki watakapomjibu, ‘Bwana, ni lini tulikuona ukiwa na njaa tukakulisha, au ukiwa na kiu tukakunywesha?

english: When did we see You a stranger and take You in, or naked and clothe You?
ekegusii: Indi twakorooche kore omogeni, togakoroisia, gose getirianda, togakoboyia?
swahili: Lini tulikuona ukiwa mgeni tukakukaribisha, au ukiwa uchi tukakuvika?

english: When did we see You sick or in prison and visit You?’
ekegusii: Naende indi twakorooche kore omorwaire, gose gosibire echela, togaacha gokorora?
swahili: Tena ni lini tulikuona ukiwa mgonjwa tukakutunza, au ukiwa kifungoni tukakutembelea?’

english: But the wise ones took oil in flasks along with their lamps.
ekegusii: korende baria abang’aini bakaimokia amaguta ase ebinto biabo amo ne chitaaya chiabo.
swahili: lakini wale wenye busara walichukua taa zao na mafuta ya akiba kwenye vyombo.

english: And the King will reply, ‘Truly I tell you, whatever you did for one of the least of these brothers of Mine, you did for Me.’
ekegusii: Na Omorwoti nabairanerie: Nekeene nabateebirie: Koreng’ana buna mware gokorera oyomo bw’aba abaminto abare abake, ninche mwakorerete.
swahili: “Naye Mfalme atawajibu, ‘Amin nawaambia, kwa jinsi mlivyomtendea mmojawapo wa hawa ndugu zangu walio wadogo, mlinitendea mimi.’

english: Then He will say to those on His left, ‘Depart from Me, you who are cursed, into the eternal fire prepared for the devil and his angels.
ekegusii: Erio nateebie abare ensemo y’okoboko kwaye gw’okobee: Karue ase ’nde inwe abamwaragereretigwe, mogende ase omorero o kare na kare, oyoroiseretigwe Saitani na abamalaika baye,
swahili: “Kisha atawaambia wale walio upande wake wa kushoto, ‘Ondokeni kwangu, ninyi mliolaaniwa, nendeni kwenye moto wa milele ulioandaliwa kwa ajili ya ibilisi na malaika zake.

english: For I was hungry and you gave Me nothing to eat, I was thirsty and you gave Me nothing to drink,
ekegusii: ekiagera inarenge nenchara, timwang’a endagera; inarenge nerang’o, timwang’a inywe.
swahili: Kwa maana nilikuwa na njaa hamkunipa chakula, nilikuwa na kiu hamkuninywesha,

english: I was a stranger and you did not take Me in, I was naked and you did not clothe Me, I was sick and in prison and you did not visit Me.’
ekegusii: Inarenge omogeni, timwandoisia; inarenge getirianda, timwamboyia; inarwarete, naende inarenge echela ime, timwacha kondora.
swahili: nilikuwa mgeni nanyi hamkunikaribisha, nilikuwa uchi hamkunivika, nilikuwa mgonjwa hamkunitunza, na nilikuwa gerezani nanyi hamkuja kunitembelea.’

english: And they too will reply, ‘Lord, when did we see You hungry or thirsty or a stranger or naked or sick or in prison, and did not minister to You?’
ekegusii: Erio barabwo nabamoiranerie: Omonene, indi twakorooche aye kore nenchara, gose kore nerang’o, gose kore omogeni, gose kore getirianda, gose kore omorwaire, gose kore echela ime, na titwagokorera?
swahili: “Ndipo wao pia watajibu, ‘Bwana ni lini tulikuona ukiwa na njaa au kiu, au ukiwa mgeni au uchi, au ukiwa mgonjwa na kifungoni na hatukukuhudumia?’

english: Then the King will answer, ‘Truly I tell you, whatever you did not do for one of the least of these, you did not do for Me.’
ekegusii: Erio omorwoti nabairanerie: Nekeene nabateebirie: Koreng’ana buna motare gokorera oyomo bw’aba abare abake, timwankorerete inche.
swahili: “Naye atawajibu, ‘Amin nawaambia, kwa jinsi ambavyo hamkumtendea mmojawapo wa hawa ndugu zangu walio wadogo, hamkunitendea mimi.’

english: And they will go away into eternal punishment, but the righteous into eternal life.”
ekegusii: Na abanto aba nabagende ase egesusuro gia kare na kare, korende abanyene oboronge inabagende ase obogima bwa kare na kare.”
swahili: “Ndipo hawa watakapoingia kwenye adhabu ya milele, lakini wale wenye haki wataingia katika uzima wa milele.”

english: When the bridegroom was delayed, they all became drowsy and fell asleep.
ekegusii: Ekero omonywomi atebana gocha, bagasundoka bonsi, bakarara.
swahili: Bwana arusi alipokawia kuja wale wanawali wote wakasinzia na kulala.

english: At midnight the cry rang out: ‘Here is the bridegroom! Come out to meet him!’
ekegusii: Korende botuko gati gekaba egeturi: Rigereria, omonywomi oyo! Soka momorotote!
swahili: “Usiku wa manane pakawa na kelele: ‘Tazameni, huyu hapa bwana arusi! Tokeni nje mkamlaki!’

english: Then all the virgins woke up and trimmed their lamps.
ekegusii: Erio abaiseke baria bonsi bakaimoka koroisia chitaaya chiabo.
swahili: “Ndipo wale wanawali wote wakaamka na kuzitengeneza taa zao.

english: The foolish ones said to the wise, ‘Give us some of your oil; our lamps are going out.’
ekegusii: Baria abariri bagateebia baria abang’aini: Twatanere amaguta aino, ekiagera chitaaya chiaito chiarimire.
swahili: Wale wapumbavu wakawaambia wale wenye busara, ‘Tupatieni mafuta yenu kidogo; taa zetu zinazimika.’

english: ‘No,’ said the wise ones, ‘or there may not be enough for both us and you. Instead, go to those who sell oil and buy some for yourselves.’
ekegusii: Korende baria abang’aini bakabairaneria: Taibo. Takonyara gotoisana intwe amo nainwe, mbuya mogende mwegorere ase abaonia.
swahili: “Lakini wale wenye busara wakawajibu, ‘Sivyo, hayatutoshi sisi na ninyi pia. Afadhali mwende kwa wauzao mkajinunulie mafuta yenu.’

english: When Jesus had finished saying all these things, He told His disciples,
ekegusii: Ekero Yeso akoorire gokwana amang’ana aya onsi, agateebia aborokigwa baye,
swahili: Yesu alipomaliza kusema hayo yote, akawaambia wanafunzi wake,

english: Aware of this, Jesus asked, “Why are you bothering this woman? She has done a beautiful deed to Me.
ekegusii: Yeso, konya omanyire aya, akabateebia, “Nase ki mokorosia omokungu oyo? Ere onkoreire emeremo emiya,
swahili: Yesu, akijua jambo hili, akawaambia, “Mbona mnamsumbua huyu mwanamke? Yeye amenitendea jambo zuri sana.

english: The poor you will always have with you, but you will not always have Me.
ekegusii: ekiagera amatuko onsi nigo more nabataka amo nainwe, korende timori nainche amatuko onsi.
swahili: Maskini mtakuwa nao siku zote, lakini mimi hamtakuwa nami siku zote.

english: By pouring this perfume on Me, she has prepared My body for burial.
ekegusii: Buna anyororokeria amaguta aya ase omobere one, onkoreire aya ase okombeeka ang’e ase ogotindekwa kwane.
swahili: Alipomiminia haya manukato kwenye mwili wangu, amefanya hivyo ili kuniandaa kwa ajili ya maziko yangu.

english: Truly I tell you, wherever this gospel is preached in all the world, what she has done will also be told in memory of her.” Judas Agrees to Betray Jesus (Mark 14:10–11; Luke 22:3–6)
ekegusii: Nekeene nabateebirie: Kera aase enchiri eye erarandigwe ase ense yonsi, neri akora oyo nariatorwe ase okomoinyora.” Yudasi ogwancherana korwa Yeso (Mar 14:10-11; Luk 22:3-6)
swahili: Amin, nawaambia, mahali popote ulimwenguni ambapo hii Injili itahubiriwa, jambo hili alilolitenda huyu mwanamke litatajwa pia kwa ukumbusho wake.” Yuda Akubali Kumsaliti Yesu (Marko 14:10-11; Luka 22:3-6)

english: Then one of the Twelve, the one called Judas Iscariot, went to the chief priests
ekegusii: Na ekero ekio oyomo bwa baria ikomi na babere, nere, oyokorokwa Yudasi Iskariota, agachiera abakuani abanene,
swahili: Kisha mmojawapo wa wale kumi na wawili, aitwaye Yuda Iskariote, alikwenda kwa viongozi wa makuhani

english: and asked, “What are you willing to give me if I hand Him over to you?” And they set out for him thirty pieces of silver.
ekegusii: akababoria, “Inki morang’e onye nkorua Yeso ase more?” Bakamoa chitaabu chi’echifeta emerongo etato.
swahili: na kuuliza, “Mtanipa nini nikimtia Yesu mikononi mwenu?” Wakamlipa vipande thelathini vya fedha.

english: So from then on Judas looked for an opportunity to betray Jesus. Preparing the Passover (Mark 14:12–16; Luke 22:7–13)
ekegusii: Korwa ekero ekio akaba nkorigia are ribaga ri’okomorua. Yeso okoria Endagera y’omoerio y’Epasaka amo n’aborokigwa baye (Mar 14:12-26; Luk 22:7-23; Yoh 13:21-30; 1 Abakr 11:23-25)
swahili: Tangu wakati huo Yuda akawa anatafuta wakati uliofaa wa kumsaliti Yesu. Yesu Ala Pasaka Pamoja Na Wanafunzi (Marko 14:12-21; Luka 22:7-23; Yohana 13:21-30)

english: On the first day of the Feast of Unleavened Bread, the disciples came to Jesus and asked, “Where do You want us to prepare for You to eat the Passover?”
ekegusii: Ase rituko rie ritang’ani ri’Emegati etabekiri memera aborokigwa bagachiera Yeso, bakamobooria, “Ng’ai origetie tokoroisie oriere Epasaka?”
swahili: Siku ya kwanza ya Sikukuu ya Mikate Isiyotiwa Chachu, wanafunzi walimjia Yesu wakamuuliza, “Unataka twende wapi ili tukuandalie mahali pa kula Pasaka?”

english: He answered, “Go into the city to a certain man and tell him that the Teacher says, ‘My time is near. I will keep the Passover with My disciples at your house.’”
ekegusii: Akabairaneria, “Genda ase omochie ase omonto gete, momoteebie: Omworokia oteebire: Engaki y’ane yaikire ang’e; nyomba mwao nao ndariere Epasaka amo naborokigwa bane.”
swahili: Akajibu, “Nendeni kwa mtu fulani huko mjini, mkamwambie, ‘Mwalimu asema hivi: Saa yangu imekaribia. Nitaiadhimisha Pasaka pamoja na wanafunzi wangu katika nyumba yako.’ ”

english: So the disciples did as Jesus had directed them and prepared the Passover. The Last Supper (Mark 14:17–26; Luke 22:14–23; 1 Corinthians 11:17–34)
ekegusii: Aborokigwa bagakora buna bachiigetwe na Yeso, bakaarigania Epasaka.
swahili: Hivyo wanafunzi wakafanya kama vile Yesu alivyokuwa amewaelekeza, nao wakaandaa Pasaka.

english: “You know that the Passover is two days away, and the Son of Man will be handed over to be crucified.”
ekegusii: “Mwamanyire ng’a magega y’amatuko abere n’ebe Epasaka, na Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto naruegwe kobambwa.”
swahili: “Kama mnavyojua, baada ya siku mbili itakuwa Pasaka, naye Mwana wa Adamu atasalitiwa ili asulubiwe.”

english: When evening came, Jesus was reclining with the twelve disciples.
ekegusii: Riachia koba mogoroba, agaikaransa ase endagera, amo naborokigwa baria ikomi na babere.
swahili: Ilipofika jioni, Yesu alikuwa ameketi mezani pamoja na wale wanafunzi wake kumi na wawili.

english: And while they were eating, He said to them, “Truly I tell you, one of you will betray Me.”
ekegusii: Kobaikaransire koragera, akabora, “Nekeene nabateebirie: oyomo oino nandue.”
swahili: Nao walipokuwa wakila, Yesu akasema, “Amin, nawaambia, mmoja wenu atanisaliti.”

english: They were deeply grieved and began to ask Him one after another, “Surely not I, Lord?”
ekegusii: Bagaichana mono, bagachaaka kera oyomo komoboria, “Inee! Omonene, ninche?”
swahili: Wakahuzunika sana, wakaanza kumuuliza mmoja baada ya mwingine, “Je, ni mimi Bwana?”

english: Jesus answered, “The one who has dipped his hand into the bowl with Me will betray Me.
ekegusii: Akairaneria, “Oyo ogotobeka okoboko kwaye amo nainche ase esani, oyio nere orandue.
swahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Yule aliyechovya mkono wake katika bakuli pamoja nami ndiye atakayenisaliti.

english: The Son of Man will go just as it is written about Him, but woe to that man by whom He is betrayed. It would be better for him if he had not been born.”
ekegusii: Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto nkogenda are buna amariiko agoteeba, korende obobe nobwaye omonto oria, Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto arurwe nere! Nigo ere buya kobua asare omonto oria, nonya ataiboretwe.”
swahili: Mwana wa Adamu anaenda zake kama vile alivyoandikiwa. Lakini ole wake mtu yule amsalitiye Mwana wa Adamu. Ingekuwa heri kwake mtu huyo kama hangezaliwa!”

english: Then Judas, who would betray Him, said, “Surely not I, Rabbi?” Jesus answered, “You have said it yourself.”
ekegusii: Yudasi, nere oyokomorua, akamobooria, “Inee! Omonene, ninche? Akamoiraneria: Naboigo. Aye gwateebire.”
swahili: Kisha Yuda, yule mwenye kumsaliti, akasema, “Je, ni mimi Rabi?” Yesu akajibu, “Naam, wewe mwenyewe umesema.” Kuanzishwa Kwa Meza Ya Bwana (Marko 14:22-26; Luka 22:14-20; 1 Wakorintho 11:23-25)

english: While they were eating, Jesus took bread, spoke a blessing and broke it, and gave it to the disciples, saying, “Take and eat; this is My body.”
ekegusii: Kobakoragera, Yeso akabogoria omogati, akayosesenia, akayosamunyora, akaa aborokigwa, akabora, “Bogoria, morie; oyo noro omobere one.”
swahili: Walipokuwa wanakula, Yesu akachukua mkate, akashukuru, akaumega, na kuwapa wanafunzi wake, akisema, “Twaeni, mle; huu ndio mwili wangu.”

english: Then He took the cup, gave thanks, and gave it to them, saying, “Drink from it, all of you.
ekegusii: Akabogoria na egekombe, na ekero airaneirie ng’a mbuya mono, akabaa, akabora, “Kanywe aya inwe mwensi,
swahili: Kisha akakitwaa kikombe, akashukuru, akawapa, akisema, “Nyweni nyote katika kikombe hiki.

english: This is My blood of the covenant, which is poured out for many for the forgiveness of sins.
ekegusii: naki aya naro amanyinga aane y’okobwatana okoyia, aitekire ase engencho y’abange ase okwaberwa kw’ebibe.
swahili: Hii ndiyo damu yangu ya Agano, imwagikayo kwa ajili ya wengi kwa ondoleo la dhambi.

english: I tell you, I will not drink of this fruit of the vine from now on until that day when I drink it anew with you in My Father’s kingdom.”
ekegusii: Nabateebirie, tinkonywa naende okwama oko kw’emesabibu goika rituko riria ndache gokonywa oboyia amo nainwe ase oborwoti bwa Tata.”
swahili: Lakini ninawaambia, tangu sasa sitakunywa tena katika uzao huu wa mzabibu, hadi siku ile nitakapounywa mpya pamoja nanyi katika Ufalme wa Baba yangu.”

english: At that time the chief priests and elders of the people assembled in the courtyard of the high priest, whose name was Caiaphas,
ekegusii: Erio abakuani abanene n’etureti y’ abanto bagasangererekana ase egoora y’Omokuani omonene oyore korokwa Kayafa;
swahili: Basi viongozi wa makuhani na wazee wa watu wakakusanyika katika jumba la utawala la kuhani mkuu, jina lake Kayafa.

english: And when they had sung a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives. Jesus Predicts Peter’s Denial (Zechariah 13:7–9; Mark 14:27–31; Luke 22:31–38; John 13:36–38)
ekegusii: Kobakoorire goteera Ogoteera, bagasoka kogenda egetunwa ki’Emezeituni. Yeso okobana buna Petero agocha komokana (Mar 14:27-31; Luk 22:31-34; Yoh 13:36-38)
swahili: Walipokwisha kuimba wimbo, wakatoka wakaenda Mlima wa Mizeituni. Yesu Atabiri Petro Kumkana (Marko 14:27-31; Luka 22:31-34; Yohana 13:36-38)

english: Then Jesus said to them, “This very night you will all fall away on account of Me. For it is written: ‘I will strike the Shepherd, and the sheep of the flock will be scattered.’
ekegusii: Erio Yeso akabateebia, “Ase obotuko bwa reero inwe mwensi inamogochwe ase engencho y’ane na gontiga; naki nariikire: Ning’ake omorisia, ne ching’ondi chie riicho inachiserebekane.
swahili: Kisha Yesu akawaambia, “Usiku huu, ninyi nyote mtaniacha, kwa maana imeandikwa: “ ‘Nitampiga mchungaji, nao kondoo wa hilo kundi watatawanyika.’

english: But after I have risen, I will go ahead of you into Galilee.”
ekegusii: Korende magega y’okobooka kwane nimbatang’anere kogenda Galili.”
swahili: Lakini baada ya kufufuka kwangu, nitawatangulia kwenda Galilaya.”

english: Peter said to Him, “Even if all fall away on account of You, I never will.”
ekegusii: Petero akamoteebia, “Neba inabagochwe bonsi ase engencho yao na bagotige, inche tinkogochwa na kogotiga nonya ng’ake.”
swahili: Petro akajibu, “Hata kama wote watakuacha, kamwe mimi sitakuacha.”

english: “Truly I tell you,” Jesus declared, “this very night, before the rooster crows, you will deny Me three times.”
ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Ekeene nagoteebirie: Ase obotuko obo, ekero etuoni etarabuga, nonkane ara gatato.”
swahili: Yesu akamjibu, “Amin, nakuambia, usiku huu, kabla jogoo hajawika, utanikana mara tatu.”

english: Peter replied, “Even if I have to die with You, I will never deny You.” And all the other disciples said the same thing. Jesus Prays at Gethsemane (Mark 14:32–42; Luke 22:39–46)
ekegusii: Petero akamoteebia, “Nimba ngokwa amo naye, tinkogokana nonya ng’ake.” Na aborokigwa bonsi bagateeba boigo. Yeso ogosaba Gethisemane (Mar 14:32-42; Luk 22:39-46)
swahili: Lakini Petro akasisitiza, “Hata kama itabidi kufa pamoja nawe, sitakukana kamwe.” Nao wanafunzi wale wengine wote wakasema vivyo hivyo. Yesu Anaomba Gethsemane (Marko 14:32-42; Luka 22:39-46)

english: At that time Jesus went with His disciples to a place called Gethsemane, and He told them, “Sit here while I go over there and pray.”
ekegusii: Naende Yeso akagenda nabarabwo goika aase akorokwa Gethisemane, agateebia aborokigwa baye, “Ikaransa aa ekero nkogenda aria gosaba.”
swahili: Kisha Yesu akaenda pamoja na wanafunzi wake mpaka kwenye bustani iitwayo Gethsemane, akawaambia, “Kaeni hapa, nami niende kule nikaombe.”

english: He took with Him Peter and the two sons of Zebedee and began to be sorrowful and deeply distressed.
ekegusii: Akaira Petero na abana baria ba Zebedi babere, agachaaka goichana na gwechanda mono.
swahili: Akamchukua Petro pamoja na wale wana wawili wa Zebedayo, akaanza kuhuzunika na kufadhaika.

english: Then He said to them, “My soul is consumed with sorrow to the point of death. Stay here and keep watch with Me.”
ekegusii: Erio akabateebia, “Omoyo one nore nobororo obonge, nonya ngoika ogokwa; ikaransa aa, morende amo nainche.”
swahili: Kisha Yesu akawaambia, “Moyo wangu umejawa na huzuni kiasi cha kufa. Kaeni hapa na mkeshe pamoja nami.”

english: Going a little farther, He fell facedown and prayed, “My Father, if it is possible, let this cup pass from Me. Yet not as I will, but as You will.”
ekegusii: Akagenderera ake, akagwa maumama, agasaba, “Tata one, onye ekonyarekana, tiga egekombe eke kerusigwe ase ’nde; korende taba buna nyanchete inche, korende buna bwanchete aye.”
swahili: Akaenda mbele kidogo, akaanguka kifudifudi, akaomba akisema, “Baba yangu, kama inawezekana, kikombe hiki na kiniondokee. Lakini si kama nipendavyo mimi, bali kama upendavyo wewe.”

english: and they conspired to arrest Jesus covertly and kill Him.
ekegusii: erio bakaigwana bagakora omoroberio banyare komobwata Yeso bobisi, na komoita.
swahili: Wakafanya shauri ili kumkamata Yesu kwa siri na kumuua.

english: Then Jesus returned to the disciples and found them sleeping. “Were you not able to keep watch with Me for one hour?” He asked Peter.
ekegusii: Agachiera aborokigwa baria, akabanyora bararire, agateebia Petero, “Inee! Iga timokonyara korenda amo nainche nonya nensa eyemo?
swahili: Kisha akarudi kwa wanafunzi wake, akawakuta wamelala. Akamuuliza Petro, “Je, ninyi hamkuweza kukesha pamoja nami hata kwa saa moja?

english: “Watch and pray so that you will not enter into temptation. For the spirit is willing, but the body is weak.”
ekegusii: Renda, mosabe, timobaisa gosoa ase ogoteemwa; omoika oro nore nogwancha, korende omobere tori ne chinguru.”
swahili: Kesheni na mwombe, msije mkaingia majaribuni. Roho iko radhi, lakini mwili ni mdhaifu.”

english: A second time He went away and prayed, “My Father, if this cup cannot pass unless I drink it, may Your will be done.”
ekegusii: Naende akagenda eria kabere, agasaba, “Tata one, onye tekonyarekana egekombe eke keng’etere ntakenywereti, abe buna bwanchete aye.”
swahili: Akaenda tena mara ya pili na kuomba, “Baba yangu, kama haiwezekani kikombe hiki kiniepuke nisikinywe, basi mapenzi yako yafanyike.”

english: And again Jesus returned and found them sleeping—for their eyes were heavy.
ekegusii: Agacha naende, akabanyora bararire; ekiagera amaiso abo abeire amarito.
swahili: Aliporudi, akawakuta tena wamelala kwa sababu macho yao yalikuwa mazito.

english: So He left them and went away once more and prayed a third time, saying the same thing.
ekegusii: Erio Yeso akabatiga naende, akagenda, agasaba eria gatato agakwana amang’ana aria amatang’ani.
swahili: Hivyo akawaacha akaenda zake tena mara ya tatu na kuomba akisema maneno yale yale.

english: Then He returned to the disciples and said, “Are you still sleeping and resting? Look, the hour is near, and the Son of Man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.
ekegusii: Erio agachiera aborokigwa baria, akabateebia, “Nonya mbono nigo moraire na gotimoka? Rora ensa yaikire, na Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto obekirwe ase amaboko y’abanyene ebibe.
swahili: Kisha akarudi kwa wanafunzi wake, akawaambia, “Bado mmelala na kupumzika? Tazameni, saa imefika ambapo Mwana wa Adamu anasalitiwa na kutiwa mikononi mwa wenye dhambi.

english: Rise, let us go! See, My betrayer is approaching!” The Betrayal of Jesus (Mark 14:43–52; Luke 22:47–53; John 18:1–14)
ekegusii: Imoka, togende, rora, ere oyokondua oikire ang’e.” Okobwatwa kwa Yeso (Mar 14:43-50; Luk 22:47-53; Yoh 18:2-11)
swahili: Inukeni, twende zetu! Tazameni, msaliti wangu yuaja!” Yesu Akamatwa (Marko 14:43-50; Luka 22:47-53; Yohana 18:3-12)

english: While Jesus was still speaking, Judas, one of the Twelve, arrived, accompanied by a large crowd armed with swords and clubs, sent from the chief priests and elders of the people.
ekegusii: Ekero arenge gokwana, Yudasi, oyomo bwa baria ikomi na babere, agacha, na omoganda omonene amo nere bare nemioro ne chinungu, bakorwa ase abakuani abanene n’etureti y’ abanto.
swahili: Alipokuwa bado anazungumza, Yuda, mmoja wa wale Kumi na Wawili, akafika. Alikuwa amefuatana na umati mkubwa wa watu wenye panga na marungu, waliokuwa wametumwa na viongozi wa makuhani na wazee wa watu.

english: Now the betrayer had arranged a signal with them: “The One I kiss is the man; arrest Him.”
ekegusii: Ere oyokomorua, konya obaeire ekemanyererio, agateeba, “Oyo ndanyunyunte, oyio nere, momobwate.”
swahili: Basi msaliti alikuwa amewapa hao watu ishara, kwamba: “Yule nitakayembusu ndiye. Mkamateni.”

english: Going directly to Jesus, he said, “Greetings, Rabbi!” and kissed Him.
ekegusii: Erio kegima agachiera Yeso, agateeba, “omorembe obe naye, Omonene!” Akamonyunyunta.
swahili: Mara Yuda akamjia Yesu na kumsalimu, “Salamu, Rabi!” Akambusu.

english: “But not during the feast,” they said, “or there may be a riot among the people.” Jesus Anointed at Bethany (Mark 14:3–9; Luke 7:36–50; John 12:1–8)
ekegusii: Korende bakaboora, “Taba ase rituko rinene, tiribaisa goocha koba rirorooche ase abanto.” Yeso ogoakwa amaguta agwo Bethania (Mar 14:3-9; Yoh 12:1-8)
swahili: Lakini wakasema, “Isiwe wakati wa Sikukuu, kusitokee ghasia miongoni mwa watu.” Yesu Anapakwa Mafuta Huko Bethania (Marko 14:3-9; Yohana 12:1-8)

english: “Friend,” Jesus replied, “do what you came for.” Then the men stepped forward, seized Jesus, and arrested Him.
ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Mosani, kora bwango eki giakoreta aa?” Erio bagaacha, bakamobwata Yeso, bakamoira.
swahili: Yesu akamwambia, “Rafiki, fanya kile ulichokuja kufanya hapa.” Kisha wale watu wakasogea mbele, wakamkamata Yesu.

english: At this, one of Jesus’ companions drew his sword and struck the servant of the high priest, cutting off his ear.
ekegusii: Na rora, oyomo obo bw’abarenge amo na Yeso akarambora okoboko kwaye, akang’usa omoyio oye o birende, agaaka omosomba bw’Omokuani omonene, akamobutora ogoto.
swahili: Ghafula mmoja wa wale waliokuwa na Yesu alipoona hivyo, akaushika upanga wake, akauchomoa na kumpiga mtumishi wa kuhani mkuu, akamkata sikio.

english: “Put your sword back in its place,” Jesus said to him. “For all who draw the sword will die by the sword.
ekegusii: Erio Yeso akamoteebia, “Irania omoyio oo o birende aase aye, ekiagera bonsi abakoimokia omoyio o birende inabasire ase omoyio o birende.
swahili: Ndipo Yesu akamwambia, “Rudisha upanga wako mahali pake, kwa maana wote watumiao upanga watakufa kwa upanga.

english: Are you not aware that I can call on My Father, and He will at once put at My disposal more than twelve legions of angels?
ekegusii: Gose tomanyeti ng’a ninyare gosaba Tata, na ere nantomere abamalaika kobua emeganda ikomi na ebere?
swahili: Je, unadhani siwezi kumwomba Baba yangu naye mara moja akaniletea zaidi ya majeshi kumi na mawili ya malaika?

english: But how then would the Scriptures be fulfilled that say it must happen this way?”
ekegusii: Korende naki rende nanga amariiko aikeranigwa, ng’a nabo egwenerete koba?”
swahili: Lakini je, yale Maandiko yanayotabiri kwamba ni lazima itendeke hivi yatatimiaje?”

english: At that time Jesus said to the crowd, “Have you come out with swords and clubs to arrest Me as you would an outlaw? Every day I sat teaching in the temple courts, and you did not arrest Me.
ekegusii: Ensa eria Yeso agateebia emeganda y’ abanto, “Inee! Igo mwachire buna abamokoumokera omouri nemioro ne chinungu gocha kong’ira? Kera rituko naikaransete amo nainwe ime ase Hekalu ase okworokereria, ko timwambwata.
swahili: Wakati huo, Yesu akawaambia ule umati wa watu, “Je, mmekuja na panga na marungu kunikamata kana kwamba mimi ni mnyangʼanyi? Siku kwa siku niliketi Hekaluni nikifundisha, mbona hamkunikamata?

english: But this has all happened so that the writings of the prophets would be fulfilled.” Then all the disciples deserted Him and fled. Jesus before the Sanhedrin (Mark 14:53–65; Luke 22:66–71; John 18:19–24)
ekegusii: Korende aya onsi abeire, erinde amariiko y’ababani aikeranigwe.” Erio aborokigwa bonsi bakamotiga, bagatama. Yeso bosio bw’etureti (Mar 14:53-65; Luk 22:54-55,63-71; Yoh 18:12-14,19-24)
swahili: Lakini haya yote yametukia ili maandiko ya manabii yapate kutimia.” Ndipo wanafunzi wake wote wakamwacha na kukimbia. Yesu Mbele Ya Kuhani Mkuu (Marko 14:53-65; Luka 22:54-71; Yohana 18:13-24)

english: Those who had arrested Jesus led Him away to the house of Caiaphas the high priest, where the scribes and elders had gathered.
ekegusii: Baria babwatete Yeso bakamoira ase enyomba ya Kayafa Omokuani omonene, aase aborokia b’amariiko na abagaaka basangererekanete.
swahili: Wale waliokuwa wamemkamata Yesu wakampeleka kwa Kayafa, kuhani mkuu, mahali ambapo walimu wa sheria pamoja na wazee walikuwa wamekusanyika.

english: But Peter followed Him at a distance, right up to the courtyard of the high priest. And he went in and sat down with the guards to see the outcome.
ekegusii: Na Petero akamotunyana korwa magega ore egeka, goika ase egoora y’Omokuani omonene, agasoa ime, agaikaransa amo nabarendi, erinde arore eki gekoba omoerio.
swahili: Lakini Petro akamfuata kwa mbali hadi uani kwa kuhani mkuu. Akaingia ndani, akaketi pamoja na walinzi ili aone litakalotukia.

english: Now the chief priests and the whole Sanhedrin were seeking false testimony against Jesus in order to put Him to death.
ekegusii: Erio abakuani abanene na ab’ekegaambero bonsi bakarigia amang’ana y’oborimo y’ogosoera Yeso, banyare komoita;
swahili: Viongozi wa makuhani na Baraza la Wayahudi lote wakatafuta ushahidi wa uongo dhidi ya Yesu ili wapate kumuua.

english: While Jesus was in Bethany in the home of Simon the Leper,
ekegusii: Na Yeso, ekero arenge Bethania ase enyomba ya Simioni, oyorenge noborwaire bwa ukoma,
swahili: Yesu alikuwa Bethania nyumbani mwa Simoni aliyekuwa na ukoma,

english: But they did not find any, though many false witnesses came forward. Finally two came forward
ekegusii: korende nonya abarori abange b’oborimo bachete, tibayanyora. Omoerio abarori babere bagaacha,
swahili: Lakini hawakupata jambo lolote, ingawa mashahidi wengi wa uongo walijitokeza. Hatimaye wakajitokeza mashahidi wawili wa uongo

english: and declared, “This man said, ‘I am able to destroy the temple of God and rebuild it in three days.’”
ekegusii: bakaboora, “Omonto oyo nigo ateebete: Ninyare gotagora Hekalu ya Nyasae, na koyeagaacha ase amatuko atato.”
swahili: na kusema, “Huyu mtu alisema, ‘Ninaweza kulivunja Hekalu la Mungu na kulijenga tena kwa siku tatu.’ ”

english: So the high priest stood up and asked Him, “Have You no answer? What are these men testifying against You?”
ekegusii: Erio Omokuani omonene agatenena akamobooria Yeso, “Tokoiraneria ing’ana? Inki aba bakogosoera?”
swahili: Kisha kuhani mkuu akasimama na kumwambia Yesu, “Je, wewe hutajibu? Ni ushahidi gani hawa watu wanauleta dhidi yako?”

english: But Jesus remained silent. Then the high priest said to Him, “I charge You under oath by the living God: Tell us if You are the Christ, the Son of God.”
ekegusii: Korende Yeso agakira. Na Omokuani omonene akamoteebia, “Nagotianirie ase Nyasae ore moyo, ototeebie gose naye Kristo, Omwana o Nyasae.”
swahili: Lakini Yesu akakaa kimya. Ndipo kuhani mkuu akamwambia, “Nakuapisha mbele za Mungu aliye hai. Tuambie kama wewe ndiwe Kristo, Mwana wa Mungu.”

english: “You have said it yourself,” Jesus answered. “But I say to all of you, from now on you will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of Power and coming on the clouds of heaven.”
ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Naboigo aye gwateebire, korende nabateebirie inwe, korwa bono inamorore Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto oikaransete ensemo y’okoboko gw’okorio kw’Oyore nokobua, ogocha ase amare a igoro.”
swahili: Yesu akajibu, “Wewe umenena. Lakini ninawaambia nyote: Siku za baadaye, mtamwona Mwana wa Adamu akiwa ameketi mkono wa kuume wa Mwenye Nguvu, na akija juu ya mawingu ya mbinguni.”

english: At this, the high priest tore his clothes and declared, “He has blasphemed! Why do we need any more witnesses? Look, now you have heard the blasphemy.
ekegusii: Erio Omokuani omonene agatandora chianga chiaye, akabora, “Oramire Nyasae; abarori naba ki tokorigia? Mwaigure emerumi yaye akorama.
swahili: Ndipo kuhani mkuu akararua mavazi yake na kusema, “Amekufuru! Tuna haja gani tena ya mashahidi zaidi? Tazama, sasa ninyi mmesikia hayo makufuru.

english: What do you think?” “He deserves to die,” they answered.
ekegusii: Inaki morooche?” Bakairaneria, “Omonto oyo nigo agwenerete akwe.”
swahili: Uamuzi wenu ni gani?” Wakajibu, “Anastahili kufa.”

english: Then they spit in His face and struck Him. Others slapped Him
ekegusii: Erio agwo bakamotwera amate obosio, bakamoaka chinkundi; abande bakamoaka chindoe,
swahili: Kisha wakamtemea mate usoni na wengine wakampiga ngumi. Wengine wakampiga makofi

english: and said, “Prophesy to us, Christ! Who hit You?” Peter Denies Jesus (Mark 14:66–72; Luke 22:54–62; John 18:15–18)
ekegusii: bakobora, “Kristo, tobanere! Ning’o ogoaka?” Petero okomokana Yeso (Mar 14:66-72; Luk 22:56-62; Yoh 18:15-18,25-27)
swahili: na kusema, “Tutabirie, wewe Kristo! Ni nani aliyekupiga?” Petro Amkana Bwana Yesu (Marko 14:66-72; Luka 22:56-62; Yohana 18:15-18, 25-27)

english: Meanwhile, Peter was sitting out in the courtyard, and a servant girl came up to him. “You also were with Jesus the Galilean,” she said.
ekegusii: Bono Petero nigo aikaransete egoora isiko. Omoiseke oyomo omosomba bw’Omokuani omonene akamochiera, akabora, “Aye naye kwarenge amo na Yeso Omogalili.”
swahili: Wakati huu Petro alikuwa amekaa nje uani. Mtumishi mmoja wa kike akamjia na kumwambia, “Wewe pia ulikuwa pamoja na Yesu wa Galilaya.”

english: a woman came to Him with an alabaster jar of expensive perfume, which she poured on His head as He reclined at the table.
ekegusii: agaacherwa n’omokuungu orenge nechuba ye rigena rirabu ere namaguta ye rigori rinene ne rimisu rigiya; gaikaransete ase endagera, akamonyororokeria ase omotwe oye.
swahili: naye mwanamke mmoja akamjia akiwa na chupa ya marhamu yenye manukato ya thamani kubwa; akayamimina kichwani mwa Yesu alipokuwa ameketi mezani kula chakula.

english: But he denied it before them all: “I do not know what you are talking about.”
ekegusii: Korende ere agakaana ase amasio abo bonsi, akabora “Timanyeti ayio ogokwana.”
swahili: Lakini Petro akakana mbele yao wote akisema, “Sijui hilo usemalo.”

english: When Peter had gone out to the gateway, another servant girl saw him and said to the people there, “This man was with Jesus of Nazareth.”
ekegusii: Ekero achia gosoka gesieri, omoiseke onde akamorora, agateebia abarengeo, “Omonto oyo nigo arenge amo na Yeso, Omonazareti.”
swahili: Alipotoka nje kufika kwenye lango, mtumishi mwingine wa kike alimwona, akawaambia watu waliokuwepo, “Huyu mtu alikuwa pamoja na Yesu, Mnazareti.”

english: And again he denied it with an oath: “I do not know the man!”
ekegusii: Agakaana naende, na gotiana, “Inche timomanyeti omonto oyio.”
swahili: Akakana tena kwa kiapo akisema, “Mimi simjui huyo!”

english: After a little while, those standing nearby came up to Peter. “Surely you are one of them,” they said, “for your accent gives you away.”
ekegusii: Magega ase egeka egeke abateneine aroro bagaacha, bagateebia Petero, “Ekeene bori, naye noyomo obo ore, ekiagera ogokwana kwao gwakoorokirie.”
swahili: Baada ya muda mfupi, wale waliokuwa wamesimama pale wakamwendea Petro, wakamwambia, “Hakika wewe ni mmoja wao, kwa maana usemi wako ni kama wao.”

english: At that he began to curse and swear to them, “I do not know the man!” And immediately a rooster crowed.
ekegusii: Erio agachaaka kweragereria na gotiana, okobora, “Inche timomanyeti omonto oyio.” Agwo kegima etuoni ekabuga.
swahili: Ndipo Petro akaanza kujilaani na kuwaapia, “Mimi simjui mtu huyo!” Papo hapo jogoo akawika.

english: Then Peter remembered the word that Jesus had spoken: “Before the rooster crows, you will deny Me three times.” And he went outside and wept bitterly.
ekegusii: Erio Petero akainyora ring’ana riria Yeso ateebete, “Ritang’ani etuoni etarabuga, nonkane ara gatato.” Agasoka isiko, akarera nobororo.
swahili: Ndipo Petro akakumbuka lile neno Yesu alilokuwa amesema: “Kabla jogoo hajawika, utanikana mara tatu.” Naye akaenda nje, akalia kwa majonzi.

english: When the disciples saw this, they were indignant and asked, “Why this waste?
ekegusii: Korende ekero aborokigwa baye bachia korora aya, bakagechigwa, bakaboora, “Nobwa ki obosiru obo:
swahili: Lakini wanafunzi wake walipoona hayo wakakasirika, wakasema, “Upotevu huu wote ni wa nini?

english: This perfume could have been sold at a high price, and the money given to the poor.”
ekegusii: Inaki amaguta aya anga taonigwa ase chisiringi chinyinge na chiegwe abataka?”
swahili: Manukato haya yangeuzwa kwa bei kubwa, na fedha hizo wakapewa maskini.”

english: When morning came, all the chief priests and elders of the people conspired against Jesus to put Him to death.
ekegusii: Bogachia gokia mambia, abakuani abanene bonsi na abatureti bagakora omoroberio bw’ogoita Yeso.
swahili: Asubuhi na mapema, viongozi wa makuhani wote na wazee wa watu wakafanya shauri pamoja dhidi ya Yesu ili kumuua.

english: and they gave them for the potter’s field, as the Lord had commanded me.” Jesus before Pilate (Luke 23:1–5; John 18:28–40)
ekegusii: bagachiira ase okogora omogondo bw’omokori chinyongo, buna Omonene achigeete.” Pilato okoboria Yeso amaborio (Mar 15:2-15; Luk 23:3-5,13-25; Yoh 18:33—19:16)
swahili: wakanunulia shamba la mfinyanzi, kama vile Bwana alivyoniagiza.” Yesu Mbele Ya Pilato (Marko 15:2-15; Luka 23:3-25; Yohana 18:33–19:16)

english: Meanwhile Jesus stood before the governor, who questioned Him: “Are You the King of the Jews?” “You have said so,” Jesus replied.
ekegusii: Nere Yeso agatenena ase gabana bw’Abarumi; oyio omobooretie, “Naye Omorwoti bw’Abayahudi?” Yeso akamoteebia, “Naboigo, aye gwateebire.”
swahili: Wakati huo Yesu akiwa amesimama mbele ya mtawala, mtawala akamuuliza, “Wewe ndiye mfalme wa Wayahudi?” Yesu akasema, “Wewe wasema hivyo.”

english: And when He was accused by the chief priests and elders, He gave no answer.
ekegusii: Korende ekero Abakuani abanene na abagaaka bamosoerete, tairaneria ing’ana rinde.
swahili: Lakini viongozi wa makuhani na wazee walipomshtaki, hakujibu neno.

english: Then Pilate asked Him, “Do You not hear how many charges they are bringing against You?”
ekegusii: Erio Pilato akamoteebia, “Toigweti amang’ana aya amange bakona‐goteeba igoro yao?”
swahili: Ndipo Pilato akamuuliza, “Je, husikii ni mambo mangapi wanayokushtaki nayo?”

english: But Jesus gave no answer, not even to a single charge, much to the governor’s amazement. The Crowd Chooses Barabbas (Mark 15:6–11; Luke 23:13–25)
ekegusii: Korende ere tairaneria rinde, nonya nase ring’ana erimo, na gabana agakumia mono.
swahili: Lakini Yesu hakumjibu hata kwa shtaka moja, kiasi kwamba mtawala alishangaa sana.

english: Now it was the governor’s custom at the feast to release to the crowd a prisoner of their choosing.
ekegusii: Bono ekero kie rituko rinene nigo yarenge engencho ya gabana gosiborera Abayahudi omosibwa oyomo oyo barigetie.
swahili: Basi ilikuwa ni desturi ya mtawala kumfungua mfungwa mmoja aliyechaguliwa na umati wa watu wakati wa sikukuu.

english: At that time they were holding a notorious prisoner named Barabbas.
ekegusii: Mbabwate omosibwa oyomo omanyekanete, okorokwa Baraba.
swahili: Wakati huo alikuwepo mfungwa mmoja mwenye sifa mbaya, aliyeitwa Baraba.

english: So when the crowd had assembled, Pilate asked them, “Which one do you want me to release to you: Barabbas, or Jesus who is called Christ?”
ekegusii: Erio kobasangererekanire, Pilato akababoria, “Norori morigetie mbasiborere ase abasibwa aba babere Baraba gose Yeso, oyo okorokwa Kristo?”
swahili: Hivyo umati wa watu walipokusanyika, Pilato akawauliza, “Mnataka niwafungulie nani, Baraba au Yesu yeye aitwaye Kristo?”

english: For he knew it was out of envy that they had handed Jesus over to him.
ekegusii: Ekiagera konya omanyire ng’a Abayahudi nigo baruete Yeso ase obogechi.
swahili: Kwa kuwa alitambua Yesu alikuwa amekabidhiwa kwake kwa ajili ya wivu.

english: While Pilate was sitting on the judgment seat, his wife sent him this message: “Have nothing to do with that innocent man, for I have suffered terribly in a dream today because of Him.”
ekegusii: Ekero Pilato aikaransire ase ekerogo gi’ekiina, akarenterwa amang’ana na mok’aye, ogoteeba, “Oyio nomonto omonyene oboronge, tobaisa kwebwatia asare, ekiagera reero inachandetwe namange ase okorota ase engencho yaye.”
swahili: Pilato akiwa ameketi kwenye kiti cha hukumu, mkewe akampelekea ujumbe huu: “Usiwe na jambo lolote juu ya mtu huyu asiye na hatia, kwa kuwa leo nimeteseka sana katika ndoto kwa sababu yake.”

english: They bound Him, led Him away, and handed Him over to Pilate the governor. Judas Hangs Himself (Zechariah 11:10–17)
ekegusii: Bakamosiba, bakamoira, bakamomoa Pilato, oyorenge gabana o Rumi. Ogokwa kwa Yudasi
swahili: Wakamfunga, wakampeleka na kumkabidhi kwa Pilato, ambaye alikuwa mtawala wa Kirumi. Yuda Ajinyonga (Matendo 1:18-19)

english: But the chief priests and elders persuaded the crowds to ask for Barabbas and to have Jesus put to death.
ekegusii: Bono abakuani abanene na abagaaka bakagenka emeganda ng’a baborie baegwe Baraba, na Yeso bamoite.
swahili: Lakini viongozi wa makuhani na wazee wakaushawishi ule umati wa watu kwamba waombe Baraba afunguliwe, naye Yesu auawe.

english: “Which of the two do you want me to release to you?” asked the governor. “Barabbas,” they replied.
ekegusii: Korende Pilato akaboria omoganda oria naende, “Ase abanto aba babere, norori morigetie mbasiborere?” Bakamoteebia, “Baraba.”
swahili: Mtawala akawauliza tena, “Ni yupi kati ya hawa wawili mnayetaka niwafungulie?” Wakajibu, “Baraba.”

english: “What then should I do with Jesus who is called Christ?” Pilate asked. They all answered, “Crucify Him!”
ekegusii: Pilato akababoria, “Imokore naki Yeso, oyo okorokwa Kristo?” Bakamoteebia bonsi, “Tiga abambwe!”
swahili: Pilato akawaambia, “Basi nifanye nini na huyu Yesu aitwaye Kristo?” Wakajibu wote, “Msulubishe!”

english: “Why?” asked Pilate. “What evil has He done?” But they shouted all the louder, “Crucify Him!” Pilate Washes His Hands (Mark 15:12–15)
ekegusii: Akababoria, “Nase ki? Mbobe ki akorete?” Barabwo bakamenta goaka egeturi, bakobora, “Tiga abambwe!”
swahili: Pilato akauliza, “Kwa nini? Amefanya kosa gani?” Lakini wao wakazidi kupiga kelele, wakisema, “Msulubishe!”

english: When Pilate saw that he was accomplishing nothing, but that instead a riot was breaking out, he took water and washed his hands before the crowd. “I am innocent of this man’s blood, ” he said. “You bear the responsibility.”
ekegusii: Ekero Pilato achia korora ng’a gento tikenyarekaneti asare, ne rirorooche rioka rikona‐kobucha, akaimokia amaache, agaisaba amaboko aye ase obosio bw’omoganda, ogoteeba, “Inche tindi na komocha ase amanyinga y’omonto oyo omonyene oboronge. Niigoro yaino abanyene.”
swahili: Pilato alipoona kwamba hawezi kufanya lolote, lakini badala yake ghasia zilikuwa zinaanza, akachukua maji, akanawa mikono yake mbele ya ule umati wa watu, akasema, “Sina hatia juu ya damu ya mtu huyu, hili ni jukumu lenu!”

english: All the people answered, “His blood be on us and on our children!”
ekegusii: Abanto bonsi bakairaneria, “Amanyinga aye, tiga abe igoro ase tore, na ase abana baito!”
swahili: Watu wote wakajibu, “Damu yake na iwe juu yetu na juu ya watoto wetu!”

english: So Pilate released Barabbas to them. But he had Jesus flogged, and handed Him over to be crucified. The Soldiers Mock Jesus (Isaiah 50:4–11; Mark 15:16–20; Luke 22:63–65; John 19:1–15)
ekegusii: Erio akabasiborera Baraba, na magega gaakire Yeso emecharichi, akabamotigera anyare kobambwa. Abasikari bagochecheria Yeso (Mar 15:16-32; Luk 23:26-43; Yoh 19:17-27)
swahili: Basi akawafungulia Baraba. Lakini baada ya kuamuru Yesu achapwe mijeledi, akamtoa ili asulubishwe. Askari Wamdhihaki Yesu (Marko 15:16-20; Yohana 19:2-3)

english: Then the governor’s soldiers took Jesus into the Praetorium and gathered the whole company around Him.
ekegusii: Erio abarwani ba Pilato bakaira Yeso ime ase enyomba y’egabana, bakamosangererekanera omoganda omogima bw’abarwani.
swahili: Kisha askari wa mtawala wakampeleka Yesu kwenye Praitorio na wakakusanya kikosi kizima cha askari kumzunguka.

english: They stripped Him and put a scarlet robe on Him.
ekegusii: Bakamorusia chianga chiaye, bakamobeekera eyanga embariri.
swahili: Wakamvua nguo zake na kumvika vazi la rangi nyekundu, kisha

english: And they twisted together a crown of thorns and set it on His head. They put a staff in His right hand and knelt down before Him to mock Him, saying, “Hail, King of the Jews!”
ekegusii: Bagatwang’a egutwa y’amagwa, bakamobeekera motwe, na egetonto bakamobekera ase okoboko kwaye gw’okorio; bagatung’ama asare, bakamochecheria na kobora, “Ochie kare, Omorwoti bw’Abayahudi!”
swahili: wakasokota taji ya miiba, wakaiweka kichwani pake. Wakamwekea fimbo katika mkono wake wa kuume, na wakapiga magoti mbele zake na kumdhihaki, wakisema, “Salamu, mfalme wa Wayahudi!”

english: When Judas, who had betrayed Him, saw that Jesus was condemned, he was filled with remorse and returned the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests and elders.
ekegusii: Ekero Yudasi, oria omoruete achia korora ng’a onacheirwe ekiina, ageitia, akairania chitaabu chiria chi’echifeta emerongo etato ase abakuani abanene na abagaaka,
swahili: Yuda, ambaye alikuwa amemsaliti Yesu, alipoona kuwa Yesu amehukumiwa, akajuta na akarudisha vile vipande thelathini vya fedha alivyopewa na viongozi wa makuhani na wazee wa watu.

english: Then they spit on Him and took the staff and struck Him on the head repeatedly.
ekegusii: Erio bakamotwera amate, bakaimokia egetonto keria, bakamoaka ase omotwe.
swahili: Wakamtemea mate, wakachukua ile fimbo wakampiga kichwani tena na tena.

english: After they had mocked Him, they removed the robe and put His own clothes back on Him. Then they led Him away to crucify Him. The Crucifixion (Psalms 22:1–31; Mark 15:21–32; Luke 23:26–43; John 19:16–27)
ekegusii: Kobamochecheirie, bakamorusia eyanga eria embariri, bakamobeekera chianga chiaye omonyene, bakamoira isiko abambwe.
swahili: Baada ya kumdhihaki, wakamvua lile joho, wakamvika tena nguo zake. Kisha wakampeleka ili wakamsulubishe. Yesu Asulubishwa (Marko 15:21-32; Luka 23:26-43; Yohana 19:17-27)

english: Along the way they found a man from Cyrene, named Simon, and they forced him to carry the cross of Jesus.
ekegusii: Kobagosoka korwa ase omochie, bakarora omonto oyomo, Omokurene, okorokwa Simioni; erio abasikari bakabetereria omonto oyio abogorerie Yeso omosalaba.
swahili: Walipokuwa wakienda, wakakutana na mtu mmoja kutoka Kirene, jina lake Simoni, nao wakamlazimisha kuubeba ule msalaba.

english: And when they came to a place called Golgotha, which means The Place of the Skull,
ekegusii: Bagachia goika aase akorokwa Gologotha (engencho yaye: Aase Ekeore),
swahili: Wakafika mahali palipoitwa Golgotha (maana yake ni Mahali pa Fuvu la Kichwa).

english: they offered Him wine to drink, mixed with gall; but after tasting it, He refused to drink it.
ekegusii: bakamoa edivai esang’anirie egento ekeroro, anywe; Agachia koyeigwa, tancha konywa.
swahili: Hapo wakampa Yesu divai iliyochanganywa na nyongo ili anywe; lakini alipoionja, akakataa kuinywa.

english: And sitting down, they kept watch over Him there.
ekegusii: Erio bagaikaransa komorigereria aria.
swahili: Kisha wakaketi, wakamchunga.

english: Above His head they posted the written charge against Him: THIS IS JESUS, THE KING OF THE JEWS.
ekegusii: Igoro ase omotwe oye bakabeeka ogosoerwa kwaye, koriikire, “OYO NERE YESO, OMORWOTI BW’ABAYAHUDI”.
swahili: Juu ya kichwa chake, kwenye msalaba, wakaandika shtaka lake hivi: Huyu ni Yesu, Mfalme wa Wayahudi.

english: Two robbers were crucified with Him, one on His right hand and the other on His left.
ekegusii: Erio abauri babere bakabambwa amo nere, oyomo ensemo y’okoboko kwaye gw’okorio, na oyomo ensemo y’okoboko kwaye gw’okobee.
swahili: Wanyangʼanyi wawili walisulubiwa pamoja naye, mmoja upande wake wa kuume na mwingine upande wa kushoto.

english: And those who passed by heaped abuse on Him, shaking their heads
ekegusii: Na barabwo abaare goeta, bakamorama, bagosinga‐singisia emetwe yabo, bakobora,
swahili: Watu waliokuwa wakipita njiani wakamtukana huku wakitikisa vichwa vyao

english: “I have sinned by betraying innocent blood,” he said. “What is that to us?” they replied. “You bear the responsibility.”
ekegusii: okobora, “Namochire ase okorua omonto otari na bobe bonde aitwe.” Barabwo bakaboora, “Ninki aya are ase tore? Echio n’echigurube chiao!”
swahili: Akasema, “Nimetenda dhambi, kwa maana nimeisaliti damu isiyo na hatia.” Wakamjibu, “Hilo latuhusu nini sisi? Ni shauri yako.”

english: and saying, “You who are going to destroy the temple and rebuild it in three days, save Yourself! If You are the Son of God, come down from the cross!”
ekegusii: “Aye oyogotagora Hekalu na koyeagaacha ase amatuko atato, etoorie! Onye naye Omwana o Nyasae, ika korwa ase omosalaba.”
swahili: na kusema, “Wewe ambaye utalivunja Hekalu na kulijenga kwa siku tatu, jiokoe mwenyewe basi! Kama wewe ni Mwana wa Mungu, shuka kutoka msalabani.”

english: In the same way, the chief priests, scribes, and elders mocked Him, saying,
ekegusii: Na baria abakuani abanene bagakora boigo, bakamokorera echeche amo naborokia b’amariiko na abagaaka, bakobora,
swahili: Vivyo hivyo, viongozi wa makuhani, walimu wa sheria pamoja na wazee wakamdhihaki wakisema,

english: “He saved others, but He cannot save Himself. He is the King of Israel! Let Him come down now from the cross, and we will believe in Him.
ekegusii: “Natooretie abande, ere omonyene takonyara gwetooria. Ere n’Omorwoti bw’Abaisraeli, tiga aike bono korwa ase omosalaba, na intwe rirorio ntomwegene.
swahili: “Aliwaokoa wengine, lakini hawezi kujiokoa mwenyewe! Yeye ni Mfalme wa Israeli! Ashuke sasa kutoka msalabani, nasi tutamwamini.

english: He trusts in God. Let God deliver Him now if He wants Him. For He said, ‘I am the Son of God.’”
ekegusii: Nigo asemeretie Nyasae, tiga Nyasae amotoorie bono, onye omoganetie, ekiagera nateebete: Inche n’Omwana o Nyasae.”
swahili: Anamwamini Mungu, basi Mungu na amwokoe sasa kama anamtaka, kwa maana alisema, ‘Mimi ni Mwana wa Mungu.’ ”

english: In the same way, even the robbers who were crucified with Him berated Him. The Death of Jesus (Psalms 22:1–31; Mark 15:33–41; Luke 23:44–49; John 19:28–30)
ekegusii: Na baria abauri, abaabambetwe amo nere, bakamorama boigo. Ogokwa kwa Yeso (Mar 15:33-41; Luk 23:44-49; Yoh 19:28-30)
swahili: Hata wale wanyangʼanyi waliosulubiwa pamoja naye wakamtukana vivyo hivyo. Kifo Cha Yesu (Marko 15:33-41; Luka 23:44-49; Yohana 19:28-30)

english: From the sixth hour until the ninth hour darkness came over all the land.
ekegusii: Bono korwa chinsa isano nemo omosunte okaba igoro ase ense yonsi goika chinsa kianda.
swahili: Tangu saa sita hadi saa tisa giza liliifunika nchi yote.

english: About the ninth hour Jesus cried out in a loud voice, “Eli, Eli, lema sabachthani?” which means, “My God, My God, why have You forsaken Me?”
ekegusii: Chiachia koba ang’e chinsa kianda, Yeso, akarera neriogi rinene, akabora, “Eloi, Eloi, lama sabakitani?” Okoonchorwa kwaye, “Nyasae one, Nyasae one, naki gwantigire?”
swahili: Ilipofika saa tisa, Yesu akapaza sauti akalia, “Eloi, Eloi, lama sabakthani?” (maana yake, “Mungu wangu, Mungu wangu, mbona umeniacha?” )

english: When some of those standing there heard this, they said, “He is calling Elijah.”
ekegusii: Na abande b’abwo bateneine aroro, bakayaigwa, bakaboora, “Omonto oyo n’Elija akorangeria.”
swahili: Baadhi ya watu waliokuwa wamesimama pale waliposikia hayo, wakasema, “Anamwita Eliya.”

english: One of them quickly ran and brought a sponge. He filled it with sour wine, put it on a reed, and held it up for Jesus to drink.
ekegusii: Erio kegima oyomo obo akaimokia esifunchi, akayeichoria chinkama, akayebeeka ase egetonto, akamoa anywe.
swahili: Ghafula mmoja wao akaenda mbio na kuleta sifongo, akaichovya kwenye siki, akaiweka kwenye mwanzi na akampa Yesu ili anywe.

english: But the others said, “Leave Him alone. Let us see if Elijah comes to save Him.”
ekegusii: Korende baria abande bakaboora, “Tiga torore gose Elija ngocha are komotooria.”
swahili: Wengine wakasema, “Basi mwacheni. Hebu tuone kama Eliya atakuja kumwokoa.”

english: So Judas threw the silver into the temple and left. Then he went away and hanged himself.
ekegusii: Yudasi agatuguta chitaabu chiria chi’echifeta ase Hekalu ime, akaimoka, akagenda akeng’enta.
swahili: Basi Yuda akavitupa vile vipande vya fedha ndani ya Hekalu akaondoka akaenda kujinyonga.

english: When Jesus had cried out again in a loud voice, He yielded up His spirit.
ekegusii: Yeso akarera naende neriogi rinene, erio agatweka mo.
swahili: Yesu alipolia tena kwa sauti kuu, akaitoa roho yake.

english: At that moment the veil of the temple was torn in two from top to bottom. The earth quaked and the rocks were split.
ekegusii: Na rora, egetambaa gi’okonacha Hekalu kegatandoka korwa igoro goika inse, gekaba bibere, ense egatengecha, ebitare bigatandoka.
swahili: Wakati huo huo pazia la Hekalu likachanika vipande viwili, kuanzia juu hadi chini. Dunia ikatetemeka na miamba ikapasuka.

english: The tombs broke open, and the bodies of many saints who had fallen asleep were raised.
ekegusii: Chimbeera chikamaanoka chigaasama, na abanto abange abachenu konya bakuure bakabokigwa.
swahili: Makaburi yakafunguka na miili ya watakatifu waliokuwa wamekufa ikafufuliwa.

english: After Jesus’ resurrection, when they had come out of the tombs, they entered the holy city and appeared to many people.
ekegusii: Kabaruure ase chimbeera, magega y’okoboka kwa Yeso bagasoa ase omochie omochenu agwo ase abanto abange babaroche.
swahili: Wakatoka makaburini, na baada ya Yesu kufufuka, waliingia kwenye Mji Mtakatifu na kuwatokea watu wengi.

english: When the centurion and those with him who were guarding Jesus saw the earthquake and all that had happened, they were terrified and said, “Truly this was the Son of God.”
ekegusii: Na ekero omotang’ani bw’abarwani rigana, na abwo barenge amo nere korenda Yeso, bachia korora omotengecho bw’ense na ebiakorekire, bakairoka mono, bakaboora, “Ekeene, oyo nigo arenge Omwana o Nyasae!”
swahili: Basi yule jemadari na wale waliokuwa pamoja naye wakimlinda Yesu walipoona lile tetemeko na yale yote yaliyokuwa yametukia, waliogopa, wakasema, “Hakika huyu alikuwa Mwana wa Mungu!”

english: And many women were there, watching from a distance. They had followed Jesus from Galilee to minister to Him.
ekegusii: Mbarengeo boigo abakungu abange, barigereretie korwa are, abatunyanete Yeso korwa Galili, bakomokorera.
swahili: Walikuwako wanawake huko wakiangalia kwa mbali. Hawa walikuwa wamemfuata Yesu tangu Galilaya ili kushughulikia mahitaji yake.

english: Among them were Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James and Joseph, and the mother of Zebedee’s sons. The Burial of Jesus (Isaiah 53:9–12; Mark 15:42–47; Luke 23:50–56; John 19:38–42)
ekegusii: Ase abwo nigo barenge Mariamu Magadalena, na Mariamu ng’ina Yakobo na Yusufu, na ng’ina ’abana ba Zebedi. Ogotindekwa kwa Yeso (Mar 15:42-47; Luk 23:50-56; Yoh 19:38-42)
swahili: Miongoni mwao walikuwepo Maria Magdalene, na Maria mama yao Yakobo na Yosefu, na mama yao wana wa Zebedayo. Maziko Ya Yesu (Marko 15:42-47; Luka 23:50-56; Yohana 19:38-42)

english: When it was evening, there came a rich man from Arimathea named Joseph, who himself was a disciple of Jesus.
ekegusii: Riachia koba mogoroba, omonto omonda bw’Arimathaya, okorokwa Yusufu, agacha; ere nomworokigwa o Yeso orenge.
swahili: Ilipofika jioni, alifika mtu mmoja tajiri kutoka Arimathaya aitwaye Yosefu, ambaye pia alikuwa mwanafunzi wa Yesu.

english: He went to Pilate to ask for the body of Jesus, and Pilate ordered that it be given to him.
ekegusii: Oyio akagenda ase Pilato, akarigia omobere o Yeso. Erio Pilato agachiika ayoegwe.
swahili: Akamwendea Pilato ili kumwomba mwili wa Yesu. Pilato akaamuru apewe.

english: So Joseph took the body, wrapped it in a clean linen cloth,
ekegusii: Yusufu akaimokia omobere, akayoboyia egetambaa ekiya ki’egatani,
swahili: Yosefu akauchukua mwili wa Yesu, akaufunga katika kitambaa cha kitani safi,

english: The chief priests picked up the pieces of silver and said, “It is unlawful to put this into the treasury, since it is blood money.”
ekegusii: Korende abakuani abanene bakaimokia chitaabu chiria chi’echifeta bakaboora, “Tari boronge gochibeeka ase ekungo y’esadaka ya Nyasae, ekiagera chirochio nechie rigori ri’amanyinga.”
swahili: Wale viongozi wa makuhani wakazichukua zile fedha wakasema, “Si halali kuchanganya fedha hizi na sadaka kwa sababu hizi ni fedha zenye damu.”
