english: and placed it in his own new tomb that he had cut into the rock. Then he rolled a great stone across the entrance to the tomb and went away.
ekegusii: akayobeka ase oboina bwaye oboyia, obwabachete ase egetare; naende agaturunkania rigena rinene gochia ase egesieri ki’oboina, akagenda.
swahili: na kuuweka katika kaburi lake mwenyewe jipya, alilokuwa amelichonga kwenye mwamba. Kisha akavingirisha jiwe kubwa katika ingilio la kaburi, akaenda zake.

english: Mary Magdalene and the other Mary were sitting there opposite the tomb. The Guards at the Tomb
ekegusii: Mbarengeo Mariamu Magadalena na Mariamu onde, baikaransete bosio bw’oboina. Oboina bokorendwa
swahili: Maria Magdalene na yule Maria mwingine walikuwepo mahali pale, wakiwa wameketi mkabala na kaburi. Walinzi Pale Kaburini

english: The next day, the one after Preparation Day, the chief priests and Pharisees assembled before Pilate.
ekegusii: Rituko ria kabere, erio riare rituko ri’Esabato, abakuani abanene na Abafarisai bagasangererekana ase Pilato,
swahili: Kesho yake, yaani siku iliyofuata ile ya Maandalizi ya Sabato, viongozi wa makuhani na Mafarisayo wakamwendea Pilato

english: “Sir,” they said, “we remember that while He was alive that deceiver said, ‘After three days I will rise again.’
ekegusii: bakaboora, “Omonene, twainyoire ng’a omong’ainereria oria nateebete ekero arenge moyo: Magega ase amatuko atato nimboke.
swahili: na kusema, “Bwana, tumekumbuka kwamba yule mdanganyifu wakati alikuwa bado hai alisema, ‘Baada ya siku tatu nitafufuka.’

english: So give the order that the tomb be secured until the third day. Otherwise, His disciples may come and steal Him away and tell the people He has risen from the dead. And this last deception would be worse than the first.”
ekegusii: Gaki, chiika oboina borendwe buya goika rituko ria gatato, aborokigwa baye tibaabaisa gocha komoiba, bateebie abanto ng’a obokire korwa ase abakuure; oborimo bw’omoerio inabobue boria bw’eritang’ani.”
swahili: Kwa hiyo uamuru kaburi lilindwe kwa uthabiti mpaka baada ya siku tatu. La sivyo, wanafunzi wake wanaweza kuja kuuiba mwili wake na kuwaambia watu kwamba amefufuliwa kutoka kwa wafu. Udanganyifu huu wa mwisho utakuwa mbaya kuliko ule wa kwanza.”

english: “You have a guard,” Pilate said. “Go, make the tomb as secure as you know how.”
ekegusii: Pilato akabateebia, “More nabarendi; genda morende mono oboina buna moranyaare.”
swahili: Pilato akawaambia, “Ninyi mnao askari walinzi. Nendeni, liwekeeni ulinzi kadri mwezavyo.”

english: So they went and secured the tomb by sealing the stone and posting the guard.
ekegusii: Ase igo bakagenda bakarenda oboina mono ase okobeeka rigena riria ekemanyererio, naende bakabeeka abarendi.
swahili: Kwa hiyo wakaenda na walinzi ili kulilinda kaburi kwa uthabiti, wakatia muhuri kwenye lile jiwe na kuweka ulinzi.

english: After conferring together, they used the money to buy the potter’s field as a burial place for foreigners.
ekegusii: Bakanacha ekiina giokogora omogondo bw’omokori chinyongo, obe aase bagotindeka abageni.
swahili: Kwa hiyo baada ya kushauriana, waliamua kuzitumia kununulia shamba la mfinyanzi, liwe mahali pa kuzikia wageni.

english: That is why it has been called the Field of Blood to this day.
ekegusii: Ase ayio omogondo oyo nigo okorokwa Omogondo bw’Amanyinga goika reero.
swahili: Hii ndiyo sababu lile shamba likaitwa Shamba la Damu hadi leo.

english: Then what was spoken through Jeremiah the prophet was fulfilled: “They took the thirty pieces of silver, the price set on Him by the people of Israel,
ekegusii: Erio rigaikeranigwa eriatebetwe nomobani Yeremia, ogoteeba, “Bakaimokia chitaabu chiria chi’echifeta emerongo etato, rigori riaye oria obegetwe rigori n’abanto bande b’Abaisraeli,
swahili: Ndipo likatimia lile lililonenwa na nabii Yeremia, kwamba, “Walichukua vile vipande thelathini vya fedha, thamani aliyopangiwa na watu wa Israeli,

english: After the Sabbath, at dawn on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary went to see the tomb.
ekegusii: Esabato egachia koera, kobogokiamoka rituko ria Jumapili, Mariamu Magadalena na oria Mariamu onde bakagenda korora oboina.
swahili: Baada ya Sabato, alfajiri mapema siku ya kwanza ya juma, Maria Magdalene na yule Maria mwingine walikwenda kulitazama kaburi.

english: “Do not be afraid,” said Jesus. “Go and tell My brothers to go to Galilee. There they will see Me.” The Report of the Guards
ekegusii: Erio Yeso akabateebia, “Timoiroka! Genda moteebie abaminto bagende Galili, nao barandore.” Amang’ana y’abarendi boboina
swahili: Ndipo Yesu akawaambia, “Msiogope. Nendeni mkawaambie ndugu zangu waende Galilaya, ndiko watakakoniona.” Taarifa Ya Walinzi

english: While the women were on their way, some of the guards went into the city and reported to the chief priests all that had happened.
ekegusii: Ekero abakungu baria bachire, rora abande b’abarendi baria boboina bagasoa ase omochie, bagateebia abakuani abanene amang’ana onsi ayakoregete.
swahili: Wakati wale wanawake walikuwa njiani wakienda, baadhi ya wale askari waliokuwa wakilinda kaburi walienda mjini na kuwaeleza viongozi wa makuhani kila kitu kilichokuwa kimetukia.

english: And after the chief priests had met with the elders and formed a plan, they gave the soldiers a large sum of money
ekegusii: Abakuani abanene bakaumerana amo n’abagaaka, bakaroisia omoroberio erio bakaa abarendi baria chitaabu chinyinge,
swahili: Baada ya viongozi wa makuhani kukutana na wazee na kutunga hila, waliwapa wale askari kiasi kikubwa cha fedha

english: and instructed them: “You are to say, ‘His disciples came by night and stole Him away while we were asleep.’
ekegusii: bakaboora, “Moteebie abanto: Aborokigwa baye mbachete botuko, bakamoiba ekero twararire.
swahili: wakiwaambia, “Inawapasa mseme, ‘Wanafunzi wake walikuja wakati wa usiku na kumwiba sisi tulipokuwa tumelala.’

english: If this report reaches the governor, we will satisfy him and keep you out of trouble.”
ekegusii: Ring’ana eri koriraigweke ase gabana, intwe natoche tokwane nere, tomoebererie, na kobarusia inwe ase emechando.”
swahili: Kama habari hizi zikimfikia mtawala, sisi tutamwondolea mashaka nanyi hamtapata tatizo lolote.”

english: So the guards took the money and did as they were instructed. And this account has been circulated among the Jews to this very day. The Great Commission (Mark 16:14–18)
ekegusii: Bakabogoria chitaabu chiria, bagakora buna bateebetigwe, na omogano oyo okumire ase Abayahudi goika reero iga. Yeso okoorokera aborokigwa baye
swahili: Kwa hiyo wale askari wakazipokea hizo fedha nao wakafanya kama walivyoelekezwa. Habari hii imeenea miongoni mwa Wayahudi mpaka leo. Yesu Awatuma Wanafunzi Wake (Marko 16:14-18; Luka 24:36-49; Yohana 20:19-23; Matendo 1:6-8)

english: Meanwhile, the eleven disciples went to Galilee, to the mountain Jesus had designated.
ekegusii: Aborokigwa baria ikomi nomo bakagenda Galili, bagaika egetunwa keria Yeso abachiigete.
swahili: Basi wale wanafunzi kumi na mmoja wakaenda hadi Galilaya kwenye ule mlima ambao Yesu alikuwa amewaagiza.

english: When they saw Him, they worshiped Him, but some doubted.
ekegusii: Ekero bachia komorora, bakamosasiima; korende abande mbabete n’echitang’utang’u.
swahili: Walipomwona, wakamwabudu; lakini baadhi yao wakaona shaka.

english: Then Jesus came to them and said, “All authority in heaven and on earth has been given to Me.
ekegusii: Yeso agacha ange nabarabwo akabateebia, “Naeirwe okobua gwonsi igoro na ense.
swahili: Yesu akawajia na kusema, “Nimepewa mamlaka yote mbinguni na duniani.

english: Therefore go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit,
ekegusii: Gaki genda mokore ebisaku bionsi koba aborokigwa, mokobaabatisa ase erieta ria Tata, neri’Omwana, neri’Omoika Omochenu,
swahili: Kwa sababu hii, enendeni mkawafanye mataifa yote kuwa wanafunzi, mkiwabatiza kwa Jina la Baba na la Mwana na la Roho Mtakatifu,

english: Suddenly there was a great earthquake, for an angel of the Lord descended from heaven, rolled away the stone, and sat on it.
ekegusii: Na rora, norengeo omotengecho omonene, ekiagera omomalaika bw’Omonene aigete korwa igoro, agachia agatigeria rigena riria, akariikaransera.
swahili: Ghafula, pakawa na tetemeko kubwa la ardhi, kwa sababu malaika wa Bwana alishuka kutoka mbinguni, akaenda penye kaburi, akalivingirisha lile jiwe na kulikalia.

english: and teaching them to obey all that I have commanded you. And surely I am with you always, even to the end of the age.”
ekegusii: mokoborokereria kobwata aya onsi nabachiikire; na rora, inche nigo inde amo nainwe amatuko onsi goika omoerio bw’ense.”
swahili: nanyi wafundisheni kuyashika mambo yote niliyowaamuru ninyi. Hakika mimi niko pamoja nanyi siku zote, hadi mwisho wa nyakati.”

english: His appearance was like lightning, and his clothes were white as snow.
ekegusii: Ekieni kiaye nigo kiarenge buna okomesa kw’embura, na eyanga yaye nendabu buna amagena y’embura.
swahili: Sura ya huyo malaika ilikuwa kama umeme, na mavazi yake yalikuwa meupe kama theluji.

english: The guards trembled in fear of him and became like dead men.
ekegusii: Ase okomoiroka ere abarendi bakaiguswa, bakaba buna abanto bakuure.
swahili: Wale walinzi wa kaburi walimwogopa sana, wakatetemeka hata wakawa kama wafu.

english: But the angel said to the women, “Do not be afraid, for I know that you are looking for Jesus, who was crucified.
ekegusii: Korende omomalaika agateebia abakungu baria, “Timoiroka inwe, ekiagera namanyire ng’a Yeso mokorigia, oria obambetwe.
swahili: Yule malaika akawaambia wale wanawake, “Msiogope, kwa maana ninajua kuwa mnamtafuta Yesu aliyesulubiwa.

english: He is not here; He has risen, just as He said! Come, see the place where He lay.
ekegusii: Tari aiga, ekiagera obokire, buna ateebete. Inchuo, morigererie aase Omonene araire.
swahili: Hayupo hapa, kwa kuwa amefufuka, kama vile alivyosema. Njooni mpatazame mahali alipokuwa amelazwa.

english: Then go quickly and tell His disciples, ‘He has risen from the dead and is going ahead of you into Galilee. There you will see Him.’ See, I have told you.”
ekegusii: Na genda bwango, moteebie aborokigwa baye ng’a obokire korwa ase abakuure; na rora, obatang’aneire kogenda Galili; agwo nao moramorore. Rora, inche nabatebirie ayio.”
swahili: Kisha nendeni upesi mkawaambie wanafunzi wake kwamba, ‘Amefufuka kutoka kwa wafu, naye awatangulia kwenda Galilaya. Huko ndiko mtamwona. Sasa nimekwisha kuwaambia.’ ”

english: So they hurried away from the tomb in fear and great joy, and ran to tell His disciples.
ekegusii: Bakaimoka korwa ase oboina bwango, bare nokoiroka na omogooko omonene, bakaminyoka, bakairera aborokigwa baye amang’ana.
swahili: Hivyo wale wanawake wakaondoka pale kaburini wakiwa wamejawa na hofu, bali wakiwa na furaha nyingi. Wakaenda mbio kuwaeleza wanafunzi wake habari hizo.

english: Suddenly Jesus met them and said, “Greetings!” They came to Him, grasped His feet, and worshiped Him.
ekegusii: Na rora, Yeso akaumerana na barabwo, akabakwania, “Omorembe obe nainwe!” Na barabwo bagaacha, bakamobwata amagoro, bakamosasiima.
swahili: Ghafula, Yesu akakutana nao, akasema, “Salamu!” Wale wanawake wakamkaribia, wakaishika miguu yake, wakamwabudu.

english: After Jesus was born in Bethlehem in Judea, during the time of King Herod, Magi from the east arrived in Jerusalem,
ekegusii: Yeso nigo aiboretwe ase omochie o Bethlehemu ime ya Boyahudi, ase amatuko aria Herode arenge omorwoti. Matuko make igo nyuma kaiboirwe, abaringoria b’eching’enang’eni bagacha korwa moocha goika Yerusalemu.
swahili: Baada ya Yesu kuzaliwa katika mji wa Bethlehemu huko Uyahudi, wakati wa utawala wa Mfalme Herode, wataalamu wa mambo ya nyota kutoka mashariki walifika Yerusalemu

english: On coming to the house, they saw the Child with His mother Mary, and they fell down and worshiped Him. Then they opened their treasures and presented Him with gifts of gold and frankincense and myrrh.
ekegusii: Bakagenda bagasoa nyomba, bakarora omwana amo na Mariamu ng’ina, bagatung’ama inse, bakamosasiima. Erio bagakuunora chinibo chiabo, bakamokwaneria ebinto ebiya, etaabu, na ubani, na manemane.
swahili: Walipoingia ndani ya ile nyumba, wakamwona mtoto pamoja na Maria mama yake, wakamsujudu na kumwabudu yule mtoto Yesu. Ndipo wakafungua hazina zao, wakamtolea zawadi za dhahabu, uvumba na manemane.

english: And having been warned in a dream not to return to Herod, they withdrew to their country by another route. The Flight to Egypt (Hosea 11:1–7)
ekegusii: Erio bakairana gochia soobo bakabwatia enchera eng’ao ekiagera Nyasae konya obakuureire ase chindoto nga tibairanera ase Herode. Ogotamigwa kw’Omwana gochia Misiri
swahili: Nao wakiisha kuonywa katika ndoto wasirudi kwa Herode, wakarudi kwenda katika nchi yao kwa njia nyingine. Yosefu, Maria Na Mtoto Yesu Wakimbilia Misri

english: When the Magi had gone, an angel of the Lord appeared to Joseph in a dream. “Get up!” he said. “Take the Child and His mother and flee to Egypt. Stay there until I tell you, for Herod is going to search for the Child to kill Him.”
ekegusii: Magega k’abageni baria bachiire, omomalaika bw’Omonene akaorokera Yusufu ase chindoto, akamoteebia, “Imoka korwa aa, oire omwana na ng’ina, otame gochia Misiri, omenye aroro goika ngoteebie, ekiagera Herode narigie omwana oyo anyare komoita.”
swahili: Walipokwisha kwenda zao, malaika wa Bwana akamtokea Yosefu katika ndoto akamwambia, “Ondoka, mchukue mtoto na mama yake mkimbilie Misri. Kaeni huko mpaka nitakapowaambia, kwa maana Herode anataka kumtafuta huyu mtoto ili amuue.”

english: So he got up, took the Child and His mother by night, and withdrew to Egypt,
ekegusii: Ere akaimoka botuko, akaira omwana oria na ng’ina, akagenda Misiri,
swahili: Kisha Yosefu akaondoka, akamchukua mtoto pamoja na mama yake wakati wa usiku, nao wakaenda Misri

english: where he stayed until the death of Herod. This fulfilled what the Lord had spoken through the prophet: “Out of Egypt I called My Son.” Weeping and Great Mourning (Jeremiah 31:1–25)
ekegusii: akamenya aroro goika Herode agakwa, erinde rinyare goikerana eriateebetwe n’Omonene ase omonwa bw’omobani, “Korwa Misiri nkarangeria omwana one.” Herode ogoita abana ba Bethlehemu
swahili: ambako walikaa mpaka Herode alipofariki. Hili lilifanyika ili litimie lile lililonenwa na Bwana kwa kinywa cha nabii kusema: “Nilimwita mwanangu kutoka Misri.”

english: When Herod saw that he had been outwitted by the Magi, he was filled with rage. Sending orders, he put to death all the boys in Bethlehem and its vicinity who were two years old and under, according to the time he had learned from the Magi.
ekegusii: Ekero Herode achia korora ng’a ochaayirwe n’ abaringoria baria b’eching’enang’eni, akaba nekeririanda ekenene mono, agatoma abanto goita abana abaisia bonsi abarenge Bethlehemu ne chinsemo chiaye chionsi, abwo barenge inse y’emiaka ebere, koreng’ana n’ekero keria atebetigwe n’abanto baria abang’aini.
swahili: Herode alipongʼamua kwamba wale wataalamu wa nyota wamemshinda kwa akili, alikasirika sana, naye akatoa amri ya kuwaua watoto wote wa kiume wenye umri wa miaka miwili kurudi chini katika mji wa Bethlehemu na sehemu zote za jirani, kufuatana na ule muda alioambiwa na wale wataalamu wa nyota.

english: Then what was spoken through the prophet Jeremiah was fulfilled:
ekegusii: Ekero ekio rigaikerana eriatebetwe nomobani Yeremia,
swahili: Ndipo lilipotimia neno lililonenwa na nabii Yeremia.

english: “A voice is heard in Ramah, weeping and great mourning, Rachel weeping for her children, and refusing to be comforted, because they are no more.” The Return to Nazareth (Luke 2:39–40)
ekegusii: “Eriogi riaigurwe Rama, okorera na okweumia. Raeli nkoreera are abana baye, tancheti akirigwe, ekiagera bonsi bakuure.” Okoiranigwa kw’Omwana korwa Misiri
swahili: “Sauti ilisikika huko Rama, maombolezo na kilio kikubwa, Raheli akilia kwa ajili ya wanawe, akikataa kufarijiwa, kwa sababu hawako tena.” Kurudi Kutoka Misri

english: After Herod died, an angel of the Lord appeared in a dream to Joseph in Egypt.
ekegusii: Magega Herode gakuure, omomalaika bw’Omonene akamoorokera Yusufu aria Misiri ase chindoto, akamoteebia,
swahili: Baada ya Herode kufa, malaika wa Bwana akamtokea Yosefu katika ndoto huko Misri

english: asking, “Where is the One who has been born King of the Jews? We saw His star in the east and have come to worship Him.”
ekegusii: Erio bakaboria “Ng’ai are omwana oiborwe oyio orabe omorwoti bw’Abayahudi? Nigo twaroche eng’enang’eni yaye ekero yachete agwo igoro ime ya moocha, naende intwe nigo twachire komosasiima.”
swahili: wakiuliza, “Yuko wapi huyo aliyezaliwa mfalme wa Wayahudi? Kwa maana tumeona nyota yake ikitokea mashariki, nasi tumekuja kumwabudu.”

english: “Get up!” he said. “Take the Child and His mother and go to the land of Israel, for those seeking the Child’s life are now dead.”
ekegusii: “Imoka, oire omwana na ng’ina, mogende ase ense ya Israeli, ekiagera baria barenge korigia obogima bw’omwana bakuure.”
swahili: na kusema, “Ondoka, mchukue mtoto na mama yake mwende, mrudi katika nchi ya Israeli kwa sababu wale waliokuwa wanatafuta uhai wa mtoto wamekufa.”

english: So Joseph got up, took the Child and His mother, and went to the land of Israel.
ekegusii: Akaimoka, akaira omwana amo na ng’ina, akagenda ase ense ya Israeli.
swahili: Basi Yosefu, akaondoka akamchukua mtoto na mama yake wakaenda mpaka nchi ya Israeli.

english: But when he learned that Archelaus was reigning in Judea in place of his father Herod, he was afraid to go there. And having been warned in a dream, he withdrew to the district of Galilee,
ekegusii: Korende agachia koigwa ng’a Arikelau obekirwe oborwoti Boyahudi ase ribaga ria Herode ise, akairoka kogenda aroro, korende erio gakuureirwe na Nyasae ase okorota, akagenda ensemo ya Galili.
swahili: Lakini aliposikia kwamba Arkelao alikuwa anatawala huko Uyahudi mahali pa Herode baba yake, aliogopa kwenda huko. Naye akiisha kuonywa katika ndoto, akaenda zake sehemu za Galilaya,

english: and he went and lived in a town called Nazareth. So was fulfilled what was spoken through the prophets: “He will be called a Nazarene.”
ekegusii: Akagenda, akamenya omochie oyomo okorokwa Nazareti, rinyare goikerana eriatebetwe nababani, “Igo ararokwe Omonazareti.”
swahili: akaenda akaishi katika mji ulioitwa Nazareti. Hivyo likawa limetimia neno lililonenwa na manabii, “Ataitwa Mnazarayo.”

english: When King Herod heard this, he was disturbed, and all Jerusalem with him.
ekegusii: Ekero omorwoti Herode achia koigwa aya ere agaichana mono, nabo igo kera omonto ime ya Yerusalemu.
swahili: Mfalme Herode aliposikia jambo hili aliingiwa na hofu sana pamoja na watu wote wa Yerusalemu.

english: And when he had assembled all the chief priests and scribes of the people, he asked them where the Christ was to be born.
ekegusii: Ere akabarangeria amo abakuani abanene bonsi amo n’aborokia b’amachiiko akababoria, “Narai gose Kristo araiborerwe?”
swahili: Herode akawaita pamoja viongozi wa makuhani na walimu wa sheria, akawauliza ni mahali gani ambapo Kristo angezaliwa.

english: “In Bethlehem in Judea,” they replied, “for this is what the prophet has written:
ekegusii: Barabwo bakairaneria. Ase omochie o Bethlehemu ime ya Boyahudi, ekiagera aya naro omobani ariigete:
swahili: Nao wakamwambia, “Katika Bethlehemu ya Uyahudi, kwa maana hivyo ndivyo ilivyoandikwa na nabii:

english: ‘But you, Bethlehem, in the land of Judah, are by no means least among the rulers of Judah, for out of you will come a ruler who will be the shepherd of My people Israel.’ ”
ekegusii: ’Bethlehemu ase ense ya Yuda, ase enchera ende yonsi aye tori moke ase egati y’emechie emenene ya Yuda; ekiagera korwa ime yao nache omorai oyio orarae abanto baane ba Israeli.
swahili: “ ‘Nawe, Bethlehemu, katika nchi ya Yuda, wewe si mdogo miongoni mwa watawala wa Yuda; kwa maana kutoka kwako atakuja mtawala atakayekuwa mchungaji wa watu wangu Israeli.’ ”

english: Then Herod called the Magi secretly and learned from them the exact time the star had appeared.
ekegusii: Erio Herode akarangeria abageni baria barwete moocha agatwara okoumerana kwa bobisi nabarabwo, erio akamanya korwa ase bare kegima chingaki eng’enang’eni eria yarorekanete.
swahili: Ndipo Herode akawaita wale wataalamu wa nyota kwa siri na kutaka kujua kutoka kwao uhakika kamili wa wakati ile nyota ilionekana.

english: And sending them to Bethlehem, he said: “Go and search carefully for the Child, and when you find Him, report to me, so that I too may go and worship Him.”
ekegusii: Akabatoma goika Bethlehemu, n’amang’ana akobwatia: “Genda morigie buya omwana oyio, ekero moramonyore ere, nainche momanyie, erio nainche boigo ingende komosasiima ere.”
swahili: Kisha akawatuma waende Bethlehemu akiwaambia, “Nendeni mkamtafute kwa bidii huyo mtoto. Nanyi mara mtakapomwona, mniletee habari ili na mimi niweze kwenda kumwabudu.”

english: In those days John the Baptist came, preaching in the wilderness of Judea
ekegusii: Ase amatuko aria Yohana Omobatisi akaoroka ase erooro ya Boyahudi agachaaka korandia, ogoteeba,
swahili: Siku hizo Yohana Mbatizaji alikuja akihubiri katika nyika ya Uyahudi, akisema,

english: The axe lies ready at the root of the trees, and every tree that does not produce good fruit will be cut down and thrown into the fire.
ekegusii: Nonya mbono egesire kiabekirwe ase emeri y’emete; nabo kera omote otaameti okwama okuya nonachwe, otugutwe ase omorero.
swahili: Hata sasa shoka limeshawekwa tayari kwenye shina la kila mti, basi kila mti usiozaa matunda mazuri, hukatwa na kutupwa motoni.

english: I baptize you with water for repentance, but after me will come One more powerful than I, whose sandals I am not worthy to carry. He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and with fire.
ekegusii: “Inche n’amaache nkobabatisera ase okoonchoka, korende ere, oyoraache magega y’ane, nare ne chinguru kombua. Ting’isaini koimokia ebikoroto biaye. N’ere orababatise ase Omoika Omochenu na ase omorero.
swahili: “Mimi nawabatiza kwa maji kwa ajili ya toba. Lakini nyuma yangu anakuja yeye aliye na uwezo kuliko mimi, ambaye sistahili hata kuvichukua viatu vyake. Yeye atawabatiza kwa Roho Mtakatifu na kwa moto.

english: His winnowing fork is in His hand to clear His threshing floor and to gather His wheat into the barn; but He will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire.” The Baptism of Jesus (Mark 1:9–11; Luke 3:21–22; John 1:29–34)
ekegusii: Oroteru rw’aye nigo rore koboko kwaye, ere naabuse ekeooreri kia’ye, nasangererie engano ase ekiage kiaye, korende omoiruro nayosambe ase omorero otakorimeka.” Okobatiswa kwa Yeso (Mar 1:9-11; Luk 3:21-22)
swahili: Pepeto lake liko mkononi mwake, naye atasafisha sakafu yake ya kupuria, na kuikusanya ngano ghalani na kuyateketeza makapi kwa moto usiozimika.” Yesu Abatizwa (Marko 1:9-11; Luka 3:21-22)

english: At that time Jesus came from Galilee to the Jordan to be baptized by John.
ekegusii: Ekero ekio Yeso akarua Galili, akagenda ase Yohana ase orooche rwa Yorodani abatiswe nere.
swahili: Kisha Yesu akaja kutoka Galilaya mpaka Mto Yordani ili Yohana ambatize.

english: But John tried to prevent Him, saying, “I need to be baptized by You, and do You come to me?”
ekegusii: Korende Yohana akarigia kwanga, agateeba, “Inche ndigetie kobatiswa naye, na aye kogocha ase ’nde?”
swahili: Lakini Yohana akajitahidi kumzuia, akimwambia, “Mimi ninahitaji kubatizwa na wewe, nawe waja kwangu nikubatize?”

english: “Let it be so now,” Jesus replied. “It is fitting for us to fulfill all righteousness in this way.” Then John permitted Him.
ekegusii: Korende Yeso akamoiraneria, “Ancha ebe iga bono, ekiagera naboigo etogwenerete goikerania oboronge bwonsi.” Erio agwo Yohana akamwanchera.
swahili: Lakini Yesu akamjibu, “Kubali hivi sasa, kwa maana ndivyo itupasavyo kwa njia hii kuitimiza haki yote.” Hivyo Yohana akakubali.

english: As soon as Jesus was baptized, He went up out of the water. Suddenly the heavens were opened, and He saw the Spirit of God descending like a dove and resting on Him.
ekegusii: Na Yeso, ekero abatisirwe, agendererete gotiira korwa ase amaache ime; igoro ekamaanoka, na ere akarora Omoika o Nyasae ogoika buna riruma, ogocha igoro ase are.
swahili: Naye Yesu alipokwisha kubatizwa, mara alipotoka ndani ya maji, ghafula mbingu zikafunguka, akamwona Roho wa Mungu akishuka kama hua na kutulia juu yake.

english: And a voice from heaven said, “This is My beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased!”
ekegusii: Na rora, eriogi rikarwa igoro rigateeba, “Oyo nere Omwana one omwanchwa, oyio ngokirie nere.”
swahili: Nayo sauti kutoka mbinguni ikasema, “Huyu ni Mwanangu mpendwa, ambaye ninapendezwa sana naye.”

english: and saying, “Repent, for the kingdom of heaven is near.”
ekegusii: “Onchoka, ekiagera oborwoti bwa igoro bwaikire ang’e!”
swahili: “Tubuni, kwa maana Ufalme wa Mbinguni umekaribia.”

english: This is he who was spoken of through the prophet Isaiah: “A voice of one calling in the wilderness, ‘Prepare the way for the Lord, make straight paths for Him.’”
ekegusii: Oyo Yohana nere oteebetwe n’omobani Isaya, ekero ateebete, “Eriogi ri’oyogoaka egeturi ase erooro: Roisia enchera y’Omonene, rongeyia oboeto bwaye.”
swahili: Huyu ndiye yule aliyenenwa habari zake na nabii Isaya aliposema: “Sauti ya mtu aliaye huko nyikani, ‘Tayarisheni njia kwa ajili ya Bwana, yanyoosheni mapito yake.’ ”

english: John wore a garment of camel’s hair, with a leather belt around his waist. His food was locusts and wild honey.
ekegusii: Ere Yohana nigo arenge kobeeka chianga chiaroiseirie amarionya y’engamia na kweboeria orokini rwe riiyo kenama kiaye, na endagera yaye nigo yarenge chingige na obooke bw’orosana.
swahili: Basi Yohana alivaa mavazi yaliyotengenezwa kwa singa za ngamia, akiwa na mkanda wa ngozi kiunoni mwake. Chakula chake kilikuwa nzige na asali ya mwitu.

english: People went out to him from Jerusalem and all Judea and the whole region around the Jordan.
ekegusii: Engaki eyio abanto ba Yerusalemu, na Boyahudi yonsi, ne chinsemo chionsi chia Yorodani bakamochiera.
swahili: Watu walikuwa wakimwendea kutoka Yerusalemu, Uyahudi yote na nchi zote za kandokando ya Mto Yordani.

english: Confessing their sins, they were baptized by him in the Jordan River.
ekegusii: Bakangama ebibe biabo erio bakabatiswa nere ase orooche rwa Yorodani.
swahili: Nao wakaziungama dhambi zao, akawabatiza katika Mto Yordani.

english: But when John saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees coming to his place of baptism, he said to them, “You brood of vipers, who warned you to flee from the coming wrath?
ekegusii: Ekero Yohana arora abanto abange ase Abafarisai na Abasadukai bakomochiera erio ababatise, akabateebia, “Inwe oroiboro rwe chinchoka, ning’o obakuureire ng’a motame korwa ase endamwamu egochia‐gocha?
swahili: Lakini alipowaona Mafarisayo na Masadukayo wengi wakija ili kubatizwa, aliwaambia: “Ninyi watoto wa nyoka! Ni nani aliyewaonya kuikimbia ghadhabu inayokuja?

english: Produce fruit, then, in keeping with repentance.
ekegusii: Gaki, orokia ase ebikorwa buna ekeene mwaonchokire;
swahili: Basi zaeni matunda yastahiliyo toba.

english: And do not presume to say to yourselves, ‘We have Abraham as our father.’ For I tell you that out of these stones God can raise up children for Abraham.
ekegusii: gose timona goteeba ase emioyo yaino ime: Ntore na sokoro yaito Aburaamu, ekiagera nabateebirie, ng’a Nyasae n’are nokobua ase amagena aya gokorera Aburaamu abana.
swahili: Wala msidhani mnaweza kusema mioyoni mwenu kuwa, ‘Sisi tunaye Abrahamu, baba yetu.’ Nawaambia kuwa Mungu anaweza kumwinulia Abrahamu watoto kutoka kwa mawe haya.

english: Then Jesus was led by the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted by the devil.
ekegusii: Erio Yeso akaragwa n’Omoika gochia ase erooro gochia goteemwa na Saitani.
swahili: Kisha Yesu akaongozwa na Roho Mtakatifu kwenda nyikani ili akajaribiwe na ibilisi.

english: “Away from Me, Satan!” Jesus declared. “For it is written: ‘Worship the Lord your God and serve Him only.’ ”
ekegusii: Erio Yeso akamoteebia, Karue aa, Saitani! Ekiagera neriikire, “Osasiime Omonene Nyasae oo, omokorere ere bweka.”
swahili: Yesu akamwambia, “Ondoka mbele yangu, Shetani! Kwa maana imeandikwa, ‘Mwabudu Bwana Mungu wako, na umtumikie yeye peke yake.’ ”

english: Then the devil left Him, and angels came and ministered to Him. Jesus Begins His Ministry (Isaiah 9:1–7; Mark 1:14–15; Luke 4:14–15)
ekegusii: Erio Saitani akamotiga, na rora, abamalaika bagaacha, bakamokorera. Yeso ogochaaka emeremo yaye Galili (Mar 1:14-15; Luk 4:14-15)
swahili: Ndipo ibilisi akamwacha, nao malaika wakaja na kumhudumia. Yesu Aanza Kuhubiri (Marko 1:14-15; Luka 4:14-15)

english: When Jesus heard that John had been imprisoned, He withdrew to Galilee.
ekegusii: Ekero Yeso achia koigwa ng’a Yohana osibirwe echela, akaimoka, akagenda Galili.
swahili: Yesu aliposikia kwamba Yohana Mbatizaji alikuwa ametiwa gerezani, alirudi Galilaya.

english: Leaving Nazareth, He went and lived in Capernaum, which is by the sea in the region of Zebulun and Naphtali,
ekegusii: Akaimoka korwa Nazareti, akagenda, akamenya Kapernaumu, omochie ore ang’e n’enyancha ase chimbebe chia Sabuloni na Nafutali,
swahili: Akaondoka Nazareti akaenda kuishi Kapernaumu, mji ulioko karibu na bahari, katika mipaka ya nchi ya Zabuloni na Naftali,

english: to fulfill what was spoken through the prophet Isaiah:
ekegusii: rinyare goikerana eriatebetwe nomobani Isaya,
swahili: ili kutimiza unabii wa nabii Isaya, kama alivyosema:

english: “Land of Zebulun and land of Naphtali, the Way of the Sea, beyond the Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles—
ekegusii: “Ense ya Sabuloni na ense ya Nafutali, enchera egochia enyancha ng’umbu ya Yorodani, Galili, ense y’ abanto b’Ebisaku,
swahili: “Nchi ya Zabuloni na nchi ya Naftali, kwenye njia ya kuelekea baharini, ngʼambo ya Yordani, Galilaya ya watu wa Mataifa:

english: the people living in darkness have seen a great light; on those living in the land of the shadow of death, a light has dawned.”
ekegusii: abanto abamenyete omosunte ime, barorire omobaso omonene, na abamenyete ensemo y’ekiriri ki’amakweri, omobaso obabareire.”
swahili: watu wale waliokaa gizani wameona nuru kuu; nao wale walioishi katika nchi ya uvuli wa mauti, nuru imewazukia.”

english: From that time on Jesus began to preach, “Repent, for the kingdom of heaven is near.” The First Disciples (Mark 1:16–20; Luke 5:1–11; John 1:35–42)
ekegusii: Korwa ekero ekio Yeso agachaaka korandia, ogoteeba, “Onchoka, ekiagera oborwoti bwa igoro bwaikire ang’e. ” Yeso okorangeria aborokigwa baye b’eritang’ani (Mar 1:16-20; Luk 5:1-11)
swahili: Tangu wakati huo, Yesu alianza kuhubiri akisema: “Tubuni, kwa maana Ufalme wa Mbinguni umekaribia.” Yesu Awaita Wanafunzi Wake Wa Kwanza (Marko 1:16-20; Luka 5:1-11)

english: As Jesus was walking beside the Sea of Galilee, He saw two brothers, Simon called Peter and his brother Andrew. They were casting a net into the sea, for they were fishermen.
ekegusii: Ekero Yeso arenge gotaara ase engegu y’enyancha ya Galili, akarora abamura babere bamwabo abwo barenge abarubi, Simioni (oyokorokwa Petero), na Anderea omwabo, bakoruta ekeonga enyancha ime, erio barube chinswe.
swahili: Yesu alipokuwa anatembea kando ya Bahari ya Galilaya, aliwaona ndugu wawili, Simoni aitwaye Petro, na Andrea ndugu yake. Walikuwa wakizitupa nyavu zao baharini kwa kuwa wao walikuwa wavuvi.

english: “Come, follow Me,” Jesus said, “and I will make you fishers of men.”
ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Inchuo montuny’ane na inche nimbakore mobe abarubi b’abaanto.”
swahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Njooni, nifuateni nami nitawafanya mwe wavuvi wa watu.”

english: After fasting forty days and forty nights, He was hungry.
ekegusii: Akeng’ata ase egeka ki’amatuko emerongo ene, obotuko n’omobaso. Magega ase aya, enchara ekamoria.
swahili: Baada ya kufunga siku arobaini usiku na mchana, hatimaye akaona njaa.

english: And at once they left their nets and followed Him.
ekegusii: Erio agwo kegima bagatiga ebionga biabo, bakamotunyana.
swahili: Mara wakaziacha nyavu zao, wakamfuata.

english: Going on from there, He saw two other brothers, James son of Zebedee and his brother John. They were in a boat with their father Zebedee, mending their nets. Jesus called them,
ekegusii: Erio akagenda gochia motwe korwa aroro, akarora abamura babere bande bamwabo, Yakobo omwana o Zebedi, na Yohana omwabo, barenge obwato ime amo na Zebedi ise bakoroisia ebionga biabo, na barabwo akabarangeria.
swahili: Alipoendelea mbele kutoka pale, akawaona ndugu wengine wawili, Yakobo mwana wa Zebedayo na Yohana nduguye, wakiwa wamekaa kwenye mashua pamoja na baba yao Zebedayo, wakizitengeneza nyavu zao. Yesu akawaita.

english: and immediately they left the boat and their father and followed Him. Jesus Heals the Multitudes (Mark 3:7–12; Luke 6:17–19)
ekegusii: Erio kegima bagatiga obwato boria, bagatiga na ise, bakamotunyana. Yeso Okoranderia omoganda bw’abaanto (Luk 6:17-19)
swahili: Nao mara wakaiacha mashua yao, pamoja na baba yao, wakamfuata. Yesu Ahubiri Na Kuponya Wagonjwa (Luka 6:17-19)

english: Jesus went throughout Galilee, teaching in their synagogues, preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing every disease and sickness among the people.
ekegusii: Yeso nigo arenge kona goetanana ase ense engima ya Galili, okworokereria ase chisinagogi chiabo, okorandia amang’ana amaya y’oborwoti, okogwenia amarwaire onsi na oboreu bwonsi obwarenge ase abanto.
swahili: Yesu akapita katika Galilaya yote, akifundisha katika masinagogi yao, akihubiri habari njema za Ufalme, na akiponya kila ugonjwa na kila aina ya maradhi miongoni mwa watu.

english: News about Him spread all over Syria, and people brought to Him all who were ill with various diseases, those suffering acute pain, the demon-possessed, those having seizures, and the paralyzed—and He healed them.
ekegusii: Chinkuma chiaye chigasarera ase ense yonsi ya Siiria; bakamorentera abarwaire bonsi ababwatire namarwaire ao ao, y’obosareru, na ababwatire n’ebirecha, na abaare ne chindurume, na abarenge amagata, akabagwenia.
swahili: Kwa hiyo sifa zake zikaenea sehemu zote za Shamu, nao watu wakamletea wote waliokuwa na magonjwa mbalimbali na maumivu, waliopagawa na pepo wachafu, wenye kifafa na waliopooza, naye akawaponya.

english: The large crowds that followed Him came from Galilee, the Decapolis, Jerusalem, Judea, and beyond the Jordan.
ekegusii: Emeganda emenge ekamotunyana korwa Galili, na Dekapoli, na Yerusalemu, na Boyahudi, na ng’umbu ya Yorodani.
swahili: Makutano makubwa ya watu yakawa yanamjia kutoka Galilaya, Dekapoli, Yerusalemu, Uyahudi na kutoka ngʼambo ya Mto Yordani.

english: The tempter came to Him and said, “If You are the Son of God, tell these stones to become bread.”
ekegusii: Omoteemi agacha, akamoteebia, “Onye aye kore Omwana o Nyasae, teebia amagena aya abe omogati.”
swahili: Mjaribu akamjia na kumwambia, “Ikiwa wewe ndiye Mwana wa Mungu, amuru mawe haya yawe mikate.”

english: But Jesus answered, “It is written: ‘Man shall not live on bread alone, but on every word that comes from the mouth of God.’ ”
ekegusii: Korende Yeso akairaneria, “Neriikire: Omonto takomenya ase omogati bwoka, korende ase kera ring’ana rikorwa ase omonwa o Nyasae.”
swahili: Lakini Yesu akajibu, “Imeandikwa: ‘Mtu haishi kwa mkate tu, ila kwa kila neno litokalo katika kinywa cha Mungu.’ ”

english: Then the devil took Him to the holy city and set Him on the pinnacle of the temple.
ekegusii: Erio Saitani akamoira goika Yerusalemu omochie omochenu, akamobeka igoro ase egechuuria egetambe mono gie Hekalu.
swahili: Ndipo ibilisi akamchukua Yesu mpaka mji mtakatifu na kumweka juu ya mnara mrefu wa Hekalu,

english: “If You are the Son of God,” he said, “throw Yourself down. For it is written: ‘He will command His angels concerning You, and they will lift You up in their hands, so that You will not strike Your foot against a stone.’ ”
ekegusii: Akamoteebia, Onye aye kore Omwana o Nyasae, etugute gochia inse, ekiagera neriikire Nyasae nagochiikere abamalaika baye bakorende, na barabwo nabakoimokie ase amaboko abo, erinde togochwa okogoro kwao ne rigena.
swahili: akamwambia, “Kama wewe ndiwe Mwana wa Mungu jitupe chini. Kwa kuwa imeandikwa: “ ‘Atakuagizia malaika zake, nao watakuchukua mikononi mwao ili usije ukajikwaa mguu wako katika jiwe.’ ”

english: Jesus replied, “It is also written: ‘Do not put the Lord your God to the test.’ ”
ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Naende neriikire Toteema Omonene Nyasae oo.”
swahili: Yesu akamjibu, “Pia imeandikwa: ‘Usimjaribu Bwana Mungu wako.’ ”

english: Again, the devil took Him to a very high mountain and showed Him all the kingdoms of the world and their glory.
ekegusii: Naende Saitani akamoira ase ekegoro egetambe mono, akamworokia amarwoti onsi y’ense, na obonene bwabo,
swahili: Kwa mara nyingine, ibilisi akamchukua Yesu mpaka kwenye kilele cha mlima mrefu na kumwonyesha falme zote za dunia na fahari zake,

english: “All this I will give You,” he said, “if You will fall down and worship me.”
ekegusii: akamoteebia, “Ebi bionsi ninkoe, koratung’amere onsasiime.”
swahili: kisha akamwambia, “Nitakupa hivi vyote kama ukinisujudia na kuniabudu.”

english: When Jesus saw the crowds, He went up on the mountain and sat down. His disciples came to Him,
ekegusii: Yeso agachia korora emeganda eria y’abanto, agatiira gochia egetunwa igoro; na ekero aikaransire, aborokigwa baye bakamochiera.
swahili: Basi Yesu alipoona makutano, alipanda mlimani akaketi chini, nao wanafunzi wake wakamjia.

english: Blessed are those who are persecuted because of righteousness, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
ekegusii: Mbasesenirie abagochandwa ase engencho y’oboronge, ekiagera oborwoti bwa igoro nobwabo.
swahili: Heri wanaoteswa kwa sababu ya haki, maana Ufalme wa Mbinguni ni wao.

english: Blessed are you when people insult you, persecute you, and falsely say all kinds of evil against you because of Me.
ekegusii: Imosesenirie inwe, ekero abanto bakobarama na kobachaanda, na kobateebera kera ring’ana riibe ase oborimo, ase engencho y’ane.
swahili: “Heri ninyi watu watakapowashutumu, na kuwatesa na kunena dhidi yenu mabaya ya aina zote kwa uongo kwa ajili yangu.

english: Rejoice and be glad, because great is your reward in heaven; for in the same way they persecuted the prophets before you. Salt and Light (Mark 9:49–50; Luke 14:34–35; Philippians 2:12–18)
ekegusii: Goka na gochenga, ekiagera eng’eria yaino n’enene igoro. Inaki naboigo bachaandete ababani abarengeo ritang’ani konya motarabao. Omoonyo n’oborabu (Mar 9:50; 4:21; Luk 14:34-35; 8:16; 11:33)
swahili: Furahini na kushangilia kwa maana thawabu yenu ni kubwa mbinguni, kwa kuwa hivyo ndivyo walivyowatesa manabii waliokuwa kabla yenu. Chumvi Na Nuru (Marko 9:50; Luka 14:34-35)

english: You are the salt of the earth. But if the salt loses its savor, how can it be made salty again? It is no longer good for anything, except to be thrown out and trampled by men.
ekegusii: Inwe nomonyoo bw’ense; korende omoonyo korasirie obwansu bwaye, ninki orabekwe bwanse? Togwenereti gento kende otatiga ogotugutwa isiko, otirindachwe n’abanto.
swahili: “Ninyi ni chumvi ya ulimwengu. Lakini chumvi ikipoteza ladha yake, yawezaje kurudishiwa ladha yake tena? Haifai tena kwa kitu chochote, ila kutupwa nje ikanyagwe na watu.

english: You are the light of the world. A city on a hill cannot be hidden.
ekegusii: Inwe noborabu bw’ense. Omochie tokobiseka koagachire ase egetunwa igoro.
swahili: “Ninyi ni nuru ya ulimwengu. Mji uliojengwa kilimani hauwezi kufichika.

english: Neither do people light a lamp and put it under a basket. Instead, they set it on a stand, and it gives light to everyone in the house.
ekegusii: Nonya n’abanto tibagotongia etaya na koyemumeka negetonga, korende nigo bakoyebeeka igoro ase egetangora, ebae oborabu bonsi abare nyomba ime.
swahili: Wala watu hawawashi taa na kuifunika kwa bakuli. Badala yake, huiweka kwenye kinara chake, nayo hutoa mwanga kwa kila mtu aliyemo ndani ya ile nyumba.

english: In the same way, let your light shine before men, that they may see your good deeds and glorify your Father in heaven. The Fulfillment of the Law
ekegusii: Ase enchera eyio eyio, tiga omobaso oino obare boigo ase abanto, erio barore emeremo yaino emiya, batogie Iso oino ore igoro. Amorokererio korwa ase ogochika
swahili: Vivyo hivyo, nuru yenu iangaze mbele ya watu, ili wapate kuona matendo yenu mema wamtukuze Baba yenu aliye mbinguni. Kutimiza Sheria

english: Do not think that I have come to abolish the Law or the Prophets. I have not come to abolish them, but to fulfill them.
ekegusii: Timokaga ng’a nigo nachire gosaria amachiiko, gose amang’ana y’ababani; tincheti kobisaria, korende ase okobiikerania.
swahili: “Msidhani kwamba nimekuja kufuta Sheria au Manabii; sikuja kuondoa bali kutimiza.

english: For I tell you truly, until heaven and earth pass away, not a single jot, not a stroke of a pen, will disappear from the Law until everything is accomplished.
ekegusii: Ekeene nabateebirie ng’a, goika igoro na ense biete, korende tegoeta enuguta eyemo gose agatone akamo ase amachiiko, goika bionsi biikerane.
swahili: Kwa maana, amin nawaambia, mpaka mbingu na dunia zitakapopita, hakuna hata herufi moja ndogo wala nukta itakayopotea kwa namna yoyote kutoka kwenye Sheria, mpaka kila kitu kiwe kimetimia.

english: So then, whoever breaks one of the least of these commandments and teaches others to do likewise will be called least in the kingdom of heaven; but whoever practices and teaches them will be called great in the kingdom of heaven.
ekegusii: Ase igo monto onde bwensi orasarie richiiko erimo erire rike ase amachiiko aya, na kworokereria abanto kogosaria okwo, oyio narokwe omoke mono ase oborwoti bwa igoro, korende oyorayakore na koyorokereria, oyio nere orarokwe omonene ase oborwoti bwa igoro.
swahili: Kwa hiyo, yeyote atakayevunja mojawapo ya amri ndogo kuliko zote ya amri hizi, naye akawafundisha wengine kufanya hivyo, ataitwa mdogo kabisa katika Ufalme wa Mbinguni, lakini yeyote azitendaye na kuzifundisha hizi amri ataitwa mkuu katika Ufalme wa Mbinguni.

english: For I tell you that unless your righteousness exceeds that of the scribes and Pharisees, you will never enter the kingdom of heaven. Anger and Reconciliation (Luke 12:57–59)
ekegusii: Inaki nabateebirie inwe, onye oboronge bwaino tibokobua obw’aborokia b’amariiko na Abafarisai, timogosoa nonya ng’ake ase oborwoti bwa igoro. Amorokererio igoro y’obororo (Luk 12:57-59)
swahili: Kwa maana nawaambia, haki yenu isipozidi haki ya Mafarisayo na walimu wa sheria, kamwe hamtaingia katika Ufalme wa Mbinguni. Kuhusu Hasira (Luka 12:57-59)

english: You have heard that it was said to the ancients, ‘Do not murder’ and ‘Anyone who murders will be subject to judgment.’
ekegusii: Mwaigwete ng’a abanto ba kare ’mbateebetigwe: Toita; na oyoraite nabe omonto okonacherwa ekiina.
swahili: “Mmesikia walivyoambiwa watu wa zamani kwamba, ‘Usiue. Yeyote atakayeua atapaswa hukumu.’

english: But I tell you that anyone who is angry with his brother will be subject to judgment. Again, anyone who says to his brother, ‘Raca,’ will be subject to the Sanhedrin. But anyone who says, ‘You fool!’ will be subject to the fire of hell.
ekegusii: Korende inche nabateebirie ng’a onde bwensi orageeche oyomwabo, nabe omonto okonacherwa ekiina, na oyoramogorere oyomwabo nabe omonto okoirwa ase ekegaambero, na oyoramoroke oyonde Omoriri! Nagwenere omorero o kare na kare.
swahili: Lakini mimi nawaambia kwamba, yeyote atakayemkasirikia ndugu yake, atapaswa hukumu. Tena, yeyote atakayemwambia ndugu yake, ‘Raka,’ atapaswa kujibu kwa Baraza la Wayahudi. Lakini yeyote atakayesema ‘Wewe mpumbavu!’ atapaswa hukumu ya moto wa jehanamu.

english: So if you are offering your gift at the altar and there remember that your brother has something against you,
ekegusii: Nabo gokorenta okorua kwao ase egesasiimero, korainyore ng’a oyomino nare ne ring’ana ase ore,
swahili: “Kwa hiyo, kama unatoa sadaka yako madhabahuni, ukakumbuka kuwa ndugu yako ana kitu dhidi yako,

english: leave your gift there before the altar. First go and be reconciled to your brother; then come and offer your gift.
ekegusii: otige okorwa kwao agwo ase egesasiimero, ogende ritang’ani mwanchane noyomino, erio oirane ase okorua kwao.
swahili: iache sadaka yako hapo mbele ya madhabahu. Enda kwanza ukapatane na ndugu yako; kisha urudi na ukatoe sadaka yako.

english: Reconcile quickly with your adversary, while you are still on the way to court. Otherwise, he may hand you over to the judge, and the judge may hand you over to the officer, and you may be thrown into prison.
ekegusii: Bwatana nomosoeri oo bwango, ekero more nere inchera gochia ase ekegaambero, erinde omosoeri oo tabaisa gokobeeka ase okoboko kw’omogaambi, na omogambi akobeke ase omorendi bw’echela, naye norutwe ime yechela.
swahili: “Patana na mshtaki wako upesi wakati uwapo njiani pamoja naye kwenda mahakamani, ili mshtaki wako asije akakutia mikononi mwa hakimu, naye hakimu akakutia mikononi mwa askari, nawe ukatupwa gerezani.

english: Truly I tell you, you will not get out until you have paid the last penny. Adultery (Leviticus 18:1–30)
ekegusii: Nekeene nagoteebirie: Tokorwa aroro nonya ng’ake goika oakane ebesa y’omoerio. Obotomani (Mat 18:8-9; Mar 9:43-48; Mat 19:9; Mar 10:11-12; Luk 16:18)
swahili: Amin, nakuambia, hautatoka humo hadi uwe umelipa senti ya mwisho. Kuhusu Uzinzi

english: You have heard that it was said, ‘Do not commit adultery.’
ekegusii: Mwaigwete ng’a ndiateebetwe: Totomana.
swahili: “Mmesikia kwamba ilinenwa, ‘Usizini.’

english: But I tell you that anyone who looks at a woman to lust after her has already committed adultery with her in his heart.
ekegusii: Korende inche nabateebirie, ng’a onde bwensi orarigererie omokungu na korengereria gotomana nere otomanire nere ime ase enkoro yaye.
swahili: Lakini mimi nawaambia kwamba, yeyote amtazamaye mwanamke kwa kumtamani, amekwisha kuzini naye moyoni mwake.

english: If your right eye causes you to sin, gouge it out and throw it away. It is better for you to lose one part of your body than for your whole body to be thrown into hell.
ekegusii: Onye eriiso riao ria borio rikogera okore ebibe, rirusie, oritugute are, ekiagera mbuya ase ore ekiimo kiao ekemo gesire, kobua omobere oo omogima gotugutwa ase omorero o kare na kare.
swahili: Jicho lako la kuume likikusababisha kutenda dhambi, lingʼoe ulitupe mbali. Ni afadhali kwako kupoteza kiungo kimoja cha mwili wako kuliko mwili wako mzima ukatupwa jehanamu.

english: “Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
ekegusii: Mbasesenirie abare abataka ase omoika, ekiagera oborwoti bwa igoro nobwabo.
swahili: “Heri walio maskini wa roho, maana Ufalme wa Mbinguni ni wao.

english: And if your right hand causes you to sin, cut it off and throw it away. It is better for you to lose one part of your body than for your whole body to depart into hell. Divorce (Deuteronomy 24:1–5; Luke 16:18)
ekegusii: Onye nokoboko kwao gw’okorio gokogera okore ebibe, konache, ogotugute are, ekiagera mbuya ase ore ekiimo kiao ekemo gesire, kobua omobere oo omogima gotugutwa ase omorero o kare na kare.
swahili: Kama mkono wako wa kuume ukikusababisha kutenda dhambi, ukate, uutupe mbali. Ni afadhali kwako kupoteza kiungo kimoja cha mwili wako kuliko mwili wako mzima utupwe jehanamu. Kuhusu Talaka (Mathayo 19:9; Marko 10:11-12; Luka 16:18)

english: It has also been said, ‘Whoever divorces his wife must give her a certificate of divorce.’
ekegusii: Naende ndiateebetwe; Oyoratige mok’aye, tiga amoe riruube ri’ogotigana.
swahili: “Pia ilinenwa kwamba, ‘Mtu yeyote amwachaye mkewe sharti ampe hati ya talaka.’

english: But I tell you that anyone who divorces his wife, except for sexual immorality, brings adultery upon her. And he who marries a divorced woman commits adultery. Oaths and Vows (Numbers 30:1–16)
ekegusii: Korende inche nabateebirie, ng’a onde bwensi oratige mok’aye, otatiga ase engencho y’obotomani, ogerire abe omotomani; na oyoramonyuome oyotigirwe, oyio otomanire. Chimuma na obwegenwa
swahili: Lakini mimi nawaambia, yeyote amwachaye mkewe isipokuwa kwa kosa la uasherati, amfanya mkewe kuwa mzinzi. Na yeyote amwoaye yule mwanamke aliyeachwa, anazini. Kuhusu Kuapa

english: Again, you have heard that it was said to the ancients, ‘Do not break your oath, but fulfill your vows to the Lord.’
ekegusii: Naende mwaigwete ng’a abanto ba kare mbateebetigwe: Totiana bosa, korende oikeranerie ase Omonene chiira chiao.
swahili: “Tena mmesikia walivyoambiwa watu wa zamani kwamba, ‘Usiape kwa uongo, bali timiza kiapo kile ulichofanya kwa Bwana.’

english: But I tell you not to swear at all: either by heaven, for it is God’s throne;
ekegusii: Korende inche nabateebirie: Totiana ase egento kende gionsi; nonya nase igoro, ekiagera nao ekerogo ki’obonene kia Nyasae;
swahili: Lakini mimi nawaambia, msiape kabisa: iwe kwa mbingu, kwa kuwa ni kiti cha enzi cha Mungu;

english: or by the earth, for it is His footstool; or by Jerusalem, for it is the city of the great King.
ekegusii: gose ase ense, ekiagera nao ekerogo kiaye gi’okobekerera amagoro; gose ase Yerusalemu, ekiagera n’oro omochie bw’Omorwoti omonene.
swahili: au kwa dunia, kwa kuwa ndipo mahali pake pa kuwekea miguu; au kwa Yerusalemu, kwa kuwa ndio mji wa Mfalme Mkuu.

english: Nor should you swear by your head, for you cannot make a single hair white or black.
ekegusii: Na totiana ase omotwe oo, ekiagera tokonyara gokora agatukia akamo kabe akarabu gose akamwamu.
swahili: Nanyi msiape kwa vichwa vyenu, kwa kuwa hamwezi kuufanya hata unywele mmoja kuwa mweupe au mweusi.

english: Simply let your ‘Yes’ be ‘Yes,’ and your ‘No,’ ‘No.’ Anything more comes from the evil one. Love Your Enemies (Leviticus 24:17–23; Luke 6:27–36)
ekegusii: Amang’ana aino abe: Ee, gose: Yaaya; naki ayakomenteka ase aya, nigo akorwa ase oria omobe. Amorokererio igoro yokorusia egesiomba (Luk 6:29-30)
swahili: ‘Ndiyo’ yenu iwe ‘Ndiyo,’ na ‘Hapana’ yenu iwe ‘Hapana.’ Lolote zaidi ya hili latoka kwa yule mwovu. Kuhusu Kulipiza Kisasi (Luka 6:29-30)

english: You have heard that it was said, ‘Eye for eye and tooth for tooth.’
ekegusii: Mwaigwete ng’a ndiateebetwe: “Eriso ase eriiso, na erino ase erino.”
swahili: “Mmesikia kwamba ilinenwa, ‘Jicho kwa jicho na jino kwa jino.’

english: But I tell you not to resist an evil person. If someone slaps you on your right cheek, turn to him the other also;
ekegusii: Korende inche nabateebirie: Timobaisa koamererania noyore omobe. Korende omonto karagoake orosea rwa borio, omoonchorere norw’okobee.
swahili: Lakini mimi nawaambia, msishindane na mtu mwovu. Lakini kama mtu akikupiga kwenye shavu la kuume, mgeuzie na la pili pia.

english: Blessed are those who mourn, for they will be comforted.
ekegusii: Mbasesenirie abaichanete, ekiagera inabaache koremigwa.
swahili: Heri wale wanaohuzunika, maana hao watafarijiwa.

english: if someone wants to sue you and take your tunic, let him have your cloak as well;
ekegusii: Na omonto karigetie gokoira ase ekegambero kogosoera na koira eyanga yao ya ime, omotigere neya isiko boigo.
swahili: Kama mtu akitaka kukushtaki na kuchukua joho lako, mwachie achukue na koti pia.

english: and if someone forces you to go one mile, go with him two miles.
ekegusii: Na onye omonto ogokobetereria kogenda nere emaeli eyemo, genda nere goika chimaeli ibere.
swahili: Kama mtu akikulazimisha kwenda maili moja, nenda naye maili mbili.

english: Give to the one who asks you, and do not turn away from the one who wants to borrow from you.
ekegusii: Oyokogosaba, moe; na oyorigetie singo, tomorina. Obwanchani ase Ababisa (Luk 6:27-28,32-36)
swahili: Mpe yeye akuombaye, wala usimgeuzie kisogo yeye atakaye kukukopa. Upendo Kwa Adui (Luka 6:27-28, 32-36)

english: You have heard that it was said, ‘Love your neighbor’ and ‘Hate your enemy.’
ekegusii: Mwaigwete ng’a ndiateebetwe: “Ancha omogisangio oo, na ogeche omobisa oo.”
swahili: “Mmesikia kwamba ilinenwa, ‘Mpende jirani yako na umchukie adui yako.’

english: But I tell you, love your enemies and pray for those who persecute you,
ekegusii: Korende inche nabateebirie: Ancha ababisa baino, mobasabere abakobachanda,
swahili: Lakini ninawaambia: Wapendeni adui zenu na waombeeni wanaowatesa ninyi,

english: that you may be sons of your Father in heaven. He causes His sun to rise on the evil and the good, and sends rain on the righteous and the unrighteous.
ekegusii: nario moranyare koba abana ba Iso oino ore igoro, ekiagera ere nigo akobabareria omobaso oye ababe na abaya, obatweria embura abakori oboronge, na abatari gokora oboronge.
swahili: ili mpate kuwa watoto wa Baba yenu aliye mbinguni. Kwa maana yeye huwaangazia jua lake watu waovu na watu wema, naye huwanyeshea mvua wenye haki na wasio haki.

english: If you love those who love you, what reward will you get? Do not even tax collectors do the same?
ekegusii: Inaki komoranche abaabanchete inwe, ing’eria ki more nero? Inee! Nonya mbaria bakorusia ebango tibari gokora bo?
swahili: Kama mkiwapenda tu wale wanaowapenda, mtapata thawabu gani? Je, hata watoza ushuru hawafanyi hivyo?

english: And if you greet only your brothers, what are you doing more than others? Do not even Gentiles do the same?
ekegusii: Na inwe komorakwanie abamino boka, mbuya ki mwakora kobua abande? Nonya n’abanto b’Ebisaku tibari gokora boigo?
swahili: Nanyi kama mkiwasalimu ndugu zenu tu, je, mnafanya nini zaidi ya wengine? Je, hata watu wasiomjua Mungu, hawafanyi hivyo?

english: Be perfect, therefore, as your heavenly Father is perfect.
ekegusii: Gaki inwe mobe abaikeranu buna Iso oino ore igoro are omoikeranu.
swahili: Kwa hiyo kuweni wakamilifu kama Baba yenu wa mbinguni alivyo mkamilifu.

english: Blessed are the meek, for they will inherit the earth.
ekegusii: Mbasesenirie abare noboitongo, ekiagera barabwo ’nabaire omwando bw’ense.
swahili: Heri walio wapole, maana hao watairithi nchi.

english: Blessed are those who hunger and thirst for righteousness, for they will be filled.
ekegusii: Mbasesenirie abare nenchara na erang’o y’okonyora okogania kwa Nyasae, ekiagera barabwo ’nabaigotigwe.
swahili: Heri wenye njaa na kiu ya haki, maana hao watatoshelezwa.

english: Blessed are the merciful, for they will be shown mercy.
ekegusii: Mbasesenirie abakororera abande amaabera, ekiagera barabwo ’nabarorerwe amaabera.
swahili: Heri wenye huruma, maana hao watapata rehema.

english: Blessed are the pure in heart, for they will see God.
ekegusii: Mbasesenirie abare abachenu ase chinkoro, ekiagera barabwo ’nabarore Nyasae.
swahili: Heri walio na moyo safi, maana hao watamwona Mungu.

english: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called sons of God.
ekegusii: Mbasesenirie abagokora omorembe, ekiagera barabwo ’nabarokwe abana ba Nyasae.
swahili: Heri walio wapatanishi, maana hao wataitwa wana wa Mungu.

english: “Be careful not to perform your righteous acts before men to be seen by them. If you do, you will have no reward from your Father in heaven.
ekegusii: Mwerende timokora ogokora kwaino okuya ase amasio y’abanto, erinde mororwe nabarabwo, ekiagera komogookora ayio, timori neng’eria ya Iso oino ore igoro.
swahili: “Angalieni msitende wema wenu mbele ya watu ili wawaone. Kwa maana mkifanya hivyo, hamna thawabu kutoka kwa Baba yenu aliye mbinguni.

english: Your kingdom come, Your will be done, on earth as it is in heaven.
ekegusii: Oborwoti bwao boche, Ogwancha kwao gokoreke ense, Buna kogokoreka igoro.
swahili: Ufalme wako uje. Mapenzi yako yafanyike hapa duniani kama huko mbinguni.

english: Give us this day our daily bread.
ekegusii: Otoe intwe reero endagera yaito ya kera rituko.
swahili: Utupatie riziki yetu ya kila siku.

english: And forgive us our debts, as we also have forgiven our debtors.
ekegusii: Otwabere ebibe biaito, Buna intwe tokobaabera abagotokorera bobe.
swahili: Utusamehe deni zetu, kama sisi nasi tulivyokwisha kuwasamehe wadeni wetu.

english: And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one. ’
ekegusii: Totoira ase ogoteemwa, Korende ototoorie korwa ase oria omobe.
swahili: Usitutie majaribuni, bali utuokoe kutoka kwa yule mwovu [kwa kuwa Ufalme ni wako, na nguvu, na utukufu, hata milele. Amen].’

english: For if you forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you.
ekegusii: Inaki inwe kamoraabere abanto ogosaria kwabo, naboigo na Iso oino ore igoro nabaabere inwe.
swahili: Kwa kuwa kama mkiwasamehe watu wengine wanapowakosea, Baba yenu wa mbinguni atawasamehe ninyi pia.

english: But if you do not forgive men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive yours. Proper Fasting
ekegusii: Korende motaabereti abanto okomocha kwabo, na Iso oino takobaabera okomocha kwaino. Okweng’ata
swahili: Lakini msipowasamehe watu wengine makosa yao, naye Baba yenu hatawasamehe ninyi makosa yenu. Kuhusu Kufunga

english: When you fast, do not be somber like the hypocrites, for they disfigure their faces to show men they are fasting. Truly I tell you, they already have their full reward.
ekegusii: “Ekero mokweng’ata timokonyiria amasio aino buna abang’ainereria, ekiagera barabwo nigo bakonyiria amasio abo, erinde banyare kororwa n’abanto ng’a mbeng’atete. Nekeene nabateebirie ng’a banyorire eng’eria yabo.
swahili: “Mnapofunga, msiwe wenye huzuni kama wafanyavyo wanafiki. Maana wao hukunja nyuso zao ili kuwaonyesha wengine kwamba wamefunga. Amin, amin nawaambia wao wamekwisha kupata thawabu yao kamilifu.

english: But when you fast, anoint your head and wash your face,
ekegusii: Korende aye, gokweng’ata, eake amaguta omotwe oo, bwesibie obosio bwao,
swahili: Lakini mnapofunga, jipakeni mafuta kichwani na kunawa nyuso zenu

english: so that your fasting will not be obvious to men, but only to your Father, who is unseen. And your Father, who sees what is done in secret, will reward you. Treasures in Heaven (Luke 12:32–34)
ekegusii: erio tobaisa kororwa n’abanto ng’a mbweng’atete, korende ororekane ase Iso oo ore bobisi, na Iso oo oyokorora bobisi nagoakane. Obotenenku bw’ekeene (Luk 12:33-34)
swahili: ili kufunga kwenu kusionekane na watu wengine ila Baba yenu aketiye mahali pa siri; naye Baba yenu aonaye sirini atawapa thawabu yenu kwa wazi. Akiba Ya Mbinguni (Luka 12:33-34)

english: Do not store up for yourselves treasures on earth, where moth and rust destroy, and where thieves break in and steal.
ekegusii: “Timogacha chinibo chiaino ase ense, aase ebigwankwa na oboboosu bigosaria, na abaibi bagotaagora na koiba;
swahili: “Msijiwekee hazina duniani, mahali ambapo nondo na kutu huharibu, nao wevi huvunja na kuiba.

english: So when you give to the needy, do not sound a trumpet before you, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and on the streets, to be honored by men. Truly I tell you, they already have their full reward.
ekegusii: Gaki gokorua ebiegwa, tobugia engoma, buna baria abang’ainereria bagokora ase chisinagogi na ase chinchera chinene chi’emechie, erinde batogigwe n’abanto. Nekeene nabateebirie ng’a barabwo banyorire eng’eria yabo.
swahili: “Hivyo mnapowapa wahitaji, msipige panda mbele yenu kama wafanyavyo wanafiki katika masinagogi na mitaani, ili wasifiwe na watu. Amin nawaambia wao wamekwisha kupokea thawabu yao.

english: But store up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where moth and rust do not destroy, and where thieves do not break in and steal.
ekegusii: korende mogache chinibo chiaino igoro, aase ebigwankwa na oboboosu bitagosoa, na abaibi batagotaagora na koiba.
swahili: Lakini jiwekeeni hazina mbinguni, mahali ambapo nondo na kutu haviharibu, wala wevi hawavunji na kuiba.

english: For where your treasure is, there your heart will be also. The Lamp of the Body (Luke 11:33–36)
ekegusii: Ekiagera aase enibo yao ere, nao nenkoro yao ekoba. Oborabu na omosunte (Luk 11:34-36)
swahili: Kwa sababu mahali hazina yako ilipo, hapo ndipo pia moyo wako utakapokuwa. Jicho Ni Taa Ya Mwili (Luka 11:34-36)

english: The eye is the lamp of the body. If your eyes are good, your whole body will be full of light.
ekegusii: “Etaya y’omobere n’eriiso. Nabo onye eriiso riao rire rigiya, omobere oo bwonsi noichorwe noborabu;
swahili: “Jicho ni taa ya mwili. Kama jicho lako ni nyofu, mwili wako wote utajaa nuru.

english: But if your eyes are bad, your whole body will be full of darkness. If then the light within you is darkness, how great is that darkness!
ekegusii: korende onye eriiso riao rire riibe, omobere oo bwonsi noichorwe nomosunte. Onye oborabu boria bore ime yao bwabeire omosunte, omosunte oyio nomonene mono. Gokorera Abanene babere (Luk 16:13; 12:22-31)
swahili: Lakini kama jicho lako ni ovu, mwili wako wote utajawa na giza. Kwa hiyo basi, kama nuru iliyomo ndani yako ni giza, hilo ni giza kuu namna gani! Mungu Na Mali (Luka 16:13; 12:22-31)

english: No one can serve two masters: Either he will hate the one and love the other, or he will be devoted to the one and despise the other. You cannot serve both God and money. Do Not Worry (Luke 12:22–31)
ekegusii: “Onde tari oranyare gokorera abanene babere, ekiagera nageche oyomo, na anche oyonde, gose nabwatane noyomo, na achaaye oyonde. Timokonyara gokorera Nyasae na enibo.
swahili: “Hakuna mtu awezaye kuwatumikia mabwana wawili. Kwa kuwa atamchukia huyu na kumpenda yule mwingine, au atashikamana sana na huyu na kumdharau yule mwingine. Hamwezi kumtumikia Mungu pamoja na Mali. Msiwe Na Wasiwasi

english: Therefore I tell you, do not worry about your life, what you will eat or drink; or about your body, what you will wear. Is not life more than food, and the body more than clothes?
ekegusii: “Ase ayio nabateebirie ng’a timochandeka igoro y’obogima bwaino, eki morarie, gose eki moranywe, gose ase emebere yaino, eki morabeeke. Inee! Obogima tibori obonene kobua endagera? Na omobere tori omonene kobua chianga?
swahili: “Kwa hiyo nawaambia, msisumbukie maisha yenu kwamba mtakula nini au mtakunywa nini; au msumbukie miili yenu kwamba mtavaa nini. Je, maisha si zaidi ya chakula, na mwili zaidi ya mavazi?

english: Look at the birds of the air: They do not sow or reap or gather into barns—and yet your heavenly Father feeds them. Are you not much more valuable than they?
ekegusii: Morigererie chinyoni chia igoro! Chirochio tichiri gosimeka, tichiri kogesa, tichiri gosangereria gochia biage, na Iso oino ore igoro nigo agochirageria. Inee! Inwe timobueti rigori riabo?
swahili: Waangalieni ndege wa angani; wao hawapandi wala hawavuni au kuweka ghalani, lakini Baba yenu wa mbinguni huwalisha. Je, ninyi si wa thamani zaidi kuliko hao ndege?

english: Who of you by worrying can add a single hour to his life?
ekegusii: Ning’o ase more goetera ase ogwechanda kwaye oranyare komenta chingaki ase obogima bwaye?
swahili: Ni nani miongoni mwenu ambaye kwa kujitaabisha kwake anaweza kujiongezea hata saa moja zaidi katika maisha yake?

english: And why do you worry about clothes? Consider how the lilies of the field grow: They do not labor or spin.
ekegusii: Ne chianga, nase ki mogochiechandera? Morigererie ebisicha bi’orosana buna bigokiina; tibiri gokora emeremo, gose tibiri gwesisa;
swahili: “Nanyi kwa nini mnajitaabisha kwa ajili ya mavazi? Fikirini maua ya shambani yameavyo. Hayafanyi kazi wala hayafumi.

english: Yet I tell you that not even Solomon in all his glory was adorned like one of these.
ekegusii: korende nabateebirie, nonya Sulemani omonyene ase obonene bwaye bwonsi tabegete chianga buna ekemo ki’ebi.
swahili: Lakini nawaambia, hata Solomoni katika fahari yake yote hakuvikwa vizuri kama mojawapo ya hayo maua.

english: But when you give to the needy, do not let your left hand know what your right hand is doing,
ekegusii: Korende aye, gokorua obokonyi gochia ase omotaka, kora ayio korende, nonya n’omosani oo oime tamanya ayio gwakora,
swahili: Lakini ninyi mtoapo sadaka, fanyeni kwa siri, hata mkono wako wa kushoto usijue mkono wako wa kuume unachofanya,

english: If that is how God clothes the grass of the field, which is here today and tomorrow is thrown into the furnace, will He not much more clothe you, O you of little faith?
ekegusii: Korende onye Nyasae okoboyia obonyansi bw’egetii oboreo reero, na ankio botugutwe ase omorero, Inee, takomenta kobaboyia inwe, abamore nokwegena ogoke?
swahili: Basi ikiwa Mungu huyavika hivi majani ya shambani, ambayo leo yapo na kesho yanatupwa motoni, je, hatawavika ninyi vizuri zaidi, enyi wa imani haba?

english: Therefore do not worry, saying, ‘What shall we eat?’ or ‘What shall we drink?’ or ‘What shall we wear?’
ekegusii: Gaki, timona gwechanda mogoteeba: Ninki torarie? Gose: Ninki toranywe? Gose: Ninki torabeeke?
swahili: Kwa hiyo msiwe na wasiwasi, mkisema, ‘Tutakula nini?’ au ‘Tutakunywa nini?’ au ‘Tutavaa nini?’

english: For the Gentiles strive after all these things, and your heavenly Father knows that you need them.
ekegusii: Inaki abanto b’Ebisaku nigo bakorigia ebio bionsi; korende Iso oino ore igoro namanyete ng’a ’moganetie ebinto ebio bionsi.
swahili: Watu wasiomjua Mungu ndio wanaoshindania hayo, lakini Baba yenu wa mbinguni anafahamu kuwa mnahitaji haya yote.

english: But seek first the kingdom of God and His righteousness, and all these things will be added unto you.
ekegusii: Korende ritang’ani rigia oborwoti bwa Nyasae na oboronge bwaye, na ebinto ebio bionsi ’namobiegwe.
swahili: Lakini utafuteni kwanza Ufalme wa Mungu na haki yake, na haya yote atawapa pia.

english: Therefore do not worry about tomorrow, for tomorrow will worry about itself. Today has enough trouble of its own.
ekegusii: “Gaki, timwechandera ay’ankio, ekiagera ankio inariechande rinyene. Kera rituko ndiisaine nogwechanda kwaye.
swahili: Kwa hiyo msiwe na wasiwasi kuhusu kesho, kwa sababu kesho itajitaabikia yenyewe. Yatosha kwa siku masumbufu yake.

english: so that your giving may be in secret. And your Father, who sees what is done in secret, will reward you. The Lord’s Prayer (Luke 11:1–4)
ekegusii: Obokonyi bwao bonyare koba bobisi; na Iso oo oyokorora bobisi nagoakane. Amegerio igoro y’ogosaba
swahili: ili sadaka yako iwe ni siri. Ndipo Baba yako wa mbinguni, yeye aonaye sirini atakupa thawabu kwa wazi. Kuhusu Maombi (Luka 11:2-4)

english: And when you pray, do not be like the hypocrites. For they love to pray standing in the synagogues and on the street corners to be seen by men. Truly I tell you, they already have their full reward.
ekegusii: Ekero mogosaba, timoba buna baria abang’ainereria; ekiagera barabwo nigo banchete gotenena na gosaba ase chisinagogi na ase amatabekania ye chinchera, banyare kororwa n’abanto. Nekeene nabateebirie ng’a banyorire eng’eria yabo.
swahili: “Nanyi msalipo, msiwe kama wanafiki, maana wao hupenda kusali wakiwa wamesimama katika masinagogi na kando ya barabara ili waonekane na watu. Amin nawaambia, wao wamekwisha kupata thawabu yao.

english: But when you pray, go into your inner room, shut your door, and pray to your Father, who is unseen. And your Father, who sees what is done in secret, will reward you.
ekegusii: Korende aye ekero ogosaba, soa nyomba mwao ime, osieke egesieri, omosabe Iso oo ore bobisi; na Iso oo oyokorora bobisi nagoakane.
swahili: Lakini wewe unaposali, ingia chumbani mwako, funga mlango na umwombe Baba yako aliye sirini. Naye Baba yako aonaye sirini atakupa thawabu yako.

english: And when you pray, do not babble on like pagans, for they think that by their many words they will be heard.
ekegusii: Ase ogosaba kwaino timokwana amang’ana amange abosa buna abanto b’Ebisaku; naki barabwo nigo bagokaga ng’a Nyasae nabaigwe ase obonge bw’amang’ana abo.
swahili: Nanyi mnaposali msiseme maneno kama wafanyavyo watu wasiomjua Mungu. Kwa maana wao hudhani kwamba watasikiwa kwa sababu ya wingi wa maneno yao.

english: Do not be like them, for your Father knows what you need before you ask Him.
ekegusii: Gaki timoba omogwekano oyomo nabarabwo, ekiagera Iso oino namanyete aya moganetie, ritang’ani motaramosaba. Ogosaba kw’Omonene (Luk 11:2-4)
swahili: Msiwe kama wao, kwa sababu Baba yenu anajua kile mnachohitaji kabla hamjamwomba.

english: So then, this is how you should pray: ‘Our Father in heaven, hallowed be Your name.
ekegusii: “Bono inwe nigo mogwenerete gosaba iga: Tata oito ore igoro, Erieta riao risikwe.
swahili: “Hivi basi, ndivyo iwapasavyo kuomba: “ ‘Baba yetu uliye mbinguni, Jina lako litukuzwe.

english: “Do not judge, or you will be judged.
ekegusii: “Timogaambia, nainwe timokogaambigwa.
swahili: “Usihukumu ili usije ukahukumiwa.

english: Or if he asks for a fish, will give him a snake?
ekegusii: Gose karamosabe enswe, namoe eng’iti?
swahili: Au mwanawe akimwomba samaki atampa nyoka?

english: So if you who are evil know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father in heaven give good things to those who ask Him!
ekegusii: Onye inwe, abamore ababe, momanyete koa abana baino ebiegwa ebiya, Inee, Iso oino ore igoro takomenta mono kobaa amaya abwo bakomosaba? Ogochika okore okuya mono (Luk 6:31)
swahili: Ikiwa ninyi basi mlio waovu mnajua kuwapa watoto wenu vitu vizuri, si zaidi sana Baba yenu aliye mbinguni atawapa vitu vizuri wale wamwombao?

english: In everything, then, do to others as you would have them do to you. For this is the essence of the Law and the Prophets. The Narrow Gate (Luke 13:22–30)
ekegusii: “Nabo ande onsi morigetie abanto babakorere inwe, nainwe mobakorere boigo. Ekiagera ayio naro amachiiko na amang’ana y’ababani. Egesieri Ekegote (Luk 13:24)
swahili: Kwa hiyo chochote mnachotaka mtendewe na watu, ninyi nanyi watendeeni vivyo hivyo. Kwa kuwa hii ndiyo Sheria na Manabii. Njia Nyembamba Na Njia Pana

english: Enter through the narrow gate. For wide is the gate and broad is the way that leads to destruction, and many enter through it.
ekegusii: “Soa ase egesieri kere ekegote, ekiagera egesieri gekogenda ase obosiru nekegare, na enchera ekogendao nengare, na abagosoa gochiao nabange.
swahili: “Ingieni kupitia mlango mwembamba, kwa maana lango ni pana na njia ni pana ielekeayo upotevuni, nao ni wengi waingiao kwa kupitia lango hilo.

english: But small is the gate and narrow the way that leads to life, and only a few find it. A Tree and Its Fruit (Luke 6:43–45)
ekegusii: Korende egesieri gekogenda ase obogima nekegote, na enchera ekogendao nenyerere, na abakoyenyora nabake. Omote n’amatunda aye (Luk 6:43-44)
swahili: Lakini mlango ni mwembamba na njia ni finyu ielekeayo kwenye uzima, nao ni wachache tu waionao. Mti Na Tunda Lake (Luka 6:43-44)

english: Beware of false prophets. They come to you in sheep’s clothing, but inwardly they are ravenous wolves.
ekegusii: “Mwerende nababani b’oborimo abwo bagocha ase more beboyetie chingobo chi’eching’ondi, na ime yabo nigo bare chisese chi’orosana chintindi mono.
swahili: “Jihadharini na manabii wa uongo, wanaowajia wakiwa wamevaa mavazi ya kondoo, lakini ndani ni mbwa mwitu wakali.

english: By their fruit you will recognize them. Are grapes gathered from thornbushes, or figs from thistles?
ekegusii: Ase amaamo abo ’namobamanye. Inee! Abanto nigo bagotwa amasabibu korwa ase emetobo, gose amako korwa ase amageri?
swahili: Mtawatambua kwa matunda yao. Je, watu huchuma zabibu kwenye miiba, au tini kwenye michongoma?

english: Likewise, every good tree bears good fruit, but a bad tree bears bad fruit.
ekegusii: Naboigo kera omote omuya nigo okwama amatunda amaya, na omote omobe nigo okwama amatunda amabe.
swahili: Vivyo hivyo, mti mwema huzaa matunda mazuri, na mti mbaya huzaa matunda mabaya.

english: A good tree cannot bear bad fruit, and a bad tree cannot bear good fruit.
ekegusii: Omote omuya tokonyara kwama amatunda amabe, na omote omobe tokonyara kwama amatunda amaya.
swahili: Mti mwema hauwezi kuzaa matunda mabaya, wala mti mbaya hauwezi kuzaa matunda mazuri.

english: Every tree that does not bear good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire.
ekegusii: Kera omote otameti amatunda amaya nigo okogechwa, otugutwa ase omorero.
swahili: Kila mti usiozaa matunda mazuri hukatwa na kutupwa motoni.

english: For with the same judgment you pronounce, you will be judged; and with the measure you use, it will be measured to you.
ekegusii: Inaki ekiina mokonacha, nakio morache konacherwa. Na ekerengo keria mokorengera, nakio morache korengerwa.
swahili: Kwa maana jinsi unavyowahukumu wengine, ndivyo utakavyohukumiwa, na kwa kipimo kile upimiacho, ndicho utakachopimiwa.

english: So then, by their fruit you will recognize them.
ekegusii: Naboigo, momanye ababani b’oborimo ase okwama kwabo. Amang’ana na ogokora (Luk 6:46; 13:25-27)
swahili: Hivyo, mtawatambua kwa matunda yao. Mwanafunzi Wa Kweli (Luka 13:25-27)

english: Not everyone who says to Me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ will enter the kingdom of heaven, but only he who does the will of My Father in heaven.
ekegusii: “Tari kera omonto ogonteebia: Omonene Nyasae, orasoe ase oborwoti bwa igoro, korende n’oyogokora ogwancha gwa Tata one ore igoro.
swahili: “Si kila mtu aniambiaye, ‘Bwana, Bwana,’ atakayeingia katika Ufalme wa Mbinguni, bali ni yeye afanyaye mapenzi ya Baba yangu aliye mbinguni.

english: Many will say to Me on that day, ‘Lord, Lord, did we not prophesy in Your name, and in Your name drive out demons and perform many miracles?’
ekegusii: Ase rituko riria nabange baranteebie: Omonene Nyasae, titware kobana ase erieta riao, na ase erieta riao goseria ebirecha, na ase erieta riao togakora ebikone ebinge bie chinguru?
swahili: Wengi wataniambia siku ile, ‘Bwana, Bwana, hatukutoa unabii kwa jina lako, na kwa jina lako kutoa pepo wachafu na kufanya miujiza mingi?’

english: Then I will tell them plainly, ‘I never knew you; depart from Me, you workers of lawlessness!’ The House on the Rock (Luke 6:46–49)
ekegusii: Erio nainche nimbateebie maiso marore abanto baria: Timbamanyeti inwe nonya ng’ake; karue ase ’nde, inwe abakori amabe! Abaagachi Enyomba babere (Luk 6:47-49; Mar 1:22)
swahili: Ndipo nitakapowaambia wazi, ‘Sikuwajua kamwe. Ondokeni kwangu, ninyi watenda maovu!’ Msikiaji Na Mtendaji (Luka 6:47-49)

english: Therefore everyone who hears these words of Mine and acts on them is like a wise man who built his house on the rock.
ekegusii: “Kera oyomo oyokoigwa amang’ana aya aane, na koyakora, nagwekanigwe n’omonto orenge omong’aini, oagachete mwaye igoro ase egetare;
swahili: “Kwa hiyo kila mtu ayasikiaye haya maneno yangu na kuyatenda, ni kama mtu mwenye busara aliyejenga nyumba yake kwenye mwamba.

english: The rain fell, the torrents raged, and the winds blew and beat against that house; yet it did not fall, because its foundation was on the rock.
ekegusii: embura egatwa amo nomwaga, na eooro egaacha, egatwoma enyomba eria, korende tiyagwa, ekiagera oboroso bwaye bwaagachetwe igoro ase egetare.
swahili: Mvua ikanyesha, mafuriko yakaja, na upepo ukavuma ukaipiga hiyo nyumba. Lakini haikuanguka; kwa sababu msingi wake ulikuwa kwenye mwamba.

english: But everyone who hears these words of Mine and does not act on them is like a foolish man who built his house on sand.
ekegusii: Na kera oyomo oyokoigwa amang’ana aya aane, ko tayakora, nagwekanigwe n’omonto omoriri, oagachete mwaye ase amaroba;
swahili: Naye kila anayesikia haya maneno yangu wala asiyatende, ni kama mtu mjinga aliyejenga nyumba yake kwenye mchanga.

english: The rain fell, the torrents raged, and the winds blew and beat against that house, and it fell—and great was its collapse!” The Authority of Jesus
ekegusii: embura egatwa amo nomwaga, na eooro egaacha, bigatwoma enyomba eria, ekagwa; okogwa kwaye gokaba okonene.” Okobua kwa Yeso
swahili: Mvua ikanyesha, mafuriko yakaja, nao upepo ukavuma ukaipiga hiyo nyumba, nayo ikaanguka kwa kishindo kikubwa.”

english: When Jesus had finished saying these things, the crowds were astonished at His teaching,
ekegusii: Ekero Yeso akoorire amang’ana aya, emeganda egakumia ase okworokereria kwaye,
swahili: Yesu alipomaliza kusema maneno haya, makutano ya watu wakashangazwa sana na mafundisho yake,

english: because He taught as one who had authority, and not as their scribes.
ekegusii: ekiagera nigo arenge koborokereria buna oyore nokobua, na tari buna aborokia babo b’amariiko.
swahili: kwa sababu alifundisha kama yeye aliye na mamlaka, wala si kama walimu wao wa sheria.

english: Why do you look at the speck in your brother’s eye, but fail to notice the beam in your own eye?
ekegusii: Inaki okorigereria ekeogoto kere ase eriiso ri’oyomino, na omoriibo ore ase eriiso riao ime toyorochi?
swahili: “Mbona unatazama kibanzi kilicho ndani ya jicho la ndugu yako, na wala huoni boriti iliyo ndani ya jicho lako mwenyewe?

english: How can you say to your brother, ‘Let me take the speck out of your eye,’ while there is still a beam in your own eye?
ekegusii: Gose ’naki orateebie oyomino: ’Ntige ’nkorusie ekeogoto kere ase eriiso riao, na rora omoriibo nore ase eriiso riao?
swahili: Au unawezaje kumwambia ndugu yako, ‘Acha nitoe kibanzi kwenye jicho lako,’ wakati kuna boriti kwenye jicho lako mwenyewe?

english: You hypocrite! First take the beam out of your own eye, and then you will see clearly to remove the speck from your brother’s eye.
ekegusii: Aye omonga’inereria, rusia ritang’ani omoriibo ore ase eriiso riao, nario orarore buya omanye korusia ekeogoto korwa ase eriiso ri’oyomino.
swahili: Ewe mnafiki, ondoa boriti ndani ya jicho lako kwanza, ndipo utaweza kuona dhahiri jinsi ya kuondoa kibanzi kilicho ndani ya jicho la ndugu yako.

english: Do not give dogs what is holy; do not throw your pearls before swine. If you do, they may trample them under their feet, and then turn and tear you to pieces. Ask, Seek, Knock (Luke 11:5–13)
ekegusii: “Timoa chisese ekere egechenu, gose timoitera chiruru chiaino ase chimbeche, tichicha gochitacha namagoro abo, naende chibaonchokere inwe, chibarie. Saba, Rigia, Tura (Luk 11:9-13)
swahili: “Msiwape mbwa vitu vilivyo vitakatifu; wala msitupie nguruwe lulu zenu. Kama mkifanya hivyo, watazikanyagakanyaga na kisha watawageukia na kuwararua vipande vipande. Omba, Tafuta, Bisha (Luka 11:9-13)

english: Ask, and it will be given to you; seek, and you will find; knock, and the door will be opened to you.
ekegusii: “Saba, ’namoegwe; rigia, ’namonyore; tura, ’namoigorerwe egesieri.
swahili: “Ombeni nanyi mtapewa; tafuteni nanyi mtapata; bisheni nanyi mtafunguliwa mlango.

english: For everyone who asks receives; he who seeks finds; and to him who knocks, the door will be opened.
ekegusii: Ekiagera kera oyogosaba nigo akoegwa, na ere oyokorigia nigo akonyora, na ere oyogotura nigo akoigorerwa.
swahili: Kwa kuwa kila aombaye hupewa; naye kila atafutaye hupata; na kila abishaye hufunguliwa mlango.

english: Which of you, if his son asks for bread, will give him a stone?
ekegusii: Gose monto onde n’are ase more, na omwana oye amosabe omogati, Inee, namoe rigena?
swahili: “Au ni nani miongoni mwenu ambaye mwanawe akimwomba mkate atampa jiwe?

english: When Jesus came down from the mountain, large crowds followed Him.
ekegusii: Ekero Yeso achia gotirimboka korwa ase egetunwa igoro, emeganda emenge ekamotunyana.
swahili: Yesu aliposhuka kutoka mlimani, makutano makubwa ya watu yakamfuata.

english: When Jesus heard this, He marveled and said to those following Him, “Truly I tell you, I have not found anyone in Israel with such great faith.
ekegusii: Ekero Yeso amoigwa agakumia, agateebia abamotunyanete, “Nekeene nabateebirie: Nonya nase Abaisraeli tindanyora okwegena okore buna oko.
swahili: Yesu aliposikia maneno haya, alishangaa, akawaambia wale waliomfuata, “Amin, nawaambia, hata katika Israeli sijapata kuona yeyote mwenye imani kubwa namna hii.

english: I say to you that many will come from the east and the west to share the banquet with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob in the kingdom of heaven.
