ekegusii: Nabatebirie ng’a abange nabache korwa moocha na bosongo, ’nabaikaranse ase emesa na koria amo na Aburaamu, na Isaka, na Yakobo, ase oborwoti bwa igoro,
swahili: Ninawaambia kwamba wengi watatoka mashariki na magharibi, nao wataketi karamuni pamoja na Abrahamu, Isaki na Yakobo katika Ufalme wa Mbinguni.

english: But the sons of the kingdom will be thrown into the outer darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.”
ekegusii: korende abana b’oborwoti ’nabatugutwe isiko ase omosunte; na aroro abanto mbabe nekerero na okoriania amaino.”
swahili: Lakini warithi wa Ufalme watatupwa katika giza la nje, ambako kutakuwako kilio na kusaga meno.”

english: Then Jesus said to the centurion, “Go! As you have believed, so will it be done for you.” And his servant was healed at that very hour. Jesus Heals at Peter’s House (Mark 1:29–34; Luke 4:38–41)
ekegusii: Yeso agateebia omotang’ani oria bw’abarwani rigana, “Genda bwoo, nabe ase ore koreng’ana nokwegena kwao.” Omosomba oria akagwenigwa ase ekero keria. Yeso okogwenia Abanto abange (Mar 1:29-34; Luk 4:38-41)
swahili: Kisha Yesu akamwambia yule jemadari, “Nenda na iwe kwako sawasawa na imani yako.” Naye yule mtumishi akapona saa ile ile. Yesu Aponya Wengi (Marko 1:29-34; Luka 4:38-41)

english: When Jesus arrived at Peter’s house, He saw Peter’s mother-in-law sick in bed with a fever.
ekegusii: Ekero Yeso asoete nyomba mwa Petero, akarora ng’ina biara Petero oraire, orwarete esosera.
swahili: Yesu alipoingia nyumbani kwa Petro, alimkuta mama mkwe wa Petro amelala kitandani, akiwa ana homa.

english: So He touched her hand, and the fever left her, and she got up and began to serve them.
ekegusii: Akamokuna okoboko kwaye. Esosera ekamotiga, na ere akaimoka akamokorera.
swahili: Akamgusa mkono wake na homa ikamwacha, naye akainuka na kuanza kumhudumia.

english: When evening came, many who were demon-possessed were brought to Jesus, and He drove out the spirits with a word and healed all the sick.
ekegusii: Riachia koba mogoroba, bakamoirera abanto abange ababwatire nebirecha, na ere akarusia ebirecha ase ring’ana, na bonsi abarenge abarwaire akabagwenia;
swahili: Jioni ile, wakamletea watu wengi waliopagawa na pepo wachafu, naye akawatoa wale pepo wachafu kwa neno lake, na kuwaponya wagonjwa wote.

english: This was to fulfill what was spoken through the prophet Isaiah: “He took on our infirmities and carried our diseases.” The Cost of Discipleship (Luke 9:57–62; Luke 14:25–33; John 6:59–66)
ekegusii: rinyare goikerana eriatebetwe nomobani Isaya, ogoteeba, “Ere akaimokia oboreu bwaito, na akabogoria amarwaire aito.” Amateemwa ase abwo barigetie koba aborokigwa (Luk 9:57-62)
swahili: Haya yalifanyika ili litimie lile lililonenwa kwa kinywa cha nabii Isaya kwamba: “Mwenyewe alitwaa udhaifu wetu na alichukua magonjwa yetu.” Gharama Ya Kumfuata Yesu (Luka 9:57-62)

english: When Jesus saw a large crowd around Him, He gave orders to cross to the other side of the sea.
ekegusii: Bono ekero Yeso achia korora emeganda emenge yamoetananire, agachiika ng’a baimoke korwa aroro bagende ng’umbu.
swahili: Yesu alipoona makutano mengi wamemzunguka, aliwaamuru wanafunzi wake wavuke mpaka ngʼambo ya ziwa.

english: And one of the scribes came to Him and said, “Teacher, I will follow You wherever You go.”
ekegusii: Omworokia oyomo bw’amariiko akamochiera, akamoteebia, “Omworokia, ningotunyane aande onsi ase okogenda.”
swahili: Kisha mwalimu mmoja wa sheria akamjia Yesu na kumwambia, “Mwalimu, nitakufuata kokote uendako.”

english: Suddenly a leper came and knelt before Him, saying, “Lord, if You are willing, You can make me clean.”
ekegusii: Rora, omonto orenge noborwaire bwa ukoma akamochiera, akamotung’amera, akamoteebia, “Omonene, oise gwancha nabo ogonsibia.”
swahili: Mtu mmoja mwenye ukoma akaja na kupiga magoti mbele yake, akasema, “Bwana, kama ukitaka, unaweza kunitakasa.”

english: Jesus replied, “Foxes have dens and birds of the air have nests, but the Son of Man has no place to lay His head.”
ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Ebibwe mbire namakuruma, ne chinyoni chia igoro nchire nebiswa, korende Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto tari nase akobeeka omotwe oye.”
swahili: Naye Yesu akamjibu, “Mbweha wana mapango, nao ndege wa angani wana viota, lakini Mwana wa Adamu hana mahali pa kulaza kichwa chake.”

english: Another of His disciples requested, “Lord, first let me go and bury my father.”
ekegusii: Na oyonde ase aborokigwa baye akamoteebia, “Omonene, ritang’ani ing’a ribaga ngende gotindeka tata”
swahili: Mwanafunzi mwingine akamwambia, “Bwana, niruhusu kwanza nikamzike baba yangu.”

english: But Jesus told him, “Follow Me, and let the dead bury their own dead.” Jesus Calms the Storm (Psalms 107:1–43; Mark 4:35–41; Luke 8:22–25)
ekegusii: Korende Yeso akamoteebia, “Ntunyana, tiga abakuure batindeke abakuure babo.” Yeso ogotoereria omwaga (Mar 4:35-41; Luk 8:22-25)
swahili: Lakini Yesu akamwambia, “Nifuate, uwaache wafu wawazike wafu wao.” Yesu Atuliza Dhoruba (Marko 4:35-41; Luka 8:22-25)

english: When He got into the boat, His disciples followed Him.
ekegusii: Ekero Yeso achia koriina obwato, aborokigwa baye bakamotunyana.
swahili: Naye alipoingia kwenye mashua, wanafunzi wake wakamfuata.

english: Suddenly a violent storm came up on the sea, so that the boat was engulfed by the waves; but Jesus was sleeping.
ekegusii: Rora, omwaga omonene okaimoka ase enyancha, goika obwato bogatubwa nemerindo; korende ere konya oraarire.
swahili: Ghafula, kukainuka dhoruba kali baharini hata mashua ikaanza kufunikwa na mawimbi, lakini Yesu alikuwa amelala usingizi.

english: The disciples went and woke Him, saying, “Lord, save us! We are perishing!”
ekegusii: Bakamochiera, bakamotura, bakamoteebia, “Omonene, totoorie, ngosira tore!”
swahili: Wanafunzi wake wakamwendea na kumwamsha, wakisema, “Bwana, tuokoe! Tunazama!”

english: “You of little faith,” Jesus replied, “why are you so afraid?” Then He got up and rebuked the winds and the sea, and it was perfectly calm.
ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Inaki mokwoboa, inwe abamore nokwegena ogoke?” Erio akaimoka, agatogonyera omwaga na enyancha; gokaba ogotoerera okonene.
swahili: Naye Yesu akawaambia, “Kwa nini mnaogopa, enyi wa imani haba?” Kisha akaamka na kukemea dhoruba na mawimbi, nako kukawa shwari kabisa.

english: The men were amazed and asked, “What kind of man is this? Even the winds and the sea obey Him!” The Demons and the Pigs (Mark 5:1–20; Luke 8:26–39)
ekegusii: Abanto baria bagakumia, bagateeba, “Monto ki oyo, nonya nomwaga na enyancha bikomoigwera?” Yeso okogwenia Abageraseni abwo Ebirecha biabwatete (Mar 5:1-20; Luk 8:26-39)
swahili: Wale watu wakashangaa, wakisema, “Ni mtu wa namna gani huyu? Hata upepo na mawimbi vinamtii!” Wawili Wenye Pepo Waponywa (Marko 5:1-20; Luka 8:26-39)

english: When Jesus arrived on the other side in the region of the Gadarenes, He was met by two demon-possessed men coming from the tombs. They were so violent that no one could pass that way.
ekegusii: Ekero achia goika ng’umbu y’ense y’Abageraseni, abanto babere ababwatire nebirecha bakaumerana nere, na barabwo nigo baare korwa ase chimbeera, nigo barenge abatindi mono, goika monto onde tarenge konyara goeta enchera eria.
swahili: Walipofika ngʼambo katika nchi ya Wagerasi, watu wawili waliopagawa na pepo wachafu walitoka makaburini nao wakakutana naye. Watu hawa walikuwa wakali mno kiasi kwamba hakuna mtu aliyeweza kupita njia ile.

english: “What do You want with us, Son of God?” they shouted. “Have You come here to torture us before the appointed time?”
ekegusii: Na rora, barabwo bagaaka eriogi bakaboora, “Inki obwate naintwe, Omwana o Nyasae? Inee! Ngwachire aiga gotoita ekero engaki etaraika?”
swahili: Wakapiga kelele, “Una nini nasi, Mwana wa Mungu? Umekuja hapa kututesa kabla ya wakati ulioamriwa?”

english: Jesus reached out His hand and touched the man. “I am willing,” He said. “Be clean!” And immediately his leprosy was cleansed.
ekegusii: Yeso akarambora okoboko kwaye, akamokuna, akamoteebia, “Nanchire; sibeka.” Erio agwo oborwaire bwaye bwa ukoma bogasibigwa.
swahili: Yesu akanyoosha mkono wake akamgusa yule mtu, akamwambia, “Nataka. Takasika!” Mara yule mtu akatakasika ukoma wake.

english: In the distance a large herd of pigs was feeding.
ekegusii: Ang’e nagwo ndiarengeo riicho rie chimbeche chinyinge, riare korisia.
swahili: Mbali kidogo kutoka pale walipokuwa, kulikuwa na kundi kubwa la nguruwe wakilisha.

english: So the demons begged Jesus, “If You drive us out, send us into the herd of pigs.”
ekegusii: Ebirecha biria bikamosorora, bikabora, “Onye kogotorusia aa, rirorio toe ribaga tosoe ase riicho rie chimbeche.”
swahili: Wale pepo wachafu wakamsihi Yesu, “Ukitutoa humu, turuhusu twende kwenye lile kundi la nguruwe.”

english: “Go!” He told them. So they came out and went into the pigs, and the whole herd rushed down the steep bank into the sea and died in the waters.
ekegusii: Yeso akabiteebia, “Genda!” Bigasooka, bigasoa ase chimbeche. Na rora, riicho rionsi rigatirimboka, rigasoa enyancha ime, rigasirera aroro.
swahili: Akawaambia, “Nendeni!” Hivyo wakatoka na kuwaingia wale nguruwe, nalo kundi lote likateremka gengeni kwa kasi, likaingia katika ziwa na kufa ndani ya maji.

english: Those tending the pigs ran off into the town and reported all this, including the account of the demon-possessed men.
ekegusii: Na abarisia b’echimbeche chiria bagatama, bakagenda omochie bakararia amang’ana onsi ayakoregete ase baria babwatire nebirecha.
swahili: Wale watu waliokuwa wakiwachunga hao nguruwe wakakimbia wakaingia mjini, wakaeleza yote kuhusu yale yaliyowatokea wale waliokuwa wamepagawa na pepo wachafu.

english: Then the whole town went out to meet Jesus. And when they saw Him, they begged Him to leave their region.
ekegusii: Na rora, abanto bonsi b’omochie oria bakagenda koumerana na Yeso; bagachia komoorora, bakamosorora arue orogongo rwabo.
swahili: Kisha watu wote wa mji huo wakatoka kwenda kukutana na Yesu. Nao walipomwona wakamsihi aondoke kwenye nchi yao.

english: Then Jesus instructed him, “See that you don’t tell anyone. But go, show yourself to the priest and offer the gift prescribed by Moses, as a testimony to them.” The Faith of the Centurion (Luke 7:1–10; John 4:43–54)
ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Rigereria, toteebia monto onde ing’ana; korende genda, bweorokie ase Omokuani, orue ekeng’wanso egiachigetwe na Musa, erinde kebe kirori ase abanto.” Yeso okogwenia Omosomba bw’omotang’ani bw’abarwani rigana (Luk 7:1-10)
swahili: Kisha Yesu akamwambia, “Hakikisha humwambii mtu yeyote. Lakini nenda ukajionyeshe kwa kuhani, na utoe sadaka aliyoamuru Mose, ili kuwa ushuhuda kwao.” Yesu Amponya Mtumishi Wa Jemadari (Luka 7:1-10)

english: When Jesus had entered Capernaum, a centurion came and pleaded with Him,
ekegusii: Ekero Yeso achia gosoa Kapernaumu, omotang’ani bw’abarwani rigana akamochiera, akamosorora,
swahili: Yesu alipoingia Kapernaumu, jemadari mmoja alimjia, kumwomba msaada,

english: “Lord, my servant lies at home, paralyzed and in terrible agony.”
ekegusii: agateeba, “Omonene, omosomba one nyomba araire, oborwaire bomogataetie, akoromwa mono.”
swahili: akisema, “Bwana, mtumishi wangu amelala nyumbani na amepooza, tena ana maumivu makali ya kutisha.”

english: “I will go and heal him,” Jesus replied.
ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Ninchiche komogwenia.”
swahili: Yesu akamwambia, “Nitakuja na kumponya.”

english: The centurion answered, “Lord, I am not worthy to have You come under my roof. But just say the word, and my servant will be healed.
ekegusii: Oria omotang’ani bw’abarwani rigana akamoiraneria, “Omonene, inche tinyisaini aye orasoe inse y’ekerama kiane; korende kwana ring’ana rioka, na omosomba one nagwene.
swahili: Lakini yule jemadari akamwambia, “Bwana, mimi sistahili wewe kuingia chini ya dari yangu. Lakini sema neno tu, naye mtumishi wangu atapona.

english: For I myself am a man under authority, with soldiers under me. I tell one to go, and he goes; and another to come, and he comes. I tell my servant to do something, and he does it.”
ekegusii: Inaki inche nomonto inde inse ase okobua, naende ninde nabarwani inse ase ’nde. Kondateebie oyo: Genda, ogenda; na oyonde: Inchuo, ocha; na omosomba one: Kora iga, okora.”
swahili: Kwa kuwa mimi mwenyewe ni mtu niliyewekwa chini ya mamlaka, nikiwa na askari chini yangu. Nikimwambia huyu, ‘Nenda,’ yeye huenda; na mwingine nikimwambia, ‘Njoo,’ yeye huja. Nikimwambia mtumishi wangu, ‘Fanya hivi,’ yeye hufanya.”

english: Jesus got into a boat, crossed over, and came to His own town.
ekegusii: Agasoa obwato, akaamboka, agaika omochie oye.
swahili: Yesu akaingia kwenye chombo, akavuka na kufika katika mji wa kwao.

english: Later, as Jesus was dining at Matthew’s house, many tax collectors and sinners came and ate with Him and His disciples.
ekegusii: Ekero Yeso aikaransire nyomba koragera, rora, abarusia ebango abange amo n’abanyabibe bagaacha, bagaikaransa amo na Yeso na aborokigwa baye.
swahili: Yesu alipokuwa akila chakula ndani ya nyumba ya Mathayo, watoza ushuru wengi na “wenye dhambi” wakaja kula pamoja naye na wanafunzi wake.

english: When the Pharisees saw this, they asked His disciples, “Why does your Teacher eat with tax collectors and sinners?”
ekegusii: Ekero Abafarisai bachia korora aya, bakabooria aborokigwa baye, “Nase ki Omworokia oino akoria amo nabarusia ebango n’a banyabibe?”
swahili: Mafarisayo walipoona mambo haya, wakawauliza wanafunzi wake, “Kwa nini Mwalimu wenu anakula pamoja na watoza ushuru na ‘wenye dhambi’?”

english: On hearing this, Jesus said, “It is not the healthy who need a doctor, but the sick.
ekegusii: Agachia koyaigwa, akabateebia, “Abare buya tibari korigia omogwenia, otatiga abarwarete.
swahili: Lakini Yesu aliposikia hayo, akawaambia, “Watu wenye afya hawahitaji tabibu, lakini wale walio wagonjwa ndio wanaohitaji tabibu.

english: But go and learn what this means: ‘I desire mercy, not sacrifice.’ For I have not come to call the righteous, but sinners. ” Questions about Fasting (Mark 2:18–20; Luke 5:33–35)
ekegusii: Genda mweorokererie engencho yaye ninki: Inche nigo ndigetie amaabera, gose tari ekeng’wanso. Inaki tincheti korangeria abanyaboronge, korende abanyabibe.” Riborio igoro y’okweng’ata (Mar 2:18-22; Luk 5:33-39)
swahili: Nendeni mkajifunze maana ya maneno haya: ‘Nataka rehema, wala si dhabihu.’ Kwa maana sikuja kuwaita wenye haki, bali wenye dhambi.” Yesu Aulizwa Kuhusu Kufunga (Marko 2:18-22; Luka 5:33-39)

english: At that time John’s disciples came to Jesus and asked, “Why is it that we and the Pharisees fast so often, but Your disciples do not fast?”
ekegusii: Ekero ekio aborokigwa ba Yohana bakamochiera, bakamoboria, Nase ki intwe na Abafarisai tokweng’ata ekero ase ekero, ko aborokigwa bao tibari kweng’ata
swahili: Wanafunzi wa Yohana Mbatizaji wakaja na kumuuliza Yesu, “Imekuwaje kwamba sisi na Mafarisayo tunafunga, lakini wanafunzi wako hawafungi?”

english: Jesus replied, “How can the guests of the bridegroom mourn while He is with them? But the time will come when the bridegroom will be taken from them; then they will fast. The Patches and the Wineskins (Mark 2:21–22; Luke 5:36–39)
ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Inee! Abarangerigwa b’enyangi inabanyare korera ekero omonywomi are amo nabarabwo? Korende amatuko nache, barache kourwa omonywomi; erio nario barache kweng’ata.
swahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Wageni wa bwana arusi wawezaje kuomboleza wakati angali pamoja nao? Wakati utafika ambapo bwana arusi ataondolewa kwao. Hapo ndipo watakapofunga.

english: No one sews a patch of unshrunk cloth on an old garment. For the patch will pull away from the garment, and a worse tear will result.
ekegusii: Onde tari okobeka ekeraka ki’egetambaa ekeyia ase eyanga engotu, ekiagera keria kiabekwa nigo kegotandora eyanga eria, na ase yatandogete ake nigo ekona‐gochiererera.
swahili: “Hakuna mtu anayeshonea kiraka kipya kwenye nguo iliyochakaa, kwa maana kile kiraka kitachanika kutoka kwenye hiyo nguo, nayo hiyo nguo itachanika zaidi.

english: Neither do men pour new wine into old wineskins. If they do, the skins will burst, the wine will spill, and the wineskins will be ruined. Instead, they pour new wine into new wineskins, and both are preserved.” The Healing Touch of Jesus (Mark 5:21–43; Luke 8:40–56)
ekegusii: Gose onde tari okobeeka edivai enyia ase ebirandi ebigotu biroisirie korwa ase amasankwa. Eise kobekwa bo, ebirandi biria nigo biratandoke, na edivai eiteke, na ebirandi bisareke; korende edivai enyia nigo ekobekwa ase ebirandi ebiyia, bionsi bibere biasirana.” Omoiseke o Yairo na omokungu ore noborwaire bw’okorua amanyinga bakogwenigwa (Mar 5:21-43; Luk 8:40-56)
swahili: Wala watu hawaweki divai mpya kwenye viriba vikuukuu. Kama wakifanya hivyo, viriba vitapasuka nayo divai itamwagika, navyo viriba vitaharibika. Lakini divai mpya huwekwa kwenye viriba vipya, na hivyo divai na viriba huwa salama.” Mwanamke Aponywa (Marko 5:21-43; Luka 8:40-56)

english: While Jesus was saying these things, a synagogue leader came and knelt before Him. “My daughter has just died,” he said. “But come and place Your hand on her, and she will live.”
ekegusii: Ekero Yeso are gokwana aya, omonene oyomo agacha, akabeeka amaru inse asare, okobora, “Omwana one omoiseke okuure bono iga, korende inchwo aye, omobekere okoboko, na ere nabe moyo.”
swahili: Yesu alipokuwa akiwaambia mambo haya, mara akaingia kiongozi wa sinagogi akapiga magoti mbele yake, akamwambia, “Binti yangu amekufa sasa hivi. Lakini njoo uweke mkono wako juu yake, naye atakuwa hai.”

english: So Jesus got up and went with him, along with His disciples.
ekegusii: Yeso akaimoka agatunyana omonto oria, ere na aborokigwa baye.
swahili: Yesu akaondoka akafuatana naye, nao wanafunzi wake pia wakaandamana naye.

english: Just then some men brought to Him a paralytic lying on a mat. When Jesus saw their faith, He said to the paralytic, “Take courage, son; your sins are forgiven.”
ekegusii: Na rigereria, bakamorentera omonto orenge rigata, oraire borere; na, ekero Yeso achia korora okwegena kwabo, agateebia oria rigata, “Remia enkoro, omwana one, ebibe biao biabeirwe.”
swahili: Wakati huo huo wakamletea mtu aliyepooza, akiwa amelazwa kwenye mkeka. Yesu alipoiona imani yao, alimwambia yule mtu aliyepooza, “Mwanangu, jipe moyo mkuu. Dhambi zako zimesamehewa.”

english: Suddenly a woman who had suffered from bleeding for twelve years came up behind Him and touched the fringe of His cloak.
ekegusii: Na rora, omokungu oyomo oyorenge noborwaire bw’okorua amanyinga ase engaki y’emiaka ikomi na ebere, akamochiera korwa magega, agakuna omokoba bw’eyanga yaye.
swahili: Wakati huo huo, mwanamke mmoja, ambaye alikuwa na ugonjwa wa kutokwa damu kwa muda wa miaka kumi na miwili, akaja nyuma ya Yesu, akagusa upindo wa vazi lake,

english: She said to herself, “If only I touch His cloak, I will be healed.”
ekegusii: Igo arengereretie ase omoyo oye ime, “Inse gokuna eyanga yaye, ningwene.”
swahili: kwa maana alisema moyoni mwake, “Kama nikigusa tu vazi lake, nitaponywa.”

english: Jesus turned and saw her. “Take courage, daughter,” He said, “your faith has healed you.” And the woman was cured from that very hour.
ekegusii: Yeso akeonchora, akamorora, akamoteebia, “Moiseke one, remia enkoro; okwegena kwao gwakogwenirie.” Omokungu oria akagwena erio kegima.
swahili: Yesu akageuka, naye alipomwona akamwambia, “Binti, jipe moyo mkuu, imani yako imekuponya.” Naye yule mwanamke akapona kuanzia saa ile ile. Yesu Amfufua Binti Wa Kiongozi Wa Sinagogi

english: When Jesus entered the house of the synagogue leader, He saw the flute players and the noisy crowd.
ekegusii: Yeso agachia gosoa enyomba y’omonto oria omonene, akarora ababugia ebiroria, na abanto basangererekaneteo bakorera.
swahili: Yesu alipofika nyumbani kwa yule kiongozi wa sinagogi na kuwaona waombolezaji wakipiga filimbi za maombolezo na watu wengi wakipiga kelele,

english: “Go away,” He told them. “The girl is not dead, but asleep.” And they laughed at Him.
ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Karuo aa! Omoiseke oyo takweti, okorara araire gwoka.” Bakamosekerera.
swahili: akawaambia, “Ondokeni! Kwa maana binti huyu hakufa, bali amelala.” Wakamcheka kwa dhihaka.

english: After the crowd had been put outside, Jesus went in and took the girl by the hand, and she got up.
ekegusii: Korende ekero baria basangererekanete amo basogetigwe isiko, agasoa ime, akamobwata okoboko, na omoiseke oria akaimoka.
swahili: Lakini watu walipokwisha kutolewa nje, akaingia mle ndani na kumshika yule binti mkono, naye akaamka.

english: And the news about this spread throughout that region. Jesus Heals the Blind and Mute (Mark 7:31–37)
ekegusii: Amang’ana aya agasarera ase ense eria yonsi. Yeso okogwenia abanto babere emeuko
swahili: Habari hizi zikaenea katika maeneo yale yote. Yesu Awaponya Vipofu

english: As Jesus went on from there, two blind men followed Him, crying out, “Have mercy on us, Son of David!”
ekegusii: Ekero Yeso arenge goeta korwa aase aria, abanto babere barenge emeuko bakamotunyana, bagaaka eriogi, bakaboora, “Tororere amaabera, aye omwana o Daudi!”
swahili: Yesu alipokuwa akiondoka mahali pale, vipofu wawili wakamfuata wakipiga kelele kwa nguvu na kusema, “Mwana wa Daudi, tuhurumie!”

english: After Jesus had entered the house, the blind men came to Him. “Do you believe that I am able to do this?” He asked. “Yes, Lord,” they answered.
ekegusii: Yeso agachia gosoa nyomba, emeuko eria ekamochiera. Yeso akababoria, “Inee! Mwegenire ng’a inche ninyare gokora ring’ana eri?” Bakamoteebia, “Ee, Omonene.”
swahili: Alipoingia mle nyumbani wale vipofu wakamjia. Naye Yesu akawauliza, “Mnaamini kwamba ninaweza kufanya jambo hili?” Wakamjibu, “Ndiyo, Bwana.”

english: Then He touched their eyes and said, “According to your faith will it be done to you.”
ekegusii: Erio agwo agakuna amaiso abo, akabateebia, “Abe ase more koreng’ana nokwegena kwaino.”
swahili: Ndipo Yesu akagusa macho yao na kusema, “Iwe kwenu sawasawa na imani yenu.”

english: On seeing this, some of the scribes said to themselves, “This man is blaspheming!”
ekegusii: Na rora, abande ase aborokia b’amariiko bakaboora ase emioyo yabo, “Omonto oyo ’nkorama are Nyasae.”
swahili: Kwa ajili ya jambo hili, baadhi ya walimu wa sheria wakasema mioyoni mwao, “Huyu mtu anakufuru!”

english: And their eyes were opened. Jesus warned them sternly, “See that no one finds out about this!”
ekegusii: Amaiso abo akaramokigwa. Yeso akabatianera bokong’u, “Rigereria monto onde tabaisa komanya amang’ana aya.”
swahili: Macho yao yakafunguka. Yesu akawaonya vikali, akisema, “Angalieni mtu yeyote asijue kuhusu jambo hili.”

english: But they went out and spread the news about Him throughout the land.
ekegusii: Korende barabwo bagasoka isiko, bagasareria amang’ana aye ase ense eria yonsi. Yeso okogwenia omonto orenge rimama, naende obwatire nekerecha
swahili: Lakini wao wakaenda na kueneza habari zake katika eneo lile lote. Yesu Amponya Mtu Bubu

english: As they were leaving, a demon-possessed man who was mute was brought to Jesus.
ekegusii: Ekero bachia gosoka isiko, rora, abanto bakamorentera omonto orenge rimama, naende nigo ere abwatire nekerecha.
swahili: Walipokuwa wanatoka, mtu mmoja aliyekuwa amepagawa na pepo mchafu na ambaye hakuweza kuongea aliletwa kwa Yesu.

english: And when the demon had been driven out, the man began to speak. The crowds were amazed and said, “Nothing like this has ever been seen in Israel!”
ekegusii: Ekero ekerecha giachia goserigwa, omonto oria rimama agakwana. Emeganda egakumia, ekabora, “Amang’ana anga buna aya tana kororekana nonya ng’ake ase Abaisraeli.”
swahili: Yule pepo mchafu alipotolewa, yule mtu aliyekuwa bubu akaongea. Ule umati wa watu ukastaajabu na kusema, “Jambo kama hili kamwe halijapata kuonekana katika Israeli.”

english: But the Pharisees said, “It is by the prince of demons that He drives out demons.” The Lord of the Harvest (Luke 10:1–12)
ekegusii: Korende Abafarisai bakaboora, “Ere nase chinguru chi’omonene bw’ebirecha agoseria ebirecha.”
swahili: Lakini Mafarisayo wakasema, “Huyo anatoa pepo wachafu kwa uwezo wa mkuu wa pepo wachafu.” Watendakazi Ni Wachache

english: Jesus went through all the towns and villages, teaching in their synagogues, preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing every disease and sickness.
ekegusii: Yeso agaetanana emechie yonsi na ebinyoro, okworokereria ase chisinagogi chiabo, okorandia amang’ana amaya y’oborwoti na kogwenia amarwaire onsi na oboreu bwonsi. Yeso okororera abanto amabeebe
swahili: Yesu akazunguka katika miji yote na vijiji vyote, akifundisha katika masinagogi yao, akihubiri habari njema za Ufalme, na akiponya kila ugonjwa na kila aina ya maradhi.

english: When He saw the crowds, He was moved with compassion for them, because they were harassed and helpless, like sheep without a shepherd.
ekegusii: Agachia korora emeganda y’ abanto, akabarorera amabeebe, ekiagera konya bachandekire, baserebekanire buna ching’ondi chitari nomorisia.
swahili: Alipoona makutano, aliwahurumia kwa sababu walikuwa wanasumbuka bila msaada, kama kondoo wasiokuwa na mchungaji.

english: Then He said to His disciples, “The harvest is plentiful, but the workers are few.
ekegusii: Erio agateebia aborokigwa baye, “Rigesa nerinene, korende abakori emeremo nabake;
swahili: Ndipo akawaambia wanafunzi wake, “Mavuno ni mengi lakini watendakazi ni wachache.

english: Ask the Lord of the harvest, therefore, to send out workers into His harvest.”
ekegusii: gaki mosabe Omonene bwe rigesa atome abakori emeremo ase rigesa riaye.”
swahili: Kwa hiyo mwombeni Bwana wa mavuno, ili apeleke watendakazi katika shamba lake la mavuno.”

english: But Jesus knew what they were thinking and said, “Why do you harbor evil in your hearts?
ekegusii: Korende Yeso namanyete ebirengererio biabo, akababoria, “Nase ki inwe mokorengereria ebirengererio ebibe ase chinkoro chiaino?
swahili: Lakini Yesu akiyafahamu mawazo yao, akawaambia, “Kwa nini mnawaza maovu mioyoni mwenu?

english: Which is easier: to say, ‘Your sins are forgiven,’ or to say, ‘Get up and walk?’
ekegusii: Ndiriri rire riango, goteeba: Ebibe biao biabeirwe, gose goteeba: Imoka ogende?
swahili: Je, ni lipi lililo rahisi zaidi: kusema, ‘Umesamehewa dhambi zako,’ au kusema, ‘Inuka, uende’?

english: But so that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins...” Then He said to the paralytic, “Get up, pick up your mat, and go home.”
ekegusii: Korende monyare komanya ng’a Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto nare nokobua ase ense gw’okwabera ebibe.” Erio agwo agateebia oria orenge rigata, “Imoka, bwetweke egeseero ki’ao, ogende bwoo.”
swahili: Lakini, ili mpate kujua kwamba Mwana wa Adamu anayo mamlaka duniani kusamehe dhambi…” Ndipo akamwambia yule aliyepooza, “Inuka, chukua mkeka wako, uende nyumbani kwako.”

english: And the man got up and went home.
ekegusii: Akaimoka, akagenda bwoye.
swahili: Yule mtu akasimama, akaenda nyumbani kwake.

english: When the crowds saw this, they were filled with awe and glorified God, who had given such authority to men. Jesus Calls Matthew (Mark 2:13–17; Luke 5:27–32)
ekegusii: Emeganda egachia korora aya, bakooboa, bakamotogia Nyasae, oy’oete Mwanyabaanto okobua konga buna oko. Okorangerigwa kwa Matayo (Mar 2:13-17; Luk 5:27-32)
swahili: Makutano walipoyaona haya, wakajawa na hofu ya Mungu, wakamtukuza Mungu ambaye alikuwa ametoa mamlaka kama haya kwa wanadamu. Kuitwa Kwa Mathayo (Marko 2:13-17; Luka 5:27-32)

english: As Jesus went on from there, He saw a man named Matthew sitting at the tax booth. “Follow Me,” He told him, and Matthew got up and followed Him.
ekegusii: Ekero Yeso achia goeta korwa aroro akarora omonto oyomo okorokwa Matayo, oikaransete aase enyomba ekoruserigwa ebango, akamoteebia, “Ntunyana!” Akaimoka, akamotunyana.
swahili: Yesu alipokuwa akienda kutoka huko, alimwona mtu mmoja jina lake Mathayo akiwa ameketi forodhani mahali pa kutoza ushuru. Yesu akamwambia, “Nifuate.” Mathayo akaondoka, akamfuata.

english: This is the word of the LORD that came to Micah the Moreshite in the days of Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah—what he saw regarding Samaria and Jerusalem:
ekegusii: Eri nario ring’ana ri’Omonene riachete ase Mika, oyo omenyete agwo Moreseti, ekero Yotamu, na Ahasi, na Hezekia, barenge abarwoti b’Abayuda. Omonene akamomaanorera Mika ayare gochia koba igoro ya Samaria na Yerusalemu. Okweumia igoro ya Samaria na Yerusalemu
swahili: Neno la Bwana lilimjia Mika, Mmoreshethi, wakati wa utawala wa Yothamu, Ahazi na Hezekia, wafalme wa Yuda; ufunuo aliouona kuhusu Samaria na Yerusalemu.

english: Do not tell it in Gath; do not weep at all. Roll in the dust in Beth-leaphrah.
ekegusii: Tiga goteebia ababisa baito ime ya Gati igoro y’okobugwa gwaito; timobaisa gotiga barore mokorera. Abanto ba Beti‐Le‐Afura orokia okorusia moyo kwaiko ase okwegaragaria igoro ase ebuse!
swahili: Usiliseme hili huko Gathi; usilie hata kidogo. Huko Beth-le-Afra gaagaa mavumbini.

english: Depart in shameful nakedness, O dwellers of Shaphir. The dwellers of Zaanan will not come out. Beth-ezel is in mourning; its support is taken from you.
ekegusii: Inwe abanto ba Safiri genda ase obooswa, getirianda more n’obosoku. Baria momenyete Saanani timweba mosoke korwa ase omochie obo omonene. Ekero moraigwe abanto ba Beti‐Hasaeli bakorera, agwo momanye ng’a botamero tibori aroro agwo.
swahili: Piteni mkiwa uchi na wenye aibu, ninyi mkaao Shafiri. Wale waishio Saanani hawatatoka nje. Beth-Eseli iko katika maombolezo; kinga yake imeondolewa kwako.

english: For the dwellers of Maroth pined for good, but calamity came down from the LORD, even to the gate of Jerusalem.
ekegusii: Abanto ba Maroti ganyerera obokonyi n’obwoba ase engencho Omonene oretire amaakwa ange na Yerusalemu.
swahili: Wale waishio Marothi wanagaagaa kwa maumivu wakingoja msaada, kwa sababu maangamizi yamekuja kutoka kwa Bwana, hata katika lango la Yerusalemu.

english: Harness your chariot horses, O dweller of Lachish. You were the beginning of sin to the Daughter of Zion, for the transgressions of Israel were found in you.
ekegusii: Inwe baria momenyete ime ya Lakisi agia chibarasi chiaino chi’esegi ebisibero. Inwe nigo mweegetie ebibe bi’Abaisraeli mokagera Yerusalemu egakora ebibe.
swahili: Enyi mkaao Lakishi, fungeni farasi kwenye magari ya vita. Mlikuwa chanzo cha dhambi kwa Binti Sayuni, kwa kuwa makosa ya Israeli yalikutwa kwako.

english: Therefore, send farewell gifts to Moresheth-gath; the houses of Achzib will prove deceptive to the kings of Israel.
ekegusii: Na bono, abanto ba Yuda batebie batigare buya omochie o Mosereti‐Gati. Abarwoti b’Abaisraeli tibakonyora gokonywa konde korwa ase omochie o Akisibuse.
swahili: Kwa hiyo utaipa Moresheth-Gathi zawadi za kuagana. Mji wa Akzibu utaonyesha wazi udanganyifu kwa wafalme wa Israeli.

english: I will again bring a conqueror against you, O dweller of Mareshah. The glory of Israel will come to Adullam.
ekegusii: Abanto ba Maresa Omonene nabaererie omobisa, oyio orachie koira omochie oino. Abarai b’Abaisraeli mbagende bebise ime ase rikuruma rire Adulamu.
swahili: Nitawaleteeni atakayewashinda ninyi mnaoishi Maresha. Yeye aliye utukufu wa Israeli atakuja Adulamu.

english: Shave yourselves bald and cut off your hair in mourning for your precious children; make yourselves as bald as an eagle, for they will go from you into exile.
ekegusii: Abanto ba Yuda kigita chitukia chiaino moreree abana baria mwanchete. Kora emetwe yaino erabe se buna ey’echinsoti ekiagera abana baino mbairwe obooswa are korwa ase more.
swahili: Nyoeni nywele zenu katika kuomboleza kwa ajili ya watoto wenu mnaowafurahia; jifanyieni upara kama tai, kwa kuwa watawaacha na kwenda uhamishoni.

english: Hear, O peoples, all of you; listen, O earth, and everyone in it! May the Lord GOD bear witness against you, the Lord from His holy temple.
ekegusii: Igwa amang’ana aya! Inwe abanto b’ebisaku bionsi, tegerera moigwe Inwe mwensi abwo momenyete ase ense, Omonene nabe kirori mamincha yaino. Tegerera moigwe amang’ana aya! Nigo agokwana korwa ase Hekalu yaye ya igoro.
swahili: Sikieni, enyi mataifa, enyi nyote, sikilizeni, ee dunia na wote mliomo ndani yake, ili Bwana Mwenyezi ashuhudie dhidi yenu, Bwana kutoka Hekalu lake takatifu. Hukumu Dhidi Ya Samaria Na Yerusalemu

english: For behold, the LORD comes forth from His dwelling place; He will come down and tread on the high places of the earth.
ekegusii: Rora, Omonene ngosoka are korwa aase aye achenu; ere ngoika are gocha aa, atare ebitunwa bi’ense.
swahili: Tazama! Bwana anakuja kutoka mahali pake; anashuka na kukanyaga mahali palipoinuka juu pa dunia.

english: The mountains will melt beneath Him, and the valleys will split apart, like wax before the fire, like water rushing down a slope.
ekegusii: Ebitunwa ebio mbinyititoke inse yaye, binyititoke buna obochoe bokonyititoka ase omorero, na bibe buna amaache akoba ekero aumoirwe ase egetirimboko.
swahili: Milima inayeyuka chini yake na mabonde yanagawanyika kama nta mbele ya moto, kama maji yatiririkayo kasi kwenye mteremko.

english: All this is for the transgression of Jacob and the sins of the house of Israel. What is the transgression of Jacob? Is it not Samaria? And what is the high place of Judah? Is it not Jerusalem?
ekegusii: Ayio nigo arabe ase engencho abanto ba Israeli bakorete ebibe bakaba mamincha ya Nyasae. Inee! Niing’o orabogorie ogosaria okwo kore ase abanto ba Israeli? ’Samaria omochie omonene omonyene! Na ase ogosaria okwo kw’ogosasiima emegwekano ase Abayuda? ’Yerusalemu enyene!
swahili: Yote haya ni kwa sababu ya kosa la Yakobo, ni kwa sababu ya dhambi za nyumba ya Israeli. Kosa la Yakobo ni lipi? Je, sio Samaria? Je, mahali pa juu pa Yuda pa kuabudia miungu ni nini? Je, sio Yerusalemu?

english: Therefore I will make Samaria a heap of rubble in the open field, a planting area for a vineyard. I will pour her stones into the valley and expose her foundations.
ekegusii: Ase ayio Omonene otebire “nintagore Samaria obe obonge bw’amagena, obe omogondo ase emesabibu erasimekwe. Ninturunkanie amagena ’omochie oyio gochia ase rigoko, nintubore amaroso aye atigwe maiso marore.
swahili: “Kwa hiyo nitaufanya Samaria kuwa lundo la kokoto, mahali pa kuotesha mizabibu. Nitayamwaga mawe yake katika bonde na kuacha wazi misingi yake.

english: All her carved images will be smashed to pieces; all her wages will be burned in the fire, and I will destroy all her idols. Since she collected the wages of a prostitute, they will be used again on a prostitute. Weeping and Mourning
ekegusii: Emegwekano yaye yonsi yerigori rinene egosasimwa nesamunyoranwe ebe ebisamunye, kera egento keria gekoegwa abatayayi be Hekalu ng’esarigwen’omorero, na emegwekano yaye yonsi nebe amatombe atigire. Samaria nigo yanyorete ebinto ebio bionsi ase emeyega y’okomenta oroiboro, bono ababisa baye mbababogorie korwa aroro gochia ase abatayayi b’echikalu b’echinsemo chinde.”
swahili: Sanamu zake zote zitavunjwa vipande vipande; zawadi zake zote za Hekalu zitachomwa kwa moto; nitaharibu vinyago vyake vyote. Kwa kuwa alikusanya zawadi zake kutokana na ujira wa kahaba, nazo zitatumika tena kulipa mishahara ya kahaba.” Kulia Na Kuomboleza

english: Because of this I will lament and wail; I will walk barefoot and naked. I will howl like a jackal and mourn like an ostrich.
ekegusii: Erio Mika agateeba, “ase engencho y’amang’ana aya nigo ndarere na kweumia. Ase o koorokia amagombo ane nigo ndatare ’ntabegeti bikoroto naende ’inde getirianda. Nigo ndaorie buna ekebwe naende ’mbuge buna esagero.
swahili: Kwa ajili ya hili nitalia na kuomboleza; nitatembea bila viatu na tena uchi. Nitabweka kama mbweha na kuomboleza kama bundi.

english: For her wound is incurable; it has reached even Judah; it has approached the gate of my people, as far as Jerusalem itself.
ekegusii: Amaote a Samaria takonyara kobwenigwa nabo igo Yuda yabereiri ange gochandeka enchera eyio eyio; ogotagorwa gwaikire ase ebiita bia Yerusalemu enyene agwo ase abanto bane bamenyete.” Ababisa bagocha Yerusalemu
swahili: Kwa sababu jeraha lake halitibiki; limekuja Yuda. Limefika hasa kwenye lango la watu wangu, hata Yerusalemu kwenyewe.

english: Woe to those who devise iniquity and plot evil on their beds! At morning’s light they accomplish it because the power is in their hands.
ekegusii: Naki erabe akong’u ase baria bakogeesa ase okoroberia amabe! Ekero bogokiamoka buna bakonyora ribaga rike baikerania obebe boria baroberetie.
swahili: Ole kwa wale wapangao uovu, kwa wale wafanyao shauri la hila vitandani mwao! Kunapopambazuka wanalitimiza kwa sababu uko katika uwezo wao kutekeleza.

english: Arise and depart, for this is not your place of rest, because its defilement brings destruction— a grievous destruction!
ekegusii: Imoka mogende; borendi tiboiyo aiga naende. Ebibe biano biaragereirie aase aa gochia ase obosareku.
swahili: Inuka, nenda zako! Kwa maana hapa sio mahali pako pa kupumzikia, kwa sababu pametiwa unajisi, pameharibiwa, wala hapatengenezeki tena.

english: If a man of wind were to come and say falsely, “I will preach to you of wine and strong drink,” he would be just the preacher for this people! The Remnant of Israel (Micah 5:7–15)
ekegusii: “Abanto aba nigo batagete omobani ogoetanana n’oborimo amo n’obong’ainereria boigo ogoteeba, ’nababaneire buna Edivai n’amarwa naumoke ase more.
swahili: Ikiwa mwongo na mdanganyifu atakuja na kusema, ‘Nitawatabiria divai na pombe kwa wingi,’ angekuwa ndiye nabii anayekubalika na watu hawa! Ahadi Ya Ukombozi

english: I will surely gather all of you, O Jacob; I will collect the remnant of Israel. I will bring them together like sheep in a pen, like a flock in the midst of its pasture— a noisy throng.
ekegusii: “Korende nimbasangererie mbabeke amo inwe abanto bonsi ba Israeli abwo batigarete. Nimbarete amo buna ching’ondi chikoirana gocha ase riicho. Buna oboriisia boichire ching’ondi, ense yaino neichorwe naende n’abanto abange.”
swahili: “Hakika nitawakusanya ninyi nyote, ee Yakobo, Hakika nitawaleta pamoja mabaki ya Israeli. Nitawaleta pamoja kama kondoo ndani ya zizi, kama kundi kwenye malisho yake, mahali hapa patakuwa na msongamano wa watu.

english: One who breaks open the way will go up before them; they will break through the gate, and go out by it. Their King will pass through before them, the LORD as their leader.
ekegusii: Omonene naigore chinchera ase bare naende abarae korwa ase obooswa. Mbasoke korwa ase ebiita bi’omochie omonene bagende bare n’obosibore. Omorwoti obo, Omonene obo bweka nere orabarae gochia isiko.
swahili: Yeye afunguaye njia atawatangulia; watapita kwenye lango na kutoka nje. Mfalme wao atawatangulia, Bwana atakuwa kiongozi.”

english: They covet fields and seize them; they take away houses. They deprive a man of his home, a fellow man of his inheritance.
ekegusii: Ekero barabwo batagete emegondo baurereria; ekero batagete chinyomba bachiira rioka. Eamate teiyo gose enibo bire n’oborendi.
swahili: Wanatamani mashamba na kuyakamata, pia nyumba na kuzichukua. Wanamlaghai mwanaume nyumba yake, mwanadamu mwenzake urithi wake.

english: Therefore this is what the LORD says: “I am planning against this nation a disaster from which you cannot free your necks. Then you will not walk so proudly, for it will be a time of calamity.
ekegusii: Ase igo Omonene nigo agoteeba, nigo ndoberetie koreta amaakwa ase more, nainwe timokonyaara koyatamboka. Ngochia more kwenyora ase obokong’u, naende timogochia konyara gotara n’obwerori naende.
swahili: Kwa hiyo, Bwana asema: “Ninapanga maangamizi dhidi ya watu hawa, ambayo hamwezi kujiokoa wenyewe. Hamtatembea tena kwa majivuno, kwa kuwa utakuwa ni wakati wa maafa.

english: In that day they will take up a proverb against you and taunt you with this bitter lamentation: ‘We are utterly ruined! He has changed the portion of my people. How He has removed it from me! He has allotted our fields to traitors.’”
ekegusii: Ekero chingaki chirache, abanto mbabogorie omogano oino koba ekiorokererio k’iobobe, na nigo baratere ogoteera gw’okwerusia moyo igoro ase ayio mwaeteire: “Twatagokire kegima! Omonene otourire ense yaito naende oyeire abanto baria batoosete.”
swahili: Siku hiyo watu watawadhihaki, watawafanyia mzaha kwa wimbo huu wa maombolezo: ‘Tumeangamizwa kabisa; mali ya watu wangu imegawanywa. Ameninyangʼanya! Ametoa mashamba yetu kwa wasaliti.’ ”

english: Therefore, you will have no one in the assembly of the LORD to divide the land by lot. Reproof of False Prophets (Ezekiel 13:1–16)
ekegusii: Na bono ekero engaki eraike ense ekoiranigwa gochia ase abanto b’Omonene, onde oino taiyo oranyore egatari aroro.
swahili: Kwa hiyo hutakuwa na yeyote katika kusanyiko la Bwana wa kugawanya mashamba kwa kura. Manabii Wa Uongo

english: “Do not preach,” they preach. “Do not preach these things; disgrace will not overtake us.”
ekegusii: Abanto nigo bakondanderia bateeba, Tobaisa gotorandia. Tobaisa korandia ayio onsi Omonene tari gochia gotoa obosoku.
swahili: Manabii wao husema, “Usitabiri. Usitabiri kuhusu vitu hivi; aibu haitatupata.”

english: Should it be said, O house of Jacob, “Is the Spirit of the LORD impatient? Are these the things He does?” Do not My words bring good to him who walks uprightly?
ekegusii: Nigo okorengereria buna Abaisraeli nigo bare inse y’okoragererigwa? Nigo Omoika bw’Omonene asirie okoremereria kwaye? Ekeene ere nakore ebinto ebio? Tari gokwana ase obwororo ase baria bagokora ay’ekeene?
swahili: Je, ingesemwa, ee nyumba ya Yakobo: “Je, Roho wa Bwana amekasirika? Je, yeye hufanya vitu kama hivyo?” “Je, maneno yangu hayamfanyii mema yeye ambaye njia zake ni nyofu?

english: But of late My people have risen up like an enemy: You strip off the splendid robe from unsuspecting passersby like men returning from battle.
ekegusii: Omonene airaneria, “Nigo mokoboera abanto bane buna ababisa. Abasacha nigo bakoirana korwa ase esegi, bakagerete ng’a mbare n’oborendi ase enka, korende nao more agwo moganyererete kobaboria chigoti chiabo korwa mareko.
swahili: Siku hizi watu wangu wameinuka kama adui. Unawavua joho la kitajiri wale wanaopita pasipo kujali, kama watu warudio kutoka vitani.

english: You drive the women of My people from their pleasant homes. You take away My blessing from their children forever.
ekegusii: Mwaseria abakungu b’abanto bane korwa ase chinka chiabo banchete, naende mwaunereirie abana babo ogosesenigwa kwane.
swahili: Unawahamisha wanawake wa watu wangu kutoka kwenye nyumba zao za kupendeza. Unaondoa baraka yangu kwa watoto wao milele.

english: Then I said: “Hear now, O leaders of Jacob, you rulers of the house of Israel. Should you not know justice?
ekegusii: Tegerera inwe abarai b’Abaisraeli! Eganga yaino nigo egwenerete koba okorigereria oboronge,
swahili: Kisha nikasema, “Sikilizeni enyi viongozi wa Yakobo, enyi watawala wa nyumba ya Israeli. Je, hampaswi kujua hukumu,

english: who build Zion with bloodshed and Jerusalem with iniquity.
ekegusii: Nigo mogendererete koagacha Yerusalemu omochie omonene o Nyasae, ase oboroso bw’ogoita n’borimo.
swahili: mnaojenga Sayuni kwa kumwaga damu na Yerusalemu kwa uovu.

english: Her leaders judge for a bribe, her priests teach for a price, and her prophets practice divination for money. Yet they lean upon the LORD, saying, “Is not the LORD among us? No disaster can come upon us.”
ekegusii: Abarai b’omochie omonene nigo bakogamba goetera ase amaaki, abakuani b’abana richiiko ase ogoakanwa, ababani barwa amaroro abo ase chitaabu boigo abwo bonsi bataamera buna Omonene nigo are amo na barabwo. Nigo bagoteeba, “bobe bonde tiboiyo boratochere.” Nainde bateeba “Omonene nigo are amo naitwe.”
swahili: Viongozi wake wanahukumu kwa rushwa, na makuhani wake wanafundisha kwa malipo, nao manabii wake wanatabiri kwa fedha. Hata hivyo wanamwegemea Bwana na kusema, “Je, Bwana si yumo miongoni mwetu? Hakuna maafa yatakayotupata.”

english: Therefore, because of you, Zion will be plowed like a field, Jerusalem will become a heap of rubble, and the temple mount a wooded ridge.
ekegusii: Ase ayio, ase engencho yaino Sayoni noremwe buna omogondo, Yerusalemu nobe amaturi, na egetunwa gie Hekalu ’nkebe rinani.
swahili: Kwa hiyo kwa sababu yenu, Sayuni italimwa kama shamba, Yerusalemu itakuwa lundo la kokoto, na kilima cha Hekalu kitakuwa kichuguu kilichofunikwa na vichaka.

english: You hate good and love evil. You tear the skin from my people and strip the flesh from their bones.
ekegusii: Korende nwe nigo mwangete aria are amaya naende nigo mwanhete ayare amabe. Nigo bogosabora abanto risankwa bare moyo naende mwarusia chinyama korwa amauga abo.
swahili: ninyi mnaochukia mema na kupenda maovu; ninyi mnaowachuna watu wangu ngozi na kuondoa nyama kwenye mifupa yao;

english: You eat the flesh of my people after stripping off their skin and breaking their bones. You chop them up like flesh for the cooking pot, like meat in a cauldron.”
ekegusii: Inwe nigo mokoria abanto baane. Mwabachobora risankwa, mwabuna amauga abo, mwababutorana buna chinyama chikobekwa enyongo.
swahili: ninyi mnaokula nyama ya watu wangu, mnaowachuna ngozi na kuvunja mifupa yao vipande vipande; mnaowakatakata kama nyama ya kuwekwa kwenye sufuria na kama nyama ya kuwekwa kwenye chungu?”

english: Then they will cry out to the LORD, but He will not answer them. At that time He will hide His face from them because of the evil they have done.
ekegusii: Engaki neike ekero morarere gochia ase Omonene korende takobairaneria inwe. Ere tagotegerera amasabo aino, ekiagera mwakorire amabe.
swahili: Kisha watamlilia Bwana, lakini hatawajibu. Wakati huo atawaficha uso wake kwa sababu ya uovu waliotenda.

english: This is what the LORD says: “As for the prophets who lead My people astray, who proclaim peace while they chew with their teeth, but declare war against one who puts nothing in their mouths:
ekegusii: Abanto bane nigo bakong’ainwa n’ababani abwo bakobariera chiira chi’omorembe baria bakobaakana, korende bagosereria baria batari kobaakana egesi. Ase ababani abwo Omonene nigo agoteeba,
swahili: Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana: “Kuhusu manabii wanaowapotosha watu wangu, mtu akiwalisha, wanatangaza ‘amani’; kama hakufanya hivyo, wanaandaa kupigana vita dhidi yake.

english: Therefore night will come over you without visions, and darkness without divination. The sun will set on these prophets, and the daylight will turn black over them.
ekegusii: “Inwe ababani, amatuko aino igo are ange koera; risase riabarimereire gochia inse. Ase engencho inwe mogosiria abanto bane, inwe timokonyora naende amaroro y’obobani, naende timokonyara kobana kende gionsi.”
swahili: Kwa hiyo usiku utawajieni, msiweze kuwa na maono, na giza, msiweze kubashiri. Jua litawachwea manabii hao, nao mchana utakuwa giza kwao.

english: Then the seers will be ashamed and the diviners will be disgraced. They will all cover their mouths because there is no answer from God.”
ekegusii: Baria bakobana aria agochia gocha mbasokigwe ase ogotaikerana kw’ayio. Abwo bonsi mbasookigwe ekiagera Nyasae takobairaneria barabwo kende.
swahili: Waonaji wataaibika na waaguzi watafedheheka. Wote watafunika nyuso zao kwa sababu hakuna jibu litokalo kwa Mungu.”

english: As for me, however, I am filled with power by the Spirit of the LORD, with justice and courage, to declare to Jacob his transgression and to Israel his sin.
ekegusii: Korende ase inde inche, Omonene nigo akongichoria n’Omoika oye n’echinguru, naende ong’a inche eki’orokererio ki’oboronge nabo igo oboremu bw’ogotebia abanto ba Israeli keria kere ebibe biabo.
swahili: Lakini kuhusu mimi, nimejazwa nguvu, nimejazwa Roho wa Bwana, haki na uweza, kumtangazia Yakobo kosa lake, na Israeli dhambi yake.

english: Now hear this, O leaders of the house of Jacob and rulers of the house of Israel, who despise justice and pervert all that is right,
ekegusii: Integerera inwe abarai b’Abaisraeli, inwe baria mwangete oboronge naende mogonchorana ekeene koba egetari boronge.
swahili: Sikieni hili, enyi viongozi wa nyumba ya Yakobo, enyi watawala wa nyumba ya Israeli, mnaodharau haki na kupotosha kila lililo sawa;

english: In the last days the mountain of the house of the LORD will be established as the chief of the mountains; it will be raised above the hills, and the peoples will stream to it.
ekegusii: Nebe ase amatuko ’omoerio ng’a egetunwa ki’enyomba y’Omonene ngekong’igwe, kebe ekenene goetania ebitunwa binde, nkeimokererigwe igoro goetania ebigoro binde; abanto abange mbaendoke gochiao.
swahili: Katika siku za mwisho mlima wa Hekalu la Bwana utaimarishwa kama mlima mkuu miongoni mwa milima yote; utainuliwa juu ya vilima, na watu wa mataifa watamiminika humo.

english: Writhe in agony, O Daughter of Zion, like a woman in labor. For now you will leave the city and camp in the open fields. You will go to Babylon; there you will be rescued; there the LORD will redeem you from the hand of your enemies!
ekegusii: Inwe abanto ba Sayoni, bina moigwe obororo buna obw’omokuungu okobina aibore; korwa bono karue ase omochie, momenye ase chinsana. Mogende Babiloni, na aroro motoorigwe. Aroro agwo Omonene nabatoorie korwa ase amaboko ’ababisa baino.
swahili: Gaagaa kwa utungu, ee Binti Sayuni, kama mwanamke mwenye utungu wa kuzaa, kwa kuwa sasa ni lazima uuache mji ukapige kambi uwanjani. Utakwenda Babeli; huko utaokolewa. Huko Bwana atakukomboa kutoka mikononi mwa adui zako.

english: But now many nations have assembled against you, saying, “Let her be defiled, and let us feast our eyes on Zion.”
ekegusii: Bono abanto b’ebisaku ebinge basangererekanire amo baabarwanie esegi, bagoteeba: “Tiga omochie oyio okorwe obe oyotachenegeti, naintwe tobe torigereretie Sayoni.”
swahili: Lakini sasa mataifa mengi yamekusanyika dhidi yako. Wanasema, “Mwache anajisiwe, macho yetu na yatazame Sayuni kwa furaha!”

english: But they do not know the thoughts of the LORD or understand His plan, for He has gathered them like sheaves to the threshing floor.
ekegusii: Korende abanto abwo tibamanyeti ebirengererio bi’Omonene, gose tibamanyeti omooroberio oye ng’a obasangereirie amo buna emesaima ere ase ekeooreri gi’okoorera.
swahili: Lakini hawayajui mawazo ya Bwana; hawauelewi mpango wake, yeye awakusanyaye kama miganda kwenye sakafu ya kupuria.

english: Rise and thresh, O Daughter of Zion, for I will give you horns of iron and hooves of bronze to break to pieces many peoples. Then you will devote their gain to the LORD, their wealth to the Lord of all the earth.
ekegusii: “Inwe abanto ba Sayoni, imoka moore, ekiagera ninkore ching’unchara chiaino chibe echi’ebioma, na ebitaago biaino bibe ebi’etai, erinde moake abanto abange, mobasamunyore.” Ebinto biabo morasakore mobiatanane bibe ebichenu ase Omonene, ne chinibo chiabo chibe echi’Omonene bw’ense engima.
swahili: “Inuka upure, ee Binti Sayuni, kwa kuwa nitakupa pembe za chuma; nitakupa kwato za shaba na utavunja vipande vipande mataifa mengi.” Utatoa mapato yao waliopata kwa udanganyifu kwa Bwana, utajiri wao kwa Bwana wa dunia yote.

english: And many nations will come and say: “Come, let us go up to the mountain of the LORD, to the house of the God of Jacob. He will teach us His ways, so that we may walk in His paths.” For the law will go forth from Zion and the word of the LORD from Jerusalem.
ekegusii: Abanto b’ebisaku ebinge mbabe bakogendao bagoteeba: “Inchuo totiire gochia ase egetunwa ki’Omonene, gochia ase enyomba ya Nyasae o Yakobo, erinde atworokererie chinchera chiaye, na intwe tochibwatie.” Amachiiko narue Sayoni, ne ring’ana ri’Omonene ndiiche korwa Yerusalemu.
swahili: Mataifa mengi yatakuja na kusema, “Njooni, twendeni mlimani mwa Bwana, kwenye nyumba ya Mungu wa Yakobo. Atatufundisha njia zake, ili tuweze kuenenda katika mapito yake.” Sheria itatoka Sayuni, neno la Bwana litatoka Yerusalemu.

english: Then He will judge between many peoples and arbitrate for strong nations far and wide. Then they will beat their swords into plowshares and their spears into pruning hooks. Nation will no longer take up the sword against nation, nor will they train anymore for war.
ekegusii: Erio Omonene nanache ekiina ase egati y’abanto abange, nagambie boronge ebisaku bire ne chinguru bimenyete aare. Abanto mbature emioro yabo y’esegi ebe amakombe, na amatimo abo abe emeyio chinkuro. Egesaku ekemo tigekoimoka korwania ekende, gose abanto tibakweorokereria korwana esegi nonya ng’ake.
swahili: Atahukumu kati ya mataifa mengi, na ataamua migogoro ya mataifa yenye nguvu na yaliyo mbali. Watafua panga zao ziwe majembe, na mikuki yao kuwa miundu ya kukata matawi. Taifa halitainua upanga dhidi ya taifa jingine, wala hawatajifunza vita tena.

english: And each man will sit under his own vine and under his own fig tree, with no one to frighten him. For the mouth of the LORD of Hosts has spoken.
ekegusii: Kera omonto nigo araikaranse inse y’emesabibu yaye na ase emeko yaye, na onde takoboboyia, ekiagera Omonene bw’Emeganda nere okwanire ayio.
swahili: Kila mtu ataketi chini ya mzabibu wake na chini ya mtini wake, wala hakuna mtu atakayewaogopesha, kwa kuwa Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote amesema.

english: Though each of the peoples may walk in the name of his god, yet we will walk in the name of the LORD our God forever and ever. The Restoration of Zion (Zechariah 8:1–23)
ekegusii: Kera egesaku nigo kerabwatie erieta ri’enyasae yaye, korende intwe nigo torabwatie erieta ri’Omonene Nyasae oito goika kare na kare. Abaisraeli mbairane korwa ase obosomba
swahili: Mataifa yote yanaweza kutembea katika jina la miungu yao; sisi tutatembea katika jina la Bwana Mungu wetu milele na milele. Mpango Wa Bwana

english: “On that day,” declares the LORD, “I will gather the lame; I will assemble the outcast, even those whom I have afflicted.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: “Ase rituko erio ninsangererie ebirema, naende ninsangererie abwo naseretie, na bonsi abwo naete amaakwa.
swahili: “Katika siku hiyo,” asema Bwana, “nitawakusanya walemavu; nitawakusanya walio uhamishoni na wale niliowahuzunisha.

english: And I will make the lame into a remnant, and the outcast into a strong nation. Then the LORD will rule over them in Mount Zion from that day and forever.
ekegusii: Nintige abare ebirema babe abatigari, na abwo baseretigwe babe egesaku kere ne chinguru. Omonene nabagambere agwo ase Egetunwa gia Sayoni, korwa bono na goika kare na kare.
swahili: Nitawafanya walemavu kuwa mabaki, wale waliofukuzwa kuwa taifa lenye nguvu. Bwana atatawala juu yao katika Mlima Sayuni kuanzia siku hiyo na hata milele.

english: And you, O watchtower of the flock, O stronghold of the Daughter of Zion— the former dominion will be restored to you; sovereignty will come to the Daughter of Jerusalem.”
ekegusii: “Naye Omorobiri bw’oborendi, aye ekegoro ki’omochie o Sayoni, obogambi bwao obokoro mbokoiranere, ee, obogambi bw’omochie o Yerusalemu.”
swahili: Lakini kuhusu wewe, ee mnara wa ulinzi wa kundi, ee ngome ya Binti Sayuni, milki ya awali itarudishwa kwako, ufalme utakuja kwa Binti Yerusalemu.”

english: Why do you now cry aloud? Is there no king among you? Has your counselor perished so that anguish grips you like a woman in labor?
ekegusii: Bono, ninki okorera neriogi rinene? Inee! Omorwoti tari ime yao? Abasemia bao mbasirigwe goika kwabeire nobororo buna obw’omokuungu okobina aibore?
swahili: Kwa nini sasa unalia kwa nguvu: kwani huna mfalme? Je, mshauri wako amekufa, hata maumivu yakukamate kama ya mwanamke aliye na utungu wa kuzaa?

english: Now, O daughter of troops, mobilize your troops; for a siege is laid against us! With a rod they will strike the cheek of the judge of Israel.
ekegusii: Aye Omochie bw’emeganda, sangereria emeganda yao y’esegi. Ababisa banaaririe omochie oito bayorwanie esegi. Barabwo mbaake omogambi bw’Abaisraeli orosea rwaye nenyimbo. Eira ya Nyasae igoro y’Omogambi orarwe Bethlehemu
swahili: Panga majeshi yako, ee mji wa majeshi, kwa kuwa kuzingirwa kumepangwa dhidi yetu. Watampiga mtawala wa Israeli shavuni kwa fimbo.

english: “In that day,” declares the LORD, “I will remove your horses from among you and wreck your chariots.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: “Ase rituko erio ninsirie chibarasi chiaino, ne chigari chiaino chirue ase more kegima.
swahili: “Katika siku ile,” asema Bwana, “nitaangamiza farasi zenu katikati yenu na kubomoa magari yenu ya vita.

english: I will remove the cities of your land and tear down all your strongholds.
ekegusii: Ninsarie emechie yonsi ere ase ense yaino, naende nintagore chindwaki chiaino echio mogwekengera.
swahili: Nitaiangamiza miji ya nchi yenu na kuziangusha chini ngome zenu zote.

english: I will cut the sorceries from your hand, and you will have no fortune-tellers.
ekegusii: Ninsirie oborogi korwa ase amaboko aino, na abaringoria tibakonyorekana ase more nonya ng’ake.
swahili: Nitaangamiza uchawi wenu na hamtapiga tena ramli.

english: I will also cut off the carved images and sacred pillars from among you, so that you will no longer bow down to the work of your own hands.
ekegusii: Ninsirie emegwekano yaino yonsi amo, ne chisiiro chiaino, ebinto ebio mogosasiima, na inwe timokogenderera gosasiima emeremo y’amaboko aino.
swahili: Nitaangamiza vinyago vyenu vya kuchonga na mawe yenu ya ibada yatoke katikati yenu; hamtasujudia tena kazi ya mikono yenu.

english: I will root out the Asherah poles from your midst and demolish your cities.
ekegusii: Ninsimore emete y’Asera eyio mogosasiima, ninyerusie korwa ase more, ninkore emechie yaino ebe bosa.
swahili: Nitangʼoa nguzo za Ashera katikati yenu na kubomoa miji yenu.

english: I will take vengeance in anger and wrath upon the nations that have not obeyed Me.”
ekegusii: Ninyeruserie egesiomba ase abanto b’ebisaku, abwo batari koigwera, inde nendamwamu na ekeririanda.”
swahili: Nitalipiza kisasi kwa hasira na ghadhabu juu ya mataifa ambayo hayajanitii.”

english: But you, Bethlehem Ephrathah, who are small among the clans of Judah, out of you will come forth for Me One to be ruler over Israel — One whose origins are of old, from the days of eternity.
ekegusii: “Korende aye Bethlehemu Efarata, aye ore omoke ase egati ye chiamate chi’egesaku ki’Abayuda, korwa asore nang’orokere oyomo orabe omogambi bw’Abaisraeli. Oyio nao arenge korwa agwo kare, ee, korwa kare na kare.”
swahili: “Lakini wewe, Bethlehemu Efrathi, ingawa u mdogo miongoni mwa koo za Yuda, kutoka kwako atatokea kwa ajili yangu yeye atakayekuwa mtawala katika Israeli, ambaye asili yake ni kutoka zamani, kutoka milele.”

english: Therefore Israel will be abandoned until she who is in labor has given birth; then the rest of His brothers will return to the children of Israel.
ekegusii: Ase ayio Omonene natige abanto baye goika engaki eike, ekero oyio okobina araibore; erio nario abanto bamwabo abatigari barairane gocha ase Abaisraeli.
swahili: Kwa hiyo Israeli utaachwa mpaka wakati mwanamke aliye na utungu atakapozaa na ndugu zake wengine warudi kujiunga na Waisraeli.

english: He will stand and shepherd His flock in the strength of the LORD, in the majestic name of the LORD His God. And they will dwell securely, for then His greatness will extend to the ends of the earth.
ekegusii: Ekero oyio oraiborwe arache, narisie riicho riaye ore ne chinguru chi’Omonene, ee, narisie nobonene bw’erieta ri’Omonene, Nyasae oye. Riicho riaye ndibe rirendire buya, ekiagera bono ere nabe omonene goika chinsinyo chionsi chi’ense.
swahili: Atasimama na kulichunga kundi lake katika nguvu ya Bwana, katika utukufu wa jina la Bwana Mungu wake. Nao wataishi kwa usalama, kwa kuwa wakati huo ukuu wake utaenea hadi miisho ya dunia.

english: And He will be our peace when Assyria invades our land and tramples our citadels. We will raise against it seven shepherds, even eight leaders of men.
ekegusii: Omorisia oyio nabe omorembe oito. Ogotooreka na egesusuro Ekero Abaasuri barache ase ense yaito gotorwania na basoe ase chinyomba chiaito chi’obonene, intwe ntosokie abarisia batano na babere, na abagaambi batano na batato, baabatange.
swahili: Naye atakuwa amani yao. Ukombozi Na Uharibifu Wakati Mwashuru atakapovamia nchi yetu na kupita katika ngome zetu, tutawainua wachungaji saba dhidi yake, hata viongozi wanane wa watu.

english: And they will rule the land of Assyria with the sword, and the land of Nimrod with the blade drawn. So He will deliver us when Assyria invades our land and marches into our borders. The Remnant of Jacob (Micah 2:12–13)
ekegusii: Barabwo mbasirie ense y’Abaasuri nemioro, na ense ya Nimurodi bayesirie nemeyio ya birende. Boigo mbatotoorie korwa ase Abaasuri ekero barasoe ase ense yaito goetera ase chimbebe chiaito.
swahili: Wataitawala nchi ya Ashuru kwa upanga, nchi ya Nimrodi kwa upanga. Atatuokoa kutoka kwa Mwashuru atakapoivamia nchi yetu na kuingia katika mipaka yetu.

english: Then the remnant of Jacob will be in the midst of many peoples like dew from the LORD, like showers on the grass, which do not wait for man or linger for mankind.
ekegusii: Erio abatigari ba Yakobo mbabe ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku ebinge, buna riime rigotonya korwa ase Omonene, na buna embura engiya egotwera obonyansi, embura eria tegoteebana koganya monto gete, gose Mwanyabaanto onde bwensi.
swahili: Mabaki ya Yakobo yatakuwa katikati ya mataifa mengi kama umande kutoka kwa Bwana, kama manyunyu juu ya majani, ambayo hayamngoji mtu wala kukawia kwa mwanadamu.

english: Then the remnant of Jacob will be among the nations, in the midst of many peoples, like a lion among the beasts of the forest, like a young lion among flocks of sheep, which tramples and tears as it passes through, with no one to rescue them.
ekegusii: Ee, abatigari abwo ba Yakobo mbabe ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku ebinge, babe buna endo ere ase egati ye ching’iti chire ase rinani, na buna endo ensae ere ase egati ye riicho rie ching’ondi, eyio ekero yasoire ase riicho nigo egotachera inse na gotandorana eyaitire, na onde tari oranyare koyetooria.
swahili: Mabaki ya Yakobo yatakuwa miongoni mwa mataifa, katikati ya mataifa mengi, kama simba miongoni mwa wanyama wa msituni, kama mwana simba miongoni mwa makundi ya kondoo, ambaye anaumiza vibaya na kuwararua kila anapopita katikati yao, wala hakuna awezaye kuokoa.

english: Your hand will be lifted over your foes, and all your enemies will be cut off.
ekegusii: Ase enchera eyio amaboko aino naimokererigwe igoro y’abachandi baino, na inwe mosirie kegima ababisa baino bonsi.
swahili: Mkono wako utainuliwa juu kwa ushindi juu ya watesi wako, nao adui zako wote wataangamizwa.

english: Hear now what the LORD says: “Arise, plead your case before the mountains, and let the hills hear your voice.
ekegusii: Bono inwe tegerera moigwe ay’Omonene agoteeba: Imoka, mwekwanere agwo bosio bw’ebitunwa, na motige ebigoro biigwe amariogi aino.
swahili: Sikiliza asemalo Bwana: “Simama, tetea shauri lako mbele ya milima; vilima na visikie lile unalotaka kusema.

english: Can I forget any longer, O house of the wicked, the treasures of wickedness and the short ephah, which is accursed?
ekegusii: Inee! Chinibo chi’obourereria nchigenderere kobeera ase chinyomba chi’abakori amabe? Na ebirengero bitaikeraneti biragereirie mbibeereo?
swahili: Je, bado nisahau, ee nyumba ya uovu, hazina yako uliyopata kwa udanganyifu na vipimo vilivyopunguka, ambavyo vimelaaniwa?

english: Can I excuse dishonest scales or bags of false weights?
ekegusii: Ninyare gwanchera ebirengero bi’obourereria, gose amagena ’obong’ainereria ay’okorengera abeere ase chisaro ime?
swahili: Je, naweza kuhukumu kuwa mtu mwenye mizani ya udanganyifu hana hatia, aliye na mfuko wa mawe ya kupimia ya uongo?

english: For the wealthy of the city are full of violence, and its residents speak lies; their tongues are deceitful in their mouths.
ekegusii: Abanto abanda bare ase egati yaino baichire nobourereria, na abwo bamenyete agwo nigo bagokwana oborimo, ne chimeme chiabo nigo chire echi’obong’ainereria.
swahili: Matajiri wake ni wajeuri; watu wake ni waongo na ndimi zao zinazungumza kwa udanganyifu.

english: Therefore I am striking you severely, to ruin you because of your sins.
ekegusii: Ase engencho y’ebibe biaino nimbaake timogwena rinde, mbasirie kegima.
swahili: Kwa hiyo, nimeanza kukuharibu, kuwaangamiza kwa sababu ya dhambi zenu.

english: You will eat but not be satisfied, and your hunger will remain with you. What you acquire, you will not preserve; and what you save, I will give to the sword.
ekegusii: Ekero morabe mokoragera, timokoigota; nigo moragenderere koba nenchara. Mosangererie na kwegachera ebinto, korende ebio mwegacheire nimbirue bisirigwe nemioro.
swahili: Mtakula lakini hamtashiba; matumbo yenu bado yatakuwa matupu. Mtaweka akiba lakini hamtaokoa chochote, kwa sababu mtakachoweka akiba nitatoa kwa upanga.

english: You will sow but not reap; you will press olives but not anoint yourselves with oil; you will tread grapes but not drink the wine.
ekegusii: Imosimeke chindagera, korende timogochigesa. Imomite amazeituni, korende timokweaka amaguta korwao; imomite amasabibu, korende timokonywa edivai ekorwao.
swahili: Mtapanda lakini hamtavuna; mtakamua zeituni lakini hamtatumia mafuta yake. Mtakamua zabibu lakini hamtakunywa hiyo divai.

english: You have kept the statutes of Omri and all the practices of Ahab’s house; you have followed their counsel. Therefore I will make you a desolation, and your inhabitants an object of contempt; you will bear the scorn of the nations. ”
ekegusii: Inwe nigo mwabeire mokobwatia amachiiko ’Omuri, na ogokora gwonsi kw’enyomba y’Ahabu, naende mwabeire mokoigwera ogosemia kwabo. Ase ayio nimbasirie kegima, na abamenyete ime yao babe bagochaywa, na igo mobogorie okoramwa okwo abanto baane barametwe.”
swahili: Mmezishika sheria za Omri na matendo yote ya nyumba ya Ahabu, tena umefuata desturi zao. Kwa hiyo nitakutoa kwa maangamizi na watu wako kuwa dhihaka; mtachukua dharau za mataifa.”

english: Hear, O mountains, the LORD’s indictment, you enduring foundations of the earth. For the LORD has a case against His people, and He will argue it against Israel:
ekegusii: “Inwe ebitunwa, nainwe ebitare, ninwe more oboroso bw’ense, tegerera moigwe ogosoera kw’Omonene! Ere nabwate amang’ana nabaanto baye, nare nekina n’Abaisraeli.
swahili: Sikilizeni, ee milima, mashtaka ya Bwana, sikilizeni, enyi misingi ya milele ya dunia. Kwa kuwa Bwana ana shauri dhidi ya watu wake; anatoa mashtaka dhidi ya Israeli.

english: ‘My people, what have I done to you? Testify against Me how I have wearied you!
ekegusii: “Inwe abanto baane, ngento ki nabakoreire? Nase amang’ana ki nabarosirie? Ng’iranerie!
swahili: “Watu wangu, nimewatendea nini? Nimewalemea kwa jinsi gani? Mnijibu.

english: For I brought you up from the land of Egypt and redeemed you from the house of slavery. I sent Moses before you, as well as Aaron and Miriam.
ekegusii: Nigo nabarusetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri; nkababooria korwa ase ense y’obosomba, inche ngatoma Musa, na Aroni, na Miriamu, bakaba bakobaraa.
swahili: Nimewatoa kutoka Misri na kuwakomboa kutoka nchi ya utumwa. Nilimtuma Mose awaongoze, pia Aroni na Miriamu.

english: My people, remember what Balak king of Moab counseled and what Balaam son of Beor answered. Remember your journey from Shittim to Gilgal, so that you may acknowledge the righteousness of the LORD.’”
ekegusii: Inwe abanto baane, inyora egento Balaki, omorwoti o Moabu, aroberetie gokora, na buna Baalamu, mosinto o Beori, amoiraneretie. Boigo inyora amang’ana akoregete ekero mwarenge ase orogendo korwa Sitimu gochia Giligali, erinde monyare komanya ogokora kw’oboronge kwane inche Omonene.” Ay’Omonene aganetie
swahili: Watu wangu, kumbukeni jinsi Balaki mfalme wa Moabu alivyofanya shauri na kile Balaamu mwana wa Beori alichojibu. Kumbukeni safari yenu kutoka Shitimu mpaka Gilgali, ili mfahamu matendo ya haki ya Bwana.”

english: With what shall I come before the LORD when I bow before the God on high? Should I come to Him with burnt offerings, with year-old calves?
ekegusii: “Ngento ki ndarentere Omonene, na ntung’ame ase obosio bwa Nyasae ore igoro? Inee! Nigo ndache ase obosio bwaye, ndetane ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa, gose chimori chiakoorire omwaka oyomo?
swahili: Nimjie Bwana na kitu gani na kusujudu mbele za Mungu aliyetukuka? Je, nije mbele zake na sadaka za kuteketezwa, nije na ndama za mwaka mmoja?

english: Would the LORD be pleased with thousands of rams, with ten thousand rivers of oil? Shall I present my firstborn for my transgression, the fruit of my body for the sin of my soul?
ekegusii: Inee! Omonene nagokigwe ne chimingichi chilifu, gose ne chindooche chi’amaguta chilifu ikomi? Inee! Nindue omwana one omotangi ase engencho y’ogosaria kwane, omwana oyio ore okwama kw’obogima bwane, abe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe ase engencho y’omoyo one?”
swahili: Je, Bwana atafurahishwa na kondoo dume elfu, au mito elfu kumi ya mafuta? Je, nimtoe mzaliwa wangu wa kwanza kwa ajili ya kosa langu, mtoto wangu mwenyewe kwa ajili ya dhambi ya nafsi yangu?

english: He has shown you, O man, what is good. And what does the LORD require of you but to act justly, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God? The Punishment of Israel
ekegusii: Aye Mwanyabaanto, Omonene okworokirie ayare amaya. Ninki Omonene aganetie korwa asore otatiga okore ayare ay’oboronge, na bwanche gokora ayare ay’obwanchani, naende otaare ase oboitongo ase obosio bwa Nyasae oo.
swahili: Amekuonyesha yaliyo mema, ee mwanadamu. Bwana anataka nini kwako? Ila kutenda kwa haki na kupenda rehema, na kwenda kwa unyenyekevu na Mungu wako. Hatia Na Adhabu Ya Israeli

english: The voice of the LORD calls out to the city (and it is sound wisdom to fear Your name): “Heed the rod and the One who ordained it.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo akorangeria abare ase omochie, na omonto oirogete erieta riaye nere omong’aini. Eriogi riaye nigo rigoteeba: “Igwa igoro y’egesusuro na ning’o ogechikiire.
swahili: Sikiliza! Bwana anauita mji: kulicha jina lako ni hekima: “Tii hiyo fimbo na yeye aliyeiamuru.

english: Woe is me! For I am like one gathering summer fruit at the gleaning of the vineyard; there is no cluster to eat, no early fig that I crave.
ekegusii: Obobe nobwane, ekiagera nabeire nkororekana buna ekero amatunda ’omorakera agosangererigwa, na ayatigaire ase emesabibu achorirwe. Ebisago bi’amasabibu bikoriegwa tibiyo, na amako amatang’ani, aya nganetie, taiyo.
swahili: Taabu gani hii niliyo nayo! Nimefanana na yule akusanyaye matunda ya kiangazi, aokotaye masazo baada ya kuvunwa shamba la mizabibu; hakuna kishada chenye matunda ya kula, hakuna hata ile tini ya mwanzoni ninayoitamani.

english: Then my enemy will see and will be covered with shame— she who said to me, “Where is the LORD your God?” My eyes will see her; at that time she will be trampled like mud in the streets.
ekegusii: Erio oria ore omobisa one arore ayio, na obosooku mbomotube oria omboretie, “Ng’ai Omonene, Nyasae oo, are?” Nimorigererie ngoke; ere natiringerwe inse buna esike ere inchera.
swahili: Kisha adui yangu ataliona naye atafunikwa na aibu, yule aliyeniambia, “Yu wapi Bwana Mungu wako?” Macho yangu yataona kuanguka kwake, hata sasa atakanyagwa chini ya mguu kama tope barabarani.

english: The day for rebuilding your walls will come— the day for extending your boundary.
ekegusii: Rituko ndiche ekero chindwaki chiao chiraagachwe. Ase rituko erio chimbebe chiao nchigareeigwe.
swahili: Siku ya kujenga kuta zako itawadia, siku ya kupanua mipaka yako.

english: On that day they will come to you from Assyria and the cities of Egypt, even from Egypt to the Euphrates, from sea to sea and mountain to mountain.
ekegusii: Ase rituko erio abanto mbagochere korwa Asuri na korwa ase emechie ya Misiri, ee, korwa Misiri goika orooche rwa Eufarati, na korwa ase enyancha eyemo goika ase eyende, na korwa ase egetunwa ekemo goika ase ekende.
swahili: Siku hiyo watu watakuja kwako kutoka Ashuru na miji ya Misri, hata kutoka Misri hadi Frati na kutoka bahari hadi bahari na kutoka mlima hadi mlima.

english: Then the earth will become desolate because of its inhabitants, as the fruit of their deeds. God’s Compassion on Israel
ekegusii: Korende ense netigwe ebe bosa ase engencho y’abanto bamenyeteo; okwo korabe okwama kw’ogokora kwabo okobe. Omonene okororera Abaisraeli amaabera
swahili: Dunia itakuwa ukiwa kwa sababu ya wakazi wake, kwa sababu ya matunda ya matendo yao. Sala Na Sifa

english: Shepherd with Your staff Your people, the flock of Your inheritance. They live alone in a woodland, surrounded by pastures. Let them graze in Bashan and Gilead, as in the days of old.
ekegusii: Risia abanto bao nenyimbo yao abanto abwo bare riicho ri’omwando oo, rimenyete ao rioka ase rinani ime agwo Karimeli. Oritige rikorisia agwo Basani na Gileadi, buna yarenge ase amatuko a kare.
swahili: Wachunge watu wako kwa fimbo yako, kundi la urithi wako, ambalo linaishi peke yake msituni, katika nchi ya malisho yenye rutuba. Waache walishe katika Bashani na Gileadi kama ilivyokuwa siku za kale.

english: As in the days when you came out of Egypt, I will show My wonders.
ekegusii: “Nimborokie amakumia buna nakorete ekero mwaruete ase ense ya Misiri.”
swahili: “Kama siku zile mlipotoka Misri, nitawaonyesha maajabu yangu.”

english: Nations will see and be ashamed, deprived of all their might. They will put their hands over their mouths, and their ears will become deaf.
ekegusii: Ekero abanto b’ebisaku bararore ayio mbasooke, ekiagera chinguru chiabo chiabuirwe. Mbatube emenwa yabo namaboko abo, na amato abo natine.
swahili: Mataifa yataona na kuaibika, waliondolewa nguvu zao zote. Wataweka mikono yao kwenye vinywa vyao na masikio yao yatakuwa na uziwi.

english: They will lick the dust like a snake, like reptiles slithering on the ground. They will crawl from their holes in the presence of the LORD our God; they will tremble in fear of You.
ekegusii: Barabwo mbamene orotu rwe riroba buna ching’iti ching’enda inse. Mbarue ase chinyomba chiabo chinkong’u bakoiguswa bekurure inse buna amakonde; mbakoonchokere aye Omonene, Nyasae oito, bare nobwoba obonene, ee, mbakoiroke aye.
swahili: Wataramba mavumbi kama nyoka, kama viumbe vitambaavyo juu ya ardhi. Watatoka nje ya mapango yao wakitetemeka; watamgeukia Bwana Mungu wetu kwa hofu nao watakuogopa.

english: Who is a God like You, who pardons iniquity and passes over the transgression of the remnant of His inheritance— who does not retain His anger forever, because He delights in loving devotion?
ekegusii: Inee! Nyasae onde nare onga buna aye? Aye nigo okwabera abatigari abare omwando oo ebibe biabo, na kweba obobe bwabo. Aye tori kogenderera koba nendamwamu yao goika kare na kare, ekiagera bwanchete koorokia obwanchani bwao botari koera.
swahili: Ni nani Mungu kama wewe, ambaye anaachilia dhambi na kusamehe makosa ya mabaki ya urithi wake? Wewe huwi na hasira milele, bali unafurahia kuonyesha rehema.

english: He will again have compassion on us; He will vanquish our iniquities. You will cast out all our sins into the depths of the sea.
ekegusii: Aye notoiranere, otororere amaabera naende; notiringere ebibe biaito inse y’amagoro ao, nobitugute bionsi ime ase chindiba chi’enyancha.
swahili: Utatuhurumia tena, utazikanyaga dhambi zetu chini ya nyayo zako, na kutupa maovu yetu yote katika vilindi vya bahari.

english: The godly man has perished from the earth; there is no one upright among men. They all lie in wait for blood; they hunt one another with a net.
ekegusii: Abanto bamoirogete Nyasae basirire korwa ase ense, na oyore nenkoro endonge tari ase egati y’abanto. Bonsi nigo bakoboera abanto baitere amanyinga abo. Kera omonto nigo akobwata, oyomwabo noboreba.
swahili: Wanaomcha Mungu wameondolewa kutoka nchi; hakuna mtu mnyofu hata mmoja aliyebaki. Watu wote wanavizia kumwaga damu, kila mmoja anamwinda ndugu yake kwa wavu.

english: You will show faithfulness to Jacob and loving devotion to Abraham, as You swore to our fathers from the days of old.
ekegusii: Aye noorokerie ororeria rwa Yakobo obwegenwa bwao, na orwa Aburaamu obwanchani bwao botari koera, buna kwarierete chisokoro chiaito eira korwa ase amatuko a kare, ogatiana.
swahili: Utakuwa wa kweli kwa Yakobo, nawe utamwonyesha Abrahamu rehema, kama ulivyowaahidi kwa kiapo baba zetu siku za kale.

english: Both hands are skilled at evil; the prince and the judge demand a bribe. When the powerful utters his evil desire, they all conspire together.
ekegusii: Abanto aba nigo bare nomokia gokora ayare amabe namaboko abo. Omogambi nigo anchete aegwe riaaki, na omogambi ebiina boigo; omonto ore nokobua nigo agosaba aegwe ebi aganetie ase okogania kwaye okobe, na nigo babwateranete amo.
swahili: Mikono yote miwili ni hodari katika kufanya ubaya, mtawala anadai zawadi, hakimu anapokea rushwa, wenye nguvu wanaamuru wanachotaka: wote wanafanya shauri baya pamoja.

english: The best of them is like a brier; the most upright is sharper than a hedge of thorns. The day for your watchmen has come, the day of your visitation. Now is the time of their confusion.
ekegusii: Oyore omuya goetania abande ase egati yabo nigo anga buna egetutu kere namagwa, na oyore nenkoro endonge nigo are nobobe kobua orobago rogiteire amagwa. Ekero rituko ri’abarendi bao, riria ri’egesusuro kiao riraike, abanto mbabe nomoichano.
swahili: Aliye mwema kupita wote kati yao ni kama mchongoma, anayeonekana mnyofu zaidi miongoni mwao ni mbaya kuliko uzio wa miiba. Siku ya walinzi wako imewadia, siku atakayokutembelea Mungu. Sasa ni wakati wao wa kuchanganyikiwa.

english: Do not rely on a friend; do not trust in a companion. Seal the doors of your mouth from her who lies in your arms.
ekegusii: Tobaisa kwegena omogisangio oo, gose gosemeria omosani oo. Orende amang’ana akorwa ase omonwa oo, nonya mokao tayamanya.
swahili: Usimtumaini jirani; usiweke matumaini kwa rafiki. Hata kwa yule alalaye kifuani mwako uwe mwangalifu kwa maneno yako.

english: For a son dishonors his father, a daughter rises against her mother, and a daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law. A man’s enemies are the members of his own household. Israel’s Confession and Comfort
ekegusii: Omwana omomura nigo agochaaya ise, na omwana omoiseke nigo akoamererania na ng’ina, na moka momura oamererania na ng’ina biara. Ababisa b’omonto nabaanto b’enyomba yaye omonyene.
swahili: Kwa kuwa mwana humdharau baba yake, naye binti huinuka dhidi ya mama yake, mkwe kuwa kinyume na mama mkwe wake: adui wa mtu ni wale wa nyumbani mwake hasa.

english: But as for me, I will look to the LORD; I will wait for the God of my salvation. My God will hear me.
ekegusii: Korende inche omonyene nindigererie Omonene; ninganye inde nogosemeria ase Nyasae ore ogotooreka kwane; Nyasae one nanyigwe. Omonene okorenta ogotooreka
swahili: Lakini mimi, namtazama Bwana kwa matumaini, namngoja Mungu Mwokozi wangu; Mungu wangu atanisikia mimi. Israeli Atainuka

english: Do not gloat over me, my enemy! Though I have fallen, I will arise; though I sit in darkness, the LORD will be my light.
ekegusii: Aye omobisa one, togokera okogwa kwane; ekero ndagwe, nintenene naende; ekero ndabe inde ase omosunte, Omonene nabe etaya yane.
swahili: Usifurahie msiba wangu, ee adui yangu! Ingawa nimeanguka, nitainuka. Japo ninaketi gizani, Bwana atakuwa nuru yangu.

english: Because I have sinned against Him, I must endure the rage of the LORD, until He argues my case and executes justice for me. He will bring me into the light; I will see His righteousness.
ekegusii: Ekiagera nakorire ebibe ase Omonene, nindemererie endamwamu yaye, goika ere agambe amang’ana aane na ang’e oboronge bwane. Ere nandete ase omobaso, na inche ningokere oboronge bwaye.
swahili: Kwa sababu nimetenda dhambi dhidi yake, nitabeba ghadhabu ya Bwana, mpaka atakaponitetea shauri langu na kuithibitisha haki yangu. Atanileta nje kwenye mwanga, nami nitaiona haki yake.

english: Then Jesus left that place and went into the region of Judea, beyond the Jordan. Again the crowds came to Him and He taught them, as was His custom.
