ekegusii: Yeso akaimoka korwa agwo, agaika chimbebe chia Boyahudi, ng’umbu ya Yorodani. Abanto abange bakamosangererekanera naende; akaborokereria aroro, buna anarete botambe.
swahili: Yesu akaondoka huko, akavuka Mto Yordani, akaenda sehemu za Uyahudi. Umati mkubwa wa watu ukaenda kwake tena, naye kama ilivyokuwa desturi yake, akawafundisha.

english: When they were back inside the house, the disciples asked Jesus about this matter.
ekegusii: Naende nyomba ime aborokigwa bakabooria Yeso engencho ye ring’ana erio.
swahili: Walipokuwa tena ndani ya nyumba, wanafunzi wake wakamuuliza kuhusu jambo hili.

english: So He told them, “Whoever divorces his wife and marries another woman commits adultery against her.
ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Kera omonto oratige mok’aye, na kunyuoma oyonde, otomanire igoro asare:
swahili: Akawajibu, “Mtu yeyote amwachaye mkewe na kuoa mke mwingine, anazini naye.

english: And if a woman divorces her husband and marries another man, she commits adultery.” Jesus Blesses the Children (Matthew 19:13–15; Luke 18:15–17)
ekegusii: na omokungu karatige omosacha oye, na konyuomwa nomonto onde, nere otomanire.” Yeso ogosesenia abana abake (Mat 19:13-15; Luk 18:15-17)
swahili: Naye mwanamke amwachaye mumewe na kuolewa na mume mwingine, anazini.” Yesu Anawabariki Watoto Wadogo (Mathayo 19:13-15; Luka 18:15-17)

english: Now people were bringing the little children to Jesus for Him to place His hands on them, and the disciples rebuked those who brought them.
ekegusii: Bakamorentera abana abake, erinde anyare kobakuna; aborokigwa baye bakabatanga.
swahili: Watu walikuwa wakimletea Yesu watoto wadogo ili awaguse, lakini wanafunzi wake wakawakemea.

english: But when Jesus saw this, He was indignant and told them, “Let the little children come to Me, and do not hinder them! For the kingdom of God belongs to such as these.
ekegusii: Korende Yeso agachia korora, akabea mono, akabateebia, “Batige abana abake bache ase ’nde, timobaisa kobatanga, ekiagera abare buna aba, oborwoti bwa Nyasae nobwabo
swahili: Yesu alipoona yaliyokuwa yakitukia, akachukizwa. Akawaambia wanafunzi wake, “Waacheni watoto wadogo waje kwangu, wala msiwazuie, kwa maana Ufalme wa Mungu ni wa wale walio kama hawa.

english: Truly I tell you, anyone who does not receive the kingdom of God like a little child will never enter it.”
ekegusii: Ekeene nabateebirie: Onde bwensi otanyoreti oborwoti bwa Nyasae buna omwana omoke, takobosoa nonya ng’ake.”
swahili: Amin, nawaambia, mtu yeyote asiyeupokea Ufalme wa Mungu kama mtoto mdogo, hatauingia kamwe.”

english: And He took the children in His arms, placed His hands on them, and blessed them. The Rich Young Man (Matthew 19:16–30; Luke 18:18–30)
ekegusii: Akabaimokia, akabaagata ase amaboko aye, akabasesenia, okobeeka amaboko aye igoro ase bare. Omomura omonda (Mat 19:16-22; Luk 18:18-23)
swahili: Akawachukua watoto mikononi mwake, akawakumbatia, akaweka mikono yake juu yao, akawabariki. Kijana Tajiri (Mathayo 19:16-30; Luka 18:18-30)

english: As Jesus started on His way, a man ran up and knelt before Him. “Good Teacher,” he asked, “what must I do to inherit eternal life?”
ekegusii: Ekero Yeso achaaka orogendo rwaye kogenda enchera, omonto oyomo agacha bwango, akamotung’amera, akamobooria, “Omworokia omuya, inki ndakore inyare koba nomwando bw’obogima bwa kare na kare?”
swahili: Yesu alipokuwa anaondoka, mtu mmoja akamkimbilia, akapiga magoti mbele yake, akamuuliza, “Mwalimu mwema, nifanye nini ili niurithi uzima wa milele?”

english: “Why do you call Me good?” Jesus replied. “No one is good except God alone.
ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Inaki okondoka omuya? Onde tari omuya otatiga Nyasae bweka.
swahili: Yesu akamwambia, “Mbona unaniita mwema? Hakuna yeyote aliye mwema ila Mungu peke yake.

english: You know the commandments: ‘Do not murder, do not commit adultery, do not steal, do not bear false witness, do not cheat others, honor your father and mother.’ ”
ekegusii: Kwamanyire amachiiko: toita, totomana, toiba, toteba oborimo, tong’aina, sika iso na nyoko.”
swahili: Unazijua amri: ‘Usiue, usizini, usiibe, usishuhudie uongo, usidanganye, waheshimu baba yako na mama yako.’ ”

english: Some Pharisees came to test Him. “Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife?” they inquired.
ekegusii: Abafarisai bakamochiera, bakamobooria, “Inee! Mboronge omonto gotiga mok’aye?” Bakamoteema.
swahili: Baadhi ya Mafarisayo wakaja ili kumjaribu kwa kumuuliza, “Je, ni halali mtu kumwacha mke wake?”

english: “Teacher,” he replied, “all these I have kept from my youth.”
ekegusii: Akamoteebia, “Omworokia, ayio onsi ninyabwatete korwa obwana bwane.”
swahili: Akamjibu, “Mwalimu, amri hizi zote nimezishika tangu nikiwa mtoto.”

english: Jesus looked at him, loved him, and said to him, “There is one thing you lack: Go, sell everything you own and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven. Then come, follow Me. ”
ekegusii: Yeso akamobeta amaiso, akamwancha, akamoteebia, “Egento ekemo ngekoremete; genda, oonie ebio ore nabio bionsi, oe abataka, na aye n’obe nenibo igoro; erio oche ontunyane.”
swahili: Yesu akamtazama na kumpenda, akamwambia, “Umepungukiwa na kitu kimoja. Nenda ukauze kila kitu ulicho nacho uwape maskini hizo fedha, nawe utakuwa na hazina mbinguni. Kisha njoo, unifuate.”

english: But the man was saddened by these words and went away in sorrow, because he had great wealth.
ekegusii: Korende ere akanyiria obosio ase ring’ana riria, akagenda n’obororo, ekiagera arenge n’eniibo enyinge. Obobe bw’obotenenku (Mat 19:23-30; Luk 18:24-30)
swahili: Yule mtu aliposikia hayo, akasikitika sana. Akaondoka kwa huzuni kwa sababu alikuwa na mali nyingi.

english: Then Jesus looked around and said to His disciples, “How hard it is for the rich to enter the kingdom of God!”
ekegusii: Yeso akarigereria chinsemo chionsi, agateebia aborokigwa baye, “Nabe aakong’u ase abare abanda gosoa ase oborwoti bwa Nyasae.”
swahili: Yesu akatazama pande zote, akawaambia wanafunzi wake, “Itakuwa vigumu sana kwa wenye mali kuingia katika Ufalme wa Mungu!”

english: And the disciples were amazed at His words. But Jesus said to them again, “Children, how hard it is to enter the kingdom of God!
ekegusii: Aborokigwa bagaichana ase amang’ana aya. Yeso akairaneria naende, akabateebia, “Abana, nabe aakong’u ase abasemeretie enibo gosoa ase oborwoti bwa Nyasae!
swahili: Wanafunzi wake wakashangazwa sana na maneno hayo. Lakini Yesu akawaambia tena, “Wanangu, tazama jinsi ilivyo vigumu kwa wale wanaotumainia mali kuingia katika Ufalme wa Mungu.

english: It is easier for a camel to pass through the eye of a needle than for a rich man to enter the kingdom of God.”
ekegusii: Naororo engamia goeta ase ekebao gi’esindani kobua omonda gosoa ase oborwoti bwa Nyasae.”
swahili: Ni rahisi zaidi kwa ngamia kupita kwenye tundu la sindano kuliko mtu tajiri kuingia katika Ufalme wa Mungu.”

english: They were even more astonished and said to one another, “Who then can be saved?”
ekegusii: Aborokigwa baye bagaichana mono, bakaboorania, “Ning’o rende oranyare gotooreka?”
swahili: Wanafunzi wake wakashangaa sana. Wakaulizana wao kwa wao, “Ni nani basi awezaye kuokoka?”

english: Jesus looked at them and said, “With man this is impossible, but not with God. For all things are possible with God.”
ekegusii: Yeso akabarigereria, akabora, “Ase Mwanyabaanto takonyarekana, korende ase Nyasae taibo, ekiagera onsi nigo akonyarekana ase Nyasae.”
swahili: Yesu akawatazama, akawaambia, “Kwa mwanadamu jambo hili haliwezekani, lakini kwa Mungu sivyo. Mambo yote yanawezekana kwa Mungu.”

english: Peter began to say to Him, “Look, we have left everything and followed You.”
ekegusii: Petero agachaaka komoteebia, “Rora, intwe twatigire bionsi, twagotunyanire.”
swahili: Ndipo Petro akamjibu, “Tazama, tumeacha kila kitu na kukufuata wewe!”

english: “Truly I tell you,” Jesus replied, “no one who has left home or brothers or sisters or mother or father or children or fields for My sake and for the gospel
ekegusii: Yeso akabora, “Ekeene nabateebirie: Monto onde otigire enyomba, gose bamura bamwabo, gose basubati bamwabo, gose ng’ina, gose ise, gose abana, gose emegondo ase engencho y’ane, gose ase engencho y’enchiri, chinyomba, na bamura bamwabo, na basubati bamwabo, na abang’ina, na abana, na emegondo, ase emechando,
swahili: Yesu akasema, “Amin, nawaambia, hakuna mtu yeyote aliyeacha nyumba, ndugu wa kiume au wa kike, au mama au baba, au watoto au mashamba kwa ajili yangu na kwa ajili ya Injili,

english: “What did Moses command you?” He replied.
ekegusii: Ere akabairaneria, “Inki Musa abachiigete?”
swahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Je, Mose aliwaamuru nini?”

english: will fail to receive a hundredfold in the present age—houses and brothers and sisters and mothers and children and fields, along with persecutions—and in the age to come, eternal life.
ekegusii: ere naegwe ebinge ase chingaki echi chia bono, na ase ense egochi-gocha obogima bwa kare na kare.
swahili: ambaye hatalipwa mara mia katika ulimwengu huu: nyumba, ndugu wa kiume na wa kike, mama na baba na watoto, mashamba pamoja na mateso, kisha uzima wa milele katika ulimwengu ujao.

english: But many who are first will be last, and the last will be first.” The Third Prediction of the Passion (Matthew 20:17–19; Luke 18:31–34)
ekegusii: Korende abange abare ab’eritang’ani, ’nababe abamagega; na abamagega babe ab’eritang’ani.” Yeso ogokwana eriagatato igoro y’ogokwa kwaye (Mat 20:17-19; Luk 18:31-34)
swahili: Lakini wengi walio wa kwanza watakuwa wa mwisho, na wa mwisho watakuwa wa kwanza.” Yesu Atabiri Mara Ya Tatu Kufa Na Kufufuka Kwake (Mathayo 20:17-19; Luka 18:31-34)

english: As they were going up the road to Jerusalem, Jesus was walking ahead of them. The disciples were amazed, but those who followed were afraid. Again Jesus took the Twelve aside and began to tell them what was going to happen to Him:
ekegusii: Bakaba inchera, bagotiira kogenda Yerusalemu. Yeso nigo arenge obatang’aine, na barabwo bagaichana, na abamotunyanete bakairoka. Naende akaira baria ikomi na babere, agachaaka kobateebia ebirage bi’amang’ana agochia komonyoora,
swahili: Walikuwa njiani wakipanda kwenda Yerusalemu, na Yesu alikuwa ametangulia. Wanafunzi wake walishangaa, nao watu waliowafuata walijawa na hofu. Yesu akawachukua tena wale wanafunzi wake kumi na wawili kando na kuwaambia yatakayompata.

english: “Look, we are going up to Jerusalem, and the Son of Man will be delivered over to the chief priests and scribes. They will condemn Him to death and will deliver Him over to the Gentiles,
ekegusii: akabora, “Rigereria, ngotiira tore kogenda Yerusalemu, na Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto nabekwe ase amaboko y’abakuani abanene na aborokia b’amariiko. Abwo nabamogambie, na bamobeke ase amaboko abanto b’Ebisaku,
swahili: Akasema, “Tunapanda kwenda Yerusalemu, na Mwana wa Adamu atasalitiwa kwa viongozi wa makuhani na walimu wa sheria. Wao watamhukumu kifo na kumtia mikononi mwa watu wa Mataifa,

english: who will mock Him and spit on Him and flog Him and kill Him. And after three days He will rise again.” The Request of James and John (Matthew 20:20–28)
ekegusii: na barabwo nabamochecherie, na komoaka chinkini, na komotwera amate, na komoita akwe; magega y’amatuko atato nabooke.” Okoboria kwa Yakobo na Yohana (Mat 20:20-23)
swahili: ambao watamdhihaki na kumtemea mate, watampiga na kumuua. Siku tatu baadaye atafufuka.” Ombi La Yakobo Na Yohana (Mathayo 20:20-28)

english: Then James and John, the sons of Zebedee, came to Jesus and declared, “Teacher, we want You to do for us whatever we ask.”
ekegusii: Yakobo na Yohana, abana ba Zebedi, bakamochiera, bakamoteebia, “Omworokia, ntorigetie otokorere rinde rionsi toragosabe.”
swahili: Kisha Yakobo na Yohana, wana wa Zebedayo, wakaja kwake na kumwambia, “Mwalimu, tunataka utufanyie lolote tutakalokuomba.”

english: “What do you want Me to do for you?” He inquired.
ekegusii: Yeso akababoria, “Inki morigetie mbakorere?”
swahili: Naye akawaambia, “Je, mwataka niwafanyie jambo gani?”

english: They answered, “Grant that one of us may sit at Your right hand and the other at Your left in Your glory.”
ekegusii: Bakamoiraneria, “Otwanchere intwe toikaranse, oyomo ensemo y’okoboko kwao gw’okorio, na oyonde ensemo y’okoboko kwao gw’okobee, ase obonene bwao.”
swahili: Wakamwambia, “Tupe kukaa mmoja upande wako wa kuume na mwingine upande wako wa kushoto katika utukufu wako.”

english: “You do not know what you are asking,” Jesus replied. “Can you drink the cup I will drink, or be baptized with the baptism I will undergo?”
ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Timomanyeti eki mogosaba. Inee! Namonyare konywera egekombe nkonywera inche, na kobatiswa ebatiso inche mbatisire?”
swahili: Lakini Yesu akawaambia, “Ninyi hamjui mnaloliomba. Je, mnaweza kukinywea kikombe ninyweacho mimi, au kubatizwa ubatizo nibatizwao mimi?”

english: “We can,” the brothers answered. “You will drink the cup that I drink,” Jesus said, “and you will be baptized with the baptism that I undergo.
ekegusii: Bakamoiraneria, “Ntonyare.” Yeso akabateebia, “Egekombe nkonywera inche imokenywere, na ebatiso ’mbatisire inche imobatiswe,
swahili: Wakajibu, “Tunaweza.” Kisha Yesu akawaambia, “Kikombe nikinyweacho mtakinywea na ubatizo nibatizwao mtabatizwa,

english: They answered, “Moses permitted a man to write his wife a certificate of divorce and send her away.”
ekegusii: Bagateeba, “Musa nigo aruete ribaga koriika riruube ri’ogotigana, na komotiga.”
swahili: Wakajibu, “Mose aliruhusu kwamba mume anaweza kumwandikia mkewe hati ya talaka na kumwacha.”

english: But to sit at My right or left is not Mine to grant. These seats belong to those for whom they have been prepared.”
ekegusii: korende ribaga ri’ogoikaransa ensemo y’okoboko kw’ane gw’okorio na okoboko nogw’okobee tinkonyara kobaa, otatiga abwo bagacheire barariegwe.” Obonene bw’ekeene (Mat 20:24-28; Luk 22:24-27)
swahili: lakini kuketi mkono wangu wa kuume au wa kushoto si juu yangu mimi kuwapa. Nafasi hizi ni kwa ajili ya wale walioandaliwa.”

english: When the ten heard about this, they became indignant with James and John.
ekegusii: Ekero baria ikomi bachia koigwa aya, bagachaaka kobea Yakobo na Yohana.
swahili: Wale wanafunzi wengine kumi waliposikia hayo, wakaanza kuwakasirikia Yakobo na Yohana.

english: So Jesus called them together and said, “You know that those regarded as rulers of the Gentiles lord it over them, and their superiors exercise authority over them.
ekegusii: Yeso akabarangeria, akabateebia, “Mwamanyire ng’a baria baabarirwe koba abagaambi b’ abanto b’Ebisaku nigo bakobagaambera ne chinguru, na abanene babo nigo bakobachiika.
swahili: Lakini Yesu akawaita wote pamoja na kuwaambia, “Mnafahamu kuwa wale wanaodhaniwa kuwa watawala wa watu wa Mataifa huwatawala watu kwa nguvu, nao wenye vyeo huonyesha mamlaka yao.

english: But it shall not be this way among you. Instead, whoever wants to become great among you must be your servant,
ekegusii: Korende takoba bo ase more. Omonto origetie koba omonene ase more, nabe omokoreri oino.
swahili: Lakini isiwe hivyo kwenu. Badala yake, yeyote anayetaka kuwa mkuu miongoni mwenu hana budi kuwa mtumishi wenu,

english: and whoever wants to be first must be the slave of all.
ekegusii: Na omonto orarigie koba oyo bw’eritang’ani ase more, nabe omosomba o bonsi.
swahili: na yeyote anayetaka kuwa wa kwanza, hana budi kuwa mtumwa wa wote.

english: For even the Son of Man did not come to be served, but to serve, and to give His life as a ransom for many.” Jesus Heals Bartimaeus (Matthew 20:29–34; Luke 18:35–43)
ekegusii: Inaki Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto tachete gokorerwa, korende gokorera, na korua obogima bwaye, erinde bobe embooria y’abange.” Baritimayo oria orenge omouko okogwenigwa (Mat 20:29-34; Luk 18:35-43)
swahili: Kwa kuwa hata Mwana wa Adamu hakuja ili kutumikiwa, bali kutumika na kuutoa uhai wake uwe fidia kwa ajili ya wengi.” Yesu Amponya Kipofu Bartimayo (Mathayo 20:29-34; Luka 18:35-43)

english: Next, they came to Jericho. And as Jesus and His disciples were leaving Jericho with a large crowd, a blind beggar named Bartimaeus, the son of Timaeus, was sitting beside the road.
ekegusii: Bagaika Yeriko. Goika Yeso agachia koba okobwatia enchera korwa Yeriko amo naborokigwa baye na omoganda omonene, omwana o Timayo, Baritimayo, oyio orenge omouko, nigo arenge oikaransete enchera ensemo, ogosaba ebiegwa.
swahili: Kisha wakafika Yeriko. Yesu alipokuwa akiondoka mjini na wanafunzi wake pamoja na umati mkubwa wa watu, kipofu mmoja, jina lake Bartimayo, mwana wa Timayo, alikuwa ameketi kando ya njia akiomba msaada.

english: When he heard that it was Jesus of Nazareth, he began to cry out, “Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on me!”
ekegusii: Agachia koigwa ng’a Yeso Omonazareti ogoeta, agachaaka goaka eriogi, ogoteeba, “Yeso, omwana o Daudi, indorere amaabera!”
swahili: Aliposikia kuwa ni Yesu wa Nazareti aliyekuwa anapita, akaanza kupaza sauti akisema, “Yesu, Mwana wa Daudi, nihurumie!”

english: Many people admonished him to be silent, but he cried out all the louder, “Son of David, have mercy on me!”
ekegusii: Abanto abange bakamotogonyera, bakamoteebia ng’a anyare gokira, korende akamenta goaka eriogi kobua, ogoteeba “Omwana o Daudi, indorera amaabera!”
swahili: Watu wengi wakamkemea, wakamwambia akae kimya, lakini yeye akazidi kupaza sauti, akisema, “Mwana wa Daudi, nihurumie!”

english: Jesus stopped and said, “Call him.” So they called the blind man. “Take courage!” they said. “Get up! He is calling for you.”
ekegusii: Yeso agatenena, akabora, “Morangerie!” Bakarangeria omouko oria, bakamoteebia, “Remia enkoro yao, imoka, okorangeirie.”
swahili: Yesu akasimama na kusema, “Mwiteni.” Hivyo wakamwita yule mtu kipofu, wakamwambia, “Jipe moyo! Inuka, anakuita.”

english: But Jesus told them, “Moses wrote this commandment for you because of your hardness of heart.
ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Ase engencho y’obokong’u bwe chinkoro chiaino nakio kiagerete abariikerete ogochika oko.
swahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Mose aliwaandikia sheria hiyo kwa sababu ya ugumu wa mioyo yenu.

english: Throwing off his cloak, Bartimaeus jumped up and came to Jesus.
ekegusii: Ere agatuguta eanga yaye, agacharoka, agachiera Yeso.
swahili: Akiwa analivua lile joho lake, alisimama na kumwendea Yesu.

english: “What do you want Me to do for you?” Jesus asked. “Rabboni,” said the blind man, “let me see again.”
ekegusii: Yeso akamobooria, “Ninki origetie ngokorere?” Omonto oria orenge omouko akamoiraneria, “Omworokia, inyare korora.”
swahili: Yesu akamuuliza, “Unataka nikufanyie nini?” Yule kipofu akajibu, “Mwalimu, nataka kuona.”

english: “Go,” said Jesus, “your faith has healed you.” And immediately he received his sight and followed Jesus along the road.
ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Genda! Okwegena kwao gwakogwenirie.” Erio kegima akaba nkorora are, agatunyana Yeso kwagachia.
swahili: Yesu akamwambia, “Nenda zako, imani yako imekuponya.” Mara akapata kuona, akamfuata Yesu njiani.

english: However, from the beginning of creation, ‘God made them male and female.’
ekegusii: Korende korwa omochakano bw’ogotongwa gw’ense Nyasae nigo atongete omosacha na omokungu.
swahili: Lakini tangu mwanzo wa uumbaji, ‘Mungu aliwaumba mwanaume na mwanamke.

english: ‘For this reason a man will leave his father and mother and be united to his wife,
ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio omonto natige ise na ng’ina, abwatane na mok’aye,
swahili: Kwa sababu hii mwanaume atamwacha baba yake na mama yake na kuambatana na mkewe, na hao wawili watakuwa mwili mmoja.’

english: and the two will become one flesh.’ So they are no longer two, but one flesh.
ekegusii: na abwo babere nigo barabe omobere oyomo. Ase igo tibakoba babere naende, korende omobere oyomo.
swahili: Kwa hiyo hawatakuwa wawili tena, bali mwili mmoja.

english: Therefore what God has joined together, let man not separate.”
ekegusii: Naboigo ebi Nyasae abwatanirie, Mwanyabaanto tabiatanana.”
swahili: Basi, alichokiunganisha Mungu, mwanadamu asikitenganishe.”

english: As they approached Jerusalem and came to Bethphage and Bethany at the Mount of Olives, Jesus sent out two of His disciples
ekegusii: Ekero bachia goika ang’e na Yerusalemu, bagaika Betifage na Bethania, ase egetunwa ki’Emezeituni, Yeso agatoma babere baborokigwa baye,
swahili: Walipokaribia Yerusalemu, wakafika Bethfage na Bethania katika Mlima wa Mizeituni. Yesu akawatuma wawili wa wanafunzi wake,

english: “Blessed is the coming kingdom of our father David!” “Hosanna in the highest!”
ekegusii: Mbosesenirie oborwoti bogocha, oborwoti bwa sokoro yaito Daudi! Hosana aye ore igoro!”
swahili: “Umebarikiwa Ufalme unaokuja wa baba yetu Daudi!” “Hosana kwake yeye aliye juu!”

english: Then Jesus entered Jerusalem and went into the temple courts. He looked around at everything, but since it was already late, He went out to Bethany with the Twelve. Jesus Curses the Fig Tree (Matthew 21:18–22; Mark 11:20–25)
ekegusii: Yeso agasoa Yerusalemu agaika ase Hekalu ime; akarigereria buya chinsemo chionsi kera egento. Korende ase engencho nigo kiarenge ekero kia mogoroba, agasoka, akagenda Bethania amo na baria ikomi na babere. Yeso okoragereria Omoko (Mat 21:18-19)
swahili: Yesu akaingia Yerusalemu na kwenda Hekaluni. Akaangalia kila kitu kilichokuwamo, lakini kwa kuwa ilishakuwa jioni, akaenda zake Bethania pamoja na wale kumi na wawili. Yesu Alaani Mtini Usiozaa (Mathayo 21:18-19)

english: The next day, when they had left Bethany, Jesus was hungry.
ekegusii: Rituko riare kobwatia kobakorwa Bethania Yeso akaigwa enchara.
swahili: Kesho yake walipokuwa wakitoka Bethania, Yesu alikuwa na njaa.

english: Seeing in the distance a fig tree in leaf, He went to see if there was any fruit on it. But when He reached it, He found nothing on it except leaves, since it was not the season for figs.
ekegusii: Akarora korwa are omoko ore namato, akagenda arore gose amako nareo. Agachia goika aroro tarora gento otatiga amato, ekiagera tikiarenge ekero ki’amako.
swahili: Akauona mtini kwa mbali, naye akaenda ili aone kama ulikuwa na matunda. Alipoufikia, akakuta una majani tu, kwa kuwa hayakuwa majira ya tini.

english: Then He said to the tree, “May no one ever eat of your fruit again.” And His disciples heard this statement. Jesus Cleanses the Temple (Matthew 21:12–17; Luke 19:45–48; John 2:12–25)
ekegusii: Yeso agateebia omoko oria, “Korwa bono monto taria amatunda ao nonya ndinde.” Aborokigwa baye bakaigwa aya. Yeso ogochena Hekalu (Mat 21:12-17; Luk 19:45-48; Yoh 2:13-22)
swahili: Akauambia ule mti, “Tangu leo mtu yeyote asile kamwe matunda kutoka kwako.” Wanafunzi wake walimsikia akisema hayo. Yesu Atakasa Hekalu (Mathayo 21:12-17; Luka 19:45-48; Yohana 2:13-22)

english: When they arrived in Jerusalem, Jesus entered the temple courts and began to drive out those who were buying and selling there. He overturned the tables of the money changers and the seats of those selling doves.
ekegusii: Bagaika Yerusalemu. Yeso agasoa ase Hekalu ime, agachaaka goseria abanto abarenge koonia na kogora aroro, agaonchorana chimesa chi’abaare goonchoreria chitaabu, na ebirogo bi’abaare koonia amaruma;
swahili: Walipofika Yerusalemu, Yesu akaingia katika eneo la Hekalu, akaanza kuwafukuza wale waliokuwa wakinunua na kuuza humo ndani. Akazipindua meza za wale waliokuwa wakibadilisha fedha, na pia viti vya wale waliokuwa wakiuza njiwa,

english: And He would not allow anyone to carry merchandise through the temple courts.
ekegusii: tatiga monto abogorie gento ase egati ye Hekalu.
swahili: wala hakumruhusu mtu yeyote kuchukua bidhaa kupitia ukumbi wa Hekalu.

english: Then Jesus began to teach them, and He declared, “Is it not written: ‘My house will be called a house of prayer for all the nations’? But you have made it ‘a den of robbers.’ ”
ekegusii: Akorokereria, okobateebia, “Inee! Teriikiri iga: Enyomba y’ane nerokwe enyomba y’ogosaba ase ebisaku bionsi? Korende inwe mwayekorire koba ribwago ri’abauri.”
swahili: Naye alipokuwa akiwafundisha, akasema, “Je, haikuandikwa kuwa: “ ‘Nyumba yangu itaitwa nyumba ya sala kwa mataifa yote’? Lakini ninyi mmeifanya kuwa ‘pango la wanyangʼanyi.’ ”

english: When the chief priests and scribes heard this, they looked for a way to kill Him. For they were afraid of Him, because the whole crowd was astonished at His teaching.
ekegusii: Abakuani abanene na aborokia b’amariiko bakanyora amang’ana, bakarigia enchera y’okomosiria, ekiagera bamoirogete; naki emeganda yonsi egakumia ase okworokereria kwaye.
swahili: Viongozi wa makuhani na walimu wa sheria wakapata habari hizi, nao wakaanza kutafuta njia ya kumuua, kwa kuwa walikuwa wakimwogopa, kwa sababu umati wote ulikuwa unashangazwa na mafundisho yake.

english: And when evening came, Jesus and His disciples went out of the city. The Withered Fig Tree (Matthew 21:18–22; Mark 11:12–14)
ekegusii: Koriaba mogoroba akarua ase omochie. Amegerio korwa ase omoko omwomo (Mat 21:20-22)
swahili: Ilipofika jioni, Yesu na wanafunzi wake wakatoka nje ya mji. Mtini Ulionyauka (Mathayo 21:20-22)

english: and said to them, “Go into the village ahead of you, and as soon as you enter it, you will find a colt tied there, on which no one has ever sat. Untie it and bring it here.
ekegusii: akabateebia, “Genda ase ekenyoro keria mokoorokera, erio kamogosoa aroro, namorore emori y’etigere esibire, etana koriinwa na monto; moyendetere.
swahili: akawaambia, “Nendeni katika kijiji kilichoko mbele yenu. Na hapo mtakapoingia kijijini, mtamkuta mwana-punda amefungwa hapo, ambaye hajapandwa na mtu bado. Mfungueni, mkamlete hapa.

english: As they were walking back in the morning, they saw the fig tree withered from its roots.
ekegusii: Na mambia kobagoeta, bakarora omoko oria bwomire bwonsi korwa ase emeri yaye.
swahili: Asubuhi yake walipokuwa wakipita, wakauona ule mtini umenyauka kutoka juu hadi kwenye mizizi yake.

english: Peter remembered it and said, “Look, Rabbi! The fig tree You cursed has withered.”
ekegusii: Petero akainyora amang’ana aria, agateebia Yeso, “Rabii, rora, omoko oria kwaragereretie bwomire.”
swahili: Petro akakumbuka na kumwambia Yesu, “Rabi, tazama! Ule mtini ulioulaani umenyauka!”

english: “Have faith in God,” Jesus said to them.
ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, “Mobe nokwegena ase Nyasae.
swahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Mwaminini Mungu.

english: “Truly I tell you that if anyone says to this mountain, ‘Be lifted up and thrown into the sea,’ and has no doubt in his heart but believes that it will happen, it will be done for him.
ekegusii: Ekeene nabateebirie: Onde bwensi orateebie egetunwa eke: Tegoka, otugutwe enyancha ime; oyo atabeeti nogosiereria ase enkoro yaye, korende egene ng’a ayio ateeba nabe, ayio nakoreke.
swahili: Amin, nawaambia, mtu yeyote atakayeuambia mlima huu, ‘Ngʼoka ukatupwe baharini,’ wala asione shaka moyoni mwake, bali aamini kwamba hayo asemayo yametukia, atatimiziwa.

english: Therefore I tell you, whatever you ask for in prayer, believe that you have received it, and it will be yours.
ekegusii: Ase ayio nabateebirie, ebinto bionsi morasabe, egene ng’a mwabinyorire, nabirobio inabibe ebiaino.
swahili: Kwa sababu hiyo nawaambia, yoyote mtakayoyaomba mkisali, aminini ya kwamba mmeyapokea, nayo yatakuwa yenu.

english: And when you stand to pray, if you hold anything against another, forgive it, so that your Father in heaven will forgive your trespasses as well. ” Jesus’ Authority Challenged (Matthew 21:23–27; Luke 20:1–8)
ekegusii: Na inwe, ekero mogotenena na gosaba, onye more ne ring’ana ase omonto, mwabere, erinde na Iso oino ore igoro abaabere nainwe amamocho aino. [
swahili: Nanyi kila msimamapo kusali, sameheni mkiwa na neno na mtu, ili naye Baba yenu aliye mbinguni awasamehe ninyi makosa yenu. [

english: After their return to Jerusalem, Jesus was walking in the temple courts, and the chief priests, scribes, and elders came up to Him.
ekegusii: Bagaika Yerusalemu naende. Ekero Yeso are gotaara Hekalu ime, abakuani abanene, na aborokia b’amariiko, na abagaaka bakamochiera,
swahili: Wakafika tena Yerusalemu, na Yesu alipokuwa akitembea Hekaluni, viongozi wa makuhani, walimu wa sheria pamoja na wazee wa watu wakamjia.

english: “I will ask you one question,” Jesus replied, “and if you answer Me, I will tell you by what authority I am doing these things.
ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Nainche nimbaborie ring’ana erimo, nainwe mong’iranerie, erio nimbateebie ase okobua ki ngokorera aya.
swahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Nitawauliza swali moja. Nijibuni, nami nitawaambia ni kwa mamlaka gani ninafanya mambo haya.

english: If anyone asks, ‘Why are you doing this?’ tell him, ‘The Lord needs it and will return it shortly.’”
ekegusii: Na omonto karababorie: Inaki mogokora iga? Momoteebie: Omonene nayeganetie, na bwango nayeiranie naende aa.”
swahili: Kama mtu yeyote akiwauliza, ‘Mbona mnamfungua?’ Mwambieni, ‘Bwana anamhitaji, na atamrudisha hapa baada ya muda mfupi.’ ”

english: John’s baptism—was it from heaven or from men? Answer Me!”
ekegusii: Ebatiso ya Yohana, niigoro yarwete igoro, gose nase Mwanyabaanto? Ng’iranerie.”
swahili: Niambieni, je, ubatizo wa Yohana ulitoka mbinguni au kwa wanadamu?”

english: They deliberated among themselves what they should answer: “If we say, ‘From heaven,’ He will ask, ‘Why then did you not believe him?’
ekegusii: Bagateebania barabwo ase barabwo, bakaboora, “Toise goteeba: Niigoro yarwete, nigo aratoboorie: Inaki rende motamwegenete?
swahili: Wakahojiana wao kwa wao, wakisema, “Kama tukisema, ‘Ulitoka mbinguni,’ atatuuliza, ‘Mbona hamkumwamini?’

english: But if we say, ‘From men’...” they were afraid of the people, for they all held that John truly was a prophet.
ekegusii: Gose toise goteeba: Nase Mwanyabaanto yarwete?” — Bakairoka abanto, ekiagera abanto bonsi mbaroche ng’a Yohana nomobani bw’ekeene.
swahili: Lakini tukisema, ‘Ulitoka kwa wanadamu,’…” (Waliwaogopa watu, kwa sababu kila mtu aliamini kwamba Yohana alikuwa nabii wa kweli.)

english: So they answered, “We do not know.” And Jesus replied, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I am doing these things.”
ekegusii: Ase ayio bakairaneria Yeso, “Titomanyeti.” Na Yeso akabateebia “Nonya ninche tinkobateebia inwe nase okobua ki ngokorera aya.”
swahili: Kwa hiyo wakamjibu Yesu, “Hatujui.” Naye Yesu akawaambia, “Wala mimi sitawaambia ni kwa mamlaka gani ninatenda mambo haya.”

english: So they went and found the colt outside in the street, tied at a doorway. They untied it,
ekegusii: Bakagenda, bakarora emori y’etigere esibire geita isiko ase enchera enene; bakayesibora.
swahili: Wakaenda, wakamkuta mwana-punda amefungwa kando ya barabara, karibu na mlango wa nyumba.

english: and some who were standing there asked, “Why are you untying the colt?”
ekegusii: Abanto bande bateneine aroro, bakababoria, “Inki ekio mogokora, mogosibora emori y’etigere?”
swahili: Walipokuwa wanamfungua, watu waliokuwa wamesimama karibu wakawauliza, “Mna maana gani mnapomfungua huyo mwana-punda?”

english: The disciples answered as Jesus had instructed them, and the people gave them permission.
ekegusii: Bakabateebia buna Yeso abachiigete; na abwo bakabatiga bagende.
swahili: Wakawajibu kama vile Yesu alivyokuwa amewaagiza, nao wale watu wakawaruhusu.

english: Then they led the colt to Jesus and threw their cloaks over it, and He sat on it.
ekegusii: Bakarentera Yeso emori eria y’etigere, bakaara chianga igoro asero, na Yeso akayeriina.
swahili: Kisha wakamleta huyo mwana-punda kwa Yesu na kutandika mavazi yao juu yake, naye akampanda.

english: Many in the crowd spread their cloaks on the road, while others spread branches they had cut from the fields.
ekegusii: Abanto abange bakaara chianga chiabo inchera; abande bakanacha chinsagia chi’emete na gochiara inchera.
swahili: Watu wengi wakatandaza mavazi yao barabarani, na wengine wakatandaza matawi waliyokuwa wamekata mashambani.

english: The ones who went ahead and those who followed were shouting: “Hosanna!” “Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord!”
ekegusii: Abanto abatang’aine na baria baare komotunyana bagaaka eriogi, bakaboora, “Hosana! Nasesenirie oyogocha ase erieta ri’Omonene!
swahili: Kisha wale waliokuwa wametangulia mbele na wale waliokuwa wakifuata nyuma wakapaza sauti, wakisema, “Hosana!” “Amebarikiwa yeye ajaye kwa Jina la Bwana!”

english: Then Jesus began to speak to them in parables: “A man planted a vineyard. He put a wall around it, dug a wine vat, and built a watchtower. Then he rented it out to some tenants and went away on a journey.
ekegusii: Yeso agachaaka gokwana nabarabwo ase emebayeeno. “Omonto naremete omogondo, agasimeka emesabibu imeo, akayogitera orobago, agakunya egetera akomitera amasabibu, akaagacha orwaki, akaywatananera abaremi, akamanora akagenda orogendo.
swahili: Yesu akaanza kusema nao kwa mifano, akawaambia: “Mtu mmoja alipanda shamba la mizabibu. Akajenga ukuta kulizunguka, akachimba shimo ndani yake kwa ajili ya shinikizo la kusindika divai, na akajenga mnara wa ulinzi. Kisha akalikodisha shamba hilo la mizabibu kwa wakulima fulani, kisha akasafiri kwenda nchi nyingine.

english: Have you never read this Scripture: ‘The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone.
ekegusii: Nonya neririiko eri timorarisoma: “Rigena riria abaagachi bangete riabeire rigena rinene ri’ekoona.
swahili: Je, hamjasoma Andiko hili: “ ‘Jiwe walilolikataa waashi limekuwa jiwe kuu la pembeni;

english: This is from the Lord, and it is marvelous in our eyes’?”
ekegusii: Ring’ana eri nigo riarure ase Omonene, na rirorio nogokumia ase amaiso aito?”
swahili: Bwana ndiye alitenda jambo hili, nalo ni ajabu machoni petu’?”

english: At this, the leaders sought to arrest Jesus, for they knew that He had spoken this parable against them. But fearing the crowd, they left Him and went away. Paying Taxes to Caesar (Matthew 22:15–22; Luke 20:19–26)
ekegusii: Erio Abakuani abanene, aborokia b’amariiko n’abagaaka bakarigia kobwata Yeso ekiagera bamanyete ng’a omobayeeno oria nabwo ogoteeba; korende bakairoka omoganda, bakamotiga, bakagenda. Riborio igoro y’okorwa ebango (Mat 22:15-22; Luk 20:20-26)
swahili: Walipotambua kuwa amesema mfano huo kwa ajili yao, wakataka kumkamata, lakini wakaogopa ule umati wa watu. Wakamwacha, wakaondoka, wakaenda zao. Swali Kuhusu Kulipa Kodi (Mathayo 22:15-22; Luka 20:20-26)

english: Later, they sent some of the Pharisees and Herodians to catch Jesus in His words.
ekegusii: Bagatoma asare abande b’Abafarisai na Abaherodia, erinde bamotege ase amang’ana.
swahili: Baadaye wakawatuma baadhi ya Mafarisayo na Maherode ili kwenda kumtega Yesu katika yale anayosema.

english: “Teacher,” they said, “we know that You are honest and seek favor from no one. Indeed, You are impartial and teach the way of God in accordance with the truth. Is it lawful to pay taxes to Caesar or not? Should we pay them or not?”
ekegusii: Bagachia goika bakamoteebia, “Omworokia, twamanyire ng’a aye nigo ore omonto bw’ekeene, gose tori koyiera monto, naki torengerereti obonene bw’ abanto, korende ase ekeene nigo okworokereria enchera ya Nyasae. Inee! Mboronge koa Kaisari ebango, gose taibo?
swahili: Wakamjia, wakamwambia, “Mwalimu, tunajua kwamba wewe ni mtu mwadilifu. Wewe huyumbishwi na wanadamu, kwa kuwa huna upendeleo. Lakini wewe huifundisha njia ya Mungu katika kweli. Je, ni halali kulipa kodi kwa Kaisari, au la?

english: But Jesus saw through their hypocrisy and said, “Why are you testing Me? Bring Me a denarius to inspect.”
ekegusii: Tomoe, gose titomoa?” Korende Yeso ere konya omanyire obong’ainereria bwabo, akabateebia: Nase ki mogonteema? Yendetere ebesa inyerore!
swahili: Je, tulipe kodi au tusilipe?” Lakini Yesu alijua unafiki wao. Akawauliza “Mbona mnajaribu kunitega? Nileteeni hiyo dinari niione.”

english: So they brought it, and He asked them, “Whose image is this? And whose inscription?” “Caesar’s,” they answered.
ekegusii: Bakayerenta. Ere akababoria, “Ekieni eke na amariiko aya nebiang’o?” Bakamoiraneria, “Nebia Kaisari.”
swahili: Wakamletea hiyo sarafu. Naye akawauliza, “Sura hii ni ya nani? Na maandishi haya ni ya nani?” Wakamjibu, “Ni vya Kaisari.”

english: Then Jesus told them, “Give to Caesar what is Caesar’s, and to God what is God’s.” And they marveled at Him. The Sadducees and the Resurrection (Matthew 22:23–33; Luke 20:27–40)
ekegusii: Erio Yeso akabateebia, “Ebire bia Kaisari, moe Kaisari, na ebia Nyasae, moe Nyasae.” Bakamokumia mono. Riborio igoro y’okobokigwa (Mat 22:23-33; Luk 20:27-40)
swahili: Ndipo Yesu akawaambia, “Mpeni Kaisari kilicho cha Kaisari, naye Mungu mpeni kilicho cha Mungu.” Nao wakamstaajabia sana. Ndoa Wakati Wa Ufufuo (Mathayo 22:23-33; Luka 20:27-40)

english: Then the Sadducees, who say there is no resurrection, came to Jesus and questioned Him:
ekegusii: Na Abasadukai bagachiera Yeso, baria bakoboora ng’a okobokigwa tikori, bakamobooria,
swahili: Kisha Masadukayo, wale wasemao kuwa hakuna ufufuo wa wafu, wakamjia Yesu,

english: “Teacher, Moses wrote for us that if a man’s brother dies and leaves a wife but no children, the man is to marry his brother’s widow and raise up offspring for him.
ekegusii: “Omworokia, Musa natoriikerete ng’a momura omwabo omonto karakwe atige omokungu oye; onye tari n’omwana, momura omwabo atware omokungu oria, atenenerie momura omwabo egesaku.
swahili: wakasema, “Mwalimu, Mose alituandikia kuwa kama ndugu wa mtu akifa na kumwacha mkewe bila mtoto, basi huyo mtu inampasa amwoe huyo mjane ili amzalie ndugu yake watoto.

english: At harvest time, he sent a servant to the tenants to collect his share of the fruit of the vineyard.
ekegusii: Ekero kie rigesa agatoma omosomba ase abaremi baria, erinde anyore korwa ase abaremi ensemo y’amatunda y’emesabibu.
swahili: Wakati wa mavuno ulipofika, mwenye shamba akamtuma mtumishi wake kwa hao wapangaji ili kuchukua sehemu yake ya mavuno ya shamba la mizabibu kutoka kwa hao wapangaji.

english: Now there were seven brothers. The first one married and died, leaving no children.
ekegusii: Bono mbarenge abamura ba ise omo batano na babere. Oyo bw’eritang’ani akanyuoma omokungu, agakwa, tatiga abana.
swahili: Basi palikuwepo ndugu saba. Yule wa kwanza akaoa mke, naye akafa pasipo kuwa na mtoto yeyote.

english: Then the second one married the widow, but he also died and left no children. And the third did likewise.
ekegusii: Na oyo o kabere akamotwara, agakwa; nonya nere tatiga abana; nonya noyo o gatato boigo.
swahili: Wa pili akamwoa yule mjane, lakini naye akafa bila kuacha mtoto yeyote. Ikawa vivyo hivyo kwa yule wa tatu.

english: In this way, none of the seven left any children. And last of all, the woman died.
ekegusii: Bonsi batano na babere bakamotwara, tibatiga abana. Omoerio o bonsi omokungu oria nere agakwa.
swahili: Hakuna hata mmojawapo wa hao ndugu wote saba aliyeacha mtoto. Hatimaye yule mwanamke naye akafa.

english: In the resurrection, then, whose wife will she be? For all seven were married to her.”
ekegusii: Inee! Ase okobokigwa ’mokang’o arabe ase aba? Ekiagera bonsi batano na babere mbamotwarete.”
swahili: Kwa hiyo wakati wa ufufuo, yeye atakuwa mke wa nani, maana aliolewa na ndugu wote saba?”

english: Jesus said to them, “Aren’t you mistaken, because you do not know the Scriptures or the power of God?
ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Inee! Timori gosira ase aya, ekiagera timomanyeti amariiko, nonya nokobua kwa Nyasae?
swahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Je, hampotoki kwa sababu hamfahamu Maandiko wala uweza wa Mungu?

english: When the dead rise, they will neither marry nor be given in marriage. Instead, they will be like the angels in heaven.
ekegusii: Inaki kobaraboke korwa ase abakuure, tibakonyuoma, korende nigo barabe buna abamalaika bare igoro.
swahili: Wafu watakapofufuka, hawataoa wala kuolewa, bali watakuwa kama malaika wa mbinguni.

english: But concerning the dead rising, have you not read about the burning bush in the Book of Moses, how God told him, ‘I am the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob’?
ekegusii: Nase amang’ana y’abakuure, buna bakobokigwa, timwana gosoma ase egetabu ya Musa, ase ring’ana ri’egetutu, buna Nyasae amotebetie, akabora: Inche ninche Nyasae bw’Aburaamu, na Nyasae o Isaka, na Nyasae o Yakobo?
swahili: Basi kuhusu wafu kufufuliwa, je hamjasoma katika Kitabu cha Mose jinsi Mungu alivyosema na Mose kutoka kile kichaka akisema, ‘Mimi ni Mungu wa Abrahamu, na Mungu wa Isaki, na Mungu wa Yakobo?’

english: He is not the God of the dead, but of the living. You are badly mistaken!” The Greatest Commandment (Deuteronomy 6:1–19; Matthew 22:34–40)
ekegusii: Ere tari Nyasae bw’abakuure, korende bw’abare moyo; ase ayio nigo mogosira mono.” Ogochika okonene (Mat 22:34-40)
swahili: Yeye si Mungu wa wafu, bali ni Mungu wa walio hai. Kwa hiyo mmekosea kabisa.” Amri Iliyo Kuu (Mathayo 22:34-40; Luka 10:25-28)

english: Now one of the scribes had come up and heard their debate. Noticing how well Jesus had answered them, he asked Him, “Which commandment is the most important of all?”
ekegusii: Oyomo ase aborokia b’amariiko agacha akabaigwa bakoamererania nere, akamanya ng’a obairaneirie buya, akamobooria, “Ase amachiiko onsi ndiriri rire rie ritang’ani?”
swahili: Mwalimu mmoja wa sheria akaja, akawasikia wakijadiliana. Akiona kwamba Yesu amewajibu vyema, naye akamuuliza, “Katika amri zote, ni ipi iliyo kuu?”

english: Jesus replied, “This is the most important: ‘Hear O Israel, the Lord our God, the Lord is One.
ekegusii: Yeso akamoiraneria, “Erie ritang’ani nario eri: Igwa, Abaisraeli, Omonene oito, Nyasae, Nere Omonene oyomo;
swahili: Yesu akajibu, “Amri iliyo kuu ndiyo hii: ‘Sikia ee Israeli. Bwana Mungu wetu, Bwana ndiye mmoja.

english: But they seized the servant, beat him, and sent him away empty-handed.
ekegusii: Abaremi baria bakabwata omosomba oria, bakamoaka, bakamoseria atari na gento.
swahili: Lakini wale wakulima walimkamata yule mtumishi, wakampiga, wakamfukuza mikono mitupu.

english: Love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your mind and with all your strength.’
ekegusii: naye mwanche Omonene oo nenkoro yao yonsi, na omoyo oo bwonsi, na obong’aini bwao bwonsi, ne chinguru chiao chionsi.
swahili: Mpende Bwana Mungu wako kwa moyo wako wote, kwa roho yako yote, kwa akili zako zote, na kwa nguvu zako zote.’

english: The second is this: ‘Love your neighbor as yourself.’ No other commandment is greater than these.”
ekegusii: Na ogwa kabere nakwo oko: Mwanche omogisangio oo buna bweanchete. Amachiiko ande tari amanene kobua aya.”
swahili: Ya pili ndiyo hii: ‘Mpende jirani yako kama nafsi yako.’ Hakuna amri nyingine iliyo kuu kuliko hizi.”

english: “Right, Teacher,” the scribe replied. “You have stated correctly that God is One and there is no other but Him,
ekegusii: Omworokia oria bw’amariiko agateebia Yeso, “Ekeene, Omworokia, gwateebire buya ng’a Nyasae noyomo, na onde tari otatiga ere;
swahili: Yule mwalimu wa sheria akamwambia Yesu, “Mwalimu, umejibu vyema kwamba Mungu ni mmoja, wala hakuna mwingine ila yeye.

english: and to love Him with all your heart and with all your understanding and with all your strength, and to love your neighbor as yourself, which is more important than all burnt offerings and sacrifices.”
ekegusii: na komwancha nenkoro yonsi, na okomanya gwonsi, ne chinguru chionsi, na gwancha omogisangio oo buna bweanchete, nkogwenerete kobua omosango bw’ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa na ebing’wanso binde.”
swahili: Kumpenda Mungu kwa moyo wote na kwa akili zote na kwa nguvu zote, na kumpenda jirani kama mtu anavyojipenda mwenyewe ni bora zaidi kuliko kutoa sadaka za kuteketezwa na dhabihu zote.”

english: When Jesus saw that the man had answered wisely, He said, “You are not far from the kingdom of God.” And no one dared to question Him any further. Whose Son Is the Christ? (Matthew 22:41–46; Luke 20:41–44)
ekegusii: Yeso agachia korora ng’a nigo airaneria ase obong’aini, akamoteebia, “Aye tori are korwa ase oborwoti bwa Nyasae.” Korwa erio monto onde tanyara komoboria ring’ana naende. Riborio igoro ya Kristo (Mat 22:41-46; Luk 20:41-44)
swahili: Yesu alipoona kwamba amejibu kwa busara, akamwambia, “Wewe hauko mbali na Ufalme wa Mungu.” Tangu wakati huo, hakuna mtu yeyote aliyethubutu kumuuliza maswali tena. Kristo Ni Mwana Wa Nani? (Mathayo 22:41-46; Luka 20:41-44)

english: While Jesus was teaching in the temple courts, He asked, “How can the scribes say that the Christ is the Son of David?
ekegusii: Yeso akabora gakworokereria ime ase Hekalu, “Inaki aborokia b’amariiko bakobora ng’a Kristo nomwana o Daudi?
swahili: Yesu alipokuwa akifundisha Hekaluni, akauliza, “Imekuwaje walimu wa sheria wanasema kwamba Kristo ni Mwana wa Daudi?

english: Speaking by the Holy Spirit, David himself declared: ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at My right hand until I put Your enemies under Your feet.”’
ekegusii: Daudi omonyene nigo ateebete, buna arenge koraagwa n’Omoika Omochenu: “Agateeba Omonene agakwana n’Omonene one Ikaransa ensemo y’okoboko kwane gw’okorio, goika mbeke ababisa bao babe inse y’amagoro ao”.
swahili: Kwa maana Daudi mwenyewe, akinena kwa kuongozwa na Roho Mtakatifu, alisema: “ ‘ Bwana alimwambia Bwana wangu: “Keti mkono wangu wa kuume, hadi nitakapowaweka adui zako chini ya miguu yako.” ’

english: David himself calls Him ‘Lord.’ So how can He be David’s son?” And the large crowd listened to Him with delight. Beware of the Scribes (Luke 20:45–47)
ekegusii: Daudi omonyene nigo akomoroka Omonene; inaki rende Masihi aba omwana oye? Na omoganda oria omonene nigo orenge komoigwa ase omogooko. Yeso ogokuurera igoro yaborokia b’amariiko (Mat 23:1-36; Luk 11:37-54; 20:45-47)
swahili: Kwa hiyo Daudi mwenyewe anamwita ‘Bwana.’ Awezaje basi yeye kuwa mwanawe?” Ule umati wote wa watu wakamsikiliza kwa furaha. Yesu Awatahadharisha Watu Kuhusu Walimu Wa Sheria (Mathayo 23:1-36; Luka 20:45-47)

english: In His teaching Jesus also said, “Watch out for the scribes. They like to walk around in long robes, to receive greetings in the marketplaces,
ekegusii: Akabateebia ase okworokereria kwaye, “Mwerende korwa ase aborokia b’amariiko, abwo banchete gotaara beboyetie chianga chintambe, na gokwanigwa ase chichiiro,
swahili: Alipokuwa akifundisha, Yesu alisema, “Jihadharini na walimu wa sheria. Wao hupenda kutembea wakiwa wamevaa mavazi marefu, na kusalimiwa kwa heshima masokoni.

english: and to have the chief seats in the synagogues and the places of honor at banquets.
ekegusii: na goikaransa aase e ritang’ani ase chisinagogi, na aase e ritang’ani ase emeyega.
swahili: Pia wao hupenda kukaa kwenye viti vya mbele katika masinagogi, na kupewa nafasi za heshima katika karamu.

english: Then he sent them another servant, and they struck him over the head and treated him shamefully.
ekegusii: Erio omonto oria agatoma naende ase bare omosomba onde, na oyio bakamoaka chingoma ase omotwe, bakamosokia bakamokora bobe.
swahili: Kisha yule mwenye shamba akamtuma mtumishi mwingine kwao; nao wale wakulima wakampiga kichwani na kumfanyia mambo ya aibu.

english: They defraud widows of their houses, and for a show make lengthy prayers. These men will receive greater condemnation.” The Widow’s Offering (Luke 21:1–4)
ekegusii: Abwo bakounereria chinyomba ch’ababoraka, na ase obong’ainereria basaba ogosaba ogotambe; aba nabanyore ekiina ekere ekenene kobua.” Esadaka y’omoboraka (Luk 21:1-4)
swahili: Wao hula nyumba za wajane, na ili waonekane kuwa wema wanasali sala ndefu. Watu kama hawa watapata hukumu iliyo kuu sana.” Sadaka Ya Mjane (Luka 21:1-4)

english: As Jesus was sitting opposite the treasury, He watched the crowd putting money into it. And many rich people put in large amounts.
ekegusii: Yeso agaikaransa korigereria ekebekerero gi’esadaka, akarigereria buna omoganda okobeeka chitaabu ase ekebekerero. Abande abarenge abanda bakabeeka chinyinge.
swahili: Kisha Yesu akaketi mkabala na sehemu ambapo sadaka zilikuwa zinawekwa na kuangalia umati wa watu wakiweka fedha zao kwenye sanduku la hazina ya Hekalu. Matajiri wengi wakaweka kiasi kikubwa cha fedha.

english: Then one poor widow came and put in two small copper coins, which amounted to a small fraction of a denarius.
ekegusii: Omokungu oyomo agacha, oyorenge omoboraka na omotaka, akabeeka ebisabwa bibere bie chitaai, rigori ri’ekeng’ese ki’ebesa eyemo.
swahili: Lakini mjane mmoja maskini akaja na kuweka sarafu mbili ndogo za shaba zenye thamani ya senti mbili.

english: Jesus called His disciples to Him and said, “Truly I tell you, this poor widow has put more than all the others into the treasury.
ekegusii: Akarangeria aborokigwa baye, akabateebia, “Ekeene nabateebirie: Oyo omoboraka omotaka obekire chinyinge kobua bonsi ababeeka ase ekebeekerero gi’esadaka,
swahili: Yesu akawaita wanafunzi wake, akawaambia, “Amin, nawaambia, huyu mjane maskini ameweka katika sanduku la hazina zaidi ya watu wengine wote.

english: For they all contributed out of their surplus, but she out of her poverty has put in all she had to live on.”
ekegusii: ekiagera aba bonsi nigo babeeka korwa ase ogoiteka kw’obonda bwabo; korende oyo ase obotaka bwaye obekire bionsi ebiarenge nabio, nonya n’enibo y’obogima bwaye bwonsi.”
swahili: Wengine wote wametoa kutokana na ziada ya mali zao. Lakini huyu mjane ametoa kutokana na umaskini wake, akaweka kila kitu alichokuwa nacho, hata kile alichohitaji ili kuishi.”

english: He sent still another, and this one they killed. He sent many others; some they beat and others they killed.
ekegusii: Omonto oria naende agatoma omosomba onde naende, na oyio bakamoita agakwa. Naboigo babakorerete abande abange; bagaaka abande, na abande bakabaita bagakwa.
swahili: Kisha akamtuma mtumishi mwingine, naye huyo wakamuua. Akawatuma wengine wengi; baadhi yao wakawapiga, na wengine wakawaua.

english: Finally, having one beloved son, he sent him to them. ‘They will respect my son,’ he said.
ekegusii: Narenge nomwana oyomo konya ataratoma, omwanchwa oye; oyo nere akamotoma ase bare magega, okobora: Inabasike omwana one.
swahili: “Mwenye shamba alikuwa bado na mmoja wa kumtuma, mwanawe aliyempenda. Hatimaye akamtuma akisema, ‘Watamheshimu mwanangu.’

english: But the tenants said to one another, ‘This is the heir. Come, let us kill him, and the inheritance will be ours.’
ekegusii: Abaremi baria bagateebania: Oyo nomonyamwando; inchwo tomoite, omwando oye obe oyoito.
swahili: “Lakini wale wapangaji wakasemezana pamoja, ‘Huyu ndiye mrithi. Njooni tumuue, nao urithi utakuwa wetu.’

english: So they seized the son, killed him, and threw him out of the vineyard.
ekegusii: Bakamobwata, bakamoita agakwa, bakaimokia omobere oye bakayotuguta isiko korwa ase omogondo bw’emesabibu.
swahili: Hivyo wakamchukua na kumuua, wakamtupa nje ya lile shamba la mizabibu.

english: What then will the owner of the vineyard do? He will come and kill those tenants, and will give the vineyard to others.
ekegusii: Bono inki rende omonene oria bw’omogondo bw’emesabibu arakore? Nachiche asirie abaremi baria, na omogondo oria bw’emesabibu nayoe abande.
swahili: “Sasa basi yule mwenye shamba atafanya nini? Atakuja na kuwaua hao wapangaji, kisha atawapa wapangaji wengine hilo shamba la mizabibu.

english: As Jesus was leaving the temple, one of His disciples said to Him, “Teacher, look at the magnificent stones and buildings!”
ekegusii: Ekero Yeso are gosoka korwa Hekalu, oyomo bw’aborokigwa baye akamoteebia, “Omworokia, rora buna amagena na amaagacho aya are amaya!”
swahili: Yesu alipokuwa akitoka Hekaluni, mmojawapo wa wanafunzi wake akamwambia, “Mwalimu! Tazama jinsi mawe haya yalivyo makubwa, na majengo haya yalivyo mazuri!”

english: And the gospel must first be proclaimed to all the nations.
ekegusii: Naende negwenerete enchiri erandigwe ritang’ani ase ebisaku bionsi.
swahili: Nayo habari njema lazima ihubiriwe kwanza kwa mataifa yote kabla ule mwisho haujawadia.

english: But when they arrest you and hand you over, do not worry beforehand what to say. Instead, speak whatever you are given at that time, for it will not be you speaking, but the Holy Spirit.
ekegusii: Ekero bakobaira ase ekiina, na kobabeeka ase amaboko y’ abanto, timochaaka gwechanda korengereria ayamorigetie gokwana; korende rinde rionsi moraegwe ase ensa eria, morikwane, ekiagera tari inwe morakwane, korende n’Omoika Omochenu.
swahili: Mtakapokamatwa na kushtakiwa, msisumbuke awali kuhusu mtakalosema. Semeni tu lolote mtakalopewa wakati huo, kwa kuwa si ninyi mtakaokuwa mkinena, bali ni Roho Mtakatifu.

english: Brother will betray brother to death, and a father his child. Children will rise against their parents and have them put to death.
ekegusii: Na momura omwabo omonto narue oyomwabo, erinde aitwe, na ise narue omwana oye; na abana nabaimokere abaibori babo kobaita.
swahili: “Ndugu atamsaliti ndugu yake ili auawe, naye baba atamsaliti mtoto wake. Watoto nao wataasi dhidi ya wazazi wao na kusababisha wauawe.

english: You will be hated by everyone because of My name, but the one who perseveres to the end will be saved. The Abomination of Desolation (Matthew 24:15–25; Luke 21:20–24)
ekegusii: Nainwe namogechwe n’abanto bonsi ase engencho y’erieta riane, korende oyoraremererie goika omoerio, oyio natooreke. Emechando emenene
swahili: Watu wote watawachukia kwa ajili ya Jina langu. Lakini yule atakayevumilia hadi mwisho ataokolewa. Chukizo La Uharibifu (Mathayo 24:15-28; Luka 21:20-24)

english: So when you see the abomination of desolation standing where it should not be (let the reader understand), then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains.
ekegusii: “Korende komorakorore okogechia kw’ogosaria kogotenena aase atagwenereti, (oyogosoma amanye), erio abare Boyahudi batame gochia ase ebitunwa;
swahili: “Mtakapoona ‘chukizo la uharibifu’ limesimama mahali pasipolipasa (asomaye na afahamu), basi wale walioko Uyahudi wakimbilie milimani.

english: Let no one on the housetop go back inside to retrieve anything from his house.
ekegusii: na ere oyore kerama igoro taika gosoa nyomba ime, gose tasoa kobogoria egento korwa mwaye;
swahili: Yeyote aliye juu ya dari ya nyumba asishuke au kuingia ndani ili kuchukua chochote.

english: And let no one in the field return for his cloak.
ekegusii: na ere oyore mogondo tairana nyomba kobogoria eanga yaye.
swahili: Aliye shambani asirudi nyumbani kuchukua vazi lake.

english: How miserable those days will be for pregnant and nursing mothers!
ekegusii: N’abe aakong’u ase abare morito na barabwo abakogonkia ase amatuko aria.
swahili: Ole wao wenye mimba na wale wanaonyonyesha watoto siku hizo!

english: Pray that this will not occur in the winter.
ekegusii: Saba ng’a ogotama kwaino tikoba ekero gi’etoigo,
swahili: Ombeni mambo haya yasitokee wakati wa baridi.

english: For those will be days of tribulation unmatched from the beginning of God’s creation until now, and never to be seen again.
ekegusii: ekiagera amatuko aria n’ebe emechando, buna etana koba korwa omochakano bw’ogotonga oko Nyasae atongete, goika bono, gose tekoba bo naende nonya ng’ake.
swahili: Kwa maana siku hizo zitakuwa za dhiki kuu ambayo haijapata kuwako tangu mwanzo, hapo Mungu alipoumba ulimwengu, mpaka leo, na wala haitakuwako tena kamwe.

english: “Do you see all these great buildings?” Jesus replied. “Not one stone here will be left on another; every one will be thrown down.”
ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Norooche amaagacho aya amanene? Aiga tirigotigara rigena erimo igoro ase erinde, eritanyaare gotaagorwa.” Amabe n’ogochandwa (Mat 24:3-25; Luk 21:7-24)
swahili: Ndipo Yesu akajibu akasema, “Je, unayaona majengo haya yalivyo makubwa? Hakuna hata jiwe moja litakalobaki juu ya jingine, bali yote yatabomolewa.” Mateso Yatabiriwa (Mathayo 24:3-14; Luka 21:7-19)

english: If the Lord had not cut short those days, nobody would be saved. But for the sake of the elect, whom He has chosen, He has cut them short.
ekegusii: Naende onye Omonene atanachete amatuko aria, anga monto onde bwensi tatooregete, korende ase engencho y’abachore, abachorete, onachire amatuko aria.
swahili: Kama Bwana asingelifupisha siku hizo, kamwe asingeliokoka mtu yeyote. Lakini kwa ajili ya wateule, wale aliowachagua, amezifupisha siku hizo.

english: At that time if anyone says to you, ‘Look, here is the Christ!’ or ‘There He is!’ do not believe it.
ekegusii: Ekero ekio omonto karabatebie: Rora, oyo nere Kristo, gose: Oria aaria, timwegena,
swahili: Wakati huo mtu yeyote akiwaambia, ‘Tazama, Kristo huyu hapa!’ au, ‘Tazama, yuko kule,’ msisadiki.

english: For false Christs and false prophets will appear and perform signs and wonders that would deceive even the elect, if that were possible.
ekegusii: ekiagera abakristo b’oborimo, na ababani b’oborimo nabaorokie ebikone na amakumia, banyare gosiria nonya nabachore ko eranyarekane.
swahili: Kwa maana watatokea makristo wa uongo na manabii wa uongo, nao watafanya ishara na maajabu ili kuwapotosha, ikiwezekana, hata wale wateule.

english: So be on your guard; I have told you everything in advance. The Return of the Son of Man (Matthew 24:26–31; Luke 21:25–28)
ekegusii: Korende inwe mwerende! Rora, nakoorire koborokia onsi ritang’ani. Ogocha kw’Omwana Omwanyabaanto (Mat 24:29-31; Luk 21:25-28)
swahili: Hivyo jihadharini. Nimekwisha kuwaambia mambo haya yote mapema kabla hayajatukia. Kuja Kwa Mwana Wa Adamu (Mathayo 24:29-31; Luka 21:25-28)

english: But in those days, after that tribulation: ‘The sun will be darkened, and the moon will not give its light;
ekegusii: “Korende amatuko aria, magega y’emechando eria, erioba naribekwe omosunte, na omotienyi tokobara,
swahili: “Lakini katika siku hizo, baada ya hiyo dhiki, “ ‘jua litatiwa giza nao mwezi hautatoa nuru yake;

english: the stars will fall from the sky, and the powers of the heavens will be shaken.’
ekegusii: ne ching’enang’eni nachigwe korwa igoro, ne chinguru chire igoro nachitengechigwe.
swahili: nazo nyota zitaanguka kutoka angani, na nguvu za anga zitatikisika.’

english: At that time they will see the Son of Man coming in the clouds with great power and glory.
ekegusii: Erio nario bararore Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto ogocha ase amare ime amo ne chinguru chinyinge na obonene.
swahili: “Ndipo watu wote watakapomwona Mwana wa Adamu akija mawinguni kwa nguvu nyingi na utukufu.

english: And He will send out the angels to gather His elect from the four winds, from the ends of the earth to the ends of heaven. The Lesson of the Fig Tree (Matthew 24:32–35; Luke 21:29–33)
ekegusii: Erio natome abamalaika baye basangererie abachore baye korwa chinsemo chie chinsinyo inye, na korwa chinsinyo chi’ense goika chinsinyo chia igoro. Amorokererio korwa ase omoko (Mat 24:32-36,42; Luk 21:29-33)
swahili: Naye atawatuma malaika wake wawakusanye wateule wake kutoka pande zote nne za dunia, kutoka miisho ya dunia hadi miisho ya mbingu. Somo Kuhusu Mtini (Mathayo 24:32-35; Luka 21:29-33)

english: Now learn this lesson from the fig tree: As soon as its branches become tender and sprout leaves, you know that summer is near.
ekegusii: “Korwa ase omoko eorokererie omobayeeno oyo. Orosagia rwaye korwachaakire koorokia amato aye, mwamanyire ng’a nekero ki’ogoseboka, egura gura ng’ang’e ere.
swahili: “Basi jifunzeni somo hili kutokana na mtini: Matawi yake yanapoanza kuchipua na kutoa majani, mnatambua kwamba wakati wa kiangazi umekaribia.

english: So also, when you see these things happening, know that He is near, right at the door.
ekegusii: Naboigo nainwe, komorarore aya aorokire, momanye ng’a obeire ang’e na gesieri.
swahili: Vivyo hivyo, myaonapo mambo haya yakitukia, mnatambua kwamba wakati u karibu, hata malangoni.

english: While Jesus was sitting on the Mount of Olives opposite the temple, Peter, James, John, and Andrew asked Him privately,
ekegusii: Ekero Yeso aikaransire ase egetunwa ki’Emezeituni korigereria Hekalu, Petero, na Yakobo, na Yohana, na Anderea, bakamobooria bobisi,
swahili: Yesu alipokuwa ameketi kwenye Mlima wa Mizeituni mkabala na Hekalu, Petro, Yakobo, Yohana na Andrea wakamuuliza faraghani,

english: Heaven and earth will pass away, but My words will never pass away. Readiness at Any Hour (Matthew 24:36–51; Luke 12:35–48)
ekegusii: Igoro na ense nabiete, korende amang’ana aane takonyara goeta nonya ng’ake. Onde taiyo omanyete rituko nonya n’ensa
swahili: Mbingu na nchi zitapita, lakini maneno yangu hayatapita kamwe. Hakuna Ajuaye Siku Wala Saa (Mathayo 24:36-44)

english: No one knows about that day or hour, not even the angels in heaven, nor the Son, but only the Father.
ekegusii: “Korende amang’ana ye rituko riria na ensa eria onde tari omanyete, nonya nabamalaika bare igoro, nonya n’Omwana, otatiga Tata.
swahili: “Kwa habari ya siku ile na saa hakuna yeyote ajuaye, hata malaika walio mbinguni wala Mwana, ila Baba peke yake.

english: Be on your guard and stay alert! For you do not know when the appointed time will come.
ekegusii: Rigereria, renda, saba, ekiagera timomanyeti engaki eria indi eranyare koba.
swahili: Jihadharini! Kesheni! Kwa maana hamjui wakati ule utakapowadia.

english: It is like a man going on a journey who left his house, put each servant in charge of his own task, and instructed the doorkeeper to keep watch.
ekegusii: Igo enga buna omonto ore kogenda ense eng’ao konya otigire enyomba yaye, oeire abasomba baye okobua, na kera omonto emeremo yaye; agachiika omorendi bw’egesieri arende.
swahili: Ni kama mtu anayesafiri. Anaiacha nyumba yake na kuwaachia watumishi wake kuiangalia, kila mtu na kazi yake, kisha akamwamuru yule bawabu aliye mlangoni akeshe.

english: Therefore keep watch, because you do not know when the master of the house will return—whether in the evening, at midnight, when the rooster crows, or in the morning.
ekegusii: Renda boigo, ekiagera timomanyeti ekero omonene bw’enyomba agochi‐gocha, gose mogoroba, gose mbotuko gati, gose etuoni gekobuga, gose mambia,
swahili: “Basi kesheni kwa sababu hamjui ni lini mwenye nyumba atakaporudi: iwapo ni jioni, au ni usiku wa manane, au alfajiri awikapo jogoo, au mapambazuko.

english: Otherwise, he may arrive without notice and find you sleeping.
ekegusii: tacha ababasokanie, abanyore mwararire.
swahili: Kama akija ghafula, asije akawakuta mmelala.

english: And what I say to you, I say to everyone: Keep watch!”
ekegusii: Na erio nabateebirie inwe, nabateebirie bonsi: Renda!”
swahili: Lile ninalowaambia ninyi, nawaambia watu wote: ‘Kesheni!’ ”

english: “Tell us, when will these things happen? And what will be the sign that they are about to be fulfilled?”
ekegusii: “Toteebie, aya indiriri arabe? Ninki ekemanyererio kiaye ekero aya onsi arabe ang’e goikerana?”
swahili: “Tafadhali tuambie, mambo haya yatatukia lini? Nayo dalili ya kuwa hayo yote yanakaribia kutimia itakuwa gani?”

english: Jesus began by telling them, “See to it that no one deceives you.
ekegusii: Yeso agachaaka kobateebia, “Mwerende, monto onde tabang’aina,
swahili: Yesu akawaambia: “Jihadharini mtu yeyote asiwadanganye.

english: Many will come in My name, claiming, ‘I am He,’ and will deceive many.
ekegusii: ekiagera abange inabache ase erieta riane, babore: Inche ninche ere; inabasirie abange.
swahili: Wengi watakuja kwa Jina langu wakidai, ‘Mimi ndiye,’ nao watawadanganya wengi.

english: When you hear of wars and rumors of wars, do not be alarmed. These things must happen, but the end is still to come.
ekegusii: Naende komoraigwe esegi, na ebirage bi’esegi, timoichanigwa, ekiagera bori, aya onsi nabe, ko moerio toracha.
swahili: Msikiapo habari za vita na uvumi wa vita, msiwe na hofu. Mambo haya hayana budi kutukia, lakini ule mwisho bado.

english: Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom. There will be earthquakes in various places, as well as famines. These are the beginning of birth pains. Witnessing to All Nations (Matthew 24:9–14; Luke 21:10–19)
ekegusii: Inaki egesaku nkeimoke korwana negesaku kende, na oborwoti mborwane noborwoti bonde. Emetengecho y’ense n’ebe chinsemo ne chinsemo, na enchara. Amang’ana ayio nigo arabe buna obororo bw’eritang’ani bw’okoibora.
swahili: Taifa litainuka dhidi ya taifa na ufalme dhidi ya ufalme. Kutakuwa na mitetemeko sehemu mbalimbali na njaa. Haya yatakuwa ndio mwanzo wa utungu.

english: So be on your guard. You will be delivered over to the councils and beaten in the synagogues. On My account you will stand before governors and kings as witnesses to them.
ekegusii: “Mwerende inwe abanyene, ekiagera nababaire ase ebigambero, na ase chisinagogi, moakwe. Naende inamoirwe gotenena ase amasio y’abagabana na ase abarwoti ase engencho y’ane, koba kirori ase bare.
swahili: “Lakini ninyi jihadharini. Kwa maana watawapeleka katika mabaraza yao na kupigwa mijeledi katika masinagogi. Mtashtakiwa mbele ya watawala na wafalme kwa ajili yangu, ili kuwa ushuhuda kwao.

english: Now the Passover and the Feast of Unleavened Bread were two days away, and the chief priests and scribes were looking for a covert way to arrest Jesus and kill Him.
ekegusii: Konya atigaire amatuko abere ne rituko rinene ri’Epasaka ribe, na eri ’Emegati etabekiri memera. Abakuani abanene na aborokia b’amariiko bakarigia enchera bakobwatera Yeso nobong’ainereria, banyare komoita,
swahili: Zilikuwa zimebaki siku mbili tu kabla ya Sikukuu ya Pasaka, na Sikukuu ya Mikate Isiyotiwa Chachu. Viongozi wa makuhani na walimu wa sheria walikuwa wakitafuta njia ya kumkamata Yesu kwa hila na kumuua.

english: Then Judas Iscariot, one of the Twelve, went to the chief priests to betray Jesus to them.
ekegusii: Yudasi Iskariota, ere noyomo bwa baria ikomi na babere, akagenda ase abakuani abanene, anyare komorua ase bare.
swahili: Kisha Yuda Iskariote, mmoja wa wale wanafunzi kumi na wawili, akaenda kwa viongozi wa makuhani ili kumsaliti Yesu kwao.

english: They were delighted to hear this, and they promised to give him money. So Judas began to look for an opportunity to betray Jesus. Preparing the Passover (Matthew 26:17–19; Luke 22:7–13)
ekegusii: Na barabwo bagachia koyaigwa bakagoka, bakamoriera eira komoa chitaabu. Akarigia enchera akomoruera ekero aranyore ribaga rigiya. Yeso okoria Epasaka y’omoerio n’aborokigwa baye (Mat 26:17-30; Luk 22:7-23; Yoh 13:21-30; 1 Abakr 11:23-25)
swahili: Walifurahi sana kusikia jambo hili na wakaahidi kumpa fedha. Hivyo yeye akawa anatafuta wakati uliofaa wa kumsaliti. Yesu Ala Pasaka Na Wanafunzi Wake (Mathayo 26:17-25; Luka 22:7-14, 21-23; Yohana 13:21-30)

english: On the first day of the Feast of Unleavened Bread, when the Passover lamb was to be sacrificed, Jesus’ disciples asked Him, “Where do You want us to prepare for You to eat the Passover?”
ekegusii: Goika rituko rie ritang’ani ri’Emegati etabekiri memera, ekero gi’okonyenya emanwa y’eng’ondi y’Epasaka, aborokigwa baye bakamobooria, “Ng’ai origetie togende tokoroiserie oriere Epasaka?”
swahili: Siku ya kwanza ya Sikukuu ya Mikate Isiyotiwa Chachu, siku ambayo kwa desturi mwana-kondoo wa Pasaka huchinjwa, wanafunzi wa Yesu wakamuuliza, “Unataka twende wapi ili tukuandalie mahali pa kula Pasaka?”

english: So He sent two of His disciples and told them, “Go into the city, and a man carrying a jug of water will meet you. Follow him,
ekegusii: Erio Yeso agatoma babere baborokigwa baye akabateebia, “Genda ase omochie na moumerane nomosaacha obogoretie enyongo ere namaache; momotuny’ane,
swahili: Basi akawatuma wawili miongoni mwa wanafunzi wake, akawaambia, “Nendeni mjini. Huko mtakutana na mwanaume amebeba mtungi wa maji. Mfuateni.

english: and whichever house he enters, say to the owner, ‘The Teacher asks: Where is My guest room, where I may eat the Passover with My disciples?’
ekegusii: na aande onsi arasoe moteebie omonyene enyomba: Omworokia oteebire: Ng’ai ere enyomba y’abageni ndiere Epasaka amo naborokigwa baane?
swahili: Mwambieni mwenye nyumba ile atakayoingia, ‘Mwalimu anauliza: Kiko wapi chumba changu cha wageni, ambamo mimi na wanafunzi wangu tutakula Pasaka?’

english: And he will show you a large upper room, furnished and ready. Make preparations for us there.”
ekegusii: Na ere omonyene naborokie akanyomba akanene ka irongo igoro, karoisigwe kabeire ang’e; agwo motoroiserie.”
swahili: Atawaonyesha chumba kikubwa ghorofani, kilichopambwa tena kilicho tayari. Tuandalieni humo.”

english: When evening came, Jesus arrived with the Twelve.
ekegusii: Ekero riaba mogoroba agacha amo na baria ikomi na babere.
swahili: Ilipofika jioni, Yesu akaja pamoja na wale wanafunzi wake kumi na wawili.

english: And while they were reclining and eating, Jesus said, “Truly I tell you, one of you who is eating with Me will betray Me.”
ekegusii: Na barabwo kobaikaransire ase endagera bakoria, Yeso akabora, “Nekeene, nabateebirie: Oyomo oino oyokoria amo nainche nandue.”
swahili: Walipoketi mezani wakila, Yesu akawaambia, “Amin, nawaambia, mmoja wenu atanisaliti, mmoja anayekula pamoja nami.”

english: They began to be grieved and to ask Him one after another, “Surely not I?”
ekegusii: Aborokigwa baye bagachaaka goichana, bakamobooria oyomo ase oyomo “Inee! Ninche?”
swahili: Wakaanza kuhuzunika na kumuuliza mmoja baada ya mwingine, “Je, ni mimi Bwana?”

english: “But not during the feast,” they said, “or there may be a riot among the people.” Jesus Anointed at Bethany (Matthew 26:6–13; Luke 7:36–50; John 12:1–8)
ekegusii: korende barabwo bagateeba, “Titomobwata ekero kie rituko rinene, ekiagera abanto nigo bararente rirorooche.” Yeso ogoakwa amaguta agwo Bethania (Mat 26:6-13; Yoh 12:1-8)
swahili: Lakini walisema, “Tusilifanye jambo hili wakati wa Sikukuu, maana watu wanaweza wakafanya ghasia.” Yesu Kupakwa Mafuta Huko Bethania (Mathayo 26:6-13; Yohana 12:1-8)

english: He answered, “It is one of the Twelve—the one who is dipping his hand into the bowl with Me.
ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Noyomo bw’aba ikomi na babere, ere oyogotobeka amo nainche omogati ase esani.
swahili: Akawajibu, “Ni mmoja miongoni mwenu ninyi kumi na wawili, yule anayechovya mkate kwenye bakuli pamoja nami.

english: The Son of Man will go just as it is written about Him, but woe to that man by whom He is betrayed! It would be better for him if he had not been born.”
ekegusii: Inaki Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto nkogenda are buna ariikeretwe korende obobe nobwaye omonto oria orure Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto. Nanga mbuya ase are omonto oria, nonya ataiboretwe.” Emesa y’Omonene
swahili: Mwana wa Adamu anaenda zake kama vile alivyoandikiwa. Lakini ole wake mtu yule amsalitiye Mwana wa Adamu! Ingekuwa heri kwake mtu huyo kama hangezaliwa.” Kuanzishwa Kwa Meza Ya Bwana (Mathayo 26:26-30; Luka 22:14-20; 1 Wakorintho 11:23-25)

english: While they were eating, Jesus took bread, spoke a blessing and broke it, and gave it to the disciples, saying, “Take it; this is My body.”
ekegusii: Ekero barenge koria, Yeso akabogoria omogati, akayosesenia, akayosamunyora, akaa aborokigwa baye, akabora, “Bogoria! Oyo noro omobere one.”
swahili: Walipokuwa wanakula, Yesu akachukua mkate, akashukuru, akaumega na kuwapa wanafunzi wake, akisema, “Twaeni mle; huu ndio mwili wangu.”

english: Then He took the cup, gave thanks, and gave it to them, and they all drank from it.
ekegusii: Akabogoria egekombe, na ekero airaneirie ng’a mbuya mono, akabaa. Bagakenywera bonsi.
swahili: Kisha akakitwaa kikombe, akashukuru, akawapa, nao wote wakanywa kutoka humo.

english: He said to them, “This is My blood of the covenant, which is poured out for many.
ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Aya naro amanyinga aane, ay’okobwatana okoyia, aitekire ase engencho y’abange.
swahili: Akawaambia, “Hii ndiyo damu yangu ya agano, imwagikayo kwa ajili ya wengi.

english: Truly I tell you, I will no longer drink of the fruit of the vine until that day when I drink it anew in the kingdom of God.”
ekegusii: Ekeene nabateebirie: Tinkonywa naende nonya ng’ake okwama kw’emesabibu goika rituko riria ndache gokonywa okoyia ase oborwoti bwa Nyasae.”
swahili: Amin, nawaambia, sitakunywa tena katika uzao wa mzabibu, hadi siku ile nitakapounywa mpya katika Ufalme wa Mungu.”

english: And when they had sung a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives. Jesus Predicts Peter’s Denial (Zechariah 13:7–9; Matthew 26:31–35; Luke 22:31–38; John 13:36–38)
ekegusii: Kobakoorire goteera Ogoteera, bagasoka kogenda egetunwa ki’Emezeituni. Yeso okobana Ng’a Petero okomokana (Mat 26:31-35; Luk 22:31-34; Yoh 13:36-38)
swahili: Walipokwisha kuimba wimbo, wakatoka wakaenda Mlima wa Mizeituni. Yesu Atabiri Kuwa Petro Atamkana (Mathayo 26:31-35; Luka 22:31-34; Yohana 13:36-38)

english: Then Jesus said to them, “You will all fall away, for it is written: ‘I will strike the Shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered.’
ekegusii: Na Yeso agateebia aborokigwa baye, “Inwe mwensi inamogochwe na gontiga, naki nariikire: Ning’ake omorisia, ne ching’ondi nachiserebekane.
swahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Ninyi nyote mtaniacha, kwa maana imeandikwa: “ ‘Nitampiga mchungaji, nao kondoo watatawanyika.’

english: But after I have risen, I will go ahead of you into Galilee.”
ekegusii: Korende magega y’okobooka kw’ane, nimbatang’anere kogenda Galili.”
swahili: Lakini baada ya kufufuka kwangu, nitawatangulia kwenda Galilaya.”

english: Peter declared, “Even if all fall away, I never will.”
ekegusii: Petero akamoteebia, “Neba imbagochwe bonsi na kogotiga, korende tari inche.”
swahili: Petro akasema, “Hata kama wengine wote watakuacha, mimi sitakuacha.”

english: While Jesus was in Bethany reclining at the table in the home of Simon the Leper, a woman came with an alabaster jar of expensive perfume, made of pure nard. She broke open the jar and poured it on Jesus’ head.
ekegusii: Yeso nigo arenge Bethania ase enyomba ya Simioni oyorenge noborwaire bwa ukoma. Ekero Yeso aikaransire ase endagera, omokungu agacha orenge nechuba ye rigena rirabu ere namaguta agotioka buya, aye rigori rinene, agaata echuba eria, akamonyororokeria omotwe oye.
swahili: Yesu alikuwa Bethania nyumbani kwa Simoni aliyekuwa na ukoma. Wakati alipokuwa ameketi mezani akila chakula cha jioni, mwanamke mmoja aliingia akiwa na chupa ya marhamu yenye manukato ya nardo safi ya thamani kubwa. Akaivunja hiyo chupa, akamiminia hayo manukato kichwani mwa Yesu.

english: “Truly I tell you,” Jesus replied, “this very night, before the rooster crows twice, you will deny Me three times.”
ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Ekeene nagotebirie: Reero, ase obotuko obo, ritang’ani etuoni etarabuga ara kabere, nonkane ara gatato.”
swahili: Yesu akamwambia, “Amin, nakuambia; leo, usiku huu, kabla jogoo hajawika mara mbili, wewe mwenyewe utanikana mara tatu.”

english: But Peter kept insisting, “Even if I have to die with You, I will never deny You.” And all the others said the same thing. Jesus Prays at Gethsemane (Matthew 26:36–46; Luke 22:39–46)
ekegusii: Korende Petero ere akamenta gokwana mono, “Nimba ngokwa amo naye, tinkogokana nonya ng’ake.” Na bonsi bagateeba boigo. Yeso ogosaba Gethisemane (Mat 26:36-46; Luk 22:39-46)
swahili: Lakini Petro akasisitiza zaidi, “Hata kama itabidi kufa pamoja nawe, sitakukana kamwe.” Nao wale wengine wote wakasema vivyo hivyo. Yesu Aomba Katika Bustani Ya Gethsemane (Mathayo 26:36-46; Luka 22:39-46)

english: Then they came to a place called Gethsemane, and Jesus told His disciples, “Sit here while I pray.”
ekegusii: Naende bagaika aase akorokwa Gethisemane: Yeso agateebia aborokigwa baye, “Ikaransa aa, ekero ngosaba.”
swahili: Wakaenda mahali paitwapo Gethsemane. Yesu akawaambia wanafunzi wake, “Kaeni hapa, nami niende nikaombe.”

english: He took with Him Peter, James, and John, and began to be deeply troubled and distressed.
ekegusii: Akaira Petero na Yakobo na Yohana amo nere, agachaaka goichana na gwechanda mono.
swahili: Kisha akawachukua pamoja naye Petro, Yakobo na Yohana. Akaanza kuhuzunika sana na kutaabika.

english: Then He said to them, “My soul is consumed with sorrow to the point of death. Stay here and keep watch.”
ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Omoyo one nore nobororo obonge, goika ogokwa; ikaransa aiga, morende.”
swahili: Akawaambia, “Moyo wangu umejawa na huzuni kiasi cha kufa. Kaeni hapa na mkeshe.”

english: Going a little farther, He fell to the ground and prayed that, if it were possible, the hour would pass from Him.
ekegusii: Akagenderera bosio ake, akagwa maumama, ogosaba ng’a onye ekonyarekana, ensa eye emoetere.
swahili: Akaenda mbele kidogo, akaanguka kifudifudi, akaomba kwamba kama ingewezekana saa hiyo ya mateso imwondokee.

english: “Abba, Father,” He said, “all things are possible for You. Take this cup from Me. Yet not what I will, but what You will.”
ekegusii: Agateeba, Abba! Engencho yaye “Tata”, onsi nigo akonyarekana ase ore, onduserie egekombe eke, korende tari buna nyanchete inche, korende buna bwanchete aye.
swahili: Akasema, “ Abba, Baba, mambo yote yawezekana kwako. Niondolee kikombe hiki. Lakini si kama nipendavyo mimi, bali vile upendavyo wewe.”

english: Then Jesus returned and found them sleeping. “Simon, are you asleep?” He asked. “Were you not able to keep watch for one hour?
ekegusii: Erio akairana gocha ase aborokigwa baria baye batato akabanyora bararire. Agateebia Petero, “Simioni, nkwararire? Tokonyara korenda nonya nensa eyemo?
swahili: Akarudi kwa wanafunzi wake, akawakuta wamelala. Akamwambia Petro, “Simoni, umelala? Je, hukuweza kukesha hata kwa saa moja?

english: Watch and pray so that you will not enter into temptation. For the spirit is willing, but the body is weak.”
ekegusii: Renda, saba, timobaisa gosoa ase ogoteemwa; omoika nore nogwancha, korende omobere tori ne chinguru.”
swahili: Kesheni na mwombe, msije mkaingia majaribuni. Roho iko radhi, lakini mwili ni mdhaifu.”

english: Again He went away and prayed, saying the same thing.
ekegusii: Akagenda naende, agasaba, ogokwana amang’ana aria amatang’ani.
swahili: Akaenda tena kuomba, akisema maneno yale yale.

english: Some of those present, however, expressed their indignation to one another: “Why this waste of perfume?
ekegusii: Abanto bake ase abwo barenge oo bakagechigwa ase emioyo yabo, bakaboora, “Nase ki ogosiria amaguta engencho buna eye?
swahili: Baadhi ya watu waliokuwepo pale walikuwa wakisemezana wao kwa wao, “Upotevu huu wote ni wa nini?

english: And again Jesus returned and found them sleeping—for their eyes were heavy. And they did not know what to answer Him.
ekegusii: Erio naende akairana gocha ase aborokigwa akabanyora bararire, ekiagera amaiso abo abeire amarito, gose tibamanya eri bakomoiraneria.
swahili: Aliporudi, akawakuta tena wamelala kwa sababu macho yao yalikuwa mazito. Nao hawakujua la kumwambia.

english: When Jesus returned the third time, He said, “Are you still sleeping and resting? That is enough! The hour has come. Look, the Son of Man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.
ekegusii: Agacha eria gatato, akabateebia, “Nonya mbono moraire, na gotimoka? Aisanire. Engaki yaikire. Rora, Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto obekirwe ase amaboko y’abanyene ebibe.
swahili: Akaja mara ya tatu, akawaambia, “Bado mmelala na kupumzika? Imetosha! Saa imewadia. Tazameni, Mwana wa Adamu anasalitiwa na kutiwa mikononi mwa wenye dhambi.

english: Rise, let us go. See, My betrayer is approaching!” The Betrayal of Jesus (Matthew 26:47–56; Luke 22:47–53; John 18:1–14)
ekegusii: Imoka, togende; rora, ere oyokondua oikire ang’e.” Okobwatwa kwa Yeso (Mat 26:47-56; Luk 22:47-53; Yoh 18:2-11)
swahili: Inukeni, twende zetu! Tazameni, msaliti wangu yuaja!” Yesu Akamatwa (Mathayo 26:47-56; Luka 22:47-53; Yohana 18:3-12)

english: While Jesus was still speaking, Judas, one of the Twelve, arrived, accompanied by a crowd armed with swords and clubs, sent from the chief priests, scribes, and elders.
ekegusii: Erio kegima Yeso kagokwana, Yudasi, oyomo bwa baria ikomi na babere, agaika, na omoganda ore amo nere nemioro ne chinungu, bakorwa ase abakuani abanene, na aborokia b’amariiko, na abagaaka.
swahili: Yesu alipokuwa bado anazungumza, Yuda, mmoja wa wale wanafunzi Kumi na Wawili, akatokea. Alikuwa amefuatana na umati wa watu wenye panga na marungu, waliokuwa wametumwa na viongozi wa makuhani, walimu wa sheria, na wazee.
