english: Now the betrayer had arranged a signal with them: “The One I kiss is the man; arrest Him and lead Him away securely.”
ekegusii: Ere oyokomorua konya obaeire ekemanyererio, ogoteeba, “Oyo ndanyunyunte, oyio nere, momobwate, momoire momorendete.”
swahili: Basi msaliti alikuwa amewapa hao watu ishara, kwamba: “Yule nitakayembusu ndiye. Mkamateni, mkamchukue chini ya ulinzi.”

english: Going directly to Jesus, he said, “Rabbi!” and kissed Him.
ekegusii: Ekero Yudasi aigete akagenda bwango, goika ase Yeso, akabora, “Rabii!” Akamonyunyunta.
swahili: Mara Yuda akamjia Yesu na kusema, “Rabi.” Akambusu.

english: Then the men seized Jesus and arrested Him.
ekegusii: Erio bakabwata Yeso, bakamoira.
swahili: Wale watu wakamkamata Yesu, wakamweka chini ya ulinzi.

english: And one of the bystanders drew his sword and struck the servant of the high priest, cutting off his ear.
ekegusii: Na oyomo ase baria bateneine ang’e akang’usa omoyio oye o birende, agaaka omosomba bw’Omokuani omonene, akamobutora ogoto.
swahili: Ndipo mmoja wa wale waliokuwa wamesimama karibu aliuchomoa upanga wake na kumpiga mtumishi wa kuhani mkuu, akamkata sikio.

english: Jesus asked the crowd, “Have you come out with swords and clubs to arrest Me as you would an outlaw?
ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Inee! Igo mwachire buna mokoimokera omouri nemioro ne chinungu, gocha kong’ira?
swahili: Kisha Yesu akawaambia, “Mmekuja na panga na marungu kunikamata kana kwamba mimi ni mnyangʼanyi?

english: Every day I was with you, teaching in the temple courts, and you did not arrest Me. But this has happened that the Scriptures would be fulfilled.”
ekegusii: Inarenge amo nainwe kera rituko ase Hekalu ime kworokereria, ko timwambwata. Korende aya akorirwe, erinde amariiko anyare goikerana.”
swahili: Siku kwa siku nilikuwa pamoja nanyi nikifundisha Hekaluni, wala hamkunikamata. Lakini Maandiko sharti yatimie.”

english: It could have been sold for over three hundred denarii and the money given to the poor.” And they scolded her.
ekegusii: Inaki amaguta aya anga naoonigwa chidinari amagana atato na kobua, abataka baegwe.” Bakamwemurunganeria omokungu oria mono.
swahili: Mafuta haya yangeweza kuuzwa kwa zaidi ya dinari 300, na fedha hizo wakapewa maskini.” Wakamkemea vikali huyo mwanamke.

english: Then everyone deserted Him and fled.
ekegusii: Erio aborokigwa bonsi bakamotiga, bagatama. Omomura oyotamete
swahili: Ndipo wanafunzi wake wote wakamwacha, wakakimbia.

english: One young man who had been following Jesus was wearing a linen cloth around his body. They caught hold of him,
ekegusii: Omomura oyomo akamotunyana, bweboyetie egetambaa ki’egatani gioka. Bagatema kamobwata,
swahili: Kijana mmoja, ambaye hakuwa amevaa kitu isipokuwa alijitanda nguo ya kitani, alikuwa akimfuata Yesu. Walipomkamata,

english: but he pulled free of the linen cloth and ran away naked. Jesus before the Sanhedrin (Matthew 26:57–68; Luke 22:66–71; John 18:19–24)
ekegusii: korende ere agatiga egetambaa keria ki’egatani, agatama ore getirianda. Yeso bosio bw’abakuani (Mat 26:57-68; Luk 22:54-55,63-71; Yoh 18:12-14,19-24)
swahili: alikimbia uchi, akaliacha vazi lake. Yesu Mbele Ya Baraza La Wayahudi (Mathayo 26:57-68; Luka 22:54-71; Yohana 18:13-24)

english: They led Jesus away to the high priest, and all the chief priests, elders, and scribes assembled.
ekegusii: Bakaira Yeso ase Omokuani omonene; bakamosangererekanera bonsi, abakuani abanene na abagaaka, na aborokia b’amariiko.
swahili: Wakampeleka Yesu kwa kuhani mkuu, nao viongozi wa makuhani wote, na wazee na walimu wa sheria wote wakakusanyika pamoja.

english: Peter followed Him at a distance, right into the courtyard of the high priest. And he sat with the officers and warmed himself by the fire.
ekegusii: Na Petero akamotunyana korwa magega ore egeka, goika ime ase egoora y’Omokuani omonene, agaikaransa amo nabasomba gwota omorero.
swahili: Petro akamfuata kwa mbali, hadi uani kwa kuhani mkuu. Huko akaketi pamoja na walinzi, akiota moto.

english: Now the chief priests and the whole Sanhedrin were seeking testimony against Jesus to put Him to death, but they did not find any.
ekegusii: Abakuani abanene na ab’ekegambero bonsi bakarigia oborori igoro ase Yeso banyare komoita, korende tibabonyora,
swahili: Viongozi wa makuhani na Baraza la Wayahudi lote wakatafuta ushahidi dhidi ya Yesu ili wapate kumuua. Lakini hawakupata jambo lolote.

english: For many bore false witness against Jesus, but their testimony was inconsistent.
ekegusii: ekiagera abange bakomoteebera oborimo, na oborori bwabo tibwabwatana.
swahili: Wengi walitoa ushahidi wa uongo dhidi yake, lakini maelezo yao hayakukubaliana.

english: Then some men stood up and testified falsely against Him:
ekegusii: Na abande bagatenena bakamoteebera oborimo, bakaboora,
swahili: Ndipo wengine wakasimama wakatoa ushahidi wa uongo dhidi yake, wakisema:

english: “We heard Him say, ‘I will destroy this man-made temple, and in three days I will build another that is made without hands.’”
ekegusii: “Ntwamoigwete ogoteeba: Inche nintagore Hekalu eye yakoregete n’amaboko, na ase amatuko atato ning’agache eyende etakoregeti n’amaboko.”
swahili: “Sisi tulimsikia akisema, ‘Mimi nitalibomoa Hekalu hili lililojengwa na wanadamu, na katika siku tatu nitajenga jingine ambalo halikujengwa na wanadamu.’ ”

english: But even their testimony was inconsistent.
ekegusii: Nonya nabo oborori bwabo tibwabwatana.
swahili: Lakini hata hivyo, ushahidi wao haukukubaliana.

english: But Jesus said, “Leave her alone; why are you bothering her? She has done a beautiful deed to Me.
ekegusii: Yeso agateeba, “Motige! Nase ki mokomorosia? Ere onkoreire emeremo emiya.
swahili: Lakini Yesu akawaambia, “Mbona mnamsumbua huyu mwanamke? Mwacheni! Yeye amenitendea jambo zuri sana.

english: So the high priest stood up before them and questioned Jesus, “Have You no answer? What are these men testifying against You?”
ekegusii: Omokuani omonene agatenena gati‐gati, akaboria Yeso okobora, “Tokoiraneria ing’ana? Inki aba bakogosoera?”
swahili: Basi kuhani mkuu akasimama mbele yao, akamuuliza Yesu, “Je, wewe hutajibu? Ni ushahidi gani hawa watu wanauleta dhidi yako?”

english: But Jesus remained silent and made no reply. Again the high priest questioned Him, “Are You the Christ, the Son of the Blessed One?”
ekegusii: Korende agakira, tairaneria ing’ana. Omokuani omonene akamobooria naende, akamoteebia, “Aye naye Kristo, Omwana bw’Omosesenigwa?”
swahili: Lakini Yesu akakaa kimya, hakusema neno lolote. Kuhani mkuu akamuuliza tena, “Je, wewe ndiwe Kristo, Mwana wa Mungu Aliyebarikiwa?”

english: “I am,” said Jesus, “and you will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of Power and coming with the clouds of heaven.”
ekegusii: Yeso agateeba, “Ee, ninche ere; na inwe namorore Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto ogoikaransa ensemo y’okoboko gw’okorio kw’Oyore nokobua, ogocha namare a igoro.”
swahili: Yesu akajibu, “Mimi ndimi. Nanyi mtamwona Mwana wa Adamu akiwa ameketi mkono wa kuume wa Mwenye Nguvu, na akija juu ya mawingu ya mbinguni.”

english: At this, the high priest tore his clothes and declared, “Why do we need any more witnesses?
ekegusii: Omokuani omonene agatandora chianga chiaye, akabora, “Ninki tokorigeria abarori bande?
swahili: Kuhani mkuu akararua mavazi yake, akasema, “Tuna haja gani tena ya mashahidi zaidi?

english: You have heard the blasphemy. What is your verdict?” And they all condemned Him as deserving of death.
ekegusii: Mwaigure okorama kwaye. Inaki morooche?” Bonsi bakamonachera ekiina ng’a nagwenerete akwe.
swahili: Ninyi mmesikia hayo makufuru. Uamuzi wenu ni gani?” Wote wakamhukumu kwamba anastahili kifo.

english: Then some of them began to spit on Him. They blindfolded Him, struck Him with their fists, and said to Him, “Prophesy!” And the officers received Him with slaps in His face. Peter Denies Jesus (Matthew 26:69–75; Luke 22:54–62; John 18:15–18)
ekegusii: Abande bagachaaka komotwera amate, na komotuba obosio, na komoaka chinkundi, na komoteebia, “Bana!” Abarendi nabarabwo bakamoaka chindoe. Petero ogokana Yeso (Mat 26:69-75; Luk 22:56-62; Yoh 18:15-18,25-27)
swahili: Kisha baadhi ya watu wakaanza kumtemea mate; wakamfunga kitambaa machoni, wakampiga kwa ngumi na kumwambia, “Tabiri!” Walinzi wakamchukua na kumpiga makofi. Petro Amkana Yesu (Mathayo 26:69-75; Luka 22:56-62; Yohana 18:15-18, 25-27)

english: While Peter was in the courtyard below, one of the servant girls of the high priest came down
ekegusii: Na Petero nigo arenge egoora inse, na oyomo bw’abaiseke abasomba b’Omokuani omonene agacha,
swahili: Petro alipokuwa bado yuko chini kwenye ua wa jumba la kifalme, tazama akaja mmoja wa watumishi wa kike wa kuhani mkuu.

english: and saw him warming himself there. She looked at Peter and said, “You also were with Jesus the Nazarene.”
ekegusii: akarora Petero ogwota omorero, akamorigereria, agateeba, “Aye naye kwarenge amo noria Omonazareti, Yeso.”
swahili: Alipomwona Petro akiota moto, akamtazama sana, akamwambia, “Wewe pia ulikuwa pamoja na Yesu, Mnazareti.”

english: But he denied it. “I do not know or even understand what you are talking about,” he said. Then he went out to the gateway, and the rooster crowed.
ekegusii: Agakana, akabora, “Timanyeti, gose tinyigweti eki ogokwana.” Agasoka gesieri; etuoni ekabuga.
swahili: Lakini Petro akakana, akasema, “Sijui wala sielewi unalosema.” Naye akaondoka kuelekea kwenye njia ya kuingilia.

english: There the servant girl saw him and again said to those standing nearby, “This man is one of them.”
ekegusii: Omoiseke oria omosomba akamorora naende, agachaaka goteebia abateneine ang’e, “Oyo n’oyomo obo.”
swahili: Yule mtumishi wa kike alipomwona mahali pale, akawaambia tena wale waliokuwa wamesimama hapo, “Huyu mtu ni mmoja wao.”

english: The poor you will always have with you, and you can help them whenever you want. But you will not always have Me.
ekegusii: Inaki amatuko onsi nigo more nabataka amo nainwe, na kero kende gionsi mwanchete, namonyare kobakorera amaya, korende timori nainche amatuko onsi.
swahili: Maskini mtakuwa nao siku zote na mnaweza kuwasaidia wakati wowote mnaotaka. Lakini mimi hamtakuwa nami siku zote.

english: But he denied it again. After a little while, those standing nearby said once more to Peter, “Surely you are one of them, for you too are a Galilean.”
ekegusii: Agakaana naende. Magega y’egeka egeke naende, baria bateneine ang’e bagateebia Petero, “Ekeene bori, naye n’oyomo obo ore, ekiagera nigo ore Omogalili.”
swahili: Lakini Petro akakana tena. Baada ya muda kidogo wale waliokuwa wamesimama hapo karibu na Petro wakamwambia, “Hakika wewe ni mmoja wao, kwa maana wewe pia ni Mgalilaya!”

english: But he began to curse and swear, “I do not know this man of whom you speak!”
ekegusii: Agachaaka kweragereria na gotiana, “Timanyeti omonto oyio mogoteeba.”
swahili: Petro akaanza kujilaani na kuwaapia, “Mimi simjui huyu mtu mnayesema habari zake!”

english: And immediately the rooster crowed a second time. Then Peter remembered the word that Jesus had spoken to him: “Before the rooster crows twice, you will deny Me three times.” And he broke down and wept.
ekegusii: Erio etuoni ekabuga eria kabere. Petero akainyora ring’ana riria atebetigwe na Yeso, “Ritang’ani etuoni etarabuga ara kabere, nonkaane ara gatato.” Agachia agetugutana, akarera.
swahili: Papo hapo jogoo akawika mara ya pili. Ndipo Petro akakumbuka lile neno Yesu alikuwa amemwambia: “Kabla jogoo hajawika mara mbili, utanikana mara tatu.” Akavunjika moyo, akalia sana.

english: She has done what she could to anoint My body in advance of My burial.
ekegusii: Okorire eki abuete, goaka omobere one ase ogotindekwa kwane.
swahili: Huyu mwanamke amenitendea lile aliloweza. Ameumiminia mwili wangu manukato ili kuniandaa kwa maziko yangu.

english: And truly I tell you, wherever the gospel is preached in all the world, what she has done will also be told in memory of her.” Judas Agrees to Betray Jesus (Matthew 26:14–16; Luke 22:3–6)
ekegusii: Nekeene nabateebirie: Kera aase enchiri erarandigwe ase ense yonsi, neri akora oyo nariatorwe ase okomoinyora.” Yudasi ogwancherana korwa Yeso (Mat 26:14-16; Luk 22:3-6)
swahili: Amin, nawaambia, mahali popote ulimwenguni ambapo Injili itahubiriwa, jambo hili alilolitenda huyu mwanamke litatajwa pia kwa ukumbusho wake.” Yuda Akubali Kumsaliti Yesu (Mathayo 26:14-16; Luka 22:3-6)

english: Early in the morning, the chief priests, elders, scribes, and the whole Sanhedrin devised a plan. They bound Jesus, led Him away, and handed Him over to Pilate.
ekegusii: Erio kobwachia gokia mambia, abakuani abanene bagakora ekiina amo nabagaaka na aborokia b’amariiko, na ekegambero ekegima. Bagasiba Yeso, bakamoira, bakamomoa Pilato.
swahili: Asubuhi na mapema, viongozi wa makuhani, pamoja na wazee, walimu wa sheria na Baraza lote, wakafikia uamuzi. Wakamfunga Yesu, wakamchukua na kumkabidhi kwa Pilato.

english: For he knew it was out of envy that the chief priests had handed Jesus over.
ekegusii: Ekiagera amanyete ng’a abakuani abanene nigo bamorure ase obogechi.
swahili: Kwa maana yeye alitambua kuwa viongozi wa makuhani walikuwa wamemtia Yesu mikononi mwake kwa ajili ya wivu.

english: But the chief priests stirred up the crowd to have him release Barabbas to them instead. Pilate Delivers Up Jesus (Matthew 27:24–26)
ekegusii: Abakuani abanene bakagenka abanto b’omoganda, erinde anche kobasiborera Baraba.
swahili: Lakini viongozi wa makuhani wakauchochea ule umati wa watu wamwombe awafungulie Baraba badala yake.

english: So Pilate asked them again, “What then do you want me to do with the One you call the King of the Jews?”
ekegusii: Pilato akairaneria naende, akabateebia, “Imokore naki oyo mogoteeba ng’a n’Omorwoti bw’Abayahudi?”
swahili: Pilato akawauliza tena, “Basi mnataka nifanye nini na huyu mtu mnayemwita Mfalme wa Wayahudi?”

english: And they shouted back, “Crucify Him!”
ekegusii: Bagaaka eriogi naende, “Mobambe!”
swahili: Wakapiga kelele wakisema, “Msulubishe!”

english: “Why?” asked Pilate. “What evil has He done?” But they shouted all the louder, “Crucify Him!”
ekegusii: Pilato akababoria, “Nase ki? Mbobe ki akorete?” Bakamenta mono goaka eriogi, “Mobambe!”
swahili: Pilato akawauliza, “Kwa nini? Amefanya kosa gani?” Lakini wao wakapiga kelele kwa nguvu zaidi, wakisema, “Msulubishe!”

english: And wishing to satisfy the crowd, Pilate released Barabbas to them. But he had Jesus flogged, and handed Him over to be crucified. The Soldiers Mock Jesus (Isaiah 50:4–11; Matthew 27:27–31; Luke 22:63–65; John 19:1–15)
ekegusii: Pilato agancha gokora ayaragwenere omoganda, akabasiborera Baraba, na ekero aakire Yeso chinkini, akamorua abambwe. Abarwani bagochecheria Yeso (Mat 27:27-31; Yoh 19:2-3)
swahili: Pilato, akitaka kuuridhisha ule umati wa watu, akawafungulia Baraba. Naye baada ya kuamuru Yesu achapwe mijeledi, akamtoa ili asulubishwe. Askari Wamdhihaki Yesu (Mathayo 27:27-31; Yohana 19:2-3)

english: Then the soldiers led Jesus away into the palace (that is, the Praetorium) and called the whole company together.
ekegusii: Abarwani bakaira Yeso ime ase enyomba y’ekegambero (nero Praitorio), bagasangererekana amo ekeombe ekegima.
swahili: Askari wakampeleka Yesu hadi kwenye ukumbi wa ndani wa jumba la kifalme, ndio Praitorio, wakakusanya kikosi kizima cha askari.

english: They dressed Him in a purple robe, twisted together a crown of thorns, and set it on His head.
ekegusii: Bakamoboyia eanga emonyinga, bagatwang’a egutwa y’amagwa, bakamobekera motwe,
swahili: Wakamvalisha Yesu joho la zambarau, wakasokota taji ya miiba, wakamvika kichwani.

english: And they began to salute Him: “Hail, King of the Jews!”
ekegusii: bagachaaka komokwania, “Masoge, Omorwoti bw’Abayahudi!”
swahili: Wakaanza kumsalimu kwa dhihaka, “Salamu, mfalme wa Wayahudi!”

english: They kept striking His head with a staff and spitting on Him. And they knelt down and bowed before Him.
ekegusii: Bakamoaka omotwe negetonto, bakamotwera amate, bakabeka amaru inse, bakamosasiima.
swahili: Wakampiga kwa fimbo ya mwanzi tena na tena kichwani na kumtemea mate. Wakapiga magoti mbele yake, wakamsujudia kwa kumdhihaki.

english: So Pilate questioned Him, “Are You the King of the Jews?” “You have said so,” Jesus replied.
ekegusii: Pilato akamobooria, “Aye naye Omorwoti bw’Abayahudi?” Akamoiraneria, “Naboigo, aye gwateebire.”
swahili: Pilato akamuuliza, “Je, wewe ndiye Mfalme wa Wayahudi?” Yesu akajibu, “Wewe umesema.”

english: After they had mocked Him, they removed the purple robe and put His own clothes back on Him. Then they led Him out to crucify Him. The Crucifixion (Psalms 22:1–31; Matthew 27:32–44; Luke 23:26–43; John 19:16–27)
ekegusii: Kobamochecheirie, bakamorusia eanga eria emonyinga, bakamoboyia chianga chiaye omonyene. Bakamoira isiko komobamba. Okobambwa kwa Yeso (Mat 27:32-44; Luk 23:26-43; Yoh 19:17-27)
swahili: Walipokwisha kumdhihaki, wakamvua lile joho la zambarau, wakamvika tena nguo zake. Kisha wakamtoa nje ili wakamsulubishe. Kusulubiwa Kwa Yesu (Mathayo 27:32-44; Luka 23:26-43; Yohana 19:17-27)

english: Now Simon of Cyrene, the father of Alexander and Rufus, was passing by on his way in from the country, and the soldiers forced him to carry the cross of Jesus.
ekegusii: Bakabetereria omonto orenge goeta, Simioni Omokurene, ore korwa borabu, ise Alekisanda na Rufo, abogorie omosalaba o Yeso.
swahili: Mtu mmoja kutoka Kirene, jina lake Simoni, baba yao Aleksanda na Rufo, alikuwa anapita zake kuingia mjini kutoka shamba, nao wakamlazimisha kuubeba ule msalaba.

english: They brought Jesus to a place called Golgotha, which means The Place of the Skull.
ekegusii: Bakamoira aase akorokwa Gologotha (engencho yaye: Aase Ekeore).
swahili: Kisha wakampeleka Yesu mpaka mahali palipoitwa Golgotha (maana yake ni Mahali pa Fuvu la Kichwa).

english: There they offered Him wine mixed with myrrh, but He did not take it.
ekegusii: Bakamoa edivai yochoganirie na manemane anywe, ko tancha konywa.
swahili: Nao wakampa divai iliyochanganywa na manemane, lakini hakuinywa.

english: And they crucified Him. They also divided His garments by casting lots to decide what each of them would take.
ekegusii: Bakamobamba, bagaatanana chianga chiaye, bagachiakera obomera eye kera omonto araire.
swahili: Basi wakamsulubisha, nazo nguo zake wakagawana miongoni mwao kwa kuzipigia kura ili kuamua ni gani kila mtu ataichukua.

english: It was the third hour when they crucified Him.
ekegusii: Nigo chiare chinsa isato ekero bamobambete.
swahili: Ilikuwa yapata saa tatu asubuhi walipomsulubisha.

english: And the charge inscribed against Him read: THE KING OF THE JEWS.
ekegusii: Na amariiko y’ogosoerwa kwaye nigo ariikire igoro, “OMORWOTI BW’ABAYAHUDI.”
swahili: Tangazo likaandikwa la mashtaka dhidi yake lenye maneno haya: “ Mfalme wa Wayahudi.”

english: Along with Jesus, they crucified two robbers, one on His right and one on His left.
ekegusii: Amo nere bakabamba abauri babere, oyomo ensemo y’okoboko kwaye gw’okorio, na oyonde okoboko gw’okobee. [
swahili: Pamoja naye walisulubiwa wanyangʼanyi wawili, mmoja upande wake wa kuume na mwingine upande wa kushoto. [

english: And those who passed by heaped abuse on Him, shaking their heads and saying, “Aha! You who are going to destroy the temple and rebuild it in three days,
ekegusii: Na abanto abaare goeta bakamorama, bagosinga‐singisia emetwe yabo, bagoteeba, “A! Aye oyogotagora Hekalu na koyeagacha ase amatuko atato,
swahili: Watu waliokuwa wakipita njiani wakamtukana huku wakitikisa vichwa vyao na kusema, “Aha! Wewe ambaye utalivunja Hekalu na kulijenga kwa siku tatu,

english: And the chief priests began to accuse Him of many things.
ekegusii: Abakuani abanene bakamosoera ase amang’ana amange.
swahili: Viongozi wa makuhani wakamshtaki kwa mambo mengi.

english: come down from the cross and save Yourself!”
ekegusii: etoorie, ika korwa ase omosalaba!”
swahili: basi shuka kutoka msalabani na ujiokoe mwenyewe!”

english: In the same way, the chief priests and scribes mocked Him among themselves, saying, “He saved others, but He cannot save Himself!
ekegusii: Naboigo nabakuani abanene bakamosekereria barabwo ase barabwo, amo naborokia b’amariiko, bagateeba, “Natooretie abande, ere omonyene takonyara gwetooria.
swahili: Vivyo hivyo, viongozi wa makuhani pamoja na walimu wa sheria wakamdhihaki miongoni mwao wakisema, “Aliwaokoa wengine, lakini hawezi kujiokoa mwenyewe!

english: Let the Christ, the King of Israel, come down now from the cross, so that we may see and believe!” And even those who were crucified with Him berated Him. The Death of Jesus (Psalms 22:1–31; Matthew 27:45–56; Luke 23:44–49; John 19:28–30)
ekegusii: Tiga Kristo, Omorwoti bw’Abaisraeli, aike bono korwa ase omosalaba, tonyare korora na kwegena!” Na barabwo abaabambetwe amo nere bakamoraama. Ogokwa kwa Yeso (Mat 27:45-56; Luk 23:44-49; Yoh 19:28-30)
swahili: Basi huyu Kristo, huyu Mfalme wa Israeli, ashuke sasa kutoka msalabani, ili tupate kuona na kuamini.” Wale waliosulubiwa pamoja naye pia wakamtukana. Kifo Cha Yesu Msalabani (Mathayo 27:45-56; Luka 23:44-49; Yohana 19:28-30)

english: From the sixth hour until the ninth hour darkness came over all the land.
ekegusii: Ekero chinsa isano nemo chiaika omosunte okaba igoro ase ense yonsi goika chinsa kianda.
swahili: Ilipofika saa sita, giza liliifunika nchi yote hadi saa tisa.

english: At the ninth hour, Jesus cried out in a loud voice, “Eloi, Eloi, lema sabachthani?” which means, “My God, My God, why have You forsaken Me?”
ekegusii: Ne chinsa kianda Yeso akarera ase eriogi rinene, “Eloi, Eloi, lama sabakitani?” Okoonchorwa kwaye: “Nyasae one, Nyasae one, naki gwantigire?”
swahili: Mnamo saa tisa, Yesu akapaza sauti, akalia, “Eloi, Eloi, lama sabakthani?” (maana yake, “Mungu wangu, Mungu wangu, mbona umeniacha?” )

english: When some of those standing nearby heard this, they said, “Behold, He is calling Elijah.”
ekegusii: Na abande b’abwo bateneine ang’e koyaigwa bakaboora, “Rora, nkorangeria are Elija.”
swahili: Baadhi ya watu waliokuwa wamesimama karibu waliposikia hayo, wakasema, “Msikieni, anamwita Eliya.”

english: And someone ran and filled a sponge with sour wine. He put it on a reed and held it up for Jesus to drink, saying, “Leave Him alone. Let us see if Elijah comes to take Him down.”
ekegusii: Omonto akaminyoka bwango, akaimokia esifunchi, akayeichoria chinkama, akayebeka igoro ase egetonto, akamoa anywe, okobora, “Tiga torore gose Elija ngocha are komoikia.”
swahili: Mtu mmoja akaenda mbio, akachovya sifongo kwenye siki, akaiweka kwenye mwanzi na akampa Yesu ili anywe, akisema, “Basi mwacheni. Hebu tuone kama Eliya atakuja kumshusha kutoka hapo msalabani.”

english: But Jesus let out a loud cry and breathed His last.
ekegusii: Yeso agaaka eriogi rinene, agatweka mo.
swahili: Kisha Yesu akatoa sauti kuu, akakata roho.

english: And the veil of the temple was torn in two from top to bottom.
ekegusii: Egetambaa gi’okonacha Hekalu kegatondoka korwa igoro goika inse, gekaba bibere.
swahili: Pazia la Hekalu likachanika vipande viwili kuanzia juu hadi chini.

english: When the centurion standing there in front of Jesus saw how He had breathed His last, he said, “Truly this man was the Son of God!”
ekegusii: Na ekero omotang’ani bw’abarwani rigana ateneine amorigereretie, agachia korora ng’a otwekire mo, akabora, “Ekeene, omonto oyo nigo arenge Omwana o Nyasae.”
swahili: Basi yule jemadari aliyekuwa amesimama hapo mbele ya msalaba wa Yesu aliposikia ile sauti yake na kuona jinsi alivyokata roho, akasema, “Hakika mtu huyu alikuwa Mwana wa Mungu!”

english: Then Pilate questioned Him again, “Have You no answer? Look how many charges they are bringing against You!”
ekegusii: Pilato akamobooria naende, akabora, “Tokoiraneria ing’ana? Rora amang’ana aya amange bagosoereire.”
swahili: Pilato akamuuliza tena, “Je, huna la kujibu? Tazama ni mashtaka mangapi wanayaleta juu yako.”

english: And there were also women watching from a distance. Among them were Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James the younger and of Joses, and Salome.
ekegusii: Mbarengeo abakungu barigereretie korwa are. Ase abwo nigo barenge Mariamu Magadalena na Mariamu ng’ina Yakobo omoke na Yose, na Salome.
swahili: Walikuwepo pia wanawake waliokuwa wakiangalia kwa mbali. Miongoni mwao walikuwepo Maria Magdalene, na Maria mama yao Yakobo mdogo na Yose, pia na Salome.

english: These women had followed Jesus and ministered to Him while He was in Galilee, and there were many other women who had come up to Jerusalem with Him. The Burial of Jesus (Isaiah 53:9–12; Matthew 27:57–61; Luke 23:50–56; John 19:38–42)
ekegusii: Aba nabwo bamotuny’anete ekero arenge Galili na komokorera, amo nabande abange abakungu abatiirete amo nere goika Yerusalemu. Ogotindekwa kwa Yeso (Mat 27:57-61; Luk 23:50-56; Yoh 19:38-42)
swahili: Hawa walifuatana na Yesu na kushughulikia mahitaji yake alipokuwa Galilaya. Pia walikuwepo wanawake wengine wengi waliokuwa wamekuja pamoja naye Yerusalemu. Maziko Ya Yesu (Mathayo 27:57-61; Luka 23:50-56; Yohana 19:38-42)

english: Now it was already evening. Since it was Preparation Day (that is, the day before the Sabbath),
ekegusii: Riachia koba mogoroba, ekiagera nerituko ri’okwebeka ang’e, nario rituko ri’ogotang’anera Esabato,
swahili: Ilipofika jioni, kwa kuwa ilikuwa Siku ya Maandalizi, yaani siku moja kabla ya Sabato,

english: Joseph of Arimathea, a prominent Council member who himself was waiting for the kingdom of God, boldly went to Pilate to ask for the body of Jesus.
ekegusii: Yusufu omonto bw’Arimathaya agacha, oyorenge omosike, omonto bw’ekegambero. Ere omonyene nigo aganyete oborwoti bwa Nyasae; agasoa noboremu ase obosio bwa Pilato, agasaba aegwe omobere o Yeso.
swahili: Yosefu wa Arimathaya, mtu aliyeheshimiwa katika Baraza, na ambaye alikuwa anautarajia Ufalme wa Mungu, akamwendea Pilato kwa ujasiri na kumwomba mwili wa Yesu.

english: Pilate was surprised to hear that Jesus was already dead, so he summoned the centurion to ask if this was so.
ekegusii: Pilato agakumia, ekiagera aikire gokwa, akarangeria omotang’ani oria bw’abarwani rigana, akamobooria gose nkare akwete.
swahili: Pilato alikuwa akijiuliza kama Yesu alikuwa amekwisha kufa. Hivyo akamwita yule jemadari, akamuuliza iwapo Yesu alikuwa amekwisha kufa.

english: When Pilate had confirmed it with the centurion, he granted the body to Joseph.
ekegusii: Goika agachia konyora ekeene ng’a okuure, akaa Yusufu omobere.
swahili: Baada ya kupata habari kutoka kwa yule jemadari kwamba kweli amekwisha kufa, Pilato akampa Yosefu ruhusa ya kuuchukua huo mwili.

english: So Joseph bought a linen cloth, took down the body of Jesus, wrapped it in the cloth, and placed it in a tomb that had been cut out of the rock. Then he rolled a stone against the entrance to the tomb.
ekegusii: Yusufu akagora egetambaa ki’egatani, akamoikia, akamoboyia egetambaa keria, akamobeka ase oboina bwabaachetwe ase egetare. Naende agaturunkania rigena gochia ase egesieri ki’oboina.
swahili: Hivyo Yosefu akanunua kitambaa cha kitani safi, akaushusha mwili kutoka msalabani, akaufunga katika kile kitambaa cha kitani, na kuuweka ndani ya kaburi lililochongwa kwenye mwamba. Kisha akavingirisha jiwe kwenye ingilio la kaburi.

english: Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joseph saw where His body was placed.
ekegusii: Mariamu Magadalena na Mariamu ng’ina Yose bakarigereria aase abegetwe.
swahili: Maria Magdalene na Maria mamaye Yose walipaona mahali pale alipolazwa.

english: But to Pilate’s amazement, Jesus made no further reply. The Crowd Chooses Barabbas (Matthew 27:15–23; Luke 23:13–25)
ekegusii: Korende Yeso tairaneria ing’ana rinde naende, goika Pilato agakumia.
swahili: Lakini Yesu hakujibu lolote, hivyo Pilato akashangaa. Pilato Amtoa Yesu Asulubiwe (Mathayo 27:15-26; Luka 23:13-25; Yohana 18:39–19:16)

english: Now it was Pilate’s custom at the feast to release to the people a prisoner of their choosing.
ekegusii: Nabo ase rituko rinene nigo anarete kobasiborera omosibwa oyomo, oyobarigetie.
swahili: Ilikuwa desturi wakati wa Sikukuu ya Pasaka kumfungulia mfungwa yeyote ambaye watu wangemtaka.

english: And a man named Barabbas was imprisoned with the rebels who had committed murder during the insurrection.
ekegusii: Narengeo omonto ore korokwa Baraba, osibetwe amo nabaanto abakorete eburuburu, na gokora oboiti ase eburuburu.
swahili: Wakati huo, mtu aliyeitwa Baraba alikuwa amefungwa gerezani pamoja na waasi wengine waliokuwa wametekeleza uuaji wakati wa maasi.

english: So the crowd went up and began asking Pilate to keep his custom.
ekegusii: Omoganda ogotiira gochiao, na barabwo bagachaaka gosaba Pilato abakorere buna anarete kobakorera.
swahili: Ule umati wa watu ukamjia Pilato na kumwomba awafanyie kama ilivyokuwa desturi yake.

english: “Do you want me to release to you the King of the Jews?” Pilate asked.
ekegusii: Pilato akababoria, “Morigetie mbasiborere Omorwoti bw’Abayahudi?”
swahili: Pilato akawauliza, “Mnataka niwafungulie huyu Mfalme wa Wayahudi?”

english: When the Sabbath was over, Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James, and Salome bought spices so they could go and anoint the body of Jesus.
ekegusii: Goika Esabato koyaerire, Mariamu Magidalena, na Mariamu ng’ina Yakobo, na Salome, bakagora amaguta yamanukato, banyare kogenda komoaka.
swahili: Sabato ilipomalizika, Maria Magdalene, Maria mama yake Yakobo, na Salome walinunua manukato ili wakaupake mwili wa Yesu.

english: She went and told those who had been with Him, who were mourning and weeping.
ekegusii: Oyo akagenda agateebia baria barenge amo nere korwa kare, baare kweumia na korera.
swahili: Maria akaenda, naye akawaambia wale waliokuwa wamefuatana na Yesu, waliokuwa wanaomboleza na kulia.

english: And when they heard that Jesus was alive and she had seen Him, they did not believe it. Jesus Appears to Two Disciples (Luke 24:13–35)
ekegusii: Na barabwo, bagachia koigwa ng’a moyo are, na ororirwe nere, tibegena.
swahili: Lakini waliposikia kwamba Yesu yu hai na kwamba Maria alikuwa amemwona, hawakusadiki. Yesu Awatokea Wanafunzi Wawili (Luka 24:13-35)

english: After this, Jesus appeared in a different form to two of them as they walked along in the country.
ekegusii: Magega ase aya akaorokera abanto babere ase barabwo, ore nekieni kende ekeao, ekero barenge gotaara kogenda borabu.
swahili: Baadaye Yesu akawatokea wawili miongoni mwa wanafunzi wake walipokuwa wakienda shambani akiwa katika sura nyingine.

english: And they went back and reported it to the rest, but they did not believe them either. The Great Commission (Matthew 28:16–20)
ekegusii: Nabarabwo bakagenda bagateebia abande amang’ana aria, korende abwo tibabegena.
swahili: Nao wakarudi na kuwaambia wenzao. Lakini hawakuwasadiki wao pia. Yesu Awaagiza Wale Wanafunzi Kumi Na Mmoja (Mathayo 28:16-20; Luka 24:36-49; Yohana 20:19-23; Matendo 1:6-8)

english: Later, as they were eating, Jesus appeared to the Eleven and rebuked them for their unbelief and hardness of heart, because they did not believe those who had seen Him after He had risen.
ekegusii: Naende akaorokera baria ikomi nomo, ekero barenge koragera; akabatogonyera ase ogotegena kwabo na obokong’u bw’emioyo yabo, ekiagera bategenete abamorooche kabokire.
swahili: Baadaye Yesu akawatokea wale wanafunzi kumi na mmoja walipokuwa wakila chakula. Akawakemea kwa kutoamini kwao na kwa ugumu wa mioyo yao kwa kutosadiki wale waliomwona baada yake kufufuka.

english: And He said to them, “Go into all the world and preach the gospel to every creature.
ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Genda ase ense yonsi, morandie enchiri ase kera egetongwa.
swahili: Akawaambia, “Enendeni ulimwenguni kote, mkaihubiri Injili kwa kila kiumbe.

english: Whoever believes and is baptized will be saved, but whoever does not believe will be condemned.
ekegusii: Oyoregene na kobatiswa, natooreke, ko oyotegeneti, nagambigwe.
swahili: Yeyote aaminiye na kubatizwa ataokoka. Lakini yeyote asiyeamini atahukumiwa.

english: And these signs will accompany those who believe: In My name they will drive out demons; they will speak in new tongues;
ekegusii: Na ebimanyererio ebi bie chinguru nabibatunyane abwo begenire: Ase erieta riane nabaserie ebirecha, nabakwane ase emenwa emeyia,
swahili: Nazo ishara hizi zitafuatana na wanaoamini: Kwa Jina langu watatoa pepo wachafu; watasema kwa lugha mpya;

english: they will pick up snakes with their hands, and if they drink any deadly poison, it will not harm them; they will lay their hands on the sick, and they will be made well.” The Ascension (Luke 24:50–53; Acts 1:6–11)
ekegusii: nababwata ching’iti, gose nabanywa egento kegoita, ko tigekobaita nonya ng’ake; nababeeke amaboko abo igoro ase abarwaire, na barabwo nabagwene.” Yeso okogenda igoro (Luk 24:50-53)
swahili: watashika nyoka kwa mikono yao; na hata wakinywa kitu chochote cha kuua, hakitawadhuru kamwe; wataweka mikono yao juu ya wagonjwa, nao watapona.” [Yesu Apaa Kwenda Mbinguni (Luka 24:50-53; Matendo 1:9-11)

english: After the Lord Jesus had spoken to them, He was taken up into heaven and sat down at the right hand of God.
ekegusii: Nabo Omonene Yeso, gakwanire nabarabwo, akabogorigwa gochia igoro, agaikaransa ensemo y’okoboko gw’okorio kwa Nyasae.
swahili: Baada ya Bwana Yesu kusema nao, alichukuliwa juu mbinguni na kuketi mkono wa kuume wa Mungu.

english: Very early on the first day of the week, just after sunrise, they went to the tomb.
ekegusii: Goika mambia chuni, rituko rie ritang’ani ri’echuma, bakagenda ase oboina, erioba korikooroka.
swahili: Asubuhi na mapema, siku ya kwanza ya juma, mara tu baada ya kuchomoza jua, walikwenda kaburini.

english: And they went out and preached everywhere, and the Lord worked through them, confirming His word by the signs that accompanied it.
ekegusii: Na barabwo bakaimoka, bakarandia chinsemo chionsi. Omonene akaba ogokora emeremo amo nabarabwo, na goikerania ring’ana ase ebimanyererio bie chinguru ebiabatuny’anete. Amina.
swahili: Kisha wanafunzi wake wakatoka, wakahubiri kila mahali, naye Bwana akatenda kazi pamoja nao na kulithibitisha neno lake kwa ishara zilizofuatana nalo.]

english: They were asking one another, “Who will roll away the stone from the entrance of the tomb?”
ekegusii: Bagateebania barabwo ase barabwo, “Ning’o oranyare gototigereria rigena riria korwa ase egesieri ki’oboina?”
swahili: Njiani wakawa wanaulizana wao kwa wao, “Ni nani atakayetuvingirishia lile jiwe kutoka kwenye ingilio la kaburi?”

english: But when they looked up, they saw that the stone had been rolled away, even though it was extremely large.
ekegusii: Goika bagachia korigereria bakarora ng’a rigena riria riatigerigwe, na rirorio nigo riarenge rinene mono.
swahili: Lakini walipotazama, wakaona lile jiwe, ambalo lilikuwa kubwa sana, limekwisha kuvingirishwa kutoka pale penye ingilio la kaburi.

english: When they entered the tomb, they saw a young man dressed in a white robe sitting on the right side, and they were alarmed.
ekegusii: Bagasoa oboina ime, bakarora omomura oikaransete ensemo y’okorio, bweboyetie eanga endabu, bakegosa.
swahili: Walipokuwa wakiingia mle kaburini, wakamwona kijana mmoja aliyevaa joho jeupe akiwa ameketi upande wa kuume, nao wakastaajabu.

english: But he said to them, “Do not be alarmed. You are looking for Jesus the Nazarene, who was crucified. He has risen! He is not here! See the place where they put Him.
ekegusii: Ere akabateebia, “Timoichana; Yeso Omonazareti mokorigia, oria obambetwe. Ere obookire, tari aiga. Rigereria aase bamobegete!
swahili: Yule malaika akawaambia, “Msistaajabu. Mnamtafuta Yesu, Mnazareti, aliyesulubiwa. Amefufuka! Hayuko hapa. Tazameni mahali walipomlaza.

english: But go, tell His disciples and Peter, ‘He is going ahead of you into Galilee. There you will see Him, just as He told you.’”
ekegusii: Korende genda, moteebie aborokigwa baye, na Petero, ng’a obatang’aneire kogenda Galili. Agwo nao moramorore, buna abateebeetie.”
swahili: Lakini nendeni mkawaambie wanafunzi wake pamoja na Petro, kwamba, ‘Anawatangulia kwenda Galilaya. Huko ndiko mtamwona, kama alivyowaambia.’ ”

english: So the women left the tomb and ran away, trembling and bewildered. And in their fear they did not say a word to anyone. Jesus Appears to Mary Magdalene (John 20:10–18)
ekegusii: Bakarua agwo, bagatama korwa ase oboina, ekiagera basoetwe nekeondoko na ogokumia. Tibateebetie monto ing’ana, ekiagera bairogete. Yeso okororekana kabookire (Yoh 20:11-18; Luk 24:13-35; Mat 28:16-20; Luk 24:36-49; Yoh 20:19-23)
swahili: Hivyo wakatoka, wakakimbia kutoka mle kaburini wakiwa na hofu kuu na mshangao. Nao hawakumwambia mtu yeyote neno lolote, kwa sababu waliogopa. Yesu Anamtokea Maria Magdalene (Mathayo 28:9-10; Yohana 20:11-18)

english: Early on the first day of the week, after Jesus had risen, He appeared first to Mary Magdalene, from whom He had driven out seven demons.
ekegusii: Yeso ekero abookire, mambia rituko rie ritang’ani ri’echuma akaorokera ritang’ani Mariamu Magidalena, ere oria arusetie ebirecha bitano na bibere.
swahili: Yesu alipofufuka alfajiri na mapema siku ya kwanza ya juma alimtokea kwanza Maria Magdalene, yule ambaye alikuwa amemtoa pepo wachafu saba.

english: This is the beginning of the gospel of Jesus Christ, the Son of God.
ekegusii: Eye nero enchiri igoro ya Yeso Kristo, Omwana o Nyasae,
swahili: Mwanzo wa Injili ya Yesu Kristo, Mwana wa Mungu.

english: As soon as Jesus came up out of the water, He saw the heavens breaking open and the Spirit descending on Him like a dove.
ekegusii: Erio kegima, Yeso kagotiira korwa ase amaache, akarora igoro amaanokire, na Omoika buna riruma ogoika igoro asare,
swahili: Yesu alipokuwa akitoka ndani ya maji, aliona mbingu zikifunguka na Roho akishuka juu yake kama hua.

english: And a voice came from heaven: “You are My beloved Son; in You I am well pleased.” The Temptation and Preaching of Jesus (Matthew 4:1–17; Luke 4:1–15)
ekegusii: na eriogi rikarwa igoro, rigateeba, “Aye naye Omwana one omwanchwa, ngokirie naye.” Ogoteemwa kwa Yeso (Mat 4:1-11; Luk 4:1-13)
swahili: Nayo sauti kutoka mbinguni ikasema, “Wewe ni Mwanangu mpendwa; nami nimependezwa nawe sana.” Majaribu Ya Yesu (Mathayo 4:1-11; Luka 4:1-13)

english: At once the Spirit drove Jesus into the wilderness,
ekegusii: Erio kegima Omoika okamoira ase erooro.
swahili: Wakati huo huo, Roho akamwongoza Yesu kwenda nyikani,

english: and He was there for forty days, being tempted by Satan. He was with the wild animals, and the angels ministered to Him.
ekegusii: Akaba ase erooro amatuko emerongo ene, ogoteemwa na Saitani; ere nigo arenge amo ne ching’iti chi’orosana; na abamalaika bakaba nkomokorera bare. Yeso okorangeria Abarubi bane (Mat 4:17; Luk 4:14-15)
swahili: naye akawa huko nyikani kwa muda wa siku arobaini, akijaribiwa na Shetani. Alikaa na wanyama wa mwituni, nao malaika wakamhudumia. Yesu Aanza Kuhubiri

english: After the arrest of John, Jesus went into Galilee and proclaimed the gospel of God.
ekegusii: Magega Yohana kabekirwe echela ime, Yeso akagenda Galili, akarandia enchiri ya Nyasae,
swahili: Baada ya Yohana kukamatwa na kutiwa gerezani, Yesu aliingia Galilaya akaanza kuhubiri habari njema ya Mungu,

english: “The time is fulfilled,” He said, “and the kingdom of God is near. Repent and believe in the gospel!” The First Disciples (Matthew 4:18–22; Luke 5:1–11; John 1:35–42)
ekegusii: okobora, “Engaki yaikeranire, na oborwoti bwa Nyasae bwaikire ang’e; onchoka na mwegene enchiri.”
swahili: akisema, “Wakati umewadia, Ufalme wa Mungu umekaribia. Tubuni na kuiamini Habari Njema.” Yesu Awaita Wanafunzi Wanne (Mathayo 4:12-22; Luka 4:14-15; 5:1-11)

english: As Jesus was walking beside the Sea of Galilee, He saw Simon and his brother Andrew. They were casting a net into the sea, for they were fishermen.
ekegusii: Ekero Yeso are goeta ensemo y’enyancha ya Galili, akarora Simioni na Anderea, momura omwabo Simioni, bakoruta ekeonga enyancha ime, ekiagera nabarubi barenge.
swahili: Yesu alipokuwa akitembea kando ya Bahari ya Galilaya, aliwaona Simoni na Andrea nduguye wakizitupa nyavu zao baharini, kwa kuwa wao walikuwa wavuvi.

english: “Come, follow Me,” Jesus said, “and I will make you fishers of men.”
ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Inchuo montunyane, na inche nimbakore mobe abarubi b’ abanto.”
swahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Njooni, nifuateni nami nitawafanya mwe wavuvi wa watu.”

english: And at once they left their nets and followed Him.
ekegusii: Erio kegima bagatiga ebionga biabo, bakamotunyana.
swahili: Mara wakaacha nyavu zao, wakamfuata.

english: Going on a little farther, He saw James son of Zebedee and his brother John. They were in a boat, mending their nets.
ekegusii: Akagenderera bosio ake, akarora Yakobo, omwana o Zebedi, na Yohana momura omwabo; barabwo nigo barenge obwato ime bakobareera ebionga biabo.
swahili: Alipokwenda mbele kidogo, akamwona Yakobo mwana wa Zebedayo na Yohana nduguye, wakiwa kwenye mashua yao wakizitengeneza nyavu zao.

english: As it is written in Isaiah the prophet: “Behold, I will send My messenger ahead of You, who will prepare Your way.”
ekegusii: nigo yachaagete buna eriikire ase egetabu y’omobani Isaya. “Nyasae agateeba,” rora, natomire omotomwa one agotang’anere, oyo oraroisie enchera yao;
swahili: Kama ilivyoandikwa katika kitabu cha nabii Isaya: “Tazama, nitamtuma mjumbe wangu mbele yako, atakayetengeneza njia mbele yako”:

english: Immediately Jesus called them, and they left their father Zebedee in the boat with the hired men and followed Him. Jesus Expels an Unclean Spirit (Luke 4:31–37)
ekegusii: Erio kegima akabarangeria; barabwo bagatiga Zebedi ise amo n’abanto b’eng’eria ime ase obwato, bakamotunyana. Yeso okogwenia Omonto obwatire n’ekerecha agwo Kapernaumu (Luk 4:31-37)
swahili: Papo hapo akawaita, nao wakamwacha Zebedayo baba yao kwenye mashua pamoja na watumishi wa kuajiriwa, nao wakamfuata Yesu. Yesu Amtoa Pepo Mchafu (Luka 4:31-37)

english: Then Jesus and His companions went to Capernaum, and right away Jesus entered the synagogue on the Sabbath and began to teach.
ekegusii: Bakabwatia enchera goika Kapernaumu, na erio kegima ase rituko ri’Esabato Yeso agasoa ase esinagogi akorokereria.
swahili: Wakaenda mpaka Kapernaumu. Ilipofika siku ya Sabato, mara Yesu akaingia sinagogi, akaanza kufundisha.

english: The people were astonished at His teaching, because He taught as one who had authority, and not as the scribes.
ekegusii: Bagakumia ase okworokereria kwaye, ekiagera arenge koborokereria buna oyore nokobua, gose tari buna aborokia b’amariiko.
swahili: Watu wakashangaa sana kwa mafundisho yake, kwa maana aliwafundisha kama yeye aliye na mamlaka, wala si kama walimu wa sheria.

english: Suddenly a man with an unclean spirit cried out in the synagogue:
ekegusii: Erio kegima omonto obwatire nekerecha ki’eubi agacha ase esinagogi, ere agaaka eriogi,
swahili: Wakati huo huo katika sinagogi lao palikuwa na mtu aliyekuwa amepagawa na pepo mchafu,

english: “What do You want with us, Jesus of Nazareth? Have You come to destroy us? I know who You are—the Holy One of God!”
ekegusii: akabora, “Inki tore naye, Yeso o Nazareti? Inee! Nigo gwachire gotosiria? Namanyire aye ning’o, aye n’Omochenu o Nyasae.”
swahili: naye akapiga kelele akisema, “Tuna nini nawe, Yesu wa Nazareti? Je, umekuja kutuangamiza? Ninakujua wewe ni nani. Wewe ndiwe Aliye Mtakatifu wa Mungu!”

english: But Jesus rebuked the spirit. “Be silent!” He said. “Come out of him!”
ekegusii: Yeso akagetogonyera, akabora, “Karwe ase omonto oyo!”
swahili: Lakini Yesu akamkemea, akamwambia, “Nyamaza kimya! Nawe umtoke!”

english: At this, the unclean spirit threw the man into convulsions and came out with a loud shriek.
ekegusii: Ekerecha keria ki’eubi gekamogaragaria, gekarera ase eriogi rinene, gekamorwa.
swahili: Yule pepo mchafu akamtikisatikisa huyo mtu kwa nguvu, kisha akamtoka akipiga kelele kwa sauti kubwa.

english: All the people were amazed and began to ask one another, “What is this? A new teaching with authority! He commands even the unclean spirits, and they obey Him!”
ekegusii: Bagaichana bonsi, goika bakaborania, bakobora, “Inki eke? Nokworokereria okoyia! Omonto oyo nigo abwate okobua kw’ogochika nonya nebirecha bi’eubi, na birobio bikomoigwera.”
swahili: Watu wote wakashangaa, hata wakaulizana wao kwa wao, “Haya ni mambo gani? Ni mafundisho mapya, tena yenye mamlaka! Anaamuru hata pepo wachafu, nao wanamtii!”

english: And the news about Jesus spread quickly through the whole region of Galilee. Jesus Heals at Peter’s House (Matthew 8:14–17; Luke 4:38–41)
ekegusii: Erio chinkuma chiaye chigasarera ase chinsinyo chionsi chi’ense ya Galili. Yeso okogwenia abanto abange (Mat 8:14-17; Luk 4:38-41)
swahili: Sifa zake zikaanza kuenea haraka katika eneo lote la karibu na Galilaya. Yesu Amponya Mama Mkwe Wa Simoni (Mathayo 8:14-15; Luka 4:38-39)

english: As soon as Jesus and His companions had left the synagogue, they went with James and John to the home of Simon and Andrew.
ekegusii: Erio agwo kobasokire korwa ase esinagogi, bakagenda goika nyomba mwa Simioni na Anderea: Yakobo na Yohana bakagenda nere.
swahili: Mara walipotoka katika sinagogi, walikwenda pamoja na Yakobo na Yohana hadi nyumbani kwa Simoni na Andrea.

english: “A voice of one calling in the wilderness, ‘Prepare the way for the Lord, make straight paths for Him.’”
ekegusii: eriogi ri’omonto ogoaka egeturi ase erooro: Roisia enchera y’Omonene, rongeyia oboeto bwaye!
swahili: “sauti ya mtu aliaye nyikani. ‘Itengenezeni njia ya Bwana, yanyoosheni mapito yake.’ ”

english: Simon’s mother-in-law was sick in bed with a fever, and they promptly told Jesus about her.
ekegusii: Ng’ina biara Simioni nigo araire, arwarete esosera. Erio kegima Yeso gaikire bakamoteebia amang’ana igoro yaye.
swahili: Mama mkwe wa Simoni alikuwa kitandani, ana homa, nao wakamweleza Yesu habari zake.

english: So He went to her, took her by the hand, and helped her up. The fever left her, and she began to serve them.
ekegusii: Yeso agaika omong’ina oria ang’e, akamoimokia ase okomobwata okoboko. Erio esosera ekamotiga na ere akabakorera.
swahili: Hivyo Yesu akamwendea, akamshika mkono na kumwinua. Kisha homa ikamwacha, naye akaanza kuwahudumia. Yesu Aponya Wengi (Mathayo 8:16-17; Luka 4:40-41)

english: That evening, after sunset, people brought to Jesus all who were sick and demon-possessed,
ekegusii: Riachia koba mogoroba, erioba korikogwa, abanto bakarentera Yeso abarwaire bonsi, na ababwatire nebirecha.
swahili: Jioni ile baada ya jua kutua, watu wakamletea Yesu wagonjwa wote na waliopagawa na pepo wachafu.

english: and the whole town gathered at the door.
ekegusii: Na omochie bwonsi okaba ngosangererekana ore gesieri.
swahili: Mji wote ukakusanyika mbele ya nyumba hiyo.

english: And He healed many who were ill with various diseases and drove out many demons. But He would not allow the demons to speak, because they knew who He was. Jesus Prays and Preaches (Luke 4:42–44)
ekegusii: Yeso akagwenia abange abarenge namarwaire ao ao, na agaseria ebirecha ebinge; tatiga ebirecha bikwane, ekiagera biamomanyete. Yeso okorandia Galili (Luk 4:42-44)
swahili: Yesu akawaponya watu wengi waliokuwa na magonjwa ya aina mbalimbali. Akawatoa pepo wachafu wengi, lakini hakuwaacha hao pepo wachafu waseme, kwa sababu walimjua yeye ni nani. Yesu Aenda Galilaya (Luka 4:42-44)

english: Early in the morning, while it was still dark, Jesus got up and slipped out to a solitary place to pray.
ekegusii: Mambia, botarakiamoka, akaimoka, agasooka, akagenda aase atari nabaanto, agasabera aroro.
swahili: Alfajiri na mapema sana kulipokuwa bado kuna giza, Yesu akaamka, akaondoka, akaenda mahali pa faragha ili kuomba.

english: Simon and his companions went to look for Him,
ekegusii: Simioni na abarenge amo nere bakamotunyana,
swahili: Simoni na wenzake wakaenda kumtafuta,

english: and when they found Him, they said, “Everyone is looking for You!”
ekegusii: ekero bamonyorete, bakamoteebia, “Abanto bonsi ngokorigia bare.”
swahili: nao walipomwona, wakamwambia, “Kila mtu anakutafuta!”

english: But Jesus answered, “Let us go on to the neighboring towns so I can preach there as well, for that is why I have come.”
ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Togende aase aande goika ebinyoro bire ang’e, ninyare korandia na aroro boigo, ekiagera ase ayio naro nachicheire.”
swahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Twendeni mahali pengine kwenye vijiji jirani, ili niweze kuhubiri huko pia, kwa sababu hicho ndicho nilichokuja kukifanya.”

english: So He went throughout Galilee, preaching in their synagogues and driving out demons. The Leper’s Prayer (Leviticus 14:1–32; Matthew 8:1–4; Luke 5:12–16)
ekegusii: Agasoa ase chisinagogi chiabo ase ense yonsi ya Galili, okorandia na goseria ebirecha. Yeso okogwenia omonto orenge noborwaire bwa ukoma (Mat 8:1-4; Luk 5:12-16)
swahili: Kwa hiyo akazunguka Galilaya kote, akihubiri katika masinagogi yao na kutoa pepo wachafu. Yesu Amtakasa Mwenye Ukoma (Mathayo 8:1-4; Luka 5:12-16)

english: John the Baptist appeared in the wilderness, preaching a baptism of repentance for the forgiveness of sins.
ekegusii: Erio Yohana Omobatisi akaoroka ase erooro, okorandia, okobateebia, “Onchoka, mobatiswe, monyore okwaberwa kw’ebibe.”
swahili: Yohana alikuja, akibatiza huko nyikani, akihubiri ubatizo wa toba kwa ajili ya msamaha wa dhambi.

english: Then a leper came to Jesus, begging on his knees: “If You are willing, You can make me clean.”
ekegusii: Omonto oyomo orenge noborwaire bwa ukoma agacha asare, akamosorora na komotung’amera, akamoteebia, “Onye ngwancha, nonyare gonsibia.”
swahili: Mtu mmoja mwenye ukoma alimjia Yesu, akamwomba akipiga magoti, akamwambia, “Ukitaka, waweza kunitakasa.”

english: Moved with compassion, Jesus reached out His hand and touched the man. “I am willing,” He said. “Be clean!”
ekegusii: Yeso akamororera amaabera, akarambora okoboko kwaye, akamokuna, akamoteebia, “Nanchire; sibeka.”
swahili: Yesu, akiwa amejawa na huruma, akanyoosha mkono wake akamgusa, akamwambia, “Nataka. Takasika!”

english: And immediately the leprosy left him, and the man was cleansed.
ekegusii: Erio agwo oborwaire bwaye bwa ukoma bokamotiga, agasibeka.
swahili: Mara ukoma ukamtoka, naye akatakasika.

english: Jesus promptly sent him away with a stern warning:
ekegusii: Akamotianera bokong’u, kamosokirie agende,
swahili: Baada ya Yesu kumwonya vikali, akamruhusu aende zake

english: “See that you don’t tell anyone. But go, show yourself to the priest and present the offering Moses prescribed for your cleansing, as a testimony to them.”
ekegusii: akamoteebia, “Rigereria, toteebia monto onde bwensi amang’ana aya; korende genda bweorokie ase Omokuani, orue ekeng’wanso egiachigetwe na Musa ase ogosibeka kwao, erinde kebe kirori ase abanto.”
swahili: akimwambia, “Hakikisha humwambii mtu yeyote habari hizi, bali nenda ukajionyeshe kwa kuhani, na ukatoe sadaka alizoagiza Mose kwa utakaso wako, ili kuwa ushuhuda kwao.”

english: But the man went out and openly began to proclaim and spread the news. Consequently, Jesus could no longer enter a town in plain view, but He stayed out in solitary places. Yet people came to Him from every quarter.
ekegusii: Korende agasoka, agachaaka koraria amang’ana aya na gosareria ring’ana riria, goika Yeso tanyara naende gosoa ase omochie ime maiso marore, korende akabeera isiko aase atari nabaanto; na abanto bakamochiera korwa kera aase.
swahili: Lakini yule mtu akaenda akaanza kutangaza habari za kuponywa kwake waziwazi. Kwa hiyo, Yesu hakuweza tena kuingia katika miji waziwazi lakini alikaa sehemu zisizo na watu. Hata hivyo watu wakamfuata huko kutoka kila upande.

english: People went out to him from all of Jerusalem and the countryside of Judea. Confessing their sins, they were baptized by him in the Jordan River.
ekegusii: Abanto b’ense yonsi ya Boyahudi, na bonsi aba Yerusalemu bakamochiera, bakabatiswa nere ase orooche rwa Yorodani, bakoorokia ebibe biabo.
swahili: Watu kutoka Uyahudi wote na sehemu zote za Yerusalemu walikuwa wakimwendea. Nao wakaziungama dhambi zao, akawabatiza katika Mto Yordani.

english: John was clothed in camel’s hair, with a leather belt around his waist. His food was locusts and wild honey.
ekegusii: Na Yohana nigo arenge kobeeka chianga chi’amarionya y’engamia, na kweboeria orokini rwe riiyo kenema kiaye. Nigo arenge koria chingige n’obooke bw’orosana.
swahili: Yohana alivaa mavazi yaliyotengenezwa kwa singa za ngamia na mkanda wa ngozi kiunoni mwake. Chakula chake kilikuwa nzige na asali ya mwitu.

english: And he began to proclaim: “After me will come One more powerful than I, the straps of whose sandals I am not worthy to stoop down and untie.
ekegusii: Akarandia, okobora, “Nache korwa magega y’ane oyore ne chinguru kombua, oyio inche ntaisaini gotung’ama na gosibora chiusi chi’ebikoroto biaye.
swahili: Naye alihubiri akisema, “Baada yangu atakuja yeye aliye na uwezo kuniliko mimi, ambaye sistahili hata kuinama na kulegeza kamba za viatu vyake.

english: I baptize you with water, but He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit. ”
ekegusii: Inche nigo nkobaabatisa ase amaache, korende ere nabaabatise ase Omoika Omochenu.” Okobatiswa kwa Yeso (Mat 3:13-17; Luk 3:21-22)
swahili: Mimi nawabatiza kwa maji, lakini yeye atawabatiza kwa Roho Mtakatifu.” Ubatizo Wa Yesu (Mathayo 3:13-17; Luka 3:21-22)

english: In those days Jesus came from Nazareth in Galilee and was baptized by John in the Jordan.
ekegusii: Ase amatuko aria Yeso agacha korwa Nazareti ya Galili, akabatiswa na Yohana ase orooche rwa Yorodani.
swahili: Wakati huo Yesu akaja kutoka Nazareti ya Galilaya, naye akabatizwa na Yohana katika Mto Yordani.

english: A few days later Jesus went back to Capernaum. And when the people heard that He was home,
ekegusii: Magega y’amatuko amake Yeso akairana gochia Kapernaumu, abanto bakanyora amang’ana ng’a nao are nyomba.
swahili: Baada ya siku kadhaa Yesu alirudi Kapernaumu, watu wakasikia kwamba amerudi nyumbani.

english: But so that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins...” He said to the paralytic,
ekegusii: Korende monyare komanya ng’a Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto nare nokobua ase ense gw’okwabera ebibe.” Erio agwo agateebia oria orenge rigata,
swahili: Lakini ili mpate kujua ya kwamba Mwana wa Adamu anayo mamlaka duniani kusamehe dhambi…” Yesu akamwambia yule aliyepooza,

english: “I tell you, get up, pick up your mat, and go home.”
ekegusii: “Nagotebirie, imoka, bwetweke oborere bwao, ogende bwoo.”
swahili: “Nakuambia, inuka, chukua mkeka wako, uende nyumbani kwako.”

english: And immediately the man got up, picked up his mat, and walked out in front of them all. As a result, they were all astounded and glorified God, saying, “We have never seen anything like this!” Jesus Calls Levi (Matthew 9:9–13; Luke 5:27–32)
ekegusii: Erio kegima akaimoka, agetweka oborere bwaye, akarua ase amasio abo bonsi; goika bagakumia bonsi, bagatogia Nyasae, bakoboora, “Ayare buna aya, titwana koyarora rinde nonya ng’ake!” Yeso okorangeria Lawi (Mat 9:9-13; Luk 5:27-32)
swahili: Yule mtu aliyekuwa amepooza akasimama, akachukua mkeka wake, akatembea machoni pao wote! Jambo hili likawashangaza wote, wakamtukuza Mungu, wakisema, “Hatujapata kuona jambo kama hili kamwe!” Yesu Amwita Lawi (Mathayo 9:9-13; Luka 5:27-32)

english: Once again Jesus went out beside the sea. All the people came to Him, and He taught them there.
ekegusii: Yeso naende akairana gochia ensemo y’enyancha. Omoganda bwonsi okamochiera, ere agachaaka koborokereria.
swahili: Yesu akaenda tena kandokando ya Bahari ya Galilaya. Umati mkubwa wa watu ukamfuata, naye akaanza kuwafundisha.

english: As He was walking along, He saw Levi son of Alphaeus sitting at the tax booth. “Follow Me,” He told him, and Levi got up and followed Him.
ekegusii: Ekero achia goeta, akarora Lawi, omwana bw’Alufayo, oikaransete aase bakoruseria ebango, akamoteebia, “Ntunyana!” Akaimoka, akamotunyana.
swahili: Alipokuwa akitembea, akamwona Lawi mwana wa Alfayo ameketi forodhani mahali pa kutoza ushuru, akamwambia, “Nifuate.” Lawi akaondoka, akamfuata Yesu.

english: While Jesus was dining at Levi’s house, many tax collectors and sinners were eating with Him and His disciples—for there were many who followed Him.
ekegusii: Ekaba ekero Yeso aikaransete nyomba mw’omonto oria, okoria endagera, abarusia ebango abange na abanyene ebibe bagaikaransa amo na Yeso na aborokigwa baye; inaki barenge abange bamotuny’anete.
swahili: Yesu alipokuwa akila chakula nyumbani mwa Lawi, watoza ushuru wengi pamoja na “wenye dhambi” walikuwa wakila pamoja naye na wanafunzi wake, kwa maana kulikuwa na watu wengi waliokuwa wakimfuata.

english: When the scribes who were Pharisees saw Jesus eating with these people, they asked His disciples, “Why does He eat with tax collectors and sinners?”
ekegusii: Aborokia b’amariiko na Abafarisai bagachia komoorora okoria amo n’abanyene ebibe na abarusia ebango, bagateebia aborokigwa baye, “Nase ki akoria na konywa amo nabarusia ebango na abanyene ebibe?”
swahili: Baadhi ya walimu wa sheria waliokuwa Mafarisayo walipomwona akila pamoja na watoza ushuru na “wenye dhambi,” wakawauliza wanafunzi wake: “Mbona Yesu anakula pamoja na watoza ushuru na ‘wenye dhambi’?”

english: On hearing this, Jesus told them, “It is not the healthy who need a doctor, but the sick. I have not come to call the righteous, but sinners.” Questions about Fasting (Matthew 9:14–15; Luke 5:33–35)
ekegusii: Yeso agachia koigwa aya, akabateebia, “Abare buya tibari korigia omogwenia, otatiga abarwarete; tincheti korangeria abanyaboronge, korende abanyene ebibe.” Riborio igoro y’okweng’ata (Mat 9:14-17; Luk 5:33-39)
swahili: Yesu aliposikia haya akawaambia, “Watu wenye afya hawahitaji tabibu, bali walio wagonjwa. Sikuja kuwaita wenye haki, bali wenye dhambi.” Yesu Aulizwa Kuhusu Kufunga (Mathayo 9:14-17; Luka 5:33-39)

english: Now John’s disciples and the Pharisees were often fasting. So people came to Jesus and asked, “Why don’t Your disciples fast like John’s disciples and those of the Pharisees?”
ekegusii: Aborokigwa ba Yohana na Abafarisai nigo barenge kweng’ata. Abanto bande bagaacha, bakamobooria, “Nase ki aborokigwa ba Yohana na aborokigwa b’Abafarisai bakweng’ata, ko aborokigwa bao tibari kweng’ata?”
swahili: Basi wanafunzi wa Yohana pamoja na Mafarisayo walikuwa wakifunga. Baadhi ya watu wakamjia Yesu na kumuuliza, “Mbona wanafunzi wa Yohana na wa Mafarisayo hufunga lakini wanafunzi wako hawafungi?”

english: Jesus replied, “How can the guests of the bridegroom fast while He is with them? As long as He is with them, they cannot fast.
ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Inee! Abatuunyire enyangi inabanyare kweng’ata ekero omonywomi are amo nabarabwo? Ekero omonywomi are amo na barabwo, tibakonyara kweng’ata.
swahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Wageni wa bwana arusi wawezaje kufunga wakati angali pamoja nao? Wakati bwana arusi bado yuko pamoja nao, hawawezi kufunga.

english: they gathered in such large numbers that there was no more room, not even outside the door, as Jesus spoke the word to them.
ekegusii: Erio abanto abange bagasangererekana amo, tiriatigara ribaga ase bare, nonya ngoika gesieri; na Yeso akaba ogokwana ring’ana ase bare.
swahili: Hivyo watu wengi wakakusanyika kiasi kwamba hapakubaki nafasi yoyote hata mlangoni! Naye akawahubiria Neno.

english: But the time will come when the bridegroom will be taken from them; then they will fast. The Patches and the Wineskins (Matthew 9:16–17; Luke 5:36–39)
ekegusii: Korende amatuko naache baraache kourwa omonywomi, erio nario baraache kweng’ata ase rituko riria.
swahili: Lakini wakati utafika ambapo bwana arusi ataondolewa kwao. Siku hiyo ndipo watakapofunga.

english: No one sews a patch of unshrunk cloth on an old garment. If he does, the new piece will pull away from the old, and a worse tear will result.
ekegusii: Gose tari monto onde okobareera ekeraka ki’egetambaa ekeyia ase eanga engotu ekiagera keria kiabekwa nigo kegotandora eanga eria, keria ekeyia kiagendereria eanga eria engotu etandoke kobua.
swahili: “Hakuna mtu ashoneaye kiraka cha nguo mpya kwenye nguo iliyochakaa. Akifanya hivyo, kile kiraka kipya kitachanika kutoka ile nguo iliyochakaa, nayo itachanika zaidi.

english: And no one pours new wine into old wineskins. If he does, the wine will burst the skins, and both the wine and the wineskins will be ruined. Instead, new wine is poured into new wineskins.” The Lord of the Sabbath (1 Samuel 21:1–7; Matthew 12:1–8; Luke 6:1–5)
ekegusii: Gose onde tari okobeeka edivai enyia ase ebirandi ebigotu biroisirie korwa ase amasankwa, gose edivai eria nebiate ebirandi, edivai eiteke, na ebirandi bitandoke; korende edivai enyia nigo ekobekwa ase ebirandi ebiyia.” Riborio igoro y’okorenda Esabato (Mat 12:1-8; Luk 6:1-5)
swahili: Wala hakuna mtu awekaye divai mpya kwenye viriba vikuukuu. Akifanya hivyo, ile divai mpya itavipasua hivyo viriba, nayo hiyo divai itamwagika na viriba vitaharibika. Lakini divai mpya huwekwa kwenye viriba vipya.” Bwana Wa Sabato (Mathayo 12:1-8; Luka 6:1-5)

english: One Sabbath Jesus was passing through the grainfields, and His disciples began to pick the heads of grain as they walked along.
ekegusii: Yeso agachia koba ngoeta arenge ase emegondo y’engano ase rituko ri’Esabato; aborokigwa baye bagachaaka kobutora ebigara kobakogenda.
swahili: Siku moja ya Sabato, Yesu pamoja na wanafunzi wake walikuwa wakipita katikati ya mashamba ya nafaka. Walipokuwa wakitembea, wanafunzi wake wakaanza kuvunja masuke.

english: So the Pharisees said to Him, “Look, why are they doing what is unlawful on the Sabbath?”
ekegusii: Abafarisai bakamoboria, “Rora, naki bagokora eritari boronge gokorwa ase rituko ri’Esabato?”
swahili: Mafarisayo wakamwambia, “Tazama, mbona wanafanya jambo lisilo halali kufanywa siku ya Sabato?”

english: Jesus replied, “Have you never read what David did when he and his companions were hungry and in need?
ekegusii: Akabairaneria, “Timwana gosoma aya Daudi akorete ekero aremeretwe endagera, akaba nenchara, ere na abwo barenge amo nere,
swahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Je, hamjasoma kamwe alivyofanya Daudi wakati yeye na wenzake walikuwa na njaa, wakahitaji chakula?

english: During the high priesthood of Abiathar, he entered the house of God and ate the consecrated bread, which was lawful only for the priests. And he gave some to his companions as well.”
ekegusii: buna asoete ase enyomba ya Nyasae, ekero Abiatari arenge Omokuani omonene, akaria emegati yarenge korugwa ase Nyasae, etare boronge koriegwa nonde otatiga abakuani, naende akaa abarenge amo nere?”
swahili: Daudi aliingia katika nyumba ya Mungu, wakati Abiathari alikuwa kuhani mkuu, akaila ile mikate iliyowekwa wakfu, ambayo ni halali kuliwa na makuhani peke yao. Naye pia akawapa wenzake.”

english: Then Jesus declared, “The Sabbath was made for man, not man for the Sabbath.
ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Esabato nigo yakoretwe ase engencho ya Mwanyabaanto, tari Mwanyabaanto ase engencho y’Esabato;
swahili: Kisha Yesu akawaambia, “Sabato ilifanyika kwa ajili ya mwanadamu, lakini si mwanadamu kwa ajili ya Sabato.

english: Therefore, the Son of Man is Lord even of the Sabbath.”
ekegusii: naki Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto nere omonene bw’Esabato.”
swahili: Hivyo, Mwana wa Adamu ndiye Bwana wa Sabato.”

english: Then a paralytic was brought to Him, carried by four men.
ekegusii: Abanto bagaacha; bakamorentera omonto orenge rigata obogoirie nabaanto bane.
swahili: Ndipo baadhi ya watu wakaja wakamletea Yesu mtu aliyepooza, akiwa amebebwa na watu wanne.

english: Since they were unable to get to Jesus through the crowd, they uncovered the roof above Him, made an opening, and lowered the paralytic on his mat.
ekegusii: Ekiagera batanyarete komoikia ang’e ase engencho y’omoganda, bakabochora ekerama aase aaria Yeso arenge. Kobakoorire kogetagora, bagaikia oborere boria oria orenge rigata araire.
swahili: Kwa kuwa walikuwa hawawezi kumfikisha kwa Yesu kwa ajili ya umati wa watu, walitoboa tundu kwenye paa mahali pale alipokuwa Yesu, wakamshusha yule aliyepooza kwa kitanda alichokuwa amelalia.

english: When Jesus saw their faith, He said to the paralytic, “Son, your sins are forgiven.”
ekegusii: Yeso agachia korora okwegena kwabo agateebia oria orenge rigata, “Omwana one, ebibe biao biabeirwe.”
swahili: Yesu alipoiona imani yao, alimwambia yule mtu aliyepooza, “Mwanangu, dhambi zako zimesamehewa.”

english: But some of the scribes were sitting there and thinking in their hearts,
ekegusii: Abande ase aborokia b’amariiko baikaransete aroro, bakeboria ase chinkoro chiabo,
swahili: Basi baadhi ya walimu wa sheria waliokuwa wameketi huko wakawaza mioyoni mwao,

english: “Why does this man speak like this? He is blaspheming! Who can forgive sins but God alone?”
ekegusii: “Inaki oyo agoteeba iga? Nkorama are! Ning’o oranyare kwabera ebibe, otatiga oyomo, nere Nyasae?”
swahili: “Kwa nini mtu huyu anasema hivi? Huyu anakufuru! Ni nani awezaye kusamehe dhambi isipokuwa Mungu peke yake?”

english: At once Jesus knew in His spirit that they were thinking this way within themselves. “Why are you thinking these things in your hearts?” He asked.
ekegusii: Erio Yeso namanyete ase omoika oye ime buna baare korengereria ase chinkoro chiabo, akabateebia, “Inaki mokorengereria iga ase chinkoro chiaino?
swahili: Mara moja Yesu akatambua rohoni mwake kile walichokuwa wanawaza mioyoni mwao, naye akawaambia, “Kwa nini mnawaza hivyo mioyoni mwenu?

english: “Which is easier: to say to a paralytic, ‘Your sins are forgiven,’ or to say, ‘Get up, pick up your mat, and walk’?
ekegusii: Ndiriri rire eriango, goteebia oyore rigata: Ebibe biao biabeirwe, gose goteeba: Imoka, bwetweke oborere bwao, ogende?
swahili: Je, ni lipi lililo rahisi zaidi: kumwambia huyu aliyepooza, ‘Umesamehewa dhambi zako,’ au kusema, ‘Inuka, uchukue mkeka wako, uende’?

english: Once again Jesus entered the synagogue, and a man with a withered hand was there.
ekegusii: Yeso agasoa naende ase esinagogi. Agwo narengeo omonto, okoboko kwaye kwagataete.
swahili: Yesu akaingia tena ndani ya sinagogi, na huko palikuwa na mtu aliyepooza mkono.

english: For He had healed so many that all who had diseases were pressing forward to touch Him.
ekegusii: Ekiagera agwenetie abanto, bonsi abarenge nemechando bakamosongerera, banyare komokuna.
swahili: Kwa kuwa alikuwa amewaponya wagonjwa wengi, wale wenye magonjwa walikuwa wanasukumana ili wapate kumgusa.

english: And when the unclean spirits saw Him, they fell down before Him and cried out, “You are the Son of God!”
ekegusii: Na abanto barenge n’ebirecha bi’eubi bagachia komoorora, bakagwa ase obosio bwaye, bakarera bagateeba, “Aye naye Omwana o Nyasae.”
swahili: Kila mara pepo wachafu walipomwona, walianguka chini mbele yake na kupiga kelele wakisema, “Wewe ndiwe Mwana wa Mungu.”

english: But He warned them sternly not to make Him known. The Twelve Apostles (Matthew 10:1–4; Luke 6:12–16)
ekegusii: Akabitianera mono tibimoorokia. Yeso ogochora abatomwa ikomi na babere (Mat 10:1-4; Luk 6:12-16)
swahili: Lakini aliwaonya wasimseme yeye ni nani. Yesu Achagua Mitume Kumi Na Wawili (Mathayo 10:1-4; Luka 6:12-16)

english: Then Jesus went up on the mountain and called for those He wanted, and they came to Him.
ekegusii: Erio Yeso agatiira gochia egetunwa igoro, akarangeria abwo arigetie ere omonyene; na barabwo bakamochiera.
swahili: Yesu akapanda mlimani na kuwaita wale aliowataka, nao wakamjia.

english: He appointed twelve of them, whom He designated as apostles, to accompany Him, to be sent out to preach,
ekegusii: Agachoora ikomi na babere, abwo arogete abatomwa erio banyare koba amo nere, erinde abatome bagende korandia,
swahili: Akawachagua kumi na wawili, ambao aliwaita mitume, ili wapate kuwa pamoja naye, na awatume kwenda kuhubiri

english: and to have authority to drive out demons.
ekegusii: na babe nokobua kw’ogoseria ebirecha.
swahili: na kuwa na mamlaka ya kutoa pepo wachafu.

english: These are the twelve He appointed: Simon (whom He named Peter),
ekegusii: Baria ikomi na babere achoorete nabwo aba: Simioni nere arogete erieta rinde Petero,
swahili: Hawa ndio wale kumi na wawili aliowachagua: Simoni (ambaye alimwita Petro);

english: James son of Zebedee and his brother John (whom He named Boanerges, meaning “Sons of Thunder”),
ekegusii: na Yakobo, omwana o Zebedi, na Yohana, momura omwabo Yakobo, akabaroka erieta Boanergi, engencho yaye: Abana b’enkoba;
swahili: Yakobo mwana wa Zebedayo, na Yohana nduguye (ambao aliwaita Boanerge, maana yake Wana wa Ngurumo);

english: Andrew, Philip, Bartholomew, Matthew, Thomas, James son of Alphaeus, Thaddaeus, Simon the Zealot,
ekegusii: Anderea na Filipo, na Baritholomayo, na Matayo, na Thomas, na Yakobo bw’Alufayo, na Tadayo, na Simioni, oyomo bw’Abazelote,
swahili: Andrea, Filipo, Bartholomayo, Mathayo, Tomaso, Yakobo mwana wa Alfayo, Thadayo, Simoni Mkananayo,

english: and Judas Iscariot, who betrayed Jesus. A House Divided (Matthew 12:22–30; Luke 11:14–23)
ekegusii: na Yudasi Iskariota, nere oyomoruete. Yeso na Beelizebuli (Mat 12:22-37; Luk 11:14-23; 12:10) Erio agasoa nyomba.
swahili: na Yuda Iskariote aliyemsaliti Yesu. Yesu Na Beelzebuli (Mathayo 12:22-32; Luka 11:14-23; 12:10)

english: In order to accuse Jesus, they were watching to see if He would heal on the Sabbath.
ekegusii: Agwo mbarenge oo abanto gete abwo baganetie gotega Yeso barore gose nagwenie omonto oria ase rituko ri’Esabato, banyare komosoera.
swahili: Wakawa wanamwangalia waone kama atamponya siku ya Sabato, ili wapate sababu ya kumshtaki.

english: Then Jesus went home, and once again a crowd gathered, so that He and His disciples could not even eat.
ekegusii: Na omoganda ogasangerereka naende; barabwo abanyene tibanyara nonya nokoria.
swahili: Kisha Yesu aliporudi nyumbani, umati wa watu ukakusanyika tena, kiasi kwamba yeye na wanafunzi wake hawakuweza kula chakula.

english: When His family heard about this, they went out to take custody of Him, saying, “He is out of His mind.”
ekegusii: Abaamate baye bagachia koigwa amang’ana aya, bagasoka kogenda komobwata, ekiagera bateebete, “Obakirwe n’eosi.”
swahili: Ndugu zake walipopata habari wakaja ili kumchukua kwa maana watu walikuwa wakisema, “Amerukwa na akili.”

english: And the scribes who had come down from Jerusalem were saying, “He is possessed by Beelzebul, ” and, “By the prince of the demons He drives out demons.”
ekegusii: Na aborokia b’amariiko, abarwete Yerusalemu, bakaboora, “Nabwatire na Beelizebuli, naende agoseria ebirecha ase okobua kw’omonene bw’ebirecha.”
swahili: Walimu wa sheria walioteremka kutoka Yerusalemu walisema, “Amepagawa na Beelzebuli! Anatoa pepo wachafu kwa kutumia mkuu wa pepo wachafu!”

english: So Jesus called them together and began to speak to them in parables: “How can Satan drive out Satan?
ekegusii: Erio Yeso akabarangeria bache asare, akabateebia ase emebayeeno, “Inaki Saitani aranyare goseria Saitani?
swahili: Basi Yesu akawaita na kuzungumza nao kwa mifano akasema: “Shetani awezaje kumtoa Shetani?

english: If a kingdom is divided against itself, it cannot stand.
ekegusii: Na oborwoti kaboraatananeke ase borobwo obonyene, oborwoti boria tibokonyara gotenena.
swahili: Kama ufalme ukigawanyika dhidi yake wenyewe, ufalme huo hauwezi kusimama.

english: If a house is divided against itself, it cannot stand.
ekegusii: Na enyomba keraatananeke enyene, enyomba eria tekonyara gotenena.
swahili: Nayo nyumba kama ikigawanyika dhidi yake yenyewe, nyumba hiyo haiwezi kusimama.

english: And if Satan is divided and rises against himself, he cannot stand; his end has come.
ekegusii: Na onye Saitani bweimokeire ere omonyene, na gweatanana, takonyara gotenena, korende nabe nomoerio.
swahili: Naye Shetani kama akijipinga mwenyewe na awe amegawanyika, hawezi kusimama bali mwisho wake umewadia.

english: Indeed, no one can enter a strong man’s house to steal his possessions unless he first ties up the strong man. Then he can plunder his house. The Unpardonable Sin (Matthew 12:31–32)
ekegusii: Omonto takonyara gosoa ase enyomba y’omonto omonyene chinguru na gosakora ebinto biaye, atamosibeti ritang’ani oria omonyene chinguru; nario aranyare gosakora enyomba yaye.
swahili: Hakuna mtu yeyote awezaye kuingia kwenye nyumba ya mtu mwenye nguvu na kuteka nyara mali zake asipomfunga kwanza yule mwenye nguvu. Ndipo ataweza kuteka nyara mali zake.

english: Truly I tell you, the sons of men will be forgiven all sins and blasphemies, as many as they utter.
ekegusii: “Ekeene nabateebirie: Ebibe bionsi Mwanyabaanto nabaaberwe, na okorama gwonsi bararame,
swahili: Amin, nawaambia, dhambi zote na makufuru yote ya wanadamu watasamehewa.

english: But whoever blasphemes against the Holy Spirit will never be forgiven; he is guilty of eternal sin.”
ekegusii: korende monto onde bwensi orarame Omoika Omochenu takwaberwa nonya ng’ake, korende nigo arabe nebibe goika kare na kare.”
swahili: Lakini yeyote anayemkufuru Roho Mtakatifu hatasamehewa kamwe, atakuwa na hatia ya dhambi ya milele.”

english: Then Jesus said to the man with the withered hand, “Stand up among us.”
ekegusii: Agateebia omonto oria okoboko kwaye kwagataete, “Tenena gati aa!”
swahili: Yesu akamwambia yule mwenye mkono uliopooza, “Njoo hapa mbele ya watu wote.”

english: Jesus made this statement because they were saying, “He has an unclean spirit.” Jesus’ Mother and Brothers (Matthew 12:46–50; Luke 8:19–21)
ekegusii: Nigo abateebetie ayio ekiagera bateebete, “Nabwatire nekerecha ki’eubi.” Ng’ina na bamura bamwabo Yeso (Mat 12:46-50; Luk 8:19-21)
swahili: Yesu alisema hivi kwa sababu walikuwa wanasema, “Ana pepo mchafu.” Mama Na Ndugu Zake Yesu (Mathayo 12:46-50; Luka 8:19-21)

english: Then Jesus’ mother and brothers came and stood outside. They sent someone in to summon Him,
ekegusii: Ng’ina na bamura bamwabo Yeso bagaacha, bagatenena isiko, bagatoma omonto komorangeria.
swahili: Kisha wakaja ndugu zake Yesu pamoja na mama yake. Wakasimama nje, wakamtuma mtu kumwita.

english: and a crowd was sitting around Him. “Look,” He was told, “Your mother and brothers are outside, asking for You.”
ekegusii: Na omoganda nigo orenge oikaransete omoetanaine, okamoteebia, “Rora nyoko na bamura bamino isiko bare, mbagotagete.”
swahili: Umati wa watu ulikuwa umeketi kumzunguka, nao wakamwambia, “Mama yako na ndugu zako wako nje, wanakutafuta.”

english: But Jesus replied, “Who are My mother and My brothers?”
ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, “Baba na bamura baminto mbarabi?”
swahili: Akawauliza, “Mama yangu na ndugu zangu ni nani?”

english: Looking at those seated in a circle around Him, He said, “Here are My mother and My brothers!
ekegusii: Akabarigereria abwo baikaransete bamoetanaine, akabora, “Rora aba nabwo baba na bamura baminto!
swahili: Kisha akawatazama wale watu waliokuwa wameketi kumzunguka pande zote, akasema, “Hawa ndio mama yangu na ndugu zangu.

english: For whoever does the will of God is My brother and sister and mother.”
ekegusii: Inaki oyorakore ogwancha kwa Nyasae, oyio nere baba na momura ominto, na mosubati ominto.”
swahili: Mtu yeyote anayetenda mapenzi ya Mungu, huyo ndiye ndugu yangu, na dada yangu na mama yangu.”

english: And He asked them, “Which is lawful on the Sabbath: to do good or to do evil, to save life or to destroy it?” But they were silent.
ekegusii: Akababoria, “Mboronge ase rituko ri’Esabato gokora amaya, gose gokora amabe; gotooria obogima, gose koboita?” Bagakira.
swahili: Kisha Yesu akawauliza, “Je, ni lipi lililo halali siku ya Sabato: Ni kutenda mema au kutenda mabaya? Ni kuokoa maisha au kuua?” Lakini wao wakanyamaza kimya.

english: Jesus looked around at them with anger and sorrow at their hardness of heart. Then He said to the man, “Stretch out your hand.” So he stretched it out, and it was restored.
ekegusii: Akabamogoreria amaiso chinsemo chionsi ase okobea, akaigwa obororo ase engencho y’obokong’u bwe chinkoro chiabo, agateebia omonto oria, “Rambora okoboko kwao!” Agakorambora, na okoboko kwaye gokagwena.
swahili: Yesu akawatazama pande zote kwa hasira, akahuzunika sana kwa ajili ya ugumu wa mioyo yao. Akamwambia yule mtu mwenye mkono uliopooza, “Nyoosha mkono wako.” Akaunyoosha, nao ukaponywa kabisa!

english: At this, the Pharisees went out and began plotting with the Herodians how they might kill Jesus. Jesus Heals the Multitudes (Matthew 4:23–25; Luke 6:17–19)
ekegusii: Erio kegima Abafarisai baria bagasoka, bakagamba amo n’Abaherodiani buna barakore baite Yeso. Omoganda bw’abaanto engegu y’enyancha
swahili: Kisha Mafarisayo wakatoka nje, nao wakaanza kufanya shauri la kumuua Yesu wakiwa na Maherode. Umati Wa Watu Wamfuata Yesu

english: So Jesus withdrew with His disciples to the sea, accompanied by a large crowd from Galilee, Judea,
ekegusii: Erio Yeso akarwa agwo amo n’Aborokigwa baye, bakagenda goika engegu ye’nyancha ya Galili, na omoganda omonene korwa Galili, naboigo korwa ase Boyahudi,
swahili: Yesu pamoja na wanafunzi wake wakaondoka huko wakaenda baharini, nao umati mkubwa wa watu kutoka Galilaya ukamfuata.

english: Jerusalem, Idumea, the region beyond the Jordan, and the vicinity of Tyre and Sidon. The large crowd came to Him when they heard what great things He was doing.
ekegusii: na Yerusalemu, na Idumea, na ng’umbu ya Yorodani, ne chinsemo chia Turo na Sidoni okabatunyana. Ochia koigwa ebirage bi’amang’ana onsi arenge gokora, omoganda oyio omonene, okamochiera.
swahili: Waliposikia mambo yote aliyokuwa akiyafanya, umati mkubwa wa watu ukamjia kutoka Uyahudi, Yerusalemu, Idumaya, na ngʼambo ya Yordani, pamoja na wale wa sehemu za karibu na Tiro na Sidoni.

english: Jesus asked His disciples to have a boat ready for Him so that the crowd would not crush Him.
ekegusii: Yeso agateebia aborokigwa baye bamobekere obwato ang’e ase engencho y’abanto; erio omoganda tomomiga.
swahili: Kwa sababu ya umati mkubwa wa watu, aliwaambia wanafunzi wake waweke tayari mashua ndogo kwa ajili yake, ili kuwazuia watu kumsonga.

english: Once again Jesus began to teach beside the sea, and such a large crowd gathered around Him that He got into a boat and sat in it, while all the people crowded along the shore.
ekegusii: Erio Yeso agachaaka kworokereria naende ase enyancha mbarabare, na omoganda omonene okamosangererekanera, goika ere akariina obwato, agaikaransa imeo igoro y’enyancha. Omoganda bwonsi nao orenge ase ense enyomo enyancha mbarabare.
swahili: Yesu akaanza kufundisha tena kando ya bahari. Umati wa watu uliokuwa umekusanyika kumzunguka ulikuwa mkubwa, kiasi kwamba ilimbidi Yesu aingie kwenye mashua iliyokuwa baharini na kuketi humo, nao watu wote walikuwa ufuoni mwa bahari.

english: As soon as Jesus was alone with the Twelve and those around Him, they asked Him about the parable.
ekegusii: Ekero arenge bweka, abanto baria bamoetanaine amo nabaria ikomi na babere bakamobooria amang’ana y’emebayeeno eria.
swahili: Alipokuwa peke yake, watu waliokuwepo naye pamoja na wanafunzi wake kumi na wawili wakamuuliza kuhusu mifano yake.

english: He replied, “The mystery of the kingdom of God has been given to you, but to those on the outside everything is expressed in parables,
ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Inwe mwaeirwe komanya obobisi bw’oborwoti bwa Nyasae, korende ase abanto bare isiko, amang’ana onsi nigo are emebayeeno ase bare,
swahili: Naye akawaambia, “Ninyi mmepewa kujua siri ya Ufalme wa Mungu. Lakini kwa wale walioko nje, kila kitu husemwa kwao kwa mifano,

english: so that, ‘they may be ever seeing but never perceiving, and ever hearing but never understanding; otherwise they might turn and be forgiven.’ ” The Parable of the Sower Explained (Matthew 13:18–23; Luke 8:11–15)
ekegusii: erio okorigereria nabarigererie, ko tibakorora, na okoigwa nabaigwe, ko tibakomanya; tibacha koonchoka, baaberwe ebibe biabo.” Ogotebereria kw’omobayeeno bw’omobusuri (Mat 13:18-23; Luk 8:11-15)
