swahili: ili, “ ‘daima waone lakini wasitambue, daima wasikie lakini wasielewe; wasije wakageuka, wakatubu na kusamehewa!’ ” Yesu Afafanua Maana Ya Mfano Wa Mbegu (Mathayo 13:18-23; Luka 8:11-15)

english: Then Jesus said to them, “Do you not understand this parable? Then how will you understand any of the parables?
ekegusii: Erio Yeso akabateebia, “Timomanyeti omobayeeno oyo? Gaki emebayeeno yonsi naki morayemanye?
swahili: Kisha Yesu akawauliza, “Hamwelewi maana ya mfano huu? Basi mtaelewaje mifano mingine?

english: The farmer sows the word.
ekegusii: Omobusuri nering’ana akobusura.
swahili: Yule mpanzi hupanda neno.

english: Some are like the seeds along the path, where the word is sown. As soon as they hear it, Satan comes and takes away the word that was sown in them.
ekegusii: Abanto bande nigo bare buna embusuro eyio ekogwa enchera ensemo; na barabwo kobaikire koriigwa ring’ana, bwango Saitani ocha orusia ring’ana riria riabusuirwe ase emioyo yabo ime.
swahili: Hawa ndio wale walio kando ya njia ambako neno lilipandwa. Walisikiapo neno, Shetani huja mara na kulinyakua lile neno lililopandwa ndani yao.

english: Some are like the seeds sown on rocky ground. They hear the word and at once receive it with joy.
ekegusii: Abanto bande nigo banga buna chimbusuro chiria chiaguete ase egetare, ekiagera kobaigure ring’ana riria, erio kegima baribwata nomogooko;
swahili: Nazo zile mbegu zilizoanguka kwenye udongo wenye miamba, ni wale wanaolisikia neno, na mara hulipokea kwa furaha.

english: But they themselves have no root, and they remain for only a season. When trouble or persecution comes because of the word, they quickly fall away.
ekegusii: na abwo tibari nemeri ime yabo abanyene, korende bagenderera ekero egeke, na ekero emechando gose okorosigwa bikooroka ase engencho ye ring’ana riria, bwango bagwa.
swahili: Lakini kwa kuwa hawana mizizi, wao hudumu kwa muda mfupi tu. Kisha dhiki au mateso yanapoinuka kwa ajili ya lile neno, mara wao huiacha imani.

english: Others are like the seeds sown among the thorns. They hear the word,
ekegusii: Naende abande nabwo baria babusuirwe ase amagwa, aba nabwo bakoigwa ring’ana,
swahili: Lakini wengine, kama mbegu iliyopandwa kwenye miiba, hulisikia lile neno;

english: but the worries of this life, the deceitfulness of wealth, and the desire for other things come in and choke the word, and it becomes unfruitful.
ekegusii: naende okorengereria gw’ense na obong’ainereria bw’eniibo, na okogania kw’amang’ana ande kogosoa, biamiga ring’ana riria, riaba tirikwama.
swahili: lakini masumbufu ya maisha haya, na udanganyifu wa mali na tamaa ya mambo mengine huja na kulisonga lile neno na kulifanya lisizae.

english: And He taught them many things in parables, and in His teaching He said,
ekegusii: Akaborokereria amang’ana amange ase emebayeeno, akabateebia ase okworokereria kwaye,
swahili: Akawafundisha mambo mengi kwa mifano, naye katika mafundisho yake akasema:

english: Still others are like the seeds sown on good soil. They hear the word, receive it, and produce a crop—thirtyfold, sixtyfold, or a hundredfold.” The Lesson of the Lamp (Luke 8:16–18)
ekegusii: Naende aba nabwo babusuirwe ase amaroba amaya, abwo n’abanto baria bakoigwa ring’ana riria, na koribwata, na kwama okwama, oyomo emerongo etato, oyomo emerongo etano nomo, na oyonde rigana.” Okworokereria korwa ase etaya na korwa ase embusuro (Mat 13:31-35; Luk 8:16-18; 13:18-19)
swahili: Wengine, kama mbegu iliyopandwa kwenye udongo mzuri, hulisikia lile neno, wakalipokea na kuzaa mazao. Wao huzaa mara thelathini, au mara sitini, au mara mia ya mbegu iliyopandwa.” Mfano Wa Taa (Luka 8:16-18)

english: Jesus also said to them, “Does anyone bring in a lamp to put it under a basket or under a bed? Doesn’t he set it on a stand?
ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Inee! Etaya nigo ekorentwa erinde yamumekwa negetonga gose yabekwa nyaro y’oborere? Teri kobekwa igoro ase ekebekerero?
swahili: Akawaambia, “Je, taa huwashwa na kufunikwa chini ya kikapu au mvunguni mwa kitanda? Je, haiwashwi na kuwekwa juu ya kinara chake?

english: For there is nothing hidden that will not be disclosed, and nothing concealed that will not be brought to light.
ekegusii: Inaki ring’ana tiriri ria bobisi ritache koorokigwa, gose eribisegete ritache koorokigwa maiso marore.
swahili: Kwa kuwa hakuna kilichofichika ambacho hakitafunuliwa, wala hakuna jambo lolote la siri ambalo halitaletwa nuruni.

english: If anyone has ears to hear, let him hear.”
ekegusii: Onye omonto ore n’amato akoigwera, tiga aigwe.”
swahili: Mwenye masikio ya kusikia, na asikie.”

english: He went on to say, “Pay attention to what you hear. With the measure you use, it will be measured to you, and even more will be added to you.
ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Rigereria aya mokoigwa; na ekerengo keria mokorengera nakio morache korengerwa inwe, naende namomenterwe.
swahili: Naye akawaambia, “Kuweni waangalifu na yale mnayosikia. Kipimo kile mpimacho, ndicho mtakachopimiwa ninyi, hata na zaidi.

english: For whoever has will be given more. But whoever does not have, even what he has will be taken away from him.” The Seed Growing Secretly
ekegusii: Inaki oyobwate naegwe; korende oyotabwati naurwe nonya nekio abwate.” Omobayeeno korwa ase embusuro egokina
swahili: Kwa maana kila mtu aliye na kitu atapewa zaidi, naye atakuwa navyo tele. Lakini yule asiye na kitu, hata kile alicho nacho atanyangʼanywa.” Mfano Wa Mbegu Inayoota

english: Jesus also said, “The kingdom of God is like a man who scatters seed on the ground.
ekegusii: Erio Yeso akabora, “Oborwoti bwa Nyasae nigo bogwekaine nomonto obusurete embusuro ase riroba.
swahili: Pia akawaambia, “Ufalme wa Mungu unafanana na mtu apandaye mbegu shambani.

english: Night and day he sleeps and wakes, and the seed sprouts and grows, though he knows not how.
ekegusii: Akaba okoraara botuko na koboka, mobaso, na embusuro eyio ekamera na gokiina, ere atamanyeti buna egokoreka.
swahili: Akiisha kuzipanda, usiku na mchana, akiwa amelala au ameamka, mbegu huota na kukua pasipo yeye kujua ikuavyo.

english: All by itself the earth produces a crop—first the stalk, then the head, then grain that ripens within.
ekegusii: Inaki ense nigo ekwama enyene, ritang’ani rinyansi, naende ekegara, erio enyeke ase ekegara.
swahili: Udongo huifanya iote kuwa mche, halafu suke, kisha nafaka kamili kwenye suke.

english: And as soon as the grain is ripe, he swings the sickle, because the harvest has come. ” The Parable of the Mustard Seed (Matthew 13:31–32; Luke 13:18–19)
ekegusii: Na endagera koyamire, omonto oyio bwango nigo akoira omoyio bwokogesa, ekiagera rigesa riaikire ang’e.” Omobayeeno bw’ententere y’omoaruni
swahili: Lakini nafaka inapokuwa imekomaa, mara mkulima huingia shambani na mundu wa kuvunia, maana mavuno yamekuwa tayari.” Mfano Wa Mbegu Ya Haradali (Mathayo 13:31-32, 34; Luka 13:18-19)

english: “Listen! A farmer went out to sow his seed.
ekegusii: “Tegerera! Omobusuri akamanora kogenda kobusura.
swahili: “Sikilizeni! Mpanzi alitoka kwenda kupanda mbegu zake.

english: Then He asked, “To what can we compare the kingdom of God? With what parable shall we present it?
ekegusii: Erio Yeso akagenderera koboora, “Ninki torabogwekanie oborwoti bwa Nyasae? Gose tobobeke ase mobayeeno ki?
swahili: Akawaambia tena, “Tuufananishe Ufalme wa Mungu na nini? Au tutumie mfano gani ili kuueleza?

english: It is like a mustard seed, which is the smallest of all seeds sown upon the earth.
ekegusii: Nigo bonga entetere y’omoaruni, ekero egosimekwa ase amaroba nenke kobua chimbusuro chionsi ase ense,
swahili: Ni kama punje ya haradali, ambayo ni mbegu ndogo sana kuliko mbegu zote zinazopandwa ardhini.

english: But after it is planted, it grows to be the largest of all garden plants and puts forth great branches, so that the birds of the air nest in its shade.”
ekegusii: korende koyasimekirwe, yakiina, yaba enene kobua emete yonsi y’amato, yaba ne chinsagia chinene; goika chinyoni chia igoro chinyare gokenderera ase ekiriri kiaye.”
swahili: Lakini ikishaota, hukua ikawa mmea mkubwa kuliko yote ya bustanini, ikawa na matawi makubwa hata ndege wa angani wanaweza kujenga viota kwenye matawi yake.”

english: With many such parables Jesus spoke the word to them, to the extent that they could understand.
ekegusii: Yeso akaranderia abanto ring’ana riaye ase emebayeeno emenge ere buna eye; nigo arenge gokwana ring’ana ase bare, koreng’ana buna baare konyara koigwa,
swahili: Kwa mifano mingine mingi kama hii Yesu alinena nao neno lake, kwa kadiri walivyoweza kulielewa.

english: He did not tell them anything without using a parable. But privately He explained everything to His own disciples. Jesus Calms the Storm (Psalms 107:1–43; Matthew 8:23–27; Luke 8:22–25)
ekegusii: gose taare kobateebia ring’ana otatiga ase omobayeeno, korende ekero arenge ensemo n’Aborokigwa baye nigo arenge kobateebia obobisi bwonsi. Yeso ogotoereria omwaga (Mat 8:23-27; Luk 8:22-25)
swahili: Hakusema nao neno lolote pasipo mfano. Lakini alipokuwa na wanafunzi wake, aliwafafanulia kila kitu. Yesu Atuliza Dhoruba (Mathayo 8:23-27; Luka 8:22-25)

english: When that evening came, He said to His disciples, “Let us cross to the other side.”
ekegusii: Ase rituko riria, rigachia koba mogoroba, akabateebia, “Twamboke gochia ng’umbu.”
swahili: Siku hiyo ilipokaribia jioni, aliwaambia wanafunzi wake, “Tuvukeni twende mpaka ngʼambo.”

english: After they had dismissed the crowd, they took Jesus with them, since He was already in the boat. And there were other boats with Him.
ekegusii: Bagatiga omoganda, bakamoira amo nabarabwo, buna arenge, ase obwato boria. Na amaato ande narenge amo nere
swahili: Wakauacha ule umati wa watu, na wakamchukua vile alivyokuwa kwenye mashua. Palikuwa pia na mashua nyingine nyingi pamoja naye.

english: Soon a violent windstorm came up, and the waves were breaking over the boat, so that it was being swamped.
ekegusii: Ekembugu‐mbugu ekenene ki’omwaga gekaoroka, emerindo egaaka‐aka obwato goika amaache agachaaka goichora obwato ime.
swahili: Kukawa na dhoruba kali, nayo mawimbi yakaipiga ile mashua hata ikawa karibu kujaa maji.

english: But Jesus was in the stern, sleeping on the cushion. So they woke Him and said, “Teacher, don’t You care that we are perishing?”
ekegusii: Ere omonyene nigo arenge ase obwato ime magega oraire igoro ase omoito. Bakamotura, bakamoteebia, “Omworokia, tari gento ase ore gatogosira?”
swahili: Yesu alikuwa katika shetri, akiwa analala juu ya mto. Wanafunzi wake wakamwamsha, wakamwambia, “Mwalimu, hujali kama tunazama?”

english: Then Jesus got up and rebuked the wind and the sea. “Silence!” He commanded. “Be still!” And the wind died down, and it was perfectly calm.
ekegusii: Yeso akaboka, agatogonyera omwaga, agateebia enyancha, “Kira, otoerere!” Omwaga okaera; gokaba ogotoerera okonene.
swahili: Akaamka, akaukemea ule upepo, akayaambia yale mawimbi, “Uwe kimya! Tulia!” Ule upepo ukatulia, kukawa shwari kabisa.

english: And as he was sowing, some seed fell along the path, and the birds came and devoured it.
ekegusii: Agachia koba nkobusura are, chimbusuro chinde chikagwa ase enchera ensemo, chinyoni chigaacha chigachiria.
swahili: Alipokuwa akitawanya mbegu, nyingine zilianguka kando ya njia, nao ndege wakaja na kuzila.

english: “Why are you so afraid?” He asked. “Do you still have no faith?”
ekegusii: Erio Yeso agateebia aborokigwa baye, “Inaki mokwoboa inwe? Timori nokwegena?”
swahili: Yesu akawaambia wanafunzi wake, “Kwa nini mnaogopa hivyo? Je, bado hamna imani?”

english: Overwhelmed with fear, they asked one another, “Who is this, that even the wind and the sea obey Him?”
ekegusii: Bagasogwa nomoondoko omonene, bagateebania, “Oyo ning’o rende, goika nonya nomwaga na enyancha bikomoigwera?”
swahili: Nao wakawa wameogopa sana, wakaulizana, “Ni nani huyu ambaye hata upepo na mawimbi vinamtii?”

english: Some fell on rocky ground, where it did not have much soil. It sprang up quickly because the soil was shallow.
ekegusii: Na echinde chikagwa aase egetare kere, aase amaroba are amake; chikamera bwango, ekiagera amaroba arenge amake.
swahili: Nyingine zilianguka kwenye ardhi yenye mwamba isiyo na udongo wa kutosha. Zikaota haraka, kwa kuwa udongo ulikuwa haba.

english: Other seed fell among thorns, which grew up and choked the seedlings, and they yielded no crop.
ekegusii: Na echinde chikagwa ase amagwa ime, na amagwa aria agakiina, agachimiga, tichiama amatunda.
swahili: Mbegu nyingine zilianguka kwenye miiba, nayo miiba hiyo ikakua, ikaisonga hiyo mimea, hivyo haikutoa mazao.

english: Still other seed fell on good soil, where it sprouted, grew up, and produced a crop—one bearing thirtyfold, another sixtyfold, and another a hundredfold.”
ekegusii: Na echinde chikagwa ase amaroba amaya, chikaama endagera, chikamera na gokina, na kwama; echinde emerongo etato, na echinde emerongo etano nomo, naende echinde rigana.”
swahili: Mbegu nyingine zilianguka kwenye udongo mzuri, zikaota vizuri na kukua, zikatoa mazao, moja mara thelathini, nyingine mara sitini, na nyingine mara mia moja.”

english: Then Jesus said, “He who has ears to hear, let him hear.” The Purpose of Jesus’ Parables (Isaiah 6:1–13; Matthew 13:10–17; Luke 8:9–10)
ekegusii: Akabora, “Oyore namato akoigwera tiga aigwe.” Ekerenga ki’ogokwana ase emebayeeno (Mat 13:10-17; Luk 8:9-10)
swahili: Kisha Yesu akasema, “Mwenye masikio ya kusikia, na asikie.” Sababu Za Mifano (Mathayo 13:10-17; Luka 8:9-10)

english: On the other side of the sea, they arrived in the region of the Gerasenes.
ekegusii: Bagaika ng’umbu y’enyancha, goika ense y’Abageraseni.
swahili: Wakafika upande wa pili wa ziwa wakaingia katika nchi ya Wagerasi.

english: And he begged Jesus repeatedly not to send them out of that region.
ekegusii: Erio ere agasorora Yeso mono tabiira isiko y’ense eria.
swahili: Akamsihi Yesu sana asiwapeleke nje ya nchi ile.

english: There on the nearby hillside a large herd of pigs was feeding.
ekegusii: Aria ase egetunwa ndiarengeo riicho rinene rie chimbeche riare korisia.
swahili: Palikuwa na kundi kubwa la nguruwe lililokuwa likilisha karibu kando ya kilima.

english: So the demons begged Jesus, “Send us to the pigs, so that we may enter them.”
ekegusii: Ebirecha bionsi bikamosorora, bikaboora, “Toire ase chimbeche, tonyare gosoa ase chirochio.”
swahili: Wale pepo wachafu wakamsihi Yesu wakisema, “Tuamuru twende kwenye wale nguruwe. Turuhusu tuwaingie.”

english: He gave them permission, and the unclean spirits came out and went into the pigs, and the herd of about two thousand rushed down the steep bank into the sea and drowned in the water.
ekegusii: Akabia ribaga. Ebirecha biria bi’eubi bigasoka, bigasoa ase chimbeche chiria; riicho riria rigatirimboka bwango gochia ase egeturunkano, goika chikagwa enyancha ime. Igo chiarenge koreng’ana chilifu ibere, chikarimera nyancha ime.
swahili: Basi Yesu akawaruhusu, nao wale pepo wachafu wakatoka, wakawaingia hao nguruwe. Lile kundi lilikuwa na nguruwe wapatao 2,000, nao wote wakateremkia gengeni kwa kasi, nao wakatumbukia ziwani na kuzama.

english: Those tending the pigs ran off and reported this in the town and countryside, and the people went out to see what had happened.
ekegusii: Abarisia bagatama, bakararia amang’ana aya ase omochie na ebinyoro. Abanto bagasooka barore amang’ana aorokire.
swahili: Wale watu waliokuwa wakichunga hao nguruwe wakakimbilia mjini na vijijini kueleza yaliyotukia. Watu wakatoka kwenda kuona hayo yaliyokuwa yametukia.

english: When they came to Jesus, they saw the man who had been possessed by the legion of demons sitting there, clothed and in his right mind; and they were afraid.
ekegusii: Bagachiera Yeso, bakarora omonto oria obwatire nomoganda bw’ebirecha oikaransete, bweboyetie chianga, ore nebirengererio ebironge bakairoka.
swahili: Walipofika kwa Yesu, wakamwona yule mtu aliyekuwa amepagawa na pepo wachafu legioni akiwa ameketi hapo, amevaa nguo na mwenye akili timamu. Wakaogopa.

english: Those who had seen it described what had happened to the demon-possessed man and also to the pigs.
ekegusii: Na baria abayaroche bakaorokia amang’ana amonyorire oria obwatire nebirecha, na amang’ana ye chimbeche.
swahili: Wale walioyaona mambo hayo wakawaeleza watu wengine yaliyomtokea yule mtu aliyekuwa amepagawa na pepo wachafu, na habari za lile kundi la nguruwe pia.

english: And the people began to beg Jesus to leave their region.
ekegusii: Bagachaaka gosorora Yeso arue ase ense yabo.
swahili: Basi watu wakaanza kumwomba Yesu aondoke katika nchi yao.

english: As He was getting into the boat, the man who had been possessed by the demons begged to go with Him.
ekegusii: Ekero Yeso achia koriina obwato ime, oria obwatire nebirecha akamosorora ng’a abe amo nere.
swahili: Yesu alipokuwa anaingia kwenye mashua, yule mtu aliyekuwa amepagawa na pepo wachafu akamsihi Yesu waende pamoja.

english: But Jesus would not allow him. “Go home to your own people,” He said, “and tell them how much the Lord has done for you, and what mercy He has shown you.”
ekegusii: Yeso tamwanchera, korende akamoteebia, “Genda nka bwoo ase abamino, obateebie amang’ana amanene ay’Omonene agokoreire, naende buna akororeire amaabera.”
swahili: Yesu hakumruhusu, bali alimwambia, “Nenda nyumbani kwa jamaa yako ukawaeleze mambo makuu aliyokutendea Bwana, na jinsi alivyokuhurumia.”

english: As soon as Jesus got out of the boat, He was met by a man with an unclean spirit, who was coming from the tombs.
ekegusii: Yeso agachia goika korwa obwato; agwo akaumerana nomonto okorwa ase chimbeera obwatire nekerecha ki’eubi.
swahili: Yesu alipotoka kwenye mashua, mara mtu mmoja mwenye pepo mchafu akatoka makaburini akakutana naye.

english: So the man went away and began to proclaim throughout the Decapolis how much Jesus had done for him. And everyone was amazed. The Healing Touch of Jesus (Matthew 9:18–26; Luke 8:40–56)
ekegusii: Akagenda bwoye, agachaaka koraria ase Dekapoli amang’ana aya Yeso amokoreire. Abanto bonsi bagakumia. Omoiseke o Yairo na omokungu ore noborwaire bw’okorua amanyinga bakogwenigwa (Mat 9:18-26; Luk 8:40-56)
swahili: Yule mtu akaenda zake, akaanza kutangaza katika Dekapoli mambo makuu Yesu aliyomtendea. Nao watu wote wakastaajabu. Mwanamke Aponywa (Mathayo 9:18-26; Luka 8:40-56)

english: When Jesus had again crossed by boat to the other side, a large crowd gathered around Him beside the sea.
ekegusii: Yeso kambokire naende koirana ng’umbu nobwato boria, omoganda omonene okamosangererekanera; ere nigo arenge ensemo y’enyancha.
swahili: Yesu alipokwisha kuvuka tena na kufika ngʼambo, umati mkubwa wa watu ukamzunguka yeye akiwa hapo kando ya bahari.

english: A synagogue leader named Jairus arrived, and seeing Jesus, he fell at His feet
ekegusii: Omonto oyomo bw’abanene b’esinagogi agacha, erieta riaye Yairo. Agachia komoorora, akagwa ase amagoro aye,
swahili: Kisha mmoja wa viongozi wa sinagogi aliyeitwa Yairo akafika pale. Naye alipomwona Yesu, akapiga magoti miguuni pake,

english: and pleaded with Him urgently, “My little daughter is near death. Please come and place Your hands on her, so that she will be healed and live.”
ekegusii: akamosorora mono, akabora, “Omonene, omoiseke one omoke oisire gokwa. Nagosabire, oche obeke okoboko kwao igoro yaye, anyare kogwena, abe moyo.”
swahili: akamsihi akisema, “Binti yangu mdogo ni mgonjwa mahututi. Tafadhali nakusihi, njoo uweke mikono yako juu yake ili apate kupona, naye atakuwa hai.”

english: So Jesus went with him, and a large crowd followed and pressed around Him.
ekegusii: Bono Yeso akaimoka akagenda amo nere. Omoganda omonene okamotunyana, okamomiga‐miga korwa ase chinsemo chionsi.
swahili: Hivyo Yesu akaenda pamoja naye. Umati mkubwa wa watu ukamfuata, nao watu wakawa wanamsonga.

english: And a woman was there who had suffered from bleeding for twelve years.
ekegusii: Narengeo omokungu oyomo orenge noborwaire bw’okorua amanyinga ase engaki y’emiaka ikomi na ebere.
swahili: Hapo palikuwa na mwanamke aliyekuwa amesumbuliwa na tatizo la kutokwa damu kwa miaka kumi na miwili.

english: She had borne much agony under the care of many physicians and had spent all she had, but to no avail. Instead, her condition had only grown worse.
ekegusii: Ere nigo achandegete mono ase amaboko y’abarwaria abange. Ere konya osiareire ebinto bionsi arenge nabio, tagwenigwa nonya ng’ake, korende obogima bwaye bokamentekana koba obobe kobua.
swahili: Mwanamke huyu alikuwa ameteseka sana kwa mikono ya matabibu wengi, na kutumia kila kitu alichokuwa nacho. Lakini badala ya kupona, hali yake ilizidi kuwa mbaya.

english: When the woman heard about Jesus, she came up through the crowd behind Him and touched His cloak.
ekegusii: Konya oigure amang’ana igoro ya Yeso, agaeta ase omoganda korwa magega, agakuna eanga yaye,
swahili: Alikuwa amesikia habari za Yesu, naye akaja kwa nyuma yake kwenye umati wa watu, akaligusa vazi lake,

english: For she kept saying, “If only I touch His garments, I will be healed.”
ekegusii: ekiagera nigo ateebete, “Kondakune chianga chiaye chioka, ningwene.”
swahili: kwa maana alisema moyoni mwake, “Kama nikiweza kuligusa vazi lake tu, nitaponywa.”

english: Immediately her bleeding stopped, and she sensed in her body that she was healed of her affliction.
ekegusii: Erio kegima ensoko y’amanyinga aye egakama: akaigwa omobere oye ng’a ogwenire korwa ase oborwaire bwaye.
swahili: Mara kutoka damu kwake kukakoma, naye akajisikia mwilini mwake amepona kabisa.

english: This man had been living in the tombs and could no longer be restrained, even with chains.
ekegusii: Obomenyo bwaye nigo bwarenge aria ase chimbeera. Monto onde tarenge ore konyara komosiba nonya nase ebinyuri,
swahili: Mtu huyu aliishi makaburini, wala hakuna aliyeweza kumzuia hata kwa kumfunga minyororo.

english: At once Jesus was aware that power had gone out from Him. Turning to the crowd, He asked, “Who touched My garments?”
ekegusii: Erio agwo Yeso akamanya ase omoyo oye ng’a chinguru chiarure asare, akeonchora gati ase omoganda, akabora, “Ning’o okuna chianga chiane?”
swahili: Ghafula Yesu akatambua kuwa nguvu zimemtoka. Akaugeukia ule umati wa watu na kuuliza, “Ni nani aliyegusa mavazi yangu?”

english: His disciples answered, “You can see the crowd pressing in on You, and yet You ask, ‘Who touched Me?’”
ekegusii: Aborokigwa baye bakamoteebia, “Norooche omoganda oyo buna okomigete, na aye gokoboria: Ning’o onkuna?”
swahili: Wanafunzi wake wakamjibu, “Unaona jinsi umati wa watu unavyokusonga. Wawezaje kuuliza, ‘Ni nani aliyenigusa?’ ”

english: But He kept looking around to see who had done this.
ekegusii: Korende Yeso akarigereria chinsemo chionsi, erinde arore oria okora ring’ana erio.
swahili: Lakini Yesu akaangalia pande zote ili aone ni nani aliyemgusa.

english: Then the woman, knowing what had happened to her, came and fell down before Him trembling in fear, and she told Him the whole truth.
ekegusii: Na omokungu oria agasogwa nomoondoko na okoiguswa, akamanya eriamonyorire, agacha akamogwera, akamoorokeria ekeene gionsi.
swahili: Yule mwanamke, akijua kilichomtokea, akaja, akaanguka miguuni pake akitetemeka kwa hofu, akamweleza ukweli wote.

english: “Daughter,” said Jesus, “your faith has healed you. Go in peace and be free of your affliction.”
ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Omoiseke one, okwegena kwao gwakogwenirie, genda nomorembe, ogwene korwa ase oborwaire bwao.”
swahili: Yesu akamwambia, “Binti, imani yako imekuponya. Nenda kwa amani, upone kabisa ugonjwa wako.” Yesu Amfufua Binti Yairo

english: While He was still speaking, messengers from the house of Jairus arrived and said, “Your daughter is dead; why bother the Teacher anymore?”
ekegusii: Ekero Yeso agendererete gokwana, abanto korwa ase enyomba y’omotang’ani bw’esinagogi bagaacha, bakaboora, “Enyaroka yao yakuure. Inki okona‐koroseria Omworokia rende?”
swahili: Alipokuwa bado anaongea, watu wakafika kutoka nyumbani kwa Yairo. Wakamwambia, “Binti yako amekufa. Kwa nini kuendelea kumsumbua Mwalimu?”

english: But Jesus overheard their conversation and said to Jairus, “Do not be afraid; just believe.”
ekegusii: Korende Yeso tancha gotegerera ring’ana riria rigotebwa, agateebia omotang’ani oria bw’esinagogi, “Toiroka, egene rioka.”
swahili: Aliposikia hayo waliyosema, Yesu akamwambia huyo kiongozi wa sinagogi, “Usiogope. Amini tu.”

english: And He did not allow anyone to accompany Him except Peter, James, and John the brother of James.
ekegusii: Gose tanchete monto onde amotuny’ane, otatiga Petero, na Yakobo, na Yohana momura omwabo Yakobo.
swahili: Hakumruhusu mtu mwingine yeyote amfuate isipokuwa Petro, Yakobo na Yohana, nduguye Yakobo.

english: When they arrived at the house of the synagogue leader, Jesus saw the commotion and the people weeping and wailing loudly.
ekegusii: Bagaika enyomba y’omonene oria bw’esinagogi; akarora rirorooche, na abanto bakorera nokweumia okonge.
swahili: Walipofika nyumbani kwa yule kiongozi wa sinagogi, Yesu akaona ghasia, watu wakilia na kuomboleza kwa sauti kubwa.

english: He went inside and asked, “Why all this commotion and weeping? The child is not dead, but asleep.”
ekegusii: Agachia gosoa, akabateebia, “Inaki mogokora rirorooche na korera? Omwana takweti, korende nigo araire.”
swahili: Alipokwisha kuingia ndani, akawaambia, “Kwa nini mnafanya ghasia na kulia? Mtoto hajafa, bali amelala tu.”

english: Though he was often bound with chains and shackles, he had broken the chains and shattered the shackles. Now there was no one with the strength to subdue him.
ekegusii: ekiagera nigo arenge konya osibirwe ara aange ne chingataare na ebinyuri, abibutora ebinyuri biria, na kobuna‐buna chingataare chiria, na onde tarenge ore ne chinguru chi’okomobua.
swahili: Kwa kuwa mara kwa mara alikuwa amefungwa minyororo mikononi na miguuni, lakini akaikata hiyo minyororo na kuzivunja zile pingu miguuni mwake. Hapakuwa na mtu yeyote aliyekuwa na nguvu za kumzuia.

english: And they laughed at Him. After He had put them all outside, He took the child’s father and mother and His own companions, and went in to see the child.
ekegusii: Bakamosekerera. Korende gaikire kobasokia isiko bonsi, akaira ise omwana, na ng’ina, na aborokigwa baye batato abwo barenge amo nere, agasoa ime ase omwana oria arenge.
swahili: Wale watu wakamcheka kwa dharau. Lakini yeye akawatoa wote nje, akawachukua baba na mama wa yule mtoto, pamoja na wale wanafunzi aliokuwa nao. Wakaingia ndani mpaka pale alipokuwa yule mtoto.

english: Taking her by the hand, Jesus said, “Talitha koum!” which means, “Little girl, I say to you, get up!”
ekegusii: Akamobwata okoboko omoiseke oria omoke, akamoteebia, “Talitha kumi”, okoonchorwa kwaye, “Tenena aye enyaroka.”
swahili: Akamshika mtoto mkono, akamwambia, “Talitha koum!” (maana yake ni, “Msichana, nakuambia: amka!” )

english: Immediately the girl got up and began to walk around. She was twelve years old, and at once they were utterly astounded.
ekegusii: Erio agwo omoiseke oria omoke akaimoka akagenda, ere konya okoorire emiaka ikomi na ebere. Erio bagakumia ogokumia okonene.
swahili: Mara yule msichana akasimama, akaanza kutembea (alikuwa na umri wa miaka kumi na miwili). Walipoona haya, wakastaajabu sana.

english: Then Jesus gave strict orders that no one should know about this, and He told them to give her something to eat.
ekegusii: Yeso akabakuurera ng’a monto onde tamanya amang’ana ayio, akabachiika bae omoiseke oria endagera arie.
swahili: Yesu akawaagiza kwa ukali wasimweleze mtu yeyote jambo hilo, naye akawaambia wampe yule msichana chakula.

english: Night and day in the tombs and in the mountains he kept crying out and cutting himself with stones.
ekegusii: Na botambe, botuko na mobaso, nao arenge ase chimbeera na ebitunwa, okona‐korera na gwekeba‐keba namagena.
swahili: Usiku na mchana alikuwa makaburini na milimani, akipiga kelele na kujikatakata kwa mawe.

english: When the man saw Jesus from a distance, he ran and fell on his knees before Him.
ekegusii: Agachia korora Yeso korwa are, akaminyoka chimbero, akamosasiima;
swahili: Alipomwona Yesu kwa mbali, alimkimbilia, akapiga magoti mbele yake.

english: And he shouted in a loud voice, “What do You want with me, Jesus, Son of the Most High God? I beg You before God not to torture me!”
ekegusii: agaaka eriogi, okobora, “Inaki inde naye aye Yeso, Omwana o Nyasae Ore Igoro Mono? Nagotianirie ase Nyasae ng’a tonchanda”,
swahili: Akapiga kelele kwa nguvu akisema, “Una nini nami, Yesu, Mwana wa Mungu Aliye Juu Sana? Ninakusihi kwa jina la Mungu, usinitese!”

english: For Jesus had already declared, “Come out of this man, you unclean spirit!”
ekegusii: ekiagera Yeso konya ogetebirie, “Aye ekerecha ki’eubi, karwe ase omonto oyo!”
swahili: Kwa kuwa Yesu alikuwa amemwambia, “Mtoke mtu huyu, wewe pepo mchafu!”

english: “What is your name?” Jesus asked. “My name is Legion,” he replied, “for we are many.”
ekegusii: Yeso akamobooria, “Erieta riao naki okorokwa?” Akairaneria, “Erieta riane n’Elegioni abasigari chilifu isano nemo na goetani erombe y’ abanto, ekiagera nabange tore.”
swahili: Yesu akamuuliza, “Jina lako ni nani?” Akamjibu, “Jina langu ni Legioni, kwa kuwa tuko wengi.”

english: Jesus went on from there and came to His hometown, accompanied by His disciples.
ekegusii: Yeso akarua agwo, agaika ase ense yaye omonyene; aborokigwa baye bakamotunyana.
swahili: Yesu akaondoka huko na kwenda mji wa kwao, akiwa amefuatana na wanafunzi wake.

english: And He told them, “When you enter a house, stay there until you leave that area.
ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Enyomba ende yonsi ase moraroisigwe, mobeere aroro goika ekero moraimoke korwa aase aria.
swahili: Akawaambia, “Mkiingia kwenye nyumba yoyote, kaeni humo hadi mtakapoondoka katika mji huo.

english: If anyone will not welcome you or listen to you, shake the dust off your feet when you leave that place, as a testimony against them.”
ekegusii: Na kera aase abanto batabaroiseti inwe, gose kobaigwa, komokorua aroro, mokong’onte orotu rore inse ase amagoro aino, robe kirori ase bare.”
swahili: Kama mahali popote hawatawakaribisha wala kuwasikiliza, mtakapoondoka huko, kungʼuteni mavumbi kutoka kwenye miguu yenu ili kuwa ushuhuda dhidi yao.”

english: So they set out and preached that the people should repent.
ekegusii: Bagasoka, bakarandia ng’a abanto baonchoke.
swahili: Kwa hiyo wakatoka na kuhubiri kwamba inawapasa watu kutubu na kuacha dhambi.

english: They also drove out many demons and healed many of the sick, anointing them with oil. The Beheading of John (Matthew 14:1–12; Luke 9:7–9)
ekegusii: Bagaseria ebirecha ebinge, bagaaka abanto abange amaguta, abwo barenge abarwaire, bakabagwenia. Ogokwa kwa Yohana Omobatisi (Mat 14:1-12; Luk 9:7-9)
swahili: Wakatoa pepo wachafu wengi, wakawapaka wagonjwa wengi mafuta na kuwaponya. Yohana Mbatizaji Akatwa Kichwa (Mathayo 14:1-12; Luka 9:7-9)

english: Now King Herod heard about this, for Jesus’ name had become well known, and people were saying, “John the Baptist has risen from the dead! That is why miraculous powers are at work in him.”
ekegusii: Omorwoti Herode akaigwa amang’ana, ekiagera erieta ria Yeso konya riakumire kera ase. Abanto bande bakaboora, “Yohana Omobatisi obokire korwa ase abakuure, nakio gekogera chinguru echi chigokora emeremo ime asare.”
swahili: Mfalme Herode akasikia habari hizi, kwa maana jina la Yesu lilikuwa limejulikana sana. Watu wengine walikuwa wakisema, “Yohana Mbatizaji amefufuliwa kutoka kwa wafu, ndiyo sababu nguvu za kutenda miujiza zinafanya kazi ndani yake.”

english: Others were saying, “He is Elijah,” and still others, “He is a prophet, like one of the prophets of old.”
ekegusii: Korende abande bakaboora, “N’Elija.” Na abande bakaboora, “Oyo nomobani, gose nigo anga buna oyomo bw’ababani.”
swahili: Wengine wakasema, “Yeye ni Eliya.” Nao wengine wakasema, “Yeye ni nabii, kama mmojawapo wa wale manabii wa zamani.”

english: But when Herod heard this, he said, “John, whom I beheaded, has risen from the dead!”
ekegusii: Korende Herode agachia koyaigwa, akabora, “Oyio Yohana oria nanachete omotwe, obokire.”
swahili: Lakini Herode aliposikia habari hizi, akasema, “Huyo ni Yohana Mbatizaji, niliyemkata kichwa, amefufuliwa kutoka kwa wafu!”

english: For Herod himself had ordered that John be arrested and bound and imprisoned, on account of his brother Philip’s wife Herodias, whom Herod had married.
ekegusii: Inaki Herode omonyene nigo atomete abanto kobwata Yohana, akamosiba echela ase engencho ya Herodia moka Filipo momura omwabo, oria Herode atwarete,
swahili: Kwa kuwa Herode alikuwa ameagiza kwamba Yohana Mbatizaji akamatwe, afungwe na kutiwa gerezani. Alifanya hivi kwa sababu ya Herodia, mke wa Filipo, ndugu yake, ambaye Herode alikuwa amemwoa.

english: For John had been telling Herod, “It is not lawful for you to have your brother’s wife!”
ekegusii: ekiagera Yohana amokanetie Herode, “Tai boronge ase ore komenyana na moka momura omino.”
swahili: Yohana alikuwa amemwambia Herode, “Si halali kwako kuwa na mke wa ndugu yako.”

english: So Herodias held a grudge against John and wanted to kill him. But she had been unable,
ekegusii: Nabo oria Herodia akaba nokogecha asare, akarigia komoita, korende tanyara,
swahili: Kwa hiyo Herodia alikuwa amemwekea Yohana kinyongo akataka kumuua. Lakini hakuweza,

english: When the Sabbath came, He began to teach in the synagogue, and many who heard Him were astonished. “Where did this man get these ideas?” they asked. “What is this wisdom He has been given? And how can He perform such miracles?
ekegusii: Na ekero gi’Esabato agachaaka kworokereria ase esinagogi; abange abamoigwete bagakumia, bagateebania, “Oyo ng’ai anyorire aya? Mbong’aini ki obo aeirwe oyo? Ogokora gwe chinguru ki oko okonene kogokoreka ase amaboko aye?
swahili: Ilipofika siku ya Sabato, akaanza kufundisha katika sinagogi, na wengi waliomsikia wakashangaa. Nao wakauliza, “Mtu huyu ameyapata wapi mambo haya yote? Tazama ni hekima ya namna gani hii aliyopewa? Tazama matendo ya miujiza ayafanyayo kwa mikono yake!

english: because Herod feared John and protected him, knowing that he was a righteous and holy man. When he heard John’s words, he was greatly perplexed; yet he listened to him gladly.
ekegusii: ekiagera Herode nairogete Yohana, konya omanyire ng’a nomonto omooronge, omochenu, akamorenda. Nigo anchete komoigwa, nonya orenge goichana mono kamoigure.
swahili: kwa sababu Herode alimwogopa Yohana akijua kwamba ni mtu mwenye haki na mtakatifu, hivyo akamlinda. Herode alifadhaika sana alipomsikia Yohana, lakini bado alipenda kumsikiliza.

english: On Herod’s birthday, her opportunity arose. Herod held a banquet for his nobles and military commanders and the leading men of Galilee.
ekegusii: Rituko rigwenerete rigaika Herodia akanyora ribaga ekero Herode ase rituko ri’okoinyora okoiborwa kwaye ekero akora omoyega ase abatang’ani bare inse yaye, na abatang’ani b’esegi, na abanto abanene ba Galili.
swahili: Mfalme Herode alifanya karamu kubwa wakati wa sikukuu ya kuzaliwa kwake. Akawaalika maafisa wake wakuu, majemadari wa jeshi na watu mashuhuri wa Galilaya. Hatimaye Herodia alipata wasaa aliokuwa akiutafuta.

english: When the daughter of Herodias came and danced, she pleased Herod and his guests, and the king said to the girl, “Ask me for whatever you wish, and I will give it to you.”
ekegusii: Erio omoiseke bwe Herodia gasoa gotenga, akagokia Herode amo nabwo baikaransete nere ase omoyega. Omorwoti agateebia omoiseke oria, “Nsabe kende gionsi ekio origetie, na inche ninkoe.”
swahili: Binti yake Herodia alipoingia na kucheza, akamfurahisha Herode pamoja na wageni wake walioalikwa chakulani. Mfalme Herode akamwambia yule binti, “Niombe kitu chochote utakacho, nami nitakupa.”

english: And he swore to her, “Whatever you ask of me, I will give you, up to half my kingdom!”
ekegusii: Akamoriera eira, “Kende gionsi ekio orarigie korwa ase ’nde ninkoe, nonya nekeng’ese ki’oborwoti bwane.”
swahili: Tena akamwahidi kwa kiapo, akamwambia, “Chochote utakachoomba nitakupa, hata kama ni nusu ya ufalme wangu.”

english: Then she went out and asked her mother, “What should I request?” And her mother answered, “The head of John the Baptist.”
ekegusii: Omoiseke oria agasoka, akaboria ng’ina, “Inki ’ndasabe?” Ng’ina akamoiraneria, “Omotwe o Yohana Omobatisi.”
swahili: Yule binti akatoka nje, akaenda kumuuliza mama yake, “Niombe nini?” Mama yake akamjibu, “Omba kichwa cha Yohana Mbatizaji.”

english: At once the girl hurried back to the king with her request: “I want you to give me the head of John the Baptist on a platter immediately.”
ekegusii: Erio kegima agasoa nomoayerero ase obosio bw’omorwoti, agasaba, akabora, “Nindigetie ong’e omotwe o Yohana Omobatisi bono iga ase esani.”
swahili: Yule binti akarudi haraka kwa mfalme, akamwambia, “Nataka unipe sasa hivi kichwa cha Yohana Mbatizaji kwenye sinia.”

english: The king was consumed with sorrow, but because of his oaths and his guests, he did not want to refuse her.
ekegusii: Omorwoti akaba nomoichano mono, korende ase engencho ye chiira chiaye, na ase engencho y’abwo baikaransete ase omoyega, tarigetie kwanga.
swahili: Mfalme akasikitika sana, lakini kwa sababu alikuwa ameapa viapo mbele ya wageni wake, hakutaka kumkatalia.

english: So without delay, the king commanded that John’s head be brought in. He sent an executioner, who went and beheaded him in the prison.
ekegusii: Erio kegima omorwoti agatoma omorwani oyomo, agachiika ng’a omotwe o Yohana orentwe. Omorwani oria akagenda akamonacha omotwe aria echela ime,
swahili: Mara mfalme akatuma askari mmojawapo wa walinzi wake kukileta kichwa cha Yohana. Akaenda na kumkata Yohana kichwa humo gerezani,

english: The man brought John’s head on a platter and presented it to the girl, who gave it to her mother.
ekegusii: akayorenta ore ase esani, akayoa omoiseke oria, na omoiseke oria akayoa ng’ina.
swahili: akakileta kichwa chake kwenye sinia na kumpa yule msichana, naye yule msichana akampa mama yake.

english: When John’s disciples heard about this, they came and took his body and placed it in a tomb. The Feeding of the Five Thousand (Matthew 14:13–21; Luke 9:10–17; John 6:1–15)
ekegusii: Ekero aborokigwa ba Yohana baigwete amang’ana aya, bakagenda bakabogoria egetondo, bakagetindeka. Yeso okorageria abanto chilifu isano (Mat 14:13-14; Luk 9:10; Mat 14:15-21; Luk 9:11-17; Yoh 6:1-13)
swahili: Wanafunzi wa Yohana walipopata habari hizi, wakaja na kuuchukua mwili wake, wakauzika kaburini. Yesu Awalisha Wanaume 5,000 (Mathayo 14:13-21; Luka 9:10-17; Yohana 6:1-14)

english: Isn’t this the carpenter, the son of Mary and the brother of James, Joses, Judas, and Simon? Aren’t His sisters here with us as well?” And they took offense at Him.
ekegusii: Oyo tari oria omobaachi, omwana o Mariamu, momura omwabo Yakobo, na Yose, na Yuda, na Simioni, na basubati bamwabo tibari aiga seito?” Bakagechigwa nere.
swahili: Huyu si yule seremala, mwana wa Maria? Na ndugu zake si Yakobo, Yose, Yuda na Simoni? Dada zake wote si tuko nao hapa kwetu?” Nao wakachukizwa sana kwa ajili yake, wakakataa kumwamini.

english: Meanwhile, the apostles gathered around Jesus and brought Him news of all they had done and taught.
ekegusii: Abatomwa bakairana ase Yeso, bakamoteebia onsi ayabakorete, na amang’ana onsi aya aborokereretie.
swahili: Wale mitume wakakusanyika kwa Yesu na kumpa taarifa ya mambo yote waliyokuwa wamefanya na kufundisha.

english: And He said to them, “Come with Me privately to a solitary place, and let us rest for a while.” For many people were coming and going, and they did not even have time to eat.
ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Inchuo inwe mweka, togende aase abanto batari, motimoke ake.” Inaki abanto abange mbarengeo, bagocha na bakogenda; goika Yeso n’aborokigwa baye tibanyora ribaga ri’okoria.
swahili: Basi kwa kuwa watu wengi mno walikuwa wakija na kutoka, hata wakawa hawana nafasi ya kula, Yesu akawaambia wanafunzi wake, “Twendeni peke yetu mahali pa faragha, mpate kupumzika.”

english: So they went away in a boat by themselves to a solitary place.
ekegusii: Bakagenda ase obwato, aase abobisi, atari nabaanto.
swahili: Hivyo wakaondoka kwa mashua peke yao, wakaenda mahali pasipo na watu.

english: But many people saw them leaving and recognized them. They ran together on foot from all the towns and arrived before them.
ekegusii: Abanto bakabarora bakogenda, abange ase abwo bakabamanya, bakaminyoka bwango korwa ase emechie yonsi, batang’ane goika asare.
swahili: Lakini watu wengi waliowaona wakiondoka, wakawatambua, nao wakaenda haraka kwa miguu kutoka miji yote, nao wakatangulia kufika.

english: When Jesus stepped ashore and saw a large crowd, He had compassion on them, because they were like sheep without a shepherd. And He began to teach them many things.
ekegusii: Yeso agachia goika korwa ase obwato, akarora omoganda omonene, akabarorera amaabera, ekiagera barenge buna ching’ondi chitari nomorisia: agachaaka koborokereria amang’ana amange.
swahili: Yesu alipofika kando ya bahari, aliona makutano makubwa ya watu, akawahurumia kwa maana walikuwa kama kondoo wasiokuwa na mchungaji. Kwa hiyo akaanza kuwafundisha mambo mengi.

english: By now the hour was already late. So the disciples came to Jesus and said, “This is a desolate place, and the hour is already late.
ekegusii: Goika chinsa chinyinge chi’omobaso chigaeta, aborokigwa baye bakamochiera, bakaboora, “Aase aa negesomo, na bono riagorobire.
swahili: Mchana ulipokuwa umeendelea sana, wanafunzi wake walienda kwake, wakamwambia, “Mahali hapa ni nyikani, nazo saa zimekwenda sana.

english: Dismiss the crowd so they can go to the surrounding countryside and villages and buy themselves something to eat.”
ekegusii: Kae abanto aba ribaga, erinde bagende emechie na ebinyoro, aria na aaria, begorere endagera.”
swahili: Waage watu ili waende mashambani na vijijini jirani, wakajinunulie chakula.”

english: But Jesus told them, “You give them something to eat.” They asked Him, “Should we go out and spend two hundred denarii to give all of them bread to eat?”
ekegusii: Korende Yeso akabairaneria, “Inwe bae endagera.” Bakamobooria “Inee! Togende togore emegati ye chidinari amagana abere, tobae barie?”
swahili: Lakini Yesu akawajibu, “Ninyi wapeni chakula.” Wakamwambia, “Je, twende tukanunue mikate ya dinari 200 ili tuwape watu hawa wale?”

english: “Go and see how many loaves you have,” He told them. And after checking, they said, “Five—and two fish.”
ekegusii: Akababoria, “Emegati nerenga mobwate? Genda morore!” Bagachia komanya bakaboora, “Netano, ne chinswe ibere.”
swahili: Akawauliza, “Kuna mikate mingapi? Nendeni mkaangalie.” Walipokwisha kujua wakarudi, wakamwambia, “Kuna mikate mitano na samaki wawili.”

english: Then Jesus directed them to have the people sit in groups on the green grass.
ekegusii: Yeso akabachiika aborokigwa baye baabaikaransie bonsi, ebiombe, ebiombe, ase obonyansi obobese.
swahili: Kisha Yesu akawaamuru wawaketishe watu makundi makundi kwenye majani,

english: Then Jesus said to them, “Only in his hometown, among his relatives, and in his own household is a prophet without honor.”
ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia, “Omobani takomocha gosikwa, otatiga ase ense yaye, na ase eamate yaye, na ase enka yaye.”
swahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Nabii hakosi heshima isipokuwa katika mji wake mwenyewe, na miongoni mwa jamaa na ndugu zake, na nyumbani kwake.”

english: So they sat down in groups of hundreds and fifties.
ekegusii: Bagaikaransa ase chindwaro, echinde rigana erimo na echinde emerongo etano.
swahili: nao wakaketi kwenye makundi ya watu mia mia na wengine hamsini hamsini.

english: Taking the five loaves and the two fish and looking up to heaven, Jesus spoke a blessing and broke the loaves. Then He gave them to His disciples to set before the people. And He divided the two fish among them all.
ekegusii: Erio Yeso akabogoria emegati eria etano ne chinswe chiria ibere, akarigereria igoro, akabisesenia, agasamunyora emegati eria, akaa aborokigwa baye babiterekere abanto, ne chinswe chiria ibere, akabagabera bonsi.
swahili: Yesu akaichukua ile mikate mitano na wale samaki wawili, akainua macho yake akatazama mbinguni, akavibariki na kuimega ile mikate. Kisha akawapa wanafunzi wake ili wawagawie wale watu wote. Pia akawagawia wote wale samaki wawili.

english: They all ate and were satisfied,
ekegusii: Bonsi bakaria, bakaigota.
swahili: Watu wote wakala, wakashiba.

english: and the disciples picked up twelve basketfuls of broken pieces of bread and fish.
ekegusii: Bagasangereria ebisamunye biasamunyogete, na ebio bigaichoria ebitonga ikomi na bibere, naboigo nebisamunye bie chinswe.
swahili: Nao wanafunzi wake wakakusanya vipande vilivyosalia vya mikate na samaki, wakajaza vikapu kumi na viwili.

english: And there were five thousand men who had eaten the loaves. Jesus Walks on Water (Matthew 14:22–33; John 6:16–21)
ekegusii: Na abasacha abariete emegati eria nigo barenge chilifu isano. Yeso ogotaara ase enyancha igoro (Mat 14:22-27; Yoh 6:16-21)
swahili: Idadi ya wanaume waliokula walikuwa 5,000. Yesu Atembea Juu Ya Maji (Mathayo 14:22-33; Yohana 6:15-21)

english: Immediately Jesus made His disciples get into the boat and go on ahead of Him to Bethsaida, while He dismissed the crowd.
ekegusii: Erio Yeso akabetereria aborokigwa baye bariine obwato, bamotang’anere kogenda ng’umbu goika Bethisaida ekero are koa omoganda ribaga ogende.
swahili: Mara Yesu akawaambia wanafunzi wake waingie kwenye mashua watangulie kwenda Bethsaida, wakati yeye alikuwa akiwaaga wale makutano.

english: After bidding them farewell, He went up on the mountain to pray.
ekegusii: Magega gakorire gokwana nabarabwo, akagenda egetunwa gosaba.
swahili: Baada ya kuwaaga wale watu, akaenda mlimani kuomba.

english: When evening came, the boat was in the middle of the sea, and Jesus was alone on land.
ekegusii: Riachia koba mogoroba, obwato bokaba enyancha gati, na ere bweka ase ense enyomo.
swahili: Ilipofika jioni, ile mashua ilikuwa imefika katikati ya bahari, na Yesu alikuwa peke yake katika nchi kavu.

english: He could see that the disciples were straining to row, because the wind was against them. About the fourth watch of the night, Jesus went out to them, walking on the sea. He intended to pass by them,
ekegusii: Akabarora bagwechanda bagwata amaache nemegango, ekiagera omwaga nigo obatangete. Koreng’ana ekero ki’oborendi bwa kane bwa botuko agacha ase bare, ogotaara igoro ase enyancha, akarigia kobaetania.
swahili: Akawaona wanafunzi wake wanahangaika na kupiga makasia kwa nguvu, kwa sababu upepo ulikuwa wa mbisho. Wakati wa zamu ya nne ya usiku, Yesu akawaendea wanafunzi wake, akiwa anatembea juu ya maji. Alikuwa karibu kuwapita,

english: but when they saw Him walking on the sea, they cried out, thinking He was a ghost—
ekegusii: Barabwo bagachia komorora ogotaara ase enyancha igoro, bagakaga ng’a nerirengari, bagaaka eriogi,
swahili: lakini walipomwona akitembea juu ya maji, wakadhani ni mzimu. Wakapiga yowe,

english: So He could not perform any miracles there, except to lay His hands on a few of the sick and heal them.
ekegusii: Gose tanyara gokora ogokora gwe chinguru aroro, otatiga abegete amaboko aye igoro ase abarwaire bake, akabagwenia.
swahili: Hakufanya miujiza yoyote huko isipokuwa kuweka mikono yake juu ya wagonjwa wachache na kuwaponya.

english: for they all saw Him and were terrified. But Jesus spoke up at once: “Take courage! It is I. Do not be afraid.”
ekegusii: ekiagera bonsi abamorooche mbaondogete. Bwango Yeso agakwana nabarabwo, akabateebia, “Remia chinkoro! Ninche. Timoiroka!”
swahili: kwa sababu wote walipomwona waliogopa. Mara Yesu akasema nao, akawaambia, “Jipeni moyo! Ni mimi. Msiogope!”

english: Then He climbed into the boat with them, and the wind died down. And the disciples were utterly astounded,
ekegusii: Akariina ime ase obwato ase bare; omwaga ogakira. Aborokigwa bagaichana mono,
swahili: Akapanda ndani ya mashua nao, na ule upepo ukakoma! Wakashangaa kabisa,

english: for they had not understood about the loaves, but their hearts had been hardened. Jesus Heals at Gennesaret (Matthew 14:34–36)
ekegusii: ekiagera tibamanyete amang’ana y’emegati eria, korende chinkoro chiabo nigo chiarenge chinkong’u. Yeso okogwenia abanto ba Genesareti (Mat 14:34-36)
swahili: kwa kuwa walikuwa hawajaelewa kuhusu ile mikate. Mioyo yao ilikuwa migumu.

english: When they had crossed over, they landed at Gennesaret and moored the boat.
ekegusii: Ekero bambokire bagaika ense ya Genesareti, bakabeeka ekeroochi.
swahili: Walipokwisha kuvuka, wakafika nchi ya Genesareti, wakatia nanga.

english: As soon as they got out of the boat, the people recognized Jesus
ekegusii: Bagachia gosoka korwa ase obwato, abanto bakamanya Yeso bwango,
swahili: Mara waliposhuka kutoka mashua yao, watu wakamtambua Yesu.

english: and ran through that whole region, carrying the sick on mats to wherever they heard He was.
ekegusii: bakaminyoka, bagaetanana ense eria yonsi, bagachaaka kobogoria abarwaire bare ase amarere abo, bakagenda kera aase baigwete ng’a nao are.
swahili: Wakaenda katika vijiji vyote upesi, wakawabeba wagonjwa kwenye mikeka ili kuwapeleka mahali popote waliposikia kuwa Yesu yupo.

english: And wherever He went—villages and towns and countrysides—they laid the sick in the marketplaces and begged Him just to let them touch the fringe of His cloak. And all who touched Him were healed.
ekegusii: Kera aase are kogenda ase ebinyoro, gose emechie, gose emegondo, bakabeeka abarwaire ase chichiiro, bakamosorora ng’a abae ribaga bakune nonya nomokoba bw’eanga yaye; na abwo bonsi abamokunete bakagwena.
swahili: Kila mahali Yesu alipokwenda, iwe vijijini, mijini au mashambani, watu waliwaweka wagonjwa wao masokoni. Wakamwomba awaruhusu hao wagonjwa waguse japo upindo wa vazi lake. Nao wote waliomgusa waliponywa.

english: And He was amazed at their unbelief. And He went around from village to village, teaching the people. The Ministry of the Twelve (Matthew 10:5–15; Luke 9:1–6)
ekegusii: Agakumia ase engencho y’ogotegena kwabo. Yeso Ogotoma Abatomwa ikomi na babere (Mat 10:5-15; Luk 9:1-6) Agaetanana ase ebinyoro biaetanaineo okworokereria.
swahili: Naye akashangazwa sana kwa jinsi wasivyokuwa na imani. Yesu Awatuma Wale Kumi Na Wawili (Mathayo 10:5-15; Luka 9:1-6) Kisha Yesu akawa anakwenda kutoka kijiji kimoja hadi kingine akifundisha.

english: Then Jesus called the Twelve to Him and began to send them out two by two, giving them authority over unclean spirits.
ekegusii: Akarangeria baria ikomi na babere, agachaaka kobatoma babere babere, akabaa okobua igoro ase ebirecha bi’eubi;
swahili: Akawaita wale kumi na wawili, akawatuma wawili wawili, na kuwapa mamlaka kutoa pepo wachafu.

english: He instructed them to take nothing but a staff for the journey—no bread, no bag, no money in their belts—
ekegusii: akabakaania tibaira gento ase orogendo rwabo, otatiga enyimbo yoka. Tibaira nonya nomogati, nonya nesaro, nonya nechitaabu ase ebimoya biabo.
swahili: Akawaagiza akisema, “Msichukue chochote kwa ajili ya safari isipokuwa fimbo tu. Msichukue mkate, wala mkoba, wala fedha kwenye mikanda yenu.

english: and to wear sandals, but not a second tunic.
ekegusii: Korende babeeke ebikoroto, ko tibeboyia chianga ibere.
swahili: Vaeni viatu, lakini msivae nguo ya ziada.”

english: Then the Pharisees and some of the scribes who had come from Jerusalem gathered around Jesus,
ekegusii: Erio Abafarisai na abande ase aborokia b’amariiko barwete Yerusalemu, bagasangererekana asare.
swahili: Mafarisayo na baadhi ya walimu wa sheria waliokuwa wametoka Yerusalemu wakakusanyika mbele ya Yesu.

english: For Moses said, ‘Honor your father and your mother’ and ‘Anyone who curses his father or mother must be put to death.’
ekegusii: Inaki Musa nigo ateebete: Sika iso na nyoko, na: Oyorakwane bobe ase ise, gose ase ng’ina, ogokwa nakwe.
swahili: Kwa mfano, Mose alisema, ‘Waheshimu baba yako na mama yako,’ na, ‘Yeyote amtukanaye baba yake au mama yake, na auawe.’

english: But you say that if a man says to his father or mother, ‘Whatever you would have received from me is Corban’ (that is, a gift devoted to God),
ekegusii: Korende inwe moteeba: Omonto karateebie ise gose ng’ina: Bionsi ebi anga kwanyora korwa ase ’nde nakio Korbani (engencho yaye: Ebiarurwe ase Nyasae) —
swahili: Lakini ninyi mwafundisha kwamba mtu akimwambia baba yake au mama yake, ‘Kile ambacho ningeweza kukusaidia ni Korbani’ (yaani kimewekwa wakfu kwa Mungu),

english: he is no longer permitted to do anything for his father or mother.
ekegusii: timori komotiga naende amokorere ise gose ng’ina ring’ana rinde.
swahili: basi hawajibiki tena kumsaidia baba yake au mama yake.

english: Thus you nullify the word of God by the tradition you have handed down. And you do so in many such matters.” What Defiles a Man (Matthew 15:10–20)
ekegusii: Igo mogosaria ring’ana ria Nyasae ase chingencho chiaino chia kare. Naende amange mwakorire mware koenana omogwekano bw’ayio.”
swahili: Kwa njia hiyo ninyi mnabatilisha neno la Mungu kwa mapokeo yenu mliyojiwekea. Nanyi mnafanya mambo mengi ya aina hiyo.”

english: Once again Jesus called the crowd to Him and said, “All of you, listen to Me and understand:
ekegusii: Erio Yeso akarangeria omoganda naende, akayoteebia, “Nyigwe mwensi, naende manya:
swahili: Yesu akaita tena ule umati wa watu, akawaambia, “Nisikilizeni, kila mmoja wenu na mwelewe jambo hili.

english: Nothing that enters a man from the outside can defile him; but the things that come out of a man, these are what defile him.”
ekegusii: Tari egento kere isiko y’omonto, na gekomosoa, keranyare komobekera ogotacheneka, korende ebikorwa ase omonto nabio bikomobekera ogotacheneka. [
swahili: Hakuna kitu kinachomwingia mtu kimtiacho unajisi, lakini kile kimtokacho ndicho kimtiacho unajisi. [

english: After Jesus had left the crowd and gone into the house, His disciples inquired about the parable.
ekegusii: Goika agachia gosoa nyomba, gatigire omoganda, aborokigwa baye bakamobooria amang’ana y’omobayeeno oria.
swahili: Akiisha kuuacha ule umati wa watu na kuingia ndani, wanafunzi wake wakamuuliza maana ya mfano ule.

english: “Are you still so dull?” He asked. “Do you not understand? Nothing that enters a man from the outside can defile him,
ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Nonya ninwe timori nobong’aini? Timomanyeti ng’a kera egento kere isiko y’omonto gokeramosoe, tigekonyara komobekera ogotacheneka,
swahili: Akawajibu, “Je, hata nanyi hamwelewi? Je, hamfahamu kwamba kitu kimwingiacho mtu hakimtii unajisi?

english: because it does not enter his heart, but it goes into the stomach and then is eliminated.” (Thus all foods are clean.)
ekegusii: ekiagera tigekomosoa enkoro, otatiga ase enda yoka, erio kiagwa kebara?” (Ase ogoteeba igo, osibirie chindagera chionsi.)
swahili: Mtu akila kitu hakiingii moyoni mwake bali tumboni, na baadaye hutolewa nje ya mwili wake.” (Kwa kusema hivi, Yesu alivihalalisha vyakula vyote kuwa ni “safi.”)

english: and they saw some of His disciples eating with hands that were defiled—that is, unwashed.
ekegusii: Bakarora abande baborokigwa baye bakoragera namaboko are neriko, engencho yaye ataisabiri.
swahili: Wakawaona baadhi ya wanafunzi wake wakila chakula kwa mikono iliyo najisi, yaani, bila kunawa kama ilivyotakiwa na sheria ya dini ya Wayahudi.

english: He continued: “What comes out of a man, that is what defiles him.
ekegusii: Akabora “Ekegosoka korwa ase omonto nakio gekomobekera ogotacheneka.
swahili: Akaendelea kusema, “Kile kimtokacho mtu ndicho kimtiacho unajisi.

english: For from within the hearts of men come evil thoughts, sexual immorality, theft, murder, adultery,
ekegusii: Ekiagera ime ase chinkoro chi’ abanto nigo bikorwao ebirengererio ebibe, obonyaka, oboibi, oboiti, obotomani,
swahili: Kwa maana kutoka ndani ya moyo wa mtu hutoka mawazo mabaya, uasherati, wizi, uuaji, uzinzi,

english: greed, wickedness, deceit, debauchery, envy, slander, arrogance, and foolishness.
ekegusii: okogania okobe, obobe, obong’ainereria, oboenenu, ribero, oborami, obwerori, oboriri.
swahili: tamaa mbaya, uovu, udanganyifu, ufisadi, wivu, matukano, kiburi na upumbavu.

english: All these evils come from within, and these are what defile a man.” The Faith of the Gentile Woman (Matthew 15:21–28)
ekegusii: Aya onsi amabe nigo akorwa ime, naro akobekera omonto ogotacheneka.” Okwegena kw’omokuungu oyomo (Mat 15:21-28)
swahili: Maovu haya yote hutoka ndani ya mtu, nayo ndiyo yamtiayo mtu unajisi.” Imani Ya Mwanamke Msirofoinike (Mathayo 15:21-28)

english: Jesus left that place and went to the region of Tyre. Not wanting anyone to know He was there, He entered a house, but was unable to escape their notice.
ekegusii: Yeso akaimoka korwa aria, akagenda goika omochie o Turo. Agasoa ase enyomba, akarigia tamanyekana na monto, korende tanyara kobiseka.
swahili: Ndipo Yesu akaondoka hapo akaenda sehemu za Tiro. Akaingia katika nyumba moja, naye hakutaka mtu yeyote ajue kwamba yuko humo. Lakini hakuweza kujificha.

english: Instead, a woman whose little daughter had an unclean spirit soon heard about Jesus, and she came and fell at His feet.
ekegusii: Erio agwo omokungu oyomo, omwana oye enyaroka obwatire nekerecha ki’eubi, akaigwa amang’ana aye, agacha akamogwera ase amagoro aye.
swahili: Mara mwanamke mmoja, ambaye binti yake mdogo alikuwa na pepo mchafu, akaja na kumpigia magoti miguuni pake.

english: Now she was a Greek woman of Syrophoenician origin, and she kept asking Jesus to drive the demon out of her daughter.
ekegusii: Omokungu oria n’Omogiriki orenge, egesaku kiaye n’Omosurofenisia. Akamosaba amosererie ekerecha korwa ase enyaroka yaye.
swahili: Basi huyo mwanamke alikuwa Myunani, aliyezaliwa Foinike ya Siria. Akamsihi Yesu amtoe binti yake huyo pepo mchafu.

english: “First let the children have their fill,” He said. “For it is not right to take the children’s bread and toss it to the dogs.”
ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Tiga abana baigote ritang’ani, ekiagera tari buya kobogoria endagera y’abana, gotugutera chisese.”
swahili: Yesu akamwambia, “Waache watoto washibe kwanza, kwa maana si vyema kuchukua chakula cha watoto na kuwatupia mbwa.”

english: “Yes, Lord,” she replied, “even the dogs under the table eat the children’s crumbs.”
ekegusii: Korende omokungu oria akamoiraneria, “Nab’Omonene, nonya nechisese nyaro ye chimesa nigo chikoria amatori y’abana.”
swahili: Lakini yule mwanamke akamjibu, “Bwana, hata mbwa walio chini ya meza hula makombo ya chakula cha watoto.”

english: Then Jesus told her, “Because of this answer, you may go. The demon has left your daughter.”
ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Ase engencho ye ring’ana eri, genda bwoo, ekerecha kiarure ase enyaroka yao.”
swahili: Ndipo Yesu akamjibu, “Kwa sababu ya jibu lako, nenda zako nyumbani; yule pepo mchafu amemtoka binti yako.”

english: Now in holding to the tradition of the elders, the Pharisees and all the Jews do not eat until they wash their hands ceremonially.
ekegusii: (Inaki Abafarisai na Abayahudi bonsi tibakoragera ritang’ani bataraisaba amaboko. Igo babwatetie engencho y’abagaaka babo.
swahili: (Kwa kuwa Mafarisayo na Wayahudi wote hawali chakula pasipo kunawa kwa kufuata desturi za wazee wao.

english: And she went home and found her child lying on the bed, and the demon was gone. The Deaf and Mute Man (Matthew 9:27–34)
ekegusii: Akagenda mwaye, akanyora omwana oria bwareirie borere, na ekerecha keria kiamorure. Yeso Okogwenia omonto orenge omotiino naende rimama (Mat 15:29-31)
swahili: Akaenda zake nyumbani akamkuta binti yake amelala kitandani, yule pepo mchafu akiwa amemtoka. Yesu Amponya Mtu Aliyekuwa Kiziwi Na Bubu

english: Then Jesus left the region of Tyre and went through Sidon to the Sea of Galilee and into the region of the Decapolis.
ekegusii: Erio Yeso akarua agwo ase ensemo ya Turo, agaeta gati‐gati ya Sidoni, akagenda goika enyancha ya Galili, egati y’ensemo ya Dekapoli.
swahili: Kisha Yesu akaondoka sehemu za Tiro, akapita katikati ya Sidoni, hadi Bahari ya Galilaya na kuingia eneo la Dekapoli.

english: Some people brought to Him a man who was deaf and hardly able to speak, and they begged Jesus to place His hand on him.
ekegusii: Bakamorentera omonto ore omotiino, naende nigo are gotutura kagokwana; bagasorora Yeso abeeke okoboko kwaye igoro asare.
swahili: Huko, watu wakamletea Yesu mtu mmoja kiziwi, ambaye pia alikuwa na kigugumizi, wakamwomba aweke mkono wake juu ya huyo mtu na amponye.

english: So Jesus took him aside privately, away from the crowd, and put His fingers into the man’s ears. Then He spit and touched the man’s tongue.
ekegusii: Yeso akamwatanana korwa ase omoganda bobisi, akabeeka ebiara biaye ase amato aye, agatwa amate, akamokuna oromeme.
swahili: Baadaye Yesu akampeleka yule kiziwi kando mbali na watu, Yesu akatia vidole vyake masikioni mwa yule mtu. Kisha akatema mate na kuugusa ulimi wa yule mtu.

english: And looking up to heaven, He sighed deeply and said to him, “Ephphatha!” (which means, “Be opened!”).
ekegusii: Erio akarigereria gochia igoro, agaita egekoe, akamoteebia, “Efatha,” engencho yaye, “Igoreka.”
swahili: Ndipo Yesu akatazama mbinguni, akavuta hewa ndani kwa nguvu akamwambia, “Efatha!” (yaani, “Funguka!” )

english: Immediately the man’s ears were opened and his tongue was released, and he began to speak plainly.
ekegusii: Bwango amato aye agatiinoka, egesibo ki’oromeme rwaye gekororoba, agakwana buya.
swahili: Mara masikio yake yakafunguka na ulimi wake ukaachiliwa, akaanza kuongea sawasawa.

english: Jesus ordered them not to tell anyone. But the more He ordered them, the more widely they proclaimed it.
ekegusii: Yeso akabatianera tibateebia monto, korende buna amentete kobakania, naboigo bamentete koraria amang’ana aya.
swahili: Yesu akawaamuru wasimwambie mtu yeyote habari hizi. Lakini kadiri alivyowazuia, ndivyo walivyozidi kutangaza kwa bidii.

english: The people were utterly astonished and said, “He has done all things well! He makes even the deaf hear and the mute speak!”
ekegusii: Abanto bagakumia mono kobua, bakaboora, “Okorire onsi buya. Abarenge emetiino obatiinoire, na abarenge amamama bakwane.”
swahili: Walistaajabu mno. Wakasema, “Amefanya mambo yote vizuri mno! Amewawezesha viziwi wasikie na bubu waseme!”

english: And on returning from the market, they do not eat unless they wash. And there are many other traditions for them to observe, including the washing of cups, pitchers, kettles, and couches for dining.
ekegusii: Naende kobakorwa echiiro, tibakoria batesibetie. Naende nchire chingencho chinde babwate buna ogosibia ebikombe ne chinyongo, na ebinto bie chitaai.)
swahili: Wanapotoka sokoni hawawezi kula pasipo kunawa. Pia kuna desturi nyingine nyingi wanazofuata kama vile jinsi ya kuosha vikombe, vyungu na vyombo vya shaba.)

english: So the Pharisees and scribes questioned Jesus: “Why do Your disciples not walk according to the tradition of the elders? Instead, they eat with defiled hands.”
ekegusii: Bono Abafarisai baria na aborokia b’amariiko bakabooria Yeso, “Nase ki aborokigwa bao batari kobwata chingencho chi’abagaaka, korende bakoragera namaboko are neriko?”
swahili: Kwa hiyo wale Mafarisayo na walimu wa sheria wakamuuliza Yesu, “Mbona wanafunzi wako hawafuati desturi za wazee, na badala yake wanakula kwa mikono najisi?”

english: Jesus answered them, “Isaiah prophesied correctly about you hypocrites, as it is written: ‘These people honor Me with their lips, but their hearts are far from Me.
ekegusii: Yeso akabateebia Isaya nigo abaanete buya igoro yaino, inwe abang’ainereria, buna eriikire; Abanto aba nigo bansigete ase ebikoba biabo igoro, korende chinkoro chiabo nigo chire aare korwa ase ’nde.
swahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Nabii Isaya alisema ukweli alipotabiri juu yenu, ninyi wanafiki. Kama ilivyoandikwa: “ ‘Watu hawa huniheshimu kwa midomo yao, lakini mioyo yao iko mbali nami.

english: They worship Me in vain; they teach as doctrine the precepts of men.’
ekegusii: Abwo nigo bagonsasiima ogosasiima kwa bosa, bakworokereria amorokererio ayare amachiiko a Mwanyabaanto oka.
swahili: Huniabudu bure, nayo mafundisho yao ni maagizo ya wanadamu tu.’

english: You have disregarded the commandment of God to keep the tradition of men. ”
ekegusii: Igo mogotiga richiiko ria Nyasae, mwabwata chingencho chia Mwanyabaanto.
swahili: Ninyi mmeziacha amri za Mungu na kushika desturi za watu.”

english: He went on to say, “You neatly set aside the command of God to maintain your own tradition.
ekegusii: Yeso akagenderera kobateebia, “Mwangire richiiko ria Nyasae ng’a monyare kobwata chingencho chiaino.
swahili: Naye akawaambia, “Ninyi mnayo njia nzuri ya kukataa amri za Mungu ili mpate kuyashika mapokeo yenu!

english: In those days the crowd once again became very large, and they had nothing to eat. Jesus called the disciples to Him and said,
ekegusii: Ase amatuko aria ekero omoganda omonene osangererekanete, na barabwo tibarenge na gento bakoria, Yeso akarangeria aborokigwa baye, akabateebia,
swahili: Katika siku hizo, umati mkubwa wa watu ulikusanyika tena. Kwa kuwa walikuwa hawana chakula, Yesu akawaita wanafunzi wake akawaambia,

english: He got into the boat with His disciples and went to the district of Dalmanutha. The Demand for a Sign (Matthew 16:1–4; Luke 12:54–56)
ekegusii: Akabaa ribaga bagende, na erio bwango akariina obwato amo naborokigwa baye, akagenda chinsemo chia Dalumanuta. Abafarisai bakoboria baorokigwe egekone (Mat 16:1-4; Luk 12:54-56)
swahili: aliingia kwenye mashua pamoja na wanafunzi wake, akaenda sehemu za Dalmanutha. Mafarisayo Waomba Ishara (Mathayo 12:38-42; 16:1-4)

english: Then the Pharisees came and began to argue with Jesus, testing Him by demanding from Him a sign from heaven.
ekegusii: Abafarisai bakaoroka, bagachaaka koamererania na Yeso, bakarigia aborokie egekone buna ekemanyererio korwa igoro, bakomoteema.
swahili: Mafarisayo wakaja, wakaanza kumhoji Yesu. Ili kumtega, wakamwomba awaonyeshe ishara kutoka mbinguni.

english: Jesus sighed deeply in His spirit and said, “Why does this generation demand a sign? Truly I tell you, no sign will be given to this generation.”
ekegusii: Agaichana ase omoika oye, akabora, “Inaki ekegori eke gekorigia egekone? Ekeene nabateebirie: Ekegori eke tigekoegwa egekone buna eke.”
swahili: Akahuzunika moyoni, akawaambia, “Kwa nini kizazi hiki kinataka ishara? Amin nawaambieni, hakitapewa ishara yoyote.”

english: And He left them, got back into the boat, and crossed to the other side. The Leaven of the Pharisees and of Herod (Matthew 16:5–12; Luke 12:1–3)
ekegusii: Akabatiga, akariina obwato naende, akamboka ng’umbu. Yeso ogotogonyera obouko bw’aborokigwa (Mat 16:5-12)
swahili: Kisha akawaacha, akarudi kwenye mashua, akavuka hadi ngʼambo. Chachu Ya Mafarisayo Na Ya Herode (Mathayo 16:5-12)

english: Now the disciples had forgotten to take bread, except for one loaf they had with them in the boat.
ekegusii: Aborokigwa bakeeba koirana emegati; nonya nase obwato tibarenge na gento, otatiga omogati oyomo bwoka.
swahili: Wanafunzi walikuwa wamesahau kuchukua mikate ya kutosha. Walikuwa na mkate mmoja tu kwenye mashua.

english: “Watch out!” He cautioned them. “Beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and of Herod.”
ekegusii: Yeso akabachiika, akabora, “Rigereria, mwerende nememera y’Abafarisai na ememera ya Herode.”
swahili: Yesu akawaonya: “Jihadharini na chachu ya Mafarisayo na ya Herode.”

english: So they began to discuss with one another the fact that they had no bread.
ekegusii: Bakaamererania barabwo ase barabwo, bakobora, “Nigo agokwana igo ase engencho totari n’emegati.”
swahili: Wakajadiliana wao kwa wao, na kusema, “Anasema hivi kwa sababu hatukuleta mikate.”

english: Aware of their conversation, Jesus asked them, “Why are you debating about having no bread? Do you still not see or understand? Do you have such hard hearts?
ekegusii: Yeso akamanya aya, akabateebia, “Inaki mokoborania, ekiagera motari nemegati? Timokoinyora gose timokomanya? Chinkoro chiaino nigo chire chinkong’u goika bono?
swahili: Yesu, akifahamu majadiliano yao, akawauliza: “Mbona mnajadiliana kuhusu kutokuwa na mikate? Je, bado hamtambui wala hamwelewi? Je, mbona mioyo yenu ni migumu kiasi hicho?

english: ‘Having eyes, do you not see? And having ears, do you not hear?’ And do you not remember?
ekegusii: ’More namaiso, ko timori korora? ’More namato, ko timori koigwa? Gose timoinyoreti?
swahili: Je, mna macho lakini mnashindwa kuona, na mna masikio lakini mnashindwa kusikia? Je, hamkumbuki?

english: When I broke the five loaves for the five thousand, how many basketfuls of broken pieces did you collect?” “Twelve,” they answered.
ekegusii: Ekero nasamunyorete emegati eria etano nkaa baria chilifu isano, ebitonga mbirenga mwasangererete biichire ebisamunye?” Bakamoteebia, “Ikomi na bibere.”
swahili: Nilipoimega ile mikate mitano kuwalisha watu 5,000, mlikusanya vikapu vingapi vilivyojaa vya masazo?” Wakamjibu, “Kumi na viwili.”

english: “I have compassion for this crowd, because they have already been with Me three days and have nothing to eat.
ekegusii: “Naroreire abanto aba amaabera, ekiagera barabwo babeire amatuko atato baikaransete amo nainche batari na gento bakoria;
swahili: “Ninauhurumia huu umati wa watu, kwa sababu sasa wamekuwa nami kwa muda wa siku tatu na hawana chakula.

english: “And when I broke the seven loaves for the four thousand, how many basketfuls of broken pieces did you collect?” “Seven,” they said.
ekegusii: “Na eria etano na ebere nkaa baria chilifu inye, ebitonga mbirenga mwasangereretie biichire ebisamunye?” Bakamoteebia, “Mbitano na bibere.”
swahili: “Je, nilipoimega ile mikate saba kuwalisha watu 4,000, mlikusanya vikapu vingapi vilivyojaa vya masazo?” Wakamjibu, “Saba.”

english: Then He asked them, “Do you still not understand?” The Blind Man at Bethsaida
ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Inaki motaramanya?” Yeso okogwenia omonto omouko agwo Bethisaida
swahili: Ndipo akawauliza, “Je, bado hamwelewi?” Yesu Amponya Kipofu Huko Bethsaida

english: When they arrived at Bethsaida, some people brought a blind man and begged Jesus to touch him.
ekegusii: Bagaika Bethisaida. Bakarentera Yeso omonto omouko, bakamosorora amokune.
swahili: Wakafika Bethsaida na baadhi ya watu wakamleta mtu mmoja kipofu wakamsihi Yesu amguse.

english: So He took the blind man by the hand and led him out of the village. Then He spit on the man’s eyes and placed His hands on him. “Can you see anything?” He asked.
ekegusii: Yeso akabwata omouko oria okoboko, akamoira isiko y’ekenyoro, Kamotwereire amate ase amaiso, akabeeka amaboko aye igoro asare, akamobooria, “Kwarorire gento?”
swahili: Yesu akamshika mkono huyo kipofu akampeleka nje ya kijiji. Baada ya kuyatemea mate macho ya yule kipofu na kumwekea mikono, Yesu akamuuliza, “Unaona chochote?”

english: The man looked up and said, “I can see the people, but they look like trees walking around.”
ekegusii: Omouko oria akarigereria igoro, akabora, “Narorire abanto, ko nigo banga buna emete bakogenda.”
swahili: Yule kipofu akaangalia, akasema, “Ninaona watu, wanaonekana kama miti inayotembea.”

english: Once again Jesus placed His hands on the man’s eyes, and when he opened them his sight was restored, and he could see everything clearly.
ekegusii: Erio naende Yeso akabeeka amaboko aye igoro ase amaiso aye. Omouko oria akarigereria mono, akagwena, akarora ebinto bionsi buya.
swahili: Yesu akamwekea tena mikono machoni. Kisha macho yake yakafunguka, kuona kwake kukarejea naye akaona kila kitu dhahiri.

english: Jesus sent him home and said, “Do not go back into the village.” Peter’s Confession of Christ (Matthew 16:13–20; Luke 9:18–20; John 6:67–71)
ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Genda bwoo, tosoa nonya nekenyoro!” Okoorokia gwa Petero ng’a Yeso nere Kristo (Mat 16:13-20; Luk 9:18-21)
swahili: Yesu akamuaga aende nyumbani kwake, akimwambia, “Hata kijijini usiingie.” Petro Amkiri Yesu Kuwa Ndiye Kristo (Mathayo 16:13-20; Luka 9:18-21)

english: Then Jesus and His disciples went on to the villages around Caesarea Philippi. On the way, He questioned His disciples: “Who do people say I am?”
ekegusii: Yeso agasoka amo naborokigwa baye, bakagenda ebinyoro bia Kaisaria Filipi. Ekero baare nchera akaboria aborokigwa baye, “Abanto nigo bakobora ng’a ninche ning’o?”
swahili: Yesu na wanafunzi wake wakaondoka kwenda katika vijiji vya Kaisaria-Filipi. Walipokuwa njiani, Yesu akawauliza, “Watu husema mimi ni nani?”

english: They replied, “Some say John the Baptist; others say Elijah; and still others, one of the prophets.”
ekegusii: Bakamoiraneria, “Yohana Omobatisi; na abande: Elija; na abande: Oyomo ase ababani.”
swahili: Wakamjibu, “Baadhi husema wewe ni Yohana Mbatizaji, wengine husema ni Eliya, na bado wengine husema wewe ni mmojawapo wa manabii.”

english: “But what about you?” Jesus asked. “Who do you say I am?” Peter answered, “You are the Christ.”
ekegusii: Akababoria, “Nainwe nigo mokobora ng’a ninche ng’o?” Petero akamoiraneria, “Aye naye Kristo.”
swahili: Akawauliza, “Je, ninyi mnasema mimi ni nani?” Petro akajibu, “Wewe ndiwe Kristo.”

english: If I send them home hungry, they will faint along the way. For some of them have come a great distance.”
ekegusii: ninsa koa abanto aba ribaga bagende chinsobo n’enchara, nabagoye ’nchera, na abande ase egati yabo ng’are barwete.”
swahili: Nikiwaaga waende nyumbani bila kula, watazimia njiani kwa sababu baadhi yao wametoka mbali.”

english: And Jesus warned them not to tell anyone about Him. Christ’s Passion Foretold (Matthew 16:21–23; Luke 9:21–22)
ekegusii: Erio Yeso akabatianera tibateebia monto amanya amang’ana aye. Yeso okobana ogokwa na okobokigwa kwaye (Mat 16:21-23; Luk 9:22)
swahili: Yesu akawaonya wasimwambie mtu yeyote habari zake. Yesu Atabiri Kifo Chake (Mathayo 16:21-28; Luka 9:22-27)

english: Then He began to teach them that the Son of Man must suffer many things and be rejected by the elders, chief priests, and scribes, and that He must be killed and after three days rise again.
ekegusii: Erio Yeso agachaaka koborokereria, ng’a negwenerete Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto anyore ogochandeka ase chinchera chinyinge, na kwangwa nabagaaka na abakuani abanene, na aborokia b’amariiko, na goitwa, na magega y’amatuko atato nabooke.
swahili: Ndipo akaanza kuwafundisha wanafunzi wake kuwa Mwana wa Adamu lazima atapata mateso mengi na kukataliwa na wazee, viongozi wa makuhani, na walimu wa sheria, na kwamba itampasa auawe lakini baada ya siku tatu afufuke.

english: He spoke this message quite frankly, and Peter took Him aside and began to rebuke Him.
ekegusii: Agakwana amang’ana aya maiso marore. Petero akamoira ensemo, agachaaka komokania.
swahili: Aliyasema haya waziwazi, ndipo Petro akamchukua kando na akaanza kumkemea.

english: But Jesus, turning and looking at His disciples, rebuked Peter and said, “Get behind Me, Satan! For you do not have in mind the things of God, but the things of men.” Take Up Your Cross (Matthew 16:24–28; Luke 9:23–27)
ekegusii: Yeso akeonchora, akarigereria aborokigwa baye, agatogonyera Petero, akabora, “Irana magega y’ane Saitani, ekiagera tori ase ensemo ya Nyasae, korende nase Mwanyabaanto.” Okorangerigwa kw’ogwekeyia omonyene (Mat 16:24-28; Luk 9:23-27)
swahili: Lakini Yesu alipogeuka na kuwaangalia wanafunzi wake, akamkemea Petro. Akasema, “Rudi nyuma yangu, Shetani! Moyo wako hauwazi yaliyo ya Mungu, bali ya wanadamu.”

english: Then Jesus called the crowd to Him along with His disciples, and He told them, “If anyone wants to come after Me, he must deny himself and take up his cross and follow Me.
ekegusii: Erio Yeso akarangeria omoganda na aborokigwa baye, akabateebia, “Oyorigetie gontunyana, tiga ekaane ere omonyene, etweke omosalaba oye, antunyane.
swahili: Ndipo akauita ule umati wa watu pamoja na wanafunzi wake, akasema, “Mtu yeyote akitaka kunifuata, ni lazima ajikane mwenyewe, auchukue msalaba wake, anifuate.

english: For whoever wants to save his life will lose it, but whoever loses his life for My sake and for the gospel will save it.
ekegusii: Inaki onde bwensi orarigie koegera obogima bwaye, oyio nabosirie; na oyorasirie obogima bwaye ase engencho y’ane, na ase engencho y’enchiri, oyio naboegere.
swahili: Kwa maana yeyote anayetaka kuyaokoa maisha yake atayapoteza, lakini yeyote atakayeyapoteza maisha yake kwa ajili yangu na kwa ajili ya Injili atayaokoa.

english: What does it profit a man to gain the whole world, yet forfeit his soul?
ekegusii: Ninki eragwenere omonto konyora ense yonsi, ko asirie omoyo oye?
swahili: Je, itamfaidi nini mtu kuupata ulimwengu wote, lakini akayapoteza maisha yake?

english: Or what can a man give in exchange for his soul?
ekegusii: Gose inki omonto ararue ribaga ri’omoyo oye?
swahili: Au mtu atatoa nini badala ya nafsi yake?

english: If anyone is ashamed of Me and My words in this adulterous and sinful generation, the Son of Man will also be ashamed of him when He comes in His Father’s glory with the holy angels.”
ekegusii: Inaki oyio oranyare kondorera obosooku inche, na amang’ana aane, ase ekegori eke ki’obotomani na ebibe, Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto namororere obosooku ere, ekero agocha n’obonene bwa Ise amo nabamalaika abachenu.”
swahili: Mtu yeyote akinionea aibu mimi na maneno yangu katika kizazi hiki cha uzinzi na dhambi, Mwana wa Adamu naye atamwonea aibu wakati atakapokuja katika utukufu wa Baba yake pamoja na malaika watakatifu.”

english: His disciples replied, “Where in this desolate place could anyone find enough bread to feed all these people?”
ekegusii: Aborokigwa baye bakamoiraneria, “Inaki omonto aranyare koigotia abanto aba, na aiga nerooro?”
swahili: Wanafunzi wake wakamjibu, “Lakini hapa nyikani tutapata wapi mikate ya kutosha kuwalisha?”

english: “How many loaves do you have?” Jesus asked. “Seven,” they replied.
ekegusii: Yeso akababoria, “Emegati nerenga mobwate?” Bakamoiraneria, “Netano na ebere.”
swahili: Yesu akawauliza, “Mna mikate mingapi?” Wakajibu, “Tuna mikate saba.”

english: And He instructed the crowd to sit down on the ground. Then He took the seven loaves, gave thanks and broke them, and gave them to His disciples to set before the people. And they distributed them to the crowd.
ekegusii: Agachiika omoganda oikaranse inse, akabogoria emegati eria etano na ebere. Kayesesenirie, akayesamunyora, akaa aborokigwa baye bayebagere abanto, na barabwo bakayegagera omoganda.
swahili: Akawaambia watu waketi chini. Akiisha kuichukua mikate saba na kushukuru, akaimega na kuwapa wanafunzi wake ili wawagawie watu. Wanafunzi wake wakafanya hivyo.

english: They also had a few small fish, and Jesus blessed them and ordered that these be set before them as well.
ekegusii: Igo barenge ne chinswe chinsinini nke igo. Gachisesenirie, akabora, “Nechi bagagere”!
swahili: Walikuwa pia na visamaki vichache, Yesu akavibariki, akawaamuru wanafunzi wake wawagawie watu.

english: The people ate and were satisfied, and the disciples picked up seven basketfuls of broken pieces that were left over.
ekegusii: Bakaria, bakaigota; bagasangereria ebisamunye ebiatigarete, ebitonga bitano na bibere.
swahili: Wale watu walikula na kutosheka. Baadaye wanafunzi wakakusanya vipande vilivyosalia, wakajaza vikapu saba.

english: And about four thousand men were present. As soon as Jesus had dismissed the crowd,
ekegusii: Na barabwo nigo barenge ang’e chilifu inye (4,000).
swahili: Watu waliokula walikuwa wapata 4,000. Akiisha kuwaaga,

english: Then Jesus said to them, “Truly I tell you, there are some standing here who will not taste death before they see the kingdom of God arrive with power.”
ekegusii: Yeso akagenderera kobateebia, “Ekeene nabateebirie: Mbare abanto bande ase aba bateneine aiga, abataetere amakweri goika barorire oborwoti bwa Nyasae bogocha ne chinguru.” Okoonchoka ekieni kwa Yeso (Mat 17:1-13; Luk 9:28-36)
