swahili: Yesu akaendelea kuwaambia, “Amin, nawaambia, kuna watu waliosimama hapa ambao hawataonja mauti kabla ya kuuona Ufalme wa Mungu ukija kwa nguvu.” Yesu Ageuka Sura (Mathayo 17:1-13; Luka 9:28-36)

english: So they kept this matter to themselves, discussing what it meant to rise from the dead.
ekegusii: Bakabwata ring’ana riria, bakaboorania barabwo ase barabwo, ng’a okoboka korwa ase abakuure, engencho yaye ninki.
swahili: Wakalihifadhi jambo hilo wao wenyewe, lakini wakawa wanajiuliza, “Huku kufufuka kwa wafu maana yake nini?”

english: And they asked Jesus, “Why do the scribes say that Elijah must come first?”
ekegusii: Bakabooria Yeso, “Nase ki aborokia b’amariiko bagoteeba ng’a negwenerete Elija ache ritang’ani?”
swahili: Wakamuuliza, “Kwa nini walimu wa sheria husema kwamba ni lazima Eliya aje kwanza?”

english: He replied, “Elijah does indeed come first, and he restores all things. Why then is it written that the Son of Man must suffer many things and be rejected?
ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Nekeene Elija ogocha ritang’ani, na koroisia onsi; korende amo naya, ekiagera ariikire ng’a Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto nachandwe namange na gochaaywa?
swahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Ni kweli, Eliya yuaja kwanza ili kutengeneza mambo yote. Mbona basi imeandikwa kwamba Mwana wa Adamu ni lazima ateseke sana na kudharauliwa?

english: But I tell you that Elijah has indeed come, and they have done to him whatever they wished, just as it is written about him.” The Boy with an Evil Spirit (Matthew 17:14–18; Luke 9:37–42)
ekegusii: Korende nabateebirie: Elija oikire gocha, na barabwo bakamokorera onsi aya barigetie, buna ariikeretwe.” Yeso Okogwenia omomura obwatire nekerecha (Mat 17:14-21; Luk 9:37-43)
swahili: Lakini ninawaambia, Eliya amekwisha kuja, nao wakamtendea walivyopenda, kama ilivyoandikwa kumhusu yeye.” Mvulana Mwenye Pepo Mchafu Aponywa (Mathayo 17:14-21; Luka 9:37-43)

english: When they returned to the other disciples, they saw a large crowd around them, and scribes arguing with them.
ekegusii: Kobaikire ase aborokigwa bande, bakarora omoganda omonene obaetanaine; aborokia b’amariiko bakaengererania nabarabwo.
swahili: Walipowafikia wale wanafunzi wengine, wakawakuta wamezungukwa na umati mkubwa wa watu na baadhi ya walimu wa sheria wakibishana nao.

english: As soon as all the people saw Jesus, they were filled with awe and ran to greet Him.
ekegusii: Erio omoganda bwonsi, ogachia korora Yeso, ogakumia mono; abwo bakamochiera bwango, bakamokwania.
swahili: Mara wale watu walipomwona Yesu, wakastaajabu sana, wakamkimbilia ili kumsalimu.

english: “What are you disputing with them?” He asked.
ekegusii: Yeso akaboria aborokigwa baye, “Ninki mokoengererania nabarabwo?”
swahili: Akawauliza wanafunzi wake, “Mnabishana nao kuhusu nini?”

english: Someone in the crowd replied, “Teacher, I brought You my son, who has a spirit that makes him mute.
ekegusii: Omonto oyomo ase omoganda akamoiraneria, “Omworokia, namorenta omomura one ase ore, obwatire nekerecha kemokorete rimama;
swahili: Mtu mmoja miongoni mwa ule umati wa watu akajibu, “Mwalimu, nilimleta kwako mwanangu ambaye ana pepo mchafu anayemfanya asiweze kuongea.

english: Whenever it seizes him, it throws him to the ground. He foams at the mouth, gnashes his teeth, and becomes rigid. I asked Your disciples to drive it out, but they were unable.”
ekegusii: ekero kiamobokire nigo gekomogaragaria inse, asokia risombogoku, na koriania amaino; ase ayio chinguru chiaye chisira. Ngakwana naborokigwa bao bageserie, tibanyara.”
swahili: Kila mara huyo pepo mchafu ampagaapo mwanangu, humwangusha chini na kumfanya atokwe povu mdomoni na kusaga meno, kisha mwili wake hukauka. Niliwaomba wanafunzi wako wamtoe huyo pepo mchafu, lakini hawakuweza.”

english: “O unbelieving generation!” Jesus replied. “How long must I remain with you? How long must I put up with you? Bring the boy to Me.”
ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, “Inwe ekegori getari nokwegena, nimbe nainwe goika ririri? Nindemererie nainwe goika ririri? Mondetere aa!”
swahili: Yesu akawaambia, “Enyi kizazi kisicho na imani! Nitakuwa pamoja nanyi mpaka lini? Nitawavumilia mpaka lini? Mleteni mvulana kwangu.”

english: After six days Jesus took with Him Peter, James, and John, and led them up a high mountain by themselves. There He was transfigured before them.
ekegusii: Na magega ase amatuko atano na rimo Yeso akaira Petero, na Yakobo, na Yohana, ase egetunwa egetambe barabwo boka, akaonchoka ekieni kiaye ase bare.
swahili: Baada ya siku sita, Yesu akawachukua Petro, Yakobo na Yohana, akawapeleka juu ya mlima mrefu, mahali walipokuwa faraghani. Huko, Yesu akageuka sura mbele yao.

english: So they brought him, and seeing Jesus, the spirit immediately threw the boy into a convulsion. He fell to the ground and rolled around, foaming at the mouth.
ekegusii: Bakamorenta asare. Ekero kiarora Yeso, bwango ekerecha keria gekaigusia omomura oria, na ere akagwa inse akegaragaria, agasokia risombogoku.
swahili: Nao wakamleta yule mvulana. Yule pepo mchafu alipomwona Yesu, mara akamtia yule mvulana kifafa, akaanguka, akagaagaa chini huku akitokwa na povu kinywani.

english: Jesus asked the boy’s father, “How long has this been with him?” “From childhood,” he said.
ekegusii: Yeso akaboria ise, “Nkorwa kero ki anyoretwe naya?” Agateeba, “Nkorwa obwana bwaye.
swahili: Yesu akamuuliza baba yake, “Mwanao amekuwa katika hali hii tangu lini?” Akamjibu, “Tangu utoto wake.

english: “It often throws him into the fire or into the water, trying to kill him. But if You can do anything, have compassion on us and help us.”
ekegusii: Ara aange kemoruta ase omorero na ase amaache, erinde kemosirie, korende koranyare gokora ring’ana, tororere amaabera, otokonye.”
swahili: Mara kwa mara huyo pepo mchafu amekuwa akimwangusha kwenye moto au kwenye maji ili kumwangamiza. Lakini kama unaweza kufanya jambo lolote, tafadhali tuhurumie utusaidie.”

english: “If You can?” echoed Jesus. “All things are possible to him who believes!”
ekegusii: Yeso akamoteebia, “Koranyare! Onsi nigo akonyarekana asare ere oyobwegenire.”
swahili: Yesu akamwambia, “Kama ukiweza kuamini, yote yawezekana kwake yeye aaminiye.”

english: Immediately the boy’s father cried out, “I do believe; help my unbelief!”
ekegusii: Bwango ise omwana oria agaaka eriogi, akarera, akabora, “Negenire, korende okwegena kwane n’ogoke nkoonye!”
swahili: Mara baba yake yule mvulana akapiga kelele akisema, “Ninaamini. Nisaidie kutokuamini kwangu!”

english: When Jesus saw that a crowd had come running, He rebuked the unclean spirit. “You deaf and mute spirit,” He said, “I command you to come out and never enter him again.”
ekegusii: Yeso agachia korora ng’a omoganda ngosangererekana ore bwango, agakania ekerecha keria ki’eubi, akageteebia, “Aye ekerecha rimama na egetiino, inche nagochiikire, morwe, tomoiranera naende!”
swahili: Yesu alipoona kwamba umati wa watu unakusanyika pamoja mbio, akamkemea yule pepo mchafu, akimwambia, “Wewe pepo bubu na kiziwi, nakuamuru umtoke, wala usimwingie tena!”

english: After shrieking and convulsing him violently, the spirit came out. The boy became like a corpse, so that many said, “He is dead.”
ekegusii: Erio gekarera, gekamogaragaria mono gekamorwa. Omwana oria akaba buna oyokuure, goika abange bakaboora, “Okuure.”
swahili: Yule pepo mchafu akiisha kupiga kelele, akamtia kifafa kwa nguvu, na akamtoka. Yule mvulana alikuwa kama maiti, hivyo watu wengi wakasema, “Amekufa.”

english: But Jesus took him by the hand and helped him to his feet, and he stood up.
ekegusii: Korende Yeso akamobwata okoboko, akamoimokia, na ere agatenena.
swahili: Lakini Yesu akamshika mkono, akamwinua, naye akasimama.

english: After Jesus had gone into the house, His disciples asked Him privately, “Why couldn’t we drive it out?”
ekegusii: Gasoire ase enyomba, aborokigwa baye bakamobooria bobisi, “Inaki intwe totanyara kogeseria?”
swahili: Baada ya Yesu kuingia ndani ya nyumba, wanafunzi wake wakamuuliza wakiwa peke yao, “Mbona sisi hatukuweza kumtoa huyo pepo mchafu?”

english: Jesus answered, “This kind cannot come out, except by prayer.” The Second Prediction of the Passion (Matthew 17:22–23; Luke 9:43–45)
ekegusii: Akabateebia, “Ekerecha kenga buna eke tigekonyara korwa ase ring’ana rinde rionsi, otatiga ase ogosaba.” Yeso ogokwana naende eriakabere igoro y’ogokwa kwaye (Mat 17:22-23; Luk 9:43-45)
swahili: Yesu akawajibu, “Hali hii haiwezi kutoka isipokuwa kwa kuomba na kufunga.” Yesu Atabiri Tena Kifo Chake Na Ufufuo (Mathayo 17:22-23; Luka 9:43-45)

english: His clothes became radiantly white, brighter than any launderer on earth could bleach them.
ekegusii: Chianga chiaye chikameka‐meka, chikaba chindabu mono, buna omosibia onde ase ense atanyare gochisibia chibe chindabu.
swahili: Mavazi yake yakawa na weupe wa kuzima macho, meupe kuliko ambavyo mtu yeyote duniani angaliweza kuyangʼarisha.

english: Going on from there, they passed through Galilee. But Jesus did not want anyone to know,
ekegusii: Yeso akarua aria, na’borokigwa baye bagaeta gati‐gati ya Galili; Yeso tancha omonto amanye ase are,
swahili: Wakaondoka huko, wakapitia Galilaya. Yesu hakutaka mtu yeyote afahamu mahali walipo,

english: because He was teaching His disciples. He told them, “The Son of Man will be delivered into the hands of men. They will kill Him, and after three days He will rise.”
ekegusii: ekiagera arenge kworokereria aborokigwa baye, akabateebia ng’a, “Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto nkogenda are kobekwa ase amaboko y’ abanto, na barabwo nabamoite, na ekero aitirwe naboke magega y’amatuko atato.”
swahili: kwa maana alikuwa anawafundisha wanafunzi wake. Akawaambia, “Mwana wa Adamu atasalitiwa na kutiwa mikononi mwa watu. Nao watamuua, lakini siku tatu baada ya kuuawa atafufuka.”

english: But they did not understand this statement, and they were afraid to ask Him about it. The Greatest in the Kingdom (Matthew 18:1–5; Luke 9:46–50)
ekegusii: Korende tibamanya ring’ana riria, bakairoka komoboria. Ning’o ore omonene? (Mat 18:1-5; Luk 9:46-48)
swahili: Lakini wao hawakuelewa kile alimaanisha, nao waliogopa kumuuliza maana yake. Mabishano Kuhusu Aliye Mkuu Zaidi (Mathayo 18:1-5; Luka 9:46-48)

english: Then they came to Capernaum. While Jesus was in the house, He asked them, “What were you discussing on the way?”
ekegusii: Bagaika Kapernaumu. Ekero arenge nyomba ime, Yeso akaboria aborokigwa baye, “Ninki mware koamererania inchera?”
swahili: Basi wakafika Kapernaumu na baada ya kuingia nyumbani akawauliza, “Mlikuwa mnabishana nini kule njiani?”

english: But they were silent, for on the way they had been arguing about which of them was the greatest.
ekegusii: Bagakira, ekiagera ekero barenge inchera baare koamererania barabwo ase barabwo ning’o ore omonene kobua abande.
swahili: Lakini hawakumjibu, kwa sababu njiani walikuwa wakibishana kuhusu nani miongoni mwao alikuwa mkuu zaidi ya wote.

english: Sitting down, Jesus called the Twelve and said, “If anyone wants to be first, he must be the last of all and the servant of all.”
ekegusii: Yeso agaikaransa inse, akarangeria baria ikomi na babere, akabateebia, “Omonto origetie koba oyo bw’eritang’ani nabe oyo bw’omoerio kobua bonsi, na boigo omosomba o bonsi.”
swahili: Akaketi chini, akawaita wote kumi na wawili, akawaambia: “Kama mtu yeyote akitaka kuwa wa kwanza, hana budi kuwa wa mwisho na mtumishi wa wote.”

english: Then He had a little child stand among them. Taking the child in His arms, He said to them,
ekegusii: Akabogoria omwana, akamotenenia gati‐gati yaabo, akamoagata, akabateebia,
swahili: Kisha akamchukua mtoto mdogo, akamsimamisha katikati yao. Akamkumbatia, akawaambia,

english: “Whoever welcomes one of these little children in My name welcomes Me, and whoever welcomes Me welcomes not only Me, but the One who sent Me.”
ekegusii: “Onde bwensi oramwanche omwana oyomo buna oyo ase erieta riane, oyio onyanchire inche; na oyoranyanche inche, tanyancheti inche, korende ere oyontomete.” Onde bwensi otari mamincha yaito nigo are naintwe (Luk 9:49-50)
swahili: “Mtu yeyote amkaribishaye mmoja wa hawa watoto wadogo kwa Jina langu, anikaribisha mimi. Naye anikaribishaye mimi, amkaribisha Baba yangu aliyenituma.” Yeyote Asiye Kinyume Nasi Yuko Upande Wetu (Luka 9:49-50)

english: John said to Him, “Teacher, we saw someone else driving out demons in Your name, and we tried to stop him, because he does not accompany us.”
ekegusii: Yohana akamoteebia, “Omworokia, ntwarora omonto ogoseria ebirecha ase erieta riao; tokamokania, ekiagera tare gototunyana intwe.”
swahili: Yohana akamwambia, “Mwalimu, tumemwona mtu akitoa pepo wachafu kwa jina lako, nasi tukamkataza, kwa sababu yeye si mmoja wetu.”

english: “Do not stop him,” Jesus replied. “For no one who performs a miracle in My name can turn around and speak evil of Me.
ekegusii: Yeso agateeba, “Timomokania, ekiagera monto onde tari oranyare gokora ebikone ase erieta riane, anyare erio bwango gonteeba bobe,
swahili: Yesu akasema, “Msimkataze, kwa kuwa hakuna yeyote atendaye miujiza kwa Jina langu ambaye baada ya kitambo kidogo aweza kunena lolote baya dhidi yangu.

english: And Elijah and Moses appeared before them, talking with Jesus.
ekegusii: Bakaorokerwa na Elija amo na Musa; na barabwo nigo barenge gokwana na Yeso.
swahili: Mose na Eliya wakawatokea, wakawa wanazungumza na Yesu.

english: For whoever is not against us is for us.
ekegusii: ekiagera oyo otari mamincha yaito, oyio nenseemo yaito are.
swahili: Kwa maana yeyote asiye kinyume chetu, yuko upande wetu.

english: Indeed, if anyone gives you even a cup of water because you bear the name of Christ, truly I tell you, he will never lose his reward. Temptations and Trespasses (Matthew 18:6–9; Luke 17:1–4)
ekegusii: Inaki onde bwensi orabae inwe amaache negekombe ase erieta riane, ekiagera inwe more abanto ba Kristo, nekeene nabateebirie: Tagosiria eng’eria yaye nonya ng’ake. Ogotatanga abande (Mat 18:6-9; Luk 17:1-2)
swahili: Amin, nawaambia, yeyote awapaye ninyi kikombe cha maji kwa Jina langu kwa sababu ninyi ni mali ya Kristo, hakika hataikosa thawabu yake.” Kusababisha Kutenda Dhambi (Mathayo 18:6-9; Luka 17:1-2)

english: But if anyone causes one of these little ones who believe in Me to stumble, it would be better for him to have a large millstone hung around his neck and to be thrown into the sea.
ekegusii: “Onde bwensi oragere oyomo bw’aba abake abanyegenete akore ebibe, anga mbuya kobua ase omonto oria asungerwe orogena rogosia ase rigoti riaye, na gotugutwa ime y’enyancha.
swahili: “Kama mtu yeyote akimsababisha mmojawapo wa wadogo hawa wanaoniamini kutenda dhambi, ingekuwa bora kwake afungiwe jiwe kubwa la kusagia shingoni mwake, na kutoswa baharini.

english: If your hand causes you to sin, cut it off. It is better for you to enter life crippled than to have two hands and go into hell, into the unquenchable fire.
ekegusii: Na onye okoboko kwao gokogera okore ebibe, konache; mbuya gosoa ase obogima kore ekerema, kobua koba namaboko abere, na kogenda Yeanamu [ase omorero o kare na kare oyo otakorimeka,
swahili: Kama mkono wako ukikusababisha kutenda dhambi, ukate. Ni afadhali kwako kuingia katika uzima ukiwa na mkono mmoja, kuliko kuwa na mikono miwili lakini ukaingia jehanamu, mahali ambako moto hauzimiki. [

english: If your foot causes you to sin, cut it off. It is better for you to enter life lame than to have two feet and be thrown into hell.
ekegusii: Na onye okogoro kwao gokogera okore ebibe, konache; mbuya gosoa ase obogima kore egesegora, kobua koba n’amagoro abere, na gotugutwa Yeanamu [ase omorero o kare na kare
swahili: Kama mguu wako ukikusababisha kutenda dhambi, ukate. Ni afadhali kwako kuingia katika uzima ukiwa kiwete, kuliko kuwa na miguu miwili lakini ukaingia jehanamu. [

english: And if your eye causes you to sin, pluck it out. It is better for you to enter the kingdom of God with one eye than to have two eyes and be thrown into hell,
ekegusii: Na onye neriso riao rikogera okore ebibe, orirusie oritugute; mbuya gosoa ase oborwoti bwa Nyasae kore egetong’o, kobua koba namaiso abere, na gotugutwa Yeanamu [ase omorero o kare na kare,
swahili: Nalo jicho lako likikusababisha kutenda dhambi, lingʼoe. Ni afadhali kwako kuingia katika Ufalme wa Mungu ukiwa na jicho moja, kuliko kuwa na macho mawili lakini ukatupwa jehanamu,

english: where ‘their worm never dies, and the fire is never quenched.’ Good Salt (Matthew 5:13–16; Luke 14:34–35)
ekegusii: aase amakonde abo atagokwa na omorero otakorimeka]. Igoro y’omonto (Mat 5:13; Luk 14:34-35)
swahili: mahali ambako “ ‘funza wake hawafi, wala moto wake hauzimiki.’

english: For everyone will be salted with fire.
ekegusii: “Inaki kera omonto nabekwe omoonyo ase omorero.
swahili: Kila mmoja atatiwa chumvi kwa moto.

english: Peter said to Jesus, “Rabbi, it is good for us to be here. Let us put up three shelters —one for You, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.”
ekegusii: Petero agateebia Yeso, “Omwarimu, mbuya intwe koba aiga, tiga tokore ebigutu bitato: ekemo ekiao, ekemo kia Musa, na ekemo ki’Elija.”
swahili: Petro akamwambia Yesu, “Rabi, ni vyema sisi tukae hapa. Turuhusu tujenge vibanda vitatu: kimoja chako, kingine cha Mose na kingine cha Eliya.”

english: Salt is good, but if the salt loses its saltiness, with what will you season it? Have salt among yourselves, and be at peace with one another.”
ekegusii: Omoonyo nomuya, korende omonyoo korasirie obwansu bwaye, ninki morayobeke bwanse? Mobe n’omoonyo ime ase more, momenye ase omorembe inwe ase inwe.”
swahili: “Chumvi ni nzuri, lakini ikipoteza ladha yake utaifanyaje ili iweze kukolea tena? Mwe na chumvi ndani yenu, mkaishi kwa amani, kila mmoja na mwenzake.”

english: For they were all so terrified that Peter did not know what else to say.
ekegusii: Inaki tamanyete eki agokwana, ekiagera babete nomoondoko omonene.
swahili: Petro hakujua aseme nini kwa maana yeye na wenzake walikuwa wameogopa sana.

english: Then a cloud appeared and enveloped them, and a voice came from the cloud: “This is My beloved Son. Listen to Him!”
ekegusii: Korende riire rigaacha rikababisia; eriogi rikarwa ase riire riria, rigateeba, “Oyo n’Omwana one omwanchwa, moigwere ere!”
swahili: Ndipo pakatokea wingu, likawafunika, nayo sauti kutoka lile wingu ikasema, “Huyu ni Mwanangu mpendwa. Msikieni yeye.”

english: Suddenly, when they looked around, they saw no one with them except Jesus.
ekegusii: Erio bwango kobarigereirie aria na aaria, tibarora monto onde, otatiga Yeso bweka amo nabarabwo.
swahili: Mara walipotazama huku na huku, hawakuona tena mtu mwingine yeyote pamoja nao isipokuwa Yesu.

english: As they were coming down the mountain, Jesus admonished them not to tell anyone what they had seen until the Son of Man had risen from the dead.
ekegusii: Kabagotirimboka korwa ase egetunwa akabakania tibatorera monto ayabaroche, goika Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto kabokire korwa ase abakuure.
swahili: Walipokuwa wakishuka kutoka mlimani, Yesu akawakataza wasimwambie mtu yeyote mambo waliyoona, mpaka Mwana wa Adamu atakapokuwa amefufuka kutoka kwa wafu.

english: This is the burden against Nineveh, the book of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite:
ekegusii: Aya naro amang’ana igoro ya Ninawi, omogano igoro y’oborori bwaroretwe na Nahumu Omoelikosi. Endamwamu y’Omonene igoro ya Ninawi
swahili: Neno alilosema Mungu kuhusu Ninawi. Kitabu cha maono cha Nahumu, Mwelkoshi. Hasira Ya Mungu Dhidi Ya Ninawi

english: For they will be entangled as with thorns and consumed like the drink of a drunkard— like stubble that is fully dry.
ekegusii: Buna korengana amagwa asisikaine na obonyansi obwomo inwe abatindu mosambwe mosire!
swahili: Watasongwa katikati ya miiba na kulewa kwa mvinyo wao. Watateketezwa kama mabua makavu.

english: From you, O Nineveh, comes forth a plotter of evil against the LORD, a counselor of wickedness.
ekegusii: Korwa ase ore, aye Ninawi, nachete korwa aroro omonto gete oichire n’emeroberio y’obobe, ere akaroberia mamincha y’Omonene. Ase Abayuda
swahili: Ee Ninawi, kutoka kwako amejitokeza mmoja, ambaye anapanga shauri baya dhidi ya Bwana na kushauri uovu.

english: This is what the LORD says: “Though they are allied and numerous, yet they will be cut down and pass away. Though I have afflicted you, O Judah, I will afflict you no longer.
ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene agoteeba ase abanto baye Abaisraeli: “Nonya Abasiria bare abakong’u naende abange ina baitwe nagosirigwa. Abanto bane ’nabakorete mogachandeka, korende inche tinkoirorera gokora ayio naende.
swahili: Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana: “Ingawa wana muungano nao ni wengi sana, watakatiliwa mbali na kuangamia. Ingawa nimekutesa wewe, ee Yuda, sitakutesa tena.

english: For I will now break their yoke from your neck and tear away your shackles.”
ekegusii: Bono ninkoore chinguru chi’Abaasiria korwa igoro ase more naende nimbutore chinyororo chiria chibasibete inwe.” Ase Ninawi
swahili: Sasa nitavunja nira zao kutoka shingo yako, nami nitazivunjilia mbali pingu zako.”

english: The LORD has issued a command concerning you, O Nineveh: “There will be no descendants to carry on your name. I will cut off the carved image and cast idol from the house of your gods; I will prepare your grave, for you are contemptible.”
ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene achiikire igoro y’Abaasiria: “Tibagotwara ororeria roragendererie erieta riabo. Inche ninsarie emegwekano ere ase chi’Hekalu chi’ebinyasae biabo. Ningendererete koroisia oboina ase Abaasiria-barabwo tibagwenereti koba moyo!” Ase Abayuda
swahili: Hii ndiyo amri Bwana aliyoitoa kukuhusu wewe, Ninawi: “Hutakuwa na wazao watakaoendeleza jina lako. Nitaharibu sanamu za kuchonga na sanamu za kuyeyusha ambazo zipo katika hekalu la miungu yenu. Nitaandaa kaburi lako, kwa maana wewe ni mwovu kabisa.”

english: Look to the mountains— the feet of one who brings good news, who proclaims peace! Celebrate your feasts, O Judah; fulfill your vows. For the wicked will never again march through you; they will be utterly cut off.
ekegusii: Rigereria omotomwa ngochicha are korwa ase ebitunwa obwate amang’ana amaya! Nigo are ’nchera gocha koraria obobui! Abanto ba Yuda chenga mokore omoyega oino naende momoe Nyasae keria mwamorierete ere eira. Abanto ababe tibakoumokera ense yaino naende. Basirigwe kegima.
swahili: Tazama, huko juu milimani, miguu ya huyo mmoja aletaye habari njema, ambaye anatangaza amani! Ee Yuda, sherehekea sikukuu zako, nawe utimize nadhiri zako. Waovu hawatakuvamia tena; wataangamizwa kabisa.

english: The LORD is a jealous and avenging God; the LORD is avenging and full of wrath. The LORD takes vengeance on His foes and reserves wrath for His enemies.
ekegusii: Omonene Nyasae tari gwanchereria abamereria; nigo akobaa egesusuro abwo bakomoengereia. Ase ekeririanda kiaye nabairanerie eri bagwenerete.
swahili: Bwana ni mwenye wivu na Mungu mlipiza kisasi; Bwana hulipiza kisasi na amejaa ghadhabu. Bwana hulipiza kisasi juu ya watesi wake, naye anadumisha ghadhabu yake dhidi ya adui zake.

english: The LORD is slow to anger and great in power; the LORD will by no means leave the guilty unpunished. His path is in the whirlwind and storm, and clouds are the dust beneath His feet.
ekegusii: Omonene tari omwango ase okogechigwa, korende nare n’enchinguru na tari gotiga oyore n’okomocha agende ataeiri egesusuro. Ase Omonene agotaara, emerindo nigo egotenena; amare naro ebuse ekoimoka korwa ase amagoro aye!
swahili: Bwana si mwepesi wa hasira naye ni mwenye nguvu, Bwana hataacha kuadhibu wenye hatia. Njia yake ipo katika kisulisuli na tufani, na mawingu ni vumbi la miguu yake.

english: He rebukes the sea and dries it up; He makes all the rivers run dry. Bashan and Carmel wither, and the flower of Lebanon wilts.
ekegusii: Nigo agochiika enyancha nero yakamoka! Nigo agokora chindoche chiakama. Emegondo ya Basani nigo egosusana, egetunwa gia Karimeli nigo kegoonchoka kiaba maroba, amaua a Lebanoni nigo akorachoka.
swahili: Anakemea bahari na kuikausha, anafanya mito yote kukauka. Bashani na Karmeli zinanyauka na maua ya Lebanoni hukauka.

english: The mountains quake before Him, and the hills melt away; the earth trembles at His presence— the world and all its dwellers.
ekegusii: Ebitunwa nigo bigotengecha ase obosio Omonene; ebigoro nigo bikonyititoka ase obosio bwaye. Ense nigo ekonyegerigwa ekero Omonene akororekana; ense amo nebitongwa nigo bikonyegerigwa.
swahili: Milima hutikisika mbele yake na vilima huyeyuka. Nchi hutetemeka mbele yake, dunia na wote waishio ndani yake.

english: Who can withstand His indignation? Who can endure His burning anger? His wrath is poured out like fire; even rocks are shattered before Him.
ekegusii: Ning’o oranyare gotenena ekero ere are n’ekeririanda? Ning’o oratigare ekero are n’obotindi obonene? Nigo akoumora obororo bogwoka; Ebitare nigo bigosamunyokana biaba orotu ase obosio bwaye.
swahili: Ni nani awezaye kuzuia hasira yake yenye uchungu? Nani awezaye kuvumilia hasira yake kali? Ghadhabu yake imemiminwa kama moto, na miamba inapasuka mbele zake.

english: The LORD is good, a stronghold in the day of distress; He cares for those who trust in Him.
ekegusii: Omonene nomuya; nigo akorenda abanto baye ase chingaki chi’emechando; nigo akorenda baria bakoonchoka gochia ase are.
swahili: Bwana ni Mwema, kimbilio wakati wa taabu. Huwatunza wale wanaomtegemea,

english: But with an overwhelming flood He will make an end of Nineveh and pursue His enemies into darkness.
ekegusii: Buna chioro chinene chikominyoka ere nigo agosiria ababisa baye kegima; obatoma gochia ase amakweri baria bakomoengereria.
swahili: lakini kwa mafuriko makubwa, ataangamiza Ninawi; atafuatilia adui zake hadi gizani.

english: Whatever you plot against the LORD, He will bring to an end. Affliction will not rise up a second time.
ekegusii: Inki mokoroberia igoro y’Omonene? Nkobasiria are, onde taiyo oramoengererie goetania are rimo.
swahili: Shauri baya lolote wapangalo dhidi ya Bwana yeye atalikomesha; taabu haitatokea mara ya pili.

english: One who scatters advances against you, O Nineveh. Guard the fortress! Watch the road! Brace yourselves! Summon all your strength!
ekegusii: Ninawi kwaboereirwe! Chinguru chi’okogosiria chiachire. Arigania ebikengero! Renda amakori! Eariganie ase esegi!
swahili: Mshambuliaji anasogea dhidi yako, Ninawi. Linda ngome, chunga barabara, jitieni nguvu wenyewe, kusanya nguvu zako zote!

english: She is emptied! Yes, she is desolate and laid waste! Hearts melt, knees knock, bodies tremble, and every face grows pale!
ekegusii: Ninawi osarigwe ong’anyirwe, obeire ritombe! Chinkoro chianyititokire n’obwoba; amarwa anyegerigwe, chinguru chiachire; amasio arachokire.
swahili: Ameharibiwa, ametekwa nyara, ameachwa uchi! Mioyo inayeyuka, magoti yanalegea, miili inatetemeka, na kila uso umebadilika rangi.

english: Where is the lions’ lair or the feeding ground of the young lions, where the lion and lioness prowled with their cubs, with nothing to frighten them away?
ekegusii: Ng’ai omochie omonene ore bono? Oyio orenge buna engoro y’echindo, agwo ase chindo chinsae chiare koerwa endagera, Ase Endo etuoni, ne eaberi, chiarenge kogenda amo n’echimanwa chiabo, chire n’oborendi?
swahili: Liko wapi sasa pango la simba, mahali ambapo waliwalisha watoto wao, ambapo simba dume na simba jike walikwenda na ambapo wana simba walikwenda bila kuogopa chochote?

english: The lion mauled enough for its cubs and strangled prey for the lioness. It filled its dens with the kill, and its lairs with mauled prey.
ekegusii: Endo nigo yare goita keria egotwara naende yakebutorana ebisamunye yaereria eyamwabo amo n’echimanwa chiaye; nigo yarenge goichoria engoro yaye n’echinyama chibutoranire.
swahili: Simba aliua mawindo ya kutosha watoto wake, alinyonga mawindo kwa ajili ya mwenzi wake, akijaza makao yake kwa alivyoua na mapango yake kwa mawindo.

english: “Behold, I am against you,” declares the LORD of Hosts. “I will send your chariots up in smoke, and the sword will devour your young lions. I will cut off your prey from the earth, and the voices of your messengers will no longer be heard.”
ekegusii: “Inche n’omobisa oo!” Nabo Omonene Omonguru agoteeba. “Inche ninsambe chigari chi’echibarasi chiao chi’esegi. Abarwani bao mbaitwe ase esegi, nainche ning’ire kera egento keria aye kwairete korwa ase abande. Amaganio abatomwa bao takoigwekana naende.”
swahili: Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote anatangaza, “Mimi ni kinyume na ninyi. Magari yenu ya vita nitayateketeza kwa moto, na upanga utakula wana simba wako. Sitawaachia mawindo juu ya nchi. Sauti za wajumbe wako hazitasikika tena.”

english: For the LORD will restore the splendor of Jacob like the splendor of Israel, though destroyers have laid them waste and ruined the branches of their vine.
ekegusii: (Omonene nare ange koirania obonene bwa Israeli, buna yarenge omochakano konya ababisa baye batarayosakora).
swahili: Bwana atarudisha fahari ya Yakobo, kama fahari ya Israeli, ingawa waangamizi wamewaacha ukiwa na wameharibu mizabibu yao.

english: The shields of his mighty men are red; the valiant warriors are dressed in scarlet. The fittings of the chariots flash like fire on the day they are prepared, and the spears of cypress have been brandished.
ekegusii: Abarwani b’ababisa nigo baimogeti chinguba chimbariri naende nigo babegete chingobo chigwekaine chire chimbariri. Barobwo nigo bagendererete koearigania koboera! Chigari chiabo chi’echibarasi nigo chikobara buna omorero! Chibarasi chiabo nigo chikwana!
swahili: Ngao za askari wake ni nyekundu, mashujaa wamevaa nguo nyekundu. Chuma kwenye magari ya vita chametameta, katika siku aliyoyaweka tayari, mikuki ya mierezi inametameta.

english: The chariots dash through the streets; they rush around the plazas, appearing like torches, darting about like lightning.
ekegusii: Chibarasi chi’esegi nigo chigotitiria n’okogosa ime y’echinchera, chikoayerera gocha na koirana ase egati y’omochie omonene. Nigo chikobara buna chitochi na kominyoka buna okomesa kw’embura.
swahili: Magari ya vita yanafanya msukosuko barabarani, yakikimbia nyuma na mbele uwanjani. Yanaonekana kama mienge ya moto; yanakwenda kasi kama umeme.

english: He summons his nobles; they stumble as they advance. They race to its wall; the protective shield is set in place.
ekegusii: Abanene baye barangerigwe; nigo bakogochwa ekero bakwemigereria gochia motwe. Ababoeri nigo bakoayerera gochia enyasi naende baimokia chinguba chiabo bekengera ase aye.
swahili: Anaita vikosi vilivyochaguliwa, lakini bado wanajikwaa njiani. Wanakimbilia haraka kwenye ukuta wa mji, ile ngao ya kuwakinga imetayarishwa.

english: The river gates are thrown open and the palace collapses.
ekegusii: Ebiita bire ange na roche biaigoirwe n’echinguru; enka y’omorwoti yaichoirwe nomoondoko.
swahili: Malango ya mto yamefunguliwa wazi, na jumba la kifalme limeanguka.

english: It is decreed that the city be exiled and carried away; her maidservants moan like doves, and beat upon their breasts.
ekegusii: Enting’ana yairirwe obosomba; abasomba baye nigo bakweumia buna amaruma, bagoaka‐aka ebikuba biabo n’obororo.
swahili: Imeagizwa kwamba mji uchukuliwe na upelekwe uhamishoni. Vijakazi wake wanaomboleza kama hua na kupigapiga vifua vyao.

english: Nineveh has been like a pool of water throughout her days, but now it is draining away. “Stop! Stop!” they cry, but no one turns back.
ekegusii: Buna amache akorwa korwa ase ritibo riatekire, abanto baayareire korwa Ninawi!. “Tenena! Tenena!” Nigo bakorera korende onde tari okorigereria magega.
swahili: Ninawi ni kama dimbwi, nayo maji yake yanakauka. Wanalia, “Simama! Simama!” Lakini hakuna anayegeuka nyuma.

english: “Plunder the silver! Plunder the gold!” There is no end to the treasure, an abundance of every precious thing.
ekegusii: Sakora chifeta! Sakora ne chitaabu! Omochie omonene nigo oichire obotenenku!
swahili: Chukueni nyara za fedha! Chukueni nyara za dhahabu! Wingi wake hauna mwisho, utajiri kutoka hazina zake zote!

english: Woe to the city of blood, full of lies, full of plunder, never without prey.
ekegusii: Oragererigwe omochie oyio omong’ainereria naende ogoita, oichire obotenenku boraibwe na gosakorwa!
swahili: Ole wa mji umwagao damu, uliojaa uongo, umejaa nyara, usiokosa kuwa na vitu vya kuteka nyara.

english: Yet she became an exile; she went into captivity. Her infants were dashed to pieces at the head of every street. They cast lots for her dignitaries, and all her nobles were bound in chains.
ekegusii: Abanto ba Tebesi bakabogorigwa gochia gooswa. Ase kera ensinyo y’agachie abana babo bagaitwa goika bagakwa. Abatang’ani babo bakabogorigwa babekire ebinyuri na kogabanwa ase abasakori babo.
swahili: Hata hivyo alichukuliwa mateka na kwenda uhamishoni. Watoto wake wachanga walivunjwa vunjwa vipande kwenye mwanzo wa kila barabara. Kura zilipigwa kwa watu wake wenye heshima, na watu wake wote wakuu walifungwa kwa minyororo.

english: You too will become drunk; you will go into hiding and seek refuge from the enemy.
ekegusii: Ninawi, aye boigo nogwe gochia ase ogosundoka kw’ogotindu! Aye boigo norigie gotama korwa ase ababisa bao.
swahili: Wewe pia utalewa; utakwenda mafichoni na kutafuta kimbilio kutoka kwa adui.

english: All your fortresses are fig trees with the first ripe figs; when shaken, they fall into the mouth of the eater!
ekegusii: Chiburi chiao chionsi nigo chirabe buna emeko ere namako atobire: nyegeria emete, n’amatunda akogwere gocha ase omonwa oo!
swahili: Ngome zako zote ni kama mitini yenye matunda yake ya kwanza yaliyoiva; wakati inapotikiswa, tini huanguka kwenye kinywa chake alaye.

english: Look at your troops— they are like your women! The gates of your land are wide open to your enemies; fire consumes their bars.
ekegusii: Abarwani bao nigo banga abakungu, n’ense yao yatenenire etabwati abarendi ase obosio bw’ababisa bao. Omorero nosarie emekorogoto y’ebiita biao.
swahili: Tazama vikosi vyako: wote ni wanawake! Malango ya nchi yako yamekuwa wazi kwa adui zako; moto umeteketeza mapingo yake.

english: Draw your water for the siege; strengthen your fortresses. Work the clay and tread the mortar; repair the brick kiln!
ekegusii: Gachie roche bweariganie ase okoboerwa, boigo kong’ia chindwaki chiao! Tiringa esike oroisie amatabori, naende obeke ang’e esike y’amatabori!
swahili: Teka maji kwa ajili ya kuzingirwa kwako, imarisha ulinzi wako, Ufanyie udongo wa mfinyanzi kazi, yakanyage matope, karabati tanuru la kuchomea matofali!

english: There the fire will devour you; the sword will cut you down and consume you like a young locust. Make yourself many like the young locust; make yourself many like the swarming locust!
ekegusii: Aye n’okora ekio orakore, goika osambwe okwe gose oitwe ase esegi. Aye nosirigwe buna endagera ekoriegwa n’echingige. Aye nigo gwaichorete buna chingige!
swahili: Huko moto utakuteketeza, huko upanga utakuangusha chini na kama vile panzi, watakumaliza. Ongezeka kama panzi, ongezeka kama nzige!

english: You have multiplied your merchants more than the stars of the sky. The young locust strips the land and flies away.
ekegusii: Aye nigo kwaiborete abaonchoreria abange kobwa ching’enang’eni chire ase erioba! Korende bono bachiire, buna chingige chikorambora chimbaba chiabo chiairuruka chiagenda.
swahili: Umeongeza idadi ya wafanyabiashara wako mpaka wamekuwa wengi kuliko nyota za angani, lakini kama nzige wanaacha nchi tupu kisha huruka na kwenda zake.

english: Your guards are like the swarming locust, and your scribes like clouds of locusts that settle on the walls on a cold day. When the sun rises, they fly away, and no one knows where.
ekegusii: Abanene bao nigo banga buna risaga ri’echingige echio chigotigara ase chinyasi ase rituko ri’obokendu. Korende ekero risase rigosoka, chirochio chiairuruka, na onde taiyo okomanya ase chikogenda!
swahili: Walinzi wako ni kama nzige, maafisa wako ni kama makundi ya nzige watuao kwenye kuta wakati wa siku ya baridi: lakini wakati jua linapotokea wanaruka kwenda zao, na hakuna ajuaye waendako.

english: O king of Assyria, your shepherds slumber; your officers sleep. Your people are scattered on the mountains with no one to gather them.
ekegusii: Aye omorwoti bw’Abaasuri; abagabana bao bakuure, n’abanene bao nigo baraire kare na kare! Abanto bao basiarerwe ase ebitunwa igoro, na onde taiyo orabairanie gocha inka naende.
swahili: Ee mfalme wa Ashuru, wachungaji wako wanasinzia; wakuu wako wanalala chini mavumbini kupumzika. Watu wako wametawanyika juu ya milima bila kuwa na mtu yeyote wa kuwakusanya.

english: There is no healing for your injury; your wound is severe. All who hear the news of you applaud your downfall, for who has not experienced your constant cruelty?
ekegusii: Riogo tiriyo gose, amaote ao takonyara kobwena. Bonsi abakoigwa amang’ana ao y’ogosarigwa nigo bagwaka chinkobi n’omogoko. Nareo onde bwensi otambogete obotindi bwao botakoera?
swahili: Hakuna kitu kinachoweza kuponya jeraha lako; jeraha lako ni la kukuua. Kila anayesikia habari zako, hupiga makofi kwa kuanguka kwako, kwa kuwa ni nani ambaye hajaguswa na ukatili wako usio na mwisho?

english: The crack of the whip, the rumble of the wheel, galloping horse and bounding chariot!
ekegusii: Tegerera ogwateka kw’emecharichi, okorasa kw’amagaari, ogocharara gw’echibarasi, na okonyenya gw’echigari chi’echibarasi chi’esegi!
swahili: Kelele za mijeledi, vishindo vya magurudumu, farasi waendao mbio na mshtuo wa magari ya vita!

english: Charging horseman, flashing sword, shining spear; heaps of slain, mounds of corpses, dead bodies without end— they stumble over their dead—
ekegusii: Abariini be chibarasi nigo bagosiaroka, emioro ekobara amatimo akomeka meka! Ebitondo bibangire amo gochia igoro, emebere ekwete etari na mobaro abasacha bakogochwa nero!
swahili: Wapanda farasi wanaenda mbio, panga zinameremeta, na mikuki inangʼaa! Majeruhi wengi, malundo ya maiti, idadi kubwa ya miili isiyohesabika, watu wanajikwaa juu ya mizoga:

english: because of the many harlotries of the harlot, the seductive mistress of sorcery, who betrays nations by her prostitution and clans by her witchcraft.
ekegusii: Ninawi omotomani nkoegwa are egesusuro. Akomeka meka na oichire n’ogwechabera kw’oborogi bw’ogoita, nigo aegete ebisaku na kobakora abasomba.
swahili: yote haya kwa sababu ya wingi wa tamaa za kahaba, anayeshawishi, bibi wa mambo ya uchawi, anayewatia utumwani mataifa kwa ukahaba wake na pia jamaa za watu kwa ulozi wake.

english: “Behold, I am against you,” declares the LORD of Hosts. “I will lift your skirts over your face. I will show your nakedness to the nations and your shame to the kingdoms.
ekegusii: Omonene Nyasae nigo agoteeba, Ninyee Ninawi egesusuro! Ngochobore otigare getirianda erio ngotigere ebisaku bikorore, birore obosoku bwao bwonsi.
swahili: Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote anasema, “Mimi ni kinyume na ninyi. Nitafunika uso wako kwa gauni lako. Nitaonyesha mataifa uchi wako na falme aibu yako.

english: I will pelt you with filth and treat you with contempt; I will make a spectacle of you.
ekegusii: Nikobogorie ase ogochaaya naende ngotube ne eubi. Abanto mbakorigererie n’omondoko.
swahili: Nitakutupia uchafu, nitakufanyia dharau na kukufanya kioja.

english: Then all who see you will recoil from you and say, ‘Nineveh is devastated; who will grieve for her?’ Where can I find comforters for you?”
ekegusii: Onde bwensi orakorigererie natame gochia magega. Barobwo mbateebe, ’Ninawi yatigaire koba ritombe! Ing’o ore n’amabeebe ande onsi ase are? Ning’o oraganie komoremia?’
swahili: Wote wanaokuona watakukimbia na kusema, ‘Ninawi ipo katika kuangamia: ni nani atakayeomboleza kwa ajili yake?’ Nitampata wapi yeyote wa kukufariji?”

english: Are you better than Thebes, stationed by the Nile with water around her, whose rampart was the sea, whose wall was the water?
ekegusii: Aye Ninawi, Nigo ore gai kobwa Tebesi, omochie omonene o Misiri? Oyio boigo narenge n’oroche rokomokengera ronga enyasi Naeli nero yarenge egekengero kiaye.
swahili: Je, wewe ni bora kuliko No-Amoni, uliopo katika Mto Naili, uliozungukwa na maji? Mto ulikuwa kinga yake, nayo maji yalikuwa ukuta wake.

english: Cush and Egypt were her boundless strength; Put and Libya were her allies.
ekegusii: Ere nigo agamberete Etiopia na Misiri boigo, chinguru chiaye tichiarenge n’echimbebe; Libia nere orenge omosani oye.
swahili: Kushi na Misri walikuwa nguvu zake zisizo na mpaka; Putu na Libia walikuwa miongoni mwa wale walioungana naye.

english: Now these were the ones who sealed the document: Nehemiah the governor, son of Hacaliah, and also Zedekiah,
ekegusii: Ababegete ebimanyererio biabo ase okobwatana koria nabwo aba: Nehemia omogabana, mosinto o Hakalia, na Zedekia.
swahili: Wale waliotia muhuri walikuwa: Nehemia mtawala, mwana wa Hakalia. Sedekia,

english: and their associates: Shebaniah, Hodiah, Kelita, Pelaiah, Hanan,
ekegusii: abamwabo: Sebania na Hodia; Kelita, na Pelaya, na Hanani;
swahili: na wenzao: Shebania, Hodia, Kelita, Pelaya, Hanani,

english: Mica, Rehob, Hashabiah,
ekegusii: Mika, na Rehobu, na Hasabia;
swahili: Mika, Rehobu, Hashabia,

english: Zaccur, Sherebiah, Shebaniah,
ekegusii: Sakuri, na Serebia, na Sebania;
swahili: Zakuri, Sherebia, Shebania,

english: Hodiah, Bani, and Beninu.
ekegusii: Hodia, na Bani, na Beninu.
swahili: Hodia, Bani na Beninu.

english: And the leaders of the people: Parosh, Pahath-moab, Elam, Zattu, Bani,
ekegusii: Abatang’ani b’abaanto nabwo aba: Parosi, na Pahati-Moabu, na Elamu, na Satu, na Bani;
swahili: Viongozi wa watu: Paroshi, Pahath-Moabu, Elamu, Zatu, Bani,

english: Bunni, Azgad, Bebai,
ekegusii: Buni, na Asigadi, na Bebai;
swahili: Buni, Azgadi, Bebai,

english: Adonijah, Bigvai, Adin,
ekegusii: Adonia, na Bigiwai, na Adini;
swahili: Adoniya, Bigwai, Adini,

english: Ater, Hezekiah, Azzur,
ekegusii: Ateri, na Hezekia, na Asuri;
swahili: Ateri, Hezekia, Azuri,

english: Hodiah, Hashum, Bezai,
ekegusii: Hodia, na Hasumu, na Besai;
swahili: Hodia, Hashumu, Besai,

english: Hariph, Anathoth, Nebai,
ekegusii: Harifu, na Anatoti, na Nebai;
swahili: Harifu, Anathothi, Nebai,

english: Seraiah, Azariah, Jeremiah,
ekegusii: Seraya, na Asaria, na Yeremia;
swahili: Seraya, Azaria, Yeremia,

english: Magpiash, Meshullam, Hezir,
ekegusii: Magipiasi, na Mesulamu, na Hesiri;
swahili: Magpiashi, Meshulamu, Heziri,

english: Meshezabel, Zadok, Jaddua,
ekegusii: Meshesabeli, na Zadoki na Yadua;
swahili: Meshezabeli, Sadoki, Yadua,

english: Pelatiah, Hanan, Anaiah,
ekegusii: Pelatia, na Hanani, na Anaya;
swahili: Pelatia, Hanani, Anaya,

english: Hoshea, Hananiah, Hasshub,
ekegusii: Hosea, na Hanania, na Hasubu;
swahili: Hoshea, Hanania, Hashubu,

english: Hallohesh, Pilha, Shobek,
ekegusii: Halohesi, na Pila, na Sobeki;
swahili: Haloheshi, Pilha, Shobeki,

english: Rehum, Hashabnah, Maaseiah,
ekegusii: Rehumu, na Hasabuna, na Maaseya;
swahili: Rehumu, Hashabna, Maaseya,

english: Ahijah, Hanan, Anan,
ekegusii: Ahiya, na Hanani, na Anani;
swahili: Ahiya, Hanani, Anani,

english: Malluch, Harim, and Baanah. The Vows of the Covenant
ekegusii: Maluku, na Harimu, na Baana. Okobwatana
swahili: Maluki, Harimu na Baana.

english: “The rest of the people—the priests, Levites, gatekeepers, singers, temple servants, and all who had separated themselves from the people of the land to obey the Law of God—along with their wives and all their sons and daughters who are able to understand,
ekegusii: Abanto abatigarete, na abakuani, na Abalawi, na abarendi b’ebiita, na abateri, na abakori emeremo be Hekalu, na abanto bonsi konya berusananirie korwa ase abanto b’ebisaku ase engencho y’amachiiko a Nyasae, barabwo amo nabakungu babo, na abana babo, abamura na abaiseke, nabwo bonsi babwate obong’aini bw’okomanya,
swahili: “Watu wengine wote, wakiwa ni makuhani, Walawi, mabawabu, waimbaji, watumishi wa Hekalu, na wale wote waliojitenga na mataifa jirani kwa ajili ya Sheria ya Mungu, pamoja na wake zao na wana wao na binti zao wote waliokuwa na uwezo wa kufahamu,

english: hereby join with their noble brothers and commit themselves with a sworn oath to follow the Law of God given through His servant Moses and to carefully obey all the commandments, ordinances, and statutes of the LORD our Lord.
ekegusii: bakabwatana nabaanto bamwabo basikire, bakaria eira bagatiana ng’a mbabwatie amachiiko a Nyasae ayaruetwe goetera ase Musa, omosomba oye, naende ng’a mbarende na gokora amachiiko onsi ay’Omonene, oyore Omonene oito, amo nemeroberio yaye yonsi echiikire.
swahili: basi hawa wote wanajiunga na ndugu zao na wakuu wao, na kujifunga kwa laana na kwa kiapo kufuata Sheria ya Mungu iliyotolewa kupitia kwa Mose mtumishi wa Mungu, na kutii kwa uangalifu amri zote, maagizo na sheria za Bwana, Bwana wetu.

english: Pashhur, Amariah, Malchijah,
ekegusii: Pasuri, na Amaria, na Malikia;
swahili: Pashuri, Amaria, Malkiya,

english: We will not give our daughters in marriage to the people of the land, and we will not take their daughters for our sons.
ekegusii: Bagateeba, Titokorua abaiseke baito banyuomwe nabaanto b’ense eye, gose titokonyuomeria abamura baito abaiseke babo.
swahili: “Tunaahidi kutowaoza binti zetu kwa watu wanaotuzunguka, wala kuwaoza wana wetu binti zao.

english: When the people of the land bring merchandise or any kind of grain to sell on the Sabbath day, we will not buy from them on a Sabbath or holy day. Every seventh year we will let the fields lie fallow, and will cancel every debt.
ekegusii: Onye abanto b’ense eye bakorenta ebinto gose chindagera gotooneria rituko ri’Esabato, titokobigora ase Esabato gose ase rituko rinde richenu. Ase omwaka o gatano na kabere ntotige emegondo yaito etimoke teremwa, ne chisira titochiboria chiakanwe.
swahili: “Wakati mataifa jirani waletapo bidhaa zao au nafaka kuuza siku ya Sabato, hatutazinunua kutoka kwao siku ya Sabato, wala siku nyingine yoyote takatifu. Kila mwaka wa saba, tutaacha kuilima ardhi na tutafuta madeni yote.

english: We also place ourselves under the obligation to contribute a third of a shekel yearly for the service of the house of our God:
ekegusii: “Twanchire ng’a kera omwaka, torue ensemo ya isato y’esekeli ekorerwe emeremo ase enyomba ya Nyasae oito.
swahili: “Tunakubali wajibu wa kutimiza amri za kutoa theluthi ya shekeli kila mwaka kwa ajili ya utumishi wa nyumba ya Mungu:

english: for the showbread, for the regular grain offerings and burnt offerings, for the Sabbath offerings, for the New Moons and appointed feasts, for the holy offerings, for the sin offerings to make atonement for Israel, and for all the duties of the house of our God.
ekegusii: “Chibesa echio chiraruegwe ase engencho y’emegati ekoruegwa ase Nyasae, na okoruegwa kw’endagera kwa botambe, na ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa kia botambe, na ebie Chisabato, na Emetienyi Emeyia, na Amatuko Amanene achiikire, na ebing’wanso ebichenu, na ebing’wanso bi’ebibe bigokora okobwatanigwa ase Abaisraeli, na ase engencho y’emeremo yonsi y’enyomba ya Nyasae oito.
swahili: Kwa ajili ya mikate ya Wonyesho, kwa ajili ya sadaka za kawaida za nafaka na sadaka za kuteketezwa, kwa ajili ya sadaka za siku za Sabato, Sikukuu za Mwandamo wa Mwezi na sikukuu nyingine zilizoamriwa, kwa ajili ya sadaka takatifu, kwa ajili ya sadaka za dhambi ili kufanya upatanisho kwa ajili ya Israeli, na kwa ajili ya kazi zote za nyumba ya Mungu wetu.

english: We have cast lots among the priests, Levites, and people for the donation of wood by our families at the appointed times each year. They are to bring it to the house of our God to burn on the altar of the LORD our God, as it is written in the Law.
ekegusii: “Boigo intwe abakuani, na Abalawi, na abanto bande, twaakire obomera ng’a tomanye buna abanto be chiamate chiaito barabe bakorenta chinko, omwaka ase omwaka, echio chirabe chigosamba ebing’wanso ase egesasiimero ki’Omonene, Nyasae oito, ase chingaki chichikiire, na buna ariikire ase Egetabu ki’Amachiko.
swahili: “Sisi makuhani, Walawi na watu, tumepiga kura kuamua kuwa kila mmoja wa jamaa zetu lazima alete katika nyumba ya Mungu wetu kwa nyakati maalum kila mwaka mchango wa kuni za kukokea moto katika madhabahu ya Bwana Mungu wetu, kama ilivyoandikwa katika Sheria.

english: We will also bring the firstfruits of our land and of every fruit tree to the house of the LORD year by year.
ekegusii: “Naende ntobe tokorenta okwama kw’eritang’ani kwe riroba riaito, na amatunda amatang’ani ay’emete yonsi, ase enyomba y’Omonene, omwaka ase omwaka.
swahili: “Pia tunachukua wajibu wa kuleta malimbuko ya mazao yetu na matunda ya kwanza ya kila mti wa matunda katika nyumba ya Bwana kila mwaka.

english: And we will bring the firstborn of our sons and our livestock, as it is written in the Law, and will bring the firstborn of our herds and flocks to the house of our God, to the priests who minister in the house of our God.
ekegusii: “Ntorete abana baito abaisia abatangi, ne chitugo chiaito chintangi ase abakuani abagokora emeremo ase enyomba ya Nyasae oito, buna eriikire ase amachiiko, torente ne chintangi chi’echiombe, na echie chimbori, na echie ching’ondi.
swahili: “Kama pia ilivyoandikwa katika Sheria, tutawaleta wazaliwa wetu wa kwanza wa kiume, na wa mifugo yetu, yaani wa ngʼombe wetu na wa makundi yetu ya kondoo na mbuzi, katika nyumba ya Mungu wetu, kwa ajili ya makuhani wanaohudumu huko.

english: Moreover, we will bring to the priests at the storerooms of the house of our God the firstfruits of our dough, of our grain offerings, of the fruit of all our trees, and of our new wine and oil. A tenth of our produce belongs to the Levites, so that they shall receive tithes in all the towns where we labor.
ekegusii: “Naende ntorente ase abakuani agwo ase ebinyomba ime, ase enyomba ya Nyasae oito, obosie bwaito bw’obotongora, na ebiegwa biaito, na amatunda ’emete yonsi, na edivai, na amaguta. Boigo ntorente ensemo ya ikomi y’okwama kwe riroba riaito ase Abalawi, ekiagera Abalawi nabwo bagosangereria chinsemo chia ikomi korwa ase emechie yonsi.
swahili: “Zaidi ya hayo, tutaleta katika ghala za nyumba ya Mungu wetu, kwa makuhani, vyakula vya kwanza vya mashamba yetu, sadaka zetu za nafaka, matunda ya miti yetu yote, divai yetu mpya na mafuta. Nasi tutaleta zaka za mazao yetu kwa Walawi, kwa kuwa Walawi ndio ambao hukusanya zaka katika miji yote tunakofanya kazi.

english: A priest of Aaron’s line is to accompany the Levites when they collect the tenth, and the Levites are to bring a tenth of these tithes to the storerooms of the treasury in the house of our God.
ekegusii: Ekero Abalawi bakorenterwa chinsemo echio chia ikomi, Omokuani, omonto bw’ororeria rwa Aroni, goika abe amo nabarabwo. Abalawi abwo mbarusie ensemo ya ikomi ye chinsemo echio chia ikomi, bayeire ase ebinyomba bi’enyomba ya Nyasae.
swahili: Kuhani atokanaye na uzao wa Aroni atashirikiana na Walawi wakati wanapopokea zaka, nao Walawi itawapasa kuleta sehemu ya kumi ya zaka katika nyumba ya Mungu wetu katika ghala za hazina.

english: For the Israelites and the Levites are to bring the contributions of grain, new wine, and oil to the storerooms where the articles of the sanctuary are kept and where the ministering priests, the gatekeepers, and the singers stay. Thus we will not neglect the house of our God.”
ekegusii: Abaisraeli na Abalawi mbarente okoruegwa kwabo gwe chindagera, na okw’edivai, na amaguta, ase ebinyomba ebio. Agwo nao ebikorero bi’Aase Aachenu bire; boigo nao abakuani bagokora emeremo, na abarendi b’ebiita, na abateri bare. “Titogotiga enyomba ya Nyasae oito eborwe ebinto.”
swahili: Watu wa Israeli pamoja na Walawi itawapasa kuleta michango yao ya nafaka, divai mpya na mafuta katika vyumba vya ghala, mahali vifaa vya mahali patakatifu vinapohifadhiwa, na wanapokaa makuhani wanaohudumu, na mabawabu na waimbaji. “Hatutaacha kuijali nyumba ya Mungu wetu.”

english: Hattush, Shebaniah, Malluch,
ekegusii: Hatusi, na Sebania, na Maluki;
swahili: Hatushi, Shebania, Maluki,

english: Harim, Meremoth, Obadiah,
ekegusii: Harimu, na Meremoti, na Obadia;
swahili: Harimu, Meremothi, Obadia,

english: Daniel, Ginnethon, Baruch,
ekegusii: Danieli, na Ginetoni, na Baruku;
swahili: Danieli, Ginethoni, Baruku,

english: Meshullam, Abijah, Mijamin,
ekegusii: Mesulamu, na Abiya, na Miyamini;
swahili: Meshulamu, Abiya, Miyamini,

english: Maaziah, Bilgai, and Shemaiah. These were the priests.
ekegusii: Maasia, na Biligai, na Semaya. Aba nabwo barenge abakuani.
swahili: Maazia, Bilgai na Shemaya. Hawa ndio waliokuwa makuhani.

english: The Levites: Jeshua son of Azaniah, Binnui of the sons of Henadad, Kadmiel,
ekegusii: Abalawi nabwo aba: Yesua, mosinto bw’Asania, na Binui bw’eamate ya Henadadi, na Kadimieli;
swahili: Walawi: Yeshua mwana wa Azania, Binui wa wana wa Henadadi, Kadmieli,

english: Now the leaders of the people settled in Jerusalem, and the rest of the people cast lots to bring one out of ten to live in the holy city of Jerusalem, while the remaining nine were to dwell in their own towns.
ekegusii: Abatang’ani b’abaanto bakamenya Yerusalemu, na abanto bande bagaaka obomera gochora omonto oyomo korwa ase kera ekeombe ki’abaanto ikomi, agende komenya Yerusalemu, omochie omochenu, na abanto aba kianda abatigari bagende komenya ase emechie ende.
swahili: Basi viongozi wa watu walikaa Yerusalemu, nao watu wale wengine walipiga kura ili kuleta mtu mmoja kati ya watu kumi aje kuishi Yerusalemu, mji mtakatifu, nao wengine tisa waliobaki wakae katika miji yao wenyewe.

english: From the priests: Jedaiah son of Joiarib; Jachin;
ekegusii: Abakuani nabwo aba: Yedaya, mosinto o Yoyaribu, na Yakini.
swahili: Kutoka makuhani: Yedaya, mwana wa Yoyaribu, Yakini,

english: Seraiah son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the chief official of the house of God;
ekegusii: Seraya, mosinto o Hilikia, o Mesulamu, o Zadoki, o Merayoti, o Ahitubu, omoteneneri bw’enyomba ya Nyasae,
swahili: Seraya mwana wa Hilkia, mwana wa Meshulamu, mwana wa Sadoki, mwana wa Merayothi, mwana wa Ahitubu, msimamizi katika nyumba ya Mungu,

english: and their associates who did the work at the temple—822 men; Adaiah son of Jeroham, the son of Pelaliah, the son of Amzi, the son of Zechariah, the son of Pashhur, the son of Malchijah;
ekegusii: na abamwabo abarenge gokora emeremo ase enyomba ya Nyasae, bonsi nabaanto amagana atano na atato, na emerongo ebere, na babere (822); Adaya, mosinto o Yerohamu, o Pelalia, bw’Amusi, o Zakaria; o Pasuri, o Malikia,
swahili: pamoja na wenzao waliofanya kazi hekaluni: watu 822. Adaya mwana wa Yerohamu, mwana wa Pelalia, mwana wa Amsi, mwana wa Zekaria, mwana wa Pashuri, mwana wa Malkiya,

english: and his associates, the leaders of families—242 men; Amashai son of Azarel, the son of Ahzai, the son of Meshillemoth, the son of Immer;
ekegusii: na abamwabo, abarenge abateneneri be chiamate, bonsi nabaanto amagana abere na emerongo ene, na babere (242); Amasai, mosinto bw’Asareli, bw’Asai, o Mesilemoti, o Imeri,
swahili: na wenzao, waliokuwa viongozi wa jamaa: watu 242. Amashisai mwana wa Azareli, mwana wa Azai, mwana wa Meshilemothi, mwana wa Imeri,

english: and his associates —128 mighty men of valor. Zabdiel son of Haggedolim was their overseer.
ekegusii: na abamwabo, abanto abamanyete gokora emeremo buya, rigana erimo, na emerongo ebere, na batano na batato (128). Omoteneneri obo nere Sabidieli, mosinto o Hagedolimu.
swahili: na wenzao waliokuwa wenye uwezo: watu 128. Afisa wao mkuu alikuwa Zabdieli mwana wa Hagedolimu.

english: From the Levites: Shemaiah son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Bunni;
ekegusii: Abalawi nabwo aba: Semaya, mosinto o Hasubu, bw’Asirikamu, o Hasabia, o Buni.
swahili: Kutoka Walawi: Shemaya mwana wa Hashubu, mwana wa Azrikamu, mwana wa Hashabia, mwana wa Buni;

english: Shabbethai and Jozabad, two leaders of the Levites, who supervised the work outside the house of God;
ekegusii: Sabetai na Yosabadi, abwo babere nabwo barenge abateneneri b’Abalawi abwo barenge gokora emeremo isiko ase enyomba ya Nyasae.
swahili: Shabethai na Yozabadi, viongozi wawili wa Walawi, ambao walisimamia kazi za nje za nyumba ya Mungu;

english: Mattaniah son of Mica, the son of Zabdi, the son of Asaph, who led in thanksgiving and prayer; Bakbukiah, second among his associates; and Abda son of Shammua, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun.
ekegusii: Matania, mosinto o Mika o Sabudi bw’ororeria rw’Asafu, oyorenge omoraai bw’amatera ase okoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono amo nogosaba; Bakibukia, nere orenge oyo o kabere ase Matania; Abuda, mosinto o Samua o Galali bw’ororeria rwa Yedutuni.
swahili: Matania mwana wa Mika, mwana wa Zabdi, mwana wa Asafu, kiongozi aliyeongoza kutoa shukrani na maombi; Bakbukia aliyekuwa msaidizi wake kati ya wenzake; na Abda mwana wa Shamua, mwana wa Galali, mwana wa Yeduthuni.

english: The Levites in the holy city totaled 284.
ekegusii: Abalawi bonsi abamenyete ase omochie oyio omochenu nigo barenge amagana abere, na emerongo etano na etato, na baane (284).
swahili: Jumla ya Walawi waliokaa katika mji mtakatifu walikuwa watu 284.

english: And the gatekeepers: Akkub, Talmon, and their associates, who kept watch at the gates—172 men. Residents Outside Jerusalem
ekegusii: Abarendi b’ebiita nabwo aba: Akubu na Talimoni amo nabamwabo, abarenge korenda ase ebiita, bonsi nabaanto rigana erimo, na emerongo etano na ebere, na babere (172).
swahili: Mabawabu: Akubu, Talmoni na wenzao, waliolinda malango: watu 172.

english: And the people blessed all the men who volunteered to live in Jerusalem.
ekegusii: Abanto bagasesenia abwo bonsi beruete kogenda komenya Yerusalemu.
swahili: Watu waliwasifu wale wote waliojitolea kuishi Yerusalemu.

english: The rest of the Israelites, with the priests and Levites, were in all the villages of Judah, each on his own inheritance.
ekegusii: Abande b’Abaisraeli, na ab’abakuani, na ab’Abalawi, bakaba bamenyete ase emechie yonsi y’Abayuda, kera oyomo ase omwando oye.
swahili: Waisraeli waliosalia, pamoja na makuhani na Walawi, walikuwa katika miji yote ya Yuda, kila mmoja katika urithi wa baba yake.

english: The temple servants lived on the hill of Ophel, with Ziha and Gishpa over them.
ekegusii: Korende abakori emeremo be Hekalu bakamenya agwo Ofeli. Siha na Gisipa nabwo barenge abateneneri b’abwo.
swahili: Watumishi wa Hekalu waliishi katika kilima cha Ofeli. Siha na Gishpa walikuwa wasimamizi wao.

english: Now the overseer of the Levites in Jerusalem was Uzzi son of Bani, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Mica. He was one of Asaph’s descendants, who were the singers in charge of the service of the house of God.
ekegusii: Oyorenge omoteneneri bw’Abalawi abamenyete Yerusalemu, nere Usi, mosinto o Bani, o Hasabia, o Matania, o Mika. Usi nigo arenge oyomo bw’ororeria rw’Asafu, abanto abarenge abateneneri b’amatera ase enyomba ya Nyasae.
swahili: Afisa mkuu wa Walawi huko Yerusalemu alikuwa Uzi mwana wa Bani, mwana wa Hashabia, mwana wa Matania, mwana wa Mika. Uzi alikuwa mmoja wa wazao wa Asafu, waliokuwa waimbaji wenye kuwajibika kwa ajili ya huduma ya nyumba ya Mungu.

english: For there was a command from the king concerning the singers, an ordinance regulating their daily activities.
ekegusii: Omorwoti nigo aruete ogochika igoro ase abanto b’eamate eyio, buna barenge gokora emeremo y’amatera agwo ase Hekalu, buna yaganeirie rituko ase rituko.
swahili: Waimbaji walikuwa chini ya amri za mfalme, ambazo pia ziliratibu shughuli zao za kila siku.

english: Pethahiah son of Meshezabel, a descendant of Zerah son of Judah, was the king’s agent in every matter concerning the people.
ekegusii: Omorwoti nigo abegete Petahia, mosinto o Mesesabeli bw’ororeria rwa Sera, mosinto o Yuda, gotenenera abanto ase amang’ana onsi. Abanto abamenyete ase emechie ende
swahili: Pethahia mwana wa Meshezabeli, mmoja wa wazao wa Zera mwana wa Yuda, alikuwa mwakilishi wa mfalme katika mambo yote kuhusu mahusiano na watu.

english: As for the villages with their fields, some of the people of Judah lived in Kiriath-arba, Dibon, Jekabzeel, and their villages;
ekegusii: Abayuda bande bakaba bamenyete ase ebichie ang’e namaremo abo. Abande bakamenya Kiriati-Ariba na ase ebichie biaye; abande bakamenya Diboni na ase ebichie biaye, na abande Yekabuseli na ase ebichie biaye;
swahili: Kuhusu vijiji na mashamba yake, baadhi ya watu wa Yuda waliishi Kiriath-Arba na makazi yaliyokizunguka, katika Diboni na makazi yake, katika Yekabzeeli na vijiji vyake,

english: in Jeshua, Moladah, and Beth-pelet;
ekegusii: abande bakamenya Yesua, na Molada, na Beti-Peleti,
swahili: katika Yeshua, katika Molada, katika Beth-Peleti,

english: in Hazar-shual; in Beersheba and its villages;
ekegusii: na Hasani-Suali, na Beeri-Seba, na ase ebichie biaye;
swahili: katika Hasar-Shuali, katika Beer-Sheba na makazi yake,

english: in Ziklag; in Meconah and its villages;
ekegusii: abande bakamenya Sikilagi, na Mekona na ase ebichie biaye;
swahili: katika Siklagi, katika Mekona na makazi yake,

english: in En-rimmon, Zorah, Jarmuth,
ekegusii: abande bakamenya Eni-Rimoni, na Sora, na Yarimuti;
swahili: katika En-Rimoni, katika Sora, katika Yarmuthi,

english: These are the heads of the provinces who settled in Jerusalem. (In the villages of Judah, however, each lived on his own property in their towns—the Israelites, priests, Levites, temple servants, and descendants of Solomon’s servants—
ekegusii: Ase emechie emeke ase ense y’Abayuda, kera omonto bw’Abaisraeli bande bonsi, na abakuani, na Abalawi, na abakori emeremo be Hekalu, na abana b’abasomba ba Sulemani, akamenya ase omwando oye. Aba nabwo abanene be chingongo chi’ense y’Abayuda abamenyete Yerusalemu,
swahili: Hawa ndio viongozi wa majimbo waliokuja kuishi Yerusalemu (baadhi ya Waisraeli, makuhani, Walawi, watumishi wa Hekalu, na wazao wa watumishi wa Solomoni waliendelea kuishi katika miji ya Yuda, kila mmoja katika milki yake mwenyewe katika miji mbalimbali,

english: Zanoah, Adullam, and their villages; in Lachish and its fields; and in Azekah and its villages. So they settled from Beersheba all the way to the Valley of Hinnom.
ekegusii: Sanoa, na Adulamu na ase ebichie biabo, na Lakisi na amaremo narengeo, na Aseka na ase ebichie biaye. Ase ayio bakaba bakomenya gochakera Beeri-Seba goikera ase Rikura ria Hinomu.
swahili: Zanoa, Adulamu na vijiji vyake, katika Lakishi na mashamba yake, na katika Azeka na makazi yake. Hivyo walikuwa wakiishi kuanzia Beer-Sheba mpaka Bonde la Hinomu.

english: The descendants of Benjamin from Geba lived in Michmash, Aija, and Bethel with its villages;
ekegusii: Abanto b’egesaku kia Benjamini bakaba bakomenya gochakera Geba na kogenderera goikera Mikimasi, na Aiya, na Beteli na ase ebichie biaye;
swahili: Wazao wa Wabenyamini kutoka Geba waliishi Mikmashi, Aiya, Betheli na makazi yake,

english: in Anathoth, Nob, Ananiah,
ekegusii: Anatoti, na Nobu, na Anania;
swahili: katika Anathothi, Nobu na Anania,

english: Hazor, Ramah, Gittaim,
ekegusii: Hasori, na Rama, na Gitaimu;
swahili: katika Hazori, Rama na Gitaimu,

english: Hadid, Zeboim, Neballat,
ekegusii: Hadidi, na Seboimo na Nebalati;
swahili: katika Hadidi, Seboimu na Nebalati,

english: Lod, and Ono; and in the Valley of the Craftsmen.
ekegusii: Lodi, na Ono, na ase Rikura ri’Abaroisia Ebinto.
swahili: katika Lodi na Ono, na katika Bonde la Mafundi.

english: And some divisions of the Levites of Judah settled in Benjamin.
ekegusii: Ebiombe binde bi’Abalawi ebiamenyete ase ense y’Abayuda bikaba bikobarwa amo nabaanto ba Benjamini.
swahili: Baadhi ya makundi ya Walawi wa Yuda waliishi huko Benyamini.

english: while some of the descendants of Judah and Benjamin settled in Jerusalem.) From the descendants of Judah: Athaiah son of Uzziah, the son of Zechariah, the son of Amariah, the son of Shephatiah, the son of Mahalalel, a descendant of Perez;
ekegusii: abande barenge ab’ororeria rwa Yuda, na abande ab’orwa Benjamini. Ab’ororeria rwa Yuda nabwo aba: Ataya, mosinto o Usia, o Zakaria, bw’Amaria, o Sefatia, o Mahalaleli, bw’ororeria rwa Peresi;
swahili: ambapo watu wengine kutoka Yuda na Benyamini waliishi Yerusalemu). Kutoka wazao wa Yuda: Athaya mwana wa Uzia, mwana wa Zekaria, mwana wa Amaria, mwana wa Shefatia, mwana wa Mahalaleli, mzao wa Peresi.

english: and Maaseiah son of Baruch, the son of Col-hozeh, the son of Hazaiah, the son of Adaiah, the son of Joiarib, the son of Zechariah, a descendant of Shelah.
ekegusii: Maaseya, mosinto o Baruku, o Koli-Hose, o Hasaya, bw’Adaya, o Yoyaribu, o Zakaria, bw’ororeria rwa Siloni.
swahili: Naye Maaseya mwana wa Baruku, mwana wa Kolhoze, mwana wa Hazaya, mwana wa Adaya, mwana wa Yoyaribu, mwana wa Zekaria, mzao wa Mshiloni.

english: From the descendants of Benjamin: Sallu son of Meshullam, the son of Joed, the son of Pedaiah, the son of Kolaiah, the son of Maaseiah, the son of Ithiel, the son of Jeshaiah;
ekegusii: Ab’ororeria rwa Benjamini nabwo aba: Salu, mosinto o Mesulamu, o Yoedi, o Pedaya, o Kolaya, o Maaseya, o Itieli, o Yesaia.
swahili: Kutoka wazao wa Benyamini: Salu mwana wa Meshulamu, mwana wa Yoedi, mwana wa Pedaya, mwana wa Kolaya, mwana wa Maaseya, mwana wa Ithieli, mwana wa Yeshaya

english: Joel son of Zichri was the officer over them, and Judah son of Hassenuah was over the Second District of the city.
ekegusii: Yoel, mosinto o Sikiri, nere orenge omoteneneri obo; na Yuda, mosinto o Hasenua, akaba omoteneneri o kabere ase omochie oria.
swahili: Yoeli mwana wa Zikri alikuwa afisa wao mkuu, naye Yuda mwana wa Hasenua alikuwa msimamizi juu ya Mtaa wa Pili katika mji.

english: Now these are the priests and Levites who went up with Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel and with Jeshua: Seraiah, Jeremiah, Ezra,
ekegusii: Oyo noro omooroberio bw’abakuani na Abalawi abairanete korwa ase obosomba amo na Serubabeli, mosinto o Sealitieli, na Yesua. Abakuani nabwo aba: Seraya, na Yeremia na Ezra;
swahili: Hawa wafuatao walikuwa makuhani na Walawi ambao walirudi na Zerubabeli mwana wa Shealtieli pamoja na Yeshua: Seraya, Yeremia, Ezra,

english: Jeshua was the father of Joiakim, Joiakim was the father of Eliashib, Eliashib was the father of Joiada,
ekegusii: Yesua akaibora Yoyakimu, na Yoyakimu akaibora Eliasibu, na Eliasibu akaibora Yoyada,
swahili: Yeshua alikuwa baba wa Yoyakimu, Yoyakimu alikuwa baba wa Eliashibu, Eliashibu alikuwa baba wa Yoyada,

english: Joiada was the father of Jonathan, and Jonathan was the father of Jaddua.
ekegusii: na Yoyada akaibora Yonathani, na Yonathani akaibora Yadua. Abateneneri be chiamate chi’abakuani
swahili: Yoyada alikuwa baba wa Yonathani, na Yonathani alikuwa baba wa Yadua.

english: In the days of Joiakim, these were the heads of the priestly families: of the family of Seraiah, Meraiah; of Jeremiah, Hananiah;
ekegusii: Ase amatuko a Yoyakimu abateneneri be chiamate chi’abakuani nabwo aba: Meraya ase eamate ya Seraya, na Hanania ase eamate ya Yeremia;
swahili: Katika siku za Yoyakimu, kulikuwa na wakuu wa jamaa za kikuhani: wa jamaa ya Seraya, Meraya; wa jamaa ya Yeremia, Hanania;

english: of Ezra, Meshullam; of Amariah, Jehohanan;
ekegusii: Mesulamu ase eamate y’Ezara, na Yehohanani ase eamate y’Amaria;
swahili: wa jamaa ya Ezra, Meshulamu; wa jamaa ya Amaria, Yehohanani;

english: of Malluchi, Jonathan; of Shebaniah, Joseph;
ekegusii: Yonathani ase eamate ya Maluki, na Yosefu ase eamate ya Sebania;
swahili: wa jamaa ya Maluki, Yonathani; wa jamaa ya Shebania, Yosefu;

english: of Harim, Adna; of Meraioth, Helkai;
ekegusii: Adina ase eamate ya Harimu, na Helikai ase eamate ya Merayoti;
swahili: wa jamaa ya Harimu, Adna; wa jamaa ya Meremothi, Helkai;

english: of Iddo, Zechariah; of Ginnethon, Meshullam;
ekegusii: Zakaria ase eamate ya Ido, na Mesulamu ase eamate ya Ginetoni;
swahili: wa jamaa ya Ido, Zekaria; wa jamaa ya Ginethoni, Meshulamu;

english: of Abijah, Zichri; of Miniamin and of Moadiah, Piltai;
ekegusii: Sikiri ase eamate y’Abiya, na Pilitai ase eamate ya Miniamini, na eya Moadiya;
swahili: wa jamaa ya Abiya, Zikri; wa jamaa ya Miniamini na ya Maazia, Piltai;

english: of Bilgah, Shammua; of Shemaiah, Jonathan;
ekegusii: Samua ase eamate ya Biliga, na Yehonathani ase eamate ya Semaya;
swahili: wa jamaa ya Bilgai, Shamua; wa jamaa ya Shemaya, Yehonathani;

english: of Joiarib, Mattenai; of Jedaiah, Uzzi;
ekegusii: Matenai ase eamate ya Yoyaribu, na Usi ase eamate ya Yedaya;
swahili: wa jamaa ya Yoyaribu, Matenai; wa jamaa ya Yedaya, Uzi;

english: Amariah, Malluch, Hattush,
ekegusii: Amaria, na Maluku, na Hatusi;
swahili: Amaria, Maluki, Hatushi,

english: of Sallai, Kallai; of Amok, Eber;
ekegusii: Kalai ase eamate ya Salai, na Eberi ase eamate y’Amoki;
swahili: wa jamaa ya Salu, Kalai; wa jamaa ya Amoki, Eberi;

english: of Hilkiah, Hashabiah; and of Jedaiah, Nethanel.
ekegusii: Hasabia ase eamate ya Hilikia, na Netaneli ase eamate ya Yedaya. Omoroberio bwe chiamate chi’abakuani na echi’Abalawi
swahili: wa jamaa ya Hilkia, Hashabia; wa jamaa ya Yedaya, Nethaneli.

english: In the days of Eliashib, Joiada, Johanan, and Jaddua, during the reign of Darius the Persian, the heads of the families of the Levites and priests were recorded.
ekegusii: Omoroberio bw’abateneneri be chiamate chi’Abalawi okarikwa ase amatuko ’Eliasibu, na Yoyada, na Yohanani, na Yadua, Boigo oyo bw’abakuani okarikwa ekero Dario arenge omogambi bw’Abaayemi.
swahili: Wakuu wa jamaa za Walawi katika siku za Eliashibu, Yoyada, Yohanani na Yadua, pia wale jamaa za makuhani, waliandikishwa wakati wa utawala wa Dario, Mwajemi.

english: As for the descendants of Levi, the family heads up to the days of Johanan son of Eliashib were recorded in the Book of the Chronicles.
ekegusii: Omoroberio bw’Abalawi abarenge abateneneri be chiamate chiabo okarikwa ase Egetabu ki’amang’ana ’Ebiro goikera ase amatuko a Yohanani, mosinto bw’Eliasibu. Ogwatananwa kw’emeremo ye Hekalu
swahili: Wakuu wa jamaa miongoni mwa wazao wa Lawi hadi wakati wa Yohanani mwana wa Eliashibu waliandikishwa katika kitabu cha kumbukumbu.

english: The leaders of the Levites were Hashabiah, Sherebiah, and Jeshua son of Kadmiel, along with their associates, who stood across from them to give praise and thanksgiving as one section alternated with the other, as prescribed by David the man of God.
ekegusii: Oyo noro omooroberio bw’abateneneri b’Abalawi: Hasabia, na Serebia, na Yesua, mosinto o Kadimieli. Abwo amo nabamwabo bande nabwo babegetwe ase ebiombe biateneneretwe korigererania ase ogoitabererania amatera ay’ogotogia na koiraneria ng’a mbuya mono, buna Daudi, omonto o Nyasae, achigete.
swahili: Viongozi wa Walawi walikuwa: Hashabia, Sherebia, Yeshua mwana wa Kadmieli na wenzao, waliosimama mkabala nao kusifu na kushukuru, sehemu moja ikipokezana na nyingine kama ilivyoagizwa na Daudi mtu wa Mungu.

english: Mattaniah, Bakbukiah, Obadiah, Meshullam, Talmon, and Akkub were gatekeepers who guarded the storerooms at the gates.
ekegusii: Matania, na Bakibukia, na Obadia, na Mesulamu, na Talimoni, na Akubu, abarendi b’ebiita, nigo barenge korenda ebigachero agwo ase ebiita.
swahili: Mabawabu waliokuwa wakilinda kwenye malango ya ghala ni: Matania, Bakbukia, Obadia, Meshulamu, Talmoni na Akubu.

english: They served in the days of Joiakim son of Jeshua, the son of Jozadak, and in the days of Nehemiah the governor and Ezra the priest and scribe. The Dedication of the Wall
ekegusii: Abanto abwo nigo barengeo ase amatuko a Yoyakimu, mosinto o Yesua o Yosadaki, na ase amatuko a Nehemia omogabana, na ay’Ezara, oyorenge Omokuani na omworokia bw’amariko. Nehemia ogwatanana na gochena orwaki rw’Omochie
swahili: Walihudumu siku za Yoyakimu mwana wa Yeshua, mwana wa Yosadaki, na katika siku za mtawala Nehemia, na za Ezra kuhani na mwandishi. Kuwekwa Wakfu Ukuta Wa Yerusalemu

english: At the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem, the Levites were sought out from all their homes and brought to Jerusalem to celebrate the joyous dedication with thanksgiving and singing, accompanied by cymbals, harps, and lyres.
ekegusii: Ekero omochie o Yerusalemu orenge gwatananwa na gochenwa, Abalawi bakarentwa Yerusalemu korwa aase ande onsi ase bamenyete, erinde bache ase ogwatananwa okwo bare nomogooko, babe bakoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono namatera, na goakania chisani chikwoga, na amakano ao ao.
swahili: Wakati wa kuwekwa wakfu ukuta wa Yerusalemu, Walawi walitafutwa kule walikokuwa wakiishi, nao wakaletwa Yerusalemu kuadhimisha kwa shangwe huko kuweka wakfu kwa nyimbo za shukrani na kwa uimbaji wakitumia matoazi, vinubi na zeze.

english: The singers were also assembled from the region around Jerusalem, from the villages of the Netophathites,
ekegusii: Chiamate ch’abateri chigasangererigwa korwa ase chinsemo chionsi chia Yerusalemu, na korwa ase emechie y’Abaanetofa.
swahili: Pia waimbaji walikusanywa pamoja kutoka maeneo yaliyozunguka Yerusalemu, kutoka vijiji vya Wanetofathi,

english: from Beth-gilgal, and from the fields of Geba and Azmaveth, for they had built villages for themselves around Jerusalem.
ekegusii: Boigo bagasangererigwa korwa Beti-Giligali na korwa ase orogongo rwa Geba, na Asimaweti, ekiagera abateri abwo konya baagachire emechie yabo goetanana Yerusalemu.
swahili: kutoka Beth-Gilgali, na kutoka eneo la Geba na Azmawethi, kwa kuwa waimbaji walikuwa wamejijengea vijiji kuzunguka Yerusalemu.

english: Shecaniah, Rehum, Meremoth,
ekegusii: Sekania, na Rehumu, na Meremoti;
swahili: Shekania, Rehumu, Meremothi,

english: After the priests and Levites had purified themselves, they purified the people, the gates, and the wall.
ekegusii: Abakuani na Abalawi bagechena abanyene, bagachena nabaanto bonsi amo nebiita, na orwaki roria.
swahili: Wakati makuhani na Walawi walipokuwa wamekwisha kujitakasa kwa kufuatana na desturi, waliwatakasa watu, malango na ukuta.

english: Then I brought the leaders of Judah up on the wall, and I appointed two great thanksgiving choirs. One was to proceed along the top of the wall to the right, toward the Dung Gate.
ekegusii: Erio nkarenta abanene b’Abayuda igoro ase orwaki, ngachora ebiombe bibere ebinene bikaba bigotaara igoro ase orwaki roria na goteera ogoteera gw’okoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono. Ekeombe ekemo kegataara agwo igoro ase orwaki gochia ase ensemo y’okorio goikera ase Egeita ki’Eubi.
swahili: Niliwaagiza viongozi wa Yuda wapande juu ya ukuta. Pia niliagiza makundi mawili makubwa ya waimbaji waimbe nyimbo za kumshukuru Mungu. Kundi moja lilipanda juu ya ukuta upande wa kuume, kuelekea Lango la Samadi.

english: Hoshaiah and half the leaders of Judah followed,
ekegusii: Abanto babwatetie ekeombe ekio nabwo aba: Hosaya, na ekeng’ese ki’abanene b’Abayuda,
swahili: Hoshaya na nusu ya viongozi wa Yuda wakawafuata,

english: along with Azariah, Ezra, Meshullam,
ekegusii: Asaria, na Ezra, na Mesulamu;
swahili: pamoja na Azaria, Ezra, Meshulamu,

english: Judah, Benjamin, Shemaiah, Jeremiah,
ekegusii: Yuda na Benjamini, na Semaya, na Yeremia.
swahili: Yuda, Benyamini, Shemaya, Yeremia,

english: and some of the priests with trumpets, and also Zechariah son of Jonathan, the son of Shemaiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Micaiah, the son of Zaccur, the son of Asaph,
ekegusii: Ababwatetie abwo n’Abakuani babwate ebitureeri, na Zakaria, mosinto o Yonathani, o Semaya, o Matania, o Mikaya, o Sakuri bw’Asafu.
swahili: pamoja na baadhi ya makuhani wenye tarumbeta, na pia walikuwa na Zekaria mwana wa Yonathani, mwana wa Shemaya, mwana wa Matania, mwana wa Mikaya, mwana wa Zakuri, mwana wa Asafu,

english: and his associates—Shemaiah, Azarel, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Nethanel, Judah, and Hanani—with the musical instruments prescribed by David the man of God. Ezra the scribe led the procession.
ekegusii: Abande b’eamate ya Zakaria: Semaya na Asareli, Milalai na Gilalai, Maai na Netaneli, Yuda na Hanani. Abwo nigo babwate ebinto biare kobugigwa, ebio Daudi, omonto o Nyasae, achigete. Ezra, omworokia bw’amariko, akaba otang’anete ekeombe ekio.
swahili: pamoja na wenzake, Shemaya, Azareli, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Nethaneli, Yuda na Hanani, wakiwa na vyombo vya uimbaji, kama ilivyoagizwa na Daudi mtu wa Mungu. Mwandishi Ezra aliongoza maandamano.

english: At the Fountain Gate they climbed the steps of the City of David on the ascent to the wall and passed above the house of David to the Water Gate on the east.
ekegusii: Agwo ase Egeita gi’Ensoko kiarenge bosio bwabo bakariina ase ebiriinero gochia ase Omochie o Daudi. Agwo bakariina ase orwaki rwarenge rogoro y’enyomba ya Daudi, gochia ase Egeita ki’Amache, ase ensemo ya moocha.
swahili: Kwenye Lango la Chemchemi waliendelea moja kwa moja mpaka kwenye ngazi za Mji wa Daudi, kwenye mwinuko wa ukuta, na kupitia juu ya nyumba ya Daudi mpaka kwenye Lango la Maji upande wa mashariki.

english: The second thanksgiving choir proceeded to the left, and I followed it with half the people along the top of the wall, past the Tower of the Ovens to the Broad Wall,
ekegusii: Ekeombe kende ki’abateri baria barenge goteera amatera ay’okoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono, bakagenda gochia ensemo y’okobee igoro ase orwaki roria, na inche amo nekeng’ese ki’abaanto tokababwatia, tokagenda goetera ase Omorobiri bw’eriko, gochia ase Orwaki Orogare.
swahili: Kundi la pili la waimbaji lilielekea upande wa kushoto. Niliwafuata juu ya ukuta, pamoja na nusu ya watu kupitia Mnara wa Tanuru mpaka kwenye Ukuta Mpana,

english: over the Gate of Ephraim, the Jeshanah Gate, the Fish Gate, the Tower of Hananel, and the Tower of the Hundred, as far as the Sheep Gate. And they stopped at the Gate of the Guard.
ekegusii: Naende togaetera Egeita gi’Efraimu, na Egeita Egekoro, na Egeita gie Chinswe, na Omorobiri o Hananeli, na Omorobiri bwe Rigana, goika ase Egeita gie Ching’ondi. Togakoorera orogendo rwaito agwo ase Egeita ki’Abarendi.
swahili: juu ya Lango la Efraimu, Lango la Yeshana, Lango la Samaki, Mnara wa Hananeli, na Mnara wa Mia, mpaka kwenye Lango la Kondoo. Walipofika kwenye Lango la Ulinzi wakasimama.

english: Iddo, Ginnethon, Abijah,
ekegusii: Ido, na Ginetoi, na Abiya;
swahili: Ido, Ginethoni, Abiya,

english: The two thanksgiving choirs then stood in the house of God, as did I, along with the half of the officials accompanying me,
ekegusii: Ase ayio ebiombe bi’abateri abarenge goteera amatera ay’okoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono bigatenena ime ase enyomba ya Nyasae, na inche amo nekeng’ese ki’abanene baria togatenena nabarabwo.
swahili: Kisha yale makundi mawili ya waimbaji yaliyoshukuru yakachukua nafasi zao katika nyumba ya Mungu. Nami pia nikafanya hivyo, pamoja na nusu ya maafisa,

english: as well as the priests with their trumpets—Eliakim, Maaseiah, Miniamin, Micaiah, Elioenai, Zechariah, and Hananiah—
ekegusii: Eliakimu na Maaseya, Miyamini na Mikaya, Elioenai na Zakaria, na Hanania, abarenge abakuani, bagatenena babwatete ebitureeri.
swahili: na makuhani wafuatao: Eliakimu, Maaseya, Miniamini, Mikaya, Elioenai, Zekaria na Hanania wakiwa na tarumbeta zao,

english: and also Maaseiah, Shemaiah, Eleazar, Uzzi, Jehohanan, Malchijah, Elam, and Ezer. Then the choirs sang out under the direction of Jezrahiah.
ekegusii: Naende mbarengeo Maaseya na Semaya, Eleazari na Usi, Yehohanani na Malikia, Elamu na Eseri. Abateri abwo bagatera, na Yesirahia nere orenge omoraai obo.
swahili: na pia Maaseya, Shemaya, Eleazari, Uzi, Yehohanani, Malkiya, Elamu na Ezeri. Makundi haya yaliimba chini ya uongozi wa Yezrahia.

english: On that day they offered great sacrifices, rejoicing because God had given them great joy. The women and children also rejoiced, so that the joy of Jerusalem was heard from afar. Provisions for Temple Worship
ekegusii: Ase rituko riria bakarua ebing’wanso ebinene, na bagachenga nomogooko omonene mono, ekiagera Nyasae abagogetie. Abakungu amo nabana boigo bagachenga, na omochengo oria orenge Yerusalemu okaigweka gochia aare. Abateneneri b’ebiegwa bie Hekalu
swahili: Siku hiyo watu walitoa dhabihu nyingi, wakishangilia kwa sababu Mungu aliwapa furaha kuu. Wanawake na watoto walishangilia pia. Sauti ya kushangilia huko Yerusalemu iliweza kusikika mbali sana.
