ekegusii: Omonene akarenta omwaga, na omwaga oyio okarenta chinkware korwa ase enyancha, ogachiruta igoro y’ebitwori gochia ase oboare bw’orogeendo rwe rituko erimo goetania ebitwori chigatorerekana, chikaba chinduenyi gocha igoro koreng’ana ekerengo ki’amaboko abere.
swahili: Kisha ukatokea upepo kutoka kwa Bwana, nao ukawaletea kware kutoka baharini. Ukawaangusha kwenye eneo lote linalozunguka kambi na kujaa ardhini kimo cha mita moja hivi kutoka ardhini kwenye eneo la umbali wa mwendo wa siku moja kila upande.

english: All that day and night, and all the next day, the people stayed up gathering the quail. No one gathered less than ten homers, and they spread them out all around the camp.
ekegusii: Abanto bakaimoka, bagasangereria chinkware chiria ase rituko riria rigima, na obotuko bwonsi, naende rituko ria kabere. Oyosangereretie chinke nigo asangereretie chiaisaine goetania ebitonga rigana erimo. Bagachikora emetanda aande onsi ase ebitwori.
swahili: Mchana kutwa na usiku kucha pamoja na siku nzima iliyofuata watu walitoka kwenda kuokota kware. Hakuna mtu yeyote aliyekusanya chini ya homeri kumi. Kisha wakazianika kuzunguka kambi yote.

english: But while the meat was still between their teeth, before it was chewed, the anger of the LORD burned against the people, and the LORD struck them with a severe plague.
ekegusii: Ekero abanto babekire chinyama menwa yabo, na konya batarachimera, Omonene akaba nendamwamu enene ase bare, akabaita ase okobaaka namaakwa amanene mono.
swahili: Lakini walipokuwa wakila nyama, ilipokuwa ingali kati ya meno yao na kabla hawajamaliza kula, hasira ya Bwana ikawaka dhidi ya watu, naye akawapiga kwa tauni.

english: So they called that place Kibroth-hattaavah, because there they buried the people who had craved other food.
ekegusii: Aase aaria akarokwa Kibiroti‐Hatawa, ekiagera aroro agwo nao abanto baria barenge abatoonu b’okogania chinyama batindegetwe.
swahili: Kwa hiyo mahali hapo pakaitwa Kibroth-Hataava, kwa sababu huko ndiko walipowazika watu ambao walitamani sana chakula kingine.

english: From Kibroth-hattaavah the people moved on to Hazeroth, where they remained for some time.
ekegusii: Abanto bakarua Kibiroti‐Hatawa, bakageenda bagaika Haseroti, bakabeera aroro.
swahili: Kutoka Kibroth-Hataava watu wakasafiri mpaka Haserothi na kukaa huko.

english: Meanwhile, the rabble among them had a strong craving for other food, and again the Israelites wept and said, “Who will feed us meat?
ekegusii: Abanto baria basang’anaine n’Abaisraeli nigo barenge nobotoonu obonene bw’okogania chinyama, na Abaisraeli boigo bakarera bagateeba, “Naki totanyora chinyama torie?
swahili: Umati wa watu wenye zogo waliokuwa miongoni mwao walitamani sana chakula kingine, Waisraeli wakaanza kulia tena na kusema, “Laiti tungekuwa na nyama tule!

english: We remember the fish we ate freely in Egypt, along with the cucumbers, melons, leeks, onions, and garlic.
ekegusii: Twainyoire chinswe twarenge koria ase ense ya Misiri totare goakanera, na endagera ende enga buna emiongo emerandi, na emenyobio, na ebitunguo biare ao ao, ebiororo amo nebiroro.
swahili: Tunakumbuka wale samaki tuliokula huko Misri bila gharama, pia yale matango, matikitimaji, mboga, vitunguu, na vitunguu saumu.

english: But now our appetite is gone; there is nothing to see but this manna!”
ekegusii: Na bono chinguru chiaito chiatoereire, titobwati endagera ende tokoria otatiga Mana yoka.”
swahili: Lakini sasa tumepoteza hamu ya chakula; hatuoni kitu kingine chochote isipokuwa hii mana!”

english: Now the manna resembled coriander seed, and its appearance was like that of gum resin.
ekegusii: Mana nigo yarenge kororekana buna chinyeke chi’amaemba enkomba.
swahili: Mana ilifanana kama mbegu za giligilani, nayo ilikuwa na rangi ya manjano iliyopauka.

english: The people walked around and gathered it, ground it on a handmill or crushed it in a mortar, then boiled it in a cooking pot or shaped it into cakes. It tasted like pastry baked with fine oil.
ekegusii: Abanto nigo barenge gosoka bayesangereria, naende bayesia ne chingena, gose bayeswaga ase chikonu. Erio baba bakoyeiyekera ase chinyongo na koyeroisia yaba emagaati. Igo yarenge gwansa buna amaandasi aroiseirie amaguta.
swahili: Hao watu walikwenda kukusanya, kisha waliisaga kwa mawe ya kusagia ya mkono au kuitwanga kwenye vinu. Waliipika vyunguni au kutengeneza maandazi. Ladha yake ilikuwa kama kitu kilichotengenezwa kwa mafuta ya zeituni.

english: When the dew fell on the camp at night, the manna would fall with it. The Complaint of Moses
ekegusii: Mana eyio nigo yarenge kogwa amo ne riime ase ebitwori ekero kia botuko.
swahili: Umande ulipoanguka kambini wakati wa usiku, pia mana ilianguka pamoja nao.

english: Then Miriam and Aaron criticized Moses because of the Cushite woman he had married, for he had taken a Cushite wife.
ekegusii: Miriamu na Aroni bagakwana amang’ana arenge mamincha ya Musa, ekiagera Musa konya onyuomire omokungu korwa ase Abaetiopia.
swahili: Miriamu na Aroni walianza kuzungumza dhidi ya Mose kwa sababu ya mke wake Mkushi, kwa kuwa alikuwa ameoa Mkushi.

english: As the cloud lifted from above the Tent, suddenly Miriam became leprous, white as snow. Aaron turned toward her, saw that she was leprous,
ekegusii: Ekero riire riria riaruete ase Eema eria, omobere o Miriamu konya obeire noborwaire bwa ukoma, okaraba se. Aroni akaonchoka komorigereria, akarora ng’a omobere oye obeire noborwaire bwa ukoma.
swahili: Wakati hilo wingu liliinuka kutoka juu ya Hema, Miriamu akawa tayari ana ukoma, mweupe kama theluji. Aroni akamgeukia, akaona ana ukoma.

english: and said to Moses, “My lord, please do not hold against us this sin we have so foolishly committed.
ekegusii: Erio Aroni agateebia Musa, “Aye omonene one, koranche, tobaisa gotoa egesusuro, ekiagera intwe nigo twakorire egento ki’oboriri, na twakorire ebibe.
swahili: Kisha Aroni akamwambia Mose, “Tafadhali, bwana wangu, usituhesabie dhambi hii ambayo tumeifanya kwa upumbavu.

english: Please do not let her be like a stillborn infant whose flesh is half consumed when he comes out of his mother’s womb.”
ekegusii: Totiga Miriamu abe buna oyokuure, buna omonto oiboretwe ne chinyama ekeng’ese, chianiarokeire inda, chiaerire.”
swahili: Usimwache awe kama mtoto mchanga aliyezaliwa akiwa mfu, ambaye nusu ya mwili wake imeharibika hapo atokapo katika tumbo la mama yake.”

english: So Moses cried out to the LORD, “O God, please heal her!”
ekegusii: Musa akarera ase Omonene, “Aye Nyasae, nagosoroire, koranche ogwenie Miriamu!”
swahili: Hivyo Mose akamlilia Bwana akisema, “Ee Mungu, nakuomba umponye!”

english: But the LORD answered Moses, “If her father had but spit in her face, would she not have been in disgrace for seven days? Let her be confined outside the camp for seven days; after that she may be brought back in.”
ekegusii: Korende Omonene akairaneria Musa, “Onye rende ise arenge komotwera amate ase obosio bwaye, Inee, tagwenerete anyore obosooku ase engaki y’amatuko atan’abere? Tiga aatananwe korwa ase egetwori abekwe ase aao ase engaki y’amatuko atan’abere, na magega y’ayio airanigwe ase egetwori.”
swahili: Bwana akamjibu Mose, “Je, kama baba yake angemtemea usoni, asingeona aibu kwa siku saba? Mfungie nje ya kambi kwa siku saba; baada ya hapo anaweza kurudishwa kambini.”

english: So Miriam was confined outside the camp for seven days, and the people did not move on until she was brought in again.
ekegusii: Ase ayio Miriamu agasokigwa isiko y’egetwori, akabeekwa ase aao ase engaki y’amatuko atan’abere, na abanto tibaimogete kogeenda goika ekero Miriamu airanete ase egetwori.
swahili: Kwa hiyo Miriamu akafungiwa nje ya kambi kwa siku saba, nao watu hawakuendelea na safari mpaka aliporudishwa kambini.

english: After that, the people set out from Hazeroth and camped in the Wilderness of Paran.
ekegusii: Magega y’ayio abanto bakaimoka kogeenda korwa ase Haseroti, bagaika ase erooro ya Parani, bagatoora aroro.
swahili: Baada ya hayo, watu waliondoka Haserothi, wakapiga kambi katika Jangwa la Parani.

english: “Does the LORD speak only through Moses?” they said. “Does He not also speak through us?” And the LORD heard this.
ekegusii: Bagakwana, bagateeba, “Inee! Omonene nigo agokwana na Musa bweka? Tari gokwana naintwe?” Omonene akaigwa amang’ana ayio.
swahili: Waliuliza, “Je, Bwana amesema kupitia Mose peke yake? Je, hajasema kutupitia sisi pia?” Naye Bwana akasikia hili.

english: Now Moses was a very humble man, more so than any man on the face of the earth.
ekegusii: Omonto oyio Musa nigo arenge omoitongo mono kobua abanto bonsi barenge ase ense.
swahili: (Basi Mose alikuwa mtu mnyenyekevu sana, mnyenyekevu kuliko mtu mwingine yeyote katika uso wa dunia.)

english: And suddenly the LORD said to Moses, Aaron, and Miriam, “You three, come out to the Tent of Meeting.” So the three went out,
ekegusii: Erio agwo Omonene agakwana na Musa, na Aroni, na Miriamu, akabateebia, “Nimbaganetie inwe batato mochiche agwo ase Eema y’Omosangererekano.” Abwo batato bakageenda aroro.
swahili: Ghafula Bwana akawaambia Mose, Aroni na Miriamu, “Njooni katika Hema la Kukutania, ninyi nyote watatu.” Kwa hiyo wote watatu wakaenda.

english: and the LORD came down in a pillar of cloud, stood at the entrance to the Tent, and summoned Aaron and Miriam. When both of them had stepped forward,
ekegusii: Omonene agaika korwa igoro ore ime ase riire riria riare buna esiiro, agatenena agwo ase egesoero ki’Eema eria, akarangeria Aroni na Miriamu. Barabwo bagasuka gochia bosio,
swahili: Kisha Bwana akashuka katika nguzo ya wingu, akasimama kwenye ingilio la Hema, akawaita Aroni na Miriamu. Wakati wote wawili waliposogea mbele,

english: He said, “Hear now My words: If there is a prophet among you, I, the LORD, will reveal Myself to him in a vision; I will speak to him in a dream.
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene akabateebia, “Igwa amang’ana ane: Onye omobani ore ase egati yaino, inche Omonene nigo ’nkwemanyekania ase are ase okorora, naende nakwana nere ase chindoto.
swahili: Bwana akasema, “Sikilizeni maneno yangu: “Akiwapo nabii wa Bwana miongoni mwenu, nitajifunua kwake kwa maono, nitanena naye katika ndoto.

english: But this is not so with My servant Moses; he is faithful in all My house.
ekegusii: Korende ase Musa, omosomba one, taibo, ere nomwegenwa ase enyomba yane yonsi.
swahili: Lakini sivyo kwa mtumishi wangu Mose; yeye ni mwaminifu katika nyumba yangu yote.

english: I speak with him face to face, clearly and not in riddles; he sees the form of the LORD. Why then were you unafraid to speak against My servant Moses?”
ekegusii: Nigo ’ngokwana nere obosio ase obosio, gose tindi gokwana nere ase emerabaaro; ere ororire ekieni kiane. Nase ki inwe motabeete n’obwoba gokwana mamincha ya Musa, omosomba one?”
swahili: Kwake nitanena naye uso kwa uso, waziwazi wala si kwa mafumbo; yeye ataona umbo la Bwana. Kwa nini basi ninyi hamkuogopa kuzungumza kinyume cha mtumishi wangu Mose?”

english: So the anger of the LORD burned against them, and He departed.
ekegusii: Endamwamu y’Omonene ekaba enene ase bare, akarua aroro agwo, akageenda.
swahili: Hasira ya Bwana ikawaka dhidi yao, akawaacha.

english: from the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel son of Sodi;
ekegusii: korwa ase egesaku gia Sabuloni, Gadieli, mosinto o Sodi;
swahili: kutoka kabila la Zabuloni, Gadieli mwana wa Sodi,

english: from the tribe of Manasseh (a tribe of Joseph), Gaddi son of Susi;
ekegusii: korwa ase egesaku kia Yusufu (nakio ekia Manase), Gadi, mosinto o Susi;
swahili: kutoka kabila la Manase (kabila la Yosefu), Gadi mwana wa Susi;

english: from the tribe of Dan, Ammiel son of Gemalli;
ekegusii: korwa ase egesaku gia Dani, Amieli, mosinto o Gemali;
swahili: kutoka kabila la Dani, Amieli mwana wa Gemali;

english: from the tribe of Asher, Sethur son of Michael;
ekegusii: korwa ase egesaku gi’Aseri, Seturi, mosinto o Mikaeli;
swahili: kutoka kabila la Asheri, Sethuri mwana wa Mikaeli;

english: from the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi son of Vophsi;
ekegusii: korwa ase egesaku kia Nafutali, Nabi, mosinto o Bofasi;
swahili: kutoka kabila la Naftali, Nabi mwana wa Wofsi;

english: and from the tribe of Gad, Geuel son of Machi.
ekegusii: korwa ase egesaku kia Gadi, Geueli, mosinto o Maki.
swahili: kutoka kabila la Gadi, Geueli mwana wa Maki.

english: These were the names of the men Moses sent to spy out the land; and Moses gave to Hoshea son of Nun the name Joshua.
ekegusii: Aya naro amarieta y’ abanto baria Musa atomete gochia koroota ense eria. Musa akaroka Hosea, mosinto o Nuni, Yoshua.
swahili: Haya ndiyo majina ya watu ambao Mose aliwatuma kuipeleleza nchi. (Mose akampa Hoshea mwana wa Nuni jina Yoshua.)

english: When Moses sent them to spy out the land of Canaan, he told them, “Go up through the Negev and into the hill country.
ekegusii: Ekero Musa are kobatoma gochia koroota ense ya Kaanani, akabateebia, “Genda motiire gochia Negebu, ensemo ya Irianyi y’ense eria, naende motiire gochia igoro ase ense y’ebitunwa.
swahili: Mose alipowatuma wakaipeleleze Kanaani, alisema, “Pandeni kupitia Negebu, mwende mpaka nchi ya vilima.

english: See what the land is like and whether its people are strong or weak, few or many.
ekegusii: Morigererie buna ense eria ere, naende morore gose abanto bareo ’mbare ne chinguru, gose naboro bare, gose nabake, gose nabange.
swahili: Mwone nchi ni ya namna gani, na kama watu waishio humo wana nguvu au ni wadhaifu, iwapo ni wachache au wengi.

english: Is the land where they live good or bad? Are the cities where they dwell open camps or fortifications?
ekegusii: Naende morore gose ense eria abanto bamenyete nengiya gose nembe, naende morore emechie yabo ase bamenyete, onye nigo ere ebitwori gose nigo egiteire chindwaki.
swahili: Wanaishi katika nchi ya namna gani? Je, ni nzuri au mbaya? Wanaishi katika miji ya namna gani? Je, haina kuta au ngome?

english: “Send out for yourself men to spy out the land of Canaan, which I am giving to the Israelites. From each of their fathers’ tribes send one man who is a leader among them.”
ekegusii: “Chora omotang’ani oyomo korwa ase kera egesaku ase ebisaku bionsi ikomi na bibere bi’Abaisraeli, erio obatome bagende koroota ense ya Kaanani, ense eria ’ngochia koa Abaisraeli.”
swahili: “Watume baadhi ya watu wakaipeleleze nchi ya Kanaani, ambayo ninawapa Waisraeli. Kutoka kwa kila kabila la baba zao, tuma mmoja wa viongozi wao.”

english: Is the soil fertile or unproductive? Are there trees in it or not? Be courageous, and bring back some of the fruit of the land.” (It was the season for the first ripe grapes.)
ekegusii: Morigererie gose riroba ndire nobotobu gose neritaka, naende gose emete nereo, gose teiyo. Mobe abaremu, morentane okwama kw’amatunda gw’ense eria.” (Engaki eria nigo yarenge ekero emesabibu konya yamire ase ogotongorwa.)
swahili: Ardhi iko aje? Ina rutuba au la? Je, kuna miti ndani yake au la? Jitahidini kadiri mwezavyo kuleta baadhi ya matunda ya nchi.” (Ulikuwa msimu wa kuiva zabibu za kwanza.)

english: So they went up and spied out the land from the Wilderness of Zin as far as Rehob, toward Lebo-hamath.
ekegusii: Ase ayio bakageenda bakaroota ense eria, bagachaakera korwa ase erooro ya Sini bagaika Rehobu ase enchera ekogeenda Hamati.
swahili: Hivyo wakapanda na kuipeleleza nchi kutoka Jangwa la Sini hadi Rehobu, kuelekea Lebo-Hamathi.

english: They went up through the Negev and came to Hebron, where Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the descendants of Anak, dwelled. It had been built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.
ekegusii: Bagatiira, bakageenda ritang’ani ase ensemo ya Irianyi y’ense eria, na bagaika Heburoni, agwo ase Ahimani, na Sesai, na Talimai, abanto b’ororeria rw’Anaki, bamenyete. (Heburoni konya oagachirwe emiaka etan’ebere ritang’ani omochie o Soani o Misiri otaraagachwa.)
swahili: Wakapanda kupitia Negebu hadi wakafika Hebroni, mahali ambapo Ahimani, Sheshai na Talmai, wazao wa Anaki, waliishi. (Hebroni ulikuwa umejengwa miaka saba kabla ya mji wa Soani ulioko Misri.)

english: When they came to the Valley of Eshcol, they cut down a branch with a single cluster of grapes, which they carried on a pole between two men. They also took some pomegranates and figs.
ekegusii: Bagaika ase rikura ri’Esikoli, na aroro bakabutora orosagia rw’emesabibu rwabwate egesago ekenene mono, bagasomeka omwaro ase orosagia roria, na abanto babere bakarwambana. Naende bagatwa amakomomanga na amako.
swahili: Walipofika katika Bonde la Eshkoli, walivunja tawi lililokuwa na kishada kimoja cha zabibu. Wawili wao wakalichukua lile tawi kwenye mti, pamoja na komamanga na tini.

english: Because of the cluster of grapes the Israelites cut there, that place was called the Valley of Eshcol. The Reports of the Spies
ekegusii: Aase aria akarokwa Rikura ri’Esikoli ase engencho y’orosagia roria Abaisraeli babutorete korwa aroro.
swahili: Eneo lile likaitwa Bonde la Eshkoli kwa sababu ya kile kishada cha zabibu ambacho Waisraeli walikikata huko.

english: After forty days the men returned from spying out the land,
ekegusii: Ekero amatuko emerongo ene aerire, abanto baria chirooti bakairana korwa ase okoroota ense eria.
swahili: Mwishoni mwa siku arobaini wakarudi kutoka kuipeleleza nchi. Taarifa Juu Ya Upelelezi

english: and they went back to Moses, Aaron, and the whole congregation of Israel in the Wilderness of Paran at Kadesh. They brought back a report for the whole congregation and showed them the fruit of the land.
ekegusii: Bakairana gochia ase Musa na Aroni, na ase omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli agwo Kadeshi ase erooro ya Parani, bakabateebia amang’ana onsi, na bakaborokia okwama gw’ense eria.
swahili: Wakarudi kwa Mose, Aroni na jumuiya yote ya Waisraeli huko Kadeshi kwenye Jangwa la Parani. Hapo ndipo walipotoa habari kwao na kwa kusanyiko lote na kuwaonyesha matunda ya hiyo nchi.

english: And they gave this account to Moses: “We went into the land to which you sent us, and indeed, it is flowing with milk and honey. Here is some of its fruit!
ekegusii: Barabwo bagateebia Musa, “Ntwageenda ase ense eria gwatotomete, ’ntwayenyora ng’a nentenenku ere n’amabeere na amooke, rora okwama gw’ense eria.
swahili: Wakampa Mose taarifa hii: “Tuliingia katika nchi uliyotutuma, nayo inatiririka maziwa na asali! Hili hapa tunda lake.

english: Nevertheless, the people living in the land are strong, and the cities are large and fortified. We even saw the descendants of Anak there.
ekegusii: Korende nonya naboigo, abanto bamenyeteo nigo bare ne chinguru, na emechie yabo nemenene mono, naende egiteire bokong’u ne chindwaki. Tari ayio oka, korende boigo ’ntwarora abanto b’ororeria rw’Anaki bare aroro.
swahili: Lakini watu wanaoishi huko ni wenye nguvu, na miji yao ina ngome na ni mikubwa sana. Huko tuliona hata wazao wa Anaki.

english: The Amalekites live in the land of the Negev; the Hittites, Jebusites, and Amorites live in the hill country; and the Canaanites live by the sea and along the Jordan.”
ekegusii: Abaameleki nigo bamenyete ase ense ya Negebu, ensemo ya Irianyi y’ense eria; Abahiti, na Abayebusi, na Abaamori, nigo bamenyete ase ense y’ebitunwa. Abakaanani barabwo nigo bamenyete ase enyancha enene mbarabare, ang’e norooche rwa Yorodani.”
swahili: Waamaleki wanaishi Negebu; Wahiti, Wayebusi na Waamori wanaishi katika nchi ya vilima; nao Wakanaani wanaishi karibu na bahari na kando ya Yordani.”

english: So at the consent of the LORD, Moses sent them out from the Wilderness of Paran. All the men were leaders of the Israelites,
ekegusii: Musa agatoma abanto korwa ase erooro ya Parani, buna Omonene amochiigete. Abanto abwo bonsi nigo barenge abatang’ani ase Abaisraeli.
swahili: Hivyo kwa agizo la Bwana Mose akawatuma kutoka Jangwa la Parani. Wote walikuwa viongozi wa Waisraeli.

english: Then Caleb quieted the people before Moses and said, “We must go up and take possession of the land, for we can certainly conquer it!”
ekegusii: Korende Kalebu agakiria abanto tibaabaisa koamereria Musa, agateeba, “Tiga togende bwango, erinde toire ense eria, ekiagera intwe ’ntonyare kobua ense eria.”
swahili: Kisha Kalebu akawanyamazisha watu mbele ya Mose na kusema, “Imetupasa kupanda na kuimiliki nchi, kwa maana hakika tunaweza kufanya hivyo.”

english: But the men who had gone up with him replied, “We cannot go up against the people, for they are stronger than we are!”
ekegusii: Abanto baria bagendete amo nere bagateeba, “Intwe titokonyara korwania abanto baria tobabue; nigo bare ne chinguru gotobua.”
swahili: Lakini watu waliokuwa wamepanda pamoja naye wakasema, “Hatuwezi kuwashambulia wale watu; wana nguvu kutuliko sisi.”

english: So they gave the Israelites a bad report about the land that they had spied out: “The land we explored devours its inhabitants, and all the people we saw there are great in stature.
ekegusii: Ase ayio bakarentera Abaisraeli amang’ana amabe igoro y’ense eria bagendete koroota, bagateeba, “Ense eria twataara ime yaye koyeroota, nigo ere ense egoita abanto bamenyeteo. Abanto bonsi twarora nabatambe mono.
swahili: Wakaeneza taarifa mbaya miongoni mwa Waisraeli kuhusu nchi waliyoipeleleza. Wakasema, “Nchi tuliyoipeleleza hula watu waishio ndani yake. Watu wote tuliowaona huko ni majitu.

english: We even saw the Nephilim there—the descendants of Anak that come from the Nephilim! We seemed like grasshoppers in our own sight, and we must have seemed the same to them!”
ekegusii: Ee, ’ntwarora amamonto, abanto b’ororeria rw’Anaki. Intwe nigo twerora ng’a n’ebimonto ebisinini mono, tore omogwekano bw’ebisase. Naboigo twarorekana ase bare.”
swahili: Tuliwaona Wanefili huko (wazao wa Anaki wanatokana na Wanefili.) Tulijiona kama panzi machoni petu wenyewe, nao ndivyo walivyotuona.”

english: and these were their names: From the tribe of Reuben, Shammua son of Zaccur;
ekegusii: Aya naro amarieta abo: Korwa ase egesaku kia Rubeni, Samua, mosinto o Sakuri;
swahili: Haya ndiyo majina yao: kutoka kabila la Reubeni, Shamua mwana wa Zakuri;

english: from the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat son of Hori;
ekegusii: korwa ase egesaku gia Simioni, Safati, mosinto o Hora;
swahili: kutoka kabila la Simeoni, Shafati mwana wa Hori;

english: from the tribe of Judah, Caleb son of Jephunneh;
ekegusii: korwa ase egesaku kia Yuda, Kalebu, mosinto o Yefune;
swahili: kutoka kabila la Yuda, Kalebu mwana wa Yefune;

english: from the tribe of Issachar, Igal son of Joseph;
ekegusii: korwa ase egesaku gia Isakaru, Igali, mosinto o Yusufu;
swahili: kutoka kabila la Isakari, Igali mwana wa Yosefu;

english: from the tribe of Ephraim, Hoshea son of Nun;
ekegusii: korwa ase egesaku kia Efraimu, Hosea, mosinto o Nuni;
swahili: kutoka kabila la Efraimu, Hoshea mwana wa Nuni;

english: from the tribe of Benjamin, Palti son of Raphu;
ekegusii: korwa ase egesaku gia Benjamini, Paliti, mosinto o Rafu;
swahili: kutoka kabila la Benyamini, Palti mwana wa Rafu;

english: Then the whole congregation lifted up their voices and cried out, and that night the people wept.
ekegusii: Erio omoganda bwonsi bw’ abanto bagaaka eriogi rinene, bakaba bakorera ase obotuko boria.
swahili: Usiku ule watu wote wa jumuiya walipaza sauti zao na kulia kwa sauti kuu.

english: But the whole congregation threatened to stone Joshua and Caleb. Then the glory of the LORD appeared to all the Israelites at the Tent of Meeting.
ekegusii: Korende omoganda bwonsi ogaaka eriogi, ogateeba ng’a baitwe n’amagena. Erio obonene bw’Omonene bokaoroka mosiabanoagwo ase Eema y’Omosangererekano ase Abaisraeli bonsi. Musa ogosabera abanto
swahili: Lakini kusanyiko lote likazungumza juu ya kuwapiga kwa mawe. Ndipo utukufu wa Bwana ukaonekana katika Hema la Kukutania kwa Waisraeli wote.

english: And the LORD said to Moses, “How long will this people treat Me with contempt? How long will they refuse to believe in Me, despite all the signs I have performed among them?
ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa, “Ngoika ririri abanto aba barabe bagonchaaya? Na ngoika ririri barabe batari konyegena, nonya nakorire ebikone ebinge ase egati yabo?
swahili: Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Watu hawa watanidharau mpaka lini? Wataendelea kukataa kuniamini mimi mpaka lini, ingawa nimetenda ishara za miujiza miongoni mwao?

english: I will strike them with a plague and destroy them—and I will make you into a nation greater and mightier than they are.” Moses Intercedes for Israel
ekegusii: Nkobaaka inde noborwaire bogoita erinde imbasirie, na aye ’ngokore obe egesaku ekenene, naende kere nokobua goetania abanto aba.”
swahili: Nitawapiga kwa tauni na kuwaangamiza, lakini nitakufanya wewe kuwa taifa kubwa lenye nguvu kuliko wao.”

english: But Moses said to the LORD, “The Egyptians will hear of it, for by Your strength You brought this people from among them.
ekegusii: Korende Musa akamoiraneria, “Aye nigo kwarusetie abanto aba korwa ase ense ya Misiri ne chinguru chinene. Ekero Abamisiri bonsi baraigwe aya gwakorire ase abanto aba,
swahili: Mose akamwambia Bwana, “Ndipo Wamisri watasikia juu ya jambo hili! Kwa uweza wako uliwapandisha watu hawa kutoka miongoni mwao.

english: And they will tell it to the inhabitants of this land. They have already heard that You, O LORD, are in the midst of this people, that You, O LORD, have been seen face to face, that Your cloud stands over them, and that You go before them in a pillar of cloud by day and a pillar of fire by night.
ekegusii: barabwo ’mbatebie abanto b’ense eye amang’ana ayio. Barabwo konya baigure ng’a aye Omonene nigo ore ase egati y’Abaisraeli, kwarorekanire ase bare obosio ase obosio, ne riire riao nigo riteneine ase bare, naende naye okobatang’ana, omobaso ase riire rire buna esiiro, na obotuko ase omorero ore buna esiiro.
swahili: Nao watawaambia wenyeji wa nchi hii jambo hili. Wao tayari wameshasikia kwamba wewe, Ee Bwana, upo pamoja na watu hawa, na kuwa wewe, Ee Bwana, umeonekana uso kwa uso, nalo wingu lako hukaa juu yao. Tena wewe unawatangulia kwa nguzo ya wingu mchana na kwa nguzo ya moto usiku.

english: If You kill this people as one man, the nations who have heard of Your fame will say,
ekegusii: Bono onye aye kogoita abanto aba bonsi amo, erio abanto b’ebisaku abaraigwe chinkuma chiao ’mbateebe:
swahili: Ikiwa utawaua watu hawa wote mara moja, mataifa ambayo yamesikia taarifa hii kukuhusu wewe watasema,

english: ‘Because the LORD was unable to bring this people into the land He swore to give them, He has slaughtered them in the wilderness.’
ekegusii: Omonene nigo asinyetwe koira abanto aba ase ense eria konya arire eira akobaa; ase ayio obaiteire ase erooro.
swahili: ‘ Bwana alishindwa kuwaingiza watu hawa katika nchi aliyowaahidi kwa kiapo; hivyo akawaua jangwani.’

english: So now I pray, may the power of my Lord be magnified, just as You have declared:
ekegusii: Bono nagosabire, tiga okobua kwao, aye Omonene, kobe okonene buna aye kwarire eira, kogokwana:
swahili: “Basi sasa nguvu za Bwana na zionekane, sawasawa na vile ulivyosema:

english: ‘The LORD is slow to anger and abounding in loving devotion, forgiving iniquity and transgression. Yet He will by no means leave the guilty unpunished; He will visit the iniquity of the fathers upon their children to the third and fourth generation.’
ekegusii: Inche Omonene tindi omwango bw’okoba n’endamwamu, nigo inde omonyene amaabera, naende nigo inde n’obwanchani botari koera. Nigo ’nkwabera amamocho na ogosaria, korende tingotiga koa abana egesusuro goika ekiaare kia gatato, na egia kane, ase engencho y’amabe y’abaibori baabo.
swahili: ‘ Bwana si mwepesi wa hasira, ni mwingi wa upendo na mwenye kusamehe dhambi na uasi. Lakini haachi kumwadhibu mwenye hatia, huadhibu watoto kwa ajili ya dhambi ya baba zao hata kizazi cha tatu na cha nne.’

english: Pardon, I pray, the iniquity of this people, in keeping with the greatness of Your loving devotion, just as You have forgiven them ever since they left Egypt.” God’s Forgiveness and Judgment (Deuteronomy 1:34–40)
ekegusii: Ase igo nagosabire, bwabere ebibe bi’abaanto aba koreng’ana nobonene bw’obwanchani bwao botari koera, koreng’ana buna aye kwabaaberete korwa ekero barenge Misiri goika reero iga.”
swahili: Kwa kadiri ya upendo wako mkuu, usamehe dhambi ya watu hawa, kama vile ulivyowasamehe tangu wakati walitoka Misri mpaka sasa.”

english: All the Israelites grumbled against Moses and Aaron, and the whole congregation said to them, “If only we had died in the land of Egypt, or if only we had died in this wilderness!
ekegusii: Abaisraeli bonsi bakaba bakwomania Musa na Aroni; bonsi bagakwana “Nigo anga yaba buya onye ’ntwakwerete Misiri, gose ase erooro eye.
swahili: Waisraeli wote wakanungʼunika dhidi ya Mose na Aroni, nalo kusanyiko lote wakawaambia, “Laiti tungekuwa tumefia humo nchi ya Misri! Au humu kwenye hili jangwa!

english: “I have pardoned them as you requested,” the LORD replied.
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene agateeba, “Nabaabeire koreng’ana buna gwansabire.
swahili: Bwana akajibu, “Nimewasamehe kama ulivyoomba.

english: “Yet as surely as I live and as surely as the whole earth is filled with the glory of the LORD,
ekegusii: Korende ekeene, buna inche inde moyo, naende buna ense yonsi eraichorwe nobonene bwane,
swahili: Hata hivyo, kwa hakika kama niishivyo, na kwa hakika kama utukufu wa Bwana uijazavyo dunia yote,

english: not one of the men who have seen My glory and the signs I performed in Egypt and in the wilderness—yet have tested Me and disobeyed Me these ten times—
ekegusii: onde tari ase abanto aba orasoe ense eria. Aba barorire obonene bwane na ebikone biria nakorete aaria Misiri, na ase erooro eye, korende nonya naboigo babeire bagonteema ase chingaki echi chionsi, nonya ng’ara ikomi, bangire konyigwera.
swahili: hakuna hata mmoja wa watu hawa ambao waliuona utukufu wangu na ishara za miujiza niliyotenda huko Misri na huko jangwani, lakini ambaye hakunitii na akanijaribu mara hizi kumi,

english: not one will ever see the land that I swore to give their fathers. None of those who have treated Me with contempt will see it.
ekegusii: Ase barabwo onde tari nonya noyomo, oranyare korora ense eria narierete chisokoro chiabo eira ng’a nimbayee. Onde tari ase abwo banchaayete oranyare koyerora.
swahili: hakuna hata mmoja wao atakayeona nchi niliyowaahidi baba zao kwa kiapo. Hakuna hata mmoja ambaye amenidharau atakayeiona.

english: But because My servant Caleb has a different spirit and has followed Me wholeheartedly, I will bring him into the land he has entered, and his descendants will inherit it.
ekegusii: Korende Kalebu, omosomba one, ekiagera abwate omoika ore nogwatananekana korwa ase oyo bwa baria bande, naende obeire okonyigwera buya ase amang’ana onsi, nimoire ase ense eria agendete koroota naende ning’ee abanto b’ororeria rw’aye ense eria ebe eyabo.
swahili: Lakini kwa sababu mtumishi wangu Kalebu ana roho ya tofauti na ananifuata kwa moyo wote, nitamwingiza katika nchi aliyoiendea, nao wazao wake watairithi.

english: Now since the Amalekites and Canaanites are living in the valleys, turn back tomorrow and head for the wilderness along the route to the Red Sea. ”
ekegusii: Na bono ekiagera Abaameleki na Abakaanani bamenyete ime ase amakura, inwe ankio moonchoke, mochake koirana gochia ase enchera ekogeenda ase omosomo bw’Enyancha Embariri.” Omonene akaa abanto abwo bamwemurunganeretie egesusuro
swahili: Kwa kuwa Waamaleki na Wakanaani wanaishi katika mabonde, kesho geukeni mwelekee jangwani kwa kufuata njia iendayo Bahari ya Shamu.”

english: Then the LORD said to Moses and Aaron,
ekegusii: Omonene agakwana na Musa na Aroni, akabateebia,
swahili: Bwana akamwambia Mose na Aroni:

english: “How long will this wicked congregation grumble against Me? I have heard the complaints that the Israelites are making against Me.
ekegusii: “Inee! Ngoika ririri omoganda oyo omobe oremurunganie ase ’nde? Naigure Abaisraeli banyemurunganeirie.
swahili: “Jumuiya hii ovu itanungʼunika dhidi yangu hadi lini? Nimesikia malalamiko ya hawa Waisraeli wanaonungʼunika.

english: So tell them: As surely as I live, declares the LORD, I will do to you exactly as I heard you say.
ekegusii: Obateebie ng’a inche Omonene nigo ngoteeba iga: Buna inche inde moyo, naigure amang’ana ayio mwakwanire, ayio naro ndabakorere.
swahili: Hivyo waambie, ‘Hakika kama niishivyo, asema Bwana, nitawafanyia vitu vilevile nilivyosikia mkisema:

english: Your bodies will fall in this wilderness—all who were numbered in the census, everyone twenty years of age or older—because you have grumbled against Me.
ekegusii: Ekiagera mwemurunganirie ase ’nde, inwe mwensi abamwabarirwe na korikwa, abamwakoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, nigo morakwe, na emebere yaino ekwete ebeere aiga ase erooro.
swahili: Kila mmoja wenu mwenye umri wa miaka ishirini au zaidi ambaye alihesabiwa na amenungʼunika dhidi yangu, miili yenu itaanguka katika jangwa hili.

english: Why is the LORD bringing us into this land to fall by the sword? Our wives and children will become plunder. Would it not be better for us to go back to Egypt?”
ekegusii: Ninki gekogera Omonene agotoira ase ense eria tochie goitwa ase esegi? Abakungu baito, na abana baito, nigo bagochia gwoswa n’ababisa baito. Naki yare koba buya onye ’ntwairana gochia Misiri.”
swahili: Kwa nini Bwana anatuleta katika nchi hii ili tufe kwa upanga? Wake zetu na watoto wetu watachukuliwa kama nyara. Je, isingekuwa bora kwetu kurudi Misri?”

english: Surely none of you will enter the land in which I swore to settle you, except Caleb son of Jephunneh and Joshua son of Nun.
ekegusii: Ase ense eria nabarierete eira na gotiana ng’a nimbayee, onde tari ase more orachie komenyao, otatiga Kalebu, mosinto o Yefune, na Yoshua, mosinto o Nuni.
swahili: Hakuna hata mmoja wenu atakayeingia katika nchi niliyoapa kwa mkono ulioinuliwa kuwa makao yenu, isipokuwa Kalebu mwana wa Yefune, na Yoshua mwana wa Nuni.

english: But I will bring your children, whom you said would become plunder, into the land you have rejected—and they will enjoy it.
ekegusii: Korende abana baino, abwo mwateebete ng’a nabooswe, aba nabwo ndaire aroro, na barabwo mbamenye ase ense eria inwe mwangire.
swahili: Lakini watoto wenu ambao mlisema watachukuliwa kama mateka, nitawaingiza humo ili waifurahie nchi ambayo ninyi mmeikataa.

english: As for you, however, your bodies will fall in this wilderness.
ekegusii: Korende inwe nigo morakwere aiga ase erooro, na emebere yaino esirere aiga.
swahili: Lakini ninyi, miili yenu itaanguka katika jangwa hili.

english: Your children will be shepherds in the wilderness for forty years, and they will suffer for your unfaithfulness until the last of your bodies lies in the wilderness.
ekegusii: Abana baino nababe abarisia ase erooro eye ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ene, nabarabwo nabachandeke, ekiagera inwe motabeete abegenwa ase ’nde, mbabe bagochandeka goika omonto bw’omoerio bw’ekegori kiaino akwe, na omobere oye osirere ase erooro eye.
swahili: Watoto wenu watakuwa wachungaji wa mifugo hapa kwa miaka arobaini, wakiteseka kwa ajili ya kukosa uaminifu kwenu, hadi mwili wa mtu wenu wa mwisho ulale katika jangwa hili.

english: In keeping with the forty days you spied out the land, you shall bear your guilt forty years—a year for each day—and you will experience My alienation.
ekegusii: Inwe nigo morachandeke ase emiaka emerongo ene, omwaka oyomo ase kera rituko mwarenge koroota ense eria, nainwe namonyare komanya ng’a inki gekoba ekero nkoba mamincha yaino.
swahili: Kwa miaka arobaini, mwaka mmoja kwa kila siku katika zile siku arobaini mlizoipeleleza nchi, mtateseka kwa ajili ya dhambi zenu, na kujua jinsi ilivyo vibaya kunifanya mimi kuwa adui yenu.’

english: I, the LORD, have spoken, and I will surely do these things to this entire wicked congregation, which has conspired against Me. They will meet their end in the wilderness, and there they will die.” The Plague on the Ten Spies
ekegusii: Ninche Omonene nakwanire. Ekeene ninkore egento eke ase omoganda oyo omobe osangererekanire amo, na obeire mamincha y’ane. Aiga ase erooro ninsirie abanto aba, aa ase erooro nao barakwere.”
swahili: Mimi Bwana nimesema, na hakika nitafanya mambo haya kwa jumuiya hii yote ovu, ambayo imefungamana pamoja dhidi yangu. Watakutana na mwisho wao katika jangwa hili; hapa ndipo watafia.”

english: So the men Moses had sent to spy out the land, who had returned and made the whole congregation grumble against him by bringing out a bad report about the land—
ekegusii: Abanto baria Musa atomete gochia koroota ense eria barentete amang’ana amabe igoro y’ense eria, bakagera omoganda bwonsi okemurungania ase Omonene.
swahili: Hivyo watu wale ambao Mose alikuwa amewatuma kuipeleleza nchi, waliorudi na kuifanya jumuiya nzima kunungʼunika dhidi ya Mose kwa kueneza taarifa mbaya kuhusu hiyo nchi:

english: those men who had brought out the bad report about the land—were struck down by a plague before the LORD.
ekegusii: Ase ayio Omonene akabaaka noborwaire bogoita, na barabwo bagakwera agwo ase obosio bwaye.
swahili: watu hawa waliohusika kueneza taarifa mbaya kuhusu hiyo nchi walipigwa na kuanguka kwa tauni mbele za Bwana.

english: Of those men who had gone to spy out the land, only Joshua son of Nun and Caleb son of Jephunneh remained alive.
ekegusii: Korende Yoshua, mosinto o Nuni, na Kalebu, mosinto o Yefune, barabwo boka bagatigwa bare moyo korwa ase abanto baria bagendete koroota ense eria. Abaisraeli bagoteema gosoa Kaanani engaki entang’ani (Okoir 1:41-46)
swahili: Miongoni mwa watu waliokwenda kuipeleleza hiyo nchi, ni Yoshua mwana wa Nuni, na Kalebu mwana wa Yefune peke yao waliosalia.

english: And when Moses relayed these words to all the Israelites, the people mourned bitterly. The Defeat at Hormah (Deuteronomy 1:41–46)
ekegusii: Musa agateebia Abaisraeli amang’ana onsi Omonene akwanete, na abanto bakarera mono nobororo.
swahili: Mose alipotoa taarifa hii kwa Waisraeli wote, waliomboleza kwa uchungu.

english: So they said to one another, “Let us appoint a leader and return to Egypt.”
ekegusii: Barabwo bagateebania, “Tochore omonto oyomo abe omoraai oito, toirane Misiri.”
swahili: Wakasemezana wao kwa wao, “Inatupasa kumchagua kiongozi na kurudi Misri.”

english: Early the next morning they got up and went up toward the ridge of the hill country. “We have indeed sinned,” they said, “but we will go to the place the LORD has promised.”
ekegusii: Ase emambia ye rituko ria kabere bakaimoka, bagatiira gochia ase ense y’ebitunwa, bagakwana, “Rora twachire, nao tore aa, bono twanchire kogeenda ase ense eri’Omonene atoteebetie. Intwe twakorire ebibe.”
swahili: Mapema asubuhi siku iliyofuata walipanda juu kuelekea kwenye nchi ya vilima virefu, wakasema, “Tumetenda dhambi. Tutakwea mpaka mahali Bwana alipotuahidi.”

english: But Moses said, “Why are you transgressing the commandment of the LORD? This will not succeed!
ekegusii: Korende Musa akabateebia, “Nase ki bono mogosaria ogochika kw’Omonene. Timokonyara konyora ogosesenigwa ase okogeendao.
swahili: Lakini Mose akasema, “Kwa nini hamtii amri ya Bwana? Jambo hili halitafanikiwa!

english: Do not go up, lest you be struck down by your enemies, because the LORD is not among you.
ekegusii: Timobaisa kogeenda; moise gokora igo, rirorio nigo mogochia goitwa n’ababisa baino, ekiagera Omonene tari amo nainwe.
swahili: Msipande juu, kwa kuwa Bwana hayupo pamoja nanyi. Mtashindwa na adui zenu,

english: For there the Amalekites and Canaanites will face you, and you will fall by the sword. Because you have turned away from the LORD, He will not be with you.”
ekegusii: Aroro agwo bosio bwaino Abaameleki na Abakaanani mbareo. Nigo bagochia kobarwania baababue na kobakenya, ekiagera inwe mwaonchokire, mwangire komoigwera Omonene; nere takonyara koba amo nainwe.”
swahili: kwa kuwa Waamaleki na Wakanaani watapambana nanyi huko. Kwa sababu mmemwacha Bwana, hatakuwa pamoja nanyi, ninyi mtaanguka kwa upanga.”

english: But they dared to go up to the ridge of the hill country, though neither Moses nor the ark of the covenant of the LORD moved from the camp.
ekegusii: Korende bagekora abaremu, bagatiira gochia ase ense y’ebitunwa, nonya Esanduki eria yare ne chibao chiriikire okobwatana kw’Omonene yatigarete ase egetwori, na Musa nao atigarete.
swahili: Hata hivyo, kwa kiburi chao walipanda juu kuelekea nchi ya vilima virefu, ijapokuwa Mose hakutoka kambini wala Sanduku la Agano la Bwana.

english: Then the Amalekites and Canaanites who lived in that part of the hill country came down, attacked them, and routed them all the way to Hormah.
ekegusii: Erio Abaameleki na Abakaanani abamenyete ase ense y’ebitunwa, bagatirimboka bakarwania Abaisraeli abwo, bakababua na kobaseria, bakababwatia goika Horima.
swahili: Ndipo Waamaleki na Wakanaani walioishi katika hiyo nchi ya vilima wakateremka na kuwashambulia, wakawapiga njia yote hadi Horma.

english: Then Moses and Aaron fell facedown before the whole assembly of the congregation of Israel.
ekegusii: Musa na Aroni bagatung’ama inse bakaumama ase obosio bw’omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli osangererekanete.
swahili: Ndipo Mose na Aroni wakaanguka kifudifudi mbele ya kusanyiko lote la Kiisraeli lililokusanyika hapo.

english: Joshua son of Nun and Caleb son of Jephunneh, who were among those who had spied out the land, tore their clothes
ekegusii: Erio Yoshua, mosinto o Nuni, na Kalebu, mosinto o Yefune, abwo barenge amo ne chirooti chiria chiarootete ense eria, bagatandora chianga chiabo,
swahili: Yoshua mwana wa Nuni na Kalebu mwana wa Yefune, waliokuwa miongoni mwa watu wale waliokwenda kuipeleleza nchi, wakararua nguo zao,

english: and said to the whole congregation of Israel, “The land we passed through and explored is an exceedingly good land.
ekegusii: bagateebia omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli, “Ense eria twataarete ase okoyeroota nigo ere ense engiya mono.
swahili: wakasema na kusanyiko lote la Kiisraeli, wakawaambia, “Nchi tuliyopita katikati yake na kuipeleleza ni nzuri sana sana.

english: If the LORD delights in us, He will bring us into this land, a land flowing with milk and honey, and He will give it to us.
ekegusii: Onye Omonene okogokigwa naintwe, na gotoyea toyeire, ense eria n’entenenku ere namabeere naamooke.
swahili: Ikiwa Bwana anapendezwa nasi, atatuongoza kuingia katika nchi ile, nchi itiririkayo maziwa na asali, naye atatupa nchi hiyo.

english: Only do not rebel against the LORD, and do not be afraid of the people of the land, for they will be like bread for us. Their protection has been removed, and the LORD is with us. Do not be afraid of them!”
ekegusii: Timobaisa kwanga komoigwera Omonene, na timobaisa koboboa ababiare b’ense eria; abwo nigo barabe buna endagera enyororo ase tore. Baurirwe okorendwa kwabo; Omonene nigo are amo naintwe; timobairoka.”
swahili: Ila tu msimwasi Bwana. Wala msiwaogope watu wa nchi hiyo, kwa sababu tutawameza. Ulinzi wao umeondoka, lakini Bwana yupo pamoja nasi. Msiwaogope.”

english: Also present half a hin of wine as a drink offering. It is an offering made by fire, a pleasing aroma to the LORD.
ekegusii: na orue edivai ebituba bibere ebe okoruegwa gw’ekenyugwa. Okwo n’okoruegwa kogosambwa n’omorero kore ne rimisu rigiya rikomogwenera Omonene.
swahili: Pia utaleta nusu ya hini ya divai kama sadaka ya kinywaji. Itakuwa sadaka iliyoteketezwa kwa moto, harufu nzuri inayompendeza Bwana.

english: This is to be done for each bull, ram, lamb, or goat.
ekegusii: “Ebinto ebi nabio biraruegwe amo na kera eeri, gose emingichi, gose kera emanwa y’eng’ondi gose ey’embori.
swahili: Kila fahali au kondoo dume, kila mwana-kondoo au mbuzi mchanga, atatayarishwa kwa njia hii.

english: This is how you must prepare each one, no matter how many.
ekegusii: Buna koreng’ana omobaro bwe ching’iti echio chiraruegwe chibe ebing’wanso oraabe, n’okoruegwa kw’endagera naboigo koraabe.
swahili: Fanyeni hivi kwa ajili ya kila mmoja, kwa kadiri ya wingi wa mtakavyoandaa.

english: Everyone who is native-born shall prepare these things in this way when he presents an offering made by fire as a pleasing aroma to the LORD.
ekegusii: Abaisraeli bonsi ababiare nabwo barabwatie omooroberio oyio, ekero bakorua okoruegwa kw’endagera kogosambwa nomorero, kobe risimu rigiya rikomogwenera Omonene.
swahili: “ ‘Kila mmoja ambaye ni mzawa ni lazima afanye vitu hivi kwa njia hii hapo aletapo sadaka ya kuteketezwa kwa moto kama harufu nzuri inayompendeza Bwana.

english: And for the generations to come, if a foreigner residing with you or someone else among you wants to prepare an offering made by fire as a pleasing aroma to the LORD, he is to do exactly as you do.
ekegusii: Onye omogeni ore amo nainwe, gose omomenyi omenyete ase egati yaino, nere oganetie korenta okoruegwa kwaye kogosambwa n’omorero, kobe rimisu rigiya rikomogwenera Omonene, nigo arabwatie omooroberio oria oria obekirwe ase more.
swahili: Kwa vizazi vijavyo, wakati wowote mgeni au mtu mwingine yeyote anayeishi miongoni mwenu aletapo sadaka ya kuteketezwa kuwa harufu nzuri ya kumpendeza Bwana, ni lazima afanye sawasawa kabisa na jinsi mnavyofanya ninyi.

english: The assembly is to have the same statute both for you and for the foreign resident; it is a permanent statute for the generations to come. You and the foreigner shall be the same before the LORD.
ekegusii: Ase omosangererekano oyio ogochika nokomo koraabe ase more na ase omomenyi omenyete ase egati yaino. Okwo nakobe ogochika koragenderere botambe, ebiaare ase ebiaare. Buna inwe more, naboigo nomomenyi omenyete ase egati yaino arabe ase obosio bw’Omonene.
swahili: Jumuiya itakuwa na sheria hizo hizo kwenu na kwa mgeni aishiye miongoni mwenu; hii ni amri ya kudumu kwa vizazi vijavyo. Ninyi na mgeni mtakuwa sawa mbele za Bwana:

english: The same law and the same ordinance will apply both to you and to the foreigner residing with you.”
ekegusii: Ogochika nokomo, na omooroberio noyomo, ase more na ase omomenyi omenyete amo nainwe.”
swahili: Sheria hizo hizo na masharti hayo hayo hayo, yatawahusu ninyi na mgeni aishiye miongoni mwenu.’ ”

english: “Speak to the Israelites and tell them: When you enter the land to which I am bringing you
ekegusii: “Kwana n’Abaisraeli, obateebie: Ekero moraike ase ense eria ase ’ngochia kobaira,
swahili: “Sema na Waisraeli na uwaambie: ‘Mtakapoingia katika nchi ninayowapeleka

english: and you eat the food of the land, you shall lift up an offering to the LORD.
ekegusii: na mokoria endagera y’ense eria, morente okoruegwa kogosungusigwa ase Omonene.
swahili: nanyi mkala chakula cha nchi hiyo, toeni sehemu ya chakula hicho kama sadaka kwa Bwana.

english: “Speak to the Israelites and tell them: After you enter the land that I am giving you as a home
ekegusii: “Kwana n’Abaisraeli, obateebie buna barachie gokora ekero baraike ase ense eria ’ngochia kobaa.
swahili: “Sema na Waisraeli uwaambie: ‘Baada ya ninyi kuingia katika nchi ninayowapa kama nyumbani,

english: From the first of your dough, you are to lift up a cake as a contribution; offer it just like an offering from the threshing floor.
ekegusii: Ekero moraroisie omogati korwa ase obosie bw’ogotongora kw’endagera, namoyorente ase Omonene obe okoruegwa kw’ogotongora buna mokomoruera endagera korwa ase ekeooreri kiaino.
swahili: Toeni andazi kutoka kwa malimbuko ya chakula chenu kitokacho katika ardhi, na mkitoe kama sadaka kutoka sakafu ya kupuria nafaka.

english: Throughout your generations, you are to give the LORD an offering from the first of your dough. Offerings for Unintentional Sins
ekegusii: Ase ebiaare biaino bionsi morentere Omonene okoruegwa korwa ase obosie bw’ogotongora kwaino.
swahili: Kwa vizazi vyote vijavyo hamna budi kutoa sadaka hii kwa Bwana kutoka kwa malimbuko ya unga wenu. Sadaka Kwa Ajili Ya Dhambi Isiyo Ya Makusudi

english: Now if you stray unintentionally and do not obey all these commandments that the LORD has spoken to Moses—
ekegusii: “Korende nenyare koba ng’a mwamochire kobwatia amachiiko ande onsi Omonene achiikire Musa,
swahili: “ ‘Basi kama pasipo kukusudia umeshindwa kushika mojawapo katika amri hizi ambazo Bwana alimpa Mose,

english: all that the LORD has commanded you through Moses from the day the LORD gave them and continuing through the generations to come—
ekegusii: gose abanto baino tibarakora onsi ay’Omonene achiikire goetera ase Musa, gochaakera rituko riri’Omonene aruete amachiiko, na kogenderera ebiaare ase ebiaare.
swahili: amri yoyote ya Bwana kwenu kupitia Mose, tangu siku ile Bwana alipowapa na inaendelea hadi vizazi vyote vijavyo;

english: and if it was done unintentionally without the knowledge of the congregation, then the whole congregation is to prepare one young bull as a burnt offering, a pleasing aroma to the LORD, with its grain offering and drink offering according to the regulation, and one male goat as a sin offering.
ekegusii: Onye okomocha okwo gwakorirwe ase ogotancha, na ase ogotamanya kw’omoganda bwonsi bw’ abanto, rirorio barue eeri ensae ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa kere ne rimisu rigiya rikomogwenera Omonene. Amo nekio barente okoruegwa kw’endagera, na ogw’ekenyugwa, koreng’ana nomoroberio ochiikire, amo negoree eyemo ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe.
swahili: ikiwa hili limefanyika pasipo kukusudia bila jumuiya kuwa na habari nalo, basi jumuiya yote itatoa fahali mchanga kuwa sadaka ya kuteketezwa ikiwa harufu nzuri inayompendeza Bwana, pamoja na sadaka ya nafaka na ya kinywaji zilizoamriwa kwayo, na mbuzi dume kwa ajili ya sadaka ya dhambi.

english: The priest is to make atonement for the whole congregation of Israel, so that they may be forgiven; for the sin was unintentional and they have brought to the LORD an offering made by fire and a sin offering, presented before the LORD for their unintentional sin.
ekegusii: Omokuani akore okobwatanigwa ase omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli, na barabwo ’mbaaberwe, ekiagera okomocha okwo nigo gwakoretwe mosiabano ase ogotancha. Barabwo barentire okoruegwa kwabo, ekeng’wanso kegosambwa nomorero ase Omonene, naboigo barentire ekeng’wanso kiabo ki’ebibe ase Omonene ase engencho y’okomocha kwabo gwakoretwe mosiabano ase ogotancha.
swahili: Kuhani atafanya upatanisho kwa ajili ya jumuiya yote ya Kiisraeli, nao watasamehewa, kwa kuwa haikuwa makusudi nao wamemletea Bwana sadaka iliyoteketezwa kwa moto na sadaka ya dhambi kwa ajili ya kosa lao.

english: Then the whole congregation of Israel and the foreigners residing among them will be forgiven, since it happened to all the people unintentionally.
ekegusii: Naboigo omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli amo nomomenyi omenyete ase egati yabo, bonsi ’nabaaberwe, ekiagera abwo bonsi nigo baabareretwe okomocha koria gwakoretwe mosiabano ase ogotancha.
swahili: Jumuiya yote ya Kiisraeli pamoja na wageni waishio miongoni mwao watasamehewa, kwa sababu watu wote walihusika katika kosa lile lisilokusudiwa.

english: Also, if one person sins unintentionally, he is to present a year-old female goat as a sin offering.
ekegusii: “Onye omonto oyomo ogokora ebibe mosiabano atancheti, arue emanwa esubeni yakoorire omwaka oyomo, ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe.
swahili: “ ‘Lakini kama mtu mmoja peke yake akitenda dhambi pasipo kukusudia, ni lazima alete mbuzi mke wa mwaka mmoja kwa ajili ya sadaka ya dhambi.

english: And the priest shall make atonement before the LORD on behalf of the person who erred by sinning unintentionally; and when atonement has been made for him, he will be forgiven.
ekegusii: Omokuani akore okobwatanigwa ase obosio bw’Omonene ase omonto oria okorire ebibe atancheti, na omonto oria naaberwe.
swahili: Kuhani atafanya upatanisho mbele za Bwana kwa ajili ya yule aliyekosa kwa kufanya dhambi pasipo kukusudia, upatanisho utakapofanywa kwa ajili yake, atasamehewa.

english: You shall have the same law for the one who acts in error, whether he is a native-born Israelite or a foreigner residing among you.
ekegusii: Nigo moraabe n’ogochika okomo ase oyio okorire ebibe mosiabano, atancheti, karabe omobiare bw’Abaisraeli, gose omomenyi omenyete ase egati yaino.
swahili: Sheria hiyo moja itamhusu kila mmoja ambaye ametenda dhambi pasipo kukusudia, awe Mwisraeli mzawa ama mgeni.

english: and you present an offering made by fire to the LORD from the herd or flock to produce a pleasing aroma to the LORD—either a burnt offering or a sacrifice, for a special vow or freewill offering or appointed feast—
ekegusii: Bateebie: ’Monyare komoruera Omonene eng’iti korwa ase chiombe, gose korwa ase riicho rie ching’ondi, gose chimbori, chibe ekeng’wanso kegosambwa nomorero, gose ekeng’wanso kende gionsi ase ogoikerania eira mwariete, gose eki’ogwancha kwaino, gose ase chingaki chichiikire ase Amatuko aino Amanene, kebe ne rimisu rigiya rikomogwenera Omonene.
swahili: nanyi mkitoa sadaka za kuteketezwa kwa moto, kutoka makundi ya ngʼombe au kondoo, kama harufu nzuri inayompendeza Bwana, ikiwa ni sadaka za kuteketezwa au dhabihu, kwa ajili ya nadhiri maalum ama sadaka ya hiari au sadaka ya sikukuu zenu,

english: But the person who sins defiantly, whether a native or foreigner, blasphemes the LORD. That person shall be cut off from among his people.
ekegusii: “Korende omonto orakore gento kende gionsi moeneno, karabe omobiare bw’Abaisraeli, gose omomenyi omenyete ase egati yaino, oyio igo oramire Omonene, ere oyio naatananwe korwa ase abanto baye.
swahili: “ ‘Lakini yeyote ambaye amefanya dhambi kwa dharau awe mzawa au mgeni, anamkufuru Bwana, naye mtu huyo ni lazima akatiliwe mbali na watu wake.

english: He shall certainly be cut off, because he has despised the word of the LORD and broken His commandment; his guilt remains on him.” A Sabbath-Breaker Stoned (Exodus 31:12–17)
ekegusii: Oyio ochaayire ring’ana ri’Omonene, naende osaririe ogochika kwaye, takororerwa amaabera. Goika aatananwe kegima, nere abarerwe ebibe biaye.” Omonto Okobwatwa Ase Ogosaria Esabato
swahili: Kwa sababu amelidharau neno la Bwana na kuvunja amri zake, mtu huyo ni lazima akatiliwe mbali; hatia yake inabaki juu yake.’ ” Mvunja Sabato Auawe

english: While the Israelites were in the wilderness, a man was found gathering wood on the Sabbath day.
ekegusii: Ekero Abaisraeli bagendererete koba ase erooro, omonto oyomo akanyorwa ogotenya chinko ase rituko ri’Esabato.
swahili: Waisraeli walipokuwa jangwani, mtu mmoja alikutwa akikusanya kuni siku ya Sabato.

english: Those who found the man gathering wood brought him to Moses, Aaron, and the whole congregation,
ekegusii: Abanto baria bamonyorete bakamoira ase Musa na Aroni, na ase omoganda bwonsi.
swahili: Wale waliomkuta akikusanya kuni wakamleta kwa Mose, Aroni na kusanyiko lote,

english: and because it had not been declared what should be done to him, they placed him in custody.
ekegusii: Omonto oria agasiekerwa aase gete akarendwa, ekiagera konya teramanyekana boronge egento agwenerete akorerwe.
swahili: nao wakamweka kifungoni, kwa sababu haikufahamika kwa wazi kwamba afanyiwe nini.

english: And the LORD said to Moses, “The man must surely be put to death. The whole congregation is to stone him outside the camp.”
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene agateebia Musa, “Omonto oyio goika aitwe akwe: asokigwe isiko y’egetwori, erio omoganda bwonsi omoake amagena.”
swahili: Ndipo Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Huyo mtu ni lazima afe. Kusanyiko lote lazima limpige mawe nje ya kambi.”

english: So the whole congregation took the man outside the camp and stoned him to death, as the LORD had commanded Moses. The Law of Tassels
ekegusii: Abanto bonsi b’omoganda bakamosokia isiko y’egetwori, bakamoaka amagena goika agakwa, buna Omonene achiigete Musa. Amachiiko Igoro Y’amasugunia
swahili: Hivyo kusanyiko likamtoa nje ya kambi na kumpiga mawe hadi akafa, kama Bwana alivyomwamuru Mose. Vifundo Kwenye Mavazi

english: Later, the LORD said to Moses,
ekegusii: Omonene agakwana na Musa, akamoteebia,
swahili: Bwana akamwambia Mose,

english: “Speak to the Israelites and tell them that throughout the generations to come they are to make for themselves tassels for the corners of their garments, with a blue cord on each tassel.
ekegusii: “Kwana n’Abaisraeli, obachiike ng’a bakore amasugunia ase emego ye chianga chiabo, babeeke ase kera obosugunia eusi ere buru. Naboigo barakore ebiaare ase ebiaare.
swahili: “Sema na Waisraeli uwaambie: ‘Kwa vizazi vyote vijavyo jifanyieni vifundo katika pindo za mavazi yenu vikiwa na uzi wa buluu kwenye kila kifundo.

english: These will serve as tassels for you to look at, so that you may remember all the commandments of the LORD, that you may obey them and not prostitute yourselves by following your own heart and your own eyes.
ekegusii: Ekiagera amasugunia ayio nabe ekeinyorio ase more. Ekero mokoyarigereria monyare koinyora amachiiko ane onsi na koyabwata. Naboigo moranyare gokonywa, erinde mobe abegenwa ase ’nde na gwetanga korwa ase okogania okobe gwe chinkoro chiaino na amaiso aino.
swahili: Mtakuwa mkivitazama vifundo hivyo ili mpate kukumbuka amri zote za Bwana, ili mpate kuzitii msije mkajitia uzinzi wenyewe kwa kuzifuata tamaa za mioyo yenu na za macho yenu.

english: then the one presenting his offering to the LORD shall also present a grain offering of a tenth of an ephah of fine flour mixed with a quarter hin of olive oil.
ekegusii: Oyokorua ebing’wanso buna ebio ase Omonene, goika arue okoruegwa kw’endagera, obosie obonuke ebimunu bibere bwochoganirie n’amaguta egetuba ekemo,
swahili: ndipo yeye aletaye sadaka yake ataiweka mbele za Bwana sadaka ya nafaka, sehemu ya kumi ya efa ya unga laini uliochanganywa na robo ya hini ya mafuta.

english: Then you will remember and obey all My commandments, and you will be holy to your God.
ekegusii: Ase igo moinyore na kobwata amachiiko ane onsi, nainwe ’namobe abachenu ase ’nde inche Nyasae oino.
swahili: Ndipo mtakumbuka kuzitii amri zangu zote nanyi mtawekwa wakfu kwa Mungu wenu.

english: I am the LORD your God who brought you out of the land of Egypt to be your God. I am the LORD your God.”
ekegusii: Ninche Omonene Nyasae oino, nabarusetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri, erinde imbe Nyasae oino. Inche ninche Omonene Nyasae oino.”
swahili: Mimi Ndimi Bwana Mungu wenu, niliyewatoa Misri niwe Mungu wenu. Mimi Ndimi Bwana Mungu wenu.’ ”

english: With the burnt offering or sacrifice of each lamb, you are to prepare a quarter hin of wine as a drink offering.
ekegusii: n’edivai egetuba ekemo kebe okoruegwa gw’ekenyugwa, amo na kera emanwa y’eng’ondi; onye nekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa gose ekeng’wanso kende gionsi.
swahili: Pamoja na kila mwana-kondoo kwa ajili ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa au dhabihu, andaa robo ya hini ya divai kwa sadaka ya kinywaji.

english: With a ram you are to prepare a grain offering of two-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with a third of a hin of olive oil,
ekegusii: Ekero okorua emingichi ebe ekeng’wanso, orente amo nero obosie obonuke ebimunu bine, bwochoganirie n’amaguta egetuba ekemo na ekeng’ese, bibe okoruegwa kw’endagera.
swahili: “ ‘Pamoja na kondoo dume andaa sadaka ya nafaka ya sehemu mbili za kumi za efa za unga laini uliochanganywa na theluthi moja ya hini ya mafuta,

english: and a third of a hin of wine as a drink offering, a pleasing aroma to the LORD.
ekegusii: Ase okoruegwa gw’ekenyugwa morue edivai egetuba ekemo na ekeng’ese ebe rimisu rigiya rikomogwenera Omonene.
swahili: na theluthi moja ya hini ya divai kama sadaka ya kinywaji. Vitoe kama harufu nzuri inayompendeza Bwana.

english: When you prepare a young bull as a burnt offering or sacrifice to fulfill a vow or as a peace offering to the LORD,
ekegusii: Ekero okorua eeri ensae ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa, gose ekeng’wanso kende gionsi, onye nase ogoikerania eira kwariete, gose ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe ase Omonene,
swahili: “ ‘Unapoandaa fahali mchanga kama sadaka ya kuteketezwa au dhabihu, kwa ajili ya nadhiri maalum au sadaka ya amani kwa Bwana,

english: present with the bull a grain offering of three-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with half a hin of olive oil.
ekegusii: orue amo n’eeri eria obosie obonuke ebimunu bitan’omo, bwochoganirie n’amaguta ebituba bibere,
swahili: leta pamoja na huyo fahali sadaka ya nafaka ya unga laini sehemu tatu za kumi za efa uliochanganywa na nusu ya hini ya mafuta.

english: Now Korah son of Izhar, the son of Kohath son of Levi, along with some Reubenites—Dathan and Abiram, sons of Eliab, and On son of Peleth—conducted
ekegusii: Kora, mosinto o Isari, Omolawi bw’eamate ya Kohati, na Datani, na Abiiramu, basinto b’Eliabu, na Oni, mosinto o Peleti bw’egesaku kia Rubeni,
swahili: Kora mwana wa Ishari, mwana wa Kohathi, mwana wa Lawi, pamoja na baadhi ya Wareubeni, yaani Dathani na Abiramu, wana wa Eliabu, na Oni mwana wa Pelethi, wakachukua baadhi ya watu,

english: He has brought you near, you and all your fellow Levites, but you are seeking the priesthood as well.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo akoete aye amo n’Abalawi bamino ribaga mobeere ang’e nere. Inee! Igo mokorigia obokuani boigo?
swahili: Amekuleta wewe na ndugu zako Walawi mwe karibu naye, lakini sasa unajaribu kupata na ukuhani pia.

english: Therefore, it is you and all your followers who have conspired against the LORD! As for Aaron, who is he that you should grumble against him?”
ekegusii: Aroni ninki aisaine inwe mwamwemurunganirie mamincha yaye? Ase ayio, mwerende, aye amo na bonsi abagokobwatia. Igo mwasangererekanire mamincha y’Omonene.”
swahili: Wewe na wafuasi wako wote mmekusanyika pamoja kinyume cha Bwana. Aroni ni nani kwamba ninyi mnungʼunike dhidi yake?”

english: Then Moses summoned Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, but they said, “We will not come!
ekegusii: Erio Musa akarangeria Datani na Abiiramu, basinto b’Eliabu. Barabwo bakairaneria, “Intwe titogocha.
swahili: Kisha Mose akawaita Dathani na Abiramu, wana wa Eliabu. Lakini wao wakasema, “Sisi hatuji!

english: Is it not enough that you have brought us up out of a land flowing with milk and honey to kill us in the wilderness? Must you also appoint yourself as ruler over us?
ekegusii: Inee! Aya namang’ana amagusu ase ore ng’a gwatorusetie korwa ase ense eria entenenku ere n’amabeere n’amooke, na ogatorenta aa, erinde otoite tokwere aa ase erooro eye? Na bono aye nigo ogwekora koba omonene igoro ase tore?
swahili: Haitoshi tu kwamba wewe umetuleta kutoka nchi itiririkayo maziwa na asali ili kutuua sisi jangwani? Nawe sasa pia unataka kuwa mkuu juu yetu?

english: Moreover, you have not brought us into a land flowing with milk and honey or given us an inheritance of fields and vineyards. Will you gouge out the eyes of these men? No, we will not come!”
ekegusii: Naende nonya naboigo, aye totorenteti ase ense eria entenenku ere namabeere na amooke, gose totoeti emiando y’amaremo na emegondo y’emesabibu. Inee! Nigo otagete kobaukoria abanto aba bonsi? Intwe titogocha.”
swahili: Zaidi ya hayo, hujatuingiza katika nchi inayotiririka maziwa na asali, wala hujatupa urithi wa mashamba na mashamba ya mizabibu. Je, utayangʼoa macho ya watu hawa? Hapana, sisi hatuji!”

english: Then Moses became very angry and said to the LORD, “Do not regard their offering. I have not taken one donkey from them or mistreated a single one of them.”
ekegusii: Musa akagechigwa mono, agateebia Omonene, “Tobaisa gwanchera ebing’wanso biabo. Inche tindaira nonya netigere yabo eyemo, gose tindakorera nonya noyomo obo bobe.”
swahili: Ndipo Mose akakasirika sana na kumwambia Bwana, “Usiikubali sadaka yao. Mimi sikuchukua chochote, hata punda kutoka kwao, wala sijamkosea hata mmoja wao.”

english: And Moses said to Korah, “You and all your followers are to appear before the LORD tomorrow—you and they and Aaron.
ekegusii: Musa agateebia Kora, Ankio aye amo na bonsi abagokobwatia mochiche ase obosio bw’Omonene. Aroni nere nache boigo.
swahili: Mose akamwambia Kora, “Wewe na wafuasi wako wote kesho mtatokea mbele za Bwana: yaani wewe na hao wenzako, pamoja na Aroni.

english: Each man is to take his censer, place incense in it, and present it before the LORD—250 censers. You and Aaron are to present your censers as well.”
ekegusii: Kera oyomo oino aimokie orogio rw’aye rw’omorero, na arobekere ubani na kororenta ase obosio bw’Omonene. Chindogio chionsi nigo chirabe amagana abere, na merongo etano; naye orente orwao, na Aroni nere arente orwaye.’
swahili: Kila mtu atachukua chetezo chake na kuweka uvumba ndani yake, vyetezo 250 kwa jumla, na kukileta mbele za Bwana. Wewe na Aroni mtaleta vyetezo vyenu pia.”

english: So each man took his censer, put fire and incense in it, and stood with Moses and Aaron at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.
ekegusii: Ase ayio kera omonto akaimokia orogio rw’aye, akarobeka omorero, na igoro yaye ubani, bagaacha bagatenena ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano. Musa na Aroni bagatenenenao boigo.
swahili: Kwa hiyo kila mtu akachukua chetezo chake, akaweka moto na uvumba ndani yake, na kusimama pamoja na Mose na Aroni kwenye mlango wa Hema la Kukutania.

english: When Korah had gathered his whole assembly against them at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting, the glory of the LORD appeared to the whole congregation.
ekegusii: Erio Kora agasangereria omoganda bwonsi, na barabwo bagatenena bosio bwa Musa na Aroni agwo ase egesoero ki’Eema eria. Erio obonene bw’Omonene bokaorokera omoganda bwonsi.
swahili: Kora alipokuwa amekusanya wafuasi wake wote kuwapinga Mose na Aroni kwenye mlango wa Hema la Kukutania, utukufu wa Bwana ukatokea kwa kusanyiko lote.

english: a rebellion against Moses, along with 250 men of Israel renowned as leaders of the congregation and representatives in the assembly.
ekegusii: bakabwatana, bakaanga koigwera Musa. Amo nabwo ’mbarengeo abanto bande b’Abaisraeli, amagana abere, namerongo etano. Abwo barenge abaraai bachorire korwa ase omosangererekano, bamanyekanete, naende basikire.
swahili: wakainuka dhidi ya Mose. Pamoja nao walikuwepo wanaume wa Kiisraeli 250, watu waliojulikana, viongozi wa jumuiya waliokuwa wameteuliwa kuwa wakuu wa kusanyiko.

english: And the LORD said to Moses and Aaron,
ekegusii: Omonene agakwana na Musa na Aroni, akabateebia,
swahili: Bwana akamwambia Mose na Aroni,

english: “Separate yourselves from this congregation so that I may consume them in an instant.”
ekegusii: “Tigera, morue ase abanto b’omoganda oyo, erinde mbasirie ara rimo.”
swahili: “Jitengeni kutoka kwenye kusanyiko hili ili nipate kuwaangamiza mara moja.”

english: But Moses and Aaron fell facedown and said, “O God, the God of the spirits of all flesh, when one man sins, will You be angry with the whole congregation?” Moses Separates the People
ekegusii: Musa na Aroni bagatung’ama inse bakaumama, bagateeba, “Aye ’Nyasae, Nyasae okorua obogima ase abanto bonsi, Inee, omonto oyomo gakorire ebibe, naye igo okogechigwa n’omoganda oyo bwonsi?”
swahili: Lakini Mose na Aroni wakaanguka kufudifudi na kulia kwa sauti, wakasema, “Ee Mungu, Mungu wa roho za wanadamu wote, utakuwa na hasira na kusanyiko lote wakati ni mtu mmoja tu ametenda dhambi?”

english: “Tell the congregation to move away from the dwellings of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram.”
ekegusii: “Kwana n’omoganda bw’ abanto oyoteebie: Tigera morue aase aetanaine chiema chia Kora, na Datani, na Abiiramu.”
swahili: “Liambie kusanyiko, ‘Ondokeni hapo karibu na mahema ya Kora, Dathani na Abiramu.’ ”

english: So Moses got up and went to Dathan and Abiram, and the elders of Israel followed him.
ekegusii: Musa akaimoka amo nabagaaka b’Abaisraeli, bakageenda ase Datani na Abiiramu.
swahili: Mose akainuka na kuwaendea Dathani na Abiramu, nao wazee wa Israeli wakafuatana naye.

english: And he warned the congregation, “Move away now from the tents of these wicked men. Do not touch anything that belongs to them, or you will be swept away because of all their sins.”
ekegusii: Erio agateebia omoganda bwonsi bw’ abanto, “Eatanane, nabasoroire, morue ase chiema chi’ abanto aba abakori amabe. Timobaisa gokuna gento kende gionsi kiabo; moise kogekuna nigo mogochia gosirigwa ase engencho y’ebibe biabo bionsi.”
swahili: Mose akalionya kusanyiko, “Sogeeni nyuma mbali na mahema ya hawa watu waovu! Msiguse kitu chochote kilicho mali yao, la sivyo mtafagiliwa mbali kwa sababu ya dhambi zao zote.”

english: So they moved away from the dwellings of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram. Meanwhile, Dathan and Abiram had come out and stood at the entrances to their tents with their wives and children and infants. The Earth Swallows Korah
ekegusii: Ase ayio abanto abwo bageatanana bakarua ase chiema chia Kora, na Datani, na Abiiramu. Datani na Abiiramu bagasoka isiko, amo nabakungu babo na abana babo, abanene na abake, bagatenena ase ebisoero bie chiema chiabo.
swahili: Hivyo wakaondoka karibu na mahema ya Kora, Dathani na Abiramu. Dathani na Abiramu walikuwa wametoka nje, nao walikuwa wamesimama pamoja na wake zao, watoto wao na wale wanyonyao kwenye mlango wa mahema yao.

english: Then Moses said, “This is how you will know that the LORD has sent me to do all these things, for it was not my own doing:
ekegusii: Musa agateebia abanto, “Ase aya namomanye ’ng’a Omonene ontomire gokora aya onsi, naende ng’a tari inche omonyene nebegete gokora buna inyanchete.
swahili: Ndipo Mose akasema, “Hivi ndivyo mtakavyojua kuwa Bwana amenituma kufanya mambo haya, na kwamba halikuwa wazo langu.

english: If these men die a natural death, or if they suffer the fate of all men, then the LORD has not sent me.
ekegusii: Onye abanto aba bagochia gokwa buna Mwanyabaanto onde bwensi agokwa, gose bakonyora egesusuro buna Mwanyabaanto onde bwensi akonyora, rirori’Omonene tantometi.
swahili: Ikiwa watu hawa watakufa kifo cha kawaida na kupatwa na yale ya kawaida yanayowapata wanadamu, basi Bwana hakunituma mimi.

english: They came together against Moses and Aaron and told them, “You have taken too much upon yourselves! For everyone in the entire congregation is holy, and the LORD is in their midst. Why then do you exalt yourselves above the assembly of the LORD?”
ekegusii: Barabwo bakabwatana, bakaba mamincha ya Musa na Aroni, bakabateebia, “Bono ayio aisanire. Abanto bonsi b’omoganda oyo nigo bare abachenu; Omonene nigo are amo na kera oyomo. Nase ki rende inwe mweimokereirie igoro na mogwekora abanene igoro y’omosangererekano Omonene?”
swahili: Wakaja kama kikundi kuwapinga Mose na Aroni, wakawaambia, “Ninyi mmejitukuza sana! Kusanyiko hili lote ni takatifu, kila mmoja wao, naye Bwana yu pamoja nao. Kwa nini basi mmejitukuza wenyewe juu ya kusanyiko la Bwana?”

english: But if the LORD brings about something unprecedented, and the earth opens its mouth and swallows them and all that belongs to them so that they go down alive into Sheol, then you will know that these men have treated the LORD with contempt.”
ekegusii: Korende onye Omonene ogochia gokora egento ekeyia, erinde riroba ritandoke, rimere abanto abwo amo n’ebinto biabo bionsi, na barabwo barimere riroba ime bare moyo, bagende gochia aase abakuure, erio ’namomanye ng’a abanto aba bachaayire Omonene.”
swahili: Lakini ikiwa Bwana ataleta jambo jipya kabisa, ardhi ikifunua kinywa chake na kuwameza wao, pamoja na kila kitu kilicho mali yao, nao washuke chini kaburini wakiwa hai, ndipo mtafahamu kuwa watu hawa wamemdharau Bwana.”

english: As soon as Moses had finished saying all this, the ground beneath them split open,
ekegusii: Ekero Musa akoorire gokwana amang’ana aya onsi, riroba rigatandoka inse yabo.
swahili: Mara Mose alipomaliza kusema haya yote, ardhi iliyokuwa chini yao ikapasuka,

english: and the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them and their households—all Korah’s men and all their possessions.
ekegusii: Riroba rikabwereka, rikabamera, amo ne chiamate chiabo, na abanto bonsi ababwatetie Kora, amo n’ebinto biabo bionsi.
swahili: nchi ikafunua kinywa chake na kuwameza wao, pamoja na jamaa zao, na watu wote wa Kora na mali zao zote.

english: They went down alive into Sheol with all they owned. The earth closed over them, and they vanished from the assembly.
ekegusii: Ase ayio barabwo bonsi bakamerwa bare moyo, bakageenda gochia aase abakuure, boigo n’ebinto biabo, erio riroba rikairanerana, rikabatindeka, na barabwo bagasirigwa bakarua ase omosangererekano oria.
swahili: Wakashuka chini kaburini wakiwa hai, pamoja na kila kitu walichokuwa nacho; nchi ikajifunika juu yao, nao wakaangamia wakatoweka kutoka kusanyiko.

english: At their cries, all the people of Israel who were around them fled, saying, “The earth may swallow us too!”
ekegusii: Abaisraeli bonsi abarenge ang’e nabarabwo bagatama, bakarera, bakobora, “Boigo naintwe riroba ndibaise gotomera.”
swahili: Kutoka kilio chao, Waisraeli wote waliowazunguka walikimbia, wakipaza sauti, “Nchi inatumeza na sisi pia!”

english: And fire came forth from the LORD and consumed the 250 men who were offering the incense. The Censers Reserved for Holy Use
ekegusii: Erio omorero okarua ase Omonene, ogasamba abanto baria amagana abere, na merongo etano, abwo konya barentire ubani. Chindogio chi’omorero
swahili: Moto ukaja kutoka kwa Bwana, ukawateketeza wale watu 250 waliokuwa wakifukiza uvumba.

english: “Tell Eleazar son of Aaron the priest to remove the censers from the flames and to scatter the coals far away, because the censers are holy.
ekegusii: “Teebia Eleazari, omomura o Aroni Omokuani, ng’a arusie chindogio chiria chi’omorero korwa ase omorero oyio ogwoka, na omorero oyio ayosiare gochia aare. Chindogio chiria chi’omorero konya chiabeire chinchenu.
swahili: “Mwambie Eleazari mwana wa kuhani Aroni, atoe vyetezo kwenye mabaki ya moto na kutawanya makaa mbali kiasi, kwa maana vyetezo ni vitakatifu:

english: As for the censers of those who sinned at the cost of their own lives, hammer them into sheets to overlay the altar, for these were presented before the LORD, and so have become holy. They will serve as a sign to the Israelites.”
ekegusii: Chindogio echio chi’ abanto baria basirete ekiagera bakorete ebibe, tiga chisunyuntwe chiroisigwe, chibe ekemumeko gekomumeka egesasiimero, ekiagera abanto baria nigo bachiruete ase obosio bw’Omonene; ase ayio chindogio echio konya chiabeire chinchenu. Echio nachio ekemanyererio ki’ogokuurera.”
swahili: vyetezo vya watu waliofanya dhambi iliyowagharimu maisha yao. Fua vyetezo hivyo kuwa bamba ili kufunika madhabahu, kwa maana vimeletwa mbele za Bwana na vimekuwa vitakatifu. Navyo viwe ishara kwa Waisraeli.”

english: So Eleazar the priest took the bronze censers brought by those who had been burned up, and he had them hammered out to overlay the altar,
ekegusii: Nabo Eleazari Omokuani akaimokia chindogio chiria chi’etai, echio abanto baria omorero osambete konya barentire ase obosio bw’Omonene. Echio chikaroisigwa, chikaba ekemumeko ki’egesasiimero.
swahili: Hivyo kuhani Eleazari akavikusanya vile vyetezo vya shaba vilivyoletwa na wale waliokuwa wameteketezwa kwa moto, naye akavifua kufunika madhabahu,

english: When Moses heard this, he fell facedown.
ekegusii: Ekero Musa aigwete amang’ana ayio akagwa inse maumama.
swahili: Mose aliposikia jambo hili, akaanguka kifudifudi.

english: just as the LORD commanded him through Moses. This was to be a reminder to the Israelites that no outsider who is not a descendant of Aaron should approach to offer incense before the LORD, lest he become like Korah and his followers. Murmuring and Plague (1 Corinthians 10:1–13)
ekegusii: Ekio gekaba ekemanyererio ki’ogokuurera Abaisraeli, ng’a nonya noyomo otari Omokuani, otari bw’ororeria rwa Aroni, tabaisa goika ang’e gosamba ubani ase obosio bw’Omonene. Aise gokora bo, nasire buna Kora amo n’abanto baria bamobwatetie basirete. Aya onsi nigo akoretwe buna Omonene konya achiikire Eleazari goetera ase Musa. Aroni Ogotooria Abanto
swahili: kama vile Bwana alivyomwelekeza kupitia Mose. Hili lilikuwa kuwakumbusha Waisraeli kwamba hakuna mtu hata mmoja, isipokuwa mzao wa Aroni, awezaye kuja kufukiza uvumba mbele za Bwana, la sivyo, angekuwa kama Kora na wafuasi wake.

english: The next day the whole congregation of Israel grumbled against Moses and Aaron, saying, “You have killed the LORD’s people!”
ekegusii: Korende rituko ria kabere, omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli okemurunganeria Musa na Aroni, okabora. “Ninwe mwaitire abanto ba Omonene.”
swahili: Siku iliyofuata jumuiya yote ya Kiisraeli wakanungʼunika dhidi ya Mose na Aroni, wakisema, “Mmewaua watu wa Bwana.”

english: But when the congregation gathered against them, Moses and Aaron turned toward the Tent of Meeting, and suddenly the cloud covered it and the glory of the LORD appeared.
ekegusii: Ekero omoganda oria konya osangererekanire amo ase okoba mamincha ya Musa na Aroni, barabwo bakeonchora bakarigereria Eema y’Omosangererekano bakarora riire riayetubire, na obonene bw’Omonene bokaoroka.
swahili: Lakini wakati kusanyiko lilipokusanyika kupingana na Mose na Aroni, nalo likageuka kuelekea Hema la Kukutania, ghafula wingu likafunika Hema, nao utukufu wa Bwana ukatokea.

english: Then Moses and Aaron went to the front of the Tent of Meeting,
ekegusii: Musa na Aroni bagaacha bosio bw’Eema eria.
swahili: Ndipo Mose na Aroni wakaenda mbele ya Hema la Kukutania,

english: and the LORD said to Moses,
ekegusii: N’Omonene agateebia Musa,
swahili: naye Bwana akamwambia Mose,

english: “Get away from this congregation so that I may consume them in an instant.” And Moses and Aaron fell facedown.
ekegusii: “Karue ase omoganda oyo, otigere gochia aare, erio inche ’mbasirie ara rimo.” Musa na Aroni bagatung’ama inse bakaumama.
swahili: “Jitenge mbali na kusanyiko hili ili niweze kuwaangamiza mara moja.” Wakaanguka chini kifudifudi.

english: Moses said to Aaron, “Take your censer, place fire from the altar in it, and add incense. Go quickly to the congregation and make atonement for them, because wrath has come out from the LORD; the plague has begun.”
ekegusii: Musa agateebia Aroni, “Imokia orogio rwao rw’ogosambera ubani rusia omorero ase egesasiimero oyobeke igoro yaye, erio obeeke ubani igoro ase omorero oyio, oroimokie ogende bwango ase omoganda bw’ abanto, erinde okore okobwatanigwa ase bare, ekiagera Omonene obeire nendamwamu: amaakwa achakire goita abanto.”
swahili: Kisha Mose akamwambia Aroni, “Chukua chetezo chako na uweke uvumba ndani yake, pamoja na moto kutoka madhabahuni, nawe uende haraka kwenye kusanyiko ili kufanya upatanisho kwa ajili yao. Ghadhabu imekuja kutoka kwa Bwana, na tauni imeanza.”

english: So Aaron took the censer as Moses had ordered and ran into the midst of the assembly. And seeing that the plague had begun among the people, he offered the incense and made atonement for the people.
ekegusii: Aroni akaimokia orogio rwa ubani buna Musa amoteebetie, akaminyoka gochia ase egati y’omoganda oria. Amaakwa konya achakire ase egati y’ abanto, korende Aroni akabeeka ubani ase orogio roria, agakora okobwatanigwa ase bare.
swahili: Hivyo Aroni akafanya kama Mose alivyosema, akakimbilia katikati ya kusanyiko. Tauni ilikuwa tayari imeanza miongoni mwa watu, lakini Aroni akafukiza uvumba na kufanya upatanisho kwa ajili yao.

english: He stood between the living and the dead, and the plague was halted.
ekegusii: Ekero Aroni atenenete gati gati ya baria bakwete na baria barenge moyo, amaakwa aria agatiga goita abanto.
swahili: Aroni akasimama kati ya waliokuwa hai na waliokufa, nayo tauni ikakoma.

english: But those who died from the plague numbered 14,700, in addition to those who had died on account of Korah.
ekegusii: Abanto konya bakuure nigo barenge chilifu ikomi na inye, na magana atano abere (14,700). Baria bakwete ase ogosaria gwa Kora tibarenge ase omobaro oyo.
swahili: Lakini walikufa watu 14,700 kutokana na tauni hiyo, licha ya wale waliokuwa wamekufa kwa sababu ya Kora.

english: Then he said to Korah and all his followers, “Tomorrow morning the LORD will reveal who belongs to Him and who is holy, and He will bring that person near to Himself. The one He chooses, He will bring near to Himself.
ekegusii: Erio agakwana na Kora na abanto bonsi b’ekeombe kiaye, akabateebia, “Ankio mambia Omonene nache aorokie ng’a ning’o ore oyoye, naende ning’o ore omochenu na ning’o arae ribaga amoike ang’e. Nache arente omonto oyio achorire amoike ang’e.
