swahili: Kisha akamwambia Kora na wafuasi wake wote: “Asubuhi Bwana ataonyesha ni nani aliye wake na ni nani aliye mtakatifu, tena atamtaka mtu huyo aje kwake. Mtu yule ambaye atamchagua atamfanya kuja karibu naye.

english: Then Aaron returned to Moses at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting, since the plague had been halted.
ekegusii: Ekero amaakwa atigete goita abanto, Aroni akairana ase Musa agwo ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano.
swahili: Ndipo Aroni akamrudia Mose kwenye mlango wa Hema la Kukutania, kwa maana tauni ilikuwa imekoma.

english: You, Korah, and all your followers are to do as follows: Take censers,
ekegusii: Ankio mambia moche mokore iga: Aye Kora amo na bonsi abagokobwatia, moimokie chindogio,
swahili: Wewe Kora na wafuasi wako wote mtafanya hivi: Chukueni vyetezo,

english: and tomorrow you are to place fire and incense in them in the presence of the LORD. Then the man the LORD chooses will be the one who is holy. It is you sons of Levi who have taken too much upon yourselves!”
ekegusii: mwanchare omorero mobekeo, na igoro y’omorero oyio mobeke ubani, naende mochirente ase obosio bw’Omonene. Omonto ori’Omonene arachore, nere oyio oraabe oria omochenu. Inwe Abalawi, bono ayio abaisanire.”
swahili: kesho wekeni moto na uvumba kwenye hivyo vyetezo mbele za Bwana. Mtu ambaye Bwana atamchagua atakuwa ndiye mtakatifu. Ninyi Walawi mmejitukuza sana!”

english: Moses also said to Korah, “Now listen, you sons of Levi!
ekegusii: Musa akagenderera gokwana na Kora, agateeba, “Bono inwe Abalawi, igwa!
swahili: Pia Mose akamwambia Kora, “Enyi Walawi! Sasa nisikilizeni.

english: Is it not enough for you that the God of Israel has separated you from the congregation of Israel and brought you near to Himself to perform the work at the LORD’s tabernacle, and to stand before the congregation to minister to them?
ekegusii: Inee! Nigo morooche ng’a negento egesinini ase more ng’a Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli obaatananire inwe korwa ase omoganda bw’Abaisraeli, na kobarenta mobe ang’e nere, na komokorera Omonene ase Obomenyo bwaye Obochenu, na gotenenera omoganda bw’ abanto, na kobakorera?
swahili: Haiwatoshi ninyi kwamba Mungu wa Israeli amewateua ninyi kutoka kusanyiko lote la Kiisraeli, na kuwaleta karibu naye mpate kufanya kazi kwenye Maskani ya Bwana, na kusimama mbele ya kusanyiko ili kuwahudumia?

english: The LORD said to Moses, “Put Aaron’s staff back in front of the Testimony, to be kept as a sign for the rebellious, so that you may put an end to their grumbling against Me, lest they die.”
ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa, Irania enyimbo ya Aroni ebeere agwo bosio bw’Esanduki ere noborori, erinde egachwe ebe ekemanyererio ki’ogokuurera abanto batari koigwera. Nabo okirie okwemurungania kwabo ase ’nde, timbaisa koigwa amang’ana buna ayio, mbaise kobaita bakwe.
swahili: Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Rudisha fimbo ya Aroni mbele ya Sanduku la Ushuhuda, ili ihifadhiwe kama alama kwa waasi. Hili litakomesha manungʼuniko yao dhidi yangu, ili kwamba wasife.”

english: So Moses did as the LORD had commanded him.
ekegusii: Naboigo Musa akorete buna Omonene amochiigete.
swahili: Mose akafanya kama Bwana alivyomwamuru.

english: Then the Israelites declared to Moses, “Look, we are perishing! We are lost; we are all lost!
ekegusii: Abaisraeli bagateebia Musa, “Rora, intwe twaikeire omoerio oito, tw akuure, twasirire intwe twensi.
swahili: Waisraeli wakamwambia Mose, “Tutakufa! Tumepotea, sote tumepotea!

english: Anyone who comes near the tabernacle of the LORD will die. Are we all going to perish?”
ekegusii: Kera omonto ogoika ang’e ase Obomenyo bw’Omonene, goika akwe. Inee! Ntwensi pi torakwe?”
swahili: Yeyote akaribiaye Maskani ya Bwana atakufa. Je, sisi sote tutakufa?”

english: “Speak to the Israelites and take from them twelve staffs, one from the leader of each tribe. Write each man’s name on his staff,
ekegusii: “Kwana n’Abaisraeli, obateebie ng’a bakoe chinyimbo chiabo, eyemo ase kera omotang’ani o kera egesaku kiabo, chinyimbo ikomi na ibere, Oriike erieta ria kera oyomo ase enyimbo yaye.
swahili: “Sema na Waisraeli, na ujipatie fimbo kumi na mbili kutoka kwao, moja kutoka kwa kila mmoja wa viongozi wa kabila za baba zao. Andika jina la kila mtu kwenye fimbo yake.

english: and write Aaron’s name on the staff of Levi, because there must be one staff for the head of each tribe.
ekegusii: Oriike erieta ria Aroni ase enyimbo y’egesaku kia Lawi. Kera omotang’ani bwe chiamate chia kera egesaku abe n’enyimbo eyemo.
swahili: Kwenye fimbo ya Lawi andika jina la Aroni, kwa maana ni lazima iwepo fimbo moja kwa kila kiongozi kwa ajili ya kila kabila la baba zao.

english: Place the staffs in the Tent of Meeting in front of the Testimony, where I meet with you.
ekegusii: Erio obeke chinyimbo echio ime ase Eema y’Omosangererekano bosio bw’Esanduki eria ere ne chibao chiriikire oborori, agwo ase inche ndaumerane nainwe.
swahili: Ziweke hizo fimbo ndani ya Hema la Kukutania mbele ya Sanduku la Ushuhuda, mahali nikutanapo nawe.

english: The staff belonging to the man I choose will sprout, and I will rid Myself of the constant grumbling of the Israelites against you.”
ekegusii: Enyimbo y’omonto oria inche ’ndachoore neseboke. Ase enchera eyio ninkore Abaisraeli batige kwemurungania mamincha y’ane, naende ningere batige kwemurungania mamincha yaino.”
swahili: Fimbo ya mtu nitakayemchagua itachipuka, nami mwenyewe nitayakomesha haya manungʼuniko ya mara kwa mara ya Waisraeli dhidi yako.”

english: So Moses spoke to the Israelites, and each of their leaders gave him a staff—one for each of the leaders of their tribes, twelve staffs in all. And Aaron’s staff was among them.
ekegusii: Musa agakwana n’Abaisraeli, akabateebia amang’ana ayio, na abaraai bonsi be chiamate chia kera egesaku bakamoa chinyimbo chiabo, chinyimbo ikomi na ibere, na enyimbo ya Aroni nigo yarenge ase egati ye chinyimbo chiria.
swahili: Hivyo Mose akasema na Waisraeli, nao viongozi wao wakampa fimbo kumi na mbili, fimbo moja kwa ajili ya kila kabila la baba zao, nayo fimbo ya Aroni ikiwa miongoni mwa hizo.

english: Then Moses placed the staffs before the LORD in the Tent of the Testimony.
ekegusii: Musa akaira chinyimbo chiria ime ase Eema y’Oborori, agachibekao ase obosio bw’Omonene.
swahili: Mose akaziweka hizo fimbo mbele za Bwana ndani ya Hema la Ushuhuda.

english: The next day Moses entered the Tent of the Testimony and saw that Aaron’s staff, representing the house of Levi, had sprouted, put forth buds, blossomed, and produced almonds.
ekegusii: Rituko ria kabere Musa agasoa ase Eema eria y’Oborori, akarora enyimbo ya Aroni, eyatenenerete egesaku kia Lawi, yasebokire, ne chinsagia echio chiasokirie amamumu na ebisicha, naende chiamire amatunda amalozi atobire.
swahili: Siku iliyofuata Mose aliingia kwenye Hema la Ushuhuda akaona ile fimbo ya Aroni ambayo iliwakilisha jamaa ya Lawi haikuwa tu imechipuka, bali pia ilikuwa imetoa machipukizi, kuchanua maua na kuzaa malozi.

english: Then Moses brought out all the staffs from the LORD’s presence to all the Israelites. They saw them, and each man took his own staff.
ekegusii: Erio Musa agachisokia isiko chinyimbo chiria chionsi korwa ase obosio bw’Omonene, agachirenta ase Abaisraeli bonsi. Abwo bagachirigereria, na kera omonto akabogoria enyimbo yaye.
swahili: Ndipo Mose akaleta zile fimbo zote kwa Waisraeli wote kutoka mbele za Bwana. Wakaziangalia, na kila mtu akaichukua fimbo yake mwenyewe.

english: So the LORD said to Aaron, “You and your sons and your father’s house must bear the iniquity involving the sanctuary. And you and your sons alone must bear the iniquity involving your priesthood.
ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Aroni, “Aye na abamura bao amo n’abanto b’eamate yaino nigo morabarerwe okomocha konde gwonsi koraabe kogokorerwa ase obokoreri ime y’Aase Aachenu, naende aye na abamura bao inamobarerwe okomocha konde gwonsi koraabe kogokorwa ase obokuani bwaino.
swahili: Bwana akamwambia Aroni, “Wewe, wanao na jamaa ya baba yako mtawajibika kwa makosa dhidi ya mahali patakatifu, na wewe na wanao peke yenu ndio mtakaowajibika kwa makosa dhidi ya ukuhani.

english: You are to eat it as a most holy offering, and every male may eat it. You shall regard it as holy.
ekegusii: Noriere ebinto ebio aase gete are aachenu mono. Kera omonto omosacha ore ase more nanyare koria ebinto ebio. Ebio n’ebinto ebichenu ase ore.
swahili: Mtaila kama kitu kilicho kitakatifu sana; kila mwanaume ataila. Ni lazima mtaiheshimu kama takatifu.

english: And this is yours as well: the offering of their gifts, along with all the wave offerings of the Israelites. I have given this to you and your sons and daughters as a permanent statute. Every ceremonially clean person in your household may eat it.
ekegusii: “Boigo nakoeire okoruegwa Abaisraeli barabe bakorenta ase ’nde buna ebing’wanso bi’ogosungusia. Nakoeire aye amo nabana bao, abamura na abaiseke, ’nabibe ebiaino kogenderera botambe. Kera omonto ochenegete ore ase enyomba yao nanyare koria ebinto ebio.
swahili: “Hiki pia ni chako: chochote kilichotengwa kutoka kwenye matoleo yote ya sadaka za kuinuliwa za Waisraeli. Ninakupa wewe haya, wana na binti zako kama sehemu yenu ya kawaida. Kila mmoja wa nyumba yako ambaye ni safi kwa taratibu za ibada anaweza kuyala.

english: I give you all the freshest olive oil and all the finest new wine and grain that the Israelites give to the LORD as their firstfruits.
ekegusii: “Nakoeire kera ekere ekiya mono ki’ogotongora oko Abaisraeli bakondetera: Amaguta y’amazeituni, na edivai, n’endagera.
swahili: “Ninawapa mafuta ya zeituni yaliyo bora kuliko yote, na divai mpya iliyo bora kuliko zote na nafaka wanazompa Bwana kama malimbuko katika mavuno yao.

english: The firstfruits of everything in their land that they bring to the LORD will belong to you. Every ceremonially clean person in your household may eat them.
ekegusii: Okwama gwonsi kw’eritang’ani ase ebinto bionsi bigokina ase ense yabo, okwo bakondetera, ’nakobe okwao. Kera omonto ochenegete ore ase enyomba yao nanyare koria ebinto ebio.
swahili: Malimbuko yote ya nchi ambayo wanamletea Bwana yatakuwa yenu. Kila mmoja nyumbani kwako ambaye ni safi kwa taratibu za Ibada anaweza kula.

english: Every devoted thing in Israel belongs to you.
ekegusii: “Kera egento Abaisraeli baatananire ase ’nde ’nakebe ekiao.
swahili: “Kila kitu katika Israeli ambacho kimetolewa kwa Bwana ni chenu.

english: The firstborn of every womb, whether man or beast, that is offered to the LORD belongs to you. But you must surely redeem every firstborn son and every firstborn male of unclean animals.
ekegusii: “Kera omwana omotangi bakorua ase ’nde ’nabe oyoo, na kera eng’iti entangi boigo, korende nonya naboigo bwanche embooria ase omwana omotangi o Mwanyabaanto, na ase chintangi chie ching’iti chiria chitachenegeti.
swahili: Kila mzaliwa wa kwanza wa mwanadamu na wa mnyama, ambaye ametolewa kwa Bwana ni wenu. Lakini ni lazima mtamkomboa kila mwana mzaliwa wa kwanza na kila mzaliwa wa kwanza wa kiume wa wanyama wasio safi.

english: You are to pay the redemption price for a month-old male according to your valuation: five shekels of silver, according to the sanctuary shekel, which is twenty gerahs.
ekegusii: Abana baboorigwe ekero bakoorire omotienyi oyomo, ne ching’iti boigo. Aye nobeke rigori ri’okobooria, ribe chisekeli isano chi’echifeta, koreng’ana nesekeli egokorerwa ase Obomenyo Obochenu. (Esekeli eyemo nechigera ibere.)
swahili: Watakapokuwa na umri wa mwezi mmoja, ni lazima mtawakomboa kwa bei ya ukombozi iliyowekwa, kwa shekeli tano za fedha, kulingana na shekeli ya mahali patakatifu, yenye uzito wa gera ishirini.

english: But you must not redeem the firstborn of an ox, a sheep, or a goat; they are holy. You are to sprinkle their blood on the altar and burn their fat as an offering made by fire, a pleasing aroma to the LORD.
ekegusii: Korende ching’iti chintangi chi’echiombe, gose ching’ondi, gose chimbori, tichikoboorigwa. Echio nchiatananwe ase ’nde. Amanyinga abo oyanyororokererie igoro ase egesasiimero, na ebitinya biabo obisambe bibe ekeng’wanso kegosambwa nomorero kere ne rimisu rikongwenera.
swahili: “Lakini kamwe usimkomboe mzaliwa wa kwanza wa maksai, kondoo au mbuzi; hawa ni watakatifu. Nyunyizia damu yao juu ya madhabahu na uchome mafuta yao kama sadaka itolewayo kwa moto, harufu nzuri inayompendeza Bwana.

english: And their meat belongs to you, just as the breast and right thigh of the wave offering belong to you.
ekegusii: Korende chinyama chiabo amo ne ritaana rigosungusigwa, na ekenama kia borio, echio nachio echiao.
swahili: Nyama zao zitakuwa chakula chenu, kama ilivyokuwa kidari cha kuinuliwa na paja la mguu wa kulia.

english: All the holy offerings that the Israelites present to the LORD I give to you and to your sons and daughters as a permanent statute. It is a permanent covenant of salt before the LORD for you and your offspring.”
ekegusii: “Ebiegwa bionsi ebichenu Abaisraeli barandetere inche Omonene nakobieire aye amo nabana bao, abamura na abaiseke, bibe ebitari biaino kera ekero. Okwo nokobwatana kw’ogotianania kw’omonyoo gwa kare na kare ase obosio bwane inche Omonene, okwo nakorire naye na ororeria rwao.”
swahili: Chochote kitakachotengwa kutoka sadaka takatifu ambazo Waisraeli wanamtolea Bwana, ninakupa wewe, wanao na binti zako kama fungu lenu la kawaida. Ni Agano la milele la chumvi mbele za Bwana kwako na watoto wako.”

english: But bring with you also your brothers from the tribe of Levi, the tribe of your father, that they may join you and assist you and your sons before the Tent of the Testimony.
ekegusii: Renta Abalawi bamino, egesaku gia iso, barabwo bakore emeremo aroro amo naye. Abwo bagokorere aye amo nabamura bao, ekero mogokora emeremo agwo bosio bw’Eema eria ere noborori.
swahili: Walete Walawi wenzako kutoka kabila la baba zako ili waungane nanyi na kuwasaidia wakati wewe na wanao mnapohudumu mbele ya Hema la Ushuhuda.

english: Then the LORD said to Aaron, “You will have no inheritance in their land, nor will you have any portion among them. I am your portion and your inheritance among the Israelites.
ekegusii: Naende Omonene agateebia Aroni, “Aye tokonyora omwando bw’orogongo ase egati y’Abaisraeli bande. Tokoegwa ensemo ende yonsi ase egati yabo. Inche ninche ensemo yao, naende omwando oo, ase egati y’Abaisraeli. Egetari Ki’Abalawi
swahili: Bwana akamwambia Aroni, “Hutakuwa na urithi wowote katika nchi yao, wala hutakuwa na sehemu miongoni mwao; Mimi ni fungu lako na urithi wako miongoni mwa Waisraeli.

english: Behold, I have given to the Levites all the tithes in Israel as an inheritance in return for the work they do, the service of the Tent of Meeting.
ekegusii: “Naeire Abalawi ensemo ya ikomi, eye Abaisraeli bakorua, ebe eyabo, ebe eng’eria ase emeremo eye barabe bagokora agwo ase Eema y’Omosangererekano.
swahili: “Ninawapa Walawi zaka yote katika Israeli kama urithi wao kuwa kama malipo kwa kazi wanayoifanya wakati wanapohudumu katika Hema la Kukutania.

english: No longer may the Israelites come near to the Tent of Meeting, or they will incur guilt and die.
ekegusii: Korwa bono na kogenderera Abaisraeli bande tibaabaisa goika ang’e n’Eema eria. Baise gokora bo, nigo barabe nebibe, erio bakwe.
swahili: Kuanzia sasa, kamwe Waisraeli wasisogelee karibu na Hema la Kukutania, la sivyo watabeba matokeo ya dhambi zao, nao watakufa.

english: The Levites are to perform the work of the Tent of Meeting, and they must bear their iniquity. This is a permanent statute for the generations to come. The Levites will not receive an inheritance among the Israelites.
ekegusii: Korende Abalawi barabwo nigo barakore emeremo ase Eema y’omosangererekano, okomocha kw’ebibe gokoraabeo nakobarwe igoro ase bare. Okwo nakwo koraabe ogochika ase bare kogenderera ebiaare ase ebiaare. Barabwo tibakoba nomwando ase egati y’Abaisraeli.
swahili: Ni Walawi watakaofanya kazi katika Hema la Kukutania na kubeba wajibu wa makosa dhidi yake. Hili ni agizo la kudumu kwa vizazi vijavyo. Hawatapokea urithi wowote miongoni mwa Waisraeli.

english: For I have given to the Levites as their inheritance the tithe that the Israelites present to the LORD as a contribution. That is why I told them that they would not receive an inheritance among the Israelites.”
ekegusii: Ensemo ya ikomi eye Abaisraeli bakondetera buna okoruegwa kwabo nayeire Abalawi ebe eyabo. Ase ayio, nabateebirie ng’a tibakoba nomwando ase egati y’Abaisraeli bande.” Ensemo ya ikomi y’Abalawi
swahili: Badala yake, ninawapa Walawi zaka zote zinazotolewa na Waisraeli kama sadaka kwa Bwana kuwa urithi wao. Hiyo ndiyo sababu nimesema hivi kuhusu wao: ‘Hawatakuwa na urithi miongoni mwa Waisraeli.’ ”

english: And the LORD instructed Moses,
ekegusii: Omonene agakwana na Musa, akamoteebia,
swahili: Bwana akamwambia Mose,

english: “Speak to the Levites and tell them: ‘When you receive from the Israelites the tithe that I have given you as your inheritance, you must present part of it as an offering to the LORD—a tithe of the tithe.
ekegusii: “Kwana n’Abalawi, obateebie: Ekero mokonyora ensemo ya ikomi korwa ase Abaisraeli, eri’Omonene abaeire ebe eyaino, erio morusie ensemo ya ikomi y’okoruegwa okwo, moyerentere Omonene.
swahili: “Sema na Walawi na uwaambie: ‘Mtakapopokea zaka kutoka kwa Waisraeli ambayo ninawapa kama urithi wenu kutoka kwao, ni lazima mtoe sehemu ya kumi ya hiyo zaka kama sadaka kwa Bwana, iwe zaka ya hiyo zaka.

english: Your offering will be reckoned to you as grain from the threshing floor or juice from the winepress.
ekegusii: Okoruegwa okwo inwe morarue, nigo korabarwe ase more buna n’okoruegwa kw’endagera korwa ase ebiooreri biaino, na ogw’edivai na amaguta korwa ase ekemitero, okwo abande bakorua.
swahili: Sadaka yenu itahesabiwa kwenu kama nafaka kutoka sakafu ya kupuria, au divai kutoka kwenye shinikizo la kukamulia zabibu.

english: So you are to present an offering to the LORD from all the tithes you receive from the Israelites, and from these you are to give the LORD’s offering to Aaron the priest.
ekegusii: Ase enchera eye nainwe morentere Omonene okoruegwa kwaino, okwo mokorusia korwa ase ensemo ya ikomi eria mokonyora korwa ase Abaisraeli. Na okoruegwa okwo gw’enseemo ya ikomi okore kw’Omonene, moe Aroni Omokuani.
swahili: Kwa njia hii, ninyi pia mtatoa sadaka kwa Bwana kutoka zaka zote mtakazopokea kutoka kwa Waisraeli. Kutoka kwenye zaka hizi, ni lazima mtoe sehemu ya Bwana kwa Aroni, kuhani.

english: You must present the offering due the LORD from all the best of every gift, the holiest part of it.’
ekegusii: Korwa ase ebiegwa ebio bionsi moranyore korwa ase Abaisraeli, mwatananere Omonene biria bire ebiya mono.
swahili: Ni lazima mtoe kama sehemu ya Bwana iliyo nzuri sana tena ile sehemu iliyo takatifu sana kuliko zote ya kile kitu mlichopewa.’

english: And they shall attend to your duties and to all the duties of the Tent; but they must not come near to the furnishings of the sanctuary or the altar, or both they and you will die.
ekegusii: Barabwo ’nabagokorere, naende bakore emeremo yonsi ase Eema eria, korende tibaabaisa goika ang’e ase ebikorero ebichenu bi’Aase Aachenu, gose tibaika ang’e ase egesasiimero. Baise gokora igo, aye amo nabarabwo igo morakwe.
swahili: Watawajibika kwenu na watafanya kazi zote za Hema, lakini kamwe wasisogelee vifaa vya patakatifu au madhabahu, la sivyo wao na ninyi mtakufa.

english: Therefore say to the Levites, ‘When you have presented the best part, it will be reckoned to you as the produce of the threshing floor or winepress.
ekegusii: Ase ayio otebie Abalawi: Ekero moraabe mwarure ebinto ebiya mono korwa ase ensemo ya ikomi eria, erio ebinto ebio nigo birabarwe ase more, inwe Abalawi, buna okoruegwa kwaino kw’endagera, na okomitwa gw’edivai, na okw’amaguta.
swahili: “Waambie Walawi: ‘Mtakapotoa sehemu zilizo bora sana, itahesabiwa kwenu kama mazao ya sakafu ya kupuria nafaka, au ya shinikizo la kukamulia zabibu.

english: And you and your households may eat the rest of it anywhere; it is the compensation for your work at the Tent of Meeting.
ekegusii: Inwe amo n’abanto b’echinka chiaino namoriere ebinto ebio aase aande onsi, ekiagera eyio neng’eria yaino moraakanwe ase emeremo mogokora agwo ase Eema y’Omosangererekano.
swahili: Ninyi na watu wa nyumbani mwenu mnaweza kula sehemu iliyobaki mahali popote, kwani ndio ujira wenu kwa ajili ya kazi yenu katika Hema la Kukutania.

english: Once you have presented the best part of it, you will not incur guilt because of it. But you must not defile the sacred offerings of the Israelites, or else you will die.’”
ekegusii: Ekero mwarure ensemo engiya kobua korwa ase okoruegwa okwo, timokoba nokomocha ase okoria eria entigari. Timobaisa gokora ebinto ebichenu bi’Abaisraeli bibe ebitachenegeti, erinde timokwa.”
swahili: Kwa kutoa sehemu zake zilizo bora sana, hamtakuwa na hatia katika jambo hili; ndipo hamtatia unajisi sadaka takatifu za Waisraeli, nanyi hamtakufa.’ ”

english: They are to join you and attend to the duties of the Tent of Meeting, doing all the work at the Tent; but no outsider may come near you.
ekegusii: Nigo barabwatane naye na gokora emeremo yabo yonsi y’obokoreri ase Eema y’Omosangererekano. Omonto onde omoao otachiikiri tabaisa goika ang’e akore emeremo amo nainwe.
swahili: Watajiunga nanyi na watawajibika kwa utunzaji wa Hema la Kukutania, yaani kazi zote kwenye Hema, wala hakuna mtu mwingine yeyote atakayeweza kusogea karibu hapo mlipo.

english: And you shall attend to the duties of the sanctuary and of the altar, so that wrath may not fall on the Israelites again.
ekegusii: Aye amo nabamura bao, ninwe mweka morakore emeremo ime y’Aase Aachenu na ase egesasiimero, erio nario endamwamu yane etabaise koba igoro y’Abaisraeli naende.
swahili: “Mtawajibika katika utunzaji wa mahali patakatifu na madhabahu, ili kwamba ghadhabu isiwaangukie Waisraeli tena.

english: Behold, I Myself have selected your fellow Levites from the Israelites as a gift to you, dedicated to the LORD to perform the service for the Tent of Meeting.
ekegusii: Ninche nachorire Abalawi bamino korwa ase Abaisraeli, babe ekeegwa ase more. Barabwo baatananirwe ase ’nde inche Omonene, bakore emeremo ase Eema y’Omosangererekano.
swahili: Mimi mwenyewe nimewachagua Walawi wenzenu kutoka miongoni mwa Waisraeli kama zawadi kwenu, waliowekwa wakfu kwa Bwana ili kufanya kazi katika Hema la Kukutania.

english: But only you and your sons shall attend to your priesthood for everything concerning the altar and what is inside the veil, and you are to perform that service. I am giving you the work of the priesthood as a gift, but any outsider who comes near the sanctuary must be put to death.” Offerings for Priests and Levites
ekegusii: Aye amo nabamura bao, ninwe mweka morakore emeremo yonsi y’obokuani, na emeremo yonsi ase egesasiimero, na eria ere moino y’etoto enachete Obomenyo Obochenu. Nabaeire obokuani buna ekeegwa kebe ekiaino. Onye omonto onde omoao otachiikiri ogocha ang’e ase obokoreri obwo, goika aitwe akwe.” Ebitari bi’abakuani
swahili: Lakini ni wewe tu na wanao mtakaoweza kutumika kama makuhani kuhusiana na kila kitu kwenye madhabahu na ndani ya pazia. Ninawapa utumishi wa ukuhani kama zawadi. Mtu mwingine yeyote atakayekaribia mahali patakatifu ni lazima auawe.” Sadaka Kwa Ajili Ya Makuhani Na Walawi

english: Then the LORD said to Aaron, “Behold, I have put you in charge of My offerings. As for all the sacred offerings of the Israelites, I have given them to you and your sons as a portion and a permanent statute.
ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Aroni, “Rora, nakoeire okoruegwa konde gwonsi gokoruegwa ase ’nde, obe gokorenda. Ebinto bionsi ebichenu Abaisraeli bakorua, ebio nakobieire bibe egetari kiao amo neki’ororeria rwao kogenderera botambe.
swahili: Kisha Bwana akamwambia Aroni, “Mimi mwenyewe nimekuweka kuwa mwangalizi wa sadaka zote zitakazotolewa kwangu; matoleo yote matakatifu Waisraeli wanayonipa ninakupa wewe na wanao kama sehemu yenu na fungu lenu la kawaida.

english: A portion of the most holy offerings reserved from the fire will be yours. From all the offerings they render to Me as most holy offerings, whether grain offerings or sin offerings or guilt offerings, that part belongs to you and your sons.
ekegusii: Ase ebinto bire ebichenu mono, ebiratigare, bitari gosambwa nomorero, ebiraabe ebiao, nabio ebi: Kera okoruegwa kw’endagera, na kera ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, na ekeng’wanso gi’okorongeyia okomocha. Ebinto bionsi barabwo barabe bakorua ase ’nde, nabibe ebichenu mono ase ore, na ase abamura bao.
swahili: Mtachukua sehemu ya yale matoleo matakatifu sana ambayo hayateketezwi kwa moto. Kutoka kwa matoleo yote wanayoniletea kama sadaka takatifu sana, ziwe za nafaka, au za dhambi, au za makosa, sehemu ile itakuwa yako na wanao.

english: Then the LORD said to Moses and Aaron,
ekegusii: Omonene agakwana na Musa amo na Aroni, akabateebia,
swahili: Bwana akamwambia Mose na Aroni:

english: The man who has gathered up the ashes of the heifer must also wash his clothes, and he will be ceremonially unclean until evening. This is a permanent statute for the Israelites and for the foreigner residing among them. Purification of the Unclean
ekegusii: Omonto oria orabuuche riibu riria, asibie chianga chiaye, nere nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio. Oko nakwo ogochika koragenderere botambe ase Abaisraeli na ase omomenyi omenyete ase egati yabo. Ogokuna Egetondo
swahili: Mtu akusanyaye majivu ya huyo mtamba ni lazima pia afue nguo zake, kadhalika naye pia atakuwa najisi hadi jioni. Hili litakuwa agizo la kudumu kwa Waisraeli na kwa wageni wanaoishi miongoni mwao.

english: Whoever touches any dead body will be unclean for seven days.
ekegusii: “Monto onde bwensi orakune egetondo, nabe oyotachenegeti ase amatuko atan’abere.
swahili: “Mtu yeyote agusaye maiti ya mtu yeyote atakuwa najisi kwa siku saba.

english: He must purify himself with the water on the third day and on the seventh day; then he will be clean. But if he does not purify himself on the third and seventh days, he will not be clean.
ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatato, naende ase rituko ria gatan’akabere, omonto oria goika esibie n’amaache, nabe ochenekire; korende onye tagwesibia ase amatuko aya abere takoba oyochenekire.
swahili: Ni lazima ajitakase mwenyewe kwa maji katika siku ya tatu na siku ya saba, ndipo atakuwa safi. Lakini kama hatajitakasa mwenyewe katika siku ya tatu na ya saba, hatakuwa safi.

english: Anyone who touches a human corpse and fails to purify himself defiles the tabernacle of the LORD. That person must be cut off from Israel. He remains unclean, because the water of purification has not been sprinkled on him, and his uncleanness is still on him.
ekegusii: Monto onde bwensi orakune egetondo, korende tesibia, igo agokora Obomenyo bw’Omonene bobe obotachenegeti. Omonto oyio aatananwe korwa ase Abaisraeli, ekiagera amaache aria ay’okomochena taumoiri ase are; ere agenderere koba oyotachenegeti.
swahili: Mtu yeyote agusaye maiti ya mtu yeyote na kushindwa kujitakasa mwenyewe hunajisi Maskani ya Bwana. Mtu huyo ni lazima akatiliwe mbali na Israeli. Kwa sababu hajanyunyiziwa maji ya utakaso, yeye ni najisi; unajisi wake unabaki juu yake.

english: This is the law when a person dies in a tent: Everyone who enters the tent and everyone already in the tent will be unclean for seven days,
ekegusii: “Oko nakwo ogochika: Omonto onde bwensi orasoe eema eria ase egetondo kere, na omonto onde bwensi ore imeo, nabe oyotachenegeti ase engaki y’amatuko atan’abere.
swahili: “Hii ndiyo sheria itumikayo wakati mtu amekufa ndani ya hema: Yeyote aingiaye ndani ya hema hilo na yeyote aliye ndani yake watakuwa najisi kwa muda wa siku saba,

english: and any open container without a lid fastened on it is unclean.
ekegusii: Egekorero kende gionsi kere ase eema eria ime, getabwati egekuneko, korende kere giasie, kiabeire egetachenegeti.
swahili: nacho kila chombo kisicho na kifuniko juu yake kitakuwa najisi.

english: Anyone in the open field who touches someone who has been killed by the sword or has died of natural causes, or anyone who touches a human bone or a grave, will be unclean for seven days.
ekegusii: Omonto onde bwensi oranyore omonto okenyirwe orosana ime, gose okwete ogokwa konde gwonsi, na amokune, gose akune riuga ri’egetondo, gose oboina, omonto oyio nabe oyotachenegeti ase engaki y’amatuko atan’abere.
swahili: “Mtu yeyote aliyeko nje mahali pa wazi agusaye mtu aliyeuawa kwa upanga au mtu aliyekufa kwa kifo cha kawaida, au mtu yeyote agusaye mfupa wa mtu aliyekufa au kaburi, atakuwa najisi kwa siku saba.

english: For the purification of the unclean person, take some of the ashes of the burnt sin offering, put them in a jar, and pour fresh water over them.
ekegusii: “Ekiagera babeire abatachenegeti, nabaimokie riibu ike ri’ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, keria giasambirwe, na kobeeka amaache amaya a rooche igoro ye riibu riria.
swahili: “Kwa mtu aliye najisi, weka majivu ya sadaka ya utakaso wa dhambi ndani ya chombo, umimine maji safi juu yao.

english: Then a man who is ceremonially clean is to take some hyssop, dip it in the water, and sprinkle the tent, all the furnishings, and the people who were there. He is also to sprinkle the one who touched a bone, a grave, or a person who has died or been slain.
ekegusii: Erio omonto ochenegete aimokie orosagia rwa hisopo, arotobeke ase amaache ayio ime, erio anyororokerie eema n’ebinto bionsi bireo, amo n’abanto barenge imeo. Naende anyororokerie omonto oria okunete riuga, gose okunete omonto oitetwe, gose oyokwete bweka, gose oboina.
swahili: Kisha mtu aliye safi kwa kawaida za kiibada atachukua hisopo, achovye ndani ya maji, na kunyunyizia hema na vifaa vyote pamoja na watu ambao walikuwamo. Pia ni lazima amnyunyizie mtu yeyote ambaye amegusa mfupa wa mtu aliyekufa, au kaburi, au mtu ambaye ameuawa, au mtu ambaye amekufa kifo cha kawaida.

english: The man who is ceremonially clean is to sprinkle the unclean person on the third day and on the seventh day. After he purifies the unclean person on the seventh day, the one being cleansed must wash his clothes and bathe in water, and that evening he will be clean.
ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatato, na ase rituko ria gatan’akabere, omonto ochenegete anyororokie amaache ase oria otachenegeti. Ase igo ase rituko ria gatan’akabere namochene; ere oria ogochia gochenwa nasibie chianga chiaye, esibie nomobere namaache, na ase engaki ya mogoroba nabe ochenekire.
swahili: Mtu ambaye ni safi ndiye atakayemnyunyizia yeyote ambaye ni najisi siku ya tatu na siku ya saba, na katika siku ya saba atamtakasa mtu huyo. Mtu ambaye ametakaswa lazima afue nguo zake na kuoga kwa maji, na jioni ile atakuwa safi.

english: “This is the statute of the law that the LORD has commanded: Instruct the Israelites to bring you an unblemished red heifer that has no defect and has never been placed under a yoke.
ekegusii: “Oyo n’oro omooroberio inche Omonene nachiikire: Teebia Abaisraeli ng’a barente eng’ombe eaberi embariri etari na kemoa ase omobere oye, naende etana kobekerwa rikorogoto ase ogokorigwa emeremo.
swahili: “Hivi ndivyo sheria ambayo Bwana ameagiza itakavyo: Waambie Waisraeli wakuletee mtamba mwekundu asiye na dosari wala waa, na ambaye hajapata kufungwa nira.

english: But if a person who is unclean does not purify himself, he will be cut off from the assembly, because he has defiled the sanctuary of the LORD. The water of purification has not been sprinkled on him; he is unclean.
ekegusii: “Omonto obeire oyotachenegeti, nere tancheti gwesibia, arusigwe ase omosangererekano bw’ abanto. Ere okorire Aase Aachenu a Omonene abeire atachenegeti, ekiagera amaache aria y’okomochena tanyororokeretigwe ase are; ere nigo are oyotachenegeti.
swahili: Lakini ikiwa mtu ambaye ni najisi hakujitakasa mwenyewe, ni lazima akatiliwe mbali na jumuiya, kwa sababu ameinajisi Maskani ya Bwana. Maji ya utakaso hayajanyunyizwa juu yake, naye ni najisi.

english: This is a permanent statute for the people: The one who sprinkles the water of purification must wash his clothes, and whoever touches the water of purification will be unclean until evening.
ekegusii: Oko nakwo ogochika kwa botambe ase bare. Omonto oria okonyororokeria amaache aria y’ogochena asibie chianga chiaye, na omonto onde omoao karakune amaache aria, nere nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio.
swahili: Hii ni sheria ya kudumu kwao. “Mtu yeyote ambaye ananyunyiza yale maji ya utakaso lazima pia afue nguo zake, na yeyote ambaye hugusa maji ya utakaso atakuwa najisi mpaka jioni.

english: Anything the unclean person touches will become unclean, and anyone who touches it will be unclean until evening.”
ekegusii: Egento kende gionsi omonto oria otachenegeti arakune nakerokio ’nakebe egetachenegeti. Omonto onde bwensi orakune egento keria nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio.”
swahili: Kitu chochote anachogusa mtu aliye najisi kitakuwa najisi, na yeyote akigusaye huwa najisi mpaka jioni.”

english: Give it to Eleazar the priest, and he will have it brought outside the camp and slaughtered in his presence.
ekegusii: Orente eng’ombe eria, oyee Eleazari Omokuani; na eng’ombe eria eirwe isiko y’egetwori, erio enyenyerweo ase obosio bwaye.
swahili: Mpeni kuhani Eleazari huyo mtamba; naye atatolewa nje ya kambi na kuchinjwa mbele yake huyo kuhani.

english: Eleazar the priest is to take some of its blood on his finger and sprinkle it seven times toward the front of the Tent of Meeting.
ekegusii: Eleazari atobeke ekiara kiaye ase amanyinga y’eng’ombe eria, ayanyororokerie ara gatano nakabere bosio bw’Eema y’Omosangererekano.
swahili: Kisha kuhani Eleazari atachukua baadhi ya damu yake kwenye kidole chake na kuinyunyiza mara saba kuelekea upande wa mbele ya Hema la Kukutania.

english: Then the heifer must be burned in his sight. Its hide, its flesh, and its blood are to be burned, along with its dung.
ekegusii: Erio chinyama chi’eng’ombe eria, chisamberwe ase obosio bwaye amo ne riiyo na amanyinga, n’esike.
swahili: Wakati angali akitazama, mtamba huyo atateketezwa: ngozi yake, nyama yake, damu na sehemu zake za ndani.

english: The priest is to take cedar wood, hyssop, and scarlet wool and throw them onto the burning heifer.
ekegusii: Erio Omokuani abogorie oroko rw’emecharake na orosagia rwa hisopo, na eusi embariri, erio abirute as’omorero oria ogosamba eng’ombe eria.
swahili: Kuhani atachukua kuni za mti wa mwerezi, hisopo na sufu nyekundu, na kuvitupa kwenye huyo mtamba anayeungua.

english: Then the priest must wash his clothes and bathe his body in water; after that he may enter the camp, but he will be ceremonially unclean until evening.
ekegusii: Erio Omokuani asibie chianga chiaye, esibie omobere boigo namaache. Ekero akoorire gokora bo achiche ase egetwori, ere nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio.
swahili: Baada ya hayo, kuhani lazima afue nguo zake, na aoge mwili wake kwa maji. Kisha anaweza kurudi kambini, lakini atakuwa najisi kwa kawaida ya ibada mpaka jioni.

english: The one who burned the heifer must also wash his clothes and bathe his body in water, and he too will be ceremonially unclean until evening.
ekegusii: Na omonto oria ogosamba eng’ombe eria goika asibie chianga chiaye, esibie nomobere namaache, ere nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio.
swahili: Mtu amchomaye huyo mtamba lazima naye pia afue nguo zake na kuoga kwa maji, naye pia atakuwa najisi mpaka jioni.

english: Then a man who is ceremonially clean is to gather up the ashes of the heifer and store them in a ceremonially clean place outside the camp. They must be kept by the congregation of Israel for preparing the water of purification; this is for purification from sin.
ekegusii: Omonto ochenegete abuuche riibu ri’eng’ombe eria, erio ariumore isiko y’egetwori, aase achenire. Riibu erio rigachwe agwo ase engencho y’omoganda bw’Abaisraeli ase ogokorerwa emeremo y’ogochena amaache akonyororokigwa ase okorusia ebibe.
swahili: “Mtu ambaye ni safi atakusanya majivu ya mtamba huyo na kuyaweka mahali ambapo ni safi nje ya kambi kwa taratibu za kiibada. Yatahifadhiwa na jumuiya ya Kiisraeli kwa matumizi katika maji ya utakaso; ni kwa ajili ya kutakasa kutoka dhambini.

english: On the first day of the second month of the second year after the Israelites had come out of the land of Egypt, the LORD spoke to Moses in the Tent of Meeting in the Wilderness of Sinai. He said:
ekegusii: Ase rituko rie ritang’ani ri’omotienyi o kabere bw’omwaka o kabere magega Abaisraeli kobarure ase ense ya Misiri, Omonene agakwana na Musa ime y’Eema y’Omosangererekano, agwo ase erooro ya Sinai, okomoteebia,
swahili: Bwana alisema na Mose katika Jangwa la Sinai, katika Hema la Kukutania, siku ya kwanza ya mwezi wa pili, katika mwaka wa pili baada ya Waisraeli kutoka nchi ya Misri. Akamwambia,

english: from the sons of Joseph: from Ephraim, Elishama son of Ammihud, and from Manasseh, Gamaliel son of Pedahzur;
ekegusii: Korwa ase basinto ba Yusufu: ase egesaku gi’Efraimu, Elisama, mosinto bw’Amihudi, na ase egesaku kia Manase, Gamalieli, mosinto o Pedasuri.
swahili: kutoka wana wa Yosefu: kutoka Efraimu, ni Elishama mwana wa Amihudi; kutoka Manase, ni Gamalieli mwana wa Pedasuri;

english: from Benjamin, Abidan son of Gideoni;
ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku kia Benjamini, Abidani, mosinto o Gidioni.
swahili: kutoka Benyamini, ni Abidani mwana wa Gideoni;

english: from Dan, Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai;
ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku gia Dani, Ahieseri, mosinto bw’Amisadai.
swahili: kutoka Dani, ni Ahiezeri mwana wa Amishadai;

english: from Asher, Pagiel son of Ocran;
ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku gi’Aseri, Pagieli, mosinto bw’Okirani.
swahili: kutoka Asheri, ni Pagieli mwana wa Okrani;

english: from Gad, Eliasaph son of Deuel;
ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku kia Gadi, Eliasafu, mosinto o Deueli.
swahili: kutoka Gadi, ni Eliasafu mwana wa Deueli;

english: and from Naphtali, Ahira son of Enan.”
ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku kia Nafutali, Ahira, mosinto o Enani.”
swahili: kutoka Naftali, ni Ahira mwana wa Enani.”

english: These men were appointed from the congregation; they were the leaders of the tribes of their fathers, the heads of the clans of Israel. The Number of Every Tribe
ekegusii: Abaaanto aba nabwo barenge abateneneri ase ebisaku ebio biabo, naende abatang’ani be chiamate chi’Abaisraeli, bachoretwe korwa ase omoganda bwonsi.
swahili: Hawa walikuwa wanaume walioteuliwa kutoka jumuiya, viongozi wa makabila ya baba zao. Walikuwa wakuu wa koo za Israeli.

english: So Moses and Aaron took these men who had been designated by name,
ekegusii: Musa na Aroni bakaira abanto abwo baatoretwe ase amarieta abo,
swahili: Mose na Aroni wakawachukua wanaume hao waliokuwa wamepewa majina yao,

english: and on the first day of the second month they assembled the whole congregation and recorded their ancestry by clans and families, counting one by one the names of those twenty years of age or older,
ekegusii: na ase rituko rie ritang’ani ri’omotienyi o kabere bagasangereria omoganda bwonsi bw’ abanto amo. Bakariika amarieta y’ abanto abwo konya bakoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, eamate ase eamate, na enyomba ase enyomba, na omonto ase omonto.
swahili: wakaita jumuiya yote pamoja katika siku ya kwanza ya mwezi wa pili. Watu wakaonyesha nasaba zao kwa koo zao na jamaa zao, nao wanaume waliokuwa na miaka ishirini au zaidi waliorodheshwa kwa majina, mmoja mmoja,

english: just as the LORD had commanded Moses. So Moses numbered them in the Wilderness of Sinai:
ekegusii: Musa akabara abanto abwo na kobarika, agwo ase erooro ya Sinai, buna Omonene konya amochiikire.
swahili: kama Bwana alivyomwagiza Mose. Hivyo aliwahesabu katika Jangwa la Sinai:

english: “Take a census of the whole congregation of Israel by their clans and families, listing every man by name, one by one.
ekegusii: “Kora omobaro bw’omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli, eamate ase eamate, na enyomba ase enyomba. Oriike amarieta y’ abanto abasacha bonsi, oyomo ase oyomo.
swahili: “Hesabu watu wa jumuiya yote ya Waisraeli kwa kufuata koo zao na jamaa zao, ukiorodhesha kila mwanaume kwa jina lake, mmoja mmoja.

english: From the sons of Reuben, the firstborn of Israel, according to the records of their clans and families, counting one by one the names of every male twenty years of age or older who could serve in the army,
ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rwa Rubeni, omotangi o Israeli, bakariikwa, omonto ase omonto, ase chiamate chiabo ne chinyomba chiabo. Abaaanto bonsi abasacha, aba konya bakoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, abwo baare konyara korwana esegi,
swahili: Kutoka wazao wa Reubeni, mzaliwa wa kwanza wa kiume wa Israeli: Wanaume wote waliokuwa na miaka ishirini au zaidi ambao waliweza kutumika katika jeshi waliorodheshwa kwa majina, mmoja mmoja, kufuatana na kumbukumbu za koo zao na jamaa zao.

english: those registered to the tribe of Reuben numbered 46,500.
ekegusii: nigo barenge chilifu emerongo ene na isano nemo, n’amagana atano (46,500).
swahili: Idadi kutoka kabila la Reubeni ilikuwa watu 46,500.

english: From the sons of Simeon, according to the records of their clans and families, counting one by one the names of every male twenty years of age or older who could serve in the army,
ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rwa Simioni bakariikwa, omonto ase omonto, ase chiamate chiabo ne chinyomba chiabo. Abanto bonsi abasacha, aba konya bakoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, abwo baare konyara korwana esegi,
swahili: Kutoka wazao wa Simeoni: Wanaume wote waliokuwa na miaka ishirini au zaidi ambao waliweza kutumika katika jeshi walihesabiwa na kuorodheshwa kwa majina, mmoja mmoja, kufuatana na kumbukumbu za koo zao na jamaa zao.

english: those registered to the tribe of Simeon numbered 59,300.
ekegusii: nigo barenge chilifu emerongo etano na kianda, n’amagana atato (59,300).
swahili: Idadi kutoka kabila la Simeoni walikuwa watu 59,300.

english: From the sons of Gad, according to the records of their clans and families, counting the names of all those twenty years of age or older who could serve in the army,
ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rwa Gadi bakariikwa, omonto ase omonto, ase chiamate chiabo ne chinyomba chiabo. Abanto bonsi abasacha, aba konya bakoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, abwo baare konyara korwana esegi,
swahili: Kutoka wazao wa Gadi: Wanaume wote waliokuwa na miaka ishirini au zaidi ambao waliweza kutumika katika jeshi waliorodheshwa kwa majina, kufuatana na kumbukumbu za koo zao na jamaa zao.

english: those registered to the tribe of Gad numbered 45,650.
ekegusii: nigo barenge chilifu emerongo ene naisano, n’amagana atano nomo, namerongo etano (45,650).
swahili: Idadi kutoka kabila la Gadi walikuwa watu 45,650.

english: From the sons of Judah, according to the records of their clans and families, counting the names of all those twenty years of age or older who could serve in the army,
ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rwa Yuda bakariikwa, omonto ase omonto, ase chiamate chiabo ne chinyomba chiabo Abanto bonsi abasacha, aba konya bakoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, abwo baare konyara korwana esegi,
swahili: Kutoka wazao wa Yuda: Wanaume wote waliokuwa na miaka ishirini au zaidi ambao waliweza kutumika katika jeshi waliorodheshwa kwa majina, kufuatana na kumbukumbu za koo zao na jamaa zao.

english: those registered to the tribe of Judah numbered 74,600.
ekegusii: nigo barenge chilifu emerongo etano nebere na inye, n’amagana atano nomo (74,600).
swahili: Idadi kutoka kabila la Yuda walikuwa watu 74,600.

english: From the sons of Issachar, according to the records of their clans and families, counting the names of all those twenty years of age or older who could serve in the army,
ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rwa Isakaru bakariikwa, omonto ase omonto, ase chiamate chiabo ne chinyomba chiabo. Abanto bonsi abasacha, aba konya bakoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, abwo baare konyara korwana esegi,
swahili: Kutoka wazao wa Isakari: Wanaume wote waliokuwa na miaka ishirini au zaidi ambao waliweza kutumika katika jeshi waliorodheshwa kwa majina, kufuatana na kumbukumbu za koo zao na jamaa zao.

english: those registered to the tribe of Issachar numbered 54,400.
ekegusii: nigo barenge chilifu emerongo etano nainye, n’amagana ane (54,400).
swahili: Idadi kutoka kabila la Isakari walikuwa watu 54,400.

english: You and Aaron are to number those who are twenty years of age or older by their divisions—everyone who can serve in Israel’s army.
ekegusii: Aye amo na Aroni mobare abanto abakoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, baria baranyare korwana esegi, mobaroberie ase esegi, ekeombe ase ekeombe.
swahili: Wewe na Aroni mtawahesabu kwa migawanyo yao wanaume wote katika Israeli wenye miaka ishirini na kuendelea ambao wanaweza kutumika katika jeshi.

english: From the sons of Zebulun, according to the records of their clans and families, counting the names of all those twenty years of age or older who could serve in the army,
ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rwa Sabuloni bakariikwa, omonto ase omonto, ase chiamate chiabo ne chinyomba chiabo. Abanto bonsi abasacha, aba konya bakoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, abwo baare konyara korwana esegi,
swahili: Kutoka wazao wa Zabuloni: Wanaume wote waliokuwa na miaka ishirini au zaidi ambao waliweza kutumika katika jeshi waliorodheshwa kwa majina, kufuatana na kumbukumbu za koo zao na jamaa zao.

english: those registered to the tribe of Zebulun numbered 57,400.
ekegusii: nigo barenge chilifu emerongo etano na isano ibere, n’amagana ane (57,400).
swahili: Idadi kutoka kabila la Zabuloni walikuwa watu 57,400.

english: From the sons of Joseph: From the sons of Ephraim, according to the records of their clans and families, counting the names of all those twenty years of age or older who could serve in the army,
ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rwa Yusufu, narwo orw’Efraimu, bakariikwa, omonto ase omonto, ase chiamate chiabo ne chinyomba chiabo. Abanto bonsi abasacha, aba konya bakoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, abwo baare konyara korwana esegi,
swahili: Kutoka wana wa Yosefu: Kutoka wazao wa Efraimu: Wanaume wote waliokuwa na miaka ishirini au zaidi ambao waliweza kutumika katika jeshi waliorodheshwa kwa majina, kufuatana na kumbukumbu za koo zao na jamaa zao.

english: those registered to the tribe of Ephraim numbered 40,500.
ekegusii: nigo barenge chilifu emerongo ene, n’amagana atano (40,500).
swahili: Idadi kutoka kabila la Efraimu walikuwa watu 40,500.

english: And from the sons of Manasseh, according to the records of their clans and families, counting the names of all those twenty years of age or older who could serve in the army,
ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rwa Manase bakariikwa, omonto ase omonto, ase chiamate chiabo ne chinyomba chiabo. Abanto bonsi abasacha, aba konya bakoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, abwo baare konyara korwana esegi,
swahili: Kutoka wazao wa Manase: Wanaume wote waliokuwa na miaka ishirini au zaidi ambao waliweza kutumika katika jeshi waliorodheshwa kwa majina, kufuatana na kumbukumbu za koo zao na jamaa zao.

english: those registered to the tribe of Manasseh numbered 32,200.
ekegusii: nigo barenge chilifu emerongo etato naibere, n’amagana abere (32,200).
swahili: Idadi kutoka kabila la Manase walikuwa watu 32,200.

english: From the sons of Benjamin, according to the records of their clans and families, counting the names of all those twenty years of age or older who could serve in the army,
ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rwa Benjamini bakariikwa, omonto ase omonto, ase chiamate chiabo ne chinyomba chiabo. Abanto bonsi abasacha, aba konya bakoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, abwo baare konyara korwana esegi,
swahili: Kutoka wazao wa Benyamini: Wanaume wote waliokuwa na miaka ishirini au zaidi ambao waliweza kutumika katika jeshi waliorodheshwa kwa majina, kufuatana na kumbukumbu za koo zao na jamaa zao.

english: those registered to the tribe of Benjamin numbered 35,400.
ekegusii: nigo barenge chilifu emerongo etato naisano, n’amagana ane (35,400).
swahili: Idadi kutoka kabila la Benyamini walikuwa watu 35,400.

english: From the sons of Dan, according to the records of their clans and families, counting the names of all those twenty years of age or older who could serve in the army,
ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rwa Dani bakariikwa, omonto ase omonto, ase chiamate chiabo ne chinyomba chiabo. Abanto bonsi abasacha, aba konya bakoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, abwo baare konyara korwana esegi,
swahili: Kutoka wazao wa Dani: Wanaume wote waliokuwa na miaka ishirini au zaidi ambao waliweza kutumika katika jeshi waliorodheshwa kwa majina, kufuatana na kumbukumbu za koo zao na jamaa zao.

english: those registered to the tribe of Dan numbered 62,700.
ekegusii: nigo barenge chilifu emerongo etano nomo naibere, n’amagana atano n’abere (62,700).
swahili: Idadi kutoka kabila la Dani walikuwa watu 62,700.

english: And one man from each tribe, the head of each family, must be there with you. The Leaders of the Tribes
ekegusii: Naende mochore korwa ase kera egesaku omonto oyomo ore omoteneneri obo. Barabwo babe amo nainwe ase okobakonya.
swahili: Mwanaume mmoja kutoka kila kabila, kila aliye kiongozi wa jamaa yake, atawasaidia.

english: From the sons of Asher, according to the records of their clans and families, counting the names of all those twenty years of age or older who could serve in the army,
ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rw’Aseri bakariikwa, omonto ase omonto, ase chiamate chiabo ne chinyomba chiabo. Abanto bonsi abasacha, aba konya bakoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, abwo baare konyara korwana esegi,
swahili: Kutoka wazao wa Asheri: Wanaume wote waliokuwa na miaka ishirini au zaidi ambao waliweza kutumika katika jeshi waliorodheshwa kwa majina, kufuatana na kumbukumbu za koo zao na jamaa zao.

english: those registered to the tribe of Asher numbered 41,500.
ekegusii: nigo barenge chilifu emerongo ene nomo, n’amagana atano (41,500).
swahili: Idadi kutoka kabila la Asheri walikuwa watu 41,500.

english: From the sons of Naphtali, according to the records of their clans and families, counting the names of all those twenty years of age or older who could serve in the army,
ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rwa Nafutali bakariikwa, omonto ase omonto, ase chiamate chiabo ne chinyomba chiabo. Abanto bonsi abasacha, aba konya bakoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, abwo baare konyara korwana esegi,
swahili: Kutoka wazao wa Naftali: Wanaume wote waliokuwa na miaka ishirini au zaidi ambao waliweza kutumika katika jeshi waliorodheshwa kwa majina, kufuatana na kumbukumbu za koo zao na jamaa zao.

english: those registered to the tribe of Naphtali numbered 53,400.
ekegusii: nigo barenge chilifu emerongo etano naisato, n’amagana ane (53,400).
swahili: Idadi kutoka kabila la Naftali walikuwa watu 53,400.

english: These were the men numbered by Moses and Aaron, with the assistance of the twelve leaders of Israel, each one representing his family.
ekegusii: Aba nabwo barigetwe na Musa, na Aroni, na abatang’ani b’Abaisraeli ikomi na babere, abatenenerete kera oyomo egesaku kiaye.
swahili: Hawa walikuwa wanaume waliohesabiwa na Mose, Aroni na viongozi kumi na wawili wa Israeli, kila mmoja akiwakilisha jamaa yake.

english: So all the Israelites twenty years of age or older who could serve in Israel’s army were counted according to their families.
ekegusii: Abaisraeli bonsi abarigetwe, enyomba ase enyomba, baria konya bakoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, naende baare konyara korwana esegi,
swahili: Wanaume wote Waisraeli waliokuwa na miaka ishirini au zaidi ambao waliweza kutumika katika jeshi la Israeli walihesabiwa kufuatana na jamaa zao.

english: And all those counted totaled 603,550. The Exemption of the Levites
ekegusii: nigo barenge chilifu amagana atano nomo na isato, n’amagana atano, namerongo etano (603,550).
swahili: Jumla ya hesabu yao ilikuwa watu 603,550.

english: The Levites, however, were not numbered along with them by the tribe of their fathers.
ekegusii: Korende abanto b’ororeria rwa Lawi, barabwo tibaabaretwe amo n’abanto abwo bande,
swahili: Hata hivyo, jamaa ya kabila la Lawi hawakuhesabiwa pamoja na wengine.

english: For the LORD had said to Moses:
ekegusii: ekiagera Omonene nigo atebeetie Musa,
swahili: Bwana alikuwa amemwambia Mose:

english: “Do not number the tribe of Levi in the census with the other Israelites.
ekegusii: “Abanto b’egesaku kia Lawi tobaabara amo n’Abaisraeli bande.
swahili: “Kamwe usihesabu kabila la Lawi wala kuwaweka pamoja katika hesabu ya Waisraeli wengine.

english: These are the names of the men who are to assist you: From the tribe of Reuben, Elizur son of Shedeur;
ekegusii: Amarieta y’ abanto abwo naro aya: Korwa ase egesaku kia Rubeni, Elisuri, mosinto o Sedeuri.
swahili: Haya ndiyo majina ya wanaume watakaowasaidia: “kutoka Reubeni, ni Elisuri mwana wa Shedeuri;

english: Instead, you are to appoint the Levites over the tabernacle of the Testimony, all its furnishings, and everything in it. They shall carry the tabernacle and all its articles, care for it, and camp around it.
ekegusii: Obeeke Abalawi babe bakorenda Obomenyo Obochenu obwo bore noborori, naende babe bakorenda ebinto bire ase Obomenyo boria ime, na ebikorero biaye. ’Nababe bakobobogoria amo n’ebinto biaye bionsi, na gokora emeremo imeo. Barabwo nigo baratenenie chiema chiabo chi’okomenya chietanane Obomenyo obwo.
swahili: Badala yake, waweke Walawi kuwa viongozi wa Maskani ya Ushuhuda, juu ya samani zake na kila kitu kilichomo ndani yake. Wao watabeba Maskani na samani zake zote; wataitunza na kupiga kambi kuizunguka.

english: Whenever the tabernacle is to move, the Levites are to take it down, and whenever it is to be pitched, the Levites are to set it up. Any outsider who goes near it must be put to death.
ekegusii: Ekero Obomenyo obwo boraabe bokong’anyigwa, Abalawi nabwo barabosimore, na ekero boraabe bogotenenigwa naende, nabwo barabotenenie aase agwo. Omonto onde bwensi otachikiri aise goika ang’e n’Obomenyo obwo goika aitwe akwe.
swahili: Wakati wowote Maskani inapohamishwa, Walawi wataifungua, na wakati wowote maskani inapotakiwa kusimamishwa, Walawi watafanya kazi hiyo. Mtu yeyote mwingine ambaye atasogea karibu nayo atauawa.

english: The Israelites are to camp by their divisions, each man in his own camp and under his own standard.
ekegusii: Abaisraeli bande nabatenenie chiema chiabo, kera egesaku ase egetwori kiaye, na kera omonto abeere inse y’ebendera yaye, ase ekeombe kiaye.
swahili: Waisraeli watapiga mahema yao kwa makundi makundi, kila mwanaume katika kambi yake mwenyewe chini ya bendera yake.

english: But the Levites are to camp around the tabernacle of the Testimony and watch over it, so that no wrath will fall on the congregation of Israel. So the Levites are responsible for the tabernacle of the Testimony.”
ekegusii: Korende Abalawi nigo baratenenie chiema chiabo chietanane Obomenyo obwo bore noborori, na komenyao, erinde endamwamu yane etangwe tebaisa kogwera omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli. Abalawi barende Obomenyo obwo bore noborori.”
swahili: Hata hivyo, Walawi watapiga mahema yao kuzunguka Maskani ya Ushuhuda ili ghadhabu isiipate jumuiya ya Waisraeli. Walawi watawajibika kwa utunzaji wa Maskani ya Ushuhuda.”

english: Thus the Israelites did everything just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
ekegusii: Abaisraeli bagakora onsi buna Omonene abachiigete goetera ase Musa.
swahili: Waisraeli walifanya yote haya sawasawa kama Bwana alivyomwamuru Mose.

english: from Simeon, Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai;
ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku gia Simioni, Selumieli, mosinto o Surisadai.
swahili: kutoka Simeoni, ni Shelumieli mwana wa Surishadai;

english: from Judah, Nahshon son of Amminadab;
ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku kia Yuda, Nahasoni, mosinto bw’Aminadabu.
swahili: kutoka Yuda, ni Nashoni mwana wa Aminadabu;

english: from Issachar, Nethanel son of Zuar;
ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku gia Isakaru, Netaneli, mosinto o Suari.
swahili: kutoka Isakari, ni Nethaneli mwana wa Suari;

english: from Zebulun, Eliab son of Helon;
ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku gia Sabuloni, Eliabu, mosinto o Heloni.
swahili: kutoka Zabuloni, ni Eliabu mwana wa Heloni;

english: In the first month, the whole congregation of Israel entered the Wilderness of Zin and stayed in Kadesh. There Miriam died and was buried.
ekegusii: Ase omotienyi bw’eritang’ani omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli ogaika ase erooro ya Sini na gotoora agwo Kadeshi. Miriamu agakwana agatindekwa aroro.
swahili: Katika mwezi wa kwanza jumuiya yote ya Kiisraeli ilifika kwenye Jangwa la Sini, nao wakakaa Kadeshi. Miriamu akafa huko na kuzikwa.

english: Then Moses and Aaron gathered the assembly in front of the rock, and Moses said to them, “Listen now, you rebels, must we bring you water out of this rock?”
ekegusii: Musa na Aroni bagasangereria omoganda bwonsi bosio bw’egetare keria, akabateebia, “Igwa inwe abasaria aba! Inee! ’Nkobasokeria tore amaache korwa ase egetare eke?”
swahili: Mose na Aroni wakakusanya kusanyiko pamoja mbele ya huo mwamba, naye Mose akawaambia, “Sikilizeni, enyi waasi. Je, ni lazima tuwatoleeni maji kutoka mwamba huu?”

english: Then Moses raised his hand and struck the rock twice with his staff, so that a great amount of water gushed out, and the congregation and their livestock were able to drink.
ekegusii: Musa akarambora okoboko kwaye, agaaka egetare keria nenyimbo yaye ara kabere. Amaache agasoka amaange mono, na omoganda oria okanywa ne chitugo chiabo chikayanywa boigo.
swahili: Ndipo Mose akainua mkono wake na kuupiga mwamba mara mbili kwa fimbo yake. Maji yakabubujika, nayo jumuiya na mifugo yao wakanywa.

english: But the LORD said to Moses and Aaron, “Because you did not trust Me to show My holiness in the sight of the Israelites, you will not bring this assembly into the land that I have given them.”
ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa na Aroni, “Ekiagera inwe motanyegenete na koorokia ase amasio y’Abaisraeli ng’a inche nomochenu inde, timokoraa na goikia omosangererekano oyio ase ense eria ebe eyabo.
swahili: Lakini Bwana akamwambia Mose na Aroni, “Kwa sababu hamkuniamini mimi kiasi cha kuniheshimu kama mtakatifu machoni pa Waisraeli, hamtaiingiza jumuiya hii katika nchi ninayowapa.”

english: These were the waters of Meribah, where the Israelites quarreled with the LORD, and He showed His holiness among them. Edom Refuses Passage
ekegusii: Aya naro amaache a Meriba aase Abaisraeli baamereranetie n’Omonene, na ere akeorokia ng’a nomochenu are ase egati yabo.” Omorwoti o Edomu okwanga koa Abaisraeli ribaga goeta ase ense yaye
swahili: Haya yalikuwa maji ya Meriba, mahali pale ambapo Waisraeli waligombana na Bwana, naye akajionyesha mwenyewe huko kuwa mtakatifu katikati yao. Edomu Wakatalia Israeli Kupita

english: From Kadesh, Moses sent messengers to tell the king of Edom, “This is what your brother Israel says: You know all the hardship that has befallen us,
ekegusii: Musa agatoma abanto korwa Kadeshi gochia ase omorwoti o Edomu bamoteebie, “Amang’ana aya naro intwe Abaisraeli bamino togoteeba: Nomanyete emechando yonsi yatonyorire,
swahili: Mose akawatuma wajumbe kutoka Kadeshi kwenda kwa mfalme wa Edomu, akisema: “Hili ndilo ndugu yako Israeli asemalo: Wewe unafahamu juu ya taabu zote ambazo zimetupata.

english: how our fathers went down to Egypt, where we lived many years. The Egyptians mistreated us and our fathers,
ekegusii: buna chisokoro chiaito chiagendete ase ense ya Misiri, chikamenyao emiaka emenge. Abamisiri bagachichanda ase obotindi obobe, bagatochanda naintwe.
swahili: Baba zetu walishuka Misri, nasi tumeishi huko miaka mingi. Wamisri walitutesa sisi na baba zetu,

english: and when we cried out to the LORD, He heard our voice, sent an angel, and brought us out of Egypt. Now look, we are in Kadesh, a city on the edge of your territory.
ekegusii: Ekero twarerete ase Omonene, ere akaigwa ebirero biaito, agatoma omomalaika agatorusia korwa ase ense ya Misiri. Bono nao tore aiga Kadeshi, omochie ore ase orobebe kegima rw’orogongo rwao.
swahili: lakini tulipomlilia Bwana, alisikia kilio chetu na akamtuma malaika akatutoa Misri. “Sasa tupo hapa Kadeshi, mji ulio mpakani mwa nchi yako.

english: Please let us pass through your land. We will not cut through any field or vineyard, or drink water from any well. We will stay on the King’s Highway; we will not turn to the right or to the left until we have passed through your territory.”
ekegusii: Koranche otoe ribaga toete ase egati y’ense yao. Titokogobera gochia ase emegondo y’endagera, gose ey’emesabibu, gose titokonywa amaache korwa ase chinsoko chiaino. Intwe nigo toraete ase enchera enene yoka, titokogobera gochia ensemo ya borio, gose eya bomosi, goika tobe twaetanirie orogongo rwao.”
swahili: Tafadhali turuhusu tupite katika nchi yako. Hatutapita katika shamba lolote, wala shamba la mizabibu, au kunywa maji kutoka kwenye kisima chochote. Tutasafiri kufuata njia kuu ya mfalme, na hatutageuka kulia wala kushoto mpaka tuwe tumeshapita nchi yako.”

english: But Edom answered, “You may not travel through our land, or we will come out and confront you with the sword.”
ekegusii: Korende omorwoti o Edomu akamoiraneria, “Timobaisa goeta ase egati y’ense y’ane; moise goeta, nigo ndabarwanie esegi imbaite nemioro.”
swahili: Lakini mfalme wa Edomu akajibu: “Hamtapita hapa; kama mkijaribu kupita, tutatoka na kuwashambulia kwa upanga.”

english: “We will stay on the main road,” the Israelites replied, “and if we or our herds drink your water, we will pay for it. There will be no problem; only let us pass through on foot.”
ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakamoteebia, “Intwe nigo toraete ase enchera enene yoka, na gatoranywe amaache ao, intwe gose chitugo chiaito, rirorio ’natoakane amaache ayio. Toe ribaga toete rioka namagoro, titokogania gento kende goetania ekio.”
swahili: Waisraeli wakajibu: “Sisi tutafuata njia kuu; tena ikiwa sisi au mifugo yetu tutakunywa tone la maji yenu, tutalilipia. Sisi tunataka tu kupita kwa miguu, wala si kitu kingine chochote.”

english: Now there was no water for the congregation, so they gathered against Moses and Aaron.
ekegusii: Amaache tarenge agwo ase batoorete; ase ayio omoganda ogasangererekana amo, okaba mamincha ya Musa na Aroni.
swahili: Mahali hapo hapakuwa na maji kwa ajili ya jumuiya hiyo, nao wakakusanyika ili kumpinga Mose na Aroni.

english: But Edom insisted, “You may not pass through.” And they came out to confront the Israelites with a large army and a strong hand.
ekegusii: Abaedomu bakairaneria naende, “Timori ne ribaga goeta ase ense yaito.” Bagacha nabarwani barenge ne chinguru gocha korwania Abaisraeli.
swahili: Watu wa Edomu wakajibu tena: “Hamwezi kupita hapa.” Ndipo watu wa Edomu wakatoka dhidi ya Waisraeli, jeshi kubwa lenye nguvu.

english: So Edom refused to allow Israel to pass through their territory, and Israel turned away from them. The Death of Aaron
ekegusii: Ekiagera Abaedomu barinete Abaisraeli ribaga goeta ase ense yabo, Abaisraeli bakarua ase bare, bagaeta ensemo eng’ao. Aroni Ogokwa
swahili: Kwa kuwa Waedomu waliwakatalia Waisraeli kupita katika nchi yao, Israeli wakageuka, wakawaacha. Kifo Cha Aroni

english: After they had set out from Kadesh, the whole congregation of Israel came to Mount Hor.
ekegusii: Omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli okarua Kadeshi, okageenda ogaika egetunwa kia Hori.
swahili: Jumuiya yote ya Kiisraeli ikaondoka kutoka Kadeshi, wakafika kwenye Mlima Hori.

english: And at Mount Hor, near the border of the land of Edom, the LORD said to Moses and Aaron,
ekegusii: Agwo ase egetunwa keria kia Hori, ase orobebe rw’ense ya Edomu, Omonene agakwana na Musa na Aroni, akabateebia,
swahili: Kwenye Mlima Hori, karibu na mpaka wa Edomu, Bwana akamwambia Mose na Aroni,

english: “Aaron will be gathered to his people; he will not enter the land that I have given the Israelites, because both of you rebelled against My command at the waters of Meribah.
ekegusii: “Aroni nakwe, asangererekane amo n’abanto baye. Ere tagosoa ase ense eria naeire Abaisraeli, ekiagera inwe babere mwasaretie, timwanyigwera buna nabachiigete agwo ase amaache a Meriba.
swahili: “Aroni atakusanywa pamoja na watu wake. Hataingia katika nchi ninayowapa Waisraeli, kwa sababu ninyi wawili mliasi dhidi ya agizo langu kwenye maji ya Meriba.

english: Take Aaron and his son Eleazar and bring them up Mount Hor.
ekegusii: Ira Aroni na Eleazari, momura oye, igoro ase egetunwa kia Hori.
swahili: Watwae Aroni na Eleazari mwanawe, na uwapandishe juu katika Mlima wa Hori.

english: Remove Aaron’s priestly garments and put them on his son Eleazar. Aaron will be gathered to his people and will die there.”
ekegusii: Orusie Aroni chianga chiaye chi’obokuani, ochibekere Eleazari, momura oye. Aroni ere ’nakwe, na asangererekane amo n’abanto baye, ekero more aaria.”
swahili: Mvue Aroni mavazi yake, na umvike Eleazari mwanawe, kwa maana Aroni atakusanywa pamoja na watu wake; atakufa huko.”

english: So Moses did as the LORD had commanded, and they climbed Mount Hor in the sight of the whole congregation.
ekegusii: Musa agakora buna Omonene amochiigete. Barabwo bagatiira gochia igoro as egetunwa keria kia Hori, ekero omoganda bwonsi origereretie.
swahili: Mose akafanya kama Bwana alivyomwagiza: Wakapanda Mlima Hori mbele ya macho ya jumuiya yote ya Kiisraeli.

english: After Moses had removed Aaron’s garments and put them on his son Eleazar, Aaron died there on top of the mountain. Then Moses and Eleazar came down from the mountain.
ekegusii: Musa akarusia Aroni chianga chiria chi’obokuani, agachibekera Eleazari, momura o Aroni. Aroni agakwera ase egetunwa keria, na Musa na Eleazari bagatirimboka korwao.
swahili: Mose akamvua Aroni mavazi yake na kumvika mwanawe Eleazari mavazi hayo. Naye Aroni akafia pale juu ya mlima. Kisha Mose na Eleazari wakateremka kutoka mlimani.

english: When the whole congregation saw that Aaron had died, the entire house of Israel mourned for him thirty days.
ekegusii: Ekero omoganda bw’Abaisraeli orooche ng’a Aroni okuure bakamoreera ase engaki y’amatuko emerongo etato.
swahili: Jumuiya yote ilipofahamu kwamba Aroni amekufa, jamaa yote ya Kiisraeli wakamwomboleza kwa siku thelathini.

english: The people quarreled with Moses and said, “If only we had perished with our brothers before the LORD!
ekegusii: Abanto baria bakaamerererania na Musa, bagakwana, “Nanga nigo yabeete buya kobua onye naintwe ’ntwakwete ekero abaminto baitetwe agwo ase obosio bw’Omonene.
swahili: Watu wakagombana na Mose, na kusema, “Laiti tungelikufa wakati ndugu zetu walipoanguka na kufa mbele za Bwana!

english: Why have you brought the LORD’s assembly into this wilderness for us and our livestock to die here?
ekegusii: Ninki mwatwegegeretie intwe omoganda Omonene gocha ase erooro eye, erio toche gokwera aiga, amo ne chitugo chiaito?
swahili: Kwa nini mmeileta jumuiya ya Bwana kwenye jangwa hili, ili tufe humu, sisi na mifugo yetu?

english: Why have you led us up out of Egypt to bring us to this wretched place? It is not a place of grain, figs, vines, or pomegranates—and there is no water to drink!”
ekegusii: Ninki mwatorusetie Misiri gocha ense eye yamakweri? Aase aa ataka atari kwama endagera, gose amako, gose amasabibu, gose amakomomanga. Nonya namaache tokonywa tari aa.”
swahili: Kwa nini mmetupandisha kutoka Misri mpaka mahali hapa pa kutisha? Hapa hakuna nafaka wala tini, zabibu au makomamanga. Wala hapa hakuna maji ya kunywa!”

english: Then Moses and Aaron went from the presence of the assembly to the entrance to the Tent of Meeting. They fell facedown, and the glory of the LORD appeared to them.
ekegusii: Musa na Aroni bakarua agwo ase omoganda oria, bakageenda ase Eema y’Omosangererekano, bagatung’ama inse bakaumama agwo ase egesoero. Erio obonene bw’Omonene bokabaorokera.
swahili: Mose na Aroni wakaondoka pale kwenye kusanyiko mpaka kwenye mlango wa Hema la Kukutania na kuanguka kifudifudi, nao utukufu wa Bwana ukawatokea.

english: “Take the staff and assemble the congregation. You and your brother Aaron are to speak to the rock while they watch, and it will pour out its water. You will bring out water from the rock and provide drink for the congregation and their livestock.”
ekegusii: “Imokia enyimbo eria, erio aye na Aroni mosangererie omoganda bwonsi, na agwo ase amasio y’ abanto bonsi mokwane negetare keria, na amaache ’nasoke korwa aroro. Ase enchera eyio ’mosokerie abanto amaache yokonywa, ne chitugo chiabo ’nchiyanywe.”
swahili: “Chukua ile fimbo, na wewe na ndugu yako Aroni mkusanye kusanyiko pamoja. Nena na ule mwamba mbele ya macho yao, nao utatoa maji yake. Utatoa maji kutoka huo mwamba kwa ajili ya jumuiya ili wao na mifugo yao waweze kunywa.”

english: So Moses took the staff from the LORD’s presence, just as he had been commanded.
ekegusii: Musa akaimokia enyimbo eria korwa aase yarenge, agwo ase obosio bw’Omonene, buna Omonene konya amochiikire.
swahili: Kwa hiyo Mose akaichukua hiyo fimbo kutoka pale ilipokuwa mbele za Bwana kama alivyomwagiza.

english: When the Canaanite king of Arad, who lived in the Negev, heard that Israel was coming along the road to Atharim, he attacked Israel and captured some prisoners.
ekegusii: Ekero omorwoti oyomo Omokaanani, oyorenge kogaamba agwo Aradi, ensemo ya Irianyi ase ense ya Kaanani, aigwete ng’a Abaisraeli nigo bare ase enchera ekogeenda Atarimu, akabaumokera, akabarwania, na agoosa abande babo.
swahili: Mfalme wa Kikanaani wa Aradi aliyeishi huko Negebu aliposikia kwamba Waisraeli walikuwa wanakuja kwa njia ya Atharimu, aliwashambulia Waisraeli na kuwateka baadhi yao.

english: Then the Israelites set out and camped at Oboth.
ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakaimoka kogeenda orogeendo rwabo, bagaika Oboti, bagatoora aroro.
swahili: Waisraeli waliendelea na safari yao na wakapiga kambi huko Obothi.

english: They journeyed from Oboth and camped at Iye-abarim in the wilderness opposite Moab to the east.
ekegusii: Naende bakarua agwo Oboti, bakageenda bagaika Iye‐Abarimu, agwo ase erooro ere moocha ya Moabu, bagatoora aroro.
swahili: Kisha wakaondoka Obothi na kupiga kambi huko Iye-Abarimu, katika jangwa linalotazamana na Moabu kuelekea mawio ya jua.

english: From there they set out and camped in the Valley of Zered.
ekegusii: Na korwa aroro bakageenda bagaika ase Rikura ria Seredi, bagatoora aroro.
swahili: Kutoka hapo waliendelea mbele wakapiga kambi kwenye Bonde la Zeredi.

english: From there they moved on and camped on the other side of the Arnon, in the wilderness that extends into the Amorite territory. Now the Arnon is the border between the Moabites and the Amorites.
ekegusii: Magega y’ayio bakaimoka korwa Seredi, bakageenda bagatoora sugusu y’orooche rw’Arinoni, ase erooro eria eigete orobebe rw’Abaamori. Arinoni nigo rware orobebe gati y’Abamoabu na Abaamori.
swahili: Wakasafiri kutoka hapo na kupiga kambi kando ya Mto Arnoni, ambao uko katika jangwa lililoenea hadi nchi ya Waamori. Arnoni ni mpaka wa Moabu, kati ya Moabu na Waamori.

english: Therefore it is stated in the Book of the Wars of the LORD: “Waheb in Suphah and the wadis of the Arnon,
ekegusii: Aya naro akogera “Egetabu gi’echisegi chi’Omonene” yakwana igoro ya “Omochie bw’Abahebu ase orogongo rwa Sufa, na amakura ase orooche rw’Arinoni rogoeta,
swahili: Ndiyo sababu Kitabu cha Vita vya Bwana kinasema: “…Mji wa Wahebu nchini Seifa na mabonde ya Arnoni,

english: even the slopes of the wadis that extend to the site of Ar and lie along the border of Moab.”
ekegusii: na egetirimboko ki’amakura, aase omochie bw’Ari ore, na gochia orobebe rwa Moabu.”
swahili: na miteremko ya mabonde inayofika hadi mji wa Ari na huelekea mpakani mwa Moabu.”

english: From there they went on to Beer, the well where the LORD said to Moses, “Gather the people so that I may give them water.”
ekegusii: Na korwa ase Arinoni bakagenderera n’orogeendo rwabo, bagaika Beeri. Eyio nensoko eria aase Omonene atebeetie Musa, “Sangereria abanto, na inche nimbae amaache banywe.”
swahili: Kutoka hapo waliendelea mbele hadi kisima cha Beeri; kwenye kisima ambacho Bwana alimwambia Mose, “Wakusanye watu pamoja, nami nitawapa maji.”

english: Then Israel sang this song: “Spring up, O well, all of you sing to it!
ekegusii: Erio Abaisraeli bagatera ogoteera oko: “Chinsoko, sokia amaache acharaare gocha, naintwe togoke na goteera ase amaache ayio.
swahili: Kisha Israeli akaimba wimbo huu: “Bubujika, ee kisima! Imba kuhusu maji,

english: The princes dug the well; the nobles of the people hollowed it out with their scepters and with their staffs.” From the wilderness the Israelites went on to Mattanah,
ekegusii: Chinsoko abanene baremete, echio chiaremetwe nenyimbo y’omogaambi, ne chinyimbo chiabo chi’ogotaarera.” Korwa agwo ase erooro bakageenda bagaika Matana,
swahili: kuhusu kisima ambacho kilichimbwa na wakuu, ambacho watu mashuhuri walikifukua, watu mashuhuri wakiwa na fimbo za utawala na bakora.” Kisha wakatoka jangwani kwenda Matana,

english: and from Mattanah to Nahaliel, and from Nahaliel to Bamoth,
ekegusii: na korwa Matana bakageenda bagaika Nahalieli, na korwa agwo bakageenda bagaika Bamoti.
swahili: kutoka Matana wakafika Nahalieli, kutoka Nahalieli wakafika Bamothi,

english: So Israel made a vow to the LORD: “If You will deliver this people into our hands, we will devote their cities to destruction. ”
ekegusii: Erio Abaisraeli bakariera Omonene eira, bakaboora, “Aye koraabeeke abanto aba ase amaboko aito, intwe natosirie emechie yabo kegima.”
swahili: Ndipo Israeli akaweka nadhiri hii kwa Bwana: “Ikiwa utawatia watu hawa mikononi mwetu, tutaiangamiza kabisa miji yao.”

english: and from Bamoth to the valley in Moab where the top of Pisgah overlooks the wasteland. The Defeat of Sihon (Deuteronomy 2:24–37)
ekegusii: Bakarua Bamoti, bakageenda gochia ase rikura riarenge ase ense y’Abaamori, ase egetirimboko ki’egetunwa gia Pisiga, ekio kerochie maate ase erooro. Okobugwa Kw’abarwoti Sihoni na Ogi (Okoir 2:26; 3:11)
swahili: na kutoka Bamothi wakafika kwenye bonde lililoko Moabu, mahali ambapo kilele cha Pisga kinatazamana na nyika. Kushindwa Kwa Sihoni Na Ogu (Kumbukumbu 2:26–3:11)

english: Then Israel sent messengers to Sihon king of the Amorites, saying,
ekegusii: Korwa aroro agwo Abasiraeli bagatoma abanto ase Sihoni, omorwoti bw’Abaamori bakwane nere, bamoborie,
swahili: Israeli akawatuma wajumbe kumwambia Sihoni mfalme wa Waamori:

english: “Let us pass through your land. We will not cut through any field or vineyard, or drink water from any well. We will stay on the King’s Highway until we have passed through your territory.”
ekegusii: “Koranche, otoe ribaga toete ase egati y’ense yao. Titogotiga enchera na kogobera gochia ase emegondo y’endagera, gose ey’emesabibu, gose titokonywa amaache korwa ase chinsoko chiaino, korende nigo toraete ase enchera enene goika tobe twaetanirie ense yaino.”
swahili: “Uturuhusu tupite katika nchi yako. Hatutageuka kando kwenda katika mashamba au mashamba ya mizabibu, ama kunywa maji kutoka kisima chochote. Tutasafiri kwenye njia kuu ya mfalme hata tutakapokuwa tumekwisha kupita katika nchi yako.”

english: But Sihon would not let Israel pass through his territory. Instead, he gathered his whole army and went out to confront Israel in the wilderness. When he came to Jahaz, he fought against Israel.
ekegusii: Korende Sihoni akaanga koa Abaisraeli ribaga baete ase ense yaye. Agasangereria abarwani baye b’esegi, akageenda agaika Yahasi ase erooro, na agwo akarwania Abaisraeli.
swahili: Lakini Sihoni hakumruhusu Israeli apite katika nchi yake. Alilikutanisha jeshi lake lote, wakaondoka kwenda jangwani ili kupigana na Israeli. Alipofika huko Yahazi, akapigana na Israeli.

english: And Israel put him to the sword and took possession of his land, from the Arnon to the Jabbok—but only up to the border of the Ammonites, because it was fortified.
ekegusii: Korende Abaisraeli bagakenya abanto abange, bakaira ense ya Sihoni, korwa orooche rw’Arinoni goika orooche rwa Yaboki ase ense y’Abaamoni. Ribebe ri’Abaamoni nigo riarendire ne chinguru.
swahili: Hata hivyo, Israeli alimshinda kwa upanga na kuiteka ardhi yake kutoka Arnoni mpaka Yaboki, lakini ni hadi kufikia nchi ya Waamoni tu, kwa sababu mipaka yake ilikuwa imezungushwa ukuta.

english: Israel captured all the cities of the Amorites and occupied them, including Heshbon and all its villages.
ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakaira emechie yonsi y’Abaamori, bakaira na Hesiboni, erio bakamenya ase emechie amo nebichie bi’emechie eyio.
swahili: Israeli akaiteka miji yote ya Waamori na kuikalia, pamoja na Heshboni na makazi yote yanayoizunguka.

english: Heshbon was the city of Sihon king of the Amorites, who had fought against the former king of Moab and taken all his land as far as the Arnon.
ekegusii: Hesiboni n’oro orenge omochie omonene o Sihoni, omorwoti bw’Abaamori, oria konya orwanirie omorwoti orenge kogambera Abaamori agwo ritang’ani. Sihoni konya oirire ense yonsi y’omorwoti oyio goikera Arinoni.
swahili: Heshboni ulikuwa mji wa Sihoni mfalme wa Waamori, ambaye alikuwa amepigana dhidi ya mfalme wa Moabu aliyetangulia na akawa amechukua ardhi yake yote mpaka Arnoni.

english: That is why the poets say: “Come to Heshbon, let it be rebuilt; let the city of Sihon be restored.
ekegusii: Ayio naro akogera abateri be chingero bakobora: “Inchuo ase Hesiboni, tiga omochie oyo oagachwe, tiga omochie o Sihoni oagachwe na kogitwa.
swahili: Ndiyo sababu watunga mashairi husema: “Njoo Heshboni na ujengwe tena; mji wa Sihoni na ufanywe upya.

english: For a fire went out from Heshbon, a blaze from the city of Sihon. It consumed Ar of Moab, the rulers of Arnon’s heights.
ekegusii: Omorero okarua ase Hesiboni, chimeme chi’omorero korwa omochie o Sihoni, ogasaria Ari, omochie o Moabu, ogasamba abanene b’ebigoro bi’Arinoni.
swahili: “Moto uliwaka kutoka Heshboni, mwali wa moto kutoka mji wa Sihoni. Uliteketeza Ari ya Moabu, raiya wa mahali pa Arnoni palipoinuka.

english: Woe to you, O Moab! You are destroyed, O people of Chemosh! He gave up his sons as refugees, and his daughters into captivity to Sihon king of the Amorites.
ekegusii: Obobe nobwaino, inwe Abamoabu! Mwasirigwe, inwe abamogosasiima Kemosi! Nere otigire abana baino abamura bagotama, bakorigia aase bakwebisa, na abana baino abaiseke boosirwe, barabwo bairirwe ase Sihoni, omorwoti bw’Abaamori.
swahili: Ole wako, ee Moabu! Umeharibiwa, enyi watu wa Kemoshi! Amewatoa wanawe kuwa wakimbizi, na binti zake kama mateka kwa Mfalme Sihoni wa Waamori.

english: And the LORD heard Israel’s plea and delivered up the Canaanites. Israel devoted them and their cities to destruction; so they named the place Hormah. The Bronze Serpent
ekegusii: Omonene akaigwa ogosaba kw’Abaisraeli, akabaa obobui igoro y’Abakaanani. Abaisraeli bakabasiria kegima, bagasaria emechie yabo. Ase ogokora oko, aase aria akarokwa Horima. Eng’iti y’etai
swahili: Bwana akasikiliza ombi la Waisraeli, naye akawapa ushindi juu ya Wakanaani. Wakawaangamiza kabisa na miji yao; hivyo mahali pale pakaitwa Horma. Nyoka Wa Shaba

english: But we have overthrown them; Heshbon is destroyed as far as Dibon. We demolished them as far as Nophah, which reaches to Medeba. ” The Defeat of Og (Deuteronomy 3:1–11)
ekegusii: Intwe twabarasire chinsara; Abahesiboni basiriigwe, twabaitire goika Diboni. Tokabasiria goika Nofa na korwa Nofa goika Medeba.”
swahili: “Lakini tumewashinda; Heshboni umeharibiwa hadi Diboni. Tumebomoa hadi kufikia Nofa, ulioenea hadi Medeba.”

english: So Israel lived in the land of the Amorites.
ekegusii: Ase igo Abaisraeli bakamenya ase ense y’Abaamori.
swahili: Kwa hiyo Israeli akaishi katika nchi ya Waamori.

english: After Moses had sent spies to Jazer, Israel captured its villages and drove out the Amorites who were there.
ekegusii: Musa agatoma chirooti gochia koroota omochie o Yaeseri. Abaisraeli bakayorwania, bakayoira amo nebichie biaye, bakabang’anyia Abaamori bamenyeteo.
