swahili: Baada ya Mose kutuma wapelelezi kwenda mji wa Yazeri, Waisraeli waliteka viunga vya mji huo na kuwafukuza Waamori waliokuwa wanaishi huko.

english: Then they turned and went up the road to Bashan, and Og king of Bashan and his whole army came out to meet them in battle at Edrei.
ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakairana, bagaetera ase enchera yarenge kogeenda Basani. Ogi, omorwoti o Basani, agacha amo nabarwani baye korwania Abaisraeli agwo Edirei.
swahili: Kisha wakageuka na kwenda katika njia inayoelekea Bashani, naye Ogu mfalme wa Bashani pamoja na jeshi lake lote wakatoka kupigana nao huko Edrei.

english: But the LORD said to Moses, “Do not fear him, for I have delivered him into your hand, along with all his people and his land. Do to him as you did to Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived in Heshbon.”
ekegusii: Korende Omonene agateebia Musa, “Tobaisa komoiroka, ekiagera namobekire ase okoboko kwao, ere amo n’abanto baye bonsi, na ense yaye. Aye goika omokore buna gwakorete Sihoni, omorwoti bw’Abaamori, oria omenyete agwo Hesiboni.”
swahili: Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Usimwogope Ogu, kwa sababu nimeshamkabidhi mikononi mwako, pamoja na jeshi lake lote na nchi yake. Mtendee kama ulivyomtendea Sihoni mfalme wa Waamori, ambaye alitawala huko Heshboni.”

english: So they struck down Og, along with his sons and his whole army, until no remnant was left. And they took possession of his land.
ekegusii: Abaisraeli bagaita Ogi, bagaita nabana baye abamura, na abanto baye, goika tibatigaria nonya nomonto oyomo ore moyo. Erio bakayeira ense yaye ekaba eyabo.
swahili: Kwa hiyo wakamuua, pamoja na wanawe na jeshi lake lote, bila ya kumwacha hata mtu mmoja hai. Nao wakaimiliki nchi yake.

english: Then they set out from Mount Hor along the route to the Red Sea, in order to bypass the land of Edom. But the people grew impatient on the journey
ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakarua ase egetunwa keria kia Hori, bakageenda orogeendo rwabo, bagaetera enchera ekogeenda gochia omosomo bw’Enyancha Embariri, erio bachie goetanana ense ya Edomu. Abanto tibaaba abaremereria ase ogoeta enchera eria.
swahili: Waisraeli wakasafiri kutoka mlima Hori kupitia njia inayoelekea Bahari ya Shamu, kuizunguka Edomu. Lakini watu wakakosa uvumilivu njiani,

english: and spoke against God and against Moses: “Why have you led us up out of Egypt to die in the wilderness? There is no bread or water, and we detest this wretched food!”
ekegusii: Bakemurunganeria Nyasae na Musa, bakaboora, “Ninki mwatwegegeretie korwa ase ense ya Misiri mogatorenta toche gokwera aiga aase erooro? Aiga endagera na amaache tibiiyo, intwe twagechiigwe nendagera eye embe.”
swahili: wakamnungʼunikia Mungu na Mose, wakisema, “Kwa nini umetupandisha kutoka Misri ili tufe jangwani? Hakuna mkate! Hakuna maji! Nasi tunachukia sana chakula hiki duni!”

english: So the LORD sent venomous snakes among the people, and many of the Israelites were bitten and died.
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene agatoma ching’iti chingeenda inse chire nobosongo chigaacha ase egati y’Abaisraeli, chikabaroma, na abanto abange bagakwa.
swahili: Ndipo Bwana akapeleka nyoka wenye sumu katikati yao; wakawauma watu, nao Waisraeli wengi wakafa.

english: Then the people came to Moses and said, “We have sinned by speaking against the LORD and against you. Intercede with the LORD so He will take the snakes away from us.” So Moses interceded for the people.
ekegusii: Abanto bakageenda ase Musa, bakamoteebia, “Twakorire ebibe, ekiagera twakwanire mamincha y’Omonene na ase ore. Koranche osabe Omonene arusie ching’iti echi ase tore.” Ase ayio Musa akabasabera.
swahili: Watu wakamjia Mose na kusema, “Tumetenda dhambi wakati tuliponena dhidi ya Bwana na dhidi yako. Mwombe Bwana ili atuondolee hawa nyoka.” Hivyo Mose akawaombea hao watu.

english: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Make a fiery serpent and mount it on a pole. When anyone who is bitten looks at it, he will live.”
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene agateebia Musa, “Roisia omogwekano bw’eng’iti korwa ase etai, erio oyebeke igoro ase omote, erinde kera omonto oromirwe neng’iti kararigererie eng’iti eria nabe moyo.”
swahili: Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Tengeneza nyoka wa shaba na umweke juu ya mti; yeyote aliyeumwa na nyoka anaweza kumtazama na akaishi tena.”

english: So Moses made a bronze snake and mounted it on a pole. If anyone who was bitten looked at the bronze snake, he would live. The Journey to Moab
ekegusii: Musa akaroisia eng’iti y’etai, akayebeka igoro ase omote, na monto onde bwensi konya oromirwe neng’iti, onye orenge koyerigereria eng’iti eria, nigo arenge koba moyo. Ebitwori Gochakera Egetunwa kia Hori Goikeera Enyancha Enyomo Ya Moabu
swahili: Kwa hiyo Mose akatengeneza nyoka wa shaba na kumweka juu ya mti. Kisha wakati mtu yeyote aliumwa na nyoka, naye akamtazama yule nyoka wa shaba, aliishi. Safari Kwenda Moabu

english: Then the Israelites traveled on and camped in the plains of Moab near the Jordan, across from Jericho.
ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakagenderera norogeendo rwabo gochia ase enyancha enyomo ya Moabu, bagatoora aroro, moocha ya Yorodani, kororia Yeriko.
swahili: Kisha Waisraeli wakasafiri katika tambarare za Moabu na kupiga kambi kando ya Mto Yordani, ngʼambo ya Yeriko.

english: And Balaam said to God, “Balak son of Zippor, king of Moab, sent me this message:
ekegusii: Baalamu akamoiraneria, “Balaki, mosinto o Sipori, omorwoti o Moabu, nere otomire abanto aba ase ’nde, ogoteeba ng’a
swahili: Balaamu akamwambia Mungu, “Balaki mwana wa Sipori, mfalme wa Moabu, alinipelekea ujumbe huu:

english: ‘Behold, a people has come out of Egypt, and they cover the face of the land. Now come and put a curse on them for me. Perhaps I may be able to fight against them and drive them away.’”
ekegusii: abanto bachire korwa ase ense ya Misiri, na barabwo nigo bare abange, batubete orogongo rwonsi. Ere nigo aganetie imbaragererie, erinde abarwanie, ababue na kobaseria.”
swahili: ‘Taifa ambalo limekuja kutoka Misri limefunika uso wa nchi. Sasa uje unilaanie hao watu. Kisha huenda nitaweza kupigana nao na kuwafukuza.’ ”

english: But God said to Balaam, “Do not go with them. You are not to curse this people, for they are blessed.”
ekegusii: Nyasae akamoiraneria, “Tobaisa kogeenda amo nabarabwo gose gochia koragereria Abaisraeli. Barabwo nigo basesenirie.”
swahili: Lakini Bwana akamwambia Balaamu, “Usiende pamoja nao. Hupaswi kulaani watu hao, kwa kuwa wamebarikiwa.”

english: So Balaam got up the next morning and said to Balak’s princes, “Go back to your homeland, because the LORD has refused to let me go with you.”
ekegusii: Ase ayio Baalamu akaimoka mambia rituko ria kabere, agateebia abanene baria batometwe na Balaki, “Bono inwe irana mogende ase ense yaino, ekiagera Omonene bwangire kong’a ribaga ngende amo nainwe.”
swahili: Asubuhi iliyofuata Balaamu akaamka, akawaambia wakuu wa Balaki, “Rudini katika nchi yenu, kwa kuwa Bwana amenikataza nisiende pamoja nanyi.”

english: And the princes of Moab arose, returned to Balak, and said, “Balaam refused to come with us.”
ekegusii: Ase ayio, abanene baria ba Moabu bakaimoka bakageenda ase Balaki bakamoteebia, “Baalamu nigo aanga, tacheti amo naintwe.”
swahili: Kwa hiyo wakuu wa Moabu wakarudi kwa Balaki na kumwambia, “Balaamu amekataa kuja pamoja nasi.”

english: Then Balak sent other princes, more numerous and more distinguished than the first messengers.
ekegusii: Naende Balaki agatoma abanene bande, abange kobua baria b’eritang’ani, naende ababwate amasikani amanene kobua abwo.
swahili: Kisha Balaki akatuma wakuu wengine, wengi zaidi na wanaoheshimiwa zaidi kuliko wale wa kwanza.

english: They came to Balaam and said, “This is what Balak son of Zippor says: ‘Please let nothing hinder you from coming to me,
ekegusii: Nabarabwo bagaacha ase Baalamu, bakamoteebia, “Aya naro Balaki, mosinto o Sipori, agoteeba: Koranche totiga kende gionsi kegotange tochicha.
swahili: Wakafika kwa Balaamu na kumwambia: “Balaki mwana wa Sipori amesema hivi: Usiruhusu kitu chochote kikuzuie kuja kwangu,

english: for I will honor you richly and do whatever you say. So please come and put a curse on this people for me!’”
ekegusii: Ekeene, inche nigo ’ngochia kogokorera aya arakorentere amasikani amanene, naende kende gionsi oramborie, ekio ningokorere; aye inchwo ondagererie abanto aba.”
swahili: kwa sababu nitakulipa vizuri sana na kufanya lolote usemalo. Njoo unilaanie watu hawa.”

english: But Balaam replied to the servants of Balak, “If Balak were to give me his house full of silver and gold, I could not do anything small or great to go beyond the command of the LORD my God.
ekegusii: Korende Baalamu akairaneria abasomba baria ba Balaki, akabateebia, “Nonya Balaki arenge kong’a enyomba yaye eichire chifeta ne chitaabu, tintageti gosaria na kwanga koigwera amang’an’Omonene Nyasae anchiikire, na gokora amang’ana ande ase ogwancha kwane, abe amake gose amanene.
swahili: Lakini Balaamu akawajibu, “Hata kama Balaki angenipa jumba lake la kifalme likiwa limejazwa fedha na dhahabu, singeweza kufanya kitu chochote kikubwa au kidogo ili kutenda kitu nje ya agizo la Bwana Mungu wangu.

english: So now, please stay here overnight as the others did, that I may find out what else the LORD has to tell me.”
ekegusii: Nababoririe komoranche, mobeere aa ase obotuko bwa reero, erio imborie Omonene, imanye gose nabwate amang’ana ande aranteebie.”
swahili: Mlale hapa usiku huu kama wale wengine walivyofanya, nami nitatafuta ni nini kingine Bwana atakachoniambia.”

english: Now Balak son of Zippor saw all that Israel had done to the Amorites,
ekegusii: Omorwoti Balaki, mosinto o Sipori, akaigwa amang’ana onsi Abaisraeli konya bakoreire Abaamori.
swahili: Basi Balaki mwana wa Sipori, aliona mambo yale yote ambayo Israeli aliwatendea Waamori,

english: That night God came to Balaam and said, “Since these men have come to summon you, get up and go with them, but you must only do what I tell you.”
ekegusii: Naende Nyasae agacha ase Baalamu ase obotuko boria, akamoteebia, “Onye abanto aba bachire gokorangeria, imoka ogende amo nabarabwo, korende egento ndagochiike nakio gioka orakore.”
swahili: Usiku ule Bwana akamjia Balaamu na kumwambia, “Kwa kuwa watu hawa wamekuja kukuita wewe, nenda nao, lakini ufanye tu lile nitakalokuambia.” Punda Wa Balaamu

english: So in the morning Balaam got up, saddled his donkey, and went with the princes of Moab. The Angel and Balaam’s Donkey
ekegusii: Baalamu akaimoka mambia rituko ria kabere, akaberekia etigere yaye egeikaransero, akageenda amo nabanene baria ba Moabu. Baalamu Na Etigere Yaye
swahili: Balaamu akaamka asubuhi, akatandika punda wake akaenda pamoja na wakuu wa Moabu.

english: Then God’s anger was kindled because Balaam was going along, and the angel of the LORD stood in the road to oppose him. Balaam was riding his donkey, and his two servants were with him.
ekegusii: Ekero Baalamu aimogete kogeenda amo nabasomba baye babere oriinete etigere, Nyasae akaba nendamwamu enene ase are; na omomalaika Omonene agatenena ase enchera gati komotanga tageenda.
swahili: Lakini Mungu alikasirika sana alipokwenda, naye malaika wa Bwana akasimama barabarani kumpinga. Balaamu alikuwa amepanda punda wake, na watumishi wake wawili walikuwa pamoja naye.

english: When the donkey saw the angel of the LORD standing in the road with a drawn sword in his hand, she turned off the path and went into a field. So Balaam beat her to return her to the path.
ekegusii: Etigere eria egachia korora omomalaika oria obwate omoyio o birende koboko kwaye, ekagobera gochia enchera ensemo, ekageenda ase omogondo. Baalamu agaaka etigere eria koyeirania ase enchera.
swahili: Wakati punda alipomwona malaika wa Bwana akiwa amesimama barabarani akiwa na upanga uliofutwa mkononi mwake, punda akageukia upande kuelekea shambani. Balaamu akampiga ili amrudishe barabarani.

english: Then the angel of the LORD stood in a narrow passage between two vineyards, with walls on either side.
ekegusii: Naende omomalaika oria Omonene akageenda ase enchera yarenge engote gati y’emegondo y’emesabibu, ne chimbago nchiarenge ase chinsemo chionsi ibere.
swahili: Ndipo malaika wa Bwana akasimama katika njia nyembamba iliyo kati ya mashamba mawili ya mizabibu, yakiwa na kuta pande zote mbili.

english: And the donkey saw the angel of the LORD and pressed herself against the wall, crushing Balaam’s foot against it. So he beat her once again.
ekegusii: Etigere eria egachia korora omomalaika oria Omonene, ekemigereria gochia orobago ang’e, ekabwaterania okogoro kwa Baalamu ase orobago, na Baalamu akayeaka naende.
swahili: Punda alipomwona malaika wa Bwana, alijisukumiza karibu na ukuta, na kugandamiza mguu wa Balaamu ukutani. Ndipo Balaamu akampiga tena punda.

english: And the angel of the LORD moved on ahead and stood in a narrow place where there was no room to turn to the right or left.
ekegusii: Erio naende omomalaika Omonene akageenda bosio, agatenena aase aagote mono, ase ribaga ritarenge ri’okogobera gochia ensemo ya borio, gose eya bomosi.
swahili: Kisha malaika wa Bwana akaendelea mbele na kusimama mahali pembamba ambapo hapakuwepo nafasi ya kugeuka, upande wa kulia wala wa kushoto.

english: When the donkey saw the angel of the LORD, she lay down under Balaam, and he became furious and beat her with his staff.
ekegusii: Ekero etigere yarooche omomalaika oria, ekarara inse, na Baalamu oyeriinete mogongo igoro. Baalamu akaba nendamwamu enene mono, agaaka etigere eria nenyimbo yaye.
swahili: Punda alipomwona malaika wa Bwana, alilala chini Balaamu angali amempanda, naye Balaamu akakasirika na kumpiga kwa fimbo yake.

english: Then the LORD opened the donkey’s mouth, and she said to Balaam, “What have I done to you that you have beaten me these three times?”
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene agakunora omonwa bw’etigere eria goika egakwana, ekaboria Baalamu, “Ngento ki nagokoreire goika kwang’akire chintunda echi isato?”
swahili: Kisha Bwana akakifungua kinywa cha punda, akamwambia Balaamu, “Nimekutendea nini kinachokufanya unipige mara hizi tatu?”

english: Balaam answered the donkey, “You have made a fool of me! If I had a sword in my hand, I would kill you right now!”
ekegusii: Baalamu akayeiraneria, “Nekiagera gwankoreire echeche. Onye nabwate omoro ase okoboko kwane, nanga nigo narenge kogoita.”
swahili: Balaamu akamjibu punda, “Umenifanya mjinga! Kama ningelikuwa na upanga mkononi mwangu, ningelikuua sasa hivi.”

english: and Moab was terrified of the people because they were numerous. Indeed, Moab dreaded the Israelites.
ekegusii: Abamoabu bakoboa abanto abwo mono, ekiagera nigo barenge abange; ee Abamoabu bakabegosera Abaisraeli.
swahili: Moabu aliogopa, kwa kuwa walikuwepo watu wengi sana. Hakika, Moabu alijawa na hofu kubwa kwa sababu ya Waisraeli.

english: But the donkey said to Balaam, “Am I not the donkey you have ridden all your life until today? Have I ever treated you this way before?” “No,” he replied.
ekegusii: Naende etigere ekaboria Baalamu, “Inee! Inche tindi etigere yao, kwabeire gokondiina ase amatuko y’obogima bwao bwonsi goika rituko eri ria reero? Inee! Inche nana‐gokora egento buna eke ase ore?” Baalamu akairaneria, “Yaya.”
swahili: Punda akamwambia Balaamu, “Je, mimi si punda wako mwenyewe, ambaye umenipanda siku zote, hadi leo? Je, nimekuwa na tabia ya kufanya hivi kwako?” Akajibu, “Hapana.”

english: Then the LORD opened Balaam’s eyes, and he saw the angel of the LORD standing in the road with a drawn sword in his hand. And Balaam bowed low and fell facedown.
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene akaramokia Baalamu amaiso, na ere akarora omomalaika Omonene oteneine ase enchera gati, obwate omoyio o birende ase okoboko kwaye. Baalamu agekumba, agatung’ama inse, akaumama.
swahili: Kisha Bwana akafungua macho ya Balaamu, naye akamwona malaika wa Bwana amesimama barabarani akiwa ameufuta upanga wake. Balaamu akainama, akaanguka kifudifudi.

english: The angel of the LORD asked him, “Why have you beaten your donkey these three times? Behold, I have come out to oppose you, because your way is perverse before me.
ekegusii: Omomalaika Omonene akaboria Baalamu, “Nase ki gwaakire etigere yao chintunda echi isato? Rora, inche nigo nacha kogotanga, ekiagera orogeendo oro okogeenda norw’ogosaria rore mamincha yane.
swahili: Malaika wa Bwana akamuuliza Balaamu, “Kwa nini umempiga punda wako mara tatu hizi? Nimekuja kukuzuia kwa sababu njia yako imepotoka mbele yangu.

english: The donkey saw me and turned away from me these three times. If she had not turned away, then by now I would surely have killed you and let her live.”
ekegusii: Korende etigire ero yandora, nero yeonchora gochia enchera ensemo chintunda isato. Ekeene, onye etigere eye eteonchora gochia ensemo korwa asende, nanga nigo nagoita okwe, ntige etigere ere moyo.”
swahili: Punda aliniona na kunikwepa mara hizi tatu. Kama punda hangenikwepa, hakika ningekuwa nimeshakuua sasa, lakini ningemwacha punda hai.”

english: “I have sinned,” Balaam said to the angel of the LORD, “for I did not realize that you were standing in the road to confront me. And now, if this is displeasing in your sight, I will go back home.”
ekegusii: Erio Baalamu agateebia omomalaika Omonene, “Inche nakorire ebibe, tinamanyete ng’a naye gwateneine gati y’enchera gontanga. Korende bono onye orogeendo rokororekana ng’a norobe ase ore, tiga ing’irane.”
swahili: Balaamu akamwambia malaika wa Bwana, “Nimetenda dhambi. Sikutambua kuwa umesimama barabarani kunizuia. Basi kama haikupendezi, nitarudi.”

english: But the angel of the LORD said to Balaam, “Go with the men, but you are to speak only what I tell you.” So Balaam went with the princes of Balak.
ekegusii: Omomalaika Omonene agateebia Baalamu, “Genda amo n’abanto abwo, korende amang’ana aria ndagochike, naro oka ogochia gokwana.” Bono Baalamu akageenda amo nabanene baria ba Balaki. Balaki Okomoorotota Baalamu
swahili: Malaika wa Bwana akamwambia Balaamu, “Uende na watu hao, lakini useme tu lile nikuambialo.” Kwa hiyo Balaamu akaenda na wale wakuu wa Balaki.

english: When Balak heard that Balaam was coming, he went out to meet him at the Moabite city on the Arnon border, at the edge of his territory.
ekegusii: Ekero Balaki aigwete ng’a Baalamu inchera are gocha, akageenda komoorototera agwo Ari, omochie orenge ang’e norooche rw’Arinoni, ase orobebe rwa Moabu.
swahili: Balaki aliposikia kuwa Balaamu anakuja, akatoka kumlaki katika mji wa Moabu, katika mpaka wa Arnoni, ukingoni mwa nchi yake.

english: And he said to Balaam, “Did I not send you an urgent summons? Why did you not come to me? Am I really not able to richly reward you?”
ekegusii: Balaki akaboria Baalamu, “Inee! Naki otachete ekero natomete abanto gokorangeria? Nase ki otachete? Nigo gwakagete ng’a tingocha gokoa ogosika kogoisaine?”
swahili: Balaki akamwambia Balaamu, “Je, sikukupelekea jumbe za haraka? Kwa nini hukuja kwangu? Hivi kweli mimi siwezi kukulipa?”

english: “See, I have come to you,” Balaam replied, “but can I say just anything? I must speak only the word that God puts in my mouth.”
ekegusii: Baalamu akamoiraneria, “Rora, bono nachire ase ore, nigo okagete ng’a inche nimbwate okobua nonya nogoke gokwana ring’ana ase ore? Ring’ana riria Nyasae aranteebie nario ndakwane.”
swahili: Balaamu akajibu, “Vema, sasa nimekuja kwako. Lakini kwani nina uwezo wa kusema tu chochote? Ni lazima niseme tu kile ambacho Mungu ataweka kinywani mwangu.”

english: So Balaam accompanied Balak, and they came to Kiriath-huzoth.
ekegusii: Erio Baalamu akageenda amo na Balaki, bagaika Kiriati‐Husoti.
swahili: Kisha Balaamu alikwenda na Balaki mpaka Kiriath-Husothi.

english: So the Moabites said to the elders of Midian, “This horde will devour everything around us, as an ox licks up the grass of the field.” Since Balak son of Zippor was king of Moab at that time,
ekegusii: Abamoabu bagateebia abagaaka ba Midiani, “Omoganda oyo omonene nigo ogochia komena okoore kera egento getoetanaine aiga, buna chintang’ana chikomena obonyansi ase egetii chiabokoora.” Ase engaki eria Balaki, mosinto o Sipori, nere orenge omorwoti bw’Abamoabu.
swahili: Wamoabu wakawaambia wazee wa Midiani, “Umati huu wa watu unakwenda kuramba kila kitu kinachotuzunguka, kama maksai arambavyo majani ya shambani.” Kwa hiyo Balaki mwana wa Sipori, ambaye alikuwa mfalme wa Moabu wakati huo,

english: Balak sacrificed cattle and sheep, and he gave portions to Balaam and the princes who were with him.
ekegusii: Balaki akanyenya chiombe ne ching’ondi, akaa Baalamu amo nabanene barenge amo nere. Obobani Bw’eritang’ani Bwa Baalamu
swahili: Balaki akatoa dhabihu ya ngʼombe na kondoo; baadhi yake akampa Balaamu na wakuu waliokuwa pamoja naye.

english: The next morning, Balak took Balaam and brought him up to Bamoth-baal. From there he could see the outskirts of the camp of the people.
ekegusii: Rituko ria kabere mambia Balaki akaira Baalamu igoro ase Bamoti‐Baali, na korwa igoro agwo Baalamu akarora ensemo eyemo y’omoganda bw’Abaisraeli.
swahili: Asubuhi iliyofuata Balaki akamchukua Balaamu mpaka Bamoth-Baali, na kutoka huko Balaamu akawaona baadhi ya watu.

english: he sent messengers to Balaam son of Beor at Pethor, which is by the Euphrates in the land of his people. “Behold, a people has come out of Egypt,” said Balak. “They cover the face of the land and have settled next to me.
ekegusii: Ere agatoma abanto ase Baalamu, mosinto o Beori, agwo Petori ore ang’e norooche rw’Eufarati, ase ense yabo. Barabwo bakamoteebia amang’ana a Balaki. “Rigereria, abanto bachire korwa ase ense ya Misiri, nabarabwo nabange, batubete orogongo rwonsi, batoorire ang’e naintwe, barigereretie ense yane.
swahili: akatuma wajumbe kwenda kumwita Balaamu mwana wa Beori, ambaye alikuwa huko Pethori, karibu na Mto Frati, katika nchi yake ya kuzaliwa. Balaki akasema: “Taifa limekuja kutoka Misri, nao wamefunika uso wa nchi, nao wametua karibu nami.

english: So please come now and put a curse on this people, because they are too mighty for me. Perhaps I may be able to defeat them and drive them out of the land; for I know that those you bless are blessed, and those you curse are cursed.”
ekegusii: Bono inchwo obandagererie, ekiagera barabwo nigo bare ne chinguru chinyinge gotobua. Gokobaragereria, ande nabo ndabaise kobarwania mbabue na kobaseria, barabwo barue ase ense y’ane. Nimanyete ng’a oyo aye ogosesenia, nigo agoseseneka, na oyo aye okoragereria, nigo akoragerereka.”
swahili: Sasa uje kuwalaani watu hawa, kwa kuwa wana nguvu sana kuniliko. Kisha huenda nikaweza kuwashinda na kuwatoa nje ya nchi. Kwa kuwa ninajua kwamba, wale unaowabariki wanabarikiwa na wale unaowalaani wanalaaniwa.”

english: The elders of Moab and Midian departed with the fees for divination in hand. They came to Balaam and relayed to him the words of Balak.
ekegusii: Abagaaka ba Moabu na ab’Abamidiani bakabogoria eng’eria y’okoringoreria ase amaboko abo, bakayeirera Baalamu, bakamoteebia amang’ana onsi a Balaki.
swahili: Wazee wa Moabu na wa Midiani wakaondoka, wakiwa wamechukua ada ya uaguzi. Walipokwenda kwa Balaamu, wakamweleza kile Balaki alikuwa amesema.

english: “Spend the night here,” Balaam replied, “and I will give you the answer that the LORD speaks to me.” So the princes of Moab stayed with Balaam.
ekegusii: Baalamu agateebia abanto baria, “Rara aa ase obotuko obo, nainche nimbarentere amairanerio korwa ase Omonene ankio mambia.” Ase ayio abanene baria ba Moabu bakabeera aroro amo na Baalamu.
swahili: Balaamu akawaambia, “Mlale hapa usiku huu, nami nitawaletea jibu lile Bwana atakalonipa.” Kwa hiyo wakuu wa Moabu wakakaa naye.

english: Then God came to Balaam and asked, “Who are these men with you?”
ekegusii: Nyasae agacha ase Baalamu, akamobooria, “Abanto abamore komo mbarabi?”
swahili: Mungu akamjia Balaamu na kumuuliza, “Watu gani hawa walio pamoja nawe?”

english: Then Balaam said to Balak, “Build for me seven altars here, and prepare for me seven bulls and seven rams.”
ekegusii: Baalamu akamoteebia Balaki, “Ng’agachere aiga ebisasimero bitano na bibere, naende ondetere chieri isan’aibere, ne chimingichi isan’aibere.”
swahili: Balaamu akasema, “Nijengee hapa madhabahu saba, mnitayarishie mafahali saba na kondoo dume saba.”

english: Who can count the dust of Jacob or number even a fourth of Israel? Let me die the death of the righteous; let my end be like theirs!”
ekegusii: Ning’o oranyare kobara ororeria rwa Yakobo, abwo bare abange buna orotu rw’amaroba? Gose ning’o oranyare kobara nonya nenseemo ya inye y’Abaisraeli? Tiga inkwe buna oyomo bw’abanyene oboronge, na omoerio bw’amatuko ane obe buna oyoobo.”
swahili: Ni nani awezaye kuhesabu mavumbi ya Yakobo, au kuhesabu robo ya Israeli? Mimi na nife kifo cha mtu mwenye haki, na mwisho wangu na uwe kama wao!”

english: Then Balak said to Balaam, “What have you done to me? I brought you here to curse my enemies, and behold, you have only blessed them!”
ekegusii: Balaki akaboria Baalamu, “Ngento ki eke aye gwankoreire? Nigo nakorangeretie ng’a oche obaragererie ababisa bane, na rora, ribaga ri’ayio kwabasesenirie.”
swahili: Balaki akamwambia Balaamu, “Ni nini ulichonitendea? Nimekuleta ulaani adui zangu, lakini wewe badala yake umewabariki!”

english: But Balaam replied, “Should I not speak exactly what the LORD puts in my mouth?” Balaam’s Second Oracle
ekegusii: Baalamu akamoiraneria, “Inee! Tiyangwenerete inyigwere na gokwana amang’ana ari’Omonene agonteebia nkwane?” Obobani Bwa Kabere Bwa Baalamu
swahili: Balaamu akajibu, “Je, hainipasi kusema kile Bwana anachoweka katika kinywa changu?” Ujumbe Wa Pili Wa Balaamu

english: Then Balak said to him, “Please come with me to another place where you can see them. You will only see the outskirts of their camp—not all of them. And from there, curse them for me.”
ekegusii: Balaki akamoteebia, “Inchuo, togende amo naye goika aase ande aao. Korwa aroro nonyare korora abare ang’e. Tokorora bonsi. Korwa aase agwo nobandagererie.”
swahili: Ndipo Balaki akamwambia, “Twende pamoja mahali pengine ambapo unaweza kuwaona; utawaona baadhi tu wala si wote. Nawe kutoka huko, unilaanie hao.”

english: So Balak took him to the field of Zophim, to the top of Pisgah, where he built seven altars and offered a bull and a ram on each altar.
ekegusii: Akamoira goika ase omogondo o Sofimu agwo ase egechuria gia Pisiga. Agwo Balaki akaagacha ebisasimero bitano na bibere, akarua eeri eyemo na emingichi eyemo igoro ase kera egesasiimero.
swahili: Basi akampeleka kwenye shamba la Sofimu, juu ya kilele cha Mlima Pisga. Pale akajenga madhabahu saba na kutoa sadaka ya fahali na kondoo dume mmoja juu ya kila madhabahu.

english: Balaam said to Balak, “Stay here beside your burnt offering while I meet the LORD over there.”
ekegusii: Baalamu agateebia Balaki, “Beera aa, otenene ensemo y’ekeng’wanso kiao ki’ogosambwa inche ’ngende aaria ng’umbu, toumerane n’Omonene.”
swahili: Balaamu akamwambia Balaki, “Kaa hapa kando ya sadaka yako wakati ninapokwenda kuonana na Mungu kule.”

english: And the LORD met with Balaam and put a message in his mouth, saying, “Return to Balak and speak what I tell you.”
ekegusii: Omonene akamoorokera Baalamu, akamoteebia amang’ana arenge gochia gokwana, naende akamotoma airane ase Balaki namang’ana ayio ayio.
swahili: Bwana akakutana na Balaamu, akaweka ujumbe katika kinywa chake akasema, “Rudi kwa Balaki umpe ujumbe huu.”

english: So he returned to Balak, who was standing there by his burnt offering with the princes of Moab. “What did the LORD say?” Balak asked.
ekegusii: Baalamu akairana gochia ase Balaki, akamonyora oteneine mbarabare ase ekeng’wanso kiaye ki’ogosambwa, na abanene b’Abamoabu bateneine agwo amo nere. Balaki akamobooria, “Mang’ana ki Omonene akwanire?”
swahili: Basi Balaamu akarudi kwa Balaki, akamkuta amesimama kando ya sadaka yake, akiwa na wakuu wa Moabu. Balaki akamuuliza, “Je, Bwana amesema nini?”

english: Then Balaam lifted up an oracle, saying: “Arise, O Balak, and listen; give ear to me, O son of Zippor.
ekegusii: Baalamu agachaaka gokwana obobani bwaye, agateeba, “Inchuo aye Balaki, omwana o Sipori, ontegerere oigwe aya ’ngokwana!
swahili: Ndipo Balaamu akasema ujumbe wake: “Balaki, inuka na usikilize, nisikie mimi, wewe mwana wa Sipori.

english: God is not a man, that He should lie, or a son of man, that He should change His mind. Does He speak and not act? Does He promise and not fulfill?
ekegusii: Nyasae tari omonto, erinde akwane oborimo, gose tari Mwanyabaanto, erinde anyare koonchoka. Inee! Aya akwanire, takonyara koyakora? Gose, aya ateebire, takonyara koyaikerania?
swahili: Mungu si mtu, hata aseme uongo, wala yeye si mwanadamu, hata ajute. Je, anasema, kisha asitende? Je, anaahidi, asitimize?

english: So Balak did as Balaam had instructed, and Balak and Balaam offered a bull and a ram on each altar.
ekegusii: Balaki agakora buna Baalamu amoteebetie, na abwo babere bakarua ekeng’wanso igoro ase kera egesasiimero, eeri eyemo na emingichi eyemo.
swahili: Balaki akafanya kama Balaamu alivyosema; hao wawili kila mmoja wao akatoa fahali mmoja na kondoo dume mmoja juu ya kila madhabahu.

english: I have indeed received a command to bless; He has blessed, and I cannot change it.
ekegusii: Rora, inche nigo nachigetwe ng’a ’nsesenie; na ekero Nyasae asesenirie, inche tinkonyara koirania ogosesenigwa okwo.
swahili: Nimepokea agizo kubariki; amebariki, nami siwezi kubadilisha.

english: He considers no disaster for Jacob; He sees no trouble for Israel. The LORD their God is with them, and the shout of the King is among them.
ekegusii: Ere tarochi obobe ase Yakobo, tarochi bokong’u bonde ase Abaisraeli. Omonene, Nyasae obo, nigo are amo nabarabwo, igo bakoraria nomochengo ng’a omorwoti nareo.
swahili: “Haijaonekana bahati mbaya katika Yakobo, wala taabu katika Israeli. Bwana, Mungu wao yu pamoja nao, nayo sauti kuu ya Mfalme imo katikati yao.

english: God brought them out of Egypt with strength like a wild ox.
ekegusii: Nyasae nere obarentire korwa Misiri; barabwo nigo babwate chinguru buna echi’eng’era.
swahili: Mungu aliwatoa kutoka Misri; wao wana nguvu za nyati.

english: For there is no spell against Jacob and no divination against Israel. It will now be said of Jacob and Israel, ‘What great things God has done!’
ekegusii: Oborogi tibogokora gento ase abanto ba Yakobo, gose oboriori ase Abaisraeli. Nakwanwe igoro y’ abanto ba Yakobo, nabwo Abaisraeli: Rora aya Nyasae akorire!
swahili: Hakuna uchawi dhidi ya Yakobo, wala hakuna uaguzi dhidi ya Israeli. Sasa itasemwa kuhusu Yakobo na Israeli, ‘Tazama yale Mungu aliyotenda!’

english: Behold, the people rise like a lioness; they rouse themselves like a lion, not resting until they devour their prey and drink the blood of the slain.”
ekegusii: Rigereria abanto abwo nigo banga buna endo eaberi ekoboka, na buna endo ekoimokerera igoro, teri korara goika eraria echi yatwarire, goika eranywa amanyinga ay’echi yaitire.”
swahili: Taifa lainuka kama simba jike; linajiinua kama simba ambaye hatulii mpaka amalize kurarua mawindo yake na kunywa damu ya mawindo yake.”

english: Now Balak said to Balaam, “Then neither curse them at all nor bless them at all!”
ekegusii: Naende Balaki agateebia Baalamu, “Bono tobaisa kobaragereria, gose tobaisa kobasesenia nonya ng’ake.”
swahili: Kisha Balaki akamwambia Balaamu, “Usiwalaani kabisa, wala usiwabariki kabisa!”

english: But Balaam replied, “Did I not tell you that whatever the LORD says, I must do?”
ekegusii: Korende Baalamu akamoiraneria, “Tinagoteebia ng’a amang’ana onsi Omonene agonteebia, ayio naro ’ndakore?” Obobani Bwa Gatato Bwa Baalamu
swahili: Balaamu akajibu, “Je, sikukuambia ni lazima nifanye lolote analosema Bwana?” Ujumbe Wa Tatu Wa Balaamu

english: “Please come,” said Balak, “I will take you to another place. Perhaps it will please God that you curse them for me from there.”
ekegusii: Balaki agateebia Baalamu, “Bono inchwo ’nkoire aase ande aao. Aande gose Nyasae nanche obandagererie korwa aroro.”
swahili: Basi Balaki akamwambia Balaamu, “Njoo, nikupeleke mahali pengine. Huenda itampendeza Mungu kukuruhusu unilaanie hao watu kutoka mahali hapo.”

english: And Balak took Balaam to the top of Peor, which overlooks the wasteland.
ekegusii: Ase ayio Balaki akaira Baalamu gochia ase egechuria ki’egetunwa gia Peori, bakarigereria erooro inse.
swahili: Balaki akamchukua Balaamu juu ya Mlima Peori, unaotazamana na nyika.

english: Then Balaam said, “Build for me seven altars here, and prepare for me seven bulls and seven rams.”
ekegusii: Baalamu akamoteebia, “Ng’agachere aiga ebisasimero bitano na bibere, na ondetere chieri isan’aibere, ne chimingichi isan’aibere.”
swahili: Balaamu akasema, “Nijengee hapa madhabahu saba, uandae mafahali saba na kondoo dume saba kwa ajili yangu.”

english: “Stay here by your burnt offering while I am gone,” Balaam said to Balak. “Perhaps the LORD will meet with me. And whatever He reveals to me, I will tell you.” So Balaam went off to a barren height,
ekegusii: Baalamu agateebia Balaki, “Beera aa, otenene mbarabare ase ekeng’wanso kiao ki’ogosambwa; inche ’ngende korora gose ande Omonene nang’orokere. Kende gionsi aranteebie, ekio nakio ndagoteebie.” Baalamu agatiira gochia egetunwa igoro aarabu.
swahili: Kisha Balaamu akamwambia Balaki, “Kaa hapa kando ya sadaka yako wakati mimi ninakwenda kando. Huenda Bwana atakuja kukutana nami. Lolote atakalonifunulia, nitakuambia.” Basi akaenda hata mahali peupe palipoinuka.

english: So Balak did as Balaam had instructed, and he offered a bull and a ram on each altar.
ekegusii: Balaki agakora buna atebetigwe, akarua eeri eyemo amo n’emingichi eyemo ase kera egesasiimero.
swahili: Balaki akafanya kama Balaamu alivyosema, kisha akatoa sadaka ya fahali mmoja na kondoo dume mmoja juu ya kila madhabahu.

english: and God met with him. “I have set up seven altars,” Balaam said, “and on each altar I have offered a bull and a ram.”
ekegusii: Nyasae agaika korwa igoro, akaumerana na Baalamu. Baalamu akamoteebia, “Naagachire ebisasimero bitano na bibere, naende narure igoro ase kera ekemo eeri eyemo na emingichi eyemo.”
swahili: Mungu akakutana naye, kisha Balaamu akasema, “Nimekwisha kutengeneza madhabahu saba, na juu ya kila madhabahu nimetoa sadaka ya fahali mmoja na kondoo dume mmoja.”

english: Then the LORD put a message in Balaam’s mouth, saying, “Return to Balak and give him this message.”
ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Baalamu ring’ana agochia gokwana. Naende akamotoma airane ase Balaki namang’ana ayio ayio.
swahili: Bwana akaweka ujumbe katika kinywa cha Balaamu na kusema, “Rudi kwa Balaki umpe ujumbe huu.”

english: So he returned to Balak, who was standing there beside his burnt offering, with all the princes of Moab.
ekegusii: Baalamu akairana gochia ase Balaki, akamonyora oteneine mbarabare ase ekeng’wanso kiaye ki’ogosambwa, amo nabanene bonsi b’Abamoabu.
swahili: Basi Balaamu akarudi kwa Balaki, akamkuta amesimama kando ya sadaka yake akiwa na wakuu wote wa Moabu.

english: And Balaam lifted up an oracle, saying: “Balak brought me from Aram, the king of Moab from the mountains of the east. ‘Come,’ he said, ‘put a curse on Jacob for me; come and denounce Israel!’
ekegusii: Baalamu agakwana obobani bwaye, agateeba: “Balaki, omorwoti o Moabu, ondetire korwa Siiria, korwa ase ebitunwa bia Moocha, oteebire: Inchuo, ondagererie abanto ba Yakobo, inchwo ogambie Abaisraeli.
swahili: Ndipo Balaamu akasema ujumbe wake: “Balaki amenileta kutoka Aramu, mfalme wa Moabu kutoka milima ya mashariki. Akasema, ‘Njoo, unilaanie Yakobo; njoo unishutumie Israeli.’

english: How can I curse what God has not cursed? How can I denounce what the LORD has not denounced?
ekegusii: Naki ’ndakore ndagererie oyo Nyasae ataragerereti? Naki ’ndakore ’ngambie oy’Omonene atagambeti?
swahili: Nitawezaje kuwalaani, hao ambao Mungu hajawalaani? Nitawezaje kuwashutumu hao ambao Bwana hakuwashutumu?

english: For I see them from atop the rocky cliffs, and I watch them from the hills. Behold, a people dwelling apart, not reckoning themselves among the nations.
ekegusii: Korwa aiga ase ebitare igoro nimbarooche, na korwa aiga ase ebitunwa nimbarigereretie. Abwo n’abanto bamenyete boka, beatananire korwa ase abanto b’ebisaku.
swahili: Kutoka vilele vya miamba ninawaona, kutoka mahali palipoinuka ninawatazama. Ninaliona taifa ambalo wanaishi peke yao, nao hawahesabiwi kama mojawapo ya mataifa.

english: And when Balaam saw that it pleased the LORD to bless Israel, he did not resort to sorcery as on previous occasions, but he turned his face toward the wilderness.
ekegusii: Ekero Baalamu arooche ng’a Omonene nigo amoganetie asesenie Abaisraeli tagendete naende ase okorigia oboringoria buna chingaki chiria chi’eritang’ani, korende akaonchora obosio bwaye gochia ase erooro.
swahili: Basi Balaamu alipoona imempendeza Bwana kubariki Israeli, hakuendelea tena kutafuta uchawi kama nyakati nyingine, bali aligeuza uso wake kuelekea nyikani.

english: Then Balak’s anger burned against Balaam, and he struck his hands together and said to Balaam, “I summoned you to curse my enemies, but behold, you have persisted in blessing them these three times.
ekegusii: Ase amang’ana ayio Balaki akaba n’endamwamu enene ase Baalamu, agaaka chinkobi, akamoteebia, “Nigo nakorangeretie ng’a oragererie ababisa bane, na rora, bono aye kwabasesenirie chintunda echi isato.
swahili: Ndipo hasira ya Balaki ikawaka dhidi ya Balaamu. Akapiga mikono yake pamoja, akamwambia Balaamu, “Nilikuita uje kuwalaani adui zangu, lakini umewabariki mara hizi tatu.

english: Therefore, flee at once to your home! I said I would richly reward you, but instead the LORD has denied your reward.”
ekegusii: Bono irana gochia bwoo. Inche igo narengereretie gokoa ogosika okonene, korende Omonene okorinire, tonyora ogosikwa okwo.”
swahili: Sasa ondoka upesi uende nyumbani! Mimi nilisema nitakuzawadia vizuri sana, lakini Bwana amekuzuia usizawadiwe.”

english: Balaam answered Balak, “Did I not already tell the messengers you sent me
ekegusii: Baalamu agateebia Balaki, “Inee! Tinateebetie abanto baria gwatomete ase inde ng’a
swahili: Balaamu akamwambia Balaki, “Je, hukumbuki jinsi nilivyowaambia wajumbe uliowatuma kwangu? Niliwaambia hivi,

english: that even if Balak were to give me his house full of silver and gold, I could not do anything of my own accord, good or bad, to go beyond the command of the LORD? I will speak whatever the LORD says.
ekegusii: Balaki naisa kong’a enyomba yaye eichire ne chifeta, ne chitaabu, tinkonyara kwanga koigwera amang’an’Omonene anchikiire, na tingokora gento kende ase ogwancha kwane, abe amabe, gose amaya. Ay’Omonene agoteeba, ayio naro ngwenerete ’nkore. Obobani Bw’omoerio Bwa Baalamu
swahili: ‘Hata ikiwa Balaki angenipa jumba lake la kifalme likiwa limejazwa fedha na dhahabu, nisingeweza kufanya kitu chochote kwa matakwa yangu, kikiwa kizuri au kibaya, kwenda kinyume na agizo la Bwana, nami imenipasa kusema tu kile Bwana atakachosema’?

english: Now I am going back to my people, but come, let me warn you what this people will do to your people in the days to come.” Balaam’s Fourth Oracle
ekegusii: “Bono ’nkoirana inde gochia ase abanto bane. Inchuo ’nkomanyie egento Abaisraeli barakore ase abanto bao ase amatuko agochia goocha.”
swahili: Sasa ninarudi kwa watu wangu. Lakini njoo, nikuonye kuhusu kile watu hawa watakachowatenda watu wako siku zijazo.” Ujumbe Wa Nne Wa Balaamu

english: Then Balaam lifted up an oracle, saying, “This is the prophecy of Balaam son of Beor, the prophecy of a man whose eyes are open,
ekegusii: Erio Baalamu agakwana obobani obo: “Amang’ana aya inche Baalamu, mosinto o Beori, ’ngokwana, amang’ana aya nay’ane, inche omonto oramokiigwe amaiso.
swahili: Kisha Balaamu akatoa ujumbe wake: “Ujumbe wa Balaamu mwana wa Beori, ujumbe wake yeye ambaye jicho lake linaona vizuri;

english: the prophecy of one who hears the words of God, who has knowledge from the Most High, who sees a vision from the Almighty, who bows down with eyes wide open:
ekegusii: Aya namang’ana y’omonto okoigwa buya aya Nyasae agoteeba, naende onyorire okomanya korwa ase oria ore Igoro Mono. Na okorora amaroro akorwa ase oria Omobui, oyogotung’ama inse na koramokigwa amaiso.
swahili: ujumbe wake yeye ambaye husikia maneno ya Mungu, ambaye ana maarifa kutoka kwa Aliye Juu Sana, huona maono kutoka Mwenyezi, ambaye huanguka kifudifudi na ambaye macho yake yamefunguka:

english: I see him, but not now; I behold him, but not near. A star will come forth from Jacob, and a scepter will arise from Israel. He will crush the skulls of Moab and strike down all the sons of Sheth.
ekegusii: Namororire, korende tari bono; namorigereirie, korende tari ang’e. Eng’enang’eni neoroke korwa ase egati y’ abanto ba Yakobo, na enyimbo y’obogambi neoroke korwa ase Abaisraeli. Nesenyente chintakunero chi’emetwe y’Abamoabu, neiyerie abanto b’ororeeria rwa Seti.
swahili: “Namwona yeye, lakini si sasa; namtazama yeye, lakini si karibu. Nyota itatoka kwa Yakobo, fimbo ya ufalme itainuka kutoka kwa Israeli. Atawaponda Wamoabu vipaji vya nyuso na mafuvu yote ya wana wa Shethi.

english: Edom will become a possession, as will Seir, his enemy; but Israel will perform with valor.
ekegusii: Ense ya Edomu nebugwe eirwe, Edomu nebugwe ebe eyabo, eyio nense y’ababisa babo. Abaisraeli ’mbagenderere koba n’okobua.
swahili: Edomu itamilikiwa, Seiri, adui wake, itamilikiwa, lakini Israeli atakuwa na nguvu.

english: A ruler will come from Jacob and destroy the survivors of the city.” Balaam’s Final Three Oracles
ekegusii: Omogambi naoroke korwa ase egati y’ abanto ba Yakobo asirie abanto batameire emechie banyore oborendi.”
swahili: Mtawala atakuja kutoka kwa Yakobo na kuangamiza walionusurika katika mji.” Ujumbe Wa Mwisho Wa Balaamu

english: When Balaam looked up and saw Israel encamped tribe by tribe, the Spirit of God came upon him,
ekegusii: Agachia koimokia amaiso, aye, akarora Abaisraeli batoorete egesaku ase egesaku. Erio Omoika o Nyasae ogaacha igoro ase are.
swahili: Balaamu alipotazama nje na kuona Israeli amepiga kambi kabila kwa kabila, Roho wa Mungu akawa juu yake,

english: Then Balaam saw Amalek and lifted up an oracle, saying: “Amalek was first among the nations, but his end is destruction.”
ekegusii: Erio Baalamu akarigereria Abaameleki, agakwana obobani obo: “Abaameleki nabwo barenge ab’eritang’ani ase ebisaku, korende ase omoerio nabasirigwe kegima.”
swahili: Kisha Balaamu akawaona watu wa Amaleki, na kutoa ujumbe wake: “Amaleki ilikuwa ya kwanza miongoni mwa mataifa, lakini mwisho wake itaangamizwa milele.”

english: Next he saw the Kenites and lifted up an oracle, saying: “Your dwelling place is secure, and your nest is set in a cliff.
ekegusii: Naende akarigereria Abakeni, agakwana obobani obo: “Obomenyo bwabo nabogenderere kobao, buna egeswa keagachire ase engako y’egetare.
swahili: Kisha akawaona Wakeni, akatoa ujumbe wake: “Makao yenu ni salama, kiota chenu kiko kwenye mwamba.

english: Yet Kain will be destroyed when Asshur takes you captive.”
ekegusii: Korende nonya naboigo, Abakeni nabasirigwe, ekero Abaasuri barabaire babe abasibwa.”
swahili: Hata hivyo ninyi Wakeni mtaangamizwa Ashuru atakapowachukua mateka.”

english: Once more Balaam lifted up an oracle, saying: “Ah, who can live unless God has ordained it?
ekegusii: Baalamu akagenderera gokwana obobani bwaye: “Obee! Ning’o oranyare koba moyo ekero Nyasae arakore aya?
swahili: Ndipo akatoa ujumbe wake: “Lo, ni nani atakayeweza kuishi wakati Mungu atakapofanya hili?

english: Ships will come from the coasts of Cyprus; they will subdue Asshur and Eber, but they too will perish forever.”
ekegusii: Abanto ’mbachiche ne chimeeri korwa ase engegu ya Kitimu, nabarabwo ’mbachaande Abaasuri na Abaeberi, korende barabwo abanyene ’mbasirigwe boigo.”
swahili: Meli zitakuja kutoka pwani za Kitimu, zitaitiisha Ashuru na Eberi, lakini nao pia wataangamizwa.”

english: Then Balaam arose and returned to his homeland, and Balak also went on his way.
ekegusii: Erio Baalamu akaimoka, akairana bwoye, na Balaki nere akabwatia enchera, akageenda bwoye.
swahili: Kisha Balaamu akainuka na kurudi nyumbani kwake, naye Balaki akashika njia yake.

english: and he lifted up an oracle, saying: “This is the prophecy of Balaam son of Beor, the prophecy of a man whose eyes are open,
ekegusii: Agwo Baalamu agakwana obobani obo: “Amang’ana aya naro inche Baalamu, mosinto o Beori, ’ngokwana amang’ana aya nay’ane, inche omonto oramokiigwe amaiso.
swahili: naye akatoa ujumbe wake: “Ujumbe wa Balaamu mwana wa Beori, ujumbe wake yeye ambaye jicho lake linaona vizuri;

english: the prophecy of one who hears the words of God, who sees a vision from the Almighty, who bows down with eyes wide open:
ekegusii: Aya namang’ana y’omonto okoigwa buya aya Nyasae agoteeba, oyo okorora amaroro akorwa ase ere oria Omonguru, oyogotung’ama inse na koramokigwa amaiso aye.
swahili: ujumbe wake yeye ambaye husikia maneno ya Mungu, ambaye huona maono kutoka kwa Mwenyezi, ambaye huanguka kifudifudi, na ambaye macho yake yamefunguka:

english: How lovely are your tents, O Jacob, your dwellings, O Israel!
ekegusii: Inwe abanto ba Yakobo, chiema chiaino naki chire chingiya! Inwe Abaisraeli aase momenyete, naki are aagiya mono!
swahili: “Tazama jinsi yalivyo mazuri mahema yako, ee Yakobo, maskani yako, ee Israeli!

english: They spread out like palm groves, like gardens beside a stream, like aloes the LORD has planted, like cedars beside the waters.
ekegusii: Igo mogwekaine omweya orambogete gochia aare, gose emegondo ere mbarabare y’orooche, nigo more buna emegaka Omonene asimegete. Gose emecharake ere ase amaache mbarabare.
swahili: “Kama mabonde, yanaenea, kama bustani kando ya mto, kama miti ya udi iliyopandwa na Bwana, kama mierezi kando ya maji.

english: Water will flow from his buckets, and his seed will have abundant water. His king will be greater than Agag, and his kingdom will be exalted.
ekegusii: Amache amaange naiteke korwa ase chinyongo chiabo na oroiboro rwabo nigo roraabe oronge mono. Omorwoti obo nabe omonene goetania Agagi, na oborwoti bwaye inabotogigwe mono.
swahili: Maji yatatiririka kutoka ndoo zake; mbegu yake itakuwa na maji tele. “Mfalme wake atakuwa mkuu kuliko Mfalme Agagi; ufalme wake utatukuka.

english: God brought him out of Egypt with strength like a wild ox, to devour hostile nations and crush their bones, to pierce them with arrows.
ekegusii: Nyasae nere obarentire korwa Misiri, chinguru chiabo nigo chire buna echi’eng’era. Barabwo mbasirie abanto abare mamincha yabo, babune amauga y’emebere y’ababisa babo, na baabarase ne chinsara chiabo.
swahili: “Mungu alimleta kutoka Misri; yeye ana nguvu kama nyati. Anayararua mataifa yaliyo adui zake, na kuvunja mifupa yao vipande vipande; huwachoma kwa mishale yake.

english: He crouches, he lies down like a lion; like a lioness, who dares to rouse him? Blessed are those who bless you and cursed are those who curse you.” Balak Dismisses Balaam
ekegusii: Abaisraeli nigo batung’aime inse buna endo, buna endo eaberi, ning’o oraabe noboremu abature? Asesenigwe omonto oria okobasesenia inwe, na aragererigwe omonto oria okobaragereria inwe.”
swahili: Hujikunyata na kuvizia kama simba, kama simba jike; nani anayethubutu kumwamsha? “Abarikiwe kila akubarikiye, na alaaniwe kila akulaaniye!”

english: While Israel was staying in Shittim, the men began to indulge in sexual immorality with the daughters of Moab,
ekegusii: Ekero Abaisraeli batoorete agwo Sitimu, abanto bagachaaka gokora obotomani n’abakuungu b’Abamoabu.
swahili: Israeli alipokuwa akikaa Shitimu, wanaume wa Israeli walianza kuzini na wanawake wa Kimoabu,

english: “Phinehas son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, has turned My wrath away from the Israelites; for he was zealous for My sake among them, so that I did not consume the Israelites in My zeal.
ekegusii: “Finehasi, mosinto bw’Eleazari o Aroni Omokuani, nere ogera endamwamu yane yatigire Abaisraeli, ekiagera ere aba ne risemi buna inche inde ne risemi ase egati y’ abanto aba. Ase ayio tinasiretie bonsi ase risemi riane.
swahili: “Finehasi mwana wa Eleazari, mwana wa kuhani Aroni, amegeuza hasira yangu mbali na Waisraeli, kwa sababu alikuwa na wivu kama nilio nao kwa heshima yangu miongoni mwao, hata kwamba kwa wivu wangu sikuwaangamiza.

english: Declare, therefore, that I am granting him My covenant of peace.
ekegusii: Ase ayio, moteebie ng’a, ’ngokora inde nere okobwatana kwane kw’omorembe.
swahili: Kwa hiyo mwambie Finehasi ninafanya Agano langu la amani naye.

english: It will be a covenant of permanent priesthood for him and his descendants, because he was zealous for his God and made atonement for the Israelites.”
ekegusii: Okobwatana okwo kw’omorembe ’nkobe ase are ere, na ase ororeria rw’aye, okobwatana kwa botambe kw’obokuani, ekiagera abeete ne risemi ase engencho yane, inche Nyasae oye, naende agakora okobwatanigwa ase Abaisraeli.”
swahili: Yeye pamoja na wazao wake watakuwa na Agano la ukuhani milele, kwa sababu alikuwa na wivu kwa ajili ya heshima ya Mungu wake, na akafanya upatanisho kwa Waisraeli.”

english: The name of the Israelite who was slain with the Midianite woman was Zimri son of Salu, the leader of a Simeonite family.
ekegusii: Omoisraeli oria oitetwe amo nomokuungu Omomidiani nigo arenge korokwa Simuri, mosinto o Salu, omotang’ani bw’eamate yaye ase egesaku gia Simioni.
swahili: Jina la Mwisraeli ambaye aliuawa pamoja na mwanamke wa Kimidiani ni Zimri mwana wa Salu, kiongozi wa jamaa ya Simeoni.

english: And the name of the slain Midianite woman was Cozbi, the daughter of Zur, a tribal chief of a Midianite family.
ekegusii: Omokungu oria bw’Abamidiani oitetwe ere nigo arenge korokwa Kosibi. Suri ise nere orenge omotang’ani bwe chiamate chinde chi’Abamidiani.
swahili: Jina la mwanamke wa Kimidiani aliyeuawa ni Kozbi binti wa Suri, aliyekuwa mkuu wa kabila la jamaa ya Wamidiani.

english: “Attack the Midianites and strike them dead.
ekegusii: “Umokera Abamidiani, obasirie,
swahili: “Watendeeni Wamidiani kama adui na mwaue,

english: For they assailed you deceitfully when they seduced you in the matter of Peor and their sister Cozbi, the daughter of the Midianite leader, the woman who was killed on the day the plague came because of Peor.”
ekegusii: ekiagera barabwo baabachandire ase okobaebereria gosasiima Peori, na ase amang’ana a Kosibi, omosubati oria bw’omonene bw’Abamidiani. Omosubati oria obo oitetwe ase rituko riria amaakwa achete ase engencho ya Peori.”
swahili: kwa sababu wao waliwatendea kama adui wakati waliwadanganya katika tukio la Peori na dada yao Kozbi, binti wa kiongozi wa Kimidiani, mwanamke ambaye aliuawa wakati tauni ilikuja kama matokeo ya tukio la Peori.”

english: who also invited them to the sacrifices for their gods. And the people ate and bowed down to these gods.
ekegusii: Abwo bakarangeria Abaisraeli bagende ase emeyega y’ebing’wanso yarenge gokorerwa chinyasae chiabo, na barabwo bakabiria, naende bagasasiima chinyasae chi’Abamoabu.
swahili: ambao waliwaalika kushiriki katika kutoa kafara kwa miungu yao. Watu wakala na kusujudu mbele ya miungu hii.

english: So Israel joined in worshiping Baal of Peor, and the anger of the LORD burned against them.
ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakabwatana n’enyasae yarenge korokwa Baali‐Peori, bakayesasiima. Omonene akaba n’endamwamu enene ase bare.
swahili: Kwa hiyo Israeli akaungana katika kumwabudu Baali wa Peori. Hasira ya Bwana ikawaka dhidi yao.

english: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Take all the leaders of the people and execute them in broad daylight before the LORD, so that His fierce anger may turn away from Israel.”
ekegusii: Erio agateebia Musa, “Renta abatang’ani bonsi b’Abaisraeli, obasunge agwo ase obosio bwane erioba ribasambe, erinde endamwamu yane enene etige Abaisraeli.”
swahili: Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Uwachukue viongozi wote wa watu hawa, uwaue na uwaweke hadharani mchana peupe mbele za Bwana, ili hasira kali ya Bwana iweze kuondoka kwa Israeli.”

english: So Moses told the judges of Israel, “Each of you must kill all of his men who have joined in worshiping Baal of Peor.” The Zeal of Phinehas
ekegusii: Erio Musa agateebia abagaambi b’Abaisraeli, “Kera oyomo ase more, tiga aite abanto baye bonsi baria babwatanire na Baali‐Peori.”
swahili: Kwa hiyo Mose akawaambia waamuzi wa Israeli, “Kila mmoja wenu lazima awaue wale wanaume wenu, walioshiriki katika kumwabudu Baali wa Peori.”

english: Just then an Israelite man brought to his family a Midianite woman in the sight of Moses and the whole congregation of Israel while they were weeping at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.
ekegusii: Omoisraeli oyomo agacha akarentana omokungu oyomo bw’Abamidiani ase eamate yaye, ase obosio bwa Musa amo nomoganda bwonsi kobateneine agwo ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano, bakorera.
swahili: Ndipo mwanaume wa Kiisraeli akamleta mwanamke wa Kimidiani katika jamaa yake palepale mbele ya Mose na mkutano wote wa Israeli walipokuwa wakilia kwenye lango la Hema la Kukutania.

english: On seeing this, Phinehas son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, got up from the assembly, took a spear in his hand,
ekegusii: Finehasi, mosinto bw’Eleazari o Aroni Omokuani, akaimoka korwa ase omoganda bw’Abaisraeli, akabogoria ritimo,
swahili: Finehasi mwana wa Eleazari, mwana wa kuhani Aroni, alipoona jambo hili, akaondoka kwenye kusanyiko, akachukua mkuki mkononi mwake,

english: followed the Israelite into his tent, and drove the spear through both of them—through the Israelite and on through the belly of the woman. So the plague against the Israelites was halted,
ekegusii: akabwatia omonto oria gochia ase akanyomba ka ime, akababeta ritimo bonsi babere, Omoisraeli oria amo nomokuungu oria, ase chinda chiabo. Ase igo amaakwa aria agatiga goita Abaisraeli.
swahili: akamfuata yule Mwisraeli ndani ya hema. Akawachoma mkuki wote wawili kwa pamoja, ukapenya kwenye mwili wa yule Mwisraeli na mwili wa yule mwanamke. Ndipo tauni iliyokuwepo dhidi ya Waisraeli ikakoma.

english: but those who died in the plague numbered 24,000.
ekegusii: Korende abanto abakwete ase ogoakwa okwo nigo babete chilifu emerongo ebere na inye (24,000).
swahili: Lakini wale waliokufa kwa hiyo tauni walikuwa watu 24,000.

english: After the plague had ended, the LORD said to Moses and Eleazar son of Aaron the priest,
ekegusii: Ekaba magega amaakwa aria gaetire, Omonene agakwana na Musa na Eleazari, omomura o Aroni Omokuani, akabateebia,
swahili: Baada ya hiyo tauni, Bwana akamwambia Mose na Eleazari mwana wa kuhani Aroni,

english: And the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them along with Korah, whose followers died when the fire consumed 250 men. They serve as a warning sign.
ekegusii: Riroba rikabwereka rikabamera amo na Kora, ekero omorero osambete na gosiria abanto amagana abere, na merongo etano. Ayio akaba ekiorokererio ki’ogokuurera.
swahili: Ardhi ilifunua kinywa chake na kuwameza pamoja na Kora, ambaye wafuasi wake walikufa wakati moto ulipowateketeza wanaume 250. Nao walikuwa kama alama ya onyo.

english: However, the line of Korah did not die out. The Tribe of Simeon
ekegusii: Korende abana ba Kora barabwo tibaitetwe.)
swahili: Pamoja na hayo, hao ukoo wa Kora hawakufa.

english: These were the descendants of Simeon by their clans: The Nemuelite clan from Nemuel, the Jaminite clan from Jamin, the Jachinite clan from Jachin,
ekegusii: Ase egesaku gia Simioni nigo chiarenge chiamate echi: Abaanemweli, abarwete ase Nemweli, na Abayamini, abarwete ase Yamini, na Abayakini, abarwete ase Yakini,
swahili: Wazao wa Simeoni kwa koo zao walikuwa: kutoka kwa Nemueli, ukoo wa Wanemueli; kutoka kwa Yamini, ukoo wa Wayamini; kutoka wa Yakini, ukoo wa Wayakini;

english: the Zerahite clan from Zerah, and the Shaulite clan from Shaul.
ekegusii: na Abazera, abarwete ase Zera, na Abasauli, abarwete ase Saulo.
swahili: kutoka kwa Zera, ukoo wa Wazera; kutoka kwa Shauli, ukoo wa Washauli.

english: These were the descendants of Gad by their clans: The Zephonite clan from Zephon, the Haggite clan from Haggi, the Shunite clan from Shuni,
ekegusii: Ase egesaku kia Gadi nigo chiarenge chiamate echi: Abazefoni, abarwete ase Zefoni, na Abahagi, abarwete ase Hagi, na
swahili: Wazao wa Gadi kwa koo zao walikuwa: kutoka kwa Sifoni, ukoo wa Wasifoni; kutoka kwa Hagi, ukoo wa Wahagi; kutoka kwa Shuni, ukoo wa Washuni;

english: the Oznite clan from Ozni, the Erite clan from Eri,
ekegusii: Abasuni, abarwete ase Suni, na Abaosini, abarwete ase Osini, na Abaeri, abarwete ase Eri,
swahili: kutoka kwa Ozni, ukoo wa Waozni; kutoka kwa Eri, ukoo wa Waeri;

english: the Arodite clan from Arod, and the Arelite clan from Areli.
ekegusii: na Abaarodi, abarwete ase Arodi, na Abaareli, abarwete ase Areli.
swahili: kutoka kwa Arodi, ukoo wa Waarodi; kutoka kwa Areli, ukoo wa Waareli.

english: These were the clans of Gad, and their registration numbered 40,500. The Tribe of Judah
ekegusii: Echi nachio chiamate chi’egesaku kia Gadi. Abaabaretwe nigo barenge chilifi emerongo ene, na amagana atano (40,500).
swahili: Hizi ndizo zilizokuwa koo za Gadi; wale waliohesabiwa walikuwa 40,500.

english: The sons of Judah were Er and Onan, but they died in the land of Canaan.
ekegusii: Basinto ba Yuda, Eri na Onani, bagakwera agwo ase ense ya Kaanani.
swahili: Eri na Onani walikuwa wana wa Yuda, lakini walifia huko Kanaani.

english: “Take a census of the whole congregation of Israel by the houses of their fathers—all those twenty years of age or older who can serve in the army of Israel.”
ekegusii: “Mobare omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli, eamate ase eamate. Moriike, abanto bakoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, abwo baranyare korwana esegi.”
swahili: “Hesabu jumuiya yote ya Kiisraeli kwa jamaa zao, wale wote wenye umri wa miaka ishirini na zaidi, ambao wanaweza kutumika katika jeshi la Israeli.”

english: These were the descendants of Judah by their clans: The Shelanite clan from Shelah, the Perezite clan from Perez, and the Zerahite clan from Zerah.
ekegusii: Ase egesaku kia Yuda nigo chiarenge chiamate echi: Abasela, abarwete ase Sela, na Abaperisi, abarwete ase Peresi, na Abazera, abarwete ase Zera.
swahili: Wazao wa Yuda kwa koo zao walikuwa: kutoka kwa Shela, ukoo wa Washela; kutoka kwa Peresi, ukoo wa Waperesi; kutoka kwa Zera, ukoo wa Wazera.

english: And these were the descendants of Perez: the Hezronite clan from Hezron and the Hamulite clan from Hamul.
ekegusii: Chiamate chia Peresi nigo chiarenge: Abahezironi, abarwete ase Hezironi, na Abahamuli, abarwete ase Hamuli.
swahili: Wazao wa Peresi walikuwa: kutoka kwa Hesroni, ukoo wa Wahesroni; kutoka kwa Hamuli, ukoo wa Wahamuli.

english: These were the clans of Judah, and their registration numbered 76,500. The Tribe of Issachar
ekegusii: Echi nachio chiamate chi’egesaku kia Yuda. Abaabaretwe nigo barenge chilifu emerongo etano ebere na isano nemo, na amagana atano (76,500).
swahili: Hizi ndizo zilizokuwa koo za Yuda; wale waliohesabiwa walikuwa 76,500.

english: These were the descendants of Issachar by their clans: The Tolaite clan from Tola, the Punite clan from Puvah,
ekegusii: Ase egesaku gia Isakaru nigo chiarenge chiamate echi: Abatola, abarwete ase Tola, na Abapua, abarwete ase Pua,
swahili: Wazao wa Isakari kwa koo zao walikuwa: kutoka kwa Tola, ukoo wa Watola; kutoka kwa Puva, ukoo wa Wapuva;

english: the Jashubite clan from Jashub, and the Shimronite clan from Shimron.
ekegusii: na Abayasubu, abarwete ase Yasubu, na Abashimuroni, abarwete ase Shimuroni.
swahili: kutoka kwa Yashubu, ukoo wa Wayashubu; kutoka kwa Shimroni, ukoo wa Washimroni.

english: These were the clans of Issachar, and their registration numbered 64,300. The Tribe of Zebulun
ekegusii: Echi nachio chiamate chi’egesaku gia Isakaru. Abaabaretwe nigo barenge chilifu emerongo etano nomo na inye, n’amagana atato (64,300).
swahili: Hizi ndizo zilizokuwa koo za Isakari; wale waliohesabiwa walikuwa 64,300.

english: These were the descendants of Zebulun by their clans: The Seredite clan from Sered, the Elonite clan from Elon, and the Jahleelite clan from Jahleel.
ekegusii: Ase egesaku gia Sabuloni nigo chiarenge chiamate echi: Abaseredi, abarwete ase Seredi, na Abaeloni, abarwete ase Eloni, na Abayaleeli, abarwete ase Yaleeli.
swahili: Wazao wa Zabuloni kwa koo zao walikuwa: kutoka kwa Seredi, ukoo wa Waseredi; kutoka kwa Eloni, ukoo wa Waeloni; kutoka kwa Yaleeli, ukoo wa Wayaleeli.

english: These were the clans of Zebulun, and their registration numbered 60,500. The Tribe of Manasseh
ekegusii: Echi nachio chiamate chi’egesaku gia Sabuloni. Abaabaretwe nigo barenge chilifu emerongo etano nomo na amagana atano (60,500).
swahili: Hizi ndizo zilizokuwa koo za Zabuloni, wale waliohesabiwa walikuwa 60,500.

english: The descendants of Joseph included the clans of Manasseh and Ephraim.
ekegusii: Ebisaku bia Yusufu nebi’abamura baye babere, Manase na Efraimu.
swahili: Wazao wa Yosefu kwa koo zao kutoka kwa Manase na kwa Efraimu walikuwa:

english: These were the descendants of Manasseh: The Machirite clan from Machir, the father of Gilead, and the Gileadite clan from Gilead.
ekegusii: Ase egesaku kia Manase nao eamate ya Makiri yarwete. Makiri nere orenge ise Gileadi, na korwa ase are nao Abagileadi barwete.
swahili: Wazao wa Manase: kutoka kwa Makiri, ukoo wa Wamakiri (Makiri alikuwa baba wa Gileadi); kutoka kwa Gileadi, ukoo wa Wagileadi.

english: So on the plains of Moab by the Jordan, across from Jericho, Moses and Eleazar the priest issued the instruction,
ekegusii: Erio Musa na Eleazari Omokuani bagakwana n’abanto baria ase enyancha enyomo ya Moabu, ase orooche rwa Yorodani, kororia Yeriko, akabateebia,
swahili: Hivyo Mose na kuhani Eleazari wakazungumza na watu kwenye nchi tambarare ya Moabu, ngʼambo ya Yordani kutokea Yeriko, wakasema,

english: These were the descendants of Gilead: the Iezerite clan from Iezer, the Helekite clan from Helek,
ekegusii: Ase ororeria rwa Gileadi nigo chiarenge chiamate echi: Abaieseri, abarwete ase Ieseri, na Abaheleki, abarwete ase Heleki,
swahili: Hawa ndio waliokuwa wazao wa Gileadi: kutoka kwa Iezeri, ukoo wa Waiezeri; kutoka kwa Heleki, ukoo wa Waheleki;

english: the Asrielite clan from Asriel, the Shechemite clan from Shechem,
ekegusii: Abaasirieli, abarwete ase Asirieli, na Abasekemu, abarwete ase Sekemu,
swahili: kutoka kwa Asirieli, ukoo wa Waasirieli; kutoka kwa Shekemu, ukoo wa Washekemu;

english: the Shemidaite clan from Shemida, and the Hepherite clan from Hepher.
ekegusii: na Abasemida, abarwete ase Semida, na Abaheferi, abarwete ase Heferi.
swahili: kutoka kwa Shemida, ukoo wa Washemida; kutoka kwa Heferi, ukoo wa Waheferi.

english: Now Zelophehad son of Hepher had no sons but only daughters. The names of his daughters were Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
ekegusii: Selofehadi, mosinto o Heferi, tabwate abana abamura, korende nabana abaiseke boka abwate, na amarieta y’abaiseke abwo naro aya: Mala, na Nuhu, na Hogila, na Milka, na Tirisa.
swahili: (Selofehadi mwana wa Heferi hakuzaa wana, bali alikuwa na watoto wa kike tu, ambao majina yao yalikuwa Mahla, Noa, Hogla, Milka na Tirsa.)

english: These were the clans of Manasseh, and their registration numbered 52,700. The Tribe of Ephraim
ekegusii: Echi nachio chiarenge chiamate chi’egesaku kia Manase. Abaabaretwe nigo barenge chilifu emerongo etano na ibere, na amagana atano abere (52,700).
swahili: Hizi ndizo zilizokuwa koo za Manase; wale waliohesabiwa walikuwa 52,700.

english: These were the descendants of Ephraim by their clans: The Shuthelahite clan from Shuthelah, the Becherite clan from Becher, and the Tahanite clan from Tahan.
ekegusii: Ase egesaku gi’Efraimu nigo chiarenge chiamate echi: Abasutela, abarwete ase Sutela, na Ababeekeri, abarwete ase Bekeri, na Abatahani, abarwete ase Tahani.
swahili: Hawa walikuwa wazao wa Efraimu kwa koo zao: kutoka kwa Shuthela, ukoo wa Washuthela; kutoka kwa Bekeri, ukoo wa Wabekeri; kutoka kwa Tahani, ukoo wa Watahani;

english: And the descendants of Shuthelah were the Eranite clan from Eran.
ekegusii: Sutela nigo arenge ise Erani, na korwa ase are nao Abaerani barwete.
swahili: Hawa ndio walikuwa wazao wa Shuthela: kutoka kwa Erani, ukoo wa Waerani.

english: These were the clans of Ephraim, and their registration numbered 32,500. These clans were the descendants of Joseph. The Tribe of Benjamin
ekegusii: Echi nachio chiamate chi’egesaku gia Efraimu. Abaabaretwe nigo barenge chilifu emerongo etato na ibere, na amagana atano (32,500). Aba nabwo barenge abana ba Yusufu ne chiamate chiabo.
swahili: Hizi ndizo zilizokuwa koo za Efraimu; wale waliohesabiwa walikuwa 32,500. Hawa ndio waliokuwa wazao wa Yosefu kwa koo zao.

english: These were the descendants of Benjamin by their clans: The Belaite clan from Bela, the Ashbelite clan from Ashbel, the Ahiramite clan from Ahiram,
ekegusii: Ase egesaku gia Benjamini nigo chiarenge chiamate echi: Ababela, abarwete ase Bela, na Abaasibeli, abarwete ase Asibeli, na Abaahiramu, abarwete ase Ahiramu,
swahili: Wazao wa Benyamini kwa koo zao walikuwa: kutoka kwa Bela, ukoo wa Wabela; kutoka kwa Ashbeli, ukoo wa Waashbeli; kutoka kwa Ahiramu, ukoo wa Waahiramu;

english: the Shuphamite clan from Shupham, and the Huphamite clan from Hupham.
ekegusii: na Abasefufamu, abarwete ase Sefufamu, na Abahufamu, abarwete ase Hufamu.
swahili: kutoka kwa Shufamu, ukoo wa Washufamu; kutoka kwa Hufamu, ukoo wa Wahufamu.

english: “Take a census of the men twenty years of age or older, as the LORD has commanded Moses.” And these were the Israelites who came out of the land of Egypt: The Tribe of Reuben
ekegusii: “Riika abanto bonsi abakoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, buna Omonene achiigete Musa.” Abaisraeli abwo barwete ense ya Misiri nabwo aba.
swahili: “Hesabuni wanaume wenye umri wa miaka ishirini na zaidi, kama Bwana alivyomwagiza Mose.” Hawa ndio Waisraeli waliotoka Misri:

english: And the descendants of Bela from Ard and Naaman were the Ardite clan from Ard and the Naamite clan from Naaman.
ekegusii: Abamura ba Bela nabwo Aridi na Naamani. Korwa ase Aridi nao Abaaridi barwete, na korwa ase Naamani nao Abanaamani barwete.
swahili: Wazao wa Bela kutoka kwa Ardi na Naamani walikuwa: kutoka kwa Ardi, ukoo wa Waardi; kutoka kwa Naamani, ukoo wa Wanaamani.

english: These were the clans of Benjamin, and their registration numbered 45,600. The Tribe of Dan
ekegusii: Echi nachio chiarenge chiamate chi’egesaku gia Benjamini Abaabaretwe nigo barenge chilifu emerongo ene na isano, na amagana atano na rimo (45,600).
swahili: Hizi ndizo zilizokuwa koo za Benyamini; wale waliohesabiwa walikuwa 45,600.

english: These were the descendants of Dan by their clans: The Shuhamite clan from Shuham. These were the clans of Dan.
ekegusii: Ase egesaku gia Dani nigo chiarenge chiamate chi’Abasuhamu, abarwete ase Suhamu. Aba nabwo abanto b’egesaku gia Dani ase chiamate chiabo.
swahili: Hawa ndio waliokuwa wazao wa Dani kwa koo zao: kutoka kwa Shuhamu, ukoo wa Washuhamu. Hizi ndizo zilizokuwa koo za Dani:

english: All of them were Shuhamite clans, and their registration numbered 64,400. The Tribe of Asher
ekegusii: Abarwete ase chiamate chi’Abasuhamu nigo barenge chilifu emerongo etano nomo na inye, na amagana ane (64,400).
swahili: Wote walikuwa koo za Washuhamu; wale waliohesabiwa walikuwa 64,400.

english: These were the descendants of Asher by their clans: The Imnite clan from Imnah, the Ishvite clan from Ishvi, and the Beriite clan from Beriah.
ekegusii: Ase egesaku gi’Aseri nigo chiarenge chiamate echi: Abaimuna, abarwete ase Imuna, na Abaisibi, abarwete ase Isibi, na Ababeria, abarwete ase Beria.
swahili: Wazao wa Asheri kwa koo zao walikuwa: kutoka kwa Imna, ukoo wa Waimna; kutoka kwa Ishvi, ukoo wa Waishvi; kutoka kwa Beria, ukoo wa Waberia;

english: And these were the descendants of Beriah: the Heberite clan from Heber and the Malchielite clan from Malchiel.
ekegusii: Abamura ba Beria nabwo Heberi ase eamate y’Abaheberi yarwete, na Malikieli, ase eamate y’Abamalikieli yarwete.
swahili: kutoka kwa wazao wa Beria: kutoka kwa Heberi, ukoo wa Waheberi; kutoka kwa Malkieli, ukoo wa Wamalkieli.

english: And the name of Asher’s daughter was Serah.
ekegusii: Omwana omoiseke o Aseri nigo arenge korokwa Sera.
swahili: (Asheri alikuwa na binti aliyeitwa Sera.)

english: These were the clans of Asher, and their registration numbered 53,400. The Tribe of Naphtali
ekegusii: Echi nachio chiamate chi’egesaku gi’Aseri. Abaabaretwe nigo barenge chilifu emerongo etano na isato, na amagana ane (53,400).
swahili: Hizi ndizo zilizokuwa koo za Asheri; wale waliohesabiwa walikuwa 53,400.

english: These were the descendants of Naphtali by their clans: The Jahzeelite clan from Jahzeel, the Gunite clan from Guni,
ekegusii: Ase egesaku kia Nafutali nigo chiarenge chiamate echi: Abayaseli, abarwete ase Yaseli, na Abaguni, abarwete ase Guni,
swahili: Wazao wa Naftali kwa koo zao walikuwa: kutoka kwa Yaseeli, ukoo wa Wayaseeli; kutoka kwa Guni, ukoo wa Waguni;

english: the Jezerite clan from Jezer, and the Shillemite clan from Shillem.
ekegusii: na Abayeseri, abarwete ase Yeseri, na Abasilemu, abarwete ase Silemu.
swahili: kutoka kwa Yeseri, ukoo wa Wayeseri; kutoka kwa Shilemu, ukoo wa Washilemu.

english: Reuben was the firstborn of Israel. These were the descendants of Reuben: The Hanochite clan from Hanoch, the Palluite clan from Pallu,
ekegusii: Rubeni nere orenge omomura omotangi o Israeli. Ase egesaku kiaye nigo chiarenge chiamate echi: Abahanoki, abarwete ase Hanoki, na Abapalu, abarwete ase Palu,
swahili: Wazao wa Reubeni, mwana mzaliwa wa kwanza wa Israeli, walikuwa: kutoka kwa Hanoki, ukoo wa Wahanoki; kutoka kwa Palu, ukoo wa Wapalu;

english: These were the clans of Naphtali, and their registration numbered 45,400.
ekegusii: Echi nachio chiamate chi’egesaku kia Nafutali. Abaabaretwe nigo barenge chilifu emerongo ene na isano, na amagana ane (45,400).
swahili: Hizi ndizo zilizokuwa koo za Naftali; wale waliohesabiwa walikuwa 45,400.

english: These men of Israel numbered 601,730 in all. Inheritance by Lot
ekegusii: Abanto bonsi b’Abaisraeli abarigetwe nigo barenge chilifu amagana atano nomo na eyemo, na amagana atano abere na merongo etato (601,730).
swahili: Jumla ya hesabu ya wanaume wa Israeli ilikuwa 601,730.

english: “The land is to be divided among the tribes as an inheritance, according to the number of names.
ekegusii: Aatananere abanto aba chingongo chibe emiando yabo. Ochiatanane kobwatekana nomobaro bw’ abanto.
swahili: “Watagawiwa nchi kama urithi kwa kulingana na hesabu ya majina.

english: Increase the inheritance for a large tribe and decrease it for a small one; each tribe is to receive its inheritance according to the number of those registered.
ekegusii: Egesaku kere ekenene keegwe orogongo oronene robe omwando obo, na egesaku kere egeke keegwe orogongo oroke robe omwando obo. Kera egesaku nakeegwe omwando oye koreng’ana nomobaro obo.
swahili: Kundi kubwa zaidi lipe urithi mkubwa zaidi, na kundi dogo zaidi lipewe urithi mdogo zaidi; kila kundi litapokea urithi wake kulingana na hesabu ya wale walioorodheshwa.

english: Indeed, the land must be divided by lot; they shall receive their inheritance according to the names of the tribes of their fathers.
ekegusii: Ense yaatananwe ase ogoakerwa obomera. Abanto mbanyore omwando koreng’ana nomobaro bw’amarieta ’ebisaku bie chisokoro chiabo.
swahili: Hakikisha kuwa nchi inagawanywa kwa kura. Kile kitakachorithiwa na kila kikundi kitakuwa kwa kulingana na majina ya kabila la babu yao.

english: Each inheritance is to be divided by lot among the larger and smaller tribes.” The Levites Numbered
ekegusii: Koreng’ana buna obomera boragwere abanto ba kera egesaku, ekenene gose egeke, nabo baranyore omwando obo.
swahili: Kila urithi utagawanywa kwa kura miongoni mwa makundi makubwa na madogo.”

english: Now these were the Levites numbered by their clans: The Gershonite clan from Gershon, the Kohathite clan from Kohath, and the Merarite clan from Merari.
ekegusii: Ase egesaku kia Lawi nigo chiarenge chiamate echi: Abagerisoni, abarwete ase Gerisoni, na Abakohati, abarwete ase Kohati, na Abamerari, abarwete ase Merari.
swahili: Hawa walikuwa Walawi ambao walihesabiwa kwa koo zao: kutoka kwa Gershoni, ukoo wa Wagershoni; kutoka kwa Kohathi, ukoo wa Wakohathi; kutoka kwa Merari, ukoo wa Wamerari.

english: These were the families of the Levites: The Libnite clan, the Hebronite clan, the Mahlite clan, the Mushite clan, and the Korahite clan. Now Kohath was the father of Amram,
ekegusii: Echi nachio chiamate chi’egesaku kia Lawi: Eamate y’Abalibini, na ey’Abaheburoni, na ey’Abamali na ey’Abamusi, na ey’Abakora. Kohati nere orenge ise Amuramu.
swahili: Hizi pia zilikuwa koo za Walawi: ukoo wa Walibni; ukoo wa Wahebroni; ukoo wa Wamahli; ukoo wa Wamushi; ukoo wa wana wa Kora. (Kohathi alikuwa baba aliyemzaa Amramu;

english: and Amram’s wife was named Jochebed. She was also a daughter of Levi, born to Levi in Egypt. To Amram she bore Aaron, Moses, and their sister Miriam.
ekegusii: Moka Amuramu nigo arenge korokwa Yokebedi, mosubati o Lawi, oria oiboreretwe Lawi agwo ase ense ya Misiri. Omokungu oria akamoiborera Amuramu abana aba: Aroni, na Musa, na Miriamu, omoiseke omwabo.
swahili: jina la mke wa Amramu ni Yokebedi, naye pia alikuwa mzao wa Lawi, ambaye alizaliwa kwa Walawi nchini Misri. Alimzalia Amramu: Aroni, Mose na dada yao Miriamu.

english: the Hezronite clan from Hezron, and the Carmite clan from Carmi.
ekegusii: na Abahezironi, abarwete ase Hezironi, na Abakarimi, abarwete ase Karimi.
swahili: kutoka kwa Hesroni, ukoo wa Wahesroni; kutoka kwa Karmi, ukoo wa Wakarmi.

english: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar were born to Aaron,
ekegusii: Basinto ba Aroni nabwo aba: Nadabu, na Abihu, na Eleazari, na Itamari.
swahili: Aroni alikuwa baba yake Nadabu na Abihu, Eleazari na Ithamari.

english: but Nadab and Abihu died when they offered unauthorized fire before the LORD.
ekegusii: Korende Nadabu na Abihu bagakwa ekero baruete ogosambwa kw’engeencho eng’ao otachiikiri ase obosio bw’Omonene.
swahili: Lakini Nadabu na Abihu walikufa wakati walitoa sadaka mbele za Bwana kwa moto usioruhusiwa.)

english: The registration of the Levites totaled 23,000, every male a month old or more; they were not numbered among the other Israelites, because no inheritance was given to them among the Israelites. Only Caleb and Joshua Remain
ekegusii: Kera omonto omosacha ase egati yabo oyo konya okoorire omotienyi oyomo na goetania nigo abaretwe. Barabwo nigo barenge chilifu emerongo ebere na isato (23,000). Abanto aba tibaabaretwe amo n’Abaisraeli bande, ekiagera tibaetwe omwando ase egati y’Abaisraeli.
swahili: Wanaume wote wa Walawi wa umri wa mwezi mmoja na zaidi walikuwa 23,000. Wao hawakuhesabiwa pamoja na Waisraeli wengine kwa sababu hawakupokea urithi miongoni mwao.

english: These were the ones numbered by Moses and Eleazar the priest when they counted the Israelites on the plains of Moab by the Jordan, across from Jericho.
ekegusii: Abanto aba nabwo Musa na Eleazari Omokuani bariigete ekero baabarete Abaisraeli agwo ase enyancha enyomo ya Moabu, ase Yorodani kororia Yeriko.
swahili: Hawa ndio walioorodheshwa na Mose na kuhani Eleazari wakati waliwahesabu Waisraeli kwenye nchi tambarare ya Moabu, kando ya Yordani ngʼambo ya Yeriko.

english: Among all these, however, there was not one who had been numbered by Moses and Aaron the priest when they counted the Israelites in the Wilderness of Sinai.
ekegusii: Korende ase egati y’ abanto aba onde tarengeo, nonya noyomo, ase baria Musa na Aroni Omokuani baabarete agwo ase erooro ya Sinai.
swahili: Hakuna hata mmoja wao aliyekuwa miongoni mwa wale waliohesabiwa na Mose na kuhani Aroni wakati waliwahesabu Waisraeli katika Jangwa la Sinai.

english: For the LORD had told them that they would surely die in the wilderness. Not one was left except Caleb son of Jephunneh and Joshua son of Nun.
ekegusii: Omonene nakwanete igoro y’abwo, “Barabwo nigo barakwere ase erooro.” Omonto onde tagotigara ore moyo nonya noyomo, otatiga Kalebu, mosinto o Yefune, na Yoshua, mosinto o Nuni.
swahili: Kwa maana Bwana alikuwa amewaambia hao Waisraeli hakika wangekufa huko jangwani, wala hakuna mmoja wao aliyeachwa, isipokuwa Kalebu mwana wa Yefune na Yoshua mwana wa Nuni.

english: These were the clans of Reuben, and their registration numbered 43,730.
ekegusii: Echi nachio chiamate chi’egesaku kia Rubeni. Abaabaretwe nigo barenge chilifu emerongo ene na isato, na amagana atano abere, na merongo etato (43,730).
swahili: Hizi zilikuwa ndizo koo za Reubeni; wale waliohesabiwa walikuwa 43,730.

english: Now the son of Pallu was Eliab,
ekegusii: Ororeria rwa Palu n’Eliabu
swahili: Mwana wa Palu alikuwa Eliabu,

english: and the sons of Eliab were Nemuel, Dathan, and Abiram. It was Dathan and Abiram, chosen by the congregation, who fought against Moses and Aaron with the followers of Korah who rebelled against the LORD.
ekegusii: amo nabana baye: Nemweli, na Datani, na Abiiramu. (Aba nabwo Datani na Abiiramu bachoretwe korwa ase omoganda. Barabwo bakaamererania na Musa na Aroni, bakaba ase ekeombe gia Kora, ekero baamereranetie n’Omonene.
swahili: nao wana wa Eliabu walikuwa Nemueli, Dathani na Abiramu. Hawa wawili Dathani na Abiramu ndio walikuwa maafisa wa jumuiya ambao walimwasi Mose na Aroni, na walikuwa miongoni mwa wafuasi wa Kora wakati walimwasi Bwana.

english: Now the daughters of Zelophehad son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, belonged to the clans of Manasseh son of Joseph. These were the names of his daughters: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah. They approached
ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio abaiseke ba Selofehadi, mosinto o Heferi o Gileadi, o Makiri, o Manase bagaacha. Aba nigo barwete ase chiamate chia Manase, mosinto o Yusufu, na amarieta abo naro aya: Mala, na Nuhu, na Hogila, na Milka, na Tirisa.
swahili: Binti za Selofehadi mwana wa Heferi, mwana wa Gileadi, mwana wa Makiri, mwana wa Manase, walikuwa wa koo za Manase mwana wa Yosefu. Majina ya hao binti yalikuwa Mahla, Noa, Hogla, Milka na Tirsa. Walikaribia

english: If he has no brothers, give his inheritance to his father’s brothers.
ekegusii: Onye omonto oyio tabwati abamura bamwabo, omwando oye oirwe nabamura bamwabo ise.
swahili: Ikiwa hana ndugu wa kiume toa urithi wake kwa ndugu za baba yake.

english: And if his father has no brothers, give his inheritance to the next of kin from his clan, that he may take possession of it. This is to be a statutory ordinance for the Israelites, as the LORD has commanded Moses.’” Moses Requests a Successor (Deuteronomy 3:23–29)
ekegusii: Na onye omonto oyio tabwati abamura bamwabo ise, omwando oye oirwe nomoamate oye ore ang’e. Okwo nigo koraabe ogochika kw’oboronge ase Abaisraeli, buna inche Omonene nagochiikire.” Yoshua Ogochorwa Koba Ribaga Ria Musa (Okoir 31:1-8)
swahili: Ikiwa baba yake hakuwa na ndugu wa kiume, toa urithi wake kwa ndugu wa karibu katika ukoo wake, ili aumiliki. Hili litakuwa dai la sheria kwa Waisraeli, kama Bwana alivyomwamuru Mose.’ ” Yoshua Kuchukua Nafasi Ya Mose (Kumbukumbu 31:1-8)

english: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Go up this mountain of the Abarim range and see the land that I have given the Israelites.
ekegusii: Omonene agakwana na Musa, akamoteebia, “Tiira gochia igoro ase egetunwa eke ki’Abarimu, na origererie ense naeire Abaisraeli.
swahili: Kisha Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Panda juu ya mlima huu katika kilele cha Abarimu uione nchi ambayo nimewapa Waisraeli.

english: After you have seen it, you too will be gathered to your people, as your brother Aaron was;
ekegusii: Ekero kwayerorire, aye nigo orasangererekane amo n’abanto bao buna Aroni omino asangererekanete amo n’abanto baye,
swahili: Baada ya kuiona, wewe pia utakusanywa pamoja na watu wako kama ndugu yako Aroni alivyokusanywa,
