english: for when the congregation contended in the Wilderness of Zin, both of you rebelled against My command to show My holiness in their sight regarding the waters.” Those were the waters of Meribah in Kadesh, in the Wilderness of Zin.
ekegusii: ekiagera timwaigwerete ring’ana riane agwo ase erooro ya Sini, rituko riria omoganda bwonsi bwemurunganetie, gose timwaorogetie ng’a inche nomochenu inde, ekero mware kobochorera abanto amaache.” (Aya namaache a Meriba ya Kadeshi ase erooro ya Sini).
swahili: kwa kuwa jumuiya ilipoasi amri yangu kwenye maji katika Jangwa la Sini, wakati jumuiya ilipogombana nami, nyote wawili mliacha kuitii amri yangu ya kuniheshimu kama mtakatifu mbele ya macho yao.” (Haya yalikuwa maji ya Meriba huko Kadeshi, katika Jangwa la Sini.)

english: So Moses appealed to the LORD,
ekegusii: Musa agakwana n’Omonene akabora,
swahili: Mose akamwambia Bwana,

english: “May the LORD, the God of the spirits of all flesh, appoint a man over the congregation
ekegusii: “Aye Omonene Nyasae, aye oyokorua obogima ase abanto bonsi, chora omonto oraraae omoganda oyo,
swahili: “ Bwana, Mungu wa roho zote za wanadamu, na amteue mtu juu ya jumuiya hii

english: who will go out and come in before them, and who will lead them out and bring them in, so that the congregation of the LORD will not be like sheep without a shepherd.” Joshua to Succeed Moses (Deuteronomy 31:1–8)
ekegusii: omonto oranyare gotang’ana abanto kobagosoka na kobakoirana, erinde omoganda bw’ abanto ba Omonene tobaisa koba buna ching’ondi chitari nomorisia.”
swahili: ili atoke na kuingia mbele yao, atakayewaongoza katika kutoka kwao na kuingia kwao, ili watu wa Bwana wasiwe kama kondoo wasio na mchungaji.”

english: And the LORD replied to Moses, “Take Joshua son of Nun, a man with the Spirit in him, and lay your hands on him.
ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa, “Ira Yoshua, mosinto o Nuni, omonto oyio omoika one ore ime yaye, erio omobekere amaboko.
swahili: Kwa hiyo Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Mchukue Yoshua mwana wa Nuni, mtu ambaye Roho yuko ndani yake, uweke mkono juu yake.

english: Have him stand before Eleazar the priest and the whole congregation, and commission him in their sight.
ekegusii: Omorente atenene ase obosio bw’Eleazari Omokuani, na ase amasio y’omoganda bwonsi bw’ abanto, erio ase amasio abo omorarie ng’a nere oirire ribaga ria’o.
swahili: Msimamishe mbele ya kuhani Eleazari pamoja na kusanyiko lote, umpe maagizo mbele yao.

english: the entrance to the Tent of Meeting, stood before Moses, Eleazar the priest, the leaders, and the whole congregation, and said,
ekegusii: Barabwo bagaacha ase obosio bwa Musa, na obwa Eleazari Omokuani, na ase amasio y’abatang’ani, na ase omoganda bwonsi, bagatenena agwo ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano, bagateeba,
swahili: ingilio la Hema la Kukutania na kusimama mbele ya Mose, kuhani Eleazari, viongozi na kusanyiko lote, wakasema,

english: Confer on him some of your authority, so that the whole congregation of Israel will obey him.
ekegusii: Omoe okobua buna okwao, erio nario omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli oramoigwere.
swahili: Mpe sehemu ya mamlaka yako ili jumuiya yote ya Waisraeli ipate kumtii.

english: He shall stand before Eleazar the priest, who will seek counsel for him before the LORD by the judgment of the Urim. At his command, he and all the Israelites with him—the entire congregation—will go out and come in.”
ekegusii: Yoshua abe ogotenena ase obosio bw’Eleazari Omokuani, na Eleazari abe okomonogeri oye ase Urimu, agwo ase obosio bwane amanye ogwancha kwane. Yoshua amo nomoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli nigo barakore emeremo yabo yonsi buna Eleazari arabachiike.”
swahili: Atasimama mbele ya kuhani Eleazari, ambaye atapokea maamuzi kwa ajili yake, kwa kuuliza mbele za Bwana kwa ile Urimu. Kwa amri yake, yeye na jumuiya yote ya Waisraeli watatoka, na kwa amri yake, wataingia.”

english: Moses did as the LORD had commanded him. He took Joshua, had him stand before Eleazar the priest and the whole congregation,
ekegusii: Musa akaira Yoshua buna Omonene konya amochiikire, akamorenta ase obosio bw’Eleazari Omokuani nomoganda bwonsi.
swahili: Mose akafanya kama Bwana alivyomwagiza. Akamtwaa Yoshua na kumsimamisha mbele ya kuhani Eleazari na kusanyiko lote.

english: and laid his hands on him and commissioned him, as the LORD had instructed through Moses.
ekegusii: Naende akabeeka amaboko aye igoro ase omotwe o Yoshua, akamwatanana, akamobeka ase ribaga riaye, buna Omonene konya amochikiire goetera ase Musa.
swahili: Kisha akaweka mikono yake juu ya kichwa cha Yoshua na kumpa maagizo, kama vile Bwana alivyoelekeza kupitia kwa Mose.

english: “Our father died in the wilderness, but he was not among the followers of Korah who gathered together against the LORD. Instead, he died because of his own sin, and he had no sons.
ekegusii: “Tata nigo akwerete agwo ase erooro. Ere tarenge ase egati y’ekeombe keria giasangererekanete amo gekaba mamincha y’Omonene, ase abwo barenge ase ensemo ya Kora, korende ere nigo akwete ase engencho y’ebibe biaye omonyene. Ekero akwete tatigete abana abamura
swahili: “Baba yetu alikufa jangwani. Hakuwa miongoni mwa wafuasi wa Kora, ambao walifungamana pamoja dhidi ya Bwana, lakini alikufa kwa ajili ya dhambi yake mwenyewe na hakuacha wana.

english: Why should the name of our father disappear from his clan because he had no sons? Give us property among our father’s brothers.”
ekegusii: Nase ki erieta ria tata rigosirigwa korwa ase eamate yaye ekiagera tabwate abana abamura? Toe naintwe omwando ase egati y’abamura bamwabo tata.”
swahili: Kwa nini jina la baba yetu lifutike kutoka ukoo wake kwa sababu hakuwa na mwana? Tupatie milki miongoni mwa ndugu za baba yetu.”

english: So Moses brought their case before the LORD,
ekegusii: Musa akaira amang’ana abo ase obosio bw’Omonene,
swahili: Kwa hiyo Mose akalileta shauri lao mbele za Bwana,

english: and the LORD answered him,
ekegusii: n’Omonene akamoteebia,
swahili: naye Bwana akamwambia Mose,

english: “The daughters of Zelophehad speak correctly. You certainly must give them property as an inheritance among their father’s brothers, and transfer their father’s inheritance to them.
ekegusii: “Abaiseke ba Selofehadi nekeene bakoboria. Bae omwando obo ase egati ya bamura bamwabo ise. Tiga omwando o ise obe oyobo.
swahili: “Wanachosema binti za Selofehadi ni sawa. Ni lazima kwa hakika uwape milki kama urithi miongoni mwa ndugu za baba yao, na kubadili urithi wa baba yao uwe wao.

english: Furthermore, you shall say to the Israelites, ‘If a man dies and leaves no son, you are to transfer his inheritance to his daughter.
ekegusii: Naende oteebie Abaisraeli ng’a omonto karakwe, onye ere tabwati omwana omomura, omwando bw’omonto oyio omwana oye omoiseke ayoire.
swahili: “Waambie Waisraeli, ‘Ikiwa mtu atakufa naye hakuacha mwana, utampa binti yake urithi wake.

english: If he has no daughter, give his inheritance to his brothers.
ekegusii: Onye omonto oyio tabwati nonya nomwana omoiseke, omwando oye abamura bamwabo bayoire.
swahili: Ikiwa hana binti, wape ndugu zake wa kiume urithi wake.

english: This is the burnt offering for every Sabbath, in addition to the regular burnt offering and its drink offering. The Monthly Offerings
ekegusii: Eke nekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa gia kera Esabato gekoruegwa amo nekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa gia kera rituko, na okoruegwa gw’ekenyugwa gochiikire amo. Ekeng’wanso Kie Rituko Rie Ritang’ani Ri’omotienyi
swahili: Hii ni sadaka ya kuteketezwa itakayotolewa kwa ajili ya kila Sabato, pamoja na sadaka ya kawaida ya kuteketezwa na sadaka yake ya kinywaji. Sadaka Za Kila Mwezi

english: At the beginning of every month, you are to present to the LORD a burnt offering of two young bulls, one ram, and seven male lambs a year old, all unblemished,
ekegusii: Ase rituko rie ritang’ani ria kera omotienyi mobe mokorua ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa ase Omonene. Morue chieri chinsae ibere, na emingichi eyemo, ne chimanwa chimingichi isan’aibere, echiakoorire omwaka oyomo, chionsi echitari na kemocho ase emebere yabo.
swahili: “ ‘Siku ya kwanza ya kila mwezi, mtamletea Bwana sadaka ya kuteketezwa ya fahali wawili wachanga, kondoo dume mmoja na wana-kondoo saba wa mwaka mmoja, wote wasiokuwa na dosari.

english: along with three-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering with each bull, two-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering with the ram,
ekegusii: Morue okoruegwa kw’endagera, obosie obonuke bwochoganirie n’amaguta y’amazeituni. Amo na kera eeri morue obosie ebimunu bitano na kemo, na amo nemingichi eria obosie ebimunu bine,
swahili: Pamoja na kila fahali, kutakuwa na sadaka ya nafaka ya unga laini sehemu tatu za kumi za efa, uliochanganywa na mafuta, pamoja na kondoo dume mmoja, sadaka ya nafaka ya unga laini uliochanganywa na mafuta;

english: and a tenth of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering with each lamb. This is a burnt offering, a pleasing aroma, an offering made by fire to the LORD.
ekegusii: na amo na kera emanwa emingichi, obosie ebimunu bibere. Ebing’wanso ebio bi’ogosambwa nigo bire okoruegwa kw’endagera kore ne rimisu rigiya kogosambwa n’omorero ase Omonene.
swahili: pamoja na kila mwana-kondoo, sadaka ya nafaka yenye uzito wa sehemu ya kumi ya efa ya unga laini uliochanganywa na mafuta. Hii ni kwa ajili ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa, harufu nzuri, sadaka ya kuteketezwa iliyotolewa kwa moto kwa Bwana.

english: Their drink offerings shall be half a hin of wine with each bull, a third of a hin with the ram, and a quarter hin with each lamb. This is the monthly burnt offering to be made at each new moon throughout the year.
ekegusii: Ekenyugwa gekoruegwa amo na kera eeri nigo kerabe edivai ebituba bibere, na amo nemingichi eria, edivai egetuba ekemo na ekeng’ese, na amo na kera emanwa emingichi edivai egetuba ekemo. Eke ’nkebe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa gekoruegwa kera omotienyi ase emetienyi yonsi y’omwaka.
swahili: Pamoja na kila fahali kutakuwa na sadaka ya kinywaji nusu ya hini ya divai; pamoja na kila kondoo dume, theluthi moja ya hini, na pamoja na kila mwana-kondoo robo hini. Hii ni sadaka ya kuteketezwa ya kila mwezi itakayotolewa kila mwandamo wa mwezi kwa mwaka.

english: In addition to the regular burnt offering with its drink offering, one male goat is to be presented to the LORD as a sin offering. Passover and the Feast of Unleavened Bread (Exodus 12:14–28; Leviticus 23:4–8; Deuteronomy 16:1–8)
ekegusii: Amo nekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa gia kera rituko na okoruegwa gw’ekenyugwa, morue egoree eyemo ase Omonene, ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe. Ebing’wanso bi’Amatuko Amanene y’Emegati Etabekiri Memera (Abal 23:5-14)
swahili: Zaidi ya sadaka ya kawaida ya kuteketezwa pamoja na sadaka yake ya kinywaji, mbuzi mmoja dume atatolewa kwa Bwana kama sadaka ya dhambi. Pasaka (Walawi 23:5-14)

english: The fourteenth day of the first month is the LORD’s Passover.
ekegusii: Rituko ria ikomi na kane ri’omotienyi bw’eritang’ani nerituko ri’Epasaka y’Omonene.
swahili: “ ‘Katika siku ya kumi na nne ya mwezi wa kwanza, itafanyika Pasaka ya Bwana.

english: On the fifteenth day of this month, there shall be a feast; for seven days unleavened bread is to be eaten.
ekegusii: Ase rituko ria ikomi na gatano ri’omotienyi oyio nario Rituko Rinene. Ase amatuko atan’abere morie emagaati etabekiri memera.
swahili: Katika siku ya kumi na tano ya mwezi huo itakuwa sikukuu; kwa siku saba mtakula mikate isiyotiwa chachu.

english: On the first day there is to be a sacred assembly; you must not do any regular work.
ekegusii: Ase rituko rie ritang’ani mobe nomosangererekano bwatananire ase ogosasiima. Timokora emeremo ya kera rituko ase rituko erio.
swahili: Katika siku ya kwanza mtakuwa na kusanyiko takatifu, msifanye kazi za kawaida.

english: Present to the LORD an offering made by fire, a burnt offering of two young bulls, one ram, and seven male lambs a year old, all unblemished.
ekegusii: Morue ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa kegosambwa nomorero ase Omonene, chieri chinsae ibere, na emingichi eyemo, ne chimanwa chimingichi isano na ibere echiakoorire omwaka oyomo, chionsi chibe chitari na kemocho ase emebere yabo.
swahili: Leteni mbele za Bwana sadaka ya kuteketezwa, sadaka ya kuteketezwa ya mafahali wawili wachanga, kondoo dume mmoja na wana-kondoo dume saba wenye umri wa mwaka mmoja, wote wasio na dosari.

english: “Command the Israelites and say to them: See that you present to Me at its appointed time the food for My offerings by fire, as a pleasing aroma to Me.
ekegusii: “Kwana n’Abaisraeli obachike ng’a ase ekero keria gechiikire goika banduere ebing’wanso na okoruegwa kw’endagera kogosambwa nomorero kore ne rimisu rigiya rikongwenera.
swahili: “Wape Waisraeli agizo hili na uwaambie: ‘Hakikisheni kwamba mnaniletea mimi kwa wakati uliowekwa chakula kwa ajili ya sadaka za kuteketezwa kwa moto, kama harufu nzuri ya kupendeza.’

english: The grain offering shall consist of fine flour mixed with oil; offer three-tenths of an ephah with each bull, two-tenths of an ephah with the ram,
ekegusii: Naende morue okoruegwa kw’endagera obosie obonuke bwochoganirie n’amaguta: Amo na kera eeri ensae morue obosie ebimunu bitano na kemo, na amo nemingichi eria obosie ebimunu bine,
swahili: Pamoja na kila fahali, andaa sadaka ya nafaka sehemu tatu za kumi za efa za unga laini uliochanganywa na mafuta; pamoja na kondoo dume, andaa sehemu mbili za kumi za efa;

english: and a tenth of an ephah with each of the seven lambs.
ekegusii: na amo na kera eyemo ye chimanwa chimingichi chiria isan’aibere obosie ebimunu bibere.
swahili: pia pamoja na kila mmoja wa wale wana-kondoo saba, andaa sehemu ya kumi ya efa.

english: Include one male goat as a sin offering to make atonement for you.
ekegusii: Naende morue egoree eyemo ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe ase ogokora okobwatanigwa ase more.
swahili: Pia mtoe beberu mmoja kama sadaka ya dhambi ambaye atafanya upatanisho kwa ajili yenu.

english: You are to present these in addition to the regular morning burnt offering.
ekegusii: Igo morarue ebinto ebi amo nekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa gia kera rituko botambe.
swahili: Andaa hizi licha ya zile sadaka za kawaida za kuteketezwa za kila asubuhi.

english: Offer the same food each day for seven days as an offering made by fire, a pleasing aroma to the LORD. It is to be offered with its drink offering and the regular burnt offering.
ekegusii: Ase enchera eyio kera rituko, ase amatuko atano na abere, mobe mokoruera Omonene okoruegwa kw’endagera kogosambwa nomorero, kere ne rimisu rigiya rikomogwenera. Morue okoruegwa okwo amo nekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa gwa kera rituko, na okoruegwa gw’ekenyugwa gochiikire.
swahili: Kwa njia hii andaa chakula cha sadaka ya kuteketezwa kila siku, kwa siku saba kama harufu nzuri impendezayo Bwana. Hii itaandaliwa licha ya ile sadaka ya kawaida ya kuteketezwa ya kila siku pamoja na sadaka yake ya kinywaji.

english: On the seventh day you shall hold a sacred assembly; you must not do any regular work. The Feast of Weeks (Deuteronomy 16:9–12)
ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatano na kabere mobe nomosangererekano bwatananire ase ogosasiima. Timokora emeremo ya kera rituko ase rituko erio. Ebing’wanso Bie Rituko Rie Rigesa (Abal 23:15-22)
swahili: Siku ya saba mwe na kusanyiko takatifu na msifanye kazi zenu za kawaida. Sikukuu Ya Majuma (Walawi 23:15-22)

english: On the day of firstfruits, when you present an offering of new grain to the LORD during the Feast of Weeks, you are to hold a sacred assembly; you must not do any regular work.
ekegusii: Ase rituko rie ritang’ani rie rigesa, ekero moraabe mokorenta okoruegwa kw’endagera enyia ase Omonene, ase Rituko Rinene rie Chichuma, ’namobe nomosangererekano bwatananire ase ogosasiima. Timokora emeremo ya kera rituko ase rituko erio.
swahili: “ ‘Siku ya malimbuko, mnapomletea Bwana sadaka ya nafaka mpya wakati wa Sikukuu ya Majuma, mwe na kusanyiko takatifu na msifanye kazi zenu za kawaida.

english: Present a burnt offering of two young bulls, one ram, and seven male lambs a year old as a pleasing aroma to the LORD,
ekegusii: Morue chieri chinsae ibere, na emingichi eyemo, amo ne chimanwa chimingichi isano na ibere, echiakoorire omwaka oyomo. Echi nchibe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa kere ne rimisu rigiya rikogwenera Omonene.
swahili: Mlete sadaka ya kuteketezwa ya mafahali wawili wachanga, kondoo dume mmoja, na pia wana-kondoo saba wenye umri wa mwaka mmoja, kama harufu nzuri ya kumpendeza Bwana.

english: together with their grain offerings of fine flour mixed with oil—three-tenths of an ephah with each bull, two-tenths of an ephah with the ram,
ekegusii: Amo nekeng’wanso ekio morue okoruegwa kw’endagera, obosie obonuke bwochoganirie n’amaguta ’amazeituni. Amo na kera eeri morue obosie ebimunu bitano na kemo, na amo nemingichi eria obosie ebimunu bine,
swahili: Pamoja na kila fahali itatolewa sadaka ya nafaka ya unga laini sehemu tatu za kumi za efa uliochanganywa na mafuta; pamoja na kondoo dume, andaa sehemu mbili za kumi za efa za unga laini;

english: and a tenth of an ephah with each of the seven lambs.
ekegusii: na amo na kera eyemo ye chimanwa chimingichi chiria isano na ibere obosie ebimunu bibere.
swahili: na sehemu ya kumi ya efa ya unga laini kwa kila mmoja wa wana-kondoo saba.

english: And tell them that this is the offering made by fire you are to present to the LORD as a regular burnt offering each day: two unblemished year-old male lambs.
ekegusii: “Obateebie: Eke nakio ekeng’wanso kegosambwa nomorero moramoruere Omonene: Kera rituko botambe morue chimanwa chimingichi ibere, echiakoorire omwaka oyomo, chitari na kemocho ase emebere yabo.
swahili: Waambie: ‘Hii ni sadaka ya kuteketezwa kwa moto mnayomtolea Bwana: wana-kondoo wawili wa mwaka mmoja wasio na dosari, kama sadaka ya kawaida ya kuteketezwa kila siku.

english: Include one male goat to make atonement for you.
ekegusii: Naende morue egoree eyemo ase ogokora okobwatanigwa ase more.
swahili: Ongeza beberu mmoja kwa kufanya upatanisho kwa ajili yenu.

english: Offer them with their drink offerings in addition to the regular burnt offering and its grain offering. The animals must be unblemished.
ekegusii: Morue ekeng’wanso ekio amo nekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa gwa kera rituko, na okoruegwa kw’endagera. Ching’iti echio chionsi chi’ebing’wanso chibe chitari na kemocho ase emebere yabo, chiruegwe amo n’okoruegwa gw’ekenyugwa gochiikire amo.
swahili: Andaa hizi sadaka pamoja na sadaka zake za vinywaji, kuwa nyongeza ya sadaka za kawaida za kuteketezwa, pamoja na sadaka yake ya nafaka. Hakikisha kuwa wanyama hao hawana dosari.

english: Offer one lamb in the morning and the other at twilight,
ekegusii: Eyemo y’echio oyerue mambia, na eyende mogoroba.
swahili: Andaa mwana-kondoo mmoja asubuhi na mwingine jioni,

english: along with a tenth of an ephah of fine flour as a grain offering, mixed with a quarter hin of oil from pressed olives.
ekegusii: Kera eyemo oyerue amo n’okoruegwa kw’endagera, ebimunu bibere bi’obosie obonuke bwochoganirie n’amaguta amitire korwa ase amazeituni egetuba ekemo.
swahili: kila mmoja atolewe pamoja na sadaka ya nafaka sehemu ya kumi ya efa ya unga laini uliochanganywa pamoja na robo ya hini ya mafuta ya zeituni.

english: This is a regular burnt offering established at Mount Sinai as a pleasing aroma, an offering made by fire to the LORD.
ekegusii: Ekio nekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa gia kera rituko, ekio Musa aruete ritang’ani agwo ase egetunwa gia Sinai gekaba rimisu rigiya, ekeng’wanso kegosambwa nomorero ase Omonene.
swahili: Hii ni sadaka ya kawaida ya kuteketezwa iliyoanzishwa katika Mlima Sinai kama harufu nzuri ya kupendeza, sadaka iliyotolewa kwa Bwana kwa moto.

english: The drink offering accompanying each lamb shall be a quarter hin. Pour out the offering of fermented drink to the LORD in the sanctuary area.
ekegusii: Orue okoruegwa gw’ekenyugwa egetuba ekemo, amo nemingichi eria entang’ani. Ekenyugwa eke egetindi keraumorwe agwo Aase Aachenu, ase obosio bw’Omonene.
swahili: Sadaka ya kinywaji itakayotolewa pamoja na kila mwana-kondoo ni robo ya hini ya kinywaji kilichochachuka. Mimina sadaka ya kinywaji kwa Bwana mahali patakatifu.

english: And offer the second lamb at twilight, with the same grain offering and drink offering as in the morning. It is an offering made by fire, a pleasing aroma to the LORD. The Sabbath Offerings
ekegusii: Emingichi eria ya kabere oyerue mogoroba amo n’okoruegwa kw’endagera, na ogw’ekenyugwa, buna kwaruete eria ya mambia. Eke nekeng’wanso kegosambwa nomorero, kere ne rimisu rigiya rikogwenera Omonene.” Ekeng’wanso gi’Esabato
swahili: Andaa yule mwana-kondoo wa pili jioni, pamoja na sadaka ya nafaka na sadaka ya kinywaji kama ulivyofanya kwa ile sadaka nyingine ya asubuhi. Hii ni sadaka iliyotolewa kwa kuteketezwa kwa moto, harufu nzuri ya kumpendeza Bwana. Sadaka Za Sabato

english: On the Sabbath day, present two unblemished year-old male lambs, accompanied by a grain offering of two-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil, as well as a drink offering.
ekegusii: Ase rituko ri’Esabato morue chimanwa chimingichi ibere, echiakoorire omwaka oyomo, chitari na kemocho ase emebere yabo. Amo nachirochio morue obosie obonuke ebimunu bine bwochoganirie amaguta y’amazeituni, bibe okoruegwa kw’endagera. Morue boigo okoruegwa gw’ekenyugwa gochiikire.
swahili: “ ‘Siku ya Sabato, utatoa sadaka ya wana-kondoo wawili wa mwaka mmoja wasiokuwa na dosari pamoja na sadaka yake ya kinywaji na sadaka ya nafaka yenye uzito wa sehemu mbili za kumi za efa za unga laini uliochanganywa na mafuta.

english: “On the first day of the seventh month, you are to hold a sacred assembly, and you must not do any regular work. This will be a day for you to sound the trumpets.
ekegusii: Ase rituko rie ritang’ani ri’omotienyi o gatano na kabere ’namobe nomosangererekano bwatananire ase ogosasiima. Timokora emeremo ya kera rituko. Rituko erio nigo rirabe rituko ri’okobugia ebiroria.
swahili: “ ‘Katika siku ya kwanza ya mwezi wa saba mtakuwa na kusanyiko takatifu na msifanye kazi ya kawaida. Ni siku kwa ajili yenu ya kupiga tarumbeta.

english: and a tenth of an ephah with each of the seven lambs.
ekegusii: na amo na kera eyemo ye chimanwa chimingichi, chiria isan’aibere, obosie ebimunu bibere.
swahili: na kwa kila mmoja wa wana-kondoo saba andaa sehemu ya kumi ya unga laini kwa kila mmoja.

english: Include one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the sin offering of atonement and the regular burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offerings. The Feast of Tabernacles (Deuteronomy 16:13–17)
ekegusii: Naende morue egoree eyemo ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, kementwe ase ekeng’wanso ki’ogokora okobwatanigwa, na ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa gwa kera rituko, amo n’okoruegwa kw’endagera na okw’ebinyugwa gochiikire amo nabirobio. Ebing’wanso bi’Amatuko Amanane y’Ebigutu (Abal 23:26-32)
swahili: Ongeza beberu mmoja kama sadaka ya dhambi, katika nyongeza ya sadaka ya dhambi kwa ajili ya upatanisho, na sadaka ya kawaida ya kuteketezwa pamoja na sadaka yake ya nafaka, na sadaka zake za vinywaji. Sikukuu Ya Vibanda (Walawi 23:33-44)

english: On the fifteenth day of the seventh month, you are to hold a sacred assembly; you must not do any regular work, and you shall observe a feast to the LORD for seven days.
ekegusii: Ase rituko ria ikomi na gatano ri’omotienyi o gatano na kabere mobe nomosangererekano bwatananire ase ogosasiima. Timokora emeremo ende yonsi, korende morende Rituko Rinene ri’Omonene ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere.
swahili: “ ‘Katika siku ya kumi na tano ya mwezi wa saba, mtakuwa na kusanyiko takatifu, na hamtafanya kazi za kawaida. Adhimisheni sikukuu kwa Bwana kwa siku saba.

english: As a pleasing aroma to the LORD, you are to present an offering made by fire, a burnt offering of thirteen young bulls, two rams, and fourteen male lambs a year old, all unblemished,
ekegusii: Morue chieri ikomi na isato, ne chimingichi ibere, ne chimanwa chimingichi ikomi na inye, echiakoorire omwaka oyomo, chionsi chibe chitari ne kemocho ase emebere yabo. Echio nchibe ekengwanso kegosambwa nomorero, kere ne rimisu rigiya rikogwenera Omonene.
swahili: Toeni sadaka ya kuteketezwa mafahali wachanga kumi na watatu, kondoo dume wawili, na wana-kondoo kumi na wanne wa mwaka mmoja, wote wasio na dosari, kama harufu nzuri inayompendeza Bwana.

english: along with the grain offering of three-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil with each of the thirteen bulls, two-tenths of an ephah with each of the two rams,
ekegusii: Amo nechio morue okoruegwa kw’endagera, obosie obonuke bwochoganirie n’amaguta. Amo na kera eyemo ye chieri chiria ikomi na isato morue obosie ebimunu bitan’akemo, na amo na kera eyemo ye chimingichi chiria ibere obosie ebimunu bine,
swahili: Pamoja na hao mafahali kumi na watatu, kila mmoja aandaliwe na sadaka ya nafaka sehemu ya kumi tatu za efa za unga laini uliochanganywa na mafuta; kwa kondoo dume wawili, kila mmoja aandaliwe sehemu ya kumi mbili za efa za unga laini;

english: and a tenth of an ephah with each of the fourteen lambs.
ekegusii: na amo na kera eyemo ye chimanwa chimingichi chiria ikomi na inye obosie ebimunu bibere.
swahili: na kwa wana-kondoo kumi na wanne, kila mmoja aandaliwe sehemu ya kumi ya efa ya unga laini.

english: Include one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offering.
ekegusii: Naende morue egoree eyemo ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe. Ebing’wanso ebio bimentwe ase ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa gia kera rituko, na okoruegwa kw’endagera, na okw’ebinyugwa gochiikire amo nabirobio.
swahili: Ongeza beberu mmoja kama sadaka ya dhambi, kwa nyongeza ya sadaka ya kawaida ya kuteketezwa, na sadaka yake ya nafaka, pamoja na sadaka ya vinywaji.

english: On the second day you are to present twelve young bulls, two rams, and fourteen male lambs a year old, all unblemished,
ekegusii: Rituko ria kabere morue chieri chinsae ikomi na ibere, ne chimingichi ibere, ne chimanwa chimingichi ikomi na inye, echiakoorire omwaka oyomo, chionsi chibe chitari na kemocho ase emebere yabo.
swahili: “ ‘Katika siku ya pili andaeni mafahali wachanga kumi na wawili, kondoo dume wawili, na wana-kondoo kumi na wanne wa mwaka mmoja, wote wasio na dosari.

english: along with the grain and drink offerings for the bulls, rams, and lambs, according to the number prescribed.
ekegusii: Mochirue amo n’okoruegwa kw’endagera, na okw’ebinyugwa gochiikire koruerwa amo ne chieri chiria, ne chimingichi chiria, ne chimanwa chimingichi chiria, koreng’ana nomobaro obo. Boigo mochirue koreng’ana nomoroberio ochiikire.
swahili: Pamoja na mafahali, kondoo dume, na wana-kondoo, andaeni sadaka zao za nafaka na sadaka za vinywaji, kulingana na idadi iliyoainishwa.

english: Include one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offering.
ekegusii: Naende morue egoree eyemo ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe. Ebing’wanso ebio bimentwe ase ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa gwa kera rituko. Morue n’okoruegwa kw’endagera, na okw’ebinyugwa gochiikire amo nabirobio.
swahili: Weka beberu mmoja kama sadaka ya dhambi, kwa nyongeza ya kawaida ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa, na sadaka yake ya nafaka, pamoja na sadaka zao za vinywaji.

english: As a pleasing aroma to the LORD, you are to present a burnt offering of one young bull, one ram, and seven male lambs a year old, all unblemished,
ekegusii: Morue eeri ensae eyemo, na emingichi enene eyemo, ne chimingichi chimanwa isano na ibere, echiakoorire omwaka oyomo, chitari na kemocho ase emebere yabo, chibe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa kere ne rimisu rigiya rikogwenera Omonene.
swahili: Mtatayarisha sadaka ya kuteketezwa kama harufu nzuri impendezayo Bwana ya fahali mmoja mchanga, kondoo dume mmoja, na wana-kondoo saba wa mwaka mmoja, wote wasio na dosari.

english: On the third day you are to present eleven bulls, two rams, and fourteen male lambs a year old, all unblemished,
ekegusii: Rituko ria gatato morue chieri ikomi nemo, ne chimingichi ibere, ne chimanwa chimingichi ikomi na inye, echiakoorire omwaka oyomo, chionsi chibe chitari na kemocho ase emebere yabo.
swahili: “ ‘Katika siku ya tatu andaeni mafahali wachanga kumi na wawili, kondoo dume wawili, na wana-kondoo kumi na wanne wa mwaka mmoja, wote wasio na dosari.

english: along with the grain and drink offerings for the bulls, rams, and lambs, according to the number prescribed.
ekegusii: Mochirue amo n’okoruegwa kw’endagera na okw’ebinyugwa gochiikire koruegwa amo ne chieri chiria, ne chimingichi chiria, ne chimanwa chimingichi chiria, koreng’ana nomobaro obo. Boigo mochirue koreng’ana nomoroberio ochiikire.
swahili: Pamoja na mafahali, kondoo dume, na wana-kondoo, andaeni sadaka zao za nafaka na sadaka za vinywaji, kulingana na idadi iliyoainishwa.

english: Include one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offering.
ekegusii: Naende morue egoree eyemo ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe. Ebing’wanso ebio bimentwe ase ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa gia kera rituko, na okoruegwa kw’endagera, na okw’ebinyugwa gochiikire amo nabirobio.
swahili: Weka beberu mmoja kama sadaka ya dhambi, kwa nyongeza ya kawaida ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa, na sadaka yake ya nafaka, pamoja na sadaka zao za vinywaji.

english: On the fourth day you are to present ten bulls, two rams, and fourteen male lambs a year old, all unblemished,
ekegusii: Rituko ria kane morue chieri ikomi, ne chimingichi ibere, ne chimanwa chimingichi ikomi na inye, echiakoorire omwaka oyomo, chionsi chibe chitari na kemocho ase emebere yabo.
swahili: “ ‘Katika siku ya nne andaeni mafahali wachanga kumi na wawili, kondoo dume wawili, na wana-kondoo kumi na wanne wa mwaka mmoja, wote wasio na dosari.

english: along with the grain and drink offerings for the bulls, rams, and lambs, according to the number prescribed.
ekegusii: Mochirue amo n’okoruegwa kw’endagera na okw’ebinyugwa gochiikire koruegwa amo ne chieri chiria, ne chimingichi chiria, ne chimanwa chiria, koreng’ana nomobaro obo. Boigo mochirue koreng’ana nomoroberio ochiikire.
swahili: Pamoja na mafahali, kondoo dume, na wana-kondoo, andaeni sadaka zao za nafaka na sadaka za vinywaji, kulingana na idadi iliyoainishwa.

english: Include one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offering.
ekegusii: Naende morue egoree eyemo ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe. Ebing’wanso ebio bimentwe ase ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa gwa kera rituko, na okoruegwa kw’endagera, na okw’ebinyugwa gochiikire amo nabirobio.
swahili: Weka beberu mmoja kama sadaka ya dhambi, kwa nyongeza ya kawaida ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa, na sadaka yake ya nafaka, pamoja na sadaka zao za vinywaji.

english: On the fifth day you are to present nine bulls, two rams, and fourteen male lambs a year old, all unblemished,
ekegusii: Rituko ria gatano morue chieri kianda, ne chimingichi ibere, ne chimanwa chimingichi ikomi na inye, echiakoorire omwaka oyomo, chionsi chibe chitari na kemocho ase emebere yabo.
swahili: “ ‘Katika siku ya tano andaeni mafahali tisa, kondoo dume wawili na wana-kondoo kumi na wanne wa mwaka mmoja, wote wasio na dosari.

english: along with the grain and drink offerings for the bulls, rams, and lambs, according to the number prescribed.
ekegusii: Mochirue amo n’okoruegwa kw’endagera, na okw’ebinyugwa gochiikire koruegwa amo ne chieri chiria, ne chimingichi chiria, ne chimanwa chimingichi chiria, koreng’ana nomobaro obo. Boigo mochirue koreng’ana nomoroberio ochiikire.
swahili: Pamoja na mafahali, kondoo dume na wana-kondoo, andaeni sadaka zao za nafaka na sadaka za kinywaji kulingana na idadi iliyoainishwa.

english: Include one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offering.
ekegusii: Naende morue egoree eyemo ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe. Ebing’wanso ebio bimentwe ase ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa gwa kera rituko, na okoruegwa kw’endagera na okw’ebinyugwa gochiikire amo nabirobio.
swahili: Ongeza beberu mmoja kama sadaka ya dhambi katika nyongeza ya sadaka ya kawaida ya kuteketezwa na sadaka yake ya nafaka pamoja na sadaka ya kinywaji.

english: On the sixth day you are to present eight bulls, two rams, and fourteen male lambs a year old, all unblemished,
ekegusii: Rituko ria gatano na rimo morue chieri isano na isato, ne chimingichi ibere, ne chimanwa chimingichi ikomi na inye, echiakoorire omwaka oyomo, chionsi chibe chitari na kemocho ase emebere yabo.
swahili: “ ‘Katika siku ya sita andaeni mafahali wachanga kumi na wawili, kondoo dume wawili, na wana-kondoo kumi na wanne wa mwaka mmoja, wote wasio na dosari.

english: together with their grain offerings of fine flour mixed with oil—three-tenths of an ephah with the bull, two-tenths of an ephah with the ram,
ekegusii: Amo nekeng’wanso ekio morue okoruegwa kw’endagera, obosie obonuke bwochoganirie n’amaguta: Amo neeri eria morue obosie ebimunu bitano na kemo, na amo nemingichi eria obosie ebimunu bine,
swahili: Pamoja na fahali, andaeni sadaka ya nafaka sehemu ya kumi tatu za efa za unga laini uliochanganywa na mafuta; kwa kondoo dume, andaa unga sehemu ya kumi mbili za efa;

english: Include one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offering.
ekegusii: Naende morue egoree eyemo ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe. Ebing’wanso ebio bimentwe ase ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa gwa kera rituko, na okoruegwa kw’endagera na okw’ebinyugwa gochiikire amo nabirobio.
swahili: Weka beberu mmoja kama sadaka ya dhambi, kwa nyongeza ya kawaida ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa, na sadaka yake ya nafaka, pamoja na sadaka zao za vinywaji.

english: On the seventh day you are to present seven bulls, two rams, and fourteen male lambs a year old, all unblemished,
ekegusii: Rituko ria gatan’akabere morue chieri isan’aibere, ne chimingichi ibere, ne chimanwa chimingichi ikomi na inye, echiakoorire omwaka oyomo, chionsi chibe chitari na kemocho ase emebere yabo.
swahili: “ ‘Katika siku ya saba andaeni mafahali wachanga kumi na wawili, kondoo dume wawili, na wana-kondoo kumi na wanne wa mwaka mmoja, wote wasio na dosari.

english: along with the grain and drink offerings for the bulls, rams, and lambs, according to the number prescribed.
ekegusii: Mochirue amo n’okoruegwa kw’endagera na okw’ebinyugwa gochiikire koruegwa amo ne chieri chiria, ne chimingichi chiria, ne chimanwa chimingichi chiria koreng’ana nomobaro obo. Boigo mochirue koreng’ana nomoroberio ochiikire.
swahili: Pamoja na mafahali, kondoo dume, na wana-kondoo, andaeni sadaka zao za nafaka na sadaka za vinywaji, kulingana na idadi iliyoainishwa.

english: On the eighth day you are to hold a solemn assembly; you must not do any regular work.
ekegusii: Rituko ria gatano na gatato goika mobe nomosangererekano bwatananire ase ogosasiima. Timokora emeremo ya kera rituko ase rituko erio.
swahili: “ ‘Katika siku ya nane mtakuwa na kusanyiko, na msifanye kazi ya kawaida.

english: As a pleasing aroma to the LORD, you are to present an offering made by fire, a burnt offering of one bull, one ram, and seven male lambs a year old, all unblemished,
ekegusii: Morue eeri eyemo, na emingichi eyemo, ne chimanwa chimingichi isan’aibere, echiakoorire omwaka oyomo, chionsi chibe chitari na kemocho ase emebere yabo. Echi nachibe ekeng’wanso kegosambwa nomorero ase Omonene, kebe ne rimisu rigiya rikomogwenera.
swahili: Toeni sadaka ya kuteketezwa kama harufu nzuri inayompendeza Bwana, sadaka ya kuteketezwa ya fahali mmoja, kondoo dume mmoja, na wana-kondoo dume saba wa mwaka mmoja, wote wasio na dosari.

english: along with the grain and drink offerings for the bulls, rams, and lambs, according to the number prescribed.
ekegusii: Mochirue amo n’okoruegwa kw’endagera na okw’ebinyugwa gochiikire koruegwa amo neeri eria, na emingichi eria, ne chimanwa chimingichi chiria, koreng’ana nomobaro obo. Boigo mochirue koreng’ana nomoroberio ochiikire.
swahili: Pamoja na fahali, kondoo dume na wana-kondoo, andaeni sadaka zao za nafaka, na sadaka za vinywaji, kulingana na idadi iliyoainishwa.

english: Include one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offering.
ekegusii: Naende morue egoree eyemo ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe. Ebing’wanso ebio bimentwe ase ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa gwa kera rituko, na okoruegwa kw’endagera, na okw’ebinyugwa gochiikire amo nabirobio.
swahili: Ongeza beberu mmoja kama sadaka ya dhambi, katika nyongeza ya sadaka ya kawaida ya kuteketezwa, na sadaka yake ya nafaka pamoja na sadaka ya kinywaji.

english: You are to present these offerings to the LORD at your appointed times, in addition to your vow and freewill offerings, whether burnt offerings, grain offerings, drink offerings, or peace offerings.”
ekegusii: Ebing’wanso ebio amo n’okoruegwa okwo goika mobirue ase Omonene ase chingaki chi’Amatuko aino Amanene achorire. Nabirobio bimentwe ase ebing’wanso biaino mwariete chiira ng’a morue, na ebing’wanso bi’ogwancha, onye nebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa, gose okoruegwa kw’endagera, gose okw’ebinyugwa, gose ebing’wanso bi’omorembe.
swahili: “ ‘Zaidi ya kile unachoweka nadhiri na sadaka zenu za hiari, andaeni hizi kwa ajili ya Bwana kwenye sikukuu zenu zilizoamriwa: sadaka zenu za kuteketezwa, sadaka za nafaka, sadaka za vinywaji, pamoja na sadaka zenu za amani.’ ”

english: and a tenth of an ephah with each of the seven male lambs.
ekegusii: boigo ase kera eyemo ye chimanwa ye chimingichi chiria isano na ibere, obosie ebimunu bibere.
swahili: na pamoja na wana-kondoo saba kila mmoja aandaliwe na sehemu ya kumi ya efa ya unga.

english: So Moses spoke all this to the Israelites just as the LORD had commanded him.
ekegusii: Musa agateebia Abaisraeli amang’ana onsi buna Omonene konya amochiikire.
swahili: Mose akawaambia Waisraeli yale yote Bwana alimwagiza.

english: Include one male goat as a sin offering to make atonement for you.
ekegusii: Naende morue egoree eyemo ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe ase ogokora okobwatanigwa ase more.
swahili: Ongeza beberu mmoja kama sadaka ya dhambi kufanya upatanisho kwa ajili yenu.

english: These are in addition to the monthly and daily burnt offerings with their prescribed grain offerings and drink offerings. They are a pleasing aroma, an offering made by fire to the LORD. The Day of Atonement (Leviticus 16:1–34; Leviticus 23:26–32)
ekegusii: Ebing’wanso ebio bimentwe ase ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa ki’Omotienyi Omoyia, amo n’okoruegwa kw’endagera gochiikire, na ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa gia kera rituko na okoruegwa kw’endagera na ogw’ekenyugwa gokorentwa amo nebio, koreng’ana nomoroberio ochiikire. Ebinto ebio bire ne rimisu rigiya, okoruegwa kogosambwa nomorero ase Omonene. Ebing’wanso Bie Rituko Ri’okobwatanigwa
swahili: Hivi ni nyongeza ya sadaka za kuteketezwa kila mwezi na kila siku pamoja na sadaka zake za nafaka na sadaka za vinywaji kama ilivyoainishwa. Ni sadaka zinazotolewa kwa Bwana kwa moto, harufu inayopendeza. Siku Ya Upatanisho (Walawi 23:26-32)

english: On the tenth day of this seventh month, you are to hold a sacred assembly, and you shall humble yourselves; you must not do any work.
ekegusii: Ase rituko ria ikomi ri’omotienyi oyio o gatan’akabere, mobe nomosangererekano bwatananire ase ogosasiima. Mobe mokweng’ata na gweitia. Timokora emeremo ende yonsi.
swahili: “ ‘Kwenye siku ya kumi ya mwezi huu wa saba mtakuwa na kusanyiko takatifu. Mtajikana wenyewe na msifanye kazi.

english: Present as a pleasing aroma to the LORD a burnt offering of one young bull, one ram, and seven male lambs a year old, all unblemished,
ekegusii: Morue eeri ensae eyemo, na emingichi eyemo, ne chimanwa chimingichi isan’aibere, echiakoorire omwaka oyomo, chionsi chibe chitari na kemocho ase emebere yabo. Echio nchibe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa kere ne rimisu rigiya rikogwenera Omonene.
swahili: Toeni sadaka ya kuteketezwa ya fahali mmoja mchanga, kondoo dume mmoja, na wana-kondoo saba wa mwaka mmoja, wote wasio na dosari, kama harufu nzuri inayompendeza Bwana.

english: together with their grain offerings of fine flour mixed with oil—three-tenths of an ephah with the bull, two-tenths of an ephah with the ram,
ekegusii: Amo nachirochio morue okoruegwa kw’endagera, obosie obonuke bwochoganirie n’amaguta. Amo neeri eria morue obosie ebimunu bitan’akemo, na amo nemingichi eria obosie ebimunu bine,
swahili: Pamoja na fahali, andaeni sadaka ya nafaka sehemu ya kumi tatu za efa za unga laini uliochanganywa na mafuta; pamoja na kondoo dume, sehemu ya kumi mbili za efa za unga laini;

english: Then the LORD said to Moses and Aaron:
ekegusii: Omonene agakwana na Musa na Aroni, akabateebia,
swahili: Bwana aliwaambia Mose na Aroni:

english: On the south side, the divisions of Reuben are to camp under their standard: The leader of the Reubenites is Elizur son of Shedeur,
ekegusii: “Abanto abaratoore ensemo ya Irianyi n’Abareubeni, inse y’ebendera y’ekeombe kiabo. Elisuri, mosinto o Sedeuri, nere oraabe omotang’ani obo,
swahili: Kwa upande wa kusini kutakuwa kambi ya makundi ya Reubeni chini ya alama yao. Kiongozi wa watu wa Reubeni ni Elisuri mwana wa Shedeuri.

english: The tribe of Simeon will camp next to it. The leader of the Simeonites is Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai,
ekegusii: Abaratoore ang’e nabarabwo n’Abasimeoni. Selumieli, mosinto o Surisadai, nere oraabe omotang’ani obo,
swahili: Kabila la Simeoni watapiga kambi karibu na Reubeni. Kiongozi wa watu wa Simeoni ni Shelumieli mwana wa Surishadai.

english: Next will be the tribe of Gad. The leader of the Gadites is Eliasaph son of Deuel,
ekegusii: Naende abaratoore ensemo yabo n’Abagadi. Eliasafu, mosinto o Reueli, nere oraabe omotang’ani obo,
swahili: Kabila la Gadi litafuata. Kiongozi wa watu wa Gadi ni Eliasafu mwana wa Deueli.

english: The total number of men in the divisions of the camp of Reuben is 151,450; they shall set out second.
ekegusii: Abanto bonsi bariikire, abare b’egetwori kia Rubeni, ase ebiombe biabo, nigo bare chilifu rigana erimo namerongo etano n’eyemo, n’amagana ane, namerongo etano (151,450). Aba nabwo barabe aba kabere komanora kogeenda orogeendo.
swahili: Wanaume wote walio katika kambi ya Reubeni, kufuatana na makundi yao, ni 151,450. Nao watakuwa nafasi ya pili kuondoka.

english: In the middle of the camps, the Tent of Meeting is to travel with the camp of the Levites. They are to set out in the order they encamped, each in his own place under his standard.
ekegusii: “Ekero abanto barabe bakogeenda orogeendo, Eema y’Omosangererekano n’ebe ekobogorigwa n’Abalawi, na barabwo babe gati‐gati y’ebiombe binde. Ase omooroberio oyo abanto ’’mbabe bagotoora, naboigo barabe ko bakogeenda orogeendo. Kera omonto abe ensemo yaye inse y’ebendera yaye.
swahili: Kisha Hema la Kukutania na kambi ya Walawi vitakuwa katikati ya kambi zote. Wao watasafiri kwa utaratibu ule ule kama walivyopiga kambi, kila mmoja mahali pake mwenyewe chini ya alama yake.

english: On the west side, the divisions of Ephraim are to camp under their standard: The leader of the Ephraimites is Elishama son of Ammihud,
ekegusii: “Abanto abaratoore ensemo ya bosongo n’Abaefraimu, inse y’ebendera y’ekeombe kiabo. Elisama, mosinto bw’Amihudi, nere oraabe omotang’ani obo,
swahili: Upande wa magharibi kutakuwepo na kambi ya makundi ya Efraimu chini ya alama yao. Kiongozi wa watu wa Efraimu ni Elishama mwana wa Amihudi.

english: “The Israelites are to camp around the Tent of Meeting at a distance from it, each man under his standard, with the banners of his family.
ekegusii: “Ekero Abaisraeli baratoore, kera omonto abe inse y’ebendera y’ekeombe kiaye, na inse y’ekemanyererio ki’eamate yaye; batoore baetanane Eema y’Omosangererekano, ne chiema chi’ abanto chirigererie Eema eria.
swahili: “Waisraeli watapiga kambi zao kuzunguka Hema la Kukutania kwa umbali fulani kutoka kwenye hema, kila mwanaume chini ya alama yake pamoja na bendera ya jamaa yake.”

english: The tribe of Manasseh will be next to it. The leader of the Manassites is Gamaliel son of Pedahzur,
ekegusii: Abaratoore ang’e nabarabwo n’Abamanase. Gamalieli, mosinto o Pedasuri, nere oraabe omotang’ani obo,
swahili: Kabila la Manase litafuata baada ya Efraimu. Kiongozi wa watu wa Manase ni Gamalieli mwana wa Pedasuri.

english: Next will be the tribe of Benjamin. The leader of the Benjamites is Abidan son of Gideoni,
ekegusii: Naende abaratoore ensemo yabo n’Ababenjamini. Abidani, mosinto o Gidioni, nere oraabe omotang’ani obo,
swahili: Kabila la Benyamini litafuata baada ya Manase. Kiongozi wa watu wa Benyamini ni Abidani mwana wa Gideoni.

english: The total number of men in the divisions of the camp of Ephraim is 108,100; they shall set out third.
ekegusii: Abanto bonsi bariikire, abare b’egetwori gi’Efraimu, ase ebiombe biabo, nigo bare chilifu rigana erimo na isano isato, ne’rigana erimo (108,100). Aba nabwo barabe aba gatato komanora kogeenda orogeendo.
swahili: Wanaume wote walio katika kambi ya Efraimu kufuatana na makundi yao ni 108,100. Nao watakuwa nafasi ya tatu kuondoka.

english: On the north side, the divisions of Dan are to camp under their standard: The leader of the Danites is Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai,
ekegusii: “Abanto abaratoore ensemo ya sugusu n’Abadani, inse y’ebendera y’ekeombe kiabo. Ahieseri, mosinto bw’Amisadai, nere oraabe omotang’ani obo,
swahili: Upande wa kaskazini kutakuwa na makundi ya kambi ya Dani, chini ya alama yao. Kiongozi wa watu wa Dani ni Ahiezeri mwana wa Amishadai.

english: The tribe of Asher will camp next to it. The leader of the Asherites is Pagiel son of Ocran,
ekegusii: Abaratoore ang’e nabarabwo n’Abaaseri. Pagieli, mosinto bw’okirani, nere oraabe omotang’ani abo,
swahili: Kabila la Asheri watapiga kambi karibu na Dani. Kiongozi wa watu wa Asheri ni Pagieli mwana wa Okrani.

english: Next will be the tribe of Naphtali. The leader of the Naphtalites is Ahira son of Enan,
ekegusii: Naende abaratoore ensemo yabo n’Abanafutali. Ahira, mosinto o Enani, nere oraabe omotang’ani obo,
swahili: Kabila la Naftali litafuata. Kiongozi wa watu wa Naftali ni Ahira mwana wa Enani.

english: On the east side, toward the sunrise, the divisions of Judah are to camp under their standard: The leader of the descendants of Judah is Nahshon son of Amminadab,
ekegusii: “Abanto abaratoore ensemo ya moocha n’Abayuda, inse y’ebendera y’ekeombe kiabo. Nahasoni, mosinto bw’Aminadabu, nere oraabe omotang’ani obo,
swahili: Kwa upande wa mashariki kuelekea mawio ya jua, kambi ya makundi ya Yuda watapiga kambi chini ya alama yao. Kiongozi wa watu wa Yuda ni Nashoni mwana wa Aminadabu.

english: The total number of men in the camp of Dan is 157,600; they shall set out last, under their standards.”
ekegusii: Abanto bonsi bariikire, abare b’egetwori gia Dani, ase ebiombe biabo, nigo bare chilifu rigana erimo na merongo etano na isano ibere, na magana atano nomo (157,600). Aba nabwo barabe abamagega kegima komanora kogeenda orogeendo, babe inse y’ebendera y’ekeombe kiabo.”
swahili: Wanaume wote walio katika kambi ya Dani ni 157,600. Wao watakuwa wa mwisho kuondoka chini ya alama yao.

english: These are the Israelites, numbered according to their families. The total of those counted in the camps, by their divisions, was 603,550.
ekegusii: Aba nabwo Abaisraeli barigetwe korwa ase kera eamate, ekeombe ase ekeombe. Omobaro obo nigo ore chilifu amagana atano nomo na isato, namagana atano, namerongo etano (603,550).
swahili: Hawa ndio Waisraeli, wakiwa wamehesabiwa kufuatana na jamaa zao. Wote walio kambini kwa makundi yao ni watu 603,550.

english: But the Levites were not counted among the other Israelites, as the LORD had commanded Moses.
ekegusii: Abalawi barabwo tibaabaretwe amo n’Abaisraeli bande, ekiagera nabo Omonene konya achiikire Musa.
swahili: Hata hivyo, Walawi hawakuhesabiwa pamoja na Waisraeli wengine, kama Bwana alivyomwagiza Mose.

english: So the Israelites did everything the LORD commanded Moses; they camped under their standards in this way and set out in the same way, each man with his clan and his family.
ekegusii: Abaisraeli bagakora onsi buna Omonene konya achiikire Musa. Bagatoora inse ye chibendera chiabo, naende kobakogeenda orogeendo, bakageenda kera oyomo amo neamate yaye, n’enyomba yaye.
swahili: Kwa hiyo Waisraeli wakafanya kila kitu Bwana alichomwamuru Mose. Hivyo ndivyo walivyopiga kambi chini ya alama zao, pia hivyo ndivyo walivyoondoka, kila mmoja akiwa na ukoo wake na jamaa yake.

english: The tribe of Issachar will camp next to it. The leader of the Issacharites is Nethanel son of Zuar,
ekegusii: Abaratoore ang’e nabarabwo n’Abaisakaru. Netaneli, mosinto o Suari, nere oraabe omotang’ani obo,
swahili: Kabila la Isakari watapiga kambi karibu na Yuda. Kiongozi wa watu wa Isakari ni Nethaneli mwana wa Suari.

english: Next will be the tribe of Zebulun. The leader of the Zebulunites is Eliab son of Helon,
ekegusii: Naende abaratoore ensemo yabo n’Abasabuloni. Eliabu, mosinto o Heloni, nere oraabe omotang’ani obo,
swahili: Kabila la Zabuloni litafuata. Kiongozi wa watu wa Zabuloni ni Eliabu mwana wa Heloni.

english: The total number of men in the divisions of the camp of Judah is 186,400; they shall set out first.
ekegusii: Abanto bonsi bariikire, abare b’egetwori ki’Abayuda, ase ebiombe biabo, nigo bare chilifu rigana erimo namerongo etano netato na isanonemo, n’amagana ane (186,400). Aba nabwo barabe bagotang’ana komanora kogeenda orogeendo.
swahili: Wanaume wote walio katika kambi ya Yuda, kufuatana na makundi yao, ni 186,400. Wao watatangulia kuondoka.

english: Then Moses said to the heads of the tribes of Israel, “This is what the LORD has commanded:
ekegusii: Musa agakwana nabatang’ani b’ebisaku bi’Abaisraeli, akabateebia, “Aya nar’Omonene achiikire:
swahili: Mose akawaambia viongozi wa makabila ya Israeli: “Hili ndilo Bwana analoagiza:

english: If a woman in her husband’s house has made a vow or put herself under an obligation with an oath,
ekegusii: “Onye omokungu ore bwoye ase omosacha oye oriete eira, gose agatiana ng’a netange korwa ase egento gete,
swahili: “Ikiwa mwanamke anayeishi na mumewe ataweka nadhiri ama kujifunga mwenyewe kwa ahadi chini ya kiapo,

english: and her husband hears of it but says nothing to her and does not prohibit her, then all the vows or pledges by which she has bound herself shall stand.
ekegusii: na omosacha oye oyaigure, korende takwana ing’ana rinde rionsi, gose komokania, omokungu oyio goika akore na goikerania kera egento akwanete.
swahili: na mumewe akasikia kuhusu jambo hili lakini asimwambie lolote wala hakumkataza, ndipo viapo vyake vyote au ahadi zinazomfunga zitakapothibitika.

english: But if her husband nullifies them on the day he hears of them, then nothing that came from her lips, whether her vows or pledges, shall stand. Her husband has nullified them, and the LORD will absolve her.
ekegusii: Korende onye omosacha oye okwanga eira yaye gose ogotiana kwaye, na kobikora bibe bosa ase rituko riria akoyaigwa, amang’ana yomokuungu oria akwanete tagoikeranigwa. Omonene naabere omokungu oria, ekiagera omosacha oye bwangire ng’a taikerania eira eria, gose ogotiana koria.
swahili: Lakini ikiwa mumewe atabatilisha nadhiri hizo baada ya kuzisikia, basi hakuna nadhiri au ahadi zozote alizoziweka kwa midomo yake zitakazothibitika. Mumewe atakuwa amezibatilisha, na Bwana atamweka huru yule mwanamke.

english: Her husband may confirm or nullify any vow or any sworn pledge to deny herself.
ekegusii: Eira ende yonsi, gose ogotiana konde gwonsi kw’ogwetanga korwa ase egento gete, omokungu oria arakore, omosacha oye nabo aranyare koyianchera, gose koyianga.
swahili: Mumewe anaweza kuthibitisha au kutangua nadhiri yoyote anayoweka, au ahadi yoyote aliyoweka kwa kuapa ili kujikana mwenyewe.

english: But if her husband says nothing to her from day to day, then he confirms all the vows and pledges that bind her. He has confirmed them, because he said nothing to her on the day he heard about them.
ekegusii: Korende onye omosacha oria okirete goika rituko ria kabere, takwanete ing’ana igoro y’ayio, rirorio nayiancherete, na omokungu oria goika aikeranie chiira chiaye chionsi ariete, gose ogotiana kwaye kw’ogwetanga korwa ase egento gete. Omosacha oye nayianchete, ekiagera takwanete gento kende ase rituko riria ayaigwete.
swahili: Lakini ikiwa mumewe hasemi lolote kwake kuhusu jambo hilo siku baada ya siku, basi mumewe atakuwa amethibitisha nadhiri zote, na ahadi zote zinazomfunga mkewe. Anavithibitisha kwa kutokusema lolote kwa mkewe anapoyasikia hayo.

english: But if he nullifies them after he hears of them, then he will bear her iniquity.”
ekegusii: Korende omosacha oria karasarie na kwanga amang’ana yomokuungu oye akwanete magega kayaigure, rirorio okomocha kw’ogotayaikerania nigo koraabe igoro y’omosaacha oria.”
swahili: Hata hivyo, ikiwa mumewe atavibatilisha baada ya kusikia hayo, basi atawajibika kwa hatia ya mkewe.”

english: These are the statutes that the LORD commanded Moses concerning the relationship between a man and his wife, and between a father and a young daughter still in his home.
ekegusii: Eye nero emeroberio echiikire, Omonene amoete Musa, yarenge koba ase egati y’omosaacha nomokuungu oye, na egati ya ise na omwana oye omoiseke otarasoka, ekero are ase omochie o ise.
swahili: Haya ndiyo masharti ambayo Bwana alimpa Mose kuhusu mahusiano kati ya mtu na mkewe, na kati ya baba na binti yake ambaye bado anaishi nyumbani kwa baba yake.

english: If a man makes a vow to the LORD or swears an oath to obligate himself by a pledge, he must not break his word; he must do everything he has promised.
ekegusii: Ekero omonto akoria eira ase Omonene, gose agotiana ng’a netange korwa ase egento gete, tagosaria eira eria yaye. Goika akore na goikerania buna akwanete.
swahili: Mwanaume awekapo nadhiri kwa Bwana, au anapoapa kujifunga kwa ahadi, kamwe asitangue neno lake, bali ni lazima afanye kila kitu alichosema.

english: And if a woman in her father’s house during her youth makes a vow to the LORD or obligates herself by a pledge,
ekegusii: “Ekero omoiseke otarasoka korwa ase omochie o ise akoria eira ase Omonene, gose gotiana ng’a netange korwa ase egento gete,
swahili: “Wakati mwanamwali anayeishi bado nyumbani kwa baba yake atakapoweka nadhiri kwa Bwana, ama amejifunga mwenyewe kwa ahadi,

english: and her father hears about her vow or pledge but says nothing to her, then all the vows or pledges by which she has bound herself shall stand.
ekegusii: na ise karaigwe igoro y’eira eria y’omoiseke oye, korende takwana ring’ana, eira eria negenderere kobao. Kera egento omoiseke oria akwanire goika ageikeranie.
swahili: na baba yake akasikia kuhusu nadhiri au ahadi yake lakini asimwambie lolote, ndipo nadhiri zake zote na kila ahadi aliyoiweka na kujifunga kwayo itathibitika.

english: But if her father prohibits her on the day he hears about it, then none of the vows or pledges by which she has bound herself shall stand. The LORD will absolve her because her father has prohibited her.
ekegusii: Korende onye ise ase rituko riria araigwe ring’ana igoro y’eira eria na tayianchera, omoiseke oria tagwenereti koyeikerania. Omonene naabere omoiseke oria, ekiagera ise nangete ng’a eira eria tekobao.
swahili: Lakini kama baba yake akimkataza wakati anapoisikia, hakuna nadhiri wala ahadi yake yoyote aliyojifunga kwayo itakayosimama; Bwana atamweka huru huyo mwanamwali kwa sababu baba yake amemkataza.

english: If a woman marries while under a vow or rash promise by which she has bound herself,
ekegusii: “Omoiseke oria onye onyuomirwe nomosaacha ritang’ani ataraikerania eira ariete, gose amang’ana akwanete ase ogotarengereria,
swahili: “Ikiwa ataolewa baada ya kuweka nadhiri au baada ya midomo yake kutamka ahadi fulani bila kufikiri akawa amejifunga hivyo,

english: and her husband hears of it but says nothing to her on that day, then the vows or pledges by which she has bound herself shall stand.
ekegusii: goika aikeranie onsi. Aya nigo arakoreke onye omosacha oye ase rituko riria aigwete amang’ana y’eira eria agakira, takwana ing’ana rinde rionsi.
swahili: na mume wake akasikia habari hiyo asimwambie neno lolote, ndipo nadhiri zake ama ahadi zake ambazo alikuwa amejifunga nazo zitathibitika.

english: But if her husband prohibits her when he hears of it, he nullifies the vow that binds her or the rash promise she has made, and the LORD will absolve her.
ekegusii: Korende onye omosacha oye ase rituko riria araigwe amang’ana y’eira eria tayianchera, erio eira eria omokungu oyio ariete, na amang’ana aya akwanete atarengereretie buya, tagoikeranigwa, n’Omonene naabere omokungu oyio.
swahili: Lakini ikiwa mume wake atamkataza atakaposikia kuhusu hilo, atakuwa ametangua nadhiri ambazo zilikuwa zimemfunga mkewe, ama ahadi aliyotamka pasipo kufikiri ambayo amejifunga kwayo, naye Bwana atamweka huru yule mwanamke.

english: Every vow a widow or divorced woman pledges to fulfill is binding on her.
ekegusii: “Korende eira ende yonsi, gose amang’ana ande onsi omokungu omotakaanwa, gose oyotiganire nomosaacha oye arierete eira, gose aya atianete, goika aikeranigwe.
swahili: “Nadhiri yoyote ama patano ambalo limefanywa na mjane ama mwanamke aliyeachwa vitakuwa vimemfunga.

english: And the LORD said to Moses,
ekegusii: Omonene agakwana na Musa, akamoteebia.
swahili: Bwana akamwambia Mose,

english: Then they burned all the cities where the Midianites had lived, as well as all their encampments,
ekegusii: Bagasamba emechie ase Abamidiani bamenyete, bagasamba nebitwori biabo bionsi bie chiema.
swahili: Walichoma moto miji yote ambayo Wamidiani walikuwa wanaishi, pamoja na kambi zao zote.

english: and carried away all the plunder and spoils, both people and animals.
ekegusii: Bakaira ebinto bionsi basakorete, bagoosa abanto, boigo bakaira chitugo chionsi.
swahili: Walichukua nyara zote na mateka, pamoja na watu na wanyama,

english: They brought the captives, spoils, and plunder to Moses, to Eleazar the priest, and to the congregation of Israel at the camp on the plains of Moab, by the Jordan across from Jericho.
ekegusii: Erio bakarenta ebinto basakorete, na abanto boosete, ne chitugo, ase Musa na Eleazari Omokuani, na ase omoganda bw’Abaisraeli otoorete ase enyancha enyomo ya Moabu, agwo ase orooche rwa Yorodani, kororia Yeriko. Okoirana Kw’abarwani B’esegi
swahili: nao waliwaleta wafungwa mateka na nyara kwa Mose na kwa kuhani Eleazari, nao Waisraeli walikusanyika kwenye kambi zao katika tambarare za nchi ya Moabu, kando ya Yordani ngʼambo ya Yeriko.

english: And Moses, Eleazar the priest, and all the leaders of the congregation went to meet them outside the camp.
ekegusii: Musa na Eleazari Omokuani, amo na abaraai bonsi b’omoganda bw’ abanto, bagasoka korwa ase ebitwori, bakageenda korotota abarwani baria b’esegi.
swahili: Mose, kuhani Eleazari na viongozi wote wa jumuiya wakatoka kuwalaki nje ya kambi.

english: But Moses was angry with the officers of the army—the commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds—who were returning from the battle.
ekegusii: Musa akagechigwa nabanene b’abarwani, abatang’ani b’abarwani chilifu, na ab’amagana, baria bairanete korwa ase okorwana esegi,
swahili: Mose aliwakasirikia maafisa wa jeshi, yaani hao wakuu wa jeshi wa maelfu na wakuu wa jeshi wa mamia, ambao walirudi kutoka vitani.

english: “Have you spared all the women?” he asked them.
ekegusii: akabora, “Inee! Ninki kiaba motaita abakungu?
swahili: Mose akawauliza, “Je, mmewaacha wanawake wote hai?”

english: “Look, these women caused the sons of Israel, through the counsel of Balaam, to turn unfaithfully against the LORD at Peor, so that the plague struck the congregation of the LORD.
ekegusii: Inyora ng’a nabwo baigwerete ogosemia gwa Baalamu, bakagera Abaisraeli tibaaba abegenwa ase Omonene, ekero barenge agwo Peori, na ase ayio amaakwa agacha ase egati y’omoganda bw’ abanto ba Omonene.
swahili: “Wanawake hao ndio waliofuata ushauri wa Balaamu, nao ndio waliowasababisha Waisraeli wamwasi Bwana kwa kile kilichotokea kule Peori, na kwa hiyo pigo liliwapata watu wa Bwana.

english: So now, kill all the boys, as well as every woman who has had relations with a man,
ekegusii: Ase ayio bono ita kera omwana omomura, naboigo moite kera omokungu obeire nomosaacha.
swahili: Sasa waue wavulana wote. Pia muue kila mwanamke ambaye alikwisha fanya tendo la ndoa,

english: but spare for yourselves every girl who has never had relations with a man.
ekegusii: Korende abaiseke bonsi abekungi timobaisa kobaita, mobaire babe abaino.
swahili: lakini mwacheni hai kwa ajili yenu kila msichana ambaye kamwe hajawahi kuzini na mwanaume.

english: All of you who have killed a person or touched the dead are to remain outside the camp for seven days. On the third day and the seventh day you are to purify both yourselves and your captives.
ekegusii: Na bono, onde bwensi ore ase more oitire omonto, na onde bwensi okunire egetondo, goika abeere isiko y’egetwori ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere. Ase rituko ria gatato, naende ase rituko ria gatano na kabere, mwechene inwe abanyene, amo nabooswa baino.
swahili: “Ninyi nyote ambao mmeua mtu yeyote au kumgusa mtu yeyote ambaye ameuawa, lazima mkae nje ya kambi kwa muda wa siku saba. Katika siku ya tatu na ya saba lazima mjitakase wenyewe pamoja na wafungwa wenu.

english: “Take vengeance on the Midianites for the Israelites. After that, you will be gathered to your people.”
ekegusii: “Genda obaruserie Abaisraeli egesiomba ase Abamidiani ase engencho y’ayio abanto abwo baabakorerete, erio magega yaye nokwe, osangererekane amo n’abanto bao.”
swahili: “Uwalipize kisasi Wamidiani kwa ajili ya Waisraeli. Halafu baada ya hayo, utakufa.”

english: And purify every garment and leather good, everything made of goat’s hair, and every article of wood.”
ekegusii: Naende mochene kera eanga, na kera egento keroisirie korwa ase amasankwa, gose korwa ase amanya ye chimbori, na ebinto bionsi bi’emete.”
swahili: Takaseni kila vazi pamoja na kila kitu kilichotengenezwa kwa ngozi, kwa singa za mbuzi au kwa mti.”

english: Then Eleazar the priest said to the soldiers who had gone into battle, “This is the statute of the law which the LORD has commanded Moses:
ekegusii: Na Eleazari Omokuani agateebia abanto abwo bairanete korwa ase okorwana esegi, “Oyo n’oro omoroberio Omonene achiigete Musa:
swahili: Kisha kuhani Eleazari aliwaambia askari waliokuwa wamekwenda vitani, “Haya ndiyo matakwa ya sheria ambayo Bwana alimpa Mose:

english: Only the gold, silver, bronze, iron, tin, and lead—
ekegusii: Etaabu, na efeta, na etai, na ebioma ao ao,
swahili: Dhahabu, fedha, shaba, chuma, bati, risasi,

english: everything that can withstand the fire—must be put through the fire, and it will be clean. But it must still be purified with the water of purification. And everything that cannot withstand the fire must pass through the water.
ekegusii: na ebinto binde bionsi bitanyare gosarigwa nomorero, ebio mobietie ase omorero ime ase okobirura, nabirobio nabicheneke. Nonya naboigo goika mobisibie namaache yogochena, na kera egento getanyare kobua omorero goika mogeetie ime ase amaache ayio.
swahili: na kitu kingine chochote ambacho kinaweza kuhimili moto lazima mkipitishe kwenye moto, kisha kitakuwa safi. Lakini ni lazima pia kitakaswe kwa maji ya utakaso. Kitu chochote kisichoweza kuhimili moto lazima kipitishwe kwenye yale maji ya utakaso.

english: On the seventh day you are to wash your clothes, and you will be clean. After that you may enter the camp.” Division of the Spoils
ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatano na kabere mosibie chianga chiaino, nainwe ’namobe abachenekire; magega y’ayio monyare gosoa ase ebitwori.” Ogwatananwa kw’ebisakorwa
swahili: Katika siku ya saba fueni nguo zenu, nanyi mtakuwa safi. Kisha mtaweza kuingia kambini.” Kugawanya Mateka

english: The LORD said to Moses,
ekegusii: Omonene agakwana na Musa, akamoteebia,
swahili: Bwana akamwambia Mose,

english: “You and Eleazar the priest and the family heads of the congregation are to take a count of what was captured, both of man and beast.
ekegusii: “Aye amo n’Eleazari Omokuani na abaraai b’ebisaku bi’omoganda bwonsi, mobare ebinto biasakorwa, na abanto abooswa, amo ne chitugo barenta.
swahili: “Wewe na kuhani Eleazari pamoja na viongozi wa jamaa ya jumuiya mtahesabu watu wote na wanyama ambao walitekwa.

english: Then divide the captives between the troops who went out to battle and the rest of the congregation.
ekegusii: Erio bwatanane ebinto biasakorwa, na abanto booswa amo ne ching’iti ase chinsemo ibere. Ensemo eyemo ebe ey’abarwani b’esegi, na eyende ey’omoganda.
swahili: Gawanyeni hizo nyara kati ya askari ambao walishiriki katika vita na kwa jumuiya.

english: Set aside a tribute for the LORD from what belongs to the soldiers who went into battle: one out of every five hundred, whether persons, cattle, donkeys, or sheep.
ekegusii: Korwa ase ensemo etungetie abarwani orusie omonto oyomo korwa ase abanto amagana atano aboosetwe abe oyo bw’Omonene. Naboigo orusie eng’iti eyemo korwa ase ching’iti amagana atano ase chiombe, chitigere, ching’ondi ne chimbori, chibe echia Omonene.
swahili: Kutoka fungu la wale waliokwenda kupigana vitani, tenga kama ushuru kwa ajili ya Bwana kitu kimoja kati ya kila mia tano, ikiwa ni wanadamu, ngʼombe, punda, kondoo au mbuzi.

english: Take it from their half and give it to Eleazar the priest as an offering to the LORD.
ekegusii: Abanto abwo baatananwe korwa ase ekeng’ese ekio baegwe Eleazari Omokuani, erio babe ekeegwa ase Omonene, naboigo ne ching’iti chiria.
swahili: Chukua ushuru huu kutoka fungu lao, umpe kuhani Eleazari kama sehemu ya Bwana.

english: So Moses told the people, “Arm some of your men for war, that they may go against the Midianites and execute the LORD’s vengeance on them.
ekegusii: Musa agateebia abanto, “Babeeke ang’e abanto bare ase egati yaino, mobae ebirwanero bagende korwania Abamidiani, erinde bamoruserie Omonene egesiomba.
swahili: Kwa hiyo Mose akawaambia watu, “Waandaeni baadhi ya wanaume wenu waende vitani kupigana na Wamidiani ili wawalipize kisasi cha Bwana.

english: From the Israelites’ half, take one out of every fifty, whether persons, cattle, donkeys, sheep, or other animals, and give them to the Levites who keep charge of the tabernacle of the LORD.”
ekegusii: Naende korwa ase ekeng’ese egetungetie omoganda bw’Abaisraeli bwatanane omonto oyomo korwa ase abanto emerongo etano, na eyemo ye chiombe ase emerongo etano, naboigo ase chitigere, ne ching’ondi, ne chimbori. Abanto abwo amo ne ching’iti echio chionsi oe Abalawi abwo bagokora emeremo ase Obomenyo Obochenu bw’Omonene.”
swahili: Kutoka fungu la Waisraeli, chukua kitu kimoja kati ya kila hamsini, ikiwa ni wanadamu, ngʼombe, punda, kondoo, mbuzi au wanyama wengine. Hivyo uwape Walawi, ambao wanawajibika kutunza Maskani ya Bwana.”

english: So Moses and Eleazar the priest did as the LORD had commanded Moses,
ekegusii: Musa na Eleazari Omokuani bagakora buna Omonene konya achiikire Musa.
swahili: Kwa hiyo Mose na kuhani Eleazari wakafanya kama Bwana alivyomwagiza Mose.

english: and this plunder remained from the spoils the soldiers had taken: 675,000 sheep,
ekegusii: Ebisakorwa ebiatigarete ase abarwani b’esegi, ebi barentete ekero babuete, nabio ebi: ching’ondi, amo ne chimbori, chilifu amagana atano nomo na merongo etano na ebere na isano (675,000),
swahili: Nyara zilizobaki kutoka mateka ambayo askari walichukua ni kondoo 675,000,

english: and 32,000 women who had not slept with a man.
ekegusii: na abaiseke abekungi chilifu emerongo etato na ibere (32,000).
swahili: na wanawake 32,000 ambao hawakumjua mume kwa kufanya tendo la ndoa.

english: This was the half portion for those who had gone to war: 337,500 sheep,
ekegusii: Ekeng’ese egiatungetie abarwani b’esegi nigo kiarenge: Ching’ondi amo ne chimbori chilifu amagana atato na merongo etato na isano ibere, na amagana atano (337,500).
swahili: Nusu ya fungu la wale waliokwenda kupigana vitani lilikuwa: Kondoo 337,500

english: 36,000 cattle, including a tribute to the LORD of 72,
ekegusii: Chiombe baetwe nigo chiarenge chilifu emerongo etato na isano nemo (36,000), na echia Omonene nigo chiarenge emerongo etano na ebere, (72).
swahili: ngʼombe 36,000 ambao ushuru kwa ajili ya Bwana ulikuwa ngʼombe 72;

english: 30,500 donkeys, including a tribute to the LORD of 61,
ekegusii: Chitigere baetwe nigo chiarenge chilifu emerongo etato, na amagana atano (30,500), na echi’Omonene nigo chiarenge emerongo etano nomo, na eyemo (61).
swahili: punda 30,500 ambao ushuru kwa ajili ya Bwana ulikuwa punda 61;

english: Send into battle a thousand men from each tribe of Israel.”
ekegusii: Korwa ase kera egesaku ki’Abaisraeli motome abanto elifu eyemo, bagende korwana esegi.”
swahili: Peleka wanaume 1,000 vitani kutoka kila kabila la Israeli.”

english: and 16,000 people, including a tribute to the LORD of 32.
ekegusii: Abaiseke abekungi baetwe nigo barenge chilifu ikomi na isano nemo (16,000) na aba Omonene nigo barenge emerongo etato, na babere (32).
swahili: Watu 16,000 ambao ushuru kwa ajili ya Bwana ulikuwa watu 32.

english: Moses gave the tribute to Eleazar the priest as an offering for the LORD, as the LORD had commanded Moses.
ekegusii: Musa akaa Eleazari Omokuani ensemo eria yaruetwe ase Omonene, buna ere konya achiikire Musa.
swahili: Mose alimpa kuhani Eleazari ushuru kama sehemu ya Bwana, kama Bwana alivyomwagiza Mose.

english: From the Israelites’ half, which Moses had set apart from the men who had gone to war,
ekegusii: Ekeng’ese giatungetie Abaisraeli, ekio Musa arusetie korwa ase abarwani baria b’esegi,
swahili: Ile nusu iliyokuwa ya Waisraeli, ambayo Mose aliitenga kutoka kwa ile ya watu waliokwenda vitani,

english: this half belonged to the congregation: 337,500 sheep,
ekegusii: nigo kiarenge ching’ondi chilifu amagana atato, emerongo etato na isano na ibere, na amagana atano (337,500),
swahili: nusu iliyokuwa ya jumuiya, ilikuwa kondoo 337,500,

english: and 16,000 people.
ekegusii: na abanto chilifu ikomi na isano nemo (16,000).
swahili: na wanadamu 16,000.

english: From the Israelites’ half, Moses took one out of every fifty persons and animals and gave them to the Levites who kept charge of the tabernacle of the LORD, as the LORD had commanded him. The Voluntary Offering
ekegusii: Korwa ase ekeng’ese giatungetie omoganda bw’Abaisraeli, Musa agaatanana oyomo bw’ abanto emerongo etano, na eyemo ye ching’iti emerongo etano, akaa Abalawi baria barenge gokora emeremo ase Obomenyo Obochenu bw’Omonene, buna Omonene konya achiikire Musa.
swahili: Kutoka hiyo nusu iliyokuwa ya Waisraeli, Mose alichagua moja kati ya kila hamsini ya wanadamu na wanyama, kama Bwana alivyomwagiza, naye aliwapa Walawi, ambao waliwajibika kutunza Maskani ya Bwana.

english: Then the officers who were over the units of the army—the commanders of thousands and of hundreds—approached Moses
ekegusii: Erio abanene b’abarwani, abatang’ani b’abarwani chilifu, na ab’amagana, bagaacha ase Musa,
swahili: Kisha maafisa waliokuwa juu ya vikosi vya jeshi, wakuu wa jeshi wa maelfu na wakuu wa jeshi wa mamia, walimwendea Mose

english: and said, “Your servants have counted the soldiers under our command, and not one of us is missing.
ekegusii: bakamoteebia, “Omonene, intwe abasomba bao, twabarire abarwani b’esegi abarenge inse y’oborendi bwaito, na twanyorire ng’a mbonsi bare, onde tasireti korwa ase tore.
swahili: na kumwambia, “Watumishi wako wamehesabu askari walio chini ya amri yetu na hakuna hata mmoja aliyekosekana.

english: So a thousand men were recruited from each tribe of Israel—twelve thousand armed for war.
ekegusii: Ase ayio korwa ase Abaisraeli chilifu chinyinge bagachora abanto elifu eyemo korwa ase kera egesaku. Abarwani bonsi bachoretwe kogeenda korwana esegi nigo baarenge chilifu ikomi na ibere.
swahili: Kwa hiyo waliandaliwa wanaume 12,000 kwa vita, wanaume 1,000 kutoka kila kabila, walitolewa kutoka koo za Israeli.

english: So we have brought to the LORD an offering of the gold articles each man acquired—armlets, bracelets, rings, earrings, and necklaces—to make atonement for ourselves before the LORD.”
ekegusii: Ase ayio twarentire ebinto bie chitaabu bi’ogwechabera: ebitange bi’amaboko, na ebigera, ne chibonyi, na ebigera bi’amato, ne chisonoi. Ebinto ebio twasakorete kera oyomo oito, na bono twabirentire, twabirure ase Omonene, ase ogokora okobwatanigwa ase tore ase obosio bwaye.”
swahili: Kwa hiyo tumeleta kama sadaka kwa Bwana vyombo vya dhahabu kila mmoja wetu alivyopata, yaani vikuku, bangili, pete za muhuri, vipuli na mikufu, ili kufanya upatanisho kwa ajili yetu mbele za Bwana.”

english: So Moses and Eleazar the priest received from them all the articles made out of gold.
ekegusii: Musa na Eleazari Omokuani bakanyora korwa ase abatang’ani abwo chitaabu chiria chiaroisetigwe ebinto bi’ogwechabera.
swahili: Mose na kuhani Eleazari wakapokea kutoka kwao dhahabu, yaani vyombo vyote vilivyonakshiwa.

english: All the gold that the commanders of thousands and of hundreds presented as an offering to the LORD weighed 16,750 shekels.
ekegusii: Chitaabu chionsi chiaruetwe ase Omonene, chiria abatang’ani baria b’abarwani chilifu na ab’amagana barentete, nigo chiarenge chi’oborito koreng’ana ne chikiro amagana abere.
swahili: Dhahabu yote kutoka kwa wakuu wa jeshi wa maelfu na wakuu wa jeshi wa mamia ambavyo Mose na kuhani Eleazari walimletea Bwana kama zawadi ilikuwa shekeli 16,750

english: Each of the soldiers had taken plunder for himself.
ekegusii: Abarwani b’esegi konya basakoire ebinto, na kera oyomo obo konya oirire ebiaye bweka omonyene.
swahili: Kila askari alikuwa amejichukulia nyara zake binafsi.

english: And Moses and Eleazar the priest received the gold from the commanders of thousands and of hundreds and brought it into the Tent of Meeting as a memorial for the Israelites before the LORD.
ekegusii: Musa na Eleazari Omokuani bakanyora chitaabu chiria korwa ase abatang’ani b’abarwani chilifu na ab’amagana, bagachiira ime y’Eema y’Omosangererekano, na Abaisraeli bakainyorwa ase obosio bw’Omonene.
swahili: Mose na kuhani Eleazari walipokea dhahabu kutoka kwa wakuu wa jeshi wa maelfu na wakuu wa jeshi wa mamia, wakazileta katika Hema la Kukutania kama ukumbusho kwa Waisraeli mbele za Bwana.

english: And Moses sent the thousand from each tribe into battle, along with Phinehas son of Eleazar the priest, who took with him the vessels of the sanctuary and the trumpets for signaling.
ekegusii: Musa agatoma abanto aba, elifu eyemo korwa ase kera egesaku, bakageenda korwana esegi. Amo nabarabwo agatoma Finehasi, mosinto bw’Eleazari Omokuani. Ere akaira ebikorero bi’Obomenyo Obochenu na chitarumbeta bi’okobugigwa.
swahili: Mose aliwatuma vitani, watu 1,000 kutoka kila kabila, pamoja na Finehasi mwana wa kuhani Eleazari, ambaye alichukua vyombo vya mahali patakatifu na tarumbeta za kuashiria.

english: Then they waged war against Midian, as the LORD had commanded Moses, and they killed every male.
ekegusii: Barabwo bakaumokera Abamidiani, bakabarwania buna Omonene achiigete Musa, bagaita kera omosacha ase abanto abwo.
swahili: Walipigana dhidi ya Wamidiani, kama Bwana alivyomwagiza Mose, nao waliua kila mwanaume.

english: Among the slain were Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba—the five kings of Midian. They also killed Balaam son of Beor with the sword.
ekegusii: Amo nabwo baitetwe nigo barenge abarwoti batano b’Abamidiani. Abarwoti abwo nabwo aba: Ebi, na Rekemu, na Suri, na Huri, na Reba. Boigo bagaita na Baalamu, mosinto o Beori n’omoro.
swahili: Miongoni mwa watu waliouawa walikuwepo wafalme watano wa Midiani, nao ni Evi, Rekemu, Suri, Huri na Reba. Vilevile walimuua Balaamu mwana wa Beori kwa upanga.

english: The Israelites captured the Midianite women and their children, and they plundered all their herds, flocks, and goods.
ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakaira abakungu b’Abamidiani amo nabana babo. Boigo bagasakora chiombe ne ching’ondi, n’ebinto bionsi bi’Abamidiani.
swahili: Waisraeli waliwateka wanawake wa Kimidiani pamoja na watoto wao na walichukua makundi ya ngʼombe, kondoo na mali zao kama nyara.

english: Now the Reubenites and Gadites, who had very large herds and flocks, surveyed the lands of Jazer and Gilead, and they saw that the region was suitable for livestock.
ekegusii: Abanto b’egesaku kia Rubeni, na ab’ekia Gadi, nigo babwate amaicho amaange mono. Ekero barooche ense ya Yaeseri na eya Gileadi ng’a nigo chire chingiya ase oborisia,
swahili: Kabila la Wareubeni na Wagadi, waliokuwa na makundi makubwa ya ngʼombe, kondoo na mbuzi, waliona kuwa nchi ya Yazeri na nchi ya Gileadi ni nzuri kwa mifugo.

english: So the anger of the LORD was kindled that day, and He swore an oath, saying,
ekegusii: Ase rituko riri’Omonene akaba nendamwamu enene, agatiana, akabora:
swahili: Siku ile hasira ya Bwana iliwaka naye akaapa kiapo hiki:

english: ‘Because they did not follow Me wholeheartedly, not one of the men twenty years of age or older who came out of Egypt will see the land that I swore to give Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob—
ekegusii: Ekeene ase abanto bonsi baruete Misiri, aba bakoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, onde tari, nonya noyomo oranyare korora ense eria narierete Aburaamu, na Isaka, na Yakobo eira ng’a nimbae, ekiagera abanto aba bangire koba abegenwa asende.
swahili: ‘Kwa kuwa hawakunifuata kwa moyo wote, hakuna mtu yeyote mwenye miaka ishirini au zaidi ambaye alikuja kutoka Misri atakayeona nchi niliyoahidi kwa kiapo kwa Abrahamu, Isaki na Yakobo;

english: not one except Caleb son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite and Joshua son of Nun—because they did follow the LORD wholeheartedly.’
ekegusii: Ase barabwo onde tari oranyare goika aroro otatiga Kalebu, mosinto o Yefune Omokenisi, na Yoshua, mosinto o Nuni. Barabwo nabaike aroro, ekiagera babeire abegenwa ase ’nde, inche Omonene.
swahili: hakuna hata mmoja isipokuwa Kalebu mwana wa Yefune, Mkenizi, na Yoshua mwana wa Nuni, kwa sababu walimfuata Bwana kwa moyo wote.’

english: The anger of the LORD burned against Israel, and He made them wander in the wilderness forty years, until the whole generation who had done evil in His sight was gone.
ekegusii: Omonene akaba nendamwamu enene ase Abaisraeli, akabatiga bakana‐goetanana ase erooro ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ene, goika abanto bonsi b’ekiaare keria, abwo konya bakorire ebibe ase Omonene, bagasirigwa kegima.
swahili: Hasira ya Bwana iliwaka dhidi ya Waisraeli na akawafanya watangetange katika jangwa kwa miaka arobaini, mpaka kizazi chote cha wale waliofanya maovu mbele yake kimeangamia.

english: Now behold, you, a brood of sinners, have risen up in place of your fathers to further stoke the burning anger of the LORD against Israel.
ekegusii: Na bono, inwe oroiboro rw’ abanto abanyabibe, mwabeire mamincha y’Omonene, buna chisokoro chiaino chiarenge, na mwagerire Omonene omentire endamwamu yaye ase Abaisraeli.
swahili: “Nanyi mko hapa, uzao wa wenye dhambi, mkisimamia mahali pa baba zenu na mkimfanya Bwana kuwakasirikia Waisraeli hata zaidi.

english: For if you turn away from following Him, He will once again leave this people in the wilderness, and you will be the cause of their destruction.”
ekegusii: Inwe komoraange koigwera Omonene, ere nigo aratige abanto aba bonsi agwo ase erooro, nainwe mogere abanto aba bonsi basire.”
swahili: Kama mkigeuka na mkiacha kumfuata, atawaacha tena watu hawa wote jangwani, na mtakuwa sababu ya maangamizi yao.”

english: Then the Gadites and Reubenites approached Moses and said, “We want to build sheepfolds here for our livestock and cities for our little ones.
ekegusii: Abanto b’egesaku kia Rubeni, na ab’ekia Gadi bagaacha ase Musa bakaboora, “Toe ribaga toagache ameri amakong’u aiga ase chitugo chiaito chikobeera, naende toagache emechie egiteire chindwaki ase abana baito baramenye.
