swahili: Ndipo wakamjia Mose na kumwambia, “Tungalitaka kujenga mazizi hapa kwa ajili ya mifugo yetu na miji kwa ajili ya wanawake wetu na watoto.

english: But we will arm ourselves and be ready to go ahead of the Israelites until we have brought them into their place. Meanwhile, our little ones will remain in the fortified cities for protection from the inhabitants of the land.
ekegusii: Erio intwe toimokie ebirwanero bi’eseegi, twebeke ang’e totang’ane Abaisraeli korwana esegi goika tobaikie aase abo. Korende abana baito batigare aa, bamenyete ime yemechie egiteire chindwaki, erinde abanto b’ense eye tibaabaisa kobakorera bobe.
swahili: Lakini sisi tuko tayari kuchukua silaha zetu na kutangulia mbele ya Waisraeli mpaka tutakapowaleta mahali pao. Wakati huo wanawake wetu na watoto wataishi katika miji yenye ngome, kwa ajili ya ulinzi dhidi ya wenyeji wa nchi.

english: We will not return to our homes until every Israelite has taken possession of his inheritance.
ekegusii: Titokoirana ase chinka chiaito goika torore ng’a Abaisraeli baminto banyorire kera omonto orogongo rw’omwando oye.
swahili: Hatutarudi nyumbani mwetu mpaka kila Mwisraeli apokee urithi wake.

english: Yet we will not have an inheritance with them across the Jordan and beyond, because our inheritance has come to us on the east side of the Jordan.”
ekegusii: Intwe titokonyora omwando oito amo nabarabwo agwo ng’umbu ya Yorodani, ekiagera twanyorire omwando oito aiga moocha ya Yorodani.”
swahili: Hatutapokea urithi wowote pamoja nao ngʼambo ya Yordani, kwa sababu urithi wetu umekuja kwetu upande wa mashariki ya Yordani.”

english: So the Gadites and Reubenites came to Moses, Eleazar the priest, and the leaders of the congregation, and said,
ekegusii: bakageenda ase Musa, na Eleazari Omokuani, na ase abaraai b’omoganda bw’Abaisraeli, bakabateebia,
swahili: Hivyo walimjia Mose, na kuhani Eleazari na viongozi wa jumuiya, na kuwaambia,

english: Moses replied, “If you will do this—if you will arm yourselves before the LORD for battle,
ekegusii: Musa akabairaneria, agateeba, “Onye mogochia gokora bo, rirorio bogoria ebirwanero biaino bi’eseegi ase obosio bw’Omonene, erio mogende korwana esegi.
swahili: Kisha Mose akawaambia, “Kama mtafanya jambo hili, kama mtajivika silaha mbele za Bwana kwa ajili ya vita,

english: and if every one of your armed men crosses the Jordan before the LORD, until He has driven His enemies out before Him,
ekegusii: Kera omonto ore ase more, oyobogoretie ebirwanero bi’eseegi nigo aramboke gochia ng’umbu ya Yorodani, ase obosio bw’Omonene: mobeereo goika ere abue ababisa baye barue ase are,
swahili: na kama ninyi nyote mtakwenda mmejivika silaha ngʼambo ya Yordani mbele za Bwana mpaka awe amewafukuza adui zake mbele zake,

english: then when the land is subdued before the LORD, you may return and be free of obligation to the LORD and to Israel. And this land will belong to you as a possession before the LORD.
ekegusii: na ense eria ebe yabuirwe ase Omonene. Magega y’ayio nario moranyare koirana aiga motari na komocha, na igo monyore ense eye ebe eyaino, monyare komenya ase obosio bw’Omonene.
swahili: hadi wakati nchi itakapokuwa imeshindwa mbele za Bwana, ndipo mtaweza kurudi na kuwa huru kutoka masharti yenu kwa Bwana na Israeli. Nayo nchi hii itakuwa milki yenu mbele za Bwana.

english: But if you do not do this, you will certainly sin against the LORD—and be assured that your sin will find you out.
ekegusii: Korende motaikeraneti chiira chiaino mwarire, ekeene rirorio mwakorire ebibe ase Omonene, na mobe nobomaene ng’a nase engencho y’ebibe ebio biaino moranyore egesusuro.
swahili: “Lakini mkishindwa kufanya hili, mtakuwa mnatenda dhambi dhidi ya Bwana; nanyi kuweni na hakika kuwa dhambi yenu itawapata.

english: Build cities for your little ones and folds for your flocks, but do what you have promised.”
ekegusii: Ase ayio agacha emechie ase abana baino baramenye na ameri ase ching’ondi chiaino, erio mokore buna mwariire chiira chiaino.”
swahili: Jengeni miji kwa ajili ya wanawake na watoto wenu, na mazizi kwa ajili ya mbuzi na kondoo zenu, lakini fanyeni yale mliyoahidi.”

english: The Gadites and Reubenites said to Moses, “Your servants will do just as our lord commands.
ekegusii: Erio abanto b’egesaku kia Gadi na ab’ekia Rubeni bakamoteebia Musa, “Omonene oito, intwe abasomba bao inatokore buna gwachiikire.
swahili: Wagadi na Wareubeni wakamwambia Mose, “Sisi watumishi wako tutafanya kama bwana wetu anavyotuagiza.

english: Our children, our wives, our livestock, and all our animals will remain here in the cities of Gilead.
ekegusii: Abana baito na abakungu barabwo tiga batigare amo ne ching’ondi ne chiombe chiaito aiga ase emechie ya Gileadi.
swahili: Watoto na wake zetu, makundi ya mbuzi na kondoo, na makundi ya ngʼombe zetu, watabaki hapa katika miji ya Gileadi.

english: But your servants are equipped for war, and every man will cross over to the battle before the LORD, just as our lord says.”
ekegusii: Korende intwe abasomba bao, kera oyomo oito oyobogoretie ebirwanero bi’okorwana esegi agwo ase obosio bw’Omonene ’namboke gochia ng’umbu, buna aye omonene oito gwachiikire.”
swahili: Lakini watumishi wenu, kila mwanaume aliyevaa silaha za vita, watavuka ngʼambo kupigana mbele za Bwana, sawa kama bwana wetu anavyosema.”

english: So Moses gave orders about them to Eleazar the priest, to Joshua son of Nun, and to the family leaders of the tribes of Israel.
ekegusii: Ase amang’ana y’ abanto abwo, Musa agachiika Eleazari Omokuani, na Yoshua, mosinto o Nuni, na abaraai be chiamate chi’ebisaku bi’Abaisraeli,
swahili: Kisha Mose akatoa amri kuhusu wao kwa kuhani Eleazari, na Yoshua mwana wa Nuni na viongozi wa jamaa za makabila ya Waisraeli.

english: And Moses said to them, “If the Gadites and Reubenites cross the Jordan with you, with every man armed for battle before the LORD, and the land is subdued before you, then you are to give them the land of Gilead as a possession.
ekegusii: akabateebia, “Onye Abagadi na Abareubeni, abwo bonsi babogoretie ebirwanero bi’eseegi, bakwamboka Yorodani amo nainwe korwana esegi ase obosio bw’Omonene, na inwe mobue ense eria, na koyeira, erio mobae ense ya Gileadi ebe eyabo.
swahili: Mose akawaambia, “Ikiwa Wagadi na Wareubeni, kila mwanaume aliyevaa silaha za vita, atavuka Yordani pamoja nanyi mbele za Bwana, basi wakati mtakapoishinda nchi iliyoko mbele yenu, wapeni nchi ya Gileadi kama milki yao.

english: “Ataroth, Dibon, Jazer, Nimrah, Heshbon, Elealeh, Sebam, Nebo, and Beon,
ekegusii: “Ataroti, na Diboni, na Yaeseri, na Nimura, na Hesiboni, na Eleali, na Sibamu, na Nebo, na Beoni,
swahili: “Atarothi, Diboni, Yazeri, Nimra, Heshboni, Eleale, Sebamu, Nebo na Beoni,

english: But if they do not arm themselves and go across with you, then they must accept their possession among you in the land of Canaan.”
ekegusii: Korende onye tibakobogoria ebirwanero bi’eseegi bamboke gochia ng’umbu ya Yorodani, rirorio nigo baranyore orogongo rwabo amo nainwe agwo ase ense ya Kaanani.”
swahili: Lakini kama hawatavuka pamoja nanyi wakiwa wamevaa silaha za vita, lazima wakubali kupokea milki yao pamoja nanyi katika nchi ya Kanaani.”

english: The Gadites and Reubenites replied, “As the LORD has spoken to your servants, so we will do.
ekegusii: Abagadi na Abareubeni bakairaneria, bagateeba, “Bun’Omonene atochiikire intwe abasomba bao, nabo torakore.
swahili: Wagadi na Wareubeni wakajibu, “Watumishi wako watafanya lile Bwana alilosema.

english: We will cross over into the land of Canaan armed before the LORD, that we may have our inheritance on this side of the Jordan.”
ekegusii: Intwe ’ntobogorie ebirwanero biaito bi’eseegi, na twamboke gochia ase ense ya Kaanani ase obosio bw’Omonene, erio nario toratware ense eye ere aa moocha ya Yorodani ebe eyaito.”
swahili: Tutavuka mbele za Bwana kuingia Kanaani tukiwa tumevaa silaha za vita, lakini mali tutakayoirithi itakuwa ngʼambo hii ya Yordani.”

english: So Moses gave to the Gadites, to the Reubenites, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh son of Joseph the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan—the land including its cities and the territory surrounding them.
ekegusii: Ase ayio Musa akaa abanto b’egesaku kia Gadi, na ab’ekia Rubeni, amo nekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase, mosinto o Yusufu, orogongo rwa Sihoni, omorwoti bw’Abaamori, na orw’Ogi, omorwoti o Basani. Amo nechio akabaa boigo emechie y’ense eria amo ne chinse chiaetanaineo.
swahili: Kisha Mose akawapa Wagadi, Wareubeni, na nusu ya kabila la Manase mwana wa Yosefu ufalme wa Sihoni mfalme wa Waamori, na ufalme wa Ogu mfalme wa Bashani, nchi yote pamoja na miji yake, na nchi inayowazunguka.

english: And the Gadites built up Dibon, Ataroth, Aroer,
ekegusii: Abagadi bakaagacha emechie ya Diboni, na Ataroti, na Aroeri,
swahili: Wagadi wakajenga Diboni, Atarothi, Aroeri,

english: Atroth-shophan, Jazer, Jogbehah,
ekegusii: na Ataroti‐Shofani, na Yaeseri, ne Yogibea,
swahili: Atroth-Shofani, Yazeri, Yogbeha,

english: Beth-nimrah, and Beth-haran as fortified cities, and they built folds for their flocks.
ekegusii: na Beti‐Nimura, na Beti‐Harani, emechie yagiteire chindwaki, naende yabwate ameri ye ching’ondi.
swahili: Beth-Nimra na Beth-Harani kama miji iliyozungushiwa ngome, tena wakajenga mazizi kwa ajili ya makundi yao ya mbuzi na kondoo.

english: The Reubenites built up Heshbon, Elealeh, Kiriathaim,
ekegusii: Abareubeni bakaagacha emechie ya Hesiboni, na Eleale, na Kiriataimu,
swahili: Nao Wareubeni wakajenga upya miji ya Heshboni, Eleale na Kiriathaimu,

english: as well as Nebo and Baal-meon (whose names were changed), and Sibmah. And they renamed the cities they rebuilt.
ekegusii: Nebo, na Baali‐Meoni (amarieta abo akaonchorwa), na Sibuma. Boigo bakaroka emechie eyio baagachete ase amarieta ande amayia.
swahili: pia Nebo na Baal-Meoni (majina ya hiyo miji yalibadilishwa) na Sibma. Miji waliyoijenga upya waliipa majina.

english: The descendants of Machir son of Manasseh went to Gilead, captured it, and drove out the Amorites who were there.
ekegusii: Abanto ba Makiri, mosinto o Manase, bakageenda bakaumokera ense ya Gileadi, bagaseria Abaamori bamenyeteo, erio bakaira ense eria.
swahili: Wazao wa Makiri mwana wa Manase walikwenda Gileadi, wakaiteka nchi na kuwafukuza Waamori waliokuwa huko.

english: which the LORD conquered before the congregation of Israel, are suitable for livestock—and your servants have livestock.”
ekegusii: nemechie y’ense eyi’Omonene atigete omoganda bw’Abaisraeli okayebua, na ense eye nigo ere engiya ase oborisia bwe chitugo, na intwe abasomba bao nigo tobwate amaicho amaange ye chitugo.”
swahili: nchi ambayo Bwana ameishinda mbele ya wana wa Israeli, inafaa kwa mifugo, nao watumishi wako wana mifugo.

english: So Moses gave Gilead to the clan of Machir son of Manasseh, and they settled there.
ekegusii: Musa akaa abanto ba Makiri, mosinto o Manase, ense ya Gileadi, na barabwo bakamenyao.
swahili: Kwa hiyo Mose akawapa Wamakiri, wazao wa Manase, nchi ya Gileadi, nao wakakaa huko.

english: Jair, a descendant of Manasseh, went and captured their villages and called them Havvoth-jair.
ekegusii: Egesaku kia Yairi, mosinto o Manase, gekageenda, gekaumokera na koira emechie emeke y’ense ya Gileadi, bakayeroka Emechie ya Yairi.
swahili: Yairi, mzao wa Manase, akateka makao yao, akayaita Hawoth-Yairi.

english: And Nobah went and captured Kenath and its villages and called it Nobah, after his own name.
ekegusii: Na Noba nere akageenda akaumokera na koira Kenati amo nebichie biaetanaineo, nere akaroka Kenati Noba, erieta riaye omonyene.
swahili: Naye Noba akateka Kenathi na makao yaliyoizunguka, akayaita Noba kwa jina lake.

english: “If we have found favor in your sight,” they said, “let this land be given to your servants as a possession. Do not make us cross the Jordan.”
ekegusii: Naende bagateeba, “Onye twanyorire ogwancherwa korwa ase ore, tiga intwe, abasomba bao, toegwe ense eye ebe eyaito, korende tobaisa gotwambokia gochia ng’umbu ya Yorodani komenyao.”
swahili: Kama tumepata kibali mbele ya macho yako, nchi hii na ipewe watumishi wako kama milki yetu. Usitufanye tuvuke Yordani.”

english: But Moses asked the Gadites and Reubenites, “Shall your brothers go to war while you sit here?
ekegusii: Musa agakwana n’abanto ba Gadi na abareubeni, akabora, “Inee! Abanto bamino nigo bakogeenda korwana esegi, nainwe mobe motigarete aase aa?
swahili: Mose akawaambia Wagadi na Wareubeni, “Je, watu wa nchi yenu watakwenda vitani wakati ninyi mmeketi hapa?

english: Why are you discouraging the Israelites from crossing into the land that the LORD has given them?
ekegusii: Nase ki inwe mogoita Abaisraeli emioyo, erinde tibaabaisa kwamboka gochia ng’umbu ya Yorodani, na koira ense eri’Omonene abaeire?
swahili: Kwa nini mmewakatisha Waisraeli tamaa wasivuke katika nchi ambayo Bwana amewapa?

english: This is what your fathers did when I sent them from Kadesh-barnea to inspect the land.
ekegusii: Amang’ana aya naro chisokoro chiaino chiakorete ekero nabatomete korwa Kadeshi-Barinea gochia koroota ense eyio.
swahili: Hivi ndivyo baba zenu walivyofanya wakati nilipowatuma kutoka Kadesh-Barnea kuipeleleza nchi.

english: For when your fathers went up to the Valley of Eshcol and saw the land, they discouraged the Israelites from entering the land that the LORD had given them.
ekegusii: Barabwo bakageenda bagaika ase ense omweya y’Esikoli, na ekero barooche ense eria, bakairana bagaita Abaisraeli emioyo ase ogotageenda ase ense eri’Omonene konya abaeire.
swahili: Baada ya kufika kwenye Bonde la Eshkoli na kuitazama nchi, waliwakatisha tamaa Waisraeli wasiingie katika nchi ambayo Bwana alikuwa amewapa.

english: These are the journeys of the Israelites when they came out of the land of Egypt by their divisions under the leadership of Moses and Aaron.
ekegusii: Aya naro amarieta y’ebitwori bi’Abaisraeli, ekero baare ase orogeendo korwa ase ense ya Misiri, ase emeganda yabo inse y’oboraai bwa Musa na Aroni.
swahili: Hivi ndivyo vituo katika safari ya Waisraeli walipotoka Misri kwa vikosi chini ya uongozi wa Mose na Aroni.

english: They set out from Elim and camped by the Red Sea.
ekegusii: Bakarua Elimu, bakageenda bagaika ang’e n’Enyancha Embariri, bagatoora aroro.
swahili: Wakaondoka Elimu na kupiga kambi kando ya Bahari ya Shamu.

english: They set out from the Red Sea and camped in the Desert of Sin.
ekegusii: Bakarua aase aria bagaika erooro ya Sini, bagatoora aroro.
swahili: Wakaondoka kando ya Bahari ya Shamu na kupiga kambi katika Jangwa la Sini.

english: They set out from the Desert of Sin and camped at Dophkah.
ekegusii: Bakarua erooro ya Sini, bakageenda bagaika Dofuka, bagatoora aroro.
swahili: Wakaondoka katika Jangwa la Sini, wakapiga kambi huko Dofka.

english: They set out from Dophkah and camped at Alush.
ekegusii: Bakarua Dofuka, bakageenda bagaika Alusi, bagatoora aroro.
swahili: Wakaondoka Dofka, wakapiga kambi huko Alushi.

english: They set out from Alush and camped at Rephidim, where there was no water for the people to drink.
ekegusii: Bakarua Alusi, bakageenda bagaika Refidimu, aase abanto batanyorete amaache bakonywa, bagatoora aroro.
swahili: Wakaondoka Alushi, wakapiga kambi Refidimu, mahali ambapo hapakuwa na maji kwa ajili ya watu kunywa.

english: They set out from Rephidim and camped in the Wilderness of Sinai.
ekegusii: Bakarua Refidimu, bakageenda bagaika erooro ya Sinai, bagatoora aroro.
swahili: Wakaondoka Refidimu na kupiga kambi katika Jangwa la Sinai.

english: They set out from the Wilderness of Sinai and camped at Kibroth-hattaavah.
ekegusii: Bakarua erooro ya Sinai, bakageenda bagaika Kibiroti‐Hatawa, bagatoora aroro.
swahili: Wakaondoka katika Jangwa la Sinai na kupiga kambi huko Kibroth-Hataava.

english: They set out from Kibroth-hattaavah and camped at Hazeroth.
ekegusii: Bakarua Kibiroti‐Hatawa, bakageenda bagaika Haseroti, bagatoora aroro.
swahili: Wakaondoka Kibroth-Hataava na kupiga kambi huko Haserothi.

english: They set out from Hazeroth and camped at Rithmah.
ekegusii: Bakarua Haseroti, bakageenda bagaika Ritima, bagatoora aroro.
swahili: Wakaondoka Haserothi na kupiga kambi huko Rithma.

english: They set out from Rithmah and camped at Rimmon-perez.
ekegusii: Bakarua Ritima, bakageenda bagaika Rimoni‐Peresi, bagatoora aroro.
swahili: Wakaondoka Rithma na kupiga kambi huko Rimon-Peresi.

english: At the LORD’s command, Moses recorded the stages of their journey. These are the stages listed by their starting points:
ekegusii: Bun’Omonene achiigete Musa, nere akariika kera aase ase baare gotoora. Ebi nabio ebitwori biabo buna baare gotoora na koimoka kogeenda.
swahili: Kwa agizo la Bwana, Mose aliweka kumbukumbu ya vituo katika safari yao. Hivi ndivyo vituo katika safari yao:

english: They set out from Rimmon-perez and camped at Libnah.
ekegusii: Bakarua Rimoni‐Peresi, bakageenda bagaika Libuna, bagatoora aroro.
swahili: Wakaondoka Rimon-Peresi na kupiga kambi huko Libna.

english: They set out from Libnah and camped at Rissah.
ekegusii: Bakarua Libuna, bakageenda bagaika Risa, bagatoora aroro.
swahili: Wakaondoka Libna na kupiga kambi huko Risa.

english: They set out from Rissah and camped at Kehelathah.
ekegusii: Bakarua Risa, bakageenda bagaika Kehelata, bagatoora aroro.
swahili: Wakaondoka Risa na kupiga kambi huko Kehelatha.

english: They set out from Kehelathah and camped at Mount Shepher.
ekegusii: Bakarua Kehelata, bakageenda bagaika egetunwa gia Seferi, bagatoora aroro.
swahili: Wakaondoka Kehelatha na kupiga kambi kwenye mlima Sheferi.

english: They set out from Mount Shepher and camped at Haradah.
ekegusii: Bakarua egetunwa gia Seferi, bakageenda bagaika Harada, bagatoora aroro.
swahili: Wakaondoka kwenye mlima Sheferi na kupiga kambi huko Harada.

english: They set out from Haradah and camped at Makheloth.
ekegusii: Bakarua Harada, bakageenda bagaika Makeloti, bagatoora aroro.
swahili: Wakaondoka Harada na kupiga kambi huko Makelothi.

english: They set out from Makheloth and camped at Tahath.
ekegusii: Bakarua Makeloti bakageenda bagaika Tahati, bagatoora aroro.
swahili: Wakaondoka Makelothi na kupiga kambi huko Tahathi.

english: They set out from Tahath and camped at Terah.
ekegusii: Bakarua Tahati, bakageenda bagaika Tera, bagatoora aroro.
swahili: Wakaondoka Tahathi na kupiga kambi huko Tera.

english: They set out from Terah and camped at Mithkah.
ekegusii: Bakarua Tera, bakageenda bagaika Mitika, bagatoora aroro.
swahili: Wakaondoka Tera na kupiga kambi huko Mithka.

english: They set out from Mithkah and camped at Hashmonah.
ekegusii: Bakarua Mitika, bakageenda bagaika Hasimona, bagatoora aroro.
swahili: Wakaondoka Mithka na kupiga kambi huko Hashmona.

english: On the fifteenth day of the first month, on the day after the Passover, the Israelites set out from Rameses. They marched out defiantly in full view of all the Egyptians,
ekegusii: Ase omotienyi bw’eritang’ani, rituko ria ikomi na gatano, rituko riarenge kobwatia eri’Epasaka, Abaisraeli bakang’anya korwa ase ense ya Misiri. Bakaimoka korwa Ramesesi, bare noboremu. Bakarua ase amasio y’Abamisiri,
swahili: Waisraeli walisafiri kutoka Ramesesi katika siku ya kumi na tano ya mwezi wa kwanza, siku iliyofuata Pasaka. Walitembea kwa ujasiri wazi mbele ya Wamisri wote,

english: They set out from Hashmonah and camped at Moseroth.
ekegusii: Bakarua Hasimona, bakageenda bagaika Moseroti, bagatoora aroro.
swahili: Wakaondoka Hashmona na kupiga kambi Moserothi.

english: They set out from Moseroth and camped at Bene-jaakan.
ekegusii: Bakarua Moseroti, bakageenda bagaika Bene‐Yakani, bagatoora aroro.
swahili: Wakaondoka Moserothi na kupiga kambi huko Bene-Yakani.

english: They set out from Bene-jaakan and camped at Hor-haggidgad.
ekegusii: Bakarua Bene‐Yakani, bakageenda bagaika Hori‐Hagidigadi, bagatoora aroro.
swahili: Wakaondoka Bene-Yakani na kupiga kambi huko Hor-Hagidgadi.

english: They set out from Hor-haggidgad and camped at Jotbathah.
ekegusii: Bakarua Hori‐Hagidigadi, bakageenda bagaika Yotibata, bagatoora aroro.
swahili: Wakaondoka Hor-Hagidgadi na kupiga kambi huko Yotbatha.

english: They set out from Jotbathah and camped at Abronah.
ekegusii: Bakarua Yotibata, bakageenda bagaika Aburona, bagatoora aroro.
swahili: Wakaondoka Yotbatha na kupiga kambi huko Abrona.

english: They set out from Abronah and camped at Ezion-geber.
ekegusii: Bakarua Aburona, bakageenda bagaika Esioni‐Geberi, bagatoora aroro.
swahili: Wakaondoka Abrona na kupiga kambi huko Esion-Geberi.

english: They set out from Ezion-geber and camped at Kadesh in the Wilderness of Zin.
ekegusii: Bakarua Esioni‐Geberi, bakageenda bagaika erooro ya Sini (nao Kadeshi), bagatoora aroro.
swahili: Wakaondoka Esion-Geberi na kupiga kambi huko Kadeshi katika Jangwa la Sini.

english: They set out from Kadesh and camped at Mount Hor, on the outskirts of the land of Edom.
ekegusii: Bakarua Kadeshi, bakageenda bagaika egetunwa kia Hori, ang’e norobebe rw’ense ya Edomu, bagatoora aroro.
swahili: Wakaondoka Kadeshi na kupiga kambi kwenye Mlima Hori, mpakani mwa Edomu.

english: At the LORD’s command, Aaron the priest climbed Mount Hor and died there on the first day of the fifth month, in the fortieth year after the Israelites had come out of the land of Egypt.
ekegusii: Ase rituko rie ritang’ani ri’omotienyi o gatano, omwaka bw’emerongo ene magega Abaisraeli kobarure ense ya Misiri, Aroni Omokuani agatiira gochia igoro ase egetunwa kia Hori, buna Omonene konya amochiikire, agakwera aroro.
swahili: Kwa amri ya Bwana, kuhani Aroni alipanda Mlima Hori, mahali alipofia katika siku ya kwanza ya mwezi wa tano, mwaka wa arobaini baada ya Waisraeli kutoka Misri.

english: Aaron was 123 years old when he died on Mount Hor.
ekegusii: Aroni konya okoorire emiaka rigana erimo, na merongo ebere, na etato (123), ekero akwerete agwo ase egetunwa keria kia Hori.
swahili: Aroni alikufa juu ya Mlima Hori akiwa na umri wa miaka 123.

english: who were burying all their firstborn, whom the LORD had struck down among them; for the LORD had executed judgment against their gods.
ekegusii: ekero barabwo barenge gotindeka abana babo abatangi, bari’Omonene aitete, naende akanachera chinyasae chiabo ekiina.
swahili: waliokuwa wakizika wazaliwa wao wa kwanza wote, ambao Bwana alikuwa amewaua katikati yao, kwa kuwa Bwana alikuwa ameleta hukumu juu ya miungu yao.

english: Now the Canaanite king of Arad, who lived in the Negev in the land of Canaan, heard that the Israelites were coming.
ekegusii: Na omorwoti orenge kogamba Aradi, ensemo ya Irianyi ase ense ya Kaanani, akaigwa ng’a Abaisraeli nigo bare inchera gocha.
swahili: Mfalme Mkanaani wa Aradi, ambaye aliishi huko Negebu ya Kanaani, akasikia kwamba Waisraeli wanakuja.

english: And the Israelites set out from Mount Hor and camped at Zalmonah.
ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakarua egetunwa keria kia Hori, bakageenda bagaika Salimona bagatoora aroro.
swahili: Wakaondoka kwenye mlima Hori na kupiga kambi huko Salmona.

english: They set out from Zalmonah and camped at Punon.
ekegusii: Bakarua Salimona, bakageenda bagaika Punoni, bagatoora aroro.
swahili: Wakaondoka Salmona, wakapiga kambi huko Punoni.

english: They set out from Punon and camped at Oboth.
ekegusii: Bakarua Punoni, bakageenda bagaika Oboti, bagatoora aroro.
swahili: Wakaondoka Punoni, wakapiga kambi huko Obothi.

english: They set out from Oboth and camped at Iye-abarim on the border of Moab.
ekegusii: Bakarua Oboti, bakageenda bagaika Iye‐Abarimu, bagatoora aroro ase orobebe rwa Moabu.
swahili: Wakaondoka Obothi, wakapiga kambi huko Iye-Abarimu, mipakani mwa Moabu.

english: They set out from Iyim and camped at Dibon-gad.
ekegusii: Bakarua agwo Iyumu, bakageenda bagaika Diboni‐Gadi, bagatoora aroro.
swahili: Wakaondoka Iye-Abarimu, wakapiga kambi huko Dibon-Gadi.

english: They set out from Dibon-gad and camped at Almon-diblathaim.
ekegusii: Bakarua Diboni‐Gadi, bakageenda bagaika Alimoni‐Dibulataimu, bagatoora aroro.
swahili: Wakaondoka Dibon-Gadi na kupiga kambi huko Almon-Diblathaimu.

english: They set out from Almon-diblathaim and camped in the mountains of Abarim facing Nebo.
ekegusii: Bakarua Alimoni‐Dibulataimu, bagaika ebitunwa bi’Abarimu kororia Nebo bagatoora aroro.
swahili: Wakaondoka Almon-Diblathaimu na kupiga kambi katika milima ya Abarimu, karibu na Nebo.

english: They set out from the mountains of Abarim and camped on the plains of Moab by the Jordan across from Jericho.
ekegusii: Bakarua ebitunwa bi’Abarimu, bakageenda bagaika ase enyancha enyomo ya Moabu, ang’e na Yorodani, kororia Yeriko, bagatoora aroro.
swahili: Wakaondoka kwenye milima ya Abarimu na kupiga kambi kwenye tambarare ya Moabu, kando ya Yordani ngʼambo ya Yeriko.

english: And there on the plains of Moab they camped by the Jordan, from Beth-jeshimoth to Abel-shittim. Instructions for Occupying Canaan
ekegusii: Bagatoora ang’e na Yorodani, na egetwori kiabo kegachaakera Beti‐Yesimoti, kegaikeera Abeli‐Sitimu, ase enyancha enyomo ya Moabu. Abaisraeli Bagotebererigwa Ekero Bataramboka Orooche Rwa Yorodani
swahili: Huko kwenye tambarare za Moabu walipiga kambi kandokando ya Mto Yordani, kuanzia Beth-Yeshimothi mpaka Abel-Shitimu.

english: The Israelites set out from Rameses and camped at Succoth.
ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakarua Ramesesi, bakageenda Sukoti, bagatoora aroro.
swahili: Waisraeli waliondoka Ramesesi na kupiga kambi huko Sukothi.

english: On the plains of Moab by the Jordan across from Jericho, the LORD said to Moses,
ekegusii: Agwo ase ebirubo ebiomo bia Moabu mbarabare y’oro rwa Yorodani, kororia Yeriko, Omonene agakwana na Musa, akamoteebia,
swahili: Katika tambarare za Moabu kando ya Yordani kuvukia Yeriko, Bwana akamwambia Mose,

english: “Speak to the Israelites and tell them: When you cross the Jordan into the land of Canaan,
ekegusii: “Kwana n’Abaisraeli, obateebie: Ekero moraabe mwambokire Yorodani na mwaikire ase ense ya Kaanani,
swahili: “Sema na Waisraeli uwaambie: ‘Mtakapovuka Mto Yordani kuingia Kanaani,

english: you must drive out before you all the inhabitants of the land, destroy all their carved images and cast idols, and demolish all their high places.
ekegusii: moseerie abanto ababiare bonsi b’ense eria barue ase amasio aino. Naende mosarie emegwekano yabo eyio bagosasiima eroisirie korwa ase ebioma binyititoire na kobombwa, motagore aase aimokererete igoro ase bagosasiimera.
swahili: wafukuzeni wakazi wote wa nchi iliyo mbele yenu. Haribuni sanamu zao zote za kuchongwa, na sanamu zilizotengenezwa kwa kuyeyusha chuma, na kupabomoa mahali pao pa ibada.

english: You are to take possession of the land and settle in it, for I have given you the land to possess.
ekegusii: Moire ense yabo ebe eyaino momenyeo, ekiagera nabayeere.
swahili: Mtaimiliki nchi hiyo na kukaa huko, kwa kuwa nimewapeni ninyi kuimiliki.

english: And you are to divide the land by lot according to your clans. Give a larger inheritance to a larger clan and a smaller inheritance to a smaller one. Whatever falls to each one by lot will be his. You will receive an inheritance according to the tribes of your fathers.
ekegusii: Mwatanane ense eria ase kera egesaku ase ogoaka obomera. Moe abanto b’egesaku ekenene orogongo oronene robe omwando obo, na abanto b’egesaku egeke orogongo oroke robe orwabo. Obomera koboragwere omonto, omwando oria nobe oyo bw’omonto oyio. Kera egesaku keegwe omwando buna obomera borakegwere. Inamoegwe emiando koreng’ana nebisaku bie chisokoro chiaino.
swahili: Mtaigawanya nchi hiyo kwa kupiga kura, kufuatana na koo zenu. Kwa kundi kubwa zaidi toa urithi mkubwa zaidi, na kwa kundi dogo zaidi urithi mdogo zaidi. Chochote kinachowaangukia kwa kura kitakuwa chao. Mtaigawanya nchi kufuatana na makabila ya babu zenu.

english: But if you do not drive out the inhabitants of the land before you, those you allow to remain will become barbs in your eyes and thorns in your sides; they will harass you in the land where you settle.
ekegusii: Korende onye timogoseria ababiare b’ense eria barue ase more, rirorio baria moratige bamenye amo nainwe ’nababe buna chimbambo chinyoge chikobabeta amaiso aino, na buna amagwa akobabeta ase amakere aino; barabwo nababachaande ase ense eyio mogochia komenya.
swahili: “ ‘Lakini kama hamkuwafukuza wenyeji wakaao katika nchi hiyo, wale mtakaowaruhusu wabaki watakuwa kama sindano kwenye macho yenu na miiba kwenu kila upande. Watawasumbua katika nchi mtakayoishi.

english: And then I will do to you what I had planned to do to them.”
ekegusii: Motabasereti, rirorio nimbakore inwe buna konya narengereirie kobakorera barabwo.”
swahili: Kisha nitawatenda ninyi kile ambacho nimepanga kuwatenda wao.’ ”

english: They set out from Succoth and camped at Etham, on the edge of the wilderness.
ekegusii: Bakarua Sukoti, bakageenda Etamu, ase ensinyo y’erooro, bagatoora aroro.
swahili: Wakaondoka Sukothi na kupiga kambi huko Ethamu, pembeni mwa jangwa.

english: They set out from Etham and turned back to Pi-hahiroth, opposite Baal-zephon, and they camped near Migdol.
ekegusii: Bakarua Etamu, bakaonchoka bakairana bagaika Pi‐Hahiroti, moocha ya Baali‐Sefoni, bagatoora ang’e na Migidoli.
swahili: Wakaondoka Ethamu, wakageuka wakarudi Pi-Hahirothi, hadi mashariki ya Baal-Sefoni, wakapiga kambi yao karibu na Migdoli.

english: They set out from Pi-hahiroth and crossed through the sea, into the wilderness, and they journeyed three days into the Wilderness of Etham and camped at Marah.
ekegusii: Bakarua agwo Pi‐Hahiroti, bakageenda bagaeta egati y’Enyancha Embariri gochia erooro. Erio bakageenda orogeendo rw’amatuko atato ase erooro ya Etamu, bagatoora agwo Mara.
swahili: Wakaondoka Pi-Hahirothi wakapita katikati ya bahari mpaka jangwani, na baada ya kusafiri kwa siku tatu katika Jangwa la Ethamu, walipiga kambi huko Mara.

english: They set out from Marah and came to Elim, where there were twelve springs and seventy palm trees, and they camped there.
ekegusii: Bakarua Mara, bakageenda bagaika Elimu, aase chinsoko chi’amaache ikomi na ibere chiarenge amo nemekendo emerongo etano na ebere, bagatoora aroro.
swahili: Wakaondoka Mara wakaenda Elimu, mahali ambapo palikuwa na chemchemi kumi na mbili na mitende sabini, huko wakapiga kambi.

english: And your eastern border will run straight from Hazar-enan to Shepham,
ekegusii: “Orobebe rwaino rwa moocha rochakere korwa Hasari‐Enani, roikere Sefamu,
swahili: “ ‘Kwa mpaka wenu wa mashariki, wekeni alama kuanzia Hasar-Enani hadi Shefamu.

english: then go down from Shepham to Riblah on the east side of Ain and continue along the slopes east of the Sea of Chinnereth.
ekegusii: naende rotirimboke gochia Ribula, moocha y’Aini, rotirimboke gochia moocha y’engegu y’enyancha ya Galili.
swahili: Mpaka utaelekea kusini kuanzia Shefamu hadi Ribla upande wa mashariki wa Aini, na kuendelea kwenye miteremko mashariki mwa Bahari ya Kinerethi.

english: Then the border will go down along the Jordan and end at the Salt Sea. This will be your land, defined by its borders on all sides.”
ekegusii: Erio rotirimboke robwatie orooche rwa Yorodani rotwomere Enyancha y’omonyoo. Eye nero erabe ense yaino, ne chimbebe chiaye chietanaineo.”
swahili: Kisha mpaka utashuka kuelekea Mto Yordani na kuishia katika Bahari ya Chumvi. “ ‘Hii itakuwa nchi yenu, ikiwa na mipaka yake kila upande.’ ”

english: So Moses commanded the Israelites, “Apportion this land by lot as an inheritance. The LORD has commanded that it be given to the nine and a half tribes.
ekegusii: Musa agachiika Abaisraeli, akabateebia, “Eyio nero ense morarie ebe omwando oino ase ogoaka obomera, ense eri’Omonene achiikire ng’a n’ebe ey’ebisaku kianda na ekeng’ese.
swahili: Mose akawaamuru Waisraeli: “Gawanyeni nchi hii kwa kura kama urithi. Bwana ameagiza kwamba itolewe kwa yale makabila tisa na nusu,

english: For the tribes of the Reubenites and Gadites, along with the half-tribe of Manasseh, have already received their inheritance.
ekegusii: Abanto b’egesaku kia Rubeni na ab’egesaku kia Gadi amo nekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase, barabwo konya banyorire omwando obo.
swahili: kwa sababu jamaa ya kabila la Reubeni, kabila la Gadi, na nusu ya kabila la Manase wamekwishapokea urithi wao.

english: These two and a half tribes have received their inheritance across the Jordan from Jericho, toward the sunrise.” Leaders to Divide the Land
ekegusii: Abanto b’ebisaku ebio bibere na ekeng’ese, barabwo konya banyorire omwando obo moocha ya Yorodani, kororia Yeriko.” Abaraai Abagochia Gwatanana Ense
swahili: Haya makabila mawili na nusu wamekwishapokea urithi wao upande wa mashariki wa Yordani ngʼambo ya Yeriko, kuelekea mawio ya jua.”

english: “These are the names of the men who are to assign the land as an inheritance for you: Eleazar the priest and Joshua son of Nun.
ekegusii: “Abanto aba nabwo bagochia kogokonya gwatanana ense: Ritang’ani Eleazari Omokuani, na Yoshua, mosinto o Nuni.
swahili: “Haya ndiyo majina ya watu ambao watakusaidia kugawanya nchi kama urithi: Eleazari kuhani na Yoshua mwana wa Nuni.

english: Appoint one leader from each tribe to distribute the land.
ekegusii: Naende ochore omoraai oyomo korwa ase kera egesaku aoboseemia gwatanana ense eria.”
swahili: Tena uteue kiongozi mmoja kutoka kila kabila kusaidia kuigawanya nchi.

english: These are their names: Caleb son of Jephunneh from the tribe of Judah;
ekegusii: Aba nabwo abanto bachoretwe. Korwa ase egesaku kia Yuda, Kalebu, mosinto o Yefune.
swahili: Haya ndiyo majina yao: “Kalebu mwana wa Yefune, kutoka kabila la Yuda;

english: “Command the Israelites and say to them: When you enter the land of Canaan, it will be allotted to you as an inheritance with these boundaries:
ekegusii: “Kwana n’Abaisraeli, obachiike: Ekero moraike ase ense ya Kaanani, eyio nero ense erabe omwando oino, chimbebe chiaye nigo chirabe iga:
swahili: “Waamuru Waisraeli na uwaambie: ‘Mtakapoingia nchi ya Kanaani, nchi ambayo itagawanywa kwenu kama urithi itakuwa na mipaka ifuatayo:

english: Shemuel son of Ammihud from the tribe of Simeon;
ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku gia Simioni, Semueli, mosinto bw’Amihudi.
swahili: Shemueli mwana wa Amihudi, kutoka kabila la Simeoni;

english: Elidad son of Chislon from the tribe of Benjamin;
ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku kia Benjamini, Elidadi, mosinto o Kisiloni.
swahili: Elidadi mwana wa Kisloni, kutoka kabila la Benyamini;

english: Bukki son of Jogli, a leader from the tribe of Dan;
ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku gia Dani, Buki, mosinto o Yogili.
swahili: Buki mwana wa Yogli, kiongozi kutoka kabila la Dani;

english: Hanniel son of Ephod, a leader from the tribe of Manasseh son of Joseph;
ekegusii: Korwa ase basinto ba Yusufu; ase egesaku kia Manase, Hanieli, mosinto o Efodi.
swahili: Hanieli mwana wa Efodi, kiongozi kutoka kabila la Manase mwana wa Yosefu;

english: Kemuel son of Shiphtan, a leader from the tribe of Ephraim;
ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku kia Efraimu, Kemueli, mosinto o Sifutani.
swahili: Kemueli mwana wa Shiftani, kiongozi kutoka kabila la Efraimu mwana wa Yosefu;

english: Eli-zaphan son of Parnach, a leader from the tribe of Zebulun;
ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku gia Sabuloni, Elisafani, mosinto o Parinaki.
swahili: Elisafani mwana wa Parnaki, kiongozi kutoka kabila la Zabuloni;

english: Paltiel son of Azzan, a leader from the tribe of Issachar;
ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku gia Isakaru, Palitieli, mosinto bw’Asani.
swahili: Paltieli mwana wa Azani, kiongozi kutoka kabila la Isakari;

english: Ahihud son of Shelomi, a leader from the tribe of Asher;
ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku gi’Aseri, Ahihudi, mosinto o Selomi.
swahili: Ahihudi mwana wa Shelomi, kiongozi kutoka kabila la Asheri;

english: and Pedahel son of Ammihud, a leader from the tribe of Naphtali.”
ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku kia Nafutali, Pedaheli, mosinto bw’Amihudi.
swahili: Pedaheli mwana wa Amihudi, kiongozi kutoka kabila la Naftali.”

english: These are the ones whom the LORD commanded to apportion the inheritance to the Israelites in the land of Canaan.
ekegusii: Abanto aba nabw’Omone ne achiigete baatanane ense ya Kaanani ebe emiando y’Abaisraeli.
swahili: Hawa ndio watu ambao Bwana aliamuru wagawanye urithi kwa Waisraeli katika nchi ya Kanaani.

english: Your southern border will extend from the Wilderness of Zin along the border of Edom. On the east, your southern border will run from the end of the Salt Sea,
ekegusii: Ensemo ya Irianyi, ense yaino eike ase erooro ya Sini, egenderere gochia ase orobebe rwa Edomu. Orobebe rwaino rwa Irianyi rochakere ensemo ya moocha ase ensinyo y’Enyancha y’omonyoo,
swahili: “ ‘Upande wenu wa kusini utajumuisha sehemu ya Jangwa la Sini kufuata mpaka wa Edomu. Upande wa mashariki mpaka wenu wa kusini utaanzia mwisho wa Bahari ya Chumvi,

english: cross south of the Ascent of Akrabbim, continue to Zin, and go south of Kadesh-barnea. Then it will go on to Hazar-addar and proceed to Azmon,
ekegusii: naende roonchoke gochia Irianyi y’egetunwa ki’Ebiuge roetere Sini, Irianyi ya Kadeshi‐Barinea. Korwa agwo rogenderere roike Hasari‐Adari, naende roete roike Asimoni,
swahili: katiza kusini mwa Pito la Akrabimu, endelea mpaka Sini na kwenda kusini ya Kadesh-Barnea. Kisha mpaka huo utaenda hadi Hasar-Adari hadi Azmoni,

english: where it will turn from Azmon, join the Brook of Egypt, and end at the Sea.
ekegusii: na korwa agwo Asimoni rogenderere kobwatia orooche rw’orobebe rwa Misiri, roike Enyancha Enene.
swahili: mahali ambapo utapinda, na kuunganika na Kijito cha Misri na kumalizikia kwenye Bahari ya Kati.

english: Your western border will be the coastline of the Great Sea; this will be your boundary on the west.
ekegusii: “Enyancha Enene nero erabe orobebe rwaino rwa bosongo.
swahili: “ ‘Mpaka wenu wa magharibi utakuwa Bahari ya Kati. Huu utakuwa mpaka wenu upande wa magharibi.

english: Your northern border will run from the Great Sea directly to Mount Hor,
ekegusii: “Orobebe rwaino rwa sugusu ’ndochakere korwa ase Enyancha Enene, rogenderere gochia ase egetunwa kia Hori.
swahili: “ ‘Kwa mpaka wenu wa kaskazini, wekeni alama kuanzia Bahari ya Kati hadi mlima Hori,

english: and from Mount Hor to Lebo-hamath, then extend to Zedad,
ekegusii: Korwa aroro rogenderere roike enchera ekogeenda Hamati, erio naende rogenderere goikera Sedadi,
swahili: na kutoka mlima Hori hadi Pito la Hamathi. Kisha mpaka utaenda hadi Sedadi,

english: continue to Ziphron, and end at Hazar-enan. This will be your boundary on the north.
ekegusii: naende rogenderere gochia Sifuroni, na korwa aroro roike Hasari‐Enani. Oro narwo orobebe rwaino rwa sugusu.
swahili: kuendelea hadi Zifroni, na kuishia Hasar-Enani. Huu utakuwa mpaka wenu upande wa kaskazini.

english: Again the LORD spoke to Moses on the plains of Moab by the Jordan across from Jericho:
ekegusii: Ase enyancha enyomo ya Moabu, ang’e na Yorodani, kororia Yeriko, Omonene agakwana na Musa, akamoteebia,
swahili: Bwana akamwambia Mose katika nchi tambarare ya Moabu, kando ya Mto Yordani kuvukia Yeriko,

english: “Speak to the Israelites and tell them: When you cross the Jordan into the land of Canaan,
ekegusii: “Kwana n’Abaisraeli, obateebie: Ekero moramboke gochia ng’umbu ya Yorodani na goika ense ya Kaanani,
swahili: “Sema na Waisraeli, uwaambie: ‘Mtakapovuka Yordani kuingia Kanaani,

english: designate cities to serve as your cities of refuge, so that a person who kills someone unintentionally may flee there.
ekegusii: mochore emechie erabe obotamero ase more, erinde omonto onde bwensi, ora’be oitire omonto onde mosiabano, natamere oyomo bw’emechie eyio.
swahili: chagueni baadhi ya miji iwe miji yenu ya makimbilio, ambayo mtu ambaye ameua mwenzake bila kukusudia aweza kukimbilia humo.

english: You are to have these cities as a refuge from the avenger, so that the manslayer will not die until he stands trial before the assembly.
ekegusii: Emechie eyio nebe obotamero bwaino, erinde omonto oria okorigia korusia egesiomba ki’oyomwabo oria oitwa, omoiti oria aratamere gochiao, abeereo goika rituko arache korentwa kogambigwa ase obosio bw’omosangererekano bwonsi.
swahili: Itakuwa mahali pa kukimbilia kutoka mlipiza kisasi, ili kwamba mtu aliyeshtakiwa kwa mauaji asife kabla ya kujitetea mbele ya mkutano.

english: The cities you select will be your six cities of refuge.
ekegusii: Emechie eyio morachore ebe ey’obotamero nigo erabe etano nomo.
swahili: Miji hii sita mtakayoitoa itakuwa miji yenu ya makimbilio.

english: Select three cities across the Jordan and three in the land of Canaan as cities of refuge.
ekegusii: Etato ebe moocha ya Yorodani, na etato ebe ase ense ya Kaanani. Eyio ebe emechie y’obotamero.
swahili: Mtatoa miji mitatu ngʼambo hii ya Yordani na miji mingine mitatu upande wa Kanaani kama miji ya makimbilio.

english: These six cities will serve as a refuge for the Israelites and for the foreigner or stranger among them, so that anyone who kills a person unintentionally may flee there.
ekegusii: Emechie eyio etano nomo ebe ey’obotamero ase Abaisraeli, na ase abageni bagoeta, na ase abanto bare abamenyi ase egati yabo, erinde monto onde bwensi oraite omonto mosiabano atancheti atamere oyomo bw’emechie eyio.
swahili: Miji hii sita itakuwa mahali pa makimbilio kwa ajili ya Waisraeli, wageni na watu wengine wanaoishi katikati yenu, ili kwamba mtu yeyote ambaye ameua mtu mwingine pasipo kukusudia aweze kukimbilia humo.

english: If, however, anyone strikes a person with an iron object and kills him, he is a murderer; the murderer must surely be put to death.
ekegusii: “Korende onye omonto oakire omonto onde negento buna ekioma, na omonto oria okuure, omoiti oyio nere goika aitwe akwe.
swahili: “ ‘Kama mtu akimpiga mwenzake kwa chuma naye mtu huyo akafa, mtu huyo ni muuaji; muuaji sharti atauawa.

english: Or if anyone has in his hand a stone of deadly size, and he strikes and kills another, he is a murderer; the murderer must surely be put to death.
ekegusii: Boigo onye omonto obwate rigena ase okoboko kwaye oakire omonto onde, na omonto oria okuure, omoiti oyio nere goika aitwe akwe, ekiagera ere nomoorominta.
swahili: Au kama mtu analo jiwe mkononi mwake ambalo laweza kuua, naye akampiga mwenzake akafa, yeye ni muuaji; muuaji huyo sharti atauawa.

english: If anyone has in his hand a deadly object of wood, and he strikes and kills another, he is a murderer; the murderer must surely be put to death.
ekegusii: Gose onye omonto oakire omonto onde nomote abwate ase okoboko kwaye, erinde omonto oria akwe, omoiti oyio nigo aita oria moeneno, nere goika aitwe akwe.
swahili: Au kama mtu ana chombo cha mti mkononi mwake ambacho chaweza kuua, naye akampiga mwenzake akafa, yeye ni muuaji; muuaji huyo sharti atauawa.

english: The avenger of blood is to put the murderer to death; when he finds him, he is to kill him.
ekegusii: Omonto oria okorigia korusia egesiomba ki’oyomwabo oitetwe, nere oraite omoiti oria aande onsi ase araumerane nere.
swahili: Mlipiza kisasi cha damu atamuua muuaji; wakati akikutana naye, atamuua.

english: “Command the Israelites to give, from the inheritance they will possess, cities for the Levites to live in and pasturelands around the cities.
ekegusii: “Chiika Abaisraeli ng’a korwa ase emiando eyio baranyore baatananere Abalawi emechie baramenye, amo noborisia boetanaineo.
swahili: “Waagize Waisraeli kuwapa Walawi miji ya kuishi kutoka urithi ambao Waisraeli wataumiliki. Wape maeneo ya malisho kuzunguka hiyo miji.

english: Likewise, if anyone maliciously pushes another or intentionally throws an object at him and kills him,
ekegusii: “Onye omonto ogechete oyonde na komoita ase okomotwoma, gose komoruta egento moeneno, na komoita,
swahili: Ikiwa mtu ana chuki ya siku nyingi na mwenzake akamsukuma au akamtupia kitu kwa kukusudia naye akafa,

english: or if in hostility he strikes him with his hand and he dies, the one who struck him must surely be put to death; he is a murderer. When the avenger of blood finds the murderer, he is to kill him.
ekegusii: gose ase engencho y’obobisa bwarengeo agaaka oyonde nokoboko kwaye na komoita, rirorio omonto oria oaka oyonde na komoita, nere goika aitwe akwe. Ere nomoiti. Omonto oria okogania korusia egesiomba ki’oyomwabo, nere oramoite aande onsi ase araumerane nere.
swahili: au ikiwa katika uadui akampiga ngumi naye akafa, mtu yule sharti atauawa; yeye ni muuaji. Mlipiza kisasi cha damu atamuua muuaji atakapokutana naye.

english: But if anyone pushes a person suddenly, without hostility, or throws an object at him unintentionally,
ekegusii: “Eise koba ng’a omonto nigo atwomete oyonde atamogechete agwo ritang’ani, gose nigo amorutete egento mosiabano,
swahili: “ ‘Lakini kama mtu akimsukuma mwenziwe ghafula pasipo chuki, au kumtupia kitu pasipo kukusudia,

english: or without looking drops a heavy stone that kills him, but he was not an enemy and did not intend to harm him,
ekegusii: gose omonto oria nigo arutete rigena, tamorooche, korende akamoaka akamoita atamogechete, gose taganetie komokorera bobe.
swahili: au, pasipo kumwona, akimwangushia jiwe ambalo laweza kumuua naye akafa, basi kwa kuwa hakuwa adui yake naye hakukusudia kumuumiza,

english: The assembly is to protect the manslayer from the hand of the avenger of blood. Then the assembly will return him to the city of refuge to which he fled, and he must live there until the death of the high priest, who was anointed with the holy oil.
ekegusii: Omosangererekano bw’ abanto notoorie omoiti oria korwa ase oria oganetie korusia egesiomba. Bamotige airane abeere ase omochie oria bw’obotamero atamerete, amenye aroro goika Omokuani omonene bw’engaki eyio, oyoakire amagutwa, akwe.
swahili: Kusanyiko ni lazima limlinde yule anayeshtakiwa kuua kutoka kwa mlipiza kisasi wa damu, na kumrudisha katika mji wa makimbilio alikokuwa amekimbilia. Lazima akae humo mpaka atakapokufa kuhani mkuu ambaye alikuwa amepakwa mafuta matakatifu.

english: But if the manslayer ever goes outside the limits of the city of refuge to which he fled
ekegusii: Korende onye omoiti oria o mosiabano ase engaki ende yonsi ogosoka korwa ase omochie bw’obotamero, agwo ase atamerete,
swahili: “ ‘Lakini kama mshtakiwa atatoka nje ya mipaka ya mji wa makimbilio ambao amekimbilia,

english: and the avenger of blood finds him outside of his city of refuge and kills him, then the avenger will not be guilty of bloodshed
ekegusii: na omonto oria okorusia egesiomba ki’oyomwabo amonyore ore isiko y’omochie oria karamoite, rirorio takobarerwa okomocha ase okomoita.
swahili: na mlipiza kisasi wa damu akamkuta nje ya mji, mlipiza kisasi wa damu anaweza kumuua mshtakiwa huyo bila kuwa na hatia ya kuua.

english: because the manslayer must remain in his city of refuge until the death of the high priest. Only after the death of the high priest may he return to the land he owns.
ekegusii: Omonto oria oitete oyonde moeneno goika agenderere kobeera ase omochie oria bw’obotamero goika Omokuani bw’engaki eyio akwe. Korende Omokuani oria omonene gakuure, omonto oria nairane gochia ase ense yaye, na ase omwando oye.
swahili: Mshtakiwa lazima akae katika mji wake wa makimbilio mpaka atakapokufa kuhani mkuu; atarudi tu kwenye mali yake baada ya kifo cha kuhani mkuu.

english: This will be a statutory ordinance for you for the generations to come, wherever you live.
ekegusii: Okwo nogochika kwa boronge koraabe ase more ebiaare ase ebiaare, aase aande onsi ase moraabe momenyete.
swahili: “ ‘Hizi ndizo kanuni za sheria zitakazohitajiwa kwenu na katika vizazi vyenu vijavyo, popote mtakapoishi.

english: The cities will be for them to live in, and the pasturelands will be for their herds, their flocks, and all their other livestock.
ekegusii: Emechie eyio ebe eyabo baramenye, na ebitii bi’oborisia bakorisia chiombe chiabo ne ching’iti chiabo chinde chionsi.
swahili: Kisha watakuwa na miji ya kuishi na maeneo ya malisho kwa ajili ya ngʼombe zao, mbuzi, kondoo na mifugo yao mingine yote.

english: If anyone kills a person, the murderer is to be put to death on the testimony of the witnesses. But no one is to be put to death based on the testimony of a lone witness.
ekegusii: “Omonto onde bwensi karaite omonto onde moeneno, omonto oyio nere goika aitwe akwe ase oborori bw’ abanto babere gose goetania, korende omonto tagoitwa ase oborori bw’omonto oyomo bweka.
swahili: “ ‘Yeyote anayeua mtu atauawa kama muuaji ikiwa tu kuna ushuhuda wa mashahidi. Lakini hakuna mtu atakayeuawa kwa ushuhuda wa shahidi mmoja tu.

english: You are not to accept a ransom for the life of a murderer who deserves to die; he must surely be put to death.
ekegusii: Omonto oitire omonto onde moeneno takoegerwa aruerwe embooria. Omoiti oria onyorekanire n’okomocha kw’ogoita, nere goika aitwe akwe.
swahili: “ ‘Usikubali fidia yoyote ya kuokoa uhai wa muuaji ambaye anastahili kufa. Mtu huyo hakika lazima auawe.

english: Nor should you accept a ransom for the person who flees to a city of refuge and allow him to return and live on his own land before the death of the high priest.
ekegusii: Boigo omonto oria omoiti o mosiabano otamire gochia ase oyomo bw’emechie y’obotamero takoboorigwa ng’a erio airane ase ense yaye ekero Omokuani Omonene bw’engaki eyio atarakwa.
swahili: “ ‘Usikubali fidia ya mtu yeyote ambaye amekimbilia katika mji wa makimbilio na kumruhusu kurudi kuishi katika nchi yake kabla ya kifo cha kuhani mkuu.

english: Do not pollute the land where you live, for bloodshed pollutes the land, and no atonement can be made for the land on which the blood is shed, except by the blood of the one who shed it.
ekegusii: Moise gokora ayio, nigo morasarie ense eye ase momenyete na koyekora ebe eyetachenegeti, ekiagera amanyinga agoiterwa nigo arakore ense ebe etachenegeti, na okobwatanigwa konde tikori korakorwe ase ense eria ase engencho y’amanyinga aiteirwe, otatiga ogoiterwa kw’amanyinga ay’oria omoiti oka.
swahili: “ ‘Msiinajisi nchi mnayoishi. Umwagaji damu hunajisi nchi, na upatanisho hauwezekani kufanyika katika nchi ambayo damu imemwagwa, isipokuwa tu kwa damu ya yule aliyeimwaga damu.

english: Do not defile the land where you live and where I dwell. For I, the LORD, dwell among the Israelites.”
ekegusii: Timokora ense eyio ase momenyete ebe etachenegeti, ekiagera inche nigo imenyete ase egati yaino. Inche ninche Omonene imenyete ase egati y’ abanto bane Abaisraeli.”
swahili: Msiinajisi nchi mnayoishi, ambayo nami ninakaa, kwa kuwa Mimi, Bwana, ninakaa katikati ya Waisraeli.’ ”

english: The pasturelands around the cities you are to give the Levites will extend a thousand cubits from the wall on every side.
ekegusii: Ebitii bi’oborisia morae Abalawi bichakere korwa ase chindwaki chi’omochie, bigareigwe gochia ase oboare bwechifuti elifu eyemo korwa ase kera ensemo y’omochie.
swahili: “Maeneo ya malisho kuzunguka miji hiyo ambayo mtawapa Walawi yataenea mita 450 kutoka kwenye ukuta wa miji.

english: You are also to measure two thousand cubits outside the city on the east, two thousand on the south, two thousand on the west, and two thousand on the north, with the city in the center. These areas will serve as larger pasturelands for the cities.
ekegusii: Naende mobare isiko y’omochie, ensemo ya moocha ekerengo giechifuti chilifu ibere, na ensemo ya Irianyi, na eya sugusu, na eya bosongo boigo, chifuti chilifu ibere; omochie obe gati‐gati. Ebitii ebi bi’oborisia Abalawi baegwe amo ne’mechie yabo.
swahili: Nje ya mji, pima mita 900 upande wa mashariki, upande wa kusini mita 900, upande wa magharibi mita 900, na upande wa kaskazini mita 900, na mji utakuwa katikati. Eneo hili litakuwa lao kwa ajili ya malisho. Miji Ya Makimbilio (Kumbukumbu 19:1-13; Yoshua 20:1-9)

english: Six of the cities you give the Levites are to be appointed as cities of refuge, to which a manslayer may flee. In addition to these, give the Levites forty-two other cities.
ekegusii: Moe Abalawi emechie etan’omo y’obotamero, erinde ekero omonto aitire omonto onde mosiabano, anyare gotamerao, naende mobae emechie ende emeao emerongo ene na ebere.
swahili: “Miji sita mtakayowapa Walawi itakuwa ya makimbilio, ambayo mtu anayemuua mwenzake aweza kukimbilia humo. Zaidi ya hiyo, wapeni miji mingine arobaini na miwili.

english: The total number of cities you give the Levites will be forty-eight, with their corresponding pasturelands.
ekegusii: Emechie yonsi morabae nigo erabe emerongo ene, na etan’etato, amo nebitii bi’oborisia bietanaine emechie eyio.
swahili: Kwa jumla inawapasa kuwapa Walawi miji arobaini na minane, pamoja na maeneo ya malisho yao.

english: The cities that you apportion from the territory of the Israelites should be given to the Levites in proportion to the inheritance of each tribe: more from a larger tribe and less from a smaller one.” Six Cities of Refuge (Deuteronomy 4:41–43; Deuteronomy 19:1–14; Joshua 20:1–9)
ekegusii: Emechie eyio morae Abalawi nigo morayerusie korwa ase eria Abaisraeli babwate. Morusie emechie emenge korwa ase egesaku keria kere ekenene kebwate emechie emenge, na korwa ase egesaku kere egeke kebwate emechie emeke morusie emekeo, koreng’ana nomobaro obo.” Emechie Y’obotamero (Okoir 19:1-3; Yosh 20:1-9)
swahili: Miji ambayo mtawapa Walawi kutoka nchi ambayo Waisraeli wanamiliki itatolewa kwa uwiano wa urithi wa kila kabila. Chukua miji mingi kutoka lile kabila lenye miji mingi, lakini uchukue miji michache kutoka kwa kabila lile lenye miji michache.”

english: Then the LORD said to Moses,
ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa,
swahili: Kisha Bwana akamwambia Mose:

english: Now the family heads of the clan of Gilead son of Machir son of Manasseh, one of the clans of Joseph, approached Moses and the leaders who were the heads of the Israelite families and addressed them,
ekegusii: Erio abanene b’egesaku kia Gileadi mosinto o Makiri mosinto o Manase abwo barenge korwa ase chinyomba chie egesaku kia Yusufu bagaacha na gokwana ase obosio bwa Musa, boigo ase abarai amo na abateneneri b’echinyomba chia Abaisraeli.
swahili: Viongozi wa jamaa ya ukoo wa Gileadi mwana wa Makiri, mwana wa Manase, waliokuwa wametoka katika koo za wazao wa Yosefu, walikuja na kuzungumza mbele ya Mose na viongozi, wakuu wa jamaa ya Waisraeli.

english: So the daughters of Zelophehad did as the LORD had commanded Moses.
ekegusii: Abaiseke ba Selofehadi bagakora buna Omonene Nyasae amochiigete Musa.
swahili: Kwa hiyo binti za Selofehadi wakafanya kama Bwana alivyomwamuru Mose.

english: Mahlah, Tirzah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Noah, the daughters of Zelophehad, were married to cousins on their father’s side.
ekegusii: Abaiseke obwo ba Selofehadi; Maala, Teresa, Ogila, Milika, amo na Nuhu bakanywomwa n’abamwabo korwa are ororeeria rwa ise.
swahili: Binti za Selofehadi, ambao ni Mahla, Tirsa, Hogla, Milka na Noa, wakaolewa na waume, wana wa ndugu za baba yao.

english: They married within the clans of the descendants of Manasseh son of Joseph, and their inheritance remained within the tribe of their father’s clan.
ekegusii: Bakanywomwa gochia ase emechie y’ororeria rwa Manase mosinto o Yusufu erio omwando oise ogatigara ase egesaku kiabo ime ase enyomba yabo.
swahili: Waliolewa ndani ya koo za wazao wa Manase mwana wa Yosefu, na urithi wao ukabaki katika ukoo na kabila la baba yao.

english: These are the commandments and ordinances that the LORD gave the Israelites through Moses on the plains of Moab by the Jordan across from Jericho.
ekegusii: Aya naro amachiiko n’emeroberio y’Omonene Nyasae, buna biaruetwe gochia ase Abaisraeli, goteera ase Musa agwo ase ense omweya ya Moabu ng’umbu y’orooche rwa Yorodani ang’e n’omochie o Yeriko.
swahili: Haya ndiyo maagizo na masharti ambayo Bwana aliwapa Waisraeli kupitia Mose katika tambarare za Moabu, karibu na Yordani ngʼambo ya Yeriko.

english: saying, “When the LORD commanded my lord to give the land as an inheritance to the Israelites by lot, He also commanded him to give the inheritance of our brother Zelophehad to his daughters.
ekegusii: Bagateeba, “ekero Omonene Nyasae aruete ogochika buna ebisaku bigaberwe emegondo buna omwando obo ase obomera, nigo ateebete omwando o Selofehadi oegwe abaiseke baye.
swahili: Wakasema, “ Bwana alipomwamuru bwana wangu kuwapa Waisraeli nchi kama urithi kwa kura, alikuamuru kutoa urithi wa ndugu yetu Selofehadi kwa binti zake.

english: But if they marry any of the men from the other tribes of Israel, their inheritance will be withdrawn from the portion of our fathers and added to the tribe into which they marry. So our allotted inheritance would be taken away.
ekegusii: Eraisa koba barabwo banywomirwe nabaanto b’ebisaku na omwando oyio obo korwa ase emegondo yaito ementeranigwe ase ebisaku biria basokerete; igo omwando bw’egesaku giaito nigo okoirwa korwa ase tore?
swahili: Sasa ikiwa wataolewa na watu wa makabila mengine ya Kiisraeli, itakuwa kwamba urithi wao utaondolewa kutoka urithi wa mababu zetu na kuongezwa katika urithi wa kabila ambalo dada hao wameolewa. Kwa hiyo sehemu ya urithi tuliyogawiwa itachukuliwa kutoka kwetu.

english: And when the Jubilee for the Israelites comes, their inheritance will be added to the tribe into which they marry and taken away from the tribe of our fathers.”
ekegusii: Boigo ekero omwaka bw’echubiri ase Abaisraeli, engaki eria chinibo chionsi chiebisakore chikoiranerigwa abanyene, nenyarekane omwando ase abaiseke ba Selofehadi oriegwe na abasacha babo korwa ase ebisaku bia isiko”.
swahili: Wakati mwaka wa Yubile kwa Waisraeli utafika, urithi wao utaongezwa kwa lile kabila ambalo wameolewa, na mali yao itaondolewa kutoka urithi wa kabila la mababu zetu.”

english: So at the word of the LORD, Moses commanded the Israelites: “The tribe of the sons of Joseph speaks correctly.
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene akarua ogochika ase Musa ogoteeba; ayio nekeene abanto b’ororeria rwa Yusufu bagokwana.
swahili: Ndipo kwa agizo la Bwana Mose akatoa amri ifuatayo kwa Waisraeli: “Kile wazao wa kabila la Yosefu wanachosema ni kweli.

english: This is what the LORD has commanded concerning the daughters of Zelophehad: They may marry anyone they please, provided they marry within a clan of the tribe of their father.
ekegusii: Oko nakwo ogochika ase abaiseke ba Selofehadi, barabwo ’mbare nobosibore konywomwa na monto onde bwensi banchete, korende omonto oyio goika arue ase egesaku kiabo.
swahili: Hivi ndivyo Bwana anavyoamuru kwa binti za Selofehadi: Wanaweza kuolewa na mtu yeyote wampendaye, mradi tu waolewe miongoni mwa koo za kabila za baba yao.

english: No inheritance in Israel may be transferred from tribe to tribe, because each of the Israelites is to retain the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers.
ekegusii: Ase enchera eyio omwando bw’egesaku ekemo tokonyara koirwa n’egesaku kende ekeao. Naboigo kera Omoisraeli narende omwando oye omotungetie.
swahili: Hakuna urithi katika Israeli utakaohamishwa kutoka kabila moja kwenda kabila jingine, kwa kuwa kila Mwisraeli atatunza ardhi ya kabila lake aliyoirithi kutoka kwa baba zake.

english: Every daughter who possesses an inheritance from any Israelite tribe must marry within a clan of the tribe of her father, so that every Israelite will possess the inheritance of his fathers.
ekegusii: Kera omoiseke ore omonyamwando ase egesaku kia Abaisraeli goika anywomwe ase omonto bw’egesaku kiaye, erio kera Omoisraeli anyare konyora omwando korwa ase ororeeria rwe chisokoro chiaye.
swahili: Kila binti atakayerithi ardhi katika kabila lolote la Israeli ni lazima aolewe na mtu kutoka kabila na ukoo wa baba yake, ili kila Mwisraeli amiliki urithi wa baba zake.

english: No inheritance may be transferred from one tribe to another, for each tribe of Israel must retain its inheritance.”
ekegusii: Ase ayio, nenyarekane ng’a omwando bw’egesaku ekemo tokonyara koirwa n’egesaku kende ekeao. Kera egesaku ase Abaisraeli ’nkenyare koegerera omwando oye ogetungetie.
swahili: Hakuna urithi uwezao kuhamishwa kutoka kabila moja kwenda kabila jingine, kwa kuwa kila kabila la Israeli litatunza nchi linayorithi.”

english: This is the account of Aaron and Moses at the time the LORD spoke with Moses on Mount Sinai.
ekegusii: Aba nabwo abanto b’ororeria rwa Aroni, na orwa Musa, ase engaki eri’Omonene akwanete na Musa, agwo ase egetunwa gia Sinai.
swahili: Hii ni hesabu ya jamaa ya Aroni na Mose kwa wakati ambao Bwana alizungumza na Mose katika Mlima Sinai.

english: So you shall appoint Aaron and his sons to carry out the duties of the priesthood; but any outsider who approaches the tabernacle must be put to death.”
ekegusii: Obeeke Aroni amo n’abamura baye bakore emeremo y’obokuani, korende monto onde bwensi omoao aise gwesoyia ase emeremo eyio nigo araitwe akwe.”
swahili: Waweke Aroni na wanawe kuhudumu kama makuhani; mtu mwingine yeyote atakayesogea mahali patakatifu ni lazima auawe.”

english: Again the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
ekegusii: Naende Omonene Nyasae agateebia Musa,
swahili: Bwana akamwambia Mose,

english: “Behold, I have taken the Levites from among the children of Israel in place of every firstborn Israelite from the womb. The Levites belong to Me,
ekegusii: “Rora, inche omonyene neatananerete Abalawi korwa ase Abaisraeli ribaga ri’abana abatangi. Abalawi mbabe abaane,
swahili: “Nimewatwaa Walawi kutoka miongoni mwa Waisraeli badala ya mzaliwa wa kwanza wa kiume wa kila mwanamke wa Mwisraeli. Walawi ni wangu,

english: for all the firstborn are Mine. On the day I struck down every firstborn in the land of Egypt, I consecrated to Myself all the firstborn in Israel, both man and beast. They are Mine; I am the LORD.” The Numbering of the Levites
ekegusii: ekiagera abana abatangi bonsi nabaane. Ase rituko riria naitete abana abatangi, ne ching’iti chintangi, agwo Misiri, nigo neatananerete abana abatangi bonsi b’Abaisraeli babe abaane, ne ching’iti chintangi boigo. Inche ninche Omonene.” Omobaro bw’Abalawi
swahili: kwa kuwa wazaliwa wote wa kwanza ni wangu. Nilipowaua wazaliwa wa kwanza huko Misri, nilimtenga kila mzaliwa wa kwanza katika Israeli awe wangu, akiwa mwanadamu au mnyama. Watakuwa wangu. Mimi ndimi Bwana.”

english: Then the LORD spoke to Moses in the Wilderness of Sinai, saying,
ekegusii: Ekero Musa arenge agwo ase erooro ya Sinai, Omonene agakwana nere, akamoteebia,
swahili: Bwana akamwambia Mose katika Jangwa la Sinai,

english: “Number the Levites by their families and clans. You are to count every male a month old or more.”
ekegusii: “Bara Abalawi enyomba ase enyomba, na eamate ase eamate. Oriike kera omonto omosacha, naboigo kera omwana omomura okoorire omotienyi oyomo na goetania.”
swahili: “Wahesabu Walawi kwa jamaa zao na koo zao. Mhesabu kila mwanaume mwenye umri wa mwezi mmoja au zaidi.”

english: So Moses numbered them according to the word of the LORD, as he had been commanded.
ekegusii: Erio Musa akabaabara, buna Omonene amochiigete.
swahili: Kwa hiyo Mose akawahesabu, kama alivyoamriwa na neno la Bwana.

english: These were the sons of Levi by name: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
ekegusii: Lawi nigo abwate abamura batato: Gerisoni, na Kohati, na Merari.
swahili: Haya yalikuwa majina ya wana wa Lawi: Gershoni, Kohathi na Merari.

english: These were the names of the sons of Gershon by their clans: Libni and Shimei.
ekegusii: Abamura ba Gerisoni nabwo Libini na Simei.
swahili: Haya ndiyo yaliyokuwa majina ya koo za Wagershoni: Libni na Shimei.

english: The sons of Kohath by their clans were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
ekegusii: Abana ba Kohati nabwo aba: Amuramu, na Isari, na Heburoni, na Usieli.
swahili: Koo za Wakohathi zilikuwa ni: Amramu, Ishari, Hebroni na Uzieli.

english: These are the names of the sons of Aaron: Nadab the firstborn, then Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
ekegusii: Aya naro amarieta y’abamura ba Aroni: Nadabu, omomura oye omotangi, na Abihu, na Eleazari, na Itamari.
swahili: Majina ya wana wa Aroni yalikuwa: Nadabu mzaliwa wa kwanza na Abihu, Eleazari na Ithamari.

english: And the sons of Merari by their clans were Mahli and Mushi. These were the clans of the Levites, according to their families. The Gershonites (Numbers 4:21–28; 1 Chronicles 23:7–11)
ekegusii: Abana ba Merari nabwo Mali na Musi. Abanto abwo nigo barenge chisokoro chie chiamate chi’Abalawi, kera oyomo ase eamate yaye.
swahili: Koo za Wamerari zilikuwa ni: Mahli na Mushi. Hizi ndizo zilizokuwa koo za Walawi, kufuatana na jamaa zao.

english: From Gershon came the Libnite clan and the Shimeite clan; these were the Gershonite clans.
ekegusii: Abanto b’eamate ya Libini na eya Simei, abwo nabwo barenge ab’ororeria rwa Gerisoni.
swahili: Kulikuwa na koo za Walibni na Washimei kwa Gershoni; hizi ndizo zilizokuwa koo za Wagershoni.

english: The number of all the males a month old or more was 7,500.
ekegusii: Abanto abasacha, aba konya bakoorire omotienyi oyomo na goetania, nigo barenge chilifu isano ibere, na magana atano (7,500).
swahili: Idadi ya waume wote waliokuwa na mwezi mmoja au zaidi waliohesabiwa walikuwa 7,500.

english: The Gershonite clans were to camp on the west, behind the tabernacle,
ekegusii: Abanto be chiamate chi’Abagerisoni nigo barabe bagotoora ensemo ya bosongo magega y’Obomenyo Obochenu.
swahili: Ukoo wa Wagershoni walitakiwa kuweka kambi zao upande wa magharibi, nyuma ya Maskani.

english: and the leader of the families of the Gershonites was Eliasaph son of Lael.
ekegusii: Eliasafu, mosinto o Laeli, nere oraabe omotang’ani bwe chiamate chi’Abagerisoni.
swahili: Kiongozi wa jamaa za Wagershoni alikuwa Eliasafu mwana wa Laeli.

english: The duties of the Gershonites at the Tent of Meeting were the tabernacle and tent, its covering, the curtain for the entrance to the Tent of Meeting,
ekegusii: Ase Eema y’Omosangererekano Abagerisoni nabwo barabe bakorenda Obomenyo obonyene, na ebimumeko biaye, na ebitambaa bi’egesoero ki’Eema eria.
swahili: Katika Hema la Kukutania, Wagershoni walikuwa na wajibu wa kutunza Maskani na hema, vifuniko vyake, pazia katika mlango wa kuingilia ndani ya Hema la Kukutania,

english: the curtains of the courtyard, the curtain for the entrance to the courtyard that surrounds the tabernacle and altar, and the cords—all the service for these items. The Kohathites (Numbers 4:1–20; 1 Chronicles 23:12–20)
ekegusii: Naende babe bakorenda ebitambaa bigosungwa ase ogotuba eraaro, na ebitambaa bi’egesoero ki’eraaro eetanaine Obomenyo Obochenu, na egesasiimero, ne chingori chiabo. Bakore emeremo ende yonsi eganeirie gokorwa ase ebinto ebio.
swahili: mapazia ya ua, pazia katika ingilio la ua unaozunguka Maskani na madhabahu, pamoja na kamba, na kila kinachohusika kwa matumizi yake.

english: From Kohath came the clans of the Amramites, the Izharites, the Hebronites, and the Uzzielites; these were the clans of the Kohathites.
ekegusii: Abanto b’eamate y’Amuramu, na eya Isari, na eya Heburoni, na eya Usieli; abwo nabwo barenge abanto b’ororeria rwa Kohati.
swahili: Kwa Kohathi kulikuwepo koo za Waamramu, Waishari, Wahebroni na Wauzieli; hizi ndizo zilizokuwa koo za Wakohathi.

english: The number of all the males a month old or more was 8,600. They were responsible for the duties of the sanctuary.
ekegusii: Abanto abasacha, aba konya bakoorire omotienyi oyomo na goetania, nigo barenge chilifu isano isato, na magana atano nomo (8,600). Abanto aba nabwo barabe bakorenda ebinto bire ase Obomenyo Obochenu.
swahili: Hesabu ya waume wote wenye mwezi mmoja au zaidi ilikuwa watu 8,600. Wakohathi waliwajibika kutunza mahali patakatifu.

english: The clans of the Kohathites were to camp on the south side of the tabernacle,
ekegusii: Barabwo nigo barabe bagotoora ensemo ya Irianyi y’Obomenyo boria.
swahili: Koo za Wakohathi zilitakiwa kuweka kambi zao upande wa kusini wa Maskani.

english: These were Aaron’s sons, the anointed priests, who were ordained to serve as priests.
ekegusii: Abamura aba ba Aroni nabwo baagetwe amaguta na gwatananwa ase emeremo y’obokuani.
swahili: Hayo yalikuwa majina ya wana wa Aroni, makuhani wapakwa mafuta, waliokuwa wamesimikwa kuhudumu kama makuhani.

english: and the leader of the families of the Kohathites was Elizaphan son of Uzziel.
ekegusii: Elisafani, mosinto bwa Usieli, nere oraabe omotang’ani bw’egesaku ki’Abakohati.
swahili: Kiongozi wa jamaa za koo za Wakohathi alikuwa Elisafani mwana wa Uzieli.

english: Their duties were the ark, the table, the lampstand, the altars, the articles of the sanctuary used with them, and the curtain—all the service for these items.
ekegusii: Barabwo nabwo barabe bakorenda ebinto ebi: Esanduki eria ere ne chibao chiriikire okobwatana kwogotianania, n’emesa, n’ekebeekerero gie chitaaya, na ebisasimero, na ebikorero bionsi bi’Obomenyo boria, biria abakuani bagokorera emeremo, amo negetambaa getubete Aase Aachenu Mono. Bakore emeremo ende yonsi eganeirie gokorwa ase ebinto ebio.
swahili: Waliwajibika kutunza Sanduku la Agano, meza, kinara cha taa, madhabahu, na vile vyombo vya mahali patakatifu vinavyotumika kuhudumu, pazia, na kila kitu kinachohusika na matumizi yake.

english: The chief of the leaders of the Levites was Eleazar son of Aaron the priest; he oversaw those responsible for the duties of the sanctuary. The Merarites (Numbers 4:29–33; 1 Chronicles 23:21–23)
ekegusii: Eleazari, omomura o Aroni Omokuani, nere oraabe omonene igoro ase abaraai b’Abalawi, naende omoteneneri bw’abaanto barabe bagokora emeremo ase Obomenyo Obochenu.
swahili: Kiongozi mkuu wa Walawi alikuwa Eleazari mwana wa kuhani, Aroni. Aliwekwa juu ya wale waliowajibika kutunza mahali patakatifu.

english: From Merari came the clans of the Mahlites and Mushites; these were the Merarite clans.
ekegusii: Abanto b’eamate ya Mali, na eya Musi abwo nabwo barenge abanto b’ororeria rwa Merari.
swahili: Kwa Merari kulikuwa na koo za Wamahli na Wamushi; hizi zilikuwa koo za Merari.

english: The number of all the males a month old or more was 6,200.
ekegusii: Abanto abasacha, aba konya bakoorire omotienyi oyomo na goetania, nigo barenge chilifu isano nemo, na magana abere (6,200).
swahili: Hesabu ya waume wote wenye umri wa mwaka mmoja au zaidi waliohesabiwa walikuwa 6,200.

english: The leader of the families of the Merarites was Zuriel son of Abihail; they were to camp on the north side of the tabernacle.
ekegusii: Barabwo nigo barabe bagotoora ensemo ya sugusu y’Obomenyo boria. Surieli, mosinto bw’Abihaili, nere oraabe omotang’ani bw’ abanto b’egesaku kia Merari.
swahili: Kiongozi wa jamaa za koo za Wamerari alikuwa Surieli mwana wa Abihaili; hawa walitakiwa kuweka kambi zao upande wa kaskazini mwa Maskani.

english: The duties assigned to the sons of Merari were the tabernacle’s frames, crossbars, posts, bases, and all its equipment—all the service for these items,
ekegusii: Abamerari nabwo barabe bakorenda ebinto ebi: chibao chi’Obomenyo Obochenu, n’emeriibo, ne chisiiro, ne chinterekerero, amo nebikorero biabo bionsi. Bakore emeremo ende yonsi eganeirie gokorwa ase ebinto ebio.
swahili: Wamerari waliwekwa kutunza miimo ya Maskani, mataruma yake, nguzo, vitako na vifaa vyake vyote na kila kitu kilichohusika na matumizi yake,

english: as well as the posts of the surrounding courtyard with their bases, tent pegs, and ropes. Moses and Aaron
ekegusii: Nabwo naende babegetwe korenda chisiiro chi’eraaro amo ne chinterekerero chiabo na ebirochi, ne chingori chiabo.
swahili: na pia nguzo za ua unaozunguka pamoja na vitako vyake, vigingi vya hema na kamba zake.

english: Moses, Aaron, and Aaron’s sons were to camp to the east of the tabernacle, toward the sunrise, before the Tent of Meeting. They were to perform the duties of the sanctuary as a service on behalf of the Israelites; but any outsider who approached the sanctuary was to be put to death.
ekegusii: Musa na Aroni amo nabamura baye mbabe bagotoora kororia Obomenyo Obochenu ensemo ya moocha, bosio bw’Eema y’Omosangererekano. Barabwo nigo barabe bagokora emeremo eganeirie gokorwa ime y’Aase Aachenu, na gotenenera emeremo ende yonsi erakorerwe Abaisraeli. Omonto onde bwensi otatananiri gokora emeremo eyio, korende aike ang’e ase Obomenyo Obochenu, nigo araitwe akwe.
swahili: Mose, na Aroni na wanawe walitakiwa kuweka kambi zao mashariki mwa Maskani, kuelekea mawio ya jua, mbele ya Hema la Kukutania. Wao walihusika na utunzaji wa mahali patakatifu kwa niaba ya Waisraeli. Mtu mwingine yeyote aliyepasogelea mahali patakatifu angeuawa.

english: The total number of Levites that Moses and Aaron counted by their clans at the LORD’s command, including all the males a month old or more, was 22,000. The Redemption of the Firstborn
ekegusii: Abanto abasacha b’Abalawi, aba konya bakoorire omotienyi oyomo na goetania, abwo Musa na Aroni bariigete, eamate ase eamate, buna Omonene abachiigete, nigo barenge chilifu emerongo ebere na ibere (22,000). Abalawi Bakobekwa Ribaga Ri’abamura Abatangi B’Abaisraeli
swahili: Jumla ya hesabu ya Walawi waliohesabiwa na Mose na Aroni kwa amri ya Bwana, kufuatana na koo, pamoja na kila mume mwenye umri wa mwezi mmoja au zaidi, walikuwa 22,000.

english: Nadab and Abihu, however, died in the presence of the LORD when they offered unauthorized fire before the LORD in the Wilderness of Sinai. And since they had no sons, only Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests during the lifetime of their father Aaron. The Duties of the Levites
ekegusii: Korende Nadabu na Abihu, barabwo bagakwera ase obosio bw’Omonene, ekero bamoruerete ase omorero otachenegeti, agwo ase erooro ya Sinai. Barabwo tibabwate abana. Ase ayio Eleazari na Itamari bakagenderera gokora emeremo y’obokuani ase amatuko onsi Aroni ise arenge moyo. Emeremo y’Abalawi
swahili: Hata hivyo Nadabu na Abihu walikufa mbele za Bwana walipotoa sadaka kwa moto usioruhusiwa mbele zake katika Jangwa la Sinai. Hawakuwa na wana; kwa hiyo Eleazari na Ithamari walihudumu peke yao kama makuhani wakati wote wa maisha ya Aroni baba yao.

english: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Number every firstborn male of the Israelites a month old or more, and list their names.
ekegusii: Omonene agakwana na Musa, akamoteebia, “Bara abanto abasacha abatangi, n’abana abamura abatangi bakoorire omotienyi oyomo na goetania, obariike.
swahili: Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Wahesabu wazaliwa wa kwanza wa kiume wote wa Waisraeli wenye umri wa mwezi mmoja au zaidi na uorodheshe majina yao.

english: You are to take the Levites for Me—I am the LORD—in place of all the firstborn of Israel, and the livestock of the Levites in place of all the firstborn of the livestock of the Israelites.”
ekegusii: Inche ninche Omonene. Ase ayio Abalawi ’mbabe abaane. Obanyatananere ribaga ri’abatangi bonsi b’Abaisraeli. Naboigo ne ribaga rie ching’iti chintangi chi’Abaisraeli onyatananere ching’iti chi’Abalawi.”
swahili: Nitwalie Walawi badala ya wazaliwa wa kwanza wa Waisraeli, nayo mifugo ya Walawi badala ya wazaliwa wa mifugo ya Waisraeli. Mimi ndimi Bwana.”

english: So Moses numbered all the firstborn of the Israelites, as the LORD had commanded him.
ekegusii: Musa akabara na korika abatangi bonsi b’Abaisraeli, ne ching’iti chintangi, buna Omonene amochiigete.
swahili: Hivyo Mose akawahesabu wazaliwa wa kwanza wote wa Waisraeli, kama Bwana alivyomwamuru.

english: The total number of the firstborn males a month old or more, listed by name, was 22,273.
ekegusii: Abanto bonsi abasacha abatangi n’abana abamura abatangi konya bakoorire omotienyi oyomo na goetania nigo barenge chilifu emerongo ebere na ibere, na amagana abere, na merongo etano ebere, na batato (22,273).
swahili: Jumla ya hesabu ya wazaliwa wa kwanza waume wenye umri wa mwezi mmoja au zaidi, walioorodheshwa kwa majina, walikuwa 22,273.

english: Again the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
ekegusii: Naende Omonene agateebia Musa,
swahili: Bwana akamwambia Mose,

english: “Take the Levites in place of all the firstborn of Israel, and the livestock of the Levites in place of their livestock. The Levites belong to Me; I am the LORD.
ekegusii: “Ira Abalawi babe abaane ribaga ri’ abanto abasacha abatangi b’Abaisraeli, naende oire ching’iti chi’Abalawi chibe echiane ribaga rie ching’iti chintangi chi’Abaisraeli. Inche ninche Omonene.
swahili: “Watwae Walawi badala ya wazaliwa wa kwanza wote wa Israeli, nayo mifugo ya Walawi badala ya mifugo yao. Walawi watakuwa wangu. Mimi ndimi Bwana.

english: To redeem the 273 firstborn Israelites who outnumber the Levites,
ekegusii: Abanto abasacha abatangi b’Abaisraeli nabange bare, mbaetanetie Abalawi ase amagana abere, na emerongo etano ebere na batato (273).
swahili: Ili kukomboa wazao wa kwanza 273 wa Waisraeli ambao wamezidi hesabu ya Walawi,

english: you are to collect five shekels for each one, according to the sanctuary shekel of twenty gerahs.
ekegusii: Ase ayio oboorie kera oyomo obo ne chitaabu chie chisekeli isano, koreng’ana ne chisekeli chigokorerwa ase Obomenyo Obochenu. (Esekeli eyemo nechigera emerongo ebere).
swahili: kusanya shekeli tano kwa kila mmoja, kufuatana na shekeli ya mahali patakatifu, ambayo ina uzito wa gera ishirini.

english: Give the money to Aaron and his sons as the redemption price for the excess among the Israelites.”
ekegusii: Omoe Aroni amo nabamura baye chitaabu echio chi’okobooria abatangi abwo baetanetie Abalawi.”
swahili: Mpe Aroni na wanawe hizo fedha kwa ajili ya ukombozi wa idadi ya Waisraeli waliozidi.”

english: So Moses collected the redemption money from those in excess of the number redeemed by the Levites.
ekegusii: Ase ayio Musa agasangereria chitaabu chiria chiabooretie abanto baria barenge abange goetania baria babooretigwe ekiagera Abalawi babete ribaga riabo.
swahili: Kwa hiyo Mose akakusanya fedha za ukombozi kutoka kwa wale ambao hesabu yao ilizidi wale waliokombolewa na Walawi.

english: He collected the money from the firstborn of the Israelites: 1,365 shekels, according to the sanctuary shekel.
ekegusii: Ase engencho y’ abanto baria abatangi b’Abaisraeli, akanyora chitaabu chie chisekeli elifu eyemo, na amagana atato, na merongo etano nomo, na isano (1,365), koreng’ana ne chisekeli chigokorerwa ase Obomenyo Obochenu.
swahili: Kutokana na wazaliwa wa kwanza wa Waisraeli alikusanya fedha yenye uzito wa shekeli 1,365 kufuatana na shekeli ya mahali patakatifu.

english: And Moses gave the redemption money to Aaron and his sons in obedience to the word of the LORD, just as the LORD had commanded him.
ekegusii: Musa akaa Aroni amo nabamura baye chitaabu chiria chi’okobooria, buna Omonene amochiigete.
swahili: Mose akampa Aroni na wanawe ile fedha ya ukombozi, kama alivyoamriwa na neno la Bwana.

english: “Bring the tribe of Levi and present them to Aaron the priest to assist him.
ekegusii: “Renta abanto b’egesaku kia Lawi, erinde obabeeke bamokorere Aroni, Omokuani.
swahili: “Walete watu wa kabila la Lawi mbele ya Aroni kuhani ili wamsaidie.

english: They are to perform duties for him and for the whole congregation before the Tent of Meeting, attending to the service of the tabernacle.
ekegusii: Abalawi abwo ’mbakorere Aroni emeremo, boigo bakorere omoganda bwonsi agwo ase Eema y’Omosangererekano, ekero bagokora emeremo ase Obomenyo Obochenu.
swahili: Watafanya huduma kwa ajili yake na kwa jumuiya yote katika Hema la Kukutania kwa kufanya kazi za Maskani.

english: They shall take care of all the furnishings of the Tent of Meeting and fulfill obligations for the Israelites by attending to the service of the tabernacle.
ekegusii: Barabwo ’mbatenenere ebinto bionsi bire ase Eema y’Omosangererekano. Ase ogokora emeremo yonsi ase Obomenyo Obochenu nigo barabe bagokorera Abaisraeli bonsi.
swahili: Watatunza samani zote za Hema la Kukutania, wakitimiza wajibu wa kuhudumia Waisraeli kwa kufanya kazi ya Maskani.

english: Assign the Levites to Aaron and his sons; they have been given exclusively to him from among the Israelites.
ekegusii: Aroni amo n’abamura baye baegwe Abalawi buna ekeegwa korwa ase Abaisraeli.
swahili: Wakabidhi Walawi kwa Aroni na wanawe; hao ndio Waisraeli ambao wanakabidhiwa kwake kabisa.

english: Then the LORD said to Moses and Aaron,
ekegusii: Omonene agakwana na Musa na Aroni, akabateebia,
swahili: Bwana akawaambia Mose na Aroni,
