english: Then they shall wrap it and all its utensils inside a covering of fine leather and put it on the carrying frame.
ekegusii: Nababeeke ekebeekerero ekio amo nebikorero biaye ase omobuko bwe risankwa ri’eng’iti ya rooche, na kobibeka ase ekebogorerio.
swahili: Kisha watakisokotea pamoja na vifaa vyake vyote katika ngozi za pomboo na kukiweka kwenye jukwaa lake.

english: Over the gold altar they are to spread a blue cloth, cover it with fine leather, and insert the poles.
ekegusii: “Naende baare egetambaa kere buru kegima igoro ase egesasiimero keroisirie korwa ase etaabu, na bagetube ne risankwa ri’eng’iti ya rooche; erio basoyie emiaro y’okobogoreria egesasiimero keria.
swahili: “Juu ya madhabahu ya dhahabu watatandaza kitambaa cha buluu na kukifunika kwa ngozi za pomboo na kuweka mipiko yake mahali pake.

english: They are to take all the utensils for serving in the sanctuary, place them in a blue cloth, cover them with fine leather, and put them on the carrying frame.
ekegusii: Nabaimokie ebinto bionsi bigokorerwa ase emeremo agwo ase Obomenyo Obochenu. Babibeke ime ase egetambaa kere buru kegima; erio babitube ne risankwa ri’eng’iti ya rooche na kobibeka ase ekebogorerio.
swahili: “Watavichukua vyombo vyote vinavyotumika kuhudumia mahali patakatifu, watavisokotea kwenye kitambaa cha buluu na kufunika kwa ngozi za pomboo, na kuviweka juu ya miti ya kuchukulia.

english: Then they shall remove the ashes from the bronze altar, spread a purple cloth over it,
ekegusii: Barabwo babuuche ribu, naende batube egesasiimero negetambaa kere monyinga.
swahili: “Wataondoa majivu kutoka madhabahu ya shaba na kutandaza kitambaa cha zambarau juu yake.

english: and place on it all the vessels used to serve there: the firepans, meat forks, shovels, and sprinkling bowls—all the equipment of the altar. They are to spread over it a covering of fine leather and insert the poles.
ekegusii: Igoro ase egesasiimero ekio babeeke ebikorero bionsi ebio bigokorerwa ase ogosasiima: chindogio chi’okorenta omorero, ne chigami, na ebichiiko, ne chisani, naende baare risankwa ri’eng’iti ya rooche igoro ase ebio bionsi, babitube. Erio basoyie emiaro y’okobogoreria egesasiimero keria.
swahili: Kisha wataweka vyombo vyote juu yake vinavyotumika kwa kuhudumia madhabahuni pamoja na vyombo vya kutolea moto, nyuma, miiko na mabakuli ya kunyunyizia. Juu yake watatandaza ngozi za pomboo ya kufunika, na kuweka mipiko mahali pake.

english: When Aaron and his sons have finished covering the holy objects and all their equipment, as soon as the camp is ready to move, the Kohathites shall come and do the carrying. But they must not touch the holy objects, or they will die. These are the transportation duties of the Kohathites regarding the Tent of Meeting.
ekegusii: Ekero engaki eraike, abanto barabe bakomanora na koimoka korwa ase ebitwori, na ekero Aroni na abamura baye bakoorire gotuba Eema y’Omosangererekano, amo n’ebinto bionsi bireo, Abakohati bachiche babogorie ebinto ebi ebichenu, korende tibabikuna. Baise kobikuna, nigo barakwe. “Emeremo y’okobogoria ebinto ebio bi’Eema y’Omosangererekano nigo erabe ey’Abakohati.
swahili: “Baada ya Aroni na wanawe kumaliza kazi ya kufunika samani takatifu na vyombo vyake vyote, watu watakapokuwa tayari kungʼoa kambi, Wakohathi watakuja kufanya kazi ya kubeba. Lakini wasije wakagusa vitu vitakatifu la sivyo watakufa. Wakohathi ndio watakaobeba vile vitu vilivyomo katika Hema la Kukutania.

english: Eleazar son of Aaron the priest shall oversee the oil for the light, the fragrant incense, the daily grain offering, and the anointing oil. He has oversight of the entire tabernacle and everything in it, including the holy objects and their utensils.”
ekegusii: “Eleazari, omomura o Aroni Omokuani, nere oratenenere amaguta e chitaaya, na ubani egotioka buya, na okoruegwa kw’endagera gwa kera rituko, na amaguta akweakwa. Ase igo emeremo yaye ebe ey’okorenda Obomenyo Obochenu, na ebinto bionsi ebichenu, na ebinto bionsi ebichenu ebire imeo.”
swahili: “Eleazari mwana wa Aroni, kuhani, ndiye atakayesimamia mafuta kwa ajili ya taa, uvumba wenye harufu nzuri, sadaka za kila siku za nafaka na mafuta ya upako. Ndiye atakayekuwa msimamizi wa maskani yote ya Bwana na kila kitu kilichomo ndani mwake pamoja na samani takatifu na vyombo vyake.”

english: Then the LORD said to Moses and Aaron,
ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa na Aroni,
swahili: Bwana akawaambia Mose na Aroni,

english: “Do not allow the Kohathite tribal clans to be cut off from among the Levites.
ekegusii: “Timotiga abanto be chiamate chia Kohati basirigwe korwa ase Abalawi.
swahili: “Hakikisheni kwamba koo za kabila la Wakohathi hawatengwi kutoka Walawi.

english: In order that they may live and not die when they come near the most holy things, do this for them: Aaron and his sons are to go in and assign each man his task and what he is to carry.
ekegusii: Ase ayio, ekero barabe bagoika ang’e n’ebinto biria ebichenu mono, Aroni na abamura baye basoe aroro, bae kera oyomo obo emeremo, na komoteebia keria arabe ogokora na kobogoria. Erio nario barabe moyo, tibakwa.
swahili: Ili wapate kuishi wala wasife wanapokaribia vitu vitakatifu sana, uwafanyie hivi: Aroni na wanawe watakwenda mahali patakatifu na kumgawia kila mtu kazi yake, na kwamba ni nini atakachochukua.

english: “Take a census of the Kohathites among the Levites by their clans and families,
ekegusii: “Kora omobaro bw’Abalawi baria bare be chiamate chia Kohati, eamate ase eamate, na enyomba ase enyomba,
swahili: “Wahesabu Wakohathi walio sehemu ya Walawi kwa koo zao na jamaa zao.

english: But the Kohathites are not to go in and look at the holy objects, even for a moment, or they will die.” The Duties of the Gershonites (Numbers 3:21–26; 1 Chronicles 23:7–11)
ekegusii: Korende Abakohati baise gosoa na korora ebinto biria ebichenu, nonya netagika ensinini, nigo barakwe.” Emeremo Y’Abagerisoni
swahili: Lakini Wakohathi hawaruhusiwi kuingia ndani ili kuangalia vitu vitakatifu, hata kwa kitambo kidogo, la sivyo watakufa.” Wagershoni

english: And the LORD said to Moses,
ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa,
swahili: Bwana akamwambia Mose,

english: “Take a census of the Gershonites as well, by their families and clans,
ekegusii: “Kora omobaro bw’Abalawi baria bare b’ororeria rwa Gerisoni, eamate ase eamate, na enyomba ase enyomba.
swahili: “Wahesabu pia Wagershoni kwa jamaa zao na koo zao.

english: from thirty to fifty years old, counting everyone who comes to serve in the work at the Tent of Meeting.
ekegusii: Oriike abasacha bonsi abare egati y’emiaka emerongo etato na merongo etano, abwo bonsi baranyare gokora emeremo ase Eema y’Omosangererekano.
swahili: Wahesabu wanaume wote wenye umri wa miaka thelathini hadi hamsini ambao huja kutumika katika Hema la Kukutania.

english: This is the service of the Gershonite clans regarding work and transport:
ekegusii: Eye nero emeremo abanto be chiamate chia Gerisoni barakore naende buna barabe bakobogoria ebinto ebi:
swahili: “Hii ndiyo huduma ya koo za Wagershoni wakati wanapofanya kazi na kubeba mizigo.

english: They are to carry the curtains of the tabernacle, the Tent of Meeting with the covering of fine leather over it, the curtains for the entrance to the Tent of Meeting,
ekegusii: Barabwo mbabogorie ebitambaa bi’Obomenyo Obochenu amo nebitubo bi’Eema eria, ne risankwa ri’eng’iti ya rooche rikobituba, na egetambaa ki’egesoero ki’Eema eria,
swahili: Watabeba mapazia ya maskani. Hema la Kukutania, kifuniko chake na kifuniko cha nje cha ngozi za pomboo, mapazia ya maingilio ya Hema la Kukutania,

english: the curtains of the courtyard, and the curtains for the entrance at the gate of the courtyard that surrounds the tabernacle and altar, along with their ropes and all the equipment for their service. The Gershonites will do all that needs to be done with these items.
ekegusii: na ebitambaa bi’eraaro eetanaine Obomenyo boria na egesasiimero, na ebitambaa bi’egesoero ki’eraaro, ne chingori chionsi chireo amo nebikorero bigokorerwao. Barabwo bakore emeremo ende yonsi eganeirie gokorwa ase ebinto ebio.
swahili: mapazia ya ua unaozunguka Maskani na madhabahu, pazia la maingilio, kamba na vifaa vyote vinavyotumika katika huduma yake. Wagershoni watafanya yote yatakiwayo kufanyika na vitu hivi.

english: All the service of the Gershonites—all their transport duties and other work—is to be done at the direction of Aaron and his sons; you are to assign to them all that they are responsible to carry.
ekegusii: Aroni na abamura baye nabwo barachike Abagerisoni ebinto bionsi barabe bakobogoria, na onsi aya barakore; inwe mobatige batenenere ebinto bionsi barabe bakobogoria.
swahili: Utumishi wao wote ukiwa ni kuchukua au wa kufanya kazi nyingine, utafanyika chini ya maelekezo ya Aroni na wanawe. Mtawapangia kama wajibu wao yote watakayoyafanya.

english: This is the service of the Gershonite clans at the Tent of Meeting, and their duties shall be under the direction of Ithamar son of Aaron the priest. The Duties of the Merarites (Numbers 3:33–37; 1 Chronicles 23:21–23)
ekegusii: Itamari, omomura o Aroni Omokuani, nere oratenenere emeremo abanto be chiamate chi’Abagerisoni barabe bagokora agwo ase Eema y’Omosangererekano.” Emeremo Y’Abamerari
swahili: Hii ndiyo huduma ya koo za Wagershoni katika Hema la Kukutania. Wajibu wao utakuwa chini ya maelekezo ya Ithamari mwana wa kuhani Aroni. Wamerari

english: men from thirty to fifty years old—everyone who is qualified to serve in the work at the Tent of Meeting.
ekegusii: abwo bare egati y’emiaka emerongo etato na merongo etano, abwo bonsi baranyare gokora emeremo ase Eema y’Omosangererekano.
swahili: Wahesabu wanaume wote wenye umri wa miaka thelathini hadi hamsini wanaokuja kutumika katika kazi ya Hema la Kukutania.

english: from thirty to fifty years old, counting everyone who comes to serve in the work of the Tent of Meeting.
ekegusii: Oriike abasacha bonsi abare egati y’emiaka emerongo etato na merongo etano, abwo bonsi baranyare gokora emeremo ase Eema y’Omosangererekano.
swahili: Wahesabu wanaume wote kuanzia umri wa miaka thelathini hadi hamsini ambao watakuja kutumika katika Hema la Kukutania.

english: This is the duty for all their service at the Tent of Meeting: to carry the frames of the tabernacle with its crossbars, posts, and bases,
ekegusii: Emeremo yabo ase Eema eria ebe ey’okobogoria ebinto ebi: Chibao chi’Obomenyo Obochenu, na emeriibo, ne chisiiro amo ne chinterekerero chiabo,
swahili: Huu ndio wajibu wao wanapofanya huduma katika Hema la Kukutania: kubeba miimo ya Maskani, mataruma yake, nguzo na vitako,

english: and the posts of the surrounding courtyard with their bases, tent pegs, and ropes, including all their equipment and everything related to their use. You shall assign by name the items that they are responsible to carry.
ekegusii: ne chisiiro chi’eraaro amo ne chinterekerero chiabo, na ebirochi, ne chingori, amo nebikorero bionsi bigokorerwao. Obaatorere ebinto bionsi barabwo barabe bakobogoria.
swahili: nguzo za ua unaozunguka pamoja na vitako vyake, vigingi vya hema, kamba, vifaa vyake vyote na kila kitu kinachohusiana na matumizi yake. Kila mtu mpangie vitu maalum vya kubeba.

english: This is the service of the Merarite clans according to all their work at the Tent of Meeting, under the direction of Ithamar son of Aaron the priest.” The Numbering of the Levite Clans
ekegusii: Eye nero emeremo y’ abanto be chiamate chia Merari barabe bagokora agwo ase Eema y’Omosangererekano, inse y’oboteneneri bwa Itamari, omomura o Aroni Omokuani.” Omobaro bw’Abalawi
swahili: Huu ndio utumishi wa koo za Merari kama watakavyofanya kazi katika Hema la Kukutania, chini ya maelekezo ya Ithamari mwana wa kuhani, Aroni.” Kuhesabiwa Kwa Koo Za Walawi

english: So Moses, Aaron, and the leaders of the congregation numbered the Kohathites by their clans and families,
ekegusii: Musa, na Aroni, na abaraai b’omoganda bagakora omobaro bw’ororeria rwa Kohati, eamate ase eamate, na enyomba ase enyomba.
swahili: Mose, Aroni na viongozi wa jumuiya wakawahesabu Wakohathi kwa koo zao na jamaa zao.

english: everyone from thirty to fifty years old who came to serve in the work at the Tent of Meeting.
ekegusii: Bakariika abasacha bonsi abaare egati y’emiaka emerongo etato na merongo etano, abwo baare konyara gokora emeremo ase Eema y’Omosangererekano.
swahili: Wanaume wote kuanzia umri wa miaka thelathini hadi hamsini ambao walikuja kutumika katika Hema la Kukutania,

english: These were counted from the Kohathite clans, everyone who could serve at the Tent of Meeting. Moses and Aaron numbered them according to the command of the LORD through Moses.
ekegusii: Oyio n’oro omobaro bwe chiamate chi’Abakohati abwo baare konyara gokora emeremo agwo ase Eema y’Omosangererekano, abwo Musa na Aroni baabarete, buna Omonene achiigete Musa.
swahili: Hii ilikuwa ndiyo jumla ya wote wale wa koo za Wakohathi ambao walitumika katika Hema la Kukutania. Mose na Aroni waliwahesabu kufuatana na amri ya Bwana kupitia kwa Mose.

english: Then the Gershonites were numbered by their clans and families,
ekegusii: Oyo n’oro omobaro bw’ororeria rwa Gerisoni, eamate ase eamate, na enyomba ase enyomba.
swahili: Wagershoni walihesabiwa kwa koo zao na jamaa zao.

english: everyone from thirty to fifty years old who came to serve in the work at the Tent of Meeting.
ekegusii: Abanto abwo baare egati y’emiaka emerongo etato na merongo etano, naende barenge konyara gokora emeremo ase Eema y’Omosangererekano, bakariikwa.
swahili: Watu wote kuanzia umri wa miaka thelathini hadi hamsini ambao walikuja kutumika katika Hema la Kukutania,

english: This service of the Kohathites at the Tent of Meeting regards the most holy things.
ekegusii: Emeremo Abakohati barakore agwo ase Eema eria nokorenda ebinto bire ebichenu mono.
swahili: “Hii ndiyo kazi ya Wakohathi katika Hema la Kukutania: Watatunza vitu vilivyo vitakatifu sana.

english: And those numbered by their clans and families totaled 2,630.
ekegusii: Abwo nigo barenge abanto chilifu ibere, amagana atano nomo na merongo etato (2,630).
swahili: waliohesabiwa kwa koo zao na jamaa zao, walikuwa 2,630.

english: These were counted from the Gershonite clans who served at the Tent of Meeting, whom Moses and Aaron counted at the LORD’s command.
ekegusii: Oyo n’oro omobaro bwe chiamate chi’Abagerisoni, abarigetwe, abwo baare konyara gokora emeremo ase Eema y’Omosangererekano, abwo Musa na Aroni baabarete, buna Omonene achiigete.
swahili: Hii ilikuwa ndiyo jumla ya wale wa koo za Gershoni ambao walitumika katika Hema la Kukutania. Mose na Aroni waliwahesabu kufuatana na amri ya Bwana.

english: And the Merarites were numbered by their clans and families,
ekegusii: Oyo n’oro omobaro bw’ororeria rwa Merari, eamate ase eamate, na enyomba ase enyomba.
swahili: Wamerari walihesabiwa kwa koo zao na jamaa zao.

english: everyone from thirty to fifty years old who came to serve in the work at the Tent of Meeting.
ekegusii: Abasacha abwo baare egati y’emiaka emerongo etato na merongo etano, naende barenge konyara gokora emeremo ase Eema y’Omosangererekano, bakariikwa.
swahili: Wanaume wote kuanzia umri wa miaka thelathini hadi miaka hamsini ambao walikuja kutumika katika Hema la Kukutania,

english: The men registered by their clans numbered 3,200.
ekegusii: Abwo nigo barenge abanto chilifu isato, n’amagana abere (3,200).
swahili: waliohesabiwa kwa koo zao, walikuwa 3,200.

english: These were counted from the Merarite clans, whom Moses and Aaron numbered at the LORD’s command through Moses.
ekegusii: Oyo n’oro omobaro bwe chiamate chi’Abamerari, abwo Musa na Aroni baabarete, buna Omonene achiigete Musa.
swahili: Hii ilikuwa ndiyo jumla ya wale wa koo za Wamerari. Mose na Aroni waliwahesabu kufuatia amri ya Bwana kupitia kwa Mose.

english: So Moses, Aaron, and the leaders of Israel numbered by their clans and families all the Levites
ekegusii: Musa, na Aroni, na abaraai b’Abaisraeli nigo baabarete Abalawi bonsi eamate ase eamate, na enyomba ase enyomba.
swahili: Hivyo Mose, Aroni na viongozi wa Israeli waliwahesabu Walawi wote kwa koo zao na jamaa zao.

english: from thirty to fifty years old who came to do the work of serving and carrying the Tent of Meeting.
ekegusii: Abwo abaare egati y’emiaka emerongo etato na merongo etano, naende barenge konyara gokora emeremo ase Eema y’Omosangererekano,
swahili: Wanaume wote wenye umri kuanzia miaka thelathini hadi hamsini waliokuja kufanya kazi ya kuhudumu na kubeba Hema la Kukutania

english: At the LORD’s command they were numbered through Moses and each one was assigned his work and burden, as the LORD had commanded Moses.
ekegusii: Abwo bonsi nigo baabaretwe buna Omonene achiigete goetera ase Musa. Kera omonto agateebigwa emeremo yaye arakore na ebinto arabogorie buna Omonene achiigete Musa.
swahili: Kwa amri ya Bwana kupitia Mose, kila mmoja aligawiwa kazi yake na kuambiwa kitu cha kubeba. Hivyo ndivyo walivyohesabiwa kama Bwana alivyomwamuru Mose.

english: Whenever the camp sets out, Aaron and his sons are to go in, take down the veil of the curtain, and cover the ark of the Testimony with it.
ekegusii: “Ekero abanto barabe bakomanora na koimoka korwa ase ebitwori, Aroni amo n’abamura baye babe bagosoa ase Eema ime, basungore egetambaa keria getubete Esanduki eria ere ne chibao chiriikire oborori, na gotuba Esanduki eria negetambaa ekio.
swahili: Wakati kambi inapohamishwa, Aroni na wanawe wataingia ndani na kushusha lile pazia la kuzuilia na kufunika nalo Sanduku la Ushuhuda.

english: They are to place over this a covering of fine leather, spread a solid blue cloth over it, and insert its poles.
ekegusii: Naende batube egetambaa ekio ne risankwa ri’eng’iti ya rooche, na igoro ase risankwa erio baare egetambaa kere buru kegima. Erio basoyie emiaro y’okobogoreria Esanduki eria.
swahili: Kisha watafunika juu yake na ngozi za pomboo, na kutandaza juu yake kitambaa cha rangi ya buluu iliyokolea na kuingiza mipiko mahali pake.

english: Over the table of the Presence they are to spread a blue cloth and place the plates and cups on it, along with the bowls and pitchers for the drink offering. The regular bread offering is to remain on it.
ekegusii: “Igoro ase emesa yemegati ekoruegwa ase Omonene baare egetambaa kere buru kegima, naende babeekeo chinteru, ne chisani ase ubani, amo n’ebitaabo n’ebitoono, ase ebio bagochia koumora okoruegwa kw’ebinyugwa. Emegati ekoruegwa botambe ase Omonene ebekweo boigo.
swahili: “Juu ya meza ya mikate ya Wonyesho watatandaza kitambaa cha buluu na waweke sahani juu yake, masinia, bakuli na magudulia kwa ajili ya sadaka za kinywaji; mkate ule ambao upo hapa daima utabaki juu yake.

english: And they shall spread a scarlet cloth over them, cover them with fine leather, and insert the poles.
ekegusii: Baare egetambaa ekebariri igoro ase ebinto ebio, bagetube ne risankwa ri’eng’iti ya rooche, na basoyie emiaro y’okobogoreria emesa eria.
swahili: Juu ya hivyo vitu watatandaza kitambaa chekundu na kufunika kwa ngozi za pomboo na kuweka mipiko yake mahali pake.

english: They are to take a blue cloth and cover the lampstand used for light, together with its lamps, wick trimmers, and trays, as well as the jars of oil with which to supply it.
ekegusii: “Erio baimokie egetambaa kere buru kegima, batube ekebeekerero gie chitaaya amo ne chitaaya chiaye, na ebinachi, ne chindogio chiaye, ne chichuba chire n’amaguta y’amazeituni, ebinto bigokorerwa ase emeremo y’obokuani.
swahili: “Watachukua kitambaa cha buluu na kufunika kinara cha taa kilicho kwa ajili ya nuru, pamoja na taa zake, mikasi yake, sinia zake, magudulia yake yote yaliyotumika kuwekea mafuta.

english: Each man’s sacred gifts are his own, but whatever he gives to the priest will belong to the priest.” The Adultery Test
ekegusii: Ebinto bionsi omonto araatanane koba ebichenu nigo birabe ebi’Omokuani oyio okobiegwa.” Abakungu Bagokagerwa Nabasaacha Babo Ng’a Tibari Abegenwa
swahili: Kila kitu cha mtu kilichowekwa wakfu ni chake mwenyewe, lakini kile atoacho kwa kuhani kitakuwa cha kuhani.’ ” Jaribio Kwa Ajili Ya Mke Asiye Mwaminifu

english: “Speak to the Israelites and tell them that if any man’s wife goes astray and is unfaithful to him
ekegusii: Teebia Abaisraeli: Ebaise koba ng’a omokungu bw’omonto obeire otari omwegenwa’ ase are.
swahili: “Nena na Waisraeli uwaambie: ‘Ikiwa mke wa mtu amepotoka na si mwaminifu kwa mumewe,

english: by sleeping with another man, and it is concealed from her husband and her impurity is undetected (since there is no witness against her and she was not caught in the act),
ekegusii: Omonto omoao kararaare nere ase obotomani, nonya ayio karabe abisekanete ase omosacha bw’omokuungu oyio, omokungu oyio bwekorire omosaria, nonya kirori onde tari okomoteeba ekiagera tabwatetwe okobokora.
swahili: kwa kukutana kimwili na mwanaume mwingine, tendo hili likafichika kwa mumewe na unajisi wake usigundulike (kwa kuwa hakuna ushahidi dhidi yake, naye hakukamatwa katika tendo hilo),

english: and if a feeling of jealousy comes over her husband and he suspects his wife who has defiled herself—or if a feeling of jealousy comes over him and he suspects her even though she has not defiled herself—
ekegusii: Omosacha oye karabe n’Omoika bwe endamwamu akagere mok’aye ng’a bwekorire omosaria, nere abe okorete ayio, gose tayakorete,
swahili: nazo hisia za wivu zikamjia mumewe na kumshuku mkewe, naye mke yule ni najisi, au mumewe ana wivu na akamshuku ingawa si najisi,

english: then he is to bring his wife to the priest. He must also bring for her an offering of a tenth of an ephah of barley flour. He is not to pour oil over it or put frankincense on it, because it is a grain offering for jealousy, an offering of memorial as a reminder of iniquity.
ekegusii: omosacha oye amoire ase Omokuani. Boigo arue obosie bw’esairi ebimunu bibere, ase engencho y’omokuungu oria. Taumora amaguta igoro y’okoruegwa okwo, gose ubani, ekiagera n’okoruegwa ase engencho ye risemi riaye. Okwo n’okoruegwa koragere okomocha koinyorwe.
swahili: basi atampeleka mkewe kwa kuhani. Huyo mume itampasa apeleke pia sadaka ya unga wa shayiri kiasi cha sehemu ya kumi ya efa kwa niaba ya mkewe. Huyo mwanaume kamwe asimimine mafuta juu ya huo unga wala asiweke uvumba juu yake, kwa sababu ni sadaka ya nafaka kwa ajili ya wivu, sadaka ya ukumbusho ili kukumbushia uovu.

english: The priest is to bring the wife forward and have her stand before the LORD.
ekegusii: Omokuani arente omokungu oria amobeeke ase obosio bw’Omonene,
swahili: “ ‘Kuhani atamleta huyo mwanamke na kumsimamisha mbele za Bwana.

english: Then he is to take some holy water in a clay jar and put some of the dust from the tabernacle floor into the water.
ekegusii: aumore amaache amaachenu ase egetaabo ki’amaroba, naende aimokie amaroba korwa inse agwo ase Obomenyo Obochenu, ayabeeke ime ase amaache aria.
swahili: Kisha kuhani atachukua sehemu ya maji matakatifu ndani ya gudulia la udongo na kuchanganya na baadhi ya vumbi kutoka sakafu ya Maskani.

english: After the priest has the woman stand before the LORD, he is to let down her hair and place in her hands the grain offering of memorial, which is the grain offering for jealousy. The priest is to hold the bitter water that brings a curse.
ekegusii: Omokuani abeeke omokungu oria ase obosio bw’Omonene, asansore etukia y’omotwe bw’omokuungu oria, naende abeeke okoruegwa koria gw’ekeinyorio ase amaboko ’omokuungu oria. Omokuani omonyene abwate ase okoboko kwaye egetaabo kere namaache amaroro, ayio akorenta okoragereria.
swahili: Baada ya kuhani kumsimamisha huyo mwanamke mbele za Bwana, atazifungua nywele za huyo mwanamke na kuweka sadaka ya ukumbusho mikononi mwake, ile sadaka ya nafaka kwa ajili ya wivu, huku kuhani mwenyewe akishikilia yale maji machungu yaletayo laana.

english: And he is to put the woman under oath and say to her, ‘If no other man has slept with you and you have not gone astray and become defiled while under your husband’s authority, may you be immune to this bitter water that brings a curse.
ekegusii: Erio Omokuani abeeke omokungu oyio inse y’okoragererigwa, amoteebie: Onye omonto omoao taraarete naye, na igo tigwakorete obotomani ase ogotaba omwegenwa ase omosacha oo, rirorio amaache aya amaroro akorenta okoragererigwa takonyara kogokorera bobe bonde.
swahili: Kisha kuhani atamwapiza huyo mwanamke, akimwambia, “Ikiwa hakuna mwanaume mwingine aliyekutana kimwili nawe, wala hujapotoka na kuwa najisi wakati ukiwa umeolewa na mumeo, maji haya machungu yaletayo laana na yasikudhuru.

english: “Command the Israelites to send away from the camp anyone with a skin disease, anyone who has a bodily discharge, and anyone who is defiled by a dead body.
ekegusii: “Bachiike Abaisraeli barusie korwa ase ebitwori biabo kera omonto obwate oborwaire bwa ukoma, na omonto okorua amaache anga buna chimengere, na omonto onde bwensi bwesoyirie ase ogotacheneka ase ogokuna egetondo.
swahili: “Waamuru Waisraeli kumtoa nje ya kambi mtu yeyote ambaye ana ugonjwa wa ngozi uambukizao, au anayetokwa na majimaji ya aina yoyote, au ambaye ni najisi kwa utaratibu wa ibada kwa sababu ya maiti.

english: But if you have gone astray while under your husband’s authority and have defiled yourself and lain carnally with a man other than your husband’—
ekegusii: Korende onye gwatomanire nomonto omoao ase ogotaba omwegenwa ase omosacha oo, na gwekorire omosaria,
swahili: Lakini ikiwa umepotoka wakati ukiwa umeolewa na mume wako na umejinajisi mwenyewe kwa kukutana kimwili na mwanaume mwingine asiyekuwa mumeo”;

english: and the priest shall have the woman swear under the oath of the curse—‘then may the LORD make you an attested curse among your people by making your thigh shrivel and your belly swell.
ekegusii: (agwo Omokuani abeeke omokungu oyio inse y’okoragererigwa gw’okomotiania) rirori’Omonene nagere abanto bao bakoragererie na kogochaaya, karakore enda yao egombae na kobimba.
swahili: hapa kuhani atamweka huyo mwanamke chini ya laana ya kiapo akisema: “ Bwana na awafanye watu wako wakulaani na kukukataa, wakati Bwana atakapolifanya paja lako kupooza na tumbo lako kuvimba.

english: May this water that brings a curse enter your stomach and cause your belly to swell and your thigh to shrivel.’ Then the woman is to say, ‘Amen, Amen.’
ekegusii: Tiga amaache aya akorenta okoragereria kagosoa enda yao, ayekore ebimbe na kogombaa. Omokungu oria airanerie: Ee, ekeene, amina.
swahili: Maji haya yaletayo laana na yaingie ndani ya mwili wako ili tumbo lako livimbe na paja lako lipooze.” “ ‘Kisha mwanamke atasema, “Amen. Iwe hivyo.”

english: And the priest shall write these curses on a scroll and wash them off into the bitter water.
ekegusii: “Erio Omokuani ariike amang’ana ayio ay’okoragereria okwo ime ase egetabu, naende ayasibie namaache aria amaroro.
swahili: “ ‘Kuhani ataandika laana hizi kwenye kitabu, kisha atazioshea laana hizo kwenye yale maji machungu.

english: He is to have the woman drink the bitter water that brings a curse, and it will enter her and cause her bitter suffering.
ekegusii: Erio ae omokungu oria amaache ayio anywe, na ekero amaache aya amaroro asoire ase enda yaye arente okoragererigwa na obororo.
swahili: Kuhani atamnywesha yule mwanamke yale maji machungu yaletayo laana, nayo maji haya yatamwingia na kumsababishia maumivu makali.

english: The priest shall take from her hand the grain offering for jealousy, wave it before the LORD, and bring it to the altar.
ekegusii: Omokuani arusie korwa ase okoboko kw’omokuungu oria okoruegwa kwe endamwamu, na kogosungusia ase obosio bw’Omonene. Magega y’ayio akorente ase egesasiimero.
swahili: Kuhani atachukua sadaka ya nafaka kwa ajili ya wivu kutoka mikononi mwa huyo mwanamke, naye ataipunga mbele za Bwana na kuileta madhabahuni.

english: Then the priest is to take a handful of the grain offering as a memorial portion and burn it on the altar; after that he is to have the woman drink the water.
ekegusii: Naende korwa ase okoruegwa okwo aimokie goke, goichire roe, kobe ekeinyorio ng’a okoruegwa okwo nokwa Omonene, na kogosambera ase egesasiimero, na magega y’ayio ae omokungu oria amaache aria anywe.
swahili: Kisha kuhani atachota sadaka ya nafaka mkono uliojaa kama sehemu ya kumbukumbu na kuiteketeza juu ya madhabahu, baada ya hayo, atamtaka huyo mwanamke anywe yale maji.

english: When he has made her drink the water, if she has defiled herself and been unfaithful to her husband, then the water that brings a curse will enter her and cause bitter suffering; her belly will swell, her thigh will shrivel, and she will become accursed among her people.
ekegusii: Onye omokungu oria tabeete omwegenwa ase omosacha oye, korende bwekorire omosaria, amaache aya amaroro akorenta okoragererigwa akore enda yaye ebimbe, naende egombae. Ase enchera eyio omokungu oyio abe ekiorokererio gi’okoragererigwa kegwatorwa ase egati y’ abanto baye.
swahili: Kama amejitia unajisi na kukosa uaminifu kwa mumewe, wakati anapotakiwa anywe maji yale yaletayo laana, yatamwingia na kusababisha maumivu makali; tumbo lake litavimba na paja lake litapooza, naye atakuwa amelaaniwa miongoni mwa watu wake.

english: But if the woman has not defiled herself and is clean, she will be unaffected and able to conceive children.
ekegusii: Onye omokungu oria takorete obotomani korende nigo are omoikeranu, rirorio tagokorerwa bobe, otatiga aibore abana.
swahili: Hata hivyo, ikiwa huyo mwanamke hakujitia unajisi, naye ni safi, atasafishwa hatia na ataweza kuzaa watoto.

english: This is the law of jealousy when a wife goes astray and defiles herself while under her husband’s authority,
ekegusii: “Oko nogochika ase amang’ana ye endamwamu, ekero omokungu atari omwegenwa ase omosacha oye, korende akore obotomani na gwekora omosaria.
swahili: “ ‘Basi, hii ndiyo sheria ya wivu mwanamke anapopotoka na kujitia unajisi akiwa ameolewa na mumewe,

english: You must send away male and female alike; send them outside the camp so they will not defile their camp, where I dwell among them.”
ekegusii: Goika morusie korwa ase ebitwori abasacha na abakungu abwo babeire abatachenegeti babeere isiko, erinde tibaabaisa gokora ebitwori biabo bibe bitachenegeti, agwo ase inche imenyete ase egati y’ abanto bane.”
swahili: Hii itakuwa ni kwa wote, yaani, wanaume na wanawake; watoeni nje ya kambi ili wasije wakanajisi kambi yao, ambamo ninaishi miongoni mwao.”

english: or when a feeling of jealousy comes over a husband and he suspects his wife. He is to have the woman stand before the LORD, and the priest is to apply to her this entire law.
ekegusii: Naboigo ekero omosacha arabe n’Omoika bwe endamwamu na gokagera mok’aye ng’a nomotomani, omosacha oria amorente ase obosio bw’Omonene, na Omokuani akore onsi aya achiikire.
swahili: au hisia za wivu zinapomjia mwanaume kwa sababu ya kumshuku mkewe. Kuhani atamfanya huyo mwanamke kusimama mbele za Bwana na atatumia sheria hii yote kwa huyo mwanamke.

english: The husband will be free from guilt, but the woman shall bear her iniquity.”
ekegusii: Omosacha oria takoba nokomocha, korende onye mok’aye okorire ogosaria okwo, goika aegwe egesusuro.”
swahili: Mume atakuwa hana hatia ya kosa lolote, bali mwanamke atayachukua matokeo ya dhambi yake.’ ”

english: So the Israelites did this, sending such people outside the camp. They did just as the LORD had instructed Moses. Restitution for Trespasses (Luke 19:1–10)
ekegusii: Abaisraeli bagakora buna Omonene atebeetie Musa. Bakarusia korwa ase ebitwori abanto abwo. Okorongeyia Ogokora Okobe
swahili: Waisraeli wakafanya hivyo; wakawatoa nje ya kambi. Wakafanya kama vile Bwana alivyokuwa amemwelekeza Mose. Malipo Kwa Ajili Ya Makosa

english: And the LORD said to Moses,
ekegusii: Naende Omonene agakwana na Musa, akamoteebia,
swahili: Bwana akamwambia Mose,

english: “Tell the Israelites that when a man or woman acts unfaithfully against the LORD by committing any sin against another, that person is guilty
ekegusii: “Teebia Abaisraeli ng’a, ekero omonto omosacha, gose omokungu, arakore ebibe binde bionsi abanto bagokora ase ogotaba abegenwa ase Omonene, na omonto oria oraabe omomochi,
swahili: “Waambie Waisraeli, ‘Wakati mwanaume au mwanamke akimkosea mwenzake kwa njia yoyote, na kwa hivyo akawa si mwaminifu kwa Bwana, mtu huyo ana hatia,

english: and must confess the sin he has committed. He must make full restitution, add a fifth to its value, and give all this to the one he has wronged.
ekegusii: omonto oyio goika aorokie ebibe biria. Boigo airanie ase omonto oria aurete rigori ri’eniibo eyio amourete, naende amente eyemo ya isano ye rigori ri’egento ekio.
swahili: na ni lazima atubu dhambi aliyoifanya. Ni lazima atoe malipo kamili kwa ajili ya kosa lake, aongeze sehemu ya tano juu ya malipo hayo na kutoa yote kwa mtu aliyemkosea.

english: But if the man has no relative to whom restitution can be made for the wrong, the restitution belongs to the LORD and must be given to the priest along with the ram of atonement, by which the atonement is made for him.
ekegusii: Korende onye omonto oria okuure, naende omoamate oye tari okoiranerigwa egento ekio kiairetwe, rirorio kerentwe ase Omonene kebe eki’Omokuani. Amo nayio omonto oyio amente emingichi erakorerwe okobwatanigwa ase are.
swahili: Lakini ikiwa mtu huyo hana jamaa ya karibu ambaye malipo yanaweza kufanywa kwa ajili ya kosa, malipo yatakuwa mali ya Bwana, nayo ni lazima apewe kuhani, pamoja na kondoo dume ambaye anatumika kufanyia upatanisho kwa ajili yake.

english: Every sacred contribution the Israelites bring to the priest shall belong to him.
ekegusii: Kera okoruegwa kw’ebinto ebichenu Abaisraeli baraarente ase Omokuani, ebinto ebio ’nabibe ebiaye.
swahili: Matoleo yote matakatifu ya Waisraeli wanayoleta kwa kuhani yatakuwa yake.

english: On the eighth day he must bring two turtledoves or two young pigeons to the priest at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.
ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatano na gatato, arente amaruma abere, gose amage y’amaruma abere, ase Omokuani agwo ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano.
swahili: Kisha siku ya nane ni lazima alete hua wawili au makinda mawili ya njiwa kwa kuhani katika mlango wa Hema la Kukutania.

english: And the priest is to offer one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering to make atonement for him, because he has sinned by being in the presence of the dead body. On that day he must consecrate his head again.
ekegusii: Omokuani arue riruma erimo ribe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, na erinde eki’ogosambwa ase ogokora okobwatanigwa ase Omwerwa oria, ekiagera okorire ebibe ase ogoika ang’e negetondo. Ase rituko erio erio omonto oria achene omotwe oye,
swahili: Kuhani atatoa mmoja kama sadaka ya dhambi, na mwingine kama sadaka ya kuteketezwa ili kufanya upatanisho kwa ajili yake kwa sababu ametenda dhambi kwa kuwepo mbele ya maiti. Siku iyo hiyo atakiweka wakfu kichwa chake.

english: He must rededicate his time of separation to the LORD and bring a year-old male lamb as a guilt offering. But the preceding days shall not be counted, because his separation was defiled.
ekegusii: na eatanane ase Omonene naende, ase engaki eng’ana buna eria ariete eira koba Omwerwa agwo ritang’ani. Erio arente emanwa emingichi yakoorire omwaka oyomo ebe ekeng’wanso gi’okorongeyia okomocha kwaye ekiagera amatuko aria aye amatang’ani eatananete ase Omonene buna Omwerwa oye takobarwa korende nigo arabe bosa, ekiagera okwerwa kwaye gwakorirwe ogotachenegeti.
swahili: Ni lazima ajitoe kabisa kwa Bwana kwa kipindi cha kujitenga kwake, na ni lazima atoe mwana-kondoo wa mwaka mmoja kama sadaka ya hatia. Siku zilizopita hazitahesabiwa kwa sababu alijitia unajisi katika siku zake za kujitenga.

english: Now this is the law of the Nazirite when his time of separation is complete: He must be brought to the entrance to the Tent of Meeting,
ekegusii: “Oko nakwo ogochika ase Omwerwa: Ekero engaki yaye y’ogweatanana yaerire, arentwe ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangerekano.
swahili: “ ‘Basi hii ndiyo sheria kwa ajili ya Mnadhiri baada ya kipindi chake cha kujitenga kupita. Ataletwa kwenye ingilio la Hema la Kukutania.

english: and he is to present an offering to the LORD of an unblemished year-old male lamb as a burnt offering, an unblemished year-old female lamb as a sin offering, and an unblemished ram as a peace offering—
ekegusii: Ere arue ekeng’wanso kiaye ase Omonene: emanwa emingichi yakoorire omwaka oyomo ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa, na emanwa esigiti yakoorire omwaka oyomo ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, na emingichi eyemo ebe ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe; chionsi chibe chitari na bimocho ase emebere yabo.
swahili: Hapo atatoa sadaka zake kwa Bwana: yaani, mwana-kondoo wa mwaka mmoja asiye na waa kwa ajili ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa, kondoo mke wa mwaka mmoja asiye na waa kwa ajili ya sadaka ya dhambi, kondoo dume asiye na waa kwa ajili ya sadaka ya amani,

english: together with their grain offerings and drink offerings—and a basket of unleavened cakes made from fine flour mixed with oil and unleavened wafers coated with oil.
ekegusii: Boigo arente egetonga kere n’emagaati etabekiri memera, na arue amaandasi aroisirie n’obosie obonuke bwochoganirie n’amaguta, na emagaati emeoo eakire amaguta, amo n’okoruegwa kw’endagera na okw’ebinyugwa gochiikire amo.
swahili: pamoja na sadaka zake za nafaka na za vinywaji, na kikapu cha mikate isiyotiwa chachu, yaani maandazi yaliyotengenezwa kwa unga laini uliochanganywa na mafuta, na mikate myembamba iliyopakwa mafuta.

english: The priest is to present all these before the LORD and make the sin offering and the burnt offering.
ekegusii: “Omokuani arente ebinto ebio ase obosio bw’Omonene na arue ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe na eki’ogosambwa ase engencho y’omonto oria.
swahili: “ ‘Kuhani atavileta vitu hivyo mbele za Bwana na kufanya sadaka ya dhambi na sadaka ya kuteketezwa.

english: He shall also offer the ram as a peace offering to the LORD, along with the basket of unleavened bread. And the priest is to offer the accompanying grain offering and drink offering.
ekegusii: Boigo arue emingichi eria ebe ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe ase Omonene, ayerue amo n’emagaati etabekiri memera ere egetonga ime, na okoruegwa kw’endagera na ogw’ekenyugwa gochiikire amo.
swahili: Ataleta pia kikapu cha mikate isiyotiwa chachu, na atatoa dhabihu kondoo dume kama sadaka ya amani kwa Bwana, pamoja na sadaka yake ya nafaka na sadaka ya kinywaji.

english: Then at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting, the Nazirite is to shave his consecrated head, take the hair, and put it on the fire under the peace offering.
ekegusii: Agwo ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano, Omwerwa oria akigite etukia y’omotwe oye ere ekemanyererio ng’a neatananete ase Omonene. Erio aire etukia yaye, ayerute ase omorero oria ore inse y’ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe.
swahili: “ ‘Kisha kwenye ingilio la Hema la Kukutania, Mnadhiri ni lazima anyoe nywele zake ambazo alikuwa ameziweka wakfu. Atazichukua hizo nywele na kuziweka ndani ya moto ulio chini ya dhabihu ya sadaka ya amani.

english: And the priest is to take the boiled shoulder from the ram, one unleavened cake from the basket, and one unleavened wafer, and put them into the hands of the Nazirite who has just shaved the hair of his consecration.
ekegusii: “Magega, ekero Omwerwa oria akoorire gokigita etukia yaye, Omokuani aimokie rireko ri’emingichi riaiyekirwe, na korwa ase egetonga arusie omogati oyomo otabekiri memera, na omogati oyomo otabekiri memera, ayebeke ase amaboko y’Omwerwa oria.
swahili: “ ‘Baada ya Mnadhiri kunyoa hizo nywele zake za kujitenga kwake, kuhani atampa mikononi mwake bega la kondoo dume lililochemshwa, na pia andazi na mkate mwembamba kutoka kwenye kikapu, vyote vikiwa vimetengenezwa bila kuwekwa chachu.

english: “Speak to the Israelites and tell them that if a man or woman makes a special vow, the vow of a Nazirite, to separate himself to the LORD,
ekegusii: “Bateebie Abaisraeli ng’a ekero omonto, omosacha gose omokungu, akoria eira abe oyo bweatananire ase Omonene abe Omwerwa oye,
swahili: “Sema na Waisraeli na uwaambie: ‘Ikiwa mwanaume au mwanamke anataka kuweka nadhiri maalum, nadhiri ya kutengwa kwa ajili ya Bwana kama Mnadhiri,

english: The priest shall then wave them as a wave offering before the LORD. This is a holy portion for the priest, in addition to the breast of the wave offering and the thigh that was presented. After that, the Nazirite may drink wine.
ekegusii: Omokuani arente ebinto ebio amo ne ritaana na ekenama bi’emingichi, abisungusie bibe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosungusigwa ase Omonene. Ebinto ebio nigo biatananetwe ase Omokuani. Erio nario Omwerwa oria arabe ne ribaga konywa edivai.”
swahili: Kisha kuhani ataviinua mbele za Bwana kama sadaka ya kuinua; ni vitakatifu na ni mali ya kuhani, pamoja na kile kidari kilichoinuliwa na lile paja lililotolewa. Baada ya hayo, Mnadhiri anaweza kunywa divai.

english: This is the law of the Nazirite who vows his offering to the LORD for his separation, in addition to whatever else he can afford; he must fulfill whatever vow he makes, according to the law of his separation.” Aaron’s Blessing
ekegusii: Oko nakwo ogochika ase oyoriete eira ng’a abe Omwerwa Omonene, goika arue ase Omonene aya amorierete eira akorua ore Omwerwa oye, korende onye oriire eira arue goetania, goika ayeikeranie kegima koreng’ana nogochika gw’okwerwa. Ogosesenia Kw’Omonene Kogokwanwa N’abakuani
swahili: “ ‘Hii ndiyo sheria ya Mnadhiri ambaye anaweka nadhiri kwa matoleo yake kwa Bwana kufuatana na kujitenga kwake, zaidi ya chochote kile anachoweza kupata. Ni lazima atimize nadhiri aliyoiweka kufuatana na sheria ya Mnadhiri.’ ” Baraka Ya Kikuhani

english: “Tell Aaron and his sons: This is how you are to bless the Israelites. Say to them:
ekegusii: Moteebie Aroni amo nabamura baye ng’a, ekero barabe bagosesenia Abaisraeli, bakwane amang’ana aya:
swahili: “Mwambie Aroni na wanawe, ‘Hivi ndivyo mtakavyowabariki Waisraeli. Waambieni:

english: ‘May the LORD bless you and keep you;
ekegusii: Omonene abasesenie, abareende;
swahili: “ ‘ “ Bwana akubariki na kukulinda;

english: may the LORD cause His face to shine upon you and be gracious to you;
ekegusii: Omonene abaraberie obosio bwaye, abaabere;
swahili: Bwana akuangazie nuru ya uso wake na kukufadhili;

english: may the LORD lift up His countenance toward you and give you peace.’
ekegusii: Omonene abaonchorere obosio bwaye, abae omorembe.
swahili: Bwana akugeuzie uso wake na kukupa amani.” ’

english: So they shall put My name on the Israelites, and I will bless them.”
ekegusii: “Naboigo bararangerie erieta riane ribe igoro y’Abaisraeli ase okobasesenia, erio inche omonyene nimbasesenie.”
swahili: “Hivyo wataliweka Jina langu juu ya Waisraeli, nami nitawabariki.”

english: he is to abstain from wine and strong drink. He must not drink vinegar made from wine or strong drink, and he must not drink any grape juice or eat fresh grapes or raisins.
ekegusii: goika eatanane korwa ase edivai amo nebinyugwa bigotindia. Tabaisa konywa ebinyugwa binde bionsi bikoroisigwa korwa ase amasabibu, gose taria amasabibu, amabese gose amomo.
swahili: ni lazima ajitenge na mvinyo na kinywaji kingine chochote chenye chachu, na kamwe asinywe siki itokanayo na mvinyo au itokanayo na kinywaji kingine chenye chachu. Kamwe asinywe maji ya zabibu wala kula zabibu mbichi au kavu.

english: All the days of his separation, he is not to eat anything that comes from the grapevine, not even the seeds or skins.
ekegusii: Ase amatuko aye onsi eatananete koba Omwerwa taria gento kende gionsi gekoroisigwa korwa ase emesabibu. Taria nonya ne chimbusururo gose amasabo y’amasabibu.
swahili: Kwa muda wote atakaokuwa Mnadhiri, kamwe hatakula chochote kitokanacho na mzabibu, sio mbegu wala maganda.

english: For the entire period of his vow of separation, no razor shall pass over his head. He must be holy until the time of his separation to the LORD is complete; he must let the hair of his head grow long.
ekegusii: “Tabaisa konacha etukia yaye gose gwekigita goika okoorire amatuko aye onsi ariete eira gweatanana koba Omwerwa Omonene. Ere nabe oyo bweatananire, na atige etukia y’omotwe oye ekiine.
swahili: “ ‘Kwa muda wote wa nadhiri yake ya kujitenga kwa ajili ya Bwana, wembe hautapita kichwani mwake. Ni lazima awe mtakatifu mpaka kipindi cha kujitenga kwake kwa ajili ya Bwana kiishe; ni lazima aache nywele za kichwa chake zirefuke.

english: Throughout the days of his separation to the LORD, he must not go near a dead body.
ekegusii: Tageenda aike ang’e negetondo ase amatuko ayio onsi eatananete koba Omwerwa Omonene.
swahili: Kwa kipindi chochote cha kujitenga kwa ajili ya Bwana hatakaribia maiti.

english: Even if his father or mother or brother or sister should die, he is not to defile himself, because the crown of consecration to his God is upon his head.
ekegusii: Ise nakwa, gose ng’ina, gose momura omwabo, gose omoiseke omwabo, tageenda ang’e negetondo na gwesoyia ase ogotacheneka. Ere nigo abwate ase omotwe oye ekemanyererio ng’a bweatananire koba Omwerwa o Nyasae oye.
swahili: Hata kama baba yake mwenyewe au mama au kaka au dada akifa, hatajinajisi mwenyewe kwa taratibu za ibada kwa ajili yao, kwa sababu ishara ya kujiweka wakfu kwake kwa Mungu ipo katika kichwa chake.

english: Throughout the time of his separation, he is holy to the LORD.
ekegusii: Ere nigo arabe omochenu aase Omonene ase amatuko aye onsi eatananete.
swahili: Kwa kipindi chote cha kujitenga kwake yeye ni wakfu kwa Bwana.

english: If someone suddenly dies in his presence and defiles his consecrated head of hair, he must shave his head on the day of his cleansing—the seventh day.
ekegusii: “Korende omonto karakwe mobosokano ang’e nere, na akore omotwe oye ore nekemanyererio gi’okwerwa kwaye abe otachenegeti, rirorio Omwerwa oyio aganye amatuko atan’abere erio akigite etukia yaye, na abe oyo’chenekire.
swahili: “ ‘Kama mtu yeyote akifa ghafula karibu naye, atakuwa ametiwa unajisi nywele zake alizoziweka wakfu, hivyo ni lazima anyoe nywele zake siku ya utakaso wake, yaani siku ya saba.

english: On the day Moses finished setting up the tabernacle, he anointed and consecrated it and all its furnishings, along with the altar and all its utensils.
ekegusii: Ase rituko riria Musa konya akoorire gotenenia Obomenyo Obochenu naende kaboakire amaguta na kobwatanana amo n’ebinto biaye bionsi, naende gakoorire gwatanana egesasiimero na ebikorero biaye,
swahili: Mose alipomaliza kuisimamisha Maskani, aliitia mafuta na kuiweka wakfu pamoja na samani zake zote. Pia alitia madhabahu mafuta na kuiweka wakfu, pamoja na vyombo vyake vyote.

english: When the altar was anointed, the leaders approached with their offerings for its dedication and presented them before the altar.
ekegusii: Ase rituko riria egesasiimero giatananetwe na goakwa amaguta, abatang’ani bakarenta okoruegwa kwabo bosio bw’egesasiimero.
swahili: Wakati madhabahu yalitiwa mafuta, viongozi walileta sadaka zao kwa ajili ya kule kuwekwa wakfu kwake na kuziweka mbele ya madhabahu.

english: And the LORD said to Moses, “Each day one leader is to present his offering for the dedication of the altar.”
ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa, “Kera rituko omotang’ani oyomo oyomo arue okoruegwa kwaye ase ogwatananwa kw’egesasiimero.”
swahili: Kwa maana Bwana alikuwa amemwambia Mose, “Kila siku kiongozi mmoja ataleta sadaka yake ili kuwekwa wakfu madhabahu.”

english: On the first day Nahshon son of Amminadab from the tribe of Judah drew near with his offering.
ekegusii: Rituko rie ritang’ani Nahasoni, mosinto bw’Aminadabu bw’egesaku kia Yuda, akarenta okoruegwa kwaye.
swahili: Yule ambaye alileta sadaka yake siku ya kwanza alikuwa Nashoni, mwana wa Aminadabu, wa kabila la Yuda.

english: His offering was one silver platter weighing a hundred and thirty shekels, and one silver bowl weighing seventy shekels, both according to the sanctuary shekel and filled with fine flour mixed with oil for a grain offering;
ekegusii: Ere akarua esani eyemo eroisirie korwa ase efeta y’oborito bwe chisekeli rigana erimo na merongo etato, na egetaabo ekemo gi’efeta y’oborito bwe chisekeli emerongo etan’ebere, ase ekerengo gi’esekeli yaare gokorerwa ase Obomenyo Obochenu. Bionsi bibere nigo biaichire n’obosie obonuke bwochoganirie n’amaguta bokaba okoruegwa kw’endagera.
swahili: Sadaka yake ilikuwa sahani moja ya fedha yenye uzito wa shekeli 130, na bakuli moja la fedha la kunyunyizia lenye uzito wa shekeli sabini, vyote kulingana na shekeli ya mahali patakatifu, vikiwa vimejazwa unga laini uliochanganywa na mafuta kama sadaka ya nafaka;

english: one gold dish weighing ten shekels, filled with incense;
ekegusii: Naende akarua egetaabo ekemo gi’etaabu y’oborito bwe chisekeli ikomi, giaichire ubani.
swahili: sinia moja la dhahabu lenye uzito wa shekeli kumi, likiwa limejazwa uvumba;

english: one young bull, one ram, and one male lamb a year old for a burnt offering;
ekegusii: Boigo akarua eeri ensae, emingichi eyemo, na emanwa emingichi eyemo yakoorire omwaka oyomo, chikaba ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa,
swahili: fahali mmoja mchanga, kondoo dume mmoja na mwana-kondoo dume mmoja wa mwaka mmoja, kwa ajili ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa;

english: one male goat for a sin offering;
ekegusii: na egoree eyemo yakoorire omwaka oyomo ekaba ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe.
swahili: mbuzi dume mmoja kwa ajili ya sadaka ya dhambi;

english: and a peace offering of two oxen, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Nahshon son of Amminadab.
ekegusii: Na ase ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe akarua chieri ibere, chimingichi isano, chigoree isano, ne chimanwa chimingichi isano chiakoorire omwaka oyomo. Oko nakwo kwarenge okorua kwa Nahasoni, mosinto bw’Aminadabu.
swahili: maksai wawili, kondoo dume watano, mbuzi dume watano na wana-kondoo dume watano wa mwaka mmoja, ili vitolewe dhabihu kama sadaka ya amani. Hii ndiyo ilikuwa sadaka ya Nashoni mwana wa Aminadabu.

english: On the second day Nethanel son of Zuar, the leader of Issachar, drew near.

swahili: Siku ya pili yake Nethaneli mwana wa Suari, kiongozi wa kabila la Isakari, alileta sadaka yake.

english: And the leaders of Israel, the heads of their families, presented an offering. These men were the tribal leaders who had supervised the registration.

swahili: Ndipo viongozi wa Israeli, wale wakuu wa jamaa waliokuwa viongozi wa kabila wasimamizi wa wale waliohesabiwa, wakatoa sadaka.

english: They brought as their offering before the LORD six covered carts and twelve oxen—an ox from each leader and a cart from every two leaders—and presented them before the tabernacle.
ekegusii: bakarentera Omonene okoruegwa kwabo. Bakarua chigaari isan’emo chitubire, ne chiombe ikomi na ibere, egaari eyemo ase abatang’ani babere na kera eng’ombe eyemo ase omoraai oyomo. Bakarenta ebio agwo bosio bw’Obomenyo Obochenu.
swahili: Walizileta kama matoleo yao mbele za Bwana: magari sita ya kukokotwa yaliyofunikwa, pamoja na maksai kumi na wawili; yaani maksai mmoja kutoka kwa kila kiongozi, na gari moja la kukokotwa kutoka kwa kila viongozi wawili. Haya waliyaleta mbele ya Maskani.

english: On the fourth day Elizur son of Shedeur, the leader of the Reubenites, drew near.
ekegusii: Rituko ria kane Elisuri, mosinto o Sedeuri bw’egesaku kia Rubeni, akarenta okoruegwa kwaye.

english: On the fifth day Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai, the leader of the Simeonites, drew near.

ekegusii: Eri’Omonene agateebia Musa,
swahili: Bwana akamwambia Mose,

english: and a peace offering of two oxen, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai.
ekegusii: Na ase ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe akarua chieri ibere, chimingichi isano, chigoree isano, ne chimanwa chimingichi isano chiakoorire omwaka oyomo. Oko nakwo kwarenge okorua gwa Selumieli, mosinto o Surisadai.

english: “Accept these gifts from them, that they may be used in the work of the Tent of Meeting. And give them to the Levites, to each man according to his service.”
ekegusii: “Ancha oire ebiegwa ebio korwa ase bare, erinde bikorerwe emeremo agwo ase Eema y’Omosangererekano. Obie Abalawi, kera omonto anyore buna emeremo yaye ere.”
swahili: “Vikubali vitu hivi kutoka kwao, ili viweze kutumika katika kazi kwenye Hema la Kukutania. Wapatie Walawi kama kazi ya kila mtu itakavyohitaji.”

english: and a peace offering of two oxen, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Elishama son of Ammihud.

english: On the eighth day Gamaliel son of Pedahzur, the leader of the Manassites, drew near.
ekegusii: Rituko ria gatano na gatato Gamalieli, mosinto o Pedasuri bw’egesaku kia Manase, akarenta okoruegwa kwaye.
swahili: Siku ya nane Gamalieli mwana wa Pedasuri, kiongozi wa watu wa Manase, alileta sadaka yake.

english: and a peace offering of two oxen, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Gamaliel son of Pedahzur.
ekegusii: Na ase ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe akarua chieri, ibere, chimingichi isano, chigoree isano, ne chimanwa chimingichi isano chiakoorire omwaka oyomo. Oko nakwo kwarenge okorua kwa Gamalieli, mosinto o Pedasuri.

english: So Moses took the carts and oxen and gave them to the Levites.
ekegusii: Ase ayio Musa akaira chigaari chiria ne chiombe, erio agachia Abalawi.
swahili: Hivyo Mose akachukua yale magari ya kukokotwa pamoja na maksai, na kuwapa Walawi.

english: On the ninth day Abidan son of Gideoni, the leader of the Benjamites, drew near.
ekegusii: Rituko ria kianda Abidani, mosinto o Gidioni bw’egesaku gia Benjamini, akarenta okoruegwa kwaye.
swahili: Siku ya tisa Abidani mwana wa Gideoni, kiongozi wa watu wa Benyamini, alileta sadaka yake.

english: His offering was one silver platter weighing a hundred and thirty shekels, and one silver bowl weighing seventy shekels, both according to the sanctuary shekel and filled with fine flour mixed with oil for a grain offering;
ekegusii: Nere akarua esani eyemo eroisirie korwa ase efeta y’oborito bwe chisekeli rigana erimo na merongo etato, na egetaabo ekemo gi’efeta y’oborito bwe chisekeli emerongo etan’ebere, ase ekerengo gi’esekeli yare gokorerwa ase Obomenyo Obochenu. Bionsi bibere nigo biaichire n’obosie obonuke bwochoganirie n’amaguta bokaba okoruegwa kw’endagera.
swahili: Sadaka aliyoleta ilikuwa sahani moja ya fedha yenye uzito wa shekeli 130, na bakuli moja la fedha la kunyunyizia lenye uzito wa shekeli sabini, vyote kulingana na shekeli ya mahali patakatifu, vikiwa vimejazwa unga laini uliochanganywa na mafuta kama sadaka ya nafaka;

english: one young bull, one ram, and one male lamb a year old for a burnt offering;
ekegusii: Boigo akarua eeri ensae, emingichi eyemo, na emanwa emengichi eyemo yakoorire omwaka oyomo, chikaba ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa,
swahili: fahali mmoja mchanga, kondoo dume mmoja na mwana-kondoo dume mmoja wa mwaka mmoja, kwa ajili ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa;

english: and a peace offering of two oxen, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Abidan son of Gideoni.
ekegusii: Na ase ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe akarua chieri ibere, chimingichi isano, chigoree isano, ne chimanwa chimingichi isano chiakoorire omwaka oyomo. Oko nakwo kwarenge okorua kw’Abidani, mosinto o Gidioni.
swahili: maksai wawili, kondoo dume watano, mbuzi dume watano na wana-kondoo dume watano wa mwaka mmoja, ili vitolewe dhabihu kama sadaka ya amani. Hii ndiyo ilikuwa sadaka ya Abidani mwana wa Gideoni.

english: On the tenth day Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai, the leader of the Danites, drew near.
ekegusii: Rituko ria ikomi Ahieseri, mosinto bw’Amisadai bw’egesaku gia Dani, akarenta okoruegwa kwaye.
swahili: Siku ya kumi Ahiezeri mwana wa Amishadai, kiongozi wa watu wa Dani, alileta sadaka yake.

english: He gave the Gershonites two carts and four oxen, as their service required,
ekegusii: Akaa Abagerisoni chigaari ibere ne chiombe inye, buna emeremo yabo yarenge.
swahili: Aliwapa Wagershoni magari mawili ya kukokotwa na maksai wanne, kama walivyohitaji kwa kazi yao,

english: and a peace offering of two oxen, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai.
ekegusii: Na ase ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe akarua chieri ibere, chimingichi isano, chigoree isano, ne chimanwa chimingichi isano chiakoorire omwaka oyomo. Oko nakwo kwarenge okorua kw’Ahieseri, mosinto bw’Amisadai.
swahili: maksai wawili, kondoo dume watano, mbuzi dume watano na wana-kondoo dume watano wa mwaka mmoja, ili vitolewe dhabihu kama sadaka ya amani. Hii ndiyo ilikuwa sadaka ya Ahiezeri mwana wa Amishadai.

english: On the eleventh day Pagiel son of Ocran, the leader of the Asherites, drew near.
ekegusii: Rituko ria ikomi na rimo Pagieli, mosinto bw’Okirani bw’egesaku gi’Aseri, akarenta okoruegwa kwaye.
swahili: Siku ya kumi na moja Pagieli mwana wa Okrani, kiongozi wa watu wa Asheri, alileta sadaka yake.

english: and a peace offering of two oxen, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Pagiel son of Ocran.
ekegusii: Na ase ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe akarua chieri ibere, chimingichi isano, chigoree isano, nechimanwa chimingichi isano chiakoorire omwaka oyomo. Oko nakwo kwarenge okorua gwa Pagieli, mosinto bw’Okirani.
swahili: maksai wawili, kondoo dume watano, mbuzi dume watano na wana-kondoo dume watano wa mwaka mmoja, ili vitolewe dhabihu kama sadaka ya amani. Hii ndiyo ilikuwa sadaka ya Pagieli mwana wa Okrani.

english: On the twelfth day Ahira son of Enan, the leader of the Naphtalites, drew near.
ekegusii: Rituko ria ikomi na kabere Ahira, mosinto o Enani bw’egesaku kia Nafutali, akarenta okoruegwa kwaye.
swahili: Siku ya kumi na mbili Ahira mwana wa Enani, kiongozi wa watu wa Naftali, alileta sadaka yake.

english: and he gave the Merarites four carts and eight oxen, as their service required, all under the direction of Ithamar son of Aaron the priest.
ekegusii: Naende akaa Abamerari chigaari inye, ne chiombe isanaisato, buna emeremo yabo yarenge inse y’oboraai bwa Itamari, omomura o Aroni Omokuani.
swahili: na pia aliwapa Wamerari magari manne ya kukokotwa na maksai wanane, kama kazi yao ilivyohitaji. Wote walikuwa chini ya maelekezo ya Ithamari mwana wa kuhani, Aroni.

english: and a peace offering of two oxen, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Ahira son of Enan.
ekegusii: Na ase ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe akarua chieri ibere, chimingichi isano, chigoree isano, ne chimanwa chimingichi isano chiakoorire omwaka oyomo. Oko nakwo kwarenge okorua kw’Ahira, mosinto o Enani.
swahili: maksai wawili, kondoo dume watano, mbuzi dume watano na wana-kondoo dume watano wa mwaka mmoja, ili vitolewe dhabihu kama sadaka ya amani. Hii ndiyo ilikuwa sadaka ya Ahira mwana wa Enani.

english: So these were the offerings from the leaders of Israel for the dedication of the altar when it was anointed: twelve silver platters, twelve silver bowls, and twelve gold dishes.
ekegusii: Omobaro bwonsi bw’ebinto biaruetwe nabatang’ani b’Abaisraeli ase ogwatananwa kw’egesasiimero ase rituko riria kiaagetwe amaguta nigo biabeete iga: Chisani ikomi na ibere chiaroisirie korwa ase chifeta, na ebitaabo ikomi na bibere biaroisirie korwa ase chifeta, na ebitaabo ikomi na bibere biaroisirie korwa ase chitaabu.
swahili: Hizi ndizo zilikuwa sadaka za viongozi wa Israeli madhabahu yalipowekwa wakfu, wakati yalitiwa mafuta: sahani kumi na mbili za fedha, bakuli kumi na mbili za fedha za kunyunyizia, na masinia kumi na mawili ya dhahabu.

english: Each silver platter weighed a hundred and thirty shekels, and each silver bowl seventy shekels. The total weight of the silver articles was two thousand four hundred shekels, according to the sanctuary shekel.
ekegusii: Kera esani y’efeta nigo yarenge n’oborito bwe chisekeli rigana erimo na merongo etato, na kera egetaabo gi’efeta n’oborito bwe chisekeli emerongo etan’ebere. Ase igo oborito bwonsi bw’echifeta chi’ebinto ebio nigo bwarenge chisekeli chilifu ibere, na amagana ane (2,400), koreng’ana nekerengo gi’esekeli yare gokorerwa ase Obomenyo Obochenu.
swahili: Kila sahani ya fedha ilikuwa na uzito wa shekeli 130, na kila bakuli la fedha la kunyunyizia lilikuwa na uzito wa shekeli sabini. Masinia yote kumi na mawili yalikuwa na uzito wa shekeli 2,400 kulingana na shekeli ya mahali patakatifu.

english: The twelve gold dishes filled with incense weighed ten shekels each, according to the sanctuary shekel. The total weight of the gold dishes was a hundred and twenty shekels.
ekegusii: Na ebitaabo biria ikomi na bibere biaroisirie korwa ase chitaabu biichire na ubani, nigo biarenge kera ekemo n’oborito bwe chisekeli ikomi koreng’ana nekerengo gi’esekeli yare gokorerwa ase Obomenyo Obochenu. Oborito bwe chitaabu chi’ebinto ebio bionsi nigo bwarenge chisekeli rigana erimo na merongo ebere.
swahili: Sahani kumi na mbili za dhahabu zilizojazwa uvumba zilikuwa na uzito wa shekeli kumi kila moja, kulingana na shekeli ya mahali patakatifu. Kwa jumla, sahani za dhahabu zilikuwa na uzito wa shekeli 120.

english: All the livestock for the burnt offering totaled twelve bulls, twelve rams, and twelve male lambs a year old—together with their grain offerings—and twelve male goats for the sin offering.
ekegusii: Ching’iti chiaruetwe chikaba ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa nigo chiarenge chieri ikomi na ibere, chimingichi ikomi na ibere, ne chimanwa chimingichi chiakoorire omwaka oyomo ikomi na ibere, amo n’okoruegwa kw’endagera gwachiikire amo, chigoree ikomi na ibere chikaba ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe.
swahili: Jumla ya wanyama waliotolewa kwa ajili ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa walikuwa fahali kumi na wawili wachanga, kondoo dume kumi na wawili na wana-kondoo dume kumi na wawili wa mwaka mmoja, pamoja na sadaka zao za nafaka. Mbuzi waume kumi na wawili walitolewa kwa ajili ya sadaka za dhambi.

english: All the livestock sacrificed for the peace offering totaled twenty-four bulls, sixty rams, sixty male goats, and sixty male lambs a year old. This was the dedication offering for the altar after it was anointed.
ekegusii: Ching’iti chionsi chiaruetwe chikaba ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe nigo chiabeete: Chieri emerongo ebere na inye, chimingichi emerongo etan’omo, chigoree emerongo etan’omo, ne chimanwa chimingichi chiakoorire omwaka oyomo emerongo etan’omo. Ebio nabio ebiegwa biaruetwe ekero egesasiimero giatananetwe na goakwa amaguta.
swahili: Jumla ya wanyama kwa ajili ya dhabihu ya sadaka ya amani walikuwa maksai ishirini na wanne, kondoo dume sitini, mbuzi dume wa mwaka mmoja sitini na wana-kondoo dume wa mwaka mmoja sitini. Hizi ndizo zilikuwa sadaka zilizoletwa kwa ajili ya kuwekwa wakfu kwa madhabahu baada ya kutiwa mafuta.

english: When Moses entered the Tent of Meeting to speak with the LORD, he heard the voice speaking to him from between the two cherubim above the mercy seat on the ark of the Testimony. Thus the LORD spoke to him.
ekegusii: Ekero Musa asoete ase Eema y’Omosangererekano gokwana n’Omonene, akaigwa eriogi rigokwana nere korwa ase Oboikaranso bwa amaabera, obwo bwarenge igoro ase Esanduki yarenge ne chibao chiriikire oborori. Eriogi erio rikarua ase egati y’Abamalaika babere babegete chimbaaba, rigakwana nere.
swahili: Mose alipoingia kwenye Hema la Kukutania kuzungumza na Bwana, alisikia sauti ikisema naye kutoka kati ya wale makerubi wawili waliokuwa juu ya kile kiti cha rehema, juu ya Sanduku la Ushuhuda. Mose akazungumza naye.

english: But he did not give any to the Kohathites, since they were to carry on their shoulders the holy objects for which they were responsible.
ekegusii: Korende Abakohati Musa tabaete gento kende, ekiagera barabwo nigo baetwe emeremo y’okobogoria ebinto ebichenu, na ebio goika bibogorigwe ase amareko.
swahili: Lakini Mose hakuwapa Wakohathi chochote kati ya hivyo, kwa sababu walitakiwa kubeba vitu vitakatifu mabegani mwao, vile walikuwa wanawajibika.

english: You are to present the Levites before the LORD and have the Israelites lay their hands upon them.
ekegusii: Ekero kwarentire Abalawi ase obosio bwane, inche Omonene, Abaisraeli goika babeeke amaboko abo igoro ase emetwe yabo.
swahili: Utawaleta Walawi mbele za Bwana, na Waisraeli wataweka mikono yao juu ya Walawi.

english: Aaron is to present the Levites before the LORD as a wave offering from the sons of Israel, so that they may perform the service of the LORD.
ekegusii: Naende Aroni arente Abalawi ase obosio bwane, babe buna ekeng’wanso ki’ogosungusigwa korwa ase Abaisraeli. Naboigo Abalawi baatananwe, babe ekeegwa ase ogonkorera inche Omonene.
swahili: Aroni atawaweka Walawi mbele za Bwana kama sadaka ya kuinua kutoka kwa Waisraeli, ili kwamba wawe tayari kuifanya kazi ya Bwana.

english: And the Levites are to lay their hands on the heads of the bulls, and offer to the LORD one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering, to make atonement for the Levites.
ekegusii: Magega yaye Abalawi goika babeeke amaboko abo igoro ase emetwe ye chieri chiria, naye orusie eeri eyemo ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, na eyende ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa ase ’nde inche Omonene, na igo okore okobwatanigwa ase Abalawi.
swahili: “Baada ya Walawi kuweka mikono yao juu ya vichwa vya hao mafahali wawili, tumia mmoja kwa ajili ya sadaka ya dhambi kwa Bwana, na mwingine kuwa sadaka ya kuteketezwa, ili kufanya upatanisho kwa ajili ya Walawi.

english: You are to have the Levites stand before Aaron and his sons and then present them before the LORD as a wave offering.
ekegusii: “Obeeke Abalawi babe bagokonya Aroni na abamura baye, obaatanane babe buna ekeng’wanso ki’ogosungusigwa ase ’nde inche Omonene.
swahili: Waambie hao Walawi wasimame mbele ya Aroni na wanawe, kisha wawatoe kama sadaka ya kuinuliwa kwa Bwana.

english: In this way you shall separate the Levites from the rest of the Israelites, and the Levites will belong to Me.
ekegusii: Ase enchera eyio obaatanane Abalawi korwa ase Abaisraeli, barabwo ’mbabe abaane.
swahili: Kwa njia hii utakuwa umewatenga Walawi kutoka kwa Waisraeli wengine, nao Walawi watakuwa wangu.

english: After you have cleansed them and presented them as a wave offering, they may come to serve at the Tent of Meeting.
ekegusii: Ekero kwabachenire na kobaatanana babe buna ekeng’wanso ki’ogosungusigwa, barabwo basoe ase Eema y’Omosangererekano babe bagokora emeremo aroro.
swahili: “Utakapokuwa umekwisha kuwatakasa Walawi na kuwatoa kama sadaka ya kuinuliwa, watakuja kufanya kazi yao katika Hema la Kukutania.

english: For the Levites have been wholly given to Me from among the sons of Israel. I have taken them for Myself in place of all who come first from the womb, the firstborn of all the sons of Israel.
ekegusii: Barabwo baruegwe kegima korwa ase Abaisraeli babe abaane, ekiagera nabachorire ribaga ri’abana abatangi b’Abaisraeli.
swahili: Wao ndio Waisraeli ambao watatolewa kabisa kwangu. Nimewatwaa kama mali yangu mwenyewe badala ya mzaliwa wa kwanza, mzaliwa wa kwanza wa kiume kutoka kwa kila mwanamke wa Kiisraeli.

english: For every firstborn male in Israel is Mine, both man and beast. I set them apart for Myself on the day I struck down all the firstborn in the land of Egypt.
ekegusii: Abana abatangi bonsi b’Abaisraeli n’abaane, ne ching’iti chintangi boigo. Rituko riria naitete abana abatangi bonsi amo ne ching’iti chintangi ase ense ya Misiri, nigo neatananerete abana abatangi b’Abaisraeli amo ne ching’iti chintangi.
swahili: Kila mzaliwa wa kwanza wa kiume katika Israeli, awe wa mwanadamu au mnyama, ni wangu. Wakati nilipowaua wazaliwa wote wa kwanza huko Misri, niliwatenga kwa ajili yangu mwenyewe.

english: But I have taken the Levites in place of all the firstborn among the sons of Israel.
ekegusii: Na bono nachorire Abalawi babe abaane ribaga ri’abana abatangi bonsi b’Abaisraeli.
swahili: Nami nimewatwaa Walawi badala ya wazaliwa wote wa kwanza wa kiume katika Israeli.

english: And I have given the Levites as a gift to Aaron and his sons from among the Israelites, to perform the service for the Israelites at the Tent of Meeting and to make atonement on their behalf, so that no plague will come against the Israelites when they approach the sanctuary.”
ekegusii: Narure Abalawi babe ekeegwa ase Aroni na abamura baye korwa ase Abaisraeli, erinde bakore emeremo ase engencho y’Abaisraeli, agwo ase Eema y’Omosangererekano. Boigo bakore okobwatanigwa ase bare, erinde nintange amaakwa tabanyora ekero bagoika ang’e n’Aase Aachenu.”
swahili: Kati ya Waisraeli wote, nimempa Aroni na wanawe Walawi kama zawadi ili wafanye kazi katika Hema la Kukutania kwa niaba ya Waisraeli, na kufanya upatanisho kwa ajili yao ili pasiwepo na pigo lolote litakalowapata Waisraeli wakati watakapokaribia mahali patakatifu.”

english: “Speak to Aaron and tell him: ‘When you set up the seven lamps, they are to light the area in front of the lampstand.’”
ekegusii: “Teebia Aroni ng’a, ekero arabeeke chitaaya isano na ibere ase ekebekerero gie chitaaya, achibeeke erinde chimoreke gochia bosio.”
swahili: “Sema na Aroni umwambie, ‘Wakati utakapoziweka zile taa saba, zinatakiwa kuangaza eneo lililo mbele ya kinara cha taa.’ ”

english: So Moses, Aaron, and the whole congregation of Israel did with the Levites everything that the LORD had commanded Moses they should do.
ekegusii: Naboigo Musa, na Aroni, amo n’omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli bakaba bagokorera Abalawi. Abaisraeli bakabakorera kera ring’ana Omonene konya achiikire Musa baabakorere.
swahili: Mose, Aroni na jumuiya yote ya Waisraeli wakawafanyia Walawi kama Bwana alivyomwamuru Mose.

english: The Levites purified themselves and washed their clothes, and Aaron presented them as a wave offering before the LORD. Aaron also made atonement for them to cleanse them.
ekegusii: Abalawi bagechena korwa ase ebibe na bagasibia chianga chiabo, na Aroni akabaatanana bakaba buna ekeng’wanso ki’ogosungusigwa ase obosio bw’Omonene, naende agakora okobwatanigwa ase bare, na kobachena.
swahili: Walawi wakajitakasa wenyewe na wakafua nguo zao. Kisha Aroni akawasogeza mbele za Bwana kuwa sadaka ya kuinuliwa, na kufanya upatanisho kwa ajili yao ili kuwatakasa.

english: After that, the Levites came to perform their service at the Tent of Meeting in the presence of Aaron and his sons. Thus they did with the Levites just as the LORD had commanded Moses. Retirement for Levites
ekegusii: Magega yayio Abalawi bakageenda ase obokoreri bwabo ime ase Eema y’Omosangererekano inse y’oborendi bwa Aroni na abamura baye. Bun’Omonene konya achiikire Musa igoro y’Abalawi nabo Abaisraeli baabakorerete.
swahili: Baada ya hayo, Walawi walikuja kufanya kazi yao katika Hema la Kukutania chini ya usimamizi wa Aroni na wanawe. Waliwafanyia Walawi kama vile Bwana alivyomwamuru Mose.

english: And the LORD said to Moses,
ekegusii: Omonene agakwana naende na Musa, akamoteebia,
swahili: Bwana akamwambia Mose,

english: “This applies to the Levites: Men twenty-five years of age or older shall enter to perform the service in the work at the Tent of Meeting.
ekegusii: “Eye nero emeremo y’Abalawi: Abwo bakoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na etano, na goetania, nigo barabe bagokora emeremo ase Eema y’Omosangererekano.
swahili: “Hili linawahusu Walawi: Wanaume wenye umri wa miaka ishirini na mitano au zaidi watakuja kushiriki katika kazi kwenye Hema la Kukutania,

english: But at the age of fifty, they must retire from performing the work and no longer serve.
ekegusii: Ekero bakoorire emiaka emerongo etano batige batimoke korwa ase emeremo eria.
swahili: lakini watakapofika umri wa miaka hamsini, ni lazima waache kazi zao za kawaida wala wasiendelee.

english: After that, they may assist their brothers in fulfilling their duties at the Tent of Meeting, but they themselves are not to do the work. This is how you are to assign responsibilities to the Levites.”
ekegusii: Barabwo ’mbabe ne ribaga ri’ogokonya baria bamwabo bare abakoreri ase Eema y’Omosangererekano, korende tibaabaisa gokora emeremo eyio abanyene. Naboigo oraroberie Abalawi ase emeremo yabo.”
swahili: Wanaweza kuwasaidia ndugu zao kufanya wajibu wao katika Hema la Kukutania, lakini wao wenyewe kamwe hawatafanya hiyo kazi. Basi, hivi ndivyo utakavyogawa wajibu kwa Walawi.”

english: And Aaron did so; he set up the lamps facing toward the front of the lampstand, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
ekegusii: Aroni agakora bo, akabeeka ekebekerero gi’echitaaya echio, erinde chimoreke gochia bosio bw’ekebeekerero ekio, buna Omonene achiigete Musa.
swahili: Aroni akafanya hivyo; akaziweka zile taa ili zielekee mbele kwenye kinara cha taa, kama vile Bwana alivyomwamuru Mose.

english: This is how the lampstand was constructed: it was made of hammered gold from its base to its blossoms, fashioned according to the pattern the LORD had shown Moses. Cleansing the Levites
ekegusii: Ekebekerero gie chitaaya na enterekerero yaye, amo n’emegwekano yaye y’ebisicha nigo biaroisirie korwa ase chitaabu chiturire. Nabo Musa aroisetie ekebeekerero ekio buna Omonene konya amochiikire. Abalawi Bagwatananwa Na Gochenwa
swahili: Hivi ndivyo kinara cha taa kilivyotengenezwa: Kilitengenezwa kwa dhahabu iliyofuliwa, kuanzia kwenye kitako chake hadi kwenye maua yake. Kinara cha taa kilitengenezwa sawasawa kabisa na kielelezo ambacho Bwana alikuwa amemwonyesha Mose. Kutengwa Kwa Walawi Kwa Ajili Ya Bwana

english: Again the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa,
swahili: Bwana akamwambia Mose:

english: “Take the Levites from among the Israelites and make them ceremonially clean.
ekegusii: “Atanana Abalawi korwa ase Abaisraeli na obachene.
swahili: “Watwae Walawi kutoka miongoni mwa Waisraeli wengine na uwatakase kwa kawaida ya ibada.

english: This is what you must do to cleanse them: Sprinkle them with the water of purification. Have them shave their whole bodies and wash their clothes, and so purify themselves.
ekegusii: Ekero okobachena nigo orakore iga: Onyororokie amaache y’ogwesibia igoro yabo, na barabwo bakigite emebere yabo yonsi na basibie chianga chiabo. Erio babe bachenekire.
swahili: Ili kuwatakasa fanya hivi: Nyunyizia maji ya utakaso juu yao; kisha uwaambie wanyoe nywele kwenye mwili mzima, wafue nguo zao na hivyo wajitakase wenyewe.

english: Then have them take a young bull with its grain offering of fine flour mixed with oil, and you are to take a second young bull for a sin offering.
ekegusii: Naende barente eeri ensae amo n’okoruegwa kw’endagera kw’obosie obonuke bwochoganirie n’amaguta. Naye oire eeri ende ensae ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe.
swahili: Waambie wamchukue fahali mchanga pamoja na sadaka yake ya nafaka ya unga laini uliochanganywa na mafuta; kisha utamchukua fahali mchanga wa pili kwa ajili ya sadaka ya dhambi.

english: Bring the Levites before the Tent of Meeting and assemble the whole congregation of Israel.
ekegusii: Osangererie omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli na orente Abalawi agwo bosio bw’Eema y’Omosangererekano.
swahili: Walete Walawi mbele ya Hema la Kukutania na ukusanye jumuiya yote ya Waisraeli.

english: In the first month of the second year after Israel had come out of the land of Egypt, the LORD spoke to Moses in the Wilderness of Sinai:
ekegusii: Ase omotienyi bw’eritang’ani, bw’omwaka o kabere, ekero Abaisraeli baruure ense ya Misiri, Omonene agakwana na Musa agwo ase erooro ya Sinai, akamoteebia,
swahili: Bwana akasema na Mose katika Jangwa la Sinai katika mwezi wa kwanza wa mwaka wa pili baada ya Waisraeli kutoka Misri. Akasema,

english: “Tell the Israelites: ‘When any one of you or your descendants is unclean because of a dead body, or is away on a journey, he may still observe the Passover to the LORD.
ekegusii: “Kwana n’Abaisraeli obateebie: Onye omonto onde oino, gose oyo bw’ororeria rwaino, obeire oyotachenegeti ase ogokuna egetondo, gose nigo are aare ase orogeendo, na onye origetie korenda rituko ri’Epasaka y’Omonene,
swahili: “Waambie Waisraeli: ‘Wakati mmoja wenu au wazao wenu wanapokuwa najisi kwa sababu ya maiti au wakiwa safarini, hata hivyo wanaweza kuadhimisha Pasaka ya Bwana.

english: Such people are to observe it at twilight on the fourteenth day of the second month. They are to eat the lamb, together with unleavened bread and bitter herbs;
ekegusii: nigo ararirende ase rituko ria ikomi na kane, chinsa chia mogoroba ase omotienyi o kabere. Narie emanwa y’eng’ondi y’Epasaka amo n’emagaati etabekiri ememera, ne chinyeni chindoro.
swahili: Wataiadhimisha wakati wa kuzama jua siku ya kumi na nne ya mwezi wa pili. Watamla mwana-kondoo, pamoja na mkate usiotiwa chachu, na mboga chungu.

english: they may not leave any of it until morning or break any of its bones. They must observe the Passover according to all its statutes.
ekegusii: Tabaisa gotigaria nonya n’ensinini ye chinyama echio goika rituko ria kabere, gose tabuna riuga nonya nerimo ri’emanwa eria. Narende rituko riria rinene ri’Epasaka koreng’ana nemeroberio eria yachiigetwe.
swahili: Wasibakize chochote hadi asubuhi wala wasivunje mifupa ya mwana-kondoo. Wakati wanapoadhimisha Pasaka, hawana budi kufuata masharti yote.

english: But if a man who is ceremonially clean and is not on a journey still fails to observe the Passover, he must be cut off from his people, because he did not present the LORD’s offering at its appointed time. That man will bear the consequences of his sin.
ekegusii: Korende omonto ochenegete gose otakari aare ase orogeendo, oretange tarenda rituko ri’Epasaka, omonto oyio naatananwe korwa ase abanto baye, ekiagera ere tarenteti okoruegwa kwaye ase Omonene ase engaki eria echiikire. Okomocha kw’ebibe kw’omonto oria ’nkobe igoro yaye.
swahili: Lakini kama mtu ni safi kwa taratibu za kiibada naye hayuko safarini, asipoadhimisha Pasaka, mtu huyo hana budi kukatiliwa mbali na watu wake kwa sababu hakutoa sadaka ya Bwana kwa wakati ulioamriwa. Mtu huyo atawajibika kubeba matokeo ya dhambi yake.

english: If a foreigner dwelling among you wants to observe the Passover to the LORD, he is to do so according to the Passover statute and its ordinances. You are to apply the same statute to both the foreigner and the native of the land.’” The Cloud above the Tabernacle (Exodus 40:34–38)
ekegusii: “Onye omomenyi omenyete ase egati yaino bwanchete koria Epasaka y’Omonene nigo arakore koreng’ana nemeroberio eria yachiigetwe. Mobe nogochika okomo ase omomenyi na ase omobiare.” Riire Igoro y’Obomenyo Obochenu (Okong’ 40:34-38)
swahili: “ ‘Mgeni anayeishi miongoni mwenu ambaye anataka kuadhimisha Pasaka ya Bwana, lazima afanye hivyo kwa kufuata desturi na masharti. Lazima masharti yawe sawasawa kwa mgeni na mzawa.’ ” Wingu La Moto Juu Ya Maskani (Kutoka 40:34-38)

english: On the day that the tabernacle, the Tent of the Testimony, was set up, the cloud covered it and appeared like fire above the tabernacle from evening until morning.
ekegusii: Ase rituko erio Obomenyo boria Obochenu bwatenenetigwe, riire rigatuba Obomenyo obwo, engencho yaye Eema y’Oborori. Na korwa mogoroba goika mambia riire riria rikarorekana rire buna omorero.
swahili: Katika siku hiyo ambayo Maskani, Hema la Ushuhuda, iliposimamishwa, wingu liliifunika. Kuanzia jioni mpaka asubuhi wingu lililokuwa juu ya Maskani lilionekana kama moto.

english: It remained that way continually; the cloud would cover the tabernacle by day, and at night it would appear like fire.
ekegusii: Naboigo riire riagendererete botambe gotuba Obomenyo boria Obochenu; ase obotuko rirorekana rire buna omorero.
swahili: Hivyo ndivyo lilivyoendelea kuwa; wingu liliifunika wakati wa mchana, na usiku lilionekana kama moto.

english: Whenever the cloud was lifted from above the Tent, the Israelites would set out, and wherever the cloud settled, there the Israelites would camp.
ekegusii: Ekero kende gionsi riire riria riarenge koimokerera igoro korwa ase Eema eria, erio Abaisraeli nigo barenge komanora, bachaaka orogeendo rwabo. Na aase riire riria riarenge gotenena, aroro agwo nao Abaisraeli barenge gotoora.
