swahili: Wakati wowote wingu lilipoinuka kutoka juu ya Hema, nao Waisraeli waliondoka; mahali popote wingu liliposimama, Waisraeli walipiga kambi.

english: At the LORD’s command the Israelites set out, and at the LORD’s command they camped. As long as the cloud remained over the tabernacle, they remained encamped.
ekegusii: Ase ogochika kw’Omonene nigo baare gochaaka orogeendo, na ase ogochika kwaye nigo baare gotoora. Engaki yonsi riire riria riagendererete kobeera igoro ase Obomenyo boria, abanto nigo baare kogenderera kobeera ase egetwori.
swahili: Kwa amri ya Bwana Waisraeli waliondoka, na kwa amri yake walipiga kambi. Kwa muda wote wingu liliposimama juu ya Maskani, Waisraeli walibaki wamepiga kambi.

english: Even when the cloud lingered over the tabernacle for many days, the Israelites kept the LORD’s charge and did not set out.
ekegusii: Onye riire riria riarenge kobeera igoro ase Obomenyo boria amatuko amaange, Abaisraeli nigo baigwerete Omonene, na barabwo tibarenge komanora kogeenda.
swahili: Wakati wingu lilipobaki juu ya Maskani kwa muda mrefu, Waisraeli walitii amri ya Bwana nao hawakuondoka.

english: “The Israelites are to observe the Passover at its appointed time.
ekegusii: “Abaisraeli goika barende rituko ri’Epasaka ase engaki echiikire.
swahili: “Waamuru Waisraeli waadhimishe Pasaka katika wakati ulioamriwa.

english: Sometimes the cloud remained over the tabernacle for only a few days, and they would camp at the LORD’s command and set out at the LORD’s command.
ekegusii: Ase chingaki chinde riire riria nigo riarenge kobeera igoro ase Obomenyo boria amatuko amake oka. Bun’Omonene achiigete, abanto nigo baare kobeera ase egetwori, naende ekero Omonene arenge kobachiika, bachaaka kogeenda ase orogeendo rwabo.
swahili: Wakati mwingine wingu lilikuwa juu ya Maskani kwa siku chache tu; kwa amri ya Bwana wangelipiga kambi na kisha kwa amri yake wangeliondoka.

english: Sometimes the cloud remained only from evening until morning, and when it lifted in the morning, they would set out. Whether it was by day or by night, when the cloud was taken up, they would set out.
ekegusii: Chingaki chinde riire riria nigo riarenge kobeera igoro ase Obomenyo boria korwa mogoroba goika mambia rioka. Ekero kende gionsi riire riarenge koimokerera igoro, abanto nigo barenge gochaaka orogeendo rwabo. Onye riarenge kobeera agwo omobaso na obotuko goika ekero riarenge koimokerera igoro naende, abanto nigo barenge gochaaka orogeendo ekero ekio.
swahili: Wakati mwingine wingu lilikuwepo kuanzia jioni mpaka asubuhi tu, na lilipoinuka asubuhi, nao waliondoka. Ikiwa ni mchana au usiku, wakati wowote wingu lilipoinuka, waliondoka.

english: Whether the cloud lingered for two days, a month, or longer, the Israelites camped and did not set out as long as the cloud remained over the tabernacle; but when it was lifted, they would set out.
ekegusii: Onye riire riarenge kobeera igoro ase Obomenyo boria amatuko abere, gose omotienyi oyomo, gose engaki entambe, Abaisraeli nigo barenge kobeera ase egetwori, tibarenge komanora kogeenda, korende ekero riire riaimokereire igoro, barabwo nigo barenge gochaaka orogeendo.
swahili: Ikiwa wingu lilikaa juu ya Maskani kwa siku mbili au mwezi au mwaka, Waisraeli wangebaki wamepiga kambi na hawakuondoka; lakini lilipoinuka, wangeondoka.

english: They camped at the LORD’s command, and they set out at the LORD’s command; they carried out the LORD’s charge according to His command through Moses.
ekegusii: Bun’Omonene arenge gochiika nigo barenge gotoora, batiga orogeendo, gose baimoka bachaaka orogeendo. Bakaba bakoigwera Omonene buna achiigete goetera ase Musa.
swahili: Kwa amri ya Bwana walipiga kambi, na kwa amri ya Bwana waliondoka. Walitii amri ya Bwana, kufuatana na agizo lake kupitia Mose.

english: You are to observe it at the appointed time, at twilight on the fourteenth day of this month, in accordance with its statutes and ordinances.”
ekegusii: Ase rituko ria ikomi na kane ri’omotienyi oyo, chinsa chia mogoroba, ’namorende rituko erio ase engaki echiikire koreng’ana n’emeroberio eria yachigetwe.”
swahili: Adhimisheni wakati ulioamriwa, yaani wakati wa kuzama jua siku ya kumi na nne ya mwezi huu, kufuatana na desturi zake zote na masharti yake.”

english: So Moses told the Israelites to observe the Passover,
ekegusii: Ase igo Musa agateebia Abaisraeli ng’a barende rituko rinene ri’Epasaka.
swahili: Hivyo Mose akawaambia Waisraeli waiadhimishe Pasaka,

english: and they did so in the Wilderness of Sinai, at twilight on the fourteenth day of the first month. The Israelites did everything just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
ekegusii: Na abanto bagakora bo, bakarenda rituko riria rinene ri’Epasaka agwo ase erooro ya Sinai, ase rituko ria ikomi na kane riomotienyi bw’eritang’ani, chinsa chia mogoroba. Abaisraeli bagakora amang’ana onsi buna Omonene achiigete Musa.
swahili: nao wakafanya hivyo kwenye Jangwa la Sinai wakati wa kuzama jua siku ya kumi na nne ya mwezi wa kwanza. Waisraeli wakafanya kila kitu kama vile Bwana alivyomwamuru Mose.

english: But there were some men who were unclean due to a dead body, so they could not observe the Passover on that day. And they came before Moses and Aaron that same day
ekegusii: Korende ’mbarengeo abanto gete konya besoyirie ase ogotacheneka ase ogokuna egetondo. Barabwo tibanyarete korenda rituko ri’Epasaka ase rituko riria. Ase ayio bakageenda ase Musa na Aroni ase rituko riria,
swahili: Lakini baadhi yao hawakuweza kuadhimisha Pasaka siku ile kwa sababu walikuwa najisi kwa taratibu za kiibada kwa ajili ya kugusa maiti. Kwa hiyo wakamwendea Mose na Aroni siku ile ile,

english: and said to Moses, “We are unclean because of a dead body, but why should we be excluded from presenting the LORD’s offering with the other Israelites at the appointed time?”
ekegusii: bakabateebia, “Intwe nigo twabeire abatachenegeti ase ogokuna egetondo. Inee! Ninki kiagera twatangirwe titorua okoruegwa ase Omonene ase engaki Abaisraeli bachiikire komoruera okoruegwa kwabo?”
swahili: wakamwambia Mose, “Tumekuwa najisi kwa sababu tumegusa maiti, lakini kwa nini tuzuiliwe kumtolea Bwana sadaka yake pamoja na Waisraeli wengine katika wakati ulioamriwa?”

english: “Wait here until I find out what the LORD commands concerning you,” Moses replied.
ekegusii: Musa akabateebia, “Ganya, inyigwe ay’Omonene arachiike igoro yaino.”
swahili: Mose akawajibu, “Ngojeni mpaka nitafute kile Bwana anachoagiza kuwahusu ninyi.”

english: Then the LORD said to Moses,
ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Musa,
swahili: Ndipo Bwana akamwambia Mose,

english: This is the vision of Obadiah: This is what the Lord GOD says about Edom— We have heard a message from the LORD; an envoy has been sent among the nations to say, “Rise up, and let us go to battle against her!”—
ekegusii: Oko nokorora kw’Obadia. Aya naro Omonene agoteeba igoro y’egesaku kia Edomu. Omonene nae Abaedomu egesusuro ee, twaigure amang’ana korwa ase Omonene, na omotomwa otomirwe gochia ase abanto b’ebisaku, ogoteeba: “Imoka, togende korwania Abaedomu esegi!”
swahili: Maono ya Obadia. Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana Mwenyezi kuhusu Edomu: Tumesikia ujumbe kutoka kwa Bwana: Mjumbe alitumwa kwa mataifa kusema, “Inukeni, twendeni tukapigane vita dhidi yake.”

english: Because of the violence against your brother Jacob, you will be covered with shame and cut off forever.
ekegusii: Ekiagera mwaureretie na goita abanto bamino b’ororeria rwa Yakobo, namosookigwe na gosirigwa goika kare na kare.
swahili: Kwa sababu ya jeuri uliyofanya dhidi ya ndugu yako Yakobo, aibu itakufunika; utaangamizwa milele.

english: On the day you stood aloof while strangers carried off his wealth and foreigners entered his gate and cast lots for Jerusalem, you were just like one of them.
ekegusii: Inwe nigo mwatenenete ensemo ase rituko riria, ekero abanto b’ense engeni bairete chinibo chiabo, bagasoa ebiita bia Yerusalemu, bakayoakera obomera. Naboigo nainwe mwarenge buna barabwo.
swahili: Siku ile ulisimama mbali ukiangalia wakati wageni walipojichukulia utajiri wake na watu wa nchi nyingine walipoingia malango yake wakipiga kura kwa ajili ya Yerusalemu, ulikuwa kama mmoja wao.

english: But you should not gloat in that day, your brother’s day of misfortune, nor rejoice over the people of Judah in the day of their destruction, nor boast proudly in the day of their distress.
ekegusii: Anga timware kogoka ase rituko riria amabe acherete abanto bamino. Gose timware gochenga ase rituko ri’ogosirigwa kw’Abayuda, gose timware gokwana noboenenu ase rituko ri’emechando yabo.
swahili: Usingemdharau ndugu yako katika siku ya msiba wake, wala kufurahia juu ya watu wa Yuda katika siku ya maangamizi yao, wala kujigamba sana katika siku ya taabu yao.

english: You should not enter the gate of My people in the day of their disaster, nor gloat over their affliction in the day of their disaster, nor loot their wealth in the day of their disaster.
ekegusii: Inwe anga timwasoete ase egeita ki’abaanto baane ase rituko ri’amaakwa abo; gose anga timwagokerete emechando yabo ase rituko ri’amaakwa abo, gose anga timwaramborete amaboko aino koira chinibo chiabo ase rituko ri’amaakwa abo.
swahili: Usingeingia katika malango ya watu wangu katika siku ya maafa yao, wala kuwadharau katika janga lao katika siku ya maafa yao, wala kunyangʼanya mali zao katika siku ya maafa yao.

english: Nor should you stand at the crossroads to cut off their fugitives, nor deliver up their survivors in the day of their distress. The Deliverance of Israel
ekegusii: Inwe anga timwatenenete ase amatabekania e chinchera goita abanto ba Edomu kobagotama, gose anga timwabegete abatooregete babo bache gosirigwa ase rituko riria ri’emechando yabo. Nyasae nanachere abanto b’ebisaku ekiina
swahili: Usingengoja kwenye njia panda na kuwaua wakimbizi wao, wala kuwatoa watu wake waliosalia katika siku ya shida yao.

english: For the Day of the LORD is near for all the nations. As you have done, it will be done to you; your recompense will return upon your own head.
ekegusii: Rituko ri’Omonene ng’ang’e rire gochera abanto b’ebisaku bionsi. Buna mwabeire mogokora, naboigo nainwe morakorerwe. Ogokora kwaino nkobairanere inwe abanyene.
swahili: “Siku ya Bwana iko karibu kwa mataifa yote. Kama ulivyofanya, nawe utafanyiwa vivyo hivyo, matendo yako yatakurudia juu ya kichwa chako.

english: For as you drank on My holy mountain, so all the nations will drink continually. They will drink and gulp it down; they will be as if they had never existed.
ekegusii: Buna babeire bakonywera egekombe ki’endamwamu yane igoro ase egetunwa kiane egechenu, naboigo nabaanto b’ebisaku bionsi baragenderere konywa botambe, ee, mbanywe bakoore pi basire kegima. Obobui bw’Abaisraeli
swahili: Kama vile ulivyokunywa juu ya mlima wangu mtakatifu, vivyo hivyo mataifa yote watakunywa mfululizo, watakunywa na kunywa, nao watatoweka kana kwamba hawajawahi kuwepo.

english: But on Mount Zion there will be deliverance, and it will be holy, and the house of Jacob will reclaim their possession.
ekegusii: “Korende ase egetunwa gia Sayoni mbabe aroro abaratooreke na aase agwo nabe aachenu. Abanto b’enyomba ya Yakobo nabairanerigwe ense yabo.
swahili: Lakini katika Mlima Sayuni kutakuwepo na wale watakaookoka; nao utakuwa mtakatifu, nayo nyumba ya Yakobo itamiliki urithi wake.

english: Then the house of Jacob will be a blazing fire, and the house of Joseph a burning flame; but the house of Esau will be stubble— Jacob will set it ablaze and consume it. Therefore no survivor will remain from the house of Esau.” For the LORD has spoken.
ekegusii: Abanto b’enyomba ya Yakobo mbabe omorero, na ab’enyomba ya Yusufu mbabe buna ekebemberi ki’omorero, mbasirie ab’enyomba ya Esau buna omorero ogosamba amasakwe amomo. Nonya n’oyomo obo tagotoreeka. Ninche Omonene nakwanire ayio.
swahili: Nyumba ya Yakobo itakuwa moto, na nyumba ya Yosefu itakuwa mwali wa moto; nayo nyumba ya Esau itakuwa bua kavu, nao wataiwasha moto na kuiteketeza. Hakutakuwa na watakaosalimika kutoka nyumba ya Esau.” Bwana amesema.

english: Those from the Negev will possess the mountains of Esau; those from the foothills will possess the land of the Philistines. They will occupy the fields of Ephraim and Samaria, and Benjamin will possess Gilead.
ekegusii: Abanto b’ense ya Negebu mbaire Egetunwa gia Esau, na ab’ense omweya mbaire ense y’Abafilisti. Abaisraeli mbaire ense y’Abaefraimu na ey’Abasamaria chibe echiabo; na abanto ba Benjamini mbaire Gileadi ebe eyabo.
swahili: Watu kutoka nchi ya Negebu wataikalia milima ya Esau, na watu kutoka miteremko ya vilima watamiliki nchi ya Wafilisti. Watayakalia mashamba ya Efraimu na Samaria, naye Benyamini atamiliki Gileadi.

english: “Behold, I will make you small among the nations; you will be deeply despised.
ekegusii: Omonene Nyasae nigo agoteebia egesaku kia Edomu “Rora, ningokore obe omoke ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku, obe kogochaywa mono na bonsi.
swahili: “Angalieni, nitawafanya wadogo miongoni mwa mataifa, mtadharauliwa kabisa.

english: And the exiles of this host of the Israelites will possess the land of the Canaanites as far as Zarephath; and the exiles from Jerusalem who are in Sepharad will possess the cities of the Negev.
ekegusii: Abarwani esegi b’Abaisraeli abwo bairetwe ase obosomba mbairane bamenye ase ense babue omochie o Foiniki goika Sarefata. Abanto ba Yerusalemu bairetwe ase obosomba, abwo bamenyete Sefaradi, mbaire emechie ya sugusu ya Yuda ebe eyabo.
swahili: Kundi la Waisraeli walioko uhamishoni Kanaani watarudi na kumiliki nchi mpaka Sarepta. Walioko uhamishoni Sefaradi kutoka Yerusalemu watamiliki miji ya Negebu.

english: The deliverers will ascend Mount Zion to rule over the mountains of Esau. And the kingdom will belong to the LORD.
ekegusii: Erio abatooria mbariine ase Egetunwa gia Sayoni, bagambere Egetunwa gia Esau. Omonene omonyene nere orabe omorwoti.”
swahili: Waokoaji watakwea juu ya Mlima Sayuni kutawala milima ya Esau. Nao ufalme utakuwa wa Bwana.

english: The pride of your heart has deceived you, O dwellers in the clefts of the rocks whose habitation is the heights, who say in your heart, ‘Who can bring me down to the ground?’
ekegusii: Oboenenu bw’enkoro yao bwakong’ainire, aye omenyete ime y’emienya y’ebitare; agwo ase omenyete aimokererete igoro. Nigo ogokwana ase enkoro yao ime, gweteeba: Ning’o orang’iyerie gochia inse?”
swahili: Kiburi cha moyo wako kimekudanganya, wewe unayeishi katika majabali ya miamba na kufanya makao yako juu, wewe unayejiambia mwenyewe, ‘Ni nani awezaye kunishusha chini?’

english: Though you soar like the eagle and make your nest among the stars, even from there I will bring you down,” declares the LORD.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: Noisa koagacha egeswa kiao aaria igoro buna ekeongo, ee, nokebeke ase egati‐gati ye ching’enang’eni, inche ninkoiyerie korwa aroro.
swahili: Ingawa unapaa juu kama tai na kufanya kiota chako kati ya nyota, nitakushusha chini kutoka huko,” asema Bwana.

english: “If thieves came to you, if robbers by night— oh, how you will be ruined— would they not steal only what they wanted? If grape gatherers came to you, would they not leave some gleanings?
ekegusii: “Abaibi gose abasakori baise kogochera botuko, aye nosirigwe kegima. Ekeene, nigo baraibe binde bionsi baganetie. Inee! Abasangereria b’amasabibu baare kogochera, tibarenge kogotigera nonya naria agotigara? Korende asore aye ababisa bao bagosiririe kegima.
swahili: “Ikiwa wevi wangekuja kwako, ikiwa wanyangʼanyi wangekujia usiku: Lo! Tazama ni maafa kiasi gani yangekuwa yanakungojea: je, si wangeiba tu kiasi ambacho wangehitaji? Kama wachuma zabibu wangekuja kwako, je, wasingebakiza zabibu chache?

english: But how Esau will be pillaged, his hidden treasures sought out!
ekegusii: Inwe abanto b’ororeria rwa Esau chinibo chiaino chiasakoirwe; na obonda bwaino bwaibirwe bwonsi!
swahili: Lakini tazama jinsi Esau atakavyotekwa, jinsi hazina zake zilizofichwa zitatekwa nyara!

english: All the men allied with you will drive you to the border; the men at peace with you will deceive and overpower you. Those who eat your bread will set a trap for you without your awareness of it.
ekegusii: Abanto baria bonsi kwabwatanete nabarabwo bagoseririe gochia ase orobebe, abanto baria gwakorete omorembe nabarabwo bakong’ainire na gokobua. Abasani bao mokoria komo bagotegeire oboreba, bagoteeba: Ng’ai obong’aini bwao bore?”
swahili: Wote ulioungana nao watakufukuza hadi mpakani, rafiki zako watakudanganya na kukushinda, wale wanaokula mkate wako watakutegea mtego, lakini hutaweza kuugundua.

english: In that day, declares the LORD, will I not destroy the wise men of Edom and the men of understanding in the mountains of Esau?
ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: Ase rituko erio ninsirie abanto abang’aini ba Edomu, naende ninsirie okomanya gwonsi korwa ase Egetunwa gia Esau.
swahili: “Katika siku hiyo,” asema Bwana, “je, sitaangamiza watu wenye hekima wa Edomu, watu wenye ufahamu katika milima ya Esau?

english: Then your mighty men, O Teman, will be terrified, so that everyone in the mountains of Esau will be cut down in the slaughter.
ekegusii: Inwe Abatemani, abarwani baino b’esegi bare chituoni mbaondoke, na kera oyomo ore ase Egetunwa gia Esau naitwe asirigwe kegima. Ayakogera Abaedomu baegwe egesusuro
swahili: Ee Temani, mashujaa wako watatiwa hofu, kila mmoja katika milima ya Esau ataangushwa chini kwa kuchinjwa.

english: Paul, a prisoner of Christ Jesus, and Timothy our brother, To Philemon our beloved fellow worker,
ekegusii: Inche Paulo, omosibwa ase engencho ya Kristo Yeso, boigo korwa ase oyominto Timotheo ase Filemoni, omwanchwa oito, omokori emeremo amo naintwe.
swahili: Paulo, mfungwa wa Kristo Yesu, pamoja na Timotheo ndugu yetu: Kwa Filemoni rafiki yetu mpendwa na mtendakazi mwenzetu,

english: I appeal to you for my child Onesimus, whose father I became while I was in chains.
ekegusii: Nagosoroire ase ribaga riaye omwana one ase Kristo, Onesimo oyio ekero nare ase egesibo kiane, obete omwana one kemoika.
swahili: nakuomba kwa ajili ya mwanangu Onesimo, aliyefanyika mwanangu nilipokuwa kwenye minyororo.

english: Formerly he was useless to you, but now he has become useful both to you and to me.
ekegusii: Agwo kare tarenge taisainegento kende ase ore, korende bono obeire oyo bw’engeencho mono ase ore nainche boigo.
swahili: Mwanzoni alikuwa hakufai, lakini sasa anakufaa sana wewe na mimi pia.

english: I am sending back to you him who is my very heart.
ekegusii: Ere namotomire gocha ase ore, na nigo enga buna nigo abogoretie enkoro yane.
swahili: Namtuma kwako, yeye aliye moyo wangu hasa.

english: I would have liked to keep him with me, so that on your behalf he could minister to me in my chains for the gospel.
ekegusii: Naki inche nigo narenge kogania abeere aiga amo nainche ase nsibire ase engencho y’enchiri, erinde anyare gonkorera ribaga riao.
swahili: Ningependa nikae naye ili ashike nafasi yako ya kunisaidia wakati huu nikiwa kifungoni kwa ajili ya Injili.

english: But I did not want to do anything without your consent, so that your goodness will not be out of compulsion, but by your own free will.
ekegusii: Korende tindigeti okore ing’ana rinde rionsi ase ogokobetereria erio aye onkoonye, korende erio ebe ase ogwancha kwao aye omonyene. Inche tinkonyara gokora ing’ana rinde rionsi otatiga aye gwancheranire narirorio.
swahili: Lakini sikutaka kufanya lolote bila idhini yako, ili wema wowote uufanyao usiwe wa lazima, bali wa hiari.

english: For perhaps this is why he was separated from you for a while, so that you might have him back for good—
ekegusii: Aande nakio kiagerete Onesimo agaatananwa korwa ase ore ase ekero egeke, erinde airane koba ase ore ase ebiro bionsi.
swahili: Huenda sababu ya yeye kutengwa nawe kwa kitambo kidogo ni ili uwe naye daima.

english: no longer as a slave, but better than a slave, as a beloved brother. He is especially beloved to me, but even more so to you, both in person and in the Lord.
ekegusii: Naende ere bono tari buna omosomba, korende goetania omosomba; buna oyominto omwanchwa, ase Kristo. Asende mono, na ase ore mono kobua, buna omosomba, naende buna oyominto ase Omonene!
swahili: Si kama mtumwa, bali bora kuliko mtumwa, kama ndugu mpendwa. Yeye ni mpendwa sana kwangu na hata kwako zaidi, yeye kama mwanadamu na kama ndugu katika Bwana.

english: So if you consider me a partner, receive him as you would receive me.
ekegusii: Gaki, onye kondengereretie inche buna omobwatani oo, omooroisie koreng’ana buna kware kondoisia inche.
swahili: Hivyo kama unanihesabu mimi kuwa mshirika wako, mkaribishe kama vile ungenikaribisha mimi mwenyewe.

english: But if he has wronged you in any way or owes you anything, charge it to my account.
ekegusii: Onye okomocheire ase ing’ana rinde rionsi, gose okoriete esira, oyeborie goetera ase ’nde.
swahili: Kama amekukosea lolote au kama unamdai chochote, nidai mimi.

english: I, Paul, write this with my own hand. I will repay it—not to mention that you owe me your very self.
ekegusii: Inche Paulo nariikire aya nokoboko kwane omonyene, ning’akane. Amaene, ninyare kogoteebia, ng’a nore nesira ase ’nde, ase obogima bwao aye omonyene.
swahili: Ni mimi Paulo, ninayeandika waraka huu kwa mkono wangu mwenyewe. Nitakulipa. Sitaji kwamba nakudai hata nafsi yako.

english: to Apphia our sister, to Archippus our fellow soldier, and to the church that meets at your house:
ekegusii: Na abanto b’ekanisa ekoumerana ase enyomba yao, naboigo Apia, mosubati ominto, na Arikipo, omorwani ore amo naintwe.
swahili: kwa dada yetu mpendwa Afia, kwa Arkipo askari mwenzetu na kwa kanisa lile likutanalo nyumbani mwako:

english: Yes, brother, let me have some benefit from you in the Lord. Refresh my heart in Christ.
ekegusii: Ee, oyominto, ninganetie obokonyi bokorwa ase ore, ekiagera noyo bw’Omonene ore. Buna oyominto ase Kristo, ong’e omoyo!
swahili: Ndugu yangu, natamani nipate faida kwako katika Bwana, uuburudishe moyo wangu katika Kristo.

english: Confident of your obedience, I write to you, knowing that you will do even more than I ask.
ekegusii: Ninde nobomaene aiga buna ngokoriikera aya, ng’a nokore buna nagosabire ekiagera nomoigweri ore, naende ase ayio nimanyete ng’a nokore goetania.
swahili: Nikiwa na hakika ya utii wako, nakuandikia, nikijua kwamba utafanya hata zaidi ya yale ninayokuomba.

english: In the meantime, prepare a guest room for me, because I hope that through your prayers I will be restored to you. Additional Greetings
ekegusii: Amo nayio, ondoiserie aase ngocha komenya, naki ninsemeretie ng’a Omonene Nyasae nayairanerie goetera ase ogosaba kwaino mwensi erio imbe nainwe. Amakwania y’ogokoorera
swahili: Jambo moja zaidi: Niandalie chumba cha wageni, kwa kuwa nataraji kurudishwa kwenu kama jibu la maombi yenu. Salamu Za Mwisho Na Dua Ya Kuwatakia Heri

english: Epaphras, my fellow prisoner in Christ Jesus, sends you greetings,
ekegusii: Epafara, oyosibire amo nainche ase engencho ya Kristo Yeso, ogokwanirie.
swahili: Epafra, aliye mfungwa mwenzangu katika Kristo Yesu, anakusalimu.

english: as do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke, my fellow workers.
ekegusii: Boigo Mariko na Aristariko, na Dema, na Luka.
swahili: Vivyo hivyo Marko, Aristarko, Dema na Luka, watendakazi wenzangu wanakusalimu.

english: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit.
ekegusii: Obuya bw’Omonene oito Yeso Kristo bobe amo nainwe mwensi.
swahili: Neema ya Bwana Yesu Kristo iwe pamoja na roho zenu. Amen.

english: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ. Philemon’s Faith and Love
ekegusii: Tiga Nyasae tata oito na Omonene Yeso Kristo abae obuya na omorembe. Obwanchani bwa Filemoni na okwegena kwaye
swahili: Neema iwe nanyi na amani itokayo kwa Mungu Baba yetu na Bwana Yesu Kristo. Shukrani Na Maombi

english: I always thank my God, remembering you in my prayers,
ekegusii: Oyominto Filemoni, ase ogosaba kwane botambe nigo ngoakera Nyasae one ng’a mbuya mono ekero ngokoinyora.
swahili: Siku zote ninamshukuru Mungu ninapokukumbuka katika maombi yangu,

english: because I hear about your faith in the Lord Jesus and your love for all the saints.
ekegusii: Ayio nase engencho nkoigwa amang’ana igoro y’obwanchani bwao ase abanto bonsi b’Omonene, na okwegena kwao obwate ase Omonene Yeso.
swahili: kwa sababu ninasikia juu ya imani yako katika Bwana Yesu na upendo wako kwa watakatifu wote.

english: I pray that your partnership in the faith may become effective as you fully acknowledge every good thing that is ours in Christ.
ekegusii: Nasabire ng’a okobwatana gw’okwegena tore nakorokwo gokore emeremo, erinde omanye mono kobua kera egento ogosesenigwa kore ase tore intwe ase okobwatana na Kristo.
swahili: Naomba utiwe nguvu katika kuishuhudia imani yako, ili upate kuwa na ufahamu mkamilifu juu ya kila kitu chema tulicho nacho ndani ya Kristo.

english: I take great joy and encouragement in your love, because you, brother, have refreshed the hearts of the saints. Paul’s Appeal for Onesimus
ekegusii: Naki oyominto, nigo nabeete nomogooko omonge na okoremigwa ase engencho y’obwanchani bwao! Chinkoro chi’abaanto b’Omonene bonsi chiasasokire. Paulo ogosabera Onesimo
swahili: Upendo wako umenifurahisha mno na kunitia moyo, kwa sababu wewe ndugu, umeiburudisha mioyo ya watakatifu. Maombi Ya Paulo Ya Kumtetea Onesimo

english: So although in Christ I am bold enough to order you to do what is proper,
ekegusii: Ase ayio, ninde noboremu obonge buna momura omino ase Kristo kogochika eri ogwenerete okore.
swahili: Hata hivyo, ingawa katika Kristo ningeweza kuwa na ujasiri na kukuagiza yale yakupasayo kutenda,

english: I prefer to appeal on the basis of love. For I, Paul, am now aged, and a prisoner of Christ Jesus as well.
ekegusii: Korende ase engencho y’obwanchani bwane ase ore, nanchire kobua kogosorora, buna inche Paulo inde omotomwa, naende inde omosibwa o Kristo Yeso.
swahili: lakini ninakuomba kwa upendo, mimi Paulo, mzee na pia sasa nikiwa mfungwa wa Kristo Yesu,

english: Paul and Timothy, servants of Christ Jesus, To all the saints in Christ Jesus at Philippi, together with the overseers and deacons:
ekegusii: Korwa ase inche Paulo na Timotheo, abasomba ba Kristo Yeso, gochia ase abanto bonsi ba Nyasae abamomenyete Filipi aba mwabwatanigwe na Kristo Yeso, amo nabatang’ani na abakoonyi ase ekanisa.
swahili: Waraka wa Paulo na Timotheo, watumishi wa Kristo Yesu: Kwa watakatifu wote katika Kristo Yesu walioko Filipi, pamoja na waangalizi na mashemasi:

english: so that you may be able to test and prove what is best and may be pure and blameless for the day of Christ,
ekegusii: erinde monyare komanya ayare amaya, naende mobe n’chinkoro chindemu, motari na komocha ase rituko ria Kristo.
swahili: ili mpate kutambua yale yaliyo mema, mkawe safi, wasio na hatia hadi siku ya Kristo,

english: filled with the fruit of righteousness that comes through Jesus Christ, to the glory and praise of God. Paul’s Trials Advance the Gospel (James 1:2–12)
ekegusii: Mwaichoirwe n’okwama kw’oboronge ase enchera ya Yeso Kristo, ase obonene na ogotogigwa kwa Nyasae. Okoba moyo n’Kristo
swahili: mkiwa mmejawa na matunda ya haki yapatikanayo kwa njia ya Yesu Kristo, kwa utukufu na sifa za Mungu. Kufungwa Kwa Paulo Kwaieneza Injili

english: Now I want you to know, brothers, that my circumstances have actually served to advance the gospel.
ekegusii: Korende baminto, nimbamanyie ng’a amang’ana aria onsi anyorete, abeire ase okogendereria gw’enchiri.
swahili: Basi, ndugu zangu, nataka mjue kwamba mambo yale yaliyonipata kwa kweli yamesaidia sana kueneza Injili.

english: As a result, it has become clear throughout the whole palace guard and to everyone else that I am in chains for Christ.
ekegusii: Ase igo amanyekanire ase abarendi bonsi b’omorwoti, na ase abande bonsi ng’a nasibirwe ase engencho ya Kristo.
swahili: Matokeo yake ni kwamba imejulikana wazi kwa walinzi wote wa jumba la kifalme na kwa wengine wote kuwa nimefungwa kwa ajili ya Kristo.

english: And most of the brothers, confident in the Lord by my chains, now dare more greatly to speak the word without fear.
ekegusii: Na abange ase abaminto abare ase Omonene Nyasae babeire n’okoremigwa ase engencho y’ogosibwa kwane, bamentekanire n’oboremu gokwana ring’ana ria Nyasae batari nobwoba.
swahili: Kwa sababu ya vifungo vyangu, ndugu wengi katika Bwana wametiwa moyo kuhubiri neno la Mungu kwa ujasiri zaidi na bila woga.

english: It is true that some preach Christ out of envy and rivalry, but others out of goodwill.
ekegusii: Abande nigo bakorandia Kristo bare n’emoko n’eriomana, korende abande ase omoyo omuya,
swahili: Ni kweli kwamba wengine wanamhubiri Kristo kutokana na wivu na kwa kutaka kushindana, lakini wengine wanamhubiri Kristo kwa nia njema.

english: The latter do so in love, knowing that I am appointed for the defense of the gospel.
ekegusii: abwo ase obwanchani, bamanyete ng’a nabekirwe ase okorwanerera enchiri.
swahili: Hawa wa mwisho wanamhubiri Kristo kwa moyo wa upendo, wakifahamu kwamba nimo humu gerezani kwa ajili ya kuitetea Injili.

english: The former, however, preach Christ out of selfish ambition, not sincerely, supposing that they can add to the distress of my chains.
ekegusii: Aba bakoraria Kristo ase esuugu gose tari ase omoyo omorabu, bakorengereria komenta obororo bwane ase ogosibwa kwane.
swahili: Hao wa kwanza wanamtangaza Kristo kutokana na tamaa zao wenyewe wala si kwa moyo mweupe, bali wanakusudia kuongeza mateso yangu katika huku kufungwa kwangu.

english: What then is the issue? Just this: that in every way, whether by false motives or true, Christ is preached. And in this I rejoice. Yes, and I will continue to rejoice,
ekegusii: Inki rende? Nonya nabo, ase kera enchera Kristo nigo arararigwe, ase obong’ainereria gose ase ekeene, na ase ayio nagokire.
swahili: Lakini inadhuru nini? Jambo la muhimu ni kwamba kwa kila njia, ikiwa ni kwa nia mbaya au njema, Kristo anahubiriwa. Nami kwa ajili ya jambo hilo ninafurahi. Naam, nami nitaendelea kufurahi,

english: because I know that through your prayers and the provision of the Spirit of Jesus Christ, my distress will turn out for my deliverance.
ekegusii: Ee, ningooke, ekiagera namanyire ng’a aya nang’onchokere koba ase ogotooreka kwane, goetera ase ogosaba kwaino na ase ogokonya kw’Omoika o Yeso Kristo.
swahili: kwa maana ninajua kwamba kwa maombi yenu na kwa msaada unaotolewa na Roho wa Yesu Kristo, yale yaliyonipata mimi yatageuka kuwa wokovu wangu.

english: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ. Thanksgiving and Prayer (1 Corinthians 1:4–9; Colossians 1:3–14)
ekegusii: Obuya bobe ase more n’omorembe bikorwa ase Nyasae Tata oito, na ase Omonene Nyasae Yeso Kristo. Paulo ogosabera Abafilipi
swahili: Neema na amani itokayo kwa Mungu Baba yetu na kwa Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo iwe nanyi. Shukrani Na Maombi

english: I eagerly expect and hope that I will in no way be ashamed, but will have complete boldness so that now as always Christ will be exalted in my body, whether by life or by death. To Live Is Christ
ekegusii: Ninde nokoganyererera okonene n’ogosemeria ng’a tingosookigwa ase enchera ende yonsi, korende ase oboremu bwane bwonsi, bono buna botambe, Kristo naegwe ogosika ase omobere one, keraabe ase obogima gose ase ogokwa.
swahili: Ninatarajia kwa shauku kubwa na kutumaini kwamba sitaaibika kwa njia yoyote, bali nitakuwa na ujasiri wa kutosha ili sasa kama wakati mwingine wowote, Kristo atukuzwe katika mwili wangu, ikiwa ni kwa kuishi au kwa kufa.

english: For to me, to live is Christ, and to die is gain.
ekegusii: Naki ase ’nde inche, okoba moyo n’Kristo, na ogokwa nokonyora amange.
swahili: Kwa maana kwangu mimi, kuishi ni Kristo, na kufa ni faida.

english: But if I go on living in the body, this will mean fruitful labor for me. So what shall I choose? I do not know.
ekegusii: Korende onye nkoba moyo ase omobere, aya nigo akondetera okwama kw’emeremo yane; gaki eri ndigetie gochora, tindimanyeti.
swahili: Kama nitaendelea kuishi katika mwili, kwangu hili ni kwa ajili ya matunda ya kazi. Lakini sijui nichague lipi? Mimi sijui!

english: I am torn between the two. I desire to depart and be with Christ, which is far better indeed.
ekegusii: Nimigire mono ase egati y’amang’ana aya abere. Okogania kwane nigo kore ng’a ngende komenya amo na Kristo; ekiagera aya namaya kobua.
swahili: Ninavutwa kati ya mambo mawili: Ninatamani kuondoka nikakae pamoja na Kristo, jambo hilo ni bora zaidi.

english: But it is more necessary for you that I remain in the body.
ekegusii: Korende gotigara ase omobere nkogwenerete kobua ase engencho yaino.
swahili: Lakini kwa sababu yenu ni muhimu zaidi mimi nikiendelea kuishi katika mwili.

english: Convinced of this, I know that I will remain and will continue with all of you for your progress and joy in the faith,
ekegusii: Ekiagera inde nobomaene ase aya, namanyire ng’a nintigare na kogenderera amo nainwe mwensi, na inwe momenteke na kogoka ase okwegena,
swahili: Kwa kuwa nina matumaini haya, ninajua kwamba nitaendelea kuwepo na kuwa pamoja nanyi nyote, ili mpate kukua na kuwa na furaha katika imani.

english: so that through my coming to you again your exultation in Christ Jesus will resound on account of me. Worthy of the Gospel
ekegusii: erinde ogwetogia kwaino ase engencho yane konyare komenteka ase Kristo Yeso, ase engencho y’okoba kwane amo nainwe naende.
swahili: Ili kwamba furaha yenu iwe nyingi katika Kristo Yesu kwa ajili yangu kwa kule kuja kwangu kwenu tena. Kuenenda Ipasavyo Injili

english: Nevertheless, conduct yourselves in a manner worthy of the gospel of Christ. Then, whether I come and see you or only hear about you in my absence, I will know that you stand firm in one spirit, contending side by side for the faith of the gospel,
ekegusii: Korende orogendo rwaino robe buna egwenerete enchiri ya Kristo, erinde onye ngocha kobarora inwe, gose tinkobao, nyigwe amang’ana aino ng’a moteneine bokong’u ase omoika oyomo, na ase omoyo oyomo mokorwanerera okwegena more nakwo ase enchiri amo.
swahili: Lakini lolote litakalotukia, mwenende kama ipasavyo Injili ya Kristo, ili kwamba nikija na kuwaona au ikiwa sipo, nipate kusikia haya juu yenu: Kuwa mnasimama imara katika roho moja, mkiishindania imani ya Injili kwa umoja,

english: without being frightened in any way by those who oppose you. This is a clear sign of their destruction but of your salvation, and it is from God.
ekegusii: Timoiroka abwo bakobaengereria ase ing’ana rinde rionsi. Eke nekemanyererio ase ogosira kwabo, korende ase more inwe nekemanyererio ki’ogotooreka. Eke nigo gekorwa ase Nyasae.
swahili: wala msitishwe na wale wanaowapinga. Hii ni ishara kwao kuwa wataangamia, lakini ninyi mtaokolewa, na hii ni kazi ya Mungu.

english: For it has been granted to you on behalf of Christ not only to believe in Him, but also to suffer for Him,
ekegusii: Ekiagera ase engencho ya Kristo mwaeirwe, tari okomwegena gwoka korende nogochandwa boigo ase engencho yaye.
swahili: Kwa maana mmepewa kwa ajili ya Kristo, si kumwamini tu, bali pia kuteswa kwa ajili yake,

english: I thank my God every time I remember you.
ekegusii: Igo nkomoakera Nyasae one ng’a mbuya mono chingaki chionsi nkobainyora,
swahili: Ninamshukuru Mungu wangu kila niwakumbukapo ninyi.

english: since you are encountering the same struggle you saw I had, and now hear that I still have.
ekegusii: Na inwe nabo more nokorwanerera koria koria mwaroche ase ’nde, na koigwa ng’a ninde nakwo goika bono.
swahili: kwa kuwa mnashiriki mashindano yale yale mliyoyaona nikiwa nayo na ambayo hata sasa mnasikia kuwa bado ninayo.

english: In every prayer for all of you, I always pray with joy,
ekegusii: ekiagera botambe ase ogosaba kwane nigo nkobasabera inwe mwensi nomogooko,
swahili: Katika maombi yangu yote daima nimekuwa nikiwaombea ninyi nyote kwa furaha,

english: because of your partnership in the gospel from the first day until now,
ekegusii: ase engencho y’okobwaterana kwaino ase enchiri korwa rituko rie ritang’ani goika reero iga.
swahili: kwa sababu ya kushiriki kwenu katika kueneza Injili, tangu siku ya kwanza hadi leo.

english: being confident of this, that He who began a good work in you will carry it on to completion until the day of Christ Jesus.
ekegusii: Ninde nobomaene, ng’a Nyasae oyochagete emeremo emiya ase emioyo yaino ime nayeikeranie goika rituko riria ria Kristo Yeso.
swahili: Nina hakika kwamba yeye aliyeianza kazi njema mioyoni mwenu, ataiendeleza na kuikamilisha hata siku ya Kristo Yesu.

english: It is right for me to feel this way about all of you, since I have you in my heart. For in my chains and in my defense and confirmation of the gospel, you are all partners in grace with me.
ekegusii: Igo bore boronge ase ’nde korengereria aya igoro ase more mwensi, ekiagera nababogoirie inwe ase enkoro yane ime. Naki ase ogosibwa kwane na ase emeremo y’okorwanerera enchiri na koyeorokia ng’a ero nechinguru, na inwe mwensi mwabwatanire nainche ase obuya obo naeirwe.
swahili: Ni haki na ni wajibu wangu kufikiri hivi juu yenu nyote, kwa sababu ninyi mko moyoni mwangu. Ikiwa nimefungwa au nikiwa ninaitetea na kuithibitisha Injili, ninyi nyote mnashiriki neema ya Mungu pamoja nami.

english: God is my witness how I long for all of you with the affection of Christ Jesus.
ekegusii: Naki Nyasae nere kirori one, buna ’nde namaiga ase more mwensi nobwanchani bokorwa ase Kristo Yeso.
swahili: Mungu ni shahidi wangu jinsi ninavyowaonea shauku ninyi nyote kwa huruma ya Kristo Yesu.

english: And this is my prayer: that your love may abound more and more in knowledge and depth of insight,
ekegusii: Oko nakwo ogosaba kwane, ng’a obwanchani bwaino bomenteke, bobe obonge mono ase okomanya kw’ogwatanana gwonsi,
swahili: Haya ndiyo maombi yangu: kwamba upendo wenu uongezeke zaidi na zaidi katika maarifa na ufahamu wote,

english: Therefore if you have any encouragement in Christ, if any comfort from His love, if any fellowship with the Spirit, if any affection and compassion,
ekegusii: Obogima bwaino ime ya Kristo nigo bokobaa chinguru, n’obwanchani bwaye bwabaremia. Okobwatana kw’Omoika, karabe amaabera ande onsi na amabeebe,
swahili: Kama kukiwa na jambo lolote la kutia moyo katika kuunganishwa na Kristo, kukiwa faraja yoyote katika upendo wake, kukiwa na ushirika wowote na Roho, kukiwa na wema wowote na huruma,

english: that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, in heaven and on earth and under the earth,
ekegusii: erinde ase erieta ria Yeso kera riiru riringwe, ri’abwo bare igoro, na ase ense, na inse y’ense,
swahili: ili kwa Jina la Yesu, kila goti lipigwe, la vitu vya mbinguni, na vya duniani, na vya chini ya nchi,

english: and every tongue confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father. Lights in the World (Matthew 5:13–16)
ekegusii: na kera oromeme narobe kirori ng’a Yeso Kristo n’Omonene, ase obonene bwa Nyasae Tata. Okobara buna Omebaso ase Ense
swahili: na kila ulimi ukiri ya kwamba Yesu Kristo ni Bwana, kwa utukufu wa Mungu Baba. Ngʼaeni Kama Mianga Katika Ulimwengu

english: Therefore, my beloved, just as you have always obeyed, not only in my presence, but now even more in my absence, continue to work out your salvation with fear and trembling.
ekegusii: Ase ayio, abanchwa baane, buna moigwerete botambe, tari ekero indeo rioka, korende kobua mono ekero ntaiyo, korera ogotooreka kwaino abanyene ase okwoboa na okoiguswa,
swahili: Kwa hiyo, wapenzi wangu, kama vile ambavyo mmekuwa mkitii siku zote, si tu wakati nikiwa pamoja nanyi, bali sasa zaidi sana nisipokuwepo, utimizeni wokovu wenu kwa kuogopa na kutetemeka,

english: For it is God who works in you to will and to act on behalf of His good purpose.
ekegusii: ekiagera Nyasae nere ogokora emeremo ime yaino ase okorigia, naende ase ogokora ogwancha kwaye okuya.
swahili: kwa maana Mungu ndiye atendaye kazi ndani yenu, kutaka kwenu na kutenda kwenu kwa kulitimiza kusudi lake jema.

english: Do everything without complaining or arguing,
ekegusii: Mokore amang’ana onsi motari nokwemurungania na okoborania,
swahili: Fanyeni mambo yote bila kunungʼunika wala kushindana,

english: so that you may be blameless and pure, children of God without fault in a crooked and perverse generation, in which you shine as lights in the world
ekegusii: erinde monyare koba abatari na komocha, abachenu, abana ba Nyasae, motari na bobe egati y’ekegori eke ekebe kere bogeka. Ase egati y’abwo mobare buna emebaso ase ense.
swahili: ili msiwe na lawama wala hatia, bali mwe wana wa Mungu wasio na kasoro katika kizazi chenye ukaidi na kilichopotoka, ambacho ndani yake ninyi mnangʼaa kama mianga ulimwenguni.

english: as you hold forth the word of life, in order that I may boast on the day of Christ that I did not run or labor in vain.
ekegusii: Bwata ring’ana ri’obogima, erinde inyore engencho y’ogwetogia ase rituko riria ria Kristo, ng’a tinaminyogete bosa, gose tinakorete emeremo bosa.
swahili: Mkilishika neno la uzima, ili nipate kuona fahari siku ya Kristo kwamba sikupiga mbio wala kujitaabisha bure.

english: But even if I am being poured out like a drink offering on the sacrifice and service of your faith, I am glad and rejoice with all of you.
ekegusii: Ee, kondaumorwe igoro y’ekeng’wanso na ogokora gw’okwegena kwaino, nagokire; ee, nagokire amo nainwe mwensi.
swahili: Lakini hata kama nikimiminwa kama sadaka ya kinywaji kwenye dhabihu na huduma itokayo katika imani yenu, mimi ninafurahi na kushangilia pamoja nanyi nyote.

english: So you too should be glad and rejoice with me. Timothy and Epaphroditus (1 Corinthians 16:10–12)
ekegusii: Nainwe boigo, goka, ee, goka amo nainche. Timotheo na Epafrodito
swahili: Vivyo hivyo, ninyi nanyi imewapasa kufurahi na kushangilia pamoja nami. Paulo Amsifu Timotheo

english: Now I hope in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy to you soon, that I also may be cheered when I learn how you are doing.
ekegusii: Korende nasemeirie ase Omonene Yeso gotoma Timotheo achiche bwango ase more, erinde inche ndemigwe, kondamanye buna more.
swahili: Natumaini katika Bwana Yesu kumtuma Timotheo hivi karibuni aje kwenu, ili nipate kufarijika moyo nitakapopata habari zenu.

english: then make my joy complete by being like-minded, having the same love, being united in spirit and purpose.
ekegusii: ikerania omogooko one ase okoba nokorengereria okwo okwo na obwanchani obomo; mobe nomoyo oyomo, na okorengereria okomo.
swahili: basi ikamilisheni furaha yangu kwa kuwa na nia moja, mkiwa na upendo huo moja, mkiwa wa roho na kusudi moja.

english: I have nobody else like him who will genuinely care for your needs.
ekegusii: Naki tindi na monto onde ore nomoyo oyomo nainche, oyoranyare gochandekera chingencho chiaino,
swahili: Sina mtu mwingine kama yeye, ambaye ataangalia hali yenu kwa halisi.

english: For all the others look after their own interests, not those of Jesus Christ.
ekegusii: ekiagera bonsi nigo bakorigia ebinto biabo abanyene, gose tari ebia Kristo Yeso.
swahili: Kwa maana kila mmoja anajishughulisha zaidi na mambo yake mwenyewe wala si yale ya Yesu Kristo.

english: But you know Timothy’s proven worth, that as a child with his father he has served with me to advance the gospel.
ekegusii: Korende momanyete Timotheo na ogokora kwaye, buna akorerete enchiri amo nainche. Igo are koreng’ana buna omwana okomokorera ise.
swahili: Lakini ninyi wenyewe mnajua jinsi Timotheo alivyojithibitisha mwenyewe, kwa maana ametumika pamoja nami kwa kazi ya Injili, kama vile mwana kwa baba yake.

english: So I hope to send him as soon as I see what happens with me.
ekegusii: Ase ayio ninganetie komotoma ase obwango ekero ndamanye buna amang’ana arabe ase ’nde.
swahili: Kwa hiyo, ninatumaini kumtuma kwenu upesi mara nitakapojua mambo yangu yatakavyokuwa.

english: And I trust in the Lord that I myself will come soon.
ekegusii: Na inche nasemeirie ase Omonene ng’a inche omonyene boigo ninchiche bwango.
swahili: Nami mwenyewe ninatumaini katika Bwana kwamba nitakuja kwenu hivi karibuni. Paulo Amsifu Epafrodito

english: But I thought it necessary to send back to you Epaphroditus, my brother, fellow worker, and fellow soldier, who is also your messenger and minister to my needs.
ekegusii: Korende nkarora ng’a ningwenerete gotoma Epafrodito oyominto, omokori emeremo amo nainche, omorwani amo nainche, oyo mwatomire gonkorera ase okoremerwa kwane.
swahili: Lakini nadhani ni muhimu kumtuma tena kwenu Epafrodito, ndugu yangu na mtendakazi pamoja nami, aliye askari mwenzangu, ambaye pia ni mjumbe wenu mliyemtuma ili ashughulike na mahitaji yangu.

english: For he has been longing for all of you and is distressed because you heard he was ill.
ekegusii: Ere nigo arenge namaiga ase more mwensi, naende agaichana mono, ekiagera mwaigwete ng’a nigo arenge omorwaire.
swahili: Kwa maana amekuwa akiwaonea sana shauku ninyi nyote, akiwa na wasiwasi kwa kuwa mlisikia kwamba alikuwa mgonjwa.

english: He was sick indeed, nearly unto death. But God had mercy on him, and not only on him but also on me, to spare me sorrow upon sorrow.
ekegusii: Ere nomorwaire arenge ekeene, ang’e nogokwa, korende Nyasae akamororera amaabera, gose tari ere bweka, korende nonya ninche boigo, timba nomoichano igoro ase omoichano.
swahili: Kweli alikuwa mgonjwa, tena karibu ya kufa. Lakini Mungu alimhurumia, wala si yeye tu, bali hata na mimi alinihurumia, nisipatwe na huzuni juu ya huzuni.

english: Therefore I am all the more eager to send him, so that when you see him again you may rejoice, and I may be less anxious.
ekegusii: Ase ayio nakorire omokia mono komotoma, erinde ekero moramorore naende, monyare kogoka, na inche nkeeanerigwe omoichano one.
swahili: Kwa hiyo mimi ninafanya bidii kumtuma kwenu ili mtakapomwona kwa mara nyingine, mpate kufurahi, nami wasiwasi wangu upungue.

english: Welcome him in the Lord with great joy, and honor men like him,
ekegusii: Momooroisie gaki ase Omonene ase omogooko bwonsi. Mosike abanto banga buna oyio,
swahili: Kwa hiyo mpokeeni katika Bwana kwa furaha kubwa, nanyi wapeni heshima watu kama hawa,

english: Do nothing out of selfish ambition or empty pride, but in humility consider others more important than yourselves.
ekegusii: Timokora ing’ana rinde rionsi ase okwegwenera na ase okweenenia, korende ase oboitongo kera omonto abare abande ng’a nabaya kobua ere omonyene.
swahili: Msitende jambo lolote kwa nia ya kujitukuza wala kujivuna, bali kwa unyenyekevu kila mtu amhesabu mwingine bora kuliko nafsi yake.

english: because he nearly died for the work of Christ, risking his life to make up for your deficit of service to me.
ekegusii: ekiagera ase engencho y’emeremo ya Kristo akaba ang’e ase ogokwa, tarendete obogima bwaye ase ogoisanera ayaremete ase ogokora kwaino ase ’nde.
swahili: kwa sababu alikaribia kufa kwa ajili ya kazi ya Kristo, akihatarisha maisha yake ili aweze kunihudumia vile ninyi hamkuweza.

english: Each of you should look not only to your own interests, but also to the interests of others. The Mind of Christ (Isaiah 52:13–15)
ekegusii: Kera omonto tarigereria ebinto biaye omonyene, korende arigererie ebinto bi’abaanto bande.
swahili: Kila mmoja wenu asiangalie faida yake mwenyewe tu, bali pia ajishughulishe kwa faida ya wengine.

english: Let this mind be in you which was also in Christ Jesus:
ekegusii: Naki mobe nebirengererio ebio ebio ime yaino buna ebio biarenge ime ya Kristo Yeso.
swahili: Kuweni na nia ile ile aliyokuwa nayo Kristo Yesu:

english: Who, existing in the form of God, did not consider equality with God something to be grasped,
ekegusii: Ere omochakano nigo arenge oyomo na Nyasae, na tabarete ng’a okoba koreng’ana buna Nyasae negento gi’okobwaterera,
swahili: Yeye, ingawa alikuwa na asili ya Mungu hasa, hakuona kule kuwa sawa na Mungu kuwa kitu cha kushikilia,

english: but emptied Himself, taking the form of a servant, being made in human likeness.
ekegusii: korende agekora buna tarenge nobonene, akaimokia ekieni ki’omosomba, akaba omogwekano o Mwanyabaanto.
swahili: bali alijifanya si kitu, akachukua hali hasa na mtumwa, naye akazaliwa katika umbo la mwanadamu.

english: And being found in appearance as a man, He humbled Himself and became obedient to death— even death on a cross.
ekegusii: Naende agachia kororekana ore buna Mwanyabaanto omonyene, agekeyia, akaba omoigweri goika ogokwa, na korokwo nogokwa igoro ase omosalaba.
swahili: Naye akiwa na umbo la mwanadamu, alijinyenyekeza, akatii hata mauti: naam, mauti ya msalaba!

english: Therefore God exalted Him to the highest place and gave Him the name above all names,
ekegusii: Ase ayio Nyasae akamoimokereria igoro mono, akamoa erieta erio ribuete amarieta onsi,
swahili: Kwa hiyo, Mungu alimtukuza juu sana, na kumpa Jina lililo kuu kuliko kila jina,

english: Finally, my brothers, rejoice in the Lord. It is no trouble for me to write the same things to you again, and it is a safeguard for you.
ekegusii: Omoerio baminto, goka ase Omonene! Kobariikera inwe amang’ana aria aria tandoseti inche, korende ase more nigo arabe obokonyi.
swahili: Hatimaye, ndugu zangu, furahini katika Bwana! Mimi kuwaandikia mambo yale yale hakuniudhi, kwa maana ni kinga kwa ajili yenu.

english: I want to know Christ and the power of His resurrection and the fellowship of His sufferings, being conformed to Him in His death,
ekegusii: Nindigetie komomanya Kristo ne chinguru chi’okobokigwa kwaye, inyare kobwatana nogochandwa kwaye, ngwekanigwe nere ase ogokwa kwaye;
swahili: Nataka nimjue Kristo na uweza wa kufufuka kwake na ushirika wa mateso yake, ili nifanane naye katika mauti yake,

english: and so, somehow, to attain to the resurrection from the dead. Pressing on toward the Goal
ekegusii: erinde inyore ase enchera ende yonsi goikera okobokigwa korwa ase abakuure. Kominyoka goika ase Engori
swahili: ili kwa njia yoyote niweze kufikia ufufuo wa wafu. Kukaza Mwendo Ili Kufikia Lengo

english: Not that I have already obtained all this, or have already been made perfect, but I press on to take hold of that for which Christ Jesus took hold of me.
ekegusii: Tari ng’a naikire konyora aya, gose naikire koba omoikeranu, korende nakong’irie orogendo inyabwate, ekiagera nabwatirwe na Kristo Yeso.
swahili: Si kwamba nimekwisha kufikia, au kwamba nimekwisha kuwa mkamilifu, la hasha! Bali nakaza mwendo ili nipate kile ambacho kwa ajili yake, nimeshikwa na Kristo Yesu.

english: Brothers, I do not consider myself yet to have taken hold of it. But one thing I do: Forgetting what is behind and straining toward what is ahead,
ekegusii: Abaminto, tinyekageti inche omonyene ng’a naikire koyabwata; korende ninkore egento ekemo gioka: kweba ayare magega, ndambaarie ayare bosio.
swahili: Ndugu zangu, sijihesabu kuwa nimekwisha kushika. Lakini ninafanya jambo moja: Ninasahau mambo yale yaliyopita, nakaza mwendo kufikia yale yaliyo mbele.

english: I press on toward the goal to win the prize of God’s heavenly calling in Christ Jesus.
ekegusii: Nakong’irie orogendo gochia aase ngokoorera, ng’ikere eng’eria y’okorangerigwa kwa igoro kwa Nyasae goetera ase Kristo Yeso.
swahili: Nakaza mwendo nifikie ile alama ya ushindi iliyowekwa ili nipate tuzo ya mwito mkuu wa Mungu ambao nimeitiwa huko juu mbinguni katika Kristo Yesu.

english: All of us who are mature should embrace this point of view. And if you think differently about some issue, God will reveal this to you as well.
ekegusii: Gaki intwe abatore abaikeranu torengererie ayio. Komorabe mokorengereria ayande, ase ing’ana rinde rionsi, Nyasae nabamaanorere ayio naro.
swahili: Hivyo sisi sote tuliokuwa kiroho tuwaze jambo hili, hata mkiwaza mengine katika jambo lolote, Mungu ataliweka wazi hilo nalo.

english: Nevertheless, we must live up to what we have already attained. Citizenship in Heaven
ekegusii: Korende togenderere ase ayio ayio twaigete konyora.
swahili: Lakini na tushike sana lile ambalo tumekwisha kulifikia.

english: Join one another in following my example, brothers, and carefully observe those who walk according to the pattern we set for you.
ekegusii: Abaminto, mobe abeegi baane, morigererie abwo bakogenda ase ogotunyana omogwekano oria oria twabaete.
swahili: Ndugu zangu, kwa pamoja fuateni mfano wangu na kuwatazama wale wanaofuata kielelezo tulichowawekea.

english: For as I have often told you before, and now say again even with tears: Many live as enemies of the cross of Christ.
ekegusii: Naki abange nigo bakogenderera bare ababisa b’omosalaba o Kristo. Nabatebirie amang’ana abo ara aange, nonya mbono nigo nkobateebia aya ase amariga.
swahili: Kwa maana, kama nilivyokwisha kuwaambia mara nyingi kabla, nami sasa nasema tena hata kwa machozi, watu wengi wanaishi kama adui wa msalaba wa Kristo.

english: Their end is destruction, their god is their belly, and their glory is in their shame. Their minds are set on earthly things.
ekegusii: Omoerio obo nogosareka, enyasae yabo nenda, obonene bwabo nigo bore ase obosooku bwabo, bakorengereria amang’ana ’ense.
swahili: Mwisho wa watu hao ni maangamizi, Mungu wao ni tumbo, na utukufu wao ni aibu, na mawazo yao yamo katika mambo ya dunia.

english: Watch out for those dogs, those workers of evil, those mutilators of the flesh!
ekegusii: Mwerende korwa ase chisese, mwerende na korwa ase abwo bagokora amabe, mwerende nabwo bakwenachanacha!
swahili: Jihadharini na mbwa, wale watenda maovu, jihadharini na wale wajikatao miili yao, wasemao ili kuokoka ni lazima kutahiriwa.

english: But our citizenship is in heaven, and we eagerly await a Savior from there, the Lord Jesus Christ,
ekegusii: Naki obobiare bwaito igoro, bore. Korwa agwo naende ntoganyete, Omotooria, Omonene Yeso Kristo,
swahili: Lakini uenyeji wetu uko mbinguni. Nasi tunamngoja kwa shauku Mwokozi kutoka huko, yaani, Bwana Yesu Kristo,

english: who, by the power that enables Him to subject all things to Himself, will transform our lowly bodies to be like His glorious body.
ekegusii: oyoranyare koonchora emebere yaito y’obosareku enyare kogwekana nomobere oye bw’obonene, koreng’ana nokobua kwaye ase okwo aranyare kobeeka ebinto bionsi inse asare.
swahili: atakayeubadili mwili wetu wa unyonge, ili upate kufanana na mwili wake wa utukufu, kwa uweza ule ambao kwa huo aweza hata kuvitiisha vitu vyote chini yake.

english: For it is we who are the circumcision, we who worship by the Spirit of God, who glory in Christ Jesus, and who put no confidence in the flesh—
ekegusii: Naki intwe naba twarogete, abatogosasiima Nyasae ase Omoika oye, na gwetogia ase Kristo Yeso, na titosemereti ebia omobere.
swahili: Kwa maana sisi ndio tulio tohara, sisi tumwabuduo Mungu katika Roho, tunaona fahari katika Kristo Yesu, ambao hatuweki tumaini letu katika mwili,

english: though I myself could have such confidence. If anyone else thinks he has grounds for confidence in the flesh, I have more:
ekegusii: Nonya ninche ase ensemo yane ninyare gosemeria ebia omobere. Onye omonto onde okorora ng’a nare nengencho y’ogosemeria ebia omobere, inche nkobua,
swahili: ingawa mimi mwenyewe ninazo sababu za kuutumainia mwili. Kama mtu yeyote akidhani anazo sababu za kuutumainia mwili, mimi zaidi.

english: circumcised on the eighth day, of the people of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin; a Hebrew of Hebrews; as to the law, a Pharisee;
ekegusii: ekiagera narogete ase rituko ria gatano na gatato, naende noyomo bw’Abaisraeli inde, oyo bw’ororeria rwa Benjamini, Omoiberania oiboretwe n’Abaiberania, na ase ogotunyana amachiiko n’Omofarisai inde.
swahili: Nilitahiriwa siku ya nane, mimi ni Mwisraeli wa kabila la Benyamini, Mwebrania wa Waebrania. Kwa habari ya sheria, ni Farisayo,

english: as to zeal, persecuting the church; as to righteousness in the law, faultless.
ekegusii: Nkaba nomokia bw’ogochanda ekanisa, na ase amang’ana ’oboronge bokonyorekana ase amachiiko tinarenge na komocha.
swahili: kwa habari ya juhudi, nilikuwa nalitesa kanisa, kuhusu haki ipatikanayo kwa sheria, mimi nilikuwa sina hatia.

english: But whatever was gain to me I count as loss for the sake of Christ.
ekegusii: Korende amang’ana aria arenge okonyora ase ’nde nayabarire koba bosa ase engencho ya Kristo.
swahili: Lakini mambo yale yaliyokuwa faida kwangu, sasa nayahesabu kuwa hasara kwa ajili ya Kristo.

english: More than that, I count all things as loss compared to the surpassing excellence of knowing Christ Jesus my Lord, for whom I have lost all things. I consider them rubbish, that I may gain Christ
ekegusii: Ee, nabarire onsi, ng’a abeire bosa ase engencho y’obuya botari nekerengo, engencho yaye okomomanya Kristo Yese Omonene one. Ase engencho yaye natigire ebinto bionsi, na kobibara buna eubi, erinde imonyore Kristo,
swahili: Zaidi ya hayo, nayahesabu mambo yote kuwa hasara tupu nikiyalinganisha na faida kubwa ipitayo kiasi cha kumjua Kristo Yesu Bwana wangu, ambaye kwa ajili yake nimepata hasara ya mambo yote, nikiyahesabu kuwa kama mavi ili nimpate Kristo.

english: and be found in Him, not having my own righteousness from the law, but that which is through faith in Christ, the righteousness from God on the basis of faith.
ekegusii: naende ndorekane ime asare. Tinkoba noboronge bwane boria bokonyorekana ase amachiiko korende boria bokonyorekana ase okomwegena Kristo, oboronge boria bokorwa ase Nyasae, bokonyorekana ase okomwegena.
swahili: Nami nionekane mbele zake bila kuwa na haki yangu mwenyewe ipatikanayo kwa sheria, bali ile ipatikanayo kwa imani katika Kristo, haki ile itokayo kwa Mungu kwa njia ya imani.

english: Therefore, my brothers, whom I love and long for, my joy and crown, that is how you must stand firm in the Lord, my beloved.
ekegusii: Gaki baminto, inwe abanyanchete, abwo amaiga andiereire, omogooko one na egutwa yane, tenena bokong’u ase Omonene, abanchi baane. Ogosorora
swahili: Kwa hiyo, ndugu zangu, ninaowapenda na ambao ninawaonea shauku, ninyi mlio furaha yangu na taji yangu, hivi ndivyo iwapasavyo kusimama imara katika Bwana, ninyi wapenzi wangu. Mausia

english: Now I rejoice greatly in the Lord that at last you have revived your concern for me. You were indeed concerned, but you had no opportunity to show it.
ekegusii: Nagokire mono ase Omonene, ekiagera bono ase omoerio mwairanire ase ebirengererio biaino igoro y’okoremerwa kwane; nabo mwarenge kondengereria ritang’ani, korende timwanyora ribaga.
swahili: Nina furaha kubwa katika Bwana kwamba hatimaye mmeanza upya kushughulika tena na maisha yangu. Kweli mmekuwa mkinifikiria lakini mlikuwa hamjapata nafasi ya kufanya hivyo.

english: I am not saying this out of need, for I have learned to be content regardless of my circumstances.
ekegusii: Tari ng’a ngokwana aya ekiagera inde nokoremerwa, naki neorokereirie goisaneka ase engencho ende yonsi inde nero.
swahili: Sisemi hivyo kwa vile nina mahitaji, la! Kwa maana nimejifunza kuridhika katika hali yoyote.

english: I know how to live humbly, and I know how to abound. I am accustomed to any and every situation—to being filled and being hungry, to having plenty and having need.
ekegusii: Namanyire ogokeeigwa, naende namanyire okomenteka; ase engencho yonsi, na ase amang’ana onsi neorokereirie, okoigota na koigwa enchara, okomenteka na okoremerwa.
swahili: Ninajua kupungukiwa, pia ninajua kuwa na vingi. Nimejifunza siri ya kuridhika katika kila hali, wakati wa kushiba na wakati wa kuona njaa, wakati wa kuwa na vingi na wakati wa kupungukiwa.

english: I can do all things through Christ who gives me strength.
ekegusii: Ninyare gokora amang’ana onsi asere oyokombeka chinguru.
swahili: Naweza kuyafanya mambo yote katika yeye anitiaye nguvu.

english: Nevertheless, you have done well to share in my affliction.
ekegusii: Korende mwakorete buya mokabwatana nainche ase emechando yane.
swahili: Lakini, mlifanya vyema kushiriki nami katika taabu zangu.

english: And as you Philippians know, in the early days of the gospel, when I left Macedonia, no church but you partnered with me in the matter of giving and receiving.
ekegusii: Na inwe Abafilipi abanyene mwamanyire ng’a ase omochakano bw’enchiri, ekero naruete Makedonia, ekanisa ende tiyarenge yabwatanete nainche ase amang’ana ’okorua na okonyora, otatiga inwe mweka.
swahili: Zaidi ya hayo, ninyi Wafilipi mnajua kwamba siku za kwanza nilipoanza kuhubiri Injili, nilipoondoka Makedonia, hakuna kanisa jingine lililoshiriki nami katika masuala ya kutoa na kupokea isipokuwa ninyi.

english: For even while I was in Thessalonica, you provided for my needs again and again.
ekegusii: Naki nonya nase Tesaloniki mwandeterete ogokonywa ase okoremerwa kwane ara kabere, tari rimo rioka.
swahili: Kwa maana hata nilipokuwa huko Thesalonike, mliniletea msaada kwa ajili ya mahitaji yangu zaidi ya mara moja.

english: Not that I am seeking a gift, but I am looking for the fruit that may be credited to your account.
ekegusii: Tari ng’a nindigetie ekeegwa keria, korende nigo ndigetie okwama koria gokomenteka koba okonge ase more.
swahili: Si kwamba natafuta sana yale matoleo, bali natafuta sana ile faida itakayozidi sana kwa upande wenu.

english: I have all I need and more, now that I have received your gifts from Epaphroditus. They are a fragrant offering, an acceptable sacrifice, well-pleasing to God.
ekegusii: Korende ninde n’ebinto bionsi, na kobua; naende naichoirwe, ekiagera nanyorire ase okoboko kwa Epafrodito ebiegwa biaruete ase more, bire ogotioka okuya, ekeng’wanso giancheirwe, kegwenerete Nyasae.
swahili: Nimelipwa kikamilifu hata na zaidi; nimetoshelezwa kabisa sasa, kwa kuwa nimepokea kutoka kwa Epafrodito vile vitu mlivyonitumia, sadaka yenye harufu nzuri, dhabihu inayokubalika na ya kumpendeza Mungu.

english: And my God will supply all your needs according to His glorious riches in Christ Jesus.
ekegusii: Na Nyasae one nabaichorerie kera ekimoganetie ase ekerengo ki’obonda bwaye ase obonene ase Kristo Yeso.
swahili: Naye Mungu wangu atawajaza ninyi na kila mnachohitaji kwa kadiri ya utajiri wake katika utukufu ndani ya Kristo Yesu.

english: I urge Euodia and Syntyche to agree with each other in the Lord.
ekegusii: Namosoroire Ewodia, namosoroire na Sintike babe nomoyo oyomo ase Omonene.
swahili: Nawasihi Euodia na Sintike wawe na nia moja katika Bwana.

english: To our God and Father be glory forever and ever. Amen. Final Greetings (Ephesians 6:21–24; 2 Timothy 4:19–22)
ekegusii: Bono Nyasae, Tata oito, abakwe kare na kare. Amina. Amakwania ’ogokoorera
swahili: Mungu wetu aliye Baba yetu apewe utukufu milele na milele. Amen. Salamu Za Mwisho

english: Greet all the saints in Christ Jesus. The brothers who are with me send you greetings.
ekegusii: Monkwanerie kera omochenu ase Kristo Yeso. Abaminto abare amo nainche baabakwanirie.
swahili: Msalimuni kila mtakatifu katika Kristo Yesu. Ndugu walioko pamoja nami wanawasalimu.

english: All the saints send you greetings, especially those from the household of Caesar.
ekegusii: Abachenu bonsi baabakwanirie, mono kobua abwo bare b’enyomba y’omorwoti omonene.
swahili: Watakatifu wote wanawasalimu, hasa wale watu wa nyumbani mwa Kaisari.

english: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit.
ekegusii: Obuya bw’Omonene Yeso Kristo bobe amo nainwe.
swahili: Neema ya Bwana Yesu Kristo iwe pamoja na roho zenu. Amen.

english: Yes, and I ask you, my true yokefellow, to help these women who have labored with me for the gospel, along with Clement and the rest of my fellow workers, whose names are in the Book of Life.
ekegusii: Ee, naye bo, omosaiga bw’ekeene, nakoboririe okonye abakungu abwo bakorete emeremo y’enchiri amo nainche, na Klementi nere, na baria bande bakorete emeremo amo nainche, abwo amarieta abo are ime ase egetabu y’obogima.
swahili: Naam, nakusihi wewe pia, mwenzangu mwaminifu, uwasaidie hawa wanawake, kwa sababu walijitaabisha katika kazi ya Injili pamoja nami bega kwa bega, wakiwa pamoja na Klementi na watendakazi wenzangu ambao majina yao yameandikwa katika kitabu cha uzima.

english: Rejoice in the Lord always. I will say it again: Rejoice!
ekegusii: Goka ase Omonene amatuko onsi; naende natebiire: Goka!
swahili: Furahini katika Bwana siku zote, tena nasema furahini!

english: Let your gentleness be apparent to all. The Lord is near.
ekegusii: Obwororo bwaino bomanyekane ase abanto bonsi. Omonene ng’ang’e are.
swahili: Upole wenu na ujulikane na watu wote. Bwana yu karibu.

english: Be anxious for nothing, but in everything, by prayer and petition, with thanksgiving, present your requests to God.
ekegusii: Timwechandera ing’ana rinde rionsi; korende ase kera ring’ana ase ogosaba na ogosorora amo nokoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono, okorigia kwaino komanyekane ase Nyasae.
swahili: Msijisumbue kwa jambo lolote, bali katika kila jambo kwa kuomba na kusihi pamoja na kushukuru, haja zenu na zijulikane na Mungu.

english: And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your minds in Christ Jesus.
ekegusii: Na omorembe o Nyasae, oyobuete okomanya gwonsi, korende chinkoro chiaino na ebirengererio biaino ase Kristo Yeso.
swahili: Nayo amani ya Mungu, inayopita fahamu zote, itailinda mioyo yenu na nia zenu katika Kristo Yesu.

english: Finally, brothers, whatever is true, whatever is honorable, whatever is right, whatever is pure, whatever is lovely, whatever is admirable—if anything is excellent or praiseworthy—think on these things.
ekegusii: Omoerio baminto, onsi ayare ay’ekeene, onsi ayare ay’ogosika, onsi ayare ay’oboronge, onsi ayare ay’oborabu, onsi ayagwenerete gwanchwa, onsi ayagokwanwa buya; koborabeo obuya bonde bwonsi, gose ogotogigwa, aya onsi yarengererie.
swahili: Hatimaye, ndugu zangu, mambo yote yaliyo ya kweli, yoyote yaliyo na sifa njema, yoyote yaliyo ya haki, yoyote yaliyo safi, yoyote ya kupendeza, yoyote yenye staha, ukiwepo uzuri wowote, pakiwepo chochote kinachostahili kusifiwa, tafakarini mambo hayo.

english: Whatever you have learned or received or heard from me, or seen in me, put it into practice. And the God of peace will be with you. The Generosity of the Philippians (2 Corinthians 8:1–15)
ekegusii: Amang’ana aya mweorokereretie na koyanyora, na koyaigwa, na koyarora korwa ase ’nde, moyakore, na Nyasae bw’omorembe nabe amo nainwe. Omogoko o Paulo ase ekeegwa korwa ase Abafilipi
swahili: Mambo yote mliyojifunza au kuyapokea au kuyasikia kutoka kwangu, au kuyaona kwangu, yatendeni hayo. Naye Mungu wa amani atakuwa pamoja nanyi. Shukrani Kwa Matoleo Yenu

english: The proverbs of Solomon: A wise son brings joy to his father, but a foolish son grief to his mother.
ekegusii: Eye nemebayeno ya Sulemani. Omwana omomura omong’aini nigo akogokia ise, korende oyore omoriri nigo akorentera ng’ina omoichano.
swahili: Mithali za Solomoni: Mwana mwenye hekima huleta furaha kwa baba yake, lakini mwana mpumbavu huleta huzuni kwa mama yake.

english: He who winks the eye causes grief, and foolish lips will come to ruin.
ekegusii: Omonto ogosumera amaiso ase okogenka nigo akorenta emechando, na oyogokwana amang’ana atagwenereti nigo arasirigwe.
swahili: Yeye akonyezaye kwa nia mbaya husababisha huzuni, naye mpumbavu apayukaye huangamia.

english: The mouth of the righteous is a fountain of life, but the mouth of the wicked conceals violence.
ekegusii: Omonwa bw’omonyene oboronge nigo onga buna ensoko y’obogima, korende obochege nigo boichire ase emenwa y’abakori amabe.
swahili: Kinywa cha mwenye haki ni chemchemi ya uzima, lakini jeuri hufunika kinywa cha mwovu.

english: Hatred stirs up dissension, but love covers all transgressions.
ekegusii: Obogechani nigo bokorenta eriomana, korende obwanchani nigo bogotuba ebibe bionsi.
swahili: Chuki huchochea faraka, lakini upendo husitiri mabaya yote.

english: Wisdom is found on the lips of the discerning, but a rod is for the back of him who lacks judgment.
ekegusii: Obong’aini nigo bokonyorekana ase omonwa bw’omonto omomanyi, korende oyo otari n’okomanya nigo agwenerete aakwe enyimbo ase omogongo oye.
swahili: Hekima hupatikana katika midomo ya wenye kupambanua, lakini fimbo ni kwa ajili ya mgongo wake asiye na ufahamu.

english: The wise store up knowledge, but the mouth of the fool invites destruction.
ekegusii: Abanto abang’aini nigo bakogaacha chiseemi, korende omonwa bw’omonto omoriri nigo okorenta ogosirigwa ang’e.
swahili: Wenye hekima huhifadhi maarifa, bali kinywa cha mpumbavu hualika maangamizi.

english: The wealth of the rich man is his fortified city, but poverty is the ruin of the poor.
ekegusii: Obotenenku bw’omonto omonda nigo bore ase are buna omochie ogiteire chindwaki, korende obotaka nabwo ogosirigwa kw’abataka.
swahili: Mali ya tajiri ni mji wake wenye ngome, bali ufukara ni maangamizi ya maskini.

english: The labor of the righteous leads to life, but the gain of the wicked brings punishment.
ekegusii: Okonyora kw’omonyene oboronge nigo gokomoraa gochia ase obogima, korende ebitoki bi’omokori amabe nigo bikomoraa gochia ase ebibe.
swahili: Ujira wa wenye haki huwaletea uzima, lakini mapato ya waovu huwaletea adhabu.

english: Whoever heeds instruction is on the path to life, but he who ignores reproof goes astray.
ekegusii: Omonto okoigwera okorongeigwa nigo akorobera ase enchera y’obogima, korende oyo okwanga korongeigwa nigo agosoa ase obosiru.
swahili: Anayekubali kuadibishwa yuko katika njia ya uzima, lakini yeyote anayepuuza maonyo hupotosha wengine.

english: The one who conceals hatred has lying lips, and whoever spreads slander is a fool.
ekegusii: Omonto obisete okogecha ime yaye nigo agokwana oborimo korwa ase omonwa oye, na oyo ogotaaria obogenki nigo are omoriri.
swahili: Yeye afichaye chuki yake ana midomo ya uongo, na yeyote anayeeneza uchonganishi ni mpumbavu.

english: When words are many, sin is unavoidable, but he who restrains his lips is wise.
ekegusii: Omonto ogokwana amang’ana amaange tari komocha korenta ogosaria, korende oyo orendete omonwa oye nigo are omong’aini.
swahili: Wakati maneno ni mengi, dhambi haikosekani, lakini yeye ambaye huzuia ulimi wake ni mwenye busara.

english: Ill-gotten treasures profit nothing, but righteousness brings deliverance from death.
ekegusii: Chinibo chi’ogokora okobe tichiri gokonya kende, korende oboronge nigo bogotooria korwa ase amakweri.
swahili: Hazina zilizopatikana kwa njia mbaya hazifai, lakini uadilifu huokoa kutoka mautini.

english: The tongue of the righteous is choice silver, but the heart of the wicked has little worth.
ekegusii: Oromeme rw’omonyene oboronge nigo ronga buna efeta echenire korende ebirengererio bi’omokori amabe tibiri na igori rinde.
swahili: Ulimi wa mwenye haki ni fedha iliyo bora, bali moyo wa mwovu una thamani ndogo.

english: The lips of the righteous feed many, but fools die for lack of judgment.
ekegusii: Ebikoba bi’omonyene oboronge nigo bikorenta amaya ase abanto abange, korende oboriri nigo bogoita.
swahili: Midomo ya mwenye haki hulisha wengi, lakini wapumbavu hufa kwa kukosa ufahamu.

english: The blessing of the LORD enriches, and He adds no sorrow to it.
ekegusii: Ogosesenigwa kw’Omonene nakwo gokorenta obotenenku, na ere tari kobeeka obororo ase ogosesenigwa okwo.
swahili: Baraka ya Bwana hutajirisha, wala haichanganyi huzuni.

english: The fool delights in shameful conduct, but a man of understanding has wisdom.
ekegusii: Omonto omoriri nigo agokora ebibe buna egosori, korende omonto ore nokomanya nigo agokora ayare ay’obong’aini.
swahili: Mpumbavu hufurahia tabia mbaya, lakini mtu mwenye ufahamu hupendezwa na hekima.

english: What the wicked man dreads will overtake him, but the desire of the righteous will be granted.
ekegusii: Aria omokori amabe airogete naro akomochera, korende omonyene oboronge ’naikeranerigwe amagania aye.
swahili: Kile anachoogopa mwovu ndicho kitakachompata; kile anachoonea shauku mwenye haki atapewa.

english: When the whirlwind passes, the wicked are no more, but the righteous are secure forever.
ekegusii: Ekero omwaga ekembugu‐mbugu ogoeta, omokori amabe nigo agosirigwa, korende omonyene oboronge nigo agotenena bokong’u kare na kare.
swahili: Tufani inapopita, waovu hutoweka, lakini wenye haki husimama imara milele.

english: Like vinegar to the teeth and smoke to the eyes, so is the slacker to those who send him.
ekegusii: Buna obokang’iti bokoba ase amaino na erioki rikoba ase amaiso, naboigo omonto omworo akoba ase abwo bakomotoma abakorere emeremo.
swahili: Kama siki ilivyo kwa meno na moshi kwa macho, ndivyo alivyo mvivu kwa wale waliomtuma.

english: The fear of the LORD prolongs life, but the years of the wicked will be cut short.
ekegusii: Okomoiroka Omonene nigo gokomenta obomenyo ase obogima, korende emiaka y’omokori amabe nigo ekweng’eigwa.
swahili: Kumcha Bwana huongeza urefu wa maisha, lakini miaka ya mwovu inafupishwa.

english: The hope of the righteous is joy, but the expectations of the wicked will perish.
ekegusii: Ogosemeria kw’abanyene oboronge nigo kogoikeranigwa ase omogooko, korende okw’abakori amabe nokwabosa.
swahili: Tarajio la mwenye haki ni furaha, bali matumaini ya mwovu huwa si kitu.

english: The way of the LORD is a refuge to the upright, but destruction awaits those who do evil.
ekegusii: Enchera y’Omonene nigo ere egekengero egekong’u ase abanyene oboronge, korende nigo ere obosiru ase abanyabibe.
swahili: Njia ya Bwana ni kimbilio kwa wenye haki, lakini ni maangamizi ya wale watendao mabaya.

english: The LORD does not let the righteous go hungry, but He denies the craving of the wicked.
ekegusii: Omonene tari gotiga omonyene oboronge abe nenchara; korende nigo akwanga okogania kw’abakori amabe.
swahili: Bwana hawaachi waadilifu kukaa njaa, lakini hupinga tamaa ya mtu mwovu.

english: The righteous will never be shaken, but the wicked will not inhabit the land.
ekegusii: Omonyene oboronge takonyegerigwa, korende omokori amabe takogeenderera komenya ase ense.
swahili: Kamwe wenye haki hawataondolewa, bali waovu hawatasalia katika nchi.

english: The mouth of the righteous brings forth wisdom, but a perverse tongue will be cut out.
ekegusii: Omonwa bw’omonyene oboronge nigo ogokwana ay’obong’aini, korende oromeme rokong’ainereria ’ndonachwe.
swahili: Kinywa cha mwenye haki hutoa hekima, bali ulimi wa upotovu utakatwa.

english: The lips of the righteous know what is fitting, but the mouth of the wicked is perverse.
ekegusii: Ebikoba bi’omonyene oboronge nigo bimanyete ayagwenerete, korende omonwa bw’omokori amabe nigo ogokwana ay’atagwenereti.
swahili: Midomo ya wenye haki inajua kile kinachofaa, bali kinywa cha mwovu hujua kile kilichopotoka tu.

english: Idle hands make one poor, but diligent hands bring wealth.
ekegusii: Omonto ogokora emeremo n’amaboko amoro nigo akoba omotaka, korende amaboko are nomokia nigo akorenta obotenenku.
swahili: Mikono mivivu hufanya mtu kuwa maskini lakini mikono yenye bidii huleta utajiri.

english: He who gathers in summer is a wise son, but he who sleeps during harvest is a disgraceful son.
ekegusii: Omwana omomura ogosangereria chindagera engaki ye rigesa nigo are omong’aini, korende oyo okorara engaki eyio nigo akorenta obosooku.
swahili: Yeye akusanyaye mazao wakati wa kiangazi ni mwana mwenye hekima, lakini yeye alalaye wakati wa mavuno ni mwana mwenye kuaibisha.

english: Blessings are on the head of the righteous, but the mouth of the wicked conceals violence.
ekegusii: Ogosesenigwa nigo gokobera ase omotwe bw’omonyene oboronge, korende obochege nigo boichire ase emenwa y’abakori amabe.
swahili: Baraka huwa taji kichwani mwa mwenye haki, lakini jeuri hufunika kinywa cha mwovu.

english: The memory of the righteous is a blessing, but the name of the wicked will rot.
ekegusii: Okoinyorwa kw’omonyene oboronge nigo gokorenta ogosesenigwa, korende erieta ri’omokori amabe nigo riragunde.
swahili: Kumbukumbu ya mwenye haki itakuwa baraka, lakini jina la mwovu litaoza.

english: A wise heart will receive commandments, but foolish lips will come to ruin.
ekegusii: Omonto ore omong’aini ase enkoro yaye nigo anchete amachiiko, korende oyogokwana amang’ana atagwenereti nigo arasirigwe.
swahili: Mwenye hekima moyoni hupokea maagizo, lakini mpumbavu apayukaye huangamia.

english: He who walks in integrity walks securely, but he who perverts his ways will be found out.
ekegusii: Omonto okobwatia chiinchera chi’oboronge nigo araarendwe buya, korende oyo okobwatia chiinchera chimbe nigo aramanyekane.
swahili: Mtu mwadilifu hutembea salama, lakini mtu aendaye katika njia zilizopotoka atagunduliwa.

english: Dishonest scales are an abomination to the LORD, but an accurate weight is His delight.
ekegusii: Egepimo ki’oborito ki’oborianania nigo kere okogechia ase Omonene, korende egi’ekeene nigo gekomogokia.
swahili: Bwana huchukia sana mizani za udanganyifu, bali vipimo sahihi ni furaha yake.

english: When the righteous thrive, the city rejoices, and when the wicked perish, there are shouts of joy.
ekegusii: Ekero abanyene oboronge bageendererete koba buya, abanto b’omochie nigo bakogoka, na ekero abakori amabe bagosira nigo bagoaka amariogi y’omochengo.
swahili: Wakati mwenye haki anapofanikiwa, mji hufurahi; mwovu atowekapo, kuna kelele za furaha.

english: By the blessing of the upright a city is built up, but by the mouth of the wicked it is torn down.
ekegusii: Goetera ase ogosesenia kw’abanyene oboronge omochie nigo okoimokererigwa igoro, korende goetera ase chinkwana chi’abakori amabe nigo okoiyerigwa.
swahili: Kutokana na baraka ya mtu mnyofu mji hukwezwa, bali kwa kinywa cha mwovu mji huharibiwa.

english: Whoever shows contempt for his neighbor lacks judgment, but a man of understanding remains silent.
ekegusii: Omonto ogochaaya omonto onde, oyio nigo aborire obong’aini, korende omonto omong’aini nigo agokira‐kiri.
swahili: Mtu asiye na akili humdharau jirani yake, bali mtu mwenye ufahamu huuzuia ulimi wake.

english: A gossip reveals a secret, but a trustworthy person keeps a confidence.
ekegusii: Omonto okona‐goeta‐etia obogenki nigo akoorokia obobisi, korende oyobwate omoika bw’obwegenwa tari koorokia obobisi.
swahili: Masengenyo husaliti tumaini, bali mtu mwaminifu hutunza siri.

english: For lack of guidance, a nation falls, but with many counselors comes deliverance.
ekegusii: Ase ogoseemia okuya gotari, egesaku nigo gekogwa, korende ase abasemia abange abaya bare, oborendi obuya ’mboreo.
swahili: Pasipo ushauri wa hekima taifa huanguka, bali washauri wengi hufanya ushindi uwe wa hakika.

english: He who puts up security for a stranger will surely suffer, but the one who hates indebtedness is secure.
ekegusii: Omonto okwerua koba intenenera ase omonto omoao nigo agwesoyia ase emechando, korende oyo okwanga koba intenenera nigo erendete buya.
swahili: Yeye amdhaminiye mgeni hakika atateseka, bali yeyote akataaye kuunga mkono dhamana ni salama.

english: A gracious woman attains honor, but ruthless men gain only wealth.
ekegusii: Omokungu omwesiki nigo akogeenderera gosikwa botambe. Abanto abatindi nabwo bakobogoria chinibo ase chinguru.
swahili: Mwanamke mwenye moyo wa huruma hupata heshima, bali wanaume wakorofi hupata mali tu.

english: A kind man benefits himself, but a cruel man brings trouble on himself.
ekegusii: Omonto ore n’amaabera nigo akwerentera amaya, korende omonto omotindi nigo agwechaanda ere omonyene.
swahili: Mwenye huruma hujinufaisha mwenyewe, bali mkatili hujiletea taabu mwenyewe.

english: The wicked man earns an empty wage, but he who sows righteousness reaps a true reward.
ekegusii: Omokori amabe nigo akwenyorera eng’eria y’oborianania, korende oyo ogosimeka oboronge nigo akwenyorera eng’eria y’ekeene.
swahili: Mtu mwovu hupata ujira wa udanganyifu, bali yeye apandaye haki huvuna tuzo ya uhakika.

english: Genuine righteousness leads to life, but the pursuit of evil brings death.
ekegusii: Omonto ore omwegenwa, ase oboronge bwaye nabe moyo, korende oyo okorigia obobe na kobobwatia nakwe.
swahili: Mtu mwenye haki kweli kweli hupata uzima, bali yeye afuatiliaye ubaya huendea kifo chake.

english: When pride comes, disgrace follows, but with humility comes wisdom.
