ekegusii: Ekero oboenenu bwachire, nobosooku nario bogocha, korende obong’aini nigo bokonyorekana ase abanto abaitongo.
swahili: Kiburi kinapokuja, ndipo huja aibu, bali unyenyekevu huja na hekima.

english: The perverse in heart are an abomination to the LORD, but the blameless in their walk are His delight.
ekegusii: Abanto abakorekanu ase chinkoro chiabo nigo bare okogechia ase Omonene, korende abare n’orogendo ororonge nigo bakomogokia.
swahili: Bwana huwachukia sana watu wenye moyo wa upotovu, bali hupendezwa na wale ambao njia zao hazina lawama.

english: Be assured that the wicked will not go unpunished, but the offspring of the righteous will escape.
ekegusii: Ekeene, Omonto omobe goika anyore egesusuro, korende oroiboro rw’abanyene oboronge ’ndotoorigwe.
swahili: Uwe na hakika na hili: Waovu hawataepuka kuadhibiwa, bali wenye haki watakuwa huru.

english: Like a gold ring in a pig’s snout is a beautiful woman who lacks discretion.
ekegusii: Omokungu omonyakieni otari nechiseemi nigo anga buna ebonyi y’etaabu ere ase chimioro chi’embeche.
swahili: Kama pete ya dhahabu katika pua ya nguruwe ndivyo alivyo mwanamke mzuri ambaye hana busara.

english: The desire of the righteous leads only to good, but the hope of the wicked brings wrath.
ekegusii: Okogania kw’abanyene oboronge nigo gokorenta amaya, korende okw’abakori amabe nigo gokobarentera egesusuro.
swahili: Shauku ya mwenye haki huishia tu kwenye mema, bali tumaini la mwovu huishia tu kwenye ghadhabu.

english: One gives freely, yet gains even more; another withholds what is right, only to become poor.
ekegusii: Ere omonto okorua ebinto ebinge, nigo akomenteranigwa ebinge goetania, na nere oria omogooko otari korua, nigo akogeenderera kona‐koremerwa.
swahili: Kuna mtu atoaye kwa ukarimu, hata hivyo hupata zaidi, mwingine huzuia, lakini huwa maskini.

english: A generous soul will prosper, and he who refreshes others will himself be refreshed.
ekegusii: Omonto okorua n’omoyo bw’ogwancha natenenkigwe; nere oyokorua amaache agokendia erang’o, nere boigo ’naegwe amaache agokendia erang’o yaye.
swahili: Mtu mkarimu atastawi; yeye awaburudishaye wengine ataburudishwa mwenyewe.

english: The people will curse the hoarder of grain, but blessing will crown the one who sells it.
ekegusii: Omonto oria okwegimeria endagera ase obong’iti, nigo akoragererigwa nabaanto, korende ogosesenigwa nigo kore igoro ase omotwe bw’oria okoyeoonia.
swahili: Watu humlaani mtu awanyimae watu nafaka, bali baraka itamkalia kichwani kama taji yeye aliye radhi kuiuza.

english: He who searches out good finds favor, but evil will come to him who seeks it.
ekegusii: Omonto ogokora omokia korigia ayare amaya, oyio nigo akonyora ayare amaya, korende oyokorigia ay’obobe, obobe nigo bokomonyoora.
swahili: Yeye atafutaye mema hupata ukarimu, bali ubaya huja kwake yeye autafutaye.

english: He who trusts in his riches will fall, but the righteous will thrive like foliage.
ekegusii: Omonto osemeretie chinibo chiaye nigo aragwe, korende abanyene oboronge ’mbareerete buna amato amarere y’emete.
swahili: Yeyote ategemeaye utajiri wake ataanguka, bali mwenye haki atastawi kama jani bichi.

english: He who brings trouble on his house will inherit the wind, and the fool will be servant to the wise of heart.
ekegusii: Omonto okorenta emechando ase enyomba yaye nigo aranyore ayare buna embeo bosa; oyore omoriri nigo arabe omosomba bw’omonto omong’aini.
swahili: Yeye aletaye taabu kwa jamaa yake atarithi tu upepo, naye mpumbavu atakuwa mtumishi wa wenye hekima.

english: The integrity of the upright guides them, but the perversity of the faithless destroys them.
ekegusii: Obwegenwa bw’abanyene oboronge nigo bokobaraa, korende obokorekanu bw’abatari abegenwa nigo bokobasiria.
swahili: Uadilifu wa wenye haki huwaongoza, bali wasio waaminifu huharibiwa na hila yao.

english: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life, and he who wins souls is wise.
ekegusii: Okwama kw’omonyaboronge nigo kore omote bw’obogima, nere oyokong’usa emioyo y’abanto n’omonto omong’aini.
swahili: Tunda la mwenye haki ni mti wa uzima, naye mwenye hekima huvuta roho za watu.

english: If the righteous receive their due on earth, how much more the ungodly and the sinner!
ekegusii: Onye omonyene oboronge okonyora eng’eria yaye aiga ase ense, Inee, omokori amabe na omonyabibe, abwo tibakoegwa eng’eria yabo goetania?
swahili: Kama wenye haki watapokea ujira wao duniani, si zaidi sana yule asiyemcha Mungu na mwenye dhambi?

english: Riches are worthless in the day of wrath, but righteousness brings deliverance from death.
ekegusii: Chinibo tichiri gokonya kende ase rituko ri’endamwamu, korende oboronge nigo boratoorie korwa ase amakweri.
swahili: Utajiri haufaidi kitu katika siku ya ghadhabu, bali haki huokoa kutoka mautini.

english: The righteousness of the blameless directs their path, but the wicked fall by their own wickedness.
ekegusii: Oboronge bw’omonto omoikeranu nigo borarongeyie chiinchera chiaye, korende omokori amabe, obobe bwaye ’mbomoiyerie.
swahili: Haki ya wasio na lawama, huwatengenezea njia iliyonyooka, bali waovu huangushwa kwa uovu wao wenyewe.

english: The righteousness of the upright delivers them, but the faithless are trapped by their own desires.
ekegusii: Oboronge bw’abaanto bare ne chinkoro chindonge mbobatoorie, korende abasaria nigo barabwatwe n’okogania kwabo okobe.
swahili: Haki ya wanyofu huwaokoa, bali wasio waaminifu hunaswa na tamaa mbaya.

english: When the wicked man dies, his hope perishes, and the hope of his strength vanishes.
ekegusii: Ekero omokori amabe agokwa, ogosemeria kwaye nigo kogokwa amo nere, ee, aya abwo batamoirogeti Nyasae basemeretie nigo agosira.
swahili: Wakati mtu mwovu anapokufa, matumaini yake hutoweka; yote aliyoyatazamia kutokana na nguvu zake huwa si kitu.

english: The righteous man is delivered from trouble; in his place the wicked man goes in.
ekegusii: Omonyene oboronge nigo akorusigwa ase emechando, erio omokori amabe osoa ase emechando ribaga riaye.
swahili: Mtu mwenye haki huokolewa kutoka taabu, naye mtu mwovu huingia humo badala yake.

english: With his mouth the ungodly man destroys his neighbor, but through knowledge the righteous are rescued.
ekegusii: Oyo otamoirogeti Nyasae nigo agosiria abanto bande n’amang’ana agokwana korwa ase omonwa oye, korende goetera ase obong’aini abanyene oboronge ’mbatoorigwe.
swahili: Kwa kinywa chake mtu asiyemwamini Mungu humwangamiza jirani yake, bali kwa maarifa mwenye haki huokolewa.

english: Whoever loves discipline loves knowledge, but he who hates correction is stupid.
ekegusii: Onde bwensi bwanchete amorokererio yokomoorongeyia, oyio nigo anchete chiseemi, korende oyo ogechete ogokuurerwa n’omoriri.
swahili: Yeyote apendaye kuadibishwa hupenda maarifa, bali yeye achukiaye kuonywa ni mpumbavu.

english: A righteous man regards the life of his animal, but the tender mercies of the wicked are only cruelty.
ekegusii: Omonyene oboronge nigo agochaandekera nonya n’obogima bwe chitugo chiaye, korende oboseera bw’enkoro y’omokori amabe nigo bore ase ogotogonya.
swahili: Mtu mwenye haki hujali mahitaji ya mnyama wake, bali matendo ya huruma ya mwovu ni ukatili.

english: The one who works his land will have plenty of food, but whoever chases fantasies lacks judgment.
ekegusii: Omonto ogokora emeremo ase omogondo oye ’natware ebinge akoria, korende oyo ogotunyana amang’ana atagwenereti, ere ’mbosa.
swahili: Yeye alimaye shamba lake atakuwa na chakula tele, bali yeye afuataye mambo ya upuzi hana akili.

english: The wicked desire the plunder of evil men, but the root of the righteous flourishes.
ekegusii: Omokori amabe nigo akogania ebionga bi’abaanto ababe, korende omori bw’omonyene oboronge nigo ogoseboka bwama.
swahili: Waovu hutamani mateka ya watu wabaya, bali shina la mwenye haki hustawi.

english: An evil man is trapped by his rebellious speech, but a righteous man escapes from trouble.
ekegusii: Omonto omobe nigo agotegwa n’ogosaria gokorwa ase ebikoba biaye, korende omonyene oboronge natooreke korwa ase emechando.
swahili: Mtu mwovu hunaswa kwa mazungumzo yake ya dhambi, bali mwenye haki huepuka taabu.

english: By fruitful speech a man is filled with good things, and the work of his hands returns to him.
ekegusii: Okwama kw’amang’ana y’omonto agokwana nigo gokomorentera amaya akomoisanekia, na emeremo y’amaboko ’omonto nigo ekomoiranera.
swahili: Kutokana na tunda la midomo yake mtu hujazwa na mambo mema, hakika kama ilivyo kazi ya mikono yake humtunza.

english: The way of a fool is right in his own eyes, but a wise man listens to counsel.
ekegusii: Enchera y’omonto omoriri nigo ekororekana ase amaiso aye ng’a nendonge, korende omonto omong’aini nigo akoigwera ogoseemigwa.
swahili: Njia ya mpumbavu huonekana sawa machoni pake mwenyewe, bali mtu mwenye hekima husikiliza ushauri.

english: A fool’s anger is known at once, but a prudent man overlooks an insult.
ekegusii: Okobeea kw’omonto omoriri nigo gokomanyekana rimo rioka, korende omonto omong’aini nigo akoombia otuba obobe.
swahili: Mpumbavu huonyesha kuudhika kwake mara moja, bali mtu wa busara hupuuza matukano.

english: He who speaks the truth declares what is right, but a false witness speaks deceit.
ekegusii: Omonto bwanchete gokwana ekeene nigo akoorokia oboronge, korende kirori bw’oborimo nigo agokwana obong’ainereria.
swahili: Shahidi wa kweli hutoa ushuhuda wa kuaminika, bali shahidi wa uongo husema uongo.

english: Speaking rashly is like a piercing sword, but the tongue of the wise brings healing.
ekegusii: Amang’ana omonto otari korengereria agokwana, nigo anga buna omoro ogokeba, korende oromeme rw’omonto omong’aini nigo rokorenta amang’ana akogwenia.
swahili: Maneno ya kipumbavu huchoma kama upanga, bali ulimi wa mwenye hekima huleta uponyaji.

english: Truthful lips endure forever, but a lying tongue lasts only a moment.
ekegusii: Ebikoba bigokwana ekeene ’mbigeenderere kobao botambe, korende oromeme rogokwana oborimo nigo rokobao ase engaki enke yoka.
swahili: Midomo isemayo kweli hudumu milele, bali ulimi wa uongo hudumu kwa muda mfupi tu.

english: The good man obtains favor from the LORD, but the LORD condemns a man who devises evil.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo akomonyoorera monto omuya ogwancherwa, korende omonachera ekiina oyogokora emeroberio y’obobe.
swahili: Mtu mwema hupata kibali kutoka kwa Bwana, bali Bwana humhukumu mwenye hila.

english: Deceit is in the hearts of those who devise evil, but the counselors of peace have joy.
ekegusii: Obong’ainereria nigo bore ase chinkoro chi’abwo bakoroberia amabe, korende abwo bakoroberia ay’omorembe nigo bakogera omogooko oba.
swahili: Upo udanganyifu katika mioyo ya wale ambao hupanga mabaya, bali kuna furaha kwa wale wanaoleta amani.

english: No harm befalls the righteous, but the wicked are filled with trouble.
ekegusii: Amabe takobanyora abanyene oboronge, korende abakori amabe ’mbanyorwe n’amabe amaange.
swahili: Hakuna dhara linalompata mwenye haki, bali waovu wana taabu nyingi.

english: Lying lips are detestable to the LORD, but those who deal faithfully are His delight.
ekegusii: Ebikoba bigokwana oborimo nigo bire okogechia ase Omonene, korende abare abegenwa ase ogokora kwabo nigo bakomogokia.
swahili: Bwana anachukia sana midomo idanganyayo, bali hufurahia watu ambao ni wa kweli.

english: A shrewd man keeps his knowledge to himself, but a foolish heart proclaims its folly.
ekegusii: Omonto omong’aini nigo akobisa ay’amanyete, korende abariri nigo bakoraria oboriri korwa ase chinkoro chiabo.
swahili: Mtu mwenye busara hujihifadhia maarifa yeye mwenyewe, bali moyo wa wapumbavu hububujika upumbavu.

english: The hand of the diligent will rule, but laziness ends in forced labor.
ekegusii: Okoboko kw’omonto omonyamokia ’nkogambe, korende oyore omworo nabetererigwe akore emeremo y’obosomba.
swahili: Mikono yenye bidii itatawala, bali uvivu huishia katika kazi za utumwa.

english: Anxiety weighs down the heart of a man, but a good word cheers it up.
ekegusii: Ogoichana kore ase enkoro y’omonto nigo gokomoiyeria, korende ring’ana rigiya nigo rikomorentera omogooko.
swahili: Moyo wa wasiwasi humlemea mtu, bali neno la huruma humfurahisha.

english: A righteous man is cautious in friendship, but the ways of the wicked lead them astray.
ekegusii: Omonyene oboronge nigo are omoraai omuya bw’omogisangio oye, korende chiinchera chi’abakori amabe nigo chikobatang’ana chiabasiria.
swahili: Mtu mwenye haki ni mwangalifu katika urafiki, bali njia ya waovu huwapotosha.

english: A lazy man does not roast his game, but a diligent man prizes his possession.
ekegusii: Omonto omworo tari koiyeka nonya n’eki arusirie ase orotwari rw’aye, korende omonyamokia nigo akoyerioseria enibo yaye rigori rekerengo ekenene.
swahili: Mtu mvivu haoki mawindo yake, bali mtu mwenye bidii ana mali za thamani.

english: There is life in the path of righteousness, but another path leads to death.
ekegusii: Ase enchera y’oboronge obogima ’mboreo, na amakweri tari gotooka ase boeto obwo.
swahili: Katika njia ya haki kuna uzima; katika mapito hayo kuna maisha ya milele.

english: A man cannot be established through wickedness, but the righteous cannot be uprooted.
ekegusii: Ogotamoiroka Nyasae tigokoagaacha omonto na komokong’ia, korende omori bw’omonyaboronge tokonyegerigwa.
swahili: Mtu hathibitiki kutokana na uovu, bali mwenye haki hataondolewa.

english: A wife of noble character is her husband’s crown, but she who causes shame is like decay in his bones.
ekegusii: Omokungu omuya nigo are eguutwa y’omosaacha oye, korende omokungu okorenta obosooku nigo are buna oboguundo ase amauga y’omosaacha oye.
swahili: Mke mwenye tabia nzuri ni taji ya mumewe, bali aaibishaye ni kama uozo katika mifupa ya mumewe.

english: The plans of the righteous are just, but the counsel of the wicked leads to deceit.
ekegusii: Ebirengererio bi’omonyene oboronge nigo bire ebi’ekeene, korende ogoseemia kw’abakori amabe nigo kore okw’obong’ainereria.
swahili: Mipango ya mtu mwadilifu ni ya haki, bali ushauri wa mwovu ni udanganyifu.

english: The words of the wicked lie in wait for blood, but the speech of the upright rescues them.
ekegusii: Amang’ana yabakori amabe nigo akoboera na goitera amanyinga, korende aria abanyene oboronge bagokwana nigo agotooria abanto.
swahili: Maneno ya waovu huotea kumwaga damu, bali maneno ya waadilifu huwaokoa.

english: The wicked are overthrown and perish, but the house of the righteous will stand.
ekegusii: Abakori amabe nigo bakoiyerigwa basira kegima, korende enyomba y’omonyene oboronge ’nemenye na gotenena.
swahili: Watu waovu huondolewa na kutoweka, bali nyumba ya mwenye haki husimama imara.

english: A man is praised according to his wisdom, but a twisted mind is despised.
ekegusii: Omonto nigo agotogigwa buna obong’aini bwaye bore, korende oyore nebirengererio ebikorekanu nigo agochaaywa.
swahili: Mtu husifiwa kulingana na hekima yake, bali watu wenye akili zilizopotoka hudharauliwa.

english: Better to be lightly esteemed yet have a servant, than to be self-important but lack food.
ekegusii: Omonto omoitongo ogwekorera emeremo yaye omonyene nigo are omuya kobua omonto ogwekora koba omonene, korende tabwati endagera.
swahili: Heri mtu wa hali ya chini mwenye mtumishi, kuliko kujifanya mtu wa hali ya juu nawe huna chakula.

english: A wise son heeds his father’s discipline, but a mocker does not listen to rebuke.
ekegusii: Omwana omong’aini nigo akoigwera amorokererio a ise, korende oyore omochaayi tari gwancha ogokuurerwa.
swahili: Mwana mwenye hekima husikia mafundisho ya babaye, bali mwenye dharau hasikilizi maonyo.

english: Arrogance leads only to strife, but wisdom is with the well-advised.
ekegusii: Oboenenu nigo bokorenta okoamererania, korende baria bakoigwera ogoseemigwa nigo bakoba n’obong’aini.
swahili: Kiburi huzalisha magomvi tu, bali hekima hupatikana kwa wale wanaozingatia ushauri.

english: Dishonest wealth will dwindle, but what is earned through hard work will be multiplied.
ekegusii: Enibo enyorire ase obwango ase enchera y’obobe nigo egosira, korende ey’ekonyorekana ase okoyekorera emeremo ’nementekane.
swahili: Fedha isiyo ya halali hupungua, bali yeye akusanyaye fedha kidogo kidogo huongezeka.

english: Hope deferred makes the heart sick, but desire fulfilled is a tree of life.
ekegusii: Egesemeirie kogiatebanire nigo gekogera enkoro yarwara, korende ogosemeria kogwaikeraniigwe nigo kore omote bw’obogima.
swahili: Kilichotarajiwa kikikawia kuja moyo huugua, bali tumaini lililotimizwa ni mti wa uzima.

english: He who despises instruction will pay the penalty, but the one who respects a command will be rewarded.
ekegusii: Omonto ogochaaya Ring’ana nigo arasirigwe narirorio, korende oyokoiroka ogochika nanyore eng’eria y’obuya.
swahili: Yeye anayedharau mafundisho anajiletea maangamizi, bali yeye anayeheshimu agizo hupewa tuzo.

english: The teaching of the wise is a fountain of life, turning one from the snares of death.
ekegusii: Amorokererio y’omonto omong’aini nigo are ensoko y’obogima, ekiagera nigo agokoonya omonto tabwatwa n’omotego bw’amakweri.
swahili: Mafundisho ya mwenye busara ni chemchemi ya uzima, ili kumwepusha mtu na mitego ya mauti.

english: Good understanding wins favor, but the way of the faithless is difficult.
ekegusii: Okomanya okuya nigo gokorenta ogwancherwa, korende enchera y’abatari abegenwa nigo ekoraa gochia ase obosiru.
swahili: Ufahamu mzuri hupata upendeleo, bali njia ya asiye mwaminifu ni ngumu.

english: Every prudent man acts with knowledge, but a fool displays his folly.
ekegusii: Omonto omong’aini nigo agokora emeremo yaye ne chiseemi, korende omonto omoriri nigo akoraria oboriri bwaye.
swahili: Kila mwenye busara hutenda kwa maarifa, bali mpumbavu hudhihirisha upumbavu wake.

english: A wicked messenger falls into trouble, but a faithful envoy brings healing.
ekegusii: Omotomwa otari omwegenwa nigo akogwa ase emechando, korende oyore omwegenwa nigo akogwenia.
swahili: Mjumbe mwovu huanguka kwenye taabu, bali mjumbe mwaminifu huleta uponyaji.

english: Poverty and shame come to him who ignores discipline, but whoever heeds correction is honored.
ekegusii: Omonto okwanga koigwera amorokererio akomoorongeyia, obotaka na obosooku nigo biramonyore, korende oyokoigwera ogokuurerwa nanyore amasikani.
swahili: Yeye anayedharau maonyo hupata umaskini na aibu, bali yeye anayekubali maonyo huheshimiwa.

english: Desire fulfilled is sweet to the soul, but turning from evil is detestable to fools.
ekegusii: Okogania gwaikeranigwe nigo kore ogwansu ase omoyo, korende okoonchoka gotiga amabe, okwo nigo kore okogechigwa ase abariri.
swahili: Tarajio lililotimizwa ni tamu kwa nafsi, bali wapumbavu huchukia sana kuacha ubaya.

english: From the fruit of his lips a man enjoys good things, but the desire of the faithless is violence.
ekegusii: Okwama kw’amang’ana omonto agokwana nigo gokomorentera amaya, korende okogania kw’abatari abegenwa nigo gokorigia obotindi.
swahili: Kutoka tunda la midomo yake mtu hufurahia mambo mema, bali wasio waaminifu wanatamani sana jeuri.

english: He who walks with the wise will become wise, but the companion of fools will be destroyed.
ekegusii: Omonto ogotaara n’abanto abang’aini nigo arabe omong’aini, korende oyo ogosanga nabariri nanyorwe n’amabe.
swahili: Yeye atembeaye na mwenye hekima atapata hekima, bali rafiki wa mpumbavu hupata madhara.

english: Disaster pursues sinners, but prosperity is the reward of the righteous.
ekegusii: Amang’ana amabe nigo agotunyana abanyene ebibe, korende abanyene oboronge ’nabaegwe amaya.
swahili: Balaa humwandama mtenda dhambi, bali mafanikio ni thawabu kwa mwenye haki.

english: A good man leaves an inheritance to his children’s children, but the sinner’s wealth is passed to the righteous.
ekegusii: Omonto omuya nigo agotiga omwando ase abana baye, na ase abachokoro baye, korende obotenenku bw’abanyene ebibe nigo bogacheire abanyene oboronge.
swahili: Mtu mwema huwaachia wana wa wanawe urithi, bali mali ya wenye dhambi imehifadhiwa kwa ajili ya wenye haki.

english: Abundant food is in the fallow ground of the poor, but without justice it is swept away.
ekegusii: Oboremo oboyia bw’omonto omotaka nigo bokwama endagera enyinge, korende ase engencho y’obobe, enyinge yasiara‐siarerwa yasira.
swahili: Shamba la mtu maskini laweza kuzalisha chakula kingi, bali dhuluma hukifutilia mbali.

english: He who spares the rod hates his son, but he who loves him disciplines him diligently.
ekegusii: Omonto okorina omwana oye ekeranya nigo amogechete, korende oy’omwanchete tari goteebana komoorongeyia.
swahili: Yeye aizuiaye fimbo yake hampendi mwanawe, bali yeye ampendaye huwa mwangalifu kumwadibisha.

english: A righteous man eats to his heart’s content, but the stomach of the wicked is empty.
ekegusii: Omonyene oboronge nigo abwate endagera ekomoisanekia, korende enda y’omokori amabe nigo egotigara n’okogania.
swahili: Mwenye haki hula mpaka akaridhisha moyo wake, bali tumbo la mwovu hutaabika kwa njaa.

english: He who guards his mouth protects his life, but the one who opens his lips invites his own ruin.
ekegusii: Omonto orendete omonwa oye, oyio nigo arendete obogima bwaye, korende oyogokwana amang’ana ateriteti, goika asoe ase obosiru.
swahili: Yeye alindaye midomo yake hulinda nafsi yake, bali yeye asemaye kwa haraka ataangamia.

english: The slacker craves yet has nothing, but the soul of the diligent is fully satisfied.
ekegusii: Omonto omworo nigo agosanera ebinto, korende takonyora kende, ere o’yore omonyamokia nigo akonyora amagania aye onsi.
swahili: Mvivu hutamani sana na hapati kitu, bali nafsi ya mwenye bidii hutoshelezwa kikamilifu.

english: The righteous hate falsehood, but the wicked bring shame and disgrace.
ekegusii: Omonyene oboronge nigo ageechete oborimo, korende omokori amabe nigo agokora echaayo n’obosooku.
swahili: Mwenye haki huchukia uongo, bali waovu huleta aibu na fedheha.

english: Righteousness guards the man of integrity, but wickedness undermines the sinner.
ekegusii: Oboronge nigo bokorenda omonto omosike, korende ebibe nigo bikomosiria omokori amabe.
swahili: Haki humlinda mtu mwadilifu, bali uovu humwangusha mwenye dhambi.

english: One pretends to be rich, but has nothing; another pretends to be poor, yet has great wealth.
ekegusii: Omonto nare ogwekora ng’a n’omonda are, korende nigo are omotaka, na oyonde bwekora ng’a nomotaka are, korende nigo are omonda mono.
swahili: Mtu mmoja hujifanya tajiri, kumbe hana chochote; mwingine hujifanya maskini, kumbe ana utajiri mwingi.

english: Riches may ransom a man’s life, but a poor man hears no threat.
ekegusii: Chinibo nachio chikobooria obogima bw’omonto omonda, korende omonto omotaka tari n’onde okomogosa.
swahili: Utajiri wa mtu waweza kukomboa maisha yake, bali mtu maskini hasikii kitisho.

english: The light of the righteous shines brightly, but the lamp of the wicked is extinguished.
ekegusii: Oborabu bw’abanyene oboronge nigo bokomoreka n’omogooko, korende etaya y’abakori amabe nigo enga ekebeya gekorima.
swahili: Nuru ya mwenye haki hungʼaa sana, bali taa ya mwovu itazimwa.

english: Every wise woman builds her house, but a foolish one tears it down with her own hands.
ekegusii: Omokungu omong’aini nigo akoagaacha mwaye, korende oyore omoriri nigo agotagora mwaye na maboko aye omonyene.
swahili: Mwanamke mwenye hekima huijenga nyumba yake, bali mpumbavu huibomoa nyumba yake kwa mikono yake mwenyewe.

english: The heart knows its own bitterness, and no stranger shares in its joy.
ekegusii: Enkoro enyene nigo emanyete obororo bwaye, na omonto omoao takonyaara gosanga ase omogooko bw’enkoro eyio.
swahili: Kila moyo hujua uchungu wake wenyewe, wala hakuna yeyote awezaye kushiriki furaha yake.

english: The house of the wicked will be destroyed, but the tent of the upright will flourish.
ekegusii: Enyomba y’omokori amabe ’nesirigwe, korende ekegutu ki’omonyene oboronge ’nkegeenderere gosesenigwa.
swahili: Nyumba ya mwovu itaangamizwa, bali hema la mnyofu litastawi.

english: There is a way that seems right to a man, but its end is the way of death.
ekegusii: Enchera nere ekororekana ase omonto ng’a nendonge, korende omoerio bw’enchera eyio namakweri.
swahili: Iko njia ionekanayo kuwa sawa kwa mtu, bali mwisho wake huelekeza mautini.

english: Even in laughter the heart may ache, and joy may end in sorrow.
ekegusii: Nonya omonto ogoseka, enkoro yaye nabo eranyaare koba nomoichano, na omoerio bw’omogooko oyio nobororo.
swahili: Hata katika kicheko moyo waweza kuuma, nayo furaha yaweza kuishia katika majonzi.

english: The backslider in heart receives the fill of his own ways, but a good man is rewarded for his ways.
ekegusii: Omonto ogure korwa ase okwegena kwaye, nabo araisaneke nechiinchera chiaye omonyene, na omonto omuya nigo agoisanekigwa n’omoyo oye.
swahili: Wasio na imani watapatilizwa kikamilifu kwa ajili ya njia zao, naye mtu mwema atapewa thawabu kwa ajili ya njia yake.

english: The simple man believes every word, but the prudent man watches his steps.
ekegusii: Omonto otamanyeti amaange nigo akwegena kera ring’ana, korende omong’aini nigo agoitona aase agochia.
swahili: Mtu mjinga huamini kila kitu, bali mwenye busara hufikiria hatua zake.

english: A wise man fears and turns from evil, but a fool is careless and reckless.
ekegusii: Omonto omong’aini nigo akwoboa na kwerenda korwa ase amabe, korende omoriri nigo akoba omoremu ase ogokora amabe.
swahili: Mtu mwenye hekima humcha Bwana na kuepuka mabaya, bali mpumbavu hukasirika kwa hamaki na uzembe.

english: A quick-tempered man acts foolishly, and a devious man is hated.
ekegusii: Omonto okogechigwa bwango nigo agokora ay’oboriri, na omonto okoroberia ay’obobe nigo akogechwa.
swahili: Mtu anayekasirika kwa haraka hufanya mambo ya upumbavu, naye mtu wa hila huchukiwa.

english: The simple inherit folly, but the prudent are crowned with knowledge.
ekegusii: Abatamanyeti amaange, oboriri nigo bokoba omwando obo, korende abare nokomanya nigo bakoegwa chiseemi chiaba eguutwa yabo.
swahili: Mjinga hurithi upumbavu, bali wenye busara huvikwa maarifa kichwani kama taji.

english: The evil bow before the good, and the wicked at the gates of the righteous.
ekegusii: Abanto ababe goika bekumbe ase amasio y’abanto abaya, na abakori amabe bekumbe ase ebiita bi’abanyene oboronge.
swahili: Watu wabaya watasujudu mbele ya watu wema, nao waovu kwenye malango ya wenye haki.

english: He who walks in uprightness fears the LORD, but the one who is devious in his ways despises Him.
ekegusii: Omonto omoirogete Omonene nigo akobwatia enchera y’oboronge, korende oyo omochaayete nigo are omokorekanu ase chiinchera chiaye.
swahili: Yeye ambaye njia zake ni nyofu humcha Bwana, bali yeye ambaye njia zake zimepotoka humdharau Mungu.

english: The poor man is hated even by his neighbor, but many are those who love the rich.
ekegusii: Omonto omotaka nigo agechire nonya nase abanto bamwabo, korende omonda nigo abwate abasani abange.
swahili: Maskini huepukwa hata na majirani zao, bali matajiri wana marafiki wengi.

english: He who despises his neighbor sins, but blessed is he who shows kindness to the poor.
ekegusii: Omonto ogochaaya omonto onde nigo agokora ebibe, korende oyokororera abachaandegete amaabera ’nasesenigwe.
swahili: Yeye anayemdharau jirani yake hutenda dhambi, bali amebarikiwa yeye aliye na huruma kwa mhitaji.

english: Do not those who contrive evil go astray? But those who plan goodness find loving devotion and faithfulness.
ekegusii: Inee! Abwo bakoroberia ayare amabe tibari gosira? Na abwo bakoroberia amaya, Inee, tibari konyora amaabera na ekeene?
swahili: Je, wale wanaopanga ubaya hawapotoki? Bali wale wanaopanga kilicho chema hupata upendo na uaminifu.

english: There is profit in all labor, but mere talk leads only to poverty.
ekegusii: Emeremo ende yonsi egokorwa nigo ekorenta ebitoki, korende amang’ana amasa agokwanwa nigo gokorenta obotaka.
swahili: Kazi zote zinazofanywa kwa bidii huleta faida, bali mazungumzo matupu huelekea umaskini tu.

english: The crown of the wise is their wealth, but the effort of fools is folly.
ekegusii: Eguutwa y’abanto abang’aini n’obonda bwabo, korende oboriri bwoka nabwo okonyora kwa abanto abariri.
swahili: Utajiri wa wenye hekima ni taji yao, bali upumbavu wa wapumbavu huzaa upumbavu.

english: A truthful witness saves lives, but one who utters lies is deceitful.
ekegusii: Kirori ogokwana ekeene nigo agotooria obogima, korende oy’ogokwana oborimo nigo akorwa abande.
swahili: Shahidi wa kweli huokoa maisha, bali shahidi wa uongo ni mdanganyifu.

english: He who fears the LORD is secure in confidence, and his children shall have a place of refuge.
ekegusii: Oyo okomoiroka Omonene nigo are n’ogosemeria gw’okorendwa bokong’u, na abana baye ’mbanyore aase bagotamera.
swahili: Yeye amchaye Bwana ana ngome salama, na kwa watoto wake itakuwa kimbilio.

english: The fear of the LORD is a fountain of life, turning a man from the snares of death.
ekegusii: Okomoiroka Omonene nakwo ensoko y’obogima eragere omonto eatanane korwa ase emetego y’amakweri.
swahili: Kumcha Bwana ni chemchemi ya uzima, ili kumwepusha mtu na mitego ya mauti.

english: A large population is a king’s splendor, but a lack of subjects is a prince’s ruin.
ekegusii: Obonge bw’abaanto nabwo bore esiko y’omorwoti, korende ase abanto bare abake omogambi obo nigo agosirigwa.
swahili: Wingi wa watu ni utukufu wa mfalme, bali pasipo watu mkuu huangamia.

english: A patient man has great understanding, but a quick-tempered man promotes folly.
ekegusii: Omonto otari kogechigwa bwango nigo abwate okomanya okonene, korende oyo okoberoroka bwango nigo agokinia oboriri bwaye.
swahili: Mtu mwenye subira ana ufahamu mwingi, bali anayekasirika haraka huonyesha upumbavu.

english: The proud speech of a fool brings a rod to his back, but the lips of the wise protect them.
ekegusii: Aya omoriri agokwana nigo are enyimbo y’oboenenu, korende aya abang’aini bagokwana nigo akobarenda.
swahili: Mazungumzo ya mpumbavu huleta fimbo mgongoni mwake, bali mwenye hekima hulindwa na maneno ya midomo yake.

english: A tranquil heart is life to the body, but envy rots the bones.
ekegusii: Enkoro y’omogooko nigo ere obogima bw’omobere, korende ogosanera nigo kore oboguundo bw’amauga.
swahili: Moyo wenye amani huupa mwili uzima, bali wivu huozesha mifupa.

english: Whoever oppresses the poor taunts their Maker, but whoever is kind to the needy honors Him.
ekegusii: Omonto ogokorera omotaka bobe nigo agochaaya Omotongi bw’omotaka oyio, korende oyore omwororo ase oria oremeire nigo asigete Omotongi oye.
swahili: Yeye amwoneaye maskini huonyesha dharau kwa Muumba wao, bali yeyote anayemhurumia mhitaji humheshimu Mungu.

english: The wicked man is thrown down by his own sin, but the righteous man has a refuge even in death.
ekegusii: Omokori amabe nigo agotugutwa riarua ase engencho y’ogokora kwaye okobe, korende omonyene oboronge nigo agokwa ore n’ogosemeria.
swahili: Waovu huangamizwa kwa matendo yao maovu, bali hata katika kifo wenye haki hupata kimbilio.

english: Wisdom rests in the heart of the discerning; even among fools she is known.
ekegusii: Obong’aini nigo bomenyete ase enkoro y’omonto ore n’okomanya, korende ase enkoro y’omoriri tibomanyekaneti nonya ’ng’ake.
swahili: Hekima hukaa katika moyo wa mwenye ufahamu bali haijulikani miongoni mwa wapumbavu.

english: Righteousness exalts a nation, but sin is a disgrace to any people.
ekegusii: Oboronge nigo bogokinia egesaku, korende ebibe nobosooku ase abanto bande bonsi.
swahili: Haki huinua taifa, bali dhambi ni aibu kwa watu wote.

english: A king delights in a wise servant, but his anger falls on the shameful.
ekegusii: Omosomba ogokora emeremo n’obong’aini nigo agwancherwa n’omorwoti, korende endamwamu y’omorwoti nigo ekoba igoro ase oria okomorentera obosooku.
swahili: Mfalme hupendezwa na mtumishi mwenye hekima, bali ghadhabu yake humwangukia mtumishi mwenye kuaibisha.

english: Where there are no oxen, the manger is empty, but an abundant harvest comes through the strength of the ox.
ekegusii: Ase chiombe chi’okorema chitari, ebiage nigo bikoba bosa, korende ase okong’usa gwe chintang’ana, endagera enyinge nigo ekonyorekana.
swahili: Pale ambapo hakuna mafahali, hori ni tupu, bali kutokana na nguvu za fahali huja mavuno mengi.

english: An honest witness does not deceive, but a dishonest witness pours forth lies.
ekegusii: Kirori ore omwegenwa tari gokwana oborimo, korende oy’otari omwegenwa nigo akoroka oborimo bwoka.
swahili: Shahidi mwaminifu hadanganyi, bali shahidi wa uongo humimina uongo.

english: A mocker seeks wisdom and finds none, but knowledge comes easily to the discerning.
ekegusii: Omonto ore omochecheria narigia obong’aini takobonyora, korende chiseemi nigo chikonyorekana bwango ase omonto ore omong’aini.
swahili: Mwenye mzaha huitafuta hekima na haipati, bali maarifa huja kwa urahisi kwa anayepambanua.

english: Stay away from a foolish man; you will gain no knowledge from his speech.
ekegusii: Karue ase omonto omoriri, ekiagera tokonyora obong’aini ase aria agokwana.
swahili: Kaa mbali na mtu mpumbavu, kwa maana hutapata maarifa katika midomo yake.

english: The wisdom of the prudent is to discern his way, but the folly of fools deceives them.
ekegusii: Obong’aini bw’omonto ore n’okomanya nigo bokomokonya omanya buna chiinchera chiaye chire, korende obosooku bw’abaanto abariri nigo bokobang’aina.
swahili: Hekima ya mwenye busara ni kufikiria njia zake, bali upumbavu wa wapumbavu ni udanganyifu.

english: Fools mock the making of amends, but goodwill is found among the upright.
ekegusii: Abanto abariri nigo bagokora echeche n’ebibe, korende abanyene oboronge nigo bagwancherana barabwo ase barabwo.
swahili: Wapumbavu hudhihaki kujirekebisha kutoka dhambi, bali wema hupatikana miongoni mwa wanyofu.

english: A gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.
ekegusii: Okoiraneria kw’obwororo nigo kogokendia endamwamu, korende amang’ana y’obotindi nigo agoseegeta endamwamu.
swahili: Jawabu la upole hugeuza ghadhabu, bali neno liumizalo huchochea hasira.

english: Discipline is harsh for him who leaves the path; he who hates correction will die.
ekegusii: Egesusuro ekenene ’nkemonyore oyotigire enchera y’oboronge, nere oy’ogechete ogokuurerwa goika akwe.
swahili: Adhabu kali humngoja yeye aachaye njia; yeye achukiaye maonyo atakufa.

english: Sheol and Abaddon lie open before the LORD— how much more the hearts of men!
ekegusii: Onye aase abakuure ne’chioora chi’obosiru bire maiso marore ase Omonene, inee! Tamanyeti chinkoro chia Mwanyabaanto mono kobua?
swahili: Mauti na Uharibifu viko wazi mbele za Bwana: je, si zaidi sana mioyo ya wanadamu!

english: A mocker does not love to be reproved, nor will he consult the wise.
ekegusii: Omonyacheche tancheti omonto okomokuurera, ere tagwancha kogeenda ase abang’aini.
swahili: Mwenye mzaha huchukia maonyo; hatataka shauri kwa mwenye hekima.

english: A joyful heart makes a cheerful countenance, but sorrow of the heart crushes the spirit.
ekegusii: Enkoro ere n’omosasoko nigo ekorenta omogooko ase obosio, korende onye enkoro ere n’omoichano, omoyo nigo okoba nobororo.
swahili: Moyo wenye furaha hufanya uso uchangamke, bali maumivu ya moyoni huponda roho.

english: A discerning heart seeks knowledge, but the mouth of a fool feeds on folly.
ekegusii: Enkoro y’omonto ore nokomanya nigo ekorigia chiseemi, korende emenwa y’abariri nigo ekwerageria oboriri.
swahili: Moyo wa mwenye ufahamu hutafuta maarifa, bali kinywa cha mpumbavu hujilisha upumbavu.

english: All the days of the oppressed are bad, but a cheerful heart has a continual feast.
ekegusii: Amatuko onsi ay’omonto ochaandegete nigo are amabe, korende oyore n’enkoro y’omosasoko nigo akogeenderera koba n’omoyega o botambe.
swahili: Siku zote za wanaoonewa ni za taabu, bali moyo mchangamfu una karamu ya kudumu.

english: Better a little with the fear of the LORD than great treasure with turmoil.
ekegusii: Mbuya koba n’ebinto ebike amo n’okomoiroka Omonene, kobua koba ne chinibo chinyinge amo nemechando.
swahili: Afadhali kuwa na kidogo pamoja na kumcha Bwana, kuliko mali nyingi pamoja na ghasia.

english: Better a dish of vegetables where there is love than a fattened ox with hatred.
ekegusii: Mbuya koria chinyeni more nobwanchani, kobua koria chinyama chi’echiombe chinoru na mogechaine.
swahili: Afadhali chakula cha mboga mahali palipo na upendo kuliko nyama ya ndama iliyonona pamoja na chuki.

english: A hot-tempered man stirs up strife, but he who is slow to anger calms dispute.
ekegusii: Omonto ore n’enkoro ekoberoroka bwango nigo agoseegeta eriomana, korende oyore omwororo nigo agokanya eriomana.
swahili: Mtu mwepesi wa hasira huchochea ugomvi, bali mtu mvumilivu hutuliza ugomvi.

english: The way of the slacker is like a hedge of thorns, but the path of the upright is a highway.
ekegusii: Enchera y’omonto omworo nigo eribete buna orobago rw’amagwa, korende ey’abanyene oboronge nigo ere endonge naende engare.
swahili: Njia ya mvivu imezibwa na miiba, bali njia ya mwenye haki ni barabara kuu.

english: The tongue of the wise commends knowledge, but the mouth of the fool spouts folly.
ekegusii: Oromeme rw’omonto omong’aini nigo rogokwana chiseemi chingiya, korende emenwa y’abariri nigo ekoumora oboriri.
swahili: Ulimi wa mwenye hekima husifu maarifa, bali kinywa cha mpumbavu hufoka upumbavu.

english: A wise son brings joy to his father, but a foolish man despises his mother.
ekegusii: Omwana omong’aini nigo akogokia ise, korende oyore omoriri nigo agochaaya ng’ina.
swahili: Mwana mwenye hekima huleta furaha kwa baba yake, bali mtu mpumbavu humdharau mama yake.

english: Folly is joy to one who lacks judgment, but a man of understanding walks a straight path.
ekegusii: Oboriri nigo bore omogooko ase omonto otabwati obomanyi, korende omonto omong’aini nigo akobwatia chiinchera chi’oboronge.
swahili: Upumbavu humfurahisha mtu ambaye hana akili, bali mtu mwenye ufahamu hushika njia iliyonyooka.

english: Plans fail for lack of counsel, but with many advisers they succeed.
ekegusii: Ase ogosemania gotari, emeroberio nigo egosareka, korende ase abaseemia abange abaya bare nigo egokiinigwa.
swahili: Mipango hushindwa kufanikiwa kwa ajili ya kukosa ushauri, bali kukiwa na washauri wengi hufanikiwa.

english: A man takes joy in a fitting reply— and how good is a timely word!
ekegusii: Omonto nigo akogookera okoiraneria okuya gokorua ase omonwa oye, ne ring’ana rigokwanwa ase engaki egwenerete, nigo rire rigiya mono.
swahili: Mtu hupata furaha katika kutoa jibu linalofaa: je, ni zuri namna gani neno lililotoka kwa wakati wake!

english: The path of life leads upward for the wise, that he may avoid going down to Sheol.
ekegusii: Enchera y’omonto omong’aini nigo egotiira gochia ase obogima, erinde omonto oyio tabaisa kogeenda inse agwo aase abakuure.
swahili: Mapito ya uzima huelekea juu kwa ajili ya wenye hekima kumwepusha asiende chini kaburini.

english: The LORD tears down the house of the proud, but He protects the boundaries of the widow.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo agotagora enyomba y’omonto omoenenu, korende arenda chimbebe chi’omotakaanwa.
swahili: Bwana hubomoa nyumba ya mtu mwenye kiburi, bali huilinda mipaka ya mjane isiguswe.

english: The LORD detests the thoughts of the wicked, but the words of the pure are pleasant to Him.
ekegusii: Ebirengererio ebibe nigo bire okogechia ase Omonene, korende amang’ana amaya nigo akomogokia.
swahili: Bwana huchukia sana mawazo ya mwovu, bali mawazo ya wale walio safi humfurahisha yeye.

english: He who is greedy for unjust gain brings trouble on his household, but he who hates bribes will live.
ekegusii: Omonto ore ne ribero ase okorigia ebitoki ase enchera etari endonge nigo akorenta emechando ase enyomba yaye, korende oyo ogechete riaaki nabe moyo.
swahili: Mtu mwenye tamaa huletea jamaa yake taabu, bali yeye achukiaye rushwa ataishi.

english: The heart of the righteous ponders how to answer, but the mouth of the wicked blurts out evil.
ekegusii: Enkoro y’omonyene oboronge nigo ekorengereria aya ekoiraneria, korende emenwa y’abakori amabe nigo egoitororoka ayare amabe.
swahili: Moyo wa mwenye haki hupima majibu yake, bali kinywa cha mwovu hufoka ubaya.

english: The LORD is far from the wicked, but He hears the prayer of the righteous.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo are aare korwa ase abakori amabe, korende nigo agotegerera ogosaba kw’abanyene oboronge.
swahili: Bwana yuko mbali na waovu, bali husikia maombi ya wenye haki.

english: The eyes of the LORD are in every place, observing the evil and the good.
ekegusii: Amaiso a Omonene nigo arigereretie kera ase, nigo arooche ababe amo n’abaya.
swahili: Macho ya Bwana yako kila mahali, yakiwaangalia waovu na wema.

english: The light of the eyes cheers the heart, and good news nourishes the bones.
ekegusii: Okorigereria kore nomosasoko nigo gokogokia enkoro, na amang’ana amaya nigo akogokia amauga.
swahili: Mtazamo wa tabasamu huleta furaha moyoni, nazo habari njema huipa mifupa afya.

english: He who listens to life-giving reproof will dwell among the wise.
ekegusii: Omonto ogotegerera na koigwera ogokuurerwa gokorenta obogima ’namenye amo n’abanto abang’aini.
swahili: Yeye asikilizaye maonyo yatoayo uzima atakuwa miongoni mwa wenye hekima.

english: He who ignores discipline despises himself, but whoever heeds correction gains understanding.
ekegusii: Omonto okwanga ogokuurera, oyio nigo agochaaya obogima bwaye omonyene, korende oyokoigwera ogokuurerwa nigo akoba n’okomanya.
swahili: Yeye anayedharau maonyo hujidharau mwenyewe, bali yeyote anayekubali maonyo hupata ufahamu.

english: The fear of the LORD is the instruction of wisdom, and humility comes before honor.
ekegusii: Okomoiroka Omonene, nakwo amorokererio akorenta obong’aini, na oboitongo nigo bogotang’anera esiko.
swahili: Kumcha Bwana humfundisha mtu hekima, nao unyenyekevu huja kabla ya heshima.

english: A soothing tongue is a tree of life, but a perverse tongue crushes the spirit.
ekegusii: Oromeme rokoiraneria n’obokanyeku nigo rokogwenia, korende orokorubania nigo rogotandora enkoro.
swahili: Ulimi uletao uponyaji ni mti wa uzima, bali ulimi udanganyao huponda roho.

english: A fool rejects his father’s discipline, but whoever heeds correction is prudent.
ekegusii: Omoriri nigo agochaaya amorokererio a ise y’okomorongeyia, korende oyokoigwera ogokuurerwa nigo akong’ainia.
swahili: Mpumbavu hubeza maonyo ya baba yake, bali yeyote akubaliye maonyo huonyesha busara.

english: The house of the righteous has great treasure, but the income of the wicked is trouble.
ekegusii: Enyomba y’omonyene oboronge nigo ere n’obonge bw’obonda, korende ebitoki bi’abakori amabe nigo bire n’obonge bw’emechando.
swahili: Nyumba ya mwenye haki ina hazina kubwa, bali mapato ya waovu huwaletea taabu.

english: The lips of the wise spread knowledge, but not so the hearts of fools.
ekegusii: Ebikoba bi’abang’aini nigo bikoraria chiseemi, korende chinkoro chi’abariri tichigokora boigo.
swahili: Midomo ya mwenye hekima hueneza maarifa, bali sivyo ilivyo mioyo ya wapumbavu.

english: The sacrifice of the wicked is detestable to the LORD, but the prayer of the upright is His delight.
ekegusii: Ekeng’wanso ki’abakori amabe nigo kere okogechia ase Omonene, korende ogosaba kw’abare ne chinkoro chindonge nigo gokomogokia.
swahili: Bwana huchukia sana dhabihu za waovu, bali maombi ya wanyofu humfurahisha Mungu.

english: The LORD detests the way of the wicked, but He loves those who pursue righteousness.
ekegusii: Enchera y’omokori amabe nigo ere okogechia ase Omonene, korende nigo anchete oy’okobwatia oboronge.
swahili: Bwana huchukia sana njia ya waovu, bali huwapenda wale wafuatao haki.

english: The plans of the heart belong to man, but the reply of the tongue is from the LORD.
ekegusii: Mwanyabaanto nigo agokora emeroberio ase enkoro yaye, korende aya oromeme rokoiraneria nigo akorwa ase Omonene.
swahili: Mipango ya moyoni ni ya mwanadamu, bali jibu la ulimi hutoka kwa Bwana.

english: A divine verdict is on the lips of a king; his mouth must not betray justice.
ekegusii: Chinkwana chinchenu ’nchigwenerete koba ase ebikoba bi’omorwoti, na omonwa oye tomocha ekero akonacha ebiina.
swahili: Midomo ya mfalme huzungumza kwa hekima ya kiungu, wala kinywa chake hakipotoshi haki.

english: Honest scales and balances are from the LORD; all the weights in the bag are His concern.
ekegusii: Ekerengero ki’oborito gi’ekeene nigo gekorwa ase Omonene, na ebirengero bionsi bire ase chisaro nigo bire ogokora kwaye.
swahili: Vipimo na mizani za halali hutoka kwa Bwana; mawe yote ya kupimia yaliyo katika mfuko ameyafanya yeye.

english: Wicked behavior is detestable to kings, for a throne is established through righteousness.
ekegusii: Ekero abarwoti bagokora amabe nigo bakorenta okogechia, ekiagera goetera ase oboronge ekerogo ki’obogambi nigo kegokong’igwa.
swahili: Wafalme huchukia sana kutenda maovu, kwa maana kiti cha ufalme hufanywa imara kwa njia ya haki.

english: Righteous lips are a king’s delight, and he who speaks honestly is beloved.
ekegusii: Amang’ana amaronge agokwanwa nigo akogokia omorwoti, nere nigo abanchete abwo bagokwana oboronge.
swahili: Wafalme hufurahia midomo ya uaminifu; humthamini mtu asemaye kweli.

english: The wrath of a king is a messenger of death, but a wise man will pacify it.
ekegusii: Endamwamu y’omorwoti nigo enga buna abatomwa bakorenta amakweri, korende omonto omong’aini nigo akoyekanya.
swahili: Ghadhabu ya mfalme ni mjumbe wa mauti, bali mtu mwenye hekima ataituliza.

english: When a king’s face brightens, there is life; his favor is like a rain cloud in spring.
ekegusii: Omosasoko ore ase obosio bw’omorwoti nigo ore obogima, na ogwancherwa kwaye nigo konga buna amare agotwa embura y’okwamia endagera.
swahili: Uso wa mfalme ungʼaapo, inamaanisha uhai; upendeleo wake ni kama wingu la mvua wakati wa vuli.

english: How much better to acquire wisdom than gold! To gain understanding is more desirable than silver.
ekegusii: Konyora obong’aini, ayio namaya kobua konyora etaabu, na okoba nobomanyi nigo kogwenerete kobua koba nefeta.
swahili: Ni bora kiasi gani kupata hekima kuliko dhahabu, kuchagua ufahamu kuliko fedha!

english: The highway of the upright leads away from evil; he who guards his way protects his life.
ekegusii: Ogweatanana korwa ase amabe, eyio nero enchera enene y’abanyene oboronge; na omonto orendete enchera yaye, nigo arendete obogima bwaye.
swahili: Njia kuu ya wanyofu huepuka ubaya; yeye aichungaye njia yake, huchunga maisha yake.

english: Pride goes before destruction, and a haughty spirit before a fall.
ekegusii: Oboenenu nigo bogotang’anera obosiru, na omoika bw’obomwenu nigo ogotang’anera okogwa.
swahili: Kiburi hutangulia maangamizi, roho ya majivuno hutangulia maanguko.

english: It is better to be lowly in spirit among the humble than to divide the spoil with the proud.
ekegusii: Nigo ere buya koba n’omoyo bw’oboitongo na komenya amo nabataka kobua koria ebisakorwa amo nabaenenu.
swahili: Ni afadhali kuwa mnyenyekevu katika roho miongoni mwa walioonewa kuliko kugawana nyara pamoja na wenye kiburi.

english: All a man’s ways are pure in his own eyes, but his motives are weighed out by the LORD.
ekegusii: Chinchera chionsi chi’omonto nigo chikororekana ase are omonyene ng’a neching’ikeranu, korende Omonene nigo akorenga omoika o Mwanyabaanto.
swahili: Njia zote za mtu huonekana safi machoni pake mwenyewe, bali makusudi hupimwa na Bwana.

english: Whoever heeds instruction will find success, and blessed is he who trusts in the LORD.
ekegusii: Omonto okoigwera Ring’ana nanyore amaya, na oyo okomosemeri’Omonene nasesenirie.
swahili: Yeyote anayekubali mafundisho hustawi, tena amebarikiwa yeye anayemtumaini Bwana.

english: The wise in heart are called discerning, and pleasant speech promotes instruction.
ekegusii: Omonto ore omong’aini ase enkoro yaye narokwe omomanyi, ne chinkwana chingiya nigo chikomenta chiseemi.
swahili: Wenye hekima moyoni huitwa wenye ufahamu, na maneno ya kupendeza huchochea mafundisho.

english: Understanding is a fountain of life to its possessor, but the discipline of fools is folly.
ekegusii: Obong’aini nigo bore ensoko y’obogima ase omong’aini, korende oboriri nigo bore egesusuro ase abariri.
swahili: Ufahamu ni chemchemi ya uzima kwa wale walio nao, bali upumbavu huleta adhabu kwa wapumbavu.

english: The heart of the wise man instructs his mouth and adds persuasiveness to his lips.
ekegusii: Enkoro y’omonto omong’aini nigo ekworokereria omonwa oye oboseemia, naende yamenta ogotegererwa kw’ebikoba biaye.
swahili: Moyo wa mtu mwenye hekima huongoza kinywa chake, na midomo yake huchochea mafundisho.

english: Pleasant words are a honeycomb, sweet to the soul and healing to the bones.
ekegusii: Amang’ana y’okogokia nigo anga obooke bokorwa ase richoe, nigo are amansu ase omoyo naende nigo akogwenia omobere.
swahili: Maneno ya kupendeza ni kama sega la asali, ni matamu kwa nafsi na uponyaji kwenye mifupa.

english: There is a way that seems right to a man, but its end is the way of death.
ekegusii: Enchera nere ekororekana ase omonto ng’a nengiya, korende omoerio bw’enchera eyio namakweri.
swahili: Iko njia ionekanayo kuwa sawa kwa mtu, bali mwisho wake huelekeza mautini.

english: A worker’s appetite works for him because his hunger drives him onward.
ekegusii: Okogania kw’omonto nigo gokomobetereria gokora emeremo, ekiagera naganetie goisanekia enchara yaye omonyene.
swahili: Shauku ya mfanyakazi humhimiza kufanya kazi; njaa yake humsukuma aendelee.

english: A worthless man digs up evil, and his speech is like a scorching fire.
ekegusii: Omonto otaisaini nigo akona‐gotukoria amabe, ne chinkwana chiaye nigo chinga omorero okorura.
swahili: Mtu mbaya kabisa hupanga mabaya, maneno yake ni kama moto uunguzao.

english: A perverse man spreads dissension, and a gossip divides close friends.
ekegusii: Omonto omonyaborimo nigo akona‐gotaara‐taaria amang’ana akorenta eriomana, na omogenki nigo akorenta obobisa ase abanto banchaine.
swahili: Mtu mpotovu huchochea ugomvi, nayo maongezi ya upuzi hutenganisha marafiki wa karibu.

english: A violent man entices his neighbor and leads him down a path that is not good.
ekegusii: Omonto omotindi nigo akoebereria omonto onde omoraa gochia ase enchera embe.
swahili: Mtu mkali humvuta jirani yake na kumwongoza katika mapito yale mabaya.

english: Commit your works to the LORD and your plans will be achieved.
ekegusii: Motweke Omonene emeremo yao, na emeroberio yao nesesenigwe.
swahili: Mkabidhi Bwana lolote ufanyalo, nayo mipango yako itafanikiwa.

english: He who winks his eye devises perversity; he who purses his lips is bent on evil.
ekegusii: Omonto ogosumera ebioge bi’amaiso aye nigo akoroberia amabe, na oyo ogotakuna omonwa oye nigo agoikerania amabe.
swahili: Yeye akonyezaye kwa jicho lake anapanga upotovu; naye akazaye midomo yake amenuia mabaya.

english: Gray hair is a crown of glory; it is attained along the path of righteousness.
ekegusii: Chimbuche chire ase omotwe neguutwa y’obonene, eyio nigo ekonyorwa n’abanyaboronge.
swahili: Mvi ni taji ya utukufu; hupatikana kwa maisha ya uadilifu.

english: He who is slow to anger is better than a warrior, and he who controls his temper is greater than one who captures a city.
ekegusii: Omonto otari omwango ase okogechigwa nigo abuete omorwani egeata, na oyomanyete kogambera enkoro yaye nigo abuete oyo okobua omochie na koyoira.
swahili: Ni afadhali mtu mstahimilivu kuliko shujaa, mtu anayeitawala hasira yake kuliko yule autekaye mji.

english: The lot is cast into the lap, but its every decision is from the LORD.
ekegusii: Obomera nigo bokorutwa ase esaro ime, korende Omonene nere ogochora oyo bokogwera.
swahili: Kura hupigwa kwa siri, lakini kila uamuzi wake hutoka kwa Bwana.

english: The LORD has made everything for His purpose— even the wicked for the day of disaster.
ekegusii: Omonene okoreire kera egento engencho yaye, nonya nabakori amabe babeo ase engencho ye rituko ri’emechando.
swahili: Bwana hufanya kila kitu kwa kusudi lake mwenyewe; hata waovu kwa siku ya maangamizi.

english: Everyone who is proud in heart is detestable to the LORD; be assured that he will not go unpunished.
ekegusii: Kera omonto ore omoenenu nigo are kogechia ase Omonene; omonto oyio goika aegwe egesusuro.
swahili: Bwana huwachukia sana wote wenye kiburi cha moyo. Uwe na hakika kwa hili: Hawataepuka kuadhibiwa.

english: By loving devotion and faithfulness iniquity is atoned for, and by the fear of the LORD one turns aside from evil.
ekegusii: Ase amaabera, na obwegenwa, embooria yaakanirwe ase engencho y’ebibe, na ase okomoiroka Omonene, omonto nigo agweatanana korwa ase amabe.
swahili: Kwa upendo na uaminifu uovu huondolewa; kwa kumcha Bwana mtu hujiepusha na ubaya.

english: When a man’s ways please the LORD, He makes even the man’s enemies live at peace with him.
ekegusii: Ekero chiinchera chi’omonto chiamogokirie Omonene Nyasae nigo agokora nonya nababisa b’omonto oyio babwatana nere.
swahili: Njia za mtu zinapompendeza Bwana, huwafanya hata adui zake waishi naye kwa amani.

english: Better a little with righteousness than great gain with injustice.
ekegusii: Mbuya koba n’ebinto ebike ase oboronge kobua koba ne chinibo chinyinge chikonyorwa ase oborianania.
swahili: Afadhali kitu kidogo pamoja na haki kuliko mapato mengi pamoja na udhalimu.

english: A man’s heart plans his course, but the LORD determines his steps.
ekegusii: Ase enkoro yaye ime omonto nigo akoroberia chiinchera chiaye, korende Omonene nere okoraa amabarato aye.
swahili: Moyo wa mtu huifikiri njia yake, bali Bwana huelekeza hatua zake.

english: Better a dry morsel in quietness than a house full of feasting with strife.
ekegusii: Nigo ere buya konyora ritoronge eriomo ri’obokima na koba n’obotoereru kobua kobeera ase enyomba eichire endagera y’omoyega ere neriomana.
swahili: Afadhali kula ukoko mkavu ukiwa na amani na utulivu kuliko kukaa kwenye nyumba ya karamu kukiwa na magomvi.

english: A rebuke cuts into a man of discernment deeper than a hundred lashes cut into a fool.
ekegusii: Kobua omonto omoriri otari kweorokereria korwa ase ogoakwa ebiranya rigana erimo, omonto omong’aini nigo akweorokereria korwa ase ogotogonyerwa okomo.
swahili: Karipio humwingia sana mtu mwenye kutambua kuliko mapigo mia kwa mpumbavu.

english: An evil man seeks only rebellion; a cruel messenger will be sent against him.
ekegusii: Omosaria okona-korigia gokora amabe oka, ere ’natomerwe omonto omotindi amoe egesusuro.
swahili: Mtu mbaya hupenda kuasi tu; mjumbe asiye na huruma atatumwa dhidi yake.

english: It is better to meet a bear robbed of her cubs than a fool in his folly.
ekegusii: Mbuya omonto aumerane n’obontindi bw’edubu enkuungu yaurirwe chimanwa chiaye, kobua koumerana n’omonto omoriri ase oboriri bwaye.
swahili: Ni afadhali ukutane na dubu aliyenyangʼanywa watoto wake, kuliko mpumbavu katika upumbavu wake.

english: If anyone returns evil for good, evil will never leave his house.
ekegusii: Omonto ogoakana amabe ase amaya, obobe tibokorua ase enyomba yaye.
swahili: Ikiwa mtu atalipa baya kwa jema, kamwe ubaya hautaondoka katika nyumba yake.

english: To start a quarrel is to release a flood; so abandon the dispute before it breaks out.
ekegusii: Ogochaaka eriomana nigo konga buna amaache aigoreirwe, ase ayio tiga amang’ana y’eriomana atarabucha.
swahili: Kuanzisha ugomvi ni kama kutoboa bwawa la maji; kwa hiyo acha jambo hilo kabla mabishano hayajaanza.

english: Acquitting the guilty and condemning the righteous— both are detestable to the LORD.
ekegusii: Omonto ogwanchereria omokori amabe ng’a nomonyaboronge, nere oria okonachera omonyakeene ekiina, abwo bonsi nigo bare okogechia ase Omonene.
swahili: Yeye asemaye kuwa asiye na haki ana haki, naye asemaye kuwa mwenye haki hana haki: Bwana huwachukia sana wote wawili.

english: Why should the fool have money in his hand with no intention of buying wisdom?
ekegusii: Inee! Chibesa omonto omoriri abwate ase okoboko kwaye agochia kogora obong’aini nechia ki, na ere tari n’enkoro y’okomanya?
swahili: Fedha ina faida gani mikononi mwa mpumbavu, wakati yeye hana haja ya kupata hekima?

english: A friend loves at all times, and a brother is born for adversity.
ekegusii: Omosani nigo akoba nobwanchani ase chingaki chionsi, na oyomino nigo aiboire agokoonye ase engaki y’emechando.
swahili: Rafiki hupenda wakati wote naye ndugu amezaliwa kwa ajili ya wakati wa shida.

english: A man lacking judgment strikes hands in pledge and puts up security for his neighbor.
ekegusii: Omonto oremeire chiseemi nigo akobwatana amaboko na kwerua koba intenenera ase omonto onde.
swahili: Mtu mjinga hupana mkono ili kuweka rehani, naye huweka dhamana kwa jirani yake.

english: He who loves transgression loves strife; he who builds his gate high invites destruction.
ekegusii: Omonto bwanchete eriomana nigo anchete ogosaria, na oyokweimokereria igoro nigo akwerigeria ogosirigwa.
swahili: Yeye apendaye ugomvi apenda dhambi; naye ainuaye sana lango lake hutafuta uharibifu.

english: A wise servant will rule over a disgraceful son and share his inheritance as one of the brothers.
ekegusii: Omosomba omong’aini nagambere omwana bw’omonene oye, oyio ogokora amang’ana ’obosooku, naende naatananerwe omwando amo nabana b’omonene oye.
swahili: Mtumishi mwenye hekima atatawala juu ya mwana aaibishaye, naye atashirikiana katika urithi kama mmoja wa hao ndugu.

english: The one with a perverse heart finds no good, and he whose tongue is deceitful falls into trouble.
ekegusii: Omonto ore omokorekanu ase enkoro yaye tari goseseneka, na oyobwate oromeme rw’ogotantania nigo akonyorwa n’emechando.
swahili: Mtu mwenye moyo mpotovu hawezi kufanikiwa; naye ambaye ulimi wake ni mdanganyifu huanguka kwenye taabu.

english: A man fathers a fool to his own grief; the father of a fool has no joy.
ekegusii: Oyo oiboire omwana omoriri nigo akoba n’omoichano, na ise omwana oyio tari koba n’omogooko.
swahili: Kuwa na mwana mpumbavu huleta huzuni; hakuna furaha kwa baba wa mpumbavu.

english: A joyful heart is good medicine, but a broken spirit dries up the bones.
ekegusii: Enkoro ere n’omogooko nigo ekogwenia buna eriogo, korende omoichano ore ase enkoro nigo okwomia emeseto y’amauga.
swahili: Moyo wenye furaha ni dawa nzuri, bali roho iliyopondeka hukausha mifupa.

english: A wicked man takes a covert bribe to subvert the course of justice.
ekegusii: Omokori amabe nigo akoegwa riaaki bobisi, erinde asarie chiinchera chi’ekina.
swahili: Mtu mwovu hukubali rushwa kwa siri ili kupotosha njia ya haki.

english: Wisdom is the focus of the discerning, but the eyes of a fool wander to the ends of the earth.
ekegusii: Botambe omonto omong’aini nigo akorora ay’obong’aini amoetanaine, korende omonto omoriri nigo akomaga-maga gochia ase chinsinyo chi’ense.
swahili: Mtu wa ufahamu huitazama hekima, lakini macho ya mpumbavu huhangaika hadi kwenye miisho ya dunia.

english: A foolish son brings grief to his father and bitterness to her who bore him.
ekegusii: Omwana omomura omoriri nigo agoichania ise, naende nigo akorenta obororo ase ng’ina oy’omoiborete.
swahili: Mwana mpumbavu huleta huzuni kwa baba yake na uchungu kwa yeye aliyemzaa.

english: It is surely not good to punish the innocent or to flog a noble for his honesty.
ekegusii: Tari buya komoa egesusuro omonto omooronge, boigo tari buya kwaguria abanto abasike ase engencho y’oboronge bwabo.
swahili: Si vizuri kumwadhibu mtu asiye na hatia, au kuwapiga sana maafisa kwa ajili ya uadilifu wao.

english: A man of knowledge restrains his words, and a man of understanding maintains a calm spirit.
ekegusii: Omonto omong’aini nigo akwerita ase amang’ana agokwana, na omonto omong’aini nigo abwate omoika bw’oboremereria.
swahili: Mtu mwenye maarifa hutumia maneno kwa kujizuia, naye mtu mwenye ufahamu ana moyo wa utulivu.

english: Even a fool is considered wise if he keeps silent, and discerning when he holds his tongue.
ekegusii: Nonya nomonto omoriri, ekero agokira, nigo akobarwa ng’a nomong’aini are. Ekero akomumeka omonwa oye nigo akorokwa omong’aini.
swahili: Hata mtu mpumbavu hudhaniwa kuwa na hekima kama akinyamaza, na mwenye ufahamu kama akiuzuia ulimi wake.

english: A crucible for silver and a furnace for gold, but the LORD is the tester of hearts.
ekegusii: Efeta nigo egoteemerwa ase enyongo ekoyenyititora, na etaabu yateemerwa ase omorero ekebemberi, korende Omonene nere okorenga chinkoro.
swahili: Kalibu ni kwa ajili ya fedha na tanuru ni kwa ajili ya dhahabu, bali Bwana huujaribu moyo.

english: A wicked man listens to evil lips; a liar gives ear to a destructive tongue.
ekegusii: Omokori amabe nigo agotegerera oigwera amang’ana y’obokorekanu, na omonyaborimo nigo akoigwera chinkwana chi’ogosiria.
swahili: Mtu mwovu husikiliza midomo mibaya; mwongo husikiliza kwa makini ulimi wa madhara.

english: He who mocks the poor insults their Maker; whoever gloats over calamity will not go unpunished.
ekegusii: Omonto ogochecheria omotaka nigo agochaaya Omotongi bw’omotaka oye, na oyokogookera emechando yanyorire abande, takomocha konyora egesusuro.
swahili: Yeye anaye mdhihaki maskini huonyesha dharau kwa Muumba wake; yeyote afurahiaye maafa hataepuka kuadhibiwa.

english: Grandchildren are the crown of the aged, and the glory of a son is his father.
ekegusii: Abachokoro nigo bare eguutwa ye chisokoro chiabo, na obonene bw’abana nigo bore ase abaibori babo.
swahili: Wana wa wana ni taji la wazee, nao wazazi ni fahari ya watoto wao.

english: Eloquent words are unfit for a fool; how much worse are lying lips to a ruler!
ekegusii: Inaki omoriri tagosemerigwa koba n’amang’ana amaya, boigo n’omogaambi tagwenereti nonya ’ng’ake chinkwana chi’oborimo.
swahili: Midomo yenye uwezo wa ushawishi haimfai mpumbavu: je, ni mibaya kiasi gani zaidi midomo ya uongo kwa mtawala!

english: A bribe is a charm to its giver; wherever he turns, he succeeds.
ekegusii: Riaaki nigo ringa buna rigena ri’ebisio ase amaiso y’omonto oria okoriegwa. Ere nigo akorengereria ng’a kende gionsi ararikorere nigo keramorentere ebisio.
swahili: Kipawa ni kama kito cha thamani machoni pake yeye aliye nacho; kokote kigeukiapo, hufanikiwa.

english: Whoever conceals an offense promotes love, but he who brings it up separates friends.
ekegusii: Omonto okorigia obwanchani nigo akwabera aya akomocherwa, korende oria okona‐koinyora nigo agosaria obasani.
swahili: Yeye anayesamehe kosa hudumisha upendo, bali yeyote arudiaye jambo hutenganisha marafiki wa karibu.

english: He who isolates himself pursues selfish desires; he rebels against all sound judgment.
ekegusii: Omonto bweanchete omonyene, nigo akweganeria ayaye oka; nigo akwanga otindia nonya nase onsi ayare amaya.
swahili: Mtu ajitengaye na wengine hufuata matakwa yake mwenyewe; hupiga vita kila shauri jema.

english: The name of the LORD is a strong tower; the righteous run to it and are safe.
ekegusii: Erieta ri’Omonene nigo rire orwaki orokong’u; omonyene oboronge nigo akorotamera oba orendire buya.
swahili: Jina la Bwana ni ngome imara, wenye haki huikimbilia na kuwa salama.

english: A rich man’s wealth is his fortified city; it is like a high wall in his imagination.
ekegusii: Obotenenku bw’omonto omonda nigo bonga buna omochie omokong’u, naende nigo bonga orwaki orotambe gochia igoro rokomorenda.
swahili: Mali ya tajiri ni mji wake wenye ngome, wanaudhania kuwa ukuta usioweza kurukwa.

english: Before his downfall a man’s heart is proud, but humility comes before honor.
ekegusii: Oboenenu bw’enkoro y’omonto nigo bogotang’anera ogosarigwa, na oboitongo nigo bogotang’anera ogosikwa.
swahili: Kabla ya anguko moyo wa mtu hujaa kiburi, bali unyenyekevu hutangulia heshima.

english: He who answers a matter before he hears it— this is folly and disgrace to him.
ekegusii: Omonto okoiraneria ring’ana atarariigwa buya, obwo noboriri ase are, na nigo akonyora obosooku.
swahili: Yeye ajibuye kabla ya kusikiliza, huo ni upumbavu wake na aibu yake.

english: The spirit of a man can endure his sickness, but who can survive a broken spirit?
ekegusii: Omoika bw’oboremu nigo okogera omonto oremereria ogochaandeka, korende ning’o orayoremererie omoika ore n’omoichano?
swahili: Roho ya mtu itastahimili katika ugonjwa bali roho iliyovunjika ni nani awezaye kuistahimili?

english: The heart of the discerning acquires knowledge, and the ear of the wise seeks it out.
ekegusii: Enkoro y’omonto omong’aini nigo ekonyora chiseemi, na ogoto kwaye nigo kogochirigia.
swahili: Moyo wa mwenye ufahamu hujipatia maarifa, masikio ya mwenye hekima huyatafuta maarifa.

english: A man’s gift opens doors for him, and brings him before great men.
ekegusii: Ebiegwa bi’omonto nigo bikomoigorera enchera na komobeeka amo n’abanto abanene.
swahili: Zawadi humfungulia njia mtoaji, nayo humleta mbele ya wakuu.

english: The first to state his case seems right until another comes and cross-examines him.
ekegusii: Omonto gekwaneire ritang’ani nigo akororekana ng’a noboronge agokwana, korende omonto omoao gachire, nigo akoorokia amang’ana ayio buna are.
swahili: Yeye aliye wa kwanza kuleta mashtaka huonekana sahihi, hadi mwingine ajitokezapo na kumuuliza maswali.

english: Casting the lot ends quarrels and separates strong opponents.
ekegusii: Obomera nabwo bogokoora okoamererania na gwatanana abanene abwo bakoamererania.
swahili: Kupiga kura hukomesha mashindano na kutenganisha wapinzani wakuu wanaopingana.

english: An offended brother is harder to win than a fortified city, and disputes are like the bars of a castle.
ekegusii: Nigo ere aakong’u koirania ase obosani omonto omocheirwe, kobua koirania omochie omokong’u, na eriomana nigo ringa buna emekorogoto y’ebiita bi’orwaki orokong’u.
swahili: Ndugu aliyechukizwa ni mgumu kuridhika kuliko mji uliozungushiwa ngome, nayo mabishano ni kama malango ya ngome yenye makomeo.

english: A fool does not delight in understanding, but only in airing his opinions.
ekegusii: Omoriri tari kogokigwa nay’obong’aini, korende nigo anchete gokwana ayare ase enkoro yaye omonyene.
swahili: Mpumbavu hafurahii ufahamu, bali hufurahia kutangaza maoni yake mwenyewe.

english: From the fruit of his mouth a man’s belly is filled; with the harvest from his lips he is satisfied.
ekegusii: Omonto nigo agoisanekia enda yaye n’ogokwana kw’omonwa oye, okwama kw’omonwa oye kwamoigotia.
swahili: Tumbo la mtu litajaa kutokana na tunda la kinywa chake, atashibishwa mavuno yanayotokana na midomo yake.

english: Life and death are in the power of the tongue, and those who love it will eat its fruit.
ekegusii: Amakweri na obogima nigo bire ase chinguru chi’oromeme, na abwo banchete korokorera emeremo ’mbanyore okwama kwaye.
swahili: Mauti na uzima viko katika uwezo wa ulimi, nao waupendao watakula matunda yake.

english: He who finds a wife finds a good thing and obtains favor from the LORD.
ekegusii: Omonto onyorire omokungu omuya, oyio onyorire ekeegwa ekiya na ogwancherwa korwa ase Omonene.
swahili: Apataye mke apata kitu chema naye ajipatia kibali kwa Bwana.

english: The poor man pleads for mercy, but the rich man answers harshly.
ekegusii: Ekero omonto omotaka agokwana nigo agosorora, korende omonda nigo akoiraneria ase obotindi.
swahili: Mtu maskini huomba kuhurumiwa bali tajiri hujibu kwa ukali.

english: A man of many companions may come to ruin, but there is a friend who stays closer than a brother.
ekegusii: Omonto obwate abasani abange nigo akwerentera emechando, korende n’are omosani bw’ekeene baigwanaine kobua oyomwabo.
swahili: Mtu mwenye marafiki wengi wanaweza kumharibu, bali yuko rafiki aambatanaye na mtu kwa karibu kuliko ndugu.

english: With a wicked man comes contempt as well, and shame is accompanied by disgrace.
ekegusii: Ekero ogokora amabe kogocha, ogochaaywa nigo kogocha nakorokwo, na ogochaaywa okwo nigo kogocha n’obosooku.
swahili: Wakati uovu unapokuja, dharau huja pia, pamoja na aibu huja lawama.

english: The words of a man’s mouth are deep waters; the fountain of wisdom is a bubbling brook.
ekegusii: Amang’ana akorua ase omonwa bw’omonto nigo anga buna amaache ye chindiba. Ensoko y’obong’aini nigo enga buna amaache y’orooche akominyoka.
swahili: Maneno ya kinywa cha mwanadamu ni kina cha maji, bali chemchemi ya hekima ni kijito kinachobubujika.

english: Showing partiality to the wicked is not good, nor is depriving the innocent of justice.
ekegusii: Tari buya gwanchereria omokori amabe na gosaria ekiina ki’omonto omooronge.
swahili: Sio vizuri kumpendelea mtu mwovu, au kumnyima haki asiye na hatia.

english: A fool’s lips bring him strife, and his mouth invites a beating.
ekegusii: Chinkwana chi’omoriri nigo chikorenta eriomana, na omonwa oye nigo okorangeria ogoakwa.
swahili: Midomo ya mpumbavu humletea ugomvi na kinywa chake hualika kipigo.

english: A fool’s mouth is his ruin, and his lips are a snare to his soul.
ekegusii: Omonwa bw’omoriri nigo okomorentera ogosareka, ne chinkwana chiaye nigo chikoba omoeto ase are.
swahili: Kinywa cha mpumbavu ni uharibifu wake na midomo yake ni mtego kwa nafsi yake.

english: The words of a gossip are like choice morsels that go down into the inmost being.
ekegusii: Amang’ana y’omogenki nigo are buna endagera enyansu; naro nigo agotirimboka gochia ase enkoro ime.
swahili: Maneno ya mchongezi ni kama chakula kitamu; huingia sehemu za ndani sana za mtu.

english: Whoever is slothful in his work is brother to him who destroys.
ekegusii: Omonto ogokora emeremo yaye nobworo nigo are oyomwabo omosaria.
swahili: Mtu aliye mlegevu katika kazi yake ni ndugu na yule anayeharibu.

english: Better a poor man who walks with integrity than a fool whose lips are perverse.
ekegusii: Omonto omotaka ore omwegenwa nigo are omuya kobua oyore omong’ainereria ase chinkwana chiaye naende omoriri.
swahili: Afadhali mtu maskini ambaye mwenendo wake hauna lawama, kuliko mpumbavu ambaye midomo yake imepotoka.

english: Luxury is unseemly for a fool— how much worse for a slave to rule over princes!
ekegusii: Tari buya omonto omoriri amenye ase obogima bw’okwegokia; onye ere bo, tari buya nonya ng’ake ng’a omosomba agaambere abagaambi.
swahili: Haistahili mpumbavu kuishi katika anasa, itakuwa vibaya kiasi gani kwa mtumwa kuwatawala wakuu.

english: A man’s insight gives him patience, and his virtue is to overlook an offense.
ekegusii: Obong’aini bw’omonto nigo bokogera oremereria okogechigwa, na okoombia okomocha nigo kore obonene bwaye.
swahili: Hekima ya mtu humpa uvumilivu, ni kwa utukufu wake kusamehe makosa.

english: A king’s rage is like the roar of a lion, but his favor is like dew on the grass.
ekegusii: Ekero omorwoti abeire nekeririanda nigo anga buna endo ekoruma, korende ogwancherwa kwaye nigo konga buna riime rire ase obonyansi.
swahili: Ghadhabu ya mfalme ni kama mngurumo wa simba, bali wema wake ni kama umande juu ya nyasi.

english: A foolish son is his father’s ruin, and a quarrelsome wife is like a constant dripping.
ekegusii: Omwana omomura omoriri nigo akorentera ise amabe, na omokungu okona‐kwomana nigo anga buna amatoima y’embura akona‐gotonya.
swahili: Mwana mpumbavu ni maangamizi ya babaye, naye mke mgomvi ni kama kutonatona kusikoisha.

english: Houses and wealth are inherited from fathers, but a prudent wife is from the LORD.
ekegusii: Chinyomba ne chinibo nigo chire omwando abana bakonyora korwa ase abaise korende omokungu omong’aini nigo are ekeegwa korwa ase Omonene.
swahili: Nyumba na mali hurithiwa kutoka kwa wazazi, bali mke mwenye busara hutoka kwa Bwana.

english: Laziness brings on deep sleep, and an idle soul will suffer hunger.
ekegusii: Obworo nigo bokorentera omonto chitoro chindito, na omonto buna oyio goika abe nenchara.
swahili: Uvivu huleta usingizi mzito, naye mtu mzembe huona njaa.

english: He who keeps a commandment preserves his soul, but he who is careless in his ways will die.
ekegusii: Omonto orendete amachiiko, oyio nigo arendete obogima bwaye, korende oyo otari korenda chiinchera chiaye nigo arakwe.
swahili: Yeye ambaye hutii mafundisho huulinda uhai wake, bali yeye anayezidharau njia zake atakufa.

english: Kindness to the poor is a loan to the LORD, and He will repay the lender.
ekegusii: Omonto okororera omotaka amaabera, oyio nigo akorua singo ase Omonene, n’Omonene ’namoakane ase ogokora okwo kwaye.
swahili: Yeye amhurumiaye maskini humkopesha Bwana, naye atamtuza kwa aliyotenda.

english: Discipline your son, for in that there is hope; do not be party to his death.
ekegusii: Orokereria omwana oo omomura ase okomorongeyia ekero ogosemeria koreo, gose tobaisa komoganeria amakweri.
swahili: Mrudi mwanao, kwa maana katika hiyo kuna tumaini, usiwe mshirika katika mauti yake.

english: A man of great anger must pay the penalty; if you rescue him, you will have to do so again.
ekegusii: Omonto ore n’ekeririanda, ekeene goika anyore egesusuro; oise komotanga kagokora bobe nigo okomoseegeta.
swahili: Mtu mwenye kukasirika haraka ni lazima atapata adhabu yake, kama utamwokoa, itakubidi kufanya hivyo tena.

english: Even zeal is no good without knowledge, and he who hurries his footsteps misses the mark.
ekegusii: Tari buya omonto aborwe okomanya ase omoyo oye, na oy’okegeenda bwango, nigo agosira.
swahili: Sio vizuri kuwa na juhudi bila maarifa, wala kufanya haraka na kuikosa njia.

english: Listen to counsel and accept discipline, that you may be wise the rest of your days.
ekegusii: Igwera ogosemigwa naende bwanche okworokererigwa, igo nario oranyore obong’aini boragokoonye ase chingaki chire bosio.
swahili: Sikiliza mashauri na ukubali mafundisho, nawe mwishoni utakuwa na hekima.

english: Many plans are in a man’s heart, but the purpose of the LORD will prevail.
ekegusii: Emeroberio emenge nere ase enkoro y’omonto, korende nonya naboigo emeroberio y’Omonene nero eraikerane.
swahili: Kuna mipango mingi ndani ya moyo wa mtu, lakini kusudi la Bwana ndilo litakalosimama.

english: The desire of a man is loving devotion; better to be poor than a liar.
ekegusii: Okogania kw’omonto nigo gokworokia obuya bwaye, na omonto omotaka nigo are omuya mono kobua omonyaborimo.
swahili: Lile mtu alionealo shauku ni upendo usio na mwisho, afadhali kuwa maskini kuliko kuwa mwongo.

english: The fear of the LORD leads to life, that one may rest content, without visitation from harm.
ekegusii: Okomoiroka Omonene nigo gokorenta obogima, na omonto ore nokoiroka okwo nigo agoisaneka, gose amabe takomonyoora.
swahili: Kumcha Bwana huongoza kwenye uzima, kisha mtu hupumzika akiwa ameridhika, bila kuguswa na shida.

english: The slacker buries his hand in the dish; he will not even bring it back to his mouth.
ekegusii: Omonto omworo nigo akobeeka okoboko kwaye ase esani y’endagera, gose tagokoimokia gocha ase omonwa oye.
swahili: Mtu mvivu hutumbukiza mkono wake kwenye sahani, lakini hawezi hata kuupeleka kwenye kinywa chake!

english: Strike a mocker, and the simple will beware; rebuke the discerning man, and he will gain knowledge.
ekegusii: Aka omonto omonyacheche, na abanto batamanyeti amaange mbeorokererie korwa ase ayio; togonyera omonto ore n’okomanya, ere nigo aranyore chiseemi.
swahili: Mpige mwenye mzaha, naye mjinga atajifunza busara, mkemee mwenye ufahamu naye atapata maarifa.

english: He who assaults his father or evicts his mother is a son who brings shame and disgrace.
ekegusii: Omwana ore omotindi ase ise na ogoseria ng’ina, nigo akorenta obosooku na ogochaaya.
swahili: Yeye amwibiaye baba yake na kumfukuza mama yake ni mwana aletaye aibu na fedheha.

english: If you cease to hear instruction, my son, you will stray from the words of knowledge.
ekegusii: Omwana one, onye tokoigwera amorokererio nigo orasire korwa ase amang’ana akorenta chiseemi.
swahili: Mwanangu, ukiacha kusikiliza mafundisho, utatangatanga mbali na maneno ya maarifa.

english: A corrupt witness mocks justice, and a wicked mouth swallows iniquity.
ekegusii: Kirori omobe nigo agochecheria oboronge, na omonwa bw’omokori amabe nigo ogworerete ebibe.
swahili: Shahidi mla rushwa hudhihaki hukumu na kinywa cha mtu mwovu humeza ubaya kwa upesi.

english: Judgments are prepared for mockers, and beatings for the backs of fools.
ekegusii: Ekiina ki’abanyacheche nigo kenachire, na abariri ’mbang’wanigwe ebiranya ase emegongo yabo.
swahili: Adhabu zimeandaliwa kwa ajili ya wenye dhihaka na mapigo kwa ajili ya migongo ya wapumbavu.

english: A man’s own folly subverts his way, yet his heart rages against the LORD.
ekegusii: Ase oboriri bw’omonto nigo agwesiria ase chiinchera chiaye omonyene, erio enkoro y’omonto oyio yamomochia Omonene.
swahili: Upumbavu wa mtu mwenyewe huharibu maisha yake hata hivyo moyo wake humkasirikia Bwana.

english: Wealth attracts many friends, but a poor man is deserted by his friend.
ekegusii: Omonto omonda nigo akonyora abasani abange, korende omotaka nigo akwangwa nomosani oye.
swahili: Mali huleta marafiki wengi, bali rafiki wa mtu maskini humwacha.

english: A false witness will not go unpunished, and one who utters lies will not escape.
ekegusii: Kirori bw’oborimo takomocha konyora egesusuro, na omonto ogokwana oborimo takomocha konyora egesusuro kiaye.
swahili: Shahidi wa uongo hataacha kuadhibiwa, naye amwagaye uongo hataachwa huru.

english: Many seek the favor of the prince, and everyone is a friend of the gift giver.
ekegusii: Abanto abange nigo bakorigia ogwanchwa na abanene, na abange nigo bakoba abasani b’omonto okorua ebiegwa n’omoyo omorabu.
swahili: Wengi hujipendekeza kwa mtawala na kila mmoja ni rafiki wa mtu atoaye zawadi.

english: All the brothers of a poor man hate him— how much more do his friends avoid him! He may pursue them with pleading, but they are nowhere to be found.
ekegusii: Omonto omotaka nigo akogechwa nabaanto bamwabo bonsi, gose tikori ogokumia ng’a abasani baye bamotigire. Nigo egenete amang’ana abo, ko aba bosa ase are.
swahili: Mtu maskini huepukwa na ndugu zake wote: Je, marafiki zake watamkwepa kiasi gani! Ingawa huwafuata kwa kuwasihi, hawapatikani popote.

english: He who acquires wisdom loves himself; one who safeguards understanding will find success.
ekegusii: Omonto okonyora obong’aini, oyio nere obwanchire obogima bwaye, na oyo okorenda obomanyi bwaye nanyore amaya.
swahili: Yeye apataye hekima huipenda nafsi yake mwenyewe, yeye ahifadhiye ufahamu hustawi.

english: A false witness will not go unpunished, and one who pours out lies will perish.
ekegusii: Kirori bw’oborimo takomocha konyora egesusuro, na oyo ogokwana oborimo goika asire.
swahili: Shahidi wa uongo hataacha kuadhibiwa, naye amwagaye uongo ataangamia.

english: These are the proverbs of Solomon son of David, king of Israel,
ekegusii: Eye nero emebayeno ya Sulemani mosinto o Daudi, omorwoti bw’Abaisraeli.
swahili: Mithali za Solomoni mwana wa Daudi, mfalme wa Israeli:

english: My son, if sinners entice you, do not yield to them.
ekegusii: Omwana one, abanyabibe kobarakoebererie ng’a mobwatane nabarabwo, tobaisa gwancha.
swahili: Mwanangu, kama wenye dhambi wakikushawishi, usikubaliane nao.

english: If they say, “Come along, let us lie in wait for blood, let us ambush the innocent without cause,
ekegusii: Baise kogoteebia, “Inchuo ogeende amo naintwe; toboere abanto tobaite, toumokere onde bwensi otari na komocha.
swahili: Kama wakisema, “Twende tufuatane; tukamvizie mtu na kumwaga damu, njoo tukavizie nafsi isiyo na hatia;

english: let us swallow them alive like Sheol, and whole like those descending into the Pit.
ekegusii: Inchuo tobamere kobare moyo, buna aase abakuure akomera, bageende abagima ase embeera.
swahili: tuwameze wakiwa hai kama kaburi, wakiwa wazima kama wale wanaotumbukia shimoni.

english: We will find all manner of precious goods; we will fill our houses with plunder.
ekegusii: Erio tonyore chinibo chionsi chie rigori rinene, toichorie chinyomba chiaito nebisakorwa ebio.
swahili: Tutapata aina zote za vitu vya thamani na kujaza nyumba zetu kwa nyara.

english: Throw in your lot with us; let us all share one purse”—
