ekegusii: Inchuo obwatane amo naintwe; tobe n’ekegaancha ekemo.”
swahili: Njoo ushirikiane nasi, vitu vyote tutakavyopata tutagawana.”

english: my son, do not walk the road with them or set foot upon their path.
ekegusii: Omwana one, tobaisa gotaara amo nabarabwo. Otange okogoro kwao tikobaisa gotacha ase bagoeta,
swahili: Mwanangu, usiandamane nao. Usiweke mguu wako katika njia zao,

english: For their feet run to evil, and they are swift to shed blood.
ekegusii: ekiagera amagoro abo nigo akominyoka gochia ase ogokora amabe, na nigo bare abaango ase ogoitera amanyinga.
swahili: kwa kuwa miguu yao hukimbilia kwenye dhambi, ni wepesi kumwaga damu.

english: How futile it is to spread the net where any bird can see it!
ekegusii: Nigo ere bosa gotegera chinyoni ebisugunia ekero chibiroche.
swahili: Tazama ni jinsi gani ilivyo kazi bure kutandaza wavu wakati ndege wote wanakuona!

english: But they lie in wait for their own blood; they ambush their own lives.
ekegusii: Abanto abwo nigo bakoboera goitera amanyinga abo abanyene, na koumokera obogima bwabo abanyene.
swahili: Watu hawa huvizia kumwaga damu yao wenyewe; hujivizia tu wenyewe!

english: Such is the fate of all who are greedy, whose unjust gain takes the lives of its possessors. Wisdom Calls Aloud
ekegusii: Naboigo omoerio bwe chiinchera chiabo ore, baria baganetie konyora chinibo ase ribero. Chinibo chiria nigo chigosiria obogima bw’abwo bagochinyora. Obong’aini Nkorangeria Bore
swahili: Huu ndio mwisho wa wote ambao wanajipatia mali kwa hila; huuondoa uhai wa wale wenye mali. Onyo Dhidi Ya Kukataa Hekima

english: for gaining wisdom and discipline, for comprehending words of insight,
ekegusii: Emebayeno eyio eragere abanto bamanye obong’aini na amorokererio y’okorongeyia, naende bamanye amang’ana are nengeencho.
swahili: Kwa kupata hekima na nidhamu; kwa kufahamu maneno ya busara;

english: Wisdom calls out in the street, she lifts her voice in the square;
ekegusii: Obong’aini nigo bogoaka eriogi rinene ase chiinchera, boigo nase chichiiro.
swahili: Hekima huita kwa sauti kuu barabarani, hupaza sauti yake kwenye viwanja vikubwa;

english: in the main concourse she cries aloud, at the city gates she makes her speech:
ekegusii: Nigo bogoaka eriogi rinene ase emesangererekano emenene y’abanto, naende ase ebiita bi’emechie, bwateeba.
swahili: kwenye makutano ya barabara za mji zenye makelele mengi hupaza sauti, kwenye malango ya mji hutoa hotuba yake:

english: “How long, O simple ones, will you love your simple ways? How long will scoffers delight in their scorn and fools hate knowledge?
ekegusii: “Ngoika ririri inwe abamotamanyeti amaange moranche ogotamanya kwaino? Ngoika ririri abachecheria baregokie nogochecheria kwabo, na abariri bageche chiseemi?
swahili: “Enyi wajinga, mtangʼangʼania ujinga wenu hadi lini? Mpaka lini wenye mizaha watafurahia mizaha, na wapumbavu kuchukia maarifa?

english: If you had repented at my rebuke, then surely I would have poured out my spirit on you; I would have made my words known to you.
ekegusii: Moise koonchoka moigwe ogokuurera kw’ane, rirorio nimbaiterere omoika one, ’mbamanyie amang’ana ane.
swahili: Kama mngekuwa mmeitikia karipio langu, ningekuwa nimemimina roho yangu kwenu na kuwafahamisha maneno yangu.

english: Because you refused my call, and no one took my outstretched hand,
ekegusii: Nabeire ’nkobarangeria, korende mwangire konyigwera; nabeire ’nkorambora okoboko kw’ane, korende monto onde tari okorigereirie.
swahili: Lakini kwa kuwa mlinikataa nilipowaita na hakuna yeyote aliyekubali niliponyoosha mkono wangu,

english: because you neglected all my counsel, and wanted none of my correction,
ekegusii: Mwachaayire ogoseemia kw’ane gwonsi, gose onde tari oigwerete ogokuurera kw’ane.
swahili: kwa kuwa mliyapuuza mashauri yangu yote na hamkukubali karipio langu,

english: in turn I will mock your calamity; I will sneer when terror strikes you,
ekegusii: Ase ayio inche nimbasekerere ekero emechando erabachere. Nimbachecherie ekero obwoba borabaachere;
swahili: mimi nami nitawacheka katika maafa yenu, nitawadhihaki wakati janga litawapata:

english: when your dread comes like a storm, and your destruction like a whirlwind, when distress and anguish overwhelm you.
ekegusii: ee, ekero obwoba borabaachere buna ekembugu‐mbugu, na emechando buna ekerambauti, boigo ekero obokong’u na omoichano birabaachere.
swahili: wakati janga litawapata kama tufani, wakati maafa yatawazoa kama upepo wa kisulisuli, wakati dhiki na taabu zitawalemea.

english: Then they will call on me, but I will not answer; they will earnestly seek me, but will not find me.
ekegusii: Erio barabwo ’mbandangerie, korende tinkobaigwa; ’mbandigie, korende tibakonyora inche.
swahili: “Ndipo watakaponiita lakini sitawajibu; watanitafuta lakini hawatanipata.

english: For they hated knowledge and chose not to fear the LORD.
ekegusii: Barabwo nigo bageechete chiseemi tibancheti komoiroka Omonene.
swahili: Kwa kuwa walichukia maarifa, wala hawakuchagua kumcha Bwana,

english: and for receiving instruction in wise living and in righteousness, justice, and equity.
ekegusii: Korwa ase ero abanto mbanyore amorokererio akorenta obong’aini, na oboronge, na ekeene, na ogokora kw’oboronge.
swahili: kwa kujipatia nidhamu na busara, kufanya lililo sawa, haki na bila kupendelea;

english: They accepted none of my counsel; they despised all my reproof.
ekegusii: Tibancheti koigwera ring’ana riane ri’okobaseemia nonya nerimo; nigo bachaayete ogokuurera kw’ane gwonsi.
swahili: kwa kuwa hawakukubali mashauri yangu, na kukataa maonyo yangu,

english: So they will eat the fruit of their own way, and be filled with their own devices.
ekegusii: Ase ayio ’mbarie okwama kw’ogokora kwabo, baisaneke n’emeroberio yabo abanyene
swahili: watakula matunda ya njia zao, na watashibishwa matunda ya hila zao.

english: For the waywardness of the simple will slay them, and the complacency of fools will destroy them.
ekegusii: Okoirana magega kw’abwo batamanyeti amaange ’nkobaite, na ogoisaneka kw’abariri ’nkobasirie barabwo abanyene.
swahili: Kwa kuwa ukaidi wa wajinga utawaua, nako kuridhika kwa wajinga kutawaangamiza.

english: But whoever listens to me will dwell in safety, secure from the fear of evil.”
ekegusii: Korende monto onde bwensi oranyigwere namenye ase omorembe, ere nabe n’obotoereru na takoiroka bobe bonde.”
swahili: Lakini yeyote anisikilizaye ataishi kwa usalama, atatulia, bila kuwa na hofu ya madhara.”

english: let the wise listen and gain instruction, and the discerning acquire wise counsel
ekegusii: Ase okoigwa emebayeno eyio omonto omong’aini nigo akong’ainia goetania, na oyore nobomanyi bwenyorera ogosemigwa okuya.
swahili: wenye hekima na wasikilize nao waongeze elimu yao, wenye kupambanua na wapate mwongozo;

english: by understanding the proverbs and parables, the sayings and riddles of the wise.
ekegusii: Korwa ase emebayeno eyio abanto ’mbanyaare kweorokereria emebayeno na eki egoteeba; boigo ’mbamanye amang’ana y’abanto abang’aini na emebayeno yabo. Ogoseemia Ekiare Egeke
swahili: kwa kufahamu mithali na mifano, misemo na vitendawili vya wenye hekima.

english: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge, but fools despise wisdom and discipline. The Enticement of Sin
ekegusii: Okomoiroka Omonene, n’oro omochakano bwe chiseemi. Abariri nigo bagochaaya obong’aini na amorokererio.
swahili: Kumcha Bwana ndicho chanzo cha maarifa, lakini wapumbavu hudharau hekima na adabu. Onyo Dhidi Ya Ushawishi Wa Marafiki Waovu

english: Listen, my son, to your father’s instruction, and do not forsake the teaching of your mother.
ekegusii: Omwana one, igwera amorokererio a iso, na tobaisa gotiga aria nyoko akogochika.
swahili: Mwanangu, sikiliza mwongozo wa baba yako, wala usiyaache mafundisho ya mama yako.

english: For they are a garland of grace on your head and a pendant around your neck.
ekegusii: Ayio nigo arabe buna egetinti gechabeire ase omotwe oo, na buna chisonoi chingiya chire ase rigoti ria’o.
swahili: Hayo yatakuwa taji la maua la neema kichwani pako, na mkufu wa kuipamba shingo yako.

english: Wine is a mocker, strong drink is a brawler, and whoever is led astray by them is not wise.
ekegusii: Edivai nigo ekorenta echeche, ekenyugwa egetindi nigo gekorenta eriomana; na onde bwensi otari gokianga nigo akoborwa obong’aini.
swahili: Mvinyo ni mdhihaki na kileo ni mgomvi; yeyote apotoshwaye navyo hana hekima.

english: Differing weights and unequal measures — both are detestable to the LORD.
ekegusii: Ebirengero bi’oborito, na ebi’obonge, bire ara kabere, nigo bire okogechia ase Omonene.
swahili: Mawe ya kupimia yaliyo tofauti na vipimo tofauti, Bwana huchukia vyote viwili.

english: Even a young man is known by his actions— whether his conduct is pure and upright.
ekegusii: Nonya nomwana nigo amanyekanete ase ogokora kwaye, gose orogendo rw’aye nigo rorabe ororonge na orw’ekeene.
swahili: Hata mtoto hujulikana kwa matendo yake, kama tabia yake ni safi na adili.

english: Ears that hear and eyes that see— the LORD has made them both.
ekegusii: Ogoto gokoigwa, na eriiso rikorora, bionsi bibere ’Omonene obikorete.
swahili: Masikio yasikiayo na macho yaonayo, Bwana ndiye alivifanya vyote viwili.

english: Do not love sleep, or you will grow poor; open your eyes, and you will have plenty of food.
ekegusii: Tobaisa gwancha chitoro, obaise koba omotaka; ramokia amaiso ao, naye ’nonyore endagera enyinge.
swahili: Usiupende usingizi la sivyo utakuwa maskini, uwe macho nawe utakuwa na chakula cha akiba.

english: “Worthless, worthless!” says the buyer, but on the way out, he gloats.
ekegusii: Omogori egento nigo agoteeba: “Eke tigeisaini gento”, na ekero akeirire bwetogia.
swahili: “Haifai, haifai!” asema mnunuzi, kisha huondoka akijisifia ununuzi wake.

english: There is an abundance of gold and rubies, but lips of knowledge are a rare treasure.
ekegusii: Etaabu nereo, na amagena amaange ye rigori rinene, korende ebikoba bigokwana ay’obong’aini nigo binga buna amagena ye rigori rinene akomeka‐meka.
swahili: Dhahabu kunayo, na marijani kwa wingi, lakini midomo inenayo maarifa ni kito cha thamani kilicho adimu.

english: Take the garment of the one who posts security for a stranger; get collateral if it is for a foreigner.
ekegusii: Bogoria eanga y’omonto bwerure koba intenenera ase omonto onde, ira biria abwate, ekiagera bwerure ase engencho y’omonto otamanyekaneti.
swahili: Chukua vazi la yule awekaye dhamana kwa ajili ya mgeni; lishikilie iwe dhamana kama anafanya hivyo kwa ajili ya mwanamke mpotovu.

english: Food gained by fraud is sweet to a man, but later his mouth is full of gravel.
ekegusii: Endagera ekonyorwa ase enchera y’obong’ainereria, nigo ekoba enyansu ase omonto, korende magega yaye omonwa bw’omonto oyio nigo ogoichorwa n’omokenye.
swahili: Chakula kilichopatikana kwa hila ni kitamu kwa mwanadamu, bali huishia na kinywa kilichojaa changarawe.

english: Set plans by consultation, and wage war under sound guidance.
ekegusii: Emeroberio nigo egoikeranigwa goetera ase ogoseemia okuya na gokorwana esegi, yerwane n’obosemia obuya.
swahili: Fanya mipango kwa kutafuta mashauri, ukipigana vita, tafuta maelekezo.

english: He who reveals secrets is a constant gossip; avoid the one who babbles with his lips.
ekegusii: Omonto okona‐goeta‐etia obogenki nigo akoorokia obobisi, ase ayio tobaisa kobwatana n’omonto otari kweriita ase amang’ana aye.
swahili: Maneno ya kusengenya husababisha kutokuaminika, kwa hiyo mwepuke mtu anayezungumza kupita kiasi.

english: The terror of a king is like the roar of a lion; whoever provokes him forfeits his own life.
ekegusii: Okogosa kw’omorwoti nigo konga buna okoruma kw’endo, na oyo okomogechia oba n’endamwamu, oyio nigo akogera obogima bwaye bosirigwe.
swahili: Ghadhabu ya mfalme ni kama ngurumo ya simba; yeye amkasirishaye hupoteza uhai wake.

english: Whoever curses his father or mother, his lamp will be extinguished in deepest darkness.
ekegusii: Omonto oraragererie ise, gose ng’ina, oyio etaya yaye nerimigwe ekero ki’omosuunte ekerima.
swahili: Ikiwa mtu atamlaani baba yake au mama yake, taa yake itazimwa katika giza nene.

english: An inheritance gained quickly will not be blessed in the end.
ekegusii: Oise gosanera konyora omwando bwango korwa omochakano, omoerio oye tori gosesenigwa.
swahili: Urithi upatikanao haraka mwanzoni, hautabarikiwa mwishoni.

english: Do not say, “I will avenge this evil!” Wait on the LORD, and He will save you.
ekegusii: Tobaisa goteeba, “Goika ng’akane amabe nakoreirwe.” Oganye Omonene, nere oragokoonye.
swahili: Usiseme, “Nitakulipiza kwa ajili ya kosa hili!” Mngojee Bwana, naye atakuokoa.

english: Unequal weights are detestable to the LORD, and dishonest scales are no good.
ekegusii: Ebirengo bi’oborito bire ara kabere nigo bire okogechia ase Omonene, na ekerengero kioboriania nigo kere ekebe.
swahili: Bwana anachukia sana mawe ya kupimia ya udanganyifu, nazo mizani zisizo halali hazimpendezi.

english: A man’s steps are from the LORD, so how can anyone understand his own way?
ekegusii: Omonene nere okoraa chiinchera chi’omonto, ase ayio ’naki omonto aranyare komanya chiinchera chiaye?
swahili: Hatua za mtu huongozwa na Bwana. Anawezaje basi mtu yeyote kuelewa njia yake mwenyewe?

english: It is a trap for a man to dedicate something rashly, only later to reconsider his vows.
ekegusii: Nigo ekoba omoeto ase omonto karabe omwango ase ogwatanana egento kebe egechenu, na magega yaye oba okorengereria aya arierete eira.
swahili: Ni mtego kwa mtu kuweka wakfu kitu kwa haraka na baada ya kitambo kidogo kufikiria tena nadhiri zake.

english: A wise king separates out the wicked and drives the threshing wheel over them.
ekegusii: Omorwoti ore omong’aini nigo akomanya abakori amabe obaatanana, erio obatacha n’amagoro ye chigaari.
swahili: Mfalme mwenye hekima hupepeta waovu, hulipitisha gurudumu la kupuria juu yao.

english: The spirit of a man is the lamp of the LORD, searching out his inmost being.
ekegusii: Omoika ore ase omonto, n’oro etaya y’Omonene; nigo ekomoreka na komanya amang’ana onsi are ime y’enkoro y’omonto.
swahili: Taa ya Bwana huchunguza roho ya mwanadamu, huchunguza utu wake wa ndani.

english: Loving devotion and faithfulness preserve a king; by these he maintains his throne.
ekegusii: Obuya na obwegenwa, nabio bikorenda omorwoti, na ekerogo kiaye ki’obogaambi nigo kegokong’igwa namaabera.
swahili: Upendo na uaminifu humweka mfalme salama, kwa njia ya upendo, kiti chake cha enzi huwa salama.

english: The glory of young men is their strength, and gray hair is the splendor of the old.
ekegusii: Chinguru nachio chire obonene bw’abamura, korende chimbuche nigo chire obwari bw’abaanto abagotu.
swahili: Utukufu wa vijana ni nguvu zao, mvi ni fahari ya uzee.

english: It is honorable for a man to resolve a dispute, but any fool will quarrel.
ekegusii: Nigo are amasikani ase omonto ogwetanga korwa ase eriomana, korende kera omonto ore omoriri nigo akona‐kwomana.
swahili: Ni kwa heshima ya mtu kujitenga ugomvi, bali kila mpumbavu ni mwepesi kugombana.

english: Lashes and wounds scour evil, and beatings cleanse the inmost parts.
ekegusii: Obororo bw’ogoakwa nenyimbo nigo bogosibia ebibe, boigo ogoakwa kw’ebiranya nigo kogosoa ase enkoro ime kwayesibia.
swahili: Mapigo na majeraha huusafisha ubaya, nayo michapo hutakasa utu wa ndani.

english: The slacker does not plow in season; at harvest time he looks, but nothing is there.
ekegusii: Omonto omworo tari korema omogondo ase engaki egwenerete, na ekero rigesa riaikire, ere gakogeenda korata, takonyora gento.
swahili: Mvivu halimi kwa majira; kwa hiyo wakati wa mavuno hutazama lakini hapati chochote.

english: The intentions of a man’s heart are deep waters, but a man of understanding draws them out.
ekegusii: Emeroberio ere ase enkoro y’omonto nigo enga buna amaache are ase endiba, korende omonto ore nokomanya nigo akoyabuucha korwa aroro.
swahili: Makusudi ya moyo wa mwanadamu ni maji yenye kina, lakini mtu mwenye ufahamu huyachota.

english: Many a man proclaims his loving devotion, but who can find a trustworthy man?
ekegusii: Abanto abange nigo bakweraria ng’a nabaya bare, korende ning’o oranyaare konyora omonto omwegenwa bori?
swahili: Watu wengi hujidai kuwa na upendo usiokoma, bali mtu mwaminifu ni nani awezaye kumpata?

english: The righteous man walks with integrity; blessed are his children after him.
ekegusii: Omonto omonyene oboronge obwatetie chiinchera chindonge, abana baye ’mbasesenigwe korwa magega yaye.
swahili: Mtu mwenye haki huishi maisha yasiyo na lawama, wamebarikiwa watoto wake baada yake.

english: A king who sits on a throne to judge sifts out all evil with his eyes.
ekegusii: Omorwoti ogoikaransa ase ekerogo kiaye gi’ekegaambero nigo agoserebania amabe onsi namaiso aye.
swahili: Wakati mfalme aketipo katika kiti chake cha enzi kuhukumu, hupepeta ubaya wote kwa macho yake.

english: Who can say, “I have kept my heart pure; I am cleansed from my sin”?
ekegusii: Ning’o oranyaare goteeba, “Nasibekire ase enkoro y’ane; nachenekire korwa ase ebibe biane”?
swahili: Ni nani awezaye kusema, “Nimeuweka moyo wangu safi; mimi ni safi na sina dhambi?”

english: The king’s heart is a waterway in the hand of the LORD; He directs it where He pleases.
ekegusii: Enkoro y’omorwoti nigo enga buna orooche rore ase okoboko kw’Omonene; n’Omonene nigo akomoraa gochia aande onsi buna aganetie.
swahili: Moyo wa mfalme uko katika mkono wa Bwana; huuongoza kama mkondo wa maji, popote apendapo.

english: The soul of the wicked man craves evil; his neighbor finds no favor in his eyes.
ekegusii: Omoyo bw’omokori amabe nigo okogania gokora ebibe, na omonto oyio tari kororera omonto onde amaabera.
swahili: Mtu mwovu hutamani sana ubaya, jirani yake hapati huruma kutoka kwake.

english: When a mocker is punished, the simple gain wisdom; and when a wise man is instructed, he acquires knowledge.
ekegusii: Ekero omonto omonyacheche akonyora egesusuro, oria otamanyeti amaange nigo akoba omong’aini; na ekero omonto omong’aini akworokererigwa nigo akonyora chiseemi.
swahili: Wakati mwenye mzaha ameadhibiwa, mjinga hupata hekima; wakati mtu mwenye hekima afundishwapo, hupata maarifa.

english: The Righteous One considers the house of the wicked and brings the wicked to ruin.
ekegusii: Nyasae omonyene oboronge nigo akorigereria enyomba y’omokori amabe; ere nigo akoiyeria abakori amabe inse basire.
swahili: Mwenye Haki huyajua yanayotendeka katika nyumba za waovu, naye atawaangamiza waovu.

english: Whoever shuts his ears to the cry of the poor, he too shall cry out and receive no answer.
ekegusii: Omonto oria ogosieka amato aye ng’a taigwa ekerero ki’omotaka, nere ekero ararere takoiguugwa.
swahili: Mtu akiziba masikio asisikie kilio cha maskini, yeye pia atalia, wala hatajibiwa.

english: A gift in secret soothes anger, and a covert bribe pacifies great wrath.
ekegusii: Ekeegwa gekoruegwa bobisi nigo kegokendia endamwamu, ne riaaki ribisire ase eanga ime nigo rigokendia ekeririanda.
swahili: Zawadi itolewayo kwa siri hutuliza hasira na rushwa iliyofichwa kwenye nguo hutuliza ghadhabu kali.

english: Justice executed is a joy to the righteous, but a terror to the workers of iniquity.
ekegusii: Ekero ekeene giakorirwe, ayio nigo akoba omogooko bw’abanyene oboronge, korende ase abakori amabe nomoichano.
swahili: Wakati haki imetendeka, huleta furaha kwa wenye haki, bali kitisho kwa watenda mabaya.

english: The man who strays from the path of understanding will rest in the assembly of the dead.
ekegusii: Omonto ogotiga enchera y’obomanyi, oyio nabeere ase omosangererekano bw’abaanto bakwete.
swahili: Mtu anayepotea kutoka mapito ya ufahamu, hupumzika katika kundi la waliokufa.

english: He who loves pleasure will become poor; the one who loves wine and oil will never be rich.
ekegusii: Omonto bwanchete emegoko goika abe omotaka; na oyobwanchete kwegokia nedivai na amaguta takoba omonda.
swahili: Mtu apendaye anasa atakuwa maskini, yeyote apendaye mvinyo na mafuta kamwe hatakuwa tajiri.

english: The wicked become a ransom for the righteous, and the faithless for the upright.
ekegusii: Omokori amabe nigo agosoa ase emechando y’omonyene oboronge, oba embooria yaye, na oyo otari omwegenwa oba embooria y’oyore n’enkoro endonge.
swahili: Waovu huwa fidia kwa ajili ya wenye haki, nao wasio waaminifu kwa ajili ya wanyofu.

english: Better to live in the desert than with a contentious and ill-tempered wife.
ekegusii: Mbuya komenya ase ense y’erooro, kobua komenya n’omokuungu omonyariomana, naende omonyandamwamu.
swahili: Ni afadhali kuishi jangwani kuliko kuishi na mke mgomvi na mkorofi.

english: All a man’s ways seem right to him, but the LORD weighs the heart.
ekegusii: Kera enchera y’omonto nigo ekororekana ng’a neya boronge ase are, korende Omonene nigo akorenga chinkoro.
swahili: Njia zote za mwanadamu huonekana sawa kwake, bali Bwana huupima moyo.

english: Precious treasures and oil are in the dwelling of the wise, but a foolish man consumes them.
ekegusii: Omonto omong’aini nigo akorenda chinibo chi’engeencho enene amo namaguta ase enka yaye, korende omoriri nigo agochiria bobe chiaera.
swahili: Katika nyumba ya mwenye hekima kuna akiba ya vyakula vizuri na mafuta, lakini mtu mpumbavu hutafuna vyote alivyo navyo.

english: He who pursues righteousness and loving devotion finds life, righteousness, and honor.
ekegusii: Omonto okorigia oboronge na obwororo, oyio ’nanyore obogima, na amasikani, na oboronge.
swahili: Yeye afuatiaye haki na upendo hupata uzima, mafanikio na heshima.

english: A wise man scales the city of the mighty and pulls down the stronghold in which they trust.
ekegusii: Omonto omong’aini nigo akoumokera omochie ore nabarwani esegi chituoni oyobua, erio otagora chindwaki chiria abanto abwo basemeretie.
swahili: Mtu mwenye hekima huushambulia mji wa wenye nguvu, na kuangusha ngome wanazozitegemea.

english: He who guards his mouth and tongue keeps his soul from distress.
ekegusii: Omonto orendete omonwa oye, na oromeme rw’aye, oyio nigo etangerete emechando.
swahili: Yeye alindaye kinywa chake na ulimi wake hujilinda na maafa.

english: Mocker is the name of the proud and arrogant man— of him who acts with excessive pride.
ekegusii: Omonto ore omoenenu na omwerori, na ogokora kwaye kore okw’obomwenu, nigo akorokwa “Omochecheria”.
swahili: Mtu mwenye kiburi na majivuno, “Mdhihaki” ndilo jina lake; hutenda mambo kwa kiburi kilichozidi.

english: The craving of the slacker kills him because his hands refuse to work.
ekegusii: Okogania kw’omonto omworo nigo gokomoita okwa, ekiagera nigo akwanga gokora emeremo namaboko aye.
swahili: Kutamani sana kwa mvivu kutakuwa kifo chake, kwa sababu mikono yake haitaki kufanya kazi.

english: All day long he covets more, but the righteous give without restraint.
ekegusii: Omonto omong’iti nigo akweganeria kera egento botambe, korende omonyene oboronge nigo akorua na tari kong’itia.
swahili: Mchana kutwa hutamani zaidi, lakini mnyofu hutoa pasipo kuzuia.

english: The sacrifice of the wicked is detestable— how much more so when brought with ill intent!
ekegusii: Ekeng’wanso ki’omokori amabe nigo kere okogechia, Inee, tari bobe mono goetania ekero agokerua nebirengererio ebibe?
swahili: Dhabihu ya mtu mwovu ni chukizo, si zaidi sana itolewapo kwa nia mbaya!

english: A lying witness will perish, but the man who listens to truth will speak forever.
ekegusii: Kirori bw’oborimo nasire, korende omotegereri omuya nageenderere gokwana.
swahili: Shahidi wa uongo ataangamia, bali maneno ya mwenye kusikia yatadumu.

english: A wicked man hardens his face, but the upright man makes his way sure.
ekegusii: Omokori amabe nigo agokong’ia obosio bwaye, korende oyore nenkoro endonge nigo akorenda orogendo rw’aye.
swahili: Mtu mwovu ana uso wa ushupavu, bali mtu mnyofu huzifikiria njia zake.

english: To do righteousness and justice is more desirable to the LORD than sacrifice.
ekegusii: Ogokora oboronge na ekeene, ayio naro Omonene agwancha kobua ebing’wanso.
swahili: Kufanya yaliyo sawa na haki inakubalika zaidi kwa Bwana kuliko dhabihu.

english: There is no wisdom, no understanding, no counsel that can prevail against the LORD.
ekegusii: Obong’aini tibori, gose okomanya, gose ogoseemia, biranyaare koamererania n’Omonene.
swahili: Hakuna hekima, wala akili, wala mpango unaoweza kufaulu dhidi ya Bwana.

english: A horse is prepared for the day of battle, but victory is of the LORD.
ekegusii: Chibarasi nigo chikobekwa ang’e kogeenda korwana esegi, korende obobui nigo bokorua ase Omonene.
swahili: Farasi huandaliwa kwa ajili ya siku ya vita, bali ushindi huwa kwa Bwana.

english: Haughty eyes and a proud heart— the guides of the wicked—are sin.
ekegusii: Amaiso are noboenenu, na enkoro y’obomwenu, ebio nigo bire etaya y’abakori amabe, bikobaraa bakora ebibe.
swahili: Macho ya kudharau na moyo wa kiburi, ambavyo ni taa ya waovu, vyote ni dhambi!

english: The plans of the diligent bring plenty, as surely as haste leads to poverty.
ekegusii: Emeroberio y’omonto omong’aini nigo ekomorentera ebitoki ebinge, korende omonto okoayerera nigo akogeenderera koremerwa.
swahili: Mipango ya mwenye bidii huelekeza kwenye faida, kama vile kwa hakika pupa huelekeza kwenye umaskini.

english: Making a fortune by a lying tongue is a vanishing mist, a deadly pursuit.
ekegusii: Chinibo chikonyorwa ase oromeme rw’obong’ainereria, nigo chikoera buna omooki, nigo chire n’obosongo buna emetego ya amakweri.
swahili: Mali iliyopatikana kwa ulimi wa uongo ni mvuke upitao upesi na mtego wa kufisha.

english: The violence of the wicked will sweep them away because they refuse to do what is just.
ekegusii: Obourereria bw’abakori amabe ’mbobasirie barueo, ekiagera bangire gokora ayare ay’oboronge.
swahili: Jeuri ya waovu itawaburuta mbali, kwa kuwa wanakataa kufanya yaliyo sawa.

english: The way of a guilty man is crooked, but the conduct of the innocent is upright.
ekegusii: Enchera y’omomochi nigo ere enkorekanu, korende ogokora kw’oyore n’enkoro endonge nigo kore okoronge.
swahili: Njia ya mwenye hatia ni ya upotovu, bali tabia ya mtu asiye na hatia ni nyofu.

english: Better to live on a corner of the roof than to share a house with a quarrelsome wife.
ekegusii: Mbuya komenya ase ekenunchi kia irongo, kobua komenya amo ase enyomba n’omokuungu omonyariomana.
swahili: Ni afadhali kuishi pembeni mwa paa la nyumba, kuliko kuishi nyumba moja na mke mgomvi.

english: A good name is more desirable than great riches; favor is better than silver and gold.
ekegusii: Erieta rigiya nigo rigwenerete gochorwa kobua chinibo chinyinge, na ogwakwaneka okuya nigo kobuete efeta na etaabu.
swahili: Heri kuchagua jina jema kuliko utajiri mwingi, kuheshimiwa ni bora kuliko fedha au dhahabu.

english: Drive out the mocker, and conflict will depart; even quarreling and insults will cease.
ekegusii: Seria omonyacheche, na eriomana ndiere, ee, eriomana na ogochaaya ’mbisire.
swahili: Mfukuze mwenye dhihaka, na mvutano utatoweka; ugomvi na matukano vitakoma.

english: He who loves a pure heart and gracious lips will have the king for a friend.
ekegusii: Omonto bwanchete enkoro echenegete, na ebikoba biaye bigokwana ayare ay’obuya, omorwoti nabe omosani oye.
swahili: Yeye apendaye moyo safi na yeye ambaye maneno yake ni ya neema, mfalme atakuwa rafiki yake.

english: The LORD’s eyes keep watch over knowledge, but He frustrates the words of the faithless.
ekegusii: Amaiso a Omonene nigo arigereretie na korenda oyore nokomanya, korende nigo akoonchorana na gosaria amang’ana ya abatari abegenwa.
swahili: Macho ya Bwana hulinda maarifa, bali huyapinga maneno ya asiye mwaminifu.

english: The slacker says, “There is a lion outside! I will be slain in the streets!”
ekegusii: Omonto omworo nigo agoteeba, “Endo nere isiko! Nigo ndabaise gochia goiterwa ase chiinchera.”
swahili: Mvivu husema, “Yuko simba nje!” au, “Nitauawa katika mitaa!”

english: The mouth of an adulteress is a deep pit; he who is under the wrath of the LORD will fall into it.
ekegusii: Omonwa bw’omokuungu omotayayi nigo ore eirima entambe, na omonto onde bwensi Omonene agechiigwe nere goika agwe ase eirima eyio.
swahili: Kinywa cha mwanamke kahaba ni shimo refu; yeye aliye chini ya ghadhabu ya Bwana atatumbukia ndani yake.

english: Foolishness is bound up in the heart of a child, but the rod of discipline drives it far from him.
ekegusii: Oboriri nigo bosiberanirie ime ase enkoro y’omwana, korende ekeranya gekorongeyia amamocho nigo gekoborusiao.
swahili: Upumbavu umefungwa ndani ya moyo wa mtoto, bali fimbo ya adhabu itaufukuzia mbali naye.

english: Oppressing the poor to enrich oneself or giving gifts to the rich will surely lead to poverty. Thirty Sayings of the Wise Saying 1
ekegusii: Ere oyo ogokorera abataka bobe ase ogwetenenkia ere omonyene, gose okorua ebiegwa ase abanda, goika aremerwe. Amang’ana emerongo etato ay’obong’aini
swahili: Yeye amwoneaye maskini ili kujiongezea mali, naye ampaye tajiri zawadi, wote huwa maskini. Misemo Ya Wenye Hekima

english: Incline your ear and hear the words of the wise— apply your mind to my knowledge—
ekegusii: Tega ogoto kwao oigwe amang’ana abanto abang’aini bagokwana, na obeke amorokererio ane ime ase enkoro yao.
swahili: Tega sikio na usikie misemo ya wenye hekima, elekeza moyo wako kwenye yale nifundishayo,

english: for it is pleasing when you keep them within you and they are constantly on your lips.
ekegusii: Nigo erabe buya korayarende ime yao, erinde abe ang’e ase ebikoba biao koyakwana.
swahili: kwa maana inapendeza unapoyahifadhi moyoni mwako na kuwa nayo yote tayari midomoni mwako.

english: So that your trust may be in the LORD, I instruct you today—yes, you.
ekegusii: Rituko ria reero nakoyamanyirie, ee, nakoyamanyirie, erinde omosemerie Omonene.
swahili: Ili tumaini lako liwe katika Bwana, hata wewe, ninakufundisha leo.

english: The rich and the poor have this in common: The LORD is Maker of them all.
ekegusii: Omonda na omotaka nigo bamenyete ase obogima obomo; Omonene nere omotongi o bonsi.
swahili: Tajiri na maskini wanafanana kwa hili: Bwana ni Muumba wao wote.

english: Have I not written for you thirty sayings about counsel and knowledge,
ekegusii: Inee! Tinkoriikereti amang’ana amanene ay’ogoseemia na ay’amorokererio?
swahili: Je, sijakuandikia misemo thelathini, misemo ya mashauri na maarifa,

english: to show you true and reliable words, that you may soundly answer those who sent you? Saying 2
ekegusii: Ayio nakworokererie ayare ay’oboronge na ay’ekeene, erinde okwane ay’oboronge na ekeene ase abwo bagotomete. 1.
swahili: kukufundisha maneno ya kweli na ya kuaminika, ili uweze kutoa majibu sahihi kwake yeye aliyekutuma?

english: Do not rob a poor man because he is poor, and do not crush the afflicted at the gate,
ekegusii: Tobaisa koura omotaka ekiaye, ekiagera are omotaka, gose agwo ase egeita tobaisa komokorera bobe omonto ochaandegete.
swahili: Usiwadhulumu maskini kwa sababu ni maskini, wala kumdhulumu mhitaji mahakamani,

english: for the LORD will take up their case and will plunder those who rob them. Saying 3
ekegusii: Omonene narwanerere abataka, na abwo bakobaurereria nabasirie. 2.
swahili: kwa sababu Bwana atalichukua shauri lao naye atawateka wao waliowateka.

english: Do not make friends with an angry man, and do not associate with a hot-tempered man,
ekegusii: Tobaisa gokora obosani n’omonto ore omwango ase okobeea gose tobaisa kogeenda amo n’omonto ore nekeririanda.
swahili: Usifanye urafiki na mtu mwenye hasira ya haraka, usishirikiane na yule aliye mwepesi kukasirika,

english: or you may learn his ways and entangle yourself in a snare. Saying 4
ekegusii: Oise kobwatana noyio, nigo orenarie chiinchera chiaye, erio obwatwe ase omotego. 3.
swahili: la sivyo utajifunza njia zake na kujiingiza mwenyewe kwenye mtego.

english: Do not be one who gives pledges, who puts up security for debts.
ekegusii: Tobaisa koba oyomo bw’abaanto abwo bakobwatana amaboko, gose bakwerua koba intenenera ase chisira chi’abaanto bande.
swahili: Usiwe mwenye kupana mikono katika rehani, au kuweka dhamana kwa ajili ya madeni.

english: If you have nothing with which to pay, why should your bed be taken from under you? Saying 5
ekegusii: Nobaise kourwa oborere bwao okoraarera, ekiagera tobwati gento ogoakana. 4.
swahili: Kama ukikosa njia ya kulipa, kitanda chako kitachukuliwa ukiwa umekilalia.

english: Do not move an ancient boundary stone which your fathers have placed. Saying 6
ekegusii: Tobaisa gotuumana orobebe orokoro orwo chisokoro chiao chiabeegete. 5.
swahili: Usisogeze jiwe la mpaka wa zamani lililowekwa na baba zako.

english: Do you see a man skilled in his work? He will be stationed in the presence of kings; he will not stand before obscure men.
ekegusii: Oise korora omonto omanyete emeremo yaye buya, oyio natenene ase amasio y’abarwoti, tagokorera abanto bande emeremo.
swahili: Je, unamwona mtu stadi katika kazi yake? Atahudumu mbele ya wafalme; hatahudumu mbele ya watu duni.

english: The prudent see danger and take cover, but the simple keep going and suffer the consequences.
ekegusii: Omonto omong’aini nigo akororera emechando korwa aare, bwebisa, korende oy’otamanyeti amaange nigo akogeenderera gochia bosio, oumerana nero, erio ochaandeka.
swahili: Mtu mwenye busara huona hatari na kujificha, bali mjinga huendelea mbele kama kipofu nayo ikamtesa.

english: The rewards of humility and the fear of the LORD are wealth and honor and life.
ekegusii: Abare abaitongo bamoirogete Omonene nigo bakonyora obotenenku, na ogosikwa, na obogima.
swahili: Unyenyekevu na kumcha Bwana huleta utajiri, heshima na uzima.

english: Thorns and snares lie on the path of the perverse; he who guards his soul stays far from them.
ekegusii: Amagwa na emeeto nigo bitegire ase chiinchera chi’abaanto abakorekanu, korende oyo orendete omoyo oye goika eatanane korwa ase bire.
swahili: Katika mapito ya waovu kuna miiba na mitego, bali yeye ailindaye nafsi yake hukaa mbali nayo.

english: Train up a child in the way he should go, and when he is old he will not depart from it.
ekegusii: Orokereria omwana abwatie enchera egwenerete, na ekero abeire omogotu takoyetiga.
swahili: Mfundishe mtoto njia impasayo kuiendea, naye hataiacha hata akiwa mzee.

english: The rich rule over the poor, and the borrower is slave to the lender.
ekegusii: Omonto omonda nigo akogambera omotaka; na omonto ogosaba aegwe singo nigo akoba omosomba bw’oria omoa singo.
swahili: Matajiri huwatawala maskini naye akopaye ni mtumwa wa akopeshaye.

english: He who sows injustice will reap disaster, and the rod of his fury will be destroyed.
ekegusii: Oy’ogosimeka obobe, nagese ogosareka, na enyimbo y’endamwamu yaye nigo erasire bosa.
swahili: Yeye aupandaye uovu huvuna taabu, nayo fimbo ya ghadhabu yake itaangamizwa.

english: A generous man will be blessed, for he shares his bread with the poor.
ekegusii: Omonto obwate eriiso ri’amaabera nasesenigwe, ekiagera bwatananeire omotaka endagera.
swahili: Mtu mkarimu yeye mwenyewe atabarikiwa kwa kuwa hushiriki chakula chake na maskini.

english: When you sit down to dine with a ruler, consider carefully what is set before you,
ekegusii: Ekero ogoikaransa koria endagera amo nomogaambi, orengererie mono ng’a ning’o ore ase obosio bwao.
swahili: Uketipo kula chakula na mtawala, angalia vyema kile kilicho mbele yako,

english: Do not move an ancient boundary stone or encroach on the fields of the fatherless,
ekegusii: Tobaisa gotumana orobebe orokoro, gose totumana osoe ase emegondo ye chintakana,
swahili: Usisogeze jiwe la mpaka wa zamani wala kunyemelea kwenye mashamba ya yatima,

english: for their Redeemer is strong; He will take up their case against you. Saying 12
ekegusii: ekiagera Omobooria obo nigo are ne chinguru, ere nachirwanerere akorwanie aye. 11.
swahili: kwa kuwa Mtetezi wao ni mwenye nguvu, atalichukua shauri lao dhidi yako.

english: Apply your heart to instruction and your ears to words of knowledge. Saying 13
ekegusii: Karue enkoro y’ao oigwe amorokererio, na amato ao aigwe amang’ana ye chiseemi. 12.
swahili: Elekeza moyo wako kwenye mafundisho na masikio yako kwenye maneno ya maarifa.

english: Do not withhold discipline from a child; although you strike him with a rod, he will not die.
ekegusii: Tobaisa gotiga korongeyia omwana oo; koramoake ekeranya, tagochia gokwa.
swahili: Usimnyime mtoto adhabu, ukimwadhibu kwa fimbo, hatakufa.

english: Strike him with a rod, and you will deliver his soul from Sheol. Saying 14
ekegusii: Ee, koramoake ekeranya nigo oratoorie obogima bwaye korwa aase abakuure. 13.
swahili: Mwadhibu kwa fimbo na kuiokoa nafsi yake kutoka mautini.

english: My son, if your heart is wise, my own heart will indeed rejoice.
ekegusii: Omwana one, onye enkoro yao ekoba n’obong’aini, rirorio enkoro y’ane nigo eragooke.
swahili: Mwanangu, kama moyo wako una hekima, basi moyo wangu utafurahi,

english: My inmost being will rejoice when your lips speak what is right. Saying 15
ekegusii: Ekero ebikoba biao birakwane amang’ana amaronge, nigo ndabe nomogooko ime y’ane. 14.
swahili: utu wangu wa ndani utafurahi, wakati midomo yako itakapozungumza lililo sawa.

english: Do not let your heart envy sinners, but always continue in the fear of the LORD.
ekegusii: Enkoro y’ao tebaisa gosanera amang’ana yabanyene ebibe, korende aye ogeenderere komoiroka Omonene kera rituko.
swahili: Usiuruhusu moyo wako kuwaonea wivu wenye dhambi, bali kila mara uwe na bidii katika kumcha Bwana.

english: For surely there is a future, and your hope will not be cut off. Saying 16
ekegusii: Ekeene, eng’eria nekare bosio, na ogosemeria kwao tikogosira bosa. 15.
swahili: Hakika kuna tumaini la baadaye kwa ajili yako, nalo tarajio lako halitakatiliwa mbali.

english: Listen, my son, and be wise, and guide your heart on the right course.
ekegusii: Aye omwana one, igwa na obe n’obong’aini, naende orende enkoro y’ao ebwatie enchera endonge.
swahili: Sikiliza, mwanangu na uwe na hekima, weka moyo wako kwenye njia iliyo sawa.

english: and put a knife to your throat if you possess a great appetite.
ekegusii: Onye kore n’enchara, obeke omoyio ase ring’orong’oche ria’o.
swahili: na utie kisu kooni mwako kama ukiwa mlafi.

english: Do not join those who drink too much wine or gorge themselves on meat.
ekegusii: Tobaisa koba ase egati y’abagotinda nedivai, gose ase egati y’abakoria chinyama bobe,
swahili: Usiwe miongoni mwa wanywao mvinyo, au wale walao nyama kwa pupa,

english: For the drunkard and the glutton will come to poverty, and drowsiness will clothe them in rags. Saying 17
ekegusii: ekiagera abagotinda, na abaria bobe, ’mbabe abataka; na obogondereria bwe chitoro nigo boraboyie omonto amachanchabe. 16.
swahili: kwa maana walevi na walafi huwa maskini, nako kusinzia huwavika matambara.

english: Listen to your father who gave you life, and do not despise your mother when she is old.
ekegusii: Igwera iso okoiborete, na tobaisa komochaya nyoko ekero agotire.
swahili: Msikilize baba yako, aliyekuzaa, wala usimdharau mama yako atakapokuwa mzee.

english: Invest in truth and never sell it— in wisdom and instruction and understanding.
ekegusii: Gora ekeene, na tobaisa gokeoonia; boigo gora obong’aini, na amorokererio, na obomanyi.
swahili: Nunua kweli wala usiiuze, pata hekima, adabu na ufahamu.

english: The father of a righteous man will greatly rejoice, and he who fathers a wise son will delight in him.
ekegusii: Ise bw’omonto ore omonyene oboronge nigo akoba nomogooko omonene. Ere oyoiboire omwana omomura omong’aini nagookigwe nere.
swahili: Baba wa mwenye haki ana furaha kubwa, naye aliye na mwana mwenye hekima humfurahia.

english: May your father and mother be glad, and may she who gave you birth rejoice! Saying 18
ekegusii: Bagookie iso na nyoko, tiga oria okoiborete akogookere. 17.
swahili: Baba yako na mama yako na wafurahi, mama aliyekuzaa na ashangilie!

english: My son, give me your heart, and let your eyes delight in my ways.
ekegusii: Omwana one, ing’a enkoro yao, na amaiso ao tiga agookere chiinchera chiane.
swahili: Mwanangu, nipe moyo wako, macho yako na yafuate njia zangu,

english: For a prostitute is a deep pit, and an adulteress is a narrow well.
ekegusii: Omokungu omotayayi nigo anga engoro entambe gochia inse, na omokungu bw’omonto onde nigo anga egesiima ekegote.
swahili: kwa maana kahaba ni shimo refu na mwanamke mpotovu ni kisima chembamba.

english: Like a robber she lies in wait and multiplies the faithless among men. Saying 19
ekegusii: Ee, omokungu oyio nigo akoboera buna omouri, nigo akomentekania abasaria ase egati ya Mwanyabaanto. 18.
swahili: Kama mnyangʼanyi, hungojea akivizia, naye huzidisha wasio waaminifu miongoni mwa wanaume.

english: Who has woe? Who has sorrow? Who has contentions? Who has complaints? Who has needless wounds? Who has bloodshot eyes?
ekegusii: Ning’o oyio ore nobobe? Ning’o oyio oichanete? Ning’o oyio okorwana na kwereera? Ning’o oyio oakirwe chingoma chitagwenerete aakwe? Ning’o oyio obariiretie amaiso?
swahili: Ni nani mwenye ole? Ni nani mwenye huzuni? Ni nani mwenye ugomvi? Ni nani mwenye malalamiko? Ni nani aliye na majeraha yasiyo na sababu? Ni nani mwenye macho mekundu?

english: Do not crave his delicacies, for that food is deceptive. Saying 8
ekegusii: Tobaisa gosanera chindagera chiaye chinyansu, ekiagera nigo chire echi’obong’ainereria. 7.
swahili: Usitamani vyakula vyake vitamu kwa kuwa chakula hicho ni cha hila.

english: Those who linger over wine, who go to taste mixed drinks.
ekegusii: Nabaanto abwo bakona-konywa edivai ase chingaki chintambe, na abwo bakona‐korigia konywa edivai yochoganirie n’eyende.
swahili: Ni hao wakaao sana kwenye mvinyo, hao waendao kuonja mabakuli ya mvinyo uliochanganywa.

english: Do not gaze at wine while it is red, when it sparkles in the cup and goes down smoothly.
ekegusii: Tobaisa korigereria edivai koyabariirire, ekero ekobera ase egekombe na koirana inse ng’ora ng’ora.
swahili: Usiukodolee macho mvinyo wakati ukiwa mwekundu, wakati unapometameta kwenye bilauri, wakati ushukapo taratibu!

english: In the end it bites like a snake and stings like a viper.
ekegusii: Omoerio nigo ekoroma buna eng’iti na korasa buna enchoka.
swahili: Mwishowe huuma kama nyoka na kutia sumu yake kama nyoka mwenye sumu.

english: Your eyes will see strange things, and your mind will utter perversities.
ekegusii: Amaiso ao nigo ararore amang’ana amageni, na ebirengererio biao ’mbibe ebikorekanu.
swahili: Macho yako yataona mambo mageni na moyo wako kuwazia mambo yaliyopotoka.

english: You will be like one sleeping on the high seas or lying on the top of a mast:
ekegusii: Nigo or’abe buna omonto oraire ase egati‐gati y’enyancha, gose buna omonto ore ase omote omotambe igoro okoirwa esiororia.
swahili: Utakuwa kama alalaye katikati ya bahari, alalaye juu ya kamba ya merikebu.

english: “They struck me, but I feel no pain! They beat me, but I did not know it! When can I wake up to search for another drink?”
ekegusii: Aye nigo orateebe, “Nigo bang’agete bororo, korende tinyigweti bobe; nigo bang’wanetie bokong’u, korende tinyigweti kende. Indi ’ngocha koboka ingeende korigia eyende?.”
swahili: Utasema, “Wamenipiga lakini sikuumia! Wamenichapa, lakini sisikii! Nitaamka lini ili nikanywe tena?”

english: Do not wear yourself out to get rich; be wise enough to restrain yourself.
ekegusii: Tobaisa gwechaanda mono ng’a obe omonda; tobaisa gosemeria obong’aini bwao omonyene.
swahili: Usijitaabishe ili kuupata utajiri, uwe na hekima kuonyesha kujizuia.

english: When you glance at wealth, it disappears, for it makes wings for itself and flies like an eagle to the sky. Saying 9
ekegusii: Tobirigereria ebio, obonda nigo bogochoma chimbaaba, bwairuruka buna ekeongo ekoiruruka yarimera igoro. 8.
swahili: Kufumba na kufumbua utajiri hutoweka, huwa kama umepata mabawa ghafula, ukaruka na kutoweka angani kama tai.

english: Do not eat the bread of a stingy man, and do not crave his delicacies;
ekegusii: Tobaisa koria endagera y’omonto ogokomogorera, gose tobaisa gosanera chindagera chiaye chinyansu.
swahili: Usile chakula cha mtu mchoyo, usitamani vyakula vyake vitamu,

english: for he is keeping track, inwardly counting the cost. “Eat and drink,” he says to you, but his heart is not with you.
ekegusii: Buna omonto akorengereria ime ase enkoro yaye, naboigo are. Nigo akogotiotereria, “Karie na kanywe!”, Korende enkoro yaye tegwancheti.
swahili: kwa maana yeye ni aina ya mtu ambaye kila mara anafikiri juu ya gharama. Anakuambia, “Kula na kunywa,” lakini moyo wake hauko pamoja nawe.

english: You will vomit up what little you have eaten and waste your pleasant words. Saying 10
ekegusii: Ayio nigo aragere oroke endagera eria kwaria, naende amang’ana ao amaya asire bosa. 9.
swahili: Utatapika kile kidogo ulichokula, nawe utakuwa umepoteza bure maneno yako ya kumsifu.

english: Do not speak to a fool, for he will despise the wisdom of your words. Saying 11
ekegusii: Tobaisa gokwana amang’ana ao ase omonto omoriri aigwete, ekiagera nigo arachaaye obong’aini bw’amang’ana ao. 10.
swahili: Usizungumze na mpumbavu, kwa maana atadhihaki hekima ya maneno yako.

english: Do not envy wicked men or desire their company;
ekegusii: Aye tobaisa gosanera amang’ana yabakori amabe, gose togania koba amo nabarabwo,
swahili: Usiwaonee wivu watu waovu, usitamani ushirika nao;

english: If you faint in the day of distress, how small is your strength!
ekegusii: Korarose na gotang’ang’a ase engaki y’obokong’u rirorio aye nigo ore omoreu otari na nguru. 25.
swahili: Ukikata tamaa wakati wa taabu, jinsi gani nguvu zako ni kidogo!

english: Rescue those being led away to death, and restrain those stumbling toward the slaughter.
ekegusii: Tooria abwo bakoirwa gochia gokwa; irania abwo bakoirwa gochia goitwa.
swahili: Okoa wale wanaoongozwa kwenye kifo; wazuie wote wanaojikokota kuelekea machinjoni.

english: If you say, “Behold, we did not know about this,” does not He who weighs hearts consider it? Does not the One who guards your life know? Will He not repay a man according to his deeds? Saying 26
ekegusii: Oise goteeba, “Intwe titwamanyete amang’ana aya”, Inee, oyio okorenga chinkoro tamanyeti ayio? Oyio origereretie omoyo oo nigo amanyete ayio, na nigo araakane kera omonto buna ogokora kwaye kore. 26.
swahili: Kama mkisema, “Lakini hatukujua lolote kuhusu hili,” je, yule apimaye mioyo halitambui hili? Je, yule awalindaye maisha yenu halijui hili? Je, hatamlipa kila mtu kulingana na aliyotenda?

english: Eat honey, my son, for it is good, and the honeycomb is sweet to your taste.
ekegusii: Aye omwana one, karie obooke, ekiagera nobuya; obooke bogotonya korwa ase eriana nigo bore obwansu ase ore.
swahili: Ule asali mwanangu, kwa kuwa ni nzuri; asali kutoka kwenye sega ni tamu kwa kuonja.

english: Know therefore that wisdom is sweet to your soul. If you find it, there is a future for you, and your hope will never be cut off. Saying 27
ekegusii: Manya ng’a obong’aini buna obwo ’mboganeirie ase omoyo oo, korabonyore, rirorio ’nonyore amaya ase amatuko agochi‐goocha, na ogosemeria kwao tikogosira bosa. 27.
swahili: Ujue pia kwamba hekima ni tamu kwa nafsi yako, kama ukiipata, kuna matumaini kwako ya siku zijazo, nalo tumaini lako halitakatiliwa mbali.

english: Do not lie in wait, O wicked man, near the dwelling of the righteous; do not destroy his resting place.
ekegusii: Aye omokori amabe, tobaisa koboera omonyene oboronge ase amenyete, tosaria aase aye agotimokera.
swahili: Usivizie kama haramia afanyavyo ili kuyashambulia makao ya mwenye haki, wala usiyavamie makazi yake,

english: For though a righteous man may fall seven times, he still gets up; but the wicked stumble in bad times. Saying 28
ekegusii: Omonyene oboronge nigo akogwa ara gatano na kabere, naende oboka, korende abakori amabe nigo bagosira ekero banyorire emechando. 28.
swahili: Kwa maana ingawa mtu mwenye haki huanguka mara saba, huinuka tena, lakini waovu huangushwa chini na maafa.

english: Do not gloat when your enemy falls, and do not let your heart rejoice when he stumbles,
ekegusii: Tobaisa kogooka ekero omobisa oo agure, na enkoro yao tebaisa gosasoka ekero agochirwe.
swahili: Usitazame kwa kufurahia adui yako aangukapo; wakati ajikwaapo, usiruhusu moyo wako ushangilie.

english: or the LORD will see and disapprove, and turn His wrath away from him. Saying 29
ekegusii: Omonene nigo ararore okogooka okwo agechigwe, erio aonchore endamwamu yaye erue ase omobisa oo. 29.
swahili: Bwana asije akaona na kuchukia akaiondoa ghadhabu yake mbali naye.

english: Do not fret over evildoers, and do not be envious of the wicked.
ekegusii: Aye togechigwa ase engencho y’abagokora amabe, gose tobaisa gosanera amang’ana y’abakori amabe.
swahili: Usikasirike kwa sababu ya watu wabaya wala usiwaonee wivu waovu,

english: for their hearts devise violence, and their lips declare trouble. Saying 21
ekegusii: ekiagera ebirengererio biabo nigo bikoroberia ay’ogosiria, na ebikoba biabo nigo bigokwama ayakorenta emechando. 20.
swahili: kwa maana mioyo yao hupanga mambo ya jeuri, nayo midomo yao husema juu ya kuleta madhara.

english: For the evil man has no future; the lamp of the wicked will be extinguished. Saying 30
ekegusii: Abagokora amabe tibakonyora amaya ase amatuko agochi‐gocha; etaya y’abakori amabe nerimigwe. 30.
swahili: kwa maana mtu mbaya hana tumaini la siku zijazo, nayo taa ya waovu itazimwa.

english: My son, fear the LORD and the king, and do not associate with the rebellious.
ekegusii: Aye omwana one, omoiroke Omonene, oiroke na omorwoti, tobaisa gosang’anana nabasaria.
swahili: Mwanangu, mche Bwana na mfalme, wala usijiunge na waasi,

english: For they will bring sudden destruction. Who knows what ruin they can bring? Further Sayings of the Wise
ekegusii: Abwo nigo baranyore emechando ya mobosokano, na ning’o oranyaare komanya ogosirigwa kwabo? Amang’ana ande y’obong’aini
swahili: kwa maana hao wawili watatuma maangamizi ya ghafula juu yao, naye ni nani ajuaye maafa wawezayo kuleta? Misemo Zaidi Ya Wenye Hekima

english: These also are sayings of the wise: To show partiality in judgment is not good.
ekegusii: Amang’ana aya boigo nay’abang’aini. Tari buya gwanchereria abanto ekero ebiina bikonachwa.
swahili: Hii pia ni misemo ya wenye hekima: Kuonyesha upendeleo katika hukumu si vyema:

english: Whoever tells the guilty, “You are innocent”— peoples will curse him, and nations will denounce him;
ekegusii: Oyo ogoteebia omonto omomochi ng’a: “Aye tori omonyaboronge”, oyio abanto ’mbamoragererie, na abanto b’ebisaku nigo baramogeche.
swahili: Yeyote amwambiaye mwenye hatia, “Wewe huna hatia,” Kabila zitamlaani na mataifa yatamkana.

english: but it will go well with those who convict the guilty, and rich blessing will come upon them.
ekegusii: Korende abwo bakoa omomochi egesusuro ’mbanyore amaya amo nogosesenigwa okuya.
swahili: Bali itakuwa vyema kwa wale watakaowatia hatiani wenye hatia, nazo baraka tele zitawajilia juu yao.

english: An honest answer given is like a kiss on the lips.
ekegusii: Omonto okoiraneria amairanerio amaronge nigo anga okonyunyuntwa kw’ebikoba.
swahili: Jawabu la uaminifu ni kama busu la midomoni.

english: Complete your outdoor work and prepare your field; after that, you may build your house.
ekegusii: Roisia emeremo yao isiko onsi, naende kora emeremo y’ao ya mogondo eere, na magega y’ayio oagache enyomba y’ao.
swahili: Maliza kazi zako za nje, nawe uweke mashamba yako tayari, baada ya hayo, jenga nyumba yako.

english: Do not testify against your neighbor without cause, and do not deceive with your lips.
ekegusii: Tobaisa koba kirori bosa igo mamincha y’omonto onde, na tobaisa kong’ainereria nebikoba biao.
swahili: Usishuhudie dhidi ya jirani yako bila sababu, au kutumia midomo yako kudanganya.

english: Do not say, “I will do to him as he has done to me; I will repay the man according to his work.”
ekegusii: Tobaisa goteeba, “Goika nainche imokorere buna ankorera; goika imoakane buna ogokora kwaye kore.”
swahili: Usiseme, “Nitamtenda kama alivyonitenda mimi; nitamlipiza mtu yule kwa kile alichonitendea.”

english: By wisdom a house is built and by understanding it is established;
ekegusii: Enyomba nigo ekoagachwa nobong’aini na yakong’igwa goetera ase okomanya.
swahili: Kwa hekima nyumba hujengwa, nayo kwa njia ya ufahamu huimarishwa

english: I went past the field of a slacker and by the vineyard of a man lacking judgment.
ekegusii: Ngaeta ase omogondo bw’omonto omworo, na ase omogondo bw’emesabibu bw’omonto otari nobong’aini.
swahili: Nilipita karibu na shamba la mvivu, karibu na shamba la mizabibu la mtu asiye na akili,

english: Thorns had grown up everywhere, thistles had covered the ground, and the stone wall was broken down.
ekegusii: Nkarora omogondo oyio omerire amagwa, na amasa ayotubire, na amagena aagacheire chindwaki chiaye konya atagokire.
swahili: miiba ilikuwa imeota kila mahali, ardhi ilikuwa imefunikwa na magugu, na ukuta wa mawe ulikuwa umebomoka.

english: I observed and took it to heart; I looked and received instruction:
ekegusii: Nkayorigereria na korengereria mono igoro y’omogondo oyio, nkanyora amorokererio aya:
swahili: Nikatafakari moyoni mwangu lile nililoliona, nami nikajifunza somo kutokana na niliyoyaona:

english: A little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to rest,
ekegusii: Okorara ake, na ogosundoka ake, na okoringania amaboko ake,
swahili: Bado kulala kidogo, kusinzia kidogo, bado kukunja mikono kidogo upate kupumzika:

english: and poverty will come upon you like a robber, and need like a bandit.
ekegusii: goika obotaka bogochere buna omouri, na oboremerwa kogochere buna omorwani esegi.
swahili: hivyo umaskini utakuja juu yako kama mnyangʼanyi, na kupungukiwa kutakujia kama mtu mwenye silaha.

english: through knowledge its rooms are filled with every precious and beautiful treasure. Saying 22
ekegusii: Ase chiseemi chire, chiero chi’enyomba eyio nigo chigoichorigwa n’ebinto ao ao bi’engeencho enene, na ebi’okogokia. 21.
swahili: kwa njia ya maarifa vyumba vyake hujazwa vitu vya thamani na vya kupendeza.

english: A wise man is strong, and a man of knowledge enhances his strength.
ekegusii: Omonto omong’aini nigo are ne chinguru, na oyore n’okomanya nigo akoorokia okobua okonene.
swahili: Mtu mwenye hekima ana uwezo mkubwa, naye mtu mwenye maarifa huongeza nguvu,

english: Only with sound guidance should you wage war, and victory lies in a multitude of counselors. Saying 23
ekegusii: Ase ogoseemia kw’obong’aini kore, nonyaare korwana esegi, na ase abasemia abange abaya bare, obobui nigo bokonyorekanao. 22.
swahili: kwa kufanya vita unahitaji uongozi na kwa ushindi washauri wengi.

english: Wisdom is too high for a fool; he does not open his mouth in the meeting place. Saying 24
ekegusii: Obong’aini nigo bore egento kere aare korwa ase omonto omoriri; ere tari komaanora omonwa oye agwo ase egeita. 23.
swahili: Hekima i juu mno kwa mpumbavu, katika kusanyiko langoni hana lolote la kusema.

english: He who plots evil will be called a schemer.
ekegusii: Ere oyokoroberia gokora amabe narokwe omonto okorenta emechando.
swahili: Yeye apangaye mabaya atajulikana kama mtu wa hila.

english: A foolish scheme is sin, and a mocker is detestable to men. Saying 25
ekegusii: Ebirengererio bi’oboriri n’ebibe, na omonyacheche nigo are okogechia ase abanto. 24.
swahili: Mipango ya upumbavu ni dhambi, watu huchukizwa na mwenye dhihaka.

english: These are additional proverbs of Solomon, which were copied by the men of Hezekiah king of Judah:
ekegusii: Eye nero emebayeno ya Sulemani, eyio abanto ba Hezekia omorwoti bw’Abayuda, basangereretie.
swahili: Hizi ni mithali zaidi za Solomoni, zilizonakiliwa na watu wa Hezekia mfalme wa Yuda:

english: lest the one who hears may disgrace you, and your infamy never go away.
ekegusii: Oise koboorokia, na omonto onde aise koigwa ayio, nigo aragosookie, na erieta ria’o risareke kogeenderera botambe.
swahili: ama yeye aisikiaye aweza kukuaibisha na kamwe sifa yako mbaya haitaondoka.

english: A word fitly spoken is like apples of gold in settings of silver.
ekegusii: Ring’ana rigokwanwa ase enchera egwenerete nigo ringa buna amatunda amororo amaya mono abekire ase egekabu keroisirie korwa ase efeta.
swahili: Neno lisemwalo kwa wakati ufaao ni kama matunda ya mtofaa ya dhahabu yaliyowekwa kwenye vijalizo vya fedha.

english: Like an earring of gold or an ornament of fine gold is a wise man’s rebuke to a listening ear.
ekegusii: Omonto omong’aini ogokuurera oyokoigwera nigo are buna ebonyi ne chisonoi biroseirie chitaabu.
swahili: Kama vile kipuli cha dhahabu au pambo la dhahabu safi, ndivyo lilivyo karipio la mtu mwenye hekima kwa sikio lisikilizalo.

english: Like the cold of snow in the time of harvest is a trustworthy messenger to those who send him; he refreshes the soul of his masters.
ekegusii: Omotomwa ore omwegenwa nigo are ase abwo bakomotoma buna amaache amakendu ase engaki ye rigesa, ekiagera nigo akogera emioyo yabo yaba emeyia.
swahili: Kama vile ubaridi wa theluji wakati wa mavuno ndivyo alivyo mjumbe mwaminifu kwa wale wamtumao, huburudisha roho za bwana zake.

english: Like clouds and wind without rain is the man who boasts of gifts never given.
ekegusii: Omonto ogwetogia ng’a nare nomoyo omorabu, ko tari korua ebiegwa, nigo anga amare na omwaga bitari korenta embura.
swahili: Kama vile mawingu na upepo pasipo mvua ndivyo alivyo mtu ajisifuye kwa zawadi ambazo hatoi.

english: Through patience a ruler can be persuaded, and a gentle tongue can break a bone.
ekegusii: Oboremereria nigo bokwororobia omogambi, na oromeme rw’obwororo nigo rokobuna riuga.
swahili: Kwa njia ya uvumilivu mtawala aweza kushawishiwa, nao ulimi laini waweza kuvunja mfupa.

english: If you find honey, eat just what you need, lest you have too much and vomit it up.
ekegusii: Onye kwanyorire obooke, karie ekerengo kegoisaine; oise kogeetania nigo oraboroke.
swahili: Ukipata asali, kula kiasi tu cha kukutosha, ukila zaidi, utatapika.

english: Seldom set foot in your neighbor’s house, lest he grow weary and hate you.
ekegusii: Amagoro ao tanara kona‐kogeenda ase enyomba y’omosani oo, nigo arabaise korosa naye, erinde akogeche.
swahili: Ingiza mguu wako nyumbani kwa jirani yako mara chache, ukizidisha, atakukinai na atakuchukia.

english: Like a club or sword or sharp arrow is a man who bears false witness against his neighbor.
ekegusii: Omonto okoba kirori bw’oborimo ase omonto onde nigo anga buna enungu y’eseegi, gose omoro, gose ensara enyonge.
swahili: Kama vile rungu au upanga au mshale mkali ndivyo alivyo mtu atoaye ushuhuda wa uongo dhidi ya jirani yake.

english: Like a broken tooth or a foot out of joint is confidence in a faithless man in time of trouble.
ekegusii: Ogosemeria omonto otari omwegenwa ase engaki y’emechando, nigo enga buna erino ribunegete gose okogoro goteng’eretie.
swahili: Kama vile jino bovu au mguu uliolemaa, ndivyo ilivyo kumtegemea mtu asiye mwaminifu wakati wa shida.

english: It is the glory of God to conceal a matter and the glory of kings to search it out.
ekegusii: Nigo bore obonene bwa Nyasae kobisa amang’ana; korende na obonene bw’abarwoti gokora obotuki ase amang’ana ayio.
swahili: Ni Utukufu wa Mungu kuficha jambo, bali ni utukufu wa wafalme kuchunguza jambo.

english: Like one who removes a garment on a cold day or vinegar poured on a wound is one who sings songs to a heavy heart.
ekegusii: Omonto ogoteera amatera y’omogooko ase omonto obwate enkoro ere nobororo nigo anga buna okorusia eanga ase engaki y’obokendu gose kobeeka egento ekeroro ase riote.
swahili: Kama vile avuaye mavazi siku ya baridi, au kama siki iliyomwagwa juu ya magadi, ndivyo alivyo yeye amuimbiaye nyimbo mtu mwenye moyo mzito.

english: If your enemy is hungry, give him food to eat, and if he is thirsty, give him water to drink.
ekegusii: Onye omobisa oo ore nenchara, moe endagera arie; onye ore nerang’o, moe amaache anywe.
swahili: Kama adui yako ana njaa, mpe chakula ale; kama ana kiu, mpe maji anywe.

english: For in so doing, you will heap burning coals on his head, and the LORD will reward you.
ekegusii: Igo nobeke omorero bw’amakara ase omotwe oye, n’Omonene nakoe eng’eria yao.
swahili: Kwa kufanya hivyo, unaweka makaa ya moto yanayowaka kichwani pake, naye Bwana atakupa thawabu.

english: As the north wind brings forth rain, so a backbiting tongue brings angry looks.
ekegusii: Omwaga okogusa korwa sugusu nigo okorenta embura, naboigo nomonto omogenki akorenta okobeeana.
swahili: Kama vile upepo wa kaskazini uletavyo mvua, ndivyo ulimi usingiziao uletavyo uso wa hasira.

english: Better to live on a corner of the roof than to share a house with a quarrelsome wife.
ekegusii: Mbuya komenya ase ekenunchi kia irongo igoro, kobua komenya ase enyomba amo n’omokungu omonyariomana.
swahili: Ni afadhali kuishi pembeni mwa paa la nyumba, kuliko kuishi nyumba moja na mke mgomvi.

english: Like cold water to a weary soul is good news from a distant land.
ekegusii: Amang’ana amaya akorentwa korwa ase ense y’aare nigo anga buna amaache amakendu ase omonto ore n’erang’o.
swahili: Kama vile maji baridi kwa nafsi iliyochoka ndivyo zilivyo habari njema kutoka nchi ya mbali.

english: Like a muddied spring or a polluted well is a righteous man who gives way to the wicked.
ekegusii: Omonyene oboronge okorua ribaga ase omokori amabe nigo anga buna orooche rore netintira na buna ensoko yasarekire.
swahili: Kama vile chemchemi iliyotibuliwa matope au kisima kilichotiwa taka ndivyo alivyo mtu mwenye haki akishiriki na waovu.

english: It is not good to eat too much honey or to search out one’s own glory.
ekegusii: Tari buya koria obooke obonge, na abwo bakwerigeria obonene, obonene bwabo nigo borabe bosa.
swahili: Si vyema kula asali nyingi sana, wala si heshima kujitafutia heshima yako mwenyewe.

english: Like a city whose walls are broken down is a man who does not control his temper.
ekegusii: Omonto otamanyeti kwegambera omonyene nigo anga buna omochie chindwaki chiaye chiatagoirwe.
swahili: Kama vile mji ambao kuta zake zimebomoka ndivyo alivyo mtu ambaye hawezi kujitawala mwenyewe.

english: As the heavens are high and the earth is deep, so the hearts of kings cannot be searched.
ekegusii: Buna koreng’ana igoro ere aare mono etatukwe emanywe, na ayare ase ense inse boigo, ne chinkoro chi’abarwoti tichigotukwa chimanywe.
swahili: Kama mbingu zilivyo juu na nchi ilivyo chini, ndivyo ambavyo mioyo ya wafalme haichunguziki.

english: Remove the dross from the silver, and a vessel for a silversmith will come forth.
ekegusii: Rusia amabiria korwa ase efeta, na omoturi ’nanyore efeta akoroiseria egekorero ekiya.
swahili: Ondoa takataka kwenye madini ya fedha, nako ndani yake kutatokea chombo cha mfua fedha.

english: Remove the wicked from the king’s presence, and his throne will be established in righteousness.
ekegusii: Rusia abakori amabe korwa ase obosio bw’omorwoti, erio ekerogo kiaye ki’obonene nigo kerageenderere gokong’igwa n’oboronge.
swahili: Ondoa waovu mbele ya mfalme, nacho kiti chake cha enzi kitaimarishwa kwa njia ya haki.

english: Do not exalt yourself in the presence of the king, and do not stand in the place of great men;
ekegusii: Tobaisa gwetang’anania ase obosio bw’omorwoti, gose tobaisa kwebeeka aase abanene bare.
swahili: Usijikweze mwenyewe mbele ya mfalme, wala usidai nafasi miongoni mwa watu wakuu;

english: for it is better that he says to you, “Come up here!” than that you should be demoted in the presence of the prince. Even what you have seen with your own eyes,
ekegusii: Nigo er’abe buya mono ekero orateebigwe, “Inchuo gocha aa”, kobua goseerigwa gochia goikaransa magega korwa ase ribaga ri’abaanto abasike.
swahili: ni afadhali yeye akuambie, “Njoo huku juu,” kuliko yeye kukuaibisha mbele ya mkuu. Kile ulichokiona kwa macho yako

english: do not bring hastily to court. Otherwise, what will you do in the end when your neighbor puts you to shame?
ekegusii: Toba omwango kogeenda ase ekegambero. Inee! Inki orakore ase omoerio, ekero omonto oyio gwasoerete arakobue n’obe n’obosooku?
swahili: usiharakishe kukipeleka mahakamani, maana utafanya nini mwishoni kama jirani yako atakuaibisha?

english: Argue your case with your neighbor without betraying another’s confidence,
ekegusii: Onye aye omonyene kobwate amang’ana n’omonto onde, kwana nere, korende tobaisa koorokia obobisi bw’omonto omoao.
swahili: Kama ukifanya shauri na jirani yako, usisaliti siri ya mtu mwingine,

english: Like snow in summer and rain at harvest, honor does not befit a fool.
ekegusii: Buna koreng’ana obokendu bogocha ase engaki y’egurugura, gose embura egotwa ase engaki ye rigesa, naboigo ere bobe omonto omoriri konyora amasikani.
swahili: Kama theluji wakati wa kiangazi au mvua wakati wa mavuno, ndivyo asivyostahili heshima mpumbavu.

english: Like an archer who wounds at random is he who hires a fool or passerby.
ekegusii: Omonto omanyete emeremo nigo agwekorera emeremo emiya, korende oyore omoriri nigo akoriika onde bwensi ogoeta, na emeremo yasareka.
swahili: Kama mpiga upinde ambaye hujeruhi ovyo, ndivyo alivyo yeye aajiriye mpumbavu au yeyote apitaye njiani.

english: As a dog returns to its vomit, so a fool repeats his folly.
ekegusii: Omonto omoriri okoiranerera gokora oboriri bwaye nigo anga esese ekoiranera amaroki aye enyene.
swahili: Kama mbwa ayarudiavyo matapiko yake, ndivyo mpumbavu arudiavyo upumbavu wake.

english: Do you see a man who is wise in his own eyes? There is more hope for a fool than for him.
ekegusii: Oise korora omonto ogwekora omong’aini, ogosemeria ’nkore ase omonto omoriri kobua ase oyio.
swahili: Je, unamwona mtu ajionaye mwenye hekima machoni pake mwenyewe? Liko tumaini zaidi kwa mpumbavu kuliko kwake.

english: The slacker says, “A lion is in the road! A fierce lion roams the public square!”
ekegusii: Omonto omworo nigo agoteeba, “Endo nere isiko, ee, endo nere ase chiinchera chi’omochie.”
swahili: Mvivu husema, “Yuko simba barabarani, simba mkali anazunguka mitaa!”

english: As a door turns on its hinges, so the slacker turns on his bed.
ekegusii: Omonto omworo nigo akonakweoncha‐onchora buna egesieri gekona‐koonchorwa ase chimbata gesibeire.
swahili: Kama vile mlango ugeukavyo kwenye bawaba zake, ndivyo mvivu ajigeuzavyo kitandani mwake.

english: The slacker buries his hand in the dish; it wearies him to bring it back to his mouth.
ekegusii: Omonto omworo nigo akobeeka okoboko kwaye ase esani y’endagera, orosa gokobogoria gocha ase omonwa oye.
swahili: Mtu mvivu hutumbukiza mkono wake kwenye sahani, naye huchoka kuupeleka kwenye kinywa chake.

english: The slacker is wiser in his own eyes than seven men who answer discreetly.
ekegusii: Omonto omworo nigo akwerora ng’a n’omong’aini are abuete abanto batano na babere barakwane amang’ana are n’engeencho.
swahili: Mtu mvivu ni mwenye hekima machoni pake mwenyewe, kuliko watu saba wawezao kujibu kwa busara.

english: Like one who grabs a dog by the ears is a passerby who meddles in a quarrel not his own.
ekegusii: Omonto orenge goeta na gwesoyia ase eriomana ritarenge eriaye nigo anga buna oyo okobwata amato y’esese.
swahili: Kama yeye amkamataye mbwa kwa masikio, ndivyo alivyo mtu apitaye njiani na kujiingiza kwenye ugomvi usiomhusu.

english: Like a fluttering sparrow or darting swallow, an undeserved curse does not come to rest.
ekegusii: Buna enchiro ekona‐koong’anya, na buna egesingororo gekoiruruka, naboigo na okoragereria gotari nengeencho gotaikere oria oragererigwe.
swahili: Kama shomoro apigapigavyo mabawa yake au mbayuwayu katika kuruka kwake kasi, ndivyo ilivyo laana isiyo na sababu haimpati mtu.

english: Without wood, a fire goes out; without gossip, a conflict ceases.
ekegusii: Ase chinko chitari, omorero nigo okorima, naboigo nase omogenki atari, eriomana nigo rigosira.
swahili: Bila kuni moto huzimika; pasipo uchongezi ugomvi humalizika.

english: Like charcoal for embers and wood for fire, so is a quarrelsome man for kindling strife.
ekegusii: Omonyariomana ogoseegeta amariomana nigo anga buna amakara akogeenderera koyia, gose chinko chikogera omorero ogeenderera gwoka.
swahili: Kama makaa juu ya makaa yanayowaka, na kama kuni kwenye moto, ndivyo alivyo mtu mgomvi kwa kuchochea ugomvi.

english: The words of a gossip are like choice morsels that go down into the inmost being.
ekegusii: Amang’ana omonto omoitania nigo are buna endagera enyansu egotirimboka gochia ase enda inse.
swahili: Maneno ya mchongezi ni kama chakula kitamu; huingia sehemu za ndani sana za mtu.

english: Like glaze covering an earthen vessel are burning lips and a wicked heart.
ekegusii: Omonto obwate amang’ana amansu ase ebikoba biaye, korende ore nobobe ase enkoro yaye, nigo anga buna egekorero ki’amaroba giatekire keoomire nefeta.
swahili: Kama rangi ingʼaayo iliyopakwa kwenye vyombo vya udongo ndivyo ilivyo midomo laini pamoja na moyo mbaya.

english: A hateful man disguises himself with his speech, but he lays up deceit in his heart.
ekegusii: Omonto omogechi nigo akobisa ase ebikoba biaye, obong’ainereria bore ase enkoro yaye.
swahili: Mtu mwenye nia ya kudhuru wengine hujificha kwa maneno ya midomo yake, lakini moyoni mwake huficha udanganyifu.

english: When he speaks graciously, do not believe him, for seven abominations fill his heart.
ekegusii: Ekero agokwana amang’ana are amansu, tobaisa komwegena, ekiagera nabwate ay’okogechia atano na abere, ase enkoro yaye ime.
swahili: Ingawa maneno yake huvutia, usimwamini, kwa maana machukizo saba hujaza moyo wake.

english: Though his hatred is concealed by deception, his wickedness will be exposed in the assembly.
ekegusii: Naisa gotuba okogecha kwaye nobong’ainereria, obokayayu bwaye goika bomanyekane n’omosangererekano bwonsi.
swahili: Nia yake ya kudhuru wengine inaweza kufichwa na udanganyifu, lakini uovu wake utafichuliwa kwenye kusanyiko.

english: He who digs a pit will fall into it, and he who rolls a stone will have it roll back on him.
ekegusii: Omonto okorema eirima, nere omonyene oragwe imeo; na omonto ogoturunkania rigena, nere omonyene rirairanere rimogwere.
swahili: Kama mtu akichimba shimo, atatumbukia ndani yake, kama mtu akivingirisha jiwe, litamrudia.

english: A lying tongue hates those it crushes, and a flattering mouth causes ruin.
ekegusii: Omonto ore noromeme rogokwana oborimo, nigo akogecha abanto abwo amang’ana aye achaandire bobe, na omonwa ogokwana amang’ana ay’okweansia nigo okorenta ogosirigwa.
swahili: Ulimi wa uongo, huwachukia wale unaowaumiza, nacho kinywa cha kujipendekeza hutenda uharibifu.

english: A whip for the horse, a bridle for the donkey, and a rod for the backs of fools!
ekegusii: Ekeranya nigo kere ase ogoaka ebarasi, na ekeokio ase okoraa etigere, naboigo n’enyimbo ere ase ogoaka omogongo bw’omonto omoriri.
swahili: Mjeledi kwa farasi, lijamu kwa punda, nayo fimbo kwa migongo ya wapumbavu!

english: Do not answer a fool according to his folly, or you yourself will be like him.
ekegusii: Tobaisa koiraneria omonto omoriri buna oboriri bwaye bore, nigo orabaise koba omoriri buna are.
swahili: Usimjibu mpumbavu sawasawa na upumbavu wake, ama wewe mwenyewe utakuwa kama yeye.

english: Answer a fool according to his folly, lest he become wise in his own eyes.
ekegusii: Moiranerie omonto omoriri buna oboriri bwaye bore, tabaisa gwekaga ng’a nomong’aini are.
swahili: Mjibu mpumbavu sawasawa na upumbavu wake, ama atakuwa mwenye hekima machoni pake mwenyewe.

english: Like cutting off one’s own feet or drinking violence is the sending of a message by the hand of a fool.
ekegusii: Omonto ogotoma amang’ana ase okoboko kw’omonto omoriri, oyio nigo akobutora amaboko aye omonyene bwerentera emechando.
swahili: Kama vile ilivyo kujikata miguu au kunywa hasara, ndivyo ilivyo kutuma ujumbe kwa mkono wa mpumbavu.

english: Like lame legs hanging limp is a proverb in the mouth of a fool.
ekegusii: Omoreng’anio ogokwanwa n’omonwa bw’omoriri nigo onga buna omonto egesegora, okogoro kwaye gotari gokora emeremo.
swahili: Kama miguu ya kiwete inavyoningʼinia ndivyo ilivyo mithali katika kinywa cha mpumbavu.

english: Like binding a stone into a sling is the giving of honor to a fool.
ekegusii: Omonto okoa omoriri amasikani, nigo anga buna oyokoruta omobuko ore n’ebinto bi’erigori rinene ase etui y’amagena.
swahili: Kama kufunga jiwe kwenye kombeo, ndivyo ilivyo kumpa mpumbavu heshima.

english: Like a thorn that falls into the hand of a drunkard is a proverb in the mouth of a fool.
ekegusii: Omoreng’anio okorwa ase omonwa bw’omonto omoriri nigo onga buna rigwa rikobeta okoboko kw’omonto otindire amarwa.
swahili: Kama mwiba kwenye mkono wa mlevi ndivyo ilivyo mithali kinywani mwa mpumbavu.

english: Do not boast about tomorrow, for you do not know what a day may bring.
ekegusii: Tobaisa gwetogeria rituko ri’ankio, ekiagera tomanyeti aya rituko erio rikorenta.
swahili: Usijisifu kwa ajili ya kesho, kwa kuwa hujui ni nini kitakachozaliwa kwa siku moja.

english: Do not forsake your friend or your father’s friend, and do not go to your brother’s house in the day of your calamity; better a neighbor nearby than a brother far away.
ekegusii: Tobaisa kweba omosani oo, na omosani o iso; rituko kwanyorire emechando togeenda ase enka y’oyomino. Mbuya kogeenda bw’omogisangio ase engaki eyio, kobua korigia oyomino omenyete aare.
swahili: Usimwache rafiki yako wala rafiki wa baba yako, tena usiende nyumbani mwa ndugu yako wakati umepatwa na maafa. Bora jirani wa karibu kuliko ndugu aliye mbali.

english: Be wise, my son, and bring joy to my heart, so that I can answer him who taunts me.
ekegusii: Omwana one, kabe n’obong’aini na ogokie enkoro y’ane, erio nario ’ndanyore ring’ana ’nkoiraneria omonto ogonchaaya.
swahili: Mwanangu, uwe na hekima, nawe ulete furaha moyoni mwangu, ndipo nitakapoweza kumjibu yeyote anitendaye kwa dharau.

english: The prudent see danger and take cover; but the simple keep going and pay the penalty.
ekegusii: Omonto omong’aini nigo akororera emechando aare bwebisa, korende oyotamanyeti amaange nigo akogeenderera gochia bosio oumerana nero, erio ochaandeka.
swahili: Mtu mwenye busara huona hatari na kujificha, bali mjinga huendelea mbele nayo ikamtesa.

english: Take the garment of him who posts security for a stranger; get collateral if it is for a foreigner.
ekegusii: Ira eanga y’omonto oyo bwerure koba intenenera ase omonto omoao, ira ebi abwate, ekiagera bwerure ase engencho y’omonto otamanyekaneti.
swahili: Chukua vazi la yule awekaye dhamana kwa ajili ya mgeni; lishikilie iwe dhamana kama anafanya hivyo kwa ajili ya mwanamke mpotovu.

english: If one blesses his neighbor with a loud voice early in the morning, it will be counted to him as a curse.
ekegusii: Omonto okobooka mambia chuni oaka eriogi gosesenia omogisangio oye, oyio nabarerwe okoragererigwa.
swahili: Kama mtu akimbariki jirani yake kwa sauti kuu asubuhi na mapema, itahesabiwa kama ni laana.

english: A constant dripping on a rainy day and a contentious woman are alike—
ekegusii: Omokungu omonyariomana nigo anga buna amatoima y’embura akona‐gotoonya.
swahili: Mke mgomvi ni kama matone yasiyokoma ya siku ya mvua.

english: restraining her is like holding back the wind or grasping oil with one’s right hand.
ekegusii: Omonto ogotanga omokungu buna oyio, okwo nigo konga ogotangwa kw’omwaga gose okobwata amaguta n’okoboko gw’okorio.
swahili: Kumzuia yeye ni kama kuuzuia upepo au kukamata mafuta kwa kiganja cha mkono.

english: As iron sharpens iron, so one man sharpens another.
ekegusii: Ekioma nigo kegotieria ekioma kende, naboigo n’omonto otieria omonto onde.
swahili: Kama vile chuma kinoavyo chuma, ndivyo mtu amnoavyo mwenzake.

english: Whoever tends a fig tree will eat its fruit, and he who looks after his master will be honored.
ekegusii: Omonto okorenda omoko narie okwama kw’omoko oyio, na oyio okorenda omonene oye, oyio nanyore ogosikwa.
swahili: Yeye autunzaye mtini atakula tunda lake, naye amtunzaye bwana wake ataheshimiwa.

english: As water reflects the face, so the heart reflects the true man.
ekegusii: Ekero okorigereria ase amaache ime nigo okorora obosio bwao, naboigo nebirengererio bi’enkoro y’omonto bikororekana ase omonto onde.
swahili: Kama uso uonekanavyo kwenye maji, ndivyo hivyo moyo wa mtu humwonyesha alivyo.

english: Let another praise you, and not your own mouth— a stranger, and not your own lips.
ekegusii: Aye omonyene tobaisa gwetogia, korende tiga omonto onde agotogie; tiga omonto omoao agotogie, korende tari ebikoba biao omonyene.
swahili: Mwache mwingine akusifu, wala si kinywa chako mwenyewe; mtu mwingine afanye hivyo na si midomo yako mwenyewe.

english: Sheol and Abaddon are never satisfied; so the eyes of man are never satisfied.
ekegusii: Buna aase abakuure na embeera bitari goisaneka, naboigo n’amaiso a Mwanyabaanto atari goisaneka.
swahili: Kuzimu na Uharibifu havishibi kadhalika macho ya mwanadamu.

english: A crucible for silver and a furnace for gold, but a man is tested by the praise accorded him.
ekegusii: Buna koreng’ana efeta egoteemerwa ase egetaabo gekonyititora, na etaabu ase omorero ekebemberi, naboigo omonto agoteemwa na komanyekana ase ogosikwa kwaye.
swahili: Kalibu ni kwa ajili ya fedha na tanuru kwa ajili ya dhahabu, bali mtu hupimwa kwa sifa azipokeazo.

english: Though you grind a fool like grain with mortar and a pestle, yet his folly will not depart from him.
ekegusii: Omonto omoriri n’omobekerania ase ekonu ime, omoswageranie amo nobori, oboriri bwaye tibogosira.
swahili: Hata ukimtwanga mpumbavu kwenye kinu, ukimtwanga kama nafaka kwa mchi, hutauondoa upumbavu wake.

english: Be sure to know the state of your flocks, and pay close attention to your herds;
ekegusii: Manya buya chingencho chi’eching’ondi ne chimbori chiao, na orende riicho ria’o buya.
swahili: Hakikisha kuwa unajua hali ya makundi yako ya kondoo na mbuzi, angalia kwa bidii ngʼombe zako.

english: for riches are not forever, nor does a crown endure to every generation.
ekegusii: Obonda tibori kogeenderera kobao botambe, na eguutwa y’obogambi teri kogeenderera kobao ekiaare ase ekiaare.
swahili: Kwa kuwa utajiri haudumu milele, nayo taji haidumu vizazi vyote.

english: When hay is removed and new growth appears and the grain from the hills is gathered,
ekegusii: Ekero obonyansi obokoro bwasirire, na oboyia nigo bokomera, na ebimeri bi’ebitunwa biasangererigwa,
swahili: Wakati majani makavu yameondolewa na mapya yamechipua, nayo majani toka milimani yamekusanywa,

english: the lambs will provide you with clothing, and the goats with the price of a field.
ekegusii: ching’ondi nigo chikonachwa amarionya akoroisigwa chianga, ne chimbori chiaoonigwa ase okogora omogondo.
swahili: wana-kondoo watakupatia mavazi na mbuzi thamani ya shamba.

english: You will have plenty of goats’ milk to feed you— food for your household and nourishment for your maidservants.
ekegusii: Erio nonyore amabeere ye chimbori agoisaine aye na abanto b’enka yao, boigo nase abasomba bao abaiseke.
swahili: Utakuwa na maziwa mengi ya mbuzi kukulisha wewe na jamaa yako, na kuwalisha watumishi wako wa kike.

english: A stone is heavy and sand is a burden, but aggravation from a fool outweighs them both.
ekegusii: Rigena neririto na omokenye nomorito, korende okogechigwa kw’omonto omoriri nigo kore okorito kobua ebinto ebio bibere.
swahili: Jiwe ni zito na mchanga ni mzigo, lakini kukasirishwa na mpumbavu ni kuzito kuliko vyote viwili.

english: Wrath is cruel and anger is like a flood, but who can withstand jealousy?
ekegusii: Endamwamu nentindi, na ekeririanda nigo kegosiria, korende ning’o oranyaare koremereria ribero?
swahili: Hasira ni ukatili na ghadhabu kali ni gharika, lakini ni nani awezaye kusimama mbele ya wivu?

english: Better an open rebuke than love that is concealed.
ekegusii: Ogotogonyera kwa maiso marore nigo kore okuya kobua obwanchani bobisegete.
swahili: Afadhali karipio la wazi kuliko upendo uliofichika.

english: The wounds of a friend are faithful, but the kisses of an enemy are deceitful.
