ekegusii: Ogoakwa gokorwa ase omosani nigo kore okw’obwegenwa, korende okonyunyunta kw’omobisa nigo kore okw’obong’ainereria.
swahili: Majeraha kutoka kwa rafiki yaonyesha uaminifu, bali kubusu kwa adui ni kwingi sana.

english: The soul that is full loathes honey, but to a hungry soul, any bitter thing is sweet.
ekegusii: Omonto oigotete nigo agochaaya nonya nobooke, korende oyore n’enchara nonya n’endagera ere endoro nigo ekomwansera.
swahili: Yeye aliyeshiba huchukia kabisa asali, bali kwa mwenye njaa hata kile kilicho kichungu kwake ni kitamu.

english: Like a bird that strays from its nest is a man who wanders from his home.
ekegusii: Omonto ogotama korwa bwoye nigo anga buna enyoni ekong’anya korwa ase egeswa kiaye.
swahili: Kama ndege atangatangavyo mbali na kiota chake, ndivyo alivyo mtu atangatangaye mbali na nyumbani mwake.

english: Oil and incense bring joy to the heart, and the sweetness of a friend is counsel to the soul.
ekegusii: Amaguta akweakwa na amanukato nigo bikogokia enkoro, naboigo bore obwororo bw’omosani oyo okorua ogoseemia okuya.
swahili: Manukato na uvumba huleta furaha moyoni, nao uzuri wa rafiki huchipuka kutoka kwenye ushauri wake wa uaminifu.

english: The wicked flee when no one pursues, but the righteous are as bold as a lion.
ekegusii: Abakori amabe nigo bagotama nonya onde tari kobabwatia, korende abanyaboronge nigo bare abaremu buna chindo chinsae.
swahili: Mtu mwovu hukimbia ingawa hakuna yeyote anayemfukuza, bali wenye haki ni wajasiri kama simba.

english: He who leads the upright along the path of evil will fall into his own pit, but the blameless will inherit what is good.
ekegusii: Omonto ogosiria abare ne chinkoro chindonge, na kobaraa ase enchera ende, oyio nagwe ase eirima eria aremire ere omonyene, korende abwo batari na komocha ’mbanyore omwando omuya.
swahili: Yeye ambaye humwongoza mwenye haki kwenye mapito mabaya, ataanguka kwenye mtego wake mwenyewe, bali wasio na lawama watapokea urithi mwema.

english: A rich man is wise in his own eyes, but a poor man with discernment sees through him.
ekegusii: Omonto omonda nigo akwerengereria ng’a nomong’aini are, korende omonto omotaka ore n’okomanya nigo aramotuke amomanye.
swahili: Mtu tajiri anaweza kuwa na hekima machoni pake mwenyewe, bali mtu maskini mwenye ufahamu atamfichua.

english: When the righteous triumph, there is great glory, but when the wicked rise, men hide themselves.
ekegusii: Ekero abanyene oboronge babuire, okoiririata okonge nigo gokobao, korende ekero abakori amabe bakobua, abanto nigo bakwebisa.
swahili: Mwenye haki ashindapo, kuna furaha kubwa, bali waovu watawalapo, watu hujificha.

english: He who conceals his sins will not prosper, but whoever confesses and renounces them will find mercy.
ekegusii: Omonto okobisa ebibe biaye tagosesenigwa, korende oyo okobiorokia na kobitiga narorerwe amaabera.
swahili: Yeye afichaye dhambi zake hatafanikiwa, bali yeyote aziungamaye na kuziacha hupata rehema.

english: Blessed is the man who is always reverent, but he who hardens his heart falls into trouble.
ekegusii: Nasesenirie omonto omoirogete Omonene botambe, korende oyo okong’etie enkoro yaye nanyore emechando eramosirie.
swahili: Amebarikiwa mtu ambaye siku zote humcha Bwana, bali yeye afanyaye moyo wake kuwa mgumu huangukia kwenye taabu.

english: Like a roaring lion or a charging bear is a wicked ruler over a helpless people.
ekegusii: Omogambi omokaayayu okogambera abanto abataka nigo anga buna endo ekoruma, gose edubu yagechiigwe.
swahili: Kama simba angurumaye au dubu ashambuliaye, ndivyo alivyo mtu mwovu atawalaye wanyonge.

english: A leader who lacks judgment is also a great oppressor, but he who hates dishonest profit will prolong his days.
ekegusii: Omogambi otari n’obong’aini nigo are omochaandi omotindi, korende oria ogechete okonyora ebitooki bitari bi’oboronge, nigo akogeenderera kogamba ase amatuko amaange.
swahili: Mtawala dhalimu hana akili, bali yeye achukiaye mapato ya udhalimu atafurahia maisha marefu.

english: A man burdened by bloodguilt will flee into the Pit; let no one support him.
ekegusii: Onye omonto oritoereirwe n’okomocha kw’ogoitera amanyinga y’omonto onde, tiga abe okona‐gotama goika akwe, na onde tagokoonya omonto oyio.
swahili: Mtu mwenye kusumbuliwa na hatia ya kuua atakuwa mtoro mpaka kufa; mtu yeyote na asimsaidie.

english: He who walks with integrity will be kept safe, but whoever is perverse in his ways will suddenly fall.
ekegusii: Omonto otari na komocha ase chiinchera chiaye natoorigwe; korende oyore omokorekanu ase chiinchera chiaye nasire ase eyemo y’echio.
swahili: Yeye ambaye mwenendo wake hauna lawama hulindwa salama, bali yeye ambaye njia zake ni potovu ataanguka ghafula.

english: The one who works his land will have plenty of food, but whoever chases fantasies will have his fill of poverty.
ekegusii: Omonto ogokora emeremo ase omogondo oye ’nanyore endagera enyinge, korende oyokobwatia emeroberio etagwenereti nigo arabe omotaka omoraboku.
swahili: Yeye alimaye shamba lake atakuwa na chakula tele, bali yule afuataye mambo ya upuzi atakuwa na umaskini wa kumtosha.

english: A land in rebellion has many rulers, but a man of understanding and knowledge maintains order.
ekegusii: Ekero ense yasaririe nigo ekoba n’abagaambi abange, korende eye ebwate abanto bare nobong’aini na okomanya, obogambi nigo bokogeenderera gotenena bokong’u.
swahili: Wakati nchi inapokuwa na uasi, inakuwa na viongozi wengi, bali mwenye ufahamu na maarifa hudumisha utaratibu.

english: A faithful man will abound with blessings, but one eager to be rich will not go unpunished.
ekegusii: Omonto ore n’enkoro endonge ’nanyore ogosesenigwa okonge, korende oyo okoayerera ase okoba omonda takomocha konyora egesusuro.
swahili: Mtu mwaminifu atabarikiwa sana, bali yeye atamaniye kupata utajiri kwa haraka hataacha kuadhibiwa.

english: To show partiality is not good, yet a man will do wrong for a piece of bread.
ekegusii: Ase engencho y’agasamunye k’omogati omonto nigo agwesaria ase ogwanchereria. Korende, tari buya gokora ogwanchereria nonya ’ng’ake.
swahili: Kuonyesha upendeleo si vizuri, hata hivyo mtu atafanya kosa kwa kipande cha mkate.

english: A stingy man hastens after wealth and does not know that poverty awaits him.
ekegusii: Omonto omwegimeria nigo akoayerera koba omonda, gose tari korengereria ng’a obotaka ’mbomonyooore.
swahili: Mtu mchoyo ana tamaa ya kupata utajiri, naye hana habari kuwa umaskini unamngojea.

english: He who rebukes a man will later find more favor than one who flatters with his tongue.
ekegusii: Omonto ogotogonyera oyo oiranire magega ase okomoorongeyia ’nanyoore ogwancherwa kobua oria okomong’aina namang’ana amansu.
swahili: Yeye amkemeaye mtu mwishoni hupata kibali zaidi, kuliko mwenye maneno ya kusifu isivyostahili.

english: He who robs his father or mother, saying, “It is not wrong,” is a companion to the man who destroys.
ekegusii: Omonto okoura ise gose ng’ina enibo yabo, erio oteeba, “Ebi tibiri ebibe,” oyio nigo are omogisangio bw’oyogosiria.
swahili: Yeye amwibiaye babaye au mamaye na kusema, “Si kosa,” yeye ni mwenzi wa yule aharibuye.

english: A greedy man stirs up strife, but he who trusts in the LORD will prosper.
ekegusii: Omonto ore n’endamwamu nigo agoseegeta eriomana, korende oyosemeretie Omonene ’natenenkigwe.
swahili: Mtu mwenye tamaa huchochea fitina, bali yule amtegemeaye Bwana atafanikiwa.

english: He who trusts in himself is a fool, but one who walks in wisdom will be safe.
ekegusii: Oyobwesemeretie ere omonyene, oyio nomoriri, korende oyo okobwatia obong’aini natoorigwe.
swahili: Yeye ajitumainiaye mwenyewe ni mpumbavu, bali yeye atembeaye katika hekima hulindwa salama.

english: Whoever gives to the poor will not be in need, but he who hides his eyes will receive many curses.
ekegusii: Omonto ogokoonya abataka takoremerwa, korende oyo ogotuba amaiso aye ng’a tarora abataka ’nanyore okoragererigwa okonge.
swahili: Yeye ampaye maskini hatapungukiwa na kitu chochote, bali yeye awafumbiaye maskini macho hupata laana nyingi.

english: When the wicked come to power, people hide themselves; but when they perish, the righteous flourish.
ekegusii: Ekero abakori amabe bakogamba, abanto nigo bakwebisa, korende ekero basiriigwe, abanyaboronge nigo bakomentekana.
swahili: Wakati waovu watawalapo, watu huenda mafichoni, bali waovu wanapoangamia, wenye haki hufanikiwa.

english: A destitute leader who oppresses the poor is like a driving rain that leaves no food.
ekegusii: Omonto omotaka ore n’okobua ogokorera abataka bande bobe ase okobaurereria, nigo anga buna embura enyinge egosaria chindagera.
swahili: Mtu maskini amwoneaye yeye aliye maskini zaidi ni kama mvua ya dhoruba isiyosaza mazao.

english: Those who forsake the law praise the wicked, but those who keep the law resist them.
ekegusii: Abanto batigire amachiiko nigo bagotogia abakori amabe, korende abarendete amachiiko nigo bakoamererania nabwo.
swahili: Wale waiachao sheria huwasifu waovu, bali wale waishikao sheria huwapinga.

english: Evil men do not understand justice, but those who seek the LORD comprehend fully.
ekegusii: Abakori amabe tibamanyeti ayare amaronge, korende abwo bakomorigia Omonene nigo bayamanyete onsi.
swahili: Watu wabaya hawaelewi haki, bali wale wamtafutao Bwana wanaielewa kikamilifu.

english: Better a poor man who walks with integrity than a rich man whose ways are perverse.
ekegusii: Omonto omotaka okobwatia oboronge nigo are omuya kobua omonda ore omokorekanu.
swahili: Afadhali maskini ambaye mwenendo wake hauna lawama kuliko tajiri ambaye njia zake ni potovu.

english: A discerning son keeps the law, but a companion of gluttons disgraces his father.
ekegusii: Omwana orendete amachiiko nigo are omong’aini, korende oyore omogisangio bwa baria bobe nigo akorenta obosooku ase ise.
swahili: Yeye ashikaye sheria ni mwana mwenye ufahamu, bali rafiki wa walafi humwaibisha baba yake.

english: He who increases his wealth by interest and usury lays it up for one who is kind to the poor.
ekegusii: Omonto okomenta chinibo chiaye ase enchera etari ey’ekeene ase okogania ebitoki, oyio nigo agochisangereria chibe echi’omonto okororera abataka amaabera.
swahili: Yeye aongezaye utajiri wake kwa riba kubwa mno hukusanya kwa ajili ya mwingine, ambaye atawahurumia maskini.

english: Whoever turns his ear away from hearing the law, even his prayer is detestable.
ekegusii: Omonto okoonchora ogoto kwaye taigwera amachiiko, nonya n’ogosaba kwaye nigo kore okogechia.
swahili: Kama mtu yeyote akikataa kusikia sheria, hata maombi yake ni chukizo.

english: A man who remains stiff-necked after much reproof will suddenly be shattered beyond recovery.
ekegusii: Omonto okona gokurerwa botambe ase okorongeigwa, korende okong’ia ebigoti, oyio nasirigwe mobosokano, tagokonywa.
swahili: Mtu anayeendelea kuwa na shingo ngumu baada ya maonyo mengi, ataangamia ghafula, wala hapati dawa.

english: Men of bloodshed hate a blameless man, but the upright care for his life.
ekegusii: Abanto bare nerang’o y’ogoitera amanyinga nigo bakogecha oyo otari na komocha, korende abare ne chinkoro chindonge nigo bakomorenda.
swahili: Watu wamwagao damu humchukia mtu mwadilifu na hutafuta kumuua mtu mnyofu.

english: A fool vents all his anger, but a wise man holds it back.
ekegusii: Omonto omoriri nigo agosokia endamwamu yaye yonsi, korende oyore omong’aini nigo akoyetanga otoerera.
swahili: Mpumbavu huonyesha hasira yake yote, bali mwenye hekima hujizuia.

english: If a ruler listens to lies, all his officials will be wicked.
ekegusii: Omogambi aise gwancha amang’ana y’oborimo, abasomba baye bonsi nigo barabe abakori amabe.
swahili: Kama mtawala akisikiliza uongo, maafisa wake wote huwa waovu.

english: The poor man and the oppressor have this in common: The LORD gives light to the eyes of both.
ekegusii: Omotaka na omochaandi nigo bamenyete amo; Omonene nere okobaa bonsi babere oborabu bw’amaiso.
swahili: Mtu maskini na mtu anayeonea wanafanana kwa jambo hili: Bwana hutia nuru macho yao wote wawili.

english: A king who judges the poor with fairness— his throne will be established forever.
ekegusii: Omorwoti okogambera abataka ase oboronge, obogambi bwaye ’mbogeenderere gotenena bokong’u.
swahili: Kama mfalme akiwaamua maskini kwa haki, kiti chake cha enzi kitakuwa thabiti siku zote.

english: A rod of correction imparts wisdom, but a child left to himself disgraces his mother.
ekegusii: Ekeranya na ogotogonyera ase okorongeyia nigo bikorenta obong’aini, korende omwana ogotigwa okora buna anchete, nigo akorentera ng’ina obosooku.
swahili: Fimbo ya maonyo hutia hekima, bali mtoto aliyeachiwa bila maonyo humwaibisha mama yake.

english: When the wicked thrive, rebellion increases; but the righteous will see their downfall.
ekegusii: Ekero abakori amabe bakomentekana, ogosaria nigo gokomentekana, korende abanyene oboronge ’mbarore okogwa kw’abwo.
swahili: Wakati waovu wanapostawi, pia dhambi vivyo hivyo, lakini wenye haki wataliona anguko lao.

english: Discipline your son, and he will give you rest; he will bring delight to your soul.
ekegusii: Rongeyia omwana oo omomura, ere nakorentere ogotimoka, nigo araarente omosasoko omonge ase enkoro yao.
swahili: Mrudi mwanao, naye atakupa amani, atakufurahisha nafsi yako.

english: Where there is no vision, the people cast off restraint; but blessed is he who keeps the Law.
ekegusii: Ase okomaanorerwa kw’amang’ana gotari, abanto tibari gwetanga gokora amabe, korende nasesenirie oyo obwatete amachiiko.
swahili: Mahali pasipo na ufunuo, watu kujizuia, bali ana heri mtu yule aishikaye sheria.

english: A servant cannot be corrected by words alone; though he understands, he will not respond.
ekegusii: Amang’ana oka amasa takorongeyia omosomba, ekiagera n’aba oyamanyete, takoyaigwera.
swahili: Mtumishi hawezi kuonywa kwa maneno matupu, ajapoelewa, hataitikia.

english: When the righteous flourish, the people rejoice, but when the wicked rule, the people groan.
ekegusii: Ekero abanyene oboronge bakogaamba, abanto nigo bakoba n’omogooko, korende ekero abakori amabe bakogaamba, abanto nigo bagochaandeka na kweumia.
swahili: Wenye haki wanapostawi, watu hufurahi; waovu watawalapo, watu hulia kwa huzuni.

english: Do you see a man who speaks in haste? There is more hope for a fool than for him.
ekegusii: Oise korora omonto ore omwango ase ogokwana, ogosemeria ’nkore ase omonto omoriri kobua ase oyio.
swahili: Je, unamwona mtu azungumzaye kwa haraka? Kuna matumaini zaidi kwa mpumbavu kuliko yeye.

english: A servant pampered from his youth will bring grief in the end.
ekegusii: Omonto ogotuga omosomba oye na omoa ebinto bionsi aganetie korwa obwana bwaye, omosomba oyio nabo araire omwando oye.
swahili: Kama mtu akimdekeza mtumishi wake tangu ujanani, atamletea sikitiko mwishoni.

english: An angry man stirs up dissension, and a hot-tempered man abounds in transgression.
ekegusii: Omonto obwate endamwamu nigo agoseegeta eriomana, na oyo okogechigwa nigo akorenta ogosaria okonge.
swahili: Mtu mwenye hasira huchochea ugomvi, naye mtu mwenye hasira ya haraka hutenda dhambi nyingi.

english: A man’s pride will bring him low, but a humble spirit will obtain honor.
ekegusii: Oboenenu bw’omonto nigo bokomokeeyia, korende oyore n’Omoika bw’oboitongo nigo akonyoora ogosikwa okonene.
swahili: Kiburi cha mtu humshusha, bali mtu mwenye roho ya unyenyekevu hupata heshima.

english: A partner to a thief hates his own soul; he receives the oath, but does not testify.
ekegusii: Omonto ore omogisangio bw’omoibi nigo ageechete obogima bwaye obonyene; nigo akoigwa ogotianerwa gw’okoragereria, korende okira takoorokia gento.
swahili: Anayekubaliana na mwizi ni adui wa nafsi yake mwenyewe; huapishwa lakini hathubutu kushuhudia.

english: The fear of man is a snare, but whoever trusts in the LORD is set securely on high.
ekegusii: Okobairoka Mwanyabaanto nigo gokoba omotego, korende omonto omosemeretie Omonene nigo arendire buya.
swahili: Kuwaogopa watu huwa ni mtego, bali yeyote amtumainiaye Bwana atakuwa salama.

english: Many seek the ruler’s favor, but a man receives justice from the LORD.
ekegusii: Abanto abange nigo bakorigia ogwancherwa gokorwa ase omogambi, korende kera omonto nigo akonyora oboronge korwa ase Omonene.
swahili: Wengi hutafuta kusikilizwa na mtawala, bali mtu hupata haki kutoka kwa Bwana.

english: An unjust man is detestable to the righteous, and one whose way is upright is detestable to the wicked.
ekegusii: Omonto otari omooronge nigo are okogechia ase oyore omooronge, na oyore n’enkoro endonge nigo are okogechia ase omokori amabe.
swahili: Mwenye haki huwachukia sana wasio waaminifu; waovu huwachukia sana wenye haki.

english: A man who loves wisdom brings joy to his father, but a companion of prostitutes squanders his wealth.
ekegusii: Oyo bwanchete obong’aini nigo akomogokia ise, korende oyogotaara amo nabakungu abatayayi nigo agosiria chinibo chiaye.
swahili: Mtu apendaye hekima huleta furaha kwa baba yake, bali aambatanaye na makahaba hutapanya mali yake.

english: By justice a king brings stability to the land, but a man who exacts tribute demolishes it.
ekegusii: Omorwoti ogokora ay’oboronge nigo akogera ense yaye yageenderera gotenena bokong’u, korende oyo okorigia amaaki nigo akoyeiyeria.
swahili: Kwa haki mfalme huipa nchi uthabiti, bali mfalme aliye na tamaa ya rushwa huiangamiza.

english: A man who flatters his neighbor spreads a net for his feet.
ekegusii: Omonto okong’aina omonto onde namang’ana amansu, oyio nigo agwetegera omotego ase amagoro aye.
swahili: Yeyote amsifuye jirani yake isivyostahili, anautandaza wavu kuitega miguu yake.

english: An evil man is caught by his own sin, but a righteous one sings and rejoices.
ekegusii: Omonto omonyabibe nigo agotegwa nobosareku bwaye, korende omonyene oboronge nigo agoteera n’omogooko na gochenga.
swahili: Mtu mbaya hutegwa na dhambi yake mwenyewe bali mwenye haki huweza kuimba na kufurahi.

english: The righteous consider the cause of the poor, but the wicked have no regard for such concerns.
ekegusii: Omonyene oboronge nigo agwechaandera oboronge bw’abataka, korende omokori amabe tamanyeti kende.
swahili: Mwenye haki hujali haki kwa ajili ya maskini, bali mwovu hajishughulishi na hilo.

english: Mockers inflame a city, but the wise turn away anger.
ekegusii: Abanyacheche nigo bakoburukania omochie, korende abanto abang’aini nigo bagokendia ekeririanda.
swahili: Wenye mzaha huuchochea mji, bali watu wenye hekima hugeuzia mbali hasira.

english: If a wise man goes to court with a fool, there will be raving and laughing with no resolution.
ekegusii: Ekero omonto omong’aini akoamererania nomoriri, oria omoriri nigo akogechigwa na goseka, tari gokira-kiri.
swahili: Kama mwenye hekima akienda mahakamani na mpumbavu, mpumbavu hukasirika na kudhihaki, wala hakuna amani.

english: My son, if you accept my words and hide my commandments within you,
ekegusii: Omwana one, ancha amang’ana ane, ogache amachiiko ane ase enkoro yao,
swahili: Mwanangu, kama utayakubali maneno yangu na kuyaweka akiba maagizo yangu ndani mwako,

english: For wisdom will enter your heart, and knowledge will delight your soul.
ekegusii: na obong’aini ’mbosoe ase enkoro yao, ne chiseemi nigo chiragokie omoyo oo.
swahili: Kwa maana hekima itaingia moyoni mwako, nayo maarifa yataifurahisha nafsi yako.

english: Discretion will watch over you, and understanding will guard you,
ekegusii: Emeroberio y’ebirengererio ebiya nekorende, na okomanya okuya ’ngokorende boigo.
swahili: Busara itakuhifadhi na ufahamu utakulinda.

english: to deliver you from the way of evil, from the man who speaks perversity,
ekegusii: Obong’aini ’mbokorusie korwa ase chiinchera chi’obobe na korwa ase abanto bagokwana amang’ana y’obosiru.
swahili: Hekima itakuokoa kutoka njia za waovu, kutoka kwa watu ambao maneno yao yamepotoka,

english: from those who leave the straight paths to walk in the ways of darkness,
ekegusii: Abanto abwo nigo bagotiga chiinchera chi’oboronge, babwatia chiinchera chi’omosunte.
swahili: wale waachao mapito yaliyonyooka wakatembea katika njia za giza,

english: from those who enjoy doing evil and rejoice in the twistedness of evil,
ekegusii: Nigo bakogookera ase ogokora amabe, naende bagookera chingencho chi’oborubanu.
swahili: wale wapendao kutenda mabaya na kufurahia upotovu wa ubaya,

english: whose paths are crooked and whose ways are devious.
ekegusii: Chinchera chiabo nigo chire chinkorekanu, nigo bagotaara ase chiinchera chire borogochi.
swahili: ambao mapito yao yamepotoka na ambao ni wapotovu katika njia zao.

english: It will rescue you from the forbidden woman, from the stranger with seductive words
ekegusii: Obong’aini obwo ’mbogokonye kwebachera omokungu onde bwensi omotayayi, oyio ogokwana amang’ana ogweansia korwa ase omonwa oye,
swahili: Itakuokoa pia kutokana na mwanamke kahaba, kutokana na mke aliyepotoka mwenye maneno ya kushawishi kutenda ubaya,

english: who abandons the partner of her youth and forgets the covenant of her God.
ekegusii: oyio otigire omwanchi bw’oboke bwaye, naende bwebire okobwatana kw’ogotianania kwa Nyasae oye.
swahili: aliyemwacha mwenzi wa ujana wake na kupuuza agano alilofanya mbele ya Mungu.

english: For her house sinks down to death, and her tracks to the departed spirits.
ekegusii: Ere amo nab’enyomba yaye nigo bagotirimboka gochia ase amakweri, ne chiinchera chiaye nigo chikobaraa gochia aase abakuure.
swahili: Kwa maana nyumba yake huelekea kwenye kifo na mapito yake kwenye roho za waliokufa.

english: None who go to her return or negotiate the paths of life.
ekegusii: Monto onde bwensi ogochiera omokungu oyio tari koirana naende, takoiranera chiinchera chi’obogima.
swahili: Hakuna yeyote aendaye kwake akarudi, au kufikia mapito ya uzima.

english: if you incline your ear to wisdom and direct your heart to understanding,
ekegusii: erinde oigwe obong’aini, naende orue enkoro yao ebe nokomanya.
swahili: kutega sikio lako kwenye hekima na kuweka moyo wako katika ufahamu,

english: So you will follow in the ways of the good, and keep to the paths of the righteous.
ekegusii: Ase ayio, obwatie enchera y’abanto abaya, na otaare ase oboeto bw’abanyaboronge.
swahili: Hivyo utatembea katika njia za watu wema na kushikamana na mapito ya wenye haki.

english: For the upright will inhabit the land, and the blameless will remain in it;
ekegusii: Ekiagera abare ne chinkoro chindonge ’mbamenye ase ense, na abaikeranu ’mbageenderere komenya aroro.
swahili: Kwa maana wanyofu wataishi katika nchi, nao wasio na lawama watabakia ndani yake.

english: but the wicked will be cut off from the land, and the unfaithful will be uprooted.
ekegusii: Korende abakori amabe ’mbaitwe barue ase ense, na abasaria ’mbasirigwe kegima.
swahili: Bali waovu watakatiliwa mbali kutoka nchi, nao wasio waaminifu watangʼolewa kutoka humo.

english: if you truly call out to insight and lift your voice to understanding,
ekegusii: Obe gokorangeria korigia chiseemi, naende osorore onyore okomanya.
swahili: na kama ukiita busara na kuita kwa sauti ufahamu,

english: if you seek it like silver and search it out like hidden treasure,
ekegusii: Origie obong’aini buna okorigia chifeta, oboriga‐rigie buna okoriga‐rigia chinibo chibisire.
swahili: na kama utaitafuta kama fedha na kuitafuta sana kama hazina iliyofichwa,

english: then you will discern the fear of the LORD and discover the knowledge of God.
ekegusii: Oise gokora bo, rirorio nomanye komoiroka Omonene, naende nigo oranyaare komomanya Nyasae.
swahili: ndipo utakapoelewa kumcha Bwana na kupata maarifa ya Mungu.

english: For the LORD gives wisdom; from His mouth come knowledge and understanding.
ekegusii: Omonene nere okoa abanto obong’aini; chiseemi na okomanya nigo bikorwa ase omonwa oye.
swahili: Kwa maana Bwana hutoa hekima, na kinywani mwake hutoka maarifa na ufahamu.

english: He stores up sound wisdom for the upright; He is a shield to those who walk with integrity,
ekegusii: Abare ne chinkoro chindonge Omonene nigo abagacherete obong’aini oboikeranu. Ere nigo are enguba ase abanto abwo bagotaara ase oboronge.
swahili: Anahifadhi ushindi kwa ajili ya mwadilifu, yeye ni ngao kwa wale wasio na lawama,

english: to guard the paths of justice and protect the way of His saints.
ekegusii: Nigo arendete chiinchera chi’abagokora ekeene, naende orenda chiinchera chi’abamoirogete.
swahili: kwa kuwa hulinda mwenendo wa mwenye haki na kuhifadhi njia ya waaminifu wake.

english: Then you will discern righteousness and justice and equity—every good path.
ekegusii: Koranyigwere, rirorio nomanye ayaare boronge na ekeene, na ayagwenerete: ee, nomanye chiinchera chionsi chire chingiya,
swahili: Ndipo utafahamu lipi lililo kweli na haki na sawa: yaani kila njia nzuri.

english: These are the words of Agur son of Jakeh—the burden that this man declared to Ithiel: “I am weary, O God, and worn out.
ekegusii: Aya naro amang’ana y’Aguri, mosinto o Yake o Masa. Omonto oyio agateebia Itieli na Ukali:
swahili: Misemo ya Aguri mwana wa Yake, usia: Huyu mtu alimwambia Ithieli, naam, kwa Ithieli na kwa Ukali:

english: Do not slander a servant to his master, or he will curse you, and you will bear the guilt.
ekegusii: Tobaisa kogenka omosomba ase omonene oye, nigo arakoragererie, erinde obe nokomocha.
swahili: “Usimchongee mtumishi kwa bwana wake, asije akakulaani, ukapatilizwa kwalo.

english: There is a generation of those who curse their fathers and do not bless their mothers.
ekegusii: Ekegori ’nkere gekoragereria abaise na tikeri gosesenia abaang’ina.
swahili: “Wako watu wale ambao huwalaani baba zao na wala hawawabariki mama zao;

english: There is a generation of those who are pure in their own eyes and yet unwashed of their filth.
ekegusii: Abanto ’mbare bakwerora ng’a nabaikeranu bare, korende tibachenegeti korwa ase obobe bwabo.
swahili: wale ambao ni safi machoni pao wenyewe kumbe hawakuoshwa uchafu wao;

english: There is a generation—how haughty are their eyes and pretentious are their glances—
ekegusii: Abanto ’mbare bagwekaga ng’a nabaya bare na korigereria namaiso aichire nobomwenu.
swahili: wale ambao daima macho yao ni ya kiburi, ambao kutazama kwao ni kwa dharau;

english: there is a generation whose teeth are swords and whose jaws are knives, devouring the oppressed from the earth and the needy from among men.
ekegusii: Abanto ’mbare babwate amaino anga emioro, ne chintakunero chi’amaino abo nigo chinga emeyio; barabwo nigo bakoria na gosiria abataka bare ase ense; nigo bakoura abaremeire bare ase abanto.
swahili: wale ambao meno yao ni panga na ambao mataya yao yamewekwa visu kuwaangamiza maskini katika nchi, na wahitaji kutoka miongoni mwa wanadamu.

english: The leech has two daughters: Give and Give. There are three things that are never satisfied, four that never say, ‘Enough!’:
ekegusii: Rikorominyo ’ndibwate abaiseke babere; barabwo nigo bakorangeria, “Toe, toe!” Mbire ebinto bitato bitari goisaneka; ee, mbire bine bitari goteeba ng’a biaisanekire, nabio ebi;
swahili: “Mruba anao binti wawili waliao, ‘Nipe! Nipe!’ “Kuna vitu vitatu visivyotosheka kamwe, naam, viko vinne visivyosema, ‘Yatosha!’:

english: Sheol, the barren womb, land never satisfied with water, and fire that never says, ‘Enough!’
ekegusii: aase abakuure, na enda engomba, ne riroba rirang’ete amaache, na omorero. Ebio tibiana goteeba, “Twaisanekire.”
swahili: Ni kaburi, tumbo lisilozaa, nchi isiyoshiba maji kamwe, na moto, usiosema kamwe, ‘Yatosha!’

english: As for the eye that mocks a father and scorns obedience to a mother, may the ravens of the valley pluck it out and young vultures devour it.
ekegusii: Eriso ri’omonto ogochecheria ise na gochaaya ng’ina ndirusigwe nebigonkoru bie rigoko na ririegwe namage ye chinsoti.
swahili: “Jicho lile limdhihakilo baba, lile linalodharau kumtii mama, litangʼolewa na kunguru wa bondeni, litaliwa na tai.

english: There are three things too wonderful for me, four that I cannot understand:
ekegusii: Ebinto mbire bitato bire bi’ogokumia ase ’nde; ee, mbire bine ebio ’ntamanyeti, nabio ebi:
swahili: “Kuna vitu vitatu vinavyonishangaza sana, naam, vinne nisivyovielewa:

english: the way of an eagle in the sky, the way of a snake on a rock, the way of a ship at sea, and the way of a man with a maiden.
ekegusii: enchera y’ekeongo igoro, na ey’eng’iti igoro ase egetare, na ey’emeeri igoro ase amaache y’enyancha, na enchera omosacha akobua omoiseke.
swahili: Ni mwendo wa tai katika anga, mwendo wa nyoka juu ya mwamba, mwendo wa meli katika maji makuu ya bahari, nao mwendo wa mtu pamoja na msichana.

english: Surely I am the most ignorant of men, and I lack the understanding of a man.
ekegusii: Ekeene, inche nigo inde omoriri otagwenereti korokwa omonto, gose timbwati obomanyi bwa Mwanyabaanto.
swahili: “Mimi ni mjinga kuliko wanadamu wote; sina ufahamu wa kibinadamu.

english: This is the way of an adulteress: She eats and wipes her mouth and says, ‘I have done nothing wrong.’
ekegusii: Eyio nenchera y’omokuungu omotomani: Nigo akoria na otinyia omonwa oye, erio oteeba, “Inche tindakora bonyaka bonde.”
swahili: “Huu ndio mwendo wa mwanamke mzinzi, hula akapangusa kinywa chake na kusema, ‘Sikufanya chochote kibaya.’

english: Under three things the earth trembles, under four it cannot bear up:
ekegusii: Nare amang’ana atato akonyegeria ense, ee, nare ane etanyaare koyaremereria, naro aya:
swahili: “Kwa mambo matatu nchi hutetemeka, naam, kwa mambo manne haiwezi kuvumilia:

english: a servant who becomes king, a fool who is filled with food,
ekegusii: Ekero omosomba akoba omorwoti, na omonto omoriri akoigota endagera,
swahili: Mtumwa awapo mfalme, mpumbavu ashibapo chakula,

english: an unloved woman who marries, and a maidservant who supplants her mistress.
ekegusii: na ekero omoiseke otanchiri akonyuomwa, na omoiseke omosomba akoira ribaga ri’omokuungu oria agokorera emeremo.
swahili: mwanamke asiyependwa aolewapo, naye mtumishi wa kike achukuapo nafasi ya bibi yake.

english: Four things on earth are small, yet they are exceedingly wise:
ekegusii: Mbire ebinto bine ebisinini mono ase ense, korende bire n’obong’aini obonge, nabio ebi:
swahili: “Vitu vinne duniani vilivyo vidogo, lakini vina akili nyingi sana:

english: The ants are creatures of little strength, yet they store up their food in the summer;
ekegusii: Amage nigo are ebitongwa bitari ne chinguru, korende nigo akogaacha endagera yabo agocha koria engaki y’egurugura.
swahili: Mchwa ni viumbe wenye nguvu ndogo, hata hivyo hujiwekea akiba ya chakula chao wakati wa kiangazi.

english: the rock badgers are creatures of little power, yet they make their homes in the rocks;
ekegusii: Ebisengi tibibwati chinguru, korende nigo bikoroisia ase bikomenya ase ebitare ime.
swahili: Pelele ni viumbe vyenye uwezo mdogo hata hivyo hujitengenezea nyumba zao kwenye miamba.

english: the locusts have no king, yet they all advance in formation;
ekegusii: Chingige tichibwati omorwoti, korende nigo chikogeendera amo emegaanda ase emegaanda.
swahili: Nzige hawana mfalme, hata hivyo huenda pamoja vikosi vikosi.

english: and the lizard can be caught in one’s hands, yet it is found in the palaces of kings.
ekegusii: Ensagara nabo erabogorigwe nokoboko kw’omonto, korende nabo ekomenya ase chinyomba chi’abarwoti.
swahili: Mjusi anaweza kushikwa kwa mkono, hata hivyo huonekana katika majumba ya kifalme.

english: There are three things that are stately in their stride, and four that are impressive in their walk:
ekegusii: Mbire ebinto bitato bikogokia ase ogotaara kwabo, ee, mbire bine bire nogotaara okuya, nabio ebi.
swahili: “Viko vitu vitatu ambavyo vinapendeza katika mwendo wao, naam, vinne ambavyo hutembea kwa mwendo wa madaha:

english: I have not learned wisdom, and I have no knowledge of the Holy One.
ekegusii: Inche tineorokereretie obong’aini, erinde imomanye oyore Omochenu.
swahili: Sijajifunza hekima, wala sina maarifa ya kumjua yeye Aliye Mtakatifu.

english: a lion, mighty among beasts, refusing to retreat before anything;
ekegusii: Endo ere ne chinguru chinyinge kobua ching’iti chinde, na teri kwoboigwa na ng’iti ende,
swahili: simba, mwenye nguvu miongoni mwa wanyama, asiyerudi nyuma kwa chochote;

english: a strutting rooster; a he-goat; and a king with his army around him.
ekegusii: na etuoni egwesigoria, na egoree, na omorwoti okoraa abarwani baye b’esegi.
swahili: jogoo atembeaye kwa maringo, pia beberu, naye mfalme pamoja na jeshi lake lililomzunguka.

english: If you have foolishly exalted yourself or if you have plotted evil, put your hand over your mouth.
ekegusii: Onye kwabeire omoriri na kweimokereirie igoro, gose onye kwabeire gokorengereria amabe, beeka okoboko kwao ase omonwa oo, oyotube.
swahili: “Ikiwa umefanya upumbavu na ukajitukuza mwenyewe, au kama umepanga mabaya, basi funika mdomo wako na mkono wako.

english: For as the churning of milk yields butter, and the twisting of the nose draws blood, so the stirring of anger brings forth strife.”
ekegusii: Amabeere agotundwa nigo akorua amaguta, na okomintontoria emioro, amanyinga nigo akoruerao. Naboigo ogoseegeta na koba nendamwamu, ayio nigo akorenta okorwana.
swahili: Kwa maana kama vile kusukasuka maziwa hutoa siagi, na pia kule kufinya pua hutoa damu, kadhalika kuchochea hasira hutokeza ugomvi.”

english: Who has ascended to heaven and come down? Who has gathered the wind in His hands? Who has bound up the waters in His cloak? Who has established all the ends of the earth? What is His name, and what is the name of His Son— surely you know!
ekegusii: Ning’o oriinete gochia igoro na goika gocha aa inse? Ning’o osangereirie omwaga ase enkundi yaye? Ning’o obwatire amaache na koyaboa ase eanga yaye? Ning’o okong’etie chinsinyo chionsi chi’ense? Inaki oyio akorokwa, na omwana oye naki akorokwa? Nteebia onye koyamanyete!
swahili: Ni nani ameshapanda mbinguni na kushuka? Ni nani ameshakusanya upepo kwenye vitanga vya mikono yake? Ni nani ameshafungia maji kwenye nguo yake? Ni nani ameimarisha miisho yote ya dunia? Jina lake ni nani, na mwanawe anaitwa nani? Niambie kama unajua!

english: Every word of God is flawless; He is a shield to those who take refuge in Him.
ekegusii: Kera ring’ana ria Nyasae nigo rienekirie ng’a neri’ekeene. Ere nenguba ase abwo bakomotamera, barendwe.
swahili: “Kila neno la Mungu ni kamilifu; yeye ni ngao kwa wale wanaomkimbilia.

english: Do not add to His words, lest He rebuke you and prove you a liar.
ekegusii: Tobaisa komenta kende ase amang’ana aye, nigo arabaise kogotogonyera, naye obe omonyaborimo. Emebayeno ende
swahili: Usiongeze kwenye maneno yake, ama atakukemea na kukuthibitisha kuwa mwongo.

english: Two things I ask of You— do not refuse me before I die:
ekegusii: Amang’ana abere naro nagosabire, toyandina ntarakwa.
swahili: “Ninakuomba vitu viwili, Ee Bwana; usininyime kabla sijafa:

english: Keep falsehood and deceitful words far from me. Give me neither poverty nor riches; feed me with the bread that is my portion.
ekegusii: Orusie korwa ase ’nde ayare abosa na oborimo. Tobaisa kong’a obotaka gose obotenenku, korende ong’e endagera engwenerete.
swahili: Uutenge mbali nami udanganyifu na uongo; usinipe umaskini wala utajiri, bali unipe chakula cha kunitosha kila siku.

english: Otherwise, I may have too much and deny You, saying, ‘Who is the LORD?’ Or I may become poor and steal, profaning the name of my God.
ekegusii: Oise konyigotia mono, nigo ’ndakwange ’nteebe, “Omonene nere ng’o?” Gose inse koba omotaka nigo ’ndabaisa koiba na ’ndetere erieta ria Nyasae one obosooku.
swahili: Nisije nikawa na vingi vya kuzidi nikakukana na kusema, ‘ Bwana ni nani?’ Au nisije nikawa maskini nikaiba, nami nikaliaibisha jina la Mungu wangu.

english: These are the words of King Lemuel—the burden that his mother taught him:
ekegusii: Amang’ana aya naro Lemweli omorwoti orokereretigwe na ng’ina.
swahili: Misemo ya Mfalme Lemueli, usia wa mama yake aliyomfundisha:

english: A wife of noble character, who can find? She is far more precious than rubies.
ekegusii: Ning’o oranyaare konyora omokungu omuya? Omokungu omuya nigo are n’engeencho enene kobua amagena ye rigori rinene.
swahili: Mke mwenye sifa nzuri, ni nani awezaye kumpata? Yeye ni wa thamani sana kuliko marijani.

english: The heart of her husband trusts in her, and he lacks nothing of value.
ekegusii: Enkoro y’omosaacha oye nigo emwegenete, gose omosacha oyio takoremerwa konyora ebitoki.
swahili: Mume wake anamwamini kikamilifu wala hakosi kitu chochote cha thamani.

english: She brings him good and not harm all the days of her life.
ekegusii: Ase obogima bwaye bwonsi omokungu oyio nigo agokorera omosacha oye amaya, gose tari korenta amabe ase are.
swahili: Humtendea mumewe mema, wala si mabaya, siku zote za maisha yake.

english: She selects wool and flax and works with eager hands.
ekegusii: Omokungu oyio nigo akorigia amarionya e ching’ondi ne chiusi chi’egatani, okora emeremo namaboko aye ore n’omoyo omuya.
swahili: Huchagua sufu na kitani naye hufanya kazi kwa mikono yenye bidii.

english: She is like the merchant ships, bringing her food from afar.
ekegusii: Nigo anga chimeeri chi’abaonchoreria; nigo akorenta endagera korwa ase ense y’aare.
swahili: Yeye ni kama meli za biashara akileta chakula chake kutoka mbali.

english: She rises while it is still night to provide food for her household and portions for her maidservants.
ekegusii: Nigo akoboka kobore botuko, oroiseria abanto b’enyomba yaye endagera, na oa abasomba baye abaiseke eyebatungetie.
swahili: Yeye huamka kungali bado giza huwapa jamaa yake chakula na mafungu kwa watumishi wake wa kike.

english: She appraises a field and buys it; from her earnings she plants a vineyard.
ekegusii: Nigo akorigia omogondo oyogora, na korwa ase ebitoki bi’emeremo y’amaboko aye nigo agosimeka emesabibu.
swahili: Huangalia shamba na kulinunua, kutokana na mapato yake hupanda shamba la mizabibu.

english: She girds herself with strength and shows that her arms are strong.
ekegusii: Nigo akweboyia chinguru buna orokini, okora emeremo emekong’u n’amaboko aye.
swahili: Hufanya kazi zake kwa nguvu, mikono yake ina nguvu kwa ajili ya kazi zake.

english: She sees that her gain is good, and her lamp is not extinguished at night.
ekegusii: Nigo akorora ng’a emeremo yaye nigo ekorenta ebitoki, na etaaya yaye teri korima nyomba mwaye botuko.
swahili: Huona kwamba biashara yake ina faida, wala taa yake haizimiki usiku.

english: She stretches out her hands to the distaff and grasps the spindle with her fingers.
ekegusii: Nigo abwate egekorero akoroiseria chiusi namaboko aye na egete agochiranderera nebiara biaye.
swahili: Huweka mikono yake kwenye pia, navyo vidole vyake hushikilia kijiti chenye uzi.

english: What shall I say, O my son? What, O son of my womb? What, O son of my vows?
ekegusii: Inaki aye omwana o’ne? Inaki aye omwana bw’enda y’ane? Ninki ndagoteebie, aye omwana bw’eira y’ane nariete?
swahili: “Ee mwanangu, ee mwana wa tumbo langu, ee mwana wa nadhiri zangu,

english: She opens her arms to the poor and reaches out her hands to the needy.
ekegusii: Nigo akorambora okoboko kwaye okonya abataka, ee, nabaremeire nigo akobaramborera amaboko aye.
swahili: Huwanyooshea maskini mikono yake na kuwakunjulia wahitaji vitanga vyake.

english: When it snows, she has no fear for her household, for they are all clothed in scarlet.
ekegusii: Ere tari kwoboa chingaki chi’obokendu, ekiagera abanto bonsi b’enyomba yaye nigo babwate chianga chie riberera chiroisirie korwa ase chiusi chimonyinga.
swahili: Theluji ishukapo, hana hofu kwa ajili ya watu wa nyumbani mwake, kwa maana wote wamevikwa nguo za kutia joto.

english: She makes coverings for her bed; her clothing is fine linen and purple.
ekegusii: Omokungu oyio nigo akweroiseria ebirarero; chianga chiaye nigo chiroisirie korwa ase egatani engiya ne chiusi chimbariri.
swahili: Hutengeneza mazulia ya urembo ya kufunika kitanda chake, yeye huvaa kitani safi na urujuani.

english: Her husband is known at the city gate, where he sits among the elders of the land.
ekegusii: Omosacha bw’omokuungu oyio nigo amanyekanete ase ebiita bi’omochie, agwo ase agoikaransa ogaamba ebiina amo nabagaaka b’ense eyio.
swahili: Mume wake anaheshimiwa kwenye lango la mji, aketipo miongoni mwa wazee wa nchi.

english: She makes linen garments and sells them; she delivers sashes to the merchants.
ekegusii: Omokungu oyio nigo akoroisia chianga chi’egatani engiya, ochioonia; naende nigo akoroisia chinkini, ochiooneria abaonchoreria bande.
swahili: Hutengeneza mavazi ya kitani na kuyauza, naye huwauzia wafanyabiashara mishipi.

english: Strength and honor are her clothing, and she can laugh at the days to come.
ekegusii: Nigo akweboyia chinguru na amasikani, na igo nabe nomogooko ase chingaki chigochi‐gocha.
swahili: Amevikwa nguvu na heshima, anaweza kucheka bila kuwa na hofu kwa siku zijazo.

english: She opens her mouth with wisdom, and faithful instruction is on her tongue.
ekegusii: Amorokererio akorua ase omonwa oye nigo are ay’obong’aini n’obuya, amo n’obwororo nigo bore ase oromeme rw’aye.
swahili: Huzungumza kwa hekima na mafundisho ya kuaminika yapo ulimini mwake.

english: She watches over the affairs of her household and does not eat the bread of idleness.
ekegusii: Nigo akoroberia buya amang’ana y’enyomba yaye, gose tari koria endagera atari gokorera emeremo.
swahili: Huangalia mambo ya nyumbani mwake wala hali chakula cha uvivu.

english: Her children rise up and call her blessed; her husband praises her as well:
ekegusii: Abana baye nigo bakoboka bamoroka “Oyosesenirie”, naboigo n’omosaacha oye nigo akomotogia, oteeba.
swahili: Watoto wake huamka na kumwita aliyebarikiwa, mumewe pia humsifu, akisema:

english: “Many daughters have done noble things, but you surpass them all!”
ekegusii: “Abakungu abange bakorire ayare amaya mono, korende aye kwababuire bonsi.”
swahili: “Wanawake wengi hufanya vitu vyenye sifa nzuri, lakini wewe umewapita wote.”

english: Do not spend your strength on women or your vigor on those who ruin kings.
ekegusii: Tobaisa gochwara chinguru chiao ase abakungu, gose chiinchera chiao ase bare, ekiagera nigo bagosiria abarwoti.
swahili: Usitumie nguvu zako kwa wanawake, uhodari wako kwa wale wanaowaharibu wafalme.

english: Charm is deceptive and beauty is fleeting, but a woman who fears the LORD is to be praised.
ekegusii: Obonyakieni nigo bokong’ainereria, na ekieni ekiya nigo kere bosa, korende omokungu omoirogete Omonene, oyio nere oranyaare gotogigwa.
swahili: Kujipamba ili kuvutia ni udanganyifu na uzuri unapita upesi, bali mwanamke anayemcha Bwana atasifiwa.

english: Give her the fruit of her hands, and let her works praise her at the gates.
ekegusii: Kae omokungu oyio okwama kw’emeremo y’amaboko aye, na tiga atogigwe agwo ase ebiita ase ogokora kwaye gwonsi.
swahili: Mpe thawabu anayostahili, nazo kazi zake na zimletee sifa kwenye lango la mji.

english: It is not for kings, O Lemuel, it is not for kings to drink wine, or for rulers to crave strong drink,
ekegusii: Aye Lemweli, okonywa edivai tikogwenereti abarwoti, gose abagaambi tibaabaisa kogania ebinyugwa bigotindia.
swahili: “Ee Lemueli, haifai wafalme, haifai wafalme kunywa mvinyo, haifai watawala kutamani sana kileo,

english: lest they drink and forget what is decreed, depriving all the oppressed of justice.
ekegusii: Baise konywa, nigo barebe amachiiko, na baonchorane oboronge bwa abachaandegete bonsi.
swahili: wasije wakanywa na kusahau vile sheria inavyoamuru na kuwanyima haki zao wote walioonewa.

english: Give strong drink to one who is perishing, and wine to the bitter in soul.
ekegusii: Moe ekenyugwa kegotindia oyo ogochia gosira, na edivai ase oyio oichanete ase omoyo oye.
swahili: Wape kileo wale wanaoangamia, mvinyo wale walio na uchungu,

english: Let him drink and forget his poverty, and remember his misery no more.
ekegusii: Tiga banywe, erinde beebe tibaabaisa kona‐koinyora emechando yabo n’obotaka bwabo.
swahili: Wanywe na kusahau umaskini wao na wasikumbuke taabu yao tena.

english: Open your mouth for those with no voice, for the cause of all the dispossessed.
ekegusii: Maanora omonwa oo, okwanere rimama, orwanerere oboronge bw’abwo batigirwe bachaandegete.
swahili: “Sema kwa ajili ya wale wasioweza kujisemea, kwa ajili ya haki za wote walioachwa ukiwa.

english: Open your mouth, judge righteously, and defend the cause of the poor and needy. The Virtues of a Noble Woman
ekegusii: Maanora omonwa oo, ogambe ebiina bi’ekeene, orwanerere oboronge bw’abataka na obaremeire. Omokungu omuya
swahili: Sema na uamue kwa haki, tetea haki za maskini na wahitaji.” Maneno Ya Mwisho: Mke Mwenye Sifa Nzuri

english: My son, do not forget my teaching, but let your heart keep my commandments;
ekegusii: Omwana one, tobaisa kweba amorokererio ane, korende tiga enkoro yao ebwate amachiiko ane.
swahili: Mwanangu, usisahau mafundisho yangu, bali zitunze amri zangu moyoni mwako,

english: then your barns will be filled with plenty, and your vats will overflow with new wine.
ekegusii: Erio ebiage biao mbiichore n’endagera enyinge na ebimitero biao biichore n’edivai engiya.
swahili: ndipo ghala zako zitakapojaa hadi kufurika, viriba vyako vitafurika kwa mvinyo mpya.

english: My son, do not reject the discipline of the LORD, and do not loathe His rebuke;
ekegusii: Omwana one, tobaisa kwanga gose gochaaya okorongeyia kw’Omonene.
swahili: Mwanangu, usiidharau adhabu ya Bwana na usichukie kukaripiwa naye,

english: for the LORD disciplines the one He loves, as does a father the son in whom he delights. The Blessings of Wisdom
ekegusii: Omonto onde bwensi Omonene anchete nigo akomorongeyia, buna ise omwana akorongeyia omwana oria agokirie nere.
swahili: kwa sababu Bwana huwaadibisha wale awapendao, kama vile baba afanyavyo kwa mwana apendezwaye naye.

english: Blessed is the man who finds wisdom, the man who acquires understanding,
ekegusii: Nare n’omogooko omonto oyio onyorire obong’aini naende ore n’okomanya.
swahili: Heri mtu yule aonaye hekima, mtu yule apataye ufahamu,

english: for she is more profitable than silver, and her gain is better than fine gold.
ekegusii: Obong’aini nigo bobwate ebitoki ebinge kobua ebie chifeta na ebie chitaabu.
swahili: kwa maana hekima ana faida kuliko fedha na mapato yake ni bora kuliko ya dhahabu safi.

english: She is more precious than rubies; nothing you desire compares with her.
ekegusii: Nigo bore n’engeencho enene kobua amagena akomeka‐meka ye rigori rinene, gose tokoboreng’ania na kende gionsi oganetie.
swahili: Hekima ana thamani kuliko marijani; hakuna chochote unachokitamani kinachoweza kulinganishwa naye.

english: Long life is in her right hand; in her left hand are riches and honor.
ekegusii: Obong’aini nigo bobwate obogima bw’amatuko amaange ase okoboko kwaye gw’okorio, na ase okoboko kwaye gw’okobee nigo bobwate obonda obonge amo n’ogosikwa.
swahili: Maisha marefu yako katika mkono wake wa kuume; katika mkono wake wa kushoto kuna utajiri na heshima.

english: All her ways are pleasant, and all her paths are peaceful.
ekegusii: Chinchera chiaye nigo chire echi’omogooko, na oboeto bwaye bwonsi nigo bore obw’omorembe.
swahili: Njia zake zinapendeza, mapito yake yote ni amani.

english: She is a tree of life to those who embrace her, and those who lay hold of her are blessed.
ekegusii: Nigo bore omote bw’obogima ase abwo babobwatererete; na kera omonto ogendererete kobobwata bokong’u nasesenirie.
swahili: Yeye ni mti wa uzima kwa wale wanaomkumbatia; wale wamshikao watabarikiwa.

english: The LORD founded the earth by wisdom and established the heavens by understanding.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo abeegete oboroso bw’ense n’obong’aini bwaye, na agakong’ia igoro nokomanya kwaye.
swahili: Kwa hekima Bwana aliiweka misingi ya dunia, kwa ufahamu aliziweka mbingu mahali pake;

english: for they will add length to your days, years and peace to your life.
ekegusii: Ayio nagere omenye amatuko amaange, na emiaka emenge, naende ogeendererete koba nomorembe.
swahili: kwa kuwa zitakuongezea miaka mingi ya maisha yako na kukuletea mafanikio.

english: By His knowledge the watery depths were broken open, and the clouds dripped with dew.
ekegusii: Ase obong’aini bwaye chindiba nigo chikobochoria, na amare atonyia riime.
swahili: kwa maarifa yake vilindi viligawanywa, nayo mawingu yanadondosha umande.

english: My son, do not lose sight of this: Preserve sound judgment and discernment.
ekegusii: Omwana one, bwata bokong’u obong’aini obuya na okomanya; tobaisa gotiga ebio birue ase obosio bwao.
swahili: Mwanangu, hifadhi maamuzi mema na busara, usiache vitoke machoni pako;

english: They will be life to your soul and adornment to your neck.
ekegusii: Igo ebio mbibe obogima ase omoyo oo, na ogwechabera okuya ase rigoti ria’o.
swahili: ndipo vitakapokuwa uzima nafsini mwako na pambo la neema shingoni mwako.

english: Then you will go on your way in safety, and your foot will not stumble.
ekegusii: Erio notaare ase enchera yao kore n’oborendi obuya, gose tokogoochwa okogoro kwao.
swahili: Kisha utaenda katika njia yako salama, wala mguu wako hautajikwaa;

english: When you lie down, you will not be afraid; when you rest, your sleep will be sweet.
ekegusii: Ekero ogochia korara, toba n’obwoba, koraire nonyore chitoro chingiya.
swahili: ulalapo, hautaogopa; ulalapo usingizi wako utakuwa mtamu.

english: Do not fear sudden danger or the ruin that overtakes the wicked,
ekegusii: Tobaisa kwoboa okogosa kogocha mobosokano, gose ogosirigwa kw’abanyabibe kogocha buna omoubera.
swahili: Usiogope maafa ya ghafula au maangamizi yanayowapata waovu,

english: for the LORD will be your confidence and will keep your foot from the snare.
ekegusii: Omonene nabe ogosemeria kwao, ere narende okogoro kwao tikobaisa kobwatwa ase omotego.
swahili: kwa kuwa Bwana atakuwa tumaini lako na kuepusha mguu wako kunaswa katika mtego.

english: Do not withhold good from the deserving when it is within your power to act.
ekegusii: Tobaisa korina abaremerwa amaya ayabagwenerete konyora, onye ayio are ase okobua kwao kobakoonya.
swahili: Usizuie wema kwa wale wanaostahili ikiwa katika uwezo wako kutenda.

english: Do not tell your neighbor, “Come back tomorrow and I will provide”— when you already have the means.
ekegusii: Ekero obwate egento ase engaki eyio kware koa omonto omino, tobaisa komoteebia, “Genda ochiche ankio, nario ndagekoe.”
swahili: Usimwambie jirani yako, “Njoo baadaye, nitakupa kesho”: wakati wewe unacho kitu kile karibu nawe.

english: Do not devise evil against your neighbor, for he trustfully dwells beside you.
ekegusii: Tobaisa gokora emeroberio gokorera omonto omino bobe; oyio omenyete amo naye, ogosemeretie ng’a anyore oborendi obuya.
swahili: Usifanye hila ya kumdhuru jirani yako, ambaye anaishi karibu na wewe akikuamini.

english: Never let loving devotion or faithfulness leave you; bind them around your neck, write them on the tablet of your heart.
ekegusii: Totiga obuya na ekeene birue ase ore; obisibe ase rigoti ria’o, na obiriike ase enkoro yao.
swahili: Usiache kamwe upendo na uaminifu vitengane nawe; vifunge shingoni mwako, viandike katika ubao wa moyo wako.

english: Do not accuse a man without cause, when he has done you no harm.
ekegusii: Tobaisa koamererania na monto onde engencho ende etaiyo, onye taragokorera bobe bonde.
swahili: Usimshtaki mtu bila sababu, wakati hajakutenda dhara lolote.

english: Do not envy a violent man or choose any of his ways;
ekegusii: Tobaisa gosanera amang’ana yomonto otari gokora ay’oboronge, gose tobaisa kwega chiinchera chiaye,
swahili: Usimwonee wivu mtu mwenye jeuri wala kuchagua njia yake iwayo yote,

english: for the LORD detests the perverse, but He is a friend to the upright.
ekegusii: ekiagera abanto abasareku nigo bare okogechia ase Omonene, korende obobisi bwaye nigo bore ase abwo bare ne chinkoro chindonge.
swahili: kwa kuwa Bwana humchukia mtu mpotovu, lakini siri yake iko kwa mwenye haki.

english: The curse of the LORD is on the house of the wicked, but He blesses the home of the righteous.
ekegusii: Okoragereria kw’Omonene nigo kore ase chinyomba chi’abakori amabe, korende nigo agosesenia chinka chi’abanyene oboronge.
swahili: Laana ya Bwana i juu ya nyumba ya mwovu, lakini yeye huibariki nyumba ya mwenye haki.

english: He mocks the mockers, but gives grace to the humble.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo agochecheria abwo bagochecheria, korende abaitongo nigo akobaa obuya na amaabera.
swahili: Huwadhihaki wale wanaodhihaki, lakini huwapa neema wale wanyenyekevu.

english: The wise will inherit honor, but fools are held up to shame.
ekegusii: Abanto abang’aini ’mbanyore omwando bw’obonene, korende abariri ’mbabogorie obosooku.
swahili: Wenye hekima hurithi heshima, bali huwaaibisha wapumbavu.

english: Then you will find favor and high regard in the sight of God and man.
ekegusii: Igo nario oranyore ogwancherwa na okomanya okuya ase obosio bwa Nyasae, na ase Mwanyabaanto.
swahili: Ndipo utapata kibali na jina zuri mbele za Mungu na mwanadamu.

english: Trust in the LORD with all your heart, and lean not on your own understanding;
ekegusii: Osemerie Omonene n’enkoro yao yonsi; tobaisa gosemeria okomanya kwao.
swahili: Mtumaini Bwana kwa moyo wako wote wala usizitegemee akili zako mwenyewe;

english: in all your ways acknowledge Him, and He will make your paths straight.
ekegusii: Orengererie Omonene, omoorokie ase chiinchera chiao chionsi, nere narongeyie oboeto bwao.
swahili: katika njia zako zote mkiri yeye, naye atayanyoosha mapito yako.

english: Be not wise in your own eyes; fear the LORD and turn away from evil.
ekegusii: Tobaisa gwekora omong’aini ase okorora kwao omonyene; omoiroke Omonene na bweatanane korwa ase amabe.
swahili: Usiwe mwenye hekima machoni pako mwenyewe; mche Bwana ukajiepushe na uovu.

english: This will bring healing to your body and refreshment to your bones.
ekegusii: Korakore igo, ayio nagwenie omobere oo abeeke emeseto y’amauga ao chinguru.
swahili: Hii itakuletea afya mwilini mwako, na mafuta kwenye mifupa yako.

english: Honor the LORD with your wealth and with the firstfruits of all your harvest;
ekegusii: Osike Omonene ne chinibo chiao chionsi na ogotongora kwao gwonsi kw’endagera.
swahili: Mheshimu Bwana kwa mali zako na kwa malimbuko ya mazao yako yote;

english: Listen, my sons, to a father’s instruction; pay attention and gain understanding.
ekegusii: Inwe abana bane, igwa amorokererio ane inche iso; tegerera mono, erinde monyaare koba n’okomanya.
swahili: Sikilizeni wanangu, mafundisho ya baba yenu; sikilizeni kwa makini na mpate ufahamu.

english: Listen, my son, and receive my words, and the years of your life will be many.
ekegusii: Aye omwana one, igwa amang’ana ane, oyaanche, igo nario emiaka y’obogima bwao er’abe emenge.
swahili: Sikiliza mwanangu, kubali ninachokuambia, nayo miaka ya maisha yako itakuwa mingi.

english: I will guide you in the way of wisdom; I will lead you on straight paths.
ekegusii: Inche nakworokereirie enchera y’obong’aini; nakoraaire ase oboeto bore oboronge.
swahili: Ninakuongoza katika njia ya hekima na kukuongoza katika mapito yaliyonyooka.

english: When you walk, your steps will not be impeded; when you run, you will not stumble.
ekegusii: Ekero oraabe kogotaara, togotererigwa, na ekero oraabe gokominyoka, tokogoochwa.
swahili: Utembeapo, hatua zako hazitazuiliwa; ukimbiapo, hutajikwaa.

english: Hold on to instruction; do not let go. Guard it, for it is your life.
ekegusii: Bwata amorokererio bokong’u, toyatiga arue ase ore; yarende, ekiagera n’aro obogima bwao.
swahili: Mkamate sana elimu, usimwache aende zake; mshike, maana yeye ni uzima wako.

english: Do not set foot on the path of the wicked or walk in the way of evildoers.
ekegusii: Tobaisa kobwatia enchera y’abakori amabe, gose tobwatia chiinchera chi’abaanto ababe.
swahili: Usiuweke mguu wako katika njia ya waovu wala usitembee katika njia ya watu wabaya.

english: Avoid it; do not travel on it. Turn from it and pass on by.
ekegusii: Bweatanane korwa ase enchera eyio, toyebwatia, korende ogobere oetere ensemo, ogeende bosio.
swahili: Epukana nayo, usisafiri katika njia hiyo; achana nayo, na uelekee njia yako.

english: For they cannot sleep unless they do evil; they are deprived of slumber until they make someone fall.
ekegusii: Abanto abwo tibari korara goika barore ng’a bakorire amabe. Onye tibarakorera omonto amabe, tibari korara chitoro.
swahili: Kwa kuwa hawawezi kulala mpaka watende uovu; wanashindwa hata kusinzia mpaka wamwangushe mtu.

english: For they eat the bread of wickedness and drink the wine of violence.
ekegusii: Endagera yabo bakoria n’ogokora amabe, na edivai yabo bakonywa n’obotindi.
swahili: Wanakula mkate wa uovu, na kunywa mvinyo wa jeuri.

english: The path of the righteous is like the first gleam of dawn, shining brighter and brighter until midday.
ekegusii: Korende enchera y’abanyene oboronge nigo enga buna amasase a mambia; ayio akogeenderera koraba goetania goika bwakia se.
swahili: Njia ya wenye haki ni kama nuru ya kwanza ya mapambazuko, ambayo hungʼaa zaidi na zaidi mpaka mchana mkamilifu.

english: But the way of the wicked is like the darkest gloom; they do not know what makes them stumble.
ekegusii: Enchera y’abakori amabe nigo enga buna omosunte ekerima; tibari komanya ebinto bikobagocha.
swahili: Lakini njia ya waovu ni kama giza nene; hawajui kinachowafanya wajikwae.

english: For I give you sound teaching; do not abandon my directive.
ekegusii: Inche nigo ’nkobaa amorokererio amaya; timotiga aya nabachiikeire.
swahili: Ninawapa mafundisho ya maana, kwa hiyo msiyaache mafundisho yangu.

english: My son, pay attention to my words; incline your ear to my sayings.
ekegusii: Omwana one, tegerera oigwe amang’ana ane! Igwera amang’ana ’nkogoteebia.
swahili: Mwanangu, yasikilize kwa makini yale ninayokuambia; sikiliza kwa makini maneno yangu.

english: Do not lose sight of them; keep them within your heart.
ekegusii: Amang’ana ayio tabaisa korua ase amaiso ao. Yagache ime ase enkoro yao.
swahili: Usiruhusu yaondoke machoni pako, yahifadhi ndani ya moyo wako;

english: For they are life to those who find them, and health to the whole body.
ekegusii: Ayio nigo are obogima ase oyio oyanyorire, naende nigo akogwenia omobere oye bwonsi.
swahili: kwa sababu ni uzima kwa wale wanaoyapata na afya kwa mwili wote wa mwanadamu.

english: Guard your heart with all diligence, for from it flow springs of life.
ekegusii: Renda enkoro yao kobua ande onsi orendete, ekiagera nao chinsoko chi’obogima chikorua.
swahili: Zaidi ya yote, linda moyo wako, kuliko yote uyalindayo, maana ndiko zitokako chemchemi za uzima.

english: Put away deception from your mouth; keep your lips from perverse speech.
ekegusii: Tuguta chinkwana chi’obokorekanu korwa ase omonwa oo, na amang’ana y’obong’ainereria korwa ase ebikoba biao.
swahili: Epusha kinywa chako na ukaidi; weka mazungumzo machafu mbali na midomo yako.

english: Let your eyes look forward; fix your gaze straight ahead.
ekegusii: Tiga amaiso ao arigererie gochia bosio, na ebioge bi’amaiso ao biramokigwe boronge.
swahili: Macho yako na yatazame mbele, kaza macho yako moja kwa moja mbele yako.

english: Make a level path for your feet, and all your ways will be sure.
ekegusii: Rongeyia oboeto bw’amagoro ao, ne chiinchera chiao chionsi chibe chindonge.
swahili: Sawazisha mapito ya miguu yako na njia zako zote ziwe zimethibitika.

english: Do not swerve to the right or to the left; turn your feet away from evil.
ekegusii: Togobera gochia aande, ensemo y’okorio gose ey’okobee. Rusia okogoro kwao korwa ase ebibe.
swahili: Usigeuke kulia wala kushoto; epusha mguu wako na ubaya.

english: When I was a son to my father, tender and the only child of my mother,
ekegusii: Nigo narenge omwana, narenge na tata; nigo narenge omwororo nanchire na baba, ekiagera nigo narenge omomoima.
swahili: Nilipokuwa mvulana mdogo katika nyumba ya baba yangu, ningali mchanga na mtoto pekee kwa mama yangu,

english: he taught me and said, “Let your heart lay hold of my words; keep my commands and you will live.
ekegusii: Tata akanyorokereria, aganteebia, “Tiga amang’ana ane abeere ase enkoro yao ime; orende amachiiko ane, erio nario or’abe moyo.”
swahili: baba alinifundisha akisema, “Yashike maneno yangu yote kwa moyo wako wote; yashike maagizo yangu na wewe utaishi.

english: Get wisdom, get understanding; do not forget my words or turn from them.
ekegusii: Enyorere obong’aini na okomanya, tobaisa kobieba! Tibwanga koigwera amang’ana ’ngokwana korwa ase omonwa one.
swahili: Pata hekima, pata ufahamu; usiyasahau maneno yangu wala usiyaache.

english: Do not forsake wisdom, and she will preserve you; love her, and she will guard you.
ekegusii: Tobaisa gotiga obong’aini, ekiagera borobwo ’mbokorende. Obwanche, na borobwo ’mbogere ogeenderere koba buya.
swahili: Usimwache hekima naye atakuweka salama; mpende, naye atakulinda.

english: Wisdom is supreme; so acquire wisdom. And whatever you may acquire, gain understanding.
ekegusii: Obong’aini nigo bore obw’engeencho enene. Ase ayio, enyorere obong’aini, na kende gionsi okorigia, rigia obe n’okomanya.
swahili: Hekima ni bora kuliko vitu vyote; kwa hiyo jipe hekima. Hata ikikugharimu vyote ulivyo navyo, pata ufahamu.

english: Prize her, and she will exalt you; if you embrace her, she will honor you.
ekegusii: Obobare koba n’engeencho enene, na borobwo ’mbogokinie; koraboboanie nigo borakorentere ogosikwa.
swahili: Mstahi, naye atakukweza; mkumbatie, naye atakuheshimu.

english: She will set a garland of grace on your head; she will present you with a crown of beauty.”
ekegusii: Mbobeke ase omotwe oo ekiore gechabeire, naende bokoe eguutwa y’obonene.
swahili: Atakuvika shada la neema kichwani mwako na kukupa taji ya utukufu.”

english: My son, pay attention to my wisdom; incline your ear to my insight,
ekegusii: Omwana one, tegerera oigwe obong’aini bwane! Igwera okomanya kw’ane!
swahili: Mwanangu, sikiliza kwa makini hekima yangu, sikiliza vizuri maneno yangu ya busara,

english: lest strangers feast on your wealth, and your labors enrich the house of a foreigner.
ekegusii: Naende abanto abaao nigo baraire chinibo chiao chionsi, na bionsi ebi gwakoreire emeremo biirwe nabaanto abwo.
swahili: wageni wasije wakasherehekea utajiri wako na jitihada yako ikatajirisha nyumba ya mwanaume mwingine.

english: At the end of your life you will groan when your flesh and your body are spent,
ekegusii: Omoerio oye norere, obokie amagombo ekero chinyama chi’omobere oo chiaerire,
swahili: Mwishoni mwa maisha yako utalia kwa uchungu, wakati nyama na mwili wako vimechakaa.

english: and you will say, “How I hated discipline, and my heart despised reproof!
ekegusii: ’noteebe, “Inaki nakorete ’nkageecha ogokuurerwa, na enkoro y’ane egachaaya okorongeigwa!
swahili: Utasema, “Tazama jinsi gani nilivyochukia adhabu! Tazama jinsi moyo wangu ulivyodharau maonyo!

english: I did not listen to the voice of my teachers or incline my ear to my mentors.
ekegusii: Tinaigwerete amorokererio yaborokia bane, gose tinategererete koigwera abarenge konyorokereria.
swahili: Sikuwatii walimu wangu wala kuwasikiliza wakufunzi wangu.

english: I am on the brink of utter ruin in the midst of the whole assembly.”
ekegusii: Nigo nabeete ang’e gosira ase obosooku kegima bosio bw’omogaanda ondigereretie.”
swahili: Nimefika ukingoni mwa maangamizi kabisa katikati ya kusanyiko lote.”

english: Drink water from your own cistern, and running water from your own well.
ekegusii: Kanywe amaache okobucha korwa ase egesima kiao, na aya agosoka korwa ase ensoko yao.
swahili: Kunywa maji kutoka kwenye kisima chako mwenyewe, maji yanayotiririka kutoka kwenye kisima chako mwenyewe.

english: Why should your springs flow in the streets, your streams of water in the public squares?
ekegusii: Inee! Chinsooko chiao ’nchigwenerete gwesiarera gochia aare, ne chindooche chiao chi’amaache ase chiinchera?
swahili: Je, chemchemi zako zifurike katika barabara za mji na vijito vyako vya maji viwanjani?

english: Let them be yours alone, never to be shared with strangers.
ekegusii: Tiga chinsoko echio chibe echiao aye bweka na tari echi’abaanto abaao.
swahili: Na viwe vyako mwenyewe, kamwe visishirikishwe wageni.

english: May your fountain be blessed, and may you rejoice in the wife of your youth:
ekegusii: Tiga ensoko yao esesenigwe, naye ogookere omokungu bw’oboke bwao,
swahili: Chemchemi yako na ibarikiwe na umfurahie mke wa ujana wako.

english: A loving doe, a graceful fawn— may her breasts satisfy you always; may you be captivated by her love forever.
ekegusii: oyore buna ensune eyanchire na buna engabi ensiani. Tiga obosiani bwaye bokong’use, na ogokigwe nere chingaki chionsi. Obwanchani bwaye tiga bokogokie kogeenderera.
swahili: Kulungu jike apendaye, kulungu mzuri: matiti yake na yakutosheleze siku zote, nawe utekwe daima na upendo wake.

english: that you may maintain discretion and your lips may preserve knowledge.
ekegusii: Erio nario oramanye korenda ebirengererio biao, na ebikoba biao birende chiseemi.
swahili: ili uweze kutunza busara na midomo yako ihifadhi maarifa.

english: Why be captivated, my son, by an adulteress, or embrace the bosom of a stranger?
ekegusii: Omwana one, nase ki okogokigwa nomokuungu omonyaka? Nase ki okoboania omokungu bw’omonto omoao?
swahili: Kwa nini mwanangu, utekwe na mwanamke kahaba? Kwa nini ukumbatie kifua cha mke wa mwanaume mwingine?

english: For a man’s ways are before the eyes of the LORD, and the LORD examines all his paths.
ekegusii: Chinchera chi’omonto nigo chirorekanete maiso marore ase Omonene, n’Omonene nigo arigereretie ogokora kwaye gwonsi.
swahili: Kwa maana njia za mtu ni wazi kabisa mbele za Bwana, naye huyapima mapito yake yote.

english: The iniquities of a wicked man entrap him; the cords of his sin entangle him.
ekegusii: Ebibe bi’omokori amabe nigo bikomobwata omonyene; nasibwe ne chingori chire ebibe biaye.
swahili: Matendo mabaya ya mtu mwovu humnasa yeye mwenyewe; kamba za dhambi yake humkamata kwa nguvu.

english: He dies for lack of discipline, led astray by his own great folly.
ekegusii: Omonto oyio nigo arakwe, ekiagera angete ogokuurerwa, na ase engencho y’oboriri bwaye obonene ’nasire.
swahili: Atakufa kwa kukosa nidhamu, akipotoshwa kwa upumbavu wake mwenyewe.

english: Though the lips of the forbidden woman drip honey and her speech is smoother than oil,
ekegusii: Ebikoba bi’omokuungu omonyaka nigo bigotonyia ayaare amansu buna obooke, na omonwa oye nigo ore omoterere kobua amaguta akweakwa.
swahili: Kwa maana midomo ya mwanamke kahaba hudondoza asali, na maneno ya kinywa chake ni laini kuliko mafuta;

english: in the end she is bitter as wormwood, sharp as a double-edged sword.
ekegusii: Korende omoerio bw’omokuungu oyio nigo ore omoororo buna ekemeri ekeroro, na omwoge buna omoyio o birende otieririe chinsemo chionsi ibere.
swahili: lakini mwisho wake ni mchungu kama nyongo, mkali kama upanga ukatao kuwili.

english: Her feet go down to death; her steps lead straight to Sheol.
ekegusii: Amagoro aye nigo akoraa gochia ase amakweri, na ogotacha kwaye kwaraa gochia aase abakuure.
swahili: Miguu yake hushuka kuelekea kwenye kifo; hatua zake huelekea moja kwa moja kaburini.

english: She does not consider the path of life; she does not know that her ways are unstable.
ekegusii: Ere tari gotaara enchera ekogeenda ase obogima; orogendo rw’aye nigo rokona‐koonchaonchoka, ere tamanyeti ayio.
swahili: Yeye hafikiri juu ya njia ya uzima; njia zake zimepotoka, lakini yeye hajui.

english: So now, my sons, listen to me, and do not turn aside from the words of my mouth.
ekegusii: Ase ayio, inwe abana bane, ’ntegerere; timobaisa gotiga amang’ana ane.
swahili: Sasa basi wanangu, nisikilizeni; msiache ninalowaambia.

english: Keep your path far from her; do not go near the door of her house,
ekegusii: Erende obeere aare korwa ase omokungu oyio; tobaisa goika ang’e negesieri ki’enyomba yaye.
swahili: Njia zenu ziwe mbali naye, msiende karibu na mlango wa nyumba yake,

english: lest you concede your vigor to others, and your years to one who is cruel;
ekegusii: Oise gokora bo, nigo orae abanto abaao amasikani ao, na emiaka yao ebaise konachwa n’abanto batari n’amaabera.
swahili: usije ukatoa nguvu zako nzuri kwa wengine na miaka yako kwa aliye mkatili,

english: My son, if you have put up security for your neighbor, if you have struck hands in pledge with a stranger,
ekegusii: Omwana one, ande kweruure koba intenenera ase omonto omino, na kwarire eira ase omonto omoao na kobwatana nere amaboko.
swahili: Mwanangu, kama umekuwa mdhamini wa jirani yako, ikiwa umeshika mikono kwa kuweka ahadi kwa ajili ya mwingine,

english: A little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to rest,
ekegusii: Okoraara ake, okwegondia ake; okoringania amaboko gotimoka,
swahili: Bado kulala kidogo, kusinzia kidogo, bado kukunja mikono kidogo upate kupumzika:

english: and poverty will come upon you like a robber, and need like a bandit.
ekegusii: obotaka ’mbogoochere buna omouri agoocha, na oboremerwa booche buna omonto obwate ebirwanero agocha.
swahili: hivyo umaskini utakuja juu yako kama mnyangʼanyi, na kupungukiwa kutakujia kama mtu mwenye silaha.

english: A worthless person, a wicked man, walks with a perverse mouth,
ekegusii: Omonto otagwenereti kende ore omokori amabe nigo agoeta‐eta, ogokwana oborimo korwa ase omonwa oye.
swahili: Mtu mbaya sana na mlaghai, ambaye huzungukazunguka na maneno ya upotovu,

english: winking his eyes, speaking with his feet, and pointing with his fingers.
ekegusii: Nigo agosumera ebioge bi’amaiso aye, naende nigo agosumera amagoro, na okworokia ebimanyererio n’amaboko aye.
swahili: ambaye anakonyeza kwa jicho lake, anayetoa ishara kwa miguu yake na kuashiria kwa vidole vyake,

english: With deceit in his heart he devises evil; he continually sows discord.
ekegusii: Ogoitania abanto nigo goichire ase enkoro yaye, botambe nigo akoroberia korenta amabe; nigo agosimeka chimbusuro chi’ogotaigwana.
swahili: ambaye hupanga ubaya kwa udanganyifu moyoni mwake: daima huchochea fitina.

english: Therefore calamity will come upon him suddenly; in an instant he will be shattered beyond recovery.
ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio emechando nemoochere mobosokano; nigo arasirigwe mobasokano atanyaare gotoorigwa.
swahili: Kwa hiyo maafa yatamkumba ghafula; ataangamizwa mara, pasipo msaada.

english: There are six things that the LORD hates, seven that are detestable to Him:
ekegusii: Mbire ebinto bitano nakemo Omonene ageechete, ee, mbire bitan’abibere bire okogeecha ase are, nabio ebi:
swahili: Kuna vitu sita anavyovichukia Bwana, naam, viko saba vilivyo chukizo kwake:

english: haughty eyes, a lying tongue, hands that shed innocent blood,
ekegusii: Okorigereria kw’oboenenu, na oromeme rogokwana oborimo, amaboko agoitera amanyinga atari na komocha;
swahili: macho ya kiburi, ulimi udanganyao, mikono imwagayo damu isiyo na hatia,

english: a heart that devises wicked schemes, feet that run swiftly to evil,
ekegusii: enkoro ekoroberia amabe, na amagoro akominyoka gochia gokora amabe;
swahili: moyo uwazao mipango miovu, miguu iliyo myepesi kukimbilia uovu,

english: a false witness who gives false testimony, and one who stirs up discord among brothers. Warnings against Adultery
ekegusii: kirori bw’oborimo, ogokwana oborimo, na omonto ogosimeka chimbusuro chi’ogoitania ase egati y’abanto abamo. Ogokuurerwa gw’okwanga obonyaka
swahili: shahidi wa uongo ambaye humwaga uongo, na mtu ambaye huchochea fitina kati ya ndugu. Onyo Dhidi Ya Uasherati

english: if you have been trapped by the words of your lips, ensnared by the words of your mouth,
ekegusii: Bono amang’ana gwakwanete korwa ase omonwa oo akobwatire buna omotego.
swahili: kama umetegwa na ulichosema, umenaswa kwa maneno ya kinywa chako,

english: My son, keep your father’s commandment, and do not forsake your mother’s teaching.
ekegusii: Omwana one, igwera aya inche iso ’nkogochika, na totiga amorokererio a nyoko.
swahili: Mwanangu, zishike amri za baba yako, wala usiyaache mafundisho ya mama yako.

english: Bind them always upon your heart; tie them around your neck.
ekegusii: Yasibe, ageenderere kobeera ase enkoro yao botambe, naende oyasibe ase rigoti ria’o.
swahili: Yafunge katika moyo wako daima, yakaze kuizunguka shingo yako.

english: When you walk, they will guide you; when you lie down, they will watch over you; when you awake, they will speak to you.
ekegusii: Ekero or’abe kogotaara, aro nakoraae; ekero or’abe koraire, ’nakorende, na ekero or’abe gokoboka, ayio nakwane naye.
swahili: Wakati utembeapo, yatakuongoza; wakati ulalapo, yatakulinda; wakati uamkapo, yatazungumza nawe.

english: For this commandment is a lamp, this teaching is a light, and the reproofs of discipline are the way to life,
ekegusii: Amachiiko nigo are etaya, na amorokererio nigo are oborabu; ogokuurera gw’okorongeigwa nigo kore enchera y’obogima.
swahili: Kwa maana amri hizi ni taa, mafundisho haya ni mwanga na maonyo ya maadili ni njia ya uzima,

english: to keep you from the evil woman, from the smooth tongue of the adulteress.
ekegusii: Nigo korakorende korwa ase omokungu omonyaka, na korwa ase amang’ana y’oromeme rw’aye oroterere rokoebereria.
swahili: yakikulinda na mwanamke aliyepotoka, kutokana na maneno laini ya mwanamke aliyepotoka.

english: Do not lust in your heart for her beauty or let her captivate you with her eyes.
ekegusii: Tobaisa komogania ase enkoro yao ime ase engencho y’ekieni kiaye ekiya; amaiso aye tabaisa gokong’usa.
swahili: Moyo wako usitamani uzuri wake wala macho yake yasikuteke,

english: For the levy of the prostitute is poverty, and the adulteress preys upon your very life.
ekegusii: Ase engencho y’omokuungu omotayayi omonto nigo akoremerwa oborwa nonya negesamunye ki’omogati, na omokungu bw’omonto omoao nigo akorigia obogima bw’omonto obosaria.
swahili: kwa maana kahaba atakufanya uwe maskini, hata ukose kipande cha mkate, naye mwanamke mzinzi huwinda maisha yako hasa.

english: Can a man embrace fire and his clothes not be burned?
ekegusii: Inee! Omonto nabogorie omorero ayobeeke ase egekuba kiaye, ne chianga chiaye tichiyia?
swahili: Je, mtu aweza kuchotea moto kwenye paja lake bila nguo zake kuungua?

english: Can a man walk on hot coals without scorching his feet?
ekegusii: Gose nataare ase rieera ri’omorero, na amagoro aye tayia?
swahili: Je, mtu aweza kutembea juu ya makaa ya moto yanayowaka bila miguu yake kuungua?

english: So is he who sleeps with another man’s wife; no one who touches her will go unpunished.
ekegusii: Naboigo er’abe ase omonto ogotomana n’omokungu bw’omonto onde; onde bwensi okoba nomokuungu oyio goika aegwe egesusuro.
swahili: Ndivyo alivyo mtu alalaye na mke wa mwanaume mwingine; hakuna yeyote amgusaye huyo mwanamke ambaye hataadhibiwa.

english: then do this, my son, to free yourself, for you have fallen into your neighbor’s hands: Go, humble yourself, and press your plea with your neighbor.
ekegusii: Ase ayio omwana one, bono nigo ore inse y’okobua kw’omonto oyio, na onye korigetie gwetooria korwa ase are okore iga: Kabe omoitongo, ogende ase are omosorore, erinde agosibore korwa ase eira eyio.
swahili: basi fanya hivi mwanangu, ili ujiweke huru, kwa kuwa umeanguka mikononi mwa jirani yako: Nenda ukajinyenyekeshe kwake; msihi jirani yako!

english: Men do not despise the thief if he steals to satisfy his hunger.
ekegusii: Abanto tibari gochaaya omoibi onye ore koiba endagera ekiagera are n’enchara.
swahili: Watu hawamdharau mwizi kama akiiba kukidhi njaa yake wakati ana njaa.

english: Yet if caught, he must pay sevenfold; he must give up all the wealth of his house.
ekegusii: Nonya naboigo omoibi oria kanyorirwe, goika airanie ara gatano na kabere; nigo araakane ebinto bionsi abwate nyomba mwaye.
swahili: Pamoja na hayo, kama akikamatwa, lazima alipe mara saba, ingawa inamgharimu utajiri wote wa nyumba yake.

english: He who commits adultery lacks judgment; whoever does so destroys himself.
ekegusii: Omonto ogotomana nomokuungu onde bwensi, oyio tabwati chiseemi; oyo ogokora ayio nigo agwesaria ere omonyene.
swahili: Lakini mwanaume aziniye na mwanamke hana akili kabisa; yeyote afanyaye hivyo hujiangamiza mwenyewe.

english: Wounds and dishonor will befall him, and his reproach will never be wiped away.
ekegusii: Omonto oyio nigo arabe n’amaakwa naende asirie amasikani onsi. Obosooku bwaye tibogotinyigwa boere.
swahili: Mapigo na aibu ni fungu lake na aibu yake haitafutika kamwe;

english: For jealousy enrages a husband, and he will show no mercy in the day of vengeance.
ekegusii: Risemi nigo rigokora omosacha oba nekeririanda, na takoba n’amaabera ekero akorusia egesiomba.
swahili: kwa maana wivu huamsha ghadhabu ya mume, naye hataonyesha huruma alipizapo kisasi.

english: He will not be appeased by any ransom, or persuaded by lavish gifts.
ekegusii: Ere tagwancha embooria ende yonsi, naegwa ebiegwa ebinge takobiancha.
swahili: Hatakubali fidia yoyote; atakataa malipo, hata yakiwa makubwa kiasi gani.

english: Allow no sleep to your eyes or slumber to your eyelids.
ekegusii: Tobaisa korara gose gosundoka;
swahili: Usiruhusu usingizi machoni pako, usiruhusu kope zako zisinzie.

english: Free yourself, like a gazelle from the hand of the hunter, like a bird from the snare of the fowler.
ekegusii: minyoka buna engabi egotama erue ase omotwari, na buna enyoni egotama erue ase omotegi.
swahili: Jiweke huru, kama swala mkononi mwa mwindaji, kama ndege kutoka kwenye mtego wa mwindaji.

english: Walk in the manner of the ant, O slacker; observe its ways and become wise.
ekegusii: Aye ore omworo, geenda ase amage, origererie orore buna agokora emeremo n’omokia onyore obong’aini.
swahili: Ewe mvivu, mwendee mchwa; zitafakari njia zake ukapate hekima!

english: Without a commander, without an overseer or ruler,
ekegusii: Aro tabwati omogambi, gose omoteneneri, gose omoraai,
swahili: Kwa maana yeye hana msimamizi, wala mwangalizi, au mtawala,

english: it prepares its provisions in summer; it gathers its food at harvest.
ekegusii: korende nigo agosangereria chindagera chiabo chingaki chi’egura gura, achigacha goika ekero ki’eguru‐gura.
swahili: lakini hujiwekea akiba wakati wa kiangazi na hukusanya chakula chake wakati wa mavuno.

english: How long will you lie there, O slacker? When will you get up from your sleep?
ekegusii: Aye omworo, ’ngoika ririri oragenderere korara? Ndiriri orabooke korwa ase chitoro chiao?
swahili: Ewe mvivu, utalala hata lini? Utaamka lini kutoka usingizi wako?

english: My son, keep my words and treasure my commandments within you.
ekegusii: Omwana one, renda amang’ana ane, na obeke amachiiko ane abeere ime yao.
swahili: Mwanangu, shika maneno yangu na kuzihifadhi amri zangu ndani yako.

english: Then a woman came out to meet him, with the attire of a harlot and cunning of heart.
ekegusii: Rora, omokungu agacha akaumerana n’omomura oria. Omokungu oria nigo abeegete chianga chi’obotayayi orenge omong’ainereria ase enkoro yaye.
swahili: Ndipo huyo mwanamke akatoka kumlaki, hali amevaa kama kahaba akiwa na nia ya udanganyifu.

english: She is loud and defiant; her feet do not remain at home.
ekegusii: Nigo arenge omonyariogi otari kogoma nyomba mwaye.
swahili: (Ni mwanamke mwenye makelele na mkaidi, miguu yake haitulii nyumbani;

english: Now in the street, now in the squares, she lurks at every corner.
ekegusii: Nigo agosioma‐siomia aande onsi ase chiinchera na ase chichiiro, na ase kera amatabekania oba oganyete.
swahili: mara kwenye barabara za mji, mara kwenye viwanja vikubwa, kwenye kila pembe huvizia.)

english: She seizes him and kisses him; she brazenly says to him:
ekegusii: Erio omokungu oria akaboania omomura oria na komonyunyunta, akomorigereria n’amaiso, atari nobosooku, akomoteebia,
swahili: Huyo mwanamke alimkumbatia kijana na kumbusu, na kwa uso usio na haya akamwambia:

english: “I have made my peace offerings; today I have paid my vows.
