ekegusii: “Nariete eira korua ebing’wanso bi’omorembe; rituko ria reero nayeikeranirie.
swahili: “Nina sadaka za amani nyumbani; leo nimetimiza nadhiri zangu.

english: So I came out to meet you; I sought you, and I have found you.
ekegusii: Ayio naro agera naacha gokorotota, nigo nakorigirie n’omokia ng’a ’nkorore, na bono nakonyorire.
swahili: Kwa hiyo nimetoka nje kukulaki; nimekutafuta na nimekupata!

english: I have decked my bed with coverings, with colored linen from Egypt.
ekegusii: Naarire oborere bwane nebirarero ebiya, na ebitambaa bimatonto bikorwa Misiri.
swahili: Nimetandika kitanda changu kwa kitani za rangi kutoka Misri.

english: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, with aloes, and with cinnamon.
ekegusii: Naboumoreire manemane, na amaguta y’omogaka, na ay’omodalasini botioke buya.
swahili: Nimetia manukato kitanda changu kwa manemane, udi na mdalasini.

english: Come, let us take our fill of love till morning. Let us delight in loving caresses!
ekegusii: Inchuo togokanie ase obotuko bwonsi goika mambia; inchwo twegokie n’obwanchani.
swahili: Njoo, tuzame katika mapenzi mpaka asubuhi; tujifurahishe wenyewe kwa mapenzi!

english: For my husband is not at home; he has gone on a long journey.
ekegusii: Omosacha one taiyo, ochiire orogendo orotambe.
swahili: Mume wangu hayupo nyumbani; amekwenda safari ya mbali.

english: Keep my commandments and live; guard my teachings as the apple of your eye.
ekegusii: Bwata amachiiko ane, erinde obe moyo; orende amorokererio ane buna orendete endorero y’eriiso ria’o.
swahili: Shika amri zangu nawe utaishi; linda mafundisho yangu kama mboni ya jicho lako.

english: He took with him a bag of money and will not return till the moon is full.”
ekegusii: Nigo aira chitaabu chichire omobuko na nigo arairane omotienyi oikire gochia gati,”
swahili: Amechukua mkoba uliojazwa fedha na hatakuwepo nyumbani karibuni.”

english: With her great persuasion she entices him; with her flattering lips she lures him.
ekegusii: Omokungu oria akaebereria omomura oria namang’ana amansu ao ao, na ase amang’ana y’ebikoba ebiterere akamobua.
swahili: Kwa maneno laini yule mwanamke akampotosha; alimshawishi kwa maneno yake laini.

english: He follows her on impulse, like an ox going to the slaughter, like a deer bounding into a trap,
ekegusii: Ase obwango obwo omomura oria agatunyana omokungu oria buna eng’ombe ekoirwa konyenywa, gose buna omosibwa obwatirwe ogochia kobekwa chingataare.
swahili: Mara huyo kijana alimfuata yule mwanamke kama fahali aendaye machinjoni, kama kulungu aingiaye kwenye kitanzi,

english: until an arrow pierces his liver, like a bird darting into a snare— not knowing it will cost him his life.
ekegusii: Ee, akamotunyana goika ensara ekamobeta egaika riini ime. Nigo abeete buna enyoni ekoayerera gochia ase ebisugunia na tamanyete ng’a ayio nobogima bwaye agosiria.
swahili: mpaka mshale umchome ini lake, kama ndege anayenaswa kwenye mtego, bila kujua itamgharimu maisha yake.

english: Now, my sons, listen to me, and attend to the words of my mouth.
ekegusii: Inwe abana bane, ’ntegerera morengererie mono amang’ana ’nkobateebia.
swahili: Sasa basi wanangu, nisikilizeni; sikilizeni kwa makini nisemalo.

english: Do not let your heart turn aside to her ways; do not stray into her paths.
ekegusii: Chinkoro chiaino tichibaisa koonchorwa na kobwatia chingencho chi’omokuungu buna oyio; gose orogendo rw’aye tirobaisa gosiria obogima bwaino.
swahili: Usiruhusu moyo wako ugeukie njia za huyo mwanamke, wala usitangetange katika mapito yake.

english: For she has brought many down to death; her slain are many in number.
ekegusii: Omokungu oyio oiyeirie abanto abange, ee, oitire omogaanda omonene.
swahili: Aliowaangusha ni wengi; aliowachinja ni kundi kubwa.

english: Her house is the road to Sheol, descending to the chambers of death.
ekegusii: Enyomba yaye nero enchera ekogeenda aase abakuure; ee, enchera eyio nigo egosoa ase chiero chi’amakweri.
swahili: Nyumba yake ni njia kuu iendayo kaburini, ielekeayo chini kwenye vyumba vya mauti.

english: Tie them to your fingers; write them on the tablet of your heart.
ekegusii: Oyasibe ase ebiara bi’amaboko ao, na oyariike oyabeeke ase enkoro ya’o.
swahili: Yafunge katika vidole vyako; yaandike katika kibao cha moyo wako.

english: Say to wisdom, “You are my sister,” and call understanding your kinsman,
ekegusii: Teebia obong’aini, “Aye naye mosubati ominto”, na obomanyi oboroke omosani oo momanyaine,
swahili: Mwambie hekima, “Wewe ni dada yangu,” uite ufahamu jamaa yako;

english: that they may keep you from the adulteress, from the stranger with seductive words.
ekegusii: erinde bikorende korwa ase omokungu omonyaka ogokwana amang’ana y’okoebereria. Omokungu Omonyaka
swahili: watakuepusha na mwanamke mzinzi, kutokana na mwanamke mpotovu na maneno yake ya kubembeleza.

english: For at the window of my house I looked through the lattice.
ekegusii: Nigo narigereretie isiko goetera ase ekebao ki’enyomba ya’ne na ebichanga bi’aroro.
swahili: Kwenye dirisha la nyumba yangu nilitazama nje kupitia upenyo kwenye mwimo wa dirisha.

english: I saw among the simple, I noticed among the youths, a young man lacking judgment,
ekegusii: Ase egati y’abanto batamanyeti amaange, ’nkarora omomura ore ase egati y’abamura bande otabwati chiseemi.
swahili: Niliona miongoni mwa wajinga, nikagundua miongoni mwa wanaume vijana, kijana asiye na akili.

english: crossing the street near her corner, strolling down the road to her house,
ekegusii: Oyio nigo arenge goeta ase enchera yarenge ang’e nekoona agwo ase omokungu oria omonyaka amenyete agechoba‐chobania gochia ase enyomba yaye
swahili: Alikuwa akishuka njiani karibu na pembe ya kwake, akielekea kwenye nyumba ya huyo mwanamke

english: at twilight, as the day was fading into the dark of the night.
ekegusii: mogoroba kobokomura‐mura, ekero ki’omosuunte bw’obotuko.
swahili: wakati wa machweo, jua likipungua nuru yake, giza la usiku lilipokuwa likiingia.

english: Does not wisdom call out, and understanding raise her voice?
ekegusii: Inee! Obong’aini tibori korangeria? Okomanya tikori goaka eriogi rinene?
swahili: Je, hekima haitani? Je, ufahamu hapazi sauti?

english: Receive my instruction instead of silver, and knowledge rather than pure gold.
ekegusii: Ancha amorokererio ane kobua efeta, ne chiseemi kobua etaabu echenire.
swahili: Chagua mafundisho yangu badala ya fedha, maarifa badala ya dhahabu safi,

english: For wisdom is more precious than rubies, and nothing you desire compares with her.
ekegusii: “Obong’aini nigo bore obuya kobua amagena akomeka‐meka aye rigori rinene, tibokoreng’anigwa n’ebinto bionsi bire ebiya biganeirie.
swahili: kwa maana hekima ina thamani kuliko marijani na hakuna chochote unachohitaji kinacholingana naye.

english: I, wisdom, dwell together with prudence, and I find knowledge and discretion.
ekegusii: Inche obong’aini nakorire okomanya kwabeire obomenyo bwane, nigo inde ne chiseemi, naende nimanyete kogamba buya.
swahili: “Mimi hekima, nakaa pamoja na busara; ninamiliki maarifa na busara.

english: To fear the LORD is to hate evil; I hate arrogant pride, evil conduct, and perverse speech.
ekegusii: Okomoiroka Omonene nokogecha obobe; nigo ’ngechete oboenenu, na obwerori, norogendo orobe, boigo namang’ana y’obong’ainereria.
swahili: Kumcha Bwana ni kuchukia uovu; ninachukia kiburi na majivuno, tabia mbaya na mazungumzo potovu.

english: Counsel and sound judgment are mine; I have insight and strength.
ekegusii: Inche nigo ’nkorua ogoseemia na obong’aini bw’ekeene; nigo inde nokomanya na okobua.
swahili: Ushauri na hukumu sahihi ni vyangu; nina ufahamu na nina nguvu.

english: By me kings reign, and rulers enact just laws;
ekegusii: Ase obokonyi bwane abarwoti nigo bakogaamba, na abagaambi nigo bakobeeka amachiiko y’ekeene.
swahili: Kwa msaada wangu wafalme hutawala na watawala hutunga sheria zilizo za haki,

english: By me princes rule, and all nobles who govern justly.
ekegusii: Ase obokonyi bwane abagaambi nigo bakorwa oboronge, boigo nabanene na abanachi ebiina bonsi.
swahili: kwa msaada wangu wakuu hutawala, na wenye vyeo wote watawalao dunia.

english: I love those who love me, and those who seek me early shall find me.
ekegusii: Nigo nyanchete abwo banyanchete; na abwo bakondigia n’omokia ’mbanyore.
swahili: Nawapenda wale wanipendao, na wale wanitafutao kwa bidii wataniona.

english: With me are riches and honor, enduring wealth and righteousness.
ekegusii: Ninche ’nkorua obonda, na esiko, boigo obotenenku na oboronge bitari koera.
swahili: Utajiri na heshima viko kwangu, utajiri udumuo na mafanikio.

english: My fruit is better than gold, pure gold, and my harvest surpasses choice silver.
ekegusii: Okwama nkorua nigo kore okuya kobua etaabu, ee, kobua etaabu engiya, na ebitoki ’nkorua ’mbibuete efeta enchore.
swahili: Tunda langu ni bora kuliko dhahabu safi; kile nitoacho hupita fedha iliyo bora.

english: On the heights overlooking the road, at the crossroads she takes her stand.
ekegusii: Obong’aini nigo bogotenena aase aimokererete igoro, ang’e n’enchera engendi, nigo bokobeera ase amatabekania ye chiinchera.
swahili: Juu ya miinuko karibu na njia, penye njia panda, ndipo asimamapo;

english: I walk in the way of righteousness, along the paths of justice,
ekegusii: Nigo ’nkobwatia enchera y’oboronge, naba ’ngotaara ase oboeto bw’ekeene.
swahili: Natembea katika njia ya unyofu katika mapito ya haki,

english: bestowing wealth on those who love me and making their treasuries full.
ekegusii: Nigo ’nkoa abwo banyanchete obotenenku na goichoria chikungo chiabo.
swahili: nawapa utajiri wale wanipendao na kuzijaza hazina zao.

english: The LORD created me as His first course, before His works of old.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo arenge nainche korwa omochakano bwe chiinchera chiaye, agwo kare konya ataratonga kende gionsi;
swahili: “ Bwana aliniumba mwanzoni mwa kazi yake, kabla ya matendo yake ya zamani;

english: From everlasting I was established, from the beginning, before the earth began.
ekegusii: nao narenge korwa agwo kare na kare, nonya nense konya etarabao.
swahili: niliteuliwa tangu milele, tangu mwanzoni, kabla ya dunia kuumbwa.

english: When there were no watery depths, I was brought forth, when no springs were overflowing with water.
ekegusii: Inche nigo naiboretwe chindiba chitarabao, nonya ne chinsoko chi’amaache.
swahili: Wakati hazijakuwepo bahari, nilikwishazaliwa, wakati hazijakuwepo chemchemi zilizojaa maji;

english: Before the mountains were settled, before the hills, I was brought forth,
ekegusii: Nigo naiboretwe oboroso bw’ebitunwa botarabekwa, na ebigoro bitarabao,
swahili: kabla milima haijawekwa mahali pake, kabla vilima havijakuwepo, nilikwishazaliwa,

english: before He made the land or fields, or any of the dust of the earth.
ekegusii: ekero ataratonga ense ne riroba riaye, nonya norotu.
swahili: kabla hajaumba dunia wala mashamba yake au vumbi lolote la dunia.

english: I was there when He established the heavens, when He inscribed a circle on the face of the deep,
ekegusii: Ekero atongete igoro chionsi nao narenge, boigo nekero abeekerete amaache chimbebe.
swahili: Nilikuwepo alipoziweka mbingu mahali pake, wakati alichora mstari wa upeo wa macho juu ya uso wa kilindi,

english: when He established the clouds above, when the fountains of the deep gushed forth,
ekegusii: Ekero abeegete igoro ekabao, na ekero abeegete chinsoko chigosokia amaache korwa ase chindiba ne chinguru,
swahili: wakati aliweka mawingu juu na kuziweka imara chemchemi za bahari,

english: when He set a boundary for the sea, so that the waters would not surpass His command, when He marked out the foundations of the earth.
ekegusii: na ekero abeekerete chinyancha chimbebe, amaache tabaisa goetania ogochika kwaye; na ekero abeegete amaroso y’ense nao narenge.
swahili: wakati aliiwekea bahari mpaka wake ili maji yasivunje agizo lake, na wakati aliweka misingi ya dunia.

english: Beside the gates to the city, at the entrances she cries out:
ekegusii: Mbarabare ase ebiita bosio bw’omochie ase ebisoero bi’ebiita nigo bogokwana neriogi rinene, bwateeba;
swahili: kando ya malango yaelekeayo mjini, kwenye maingilio, hulia kwa sauti kubwa, akisema:

english: Then I was a skilled craftsman at His side, and His delight day by day, rejoicing always in His presence.
ekegusii: Inche nigo narenge amo nere buna oyomanyete emeremo eyio buya. Kera rituko nigo arenge kogokigwa nainche, na inche ’nkaba inde nomogooko ase obosio bwaye botambe.
swahili: Wakati huo nilikuwa fundi stadi kando yake. Nilijazwa na furaha siku baada ya siku, nikifurahi daima mbele zake,

english: I was rejoicing in His whole world, delighting together in the sons of men.
ekegusii: Nigo nagokerete ense yaye emenyire nabaanto, na nkaba nsasokerete Mwanyabaanto.
swahili: nikifurahi katika dunia yake yote nami nikiwafurahia wanadamu.

english: Now therefore, my sons, listen to me, for blessed are those who keep my ways.
ekegusii: “Na bono, inwe abana bane, ’ntegerere moigwe, mbare n’omogooko abwo barendete chiinchera chiane,
swahili: “Basi sasa wanangu, nisikilizeni; heri wale wanaozishika njia zangu.

english: Listen to instruction and be wise; do not ignore it.
ekegusii: Igwera amorokererio! Ancha obong’aini, timobwanga!
swahili: Sikilizeni mafundisho yangu mwe na hekima; msiyapuuze.

english: Blessed is the man who listens to me, watching daily at my doors, waiting at the posts of my doorway.
ekegusii: Nasesenirie omonto oyio okonyigwera; oyio okorenda ase ebiita biane kera rituko, oganyete ase ebisieri biane.
swahili: Heri mtu yule anisikilizaye mimi, akisubiri siku zote malangoni mwangu, akingoja kwenye vizingiti vya mlango wangu.

english: For whoever finds me finds life and obtains the favor of the LORD.
ekegusii: Omonto onyorire inche, oyio onyorire obogima; naende nancherwe n’Omonene.
swahili: Kwa maana yeyote anipataye mimi amepata uzima na kujipatia kibali kutoka kwa Bwana.

english: But he who fails to find me harms himself; all who hate me love death.”
ekegusii: Korende oyio otari nainche nigo akwenachera ekiina ere omonyene. Bonsi abangechete nigo banchete amakweri.”
swahili: Lakini yeyote ashindwaye kunipata hujiumiza mwenyewe; na wote wanichukiao mimi hupenda mauti.”

english: “To you, O men, I call out, and my cry is to the sons of men.
ekegusii: “Inwe abanto, ninwe ’nkorangeria; eriogi riane nigo rigochera Mwanyabaanto.
swahili: “Ni ninyi wanaume, ninaowaita; ninapaza sauti yangu kwa wanadamu wote.

english: O simple ones, learn to be shrewd; O fools, gain understanding.
ekegusii: Inwe abamotamanyeti amaange, egera obong’aini; na inwe abariri, egera okomanya.
swahili: Ninyi ambao ni wajinga, pateni akili; ninyi mlio wapumbavu, pateni ufahamu.

english: Listen, for I speak of noble things, and the opening of my lips will reveal right.
ekegusii: Tegerera moigwe, ekiagera nigo ’ndakwane amang’ana amaya mono; amang’ana akorwa ase omonwa one nay’oboronge.
swahili: Sikilizeni, kwa maana nina mambo muhimu ya kusema; ninafungua midomo yangu kusema lililo sawa.

english: For my mouth will speak the truth, and wickedness is detestable to my lips.
ekegusii: Amang’ana ’ngokwana nay’ekeene; amang’ana y’obobe nigo are okogechia ase ebikoba biane.
swahili: Kinywa changu husema lililo kweli, kwa maana midomo yangu huchukia uovu.

english: All the words of my mouth are righteous; none are crooked or perverse.
ekegusii: Amang’ana ane onsi ’ngokwana nigo are ay’oboronge, ande tari are ay’oborimo, gose ay’obokorekanu.
swahili: Maneno yote ya kinywa changu ni haki; hakuna mojawapo lililopotoka wala ukaidi.

english: They are all plain to the discerning, and upright to those who find knowledge.
ekegusii: Nigo akoigweka buya ase omonto oyio okoyamanya, naende namaronge ase abwo banyorire chiseemi.
swahili: Kwa wenye kupambanua yote ni sahihi; hayana kasoro kwa wale wenye maarifa.

english: Wisdom has built her house; she has carved out her seven pillars.
ekegusii: Obong’aini nigo bweagacherete enyomba. Nigo bwebaacherete chisiiro isano na ibere.
swahili: Hekima amejenga nyumba yake; amechonga nguzo zake saba.

english: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom, and knowledge of the Holy One is understanding.
ekegusii: Okomoiroka Omonene, oyio n’oro omochakano bw’obong’aini, na okomomanya Oyore Omochenu nabwo obomanyi.
swahili: “Kumcha Bwana ndicho chanzo cha hekima, na kumjua Aliye Mtakatifu ni ufahamu.

english: For through wisdom your days will be multiplied, and years will be added to your life.
ekegusii: Ase ogokonywa kw’ane amatuko ao nabe amaange, na emiaka y’obogima bwao nementwe.
swahili: Kwa maana kwa msaada wangu siku zako zitakuwa nyingi, na miaka itaongezwa katika maisha yako.

english: If you are wise, you are wise to your own advantage; but if you scoff, you alone will bear the consequences. The Way of Folly
ekegusii: Korabe nobong’aini, borobwo ’mbooboseemia; korende korabe omochaayi, obochaayi obwo ’mbokoiranere.
swahili: Kama wewe una hekima, hekima yako itakupa tuzo; kama wewe ni mtu wa mzaha, wewe mwenyewe ndiwe utateseka.”

english: The woman named Folly is loud; she is naive and knows nothing.
ekegusii: Omokungu omoriri nigo are omonyariogi. Ere nigo are bosa, na tamanyeti ring’ana rinde.
swahili: Mwanamke aitwaye Mpumbavu ana kelele; hana adabu na hana maarifa.

english: She sits at the door of her house, on a seat in the heights of the city,
ekegusii: Nigo agoikaransera ekerogo ase egesieri ki’enyomba yaye, agwo aase aimokererete igoro ase omochie,
swahili: Huketi kwenye mlango wa nyumba yake, juu ya kiti katika mahali pa juu sana pa mji,

english: calling out to those who pass by, who make their paths straight.
ekegusii: aba okorangeria abaeti bare ase orogendo rwabo,
swahili: akiita wale wapitao karibu, waendao moja kwa moja kwenye njia yao.

english: “Whoever is simple, let him turn in here!” she says to him who lacks judgment.
ekegusii: oteeba, “Onde bwensi otamanyeti amaange, tiga ache aa!” Na ase oyore omoriri oteeba,
swahili: Anawaambia wale wasio na akili, “Wote ambao ni wajinga na waje hapa ndani!”

english: “Stolen water is sweet, and bread eaten in secret is tasty!”
ekegusii: “Amaache aibire nigo are amansu, na omogati okorierwa aase abobisi nigo ogwansa.”
swahili: “Maji yaliyoibiwa ni matamu; chakula kinacholiwa sirini ni kitamu!”

english: But they do not know that the dead are there, that her guests are in the depths of Sheol.
ekegusii: Korende oyio ogosoa aroro tamanyeti ng’a amakweri nareo, naende ng’a abageni b’omokuungu oyio nigo bare agwo aase abakuure.
swahili: Lakini hawajui hata kidogo kuwa wafu wako humo, kwamba wageni wake huyo mwanamke wako katika vilindi vya kuzimu.

english: She has prepared her meat and mixed her wine; she has also set her table.
ekegusii: Bwanyenyire ching’iti chiaye; bwochoganirie edivai yaye, bwariganirie emesa yaye.
swahili: Ameandaa nyama na kuchanganya divai yake; pia ameandaa meza yake.

english: She has sent out her maidservants; she calls out from the heights of the city.
ekegusii: Bwatomire abasomba baye abaiseke gochia aase aimokererete igoro mono yomochie korangeria abanto, bogoteeba:
swahili: Amewatuma watumishi wake wa kike, naye huita kutoka mahali pa juu sana pa mji.

english: “Whoever is simple, let him turn in here!” she says to him who lacks judgment.
ekegusii: “Oyo otamanyeti amaange, tiga ache aa!” Na ase oyore omoriri bwateeba:
swahili: Anawaambia wale wasio na akili, “Wote ambao ni wajinga na waje hapa!

english: “Come, eat my bread and drink the wine I have mixed.
ekegusii: “Inchuo orie endagera y’ane, na onywe edivai nochoganirie!
swahili: Njooni, mle chakula changu na mnywe divai niliyoichanganya.

english: Leave your folly behind, and you will live; walk in the way of understanding.”
ekegusii: Tiga oboriri bwao, erinde obe moyo! Obwatie enchera y’okonyora okomanya!”
swahili: Acheni njia zenu za ujinga nanyi mtaishi; tembeeni katika njia ya ufahamu.

english: He who corrects a mocker brings shame on himself; he who rebukes a wicked man taints himself.
ekegusii: Omonto ogokuurera omonyacheche, nigo akwenyorera obororo; na oyogotogonyera omonto omokori amabe nigo akwenyorera ogochaaywa.
swahili: “Yeyote anayemkosoa mwenye mzaha hukaribisha matukano; yeyote anayekemea mtu mwovu hupatwa na matusi.

english: Do not rebuke a mocker, or he will hate you; rebuke a wise man, and he will love you.
ekegusii: Tobaisa gokuurera omonto omochaayi; oyio nigo arakogeche. Kuurera omonto omong’aini, oyio nigo aragwanche.
swahili: Usimkemee mwenye mzaha la sivyo atakuchukia; mkemee mwenye hekima naye atakupenda.

english: Instruct a wise man, and he will be wiser still; teach a righteous man, and he will increase his learning.
ekegusii: Orokereria omonto omong’aini, oyio nigo arageenderere koba omong’aini goetania. Orokereria omonto omooronge, oyio namente koba ne chiseemi.
swahili: Mfundishe mtu mwenye hekima naye atakuwa na hekima zaidi; mfundishe mtu mwadilifu naye atazidi kufundishika.

english: Make a joyful noise to the LORD, all the earth.
ekegusii: Inwe abanto b’ense yonsi, moterere Omonene more nomochengo!
swahili: Mpigieni Bwana kelele za shangwe, dunia yote.

english: Serve the LORD with gladness; come into His presence with joyful songs.
ekegusii: Mokorere Omonene more nomogooko, moche ase obosio bwaye na komoterera amatera ’omochengo!
swahili: Mwabuduni Bwana kwa furaha; njooni mbele zake kwa nyimbo za shangwe.

english: Know that the LORD is God. It is He who made us, and we are His; we are His people, and the sheep of His pasture.
ekegusii: Manya ng’a Omonene nere Nyasae. Nere ototongete, na intwe nabaye tore; nigo tore abanto baye, ne ching’ondi chie riicho riaye.
swahili: Jueni kwamba Bwana ndiye Mungu. Yeye ndiye alituumba, sisi tu mali yake; sisi tu watu wake, kondoo wa malisho yake.

english: Enter His gates with thanksgiving and His courts with praise; give thanks to Him and bless His name.
ekegusii: Soa ase ebiita biaye na komoakera ng’a mbuya mono, soa ase chigoora chiaye na komotogia! Moakere ng’a mbuya mono, motogie erieta riaye!
swahili: Ingieni malangoni mwake kwa shukrani na katika nyua zake kwa kusifu, mshukuruni yeye na kulisifu jina lake.

english: For the LORD is good, and His loving devotion endures forever; His faithfulness continues to all generations.
ekegusii: Naki Omonene nomuya, na obwanchani bwaye nobwa kare na kare, na obwegenwa bwaye nigo bogendererete ebiaare ase ebiaare.
swahili: Kwa maana Bwana ni mwema na upendo wake wadumu milele; uaminifu wake unadumu kwa vizazi vyote.

english: I will sing of Your loving devotion and justice; to You, O LORD, I will sing praises.
ekegusii: Nintere igoro y’amaabera ao na oboronge bwao; ningoterere aye Omonene.
swahili: Nitaimba juu ya upendo wako na haki yako; kwako wewe, Ee Bwana, nitaimba sifa.

english: I will ponder the way that is blameless— when will You come to me? I will walk in my house with integrity of heart.
ekegusii: Nigo nganetie na korenda enchera y’oboronge. Inee! Ndiriri orache ase ’nde? Nigo nganetie imbe norogendo ororonge ase enyomba yane imenyete.
swahili: Nitazingatia kuishi maisha yasiyo na lawama: utakuja kwangu lini? Nitatembea nyumbani mwangu kwa moyo usio na lawama.

english: I will set no worthless thing before my eyes. I hate the work of those who fall away; it shall not cling to me.
ekegusii: Tinkobeeka ase obosio bwane ing’ana rinde rionsi ri’obobe; nigo ngechete ogokora kw’abaanto bagotiga obwegenwa, tinkonyara kobwatwa ne chingencho chiabo.
swahili: Sitaweka mbele ya macho yangu kitu kiovu. Ninayachukia matendo ya watu wasio na imani; hawatashikamana nami.

english: A perverse heart shall depart from me; I will know nothing of evil.
ekegusii: Nimbeere aare korwa ase abwo bare ne chinkoro chi’obokorekanu, ring’ana rinde rionsi ri’obobe ribe aare nainche.
swahili: Moyo wa ukaidi utakuwa mbali nami; nitajitenga na kila ubaya.

english: Whoever slanders his neighbor in secret, I will put to silence; the one with haughty eyes and a proud heart, I will not endure.
ekegusii: Ninsirie omonto okona‐gokwana bobe omonto onde bobisi, tinkoremereria omonto omoenenu na omweanchi.
swahili: Kila amsingiziaye jirani yake kwa siri, huyo nitamnyamazisha; mwenye macho ya dharau na moyo wa kiburi huyo sitamvumilia.

english: My eyes favor the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me; he who walks in the way of integrity shall minister to me.
ekegusii: Amaiso aane narigereretie abegenwa bare ase ense, abwo mbamenye amo nainche. Omonto okobwatia chinchera chi’oboronge, oyio nabe ogonkorera.
swahili: Macho yangu yatawaelekea waaminifu katika nchi, ili waweze kuishi pamoja nami; yeye ambaye moyo wake hauna lawama atanitumikia.

english: No one who practices deceit shall dwell in my house; no one who tells lies shall stand in my presence.
ekegusii: Omonto okwenaria obong’ainereria takomenya ase enyomba yane, oyo ogoteeba oborimo takobeera ase obosio bwane.
swahili: Mdanganyifu hatakaa nyumbani mwangu, yeye asemaye kwa uongo hatasimama mbele yangu.

english: Every morning I will remove all the wicked of the land, that I may cut off every evildoer from the city of the LORD.
ekegusii: Kera emambia nimbe ngosiria abakori amabe bonsi abare ase ense, nindusie abakori ebibe bonsi korwa ase omochie O’ Omonene.
swahili: Kila asubuhi nitawanyamazisha waovu wote katika nchi; nitamkatilia mbali kila mtenda mabaya kutoka mji wa Bwana.

english: Hear my prayer, O LORD; let my cry for help come before You.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, igwa ogosaba kwane; ekerero kiane tiga geike asore.
swahili: Ee Bwana, usikie maombi yangu, kilio changu cha kuomba msaada kikufikie.

english: because of Your indignation and wrath, for You have picked me up and cast me aside.
ekegusii: ekiagera kwabeire nekeririanda na endamwamu ase ’nde. Aye kwambwatire na gwantugutire gochia aare.
swahili: kwa sababu ya ghadhabu yako kuu, kwa maana umeniinua na kunitupa kando.

english: My days are like lengthening shadows, and I wither away like grass.
ekegusii: Amatuko aane nigo agoeta buna omorengari o mogoroba; nasusanire buna obonyansi.
swahili: Siku zangu ni kama kivuli cha jioni, ninanyauka kama jani.

english: But You, O LORD, sit enthroned forever; Your renown endures to all generations.
ekegusii: Korende aye Omonene nigo ore omogambi goika kare na kare; erieta riao nigo rigendererete ase ebiaare bionsi.
swahili: Lakini wewe, Ee Bwana, umeketi katika kiti chako cha enzi milele, sifa zako za ukuu zaendelea vizazi vyote.

english: You will rise up and have compassion on Zion, for it is time to show her favor— the appointed time has come.
ekegusii: Aye noimokerere igoro ororere Sayoni amaabera; ekiagera eye nero engaki y’okoywancha; ee, engaki eria yachigetwe yaikire.
swahili: Utainuka na kuihurumia Sayuni, kwa maana ni wakati wa kumwonyesha wema; wakati uliokubalika umewadia.

english: For Your servants delight in her stones and take pity on her dust.
ekegusii: Abasomba bao nigo banchete amagena aye, na nigo bare namabeebe ase orotu rwaye.
swahili: Kwa maana mawe yake ni ya thamani kwa watumishi wako, vumbi lake lenyewe hulionea huruma.

english: So the nations will fear the name of the LORD, and all the kings of the earth will fear Your glory.
ekegusii: Ebisaku bionsi mbiiroke erieta ri’Omonene, na abarwoti bonsi b’ense mbairoke obonene bwaye.
swahili: Mataifa wataogopa jina la Bwana, wafalme wote wa dunia watauheshimu utukufu wako.

english: For the LORD will rebuild Zion; He has appeared in His glory.
ekegusii: Omonene naagache Sayoni naende, nere orarorekane aroro ore ase obonene bwaye.
swahili: Kwa maana Bwana ataijenga tena Sayuni na kutokea katika utukufu wake.

english: He will turn toward the prayer of the destitute; He will not despise their prayer.
ekegusii: Nabe okoigwa ogosaba kw’abaanto batigirwe bosa, tagochaaya ogosorora kwabo.
swahili: Ataitikia maombi ya mtu mkiwa, wala hatadharau hoja yao.

english: Let this be written for the generation to come, so that a people not yet created may praise the LORD.
ekegusii: Amang’ana ayio tiga arikwe agachwe ase engencho y’ekiaare kegochi‐gocha, erinde abanto abwo bataraiborwa, nabarabwo bache gotogia Omonene.
swahili: Hili na liandikwe kwa ajili ya kizazi kijacho, ili taifa litakaloumbwa baadaye waweze kumsifu Bwana:

english: For He looked down from the heights of His sanctuary; the LORD gazed out from heaven to earth
ekegusii: Korwa aaria igoro aase aye aachenu Omonene nigo arigereretie gocha aa, ee, nigo arigereretie gocha ase ense,
swahili: “ Bwana alitazama chini kutoka patakatifu pake palipo juu, kutoka mbinguni alitazama dunia,

english: Do not hide Your face from me in my day of distress. Incline Your ear to me; answer me quickly when I call.
ekegusii: Tobaisa kobisa obosio bwao korwa ase ’nde ase engaki inde nemechando, integerere onyigwe, ong’iranerie bwango ase rituko ngokorangeria.
swahili: Usinifiche uso wako ninapokuwa katika shida. Unitegee sikio lako, ninapoita, unijibu kwa upesi.

english: to hear a prisoner’s groaning, to release those condemned to death,
ekegusii: erinde aigwe okweumia kw’abasibwa, na gosibora abwo konya banacheirwe ekiina ki’ogokwa.
swahili: kusikiliza vilio vya uchungu vya wafungwa na kuwaweka huru wale waliohukumiwa kufa.”

english: that they may proclaim the name of the LORD in Zion and praise Him in Jerusalem,
ekegusii: Erio abanto banyare koraria erieta ri’Omonene ase Sayoni, na ogotogigwa kwaye agwo Yerusalemu,
swahili: Kwa hiyo jina la Bwana latangazwa huko Sayuni na sifa zake katika Yerusalemu,

english: when peoples and kingdoms assemble to serve the LORD.
ekegusii: ekero ekio abanto b’ebisaku bionsi mbasangererekane amo namarwoti ase ogosasiima Omonene.
swahili: wakati mataifa na falme zitakapokusanyika ili kumwabudu Bwana.

english: He has broken my strength on the way; He has cut short my days.
ekegusii: Ere okeeirie chinguru chiane konde ase orogendo, bweng’eirie amatuko aane.
swahili: Katika kuishi kwangu alivunja nguvu zangu, akafupisha siku zangu.

english: I say: “O my God, do not take me in the midst of my days! Your years go on through all generations.
ekegusii: Nigo ngoteeba, Aye Nyasae one, takondusia aiga ekero inde ase egati‐gati y’obogima bwane. Omonene, aye nigo oreo kare na kare, ase ebiaare bionsi.
swahili: Ndipo niliposema: “Ee Mungu wangu, usinichukue katikati ya siku zangu; miaka yako inaendelea vizazi vyote.

english: In the beginning You laid the foundations of the earth, and the heavens are the work of Your hands.
ekegusii: Agwo kare nigo kwabegete oboroso bw’ense, na igoro chionsi nigo chire emeremo y’amaboko ao.
swahili: Hapo mwanzo uliweka misingi ya dunia, nazo mbingu ni kazi ya mikono yako.

english: They will perish, but You remain; they will all wear out like a garment. Like clothing You will change them, and they will be passed on.
ekegusii: Echio chionsi nchisirigwe, korende aye nigo oreo kare na kare, echio chionsi nchigote buna eanga, ekiagera aye nigo ogochionchoreria buna eanga ekoonchorerigwa, ee, nigo chirasirigwe kegima.
swahili: Hizi zitatoweka, lakini wewe utadumu, zote zitachakaa kama vazi. Utazibadilisha kama nguo nazo zitaondoshwa.

english: But You remain the same, and Your years will never end.
ekegusii: Korende aye naye oria oria, na emiaka yao tekoba nomoerio.
swahili: Lakini wewe, U yeye yule, nayo miaka yako haikomi kamwe.

english: The children of Your servants will dwell securely, and their descendants will be established before You.”
ekegusii: Abana b’abasomba bao mbamenye ase oborendi obuya, ne chinderia chiabo chigenderere komenya ase obosio bwao.
swahili: Watoto wa watumishi wako wataishi mbele zako; wazao wao wataimarishwa mbele zako.”

english: For my days vanish like smoke, and my bones burn like glowing embers.
ekegusii: Amatuko ’obogima bwane nigo agoeta bwango na gosira buna erioki, amauga ’omobere one nigo akoyia buna omorero bw’amakara.
swahili: Kwa kuwa siku zangu zinatoweka kama moshi, mifupa yangu inaungua kama kaa la moto.

english: My heart is afflicted, and withered like grass; I even forget to eat my bread.
ekegusii: Enkoro yane yaakirwe yabeire buna obonyansi bwagekirwe na kwoma; nigo nkweba koria endagera yane,
swahili: Moyo wangu umefifia na kunyauka kama jani, ninasahau kula chakula changu.

english: Through my loud groaning my flesh clings to my bones.
ekegusii: ekiagera nigo ngendererete korera na kweumia, amauga ’omobere one abwatanire ne chinyama chi’omobere one.
swahili: Kwa sababu ya kusononeka kwangu kwa uchungu, nimebakia ngozi na mifupa.

english: I am like a desert owl, like an owl among the ruins.
ekegusii: Inche nigo inga buna etigere ere ase erooro, gose buna enyakweumia etigarete komenya aase amatuuri.
swahili: Nimekuwa kama bundi wa jangwani, kama bundi kwenye magofu.

english: I lie awake; I am like a lone bird on a housetop.
ekegusii: Tindi korara chitoro; nigo inga buna enyoni etigarete yoka kerama igoro.
swahili: Nilalapo sipati usingizi, nimekuwa kama ndege mpweke kwenye paa la nyumba.

english: All day long my enemies taunt me; they ridicule me and curse me.
ekegusii: Ababisa baane nigo bagonchecheria omobaso boira; abwo bangechete, kobakoragereria nigo bagwatora erieta riane.
swahili: Mchana kutwa adui zangu hunidhihaki, wale wanaonizunguka hutumia jina langu kama laana.

english: For I have eaten ashes like bread and mixed my drink with tears
ekegusii: Nigo nkoria ribu buna nkoria endagera, na ekenyugwa kiane nigo ngokeburukania namariga,
swahili: Ninakula majivu kama chakula changu na nimechanganya kinywaji changu na machozi

english: Bless the LORD, O my soul; all that is within me, bless His holy name.
ekegusii: Aye omoyo one, togia Omonene, na bionsi ebire ime yane bitogie erieta riaye richenu.
swahili: Ee nafsi yangu, umhimidi Bwana. Vyote vilivyomo ndani yangu vilihimidi jina lake takatifu.

english: He has not dealt with us according to our sins or repaid us according to our iniquities.
ekegusii: Omonene tari gotokorera aya togwenerete ase engencho y’ebibe biaito, gose tari gotoa egesusuro koreng’ana nobobe bwaito.
swahili: yeye hatutendei kulingana na dhambi zetu wala hatupatilizi kwa kadiri ya maovu yetu.

english: For as high as the heavens are above the earth, so great is His loving devotion for those who fear Him.
ekegusii: Koreng’ana buna igoro ere aare mono korwa ase ense, naboigo obwanchani bwaye bore obonene ase abanto bamoirogete.
swahili: Kama vile mbingu zilivyo juu ya dunia sana, ndivyo wema wake ulivyo mwingi kwa wanaomcha;

english: As far as the east is from the west, so far has He removed our transgressions from us.
ekegusii: Naende koreng’ana buna moocha ere aare mono korwa bosongo, naboigo Omonene akorusia ebibe biaito korwa ase tore biabeera aare.
swahili: kama mashariki ilivyo mbali na magharibi, ndivyo Mungu alivyoziweka dhambi zetu mbali nasi.

english: As a father has compassion on his children, so the LORD has compassion on those who fear Him.
ekegusii: Koreng’ana buna ise abana akoba namaabera ase bare, naboigo n’Omonene akoba namaabera ase abwo bamoirogete.
swahili: Kama baba alivyo na huruma kwa watoto wake, ndivyo Bwana anavyowahurumia wale wanaomcha;

english: For He knows our frame; He is mindful that we are dust.
ekegusii: Ere nigo amanyete buna totongire, nigo akoinyora ng’a nigo tore orotu bosa.
swahili: kwa kuwa anajua tulivyoumbwa, anakumbuka kwamba sisi tu mavumbi.

english: As for man, his days are like grass— he blooms like a flower of the field;
ekegusii: Amatuko ’omonto nigo anga buna obonyansi, omonto nigo akoba buna egesicha gekoreereta ase omogondo;
swahili: Kuhusu mwanadamu, siku zake ni kama majani, anachanua kama ua la shambani;

english: when the wind passes over, it vanishes, and its place remembers it no more.
ekegusii: ekero omwaga ogocha, okerusiao giasira kegima, aase aye tari komanya ng’a nkiarengeo.
swahili: upepo huvuma juu yake nalo hutoweka, mahali pake hapalikumbuki tena.

english: But from everlasting to everlasting the loving devotion of the LORD extends to those who fear Him, and His righteousness to their children’s children—
ekegusii: Korwa kare goika kare na kare obwanchani bw’ Omonene nigo bore ase abwo bamoirogete, na oboronge bwaye nigo borabe ase chinderia chiabo
swahili: Lakini kutoka milele hata milele upendo wa Bwana uko kwa wale wamchao, nayo haki yake kwa watoto wa watoto wao:

english: to those who keep His covenant and remember to obey His precepts.
ekegusii: ase abwo bakobwata okobwatana kwaye kw’ogotianania, naende bakoinyora amachiiko aye na koyaigwera.
swahili: kwa wale walishikao agano lake na kukumbuka kuyatii mausia yake.

english: The LORD has established His throne in heaven, and His kingdom rules over all.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo abegete ekerogo kiaye ki’obonene aaria igoro, na oborwoti bwaye nigo bokogambera onsi.
swahili: Bwana ameweka imara kiti chake cha enzi mbinguni, ufalme wake unatawala juu ya vyote.

english: Bless the LORD, O my soul, and do not forget all His kind deeds—
ekegusii: Aye omoyo one, togia Omonene, tobaisa kweba obuya bwaye bwonsi agokoreire.
swahili: Ee nafsi yangu, umhimidi Bwana, wala usisahau wema wake wote,

english: Bless the LORD, all His angels mighty in strength who carry out His word, who hearken to the voice of His command.
ekegusii: Inwe abamalaika b’Omonene, motogie; inwe abamore ne chinguru chinene na mogokora aya agochika ekero mwaigure eriogi rie ring’ana riaye.
swahili: Mhimidini Bwana, enyi malaika zake, ninyi mlio mashujaa mnaozitii amri zake, ninyi mnaotii neno lake.

english: Bless the LORD, all His hosts, you servants who do His will.
ekegusii: Togia Omonene, inwe emeganda yaye yonsi, na inwe abasomba baye, aba mogokora ogwancha kwaye!
swahili: Mhimidini Bwana, ninyi jeshi lake lote la mbinguni, ninyi watumishi wake mnaofanya mapenzi yake.

english: Bless the LORD, all His works in all places of His dominion. Bless the LORD, O my soul!
ekegusii: Togia Omonene, inwe ebitongwa biaye bionsi, motogie aande onsi ase akogamba. Aye omoyo one, togia Omonene!
swahili: Mhimidini Bwana, kazi zake zote kila mahali katika milki yake. Ee nafsi yangu, umhimidi Bwana.

english: He who forgives all your iniquities and heals all your diseases,
ekegusii: Nere ogokwabera ebibe biao bionsi, na kogwenia amarwaire ao onsi.
swahili: akusamehe dhambi zako zote, akuponya magonjwa yako yote,

english: who redeems your life from the Pit and crowns you with loving devotion and compassion,
ekegusii: Nigo akobooria obogima bwao korwa ase embeera na gokobekera egutwa y’obwanchani bogendererete botambe amo namaabera.
swahili: aukomboa uhai wako na kaburi, akuvika taji ya upendo na huruma,

english: who satisfies you with good things, so that your youth is renewed like the eagle’s.
ekegusii: Ere nigo agoisanekia okogania kwao namaya, erinde otigara koba omosae buna ekeongo kegwekerora.
swahili: atosheleza mahitaji yako kwa vitu vyema, ili ujana wako uhuishwe kama wa tai.

english: The LORD executes righteousness and justice for all the oppressed.
ekegusii: Omonene nere okorua oboronge na ekeene ase abwo bonsi bagokorerwa bobe.
swahili: Bwana hutenda haki, naye huwapa hukumu ya haki wote wanaoonewa.

english: He made known His ways to Moses, His deeds to the people of Israel.
ekegusii: Nere omanyekanetie chinchera chiaye ase Musa, naboigo nogokora kwaye ase Abaisraeli.
swahili: Alijulisha Mose njia zake, na wana wa Israeli matendo yake.

english: The LORD is compassionate and gracious, slow to anger, abounding in loving devotion.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo are omonyene amaabera na obuya, tari omwango bw’okoba nendamwamu, nigo are nobwanchani botari koera.
swahili: Bwana ni mwingi wa huruma na mwenye neema; si mwepesi wa hasira, bali amejaa upendo.

english: He will not always accuse us, nor harbor His anger forever.
ekegusii: Ere tari kona‐gotogonyera ase chingaki chionsi, gose takogenderera kogaacha endamwamu yaye botambe.
swahili: Yeye hatalaumu siku zote, wala haweki hasira yake milele,

english: Bless the LORD, O my soul! O LORD my God, You are very great; You are clothed with splendor and majesty.
ekegusii: Aye omoyo one, togia Omonene! Omonene, Nyasae one, aye nigo ore omonene mono; nigo bweboetie ogosikwa na obonene.
swahili: Ee nafsi yangu, umhimidi Bwana. Ee Bwana Mungu wangu, wewe ni mkuu sana, umejivika utukufu na enzi.

english: He sends forth springs in the valleys; they flow between the mountains.
ekegusii: Nigo ogotubokia chinsoko ase amagoko, amaache aba agoeta ase egati y’ebitunwa.
swahili: Huzifanya chemchemi zimwage maji mabondeni, hutiririka kati ya milima.

english: They give drink to every beast of the field; the wild donkeys quench their thirst.
ekegusii: Chinsoko echio nigo chikoa ching’iti chionsi amaache chianywa, ne chitigere chi’orosana nigo chikoyanywa, na erang’o yasira.
swahili: Huwapa maji wanyama wote wa kondeni, punda-mwitu huzima kiu yao.

english: The birds of the air nest beside the springs; they sing among the branches.
ekegusii: Chinyoni nigo chikomenya ang’e na chirochio, nigo chikoba chigotera ekero chigwete ase chinsagia chi’emete.
swahili: Ndege wa angani hufanya viota kando ya maji, huimba katikati ya matawi.

english: He waters the mountains from His chambers; the earth is satisfied by the fruit of His works.
ekegusii: Korwa agwo igoro ase omenyete, nigo ogotweria ebitunwa embura, na ense nigo egoisaneka nokwama kw’emeremo yao.
swahili: Huinyeshea milima kutoka orofa zake, dunia inatoshelezwa kwa matunda ya kazi yake.

english: He makes the grass grow for the livestock and provides crops for man to cultivate, bringing forth food from the earth:
ekegusii: Nigo okomeria obonyansi ching’iti chikorisia, naende kwanyorera abanto ebimeri bagokorera, na igo kwabanyorera chindagera korwa ase riroba.
swahili: Huyafanya majani ya mifugo yaote, na mimea kwa watu kulima, wajipatie chakula kutoka ardhini:

english: wine that gladdens the heart of man, oil that makes his face to shine, and bread that sustains his heart.
ekegusii: Abanto nigo bakonywa edivai na baba nomogooko; nigo bakweaka amaguta, bagirigenta amasio abo, naende baria endagera, erinde emebere yabo yanyora chinguru.
swahili: divai ya kuufurahisha moyo wa mwanadamu, mafuta kwa ajili ya kungʼarisha uso wake, na mkate wa kutia mwili nguvu.

english: The trees of the LORD have their fill, the cedars of Lebanon that He planted,
ekegusii: Emete y’Omonene nigo egoisaneka namaache, ee, emecharake ya Lebanoni, eyi’Omonene asimegete.
swahili: Miti ya Bwana inanyeshewa vizuri, mierezi ya Lebanoni aliyoipanda.

english: where the birds build their nests; the stork makes her home in the cypresses.
ekegusii: Chinyoni nigo chikoagacha ebiswa biabo ase emete eyio, amaagonga nigo akoagacha ebiswa biabo aroro ase emetarakwa.
swahili: Humo ndege hufanya viota vyao, korongo ana nyumba yake kwenye msunobari.

english: The high mountains are for the wild goats, the cliffs a refuge for the rock badgers.
ekegusii: Ebitunwa ebitambe nabio bire obomenyo bwe chimbori chi’orosana, emienya y’ebitare nero obotamero bw’ebisengi.
swahili: Milima mirefu ni makao ya mbuzi-mwitu, majabali ni kimbilio la pelele.

english: He made the moon to mark the seasons; the sun knows when to set.
ekegusii: Aye kwabekire omotienyi obeire ekemanyererio gie chingaki, na erioba nigo rimanyete boronge ekero rigwenerete kogwa.
swahili: Mwezi hugawanya majira, na jua hutambua wakati wake wa kutua.

english: He wraps Himself in light as with a garment; He stretches out the heavens like a tent,
ekegusii: Aye nigo bwetubete oborabu buna ogwetuba egetambaa gi’okwambara, kwaramboire igoro buna eema eramboire.
swahili: Amejifunika katika nuru kama vile kwa vazi, amezitandaza mbingu kama hema

english: You bring darkness, and it becomes night, when all the beasts of the forest prowl.
ekegusii: Aye nigo okorenta omosunte bwaba botuko, erio ching’iti chionsi chi’orosana chiachaka gotaara.
swahili: Unaleta giza, kunakuwa usiku, wanyama wote wa mwituni huzurura.

english: The young lions roar for their prey and seek their food from God.
ekegusii: Chindo chinsae nigo chikoronya ekero chigotwara, chiarigia endagera yabo korwa ase Nyasae.
swahili: Simba hunguruma kwa mawindo yao, na kutafuta chakula chao kutoka kwa Mungu.

english: The sun rises, and they withdraw; they lie down in their dens.
ekegusii: Ekero erioba rigochia kooroka chiairana, chiagenda korara ase amakuruma abo.
swahili: Jua huchomoza, nao huondoka, hurudi na kulala katika mapango yao.

english: Man goes forth to his work and to his labor until evening.
ekegusii: Mwanyabaanto nigo bakogenda ase emeremo yabo, bayekora goika mogoroba.
swahili: Kisha mwanadamu huenda kazini mwake, katika kazi yake mpaka jioni.

english: How many are Your works, O LORD! In wisdom You have made them all; the earth is full of Your creatures.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, naki ogokora kwao kore okonene! Okwo gwonsi nigo okogokora nobong’aini, ense nigo eichire nebitongwa biao.
swahili: Ee Bwana, jinsi matendo yako yalivyo mengi! Kwa hekima ulizifanya zote, dunia imejaa viumbe vyako.

english: Here is the sea, vast and wide, teeming with creatures beyond number, living things both great and small.
ekegusii: Enyancha nero enene naende engare; nigo eichire nebitongwa bire moyo bitari kobareka, ebike na ebinene.
swahili: Pale kuna bahari, kubwa na yenye nafasi tele, imejaa viumbe visivyo na idadi, vitu vyenye uhai vikubwa na vidogo.

english: There the ships pass, and Leviathan, which You formed to frolic there.
ekegusii: Chimeeri nao chigoeta, na Leviatani, eng’iti eria enene y’okwoboyia gwatongete, ekonagoswenenao.
swahili: Huko meli huenda na kurudi, pia Lewiathani, uliyemuumba acheze ndani yake.

english: All creatures look to You to give them their food in due season.
ekegusii: Ebitongwa ebio bionsi naye bisemeretie, erio oe kera ekemo endagera yaye ase engaki egwenerete.
swahili: Hawa wote wanakutazamia wewe, uwape chakula chao kwa wakati wake.

english: When You give it to them, they gather it up; when You open Your hand, they are satisfied with good things.
ekegusii: Ekero kwabieire endagera, nigo bikoyesangereria; ekero kwaramboire okoboko kwao, nigo bigoisaneka n’ebinto bire ebiya.
swahili: Wakati unapowapa, wanakikusanya, unapofumbua mkono wako, wao wanashibishwa mema.

english: When You hide Your face, they are terrified; when You take away their breath, they die and return to dust.
ekegusii: Ekero kwabisire obosio bwao, nigo bikoba nobwoba obonene; na ekero okobiura omoika obo, nigo bigokwa, biairana ase amaroba ime.
swahili: Unapoficha uso wako, wanapata hofu, unapoondoa pumzi yao, wanakufa na kurudi mavumbini.

english: laying the beams of His chambers in the waters above, making the clouds His chariot, walking on the wings of the wind.
ekegusii: Aye nigo bwarete emiaro y’obomenyo bwao ase amaache, gwakorire amare abeire egari yao, nigo ogoeta kore ase chimbaaba chi’embeo.
swahili: na kuziweka nguzo za orofa yake juu ya maji. Huyafanya mawingu kuwa gari lake, na hupanda kwenye mbawa za upepo.

english: When You send Your Spirit, they are created, and You renew the face of the earth.
ekegusii: Ekero ogotoma omoika oo, nigo bigotongwa, naende gwakora ense yaba enyia.
swahili: Unapopeleka Roho wako, wanaumbwa, nawe huufanya upya uso wa dunia.

english: May the glory of the LORD endure forever; may the LORD rejoice in His works.
ekegusii: Tiga obonene bw’Omonene bogenderere kobao kare na kare; Omonene tiga agokere emeremo yaye.
swahili: Utukufu wa Bwana na udumu milele, Bwana na azifurahie kazi zake:

english: He looks on the earth, and it trembles; He touches the mountains, and they smolder.
ekegusii: Ere nigo akorigereria ense, nero yatengecha, nigo agokuna ebitunwa, na birobio biasokia erioki.
swahili: yeye aitazamaye dunia, nayo ikatetemeka, aigusaye milima, nayo ikatoa moshi.

english: I will sing to the LORD all my life; I will sing praise to my God while I have my being.
ekegusii: Ninterere Omonene ase obogima bwane bwonsi, nimbe ngotera ase ogotogia Nyasae one ekero inde moyo.
swahili: Nitamwimbia Bwana maisha yangu yote; nitaimba sifa kwa Mungu wangu muda wote ninaoishi.

english: May my meditation be pleasing to Him, for I rejoice in the LORD.
ekegusii: Tiga Omonene agokigwe nebirengererio ebio biane, ekiagera inche nigo ngogete asare.
swahili: Kutafakari kwangu na kumpendeze yeye, ninapofurahi katika Bwana.

english: May sinners vanish from the earth and the wicked be no more. Bless the LORD, O my soul. Hallelujah!
ekegusii: Abanyabibe tiga basirigwe korwa ase ense, abakori amabe tibaabaisa kobao. Aye omoyo one, togia Omonene, Motogie Omonene!
swahili: Lakini wenye dhambi na watoweke katika dunia na waovu wasiwepo tena. Ee nafsi yangu, msifu Bwana. Msifuni Bwana.

english: He makes the winds His messengers, flames of fire His servants.
ekegusii: Gwakorire abamalaika bao babeire chimbeo, na abasomba bao babeire ebibemberi bi’omorero.
swahili: Huzifanya pepo kuwa wajumbe wake, miali ya moto watumishi wake.

english: He set the earth on its foundations, never to be moved.
ekegusii: Aye nigo otenenetie ense bokong’u igoro ase amaroso aye, tebaisa konyegerigwa nonya ng’ake.
swahili: Ameiweka dunia kwenye misingi yake, haiwezi kamwe kuondoshwa.

english: You covered it with the deep like a garment; the waters stood above the mountains.
ekegusii: Nigo kwayetubete chindiba buna eanga egotuba, amaache akabeera igoro ase ebitunwa.
swahili: Uliifunika kwa kilindi kama kwa vazi, maji yalisimama juu ya milima.

english: At Your rebuke the waters fled; at the sound of Your thunder they hurried away—
ekegusii: Ekero gwatogonyerete amaache ayio, nigo atamete, na ekero aigwete eriogi riao ri’okogukura, nigo aayererete agatama.
swahili: Lakini kwa kukemea kwako maji yalikimbia, kwa sauti ya radi yako yakatoroka,

english: the mountains rose and the valleys sank to the place You assigned for them—
ekegusii: Agatiira gochia ebitunwa igoro, na agatirimboka gochia ase amakura inse, agaika aase kwayachikerete.
swahili: yakapanda milima, yakateremka mabondeni, hadi mahali pale ulipoyakusudia.

english: You set a boundary they cannot cross, that they may never again cover the earth.
ekegusii: Nigo kwabegete chimbebe aase amaache atanyare goetania, erinde tabaisa gotuba ense yonsi naende.
swahili: Uliyawekea mpaka ambao hayawezi kuuvuka, kamwe hayataifunika dunia tena.

english: Give thanks to the LORD, call upon His name; make known His deeds among the nations.
ekegusii: Moiranerie Omonene ng’a mbuya mono, rangeria erieta riaye ase ogokonywa, teebia abanto b’ebisaku ogokora kwaye.
swahili: Mshukuruni Bwana, liitieni jina lake, wajulisheni mataifa yale aliyoyatenda.

english: He confirmed it to Jacob as a decree, to Israel as an everlasting covenant:
ekegusii: Okobwatana okwo akagokong’ia gokaba ogochika ase Yakobo, ee, ase Israeli okobwatana gwa kare na kare,
swahili: Alilithibitisha kwa Yakobo kuwa amri, kwa Israeli liwe agano la milele:

english: “I will give you the land of Canaan as the portion of your inheritance.”
ekegusii: akamoteebia, “Ninkoe ense ya Kaanani ebe egetari oraire kebe omwando oo.”
swahili: “Nitakupa wewe nchi ya Kanaani kuwa sehemu utakayoirithi.”

english: When they were few in number, few indeed, and strangers in the land,
ekegusii: Ase engaki eria nigo barenge abanto abake ase omobaro, bakabarwa ng’a tibaisaini gento; nigo barenge abaeti ase ense eyio.
swahili: Walipokuwa wachache kwa idadi, wachache sana na wageni ndani yake,

english: “Do not touch My anointed ones! Do no harm to My prophets!”
ekegusii: agateeba, “Timobaisa gokuna abaakwa amaguta baane, gose timokorera ababani baane bobe.”
swahili: “Msiwaguse niliowatia mafuta; msiwadhuru manabii wangu.”

english: He called down famine on the land and cut off all their supplies of food.
ekegusii: Ekero Omonene arentete enchara ase ense, na asiretie chindagera chiabo chionsi,
swahili: Akaiita njaa juu ya nchi na kuharibu chakula chao chote,

english: He sent a man before them— Joseph, sold as a slave.
ekegusii: konya otomire omonto agwo ritang’ani, nere Yusufu konya oonigwe obeire omosomba.
swahili: naye akatuma mtu mbele yao, Yosefu, aliyeuzwa kama mtumwa.

english: They bruised his feet with shackles and placed his neck in irons,
ekegusii: Nigo asibetwe chingatare chigasionora amagoro aye, naende akabeekerwa eteyo y’ekioma ase rigoti riaye,
swahili: Walichubua miguu yake kwa minyororo, shingo yake ilifungwa kwa chuma,

english: until his prediction came true and the word of the LORD proved him right.
ekegusii: goika ayabaanete agaikerana. Ase ayio ring’ana ri’Omonene rikaenekia ng’a Yusufu nomooronge.
swahili: hadi yale aliyotangulia kusema yalipotimia, hadi neno la Bwana lilipomthibitisha.

english: Sing to Him, sing praises to Him; tell of all His wonders.
ekegusii: Terera Omonene, moterere amatera ay’okomotogia, raria ogokora kwaye kw’ogokumia!
swahili: Mwimbieni yeye, mwimbieni yeye sifa, waambieni matendo yake yote ya ajabu.

english: The king sent and released him; the ruler of peoples set him free.
ekegusii: Omorwoti agatoma abanto bakamosibora, ee, oyorenge omogambi bw’abaanto akamosibora.
swahili: Mfalme alituma watu wakamfungua, mtawala wa watu alimwachia huru.

english: He made him master of his household, ruler over all his substance,
ekegusii: Akamobeka akaba Omonene bw’enyomba yaye, amo n’ebinto bionsi abwate,
swahili: Alimfanya mkuu wa nyumba yake, mtawala juu ya vyote alivyokuwa navyo,

english: to instruct his princes as he pleased and teach his elders wisdom.
ekegusii: erinde abe ogotebereria abanene b’oborwoti boria buna anchete, na kworokereria abagaaka baye b’oborwoti chisemi.
swahili: kuwaelekeza wakuu wa mfalme apendavyo na kuwafundisha wazee wake hekima.

english: Then Israel entered Egypt; Jacob dwelt in the land of Ham.
ekegusii: Erio Abaisraeli bagacha Misiri; Yakobo akaba omomenyi ase ense ya Hamu.
swahili: Kisha Israeli akaingia Misri, Yakobo akaishi kama mgeni katika nchi ya Hamu.

english: And the LORD made His people very fruitful, more numerous than their foes,
ekegusii: Omonene agasesenia abanto abwo bakabucha mono, naende bakaba ne chinguru chinyinge kobua abachandi babo.
swahili: Bwana aliwafanya watu wake kuzaana sana, akawafanya kuwa wengi sana kuliko adui zao,

english: whose hearts He turned to hate His people, to conspire against His servants.
ekegusii: Omonene akaonchora chinkoro chi’Abamisiri, erinde bakagecha abanto baye, erio bagakorera abasomba b’Omonene amabe ay’obong’ainereria.
swahili: ndiye aliigeuza mioyo yao iwachukie watu wake, wakatenda hila dhidi ya watumishi wake.

english: He sent Moses His servant, and Aaron, whom He had chosen.
ekegusii: Omonene agatoma Musa, omosomba oye, na Aroni, oyio konya achorire.
swahili: Akamtuma Mose mtumishi wake, pamoja na Aroni, aliyemchagua.

english: They performed His miraculous signs among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.
ekegusii: Barabwo bakaorokia ebimanyererio ase egati y’abanto, bagakora ebikone agwo ase ense ya Hamu.
swahili: Walifanya ishara zake za ajabu miongoni mwao, miujiza yake katika nchi ya Hamu.

english: He sent darkness, and it became dark— yet they defied His words.
ekegusii: Omonene agatoma omosunte, na ense eria ekamwama ti. Barabwo tibangete koigwera amang’ana aye.
swahili: Alituma giza na nchi ikajaa giza, kwani si walikuwa wameyaasi maneno yake?

english: He turned their waters to blood and caused their fish to die.
ekegusii: Akaonchora amaache abo akaba amanyinga, na ayio akagera chinswe chiabo chigakwa.
swahili: Aligeuza maji yao kuwa damu, ikasababisha samaki wao kufa.

english: Glory in His holy name; let the hearts of those who seek the LORD rejoice.
ekegusii: Etogerie erieta riaye richenu, abanto bonsi abakorigia Omonene basasoke ase chinkoro chiabo.
swahili: Lishangilieni jina lake takatifu, mioyo ya wale wamtafutao Bwana na ifurahi.

english: Their land teemed with frogs, even in their royal chambers.
ekegusii: Ebioto bigacha bigaichora ase ense yabo nonya nase ebinyomba bi’okorara bi’abagaambi babo.
swahili: Nchi yao ilijaa vyura tele, ambao waliingia hadi kwenye vyumba vya kulala vya watawala wao.

english: He spoke, and insects swarmed— gnats throughout their country.
ekegusii: Omonene agakwana, ne chingi chinyinge mono chigaacha, ne chinsona boigo ase ense eria yonsi.
swahili: Alisema, yakaja makundi ya mainzi, na viroboto katika nchi yao yote.

english: He gave them hail for rain, with lightning throughout their land.
ekegusii: Akarenta amagena ’embura ribaga ri’embura, chinkoba chikamesa aande onsi ase ense eria.
swahili: Alibadilisha mvua yao ikawa mvua ya mawe, yenye umeme wa radi nchini yao yote,

english: He struck their vines and fig trees and shattered the trees of their country.
ekegusii: Agasaria emesabibu na emeko yabo, emete y’ense eria ekabunwa.
swahili: akaharibu mizabibu yao na miti ya tini, na akaangamiza miti ya nchi yao.

english: He spoke, and the locusts came— young locusts without number.
ekegusii: Agakwana, ne chingige chigaacha, chirochio chikabiara chikaba chinyinge,
swahili: Alisema, nzige wakaja, tunutu wasio na idadi,

english: They devoured every plant in their land and consumed the produce of their soil.
ekegusii: chikaria chigakoora ebimeri bi’ense eria, boigo chikaria okwama kwe riroba riabo.
swahili: wakala kila jani katika nchi yao, wakala mazao ya ardhi yao.

english: Then He struck all the firstborn in their land, the firstfruits of all their vigor.
ekegusii: Omonene agaita abana abatangi bonsi ase ense eria, ne ching’iti chintangi, ogotongora gwe chinguru chiabo chionsi.
swahili: Kisha akawaua wazaliwa wote wa kwanza katika nchi yao, matunda ya kwanza ya ujana wao wote.

english: He brought Israel out with silver and gold, and none among His tribes stumbled.
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene akang’anyia Abaisraeli korwa aroro bare ne chifeta ne chitaabu, monto onde tarenge ase abanto baye oborire chinguru.
swahili: Akawatoa Israeli katika nchi wakiwa na fedha na dhahabu nyingi, wala hakuna hata mmoja kutoka kabila zao aliyejikwaa.

english: Egypt was glad when they departed, for the dread of Israel had fallen on them.
ekegusii: Abamisiri nigo babete nomogooko ekero Abaisraeli bang’anyete, ekiagera obwoba konya bwabagwereire ase engencho y’Abaisraeli.
swahili: Misri ilifurahi walipoondoka, kwa sababu hofu ya Israeli ilikuwa imewaangukia.

english: He spread a cloud as a covering and a fire to light up the night.
ekegusii: Omonene akarambora riire rigatuba abanto baye, na omorero okaba okobamorekera botuko.
swahili: Alitandaza wingu kama kifuniko, na moto kuwamulikia usiku.

english: Seek out the LORD and His strength; seek His face always.
ekegusii: Rigia Omonene amo ne chinguru chiaye, morigie obosio bwaye botambe.
swahili: Mtafuteni Bwana na nguvu zake, utafuteni uso wake siku zote.

english: They asked, and He brought quail and satisfied them with the bread of heaven.
ekegusii: Ekero baboretie eki bakoria, ere agatoma chinkware, boigo akabaigotia nendagera korwa igoro.
swahili: Waliomba, naye akawaletea kware, akawashibisha kwa mkate wa mbinguni.

english: He opened a rock, and water gushed out; it flowed like a river in the desert.
ekegusii: Akabochora egetare, na amaache agasoka korwao, akaminyoka ase erooro buna orooche.
swahili: Alipasua mwamba, maji yakabubujika, yakatiririka jangwani kama mto.

english: For He remembered His holy promise to Abraham His servant.
ekegusii: Omonene akainyora eira eria enchenu ariete, boigo akainyora Aburaamu, omosomba oye.
swahili: Kwa maana alikumbuka ahadi yake takatifu, aliyompa Abrahamu mtumishi wake.

english: He brought forth His people with rejoicing, His chosen with shouts of joy.
ekegusii: Ase igo akang’anyia abanto baye korwa ase ense eria bakaba bagochenga, abanto abwo baye achorete bakaba bagoteera nomogooko.
swahili: Aliwatoa watu wake kwa furaha, wateule wake kwa kelele za shangwe,

english: He gave them the lands of the nations, that they might inherit the fruit of others’ labor,
ekegusii: Akabaa chinse chi’abaanto b’ebisaku chikaba echiabo, akabaa n’ebinto abanto abwo konya bechandeire.
swahili: akawapa nchi za mataifa, wakawa warithi wa mali wengine walikuwa wameitaabikia:

english: that they might keep His statutes and obey His laws. Hallelujah!
ekegusii: Ayio nigo akoregete, erinde Abaisraeli baigwere emeroberio yaye echiikire, naende barende amachiiko aye. Motogie Omonene!
swahili: alifanya haya ili wayashike mausia yake na kuzitii sheria zake. Msifuni Bwana.

english: Remember the wonders He has done, His marvels, and the judgments He has pronounced,
ekegusii: Inyora emeremo yo’gokumia eria akorire, ebikone biaye na ebiina biaye bi’ekeene arure
swahili: Kumbuka matendo ya ajabu aliyoyafanya, miujiza yake na hukumu alizozitamka,

english: O offspring of His servant Abraham, O sons of Jacob, His chosen ones.
ekegusii: Inwe abanto b’ororeria rwa Aburaamu, omosomba O’ Omonene, ee, inwe abanto ba Yakobo, abachore b’Omonene,
swahili: enyi wazao wa Abrahamu mtumishi wake, enyi wana wa Yakobo, wateule wake.

english: He is the LORD our God; His judgments carry throughout the earth.
ekegusii: Ere nere Omonene, Nyasae oito, ebiina biaye nigo bire ase ense yonsi.
swahili: Yeye ndiye Bwana Mungu wetu, hukumu zake zimo duniani pote.

english: He remembers His covenant forever, the word He ordained for a thousand generations—
ekegusii: Botambe nigo akoinyora okobwatana kwaye kw’ogotianania, boigo goika ebiare elifu eyemo nigo akoinyora ring’ana achigete,
swahili: Hulikumbuka agano lake milele, neno ambalo aliamuru, kwa vizazi elfu,

english: the covenant He made with Abraham, and the oath He swore to Isaac.
ekegusii: na okobwatana koria gw’ogotianania akorete na Aburaamu, na eira yaye y’ogotianania amorierete Isaka.
swahili: agano alilolifanya na Abrahamu, kiapo alichomwapia Isaki.

english: Hallelujah! Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.
ekegusii: Motogie Omonene! Moakere Omonene ng’a mbuya mono, ekiagera ere nomuya, na obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.
swahili: Msifuni Bwana. Mshukuruni Bwana, kwa kuwa ni mwema; upendo wake wadumu milele.

english: He saved them from the hand that hated them; He redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.
ekegusii: Naboigo Omonene akabatooria korwa ase amaboko ay’abaabagechete na kobabooria korwa ase chinguru chi’ababisa babo.
swahili: Aliwaokoa mikononi mwa adui; kutoka mikononi mwa adui aliwakomboa.

english: The waters covered their foes; not one of them remained.
ekegusii: Amaache akamera kegima abachandi baria babo; onde tatigarete ore moyo nonya noyomo.
swahili: Maji yaliwafunika adui zao, hakunusurika hata mmoja.

english: Then they believed His promises and sang His praise.
ekegusii: Erio bakwegena ring’ana ri’Omonene, agwo bagateera ase okomotogia.
swahili: Ndipo walipoamini ahadi zake, nao wakaimba sifa zake.

english: Yet they soon forgot His works and failed to wait for His counsel.
ekegusii: Korende ase obwango bakeba ogokora kwaye, tibaganyete Omonene abasemie.
swahili: Lakini mara walisahau aliyowatendea, wala hawakungojea shauri lake.

english: They craved intensely in the wilderness and tested God in the desert.
ekegusii: Barabwo nigo babete nobotoonu bw’okogania endagera. Bagateema Nyasae agwo ase erooro.
swahili: Jangwani walitawaliwa na tamaa zao, walimjaribu Mungu nyikani.

english: So He granted their request, but sent a wasting disease upon them.
ekegusii: Ere akabaa egento baboretie baegwe, korende akabatomera oborwaire bw’okobareyia.
swahili: Kwa hiyo aliwapa kile walichoomba, lakini akatuma juu yao ugonjwa wa kudhoofisha.

english: In the camp they envied Moses, as well as Aaron, the holy one of the LORD.
ekegusii: Ekero abanto b’egetwori babete ne ribero ase Musa, na ase Aroni, oyio orenge omochenu o Nyasae,
swahili: Kambini walimwonea wivu Mose, na pia Aroni aliyekuwa amewekwa wakfu kwa Bwana.

english: The earth opened up and swallowed Dathan; it covered the assembly of Abiram.
ekegusii: riroba rikabwereka rikamera Datani, na rikamumekeria abanto b’ekeombe ki’Abiiramu.
swahili: Ardhi ilifunguka ikawameza Dathani, ikawazika Abiramu na kundi lake.

english: Then fire blazed through their company; flames consumed the wicked.
ekegusii: Boigo omorero ogatuboka agwo ase egati y’ekeombe kiabo, ekebemberi ki’omorero kegasamba abakori amabe baria.
swahili: Moto uliwaka katikati ya wafuasi wao, mwali wa moto uliwateketeza waovu.

english: At Horeb they made a calf and worshiped a molten image.
ekegusii: Abanto bakaroisia omogwekano bw’emori agwo Horebu, erio bagasasiima omogwekano oria obombire.
swahili: Huko Horebu walitengeneza ndama, na kuabudu sanamu ya kusubu kwa chuma.

english: Who can describe the mighty acts of the LORD or fully proclaim His praise?
ekegusii: Ning’o oranyare goteeba ogokora okonene kw’Omonene, gose koraria obonene bwaye bwonsi?
swahili: Ni nani awezaye kusimulia matendo makuu ya Bwana au kutangaza kikamilifu sifa zake?

english: They exchanged their Glory for the image of a grass-eating ox.
ekegusii: Barabwo bakaonchoreria oyorenge obonene bwabo, bakaonchokera omogwekano bw’eng’ombe ekorisia obonyansi.
swahili: Waliubadilisha Utukufu wao kwa sanamu ya fahali, ambaye hula majani.

english: They forgot God their Savior, who did great things in Egypt,
ekegusii: Bakeba Nyasae, Omotooria obo, oria okorete amang’ana amanene aaria Misiri;
swahili: Walimsahau Mungu aliyewaokoa, aliyekuwa ametenda mambo makuu huko Misri,

english: wondrous works in the land of Ham, and awesome deeds by the Red Sea.
ekegusii: oria okorete ogokora kw’ogokumia ase ense ya Hamu, naende agakora amang’ana ay’okoondokia aaria ase Enyancha Embariri.
swahili: miujiza katika nchi ya Hamu na mambo ya kutisha huko Bahari ya Shamu.

english: So He said He would destroy them— had not Moses His chosen one stood before Him in the breach to divert His wrath from destroying them.
ekegusii: Ase ayio Omonene akarengereria ng’a abasirie, korende Musa, omochore oye, agatenena ase obosio bwaye buna omobwatania, ase ogotanga endamwamu yaye teita abanto.
swahili: Kwa hiyo alisema kwamba angewaangamiza: kama Mose mteule wake, asingesimama kati yao na Mungu kuizuia ghadhabu yake kuwaangamiza.

english: They despised the pleasant land; they did not believe His promise.
ekegusii: Abanto bagachaaya ense eria yarenge engiya, ekiagera tibegenete eira y’Omonene.
swahili: Kisha waliidharau ile nchi nzuri, hawakuiamini ahadi yake.

english: They grumbled in their tents and did not listen to the voice of the LORD.
ekegusii: Ekero barenge ase chiema chiabo ime nigo bemurunganetie, tibaigwera eriogi ri’Omonene.
swahili: Walinungʼunika ndani ya mahema yao, wala hawakumtii Bwana.

english: So He raised His hand and swore to cast them down in the wilderness,
ekegusii: Ase ayio akarambora okoboko kwaye igoro yaabo, agatiana ng’a abatige bakwere agwo ase erooro,
swahili: Kwa hiyo akaapa kwa mkono ulioinuliwa kwamba atawafanya waanguke jangwani,

english: to disperse their offspring among the nations and scatter them throughout the lands.
ekegusii: naende ng’a asiarere abanto b’ororeria rwabo, bagende komenya ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku ase chinse ao ao.
swahili: kuwatawanya wazao wao waanguke miongoni mwa mataifa, na kuwatawanya katika nchi zote.

english: They yoked themselves to Baal of Peor and ate sacrifices offered to lifeless gods.
ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakabwatana na Baali, enyasae ya Peori, bakaria ebing’wanso biarenge koruegwa ase chinyasae chitari moyo.
swahili: Walijifunga nira na Baali wa Peori, wakala dhabihu zilizotolewa kwa miungu isiyo na uhai.

english: So they provoked the LORD to anger with their deeds, and a plague broke out among them.
ekegusii: Ase igo ogokora okwo kwabo gokagechia Omonene goika akaba nendamwamu, na oborwaire bogoita bogatuboka ase egati yaabo.
swahili: Waliichochea hasira ya Bwana, wakamkasirisha kwa matendo yao maovu, nayo tauni ikazuka katikati yao.

english: Blessed are those who uphold justice, who practice righteousness at all times.
ekegusii: Mbasesenirie abanto abwo bagokora oboronge, abwo bagokora oboronge ase chingaki chionsi.
swahili: Heri wale wanaodumisha haki, ambao daima wanafanya yaliyo mema.

english: But Phinehas stood and intervened, and the plague was restrained.
ekegusii: Erio Finehasi agatenena agaakanera amabe ayio akoretwe, na oborwaire boria bogatiga goita abanto.
swahili: Lakini Finehasi alisimama na kuingilia kati, nayo tauni ikazuiliwa.

english: It was credited to him as righteousness for endless generations to come.
ekegusii: Ase engencho y’ogokora okwo Finehasi akabarwa ng’a nomonyene oboronge aare, ebiaare ase ebiaare kogenderera botambe.
swahili: Hili likahesabiwa kwake haki, kwa vizazi visivyo na mwisho vijavyo.

english: At the waters of Meribah they angered the LORD, and trouble came to Moses because of them.
ekegusii: Abanto bakagechia Omonene agwo ase amaache a Meriba, na ase engencho yaabo Musa agasoa ase emechando.
swahili: Kwenye maji ya Meriba, walimkasirisha Bwana, janga likampata Mose kwa sababu yao;

english: For they rebelled against His Spirit, and Moses spoke rashly with his lips.
ekegusii: Nigo bagechetie enkoro ya Musa, goika agakwana amang’ana nobororo, ase ogotarengereria buya.
swahili: kwa maana walimwasi Roho wa Mungu, na maneno yasiyofaa yakatoka midomoni kwa Mose.

english: They did not destroy the peoples as the LORD had commanded them,
ekegusii: Abaisraeli tibaitete basirie kegima abanto b’ebisaku, buna Omonene konya achiikire.
swahili: Hawakuyaangamiza yale mataifa kama Bwana alivyowaagiza,

english: but they mingled with the nations and adopted their customs.
ekegusii: Korende nigo basang’ananete n’abanto abwo bakeorokereria ogokora kwabo.
swahili: bali walijichanganya na mataifa na wakazikubali desturi zao.

english: They worshiped their idols, which became a snare to them.
ekegusii: Nigo bakorerete emegwekano yaabo baare gosasiima, na eyio ekaba amareba ase bare.
swahili: Waliabudu sanamu zao, zikawa mtego kwao.

english: They sacrificed their sons and their daughters to demons.
ekegusii: Barabwo nigo baruete abana babo, abamura na abaiseke, bakaba ebing’wanso ase ebirecha.
swahili: Wakawatoa wana wao na binti zao dhabihu kwa mashetani.

english: They shed innocent blood— the blood of their sons and daughters, whom they sacrificed to the idols of Canaan, and the land was polluted with blood.
ekegusii: Bagaitera amanyinga ya bana babo, abamura na abaiseke, abatari na komocha, abwo baruete bakaba ebing’wanso ase emegwekano bagasasiima ase ense ya Kaanani; na ense eria ekaba eyetachenegeti ase engencho y’ogoiterwa kw’amanyinga ayio.
swahili: Walimwaga damu isiyo na hatia, damu za wana wao na binti zao, ambao waliwatoa dhabihu kwa sanamu za Kanaani, nayo nchi ikanajisika kwa damu zao.

english: They defiled themselves by their actions and prostituted themselves by their deeds.
ekegusii: Ase ayio abanto abwo bagesoyia ase ogotacheneka ase engencho y’ogokora kwabo, bagakora obonyaka tibaaba abegenwa.
swahili: Wakajinajisi wenyewe kwa yale waliyotenda; kwa matendo yao wenyewe wakajifanyia ukahaba.

english: Remember me, O LORD, in Your favor to Your people; visit me with Your salvation,
ekegusii: Omonene, ong’inyore ekero okororera abanto bao amaabera, onchichere, ontoorie!
swahili: Ee Bwana, unikumbuke unapowatendea mema watu wako, uwe msaada wangu unapowaokoa,

english: So the anger of the LORD burned against His people, and He abhorred His own inheritance.
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene akaba nendamwamu ase abanto baye, na akagechigwa n’abanto bare omwando oye.
swahili: Kwa hiyo Bwana akawakasirikia watu wake na akauchukia sana urithi wake.

english: He delivered them into the hand of the nations, and those who hated them ruled over them.
ekegusii: Akababeka ase amaboko ya banto b’ebisaku, erinde abanto abwo baabagechete bakaba bakobagambera.
swahili: Akawakabidhi kwa mataifa na adui zao wakawatawala.

english: Their enemies oppressed them, and subdued them under their hand.
ekegusii: Ababisa babo bakabakorera bobe, bakababua bakababeeka inse yobogambi bwabo.
swahili: Adui zao wakawaonea na kuwatia chini ya mamlaka yao.

english: Many times He rescued them, but they were bent on rebellion and sank down in their iniquity.
ekegusii: Ase chingaki chinyinge Omonene nigo arenge kobatooria, korende ase ogosemania kwabo bagachora gosaria asare: ase igo bakaba bagochandeka mono ase engencho y’ebibe biabo.
swahili: Mara nyingi aliwaokoa lakini walikuwa wamezama kwenye uasi, nao wakajiharibu katika dhambi zao.

english: Nevertheless He heard their cry; He took note of their distress.
ekegusii: Nonya naboigo nabechanderete ase emechando yaabo, akaigwa ekerero kiabo.
swahili: Lakini akaangalia mateso yao wakati aliposikia kilio chao;

english: And He remembered His covenant with them, and relented by the abundance of His loving devotion.
ekegusii: Ase engencho yaabo nigo ainyorete okobwatana kwaye kw’ogotianania, akabarorera amabeebe, ekiagera are nobwanchani bogendererete botambe.
swahili: kwa ajili yao akakumbuka agano lake, na kutokana na upendo wake mkuu akapooza hasira yake.

english: He made them objects of compassion to all who held them captive.
ekegusii: Nigo agerete abwo babosete bakabarorera amaabera.
swahili: Akawafanya wahurumiwe na wote waliowashikilia mateka.

english: Save us, O LORD our God, and gather us from the nations, that we may give thanks to Your holy name, that we may glory in Your praise.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, Nyasae oito, totoorie; tosangererie amo, otorusie korwa ase abanto b’ebisaku, erio tonyare gotogia erieta riao richenu, na gochengera obonene bwao.
swahili: Ee Bwana Mungu wetu, tuokoe. Tukusanye tena kutoka kwa mataifa, ili tuweze kulishukuru jina lako takatifu, na kushangilia katika sifa zako.

english: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting. Let all the people say, “Amen!” Hallelujah!
ekegusii: Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, atogigwe korwa kare goika kare na kare; na abanto bonsi pi bateebe, “Amina.” Togia Omonene!
swahili: Atukuzwe Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli, tangu milele na hata milele. Watu wote na waseme, “Amen!” Msifuni Bwana.

english: that I may see the prosperity of Your chosen ones, and rejoice in the gladness of Your nation, and give glory with Your inheritance.
ekegusii: Erio inyare korora ebisio abanto bao abachore baranyore, na inche inyare kogokera omogooko bw’abaanto bao, naende inyare gwetogia amo n’abanto bare omwando oo.
swahili: ili niweze kufurahia mafanikio ya wateule wako, niweze kushiriki katika furaha ya taifa lako, na kuungana na urithi wako katika kukusifu.

english: We have sinned like our fathers; we have done wrong and acted wickedly.
ekegusii: Intwe twakorire ebibe buna chisokoro chiaito chiakorete; twakorire ayare amabe mono, ee, twakorire ayare amabe.
swahili: Tumetenda dhambi, kama vile baba zetu walivyotenda, tumekosa na tumetenda uovu.

english: Our fathers in Egypt did not grasp Your wonders or remember Your abundant kindness; but they rebelled by the sea, there at the Red Sea.
ekegusii: Ekero chisokoro chiaito chiarenge Misiri, tichiarengereretie igoro y’emeremo yao y’ogokumia; tichiainyorete obwanchani bwao obonge bogendererete botambe, korende chigasaria asore aaria ase Enyancha Embariri.
swahili: Wakati baba zetu walipokuwa Misri, hawakuzingatia maajabu yako, wala hawakukumbuka wingi wa fadhili zako, bali waliasi kando ya bahari, Bahari ya Shamu.

english: Yet He saved them for the sake of His name, to make His power known.
ekegusii: Nonya naboigo Omonene akabatooria ase engencho y’erieta riaye, ng’a anyare komanyekania okobua kwaye okonene.
swahili: Hata hivyo aliwaokoa kwa ajili ya jina lake, ili apate kudhihirisha uweza wake mkuu.

english: He rebuked the Red Sea, and it dried up; He led them through the depths as through a desert.
ekegusii: Nigo atogonyerete Enyancha eria Embariri egakamoka, erio agaetia Abaisraeli aroro buna nase ense enyomo.
swahili: Alikemea Bahari ya Shamu, nayo ikakauka, akawaongoza katika vilindi vyake kama vile jangwani.

english: Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.
ekegusii: Moakere Omonene ng’a mbuya mono, ekiagera ere nomuya, no’bwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.
swahili: Mshukuruni Bwana, kwa kuwa yeye ni mwema, upendo wake wadumu milele.

english: Some sat in darkness and in the shadow of death, prisoners in affliction and chains,
ekegusii: Abanto nigo bamenyete ase omosunte na ase ekiriri ki’amakweri, nigo basibire ase emechando, basibeire chingataare,
swahili: Wengine walikaa gizani na katika huzuni kuu, wafungwa wakiteseka katika minyororo,

english: because they rebelled against the words of God and despised the counsel of the Most High.
ekegusii: ekiagera bangete koigwera ring’ana ria Nyasae, bagachaaya ogoseemia kw’Oyore Igoro Mono.
swahili: kwa sababu walikuwa wameasi dhidi ya maneno ya Mungu na kudharau shauri la Aliye Juu Sana.

english: He humbled their hearts with hard labor; they stumbled, and there was no one to help.
ekegusii: Agakanya chinkoro chiabo ase okobaa obokong’u, bakaiyerigwa inse, na monto onde tarengeo okobakoonya.
swahili: Aliwatumikisha kwa kazi ngumu; walijikwaa na hapakuwepo yeyote wa kuwasaidia.

english: Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, and He saved them from their distress.
ekegusii: Erio bakarera ase Omonene ase engencho y’emechando yaabo, ere akabatooria korwa ase obokong’u bwabo.
swahili: Ndipo walipomlilia Bwana katika shida yao, naye akawaokoa kutoka taabu yao.

english: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death and broke away their chains.
ekegusii: Akabarusia korwa ase omosunte ekerima, akabutora chingataare basibeire.
swahili: Akawatoa katika giza na huzuni kuu na akavunja minyororo yao.

english: Let them give thanks to the LORD for His loving devotion and His wonders to the sons of men.
ekegusii: Tiga baakere Omonene ng’a mbuya mono ase engencho y’obwanchani bwaye bwa botambe, na ase emeremo y’ogokumia akoreire Mwanyabaanto.
swahili: Basi na wamshukuru Bwana kwa upendo wake usiokoma, na kwa matendo yake ya ajabu kwa wanadamu,

english: For He has broken down the gates of bronze and cut through the bars of iron.
ekegusii: Ere nigo abunete ebisiekero bie chitaai, na akabuna emekorogoto y’ebioma ekaba ebing’ese.
swahili: kwa kuwa yeye huvunja malango ya shaba na kukata mapingo ya chuma.

english: Fools, in their rebellious ways, and through their iniquities, suffered affliction.
ekegusii: Abande bakariria, ekiagera babwatetie enchera y’ogosareka, na bakaba bagochaandeka ase engencho y’ebibe biabo.
swahili: Wengine wakawa wapumbavu kutokana na uasi wao, wakapata mateso kwa sababu ya uovu wao.

english: They loathed all food and drew near to the gates of death.
ekegusii: Kera endagera ekaba enguundo ase bare, bakaba ang’e gosoa ase ebiita bi’amakweri.
swahili: Wakachukia kabisa vyakula vyote, wakakaribia malango ya mauti.

english: Let the redeemed of the LORD say so, whom He has redeemed from the hand of the enemy
ekegusii: Abanto abw’Omonene abooretie tiga bakwane igo, abwo aboretie korwa ase okoboko kw’omochaandi.
swahili: Waliokombolewa wa Bwana na waseme hivi, wale aliowaokoa kutoka mkono wa adui,

english: He sent forth His word and healed them; He rescued them from the Pit.
ekegusii: Akabatomera ring’ana riaye, akabagwenia, akabatooria korwa ase chimbeera.
swahili: Akalituma neno lake na kuwaponya, akawaokoa kutoka maangamizo yao.

english: Let them give thanks to the LORD for His loving devotion and His wonders to the sons of men.
ekegusii: Tiga baakere Omonene ng’a mbuya mono ase engencho y’obwanchani bwaye bwa botambe, na ase emeremo y’ogokumia akoreire Mwanyabaanto.
swahili: Basi na wamshukuru Bwana kwa upendo wake usiokoma, na kwa matendo yake ya ajabu kwa wanadamu.

english: Let them offer sacrifices of thanksgiving and declare His works with rejoicing.
ekegusii: Tiga barue ebing’wanso bi’ogoaka ng’a mbuya mono, naende bararie ogokora kwaye ase ogoteera n’omogooko.
swahili: Na watoe dhabihu za kushukuru, na wasimulie matendo yake kwa nyimbo za furaha.

english: Others went out to sea in ships, conducting trade on the mighty waters.
