ekegusii: Abwo bageendete ne chimeeri ase enyancha, bagakora oboonchoreria ase chinyancha chinene,
swahili: Wengine walisafiri baharini kwa meli, walikuwa wafanyabiashara kwenye maji makuu.

english: They saw the works of the LORD, and His wonders in the deep.
ekegusii: mbaarooche ogokora kw’Omonene, ee, ogokora kwaye kw’ogokumia ime ase chindiba.
swahili: Waliziona kazi za Bwana, matendo yake ya ajabu kilindini.

english: For He spoke and raised a tempest that lifted the waves of the sea.
ekegusii: Ere agachiika ekembugu‐mbugu gekaimoka, kerokio gekaimokereria igoro emerindo y’enyancha,
swahili: Kwa maana alisema na kuamsha tufani iliyoinua mawimbi juu.

english: They mounted up to the heavens, then sunk to the depths; their courage melted in their anguish.
ekegusii: Emerindo eyio ekaimokerera igoro, naende ekairana inse, na ase ayio abanto bakerusia moyo ase omoichano.
swahili: Yakainuka juu mbinguni, yakashuka chini hadi vilindini, katika hatari hii ujasiri wao uliyeyuka.

english: They reeled and staggered like drunkards, and all their skill was useless.
ekegusii: Bakaba bakoong’anya na gotabataba buna abanto batiindire, na obong’aini bwabo bwonsi bokabaerera.
swahili: Walipepesuka na kuyumbayumba kama walevi, ujanja wao ukafikia ukomo.

english: Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, and He brought them out of their distress.
ekegusii: Erio bakarera ase Omonene ase engencho y’emechando yaabo, nere akabatooria korwa ase obokong’u bwabo.
swahili: Ndipo walipomlilia Bwana katika shida yao, naye akawatoa kwenye taabu yao.

english: He calmed the storm to a whisper, and the waves of the sea were hushed.
ekegusii: Agachiika ekembugu‐mbugu keria, kegakira‐kiri, na emerindo y’enyancha egatoerera.
swahili: Akatuliza dhoruba kwa mnongʼono, mawimbi ya bahari yakatulia.

english: and gathered from the lands, from east and west, from north and south.
ekegusii: Obasangereirie obarentire korwa ase chinse ao ao, korwa moocha na bosongo, na korwa sugusu na Irianyi.
swahili: wale aliowakusanya kutoka nchi mbalimbali, kutoka mashariki na magharibi, kutoka kaskazini na kusini.

english: They rejoiced in the silence, and He guided them to the harbor they desired.
ekegusii: Erio bakaba n’omogooko, ekiagera banyorete obotoereru, n’Omonene akabaikia ase ekiambokero keria baganetie.
swahili: Walifurahi ilipokuwa shwari, naye akawaongoza hadi bandari waliyoitamani.

english: Let them give thanks to the LORD for His loving devotion and His wonders to the sons of men.
ekegusii: Tiga baakere Omonene ng’a mbuya mono, ase engencho y’obwanchani bwaye bwa botambe, na ase emeremo y’ogokumia akoreire Mwanyabaanto.
swahili: Basi na wamshukuru Bwana kwa upendo wake usiokoma, na kwa matendo yake ya ajabu kwa wanadamu.

english: Let them exalt Him in the assembly of the people and praise Him in the council of the elders.
ekegusii: Tiga baabake Omonene agwo ase omosangererekano bw’ abanto, bamotogie nase abagaaka bagoikaransa kogaamba.
swahili: Na wamtukuze yeye katika kusanyiko la watu, na wamsifu katika baraza la wazee.

english: He turns rivers into deserts, springs of water into thirsty ground,
ekegusii: Omonene akaonchora chindooche chikaba erooro, ne chinsooko chikaba ense enyomo.
swahili: Yeye aligeuza mito kuwa jangwa, chemchemi za maji zitiririkazo kuwa ardhi yenye kiu,

english: and fruitful land into fields of salt, because of the wickedness of its dwellers.
ekegusii: Akaonchora n’ense ere entobu ekaba ekerubo ki’omonyo, ase engencho y’obobe bw’ abanto bamenyeteo.
swahili: nchi izaayo ikawa ya chumvi isiyofaa, kwa sababu ya uovu wa wale walioishi humo.

english: He turns a desert into pools of water and a dry land into flowing springs.
ekegusii: Boigo akaonchora erooro ekaba ritibo riichire amaache, na ense enyomo egatuboka chinsooko chi’amaache.
swahili: Aligeuza jangwa likawa madimbwi ya maji, nayo ardhi kame kuwa chemchemi za maji zitiririkazo;

english: He causes the hungry to settle there, that they may establish a city in which to dwell.
ekegusii: Aroro agwo nigo arentete abanto bare n’enchara; barabwo bakaagaacha omochie aroro bakamenyao.
swahili: aliwaleta wenye njaa wakaishi humo, nao wakajenga mji wangeweza kuishi.

english: They sow fields and plant vineyards that yield a fruitful harvest.
ekegusii: Barabwo nigo bakobusura emegondo, naende basimeka emesabibu, bakanyora okwama okonene mono.
swahili: Walilima mashamba na kupanda mizabibu, nayo ikazaa matunda mengi,

english: He blesses them, and they multiply greatly; He does not let their herds diminish.
ekegusii: Omonene akabasesenia bagasarara mono, tatigete omobaro bwe chitugo chiabo okee.
swahili: Mungu aliwabariki, hesabu yao ikaongezeka sana, wala hakuruhusu mifugo yao kupungua.

english: When they are decreased and humbled by oppression, evil, and sorrow,
ekegusii: Ekero bakeetigwe na kworoba ase engencho y’ogokorerwa bobe na gochaandwa,
swahili: Kisha hesabu yao ilipungua, na walinyenyekeshwa kwa kuonewa, maafa na huzuni.

english: Some wandered in desert wastelands, finding no path to a city in which to dwell.
ekegusii: Abanto abwo nigo babete bakona goetanana ase erooro enyomo, tibanyorete mochie onde ase baare komenya.
swahili: Baadhi yao walitangatanga jangwani, hawakuona njia ya kuwafikisha mji ambao wangeweza kuishi.

english: He pours out contempt on the nobles and makes them wander in a trackless wasteland.
ekegusii: Omonene agachaaya abanene baria babachaandete, bakaba bakoong’anya ase chirooro chitari ne chinchera.
swahili: Yeye ambaye huwamwagia dharau wakuu, aliwafanya watangetange nyikani isiyo na njia.

english: But He lifts the needy from affliction and increases their families like flocks.
ekegusii: Korende ere nigo akorusia abaremeire korwa ase emechando, na obuchia chiamate chiabo chiaba buna amaicho.
swahili: Lakini yeye aliwainua wahitaji katika taabu zao, na kuongeza jamaa zao kama makundi ya kondoo.

english: The upright see and rejoice, and all iniquity shuts its mouth.
ekegusii: Abanyaboronge nigo bakorora amang’ana ayio na bagooka mono; korende abakori amabe nigo bagokira‐kiri baumata.
swahili: Wanyofu wataona na kufurahi, lakini waovu wote watafunga vinywa vyao.

english: Let him who is wise pay heed to these things and consider the loving devotion of the LORD.
ekegusii: Omonto onde bwensi ore omong’aini, tiga aigwe amang’ana aya, tiga arengererie mono amanye obwanchani bw’Omonene bogendererete botambe.
swahili: Yeyote aliye na hekima, ayasikie mambo haya, na atafakari upendo mkuu wa Bwana.

english: They were hungry and thirsty; their soul fainted within them.
ekegusii: Nigo babete n’enchara amo n’erang’o goika bakerusia moyo.
swahili: Walikuwa na njaa na kiu, nafsi zao zikadhoofika.

english: Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, and He delivered them from their distress.
ekegusii: Erio bakarera ase Omonene ase engencho y’emechando yaabo, ere akabatooria korwa ase obokong’u bwabo.
swahili: Ndipo walipomlilia Bwana katika shida yao, naye akawaokoa kutoka taabu yao.

english: He led them on a straight path to reach a city where they could live.
ekegusii: Akabaraa ase enchera endonge, goika akabaikia ase omochie banyaarete komenya.
swahili: Akawaongoza kwa njia iliyo sawa hadi mji ambao wangeweza kuishi.

english: Let them give thanks to the LORD for His loving devotion and His wonders to the sons of men.
ekegusii: Tiga abanto baakere Omonene ng’a mbuya mono ase engencho y’obwanchani bwaye bwa botambe na ase emeremo y’ogokumia akobakorera Mwanyabaanto.
swahili: Basi na wamshukuru Bwana kwa upendo wake usiokoma, na kwa matendo yake ya ajabu kwa wanadamu,

english: For He satisfies the thirsty and fills the hungry with good things.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoisanekia oyore n’erang’o, na oyore n’enchara omoigotia n’ebinto ebiya.
swahili: kwa maana yeye humtosheleza mwenye kiu, na kumshibisha mwenye njaa kwa vitu vyema.

english: My heart is steadfast, O God; I will sing and make music with all my being.
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, enkoro yane nigo ere n’oboremu! Nintere na gochenga! Omoyo one bwonsi, boka!
swahili: Ee Mungu, moyo wangu ni thabiti; nitaimba na kusifu kwa moyo wangu wote.

english: Who will bring me to the fortified city? Who will lead me to Edom?
ekegusii: Ning’o orandaae ansoyie ase omochie ogiteire chindwaki? Ning’o orantang’ane gochia Edomu?
swahili: Ni nani atakayenipeleka hadi mji wenye ngome? Ni nani atakayeniongoza hadi nifike Edomu?

english: Have You not rejected us, O God? Will You no longer march out, O God, with our armies?
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, Inee, ngwatotigire kegima? Aye tori kogeenda amo nabarwani baito b’esegi.
swahili: Ee Mungu, si ni wewe uliyetukataa sisi, na hutoki tena na majeshi yetu?

english: Give us aid against the enemy, for the help of man is worthless.
ekegusii: Tokoonye, torwanie ababisa baito tobabue, ekiagera ogokoonywa gokorwa ase Mwanyabaanto mbosa.
swahili: Tuletee msaada dhidi ya adui, kwa maana msaada wa mwanadamu haufai kitu.

english: With God we will perform with valor, and He will trample our enemies.
ekegusii: Ekero tore amo na Nyasae, ’natokore amang’ana amanene, nere orabue ababisa baito na kobatiringera inse.
swahili: Kwa msaada wa Mungu tutapata ushindi, naye atawaponda adui zetu.

english: Awake, O harp and lyre! I will awaken the dawn.
ekegusii: Inwe amakano aane onsi, boka! Nainche nimboke mambia chuni.
swahili: Amka, kinubi na zeze! Nitayaamsha mapambazuko.

english: I will praise You, O LORD, among the nations; I will sing Your praises among the peoples.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ninkoiranerie ng’a mbuya mono ase egati y’ abanto, nimbe ’ngotera amatera y’okogotogia ase egati y’ebisaku.
swahili: Nitakusifu wewe, Ee Bwana, katikati ya mataifa; nitaimba habari zako, katikati ya jamaa za watu.

english: For Your loving devotion extends beyond the heavens, and Your faithfulness reaches to the clouds.
ekegusii: Amaabera ao nigo are amanene aigete aaria igoro, obwegenwa bwao nigo boigete igoro ase amare.
swahili: Kwa maana upendo wako ni mkuu, ni juu kuliko mbingu; uaminifu wako unazifikia anga.

english: Be exalted, O God, above the heavens; may Your glory cover all the earth.
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, oorokie ng’a nigo ore omonene goetania igoro chionsi. Tiga obonene bwao bororekane ase ense yonsi.
swahili: Ee Mungu, utukuzwe juu ya mbingu, utukufu wako na uenee duniani kote.

english: Respond and save us with Your right hand, that Your beloved may be delivered.
ekegusii: Intoorie n’okoboko kwao gw’okorio na oigwe aya ’nkogosaba.
swahili: Tuokoe na utusaidie kwa mkono wako wa kuume, ili wale uwapendao wapate kuokolewa.

english: God has spoken from His sanctuary: “I will triumph! I will parcel out Shechem and apportion the Valley of Succoth.
ekegusii: Nyasae orire eira korwa ase obomenyo bwaye obochenu, ogoteeba, “Ase omochengo ninyatanane Sekemu, na ense omweya ya Sukoti ni’nyiate chincherere.
swahili: Mungu amenena kutoka patakatifu pake: “Nitaigawa Shekemu kwa ushindi na kulipima Bonde la Sukothi.

english: Gilead is Mine, and Manasseh is Mine; Ephraim is My helmet, Judah is My scepter.
ekegusii: Gileadi neyaane, na Manase neyaane; Efraimu nekegogwa kiane gi’ekioma, na Yuda nenyimbo yane y’obogaambi.
swahili: Gileadi ni yangu, Manase ni yangu, Efraimu ni kofia yangu ya chuma, nayo Yuda ni fimbo yangu ya utawala.

english: Moab is My washbasin; upon Edom I toss My sandal; over Philistia I shout in triumph.”
ekegusii: Moabu negetaabo kiane ngoisabera, nindute egekooroto kiane igoro ase Edomu, ning’ake eriogi ri’okobua igoro y’ense y’Abafilisti.”
swahili: Moabu ni sinia langu la kunawia, juu ya Edomu natupa kiatu changu; nashangilia kwa kushindwa kwa Ufilisti.”

english: O God of my praise, be not silent.
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae ningotogie, tobaisa gokira‐kiri.
swahili: Ee Mungu, ambaye ninakusifu, usiwe kimya,

english: May his children wander as beggars, seeking sustenance far from their ruined homes.
ekegusii: Abana baye babe bakoombogana na kona‐gosaberera, bageende kona‐korigia endagera aare korwa ase amatuuri bamenyete.
swahili: Watoto wake na watangetange wakiomba, na wafukuzwe kwenye magofu ya nyumba zao.

english: May the creditor seize all he owns, and strangers plunder the fruits of his labor.
ekegusii: Tiga abamoete ebinto singo bache baire ebinto biaye bionsi; abanto abaao bache basakore ebi bakorerete emeremo emekong’u.
swahili: Mtu anayemdai na ateke vyote alivyo navyo, matunda ya kazi yake yatekwe nyara na wageni.

english: May there be no one to extend kindness to him, and no one to favor his fatherless children.
ekegusii: Monto onde tabaisa koba omuya asare, gose onde taba n’amaabera ase abana baye bare chintakana.
swahili: Asiwepo mtu yeyote wa kumtendea mema wala wa kuwahurumia yatima wake.

english: May his descendants be cut off; may their name be blotted out from the next generation.
ekegusii: Tiga ororeeria rwaye rosirigwe, na erieta riaye riebwe kegima ase ekiare gia kabere.
swahili: Uzao wake na ukatiliwe mbali, majina yao yafutike katika kizazi kifuatacho.

english: May the iniquity of his fathers be remembered before the LORD, and the sin of his mother never be blotted out.
ekegusii: Ebibe bie chisokoro chiaye biinyorwe ase obosio bw’Omonene, na ebibe bia ng’ina tibibaisa gotinyigwa.
swahili: Maovu ya baba zake na yakumbukwe mbele za Bwana, dhambi ya mama yake isifutwe kamwe.

english: May their sins always remain before the LORD, that He may cut off their memory from the earth.
ekegusii: Ebibe biabo tiga bigenderere kobeera ase obosio Omonene botambe; na barabwo tibaabaisa koinyorwa ase ense nonya ng’ake.
swahili: Dhambi zao na zibaki daima mbele za Bwana, ili apate kukatilia mbali kumbukumbu lao duniani.

english: For he never thought to show kindness, but pursued the poor and needy and brokenhearted, even to their death.
ekegusii: Omonto oyio tainyorete koorokia amaabera, korende abataka, na abaremerwa, na abasionoire chinkoro chiabo, nigo abachaandete goika ogokwa kwabo.
swahili: Kwa maana kamwe hakuweza kutenda wema, bali alimfukuza mnyonge na mhitaji, aliwafanyia jeuri wahitaji na waliovunjika moyo.

english: The cursing that he loved, may it fall on him; the blessing in which he refused to delight, may it be far from him.
ekegusii: Ere nigo anchete koragereria, bono tiga okoragereria okwo komoiranere. Ere tanchete gosesenia, ase ayio ogosesenigwa kobe aare asare.
swahili: Alipenda kulaani, nayo laana ikampata; hakupenda kubariki, kwa hiyo baraka na ikae mbali naye.

english: The cursing that he wore like a coat, may it soak into his body like water, and into his bones like oil.
ekegusii: Nigo ambarete okoragererigwa buna akwambara egoti yaye; bono tiga konywere ase omobere oye buna amaache akonywera ase omobere, na buna amaguta akweakwa akonywera aika ase amauga aye.
swahili: Alivaa kulaani kama vazi lake, nayo laana ikamwingia mwilini mwake kama maji, kwenye mifupa yake kama mafuta.

english: May it be like a robe wrapped about him, like a belt tied forever around him.
ekegusii: Tiga okoragererigwa okwo kobe buna egetambaa akwambara, naende kobe buna orokini akweboeria botambe.
swahili: Na iwe kama joho alilozungushiwa, kama mshipi aliofungiwa daima.

english: For wicked and deceitful mouths open against me; they speak against me with lying tongues.
ekegusii: Abakori amabe abare abang’ainereria nigo bagokwana igoro yane, ee, nigo bagokwana oborimo igoro yane.
swahili: kwa maana watu waovu na wadanganyifu wamefungua vinywa vyao dhidi yangu; wasema dhidi yangu kwa ndimi za udanganyifu.

english: May this be the LORD’s reward to my accusers, to those who speak evil against me.
ekegusii: Tiga Omonene abaakane igo abwo bagonsoera, abwo bagokwana bobe igoro y’obogima bwane.
swahili: Haya na yawe malipo ya Bwana kwa washtaki wangu, kwa wale wanaoninenea mabaya.

english: But You, O GOD, the Lord, deal kindly with me for the sake of Your name; deliver me by the goodness of Your loving devotion.
ekegusii: Korende aye Nyasae, Omonene one, ondwanerere ase engencho y’erieta riao, intoorie, ekiagera obwanchani bwao bwa botambe nigo bore obuya.
swahili: Lakini wewe, Ee Bwana Mwenyezi, unitendee wema kwa ajili ya jina lako, uniokoe kwa wema wa pendo lako.

english: For I am poor and needy; my heart is wounded within me.
ekegusii: Inche nigo ’nde omotaka oremeire mono, na nigo ’nde n’obororo ase enkoro yane ime.
swahili: Maana mimi ni maskini na mhitaji, moyo wangu umejeruhiwa ndani yangu.

english: I am fading away like a lengthening shadow; I am shaken off like a locust.
ekegusii: Nigo ’ngoeta buna omorengari o mogoroba, nigo nkoirurukigwa buna chingige.
swahili: Ninafifia kama kivuli cha jioni, nimerushwa-rushwa kama nzige.

english: My knees are weak from fasting, and my body grows lean and gaunt.
ekegusii: Amaru aborirwe chinguru ase engencho y’okweng’ata, na omobere one oreeire mono.
swahili: Magoti yangu yamelegea kwa kufunga, mwili wangu umedhoofika na kukonda.

english: I am an object of scorn to my accusers; when they see me, they shake their heads.
ekegusii: Nabeire omonto ogosekererwa nabansoeri; ekero bakondora, nigo bagonchaaya basingisia emetwe yaabo.
swahili: Nimekuwa kitu cha kudharauliwa kwa washtaki wangu, wanionapo, hutikisa vichwa vyao.

english: Help me, O LORD my God; save me according to Your loving devotion.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, Nyasae one, inkonye! Intoorie, ekiagera aye nigo obwate amaabera amange!
swahili: Ee Bwana, Mungu wangu nisaidie, niokoe sawasawa na upendo wako.

english: Let them know that this is Your hand, that You, O LORD, have done it.
ekegusii: Tiga abansoeri abwo bamanye ng’a aya nigo arure ase okoboko kwao. Aye Omonene, naye gwakorire aya.
swahili: Watu na wafahamu kuwa ni mkono wako, kwamba wewe, Ee Bwana, umetenda hili.

english: Though they curse, You will bless. When they rise up, they will be put to shame, but Your servant will rejoice.
ekegusii: Barabwo tiga bandagererie, korende aye onsesenie. Tiga abwo bagonkorera bobe barore obosooku, korende inche, omosomba oo, nimbe n’omogooko.
swahili: Wanaweza kulaani, lakini wewe utabariki, watakaposhambulia wataaibishwa, lakini mtumishi wako atashangilia.

english: May my accusers be clothed with disgrace; may they wear their shame like a robe.
ekegusii: Tiga abansoeri baboigwe ogochaaywa, tiga obosooku obwo bobatube buna egetambaa gi’okwambara.
swahili: Washtaki wangu watavikwa fedheha, na kufunikwa na aibu kama joho.

english: They surround me with hateful words and attack me without cause.
ekegusii: Bang’etananire bagokwana amang’ana y’obobisa, nigo bakondwania ’ntari na komocha konde.
swahili: Wamenizunguka kwa maneno ya chuki, wananishambulia bila sababu.

english: With my mouth I will thank the LORD profusely; I will praise Him in the presence of many.
ekegusii: Ning’iranerie Omonene ng’a mbuya mono kegima n’omonwa one, nimbe nkona‐komotogia ase egati y’ abanto abange.
swahili: Kwa kinywa changu nitamtukuza sana Bwana, katika umati mkubwa nitamsifu.

english: For He stands at the right hand of the needy one, to save him from the condemners of his soul.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo ateneine ensemo y’okoboko gw’okorio kw’omotaka, ase okomotooria korwa ase abwo bakomonachera ekiina ki’ogokwa.
swahili: Kwa maana husimama mkono wa kuume wa mhitaji, kuokoa maisha yake kutoka kwa wale wanaomhukumu.

english: In return for my love they accuse me, but I am a man of prayer.
ekegusii: Nonya inche ’mbanchete, barabwo nigo bangeechete, ee, nonya ngendererete kobasabera ebisio.
swahili: Wanachonilipa badala ya urafiki wangu ni kunishtaki, lakini mimi ninawaombea.

english: They repay me evil for good, and hatred for my love.
ekegusii: Nigo bakong’akana amabe ase amaya aane na okogeecha ase obwanchani bwane.
swahili: Wananilipiza mabaya kwa mema, chuki badala ya urafiki wangu.

english: Set over him a wicked man; let an accuser stand at his right hand.
ekegusii: Chora omonto omobe amogambere omobisa one, na tiga oria omosoeri atenene ase okoboko kwaye gw’okorio amosoere.
swahili: Agiza mtu mwovu ampinge, mshtaki asimame mkono wake wa kuume.

english: When he is tried, let him be found guilty, and may his prayer be regarded as sin.
ekegusii: Ekero agambiigwe ekiina, tiga abarerwe okomocha, nonya n’ogosaba kwaye kobarwe ng’a nebibe.
swahili: Anapohukumiwa, apatikane na hatia, nayo maombi yake yamhukumu.

english: May his days be few; may another take his position.
ekegusii: Amatuko aye tiga abe amake, na oboteneneri bwaye omoao aboire.
swahili: Siku zake za kuishi na ziwe chache, nafasi yake ya uongozi ichukuliwe na mtu mwingine.

english: May his children be fatherless and his wife a widow.
ekegusii: Tiga abana baye batigwe bare chintakana, na omokungu oye atigwe ore omoboraka.
swahili: Watoto wake na waachwe yatima, mke wake na awe mjane.

english: Why, O LORD, do You stand far off? Why do You hide in times of trouble?
ekegusii: Omonene, naki gwateneneire aare iga? Naki okwebisa, otari kororekana chingaki chi’emechando?
swahili: Kwa nini, Ee Bwana, unasimama mbali? Kwa nini unajificha wakati wa shida?

english: They are crushed and beaten down; the hapless fall prey to his strength.
ekegusii: Abaremerwa nigo bagosegenyigwa na koiyerigwa, barutwa endiba ime, abanto batari na gokonywa konde, obasiria n’echinguru chiaye.
swahili: Mateka wake hupondwa, huzimia; wanaanguka katika nguvu zake.

english: He says to himself, “God has forgotten; He hides His face and never sees.”
ekegusii: Igo ase enkoro yaye ime orengereria iga: “Nyasae tagwechandera kende, obisire obosio bwaye tayarora nonya ng’ake.”
swahili: Anajisemea mwenyewe, “Mungu amesahau, huficha uso wake na haoni kabisa.”

english: Arise, O LORD! Lift up Your hand, O God! Do not forget the helpless.
ekegusii: Omonene, gaki ’nchuo! Aye Nyasae, rambora okoboko kwao, gaki tibweba bachandegete!
swahili: Inuka Bwana! Inua mkono wako, Ee Mungu. Usiwasahau wanyonge.

english: Why has the wicked man renounced God? He says to himself, “You will never call me to account.”
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, nase ki omonto omokori amabe akogochecheria, na gokaga ng’a aye tokomoa egesusuro?
swahili: Kwa nini mtu mwovu anamtukana Mungu? Kwa nini anajiambia mwenyewe, “Hataniita nitoe hesabu?”

english: But You have regarded trouble and grief; You see to repay it by Your hand. The victim entrusts himself to You; You are the helper of the fatherless.
ekegusii: Aye nigo okorora abachandeku na komanya okwerera kwabo, amang’ana ayio nigo oyabegete ase amaboko ao. Omonto otari na gokonywa konde nigo akwerua asore, ekiagera naye botambe ogokonya chintakana.
swahili: Lakini wewe, Ee Mungu, unaona shida na huzuni, umekubali kuyapokea mkononi mwako. Mhanga anajisalimisha kwako, wewe ni msaada wa yatima.

english: Break the arm of the wicked and evildoer; call him to account for his wickedness until none is left to be found.
ekegusii: Saria chinguru chi’abakori amabe na abanyabibe, obae egesusuro ase amabe onsi bagokora goika toyarora naende.
swahili: Vunja mkono wa mtu mwovu na mbaya, mwite atoe hesabu ya maovu yake ambayo yasingejulikana.

english: The LORD is King forever and ever; the nations perish from His land.
ekegusii: Omonene n’Omorwoti o kare na kare; abanto b’Ebisaku batamomanyeti basirigwe ase ense yaye.
swahili: Bwana ni Mfalme milele na milele, mataifa wataangamia watoke nchini mwake.

english: You have heard, O LORD, the desire of the humble; You will strengthen their hearts. You will incline Your ear,
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, nigo ogotegerera abanto abaitongo abakoganetie; nigo okobaigwa na kobeka chinkoro chiabo chinguru.
swahili: Unasikia, Ee Bwana, shauku ya wanaoonewa, wewe huwatia moyo, na kusikiliza kilio chao,

english: to vindicate the fatherless and oppressed, that the men of the earth may strike terror no more.
ekegusii: Igo okoa chintakana na abachandeku oboronge bwabo, erinde monto onde bw’ense tabachanda naende.
swahili: ukiwatetea yatima na walioonewa, ili mwanadamu, ambaye ni udongo, asiogopeshe tena.

english: In pride the wicked pursue the needy; let them be caught in the schemes they devise.
ekegusii: Abakori amabe baenenire na gokorera abaremerwa bobe. Tiga babwatwe barabwo abanyene ase emeroberio yabo y’obobe.
swahili: Katika kiburi chake, mwovu humtesa maskini, waovu na wanaswe katika hila wanazozitunga.

english: For the wicked man boasts in the cravings of his heart; he blesses the greedy and reviles the LORD.
ekegusii: Omonto omokori ebibe nigo agwetogeria okogania okobe gw’enkoro yaye; na omonto ore ne ribero nigo akoragereri’Omonene ase okomochecheria.
swahili: Hujivunia tamaa za moyo wake; humbariki mlafi na kumtukana Bwana.

english: In his pride the wicked man does not seek Him; in all his schemes there is no God.
ekegusii: Omokori amabe ase oboenenu bwaye nigo agoteeba ng’a Nyasae takomoa egesusuro. Ase ebirengerio biaye ime nigo agokaga ng’a Nyasae tari.
swahili: Katika kiburi chake, mwovu hamtafuti Mungu, katika mawazo yake yote hakuna nafasi ya Mungu.

english: He is secure in his ways at all times; Your lofty judgments are far from him; he sneers at all his foes.
ekegusii: Omonto oyio nigo akogenderera gokiina ase chinchera chiaye. Ebina biao okonacha nigo bire igoro mono, takobimanya; nigo agochaaya ababisa baye bonsi.
swahili: Njia zake daima hufanikiwa; hujivuna na amri zako ziko mbali naye, huwacheka kwa dharau adui zake wote.

english: He says to himself, “I will not be moved; from age to age I am free of distress.”
ekegusii: Omonto oyio ase enkoro yaye ime oteeba iga: “Tinkwoboa gento kende, tinkonyorwa na bobe bonde nonya ng’ake.”
swahili: Anajisemea mwenyewe, “Hakuna kitakachonitikisa, daima nitakuwa na furaha, kamwe sitakuwa na shida.”

english: His mouth is full of cursing, deceit, and violence; trouble and malice are under his tongue.
ekegusii: Aya agokwana nigo aichire okoragereria, na obong’ainereria, na ogokorera abande bobe; oromeme rwaye nigo robwate amang’ana obobe n’ogosaria.
swahili: Kinywa chake kimejaa laana, uongo na vitisho; shida na ubaya viko chini ya ulimi wake.

english: He lies in wait near the villages; in ambush he slays the innocent; his eyes watch in stealth for the helpless.
ekegusii: Nigo akwebisa ase emechie oboera abanto, oganya agwo ase ogoita abanto batari na komocha. Nigo agotengera konyora abanto batari na gokonywa konde,
swahili: Huvizia karibu na vijiji; kutoka mafichoni huwanasa wasio na hatia, akivizia wapitaji.

english: He lies in wait like a lion in a thicket; he lurks to seize the oppressed; he catches the lowly in his net.
ekegusii: bw’ebisa aase are bobisi, buna endo ere ase egetutu eboerete, oganya ase okobwata abaremerwa; obabwata ekero akobakurura ase omoeto oye.
swahili: Huvizia kama simba aliye mawindoni; huvizia kumkamata mnyonge, huwakamata wanyonge na kuwaburuza katika wavu wake.

english: The LORD said to my Lord: “Sit at My right hand until I make Your enemies a footstool for Your feet.”
ekegusii: Omonene agateebia Nyasae Omonene one, “Ikaransa ensemo y’okoboko kwane gw’okorio goika mbeeke ababisa bao babe inse y’amagoro ao.”
swahili: Bwana amwambia Bwana wangu: “Keti mkono wangu wa kuume, mpaka nitakapowafanya adui zako kuwa mahali pa kuweka miguu yako.”

english: The LORD extends Your mighty scepter from Zion: “Rule in the midst of Your enemies.”
ekegusii: Korwa Sayoni Omonene narambore enyimbo yao y’obogaambi ere n’okobua, ateebe, “Gamba ase egati y’ababisa bao.”
swahili: Bwana ataeneza fimbo yako ya utawala yenye nguvu kutoka Sayuni; utatawala katikati ya adui zako.

english: Your people shall be willing on Your day of battle. Arrayed in holy splendor, from the womb of the dawn, to You belongs the dew of Your youth.
ekegusii: Abanto bao mberue n’ogwancha kwabo, ekero orasangererie abarwani bao b’esegi. Abamura bao mbaache asore beboetie oboseera obochenu, buna riime ria mambia.
swahili: Askari wako watajitolea kwa hiari katika siku yako ya vita. Ukiwa umevikwa fahari takatifu, kutoka tumbo la mapambazuko utapokea umande wa ujana wako.

english: The LORD has sworn and will not change His mind: “You are a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.”
ekegusii: Omonene otianire, takoonchora ebirengererio biaye: “Aye nigo ore Omokuani goika kare na kare, koreng’ana buna Melkizedeki.”
swahili: Bwana ameapa, naye hatabadilisha mawazo yake: “Wewe ni kuhani milele, kwa mfano wa Melkizedeki.”

english: The Lord is at Your right hand; He will crush kings in the day of His wrath.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo ateneine ase ensemo y’okoboko kwao gw’okorio; ere nasenyente abarwoti ase rituko ri’endamwamu yaye.
swahili: Bwana yuko mkono wako wa kuume, atawaponda wafalme siku ya ghadhabu yake.

english: He will judge the nations, heaping up the dead; He will crush the leaders far and wide.
ekegusii: Nanachere abanto b’ebisaku ekiina, ense neichore n’ebitondo; nasenyente emetwe y’abagaambi b’ense engima.
swahili: Atawahukumu mataifa, akilundika mizoga na kuwaponda watawala wa dunia nzima.

english: He will drink from the brook by the road; therefore He will lift up His head.
ekegusii: Nabe okonywa amaache y’ensoko ekero are ase orogeendo rwaye, ase ayio naimokererie omotwe oye igoro kabuire.
swahili: Atakunywa maji katika kijito kando ya njia, kwa hiyo atainua kichwa chake juu.

english: Hallelujah! I will give thanks to the LORD with all my heart in the council of the upright and in the assembly.
ekegusii: Togia Omonene! Ning’ake ng’a mbuya mono ase Omonene n’enkoro yane yonsi, agwo ase omosangererekano bw’ abanto bare ne chinkoro chindonge.
swahili: Msifuni Bwana. Nitamtukuza Bwana kwa moyo wangu wote, katika baraza la wanyofu na katika kusanyiko.

english: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom; all who follow His precepts gain rich understanding. His praise endures forever!
ekegusii: Okomoiroka Omonene, oyio noro omochakano bw’obong’aini, bonsi abagokora ayio nigo bare nokomanya okuya. Ogotogigwa kwaye nogwa kare na kare.
swahili: Kumcha Bwana ndicho chanzo cha hekima, wote wanaozifuata amri zake wana busara. Sifa zake zadumu milele.

english: Great are the works of the LORD; they are pondered by all who delight in them.
ekegusii: Ogokora kw’Omonene nigo kore okonene, Abwo bagokogookera nigo bagokweorokereria erinde bakomanye.
swahili: Kazi za Bwana ni kuu, wote wanaopendezwa nazo huzitafakari.

english: Splendid and majestic is His work; His righteousness endures forever.
ekegusii: Ogokora kw’Omonene nigo kore okw’ogosikwa okonene na obonene, na oboronge bwaye nigo bogendererete kobao goika kare na kare.
swahili: Kazi zake zimejaa fahari na utukufu, haki yake hudumu daima.

english: He has caused His wonders to be remembered; the LORD is gracious and compassionate.
ekegusii: Omonene okorire ogokora kwaye kw’ogokumia kobe gokoinyorwa, ere nigo are n’obuya na amaabera.
swahili: Amefanya maajabu yake yakumbukwe, Bwana ni mwenye neema na huruma.

english: He provides food for those who fear Him; He remembers His covenant forever.
ekegusii: Nigo akoa abanto abwo bamoirogete endagera; nabe ogendererete koinyora okobwatana kwaye kw’ogotianania goika kare na kare.
swahili: Huwapa chakula wale wanaomcha, hulikumbuka agano lake milele.

english: He has shown His people the power of His works by giving them the inheritance of the nations.
ekegusii: Oorokeirie abanto baye okobua kw’ogokora kwaye ase okobaa emiando y’ abanto b’ebisaku.
swahili: Amewaonyesha watu wake uwezo wa kazi zake, akiwapa nchi za mataifa mengine.

english: The works of His hands are truth and justice; all His precepts are trustworthy.
ekegusii: Ogokora kw’amaboko aye nigo kore okw’obwegenwa na okw’oboronge, n’amachiiko aye onsi nay’obwegenwa.
swahili: Kazi za mikono yake ni za uaminifu na haki, mausia yake yote ni ya kuaminika.

english: They are upheld forever and ever, enacted in truth and uprightness.
ekegusii: Amachiiko ayio nigo ateneine bokong’u kare na kare, aikeranigwe ase ekeene na oboronge.
swahili: Zinadumu milele na milele, zikifanyika kwa uaminifu na unyofu.

english: He has sent redemption to His people; He has ordained His covenant forever; holy and awesome is His name.
ekegusii: Ere otomeire abanto baye okoboorigwa, na ochiikire okobwatana kwaye kw’ogotianania kobeo goika kare na kare. Erieta riaye nigo rire richenu na eri’okoirokwa.
swahili: Aliwapa watu wake ukombozi, aliamuru agano lake milele: jina lake ni takatifu na la kuogopwa.

english: Hallelujah! Blessed is the man who fears the LORD, who greatly delights in His commandments.
ekegusii: Togia Omonene! Nasesenirie omonto oyio omoirogete Omonene, na ogokirie mono koigwera amachiiko aye.
swahili: Msifuni Bwana. Heri mtu yule amchaye Bwana, mtu yule apendezwaye sana na amri zake.

english: The wicked man will see and be grieved; he will gnash his teeth and waste away; the desires of the wicked will perish.
ekegusii: Ekero omonto omonyabibe akorora ayio, nigo agoichana ogeechigwa, oriania amaino aye, orea osira. Okogania kw’omonyabibe nigo kogosira.
swahili: Mtu mwovu ataona na kuchukizwa, atasaga meno yake na kutoweka, kutamani kwa mtu mwovu kutaishia patupu.

english: His descendants will be mighty in the land; the generation of the upright will be blessed.
ekegusii: Oroiboro rwaye ’ndobe n’okobua ase ense; ekiaare ki’abare ne chinkoro chindonge ’ngesesenigwe.
swahili: Watoto wake watakuwa wenye uwezo katika nchi, kizazi cha watu waadilifu kitabarikiwa.

english: Wealth and riches are in his house, and his righteousness endures forever.
ekegusii: Obotenenku na obonda ’mbibe ase enyomba yaye, na oboronge bwaye ’mbogenderere kobao botambe.
swahili: Nyumbani mwake kuna mali na utajiri, haki yake hudumu milele.

english: Light dawns in the darkness for the upright— for the gracious, compassionate, and righteous.
ekegusii: Buna koreng’ana omobaso okobara ase omosunte, Omonene nabo ogochera abanyaboronge, ore nobuya, n’amaabera, na oboronge.
swahili: Hata gizani nuru humzukia mtu mwadilifu, yule mwenye rehema, huruma na haki.

english: It is well with the man who is generous and lends freely, whose affairs are guided by justice.
ekegusii: Nasesenirie omonto ore n’amaabera na okorua ebinto singo, boigo ogokora amang’ana aye onsi ase oboronge.
swahili: Mema yatamjia mtu yule aliye mkarimu na mwenye kukopesha bila riba, anayefanya mambo yake kwa haki.

english: Surely he will never be shaken; the righteous man will be remembered forever.
ekegusii: Omonyaboronge takonyegerigwa nonya ng’ake, nabe okoinyorwa kare na kare.
swahili: Hakika hatatikisika kamwe, mtu mwenye haki atakumbukwa milele.

english: He does not fear bad news; his heart is steadfast, trusting in the LORD.
ekegusii: Ere takwoboa kagotebigwa amang’ana amabe, enkoro yaye nigo ere endemu esemeretie Omonene.
swahili: Hataogopa habari mbaya, moyo wake ni thabiti, ukimtegemea Bwana.

english: His heart is assured; he does not fear, until he looks in triumph on his foes.
ekegusii: Enkoro yaye teri koirianyeka gose kwoboa, ere nigo akoremereria goika abachaandi baye babugwe.
swahili: Moyo wake ni salama, hatakuwa na hofu, mwishoni ataona ushindi dhidi ya adui zake.

english: He has scattered abroad his gifts to the poor; his righteousness endures forever; his horn will be lifted high in honor.
ekegusii: Ere nigo akoa abataka ebiegwa ore n’omoyo omorabu; oboronge bwaye ’mbogenderere kobao kare na kare; orogunchara rwaye ’ndokiine ase ogosikwa.
swahili: Ametawanya vipawa vyake kwa ukarimu akawapa maskini; haki yake hudumu milele; pembe yake itatukuzwa kwa heshima.

english: Hallelujah! Give praise, O servants of the LORD; praise the name of the LORD.
ekegusii: Motogie Omonene! Inwe abasomba b’Omonene, motogie, ee, ritogie erieta riaye!
swahili: Msifuni Bwana. Enyi watumishi wa Bwana msifuni, lisifuni jina la Bwana.

english: Blessed be the name of the LORD both now and forevermore.
ekegusii: Erieta ri’Omonene ritogigwe korwa bono goika kare na kare!
swahili: Jina la Bwana na lisifiwe, sasa na hata milele.

english: From where the sun rises to where it sets, the name of the LORD is praised.
ekegusii: Erieta ri’Omonene ribe rigotogigwa korwa ekero risase rikooroka goika ekero rikorimera!
swahili: Kuanzia mawio ya jua hadi machweo yake, jina la Bwana linapaswa kusifiwa.

english: The LORD is exalted over all the nations, His glory above the heavens.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo are omonene igoro ase ebisaku bionsi, na obonene bwaye nigo boetanaine igoro chionsi.
swahili: Bwana ametukuka juu ya mataifa yote, utukufu wake juu ya mbingu.

english: Who is like the LORD our God, the One enthroned on high?
ekegusii: Ning’o onga buna Omonene, Nyasae oito, oria omenyete aaria igoro mono,
swahili: Ni nani aliye kama Bwana Mungu wetu, Yeye ambaye ameketi juu kwenye kiti cha enzi,

english: He humbles Himself to behold the heavens and the earth.
ekegusii: na origereretie goocha inse aa arore igoro na ense.
swahili: ambaye huinama atazame chini aone mbingu na nchi?

english: He raises the poor from the dust and lifts the needy from the dump
ekegusii: Nigo akoimokia omotaka korwa ase obotaka obwere, na koimokia omoremerwa korwa ase ribu,
swahili: Huwainua maskini kutoka mavumbini, na kuwanyanyua wahitaji kutoka kwenye jalala,

english: to seat them with nobles, with the princes of His people.
ekegusii: obabeeka baikaransa amo n’abwo bare n’okobua, baria bakogambera abanto baye.
swahili: huwaketisha pamoja na wakuu, pamoja na wakuu wa watu wake.

english: He settles the barren woman in her home as a joyful mother to her children. Hallelujah!
ekegusii: Nigo akoa omokungu omogomba chinguru chi’okoibora, oba n’omogooko ase obomenyo bwaye. Omonene atogigwe!
swahili: Humjalia mwanamke tasa kutulia nyumbani mwake, akiwa mama watoto mwenye furaha. Msifuni Bwana.

english: When Israel departed from Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of foreign tongue,
ekegusii: Ekero Abaisraeli barwete Misiri, ee, ekero abanto ba Yakobo barwete ase abanto barenge konoga omonwa omoao,
swahili: Wakati Israeli walipotoka Misri, nyumba ya Yakobo kutoka kwa watu wa lugha ngeni,

english: Judah became God’s sanctuary, and Israel His dominion.
ekegusii: Abayuda bakaba aase aachenu a Omonene, na Abaisraeli bakaba ab’obogaambi bwaye.
swahili: Yuda alifanywa makao matakatifu ya Mungu, Israeli akawa milki yake.

english: The sea observed and fled; the Jordan turned back;
ekegusii: Enyancha ekarora ayio egatama, na orooche rwa Yorodani rokanacheka, rokairana magega.
swahili: Bahari ilitazama ikakimbia, Yordani ulirudi nyuma,

english: the mountains skipped like rams, the hills like lambs.
ekegusii: Ebitunwa bigatuma-tuma buna chimingichi, na ebigoro buna chimanwa chi’eching’ondi.
swahili: milima ilirukaruka kama kondoo dume, vilima kama wana-kondoo.

english: Why was it, O sea, that you fled, O Jordan, that you turned back,
ekegusii: Aye enyancha, ninki kwarooche, erinde ogatama? Aye Yorodani, ninki kiabeete asore, erinde okanacheka okairana magega?
swahili: Ee bahari, ni nini kilichokufanya ukakimbia, nawe, ee Yordani, ukarudi nyuma,

english: O mountains, that you skipped like rams, O hills, like lambs?
ekegusii: Inwe ebitunwa, ninki kiagerete mogatuma‐tuma buna chimingichi, nainwe ebigoro boigo buna chimanwa chi’eching’ondi?
swahili: enyi milima mkarukaruka kama kondoo dume, enyi vilima, kama wana-kondoo?

english: Tremble, O earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob,
ekegusii: Aye ense, tengecha ase obosio Omonene, ee, ase obosio bwa Nyasae o Yakobo.
swahili: Ee dunia, tetemeka mbele za Bwana, mbele za Mungu wa Yakobo,

english: who turned the rock into a pool, the flint into a fountain of water!
ekegusii: Oyio oonchorete egetare gekaba ritibo ri’amaache, ne rigena riikong’u rikaba ensoko y’amaache.
swahili: aliyegeuza mwamba kuwa dimbwi la maji, mwamba mgumu kuwa chemchemi za maji.

english: Not to us, O LORD, not to us, but to Your name be the glory, because of Your loving devotion, because of Your faithfulness.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, intwe titobaisa gotogigwa, korende erieta riao rioka ritogigwe, ase engencho y’obwanchani bwao bwa botambe, nase obwegenwa bwao.
swahili: Sio kwetu sisi, Ee Bwana, sio kwetu sisi, bali utukufu ni kwa jina lako, kwa sababu ya upendo na uaminifu wako.

english: O house of Aaron, trust in the LORD! He is their help and shield.
ekegusii: Inwe ab’ororeeria rwa Aroni, mosemerie Omonene; ere nere Omokonyi oino na enguba yaino.
swahili: Ee nyumba ya Aroni, mtumainini Bwana, yeye ni msaada na ngao yao.

english: You who fear the LORD, trust in the LORD! He is their help and shield.
ekegusii: Inwe abamoirogete Omonene, mosemerie Omonene; ere nere Omokonyi oino na enguba yaino.
swahili: Ninyi mnaomcha, mtumainini Bwana, yeye ni msaada na ngao yao.

english: The LORD is mindful of us; He will bless us. He will bless the house of Israel; He will bless the house of Aaron;
ekegusii: Omonene obeire ogotoinyora, natosesenie; nasesenie Abaisraeli, nasesenie ab’ororeeria rwa Aroni.
swahili: Bwana anatukumbuka na atatubariki: ataibariki nyumba ya Israeli, ataibariki nyumba ya Aroni,

english: He will bless those who fear the LORD— small and great alike.
ekegusii: Ere nasesenie bonsi abamoirogete, abake na abanene.
swahili: atawabariki wale wanaomcha Bwana, wadogo kwa wakubwa.

english: May the LORD give you increase, both you and your children.
ekegusii: Tiga Omonene abamentekanie, inwe amo ne chinderia chiaino.
swahili: Bwana na awawezeshe kuongezeka, ninyi na watoto wenu.

english: May you be blessed by the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth.
ekegusii: Mosesenigwe n’Omonene, oria otongete igoro na ense.
swahili: Mbarikiwe na Bwana Muumba wa mbingu na dunia.

english: The highest heavens belong to the LORD, but the earth He has given to mankind.
ekegusii: Igoro yonsi na aase aye ere Omonene ore igoro, korende ense ero oyeire Mwanyabaanto.
swahili: Mbingu zilizo juu sana ni mali ya Bwana, lakini dunia amempa mwanadamu.

english: It is not the dead who praise the LORD, nor any who descend into silence.
ekegusii: Abakuure tibari gotogia Omonene, na ase abwo bagendire aase aakiriru onde tari okomotogia.
swahili: Sio wafu wanaomsifu Bwana, wale washukao mahali pa kimya,

english: But it is we who will bless the LORD, both now and forevermore. Hallelujah!
ekegusii: Korende intwe ntogenderere gotogia Omonene, korwa bono goika kare na kare. Motogie Omonene!
swahili: bali ni sisi tunaomtukuza Bwana, sasa na hata milele. Msifuni Bwana.

english: Why should the nations say, “Where is their God?”
ekegusii: Nase ki abanto b’ebisaku baraborie, “Nyasae oyio obo ng’ai are?”
swahili: Kwa nini mataifa waseme, “Yuko wapi Mungu wao?”

english: Our God is in heaven; He does as He pleases.
ekegusii: Nyasae oito niigoro are, naende nigo agokora rinde rionsi aganetie.
swahili: Mungu wetu yuko mbinguni, naye hufanya lolote limpendezalo.

english: Their idols are silver and gold, made by the hands of men.
ekegusii: Emegwekano abanto abwo bagosasiima nigo eroiseirie chifeta ne chitaabu, nigo ere emeremo y’amaboko a Mwanyabaanto.
swahili: Lakini sanamu zao ni za fedha na dhahabu, zilizotengenezwa kwa mikono ya wanadamu.

english: They have mouths, but cannot speak; they have eyes, but cannot see;
ekegusii: Nigo ebwate omonwa, korende teri gokwana, nebwate amaiso, korende teri korora.
swahili: Zina vinywa, lakini haziwezi kusema, zina macho, lakini haziwezi kuona;

english: they have ears, but cannot hear; they have noses, but cannot smell;
ekegusii: Nebwate amato, korende teri koigwa, nebwate emioro, korende teri konyonka eigwe rimisu.
swahili: zina masikio, lakini haziwezi kusikia, zina pua, lakini haziwezi kunusa;

english: they have hands, but cannot feel; they have feet, but cannot walk; they cannot even clear their throats.
ekegusii: Nebwate amaboko, korende teri kobwata gento, nebwate amagoro, korende teri gotaara; gose tebwati eriogi ri’ogokwana korwa ase emioyo yaabo.
swahili: zina mikono, lakini haziwezi kupapasa, zina miguu, lakini haziwezi kutembea; wala koo zao haziwezi kutoa sauti.

english: Those who make them become like them, as do all who trust in them.
ekegusii: Abakoroisia emegwekano eyio nabo barabe buna ero ere; na baria bayiegenete boigo.
swahili: Wale wanaozitengeneza watafanana nazo, vivyo hivyo wale wote wanaozitumainia.

english: O Israel, trust in the LORD! He is their help and shield.
ekegusii: Inwe Abaisraeli, mosemerie Omonene; ere nere Omokonyi oino na enguba yaino.
swahili: Ee nyumba ya Israeli, mtumainini Bwana, yeye ni msaada na ngao yao.

english: I love the LORD, for He has heard my voice— my appeal for mercy.
ekegusii: Nigo inyanchete Omonene, ekiagera ere oiguure eriogi riane na ogosaba kwane.
swahili: Ninampenda Bwana kwa maana amesikia sauti yangu; amesikia kilio changu ili anihurumie.

english: I believed, therefore I said, “I am greatly afflicted.”
ekegusii: Nigo negenete, na ase engencho eyio ’ngakwana, “Inche nigo ’nchaandegete mono”
swahili: Niliamini, kwa hiyo nilisema, “Mimi nimeteseka sana.”

english: In my alarm I said, “All men are liars!”
ekegusii: na ase okwegosa kwane ’ngateeba, “Kere omonto nomonyaborimo.”
swahili: Katika taabu yangu nilisema, “Wanadamu wote ni waongo.”

english: How can I repay the LORD for all His goodness to me?
ekegusii: Ngento ki ’ndarue ing’akane Omonene ase engencho y’amaya aya ankoreire?
swahili: Nimrudishie Bwana nini kwa wema wake wote alionitendea?

english: I will lift the cup of salvation and call on the name of the LORD.
ekegusii: Ninyimokie egekombe ki’ogotooreka, ’ndangerie ase erieta ri’Omonene.
swahili: Nitakiinua kikombe cha wokovu na kulitangaza jina la Bwana.

english: I will fulfill my vows to the LORD in the presence of all His people.
ekegusii: Ning’ikeranie chiira chiane ase Omonene agwo ase amasio y’ abanto baye bonsi.
swahili: Nitazitimiza nadhiri zangu kwa Bwana mbele za watu wake wote.

english: Precious in the sight of the LORD is the death of His saints.
ekegusii: Nigo ere engencho enene ase amaiso y’Omonene ekero abanto baye abachenu bagokwa.
swahili: Kifo cha watakatifu kina thamani machoni pa Bwana.

english: Truly, O LORD, I am Your servant; I am Your servant, the son of Your maidservant; You have broken my bonds.
ekegusii: Nagosoroire, Omonene, inche nigo ’nde omosomba oo; nigo ’nde omosomba oo, omwana bw’omokuungu ore omosomba oo. Aye gwachisiboire chingataare korwa ase amagoro ane.
swahili: Ee Bwana, hakika mimi ni mtumishi wako, mimi ni mtumishi wako, mwana wa mjakazi wako; umeniweka huru toka katika minyororo yangu.

english: I will offer to You a sacrifice of thanksgiving and call on the name of the LORD.
ekegusii: Ase ayio ninkoruere okoruegwa gw’ekeng’wanso ki’ogoaka ng’a mbuya mono, naende ’ndangerie erieta ri’Omonene.
swahili: Nitakutolea dhabihu ya kukushukuru na kuliita jina la Bwana.

english: I will fulfill my vows to the LORD in the presence of all His people,
ekegusii: Ning’ikeranie chiira chiane ase Omonene agwo ase amasio y’ abanto baye bonsi.
swahili: Nitazitimiza nadhiri zangu kwa Bwana mbele za watu wake wote,

english: in the courts of the LORD’s house, in your midst, O Jerusalem. Hallelujah!
ekegusii: Ime ase chigoora chi’enyomba y’Omonene gati‐gati yao aye Yerusalemu; Omonene atogigwe!
swahili: katika nyua za nyumba ya Bwana, katikati yako, ee Yerusalemu. Msifuni Bwana.

english: Because He has inclined His ear to me, I will call on Him as long as I live.
ekegusii: Ere ontegereire onyiguure, ase ayio, ekero ’nde moyo nimbe ’nkona‐komorangeria ng’a ankonye.
swahili: Kwa sababu amenitegea sikio lake, nitamwita siku zote za maisha yangu.

english: The ropes of death entangled me; the anguish of Sheol overcame me; I was confronted by trouble and sorrow.
ekegusii: Ebisibo bi’amakweri nigo biang’etananete; ekeondoko gi’aase abakuure gekambwata; nigo nabeete n’emechando na omoichano.
swahili: Kamba za mauti zilinizunguka, maumivu makuu ya kuzimu yalinipata, nikalemewa na taabu na huzuni.

english: Then I called on the name of the LORD: “O LORD, deliver my soul!”
ekegusii: Erio nkarangeria erieta ri’Omonene, ’ngasaba, “Aye Omonene, nagosoroire ontoorie omoyo one.”
swahili: Ndipo nikaliitia jina la Bwana: “Ee Bwana, niokoe!”

english: The LORD is gracious and righteous; our God is full of compassion.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo are nobuya na oboronge; Ere, Nyasae oito nigo are omonyamaabera.
swahili: Bwana ni mwenye neema na haki, Mungu wetu ni mwingi wa huruma.

english: The LORD preserves the simplehearted; I was helpless, and He saved me.
ekegusii: Ere nigo akorenda abanto abakanyeku; ekero nabeete ing’ichaanete, nigo antooretie.
swahili: Bwana huwalinda wanyenyekevu, nilipokuwa katika shida kubwa, aliniokoa.

english: Return to your rest, O my soul, for the LORD has been good to you.
ekegusii: Aye omoyo one, irana ase n’obotoereru bwao, ekiagera Omonene ogokoreire amaya amange.
swahili: Ee nafsi yangu, tulia tena, kwa kuwa Bwana amekuwa mwema kwako.

english: For You have delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, my feet from stumbling.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene kwarusirie omoyo one ase amakweri, gwatinyirie amariga korwa ase amaiso aane, kwarendire amagoro aane tindichaniwa ingwe.
swahili: Kwa kuwa wewe, Ee Bwana, umeniokoa nafsi yangu na mauti, macho yangu kutokana na machozi, miguu yangu kutokana na kujikwaa,

english: I will walk before the LORD in the land of the living.
ekegusii: Nimbe ’ngotaara ase obosio Omonene, ’nde ase ense y’ abanto bare moyo.
swahili: ili niweze kutembea mbele za Bwana, katika nchi ya walio hai.

english: Praise the LORD, all you nations! Extol Him, all you peoples!
ekegusii: Inwe abanto b’ebisaku bionsi, motogie Omonene! Inwe abanto bonsi, mobake!
swahili: Msifuni Bwana, enyi mataifa yote; mtukuzeni yeye, enyi watu wote.

english: For great is His loving devotion toward us, and the faithfulness of the LORD endures forever. Hallelujah!
ekegusii: Obwanchani bwaye bwa botambe nigo bore obonene ase tore, na obwegenwa bwaye nigo bogenderete goika kare na kare. Motogie Omonene!
swahili: Kwa kuwa upendo wake kwetu ni mkuu, uaminifu wa Bwana unadumu milele. Msifuni Bwana.

english: Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.
ekegusii: Moakere Omonene ng’a mbuya mono, ekiagera ere nomuya; obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.
swahili: Mshukuruni Bwana, kwa kuwa ni mwema; upendo wake wadumu milele.

english: All the nations surrounded me, but in the name of the LORD I cut them off.
ekegusii: Abanto b’ebisaku bionsi nigo bang’etananete kondwania, korende ase erieta ri’Omonene ’nkabasiria.
swahili: Mataifa yote yalinizunguka, lakini kwa jina la Bwana naliwakatilia mbali.

english: They surrounded me on every side, but in the name of the LORD I cut them off.
ekegusii: Nigo bamboerete korwa chinsinyo chionsi, korende ase erieta ri’Omonene nkabasiria.
swahili: Walinizunguka pande zote, lakini kwa jina la Bwana naliwakatilia mbali.

english: They swarmed around me like bees, but they were extinguished like burning thorns; in the name of the LORD I cut them off.
ekegusii: Nigo bang’umokerete buna chinchoke, korende bakarima buna omorero bw’amagwa; ase erieta ri’Omonene ’nkabasiria.
swahili: Walinizunguka kama kundi la nyuki, lakini walikufa haraka kama miiba iteketeayo; kwa jina la Bwana naliwakatilia mbali.

english: I was pushed so hard I was falling, but the LORD helped me.
ekegusii: Nigo natwometwe bokong’u ng’a ingwe, korende Omonene agankonya.
swahili: Nilisukumwa nyuma karibu kuanguka, lakini Bwana alinisaidia.

english: The LORD is my strength and my song, and He has become my salvation.
ekegusii: Omonene nere chinguru na omoegereri one, ere obeire ogotooreka kwane.
swahili: Bwana ni nguvu yangu na wimbo wangu, yeye amefanyika wokovu wangu.

english: Shouts of joy and salvation resound in the tents of the righteous: “The right hand of the LORD performs with valor!
ekegusii: Tegerera moigwe amateera y’omogooko igoro y’ogotoreka, ayio akorwa ase chiema ase abanyene oboronge bamenyete, agoteeba, “Okoboko gw’okorio kw’Omonene nigo kogokora amang’ana y’ogokumia.
swahili: Sauti za shangwe na ushindi zinavuma hemani mwa wenye haki: “Mkono wa kuume wa Bwana umetenda mambo makuu!

english: The right hand of the LORD is exalted! The right hand of the LORD performs with valor!”
ekegusii: Okoboko gw’okorio kw’Omonene nigo koimokererete igoro, ee, okoboko gw’okorio kw’Omonene nigo kogokora amang’ana y’ogokumia.”
swahili: Mkono wa kuume wa Bwana umeinuliwa juu, mkono wa kuume wa Bwana umetenda mambo makuu!”

english: I will not die, but I will live and proclaim what the LORD has done.
ekegusii: Inche tingokwa, korende nimbe moyo, erio ning’iranerere amakumia a Omonene.
swahili: Sitakufa, bali nitaishi, nami nitatangaza yale Bwana aliyoyatenda.

english: The LORD disciplined me severely, but He has not given me over to death.
ekegusii: Omonene obeire okong’a egesusuro ekenene gi’okondongeyia, korende tang’ereretie gochia ase amakweri.
swahili: Bwana ameniadhibu vikali, lakini hakuniacha nife.

english: Open to me the gates of righteousness, that I may enter and give thanks to the LORD.
ekegusii: Inyigorere ebiita bi’oboronge, erio insoe aroro ase okoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono ase Omonene.
swahili: Nifungulie malango ya haki, nami nitaingia na kumshukuru Bwana.

english: Let Israel say, “His loving devotion endures forever.”
ekegusii: Tiga Abaisraeli bateebe, “Obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.”
swahili: Israeli na aseme sasa: “Upendo wake wadumu milele.”

english: This is the gate of the LORD; the righteous shall enter through it.
ekegusii: Eke nakio egeita kia Omonene, agwo nao abanyene oboronge barasoere.
swahili: Hili ni lango la Bwana ambalo wenye haki wanaweza kuliingia.

english: I will give You thanks, for You have answered me, and You have become my salvation.
ekegusii: Nagoakeire ng’a mbuya mono, ekiagera kwanyiguure, naende kwabeire ogotooreka kwane.
swahili: Nitakushukuru, kwa kuwa ulinijibu, umekuwa wokovu wangu.

english: The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone.
ekegusii: Rigena riria abaagachi bangete riabeire rigena rinene ri’ekoona.
swahili: Jiwe walilolikataa waashi, limekuwa jiwe kuu la pembeni.

english: This is from the LORD, and it is marvelous in our eyes.
ekegusii: Ring’ana eri nigo riarure ase Omonene, eri neriogokumia ase amaiso aito.
swahili: Bwana ametenda hili, nalo ni la kushangaza machoni petu.

english: This is the day that the LORD has made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.
ekegusii: Rituko eri nario Omonene akorire, tiga tobe n’omogooko, tochenge ase rirorio.
swahili: Hii ndiyo siku Bwana aliyoifanya, tushangilie na kufurahi ndani yake.

english: O LORD, save us, we pray. We beseech You, O LORD, cause us to prosper!
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, twagosoroire ototoorie! Omonene, twakogarameire, toe obobui!
swahili: Ee Bwana, tuokoe, Ee Bwana, utujalie mafanikio.

english: Blessed is he who comes in the name of the LORD. From the house of the LORD we bless you.
ekegusii: Nasesenirie oyio ogoocha ase erieta ri’Omonene! Intwe nigo tokobasesenia korwa ase enyomba ya Nyasae.
swahili: Heri yule ajaye kwa jina la Bwana. Kutoka nyumba ya Bwana tunakubariki.

english: The LORD is God; He has made His light to shine upon us. Bind the festal sacrifice with cords to the horns of the altar.
ekegusii: Omonene nere Nyasae, ere otorabeirie ensaakia. Bogoria chinsagia chi’emete, mochaake rituko rinene, moroobere gochia ase egesasiimero kere n’emegwekano ye ching’unchara!
swahili: Bwana ndiye Mungu, naye ametuangazia nuru yake. Mkiwa na matawi mkononi, unganeni kwenye maandamano ya sikukuu hadi kwenye pembe za madhabahu.

english: You are my God, and I will give You thanks. You are my God, and I will exalt You.
ekegusii: Aye naye Nyasae one, nimbe ’nkogoakera ng’a mbuya mono; Nyasae one, nimbe nkona‐gokobaka.
swahili: Wewe ni Mungu wangu, nitakushukuru, wewe ni Mungu wangu, nitakutukuza.

english: Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.
ekegusii: Moakere Omonene ng’a mbuya mono, ekiagera ere nomuya, na obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.
swahili: Mshukuruni Bwana kwa kuwa ni mwema; upendo wake wadumu milele.

english: Let the house of Aaron say, “His loving devotion endures forever.”
ekegusii: Tiga abanto b’enyomba ya Aroni bateebe, “Obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.”
swahili: Nyumba ya Aroni na iseme sasa: “Upendo wake wadumu milele.”

english: Let those who fear the LORD say, “His loving devotion endures forever.”
ekegusii: Tiga abanto abwo bairogete Omonene bateebe, “Obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.”
swahili: Wote wamchao Bwana na waseme sasa: “Upendo wake wadumu milele.”

english: In my distress I called to the LORD, and He answered and set me free.
ekegusii: Ekero nareenge n’emechando nkamorangeri’Omonene; nere akang’iraneria, akambeeka aase aagare.
swahili: Wakati wa maumivu yangu makuu nilimlilia Bwana, naye akanijibu kwa kuniweka huru.

english: The LORD is on my side; I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
ekegusii: Omonene kare ase ensemo yane, tinkonyaara kwoboa. Mwanyabaanto onde bwensi ninki aranyare gonkorera?
swahili: Bwana yuko pamoja nami, sitaogopa. Mwanadamu anaweza kunitenda nini?

english: The LORD is on my side; He is my helper. Therefore I will look in triumph on those who hate me.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo are ase ensemo y’abarwanereri baane; ningoke ase engencho yokobugwa kw’abwo bangeechete.
swahili: Bwana yuko pamoja nami, yeye ni msaidizi wangu. Nitawatazama adui zangu wakiwa wameshindwa.

english: It is better to take refuge in the LORD than to trust in man.
ekegusii: Nigo ere buya komotamera Omonene, kobua gosemeria Mwanyabaanto.
swahili: Ni bora kumkimbilia Bwana kuliko kumtumainia mwanadamu.

english: It is better to take refuge in the LORD than to trust in princes.
ekegusii: Nigo ere buya komotamera Omonene kobua gosemeria omonyamwando bw’obogaambi.
swahili: Ni bora kumkimbilia Bwana kuliko kuwatumainia wakuu.

english: Blessed are those whose way is blameless, who walk in the Law of the LORD.
ekegusii: Inaki bagasesenirie abwo chinchera chiabo chire chindonge! Barabwo abagendererete kobwatia amachiiko y’Omonene!
swahili: Heri wale walio waadilifu katika njia zao, wanaoenenda katika sheria ya Bwana.

english: With all my heart I have sought You; do not let me stray from Your commandments.
ekegusii: Inche nigo ’ngokorigia nenkoro yane yonsi; ondende timbaisa gotiga amachiiko ao.
swahili: Ninakutafuta kwa moyo wangu wote, usiniache niende mbali na amri zako.

english: I discern more than the elders, for I obey Your precepts.
ekegusii: Nigo ’manyete amange kobua abanto abagotu, ekiagera ’mbwatete amachiiko ao.
swahili: Nina ufahamu zaidi kuliko wazee, kwa kuwa ninayatii mausia yako.

english: I have kept my feet from every evil path, that I may keep Your word.
ekegusii: Nigo ’ntangete amagoro aane tabaisa kobwatia enchera ende yonsi y’obobe, erinde ’nyaare korenda ring’ana riao.
swahili: Nimezuia miguu yangu isiende kwenye kila njia mbaya, ili niweze kutii neno lako.

english: I have not departed from Your ordinances, for You Yourself have taught me.
ekegusii: Tindi gotiga aya gwachiikire, ekiagera naye kwanyorokereirie.
swahili: Sijaziacha sheria zako, kwa kuwa umenifundisha wewe mwenyewe.

english: How sweet are Your words to my taste— sweeter than honey in my mouth!
ekegusii: Amang’ana ao naki are amansu ase ’nde! Ee, nigo are amansu ase omonwa one kobua obooke.
swahili: Tazama jinsi maneno yako yalivyo matamu kwangu, matamu kuliko asali katika kinywa changu!

english: I gain understanding from Your precepts; therefore I hate every false way. NUN
ekegusii: Amachiiko ao ang’eire obong’aini, ase ayio nigo ’ngeechete kera enchera y’obong’ainereria. Omobaso Okorwa ase Amachiiko y’Omonene
swahili: Ninapata ufahamu kutoka mausia yako, kwa hiyo ninachukia kila njia ya upotovu. Nuru Kutoka Kwenye Sheria Ya Bwana

english: Your word is a lamp to my feet and a light to my path.
ekegusii: Ring’ana riao netaya ase amagoro aane na omobaso ase enchera ’ngoeta.
swahili: Neno lako ni taa ya miguu yangu na mwanga katika njia yangu.

english: I have sworn and confirmed that I will keep Your righteous judgments.
ekegusii: Natianire ng’a ning’ikeranie eira eyio yane; nimbwatie aria onsi gwachiikire ase oboronge.
swahili: Nimeapa na nimethibitisha, kwamba nitafuata sheria zako za haki.

english: I am severely afflicted, O LORD; revive me through Your word.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, nigo nchaandegete mono, ing’a obogima oboyia koreng’ana ne ring’ana riao.
swahili: Nimeteseka sana, uhifadhi maisha yangu, Ee Bwana, sawasawa na neno lako.

english: Accept the freewill offerings of my mouth, O LORD, and teach me Your judgments.
ekegusii: Omonene, anchera ogosaba kwane kw’ogoaka ng’a mbuya mono, naende onyorokererie aya gwachiikire.
swahili: Ee Bwana, pokea sifa za hiari za kinywa changu, nifundishe sheria zako.

english: I constantly take my life in my hands, yet I do not forget Your law.
ekegusii: Ase chingaki chionsi tinaboegererete obogima bwane, na tinebete amachiiko ao.
swahili: Ingawa maisha yangu yako hatarini siku zote, sitasahau sheria yako.

english: I have hidden Your word in my heart that I might not sin against You.
ekegusii: Nagachire ring’ana riao ase enkoro yane ime, ng’a tinkora ebibe asore.
swahili: Nimelificha neno lako moyoni mwangu ili nisikutende dhambi.

english: The wicked have set a snare for me, but I have not strayed from Your precepts.
ekegusii: Abakori amabe babeekire omoeto ase ’ngoeta, korende tintantaniri korwa ase amachiiko ao.
swahili: Waovu wamenitegea mtego, lakini sijayakiuka maagizo yako.

english: Your testimonies are my heritage forever, for they are the joy of my heart.
ekegusii: Oborori bwao nabwo omwando one goika kare na kare, ee, nabwo enkoro yane egokerete mono.
swahili: Sheria zako ni urithi wangu milele, naam ni furaha ya moyo wangu.

english: I have inclined my heart to perform Your statutes, even to the very end. SAMEKH
ekegusii: Narure enkoro yane erende amachiiko ao, botambe goika omoerio. Oborendi Obuya Bokorwa Ase Amachiiko y’Omonene
swahili: Nimekusudia moyoni mwangu kuyafuata maagizo yako mpaka mwisho. Usalama Ndani Ya Sheria Ya Bwana

english: The double-minded I despise, but Your law I love.
ekegusii: Nigo ’ngeechete abanyamenwa ebere, korende nigo ’nyanchete amachiiko ao.
swahili: Ninachukia watu wa nia mbili, lakini ninapenda sheria yako.

english: You are my hiding place and my shield; I put my hope in Your word.
ekegusii: Aye naye ore obwebisero bwane, na enguba yane, nigo ’nsemeretie ring’ana riao.
swahili: Wewe ni kimbilio langu na ngao yangu, nimeweka tumaini langu katika neno lako.

english: Depart from me, you evildoers, that I may obey the commandments of my God.
ekegusii: Inwe abakori amabe, karue ase ’nde, erinde ’nyaare korenda amachiiko a Nyasae one.
swahili: Ondokeni kwangu, ninyi mtendao mabaya, ili niweze kushika amri za Mungu wangu!

english: Sustain me as You promised, that I may live; let me not be ashamed of my hope.
ekegusii: Ing’a chinguru buna kwariire eira, erinde imbe moyo. Tobaisa gontiga ’ndore obosooku ase ogosemeria kwane.
swahili: Nihifadhi sawasawa na ahadi yako, nami nitaishi; usiache matumaini yangu yakavunjwa.

english: Uphold me, and I will be saved, that I may always regard Your statutes.
ekegusii: Imboanie kegima, ’ngitere buya, inyare gosika botambe emeroberio yao echiikire.
swahili: Nitegemeze, nami nitaokolewa, nami daima nitayaheshimu maagizo yako.

english: You reject all who stray from Your statutes, for their deceitfulness is in vain.
ekegusii: Aye nigo okwanga abwo bagotantana korwa ase emeroberio yao echiikire; ee, obong’ainereria bwabo nigo bore bosa.
swahili: Unawakataa wote wanaoyaasi maagizo yako, kwa maana udanganyifu wao ni bure.

english: All the wicked on earth You discard like dross; therefore I love Your testimonies.
ekegusii: Aye nigo obarete abakori amabe bonsi b’ense koba bosa buna amabiria; ase ayio inche nigo inyanchete oborori bwao.
swahili: Waovu wa nchi unawatupa kama takataka, kwa hivyo nazipenda sheria zako.

english: Blessed are You, O LORD; teach me Your statutes.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene nigo osesenegete. Inyorokererie emeroberio yao echiikire.
swahili: Sifa ni zako, Ee Bwana, nifundishe maagizo yako.

english: My flesh trembles in awe of You; I stand in fear of Your judgments. AYIN
ekegusii: Omobere one nigo okoiguswa ore n’obwoba asore, naende nairokire ebiina biao. Okoigwera Amachiiko y’Omonene
swahili: Mwili wangu unatetemeka kwa kukuogopa wewe, ninaziogopa sheria zako. Kuitii Sheria Ya Bwana

english: I have done what is just and right; do not leave me to my oppressors.
ekegusii: Inche nakorire amang’ana are ay’ekeene na ay’oboronge; tontiga ase abachandi baane.
swahili: Nimetenda yaliyo haki na sawa, usiniache mikononi mwa watesi wangu.

english: Ensure Your servant’s well-being; do not let the arrogant oppress me.
ekegusii: Ontenenere inche omosomba oo inyore ebisio; totiga abanto abamwenu bankorere bobe.
swahili: Mhakikishie mtumishi wako usalama, usiache wenye kiburi wanionee.

english: My eyes fail, looking for Your salvation, and for Your righteous promise.
ekegusii: Amaiso aane arosire ase okoganya ogotooreka gokorwa asore, amo nogoikeranigwa kw’eira yao y’oboronge.
swahili: Macho yangu yamefifia, yakitazamia wokovu wako, na kuitazamia ahadi yako ya kweli.

english: Deal with Your servant according to Your loving devotion, and teach me Your statutes.
ekegusii: Nkorere amaya inche omosomba oo koreng’ana nobwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe, naende onyorokererie ’manye emeroberio yao echiikire.
swahili: Mfanyie mtumishi wako kulingana na upendo wako na unifundishe maagizo yako.

english: I am Your servant; give me understanding, that I may know Your testimonies.
ekegusii: Inche nigo ’nde omosomba oo, ing’a okomanya, erinde ’manye oborori bwao.
swahili: Mimi ni mtumishi wako; nipe ufahamu ili niweze kuelewa sheria zako.

english: It is time for the LORD to act, for they have broken Your law.
ekegusii: Engaki yaikire aye Omonene ogwenerete gokora ogokora kwao, ekiagera basaririe amachiiko ao.
swahili: Ee Bwana, wakati wako wa kutenda umewadia, kwa kuwa sheria yako inavunjwa.

english: Therefore I love Your commandments more than gold, even the purest gold.
ekegusii: Ase ayio inche nigo ’nyanchete amachiiko ao kobua etaabu, ee, kobua etaabu enkenonoku.
swahili: Kwa sababu nazipenda amri zako zaidi ya dhahabu, naam, zaidi ya dhahabu safi,

english: Therefore I admire all Your precepts and hate every false way. PE
ekegusii: Na ase ayio nigo ndoche ng’a amachiiko ao onsi namaronge. Nigo ngeechete kera enchera y’obong’ainereria. Okogania Gw’okoigwera Amachiiko y’Omonene
swahili: na kwa sababu naona maagizo yako yote ni adili, nachukia kila njia potovu. Shauku Ya Kuitii Sheria Ya Bwana

english: Wonderful are Your testimonies; therefore I obey them.
ekegusii: Oborori bwao nigo bore obw’ogokumia, ase ayio nigo mbobwatete nomoyo one bwonsi.
swahili: Sheria zako ni za ajabu, hivyo ninazitii.

english: With my lips I proclaim all the judgments of Your mouth.
ekegusii: Nimbe ’nkona‐koraria aya onsi gwanchiikire nomonwa oo.
swahili: Kwa midomo yangu nitasimulia sheria zote zinazotoka katika kinywa chako.

english: The unfolding of Your words gives light; it informs the simple.
ekegusii: Ekero amang’ana ao amaanoirwe nigo akorua omobaso na kobaa abatamanyeti amange obong’aini.
swahili: Kuingia kwa maneno yako kunaleta nuru, kunampa mjinga ufahamu.

english: I open my mouth and pant, longing for Your commandments.
ekegusii: Nigo ngwasamia omonwa one na gwesesa, ekiagera nigo ’nde namaiga imanye amachiiko ao.
swahili: Nimefungua kinywa changu na kuhema, nikitamani amri zako.

english: Turn to me and show me mercy, as You do to those who love Your name.
ekegusii: Ndigererie, ondorere amaabera buna egwenerete abwo banchete erieta riao.
swahili: Nigeukie na unihurumie, kama uwafanyiavyo siku zote wale wanaolipenda jina lako.

english: Order my steps in Your word; let no sin rule over me.
ekegusii: Kong’ia orogendo rwane koreng’ana ne ring’ana riao, totiga obobe bongambere.
swahili: Ongoza hatua zangu kulingana na neno lako, usiache dhambi yoyote initawale.

english: Redeem me from the oppression of man, that I may keep Your precepts.
ekegusii: Mboorie korwa ase ogochaandwa kwa Mwanyabaanto, erio nario ndanyaare korenda amachiiko ao.
swahili: Niokoe na uonevu wa wanadamu, ili niweze kutii mausia yako.

english: Make Your face shine upon Your servant, and teach me Your statutes.
ekegusii: Mbarerie inche omosomba oo obosio bwao, na onyorokererie emeroberio yao echiikire.
swahili: Mwangazie mtumishi wako uso wako na unifundishe amri zako.

english: My eyes shed streams of tears because Your law is not obeyed. TZADE
ekegusii: Nigo nkorera, naitera amariga amange mono, ekiagera abanto tibarendeti amachiiko ao. Oboronge bw’amachiiko y’Omonene
swahili: Chemchemi za machozi zinatiririka kutoka machoni yangu, kwa kuwa sheria yako haifuatwi. Haki Ya Sheria Ya Bwana

english: Righteous are You, O LORD, and upright are Your judgments.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene nigo ore omonyene oboronge, na okogaambera kwao n’okwaboronge.
swahili: Ee Bwana, wewe ni mwenye haki, sheria zako ni sahihi.

english: The testimonies You have laid down are righteous and altogether faithful.
ekegusii: Gwachiikire oborori bwao ase oboronge, na ase obwegenwa bwonsi.
swahili: Sheria ulizoziweka ni za haki, ni za kuaminika kikamilifu.

english: My zeal has consumed me because my foes forget Your words.
ekegusii: Risemi riane riandire, ekiagera ababisa baane bebire ring’ana riao.
swahili: Jitihada yangu imenidhoofisha, kwa kuwa adui zangu wanayapuuza maneno yako.

english: I rejoice in the way of Your testimonies as much as in all riches.
ekegusii: Nigo ’nde n’omogooko ase obonene bwe chinkuma chiao; kobua koba nobotenenku obonene.
swahili: Ninafurahia kufuata sheria zako kama mtu afurahiaye mali nyingi.

english: Your promise is completely pure; therefore Your servant loves it.
ekegusii: Ring’ana riao riateemirwe, nigo riteneine bokong’u, na inche omosomba oo nigo ndianchete.
swahili: Ahadi zako zimejaribiwa kikamilifu, mtumishi wako anazipenda.

english: I am lowly and despised, but I do not forget Your precepts.
ekegusii: Nigo ’nde oyo otasikiri, naende inchayire, korende nonya naboigo tinkweba amachiiko ao.
swahili: Ingawa ni mdogo na ninadharauliwa, sisahau mausia yako.

english: Your righteousness is everlasting and Your law is true.
ekegusii: Oboronge bwao nigo bore obwa kare na kare, n’amachiiko ao nigo are ay’ekeene.
swahili: Haki yako ni ya milele, na sheria yako ni kweli.

english: Trouble and distress have found me, but Your commandments are my delight.
ekegusii: Emechando na omoichano bianyorire, korende nigo ’ngokerete amachiiko ao.
swahili: Shida na dhiki zimenipata, lakini amri zako ni furaha yangu.

english: Your testimonies are righteous forever. Give me understanding, that I may live. KOPH
ekegusii: Oborori bwao nigo bore oboronge goika kare na kare; on g’e okomanya, erinde imbe moyo. Ogosaba Gw’okonyora Ogotooreka
swahili: Sheria zako ni sahihi milele, hunipa ufahamu ili nipate kuishi. Maombi Kwa Ajili Ya Kuokolewa

english: I call with all my heart; answer me, O LORD! I will obey Your statutes.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, nigo ’ngokorangeria nenkoro yane yonsi, inyigwe, na inche nimbwate emeroberio yao echiikire.
swahili: Ee Bwana, ninakuita kwa moyo wangu wote, nami nitayatii maagizo yako.

english: I call to You; save me, that I may keep Your testimonies.
ekegusii: Nigo ’nkorera asore, ontoorie, erinde ’mbwate oborori bwao.
swahili: Ninakuita; niokoe nami nitazishika sheria zako.

english: I rise before dawn and cry for help; in Your word I have put my hope.
ekegusii: Nigo ’nkobooka mambia chuni gokorangeria ng’a onkonye, ninsemeretie amang’ana ao.
swahili: Ninaamka asubuhi na mapema na kukuomba msaada; nimeweka tumaini langu katika neno lako.

english: My eyes anticipate the watches of night, that I may meditate on Your word.
ekegusii: Nigo nkogeesa botuko bokia, mbe nkona‐koiranerera ring’ana riao.
swahili: Sikufumba macho yangu usiku kucha, ili niweze kutafakari juu ya ahadi zako.

english: Hear my voice, O LORD, according to Your loving devotion; give me life according to Your justice.
ekegusii: Omonene, igwa eriogi riane ase engencho y’obwanchani bwao botari koera; ong’e obogima oboyia koreng’ana noboronge bwao.
swahili: Usikie sauti yangu sawasawa na upendo wako, Ee Bwana, uyahifadhi maisha yangu, sawasawa na sheria zako.

english: I will meditate on Your precepts and regard Your ways.
ekegusii: Nimbe ’nkorengereria mono igoro y’amachiiko ao, naende ’mbe ’nkorigereria chinchera chiao chionsi.
swahili: Ninatafakari maagizo yako na kuziangalia njia zako.

english: Those who follow after wickedness draw near; they are far from Your law.
ekegusii: Abwo bakominyokera amabe bambereire ang’e; abwo nigo bare aare korwa ase amachiiko ao.
swahili: Wale wanaopanga mipango miovu wako karibu nami, lakini wako mbali na sheria yako.

english: You are near, O LORD, and all Your commandments are true.
ekegusii: Korende aye Omonene nigo ore ang’e, n’amachiiko ao onsi nigo are ay’ekeene.
swahili: Ee Bwana, hata hivyo wewe u karibu, na amri zako zote ni za kweli.

english: Long ago I learned from Your testimonies that You have established them forever. RESH
ekegusii: Korwa kare nimanyete korwa ase oborori bwao ng’a naye kwabobegete bobeo goika kare na kare. Ogosaba Gw’okonyora Ogokoonywa
swahili: Tangu zamani nimejifunza kutoka shuhuda zako kwamba umezithibitisha ili zidumu milele. Maombi Kwa Ajili Ya Msaada

english: Look upon my affliction and rescue me, for I have not forgotten Your law.
ekegusii: Rigereria emechando yane, ontoorie, ekiagera tinyebeti amachiiko ao.
swahili: Yaangalie mateso yangu, uniokoe, kwa kuwa sijasahau sheria yako.

english: Defend my cause and redeem me; revive me according to Your word.
ekegusii: Indwanerere, omboorie, ong’e obogima oboyia koreng’ana ne ring’ana riao.
swahili: Nitetee katika hali hii yangu na unikomboe, uyahifadhi maisha yangu sawasawa na ahadi yako.

english: Salvation is far from the wicked because they do not seek Your statutes.
ekegusii: Ogotooreka nigo kore aare korwa ase abakori amabe, ekiagera barabwo tibari korigia emeroberio yao echiikire.
swahili: Wokovu uko mbali na waovu, kwa kuwa hawatafuti maagizo yako.

english: Great are Your mercies, O LORD; revive me according to Your ordinances.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, amaabera ao nigo are amanene; ong’e obogima oboyia koreng’ana nokogaamba kwao.
swahili: Ee Bwana, huruma zako ni kuu, uyahifadhi maisha yangu sawasawa na sheria zako.

english: Though my persecutors and foes are many, I have not turned from Your testimonies.
ekegusii: Abagonchaanda na abare ababisa baane nigo bare abange, korende tinkogobera ase okorwa oborori bwao.
swahili: Adui wanaonitesa ni wengi, lakini mimi sitaziacha sheria zako.

english: I look on the faithless with loathing because they do not keep Your word.
ekegusii: Ekero nkorigereria abatari abegenwa nigo nkogeechigwa nabarabwo, ekiagera tibabwateti ring’ana riao.
swahili: Ninawatazama wasioamini kwa chuki, kwa kuwa hawalitii neno lako.

english: Consider how I love Your precepts, O LORD; give me life according to Your loving devotion.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, rora buna nyanchete amachiiko ao! Ong’e obogima oboyia koreng’ana nobwanchani bwao botari koera.
swahili: Tazama jinsi ninavyopenda mausia yako; Ee Bwana, uyahifadhi maisha yangu, sawasawa na upendo wako.

english: I will delight in Your statutes; I will not forget Your word. GIMEL
ekegusii: Ningokere emeroberio yao echiikire; tinkweba ring’ana riao. Omogooko bw’okorenda amachiiko y’Omonene
swahili: Ninafurahia maagizo yako, wala sitalipuuza neno lako. Furaha Katika Sheria Ya Bwana

english: The entirety of Your word is truth, and all Your righteous judgments endure forever. SIN and SHIN
ekegusii: Amang’ana ao onsi nay’ekeene, na okogaamba kwao gwonsi kw’oboronge nogwa kare na kare. Okwerua Ase Okoigwera Amachiiko y’Omonene
swahili: Maneno yako yote ni kweli, sheria zako zote za haki ni za milele. Kujiweka Wakfu Kwa Sheria Ya Bwana

english: Rulers persecute me without cause, but my heart fears only Your word.
ekegusii: Abagaambi nigo bagonchaanda bosa ’ntari na komocha, korende enkoro yane nigo eirogete amang’ana ao.
swahili: Watawala wamenitesa bila sababu, lakini moyo wangu unatetemeka kwa neno lako.

english: I rejoice in Your promise like one who finds great spoil.
ekegusii: Nigo nkogokera ring’ana riao, naba buna oyo onyorire ebisakorwa ebinge.
swahili: Nafurahia ahadi zako kama mtu aliyepata mateka mengi.

english: I hate and abhor falsehood, but Your law I love.
ekegusii: Nigo ngeechete kegima oborimo bonde bwonsi, korende nigo nyanchete amachiiko ao.
swahili: Ninachukia na kuchukizwa sana na uongo, lakini napenda sheria yako.

english: Seven times a day I praise You for Your righteous judgments.
ekegusii: Ara gatan’akabere ase rituko nigo ’nkogotogia, ase engencho y’emeroberio yao y’oboronge echiikire.
swahili: Ninakusifu mara saba kwa siku, kwa ajili ya sheria zako za haki.

english: Abundant peace belongs to those who love Your instruction; nothing can make them stumble.
ekegusii: Abwo banchete amachiiko ao nigo bare n’omorembe omonene mono, kende tikeri gekobagoocha.
swahili: Wanaopenda sheria yako wana amani tele, wala hakuna kitu kinachoweza kuwakwaza.

english: I wait for Your salvation, O LORD, and I carry out Your commandments.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, nigo ’nganyete ng’a ontoorie, naende nigo ’ngokora buna amachiiko ao agoteeba.
swahili: Ee Bwana, ninangojea wokovu wako, nami ninafuata amri zako,

english: I obey Your testimonies and love them greatly.
ekegusii: Omoyo one nigo obwatete oborori bwao, nigo ’mbwanchete mono.
swahili: Ninazitii sheria zako, kwa sababu ninazipenda mno.

english: I obey Your precepts and Your testimonies, for all my ways are before You. TAW
ekegusii: Nigo imbwatete amachiiko ao, na oborori bwao, ekiagera nigo omanyete chinchera chiane chionsi. Ogosaba Gw’okonyora Ogokonywa
swahili: Nimetii mausia yako na sheria zako, kwa kuwa njia zangu zote zinajulikana kwako. Kuomba Msaada

english: May my cry come before You, O LORD; give me understanding according to Your word.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, tiga okorera kwane goike ase obosio bwao; ing’a obong’aini koreng’ana ne ring’ana riao!
swahili: Ee Bwana, kilio changu na kifike mbele zako, nipe ufahamu sawasawa na neno lako.

english: Deal bountifully with Your servant, that I may live and keep Your word.
ekegusii: ’nkorere amaya, inche omosomba oo, erio nario ’ndabe moyo, ’mbwate ring’ana riao.
swahili: Mtendee mema mtumishi wako, nami nitaishi; nitalitii neno lako.

english: May my plea come before You; rescue me according to Your promise.
ekegusii: Tiga ogosaba kwane goike asore; ontoorie koreng’ana ne ring’ana riao!
swahili: Maombi yangu na yafike mbele zako, niokoe sawasawa na ahadi yako.

english: My lips pour forth praise, for You teach me Your statutes.
ekegusii: Nimbe ’nkona‐kogotogia nebikoba biane, ekiagera aye kwanyorokereirie ’manye emeroberio yao echiikire.
swahili: Midomo yangu na ibubujike sifa, kwa kuwa unanifundisha maagizo yako.

english: My tongue sings of Your word, for all Your commandments are righteous.
ekegusii: Oromeme rwane ’ndoteere ring’ana riao, ekiagera amachiiko ao onsi nigo are amaronge.
swahili: Ulimi wangu na uimbe kuhusu neno lako, kwa kuwa amri zako zote ni za haki.

english: May Your hand be ready to help me, for I have chosen Your precepts.
ekegusii: Okoboko kwao, tiga kobe ang’e gonkonya, ekiagera nachoorire kobwatia amachiiko ao.
swahili: Mkono wako uwe tayari kunisaidia, kwa kuwa nimechagua mausia yako.

english: I long for Your salvation, O LORD, and Your law is my delight.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, nigo ’nde namaiga ng’a ontoorie, n’amachiiko ao nigo angogetie mono.
swahili: Ee Bwana, ninatamani wokovu wako, na sheria yako ni furaha yangu.

english: Let me live to praise You; may Your judgments sustain me.
ekegusii: Tiga omoyo one obe moyo, erinde ’ngotogie, na aya gwachiikire, tiga ankonye.
swahili: Nijalie kuishi ili nipate kukusifu, na sheria zako zinitegemeze.
