english: I have strayed like a lost sheep; seek Your servant, for I have not forgotten Your commandments.
ekegusii: Inche nasirire buna eng’ondi ensiru, ’ndigie inche omosomba oo, ekiagera tinyebeti amachiiko ao.
swahili: Nimetangatanga kama kondoo aliyepotea. Mtafute mtumishi wako, kwa kuwa sijasahau amri zako.

english: Open my eyes that I may see wondrous things from Your law.
ekegusii: Ndamokie amaiso, inyare korora amang’ana y’ogokumia y’amachiiko ao.
swahili: Yafungue macho yangu nipate kuona mambo ya ajabu katika sheria yako.

english: I am a stranger on the earth; do not hide Your commandments from me.
ekegusii: Inche nigo ’nde omoeti ase ense, tobaisa kombisa amachiiko ao.
swahili: Mimi ni mgeni duniani, usinifiche amri zako.

english: Blessed are those who keep His testimonies and seek Him with all their heart.
ekegusii: Mbasesenirie abwo barendete oborori bwaye, abwo bakorigia Omonene ne chinkoro chiabo chionsi,
swahili: Heri wale wanaozishika shuhuda zake, wamtafutao kwa moyo wao wote.

english: My soul is consumed with longing for Your judgments at all times.
ekegusii: Enkoro yane yarang’ire namaiga, chingaki chionsi nigo eganetie komanya okogania kwao.
swahili: Nafsi yangu inataabika kwa shauku kubwa juu ya sheria zako wakati wote.

english: You rebuke the arrogant— the cursed who stray from Your commandments.
ekegusii: Aye nigo ogotogonyera abanto abaenenu, abwo baragereirie, baria batigire kobwata amachiiko ao.
swahili: Unawakemea wenye majivuno, waliolaaniwa waendao mbali na amri zako.

english: Remove my scorn and contempt, for I have kept Your testimonies.
ekegusii: Onduserie ogochecherigwa na ogochaaywa kwabo, ekiagera inche nigo ’ndendete oborori bwao.
swahili: Niondolee dharau na dhihaka, kwa kuwa ninazishika sheria zako.

english: Though rulers sit and slander me, Your servant meditates on Your statutes.
ekegusii: Abagaambi nabaikaransa amo koroberia bankorere bobe, korende inche, omosomba oo, nigo nkona‐koiranerera emeroberio yao echiikire.
swahili: Ingawa watawala huketi pamoja na kunisingizia, mtumishi wako atatafakari juu ya maagizo yako.

english: Your testimonies are indeed my delight; they are my counselors. DALETH
ekegusii: Nigo ’ngokerete oborori bwao, ekiagera nabwo bogonseemia. Okogania gw’okoigwera amachiiko Omonene
swahili: Sheria zako ni furaha yangu, nazo ni washauri wangu. Kuamua Kuitii Sheria Ya Bwana

english: My soul cleaves to the dust; revive me according to Your word.
ekegusii: Omoyo one otiringeirwe inse, ’ng’a obogima oboyia koreng’ana ne ring’ana riao.
swahili: Nimelazwa chini mavumbini, yahifadhi maisha yangu sawasawa na neno lako.

english: I recounted my ways, and You answered me; teach me Your statutes.
ekegusii: Ekero naorogetie amakora aane nigo kwanyigwete; ’nyorokererie emeroberio yao echiikire!
swahili: Nilikueleza njia zangu ukanijibu, nifundishe sheria zako.

english: Make clear to me the way of Your precepts; then I will meditate on Your wonders.
ekegusii: Inyorokererie, erinde imanye chinchera chi’amachiiko ao, nimbe ’nkona koiranerera ogokora kwao kw’ogokumia.
swahili: Nijulishe mafundisho ya mausia yako, nami nitatafakari maajabu yako.

english: My soul melts with sorrow; strengthen me according to Your word.
ekegusii: Omoyo one obuirwe n’emechando, ’mbeeke chinguru koreng’ana ne ring’ana riao.
swahili: Nafsi yangu imechakazwa kwa huzuni, uniimarishe sawasawa na neno lako.

english: Remove me from the path of deceit and graciously grant me Your law.
ekegusii: Nduserie chinchera chi’obong’ainereria chibe aare korwa ase ’nde, ase obuya bwao ’nyorokererie amachiiko ao.
swahili: Niepushe na njia za udanganyifu, kwa neema unifundishe sheria zako.

english: They do no iniquity; they walk in His ways.
ekegusii: abwo batari gokora amabe, korende nigo bakobwatia chinchera chiaye.
swahili: Wasiofanya lolote lililo baya, wanaoenenda katika njia zake.

english: I have chosen the way of truth; I have set Your ordinances before me.
ekegusii: Inche nachoorire enchera y’ekeene, nayabeekire motwe aria gwanchiikire.
swahili: Nimechagua njia ya kweli, nimekaza moyo wangu katika sheria zako.

english: I cling to Your testimonies, O LORD; let me not be put to shame.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, nabwatereire oborori bwao, tobaisa gontiga ’nsookigwe.
swahili: Nimengʼangʼania sheria zako, Ee Bwana, usiniache niaibishwe.

english: I run in the path of Your commandments, for You will enlarge my heart. HE
ekegusii: Ekero oramanyie enkoro yane obuya bwao, niminyoke ’nyigwere amachiiko ao. Ogosaba gw’okoegwa okomanya
swahili: Nakimbilia katika njia ya maagizo yako, kwa kuwa umeuweka moyo wangu huru. Maombi Ili Kupata Ufahamu Wa Sheria

english: Teach me, O LORD, the way of Your statutes, and I will keep them to the end.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ’nyorokererie enchera y’emeroberio yao echiikire; na inche nin’yerende goika omoerio.
swahili: Ee Bwana, nifundishe kuyafuata maagizo yako, nami nitayashika mpaka mwisho.

english: Give me understanding that I may obey Your law, and follow it with all my heart.
ekegusii: Imanyie amachiiko ao, erinde ’n’yabwate na koyarenda nenkoro yane yonsi.
swahili: Nipe ufahamu, nami nitaishika sheria yako na kuitii kwa moyo wangu wote.

english: Direct me in the path of Your commandments, for there I find delight.
ekegusii: Indaae ’mbwatie enchera y’amachiiko ao, ekiagera inche nigo ’ngokirie naro.
swahili: Niongoze kwenye njia ya amri zako, kwa kuwa huko napata furaha.

english: Turn my heart to Your testimonies and not to covetous gain.
ekegusii: Oonchore enkoro yane. Yanche oborori bwao, na toyetiga ebe nokogania kwe ribero.
swahili: Ugeuze moyo wangu kuelekea sheria zako, na siyo kwenye mambo ya ubinafsi.

english: Turn my eyes away from worthless things; revive me with Your word.
ekegusii: Oyaonchore amaiso aane tarigereria amang’ana atagwenereti; ing’a obogima oboyia ’mbwatie chinchera chiao.
swahili: Geuza macho yangu kutoka kwenye mambo yasiyofaa, uyahifadhi maisha yangu sawasawa na neno lako.

english: Establish Your word to Your servant, to produce reverence for You.
ekegusii: Ikerania ase ’nde, inche omosomba oo, eira kwandierete, eira eyio okoa abakoirogete.
swahili: Mtimizie mtumishi wako ahadi yako, ili upate kuogopwa.

english: Turn away the disgrace I dread, for Your judgments are good.
ekegusii: Induserie amang’ana y’ogochaaywa inyirogete, ekiagera aya gwachiikire nigo are amaya.
swahili: Niondolee aibu ninayoiogopa, kwa kuwa sheria zako ni njema.

english: You have ordained Your precepts, that we should keep them diligently.
ekegusii: Aye gwatoeire amachiiko ao, toyarende nomokia.
swahili: Umetoa maagizo yako ili tuyatii kwa ukamilifu.

english: How I long for Your precepts! Revive me in Your righteousness. WAW
ekegusii: Rora, inche nigo ’nganetie koigwera amachiiko ao; ing’a obogima oboyia goetera ase oboronge bwao. Ogosemeria amachiiko Omonene
swahili: Tazama jinsi ninavyoonea shauku mausia yako! Hifadhi maisha yangu katika haki yako. Kuitumainia Sheria Ya Bwana

english: May Your loving devotion come to me, O LORD, Your salvation, according to Your promise.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, orokia ase ’nde obwanchani bwao botakoera, naende ontoorie buna kwandierete eira.
swahili: Ee Bwana, upendo wako usiokoma unijie, wokovu wako sawasawa na ahadi yako,

english: Then I can answer him who taunts, for I trust in Your word.
ekegusii: Erio inyore ring’ana ’ndairanerie abwo bagonchecheria, ekiagera nigo ’nyegenete ring’ana riao.
swahili: ndipo nitakapomjibu anayenidhihaki, kwa kuwa ninalitumainia neno lako.

english: Never take Your word of truth from my mouth, for I hope in Your judgments.
ekegusii: Tobaisa korusia nonya ng’ake ring’ana ri’ekeene korwa ase omonwa one, ekiagera nigo ’nsemeretie aria gwachiikire.
swahili: Usilinyakue neno la kweli kutoka kinywani mwangu, kwa kuwa nimeweka tumaini langu katika amri zako.

english: I will always obey Your law, forever and ever.
ekegusii: Nimbe ’nkoigwera amachiiko ao botambe goika kare na kare.
swahili: Nitaitii amri yako daima, naam, milele na milele.

english: And I will walk in freedom, for I have sought Your precepts.
ekegusii: Nimbe ’ngotaara ase obosibore, ekiagera neorokereirie amachiiko ao.
swahili: Nitatembea nikiwa huru, kwa kuwa nimejifunza mausia yako.

english: I will speak of Your testimonies before kings, and I will not be ashamed.
ekegusii: Nindue oborori bwao ase amasio y’abarwoti ’ntari nobosooku.
swahili: Nitasema sheria zako mbele za wafalme wala sitaaibishwa,

english: I delight in Your commandments because I love them.
ekegusii: Inche nigo ’nde n’omogooko ase amachiiko ao, ekiagera ayio nin’yanchete.
swahili: kwa kuwa ninazifurahia amri zako kwa sababu ninazipenda.

english: I lift up my hands to Your commandments, which I love, and I meditate on Your statutes. ZAYIN
ekegusii: Nindambore amaboko aane ’mbwate amachiiko ao nyanchete, na nimbe ’nkorengereria igoro y’emeroberio yao echiikire. Okwegena Amachiiko y’Omonene
swahili: Ninaziinulia amri zako ambazo ninazipenda mikono yangu, nami ninatafakari juu ya maagizo yako. Matumaini Katika Sheria Ya Bwana

english: Remember Your word to Your servant, upon which You have given me hope.
ekegusii: Inyora ring’ana riao gwakwanete ase ’nde inche omosomba oo, ekiagera ase rirorio kwang’eire ogosemeria.
swahili: Kumbuka neno lako kwa mtumishi wako, kwa sababu umenipa tumaini.

english: Oh, that my ways were committed to keeping Your statutes!
ekegusii: Nigo nganetie ng’a chinchera chiane chibe chindonge, erinde ndende emeroberio yao echiikire.
swahili: Laiti mwenendo wangu ungekuwa imara katika kuyatii maagizo yako!

english: This is my comfort in affliction, that Your promise has given me life.
ekegusii: Egekondemia ase emechando yane n’eke: Ring’ana riao nigo rigonkora naba omoyia.
swahili: Faraja yangu katika mateso yangu ni hii: Ahadi yako inahifadhi maisha yangu.

english: The arrogant utterly deride me, but I do not turn from Your law.
ekegusii: Abanto abamwenu nigo bagonchecheria mono, nonya naboigo tindi gotiga amachiiko ao.
swahili: Wenye majivuno wamenisimanga bila kuchoka, hata hivyo sitaiacha sheria yako.

english: I remember Your judgments of old, O LORD, and in them I find comfort.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ekero ’nkoinyora okogaamba kwao korwa kare, nigo ’nkoba nokoremigwa.
swahili: Ee Bwana, ninazikumbuka sheria zako za zamani, nazo zinanifariji.

english: Rage has taken hold of me because of the wicked who reject Your law.
ekegusii: Nigo ’nde n’okogeechigwa okonene ase engencho y’abakori amabe, ekiagera bagosaria amachiiko ao.
swahili: Nimeshikwa sana na ghadhabu kwa ajili ya waovu, ambao wameacha sheria yako.

english: Your statutes are songs to me in the house of my pilgrimage.
ekegusii: Ekero imenyete ase enyomba yane y’obogeni, nabeire ’nkona‐gotererera emeroberio yao echiikire.
swahili: Maagizo yako ni kiini cha nyimbo zangu popote ninapoishi.

english: In the night, O LORD, I remember Your name, that I may keep Your law.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, nigo ’nkoinyora erieta riao botuko, nigo ’ndendete amachiiko ao.
swahili: Ee Bwana, wakati wa usiku ninalikumbuka jina lako, nami nitatii sheria yako.

english: This is my practice, for I obey Your precepts. HETH
ekegusii: Oko nakwo ogosesenigwa kwane, ng’a nabeire ’ndendete amachiiko ao. Okwerua koigwera amachiiko y’Omonene
swahili: Hili limekuwa zoezi langu: nami ninayatii mausia yako. Kujitolea Katika Sheria Ya Bwana

english: The LORD is my portion; I have promised to keep Your words.
ekegusii: Omonene, aye negetare kiane; nariire eira koigwera amang’ana ao.
swahili: Ee Bwana, wewe ni fungu langu, nimeahidi kuyatii maneno yako.

english: I have sought Your face with all my heart; be gracious to me according to Your promise.
ekegusii: Nigo ’nkogosorora nenkoro yane yonsi: Ondorere amaabera koreng’ana ne ring’ana riao.
swahili: Nimetafuta uso wako kwa moyo wangu wote, nihurumie sawasawa na ahadi yako.

english: I considered my ways and turned my steps to Your testimonies.
ekegusii: Nigo nareengereretie igoro ye chinchera chiane, ’nkaonchora amagoro aane ’nkabwatia oborori bwao.
swahili: Nimezifikiri njia zangu na nimeelekeza hatua zangu katika mausia yako.

english: Then I would not be ashamed when I consider all Your commandments.
ekegusii: Rirorio tingosookigwa ekero ’ndabe ’ndigereretie amachiiko ao onsi.
swahili: Hivyo mimi sitaaibishwa ninapozingatia amri zako zote.

english: I hurried without hesitating to keep Your commandments.
ekegusii: Nigo ’nkoayerera, tingotebana koigwera amachiiko ao.
swahili: Nitafanya haraka bila kuchelewa kuzitii amri zako.

english: Though the ropes of the wicked bind me, I do not forget Your law.
ekegusii: Chingori chi’abakori amabe chiang’etananire, korende tinkweba amachiiko ao.
swahili: Hata waovu wanifunge kwa kamba, sitasahau sheria yako.

english: At midnight I rise to give You thanks for Your righteous judgments.
ekegusii: Nigo ’nkobooka botuko gati kogoakera ng’a mbuya mono, ekiagera okogaamba kwao nokoronge.
swahili: Usiku wa manane ninaamka kukushukuru kwa sababu ya sheria zako za haki.

english: I am a friend to all who fear You, and to those who keep Your precepts.
ekegusii: Inche nigo ’nde omogisangio bw’abwo bonsi bakoirogete, abwo barendete amachiiko ao.
swahili: Mimi ni rafiki kwa wale wote wakuchao, kwa wote wanaofuata mausia yako.

english: The earth is filled with Your loving devotion, O LORD; teach me Your statutes. TETH
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, obwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe nigo boichire ase ense, ’nyorokererie imanye emeroberio yao echiikire. Engencho enene ere ase amachiiko y’Omonene
swahili: Ee Bwana, dunia imejaa upendo wako, nifundishe maagizo yako. Thamani Ya Sheria Ya Bwana

english: You are good to Your servant, O LORD, according to Your word.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, koreng’ana ne ring’ana riao gwankoreire inche omosomba oo obuya obonge.
swahili: Mtendee wema mtumishi wako Ee Bwana, sawasawa na neno lako.

english: Teach me good judgment and knowledge, for I believe in Your commandments.
ekegusii: Inyorokererie imanye kogaamba buya na imbe ne chisemi, ekiagera nigo ’nyegenete amachiiko ao.
swahili: Nifundishe maarifa na uamuzi mzuri, kwa kuwa ninaamini amri zako.

english: Before I was afflicted, I went astray; but now I keep Your word.
ekegusii: Ekero konya ’ntaraegwa egesusuro, nigo nareenge omosiru, korende bono nigo ’ndendete ring’ana riao.
swahili: Kabla sijapata shida nilipotea njia, lakini sasa ninalitii neno lako.

english: You are good, and You do what is good; teach me Your statutes.
ekegusii: Aye nigo ore omuya, naende nigo ogokora amaya, ase ayio ’nyorokererie emeroberio yao echiikire.
swahili: Wewe ni mwema, unalotenda ni jema, nifundishe maagizo yako.

english: Though the arrogant have smeared me with lies, I keep Your precepts with all my heart.
ekegusii: Abanto abamwenu nigo bakongamba na gokwana oborimo igoro yane, korende inche nigo ’ndendete amachiiko ao nenkoro yane yonsi.
swahili: Ingawa wenye majivuno wamenisingizia uongo, nitafuata mausia yako kwa moyo wangu wote.

english: I will praise You with an upright heart when I learn Your righteous judgments.
ekegusii: Ekero ’ndabe neorokereirie okogaamba kwao kw’oboronge, rirorio nimbe nkona‐kogotogia nenkoro endonge.
swahili: Nitakusifu kwa moyo mnyofu ninapojifunza sheria zako za haki.

english: Their hearts are hard and callous, but I delight in Your law.
ekegusii: Chinkoro chiabo nigo chinorete buna ebitinya, korende inche nigo ’nde n’omogooko ase amachiiko ao.
swahili: Mioyo yao ni katili na migumu, bali mimi napendezwa na sheria yako.

english: It was good for me to be afflicted, that I might learn Your statutes.
ekegusii: Nigo yabeete buya mono ase ’nde konyora egesusuro keria, ekiagera ayio naro agerete neorokereirie emeroberio yao echiikire.
swahili: Ilikuwa vyema mimi kupata shida ili nipate kujifunza maagizo yako.

english: The law from Your mouth is more precious to me than thousands of pieces of gold and silver. YODH
ekegusii: Amachiiko ao gwakwanete nigo are amaya ase ’nde, kobua chitaabu ne chifeta chilifu chinyinge. Oboronge bore ase amachiiko y’Omonene
swahili: Sheria inayotoka kinywani mwako ina thamani kubwa kwangu kuliko maelfu ya vipande vya fedha na dhahabu. Haki Ya Sheria Ya Bwana

english: Your hands have made me and fashioned me; give me understanding to learn Your commandments.
ekegusii: Amaboko ao naro ambombete akandoisia, ing’a obong’aini, erinde inyare kweorokereria amachiiko ao.
swahili: Mikono yako ilinifanya na kuniumba, nipe ufahamu niweze kujifunza amri zako.

english: May those who fear You see me and rejoice, for I have hoped in Your word.
ekegusii: Abanto abwo bakoirogete ’mbandore bagoke, ekiagera ’nsemeretie ring’ana riao.
swahili: Wakuchao wafurahie wanaponiona, kwa kuwa nimeweka tumaini langu katika neno lako.

english: I know, O LORD, that Your judgments are righteous, and that in faithfulness You have afflicted me.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, nimanyete ng’a ebiina biao nebia boronge, naende ase bwegenwa bwao, nigo kwang’eire egesusuro gi’okondongeyia.
swahili: Ee Bwana, ninajua kwamba sheria zako ni za haki, katika uaminifu wako umeniadhibu.

english: May Your loving devotion comfort me, I pray, according to Your promise to Your servant.
ekegusii: Tiga obwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe bondemie, koreng’ana buna kwariire eira ase ’nde, inche omosomba oo.
swahili: Upendo wako usiokoma uwe faraja yangu, sawasawa na ahadi yako kwa mtumishi wako.

english: May Your compassion come to me, that I may live, for Your law is my delight.
ekegusii: Ondorere amaabera, erinde imbe moyo; inche nigo ’ngokerete amachiiko ao.
swahili: Huruma yako na inijie ili nipate kuishi, kwa kuwa naifurahia sheria yako.

english: May the arrogant be put to shame for subverting me with a lie; I will meditate on Your precepts.
ekegusii: Tiga abanto abamwenu barore obosooku, ekiagera bankoreire bobe engencho ende etaiyo, korende inche nigo ’nkona koiranerera amachiiko ao.
swahili: Wenye majivuno na waaibishwe kwa kunikosea mimi bila sababu, lakini mimi nitatafakari juu ya mausia yako.

english: May those who fear You turn to me, those who know Your testimonies.
ekegusii: Tiga abanto abwo bakoirogete bache ase ’nde. Abwo bamanyete oborori bwao.
swahili: Wale wakuchao na wanigeukie mimi, hao ambao wanazielewa sheria zako.

english: I will keep Your statutes; do not utterly forsake me. BETH
ekegusii: Ninyigwere amachiiko ao; tobaisa gontiga. Okoigwera amachiiko Omonene
swahili: Nitayatii maagizo yako; usiniache kabisa. Kutii Sheria Ya Bwana

english: May my heart be blameless in Your statutes, that I may not be put to shame. KAPH
ekegusii: Tiga enkoro yane ebe etari na komocha ase emeroberio yao echiikire, erinde timbaisa konyora obosooku. Ogosaba Gw’okonyora Ogotoorigwa
swahili: Moyo wangu usiwe na lawama katika kutii maagizo yako, ili nisiaibishwe. Maombi Kwa Ajili Ya Kuokolewa

english: My soul faints for Your salvation; I wait for Your word.
ekegusii: Omoyo one oganyoire ase okogania ogotooreka kwao, nigo ’nsemeretie ring’ana riao.
swahili: Nafsi yangu inazimia kwa kutamani wokovu wako, lakini nimeweka tumaini langu katika neno lako.

english: My eyes fail, looking for Your promise; I ask, “When will You comfort me?”
ekegusii: Amaiso aane asundokire ase okoganya ring’ana riao, nigo ’nkoboria, “Indi aye orache kondemia?”
swahili: Macho yangu yamefifia, nikingoja ahadi yako; ninasema, “Utanifajiri lini?”

english: Though I am like a wineskin dried up by smoke, I do not forget Your statutes.
ekegusii: Inche nabeire buna ekerandi gi’edivai gekorire korwa ase risankwa kere ase erioki, nonya naboigo, tindeba emeroberio yao echiikire.
swahili: Ingawa nimekuwa kama kiriba kwenye moshi, bado sijasahau maagizo yako.

english: How many days must Your servant wait? When will You execute judgment on my persecutors?
ekegusii: Ngoika ririri inche omosomba oo ’ndagenderere koremereria? Ndiriri oranache ekiina ase abachaandi baane?
swahili: Mtumishi wako itampasa angoje mpaka lini? Ni lini utawaadhibu washtaki wangu?

english: The arrogant have dug pits for me in violation of Your law.
ekegusii: Abanto abamwenu batabwateti amachiiko ao nigo bankuunyeire emetaro.
swahili: Wenye majivuno wananichimbia mashimo, kinyume na sheria yako.

english: All Your commandments are faithful; I am persecuted without cause—help me!
ekegusii: Amachiiko ao onsi nigo are ay’ekeene, korende abanto nigo bagonchaanda ase okong’aacha. Koranche onkonye!
swahili: Amri zako zote ni za kuaminika; unisaidie, kwa sababu watu wananishtaki bila sababu.

english: They almost wiped me from the earth, but I have not forsaken Your precepts.
ekegusii: Barabwo babeire ang’e gonsiria aiga ase ense, nonya naboigo, tintigeti amachiiko ao.
swahili: Walikaribia kabisa kunifuta kutoka uso wa dunia, lakini sijaacha mausia yako.

english: Revive me according to Your loving devotion, that I may obey the testimony of Your mouth. LAMEDH
ekegusii: Ing’a obogima oboyia ase engencho y’obwanchani bwao bwa botambe, erinde ’mbwatie oborori bwao gwakwanete. Okoba Nokwegena ase Amachiiko y’Omonene
swahili: Yahifadhi maisha yangu sawasawa na upendo wako, nami nitatii sheria za kinywa chako. Imani Katika Sheria Ya Bwana

english: Your word, O LORD, is everlasting; it is firmly fixed in the heavens.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ring’ana riao nigo riteneine bokong’u aaria igoro goika kare na kare.
swahili: Ee Bwana, neno lako ni la milele, linasimama imara mbinguni.

english: How can a young man keep his way pure? By guarding it according to Your word.
ekegusii: Naki omonto omosae arakore arende obochenu bw’obogima bwaye? Nase okorenda orogeendo rwaye kobwatekana ne ring’ana riao.
swahili: Kijana aifanye njia yake kuwa safi jinsi gani? Ni kwa kutii, akilifuata neno lako.

english: Your faithfulness continues through all generations; You established the earth, and it endures.
ekegusii: Obwegenwa bwao nigo bogendererete ase ebiaare bionsi; aye gwatenenirie ense aase aye, ero nigo eteneine bokong’u.
swahili: Uaminifu wako unaendelea kwa vizazi vyote, umeiumba dunia, nayo inadumu.

english: Your ordinances stand to this day, for all things are servants to You.
ekegusii: Ebinto bionsi nigo bigendererete kobao goika reero buna aye kwabichiigete, ekiagera bionsi nigo bikogokorera.
swahili: Sheria zako zinadumu hadi leo, kwa kuwa vitu vyote vinakutumikia.

english: If Your law had not been my delight, then I would have perished in my affliction.
ekegusii: Onye ogochika kwao gotarenge omogooko one nanga nigo nasirete ase emechando yane.
swahili: Kama nisingefurahia sheria yako, ningeangamia katika taabu zangu.

english: I will never forget Your precepts, for by them You have revived me.
ekegusii: Inche tinkonyaara kweba amachiiko ao, ekiagera aye kwang’eire obogima oboyia goetera ase aro.
swahili: Sitasahau mausia yako kamwe, kwa maana kwayo umehifadhi maisha yangu.

english: I am Yours; save me, for I have sought Your precepts.
ekegusii: Inche noyoo, ntoorie! Nigo nabeire ’nkona‐koinyora amachiiko ao.
swahili: Uniokoe, kwa maana mimi ni wako, kwa kuwa nimetafuta mausia yako.

english: The wicked wait to destroy me, but I will ponder Your testimonies.
ekegusii: Abakori amabe nigo bakomboera ng’a bansirie, korende nigo ’nyigwerete oborori bwao.
swahili: Waovu wanangojea kuniangamiza, bali mimi ninatafakari sheria zako.

english: I have seen a limit to all perfection, but Your commandment is without limit. MEM
ekegusii: Narorire ng’a gento kende tikeri kere noboikeranu, korende amachiiko ao namaikeranu. Okoba Nobwanchani ase Amachiiko y’Omonene
swahili: Katika ukamilifu wote ninaona mna kikomo, lakini amri zako hazina mpaka. Kuipenda Sheria Ya Bwana

english: Oh, how I love Your law! All day long it is my meditation.
ekegusii: Aa! Naki inyanchete amachiiko ao! Naro nkona‐koiranerera omobaso boira.
swahili: Aha! Tazama, sheria yako naipenda mno ajabu. Ninaitafakari mchana kutwa.

english: Your commandments make me wiser than my enemies, for they are always with me.
ekegusii: Amachiiko ao nigo agonkora naba omong’aini kobua ababisa baane, ekiagera ayio nigo are ase ’nde chingaki chionsi.
swahili: Amri zako zimenipa hekima zaidi kuliko adui zangu, kwa kuwa nimezishika daima.

english: I have more insight than all my teachers, for Your testimonies are my meditation.
ekegusii: Inche nigo ’nde nokomanya okonge kobua aborokia baane, ekiagera nigo ’nkona‐korengereria mono igoro y’oborori bwao.
swahili: Nina akili zaidi kuliko walimu wangu wote, kwa kuwa ninatafakari juu ya sheria zako.

english: In the LORD I take refuge. How then can you say to me: “Flee like a bird to your mountain!
ekegusii: Omonene nere obotemero bwane! Nase ki rende mogonteebia: “Iruruka buna enyoni ogende gochia ebitunwa igoro?
swahili: Kwa Bwana ninakimbilia, unawezaje basi kuniambia: “Ruka kama ndege kwenye mlima wako.

english: For behold, the wicked bend their bows. They set their arrow on the string to shoot from the shadows at the upright in heart.
ekegusii: Rigereria abakori amabe buna batingire amata abo, babekire chinsara chiabo ang’e ase chingori chi’amata, erinde barase abanto bare ne chinkoro chindonge.
swahili: Hebu tazama, waovu wanapinda pinde zao, huweka mishale kwenye uzi wake, wakiwa gizani ili kuwapiga wale wanyofu wa moyo.

english: If the foundations are destroyed, what can the righteous do?”
ekegusii: Onye amaroso atagoirwe, ngento ki omonto omooronge arakore?”
swahili: Wakati misingi imeharibiwa, mwenye haki anaweza kufanya nini?”

english: The LORD is in His holy temple; the LORD is on His heavenly throne. His eyes are watching closely; they examine the sons of men.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo are ime ye Hekalu yaye enchenu, ekerogo kiaye ki’obonene naaria igoro kere. Amaiso aye nigo amongerete, nigo arigereretie na korenga Mwanyabaanto.
swahili: Bwana yuko ndani ya Hekalu lake takatifu; Bwana yuko kwenye kiti chake cha enzi mbinguni. Huwaangalia wana wa watu, macho yake yanawajaribu.

english: The LORD tests the righteous and the wicked; His soul hates the lover of violence.
ekegusii: Omonene arengete abare abaronge na abakori amabe, korende omoyo oye nigo ogechete abakori amabe na abagoita abande ase obotindi bwa bosa.
swahili: Bwana huwajaribu wenye haki, lakini waovu na wanaopenda jeuri, nafsi yake huwachukia.

english: On the wicked He will rain down fiery coals and sulfur; a scorching wind will be their portion.
ekegusii: Natwerie abakori amabe omorero bw’amakara, amagena agosamba na omwaga ore n’oroguto rw’omorero, ’ng’a bibe egesusuro kiabo.
swahili: Atawanyeshea waovu makaa ya moto mkali na kiberiti kinachowaka, upepo wenye joto kali ndio fungu lao.

english: For the LORD is righteous; He loves justice. The upright will see His face.
ekegusii: Omonene nomonyene oboronge, nigo anchete ogokora kw’oboronge; abanto abare ne chinkoro chindonge mbarore obosio bwaye.
swahili: Kwa kuwa Bwana ni mwenye haki, yeye hupenda haki. Wanyofu watauona uso wake.

english: In my distress I cried to the LORD, and He answered me.
ekegusii: Ekero ’nde n’emechando nigo ’nkorera ase Omonene, ere nigo akonyigwa.
swahili: Katika dhiki yangu namwita Bwana, naye hunijibu.

english: Deliver my soul, O LORD, from lying lips and a deceitful tongue.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ’ntoorie korwa ase abanto abanyaborimo, bare ne chimeme chi’obong’ainereria.
swahili: Ee Bwana, uniokoe kutoka midomo ya uongo na ndimi za udanganyifu.

english: What will He do to you, and what will be added to you, O deceitful tongue?
ekegusii: Inwe abamore ne chimeme chi’obong’ainereria, ngento ki moraegwe, na mang’ana ki naende morakorerwe?
swahili: Atakufanyia nini, au akufanyie nini zaidi, ewe ulimi mdanganyifu?

english: Sharp arrows will come from the warrior, with burning coals of the broom tree!
ekegusii: Mobetwe chinsara chinyoge chi’omorwani etuoni, na mosambwe n’omorero bw’amakara ’omote okorokwa omoretemu.
swahili: Atakuadhibu kwa mishale mikali ya shujaa, kwa makaa yanayowaka ya mti wa mretemu.

english: Woe to me that I dwell in Meshech, that I live among the tents of Kedar!
ekegusii: Obobe nobwane, ekiagera ’nde omomenyi agwo Meseki, nigo imenyete ase egati y’Abakedari.
swahili: Ole wangu kwa kuwa naishi Mesheki, kwamba naishi katikati ya hema za Kedari!

english: Too long have I dwelt among those who hate peace.
ekegusii: Nabeire imenyete ase engaki entambe ase egati y’ abanto bageechete omorembe.
swahili: Nimeishi muda mrefu mno miongoni mwa wale wanaochukia amani.

english: I am in favor of peace; but when I speak, they want war.
ekegusii: Inche nigo ’ngokora omorembe, korende ekero ’ngokwana, barabwo nigo baganetie esegi.
swahili: Mimi ni mtu wa amani; lakini ninaposema, wao wanataka vita.

english: I lift up my eyes to the hills. From where does my help come?
ekegusii: Ninyimokererie amaiso aane gochia ase ebitunwa. Ogokonywa kwane, ng’ai korarwe?
swahili: Nayainua macho yangu nitazame vilima, msaada wangu utatoka wapi?

english: My help comes from the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth.
ekegusii: Ogokonywa kwane nigo korarwe ase Omonene, oyotongete igoro na ense.
swahili: Msaada wangu hutoka kwa Bwana, Muumba wa mbingu na dunia.

english: He will not allow your foot to slip; your Protector will not slumber.
ekegusii: Ere tagotiga okogoro kwao gotererigwe; oyokorendete tagosundoka.
swahili: Hatauacha mguu wako uteleze, yeye akulindaye hatasinzia,

english: Behold, the Protector of Israel will neither slumber nor sleep.
ekegusii: Ee, ere omorendi bw’Abaisraeli tagosundoka, gose takorara.
swahili: hakika, yeye alindaye Israeli hatasinzia wala hatalala usingizi.

english: The LORD is your keeper; the LORD is the shade on your right hand.
ekegusii: Omonene nere omorendi oo, nere ekiriri kiao ase ensemo y’okoboko kwao kwa borio.
swahili: Bwana anakulinda, Bwana ni uvuli wako mkono wako wa kuume,

english: The sun will not strike you by day, nor the moon by night.
ekegusii: Erioba tirikogoaka omobaso, gose omotienyi obotuko.
swahili: jua halitakudhuru mchana, wala mwezi wakati wa usiku.

english: The LORD will guard you from all evil; He will preserve your soul.
ekegusii: Omonene nakorende korwa ase amabe onsi, narende omoyo oo.
swahili: Bwana atakukinga na madhara yote, atayalinda maisha yako,

english: The LORD will watch over your coming and going, both now and forevermore.
ekegusii: Omonene nakorende kogosoa na kogosoka, korwa bono na goika kare na kare.
swahili: Bwana atakulinda unapoingia na unapotoka, tangu sasa na hata milele.

english: I was glad when they said to me, “Let us go to the house of the LORD.”
ekegusii: Nigo nagogete na baria banteebetie, “Inchuo, togende ase enyomba y’Omonene!”
swahili: Nilishangilia pamoja na wale walioniambia, “Twende nyumbani ya Bwana.”

english: Our feet are standing in your gates, O Jerusalem.
ekegusii: Aye Yerusalemu, bono amagoro aito nigo ateneine aa ase ebiita biao.
swahili: Ee Yerusalemu, miguu yetu imesimama malangoni mwako.

english: Jerusalem is built up as a city united together,
ekegusii: Aye Yerusalemu kwaagachirwe naende aye n’omochie obwateranirie amo.
swahili: Yerusalemu imejengwa vyema kama mji ambao umeshikamanishwa pamoja.

english: where the tribes go up, the tribes of the LORD, as a testimony for Israel, to give thanks to the name of the LORD.
ekegusii: Agwo nao ebisaku bigotiira gochia, ebio bire ebisaku bi’Omonene. Abaisraeli abwo nigo bachigetwe ng’a babe bakoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono ase erieta ri’Omonene.
swahili: Huko ndiko makabila hukwea, makabila ya Bwana, kulisifu jina la Bwana kulingana na maagizo waliopewa Israeli.

english: For there the thrones of judgment stand, the thrones of the house of David.
ekegusii: Agwo nao ebirogo bi’abanachi ebiina bire, ebirogo bi’obonene bi’enyomba ya Daudi.
swahili: Huko viti vya enzi vya hukumu hukaa, viti vya enzi vya nyumba ya Daudi.

english: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: “May those who love you prosper.
ekegusii: Sabera Yerusalemu, erinde obe n’omorembe! Abanto abwo bagwanchete tiga basesenigwe.
swahili: Omba kwa ajili ya amani ya Yerusalemu: “Wote wakupendao na wawe salama.

english: May there be peace within your walls, and prosperity inside your fortresses.”
ekegusii: Omorembe obe ase chindwaki chiao ime, na ogosesenigwa kobe ase chinyomba chiao chi’oborwoti.
swahili: Amani na iwepo ndani ya kuta zako na usalama ndani ya ngome zako.”

english: For the sake of my brothers and friends, I will say, “Peace be within you.”
ekegusii: Ase engencho y’abaminto na abagisangio baane, nigo ’ngokoganeria omorembe.
swahili: Kwa ajili ya ndugu zangu na marafiki, nitasema, “Amani iwe ndani yako.”

english: For the sake of the house of the LORD our God, I will seek your prosperity.
ekegusii: Ase engencho y’enyomba y’Omonene Nyasae oito ningosabere ebisio.
swahili: Kwa ajili ya nyumba ya Bwana Mungu wetu, nitatafuta mafanikio yako.

english: I lift up my eyes to You, the One enthroned in heaven.
ekegusii: Ninyimokererie amaiso aane goocha agwo asore, igoro ase obomenyo bwao.
swahili: Ninayainua macho yangu kwako, kwako wewe ambaye kiti chako cha enzi kiko mbinguni.

english: As the eyes of servants look to the hand of their master, as the eyes of a maidservant look to the hand of her mistress, so our eyes are on the LORD our God until He shows us mercy.
ekegusii: Ama! Buna koreng’ana abasomba basemeretie omonene obo, na abasomba abaiseke basemeretie omoteneneri obo omokungu; naboigo naintwe tosemeretie Omonene Nyasae oito, goika abe otororeire amaabera.
swahili: Kama vile macho ya watumwa yatazamavyo mkono wa bwana wao, kama vile macho ya mtumishi wa kike yatazamavyo mkono wa bibi yake, ndivyo macho yetu yamtazamavyo Bwana Mungu wetu, mpaka atakapotuhurumia.

english: Have mercy on us, O LORD, have mercy, for we have endured much contempt.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, otororere amaabera, koranche otororere amaabera, ekiagera twabeire togochecherigwa mono goetania.
swahili: Uturehemu, Ee Bwana, uturehemu, kwa maana tumevumilia dharau nyingi.

english: We have endured much scorn from the arrogant, much contempt from the proud.
ekegusii: Twaichoirwe n’echaayo y’abwo beisanekerete, na ogochecherigwa kw’abamwenu.
swahili: Tumevumilia dhihaka nyingi kutoka kwa wenye kiburi, dharau nyingi kutoka kwa wenye majivuno.

english: If the LORD had not been on our side— let Israel now declare—
ekegusii: Inee! Naki yare goocha koba onye Omonene atabeete ase ensemo yaito? Tiga Abaisraeli bairanerie.
swahili: Kama Bwana asingalikuwa upande wetu; Israeli na aseme sasa:

english: if the LORD had not been on our side when men attacked us,
ekegusii: Onye Omonene atabeete ase ensemo yaito, ekero abanto batoumokerete gotorwania,
swahili: kama Bwana asingalikuwa upande wetu, wakati watu walipotushambulia,

english: when their anger flared against us, then they would have swallowed us alive,
ekegusii: nanga nigo batomerete gatore moyo, ekiagera babete n’endamwamu enene ase tore;
swahili: wakati hasira yao ilipowaka dhidi yetu, wangalitumeza tungali hai,

english: then the floods would have engulfed us, then the torrent would have overwhelmed us,
ekegusii: naende emerindo nigo yarenge goocha gotokorobanania, eooro nigo yarenge goocha goeta igoro yaito;
swahili: mafuriko yangalitugharikisha, maji mengi yangalitufunika,

english: then the raging waters would have swept us away.
ekegusii: ee, amaache aichoreranete nigo arenge goocha gotomera kegima.
swahili: maji yaendayo kasi yangalituchukua.

english: Blessed be the LORD, who has not given us as prey to their teeth.
ekegusii: Omonene atogigwe, ekiagera tatoruete totaboranwe namaino y’ abanto abwo.
swahili: Bwana asifiwe, yeye ambaye hakuruhusu turaruliwe kwa meno yao.

english: We have escaped like a bird from the snare of the fowler; the net is torn, and we have slipped away.
ekegusii: Emioyo yaito yatoorekire buna enyoni egotooreka korwa ase egesuguni ki’omotegi. Egesuguni kiabutokire, naintwe twaminchoirie na gotama.
swahili: Tumeponyoka kama ndege kutoka mtego wa mwindaji; mtego umevunjika, nasi tukaokoka.

english: Our help is in the name of the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth.
ekegusii: Ogokonywa gwaito nigo gokorwa ase erieta ri’Omonene, oyio otongete igoro na ense.
swahili: Msaada wetu ni katika jina la Bwana, Muumba wa mbingu na dunia.

english: Those who trust in the LORD are like Mount Zion. It cannot be moved; it abides forever.
ekegusii: Abwo bamosemeretie Omonene nigo banga buna egetunwa gia Sayoni getari konyegerigwa, korende nigo kegendererete kobao botambe.
swahili: Wale wamtumainio Bwana ni kama mlima Sayuni, ambao hauwezi kutikisika, bali wadumu milele.

english: As the mountains surround Jerusalem, so the LORD surrounds His people, both now and forevermore.
ekegusii: Buna ebitunwa bietanaine Yerusalemu, naboigo Omonene abaetanaine abanto baye korwa bono na goika kare na kare.
swahili: Kama milima inavyozunguka Yerusalemu, ndivyo Bwana anavyowazunguka watu wake sasa na hata milele.

english: For the scepter of the wicked will not rest upon the land allotted to the righteous, so that the righteous will not put forth their hands to injustice.
ekegusii: Enyimbo y’obogaambi y’abakori amabe tekogenderera kogambera omwando bw’ abanto abaronge; abwo baabaise korambora amaboko abo ase ogokora amabe.
swahili: Fimbo ya waovu haitadumu juu ya nchi waliopewa wenye haki, ili wenye haki wasije wakatumia mikono yao kutenda ubaya.

english: Do good, O LORD, to those who are good, and to the upright in heart.
ekegusii: Omonene, bakorere amaya abanto abwo bare abaya, abwo bare ne chinkoro chinyegenwa!
swahili: Ee Bwana, watendee mema walio wema, wale walio wanyofu wa moyo.

english: But those who turn to crooked ways the LORD will banish with the evildoers. Peace be upon Israel.
ekegusii: Korende abwo bakogobera gochia ase chinchera chiabo chi’obosiru, Omonene nabarusieo amo nabagokora amabe. Omorembe obe ase Abaisraeli!
swahili: Bali wale wanaogeukia njia zilizopotoka, Bwana atawafukuza pamoja na watenda mabaya. Amani iwe juu ya Israeli.

english: When the LORD restored the captives of Zion, we were like dreamers.
ekegusii: Ekero Omonene atoiraneretie intwe Abasayoni ebisio bieito, nigo twabeete buna abakoroota!
swahili: Bwana alipowarejeza mateka Sayuni, tulikuwa kama watu walioota ndoto.

english: Then our mouths were filled with laughter, our tongues with shouts of joy. Then it was said among the nations, “The LORD has done great things for them.”
ekegusii: Erio emenwa yaito egaichorwa namaseko, ne chimeme chiaito chigatera as’omogooko. Erio abanto b’ebisaku bagateebania, “Omonene okoreire abanto abwo amang’ana amanene.”
swahili: Vinywa vyetu vilijaa kicheko, ndimi zetu zilijaa nyimbo za shangwe. Ndipo iliposemwa miongoni mwa mataifa, “ Bwana amewatendea mambo makuu.”

english: The LORD has done great things for us; we are filled with joy.
ekegusii: Ee, Omonene otokoreire amang’ana amanene; ase igo ntore n’omogooko.
swahili: Bwana ametutendea mambo makuu, nasi tumejaa furaha.

english: Restore our captives, O LORD, like streams in the Negev.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, toiranerie ebisio biaito, buna okoirania chindooche ase Ense ya Irianyi.
swahili: Ee Bwana, turejeshee watu wetu waliotekwa, kama vijito katika Negebu.

english: Those who sow in tears will reap with shouts of joy.
ekegusii: Abwo bakobusura bare namariga mbagese bare nomochengo.
swahili: Wapandao kwa machozi watavuna kwa nyimbo za shangwe.

english: He who goes out weeping, bearing a trail of seed, will surely return with shouts of joy, carrying sheaves of grain.
ekegusii: Nigo bagosoka bakoiyeria amariga, babogoretie chimbusuro gochia kobusura mbairane bare n’omochengo, babogoretie emesaima yabo bagesire.
swahili: Yeye azichukuaye mbegu zake kwenda kupanda, huku akilia, atarudi kwa nyimbo za shangwe, akichukua miganda ya mavuno yake.

english: Unless the LORD builds the house, its builders labor in vain; unless the LORD protects the city, its watchmen stand guard in vain.
ekegusii: Onye Omonene takoagaacha enyomba, abwo bakoyeagaacha nigo bagokora emeremo ya bosa. Onye Omonene takorenda omochie omonto oyio okoyorenda nigo akorenda bosa.
swahili: Bwana asipoijenga nyumba, wajengao hufanya kazi bure. Bwana asipoulinda mji, walinzi wakesha bure.

english: In vain you rise early and stay up late, toiling for bread to eat— for He gives sleep to His beloved.
ekegusii: Nigo ere bosa ase more kobooka mambia chuni na gokora emeremo emekong’u ase okonyora endagera, naende mwanyorwa gochia korara. Korende Omonene nigo agwechaandera abanto baye anchete, nonya nekero baraire chitoro.
swahili: Mnajisumbua bure kuamka mapema na kuchelewa kulala, mkitaabikia chakula: kwa maana yeye huwapa usingizi wapenzi wake.

english: Children are indeed a heritage from the LORD, and the fruit of the womb is His reward.
ekegusii: Rora, abana nigo bare omwando okorwa ase Omonene, ekiagera oroiboro rokorwa ase enda nigo rore ekeegwa.
swahili: Wana ni urithi utokao kwa Bwana, watoto ni zawadi kutoka kwake.

english: Like arrows in the hand of a warrior, so are children born in one’s youth.
ekegusii: Abana omonto akonyora kare ne’chinguru chi’obosae bwaye, nigo banga buna chinsara chire koboko kw’omorwani etuoni.
swahili: Kama mishale mikononi mwa shujaa ndivyo walivyo wana awazaao mtu katika ujana wake.

english: Blessed is the man whose quiver is full of them. He will not be put to shame when he confronts the enemies at the gate.
ekegusii: Nasesenirie omonto oyo oichoretie esaaro yaye ne chinsara echio. Oyio takobugwa ekero arabe okogamberana nababisa baye agwo ase ekegambero gia’etureti.
swahili: Heri mtu ambaye podo lake limejazwa nao. Hawataaibishwa wanaposhindana na adui zao langoni.

english: Blessed are all who fear the LORD, who walk in His ways!
ekegusii: Naki agasesenirie omonto omoirogete Omonene, naende obwatete chinchera chiaye!
swahili: Heri ni wale wote wamchao Bwana, waendao katika njia zake.

english: For when you eat the fruit of your labor, blessings and prosperity will be yours.
ekegusii: Aye nobe gokonyora okwama kw’emeremo y’amaboko ao; nosesenigwe, na amang’ana onsi nigo arabe buya asore.
swahili: Utakula matunda ya kazi yako; baraka na mafanikio vitakuwa vyako.

english: Your wife will be like a fruitful vine flourishing within your house, your sons like olive shoots sitting around your table.
ekegusii: Mokao nabe ase enyomba yao buna omosabibu okwama amasabibu; abana bao nigo barabe buna ebisabo bi’omozeituni, baikaranse baetanane emesa yao.
swahili: Mke wako atakuwa kama mzabibu uzaao ndani ya nyumba yako; wana wako watakuwa kama machipukizi ya mizeituni kuizunguka meza yako.

english: In this way indeed shall blessing come to the man who fears the LORD.
ekegusii: Ama! Naboigo omonto oria omoirogete Omonene arasesenigwe.
swahili: Hivyo ndivyo atakavyobarikiwa mtu amchaye Bwana.

english: May the LORD bless you from Zion, that you may see the prosperity of Jerusalem all the days of your life,
ekegusii: Omonene agosesenie korwa Sayoni! Erio orore obuya bwa Yerusalemu ase amatuko onsi ore moyo,
swahili: Bwana na akubariki kutoka Sayuni siku zote za maisha yako, na uone mafanikio ya Yerusalemu,

english: that you may see your children’s children. Peace be upon Israel!
ekegusii: naende orore abaachokoro bao. Omorembe obe ase Abaisraeli!
swahili: nawe ujaliwe kuishi uone watoto wa watoto wako. Amani iwe juu ya Israeli.

english: Many a time they have persecuted me from my youth— let Israel now declare—
ekegusii: “Ababisa nigo batochaandete korwa oboke bwaito.” Nabo Abaisraeli bagoteeba.
swahili: Wamenionea mno tangu ujana wangu; Israeli na aseme sasa:

english: many a time they have persecuted me from my youth, but they have not prevailed against me.
ekegusii: “Ee, barabwo nigo batochaandete korwa oboke bwaito, korende tibana‐gotobua.
swahili: wamenionea mno tangu ujana wangu, lakini bado hawajanishinda.

english: The plowmen plowed over my back; they made their furrows long.
ekegusii: Bakang’ororia emegongo yaito buna emegondo. Bakayetambeyia emeng’ororia yaabo.”
swahili: Wakulima wamelima mgongo wangu, na kufanya mifereji yao mirefu.

english: The LORD is righteous; He has cut me from the cords of the wicked.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo are omonyene oboronge, ere obutoire chingori chi’abakori amabe.
swahili: Lakini Bwana ni mwenye haki; amenifungua toka kamba za waovu.

english: May all who hate Zion be turned back in shame.
ekegusii: Abwo bonsi bageechete Sayoni, taga basookigwe na koiranigwa magega.
swahili: Wale wote waichukiao Sayuni na warudishwe nyuma kwa aibu.

english: May they be like grass on the rooftops, which withers before it can grow,
ekegusii: Barabwo tiga babe buna obonyansi bore kerama igoro, bogosusana botarakina;
swahili: Wawe kama majani juu ya paa, ambayo hunyauka kabla hayajakua;

english: unable to fill the hands of the reaper, or the arms of the binder of sheaves.
ekegusii: tibori goichora okoboko kw’omosangereria, gose kobogwa omosaima okoboko.
swahili: kwa hayo mvunaji hawezi kujaza vitanga vyake, wala akusanyaye kujaza mikono yake.

english: May none who pass by say to them, “The blessing of the LORD be on you; we bless you in the name of the LORD.”
ekegusii: Abanto bagoeta inchera tibakonyaara goteeba, “Omonene abasesenie!” Gose goteeba, “Nkobasesenia tore inwe ase erieta ri’Omonene!”
swahili: Wale wapitao karibu na wasiseme, “Baraka ya Bwana iwe juu yako; tunakubariki katika jina la Bwana.”

english: Help, O LORD, for the godly are no more; the faithful have vanished from among men.
ekegusii: Omonene, gaki ayerera totoorie! Abakoirogete aye Nyasae baerire, abegenwa tibari konyorekana ase Mwanyabaanto.
swahili: Bwana tusaidie, kwa kuwa wacha Mungu wametoweka; waaminifu wametoweka miongoni mwa wanadamu.

english: They lie to one another; they speak with flattering lips and a double heart.
ekegusii: Abanto bonsi nigo bagoteebania amang’ana ’oborimo; nigo bare okong’o nyamenwa ebere na gokwana amang’ana ay’okweansia.
swahili: Kila mmoja humwambia jirani yake uongo; midomo yao ya hila huzungumza kwa udanganyifu.

english: May the LORD cut off all flattering lips and every boastful tongue.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, koranche kiria emenwa y’abwo egokwana amang’ana ’okweansia, ne chimeme chi’abwo bagwetogia ase amang’ana y’oboenenu.
swahili: Bwana na akatilie mbali midomo yote ya hila na kila ulimi uliojaa majivuno,

english: They say, “With our tongues we will prevail. We own our lips—who can be our master?”
ekegusii: Barabwo nigo bagoteeba: “Ase amang’ana ’emenwa yaito ntore ne chinguru, aya togokwana nigo agotokonya. Ning’o ore Omonene gotobua?”
swahili: ule unaosema, “Kwa ndimi zetu tutashinda; midomo ni mali yetu, bwana wetu ni nani?”

english: “For the cause of the oppressed and for the groaning of the needy, I will now arise,” says the LORD. “I will bring safety to him who yearns.”
ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: “Bono ninchiche, ekiagera abataka baregirwe na abaremerwa nkorera bare. Nindwe oborendi obuya kegima ase abwo basemeretie kobonyora.”
swahili: “Kwa sababu ya uonevu wa wanyonge na kulia kwa uchungu kwa wahitaji, nitainuka sasa,” asema Bwana. “Nitawalinda kutokana na wale wenye nia mbaya juu yao.”

english: The words of the LORD are flawless, like silver refined in a furnace, like gold purified sevenfold.
ekegusii: Amang’ana ’Omonene nigo are ay’obwegenwa naende n’amaachenu, nigo agwekaine efeta yasambirwe ase riera ri’omorero na koumorwa inse, yachenirwe ara gatano na kabere.
swahili: Maneno ya Bwana ni safi, kama fedha iliyosafishwa katika tanuru, iliyosafishwa mara saba.

english: You, O LORD, will keep us; You will forever guard us from this generation.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, otorende! Otorende botambe korwa ase obobe bw’ekegori eke.
swahili: Ee Bwana, utatuweka salama na kutulinda na kizazi hiki milele.

english: The wicked wander freely, and vileness is exalted among men.
ekegusii: Abakori amabe nigo bagoetanana chinsemo chionsi, na obonyaka bonde bwonsi botogigwa ase egati ya Mwanyabaanto.
swahili: Watu waovu huenda wakiringa kila mahali wakati ambapo yule aliye mbaya sana ndiye anayeheshimiwa miongoni mwa watu.

english: Out of the depths I cry to You, O LORD!
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, nigo nkorera asore, korwa ase chindiba ime.
swahili: Kutoka vilindini ninakulilia, Ee Bwana.

english: O Lord, hear my voice; let Your ears be attentive to my plea for mercy.
ekegusii: Omonene, igwa eriogi riane; tegerera oigwe eriogi ri’ogosaba kwane.
swahili: Ee Bwana, sikia sauti yangu. Masikio yako na yawe masikivu kwa kilio changu unihurumie.

english: If You, O LORD, kept track of iniquities, then who, O Lord, could stand?
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, onye ’nkware gokora omobaro bw’ebibe, ning’o ore konyaara gotenena ase obosio bwao?
swahili: Kama wewe, Ee Bwana, ungeweka kumbukumbu ya dhambi, Ee Bwana, ni nani angeliweza kusimama?

english: But with You there is forgiveness, so that You may be feared.
ekegusii: Korende aye nigo ore omwaberi, erinde onyaare koirokwa.
swahili: Lakini kwako kuna msamaha, kwa hiyo wewe unaogopwa.

english: I wait for the LORD; my soul does wait, and in His word I put my hope.
ekegusii: Inche nigo ’nganyete Omonene, ee, omoyo one nigo omoganyete; nigo ’nsemeretie ring’ana riaye.
swahili: Namngojea Bwana, nafsi yangu inangojea, katika neno lake naweka tumaini langu.

english: My soul waits for the Lord more than watchmen wait for the morning— more than watchmen wait for the morning.
ekegusii: Omoyo one nigo oganyete Omonene, kobua buna abarendi bakoganya ogokiamoka, ee, kobua abarendi baganyete ng’a bokie.
swahili: Nafsi yangu inamngojea Bwana kuliko walinzi waingojeavyo asubuhi, naam, kuliko walinzi waingojeavyo asubuhi.

english: O Israel, put your hope in the LORD, for with the LORD is loving devotion, and with Him is redemption in abundance.
ekegusii: Inwe Abaisraeli, mosemerie Omonene, ekiagera Omonene nigo are nobwanchani bogendererete botambe, na ogotooreka okonge nigo gokorwa asare.
swahili: Ee Israeli, mtumaini Bwana, maana kwa Bwana kuna upendo usiokoma, na kwake kuna ukombozi kamili.

english: And He will redeem Israel from all iniquity.
ekegusii: Ere naboorie Abaisraeli korwa ase ebibe biabo bionsi.
swahili: Yeye mwenyewe ataikomboa Israeli kutoka dhambi zao zote.

english: My heart is not proud, O LORD, my eyes are not haughty. I do not aspire to great things or matters too lofty for me.
ekegusii: Omonene, ase enkoro yane tindi kweimokereria igoro, gose tindi omwerori. Inche tinyechaandeti kwerigeria amang’ana amanene, gose ayaare amakong’u mono ase ’nde.
swahili: Moyo wangu hauna kiburi, Ee Bwana, macho yangu hayajivuni; sijishughulishi na mambo makuu kunizidi wala mambo ya ajabu mno kwangu.

english: Surely I have stilled and quieted my soul; like a weaned child with his mother, like a weaned child is my soul within me.
ekegusii: Korende inche nigo intoereretie omoyo one; buna omwana otigire okogonka oagatire koboko kwa ng’ina, ee, naboigo omoyo one ore ime yane.
swahili: Lakini nimetuliza na kunyamazisha nafsi yangu; kama mtoto aliyeachishwa kunyonya na mama yake, kama mtoto aliyeachishwa kunyonya ndivyo ilivyo nafsi iliyoko ndani yangu.

english: O Israel, put your hope in the LORD, both now and forevermore.
ekegusii: Inwe Abaisraeli, mosemerie Omonene korwa bono na goika kare na kare.
swahili: Ee Israeli, mtumaini Bwana tangu sasa na hata milele.

english: O LORD, remember on behalf of David all the hardships he endured,
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, oinyore Daudi, ase engencho y’obokong’u bwonsi bwamonyoorete.
swahili: Ee Bwana, mkumbuke Daudi na taabu zote alizozistahimili.

english: For the sake of Your servant David, do not reject Your anointed one.
ekegusii: Ase engencho ya Daudi, omosomba oo, tobaisa kwanga korigereria omoakwa amaguta oo.
swahili: Kwa ajili ya Daudi mtumishi wako, usimkatae mpakwa mafuta wako.

english: The LORD swore an oath to David, a promise He will not revoke: “One of your descendants I will place on your throne.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, tokonyaara gotiga eira eyio kwarierete Daudi ase ogotiana, ogateeba: “Oyomo bw’oroiboro rwao nimobeeke aikaranse ase ekerogo kiao ki’obogaambi.
swahili: Bwana alimwapia Daudi kiapo, kiapo cha uhakika ambacho hatakitangua: “Nitamweka mmoja wa wazao wako mwenyewe katika kiti chako cha enzi,

english: If your sons keep My covenant and the testimony I will teach them, then their sons will also sit on your throne forever and ever.”
ekegusii: Abana bao kobarabwate okobwatana kwane kw’ogotianania, na oborori bwane ’ndaborokererie, rirorio abana baabo boigo ’mbabe bagoikaransa ase ekerogo kiao ki’obogaambi kogenderera botambe.”
swahili: kama wanao watashika Agano langu na sheria ninazowafundisha, ndipo wana wao watarithi kiti chako cha enzi milele na milele.”

english: For the LORD has chosen Zion; He has desired it for His home:
ekegusii: Omonene ochorire Sayoni; nigo aganetie obe obomenyo bwaye, oteebire,
swahili: Kwa maana Bwana ameichagua Sayuni, amepaonea shauku pawe maskani yake:

english: “This is My resting place forever and ever; here I will dwell, for I have desired this home.
ekegusii: “Aase aa nao obotimokero bwane bwa botambe, aa nao ’ndabe ’nkomenya, ekiagera naanchire.
swahili: “Hapa ni mahali pangu pa kupumzika milele na milele; hapa ndipo nitakapoketi nikitawala, kwa sababu nimepaonea shauku:

english: I will bless her with abundant provisions; I will satisfy her poor with bread.
ekegusii: Ninsesenie omochie oyo obe n’ebinto bionsi biganeirie, abaremeire endagera nimbaigotie.
swahili: Nitambariki kwa kumpa mahitaji tele: nitashibisha maskini wake kwa chakula.

english: I will clothe her priests with salvation, and her saints will sing out in joy.
ekegusii: Nimboyie abakuani b’omochie oyo nogotooreka, na abachenu baye ’mbabe bagoaka amariogi y’omogooko.
swahili: Nitawavika makuhani wake wokovu, nao watakatifu wake watadumu wakiimba kwa furaha.

english: There I will make a horn grow for David; I have prepared a lamp for My anointed one.
ekegusii: Aroro agwo nimererie Daudi orogunchara, ekiagera nimwokerie omoakwa amaguta one etaya.
swahili: “Hapa nitamchipushia Daudi pembe, na kuweka taa kwa ajili ya masiya wangu.

english: I will clothe his enemies with shame, but the crown upon him will gleam.”
ekegusii: Ninsookie ababisa baye kegima, korende egutwa y’omotwe oye omonyene negenderere komekameka.”
swahili: Adui zake nitawavika aibu, bali taji kichwani pake itangʼaa sana.”

english: how he swore an oath to the LORD, and vowed to the Mighty One of Jacob:
ekegusii: Oinyore buna ariete eira na gotiana asore aye Omonene ore Chinguru chia Yakobo, agateeba,
swahili: Aliapa kiapo kwa Bwana na akaweka nadhiri kwa Yule Mwenye Nguvu wa Yakobo:

english: “I will not enter my house or get into my bed,
ekegusii: “Tingosoa nyomba mwane, gose tinkoriina borere korara;
swahili: “Sitaingia nyumbani mwangu au kwenda kitandani mwangu:

english: I will not give sleep to my eyes or slumber to my eyelids,
ekegusii: tingwancha korara chitoro, gose gosundoka,
swahili: sitaruhusu usingizi katika macho yangu, wala kope zangu kusinzia,

english: until I find a place for the LORD, a dwelling for the Mighty One of Jacob. ”
ekegusii: goika inyore aase, agwo arabe obomenyo bw’Oyore Chinguru chia Yakobo.”
swahili: mpaka nitakapompatia Bwana mahali, makao kwa ajili ya Yule Mwenye Nguvu wa Yakobo.”

english: We heard that the ark was in Ephrathah; we found it in the fields of Jaar.
ekegusii: Ama! Agwo Efarata tokaigwa amang’ana igoro y’Esanduki y’Okobwatana, tokayenyora aaria ase orosana rwa Yearimu.
swahili: Tulisikia habari hii huko Efrathi, tulikutana nayo katika mashamba ya Yaara:

english: Let us go to His dwelling place; let us worship at His footstool.
ekegusii: “Inchuo togende ase obomenyo bw’Omonene, tosasiime agwo ase egeteni kiaye kia amagoro!”
swahili: “Twendeni kwenye makao yake, na tuabudu kwenye kiti cha kuwekea miguu yake;

english: Arise, O LORD, to Your resting place, You and the ark of Your strength.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, imoka ochiche aase ao ogotimokera, aye amo n’Esanduki eria ekworokia okobua kwao.
swahili: inuka, Ee Bwana, uje mahali pako pa kupumzikia, wewe na Sanduku la nguvu zako.

english: May Your priests be clothed with righteousness, and Your saints shout for joy.
ekegusii: Tiga abakuani bao beboyie oboronge, na abanto bao abachenu babe bagoaka amariogi y’omogooko.
swahili: Makuhani wako na wavikwe haki, watakatifu wako na waimbe kwa furaha.”

english: Behold, how good and pleasant it is when brothers live together in harmony!
ekegusii: Rora buna ere buya na okogokia okonene ekero abanto abamo bakomenya amo, baigwanaine.
swahili: Tazama jinsi ilivyo vyema na kupendeza wakati ndugu wanapoishi pamoja katika umoja!

english: It is like fine oil on the head, running down on the beard, running down Aaron’s beard over the collar of his robes.
ekegusii: Amang’ana ayio nigo anga buna amaguta akweakwa are amaya mono, akonyororoka gochia ase chinderu chia Aroni, aitekera omokoba bwe rigoti ri’omwambaro oye.
swahili: Ni kama mafuta ya thamani yaliyomiminwa kichwani, yakitiririka kwenye ndevu, yakitiririka kwenye ndevu za Aroni, mpaka kwenye upindo wa mavazi yake.

english: It is like the dew of Hermon falling on the mountains of Zion. For there the LORD has bestowed the blessing of life forevermore.
ekegusii: Naende nigo anga buna riime ria Herimoni, rigotonya igoro y’ebitunwa bia Sayoni. Aroro agwo Omonene ochiikire ogosesenigwa na obogima botari nomoerio.
swahili: Ni kama vile umande wa Hermoni unavyoanguka juu ya Mlima Sayuni. Kwa maana huko ndiko Bwana alikoamuru baraka yake, naam, hata uzima milele.

english: Come, bless the LORD, all you servants of the LORD who serve by night in the house of the LORD!
ekegusii: Inchuo motogie Omonene, inwe abasomba baye mwensi, inwe abamokomokorera ase enyomba yaye botuko.
swahili: Msifuni Bwana, ninyi nyote watumishi wa Bwana, ninyi mnaotumika usiku ndani ya nyumba ya Bwana.

english: Lift up your hands to the sanctuary and bless the LORD!
ekegusii: Rambora amaboko aino gochia Aase Aachenu, motogie Omonene!
swahili: Inueni mikono yenu katika pale patakatifu na kumsifu Bwana.

english: May the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth, bless you from Zion.
ekegusii: Omonene, oria otongete igoro na ense, agosesenie korwa Sayoni!
swahili: Naye Bwana, Muumba wa mbingu na dunia, awabariki kutoka Sayuni.

english: Hallelujah! Praise the name of the LORD. Give praise, O servants of the LORD,
ekegusii: Motogie Omonene! Togia erieta ri’Omonene! Inwe abasomba ba Omonene, motogie!
swahili: Msifuni Bwana. Lisifuni jina la Bwana, msifuni, enyi watumishi wa Bwana,

english: He struck down many nations and slaughtered mighty kings:
ekegusii: Omonene nigo asiretie ebisaku ebinge, na agaita abarwoti barenge ne’chinguru;
swahili: Aliyapiga mataifa mengi, na akaua wafalme wenye nguvu:

english: Sihon king of the Amorites, Og king of Bashan, and all the kings of Canaan.
ekegusii: Sihoni, omorwoti bw’Abaamori, na Ogi, omorwoti o Basani; boigo agasiria amarwoti onsi a Kaanani.
swahili: Mfalme Sihoni na Waamori, Ogu mfalme wa Bashani na wafalme wote wa Kanaani:

english: He gave their land as an inheritance, as a heritage to His people Israel.
ekegusii: Ense y’ebisaku ebio akayea Abaisraeli, abanto baye, ekaba omwando obo.
swahili: akatoa nchi yao kuwa urithi, urithi kwa watu wake Israeli.

english: Your name, O LORD, endures forever, Your renown, O LORD, through all generations.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, erieta riao nigo rigendererete kobao goika kare na kare. Nobe gokoinyorwa nebiaare bionsi.
swahili: Ee Bwana, jina lako ladumu milele, kumbukumbu za fahari zako, Ee Bwana, kwa vizazi vyote.

english: For the LORD will vindicate His people and will have compassion on His servants.
ekegusii: Omonene narwanerere abanto baye, narorere abasomba baye amaabera.
swahili: Maana Bwana atawathibitisha watu wake, na kuwahurumia watumishi wake.

english: The idols of the nations are silver and gold, made by the hands of men.
ekegusii: Emegwekano egosasiimwa n’abanto b’ebisaku nigo eroisirie korwa ase chifeta ne chitaabu; nigo ere emeremo y’amaboko a Mwanyabaanto.
swahili: Sanamu za mataifa ni fedha na dhahabu, zilizotengenezwa kwa mikono ya wanadamu.

english: They have mouths, but cannot speak; they have eyes, but cannot see;
ekegusii: Nigo ebwate emenwa, korende teri gokwana, nebwate amaiso, korende teri korora,
swahili: Zina vinywa, lakini haziwezi kusema, zina macho, lakini haziwezi kuona;

english: they have ears, but cannot hear; nor is there breath in their mouths.
ekegusii: nebwate amato, korende teri koigwa, gose tebwati omoika bw’okoeyana.
swahili: zina masikio, lakini haziwezi kusikia, wala hakuna pumzi katika vinywa vyao.

english: Those who make them become like them, as do all who trust in them.
ekegusii: Abakoroisia emegwekano eyio nigo banga buna ero, ee, naboigo abwo bonsi bayiegenete.
swahili: Wale wanaozitengeneza watafanana nazo, vivyo hivyo wale wote wanaozitumainia.

english: O house of Israel, bless the LORD; O house of Aaron, bless the LORD;
ekegusii: Inwe Abaisraeli, togia Omonene! Nainwe ab’ororeeria rwa Aroni, togia Omonene!
swahili: Ee nyumba ya Israeli, msifuni Bwana; ee nyumba ya Aroni, msifuni Bwana;

english: who stand in the house of the LORD, in the courts of the house of our God.
ekegusii: Inwe aba mogotenena ase enyomba y’Omonene, agwo ase chigoora chi’enyomba ya Nyasae oito, motogie!
swahili: ninyi ambao mnatumika ndani ya nyumba ya Bwana, katika nyua za nyumba ya Mungu wetu.

english: O house of Levi, bless the LORD; you who fear the LORD, bless the LORD!
ekegusii: Inwe ab’ororeeria rwa Lawi, togia Omonene! Nainwe abamoirogete Omonene, motogie!
swahili: ee nyumba ya Lawi, msifuni Bwana; ninyi mnaomcha, msifuni Bwana.

english: Blessed be the LORD from Zion— He who dwells in Jerusalem. Hallelujah!
ekegusii: Omonene tiga atogigwe korwa Sayoni, Omonene oria omenyete Yerusalemu. Motogie Omonene!
swahili: Msifuni Bwana kutoka Sayuni, msifuni yeye aishiye Yerusalemu. Msifuni Bwana.

english: Hallelujah, for the LORD is good; sing praises to His name, for it is lovely.
ekegusii: Motogie Omonene, ekiagera ere nigo are omuya, terera erieta riaye, ekiagera nigo rire eriansu.
swahili: Msifuni Bwana, kwa kuwa Bwana ni mwema, liimbieni sifa jina lake, kwa maana hilo lapendeza.

english: For the LORD has chosen Jacob as His own, Israel as His treasured possession.
ekegusii: Omonene bwechooreire Yakobo, bwechooreire Abaisraeli koba aba aye bori.
swahili: Kwa maana Bwana amemchagua Yakobo kuwa wake mwenyewe, Israeli kuwa mali yake ya thamani.

english: For I know that the LORD is great; our Lord is above all gods.
ekegusii: Inche nigo imanyete ng’a Omonene nigo are omonene; ee, Omonene oito nigo are igoro ye’chinyasae chionsi.
swahili: Ninajua ya kuwa Bwana ni mkuu, kwamba Bwana wetu ni mkuu kuliko miungu yote.

english: The LORD does all that pleases Him in the heavens and on the earth, in the seas and in all their depths.
ekegusii: Kende gionsi Omonene agwancha gokora nigo akogekora; gokeraabe ase ense, gose igoro, gose ase enyancha, gose ase chindiba.
swahili: Bwana hufanya lolote apendalo, mbinguni na duniani, katika bahari na vilindi vyake vyote.

english: He causes the clouds to rise from the ends of the earth. He generates the lightning with the rain and brings forth the wind from His storehouses.
ekegusii: Nere okorenta amare korwa ase chinsinyo chi’ense; nere okorenta chinkoba chire nembura, na omwaga okogusa korwa ase ebigancha biaye.
swahili: Hufanya mawingu kupanda kutoka miisho ya dunia; hupeleka umeme wa radi pamoja na mvua na huleta upepo kutoka ghala zake.

english: He struck down the firstborn of Egypt, of both man and beast.
ekegusii: Nere oitete abana abatangi ba Misiri, ne ching’iti chintangi boigo.
swahili: Alimuua mzaliwa wa kwanza wa Misri, mzaliwa wa kwanza wa wanadamu na wanyama.

english: He sent signs and wonders into your midst, O Egypt, against Pharaoh and all his servants.
ekegusii: Nere okorete ebikone na amakumia ase egati yao, aye Misiri, na ase Farao amo nabasomba baye.
swahili: Alipeleka ishara zake na maajabu katikati yako, ee Misri, dhidi ya Farao na watumishi wake wote.

english: Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good. His loving devotion endures forever.
ekegusii: Moakere Omonene ng’a mbuya mono, ekiagera ere nomuya; obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.
swahili: Mshukuruni Bwana, kwa kuwa ni mwema. Fadhili zake zadumu milele.

english: He struck down the firstborn of Egypt His loving devotion endures forever.
ekegusii: Ere nigo aitete abana abatangi ba Misiri, ne ching’iti chintangi boigo, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.
swahili: Kwake yeye aliyemuua mzaliwa wa kwanza wa Misri, Fadhili zake zadumu milele.

english: and brought Israel out from among them His loving devotion endures forever.
ekegusii: Erio akang’anyia Abaisraeli korwa ase Abamisiri, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.
swahili: Na kuwatoa Israeli katikati yao, Fadhili zake zadumu milele.

english: with a mighty hand and an outstretched arm. His loving devotion endures forever.
ekegusii: Akabarusia aroro n’okoboko kwaye gwe chinguru koramboire, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.
swahili: Kwa mkono wenye nguvu ulionyooshwa, Fadhili zake zadumu milele.

english: He divided the Red Sea in two His loving devotion endures forever.
ekegusii: Ere nigo aatananete Enyancha Embariri, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.
swahili: Kwake yeye aliyeigawa Bahari ya Shamu, Fadhili zake zadumu milele.

english: and led Israel through the midst, His loving devotion endures forever.
ekegusii: Erio akaambokeria Abaisraeli aroro, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.
swahili: Na kuwapitisha Israeli katikati yake, Fadhili zake zadumu milele.

english: but swept Pharaoh and his army into the Red Sea. His loving devotion endures forever.
ekegusii: Ere akarimeria Farao amo nemeganda yaye ase Enyancha Embariri, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.
swahili: Lakini alimfagia Farao na jeshi lake katika Bahari ya Shamu, Fadhili zake zadumu milele.

english: He led His people through the wilderness. His loving devotion endures forever.
ekegusii: Ere nigo araaete abanto baye goetera ase erooro, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.
swahili: Kwake yeye aliyewaongoza watu wake katika jangwa, Fadhili zake zadumu milele.

english: He struck down great kings His loving devotion endures forever.
ekegusii: Ere nigo aitete abarwoti barenge ne’chinguru, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.
swahili: Ambaye aliwapiga wafalme wenye nguvu, Fadhili zake zadumu milele.

english: and slaughtered mighty kings— His loving devotion endures forever.
ekegusii: Ere nigo aitete abarwoti abaakumete, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.
swahili: Naye aliwaua wafalme wenye nguvu, Fadhili zake zadumu milele.

english: Sihon king of the Amorites His loving devotion endures forever.
ekegusii: Agaita Sihoni, omorwoti bw’Abaamoni, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.
swahili: Sihoni mfalme wa Waamori, Fadhili zake zadumu milele.

english: Give thanks to the God of gods. His loving devotion endures forever.
ekegusii: Moakere Nyasae, oyobuete chinyasae, ng’a mbuya mono, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.
swahili: Mshukuruni Mungu wa miungu. Fadhili zake zadumu milele.

english: and Og king of Bashan— His loving devotion endures forever.
ekegusii: Agaita na Ogi, omorwoti o Basani, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.
swahili: Ogu mfalme wa Bashani, Fadhili zake zadumu milele.

english: and He gave their land as an inheritance, His loving devotion endures forever.
ekegusii: Akabaura chinse chiabo chikaba omwando bw’ abanto baye, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.
swahili: Akatoa nchi yao kuwa urithi, Fadhili zake zadumu milele.

english: a heritage to His servant Israel. His loving devotion endures forever.
ekegusii: Chinse echio chikaba omwando bw’Abaisraeli, abasomba baye, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.
swahili: Urithi kwa Israeli mtumishi wake, Fadhili zake zadumu milele.

english: He remembered us in our low estate His loving devotion endures forever.
ekegusii: Ere nigo atoinyorete ekero twarenge aboororo, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.
swahili: Aliyetukumbuka katika unyonge wetu, Fadhili zake zadumu milele.

english: and freed us from our enemies. His loving devotion endures forever.
ekegusii: Ere nigo atotooretie korwa ase ababisa baito, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.
swahili: Alituweka huru toka adui zetu, Fadhili zake zadumu milele.

english: He gives food to every creature. His loving devotion endures forever.
ekegusii: Ere nigo akorua endagera oa ebitongwa bionsi bire moyo, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.
swahili: Ambaye humpa chakula kila kiumbe. Fadhili zake zadumu milele.

english: Give thanks to the God of heaven! His loving devotion endures forever.
ekegusii: Moakere Nyasae o igoro ng’a mbuya mono, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.
swahili: Mshukuruni Mungu wa mbinguni, Fadhili zake zadumu milele.

english: Give thanks to the Lord of lords. His loving devotion endures forever.
ekegusii: Moakere Omonene bw’abanene ng’a mbuya mono, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.
swahili: Mshukuruni Bwana wa mabwana: Fadhili zake zadumu milele.

english: He alone does great wonders. His loving devotion endures forever.
ekegusii: Nere bweka okorete amakumia amanene, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.
swahili: Kwake yeye pekee atendaye maajabu makuu, Fadhili zake zadumu milele.

english: By His insight He made the heavens. His loving devotion endures forever.
ekegusii: Ere ase obong’aini bwaye nigo atongete igoro, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.
swahili: Ambaye kwa ufahamu wake aliziumba mbingu, Fadhili zake zadumu milele.

english: He spread out the earth upon the waters. His loving devotion endures forever.
ekegusii: Ere oramborete ense, akayiaara ase amaache, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.
swahili: Ambaye aliitandaza dunia juu ya maji, Fadhili zake zadumu milele.

english: He made the great lights— His loving devotion endures forever.
ekegusii: Ere okorete emebaso eria emenene, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.
swahili: Ambaye aliumba mianga mikubwa, Fadhili zake zadumu milele.

english: the sun to rule the day, His loving devotion endures forever.
ekegusii: Akabeeka risase rigambe mobaso, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.
swahili: Jua litawale mchana, Fadhili zake zadumu milele.

english: the moon and stars to govern the night. His loving devotion endures forever.
ekegusii: Akabeeka omotienyi ne ching’enang’eni bigambe botuko, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.
swahili: Mwezi na nyota vitawale usiku, Fadhili zake zadumu milele.

english: By the rivers of Babylon we sat and wept when we remembered Zion.
ekegusii: Nigo twarenge goikaransa ase chingegu chie chindooche chia Babiloni, twaba tokorera ekero twarenge koinyora Sayoni.
swahili: Kando ya mito ya Babeli tuliketi, tukaomboleza tulipokumbuka Sayuni.

english: There on the willows we hung our harps,
ekegusii: Aroro agwo nigo twasungete amakano aito ase emete enga buna emesobeti.
swahili: Kwenye miti ya huko tulitundika vinubi vyetu,

english: for there our captors requested a song; our tormentors demanded songs of joy: “Sing us a song of Zion.”
ekegusii: Abanto baria batwosete bakagania tobaterere, abachandi abwo baito bakagania tobagokie, bagateeba, “Toterere ogoteera gwa Sayoni.”
swahili: kwa maana huko hao waliotuteka walitaka tuwaimbie nyimbo, watesi wetu walidai nyimbo za furaha; walisema, “Tuimbieni wimbo mmoja kati ya nyimbo za Sayuni!”

english: How can we sing a song of the LORD in a foreign land?
ekegusii: Naki torakore totere ogoteera kw’Omonene ase ense engeni?
swahili: Tutaimbaje nyimbo za Bwana, tukiwa nchi ya kigeni?

english: If I forget you, O Jerusalem, may my right hand cease to function.
ekegusii: Aye Yerusalemu, inse gokweba, rirorio okoboko kwane gw’okorio kogatae.
swahili: Nikikusahau wewe, ee Yerusalemu, basi mkono wangu wa kuume na usahau ujuzi wake.

english: May my tongue cling to the roof of my mouth if I do not remember you, if I do not exalt Jerusalem as my greatest joy!
ekegusii: Onye tingokoinyora aye Yerusalemu, erinde obe omogooko one omonene mono, rirorio tiga oromeme rwane robwatane namang’ang’ura.
swahili: Ulimi wangu ushikamane na kaakaa la kinywa changu kama sitakukumbuka wewe, kama nisipokufikiri Yerusalemu kuwa furaha yangu kubwa.

english: Remember, O LORD, the sons of Edom on the day Jerusalem fell: “Destroy it,” they said, “tear it down to its foundations!”
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, inyora amabe aya abanto b’Edomu bakorete ase rituko riria Yerusalemu obwatetwe; buna bateebete, “Yotagore kegima! Yotagore amo noboroso bwaye!”
swahili: Kumbuka, Ee Bwana, walichokifanya Waedomu, siku ile Yerusalemu ilipoanguka. Walisema, “Bomoa, Bomoa mpaka kwenye misingi yake!”

english: O Daughter of Babylon, doomed to destruction, blessed is he who repays you as you have done to us.
ekegusii: Inwe abanto ba Babiloni nigo mogochia gosirigwa. Nagoke oyio ogochia kobaakana amabe aya mwabeire mogotokorera.
swahili: Ee binti Babeli, uliyehukumiwa kuangamizwa, heri yeye atakayekulipiza wewe kwa yale uliyotutenda sisi:

english: Blessed is he who seizes your infants and dashes them against the rocks.
ekegusii: Nachenge omonto oyio ogochia koira abana baino abake na kobaakera ase amagena y’Ebitare.
swahili: yeye ambaye atawakamata watoto wako wachanga na kuwaponda juu ya miamba.

english: I give You thanks with all my heart; before the gods I sing Your praises.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, nigo ’nkogoakera ng’a mbuya mono n’enkoro yane yonsi, ningoterere na kogotogia ase obosio bwe chinyasae.
swahili: Nitakusifu wewe, Ee Bwana, kwa moyo wangu wote, mbele ya “miungu” nitaimba sifa zako.

english: I bow down toward Your holy temple and give thanks to Your name for Your loving devotion and Your faithfulness; You have exalted Your name and Your word above all else.
ekegusii: Nigo ’nkogosasiima ndigereretie gochia ase Hekalu yao Enchenu, naaka ng’a mbuya mono ase erieta riao, na ase engencho y’obwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe, na ase obwegenwa bwao. Aye gwakorire eira yao koba enene goetania onsi aya erieta riao riatoteebetie.
swahili: Nitasujudu nikielekea Hekalu lako takatifu, nami nitalisifu jina lako kwa ajili ya upendo wako na uaminifu, kwa kuwa umelikuza jina lako na neno lako juu ya vitu vyote.

english: On the day I called, You answered me; You emboldened me and strengthened my soul.
ekegusii: Ase rituko riria nakorangeretie, nigo kwanyigwete, okaremia omoyo one, okambeeka chinguru.
swahili: Nilipoita, ulinijibu; ulinifanya jasiri na mwenye moyo hodari.

english: All the kings of the earth will give You thanks, O LORD, when they hear the words of Your mouth.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, abarwoti bonsi b’ense ’mbagotogie, ekero baraigwe amang’ana akorwa ase omonwa oo;
swahili: Wafalme wote wa dunia wakusifu wewe Ee Bwana, wakati wanaposikia maneno ya kinywa chako.

english: They will sing of the ways of the LORD, for the glory of the LORD is great.
ekegusii: ’mbabe bagotera igoro y’ogokora kwao, aye Omonene, ekiagera obonene bwao nigo bore obonene mono.
swahili: Wao na waimbe kuhusu njia za Bwana, kwa maana utukufu wa Bwana ni mkuu.

english: Though the LORD is on high, He attends to the lowly; but the proud He knows from afar.
ekegusii: Nony’Omonene ore igoro aare, nigo arooche abanto abaitongo, korende abare abaenenu nigo akobamanya kobare aare.
swahili: Ingawa Bwana yuko juu, humwangalia mnyonge, bali mwenye kiburi yeye anamjua kutokea mbali.

english: If I walk in the midst of trouble, You preserve me from the anger of my foes; You extend Your hand, and Your right hand saves me.
ekegusii: Nimba ngoeta ase egati y’emechando, aye nigo ondendete ngenderere koba moyo; aye nigo okorambora okoboko kwao igoro y’ababisa baane bare n’endamwamu, n’okoboko kwao gw’okorio gwantooria.
swahili: Nijapopita katikati ya shida, wewe unayahifadhi maisha yangu, unanyoosha mkono wako dhidi ya hasira ya adui zangu, kwa mkono wako wa kuume unaniokoa.

english: The LORD will fulfill His purpose for me. O LORD, Your loving devotion endures forever— do not abandon the works of Your hands.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, nonyare goikerania aria kwandierete eira, ekiagera obwanchani bwao nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare. Tobaisa kweba emeremo y’amaboko ao.
swahili: Bwana atatimiza kusudi lake kwangu, Ee Bwana, upendo wako wadumu milele: usiziache kazi za mikono yako.

english: O LORD, You have searched me and known me.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene kwariga‐rigirie ime yane, kwamanyire inche.
swahili: Ee Bwana, umenichunguza na kunijua.

english: even there Your hand will guide me; Your right hand will hold me fast.
ekegusii: nonya naroro okoboko kwao ’nkondaae, ee, okoboko kwao gw’okorio ’nkombwate.
swahili: hata huko mkono wako utaniongoza, mkono wako wa kuume utanishika kwa uthabiti.

english: If I say, “Surely the darkness will hide me, and the light become night around me”—
ekegusii: Ninsa goteeba, “Tiga omosunte ontube kegima, na oborabu bong’etanaine boonchoke bobe omosunte”,
swahili: Kama nikisema, “Hakika giza litanificha na nuru inayonizunguka iwe usiku,”

english: even the darkness is not dark to You, but the night shines like the day, for darkness is as light to You.
ekegusii: nonya nomosunte tori omosunte asore, obotuko nigo bokoraba se, bwaba buna omobaso, asore omusunte na oborabu nigo bigwekaine.
swahili: hata giza halitakuwa giza kwako, usiku utangʼaa kama mchana, kwa kuwa giza ni kama nuru kwako.

english: For You formed my inmost being; You knit me together in my mother’s womb.
ekegusii: Naye gwatongete ebire ase enda yane ime, nigo kwambwatanetie amo ase enda ya baba.
swahili: Kwa maana wewe ndiwe uliyeumba utu wangu wa ndani; uliniunga pamoja tumboni mwa mama yangu.

english: I praise You, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Marvelous are Your works, and I know this very well.
ekegusii: Nigo ’nkogotogia, ekiagera natongetwe ase enchera y’ogokumia, na ey’ogoichania. Ogokora kwao nigo kore okuya kw’ogokumia! Igo nimanyete amang’ana ayio buya ase omoyo one.
swahili: Ninakusifu kwa sababu nimeumbwa kwa namna ya ajabu na ya kutisha; kazi zako ni za ajabu, ninajua hayo kikamilifu.

english: My frame was not hidden from You when I was made in secret, when I was woven together in the depths of the earth.
ekegusii: Amauga y’omobere one tabisekanete asore, ekero natongetwe bobisi, ekero nabombetwe ase ense ime.
swahili: Umbile langu halikufichika kwako, nilipoumbwa mahali pa siri. Nilipoungwa pamoja kwa ustadi katika vilindi vya nchi,

english: Your eyes saw my unformed body; all my days were written in Your book and ordained for me before one of them came to be.
ekegusii: Amaiso ao nigo andoche ekero nareenge inche ase enda ya baba ime, amatuko aane onsi nigo arigetwe ase egetabu yao, na akaroberigwa ritang’ani rituko rinde ritaraika.
swahili: macho yako yaliniona kabla mwili wangu haujakamilika. Siku zangu zote ulizonipangia ziliandikwa katika kitabu chako kabla haijakuwepo hata moja.

english: How precious to me are Your thoughts, O God, how vast is their sum!
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, ebirengererio biao nigo bire ebikong’u ase ’nde kobimanya, naende nebinge mono bitanyaare kobareka.
swahili: Tazama jinsi yalivyo ya thamani mawazo yako kwangu, Ee Mungu! Jinsi jumla yake ilivyo kubwa!

english: If I were to count them, they would outnumber the grains of sand; and when I awake, I am still with You.
ekegusii: Inse kobibara, nigo bire ebinge goetania omokenye. Ekero ’nkobooka, nigo ’ngendererete kobeera amo naye.
