swahili: Kama ningezihesabu, zingekuwa nyingi kuliko mchanga. Niamkapo, bado niko pamoja nawe.

english: O God, that You would slay the wicked— away from me, you bloodthirsty men—
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, naki yare goocha koba buya onye ’ngwaita abakori amabe, onye abagoitera amanyinga ’mbarua ase ’nde.
swahili: Laiti ungewachinja waovu, Ee Mungu! Ondokeni kwangu, ninyi wamwaga damu!

english: You know when I sit and when I rise; You understand my thoughts from afar.
ekegusii: Aye nigo omanyete ekero ing’ikaransete, na ekero ’nkoimoka. Nigo omanyete ebirengererio biane bionsi kore aare.
swahili: Unajua ninapoketi na ninapoinuka; unatambua mawazo yangu tokea mbali.

english: who speak of You deceitfully; Your enemies take Your name in vain.
ekegusii: Abwo nigo bagokwana bobe igoro yao; nigo bare abaenenu bagokora ebibe asore.
swahili: Wanazungumza juu yako wakiwa na kusudi baya, adui zako wanatumia vibaya jina lako.

english: Do I not hate those who hate You, O LORD, and detest those who rise against You?
ekegusii: Omonene, Inee, tingeecheti abwo bakogeechete? Tinkonyinyera abwo bagosaria asore?
swahili: Ee Bwana, je, nisiwachukie wanaokuchukia? Nisiwachukie sana wanaoinuka dhidi yako?

english: I hate them with perfect hatred; I count them as my enemies.
ekegusii: Abwo nigo ’mbageechete mono, nigo ’mbaabarete ng’a nababisa baane.
swahili: Sina kitu zaidi ya chuki dhidi yao, ninawahesabu ni adui zangu.

english: Search me, O God, and know my heart; test me and know my concerns.
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, ndiga‐rigie omanye enkoro yane. Nteeme omanye ebirengererio biane.
swahili: Ee Mungu, nichunguze, uujue moyo wangu, nijaribu na ujue mawazo yangu.

english: See if there is any offensive way in me; lead me in the way everlasting.
ekegusii: Origererie timbwatia enchera y’obosiru, na ondaae ase enchera ya kare na kare.
swahili: Uone kama kuna njia iletayo machukizo ndani yangu, uniongoze katika njia ya milele.

english: You search out my path and my lying down; You are aware of all my ways.
ekegusii: Ekero ’ngotaara gose kondaire nigo omanyete; aye nigo omanyete chinchera chiane chionsi.
swahili: Unafahamu kutoka kwangu na kulala kwangu; unaelewa njia zangu zote.

english: Even before a word is on my tongue, You know all about it, O LORD.
ekegusii: Nonya nekero ’ntarakwana ring’ana rinde rionsi, Naama, aye Omonene nigo orimanyete kegima.
swahili: Kabla neno halijafika katika ulimi wangu, wewe walijua kikamilifu, Ee Bwana.

english: You hem me in behind and before; You have laid Your hand upon me.
ekegusii: Aye nigo ong’etanaine ase chinsemo chionsi, na nigo obegete okoboko kwao igoro yane ondendete.
swahili: Umenizunguka nyuma na mbele; umeweka mkono wako juu yangu.

english: Such knowledge is too wonderful for me, too lofty for me to attain.
ekegusii: Okomanya okwo nigo kore okw’ogokumia ase ’nde; nigo kore okonene mono, tinkonyaara gokomanya.
swahili: Maarifa haya ni ya ajabu mno kwangu, ni ya juu sana kwangu kuyafikia.

english: Where can I go to escape Your Spirit? Where can I flee from Your presence?
ekegusii: Ng’ai ’ndagende, erinde ntigane n’Omoika oo? Gose ng’ai ’ndatame gochia, ’ndue ase obosio bwao?
swahili: Niende wapi nijiepushe na Roho yako? Niende wapi niukimbie uso wako?

english: If I ascend to the heavens, You are there; if I make my bed in Sheol, You are there.
ekegusii: Ninsa koriina gochia igoro, aye nao ore; ninsa kwara ekerarero kiane agwo aase abakuure, aye nao ore.
swahili: Kama nikienda juu mbinguni, wewe uko huko; nikifanya vilindi kuwa kitanda changu, wewe uko huko.

english: If I rise on the wings of the dawn, if I settle by the farthest sea,
ekegusii: Ninsa koirurukigwa namasase a mambia, ingende komenya ase chinsinyo chi’enyancha,
swahili: Kama nikipanda juu ya mbawa za mapambazuko, kama nikikaa pande za mbali za bahari,

english: How long, O LORD? Will You forget me forever? How long will You hide Your face from me?
ekegusii: Omonene, ngoika ririri oragenderere konyeba? Ngoika kare na kare? Ngoika ririri orabe kobisete obosio bwao ng’a tondora?
swahili: Mpaka lini, Ee Bwana? Je, utanisahau milele? Utanificha uso wako mpaka lini?

english: How long must I wrestle in my soul, with sorrow in my heart each day? How long will my enemy dominate me?
ekegusii: Ngoika ririri ndabe ndemereretie emechando ase omoyo one, imbe nobororo ase enkoro yane rituko ase rituko? Ngoika ririri omobisa one arabe okogokera emechando yane?
swahili: Nitapambana na mawazo yangu mpaka lini, na kila siku kuwa na majonzi moyoni mwangu? Adui zangu watanishinda mpaka lini?

english: Consider me and respond, O LORD my God. Give light to my eyes, lest I sleep in death,
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, aye Nyasae one, ondigererie, ong’iranerie ase ogosaba kwane! Ondamokie amaiso aane, timbaisa korara chitoro chi’amakweri.
swahili: Nitazame, unijibu, Ee Bwana Mungu wangu. Yatie nuru macho yangu, ama sivyo nitalala usingizi wa mauti.

english: lest my enemy say, “I have overcome him,” and my foes rejoice when I fall.
ekegusii: Totiga omobisa one ateebe ng’a ombuire, na ababisa baane bonsi bachengere okogwa kwane.
swahili: Adui yangu atasema, “Nimemshinda,” nao adui zangu watashangilia nitakapoanguka.

english: But I have trusted in Your loving devotion; my heart will rejoice in Your salvation.
ekegusii: Ninsemerie obwanchani bwao botari koera, enkoro yane negokere ogotooreka gokorwa asore.
swahili: Lakini ninategemea upendo wako usiokoma; moyo wangu unashangilia katika wokovu wako.

english: I will sing to the LORD, for He has been good to me.
ekegusii: Ningoterere aye Omonene, ekiagera gwankoreire amaya amange.
swahili: Nitamwimbia Bwana, kwa kuwa amekuwa mwema kwangu.

english: Rescue me, O LORD, from evil men. Protect me from men of violence,
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ’ntoorie korwa ase abanto ababe; indende korwa ase abanto abatindi!
swahili: Ee Bwana, niokoe, kutoka kwa watu waovu; nilinde na watu wenye jeuri,

english: May burning coals fall on them; may they be thrown into the fire, into the miry pits, never to rise again.
ekegusii: Tiga omorero bw’amakara obagwere, barabwo batugutwe ase omorero, barutwe ase chingoro chintambe tibaruao.
swahili: Makaa ya mawe ya moto na yawaangukie! Na watupwe motoni, katika mashimo ya matope, wasiinuke tena kamwe.

english: May no slanderer be established in the land; may calamity hunt down the man of violence.
ekegusii: Totiga abagenki bagenderere koba ase ense. Obobe nigo bogotwara abanto abatindi ase omoayerero bw’abasiria.
swahili: Wasingiziaji wasifanikiwe katika nchi; maafa na yawawinde watu wenye jeuri.

english: I know that the LORD upholds justice for the poor and defends the cause of the needy.
ekegusii: Nimanyete ng’a aye Omonene norwanerere abagokorerwa bobe, noe abataka oboronge bwabo.
swahili: Najua kwamba Bwana huwapatia maskini haki, na kuitegemeza njia ya mhitaji.

english: Surely the righteous will praise Your name; the upright will dwell in Your presence.
ekegusii: Ekeene, abanyene oboronge ’mbaake ng’a mbuya mono ase erieta riao, abare ne chinkoro chindonge ’mbamenye ase obosio bwao.
swahili: Hakika wenye haki watalisifu jina lako, na waadilifu wataishi mbele zako.

english: who devise evil in their hearts and stir up war all day long.
ekegusii: Abanto abwo nigo bakoroberia amabe ase chinkoro chiabo ime, baba bakona‐korwana esegi botambe.
swahili: ambao hupanga mipango mibaya mioyoni mwao, na kuchochea vita siku zote.

english: They sharpen their tongues like snakes; the venom of vipers is on their lips. Selah
ekegusii: Chimeme chiabo nigo chire chinyoge buna echie ching’iti chingeenda inse; obosongo bw’amarubi nigo bore ase ebikoba bi’emenwa yaabo.
swahili: Wao hufanya ndimi zao kali kama za nyoka, sumu ya nyoka iko midomoni mwao.

english: Guard me, O LORD, from the hands of the wicked. Keep me safe from men of violence who scheme to make me stumble.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, indende korwa ase amaboko y’abakori amabe; intoorie korwa ase abanto abatindi, abwo barobeirie kobeeka ebigoocha ase ’ngoeta.
swahili: Ee Bwana, niepushe na mikono ya waovu; nilinde na watu wenye jeuri wanaopanga kunikwaza miguu yangu.

english: The proud hide a snare for me; the cords of their net are spread along the path, and lures are set out for me. Selah
ekegusii: Abanto abaenenu babeekire oboreba bobisi ase ’ngoetera, bantegeire ebichanga bimbwate, babeekire emeeto ase oboeto bwane bwonsi.
swahili: Wenye kiburi wameficha mtego wa kuninasa, wametandaza kamba za wavu wao, wametega mitego kwenye njia yangu.

english: I say to the LORD, “You are my God.” Hear, O LORD, my cry for help.
ekegusii: Nateebirie Omonene: Aye Nyasae one, aye Omonene, tegerera oigwe ogosaba kwane.
swahili: Ee Bwana, ninakuambia, “Wewe ni Mungu wangu.” Ee Bwana, usikie kilio changu na kunihurumia.

english: O GOD the Lord, the strength of my salvation, You shield my head in the day of battle.
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae one, Omonene, Omotooria one omokong’u, aye nigo ogotuba omotwe one ase engaki y’eseegi.
swahili: Ee Bwana Mwenyezi, Mwokozi wangu mwenye nguvu, unikingaye kichwa changu siku ya vita:

english: Grant not, O LORD, the desires of the wicked; do not promote their evil plans, lest they be exalted. Selah
ekegusii: Omonene, tobaisa koa abakori amabe aya baganetie; tobaisa gosesenia emeroberio yaabo emebe, baabaise gwetogia.
swahili: Ee Bwana, usiwape waovu matakwa yao, usiache mipango yao ikafanikiwa, wasije wakajisifu.

english: May the heads of those who surround me be covered in the trouble their lips have caused.
ekegusii: Totiga ababisa abwo bang’etananire babue, tiga obobe bw’amang’ana bagokwana bobairanere abanyene.
swahili: Vichwa vya wanaonizunguka vifunikwe na shida zinazosababishwa na midomo yao.

english: I call upon You, O LORD; come quickly to me. Hear my voice when I call to You.
ekegusii: Omonene, nigo ’ngokorangeria, ayerera oche bwango! Tegerera oigwe eriogi riane ekero ’ngokorangeria.
swahili: Ee Bwana, ninakuita wewe, uje kwangu hima. Sikia sauti yangu ninapokuita.

english: Let the wicked fall into their own nets, while I pass by in safety.
ekegusii: Tiga abakori amabe abwo bagwe ase ebichanga biabo abanyene, korende inche ’ntooreke.
swahili: Waovu na waanguke kwenye nyavu zao wenyewe, wakati mimi ninapita salama.

english: May my prayer be set before You like incense, my uplifted hands like the evening offering.
ekegusii: Bwanchere ogosaba kwane buna ubani, na amaboko aane aimokereirie igoro oyanchere buna ekeng’wanso kia mogoroba!
swahili: Maombi yangu na yafike mbele zako kama uvumba; kuinua mikono yangu juu na kuwe kama dhabihu ya jioni.

english: Set a guard, O LORD, over my mouth; keep watch at the door of my lips.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, beeka omorendi ase omonwa one, abe okorenda ebikoba biane.
swahili: Ee Bwana, weka mlinzi kinywani mwangu, weka ulinzi mlangoni mwa midomo yangu.

english: Do not let my heart be drawn to any evil thing or take part in works of wickedness with men who do iniquity; let me not feast on their delicacies.
ekegusii: Totiga enkoro yane egobere yanche amang’ana amabe. Tontiga inare gokora ayaare amabe amo nabwo bagokora ebibe; tingosanga amo nabarabwo ase emeyega.
swahili: Usiuache moyo wangu uvutwe katika jambo baya, nisije nikashiriki katika matendo maovu pamoja na watu watendao mabaya, wala nisije nikala vyakula vyao vya anasa.

english: Let the righteous man strike me; let his rebuke be an act of loving devotion. It is oil for my head; let me not refuse it. For my prayer is ever against the deeds of the wicked.
ekegusii: Tiga oyore omonyaboronge ang’ake na antogonyere ase obwanchani, okwo nigo konga buna amaguta akweakwa, na omotwe one toyaanga. Botambe nigo ogosaba kwane kore mamincha y’abakori amabe.
swahili: Mtu mwenye haki na anipige: ni jambo la huruma; na anikemee: ni mafuta kichwani mwangu. Kichwa changu hakitalikataa. Hata hivyo, maombi yangu daima ni kinyume cha watenda mabaya,

english: When their rulers are thrown down from the cliffs, the people will listen to my words, for they are pleasant.
ekegusii: Ekero abagaambi baabo baraturunkanigwe ase egetare, abanto ’mbaanche amang’ana aane ng’a n’amaya.
swahili: watawala wao watatupwa chini kutoka kwenye majabali, waovu watajifunza kwamba maneno yangu yalikuwa kweli.

english: As when one plows and breaks up the soil, so our bones have been scattered at the mouth of Sheol.
ekegusii: Amauga aito nigo asiareire ase egesieri n’erieta riikoro engencho yaye egesieri gose omogwa bw’embeera, buna ebisamunye bie chiinko, gose ebi’amagena bigosiarerwa ase riroba igoro.
swahili: Watasema, “Kama mtu anavyolima na kuvunja ardhi, ndivyo mifupa yetu imetawanywa kwenye mlango wa kaburi.”

english: But my eyes are fixed on You, O GOD the Lord. In You I seek refuge; do not leave my soul defenseless.
ekegusii: Korende amaiso aane nigo arigereretie goocha asore, aye Omonene; naye ’ngotamera, tibwanga omoyo one.
swahili: Lakini nimekaza macho yangu kwako, Ee Bwana Mwenyezi, ndani yako nimekimbilia, usiniache nife.

english: Keep me from the snares they have laid for me, and from the lures of evildoers.
ekegusii: Indende korwa ase emeeto bantegeire; na korwa ase amareba y’abakori amabe.
swahili: Niepushe na mitego waliyonitegea, kutokana na mitego iliyotegwa na watenda mabaya.

english: I cry aloud to the LORD; I lift my voice to the LORD for mercy.
ekegusii: Nigo ’nkorera neriogi ase ogokorangeri’Omonene, naaka eriogi ase okomosaba amaabera.
swahili: Namlilia Bwana kwa sauti, nainua sauti yangu kwa Bwana anihurumie.

english: I pour out my complaint before Him; I reveal my trouble to Him.
ekegusii: Nigo ’nkorenta obokong’u bwane ase obosio bwaye na komoteebia emechando yane.
swahili: Namimina malalamiko yangu mbele zake, mbele zake naeleza shida zangu.

english: Although my spirit grows faint within me, You know my way. Along the path I travel they have hidden a snare for me.
ekegusii: Ekero ’nkoba buna oyo okogireka, aye nomanyete ase ’ngoetera. Agwo ase ’ngoeta ababisa bambeekeire amareba.
swahili: Wakati roho yangu inapozimia ndani yangu, wewe ndiwe unajua njia zangu. Katika njia ninayopita watu wameniwekea mtego.

english: Look to my right and see; no one attends to me. There is no refuge for me; no one cares for my soul.
ekegusii: Ekero ’nkorigereria ase ensemo yane y’okorio, tindi korora monto aroro ogonkonya; gose tindi korora aase ’ndatamere, monto onde tari okonyechaandera.
swahili: Tazama kuume kwangu na uone, hakuna hata mmoja anayejihusisha nami. Sina kimbilio, hakuna anayejali maisha yangu.

english: I cry to You, O LORD: “You are my refuge, my portion in the land of the living.”
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, nigo ’nkorera asore; nigo ’ngoteeba: Naye ore obotamero bwane, na egetare kiane aiga ase ense y’ abanto bare moyo.
swahili: Ee Bwana, nakulilia wewe, nasema, “Wewe ni kimbilio langu, fungu langu katika nchi ya walio hai.”

english: Listen to my cry, for I am brought quite low. Rescue me from my pursuers, for they are too strong for me.
ekegusii: Tegerera oigwe ekerero kiane, ekiagera nachaandekire mono! Ntoorie korwa ase abanto abwo bagonchaanda, ekiagera nigo babwate chinguru kombua.
swahili: Sikiliza kilio changu, kwa sababu mimi ni mhitaji sana; niokoe na wale wanaonifuatilia, kwa kuwa wamenizidi nguvu.

english: Free my soul from prison, that I may praise Your name. The righteous will gather around me because of Your goodness to me.
ekegusii: Osibore omoyo one korwa ase obosibwa, erinde imbe ’ngotogia erieta riao. Abanyene oboronge ’mbang’etanane, ekiagera gwankoreire amaya.
swahili: Nifungue kutoka kifungo changu, ili niweze kulisifu jina lako. Ndipo wenye haki watanizunguka, kwa sababu ya wema wako kwangu.

english: O LORD, hear my prayer. In Your faithfulness, give ear to my plea; in Your righteousness, answer me.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, oigwe ogosaba kwane; ase engencho y’oboronge bwao otegerere ogosorora kwane, ong’iranerie ase engencho y’obwegenwa bwao.
swahili: Ee Bwana, sikia sala yangu, sikiliza kilio changu unihurumie; katika uaminifu na haki yako njoo unisaidie.

english: Teach me to do Your will, for You are my God. May Your good Spirit lead me on level ground.
ekegusii: Inyorokererie imanye gokora ogwancha kwao, ekiagera naye ore Nyasae one! Tiga Omoika oo omuya ondaae ase enchera ere endonge.
swahili: Nifundishe kufanya mapenzi yako, kwa maana wewe ndiwe Mungu wangu, Roho wako mwema na aniongoze katika nchi tambarare.

english: For the sake of Your name, O LORD, revive me. In Your righteousness, bring my soul out of trouble.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ing’a obogima oboyia ase engencho y’erieta riao; na ase engencho y’oboronge bwao rusia omoyo one korwa ase emechando.
swahili: Ee Bwana, kwa ajili ya jina lako, hifadhi maisha yangu, kwa haki yako nitoe katika taabu.

english: And in Your loving devotion, cut off my enemies. Destroy all who afflict me, for I am Your servant.
ekegusii: Ase engencho y’obwanchani bwao bwa botambe, siria ababisa baane; basirie kegima bonsi abagochaanda omoyo one, ekiagera inche nigo ’nde omosomba oo.
swahili: Kwa upendo wako usiokoma, nyamazisha adui zangu; waangamize watesi wangu wote, kwa kuwa mimi ni mtumishi wako.

english: Do not bring Your servant into judgment, for no one alive is righteous before You.
ekegusii: Tobaisa kong’ira inche omosomba oo ase ekegambero, ekiagera ase abwo bare moyo onde tari ore omooronge asore.
swahili: Usimhukumu mtumishi wako, kwa kuwa hakuna mtu anayeishi aliye mwenye haki mbele zako.

english: For the enemy has pursued my soul, crushing my life to the ground, making me dwell in darkness like those long since dead.
ekegusii: Omobisa one obeire okorigia omoyo one; obeire ogontiringera inse ase amaroba, ong’ikaransirie ase omosunte, nabeire buna omonto okwete kare.
swahili: Adui hunifuatilia, hunipondaponda chini; hunifanya niishi gizani kama wale waliokufa zamani.

english: My spirit grows faint within me; my heart is dismayed inside me.
ekegusii: Ase ayio omoika ore ime yane oborirwe chinguru, na enkoro yane yairianyekire.
swahili: Kwa hiyo roho yangu inazimia ndani yangu, moyo wangu ndani yangu unakata tamaa.

english: I remember the days of old; I meditate on all Your works; I consider the work of Your hands.
ekegusii: Nigo ’nkoinyora amatuko a kare, na korengereria igoro y’ogokora kwao gwonsi, naba ’nkona‐koiranerera emeremo y’amaboko ao.
swahili: Nakumbuka siku za zamani; natafakari juu ya kazi zako zote, naangalia juu ya kazi ambazo mikono yako imezifanya.

english: I stretch out my hands to You; my soul thirsts for You like a parched land. Selah
ekegusii: Nigo ’nkorambora amaboko aane goocha asore, omoyo one nigo ore nerang’o asore, buna riroba rirang’ete embura.
swahili: Nanyoosha mikono yangu kwako, nafsi yangu inakuonea kiu kama ardhi kame.

english: Answer me quickly, O LORD; my spirit fails. Do not hide Your face from me, or I will be like those who descend to the Pit.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ing’iranerie bwango! Omoika ’nkong’erera ore! Tombisa obosio bwao mbaise koba buna abwo bakogeenda ase abakuure.
swahili: Ee Bwana, unijibu haraka, roho yangu inazimia. Usinifiche uso wako, ama sivyo nitafanana na wale washukao shimoni.

english: Let me hear Your loving devotion in the morning, for I have put my trust in You. Teach me the way I should walk, for to You I lift up my soul.
ekegusii: Kera emambia omanyie obwanchani bwao bogenderere botambe, ekiagera naye ’nyegenete. Inyorokererie enchera ’ngwenerete kobwatia, ekiagera narure omoyo one asore.
swahili: Asubuhi uniletee neno la upendo wako usiokoma, kwa kuwa nimeweka tumaini langu kwako. Nionyeshe njia nitakayoiendea, kwa kuwa kwako nainua nafsi yangu.

english: Deliver me from my enemies, O LORD; I flee to You for refuge.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ’ntoorie korwa ase ababisa baane; nagotameire ombise.
swahili: Ee Bwana, uniokoe na adui zangu, kwa kuwa nimejificha kwako.

english: Blessed be the LORD, my Rock, who trains my hands for war, my fingers for battle.
ekegusii: Atogigwe Omonene, oyore egetare kiane; bworokereirie amaboko aane amanye korwana esegi, ne ebiara bimanye korwana.
swahili: Sifa ni kwa Bwana Mwamba wangu, aifundishaye mikono yangu vita, na vidole vyangu kupigana.

english: to Him who gives victory to kings, who frees His servant David from the deadly sword.
ekegusii: Aye nigo okoa abarwoti obobui, naye gwatooretie Daudi, omosomba oo, korwa ase omoro bw’obobe.
swahili: kwa Yule awapaye wafalme ushindi, ambaye humwokoa Daudi, mtumishi wake kutokana na upanga hatari.

english: Set me free and rescue me from the grasp of foreigners, whose mouths speak falsehood, whose right hands are deceitful.
ekegusii: Ondusie na ontoorie korwa ase amaboko y’ abanto b’echinse chingeni, abwo bagokwana oborimo nemenwa yaabo, na amaboko abo a borio agokora obong’ainereria.
swahili: Nikomboe na uniokoe kutoka mikononi mwa wageni ambao vinywa vyao vimejaa uongo, na mikono yao ya kuume ni midanganyifu.

english: Then our sons will be like plants nurtured in their youth, our daughters like corner pillars carved to adorn a palace.
ekegusii: Tiga abamura baito ase oboke bwabo babe buna ebimeri biakinire bire ne’chinguru, na abaiseke baito babe buna ebisigisa bie chikoona bibaachire buya bikogwenera chinyomba chi’oborwoti.
swahili: Kisha wana wetu wakati wa ujana wao watakuwa kama mimea iliyotunzwa vizuri, binti zetu watakuwa kama nguzo zilizoviringwa kurembesha jumba la kifalme.

english: Our storehouses will be full, supplying all manner of produce; our flocks will bring forth thousands, tens of thousands in our fields.
ekegusii: Tiga ebiage biaito biichore chindagera, bigaache chindagera ao ao, ne ching’ondi chiaito chire ase ebitii chibiare chilifu ne chilifu.
swahili: Ghala zetu zitajazwa aina zote za mahitaji. Kondoo zetu watazaa kwa maelfu, kwa makumi ya maelfu katika mashamba yetu;

english: Our oxen will bear great loads. There will be no breach in the walls, no going into captivity, and no cry of lament in our streets.
ekegusii: Tiga chiombe chiaito chibe ne’chinguru, ende tebaisa korekera, gose goochia bogima. Ekerero kende gionsi tikeba ase chinchera chiaito.
swahili: maksai wetu watakokota mizigo mizito. Hakutakuwa na kubomoka kuta, hakuna kuchukuliwa mateka, wala kilio cha taabu katika barabara zetu.

english: Blessed are the people of whom this is so; blessed are the people whose God is the LORD.
ekegusii: Mbare n’omogooko abanto bakonyora ogosesenigwa okwo. Ee, ’mbare n’omogooko abanto abw’Omonene are Nyasae obo.
swahili: Heri watu ambao hili ni kweli; heri wale ambao Bwana ni Mungu wao.

english: He is my steadfast love and my fortress, my stronghold and my deliverer. He is my shield, in whom I take refuge, who subdues peoples under me.
ekegusii: Ere nomwegenwa ase ’nde, naende norwaki rwane, obwebiso bwane obokong’u na Omobooria one. Ere nenguba yane, nere ’ngotamera, ekiagera nabeeke abanto baane inse yane banyigwere.
swahili: Yeye ni Mungu wangu wa upendo na boma langu, ngome yangu na mwokozi wangu, ngao yangu ninayemkimbilia, ambaye huwatiisha mataifa chini yangu.

english: O LORD, what is man, that You regard him, the son of man that You think of him?
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, omonto ninki aisaine goika okomwechaandera, gose Mwanyabaanto ninki are, aye okomorengereria?
swahili: Ee Bwana, mwanadamu ni nini hata umjali, Binadamu ni nini hata umfikirie?

english: Man is like a breath; his days are like a passing shadow.
ekegusii: Omonto nigo are buna omooki, amatuko aye nigo anga buna omorengari ogoeta.
swahili: Mwanadamu ni kama pumzi, siku zake ni kama kivuli kinachopita.

english: Part Your heavens, O LORD, and come down; touch the mountains, that they may smoke.
ekegusii: Omonene, kumba igoro chiao ochiche inse aa! Kuna ebitunwa, erinde bisokie erioki.
swahili: Ee Bwana, pasua mbingu zako, ushuke, gusa milima ili itoe moshi.

english: Flash forth Your lightning and scatter them; shoot Your arrows and rout them.
ekegusii: Mesia chinkoba chiao oserebanie ababisa, ruta chinsara chiao obasirie kegima!
swahili: Peleka umeme uwatawanye adui, lenga mishale yako uwashinde.

english: Reach down from on high; set me free and rescue me from the deep waters, from the grasp of foreigners,
ekegusii: Rambora okoboko kwao korwa agwo igoro, ondusie na ontoorie korwa ase amaache aya amange, na korwa ase amaboko y’ abanto b’echinse chingeni,
swahili: Nyoosha mkono wako kutoka juu, nikomboe na kuniokoa kutoka maji makuu, kutoka mikononi mwa wageni

english: whose mouths speak falsehood, whose right hands are deceitful.
ekegusii: abwo bagokwana oborimo nemenwa yaabo, na amaboko abo a borio agokora obong’ainereria.
swahili: ambao vinywa vyao vimejaa uongo, na mikono yao ya kuume ni midanganyifu.

english: I will sing to You a new song, O God; on a harp of ten strings I will make music to You—
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, ningoterere ogoteera okoyia, ninkobugerie obokano bore ne chinge ikomi.
swahili: Ee Mungu, nitakuimbia wimbo mpya, kwa zeze yenye nyuzi kumi nitakuimbia,

english: I will exalt You, my God and King; I will bless Your name forever and ever.
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae one na omorwoti one, ninkobaake, nimbe ’ngotogia erieta riao goika kare na kare.
swahili: Nitakutukuza wewe, Mungu wangu Mfalme, nitalisifu jina lako milele na milele.

english: All You have made will give You thanks, O LORD, and Your saints will bless You.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ebitongwa biao bionsi nigo bikogoakera ng’a mbuya mono, na abachenu bao bonsi mbagotogie.
swahili: Ee Bwana, vyote ulivyovifanya vitakusifu, watakatifu wako watakutukuza.

english: They will tell of the glory of Your kingdom and speak of Your might,
ekegusii: Mbabe bakoraria obonene bw’oborwoti bwao, naende babe bagokwana igoro y’okobua kwao,
swahili: Watasimulia utukufu wa ufalme wako na kusema juu ya ukuu wako,

english: to make known to men Your mighty acts and the glorious splendor of Your kingdom.
ekegusii: bamanyie Mwanyabaanto ogokora kwao okonene, na obonene bw’ogosikwa kw’oborwoti bwao.
swahili: ili watu wote wajue matendo yako makuu na utukufu wa fahari ya ufalme wako.

english: Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and Your dominion endures through all generations. The LORD is faithful in all His words and kind in all His actions.
ekegusii: Oborwoti bwao nobwa kare na kare, na okogambera kwao nigo kogendererete ase ebiaare bionsi. Omonene nigo are omwegenwa ase amang’ana aye onsi, na oichire nobuya ase ogokora kwaye gwonsi.
swahili: Ufalme wako ni ufalme wa milele, mamlaka yako hudumu vizazi vyote. Bwana ni mwaminifu kwa ahadi zake zote na mwenye upendo kwa vyote alivyovifanya.

english: The LORD upholds all who fall and lifts up all who are bowed down.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo akobwata bonsi abakogwa, nigo akogororokia abwo bakumbirwe gochia inse.
swahili: Bwana huwategemeza wote waangukao, na huwainua wote waliolemewa na mizigo yao.

english: The eyes of all look to You, and You give them their food in season.
ekegusii: Amaiso y’ebitongwa bionsi nigo akorigereretie nogosemeria, naye nigo okobia chindagera chiabo ase chingaki chigwenerete.
swahili: Macho yao wote yanakutazama wewe, nawe huwapa chakula chao wakati wake.

english: You open Your hand and satisfy the desire of every living thing.
ekegusii: Aye nigo okomaanora okoboko kwao, kwarua ebisio na goisanekia kera egetongwa kere moyo.
swahili: Waufumbua mkono wako, watosheleza haja ya kila kitu kilicho hai.

english: The LORD is righteous in all His ways and kind in all His deeds.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo are omonyene oboronge ase chinchera chiaye chionsi, na omuya ase ogokora kwaye gwonsi.
swahili: Bwana ni mwenye haki katika njia zake zote, na mwenye upendo kwa vyote alivyovifanya.

english: The LORD is near to all who call on Him, to all who call out to Him in truth.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo are ang’e ase abanto abwo bakomorangeria; abwo bonsi bakomorangeria ase ekeene.
swahili: Bwana yu karibu na wote wamwitao, karibu na wote wamwitao kwa uaminifu.

english: He fulfills the desires of those who fear Him; He hears their cry and saves them.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoikeraneria abamoirogete okogania kwabo; boigo nigo akoigwa ekerero kiabo na kobatooria.
swahili: Huwatimizia wamchao matakwa yao, husikia kilio chao na kuwaokoa.

english: Every day I will bless You, and I will praise Your name forever and ever.
ekegusii: Kera rituko nimbe ’nkogotogia, nintogie erieta riao goika kare na kare.
swahili: Kila siku nitakusifu na kulitukuza jina lako milele na milele.

english: The LORD preserves all who love Him, but all the wicked He will destroy.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo arendete bonsi abamwanchete; korende nasirie abakori amabe bonsi.
swahili: Bwana huwalinda wote wampendao, bali waovu wote atawaangamiza.

english: My mouth will declare the praise of the LORD; let every creature bless His holy name forever and ever.
ekegusii: Omonwa one nobe ogokwana ogotogigwa kw’Omonene; tiga ebitongwa bionsi bitogie erieta riaye richenu bono na goika kare na kare.
swahili: Kinywa changu kitazinena sifa za Bwana. Kila kiumbe na kilisifu jina lake takatifu milele na milele.

english: Great is the LORD and greatly to be praised; His greatness is unsearchable.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo are omonene, nagwenerete atogigwe mono; obonene bwaye tibokomanyekana buna bore.
swahili: Bwana ni mkuu, anayestahili kusifiwa sana, ukuu wake haupimiki.

english: One generation will commend Your works to the next, and will proclaim Your mighty acts—
ekegusii: Emeremo yao netogigwe ebiaare ase ebiaare. Mbirarie ogokora kwao kore okonene.
swahili: Kizazi kimoja kitasifia kazi zako kwa kizazi kingine, watasimulia matendo yako makuu.

english: the glorious splendor of Your majesty. And I will meditate on Your wondrous works.
ekegusii: Nimbe ’nkorengereria mono igoro y’obonene bwao bw’ogosikwa okonene, na igoro y’emeremo yao y’ogokumia.
swahili: Watasema juu ya utukufu wa fahari ya ukuu wako, nami nitatafakari juu ya kazi zako za ajabu.

english: They will proclaim the power of Your awesome deeds, and I will declare Your greatness.
ekegusii: Abanto ’mbabe bakoraria ogokora kwao okonene gw’okoirokia, nainche nimbe ’nkoraria obonene bwao.
swahili: Watasimulia uwezo wa kazi zako za kutisha, nami nitatangaza matendo yako makuu.

english: They will extol the fame of Your abundant goodness and sing joyfully of Your righteousness.
ekegusii: Mbararie chinkuma chi’obuya bwao obonge, babe bagotera namariogi amanene gotogia oboronge bwao.
swahili: Wataadhimisha wema wako mwingi, na wataimba kwa shangwe juu ya haki yako.

english: The LORD is gracious and compassionate, slow to anger and abounding in loving devotion.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo are nobwanchani obonge, na amaabera amange; tari omwango ase okoba n’endamwamu, nigo aichire nobwanchani bogendererete botambe.
swahili: Bwana ni mwenye neema na mwingi wa huruma, si mwepesi wa hasira, bali ni mwingi wa upendo.

english: The LORD is good to all; His compassion rests on all He has made.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo are omuya ase abanto bonsi, naende nigo are namaabera ase ebitongwa biaye bionsi.
swahili: Bwana ni mwema kwa wote, ana huruma kwa vyote alivyovifanya.

english: Hallelujah! Praise the LORD, O my soul.
ekegusii: Togia Omonene! Aye omoyo one, togia Omonene!
swahili: Msifuni Bwana! Ee nafsi yangu, umsifu Bwana,

english: The LORD reigns forever, your God, O Zion, for all generations. Hallelujah!
ekegusii: Omonene nagambe goika kare na kare; aye Sayoni, Nyasae oo nagambere ebiaare bionsi.
swahili: Bwana atamiliki milele, Mungu wako, ee Sayuni, kwa vizazi vyote. Msifuni Bwana.

english: I will praise the LORD all my life; I will sing praises to my God while I have my being.
ekegusii: Nimbe ngotogia Omonene kongendererete koba moyo, ninterere Nyasae one ase okomotogia kondagenderere kobao.
swahili: Nitamsifu Bwana maisha yangu yote; nitamwimbia Mungu wangu sifa wakati wote niishipo.

english: Put not your trust in princes, in mortal man, who cannot save.
ekegusii: Timobaisa gosemeria abagaambi, gose Mwanyabaanto abwo batanyaare gokonya kende.
swahili: Usiweke tumaini lako kwa wakuu, kwa wanadamu ambao hufa, ambao hawawezi kuokoa.

english: When his spirit departs, he returns to the ground; on that very day his plans perish.
ekegusii: Ekero omoika orure ase omonto, ere nigo akoirana ase amaroba, ase arwete. Ase rituko erio erio emeroberio yaye nigo egosira.
swahili: Roho yao itokapo hurudi mavumbini, siku hiyo hiyo mipango yao yote hukoma.

english: Blessed is he whose help is the God of Jacob, whose hope is in the LORD his God,
ekegusii: Nasesenirie omonto oyio Nyasae o Yakobo are ogokonywa kwaye, oyio osemeretie Omonene, Nyasae oye,
swahili: Heri yeye ambaye Mungu wa Yakobo ni msaada wake, ambaye tumaini lake ni katika Bwana, Mungu wake,

english: the Maker of heaven and earth, the sea, and everything in them. He remains faithful forever.
ekegusii: Nyasae oria otongete igoro na ense, na enyancha, na ebinto bionsi bire imeo. Ere nigo agendererete koba omwegenwa goika kare na kare.
swahili: Muumba wa mbingu na nchi, na bahari na vyote vilivyomo ndani yake: Bwana anayedumu kuwa mwaminifu milele na milele.

english: He executes justice for the oppressed and gives food to the hungry. The LORD sets the prisoners free,
ekegusii: Omonene nigo akoa abwo bagokorerwa bobe oboronge bwabo, na abare nenchara nigo akobaa endagera. Omonene nigo agosibora abwo basibire.
swahili: Naye huwapatia haki walioonewa na kuwapa wenye njaa chakula. Bwana huwaweka wafungwa huru,

english: the LORD opens the eyes of the blind, the LORD lifts those who are weighed down, the LORD loves the righteous.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo akoramokia emeuko amaiso na kogororokia abwo bakumbirwe gochia inse. Omonene nigo anchete abanyaboronge.
swahili: Bwana huwafumbua vipofu macho, Bwana huwainua waliolemewa na mizigo yao, Bwana huwapenda wenye haki.

english: The LORD protects foreigners; He sustains the fatherless and the widow, but the ways of the wicked He frustrates.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo akorenda abanto abageni, nigo akoa chintakana na ababoraka ogosemeria, korende chinchera chi’abakori amabe nigo agochisiria.
swahili: Bwana huwalinda wageni na kuwategemeza yatima na wajane, lakini hupinga njia za waovu.

english: Hallelujah! How good it is to sing praises to our God, how pleasant and lovely to praise Him!
ekegusii: Motogie Omonene! Nigo ere buya komoterera Nyasae oito ase okomotogia, ayio naro amaya mono na atogwenerete.
swahili: Msifuni Bwana. Tazama jinsi ilivyo vyema kumwimbia Mungu wetu sifa, jinsi inavyopendeza na kustahili kumsifu yeye!

english: He does not delight in the strength of the horse; He takes no pleasure in the legpower of the man.
ekegusii: Omonene tagokiri ne’chinguru chi’echibarasi, gose ase omoayerero bw’omonto,
swahili: Furaha yake haipo katika nguvu za farasi, wala furaha yake kwenye miguu ya mwanadamu.

english: The LORD is pleased with those who fear Him, who hope in His loving devotion.
ekegusii: korende nigo agokirie n’abanto abwo bamoirogete, abwo basemeretie obwanchani bwaye bogendererete botambe.
swahili: Bwana hupendezwa na wale wamchao, wale wanaoweka tumaini lao katika upendo wake usiokoma.

english: Exalt the LORD, O Jerusalem; praise your God, O Zion!
ekegusii: Aye Yerusalemu, togia Omonene! Aye Sayoni, togia Nyasae oo!
swahili: Mtukuze Bwana, ee Yerusalemu, msifu Mungu wako, ee Sayuni,

english: For He strengthens the bars of your gates and blesses the children within you.
ekegusii: Ere nigo agokong’ia emekorogoto y’ebiita biaino; nigo agosesenia abana bamenyete ime yao.
swahili: kwa maana huimarisha makomeo ya malango yako na huwabariki watu wako walio ndani yako.

english: He makes peace at your borders; He fills you with the finest wheat.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo akobeeka omorembe oba ase chimbebe chiao, naende nigo agoichoria engano ere engiya mono.
swahili: Huwapa amani mipakani mwenu na kukushibisha kwa ngano safi kabisa.

english: He sends forth His command to the earth; His word runs swiftly.
ekegusii: Nigo agotoma amachiiko aye goocha ase ense, ne ring’ana riaye riaranda bwango.
swahili: Hutuma amri yake duniani, neno lake hukimbia kasi.

english: He spreads the snow like wool; He scatters the frost like ashes;
ekegusii: Ere nigo akorenta amagena y’embura agwekaine amarionya amarabu, oyasiarera buna agosiara ribu.
swahili: Anatandaza theluji kama sufu na kutawanya umande kama majivu.

english: He casts forth His hail like pebbles. Who can withstand His icy blast?
ekegusii: Nigo agosiarera amagena ayio buna amaemba enkomba. Ning’o oraremererie obokendu bwaye?
swahili: Huvurumisha mvua yake ya mawe kama changarawe. Ni nani awezaye kustahimili ukali wa baridi yake?

english: He sends forth His word and melts them; He unleashes His winds, and the waters flow.
ekegusii: Nigo agotoma ring’ana riaye, na amagena ayio amakendu anyititoke. Erio ogusia embeo amaache ageenda.
swahili: Hutuma neno lake na kuviyeyusha, huvumisha upepo wake, nayo maji hutiririka.

english: He declares His word to Jacob, His statutes and judgments to Israel.
ekegusii: Ere nigo akomanyia abanto ba Yakobo ring’ana riaye, ee, Abaisraeli emeroberio yaye n’amachiiko aye.
swahili: Amemfunulia Yakobo neno lake, sheria zake na maagizo yake kwa Israeli.

english: The LORD builds up Jerusalem; He gathers the exiles of Israel.
ekegusii: Omonene naagache Yerusalemu naende, nasangererie amo Abaisraeli abwo baserebaanetigwe.
swahili: Bwana hujenga Yerusalemu, huwakusanya Israeli walio uhamishoni.

english: He has done this for no other nation; they do not know His judgments. Hallelujah!
ekegusii: Omonene tana‐gokorera abanto b’ebisaku binde amang’ana buna ayio, barabwo tibamanyeti amachiiko aye. Motogie Omonene!
swahili: Hajafanya hivyo kwa taifa lingine lolote, hawazijui sheria zake. Msifuni Bwana.

english: He heals the brokenhearted and binds up their wounds.
ekegusii: Nigo akogwenia abwo chinkoro chiabo chiasionoirwe, na koboa amaote abo.
swahili: Anawaponya waliovunjika mioyo na kuvifunga vidonda vyao.

english: He determines the number of the stars; He calls them each by name.
ekegusii: Nigo amanyete omobaro bwe ching’enang’eni chionsi; boigo kera eyemo nigo ayerogete erieta.
swahili: Huzihesabu nyota na huipa kila moja jina lake.

english: Great is our Lord, and mighty in power; His understanding has no limit.
ekegusii: Omonene oito nigo are omonene mono, ne’chinguru chiaye nechinyinge; obong’aini bwaye tibokorengeka.
swahili: Bwana wetu ni mkuu na mwenye uwezo mwingi, ufahamu wake hauna kikomo.

english: The LORD sustains the humble, but casts the wicked to the ground.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo akoimokereria abanto abaitongo igoro, korende abakori amabe nigo akobaiyeria inse.
swahili: Bwana huwahifadhi wanyenyekevu lakini huwashusha waovu mpaka mavumbini.

english: Sing to the LORD with thanksgiving; make music on the harp to our God,
ekegusii: Moterere Omonene na komoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono; bugeria Nyasae oito amakano n’amariogi amaya!
swahili: Mwimbieni Bwana kwa shukrani, mpigieni Mungu wetu kinubi.

english: who covers the sky with clouds, who prepares rain for the earth, who makes grass to grow on the hills.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo agotuba igoro n’amare, bwariganeria ense embura, nigo akomeria obonyansi ase ebitunwa.
swahili: Yeye huzifunika anga kwa mawingu, huinyeshea ardhi mvua, na kuzifanya nyasi kuota juu ya vilima.

english: He provides food for the animals, and for the young ravens when they call.
ekegusii: Nere okoa ching’iti chionsi endagera yaabo, naende orageria amage y’ebigonkoru ekero akorera.
swahili: Huwapa chakula mifugo na pia makinda ya kunguru yanapolia.

english: Hallelujah! Praise the LORD from the heavens; praise Him in the highest places.
ekegusii: Motogie Omonene! Motogie Omonene korwa agwo igoro! Momotogie agwo igoro mono!
swahili: Msifuni Bwana. Msifuni Bwana kutoka mbinguni, msifuni juu vileleni.

english: wild animals and all cattle, crawling creatures and flying birds,
ekegusii: nainwe ching’iti chi’orosana na echitugire chionsi, nainwe echikwagura amo ne chinyoni chionsi!
swahili: wanyama wa mwituni na mifugo yote, viumbe vidogo na ndege warukao,

english: kings of the earth and all peoples, princes and all rulers of the earth,
ekegusii: Motogie inwe abarwoti b’ense na abanto bonsi, nainwe abagaambi na abanachi ebiina mwensi,
swahili: wafalme wa dunia na mataifa yote, ninyi wakuu na watawala wote wa dunia,

english: young men and maidens, old and young together.
ekegusii: nainwe abamura na abaiseke mwensi, nainwe abanto abagotu na abana.
swahili: wanaume vijana na wanawali, wazee na watoto.

english: Let them praise the name of the LORD, for His name alone is exalted; His splendor is above the earth and the heavens.
ekegusii: Inwe mwensi, togia erieta ri’Omonene, ekiagera erieta riaye nario rioka rire rinene rikobakwa; obonene bwaye nigo boetanaine ense na igoro.
swahili: Wote na walisifu jina la Bwana, kwa maana jina lake pekee limetukuka, utukufu wake uko juu ya nchi na mbingu.

english: He has raised up a horn for His people, the praise of all His saints, of Israel, a people near to Him. Hallelujah!
ekegusii: Omonene omeririe abanto baye ching’unchara, erinde abachenu baye bonsi bamotogie; ee, Abaisraeli abwo bare ang’e nere bamotogie! Motogie Omonene!
swahili: Amewainulia watu wake pembe, sifa ya watakatifu wake wote, ya Israeli, watu walio karibu na moyo wake. Msifuni Bwana.

english: Praise Him, all His angels; praise Him, all His heavenly hosts.
ekegusii: Inwe abamalaika baye mwensi, motogie, nainwe emeganda yaye yonsi, motogie!
swahili: Msifuni, enyi malaika wake wote, msifuni yeye, enyi jeshi lake lote la mbinguni.

english: Praise Him, O sun and moon; praise Him, all you shining stars.
ekegusii: Aye risase, na aye omotienyi, motogie, nainwe ching’enang’eni chionsi chikobara, motogie.
swahili: Msifuni yeye, enyi jua na mwezi, msifuni yeye, enyi nyota zote zingʼaazo.

english: Praise Him, O highest heavens, and you waters above the skies.
ekegusii: Inwe igoro ya igoro chionsi, motogie Nainwe amaache are igoro ya igoro, motogie!
swahili: Msifuni yeye, enyi mbingu zilizo juu sana, na ninyi maji juu ya anga.

english: Let them praise the name of the LORD, for He gave the command and they were created.
ekegusii: Ebinto ebio bionsi tiga bitogie erieta ri’Omonene, ekiagera nere ochiigete, na ebio bigatongwa.
swahili: Vilisifu jina la Bwana kwa maana aliamuru navyo vikaumbwa.

english: He established them forever and ever; He issued a decree that will never pass away.
ekegusii: Omonene obibeekire bigenderere kobao goika kare na kare; nigo abibeekerete ogochika okwo gotaetanigwe.
swahili: Aliviweka mahali pake milele na milele, alitoa amri ambayo haibadiliki milele.

english: Praise the LORD from the earth, all great sea creatures and ocean depths,
ekegusii: Motogie Omonene korwa ase ense, nainwe ebitongwa bie chinyancha ne chindiba chionsi!
swahili: Mtukuzeni Bwana kutoka duniani, ninyi viumbe vikubwa vya baharini na vilindi vyote vya bahari,

english: lightning and hail, snow and clouds, powerful wind fulfilling His word,
ekegusii: Motogie, inwe omorero na amagena y’embura, na obokeng’entu, na amare, na aye omwaga omotindi ogoikerania aya achiigete!
swahili: umeme wa radi na mvua ya mawe, theluji na mawingu, pepo za dhoruba zinazofanya amri zake,

english: mountains and all hills, fruit trees and all cedars,
ekegusii: Motogie Omonene, inwe ebitunwa na ebigoro bionsi, nainwe emete ekwama amatunda, na emecharake yonsi,
swahili: ninyi milima na vilima vyote, miti ya matunda na mierezi yote,

english: Hallelujah! Sing to the LORD a new song— His praise in the assembly of the godly.
ekegusii: Motogie Omonene! Terera Omonene ogoteera okoyia, motogie ase omosangererekano bw’ abanto abegenwa.
swahili: Msifuni Bwana. Mwimbieni Bwana wimbo mpya, sifa zake katika kusanyiko la watakatifu.

english: Let Israel rejoice in their Maker; let the children of Zion rejoice in their King.
ekegusii: Tiga Abaisraeli bagokere Omotongi obo; abanto ba Sayoni tiga bachengere Omorwoti obo!
swahili: Israeli na washangilie katika Muumba wao, watu wa Sayuni na wafurahi katika Mfalme wao.

english: Let them praise His name with dancing, and make music to Him with tambourine and harp.
ekegusii: Batogie erieta riaye ase ogotenga, babe bakobugia chinchigiri na amakano.
swahili: Na walisifu jina lake kwa kucheza na wampigie muziki kwa matari na kinubi.

english: For the LORD takes pleasure in His people; He adorns the afflicted with salvation.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo agokirie n’abanto baye; abwo bare abaitongo nigo akobachabera ogotooreka.
swahili: Kwa maana Bwana anapendezwa na watu wake, anawavika wanyenyekevu taji ya wokovu.

english: Let the saints exult in glory; let them shout for joy upon their beds.
ekegusii: Tiga abegenwa bachenge ase obonene, babe bagotera n’omogooko kobare ase amarere abo.
swahili: Watakatifu washangilie katika heshima hii, na waimbe kwa shangwe vitandani mwao.

english: May the high praises of God be in their mouths, and a double-edged sword in their hands,
ekegusii: Tiga ogotogigwa okonene kwa Nyasae kobe ase emenwa yaabo, na ase amaboko abo babogorie emeyio ya birende ere nobwoge chinsemo ibere,
swahili: Sifa za Mungu na ziwe vinywani mwao na upanga ukatao kuwili mikononi mwao,

english: to inflict vengeance on the nations and punishment on the peoples,
ekegusii: erinde barusie egesiomba ase egesaku, na bae abanto egesusuro.
swahili: ili walipize mataifa kisasi na adhabu juu ya mataifa,

english: to bind their kings with chains and their nobles with shackles of iron,
ekegusii: Boigo banyaare gosiba abarwoti baabo nebinyuri, na abanene baabo ne chingataare chi’ekioma,
swahili: wawafunge wafalme wao kwa minyororo, wakuu wao kwa pingu za chuma,

english: to execute the judgment written against them. This honor is for all His saints. Hallelujah!
ekegusii: erinde baabanachere ekiina keriikire. Obo nabwo obonene bw’abegenwa bonsi bw’Omonene. Motogie Omonene!
swahili: ili kuwafanyia hukumu iliyoandikwa dhidi yao. Huu ndio utukufu wa watakatifu wake wote. Msifuni Bwana.

english: The fool says in his heart, “There is no God.” They are corrupt; their acts are vile. There is no one who does good.
ekegusii: Abanto abariri nigo bakorengereria ase chinkoro chiabo ime: “Nyasae tari.” Barabwo nabasareku, bagokora amang’ana ay’okogechia; onde tari ogokora ayare amaya, nonya noyomo.
swahili: Mpumbavu anasema moyoni mwake, “Hakuna Mungu.” Wameharibika, matendo yao ni maovu kabisa; hakuna hata mmoja atendaye mema.

english: The LORD looks down from heaven upon the sons of men to see if any understand, if any seek God.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo arigereretie Mwanyabaanto korwa igoro, arore gose monto onde nareo ore omong’aini, oyokomorigia Nyasae.
swahili: Bwana anawachungulia wanadamu chini kutoka mbinguni aone kama wako wenye akili, wowote wanaomtafuta Mungu.

english: All have turned away, they have together become corrupt; there is no one who does good, not even one.
ekegusii: Abanto bonsi basirire enchera, bonsi amo bagundire; onde tari ogokora amaya, nonya noyomo.
swahili: Wote wamepotoka, wameharibika wote pamoja, hakuna atendaye mema. Naam, hakuna hata mmoja!

english: Will the workers of iniquity never learn? They devour my people like bread; they refuse to call upon the LORD.
ekegusii: Inee! Abanto aba bonsi abakori amabe tibari nokomanya? Nigo bakoria abanto baane ase okobaurereria buna bakoria endagera yabo; tibari korangeri’Omonene abakoonye.
swahili: Je, watendao mabaya kamwe hawatajifunza: wale ambao huwala watu wangu kama watu walavyo mkate, hao ambao hawamwiti Bwana?

english: There they are, overwhelmed with dread, for God is in the company of the righteous.
ekegusii: Erio agwo abanto abwo mbasogwe nomoondoko omonene mono, ekiagera Nyasae nigo are amo nabaanto abaronge.
swahili: Wako hapo, wameingiwa na hofu kuu, maana Mungu yupo pamoja na wenye haki.

english: You sinners frustrate the plans of the oppressed, yet the LORD is their shelter.
ekegusii: Inwe abakori amabe nigo mogochaaya omooroberio bw’omonto otari na nguru, korende Omonene nere obotamero bwaye.
swahili: Ninyi watenda mabaya mnakwamisha mipango ya maskini, bali Bwana ndiye kimbilio lao.

english: Oh, that the salvation of Israel would come from Zion! When the LORD restores His captive people, let Jacob rejoice, let Israel be glad!
ekegusii: Naki yare koba buya onye ogotooreka ngwachera Abaisraeli korwa Sayoni! Ekero Omonene arairanerie abanto baye amaya abo, abanto b’ororeeria rwa Yakobo mbachenge, ee, Abaisraeli mbabe nomogooko.
swahili: Laiti wokovu wa Israeli ungalikuja kutoka Sayuni! Wakati Bwana arejeshapo wafungwa wa watu wake, Yakobo na ashangilie, Israeli na afurahi!

english: Hallelujah! Praise God in His sanctuary. Praise Him in His mighty heavens.
ekegusii: Motogie Omonene! Motogie Nyasae agwo ase obomenyo bwaye obochenu, motogie agwo igoro eyio yatongetwe ase okobua kwaye!
swahili: Msifuni Bwana. Msifuni Mungu katika patakatifu pake, msifuni katika mbingu zake kuu.

english: Praise Him for His mighty acts; praise Him for His excellent greatness.
ekegusii: Motogie ase engencho y’ogokora kwaye okonene; motogie koreng’ana nobonene bwaye bore ne’chinguru chinyinge goetania!
swahili: Msifuni kwa matendo yake makuu, msifuni kwa kadiri ya wingi wa ukuu wake.

english: Praise Him with the sound of the horn; praise Him with the harp and lyre.
ekegusii: Motogie ase okobugia ebitureeri; motogie ase okobugia amakano onsi!
swahili: Msifuni kwa mvumo wa tarumbeta, msifuni kwa kinubi na zeze,

english: Praise Him with tambourine and dancing; praise Him with strings and flute.
ekegusii: Motogie ase okobugia chinchigiri na gotenga; motogie ase okobugia amakano na ebiroria!
swahili: msifuni kwa matari na kucheza, msifuni kwa kinanda cha nyuzi na filimbi,

english: Praise Him with clashing cymbals; praise Him with resounding cymbals.
ekegusii: Motogie ase ogoakania chisani chikwoga amariogi are inse; motogie ase ogoakania chisani chikwoga amariogi are igoro!
swahili: msifuni kwa matoazi yaliayo, msifuni kwa matoazi yavumayo sana.

english: Let everything that has breath praise the LORD! Hallelujah!
ekegusii: Tiga ebitongwa bionsi bire moyo bitogie Omonene! Motogie Omonene!
swahili: Kila chenye pumzi na kimsifu Bwana. Msifuni Bwana!

english: O LORD, who may abide in Your tent? Who may dwell on Your holy mountain?
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ’monto ki oranyare komenya ase obomenyo bwao? Ning’o oranyare komenya ase egetunwa kiao egechenu?
swahili: Bwana, ni nani awezaye kukaa katika Hekalu lako? Nani awezaye kuishi katika mlima wako mtakatifu?

english: He who walks with integrity and practices righteousness, who speaks the truth from his heart,
ekegusii: Nomonto oria orogendo rwaye rore oroikeranu, oria ogokora kwaye kore okuya, na amang’ana agokwana korwa ase enkoro yaye nay’ekeene,
swahili: Ni yule aendaye pasipo mawaa, atendaye yaliyo haki, asemaye kweli toka moyoni mwake,

english: who has no slander on his tongue, who does no harm to his neighbor, who casts no scorn on his friend,
ekegusii: naende ere tari omogenki, omonto oyio tari gokorera monto onde bobe, gose tari gokwana onde bobe.
swahili: na hana masingizio ulimini mwake, asiyemtenda jirani yake vibaya, na asiyemsingizia mwenzake,

english: who despises the vile but honors those who fear the LORD, who does not revise a costly oath,
ekegusii: Ere nigo achayete oyobwangire na Nyasae, korende osika abwo bamoirogete Omonene. Karire eira na gotiana tari koonchoka, nonya egochia komorentera obokong’u.
swahili: ambaye humdharau mtu mbaya, lakini huwaheshimu wale wamwogopao Bwana, yule atunzaye kiapo chake hata kama anaumia.

english: who lends his money without interest and refuses a bribe against the innocent. He who does these things will never be shaken.
ekegusii: Ekero akorua chitaabu chiaye singo tari kogania ebitoki, omonto oyio tari koira risoya, erio kogera omonto otari nokomocha agambigwe. Omonto ogokora oboronge ase amang’ana ayio onsi namenye ase obotoereru kare na kare.
swahili: Yeye akopeshaye fedha yake bila riba, na hapokei rushwa dhidi ya mtu asiye na hatia. Mtu afanyaye haya kamwe hatatikisika.

english: Preserve me, O God, for in You I take refuge.
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, gaki ondende, ekiagera naye ngotamera.
swahili: Ee Mungu, uniweke salama, kwa maana kwako nimekimbilia.

english: For You will not abandon my soul to Sheol, nor will You let Your Holy One see decay.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, togontiga agwo aase abakuure gose togotiga omochenu oo agunde.
swahili: kwa maana hutaniacha kaburini, wala hutamwacha Mtakatifu Wako kuona uharibifu.

english: You have made known to me the path of life; You will fill me with joy in Your presence, with eternal pleasures at Your right hand.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, nonyorokererie enchera ekogenda ase obogima; ase obosio bwao noreo omogooko omonge mono kegima; ase ensemo yao y’okorio mboreo obwansu obuya goika kare na kare.
swahili: Umenijulisha njia ya uzima; utanijaza na furaha mbele zako, pamoja na furaha za milele katika mkono wako wa kuume.

english: I said to the LORD, “You are my Lord; apart from You I have no good thing.”
ekegusii: Nigo ngoteebia Omonene iga: “Aye naye Omonene one, obuya bwonsi ’nde nabwo nigo bokorwa asore.”
swahili: Nilimwambia Bwana, “Wewe ndiwe Bwana wangu; pasipo wewe sina jambo jema.”

english: As for the saints in the land, they are the excellence in whom all my delight resides.
ekegusii: Abanto abachenu bare ase ense nigo bare nobonene bokumete; abwo nabwo bangogeetie mono.
swahili: Kwa habari ya watakatifu walioko duniani, ndio walio wa fahari ambao ninapendezwa nao.

english: Sorrows will multiply to those who chase other gods. I will not pour out their libations of blood, or speak their names with my lips.
ekegusii: Abwo bakominyokera chinyasae ching’ao, nigo bakwementera emechando. Tinkoumora okoruegwa kw’amanyinga okwo bakorua, gose tingwatora amarieta abo n’ebikoba biane.
swahili: Huzuni itaongezeka kwa wale wanaokimbilia miungu mingine. Sitazimimina sadaka zao za damu au kutaja majina yao midomoni mwangu.

english: The LORD is my chosen portion and my cup; You have made my lot secure.
ekegusii: Omonene nere egetare kiane; nere okong’a onsi aya ’ngwenerete konyora; ere igo arendete aya antungetie.
swahili: Bwana umeniwekea fungu langu na kikombe changu; umeyafanya mambo yangu yote yawe salama.

english: The lines of my boundary have fallen in pleasant places; surely my inheritance is delightful.
ekegusii: Ebintungetie biangwereire agwo aase are aagiya, ee, omwando one nigo ore omuya mono kegima.
swahili: Alama za mipaka zimeniangukia mahali pazuri, hakika nimepata urithi mzuri.

english: I will bless the LORD who counsels me; even at night my conscience instructs me.
ekegusii: Nigo ngotogia Omonene oyo ogonsemia, ase obotuko enkoro yane nigo egonteebereria gokora igo.
swahili: Nitamsifu Bwana ambaye hunishauri, hata wakati wa usiku moyo wangu hunifundisha.

english: I have set the LORD always before me. Because He is at my right hand, I will not be shaken.
ekegusii: Botambe, nigo ndigereretie Omonene; ere nigo are ensemo yane y’okorio, igo tinkwoboa.
swahili: Nimemweka Bwana mbele yangu daima. Kwa sababu yuko mkono wangu wa kuume, sitatikisika.

english: Therefore my heart is glad and my tongue rejoices; my body also will dwell securely.
ekegusii: Ase igo, enkoro yane amo n’omoyo one nigo bire nomosasoko; nonya n’omobere one nigo omenyete ase ogosemeria.
swahili: Kwa hiyo moyo wangu unafurahia, na ulimi wangu unashangilia; mwili wangu nao utapumzika salama,

english: Hear, O LORD, my righteous plea; listen to my cry. Give ear to my prayer— it comes from lips free of deceit.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, tegerera oigwe okogania kwane kw’ogokorerwa oboronge, igwa okorera kwane na ogosaba kwane, omonwa one tori gokwana obong’ainereria.
swahili: Sikia, Ee Bwana, kusihi kwangu kwa haki, sikiliza kilio changu. Tega sikio kwa ombi langu, halitoki kwenye midomo ya udanganyifu.

english: They have closed their callous hearts; their mouths speak with arrogance.
ekegusii: Abanto abwo bare ne chinkoro chitari namaabera nigo bagokwana amang’ana ’oboenenu.
swahili: Huifunga mioyo yao iliyo migumu, vinywa vyao hunena kwa majivuno.

english: They have tracked us down, and now surround us; their eyes are set to cast us to the ground,
ekegusii: Bono bang’etananire ase chinsemo chionsi; banaaririe, erinde bambwate na konyiyeria inse.
swahili: Wamenifuatia nyayo zangu, sasa wamenizingira, wakiwa macho, waniangushe chini.

english: like a lion greedy for prey, like a young lion lurking in ambush.
ekegusii: Barabwo nigo banga buna endo eganetie orotwari; buna endo ensae eboete ase egesarara.
swahili: Wamefanana na simba mwenye njaa awindaye, kama simba mkubwa anyemeleaye mafichoni.

english: Arise, O LORD, confront them! Bring them to their knees; deliver me from the wicked by Your sword,
ekegusii: Omonene, gaki imoka! Orwanie ababisa baane obabue! Ntoorie korwa ase abakori amabe ase okobarwania n’omoro oo.
swahili: Inuka, Ee Bwana, pambana nao, uwaangushe, niokoe kutokana na waovu kwa upanga wako.

english: from such men, O LORD, by Your hand— from men of the world whose portion is in this life. May You fill the bellies of Your treasured ones and satisfy their sons, so they leave their abundance to their children.
ekegusii: Ee, Omonene, ntoorie nokoboko kwao korwa ase abanto abwo. Barabwo nabaanto b’ense eye, egetari kiabo neki’obogima obo. Chinda chiabo chiisaneke n’ebinto ebio kwabagacheire, biisane nase abana babo, naende abachokoro babo batigerwe ebiatigaire.
swahili: Ee Bwana, mkono wako uniokoe na watu wa jinsi hii, kutokana na watu wa ulimwengu huu ambao fungu lao liko katika maisha haya. Na wapate adhabu ya kuwatosha. Watoto wao na wapate zaidi ya hayo, hukumu na iendelee kwa watoto wa watoto wao.

english: As for me, I will behold Your face in righteousness; when I awake, I will be satisfied in Your presence.
ekegusii: Korende inche nindore obosio bwao inde noboronge; ekero ndabokigwe ning’isaneke ase ogokorora.
swahili: Na mimi katika haki nitauona uso wako, niamkapo, nitaridhika kwa kuona sura yako.

english: May my vindication come from Your presence; may Your eyes see what is right.
ekegusii: Aye omonyene onachere ekiina gi’okong’a oboronge, amaiso ao nigo akorora ayare ay’ekeene.
swahili: Hukumu yangu na itoke kwako, macho yako na yaone yale yaliyo haki.

english: You have tried my heart; You have visited me in the night. You have tested me and found no evil; I have resolved not to sin with my mouth.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, kwarengire enkoro yane, nonya nase obotuko nigo ogonteema, kwauna-unirie na tonyoreti gento, amabe are ase enkoro yane tinkoyakwana.
swahili: Ingawa unauchunguza moyo wangu na kunikagua usiku, ingawa umenijaribu, hutaona chochote. Nimeamua kwamba kinywa changu hakitatenda dhambi.

english: As for the deeds of men— by the word of Your lips I have avoided the ways of the violent.
ekegusii: Mang’ana ande onsi abanto bagokora, na koreng’ana namang’ana ao natigire kobwatia chinchera chi’abasaria.
swahili: Kuhusu matendo ya wanadamu: kwa neno la midomo yako, nimejiepusha na njia za wenye jeuri.

english: My steps have held to Your paths; my feet have not slipped.
ekegusii: Nabeire nkobwatia chinchera chiao botambe; amagoro aane tana-gotererigwa.
swahili: Hatua zangu zimeshikamana na njia zako; nyayo zangu hazikuteleza.

english: I call on You, O God, for You will answer me. Incline Your ear to me; hear my words.
ekegusii: Nyasae, nigo ngokorangeria ng’a onkonye, ekiagera aye nong’itabere; tegerera oigwe amang’ana aane ngokoboria.
swahili: Ee Mungu, ninakuita, kwa kuwa utanijibu, nitegee sikio lako na usikie ombi langu.

english: Show the wonders of Your loving devotion, You who save by Your right hand those who seek refuge from their foes.
ekegusii: Aye Omotooria bw’abagotamera okoboko kwao kwa borio korwa ase ababisa babo, oorokia obwanchani bwao bw’ogokumia.
swahili: Uonyeshe ajabu ya upendo wako mkuu, wewe uokoaye kwa mkono wako wa kuume wale wanaokukimbilia kutokana na adui zao.

english: Keep me as the apple of Your eye; hide me in the shadow of Your wings
ekegusii: Indende buna orendete endorero y’eriso riao; intube ase ekiriri gie chimbaaba chiao;
swahili: Nilinde kama mboni ya jicho lako, unifiche chini ya kivuli cha mbawa zako

english: from the wicked who assail me, from my mortal enemies who surround me.
ekegusii: mbise korwa ase abakori amabe, abarigetie gonsiria, korwa ase ababisa bang’etanaine bang’ite.
swahili: kutokana na waovu wanaonishambulia, kutokana na adui wauaji wanaonizunguka.

english: I love You, O LORD, my strength.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, aye chinguru chiane, ningwanchete mono!
swahili: Nakupenda wewe, Ee Bwana, nguvu yangu.

english: He mounted a cherub and flew; He soared on the wings of the wind.
ekegusii: Akariina egetongwa kebwate chimbaba, akairuruka, agacha ng’ora igoro ye chimbaaba chi’embeo.
swahili: Alipanda juu ya kerubi akaruka, akapaa juu kwa mbawa za upepo.

english: He made darkness His hiding place, and storm clouds a canopy around Him.
ekegusii: Agakora omosunte koba egietubo kiaye ere omonyenye, na amare amarito aichire amaache.
swahili: Alifanya giza kuwa kitu chake cha kujifunika, hema lake kumzunguka, mawingu meusi ya mvua ya angani.

english: From the brightness of His presence His clouds advanced— hailstones and coals of fire.
ekegusii: Korwa ase obomeka-meku obwo bwarenge bosio bwaye amagena ’embura na omorero bw’amakara bigasoka goetera ase amare aye.
swahili: Kutokana na mwanga wa uwepo wake mawingu yalisogea, ikanyesha mvua ya mawe na umeme wa radi.

english: The LORD thundered from heaven; the voice of the Most High resounded— hailstones and coals of fire.
ekegusii: Omonene agaaka enkoba korwa igoro; na eriogi ri’Oyore Igoro Mono rikaigugwa; amagena ’embura na omorero bw’amakara bigacha.
swahili: Bwana alinguruma kutoka mbinguni, sauti ya Aliye Juu Sana ilisikika.

english: He shot His arrows and scattered the foes; He hurled lightning and routed them.
ekegusii: Akaruta emegwe yaye, agaserebania ababisa baye; akamesia chinkoba, akabatantania.
swahili: Aliipiga mishale yake na kutawanya adui, naam, umeme mwingi wa radi na kuwafukuza.

english: The channels of the sea appeared, and the foundations of the world were exposed, at Your rebuke, O LORD, at the blast of the breath of Your nostrils.
ekegusii: Erio ebiambokero bi’enyancha bikarorekana, na amaroso ’ense akaorokigwa aarabu, ekero Omonene abatogonyerete ase ogwoka kw’omoika bwe chimioro chiaye.
swahili: Mabonde ya bahari yalifunuliwa, na misingi ya dunia ikawa wazi kwa kukaripia kwako, Ee Bwana, kwa uvumi wa pumzi kutoka puani mwako.

english: He reached down from on high and took hold of me; He drew me out of deep waters.
ekegusii: Omonene akarambora okoboko kwaye korwa igoro, akambwata, akandusia ase amaache amange.
swahili: Alinyoosha mkono kutoka juu na kunishika; alinitoa kutoka kilindi cha maji makuu.

english: He rescued me from my powerful enemy, from foes too mighty for me.
ekegusii: Agantooria korwa ase omobisa one ore ne chinguru, na korwa ase abwo bangechete; barabwo nigo barenge ne chinguru kombua.
swahili: Aliniokoa kutoka adui wangu mwenye nguvu nyingi, kutoka adui zangu waliokuwa na nguvu nyingi kuliko mimi.

english: They confronted me in my day of calamity, but the LORD was my support.
ekegusii: Ekero narenge nemechando bakandwania, korende Omonene akaba egekengero kiane.
swahili: Walinikabili siku ya msiba wangu, lakini Bwana alikuwa msaada wangu.

english: He brought me out into the open; He rescued me because He delighted in me.
ekegusii: Akang’ira aase arenge aagare; agantooria, ekiagera namogogetie.
swahili: Alinileta nje mahali penye nafasi tele, akaniokoa kwa kuwa alipendezwa nami.

english: The LORD is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer. My God is my rock, in whom I take refuge, my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my stronghold.
ekegusii: Omonene nere egetare kiane na eburi yane y’ogokumia, nere Omotooria one, na Nyasae one, Nyasae one nere egetare kiane ’ndatamere; nere enguba egonkengera, na Omotooria one bw’echinguru, oyo ogonkengera bokong’u.
swahili: Bwana ni mwamba wangu, ngome yangu na mwokozi wangu, Mungu wangu ni mwamba, ambaye kwake ninakimbilia. Yeye ni ngao yangu na pembe ya wokovu wangu, ngome yangu.

english: The LORD has rewarded me according to my righteousness; He has repaid me according to the cleanness of my hands.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo ang’ete eng’eria y’obuya, ekiagera inde omooronge, nigo ansesenetie, ekiagera inde namaboko atari na komocha.
swahili: Bwana alinitendea sawasawa na uadilifu wangu; sawasawa na usafi wa mikono yangu amenilipa.

english: For I have kept the ways of the LORD and have not wickedly departed from my God.
ekegusii: Inche nabeire nkobwatia chinchera chia Omonene, tintigeti Nyasae one ase ogokora obonyaka.
swahili: Kwa maana nimezishika njia za Bwana; sijatenda ubaya nikamwacha Mungu wangu.

english: For all His ordinances are before me; I have not disregarded His statutes.
ekegusii: Nabeire nkorenda amachiiko aye onsi, na timbeti ngotiga emeroberio yaye echiikire.
swahili: Sheria zake zote zi mbele yangu, wala sijayaacha maagizo yake.

english: And I have been blameless before Him and kept myself from iniquity.
ekegusii: Nigo narenge omoikeranu asare, nkerenda korwa ase obobe.
swahili: Nimekuwa sina hatia mbele zake, nami nimejilinda nisitende dhambi.

english: So the LORD has repaid me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in His sight.
ekegusii: Omonene ong’akanire, ekiagera ngokora ayare boronge, na ekiagera aroche ng’a amaboko aane achenekire.
swahili: Bwana amenilipa sawasawa na uadilifu wangu; sawasawa na usafi wa mikono yangu machoni pake.

english: To the faithful You show Yourself faithful, to the blameless You show Yourself blameless;
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, nigo ore omwegenwa ase abwo bare abegenwa, nigo okweorokia ng’a nomoikeranu ore ase abwo bare abaikeranu.
swahili: Kwa yeye aliye mwaminifu, unajionyesha kuwa mwaminifu, kwa asiye na hatia, unajionyesha kutokuwa na hatia.

english: to the pure You show Yourself pure, but to the crooked You show Yourself shrewd.
ekegusii: Aye nigo ore omochenu ase abwo bare abachenu; nigo okwanga abwo bare abakorekanu.
swahili: Kwa aliye mtakatifu, unajionyesha kuwa mtakatifu, lakini kwa aliyepotoka, unajionyesha kuwa mkaidi.

english: For You save an afflicted people, but You humble those with haughty eyes.
ekegusii: Aye nigo ogotooria abanto bare abaitongo, korende abwo bare namaiso ’oboenenu nigo okobairania inse.
swahili: Wewe huwaokoa wanyenyekevu, lakini huwashusha wenye kiburi.

english: For You, O LORD, light my lamp; my God lights up my darkness.
ekegusii: Ee, naye ogontongeria etaya yane; Omonene, Nyasae one, nigo akomoreka omosunte ore asende oba oborabu.
swahili: Wewe, Ee Bwana, unaifanya taa yangu iendelee kuwaka; Mungu wangu hulifanya giza langu kuwa mwanga.

english: For in You I can charge an army, and with my God I can scale a wall.
ekegusii: Konde amo naye, nigo ndasirie omoganda bw’esegi; na ekero inde na Nyasae one nincharoke chindwaki igoro.
swahili: Kwa msaada wako naweza kushinda jeshi, nikiwa pamoja na Mungu wangu nitaweza kuruka ukuta.

english: I will call upon the LORD, who is worthy to be praised; so shall I be saved from my enemies.
ekegusii: Nindangerie Omonene, oyo ogwenerete gotogigwa, nigo arantoorie korwa ase ababisa baane.
swahili: Ninamwita Bwana anayestahili kusifiwa, nami ninaokolewa kutoka kwa adui zangu.

english: As for God, His way is perfect; the word of the LORD is flawless. He is a shield to all who take refuge in Him.
ekegusii: Enchera ya Nyasae neng’ikeranu, amang’ana aye ateemirwe na gotenena. Ere nenguba ase bonsi abakomotamera.
swahili: Kuhusu Mungu, njia yake ni kamilifu, neno la Bwana halina dosari. Yeye ni ngao kwa wote wanaokimbilia kwake.

english: It is God who arms me with strength and makes my way clear.
ekegusii: Nyasae nere okomboyia chinguru na kondenda ase enchera yane.
swahili: Mungu ndiye anivikaye nguvu na kufanya njia yangu kuwa kamilifu.

english: He makes my feet like those of a deer and stations me upon the heights.
ekegusii: Ere okorire amagoro aane abeire buna ey’egesia, onkong’irie na gontenenia ase ebitunwa.
swahili: Huifanya miguu yangu kama miguu ya kulungu, huniwezesha kusimama mahali palipo juu.

english: He trains my hands for battle; my arms can bend a bow of bronze.
ekegusii: Ere bworokereirie amaboko aane korwana esegi, erinde amaboko aane anyare gotinga obota bw’etai.
swahili: Huifundisha mikono yangu kupigana vita; mikono yangu inaweza kupinda upinde wa shaba.

english: You have given me Your shield of salvation; Your right hand upholds me, and Your gentleness exalts me.
ekegusii: Aye kwang’eire enguba yao ase ogontooria, okoboko kwao gw’okorio kogansiira; na ogokonywa kwao gwankorire nabeire omonene.
swahili: Hunipa ngao yako ya ushindi, nao mkono wako wa kuume hunitegemeza, unajishusha chini ili kuniinua.

english: You broaden the path beneath me so that my ankles do not give way.
ekegusii: Kwang’eire aase aagare ngotaara, na amagoro aane tagotererigwa.
swahili: Huyapanua mapito yangu, ili miguu yangu isiteleze.

english: I pursued my enemies and overtook them; I did not turn back until they were consumed.
ekegusii: Nkabwatia ababisa baane, nkabaikeera inchera; gose tinairanete goika nkabakoora.
swahili: Niliwafuatia adui zangu na nikawapata, sikurudi nyuma mpaka walipoangamizwa.

english: I crushed them so they could not rise; they have fallen under my feet.
ekegusii: Nkabaaka inse nkabasenyenta, tibanyara koimoka, bakagwa inse y’amagoro aane, bakabugwa.
swahili: Niliwaseta hata hawakuweza kuinuka tena; walianguka chini ya miguu yangu.

english: You have armed me with strength for battle; You have subdued my foes beneath me.
ekegusii: Aye nigo kwambegete chinguru chi’okorwana esegi; okabeka ababisa baane inse y’amagoro aane.
swahili: Ulinivika nguvu kwa ajili ya kupigana vita; uliwafanya adui zangu wasujudu miguuni pangu.

english: The cords of death encompassed me; the torrents of chaos overwhelmed me.
ekegusii: Obororo bw’amakweri bokong’etanana, chiooro chi’obobe chikandetera obwoba.
swahili: Kamba za mauti zilinizunguka, mafuriko ya maangamizi yalinilemea.

english: You have made my enemies retreat before me; I put an end to those who hated me.
ekegusii: Ogakora ababisa baane bagatama korwa asende; abangechete nkabasiria kegima.
swahili: Uliwafanya adui zangu wageuke na kukimbia, nami nikawaangamiza adui zangu.

english: They cried for help, but there was no one to save them— to the LORD, but He did not answer.
ekegusii: Abanto aba bakarera ng’a bakonywe, korende onde tarenge obatooretie, bakarangeri’Omonene, korende ere tabaigwa.
swahili: Walipiga yowe, lakini hapakuwepo na yeyote wa kuwaokoa; walimlilia Bwana, lakini hakuwajibu.

english: I ground them as dust in the face of the wind; I trampled them like mud in the streets.
ekegusii: Nkabasunyunta bakaba ebuse ekoirurukigwa nomwaga; nkabatuguta buna ngotuguta esike ase enchera.
swahili: Niliwaponda kama mavumbi yanayopeperushwa na upepo; niliwamwaga nje kama tope barabarani.

english: You have delivered me from the strife of the people; You have made me the head of nations; a people I had not known shall serve me.
ekegusii: Aye gwantooririe korwa ase okoamererania nabaanto, kwambekire nabeire omogambi bw’abaanto b’ebisaku; abanto ntamanyete, bono babeire abasomba baane.
swahili: Umeniokoa kutokana na mashambulizi ya watu; umenifanya kuwa kiongozi wa mataifa, watu ambao sikuwajua wananitumikia.

english: When they hear me, they obey me; foreigners cower before me.
ekegusii: Ekero baigure chinkuma chiane nigo bakonyigwera; abamenyi nigo bagocha bebeka inse yane.
swahili: Mara wanisikiapo hunitii, wageni hunyenyekea mbele yangu.

english: Foreigners lose heart and come trembling from their strongholds.
ekegusii: Abanto b’ebisaku ebiaao berusirie moyo kobagosoka korwa ase chiburi chiabo, nigo bakoiguswa.
swahili: Wote wanalegea, wanatoka katika ngome zao wakitetemeka.

english: The LORD lives, and blessed be my Rock! And may the God of my salvation be exalted—
ekegusii: Omonene nigo are moyo! Ere oyore egetare kiane atogigwe! Nyasae ore ogotooreka kwane aimokererigwe igoro.
swahili: Bwana yu hai! Sifa ni kwa Mwamba wangu! Atukuzwe Mungu Mwokozi wangu!

english: the God who avenges me and subdues nations beneath me,
ekegusii: Nyasae nigo akonduseria egesiomba, nabeeke abanto b’ebisaku inse yane.
swahili: Yeye ndiye Mungu anilipiziaye kisasi, awatiishaye mataifa chini yangu,

english: who delivers me from my enemies. You exalt me above my foes; You rescue me from violent men.
ekegusii: Ere nigo antooretie korwa ase ababisa baane, akanyimokereria igoro ase abare mamincha yane, naende agantooria korwa ase abanto abatindi.
swahili: aniokoaye na adui zangu. Uliniinua juu ya adui zangu; uliniokoa toka kwa watu wajeuri.

english: Therefore I will praise You, O LORD, among the nations; I will sing praises to Your name.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ase ayio ningotogie ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku, ninterere erieta riao ase okoritogia.
swahili: Kwa hiyo nitakusifu katikati ya mataifa, Ee Bwana; nitaliimbia sifa jina lako.

english: Great salvation He brings to His king. He shows loving devotion to His anointed, to David and his descendants forever.
ekegusii: Nyasae ong’eire inche, omorwoti oye, obobui obonene, oorokirie obwanchani botari koera asende, inche omoakwa amaguta oye. Inche Daudi, na ororeria rwane, goika kare na kare.
swahili: Humpa mfalme wake ushindi mkuu, huonyesha fadhili zake kwa mpakwa mafuta wake, kwa Daudi na wazao wake milele.

english: In my distress I called upon the LORD; I cried to my God for help. From His temple He heard my voice, and my cry for His help reached His ears.
ekegusii: Ase emechando yane nkarangeri’Omonene, nkarera ase Nyasae one ng’a ankonye. Korwa ase Hekalu yaye akaigwa eriogi riane, ekerero kiane gekamoikera, ere agakeigwa.
swahili: Katika shida yangu nalimwita Bwana, nilimlilia Mungu wangu anisaidie. Kutoka hekaluni mwake alisikia sauti yangu, kilio changu kikafika mbele zake, masikioni mwake.

english: Then the earth shook and quaked, and the foundations of the mountains trembled; they were shaken because He burned with anger.
ekegusii: Erio ense ekanyegerigwa na koondoka, na amaroso ’ebitunwa agatengechigwa. Ee, ense ekaiguswa, ekiagera Omonene arenge nendamwamu.
swahili: Dunia ilitetemeka na kutikisika, misingi ya milima ikatikisika, vilitetemeka kwa sababu alikuwa amekasirika.

english: Smoke rose from His nostrils, and consuming fire came from His mouth; glowing coals blazed forth.
ekegusii: Erioki rigasoka korwa ase chimioro chiaye, na omorero ogosamba ogasoka korwa ase omonwa oye; ee, omorero bw’amakara ogasoka korwa asare.
swahili: Moshi ukapanda kutoka puani mwake, moto uteketezao ukatoka kinywani mwake, makaa ya moto yawakayo yakatoka ndani mwake.

english: He parted the heavens and came down with dark clouds beneath His feet.
ekegusii: Akang’usa igoro gocha inse aa, agacha; riire rimwamu rikaba inse y’amagoro aye.
swahili: Akazipasua mbingu akashuka chini, mawingu meusi yalikuwa chini ya miguu yake.

english: The heavens declare the glory of God; the skies proclaim the work of His hands.
ekegusii: Igoro nigo chikoorokia obonene bwa Nyasae; na eaanga ya igoro eraria emeremo y’amaboko aye.
swahili: Mbingu zinatangaza utukufu wa Mungu, anga zahubiri kazi ya mikono yake.

english: They are more precious than gold, than much pure gold; they are sweeter than honey, than honey from the comb.
ekegusii: Ayio onsi nigo are amaya kobua etaabu, ee, kobua etaabu echenire na amansu kobua obooke, ee, kobua richoe ri’obooke.
swahili: Ni za thamani kuliko dhahabu, kuliko dhahabu iliyo safi sana, ni tamu kuliko asali, kuliko asali kutoka kwenye sega.

english: By them indeed Your servant is warned; in keeping them is great reward.
ekegusii: Amo nayio nigo ogokuurera omosomba oo; oyio okoyarenda nigo akoegwa eng’eria enene y’obuya.
swahili: Kwa hizo mtumishi wako anaonywa, katika kuzishika kuna thawabu kubwa.

english: Who can discern his own errors? Cleanse me from my hidden faults.
ekegusii: Ning’o oranyare komanya amamocho aye? Omonene, nchene korwa ase amamocho aane abisekanete.
swahili: Ni nani awezaye kutambua makosa yake? Nisamehe makosa yangu nisiyoyajua.

english: Keep Your servant also from willful sins; may they not rule over me. Then I will be blameless and cleansed of great transgression.
ekegusii: Ontange inche, omosomba oo, tinkora ebibe bi’obomwenu; tobitiga ebio bingambere! Rirorio nimbe ntari na komocha, nimbe omosibore korwa ase ogosaria okonene.
swahili: Mlinde mtumishi wako na dhambi za makusudi, nazo zisinitawale. Ndipo nitakapokuwa sina lawama, wala sitakuwa na hatia ya kosa kubwa.

english: May the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be pleasing in Your sight, O LORD, my Rock and my Redeemer.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, Egetare kiane na Omobooria one, anchera amang’ana aane na ebirengererio bire ase enkoro yane.
swahili: Maneno ya kinywa changu na mawazo ya moyo wangu, yapate kibali mbele zako, Ee Bwana, Mwamba wangu na Mkombozi wangu.

english: Day after day they pour forth speech; night after night they reveal knowledge.
ekegusii: Rituko erimo riatebia erinde obonene obo, na obotuko obomo bwarareria obotuko bonde ayio ayio.
swahili: Siku baada ya siku zinatoa habari, usiku baada ya usiku zinatangaza maarifa.

english: Without speech or language, without a sound to be heard,
ekegusii: Chinkwana chinde tichiri aroro, gose omonwa onde ogokwanwa tori, na eriogi riabo tiriri koigugwa.
swahili: Hakuna msemo wala lugha, ambapo sauti zao hazisikiki.

english: their voice has gone out into all the earth, their words to the ends of the world. In the heavens He has pitched a tent for the sun.
ekegusii: Eriogi riabo riagendire, riesiareire ase ense engima, na amang’ana abo aikire chinsinyo chi’ense. Nyasae okorire igoro koba obomenyo bw’erioba.
swahili: Sauti yao imeenea duniani pote, nayo maneno yao yameenea hadi miisho ya ulimwengu. Katika mbingu amepiga hema kwa ajili ya jua,

english: Like a bridegroom emerging from his chamber, like a champion rejoicing to run his course,
ekegusii: Erioba nigo rigosoka buna omonywomi ogosoka korwa mwaye, na riagoka buna omogosoria omokong’u okominyoka chimbero.
swahili: linafanana na bwana arusi akitoka chumbani mwake, kama shujaa afurahiavyo kukamilisha kushindana kwake.

english: it rises at one end of the heavens and runs its circuit to the other; nothing is deprived of its warmth.
ekegusii: Nigo rigosoka korwa ensemo eyemo ya igoro, naende riekumba riagenda gochia ensemo ende; gento kende tikeri gekobisekana korwa ase riberera riaye. Amachiiko y’Omonene
swahili: Huchomoza upande mmoja wa mbingu, na kufanya mzunguko wake hadi upande mwingine. Hakuna kilichojificha joto lake.

english: The Law of the LORD is perfect, reviving the soul; the testimony of the LORD is trustworthy, making wise the simple.
ekegusii: Amachiiko ’Omonene namaikeranu, nigo agokora omoyo oba omoyia. Oborori bw’Omonene nobw’ekeene, nigo akong’ainiyia oyotamanyeti amange.
swahili: Sheria ya Bwana ni kamilifu, ikihuisha nafsi. Shuhuda za Bwana ni za kuaminika, zikimpa mjinga hekima.

english: The precepts of the LORD are right, bringing joy to the heart; the commandments of the LORD are radiant, giving light to the eyes.
ekegusii: Amachiiko ’Omonene namaronge, nigo akogokia enkoro; ring’an’Omonene achiikire nerironge, nigo rikorenta oborabu ase amaiso.
swahili: Maagizo ya Bwana ni kamili, nayo hufurahisha moyo. Amri za Bwana huangaza, zatia nuru machoni.

english: The fear of the LORD is pure, enduring forever; the judgments of the LORD are true, being altogether righteous.
ekegusii: Okomoiroka Omonene nering’ana richenegete, okwo koragenderere kare na kare; okogamba kw’Omonene nogw’ekeene, na okw’oboronge.
swahili: Kumcha Bwana ni utakatifu, nako kwadumu milele. Amri za Bwana ni za hakika, nazo zina haki.

english: Blessed is the man who does not walk in the counsel of the wicked, or set foot on the path of sinners, or sit in the seat of mockers.
