ekegusii: Nasesenirie omonto otari gotunyana chingencho chi’abakori amabe, n’otari kobwatia chinchera chi’abanyabibe, gose otari gosanga amo nabwo bagochecheria.
swahili: Heri mtu yule ambaye haendi katika shauri la watu waovu, wala hasimami katika njia ya wenye dhambi, au kuketi katika baraza la wenye mizaha.

english: But his delight is in the Law of the LORD, and on His law he meditates day and night.
ekegusii: Korende richiko ri’Omonene nigo rikomogokia mono, na okorengereria kwaye gwonsi nigo kore ase richiko erio, omobaso na obotuko.
swahili: Bali huifurahia sheria ya Bwana, naye huitafakari hiyo sheria usiku na mchana.

english: He is like a tree planted by streams of water, yielding its fruit in season, whose leaf does not wither, and who prospers in all he does.
ekegusii: Ere nigo anga buna omote osimekire rooche mbarabare, oyokwama amatunda amaya ekero engaki yaye egoika, na amato aye tari kwoma ngaki ende yonsi, na rinde rionsi agokora nigo agosesenigwa.
swahili: Mtu huyo ni kama mti uliopandwa kando ya vijito vya maji, ambao huzaa matunda kwa majira yake na majani yake hayanyauki. Lolote afanyalo hufanikiwa. Huzuni Ya Waovu

english: Not so the wicked! For they are like chaff driven off by the wind.
ekegusii: Abakori amabe tibari bo, korende nigo banga buna omoiriro okoirurukigwa nomwaga.
swahili: Sivyo walivyo waovu! Wao ni kama makapi yapeperushwayo na upepo.

english: Therefore the wicked will not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the assembly of the righteous.
ekegusii: Ase ayio, abakori amabe tibagocha gwekengera ase rituko ri’ekiina, gose abanyabibe tibagosangererekana amo n’abanyene oboronge.
swahili: Kwa hiyo waovu hawatastahimili hukumu, wala wenye dhambi katika kusanyiko la wenye haki.

english: For the LORD guards the path of the righteous, but the way of the wicked will perish.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo akoraa enchera y’abanyene oboronge, korende enchera y’abakori amabe nesire.
swahili: Kwa maana Bwana huziangalia njia za mwenye haki, bali njia ya waovu itaangamia.

english: May the LORD answer you in the day of trouble; may the name of the God of Jacob protect you.
ekegusii: Tiga Omonene aigwe ogosaba kwao ase engaki y’emechando. Erieta ria Nyasae o Yakobo rikorende.
swahili: Bwana na akujibu unapokuwa katika dhiki, jina la Mungu wa Yakobo na liwe kinga yako.

english: May He send you help from the sanctuary and sustain you from Zion.
ekegusii: Ere nagotomere ogokonywa korwa ase obomenyo bwaye obochenu, na akoe chinguru korwa ase Sayoni.
swahili: Na akutumie msaada kutoka patakatifu na akupatie msaada kutoka Sayuni.

english: May He remember all your gifts and look favorably on your burnt offerings. Selah
ekegusii: Tiga ainyore okorua kwao gwonsi, anche na kogokera ebing’wanso biao bionsi bi’ogosambwa.
swahili: Na azikumbuke dhabihu zako zote, na azikubali sadaka zako za kuteketezwa.

english: May He give you the desires of your heart and make all your plans succeed.
ekegusii: Tiga akoe okogania gw’enkoro yao, na aikeranie emeroberio yao yonsi.
swahili: Na akujalie haja ya moyo wako, na aifanikishe mipango yako yote.

english: May we shout for joy at your victory and raise a banner in the name of our God. May the LORD grant all your petitions.
ekegusii: Erio toake amariogi yomogooko ase engencho y’obobui bwao, toimokererie igoro ebendera y’erieta ria Nyasae oito! Tiga Omonene aikeranie okoboria kwao kw’oboitongo.
swahili: Tutashangilia kwa furaha utakaposhinda, tutainua bendera zetu kwa jina la Mungu wetu. Bwana na akupe haja zako zote.

english: Now I know that the LORD saves His anointed; He answers him from His holy heaven with the saving power of His right hand.
ekegusii: Bono namanyire ng’a Omonene nae omoakwa amaguta oye obobui, namoiranerie korwa aase aye aachenu aaria igoro, namoe obobui goetera ase okoboko kwaye gw’okorio.
swahili: Sasa nafahamu kuwa Bwana humwokoa mpakwa mafuta wake, humjibu kutoka mbingu yake takatifu kwa nguvu za wokovu wa mkono wake wa kuume.

english: Some trust in chariots and others in horses, but we trust in the name of the LORD our God.
ekegusii: Abanto bande nigo basemeretie chigari chi’esegi, na abande chibarasi chi’esegi, korende intwe nigo tosemeretie erieta ri’Omonene, Nyasae oito.
swahili: Wengine wanatumaini magari ya vita, na wengine farasi, bali sisi tutalitumainia jina la Bwana, Mungu wetu.

english: They collapse and fall, but we rise up and stand firm.
ekegusii: Barabwo nigo baragochwe bagwe inse korende intwe nigo toragororoke totenene boronge.
swahili: Wao wameshushwa chini na kuanguka, bali sisi tunainuka na kusimama imara.

english: O LORD, save the king. Answer us on the day we call.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, kae omorwoti oo gwachorire obobui; otoiranerie ekero togokorangeria!
swahili: Ee Bwana, mwokoe mfalme! Tujibu tunapokuita!

english: O LORD, the king rejoices in Your strength. How greatly he exults in Your salvation!
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, omorwoti nigo agokerete chinguru chiao, na gochengera obobui kwamoeire.
swahili: Ee Bwana, mfalme huzifurahia nguvu zako. Tazama jinsi ilivyo kuu furaha yake kwa ushindi unaompa!

english: You will wipe their descendants from the earth, and their offspring from the sons of men.
ekegusii: Aye noite abana babo, obasirie korwa ase ense, na ororeria rwabo orosirie kegima korwa ase Mwanyabaanto.
swahili: Utawaangamiza wazao wao kutoka duniani, uzao wao kutoka wanadamu.

english: Though they intend You harm, the schemes they devise will not prevail.
ekegusii: Kobarabe bagokora emeroberio y’ogokora bobe, gose korengereria chinchera chi’okorenta emechando, tibakobua,
swahili: Ingawa watapanga mabaya dhidi yako na kutunga hila, hawawezi kufanikiwa,

english: For You will put them to flight when Your bow is trained upon them.
ekegusii: ekiagera nobaserie batame, nobarenge emegwe ase amasio abo.
swahili: kwa kuwa utawafanya wakimbie utakapowalenga usoni pao kwa mshale kutoka kwenye upinde wako.

english: Be exalted, O LORD, in Your strength; we will sing and praise Your power.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene otogigwe ase engencho ye chinguru chiao, intwe ntobe togotera ogoteera kw’ogotogia okobua kwao.
swahili: Ee Bwana, utukuzwe katika nguvu zako, tutaimba na kusifu nguvu zako.

english: You have granted his heart’s desire and have not withheld the request of his lips. Selah
ekegusii: Kwamoeire okogania gw’enkoro yaye; na totangeti aya aboretie korwa asore.
swahili: Umempa haja ya moyo wake na hukumzuilia maombi ya midomo yake.

english: For You welcomed him with rich blessings; You placed on his head a crown of pure gold.
ekegusii: Aye kwamorenteire ogosesenigwa okuya; kwamobekeire egutwa y’etaabu echenire ase omotwe oye.
swahili: Ulimkaribisha kwa baraka tele na kumvika taji ya dhahabu safi kichwani pake.

english: He asked You for life, and You granted it— length of days, forever and ever.
ekegusii: Akagosaba ng’a omoe obogima, naye okabomoa; okamoa amatuko amange amenye kogenderera botambe.
swahili: Alikuomba maisha, nawe ukampa, wingi wa siku milele na milele.

english: Great is his glory in Your salvation; You bestow on him splendor and majesty.
ekegusii: Amasikani ’omorwoti nigo are amanene, ekiagera aye kwamokonyire; kwamoeire obonene obonge na ogosika okonene.
swahili: Kutokana na ushindi uliompa, utukufu wake ni mkubwa, umeweka juu yake fahari na utukufu.

english: For You grant him blessings forever; You cheer him with joy in Your presence.
ekegusii: Ee, kwamokorire koba ogoseseneka gwa kare na kare, kwamogokeire, ekiagera ore amo nere botambe.
swahili: Hakika umempa baraka za milele, umemfanya awe na furaha kwa shangwe ya uwepo wako.

english: For the king trusts in the LORD; through the loving devotion of the Most High, he will not be shaken.
ekegusii: Omorwoti nigo asemeretie Omonene, na ase engencho y’obwanchani bw’Omonene Ore Igoro bogendererete botambe ere takonyara kwoboa.
swahili: Kwa kuwa mfalme anamtumaini Bwana; kwa upendo usiokoma wa Aliye Juu Sana hatatikiswa.

english: Your hand will apprehend all Your enemies; Your right hand will seize those who hate You.
ekegusii: Aye Omorwoti, noikeere ababisa bao bonsi; nobwate nokoboko kwao gw’okorio abwo bakogechete.
swahili: Mkono wako utawashika adui zako wote, mkono wako wa kuume utawakamata adui zako.

english: You will place them in a fiery furnace at the time of Your appearing. In His wrath the LORD will engulf them, and the fire will consume them.
ekegusii: Ekero orabaorokere nobakore booke buna omorero ekebemberi. Omonene nabasirie nendamwamu yaye enene; omorero nobasambe, bayie baere.
swahili: Wakati utakapojitokeza utawafanya kama tanuru ya moto. Katika ghadhabu yake Bwana atawameza, moto wake utawateketeza.

english: My God, my God, why have You forsaken me? Why are You so far from saving me, so far from my words of groaning?
ekegusii: Nyasae one, aye Nyasae one, naki gwantigire iga? Nabeire nkorera ontoorie, korende kwambeereire aare.
swahili: Mungu wangu, Mungu wangu, mbona umeniacha? Kwa nini uko mbali hivyo kuniokoa? Mbali hivyo na maneno ya kuugua kwangu?

english: From birth I was cast upon You; from my mother’s womb You have been my God.
ekegusii: Nigo narutetwe asore korwa ase okoiborwa kwane, na korwa ekero narenge ase enda ya baba naye kwarenge Nyasae one.
swahili: Nimekabidhiwa kwako tangu kuzaliwa, toka tumboni mwa mama yangu umekuwa Mungu wangu.

english: Be not far from me, for trouble is near and there is no one to help.
ekegusii: Tobaisa kobeera aare korwa asende, ekiagera emechando nigo ere ange, na monto onde tari orankonye.
swahili: Usiwe mbali nami, kwa maana shida iko karibu na hakuna wa kunisaidia.

english: Many bulls surround me; strong bulls of Bashan encircle me.
ekegusii: Chieri chinyinge nching’etanaine, ee, chieri chiria chia Basani chire ne chinguru nigo ching’etanaine.
swahili: Mafahali wengi wamenizunguka, mafahali wa Bashani wenye nguvu wamenizingira.

english: They open their jaws against me like lions that roar and maul.
ekegusii: Baasamirie emenwa yabo gocha asende, yabeire buna chindo chikoronya na koruma.
swahili: Simba wangurumao wanaorarua mawindo yao hupanua vinywa vyao dhidi yangu.

english: I am poured out like water, and all my bones are disjointed. My heart is like wax; it melts away within me.
ekegusii: Nabeire buna amaache aiteirwe ’nse; amauga onsi ay’omobere one atengokire na achoga‐chogire; enkoro yane yabeire buna obochoe, yanyititokire ime yane.
swahili: Nimemiminwa kama maji, mifupa yangu yote imetoka katika viungo vyake. Moyo wangu umegeuka kuwa nta, umeyeyuka ndani yangu.

english: My strength is dried up like a potsherd, and my tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth. You lay me in the dust of death.
ekegusii: Chinguru chiane chiang’ereire, omoyo one bwomire pa buna ekegonkorio, oromeme rwane rwabwatanire namang’ang’ura; aye kwanyareirie ase amaroba nkwete.
swahili: Nguvu zangu zimekauka kama kigae, ulimi wangu umegandamana na kaakaa la kinywa changu, kwa sababu umenilaza katika mavumbi ya kifo.

english: For dogs surround me; a band of evil men encircles me; they have pierced my hands and feet.
ekegusii: Abakori amabe nigo bang’etanaine korwa kera aase, ee, nigo bang’etanaine korwa chinsemo chionsi buna ekeombe gie chisese; bambetire ebisanyi bi’amaboko, na ebi’amagoro boigo.
swahili: Mbwa wamenizunguka, kundi la watu waovu limenizingira, wametoboa mikono yangu na miguu yangu.

english: I can count all my bones; they stare and gloat over me.
ekegusii: Amauga ’omobere one atongororokire nabo ’nkoyabara; abanto nigo bakondigereria na kogokera obobe bwane.
swahili: Naweza kuhesabu mifupa yangu yote, watu wananikodolea macho na kunisimanga.

english: They divide my garments among them and cast lots for my clothing.
ekegusii: Baatananire chianga chiane ase egati yabo; baakeire eganchwa yane obomera.
swahili: Wanagawana nguo zangu wao kwa wao, na vazi langu wanalipigia kura.

english: But You, O LORD, be not far off; O my Strength, come quickly to help me.
ekegusii: Korende aye Omonene, tobeera aare korwa asende; aye ore chinguru chiane, koranche, ayerera onkonye!
swahili: Lakini wewe, Ee Bwana, usiwe mbali. Ee Nguvu yangu, uje haraka unisaidie.

english: I cry out by day, O my God, but You do not answer, and by night, but I have no rest.
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae one! Nigo nkorera botuko bokia, korende tori kong’iraneria; nase obotuko boigo, korende tindi konyora ogotimoka.
swahili: Ee Mungu wangu, ninalia mchana, lakini hunijibu, hata usiku, sinyamazi.

english: Deliver my soul from the sword, my precious life from the power of wild dogs.
ekegusii: Ntoorie korwa ase omoro bw’amakweri, tooria obogima bwane korwa ase okobua gwe chisese chiria!
swahili: Okoa maisha yangu na upanga, uhai wangu wa thamani kutoka nguvu za mbwa.

english: Save me from the mouth of the lion; at the horns of the wild oxen You have answered me!
ekegusii: Ntoorie, ondusie ase emenwa ye chindo chiria; nkonya korwa ase ching’unchara chie ching’era!
swahili: Niokoe kutoka kinywani mwa simba, niokoe kutoka pembe za mafahali mwitu.

english: I will proclaim Your name to my brothers; I will praise You in the assembly.
ekegusii: Omonene, nindarie erieta riao ase abanto baminto, ase egati y’omosangererekano ningotogie.
swahili: Nitalitangaza jina lako kwa ndugu zangu, katika kusanyiko nitakusifu wewe.

english: You who fear the LORD, praise Him! All descendants of Jacob, honor Him! All offspring of Israel, revere Him!
ekegusii: Inwe abamoirogete Omonene, motogie! Inwe mwensi ab’ororeria rwa Yakobo, togia obonene bwaye! Inwe Abaisraeli bonsi, moiroke!
swahili: Ninyi ambao mnamcha Bwana, msifuni! Ninyi nyote wazao wote wa Yakobo, mheshimuni yeye! Mcheni yeye, ninyi wazao wote wa Israeli!

english: For He has not despised or detested the torment of the afflicted. He has not hidden His face from him, but has attended to his cry for help.
ekegusii: Omonene tari gochaaya emechando y’abwo bachandegete, gose koyegecha, gose tabiseti obosio bwaye korwa ase bare; korende ekero bamorangeretie nigo abaigwete.
swahili: Kwa maana hakupuuza wala kudharau mateso ya aliyeonewa; hakumficha uso wake bali alisikiliza kilio chake ili amsaidie.

english: My praise for You resounds in the great assembly; I will fulfill my vows before those who fear You.
ekegusii: Ekero ’nde ase omosangererekano omonene ningotogie. Chiira nariete ning’ikeranie agwo ase obosio bw’abaanto bamoirogete Omonene.
swahili: Kwako wewe hutoka kiini cha sifa zangu katika kusanyiko kubwa, nitatimiza nadhiri zangu mbele ya wale wakuchao wewe.

english: The poor will eat and be satisfied; those who seek the LORD will praise Him. May your hearts live forever!
ekegusii: Abwo bare abaitongo mbanyore endagera barie baigote. Abanto bakorigia Omonene mbabe bakomotogia, ne chinkoro chiaino nchigenderere koba moyo goika kare na kare.
swahili: Maskini watakula na kushiba, wale wamtafutao Bwana watamsifu: mioyo yenu na iishi milele!

english: All the ends of the earth will remember and turn to the LORD. All the families of the nations will bow down before Him.
ekegusii: Abanto b’echinsemo chionsi chi’ense mbainyore Omonene, bamoonchokere; chiamate chionsi chi’ebisaku nchimosasime.
swahili: Miisho yote ya dunia itakumbuka na kumgeukia Bwana, nazo jamaa zote za mataifa watasujudu mbele zake,

english: For dominion belongs to the LORD and He rules over the nations.
ekegusii: Omogambi Omonene, nere okogamba igoro ase ebisaku bionsi.
swahili: kwa maana ufalme ni wa Bwana naye hutawala juu ya mataifa.

english: All the rich of the earth will feast and worship; all who go down to the dust will kneel before Him— even those unable to preserve their lives.
ekegusii: Ee, abanto abatenenku bonsi bare ase ense goika batung’ame ase obosio bw’Omonene, abwo bonsi bakogenda ase chimbeera ime mbatung’ame ase obosio bwaye; naboigo nabwo batanyare korenda obogima bwabo bogenderere.
swahili: Matajiri wote wa dunia watasherehekea na kuabudu. Wote waendao mavumbini watapiga magoti mbele yake, wote ambao hawawezi kudumisha uhai wao.

english: Yet You are holy, enthroned on the praises of Israel.
ekegusii: Nonya naboigo, aye nigo ore omochenu; obonene nobwao, naye ogotogigwa n’Abaisraeli.
swahili: Hata hivyo umesimikwa katika kiti cha enzi kama Uliye Mtakatifu; wewe ni sifa ya Israeli.

english: Posterity will serve Him; they will declare the Lord to a new generation.
ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rwaye mbabe bakomokorera; mbabe bagokwana igoro y’Omonene ase ebiaare bigochi‐gocha.
swahili: Wazao wa baadaye watamtumikia yeye; vizazi vijavyo vitajulishwa habari za Bwana.

english: They will come and proclaim His righteousness to a people yet unborn— all that He has done.
ekegusii: Oboronge bwaye mbobe bokorarigwa ase abanto bataraiborwa, ng’a ere oikeranirie onsi.
swahili: Watatangaza haki yake kwa watu ambao hawajazaliwa bado, kwa maana yeye ametenda hili.

english: In You our fathers trusted; they trusted and You delivered them.
ekegusii: Chisokoro chiaito nigo chiagosemeretie, ee, nigo chiagosemeretie, naye ogachitooria.
swahili: Kwako wewe baba zetu waliweka tumaini lao, walikutumaini nawe ukawaokoa.

english: They cried out to You and were set free; they trusted in You and were not disappointed.
ekegusii: Barabwo nigo barerete asore, bakanyora ogotooreka, nigo babete bagosemeretie, na tibasoogetigwe.
swahili: Walikulilia wewe na ukawaokoa, walikutegemea wewe nao hawakuaibika.

english: But I am a worm and not a man, scorned by men and despised by the people.
ekegusii: Inche nerikonde, tindi omonto, nigo ngochecherigwa na gochaywa n’abanto.
swahili: Mimi ni mnyoo wala si mwanadamu, wanaume wamenibeza, na watu wamenidharau.

english: All who see me mock me; they sneer and shake their heads:
ekegusii: Abanto bonsi abakondora nigo bagonchecheria na gonsekerera; nigo bagoaka eriogi asende na gosinga‐singisia emetwe yabo,
swahili: Wote wanionao hunidhihaki, hunivurumishia matusi, wakitikisa vichwa vyao:

english: “He trusts in the LORD, let the LORD deliver him; let the LORD rescue him, since He delights in him.”
ekegusii: bagoteeba: “Omonto oyo nigo asemeretie Omonene ng’a namotoorie, tiga amotoorie bono, ekiagera agokirie nere!”
swahili: Husema, “Anamtegemea Bwana, basi Bwana na amwokoe. Amkomboe basi, kwa maana anapendezwa naye.”

english: Yet You brought me forth from the womb; You made me secure at my mother’s breast.
ekegusii: Omonene, naye kwandusetie ase enda ya baba; naye kwabete gokondenda buya ase amaboko a baba.
swahili: Hata hivyo ulinitoa tumboni, ukanifanya nikutegemee, hata nilipokuwa ninanyonya matiti ya mama yangu.

english: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.
ekegusii: Omonene nomorisia one, tinkoremerwa kende,
swahili: Bwana ndiye mchungaji wangu, sitapungukiwa na kitu.

english: He makes me lie down in green pastures; He leads me beside quiet waters.
ekegusii: Nigo agontimokeria ase obonyansi obobese na kondaa gochia ase amaache amakenonoku akwongora ng’ora.
swahili: Hunilaza katika malisho ya majani mabichi, kando ya maji matulivu huniongoza,

english: He restores my soul; He guides me in the paths of righteousness for the sake of His name.
ekegusii: Ere nigo agokora omoyo one koba omoyia na kondaa ase chinchera chiaye chia boronge, ase engencho y’erieta riaye.
swahili: hunihuisha nafsi yangu. Huniongoza katika njia za haki kwa ajili ya jina lake.

english: Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for You are with me; Your rod and Your staff, they comfort me.
ekegusii: Ninsa goeta ase omwenya bw’ekiriri ki’amakweri, tinkoiroka bobe bonde, ekiagera aye Omonene nigo ore amo nainche, enyimbo yao na enungu yao nabindemie.
swahili: Hata kama nikipita katikati ya bonde la uvuli wa mauti, sitaogopa mabaya, kwa maana wewe upo pamoja nami; fimbo yako na mkongojo wako vyanifariji.

english: You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies. You anoint my head with oil; my cup overflows.
ekegusii: Kwambekeire endagera ase amasio ’ababisa baane; kwang’akire amaguta omotwe one ase okonyarigania, gwaichoirie egekombe kiane, ngoiteka kere.
swahili: Waandaa meza mbele yangu machoni pa adui zangu. Umenipaka mafuta kichwani pangu, kikombe changu kinafurika.

english: Surely goodness and mercy will follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in the house of the LORD forever.
ekegusii: Ekeene, obuya na obwanchani botari koera nabintunyane amatuko onsi ay’obogima bwane; nainche nimenye ase enyomba y’Omonene goika kare na kare.
swahili: Hakika wema na upendo vitanifuata siku zote za maisha yangu, nami nitakaa nyumbani mwa Bwana milele.

english: The earth is the LORD’s, and the fullness thereof, the world and all who dwell therein.
ekegusii: Ense na ebinto bire aroro nebia Omonene; oboiko bwonsi nobwaye, amo nabaanto bamenyeteo.
swahili: Dunia ni mali ya Bwana, na vyote vilivyomo ndani yake, ulimwengu, na wote waishio ndani yake,

english: Who is He, this King of Glory? The LORD of Hosts— He is the King of Glory. Selah
ekegusii: Inee! Omorwoti oyio bw’obonene nere ng’o? Ere Omonene bw’Emeganda; ere n’Omorwoti bw’Obonene.
swahili: Ni nani yeye, huyu Mfalme wa utukufu? Ni Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote; yeye ndiye Mfalme wa utukufu.

english: For He has founded it upon the seas and established it upon the waters.
ekegusii: Nigo abegete oboroso bwaye igoro ase chinyancha, akabokong’ia igoro ase chindooche.
swahili: maana aliiwekea misingi yake baharini na kuifanya imara juu ya maji.

english: Who may ascend the hill of the LORD? Who may stand in His holy place?
ekegusii: Ning’o oragwenere gotiira ase egetunwa kia Omonene? Ning’o oragwenere gotenena aase aye aachenu?
swahili: Nani awezaye kuupanda mlima wa Bwana? Ni nani awezaye kusimama patakatifu pake?

english: He who has clean hands and a pure heart, who does not lift up his soul to an idol or swear deceitfully.
ekegusii: Nomonto oria obwate amaboko atari na komocha, na enkoro echenegete, noria otari gosasiima chinyasae chi’oborimo, gose gotiana ase obong’ainereria.
swahili: Ni yule mwenye mikono safi na moyo mweupe, yule ambaye hakuinulia sanamu nafsi yake au kuapa kwa kitu cha uongo.

english: He will receive blessing from the LORD and vindication from the God of his salvation.
ekegusii: Omonto oyio nonyore ogosesenigwa korwa ase Omonene; boigo nanyore oboronge korwa ase Nyasae ore ogotooreka kwaye.
swahili: Huyo atapokea baraka kutoka kwa Bwana, na hukumu ya haki kutoka kwa Mungu Mwokozi wake.

english: Such is the generation of those who seek Him, who seek Your face, O God of Jacob. Selah
ekegusii: Naboigo ekegori ki’abakomorigia kere; abwo bakorigia barore obosio bwa Nyasae o Yakobo.
swahili: Hiki ndicho kizazi cha wale wamtafutao, wale wautafutao uso wako, Ee Mungu wa Yakobo.

english: Lift up your heads, O gates! Be lifted up, O ancient doors, that the King of Glory may enter!
ekegusii: Inwe ebiita, imokereria emekorogoto yaino igoro! Inwe ebiita bia kare, igoka, erinde Omorwoti bw’obonene asoe ime!
swahili: Inueni vichwa vyenu, enyi malango, inukeni enyi milango ya kale, ili mfalme wa utukufu apate kuingia.

english: Who is this King of Glory? The LORD strong and mighty, the LORD mighty in battle.
ekegusii: Inee! Omorwoti oyio bw’obonene nere ng’o? Ere Omonene ore ne chinguru na okobua, ere Omonene, omobui ase chiseegi.
swahili: Ni nani huyu Mfalme wa utukufu? Ni Bwana aliye na nguvu na uweza, ni Bwana aliye hodari katika vita.

english: Lift up your heads, O gates! Be lifted up, O ancient doors, that the King of Glory may enter!
ekegusii: Inwe ebiita, imokereria emetwe yaino igoro! Inwe ebiita bia kare, igoka, erinde Omorwoti bw’obonene asoe ime!
swahili: Inueni vichwa vyenu, enyi malango, viinueni juu enyi milango ya kale, ili Mfalme wa utukufu apate kuingia.

english: To You, O LORD, I lift up my soul;
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ngocha nde asore nomoyo one bwonsi.
swahili: Kwako wewe, Ee Bwana, nainua nafsi yangu,

english: All the LORD’s ways are loving and faithful to those who keep His covenant and His decrees.
ekegusii: Chinchera chionsi chi’ Omonene nigo chire echi’obwanchani, na echi’obwegenwa, ase abwo barendete okobwatana kwaye na oborori bwaye.
swahili: Njia zote za Bwana ni za upendo na uaminifu kwa wale wanaoshika shuhuda za agano lake.

english: For the sake of Your name, O LORD, forgive my iniquity, for it is great.
ekegusii: Omonene, ase engencho y’erieta riao onyabere ogosaria kwane, ekiagera nokonene.
swahili: Ee Bwana, kwa ajili ya jina lako, unisamehe uovu wangu, ijapokuwa ni mwingi.

english: Who is the man who fears the LORD? He will instruct him in the path chosen for him.
ekegusii: Kera omonto omoirogete Omonene, eri’Omonene amworokereria enchera agwenerete gochora.
swahili: Ni nani basi, mtu yule anayemcha Bwana? Atamfundisha katika njia atakayoichagua kwa ajili yake.

english: His soul will dwell in prosperity, and his descendants will inherit the land.
ekegusii: Omonto oyio nagenderere gosesenigwa, na ororeria rwaye ndoire ense.
swahili: Mtu huyo atafanikiwa maishani mwake, nao wazao wake watairithi nchi.

english: The LORD confides in those who fear Him, and reveals His covenant to them.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo are omosani bw’abaanto bamoirogete, nigo akobamanyia okobwatana kwaye kw’ogotianania.
swahili: Siri ya Bwana iko kwa wale wamchao, yeye huwajulisha agano lake.

english: My eyes are always on the LORD, for He will free my feet from the mesh.
ekegusii: Botambe nigo nkoba imorigereretie Omonene, nere orarusie amagoro aane ase oboreba.
swahili: Macho yangu humwelekea Bwana daima, kwa kuwa yeye peke yake ndiye ataitoa miguu yangu kutoka mtego.

english: Turn to me and be gracious, for I am lonely and afflicted.
ekegusii: Aye omonene, ing’iranere ondorere amaabera, ekiagera nigo inde inche bweka, naende nchandegete.
swahili: Nigeukie na unihurumie, kwa maana mimi ni mpweke na mwenye kuteseka.

english: The troubles of my heart increase; free me from my distress.
ekegusii: Omoichano nigo oichire ase enkoro yane, ndusie ase obokong’u bwane,
swahili: Shida za moyo wangu zimeongezeka, niokoe katika dhiki yangu.

english: Consider my affliction and trouble, and take away all my sins.
ekegusii: ndigererie orore obororo bwane na ogochandwa kwane, na onyabere ebibe biane bionsi.
swahili: Uangalie mateso na shida zangu na uniondolee dhambi zangu zote.

english: Consider my enemies, for they are many, and they hate me with vicious hatred.
ekegusii: Rora ababisa baane bonsi buna bare abange; na buna bangechete nobotindi obonge.
swahili: Tazama adui zangu walivyo wengi, pia uone jinsi wanavyonichukia vikali!

english: in You, my God, I trust. Do not let me be put to shame; do not let my enemies exult over me.
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae one, naye nsemeretie, tontiga nsookigwe; totiga ababisa baane bagokere okobugwa kwane.
swahili: ni wewe ninayekutumainia, Ee Mungu wangu. Usiniache niaibike, wala usiache adui zangu wakanishinda.

english: Guard my soul and deliver me; let me not be put to shame, for I take refuge in You.
ekegusii: Renda omoyo one na ontoorie; naye ngotamera tobaisa gontiga nsookigwe.
swahili: Uyalinde maisha yangu na uniokoe, usiniache niaibike, kwa maana nimekukimbilia wewe.

english: May integrity and uprightness preserve me, because I wait for You.
ekegusii: Tiga obwegenwa na oboronge bindende, ekiagera naye nsemeretie.
swahili: Uadilifu na uaminifu vinilinde, kwa sababu tumaini langu ni kwako.

english: Redeem Israel, O God, from all its distress.
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, booria Abaisraeli korwa ase emechando yabo yonsi.
swahili: Ee Mungu, wakomboe Israeli, katika shida zao zote!

english: Surely none who wait for You will be put to shame; but those who are faithless without cause will be disgraced.
ekegusii: Monto onde bwensi ogosemeretie totiga asookigwe; korende abwo batigire obwegenwa engencho ende etaiyo basookigwe.
swahili: Kamwe hakuna hata mmoja anayekutegemea atakayeaibishwa, bali wataaibishwa wafanyao hila bila sababu.

english: Show me Your ways, O LORD; teach me Your paths.
ekegusii: Omonene, imanyie chinchera chiao; inyorokererie oboeto bwao.
swahili: Nionyeshe njia zako, Ee Bwana, nifundishe mapito yako,

english: Guide me in Your truth and teach me, for You are the God of my salvation; all day long I wait for You.
ekegusii: Ondaae ase ekeene kiao na onyorokererie, ekiagera aye Nyasae nogotooreka kwane, aye nigo ngosemeretie.
swahili: niongoze katika kweli yako na kunifundisha, kwa maana wewe ni Mungu Mwokozi wangu, nalo tumaini langu liko kwako wakati wote.

english: Remember, O LORD, Your compassion and loving devotion, for they are from age to age.
ekegusii: Omonene, inyora amaabera ao na obwanchani bwao botari koera, ekiagera nao biarenge korwa kare.
swahili: Kumbuka, Ee Bwana, rehema zako kuu na upendo, kwa maana zimekuwepo tangu zamani.

english: Remember not the sins of my youth, nor my rebellious acts; remember me according to Your loving devotion, because of Your goodness, O LORD.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, tobaisa koinyora ebibe na ogosaria bi’obosae bwane; ong’inyore ase engencho y’obwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe, na ase engencho y’obuya bwao.
swahili: Usizikumbuke dhambi za ujana wangu wala njia zangu za uasi, sawasawa na upendo wako unikumbuke, kwa maana wewe ni mwema, Ee Bwana.

english: Good and upright is the LORD; therefore He shows sinners the way.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo are omuya na ere nere omonyene oboronge, ase ayio nigo akworokereria abanyabibe enchera bagwenerete kobwatia.
swahili: Bwana ni mwema na mwenye adili, kwa hiyo huwafundisha wenye dhambi njia zake.

english: He guides the humble in what is right and teaches them His way.
ekegusii: Ere nigo akoraa abanto bare abaitongo ase enchera endonge, naende aborokereria komanya enchera yaye.
swahili: Huwaongoza wanyenyekevu katika haki, naye huwafundisha njia yake.

english: Vindicate me, O LORD! For I have walked with integrity; I have trusted in the LORD without wavering.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ing’a oboronge bwane; ekiagera nabeire ntari na komocha; naboigo ngosemeretie aye Omonene ntari ne chitang’u‐tang’u.
swahili: Ee Bwana, nithibitishe katika haki, maana nimeishi maisha yasiyo na lawama; nimemtumainia Bwana bila kusitasita.

english: in whose hands are wicked schemes, whose right hands are full of bribes.
ekegusii: Abanto abwo bagokora emeroberio y’obonyaka, na amaboko abo a borio nigo aichire namaaki.
swahili: ambao mikononi mwao kuna mipango miovu, ambao mikono yao ya kuume imejaa rushwa.

english: But I will walk with integrity; redeem me and be merciful to me.
ekegusii: Inche nigo inde norogendo rotari na komocha; indorere amaabera na omboorie.
swahili: Bali mimi ninaishi maisha yasiyo na lawama; nikomboe na unihurumie.

english: My feet stand on level ground; in the congregations I will bless the LORD.
ekegusii: Amagoro aane nigo agotenena aase ateremu; nintogie Omonene ase egati y’omosangererekano omonene.
swahili: Miguu yangu imesimama katika uwanja tambarare; katika kusanyiko kuu nitamsifu Bwana.

english: Test me, O LORD, and try me; examine my heart and mind.
ekegusii: Omonene, inteeme na ondenge; orenge enkoro yane na ebirengererio biane.
swahili: Ee Bwana, unijaribu, unipime, uuchunguze moyo wangu na mawazo yangu;

english: For Your loving devotion is before my eyes, and I have walked in Your truth.
ekegusii: Nigo ndigereretie obwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe na gotaara ase obwegenwa bwao.
swahili: kwa maana upendo wako uko mbele yangu daima, nami natembea siku zote katika kweli yako.

english: I do not sit with deceitful men, nor keep company with hypocrites.
ekegusii: Tindi gosanga nabanyaborimo, gose tindi kogosoria nabang’ainereria.
swahili: Siketi pamoja na watu wadanganyifu, wala siandamani na wanafiki,

english: I hate the mob of evildoers, and refuse to sit with the wicked.
ekegusii: Inche nigo ngechete gosanga nabaanto bagokora amabe, na tingwancha goikaransa amo nabaanto abakayayu.
swahili: ninachukia kusanyiko la watenda mabaya na ninakataa kuketi pamoja na waovu.

english: I wash my hands in innocence that I may go about Your altar, O LORD,
ekegusii: Nigo ngoisaba amaboko aane ase okoorokia ng’a tindi na komocha, erio naetanana egesasiimero kiao, aye Omonene,
swahili: Ninanawa mikono yangu kwa kuwa sina hatia, naikaribia madhabahu yako, Ee Bwana,

english: to raise my voice in thanksgiving and declare all Your wonderful works.
ekegusii: imba ngoteera neriogi rinene gokoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono na koraria ogokora kwao kw’ogokumia.
swahili: nikitangaza sifa yako kwa sauti kubwa, huku nikisimulia matendo yako ya ajabu.

english: O LORD, I love the house where You dwell, the place where Your glory resides.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, inche nigo nyanchete obomenyo bwao, aase obonene bwao bore.
swahili: Ee Bwana, naipenda nyumba yako mahali unakoishi, mahali ambapo utukufu wako hukaa.

english: Do not take my soul away with sinners, or my life with men of bloodshed,
ekegusii: Tosiria omoyo one ekero ogosiria abanyabibe; gose obogima bwane ekero ogosiria abaiti.
swahili: Usiiondoe nafsi yangu pamoja na watenda dhambi, wala uhai wangu pamoja na wamwagao damu,

english: The LORD is my light and my salvation— whom shall I fear? The LORD is the stronghold of my life— whom shall I dread?
ekegusii: Omonene nere omobaso one, na ogotooreka kwane, ning’o ndanyare koiroka? Omonene nere eburi ekengerete obogima bwane, monto ki ndanyare kwoboa?
swahili: Bwana ni nuru yangu na wokovu wangu, nimwogope nani? Bwana ni ngome ya uzima wangu, nimhofu nani?

english: Though my father and mother forsake me, the LORD will receive me.
ekegusii: Onye tata na baba baraba bagontiga, Omonene nang’ire imbe oyoye.
swahili: Hata kama baba yangu na mama wakiniacha, Bwana atanipokea.

english: Teach me Your way, O LORD, and lead me on a level path, because of my oppressors.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, inyorokererie enchera yao; indaae ong’eterie aase ateremu, ntooreke korwa ase ababisa baane.
swahili: Nifundishe njia yako, Ee Bwana, niongoze katika njia iliyonyooka kwa sababu ya watesi wangu.

english: Do not hand me over to the will of my foes, for false witnesses rise up against me, breathing out violence.
ekegusii: Tobaisa kondua ase ababisa baane bankore buna banchete; birori b’oborimo banyimokeire, bagontianera nobotindi.
swahili: Usiniachilie kwa nia za adui zangu, kwa maana mashahidi wa uongo wameinuka dhidi yangu, wakipumua ujeuri.

english: Still I am certain to see the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living.
ekegusii: Naenekirie ng’a nindore obuya bw’ Omonene; ase ense y’abanto bare moyo.
swahili: Nami bado nina tumaini hili: nitauona wema wa Bwana katika nchi ya walio hai.

english: Wait patiently for the LORD; be strong and courageous. Wait patiently for the LORD!
ekegusii: Remereria oganye Omonene, kabe omoremu, tokwa omoyo; ee, remereria oganye Omonene!
swahili: Mngojee Bwana, uwe hodari na mwenye moyo mkuu, nawe, umngojee Bwana.

english: When the wicked came upon me to devour my flesh, my enemies and foes stumbled and fell.
ekegusii: Ekero abakori amabe bakong’umokera ng’a bamere, ababisa baane abwo bangechete nigo baragochwe na kogwa.
swahili: Waovu watakaposogea dhidi yangu ili wanile nyama yangu, adui zangu na watesi wangu watakaponishambulia, watajikwaa na kuanguka.

english: Though an army encamps around me, my heart will not fear; though a war breaks out against me, I will keep my trust.
ekegusii: Neba omoganda omonene bw’esegi ong’etananire, enkoro yane tekoba nobwoba; gose abanto nabachicha kondwania esegi, inche nigo ndagenderere koba noboremu.
swahili: Hata jeshi linizunguke pande zote, moyo wangu hautaogopa; hata vita vitokee dhidi yangu, hata hapo nitakuwa na ujasiri.

english: One thing I have asked of the LORD; this is what I desire: to dwell in the house of the LORD all the days of my life, to gaze on the beauty of the LORD and seek Him in His temple.
ekegusii: Nasabire ring’ana erimo korwa ase Omonene. Erio nario nganetie: Imenye ase enyomba y’Omonene ase amatuko onsi ay’obogima bwane, erinde ndore oboseera bw’Omonene na kona‐koboiranerera ase Hekalu yaye.
swahili: Jambo moja ninamwomba Bwana, hili ndilo ninalolitafuta: niweze kukaa nyumbani mwa Bwana siku zote za maisha yangu, niutazame uzuri wa Bwana na kumtafuta hekaluni mwake.

english: For in the day of trouble He will hide me in His shelter; He will conceal me under the cover of His tent; He will set me high upon a rock.
ekegusii: Ase engaki y’emechando nantube ase ekiriri kiaye; nambise ase eema yaye ime, Nanyimokie ambeke ase egetare igoro.
swahili: Kwa kuwa siku ya shida, atanihifadhi salama katika maskani yake, atanificha uvulini mwa hema yake na kuniweka juu kwenye mwamba.

english: Then my head will be held high above my enemies around me. At His tabernacle I will offer sacrifices with shouts of joy; I will sing and make music to the LORD.
ekegusii: Ninyimokererigwa igoro ase ababisa baane bang’etanaine. Ase eema yaye ime nindue ebing’wanso inde nomochengo; ninterere Omonene na komotogia.
swahili: Kisha kichwa changu kitainuliwa juu ya adui zangu wanaonizunguka. Katika maskani yake nitatoa dhabihu kwa kelele za shangwe; nitamwimbia Bwana na kumsifu.

english: Hear, O LORD, my voice when I call; be merciful and answer me.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, oigwe okorera kwane, indorere amaabera na oiranerie ogosaba kwane.
swahili: Isikie sauti yangu nikuitapo, Ee Bwana, unihurumie na unijibu.

english: My heart said, “Seek His face.” Your face, O LORD, I will seek.
ekegusii: Aye gwatebire: “Indigie ondore obosio bwane.” Na enkoro yane nigo ekogoteebia: “Omonene, inche igo nkorigia obosio bwao.”
swahili: Moyo wangu unasema kuhusu wewe, “Utafute uso wake!” Uso wako, Bwana “Nitautafuta.”

english: Hide not Your face from me, nor turn away Your servant in anger. You have been my helper; do not leave me or forsake me, O God of my salvation.
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae one ore ogotooreka kwane, tobisa obosio bwao korwa asende; tontiga kore nendamwamu. Aye kwabeire kogonkonya botambe, tontuguta gose tontiga.
swahili: Usinifiche uso wako, usimkatae mtumishi wako kwa hasira; wewe umekuwa msaada wangu. Usinikatae wala usiniache, Ee Mungu Mwokozi wangu.

english: To You, O LORD, I call; be not deaf to me, O my Rock. For if You remain silent, I will be like those descending to the Pit.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, egetare kiane, naye nkorangeria, tibwanga konyigwa. Oise gokira, inche nigo ndabe oyomo bw’abakogenda ase chimbeera.
swahili: Ninakuita wewe, Ee Bwana, Mwamba wangu; usiwe kwangu kama kiziwi. Kwa sababu ukinyamaza nitafanana na walioshuka shimoni.

english: Hear my cry for mercy when I call to You for help, when I lift up my hands toward Your holy sanctuary.
ekegusii: Igwa eriogi ri’ogosaba kwane, ekero nkorera asore onkonye, ekero ndamborete amaboko aane igoro gocha ase obomenyo bwao obochenu.
swahili: Sikia kilio changu unihurumie ninapokuita kwa ajili ya msaada, niinuapo mikono yangu kuelekea Patakatifu pa Patakatifu pako.

english: Do not drag me away with the wicked, and with the workers of iniquity, who speak peace to their neighbors while malice is in their hearts.
ekegusii: Tobaisa gonsiria amo nabakori amabe na abasaria, abanto abagokwana amang’ana yo omorembe nabaanto bande, korende ime ase chinkoro chiabo nigo baabagechete.
swahili: Usiniburute pamoja na waovu, pamoja na hao watendao mabaya, ambao huzungumza na jirani zao maneno mazuri, lakini mioyoni mwao wameficha chuki.

english: Repay them according to their deeds and for their works of evil. Repay them for what their hands have done; bring back on them what they deserve.
ekegusii: Bae egesusuro koreng’ana nogokora kwabo na ebibe biabo, obaakane koreng’ana nemeremo y’amaboko abo, obae eki bagwenerete konyora.
swahili: Walipe sawasawa na matendo yao, sawasawa na matendo yao maovu; walipe sawasawa na kazi za mikono yao, uwalipe wanavyostahili.

english: Since they show no regard for the works of the LORD or what His hands have done, He will tear them down and never rebuild them.
ekegusii: Abanto abwo tibari kobara ng’a ogokora kw’Omonene, gose emeremo y’amaboko aye, negento; ase ayio nabaiyerie inse, takobaimokia naende.
swahili: Kwa kuwa hawaheshimu kazi za Bwana, na yale ambayo mikono yake imetenda, atawabomoa na kamwe hatawajenga tena.

english: Blessed be the LORD, for He has heard my cry for mercy.
ekegusii: Omonene atogigwe! Ere oigure okoboria kwane kw’oboitongo.
swahili: Bwana asifiwe, kwa maana amesikia kilio changu nikimwomba anihurumie.

english: The LORD is my strength and my shield; my heart trusts in Him, and I am helped. Therefore my heart rejoices, and I give thanks to Him with my song.
ekegusii: Omonene nere chinguru chiane na enguba yane; nere nsemeretie ase enkoro yane, ere nankonyete. Ase ayio ninde nomosasoko ase enkoro yane; nimbe nkomoterera na komoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono.
swahili: Bwana ni nguvu zangu na ngao yangu, moyo wangu umemtumaini yeye, nami nimesaidiwa. Moyo wangu unarukaruka kwa furaha nami nitamshukuru kwa wimbo.

english: The LORD is the strength of His people, a stronghold of salvation for His anointed.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo are chinguru ase abanto baye, na obotamero bw’ogotooreka ase omoakwa amaguta oye.
swahili: Bwana ni nguvu ya watu wake, ngome ya wokovu kwa mpakwa mafuta wake.

english: Save Your people and bless Your inheritance; shepherd them and carry them forever.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, tooria abanto bao abare omwando oo, obe omorisia obo, obabogorie goika kare na kare.
swahili: Waokoe watu wako na uubariki urithi wako; uwe mchungaji wao na uwabebe milele.

english: Ascribe to the LORD, O heavenly beings, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.
ekegusii: Inwe abana ba Nyasae, motogie Omonene, atora obonene bw’Omonene ne chinguru chiaye.
swahili: Mpeni Bwana, enyi mashujaa, mpeni Bwana utukufu na nguvu.

english: The LORD sits enthroned over the flood; the LORD is enthroned as King forever.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo aikaransete ase ekerogo kiaye ki’obonene kogambera chioora; Omonene nere omorwoti ase ekerogo kiaye kare na kare.
swahili: Bwana huketi akiwa ametawazwa juu ya gharika; Bwana ametawazwa kuwa Mfalme milele.

english: The LORD gives His people strength; the LORD blesses His people with peace.
ekegusii: Omonene nae abanto baye chinguru, naende abasesenie ase okobaa omorembe.
swahili: Bwana huwapa watu wake nguvu; Bwana huwabariki watu wake kwa kuwapa amani.

english: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due His name; worship the LORD in the splendor of His holiness.
ekegusii: Togia erieta ri’Omonene rire nobonene obonge; mosasime Omonene mweboetie obochenu.
swahili: Mpeni Bwana utukufu unaostahili jina lake; mwabuduni Bwana katika uzuri wa utakatifu wake.

english: The voice of the LORD is over the waters; the God of glory thunders; the LORD is heard over many waters.
ekegusii: Eriogi ri’Omonene nigo rikoigweka ase chinyancha igoro; Nyasae bw’obonene nigo agoaka enkoba, Omonene nigo akogukura igoro ye chinyancha chinyinge.
swahili: Sauti ya Bwana iko juu ya maji; Mungu wa utukufu hupiga radi, Bwana hupiga radi juu ya maji makuu.

english: The voice of the LORD is powerful; the voice of the LORD is majestic.
ekegusii: Eriogi ri’Omonene nigo rikoigweka rire nokobua; eriogi ri’Omonene nigo riichire nobonene.
swahili: Sauti ya Bwana ina nguvu; sauti ya Bwana ni tukufu.

english: The voice of the LORD breaks the cedars; the LORD shatters the cedars of Lebanon.
ekegusii: Eriogi ri’Omonene nigo rikobuna emete emecharake, ee, nigo rikobuna emecharake ya Lebanoni.
swahili: Sauti ya Bwana huvunja mierezi; Bwana huvunja vipande vipande mierezi ya Lebanoni.

english: He makes Lebanon skip like a calf, and Sirion like a young wild ox.
ekegusii: Nigo agotira‐tiria emete eyio buna emori egotiria, na ebitunwa bia Lebanoni na Sirioni buna eng’era ensae.
swahili: Hufanya Lebanoni irukaruke kama ndama, Sirioni urukaruke kama mwana nyati.

english: The voice of the LORD strikes with flames of fire.
ekegusii: Eriogi ri’Omonene nigo rikomesia chinsase chi’omorero.
swahili: Sauti ya Bwana hupiga kwa miali ya umeme wa radi.

english: The voice of the LORD shakes the wilderness; the LORD shakes the Wilderness of Kadesh.
ekegusii: Eriogi ri’Omonene nigo rigotengechia erooro; ee, nigo rigotengechia erooro ya Kadeshi.
swahili: Sauti ya Bwana hutikisa jangwa; Bwana hutikisa Jangwa la Kadeshi.

english: The voice of the LORD twists the oaks and strips the forests bare. And in His temple all cry, “Glory!”
ekegusii: Eriogi erio ri’Omonene nigo rikorekeria chingabi, nigo rigosabora emete y’amanani yaba bosa. Ase Hekalu yaye ebitongwa bionsi biatogia obonene bwaye.
swahili: Sauti ya Bwana huzalisha ayala, na huuacha msitu wazi. Hekaluni mwake wote wasema, “Utukufu!”

english: Why do the nations rage and the peoples plot in vain?
ekegusii: Nase ki abanto b’ebisaku bagokora rirorooche? Nase ki abanto bagokora emeroberio ere bosa?
swahili: Kwa nini mataifa wanashauriana kufanya mabaya, na kabila za watu kula njama bure?

english: Therefore be wise, O kings; be admonished, O judges of the earth.
ekegusii: Ase ayio, inwe abarwoti, mobe abang’aini, inwe abagaambi b’ense, igwera ogokuurerwa oko:
swahili: Kwa hiyo, ninyi wafalme, kuweni na hekima; mwonyeke, enyi watawala wa dunia.

english: Serve the LORD with fear, and rejoice with trembling.
ekegusii: Mokorere Omonene more nobwoba na okoiguswa.
swahili: Mtumikieni Bwana kwa hofu na mshangilie kwa kutetemeka.

english: Kiss the Son, lest He be angry and you perish in your rebellion, when His wrath ignites in an instant. Blessed are all who take refuge in Him.
ekegusii: Tugama inse na kworokia amasikani ase Omwana oye. Motakoreti bo, Omonene nigo arabe nendamwamu, abasirie ase chinchera chiaino, ekiagera endamwamu yaye nigo egwoka bwango mbasesenirie abanto bonsi bakomotamera.
swahili: Mbusu Mwana, asije akakasirika nawe ukaangamizwa katika njia yako, kwa maana hasira yake inaweza kuwaka ghafula. Heri wote wanaomkimbilia.

english: The kings of the earth take their stand and the rulers gather together, against the LORD and against His Anointed One:
ekegusii: Abarwoti b’ense bebekire ang’e, na abagaambi nigo bakogamba amo ase okwanga Omonene na Omoakwa Amaguta oye.
swahili: Wafalme wa dunia wanajipanga na watawala wanajikusanya pamoja dhidi ya Bwana na dhidi ya Mpakwa Mafuta wake.

english: “Let us break Their chains and cast away Their cords.”
ekegusii: Nigo bagoteebania: “Tobutore ebisibo biabo, totugute chingori chiabo batosiberete!”
swahili: Wanasema, “Tuvunje minyororo yao na kuvitupilia mbali vifungo vyao.”

english: The One enthroned in heaven laughs; the Lord taunts them.
ekegusii: Omonene oria oikaransete aaria igoro, nigo agoseka na kobachecheria.
swahili: Yeye atawalaye mbinguni hucheka, Bwana huwadharau.

english: Then He rebukes them in His anger, and terrifies them in His fury:
ekegusii: Erio nabatogonyere ase endamwamu yaye, abagose ase ekeririanda kiaye, ogoteeba:
swahili: Kisha huwakemea katika hasira yake na kuwaogopesha katika ghadhabu yake, akisema,

english: “I have installed My King on Zion, upon My holy mountain.”
ekegusii: “Nabeekire omorwoti one ase Sayoni, egetunwa kiane egechenu.”
swahili: “Nimemtawaza Mfalme wangu juu ya Sayuni, mlima wangu mtakatifu.” Ushindi Wa Mfalme

english: I will proclaim the decree spoken to Me by the LORD: “You are My Son; today I have become Your Father.
ekegusii: Omorwoti oteebire: “Nindarie amang’an’Omonene aroberetie. Ere aganteebia: Aye naye Omwana one, reero nakoiboire.
swahili: Nitatangaza amri ya Bwana: Yeye aliniambia, “Wewe ni Mwanangu, leo mimi nimekuzaa.

english: Ask Me, and I will make the nations Your inheritance, the ends of the earth Your possession.
ekegusii: Omborie, na inche ninkoe ebisaku bionsi bibe omwando oo, ne chinsemo chionsi chi’ense nchibe echiao.
swahili: Niombe, nami nitayafanya mataifa kuwa urithi wako, miisho ya dunia kuwa milki yako.

english: You will break them with an iron scepter; You will shatter them like pottery. ”
ekegusii: Aye nobasenyente nenyimbo y’ekioma, obasegenye babe buna ebigonkorio.”
swahili: Utawatawala kwa fimbo ya chuma na kuwavunjavunja kama chombo cha mfinyanzi.”

english: I will exalt You, O LORD, for You have lifted me up and have not allowed my foes to rejoice over me.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ningotogie, ekiagera kwanyimokirie korwa inse, tigwatigete ababisa baane betogie igoro yane.
swahili: Nitakutukuza wewe, Ee Bwana, kwa kuwa umeniinua kutoka vilindi, na hukuacha adui zangu washangilie juu yangu.

english: Hear me, O LORD, and have mercy; O LORD, be my helper.”
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, inyigwe, ondorere amaabera! Omonene, inkonye!
swahili: Ee Bwana, unisikie na kunihurumia, Ee Bwana, uwe msaada wangu.”

english: You turned my mourning into dancing; You peeled off my sackcloth and clothed me with joy,
ekegusii: Aye kwaonchoire omoichano one okaba omochengo; kwandusirie eanga y’emechando, kwambekeire ey’omogooko.
swahili: Uligeuza maombolezo yangu kuwa kucheza, ulinivua nguo za gunia ukanivika shangwe,

english: that my heart may sing Your praises and not be silent. O LORD my God, I will give thanks forever.
ekegusii: Ase ayio, omoyo one nogenderere kogotogia, togokira. Aye Omonene, Nyasae one, ninkoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono kogenderera kare na kare.
swahili: ili moyo wangu uweze kukusifu na usikae kimya. Ee Bwana Mungu wangu, nitakushukuru milele.

english: O LORD my God, I cried to You for help, and You healed me.
ekegusii: Aye, Omonene Nyasae one, nigo narerete asore ng’a onkonye, na bono kwangwenirie.
swahili: Ee Bwana, Mungu wangu, nilikuita unisaidie na wewe umeniponya.

english: O LORD, You pulled me up from Sheol; You spared me from descending into the Pit.
ekegusii: Omonene, gwatooririe omoyo one korwa aase abakuure kwang’iraneirie obogima tingenda ase oboina ime.
swahili: Ee Bwana, umenitoa Kuzimu, umeniokoa nisishuke kwenye shimo la mauti.

english: Sing to the LORD, O you His saints, and praise His holy name.
ekegusii: Inwe abachenu baye, tera amatera ay’okobaka Omonene, iraneria ng’a mbuya mono ase erieta riaye richenu.
swahili: Mwimbieni Bwana, enyi watakatifu wake; lisifuni jina lake takatifu.

english: For His anger is fleeting, but His favor lasts a lifetime. Weeping may stay the night, but joy comes in the morning.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo akoba nendamwamu ase engaki ensinini yoka, korende obuya bwaye nigo bokoba ase obogima bw’omonto. Ekerero nabo keranyare kobao ase omogoroba, korende mambia omogooko na omochengo nigo bigocha.
swahili: Kwa maana hasira yake ni ya muda mfupi, bali upendo wake hudumu siku zote. Inawezekana kilio kiwepo usiku kucha, lakini asubuhi kukawa na furaha.

english: In prosperity I said, “I will never be shaken.”
ekegusii: Ekero amang’ana onsi arenge amaya asende, ngateeba ng’a tinkobugwa.
swahili: Nilipofanikiwa nilisema, “Sitatikiswa kamwe.”

english: O LORD, You favored me; You made my mountain stand strong. When You hid Your face, I was dismayed.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ase engencho y’obuya bwao ogakora egetunwa kiane kegatenena bokong’u, korende ekero kwabisete obosio bwao nkaba nobwoba.
swahili: Ee Bwana, uliponijalia, uliuimarisha mlima wangu, lakini ulipouficha uso wako nilifadhaika.

english: To You, O LORD, I called, and I begged my Lord for mercy:
ekegusii: Erio nkarera asore, aye Omonene, ngakoboria ase oboitongo:
swahili: Kwako wewe, Ee Bwana, niliita, kwa Bwana niliomba rehema:

english: “What gain is there in my bloodshed, in my descent to the Pit? Will the dust praise You? Will it proclaim Your faithfulness?
ekegusii: Mbitoki ki aye oranyore onye ngokwa na gosoa ase oboina ime? Inee! Orotu rw’amaroba ndonyare kogotogia? Ndonyare koraria obwegenwa bwao?
swahili: “Kuna faida gani katika kuangamia kwangu? Katika kushuka kwangu shimoni? Je, mavumbi yatakusifu? Je, yatatangaza uaminifu wako?

english: In You, O LORD, I have taken refuge; let me never be put to shame; save me by Your righteousness.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, naye ngotamera, tobaisa gontiga nsookigwe; ntoorie goetera ase oboronge bwao!
swahili: Ee Bwana, nimekukimbilia wewe, usiache nikaaibika kamwe, kwa haki yako uniokoe.

english: For my life is consumed with grief and my years with groaning; my iniquity has drained my strength, and my bones are wasting away.
ekegusii: Ase obogima bwane bwonsi nabeire inde nemechando; na ase emiaka yane yonsi nabeire inde nomoichano; chinguru chiane chiaerire ase engencho y’ogosaria kwane; amauga yomobere one omire pa.
swahili: Maisha yangu yamedhoofika kwa majonzi, naam, miaka yangu kwa kulia kwa maumivu makali; nguvu zangu zinaisha kwa ajili ya mateso, na mifupa yangu inachakaa.

english: Among all my enemies I am a disgrace, and among my neighbors even more. I am dreaded by my friends— they flee when they see me on the street.
ekegusii: Ababisa baane bonsi nigo bagonchecheria, na abasani baane boigo. Abanto baamanyete banyoboire; bonsi abakondora ase enchera nigo bagontama.
swahili: Kwa sababu ya adui zangu wote, nimedharauliwa kabisa na jirani zangu, hata kwa rafiki zangu nimekuwa tisho, wale wanionao barabarani hunikimbia.

english: I am forgotten like a dead man, out of mind. I am like a broken vessel.
ekegusii: Abanto banyebire buna bakweba omonto okuure; nabeire buna enyongo yatekire.
swahili: Nimesahaulika miongoni mwao kama mtu aliyekufa, nimekuwa kama chombo cha mfinyanzi kilichovunjika.

english: For I hear the slander of many; there is terror on every side. They conspire against me and plot to take my life.
ekegusii: Nigo nkoigwa ababisa baane bakomonyererana; okogosa nigo kong’etanaine. Abwo nigo bagosangererekana amo kogamba, bagokora omooroberio bw’okong’ita.
swahili: Kwa maana nimesikia maneno niliyosingiziwa na wengi; vitisho viko pande zote; kwa kuwa wamefanya mashauri dhidi yangu, na kula njama kuniua.

english: But I trust in You, O LORD; I say, “You are my God.”
ekegusii: Korende inche nigo ngosemeretie aye Omonene. Nigo ngoteeba: “Aye naye Nyasae one.”
swahili: Lakini mimi ninakutumaini wewe peke yako, Ee Bwana; nimesema, “Wewe ndiwe Mungu wangu.”

english: My times are in Your hands; deliver me from my enemies and from those who pursue me.
ekegusii: Obogima bwane nigo bore ase amaboko ao; ntoorie korwa ase amaboko ’ababisa baane na ay’abachandi baane.
swahili: Siku za maisha yangu ziko mikononi mwako, uniokoe mikononi mwa adui zangu na wale wanifuatiao.

english: Make Your face shine on Your servant; save me by Your loving devotion.
ekegusii: Ing’onchorere obosio bwao, inche omosomba oo, ontoorie ase engencho y’obwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe.
swahili: Mwangazie mtumishi wako uso wako, uniokoe kwa ajili ya upendo wako usiokoma.

english: O LORD, let me not be ashamed, for I have called on You. Let the wicked be put to shame; let them lie silent in Sheol.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, tontiga nsookigwe, ekiagera nigo ngokorangeria. Tiga abakori amabe basookigwe, bagende aase abakuure babe amamama.
swahili: Usiniache niaibike, Ee Bwana, kwa maana nimekulilia wewe, bali waovu waaibishwe na kunyamazishwa Kuzimu.

english: May lying lips be silenced— lips that speak with arrogance against the righteous, full of pride and contempt.
ekegusii: Kiria emenwa yabwo bagokwana amang’ana ’oborimo, abwo bagokwana amang’ana amabe igoro y’oyore omooronge, na gokwana amang’ana yoboenenu na ay’ogochaaya.
swahili: Midomo yao isemayo uongo na inyamazishwe, kwa maana kwa kiburi na dharau wao husema kwa majivuno dhidi ya wenye haki.

english: How great is Your goodness which You have laid up for those who fear You, which You have bestowed before the sons of men on those who take refuge in You!
ekegusii: Naki obuya bwao bore obonge na obw’ogokumigwa, obwo kwagacheire abanto abakoirogete, ase amasio a Mwanyabaanto nigo okoboorokia ase abakogotamera.
swahili: Tazama jinsi ulivyo mkuu wema wako, uliowawekea akiba wakuchao, ambao huwapa wale wakukimbiliao machoni pa watu.

english: Incline Your ear to me; come quickly to my rescue. Be my rock of refuge, the stronghold of my deliverance.
ekegusii: Tegerera oigwe amang’ana aane, obe omwango gontooria. Kabe egetare kiane ngotamera, na eburi yane enkong’u, na ontoorie!
swahili: Nitegee sikio lako, uje uniokoe haraka; uwe kwangu mwamba wa kimbilio, ngome imara ya kuniokoa.

english: You hide them in the secret place of Your presence from the schemes of men. You conceal them in Your shelter from accusing tongues.
ekegusii: Nigo okobabisa agwo asore, ase okobarenda korwa ase emeroberio emebe y’abanto; nigo okobarenda ase ekiriri kiao korwa ase abanto abang’achi.
swahili: Unawahifadhi katika uvuli wa uwepo wako kutokana na hila za wanadamu; katika makao yako huwaweka salama kutokana na ndimi za mashtaka.

english: Blessed be the LORD, for He has shown me His loving devotion in a city under siege.
ekegusii: Omonene atogigwe! Nigo anyorogetie obwanchani bwaye bw’ogokumia; akandenda ase omochie omokong’u.
swahili: Atukuzwe Bwana, kwa kuwa amenionyesha upendo wake wa ajabu nilipokuwa katika mji uliozingirwa.

english: In my alarm I said, “I am cut off from Your sight!” But You heard my plea for mercy when I called to You for help.
ekegusii: Ekero narenge nobwoba nigo narengereretie, ngateeba; “Bono naserigwe gochia aare korwa ase obosio bwao!” Korende nigo kwaigwete okoboria kwane kw’oboitongo, ekero narerete asore ng’a onkonye.
swahili: Katika hofu yangu nilisema, “Nimekatiliwa mbali na macho yako!” Hata hivyo ulisikia kilio changu ukanihurumia nilipokuita unisaidie.

english: Love the LORD, all His saints. The LORD preserves the faithful, but fully repays the arrogant.
ekegusii: Mwanche Omonene, inwe abachenu baye mwensi! Omonene nigo akobarenda buya abanto bare abegenwa, korende nigo akorua egesusuro ase oyore omomwenu.
swahili: Mpendeni Bwana ninyi watakatifu wake wote! Bwana huwahifadhi waaminifu, lakini wenye kiburi huwalipiza kikamilifu.

english: Be strong and courageous, all you who hope in the LORD.
ekegusii: Inwe mwensi aba momosemeretie Omonene, kabe ne chinguru, mobe abaremu!
swahili: Kuweni hodari na mjipe moyo, ninyi nyote mnaomtumaini Bwana.

english: For You are my rock and my fortress; lead me and guide me for the sake of Your name.
ekegusii: Aye naye egetare kiane na eburi yane; ase engencho y’erieta riao ondaae na kondenda.
swahili: Kwa kuwa wewe ni mwamba wangu na ngome yangu, uniongoze na kunilinda kwa ajili ya jina lako.

english: You free me from the net laid out for me, for You are my refuge.
ekegusii: Indusie korwa ase oboreba bobisire bombwate, aye naye egekengero kiane.
swahili: Uniepushe na mtego niliotegewa, maana wewe ndiwe kimbilio langu.

english: Into Your hands I commit my spirit; You have redeemed me, O LORD, God of truth.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, Nyasae omwegenwa, naye kwambooririe.
swahili: Ninaikabidhi roho yangu mikononi mwako, unikomboe Ee Bwana, uliye Mungu wa kweli.

english: I hate those who cling to worthless idols, but in the LORD I trust.
ekegusii: Nigo ngechete abanto bagosasiima emegwekano ere bosa, korende nigo ngosemeretie aye Omonene.
swahili: Ninawachukia wale wanaongʼangʼania sanamu batili; mimi ninamtumaini Bwana.

english: I will be glad and rejoice in Your loving devotion, for You have seen my affliction; You have known the anguish of my soul.
ekegusii: Ningoke na gochenga ase engencho y’obwanchani bwao botari koera; aye igo ogwechandera emechando yane, na kondengereria mono ase ogochandwa kwane.
swahili: Nitafurahia na kushangilia upendo wako, kwa kuwa uliona mateso yangu na ulijua maumivu ya nafsi yangu.

english: You have not delivered me to the enemy; You have set my feet in the open.
ekegusii: Tombegeti ase amaboko ’omobisa one; korende gwatenenirie amagoro aane aase are aagare.
swahili: Hukunikabidhi kwa adui yangu bali umeiweka miguu yangu mahali penye nafasi.

english: Be merciful to me, O LORD, for I am in distress; my eyes fail from sorrow, my soul and body as well.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ndorere amaabera, ekiagera nigo mbwate emechando; amaiso aane arimeire ime ase engencho y’obororo, omoyo one ogoyire, naboigo nomobere one.
swahili: Ee Bwana unihurumie, kwa kuwa niko kwenye shida; macho yangu yanafifia kwa huzuni, nafsi yangu na mwili wangu kwa sikitiko.

english: Blessed is he whose transgressions are forgiven, whose sins are covered.
ekegusii: Nasesenirie omonto oyo bwabeirwe ogosaria kwaye, na ebibe biaye biatubirwe.
swahili: Heri mtu yule ambaye amesamehewa makosa yake, ambaye dhambi zake zimefunikwa.

english: Many are the sorrows of the wicked, but loving devotion surrounds him who trusts in the LORD.
ekegusii: Omokori amabe nare namaakwa amange, korende oyomosemeretie Omonene, Omonene nigo amoetananeretie nobwanchani botari koera.
swahili: Mtu mwovu ana taabu nyingi, bali upendo usio na kikomo wa Bwana unamzunguka mtu anayemtumaini.

english: Be glad in the LORD and rejoice, O righteous ones; shout for joy, all you upright in heart.
ekegusii: Inwe abanyene oboronge, mogokere Omonene na komochengera; inwe mwensi abamore ne chinkoro chindonge, aka eriogi nomogooko.
swahili: Shangilieni katika Bwana na mfurahi, enyi wenye haki! Imbeni, nyote mlio wanyofu wa moyo!

english: Blessed is the man whose iniquity the LORD does not count against him, in whose spirit there is no deceit.
ekegusii: Nasesenirie omonto oyi’Omonene atabarereti okomocha kwaye, oyo otari nobong’ainereria ase omoyo oye ime.
swahili: Heri mtu yule ambaye Bwana hamhesabii dhambi, na ambaye rohoni mwake hamna udanganyifu.

english: When I kept silent, my bones became brittle from my groaning all day long.
ekegusii: Ekero konya ntaraorokia ebibe biane, omobere one okoma pa ase okwerera omobaso boira.
swahili: Niliponyamaza, mifupa yangu ilichakaa kwa kulia kwa maumivu makali mchana kutwa.

english: For day and night Your hand was heavy upon me; my strength was drained as in the summer heat. Selah
ekegusii: Omobaso na obotuko okoboko kwao gokanditoera negesusuro; chinguru chiane chikaera buna amaache akoera ekero ki’egurugura.
swahili: Usiku na mchana mkono wako ulinilemea, nguvu zangu zilinyonywa kama vile katika joto la kiangazi.

english: Then I acknowledged my sin to You and did not hide my iniquity. I said, “I will confess my transgressions to the LORD,” and You forgave the guilt of my sin. Selah
ekegusii: Erio ngakoorokeria ebibe biane, gose tinakobisete okomocha kwane, ngateeba: “Nimoorokerie Omonene ogosaria kwane,” erio okanyabera ebibe biane bionsi.
swahili: Kisha nilikujulisha dhambi yangu wala sikuficha uovu wangu. Nilisema, “Nitaungama makosa yangu kwa Bwana.” Ndipo uliponisamehe hatia ya dhambi yangu.

english: Therefore let all the godly pray to You while You may be found. Surely when great waters rise, they will not come near.
ekegusii: Ase ayio, kera omonto oyokoirogete tiga agosabe ase engaki y’emechando. Ekero amaache amange agotirimboka gocha bwango, tabaisa komoikera.
swahili: Kwa hiyo kila mtu mcha Mungu akuombe wakati unapopatikana, hakika maji makuu yatakapofurika hayatamfikia yeye.

english: You are my hiding place. You protect me from trouble; You surround me with songs of deliverance. Selah
ekegusii: Aye naye obwebiso bwane, nondendete korwa ase emechando, nimbe nomogooko na omochengo, ekiagera gwantooririe.
swahili: Wewe ndiwe mahali pangu pa kujificha, utaniepusha na taabu na kunizunguka kwa nyimbo za wokovu.

english: I will instruct you and teach you the way you should go; I will give you counsel and watch over you.
ekegusii: Ninkworokererie na gokoraa ase enchera ogwenerete kogenda; ningosemie, na amaiso aane nakorigererie.
swahili: Nitakufundisha na kukuonyesha njia utakayoiendea; nitakushauri na kukuangalia.

english: Do not be like the horse or mule, which have no understanding; they must be controlled with bit and bridle to make them come to you.
ekegusii: Timoba buna chibarasi ne chibarasi chitari nobong’aini, echigwenerete chibekerwe chinkini na ebigobanio bi’ogochigambera.
swahili: Usiwe kama farasi au nyumbu wasio na akili, ambao ni lazima waongozwe kwa lijamu na hatamu la sivyo hawatakukaribia.

english: Rejoice in the LORD, O righteous ones; it is fitting for the upright to praise Him.
ekegusii: Inwe abanto abaronge, mochengere Omonene! Inwe abamore ne chinkoro chindonge goika motogie Omonene!
swahili: Mwimbieni Bwana kwa furaha, enyi wenye haki; kusifu kunawapasa wanyofu wa moyo.

english: The LORD frustrates the plans of the nations; He thwarts the devices of the peoples.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo akoonchorana emeroberio y’abanto b’ebisaku, na gosaria okogamba kwa Mwanyabaanto kwaba bosa.
swahili: Bwana huzuia mipango ya mataifa, hupinga makusudi ya mataifa.

english: The counsel of the LORD stands forever, the purposes of His heart to all generations.
ekegusii: Okogamba kw’Omonene nigo goteneine kare na kare; emeroberio yaye nigo egendererete ebiaare ase ebiaare.
swahili: Lakini mipango ya Bwana inasimama imara milele, makusudi ya moyo wake kwa vizazi vyote.

english: Blessed is the nation whose God is the LORD, the people He has chosen as His inheritance!
ekegusii: Ngesesenirie egesaku eke Omonene are Nyasae obo, abanto aba achorete babe omwando oye.
swahili: Heri taifa ambalo Bwana ni Mungu wao, watu ambao aliwachagua kuwa urithi wake.

english: The LORD looks down from heaven; He sees all the sons of men.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo arigereretie korwa igoro, orooche Mwanyabaanto bonsi.
swahili: Kutoka mbinguni Bwana hutazama chini na kuwaona wanadamu wote;

english: From His dwelling place He gazes on all who inhabit the earth.
ekegusii: Korwa agwo ase aikaransete, nigo akobagambera bonsi abamenyete ase ense.
swahili: kutoka maskani mwake huwaangalia wote wakaao duniani:

english: He shapes the hearts of each; He considers all their works.
ekegusii: Nere otongete chinkoro chi’abaanto bonsi, namanyete korenga ogokora kwabo gwonsi.
swahili: yeye ambaye huumba mioyo yao wote, ambaye huangalia kila kitu wanachokitenda.

english: No king is saved by his vast army; no warrior is delivered by his great strength.
ekegusii: Omorwoti tari orabue nomoganda oye omonene Nyasae bw’abarwani, gose etuoni teri eratoorigwe ne chinguru chiaye chinyinge.
swahili: Hakuna mfalme aokokaye kwa ukubwa wa jeshi lake; hakuna shujaa aokokaye kwa wingi wa nguvu zake.

english: A horse is a vain hope for salvation; even its great strength cannot save.
ekegusii: Gosemeria chibarasi chi’esegi, ayio mbosa, tichikonyara kobua, chinguru chiabo chinyinge tichigotooria omonto.
swahili: Farasi ni tumaini la bure kwa wokovu, licha ya nguvu zake nyingi, hawezi kuokoa.

english: Surely the eyes of the LORD are on those who fear Him, on those whose hope is in His loving devotion
ekegusii: Rora amaiso a Omonene nigo abarigereretie abwo bamoirogete, abwo basemeretie obwanchani bwaye botari koera.
swahili: Lakini macho ya Bwana yako kwa wale wamchao, kwa wale tumaini lao liko katika upendo wake usio na kikomo,

english: to deliver them from death and keep them alive in famine.
ekegusii: Omonene natoorie emioyo yabo korwa ase amakweri, tibakwa ekero gi’enchara.
swahili: ili awaokoe na mauti, na kuwahifadhi wakati wa njaa.

english: Praise the LORD with the harp; make music to Him with ten strings.
ekegusii: Moakere Omonene ng’a mbuya mono ase okobugia amakano yebirigisa, motogie ase okobugia amakano are ne chinga ikomi!
swahili: Msifuni Bwana kwa kinubi, mwimbieni sifa kwa zeze la nyuzi kumi.

english: Our soul waits for the LORD; He is our help and our shield.
ekegusii: Emioyo yaito nigo emoganyete Omonene, ere nere ogokonywa gwaito, na enguba yaito.
swahili: Sisi tunamngojea Bwana kwa matumaini, yeye ni msaada wetu na ngao yetu.

english: For our hearts rejoice in Him, since we trust in His holy name.
ekegusii: Ee, chinkoro chiaito nchimogokerete, ekiagera tosemeretie erieta riaye richenu.
swahili: Mioyo yetu humshangilia, kwa maana tunalitumainia jina lake takatifu.

english: May Your loving devotion rest on us, O LORD, as we put our hope in You.
ekegusii: Omonene, obwanchani bwao botari koera bobe amo naintwe, ekiagera naye togosemeretie.
swahili: Upendo wako usio na mwisho ukae juu yetu, Ee Bwana, tunapoliweka tumaini letu kwako.

english: Sing to Him a new song; play skillfully with a shout of joy.
ekegusii: Moteerere ogoteera okoyia, na kobugia ase eriogi rireng’aine buya na komochengera!
swahili: Mwimbieni wimbo mpya; pigeni kwa ustadi, na mpaze sauti za shangwe.

english: For the word of the LORD is upright, and all His work is trustworthy.
ekegusii: Naki ring’ana ri’Omonene nigo rire boronge, na ogokora kwaye gwonsi nigo agokora ase obwegenwa.
swahili: Maana neno la Bwana ni haki na kweli, ni mwaminifu kwa yote atendayo.

english: The LORD loves righteousness and justice; the earth is full of His loving devotion.
ekegusii: Ere nigo anchete ayare boronge na ekeene, na ense nigo eichire nobwanchani bw’Omonene botari koera.
swahili: Bwana hupenda uadilifu na haki; dunia imejaa upendo wake usiokoma.

english: By the word of the LORD the heavens were made, and all the stars by the breath of His mouth.
ekegusii: Ase chinguru chi’ering’ana ri’Omonene igoro egatongwa, na ase okobua kwe ring’ana riaye erioba na omotienyi ne ching’enang’eni bigatongwa.
swahili: Kwa neno la Bwana mbingu ziliumbwa, jeshi lao la angani kwa pumzi ya kinywa chake.

english: He piles up the waters of the sea; He puts the depths into storehouses.
ekegusii: Igo agosangereria amaache yenyancha, buna amaache are enyongo ime, obeka chindiba aase abo.
swahili: Ameyakusanya maji ya bahari kama kwenye chungu; vilindi vya bahari ameviweka katika ghala.

english: Let all the earth fear the LORD; let all the people of the world revere Him.
ekegusii: Ense yonsi neiroke Omonene, na bonsi abamenyete ase ense bamwoboe.
swahili: Dunia yote na imwogope Bwana, watu wote wa dunia wamche.

english: For He spoke, and it came to be; He commanded, and it stood firm.
ekegusii: Naki ere agakwana, na ayio agakoreka; agachiika, na ayio akabao.
swahili: Kwa maana Mungu alisema, na ikawa, aliamuru na ikasimama imara.

english: I will bless the LORD at all times; His praise will always be on my lips.
ekegusii: Nimbake Omonene chingaki chionsi, ase omonwa one nimotogie botambe.
swahili: Nitamtukuza Bwana nyakati zote, sifa zake zitakuwa midomoni mwangu siku zote.

english: Young lions go lacking and hungry, but those who seek the LORD lack no good thing.
ekegusii: Chindo chinsae nachinyare koremerwa na koba nenchara, korende abwo bakomorigia Omonene tibakoremerwa kende gionsi kere ekiya.
swahili: Wana simba wenye nguvu hutindikiwa na kuona njaa, bali wale wamtafutao Bwana hawatakosa kitu chochote kilicho chema.

english: Come, children, listen to me; I will teach you the fear of the LORD.
ekegusii: Abana baane, inchwo montegerere, mborokererie buna moramoiroke Omonene.
swahili: Njooni, watoto wangu, mnisikilize, nitawafundisha kumcha Bwana.

english: Who is the man who delights in life, who desires to see good days?
ekegusii: Inee! Aye nomonto bwanchete obogima? Oganetie obe moyo amatuko amange, na korora amaya?
swahili: Yeyote kati yenu anayependa uzima na kutamani kuziona siku nyingi njema,

english: Keep your tongue from evil and your lips from deceitful speech.
ekegusii: Rirorio tanga oromeme rwao tirokwana amabe, na ebikoba biao tibikwana obong’ainereria.
swahili: basi auzuie ulimi wake na mabaya, na midomo yake kutokana na kusema uongo.

english: Turn away from evil and do good; seek peace and pursue it.
ekegusii: Otige amabe, okore amaya; origie omorembe na koyobwata mono.
swahili: Aache uovu, atende mema, aitafute amani na kuifuatilia.

english: The eyes of the LORD are on the righteous, and His ears are inclined to their cry.
ekegusii: Amaiso a Omonene nigo arigereretie abanyene oboronge, na amato aye nigo akoigwa ebirero biabo.
swahili: Macho ya Bwana huwaelekea wenye haki, na masikio yake yako makini kusikiliza kilio chao.

english: But the face of the LORD is against those who do evil, to wipe out all memory of them from the earth.
ekegusii: Obosio bw’Omonene nigo bore mamincha y’abwo bagokora amabe, nabasirie korwa ase ense, tibainyorwa.
swahili: Uso wa Bwana uko kinyume na watendao maovu, ili kufuta kumbukumbu lao duniani.

english: The righteous cry out, and the LORD hears; He delivers them from all their troubles.
ekegusii: Ekero abanyene oboronge bakorera ng’a bakonywe, Omonene nigo akobaigwa na kobatooria korwa ase emechando yabo yonsi.
swahili: Wenye haki hulia, naye Bwana huwasikia, huwaokoa katika taabu zao zote.

english: The LORD is near to the brokenhearted; He saves the contrite in spirit.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo are ang’e nabwo chinkoro chiabo chiabunekire, nigo akobatooria abwo berusirie moyo.
swahili: Bwana yu karibu na waliovunjika moyo, na huwaokoa waliopondeka roho.

english: Many are the afflictions of the righteous, but the LORD delivers him from them all.
ekegusii: Omonyene oboronge nigo akonyora emechando emenge, korende Omonene namotoorie korwa ase eyio yonsi;
swahili: Mwenye haki ana mateso mengi, lakini Bwana humwokoa nayo yote,

english: My soul boasts in the LORD; let the oppressed hear and rejoice.
ekegusii: Ase omoyo one ninyetogerie Omonene, abwo bachayire tiga bayaigwe bagoke.
swahili: Nafsi yangu itajisifu katika Bwana, walioonewa watasikia na wafurahi.

english: He protects all his bones; not one of them will be broken.
ekegusii: nigo akorenda amauga aye onsi, rinde tiribunwa nonya nerimo.
swahili: huhifadhi mifupa yake yote, hata mmoja hautavunjika.

english: Evil will slay the wicked, and the haters of the righteous will be condemned.
ekegusii: Obobe nigo boraite omokori amabe, na abwo bagechete omonyene oboronge nabagaambigwe, banyore egesusuro.
swahili: Ubaya utamuua mtu mwovu, nao adui za mwenye haki watahukumiwa.

english: The LORD redeems His servants, and none who take refuge in Him will be condemned.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo akobooria emioyo y’abasomba baye, gose onde tari ase abwo bakomotamera orache kogambigwa.
swahili: Bwana huwakomboa watumishi wake, yeyote anayemkimbilia yeye hatahukumiwa kamwe.

english: Magnify the LORD with me; let us exalt His name together.
ekegusii: Raria obonene bw’Omonene amo nainche totogie erieta riaye twensi amo.
swahili: Mtukuzeni Bwana pamoja nami, naam, na tulitukuze jina lake pamoja.

english: I sought the LORD, and He answered me; He delivered me from all my fears.
ekegusii: Nkarangeria Omonene, nere akang’iraneria, akandusia korwa ase obwoba bwane bwonsi.
swahili: Nilimtafuta Bwana naye akanijibu, akaniokoa kwenye hofu zangu zote.

english: Those who look to Him are radiant with joy; their faces shall never be ashamed.
ekegusii: Abwo bamorigereretie nigo bakomeka‐meka bare nomogooko, gose amasio abo takororekana are nobosooku.
swahili: Wale wamtazamao hutiwa nuru, nyuso zao hazifunikwi na aibu kamwe.

english: This poor man called out, and the LORD heard him; He saved him from all his troubles.
ekegusii: Omonto omotaka nigo akorera, n’Omonene omoigwa, omotooria korwa ase emechando yaye yonsi.
swahili: Maskini huyu alimwita Bwana, naye akamsikia, akamwokoa katika taabu zake zote.

english: The angel of the LORD encamps around those who fear Him, and he delivers them.
ekegusii: Omomalaika Omonene nigo akorenda na goetanana abwo bamoirogete Omonene na kobatooria.
swahili: Malaika wa Bwana hufanya kituo akiwazunguka wale wamchao, naye huwaokoa.

english: Taste and see that the LORD is good; blessed is the man who takes refuge in Him!
ekegusii: Moteeme Omonene, morore ng’a nomuya. Nasesenirie omonto oria omotameire.
swahili: Onjeni mwone kwamba Bwana ni mwema, heri mtu yule anayemkimbilia.

english: Fear the LORD, you His saints, for those who fear Him lack nothing.
ekegusii: Moiroke Omonene, inwe abachenu baye, naki abwo bamoirogete tibakoremerwa kende.
swahili: Mcheni Bwana enyi watakatifu wake, kwa maana wale wamchao hawapungukiwi na chochote.

english: Contend with my opponents, O LORD; fight against those who fight against me.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, engereria abanto abwo bakoengererania nainche, rwania abwo bakondwania!
swahili: Ee Bwana, pingana na wale wanaopingana nami, upigane na hao wanaopigana nami.

english: All my bones will exclaim, “Who is like You, O LORD, who delivers the afflicted from the aggressor, the poor and needy from the robber?”
ekegusii: Amauga onsi ay’omobere one nateebe, “Aye Omonene, ning’o onga buna aye? Aye Omonene, nigo ogotooria oyo otari ne chinguru korwa ase oyore ne chinguru komobua, ee, nigo ogotooria oyo otari ne chinguru naende omoremerwa, korwa ase oyo okomochanda.”
swahili: Nitapaza sauti yangu nikisema, “Ni nani aliye kama wewe, Ee Bwana? Wewe huwaokoa maskini kutokana na wale walio na nguvu kuliko wao, maskini na mhitaji kutokana na wanaowanyangʼanya!”

english: Hostile witnesses come forward; they make charges I know nothing about.
ekegusii: Birori bi’oborimo nigo bakonyimokera, bakomboria ase amang’ana ntamanyeti.
swahili: Mashahidi wakatili wanainuka, wananiuliza mambo nisiyoyajua.

english: They repay me evil for good, to the bereavement of my soul.
ekegusii: Abanto abwo nigo bakong’akana amabe ase amaya, nerusirie moyo.
swahili: Wananilipa baya kwa jema na kuiacha nafsi yangu ukiwa.

english: Yet when they were ill, I put on sackcloth; I humbled myself with fasting, but my prayers returned unanswered.
ekegusii: Ekero abanto abwo barwarete nigo neboyetie eanga y’okweumia na goichana; ngechanda ase okweng’ata, ngasaba nturegete omotwe.
swahili: Lakini walipokuwa wagonjwa, nilivaa nguo ya gunia na nikajinyenyekesha kwa kufunga. Maombi yangu yaliponirudia bila kujibiwa,

english: I paced about as for my friend or brother; I was bowed down with grief, like one mourning for his mother.
ekegusii: Nkabechandera buna nigo barenge abasani baane gose abaminto; nigo nabegete eanga y’okweumia, nturegete omotwe buna omonto okweumia ekero ng’ina akuure.
swahili: niliendelea kuomboleza kama vile wao ni rafiki au ndugu. Niliinamisha kichwa chini kwa huzuni kama ninayemwombolezea mama yangu.

english: But when I stumbled, they assembled in glee; they gathered together against me. Assailants I did not know slandered me without ceasing.
ekegusii: Korende ekero narenge ase emechando, nigo basangererekanete amo bakagoka. Abanto batagwenerete, aba ntamanyeti bakaba bagonchecheria batari gotiga.
swahili: Lakini nilipojikwaa, walikusanyika kwa shangwe; washambuliaji walijikusanya dhidi yangu bila mimi kujua. Walinisingizia pasipo kukoma.

english: Like godless jesters at a feast, they gnashed their teeth at me.
ekegusii: Abatamoirogeti Omonene nigo banchayete na gonchecheria, bakangecha bakaba bakondiananeria amaino.
swahili: Kama watu wasiomcha Mungu, wamenidhihaki, wamenisagia meno.

english: How long, O Lord, will You look on? Rescue my soul from their ravages, my precious life from these lions.
ekegusii: Omonene, ngoika ririri orabe koyarigereretie rioka? Intaborie korwa ase ogosiria barobeirie, tooria obogima bwane korwa ase chindo echio!
swahili: Ee Bwana, utatazama mpaka lini? Niokoe maisha yangu na maangamizi yao, uhai wangu wa thamani kutokana na simba hawa.

english: Then I will give You thanks in the great assembly; I will praise You among many people.
ekegusii: Erio ninkoiranerie ng’a mbuya mono agwo ase omosangererekano omonene, ningotogie ase omoganda omonene bw’abaanto.
swahili: Nami nitakushukuru mbele ya kusanyiko kubwa, nitakusifu katikati ya watu wengi.

english: Let not my enemies gloat over me without cause, nor those who hate me without reason wink in malice.
ekegusii: Totiga ababisa baane bagoke igoro yane engencho ende etaiyo; totiga abwo bangechete bosa bagosimanera amaiso bankore bobe.
swahili: Usiwaache wale wanaonisimanga, wale ambao ni adui zangu bila sababu; usiwaache wale ambao ni adui zangu bila sababu wakonyeze jicho kwa hila.

english: Take up Your shield and buckler; arise and come to my aid.
ekegusii: Bogoria enguba na eng’aya, imoka onkonye!
swahili: Chukua ngao na kigao. Inuka unisaidie.

english: For they do not speak peace, but they devise deceitful schemes against those who live quietly in the land.
ekegusii: Abanto abwo tibari gokwana amang’ana akorenta omorembe; nigo bakona-korigia amang’ana yobong’ainereria igoro y’abanto abwo bare abatoereru ase ense.
swahili: Hawazungumzi kwa amani, bali wanatunga mashtaka ya uongo dhidi ya wale wanaoishi kwa utulivu katika nchi.
