english: They gape at me and say, “Aha, aha! Our eyes have seen!”
ekegusii: Abwo nigo bagwasamia emenwa yabo bateeba: “Ahaa! Ahaa! Ntwayarora namaiso aito.”
swahili: Hunifumbulia vinywa vyao wakisema, “Aha! Aha! Kwa macho yetu wenyewe tumeliona.”

english: O LORD, You have seen it; be not silent. O Lord, be not far from me.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, kwarorire amang’ana ayio, tokirakiri. Omonene, tobaisa kobeera aare korwa asende!
swahili: Ee Bwana, umeona hili, usiwe kimya. Usiwe mbali nami, Ee Bwana.

english: Awake and rise to my defense, to my cause, my God and my Lord!
ekegusii: Omonene one, ore Nyasae one, tabobora, oimokerere igoro, erinde orwanerere oboronge bwane na amang’ana aane.
swahili: Amka, inuka unitetee! Unipiganie Mungu wangu na Bwana wangu.

english: Vindicate me by Your righteousness, O LORD my God, and do not let them gloat over me.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, Nyasae one, nacha ekiina kiane koreng’ana noboronge bwao, tobaisa gotiga ababisa baane bagoke igoro yane.
swahili: Nihukumu kwa haki yako, Ee Bwana Mungu wangu, sawasawa na haki yako; usiwaache wakusimange.

english: Let them not say in their hearts, “Aha, just what we wanted!” Let them not say, “We have swallowed him up!”
ekegusii: Tobatiga bateebe: “Bono twamonyorire buna twaganetie.” Tobatiga bateebe: “Bono twamobuire.”
swahili: Usiwaache wafikiri, “Aha, hili ndilo tulilotaka!” Au waseme, “Tumemmeza.”

english: May those who gloat in my distress be ashamed and confounded; may those who exalt themselves over me be clothed in shame and reproach.
ekegusii: Abanto abwo bakogokera emechando yane, tiga basookigwe na batantanigwe; abwo bagwetogia igoro yane, tiga baboigwe obosooku na ogochaywa.
swahili: Wote wanaofurahia dhiki yangu waaibishwe na wachanganyikiwe; hao wanaojiinua dhidi yangu wavikwe aibu na dharau.

english: May those who favor my vindication shout for joy and gladness; may they always say, “Exalted be the LORD who delights in His servant’s well-being.”
ekegusii: Abanto abwo banchete ng’a ng’egwe oboronge bwane, tiga baake eriogi ri’omogooko na omochengo, bagenderere goteeba: “Omonene noyo bw’obonene! Ee, nigo agokirie namaya omosomba oye akonyora!”
swahili: Wale wanaofurahia hukumu yangu ya haki wapige kelele za shangwe na furaha; hebu waseme siku zote, “ Bwana atukuzwe, ambaye amefurahia mafanikio ya mtumishi wake.”

english: Then my tongue will proclaim Your righteousness and Your praises all day long.
ekegusii: Erio oromeme rwane ndogenderere koraria oboronge bwao, na ogotogigwa kwao, omobaso boira.
swahili: Ulimi wangu utanena haki yako na sifa zako mchana kutwa.

english: Draw the spear and javelin against my pursuers; say to my soul: “I am your salvation.”
ekegusii: Aye orute abanto abwo bakombwatia ritimo na esimisi! Ontebie ase omoyo one: “Ninche Omotooria oo.”
swahili: Inua mkuki wako na fumo lako dhidi ya hao wanaonifuatia. Iambie nafsi yangu, “Mimi ni wokovu wako.”

english: May those who seek my life be disgraced and put to shame; may those who plan to harm me be driven back and confounded.
ekegusii: Abanto abwo bakorigia gosiria obogima bwane, tiga babugwe na gosookigwa. Abwo bagokora emeroberio emebe y’okong’ita, tiga bairanigwe babe nobosooku.
swahili: Wafedheheshwe na waaibishwe wale wanaotafuta uhai wangu. Wanaofanya shauri kuniangamiza warudishwe nyuma kwa hofu.

english: May they be like chaff in the wind, as the angel of the LORD drives them away.
ekegusii: Barabwo tiga babe buna omoiriro okoirurukigwa nomwaga, na omomalaika Omonene abe okobaiyeria.
swahili: Wawe kama makapi yapeperushwayo na upepo, malaika wa Bwana akiwafukuza.

english: May their path be dark and slick, as the angel of the LORD pursues.
ekegusii: Omosunte na oboterere bibe ase enchera bagoetera, na omomalaika Omonene abe okobabwata abasirie.
swahili: Njia yao na iwe giza na ya utelezi, malaika wa Bwana akiwafuatilia.

english: For without cause they laid their net for me; without reason they dug a pit for my soul.
ekegusii: Abanto abwo bambekeire oboreba bobisi engencho ende etaiyo, na bakunyire eirima ng’a basirie obogima bwane.
swahili: Kwa vile walinifichia wavu wao bila sababu, na bila sababu wamenichimbia shimo,

english: May ruin befall them by surprise; may the net they hid ensnare them; may they fall into the hazard they created.
ekegusii: Ogosirigwa tiga kobanyore mobosokano; oboreba obwo bantegeire tiga bobabwate barabwo abanyene, tiga bagwe imeo abanyene na gosirigwa.
swahili: maafa na yawapate ghafula: wavu walionifichia na uwatege wenyewe, na waanguke katika shimo hilo, kwa maangamizo yao.

english: Then my soul will rejoice in the LORD and exult in His salvation.
ekegusii: Omoyo one nogoke ase Omonene na gochenga ase engencho y’ogotooreka kwaye.
swahili: Ndipo nafsi yangu itashangilia katika Bwana na kuufurahia wokovu wake.

english: An oracle is in my heart regarding the transgression of the wicked man: There is no fear of God before his eyes.
ekegusii: Ebibe nigo bigokwana nomonto omokori amabe ase enkoro yaye ime; okomoiroka Nyasae tikori ase obosio bwaye.
swahili: Kuna neno moyoni mwangu kuhusu hali ya dhambi ya mwovu. Hakuna hofu ya Mungu mbele ya macho yake.

english: Extend Your loving devotion to those who know You, and Your righteousness to the upright in heart.
ekegusii: Genderera koorokia obwanchani bwao obonene ase abwo bakomanyete, na oboronge bwao ase abwo bare ne chinkoro chindonge.
swahili: Dumisha upendo wako kwa wale wanaokujua wewe, haki yako kwa wale walio wanyofu wa moyo.

english: Let not the foot of the proud come against me, nor the hand of the wicked drive me away.
ekegusii: Totiga amagoro ya abaenenu ang’ike ang’e kondwania, gose amaboko ya abakori amabe anserie.
swahili: Mguu wa mwenye kiburi usije dhidi yangu, wala mkono wa mwovu usinifukuze.

english: There the evildoers lie fallen, thrown down and unable to rise.
ekegusii: Rora aase abakori amabe bagure inse, baiyerigwe tibakonyara koboka naende.
swahili: Angalia jinsi watenda mabaya walivyoanguka: wametupwa chini, hawawezi kuinuka!

english: For his eyes are too full of conceit to detect or hate his own sin.
ekegusii: Omonto oyo nigo akweremia omonyene ase okweng’aina, ng’a ebibe biaye tibikomanyekana bigechwe.
swahili: Kwa kuwa machoni pake mwenyewe hujisifu mno hata hawezi kugundua au kuichukia dhambi yake.

english: The words of his mouth are wicked and deceitful; he has ceased to be wise and well-doing.
ekegusii: Amang’ana omonto oyio agokwana nigo are ay’ogosaria na obong’ainereria; ere otigire gokora amang’ana ’obong’aini na ayare amaya.
swahili: Maneno ya kinywa chake ni maovu na ya udanganyifu, ameacha kuwa mwenye hekima na kutenda mema.

english: Even on his bed he plots wickedness; he sets himself on a path that is not good; he fails to reject evil.
ekegusii: Ekero araire borere bwaye nigo agokora emeroberio y’amabe, na kobwatia chinchera chitari chingiya, tari kwanga obobe bonde bwonsi. Obuya bwa Nyasae
swahili: Hata kitandani mwake hupanga hila mbaya, hujitia katika njia ya dhambi na hakatai lililo baya.

english: Your loving devotion, O LORD, reaches to the heavens, Your faithfulness to the clouds.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, obwanchani bwao botari koera nigo bogoika aaria igoro, na obwegenwa bwao nigo boigete ase amare igoro.
swahili: Upendo wako, Ee Bwana, unafika hadi mbinguni, uaminifu wako hadi kwenye anga.

english: Your righteousness is like the highest mountains; Your judgments are like the deepest sea. O LORD, You preserve man and beast.
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, oboronge bwao nigo boteneine bokong’u buna ebitunwa biao. Okogamba kwao nigo kore buna chindiba chintambe, aye nigo orendete Mwanyabaanto ne ching’iti boigo.
swahili: Haki yako ni kama milima mikubwa, hukumu zako ni kama kilindi kikuu. Ee Bwana, wewe huwahifadhi mwanadamu na mnyama.

english: How precious is Your loving devotion, O God, that the children of men take refuge in the shadow of Your wings!
ekegusii: Nyasae, naki obwanchani bwao bwa botambe bore obonene! Mwanyabaanto nigo bagotamera ekiriri gie chimbaaba chiao.
swahili: Upendo wako usiokoma ni wa thamani mno! Watu wakuu na wadogo hujificha uvulini wa mbawa zako.

english: They feast on the abundance of Your house, and You give them drink from Your river of delights.
ekegusii: Nigo bagoisanekigwa nobonoru bokorwa ase enyomba yao, aye nobae banywe korwa ase orooche rwao rw’okogokia.
swahili: Wanajifurahisha katika wingi nyumbani mwako, nawe utawanywesha katika mto wa furaha zako.

english: For with You is the fountain of life; in Your light we see light.
ekegusii: Naye ore ensoko y’obogima, na ase omobaso oo nigo tokorora omobaso.
swahili: Kuwa pamoja nawe ni kijito cha uzima, katika nuru yako twaona nuru.

english: Do not fret over those who do evil; do not envy those who do wrong.
ekegusii: Togechigwa ase engencho y’abakori amabe, toba ne ribero ase abakori amabe.
swahili: Usisumbuke kwa ajili ya watendao maovu, wala usiwaonee wivu watendao mabaya,

english: Yet a little while, and the wicked will be no more; though you look for them, they will not be found.
ekegusii: Netigarete engaki ensinini, na omokori amabe asirigwe; nobe gokorigereria mono aase aye, takonyorekana oreo.
swahili: Bado kitambo kidogo, nao waovu hawataonekana, ingawa utawatafuta, hawataonekana.

english: But the meek will inherit the land and delight in abundant prosperity.
ekegusii: Abaitongo mbaire ense ebe omwando obo, na barabwo mbagoke na goisaneka ase obonge bw’omorembe.
swahili: Bali wanyenyekevu watairithi nchi na wafurahie amani tele.

english: The wicked scheme against the righteous and gnash their teeth at them,
ekegusii: Omokori amabe nigo agokora omooroberio bw’ogoita oyore omooronge, na komoriananeria amaino.
swahili: Waovu hula njama dhidi ya wenye haki na kuwasagia meno,

english: but the Lord laughs, seeing that their day is coming.
ekegusii: Omonene nasekerere omokori amabe, ekiagera aroche ng’a rituko ri’ogosirigwa kwaye ndichiche.
swahili: bali Bwana huwacheka waovu, kwa sababu anajua siku yao inakuja.

english: The wicked have drawn the sword and bent the bow to bring down the poor and needy, to slay those whose ways are upright.
ekegusii: Abakori amabe nigo bagosomora emeyio yabo na batinga amata abo, erinde baite abanto abataka na abaremeire, baite na abakobwatia chinchera chi’oboronge.
swahili: Waovu huchomoa upanga na kupinda upinde, ili wawaangushe maskini na wahitaji, kuwachinja wale ambao njia zao ni nyofu.

english: But their swords will pierce their own hearts, and their bows will be broken.
ekegusii: Emeyio yabo nebete chinkoro chiabo abanyene, na amata abo nabunwe.
swahili: Lakini panga zao zitachoma mioyo yao wenyewe, na pinde zao zitavunjwa.

english: Better is the little of the righteous than the abundance of many who are wicked.
ekegusii: Ebinto ebike omonto omonyaboronge abwate, nigo bire ebiya kobua ebinge biria abakori amabe abange babwate.
swahili: Bora kidogo walicho nacho wenye haki kuliko wingi wa mali wa waovu wengi;

english: For the arms of the wicked will be broken, but the LORD upholds the righteous.
ekegusii: Abakori amabe mbaurwe chinguru echi babwate, korende Omonene nagenderere koa abanyaboronge chinguru.
swahili: kwa maana nguvu za waovu zitavunjwa, lakini Bwana humtegemeza mwenye haki.

english: The LORD knows the days of the blameless, and their inheritance will last forever.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo amanyete amatuko ya abamoirogete, na omwando obo nogenderere kobao kare na kare.
swahili: Bwana anazifahamu siku za wanyofu, na urithi wao utadumu milele.

english: In the time of evil they will not be ashamed, and in the days of famine they will be satisfied.
ekegusii: Barabwo tibari gosookigwa ase chingaki chi’amabe, ase chingaki chi’enchara nigo bakoigota.
swahili: Siku za maafa hawatanyauka, siku za njaa watafurahia wingi wa vitu.

english: For they wither quickly like grass and wilt like tender plants.
ekegusii: Barabwo mbasirigwe bwango, basire buna obonyansi basusane buna ebimeri ebibese.
swahili: kwa maana kama majani watanyauka mara, kama mimea ya kijani watakufa mara.

english: But the wicked and enemies of the LORD will perish like the glory of the fields. They will vanish; like smoke they will fade away.
ekegusii: Korende abakori amabe mbasirigwe; ababisa ba Omonene nigo bare buna obuya bw’ebisicha, nigo barasire, ee, mbasire buna erioki rigosira kegima.
swahili: Lakini waovu wataangamia: Adui za Bwana watakuwa kama uzuri wa mashamba, watatoweka, watatoweka kama moshi.

english: The wicked borrow and do not repay, but the righteous are gracious and giving.
ekegusii: Omokori amabe nigo akoira egento singo tagokeirania, korende omonto omooronge nigo are namaabera na korua ebiegwa,
swahili: Waovu hukopa na hawalipi, bali wenye haki hutoa kwa ukarimu.

english: Surely those He blesses will inherit the land, but the cursed will be destroyed.
ekegusii: Abanto abw’Omonene asesenirie mbaire ense ebe eyabo, korende abwo aragereirie mbasirigwe kegima.
swahili: Wale wanaobarikiwa na Bwana watairithi nchi, bali wale anaowalaani watakatiliwa mbali.

english: The steps of a man are ordered by the LORD who takes delight in his journey.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo akobeka orogendo rw’omonto omooronge chinguru, na kogokigwa nabarabwo.
swahili: Kama Bwana akipendezwa na njia ya mtu, yeye huimarisha hatua zake,

english: Though he falls, he will not be overwhelmed, for the LORD is holding his hand.
ekegusii: Omonto oyio naisa kogochwa, takogwa inse, ekiagera Omonene namobwatete okoboko kwaye.
swahili: ajapojikwaa, hataanguka, kwa maana Bwana humtegemeza kwa mkono wake.

english: I once was young and now am old, yet never have I seen the righteous abandoned or their children begging for bread.
ekegusii: Nigo narenge omwana, bono nagotire, korende tinana-korora omonto omooronge ogotigwa bosa, gose abana baye bakoborwa endagera.
swahili: Nilikuwa kijana na sasa ni mzee, lakini sijaona kamwe wenye haki wameachwa au watoto wao wakiombaomba chakula.

english: They are ever generous and quick to lend, and their children are a blessing.
ekegusii: Omonto oyio nigo akogenderera kona-korua ebiegwa na korua singo, abana baye nigo barasesenigwe.
swahili: Wakati wote ni wakarimu na hukopesha bila masharti. Watoto wao watabarikiwa.

english: Turn away from evil and do good, so that you will abide forever.
ekegusii: Tiga gokora amabe, kora ayare amaya, igo nario orachie kare.
swahili: Acha ubaya na utende wema, nawe utaishi katika nchi milele.

english: For the LORD loves justice and will not forsake His saints. They are preserved forever, but the offspring of the wicked will be cut off.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo anchete oboronge; tagotiga abachenu baye. Barabwo mbarendwe goika kare na kare, korende ororeria rw’abakori amabe ndosirigwe kegima.
swahili: Kwa kuwa Bwana huwapenda wenye haki naye hatawaacha waaminifu wake. Watalindwa milele, lakini uzao wa waovu utakatiliwa mbali.

english: The righteous will inherit the land and dwell in it forever.
ekegusii: Abanyene oboronge mbaire ense ebe eyabo, erio bagenderere komenyao botambe.
swahili: Wenye haki watairithi nchi, na kuishi humo milele.

english: Trust in the LORD and do good; dwell in the land and cultivate faithfulness.
ekegusii: Mosemerie Omonene okore ayare amaya, erio nario oramenye ase ense, obe korendire buya.
swahili: Mtumaini Bwana na utende yaliyo mema; Kaa katika nchi ukafurahie malisho salama.

english: The mouth of the righteous man utters wisdom, and his tongue speaks justice.
ekegusii: Omonwa bw’omonto omooronge nigo agokwana amang’ana yobong’aini, na oromeme rwaye nigo rogosokia ay’ekeene.
swahili: Kinywa cha mwenye haki hutamka hekima, nao ulimi wake huzungumza lililo haki.

english: The law of his God is in his heart; his steps do not falter.
ekegusii: Amachiiko a Nyasae oye nigo abeerete ase enkoro y’omonto oyio; ase agoeta tari gotererigwa.
swahili: Sheria ya Mungu wake imo moyoni mwake; nyayo zake hazitelezi.

english: Though the wicked lie in wait for the righteous, and seek to slay them,
ekegusii: Omokori amabe nigo agotengera omonto omooronge, erio origia chinchera chi’okomoita.
swahili: Watu waovu huvizia wenye haki, wakitafuta kuwaua;

english: the LORD will not leave them in their power or let them be condemned under judgment.
ekegusii: Omonene tagotiga omonto omooronge ase okobua kw’omokori amabe, gose takomotiga abugwe ekero asoeirwe ase ekegambero.
swahili: lakini Bwana hatawaacha mikononi mwao wala hatawaacha wahukumiwe kuwa wakosa wanaposhtakiwa.

english: Wait for the LORD and keep His way, and He will raise you up to inherit the land. When the wicked are cut off, you will see it.
ekegusii: Gany’Omonene na obwatie enchera yaye, nere nakoimokererie igoro akoe ense ebe eyao; erio norigererie orore buna abanyabibe bagosirigwa.
swahili: Mngojee Bwana, na uishike njia yake. Naye atakutukuza uirithi nchi, waovu watakapokatiliwa mbali, utaliona hilo.

english: I have seen a wicked, ruthless man flourishing like a well-rooted native tree,
ekegusii: Narorire omokori amabe otindire ase obomwenu, akaba okoranda buna emecharake egokina ase amaroba amatobu.
swahili: Nimemwona mtu mwovu na mkatili akistawi kama mwerezi wa Lebanoni,

english: yet he passed away and was no more; though I searched, he could not be found.
ekegusii: Magega y’amatuko amake ngaetera aase agwo, korende tarengeo, nkamorigia, korende tinamonyora aande.
swahili: lakini alitoweka mara na hakuonekana, ingawa nilimtafuta, hakupatikana.

english: Consider the blameless and observe the upright, for posterity awaits the man of peace.
ekegusii: Rigereria omonto omoikeranu, ee, origererie omonto ore nenkoro endonge, norore ng’a omonto ogokora omorembe nere orachie kare.
swahili: Watafakari watu wasio na hatia, wachunguze watu wakamilifu, kuna mafanikio kwa mtu apendaye amani.

english: But the transgressors will all be destroyed; the future of the wicked will be cut off.
ekegusii: Korende abasaria mbasirigwe bonsi pi, na ororeria rw’abakori amabe tirokogenderera.
swahili: Lakini watenda dhambi wote wataangamizwa, mafanikio yao yatakatiliwa mbali.

english: The salvation of the righteous is from the LORD; He is their stronghold in time of trouble.
ekegusii: Ogotooreka kw’abanyaboronge nigo gokorwa ase Omonene, ere nere obotamero bwabo ase chingaki chi’emechando.
swahili: Wokovu wa wenye haki hutoka kwa Bwana, yeye ni ngome yao wakati wa shida.

english: Delight yourself in the LORD, and He will give you the desires of your heart.
ekegusii: Goka ase Omonene, ere nakoe okogania gw’enkoro yao.
swahili: Jifurahishe katika Bwana naye atakupa haja za moyo wako.

english: The LORD helps and delivers them; He rescues and saves them from the wicked, because they take refuge in Him.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo akobakonya na kobatooria; nigo akobarusia korwa ase abakori amabe, obatooria, ekiagera bakomotamera.
swahili: Bwana huwasaidia na kuwaokoa, huwaokoa kutoka kwa waovu na kuwahifadhi, kwa maana wanamkimbilia.

english: Commit your way to the LORD; trust in Him, and He will do it.
ekegusii: Erue ase Omonene mosemerie ere bweka, nere naoboseemia.
swahili: Mkabidhi Bwana njia yako, mtumaini yeye, naye atatenda hili:

english: He will bring forth your righteousness like the dawn, your justice like the noonday sun.
ekegusii: Omonene naorokie oboronge bwao buna akoorokia oborabu, na ekeene kiao buna amasase a mobaso gati.
swahili: Yeye atafanya haki yako ingʼae kama mapambazuko, na hukumu ya shauri lako kama jua la adhuhuri.

english: Be still before the LORD and wait patiently for Him; do not fret when men prosper in their ways, when they carry out wicked schemes.
ekegusii: Obe n’obotoereru ase obosio bw’Omonene, omoganye noboremereria. Togechigwa nomonto okogenderera buya ase enchera yaye, omonto oyio okoroberia ogosaria.
swahili: Tulia mbele za Bwana na umngojee kwa uvumilivu; usisumbuke watu wanapofanikiwa katika njia zao, wanapotekeleza mipango yao miovu.

english: Refrain from anger and abandon wrath; do not fret—it can only bring harm.
ekegusii: Bwetange korwa ase endamwamu, tiga ekeririanda kegima. Togechigwa; okogechigwa nigo koragere okore ebibe.
swahili: Epuka hasira na uache ghadhabu, usihangaike: itakuongoza tu kutenda uovu.

english: For the evildoers will be cut off, but those who hope in the LORD will inherit the land.
ekegusii: Abanyabibe mbasirigwe kegima, korende abamoganyete Omonene mbaire ense ebe omwando obo.
swahili: Kwa maana waovu watakatiliwa mbali, bali wale wanaomtumaini Bwana watairithi nchi.

english: O LORD, do not rebuke me in Your anger or discipline me in Your wrath.
ekegusii: Omonene, tontogonyera ekero ore nendamwamu, tong’a egesusuro gi’okondongeyia ekero ore nekeririanda.
swahili: Ee Bwana, usinikemee katika hasira yako, wala kuniadhibu katika ghadhabu yako.

english: My heart pounds, my strength fails, and even the light of my eyes has faded.
ekegusii: Enkoro yane nigo egotiesana, chinguru chiang’ereire; amaiso aane asoirwe orotutu, tindi korora.
swahili: Moyo wangu unapigapiga, nguvu zangu zimeniishia; hata macho yangu yametiwa giza.

english: My beloved and friends shun my disease, and my kinsmen stand at a distance.
ekegusii: Abanchi na abasani baane babeereire aare korwa ase amaakwa aane, na abanto baminto boigo bambeereire aare.
swahili: Rafiki na wenzangu wananikwepa kwa sababu ya majeraha yangu; majirani zangu wanakaa mbali nami.

english: Those who seek my life lay snares; those who wish me harm speak destruction, plotting deceit all day long.
ekegusii: Abanto abwo baganetie gosiria obogima bwane bantegeire oboreba; na abwo baganetie gonkora bobe nigo bagokwana amang’ana ’ogosirigwa kwane, bakorengereria amang’ana yobong’ainereria omobaso boira.
swahili: Wale wanaotafuta uhai wangu wanatega mitego yao, wale ambao wangetaka kunidhuru huongea juu ya maangamizi yangu; hufanya shauri la hila mchana kutwa.

english: But like a deaf man, I do not hear; and like a mute man, I do not open my mouth.
ekegusii: Korende inche nabeire buna omotino, tindi koigwa, nabeire buna omonto rimama, tindi gokwana.
swahili: Mimi ni kama mtu kiziwi, asiyeweza kusikia, ni kama bubu, asiyeweza kufungua kinywa chake,

english: I am like a man who cannot hear, whose mouth offers no reply.
ekegusii: Ee, inche nabeire buna omonto otari koigwa, buna oyo omonwa oye otabwati amang’ana okoiraneria.
swahili: nimekuwa kama mtu asiyesikia, ambaye kinywa chake hakiwezi kutoa jibu.

english: I wait for You, O LORD; You will answer, O Lord my God.
ekegusii: Korende Omonene, naye nsemereretie. Omonene, Nyasae one, naye oranyare koiraneria.
swahili: Ee Bwana, ninakungojea wewe, Ee Bwana Mungu wangu, utajibu.

english: For I said, “Let them not gloat over me— those who taunt me when my foot slips.”
ekegusii: Nigo nkogosaba ng’a ababisa baane tibagokera emechando yane; na tibetogeria okogwa kwane.
swahili: Kwa kuwa nilisema, “Usiwaache wafurahie, wala wasijitukuze juu yangu mguu wangu unapoteleza.”

english: For I am ready to fall, and my pain is ever with me.
ekegusii: Inche nabeereire ang’e kogwa, na obororo bwane nigo bogendererete kobeera asende.
swahili: Kwa maana ninakaribia kuanguka, na maumivu yangu yananiandama siku zote.

english: Yes, I confess my iniquity; I am troubled by my sin.
ekegusii: Bono nigo nkoorokia ogosaria kwane, neitirie ase engencho y’ebibe biane.
swahili: Naungama uovu wangu, ninataabishwa na dhambi yangu.

english: Many are my enemies without cause, and many hate me without reason.
ekegusii: Ababisa baane nigo bare abagima, naende bare ne chinguru, abwo bangechete bosa nabange bare.
swahili: Wengi ni wale ambao ni adui zangu hodari, wale wanaonichukia bila sababu ni wengi.

english: For Your arrows have pierced me deeply, and Your hand has pressed down on me.
ekegusii: Kwandasire emegwe yao yasoeire ime yane, kwanyiyeirie inse nokoboko kwao.
swahili: Kwa kuwa mishale yako imenichoma, na mkono wako umenishukia.

english: Those who repay my good with evil attack me for pursuing the good.
ekegusii: Abwo bagoakana amabe ase amaya nigo babeire ababisa baane, ekiagera ngokora ayare amaya.
swahili: Wanaolipa maovu kwa wema wangu hunisingizia ninapofuata lililo jema.

english: Do not forsake me, O LORD; be not far from me, O my God.
ekegusii: Omonene, tontiga! Aye Nyasae one, tobaisa kombeera aare!
swahili: Ee Bwana, usiniache, usiwe mbali nami, Ee Mungu wangu.

english: Come quickly to help me, O Lord my Savior.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene ore ogotooreka kwane, ayerera onkonye!
swahili: Ee Bwana Mwokozi wangu, uje upesi kunisaidia.

english: There is no soundness in my body because of Your anger; there is no rest in my bones because of my sin.
ekegusii: Ase engencho y’ekeririanda kiao omobere one bwensi orwarire, nase engencho y’ebibe biane amauga aane nigo akonyatia.
swahili: Hakuna afya mwilini mwangu kwa sababu ya ghadhabu yako, mifupa yangu haina uzima kwa sababu ya dhambi zangu.

english: For my iniquities have overwhelmed me; they are a burden too heavy to bear.
ekegusii: Ebibe biane biantubire nonya nomotwe bwonsi, bianditoeire na kombua.
swahili: Maovu yangu yamenifunika kama mzigo usiochukulika.

english: My wounds are foul and festering because of my sinful folly.
ekegusii: Amaote aane agundire atiokire bobe ase engencho y’oboriri bwane.
swahili: Majeraha yangu yameoza na yananuka, kwa sababu ya upumbavu wa dhambi zangu.

english: I am bent and brought low; all day long I go about mourning.
ekegusii: Igo ng’umaime na koumata, nigo ingendererete korera na goichana omobaso boira.
swahili: Nimeinamishwa chini na kushushwa sana, mchana kutwa nazunguka nikiomboleza.

english: For my loins are full of burning pain, and no soundness remains in my body.
ekegusii: Chibachwa chiane nigo chikoyia buna omorero, omobere one bwonsi orwarire.
swahili: Viuno vyangu vimejaa maumivu yaunguzayo, hakuna afya mwilini mwangu.

english: I am numb and badly crushed; I groan in anguish of heart.
ekegusii: Chinguru chiane chionsi chiaerire, nasenyentekire, nigo nkona‐kweumia ase engencho y’obororo bw’enkoro yane.
swahili: Nimedhoofika na kupondwa kabisa, nasononeka kwa maumivu makuu ya moyoni.

english: O Lord, my every desire is before You; my groaning is not hidden from You.
ekegusii: Omonene, aye nigo omanyete okogania kwane gwonsi, na ogochandeka kwane tikobisekaneti asore.
swahili: Ee Bwana, yote ninayoyaonea shauku yako wazi mbele zako, kutamani kwangu sana hakufichiki mbele zako.

english: I said, “I will watch my ways so that I will not sin with my tongue; I will guard my mouth with a muzzle as long as the wicked are present.”
ekegusii: Ngateeba: “Nindende orogendo rwane, timbaisa gokora ebibe ekero ngokwana. Nimbeke omonwa one ekeokio ekero abakori amabe bare ase obosio bwane.”
swahili: Nilisema, “Nitaziangalia njia zangu na kuuzuia ulimi wangu usije ukatenda dhambi; nitaweka lijamu kinywani mwangu wakati wote waovu wanapokuwa karibu nami.”

english: Remove Your scourge from me; I am perishing by the force of Your hand.
ekegusii: Rusia egesusuro kiao asende; naerire ase ogoakwa gw’okoboko kwao.
swahili: Niondolee mjeledi wako, nimeshindwa kwa mapigo ya mkono wako.

english: You discipline and correct a man for his iniquity, consuming like a moth what he holds dear; surely each man is but a vapor. Selah
ekegusii: Ekero okorongeyia omonto ase okomotogonyera ase engencho y’ebibe, nigo ogosiria obonene bwaye, koreng’ana buna ebigwankwa bikoria chianga. Amaene, Mwanyabaanto nigo anga buna omwaga.
swahili: Unakemea na kuadhibu wanadamu kwa ajili ya dhambi zao; unaharibu utajiri wao kama nondo aharibuvyo: kila mwanadamu ni kama pumzi tu.

english: Hear my prayer, O LORD, and give ear to my cry for help; do not be deaf to my weeping. For I am a foreigner dwelling with You, a stranger like all my fathers.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, igwa ogosaba kwane, otegerere okorera kwane; tokira‐kiri ekero nkoiyeria amariga, ekiagera inche nomogeni oo inde, na omoeti buna chisokoro chiane chiarenge.
swahili: “Ee Bwana, usikie maombi yangu, usikie kilio changu unisaidie, usiwe kiziwi kwa kulia kwangu. Kwani mimi ninaishi na wewe kama mgeni, kama walivyokuwa baba zangu wote,

english: Turn Your gaze away from me, that I may again be cheered before I depart and am no more.”
ekegusii: Intige, inyore chinguru chinyia ntararua ase ense, na ntabeo naende.
swahili: Tazama mbali nami, ili niweze kufurahi tena kabla sijaondoka na nisiwepo tena.”

english: I was speechless and still; I remained silent, even from speaking good, and my sorrow was stirred.
ekegusii: Igo narenge nkirete‐kiri, tinare gokwana, tinaba na koremigwa konde, obororo bwane bokamenteka mono,
swahili: Lakini niliponyamaza kimya na kutulia, hata pasipo kusema lolote jema, uchungu wangu uliongezeka.

english: My heart grew hot within me; as I mused, the fire burned. Then I spoke with my tongue:
ekegusii: enkoro yane ekaba ekoyia omorero ime yane. Ekero naare ndengereretie aya, omorero ogoka, tinare konyara gwetanga ogokwana kwane.
swahili: Moyo wangu ulipata moto ndani yangu, nilipotafakari, moto uliwaka, ndipo nikasema kwa ulimi wangu:

english: “Show me, O LORD, my end and the measure of my days. Let me know how fleeting my life is.
ekegusii: Omonene, imanyie omoerio bw’amatuko aane, na ekerengo ki’amatuko aane naki keng’ana, erinde imanye ng’a obogima bwane nobweng’e.
swahili: “Ee Bwana, nijulishe mwisho wa maisha yangu na hesabu ya siku zangu; nijalie kujua jinsi maisha yangu yanavyopita upesi.

english: You, indeed, have made my days as handbreadths, and my lifetime as nothing before You. Truly each man at his best exists as but a breath. Selah
ekegusii: Naama! Amatuko kwang’ete nameng’e mono. Engaki y’obogima bwane nigo ere buna teri gento ase obosio bwao. Amaene, kera omonto, nonya bwetenenerete bokong’u, nigo agoeta bwango buna omwaga.
swahili: Umefanya maisha yangu mafupi kama pumzi; muda wangu wa kuishi ni kama hauna thamani kwako. Maisha ya kila mwanadamu ni kama pumzi.

english: Surely every man goes about like a phantom; surely he bustles in vain; he heaps up riches not knowing who will haul them away.
ekegusii: Amaene, Mwanyabaanto nigo agotaara ore buna omogwekano okorora ase okorota; nigo agwechanda bosa; asangereria enibo, korende tamanyeti gose ning’o orache koyeria.
swahili: Hakika kila binadamu ni kama njozi aendapo huku na huko: hujishughulisha na mengi lakini ni ubatili; anakusanya mali nyingi, wala hajui ni nani atakayeifaidi.

english: And now, O Lord, for what do I wait? My hope is in You.
ekegusii: Nabono aye Omonene, inki nganyete? Naye bweka nsemeretie.
swahili: “Lakini sasa Bwana, nitafute nini? Tumaini langu ni kwako.

english: Deliver me from all my transgressions; do not make me the reproach of fools.
ekegusii: Ntoorie korwa ase ogosaria kwane, tontiga nsekererwe noyio ore omoriri.
swahili: Niokoe kutoka kwenye makosa yangu yote, usinifanye kuwa dhihaka ya wapumbavu.

english: I have become mute; I do not open my mouth because of what You have done.
ekegusii: Nigo nkirete‐kiri, tindi komumora omonwa one, ekiagera aye naye gwakorete ayio.
swahili: Nilinyamaza kimya, sikufumbua kinywa changu, kwa sababu wewe ndiwe uliyetenda hili.

english: O LORD, how my foes have increased! How many rise up against me!
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ababisa baane mbarenga bare! Abange banyimokeire gonkorera bobe.
swahili: Ee Bwana, tazama adui zangu walivyo wengi! Ni wengi kiasi gani wanaoinuka dhidi yangu!

english: Many say of me, “God will not deliver him.” Selah
ekegusii: Abange nigo bagokwana igoro yane, bateeba: Nyasae tancheti komotooria.
swahili: Wengi wanasema juu yangu, “Mungu hatamwokoa.”

english: But You, O LORD, are a shield around me, my glory, and the One who lifts my head.
ekegusii: Korende aye Omonene, aye naye enguba yane, na naye obonene bwane, nigo okong’iraneria oboremu bw’obobui bwane.
swahili: Lakini wewe, Ee Bwana, ni ngao pande zote; umeniwekea utukufu na kuinua kichwa changu.

english: To the LORD I cry aloud, and He answers me from His holy mountain. Selah
ekegusii: Nigo nkorera na gokuura ase Omonene ng’a ankonye, nere nigo akong’iraneria korwa ase egetunwa kiaye egechenu.
swahili: Ninamlilia Bwana kwa sauti kuu, naye ananijibu kutoka mlima wake mtakatifu.

english: I lie down and sleep; I wake again, for the LORD sustains me.
ekegusii: Nigo ngwetoora na korara chitoro, erio naboka naende, ekiagera Omonene nigo agendererete kondenda.
swahili: Ninajilaza na kupata usingizi; naamka tena, kwa maana Bwana hunitegemeza.

english: I will not fear the myriads set against me on every side.
ekegusii: Tindi koiroka ababisa chilifu chinyinge, abwo mamincha yane, bakondia korwa chinsemo chiane chionsi.
swahili: Sitaogopa makumi elfu ya adui, wanaojipanga dhidi yangu kila upande.

english: Arise, O LORD! Save me, O my God! Strike all my enemies on the jaw; break the teeth of the wicked.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene imoka, gaki, inchwo! Aye Nyasae one, ntoorie! Aye gwaakire ababisa baane bonsi oroe ase chinsea chiabo, kwabunire amaino ’abakori amabe kwabakorire bosa.
swahili: Ee Bwana, amka! Niokoe, Ee Mungu wangu! Wapige adui zangu wote kwenye taya, vunja meno ya waovu.

english: Salvation belongs to the LORD; may Your blessing be on Your people. Selah
ekegusii: Ogotooreka nigo gokorwa asore aye bweka Omonene; ase ayio, sesenia abanto bao.
swahili: Kwa maana wokovu watoka kwa Bwana. Baraka yako na iwe juu ya watu wako.

english: I waited patiently for the LORD; He inclined to me and heard my cry.
ekegusii: Nkaba imoganyete Omonene ase okoremereria, na ere akanyeonchorera akaigwa ekerero kiane.
swahili: Nilimngoja Bwana kwa saburi, naye akaniinamia, akasikia kilio changu.

english: I have not covered up Your righteousness in my heart; I have declared Your faithfulness and salvation; I have not concealed Your loving devotion and faithfulness from the great assembly.
ekegusii: Tinyegachereti inche bweka oboronge bwao ase enkoro yane ime; korende nararirie obwegenwa bwao, na ogotooreka kwao. Timbiseti obuya bwao, na obwegenwa bwao, korwa ase omosangererekano omonene.
swahili: Sikuficha haki yako moyoni mwangu; ninasema juu ya uaminifu wako na wokovu wako. Sikuficha upendo wako na kweli yako mbele ya kusanyiko kubwa.

english: O LORD, do not withhold Your mercy from me; Your loving devotion and faithfulness will always guard me.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, tondina amaabera ao! Obuya na obwegenwa bwao bindende botambe. Ogosaba gw’okonyora ooboseemiaka (Zab 70)
swahili: Ee Bwana, usizuilie huruma zako, upendo wako na kweli yako daima vinilinde.

english: For evils without number surround me; my sins have overtaken me, so that I cannot see. They are more than the hairs of my head, and my heart has failed within me.
ekegusii: Amabe amange atari kobareka nigo ang’etanaine. Ebibe biane biambuire, goika tinkonyara korora; biabeire ebinge kobua etukia y’omotwe one, goika nerusirie moyo.
swahili: Kwa maana taabu zisizo na hesabu zimenizunguka, dhambi zangu zimenikamata, hata nisiweze kuona. Zimekuwa nyingi kuliko nywele za kichwa changu, nao moyo unazimia ndani yangu.

english: Be pleased, O LORD, to deliver me; hurry, O LORD, to help me.
ekegusii: Omonene, koranche ontoorie! Omonene, oche bwango onkonye!
swahili: Ee Bwana, uwe radhi kuniokoa; Ee Bwana, njoo hima unisaidie.

english: May those who seek my life be ashamed and confounded; may those who wish me harm be repelled and humiliated.
ekegusii: Abwo bonsi barigetie kong’ita, tiga basookigwe na batantanigwe bonsi amo, na abwo baganetie obobe bonyore, tiga bairanigwe magega barore obosooku.
swahili: Wote wanaotafuta kuuondoa uhai wangu, waaibishwe na kufadhaishwa; wote wanaotamani kuangamizwa kwangu, warudishwe nyuma kwa aibu.

english: May those who say to me, “Aha, aha!” be appalled at their own shame.
ekegusii: Abwo bagonsiereria bagoteeba: “Kiamonyorire!” Tiga bakirigwe‐kiri ase obosooku bwabo.
swahili: Wale waniambiao, “Aha! Aha!” wafadhaishwe na iwe aibu yao.

english: May all who seek You rejoice and be glad in You; may those who love Your salvation always say, “The LORD be magnified!”
ekegusii: Korende abwo bonsi bagokorigia, tiga bakogokere na kogochengera; abwo banchete ogotooreka kwao bateebe botambe, “Omonene nigo are omonene!”
swahili: Lakini wote wakutafutao washangilie na kukufurahia, wale wapendao wokovu wako siku zote waseme, “ Bwana atukuzwe!”

english: But I am poor and needy; may the Lord think of me. You are my helper and deliverer; O my God, do not delay.
ekegusii: Inche nigo inde omotaka na omoremerwa, korende Omonene nigo akonyechandera. Naye ore ogokonywa kwane, na ogotooreka kwane. Aye Nyasae one, totebana!
swahili: Lakini bado mimi ni maskini na mhitaji; Bwana na anifikirie. Wewe ndiwe msaada wangu na Mwokozi wangu; Ee Mungu wangu, usikawie.

english: He lifted me up from the pit of despair, out of the miry clay; He set my feet upon a rock, and made my footsteps firm.
ekegusii: Ere akandusia korwa ase engoro y’obosareku, korwa ase etintira na esike; agatenenia amagoro aane ase egetare igoro, agankong’ia ase ngoeta.
swahili: Akanipandisha kutoka shimo la uharibifu, kutoka matope na utelezi; akaiweka miguu yangu juu ya mwamba na kunipa mahali imara pa kusimama.

english: He put a new song in my mouth, a hymn of praise to our God. Many will see and fear and put their trust in the LORD.
ekegusii: Akanyorokereria oteera ogoteera okoyia, ogoteera gw’okomotogia Nyasae oito. Abange nabayarore na koiroka, na igo mbamosemerie Omonene.
swahili: Akaweka wimbo mpya kinywani mwangu, wimbo wa sifa kwa Mungu wetu. Wengi wataona na kuogopa na kuweka tumaini lao kwa Bwana.

english: Blessed is the man who has made the LORD his trust, who has not turned to the proud, nor to those who lapse into falsehood.
ekegusii: Nasesenirie omonto oria omosemeretie Omonene, otari kweonchora gochia ase abanto abaenenu, gose ase abwo bagosira ase okoonchokera chinyasae chi’oborimo.
swahili: Heri mtu yule amfanyaye Bwana kuwa tumaini lake, asiyewategemea wenye kiburi, wale wenye kugeukia miungu ya uongo.

english: Many, O LORD my God, are the wonders You have done, and the plans You have for us— none can compare to You— if I proclaim and declare them, they are more than I can count.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, Nyasae one, ogokora kwao na ebirengererio biao ase tore nebi’ogokumia; onde tari orareng’anigwe naye. Ninganetie koraria ayio na koyakwana, korende namange mono, takobareka.
swahili: Ee Bwana Mungu wangu, umefanya mambo mengi ya ajabu. Mambo uliyopanga kwa ajili yetu hakuna awezaye kukuhesabia; kama ningesema na kuyaelezea, yangekuwa mengi mno kuyaelezea.

english: Sacrifice and offering You did not desire, but my ears You have opened. Burnt offerings and sin offerings You did not require.
ekegusii: Ebing’wanso na ebiruegwa tobiganeti, korende amato aane kwayatinoire. Ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa, na ebi’ebibe tobiganeti.
swahili: Dhabihu na sadaka hukuvitaka, lakini umefungua masikio yangu; sadaka za kuteketezwa na sadaka za dhambi hukuzihitaji.

english: Then I said, “Here I am, I have come— it is written about me in the scroll:
ekegusii: Erio ngateeba: “Rigereria, nachire; ase egetabu nigo eriikire aya ngwenerete gokora.
swahili: Ndipo niliposema, “Mimi hapa, nimekuja: imeandikwa kunihusu katika kitabu.

english: I delight to do Your will, O my God; Your law is within my heart.”
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae one, ninganetie nkore ogwancha kwao, amachiiko ao nigo are ase enkoro yane ime.”
swahili: Ee Mungu wangu, natamani kuyafanya mapenzi yako; sheria yako iko ndani ya moyo wangu.”

english: I proclaim righteousness in the great assembly; behold, I do not seal my lips, as You, O LORD, do know.
ekegusii: Ase omosangererekano omonene narandirie amang’ana amaya ay’oboronge; aye Omonene, nomanyete ng’a tingotanga ebikoba biane tibiyakwana.
swahili: Nimehubiri haki katika kusanyiko kubwa, sikufunga mdomo wangu, Ee Bwana, kama ujuavyo.

english: Blessed is the one who cares for the poor; the LORD will deliver him in the day of trouble.
ekegusii: Nasesenirie omonto oyo ogwechandera abataka. Ekero aranyorwe nemechando, Omonene namokonye.
swahili: Heri mtu yule anayemjali mnyonge, Bwana atamwokoa wakati wa shida.

english: But You, O LORD, be gracious to me and raise me up, that I may repay them.
ekegusii: Omonene, ndorera amaabera, ngwenie, erinde ing’akane ababisa baane obobe bwabo.
swahili: Lakini wewe, Ee Bwana, nihurumie, ukaniinue tena, ili niweze kuwalipiza kisasi.

english: By this I know that You delight in me, for my enemy does not triumph over me.
ekegusii: Ababisa baane tibagochenga igoro yane. Ase ayio nimanye ng’a aye nogokirie nainche.
swahili: Najua kwamba wapendezwa nami, kwa kuwa adui yangu hanishindi.

english: In my integrity You uphold me and set me in Your presence forever.
ekegusii: Aye gwankonyire, ekiagera tindi na komocha, kwambekire gotenena ase obosio bwao kogenderera botambe.
swahili: Katika uadilifu wangu unanitegemeza na kuniweka kwenye uwepo wako milele.

english: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting. Amen and Amen.
ekegusii: Omonene Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, atogigwe, buna yarenge korwa kare nabo erabe goika kare na kare. Amina. Amina.
swahili: Msifuni Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli, tangu milele na hata milele. Amen na Amen.

english: The LORD will protect and preserve him; He will bless him in the land and refuse to surrender him to the will of his foes.
ekegusii: Omonene amorende na komokorera agenderere koba moyo, erinde arokwe oyosesenirie ase ense. Omonene tagotiga ababisa bamokorere buna banchete.
swahili: Bwana atamlinda na kuyahifadhi maisha yake, atambariki katika nchi na hatamwacha katika tamaa ya adui zake.

english: The LORD will sustain him on his bed of illness and restore him from his bed of sickness.
ekegusii: Omonene namorende ekero are borere arwarete, namogusuerie oborwaire bwaye.
swahili: Bwana atamtegemeza awapo mgonjwa kitandani, atamwinua kutoka kitandani mwake.

english: I said, “O LORD, be gracious to me; heal me, for I have sinned against You.”
ekegusii: Inche nigo nateebete: “Omonene, indorera amaabera, ingwenie omoyo one, ekiagera nakorire ebibe asore.”
swahili: Nilisema, “Ee Bwana nihurumie, niponye, maana nimekutenda dhambi wewe.”

english: My enemies say with malice: “When will he die and be forgotten?”
ekegusii: Ababisa baane nigo bagokwana amang’ana amabe igoro yane, bateba, “Omonto oyo indi arakwe na erieta riaye riebwe kegima?”
swahili: Adui zangu wanasema kwa hila, “Lini atakufa, na jina lake litokomee kabisa.”

english: My visitor speaks falsehood; he gathers slander in his heart; he goes out and spreads it abroad.
ekegusii: Onde bwensi ogocha kondora nigo agokwana amang’ana yoborimo, enkoro yaye nigo egosangereria amabe, erio ogenda isiko oraria amang’ana ayio amabe.
swahili: Kila anapokuja mtu kunitazama, huzungumza uongo, huku moyo wake hukusanya masingizio; kisha huondoka na kuyasambaza huku na huko.

english: All who hate me whisper against me; they imagine the worst for me:
ekegusii: Abwo bonsi bangechete nigo bakomonyererana igoro yane, nigo bakorire omooroberio bw’ogonkora bobe.
swahili: Adui zangu wote hunongʼonezana dhidi yangu, hao huniwazia mabaya sana, wakisema,

english: “A vile disease has been poured into him; he will never get up from where he lies!”
ekegusii: Barabwo nigo bagoteeba: “Noborwaire boramoite bwamonyorire, takoboka naende korwa ase araire”.
swahili: “Ugonjwa mbaya sana umempata, kamwe hatainuka tena kitandani mwake.”

english: Even my close friend whom I trusted, the one who shared my bread, has lifted up his heel against me.
ekegusii: Nonya nomosani one negenete, tware koragera komo, ong’akire chintacho.
swahili: Hata rafiki yangu wa karibu niliyemwamini, yule aliyekula chakula changu ameniinulia kisigino chake.

english: As the deer pants for streams of water, so my soul longs after You, O God.
ekegusii: Buna koreng’ana engabi ekogania amaache a rooche, naboigo omoyo one okoganetie aye Nyasae.
swahili: Kama vile ayala aoneavyo shauku vijito vya maji, ndivyo nafsi yangu ikuoneavyo shauku, Ee Mungu.

english: Like the crushing of my bones, my enemies taunt me, while they say to me all day long, “Where is your God?”
ekegusii: Ekero ababisa baane bagonchecheria, nigo nkoigwa buna amauga aane akonyatia. Nigo bagendererete kona‐komboria, “Nyasae oo, ng’ai are?”
swahili: Mifupa yangu inateseka kwa maumivu makali adui zangu wanaponidhihaki, wakiniambia mchana kutwa, “Yuko wapi Mungu wako?”

english: Why are you downcast, O my soul? Why the unease within me? Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise Him, my Savior and my God.
ekegusii: Aye omoyo one, nase ki kwabeire nomoichano omonene? Nase ki otari n’obotoereru? Semeria Nyasae! Igo ninyare komotogia naende ere oyore ogotooreka kwane, na Nyasae one.
swahili: Ee nafsi yangu, kwa nini unasononeka? Kwa nini unafadhaika hivyo ndani yangu? Weka tumaini lako kwa Mungu, kwa sababu bado nitamsifu, Mwokozi wangu na Mungu wangu.

english: My soul thirsts for God, the living God. When shall I come and appear in God’s presence?
ekegusii: Omoyo one nigo ore nerang’o asore aye Nyasae ore moyo. Ndiriri ndachiche ndore obosio bwao, aye Nyasae?
swahili: Nafsi yangu inamwonea Mungu kiu, Mungu aliye hai. Ni lini nitaweza kwenda kukutana na Mungu?

english: My tears have been my food both day and night, while men ask me all day long, “Where is your God?”
ekegusii: Omobaso na obotuko nigo nkorera, na amariga abeire endagera yane; botambe abanto nigo bakomboria: “Nyasae oo ng’ai are?”
swahili: Machozi yangu yamekuwa chakula changu usiku na mchana, huku watu wakiniambia mchana kutwa, “Yuko wapi Mungu wako?”

english: These things come to mind as I pour out my soul: how I walked with the multitude, leading the procession to the house of God with shouts of joy and praise.
ekegusii: Nigo nkoumora ayare ase omoyo one ime, ekero nkoinyora amang’ana aetire, buna narenge kogenda amo nomoganda bw’abaanto gochia ase enyomba ya Nyasae, nkaba ngotera nomogooko neriogi rinene na koiraneria ng’a mbuya mono amo nabwo barenge koinyora na korenda Rituko Rinene.
swahili: Mambo haya nayakumbuka ninapoimimina nafsi yangu: Jinsi nilivyokuwa nikienda na umati wa watu, nikiongoza maandamano kuelekea kwenye nyumba ya Mungu, kwa kelele za shangwe na za shukrani katikati ya umati uliosherehekea.

english: Why are you downcast, O my soul? Why the unease within me? Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise Him for the salvation of His presence.
ekegusii: Aye omoyo one, nase ki kwabeire nomoichano? Nase ki otari n’obotoereru? Semeria Nyasae! Igo ninyare komotogia naende ase ogotooreka gokorwa ase obosio bwaye.
swahili: Ee nafsi yangu, kwa nini unasononeka? Kwa nini unafadhaika hivyo ndani yangu? Weka tumaini lako kwa Mungu, kwa sababu bado nitamsifu, Mwokozi wangu na

english: O my God, my soul despairs within me. Therefore I remember You from the land of Jordan and the peaks of Hermon— even from Mount Mizar.
ekegusii: Nyasae one, enkoro yane yabeire nomoichano, ase ayio, nakoinyoire ekero inde ase ense ya Yorodani, na ase egetunwa kia Herimoni na ekia Misari.
swahili: Mungu wangu. Nafsi yangu inasononeka ndani yangu; kwa hiyo nitakukumbuka kutoka nchi ya Yordani, katika vilele vya Hermoni, kutoka Mlima Mizari.

english: Deep calls to deep in the roar of Your waterfalls; all Your breakers and waves have rolled over me.
ekegusii: Endiba y’amaache nigo ekorangeria endiba ende, ekero amaache ’ebieera akoeera; chiooro chiao chionsi na emerindo yao biantubire.
swahili: Kilindi huita kilindi, katika ngurumo za maporomoko ya maji yako; mawimbi yako yote pamoja na viwimbi vimepita juu yangu.

english: The LORD decrees His loving devotion by day, and at night His song is with me as a prayer to the God of my life.
ekegusii: Ase omobaso Omonene nigo akong’a obwanchani bwaye botari koera, na ase obotuko nigo nkomotogia namatera na gosaba Nyasae oyore obogima bwane.
swahili: Mchana Bwana huelekeza upendo wake, usiku wimbo wake uko nami: maombi kwa Mungu wa uzima wangu.

english: I say to God my Rock, “Why have You forgotten me? Why must I walk in sorrow because of the enemy’s oppression?”
ekegusii: Nigo ngotebia Nyasae ore egetare kiane, “Nase ki aye kwanyebire? Nase ki ngendererete korera ngochandwa nababisa baane?”
swahili: Ninamwambia Mungu Mwamba wangu, “Kwa nini umenisahau? Kwa nini niendelee kuomboleza, nikiwa nimeonewa na adui?”

english: Vindicate me, O God, and plead my case against an ungodly nation; deliver me from deceitful and unjust men.
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, ing’a oboronge bwane, ndwanerere nkonye korwa ase abanto batakoirogeti, ntoorie korwa ase abanto abang’ainereria, abatari abanyakeene.
swahili: Ee Mungu unihukumu, nitetee dhidi ya taifa lisilomcha Mungu, niokoe na watu wadanganyifu na waovu.

english: For You are the God of my refuge. Why have You rejected me? Why must I walk in sorrow because of the enemy’s oppression?
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae ore obotamero bwane, naki gwantigire? Ninki gekogera inche ngendererete kweumia, na ababisa baane bagendererete gonkorera bobe?
swahili: Wewe ni Mungu ngome yangu. Kwa nini umenikataa? Kwa nini niendelee kuomboleza, nikiwa nimeonewa na adui?

english: Send out Your light and Your truth; let them lead me. Let them bring me to Your holy mountain, and to the place where You dwell.
ekegusii: Ntomere oborabu bwao, na ekeene kiao, binyare kondaa, na kong’ikia ase egetunwa kiao egechenu kere obomenyo bwao.
swahili: Tuma hima nuru yako na kweli yako na viniongoze; vinilete mpaka mlima wako mtakatifu, mpaka mahali unapoishi.

english: Then I will go to the altar of God, to God, my greatest joy. I will praise You with the harp, O God, my God.
ekegusii: Erio ngende ase egesasiimero kiao, aye Nyasae, Nyasae, aye oyore omogooko one omonene, nimbugie obokano na goteera ogoteera gw’okogotogia, aye Nyasae ore Nyasae one.
swahili: Ndipo nitakwenda madhabahuni pa Mungu, kwa Mungu, furaha yangu na shangwe yangu. Nitakusifu kwa kinubi, Ee Mungu, Mungu wangu.

english: Why are you downcast, O my soul? Why the unease within me? Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise Him, my Savior and my God.
ekegusii: Aye omoyo one, nase ki kwabeire nomoichano omonene? Nase ki otari n’obotoereru? Semeria Nyasae, ekiagera ninyare komotogia naende ere oyore ogotooreka kwane, na Nyasae one.
swahili: Ee nafsi yangu, kwa nini unasononeka? Kwa nini unafadhaika hivyo ndani yangu? Weka tumaini lako kwa Mungu, kwa sababu bado nitamsifu Mwokozi wangu na Mungu wangu.

english: We have heard with our ears, O God; our fathers have told us the work You did in their days, in the days of old.
ekegusii: Nyasae, intwe tweigwereire namato aito, chisokoro chiaito nchiatotebetie amang’ana gwakorete ase amatuko a kare.
swahili: Ee Mungu, tumesikia kwa masikio yetu, baba zetu wametueleza yale uliyotenda katika siku zao, siku za kale.

english: You have made us retreat from the foe, and those who hate us have plundered us.
ekegusii: Gwatokorire gotama ababisa baito, na barabwo babeire bagosakora ebinto biaito.
swahili: Umetufanya turudi nyuma mbele ya adui, nao watesi wetu wametuteka nyara.

english: You have given us up as sheep to be devoured; You have scattered us among the nations.
ekegusii: Aye kwarure ribaga toriegwe buna ching’ondi chikoriegwa, gwatosiareire gochia ase abanto b’ebisaku.
swahili: Umetuacha tutafunwe kama kondoo na umetutawanya katika mataifa.

english: You sell Your people for nothing; no profit do You gain from their sale.
ekegusii: Aye kwaoonirie abanto bao ase rigori risinini mono; tikwababeekerete rigori rinene.
swahili: Umewauza watu wako kwa fedha kidogo, wala hukupata faida yoyote kwa mauzo yao.

english: You have made us a reproach to our neighbors, a mockery and derision to those around us.
ekegusii: Gwatokorire koba okogechia ase abanto baito; twabeire togochaywa na gosekererwa nabaanto batoetanaine.
swahili: Umetufanya lawama kwa jirani zetu, dharau na dhihaka kwa wale wanaotuzunguka.

english: You have made us a byword among the nations, a laughingstock among the peoples.
ekegusii: Gwatokorire koba omorabaaro ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku, twabeire togosingiserigwa emetwe nabaanto.
swahili: Umetufanya kuwa mithali miongoni mwa mataifa, mataifa hutikisa vichwa vyao.

english: All day long my disgrace is before me, and shame has covered my face,
ekegusii: Ogochaywa kwane nigo kogendererete asende omobaso boira, na obosooku bwatubire obosio bwane
swahili: Fedheha yangu iko mbele yangu mchana kutwa, na uso wangu umejaa aibu tele,

english: at the voice of the scorner and reviler, because of the enemy, bent on revenge.
ekegusii: ekero nkoigwa amang’ana ’abagonchecheria na gonkwana bobe, na ekero nkorora obosio bw’omobisa na obw’oyo okorusia egesiomba.
swahili: kwa ajili ya dhihaka ya wale wanaonilaumu na kunitukana, kwa sababu ya adui, ambaye anatamani kulipiza kisasi.

english: All this has come upon us, though we have not forgotten You or betrayed Your covenant.
ekegusii: Amang’ana aya onsi atonyorire, nonya intwe titoraba togokweba, gose titorasaria okobwatana kwao kw’ogotianania.
swahili: Hayo yote yametutokea, ingawa tulikuwa hatujakusahau wala hatujaenda kinyume na agano lako.

english: Our hearts have not turned back; our steps have not strayed from Your path.
ekegusii: Chinkoro chiaito tichionchogeti chigotige, gose titotigeti kobwatia enchera yao,
swahili: Mioyo yetu ilikuwa haijarudi nyuma; nyayo zetu zilikuwa hazijaiacha njia yako.

english: But You have crushed us in the lair of jackals; You have covered us with deepest darkness.
ekegusii: erinde otoake na gototuguta ase chisese chi’orosana chimenyete, gose gototuba ekiriri ki’amakweri.
swahili: Lakini ulituponda na kutufanya makao ya mbweha, na ukatufunika kwa giza nene.

english: With Your hand You drove out the nations and planted our fathers there; You crushed the peoples and cast them out.
ekegusii: Aye omonyene nigo gwaseretie abanto b’ebisaku nokoboko kwao, korende chisokoro chiaito okabarenta okabasimeka aroro; nigo kwarentete emechando ase abanto b’ebisaku, korende chisokoro chiaito okabamentekania bakaranda.
swahili: Kwa mkono wako uliwafukuza mataifa na ukawapanda baba zetu, uliangamiza mataifa na kuwastawisha baba zetu.

english: If we had forgotten the name of our God or spread out our hands to a foreign god,
ekegusii: Onye ntwebire erieta ria Nyasae oito, gose ntwaramboire amaboko aito ase ogosasiima enyasae ende eng’ao.
swahili: Kama tungalikuwa tumelisahau jina la Mungu wetu au kunyooshea mikono yetu kwa mungu mgeni,

english: would not God have discovered, since He knows the secrets of the heart?
ekegusii: Inee, Nyasae tari komanya amang’ana ayio? Ere nigo amanyete obobisi bwonsi bore ime ase enkoro.
swahili: je, Mungu hangaligundua hili, kwa kuwa anazijua siri za moyo?

english: Yet for Your sake we face death all day long; we are considered as sheep to be slaughtered.
ekegusii: Korende ase engencho yao nigo togoitwa omobaso boira, nigo tokobarwa buna ching’ondi chikonyenywa.
swahili: Hata hivyo kwa ajili yako tunauawa mchana kutwa; tumehesabiwa kama kondoo wa kuchinjwa.

english: Wake up, O Lord! Why are You sleeping? Arise! Do not reject us forever.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, boka oimokerere igoro? Nase ki oraire? Boka, tototuguta kegima!
swahili: Amka, Ee Bwana! Kwa nini unalala? Zinduka! Usitukatae milele.

english: Why do You hide Your face and forget our affliction and oppression?
ekegusii: Nase ki aye kwabisire obosio bwao korwa ase tore? Nase ki aye kwebire emechando yaito na ogokorerwa bobe gwaito?
swahili: Kwa nini unauficha uso wako na kusahau taabu na mateso yetu?

english: For our soul has sunk to the dust; our bodies cling to the earth.
ekegusii: Amaene, emioyo yaito yaiyerigwe inse ase orotu, emebere yaito yabwateranigwe inse ase riroba.
swahili: Tumeshushwa hadi mavumbini, miili yetu imegandamana na ardhi.

english: Rise up; be our help! Redeem us on account of Your loving devotion.
ekegusii: Imokerera igoro, ochiche otokonye! Ototoorie ase engencho y’obwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe.
swahili: Inuka na utusaidie, utukomboe kwa sababu ya upendo wako usio na mwisho.

english: For it was not by their sword that they took the land; their arm did not bring them victory. It was by Your right hand, Your arm, and the light of Your face, because You favored them.
ekegusii: Abanto bao tibairete ense eria ase okoyerwania nemioro, gose tari chinguru chi’amaboko abo chiabarenterete obobui, korende nokoboko kwao gw’okorio ne chinguru chi’amaboko ao, amo noborabu bwaruete ase obosio bwao, ekiagera aye nigo kwagogetigwe nabarabwo.
swahili: Sio kwa upanga wao waliipata nchi, wala si mkono wao uliwapatia ushindi; ilikuwa ni kitanga cha mkono wako wa kuume, na nuru ya uso wako, kwa kuwa uliwapenda.

english: You are my King, O God, who ordains victories for Jacob.
ekegusii: Aye naye omorwoti one, na Nyasae one, ase ayio, chiika ng’a abanto b’ororeria rwa Yakobo baegwe obobui.
swahili: Wewe ni mfalme wangu na Mungu wangu, unayeamuru ushindi kwa Yakobo.

english: Through You we repel our foes; through Your name we trample our enemies.
ekegusii: Ase chinguru chiao nigo toraiyerie inse ababisa baito; goetera ase erieta riao nigo toratiringere inse abwo bagocha gotorwania esegi.
swahili: Kwa uwezo wako tunawasukuma nyuma watesi wetu; kwa jina lako tunawakanyaga adui zetu.

english: For I do not trust in my bow, nor does my sword save me.
ekegusii: Inche tinsemeretie obota bwane; gose omoro one tong’a obobui.
swahili: Siutumaini upinde wangu, upanga wangu hauniletei ushindi;

english: For You save us from our enemies; You put those who hate us to shame.
ekegusii: Korende naye gwatoete obobui igoro y’ababisa baito, abwo batogechete nigo kwabasoogetie.
swahili: bali wewe unatupa ushindi juu ya adui zetu, unawaaibisha watesi wetu.

english: In God we have boasted all day long, and Your name we will praise forever. Selah
ekegusii: Intwe ntogenderere gwetogia asore aye Nyasae, ntobe tokoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono ase erieta riao kogenderera botambe.
swahili: Katika Mungu wetu tunajivuna mchana kutwa, nasi tutalisifu jina lako milele.

english: But You have rejected and humbled us; You no longer go forth with our armies.
ekegusii: Nonya naboigo gwatotigire na gotosookia, tori kogenda amo nabarwani baito b’esegi.
swahili: Lakini sasa umetukataa na kutudhili, wala huendi tena na jeshi letu.

english: My heart is stirred by a noble theme as I recite my verses to the king; my tongue is the pen of a skillful writer.
ekegusii: Enkoro yane nigo eichire namang’ana amaya, engero yane nigo ere igoro y’omorwoti; oromeme rwane nigo rore buna ekaramu y’omoriki omuya.
swahili: Moyo wangu umesisimuliwa na jambo jema ninapomsimulia mfalme mabeti yangu; ulimi wangu ni kalamu ya mwandishi stadi.

english: Listen, O daughter! Consider and incline your ear: Forget your people and your father’s house,
ekegusii: Aye omoiseke, igwa! Ntegerera mono! Eba bono abanto baino na ab’enyomba ya iso.
swahili: Sikiliza, ewe binti, fikiri na utege sikio: Sahau watu wako na nyumba ya baba yako.

english: and the king will desire your beauty; bow to him, for he is your lord.
ekegusii: Oboseera bwao mbogere omorwoti agosanere, ekiagera ere nomonene oo, goika bwekumbe ase obosio bwaye.
swahili: Mfalme ameshangazwa na uzuri wako; mheshimu, kwa kuwa yeye ni bwana wako.

english: The Daughter of Tyre will come with a gift; men of wealth will seek your favor.
ekegusii: Abanto ba Turo, abare abanda mono, nigo barakorentere ebiegwa, barigie ogwancherwa kwao.
swahili: Binti wa Tiro atakuletea zawadi, watu wenye utajiri watatafuta upendeleo wako.

english: All glorious is the princess in her chamber; her gown is embroidered with gold.
ekegusii: Omoiseke bw’omorwoti nigo are ime ase eero yaye ore nobonene, obegete eganchwa yaye eroiseirie etaabu.
swahili: Utukufu wote una binti mfalme katika chumba chake; vazi lake limefumwa kwa nyuzi za dhahabu.

english: In colorful garments she is led to the king; her virgin companions are brought before you.
ekegusii: Nigo akoirwa ase omorwoti obegete chiganchwa chi’ebieni ao ao, nigo agotunyanwa nabaiseke abekungi abare abagisangio baye; bonsi nigo bakoirwa ase omorwoti.
swahili: Anaongozwa kwa mfalme, akiwa amevalia mavazi yaliyotariziwa, mabikira wenzake wanamfuata na wanaletwa kwako.

english: They are led in with joy and gladness; they enter the palace of the king.
ekegusii: Nigo bakoirwa bare nomogooko na omochengo, erio basoigwa ase enyomba y’omorwoti.
swahili: Wanaingizwa ndani kwa shangwe na furaha, na kuingia katika jumba la mfalme.

english: Your sons will succeed your fathers; you will make them princes throughout the land.
ekegusii: Abana bao abamura mbabe ribaga rie chisokoro chiao, naye nobabeeke babe abagaambi igoro ase ense yonsi.
swahili: Wana wenu watachukua nafasi za baba zenu, mtawafanya wakuu katika nchi yote.

english: I will commemorate your name through all generations; therefore the nations will praise you forever and ever.
ekegusii: Ninkore erieta riao ribe rikoinyorwa nebiaare bionsi; ase ayio, abanto b’ebisaku mbabe bakogotogia goika kare na kare.
swahili: Nitadumisha kumbukumbu lako katika vizazi vyote, kwa hiyo mataifa watakusifu milele na milele.

english: You are the most handsome of men; grace has anointed your lips, since God has blessed you forever.
ekegusii: Aye nigo ore omoseera kobua abanto bonsi; ebikoba biao nigo bigokwana amang’ana ’obwanchani. Ase ayio Nyasae ogosesenirie goika kare na kare.
swahili: Wewe ni bora kuliko watu wengine wote na midomo yako imepakwa neema, kwa kuwa Mungu amekubariki milele.

english: Strap your sword at your side, O mighty warrior; appear in your majesty and splendor.
ekegusii: Aye omobui, eboeranie omoyio o birende ase ekenema kiao, aye nigo ore nobonene na ogosikwa okonene.
swahili: Jifunge upanga wako pajani mwako, ee mwenye nguvu, jivike fahari na utukufu.

english: In your splendor ride forth in victory on behalf of truth and humility and justice; may your right hand show your awesome deeds.
ekegusii: Genda bosio nobobui na obonene,! Okengere ekeene, na obwororo, na oboronge; na okoboko kwao gw’okorio ngokworokererie amang’ana ’ogokumia.
swahili: Katika fahari yako, songa mbele kwa ushindi, kwa ajili ya kweli, unyenyekevu na haki, mkono wako wa kuume na uonyeshe matendo ya kutisha.

english: Your arrows pierce the hearts of the king’s foes; the nations fall beneath your feet.
ekegusii: Emegwe yao nigo ere emioge, nigo ekobeta chinkoro chi’ababisa bao aye omorwoti abanto nigo bakogwa inse yao.
swahili: Mishale yako mikali na ichome mioyo ya adui za mfalme, mataifa na yaanguke chini ya nyayo zako.

english: Your throne, O God, endures forever and ever, and justice is the scepter of Your kingdom.
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, ekerogo kiao ki’obonene nigo kegendererete kobao kare na kare. Enyimbo yao y’oborwoti nigo ere ey’oboronge.
swahili: Ee Mungu, kiti chako cha enzi kitadumu milele na milele, fimbo ya utawala wa haki itakuwa fimbo ya utawala wa ufalme wako.

english: You have loved righteousness and hated wickedness; therefore God, your God, has anointed you above your companions with the oil of joy.
ekegusii: Aye nigo bwanchete oboronge na kogechete ebibe. Ase ayio, Nyasae, oyore Nyasae oo ogoakire amaguta, okorenteire omogooko kobua oyo bw’abande bamino.
swahili: Unaipenda haki na kuchukia uovu; kwa hiyo Mungu, Mungu wako, amekuweka juu ya wenzako, kwa kukupaka mafuta ya furaha.

english: All your garments are fragrant with myrrh and aloes and cassia; from palaces of ivory the harps make you glad.
ekegusii: Chiganchwa chiao nigo chikouboka rimisu ri’amaguta a manemane, na ay’omogaka, na aya kasia. Korwa ase chinyomba chichabeire amaino e chinchogu abanto nigo bakobugia amakano na gokogokia.
swahili: Mavazi yako yote yana harufu nzuri ya manemane, udi na mdalasini; kutoka kwenye majumba ya kifalme yaliyopambwa kwa pembe za ndovu, sauti za vinanda vya nyuzi zinakufanya ufurahi.

english: The daughters of kings are among your honored women; the queen stands at your right hand, adorned with the gold of Ophir.
ekegusii: Abaiseke b’abarwoti nigo bare amo nabwo bakogokorera ase amasikani; eting’ana bwechaberete netaabu ekorwa Ofiri, nigo ateneine ase okoboko kwao gw’okorio.
swahili: Binti za wafalme ni miongoni mwa wanawake wako waheshimiwa; kuume kwako yupo bibi arusi malkia aliyevaa dhahabu ya Ofiri.

english: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in times of trouble.
ekegusii: Nyasae nobotamero bwaito, ne chinguru chiaito, botambe nigo are ang’e gotokonya ase engaki y’emechando.
swahili: Mungu kwetu sisi ni kimbilio na nguvu, msaada utakaoonekana tele wakati wa mateso.

english: “Be still and know that I am God; I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted over the earth.”
ekegusii: “Toerera, momanye ng’a ninche Nyasae; inche inde omonene ase abanto b’ebisaku, omonene ase ense.”
swahili: “Tulieni, mjue ya kwamba mimi ndimi Mungu; nitatukuzwa katikati ya mataifa, nitatukuzwa katika dunia.”

english: The LORD of Hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our fortress. Selah
ekegusii: Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo are amo naintwe, Nyasae o Yakobo nere obotamero bwaito.
swahili: Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote yu pamoja nasi; Mungu wa Yakobo ni ngome yetu.

english: Therefore we will not fear, though the earth is transformed and the mountains are toppled into the depths of the seas,
ekegusii: Ase ayio titokwoboa, ense neisa gotengechigwa na ebitunwa birutwe ase chindiba chi’enyancha,
swahili: Kwa hiyo hatutaogopa, hata kama dunia ikiondolewa nayo milima ikiangukia moyoni mwa bahari.

english: though their waters roar and foam and the mountains quake in the surge. Selah
ekegusii: gose emerindo y’enyancha neba ekoruma na koimokerera igoro, na ebitunwa bibe bigotengechigwa ase ogoturubanigwa okwo.
swahili: Hata kama maji yake yatanguruma na kuumuka, milima nayo ikitetemeka kwa mawimbi yake.

english: There is a river whose streams delight the city of God, the holy place where the Most High dwells.
ekegusii: Orooche ndoreo chindooche chiaye chikogokia omochie o Nyasae, omochie ore obomenyo obochenu bw’Oyore Igoro Mono.
swahili: Kuna mto ambao vijito vyake vinaufurahisha mji wa Mungu, mahali patakatifu ambako Aliye Juu Sana anaishi.

english: God is within her; she will not be moved. God will help her when morning dawns.
ekegusii: Nyasae nigo amenyete imeo, tokonyegerigwa, ere nayokonye kobogokia mambia.
swahili: Mungu yuko katikati yake, hautaanguka, Mungu atausaidia asubuhi na mapema.

english: Nations rage, kingdoms crumble; the earth melts when He lifts His voice.
ekegusii: Abanto b’ebisaku babeire neburuburu, amagambi aiyerigwe; Nyasae ogoaka eriogi riaye, ense nenyititoke.
swahili: Mataifa yanafanya ghasia, falme zinaanguka, Yeye huinua sauti yake, dunia ikayeyuka.

english: The LORD of Hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our fortress. Selah
ekegusii: Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo are amo naintwe, Nyasae o Yakobo nere obotamero bwaito.
swahili: Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote yu pamoja nasi, Mungu wa Yakobo ni ngome yetu.

english: Come, see the works of the LORD, who brings devastation upon the earth.
ekegusii: Inchuo morore ay’Omonene akorire, orentire ogosirigwa ase ense.
swahili: Njooni mkaone kazi za Bwana jinsi alivyofanya ukiwa katika nchi.

english: He makes wars to cease throughout the earth; He breaks the bow and shatters the spear; He burns the shields in the fire.
ekegusii: Otangire chiseegi ase ense engima, obunire amata, osenyentire amatimo, osambire chigari nomorero.
swahili: Anakomesha vita hata miisho ya dunia, anakata upinde na kuvunjavunja mkuki, anateketeza ngao kwa moto.

english: Clap your hands, all you peoples; shout unto God with a voice of triumph.
ekegusii: Inwe abanto bonsi, aka chinkobi, moterere Nyasae amatera ’omogooko neriogi rinene!
swahili: Pigeni makofi, enyi mataifa yote, mpigieni Mungu kelele za shangwe!

english: How awesome is the LORD Most High, the great King over all the earth!
ekegusii: Omonene ore Igoro Mono nigo are oyo bw’okoirokia, ere nomorwoti omonene bw’ense yonsi.
swahili: Jinsi gani alivyo wa kutisha, Bwana Aliye Juu Sana, Mfalme mkuu juu ya dunia yote!

english: He subdues nations beneath us, and peoples under our feet.
ekegusii: Omonene obekire abanto inse yaito, otoeire okobua kogambera abanto b’ebisaku.
swahili: Ametiisha mataifa chini yetu watu wengi chini ya miguu yetu.

english: He chooses our inheritance for us, the pride of Jacob, whom He loves. Selah
ekegusii: Nigo atochorerete omwando, oyio ore obwari bwa Yakobo, ori’Omonene anchete.
swahili: Alituchagulia urithi wetu, fahari ya Yakobo, aliyempenda.

english: God has ascended amid shouts of joy, the LORD with the sound of the horn.
ekegusii: Nyasae otiirire namariogi ay’ogochengerwa, Omonene nigo akobugerigwa ebitureeri.
swahili: Mungu amepaa kwa kelele za shangwe, Bwana kwa sauti za tarumbeta.

english: Sing praises to God, sing praises; sing praises to our King, sing praises!
ekegusii: Tera amatera ay’ogotogia Nyasae, tera amatera ay’ogotogia! Tera amatera ay’ogotogia omorwoti oito, tera amatera ay’ogotogia!
swahili: Mwimbieni Mungu sifa, imbeni sifa, mwimbieni sifa Mfalme wetu, imbeni sifa.

english: For God is King of all the earth; sing profound praises to Him.
ekegusii: Nyasae nigo are omorwoti bw’ense yonsi, motogie namatera are nengencho.
swahili: Kwa kuwa Mungu ni mfalme wa dunia yote, mwimbieni zaburi za sifa.

english: God reigns over the nations; God is seated on His holy throne.
ekegusii: Nyasae nere okogamba igoro ase ebisaku; ere nigo aikaransete ase ekerogo kiaye ki’obonene kere egechenu.
swahili: Mungu anatawala juu ya mataifa, Mungu ameketi juu ya kiti chake cha enzi kitakatifu.

english: The nobles of the nations have assembled as the people of the God of Abraham; for the shields of the earth belong to God; He is highly exalted.
ekegusii: Abagaambi b’abaanto basangererekanire amo, babe abanto ba Nyasae o Aburaamu. Chinguba chi’ense nigo chire echia Nyasae; ere oimokererigwe igoro mono kegima.
swahili: Wakuu wa mataifa wanakusanyika kama watu wa Mungu wa Abrahamu, kwa kuwa wafalme wa dunia ni mali ya Mungu; yeye ametukuka sana.

english: Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised in the city of our God, His holy mountain.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo are omonene mono, goika atogigwe; ere goika atogigwe agwo ase omochie o Nyasae oito, ase egetunwa kiaye egechenu.
swahili: Bwana ni mkuu, anayestahili kusifiwa sana, katika mji wa Mungu wetu, mlima wake mtakatifu.

english: Your name, O God, like Your praise, reaches to the ends of the earth; Your right hand is full of righteousness.
ekegusii: Nyasae, buna koreng’ana erieta riao rikumete, naboigo nogotogigwa kwao gokumete goikera chinsinyo chi’ense. Okoboko kwao gw’okorio nigo goichire noboronge.
swahili: Ee Mungu, kama jina lako lilivyo, sifa zako zinafika hadi miisho ya dunia, mkono wako wa kuume umejazwa na haki.

english: Mount Zion is glad, the daughters of Judah rejoice, on account of Your judgments.
ekegusii: Tiga abanto b’egetunwa gia Sayoni bagoke; boigo nab’emechie y’Abayuda, ekiagera aye nigo okonacha ebiina bia boronge.
swahili: Mlima Sayuni unashangilia, vijiji vya Yuda vinafurahi kwa sababu ya hukumu zako.

english: March around Zion, encircle her, count her towers,
ekegusii: Taara moetanane Sayoni, mobare emerobiri yaye.
swahili: Tembeeni katika Sayuni, uzungukeni mji, hesabuni minara yake;

english: consider her ramparts, tour her citadels, that you may tell the next generation.
ekegusii: Rigereria chindwaki chiaye, eta motaare ime ase chiburi chiaye; erio nario morache goteebia ebigori bigochi-gocha:
swahili: yatafakarini vyema maboma yake, angalieni ngome zake, ili mpate kusimulia habari zake kwa kizazi kijacho.

english: For this God is our God forever and ever; He will be our guide even till death.
ekegusii: “Omonene oyo nere Nyasae oito o kare na kare. Ere nabe omoraai oito kogenderera botambe.”
swahili: Kwa kuwa huyu Mungu ni Mungu wetu milele na milele; atakuwa kiongozi wetu hata mwisho.

english: Beautiful in loftiness, the joy of all the earth, like the peaks of Zaphon is Mount Zion, the city of the great King.
ekegusii: Sayoni, egetunwa kia Nyasae egeseera, keimokererete igoro agwo sugusu, nigo kere omogooko bw’ense engima; omochie oyio noyo bw’omorwoti omonene.
swahili: Ni mzuri katika kuinuka kwake juu sana, furaha ya dunia yote. Kama vilele vya juu sana vya Safoni ni Mlima Sayuni, mji wa Mfalme Mkuu.

english: God is in her citadels; He has shown Himself to be a fortress.
ekegusii: Agwo ase chiburi chi’omochie oyio, Nyasae bweorokirie ng’a nere obotamero bw’ogwekengera.
swahili: Mungu yuko katika ngome zake; amejionyesha mwenyewe kuwa ngome yake.

english: For behold, the kings assembled; they all advanced together.
ekegusii: Rora, abarwoti nigo basangererekanete, bagacha amo.
swahili: Wakati wafalme walipounganisha nguvu, waliposonga mbele pamoja,

english: They saw and were astounded; they fled in terror.
ekegusii: Ekero baroche omochie oria, nigo bakumetie, bakaondoka, bagatama.
swahili: walimwona nao wakashangaa, wakakimbia kwa hofu.

english: Trembling seized them there, anguish like a woman in labor.
ekegusii: Bagasogwa nobwoba, bakaiguswa, bagaichana na koba nobororo buna obw’omokuungu okobina aibore.
swahili: Kutetemeka kuliwashika huko, maumivu kama ya mwanamke mwenye utungu wa kuzaa.

english: With a wind from the east You wrecked the ships of Tarshish.
ekegusii: Nigo kwababunete buna chimeeri chia Tarisisi nomwaga okogusa korwa moocha.
swahili: Uliwaangamiza kama meli za Tarshishi zilizovunjwa na upepo wa mashariki.

english: As we have heard, so we have seen in the city of the LORD of Hosts, in the city of our God: God will establish her forever. Selah
ekegusii: Amang’ana twaigwete, bono twayarorire agwo ase omochie Omonene bw’Emeganda, omochie o Nyasae oito. Nyasae nigo ayorendete na koyokong’ia goika kare na kare.
swahili: Kama tulivyokuwa tumesikia, ndivyo tulivyoona katika mji wa Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, katika mji wa Mungu wetu: Mungu ataufanya uwe salama milele.

english: Within Your temple, O God, we contemplate Your loving devotion.
ekegusii: Nyasae, ekero tore ase Hekalu yao ime, nigo tokorengereria igoro y’obwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe.
swahili: Ee Mungu, hekaluni mwako tunatafakari upendo wako usiokoma.

english: Hear this, all you peoples; listen, all inhabitants of the world,
ekegusii: Inwe abanto bonsi, igwa amang’ana aya! Tegerera moigwe, inwe mwensi momenyete ase ense,
swahili: Sikieni haya, enyi mataifa yote, sikilizeni, ninyi wote mkaao dunia hii.

english: For it is clear that wise men die, and the foolish and the senseless both perish and leave their wealth to others.
ekegusii: Bonsi nigo bamanyete ng’a nonya nabaanto abang’aini ngokwa bare, naboigo nabare abariri na amachara, erio batiga abanto abaao bakoira chinibo chiabo.
swahili: Wote wanaona kwamba watu wenye hekima hufa; wajinga na wapumbavu vivyo hivyo huangamia na kuwaachia wengine mali zao.

english: Their graves are their eternal homes— their dwellings for endless generations— even though their lands were their namesakes.
ekegusii: Nigo bakorengereria ng’a nigo chirabeo kare na kare, na obomenyo bwabo ebiaare ase ebiaare; nigo bagwatora emegondo yabo ase amarieta abo.
swahili: Makaburi yao yatabaki kuwa nyumba zao za milele, makao yao vizazi vyote; ingawa walikuwa na mashamba na kuyaita kwa majina yao.

english: But a man, despite his wealth, cannot endure; he is like the beasts that perish.
ekegusii: Korende Mwanyabaanto takonyara kogenderera koba nogosikwa, ere nigo anga buna ching’iti chigokwa chiasira.
swahili: Lakini mwanadamu, licha ya utajiri wake, hadumu; anafanana na mnyama aangamiaye.

english: This is the fate of the self-confident and their followers who endorse their sayings. Selah
ekegusii: Obwo nabwo obosiru bw’abaanto abwo besemeretie abanyene, omoerio obo abwo begenete amang’ana abo.
swahili: Hii ndiyo hatima ya wale wanaojitumainia wenyewe, pia ya wafuasi wao, waliothibitisha misemo yao.

english: Like sheep they are destined for Sheol. Death will be their shepherd. The upright will rule them in the morning, and their form will decay in Sheol, far from their lofty abode.
ekegusii: Buna riicho rie ching’ondi nigo bakoirwa gochia aase abakuure amakweri naro arabe omorisia obo. Abwo bare abaronge mbaabagambere kobogokiamoka, na ebieni biabo mbisirere agwo aase abakuure aase are obomenyo bwabo.
swahili: Kama kondoo, wamewekewa kwenda kaburini, nacho kifo kitawala. Wanyofu watawatawala asubuhi, maumbile yao yataozea kaburini, mbali na majumba yao makubwa ya fahari.

english: But God will redeem my life from Sheol, for He will surely take me to Himself. Selah
ekegusii: Korende Nyasae naboorie omoyo one, ayorusie korwa ase okobua gw’aase abakuure erinde ang’ire imenye asare.
swahili: Lakini Mungu atakomboa uhai wangu na kaburi, hakika atanichukua kwake.

english: Do not be amazed when a man grows rich, when the splendor of his house increases.
ekegusii: Tobaisa koiroka ekero omonto abeire omotenenku, na ebinto bire ase enyomba yaye biamentekanire.
swahili: Usitishwe mtu anapotajirika, fahari ya nyumba yake inapoongezeka,

english: For when he dies, he will carry nothing away; his abundance will not follow him down.
ekegusii: Ekero omonto oyio arakwe, takoira gento kende, obonene bwaye tibokomotunyana bogende inse aaria amo nere.
swahili: kwa maana hatachukua chochote atakapokufa, fahari yake haitashuka pamoja naye.

english: Though in his lifetime he blesses his soul— and men praise you when you prosper—
ekegusii: Nonya omonto oyio ekero are moyo, ogweteba ng’a nigo asesenirie, ee, nonya ogotogigwa ekero ekoreire amaya,
swahili: Ingawa alipokuwa akiishi alijihesabu kuwa heri, na wanadamu wanakusifu unapofanikiwa,

english: he will join the generation of his fathers, who will never see the light of day.
ekegusii: ere goika akwe, asangerereke ase chisokoro chiaye chire, echio chitarore oborabu naende.
swahili: atajiunga na kizazi cha baba zake, ambao hawataona kamwe nuru ya uzima.

english: both low and high, rich and poor alike.
ekegusii: inwe mwensi, abake na abanene, abanda na abataka mwensi amo tegerera!
swahili: Wakubwa kwa wadogo, matajiri na maskini pamoja:

english: A man who has riches without understanding is like the beasts that perish.
ekegusii: Mwanyabaanto oyio osikire otabwati obong’aini, nigo anga buna ching’iti chigokwa chiasira.
swahili: Mwanadamu mwenye utajiri bila ufahamu ni kama wanyama waangamiao.

english: My mouth will impart wisdom, and the meditation of my heart will bring understanding.
ekegusii: Omonwa one nokwane amang’ana ’obong’aini, na ebirengererio bi’enkoro yane nigo birabe ebi’okomanya.
swahili: Kinywa changu kitasema maneno ya hekima, usemi wa moyo wangu utatoa ufahamu.

english: I will incline my ear to a proverb; I will express my riddle with the harp:
ekegusii: Nintegerere amang’ana agokwanwa ase omoreng’anio, ning’orokie engencho yaye ’gokobugia obokano.
swahili: Nitatega sikio langu nisikilize mithali, nitafafanua kitendawili kwa zeze:

english: Why should I fear in times of trouble, when wicked usurpers surround me?
ekegusii: Inche tinkoba nobwoba ase chingaki chi’emechando, ekero amabe ’abachandi baane arabe ang’etananire.
swahili: Kwa nini niogope siku mbaya zinapokuja, wakati wadanganyifu waovu wanaponizunguka,

english: They trust in their wealth and boast in their great riches.
ekegusii: Tinkwoboa abanto abwo basemeretie obotenenku bwabo; barabwo nigo bare bakoenenera obonda bwabo bore obonge.
swahili: wale wanaotegemea mali zao na kujivunia utajiri wao mwingi?

english: No man can possibly redeem his brother or pay his ransom to God.
ekegusii: Ekeene, omonto tari oranyare kobooria oyomwabo, gose koa Nyasae embooria y’ogotooria obogima bwaye.
swahili: Hakuna mwanadamu awaye yote awezaye kuukomboa uhai wa mwingine, au kumpa Mungu fidia kwa ajili yake.

english: For the redemption of his soul is costly, and never can payment suffice,
ekegusii: Rigori ri’okobooria omoyo oye nigo rire rinene mono, na mbooria ende teri eraisanere rigori erio,
swahili: Fidia ya uhai ni gharama kubwa, hakuna malipo yoyote yanayotosha,

english: that he should live on forever and not see decay.
ekegusii: eyio eragere omonto agenderere koba moyo botambe, tabaisa kogenda ase embeera.
