swahili: ili kwamba aishi milele na asione uharibifu.

english: Answer me when I call, O God of my righteousness! You have relieved my distress; show me grace and hear my prayer.
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, aye okong’a oboronge, ong’iranerie ekero ngokorangeria! Ekero narenge nkomiga‐migwa nobokong’u nigo kwang’ete ribaga rigare. Indorera amaabera, na oigwe ogosaba kwane!
swahili: Nijibu nikuitapo, Ee Mungu wangu mwenye haki! Nipumzishe katika shida zangu; nirehemu, usikie ombi langu.

english: How long, O men, will my honor be maligned? How long will you love vanity and seek after lies? Selah
ekegusii: Inwe Mwanyabaanto, ngoika ririri moragenderere korenta emechando na kobeka echayo ase obonene bwane? Ngoika ririri moragenderere gwancha amang’ana abosa na korigia ay’oborimo?
swahili: Enyi watu, mtabadilisha utukufu wangu kuwa aibu mpaka lini? Mtapenda udanganyifu na kufuata miungu ya uongo mpaka lini?

english: Know that the LORD has set apart the godly for Himself; the LORD hears when I call to Him.
ekegusii: Korende manya ng’a Omonene bwechoreire omonyene oboronge. Omonene nigo akonyigwa ekero nkomosaba.
swahili: Fahamuni hakika kwamba Bwana amewatenga wale wamchao kwa ajili yake; Bwana atanisikia nimwitapo.

english: Be angry, yet do not sin; on your bed, search your heart and be still. Selah
ekegusii: Nabo morabee, korende timobaisa gokora ebibe; morengereria mono kegima amang’ana ayio ime ye chinkoro chiano ekero mokorara ase amarere aino, na mobe abatoereru.
swahili: Katika hasira yako, usitende dhambi. Mkiwa vitandani mwenu, mtulie kimya mkiichunguza mioyo yenu.

english: Offer the sacrifices of the righteous and trust in the LORD.
ekegusii: Karue ebing’wanso bi’oboronge, na mosemerie Omonene.
swahili: Toeni dhabihu zilizo haki; mtegemeeni Bwana.

english: Many ask, “Who can show us the good?” Shine the light of Your face upon us, O LORD.
ekegusii: Abanto abange bagokwana iga: “Naki yare koba buya onye ’ntwanyora ayare amaya.” Aye Omonene, tiga omobaso bw’obosio bwao otomorekere.
swahili: Wengi wanauliza, “Ni nani awezaye kutuonyesha jema lolote?” Ee Bwana, tuangazie nuru ya uso wako.

english: You have filled my heart with more joy than when grain and new wine abound.
ekegusii: Kwang’eire omogooko ase enkoro yane ime ore omuya kobua oyo abanto bande bakonyora, abwo bare nobonge bw’endagera na edivai.
swahili: Wewe umejaza moyo wangu kwa furaha kubwa kuliko watu waliopata nafaka na divai kwa wingi.

english: I will lie down and sleep in peace, for You alone, O LORD, make me dwell in safety.
ekegusii: Ekero ngochia gwetoora koraara, nigo nkorara chitoro inde nomorembe, ekiagera aye Omonene naye okogera imenye ase okorendwa okuya.
swahili: Nitajilaza chini na kulala kwa amani, kwa kuwa wewe peke yako, Ee Bwana, waniwezesha kukaa kwa salama.

english: The Mighty One, God the LORD, speaks and summons the earth from where the sun rises to where it sets.
ekegusii: Nyasae omonguru, Nyasae Omonene, nigo agokwana, nigo agokwana na korangeria ense yonsi korwa moocha goika bosongo.
swahili: Mwenye Nguvu, Mungu, Bwana, asema na kuiita dunia, tangu mawio ya jua hadi mahali pake liendapo kutua.

english: for every beast of the forest is Mine— the cattle on a thousand hills.
ekegusii: ekiagera ching’iti chionsi chi’orosana nechiane, ne chiombe chilifu chire ase ebigoro nechiane.
swahili: Kwa maana kila mnyama wa msituni ni wangu, na pia makundi ya mifugo juu ya vilima elfu.

english: I know every bird in the mountains, and the creatures of the field are Mine.
ekegusii: Nimanyete chinyoni chionsi chire ase ebitunwa, ne ching’iti chinde chionsi chikonagoetanana ase ense nechiane.
swahili: Ninamjua kila ndege mlimani, nao viumbe wa kondeni ni wangu.

english: If I were hungry, I would not tell you, for the world is Mine, and the fullness thereof.
ekegusii: “Onye narenge nenchara, tinare kogotebia, ekiagera ense, na ebinto bionsi bireo nebiane.
swahili: Kama ningekuwa na njaa, nisingewaambia ninyi, kwa maana ulimwengu ni wangu, pamoja na vyote vilivyomo ndani yake.

english: Do I eat the flesh of bulls, or drink the blood of goats?
ekegusii: Inee! Inche ne chinyama chie chieri nkoria? Gose namanyinga e chimbori nkonywa?
swahili: Je, mimi hula nyama ya mafahali au kunywa damu ya mbuzi?

english: Sacrifice a thank offering to God, and fulfill your vows to the Most High.
ekegusii: Aye omoruere Nyasae ekeng’wanso gi’okoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono, naende ikerania ase Oyore Igoro Mono chiira kwamorierete.
swahili: Toa sadaka za shukrani kwa Mungu, timiza nadhiri zako kwake Yeye Aliye Juu Sana,

english: Call upon Me in the day of trouble; I will deliver you, and you will honor Me.”
ekegusii: Ndangerie ase engaki y’emechando; inche ninoboseemia, naye nontogie.”
swahili: na uniite siku ya taabu; nami nitakuokoa, nawe utanitukuza.”

english: To the wicked, however, God says, “What right have you to recite My statutes and to bear My covenant on your lips?
ekegusii: Korende Nyasae nigo agotebia omokori amabe, “Naye mboronge ki obwate okonagwatora amachiiko aane? Gose kona‐gokwana‐kwana okobwatana kwane kw’ogotianania?
swahili: Lakini kwake mtu mwovu, Mungu asema: “Una haki gani kunena sheria zangu au kuchukua agano langu midomoni mwako?

english: For you hate My instruction and cast My words behind you.
ekegusii: Aye nigo ogechete amorokererio ay’okorongeyia, gwatugutire amang’ana aane gochia magega.
swahili: Unachukia mafundisho yangu na kuyatupa maneno yangu nyuma yako.

english: When you see a thief, you befriend him, and throw in your lot with adulterers.
ekegusii: Ekero okorora omoibi, nigo ogwancherana nere, boigo nigo okobwatana nabatomani.
swahili: Unapomwona mwizi, unaungana naye, unapiga kura yako pamoja na wazinzi.

english: You unleash your mouth for evil and unharness your tongue for deceit.
ekegusii: “Omonwa oo nigo ore omwango gokwana amang’ana ’obobe, na oromeme rwao nigo romanyete koroisia amang’ana ’obong’ainereria.
swahili: Unakitumia kinywa chako kwa mabaya na kuuongoza ulimi wako kwa hila.

english: From Zion, perfect in beauty, God shines forth.
ekegusii: Korwa Sayoni, omochie omoikeranu bw’oboseera, Nyasae omorekire korwao.
swahili: Kutoka Sayuni, penye uzuri mkamilifu, Mungu anaangaza.

english: You sit and malign your brother; you slander your own mother’s son.
ekegusii: Aye nigo ogoikaransa na konakogamba abanto bamino bobe; nigo okona‐kong’acha oyomino morwete enda eyemo.
swahili: Wanena daima dhidi ya ndugu yako na kumsingizia mwana wa mama yako.

english: You have done these things, and I kept silent; you thought I was just like you. But now I rebuke you and accuse you to your face.
ekegusii: Kwabeire gokona‐gokora ayio, nainche nkirete‐kiri, nigo okagete ng’a inche nigo inde buna aye. Korende bono nkogotogonyera nde na kobeka ayio ase obosio bwao.
swahili: Mambo haya unayafanya, nami nimekaa kimya, ukafikiri Mimi nami ni kama wewe. Lakini nitakukemea na kuweka mashtaka mbele yako.

english: Now consider this, you who forget God, lest I tear you to pieces, with no one to rescue you:
ekegusii: “Inwe aba mwanyebire inche Nyasae, rengereria amang’ana aya mono; onye taibo, nimbaake mbatandorane, na monto onde tari orabatoorie.
swahili: “Yatafakarini haya, ninyi mnaomsahau Mungu, ama sivyo nitawararua vipande vipande, wala hapatakuwepo na yeyote wa kuwaokoa:

english: He who sacrifices a thank offering honors Me, and to him who rights his way, I will show the salvation of God.”
ekegusii: Onde bwensi okong’iraneria ng’a mbuya mono, okwo nakwo ekeng’wanso ki’ogonsika, na onde bwensi okobwatia chinchera chi’oboronge, oyio nimorentere ogotooreka kwane inche Nyasae.”
swahili: Atoaye dhabihu za shukrani ananiheshimu mimi, naye aiandaa njia yake ili nimwonyeshe wokovu wa Mungu.”

english: Our God approaches and will not be silent! Consuming fire precedes Him, and a tempest rages around Him.
ekegusii: Nyasae oito ngocha are, tagokirakiri; omorero okoria nigo otang’aine bosio bwaye, omwaga omotindi nigo omoetanaine.
swahili: Mungu wetu anakuja na hatakaa kimya, moto uteketezao unamtangulia, akiwa amezungukwa na tufani kali.

english: He summons the heavens above, and the earth, that He may judge His people:
ekegusii: Ere nigo akorangeria igoro na ense chibe birori, ekero akonachera abanto baye ekiina, ogoteeba:
swahili: Anaziita mbingu zilizo juu, na nchi, ili aweze kuwahukumu watu wake:

english: “Gather to Me My saints, who made a covenant with Me by sacrifice.”
ekegusii: “Sangereria abanto baane abegenwa bache asende, abwo bakorete okobwatana kw’ogotianania nainche ase okorua ebing’wanso.”
swahili: “Nikusanyieni watu wangu waliowekwa wakfu, waliofanya agano nami kwa dhabihu.”

english: And the heavens proclaim His righteousness, for God Himself is Judge. Selah
ekegusii: Igoro nigo chikoraria oboronge bwa Nyasae; Nyasae omonyene nere omonachi ebiina.
swahili: Nazo mbingu zinatangaza haki yake, kwa maana Mungu mwenyewe ni hakimu.

english: “Hear, O My people, and I will speak, O Israel, and I will testify against you: I am God, your God.
ekegusii: “Inwe abanto baane, tegerera moigwe, inche nkwane! Inwe Abaisraeli, inche nimbe nkorua oborori bore mamincha yaino. Inche Nyasae inde Nyasae oino.
swahili: “Sikieni, enyi watu wangu, nami nitasema, ee Israeli, nami nitashuhudia dhidi yenu: Mimi ndimi Mungu, Mungu wenu.

english: I do not rebuke you for your sacrifices, and your burnt offerings are ever before Me.
ekegusii: Tinkobatogonyera ase engencho y’ebing’wanso biaino; ebing’wanso biaino bi’ogosambwa nigo bire ase obosio bwane botambe.
swahili: Sikukemei kwa sababu ya dhabihu zako, au sadaka zako za kuteketezwa, ambazo daima ziko mbele zangu.

english: I have no need for a bull from your stall or goats from your pens,
ekegusii: Tingwanchera chieri chikorwa ase ameeri aino, gose chigoree chikorwa ase amaicho aino;
swahili: Sina haja ya fahali wa banda lako, au mbuzi wa zizi lako.

english: Have mercy on me, O God, according to Your loving devotion; according to Your great compassion, blot out my transgressions.
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, ’ndorere amaabera koreng’ana nobwanchani bwao botari koera; ase engencho y’obonge bw’amaabera ao otinyie ogosaria kwane.
swahili: Ee Mungu, unihurumie, kwa kadiri ya upendo wako usiokoma, kwa kadiri ya huruma yako kuu, uyafute makosa yangu.

english: Create in me a clean heart, O God, and renew a right spirit within me.
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, ontongere enkoro endabu, okore omoika ore ime yane obe omoyia na oyokong’ie.
swahili: Ee Mungu, uniumbie moyo safi, uifanye upya roho ya uthabiti ndani yangu.

english: Cast me not away from Your presence; take not Your Holy Spirit from me.
ekegusii: Tonyatanana korwa ase obosio bwao, nonya n’Omoika Omochenu toyorusia asende.
swahili: Usinitupe kutoka mbele zako wala kuniondolea Roho wako Mtakatifu.

english: Restore to me the joy of Your salvation, and sustain me with a willing spirit.
ekegusii: Ong’iranerie omogooko okorwa ase ogotooreka kwao, okong’ie omoika one obe omoigweri.
swahili: Unirudishie tena furaha ya wokovu wako, unipe roho ya utii, ili initegemeze.

english: Then I will teach transgressors Your ways, and sinners will return to You.
ekegusii: Erio inyorokererie abasaria chinchera chiao, na abanyene ebibe mbairane asore.
swahili: Ndipo nitakapowafundisha wakosaji njia zako, na wenye dhambi watakugeukia wewe.

english: Deliver me from bloodguilt, O God, the God of my salvation, and my tongue will sing of Your righteousness.
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, Nyasae bw’ogotooreka kwane, ontoorie, ting’itera amanyinga ’abaanto, na oromeme rwane rotere n’oboronge bwao.
swahili: Ee Mungu, Mungu uniokoaye, niokoe na hatia ya kumwaga damu, nao ulimi wangu utaimba juu ya haki yako.

english: O Lord, open my lips, and my mouth will declare Your praise.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ong’igore ebikoba biane, na omonwa one norarie ogotogigwa kwao.
swahili: Ee Bwana, fungua midomo yangu, na kinywa changu kitatangaza sifa zako.

english: For You do not delight in sacrifice, or I would bring it; You take no pleasure in burnt offerings.
ekegusii: Togokiri nekeng’wanso, ninsa gokerua; aye toganeti ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa.
swahili: Wewe hupendezwi na dhabihu, au ningaliileta, hufurahii sadaka za kuteketezwa.

english: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit; a broken and a contrite heart, O God, You will not despise.
ekegusii: Ebing’wanso biancheire na Nyasae omoyo omokanyeku na bw’okweitia; enkoro yasionokire na gwekeyia, aye Nyasae, tokoyechaya.
swahili: Bali dhabihu za Mungu ni roho iliyovunjika, moyo uliovunjika wenye toba, Ee Mungu, hutaudharau.

english: In Your good pleasure, cause Zion to prosper; build up the walls of Jerusalem.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene okorere Sayoni amaya ase amaabera ao; oagache chindwaki chia Yerusalemu.
swahili: Kwa wema wa radhi yako uifanye Sayuni istawi, ukazijenge upya kuta za Yerusalemu.

english: Then You will delight in righteous sacrifices, in whole burnt offerings; then bulls will be offered on Your altar.
ekegusii: Erio nario oragokigwe n’ogosambwa kw’bing’wanso bi’ekeene; erio chieri nchiruegwe igoro ase egesasiimero kiao.
swahili: Hapo ndipo kutakapokuwa na dhabihu za haki, sadaka nzima za kuteketezwa za kukupendeza sana, pia mafahali watatolewa madhabahuni mwako.

english: Wash me clean of my iniquity and cleanse me from my sin.
ekegusii: Onsibie korwa obobe bwane kegima, na onchene korwa ase ebibe biane.
swahili: Unioshe na uovu wangu wote na unitakase dhambi yangu.

english: For I know my transgressions, and my sin is always before me.
ekegusii: Inche namanyire ogosaria kwane, na ebibe biane nigo bire bosio bwane botambe.
swahili: Kwa maana ninajua makosa yangu, na dhambi yangu iko mbele yangu daima.

english: Against You, You only, have I sinned and done what is evil in Your sight, so that You may be proved right when You speak and blameless when You judge.
ekegusii: Nagokoreire ebibe aye omonyene bweka, nakorire amabe bosio bwao. Aye omanyekane ng’a mboronge ore ekero ogokwana, na mboronge ore na nigo okonacha ekiina buya kegima.
swahili: Dhidi yako, wewe peke yako, nimetenda dhambi na kufanya yaliyo mabaya machoni pako, ili uthibitike kuwa wa kweli unenapo, na kuwa na haki utoapo hukumu.

english: Surely I was brought forth in iniquity; I was sinful when my mother conceived me.
ekegusii: Rora, inche nigo naiboretwe inde ne chingencho chi’ebibe; nigo narenge omonyabibe korwa ekero natongetwe ase enda yabaaba.
swahili: Hakika mimi nilizaliwa mwenye dhambi, mwenye dhambi tangu nilipotungwa mimba kwa mama yangu.

english: Surely You desire truth in the inmost being; You teach me wisdom in the inmost place.
ekegusii: Rora, aye nigo oganetie ekeene ase enkoro ime; ase ayio inyorokererie obong’aini bwao ase enkoro yane ime.
swahili: Hakika wewe wapendezwa na kweli itokayo moyoni, ndani sana ya moyo wangu wanifundisha hekima.

english: Purify me with hyssop, and I will be clean; wash me, and I will be whiter than snow.
ekegusii: Onsibie ne chinsagia chia hisopo, na inche nincheneke; onsibie erio imbe omorabu se goetania amagena ’embura.
swahili: Nioshe kwa hisopo, nami nitakuwa safi, unisafishe, nami nitakuwa mweupe kuliko theluji.

english: Let me hear joy and gladness; let the bones You have crushed rejoice.
ekegusii: Ong’ichorie n’omogooko na omochengo, amauga aane aya gwasenyentete n’agoke.
swahili: Unipe kusikia furaha na shangwe, mifupa uliyoiponda na ifurahi.

english: Hide Your face from my sins and blot out all my iniquities.
ekegusii: Togaacha etobo y’ebibe biane bosio bwao, torora ebibe biane; ontinyie obobe bwane bwonsi.
swahili: Ufiche uso wako usizitazame dhambi zangu, na uufute uovu wangu wote.

english: Why do you boast of evil, O mighty man? The loving devotion of God endures all day long.
ekegusii: Aye omonto ore nokobua, nase ki ogwetogeria amabe aya ogokora? Obwanchani bwa Nyasae nigo bogendererete kare na kare.
swahili: Ewe jitu, mbona unajivunia ubaya? Kwa nini unajivuna mchana kutwa, wewe ambaye ni fedheha mbele za Mungu?

english: Your tongue devises destruction like a sharpened razor, O worker of deceit.
ekegusii: Aye omong’ainereria, oromeme rwao nigo rokoroberia amang’ana ’ogosaria; nigo ronga buna omoyio otukia omwoge.
swahili: Ulimi wako hupanga mashauri mabaya ya maangamizi. Ni kama wembe mkali, ninyi mfanyao hila.

english: You love evil more than good, falsehood more than speaking truth. Selah
ekegusii: Aye nigo bwanchete amabe kobua amaya, nigo bwanchete gokwana oborimo kobua ekeene.
swahili: Unapenda mabaya kuliko mema, uongo kuliko kusema kweli.

english: You love every word that devours, O deceitful tongue.
ekegusii: Aye ore noromeme rw’obong’ainereria, nigo bwanchete gokwana amang’ana agosaria.
swahili: Unapenda kila neno lenye kudhuru, ewe ulimi wenye hila!

english: Surely God will bring you down to everlasting ruin; He will snatch you up and tear you away from your tent; He will uproot you from the land of the living. Selah
ekegusii: Nyasae nakoiyerie inse kare na kare, nakobwate na kogotaboria korwa nyomba mwao, nagosimore korwa ase ense y’abare moyo.
swahili: Hakika Mungu atakushusha chini kwa maangamizi ya milele: atakunyakua na kukuondoa kwa nguvu kutoka hema yako, atakungʼoa kutoka nchi ya walio hai.

english: The righteous will see and fear; they will mock the evildoer, saying,
ekegusii: Abanyene oboronge mbarore ayio boboe, bamosekerere bateebe;
swahili: Wenye haki wataona na kuogopa, watamcheka, wakisema,

english: “Look at the man who did not make God his refuge, but trusted in the abundance of his wealth and strengthened himself by destruction.”
ekegusii: “Rora, omonto oyo bwangete gokora Nyasae abe obotamero bwaye, nigo egenete obonge bw’obonda bwaye omonyene, na akeenenia ase chinguru chiaye chi’ogosaria.”
swahili: “Huyu ni yule mtu ambaye hakumfanya Mungu kuwa ngome yake, bali alitumainia wingi wa utajiri wake, na akawa hodari kwa kuwaangamiza wengine!” Neema Ya Mungu

english: But I am like an olive tree flourishing in the house of God; I trust in the loving devotion of God forever and ever.
ekegusii: Korende inche nigo inga buna omozeituni osebogete ase enyomba ya Nyasae ime. Nigo nsemeretie obwanchani bwa Nyasae botari koera goika kare na kare.
swahili: Lakini mimi ni kama mti wa mzeituni unaostawi katika nyumba ya Mungu, nautegemea upendo wa Mungu usiokoma milele na milele.

english: I will praise You forever, because You have done it. I will wait on Your name— for it is good— in the presence of Your saints.
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, ngokoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono kare na kare, ekiagera gwakorire ayio. Ase amasio ’abaanto bao bare abegenwa nindarie erieta riao, ekiagera nerigiya.
swahili: Nitakusifu milele kwa yale uliyoyatenda, nitatumaini jina lako, kwa kuwa jina lako ni jema. Nitakusifu mbele ya watakatifu wako.

english: The fool says in his heart, “There is no God.” They are corrupt; their ways are vile. There is no one who does good.
ekegusii: Abanto abariri nigo bagwetebia ase chinkoro chiabo ime: “Nyasae tari.” Barabwo nabasareku, nigo bagokora amang’ana amabe ay’okogechia; onde tari ogokora ayare amaya, nonya noyomo.
swahili: Mpumbavu anasema moyoni mwake, “Hakuna Mungu.” Wameharibika, na njia zao ni za uovu kabisa, hakuna hata mmoja atendaye mema.

english: God looks down from heaven upon the sons of men to see if any understand, if any seek God.
ekegusii: Nyasae nigo arigereretie Mwanyabaanto korwa igoro arore gose monto onde nareo ore omong’aini, oyokomorigia Nyasae.
swahili: Mungu anawachungulia wanadamu chini kutoka mbinguni aone kama wako wenye akili, wowote wanaomtafuta Mungu.

english: All have turned away, they have together become corrupt; there is no one who does good, not even one.
ekegusii: Abanto bonsi bairanire magega, bonsi amo basarekire; onde tari ogokora amaya, nonya noyomo.
swahili: Kila mmoja amegeukia mbali, wameharibika wote pamoja, hakuna atendaye mema. Naam, hakuna hata mmoja!

english: Will the workers of iniquity never learn? They devour my people like bread; they refuse to call upon God.
ekegusii: Inee! Abanto abwo bagokora amabe, tibamanyeti gento? Nigo bakoria abanto baane ase okobaurereria buna bakoria endagera yabo; tibari kondangeria inche Nyasae mbakonye.
swahili: Je, watendao mabaya kamwe hawatajifunza: wale ambao huwala watu wangu kama watu walavyo mkate, hao ambao hawamwiti Mungu?

english: There they are, overwhelmed with dread, where there was nothing to fear. For God has scattered the bones of those who besieged you. You put them to shame, for God has despised them.
ekegusii: Abwo nigo bagosogwa nomoondoko omonene mono, omoondoko buna oyio tona‐komanyekana nonya ndinde, Nyasae nasiarere amauga ’emebere y’ababisa abwo bakonaaretie. Nyasae nabasookie, ekiagera obaangire.
swahili: Hapo waliingiwa na hofu kuu, ambapo hapakuwa cha kutetemesha. Mungu alitawanya mifupa ya wale waliokushambulia; uliwaaibisha, kwa sababu Mungu aliwadharau.

english: Oh, that the salvation of Israel would come from Zion! When God restores His captive people, let Jacob rejoice, let Israel be glad!
ekegusii: Naki yare koba buya onye ogotooreka ngwachera Abaisraeli korwa Sayoni! Ekero Nyasae arairanerie abanto baye amaya abo, abanto b’ororeria rwa Yakobo mbachenge, ee, Abaisraeli mbabe nomogooko.
swahili: Laiti wokovu wa Israeli ungalikuja kutoka Sayuni! Wakati Mungu arejeshapo wafungwa wa watu wake, Yakobo na ashangilie, Israeli na afurahi!

english: Save me, O God, by Your name, and vindicate me by Your might!
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, ntoorie ase engencho y’erieta riao, ong’e oboronge bwane goetera ase okobua kwao.
swahili: Ee Mungu uniokoe kwa jina lako, unifanyie hukumu kwa uwezo wako.

english: Hear my prayer, O God; listen to the words of my mouth.
ekegusii: Nyasae, igwa ogosaba kwane; tegerera oigwe amang’ana aane ngokwana.
swahili: Ee Mungu, sikia maombi yangu, usikilize maneno ya kinywa changu.

english: For strangers rise up against me, and ruthless men seek my life— men with no regard for God. Selah
ekegusii: Abanto abamwenu bang’umokeire kong’ita, na abanto abatindi nigo baganetie obogima bwane; abwo tibakoirogeti aye Nyasae.
swahili: Wageni wananishambulia, watu wakatili wanayatafuta maisha yangu, watu wasiomjali Mungu.

english: Surely God is my helper; the Lord is the sustainer of my soul.
ekegusii: Nimanyete ng’a Nyasae nere omokonyi one, Omonene nere orendete obogima bwane.
swahili: Hakika Mungu ni msaada wangu, Bwana ndiye anayenitegemeza.

english: He will reward my enemies with evil. In Your faithfulness, destroy them.
ekegusii: Nairanerie ababisa baane obobe bwabo. Aye Omonene, obasirie, ekiagera igo ore omwegenwa.
swahili: Mabaya na yawarudie wale wanaonisingizia, kwa uaminifu wako uwaangamize.

english: Freely I will sacrifice to You; I will praise Your name, O LORD, for it is good.
ekegusii: Omonene, ninkoruere ekeng’wanso inde nenkoro y’ogwancha, nimbe nkoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono ase erieta riao, ekiagera nerigiya.
swahili: Nitakutolea dhabihu za hiari; Ee Bwana, nitalisifu jina lako kwa kuwa ni vyema.

english: For He has delivered me from every trouble, and my eyes have stared down my foes.
ekegusii: Aye gwantooririe ase emechando yonsi, na amaiso aane nigo arigereretie ababisa baane inde nomochengo.
swahili: Kwa maana ameniokoa katika shida zangu zote, na macho yangu yamewatazama adui zangu kwa ushindi.

english: Listen to my prayer, O God, and do not ignore my plea.
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, tegerera oigwe ogosaba kwane, tobaisa kwebisa toigwa ogosaba kw’ogosorora kwane.
swahili: Ee Mungu, sikiliza maombi yangu, wala usidharau hoja yangu.

english: Day and night they encircle the walls, while malice and trouble lie within.
ekegusii: bikoyoetanana igoro ase chindwaki omobaso na obotuko; amabe a mobosokano na emechando bire ase omochie oyio.
swahili: Usiku na mchana wanazunguka juu ya kuta zake, uovu na dhuluma vimo ndani yake.

english: Destruction is within; oppression and deceit never leave the streets.
ekegusii: Obosareku nigo boichire ime yaye, obong’ainereria na ogokorera abande bobe tibikorua ase chinchera chiaye.
swahili: Nguvu za uharibifu zinatenda kazi mjini, vitisho na uongo haviondoki mitaani mwake.

english: For it is not an enemy who insults me; that I could endure. It is not a foe who rises against me; from him I could hide.
ekegusii: Onye nomobisa ore gonchecheria, nanga nigo nare koremereria; naende onye nomobisa ore gonkorera bobe ase oboenenu, nanga nigo nare kwebisa.
swahili: Kama aliyenitukana ni adui yangu, ningevumilia, kama mtu mwovu angejiinua dhidi yangu, ningejificha asinione.

english: But it is you, a man like myself, my companion and close friend.
ekegusii: Korende bono naye ogonkorera bobe, aye oyo kwarenge obomo nainche, omosani tomanyaine.
swahili: Kumbe ni wewe, mwenzangu, mshiriki na rafiki yangu wa karibu,

english: We shared sweet fellowship together; we walked with the crowd into the house of God.
ekegusii: Nigo tware koba tokogamba amo amang’ana amaya ay’ogosemania, naende nigo tware koba togosasiima amo ase enyomba ya Nyasae.
swahili: ambaye awali tulifurahia ushirika mzuri, tulipokuwa tukienda na umati hekaluni mwa Mungu.

english: Let death seize them by surprise; let them go down to Sheol alive, for evil is with them in their homes.
ekegusii: Tiga amakweri abachere ababisa baane mobosokano, bagende gochia aase abakuure bare moyo; obobe nigo bore ase obomenyo bwabo, na ase chinkoro chiabo.
swahili: Kifo na kiwajie adui zangu ghafula, na washuke kuzimu wangali hai, kwa maana uovu upo ndani yao.

english: But I call to God, and the LORD saves me.
ekegusii: Korende inche nigo nkomorangeria Nyasae, nere Omonene nantoorie.
swahili: Lakini ninamwita Mungu, naye Bwana huniokoa.

english: Morning, noon, and night, I cry out in distress, and He hears my voice.
ekegusii: Kera omogoroba, na emambia, na mobaso gati, nigo nkwereera ase engencho y’emechando yane, n’Omonene naigwe eriogi riane.
swahili: Jioni, asubuhi na adhuhuri ninalia kwa huzuni, naye husikia sauti yangu.

english: He redeems my soul in peace from the battle waged against me, even though many oppose me.
ekegusii: Ere nantoorie, andende buya korwa ase esegi eyio nkorwana, ekiagera ababisa abange banyimokeire.
swahili: Huniokoa nikawa salama katika vita vilivyopangwa dhidi yangu, ingawa watu wengi hunipinga.

english: God will hear and humiliate them— the One enthroned for the ages— Selah because they do not change and they have no fear of God.
ekegusii: Nyasae oyio obeire okogamba korwa kare, nanyigwe inche, erio abue abanto abwo, ekiagera abwo tibari koonchoka na komoiroka Nyasae.
swahili: Mungu anayemiliki milele, atawasikia na kuwaadhibu, watu ambao hawabadilishi njia zao, wala hawana hofu ya Mungu.

english: Attend to me and answer me. I am restless in my complaint, and distraught
ekegusii: Inyigwe na ong’iranerie; inche nigo nkona‐korera na kweumia inde nobororo.
swahili: Nisikie na unijibu. Mawazo yangu yananisumbua na nimehangaishwa

english: My companion attacks his friends; he violates his covenant.
ekegusii: Oyorenge omosani one nigo aramborete okoboko kwaye, akore bobe ase abakorete omorembe nere, osaririe okobwatana kwaye kw’ogotianania.
swahili: Mwenzangu hushambulia rafiki zake, naye huvunja agano lake.

english: His speech is smooth as butter, but war is in his heart. His words are softer than oil, yet they are swords unsheathed.
ekegusii: Chinkwana chiaye nigo chiarenge chinyororo kobua amaguta atundire, korende ebirengererio biaye nebi’esegi; amang’ana aye nigo arenge amororo kobua amaguta, nonya naboigo nigo akonachanacha buna emioro.
swahili: Mazungumzo yake ni laini kama siagi, hata hivyo vita vimo moyoni mwake. Maneno yake ni mororo kuliko mafuta, hata hivyo ni upanga mkali uliofutwa.

english: Cast your burden upon the LORD and He will sustain you; He will never let the righteous be shaken.
ekegusii: Motweke Omonene chigurube chiao, nere nakobwate nokoboko kwaye akorende; ere tagotiga omonyaboronge abugwe namabe.
swahili: Mtwike Bwana fadhaa zako, naye atakutegemeza, hatamwacha kamwe mwenye haki wake aanguke.

english: But You, O God, will bring them down to the Pit of destruction; men of bloodshed and deceit will not live out half their days. But I will trust in You.
ekegusii: Korende abanto abaiti na abang’ainereria aye Nyasae nobaturunkanie gochia ase eoromomo, ekero bataraika ase ekeng’ese ki’obogima bwabo, korende inche nimbe nkwegenete aye Omonene.
swahili: Lakini wewe, Ee Mungu, utawashusha waovu katika shimo la uharibifu. Wenye kiu ya kumwaga damu na wenye hila, hawataishi nusu ya siku zao. Lakini mimi ninakutumaini wewe.

english: at the voice of the enemy, at the pressure of the wicked. For they release disaster upon me and revile me in their anger.
ekegusii: Ninde nobwoba ase engencho y’amariogi ’ababisa baane, na ase engencho y’obobe bw’abakori amabe. Abanto abwo nigo bakondetera amaakwa, bakongecha bare nendamwamu.
swahili: kwa sauti ya adui, kwa kukaziwa macho na waovu, kwa sababu wananiletea mateso juu yangu na kunitukana kwa hasira zao.

english: My heart murmurs within me, and the terrors of death assail me.
ekegusii: Enkoro yane nigo ere nomoichano, nasoirwe nokogoswa kw’amakweri.
swahili: Moyo wangu umejaa uchungu, hofu ya kifo imenishambulia.

english: Fear and trembling grip me, and horror has overwhelmed me.
ekegusii: Nasoirwe nobwoba na okoiguswa, nabuirwe nomoichano omonene.
swahili: Woga na kutetemeka vimenizunguka, hofu kuu imenigharikisha.

english: I said, “Oh, that I had wings like a dove! I would fly away and find rest.
ekegusii: Bono nigo ngoteeba: “Onye ndiria nabwate chimbaaba buna riruma, nanga nigo nare koiruruka ngende gotimoka.
swahili: Nilisema, “Laiti ningekuwa na mbawa za njiwa! Ningeruka niende mbali kupumzika.

english: How far away I would flee! In the wilderness I would remain. Selah
ekegusii: Ee, nigo nanga nare kogenda aare, imbe ntoorete ase erooro.
swahili: Ningalitorokea mbali sana na kukaa jangwani,

english: I would hurry to my shelter, far from this raging tempest.”
ekegusii: Nigo nare kominyoka chimbero, erinde inyenyorere aase nkwebisa, korwa ase omwaga omotindi na ekembugu‐mbugu.”
swahili: ningaliharakisha kwenda mahali pa salama, mbali na tufani kali na dhoruba.”

english: O Lord, confuse and confound their speech, for I see violence and strife in the city.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, saria emeroberio y’abanto abwo, otantanie chimeme chiabo tibaigwana. Narorire obotindi na amariomana bire agwo ase omochie,
swahili: Ee Bwana, uwatahayarishe waovu na uwachanganyishie semi zao, maana nimeona jeuri na ugomvi mjini.

english: Be merciful to me, O God, for men are hounding me; all day they press their attack.
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, indorere amaabera, ekiagera abanto nigo baganetie ng’a bang’ite bansirie kegima; omobaso boira ababisa baane nigo bakondwania esegi.
swahili: Ee Mungu unihurumie, maana watu wananifuatia vikali; mchana kutwa wanazidisha mashambulizi yao.

english: In God, whose word I praise, in the LORD, whose word I praise,
ekegusii: Ase okobua kwa Nyasae nintogie ring’ana riaye; ee, ase okobua kw’Omonene nintogie ring’ana riaye.
swahili: Katika Mungu, ambaye neno lake ninalisifu, katika Bwana, ambaye neno lake ninalisifu,

english: in God I trust; I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
ekegusii: Nigo nsemeretie Nyasae ntari nobwoba. Inee! Mwanyabaanto inki aranyare gonkorera?
swahili: katika Mungu ninatumaini, sitaogopa. Mwanadamu anaweza kunitenda nini?

english: Your vows are upon me, O God; I will render thank offerings to You.
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, goika ng’ikeranie chiira nakorierete; naende ninkoruere ebing’wanso bi’okoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono.
swahili: Ee Mungu, nina nadhiri kwako, nitakutolea wewe sadaka zangu za shukrani.

english: For You have delivered my soul from death, and my feet from stumbling, that I may walk before God in the light of life.
ekegusii: Aye gwatooririe omoyo one korwa ase amakweri, ee, gwatangire amagoro aane tagwa, erinde inyare gotaara ase obosio bwao, aye Nyasae, ase oborabu bw’abwo bare moyo.
swahili: Kwa kuwa umeniokoa toka kwenye mauti na miguu yangu kwenye kujikwaa, ili niweze kuenenda mbele za Mungu katika nuru ya uzima.

english: My enemies pursue me all day long, for many proudly assail me.
ekegusii: Omobaso boira ababisa baane nigo bakondigia baamere, ee, mbare abange mono bakondwania ase oboenenu.
swahili: Wasingiziaji wangu wananifuatia mchana kutwa, wengi wananishambulia kwa kiburi chao.

english: When I am afraid, I put my trust in You.
ekegusii: Ekero inde nobwoba, nigo ngosemeretie.
swahili: Wakati ninapoogopa, nitakutumaini wewe.

english: In God, whose word I praise— in God I trust. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
ekegusii: Ase okobua kwa Nyasae nintogie ring’ana riaye, ninsemeretie Nyasae ntari nobwoba. Inee! Mwanyabaanto inki baranyare gonkorera?
swahili: Katika Mungu, ambaye neno lake ninalisifu, katika Mungu ninatumaini; sitaogopa. Mwanadamu apatikanaye na kufa, atanitenda nini?

english: All day long they twist my words; all their thoughts are on my demise.
ekegusii: Omobaso boira ababisa baane nigo bakoonchorana amang’ana aane; ebirengererio biabo bionsi nigo bire ebibe igoro yane.
swahili: Mchana kutwa wanayageuza maneno yangu, siku zote wanapanga shauri la kunidhuru.

english: They conspire, they lurk, they watch my steps while they wait to take my life.
ekegusii: Nigo bagosangererekana amo baroberia komboera, barigererie kera egento ngokora; naboigo bagendererete korigia obogima bwane babosirie.
swahili: Wananifanyia hila, wanajificha, wanatazama hatua zangu, wakiwa na shauku ya kuutoa uhai wangu.

english: In spite of such sin, will they escape? In Your anger, O God, cast down the nations.
ekegusii: Inee! Nabatooreke korwa ase obobe buna obwo? Taibo. Aye Nyasae, basirie abanto abwo kegima nendamwamu yao entindi.
swahili: Wasiepuke kwa vyovyote, Ee Mungu, katika hasira yako yaangushe mataifa.

english: You have taken account of my wanderings. Put my tears in Your bottle— are they not in Your book?
ekegusii: Omonene, aye nomanyete okoong’anya kwane, nigo osangereretie amariga aane okayabeka ase egetono kiao. Inee! Ayio onsi tarikiri ase egetabu yao?
swahili: Andika maombolezo yangu, orodhesha machozi yangu katika gombo lako: je, haya hayapo katika kumbukumbu zako?

english: Then my enemies will retreat on the day I cry for help. By this I will know that God is on my side.
ekegusii: Ekero ndarangerie Omonene, ababisa baane mbairanigwe gochia magega. Nimanyete kegima ng’a Nyasae nigo are ase ensemo yane.
swahili: Ndipo adui zangu watarudi nyuma ninapoita msaada. Kwa hili nitajua kwamba Mungu yuko upande wangu.

english: Have mercy on me, O God, have mercy, for in You my soul takes refuge. In the shadow of Your wings I will take shelter until the danger has passed.
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, indorera amaabera, indorera amaabera, ekiagera naye natameire nomoyo one. Nintame nyebise inse ase ekiriri gie chimbaaba chiao, goika omwaga bw’ogosiria oete.
swahili: Unihurumie, Ee Mungu, unihurumie, kwa maana nafsi yangu inakukimbilia. Chini ya uvuli wa mbawa zako nitakimbilia mpaka maafa yapite.

english: For Your loving devotion reaches to the heavens, and Your faithfulness to the clouds.
ekegusii: Amabera ao nigo are amanene aigete aaria igoro; obwegenwa bwao nigo boigete igoro ase amare.
swahili: Kwa maana upendo wako ni mkuu, waenea hadi mbinguni, uaminifu wako unazifikia anga.

english: Be exalted, O God, above the heavens; may Your glory cover all the earth.
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, oorokia ng’a nigo ore omonene goetania igoro chionsi, tiga obonene bwao bororekane ase ense yonsi.
swahili: Ee Mungu, utukuzwe juu mbinguni, utukufu wako na uwe duniani pote.

english: I cry out to God Most High, to God who fulfills His purpose for me.
ekegusii: Inche nigo nkorera ase Nyasae Ore Igoro Mono, ase Nyasae oria okong’ikeraneria onsi.
swahili: Namlilia Mungu Aliye Juu Sana, Mungu atimizaye makusudi yake kwangu.

english: He reaches down from heaven and saves me; He rebukes those who trample me. Selah God sends forth His loving devotion and His truth.
ekegusii: Omonene nantomere ogotooreka korwa igoro, nababue abwo bagonkorera bobe babe nobosooku. Nyasae naorokie amaabera aye na ekeene kiaye.
swahili: Hutumana kutoka mbinguni na kuniokoa, akiwakemea wale wanaonifuatilia vikali; Mungu huutuma upendo wake na uaminifu wake.

english: My soul is among the lions; I lie down with ravenous beasts— with men whose teeth are spears and arrows, whose tongues are sharp swords.
ekegusii: Omoyo one nigo oetananire ne chindo, nigo ndaire ase egati ya Mwanyabaanto bagoutoka omorero, amaino abo nigo are amoge buna amatimo ne chinsara, chimeme chiabo nigo chire emioro emioge.
swahili: Niko katikati ya simba, nimelala katikati ya wanyama wenye njaa kuu: watu ambao meno yao ni mikuki na mishale, ambao ndimi zao ni panga kali.

english: Be exalted, O God, above the heavens; may Your glory cover all the earth.
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, oorokie ng’a nigo ore omonene goetania igoro chionsi, tiga obonene bwao bororekane ase ense yonsi.
swahili: Ee Mungu, utukuzwe juu ya mbingu, utukufu wako na uenee duniani kote.

english: They spread a net for my feet; my soul was despondent. They dug a pit before me, but they themselves have fallen into it! Selah
ekegusii: Ababisa bantegeire oboreba ase ngoeta, bamionogoreire inse. Bakunyire eirima ase enchera yane, korende mbarabwo abanyene bagure imeo.
swahili: Waliitegea miguu yangu nyavu, nikainamishwa chini na dhiki. Wamechimba shimo katika njia yangu, lakini wametumbukia humo wao wenyewe.

english: My heart is steadfast, O God, my heart is steadfast. I will sing and make music.
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, enkoro yane nigo ere noboremu, ee, nigo ere noboremu; nintere na gochenga.
swahili: Ee Mungu, moyo wangu ni thabiti; nitaimba na kusifu kwa moyo wangu wote.

english: Awake, my glory! Awake, O harp and lyre! I will awaken the dawn.
ekegusii: Aye omoyo one, boka! Inwe amakano aane onsi, boka! Nainche nimboke mambia chuni.
swahili: Amka, nafsi yangu! Amka, kinubi na zeze! Nitayaamsha mapambazuko.

english: I will praise You, O Lord, among the nations; I will sing Your praises among the peoples.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ase egati y’abanto ninkoiranerie ng’a mbuya mono, nimbe ngotera amatera ay’okogotogia ase egati y’ebisaku.
swahili: Nitakusifu wewe, Ee Bwana, katikati ya mataifa; nitaimba habari zako, katikati ya jamaa za watu.

english: Do you indeed speak justly, O rulers? Do you judge uprightly, O sons of men?
ekegusii: Inwe abamokogamba, Inee, ngokwana more amang’ana ’ekeene? Inee! Nkonachera more abanto ebiina bire boronge?
swahili: Enyi watawala, je, kweli mwanena kwa haki? Je, mnahukumu kwa unyofu miongoni mwa watu?

english: The righteous will rejoice when they see they are avenged; they will wash their feet in the blood of the wicked.
ekegusii: Omonyene oboronge nagoke ekero egesiomba kegoakanwa, natiringe amanyinga ’abaanto abanyabibe.
swahili: Wenye haki watafurahi waonapo wakilipizwa kisasi, watakapochovya nyayo zao katika damu ya waovu.

english: Then men will say, “There is surely a reward for the righteous! There is surely a God who judges the earth!”
ekegusii: Erio abanto bateebe, “Ekeene, abanyaboronge nigo bakonyora eng’eria yabo; ekeene, Nyasae nareo okonacha ebiina ase ense.”
swahili: Ndipo wanadamu watasema, “Hakika utulivu wa wenye haki bado una thawabu, hakika kuna Mungu ahukumuye dunia.”

english: No, in your hearts you devise injustice; with your hands you mete out violence on the earth.
ekegusii: Yaya, nigo more nemeroberio emekorekanu ime ase chinkoro chiaino, amaboko aino nigo agokora obotindi bw’oborianania ase ense.
swahili: La, mioyoni mwenu mnatunga udhalimu, na mikono yenu hupima jeuri duniani.

english: The wicked are estranged from the womb; the liars go astray from birth.
ekegusii: Abakori amabe nigo basirete korwa chinda chi’abang’ina, abanyaborimo nigo bakoba abatantanu korwa engaki y’okoiborwa kwabo.
swahili: Waovu ni wapotovu tangu kuzaliwa kwao, toka tumboni mwa mama zao ni wakaidi na husema uongo.

english: Their venom is like the venom of a snake, like a cobra that shuts its ears,
ekegusii: Barabwo nigo babwate obosongo bonga buna obw’eng’iti, nigo banga buna rirubi rigoticha amato aye,
swahili: Sumu yao ni kama sumu ya nyoka, kama ile ya fira ambaye ameziba masikio yake,

english: refusing to hear the tune of the charmer who skillfully weaves his spell.
ekegusii: erinde tiriigwa amariogi abanyamosira, gose ay’abaebia b’obong’aini.
swahili: ambaye hatasikia sauti ya kutumbuiza ya mwaguzi, hata kama mganga angecheza kwa ustadi kiasi gani.

english: O God, shatter their teeth in their mouths; O LORD, tear out the fangs of the lions.
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, obune amaino ’emenwa yabo; aye Omonene, gokora amagegu e chindo chinsae!
swahili: Ee Mungu, yavunje meno katika vinywa vyao; Ee Bwana, vunja meno makali ya hao simba!

english: May they vanish like water that runs off; when they draw the bow, may their arrows be blunted.
ekegusii: Abanto abwo tiga basirigwe kegima buna amaache omogooko agoeta asira; ekero bakoruta emegwe yabo, eburoke.
swahili: Na watoweke kama maji yapitayo kwa kasi, wavutapo pinde zao, mishale yao na iwe butu.

english: Like a slug that dissolves in its slime, like a woman’s stillborn child, may they never see the sun.
ekegusii: Barabwo tiga babe buna amakorominyo akonyititoka amarenda aera, na buna oborito bw’omokuungu bokogwa botaraika engaki yaye.
swahili: Kama konokono ayeyukavyo akitembea, kama mtoto aliyezaliwa akiwa mfu, wasilione jua.

english: Before your pots can feel the burning thorns— whether green or dry— He will sweep them away.
ekegusii: Omonene nabasirie bwango, ee, bwango kobua chinyongo chiaino chitarabwata riberera ri’omorero bw’amagwa, karabe amabese gose amasusanu.
swahili: Kabla vyungu vyenu havijapata moto wa kuni za miiba, zikiwa mbichi au kavu, waovu watakuwa wamefagiliwa mbali.

english: Deliver me from my enemies, O my God; protect me from those who rise against me.
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae one, ntoorie korwa ase ababisa baane, indende korwa ase abanto aba banyimokeire gonkora bobe.
swahili: Ee Mungu, uniokoe na adui zangu, unilinde kutokana na hao wanaoinuka dhidi yangu.

english: My God of loving devotion will come to meet me; God will let me stare down my foes.
ekegusii: Nyasae one nigo agonchichera nobwanchani bwaye botari koera, Nyasae one nankore nchenge igoro y’ababisa baane.
swahili: Mungu wangu unipendaye. Mungu atanitangulia, naye atanifanya niwachekelee wale wanaonisingizia.

english: Do not kill them, or my people will forget. Scatter them by Your power, and bring them down, O Lord, our shield.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, enguba yaito, tobaisa kobaita! Abanto baane nigo barabaise kweba. Obaomboganie ase chinguru chiao, erio omanye kobasiria.
swahili: Lakini usiwaue, Ee Bwana, ngao yetu, au sivyo watu wangu watasahau. Katika uwezo wako wafanye watangetange na uwashushe chini.

english: By the sins of their mouths and the words of their lips, let them be trapped in their pride, in the curses and lies they utter.
ekegusii: Ebibe nigo bire ase emenwa yabo, na amang’ana bagokwana namabe. Ase igo, tiga oboenenu bwabo bobabwate buna oboreba bokobwata. Barabwo nigo bakoragereria na gokwana amang’ana ’oborimo.
swahili: Kwa ajili ya dhambi za vinywa vyao, kwa ajili ya maneno ya midomo yao, waache wanaswe katika kiburi chao. Kwa ajili ya laana na uongo wanaotamka,

english: Consume them in wrath; consume them till they are no more, so it may be known to the ends of the earth that God rules over Jacob. Selah
ekegusii: Ase ayio, obasirie nendamwamu yao; basirie kegima, onde tanyorekana ore moyo nonya noyomo, erio abanto b’ense yonsi mbamanye ng’a Nyasae nere okogambera abanto ba Yakobo.
swahili: wateketeze katika ghadhabu, wateketeze hadi wasiwepo tena. Ndipo itakapofahamika katika miisho ya dunia kwamba Mungu anatawala juu ya Yakobo.

english: They return in the evening, snarling like dogs and prowling around the city.
ekegusii: Kera omogoroba nigo bakoirana, baetanana omochie, bakoga buna chisese.
swahili: Hurudi jioni, wakibweka kama mbwa, wakiuzurura mji.

english: They scavenge for food, and growl if they are not satisfied.
ekegusii: Nigo bakoong’anya korigia endagera, batayenyoreti nigo bakogeesa bokia.
swahili: Wanatangatanga wakitafuta chakula, wasipotosheka hubweka kama mbwa.

english: But I will sing of Your strength and proclaim Your loving devotion in the morning. For You are my fortress, my refuge in times of trouble.
ekegusii: Korende inche nintere igoro y’okobua kwao, kera emambia nintere neriogi rinene igoro y’obwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe, ekiagera ase chingaki chi’emechando nigo kwabeire egekengero kiane na obotamero bwane.
swahili: Lakini mimi nitaziimba nguvu zako, asubuhi nitaimba juu ya upendo wako; kwa maana wewe ndiwe ngome yangu na kimbilio langu wakati wa shida.

english: To You, O my strength, I sing praises, for You, O God, are my fortress, my God of loving devotion.
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae ore chinguru chiane, nintere ogoteera gw’okogotogia; aye naye egekengero kiane, aye naye Nyasae onyanchete mono.
swahili: Ee uliye Nguvu zangu, ninakuimbia sifa. Wewe, Ee Mungu, ndiwe ngome yangu, Mungu unipendaye.

english: Deliver me from workers of iniquity, and save me from men of bloodshed.
ekegusii: Nkonye korwa ase abakori amabe; ntoorie korwa ase abaiteri amanyinga.
swahili: Uniponye na watu watendao mabaya, uniokoe kutokana na wamwagao damu.

english: See how they lie in wait for me. Fierce men conspire against me for no transgression or sin of my own, O LORD.
ekegusii: Rora, abanto aba bebisete na komboera bang’ite, abanto abatindi basangererekanire amo bankore bobe; Omonene, ayio tari ase engencho y’ogosaria gose ebibe nakorire.
swahili: Tazama wanavyonivizia! Watu wakali wananifanyia hila, ingawa Ee Bwana, mimi sijakosea wala kutenda dhambi.

english: For no fault of my own, they move swiftly to attack me. Arise to help me, and take notice.
ekegusii: Tindakora bobe bonde bokogera baminyoke gocha gonkora bobe. Omonene imoka, orore amang’ana ayio, onkonye!
swahili: Sijatenda kosa; hata hivyo wako tayari kunishambulia. Inuka unisaidie, uone hali yangu mbaya!

english: O LORD God of Hosts, the God of Israel, rouse Yourself to punish all the nations; show no mercy to the wicked traitors. Selah
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, Nyasae bw’Emeganda, naye Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli! Imoka, orue egesusuro ase abanto b’ebisaku bionsi, tobaisa gotigaria nonya noyomo ore moyo ase abwo bagokora amabe ase obong’ainereria.
swahili: Ee Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, Mungu wa Israeli! Zinduka uyaadhibu mataifa yote, usionyeshe huruma kwa wasaliti.

english: They return in the evening, snarling like dogs and prowling around the city.
ekegusii: Kera omogoroba nigo bakoirana, baetanana omochie, bakoga buna chisese.
swahili: Hurudi wakati wa jioni, wakibweka kama mbwa, wakiuzurura mji.

english: See what they spew from their mouths— sharp words from their lips: “For who can hear us?”
ekegusii: Oise kobarigereria, orore buna bakona‐gokwana‐kwana! Ebikoba biabo nigo bire buna emioro emioge, bateba: “Ning’o oranyare gotoigwa?”
swahili: Tazama yale wanayotema kutoka vinywa vyao, hutema upanga kutoka midomo yao, nao husema, “Ni nani atakayetusikia?”

english: But You, O LORD, laugh at them; You scoff at all the nations.
ekegusii: Korende aye Omonene nigo okobasekerera, aye nigo ogochecheria abanto bonsi batakomanyeti.
swahili: Lakini wewe, Bwana, uwacheke; unayadharau mataifa hayo yote.

english: I will keep watch for You, O my strength, because You, O God, are my fortress.
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae ore chinguru chiane, nimbe nkoganyete, ekiagera naye ore obotamero obokong’u.
swahili: Ee nguvu yangu, ninakutazama wewe, wewe, Ee Mungu, ndiwe ngome yangu,

english: Give ear to my words, O LORD; consider my groaning.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, tegerera oigwe amang’ana aane; oiraneria egekoe kiane.
swahili: Ee Bwana, tegea sikio maneno yangu, uangalie kupiga kite kwangu.

english: Declare them guilty, O God; let them fall by their own devices. Drive them out for their many transgressions, for they have rebelled against You.
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, obae egesusuro ase ebibe biabo: emeroberio eyio bakorire tiga egere bagwe. Obaserie kegima, ekiagera basaririe asore, na ekiagera bangire gokoigwera.
swahili: Uwatangaze kuwa wenye hatia, Ee Mungu! Hila zao ziwe anguko lao wenyewe. Wafukuzie mbali kwa sababu ya dhambi zao nyingi, kwa kuwa wamekuasi wewe.

english: But let all who take refuge in You rejoice; let them ever shout for joy. May You shelter them, that those who love Your name may rejoice in You.
ekegusii: Abanto bonsi abakogotamera mbabe nomogooko, barabwo mbatere kogenderera botambe na gochenga. Aye igo orakengere abwo banchete erieta riao, erio banyare koba nomogooko omonene ase engencho yao.
swahili: Lakini wote wakimbiliao kwako na wafurahi, waimbe kwa shangwe daima. Ueneze ulinzi wako juu yao, ili wale wapendao jina lako wapate kukushangilia.

english: For surely You, O LORD, bless the righteous; You surround them with the shield of Your favor.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene nigo ogosesenia omonyene oboronge na komotuba n’obuya bwao bw’amaabera buna enguba.
swahili: Kwa hakika, Ee Bwana, unawabariki wenye haki, unawazunguka kwa wema wako kama ngao.

english: Attend to the sound of my cry, my King and my God, for to You I pray.
ekegusii: Aye omorwoti one, aye Nyasae one, tegerera oigwe amang’ana ’okorera kwane, ekiagera naye ngosaba.
swahili: Sikiliza kilio changu ili unisaidie, Mfalme wangu na Mungu wangu, kwa maana kwako ninaomba.

english: In the morning, O LORD, You hear my voice; at daybreak I lay my plea before You and wait in expectation.
ekegusii: Omonene, aye nigo okoigwa ogosaba kwane maambia; kobogokiamoka nigo nkobeka okogania kwane obosio bwao, erio naganya ntegesetie.
swahili: Asubuhi, unasikia sauti yangu, Ee Bwana; asubuhi naleta haja zangu mbele zako, na kusubiri kwa matumaini.

english: For You are not a God who delights in wickedness; no evil can dwell with You.
ekegusii: Aye tori Nyasae bwanchete ogokora okobe. Oyogokora ebibe takonyara komenya amo naye.
swahili: Wewe si Mungu unayefurahia uovu, kwako mtu mwovu hataishi.

english: The boastful cannot stand in Your presence; You hate all workers of iniquity.
ekegusii: Abanto abaenenu tibakonyara gotenena obosio bwao, nigo ogechete abakori amabe bonsi.
swahili: Wenye kiburi hawawezi kusimama mbele yako, unawachukia wote watendao mabaya.

english: You destroy those who tell lies; the LORD abhors the man of bloodshed and deceit.
ekegusii: Aye nigo orasirie abanyaborimo bonsi; aye Omonene nigo ogechete abaiteri amanyinga na abang’ainereria.
swahili: Unawaangamiza wasemao uongo. Bwana huwachukia wamwagao damu na wadanganyifu.

english: But I will enter Your house by the abundance of Your loving devotion; in reverence I will bow down toward Your holy temple.
ekegusii: Korende ase engencho y’obonge bw’obwanchani bwao botari koera ninsoe nyomba mwao; nigo ndasasime ndigereretie Hekalu yao Enchenu na nimbe ngokoiroka.
swahili: Lakini mimi, kwa rehema zako kuu, nitakuja katika nyumba yako, kwa unyenyekevu, nitasujudu kuelekea Hekalu lako takatifu.

english: Lead me, O LORD, in Your righteousness because of my enemies; make straight Your way before me.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, nigo mbwate ababisa abange, ase ayio, ondaae ase oboronge bwao; roisia enchera yao ase ngoetera ebe endonge.
swahili: Niongoze katika haki yako, Ee Bwana, kwa sababu ya adui zangu, nyoosha njia yako mbele yangu.

english: For not a word they speak can be trusted; destruction lies within them. Their throats are open graves; their tongues practice deceit.
ekegusii: Amang’ana ababisa baane bagokwana nay’oborimo, chinkoro chiabo nigo chire nemeroberio y’ogosiria kegima; emioyo yabo noboina bwasie, chimeme chiabo nigo chigokwana amang’ana amansu ay’ogosiria.
swahili: Hakuna neno kinywani mwao linaloweza kuaminika, mioyo yao imejaa maangamizi. Koo lao ni kaburi lililo wazi, kwa ndimi zao, wao hunena udanganyifu.

english: You have rejected us, O God; You have broken us; You have been angry; restore us!
ekegusii: Nyasae, aye gwatwangire na gwatosiareire, kwabeire kore nendamwamu, toiranerie amaya aito.
swahili: Ee Mungu, umetukataa na kutokea ghafula juu yetu, umekasirika: sasa turejeshe upya!

english: Have You not rejected us, O God? Will You no longer march out, O God, with our armies?
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, Inee, ngwatotigire kegima? Aye tori kogenda amo nabarwani baito b’esegi.
swahili: Ee Mungu, si ni wewe uliyetukataa sisi, na hutoki tena na majeshi yetu?

english: Give us aid against the enemy, for the help of man is worthless.
ekegusii: Tokonye torwanie ababisa baito tobabue, ekiagera ogokonywa kwa Mwanyabaanto mbosa.
swahili: Tuletee msaada dhidi ya adui, kwa maana msaada wa mwanadamu haufai kitu.

english: With God we will perform with valor, and He will trample our enemies.
ekegusii: Ekero tore amo na Nyasae, inatokore amang’ana amanene, nere orabue ababisa baito na kobatiringera inse.
swahili: Kwa msaada wa Mungu tutapata ushindi, naye atawaponda adui zetu.

english: You have shaken the land and torn it open. Heal its fractures, for it is quaking.
ekegusii: Aye gwatengechirie ense na koyetandora; iraneria naende amatandoku ayio, ekiagera nigo egotengecha mono.
swahili: Umetetemesha nchi na kuipasua; uiponye mavunjiko yake, kwa maana inatetemeka.

english: You have shown Your people hardship; we are staggered from the wine You made us drink.
ekegusii: Gwakorire abanto bao babeire nemechando emekong’u; gwatonyoisirie edivai yatotindirie na gotoong’anyia.
swahili: Umewaonyesha watu wako nyakati za kukata tamaa; umetunywesha mvinyo unaotuyumbisha.

english: You have raised a banner for those who fear You, that they may flee the bow. Selah
ekegusii: Aye kwaeire abanto abwo bakoirogete ekemanyererio, kenyare koimokererigwa igoro ase ogotenenera ekeene.
swahili: Kwa wale wanaokucha wewe, umewainulia bendera, ili iweze kutwekwa dhidi ya upinde.

english: Respond and save us with Your right hand, that Your beloved may be delivered.
ekegusii: Igo nonyare gotooria abanto abwo gwanchete; otoe obobui goetera ase okoboko kwao gw’okorio, oigwe ogosaba gwaito.
swahili: Tuokoe na utusaidie kwa mkono wako wa kuume, ili wale uwapendao wapate kuokolewa.

english: God has spoken from His sanctuary: “I will triumph! I will parcel out Shechem and apportion the Valley of Succoth.
ekegusii: Nyasae okwanire korwa ase Obomenyo bwaye Obochenu, ogoteeba, “Ase omochengo ninyatanane Sekemu, na ense omweya ya Sukoti inyiate chincherere.
swahili: Mungu amenena kutoka patakatifu pake: “Nitaigawa Shekemu kwa ushindi na kulipima Bonde la Sukothi.

english: Gilead is Mine, and Manasseh is Mine; Ephraim is My helmet, Judah is My scepter.
ekegusii: Gileadi neyane, na Manase neyane; Efraimu nekegogwa kiane gi’ekioma, na Yuda nenyimbo yane y’obogambi.
swahili: Gileadi ni yangu na Manase ni yangu; Efraimu ni kofia yangu ya chuma, nayo Yuda ni fimbo yangu ya utawala.

english: Moab is My washbasin; upon Edom I toss My sandal; over Philistia I shout in triumph.”
ekegusii: Moabu negetaabo kiane ngoisabera; nindute egekoroto kiane igoro ase Edomu, ning’ake eriogi ri’okobua igoro y’ense y’Abafilisti.”
swahili: Moabu ni sinia langu la kunawia, juu ya Edomu natupa kiatu changu; nashangilia kwa kushindwa kwa Ufilisti.”

english: Hear my cry, O God; attend to my prayer.
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae one, igwa ekerero kiane; tegerera oigwe ogosaba kwane.
swahili: Ee Mungu, sikia kilio changu, usikilize maombi yangu.

english: From the ends of the earth I call out to You whenever my heart is faint. Lead me to the rock that is higher than I.
ekegusii: Ekero enkoro yane yarusirie moyo, nigo ngokorangeria korwa ase chinsinyo chi’ense. Aye ondaae gochia egetare keria kere egetambe mono kombua.
swahili: Kutoka miisho ya dunia ninakuita, ninaita huku moyo wangu unadhoofika; uniongoze kwenye mwamba ule ulio juu kuliko mimi.

english: For You have been my refuge, a tower of strength against the enemy.
ekegusii: Aye naye obotamero bwane, eburi enkong’u egonkengera korwa ase ababisa baane.
swahili: Kwa kuwa umekuwa kimbilio langu, ngome imara dhidi ya adui.

english: Let me dwell in Your tent forever and take refuge in the shelter of Your wings. Selah
ekegusii: Ing’a ribaga ingenderere komenya botambe ase eema yao; ninganetie inyore oborendi obuya inse y’ekiriri gie chimbaaba chiao.
swahili: Natamani kukaa hemani mwako milele, na kukimbilia chini ya uvuli wa mbawa zako.

english: For You have heard my vows, O God; You have given me the inheritance reserved for those who fear Your name.
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae kwaigure chiira chiane narire ase ogotiana, abanto bairogete erieta riao kwabaeire omwando obo.
swahili: Ee Mungu, kwa kuwa umesikia nadhiri zangu, umenipa urithi wa wale wanaoliogopa jina lako.

english: Increase the days of the king’s life; may his years span many generations.
ekegusii: Omentere omorwoti amatuko agenderere koba moyo; emiaka yaye ebe ey’ebiaare ebinge.
swahili: Mwongezee mfalme siku za maisha yake, miaka yake kwa vizazi vingi.

english: May he sit enthroned in God’s presence forever; appoint Your loving devotion and Your faithfulness to guard him.
ekegusii: Tiga agenderere botambe koba omorwoti ase obosio bwao aye Nyasae; obwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe, na obwegenwa bwao, bimorende.
swahili: Yeye na atawazwe kwenye kiti cha enzi mbele za Mungu milele; amuru upendo wako na uaminifu wako vimlinde.

english: Then I will ever sing praise to Your name and fulfill my vows day by day.
ekegusii: Igo nimbe ngotera ase ogotogia erieta riao botambe, naende rituko ase rituko imbe ngoikerania chiira chiane.
swahili: Ndipo daima nitaliimbia sifa jina lako na kuzitimiza nadhiri zangu siku baada ya siku.

english: In God alone my soul finds rest; my salvation comes from Him.
ekegusii: Omoyo one nigo oganyete Nyasae bweka ase okonyora obotoereru; ogotooreka kwane nigo gokorwa asare.
swahili: Kwa Mungu peke yake nafsi yangu inapata pumziko; wokovu wangu watoka kwake.

english: Place no trust in extortion, or false hope in stolen goods. If your riches increase, do not set your heart upon them.
ekegusii: Timobaisa gosemeria obourereria, timobaisa koba nogosemeria kwa bosa ase ebinto bi’oboibi. Onye obotenenku bwaino bwabeire obonge, timobaisa kobosemeria.
swahili: Usitumainie vya udhalimu wala usijivune kwa vitu vya wizi; ingawa utajiri wako utaongezeka, usiviwekee moyo wako.

english: God has spoken once; I have heard this twice: that power belongs to God,
ekegusii: Nyasae okwanire ara rimo, ee, nabeire nkoyaigwa chintunda ibere, ng’a Nyasae nere omonyene okobua.
swahili: Jambo moja Mungu amelisema, mambo mawili nimeyasikia: kwamba, Ee Mungu, wewe una nguvu,

english: and loving devotion to You, O Lord. For You will repay each man according to his deeds.
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, nigo ore nobwanchani bogendererete botambe; aye nigo ogoakana omonto koreng’ana buna emeremo yaye ere.
swahili: na kwamba, Ee Bwana, wewe ni mwenye upendo. Hakika utampa kila mtu thawabu kwa kadiri ya alivyotenda.

english: He alone is my rock and my salvation. He is my fortress; I will never be shaken.
ekegusii: Ere nere bweka egetare kiane, na ogotooreka kwane, nere orwaki rwane, tinkonyegerigwa mono.
swahili: Yeye peke yake ndiye mwamba wangu na wokovu wangu; yeye ni ngome yangu, sitatikisika kamwe.

english: How long will you threaten a man? Will all of you throw him down like a leaning wall or a tottering fence?
ekegusii: Inee! Inwe mwensi, ngoika ririri moragenderere korwania omonto ore bweka, erinde momoakere inse, inwe mwensi amo, buna nigo are enyasi ere ang’e kogwa na orwaki rwatandokire?
swahili: Mtamshambulia mtu hata lini? Je, ninyi nyote mtamtupa chini, ukuta huu ulioinama na uzio huu unaotikisika?

english: They fully intend to cast him down from his lofty perch; they delight in lies; with their mouths they bless, but inwardly they curse. Selah
ekegusii: Abanto abwo nigo bakoroberia bamoiyerie korwa ase obonene bwaye. Barabwo nigo bakogokigwa mono gokwana oborimo; nigo bagosesenia nebikoba biabo bosa, korende ase chinkoro chiabo ime nigo bakoragereria.
swahili: Walikusudia kikamilifu kumwangusha toka mahali pake pa fahari; wanafurahia uongo. Kwa vinywa vyao hubariki, lakini ndani ya mioyo yao hulaani.

english: Rest in God alone, O my soul, for my hope comes from Him.
ekegusii: Omoyo one nigo omoganyete Nyasae bweka ase okonyora obotoereru; ogosemeria kwane nigo gokorwa asare.
swahili: Ee nafsi yangu, upumzike, kwa Mungu peke yake, tumaini langu latoka kwake.

english: He alone is my rock and my salvation; He is my fortress; I will not be shaken.
ekegusii: Ere bweka negetare kiane, na ogotooreka kwane, na egekengero kiane egekong’u; tinkonyegerigwa.
swahili: Yeye peke yake ndiye mwamba wangu na wokovu wangu; ndiye ngome yangu, sitatikisika.

english: My salvation and my honor rest on God, my strong rock; my refuge is in God.
ekegusii: Ogotooreka kwane, na obonene bwane, nigo bikonyorekana ase Nyasae. Nyasae negetare kiane gie chinguru, na obotamero bwane.
swahili: Wokovu wangu na heshima yangu viko kwa Mungu, ndiye mwamba wangu wenye nguvu na kimbilio langu.

english: Trust in Him at all times, O people; pour out your hearts before Him. God is our refuge. Selah
ekegusii: Inwe abanto, mwegene Omonene ase chingaki chionsi, morentere emechando yaino; Nyasae nere obotamero bwaito.
swahili: Enyi watu, mtumainini yeye wakati wote, miminieni mioyo yenu kwake, kwa kuwa Mungu ni kimbilio letu.

english: Lowborn men are but a vapor, the exalted but a lie. Weighed on the scale, they go up; together they are but a vapor.
ekegusii: Ekeene, Mwanyabaanto nigo bare buna omooki rioka, abanto baeire obonene nigo bare bosa; ekero bakorengwa nigo bare abagusu; bonsi nigo bare abagusu kobua omooki.
swahili: Binadamu wa ngazi ya chini ni pumzi tu, nao wa ngazi ya juu ni uongo tu; wakipimwa kwenye mizani, si chochote; wote kwa pamoja ni pumzi tu.

english: O God, You are my God. Earnestly I seek You; my soul thirsts for You. My body yearns for You in a dry and weary land without water.
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, Nyasae one, naye ngotang’ana korigia. Omoyo one nigo ore nerang’o asore, na omobere one nigo okoganetie, ase ense y’eguru‐gura enyomo pa etari namaache.
swahili: Ee Mungu, wewe ni Mungu wangu, nakutafuta kwa moyo wote; nafsi yangu inakuonea kiu, mwili wangu unakuonea wewe shauku, katika nchi kame na iliyochoka mahali ambapo hapana maji.

english: They will fall to the power of the sword; they will become a portion for foxes.
ekegusii: Barabwo nigo bararuegwe baitwe nemioro, babe endagera ye chisese chi’orosana.
swahili: Watatolewa wafe kwa upanga, nao watakuwa chakula cha mbweha.

english: But the king will rejoice in God; all who swear by Him will exult, for the mouths of liars will be shut.
ekegusii: Nonya naboigo omorwoti nabe okogoka ase Nyasae, na abanto bonsi abagotiana asare mbabe bagwetogia, korende emenwa y’abanto bagokwana oborimo nekirigwe.
swahili: Bali mfalme atafurahi katika Mungu, wale wote waapao kwa jina la Mungu watamsifu, bali vinywa vya waongo vitanyamazishwa.

english: So I have seen You in the sanctuary and beheld Your power and glory.
ekegusii: Nabeire ngokorigia ase Obomenyo Obochenu, erinde ndore okobua kwao na obonene bwao.
swahili: Nimekuona katika mahali patakatifu na kuuona uwezo wako na utukufu wako.

english: Because Your loving devotion is better than life, my lips will glorify You.
ekegusii: Obwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe nigo bore obuya kobua obogima, ase ayio nimbe nkogotogia nomonwa one.
swahili: Kwa sababu upendo wako ni bora kuliko uhai, midomo yangu itakuadhimisha.

english: So I will bless You as long as I live; in Your name I will lift my hands.
ekegusii: Nimbe nkona‐kogotogia ase obogima bwane bwonsi, ase erieta riao nindambore amaboko aane gochia igoro.
swahili: Nitakusifu siku zote za maisha yangu, na kwa jina lako nitainua mikono yangu.

english: My soul is satisfied as with the richest of foods; with joyful lips my mouth will praise You.
ekegusii: Omoyo one oisanekire buna oyorire obonoru bw’emeseto na ebitinya, nimbe nkogotogia nomonwa one ore nebikoba bire nomogooko.
swahili: Nafsi yangu itatoshelezwa kama kwa wingi wa vyakula; kwa midomo iimbayo kinywa changu kitakusifu wewe.

english: When I remember You on my bed, I think of You through the watches of the night.
ekegusii: Ekero indaire ase oborere bwane, nigo nkoba nkorengereretie, ase obotuko obogima ebirengererio biane nigo bikona‐gokoiranerera.
swahili: Kitandani mwangu ninakukumbuka wewe, ninawaza juu yako makesha yote ya usiku.

english: For You are my help; I will sing for joy in the shadow of Your wings.
ekegusii: Aye kwabeire botambe ogokonya kwane, na inse y’ekiiriri gie chimbaaba chiao nintere nomogooko.
swahili: Kwa sababu wewe ndiwe msaada wangu, chini ya uvuli wa mbawa zako naimba.

english: My soul clings to You; Your right hand upholds me.
ekegusii: Omoyo one nokobwaterere mono, ekiagera aye nonsiirete nokoboko kwao gw’okorio.
swahili: Nafsi yangu inaambatana nawe, mkono wako wa kuume hunishika.

english: But those who seek my life to destroy it will go into the depths of the earth.
ekegusii: Abanto abwo bakorigia gosiria obogima bwane, mbagende gochia inse kegima y’ense.
swahili: Wale wanaotafuta uhai wangu wataharibiwa, watakwenda chini kwenye vilindi vya dunia.

english: Hear, O God, my voice of complaint; preserve my life from dread of the enemy.
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, igwa eriogi riane ekero nkorera; renda obogima bwane korwa ase omobisa oyo okongosa.
swahili: Ee Mungu, unisikie ninapoeleza lalamiko langu, uyahifadhi maisha yangu kutokana na vitisho vya adui.

english: Let the righteous rejoice in the LORD and take refuge in Him; let all the upright in heart exult.
ekegusii: Abanyene oboronge mbabe nomogooko ase Omonene na komotamera. Abwo bare ne chinkoro chindonge mbabe bagwetogia.
swahili: Wenye haki na wafurahi katika Bwana, na wakimbilie kwake; wanyofu wote wa moyo na wamsifu yeye!

english: Hide me from the scheming of the wicked, from the mob of workers of iniquity,
ekegusii: Imbise korwa ase emeroberio ya bobisi y’abakori amabe, korwa ase eburu-buru y’abakori ebibe.
swahili: Unifiche kutokana na shauri la siri la waovu, kutokana na zile kelele za kundi la watenda mabaya.

english: who sharpen their tongues like swords and aim their bitter words like arrows,
ekegusii: Abwo nigo bagotieria chimeme chiabo buna emioro, amang’ana bagokwana nigo are nobororo, anga buna chinsara.
swahili: Wananoa ndimi zao kama panga na kuelekeza maneno yao kama mishale ya kufisha.

english: ambushing the innocent in seclusion, shooting suddenly, without fear.
ekegusii: Korwa ase baboeete nigo bakorasa omonto otari na komocha, bamorasa chinsara mobosokano batari nobwoba.
swahili: Hurusha mishale kutoka kwenye mavizio kwa mtu asiye na hatia, humrushia ghafula bila woga.

english: They hold fast to their evil purpose; they speak of hiding their snares. “Who will see them?” they say.
ekegusii: Barabwo nigo bakobeekana chinguru ase ogokora ebibe ebio barobeirie; nigo bagokwana amo igoro y’ogotegera abande oboreba bobisi, bagoteebania: “Ning’o torooche?”
swahili: Kila mmoja humtia moyo mwenzake katika mipango mibaya; huzungumza juu ya kuficha mitego yao, nao husema, “Ni nani ataiona?”

english: They devise injustice and say, “We have perfected a secret plan.” For the inner man and the heart are mysterious.
ekegusii: Nigo bagokora emeroberio emebe, bagoteeba, “Bono twakorire omooroberio oito omoikeranu.” Ekeene, ebirengererio bia ime bi’omonto, na enkoro yaye, nigo bisinyete.
swahili: Hufanya shauri baya la dhuluma na kusema, “Tumebuni mpango mkamilifu!” Hakika nia na moyo wa mwanadamu vina hila.

english: But God will shoot them with arrows; suddenly they will be wounded.
ekegusii: Korende Nyasae nabarase ensara yaye, na barabwo baraswe mobosokano.
swahili: Bali Mungu atawapiga kwa mishale, nao ghafula wataangushwa.

english: They will be made to stumble, their own tongues turned against them. All who see will shake their heads.
ekegusii: Nasirie abanto abwo ase engencho y’amang’ana amabe bagokwana; bonsi abarabe bakobarora mbasingisie emetwe yabo ase ogoichana.
swahili: Atageuza ndimi zao wenyewe dhidi yao na kuwaleta kwenye maangamizi; wote wawaonao watatikisa vichwa vyao kwa dharau.

english: Then all mankind will fear and proclaim the work of God; so they will ponder what He has done.
ekegusii: Erio abanto bonsi mbairoke, babe bakoraria emeremo ya Nyasae na komanya mono ayakorire.
swahili: Wanadamu wote wataogopa, watatangaza kazi za Mungu na kutafakari yale aliyoyatenda.

english: Praise awaits You, O God, in Zion; to You our vows will be fulfilled.
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae o Sayoni, ogotogigwa nokwao; goika togoikeranerie chiira chiaito.
swahili: Ee Mungu, sifa zakungojea katika Sayuni; kwako wewe nadhiri zetu zitatimizwa.

english: You soak its furrows and level its ridges; You soften it with showers and bless its growth.
ekegusii: Aye nigo okorenta embura ase chinchwara chi’emegondo y’ense; nigo okwarania aase aimokererete igoro, erio gwatoma embura yororobia riroba na gosesenia ebigokina ase emegondo.
swahili: Umeilowesha mifereji yake na kusawazisha kingo zake; umeilainisha kwa manyunyu na kuibariki mimea yake.

english: You crown the year with Your bounty, and Your paths overflow with plenty.
ekegusii: Kwabeekeire omwaka egutwa y’obuya bwao, amabarato ao nigo agotonya obonoru.
swahili: Umeuvika mwaka taji ya baraka, magari yako yanafurika kwa wingi.

english: The pastures of the wilderness overflow; the hills are robed with joy.
ekegusii: Amarisia e chirooro nigo agotonya boigo, na ebigoro nigo bieboetie omogooko.
swahili: Mbuga za majani za jangwani umezineemesha; vilima vimevikwa furaha.

english: The pastures are clothed with flocks, and the valleys are decked with grain. They shout in triumph; indeed, they sing.
ekegusii: Ebirubo nigo biichire namaicho e ching’ondi, na amakura nigo atubire ne chindagera. Kera egento nigo kegochenga nomogooko.
swahili: Penye nyanda za malisho pamejaa makundi ya wanyama, na mabonde yamepambwa kwa mavuno; vyote vinashangilia kwa furaha na kuimba.

english: O You who listen to prayer, all people will come to You.
ekegusii: Aye nigo okoigwa ogosaba, ase ayio abanto bonsi mbache asore.
swahili: Ewe usikiaye maombi, kwako wewe watu wote watakuja.

english: When iniquities prevail against me, You atone for our transgressions.
ekegusii: Nonya ebibe biambuire aye nigo okwabera ogosaria okwo.
swahili: Tulipokuwa tumefunikwa kabisa na dhambi, wewe ulisamehe makosa yetu.

english: Blessed is the one You choose and bring near to dwell in Your courts! We are filled with the goodness of Your house, the holiness of Your temple.
ekegusii: Nasesenirie omonto oyio gwachorire na komoikia ang’e, amenye naye ase chigoora chiao. Intwe ntoisaneke nobuya bw’enyomba yao, Hekalu yao Enchenu.
swahili: Heri wale uliowachagua na kuwaleta karibu ili waishi katika nyua zako! Tunashibishwa kwa mema ya nyumba yako, mema ya Hekalu lako takatifu.

english: With awesome deeds of righteousness You answer us, O God of our salvation, the hope of all the ends of the earth and of the farthest seas.
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae ore ogotooreka gwaito, ase ogokora kw’ogokumia ogotoigwa ase oboronge bwao; naye ore ogosemeria kw’abaanto bamenyete ase ense, nonya ngoika chinsinyo chi’ense, na ase chinyancha chi’aare.
swahili: Unatujibu kwa matendo ya kushangaza ya haki, Ee Mungu Mwokozi wetu, tumaini la miisho yote ya duniani na la bahari zilizo mbali sana,

english: You formed the mountains by Your power, having girded Yourself with might.
ekegusii: Aye gwakong’irie ebitunwa ne chinguru chiao, ekiagera aye nigo bweboetie okobua.
swahili: uliyeumba milima kwa uwezo wako, ukiwa umejivika nguvu,

english: You stilled the roaring of the seas, the pounding of their waves, and the tumult of the nations.
ekegusii: Aye nigo ogotoereria enyancha ekoruma, na emerindo yaye, naboigo namarorooche a Mwanyabaanto.
swahili: uliyenyamazisha dhoruba za bahari, ngurumo za mawimbi yake, na ghasia za mataifa.

english: Those who live far away fear Your wonders; You make the dawn and sunset shout for joy.
ekegusii: Abamenyete ase chinsinyo chi’ense nigo bagokumia ebimanyererio biao. Abare ase erioba rigosoka korwa goikera ase rikogwa gochia, nigo okogera batera nomogooko.
swahili: Wale wanaoishi mbali sana wanaogopa maajabu yako, kule asubuhi ipambazukiapo na kule jioni inakofifilia umeziita nyimbo za furaha.

english: You attend to the earth and water it; with abundance You enrich it. The streams of God are full of water, for You prepare our grain by providing for the earth.
ekegusii: Aye nigo ogwechandera ense, kwayerentera embura, nigo okoyea obotenenku obonge mono; chindooche chiao aye Nyasae nigo chiichire namaache. Ase okoroisia riroba igo nigo okoa abanto endagera.
swahili: Waitunza nchi na kuinyeshea, waitajirisha kwa wingi. Vijito vya Mungu vimejaa maji ili kuwapa watu nafaka, kwa maana wewe umeviamuru.

english: Make a joyful noise to God, all the earth!
ekegusii: Inwe abanto b’ense yonsi, aka eriogi ri’omogooko ase Nyasae;
swahili: Mpigieni Mungu kelele za shangwe, dunia yote!

english: For You, O God, have tested us; You have refined us like silver.
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae gwatoteemire, ee, gwatoteemire buna efeta egoteemwa ase omorero.
swahili: Ee Mungu, wewe ulitujaribu, ukatusafisha kama fedha.

english: You led us into the net; You laid burdens on our backs.
ekegusii: Nigo gwatotigete tokagwa ase egesibo aye nigo gwatotwegete egurube endito.
swahili: Umetuingiza kwenye nyavu na umetubebesha mizigo mizito migongoni mwetu.

english: You let men ride over our heads; we went through fire and water, but You brought us into abundance.
ekegusii: Aye nigo kwarentete ababisa baito bagatotacha emetwe. Intwe nigo twaetete ime y’omorero na amaache, korende nonya nabo, ogatorusiao, ogatobeka ase obuya obonge bore.
swahili: Uliwaruhusu watu watukalie vichwani, tulipita kwenye moto na kwenye maji, lakini ulituleta kwenye nchi iliyojaa utajiri tele.

english: I will enter Your house with burnt offerings; I will fulfill my vows to You—
ekegusii: Ninchiche ase enyomba yao, indetane ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa. Ning’ikeranie chiira nakorierete ase ogotiana,
swahili: Nitakuja hekaluni mwako na sadaka za kuteketezwa na kukutimizia nadhiri zangu:

english: the vows that my lips promised and my mouth spoke in my distress.
ekegusii: chiira chiria nakwanete nomonwa one, echio nariete ekero narenge ase emechando.
swahili: nadhiri ambazo midomo yangu iliahidi na nilizotamka kwa kinywa changu nilipokuwa katika shida.

english: I will offer You fatlings as burnt offerings, with the fragrant smoke of rams; I will offer bulls and goats. Selah
ekegusii: Ninkorentere ching’iti chire chinoru chibe ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa, ninchirue amo nekeng’wanso gie chimingichi kere ne rimisu rigiya. Nindue ne chieri ne chimbori chibe ebing’wanso.
swahili: Nitakutolea dhabihu za wanyama wanono na sadaka za kondoo dume, nitakutolea mafahali na mbuzi.

english: Come and listen, all you who fear God, and I will declare what He has done for me.
ekegusii: Inwe mwensi abamoirogete Nyasae, inchwo moigwe, nainche nimbatebie ay’Omonene ankoreire.
swahili: Njooni msikilize ninyi nyote mnaomcha Mungu, nami niwaambie aliyonitendea.

english: I cried out to Him with my mouth and praised Him with my tongue.
ekegusii: Inche nigo narerete neriogi rinene asare, na ogotogigwa kwaye nigo kwarenge ase oromeme rwane.
swahili: Nilimlilia kwa kinywa changu, sifa zake zilikuwa katika ulimi wangu.

english: If I had cherished iniquity in my heart, the Lord would not have listened.
ekegusii: Onye nabete ndengereretie amabe ase enkoro yane, Omonene anga tantegererete.
swahili: Kama ningekuwa nimeyaficha maovu moyoni mwangu, Bwana asingekuwa amenisikiliza;

english: But God has surely heard; He has attended to the sound of my prayer.
ekegusii: Korende ekeene, Nyasae ontegereire; ee, oigure eriogi ri’ogosaba kwane.
swahili: lakini hakika Mungu amenisikiliza na amesikia sauti yangu katika maombi.

english: Sing the glory of His name; make His praise glorious.
ekegusii: terera obonene bw’erieta riaye, moe obonene ase okomotogia!
swahili: Imbeni utukufu wa jina lake; mpeni sifa zake kwa utukufu!

english: Blessed be God, who has not rejected my prayer or withheld from me His loving devotion!
ekegusii: Nyasae atogigwe, ekiagera tangeti koigwa ogosaba kwane, gose tarusetie korwa asende obwanchani bwaye bogendererete botambe.
swahili: Sifa apewe Mungu, ambaye hakulikataa ombi langu wala kunizuilia upendo wake!

english: Say to God, “How awesome are Your deeds! So great is Your power that Your enemies cower before You.
ekegusii: Motebie Nyasae: Naki ogokora kwao kore ogw’okwoboyia! Obobui bwao nigo bore obonene mono, goika ababisa bao bekeyie asore.
swahili: Mwambieni Mungu, “Jinsi gani yalivyo ya kutisha matendo yako! Uwezo wako ni mkuu mno kiasi kwamba adui wananyenyekea mbele zako.

english: All the earth bows down to You; they sing praise to You; they sing praise to Your name.” Selah
ekegusii: Ense engima nigo ekogosasiima na kogotogia, abanto bonsi nigo bagotera na gotogia erieta riao.
swahili: Dunia yote yakusujudia, wanakuimbia wewe sifa, wanaliimbia sifa jina lako.”

english: Come and see the works of God; how awesome are His deeds toward mankind.
ekegusii: Inchuo morore aya Nyasae akorire. Aya akorire ase egati ya Mwanyabaanto nigo are ay’okwoboyia.
swahili: Njooni mwone yale Mungu aliyoyatenda, mambo ya kutisha aliyoyatenda miongoni mwa wanadamu!

english: He turned the sea into dry land; they passed through the waters on foot; there we rejoiced in Him.
ekegusii: Ere akaonchora enyancha ekaba ense enyomo, erio abanto bakambokera aroro namagoro. Aroro agwo tokagoka mono asare.
swahili: Alifanya bahari kuwa nchi kavu, wakapita kati ya maji kwa miguu, njooni, tumshangilie.

english: He rules forever by His power; His eyes watch the nations. Do not let the rebellious exalt themselves. Selah
ekegusii: Omonene nere okogamba ase okobua kwaye kare na kare; amaiso aye nigo arigereretie ebisaku bionsi, ase igo abasaria tibaabaisa kweimokereria igoro.
swahili: Yeye hutawala kwa uwezo wake milele, macho yake huangalia mataifa yote: waasi wasithubutu kujiinua dhidi yake.

english: Bless our God, O peoples; let the sound of His praise be heard.
ekegusii: Inwe abanto b’ebisaku bionsi, motogie Nyasae oito, tiga eriogi ri’okomotogia riigweke.
swahili: Enyi mataifa, msifuni Mungu wetu, sauti ya sifa yake isikike,

english: He preserves our lives and keeps our feet from slipping.
ekegusii: Omonene nere otorendete tore moyo, tatotigeti totererigwe amagoro.
swahili: ameyahifadhi maisha yetu na kuizuia miguu yetu kuteleza.

english: May God be gracious to us and bless us, and cause His face to shine upon us, Selah
ekegusii: Nyasae atororere amaabera, atosesenie, atoraberie obosio bwaye.
swahili: Mungu aturehemu na kutubariki, na kutuangazia nuru za uso wake,

english: that Your ways may be known on earth, Your salvation among all nations.
ekegusii: Tiga enchera yao emanyekane ase ense, na okobua kwao kw’ogotooria komanyekane ase abanto b’ebisaku bionsi.
swahili: ili njia zako zijulikane duniani, wokovu wako katikati ya mataifa yote.

english: Let the peoples praise You, O God; let all the peoples praise You.
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, tiga abanto bagotogie; ee, abanto bonsi tiga bagotogie!
swahili: Ee Mungu, mataifa na wakusifu, mataifa yote na wakusifu.

english: Let the nations be glad and sing for joy, for You judge the peoples justly and lead the nations of the earth. Selah
ekegusii: Tiga abanto b’ebisaku bagoke na oteera nomochengo; ekiagera aye nigo okonachera abanto ebiina ase oboronge. Aye naye okoraa ebisaku bire ase ense.
swahili: Mataifa yote wafurahi na kuimba kwa shangwe, kwa kuwa unatawala watu kwa haki na kuongoza mataifa ya dunia.

english: Let the peoples praise You, O God; let all the peoples praise You.
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, tiga abanto bagotogie, ee, abanto bonsi tiga bagotogie!
swahili: Ee Mungu, mataifa na wakusifu, mataifa yote na wakusifu.
