english: The earth has yielded its harvest; God, our God, blesses us.
ekegusii: Ense yamire okwama kwaye okonge, Nyasae, aye ore Nyasae oito, otosesenie!
swahili: Ndipo nchi itatoa mazao yake, naye Mungu, Mungu wetu, atatubariki.

english: God blesses us, that all the ends of the earth shall fear Him.
ekegusii: Nyasae otosesenirie; ase igo, tiga abanto bare ase ense engima bamoiroke!
swahili: Mungu atatubariki na miisho yote ya dunia itamcha yeye.

english: God arises. His enemies are scattered, and those who hate Him flee His presence.
ekegusii: Tiga Nyasae aimokerere igoro, na ababisa baye basiarerwe, abanto abwo bamogechete, tiga batame barue asare.
swahili: Mungu na ainuke, watesi wake watawanyike, adui zake na wakimbie mbele zake.

english: Your flock settled therein; O God, from Your bounty You provided for the poor.
ekegusii: Omoganda oo okanyora obomenyo aase agwo. Aye Nyasae, ase engencho y’obuya bwao, kwaeire abanto abataka aya baremeire.
swahili: Ee Mungu, watu wako waliishi huko, nawe kwa wingi wa utajiri wako uliwapa maskini mahitaji yao.

english: The Lord gives the command; a great company of women proclaim it:
ekegusii: Nyasae akarua ogochika, na omoganda omonene bw’abakungu bakararia amang’ana ayio:
swahili: Bwana alitangaza neno, waliolitangaza neno hilo walikuwa kundi kubwa:

english: “Kings and their armies flee in haste; she who waits at home divides the plunder.
ekegusii: “Abarwoti b’abarwani esegi batamire, ee, batamire!” Abakungu batigarete ase chinka ngwatanana bare ebisakorwa.
swahili: “Wafalme na majeshi walikimbia upesi, watu waliobaki kambini waligawana nyara.

english: Though you lie down among the sheepfolds, the wings of the dove are covered with silver, and her feathers with shimmering gold.”
ekegusii: Nonya bagendererete kobeera ase ameri e ching’ondi, nigo bare buna amaruma are ne chimbaaba chiatubire nefeta, na amarionya abo atubire netaabu ekomeka‐meka.
swahili: Hata ulalapo katikati ya mioto ya kambini, mabawa ya njiwa wangu yamefunikwa kwa fedha, manyoya yake kwa dhahabu ingʼaayo.”

english: When the Almighty scattered the kings in the land, it was like the snow falling on Zalmon.
ekegusii: Ekero Omonene, Omobui asiarerete abarwoti b’aase agwo, amagena ’embura agatwa ase egetunwa gia Salimoni.
swahili: Wakati Mwenyezi alipowatawanya wafalme katika nchi, ilikuwa kama theluji iliyoanguka juu ya Salmoni.

english: A mountain of God is Mount Bashan; a mountain of many peaks is Mount Bashan.
ekegusii: Aye egetunwa kia Basani, nigo ore egetunwa kia Nyasae, aye egetunwa kia Basani, nigo obwate ebichuria ebinge.
swahili: Milima ya Bashani ni milima iliyotukuka, milima ya Bashani ina vilele vilivyochongoka.

english: Why do you gaze in envy, O mountains of many peaks? This is the mountain God chose for His dwelling, where the LORD will surely dwell forever.
ekegusii: Aye egetunwa ki’ebichuria ebinge, nase ki okorigereria ne ribero ase egetunwa ekio Nyasae achorire koba obomenyo bwaye? Ee, Omonene ochorire komenya aroro kogenderera botambe.
swahili: Enyi milima yenye vilele vilivyochongoka, kwa nini mnakazia macho kwa wivu, katika mlima Mungu anaochagua kutawala, ambako Bwana mwenyewe ataishi milele?

english: The chariots of God are tens of thousands— thousands of thousands are they; the Lord is in His sanctuary as He was at Sinai.
ekegusii: Chigari chia Nyasae nigo chire chilifu chinyinge mono, Omonene nigo are ase egati yabo buna nase Sinai, Aase aye aachenu.
swahili: Magari ya Mungu ni makumi ya maelfu, na maelfu ya maelfu; Bwana amekuja kutoka Sinai hadi katika patakatifu pake.

english: You have ascended on high; You have led captives away. You have received gifts from men, even from the rebellious, that the LORD God may dwell there.
ekegusii: Aye ogatiira gochia igoro ogoosa abasibwa, na okanyora ebiegwa ase egati ya Mwanyabaanto, ee, nonya nase egati y’abasaria, ng’a aye Omonene Nyasae onyare komenya aroro.
swahili: Ulipopanda juu, uliteka mateka, ukapokea vipawa kutoka kwa wanadamu, hata kutoka kwa wale walioasi, ili wewe, Ee Bwana Mungu, upate kuishi huko.

english: Blessed be the Lord, who daily bears our burden, the God of our salvation. Selah
ekegusii: Omonene atogigwe, rituko ase rituko nigo agotobogoreria chigurube chiaito. Nyasae nere ogotooreka gwaito.
swahili: Sifa apewe Bwana, Mungu Mwokozi wetu, ambaye siku kwa siku hutuchukulia mizigo yetu.

english: As smoke is blown away, You will drive them out; as wax melts before the fire, the wicked will perish in the presence of God.
ekegusii: Tiga baserigwe gochia aare, buna erioki rikoirwa aa n’aaria; Tiga abakori amabe basirigwe kegima, barue ase obosio bwa Nyasae, basirigwe buna obochoe bokonyititoka ase omorero.
swahili: Kama vile moshi upeperushwavyo na upepo, vivyo hivyo uwapeperushe mbali, kama vile nta iyeyukavyo kwenye moto, vivyo hivyo waovu na waangamie mbele za Mungu.

english: Our God is a God of deliverance; the Lord GOD is our rescuer from death.
ekegusii: Nyasae oito nigo are Nyasae ogotooria. Nyasae oito, Omonene nigo agototooria korwa ase amakweri.
swahili: Mungu wetu ni Mungu aokoaye, Bwana Mwenyezi hutuokoa na kifo.

english: Surely God will crush the heads of His enemies, the hairy crowns of those who persist in guilty ways.
ekegusii: Nyasae nasenyente emetwe y’ababisa baye, nasenyente ebiore bire netukia bi’abwo bakogenderera ne chinchera chiabo chi’ebibe.
swahili: Hakika Mungu ataponda vichwa vya adui zake, vichwa vya hao waendao katika njia za dhambi.

english: The Lord said, “I will retrieve them from Bashan, I will bring them up from the depths of the sea,
ekegusii: Korende Nyasae agateeba: “Ning’iranie abanto abwo korwa Basani, mbarente korwa ase chindiba chi’enyancha,
swahili: Bwana alisema, “Nitawarudisha kutoka Bashani; nitawarudisha kutoka vilindi vya bahari,

english: that your foot may be dipped in the blood of your foes— the tongues of your dogs in the same.”
ekegusii: erinde motache amanyinga abo namagoro aino, ne chisese chiaino chinyore ebitari biabo biababisa baino.”
swahili: ili uweze kuchovya miguu yako katika damu ya adui zako, huku ndimi za mbwa wako zikiwa na fungu lake.”

english: They have seen Your procession, O God— the march of my God and King into the sanctuary.
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, omoganda oo ogotaara ororekanire; ee, aye Nyasae one, na omorwoti one, omoganda oria oo ogosoa ase obomenyo bwao obochenu.
swahili: Ee Mungu, maandamano yako yameonekana, maandamano ya Mungu wangu, Mfalme wangu, yakielekea patakatifu pake.

english: The singers lead the way, the musicians follow after, among the maidens playing tambourines.
ekegusii: Abateri nigo batang’aine bosio, magega yabo abakobugia amakano, na ase egati yabo abaiseke bakobugia chinchigiri:
swahili: Mbele wako waimbaji, baada yao wapiga vinanda, pamoja nao wako wanawali wakipiga matari.

english: Bless God in the great congregation; bless the LORD from the fountain of Israel.
ekegusii: “Inwe abamore ab’ororeria rw’Abaisraeli, motogie Nyasae ase egati y’omosangererekano Omonene.”
swahili: Msifuni Mungu katika kusanyiko kubwa, msifuni Bwana katika kusanyiko la Israeli.

english: There is Benjamin, the youngest, ruling them, the princes of Judah in their company, the princes of Zebulun and of Naphtali.
ekegusii: Abanto ba Benjamini, abare abasinini mono ase egati yabo, nao bare baabatang’aine, na abanene b’Abayuda nao bare amo nomoganda obo, na abanene b’Abasabuloni na ab’Abanafutali.
swahili: Liko kabila dogo la Benyamini likiwaongoza, wakifuatwa na kundi kubwa la watawala wa Yuda, hatimaye watawala wa Zabuloni na Naftali.

english: Summon Your power, O God; show Your strength, O God, which You have exerted on our behalf.
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, oorokia okobua kwao; ee Nyasae, ayio gwatokoreire, genderera koyabeka chinguru.
swahili: Ee Mungu, amuru uwezo wako, Ee Mungu tuonyeshe nguvu zako, kama ulivyofanya hapo awali.

english: Because of Your temple at Jerusalem kings will bring You gifts.
ekegusii: Abarwoti nigo bagokorentera ebiegwa ime ase Hekalu yao ere agwo Yerusalemu.
swahili: Kwa sababu ya Hekalu lako Yerusalemu wafalme watakuletea zawadi.

english: But the righteous will be glad and rejoice before God; they will celebrate with joy.
ekegusii: Korende abanyene oboronge tiga babe nomogooko omonene kegima, tiga babe nomochengo ase obosio bwa Nyasae, babe bagoteera bare nomogooko.
swahili: Bali wenye haki na wafurahi, washangilie mbele za Mungu, wafurahi na kushangilia.

english: Rebuke the beast in the reeds, the herd of bulls among the calves of the nations, until it submits, bringing bars of silver. Scatter the nations who delight in war.
ekegusii: Togonyera eng’iti eria y’orosana emenyete ase ebitonto ime, na amaicho e chieri amo ne chimori chiabo, nabwo abanto. Togonyera abanto goika bekeyie na gokoruera chifeta chiabo. Osiarere abanto banchete esegi.
swahili: Mkemee mnyama aliyeko kwenye manyasi, kundi la mafahali katikati ya ndama za mataifa. Na walete minara ya madini ya fedha wakinyenyekea. Tawanya mataifa yapendayo vita.

english: Envoys will arrive from Egypt; Cush will stretch out her hands to God.
ekegusii: Abanto bare ne chinguru mbarue Misiri, na abanto b’Ethiopia baayerere koramborera Nyasae amaboko abo.
swahili: Wajumbe watakuja kutoka Misri, Kushi atajisalimisha kwa Mungu.

english: Sing to God, O kingdoms of the earth; sing praises to the Lord— Selah
ekegusii: Inwe amarwoti are ase ense, tera motogie Nyasae; tera amatera ay’okomotogia Omonene!
swahili: Mwimbieni Mungu, enyi falme za dunia, mwimbieni Bwana sifa,

english: to Him who rides upon the highest heavens of old; behold, His mighty voice resounds.
ekegusii: Moteerere ere oria oriinete igoro, igoro eria yarengeo korwa chingaki chia kare. Rora, nigo agoaka eriogi riaye rire ne chinguru riaigugwa.
swahili: mwimbieni sifa yeye apandaye mbingu za kale zilizo juu, yeye angurumaye kwa sauti kuu.

english: Ascribe the power to God, whose majesty is over Israel, whose strength is in the skies.
ekegusii: Inwe raria okobua kwa Nyasae, oyio obonene bwaye bore igoro y’Abaisraeli, na okobua kwaye nigo kore igoro onsi.
swahili: Tangazeni uwezo wa Mungu, ambaye fahari yake iko juu ya Israeli, ambaye uwezo wake uko katika anga.

english: O God, You are awesome in Your sanctuary; the God of Israel Himself gives strength and power to His people. Blessed be God!
ekegusii: Nyasae nigo are oyo bw’okogosa korwa ase obomenyo bwaye obochenu; ere Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli; nigo akoa abanto baye okobua ne chinguru. Omonene atogigwe!
swahili: Ee Mungu, wewe unatisha katika mahali patakatifu pako, Mungu wa Israeli huwapa watu wake uwezo na nguvu. Mungu Asifiwe!

english: Sing to God! Sing praises to His name. Exalt Him who rides on the clouds — His name is the LORD— and rejoice before Him.
ekegusii: Moteerere Nyasae, tera amatera agotogia erieta riaye. Moroiserie enchera ere agoetera ase chirooro. Erieta riaye n’Omonene, kabe nomochengo ase obosio bwaye!
swahili: Mwimbieni Mungu, liimbieni sifa jina lake, mtukuzeni yeye aendeshwaye juu ya mawingu: jina lake ni Bwana, furahini mbele zake.

english: A father of the fatherless, and a defender of the widows, is God in His holy habitation.
ekegusii: Nyasae oria omenyete aase aye aachenu, nere ise bwe chintakana, na omorendi bw’ababoraka.
swahili: Baba wa yatima, mtetezi wa wajane, ni Mungu katika makao yake matakatifu.

english: God settles the lonely in families; He leads the prisoners out to prosperity, but the rebellious dwell in a sun-scorched land.
ekegusii: Nyasae nigo akoa abatigirwe bosa chinka ase bakomenya. Nigo agosibora abanto basibire baseseneka, korende abasaria nigo bakomenya ase ense enyomo kegima.
swahili: Mungu huwaweka wapweke katika jamaa, huwaongoza wafungwa wakiimba, bali waasi huishi katika nchi kame.

english: O God, when You went out before Your people, when You marched through the wasteland, Selah
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, ekero gwatang’anete abanto bao na ogotaara ase erooro,
swahili: Ee Mungu, ulipowatangulia watu wako, ulipopita nyikani,

english: the earth shook and the heavens poured down rain before God, the One on Sinai, before God, the God of Israel.
ekegusii: ense nigo yatengechete, embura egatwa korwa igoro, na aye Nyasae nao kwarenge. Nonya negetunwa gia Sinai nigo giatengechete, ekero aye Nyasae kwarengeo; aye ore Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli.
swahili: dunia ilitikisika, mbingu zikanyesha mvua, mbele za Mungu, Yule wa Sinai, mbele za Mungu, Mungu wa Israeli.

english: You sent abundant rain, O God; You refreshed Your weary inheritance.
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, nigo kwarentete embura enyinge mono, na igo omwando oo oria konya orosire okayoiraneria chinguru.
swahili: Ee Mungu, ulinyesha mvua nyingi na kuiburudisha ardhi iliyokuwa imechoka.

english: Save me, O God, for the waters are up to my neck.
ekegusii: Nyasae, intoorie, ekiagera amaache aichoire, aikire ase omoyo one.
swahili: Ee Mungu, niokoe, kwa maana maji yamenifika shingoni.

english: I wept and fasted, but it brought me reproach.
ekegusii: Ekero nabete nkorera ase omoyo one na kweng’ata, ngachaywa na gokwanwa bobe.
swahili: Ninapolia na kufunga, lazima nivumilie matusi.

english: I made sackcloth my clothing, and I was sport to them.
ekegusii: Ekero neboyetie chigunia ase okweumia bakaba bakondabaara.
swahili: Ninapovaa nguo ya gunia, watu hunidharau.

english: Those who sit at the gate mock me, and I am the song of drunkards.
ekegusii: Inche ’ngokwanwa bobe nabwo bagoikaransa ang’e negeita kogamba, abakonywa na gotinda bakoroisia amatera ay’ogonchecheria.
swahili: Wale wanaoketi mlangoni wananisimanga, nimekuwa wimbo wa walevi.

english: But my prayer to You, O LORD, is for a time of favor. In Your abundant loving devotion, O God, answer me with Your sure salvation.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, naye ngosaba ase engaki yancheire. Aye Nyasae, inyigwere, ekiagera nigo ore nobwanchani botari koera, naende nigo ore omwegenwa ase ogotooria.
swahili: Lakini Ee Bwana, ninakuomba, kwa wakati ukupendezao; katika upendo wako mkuu, Ee Mungu, unijibu kwa wokovu wako wa hakika.

english: Rescue me from the mire and do not let me sink; deliver me from my foes and out of the deep waters.
ekegusii: Ntoorie, tindimera ase etintira ime! Ntoorie korwa ase ababisa baane, na korwa ase amaache ’endiba entambe.
swahili: Uniokoe katika matope, usiniache nizame; niokoe na hao wanichukiao, kutoka kwenye vilindi vya maji.

english: Do not let the floods engulf me or the depths swallow me up; let not the Pit close its mouth over me.
ekegusii: Gaki totiga emerindo entube, gose chindiba chimere, gose engoro emumekerie.
swahili: Usiache mafuriko yanigharikishe au vilindi vinimeze, au shimo lifumbe kinywa chake juu yangu.

english: Answer me, O LORD, for Your loving devotion is good; turn to me in keeping with Your great compassion.
ekegusii: Omonene, ing’iranerie, ekiagera obwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe nigo bore obuya, ing’iranere, ekiagera amaabera ao namange mono.
swahili: Ee Bwana, unijibu, kwa wema wa upendo wako; kwa huruma zako nyingi unigeukie.

english: Hide not Your face from Your servant, for I am in distress. Answer me quickly!
ekegusii: Tobisa obosio bwao korwa asende inche omosomba oo; inyigwe bwango, ekiagera inche nigo inde ase emechando emenene.
swahili: Usimfiche mtumishi wako uso wako, uharakishe kunijibu, kwa sababu niko katika shida.

english: Draw near to my soul and redeem me; ransom me because of my foes.
ekegusii: Inchuo ang’e asende, omboorie, onsibore korwa ase ababisa baane!
swahili: Njoo karibu uniokoe, nikomboe kwa sababu ya adui zangu.

english: You know my reproach, my shame and disgrace. All my adversaries are before You.
ekegusii: Aye nomanyete amabe nakoreirwe, na buna nasookigwe na gochaywa; nigo omanyete ababisa baane bonsi.
swahili: Unajua jinsi ninavyodharauliwa, kufedheheshwa na kuaibishwa, adui zangu wote unawajua.

english: I have sunk into the miry depths, where there is no footing; I have drifted into deep waters, where the flood engulfs me.
ekegusii: Nigo ngendererete korimera endiba y’etintira ime, aase tari ase ngotacha n’amagoro. Narimeire ase amaache ase endiba entambe, na emerindo yantubire.
swahili: Ninazama kwenye vilindi vya matope, pasipo mahali pa kukanyaga, Nimefika kwenye maji makuu, mafuriko yamenigharikisha.

english: Insults have broken my heart, and I am in despair. I looked for sympathy, but there was none, for comforters, but I found no one.
ekegusii: Amabe ayio nakoreirwe asionoire enkoro yane, bono nerusirie moyo. Nigo nasemeretie ng’a ndorerwe amabeebe, korende tinayaroreretwe; nigo nasemeretie inyore abaremia, korende tinabanyora.
swahili: Dharau zimenivunja moyo na nimekata tamaa, nimetafuta wa kunihurumia, lakini sikumpata, wa kunituliza, lakini sikumpata.

english: They poisoned my food with gall and gave me vinegar to quench my thirst.
ekegusii: Ekero narenge nenchara, abanto bakang’a amaache endorwe ribaga ri’endagera, na ekero narenge nerang’o, bakang’a chinkama nkanywa.
swahili: Waliweka nyongo katika chakula changu na walinipa siki nilipokuwa na kiu.

english: May their table become a snare; may it be a retribution and a trap.
ekegusii: Tiga endagera ere ase amasio abo, ebe egesugunia ase bare, na oboreba ase abwo bekagete ng’a mbuya bare.
swahili: Meza iliyoandaliwa mbele yao na iwe mtego, nayo iwe upatilizo na tanzi.

english: May their eyes be darkened so they cannot see, and their backs be bent forever.
ekegusii: Oukorie amaiso abo: otengechie chibachwa chiabo kogenderera.
swahili: Macho yao yatiwe giza ili wasiweze kuona, nayo migongo yao iinamishwe daima.

english: Pour out Your wrath upon them, and let Your burning anger overtake them.
ekegusii: Obaumorere ekeririanda kiao, na endamwamu yao yoke igoro yabo.
swahili: Uwamwagie ghadhabu yako, hasira yako kali na iwapate.

english: May their place be deserted; let there be no one to dwell in their tents.
ekegusii: Tiga omochie obo otigare bosa, monto onde tamenya ase chiema chiabo.
swahili: Mahali pao na pawe ukiwa, wala asiwepo yeyote atakayeishi katika mahema yao.

english: For they persecute the one You struck and recount the pain of those You wounded.
ekegusii: Abanto abwo nigo bachandete omonto oria kwaagete, na bagokwana igoro y’obororo bw’oyio kwabetete.
swahili: Kwa kuwa wanawatesa wale uliowajeruhi, na kuzungumza juu ya maumivu ya wale uliowaumiza.

english: Add iniquity to their iniquity; let them not share in Your righteousness.
ekegusii: Menta obobe igoro ase obobe bwabo; tobatiga basoe ase oboronge bwao.
swahili: Walipize uovu juu ya uovu, usiwaache washiriki katika wokovu wako.

english: May they be blotted out of the Book of Life and not listed with the righteous.
ekegusii: Tiga amarieta abo atinyigwe korwa ase egetabu y’abare moyo, tarikwa amo nay’abanyene oboronge.
swahili: Wafutwe kutoka kitabu cha uzima na wasiorodheshwe pamoja na wenye haki.

english: But I am in pain and distress; let Your salvation protect me, O God.
ekegusii: Inche nigo inde ase emechando n’obororo; aye Nyasae, ogotooreka kwao konyimokererie igoro.
swahili: Mimi niko katika maumivu na dhiki; Ee Mungu, wokovu wako na unihifadhi.

english: I am weary from my crying; my throat is parched. My eyes fail, looking for my God.
ekegusii: Narosire ekiagera nkona-korera, omoyo one bwomire kegima. Amaiso aane abeire orotutu, nganyete Nyasae one.
swahili: Nimechoka kwa kuomba msaada, koo langu limekauka. Macho yangu yanafifia, nikimtafuta Mungu wangu.

english: I will praise God’s name in song and exalt Him with thanksgiving.
ekegusii: Nintogie erieta ria Nyasae ase okomoterera; nindarie obonene bwaye ase okoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono.
swahili: Nitalisifu jina la Mungu kwa wimbo, nami nitamtukuza kwa kumtolea shukrani.

english: And this will please the LORD more than an ox, more than a bull with horns and hooves.
ekegusii: Ayio naro aragokie Omonene kobua komoruera eng’ombe koba ekeng’wanso, gose komoruera eeri ere ne ching’unchara na ebitaago.
swahili: Hili litampendeza Bwana kuliko ngʼombe dume, zaidi ya fahali akiwa na pembe na kwato zake.

english: The humble will see and rejoice. You who seek God, let your hearts be revived!
ekegusii: Abwo bakoreire bobe mbarore ayio, bagoke; inwe aba mokorigia Nyasae, tiga chinkoro chiaino chikorwe chinyia.
swahili: Maskini wataona na kufurahi: ninyi mnaomtafuta Mungu, mioyo yenu na iishi!

english: For the LORD listens to the needy and does not despise His captive people.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo akoigwa abanto baria baremeire; ere tari gochaaya abanto baye abwo bare ase obosibwa.
swahili: Bwana huwasikia wahitaji wala hadharau watu wake waliotekwa.

english: Let heaven and earth praise Him, the seas and everything that moves in them.
ekegusii: Tiga igoro na ense chitogie Omonene, naboigo na enyancha, na ebitongwa bionsi bire imeo.
swahili: Mbingu na dunia zimsifu, bahari na vyote viendavyo ndani yake,

english: For God will save Zion and rebuild the cities of Judah, that they may dwell there and possess it.
ekegusii: Nyasae natoorie Sayoni na aagache emechie y’Abayuda naende, abasomba baye mbayeire ebe eyabo na komenya aroro.
swahili: kwa maana Mungu ataiokoa Sayuni na kuijenga tena miji ya Yuda. Kisha watu watafanya makao yao humo na kuimiliki,

english: The descendants of His servants will inherit it, and those who love His name will settle in it.
ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rw’abasomba b’Omonene mbayeire ebe eyabo, boigo nabaanto baria banchete erieta ri’Omonene mbamenye aroro.
swahili: watoto wa watumishi wake watairithi na wale wote walipendao jina lake wataishi humo.

english: Those who hate me without cause outnumber the hairs of my head; many are those who would destroy me— my enemies for no reason. Though I did not steal, I must repay.
ekegusii: Abanto nigo bangechete bosa ’ngencho ende etaiyo; nigo bare abange kobua etukia ere ase omotwe one. Ababisa baane nigo bagokwana oborimo igoro yane, baganetie gosiria obogima bwane, nigo bare ne chinguru chinyinge. Nigo n’akanete ebi ntaibete.
swahili: Wale wanaonichukia bila sababu ni wengi kuliko nywele za kichwa changu; wengi ni adui kwangu bila sababu, wale wanaotafuta kuniangamiza. Ninalazimishwa kurudisha kitu ambacho sikuiba.

english: You know my folly, O God, and my guilt is not hidden from You.
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, nomanyete oboriri bwane, naki amamocho aane tabisekaneti korwa asore.
swahili: Ee Mungu, wewe unajua upumbavu wangu, wala hatia yangu haikufichika kwako.

english: May those who hope in You not be ashamed through me, O Lord GOD of Hosts; may those who seek You not be dishonored through me, O God of Israel.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene bw’Emeganda, totiga abanto abwo bagosemeretie, bare ime yane, barore obosooku. Aye Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, totiga abanto abwo bagokorigia, bare ime yane, bachaywe.
swahili: Ee Bwana, ewe Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, wakutumainio wasiaibishwe kwa ajili yangu; wakutafutao wasifedheheshwe kwa ajili yangu, Ee Mungu wa Israeli.

english: For I have endured scorn for Your sake, and shame has covered my face.
ekegusii: Inche nigo nachayirwe ase engencho yao, obosooku bwatubire obosio bwane.
swahili: Kwa maana nimestahimili dharau kwa ajili yako, aibu imefunika uso wangu.

english: I have become a stranger to my brothers and a foreigner to my mother’s sons,
ekegusii: Inche nabeire omogeni ase abanto baminto, na omoeti ase abaminto twaiboretwe korwa ase enda eyemo.
swahili: Nimekuwa mgeni kwa ndugu zangu, mgeni kwa wana wa mama yangu mwenyewe.

english: because zeal for Your house has consumed me, and the insults of those who insult You have fallen on me.
ekegusii: Risemi ri’enyomba yao riandire, emerumi y’abwo bakoramete nigo yangwerete.
swahili: Kwa kuwa wivu wa nyumba yako unanila, matukano ya wale wanaokutukana yameniangukia.

english: O LORD, do not rebuke me in Your anger or discipline me in Your wrath.
ekegusii: Omonene, tontogonyera ekero ore nendamwamu; tong’a egesusuro gi’okondongeyia ekero ore nekeririanda.
swahili: Ee Bwana, usinikemee katika hasira yako, wala usiniadhibu katika ghadhabu yako.

english: All my enemies will be ashamed and dismayed; they will turn back in sudden disgrace.
ekegusii: Ababisa baane bonsi mbarore obosooku, bagoswe na koondokigwa mono kegima, mbairane gochia magega bwango bare nobosooku.
swahili: Adui zangu wote wataaibika na kufadhaika, watarudi nyuma kwa aibu ya ghafula.

english: Be merciful to me, O LORD, for I am frail; heal me, O LORD, for my bones are in agony.
ekegusii: Omonene, ndorera amaabera, ekiagera ’nde omonyanyuru. Aye Omonene, ’ngwenie, ekiagera amauga aane nigo akonyegerigwa.
swahili: Unirehemu Bwana, kwa maana nimedhoofika; Ee Bwana, uniponye, kwa maana mifupa yangu ina maumivu makali.

english: My soul is deeply distressed. How long, O LORD, how long?
ekegusii: Omoyo one ochandekire nomoondoko. Omonene, ngoika ririri orenane otarankonya?
swahili: Nafsi yangu ina uchungu mwingi. Mpaka lini, Ee Bwana, mpaka lini?

english: Turn, O LORD, and deliver my soul; save me because of Your loving devotion.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ing’iranere omboorie! Ontoorie ase engencho y’obwanchani bwao botari koera.
swahili: Geuka Ee Bwana, unikomboe, uniokoe kwa sababu ya fadhili zako.

english: For there is no mention of You in death; who can praise You from Sheol?
ekegusii: Ase abwo bakuure onde tari oranyare gokoinyora. Inee! Ning’o oranyare kogotogia korwa aase abakuure?
swahili: Hakuna mtu anayekukumbuka akiwa amekufa. Ni nani awezaye kukusifu akiwa kuzimu?

english: I am weary from groaning; all night I flood my bed with weeping and drench my couch with tears.
ekegusii: Nanyarekire ase okwerera kwane kw’obororo, kera obotuko nigo ngoteremia namariga ase oborere bwane, ebirarero biane biaichoirwe namariga.
swahili: Nimechakaa kwa kulia kwa huzuni; usiku kucha nafurikisha kitanda changu kwa machozi; nimelowesha viti vyangu vya fahari kwa machozi.

english: My eyes fail from grief; they grow dim because of all my foes.
ekegusii: Obosio bwane bwomire pa ase engencho y’emechando, bwareeire ase engencho y’ababisa baane bonsi.
swahili: Macho yangu yamedhoofika kwa kuhuzunika, yamedhoofika kwa sababu ya adui zangu wote.

english: Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity, for the LORD has heard my weeping.
ekegusii: Inwe mwensi abakori amabe, karue asende ekiagera Omonene oigure eriogi ria ebirero biane.
swahili: Kaeni mbali nami, ninyi nyote mtendao mabaya, kwa maana Bwana amesikia kulia kwangu.

english: The LORD has heard my cry for mercy; the LORD accepts my prayer.
ekegusii: Omonene oigure okoboria kwane gw’okonyora amaabera, nere bwancheire ogosaba kwane.
swahili: Bwana amesikia kilio changu kwa huruma, Bwana amekubali sala yangu.

english: Make haste, O God, to deliver me! Hurry, O LORD, to help me!
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, koranche ontoorie! Omonene, oche bwango onkonye!
swahili: Ee Mungu, ufanye haraka kuniokoa; Ee Bwana, njoo hima unisaidie.

english: May those who seek my life be ashamed and confounded; may those who wish me harm be repelled and humiliated.
ekegusii: Abanto abwo barigetie gosiria obogima bwane, tiga basookigwe na gotantanigwa, na abwo baganetie ng’a obobe bonyore inche, tiga bairanigwe magega na gochaywa.
swahili: Wale wanaotafuta kuuondoa uhai wangu, waaibishwe na kufadhaishwa; wote wanaotamani kuangamizwa kwangu, warudishwe nyuma kwa aibu.

english: May those who say, “Aha, aha!” retreat because of their shame.
ekegusii: Abwo bagonchaya na goteeba: “Kiamonyorire!” Tiga bakirigwe-kiri ase obosooku bwabo.
swahili: Wale waniambiao, “Aha! Aha!” warudi nyuma kwa sababu ya aibu yao.

english: May all who seek You rejoice and be glad in You; may those who love Your salvation always say, “Let God be magnified!”
ekegusii: Abwo bonsi bagokorigia, tiga bakogokere na kogochengera; abwo banchete ogotooreka kwao, tiga bagenderere goteeba: “Nyasae atogigwe!”
swahili: Lakini wote wakutafutao washangilie na kukufurahia, wale wapendao wokovu wako siku zote waseme, “Mungu na atukuzwe!”

english: But I am poor and needy; hurry to me, O God. You are my help and my deliverer; O LORD, do not delay.
ekegusii: Inche nigo inde omotaka na omoremerwa; aye Nyasae, inchwo bwango onkonye! Aye naye Omokonyi one, na Omotooria one. Aye Omonene, totebana!
swahili: Lakini bado mimi ni maskini na mhitaji; Ee Mungu, unijie haraka. Wewe ndiwe msaada wangu na mwokozi wangu; Ee Bwana, usikawie.

english: In You, O LORD, I have taken refuge; let me never be put to shame.
ekegusii: Omonene, naye natameire, tontiga nsookigwe.
swahili: Ee Bwana, nimekukimbilia wewe, usiache nikaaibika kamwe.

english: For my enemies speak against me, and those who lie in wait for my life conspire,
ekegusii: Ababisa baane nigo bakongamba, basangererekanire gokora omooroberio bw’ogonsiria,
swahili: Kwa maana adui zangu wananisengenya, wale wanaonivizia kuniua wafanya hila.

english: saying, “God has forsaken him; pursue him and seize him, for there is no one to rescue him.”
ekegusii: bateeba: “Nyasae omotigire, inchwo tomotunye, erinde tomobwate, onde tari oranyare komotooria.”
swahili: Wanasema, “Mungu amemwacha, mkimbilieni mkamkamate, kwani hakuna wa kumwokoa.”

english: Be not far from me, O God. Hurry, O my God, to help me.
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, tombeera aare, Nyasae one, inchwo bwango onkonye!
swahili: Ee Mungu, usiwe mbali nami, njoo haraka kunisaidia, Ee Mungu wangu.

english: May the accusers of my soul be ashamed and consumed; may those who seek my harm be covered with scorn and disgrace.
ekegusii: Ababisa abwo bakorigia obogima bwane, tiga basookigwe na gosirigwa kegima; abwo bakorigia gonkora bobe, tiga bachaywe na gochecherigwa mono.
swahili: Washtaki wangu na waangamie kwa aibu, wale wanaotaka kunidhuru na wafunikwe kwa dharau na fedheha.

english: But I will always hope and will praise You more and more.
ekegusii: Korende inche nimbe nogosemeria botambe, na nimbe nkona-kogotogia mono goetania.
swahili: Lakini mimi, nitatumaini siku zote, nitakusifu zaidi na zaidi.

english: My mouth will declare Your righteousness and Your salvation all day long, though I cannot know their full measure.
ekegusii: Nimbe nkoraria ogokora kwao kw’oboronge nomonwa one. Omobaso boira nimbe nkonagwatora ogotooreka kwao; okwo kore okonene ntanyare gokorenga.
swahili: Kinywa changu kitasimulia haki yako, wokovu wako mchana kutwa, ingawa sifahamu kipimo chake.

english: I will enter in the strength of the Lord GOD; I will proclaim Your righteousness—Yours alone.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene Nyasae, nimbe nkoraria ogokora kwao okonene, nimbe nkona-gotogia oboronge bwao, ee, ningotogie aye bweka.
swahili: Ee Bwana Mwenyezi, nitakuja na kutangaza matendo yako makuu, nitatangaza haki yako, yako peke yako.

english: O God, You have taught me from my youth, and to this day I proclaim Your marvelous deeds.
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, kwabeire gokonyorokereria korwa obwana bwane, goika reero iga ningenderere konakoraria ogokora kwao kw’ogokumia.
swahili: Ee Mungu, umenifundisha tangu ujana wangu, hadi leo ninatangaza matendo yako ya ajabu.

english: Even when I am old and gray, do not forsake me, O God, until I proclaim Your power to the next generation, Your might to all who are to come.
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, tobaisa gonchwara ekero ndabe nagotire, namerire chimbuche chiarabire se, goika imbe narareirie abanto b’ebiaare bigochi-gocha chinguru chiao, na okobua kwao.
swahili: Ee Mungu, usiniache, hata niwapo mzee wa mvi, mpaka nitangaze uwezo wako kwa kizazi kijacho, nguvu zako kwa wote watakaokuja baadaye.

english: Your righteousness reaches to the heavens, O God, You who have done great things. Who, O God, is like You?
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, oboronge bwao boigete aaria igoro mono. Aye nigo gwakorete amang’ana amanene mono. Ee, Nyasae, ning’o ore buna aye?
swahili: Ee Mungu, haki yako imefika juu katika mbingu, wewe ambaye umefanya mambo makuu. Ee Mungu, ni nani aliye kama wewe?

english: In Your justice, rescue and deliver me; incline Your ear and save me.
ekegusii: Nkonye na onsibore goetera ase oboronge bwao; ntegerere, ontoorie!
swahili: Kwa haki yako uniponye na kuniokoa, unitegee sikio lako uniokoe.

english: Though You have shown me many troubles and misfortunes, You will revive me once again. Even from the depths of the earth You will bring me back up.
ekegusii: Ekero gwatotigete, nigo twaroche emechando emenge, korende nonyare gotokora abayia naende; torusie, ototiirie korwa ase chiirima chire ase ense.
swahili: Ingawa umenifanya nipate taabu, nyingi na chungu, utanihuisha tena, kutoka vilindi vya dunia utaniinua tena.

english: You will increase my honor and comfort me once again.
ekegusii: Aye omente obonene bwane, na ondemie naende.
swahili: Utaongeza heshima yangu na kunifariji tena.

english: So I will praise You with the harp for Your faithfulness, O my God; I will sing praise to You with the lyre, O Holy One of Israel.
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae one, nimbe nkobugia obokano ase okogotogia, ekiagera aye nigo ore omwegenwa. Nimbe nkogoterera ase okobugia obokano bw’ebirigisa, aye Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli.
swahili: Ee Mungu wangu, nitakusifu kwa kinubi kwa ajili ya uaminifu wako; Ee Uliye Mtakatifu wa Israeli, nitakuimbia sifa kwa zeze.

english: When I sing praise to You my lips will shout for joy, along with my soul, which You have redeemed.
ekegusii: Ning’ake eriogi rinene ri’omogooko nomonwa one, ekero ndabe ngotera amatera akogotogia. Nintere nomoyo one boigo, ekiagera aye gwantooririe.
swahili: Midomo yangu itapaza sauti kwa furaha ninapokuimbia sifa, mimi, ambaye umenikomboa.

english: My tongue will indeed proclaim Your righteousness all day long, for those who seek my harm are disgraced and confounded.
ekegusii: Omobaso boira oromeme rwane ndobe rokona-gokwana igoro y’oboronge bwao, erinde abwo barigetie gonkora bobe basookigwe na gochaywa.
swahili: Ulimi wangu utasimulia matendo yako ya haki mchana kutwa, kwa maana wale waliotaka kunidhuru, wameaibishwa na kufadhaishwa.

english: Be my rock of refuge, where I can always go. Give the command to save me, for You are my rock and my fortress.
ekegusii: Aye kabe egetare kiane ki’obotamero ase nkogenda botambe, aye gwanchire gontooria. Naki aye negetare kiane, na egekengero kiane egekong’u.
swahili: Uwe kwangu mwamba wa kimbilio, mahali nitakapokimbilia kila wakati; toa amri ya kuniokoa, kwa kuwa wewe ni mwamba wangu na ngome yangu.

english: Deliver me, O my God, from the hand of the wicked, from the grasp of the unjust and ruthless.
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae one, ntoorie korwa ase okoboko kw’omokori amabe, indusie korwa ase okobua kw’oyo otari omooronge, na oyore omotindi.
swahili: Ee Mungu wangu uniokoe kutoka kwenye mkono wa mwovu, kutoka kwenye makucha ya watu wabaya na wakatili.

english: For You are my hope, O Lord GOD, my confidence from my youth.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, naye ogosemeria kwane, nabeire nkwegenete korwa obwana bwane.
swahili: Kwa kuwa umekuwa tumaini langu, Ee Bwana Mwenyezi, tegemeo langu tangu ujana wangu.

english: I have leaned on You since birth; You pulled me from my mother’s womb. My praise is always for You.
ekegusii: Kwabeire gontenenerete korwa ekero ntaraiborwa, naye kwandusetie korwa ase enda ya baba. Naye ndabe nkona-gotogia botambe.
swahili: Tangu kuzaliwa nimekutegemea wewe, ulinitoa tumboni mwa mama yangu. Nitakusifu wewe daima.

english: I have become a portent to many, but You are my strong refuge.
ekegusii: Inche nabeire buna egento ki’ogoichanerwa ase abanto abange, korende aye naye obotamero bwane obokong’u.
swahili: Nimekuwa kama kioja kwa wengi, lakini wewe ni kimbilio langu imara.

english: My mouth is filled with Your praise and with Your splendor all day long.
ekegusii: Omonwa one noichorigwe nogotogigwa kwao, na omobaso boira ninkobake.
swahili: Kinywa changu kimejazwa sifa zako, nikitangaza utukufu wako mchana kutwa.

english: Do not discard me in my old age; do not forsake me when my strength fails.
ekegusii: Tobaisa gonchwara ekero ndabe nagotire, tontiga ekero chinguru chirabe chiang’ereire.
swahili: Usinitupe wakati wa uzee, wala usiniache nguvu zangu zinapopungua.

english: Endow the king with Your justice, O God, and the son of the king with Your righteousness.
ekegusii: Nyasae, kae omorwoti okobua gw’okogamba buna aye okogamba, na omwana bw’omorwoti agambe ase oboronge buna aye.
swahili: Ee Mungu, mjalie mfalme aamue kwa haki yako, mwana wa mfalme kwa haki yako.

english: May the kings of Tarshish and distant shores bring tribute; may the kings of Sheba and Seba offer gifts.
ekegusii: Abarwoti ba Tarisisi na ab’ebisinka ’mbabe bakomorentera ebiegwa; naboigo nabarwoti ba Sheba na Seba mbamorentere ebango.
swahili: Wafalme wa Tarshishi na wa pwani za mbali watamletea kodi; wafalme wa Sheba na Seba watampa zawadi.

english: May all kings bow down to him and all nations serve him.
ekegusii: Abarwoti bonsi ’mbatugame ase obosio bwaye bamosike, na abanto b’ebisaku bionsi mbamokorere.
swahili: Wafalme wote watamsujudia na mataifa yote yatamtumikia.

english: For he will deliver the needy who cry out and the afflicted who have no helper.
ekegusii: Ere nigo agotooria oyoremeire gakorangeria, naboigo nomotaka na oyotabwati onde okomokonya.
swahili: Kwa maana atamwokoa mhitaji anayemlilia, aliyeonewa asiye na wa kumsaidia.

english: He will take pity on the poor and needy and save the lives of the oppressed.
ekegusii: Nigo are omwororo ase omoremerwa na ase omotaka, boigo nigo agotooria emioyo y’abaremeire.
swahili: Atawahurumia wanyonge na wahitaji na kuwaokoa wahitaji kutoka mauti.

english: He will redeem them from oppression and violence, for their blood is precious in his sight.
ekegusii: Nigo akobooria emioyo yabo korwa ase abachandi babo na korwa ase obotindi. Amanyinga abo nigo are nengencho enene asare.
swahili: Atawaokoa kutoka uonevu na ukatili, kwani damu yao ni ya thamani machoni pake.

english: Long may he live! May gold from Sheba be given him. May people ever pray for him; may they bless him all day long.
ekegusii: Tiga omorwoti agenderere koba moyo. Chitaabu chi’ense ya Seba chirentwe asare, tiga abanto babe bakomosabera botambe, boigo tiga abe okona-gosesenigwa kera rituko.
swahili: Aishi maisha marefu! Na apewe dhahabu ya Sheba. Watu wamwombee daima na kumbariki mchana kutwa.

english: May there be an abundance of grain in the land; may it sway atop the hills. May its fruit trees flourish like the forests of Lebanon, and its people like the grass of the field.
ekegusii: Tiga endagera yame enyinge ase ense, nonya nase ebitunwa igoro. Chindagera echio tiga china-konyegerigwa buna emete ya Lebanoni. Abanto b’emechie tiga babuche babe buna obonyansi bw’ense.
swahili: Nafaka ijae tele katika nchi yote, juu ya vilele vya vilima na istawi. Tunda lake na listawi kama Lebanoni, listawi kama majani ya kondeni.

english: May his name endure forever; may his name continue as long as the sun shines. In him may all nations be blessed; may they call him blessed.
ekegusii: Erieta riaye tiga rigenderere kobao botambe, rikume koreng’ana buna erioba rigendererete kobao. Abanto mbabe bagosesenigwa ime yaye; abanto b’ebisaku bionsi tiga bamoroke oyosesenirie.
swahili: Jina lake na lidumu milele, na lidumu kama jua. Mataifa yote yatabarikiwa kupitia kwake, nao watamwita aliyebarikiwa.

english: Blessed be the LORD God, the God of Israel, who alone does marvelous deeds.
ekegusii: Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, tiga atogigwe, nere bweka ogokora amakumia.
swahili: Bwana Mungu, Mungu wa Israeli, apewe sifa, yeye ambaye peke yake hutenda mambo ya ajabu.

english: And blessed be His glorious name forever; may all the earth be filled with His glory. Amen and amen.
ekegusii: Tiga erieta riaye ri’obonene ritogigwe goika kare na kare; obonene bwaye tiga boichore ase ense yonsi. Amina, Amina!
swahili: Jina lake tukufu lisifiwe milele, ulimwengu wote ujae utukufu wake. Amen na Amen.

english: May he judge Your people with righteousness and Your afflicted with justice.
ekegusii: Erio amanye konachera abanto bao ebiina bi’oboronge na gokora ekeene ase abataka.
swahili: Atawaamua watu wako kwa haki, watu wako walioonewa kwa haki.

english: Thus conclude the prayers of David son of Jesse.
ekegusii: Oyo noro omoerio bw’ogosaba gwa Daudi, mosinto o Yese.
swahili: Huu ndio mwisho wa maombi ya Daudi mwana wa Yese.

english: May the mountains bring peace to the people, and the hills bring righteousness.
ekegusii: Ebitunwa na ebigoro mbirentere abanto omorembe goetera ase oboronge.
swahili: Milima italeta mafanikio kwa watu, vilima tunda la haki.

english: May he vindicate the afflicted among the people; may he save the children of the needy and crush the oppressor.
ekegusii: Tiga omorwoti abe okorwanerera abataka, na atoorie abana b’abaremeire, korende asenyente abanto bagokorera abande bobe.
swahili: Atawatetea walioonewa miongoni mwa watu na atawaokoa watoto wa wahitaji, ataponda mdhalimu.

english: May they fear him as long as the sun shines, as long as the moon remains, through all generations.
ekegusii: Abanto mbakoiroke, koreng’ana buna erioba na omotienyi bigendererete kobao, ebiaare ase ebiaare.
swahili: Atadumu kama jua lidumuvyo, kama mwezi, vizazi vyote.

english: May he be like rain that falls on freshly cut grass, like spring showers that water the earth.
ekegusii: Ere tiga aike korwa igoro buna embura egotwa ase obonyansi oborere, na buna omonyirira ogotwa igoro ase riroba.
swahili: Atakuwa kama mvua inyeshayo juu ya shamba lililofyekwa, kama manyunyu yanyeshayo ardhi.

english: May the righteous flourish in his days and prosperity abound, until the moon is no more.
ekegusii: Tiga omonyaboronge asesenigwe ase amatuko aye, na omorembe ogenderere kobao goika ekero omotienyi otabeo.
swahili: Katika siku zake wenye haki watastawi; mafanikio yatakuwepo mpaka mwezi utakapokoma.

english: May he rule from sea to sea, and from the Euphrates to the ends of the earth.
ekegusii: Tiga omorwoti abe okogamba korwa ase enyancha eyemo goika eyende, na korwa ase orooche rw’Eufarati goika ase ensinyo y’ense.
swahili: Atatawala kutoka bahari hadi bahari na kutoka Mto mpaka miisho ya dunia.

english: May the nomads bow before him, and his enemies lick the dust.
ekegusii: Abanto bamenyete ase erooro mbatugame ase obosio bwaye bamosike, n’ababisa baye bamene orotu.
swahili: Makabila ya jangwani watamsujudia, na adui zake wataramba mavumbi.

english: Surely God is good to Israel, to those who are pure in heart.
ekegusii: Ekeene, Nyasae nigo are omuya mono ase Abaisraeli, ee, ase abwo bare ne chinkoro chichenegete.
swahili: Hakika Mungu ni mwema kwa Israeli, kwa wale ambao mioyo yao ni safi.

english: So their people return to this place and drink up waters in abundance.
ekegusii: Ase ayio abanto babo nigo bakoonchoka baababwatia, nigo bakwong’otera amaache abo are amange.
swahili: Kwa hiyo watu wao huwageukia na kunywa maji tele.

english: The wicked say, “How can God know? Does the Most High have knowledge?”
ekegusii: Erio bateeba, “Naki Nyasae arakore amanye? Inee! Ere Oyore Igoro Mono nabwate obong’aini?”
swahili: Wanasema, “Mungu awezaje kujua? Je, Yeye Aliye Juu Sana anayo maarifa?”

english: Behold, these are the wicked— always carefree as they increase their wealth.
ekegusii: Naama! Naboigo abakori amabe bare; botambe nigo bare buya na bagendererete komenta obotenenku bwabo.
swahili: Hivi ndivyo walivyo waovu: siku zote hawajali, wanaongezeka katika utajiri.

english: Surely in vain I have kept my heart pure; in innocence I have washed my hands.
ekegusii: Ekeene, mbosa nabeire ndendete enkoro yane ebe echenegete, mbosa nabeire ngoisaba amaboko aane ng’a timba nokomocha.
swahili: Hakika nimeuweka moyo wangu safi bure, ni bure nimenawa mikono yangu nisiwe na hatia.

english: For I am afflicted all day long and punished every morning.
ekegusii: Omobaso boira nabeire nkonyora amaakwa, na kera emambia nabeire nkonyora egesusuro gi’okondongeyia.
swahili: Mchana kutwa nimetaabika, nimeadhibiwa kila asubuhi.

english: If I had said, “I will speak this way,” then I would have betrayed Your children.
ekegusii: Onye nakwanete amang’ana buna ayio, nigo narenge gocha koba oyotari omwegenwa ase ebiaare bi’abaanto bao.
swahili: Kama ningesema, “Nitasema hivi,” ningelikuwa nimewasaliti watoto wako.

english: When I tried to understand all this, it was troublesome in my sight
ekegusii: Bono ekero nabeete nkorengereria komanya engencho y’amang’ana ayio, amang’ana ayio akaba amakong’u ase ’nde,
swahili: Nilipojaribu kuelewa haya yote, yalikuwa magumu kwangu kuelewa.

english: until I entered God’s sanctuary; then I discerned their end.
ekegusii: goika ekero nasoete ime ase obomenyo obochenu bwa Nyasae, erio nario namanyete omoerio bw’abanyabibe buna ore.
swahili: Mpaka nilipoingia patakatifu pa Mungu, ndipo nilipotambua mwisho wao.

english: Surely You set them on slick ground; You cast them down into ruin.
ekegusii: Ekeene, aye Omonene nigo okobabeeka aase are aaterere, aye nigo okobaturunkania kwabasiria kegima.
swahili: Hakika unawaweka mahali pa utelezi, unawaangusha chini kwa uharibifu.

english: How suddenly they are laid waste, completely swept away by terrors!
ekegusii: Barabwo nigo bagosirigwa rioka, omoerio obo nomoondoko okobasiria.
swahili: Tazama jinsi wanavyoangamizwa ghafula, wanatoweshwa kabisa na vitisho!

english: But as for me, my feet had almost stumbled; my steps had nearly slipped.
ekegusii: Amagoro aane konya abeire ang’e kogochwa, konya nabeire ang’e gotererigwa,
swahili: Bali kwangu mimi, miguu yangu ilikuwa karibu kuteleza; nilikuwa karibu mguu wangu kuachia uliposimama.

english: Like one waking from a dream, so You, O Lord, awaken and despise their form.
ekegusii: Nigo banga buna chindoto omonto akweba mambia gakoboka. Aye Omonene, naboigo bare asore buna omogwekano okororwa ase okorota, ekero okoimoka nigo okweba ebieni biabo.
swahili: Kama ndoto mtu aamkapo, hivyo wakati uinukapo, Ee Bwana, utawatowesha kama ndoto.

english: When my heart was grieved and I was pierced within,
ekegusii: Ekero narenge nobororo ase omoyo ime, na enkoro yane ekaba buna eyabetirwe.
swahili: Wakati moyo wangu ulipohuzunishwa, na roho yangu ilipotiwa uchungu,

english: I was senseless and ignorant; I was a brute beast before You.
ekegusii: Nigo nabeete omoriri mono, tinamanya gento; nkaba buna eng’iti y’orosana ase obosio bwao.
swahili: nilikuwa mpumbavu na mjinga, nilikuwa mnyama mkatili mbele yako.

english: Yet I am always with You; You hold my right hand.
ekegusii: Nonya naboigo, inche nigo ngendererete kobeera asore botambe, aye nigo obwatete okoboko kwane gw’okorio.
swahili: Hata hivyo niko pamoja nawe siku zote, umenishika mkono wangu wa kuume.

english: You guide me with Your counsel, and later receive me in glory.
ekegusii: Aye nigo okondaa na gonsemia, na magega y’ayio noche kong’ira onsoyie ase obonene.
swahili: Unaniongoza kwa shauri lako, hatimaye utaniingiza katika utukufu.

english: Whom have I in heaven but You? And on earth I desire no one besides You.
ekegusii: Inee! Ning’o naende imbwate aaria igoro, otatiga aye bweka? Ekero nkobwate, gento tikeri aiga ase ense nganetie.
swahili: Nani niliye naye mbinguni ila wewe? Dunia haina chochote ninachokitamani ila wewe.

english: My flesh and my heart may fail, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.
ekegusii: Omobere one na enkoro yane nabo biranyare koborwa chinguru, korende aye Nyasae, naye ore egetare gi’enkoro yane, naende naye egetare kiane goika kare na kare.
swahili: Mwili na moyo wangu vyaweza kushindwa, bali Mungu ni nguvu ya moyo wangu na fungu langu milele.

english: Those far from You will surely perish; You destroy all who are unfaithful to You.
ekegusii: Rora, abanto abwo bagweatanana korwa asore nabasire; aye nigo orasirie abwo batari abegenwa asore.
swahili: Wale walio mbali nawe wataangamia, unawaangamiza wote wasio waaminifu kwako.

english: But as for me, it is good to draw near to God. I have made the Lord GOD my refuge, that I may proclaim all Your works.
ekegusii: Korende ase ’nde inche, nigo ere buya mono kobeera ang’e na Nyasae. Omonene obeire obotamero bwane, ninyare koraria emeremo yaye yonsi.
swahili: Lakini kwangu mimi, ni vyema kuwa karibu na Mungu. Nimemfanya Bwana Mwenyezi kimbilio langu; nami nitayasimulia matendo yako yote.

english: For I envied the arrogant when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.
ekegusii: ekiagera nigo nabeete ne ribero ase abanto abaenenu, ekero naroche ng’a abwo ababe nigo basesenirie.
swahili: Kwa maana niliwaonea wivu wenye kujivuna nilipoona kufanikiwa kwa waovu.

english: They have no struggle in their death; their bodies are well-fed.
ekegusii: Barabwo tibari konyorwa nobokong’u bonde ase obogima bwabo; emebere yabo nigo ere emiya, naende emenoru.
swahili: Wao hawana taabu, miili yao ina afya na nguvu.

english: They are free of the burdens others carry; they are not afflicted like other men.
ekegusii: Tibabwati emechando buna abanto bande babwate; tibari konyora amaakwa buna abande.
swahili: Hawapati shida zinazowataabisha watu wengine, wala hawapati mapigo kama wanadamu wengine.

english: Therefore pride is their necklace; a garment of violence covers them.
ekegusii: Ase ayio, obwerori nigo boetanaine amagoti abo, na obotindi nabwo beboyetie buna eanga.
swahili: Kwa hiyo kiburi ni mkufu wao, wamejivika jeuri.

english: From their prosperity proceeds iniquity; the imaginations of their hearts run wild.
ekegusii: Amaiso abo nigo akogirigenta nobonoru, obotantanu bw’ebirengererio bie chinkoro chiabo nobonge mono.
swahili: Uovu hutoka katika mioyo yao iliyokufa ganzi, majivuno maovu kutoka mioyoni mwao hauna kikomo.

english: They mock and speak with malice; with arrogance they threaten oppression.
ekegusii: Nigo bagochecheria abande na gokwana ase okobakorera bobe. Nigo bakweimokereria igoro na kobatianera.
swahili: Hudhihaki na kusema kwa ukorofi, katika majivuno yao wanatishia kutesa.

english: They set their mouths against the heavens, and their tongues strut across the earth.
ekegusii: Emenwa yabo nigo egokwana amang’ana amabe are mamincha ya igoro; ne chimeme chiabo chiasokia ayakogenda ase ense engima.
swahili: Vinywa vyao huweka madai hata kwa mbingu, nazo ndimi zao humiliki duniani.

english: Why have You rejected us forever, O God? Why does Your anger smolder against the sheep of Your pasture?
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, nase ki gwatotigire kegima? Ninki gekogera endamwamu yao yokire igoro ye ching’ondi chi’oborisia bwao?
swahili: Ee Mungu, mbona umetukataa milele? Mbona hasira yako inatoka moshi juu ya kondoo wa malisho yako?

english: How long, O God, will the enemy taunt You? Will the foe revile Your name forever?
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, ngoika ririri ababisa barabe bakona‐gochecheria? Inee! Ababisa aba nigo bagochia kona‐korama erieta riao kogenderera botambe?
swahili: Ee Mungu, mtesi atakudhihaki mpaka lini? Je, adui watalitukana jina lako milele?

english: Why do You withdraw Your strong right hand? Stretch it out to destroy them!
ekegusii: Nase ki aye kwaringire okoboko kwao gw’okorio? Korambore korwa ase egekuba kiao, obasirie kegima.
swahili: Kwa nini unazuia mkono wako, mkono wako wa kuume? Uutoe kutoka makunjo ya vazi lako na uwaangamize!

english: Yet God is my King from ancient times, working salvation on the earth.
ekegusii: Nyasae, aye nigo ore omorwoti one, kwarengeo korwa kare, naye kwabeire kogokora emeremo y’ogotooria ense engima.
swahili: Lakini wewe, Ee Mungu, ni mfalme wangu tangu zamani, unaleta wokovu duniani.

english: You divided the sea by Your strength; You smashed the heads of the dragons of the sea;
ekegusii: Aye nigo gwatananete enyancha ase okobua kwao, ogasenyenta emetwe ye chinchoka chi’enyancha.
swahili: Ni wewe uliyeigawanya bahari kwa uweza wako; ulivunja vichwa vya wanyama wakubwa wa kutisha katika maji.

english: You crushed the heads of Leviathan; You fed him to the creatures of the desert.
ekegusii: Aye nigo gwasenyentete emetwe ya Leviatani, eng’iti eria enene y’okwoboyia, erio omobere oye okayoa ching’iti chi’erooro chikayoria.
swahili: Ni wewe uliyeponda vichwa vya Lewiathani nawe ukamtoa kama chakula kwa viumbe vya jangwani.

english: You broke open the fountain and the flood; You dried up the ever-flowing rivers.
ekegusii: Aye nigo gwatubogetie chinsoko ne chindooche; boigo ogasiria amaache ye chindooche chinene, chigakamoka.
swahili: Ni wewe uliyefungua chemchemi na vijito, ulikausha mito ambayo ilikuwa ikitiririka daima.

english: The day is Yours, and also the night; You established the moon and the sun.
ekegusii: Omobaso noyoo, na obotuko nobwao, naye gwatongete omotienyi na erioba.
swahili: Mchana ni wako, nao usiku ni wako pia, uliziweka jua na mwezi.

english: You set all the boundaries of the earth; You made the summer and winter.
ekegusii: Naye gwachiigete aase chimbebe chionsi chi’ense chikobeera, naende ogakora chingaki chi’egura gura n’etoigo.
swahili: Ni wewe uliyeiweka mipaka yote ya dunia, ulifanya kiangazi na masika.

english: Remember how the enemy has mocked You, O LORD, how a foolish people has spurned Your name.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, inyora buna ababisa bagendererete kogochecheria, na abatakoirogeti nigo bagendererete korama erieta riao.
swahili: Ee Bwana, kumbuka jinsi mtesi alivyokudhihaki, jinsi watu wapumbavu walivyolitukana jina lako.

english: Do not deliver the soul of Your dove to beasts; do not forget the lives of Your afflicted forever.
ekegusii: Tobaisa korua omoyo one, inche riruma riao, ase omoganda oria omobe; tibweba nonya ng’ake abanto bao abwo baregire.
swahili: Usiukabidhi uhai wa njiwa wako kwa wanyama wakali wa mwitu; usisahau kabisa uhai wa watu wako wanaoteseka milele.

english: Remember Your congregation, which You purchased long ago and redeemed as the tribe of Your inheritance— Mount Zion where You dwell.
ekegusii: Inyora omoganda bw’abaanto bao, abwo kwenyorerete ase chingaki chia kare. Aye nigo kwababooretie babe egesaku kere omwando oo. Inyora egetunwa gia Sayoni, agwo ase kwabeire komenyete.
swahili: Kumbuka watu uliowanunua zamani, kabila la urithi wako, ambao uliwakomboa: Mlima Sayuni, ambamo uliishi.

english: Consider Your covenant, for haunts of violence fill the dark places of the land.
ekegusii: Oinyore okobwatana kwao kw’ogotianania gwakorete naintwe; ense nigo eichire nobobe ase kera ensemo y’omosunte.
swahili: Likumbuke agano lako, maana mara kwa mara mambo ya jeuri yamejaa katika sehemu za giza nchini.

english: Do not let the oppressed retreat in shame; may the poor and needy praise Your name.
ekegusii: Tobaisa gotiga abanto abwo bagokorerwa bobe basookigwe; tiga abanto abataka na abwo baremeire batogie erieta riao.
swahili: Usiruhusu walioonewa warudi nyuma kwa aibu; maskini na wahitaji hebu walisifu jina lako.

english: Rise up, O God; defend Your cause! Remember how the fool mocks You all day long.
ekegusii: Nyasae, imoka bwerwanerere aye omonyene; inyora buna abatakoirogeti bakogokorera echeche kera rituko.
swahili: Inuka, Ee Mungu, ujitetee; kumbuka jinsi wapumbavu wanavyokudhihaki mchana kutwa.

english: Do not disregard the clamor of Your adversaries, the uproar of Your enemies that ascends continually.
ekegusii: Tobaisa kweba okwoga kw’ababisa bao, ne rirorooche ri’abakogochecheria rigotiira botambe.
swahili: Usipuuze makelele ya watesi wako, ghasia za adui zako, zinazoinuka mfululizo.

english: Turn Your steps to the everlasting ruins, to everything in the sanctuary the enemy has destroyed.
ekegusii: Inchuo otaare aase agwo agendererete gosareka; ababisa nigo basaretie bionsi ebiarenge ime ase obomenyo boria obochenu.
swahili: Geuza hatua zako kuelekea magofu haya ya kudumu, uharibifu wote huu ambao adui ameuleta pale patakatifu.

english: Your foes have roared within Your meeting place; they have unfurled their banners as signs,
ekegusii: Ababisa bao nigo bakwoga aase abanto bao basangererekanete, barabwo batenenirie chibendera chiabo koba ebimanyererio biabo.
swahili: Adui zako wamenguruma pale ulipokutana nasi, wanaweka bendera zao kama alama.

english: like men wielding axes in a thicket of trees
ekegusii: Nigo yarorekanete buna nabaanto bakogecha emete, bakaimokia ebisire kogecha rinani rinoru.
swahili: Walifanya kama watu wanaotumia mashoka kukata kichaka cha miti.

english: and smashing all the carvings with hatchets and picks.
ekegusii: Nigo baimogetie chinyundo na ebisire, bakabuna ebinto bionsi bie Hekalu biabachetwe korwa ase emete.
swahili: Walivunjavunja milango yote iliyonakshiwa kwa mashoka na vishoka vyao.

english: They have burned Your sanctuary to the ground; they have defiled the dwelling place of Your Name.
ekegusii: Nigo basambete nomorero Obomenyo bwao Obochenu, bakaiyeria inse Obomenyo Obochenu bw’erieta riao, na bakabokora bokaba obotachenegeti.
swahili: Waliteketeza kabisa mahali pako patakatifu, wakayanajisi makao ya Jina lako.

english: They said in their hearts, “We will crush them completely.” They burned down every place where God met us in the land.
ekegusii: Abanto abwo bagateeba ase emioyo yabo, “Goika tobasirie kegima.” Nigo basambete aase onsi abanto ba Nyasae bagosangererekana.
swahili: Walisema mioyoni mwao, “Tutawaponda kabisa!” Walichoma kila mahali ambapo Mungu aliabudiwa katika nchi.

english: There are no signs for us to see. There is no longer any prophet. And none of us knows how long this will last.
ekegusii: Titorochi ebimanyererio biaito, na ababani tibaiyo, na onde tari ase egati yaito omanyete ngoika ririri aya arabe.
swahili: Hatukupewa ishara za miujiza; hakuna manabii waliobaki, hakuna yeyote kati yetu ajuaye hali hii itachukua muda gani.

english: We give thanks to You, O God; we give thanks, for Your Name is near. The people declare Your wondrous works.
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, nigo togokoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono, naende mbuya mono, ekiagera erieta riao nigo rire ang’e, nigo tokoraareria emeremo yao y’ogokumia.
swahili: Ee Mungu, tunakushukuru, tunakushukuru wewe, kwa kuwa jina lako li karibu; watu husimulia matendo yako ya ajabu.

english: “All the horns of the wicked I will cut off, but the horns of the righteous will be exalted.”
ekegusii: Omonene nabune kegima ching’unchara chi’abakori amabe, korende echi’abanyaboronge nachiimokererie igoro.
swahili: Nitazikatilia mbali pembe za waovu wote, bali pembe za wenye haki zitainuliwa juu.

english: “When I choose a time, I will judge fairly.
ekegusii: “Ekero engaki nachigete eraike, inche Nyasae ninache ekiina kia boronge.
swahili: Unasema, “Ninachagua wakati maalum; ni mimi nihukumuye kwa haki.

english: When the earth and all its dwellers quake, it is I who bear up its pillars. Selah
ekegusii: Ekero ense egotengechigwa amo na bonsi abamenyeteo, ninche omonyene nigo nkobwata chisiiro chiaye bokong’u.
swahili: Wakati dunia na watu wake wote inapotetemeka, ni mimi ninayezishikilia nguzo zake imara.

english: I say to the proud, ‘Do not boast,’ and to the wicked, ‘Do not lift up your horn.
ekegusii: Nigo ngokania abanto bagwetogia: Timobaisa gwetogia, naende nintebie abakori amabe: Timobaisa komera ching’unchara chi’obomwenu.
swahili: Kwa wale wenye majivuno ninasema, ‘Msijisifu tena,’ kwa wale waovu, ‘Msiinue pembe zenu.

english: Do not lift up your horn against heaven or speak with an outstretched neck.’”
ekegusii: Ee, timobaisa gochiimokereria igoro ase ogwekaga, gose gokwana amabe, inwe abamore abanyabigoti bikong’u.”
swahili: Msiinue pembe zenu dhidi ya mbingu; msiseme kwa shingo zilizonyooshwa.’ ”

english: For exaltation comes neither from east nor west, nor out of the desert,
ekegusii: Obonene tibori korwa moocha, gose korwa bosongo, gose tibori korwa ase ebitunwa bi’erooro.
swahili: Hakuna yeyote atokaye mashariki wala magharibi au kutoka jangwani awezaye kumkweza mwanadamu.

english: but it is God who judges; He brings down one and exalts another.
ekegusii: Korende Nyasae nere okonacha ekiina, okeyia oyomo, na oimokereria oyonde igoro.
swahili: Bali Mungu ndiye ahukumuye: Humshusha huyu na kumkweza mwingine.

english: For a cup is in the hand of the LORD, full of foaming wine mixed with spices. He pours from His cup, and all the wicked of the earth drink it down to the dregs.
ekegusii: Omonene nabwate egekombe ase okoboko kwaye, geichire nedivai entindi yochoganirie, nayeumorere abakori amabe bonsi b’ense na kobabetereria bayenywe, bayekoore amo neturubo yaye.
swahili: Mkononi mwa Bwana kuna kikombe kilichojaa mvinyo unaotoka povu uliochanganywa na vikolezo; huumimina, nao waovu wote wa dunia hunywa mpaka tone la mwisho.

english: But I will proclaim Him forever; I will sing praise to the God of Jacob.
ekegusii: Korende inche nimbe nkona‐koraria kobeeka kogenderera botambe; nimbe nkona‐goteera ogoteera gw’okomotogia Nyasae o Yakobo.
swahili: Bali mimi, nitatangaza hili milele; nitaimba sifa kwa Mungu wa Yakobo.

english: God is known in Judah; His name is great in Israel.
ekegusii: Nyasae nigo amanyekanete ase Abayuda, erieta riaye rire rinene mono ase Abaisraeli.
swahili: Katika Yuda, Mungu anajulikana, jina lake ni kuu katika Israeli.

english: Even the wrath of man shall praise You; with the survivors of wrath You will clothe Yourself.
ekegusii: Ekeene, endamwamu ya Mwanyabaanto nenyare kogera aye otogigwe; eyeratigare noyieboyie buna orokini.
swahili: Hakika ghadhabu yako dhidi ya wanadamu inakuletea sifa, na masalia ya ghadhabu yako unajifunga mshipi.

english: Make and fulfill your vows to the LORD your God; let all the neighboring lands bring tribute to Him who is to be feared.
ekegusii: Inwe karie chiira ase Omonene, Nyasae oino, na mochiikeranie. Abanto bonsi bamoetanaine, tiga bamorentere ebiegwa, ere oria ogwenerete koirokwa.
swahili: Wekeni nadhiri kwa Bwana Mungu wenu na kuzitimiza; nchi zote za jirani na walete zawadi kwa Yule astahiliye kuogopwa.

english: He breaks the spirits of princes; He is feared by the kings of the earth.
ekegusii: Ere nigo agokeyia abare abaenenu ase ense, abarwoti bonsi b’ense nigo bamwoboete.
swahili: Huvunja roho za watawala; anaogopwa na wafalme wa dunia.

english: His tent is in Salem, His dwelling place in Zion.
ekegusii: Obomenyo bwaye Obochenu nigo bore agwo Salemu, ere nigo amenyete agwo Sayoni.
swahili: Hema lake liko Salemu, makao yake katika Sayuni.

english: There He shattered the flaming arrows, the shield and sword and weapons of war. Selah
ekegusii: Aroro agwo nabunete chinsara chi’amata chikomesa, boigo naende akabutorana chinguba, na emioro na ebirwanero binde bi’esegi.
swahili: Huko alivunja mishale imetametayo, ngao na panga, silaha za vita.

english: You are resplendent with light, more majestic than mountains filled with game.
ekegusii: Aye nigo okomeka‐meka oichire nobonene kogocha korwa ase ebitunwa biababisa kwabuire.
swahili: Wewe unangʼaa kwa mwanga, mwenye fahari zaidi ya milima yenye utajiri wa wanyama pori.

english: The valiant lie plundered; they sleep their last sleep. No men of might could lift a hand.
ekegusii: Abare ne chinkoro chimwenu baurirwe ebinto konya basakoire, bono bararire chitoro chindito. Abarwani esegi bonsi basinyirwe korwana namaboko abo.
swahili: Mashujaa hulala wametekwa nyara, hulala usingizi wao wa mwisho; hakuna hata mmoja wa watu wa vita anayeweza kuinua mikono yake.

english: At Your rebuke, O God of Jacob, both horse and rider lie stunned.
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae o Yakobo, ekero gwatogonyerete abanto bariinete chibarasi, barabwo nigo bagwete inse, bakaba buna nigo bakwete, amo ne chibarasi chiabo.
swahili: Kwa kukemea kwako, Ee Mungu wa Yakobo, farasi na gari la vita vilikaa kimya.

english: You alone are to be feared. When You are angry, who can stand before You?
ekegusii: Aye bweka nigo ore oyo bw’okoondokia mono. Ning’o oranyare gotenena ase obosio bwao, ekero kwabeire nendamwamu?
swahili: Wewe peke yako ndiye wa kuogopwa. Ni nani awezaye kusimama mbele yako unapokasirika?

english: From heaven You pronounced judgment, and the earth feared and was still
ekegusii: Korwa agwo igoro, nigo kwamanyetie ense ebiina biao; na ense ekoboa egakira‐kiri,
swahili: Kutoka mbinguni ulitamka hukumu, nayo nchi ikaogopa, ikawa kimya:

english: when God rose up to judge, to save all the lowly of the earth. Selah
ekegusii: ekero aye Nyasae gwatenenete konacha ekiina na kobatooria abwo bonsi bagokorerwa bobe.
swahili: wakati wewe, Ee Mungu, ulipoinuka kuhukumu, kuwaokoa wote walioonewa katika nchi.

english: I cried out to God; I cried aloud to God to hear me.
ekegusii: Nkorera nde ase Nyasae neriogi rinene, nigo nkorera mono asare ng’a anyigwe.
swahili: Nilimlilia Mungu ili anisaidie, nilimlilia Mungu ili anisikie.

english: So I said, “I am grieved that the right hand of the Most High has changed.”
ekegusii: Erio ngateeba, “Obo nobororo bwane, eye nengaki okoboko gw’okorio kw’Oyore Igoro Mono gwantomeire.”
swahili: Ndipo nikawaza, “Huu ndio udhaifu wangu: lakini nitakumbuka miaka ya mkono wa kuume wa Aliye Juu Sana.”

english: I will remember the works of the LORD; yes, I will remember Your wonders of old.
ekegusii: Ning’inyore ogokora kwao aye Omonene; ee, ning’inyore amakumia ao a kare.
swahili: Nitayakumbuka matendo ya Bwana; naam, nitaikumbuka miujiza yako ya zamani.

english: I will reflect on all You have done and ponder Your mighty deeds.
ekegusii: Nimbe nkorengereria igoro y’emeremo yao yonsi, na imbe nkona‐koiranerera ogokora kwao gwe chinguru.
swahili: Nitazitafakari kazi zako zote na kuyawaza matendo yako makuu.

english: Your way, O God, is holy. What god is so great as our God?
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, chinchera chiao nigo chire chinchenu. Nenyasae ereri ere enene buna Nyasae oito?
swahili: Ee Mungu, njia zako ni takatifu. Ni mungu yupi aliye mkuu kama Mungu wetu?

english: You are the God who works wonders; You display Your strength among the peoples.
ekegusii: Aye nigo ore Nyasae ogokora amakumia; kwaorokirie okobua kwao ase egati ya Mwanyabaanto.
swahili: Wewe ndiwe Mungu utendaye miujiza, umeonyesha uwezo wako katikati ya mataifa.

english: With power You redeemed Your people, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah
ekegusii: Aye nigo gwatooretie abanto bao nokoboko kwao koramboire. Abanto abwo nigo barenge ab’ororeria rwa Yakobo na orwa Yusufu.
swahili: Kwa mkono wako wenye nguvu umewakomboa watu wako, uzao wa Yakobo na Yosefu.

english: The waters saw You, O God; the waters saw You and swirled; even the depths were shaken.
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, ekero amaache akorooche, ee, ekero akorooche, nigo akwoboete, ne chindiba chikanyegerigwa.
swahili: Maji yalikuona, Ee Mungu, maji yalikuona yakakimbia, vilindi vilitetemeka.

english: The clouds poured down water; the skies resounded with thunder; Your arrows flashed back and forth.
ekegusii: Amare agaitera amaache; ne chinkoba chigaaka korwa igoro, chinsara chiao chikamesa ase chinsemo chionsi.
swahili: Mawingu yalimwaga maji, mbingu zikatoa ngurumo kwa radi, mishale yako ikametameta huku na huko.

english: Your thunder resounded in the whirlwind; the lightning lit up the world; the earth trembled and quaked.
ekegusii: Okogukura gw’enkoba nigo kwarenge ime ase ekerambauti, na ense egatengecha.
swahili: Ngurumo yako ilisikika katika upepo wa kisulisuli, umeme wako wa radi ukaangaza dunia, nchi ikatetemeka na kutikisika.

english: Your path led through the sea, Your way through the mighty waters, but Your footprints were not to be found.
ekegusii: Nigo gwakorete enchera yao ase enyancha, oboeto bwao bokaba ime ase amaache amange mono, korende nonya naboigo amabarato ao tarorekanete aroro.
swahili: Njia yako ilipita baharini, mapito yako kwenye maji makuu, ingawa nyayo zako hazikuonekana.

english: In the day of trouble I sought the Lord; through the night my outstretched hands did not grow weary; my soul refused to be comforted.
ekegusii: Ase chingaki chi’emechando nigo nkorigia Omonene; ase obotuko nigo nkorambora okoboko kwane ase ogosaba ntari korosa, omoyo one nigo okwanga koremigwa.
swahili: Nilipokuwa katika taabu, nilimtafuta Bwana, usiku nilinyoosha mikono bila kuchoka na nafsi yangu ilikataa kufarijika.

english: You led Your people like a flock by the hand of Moses and Aaron.
ekegusii: Aye nigo kwaraaete abanto bao buna riicho rikoraagwa, ee, okabaraa goetera ase amaboko a Musa na Aroni.
swahili: Uliongoza watu wako kama kundi kwa mkono wa Mose na Aroni.

english: I remembered You, O God, and I groaned; I mused and my spirit grew faint. Selah
ekegusii: Ekero nkoinyora Nyasae, nigo nkorera, na ekero nkomorengereria, nigo ngokwa omoyo.
swahili: Ee Mungu, nilikukumbuka wewe, nikalia kwa huzuni; nikatafakari, roho yangu ikadhoofika.

english: You have kept my eyes from closing; I am too troubled to speak.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, nigo ogotanga amaiso aane takonyora chitoro. Nigo nchandegete mono, tinkonyara gokwana.
swahili: Ulizuia macho yangu kufumba; nilikuwa nasumbuka, nikashindwa kusema.

english: I considered the days of old, the years long in the past.
ekegusii: Nigo nkoba nkorengereria igoro y’amatuko a kare, nkoinyora emiaka ya kare buna yarenge.
swahili: Nilitafakari juu ya siku zilizopita, miaka mingi iliyopita,

english: At night I remembered my song; in my heart I mused, and my spirit pondered:
ekegusii: Ase obotuko obogima nigo nkoinyora amatera aane: nigo nkoba nkorengereria ase enkoro yane ime, neriga‐rigia na kweboria:
swahili: nilikumbuka nilivyoimba nyimbo usiku. Moyo wangu ulitafakari na roho yangu ikauliza:

english: “Will the Lord spurn us forever and never show His favor again?
ekegusii: “Inee! Omonene natotigire kegima? Tagotororera amaabera rinde?
swahili: “Je, Bwana atakataa milele? Je, hatatenda mema tena?

english: Is His loving devotion gone forever? Has His promise failed for all time?
ekegusii: Inee! Obwanchani bwaye bwa botambe mbwaerire kegima? Chiira chiaye nchiaikire omoerio?
swahili: Je, upendo wake usio na mwisho umetoweka milele? Je, ahadi yake imekoma nyakati zote?

english: Has God forgotten to be gracious? Has His anger shut off His compassion?” Selah
ekegusii: Nyasae nigo ebire koba omonyamaabera? Inee! Nigo abeire nendamwamu, goika osiekire amabeebe?”
swahili: Je, Mungu amesahau kuwa na huruma? Je, katika hasira amezuia huruma yake?”

english: Give ear, O my people, to my instruction; listen to the words of my mouth.
ekegusii: Inwe abanto baane, igwa amang’ana nkoborokereria, tegerera moigwe amang’ana ’omonwa one.
swahili: Enyi watu wangu, sikieni mafundisho yangu, sikilizeni maneno ya kinywa changu.

english: They failed to keep God’s covenant and refused to live by His law.
ekegusii: Barabwo tibarendete okobwatana kw’ogotianania kwa Nyasae, naende nigo bangete kobwatia amachiiko aye.
swahili: Hawakulishika agano la Mungu na walikataa kuishi kwa sheria yake.

english: They forgot what He had done, the wonders He had shown them.
ekegusii: Bakeba amang’an’Omonene konya akorire, na ebikone biria konya aorokirie ase bare.
swahili: Walisahau aliyokuwa ameyatenda, maajabu aliyokuwa amewaonyesha.

english: He worked wonders before their fathers in the land of Egypt, in the region of Zoan.
ekegusii: Ase amasio e chisokoro chiabo Nyasae nigo akorete amakumia agwo ase ense ya Misiri, ase orogongo rwa Soani.
swahili: Alitenda miujiza machoni mwa baba zao, huko Soani, katika nchi ya Misri.

english: He split the sea and brought them through; He set the waters upright like a wall.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo aatananete amaache ’enyancha, akaambokeria chisokoro chiabo aroro, agakora amaache ayio agatenena buna orwaki.
swahili: Aliigawanya bahari akawapitisha, alifanya maji yasimame imara kama ukuta.

english: He led them with a cloud by day and with a light of fire all night.
ekegusii: Ase chingaki chia mobaso nigo arenge kobaraa ne riire, na ase chingaki chia botuko abaraa ne riire ri’omorero.
swahili: Aliwaongoza kwa wingu mchana na kwa nuru kutoka kwenye moto usiku kucha.

english: He split the rocks in the wilderness and gave them drink as abundant as the seas.
ekegusii: Ere agatandora ebitare agwo ase erooro, agasokeria abanto amaache amange mono buna aye chindooche chinene.
swahili: Alipasua miamba jangwani na akawapa maji tele kama bahari,

english: He brought streams from the stone and made water flow down like rivers.
ekegusii: Agatubokia chindooche korwa ase ebitare ime, na amaache agatirimboka buna aye chindooche chinene.
swahili: alitoa vijito kutoka kwenye jabali lililochongoka, akayafanya maji yatiririke kama mito.

english: But they continued to sin against Him, rebelling in the desert against the Most High.
ekegusii: Nonya naboigo abanto abwo nigo bamentete gokora ebibe ase Omonene, agwo ase erooro nigo basaretie ase Omonene Ore Igoro Mono.
swahili: Lakini waliendelea kutenda dhambi dhidi yake, wakiasi jangwani dhidi ya Aliye Juu Sana.

english: They willfully tested God by demanding the food they craved.
ekegusii: Barabwo nigo bateemete Nyasae ase chinkoro chiabo ime, bakagania baegwe endagera basanerete.
swahili: Kwa makusudi walimjaribu Mungu, wakidai vyakula walivyovitamani.

english: They spoke against God, saying, “Can God really prepare a table in the wilderness?
ekegusii: Bagakwana amang’ana arenge mamincha ya Nyasae, bagateeba, “Inee! Nyasae nanyare gototerekera endagera eisaine aa ase erooro?
swahili: Walinena dhidi ya Mungu, wakisema, “Je, Mungu aweza kuandaa meza jangwani?

english: I will open my mouth in parables; I will utter things hidden from the beginning,
ekegusii: Inche ninkwane ase omoreng’anio, nigo ndakwane ase emebayeno ya kare.
swahili: Nitafungua kinywa changu kwa mafumbo, nitazungumza mambo yaliyofichika, mambo ya kale:

english: When He struck the rock, water gushed out and torrents raged. But can He also give bread or supply His people with meat?”
ekegusii: Ee, amaene ere naagete egetare na amaache agacharara korwao, ne chindooche chi’amaache amange chikarwao, korende, Inee, nanyare boigo koa intwe abanto baye endagera? Nanyare gotoa na enyama torie?”
swahili: Alipopiga mwamba, maji yalitoka kwa nguvu, vijito vikatiririka maji mengi. Lakini je, aweza kutupa chakula pia? Je, anaweza kuwapa watu wake nyama?”

english: Therefore the LORD heard and was filled with wrath; so a fire was kindled against Jacob, and His anger flared against Israel,
ekegusii: Ase ayio, ekero Omonene aigwete ayio, agaichorwa nekeririanda, akarwania abanto b’ororeria rwa Yakobo nomorero, ekiagera nigo abeete nendamwamu enene mono ase Abaisraeli.
swahili: Bwana alipowasikia, alikasirika sana, moto wake ukawa dhidi ya Yakobo, na ghadhabu yake ikawaka dhidi ya Israeli,

english: because they did not believe God or rely on His salvation.
ekegusii: Ayio nigo akoregete, ekiagera tibamwegenete Nyasae, naende tibegenete ng’a ere nanyare kobatooria.
swahili: kwa kuwa hawakumwamini Mungu, wala kuutumainia ukombozi wake.

english: Yet He commanded the clouds above and opened the doors of the heavens.
ekegusii: Korende nonya nabo, ere nigo achigete igoro, akaigora ebisieri bi’aroro;
swahili: Hata hivyo alitoa amri kwa anga zilizo juu na kufungua milango ya mbingu,

english: He rained down manna for them to eat; He gave them grain from heaven.
ekegusii: akabatweria endagera ekorokwa mana, bakaba bakoyeria; ee, akabaa endagera korwa igoro.
swahili: akawanyeshea mana ili watu wale; aliwapa nafaka ya mbinguni.

english: Man ate the bread of angels; He sent them food in abundance.
ekegusii: Ase ayio, Mwanyabaanto bakaria endagera y’abamalaika; Omonene akabatomera endagera enyinge mono.
swahili: Watu walikula mkate wa malaika, akawatumia chakula chote ambacho wangeliweza kula.

english: He stirred the east wind from the heavens and drove the south wind by His might.
ekegusii: Akarenta omwaga o moocha okagusa igoro, na ase okobua kwaye akagusia omwaga korwa Irianyi.
swahili: Aliachia upepo wa mashariki kutoka kwenye mbingu na kuuongoza upepo wa kusini kwa uwezo wake.

english: He rained meat on them like dust, and winged birds like the sand of the sea.
ekegusii: Erio akabarentera chinyama chinyinge buna orotu, ne chinyoni chikoiruruka chinyinge buna omokenye ore ase enyancha;
swahili: Aliwanyeshea nyama kama mavumbi, ndege warukao kama mchanga wa pwani.

english: He felled them in the midst of their camp, all around their dwellings.
ekegusii: agatiga chinyoni echio chikagwa gati‐gati y’egetwori kiabo, chigaetanana chiema chiabo.
swahili: Aliwafanya washuke ndani ya kambi yao, kuzunguka mahema yao yote.

english: So they ate and were well filled, for He gave them what they craved.
ekegusii: Erio abanto abwo bakaria chinyama bakaigota, ekiagera Nyasae nigo abaete eke basanerete.
swahili: Walikula na kusaza, kwa maana alikuwa amewapa kile walichotamani.

english: that we have heard and known and our fathers have relayed to us.
ekegusii: Amang’ana ayio twaigwete na koyamanya, ayio chisokoro chiaito chiatotebetie.
swahili: yale ambayo tuliyasikia na kuyajua, yale ambayo baba zetu walituambia.

english: Yet before they had filled their desire, with the food still in their mouths,
ekegusii: Korende ekero chinyama chiarenge ase emenwa yabo bagendererete gochitakuna, naende konya bataraisanekia obogworu bwabo.
swahili: Kabla hawajamaliza kula walichokitamani, hata kilipokuwa kingali bado vinywani mwao,

english: God’s anger flared against them, and He put to death their strongest and subdued the young men of Israel.
ekegusii: Nyasae akaba nendamwamu enene ase bare, agaita abanto abwo barenge ne chinguru goetania abande, agakoora kegima abamura b’Abaisraeli.
swahili: hasira ya Mungu ikawaka juu yao, akawaua wale waliokuwa na nguvu zaidi miongoni mwao, akiwaangusha vijana wa Israeli.

english: In spite of all this, they kept on sinning; despite His wonderful works, they did not believe.
ekegusii: Nonya naboigo, abanto abwo nigo bagendererete gokora ebibe, nonya ere okorete amakumia, tibamwegenete.
swahili: Licha ya haya yote, waliendelea kutenda dhambi, licha ya maajabu yake, hawakuamini.

english: So He ended their days in futility, and their years in sudden terror.
ekegusii: Ase ayio agakoora amatuko abo, akayasiria, na emiaka yabo ekaera ase okoondokia.
swahili: Kwa hiyo akamaliza siku zao katika ubatili na miaka yao katika vitisho.

english: When He slew them, they would seek Him; they repented and searched for God.
ekegusii: Ekero aitete abanto abatigari nigo bamorigetie; nigo baonchogete, bakamorigia ase ekeene.
swahili: Kila mara Mungu alipowaua baadhi yao, waliosalia walimtafuta, walimgeukia tena kwa shauku.

english: And they remembered that God was their Rock, that God Most High was their Redeemer.
ekegusii: Nigo bainyorete ng’a Nyasae nere egetare kiabo; naende ng’a Nyasae Oyore Igoro Mono, nere Omobooria obo.
swahili: Walikumbuka kwamba Mungu alikuwa Mwamba wao, kwamba Mungu Aliye Juu Sana alikuwa Mkombozi wao.

english: But they deceived Him with their mouths, and lied to Him with their tongues.
ekegusii: Korende nigo bakwanete amang’ana amansu ase okomong’aina, bagakwana oborimo nemenwa yabo.
swahili: Lakini walimdanganya kwa vinywa vyao, wakisema uongo kwa ndimi zao,

english: Their hearts were disloyal to Him, and they were unfaithful to His covenant.
ekegusii: Tibamobwatetie bokong’u ne chinkoro chiabo, gose tibarenge abegenwa ase okobwatana kwaye kw’ogotianania.
swahili: mioyo yao haikuwa thabiti kwake, wala hawakuwa waaminifu katika agano lake.

english: And yet He was compassionate; He forgave their iniquity and did not destroy them. He often restrained His anger and did not unleash His full wrath.
ekegusii: Korende Omonene nigo arenge namaabera, akaba okwabera ebibe biabo tabasiria; ase chingaki chinyinge nigo arenge gotanga endamwamu yaye, gose tarenge gotiga ekeririanda kiaye gioke mono.
swahili: Hata hivyo alikuwa na huruma, alisamehe maovu yao na hakuwaangamiza. Mara kwa mara alizuia hasira yake, wala hakuchochea ghadhabu yake yote.

english: He remembered that they were but flesh, a passing breeze that does not return.
ekegusii: Nigo ainyorete ng’a barabwo Mwanyabaanto bagosira, nigo banga buna embeo egoeta na tekoirana.
swahili: Alikumbuka kwamba wao walikuwa nyama tu, upepo upitao ambao haurudi.

english: We will not hide them from their children, but will declare to the next generation the praises of the LORD and His might, and the wonders He has performed.
ekegusii: Amang’ana ayio titokoyabisa ase abana babo; goika toteebie ebiaare bigochi‐gocha ogokora kw’obonene bw’Omonene, na amakumia aye ay’okobua akorire.
