swahili: Hatutayaficha kwa watoto wao; tutakiambia kizazi kijacho matendo yastahiliyo sifa ya Bwana, uweza wake, na maajabu aliyoyafanya.

english: How often they disobeyed Him in the wilderness and grieved Him in the desert!
ekegusii: Ase chingaki chinyinge nigo babete bagosaria ase Omonene agwo ase erooro; bakaba bakomoichania aroro agwo.
swahili: Mara ngapi walimwasi jangwani na kumhuzunisha nyikani!

english: Again and again they tested God and provoked the Holy One of Israel.
ekegusii: Nigo babete bakomoteema naende, bakaba bakomogechia ere oyore Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli.
swahili: Walimjaribu Mungu mara kwa mara, wakamkasirisha yeye Aliye Mtakatifu wa Israeli.

english: They did not remember His power — the day He redeemed them from the adversary,
ekegusii: Ti babete bakoinyora chinguru chi’okoboko kwaye, gose tibabete bakoinyora rituko riria ababooretie korwa ase ababisa babo,
swahili: Hawakukumbuka uwezo wake, siku aliyowakomboa kutoka kwa mtesi,

english: when He performed His signs in Egypt and His wonders in the fields of Zoan.
ekegusii: na buna akorete ebikone ebinge ase ense ya Misiri, na amakumia agwo ase orogongo rwa Soani.
swahili: siku aliyoonyesha ishara zake za ajabu huko Misri, maajabu yake huko Soani.

english: He turned their rivers to blood, and from their streams they could not drink.
ekegusii: Aroro aari’Omonene nigo aonchorete amaache e chindooche akaba amanyinga, abanto tibanyara koyanywa.
swahili: Aligeuza mito yao kuwa damu, hawakuweza kunywa maji kutoka vijito vyao.

english: He sent swarms of flies that devoured them, and frogs that devastated them.
ekegusii: Nigo arentete chingi chinyinge chikabachanda, na akabarentera ebioto bigasaria ense yabo.
swahili: Aliwapelekea makundi ya mainzi yakawala, na vyura wakawaharibu.

english: He gave their crops to the grasshopper, the fruit of their labor to the locust.
ekegusii: Akarenta chingeeti chigasaria ebimeri biabo, naende akarenta chingige chikaria endagera y’emegondo yabo bechanderete.
swahili: Aliruhusu tunutu kuharibu mimea yao, mazao yao kwa nzige.

english: He killed their vines with hailstones and their sycamore-figs with sleet.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo arentete amagena ’embura agasaria emesabibu yabo, agasaria nemeko yabo.
swahili: Aliharibu mizabibu yao kwa mvua ya mawe na mikuyu yao kwa mvua iliyochangamana na theluji.

english: He abandoned their cattle to the hail and their livestock to bolts of lightning.
ekegusii: Akarenta amagena ’embura agaita chiombe chiabo, ne chinkoba chigaita ching’ondi ne chimbori chiabo.
swahili: Aliwaachia mifugo yao mvua ya mawe, akayapiga makundi ya wanyama wao kwa radi.

english: He unleashed His fury against them, wrath, indignation, and calamity— a band of destroying angels.
ekegusii: Omonene akabatomera endamwamu yaye enene, na ekeririanda kiaye, na okogechigwa kwaye na emechando yonsi, ekeombe ekio ki’abamalaika b’ogosiria.
swahili: Aliwafungulia hasira yake kali, ghadhabu yake, hasira na uadui, na kundi la malaika wa kuharibu.

english: For He established a testimony in Jacob and appointed a law in Israel, which He commanded our fathers to teach to their children,
ekegusii: Ere nigo abegete oborori bwaye ase abanto b’ororeria rwa Yakobo, na akaa Abaisraeli amachiiko, ayio achigete chisokoro chiaito chiorokererie abana babo.
swahili: Aliagiza amri kwa Yakobo na akaweka sheria katika Israeli, ambazo aliwaamuru baba zetu wawafundishe watoto wao,

english: He cleared a path for His anger; He did not spare them from death but delivered their lives to the plague.
ekegusii: Ere akaroiseria endamwamu yaye enchera; akabeeka emioyo yabo ase amakweri, akabarentera oborwaire bokabaita.
swahili: Aliitengenezea njia hasira yake, hakuwaepusha na kifo, bali aliwaachia tauni.

english: He struck all the firstborn of Egypt, the virility in the tents of Ham.
ekegusii: Agaita abana abatangi bonsi aaria Misiri, abwo barenge abatangi b’echinguru chiabo ase chiema chia Hamu.
swahili: Aliwapiga wazaliwa wote wa kwanza wa Misri, matunda ya kwanza ya ujana katika mahema ya Hamu.

english: He led out His people like sheep and guided them like a flock in the wilderness.
ekegusii: Erio akang’anyia abanto baye buna ching’ondi chikong’anyigwa, akabaraa ase erooro buna riicho rikoraagwa.
swahili: Lakini aliwatoa watu wake kama kundi, akawaongoza kama kondoo kupitia jangwani.

english: He led them safely, so they did not fear, but the sea engulfed their enemies.
ekegusii: Akabaraa na kobarenda buya, na tibabete nobwoba, korende enyancha ekamera ababisa babo.
swahili: Aliwaongoza salama, wala hawakuogopa, bali bahari iliwameza adui zao.

english: He brought them to His holy land, to the mountain His right hand had acquired.
ekegusii: Omonene akabarenta ase ense yaye enchenu, ase egetunwa keria enyorerete nokoboko kwaye gw’okorio.
swahili: Hivyo akawaleta hadi kwenye mpaka wa nchi yake takatifu, hadi nchi ya vilima ambayo mkono wake wa kuume ulikuwa umeitwaa.

english: He drove out nations before them and apportioned their inheritance; He settled the tribes of Israel in their tents.
ekegusii: Agaseria abanto b’ebisaku korwa bosio bwabo. Nigo abaatananerete ense eyio ekaba emiando yabo, akabeeka Abaisraeli bakamenya ase chiema chiabo.
swahili: Aliyafukuza mataifa mbele yao, na kuwagawia nchi zao kama urithi, aliwakalisha makabila ya Israeli katika makao yao.

english: But they tested and disobeyed God Most High, for they did not keep His decrees.
ekegusii: Erio bagateema Nyasae Ore Igoro Mono, bakamogechia, tibabwatete amachiiko aye.
swahili: Lakini wao walimjaribu Mungu, na kuasi dhidi ya Yeye Aliye Juu Sana, wala hawakuzishika sheria zake.

english: They turned back and were faithless like their fathers, twisted like a faulty bow.
ekegusii: Nigo baonchogete tibaaba abegenwa, buna chisokoro chiabo chitabeete abegenwa, bakaba abasaria buna obota bosaregete.
swahili: Kama baba zao, hawakuwa thabiti wala waaminifu, wakawa wasioweza kutegemewa kama upinde wenye kasoro.

english: They enraged Him with their high places and provoked His jealousy with their idols.
ekegusii: Bakagechia Omonene ase engencho y’aase abo aimokererete igoro bagosasimera, na ekiagera basasimete emegwekano, Omonene akaba ne risemi.
swahili: Wakamkasirisha Mungu kwa mahali pao pa juu pa kuabudia miungu, wakachochea wivu wake kwa sanamu zao.

english: On hearing it, God was furious and rejected Israel completely.
ekegusii: Ekero Nyasae aroche ayio, akaba nekeririanda, agatiga Abaisraeli kegima.
swahili: Wakati Mungu alipowasikia, alikasirika sana, akamkataa Israeli kabisa.

english: that the coming generation would know them— even children yet to be born— to arise and tell their own children
ekegusii: Nigo aganetie ng’a abanto b’ebiaare bigochi‐gocha bayamanye, ee, nonya nabana b’ebiaare konya bataraiborwa, naende abwo bayateebie abana babo.
swahili: ili kizazi kijacho kizijue, pamoja na watoto ambao watazaliwa, nao pia wapate kuwaeleza watoto wao.

english: He abandoned the tabernacle of Shiloh, the tent He had pitched among men.
ekegusii: Omonene akaanga eema yaye yarenge Silo, eema eria akorete obomenyo bwaye ase egati y’abanto.
swahili: Akaiacha hema ya Shilo, hema aliyokuwa ameiweka katikati ya wanadamu.

english: He delivered His strength to captivity, and His splendor to the hand of the adversary.
ekegusii: Nigo atigete eke kiarenge chinguru chiaye kegasakorwa, ekio kiarenge obonene bwaye agakerua ase amaboko ababisa.
swahili: Akalipeleka Sanduku la nguvu zake utumwani, utukufu wake mikononi mwa adui.

english: He surrendered His people to the sword because He was enraged by His heritage.
ekegusii: Ere nigo abeete nendamwamu ase abanto abwo barenge omwando oye, akabarua bagaitwa nemioro.
swahili: Aliachia watu wake wauawe kwa upanga, akaukasirikia sana urithi wake.

english: Fire consumed His young men, and their maidens were left without wedding songs.
ekegusii: Omorero ogaita abamura babo, na abaiseke babo bakaborwa abakobanyuoma.
swahili: Moto uliwaangamiza vijana wao, na wanawali wao hawakuimbiwa nyimbo za arusi,

english: His priests fell by the sword, but their widows could not lament.
ekegusii: Abakuani babo nigo baitetwe nemioro, na ababoraka babo tibanyarete kobareera.
swahili: makuhani wao waliuawa kwa upanga, wala wajane wao hawakuweza kulia.

english: Then the Lord awoke as from sleep, like a mighty warrior overcome by wine.
ekegusii: Eri’Omonene akaboka buna nigo araire chitoro, na akaba buna omonto etuoni onyure edivai ogoaka eriogi;
swahili: Ndipo Bwana alipoamka kama vile kuamka usingizini, kama vile mtu aamkavyo kutoka kwenye bumbuazi la mvinyo.

english: He beat back His foes; He put them to everlasting shame.
ekegusii: agaaka abachandi baye bagatama gochia ase barwete, akababeeka ase obosooku goika kare na kare.
swahili: Aliwapiga na kuwashinda adui zake, akawatia katika aibu ya milele.

english: He rejected the tent of Joseph and refused the tribe of Ephraim.
ekegusii: Omonene akaanga abanto b’ororeria rwa Yusufu, gose tachorete abanto b’egesaku gi’Efraimu,
swahili: Ndipo alipozikataa hema za Yosefu, hakulichagua kabila la Efraimu,

english: But He chose the tribe of Judah, Mount Zion, which He loved.
ekegusii: korende agachora abanto b’egesaku kia Yuda, na egetunwa gia Sayoni ekio anchete.
swahili: lakini alilichagua kabila la Yuda, Mlima Sayuni, ambao aliupenda.

english: He built His sanctuary like the heights, like the earth He has established forever.
ekegusii: Aroro akaagacha obomenyo bwaye obochenu bobere igoro mono, nabobe obokong’u buna ense ekong’irie kogenderera botambe.
swahili: Alijenga patakatifu pake kama vilele, kama dunia ambayo aliimarisha milele.

english: that they should put their confidence in God, not forgetting His works, but keeping His commandments.
ekegusii: Erio nario barabe bagosemeria Nyasae, na tibaabaisa kweba emeremo yaye, korende babe bakobwata amachiiko aye.
swahili: Ndipo wangeweka tumaini lao kwa Mungu, nao wasingesahau matendo yake, bali wangalizishika amri zake.

english: He chose David His servant and took him from the sheepfolds;
ekegusii: Agachora Daudi omosomba oye, akamorusia korwa ase arenge korisia ching’ondi.
swahili: Akamchagua Daudi mtumishi wake na kumtoa kwenye mazizi ya kondoo.

english: from tending the ewes He brought him to be shepherd of His people Jacob, of Israel His inheritance.
ekegusii: Ee, akamorusia korwa ase arenge gotunyana ching’ondi chiare ne chimanwa chikogonka, akamokora akaba omorisia bw’ororeria rwa Yakobo, abanto baye, nabwo Abaisraeli omwando oye.
swahili: Kutoka kuchunga kondoo alimleta kuwa mchungaji wa watu wake Yakobo, wa Israeli urithi wake.

english: So David shepherded them with integrity of heart and guided them with skillful hands.
ekegusii: Daudi akaba omorisia bw’abaanto abwo ore nenkoro endonge, akaba okobaraa nokoboko kw’obong’aini.
swahili: Naye Daudi aliwachunga kwa uadilifu wa moyo, kwa mikono ya ustadi aliwaongoza.

english: Then they will not be like their fathers, a stubborn and rebellious generation, whose heart was not loyal, whose spirit was not faithful to God.
ekegusii: Barabwo tibaabaisa koba buna chisokoro chiabo, chiria chitaigwerete, naende chiasaretie; tichiarenge ne chinkoro chindonge, gose tichiarenge chinyegenwa ase Nyasae ase emioyo yabo.
swahili: Ili wasifanane na baba zao, waliokuwa kizazi cha ukaidi na uasi, ambao roho zao hazikuwa na uaminifu kwake, ambao roho zao hazikumwamini.

english: The archers of Ephraim turned back on the day of battle.
ekegusii: Abanto b’Efraimu, abwo babogoretie amata, bakaonchoka bagatama ase rituko ri’esegi.
swahili: Watu wa Efraimu, ingawa walijifunga pinde, walikimbia siku ya vita.

english: The nations, O God, have invaded Your inheritance; they have defiled Your holy temple and reduced Jerusalem to rubble.
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, abanto batakomanyeti bachire basoire ase omwando oo, barabwo bakorire Hekalu yao Enchenu yabeire eyetachenegeti, bakorire Yerusalemu obeire chitui chi’amagena.
swahili: Ee Mungu, mataifa yameuvamia urithi wako, wamelinajisi Hekalu lako takatifu, wameifanya Yerusalemu kuwa magofu.

english: Why should the nations ask, “Where is their God?” Before our eyes, make known among the nations Your vengeance for the bloodshed of Your servants.
ekegusii: Nase ki abanto b’ebisaku bakoboria, “Ng’ai Nyasae oyio obo are?” Ase amasio aito tiga abanto b’ebisaku bamanye buna okorusia egesiomba ase engencho y’ogoiterwa kw’amanyinga ’abasomba bao.
swahili: Kwa nini mataifa waseme, “Yuko wapi Mungu wenu?” Mbele ya macho yetu, dhihirisha kati ya mataifa kwamba unalipiza kisasi damu iliyomwagwa ya watumishi wako.

english: May the groans of the captives reach You; by the strength of Your arm preserve those condemned to death.
ekegusii: Tiga ekerero ki’abasibire geike ase obosio bwao; tooria abanto abwo banacheirwe ekiina bakwe, ekiagera aye nobwate okobua okonene.
swahili: Kilio cha huzuni cha wafungwa kifike mbele zako; kwa nguvu za mkono wako hifadhi wale waliohukumiwa kufa.

english: Pay back into the laps of our neighbors sevenfold the reproach they hurled at You, O Lord.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, abanto abwo bamenyete ang’e bagochecheirie na kogochaaya, obairanerie amabe ayio abo ara gatano na kabere.
swahili: Walipize jirani zetu mara saba vifuani mwao aibu walizovurumisha juu yako, Ee Bwana.

english: Then we Your people, the sheep of Your pasture, will thank You forever; from generation to generation we will declare Your praise.
ekegusii: Erio intwe, abanto bao, abatore abe riicho ri’oborisia bwao, natokoiranerie ng’a mbuya mono kogenderera botambe, na ebiaare ase ebiaare natobe tokogotogia.
swahili: Ndipo sisi watu wako, kondoo wa malisho yako, tutakusifu milele; toka kizazi hadi kizazi tutasimulia sifa zako.

english: They have given the corpses of Your servants as food to the birds of the air, the flesh of Your saints to the beasts of the earth.
ekegusii: Baeire chinyoni emebere y’abasomba bao chiyerie, ee, chinyama chi’emebere y’abachenu bao ase ching’iti chi’orosana.
swahili: Wametoa maiti za watumishi kuwa chakula cha ndege wa angani na nyama ya watakatifu wako kwa wanyama wa nchi.

english: They have poured out their blood like water all around Jerusalem, and there is no one to bury the dead.
ekegusii: Baiteire amanyinga abo buna amaache ase chinsemo chionsi chia Yerusalemu, abakobatindeka baborire.
swahili: Wamemwaga damu kama maji kuzunguka Yerusalemu yote, wala hakuna yeyote wa kuwazika.

english: We have become a reproach to our neighbors, a scorn and derision to those around us.
ekegusii: Intwe twabeire okogechia ase abanto bamenyete ang’e naintwe, abanto batoetanaine nigo bagotochecheria na gotosekerera.
swahili: Tumekuwa kitu cha aibu kwa jirani zetu, cha dharau na mzaha kwa wale wanaotuzunguka.

english: How long, O LORD? Will You be angry forever? Will Your jealousy burn like fire?
ekegusii: Aye Omonene ngoika ririri oragenderere koba nendamwamu ase tore? Inee! Ribero riao, ngoika ririri rigochia gwoka buna omorero?
swahili: Hata lini, Ee Bwana? Je, wewe utakasirika milele? Wivu wako utawaka kama moto hadi lini?

english: Pour out Your wrath on the nations that do not acknowledge You, on the kingdoms that refuse to call on Your name,
ekegusii: Umora endamwamu yao igoro ase abanto b’ebisaku batakomanyeti, na igoro ase amagambi ayio atari gokorangeria oyakonye.
swahili: Mwaga ghadhabu yako kwa mataifa yasiyokukubali, juu ya falme za hao wasioliitia jina lako,

english: for they have devoured Jacob and devastated his homeland.
ekegusii: Naki abanto abwo basiririe abanto b’ororeria rwa Yakobo, naende basaririe aase bamenyete.
swahili: kwa maana wamemrarua Yakobo na kuharibu nchi ya makao yake.

english: Do not hold past sins against us; let Your compassion come quickly, for we are brought low.
ekegusii: Tobaisa gotoa intwe egesusuro ase engencho y’ebibe bie chisokoro chiaito; otorotote namaabera ao bwango, ekiagera twabeire bosa kegima.
swahili: Usituhesabie dhambi za baba zetu, huruma yako na itujie hima, kwa maana tu wahitaji mno.

english: Help us, O God of our salvation, for the glory of Your name; deliver us and atone for our sins, for the sake of Your name.
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae ore ogotooreka gwaito, ase engencho y’obonene bw’erieta riao, tokonye; naende ase engencho y’erieta riao otoboorie, otwabere ebibe biaito!
swahili: Ee Mungu Mwokozi wetu, utusaidie, kwa ajili ya utukufu wa jina lako; tuokoe na kutusamehe dhambi zetu kwa ajili ya jina lako.

english: O LORD my God, I take refuge in You; save me and deliver me from all my pursuers,
ekegusii: Omonene one, Nyasae one, naye ngotamera, intoorie korwa ase abachandi baane, ’nkonye!
swahili: Ee Bwana, Mungu wangu, ninakukimbilia wewe, uniokoe na kunikomboa na wote wanaonifuatia,

english: My shield is with God, who saves the upright in heart.
ekegusii: Nyasae nere enguba yane, ere nigo agotooria abare ne chinkoro chindonge.
swahili: Ngao langu ni Mungu Aliye Juu Sana, awaokoaye wanyofu wa moyo.

english: God is a righteous judge and a God who feels indignation each day.
ekegusii: Nyasae nigo are omogambi omooronge, na kera rituko nigo akoba nekeririanda ase abakori amabe.
swahili: Mungu ni mwamuzi mwenye haki, Mungu aghadhibikaye kila siku.

english: If one does not repent, God will sharpen His sword; He has bent and strung His bow.
ekegusii: Omonto karaange gweitia, Nyasae natierie omoro oye, natinge obota bwaye abobeke ang’e.
swahili: Kama hakutuhurumia, atanoa upanga wake, ataupinda na kuufunga uzi upinde wake.

english: He has prepared His deadly weapons; He ordains His arrows with fire.
ekegusii: Oroisirie ebirwanero biaye ebiogoita omonto buna oyio, akore emegwe yaye esambe buna omorero.
swahili: Ameandaa silaha zake kali, ameweka tayari mishale yake ya moto.

english: Behold, the wicked man travails with evil; he conceives trouble and births falsehood.
ekegusii: Omonyabibe nigo aichire nobobe, nigo are morito, oborito bw’ogosaria na gakoibora oibara oborimo.
swahili: Yeye aliye na mimba ya uovu na achukuaye mimba ya ghasia huzaa uongo.

english: He has dug a hole and hollowed it out; he has fallen into a pit of his own making.
ekegusii: Omonto oyio nigo agokunya eirima entambe, korende ogwa ime y’eirima eyio ere omonyene.
swahili: Yeye achimbaye shimo na kulifukua hutumbukia katika shimo alilochimba mwenyewe.

english: His trouble recoils on himself, and his violence falls on his own head.
ekegusii: Emechando yaye nigo ekomoiranera; na ogokora kwaye okobe kwamogwera ere omonyene.
swahili: Ghasia azianzishazo humrudia mwenyewe, ukatili wake humrudia kichwani.

english: I will thank the LORD for His righteousness and sing praise to the name of the LORD Most High.
ekegusii: Ning’akere Omonene ng’a mbuya mono ase engencho y’oboronge bwaye; nimotererie Omonene ogoteera kw’ogotogia erieta riaye, oyore Igoro Mono kegima.
swahili: Nitamshukuru Bwana kwa ajili ya haki yake, na nitaliimbia sifa jina la Bwana Aliye Juu Sana.

english: or they will shred my soul like a lion and tear me to pieces with no one to rescue me.
ekegusii: Onye taibo, nigo barantaborane bare buna chindo, ’mbankurure gochia aase omonto onde otache gontooria.
swahili: la sivyo watanirarua kama simba na kunichana vipande vipande, asiwepo wa kuniokoa.

english: O LORD my God, if I have done this, if injustice is on my hands,
ekegusii: Omonene one, Nyasae one, onye nakorire amang’ana aya, onye nakorire amabe namaboko aane,
swahili: Ee Bwana, Mungu wangu, kama nimetenda haya na kuna hatia mikononi mwangu,

english: if I have rewarded my ally with evil, if I have plundered my foe without cause,
ekegusii: onye naakanire omosani one amabe, gose nasakoire ebinto bi’omobisa one ase engencho ende etaiyo,
swahili: au ikiwa nimemtenda uovu aliye na amani nami, au nimemnyangʼanya adui yangu pasipo sababu,

english: then may my enemy pursue me and overtake me; may he trample me to the ground and leave my honor in the dust. Selah
ekegusii: rirorio tiga omobisa one ambwatie na kombwata, erio antiringere inse egere asirie obogima bwane, erio ansarerie amasikani.
swahili: basi adui anifuatie na kunipata, auponde uhai wangu ardhini na kunilaza mavumbini.

english: Arise, O LORD, in Your anger; rise up against the fury of my enemies. Awake, my God, and ordain judgment.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, imoka kore nendamwamu yao, imokerera igoro orwanie ekeririanda ki’ababisa baane! Inchuo onkonye! Aye gwachikiire ekiina.
swahili: Amka kwa hasira yako, Ee Bwana, inuka dhidi ya ghadhabu ya adui zangu. Amka, Mungu wangu, uamue haki.

english: Let the assembled peoples gather around You; take Your seat over them on high.
ekegusii: Abanto b’ebisaku bionsi tiga basangererekane bagoetanane; obagambere korwa ase ekerogo kiao ki’obonene aaria igoro.
swahili: Kusanyiko la watu na likuzunguke. Watawale kutoka juu.

english: The LORD judges the peoples; vindicate me, O LORD, according to my righteousness and integrity.
ekegusii: Omonene, naye okogamba na konachera abanto bonsi ekiina. Aye Omonene, onachere inche ekiina koreng’ana noboronge bwane, na buna ntari na komocha.
swahili: Bwana na awahukumu kabila za watu. Nihukumu Ee Bwana, kwa kadiri ya haki yangu, kwa kadiri ya uadilifu wangu, Ewe Uliye Juu Sana.

english: Put an end to the evil of the wicked, but establish the righteous, O righteous God who searches hearts and minds.
ekegusii: Tiga ebibe bi’abakori amabe biere, korende omonto omooronge omotenenie bokong’u. Aye Nyasae omonyene oboronge nigo okorenga chinkoro na emioyo.
swahili: Ee Mungu mwenye haki, uchunguzaye mawazo na mioyo, komesha ghasia za waovu na ufanye wenye haki waishi kwa amani.

english: Hear us, O Shepherd of Israel, who leads Joseph like a flock; You who sit enthroned between the cherubim, shine forth
ekegusii: Aye omorisia bw’Abaisraeli, tegerera oigwe, aye okoraa abanto b’ororeria rwa Yusufu buna riicho rikoraagwa! Aye oyore ase oboikaranso bw’obonene igoro y’ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba, tomorekere!
swahili: Ee Mchungaji wa Israeli tusikie, wewe umwongozaye Yosefu kama kundi; wewe uketiye katika kiti cha enzi katikati ya makerubi, angaza

english: The mountains were covered by its shade, and the mighty cedars with its branches.
ekegusii: Ekiriri ki’omosabibu oyio nigo giatubete ebitunwa, ne chinsagia chiaye chikaranda gochia aase emecharake ya Nyasae ere.
swahili: Milima ilifunikwa kwa kivuli chake, matawi yake yakafunika mierezi mikubwa.

english: It sent out its branches to the Sea, and its shoots toward the River.
ekegusii: Chinsagia echio chikaranda chigaikeera Enyancha Enene, na emeseboka yaye gochia ase orooche rw’Eufarati.
swahili: Matawi yake yalienea mpaka Baharini, machipukizi yake mpaka kwenye Mto.

english: Why have You broken down its walls, so that all who pass by pick its fruit?
ekegusii: Nase ki rende aye gwatagoire chindwaki chiaye, erinde bonsi abagoeta ase enchera batabora amasabibu aye?
swahili: Mbona umebomoa kuta zake ili wote wapitao karibu wazichume zabibu zake?

english: The boar from the forest ravages it, and the creatures of the field feed upon it.
ekegusii: Chimbeche chie rinani nigo chigosaria omosabibu oyio, ne ching’iti chi’orosana nigo chikoyotakuna.
swahili: Nguruwe mwitu wanauharibu na wanyama wa kondeni hujilisha humo.

english: Return, O God of Hosts, we pray! Look down from heaven and see! Attend to this vine—
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae bw’Emeganda, yoiranere naende, rigereria korwa agwo igoro orore; bwechandere omosabibu oyio.
swahili: Turudie, Ee Mungu Mwenye Nguvu Zote! Tazama chini kutoka mbinguni na uone! Linda mzabibu huu,

english: the root Your right hand has planted, the son You have raised up for Yourself.
ekegusii: Renda omote oyo gwasimegete nokoboko kwao gw’okorio, orosagia orwo gwechoreire na korobeka chinguru.
swahili: mche ulioupanda kwa mkono wako wa kuume, mwana uliyemlea kwa ajili yako mwenyewe.

english: Your vine has been cut down and burned; they perish at the rebuke of Your countenance.
ekegusii: Abanto bayosambire nomorero na koyogecha. Osirie abanto abwo ase okobea kwao!
swahili: Mzabibu wako umekatwa, umechomwa moto, unapowakemea, watu wako huangamia.

english: Let Your hand be upon the man at Your right hand, on the son of man You have raised up for Yourself.
ekegusii: Orende nokoboko kwao omonto oyio gwachorire nokoboko kwao gw’okorio, Mwanyabaanto abwo aye gwechoreire.
swahili: Mkono wako na utulie juu ya mtu aliyeko mkono wako wa kuume, mwana wa mtu uliyemlea kwa ajili yako mwenyewe.

english: Then we will not turn away from You; revive us, and we will call on Your name.
ekegusii: Erio titokoonchoka togotige; torende togenderere koba moyo, na intwe ntobe togotogia erieta riao.
swahili: Ndipo hatutakuacha tena, utuhuishe, nasi tutaliitia jina lako.

english: Restore us, O LORD God of Hosts; cause Your face to shine upon us, that we may be saved.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, Nyasae bw’Emeganda, tokore tobe abayia, otoraberie obosio bwao, erio nario toratooreke.
swahili: Ee Bwana Mungu Mwenye Nguvu Zote, uturejeshe; utuangazie uso wako, ili tuweze kuokolewa.

english: before Ephraim, Benjamin, and Manasseh. Rally Your mighty power and come to save us.
ekegusii: Orokia chinguru chiao ase abanto b’Efraimu, na Ababenjamini, na Abamanase, na oche ototoorie!
swahili: mbele ya Efraimu, Benyamini na Manase. Uamshe nguvu zako, uje utuokoe.

english: Restore us, O God, and cause Your face to shine upon us, that we may be saved.
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, otokore tobe abayia, otoraberie obosio bwao, erio nario toratooreke.
swahili: Ee Mungu, uturejeshe, utuangazie uso wako, ili tuweze kuokolewa.

english: O LORD God of Hosts, how long will Your anger smolder against the prayers of Your people?
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, Nyasae bw’Emeganda, ngoika ririri orabe gokogechigwa nogosaba kw’abaanto bao?
swahili: Ee Bwana Mungu Mwenye Nguvu Zote, hata lini hasira yako itawaka na kufoka moshi dhidi ya maombi ya watu wako?

english: You fed them with the bread of tears and made them drink the full measure of their tears.
ekegusii: Aye gwakorire amariga ’omoichano koba endagera yabo, kwabanyoisirie amariga amange mono.
swahili: Umewalisha kwa mkate wa machozi, umewafanya wanywe machozi bakuli tele.

english: You make us contend with our neighbors; our enemies mock us.
ekegusii: Aye gwatokorire twabeire abakwomanerwa ase egati y’abanto bare ang’e naintwe, na ababisa baito nigo bagendererete gotochecheria.
swahili: Tumekuwa chanzo cha ugomvi kwa jirani zetu, na adui zetu wanatudhihaki.

english: Restore us, O God of Hosts, and cause Your face to shine upon us, that we may be saved.
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae bw’Emeganda, otoonchore tobe abayia, otoraberie obosio bwao, erio nario toratooreke.
swahili: Ee Mungu Mwenye Nguvu Zote, uturejeshe; utuangazie uso wako, nasi tuweze kuokolewa.

english: You uprooted a vine from Egypt; You drove out the nations and transplanted it.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene nigo kwarentete omosabibu korwa ase ense ya Misiri, erio ogaseria abanto b’ebisaku korwa aase abo, okayosimeka aroro.
swahili: Ulileta mzabibu kutoka Misri, ukawafukuza mataifa, ukaupanda.

english: You cleared the ground for it, and it took root and filled the land.
ekegusii: Aye nigo kwayoraberetie aase na koaroisia, noro ogakina okaira emeri inse, okaranda ase ense eyio engima.
swahili: Uliandaa shamba kwa ajili yake, mizizi ikawa imara, ukajaza nchi.

english: Sing for joy to God our strength; make a joyful noise to the God of Jacob.
ekegusii: Moterere Nyasae neriogi rinene, ekiagera nere chinguru chiaito, aka eriogi ri’omogooko ase Nyasae o Yakobo.
swahili: Mwimbieni kwa furaha, Mungu aliye nguvu yetu; mpigieni kelele za shangwe Mungu wa Yakobo!

english: I am the LORD your God, who brought you up out of Egypt. Open wide your mouth, and I will fill it.
ekegusii: Inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino, ninche nabarusetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri. Ase ayio, asamia emenwa yaino ebe yasie, na inche imbaragerie.
swahili: Mimi ni Bwana Mungu wako, niliyekutoa nchi ya Misri. Panua sana kinywa chako nami nitakijaza.

english: But My people would not listen to Me, and Israel would not obey Me.
ekegusii: “Korende abanto baane tibaigwete eriogi riane; Abaisraeli abwo nigo bangete kegima konyigwera.
swahili: “Lakini watu wangu hawakutaka kunisikiliza; Israeli hakutaka kunitii.

english: So I gave them up to their stubborn hearts to follow their own devices.
ekegusii: Ase ayio nkabatiga babwatie obomwenu bwe chinkoro chiabo, erinde bakore buna koreng’ana konya barobeirie abanyene.
swahili: Basi niliwaacha katika ukaidi wa mioyo yao wafuate mashauri yao wenyewe.

english: If only My people would listen to Me, if Israel would follow My ways,
ekegusii: Onye ndiria abanto abwo baane bantegererete! Onye Abaisraeli mbabwatetie chinchera chiane!
swahili: “Laiti kama watu wangu wangalinisikiliza, kama Israeli wangalifuata njia zangu,

english: how soon I would subdue their enemies and turn My hand against their foes!
ekegusii: Rirorio nanga nabuete ababisa babo bwango, na okoboko kwane nkoba kware mamincha yabo.
swahili: ningaliwatiisha adui zao kwa haraka, na kuugeuza mkono wangu dhidi ya watesi wao!

english: Those who hate the LORD would feign obedience, and their doom would last forever.
ekegusii: Abwo bangechete inche Omonene, nigo baare gocha gotung’ama ase ’nde bare nobwoba, na amatuko abo nagenderere kobao kare na kare.
swahili: Wale wanaomchukia Bwana wangalinyenyekea mbele zake, na adhabu yao ingedumu milele.

english: But I would feed you the finest wheat; with honey from the rock I would satisfy you.”
ekegusii: Korende inwe nigo narenge gocha kobaa engano enoru, na kobaisanekia nobooke korwa ase egetare.”
swahili: Bali ninyi mngalilishwa ngano iliyo bora, na kuwatosheleza kwa asali itokayo kwenye mwamba.”

english: Lift up a song, strike the tambourine, play the sweet-sounding harp and lyre.
ekegusii: Tera ogoteera kw’ogotogia, mobugie chinchigiri amo namakano ’ebirigisa, na amakano ande.
swahili: Anzeni wimbo, pigeni matari, pigeni kinubi na zeze kwa sauti nzuri.

english: Sound the ram’s horn at the New Moon, and at the full moon on the day of our Feast.
ekegusii: Mobugie egetureeri ase rituko ri’Omotienyi Omoyia, na ekero oorokire omogima, ase ogosika rituko riaito ri’omoyega richikiire.
swahili: Pigeni baragumu za pembe za kondoo dume wakati wa Mwandamo wa Mwezi, na wakati wa mwezi mpevu, katika siku ya Sikukuu yetu;

english: For this is a statute for Israel, an ordinance of the God of Jacob.
ekegusii: Oyio nigo ore omooroberio ochikiire ase Abaisraeli, na aya Nyasae o Yakobo achiikire.
swahili: hii ni amri kwa Israeli, agizo la Mungu wa Yakobo.

english: He ordained it as a testimony for Joseph when he went out over the land of Egypt, where I heard an unfamiliar language:
ekegusii: Ekero Omonene aetete ense ya Misiri, agachiika omooroberio oyio ase abanto ba Yusufu. Nkaigwa enkwana y’omonwa ntamanyete egoteeba:
swahili: Aliiweka iwe kama sheria kwa Yosefu alipotoka dhidi ya Misri, huko tulikosikia lugha ambayo hatukuielewa.

english: “I relieved his shoulder of the burden; his hands were freed from the basket.
ekegusii: “Ninche narusetie chigurube korwa ase amareko aino, na ngasibora amaboko aino korwa ase ebitonga bi’okobogoria chigurube.
swahili: Asema, “Nimeondoa mzigo mabegani mwao; mikono yao iliwekwa huru kutoka kwenye kikapu.

english: You called out in distress, and I rescued you; I answered you from the cloud of thunder; I tested you at the waters of Meribah. Selah
ekegusii: Ekero mwarenge nemechando nigo mwandangeretie, na inche nkabatooria, nigo nabairaneretie korwa ime y’enkoba ase nebisete, nkabateema agwo ase amaache a Meriba.
swahili: Katika shida yako uliniita nami nikakuokoa, nilikujibu katika mawingu yenye ngurumo; nilikujaribu katika maji ya Meriba.

english: Hear, O My people, and I will warn you: O Israel, if only you would listen to Me!
ekegusii: Inwe abanto baane, igwa ekero nkob akuurera! Inwe Abaisraeli, onye ndiria mware konyigwera!
swahili: “Enyi watu wangu, sikieni, nami nitawaonya: laiti kama mngenisikiliza, ee Israeli!

english: There must be no strange god among you, nor shall you bow to a foreign god.
ekegusii: Timoba nenyasae ende eng’ao ase egati yaino, timotung’amera na gosasiima enyasae engeni.
swahili: Hamtakuwa na mungu mgeni miongoni mwenu; msimsujudie mungu wa kigeni.

english: God presides in the divine assembly; He renders judgment among the gods:
ekegusii: Nyasae nigo agotenena ase omosangererekano oye omochenu, ase egati ye chinyasae nigo akonacha ekiina.
swahili: Mungu anaongoza kusanyiko kuu, anatoa hukumu miongoni mwa “miungu”:

english: “How long will you judge unjustly and show partiality to the wicked? Selah
ekegusii: “Inee! Ngoika ririri moragenderere konacha ebiina bitari noboronge? Ngoika ririri moragenderere gwanchereria abanto ababe?
swahili: “Hata lini utaendelea kuwatetea wasio haki na kuonyesha upendeleo kwa waovu?

english: Defend the cause of the weak and fatherless; uphold the rights of the afflicted and oppressed.
ekegusii: Kae abataka ne chintakana oboronge bwabo; boigo nabwo bagokorerwa bobe, na abaremeire.
swahili: Teteeni wanyonge na yatima, tunzeni haki za maskini na walioonewa.

english: Rescue the weak and needy; save them from the hand of the wicked.
ekegusii: Tooria abatari na nguru, na abatabwati kende, basibore korwa ase amaboko ’abakori amabe.”
swahili: Mwokoeni mnyonge na mhitaji, wakomboeni kutoka mkononi mwa mwovu.

english: They do not know or understand; they wander in the darkness; all the foundations of the earth are shaken.
ekegusii: Abanto abwo tibamanyeti gento, tibari nobong’aini, nigo bagotaara bakona‐kouna‐una ime ase omosunte; amaroso ’ense anyegerigwe.
swahili: “Hawajui lolote, hawaelewi lolote. Wanatembea gizani; misingi yote ya dunia imetikisika.

english: I have said, ‘You are gods; you are all sons of the Most High.’
ekegusii: Natebiire ng’a: “Inwe nechinyasae; inwe mwensi nabana b’Omonene Ore Igoro Mono.
swahili: “Nilisema, ‘Ninyi ni “miungu”; ninyi nyote ni wana wa Aliye Juu Sana.’

english: But like mortals you will die, and like rulers you will fall.”
ekegusii: Korende nigo morakwe buna Mwanyabaanto bande, na obogima bwaino boere buna obw’abanene b’ense.”
swahili: Lakini mtakufa kama wanadamu wa kawaida; mtaanguka kama mtawala mwingine yeyote.”

english: Arise, O God, judge the earth, for all the nations are Your inheritance.
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, imoka, ogambie ense ekiina, ekiagera abanto b’ebisaku bionsi nabao.
swahili: Ee Mungu, inuka uihukumu nchi, kwa kuwa mataifa yote ni urithi wako.

english: O God, be not silent; be not speechless; be not still, O God.
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, tokira‐kiri! Nyasae, totoerera na gotimoka.
swahili: Ee Mungu, usinyamaze kimya, usinyamaze, Ee Mungu, usitulie.

english: who perished at Endor and became like dung on the ground.
ekegusii: Abwo nigo baiteretwe agwo EniDori; bakaba esike ase riroba.
swahili: ambao waliangamia huko Endori na wakawa kama takataka juu ya nchi.

english: Make their nobles like Oreb and Zeeb, and all their princes like Zebah and Zalmunna,
ekegusii: Okore abanto babo basikire buna gwakorete Orebu na Seebu, na abanene babo babe buna Seba na Salimuna,
swahili: Wafanye wakuu wao kama Orebu na Zeebu, watawala wao kama Zeba na Salmuna,

english: who said, “Let us possess for ourselves the pastures of God.”
ekegusii: ekiagera bateebete, “Inchuo toire amarisio a Nyasae abe ayaito.”
swahili: ambao walisema, “Na tumiliki nchi ya malisho ya Mungu.”

english: Make them like tumbleweed, O my God, like chaff before the wind.
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae one, tiga abanto abwo bairurukigwe buna orotu, ee, buna omoiriro okoirurukigwa nomwaga.
swahili: Ee Mungu wangu, wapeperushe kama mavumbi ya kisulisuli, kama makapi yapeperushwayo na upepo.

english: As fire consumes a forest, as a flame sets the mountains ablaze,
ekegusii: Buna omorero ogokoora rinani, na buna ekebemberi ki’omorero kegosamba ebitunwa,
swahili: Kama vile moto uteketezavyo msitu au mwali wa moto unavyounguza milima,

english: so pursue them with Your tempest, and terrify them with Your storm.
ekegusii: naboigo batunyanerie omwaga oo bw’omoubera, na obaondokie nekembugu‐mbugu kiao.
swahili: wafuatilie kwa tufani yako na kuwafadhaisha kwa dhoruba yako.

english: Cover their faces with shame, that they may seek Your name, O LORD.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, kora amasio abo abe nobosooku obonene, erinde babe bakorigia erieta riao.
swahili: Funika nyuso zao kwa aibu ili watu walitafute jina lako, Ee Bwana.

english: May they be ever ashamed and terrified; may they perish in disgrace.
ekegusii: Abanto abwo tiga babe nobosooku na omoichano goika kare na kare; ee, tiga basookigwe na basire kegima.
swahili: Wao na waaibishwe na kufadhaishwa milele, na waangamie kwa aibu.

english: May they know that You alone, whose name is the LORD, are Most High over all the earth.
ekegusii: Abanto abwo tiga bamanye ng’a naye bweka okorokwa Omonene, nigo ore Oyore Igoro Mono igoro y’ense yonsi.
swahili: Hebu wajue kwamba wewe, ambaye jina lako ni Bwana, kwamba wewe peke yako ndiwe Uliye Juu Sana ya dunia yote.

english: See how Your enemies rage, how Your foes have reared their heads.
ekegusii: Rora, ababisa bao buna bagokora rirorooche; abwo bakogechete baimokereirie emetwe igoro ase oboenenu.
swahili: Tazama watesi wako wanafanya fujo, jinsi adui zako wanavyoinua vichwa vyao.

english: With cunning they scheme against Your people and conspire against those You cherish,
ekegusii: Nigo bagokora emeroberio y’obong’ainereria igoro y’abanto bao; abwo nigo bagosemania kobakorera bobe abanto bao abwo orendete.
swahili: Kwa hila, wanafanya shauri dhidi ya watu wako, wanafanya shauri baya dhidi ya wale unaowapenda.

english: saying, “Come, let us erase them as a nation; may the name of Israel be remembered no more.”
ekegusii: Nigo bagoteebania: “Inchuo tobasirie tibaaba egesaku naende, tiga erieta ri’Abaisraeli riebwe kegima!”
swahili: Wanasema, “Njooni, tuwaangamize kama taifa, ili jina la Israeli lisikumbukwe tena.”

english: For with one mind they plot together, they form an alliance against You—
ekegusii: Abanto abagaambire ase omoyo oyomo na bakorire okobwatana mamincha yao nabwo aba;
swahili: Kwa nia moja wanapanga mashauri mabaya pamoja, wanafanya muungano dhidi yako,

english: the tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites, of Moab and the Hagrites,
ekegusii: abanto bamenyete ase chiema chi’Edomu na Abaisumaeli; Abamoabu na Abahagari;
swahili: mahema ya Edomu na Waishmaeli, ya Wamoabu na Wahagari,

english: of Gebal, Ammon, and Amalek, of Philistia with the people of Tyre.
ekegusii: Abagebali, na Abaamoni, na Abaamaleki; Abafirisiti amo nabamenyete Turo.
swahili: Gebali, Amoni na Amaleki, Ufilisti, pamoja na watu wa Tiro.

english: Even Assyria has joined them, lending strength to the sons of Lot. Selah
ekegusii: Boigo Abaasuri babwatanire nabwo ase ogokonya abanto b’ororeria rwa Loti.
swahili: Hata Ashuru wameungana nao kuwapa nguvu wazao wa Loti.

english: Do to them as You did to Midian, as to Sisera and Jabin at the River Kishon,
ekegusii: Omonene, obakore buna gwakorete Abamidiani, na buna gwakorete Sisera na Yabini agwo ase orooche rwa Kisoni.
swahili: Uwatendee kama vile ulivyowatendea Midiani, na kama vile ulivyowatendea Sisera na Yabini hapo kijito cha Kishoni,

english: How lovely is Your dwelling place, O LORD of Hosts!
ekegusii: Aye Omonene bw’Emeganda, naki obomenyo bwao bore oboseera!
swahili: Ee Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, makao yako yapendeza kama nini!

english: For better is one day in Your courts than a thousand elsewhere. I would rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God than dwell in the tents of the wicked.
ekegusii: Mbuya kobeera ase enyomba yao rituko erimo rioka kobua kobeera amatuko chilifu chinyinge aande onsi; mbuya koba omorendi bw’egesieri ki’enyomba yao aye Nyasae one, kobua kobeera ase obomenyo bw’abakori amabe.
swahili: Siku moja katika nyua zako ni bora kuliko siku elfu mahali pengine; afadhali ningekuwa bawabu katika nyumba ya Mungu wangu kuliko kukaa katika mahema ya waovu.

english: For the LORD God is a sun and a shield; the LORD gives grace and glory; He withholds no good thing from those who walk with integrity.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo are erioba na enguba, ere nigo agotoa amaabera na obonene; ere takorina abare ne chinkoro chindonge gento kende gionsi kere ekiya.
swahili: Kwa kuwa Bwana ni jua na ngao, Bwana hutoa wema na heshima; hakuna kitu chema anachowanyima wale ambao hawana hatia.

english: O LORD of Hosts, how blessed is the man who trusts in You!
ekegusii: Aye Omonene bw’Emeganda, nasesenirie omonto okwegenete.
swahili: Ee Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, heri ni mtu yule anayekutumaini wewe.

english: My soul longs, even faints, for the courts of the LORD; my heart and my flesh cry out for the living God.
ekegusii: Omoyo one nore namaiga amange kobeera ase chigoora chia Omonene; enkoro yane na omobere one nigo bigoterera Nyasae ore moyo nomogooko omonene.
swahili: Nafsi yangu inatamani sana, naam, hata kuona shauku, kwa ajili ya nyua za Bwana; moyo wangu na mwili wangu vinamlilia Mungu Aliye Hai.

english: Even the sparrow has found a home, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she places her young near Your altars, O LORD of Hosts, my King and my God.
ekegusii: Enchiro nigo ekonyora obomenyo, na egesingororo nigo gekwenyorera egeswa ase amage aye akobeera, agwo ase egesasiimero kiao, aye Omonene bw’Emeganda, aye Omorwoti one, na Nyasae one.
swahili: Hata shomoro amejipatia makao, mbayuwayu amejipatia kiota mahali awezapo kuweka makinda yake: mahali karibu na madhabahu yako, Ee Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, Mfalme wangu na Mungu wangu.

english: How blessed are those who dwell in Your house! They are ever praising You. Selah
ekegusii: Mbarenomogooko abanto abwo bamenyete ase enyomba yao, abwo bakona‐goteera botambe ase okogotogia.
swahili: Heri wale wanaokaa nyumbani mwako, wanaokusifu wewe daima.

english: Blessed are those whose strength is in You, whose hearts are set on pilgrimage.
ekegusii: Mbare nomogooko abanto abwo bakonyora chinguru chiabo korwa asore; abwo chinkoro chiabo chiganetie kogenda Sayoni.
swahili: Heri wale ambao nguvu zao ziko kwako, na njia ziendazo Sayuni zimo mioyoni mwao.

english: As they pass through the Valley of Baca, they make it a place of springs; even the autumn rain covers it with pools.
ekegusii: Ekero abanto abwo bagoeta ase Rigoko ria Baka, nigo bakorikora riaba aase e chinsoko chi’amaache; na embura ye ritang’ani nigo ekorirentera ogosesenigwa okonge.
swahili: Wanapopita katika Bonde la Baka, hulifanya mahali pa chemchemi, pia mvua za vuli hulijaza kwa madimbwi.

english: They go from strength to strength, until each appears before God in Zion.
ekegusii: Barabwo mbabe bakomenta koba ne chinguru kogenderera botambe, mbarore Nyasae ayobuete chinyasae agwo Sayoni.
swahili: Huendelea toka nguvu hadi nguvu, hadi kila mmoja afikapo mbele za Mungu huko Sayuni.

english: O LORD God of Hosts, hear my prayer; give ear, O God of Jacob. Selah
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, Nyasae bw’Emeganda, igwa ogosaba kwane, tegerera onyigwe, aye Nyasae o Yakobo.
swahili: Ee Bwana Mungu Mwenye Nguvu Zote, sikia maombi yangu; nisikilize, Ee Mungu wa Yakobo.

english: Take notice of our shield, O God, and look with favor on the face of Your anointed.
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae ore enguba yaito, origererie obosio bw’omoakwa amaguta oo.
swahili: Ee Mungu, uitazame ngao yetu, mtazame kwa wema mpakwa mafuta wako.

english: You showed favor to Your land, O LORD; You restored Jacob from captivity.
ekegusii: Omonene, kare nigo kwarenge namaabera ase ense yao, nigo kwairaneretie abanto ba Yakobo amaya abo.
swahili: Ee Bwana, ulionyesha wema kwa nchi yako. Ulimrejeshea Yakobo baraka zake.

english: Loving devotion and faithfulness have joined together; righteousness and peace have kissed.
ekegusii: Aase agwo obwanchani bogendererete botambe na ekeene mbiumerane, boigo oboronge na omorembe mbinyunyuntane.
swahili: Upendo na uaminifu hukutana pamoja, haki na amani hubusiana.

english: Faithfulness sprouts from the earth, and righteousness looks down from heaven.
ekegusii: Aase agwo obwegenwa mbooroke ase ense, na oboronge mborigererie korwa igoro.
swahili: Uaminifu huchipua kutoka nchi, haki hutazama chini kutoka mbinguni.

english: The LORD will indeed provide what is good, and our land will yield its increase.
ekegusii: Ekeene, Omonene narue ayare amaya, na orogongo rwaito rorue okwama kwaye.
swahili: Naam, hakika Bwana atatoa kilicho chema, nayo nchi yetu itazaa mavuno yake.

english: Righteousness will go before Him to prepare the way for His steps.
ekegusii: Oboronge mbotang’ane bosio bwaye, naende bobwatie ase aetete.
swahili: Haki itatangulia mbele yake na kutengeneza njia kwa ajili ya hatua zake.

english: You forgave the iniquity of Your people; You covered all their sin. Selah
ekegusii: Aye nigo kwaberete abanto bao obobe bwabo, nigo gwatubete ebibe biabo bionsi.
swahili: Ulisamehe uovu wa watu wako, na kufunika dhambi zao zote.

english: You withheld all Your fury; You turned from Your burning anger.
ekegusii: Boigo ngwatigete koba nekeririanda, ngwatigete kegima kogechigwa nabarabwo.
swahili: Uliweka kando ghadhabu yako yote na umegeuka na kuiacha hasira yako kali.

english: Restore us, O God of our salvation, and put away Your displeasure toward us.
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, Omotooria oito, otoiranere, rusia ekeririanda kiao korwa ase tore.
swahili: Ee Mungu Mwokozi wetu, uturejeshe tena, nawe uiondoe chuki yako juu yetu.

english: Will You be angry with us forever? Will You draw out Your anger to all generations?
ekegusii: Inee! Nigo ogochia koba nendamwamu ase tore kogenderera botambe? Inee! Endamwamu yao nigo egendererete koba ase ebiaare bionsi?
swahili: Je, utatukasirikia milele? Utaendeleza hasira yako kwa vizazi vyote?

english: Will You not revive us again, that Your people may rejoice in You?
ekegusii: Inee! Togotokora abayia naende, erinde intwe abanto bao tobe nomogooko asore?
swahili: Je, hutatuhuisha tena, ili watu wako wakufurahie?

english: Show us Your loving devotion, O LORD, and grant us Your salvation.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, otoorokerie obwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe, na otoe ogotooreka kwao.
swahili: Utuonyeshe upendo wako usiokoma, Ee Bwana, utupe wokovu wako.

english: I will listen to what God the LORD will say; for He will surely speak peace to His people and His saints; He will not let them return to folly.
ekegusii: Nimbe nkoigwa amang’an’Omonene Nyasae agokwana; ere nigo agokwana amang’ana ’omorembe ase abanto baye abachenu, tobatiga baonchokere oboriri naende.
swahili: Nitasikiliza lile atakalosema Mungu aliye Bwana; anaahidi amani kwa watu wake, watakatifu wake: lakini nao wasirudie upumbavu.

english: Surely His salvation is near to those who fear Him, that His glory may dwell in our land.
ekegusii: Ekeene, ogotooreka kwaye nigo kore ang’e ase abanto bairogete Omonene; obonene mbobe bomenyete ase ense yaito.
swahili: Hakika wokovu wake uko karibu na wale wamchao, ili utukufu wake udumu katika nchi yetu.

english: Incline Your ear, O LORD, and answer me, for I am poor and needy.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, integerera, onyigwe na ong’iranerie, ekiagera nigo inde omotaka na omoremerwa.
swahili: Ee Bwana, sikia na unijibu, kwa maana mimi ni maskini na mhitaji.

english: For You are great and perform wonders; You alone are God.
ekegusii: Aye naye ore omonene, nigo ogokora amakumia; aye naye bweka ore Nyasae.
swahili: Kwa maana wewe ni mkuu, na unafanya mambo ya ajabu; wewe peke yako ndiwe Mungu.

english: Teach me Your way, O LORD, that I may walk in Your truth. Give me an undivided heart, that I may fear Your name.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, inyorokererie enchera yao, nigo nganetie kobwatia ekeene kiao; renda enkoro yane, erinde inyiroke erieta riao.
swahili: Ee Bwana, nifundishe njia yako, nami nitakwenda katika kweli yako; nipe moyo usiositasita, ili niweze kulicha jina lako.

english: I will praise You, O Lord my God, with all my heart; I will glorify Your name forever.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene Nyasae one, nigo nkoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono nenkoro yane yonsi, nindarie obonene bw’erieta riao goika kare na kare.
swahili: Ee Bwana wangu, nitakusifu kwa moyo wote; nitaliadhimisha jina lako milele.

english: For great is Your loving devotion to me; You have delivered me from the depths of Sheol.
ekegusii: Naki obwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe nigo bore obonene ase ’nde; aye kwabooririe omoyo one korwa aase abakuure.
swahili: Kwa maana upendo wako ni mkuu kwangu; umeniokoa kutoka kwenye vilindi vya kaburi.

english: The arrogant rise against me, O God; a band of ruthless men seeks my life, with no regard for You.
ekegusii: Nyasae, abanto abaenenu banyimokeire kondwania esegi; ekeombe ki’abaanto abatindi nigo bakorigia basirie obogima bwane, abwo tibakoirogeti nonya ng’ake.
swahili: Ee Mungu, wenye majivuno wananishambulia; kundi la watu wakatili linatafuta uhai wangu: watu wasiokuheshimu wewe.

english: But You, O Lord, are a compassionate and gracious God, slow to anger, abounding in loving devotion and faithfulness.
ekegusii: Korende aye Omonene nigo ore Nyasae bw’amaabera na obuya; tori omwango bw’okoba nendamwamu, nigo ore nobwanchani botari koera, na obwegenwa.
swahili: Lakini wewe, Ee Bwana, ni Mungu wa huruma na neema, si mwepesi wa hasira, bali ni mwingi wa upendo na uaminifu.

english: Turn to me and have mercy; grant Your strength to Your servant; save the son of Your maidservant.
ekegusii: Ing’iranerie na ondorere amaabera, ong’e inche omosomba oo chinguru chiao, intoorie inche omwana bw’omosomba oo omokungu.
swahili: Nigeukie na unihurumie; mpe mtumishi wako nguvu zako, mwokoe mwana wa mtumishi wako wa kike.

english: Show me a sign of Your goodness, that my enemies may see and be ashamed; for You, O LORD, have helped me and comforted me.
ekegusii: Inyorokie ekemanyererio ki’obuya bwao, erinde abanto bangechete bakerore na gosookigwa, ekiagera aye Omonene gwankonyire na kondemia.
swahili: Nipe ishara ya wema wako, ili adui zangu waione nao waaibishwe, kwa kuwa wewe, Ee Bwana, umenisaidia na kunifariji.

english: Preserve my soul, for I am godly. You are my God; save Your servant who trusts in You.
ekegusii: Orende omoyo one, ekiagera nigo nkoirogete; aye Nyasae one, intoorie inche omosomba oo, ekiagera nigo ngosemeretie.
swahili: Linda maisha yangu, kwa maana nimejiweka kwako, wewe ni Mungu wangu, mwokoe mtumishi wako anayekutumaini.

english: Be merciful to me, O Lord, for I call to You all day long.
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, indorera amaabera, ekiagera nigo nkorera asore omobaso boira.
swahili: Ee Bwana, nihurumie mimi, kwa maana ninakuita mchana kutwa.

english: Bring joy to Your servant, for to You, O Lord, I lift up my soul.
ekegusii: Gokia omoyo one inche omosomba oo, ekiagera narentire omoyo one asore aye Omonene.
swahili: Mpe mtumishi wako furaha, kwa kuwa kwako wewe, Ee Bwana, ninainua nafsi yangu.

english: For You, O Lord, are kind and forgiving, rich in loving devotion to all who call on You.
ekegusii: Omonene, aye nigo ore omuya na oyo okwabera; nigo okoorokia obwanchani obonge ase abagokorangeria obakonye.
swahili: Ee Bwana, wewe ni mwema na mwenye kusamehe, umejaa upendo kwa wote wakuitao.

english: Hear my prayer, O LORD, and attend to my plea for mercy.
ekegusii: Omonene, tegerera oigwe ogosaba kwane, igwa ekerero ki’ogosorora kwane.
swahili: Ee Bwana, sikia maombi yangu, sikiliza kilio changu unihurumie.

english: In the day of my distress I call on You, because You answer me.
ekegusii: Ekero inde nemechando nigo ngokorangeria, ekiagera aye nigo okonyigwa na kong’iraneria.
swahili: Katika siku ya shida yangu nitakuita, kwa maana wewe utanijibu.

english: O Lord, there is none like You among the gods, nor any works like Yours.
ekegusii: Omonene, enyasae teri enga buna aye, gose emeremo ende teri enga buna eyao.
swahili: Ee Bwana, katikati ya miungu hakuna kama wewe, hakuna matendo ya kulinganishwa na yako.

english: All the nations You have made will come and bow before You, O Lord, and they will glorify Your name.
ekegusii: Ebisaku bionsi gwatongete mbichiche, bitung’ame ase obosio bwao kogosasiima, mbitogie erieta riao, aye Omonene.
swahili: Ee Bwana, mataifa yote uliyoyafanya yatakuja na kuabudu mbele zako; wataliletea utukufu jina lako.

english: He has founded His city on the holy mountains.
ekegusii: Omochie oria obegetwe oboroso n’Omonene nigo oteneine igoro ase ebitunwa ebichenu.
swahili: Ameuweka msingi wake katika mlima mtakatifu;

english: The LORD loves the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo anchete ebiita bia Sayoni kobua aande onsi ase abanto ba Yakobo bamenyete.
swahili: Bwana anayapenda malango ya Sayuni kuliko makao yote ya Yakobo.

english: Glorious things are ascribed to you, O city of God. Selah
ekegusii: Aye omochie o Nyasae, amang’ana ’obonene nigo agokwanwa igoro yao.
swahili: Mambo matukufu yanasemwa juu yako, ee mji wa Mungu:

english: “I will mention Rahab and Babylon among those who know Me— along with Philistia, Tyre, and Cush — when I say, ‘This one was born in Zion.’”
ekegusii: Ase abanto abwo bamanyete inche ninyatore Rahabu, na Abaababeli, na Abafirisiti, na Abaturo, amo nabaanto b’Ethiopia, na goteeba, “Oyo na oyo nao baiboreretwe ime aaria.”
swahili: “Nitaweka kumbukumbu ya Rahabu na Babeli miongoni mwa wale wanaonikubali mimi: Ufilisti pia na Tiro, pamoja na Kushi, nami nitasema, ‘Huyu alizaliwa Sayuni.’ ”

english: And it will be said of Zion: “This one and that one were born in her, and the Most High Himself will establish her.”
ekegusii: Igoro ya Sayoni amang’ana aya nakwanwe. “Omonto oyo na oria nao baiboreretwe ime yaye,” n’Omonene ore Igoro Mono nere orabe okoyokong’ia.
swahili: Kuhusu Sayuni itasemwa hivi, “Huyu na yule walizaliwa humo, naye Aliye Juu Sana mwenyewe atamwimarisha.”

english: The LORD will record in the register of the peoples: “This one was born in Zion.” Selah
ekegusii: Ekero Omonene arakore omobaro bw’abaanto, nigo ararike, “Oyo na oyo nao baiboreretwe ime aaria.”
swahili: Bwana ataandika katika orodha ya mataifa: “Huyu alizaliwa Sayuni.”

english: Singers and pipers will proclaim, “All my springs of joy are in You.”
ekegusii: Ekero bagotera na bagotenga nigo bagoteeba, “Chinsoko chiaito chionsi nigo chire ime yao.”
swahili: Watakapokuwa wanapiga vinanda wataimba, “Chemchemi zangu zote ziko kwako.”

english: O LORD, the God of my salvation, day and night I cry out before You.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, Nyasae bw’ogotooreka kwane, omobaso na obotuko nigo nkorera asore ng’a onkonye.
swahili: Ee Bwana, Mungu uniokoaye, nimelia mbele zako usiku na mchana.

english: Do You work wonders for the dead? Do departed spirits rise up to praise You? Selah
ekegusii: Inee! Abakuure nkobakorera ore amakumia? Inee! Abwo nkoimoka bare na kogotogia?
swahili: Je, wewe huwaonyesha wafu maajabu yako? Je, wale waliokufa huinuka na kukusifu?

english: Can Your loving devotion be proclaimed in the grave, Your faithfulness in Abaddon?
ekegusii: Inee! Obwanchani bwao ngokwanwa bore ime ase chimbeera, gose obwegenwa bwao agwo aase aasareku?
swahili: Je, upendo wako hutangazwa kaburini, uaminifu wako katika Uharibifu?

english: Will Your wonders be known in the darkness, or Your righteousness in the land of oblivion?
ekegusii: Inee! Amang’ana ao ay’ogokumia namanyire agwo ase omosunte ime? Gose oboronge bwao mbomanyire agwo ase ense y’okwebwa?
swahili: Je, maajabu yako hujulikana mahali pa giza, au matendo yako ya haki katika nchi ya usahaulifu?

english: But to You, O LORD, I cry for help; in the morning my prayer comes before You.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, nigo nkorera asore, onkonye, nonya nemambia ogosaba kwane nigo kogoika asore.
swahili: Lakini ninakulilia wewe, Ee Bwana, unisaidie; asubuhi maombi yangu huja mbele zako.

english: Why, O LORD, do You reject me? Why do You hide Your face from me?
ekegusii: Omonene, nase ki gwatugutire omoyo one? Nase ki kwabisire obosio bwao korwa ase ’nde?
swahili: Ee Bwana, kwa nini unanikataa na kunificha uso wako?

english: From my youth I was afflicted and near death. I have borne Your terrors; I am in despair.
ekegusii: Korwa obwana bwane nabeire inde nemechando, nabeire ang’e nogokwa, ndemereretie okogosa kwao, tindi nogokonywa konde nonya nogoke.
swahili: Tangu ujana wangu nimeteseka, nikakaribia kifo; nimepatwa na hofu zako, nami nimekata tamaa.

english: Your wrath has swept over me; Your terrors have destroyed me.
ekegusii: Endamwamu yao entindi yantubire kegima, amaakwa ao ansiririe.
swahili: Ghadhabu yako imepita juu yangu; hofu zako zimeniangamiza.

english: All day long they engulf me like water; they enclose me on every side.
ekegusii: Nigo ang’etanaine buna amaache omobaso boira; abwatanire amo, na amigire inche.
swahili: Mchana kutwa zinanizunguka kama mafuriko; zimenimeza kabisa.

english: You have removed my beloved and my friend; darkness is my closest companion.
ekegusii: Aye gwatananire omwanchwa one na omosani one bambeereire aare, na omosunte obeire omogisangio one.
swahili: Umeniondolea marafiki na wapendwa wangu; giza limekuwa ndilo rafiki yangu wa karibu kuliko wote.

english: May my prayer come before You; incline Your ear to my cry.
ekegusii: Ogosaba kwane tiga goike ase obosio bwao, tegerera oigwe okorera kwane.
swahili: Maombi yangu yafike mbele zako, utegee kilio changu sikio lako.

english: For my soul is full of troubles, and my life draws near to Sheol.
ekegusii: Omoyo one nigo oichire nemechando, na obogima bwane bwaikire ang’e kogenda aase abakuure.
swahili: Kwa maana nafsi yangu imejaa taabu, na maisha yangu yanakaribia kaburi.

english: I am counted among those descending to the Pit. I am like a man without strength.
ekegusii: Inche nabareranigwe amo nabwo bakogenda ase embeera, chinguru chiang’ereire.
swahili: Nimehesabiwa miongoni mwa wale waendao shimoni, niko kama mtu asiye na nguvu.

english: I am forsaken among the dead, like the slain who lie in the grave, whom You remember no more, who are cut off from Your care.
ekegusii: Natigirwe inde buna oyomo bw’abakuure buna abwo baitetwe, bono bare ase chimbeera ime. Nabeire buna abwo aye otainyoreti nonya ng’ake, kwabaatananire korwa ase okoboko kwao.
swahili: Nimetengwa pamoja na wafu, kama waliochinjwa walalao kaburini, ambao huwakumbuki tena, ambao wamekatiliwa mbali na uangalizi wako.

english: You have laid me in the lowest Pit, in the darkest of the depths.
ekegusii: Kwambekire inse kegima ase embeera ime; agwo aase are omosunte na aatambe gochia inse.
swahili: Umenitupa katika shimo lenye kina kirefu sana, katika vina vya giza nene.

english: Your wrath weighs heavily upon me; all Your waves have submerged me. Selah
ekegusii: Egesusuro kiao nigo kere ekerito igoro yane, kwambagoreire emerindo yao yonsi yantubire kegima.
swahili: Ghadhabu yako imekuwa nzito juu yangu, umenigharikisha kwa mawimbi yako yote.

english: You have removed my friends from me; You have made me repulsive to them; I am confined and cannot escape.
ekegusii: Kwabekire aare abagisangio baane twamanyaine, gwankorire nabeire okogechia ase bare; nasiekereirwe, tinkonyara gosoka.
swahili: Umenitenga na rafiki zangu wa karibu na kunifanya chukizo kwao. Nimezuiliwa, wala siwezi kutoroka;

english: My eyes grow dim with grief. I call to You daily, O LORD; I spread out my hands to You.
ekegusii: Amaiso aane amwamire ase okweumia; Aye Omonene, kera rituko nigo ngokorangeria, ndamborete amaboko aane gocha asore.
swahili: nuru ya macho yangu imefifia kwa ajili ya huzuni. Ee Bwana, ninakuita kila siku, ninakunyooshea wewe mikono yangu.

english: I will sing of the loving devotion of the LORD forever; with my mouth I will proclaim Your faithfulness to all generations.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, goika kare na kare ninterere obwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe, nindarie obwegenwa bwao ase ebiaare bionsi.
swahili: Nitaimba juu ya upendo mkuu wa Bwana milele; kwa kinywa changu nitajulisha uaminifu wako ujulikane kwa vizazi vyote.

english: You crushed Rahab like a carcass; You scattered Your enemies with Your mighty arm.
ekegusii: Aye nigo gwasenyentete enchoka eria Rahabu ekaba buna egetondo, nokoboko kwao kore ne chinguru ogasiarera ababisa bao.
swahili: Wewe ulimponda Rahabu kama mmojawapo wa waliochinjwa; kwa mkono wako wenye nguvu, uliwatawanya adui zako.

english: The heavens are Yours, and also the earth. The earth and its fullness You founded.
ekegusii: Igoro neyao, na ense neyao, ense na ebinto bionsi bireo naye kwabitongete.
swahili: Mbingu ni zako, nayo nchi pia ni yako, uliuwekea ulimwengu msingi pamoja na vyote vilivyomo.

english: North and south You created; Tabor and Hermon shout for joy at Your name.
ekegusii: Naye gwatongete sugusu na Irianyi; egetunwa gia Tabori, na ekia Herimoni, nigo bigotogia erieta riao nomogooko.
swahili: Uliumba kaskazini na kusini; Tabori na Hermoni wanaliimbia jina lako kwa furaha.

english: Mighty is Your arm; strong is Your hand. Your right hand is exalted.
ekegusii: Okoboko kwao nigo kore nokobua, ee, nigo kore ne chinguru; okoboko kwao gw’okorio nigo koimokererete igoro.
swahili: Mkono wako umejaa uwezo; mkono wako una nguvu, mkono wako wa kuume umetukuzwa.

english: Righteousness and justice are the foundation of Your throne; loving devotion and faithfulness go before You.
ekegusii: Oboronge na ekeene nabio bire oboroso bw’okogamba kwao, obwanchani bwa kare na kare, na obwegenwa, nigo bitang’aine bosio bwao.
swahili: Haki na hukumu ndio msingi wa kiti chako cha enzi; upendo na uaminifu vinakutangulia.

english: Blessed are those who know the joyful sound, who walk, O LORD, in the light of Your presence.
ekegusii: Mbarenomogooko abanto abwo bamanyete goaka eriogi ri’omogooko asore, abwo bagotaara ase oborabu bokorwa ase obosio bwao aye Omonene.
swahili: Heri ni wale ambao wamejifunza kukusifu kwa shangwe, wanaotembea katika mwanga wa uwepo wako, Ee Bwana.

english: They rejoice in Your name all day long, and in Your righteousness they exult.
ekegusii: Abwo nigo bagochengera erieta riao omobaso boira; na goetera ase oboronge bwao nigo bakoimokererigwa igoro.
swahili: Wanashangilia katika jina lako mchana kutwa, wanafurahi katika haki yako.

english: For You are the glory of their strength, and by Your favor our horn is exalted.
ekegusii: Aye nigo ore obonene bwabo ne chinguru chiabo; ase engencho y’ogwancherwa kwao ching’unchara chiaito chiakinire.
swahili: Kwa kuwa wewe ni utukufu na nguvu yao, kwa wema wako unatukuza pembe yetu.

english: Surely our shield belongs to the LORD, and our king to the Holy One of Israel.
ekegusii: Oyore enguba yaito n’oyore Omonene, ee, omorwoti oito noyo bw’Oyore Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli. Nyasae okoriera Daudi chiira
swahili: Naam, ngao yetu ni mali ya Bwana, na mfalme wetu mali ya Aliye Mtakatifu wa Israeli.

english: You once spoke in a vision; to Your godly ones You said, “I have bestowed help on a warrior; I have exalted one chosen from the people.
ekegusii: Kare ngwakwanete nabegenwa bao ase okorora, okabateebia, “Narentire ogokonywa goetera ase oyomo ore nokobua, naimokereirie igoro oyomo nachorire korwa ase egati y’abanto.
swahili: Ulizungumza wakati fulani katika maono, kwa watu wako waaminifu, ukasema: “Nimeweka nguvu kwa shujaa, nimemwinua kijana miongoni mwa watu.

english: For I have said, “Loving devotion is built up forever; in the heavens You establish Your faithfulness.”
ekegusii: Ninkwane ng’a obwanchani bwao mbogendererete botambe bwakorirwe kobao goika kare na kare; aaria igoro nigo okong’etie obwegenwa bwao.
swahili: Nitatangaza kuwa upendo wako unasimama imara milele na uaminifu wako umeuthibitisha mbinguni.

english: I have found My servant David; with My sacred oil I have anointed him.
ekegusii: Nanyorire Daudi, omosomba one, namoakire amaguta aane amaachenu ase okomwatanana ase ’nde.
swahili: Nimemwona Daudi, mtumishi wangu, na nimemtia mafuta yangu matakatifu.

english: My hand will sustain him; surely My arm will strengthen him.
ekegusii: Okoboko kwane nkobe amo nere botambe, ee, okoboko kwane nkomobeke chinguru.
swahili: Kitanga changu kitamtegemeza, hakika mkono wangu utamtia nguvu.

english: No enemy will exact tribute; no wicked man will oppress him.
ekegusii: Ababisa tibakomobwata mobosokano, na abakori amabe tibakomochanda.
swahili: Hakuna adui atakayemtoza ushuru, hakuna mtu mwovu atakayemwonea.

english: I will crush his foes before him and strike down those who hate him.
ekegusii: Ninsenyente ababisa baye ase obosio bwaye, abwo bamogechete nimbae amaakwa.
swahili: Nitawaponda adui zake mbele zake na kuwaangamiza watesi wake.

english: My faithfulness and loving devotion will be with him, and through My name his horn will be exalted.
ekegusii: Obwegenwa na obwanchani bwane bogendererete botambe mbibe amo nere; ase erieta riane orogunchara rwaye ndokine.
swahili: Upendo wangu mkamilifu utakuwa pamoja naye, kwa Jina langu pembe yake itatukuzwa.

english: I will set his hand over the sea, and his right hand upon the rivers.
ekegusii: Nimbeke enyancha inse y’okoboko kwaye, ne chindooche nchibe inse y’okoboko kwaye gw’okorio.
swahili: Nitauweka mkono wake juu ya bahari, mkono wake wa kuume juu ya mito.

english: He will call to Me, ‘You are my Father, my God, the Rock of my salvation.’
ekegusii: Ere nabe okorera ase ’nde na goteeba; Aye naye Tata, naye Nyasae one, na Egetare kiane ki’ogotooreka.
swahili: Naye ataniita kwa sauti, ‘Wewe ni Baba yangu, Mungu wangu, Mwamba na Mwokozi wangu.’

english: I will indeed appoint him as My firstborn, the highest of the kings of the earth.
ekegusii: Erio inche nimokore abe omwana one omotangi, abe omorwoti ore omonene kobua abarwoti bande bonsi b’ense.
swahili: Nitamteua pia awe mzaliwa wangu wa kwanza, aliyetukuka kuliko wafalme wote wa dunia.

english: I will forever preserve My loving devotion for him, and My covenant with him will stand fast.
ekegusii: Obwanchani bwane botari koera nimoborendere kare na kare, na okobwatana kwane kw’ogotianania nkorete nere ngotenene bokong’u.
swahili: Nitadumisha upendo wangu kwake milele, na agano langu naye litakuwa imara.

english: I will establish his line forever, his throne as long as the heavens endure.
ekegusii: Ninkore oroiboro rwaye rogenderere kobao botambe, na ekerogo kiaye ki’obonene nkegenderere kobao buna igoro erabe ereo.
swahili: Nitaudumisha uzao wake milele, kiti chake cha enzi kama mbingu zinavyodumu.

english: You said, “I have made a covenant with My chosen one, I have sworn to David My servant:
ekegusii: Aye nigo gwateebete, “Nakorire okobwatana nomochore one, narire eira y’ogotiana ase Daudi omosomba one.
swahili: Ulisema, “Nimefanya agano na mteule wangu, nimemwapia mtumishi wangu Daudi,

english: If his sons forsake My law and do not walk in My judgments,
ekegusii: “Onye abanto b’ororeria rwaye bagochia gotiga amachiiko aane, bange koigwera emeroberio yane echiikire,
swahili: “Kama wanae wataacha amri yangu na wasifuate sheria zangu,

english: if they violate My statutes and fail to keep My commandments,
ekegusii: na onye bagochia gosaria aya nachiikire. Bange kobwata amachiiko aane,
swahili: kama wakihalifu maagizo yangu na kutoshika amri zangu,

english: I will attend to their transgression with the rod, and to their iniquity with stripes.
ekegusii: rirorio nimbae egesusuro, mbaake nenyimbo ase engencho y’ogosaria kwabo, na mbang’wanie ebiranya ase engencho y’ebibe biabo.
swahili: nitaadhibu dhambi yao kwa fimbo, uovu wao kwa kuwapiga,

english: But I will not withdraw My loving devotion from him, nor ever betray My faithfulness.
ekegusii: Korende obwanchani bwane bogendererete botambe tinkoborusia asare, tingotiga koba omwegenwa asare.
swahili: lakini sitauondoa upendo wangu kwake, wala sitausaliti uaminifu wangu kamwe.

english: I will not violate My covenant or alter the utterance of My lips.
ekegusii: Tinkonyara gosaria okobwatana kwane kw’ogotianania, gose tinkoonchora ring’ana nakwanire nomonwa one.
swahili: Mimi sitavunja agano langu wala sitabadili lile ambalo midomo yangu imelitamka.

english: Once and for all I have sworn by My holiness— I will not lie to David—
ekegusii: “Ase obochenu bwane natianire rimo ng’a tingokwana oborimo ase Daudi.
swahili: Mara moja na kwa milele, nimeapa kwa utakatifu wangu, nami sitamdanganya Daudi:

english: his offspring shall endure forever, and his throne before Me like the sun,
ekegusii: Oroiboro rwaye ndogenderere kobao botambe, na ekerogo kiaye ki’obonene nkegenderere kobao, buna erioba rirabe rireo ase obosio bwane.
swahili: kwamba uzao wake utaendelea milele, na kiti chake cha enzi kitadumu mbele zangu kama jua;

english: like the moon, established forever, a faithful witness in the sky.” Selah
ekegusii: Nkegenderere kobao buna omotienyi, oborori obwo bwa igoro nigo bore obwegenwa.” Okweumia ase engencho y’okobugwa kw’omorwoti
swahili: kitaimarishwa milele kama mwezi, shahidi mwaminifu angani.”

english: Now, however, You have spurned and rejected him; You are enraged by Your anointed one.
ekegusii: Korende bono, aye Omonene kwangire omoakwa amaguta oo, kwabeire nendamwamu enene asare.
swahili: Lakini wewe umemkataa, umemdharau, umemkasirikia sana mpakwa mafuta wako.

english: You have renounced the covenant with Your servant and sullied his crown in the dust.
ekegusii: Bono gwatigire okobwatana kwao kw’ogotianania gwakorete nomosomba oo, kwarutire egutwa yaye y’obogambi inse kwayemwamirie.
swahili: Umelikana agano lako na mtumishi wako, na umeinajisi taji yake mavumbini.

english: ‘I will establish your offspring forever and build up your throne for all generations.’” Selah
ekegusii: Ninkore oroiboro rwao rogenderere koba ne chinguru botambe, nintenenie ekerogo kiao ki’obonene kebe ase ebiaare bionsi.”
swahili: ‘Nitaimarisha uzao wako milele na kudumisha ufalme wako kwa vizazi vyote.’ ”

english: You have broken down all his walls; You have reduced his strongholds to rubble.
ekegusii: Gwatagoire chindwaki chiaye chionsi gwatagoire amaagacho aye onsi are amakong’u abeire amatombe.
swahili: Umebomoa kuta zake zote, na ngome zake zote umezifanya kuwa magofu.

english: All who pass by plunder him; he has become a reproach to his neighbors.
ekegusii: Abanto bonsi bagoetera aase agwo nigo bakomosakora, abamenyete ang’e nere nigo bakomochecheria.
swahili: Wote wapitao karibu wamemnyangʼanya mali zake; amekuwa dharau kwa jirani zake.

english: You have exalted the right hand of his foes; You have made all his enemies rejoice.
ekegusii: Abwo bakomochanda aye kwabaeire chinguru chinyinge, na kwagerire ababisa baye bonsi bagoke.
swahili: Umeutukuza mkono wa kuume wa adui zake, umewafanya watesi wake wote washangilie.

english: You have bent the edge of his sword and have not sustained him in battle.
ekegusii: Kwairanirie omoro oye bw’esegi, tori komoa chinguru chi’okorwana esegi.
swahili: Umegeuza makali ya upanga wake, na hukumpa msaada katika vita.

english: You have ended his splendor and cast his throne to the ground.
ekegusii: Kwamourire obonene bwaye, gwaakeire inse ekerogo kiaye ki’obogambi.
swahili: Umeikomesha fahari yake, na kukiangusha kiti chake cha enzi.

english: You have cut short the days of his youth; You have covered him with shame. Selah
ekegusii: Kwanachire amatuko aye ay’obosae abeire ameng’e, boigo kwamotubire nobosooku obonge mono. Ogosaba gw’okonyora ogotoorigwa
swahili: Umezifupisha siku za ujana wake, umemfunika kwa vazi la aibu.

english: How long, O LORD? Will You hide Yourself forever? Will Your wrath keep burning like fire?
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ngoika ririri oragenderere kwebisete? Inee! Ngoika ririri endamwamu yao eragenderere gwoka buna omorero?
swahili: Hata lini, Ee Bwana? Utajificha milele? Ghadhabu yako itawaka kama moto hata lini?

english: Remember the briefness of my lifespan! For what futility You have created all men!
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, inyora buna obogima bwane bore obweng’e, nigo gwatongete Mwanyabaanto bonsi bakwe igo.
swahili: Kumbuka jinsi maisha yangu yanavyopita haraka. Ni kwa ubatili kiasi gani umemuumba mwanadamu!

english: What man can live and never see death? Can he deliver his soul from the power of Sheol? Selah
ekegusii: Monto ki orabe moyo otakwe? Ning’o oranyare gotooria omoyo oye korwa ase chinguru chi’amakweri?
swahili: Ni mtu gani awezaye kuishi na asione kifo, au kujiokoa mwenyewe kutoka nguvu za kaburi?

english: Where, O Lord, is Your loving devotion of old, which You faithfully swore to David?
ekegusii: Omonene, ng’ai obwanchani bwao bwa kare na kare bore, obwo ase obwegenwa bwao kwarierete Daudi eira?
swahili: Ee Bwana, uko wapi upendo wako mkuu wa mwanzoni, ambao katika uaminifu wako ulimwapia Daudi?

english: The heavens praise Your wonders, O LORD— Your faithfulness as well— in the assembly of the holy ones.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, igoro nchitogie emeremo yao y’ogokumia, naende obwegenwa bwao boigo ase omosangererekano bw’abachenu bao.
swahili: Ee Bwana, mbingu zinayasifu maajabu yako, uaminifu wako pia katika kusanyiko la watakatifu.

english: Remember, O Lord, the reproach of Your servants, which I bear in my heart from so many people—
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ing’inyore inche omosomba oo buna ingokorerwa echeche; nigo ndemereretie emerumi y’abanto abange.
swahili: Bwana kumbuka jinsi mtumishi wako amesimangwa, jinsi ninavyovumilia moyoni mwangu dhihaka za mataifa yote,

english: how Your enemies have taunted, O LORD, and have mocked every step of Your anointed one!
ekegusii: Omonene, ababisa bao nigo bagonchecheria, ee, nigo bagochecheria amabarato ’omoakwa amaguta oo.
swahili: dhihaka ambazo kwazo adui zako wamenisimanga, Ee Bwana, ambazo kwazo wamesimanga kila hatua ya mpakwa mafuta wako.

english: Blessed be the LORD forever! Amen and amen.
ekegusii: Omonene atogigwe kare na kare! Amina. Amina.
swahili: Msifuni Bwana milele! Amen na Amen.

english: For who in the skies can compare with the LORD? Who among the heavenly beings is like the LORD?
ekegusii: Inee! Ning’o ore agwo igoro oranyare koreng’anigwa n’Omonene? Nkereki ase ebitongwa bia Nyasae kenga buna ere?
swahili: Kwa kuwa ni nani katika mbingu anayeweza kulinganishwa na Bwana? Ni nani miongoni mwa viumbe vya mbinguni aliye kama Bwana?

english: In the council of the holy ones, God is greatly feared, and awesome above all who surround Him.
ekegusii: Ere nigo are Nyasae oirokire ase ekegambero ki’abachenu, bonsi abamoetanaine nigo bamoirogete.
swahili: Katika kusanyiko la watakatifu, Mungu huogopwa sana, anahofiwa kuliko wote wanaomzunguka.

english: O LORD God of Hosts, who is like You? O mighty LORD, Your faithfulness surrounds You.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, Nyasae bw’Emeganda, ning’o obwate okobua buna okwao? Ee, Omonene, obwegenwa bwao nigo bogoetanaine.
swahili: Ee Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, ni nani aliye kama wewe? Ee Bwana, wewe ni mwenye nguvu, na uaminifu wako unakuzunguka.

english: You rule the raging sea; when its waves mount up, You still them.
ekegusii: Aye nigo okogambera enyancha ekoimokerera igoro; ekero emerindo yaye ekoimokerera igoro, aye nigo okoyotoereria.
swahili: Wewe unatawala bahari yenye msukosuko; wakati mawimbi yake yanapoinuka, wewe unayatuliza.

english: O LORD, our Lord, how majestic is Your name in all the earth! You have set Your glory above the heavens.
ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, aye Omonene oito, erieta riao naki riakuma iga ense yonsi! Obonene bwao nigo bogotogigwa nonya ngoika igoro.
swahili: Ee Bwana, Bwana wetu, tazama jinsi lilivyo tukufu jina lako duniani mwote! Umeuweka utukufu wako juu ya mbingu.

english: From the mouths of children and infants You have ordained praise on account of Your adversaries, to silence the enemy and avenger.
ekegusii: Ase emenwa y’abana n’eyabakogonka nigo kweagacheire eburi bosio bw’ababisa bao, erinde okoiyeria ababisa bao inse na abakorusia egesiomba.
swahili: Midomoni mwa watoto wachanga na wanyonyao umeamuru sifa, kwa sababu ya watesi wako, kumnyamazisha adui na mlipiza kisasi.

english: When I behold Your heavens, the work of Your fingers, the moon and the stars, which You have set in place—
ekegusii: Ekero nkorigereria gochia igoro, na korora emeremo gwakorete namaboko ao, omotienyi ne ching’enang’eni, ebi kwabegete kera ekemo ase aaye;
swahili: Nikiziangalia mbingu zako, kazi ya vidole vyako, mwezi na nyota, ulizoziratibisha,

english: what is man that You are mindful of him, or the son of man that You care for him?
ekegusii: omonto ’nki aisaine aye ogendererete komorengereria? Mwanyabaanto ’nki aisaine aye okomorenda?
swahili: mwanadamu ni kitu gani hata unamfikiria, binadamu ni nani hata unamjali?

english: You made him a little lower than the angels; You crowned him with glory and honor.
ekegusii: Kwamokorire koba inse kegima asore aye omonyene, Nyasae; korende kwamoboirie obonene na amasikani.
swahili: Umemfanya chini kidogo kuliko viumbe wa mbinguni, ukamvika taji ya utukufu na heshima.

english: You made him ruler of the works of Your hands; You have placed everything under his feet:
ekegusii: Kwamobekire kogambera ebinto bionsi gwatongete; kwabekire ebitongwa bionsi inse y’amagoro aye:
swahili: Umemfanya mtawala juu ya kazi za mikono yako; umeweka vitu vyote chini ya miguu yake.

english: all sheep and oxen, and even the beasts of the field,
ekegusii: ching’ondi chionsi ne chiombe, amo ne ching’iti chi’orosana,
swahili: Mifugo na makundi yote pia, naam, na wanyama wa kondeni,

english: the birds of the air and the fish of the sea, all that swim the paths of the seas.
ekegusii: ne chinyoni chikoiruruka amo ne chinswe chi’enyancha, na kende gionsi kegoetanana ase chindiba chie chinyancha.
swahili: ndege wa angani na samaki wa baharini, naam, kila kiogeleacho katika njia za bahari.

english: O LORD, our Lord, how majestic is Your name in all the earth!
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, aye Omonene oito, naki erieta riao riakuma ense yonsi!
swahili: Ee Bwana, Bwana wetu, tazama jinsi lilivyo tukufu jina lako duniani mwote!

english: Lord, You have been our dwelling place through all generations.
ekegusii: Omonene, aye nigo ore obotamero bwaito ebiaare ase ebiaare.
swahili: Bwana, wewe umekuwa makao yetu katika vizazi vyote.

english: The length of our days is seventy years— or eighty if we are strong— yet their pride is but labor and sorrow, for they quickly pass, and we fly away.
ekegusii: Emiaka y’obogima bwaito nemerongo etano na ebere; onye tore ne chinguru, eba emerongo etano na etato; na obogima obo nigo boichire nobokong’u na emechando, nigo bogoeta bwango, na intwe tweiruruka twasira.
swahili: Siku zetu za kuishi ni miaka sabini, au miaka themanini ikiwa tuna nguvu, lakini yote ni ya shida na taabu, nazo zapita haraka, nasi twatoweka.

english: Who knows the power of Your anger? Your wrath matches the fear You are due.
ekegusii: Ning’o omanyete okobua kw’endamwamu yao, na ogw’ekeririanda kiao, erinde akoiroke?
swahili: Ni nani ajuaye nguvu za hasira yako? Kwa maana ghadhabu yako ni kubwa kama hofu tunayopaswa kuwa nayo kwako.

english: So teach us to number our days, that we may present a heart of wisdom.
ekegusii: Tworokererie, tomanye obweng’e bw’obogima bwaito, erinde chinkoro chiaito chibe nobong’aini.
swahili: Tufundishe kuzihesabu siku zetu vizuri, ili tujipatie moyo wa hekima.

english: Return, O LORD! How long will it be? Have compassion on Your servants.
ekegusii: Omonene, irana ase tore! Ngoika ririri orabe kogoteebana? Otororere intwe, abasomba bao, amaabera!
swahili: Ee Bwana, uwe na huruma! Utakawia hata lini? Wahurumie watumishi wako.

english: Satisfy us in the morning with Your loving devotion, that we may sing for joy and be glad all our days.
ekegusii: Kobogokia mambia, otoisanekie nobwanchani bwao botari koera, erinde tochenge na kogoka amatuko aito onsi.
swahili: Tushibishe asubuhi kwa upendo wako usiokoma, ili tuweze kuimba kwa shangwe na kufurahi siku zetu zote.

english: Make us glad for as many days as You have afflicted us, for as many years as we have seen evil.
ekegusii: Otogokie amatuko ang’ana buna ayio twachandegete, na emiaka eng’ana buna eria twanyorete amabe.
swahili: Utufurahishe kulingana na siku ulizotuadhibu, kulingana na miaka tuliyotaabika.

english: May Your work be shown to Your servants, and Your splendor to their children.
