ekegusii: Tworokie intwe, abasomba bao, ogokora kwao, na abana baito oborokie obonene bwao.
swahili: Matendo yako na yaonekane kwa watumishi wako, utukufu wako kwa watoto wao.

english: May the favor of the Lord our God rest upon us; establish for us the work of our hands— yes, establish the work of our hands!
ekegusii: Obosiani bw’Omonene, Nyasae oito, bobe igoro yaito, na emeremo y’amaboko aito oyesesenie ase tore, ee, osesenie emeremo y’amaboko aito!
swahili: Wema wa Bwana Mungu wetu uwe juu yetu; uzithibitishe kazi za mikono yetu: naam, uzithibitishe kazi za mikono yetu.

english: Before the mountains were born or You brought forth the earth and the world, from everlasting to everlasting You are God.
ekegusii: Ritang’ani ebigoro bitarabao, gose konya otaratonga ense, korwa kare na kare aye naye Nyasae.
swahili: Kabla ya kuzaliwa milima au hujaumba dunia na ulimwengu, wewe ni Mungu tangu milele hata milele.

english: You return man to dust, saying, “Return, O sons of mortals.”
ekegusii: Aye nigo okoonchorana abanto bairana, baba amaroba naende, gwateba, “Inwe Mwanyabaanto, irana!”
swahili: Huwarudisha watu mavumbini, ukisema, “Rudini mavumbini, enyi wanadamu.”

english: For in Your sight a thousand years are but a day that passes, or a watch of the night.
ekegusii: Asore aye, emiaka elifu eyemo nigo ere buna rituko ria igoro koriaetire, buna engaki enke y’okorenda botuko.
swahili: Kwa maana kwako miaka elfu ni kama siku moja iliyokwisha pita, au kama kesha la usiku.

english: You whisk them away in their sleep; they are like the new grass of the morning—
ekegusii: Nigo ogokorobanania Mwanyabaanto buna eooro, baeta bwango buna chindoto. Barabwo nigo bare buna obonyansi bokomera mambia;
swahili: Unawatowesha wanadamu katika usingizi wa kifo, nao ni kama majani machanga ya asubuhi:

english: in the morning it springs up new, but by evening it fades and withers.
ekegusii: mambia nigo bogokina bwasicha, mogoroba bwanachwa bwoma.
swahili: ingawa asubuhi yanachipua, ifikapo jioni huwa yamenyauka na kukauka.

english: For we are consumed by Your anger and terrified by Your wrath.
ekegusii: Intwe nigo togosirigwa nendamwamu yao, twaondokigwa nekeririanda kiao.
swahili: Tumeangamizwa kwa hasira yako na tumetishwa kwa ghadhabu yako.

english: You have set our iniquities before You, our secret sins in the light of Your presence.
ekegusii: Amabe aya twakorire nigo oyabegete ase obosio bwao, na ebibe biaito bia bobisi nigo bire maiso marore asore.
swahili: Umeyaweka maovu yetu mbele yako, dhambi zetu za siri katika nuru ya uwepo wako.

english: For all our days decline in Your fury; we finish our years with a sigh.
ekegusii: Obogima bwaito bwonsi nigo bokoera bwango inse y’ekeririanda kiao, nigo togokoora emiaka yaito buna ogoita egekoe
swahili: Tumeishi siku zetu zote chini ya ghadhabu yako, tunamaliza miaka yetu kwa kuomboleza.

english: He who dwells in the shelter of the Most High will abide in the shadow of the Almighty.
ekegusii: Ere oyomenyete inse y’oborendi bw’Oyore Igoro Mono, na otimogete ase ekiriri ki’oyore Omobui,
swahili: Yeye akaaye mahali pa salama pake Yeye Aliye Juu Sana, atadumu katika uvuli wake Mwenyezi.

english: no evil will befall you, no plague will approach your tent.
ekegusii: amabe ande onsi tagokonyora, na amaakwa ande onsi tagocha ase enka yao.
swahili: basi hakuna madhara yatakayokupata wewe, hakuna maafa yataikaribia hema yako.

english: For He will command His angels concerning you to guard you in all your ways.
ekegusii: Naki Nyasae nagochikere abamalaika baye bakorende ase chinchera chiao chionsi.
swahili: Kwa kuwa atawaagiza malaika zake kwa ajili yako, wakulinde katika njia zako zote.

english: They will lift you up in their hands, so that you will not strike your foot against a stone.
ekegusii: Barabwo nabakoimokie ase amaboko abo, erinde togochwa okogoro kwao ne rigena.
swahili: Mikononi mwao watakuinua, ili usijikwae mguu wako kwenye jiwe.

english: You will tread on the lion and cobra; you will trample the young lion and serpent.
ekegusii: Notache chindo na amarubi, notiringe chindo chinsae ne chinchoka.
swahili: Utawakanyaga simba na nyoka wakali, simba mkubwa na nyoka utawaponda kwa miguu.

english: “Because he loves Me, I will deliver him; because he knows My name, I will protect him.
ekegusii: Naki oyo obwatanire nainche ase obwanchani nimotoorie, nimorende, ekiagera namanyete erieta riane.
swahili: Bwana asema, “Kwa kuwa ananipenda, nitamwokoa; nitamlinda, kwa kuwa analikiri Jina langu.

english: When he calls out to Me, I will answer him; I will be with him in trouble. I will deliver him and honor him.
ekegusii: Ekero arandangerie, inche nimoitabere, inche nigo inde amo nere ase engaki y’emechando. Nimotoorie, naende nimoe ogosika.
swahili: Ataniita, nami nitamjibu; nitakuwa pamoja naye katika taabu, nitamwokoa na kumheshimu.

english: With long life I will satisfy him and show him My salvation.”
ekegusii: Nimoisanekie nobogima obotambe na komwoorokia ogotooreka kwane.
swahili: Kwa siku nyingi nitamshibisha na kumwonyesha wokovu wangu.”

english: I will say to the LORD, “You are my refuge and my fortress, my God, in whom I trust.”
ekegusii: oyio nigo aranyare goteeba, “Omonene nere obotamero bwane, na orwaki rwane, nere Nyasae one oyo nsemeretie.”
swahili: Nitasema kumhusu Bwana, “Yeye ndiye kimbilio langu na ngome yangu, Mungu wangu, ambaye ninamtumaini.”

english: Surely He will deliver you from the snare of the fowler, and from the deadly plague.
ekegusii: Ere nagotoorie korwa ase omoeto bw’omotegi, na korwa ase amarwaire amabe agoita.
swahili: Hakika yeye ataniokoa na mtego wa mwindaji, na maradhi ya kuambukiza ya kuua.

english: He will cover you with His feathers; under His wings you will find refuge; His faithfulness is a shield and rampart.
ekegusii: Ere nagotube namarionya aye, ase chimbaaba chiaye ime nonyore obotamero. Obwegenwa bwaye nenguba na eng’aya asore.
swahili: Atakufunika kwa manyoya yake, chini ya mbawa zake utapata kimbilio, uaminifu wake utakuwa ngao na kinga yako.

english: You will not fear the terror of the night, nor the arrow that flies by day,
ekegusii: Tokwoboa okogoswa ekero kia botuko, gose omogwe okorutwa mobaso,
swahili: Hutaogopa vitisho vya usiku, wala mshale urukao mchana,

english: nor the pestilence that stalks in the darkness, nor the calamity that destroys at noon.
ekegusii: nonya namarwaire amabe agoeta ase omosunte, gose amabe ande onsi agoita mobaso.
swahili: wala maradhi ya kuambukiza yanayonyemelea gizani, wala tauni iharibuyo adhuhuri.

english: Though a thousand may fall at your side, and ten thousand at your right hand, no harm will come near you.
ekegusii: Abanto elifu eyemo nabaisa kogwa ase rikere riao, gose chilifu ikomi ase ensemo yao ya borio, korende ayio tagokonyora aye.
swahili: Ijapo watu elfu wataangukia kando yako, kumi elfu mkono wako wa kuume, lakini haitakukaribia wewe.

english: You will only see it with your eyes and witness the punishment of the wicked.
ekegusii: Norigererie namaiso ao, orore buna abakori amabe bakoegwa egesusuro.
swahili: Utatazama tu kwa macho yako na kuona adhabu ya waovu.

english: Because you have made the LORD your dwelling— my refuge, the Most High—
ekegusii: Ekiagera kwabekire Omonene obeire egekengano kiao, na Oyore Igoro Mono obotamero bwao,
swahili: Kama ukimfanya Aliye Juu Sana kuwa makao yako: naam, Bwana ambaye ni kimbilio langu,

english: It is good to praise the LORD, and to sing praises to Your name, O Most High,
ekegusii: Nigo ere buya gokoakera aye Omonene Nyasae ng’a mbuya mono, na goteera ase ogotogia erieta riao, aye Nyasae Ore Igoro Mono.
swahili: Ni vyema kumshukuru Bwana na kuliimbia jina lako, Ee Uliye Juu Sana,

english: But You have exalted my horn like that of a wild ox; with fine oil I have been anointed.
ekegusii: Gwakinirie orogunchara rwane rwabeire buna orw’eng’era, kwang’umoreire amaguta amayia.
swahili: Umeitukuza pembe yangu kama ile ya nyati dume, mafuta mazuri yamemiminwa juu yangu.

english: My eyes see the downfall of my enemies; my ears hear the wailing of my wicked foes.
ekegusii: Narorire namaiso aane ababisa baane bakobugwa, naigure namato aane igoro y’abakori amabe abanyimokerete.
swahili: Macho yangu yamewaona adui zangu wakishindwa, masikio yangu yamesikia maangamizi ya adui zangu waovu.

english: The righteous will flourish like a palm tree, and grow like a cedar in Lebanon.
ekegusii: Omonyene oboronge naseboke buna omokendo, nakine buna omocharake o Lebanoni.
swahili: Wenye haki watastawi kama mtende, watakuwa kama mwerezi wa Lebanoni,

english: Planted in the house of the LORD, they will flourish in the courts of our God.
ekegusii: Abwo basimekire ase enyomba y’Omonene, nigo baragenderere koreereta ase chigoora chia Nyasae oito.
swahili: waliopandwa katika nyumba ya Bwana, watastawi katika nyua za Mungu wetu.

english: In old age they will still bear fruit; healthy and green they will remain,
ekegusii: Abwo nigo bakogenderera goseboka nonya bagotire, nigo baragenderere kobesea.
swahili: Wakati wa uzee watakuwa bado wanazaa matunda, watakuwa wabichi tena wamejaa nguvu,

english: to proclaim, “The LORD is upright; He is my Rock, and in Him there is no unrighteousness.”
ekegusii: Ayio nigo akworokia ng’a Omonene nigo are omonyene oboronge, ere nere egetare kiane, na obokorekanu tibori ime yaye.
swahili: wakitangaza, “ Bwana ni mkamilifu; yeye ni Mwamba wangu, na ndani yake hamna uovu.”

english: to proclaim Your loving devotion in the morning and Your faithfulness at night
ekegusii: Kera emambia nigo ere buya koraria obwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe, na kera obotuko koraria obwegenwa bwao,
swahili: kuutangaza upendo wako asubuhi, na uaminifu wako wakati wa usiku,

english: with the ten-stringed harp and the melody of the lyre.
ekegusii: ase okobugia obokano bore ne chinga ikomi, na amakano ande are namariogi amaya.
swahili: kwa zeze yenye nyuzi kumi na kwa sauti ya kinubi.

english: For You, O LORD, have made me glad by Your deeds; I sing for joy at the works of Your hands.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ogokora kwao nigo kongogetie; ninchenge ase engencho y’emeremo y’amaboko ao.
swahili: Ee Bwana, kwa kuwa matendo yako yamenifurahisha, nitaziimba kwa shangwe kazi za mikono yako.

english: How great are Your works, O LORD, how deep are Your thoughts!
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, emeremo yao nigo ere emenene mono, na ebirengererio biao nigo bire ebia ime mono.
swahili: Ee Bwana, tazama jinsi yalivyo makuu matendo yako, tazama jinsi yalivyo ya kina mawazo yako!

english: that though the wicked sprout like grass, and all evildoers flourish, they will be forever destroyed.
ekegusii: Abakori amabe nabaisa koreereta buna obonyansi, na abakori ebibe bonsi babe bagosicha buya, korende omoerio obo nogosirigwa goika kare na kare.
swahili: ingawa waovu huchipua kama majani na wote watendao mabaya wanastawi, wataangamizwa milele.

english: But You, O LORD, are exalted forever!
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, nigo ore omonene mono kare na kare.
swahili: Bali wewe, Ee Bwana, utatukuzwa milele.

english: For surely Your enemies, O LORD, surely Your enemies will perish; all evildoers will be scattered.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, Naama! Ababisa bao mbasirigwe; na abakori ebibe bonsi mbasiarerwe gochia aande onsi.
swahili: Ee Bwana, hakika adui zako, hakika adui zako wataangamia. Wote watendao mabaya watatawanyika.

english: The LORD reigns! He is robed in majesty; the LORD has clothed and armed Himself with strength. The world indeed is firmly established; it cannot be moved.
ekegusii: Omonene nere okogamba, nigo eboetie obonene. Omonene nigo asiberanetie chinguru. Ase ayio ense nigo eteneine bokong’u tekonyegerigwa.
swahili: Bwana anatawala, amejivika utukufu; Bwana amejivika utukufu tena amejivika nguvu. Dunia imewekwa imara, haitaondoshwa.

english: Your throne was established long ago; You are from all eternity.
ekegusii: Ekerogo kiao ki’obonene nigo kiabekire aroro korwa kare, ekiagera aye nao kwarenge korwa kare.
swahili: Kiti chako cha enzi kimekuwa thabiti tangu zamani; wewe umekuwako tangu milele.

english: The floodwaters have risen, O LORD; the rivers have raised their voice; the seas lift up their pounding waves.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, amaache aimokereire igoro, amaache nkoeera are neriogi, ee, aimokereirie emerindo yaye igoro.
swahili: Bahari zimeinua, Ee Bwana, bahari zimeinua sauti zake; bahari zimeinua sauti za mawimbi yake.

english: Above the roar of many waters— the mighty breakers of the sea— the LORD on high is majestic.
ekegusii: Omonene nere obwate okobua okonene aria igoro; okobua kwaye nigo kobuete okoruma kw’amaache, ee, okw’amaache amange na okw’emerindo y’enyancha.
swahili: Yeye ni mkuu kuliko ngurumo ya maji makuu, ni mkuu kuliko mawimbi ya bahari: Bwana aishiye juu sana ni mkuu.

english: Your testimonies are fully confirmed; holiness adorns Your house, O LORD, for all the days to come.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, oborori bwao nigo boteneine bokong’u. Obochenu nabwo bore ogochaberwa kw’enyomba yao goika kare na kare.
swahili: Ee Bwana, sheria zako ni imara; utakatifu umepamba nyumba yako pasipo mwisho.

english: O LORD, God of vengeance, O God of vengeance, shine forth.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene ogoakana egesiomba, aye Nyasae ogoakana egesiomba, oorokia oborabu bwao.
swahili: Ee Bwana, ulipizaye kisasi, Ee Mungu ulipizaye kisasi, uangaze sasa.

english: He who admonishes the nations, does He not discipline? He who teaches man, does He lack knowledge?
ekegusii: Oyo okorongeyia ebisaku, tari korua ebisusuro? Ere nigo akworokereria Mwanyabaanto bamanye obong’aini.
swahili: Je, anayeadhibisha mataifa asiadhibu? Je, awafundishaye wanadamu asiwe na maarifa?

english: The LORD knows the thoughts of man, that they are futile.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo amanyete ebirengererio bia Mwanyabaanto, ng’a nigo bire bosa.
swahili: Bwana anajua mawazo ya mwanadamu; anajua kwamba ni ubatili.

english: Blessed is the man You discipline, O LORD, and teach from Your law,
ekegusii: Nasesenirie omonto oyio aye Omonene okorongeyia na komworokereria amachiiko ao,
swahili: Ee Bwana, heri mtu anayeadhibishwa na wewe, mtu unayemfundisha kwa sheria yako,

english: to grant him relief from days of trouble, until a pit is dug for the wicked.
ekegusii: naende kwamoa ogotimoka ase amatuko ’emechando, goika ekero abakori amabe baraaremerwe chimbeera chiabo.
swahili: unampa utulivu siku za shida, mpaka shimo litakapokuwa limechimbwa kwa ajili ya mwovu.

english: For the LORD will not forsake His people; He will never abandon His heritage.
ekegusii: Omonene tagotuguta abanto baye, takonyara gotiga abwo bare omwado oye.
swahili: Kwa kuwa Bwana hatawakataa watu wake, hatauacha urithi wake.

english: Surely judgment will again be righteous, and all the upright in heart will follow it.
ekegusii: Ebiina mbinachwe ase oboronge naende, na abanto bonsi bare ne chinkoro chindonge mbabobwatie.
swahili: Hukumu itasimamishwa tena kwenye haki, wote walio na mioyo minyofu wataifuata.

english: Who will rise up for me against the wicked? Who will stand for me against the workers of iniquity?
ekegusii: Ning’o oratenene andwanerie abakori amabe? Ning’o oratenene ankonye korwa ase abakori ebibe?
swahili: Ni nani atakayeinuka dhidi ya mwovu kwa ajili yangu? Ni nani atakayenikinga dhidi ya watenda maovu?

english: Unless the LORD had been my helper, I would soon have dwelt in the abode of silence.
ekegusii: Onye Omonene atankonyete, omoyo one nigo orenge gocha kobeera ase obokiriru bw’amakweri bwango.
swahili: Kama Bwana asingelinisaidia upesi, ningelikuwa ninaishi katika ukimya wa kifo.

english: If I say, “My foot is slipping,” Your loving devotion, O LORD, supports me.
ekegusii: Ekero naroche ng’a natererigwe, aye Omonene, obwanchani bwao bwa botambe nigo bwansiirete tinagwa.
swahili: Niliposema, “Mguu wangu unateleza,” Ee Bwana, upendo wako ulinishikilia.

english: When anxiety overwhelms me, Your consolation delights my soul.
ekegusii: Ekero enkoro yane ere nogwechanda okonge, okoremia kwao okonge nigo gokogokia omoyo one.
swahili: Wakati wasiwasi ulipokuwa mwingi ndani yangu, faraja yako ilinipa furaha nafsini mwangu.

english: Rise up, O Judge of the earth; render a reward to the proud.
ekegusii: Aye omonachi ebiina bw’ense, imoka oe abanto abaenenu eng’eria koreng’ana buna ogokora kwabo kore!
swahili: Ee Mhukumu wa dunia, inuka, uwalipize wenye kiburi kama wanavyostahili.

english: Can a corrupt throne be Your ally— one devising mischief by decree?
ekegusii: Inee! Abanto b’ekegambero egekorekanu mbabwatane naye? Abwo nigo bakorenta obokong’u ase okoonchorana amachiiko.
swahili: Je, kiti cha utawala wa udhalimu kitajiunga nawe, ule utawala uletao taabu kutokana na sheria zake?

english: They band together against the righteous and condemn the innocent to death.
ekegusii: Nigo bakoumokera amo omoyo bw’oyore omonyaboronge, banachera oyotari nokomocha ekiina ki’ogokwa.
swahili: Huungana kuwashambulia wenye haki, kuwahukumu kufa wasio na hatia.

english: But the LORD has been my stronghold, and my God is my rock of refuge.
ekegusii: Korende Omonene obeire egekengero kiane egekong’u, ee, Nyasae one negetare ngotamera.
swahili: Lakini Bwana amekuwa ngome yangu, na Mungu wangu amekuwa mwamba ninaoukimbilia.

english: He will bring upon them their own iniquity and destroy them for their wickedness. The LORD our God will destroy them.
ekegusii: Ere nabae egesusuro ase engencho y’ebibe biabo, na abasirie ase engencho y’ogosaria kwabo; ee, Omonene, Nyasae oito, nabasirie kegima.
swahili: Yeye atawalipa kwa ajili ya dhambi zao na atawaangamiza kwa ajili ya maovu yao; Bwana Mungu wetu atawaangamiza.

english: How long will the wicked, O LORD, how long will the wicked exult?
ekegusii: Omonene, ngoika ririri abanyabibe baragenderere gwetogia? Ngoika ririri?
swahili: Hata lini, waovu, Ee Bwana, hata lini waovu watashangilia?

english: They pour out arrogant words; all workers of iniquity boast.
ekegusii: Abakori amabe bonsi nigo bagwetogia, nigo bagokwana‐kwana amang’ana amabe.
swahili: Wanamimina maneno ya kiburi, watenda mabaya wote wamejaa majivuno.

english: They crush Your people, O LORD; they oppress Your heritage.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, abwo nigo bagosamunyorana abanto bao, na gochanda abanto bare omwando oo.
swahili: Ee Bwana, wanawaponda watu wako, wanawaonea urithi wako.

english: They kill the widow and the foreigner; they murder the fatherless.
ekegusii: Nigo bagoita ababoraka na abamenyi, ne chintakana nigo bagochiita;
swahili: Wanamchinja mjane na mgeni, na kuwaua yatima.

english: They say, “The LORD does not see; the God of Jacob pays no heed.”
ekegusii: erio bateba, “Omonene tari korora amang’ana ayio, Nyasae o Yakobo tari komanya ayio.”
swahili: Nao husema, “ Bwana haoni, Mungu wa Yakobo hafahamu.”

english: Take notice, O senseless among the people! O fools, when will you be wise?
ekegusii: Inwe abamotamanyeti gento, kabe nokomanya! Inwe abariri, ndiriri morabe abang’aini?
swahili: Sikizeni, enyi wajinga miongoni mwa watu; enyi wapumbavu, lini mtakuwa na hekima?

english: He who affixed the ear, can He not hear? He who formed the eye, can He not see?
ekegusii: Inee! Oyo otongete amato, tari koigwa? Ere oyo otongete amaiso, tari korora?
swahili: Je, aliyeweka sikio asisikie? Aliyeumba jicho asione?

english: Come, let us sing for joy to the LORD; let us shout to the Rock of our salvation!
ekegusii: Inchuo, tomoterere Omonene Nyasae nomogooko, inchwo, tomochengere oyore egetare ki’ogotooreka gwaito!
swahili: Njooni, tumwimbie Bwana kwa furaha; tumfanyie kelele za shangwe Mwamba wa wokovu wetu.

english: For forty years I was angry with that generation, and I said, “They are a people whose hearts go astray, and they have not known My ways.”
ekegusii: Ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ene, nigo nagechetigwe nekiaare keria, ngateba, “Abanto aba nabasareku ase chinkoro chiabo ime, tibaraareti chinchera chiane.”
swahili: Kwa miaka arobaini nilikasirikia kizazi kile, nikasema, “Hawa ni taifa ambalo mioyo yao imepotoka, nao hawajazijua njia zangu.”

english: So I swore on oath in My anger, “They shall never enter My rest.”
ekegusii: Ase ayio ngatiana ase endamwamu yane ng’a tibagosoa ase ogotimoka kwane.
swahili: Hivyo nikatangaza kwa kiapo katika hasira yangu, “Kamwe hawataingia rahani mwangu.”

english: Let us enter His presence with thanksgiving; let us make a joyful noise to Him in song.
ekegusii: Inchuo, togende ase obosio bwaye ase okomoakera ng’a mbuya mono, tomochengere namatera ay’ogotogia!
swahili: Tuje mbele zake kwa shukrani, tumtukuze kwa vinanda na nyimbo.

english: For the LORD is a great God, a great King above all gods.
ekegusii: Naki Omonene nere Nyasae ore omonene, nere Omorwoti omonene obuete chinyasae chionsi.
swahili: Kwa kuwa Bwana ni Mungu mkuu, mfalme mkuu juu ya miungu yote.

english: In His hand are the depths of the earth, and the mountain peaks belong to Him.
ekegusii: Ere nigo abwatete amakura ’ense ase okoboko kwaye, naboigo nebitunwa ebitambe bire ebiaye.
swahili: Mkononi mwake mna vilindi vya dunia, na vilele vya milima ni mali yake.

english: The sea is His, for He made it, and His hands formed the dry land.
ekegusii: Enyancha neyaye, ekiagera nere oyetongete, okoboko kwaye nakwo kwabombete ense enyomo.
swahili: Bahari ni yake, kwani ndiye aliifanya, na mikono yake iliumba nchi kavu.

english: O come, let us worship and bow down; let us kneel before the LORD our Maker.
ekegusii: Inchuo, twekumbe ase obosio bw’Omonene, totung’ame asare, ekiagera nere ototongete.
swahili: Njooni, tusujudu, tumwabudu, tupige magoti mbele za Bwana Muumba wetu,

english: For He is our God, and we are the people of His pasture, the sheep under His care. Today, if you hear His voice,
ekegusii: Ere nere Nyasae oito, na intwe nigo tore abanto b’oborisia bwaye, nigo tore ching’ondi chire ase oborendi bwaye. Naki yare koba buya onye rituko ria reero mwategerera eriogi riaye!
swahili: kwa maana yeye ndiye Mungu wetu, na sisi ni watu wa malisho yake, kondoo chini ya utunzaji wake. Kama mkiisikia sauti yake leo,

english: do not harden your hearts as you did at Meribah, in the day at Massah in the wilderness,
ekegusii: Timokong’ia chinkoro chiaino, buna abakoro bakorete aaria Meriba; na buna bakorete ase rituko riria aaria Masa agwo ase erooro.
swahili: msiifanye mioyo yenu migumu kama mlivyofanya kule Meriba, kama mlivyofanya siku ile kule Masa jangwani,

english: where your fathers tested and tried Me, though they had seen My work.
ekegusii: Aaria chisokoro chiaino nigo chianteemete, nonya chiaroche emeremo yane nigo chiandengete.
swahili: ambapo baba zenu walinijaribu na kunipima, ingawa walikuwa wameyaona matendo yangu.

english: Sing to the LORD a new song; sing to the LORD, all the earth.
ekegusii: Moterere Omonene ogoteera okoyia, aye ense yonsi, moterere Omonene!
swahili: Mwimbieni Bwana wimbo mpya; mwimbieni Bwana dunia yote.

english: Declare among the nations: “The LORD reigns!” The world is firmly established; it cannot be moved; He will judge the peoples with equity.
ekegusii: Teebia abanto bonsi b’ebisaku, “Omonene nere okogamba. Ense nigo eteneine bokong’u, tekonyegerigwa. Omonene nanachere abanto ekiina atari gwanchereria.”
swahili: Katikati ya mataifa semeni, “ Bwana anatawala.” Ulimwengu ameuweka imara, hauwezi kusogezwa; atawahukumu watu kwa uadilifu.

english: Let the heavens be glad and the earth rejoice; let the sea resound, and all that fills it.
ekegusii: Tiga igoro chibe nomogooko, tiga enyancha echenge ase okoeera, amo na bionsi ebire ime yaye!
swahili: Mbingu na zishangilie, nchi na ifurahi; bahari na ivume, na vyote vilivyomo ndani yake;

english: Let the fields exult, and all that is in them. Then all the trees of the forest will sing for joy
ekegusii: Emegondo echenge amo n’ebinto bionsi bire ime yabo! Erio emete yonsi ye rinani netere nomogooko,
swahili: mashamba na yashangilie, pamoja na vyote vilivyomo ndani yake. Kisha miti yote ya msituni itaimba kwa furaha;

english: before the LORD, for He is coming— He is coming to judge the earth. He will judge the world in righteousness and the peoples in His faithfulness.
ekegusii: ase obosio bw’Omonene, ekiagera ngocha are, ee, ngocha are konachera ense ekiina. Nigo aranachere ense ekiina ase oboronge, na anachere abanto ekiina ase obwegenwa.
swahili: itaimba mbele za Bwana kwa maana anakuja, anakuja kuihukumu dunia. Ataihukumu dunia kwa haki, na mataifa katika kweli yake.

english: Sing to the LORD, bless His name; proclaim His salvation day after day.
ekegusii: Moterere Omonene, motogie erieta riaye, mobe mokoraria ogotooreka kwaye rituko ase rituko.
swahili: Mwimbieni Bwana, lisifuni jina lake; tangazeni wokovu wake siku baada ya siku.

english: For great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised; He is to be feared above all gods.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo are omonene mono, goika atogigwe, goika airokwe goetania chinyasae chinde.
swahili: Kwa kuwa Bwana ni mkuu mwenye kustahili kusifiwa kuliko wote; yeye ni wa kuogopwa kuliko miungu yote.

english: Splendor and majesty are before Him; strength and beauty fill His sanctuary.
ekegusii: Ogosikwa na obonene nigo bire ase obosio bwaye, chinguru na oboseera nigo bire ase obomenyo bwaye obochenu.
swahili: Fahari na enzi viko mbele yake; nguvu na utukufu vimo patakatifu pake.

english: Ascribe to the LORD, O families of the nations, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.
ekegusii: Inwe abe chiamate chi’abaanto, togia Omonene! Motogie ase obonene bwaye na okobua kwaye.
swahili: Mpeni Bwana, enyi jamaa za mataifa, mpeni Bwana utukufu na nguvu.

english: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due His name; bring an offering and enter His courts.
ekegusii: Mobake Omonene ase obonene bw’erieta riaye, moche ase chigoora chiaye, morentane ebiegwa.
swahili: Mpeni Bwana utukufu unaostahili jina lake; leteni sadaka na mje katika nyua zake.

english: Worship the LORD in the splendor of His holiness; tremble before Him, all the earth.
ekegusii: Mosasime Omonene mweboetie obochenu! Inwe abanto b’ense yonsi, mobe mokoiguswa ase obosio bwaye.
swahili: Mwabuduni Bwana katika uzuri wa utakatifu wake; dunia yote na itetemeke mbele zake.

english: The LORD reigns, let the earth rejoice; let the distant shores be glad.
ekegusii: Omonene nere omorwoti. Aye ense, goka! Na inwe ebisinka ebinge, chenga!
swahili: Bwana anatawala, nchi na ifurahi, visiwa vyote vishangilie.

english: Hate evil, O you who love the LORD! He preserves the souls of His saints; He delivers them from the hand of the wicked.
ekegusii: Inwe abamwanchete Omonene, gecha obobe! Ere nigo akorenda emioyo y’abachenu baye; nigo akobatooria korwa ase amaboko ’abakori amabe.
swahili: Wale wanaompenda Bwana na wauchukie uovu, kwa maana yeye hulinda maisha ya waaminifu wake na kuwaokoa kutoka mkononi mwa mwovu.

english: Light shines on the righteous, gladness on the upright in heart.
ekegusii: Oborabu nigo bokomocheera oyore omooronge, na omogooko obachera abare ne chinkoro chindonge.
swahili: Nuru huangaza wenye haki na furaha kwa watu wanyofu wa moyo.

english: Rejoice in the LORD, you righteous ones, and praise His holy name.
ekegusii: Inwe mwensi abamore abaronge, goka ase Nyasae, moake ng’a mbuya mono ase erieta riaye richenu.
swahili: Furahini katika Bwana, ninyi mlio wenye haki, lisifuni jina lake takatifu.

english: Clouds and darkness surround Him; righteousness and justice are His throne’s foundation.
ekegusii: Amare na omosunte ekerima nigo bimoetanaine; oboronge na ekeene nabio bire oboroso bw’ekerogo kiaye ki’obonene.
swahili: Mawingu na giza nene vinamzunguka, haki na hukumu ndio msingi wa kiti chake cha enzi.

english: Fire goes before Him and consumes His foes on every side.
ekegusii: Omorero nigo otang’aine bosio bwaye, oro nigo ogosamba ababisa baye abwo bamoetanaine.
swahili: Moto hutangulia mbele zake na huteketeza adui zake pande zote.

english: His lightning illuminates the world; the earth sees and trembles.
ekegusii: Okomesa kwaye gwe chinkoba nigo gokomoreka ense eye; ense nigo ekorora okomesa okwo yatengechigwa.
swahili: Umeme wake wa radi humulika dunia, nchi huona na kutetemeka.

english: The mountains melt like wax at the presence of the LORD, before the Lord of all the earth.
ekegusii: Ebitunwa nigo bikonyititoka buna obochoe ase obosio bw’Omonene, ee, ase obosio bw’Omonene bw’ense yonsi.
swahili: Milima huyeyuka kama nta mbele za Bwana, mbele za Bwana wa dunia yote.

english: The heavens proclaim His righteousness; all the peoples see His glory.
ekegusii: Igoro chionsi nigo chikoraria oboronge bwaye, na abanto bonsi barora obonene bwaye.
swahili: Mbingu zinatangaza haki yake, na mataifa yote huona utukufu wake.

english: All worshipers of images are put to shame— those who boast in idols. Worship Him, all you gods!
ekegusii: Abanto bonsi abagosasiima emegwekano nigo bagosookigwa, ee, abwo bagwetogeria emegwekano y’ogosasimwa ere bosa; inwe chinyasae chionsi, tung’ama ase obosio bwaye.
swahili: Wote waabuduo sanamu waaibishwa, wale wajisifiao sanamu: mwabuduni yeye, enyi miungu yote!

english: Zion hears and rejoices, and the towns of Judah exult because of Your judgments, O LORD.
ekegusii: Abanto ba Sayoni nigo bakoigwa ayio bagoka, na ab’emechie ya Yuda bachenga, ekiagera aye Nyasae kwanachire ebiina.
swahili: Sayuni husikia na kushangilia, vijiji vya Yuda vinafurahi kwa sababu ya hukumu zako, Ee Bwana.

english: For You, O LORD, are Most High over all the earth; You are exalted far above all gods.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, naye ore omonene goetania ense yonsi, aye kwaimokererigwe igoro kobua chinyasae chionsi.
swahili: Kwa kuwa wewe, Ee Bwana, ndiwe Uliye Juu Sana kuliko dunia yote; umetukuka sana juu ya miungu yote.

english: Sing to the LORD a new song, for He has done wonders; His right hand and holy arm have gained Him the victory.
ekegusii: Moterere Omonene ogoteera okoyia, ekiagera okorire amang’ana ay’ogokumia; obuire nokoboko kwaye gw’okorio, ee, nokoboko kwaye ogochenu.
swahili: Mwimbieni Bwana wimbo mpya, kwa maana ametenda mambo ya ajabu; kitanga chake cha kuume na mkono wake mtakatifu umemfanyia wokovu.

english: The LORD has proclaimed His salvation and revealed His righteousness to the nations.
ekegusii: Omonene okorire ogotooreka kwaye komanyekane, oorokirie oboronge bwaye ase amasio ’abaanto b’ebisaku;
swahili: Bwana ameufanya wokovu wake ujulikane na amedhihirisha haki yake kwa mataifa.

english: He has remembered His love and faithfulness to the house of Israel; all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.
ekegusii: oinyoire obwanchani bwaye bogendererete botambe, na obwegenwa bwaye, obwo aorogetie ase Abaisraeli. Chinsinyo chionsi chi’ense chiarorire ogotooreka kwa Nyasae oito.
swahili: Ameukumbuka upendo wake na uaminifu wake kwa nyumba ya Israeli; miisho yote ya dunia imeuona wokovu wa Mungu wetu.

english: Make a joyful noise to the LORD, all the earth; break forth—let your cry ring out, and sing praises!
ekegusii: Aye ense yonsi, aka eriogi ri’omogooko ase Omonene, tera ogoteera kw’omogooko na motogie ase amariogi amanene.
swahili: Mpigieni Bwana kelele za shangwe, dunia yote, ipaze sauti kwa nyimbo za shangwe na vinanda;

english: Sing praises to the LORD with the lyre, in melodious song with the harp.
ekegusii: Terera Omonene ase okobugia amakano, ee, ase okobugia amakano tera namariogi amaya.
swahili: mwimbieni Bwana kwa kinubi, kwa kinubi na sauti za kuimba,

english: With trumpets and the blast of the ram’s horn shout for joy before the LORD, the King.
ekegusii: Moake amariogi ’omogooko ase Omonene ore omorwoti ase okobugia ebirombeta na ebitureeri.
swahili: kwa tarumbeta na mvumo wa baragumu za pembe za kondoo dume: shangilieni kwa furaha mbele za Bwana, aliye Mfalme.

english: Let the sea resound, and all that fills it, the world, and all who dwell in it.
ekegusii: Tiga enyancha ebe ekoruma amo n’ebinto bionsi bire ime yaye, boigo nense na abanto bonsi bamenyeteo.
swahili: Bahari na ivume na kila kiliomo ndani yake, dunia na wote wakaao ndani yake.

english: Let the rivers clap their hands, let the mountains sing together for joy
ekegusii: Chindooche tiga chiake chinkobi, na ebitunwa tiga bitere nomogooko amo,
swahili: Mito na ipige makofi, milima na iimbe pamoja kwa furaha,

english: before the LORD, for He comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness and the peoples with equity.
ekegusii: ase obosio bw’Omonene, ekiagera ngocha are konachera ense ekiina. Ere nanachere ense ekiina ase oboronge, na abanto nabanachere ekiina atari gwanchereria.
swahili: vyote na viimbe mbele za Bwana, kwa maana yuaja kuhukumu dunia. Atahukumu dunia kwa haki na mataifa kwa haki.

english: The LORD reigns; let the nations tremble! He is enthroned above the cherubim; let the earth quake!
ekegusii: Omonene nere okogamba! Ase ayio, abanto b’ebisaku nigo bakoiguswa. Omonene nigo amenyete nobonene bwaye igoro y’ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba, na ense nigo egotengechigwa.
swahili: Bwana anatawala, mataifa na yatetemeke; anakalia kiti cha enzi katikati ya makerubi, dunia na itikisike.

english: Great is the LORD in Zion; He is exalted above all the peoples.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo are omonene ase Sayoni, oimokererigwe igoro kobua abanto b’ebisaku bionsi.
swahili: Bwana ni mkuu katika Sayuni; ametukuzwa juu ya mataifa yote.

english: Let them praise Your great and awesome name— He is holy!
ekegusii: Abanto bonsi tiga batogie erieta riaye rinene na eri’okoirokia. Ere nigo are omochenu.
swahili: Wanalisifu jina lako ambalo ni kuu na la kuogopwa: yeye ni mtakatifu!

english: The mighty King loves justice. You have established equity; You have exercised justice and righteousness in Jacob.
ekegusii: Aye omorwoti ore nokobua, nigo bwanchete ekeene, aye gwakorire oboronge botenene bokong’u, nigo okonacha ebiina bi’ekeene na oboronge ase abanto b’ororeria rwa Yakobo.
swahili: Mfalme ni mwenye nguvu na hupenda haki, wewe umethibitisha adili; katika Yakobo umefanya yaliyo haki na sawa.

english: Exalt the LORD our God, and worship at His footstool; He is holy!
ekegusii: Moimokererie Omonene, Nyasae oito, igoro, mosasime agwo ase egeteni kiaye ki’amagoro! Ere nigo are omochenu.
swahili: Mtukuzeni Bwana Mungu wetu, na mkaabudu katika mahali pa kuwekea miguu yake; yeye ni mtakatifu.

english: Moses and Aaron were among His priests; Samuel was among those who called on His name. They called to the LORD and He answered.
ekegusii: Musa na Aroni nigo barenge abamo b’abakuani b’Omonene, boigo Samweli nigo arenge oyomo bw’abaanto barenge korangeria erieta riaye. Abanto abwo nigo barangeretie Omonene ng’a abakoonye, nere akabaigwa.
swahili: Mose na Aroni walikuwa miongoni mwa makuhani wake, Samweli alikuwa miongoni mwa walioliitia jina lake; walimwita Bwana, naye aliwajibu.

english: He spoke to them from the pillar of cloud; they kept His decrees and the statutes He gave them.
ekegusii: Nigo akwanete nabarabwo, ore ime ase riire. Abanto abwo nigo babwatete oborori bwaye, na amachiiko abaete.
swahili: Alizungumza nao kutoka nguzo ya wingu; walizishika sheria zake na amri alizowapa.

english: O LORD our God, You answered them. You were a forgiving God to them, yet an avenger of their misdeeds.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, Nyasae oito, nigo kwaigwete abanto baria, nigo kwarenge Nyasae, kwarenge kobaabera, nonya naboigo nigo kwarenge kobaa egesusuro ase engencho y’ogokora kwabo okobe.
swahili: Ee Bwana, wetu, ndiwe uliyewajibu, kwa Israeli ulikuwa Mungu mwenye kusamehe, ingawa uliadhibu matendo yao mabaya.

english: Exalt the LORD our God and worship at His holy mountain, for the LORD our God is holy.
ekegusii: Moimokererie Omonene, Nyasae oito, igoro! Inchuo mosasimere ase egetunwa kiaye egechenu, ekiagera Omonene, Nyasae oito, nigo are omochenu.
swahili: Mtukuzeni Bwana Mungu wetu, mwabuduni kwenye mlima wake mtakatifu, kwa maana Bwana Mungu wetu ni mtakatifu.

english: I will give thanks to the LORD with all my heart; I will recount all Your wonders.
ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ningoakere mbuya mono kegima n’enkoro yane yonsi. Nindarie emeremo yao yonsi y’ogokumia.
swahili: Ee Bwana, nitakutukuza kwa moyo wangu wote, nitayasimulia matendo yako yote ya ajabu.

english: Those who know Your name trust in You, for You, O LORD, have not forsaken those who seek You.
ekegusii: Abwo bonsi bamanyete erieta riao, nigo bagosemeretie, ekiagera aye Omonene togotiga abwo bagokorigia.
swahili: Wote wanaolijua jina lako watakutumaini wewe, kwa maana wewe Bwana, hujawaacha kamwe wakutafutao.

english: Sing praises to the LORD, who dwells in Zion; proclaim His deeds among the nations.
ekegusii: Tera amatera ase ogotogia Omonene oyomenyete Sayoni! Teebia ebisaku bionsi buna ogokora kwaye gokumete!
swahili: Mwimbieni Bwana sifa, amefanywa mtawala Sayuni, tangazeni miongoni mwa mataifa, yale aliyoyatenda.

english: For the Avenger of bloodshed remembers; He does not ignore the cry of the afflicted.
ekegusii: Ere oyo okorusia egesiomba ase okomocha kw’ogoitera amanyinga na koinyora abaichanete, Omonene tari kweba ekerero ki’abwo bagokorerwa bobe.
swahili: Kwa maana yeye alipizaye kisasi cha damu hukumbuka, hapuuzi kilio cha wanaoonewa.

english: Be merciful to me, O LORD; see how my enemies afflict me! Lift me up from the gates of death,
ekegusii: Aye Omonene ndorere amaabera! Rora emechando eye abanto bangechete bakondetera. Aye kwandusirie korwa ase ebiita bi’amakweri,
swahili: Ee Bwana, tazama jinsi walivyo wengi adui zangu wanaonitesa! Nihurumie, uniinue kutoka malango ya mauti,

english: that I may declare all Your praises— that within the gates of Daughter Zion I may rejoice in Your salvation.
ekegusii: erinde intenene ase abanto ba Sayoni, ase ebiita biabo nimbatebie amang’ana onsi agerire nkogotogia; ningokere ogotooreka kwao.
swahili: ili niweze kutangaza sifa zako katika malango ya Binti Sayuni na huko niushangilie wokovu wako.

english: The nations have fallen into a pit of their making; their feet are caught in the net they have hidden.
ekegusii: Abanto b’ebisaku bagure ase eirima bakunyete, na ase oboreba babisete bombwate, babwatirwe barabwo abanyene.
swahili: Mataifa wameanguka kwenye shimo walilolichimba, miguu yao imenaswa kwenye wavu waliouficha.

english: The LORD is known by the justice He brings; the wicked are ensnared by the work of their hands. Higgaion Selah
ekegusii: Omonene bwemanyekanirie ase okonacha ebiina bia boronge; abakori amabe babwatirwe ase ogokora kwabo abanyene.
swahili: Bwana anajulikana kwa haki yake, waovu wamenaswa katika kazi za mikono yao.

english: The wicked will return to Sheol— all the nations who forget God.
ekegusii: Abakori amabe nigo bakogenda gochia aase abakuure, naboigo gochia ase nabaanto bonsi b’ebisaku abwo bebire Nyasae.
swahili: Waovu wataishia kuzimu, naam, mataifa yote wanaomsahau Mungu.

english: For the needy will not always be forgotten; nor the hope of the oppressed forever dashed.
ekegusii: Abanto abaremerwa tibakwebwa kogenderera botambe, na ogosemeria kw’abagokorerwa bobe tikogosira nonya ng’ake.
swahili: Lakini mhitaji hatasahaulika siku zote, wala matumaini ya walioonewa hayatapotea.

english: Rise up, O LORD, do not let man prevail; let the nations be judged in Your presence.
ekegusii: Omonene, gaki ’nchuo! Totiga abanto babue, tiga abanto b’Ebisaku banacherwe ekiina ase obosio bwao.
swahili: Ee Bwana, inuka, usimwache binadamu ashinde. Mataifa na yahukumiwe mbele zako.

english: I will be glad and rejoice in You; I will sing praise to Your name, O Most High.
ekegusii: Ningoke na gochenga mono kegima ase engencho yao, nintere na gotogia erieta riao, aye Omonene Ore Igoro Mono Kegima.
swahili: Nitafurahi na kushangilia ndani yako. Nitaliimbia sifa jina lako, Ewe Uliye Juu Sana.

english: Lay terror upon them, O LORD; let the nations know they are but men. Selah
ekegusii: Omonene, obaondokie! Tiga bamanye ng’a barabwo botaambe nigo bare Mwanyabaanto.
swahili: Ee Bwana, wapige kwa hofu, mataifa na yajue kuwa wao ni watu tu.

english: When my enemies retreat, they stumble and perish before You.
ekegusii: Ekero ababisa baane bakoirana magega, bagwe inse na gosirigwa bosio bwao.
swahili: Adui zangu wamerudi nyuma, wamejikwaa na kuangamia mbele zako.

english: For You have upheld my just cause; You sit on Your throne judging righteously.
ekegusii: Aye nigo okonacha ekiina kiane ase oboronge; noikaransete ase ekerogo kiao ki’obonene kore omonachi ebiina omooronge.
swahili: Kwa maana umetetea haki yangu na msimamo wangu; umeketi kwenye kiti chako cha enzi, ukihukumu kwa haki.

english: You have rebuked the nations; You have destroyed the wicked; You have erased their name forever and ever.
ekegusii: Aye gwatogonyeire abanto b’ebisaku na gosiria abakori amabe, gwasiririe amarieta abo kegima, tibakoinyorwa goika kare na kare.
swahili: Umekemea mataifa na kuwaangamiza waovu; umeyafuta majina yao milele na milele.

english: The enemy has come to eternal ruin, and You have uprooted their cities; the very memory of them has vanished.
ekegusii: Ababisa baerire, basirigwe kegima, gwatagoire emechie yabo, barabwo bebirwe, tibakoinyorwa nonya ng’ake.
swahili: Uharibifu usiokoma umempata adui, umeingʼoa miji yao; hata kumbukumbu lao limetoweka.

english: But the LORD abides forever; He has established His throne for judgment.
ekegusii: Korende Omonene nigo are omorwoti o kare na kare, obekire ang’e ekerogo kiaye ki’obonene, erinde anache ekiina.
swahili: Bwana anatawala milele, ameweka kiti chake cha enzi apate kuhukumu.

english: He judges the world with justice; He governs the people with equity.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo aragambie ense ase oboronge na konachera abanto ekiina gi’ekeene atari gwanchereria.
swahili: Mungu atahukumu ulimwengu kwa haki, atatawala mataifa kwa haki.

english: The LORD is a refuge for the oppressed, a stronghold in times of trouble.
ekegusii: Omonene nigo are obotamero ase abwo bagokorerwa bobe, nere obotamero ase chingaki chi’emechando.
swahili: Bwana ni kimbilio la watu wanaoonewa, ni ngome imara wakati wa shida.

english: Then I saw another mighty angel coming down from heaven, wrapped in a cloud, with a rainbow above his head. His face was like the sun, and his legs were like pillars of fire.
ekegusii: Erio nkarora omomalaika onde bw’echinguru ogoika korwa igoro oboirie riire. Nigo arenge nomokubinyongo bw’embura oetanaine omotwe oye, na obosio bwaye nigo bwarenge buna erioba, na amagoro aye buna chisiiro chi’omorero.
swahili: Kisha nikamwona malaika mwingine mwenye nguvu akishuka kutoka mbinguni. Alikuwa amevikwa wingu na upinde wa mvua juu ya kichwa chake. Uso wake ulingʼaa kama jua na miguu yake ilikuwa kama nguzo za moto.

english: So I took the small scroll from the angel’s hand and ate it; and it was as sweet as honey in my mouth, but when I had eaten it, my stomach turned bitter.
ekegusii: Nkabogoria egetabu eria enke korwa ase okoboko kw’omomalaika oria, nkayeria. Ase omonwa one ekaba enyansu buna obooke, korende ase enda yane ekambekera obororo.
swahili: Hivyo nikakichukua kile kitabu kidogo kutoka mkononi mwa yule malaika nikakila. Kilikuwa kitamu kama asali kinywani mwangu, lakini baada ya kukila, tumbo langu likatiwa uchungu.

english: And they told me, “You must prophesy again about many peoples and nations and tongues and kings.”
ekegusii: Erio aganteebia, “Nekogwenerete obaane naende igoro ase abanto, na ebisaku, na emenwa, na abarwoti abange.”
swahili: Kisha nikaambiwa, “Imekupasa kutoa unabii tena kuhusu makabila mengi, mataifa, lugha na wafalme.”

english: He held in his hand a small scroll, which lay open. He placed his right foot on the sea and his left foot on the land.
ekegusii: Narenge na egetabu egeke kiaigoire ase okoboko kwaye. Akabeka okogoro kwaye gw’okorio igoro ase enyancha na ogw’okobee igoro ase ense enyomo,
swahili: Mkononi mwake alikuwa ameshika kijitabu kilichokuwa kimefunguliwa. Akauweka mguu wake wa kuume juu ya bahari na mguu wake wa kushoto akauweka juu ya nchi kavu.

english: Then he cried out in a loud voice like the roar of a lion. And when he cried out, the seven thunders sounded their voices.
ekegusii: na akarera neriogi rinene ringa buna eri’endo ekoruma. Ekero achia korera chinkoba isano na ibere chigakwana neriogi riabo.
swahili: Naye akapiga kelele kwa sauti kuu kama simba anayenguruma. Alipopiga kelele, zile radi saba zikatoa ngurumo zake.

english: When the seven thunders had spoken, I was about to put it in writing. But I heard a voice from heaven saying, “Seal up what the seven thunders have said, and do not write it down.”
ekegusii: Ekero chinkoba echio isano na ibere chiare goaka eriogi nkaba ang’e korika. Erio nkaigwa eriogi rikorwa igoro rigoteeba, “Mumeka amang’ana ayio atebwa ne chinkoba chiria isano na ibere, oyabeeke ekemanyerio, toyariika.”
swahili: Nazo zile radi saba zilipotoa ngurumo, nilitaka kuanza kuandika, lakini nikasikia sauti kutoka mbinguni ikisema, “Yatie muhuri hayo yaliyosemwa na hizo radi saba na usiyaandike.”

english: Then the angel I had seen standing on the sea and on the land lifted up his right hand to heaven.
ekegusii: Na omomalaika oria naroche oteneine ase enyancha na ase ense enyomo akaimokereria okoboko kwaye gw’okorio igoro,
swahili: Kisha yule malaika niliyekuwa nimemwona akiwa amesimama juu ya bahari na juu ya nchi akainua mkono wake wa kuume kuelekea mbinguni.

english: And he swore by Him who lives forever and ever, who created heaven and everything in it, the earth and everything in it, and the sea and everything in it: “There will be no more delay!
ekegusii: agatiana asere oyore moyo goika kare na kare, oyotongete igoro na ebinto bireo, na ense na ebinto bireo, na enyancha na ebinto bireo, agateeba, “Engaki ende tekoba magega ase aya,
swahili: Naye akaapa kwa Yule aishiye milele na milele, aliyeumba mbingu na vyote vilivyomo, dunia na vyote viijazavyo, pamoja na bahari na vyote vilivyomo ndani yake, akasema, “Hakuna kungoja tena!

english: But in the days of the voice of the seventh angel, when he is about to sound his trumpet, the mystery of God will be fulfilled, just as He proclaimed to His servants the prophets.”
ekegusii: korende ekero omomalaika o gatano na kabere arabugie egetureeri kiaye, obobisi bwa Nyasae naboikeranigwe, buna araareretie abasomba baye ababani.”
swahili: Lakini katika siku zile ambazo huyo malaika wa saba atakapokaribia kuipiga hiyo tarumbeta yake, siri ya Mungu itatimizwa, kama vile alivyowatangazia watumishi wake manabii.”

english: Then the voice that I had heard from heaven spoke to me again, saying, “Go, take the small scroll that lies open in the hand of the angel standing on the sea and on the land.”
ekegusii: Erio eriogi riria naigwete korwa igoro riare gokwana nainche naende, rigateba, “Genda, obogorie egetabu eria eigoire ere ase okoboko kw’omomalaika oria oteneine ase enyancha na ase ense enyomo.”
swahili: Ndipo ile sauti niliyokuwa nimeisikia kutoka mbinguni ikasema nami tena ikaniambia, “Nenda, chukua kile kitabu kilichofunguliwa kilichoko mkononi mwa yule malaika aliyesimama juu ya bahari na juu ya nchi kavu.”

english: And I went to the angel and said, “Give me the small scroll.” “Take it and eat it,” he said. “It will make your stomach bitter, but in your mouth it will be as sweet as honey.”
ekegusii: Nkagenda ase omomalaika oria nkamoteebia, “Ing’a egetabu eyio enke.” Aganteebia, “Yebogorie, oyerie; ero nekobekere obororo ase enda yao, korende ase omonwa oo nebe enyansu buna obooke.”
swahili: Basi nikamwendea nikamwomba yule malaika anipe kile kitabu kidogo. Akaniambia, “Chukua na ukile. Kitakuwa kichungu tumboni mwako, lakini kinywani mwako kitakuwa kitamu kama asali.”

english: Then I was given a measuring rod like a staff and was told, “Go and measure the temple of God and the altar, and count the number of worshipers there.
ekegusii: Inche nkaegwa emoti y’okorenga enga buna enyimbo, ngateebigwa, “Imoka, orenge Hekalu ya Nyasae amo negesasiimero na obare abwo bagosasiimera aroro.
swahili: Ndipo nikapewa mwanzi uliokuwa kama ufito wa kupimia, nikaambiwa, “Nenda ukapime hekalu la Mungu pamoja na madhabahu, nawe uwahesabu wale waabuduo humo.

english: And those who dwell on the earth will gloat over them, and will celebrate and send one another gifts, because these two prophets had tormented them.
ekegusii: Na abwo bamenyete ase ense nabachenge igoro ase bare na kogoka, na barabwo nabatomerane ebiegwa, ekiagera ababani baria babere bachandete abwo bamenyete ase ense.
swahili: Watu waishio duniani watazitazama kwa furaha maiti za hao manabii wawili na kushangilia kwa kupeana zawadi kwa sababu hao manabii waliwatesa watu waishio duniani.

english: But after the three and a half days, the breath of life from God entered the two witnesses, and they stood on their feet, and great fear fell upon those who saw them.
ekegusii: Korende magega y’amatuko atato na ekeng’ese omoika bw’obogima korwa ase Nyasae okabasoa, bagatenena namagoro abo, na obwoba bogasoa abanto baria baabaroche.
swahili: Lakini baada ya zile siku tatu na nusu, pumzi ya uhai kutoka kwa Mungu ikawaingia, nao wakasimama kwa miguu yao na wote waliowaona wakaingiwa na hofu kuu.

english: And the witnesses heard a loud voice from heaven saying, “Come up here.” And they went up to heaven in a cloud as their enemies watched them.
ekegusii: Abaabani baria babere bakaigwa eriogi rinene korwa igoro rikobateebia, “Tiira gocha aa!” Bagatiira gochia igoro ase amare ime, na ababisa babo baabarigereretie.
swahili: Kisha wale manabii wawili wakasikia sauti kuu kutoka mbinguni ikiwaambia, “Njooni huku juu!” Nao wakapaa mbinguni katika wingu, wakati adui zao wakiwa wanawatazama.

english: And in that hour there was a great earthquake, and a tenth of the city collapsed. Seven thousand were killed in the quake, and the rest were terrified and gave glory to the God of heaven.
ekegusii: Na ase ensa eria ekaba omotengecho omonene bw’ense, na ensemo ya ikomi y’omochie ekagwa. Abanto chilifu isano na ibere bagaitwa ase omotengecho oria, na abwo batigarete bagasogwa nomoondoko, bagatogia obonene bwa Nyasae ore igoro.
swahili: Saa iyo hiyo, kukatokea tetemeko kubwa la nchi na sehemu ya kumi ya mji ikaanguka. Watu elfu saba wakauawa katika tetemeko hilo, nao walionusurika wakaogopa sana, wakamtukuza Mungu wa mbinguni.

english: The second woe has passed. Behold, the third woe is coming shortly. The Seventh Trumpet
ekegusii: Obobe bwa kabere bwaetire, rora, obobe bwa gatato ngocha bore bwango. Egetureri kia gatano na kabere
swahili: Ole ya pili imekwisha kupita, tazama ole ya tatu inakuja upesi. Tarumbeta Ya Saba

english: Then the seventh angel sounded his trumpet, and loud voices called out in heaven: “The kingdom of the world has become the kingdom of our Lord and of His Christ, and He will reign forever and ever.”
ekegusii: Omomalaika o gatano na kabere akabugia egetureeri kiaye. Erio amariogi amanene akaigugwa igoro, agoteeba, “Oborwoti bw’ense bwabeire oborwoti bw’Omonene oito, na obwa Kristo oye, ere nagambe goika kare na kare.”
swahili: Yule malaika wa saba akaipiga tarumbeta yake, pakawa na sauti kubwa mbinguni iliyosema: “Ufalme wa ulimwengu umekuwa ufalme wa Bwana wetu na wa Kristo wake, naye atatawala milele na milele.”

english: And the twenty-four elders who sit on their thrones before God fell on their faces and worshiped God,
ekegusii: Na abagaaka baria emerongo ebere na baane, abaikaransete ase obosio bwa Nyasae ase ebirogo biabo bi’obonene, bagatung’ama, bagasasiima Nyasae,
swahili: Nao wale wazee ishirini na wanne, waliokuwa wameketi mbele za Mungu, kwenye viti vyao vya enzi, wakaanguka kifudifudi, wakamwabudu Mungu,

english: saying: “We give thanks to You, O Lord God Almighty, the One who is and who was, because You have taken Your great power and have begun to reign.
ekegusii: bagoteeba, “Aye Omonene Nyasae Omobui, oyoreo na oyokwarengeo, twagoakeire ng’a mbuya mono, ekiagera kwabogoirie okobua kwao okonene, na gwachakire kogamba.
swahili: wakisema: “Tunakushukuru, Bwana Mungu Mwenyezi, uliyeko na uliyekuwako, kwa kuwa umetwaa uweza wako mkuu na ukaanza kutawala.

english: The nations were enraged, and Your wrath has come. The time has come to judge the dead and to reward Your servants the prophets, as well as the saints and those who fear Your name, both small and great— and to destroy those who destroy the earth.”
ekegusii: Abanto b’ebisaku bakabea, korende bono endamwamu yao yachire, na engaki y’okogambia abakuure, na engaki y’okoa abasomba bao ababani, na abachenu, na abwo bairogete erieta riao, abake na abanene, eng’eria yabo, na gosiria abwo bagosaria ense.”
swahili: Mataifa walikasirika nao wakati wa ghadhabu yako umewadia. Wakati umewadia wa kuwahukumu waliokufa na kuwapa thawabu watumishi wako manabii na watakatifu wako pamoja na wale wote wanaoliheshimu Jina lako, wakubwa kwa wadogo: na kuwaangamiza wale wanaoiangamiza dunia.”

english: Then the temple of God in heaven was opened, and the ark of His covenant appeared in His temple. And there were flashes of lightning, and rumblings, and peals of thunder, and an earthquake, and a great hailstorm.
ekegusii: Erio Hekalu ya Nyasae ere igoro ekaigorwa, na Esanduki y’okobwatana kwaye ekarorekana ase Hekalu yaye ime. Aroro bikaba okomesa, na okogukura, ne chinkoba, na omotengecho bw’ense, na embura y’amagena enyinge mono egatwa.
swahili: Ndipo hekalu la Mungu lililoko mbinguni likafunguliwa, na sanduku la agano lake likaonekana humo ndani. Kukatokea mianga ya umeme wa radi, ngurumo, sauti za radi, tetemeko la nchi na mvua kubwa ya mawe.

english: But exclude the courtyard outside the temple. Do not measure it, because it has been given over to the nations, and they will trample the holy city for 42 months.
ekegusii: Na egoora eria ere isiko ye Hekalu oyetige, toyerenga, ekiagera abanto b’ebisaku bayeeirwe, na barabwo nabatache omochie omochenu ase engaki y’emetienyi emerongo ene na ebere.
swahili: Lakini usiupime ua wa nje wa Hekalu, uache, kwa sababu ua huo wamepewa watu wa Mataifa. Hao wataukanyagakanyaga mji mtakatifu kwa muda wa miezi arobaini na miwili.

english: And I will empower my two witnesses, and they will prophesy for 1,260 days, clothed in sackcloth.”
ekegusii: Inche ning’ee birori baane babere okobua gw’okobana, na barabwo inababane ase engaki y’amatuko elifu eyemo na amagana abere, na emerongo etano nomo, babeekeire chianga chi’echigunia.”
swahili: Nami nitawapa mashahidi wangu wawili uwezo, nao watoe unabii kwa muda wa siku 1,260, wakiwa wamevaa nguo za gunia.”

english: These witnesses are the two olive trees and the two lampstands that stand before the Lord of the earth.
ekegusii: Abwo nabwo emete eria ebere y’emezeituni na ebibekerero biria bie chitaaya bibere biteneine ase obosio bw’Omonene bw’ense.
swahili: Hawa ndio ile mizeituni miwili na vile vinara viwili vya taa visimamavyo mbele za Bwana Mungu wa dunia yote.

english: If anyone wants to harm them, fire proceeds from their mouths and devours their enemies. In this way, anyone who wants to harm them must be killed.
ekegusii: Na omonto kararigie kobachanda, omorero norue ase emenwa yabo, orie ababisa babo. Omonto kararigie kobachanda, nemogwenerete aitwe.
swahili: Kama mtu yeyote akitaka kuwadhuru, moto hutoka vinywani mwao na kuwateketeza adui zao. Hivi ndivyo impasavyo kufa mtu yeyote atakayetaka kuwadhuru.

english: These witnesses have power to shut the sky so that no rain will fall during the days of their prophecy, and power to turn the waters into blood and to strike the earth with every kind of plague as often as they wish. The Witnesses Killed and Raised
ekegusii: Barabwo nigo bare nokobua gosieka igoro, erinde embura tetwa amatuko ’obobani bwabo, naende mbare nokobua gw’okoonchora amaache abe amanyinga, na goaka ense ase kera ogoakwa, koreng’ana buna baganetie.
swahili: Watu hawa wanao uwezo wa kufunga anga ili mvua isinyeshe wakati wote watakapokuwa wanatoa unabii wao. Nao watakuwa na uwezo wa kuyabadili maji kuwa damu na kuipiga dunia kwa kila aina ya mapigo mara kwa mara kama watakavyo.

english: When the two witnesses have finished their testimony, the beast that comes up from the Abyss will wage war with them, and will overpower and kill them.
ekegusii: Ekero bakoorire korua oborori bwabo eng’iti eria ekorwa ase eora y’abakuure nekore esegi na barabwo. Ero nebabue, ebaite bakwe,
swahili: Basi watakapokuwa wamemaliza ushuhuda wao, yule mnyama atokaye katika lile Shimo atapigana nao vita, atawashinda na kuwaua.

english: Their bodies will lie in the street of the great city—figuratively called Sodom and Egypt—where their Lord was also crucified.
ekegusii: na ebitondo ebio nabibeere ase enchera y’omochie oria omonene aase Omonene obo abambetwe. Ase okobayena omochie oyio erieta riaye nigo okorokwa Sodomu na Misiri.
swahili: Maiti zao zitabaki katika barabara ya mji mkubwa, ambao kwa fumbo unaitwa Sodoma na Misri, ambapo pia Bwana wao alisulubiwa.

english: For three and a half days all peoples and tribes and tongues and nations will view their bodies and will not permit them to be laid in a tomb.
ekegusii: Na abanto ba kera egesaku, na eamate, na omonwa, na abe chinse chionsi, nabarigererie ebitondo ebio ase engaki y’amatuko atato na ekeng’ese, na tibakobitiga bitindekwe.
swahili: Kwa muda wa siku tatu na nusu, watu wa kila kabila, jamaa, lugha na taifa wataziangalia hizo maiti zao na hawataruhusu wazikwe.

english: And a great sign appeared in heaven: a woman clothed in the sun, with the moon under her feet and a crown of twelve stars on her head.
ekegusii: Na egekone ekenene gekarorekana igoro: Omokungu oboirie erioba, na omotienyi nigo orenge inse y’amagoro aye. Ase omotwe oye nigo arenge negutwa ye ching’enang’eni ikomi na ibere.
swahili: Kukaonekana ishara kuu mbinguni: Palikuwa na mwanamke aliyevikwa jua, na mwezi ukiwa chini ya miguu yake, na taji ya nyota kumi na mbili ilikuwa kichwani mwake.

english: And I heard a loud voice in heaven saying: “Now have come the salvation and the power and the kingdom of our God, and the authority of His Christ. For the accuser of our brothers has been thrown down— he who accuses them day and night before our God.
ekegusii: Nkaigwa eriogi rinene igoro rigoteeba, “Bono ogotooreka kwa Nyasae oito gwachire amo ne chinguru na oborwoti bwaye, na okobua gwa Kristo oye, ekiagera omosoeri bw’abaminto orutirwe inse, ere oyorenge kobasoera ase obosio bwa Nyasae oito omobaso na obotuko.
swahili: Kisha nikasikia sauti kuu mbinguni, ikisema: “Sasa wokovu na uweza na Ufalme wa Mungu wetu umekuja na mamlaka ya Kristo wake. Kwa kuwa ametupwa chini mshtaki wa ndugu zetu, anayewashtaki mbele za Mungu usiku na mchana.

english: They have conquered him by the blood of the Lamb and by the word of their testimony. And they did not love their lives so as to shy away from death.
ekegusii: Na barabwo bakamobua ase chinguru chi’amanyinga ’Emanwa y’Eng’ondi, na ase amang’ana ’oborori bwabo; tibancha obogima bwabo nonya ngoika ogokwa.
swahili: Nao wakamshinda kwa damu ya Mwana-Kondoo na kwa neno la ushuhuda wao. Wala wao hawakuyapenda maisha yao hata kufa.

english: Therefore rejoice, O heavens, and you who dwell in them! But woe to the earth and the sea; with great fury the devil has come down to you, knowing he has only a short time.” The Woman Persecuted
ekegusii: Ase ayio, aye igoro, chenga, na inwe abamomenyete imeo. Korende obobe nobwaino, ense na enyancha, ekiagera Saitani oikire ase more ore nendamwamu enyinge, ekiagera amanyete ng’a engaki yaye nenke!”
swahili: Kwa hiyo, furahini ninyi mbingu na wote wakaao humo! Lakini ole wenu nchi na bahari, kwa maana huyo ibilisi ameshuka kwenu, akiwa amejaa ghadhabu, kwa sababu anajua ya kuwa muda wake ni mfupi!”

english: And when the dragon saw that he had been thrown to the earth, he pursued the woman who had given birth to the male child.
ekegusii: Na enchoka eria, ekero yachia korora ng’a yatugutirwe ase ense, egatunyana omokungu oria oiborete omwana omoisia.
swahili: Lile joka lilipoona kuwa limetupwa chini duniani, lilimfuatilia yule mwanamke aliyekuwa amezaa mtoto mwanaume.

english: But the woman was given two wings of a great eagle to fly from the presence of the serpent to her place in the wilderness, where she was nourished for a time, and times, and half a time.
ekegusii: Korende omokungu oria akaegwa chimbaaba ibere buna echi’ekeongo enene, anyare koiruruka korwa ase eng’iti eria gochia ase erooro aase agochia korendwa ase engaki y’emiaka etato na ekeng’ese.
swahili: Lakini huyo mwanamke akapewa mabawa mawili ya tai mkubwa, kusudi aweze kuruka mpaka mahali palipotayarishwa kwa ajili yake huko jangwani, ambako atatunzwa kwa wakati na nyakati na nusu, ya wakati ambako yule joka hawezi kufika.

english: Then from the mouth of the serpent spewed water like a river to overtake the woman and sweep her away in the torrent.
ekegusii: Eng’iti eria egasiara amaache korwa ase omonwa oye, anga buna orooche, korwa magega y’omokuungu oria, emoire norooche roria.
swahili: Ndipo lile joka likamwaga maji kama mto kutoka kinywani mwake, ili kumfikia huyo mwanamke na kumkumba kama mafuriko.

english: But the earth helped the woman and opened its mouth to swallow up the river that had poured from the dragon’s mouth.
ekegusii: Korende ense egakoonya omokungu oria, egaasamia omonwa, ekamera orooche roria enchoka yasiarete korwa ase omonwa oye.
swahili: Lakini nchi ikamsaidia huyo mwanamke kwa kufungua kinywa na kuumeza huo mto ambao huyo joka alikuwa ameutoa kinywani mwake.

english: And the dragon was enraged at the woman, and went to make war with the rest of her children, who keep the commandments of God and hold to the testimony of Jesus. And the dragon stood on the shore of the sea.
ekegusii: Ase igo, enchoka eria ekaba nendamwamu ase omokungu oria, ekagenda gokora esegi ase oroiboro rwaye oro rwatigarete, ase abwo babwatete amachiiko a Nyasae, na bare noborori bwa Yeso.
swahili: Kisha lile joka likapatwa na hasira kali kwa ajili ya huyo mwanamke na likaondoka ili kupigana vita na watoto waliosalia wa huyo mwanamke, yaani, wale wanaozitii amri za Mungu na kuushika ushuhuda wa Yesu Kristo. Lile joka likasimama kwenye mchanga wa bahari.

english: She was pregnant and crying out in the pain and agony of giving birth.
ekegusii: Ere nigo arenge morito, akarera nobororo bw’okobina, ekiagera achandegete ase okoibora.
swahili: Alikuwa na mimba naye akilia kwa uchungu kwa kuwa alikuwa anakaribia kuzaa.

english: Then another sign appeared in heaven: a huge red dragon with seven heads, ten horns, and seven royal crowns on his heads.
ekegusii: Egekone kende gekarorekana igoro: Enchoka enene embariri eyarenge nemetwe etano na ebere ne ching’unchara ikomi, na igoro ase emetwe yaye nigo yarenge ne chigutwa isano na ibere.
swahili: Kisha ishara nyingine ikaonekana mbinguni: Likaonekana joka kubwa jekundu lenye vichwa saba na pembe kumi na taji saba katika vichwa vyake.

english: His tail swept a third of the stars from the sky, tossing them to the earth. And the dragon stood before the woman who was about to give birth, ready to devour her child as soon as she gave birth.
ekegusii: Ekemincha kiaye kegakurura ensemo ya gatato ye ching’enang’eni chia igoro na gochiyeria ase ense. Na enchoka eria egatenena ase obosio bw’omokuungu oria orenge ang’e koibora, erinde ekero aiboire erie omwana oye.
swahili: Mkia wake ukakokota theluthi ya nyota zote angani na kuziangusha katika nchi. Ndipo lile joka likasimama mbele ya yule mwanamke aliyekuwa karibu kuzaa ili lipate kumla huyo mtoto mara tu atakapozaliwa.

english: And she gave birth to a son, a male child, who will rule all the nations with an iron scepter. And her child was caught up to God and to His throne.
ekegusii: Omokungu oria akaibora omwana omoisia, oyio nere oragambere abanto b’ebisaku bionsi nenyimbo y’ekioma. Korende omwana oye agataborigwa gochia igoro ase Nyasae na ase ekerogo kiaye ki’obonene.
swahili: Yule mwanamke akazaa mtoto mwanaume, atakayeyatawala mataifa yote kwa fimbo yake ya utawala ya chuma. Lakini huyo mtoto akanyakuliwa na kupelekwa kwa Mungu kwenye kiti chake cha enzi.

english: And the woman fled into the wilderness, where God had prepared a place for her to be nourished for 1,260 days. The War in Heaven
ekegusii: Omokungu oria agatama gochia ase erooro agwo aase aroiseretigwe na Nyasae, erinde arendwe aroro ase engaki y’amatuko elifu eyemo, na amagana abere, na emerongo etano nomo (1,260).
swahili: Yule mwanamke akakimbilia jangwani, ambako Mungu alikuwa amemtayarishia mahali ili apate kutunzwa huko kwa muda wa siku 1,260. Malaika Mikaeli Amshinda Yule Joka

english: Then a war broke out in heaven: Michael and his angels fought against the dragon, and the dragon and his angels fought back.
ekegusii: Erio esegi yabeete igoro. Mikaeli na abamalaika baye bakarwania enchoka. Na enchoka eria na abamalaika baye bakarwanera amo,
swahili: Basi palikuwa na vita mbinguni: Mikaeli na malaika zake wakapigana na hilo joka, nalo joka pamoja na malaika zake likapigana nao.

english: But the dragon was not strong enough, and no longer was any place found in heaven for him and his angels.
ekegusii: korende tibabua, nonya nase abo tanyorekana igoro naende.
swahili: Lakini joka na malaika zake wakashindwa, na hapakuwa tena na nafasi yao huko mbinguni.

english: And the great dragon was hurled down—that ancient serpent called the devil and Satan, the deceiver of the whole world. He was hurled to the earth, and his angels with him.
ekegusii: Na enchoka eria enene egatugutwa gocha inse. Eria neng’iti ya kare ekorokwa Omogenki na Saitani, omong’ainereria bw’ense yonsi. Ere agatugutwa gocha ase ense, na abamalaika baye bagatugutwa amo nere.
swahili: Lile joka kuu likatupwa chini, yule nyoka wa zamani aitwaye ibilisi au Shetani, aupotoshaye ulimwengu wote. Akatupwa chini duniani, yeye pamoja na malaika zake. Ushindi Mbinguni Watangazwa

english: Then I saw a beast with ten horns and seven heads rising out of the sea. There were ten royal crowns on its horns and blasphemous names on its heads.
ekegusii: Erio nkarora eng’iti egosoka korwa ase enyancha. Ero nigo yarenge ne ching’unchara ikomi na emetwe etano na ebere. Igoro ase ching’unchara chiaye nchiarengeo chigutwa ikomi, na ase emetwe yaye ndiarengeo erieta ri’okoraama.
swahili: Yule joka akajikita katika mchanga ulioko ufuoni mwa bahari. Mnyama Kutoka Baharini Nami nikamwona mnyama akitoka ndani ya bahari. Mnyama huyo alikuwa na pembe kumi na vichwa saba, akiwa na taji kumi kwenye hizo pembe zake, na juu ya kila kichwa kulikuwa na jina la kukufuru.

english: “If anyone is destined for captivity, into captivity he will go; if anyone is to die by the sword, by the sword he must be killed.” Here is a call for the perseverance and faith of the saints. The Beast from the Earth
ekegusii: Omonto gachoreirwe ogwoswa, goika oswe. Omonto gachoreirwe ogoitwa nomoyio o birende, goika aitwe nomoyio o birende. Aiga nao abachenu barabe nokoremereria na obwegenwa.
swahili: Ikiwa mtu ni wa kuchukuliwa mateka, atachukuliwa mateka. Ikiwa mtu ni wa kuuawa kwa upanga, atauawa kwa upanga. Hapa ndipo penye wito wa subira na imani ya watakatifu. Mnyama Kutoka Dunia

english: Then I saw another beast rising out of the earth. This beast had two horns like a lamb, but spoke like a dragon.
ekegusii: Erio nkarora eng’iti ende egotiira korwa inse. Ero nigo yarenge ne ching’unchara ibere chinga buna echi’emanwa y’eng’ondi, egakwana buna enchoka.
swahili: Kisha nikamwona mnyama mwingine, akipanda juu kutoka dunia. Alikuwa na pembe mbili kama mwana-kondoo, lakini akanena kama joka.

english: And this beast exercised all the authority of the first beast and caused the earth and those who dwell in it to worship the first beast, whose mortal wound had been healed.
ekegusii: Nigo ekwenaria okobua gwonsi kw’eng’iti eria ye ritang’ani ase obosio bwaye, na kogera ense na bonsi abamenyete aroro basasime eng’iti eria ye ritang’ani, ero eyio orogoma rwaye rw’amakweri rwagwenetigwe.
swahili: Akatumia mamlaka yote ya yule mnyama wa kwanza kwa niaba yake, naye akawafanya wote wakaao duniani kumwabudu yule mnyama wa kwanza, ambaye jeraha lake la mauti lilipona.

english: And the second beast performed great signs to cause even fire from heaven to come down to earth in the presence of the people.
ekegusii: Nero yakorire ebikone ebinene, goika yagerire omorero oike korwa igoro gocha ase ense ase amasio a Mwanyabaanto.
swahili: Naye akafanya ishara kuu na za ajabu, hata kusababisha moto kushuka toka mbinguni kuja duniani watu wakiona waziwazi.

english: Because of the signs it was given to perform on behalf of the first beast, it deceived those who dwell on the earth, telling them to make an image to the beast that had been wounded by the sword and yet had lived.
ekegusii: Na ase ebikone biria yaetwe ribaga kobikora ase obosio bw’eng’iti eria ye ritang’ani ekong’aina abwo bamenyete ase ense, egoteebia abamenyete ase ense bakore omogwekano bw’eng’iti eria yaagetwe orogoma nomoyio o birende, nero ekaba moyo.
swahili: Kwa sababu ya zile ishara alizokuwa amepewa uwezo wa kuzifanya kwa niaba ya yule mnyama wa kwanza, akawadanganya wakaao duniani. Akawaamuru wasimamishe sanamu kwa heshima ya yule mnyama aliyekuwa amejeruhiwa kwa upanga lakini akaishi.

english: The second beast was permitted to give breath to the image of the first beast, so that the image could speak and cause all who refused to worship it to be killed. The Mark of the Beast
ekegusii: Ekaegwa ribaga kobekera omogwekano bw’eng’iti eria omoika, goika omogwekano oria okwane, na ogere abanto bonsi abatasasimete omogwekano oria bw’eng’iti baitwe.
swahili: Akapewa uwezo wa kuipa pumzi ile sanamu ya yule mnyama wa kwanza, ili iweze kusema na kuwasababisha wale wote waliokataa kuiabudu hiyo sanamu kuuawa.

english: And the second beast required all people small and great, rich and poor, free and slave, to receive a mark on their right hand or on their forehead,
ekegusii: Naboigo ekagera abanto bonsi, abake na abanene, abanda na abataka, abatari abasomba na abasomba, babekwe ekemanyererio ase amaboko abo a borio gose amasio abo igoro,
swahili: Pia alimlazimisha kila mmoja, mdogo na mkubwa, tajiri na maskini, mtu huru na mtumwa, atiwe chapa kwenye mkono wake wa kuume au kwenye kipaji chake cha uso,

english: so that no one could buy or sell unless he had the mark—the name of the beast or the number of its name.
ekegusii: erinde monto onde bwensi tagora gose koonia otatiga ere oyore nekemanyererio keria, engencho yaye erieta ri’eng’iti eria gose chinamba chi’erieta riaye.
swahili: ili kwamba mtu yeyote asiweze kununua wala kuuza isipokuwa amekuwa na hiyo chapa, ambayo ni jina la huyo mnyama au tarakimu za jina lake.

english: Here is a call for wisdom: Let the one who has insight calculate the number of the beast, for it is the number of a man, and that number is 666.
ekegusii: Aiga nao obong’aini boganeirie. Ere oyore ne chisemi tiga abare chinamba chi’eng’iti eyio, naki echi nechinamba chia Mwanyabaanto, ne chinamba chiaye namagana atano na rimo na emerongo etano nomo na isano nemo (666).
swahili: Hapa ndipo penye hekima. Yeye aliye na ufahamu na ahesabu tarakimu za huyo mnyama, kwa maana ni tarakimu za kibinadamu. Tarakimu zake ni 666.

english: The beast I saw was like a leopard, with the feet of a bear and the mouth of a lion. And the dragon gave the beast his power and his throne and great authority.
ekegusii: Na eng’iti eria narooche nigo yagwekaine engo. Amagoro aye nigo arenge buna ay’edubu, na omonwa oye buna oyo bw’endo. Enchoka ekaa eng’iti eria chinguru chiaye, na ekerogo kiaye ki’obonene, na okobua okonene.
swahili: Mnyama yule niliyemwona alifanana na chui, lakini miguu yake ilikuwa kama ya dubu na kichwa chake kama cha simba. Lile joka likampa huyo mnyama nguvu zake, kiti chake cha enzi na mamlaka makubwa.

english: One of the heads of the beast appeared to be mortally wounded. But the mortal wound was healed, and the whole world marveled and followed the beast.
ekegusii: Omotwe oyomo bw’emetwe y’eng’iti eria okarorekana buna nore norogoma rw’amakweri, korende orogoma rwaye rw’amakweri rokagwenigwa, na ense yonsi egakumia ase eng’iti eria na koyetunyana.
swahili: Kimojawapo ya vichwa vya huyo mnyama kilikuwa kama kilichokwisha kupata jeraha la mauti, lakini jeraha hilo la mauti likapona. Ulimwengu wote ukashangaa ukamfuata huyo mnyama.

english: They worshiped the dragon who had given authority to the beast, and they worshiped the beast, saying, “Who is like the beast, and who can wage war against it?”
ekegusii: Abanto bagasasiima enchoka eria, ekiagera yaete eng’iti eria okobua. Naende bagasasiima eng’iti eria bagoteeba, “Ning’o oreng’aine neng’iti eye? Ning’o oranyare koyerwania?”
swahili: Watu wakaliabudu lile joka kwa sababu lilikuwa limempa huyo mnyama mamlaka yake, pia wakamwabudu huyo mnyama na kuuliza, “Ni nani aliye kama huyu mnyama? Ni nani awezaye kupigana vita naye?”

english: The beast was given a mouth to speak arrogant and blasphemous words, and authority to act for 42 months.
ekegusii: Eng’iti eria ekaegwa ribaga ri’ogokwana amang’ana amanene na ay’okorama, naende ekaegwa okobua gw’okogamba ase engaki y’emetienyi emerongo ene na ebere.
swahili: Huyo mnyama akapewa kusema maneno ya kiburi na kukufuru na kutumia mamlaka yake kwa muda wa miezi arobaini na miwili.

english: And the beast opened its mouth to speak blasphemies against God and to slander His name and His tabernacle—those who dwell in heaven.
ekegusii: Na igo egachaaka korama Nyasae, ekarama na erieta riaye, na obomenyo bwaye, na abwo bamenyete igoro,
swahili: Akafungua kinywa chake ili kumkufuru Mungu, akilitukana Jina lake na mahali aishipo na wale wakaao mbinguni.

english: Then the beast was permitted to wage war against the saints and to conquer them, and it was given authority over every tribe and people and tongue and nation.
ekegusii: naende ekaegwa ribaga korwania abachenu na kobabua. Ekaegwa okobua igoro ya kera eamate, na abanto, na omonwa, na egesaku.
swahili: Pia akaruhusiwa kufanya vita na watakatifu na kuwashinda. Akapewa uwezo juu ya watu wa kila kabila, jamaa, lugha na taifa.

english: And all who dwell on the earth will worship the beast—all whose names have not been written from the foundation of the world in the Book of Life belonging to the Lamb who was slain.
ekegusii: Abanto bonsi abamenyete ase ense mbayesasime, otatiga abwo amarieta abo ariikire ase egetabu y’obogima y’Emanwa y’Eng’ondi, oyoitetwe korwa omochakano, ekero oboroso bw’ense bwabegetwe.
swahili: Nao watu wote waishio duniani watamwabudu huyo mnyama, yaani, wale wote ambao majina yao hayakuandikwa kwenye kitabu cha uzima cha Mwana-Kondoo aliyechinjwa tangu kuumbwa kwa ulimwengu.

english: He who has an ear, let him hear:
ekegusii: Omonto kare namato akoigwera, tiga aigwe:
swahili: Yeye aliye na sikio na asikie.

english: Then I looked and saw the Lamb standing on Mount Zion, and with Him 144,000 who had His name and His Father’s name written on their foreheads.
ekegusii: Erio nkarigereria, nkarora Emanwa y’Eng’ondi oteneine ase egetunwa gia Sayoni, na amo nere abanto chilifu rigana erimo na emerongo ene na inye (144,000) abaare nerieta riaye amo neria Ise riarikire ase amasio abo igoro.
swahili: Kisha nikatazama na hapo mbele yangu alikuwepo Mwana-Kondoo, akiwa amesimama juu ya Mlima Sayuni. Pamoja naye walikuwa wale 144,000 wenye Jina la Mwana-Kondoo na Jina la Baba yake likiwa limeandikwa kwenye vipaji vya nyuso zao.

english: he too will drink the wine of God’s anger, poured undiluted into the cup of His wrath. And he will be tormented in fire and sulfur in the presence of the holy angels and of the Lamb.
ekegusii: ere nanywe edivai y’endamwamu ya Nyasae yaroisigwe, etasang’aniri kende, ase egekombe ki’endamwamu yaye. Naende nachandwe nomorero na ekebiriti ase amasio ’abamalaika abachenu, na ase obosio bw’Emanwa y’Eng’ondi.
swahili: yeye pia atakunywa mvinyo wa hasira kali ya Mungu ambayo imemiminwa katika kikombe cha ghadhabu yake pasipo kuchanganywa na maji. Naye atateswa kwa moto uwakao na kiberiti mbele ya malaika watakatifu na mbele za Mwana-Kondoo.

english: And the smoke of their torment rises forever and ever. Day and night there is no rest for those who worship the beast and its image, or for anyone who receives the mark of its name.”
ekegusii: Na erioki ri’okoyia kw’abwo bagochandeka nigo rirachongororoke gochia igoro goika kare na kare. Na ogotimoka tikori omobaso gose obotuko ase abwo basasiimete eng’iti eria na omogwekano oye, na kera oyonyorire ekemanyererio ki’erieta riaye.”
swahili: Nao moshi wa mateso yao hupanda juu milele na milele. Hakuna mapumziko, mchana wala usiku, kwa wale wamwabuduo huyo mnyama na sanamu yake, au kwa yeyote anayepokea chapa ya jina lake.”

english: Here is a call for the perseverance of the saints who keep the commandments of God and the faith of Jesus.
ekegusii: Aiga nao abachenu barabe nokoremereria, abwo babwatete amachiiko a Nyasae na koba abegenwa ase Yeso.
swahili: Hapa ndipo penye wito wa subira na uvumilivu wa watakatifu; wale wanaozishika amri za Mungu na kudumu katika uaminifu kwa Yesu.

english: And I heard a voice from heaven telling me to write, “Blessed are the dead—those who die in the Lord from this moment on.” “Yes,” says the Spirit, “they will rest from their labors, for their deeds will follow them.” The Harvest of the Earth
ekegusii: Erio nkaigwa eriogi rikorwa igoro rigoteeba, “Riika aya: Mbasesenirie abagokwa korwa bono, bamwegenete Omonene. Ee, nabo, Omoika ogoteeba, tiga batimoke korwa ase emeremo yabo, ekiagera okwama kw’ogokora kwabo nigo gokobatunyana.” Okogesa gw’ense
swahili: Kisha nikasikia sauti kutoka mbinguni ikisema, “Andika: Wamebarikiwa wafu wafao katika Bwana tangu sasa.” “Naam,” asema Roho, “watapumzika kutoka taabu zao, kwa kuwa matendo yao yatawafuata.” Kuvuna Mavuno Ya Dunia

english: And I looked and saw a white cloud, and seated on the cloud was One like the Son of Man, with a golden crown on His head and a sharp sickle in His hand.
ekegusii: Erio nkarigereria, nkarora riire rirabu, na igoro ase riire riria naikaranseteo oyomo ogwekaine omwana o Mwanyabaanto, orenge negutwa y’etaabu ase omotwe oye, na omoyio okogesa ase okoboko kwaye.
swahili: Nikatazama, hapo mbele yangu palikuwa na wingu jeupe, na aliyekuwa ameketi juu ya hilo wingu alikuwa “kama Mwana wa Adamu” mwenye taji ya dhahabu kichwani mwake na mundu mkali mkononi mwake.

english: Then another angel came out of the temple, crying out in a loud voice to the One seated on the cloud, “Swing Your sickle and reap, because the time has come to harvest; for the crop of the earth is ripe.”
ekegusii: Na omomalaika onde agasooka korwa ase Hekalu akarera neriogi rinene, agateebia oyoikaransete igoro ase riire riria, “Soyia omoyio oo mogondo, ogese, ekiagera engaki y’okogesa yaikire, ne rigesa riomire mono.”
swahili: Kisha malaika mwingine akaja kutoka hekaluni naye akamwita kwa sauti kubwa yule aliyekuwa ameketi juu ya lile wingu akasema, “Chukua mundu wako ukavune kwa kuwa wakati wa mavuno umewadia, kwa maana mavuno ya dunia yamekomaa.”

english: So the One seated on the cloud swung His sickle over the earth, and the earth was harvested.
ekegusii: Na ere oyoikaransete igoro ase riire riria agasoyia omoyio oye ase ense, na ense ekageswa.
swahili: Hivyo yule aliyekuwa ameketi juu ya lile wingu akauzungusha mundu wake duniani, nayo dunia ikavunwa.

english: Then another angel came out of the temple in heaven, and he too had a sharp sickle.
ekegusii: Na omomalaika onde agasoka korwa ase Hekalu ya igoro, nere boigo narenge nomoyio okogesa.
swahili: Malaika mwingine akatoka katika hekalu lililoko mbinguni, naye pia alikuwa na mundu mkali.

english: Still another angel, with authority over the fire, came from the altar and called out in a loud voice to the angel with the sharp sickle, “Swing your sharp sickle and gather the clusters of grapes from the vine of the earth, because its grapes are ripe.”
