english: Now the rest of mankind who were not killed by these plagues still did not repent of the works of their hands. They did not stop worshiping demons and idols of gold, silver, bronze, stone, and wood, which cannot see or hear or walk.
ekegusii: Na Mwanyabaanto abatigarete bataitetwe ase amaakwa ayio tibaonchogete korwa ase emeremo eria bakorete namaboko abo, na tibatiga gosasiima ebirecha na emegwekano yakorire korwa ase chitaabu, ne chifeta, ne chitaai, na amagena, na emete, eyio etanyare korora, gose koigwa, gose kogenda.
swahili: Wanadamu waliosalia, ambao hawakuuawa katika mapigo hayo, bado walikataa kutubia kazi za mikono yao na hawakuacha kuabudu mashetani na sanamu za dhahabu, za fedha, za shaba, za mawe na za miti, ambazo haziwezi kuona, kusikia wala kutembea.

english: Furthermore, they did not repent of their murder, sorcery, sexual immorality, and theft.
ekegusii: Na barabwo tibaonchogete korwa ase ogoita kwabo, gose oborogi bwabo, gose obotomani bwabo, gose okoiba kwabo.
swahili: Wala hawakutubu na kuacha matendo yao ya uuaji, uchawi, uasherati wala wizi wao.

english: And out of the smoke, locusts descended on the earth, and they were given power like that of the scorpions of the earth.
ekegusii: Ne chingige chigasoka korwa ase erioki riria, chikagenda ase ense, chikaegwa okobua buna ebiuge bi’ense bire nakwo.
swahili: Ndipo katika ule moshi wakatoka nzige wakaenda juu ya nchi, nao wakapewa nguvu kama zile za nge wa duniani.

english: They were told not to harm the grass of the earth or any plant or tree, but only those who did not have the seal of God on their foreheads.
ekegusii: Chirochio chigateebigwa tichisaria obonyansi bw’ense, gose kemeri kende, gose mote onde bwonsi, otatiga chisarie abanto baria batari nekemanyererio kia Nyasae ase amasio abo igoro.
swahili: Wakaambiwa wasidhuru nyasi ya nchi, wala mmea wala mti wowote, bali wawadhuru tu wale watu ambao hawana muhuri wa Mungu kwenye vipaji vya nyuso zao.

english: The locusts were not given power to kill them, but only to torment them for five months, and their torment was like the stinging of a scorpion.
ekegusii: Tichiaegwa ribaga ri’okobaita bakwe, korende eri’okobachanda ase engaki y’emetienyi etano. Okoroma kwabo nigo kwarenge buna okoroma gw’riagaga gekoroma omonto.
swahili: Wakaruhusiwa kuwatesa kwa muda wa miezi mitano, lakini wasiwaue. Uchungu wa kuuma kwao ulikuwa kama ule wa mtu aumwapo na nge.

english: In those days men will seek death and will not find it; they will long to die, but death will escape them.
ekegusii: Na ase amatuko aria Mwanyabaanto nabarigie amakweri, na barabwo tibakoyanyora nonya ng’ake. Barabwo nababe namaiga ase amakweri, korende amakweri inabatame.
swahili: Katika siku hizo watu watatafuta kifo lakini hawatakiona, watatamani kufa, lakini kifo kitawakimbia.

english: And the locusts looked like horses prepared for battle, with something like crowns of gold on their heads, and faces like the faces of men.
ekegusii: Ase ebieni biabo chingige chiria nigo chiagwekaine chibarasi chibekire ang’e ase esegi. Ase emetwe yabo nigo chiarenge n’ebinto bikororekana buna chigutwa chi’echitaabu, na amasio abo nigo agwekaine amasio a Mwanyabaanto.
swahili: Wale nzige walikuwa na umbo kama la farasi waliotayarishwa kwa ajili ya vita. Kwenye vichwa vyao kulikuwa na kitu kama taji za dhahabu na nyuso zao zilikuwa kama za binadamu.

english: They had hair like that of women, and teeth like those of lions.
ekegusii: Chitukia chiabo nigo chiarenge buna chitukia chi’abakungu, na amaino abo buna amaino e chindo.
swahili: Walikuwa na nywele kama za wanawake, na meno yao yalikuwa kama ya simba.

english: They also had thoraxes like breastplates of iron, and the sound of their wings was like the roar of many horses and chariots rushing into battle.
ekegusii: Ebikuba biabo nigo biaboirie chingobo chi’ebioma, na egeturi gie chimbaaba chiabo nigo kiarenge buna egeturi gie chigari chinyinge chi’echibarasi chikominyoka gochia ase esegi.
swahili: Walikuwa na dirii kama za chuma, na sauti za mabawa yao zilikuwa kama ngurumo za farasi wengi na magari mengi yakikimbilia vitani.

english: Brothers, my heart’s desire and prayer to God for the Israelites is for their salvation.
ekegusii: Baminto okogania gw’enkoro y’ane na ogosaba kw’ane ase Nyasae ase engencho y’Abaisraeli nakwo oko, ng’a batoorigwe.
swahili: Ndugu zangu, shauku ya moyo wangu na maombi yangu kwa Mungu ni kwa ajili ya Waisraeli, kwamba waokolewe.

english: For with your heart you believe and are justified, and with your mouth you confess and are saved.
ekegusii: Inaki ase enkoro omonto nigo akwegena, erio onyora oboronge; na ase omonwa oorokia, erio onyora ogotooreka.
swahili: Kwa maana kwa moyo mtu huamini na hivyo kuhesabiwa haki, tena kwa kinywa mtu hukiri na hivyo kupata wokovu.

english: It is just as the Scripture says: “Anyone who believes in Him will never be put to shame.”
ekegusii: Amariiko nigo agoteeba, “Onde bwensi oramwegene takorora obosooku.”
swahili: Kama yasemavyo Maandiko, “Yeyote amwaminiye hataaibika kamwe.”

english: For there is no difference between Jew and Greek: The same Lord is Lord of all, and gives richly to all who call on Him,
ekegusii: Inaki gwatananeka tikori ase Abayahudi na Abagiriki, ekiagera ase Abayahudi na Abagiriki, ekiagera Omonene nigo are Omonene o bonsi, na obonda bwaye nigo akoa abanto bonsi abakomorangeria.
swahili: Kwa maana hakuna tofauti kati ya Myahudi na Myunani, yeye ni Bwana wa wote, mwenye utajiri kwa wote wamwitao.

english: for, “Everyone who calls on the name of the Lord will be saved.”
ekegusii: Ekiagera, “Onde bwensi orarangerie erieta ri’Omonene natoorigwe.”
swahili: Kwa maana, “Kila mtu atakayeliitia Jina la Bwana, ataokolewa.”

english: How then can they call on the One in whom they have not believed? And how can they believe in the One of whom they have not heard? And how can they hear without someone to preach?
ekegusii: Inee! Inaki baramorangerie ere bataramwegena? Naende inaki baramwegene oyo batana koigwa amang’ana igoro yaye? Naende inaki baraigwe batari nomorandia?
swahili: Lakini watamwitaje yeye ambaye hawajamwamini? Nao watawezaje kumwamini yeye ambaye hawajamsikia? Tena watamsikiaje bila mtu kuwahubiria?

english: And how can they preach unless they are sent? As it is written: “How beautiful are the feet of those who bring good news!”
ekegusii: Naende inaki bararandie batatomiri? Buna eriikire, “Inaki amagoro abo are amaseera, baria bakorandia amang’ana amaya!”
swahili: Nao watahubirije wasipopelekwa? Kama ilivyoandikwa, “Tazama jinsi ilivyo mizuri miguu yao wale wanaohubiri habari njema!”

english: But not all of them welcomed the good news. For Isaiah says, “Lord, who has believed our message?”
ekegusii: Korende tari bonsi baigwerete enchiri. Inaki Isaya nigo agoteeba, “Omonene, ning’o bwegenire aya aigure korwa ase tore?”
swahili: Lakini si wote waliotii Habari Njema. Kwa maana Isaya asema, “Bwana, ni nani aliyeamini ujumbe wetu?”

english: Consequently, faith comes by hearing, and hearing by the word of Christ.
ekegusii: Ase ayio, okwegena nigo kogoocha ase enchera y’okoigwa, na aya tokoigwa nigo agoocha korwa ase ring’ana ria Kristo.
swahili: Basi, imani chanzo chake ni kusikia, na kusikia huja kwa neno la Kristo.

english: But I ask, did they not hear? Indeed they did: “Their voice has gone out into all the earth, their words to the ends of the world.”
ekegusii: Korende nkoboria ’nde: Inee! Barabwo tibaigwete? Ee, mbaigwete, “Egeturi kieriogi riabo giesiareire ase ense engima, na amang’ana abo aikire chinsinyo chionsi chi’ense aase abanto bamenyete.”
swahili: Lakini nauliza: Je, wao hawakusikia? Naam, wamesikia, kwa maana: “Sauti yao imeenea duniani pote, nayo maneno yao yameenea hadi miisho ya ulimwengu.”

english: I ask instead, did Israel not understand? First, Moses says: “I will make you jealous by those who are not a nation; I will make you angry by a nation without understanding.”
ekegusii: Naende nkoboria ’nde: Inee! Abaisraeli tibamanyete? Agwo ritang’ani Musa nigo agoteeba, “Nimbakore mobe ne ribero ase abanto batari egesaku, ase egesaku kere ekeriri nigo ndababeeyie.”
swahili: Nami nauliza tena: Je, Waisraeli hawakuelewa? Kwanza, Mose asema, “Nitawafanya mwe na wivu kwa watu wale ambao si taifa. Nitawakasirisha kwa taifa lile lisilo na ufahamu.”

english: For I testify about them that they are zealous for God, but not on the basis of knowledge.
ekegusii: Inaki nababereire kirori, ng’a ’mbare n’omokia ase Nyasae, korende ase omokia obo tibari nobong’ani.
swahili: Kwa maana ninaweza nikashuhudia wazi kwamba wao wana juhudi kubwa kwa ajili ya Mungu, lakini juhudi yao haina maarifa.

english: And Isaiah boldly says: “I was found by those who did not seek Me; I revealed Myself to those who did not ask for Me.”
ekegusii: Na Isaya n’are noboremu bw’ogoteeba, “Nigo nanyorekanete n’abaatare kondigia; nkeorokia ase abataare kong’itaa.”
swahili: Naye Isaya kwa ujasiri mwingi anasema, “Nimeonekana na watu wale ambao hawakunitafuta. Nilijifunua kwa watu wale ambao hawakunitafuta.”

english: But as for Israel he says: “All day long I have held out My hands to a disobedient and obstinate people.”
ekegusii: Korende ase Abaisraeli nigo agoteeba, “Omobaso boira nigo n’are kobaramborera amaboko aane abanto batari abaigweri korende abaamereria.”
swahili: Lakini kuhusu Israeli anasema, “Mchana kutwa nimewanyooshea watu wakaidi na wasiotii mikono yangu.”

english: Because they were ignorant of God’s righteousness and sought to establish their own, they did not submit to God’s righteousness.
ekegusii: Inaki kobar’abe tibamanyeti oboronge bokorwa ase Nyasae, naende bakorigia goikerania oboronge bwabo abanyene, igo tibebegeti inse ase oboronge bwa Nyasae.
swahili: Kwa kuwa hawakuijua haki itokayo kwa Mungu, wakatafuta kuweka haki yao wenyewe, hawakujitia chini ya haki ya Mungu.

english: For Christ is the end of the law, to bring righteousness to everyone who believes.
ekegusii: Inaki Kristo nere ore omoerio bw’amachiiko, erinde onde bwensi oyoramwegene anyore oboronge. Enchera enyia y’okonyora oboronge nigo eruure ase abanto bonsi
swahili: Kwa maana Kristo ni ukomo wa sheria ili kuwe na haki kwa kila mtu aaminiye. Wokovu Ni Kwa Ajili Ya Wote

english: For concerning the righteousness that is by the law, Moses writes: “The man who does these things will live by them.”
ekegusii: Inaki Musa nigo ariigete igoro y’oboronge obo bokorua ase amachiiko, ng’a omonto oy’orakore aya nabe n’obogima ase aya.
swahili: Mose anaandika kuhusu haki ile itokanayo na sheria, kwamba, “Mtu atendaye matendo hayo ataishi kwa hayo.”

english: But the righteousness that is by faith says: “Do not say in your heart, ‘Who will ascend into heaven?’ (that is, to bring Christ down)
ekegusii: Korende oboronge boria bokonyorekana ase okwegena nigo bogoteeba iga: Toteeba ase enkoro yao ime, “Ning’o oragende gochia igoro” (engencho yaye nokorenta Kristo inse aa);
swahili: Lakini ile haki itokanayo na imani husema hivi: “Usiseme moyoni mwako, ‘Ni nani atakayepanda mbinguni?’ ” (yaani ili kumleta Kristo chini)

english: or, ‘Who will descend into the Abyss?’ (that is, to bring Christ up from the dead).”
ekegusii: gose, “Ning’o oranyare kogenda aike inse ase eora y’abakuure?” (Engencho yaye nokorenta Kristo igoro korwa ase abakuure).
swahili: “au ‘Ni nani atashuka kwenda kuzimu?’ ” (yaani ili kumleta Kristo kutoka kwa wafu.)

english: But what does it say? “The word is near you; it is in your mouth and in your heart,” that is, the word of faith we are proclaiming:
ekegusii: Korende, inaki bogoteeba? Ring’ana riria nigo rire ang’e naye, ase omonwa oo, na ime ase enkoro yao (eri n’ering’ana ri’okwegena, riria tokorandia).
swahili: Lakini andiko lasemaje? “Lile neno liko karibu nawe, liko kinywani mwako na moyoni mwako,” yaani, lile neno la imani tunalolihubiri.

english: that if you confess with your mouth, “Jesus is Lord,” and believe in your heart that God raised Him from the dead, you will be saved.
ekegusii: Ekiagera koraorokie nomonwa oo, ng’a Yeso nere Omonene, na kwegena ime ase enkoro yao ng’a Nyasae namobogetie korwa ase abakuure, notoorigwe.
swahili: Kwa sababu kama ukikiri kwa kinywa chako kwamba “Yesu ni Bwana,” na kuamini moyoni mwako kwamba Mungu alimfufua kutoka kwa wafu, utaokoka.

english: I ask then, did God reject His people? Certainly not! I am an Israelite myself, a descendant of Abraham, from the tribe of Benjamin.
ekegusii: Ase igo nkoboria ’nde: Inee! Nyasae nigo angete abanto baye? Yaya, taibo! Inche omonyene n’Omoisraeli inde, oyomo bw’oroiboro rwa Aburaamu, omonto bw’ororeria rwa Benjamini.
swahili: Basi nauliza: Je, Mungu amewakataa watu wake? La, hasha! Mimi mwenyewe ni Mwisraeli, tena uzao wa Abrahamu kutoka kabila la Benyamini.

english: May their eyes be darkened so they cannot see, and their backs be bent forever.” The Ingrafting of the Gentiles
ekegusii: Tiga amaiso abo abekwe omosunte tibarora. Obakumbe emegongo yabo botambe!”
swahili: Macho yao yatiwe giza ili wasiweze kuona, nayo migongo yao iinamishwe daima.” Matawi Yaliyopandikizwa

english: I ask then, did they stumble so as to fall beyond recovery? Certainly not! However, because of their trespass, salvation has come to the Gentiles to make Israel jealous.
ekegusii: Bono nkoboria nde, “Inee! Nigo bagochirwe goika baguure kegima?” Yaya, taibo! Korende ase ogosaria kwabo ogotooreka gwaikeire abanto b’Ebisaku, erinde Abaisraeli bakorwe babe ne ribero.
swahili: Hivyo nauliza tena: Je, Waisraeli walijikwaa ili waanguke na kuangamia kabisa? La, hasha! Lakini kwa sababu ya makosa yao, wokovu umewafikia watu wa Mataifa, ili kuwafanya Waisraeli waone wivu.

english: But if their trespass means riches for the world, and their failure means riches for the Gentiles, how much greater riches will their fullness bring!
ekegusii: Bono onye ogosaria kwabo kwaeire abanto b’ense eye obonda, na onye okobugwa kwabo kwaeire abanto b’Ebisaku obonda, Inee, tari kobua mono oboikeranu bwabo? Ogotooreka ase abanto b’Ebisaku. Okworokereria korwa ase ogochomwa gwe chinsagia
swahili: Basi ikiwa kukosa kwao kumekuwa utajiri mkubwa kwa ulimwengu, tena kama kuangamia kwao kumeleta utajiri kwa watu wa Mataifa, kurudishwa kwao kutaleta utajiri mkuu zaidi.

english: I am speaking to you Gentiles. Inasmuch as I am the apostle to the Gentiles, I magnify my ministry
ekegusii: Bono ’ngokwana nde nainwe abanto b’Ebisaku. Koreng’ana buna inde omotomwa bw’ abanto b’Ebisaku, nabarire ng’a obosomba bwane n’egento ekenene,
swahili: Sasa ninasema nanyi watu wa Mataifa. Maadamu mimi ni mtume kwa watu wa Mataifa, naitukuza huduma yangu

english: in the hope that I may provoke my own people to jealousy and save some of them.
ekegusii: erinde inyare kobeeka abare amanyinga ayamo nainche ribero, na gotooria abande babo.
swahili: ili kuwafanya watu wangu waone wivu na hivyo kuwaokoa baadhi yao.

english: For if their rejection is the reconciliation of the world, what will their acceptance be but life from the dead?
ekegusii: Inaki onye okwangwa kwabo gokorenta okobwatania ase ense, Inee, ogwancherwa kwabo inki koraarente? Nigo gokorenta obogima ribaga ri’ogokwa.
swahili: Kwa kuwa ikiwa kukataliwa kwao ni kupatanishwa kwa ulimwengu, kukubaliwa kwao si kutakuwa ni uhai baada ya kufa?

english: If the first part of the dough is holy, so is the whole batch; if the root is holy, so are the branches.
ekegusii: Naende onye ensemo ye ritang’ani ye ribomba ri’obosie ere enchenu, naboigo ne ribomba rionsi rire; na onye ritina rire richenu, naboigo ne chinsagia chire.
swahili: Kama sehemu ya donge la unga uliotolewa kuwa limbuko ni mtakatifu, basi unga wote ni mtakatifu, nalo shina kama ni takatifu, vivyo hivyo na matawi nayo.

english: Now if some branches have been broken off, and you, a wild olive shoot, have been grafted in among the others to share in the nourishment of the olive root,
ekegusii: Korende onye chinsagia chinde chiabunekire, na aye oyokwarwete ase omozeituni bw’orosana gwachomirwe ase ribaga riabo, okaba oyomo bwe ritina ri’omozeituni, na konyora obonoru bwaye,
swahili: Lakini kama baadhi ya matawi yalikatwa, nawe chipukizi la mzeituni mwitu ukapandikizwa mahali pao ili kushiriki unono pamoja na matawi mengine kutoka shina la mzeituni,

english: do not boast over those branches. If you do, remember this: You do not support the root, but the root supports you.
ekegusii: tibwetogia igoro ase chinsagia chiria. Onye kogwetogia, inyora ng’a tari aye oimogetie ritina, korende neritina rikoimogetie aye.
swahili: basi usijivune juu ya hayo matawi. Kama ukijivuna, kumbuka jambo hili: si wewe unayelishikilia shina, bali ni shina linalokushikilia wewe.

english: You will say then, “Branches were broken off so that I could be grafted in.”
ekegusii: Bono noteebe, “Chinsagia nigo chiabunegete, erinde nchomwe aroro.”
swahili: Basi utasema, “Matawi yale yalikatwa ili nipate kupandikizwa katika hilo shina.”

english: God did not reject His people, whom He foreknew. Do you not know what the Scripture says about Elijah, how he appealed to God against Israel:
ekegusii: Nyasae tangeti abanto baye baria amanyete korwa kare. Gose timomanyeti aya amariiko agoteeba igoro y’Elija, buna akweng’ereria ase Nyasae igoro y’Abaisraeli?
swahili: Mungu hajawakataa watu wake, ambao yeye aliwajua tangu mwanzo. Je, hamjui yale Maandiko yasemayo kuhusu Eliya, jinsi alivyomlalamikia Mungu kuhusu Israeli?

english: That is correct: They were broken off because of unbelief, but you stand by faith. Do not be arrogant, but be afraid.
ekegusii: Ee, ayio namaene. Barabwo mbabunegete ase ogot’egena kwabo, korende aye nigo oteneine ase okwegena kwao. Ase igo toenena, korende oiroke.
swahili: Hii ni kweli. Matawi hayo yalikatwa kwa sababu ya kutokuamini kwake, lakini wewe umesimama tu kwa sababu ya imani. Kwa hiyo usijivune, bali simama kwa kuogopa.

english: For if God did not spare the natural branches, He will certainly not spare you either.
ekegusii: Inaki onye Nyasae tarorerete chinsagia chi’omote omonyene amaabera, nonya naye tagokororera amaabera.
swahili: Kwa maana kama Mungu hakuyahurumia matawi ya asili, wala hatakuhurumia wewe.

english: Take notice, therefore, of the kindness and severity of God: severity to those who fell, but kindness to you, if you continue in His kindness. Otherwise you also will be cut off.
ekegusii: Inyora obuya na obotindi bwa Nyasae, obotindi ase baria baguure; korende ase ore obuya bwa Nyasae, korabeere ase obuya bwaye. Onye taibo, naye boigo nonachwe korwa aroro.
swahili: Angalia basi wema na ukali wa Mungu: Kwa wale walioanguka, ukali, bali kwako wewe wema wa Mungu, kama utadumu katika wema wake. La sivyo, nawe utakatiliwa mbali.

english: And if they do not persist in unbelief, they will be grafted in, for God is able to graft them in again.
ekegusii: Nonya nabwo bande, onye tibakogenderera ase ogot’egena kwabo, rirorio nabachomwe, ekiagera Nyasae n’are n’okobua kobachoma naende.
swahili: Wao nao wasipodumu katika kutokuamini kwao, watapandikizwa tena kwenye shina, kwa maana Mungu anao uwezo wa kuwapandikiza tena kwenye hilo shina.

english: For if you were cut from a wild olive tree, and contrary to nature were grafted into one that is cultivated, how much more readily will these, the natural branches, be grafted into their own olive tree! All Israel Will Be Saved
ekegusii: Inaki onye aye kwanachetwe korwa ase omozeituni bw’orosana, ogachomwa ase ogochomwa gotanaretwe bo, ase omozeituni oy’osimekire, tari kobua mono chinsagia chie ritina rinyene chichomwe ase omozeituni obo omonyene. Ogwancha kw’oboikeranu kwa Nyasae nigo gokorentera bonsi amaabera
swahili: Ikiwa wewe ulikatwa kutoka kile ambacho kwa asili ni mzeituni mwitu na kupandikizwa kinyume cha asili kwenye mzeituni uliopandwa, si rahisi zaidi matawi haya ya asili kupandikizwa tena kwenye shina lake la mzeituni! Israeli Wote Wataokolewa

english: I do not want you to be ignorant of this mystery, brothers, so that you will not be conceited: A hardening in part has come to Israel, until the full number of the Gentiles has come in.
ekegusii: Inaki baminto, timwerora ng’a nigo more abanyene obong’aini; nindigetie momanye obobisi obo. Obokong’u bwanyorire abande b’Abaisraeli, goika ogoikerana kw’Ebisaku goike.
swahili: Ndugu zangu, ili msije mkajidai kuwa wenye hekima kuliko mlivyo, nataka mfahamu siri hii: Ugumu umewapata Israeli kwa sehemu hadi idadi ya watu wa Mataifa watakaoingia itimie.

english: And so all Israel will be saved, as it is written: “The Deliverer will come from Zion; He will remove godlessness from Jacob.
ekegusii: Na igo Abaisraeli bonsi inabatoorigwe, buna eriikire, “Ere Omosibori naache korwa Sayoni. Narusie obobe bore ase Yakobo;
swahili: Hivyo Israeli wote wataokolewa. Kama ilivyoandikwa: “Mkombozi atakuja kutoka Sayuni; ataondoa kutokumcha Mungu katika Yakobo.

english: And this is My covenant with them when I take away their sins.”
ekegusii: na oko nakwo okobwatana kw’ane nabarabwo, ekero ’ndaache kobaruseria ebibe biabo.”
swahili: Hili ndilo agano langu nao nitakapoziondoa dhambi zao.”

english: Regarding the gospel, they are enemies on your account; but regarding election, they are loved on account of the patriarchs.
ekegusii: Naboigo ase amanag’ana y’enchiri babeire ababisa ba Nyasae ase engencho yaino; korende ase ogochoorwa babeire abanchwa ase engencho ye chisokoro chiabo.
swahili: Kwa habari ya Injili, wao ni adui wa Mungu kwa ajili yenu, lakini kuhusu kule kuteuliwa kwao ni wapendwa, kwa ajili ya mababa zao wa zamani,

english: For God’s gifts and His call are irrevocable.
ekegusii: Inaki Nyasae tari gweiteria ebiegwa biaye na okorangeria kwaye.
swahili: kwa maana akishawapa watu karama, Mungu haziondoi, wala wito wake.

english: “Lord, they have killed Your prophets and torn down Your altars. I am the only one left, and they are seeking my life as well”?
ekegusii: “Omonene, baitire ababani bao, batagoire egesasiimero kiao, ninche bweka natigaire, na barabwo nkorigia bare obogima bwane babosirie.”
swahili: Alisema, “Bwana, wamewaua manabii wako na kuzibomoa madhabahu zako, nimebaki mimi peke yangu, nao wanataka kuniua?”

english: Just as you who formerly disobeyed God have now received mercy through their disobedience,
ekegusii: Inaki buna inwe kare motarenge koigwera Nyasae, korende bono mwanyorire amaabera ase engencho y’ogotaigwera kwabo,
swahili: Kama vile ninyi wakati fulani mlivyokuwa waasi kwa Mungu lakini sasa mmepata rehema kwa sababu ya kutokutii kwao,

english: so they too have now disobeyed, in order that they too may now receive mercy through the mercy shown to you.
ekegusii: naboigo na barabwo bono bataigwereti, erinde ase amaabera aya mwanyorire inwe, nabarabwo boigo banyore amaabera.
swahili: hivyo nao Waisraeli wamekuwa waasi ili kwamba wao nao sasa waweze kupata rehema kwa ajili ya rehema za Mungu kwenu.

english: For God has consigned everyone to disobedience so that He may have mercy on everyone. A Hymn of Praise (Isaiah 40:9–31)
ekegusii: Inaki Nyasae osibire bonsi ase ogotaigwera, erinde aborokie bonsi amaabera.
swahili: Kwa maana Mungu amewafunga wanadamu wote kwenye kuasi ili apate kuwarehemu wote. Wimbo Wa Shukrani

english: O, the depth of the riches of the wisdom and knowledge of God! How unsearchable are His judgments, and untraceable His ways!
ekegusii: Aa! Obonge bw’obonda, na obong’aini, ne chisemi bire ase Nyasae! Tibikorengeka. Ebiina biaye tibikomanyekana ne chinchera chiaye tichikoriigeka!
swahili: Tazama jinsi kilivyo kina cha utajiri wa hekima na maarifa ya Mungu! Tazama jinsi ambavyo hukumu zake hazichunguziki, na ambavyo njia zake zisivyotafutikana!

english: “Who has known the mind of the Lord? Or who has been His counselor?”
ekegusii: “Inaki ning’o omanyete ebirengererio bia Omonene? Gose ning’o okomotebereria buna agwenerete agaambe?
swahili: “Ni nani aliyeyafahamu mawazo ya Bwana? Au ni nani ambaye amekuwa mshauri wake?”

english: “Who has first given to God, that God should repay him?”
ekegusii: Gose ning’o omoete ekeegwa ritang’ani, erinde akeiranerigwe?”
swahili: “Au ni nani aliyempa chochote ili arudishiwe?”

english: For from Him and through Him and to Him are all things. To Him be the glory forever! Amen.
ekegusii: Ekiagera ebinto bionsi nigo bikorwa ase are, nigo bire ase okobua kwaye, naende nigo biteneine ase are. Ogotogigwa nokwaye goika kare na kare. Amina.
swahili: Kwa maana vitu vyote vyatoka kwake, viko kwake na kwa ajili yake. Utukufu ni wake milele! Amen.

english: And what was the divine reply to him? “I have reserved for Myself seven thousand men who have not bowed the knee to Baal.”
ekegusii: Korende okoiraneria kwa Nyasae inaki gokomoteebia? “Ninde nabaanto chilifu isano na ibere batabegete amaru inse ase Baali.”
swahili: Je, Mungu alimjibuje? “Nimejibakizia watu elfu saba ambao hawajapiga magoti kumwabudu Baali.”

english: In the same way, at the present time there is a remnant chosen by grace.
ekegusii: Nabo ekero kia bono ’mbare abatigari abachoorirwe ase obuya bwa Nyasae.
swahili: Vivyo hivyo pia, sasa wapo mabaki waliochaguliwa kwa neema ya Mungu.

english: And if it is by grace, then it is no longer by works. Otherwise, grace would no longer be grace.
ekegusii: Korende onye nase obuya, rirorio tibokoba ase ogokora, onye taibo, obuya tibokoba obuya.
swahili: Lakini ikiwa wamechaguliwa kwa neema, si tena kwa msingi wa matendo. Kama ingekuwa kwa matendo, neema isingekuwa neema tena.

english: What then? What Israel was seeking, it failed to obtain, but the elect did. The others were hardened,
ekegusii: Inaki rende abeire? Egento keria Abaisraeli baare korigia tibakenyorete, Baria bachoretwe, mbarabwo bakenyorete, korende abatigarete bagakorwa koba abakong’u ase chinkoro chiabo,
swahili: Tuseme nini basi? Kile kitu ambacho Israeli alikitafuta kwa bidii hakukipata. Lakini waliochaguliwa walikipata. Waliobaki walifanywa wagumu,

english: as it is written: “God gave them a spirit of stupor, eyes that could not see, and ears that could not hear, to this very day.”
ekegusii: buna eriikire, “Nyasae akabaa omoika bwe chitoro, na amaiso atanyare korora, na amato atanyare koigwa, goika reero iga.”
swahili: kama ilivyoandikwa: “Mungu aliwapa bumbuazi la mioyo, macho ili wasiweze kuona, na masikio ili wasiweze kusikia, hadi leo.”

english: And David says: “May their table become a snare and a trap, a stumbling block and a retribution to them.
ekegusii: Na Daudi nigo agoteeba, “Tiga endagera yabo ebe egesugunia na oboreba, na egento gekobagocha, na ogoakanwa kwabo.
swahili: Naye Daudi anasema: “Karamu zao na ziwe tanzi na mtego wa kuwanasa, kitu cha kuwakwaza waanguke, na adhabu kwao.

english: Therefore I urge you, brothers, on account of God’s mercy, to offer your bodies as living sacrifices, holy and pleasing to God, which is your spiritual service of worship.
ekegusii: Gaki baminto, nabasoroire mono ase amaabera a Nyasae, morue emebere yaino ebe ekeng’wanso kere moyo, egechenu, ekeranyare gwanchwa na Nyasae, nakio ogosasiima kwaino gw’ekeene.
swahili: Kwa hiyo, ndugu zangu, nawasihi kwa rehema zake Mungu, itoeni miili yenu iwe dhabihu iliyo hai, takatifu na inayompendeza Mungu, hii ndiyo ibada yenu yenye maana.

english: Be devoted to one another in brotherly love. Outdo yourselves in honoring one another.
ekegusii: Obwanchani bw’obomino bobe ase egati yaino; mobe ab’eritang’ani kworokia abamino amasikani.
swahili: Pendaneni ninyi kwa ninyi kwa upendo wa ndugu. Waheshimuni na kuwatanguliza wengine.

english: Do not let your zeal subside; keep your spiritual fervor, serving the Lord.
ekegusii: Ase omokia oino timoba aboro; mobe n’Omoika ogwoka, mogokorera Omonene.
swahili: Msiwe wavivu, bali mwe na bidii katika roho mkimtumikia Bwana.

english: Be joyful in hope, patient in affliction, persistent in prayer.
ekegusii: Mogoke ase ogosemeria, moremererie ase emechando, mogenderere n’ogosaba.
swahili: Kuweni na furaha katika tumaini, katika dhiki kuweni na saburi, dumuni katika maombi.

english: Share with the saints who are in need. Practice hospitality. Forgiveness (Matthew 18:21–35)
ekegusii: Mobe ang’e gokoonya abachenu ase okoremerwa kwabo, mobe abanyamokia ase okoroisia abageni.
swahili: Changieni katika mahitaji ya watakatifu, wakaribisheni wageni.

english: Bless those who persecute you. Bless and do not curse.
ekegusii: Mosesenie abwo bakobachaanda; basesenie, timobaragereria.
swahili: Wabarikini wale wanaowatesa, barikini wala msilaani.

english: Rejoice with those who rejoice; weep with those who weep.
ekegusii: Goka amo nabwo bakogoka; rera amo nabwo bakorera.
swahili: Furahini pamoja na wenye kufurahi, lieni pamoja na wale waliao.

english: Live in harmony with one another. Do not be proud, but enjoy the company of the lowly. Do not be conceited.
ekegusii: Mobe n’omoyo oyomo inwe ase inwe. Timorengereria ayare amanene, korende mosange n’abare n’oboitongo. Timoba abanto bakoenenera obong’aini.
swahili: Kaeni kwa amani ninyi kwa ninyi. Msijivune, bali mwe tayari kushirikiana na wanyonge. Wala msiwe watu wenye kujivuna kwamba mnajua kila kitu.

english: Do not repay anyone evil for evil. Carefully consider what is right in the eyes of everybody.
ekegusii: Timoakana omonto obobe ase obobe, tang’ania ayare amaya ase amasio y’ abanto bonsi.
swahili: Msimlipe mtu yeyote ovu kwa ovu. Jitahidini ili mtende yaliyo mema machoni pa watu wote.

english: If it is possible on your part, live at peace with everyone.
ekegusii: Keranyarekane ase ensemo yaino, mobe n’omorembe n’abanto bonsi.
swahili: Kama ikiwezekana, kwa upande wenu kaeni kwa amani na watu wote.

english: Do not avenge yourselves, beloved, but leave room for God’s wrath. For it is written: “Vengeance is Mine; I will repay, says the Lord.”
ekegusii: Abanchwa, timorigia kweruseria egesiomba, tiga ribaga ase endamwamu ya Nyasae, ekiagera neriikire, “Omonene oteebire: Egesiomba n’ekiane; inche ning’akane.”
swahili: Wapendwa, msilipize kisasi, bali ipisheni ghadhabu ya Mungu, maana imeandikwa: “Ni juu yangu kulipiza kisasi, nitalipiza,” asema Bwana.

english: Do not be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind. Then you will be able to test and approve what is the good, pleasing, and perfect will of God.
ekegusii: Gose timwereng’ania ne chingencho chi’ense eye; korende moonchorwe, mokorwe koba abayia ase emioyo yaino, monyare korigia na komanya boronge ogwancha kwa Nyasae, na erire rigiya, na eriranchwe, na oboikeranu. Buna etogwenerete tokore nebiegwa bi’Omoika
swahili: Msifuatishe tena mfano wa ulimwengu huu, bali mgeuzwe kwa kufanywa upya nia zenu. Ndipo mtaweza kuonja na kuhakikisha ni nini mapenzi ya Mungu yaliyo mema, yanayopendeza machoni pake na ukamilifu.

english: On the contrary, “If your enemy is hungry, feed him; if he is thirsty, give him a drink. For in so doing, you will heap burning coals on his head.”
ekegusii: Naboigo, “Omobisa oo karabe nenchara, moragerie, kar’abe n’erang’o, moe anywe, ekiagera korakore ayio, nomobekere amakara y’omorero ase omotwe oye.”
swahili: Badala yake: “Kama adui yako ana njaa, mlishe; kama ana kiu, mpe kinywaji. Kwa kufanya hivyo, unaweka makaa ya moto yanayowaka kichwani pake.”

english: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
ekegusii: Tobugwa n’obobe, korende obue obobe ase obuya.
swahili: Usishindwe na ubaya, bali uushinde ubaya kwa wema.

english: For by the grace given me I say to every one of you: Do not think of yourself more highly than you ought, but think of yourself with sober judgment, according to the measure of faith God has given you.
ekegusii: Inaki ase obuya naetwe nigo ngoteebia kera omonto oyore ase more, tabaisa kweenenia ere omonyene ase ebirengererio biaye kobua buna emogwenerete korengereria; korende abe n’ebirengererio ebironge koreng’ana buna Nyasae aeire kera omonto ekerengo gi’okwegena.
swahili: Kwa ajili ya neema niliyopewa nawaambia kila mmoja miongoni mwenu, asijidhanie kuwa bora kuliko impasavyo, bali afikiri kwa busara kwa kulingana na kipimo cha imani Mungu aliyompa.

english: Just as each of us has one body with many members, and not all members have the same function,
ekegusii: Inaki buna ase omobere tore nebiimo ebinge, na birobio tibiri gokora omoremo oyomo;
swahili: Kama vile katika mwili mmoja tulivyo na viungo vingi, navyo viungo vyote havina kazi moja,

english: so in Christ we who are many are one body, and each member belongs to one another.
ekegusii: naboigo naintwe, nonya tore abange, nigo tore omobere oyomo ase Kristo, na intwe twensi nigo tore buna ebiimo kera oyomo ase oy’omwabo.
swahili: vivyo hivyo na sisi tulio wengi, tu mwili mmoja katika Kristo, nasi kila mmoja ni kiungo cha mwenzake.

english: We have different gifts according to the grace given us. If one’s gift is prophecy, let him use it in proportion to his faith;
ekegusii: Nigo tore nebiegwa ao ao koreng’ana n’obuya twaeirwe; onye n’obobani tobane koreng’ana n’okwegena gwaito;
swahili: Tuna karama zilizotofautiana kila mmoja kutokana na neema tuliyopewa. Kama ni unabii na tutoe unabii kwa kadiri ya imani.

english: if it is serving, let him serve; if it is teaching, let him teach;
ekegusii: onye n’ogokorera, tobeo ase ogokorera gwaito; oyo okworokereria abe ase okworokereria kwaye;
swahili: Kama ni kuhudumu na tuhudumu, mwenye kufundisha na afundishe,

english: if it is encouraging, let him encourage; if it is giving, let him give generously; if it is leading, let him lead with diligence; if it is showing mercy, let him do it cheerfully. Love, Zeal, Hope, Hospitality (John 13:31–35; 1 John 3:11–24)
ekegusii: oyo okoremia abe ase okoremia kwaye; oyo okorua arue ase omoyo omorabu; oyo ogotenenera atenenere ase omokia; oyo okororera amaabera arorere amaabera n’omogooko. Emeroberio y’obogima bw’obokristo
swahili: kama ni kutia moyo na atie moyo, kama ni kuchangia kwa ajili ya mahitaji ya wengine na atoe kwa ukarimu, kama ni uongozi na aongoze kwa bidii, kama ni kuhurumia wengine na afanye hivyo kwa furaha. Alama Za Mkristo Wa Kweli

english: Love must be sincere. Detest what is evil; cling to what is good.
ekegusii: Obwanchani bobe botari n’obong’ainereria. Gecha erire riibe, bwatana n’erire rigiya.
swahili: Upendo lazima usiwe na unafiki. Chukieni lililo ovu, shikamaneni na lililo jema.

english: Everyone must submit himself to the governing authorities, for there is no authority except that which is from God. The authorities that exist have been appointed by God.
ekegusii: Tiga kera omonto abe omoigweri ase abare n’okobua, ekiagera okobua konde tikori gotarueti ase Nyasae, na koria koreo nokobekire na Nyasae.
swahili: Kila mtu na atii mamlaka inayotawala, kwa maana hakuna mamlaka isiyotoka kwa Mungu, nazo mamlaka zilizopo zimewekwa na Mungu.

english: Love does no wrong to its neighbor. Therefore love is the fulfillment of the law. The Day Is Near
ekegusii: Obwanchani tibogokorera omogisangio oo bobe; naboigo, obwanchani nabwo bogoikerania amachiiko. Ogocha kw’erituko ria Kristo
swahili: Upendo haumfanyii jirani jambo baya. Kwa hiyo upendo ndio utimilifu wa sheria.

english: And do this, understanding the occasion. The hour has come for you to wake up from your slumber, for our salvation is nearer now than when we first believed.
ekegusii: Kora ayio, ekiagera mwamanyire ng’a amatuko aikire, na engaki yaino y’okoboka korwa ase chitoro yabeire ang’e. Inaki bono ogotooreka nigo kore ang’e naintwe kobua ekero keria twachaagete kwegena.
swahili: Nanyi fanyeni hivi, mkiutambua wakati tulio nao. Saa ya kuamka kutoka usingizini imewadia, kwa maana sasa wokovu wetu umekaribia zaidi kuliko hapo kwanza tulipoamini.

english: The night is nearly over; the day has drawn near. So let us lay aside the deeds of darkness and put on the armor of light.
ekegusii: Obotuko bwaisire koera, omobaso obeire ang’e. Torusie ogokora kw’omosunte; tweboyie ebirwanero bi’omobaso.
swahili: Usiku umeendelea sana, mapambazuko yamekaribia. Kwa hiyo tuyaweke kando matendo ya giza na tuvae silaha za nuru.

english: Let us behave decently, as in the daytime, not in carousing and drunkenness, not in sexual immorality and debauchery, not in dissension and jealousy.
ekegusii: Totaare buna egwenerete ase omobaso; tari ase okoria bobe na gotinda, tari ase obotomani na ase obonyaka, tari ase eriomana ne ribero.
swahili: Basi na tuenende kwa adabu kama inavyopasa wakati wa mchana, si kwa kufanya karamu za ulafi na ulevi, si kwa ufisadi na uasherati, si kwa ugomvi na wivu.

english: Instead, clothe yourselves with the Lord Jesus Christ, and make no provision for the desires of the flesh.
ekegusii: Korende mweboyie Omonene Yeso Kristo, timoa omobere ribaga goikerania okogania kwaye kw’ebibe.
swahili: Bali jivikeni Bwana Yesu Kristo, wala msifikiri jinsi mtakavyotimiza tamaa za miili yenu yenye asili ya dhambi.

english: Consequently, whoever resists authority is opposing what God has set in place, and those who do so will bring judgment on themselves.
ekegusii: Naboigo oy’otari koigwera oyore n’okobua, nigo akoamererania naya Nyasae achiikire; na barabwo abakoamererania inabenyorere ekiina.
swahili: Kwa hiyo yeye anayeasi dhidi ya mamlaka inayotawala anaasi dhidi ya kile kilichowekwa na Mungu, nao wale wafanyao hivyo watajiletea hukumu juu yao wenyewe.

english: For rulers are not a terror to good conduct, but to bad. Do you want to be unafraid of the one in authority? Then do what is right, and you will have his approval.
ekegusii: Inaki abakogaamba tibari kogosa abanto ase engencho y’ogokora okuya, korende nase engencho y’ogokora okobe. Inee! Torigeti komoiroka oyore n’okobua? Kora ayare amaya, na aye nonyore ogotogigwa ase amaya aria.
swahili: Kwa kuwa watawala hawawatishi watu wale wanaotenda mema bali wale wanaotenda mabaya. Je, wataka usimwogope mwenye mamlaka? Basi tenda lile lililo jema naye atakusifu.

english: For he is God’s servant for your good. But if you do wrong, be afraid, for he does not carry the sword in vain. He is God’s servant, an agent of retribution to the wrongdoer.
ekegusii: Inaki oyore n’okobua, ere n’omokoreri o Nyasae ase ogokonyorera amaya. Korende korakore amabe nekogwenerete oiroke; inaki ere tabogoreti omoro bosa, ekiagera n’omokoreri o Nyasae ase ogoakana egesiomba ase omokori amabe na komoa egesusuro.
swahili: Kwa maana mwenye mamlaka ni mtumishi wa Mungu kwa ajili ya mema. Lakini kama ukitenda mabaya, basi ogopa, kwa kuwa hauinui upanga bila sababu. Yeye ni mtumishi wa Mungu, mjumbe wa Mungu wa kutekeleza adhabu juu ya watenda mabaya.

english: Therefore it is necessary to submit to authority, not only to avoid punishment, but also as a matter of conscience.
ekegusii: Ase ayio negwenerete kera oyomo aigwere, tari ase engencho y ’endamwamu ya Nyasae yoka, korende aigwere boigo, erinde enkoro yaye temogaambia.
swahili: Kwa hiyo ni lazima kutii wenye mamlaka, si kwa sababu ya kuogopa adhabu iwezayo kutolewa, bali pia kwa ajili ya dhamiri.

english: This is also why you pay taxes. For the authorities are God’s servants, who devote themselves to their work.
ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio naende nakio mokoruera ebango, ekiagera abare n’okobua nigo bare abakoreri ba Nyasae, ase ogokora emeremo eyio eyio.
swahili: Kwa sababu hii mnalipa kodi, kwa maana watawala ni watumishi wa Mungu, ambao hutumia muda wao wote kutawala.

english: Pay everyone what you owe him: taxes to whom taxes are due, revenue to whom revenue is due, respect to whom respect is due, honor to whom honor is due. Love Fulfills the Law (Leviticus 19:9–18)
ekegusii: Bae bonsi ebiaboronge biabo: omonto bw’ebango, ebango; na omonto bw’ogochooga, ogochooga; oyogwenerete koirokwa, tiga airokwe; na oyogwenerete gosikwa, tiga asikwe. Mobe nobwanchani inwe ase inwe
swahili: Mlipeni kila mtu kile mnachodaiwa. Kama mnadaiwa kodi lipeni kodi, kama ni ushuru, lipeni ushuru, astahiliye hofu, mhofu, astahiliye heshima, mheshimu. Kupendana Kila Mmoja Na Mwingine

english: Be indebted to no one, except to one another in love. For he who loves his neighbor has fulfilled the law.
ekegusii: Timoba n’esira ase onde bwensi otatiga ogwanchana, ekiagera oy’omwanchete omogisangio oye oikeranirie amachiiko.
swahili: Msidaiwe kitu na mtu yeyote, isipokuwa kupendana, kwa maana yeye ampendaye mwenzake, ameitimiza sheria.

english: The commandments “Do not commit adultery,” “Do not murder,” “Do not steal,” “Do not covet,” and any other commandments, are summed up in this one decree: “Love your neighbor as yourself.”
ekegusii: Inaki amachiiko aya, “Totomana, Toita, Toiba, Toba nokogania okobe”, na gakorabeo gochiika konde gwonsi, kwabeekeraniigwe amo ase ring’ana eri, “Ancha omogisangio oo buna bweanchete.”
swahili: Kwa kuwa amri hizi zisemazo, “Usizini,” “Usiue,” “Usiibe,” “Usitamani,” na amri nyingine zote, zinajumlishwa katika amri hii moja: “Mpende jirani yako kama nafsi yako.”

english: Accept him whose faith is weak, without passing judgment on his opinions.
ekegusii: Moroisie ere oy’otari na nguru ase okwegena, motari koamererania.
swahili: Mkaribisheni yeye ambaye imani yake ni dhaifu, lakini si kwa kugombana na kubishana juu ya mawazo yake.

english: Why, then, do you judge your brother? Or why do you belittle your brother? For we will all stand before God’s judgment seat.
ekegusii: Korende aye, nase ki okogaambia oy’omino? Gose aye, nase ki ogochaaya oy’omino? Inaki intwe twensi inatoche gotenena bosio bw’ekerogo gi’ekina kia Nyasae.
swahili: Basi kwa nini wewe wamhukumu ndugu yako? Au kwa nini wewe unamdharau ndugu yako? Kwa kuwa sote tutasimama mbele ya kiti cha Mungu cha hukumu.

english: It is written: “As surely as I live, says the Lord, every knee will bow before Me; every tongue will confess to God.”
ekegusii: Inaki neriikire, “Omonene oteebire: Amaene buna inde moyo, kera riiru inaribekwe inse ase obosio bwane, na kera oromeme ’naromobeere Nyasae kirori.”
swahili: Kwa kuwa imeandikwa: “ ‘Kama vile niishivyo,’ asema Bwana, ‘kila goti litapigwa mbele zangu, na kila ulimi utakiri kwa Mungu.’ ”

english: So then, each of us will give an account of himself to God. The Law of Love (Ezekiel 14:1–11; 1 Corinthians 8:1–13)
ekegusii: Ase igo, kera omonto ore ase egati yaito naache gwekwanera ere omonyene ase obosio bwa Nyasae.
swahili: Hivyo basi kila mmoja wetu atatoa habari zake mwenyewe kwa Mungu. Usimfanye Ndugu Yako Ajikwae

english: Therefore let us stop judging one another. Instead, make up your mind not to put any stumbling block or obstacle in your brother’s way.
ekegusii: Ase ayio, titoba nkona‐kogaambania tore, korende anga mbuya kobua togaambe ng’a onde tabeekera oy’omwabo egento gekomogocha gose gekomotanga.
swahili: Kwa hiyo tusiendelee kuhukumiana: Badala yake mtu asiweke kamwe kikwazo au kizuizi katika njia ya ndugu mwingine.

english: I am convinced and fully persuaded in the Lord Jesus that nothing is unclean in itself. But if anyone regards something as unclean, then for him it is unclean.
ekegusii: Namanyire, naende naenekirie ase Omonene Yeso, ng’a gento kende tikeri ekebe ekenyene, korende nigo kere ekebe ase oyo okeroche ng’a negento ekebe.
swahili: Ninajua tena nimehakikishiwa sana katika Bwana Yesu kwamba hakuna kitu chochote ambacho ni najisi kwa asili yake. Lakini kama mtu anakiona kitu kuwa ni najisi, basi kwake huyo kitu hicho ni najisi.

english: If your brother is distressed by what you eat, you are no longer acting in love. Do not by your eating destroy your brother, for whom Christ died.
ekegusii: Onye oy’omino okoba n’ogwechanda ase engencho y’endagera okoria aye, gwatigire gotaara ase obwanchani. Ase engencho y’endagera yao tomobeyia omonto oria, ere Kristo akwete ase engencho yaye.
swahili: Kama ndugu yako anahuzunishwa kwa sababu ya kile unachokula, basi huenendi tena katika upendo. Usiruhusu kile unachokula kiwe sababu ya kumwangamiza ndugu yako ambaye Kristo alikufa kwa ajili yake.

english: Do not allow what you consider good, then, to be spoken of as evil.
ekegusii: Timotiga ayare amaya ase more atorwe ng’a n’amabe.
swahili: Usiruhusu kile ambacho unakiona kuwa chema kisemwe kuwa ni kiovu.

english: For the kingdom of God is not a matter of eating and drinking, but of righteousness, peace, and joy in the Holy Spirit.
ekegusii: Inaki oborwoti bwa Nyasae tari okoria na okonywa, korende oboronge, na omorembe, na omogooko bikorwa ase Omoika Omochenu.
swahili: Kwa maana Ufalme wa Mungu si kula na kunywa, bali ni haki, amani na furaha katika Roho Mtakatifu.

english: For whoever serves Christ in this way is pleasing to God and approved by men.
ekegusii: Ere oy’ogokorera Kristo ase amang’ana aya onsi nigo akogwenera Nyasae, naende nigo agwancherwa na Mwanyabaanto.
swahili: Kwa sababu mtu yeyote anayemtumikia Kristo kwa jinsi hii, anampendeza Mungu na kukubaliwa na wanadamu.

english: So then, let us pursue what leads to peace and to mutual edification.
ekegusii: Ase igo, tiga torigie chingencho chi’omorembe ne chingencho chigwenerete ase okoagachana.
swahili: Kwa hiyo na tufanye bidii kutafuta yale yaletayo amani na kujengana sisi kwa sisi.

english: For one person has faith to eat all things, while another, who is weak, eats only vegetables.
ekegusii: Omonto oyomo bwegenete ng’a nanyare koria bionsi, korende ere oy’otari na nguru nigo akoria chinyeni.
swahili: Mtu mmoja imani yake inamruhusu kula kila kitu, lakini mwingine ambaye imani yake ni dhaifu, hula mboga tu.

english: Do not destroy the work of God for the sake of food. All food is clean, but it is wrong for a man to let his eating be a stumbling block.
ekegusii: Ase engencho y’endagera tosaria emeremo ya Nyasae. Bionsi nebichenu; korende ’mbobe omonto oragere abande bagochwe ase engencho y’ebiakoria.
swahili: Usiiharibu kazi ya Mungu kwa ajili ya chakula. Hakika vyakula vyote ni safi, lakini ni kosa kula kitu chochote kinachomsababisha ndugu yako ajikwae.

english: It is better not to eat meat or drink wine or to do anything to cause your brother to stumble.
ekegusii: Mbuya gotaria enyama, nonya ’nkonywa edivai, gose gokora gento kende gionsi keragoche oy’omino.
swahili: Ni afadhali kutokula nyama wala kunywa divai au kufanya jambo lingine lolote litakalomsababisha ndugu yako ajikwae.

english: Keep your belief about such matters between yourself and God. Blessed is the one who does not condemn himself by what he approves.
ekegusii: Okwegena okwo ore nakwo, obe nakorokwo ase egati yao na Nyasae. Nasesenirie omonto oria otenachereti ekiina ase ring’ana riria anchete.
swahili: Je, wewe unayo imani? Ile imani uliyo nayo, uwe nayo nafsini mwako mbele za Mungu. Heri mtu yule asiye na sababu ya kujihukumu nafsi yake kwa ajili ya kile anachokifanya.

english: But the one who has doubts is condemned if he eats, because his eating is not from faith; and everything that is not from faith is sin.
ekegusii: Korende oyore ne chitang’u‐tang’u onye okoria, onacheirwe ekiina, ekiagera tarieti ase okwegena; na ogokora konde gwonsi gotarueti ase okwegena nebibe.
swahili: Lakini kama mtu ana shaka kuhusu kile anachokula, amehukumiwa, kwa sababu hakula kwa imani. Kwa kuwa chochote kinachofanywa pasipo imani ni dhambi.

english: The one who eats everything must not belittle the one who does not, and the one who does not eat everything must not judge the one who does, for God has accepted him.
ekegusii: Oyokoria tachaaya oria otari koria, na oria otari koria tagaambia oria okoria, ekiagera Nyasae omwancheire.
swahili: Yeye alaye kila kitu asimdharau yeye asiyekula. Wala yeye asiyekula kila kitu asimhukumu yule alaye kila kitu, kwa maana Mungu amemkubali.

english: Who are you to judge someone else’s servant? To his own master he stands or falls. And he will stand, for the Lord is able to make him stand.
ekegusii: Aye naye ning’o okogaambia omosomba bw’omonto onde? Ase omonene oye omonyene nigo ateneine gose nigo akogwa. Ee, natenene, ekiagera Omonene nere ore n’okobua gw’okomotenenia.
swahili: Wewe ni nani hata umhukumu mtumishi wa mtu mwingine? Kwa bwana wake tu anasimama au kuanguka. Naye atasimama kwa sababu Bwana anaweza kumsimamisha.

english: One person regards a certain day above the others, while someone else considers every day alike. Each one should be fully convinced in his own mind.
ekegusii: Omonto oyomo narengereretie ng’a rituko erimo nerinene kobua erinde, na oyonde arora ng’a amatuko onsi nigo areng’aine. Tiga kera omonto aisaneke ase aya amanyete omonyene.
swahili: Mtu mmoja anaitukuza siku fulani kuwa ni bora kuliko nyingine, na mwingine anaona kuwa siku zote ni sawa. Basi kila mmoja awe na hakika na yale anayoamini.

english: He who observes a special day does so to the Lord; he who eats does so to the Lord, for he gives thanks to God; and he who abstains does so to the Lord and gives thanks to God.
ekegusii: Ere oyokorenda rituko, nigo akorirenda ase Omonene, na ere oyokoria, nigo akoria ase Omonene, ekiagera nigo agoakera Nyasae ng’a mbuya mono; ere oy’otari koria, nigo agokora bo ase Omonene, na aakera Nyasae ng’a mbuya mono.
swahili: Yeye anayehesabu siku moja kuwa takatifu kuliko nyingine, hufanya hivyo kwa kumheshimu Bwana. Naye alaye nyama hula kwa Bwana, kwa maana humshukuru Mungu, naye akataaye kula nyama hufanya hivyo kwa Bwana na humshukuru Mungu.

english: For none of us lives to himself alone, and none of us dies to himself alone.
ekegusii: Ekiagera onde tari ase egati yaito ore moyo ase engencho yaye omonyene; na onde tari ogokwa ase engencho yaye omonyene.
swahili: Kwa kuwa hakuna hata mmoja wetu anayeishi kwa ajili yake mwenyewe, wala hakuna hata mmoja wetu afaye kwa ajili yake mwenyewe.

english: If we live, we live to the Lord, and if we die, we die to the Lord. So whether we live or die, we belong to the Lord.
ekegusii: Inaki onye tore moyo, nigo tore moyo ase Omonene; gose gatorakwe, nigo torakwe ase Omonene. Naboigo, onye tore moyo, gose gatorakwe, nigo tore aba Omonene.
swahili: Kama tunaishi, tunaishi kwa Bwana, nasi pia tukifa tunakufa kwa Bwana. Kwa hiyo basi, kama tukiishi au kama tukifa, sisi ni mali ya Bwana.

english: For this reason Christ died and returned to life, that He might be the Lord of both the dead and the living.
ekegusii: Inaki Kristo nigo akwete, naende akaba moyo, erinde abe Omonene ase abare moyo na ase abakuure boigo.
swahili: Kwani kwa sababu hii hasa, Kristo alikufa na akawa hai tena kusudi apate kuwa Bwana wa wote, yaani, waliokufa na walio hai.

english: We who are strong ought to bear with the shortcomings of the weak and not to please ourselves.
ekegusii: Intwe abatore ne chinguru netogwenerete kobogoria oboreu bw’abatari ne chinguru, tetogwenereti kwegwenera intwe abanyene.
swahili: Sisi tulio na nguvu, hatuna budi kuchukuliana na kushindwa kwa wale walio dhaifu wala si kujipendeza nafsi zetu wenyewe.

english: Again, it says: “Rejoice, O Gentiles, with His people.”
ekegusii: Naende nigo agoteeba, “Abanto b’Ebisaku, goka amo n’abanto ba n’Omonene.”
swahili: Tena yasema, “Enyi watu wa Mataifa, furahini pamoja na watu wa Mungu.”

english: And again: “Praise the Lord, all you Gentiles, and extol Him, all you peoples.”
ekegusii: Naende, “Abanto b’Ebisaku bionsi, motogie Omonene; abanto bonsi bamobaake!”
swahili: Tena, “Msifuni Bwana, ninyi watu wa Mataifa wote, na kumwimbia sifa, enyi watu wote.”

english: And once more, Isaiah says: “The Root of Jesse will appear, One who will arise to rule over the Gentiles; in Him the Gentiles will put their hope.”
ekegusii: Naende Isaya nigo agokwana, “Ritina ria Yese inariiche, ere naoroke kogaambera abanto b’Ebisaku; nere abanto b’Ebisaku barasemerie.”
swahili: Tena Isaya anasema, “Shina la Yese litachipuka, yeye atakayeinuka ili kutawala juu ya mataifa. Watu wa Mataifa watamtumaini.”

english: Now may the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace as you believe in Him, so that you may overflow with hope by the power of the Holy Spirit. Paul the Minister to the Gentiles
ekegusii: Naboigo Nyasae bw’ogosemerigwa abaichorie n’omogooko bwonsi na omorembe ase okwegena, monyare komenta mono ase ogosemeria ase chinguru chi’Omoika Omochenu. Paulo ogosaba ogwancherwa ase oboremu bwaye bw’okoriika
swahili: Mungu wa tumaini awajaze ninyi furaha yote na amani katika kumwamini, ili mpate kujawa na tumaini tele kwa nguvu ya Roho Mtakatifu. Paulo Mhudumu Wa Watu Wa Mataifa

english: I myself am convinced, my brothers, that you yourselves are full of goodness, brimming with knowledge, and able to instruct one another.
ekegusii: Abaminto, inche omonyene naenekerigwe igoro yaino ng’a mwaichoirwe n’amaya, naende mwaichoirwe ne chisemi chionsi, na monyare kworokererania.
swahili: Ndugu zangu, mimi mwenyewe ninasadiki kwamba mmejaa wema na ufahamu wote, tena mnaweza kufundishana ninyi kwa ninyi.

english: However, I have written you a bold reminder on some points, because of the grace God has given me
ekegusii: Korende nabariikeire ase oboremu kobua ase chinsemo chinde chie riirube eri, nkobainyoria ase obuya boria naetwe na Nyasae,
swahili: Nimewaandikia kwa ujasiri vipengele kadha wa kadha katika waraka huu kama kuwakumbusha tena kwa habari ya ile neema Mungu aliyonipa,

english: to be a minister of Christ Jesus to the Gentiles in the priestly service of the gospel of God, so that the Gentiles might become an offering acceptable to God, sanctified by the Holy Spirit.
ekegusii: erinde imbe omosomba o Kristo Yeso ase ogokorera abanto b’Ebisaku, emeremo y’obokuani ase okorandia enchiri ya Nyasae, erinde ekeng’wanso kiabo giancherwe, gechenwe n’Omoika Omochenu.
swahili: ili kuwa mhudumu wa Kristo Yesu kwa watu wa Mataifa nikiwa na huduma ya kikuhani ya kutangaza Injili ya Mungu, ili watu wa Mataifa wapate kuwa dhabihu inayokubaliwa na Mungu, iliyotakaswa na Roho Mtakatifu.

english: Therefore I exult in Christ Jesus in my service to God.
ekegusii: Bono ninde n’engencho y’okweenenia ime ya Kristo Yeso ase emeremo y’ane ase obosio bwa Nyasae.
swahili: Kwa hiyo ninajisifu katika Kristo Yesu, kwenye utumishi wangu kwa Mungu.

english: I will not presume to speak of anything except what Christ has accomplished through me in leading the Gentiles to obedience by word and deed,
ekegusii: Inaki tinkonyara gwatora ring’ana rinde otatiga eri Kristo akorete goetera ase emeremo y’ane, erinde abanto b’Ebisaku banyare koigwera ase engencho ye ring’ana na ogokora,
swahili: Kwa maana sitathubutu kusema kitu chochote zaidi ya kile ambacho Kristo amefanya kwa kunitumia mimi katika kuwaongoza watu wa Mataifa wamtii Mungu kwa yale niliyosema na kufanya,

english: by the power of signs and wonders, and by the power of the Spirit of God. So from Jerusalem all the way around to Illyricum, I have fully proclaimed the gospel of Christ.
ekegusii: ase chinguru chi’ebikone na amakumia, ase chinguru chi’Omoika Omochenu. Naikire korandia enchiri ya Kristo ase Yerusalemu ne chinsemo chionsi chietanaine goika Iluriko.
swahili: kwa nguvu za ishara na miujiza, kwa uweza wa Roho wa Mungu, hivyo kuanzia Yerusalemu hadi maeneo yote ya kandokando yake mpaka Iliriko, nimekwisha kuihubiri Injili ya Kristo kwa ukamilifu.

english: Each of us should please his neighbor for his good, to build him up.
ekegusii: Kera omonto ore ase egati yaito tiga agwenere omogisangio oye, anyore obuya, erinde tonyare koagachana,
swahili: Kila mmoja wetu inampasa kumpendeza jirani yake kwa mambo mema, ili kumjenga katika imani.

english: In this way I have aspired to preach the gospel where Christ was not known, so that I would not be building on someone else’s foundation.
ekegusii: Naboigo nakorete omokia one korandia enchiri, korende tari aase erieta ria Kristo riaikire koigugwa, erinde timbaisa koagacha ase oboroso bw’omonto onde,
swahili: Hivyo ni nia yangu kuhubiri Habari Njema, si pale ambapo Kristo amekwisha kujulikana, ili nisije nikajenga juu ya msingi wa mtu mwingine.

english: Rather, as it is written: “Those who were not told about Him will see, and those who have not heard will understand.”
ekegusii: korende, buna eriikire, “Baria batana goteebigwa amang’ana igoro yaye, inabarore, na baria batana koyaigwa, inabamanye.” Emeroberio ya Paulo omonyene
swahili: Lakini kama ilivyoandikwa: “Wale ambao hawajahubiriwa habari zake wataona, nao wale ambao hawajazisikia watafahamu.”

english: That is why I have often been hindered from coming to you. Paul’s Travel Plans (1 Corinthians 16:5–9)
ekegusii: Eke nakio kiagerete ingatangwa ebiro ebinge tinaacha ase more.
swahili: Hii ndiyo sababu nimezuiliwa mara nyingi nisiweze kuja kwenu. Paulo Apanga Kwenda Rumi

english: But now that there are no further opportunities for me in these regions, and since I have longed for many years to visit you,
ekegusii: Korende bono tindi ne ribaga rinde ri’ogokora emeremo ase chinsemo echi, naende korwa emiaka emenge inarenge namaiga gocha ase more.
swahili: Lakini sasa kwa kuwa hakuna nafasi zaidi kwa ajili yangu katika sehemu hii, ninatamani kuja kwenu kama ambavyo nimekuwa na shauku kwa miaka mingi.

english: I hope to see you on my way to Spain. And after I have enjoyed your company for a while, you can equip me for my journey.
ekegusii: Ekero nkogenda gochia Hispania ninganetie ng’etere seino, ’mbarore. Na magega konabeire amo nainwe ase ogokonyana ase ekero egeke, namonkoobe.
swahili: Nimekusudia kufanya hivyo nitakapokuwa njiani kwenda Hispania. Natarajia kuwaona katika safari yangu na kusafirishwa nanyi mpaka huko, baada ya kufurahia ushirika wenu kwa kitambo kidogo.

english: Now, however, I am on my way to Jerusalem to serve the saints there.
ekegusii: Na bono ningende Yerusalemu, imbe ingokorera abachenu.
swahili: Sasa, niko njiani kuelekea Yerusalemu kwa ajili ya kuwahudumia watakatifu huko.

english: For Macedonia and Achaia were pleased to make a contribution for the poor among the saints in Jerusalem.
ekegusii: Inaki agweneire abanto ba Makedonia na Akaya gosangereria ebiegwa bi’ogokonya abachenu ba Yerusalemu, baria bare abataka.
swahili: Kwa kuwa imewapendeza watu wa Makedonia na Akaya kufanya changizo kwa ajili ya maskini walioko miongoni mwa watakatifu huko Yerusalemu.

english: They were pleased to do it, and indeed they owe it to them. For if the Gentiles have shared in their spiritual blessings, they are obligated to minister to them with material blessings.
ekegusii: Ee, amaene, abagweneire gokora bo, naende nabasiira babo bare, ekiagera onye abanto b’Ebisaku babwatanire nabarabwo ase ogosesenigwa kwabo kw’omoika, igo nebagwenerete bakorere abachenu baria ase ebinto birabakonye ase obogima obo.
swahili: Imewapendeza kufanya hivyo, naam, kwani ni wadeni wao. Kwa maana ikiwa watu wa Mataifa wameshiriki baraka za rohoni za Wayahudi, wao ni wadeni wa Wayahudi, ili Wayahudi nao washiriki baraka zao za mambo ya mwilini.

english: So after I have completed this service and have safely delivered this bounty to them, I will set off to Spain by way of you.
ekegusii: Naboigo kondaikeranie ring’ana eri na kobaa ebiegwa ebi biasangererigwe, ekero nabibekire ekemanyererio, ning’etere seino konde orogendo rw’ane gochia Hispania.
swahili: Kwa hiyo baada ya kukamilisha kazi hii na kuhakikisha kuwa wamepokea kila kitu kilichokusanywa, nitapitia kwenu nikiwa njiani kwenda Hispania.

english: I know that when I come to you, I will come in the fullness of the blessing of Christ.
ekegusii: Na inche namanyire ng’a kondache ase more, ninchiche nogoichorwa kw’ogosesenigwa gwa Kristo.
swahili: Ninajua kwamba nitakapokuja kwenu, nitakuja na wingi wa baraka za Kristo.

english: For even Christ did not please Himself, but as it is written: “The insults of those who insult You have fallen on Me.”
ekegusii: Inaki Kristo tegwenerete ere omonyene; korende buna eriikire, “Emerumi yabo bakoramete nigo yangwerete inche.”
swahili: Kwa maana hata Kristo hakujipendeza mwenyewe, bali kama ilivyoandikwa: “Matukano yao wale wanaokutukana wewe yalinipata mimi.”

english: Now I urge you, brothers, by our Lord Jesus Christ and by the love of the Spirit, to join me in my struggle by praying to God for me.
ekegusii: Nabasoroire baminto ase Omonene oito Yeso Kristo na ase obwanchani bw’Omoika Omochenu, mobe n’omokia amo nainche ase ogosaba kwaino ase engencho y’ane ase obosio bwa Nyasae;
swahili: Basi, ndugu zangu, nawasihi kwa Jina la Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo na kwa upendo wa Roho Mtakatifu, kujiunga nami katika taabu zangu mkiniombea kwa Mungu.

english: Pray that I may be delivered from the unbelievers in Judea, and that my service in Jerusalem may be acceptable to the saints there,
ekegusii: erinde nsiborwe korwa ase baria bategeneti ase Boyahudi, naende emeremo imbwate aaria Yerusalemu yancheirwe n’abachenu.
swahili: Ombeni ili nipate kuokolewa mikononi mwa wale wasioamini walioko Uyahudi, na kwamba utumishi wangu upate kukubaliwa na watakatifu wa huko Yerusalemu,

english: so that by God’s will I may come to you with joy and together with you be refreshed.
ekegusii: Igo niny’are gocha ase more n’omogooko, Nyasae karanche, na konyora ogotimoka amo nainwe.
swahili: ili kwa mapenzi ya Mungu niweze kuja kwenu kwa furaha, nami niburudishwe pamoja nanyi.

english: The God of peace be with all of you. Amen.
ekegusii: Nyasae bw’omorembe abe amo nainwe mwensi. Amina.
swahili: Mungu wa amani na awe pamoja nanyi nyote. Amen.

english: For everything that was written in the past was written for our instruction, so that through endurance and the encouragement of the Scriptures, we might have hope.
ekegusii: Inaki onsi ayatang’anete koriikwa korwa kare nigo arigetwe ase ogotworokereria intwe, erinde ase oboremereria na ase okoremigwa tokonyora korwa ase amariiko, tonyare koba nogosemeria.
swahili: Kwa maana kila kitu kilichoandikwa zamani, kiliandikwa kutufundisha, ili kwamba kwa saburi na faraja tunayopata katika Maandiko tuwe na tumaini.

english: Now may the God who gives endurance and encouragement grant you harmony with one another in Christ Jesus,
ekegusii: Na Nyasae bw’oboremereria na bw’okoremia abakoonye mobe n’omoyo oyomo inwe ase inwe ase omogwekano o Kristo Yeso;
swahili: Mungu atoaye saburi na faraja, awajalie ninyi roho ya umoja miongoni mwenu mnapomfuata Kristo Yesu,

english: so that with one mind and one voice you may glorify the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ. Christ the Servant of Jews and Gentiles
ekegusii: erio ase omoyo oyomo monyare komobaka Nyasae Tata n’Omonene oito Yeso Kristo. Enchiri ase abanto b’Ebisaku
swahili: ili kwa moyo mmoja mpate kumtukuza Mungu aliye Baba wa Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo. Injili Sawa Kwa Wayahudi Na Kwa Watu Wa Mataifa

english: Accept one another, then, just as Christ accepted you, in order to bring glory to God.
ekegusii: Naboigo moroisanie buna Kristo nere abaroisetie inwe, erinde Nyasae abaakwe.
swahili: Karibishaneni ninyi kwa ninyi kama Kristo alivyowakaribisha ninyi ili kumletea Mungu utukufu.

english: For I tell you that Christ has become a servant of the circumcised on behalf of God’s truth, to confirm the promises made to the patriarchs,
ekegusii: Inaki nabateebirie inwe, ng’a Kristo akaba omosomba bw’abaarogete ase okoorokia ng’a Nyasae noyo bw’ekeene, erinde aikeranie chiira echi abagaaka baito ba kare baetwe.
swahili: Kwa maana nawaambia kwamba, Kristo amekuwa mtumishi kwa wale waliotahiriwa ili kuonyesha kweli ya Mungu na kuthibitisha zile ahadi walizopewa baba zetu wa zamani,

english: so that the Gentiles may glorify God for His mercy. As it is written: “Therefore I will praise You among the Gentiles; I will sing hymns to Your name.”
ekegusii: Naende abanto b’Ebisaku bamobake Nyasae ase engencho y’amaabera aye, buna eriikire, “Ase engencho eye ningotogie ase egati y’ abanto b’Ebisaku, ninterere erieta riao ase okoritogia.”
swahili: pia ili watu wa Mataifa wamtukuze Mungu kwa rehema zake. Kama ilivyoandikwa: “Kwa hiyo nitakutukuza katikati ya watu wa Mataifa; nitaliimbia sifa jina lako.”

english: I commend to you our sister Phoebe, a servant of the church in Cenchrea.
ekegusii: Nabekire oyominto Febe ase amaboko aino. Ere nomosubati omokoreri ore ase ekanisa gia Kenkrea.
swahili: Napenda kumtambulisha kwenu dada yetu Foibe, mtumishi katika kanisa la Kenkrea.

english: Greet Apelles, who is approved in Christ. Greet those who belong to the household of Aristobulus.
ekegusii: Nkwanerie Apele oyo bwancheretwe ase Kristo. Nkwanerie abanto b’enyomba y’Aristobulu.
swahili: Msalimuni Apele aliyejaribiwa na akaithibitisha imani yake katika Kristo. Wasalimuni wote walio nyumbani mwa Aristobulo.

english: Greet Herodion, my fellow countryman. Greet those from the household of Narcissus who are in the Lord.
ekegusii: Nkwanerie Herodioni, omoamate one. Nkwanerie abanto b’enyomba ya Narikiso bare ase Omonene.
swahili: Msalimuni ndugu yangu Herodioni. Wasalimuni wote walio nyumbani mwa Narkisi walio katika Bwana.

english: Greet Tryphena and Tryphosa, women who have worked hard in the Lord. Greet my beloved Persis, who has worked very hard in the Lord.
ekegusii: Nkwanerie Turufena na Turufosa, abakori emeremo ase Omonene. Nkwanerie Perisi omwanchwa, oyokorire omokia mono ase Omonene.
swahili: Wasalimuni Trifaina na Trifosa, wale wanawake wanaofanya kazi kwa bidii katika Bwana. Msalimuni rafiki yangu mpendwa Persisi, mwanamke mwingine aliyefanya kazi kwa bidii katika Bwana.

english: Greet Rufus, chosen in the Lord, and his mother, who has been a mother to me as well.
ekegusii: Nkwanerie Rufo omochorwa Omonene, na ng’ina ore buna baba ase ’nde.
swahili: Msalimuni Rufo, mteule katika Bwana, pamoja na mama yake, ambaye amekuwa mama kwangu pia.

english: Greet Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, Hermas, and the brothers with them.
ekegusii: Nkwanerie Asunkrito, Felegoni, Herme, Patiroba, Herama na abaminto abare amo nabarabwo.
swahili: Wasalimuni Asinkrito, Flegoni, Herme, Patroba, Herma na ndugu wote walio pamoja nao.

english: Greet Philologus and Julia, Nereus and his sister, and Olympas and all the saints with them.
ekegusii: Nkwanerie Fililogo, Yuli, Nereu na mosubati omwabo, Olimpa na abachenu bonsi abare amo n’abarabwo.
swahili: Wasalimuni Filologo, Yulia, Nerea na dada yake, na Olimpa na watakatifu wote walio pamoja nao.

english: Greet one another with a holy kiss. All the churches of Christ send you greetings. Avoid Divisions (Titus 3:9–11)
ekegusii: Kwanania inwe ase inwe ase okonyunyuntana. Chikanisa chionsi chia Kristo chiabakwanirie.
swahili: Salimianeni ninyi kwa ninyi kwa busu takatifu. Makanisa yote ya Kristo yanawasalimu. Maelekezo Ya Mwisho

english: Now I urge you, brothers, to watch out for those who create divisions and obstacles that are contrary to the teaching you have learned. Turn away from them.
ekegusii: Nabasoroire baminto, morigererie baria bakorenta ogwatananekana ne chingencho chikogera abanto bagwe korwa ase okwegena kwabo, chire mamincha y’okworokererigwa mworokereretigwe; mweatanane korwa ase barabwo.
swahili: Ndugu zangu, nawasihi mjihadhari na kujiepusha na wale watu waletao matengano na kuweka vikwazo mbele yenu dhidi ya mafundisho mliyojifunza.

english: For such people are not serving our Lord Christ, but their own appetites. By smooth talk and flattery they deceive the hearts of the naive.
ekegusii: Inaki abanto banga buna abwo tibari gokorera Omonene oito Kristo, korende nechinda chiabo bagokorera abanyene; na ase amang’ana amororo na ay’okwegwenia bang’aina emioyo y’ abanto batetenenereti ase ebirengererio biabo.
swahili: Kwa maana watu kama hao hawamtumikii Bwana Kristo, bali wanatumikia tamaa zao wenyewe. Kwa kutumia maneno laini na ya kubembeleza, hupotosha mioyo ya watu wajinga.

english: Everyone has heard about your obedience, so I rejoice over you. But I want you to be wise about what is good and innocent about what is evil.
ekegusii: Inaki oboigweri bwaino bwamanyekanire ase abanto bonsi. Naboigo nagokire ase engencho yaino, korende nindigetie mobe abang’aini ase amang’ana amaya, na abariri ase amang’ana amabe.
swahili: Kila mtu amesikia juu ya utii wenu, nami nimejawa na furaha tele kwa ajili yenu. Lakini nataka mwe na hekima katika mambo mema na bila hatia katika mambo maovu.

english: Welcome her in the Lord in a manner worthy of the saints, and assist her with anything she may need from you. For she has been a great help to many people, including me.
ekegusii: Momooroisie ase Omonene, buna egwenerete abachenu, momokonye ase ring’ana rinde rionsi araganie ase more, ekiagera ere obeire ogokonya abanto abange, nonya ninche omonyene nankonyete.
swahili: Naomba mpokeeni katika Bwana ipasavyo watakatifu na kumpa msaada wowote atakaohitaji kutoka kwenu, kwa maana yeye amekuwa msaada kwa watu wengi, mimi nikiwa miongoni mwao.

english: The God of peace will soon crush Satan under your feet. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Greetings from Paul’s Fellow Workers (Colossians 4:7–14)
ekegusii: Nyasae bw’omorembe namionogorere Saitani inse y’amagoro aino bwango. Obuya bw’Omonene oito Yeso Kristo bobe amo nainwe.
swahili: Mungu wa amani atamponda Shetani chini ya miguu yenu upesi. Neema ya Bwana wetu Yesu iwe nanyi. Amen.

english: Timothy, my fellow worker, sends you greetings, as do Lucius, Jason, and Sosipater, my fellow countrymen.
ekegusii: Timotheo, omokori emeremo amo nainche, obakwanirie; naboigo Lukio, na Yasoni, na Sosipateri, abaamate bane, baabakwanirie.
swahili: Timotheo, mtendakazi mwenzangu anawasalimu. Vivyo hivyo Lukio, Yasoni, na Sosipatro, ndugu zangu.

english: I, Tertius, who wrote down this letter, greet you in the Lord.
ekegusii: Inche Teretio, omoriki bwe riirube eri, nabakwanirie ase Omonene.
swahili: Mimi, Tertio, niliye mwandishi wa waraka huu, nawasalimu katika Bwana.

english: Gaius, who has hosted me and all the church, sends you greetings. Erastus, the city treasurer, sends you greetings, as does our brother Quartus. Doxology (Jude 1:24–25)
ekegusii: Gayo, oyokondoisia inche na ekanisa engima, baabakwanirie. Erasto, omogachi bwe chitaabu, chi’omochie, na Kwarito oyominto, baabakwanirie.
swahili: Gayo, ambaye ni mwenyeji wangu na wa kanisa lote, anawasalimu. Erasto, mweka hazina wa mji huu, pamoja na Kwarto ndugu yetu pia wanawasalimu. [

english: Now to Him who is able to strengthen you by my gospel and by the proclamation of Jesus Christ, according to the revelation of the mystery concealed for ages past
ekegusii: Bono ase are ere oyoranyare kobakong’ia ase enchiri y’ane, na ase okorandigwa kwa Yeso Kristo, na ase okomaanorerwa kw’obobisi boria bwabisegete korwa kare,
swahili: Sasa atukuzwe yeye awezaye kuwafanya ninyi imara kwa Injili yangu na kuhubiriwa kwa Yesu Kristo, kutokana na kufunuliwa siri zilizofichika tangu zamani za kale.

english: but now revealed and made known through the writings of the prophets by the command of the eternal God, in order to lead all nations to the obedience that comes from faith —
ekegusii: korende bono bwaorokiigwe ase amariiko y’ababani, bwamanyekanire ase abanto b’ebisaku bionsi buna Nyasae o kare na kare achiigete, erinde baigwere na kwegena,
swahili: Lakini sasa siri hiyo imefunuliwa na kujulikana kupitia maandiko ya kinabii kutokana na amri ya Mungu wa milele, ili mataifa yote yaweze kumwamini na kumtii

english: to the only wise God be glory forever through Jesus Christ! Amen.
ekegusii: ase Nyasae, omonyene obong’aini bweka, ogotogigwa kare na kare ase Yeso Kristo! Amina.
swahili: Mungu aliye pekee, mwenye hekima, ambaye kwa njia ya Yesu Kristo utukufu ni wake milele na milele! Amen.

english: Greet Prisca and Aquila, my fellow workers in Christ Jesus,
ekegusii: Nkwanerie Priskila na Akwila, abakori emeremo amo nainche ase Kristo Yeso,
swahili: Wasalimuni Prisila na Akila, watumishi wenzangu katika Kristo Yesu.

english: who have risked their lives for me. Not only I but all the churches of the Gentiles are grateful to them.
ekegusii: ababete ang’e korua obogima bwabo ase engencho y’ane. Nabaakeire ng’a mbuya mono, gose tari inche bweka, korende nonya n’Ebirisia bionsi bi’abaanto b’Ebisaku.
swahili: Wao walihatarisha maisha yao kwa ajili yangu; wala si mimi tu ninayewashukuru bali pia makanisa yote ya watu wa Mataifa.

english: Greet also the church that meets at their house. Greet my beloved Epenetus, who was the first convert to Christ in the province of Asia.
ekegusii: Nkwanerie boigo ekanisa kere ase enyomba yabo. Nkwanerie Epaineto omwanchwa one, nere orenge bw’eritang’ani ase Asia koonchoka ase Kristo.
swahili: Lisalimuni pia kanisa linalokutana nyumbani mwao. Msalimuni rafiki yangu mpendwa Epaineto, aliyekuwa mtu wa kwanza kumwamini Kristo huko Asia.

english: Greet Mary, who has worked very hard for you.
ekegusii: Nkwanerie Mariamu oyokorete emeremo emekong’u ase egati yaino.
swahili: Msalimuni Maria, aliyefanya kazi kwa bidii kwa ajili yenu.

english: Greet Andronicus and Junia, my fellow countrymen and fellow prisoners. They are outstanding among the apostles, and they were in Christ before I was.
ekegusii: Nkwanerie Androniko na Yunia, abaamate baane, abasibetwe ano nainche, abatomwa bagwatorwa ng’a nabaya; barabwo nigo bantang’anerete koba ime ase Kristo.
swahili: Wasalimuni Androniko na Yunia, jamaa zangu ambao wamekuwa gerezani pamoja nami. Wao ni maarufu miongoni mwa mitume, nao walikuwa katika Kristo kabla yangu.

english: Greet Ampliatus, my beloved in the Lord.
ekegusii: Nkwanerie Ampiliato, omwanchwa one ase Omonene.
swahili: Msalimuni Ampliato, yeye nimpendaye katika Bwana.

english: Greet Urbanus, our fellow worker in Christ, and my beloved Stachys.
ekegusii: Nkwanerie Urubano omokori emeremo amo nainche ase Kristo, na Staku omwanchwa one.
swahili: Msalimuni Urbano, mtendakazi mwenzetu katika Kristo, pamoja na rafiki yangu mpendwa Stakisi.

english: Paul, a servant of Christ Jesus, called to be an apostle, and set apart for the gospel of God—
ekegusii: Korwa ase inche Paulo, omosomba o Kristo Yeso, n’omotomwa nachoretwe nakorangerigwa, korandia enchiri ya Nyasae,
swahili: Paulo, mtumishi wa Kristo Yesu, aliyeitwa kuwa mtume na kutengwa kwa ajili ya Injili ya Mungu,

english: in my prayers at all times, asking that now at last by God’s will I may succeed in coming to you.
ekegusii: Botambe nigo ngosaba ng’a Nyasae karanche konyigorera enchera engiya, inchiche ase more.
swahili: katika maombi yangu siku zote, nami ninaomba kwamba hatimaye sasa kwa mapenzi ya Mungu, njia ipate kufunguliwa kwa ajili yangu ili nije kwenu.

english: For I long to see you so that I may impart to you some spiritual gift to strengthen you,
ekegusii: Nigo inde n’amaiga kororana nainwe na kobaa ekeegwa ase enchera y’Omoika Omochenu, erio mobekwe chinguru,
swahili: Ninatamani sana kuwaona ili nipate kuweka juu yenu karama za rohoni ili mwe imara,

english: that is, that you and I may be mutually encouraged by each other’s faith.
ekegusii: erinde toremanie inche nainwe, kera omonto ase okwegena kw’oyonde, okwaino na okwane.
swahili: au zaidi, ninyi pamoja nami tuweze kutiana moyo katika imani sisi kwa sisi.

english: I do not want you to be unaware, brothers, how often I planned to come to you (but have been prevented from visiting until now), in order that I might have a harvest among you, just as I have had among the other Gentiles.
ekegusii: Korende abaminto, nindigetie momanye ng’a ekero ase ekero nigo narengereretie gocha ase more (korende ngatangeka goika bono) erinde inyore okwama ase egati yaino, buna inde nakwo ase abanto b’Ebisaku binde.
swahili: Ndugu zangu, napenda mfahamu kwamba mara nyingi nimekusudia kuja kwenu (ingawa mpaka sasa nimezuiliwa), ili nipate kuvuna mavuno miongoni mwenu kama nilivyovuna miongoni mwa wengine ambao ni watu wa Mataifa wasiomjua Mungu.

english: I am obligated both to Greeks and non-Greeks, both to the wise and the foolish.
ekegusii: Ase ayio ninde n’esiira ase Abagiriki na ase abatari Abagiriki, ase abanyasemi na ase abariri.
swahili: Mimi ni mdeni kwa Wayunani na kwa wasio Wayunani, kwa wenye hekima na kwa wasio na hekima.

english: That is why I am so eager to preach the gospel also to you who are in Rome.
ekegusii: Ase ensemo yane nigo nganetie mono korandia enchiri nonya nase more abamomenyete Rumi. Chinguru chi’enchiri
swahili: Ndiyo sababu ninatamani sana kuihubiri Injili kwenu pia ninyi mlioko Rumi.

english: I am not ashamed of the gospel, because it is the power of God for salvation to everyone who believes, first to the Jew, then to the Greek.
ekegusii: Inaki tinkororera enchiri obosooku, ekiagera ero n’okobua kwa Nyasae gokorenta ogotooreka ase onde bwensi oyo bwegenete, ritang’ani ase Omoyahudi, na ase Omogiriki boigo.
swahili: Mimi siionei haya Injili ya Kristo kwa maana ni uweza wa Mungu uletao wokovu kwa kila aaminiye, kwanza kwa Myahudi na kwa Myunani pia.

english: For the gospel reveals the righteousness of God that comes by faith from start to finish, just as it is written: “The righteous will live by faith.” God’s Wrath against Sin
ekegusii: Ekiagera ime yaye oboronge bokorwa ase Nyasae bwaorokiigwe korwa okwegena goika okwegena, buna eriikire, “Omonyene oboronge nabe moyo ase okwegena.” Obobe bw’ abanto b’Ebisaku
swahili: Kwa maana katika Injili haki itokayo kwa Mungu imedhihirishwa, haki ile iliyo kwa njia ya imani hadi imani. Kama ilivyoandikwa: “Mwenye haki ataishi kwa imani.” Ghadhabu Ya Mungu Kwa Wanadamu

english: The wrath of God is being revealed from heaven against all the godlessness and wickedness of men who suppress the truth by their wickedness.
ekegusii: Inaki endamwamu ya Nyasae yaorokiigwe korwa igoro, ase ogotamoiroka Nyasae gwonsi na obobe bwa Mwanyabaanto, abagotanga ekeene nobobe bwabo.
swahili: Ghadhabu ya Mungu imedhihirishwa kutoka mbinguni dhidi ya uasi wote na uovu wa wanadamu ambao huipinga kweli kwa uovu wao,

english: For what may be known about God is plain to them, because God has made it plain to them.
ekegusii: Bono ayaranyare komanywa igoro ya Nyasae aorokigwe ase bare, ekiagera Nyasae nabaorokeretie.
swahili: kwa maana yote yanayoweza kujulikana kumhusu Mungu ni dhahiri kwao, kwa sababu Mungu mwenyewe ameyadhihirisha kwao.

english: the gospel He promised beforehand through His prophets in the Holy Scriptures,
ekegusii: eye Nyasae atang’anete koria eira ase emenwa y’ababani baye ase amariiko amachenu.
swahili: Injili ambayo Mungu alitangulia kuiahidi kwa vinywa vya manabii wake katika Maandiko Matakatifu,

english: For since the creation of the world God’s invisible qualities, His eternal power and divine nature, have been clearly seen, being understood from His workmanship, so that men are without excuse.
ekegusii: Inaki chingencho chiaye, echi chitari kororekana, engencho yaye okobua kwaye gwa kare na kare, na obonyasae bwaye, nchimanyekanete korwa ase ogotongwa gw’ense ase ebinto atongete. Ase igo tibari naya bagotaamera.
swahili: Kwa maana tangu kuumbwa kwa ulimwengu, asili ya Mungu asiyeonekana kwa macho, yaani, uweza wake wa milele na asili yake ya Uungu, imeonekana waziwazi, ikitambuliwa kutokana na yale aliyoyafanya ili wanadamu wasiwe na udhuru.

english: For although they knew God, they neither glorified Him as God nor gave thanks to Him, but they became futile in their thinking and darkened in their foolish hearts.
ekegusii: Inaki nonya bamanyete Nyasae, tibamosigete buna Nyasae, gose komoakera ng’a mbuya mono; korende ebirengererio biabo bikaba bosa, na emioyo yabo y’oboriri ekabekwa omosunte.
swahili: Kwa maana ingawa walimjua Mungu, hawakumtukuza yeye kama ndiye Mungu wala hawakumshukuru, bali fikira zao zimekuwa batili na mioyo yao ya ujinga ikatiwa giza.

english: Although they claimed to be wise, they became fools,
ekegusii: Bagateeba ng’a mbare nobong’aini, korende bakaririeka.
swahili: Ingawa walijidai kuwa wenye hekima, wakawa wajinga

english: and exchanged the glory of the immortal God for images of mortal man and birds and animals and reptiles.
ekegusii: Bakaonchoreria obonene bwa Nyasae, oyotari n’ogosareka, ase omogwekano bw’ekieni kia Mwanyabaanto oyore nogosareka, na oyobwechinyoni, na bwe ching’iti chire n’amagoro ane, na bwe ching’iti chikwagura.
swahili: na kubadili utukufu wa Mungu aishiye milele kwa sanamu zilizofanywa zifanane na mwanadamu ambaye hufa, na mfano wa ndege, wanyama na viumbe vitambaavyo.
