english: Therefore God gave them over in the desires of their hearts to impurity for the dishonoring of their bodies with one another.
ekegusii: Ase ayio Nyasae akabatiga ase okogania okobe gwe chinkoro chiabo, batunyane obonyaka goika bagasarerania ogosika ase emebere yabo barabwo ase barabwo,
swahili: Kwa hiyo, Mungu akawaacha wazifuate tamaa mbaya za mioyo yao katika uasherati, hata wakavunjiana heshima miili yao wao kwa wao.

english: They exchanged the truth of God for a lie, and worshiped and served the creature rather than the Creator, who is forever worthy of praise! Amen.
ekegusii: ekiagera batigete ekeene kia Nyasae, bagachoora oborimo, bagasasiima na gokorera ebitongwa ribaga ri’Omotongi, oyorabaakwe kare na kare! Amina.
swahili: Kwa sababu waliibadili kweli ya Mungu kuwa uongo, wakaabudu na kutumikia kiumbe badala ya Muumba, ahimidiwaye milele! Amen.

english: For this reason God gave them over to dishonorable passions. Even their women exchanged natural relations for unnatural ones.
ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio Nyasae akabatiga batunyane okogania kwabo kw’obosooku, goika abakungu babo bakaonchoreria okomenyana kw’omobere kwa boronge ase oko gotari kwa boronge.
swahili: Kwa sababu hii, Mungu aliwaacha wavunjiane heshima kwa kufuata tamaa zao za aibu. Hata wanawake wao wakabadili matumizi ya asili ya miili yao wakaitumia isivyokusudiwa.

english: Likewise, the men abandoned natural relations with women and burned with lust for one another. Men committed indecent acts with other men, and received in themselves the due penalty for their error.
ekegusii: Na abasacha boigo bagatiga okomenyana nabakungu kwa boronge, bagasambwa ase okorigania abasacha ase abasacha, bagakora ogokora kw’obosooku, bakanyora abanyene ogoakanwa kwa boronge kw’ogosaria kwabo.
swahili: Vivyo hivyo wanaume pia wakiacha matumizi ya asili ya wanawake wakawakiana tamaa wao kwa wao. Wanaume wakafanyiana matendo ya aibu na wanaume wengine nao wakapata katika maisha yao adhabu iliyowastahili kwa ajili ya upotovu wao.

english: Furthermore, since they did not see fit to acknowledge God, He gave them up to a depraved mind, to do what ought not to be done.
ekegusii: Ekiagera batabarete ng’a ngento komomanya Nyasae, Nyasae akabatiga ase ebirengererio bie chingencho chiabo chimbe, bakore aya’atagwenereti.
swahili: Nao kwa kuwa hawakuona umuhimu wa kudumisha ufahamu wa Mungu, yeye akawaachilia wafuate akili za upotovu, watende mambo yale yasiyostahili kutendwa.

english: They have become filled with every kind of wickedness, evil, greed, and depravity. They are full of envy, murder, strife, deceit, and malice. They are gossips,
ekegusii: Bagaichorwa ne chingencho chionsi chitari boronge, na obobe, na okogania okobe, na okorengereria okobe, ne ribero, na oboiti, na eriomana, na obong’ainereria, na okogeechana. Bakaba abagenkani,
swahili: Wakiwa wamejawa na udhalimu wa kila namna, uasherati, uovu, tamaa mbaya na hila. Wamejawa na husuda, uuaji, ugomvi, udanganyifu, hadaa na nia mbaya. Wao pia ni wasengenyaji,

english: regarding His Son, who was a descendant of David according to the flesh,
ekegusii: Eye nenchiri igoro y’Omwana oye Yeso Kristo, Omonene oito. Ere akaiborwa buna Mwanyabaanto ase ororeria rwa Daudi,
swahili: yaani, Injili inayomhusu Mwanawe, yeye ambaye kwa uzao wa mwili alikuwa mzao wa Daudi,

english: slanderers, God-haters, insolent, arrogant, and boastful. They invent new forms of evil; they disobey their parents.
ekegusii: abaitania, abamogechete Nyasae, abachaayi, abaenenu, abetogia, abaroisia amabe, abatari koigwera abaibori babo,
swahili: wasingiziaji, wanaomchukia Mungu, wajeuri, wenye kiburi na majivuno, wenye hila, wasiotii wazazi wao,

english: They are senseless, faithless, heartless, merciless.
ekegusii: abariri, abatari abegenwa, abatari nobwanchani, abatari n’amaabera.
swahili: wajinga, wasioamini, wasio na huruma na wakatili.

english: Although they know God’s righteous decree that those who do such things are worthy of death, they not only continue to do these things, but also approve of those who practice them.
ekegusii: Barabwo abanyene mbamanyete mono ekiina kia Nyasae kia boronge, ng’a abagokora ayaiga nebagwenerete amakweri; tibakorete aya oka, korende nigo bagwancherana nabwo bakoyakora.
swahili: Ingawa wanafahamu sheria ya haki ya Mungu kwamba watu wanaofanya mambo kama hayo wanastahili mauti, si kwamba wanaendelea kutenda hayo tu, bali pia wanakubaliana na wale wanaoyatenda.

english: and who through the Spirit of holiness was declared with power to be the Son of God by His resurrection from the dead: Jesus Christ our Lord.
ekegusii: naende ase okobokigwa korwa ase abakuure na ase chinguru chi’Omoika bw’Obochenu akaorokigwa koba Omwana o Nyasae.
swahili: na ambaye kwa uwezo wa Roho wa utakatifu alidhihirishwa kuwa Mwana wa Mungu kwa ufufuo wake kutoka kwa wafu, yaani, Yesu Kristo, Bwana wetu.

english: Through Him and on behalf of His name, we received grace and apostleship to call all those among the Gentiles to the obedience that comes from faith.
ekegusii: Asare ere ntwanyorete obuya na obotomwa, erio ase engencho y’erieta riaye tworokererie abanto b’ebisaku bionsi, erinde banyare koba nokoigwera gw’okwegena
swahili: Kwa kupitia kwake na kwa ajili ya Jina lake, tumepokea neema na utume ili kuwaita watu miongoni mwa watu wa mataifa yote, waje kwenye utii utokanao na imani.

english: And you also are among those who are called to belong to Jesus Christ.
ekegusii: amo nainwe abanyene, inwe abamwarangeretigwe koba aba Yeso Kristo.
swahili: Ninyi nyote pia mko miongoni mwa watu walioitwa ili mpate kuwa mali ya Yesu Kristo.

english: To all in Rome who are loved by God and called to be saints: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ. Unashamed of the Gospel
ekegusii: Nabariikeire inwe mwensi abamomenyete Rumi, abanchwa ba Nyasae, abamwarangeretigwe koba abachenu. Obuya bobe ase more na omorembe bikorwa ase Nyasae Tata oito, na ase Omonene Yeso Kristo. Ogosaba kw’ogoaka mbuya mono
swahili: Kwa wote walioko Rumi wapendwao na Mungu na kuitwa kuwa watakatifu: Neema na amani itokayo kwa Mungu Baba yetu na kwa Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo iwe nanyi. Maombi Na Shukrani

english: First, I thank my God through Jesus Christ for all of you, because your faith is being proclaimed all over the world.
ekegusii: Ritang’ani naakeire Nyasae one ng’a mbuya mono ase Yeso Kristo ase engencho yaino inwe mwensi, ekiagera okwegena kwaino kwamanyekanire ase ense yonsi.
swahili: Kwanza kabisa, namshukuru Mungu wangu kwa njia ya Yesu Kristo kwa ajili yenu nyote, kwa sababu imani yenu inatangazwa duniani kote.

english: God, whom I serve with my spirit in preaching the gospel of His Son, is my witness how constantly I remember you
ekegusii: Inaki Nyasae, oyo ’ngokorera ase omoika one korandia enchiri y’Omwana oye, nere kirori one ng’a tintigeti kobaatora botambe ase ogosaba kwane.
swahili: Kwa maana Mungu ninayemtumikia kwa moyo wangu wote katika kuhubiri Injili ya Mwanawe, ni shahidi wangu jinsi ninavyowakumbuka

english: You, therefore, have no excuse, you who pass judgment on another. For on whatever grounds you judge the other, you are condemning yourself, because you who pass judgment do the same things.
ekegusii: Ase ayio, aye onde bwensi, tori naya ogotaamera, ekero okogaambia oyonde ekiina, ekiagera ase okomogaambia oyonde ekiina, naye okwegaambia omonyene. Inaki okomogaambia, na aye naro ayio ogokora?
swahili: Kwa hiyo huna udhuru wowote, wewe utoaye hukumu kwa mwingine, kwa maana katika jambo lolote unalowahukumu wengine, unajihukumu wewe mwenyewe kwa sababu wewe unayehukumu unafanya mambo hayo hayo.

english: but glory, honor, and peace for everyone who does good, first for the Jew, then for the Greek.
ekegusii: korende obonene na ogosika, na omorembe nigo bire ase kera oyomo oyogokora amaya, ritang’ani ase Omoyahudi, na ase Omogiriki boigo.
swahili: bali utukufu, heshima na amani kwa ajili ya kila mmoja atendaye mema, kwa Myahudi kwanza, kisha kwa mtu wa Mataifa.

english: For God does not show favoritism.
ekegusii: Ekiagera gwanchereria tikori ase Nyasae.
swahili: Kwa maana Mungu hana upendeleo.

english: All who sin apart from the law will also perish apart from the law, and all who sin under the law will be judged by the law.
ekegusii: Inaki Abagiriki bakorire ebibe batari namachiiko a Musa, inabasire batari namachiiko; na Abayahudi bakorire ebibe bare namachiiko, nabo baranacherwe ekiina ase amachiiko.
swahili: Watu wote waliotenda dhambi pasipo sheria wataangamia pasipo sheria, nao wote wale waliotenda dhambi chini ya sheria watahukumiwa kwa sheria.

english: For it is not the hearers of the law who are righteous before God, but it is the doers of the law who will be declared righteous.
ekegusii: Inaki tari abwo bakoigwa amachiiko bare abanyene oboronge ase obosio bwa Nyasae, korende mbaria bagoikerania amachiiko, nabwo baraegwe oboronge.
swahili: Kwa maana si wale wanaoisikia sheria ambao ni wenye haki mbele za Mungu, bali ni wale wanaoitii sheria ndio watakaohesabiwa haki.

english: Indeed, when Gentiles, who do not have the law, do by nature what the law requires, they are a law to themselves, even though they do not have the law.
ekegusii: Abanto b’Ebisaku batari namachiiko, ekero bagokora buna engencho ya Mwanyabaanto ere aya amachiiko are korigia, nonya abwo tibari namachiiko, babeire amachiiko boka abanyene.
swahili: (Naam, wakati wa watu wa Mataifa, ambao hawana sheria, wanapofanya kwa asili mambo yatakiwayo na sheria, wao ni sheria kwa nafsi zao wenyewe, hata ingawa hawana sheria.

english: So they show that the work of the law is written on their hearts, their consciences also bearing witness, and their thoughts either accusing or defending them
ekegusii: Abwo nigo bakoorokia ng’a aya amachiiko are korigia ariikirwe ime ase chinkoro chiabo. Okomanya gwe chinkoro chiabo ime nigo gokobabera kirori, na ebirengererio biabo nigo bikobasoera gose kobaegerera.
swahili: Wao wanaonyesha kwamba lile linalotakiwa na sheria limeandikwa kwenye mioyo yao, ambayo pia dhamiri zao zikiwashuhudia, nayo mawazo yao yenye kupingana yatawashtaki au kuwatetea.)

english: on the day when God will judge men’s secrets through Christ Jesus, as proclaimed by my gospel. The Jews and the Law
ekegusii: Nabo arache koba ase rituko riria, koreng’ana nenchiri eye nkorandia, Nyasae kagochi‐gocha nanachere obobisi bwa Mwanyabaanto ekiina, goetera ase Kristo Yeso. Abayahudi n’amachiiko
swahili: Hili litatukia siku hiyo Mungu atakapozihukumu siri za wanadamu kwa njia ya Yesu Kristo, kama isemavyo Injili yangu. Wayahudi Na Sheria

english: Now you, if you call yourself a Jew; if you rely on the law and boast in God;
ekegusii: Korende aye okweroka Omoyahudi, na gosemeretie amachiiko, na gwetogia ase Nyasae.
swahili: Tazama, wewe ukiwa unaitwa Myahudi na kuitegemea sheria na kujisifia uhusiano wako na Mungu,

english: if you know His will and approve of what is superior because you are instructed by the law;
ekegusii: Kwamanyire ogwancha kwaye, naende nomanyete buya amang’ana ayare amaya, ekiagera kworokererigwe amachiiko.
swahili: kama unajua mapenzi ya Mungu na kukubali lililo bora kwa sababu umefundishwa na hiyo sheria,

english: if you are convinced that you are a guide for the blind, a light for those in darkness,
ekegusii: Nore nobomaene ng’a aye omonyene nigo ore omoraai bw’emeuko, na omobaso bw’abare ase omosunte ime.
swahili: kama unatambua kuwa wewe ni kiongozi wa vipofu, na mwanga kwa wale walio gizani,

english: And we know that God’s judgment against those who do such things is based on truth.
ekegusii: Intwe twamanyire ng’a ekiina kia Nyasae nigo kere boronge igoro ase abwo bagokora ayio.
swahili: Basi tunajua kwamba hukumu ya Mungu dhidi ya wale wafanyao mambo kama hayo ni ya kweli.

english: an instructor of the foolish, a teacher of infants, because you have in the law the embodiment of knowledge and truth—
ekegusii: Omotebereria bw’abariri, na omworokia bw’abana abake, ekiagera kwanyorire okworokereria okuya gwe chisemi na ekeene bire ime ase amachiiko.
swahili: mkufunzi wa wajinga na mwalimu wa watoto wachanga, kwa kuwa una maarifa ya kweli katika hiyo sheria,

english: you, then, who teach others, do you not teach yourself? You who preach against stealing, do you steal?
ekegusii: Aye okworokereria abande, Inee, tokweorokereria aye omonyene? Aye okorandia ng’a omonto taiba, tori koiba aye omonyene?
swahili: basi wewe, uwafundishaye wengine, mbona hujifunzi mwenyewe? Wewe uhubiriye kwamba mtu asiibe, wewe mwenyewe waiba?

english: You who forbid adultery, do you commit adultery? You who abhor idols, do you rob temples?
ekegusii: Aye ogoteeba ng’a omonto tatomana, tori gotomana aye omonyene? Aye ogechete emegwekano y’ogosasimwa, aye tori koiba korwa ase chi Hekalu?
swahili: Wewe usemaye mtu asizini, wewe mwenyewe wazini? Wewe uchukiaye miungu ya sanamu, wafanya jambo la kumchukiza katika mahekalu?

english: You who boast in the law, do you dishonor God by breaking the law?
ekegusii: Aye ogwetogeria amachiiko, Inee, nigo ogosareria Nyasae ogosika ase ogosaria kwao kw’amachiiko?
swahili: Wewe ujivuniaye sheria, wamwaibisha Mungu kwa kuvunja sheria?

english: As it is written: “God’s name is blasphemed among the Gentiles because of you.”
ekegusii: Inaki amariiko nigo agoteeba, “Erieta ria Nyasae nigo rikoramwa ase egati y’ abanto b’Ebisaku ase engencho yaino.”
swahili: Kama ilivyoandikwa, “Kwa ajili yenu ninyi, Jina la Mungu linatukanwa miongoni mwa watu wa Mataifa.”

english: Circumcision has value if you observe the law, but if you break the law, your circumcision has become uncircumcision.
ekegusii: Okwaroka nigo kogwenerete onye kore omoigweri bw’amachiiko, korende onye kore omosaria bw’amachiiko, okwaroka kwao kwabeire ogotaaroka.
swahili: Kutahiriwa kuna thamani ikiwa unatii sheria, lakini kama unavunja sheria, kutahiriwa kwako kumekuwa kutokutahiriwa.

english: If a man who is not circumcised keeps the requirements of the law, will not his uncircumcision be regarded as circumcision?
ekegusii: Karabe ere oyotaarogeti okobwata amachiiko, Inee, ogotaaroka kwaye tigokobarwa ng’a kwabeire okwaroka?
swahili: Hivyo, ikiwa wale wasiotahiriwa wanatimiza mambo ambayo sheria inataka, je, kutokutahiriwa kwao hakutahesabiwa kuwa sawa na kutahiriwa?

english: The one who is physically uncircumcised yet keeps the law will condemn you who, even though you have the written code and circumcision, are a lawbreaker.
ekegusii: Ere oyotaarogeti ase omobere, onye obwatete amachiiko, Inee, tagokonachera ekiina aye, oyore namachiiko na okwaroka, naende osaririe amachiiko?
swahili: Ndipo wale ambao hawakutahiriwa kimwili lakini wanaitii sheria watawahukumu ninyi, ambao ingawa mmetahiriwa na kuijua sana sheria ya Mungu iliyoandikwa, lakini mwaivunja.

english: A man is not a Jew because he is one outwardly, nor is circumcision only outward and physical.
ekegusii: Inaki ere oyore Omoyahudi ase isiko oka, tari Omoyahudi bw’ekeene, gose okwaroka koria gokorire isiko ase omobere, tikori okwaroka gw’ekeene.
swahili: Kwa maana mtu si Myahudi kwa vile alivyo kwa nje, wala tohara ya kweli si kitu cha nje au cha kimwili.

english: No, a man is a Jew because he is one inwardly, and circumcision is a matter of the heart, by the Spirit, not by the written code. Such a man’s praise does not come from men, but from God.
ekegusii: Korende ere n’Omoyahudi bw’ekeene oyore Omoyahudi o ime, na okwaroka gw’ekeene nogw’enkoro. Eye nemeremo y’Omoika, teri ey’amariiko. Ogotogigwa kwaye tikorueti ase Mwanyabaanto, korende nase Nyasae.
swahili: Lakini mtu ni Myahudi alivyo ndani, nayo tohara ya kweli ni jambo la moyoni, ni la Roho, wala si la sheria iliyoandikwa. Mtu wa namna hiyo hapokei sifa kutoka kwa wanadamu bali kwa Mungu.

english: So when you, O man, pass judgment on others, yet do the same things, do you think you will escape God’s judgment?
ekegusii: Aye omonto oyokogaambia baria bagokora ayio, naye omonyene naro ayio ogokora, Inee, nokagete ng’a aye notame korwa ase ekiina kia Nyasae?
swahili: Hivyo wewe mwanadamu, utoapo hukumu juu yao na bado unafanya mambo yale yale, unadhani utaepuka hukumu ya Mungu?

english: Or do you disregard the riches of His kindness, tolerance, and patience, not realizing that God’s kindness leads you to repentance?
ekegusii: Gose ngwachaayire obonge bw’obuya bwaye, na oboremereria bwaye, na okoganya kwaye, na tomanyeti ng’a obuya bwa Nyasae nigo borigetie gokoraa gochia ase okoonchoka?
swahili: Au waudharau wingi wa wema, ustahimili na uvumilivu wake, bila kujua kuwa wema wa Mungu wakuelekeza kwenye toba?

english: But because of your hard and unrepentant heart, you are storing up wrath against yourself for the day of wrath, when God’s righteous judgment will be revealed.
ekegusii: Korende ase obokong’u bwao na enkoro yao etari nokoonchoka, kwegacheire endamwamu ase rituko riria ri’endamwamu, ekero ekiina kia boronge kia Nyasae kerache koorokigwa,
swahili: Lakini kwa sababu ya ukaidi wenu na mioyo yenu isiyotaka kutubu, mnajiwekea akiba ya ghadhabu dhidi yenu wenyewe kwa siku ile ya ghadhabu ya Mungu, wakati hukumu yake ya haki itakapodhihirishwa.

english: God “will repay each one according to his deeds.”
ekegusii: ekiagera ere naache komoa kera omonto koreng’ana nogokora kwaye;
swahili: Kwa maana Mungu atamlipa kila mtu sawasawa na matendo yake.

english: To those who by perseverance in doing good seek glory, honor, and immortality, He will give eternal life.
ekegusii: nabae obogima bwa kare na kare baria bakorigia obonene, na ogosika, na ogotasareka, na gokora amaya ase oboremereria.
swahili: Wale ambao kwa kuvumilia katika kutenda mema hutafuta utukufu, heshima na maisha yasiyoharibika, Mungu atawapa uzima wa milele.

english: But for those who are self-seeking and who reject the truth and follow wickedness, there will be wrath and anger.
ekegusii: Korende endamwamu na ekeririanda inabibe igoro ase baria beanchete abanyene, batari koigwera ekeene, korende bakoigwera ayatari boronge.
swahili: Lakini kwa wale watafutao mambo yao wenyewe na wale wanaokataa kweli na kuzifuata njia mbaya, kutakuwa na ghadhabu na hasira ya Mungu.

english: There will be trouble and distress for every human being who does evil, first for the Jew, then for the Greek;
ekegusii: Emechando na obororo inabibe igoro ase kera oyomo bw’abana ba Mwanyabaanto oyogokora amabe, ritang’ani ase Omoyahudi, na ase Omogiriki boigo;
swahili: Kutakuwa na taabu na dhiki kwa kila mmoja atendaye maovu, Myahudi kwanza na mtu wa Mataifa pia,

english: What, then, is the advantage of being a Jew? Or what is the value of circumcision?
ekegusii: Gaki rende, Omoyahudi inki abuete abande? Na okwaroka inki kogwenerete?
swahili: Basi kuna faida gani kuwa Myahudi? Au kuna thamani gani katika tohara?

english: As it is written: “There is no one righteous, not even one.
ekegusii: buna eriikire ng’a, “Onde tari omonyene oboronge, nonya noyomo;
swahili: Kama ilivyoandikwa: “Hakuna mwenye haki, hakuna hata mmoja.

english: There is no one who understands, no one who seeks God.
ekegusii: onde tari okomanya, onde tari okorigia Nyasae.
swahili: Hakuna hata mmoja mwenye ufahamu, hakuna hata mmoja amtafutaye Mungu.

english: All have turned away, they have together become worthless; there is no one who does good, not even one.”
ekegusii: Bonsi bachiire bogeeka korwa ase Nyasae, bonsi babeire bosa; onde tari oy’ogokora amaya, nonya n’oyomo.
swahili: Wote wamepotoka, wote wameoza pamoja; hakuna atendaye mema, naam, hakuna hata mmoja.”

english: “Their throats are open graves; their tongues practice deceit.” “The venom of vipers is on their lips.”
ekegusii: Emioyo yabo noboina bwasie, ase emenwa yabo nigo bagokwana obong’ainereria, obosongo bwe ching’iti nigo bore ase ebikoba bi’emenwa yabo.
swahili: “Makoo yao ni makaburi wazi; kwa ndimi zao wao hufanya udanganyifu.” “Sumu ya nyoka iko midomoni mwao.”

english: “Their mouths are full of cursing and bitterness.”
ekegusii: Emenwa yabo yaichoirwe nokoragereria na obororo,
swahili: “Vinywa vyao vimejaa laana na uchungu.”

english: “Their feet are swift to shed blood;
ekegusii: amagoro abo nigo are amaango ase ogoitera amanyinga,
swahili: “Miguu yao ina haraka kumwaga damu;

english: ruin and misery lie in their wake,
ekegusii: obosareku na emechando nigo bire ase chinchera chiabo.
swahili: maangamizi na taabu viko katika njia zao,

english: and the way of peace they have not known.”
ekegusii: Enchera y’omorembe tibayemanyeti.
swahili: wala njia ya amani hawaijui.”

english: “There is no fear of God before their eyes.”
ekegusii: Okomoiroka Nyasae tikori ase amaiso abo.”
swahili: “Hakuna hofu ya Mungu machoni pao.”

english: Now we know that whatever the law says, it says to those who are under the law, so that every mouth may be silenced and the whole world held accountable to God.
ekegusii: Twamanyire ng’a amang’ana onsi agokwanwa n’amachiiko nigo agokwanwa ase baria bare inse y’amachiiko, erinde kera omonwa osiekwe, na ense yonsi ebekwe inse ase ekiina kia Nyasae.
swahili: Basi tunajua ya kwamba chochote sheria inachosema, inawaambia wale walio chini ya sheria ili kila kinywa kinyamazishwe na ulimwengu wote uwajibike kwa Mungu.

english: Much in every way. First of all, they have been entrusted with the very words of God.
ekegusii: Nkogwenerete mono ase kera enchera. Ritang’ani, Abayahudi mbegenetwe konyora ring’ana ria Nyasae.
swahili: Kuna faida kubwa kwa kila namna! Kwanza kabisa, Wayahudi wamekabidhiwa lile Neno halisi la Mungu.

english: Therefore no one will be justified in His sight by works of the law. For the law merely brings awareness of sin. Righteousness through Faith in Christ (Philippians 3:1–11)
ekegusii: Inaki ase ogokora kw’amachiiko onde tari ase Mwanyabaanto oranyare konyora oboronge ase obosio bwa Nyasae, ekiagera amachiiko n’aro akorenta okomanya ebibe. Buna tokobekwa boronge ase Nyasae
swahili: Kwa hiyo hakuna binadamu hata mmoja atakayehesabiwa haki mbele za Mungu kwa matendo ya sheria, kwa maana sheria hutufanya tuitambue dhambi. Haki Kwa Njia Ya Imani

english: But now, apart from the law, the righteousness of God has been revealed, as attested by the Law and the Prophets.
ekegusii: Korende bono oboronge bwa Nyasae bwaorokigwe machiiko ataiyo, obwaberetwe kirori namachiiko na ababani,
swahili: Lakini sasa, haki itokayo kwa Mungu imedhihirishwa pasipo sheria, ambayo Sheria na Manabii wanaishuhudia.

english: And this righteousness from God comes through faith in Jesus Christ to all who believe. There is no distinction,
ekegusii: engencho yaye oboronge bokorwa ase Nyasae obo bogocha ase enchera y’okomwegena Yeso Kristo ase bonsi abegenete. Inaki gwatananekana tikori,
swahili: Haki hii itokayo kwa Mungu hupatikana kwa Yesu Kristo kwa wote wamwaminio. Kwa maana hapo hakuna tofauti,

english: for all have sinned and fall short of the glory of God,
ekegusii: ekiagera bonsi bakorire ebibe, na baremeirwe n’obonene bwa Nyasae;
swahili: kwa kuwa wote wametenda dhambi na kupungukiwa na utukufu wa Mungu,

english: and are justified freely by His grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus.
ekegusii: baeirwe oboronge buna ekeegwa ase obuya bwaye, ase enchera y’okoboorigwa kore ime ase Kristo Yeso.
swahili: wanahesabiwa haki bure kwa neema yake kwa njia ya ukombozi ulio katika Kristo Yesu.

english: God presented Him as the atoning sacrifice through faith in His blood, in order to demonstrate His righteousness, because in His forbearance He had passed over the sins committed beforehand.
ekegusii: Ere Nyasae omobekire koba ekeng’wanso gi’okobwatania ase amanyinga aye, erinde tomonyoore ase enchera y’okwegena. Igo Nyasae oorokirie oboronge bwaye, ekiagera ase okoremereria kwaye atigete ebibe biria biatang’anete.
swahili: Yeye ambaye Mungu alimtoa awe dhabihu ya upatanisho kwa njia ya imani katika damu yake. Alifanya hivi ili kuonyesha haki yake, kwa sababu kwa ustahimili wake aliziachilia zile dhambi zilizotangulia kufanywa.

english: He did this to demonstrate His righteousness at the present time, so as to be just and to justify the one who has faith in Jesus.
ekegusii: Ekero ekeiga oorokirie ng’a ere nomonyene oboronge, naende nere okomoa oboronge oyo okomwegena Yeso.
swahili: Alifanya hivyo ili kuonyesha haki yake wakati huu, ili yeye awe mwenye haki na mwenye kumhesabia haki yule anayemwamini Yesu. Umuhimu Wa Kuwa Na Imani

english: Where, then, is boasting? It is excluded. On what principle? On that of works? No, but on that of faith.
ekegusii: Ng’ai rende ogwetogia gwaito kore? Kende tikeri. Ase ogochika ki? Ase ogochika kw’ogokora? Yaya, korende ase ogochika gw’okwegena.
swahili: Basi, kujivuna kuko wapi? Kumewekwa mbali. Kwa sheria gani? Je, ni kwa ile ya matendo? La hasha, bali kwa ile sheria ya imani.

english: For we maintain that a man is justified by faith apart from works of the law.
ekegusii: Naboigo, tokobara ng’a omonto nigo akoegwa oboronge ase okwegena kore ao nogokora kw’amachiiko.
swahili: Kwa maana twaona kwamba mwanadamu huhesabiwa haki kwa njia ya imani wala si kwa matendo ya sheria.

english: Is God the God of Jews only? Is He not the God of Gentiles too? Yes, of Gentiles too,
ekegusii: Gose Nyasae nigo are Nyasae bw’Abayahudi boka? Tari Nyasae bw’Ebisaku boigo? Ee, ere ’Nyasae bw’Ebisaku boigo.
swahili: Je, Mungu ni Mungu wa Wayahudi peke yao? Je, yeye si Mungu wa watu wa Mataifa pia? Naam, yeye ni Mungu wa watu wa Mataifa pia.

english: What if some did not have faith? Will their lack of faith nullify God’s faithfulness?
ekegusii: Inki rende onye abande tibari abegenwa? Inee! Ogotegenwa kwabo nakonyaare gokora obwegenwa bwa Nyasae bobe bosa?
swahili: Ingekuwaje kama wengine hawakuwa na imani? Je, kutokuamini kwao kungebatilisha uaminifu wa Mungu?

english: since there is only one God, who will justify the circumcised by faith and the uncircumcised through that same faith.
ekegusii: Inaki Nyasae noyomo, oranyare koa Abayahudi oboronge ase okwegena, na abanto b’ebisaku ase enchera y’okwegena.
swahili: Basi kwa kuwa tuna Mungu mmoja tu, atawahesabia haki wale waliotahiriwa kwa imani na wale wasiotahiriwa kwa imani iyo hiyo.

english: Do we, then, nullify the law by this faith? Certainly not! Instead, we uphold the law.
ekegusii: Inee! Ntwaonchoire amachiiko abe bosa ase okwegena okwo? Yaya, taibo! Nigo togwanchera amachiiko.
swahili: Je, basi ni kwamba tunaibatilisha sheria kwa imani hii? La, hasha! Badala yake tunaithibitisha sheria.

english: Certainly not! Let God be true and every man a liar. As it is written: “So that You may be proved right when You speak and victorious when You judge.”
ekegusii: Yaya, taibo! Goika Nyasae amanyekane ng’a nomonyene ekeene, nonya ’nkera omonto ore omorimo, buna eriikire, “Erinde omanyekane ng’a mboronge ore ase amang’ana ao, na obue ekero ogosoa ase ekiina.”
swahili: La hasha! Mungu na aonekane mwenye haki, na kila mwanadamu kuwa mwongo, kama ilivyoandikwa: “Ili uthibitike kuwa wa kweli unaponena, na ukashinde utoapo hukumu.”

english: But if our unrighteousness highlights the righteousness of God, what shall we say? That God is unjust to inflict His wrath on us? I am speaking in human terms.
ekegusii: Korende ker’abe ng’a obobe bwaito bokoorokia oboronge bwa Nyasae, inki torateebe rende? Nyasae noy’otari omooronge ekero akorenta endamwamu? (Nakwanire buna Mwanyabaanto).
swahili: Ikiwa uovu wetu unathibitisha haki ya Mungu waziwazi, tuseme nini basi? Je, Mungu kuileta ghadhabu yake juu yetu ni kwamba yeye si mwenye haki? (Nanena kibinadamu.)

english: Certainly not! In that case, how could God judge the world?
ekegusii: Yaya, taibo! Onye nabo, inaki rende Nyasae aranyare kogaambia ense?
swahili: La hasha! Kama hivyo ndivyo ilivyo, Mungu angehukumuje ulimwengu?

english: However, if my falsehood accentuates God’s truthfulness, to the increase of His glory, why am I still condemned as a sinner?
ekegusii: Korende onye oboene obonge bwa Nyasae bwamentekire ase obonene bwaye ase engencho y’oborimo bwane, nase ki inche nonya mbono nkona‐kogambigwa buna omonyene ebibe?
swahili: Mtu aweza kuuliza, “Kama uongo wangu unasaidia kuonyesha kweli ya Mungu na kuzidisha utukufu wake, kwa nini basi mimi nahukumiwa kuwa mwenye dhambi?”

english: Why not say, as some slanderously claim that we say, “Let us do evil that good may result”? Their condemnation is deserved! There Is No One Righteous (Psalms 14:1–7; Psalms 53:1–6; Isaiah 59:1–17)
ekegusii: Inaki rende totagokora obobe, erinde obuya boche? Buna abande bagoteeba ase ogotoitania. Okogambigwa kwabo nigo kore boronge. Onde tari ore omooronge
swahili: Nasi kwa nini tusiseme, kama wengine wanavyotusingizia kuwa tunasema, “Tutende maovu ili mema yapate kuja?” Wao wanastahili hukumu yao. Wote Wametenda Dhambi

english: What then? Are we any better? Not at all. For we have already made the charge that Jews and Greeks alike are all under sin.
ekegusii: Ninki rende? Intwe Abayahudi n’abaya tore kobua abande? Yaya, nonya ng’ake! Inaki nasoereire Abayahudi amo n’Abagiriki ng’a bonsi nigo bare inse y’okobua kw’ebibe;
swahili: Tusemeje basi? Je, sisi ni bora kuwaliko wao? La hasha! Kwa maana tumekwisha kuhakikisha kwa vyovyote kwamba Wayahudi na watu wa Mataifa wote wako chini ya nguvu ya dhambi.

english: What then shall we say that Abraham, our forefather, has discovered?
ekegusii: Inki rende toratebe? Aburaamu sokoro yaito bw’ororeria inki anyorete?
swahili: Tuseme nini basi, kuhusu Abrahamu baba yetu kwa jinsi ya mwili: yeye alipataje kujua jambo hili?

english: In what context was it credited? Was it after his circumcision, or before? It was not after, but before.
ekegusii: Indi abareretwe ayio? Nekero konya arokire gose nekero konya ataraaroka? Tari ekero konya arokire, korende nekero konya ataraaroka.
swahili: Je, ni lini basi ilipohesabiwa kwake kuwa haki? Je, ilikuwa kabla au baada ya kutahiriwa kwake? Haikuwa baada, ila kabla hajatahiriwa.

english: And he received the sign of circumcision as a seal of the righteousness that he had by faith while he was still uncircumcised. So then, he is the father of all who believe but are not circumcised, in order that righteousness might be credited to them.
ekegusii: Ere nigo anyorete ekiorokererio eke gi’okwaroka buna ekemanyererio ki’oboronge bw’okwegena arenge naborobwo rigoro ataraaroka, anyare koba ise o bonsi abegenete, nonya tibaarogeti, erinde baabarerwe oboronge.
swahili: Alipewa ishara ya tohara kuwa muhuri wa haki aliyokuwa nayo kwa imani hata alipokuwa bado hajatahiriwa. Kusudi lilikuwa kumfanya baba wa wote wale waaminio pasipo kutahiriwa na ambao wamehesabiwa haki.

english: And he is also the father of the circumcised who not only are circumcised, but who also walk in the footsteps of the faith that our father Abraham had before he was circumcised. Abraham Receives the Promise (Genesis 15:8–21)
ekegusii: Naboigo akaba ise bw’abaarogete, tari ng’a baarogete rioka, korende boigo abagotunyana chimbaratero chi’okwegena kwaye sokoro yaito Aburaamu, oko arenge nakorokwo ekero konya ataraaroka. Eira ekoenekigwa ase okwegena
swahili: Vivyo hivyo awe baba wa wale waliotahiriwa ambao si kwamba wametahiriwa tu, bali pia wanafuata mfano wa imani ambayo Baba yetu Abrahamu alikuwa nayo kabla ya kutahiriwa. Ahadi Ya Mungu Hufahamika Kwa Imani

english: For the promise to Abraham and his offspring that he would be heir of the world was not given through the law, but through the righteousness that comes by faith.
ekegusii: Inaki eira eria Aburaamu aetwe amo noroiboro rw’aye ng’a naire omwando bw’ense, tiyarwete ase amachiiko korende ase oboronge obwo anyorete ase okwegena.
swahili: Kwa maana ile ahadi kwamba angeurithi ulimwengu haikuja kwa Abrahamu au kwa wazao wake kwa njia ya sheria bali kwa njia ya haki ipatikanayo kwa imani.

english: For if those who live by the law are heirs, faith is useless and the promise is worthless,
ekegusii: Inaki onye baria b’amachiiko mbarabwo abanyamwando, rirorio okwegena kwabeire okwa bosa, na eira yabeire teri gento.
swahili: Kwa maana ikiwa wale waishio kwa sheria ndio warithi, imani haina thamani na ahadi haifai kitu,

english: because the law brings wrath. And where there is no law, there is no transgression.
ekegusii: Ekiagera ogochika nakwo gokorenta endamwamu; na aase ogochika gotari, komocha tikoiyo.
swahili: kwa sababu sheria huleta ghadhabu. Mahali ambapo hakuna sheria hakuna makosa.

english: Therefore, the promise comes by faith, so that it may rest on grace and may be guaranteed to all Abraham’s offspring—not only to those who are of the law, but also to those who are of the faith of Abraham. He is the father of us all.
ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio eira eye nigo yanyoretwe ase okwegena, ebe ase enchera y’amaabera, erinde enyare koba eng’ikeranu ase oroiboro rwaye rwonsi, tari ase baria b’amachiiko boka korende nase baria bare nokwegena buna okwa Aburaamu. Ere nere tata oito intwe twensi,
swahili: Kwa hiyo, ahadi huja kwa njia ya imani, ili iwe ni kwa neema, na itolewe kwa wazao wa Abrahamu, si kwa wale walio wa sheria peke yao, bali pia kwa wale walio wa imani ya Abrahamu. Yeye ndiye baba yetu sisi sote.

english: As it is written: “I have made you a father of many nations.” He is our father in the presence of God, in whom he believed, the God who gives life to the dead and calls into being what does not yet exist.
ekegusii: buna eriikire ng’a, “Nakobekire obe ise bw’ebisaku ebinge”. Eira eye nigo yaikeranire ase obosio bwa Nyasae, ere oyo Aburaamu egenete, Nyasae oyokobokia abakuure, naende bwatora ebinto bitaiyo buna mbireo.
swahili: Kama ilivyoandikwa: “Nimekufanya wewe kuwa baba wa mataifa mengi.” Yeye ni baba yetu mbele za Mungu, ambaye yeye alimwamini, yule Mungu anaye fufua waliokufa, na kuvitaja vile vitu ambavyo haviko kana kwamba vimekwisha kuwako. Mfano Wa Imani Ya Abrahamu

english: Against all hope, Abraham in hope believed and so became the father of many nations, just as he had been told, “So shall your offspring be.”
ekegusii: Ere akeegena ase ogosemeria ase ay’atanyare gosemerigwa, erinde abe ise bw’ebisaku ebinge, buna ateebetigwe, “Naboigo oroiboro rwao rorabe.”
swahili: Akitarajia yasiyoweza kutarajiwa, Abrahamu akaamini, akawa baba wa mataifa mengi, kama alivyoahidiwa kwamba, “Uzao wako utakuwa mwingi mno.”

english: Without weakening in his faith, he acknowledged the decrepitness of his body (since he was about a hundred years old) and the lifelessness of Sarah’s womb.
ekegusii: Tabeete omworo ase okwegena, ekero aroche ng’a omobere oye obeire ang’e nogokwa, ekiagera konya okoorire emiaka koreng’ana rigana erimo, na enda ya Sara egombaete;
swahili: Abrahamu hakuwa dhaifu katika imani hata alipofikiri juu ya mwili wake, ambao ulikuwa kama uliokufa, kwani umri wake ulikuwa unakaribia miaka mia moja, au alipofikiri juu ya ufu wa tumbo la Sara.

english: If Abraham was indeed justified by works, he had something to boast about, but not before God.
ekegusii: Ekiagera onye Aburaamu oetwe oboronge ase engencho y’ogokora kwaye, nare neki agwetogeria, korende tari ase obosio bwa Nyasae.
swahili: Kwa maana ikiwa Abrahamu alihesabiwa haki kwa matendo, basi, anacho kitu cha kujivunia, lakini si mbele za Mungu.

english: Yet he did not waver through disbelief in the promise of God, but was strengthened in his faith and gave glory to God,
ekegusii: gose tabeete na tang’u‐tang’u chinde ase eira eria ya Nyasae ase ogotegena, korende nigo abegetwe chinguru ase okwegena kwaye, akamotogia Nyasae.
swahili: Lakini Abrahamu hakusitasita kwa kutokuamini ahadi ya Mungu, bali alitiwa nguvu katika imani yake na kumpa Mungu utukufu,

english: being fully persuaded that God was able to do what He had promised.
ekegusii: Akamanya boronge ng’a Nyasae nanyare gokora aria arierete eira.
swahili: akiwa na hakika kabisa kwamba Mungu alikuwa na uwezo wa kutimiza lile aliloahidi.

english: This is why “it was credited to him as righteousness.”
ekegusii: Ase ayio ase okwegena kwaye “akabarerwa ng’a nare noboronge.”
swahili: Hii ndio sababu, “ilihesabiwa kwake kuwa haki.”

english: Now the words “it was credited to him” were written not only for Abraham,
ekegusii: Korende amang’ana aya “akabarerwa ng’a nare noboronge” tarigetwe ase engencho yaye bweka,
swahili: Maneno haya “ilihesabiwa kwake kuwa haki,” hayakuandikwa kwa ajili yake peke yake,

english: but also for us, to whom righteousness will be credited—for us who believe in Him who raised Jesus our Lord from the dead.
ekegusii: korende nase engencho yaito boigo. Nonya nintwe ntoche kobarerwa boigo, intwe abatwamwegenire ere oyomobogetie Yeso, Omonene oito, korwa ase abakuure,
swahili: bali kwa ajili yetu sisi pia ambao Mungu atatupa haki, sisi tunaomwamini yeye aliyemfufua Yesu Bwana wetu kutoka kwa wafu.

english: He was delivered over to death for our trespasses and was raised to life for our justification.
ekegusii: oyoruetwe ase ogokwa ase engencho y’ebibe biaito, na akabokigwa ekiagera otorenteire oboronge.
swahili: Alitolewa afe kwa ajili ya dhambi zetu, naye alifufuliwa kutoka mauti ili tuhesabiwe haki.

english: For what does the Scripture say? “Abraham believed God, and it was credited to him as righteousness.”
ekegusii: Ninki amariiko agoteeba? “Aburaamu nigo amwegenete Nyasae, na ase engencho eyio akabarerwa oboronge.”
swahili: Kwa maana Maandiko yasemaje? “Abrahamu alimwamini Mungu na ikahesabiwa kwake kuwa haki.”

english: Now the wages of the worker are not credited as a gift, but as an obligation.
ekegusii: Korende ase omonto oy’ogokora emeremo, eng’eria yaye teri kobarwa buna nobuya, korende nigo ekoba ogoakanwa ase emeremo yaye.
swahili: Basi mtu afanyapo kazi, mshahara wake hauhesabiwi kwake kuwa ni zawadi, bali ni haki yake anayostahili.

english: However, to the one who does not work, but believes in Him who justifies the wicked, his faith is credited as righteousness.
ekegusii: Ase omonto otari gosemeria ogokora kw’emeremo yaye, korende nigo egenete ere oria okoa abanyabibe oboronge, okwegena kwaye omonto oyio kwamobarire ng’a n’are noboronge.
swahili: Lakini kwa mtu ambaye hafanyi kazi na anamtumaini Mungu, yeye ambaye huwahesabia waovu haki, imani yake inahesabiwa kuwa haki.

english: And David speaks likewise of the blessedness of the man to whom God credits righteousness apart from works:
ekegusii: Naboigo Daudi agoteeba, ng’a nasesenirie omonto oria ere Nyasae abarire koba noboronge atari nogokora kw’amachiiko,
swahili: Daudi pia alisema vivyo hivyo aliponena juu ya baraka za mtu ambaye Mungu humhesabia haki pasipo matendo:

english: “Blessed are they whose lawless acts are forgiven, whose sins are covered.
ekegusii: “Mbasesenirie abaabeirwe ebibe biabo, abwo ebibe biabo biatubirwe.
swahili: “Wamebarikiwa wale ambao wamesamehewa makosa yao, ambao dhambi zao zimefunikwa.

english: Blessed is the man whose sin the Lord will never count against him.”
ekegusii: Nasesenirie omonto ori’Omonene atabarereti ebibe biaye.”
swahili: Heri mtu yule Bwana hamhesabii dhambi zake.” Haki Kabla Ya Tohara

english: Is this blessing only on the circumcised, or also on the uncircumcised? We have been saying that Abraham’s faith was credited to him as righteousness.
ekegusii: Inee! Ogosesenigwa oko nigo kore ase abwo baarogete, gose nase abwo batarogeti boigo? Nigo togoteeba, ng’a Aburaamu ase okwegena kwaye akabarerwa ng’a nare noboronge.
swahili: Je, huku kubarikiwa ni kwa wale waliotahiriwa peke yao, au pia na kwa wale wasiotahiriwa? Tunasema, “Imani ya Abrahamu ilihesabiwa kwake kuwa haki.”

english: Therefore, since we have been justified through faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ,
ekegusii: Ase igo ekero twaeirwe oboronge ase okwegena, ntore nomorembe na Nyasae goetera ase Omonene oito Yeso Kristo.
swahili: Kwa hiyo, kwa kuwa tumekwisha kuhesabiwa haki kwa imani, tuna amani na Mungu kwa njia ya Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo,

english: For if, when we were enemies of God, we were reconciled to Him through the death of His Son, how much more, having been reconciled, shall we be saved through His life!
ekegusii: Inaki ekero twarenge ababisa ba Nyasae, tokabwatanigwa nere ase amakweri y’Omwana oye. Kobua mono, magega gatwabwatanigwe natotoorigwe ase obogima bwaye;
swahili: Kwa kuwa kama tulipokuwa adui wa Mungu tulipatanishwa naye kwa njia ya kifo cha Mwanawe, si zaidi sana tukiisha kupatanishwa, tutaokolewa kwa uzima wake.

english: Not only that, but we also rejoice in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, through whom we have now received reconciliation. Death in Adam, Life in Christ (Genesis 3:1–7)
ekegusii: gose tari igo rioka, korende nigo tokogoka ase Omonene oito Yeso Kristo ere ase are twanyorire okobwatanigwa. Amakweri goetera ase Adamu, obogima goetera ase Kristo
swahili: Lakini zaidi ya hayo, pia tunafurahi katika Mungu kwa njia ya Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo, ambaye kupitia kwake tumepata upatanisho. Adamu Alileta Kifo, Yesu Ameleta Uzima

english: Therefore, just as sin entered the world through one man, and death through sin, so also death was passed on to all men, because all sinned.
ekegusii: Ase ayio, buna ase engencho y’omonto oyomo ebibe bigasoa ase ense, na ase engencho y’ebibe amakweri, naboigo amakweri agaikera abanto bonsi, ekiagera bonsi bakorire ebibe.
swahili: Kwa hiyo kama vile dhambi ilivyoingia ulimwenguni kupitia kwa mtu mmoja, na kupitia dhambi hii mauti ikawafikia watu wote, kwa sababu wote wamefanya dhambi:

english: For sin was in the world before the law was given; but sin is not taken into account when there is no law.
ekegusii: Inaki ebibe nao biarenge ase ense amachiiko atarabekwa, korende ebibe tibikobarwa amachiiko ataiyo.
swahili: kwa maana kabla sheria haijatolewa, dhambi ilikuwepo ulimwenguni. Lakini dhambi haihesabiwi wakati hakuna sheria.

english: Nevertheless, death reigned from Adam until Moses, even over those who did not sin in the way that Adam transgressed. He is a pattern of the One to come.
ekegusii: Korende amakweri nigo agaambete korwa Adamu goika Musa, nonya niigoro y’abwo batakorete ebibe koreng’ana nogosaria kw’Adamu, oyorenge omogwekano bw’oyio ogochi‐gocha.
swahili: Hata hivyo, tangu wakati wa Adamu hadi wakati wa Mose, mauti ilitawala watu wote, hata wale ambao hawakutenda dhambi kwa kuvunja amri, kama alivyofanya Adamu, ambaye alikuwa mfano wa yule atakayekuja.

english: But the gift is not like the trespass. For if the many died by the trespass of the one man, how much more did God’s grace and the gift that came by the grace of the one man, Jesus Christ, abound to the many!
ekegusii: Korende ekeegwa keria ki’amaabera tikeri buna ogosaria koria. Inaki ase ogosaria kw’omonto oyomo abange bagakwa, korende amaabera a Nyasae na ekeegwa eke ki’amaabera biamentekire kobua mono ase abange ase omonto oyomo Yeso Kristo.
swahili: Lakini ile karama iliyotolewa haikuwa kama lile kosa. Kwa maana ikiwa watu wengi walikufa kwa sababu ya kosa la mtu mmoja, zaidi sana neema ya Mungu na ile karama iliyokuja kwa neema ya mtu mmoja, yaani, Yesu Kristo, imezidi kuwa nyingi kwa ajili ya wengi.

english: Again, the gift is not like the result of the one man’s sin: The judgment that followed one sin brought condemnation, but the gift that followed many trespasses brought justification.
ekegusii: Ekeegwa keria ki’amaabera tikeri buna ogosaria kw’omonto oyomo, ekiagera ekiina keria nigo giachete ase enchera y’ogosaria okomo, gekarenta okogambigwa, korende ekeegwa keria ki’amaabera kegaacha ase engencho y’ogosaria okonge, gekarenta oboronge.
swahili: Tena, ile karama ya Mungu si kama matokeo ya ile dhambi. Hukumu ilikuja kwa njia ya mtu mmoja, ikaleta adhabu, bali karama ya neema ya Mungu ilikuja kwa njia ya makosa mengi, ikaleta kuhesabiwa haki.

english: For if, by the trespass of the one man, death reigned through that one man, how much more will those who receive an abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness reign in life through the one man, Jesus Christ!
ekegusii: Onye ase ogosaria kw’omonto oyomo amakweri agaambete ase engencho y’omonto oria oyomo, kobua mono abwo banyorire amaabera amange na ekeegwa ki’oboronge nabagaambe ase obogima goetera ase omonto oyomo, Yeso Kristo.
swahili: Kwa maana ikiwa kutokana na kosa la mtu mmoja, mauti ilitawala kupitia huyo mtu mmoja, zaidi sana wale wanaopokea wingi wa neema ya Mungu na karama yake ya kuhesabiwa haki, watatawala katika uzima kwa njia ya huyo mtu mmoja, yaani, Yesu Kristo.

english: So then, just as one trespass brought condemnation for all men, so also one act of righteousness brought justification and life for all men.
ekegusii: Naboigo, buna ase ogosaria kw’omonto oyomo abanto bonsi bakanacherwa ekiina, ee, naboigo ase ogokora kw’oboronge kw’omonto oyomo, abanto bonsi bakaegwa oboronge na obogima.
swahili: Kwa hiyo, kama vile kosa la mtu mmoja lilivyoleta adhabu kwa watu wote, vivyo hivyo pia kwa tendo la haki la mtu mmoja lilileta kuhesabiwa haki ambako huleta uzima kwa wote.

english: For just as through the disobedience of the one man the many were made sinners, so also through the obedience of the one man the many will be made righteous.
ekegusii: Inaki buna ase ogotaigwera kw’omonto oyomo abange bagakorwa koba abanyene ebibe, naboigo ase okogwa kw’omonto oyomo abange nabakorwe koba abanyene oboronge.
swahili: Kwa maana kama vile kwa kutokutii kwa yule mtu mmoja wengi walifanywa wenye dhambi, vivyo hivyo kwa kutii kwa mtu mmoja wengi watafanywa wenye haki.

english: through whom we have gained access by faith into this grace in which we stand. And we rejoice in the hope of the glory of God.
ekegusii: Goetera ase are twaigoreirwe enchera ase okwegena goikera ase obuya obo toteneine ime yaye, naende nigo tokogoka ase ogosemeria kw’obonene bwa Nyasae.
swahili: ambaye kwa kupitia kwake tumepata kwa njia ya imani kuifikia neema hii ambayo ndani yake sasa tunasimama, nasi twafurahia katika tumaini letu la kushiriki utukufu wa Mungu.

english: The law came in so that the trespass would increase; but where sin increased, grace increased all the more,
ekegusii: Amachiiko agasoa, erinde ogosaria kobe okonene mono. Korende aase ebibe biamentegete, amaabera akamenteka akaba amange kobua,
swahili: Zaidi ya hayo, sheria ilikuja, ili uvunjaji wa sheria uongezeke. Lakini dhambi ilipoongezeka, neema iliongezeka zaidi,

english: so that, just as sin reigned in death, so also grace might reign through righteousness to bring eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.
ekegusii: erinde, buna ebibe biagaambete ase amakweri, naboigo ase enchera y’oboronge amaabera agaambe goika obogima bwa kare na kare goetera ase Yeso Kristo, Omonene oito.
swahili: ili kwamba kama vile dhambi ilivyotawala kwa njia ya mauti, vivyo hivyo neema iweze kutawala kwa njia ya kuhesabiwa haki hata kuleta uzima wa milele katika Yesu Kristo Bwana wetu.

english: Not only that, but we also rejoice in our sufferings, because we know that suffering produces perseverance;
ekegusii: Gose tari igo rioka, korende nigo tokogoka nonya nase emechando yaito, ekiagera ntomanyete ng’a emechando nigo ekorenta oboremereria;
swahili: Si hivyo tu, bali twafurahi pia katika mateso, kwa sababu tunajua kuwa mateso huleta saburi,

english: perseverance, character; and character, hope.
ekegusii: na oboremereria nigo bokorenta oboremu bw’omoyo, na oboremu bw’omoyo nigo bokorenta ogosemeria.
swahili: nayo saburi huleta uthabiti wa moyo, na uthabiti wa moyo huleta tumaini,

english: And hope does not disappoint us, because God has poured out His love into our hearts through the Holy Spirit, whom He has given us. Christ’s Sacrifice for the Ungodly (John 3:1–21)
ekegusii: Na ogosemeria tikori gotorentera obosooku, ekiagera obwanchani bwa Nyasae bwaichorigwe ase chinkoro chiaito n’Omoika Omochenu, oyo twaetwe. Obwanchani bwa Nyasae bwaorokigwe ase ogokwa gwa Kristo
swahili: wala tumaini halitukatishi tamaa, kwa sababu Mungu amekwisha kumimina pendo lake mioyoni mwetu kwa njia ya Roho Mtakatifu ambaye ametupatia.

english: For at just the right time, while we were still powerless, Christ died for the ungodly.
ekegusii: Amaene ekero totarenge ne chinguru, ekero engaki yaigete, Kristo agakwa ase engencho y’abanyabibe.
swahili: Kwa maana hata tulipokuwa dhaifu, wakati ulipowadia, Kristo alikufa kwa ajili yetu sisi wenye dhambi.

english: Very rarely will anyone die for a righteous man, though for a good man someone might possibly dare to die.
ekegusii: Inaki naakong’u omonto gokwa ribaga ri’omonto omonyene oboronge, korende nenyarekane omonto koremereria gokwa ribaga ri’omonto omuya.
swahili: Hakika, ni vigumu mtu yeyote kufa kwa ajili ya mwenye haki, ingawa inawezekana mtu akathubutu kufa kwa ajili ya mtu mwema.

english: But God proves His love for us in this: While we were still sinners, Christ died for us.
ekegusii: Korende Nyasae oorokirie obwanchani bwaye ase tore ase ogotoma Kristo gokwa ase engencho yaito, ekero twarenge abanyene ebibe.
swahili: Lakini Mungu anaudhihirisha upendo wake kwetu kwamba: Tulipokuwa tungali wenye dhambi, Kristo alikufa kwa ajili yetu.

english: Therefore, since we have now been justified by His blood, how much more shall we be saved from wrath through Him!
ekegusii: Naboigo kobua mono, gatwaeirwe oboronge ase amanyinga aye, ere natotoorie korwa ase endamwamu ya Nyasae.
swahili: Basi, kwa kuwa sasa tumehesabiwa haki kwa damu yake, si zaidi sana tutaokolewa kutoka ghadhabu ya Mungu kupitia kwake!

english: What then shall we say? Shall we continue in sin so that grace may increase?
ekegusii: Ninki rende torateebe? Togenderere ase ebibe, erinde amaabera amenteke abe amange kobua?
swahili: Tuseme nini basi? Je, tuendelee kutenda dhambi ili neema ipate kuongezeka?

english: The death He died, He died to sin once for all; but the life He lives, He lives to God.
ekegusii: Ase ogokwa koria akwete nigo akwerete ebibe ara rimo rioka, korende obogima boria are nabwo nigo are nabwo ase Nyasae.
swahili: Kifo alichokufa, aliifia dhambi mara moja tu, lakini uzima alio nao anamwishia Mungu.

english: So you too must count yourselves dead to sin, but alive to God in Christ Jesus.
ekegusii: Naboigo nainwe mwebare ng’a mwabeire abakuure ase ebibe, korende mwabeire moyo ase Nyasae ime ase Kristo Yeso.
swahili: Vivyo hivyo, jihesabuni wafu katika dhambi lakini mlio hai kwa Mungu katika Kristo Yesu.

english: Therefore do not let sin reign in your mortal body so that you obey its desires.
ekegusii: Bono timotiga ebibe bigaambe ime ase emebere yaino ey’ekonyorekana n’amakweri, na timobaisa koigwera okogania kwabo okobe.
swahili: Kwa hiyo, msiruhusu dhambi itawale ndani ya miili yenu, ipatikanayo na kufa, ili kuwafanya mzitii tamaa mbaya.

english: Do not present the parts of your body to sin as instruments of wickedness, but present yourselves to God as those who have been brought from death to life; and present the parts of your body to Him as instruments of righteousness.
ekegusii: Timobaisa korua ebiimo biaino bikore ebibe buna ebikorero bi’obobe, korende mwerue abanyene ase Nyasae buna abanto barusetigwe korwa ase ogokwa na babekirwe ase obogima, na ebiimo biaino ase Nyasae bibe ebikorero bi’oboronge.
swahili: Wala msivitoe viungo vya miili yenu vitumike kama vyombo vya uovu vya kutenda dhambi, bali jitoeni kwa Mungu, kama watu waliotolewa kutoka mautini kuingia uzimani. Nanyi vitoeni viungo vya miili yenu kwake kama vyombo vya haki.

english: For sin shall not be your master, because you are not under law, but under grace. The Wages of Sin
ekegusii: Inaki ebibe tibikobaagaambera inwe, ekiagera timori inse y’amachiiko korende inse y’amaabera. Okworokereria korwa ase obosomba
swahili: Kwa maana dhambi haitakuwa na mamlaka juu yenu, kwa sababu hampo chini ya sheria, bali chini ya neema. Watumwa Wa Haki

english: What then? Shall we sin because we are not under law, but under grace? Certainly not!
ekegusii: Ninki rende? Tokore ebibe ekiagera totari inse y’amachiiko korende inse y’amaabera? Yaya taibo!
swahili: Ni nini basi? Je, tutende dhambi kwa kuwa hatuko chini ya sheria bali chini ya neema? La, hasha!

english: Do you not know that when you offer yourselves as obedient slaves, you are slaves to the one you obey, whether you are slaves to sin leading to death, or to obedience leading to righteousness?
ekegusii: Timomanyeti ng’a onye mwerure ase omonto onde koba abasomba baye na komoigwera, nigo more abasomba baye ere oria moigwerete, onye n’obosomba bw’ebibe obokoraa gochia ase amakweri, gose obosomba bw’okoigwera obokoraa gochia ase oboronge?
swahili: Je, hamjui kwamba mnapojitoa kwa mtu yeyote kama watumwa watiifu, ninyi ni watumwa wa yule mnayemtii, aidha watumwa wa dhambi, ambayo matokeo yake ni mauti, au watumwa wa utii ambao matokeo yake ni haki?

english: But thanks be to God that, though you once were slaves to sin, you wholeheartedly obeyed the form of teaching to which you were committed.
ekegusii: Korende Nyasae aakerwe ng’a mbuya mono, ekiagera inwe, abamwarenge abasomba b’ebibe, mwabeire abaigweri ase chinkoro chiaino ase okworokereria koria mwaetwe,
swahili: Lakini Mungu ashukuriwe kwa kuwa ninyi ambao kwanza mlikuwa watumwa wa dhambi, mmekuwa watii kutoka moyoni kwa mafundisho mliyopewa.

english: You have been set free from sin and have become slaves to righteousness.
ekegusii: na ekero mwasiboretwe korwa ase ebibe mogakorwa koba abasomba b’oboronge.
swahili: Nanyi, mkiisha kuwekwa huru mbali na dhambi, mmekuwa watumwa wa haki.

english: I am speaking in human terms because of the weakness of your flesh. Just as you used to offer the parts of your body in slavery to impurity and to escalating wickedness, so now offer them in slavery to righteousness leading to holiness.
ekegusii: Nigo ngokwana buna engencho ya Mwanyabaanto ase engencho y’oboreu bwaino bwa Mwanyabaanto, Inaki koreng’ana buna inwe ritang’ani mwaruete ebiimo biaino bibe ebisomba bi’obonyaka na ase ogosaria okonene mono, naboigo na bono karue ebiimo biaino bikorere oboronge, monyare gokorwa koba abachenu.
swahili: Ninasema kwa namna ya kibinadamu kwa sababu ya udhaifu wenu wa hali ya asili. Kama vile mlivyokuwa mkivitoa viungo vya miili yenu kama watumwa wa mambo machafu na uovu uliokuwa ukiongezeka zaidi, hivyo sasa vitoeni viungo vyenu kama watumwa wa haki inayowaelekeza mpate kutakaswa.

english: Certainly not! How can we who died to sin live in it any longer?
ekegusii: Yaya, taibo! Intwe abatwakuure korwa ase ebibe, inaki toranyare komenya ase ebibe naende?
swahili: La hasha! Sisi tulioifia dhambi, tutawezaje kuendelea kuishi tena katika dhambi?

english: For when you were slaves to sin, you were free of obligation to righteousness.
ekegusii: Inaki ekero mwarenge abasomba b’ebibe nigo mwarenge abasibore korwa ase oboronge.
swahili: Mlipokuwa watumwa wa dhambi, mlikuwa hamtawaliwi na haki.

english: What fruit did you reap at that time from the things of which you are now ashamed? The outcome of those things is death.
ekegusii: Nkwama ki rende mwanyorete korwa ase ebinto biria bikobarentera obosooku bono? Inaki omoerio bw’ebinto ebi n’amakweri.
swahili: Lakini mlipata faida gani kwa mambo hayo ambayo sasa mnayaonea aibu? Mwisho wa mambo hayo ni mauti.

english: But now that you have been set free from sin and have become slaves to God, the fruit you reap leads to holiness, and the outcome is eternal life.
ekegusii: Korende bono ekero mwasiboirwe korwa ase ebibe na gokorwa koba abasomba ba Nyasae, okwama kwaino more nakwo noko, ng’a mokorwe koba abachenu, na omoerio oye nobogima bwa kare na kare.
swahili: Lakini sasa kwa kuwa mmewekwa huru mbali na dhambi na mmekuwa watumwa wa Mungu, faida mnayopata ni utakatifu, ambao mwisho wake ni uzima wa milele.

english: For the wages of sin is death, but the gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.
ekegusii: Inaki eng’eria y’ebibe n’amakweri, korende ekeegwa kia Nyasae nobogima bwa kare na kare ase Kristo Yeso, Omonene oito.
swahili: Kwa maana mshahara wa dhambi ni mauti, bali karama ya Mungu ni uzima wa milele katika Kristo Yesu Bwana wetu.

english: Or aren’t you aware that all of us who were baptized into Christ Jesus were baptized into His death?
ekegusii: Timomanyeti ng’a intwe twensi abatwabatisetwe ase Kristo Yeso nigo twabatisetwe ase amakweri aye?
swahili: Au hamjui ya kuwa sisi sote tuliobatizwa katika Kristo Yesu tulibatizwa katika mauti yake?

english: We were therefore buried with Him through baptism into death, in order that, just as Christ was raised from the dead through the glory of the Father, we too may walk in newness of life.
ekegusii: Naboigo twatindegetwe amo nere ase enchera y’ebatiso ase amakweri, erinde buna Kristo abogetigwe korwa ase abakuure ase obonene bwa Ise, naboigo naintwe, totaare ase obogima oboyia.
swahili: Kwa hiyo tulizikwa pamoja naye kwa njia ya ubatizo katika mauti, ili kama vile Kristo alivyofufuliwa kutoka kwa wafu kwa utukufu wa Baba, vivyo hivyo sisi nasi pia tupate kuenenda katika upya wa uzima.

english: For if we have been united with Him like this in His death, we will certainly also be united with Him in His resurrection.
ekegusii: Inaki onye twabwatanire nere ase amakweri buna ayaye, naboigo torabwatane nere ase okobokigwa buna ok’waye.
swahili: Kwa maana ikiwa tumeungana naye katika mauti yake, bila shaka tutaungana naye katika ufufuo wake.

english: We know that our old self was crucified with Him so that the body of sin might be rendered powerless, that we should no longer be slaves to sin.
ekegusii: Twamanyire ng’a obo Mwanyabaanto bwaito bwa kare nigo bwabambetwe amo nere, erinde omobere bw’ebibe osirigwe, titoba abasomba b’ebibe naende.
swahili: Kwa maana twajua kwamba utu wetu wa kale ulisulubiwa pamoja naye ili ule mwili wa dhambi upate kuangamizwa, nasi tusiendelee kuwa tena watumwa wa dhambi.

english: For anyone who has died has been freed from sin.
ekegusii: Inaki ere oy okuure osiboirwe korwa ase ebibe.
swahili: Kwa maana mtu yeyote aliyekufa amehesabiwa haki mbali na dhambi.

english: Now if we died with Christ, we believe that we will also live with Him.
ekegusii: Korende onye twakwete amo na Kristo, twegenire ng’a inatobe moyo amo nere.
swahili: Basi ikiwa tulikufa pamoja na Kristo, tunaamini kwamba pia tutaishi pamoja naye.

english: For we know that since Christ was raised from the dead, He cannot die again; death no longer has dominion over Him.
ekegusii: Twamanyire ng’a Kristo oyobogetigwe korwa ase abakuure tagokwa naende; amakweri takomogaambera naende.
swahili: Kwa maana tunajua kwamba Kristo, kwa sababu alifufuliwa kutoka kwa wafu, hawezi kufa tena; mauti haina tena mamlaka juu yake.

english: Do you not know, brothers (for I am speaking to those who know the law), that the law has authority over a man only as long as he lives?
ekegusii: Timomanyeti, baminto (inche nigo ngokwana nabwo bamanyete amachiiko) ng’a amachiiko nigo akogaambera omonto ekero are moyo?
swahili: Ndugu zangu (sasa ninasema na wale wanaoijua sheria), je, hamjui ya kwamba sheria ina mamlaka tu juu ya mtu wakati akiwa hai?

english: So I discovered that the very commandment that was meant to bring life actually brought death.
ekegusii: Ogochika koria gw’okong’a obogima, gokarorekana gokondetera amakweri.
swahili: Nikaona kwamba ile amri iliyokusudiwa kuleta uzima, ilileta mauti.

english: For sin, seizing its opportunity through the commandment, deceived me and through the commandment put me to death.
ekegusii: Inaki ebibe bikanyora ribaga ase ogochika koria, bikang’aina, na ase korokwo bikang’ita.
swahili: Kwa maana dhambi kwa kupata nafasi katika amri, ilinidanganya, na kupitia katika hiyo amri, ikaniua.

english: So then, the law is holy, and the commandment is holy, righteous, and good. Struggling with Sin
ekegusii: Naboigo amachiiko namachenu, na ogochika nogochenu, na okwa boronge, na okuya.
swahili: Hivyo basi, sheria yenyewe ni takatifu, na amri ni takatifu na ya haki, tena ni njema.

english: Did that which is good, then, become death to me? Certainly not! But in order that sin might be exposed as sin, it produced death in me through what was good, so that through the commandment sin might become utterly sinful.
ekegusii: Bono inee, riria erire rigiya ndiabeire amakweri ase ’nde? Yaya, taibo! Ebibe bikang’ita ase enchera y’erire rigiya, erio ebibe birorekane ng’a nebibe, erinde ase ogochika koria ebibe bimenteke koba bitari nekerengo. Chingencho ibere chia Mwanyabaanto
swahili: Je, kile kilicho chema basi kilikuwa mauti kwangu? La, hasha! Lakini ili dhambi itambuliwe kuwa ni dhambi, ilileta mauti ndani yangu kupitia kile kilichokuwa chema, ili kwa njia ya amri dhambi izidi kuwa mbaya kupita kiasi. Mgongano Wa Ndani

english: We know that the law is spiritual; but I am unspiritual, sold as a slave to sin.
ekegusii: Inaki twamanyire ng’a amachiiko nay’Omoika, korende inche n’omonto bw’engencho y’ebibe; nigo naonetigwe inse ase obosomba bw’ebibe.
swahili: Kwa maana tunajua kwamba sheria ni ya kiroho, lakini mimi ni wa kimwili nikiwa nimeuzwa kwenye utumwa wa dhambi.

english: I do not understand what I do. For what I want to do, I do not do. But what I hate, I do.
ekegusii: Inaki timanyeti aya ngokora, ekiagera aya nyanchete, tindi koyakora, korende aya ngechete naro ngokora.
swahili: Sielewi nitendalo, kwa maana lile ninalotaka kulitenda, silitendi, lakini ninatenda lile ninalolichukia.

english: And if I do what I do not want to do, I admit that the law is good.
ekegusii: Korende onye ngokora aya ntancheti, rirorio nanchire ng’a amachiiko n’amaya.
swahili: Basi kama ninatenda lile nisilotaka kutenda, ni kwamba ninakubali kuwa sheria ni njema.

english: In that case, it is no longer I who do it, but it is sin living in me that does it.
ekegusii: Ase ayio, bono tari inche nkoyakora, korende n’ebibe biria bimenyete ime ase ’nde.
swahili: Lakini, kwa kweli si mimi tena nitendaye lile nisilotaka bali ni ile dhambi ikaayo ndani yangu.

english: I know that nothing good lives in me, that is, in my flesh; for I have the desire to do what is good, but I cannot carry it out.
ekegusii: Inaki namanyire ng’a ime ase ’nde, ase engencho y’ane y’obobe, kende kiya tikeiyo; okorigia kw’ogokora okuya nkoreo, korende tinkonyara kogokora.
swahili: Kwa maana ninafahamu kwamba hakuna jema lolote likaalo ndani yangu, yaani, katika asili yangu ya dhambi. Kwa kuwa nina shauku ya kutenda lililo jema, lakini siwezi kulitenda.

english: For I do not do the good I want to do. Instead, I keep on doing the evil I do not want to do.
ekegusii: Inaki keria kere ekiya nyanchete, tindi kogekora, korende keria kere ekebe ntancheti, nakio ngokora.
swahili: Sitendi lile jema nitakalo kutenda, bali lile baya nisilolitaka, ndilo nitendalo.

english: For instance, a married woman is bound by law to her husband as long as he lives. But if her husband dies, she is released from the law of marriage.
ekegusii: Inaki omokungu onyuomire igo asibire n’amachiiko ase omosacha oye, ekero ere are moyo, korende omosacha oye karakwe, rirorio osiboirwe korwa ase amachiiko aria amosibete ase omosacha oria.
swahili: Kwa mfano, mwanamke aliyeolewa amefungwa kwa mumewe wakati akiwa hai, lakini yule mume akifa, yule mwanamke amefunguliwa kutoka sheria ya ndoa.

english: And if I do what I do not want, it is no longer I who do it, but it is sin living in me that does it.
ekegusii: Onye ngokora keria ntancheti, bono tari inche nkogekora, korende n’ebibe biria bimenyete ime ase ’nde.
swahili: Basi kama ninatenda lile nisilotaka kutenda, si mimi tena nifanyaye hivyo, bali ni ile dhambi ikaayo ndani yangu.

english: So this is the principle I have discovered: When I want to do good, evil is right there with me.
ekegusii: Narorire ogochika oko, ng’a kondigetie gokora ekere ekiya, ekere ekebe nigo kenyesungetie.
swahili: Hivyo naiona sheria ikitenda kazi. Ninapotaka kutenda jema, jambo baya liko papo hapo.

english: For in my inner being I delight in God’s law.
ekegusii: Inaki nigo ngosasoka mono ase omoyo one ase engencho y’amachiiko a Nyasae,
swahili: Kwa maana katika utu wangu wa ndani naifurahia sheria ya Mungu.

english: But I see another law at work in my body, warring against the law of my mind and holding me captive to the law of sin that dwells within me.
ekegusii: korende ase ebiimo biane narorire ogochika konde nkoreo, gokorwana esegi n’ogochika gw’okomanya kw’ane na kogonkora koba omosakorwa bw’ogochika koria kw’ebibe kore ase ebiimo biane.
swahili: Lakini ninaona kuna sheria nyingine inayotenda kazi katika viungo vya mwili wangu inayopigana vita dhidi ya ile sheria ya akili yangu. Sheria hii inanifanya mateka wa ile sheria ya dhambi inayofanya kazi katika viungo vya mwili wangu.

english: What a wretched man I am! Who will rescue me from this body of death?
ekegusii: Obobe nobwane inche Mwanyabaanto! Ning’o oransibore korwa ase omobere oyo bw’amakweri?
swahili: Ole wangu mimi maskini! Ni nani atakayeniokoa na mwili huu wa mauti?

english: Thanks be to God, through Jesus Christ our Lord! So then, with my mind I serve the law of God, but with my flesh I serve the law of sin.
ekegusii: Namoakeire Nyasae ng’a mbuya mono ase Yeso Kristo Omonene oito! Inaki inche omonyene ase okomanya kw’ane nigo ngokorera amachiiko a Nyasae, korende ase engencho y’obobe bwane nigo ngokorera amachiiko y’ebibe.
swahili: Ashukuriwe Mungu kwa njia ya Yesu Kristo Bwana wetu! Hivyo basi, mimi mwenyewe kwa akili zangu ni mtumwa wa sheria ya Mungu, lakini katika asili ya dhambi ni mtumwa wa sheria ya dhambi.

english: So then, if she is joined to another man while her husband is still alive, she is called an adulteress; but if her husband dies, she is free from that law and is not an adulteress, even if she marries another man.
ekegusii: Naboigo ekero omosacha oye are moyo, aise koba nomosaacha onde nigo akorokwa omotomani; korende omosacha oye karakwe, rirorio osiboirwe korwa ase amachiiko ayio. Naisa konyuomwa nomosaacha onde, takorokwa omotomani.
swahili: Hivyo basi, kama huyo mwanamke ataolewa na mwanaume mwingine wakati mumewe akiwa bado yuko hai, ataitwa mzinzi. Lakini kama mumewe akifa, mwanamke huyo hafungwi tena na sheria ya ndoa, naye akiolewa na mtu mwingine haitwi mzinzi.

english: Therefore, my brothers, you also died to the law through the body of Christ, that you might belong to another, to Him who was raised from the dead, in order that we might bear fruit to God.
ekegusii: Naboigo baminto, nainwe mwakwereire amachiiko ase enchera y’omobere o Kristo, erinde monyare koba ab’omoao, abaye ere oy’obogetigwe korwa ase abakuure, erinde tomwamere Nyasae okwama.
swahili: Vivyo hivyo, ndugu zangu, ninyi mmeifia sheria kwa njia ya mwili wa Kristo, ili mweze kuwa mali ya mwingine, yeye ambaye alifufuliwa kutoka kwa wafu, ili tupate kuzaa matunda kwa Mungu.

english: For when we lived according to the flesh, the sinful passions aroused by the law were at work in our bodies, bearing fruit for death.
ekegusii: Inaki ekero twarenge ime y’engencho yaito y’ebibe okogania gwaito kw’ebibe gokabooka ase engencho y’amachiiko, kogakora emeremo ase ebiimo biaito goika tokaamera amakweri okwama.
swahili: Kwa maana tulipokuwa tunatawaliwa na asili ya dhambi, tamaa za dhambi zilizochochewa na sheria zilikuwa zikitenda kazi katika miili yetu, hivyo tulizaa matunda ya mauti.

english: But now, having died to what bound us, we have been released from the law, so that we serve in the new way of the Spirit, and not in the old way of the written code. God’s Law Is Holy
ekegusii: Korende bono twasiboirwe korwa ase amachiiko, twakwereire ay’atosibete, erinde tonyare gokorera ase obogima oboyia bw’Omoika, tari inse y’amachiiko a kare ayariikire. Amachiiko na ebibe
swahili: Lakini sasa, kwa kufia kile kilichokuwa kimetufunga kwanza, tumewekwa huru kutokana na sheria ili tutumike katika njia mpya ya Roho, wala si katika njia ya zamani ya sheria iliyoandikwa. Sheria Na Dhambi

english: What then shall we say? Is the law sin? Certainly not! Indeed, I would not have been mindful of sin if not for the law. For I would not have been aware of coveting if the law had not said, “Do not covet.”
ekegusii: Ninki rende torateebe? Amachiiko n’ebibe? Yaya, taibo! Korende tinare komanya ebibe onye amachiiko atarengeo; inaki tinare komanya okogania okobe, onye ogochika gotagoteeba, “Toba nokogania okobe.”
swahili: Tuseme nini basi? Kwamba sheria ni dhambi? La, hasha! Lakini, isingekuwa kwa sababu ya sheria, nisingalijua dhambi. Nisingalijua kutamani ni nini kama sheria haikusema, “Usitamani.”

english: But sin, seizing its opportunity through the commandment, produced in me every kind of covetous desire. For apart from the law, sin is dead.
ekegusii: Korende ebibe bikanyora ribaga ase ogochika koria, bikabokia ime ase ’nde chingencho chionsi chi’okogania okobe. Ase amachiiko atari, rirorio ebibe mbikwete.
swahili: Lakini dhambi kwa kupata nafasi katika amri, hii ikazaa ndani yangu kila aina ya tamaa. Kwa maana pasipo sheria, dhambi imekufa.

english: Once I was alive apart from the law; but when the commandment came, sin sprang to life and I died.
ekegusii: Inche iga narenge moyo agwo ritang’ani ekero ntarenge n’amachiiko, korende ekero ogochika koria gwachete, ebibe bikaboka, na inche ’ngakwa.
swahili: Wakati fulani nilikuwa hai pasipo sheria, lakini amri ilipokuja, dhambi ikawa hai, nami nikafa.

english: Therefore, there is now no condemnation for those who are in Christ Jesus.
ekegusii: Na bono kogaambigwa tikori ase abwo bare ime ase Kristo Yeso.
swahili: Kwa hiyo, sasa hakuna hukumu ya adhabu kwa wale walio ndani ya Kristo Yesu, wale ambao hawaenendi kwa kuufuata mwili bali kwa kufuata Roho.

english: But if Christ is in you, your body is dead because of sin, yet your spirit is alive because of righteousness.
ekegusii: Na Kristo kar’abe ime yaino, nonya emebere yaino ekwete ase engencho y’ebibe, emeika yaino moyo ere ase engencho y’oboronge obo mwanyorete.
swahili: Lakini kama Kristo anakaa ndani yenu, miili yenu imekufa kwa sababu ya dhambi, lakini roho zenu zi hai kwa sababu ya haki.

english: And if the Spirit of Him who raised Jesus from the dead is living in you, He who raised Christ Jesus from the dead will also give life to your mortal bodies through His Spirit, who lives in you. Heirs with Christ
ekegusii: Korende onye Omoika oye ere oyobogetie Yeso korwa ase abakuure omenyete ime yaino, ere oyobogetie Kristo Yeso korwa ase abakuure nabookie na emebere yaino eranyorekane n’amakweri, ase engencho y’Omoika oy’omenyete ime yaino.
swahili: Nanyi ikiwa Roho wa Mungu aliyemfufua Yesu kutoka kwa wafu anakaa ndani yenu, yeye aliyemfufua Kristo Yesu kutoka kwa wafu ataihuisha pia miili yenu ambayo hufa, kwa njia ya Roho wake akaaye ndani yenu.

english: Therefore, brothers, we have an obligation, but it is not to the flesh, to live according to it.
ekegusii: Naboigo baminto, igo tore abasiira, korende tari ase chingencho chiaito chi’ebibe, ase ogotunyana chingencho chi’ebibe,
swahili: Kwa hiyo ndugu zangu, sisi tu wadeni, si wa mwili, ili tuishi kwa kuufuata mwili,

english: For if you live according to the flesh, you will die; but if by the Spirit you put to death the deeds of the body, you will live.
ekegusii: inaki komoratunyane chingencho chi’ebibe, nigo morakwe, korende komoraite ogokora kw’omobere ase chinguru chi’Omoika, inamobe moyo. Abana ba Nyasae
swahili: kwa maana mkiishi kwa kuufuata mwili, mtakufa, lakini kama mkiyaua matendo ya mwili kwa Roho, mtaishi.

english: For all who are led by the Spirit of God are sons of God.
ekegusii: Inaki bonsi abakoraagwa n’Omoika o Nyasae, abwo nabwo abana ba Nyasae.
swahili: Kwa kuwa wote wanaoongozwa na Roho wa Mungu, hao ndio watoto wa Mungu.

english: For you did not receive a spirit of slavery that returns you to fear, but you received the Spirit of sonship, by whom we cry, “Abba! Father!”
ekegusii: Inaki timwanyorete omoika oyo obakorire koba abasomba na korenta obwoba, korende nigo mwanyorete Omoika oyo obakorire koba abana ba Nyasae. Igo torera, “Abba!” Engencho yaye “Tata!”
swahili: Kwa maana hamkupokea roho ya utumwa iwaleteayo tena hofu, bali mlipokea roho ya kufanywa wana, ambaye kwa yeye twalia, “Abba, yaani, Baba,”

english: The Spirit Himself testifies with our spirit that we are God’s children.
ekegusii: Omoika omonyene obeire kirori amo n’emeika yaito, ng’a intwe nabana ba Nyasae.
swahili: Roho mwenyewe hushuhudia pamoja na roho zetu ya kwamba sisi tu watoto wa Mungu.

english: And if we are children, then we are heirs: heirs of God and co-heirs with Christ—if indeed we suffer with Him, so that we may also be glorified with Him. Future Glory (2 Corinthians 5:1–10)
ekegusii: Onye tore abana, naboigo tore abanyamwando, abanyamwando ba Nyasae, abaraire omwando amo na Kristo, gatorachandwe amo nere, erinde tonyore obonene amo nere. Obonene bogochi‐gocha
swahili: Hivyo, ikiwa sisi ni watoto, basi tu warithi, warithi wa Mungu, warithio pamoja na Kristo, naam, tukiteswa pamoja naye tupate pia kutukuzwa pamoja naye. Utukufu Ujao

english: I consider that our present sufferings are not comparable to the glory that will be revealed in us.
ekegusii: Nabarire emechando y’ekero kia bono, ng’a teri gento onye ekoreng’anigwa nobonene boria bogocha koorokigwa ase tore.
swahili: Nayahesabu mateso yetu ya wakati huu kuwa si kitu kulinganisha na utukufu utakaodhihirishwa kwetu.

english: The creation waits in eager expectation for the revelation of the sons of God.
ekegusii: Nabo ebitongwa bionsi nigo biganyete n’okogania okonene mono ase rituko riria Abana ba Nyasae bagocha koorokigwa.
swahili: Kwa maana viumbe vyote vinangoja kwa shauku kudhihirishwa kwa watoto wa Mungu.

english: For in Christ Jesus the law of the Spirit of life set you free from the law of sin and death.
ekegusii: Inaki ogochika kw’Omoika bw’obogima boria bore ime ase Kristo Yeso gwansiboire korwa ase ogochika kw’ebibe na amakweri.
swahili: Kwa sababu sheria ya Roho wa uzima katika Kristo Yesu imeniweka huru mbali na sheria ya dhambi na mauti.

english: For the creation was subjected to futility, not by its own will, but because of the One who subjected it, in hope
ekegusii: Inaki ebitongwa bionsi nigo biabegetwe inse y’engencho ya bosa, tari ase ogwancha kwabo, korende ase ogwancha kwaye ere oyobibegete ase ogosemeria,
swahili: Kwa kuwa viumbe vyote viliwekwa chini ya ubatili, si kwa chaguo lao, bali kwa mapenzi yake yeye aliyevitiisha katika tumaini,

english: that the creation itself will be set free from its bondage to decay and brought into the glorious freedom of the children of God.
ekegusii: ekiagera ebitongwa ebinyene nabisiborwe korwa ase obosibwa bwabo bw’ogosareka, bisoe ime ase ogosiborwa kw’obonene bw’abaana ba Nyasae.
swahili: ili kwamba viumbe vyote vipate kuwekwa huru kutoka kwa utumwa wa kuharibika na kupewa uhuru wa utukufu wa watoto wa Mungu.

english: We know that the whole creation has been groaning together in the pains of childbirth until the present time.
ekegusii: Inaki twamanyire ng’a ebitongwa bionsi nigo bire n’ogwechanda, naende nigo bire n’obororo nonya ngoika bono,
swahili: Kwa maana twajua ya kuwa hata sasa viumbe vyote vimekuwa vikilia kwa maumivu kama utungu wa mwanamke wakati wa kuzaa.

english: Not only that, but we ourselves, who have the firstfruits of the Spirit, groan inwardly as we wait eagerly for our adoption as sons, the redemption of our bodies.
ekegusii: gose tari igo rioka, korende nonya nintwe abanyene abatore nogotongorwa kw’Omoika, nigo togwechaanda ase emioyo yaito, gatoganyete gokorwa koba abana ba Nyasae, engencho yaye okoboorigwa kw’emebere yaito.
swahili: Wala si hivyo viumbe peke yao, bali hata sisi ambao ndio matunda ya kwanza ya Roho, kwa ndani tunalia kwa uchungu tukisubiri kwa shauku kufanywa wana wa Mungu, yaani, ukombozi wa miili yetu.

english: For in this hope we were saved; but hope that is seen is no hope at all. Who hopes for what he can already see?
ekegusii: Inaki nigo twatooretigwe ase ogosemeria. Korende egento keria gesemeirie gokiarorekanire, rirorio gosemeria tikori. Inaki ning’o orasemerie eki aroche?
swahili: Kwa kuwa tuliokolewa kwa tumaini hili. Lakini kama kinachotumainiwa kikionekana hakiwi tumaini tena. Je, kuna mtu anayetumaini kupata kitu alicho nacho tayari?

english: But if we hope for what we do not yet see, we wait for it patiently.
ekegusii: Korende gatorasemerie egento totarakerora, nigo togokeganya ase oboremereria.
swahili: Lakini tunapotumaini kupata kitu ambacho hatuna, basi twakingojea kwa saburi.

english: In the same way, the Spirit helps us in our weakness. For we do not know how we ought to pray, but the Spirit Himself intercedes for us with groans too deep for words.
ekegusii: Naboigo n’Omoika nere nigo ogotokoonya ase oboreu bwaito. Inaki titomanyeti gosaba buna etogwenerete, korende Omoika omonyene nigo agotosabera ase ogwechanda gotanyare gokwanwa.
swahili: Vivyo hivyo, Roho hutusaidia katika udhaifu wetu, kwa sababu hatujui kuomba ipasavyo. Lakini Roho mwenyewe hutuombea kwa uchungu usioweza kutamkwa.

english: And He who searches our hearts knows the mind of the Spirit, because the Spirit intercedes for the saints according to the will of God. God Works in All Things (Ephesians 1:3–14)
ekegusii: Na ere oyokoriga‐rigia chinkoro chi’ abanto, namanyete okorengereria kw’Omoika, ekiagera Omoika oyo nigo ogosabera abachenu buna Nyasae anchete.
swahili: Naye Mungu aichunguzaye mioyo, anaijua nia ya Roho, kwa sababu Roho huwaombea watakatifu sawasawa na mapenzi ya Mungu. Tunashinda Na Zaidi Ya Kushinda

english: And we know that God works all things together for the good of those who love Him, who are called according to His purpose.
ekegusii: Na twamanyire ng’a Nyasae nigo agokora amang’ana onsi amo na baria bamwanchete, erio abanyorere amaya, baria barangerigwe ase omooroberio oye.
swahili: Nasi tunajua ya kuwa katika mambo yote Mungu hutenda kazi pamoja na wote wampendao, katika kuwapatia mema, yaani, wale walioitwa kwa kusudi lake.

english: For those God foreknew, He also predestined to be conformed to the image of His Son, so that He would be the firstborn among many brothers.
ekegusii: Inaki baria amanyete korwa kare akabachoora korwa kare, bareng’anigwe n’omogwekano bw’Omwana oye, erinde ere abe omotangi bw’abamwabo abange.
swahili: Maana wale Mungu aliowajua tangu mwanzo, pia aliwachagua tangu mwanzo, wapate kufanana na mfano wa Mwanawe, ili yeye awe mzaliwa wa kwanza miongoni mwa ndugu wengi.

english: For what the law was powerless to do in that it was weakened by the flesh, God did by sending His own Son in the likeness of sinful man, as an offering for sin. He thus condemned sin in the flesh,
ekegusii: Inaki aria amachiiko atare konyara gokora, ekiagera nigo arenge amareu ase engencho y’ebibe bi’emebere ya Mwanyabaanto, Nyasae agakora ase ogotoma Omwana oye omonyene ase omogwekano bw’engencho yaito y’ebibe, na ase engencho y’ebibe, akagaambia ebibe ase omobere oye o Mwanyabaanto,
swahili: Kwa maana kile ambacho sheria haikuwa na uwezo wa kufanya, kwa vile ilivyokuwa dhaifu katika mwili, Mungu kwa kumtuma Mwanawe mwenyewe kwa mfano wa mwanadamu mwenye mwili ulio wa dhambi na kwa ajili ya dhambi, yeye aliihukumu dhambi katika mwili,

english: And those He predestined, He also called; those He called, He also justified; those He justified, He also glorified.
ekegusii: Na baria achorete korwa kare, abwo akabarangeria boigo; na baria arangeretie, abwo akabaa oboronge boigo; na baria aete oboronge akabaa obonene boigo. Obwanchani bwa Nyasae
swahili: Nao wale Mungu aliotangulia kuwachagua, akawaita, wale aliowaita pia akawahesabia haki, nao wale aliowahesabia haki, pia akawatukuza. Upendo Wa Mungu

english: What then shall we say in response to these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?
ekegusii: Ninki rende torateebe ase ayio? Onye Nyasae ore ensemo yaito, ning’o oranyare gotobua?
swahili: Tuseme nini basi kuhusu haya? Ikiwa Mungu yuko upande wetu, ni nani awezaye kuwa kinyume chetu?

english: He who did not spare His own Son but gave Him up for us all, how will He not also, along with Him, freely give us all things?
