ekegusii: Ere otarorerete Omwana oye amaabera, korende akamorua ase engencho yaito intwe twensi, inaki aramoche gotoa ebinto bionsi amo nere?
swahili: Ikiwa Mungu hakumhurumia Mwanawe, bali alimtoa kwa ajili yetu sote, atakosaje basi kutupatia vitu vyote kwa ukarimu pamoja naye?

english: Who will bring any charge against God’s elect? It is God who justifies.
ekegusii: Ning’o oranyare gosoera abachoore ba Nyasae? Nyasae nere okobaa oboronge.
swahili: Ni nani atakayewashtaki wale ambao Mungu amewateua? Ni Mungu mwenyewe ndiye mwenye kuwahesabia haki.

english: Who is there to condemn us? For Christ Jesus, who died, and more than that was raised to life, is at the right hand of God—and He is interceding for us. More than Conquerors (Psalms 44:1–26)
ekegusii: Ning’o oranyare kobanachera ekiina? Kristo Yeso nere okwete, ee, na kobua ase aya obokiigwe korwa ase abakuure; ere nigo are ensemo y’okoboko gw’okorio kwa Nyasae, naende nere ogotosabera.
swahili: Ni nani basi atakayewahukumia adhabu? Kristo Yesu aliyekufa, naam, zaidi ya hayo, aliyefufuliwa kutoka kwa wafu, yuko mkono wa kuume wa Mungu, naye pia anatuombea.

english: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? Shall trouble or distress or persecution or famine or nakedness or danger or sword?
ekegusii: Ning’o oratwatanane korwa ase obwanchani bwa Kristo? Inee! Nogochandwa, gose nobororo, gose nokorosigwa, gose nenchara, gose ngesobono, gose n’obobe, gose n’omoro?
swahili: Ni nani atakayetutenga na upendo wa Kristo? Je, ni shida au taabu au mateso au njaa au uchi au hatari au upanga?

english: As it is written: “For Your sake we face death all day long; we are considered as sheep to be slaughtered.”
ekegusii: Buna eriikire, “Ase engencho yao nigo togoitwa omobaso boira; twabarirwe koba buna ching’ondi chigocha konyenywa.”
swahili: Kama ilivyoandikwa: “Kwa ajili yako tunauawa mchana kutwa; tumehesabiwa kama kondoo wa kuchinjwa.”

english: No, in all these things we are more than conquerors through Him who loved us.
ekegusii: Korende ase amang’ana aya onsi twabeire ababui, na goetania ababui, goetera ase are oyotwanchete.
swahili: Lakini katika mambo haya yote tunashinda, naam na zaidi ya kushinda, kwa yeye aliyetupenda.

english: For I am convinced that neither death nor life, neither angels nor principalities, neither the present nor the future, nor any powers,
ekegusii: Ninde nobomaene bw’okomanya, ng’a nonya namakweri, nonya nobogima, nonya nabamalaika, nonya nabare ne chinguru, nonya n’ebinto ebireo, nonya nebi gochi‐gocha, nonya n’okobua,
swahili: Kwa maana nimekwisha kujua kwa hakika ya kuwa sio mauti, wala uzima, wala malaika, wala wenye mamlaka, wala yaliyopo, wala yatakayokuja, wala wenye uwezo,

english: neither height nor depth, nor anything else in all creation, will be able to separate us from the love of God that is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
ekegusii: nonya nayare igoro, nonya nayare inse, nonya negetongwa kende gionsi, tibikonyara gotwatanana korwa ase obwanchani bwa Nyasae obore ime ase Kristo Yeso Omonene oito.
swahili: wala yaliyo juu, wala yaliyo chini, wala kiumbe kingine chochote zitaweza kututenga na upendo wa Mungu ulio katika Kristo Yesu, Bwana wetu.

english: so that the righteous standard of the law might be fulfilled in us, who do not walk according to the flesh but according to the Spirit.
ekegusii: erinde ekerigirie ime ase amachiiko geikeranigwe ime yaito, aba totari gotunyana chingencho chiaito chi’ebibe, korende chingencho chi’Omoika.
swahili: ili kwamba haki ipatikanayo kwa sheria itimizwe ndani yetu sisi, ambao hatuenendi kwa kuufuata mwili bali kwa kufuata Roho.

english: Those who live according to the flesh set their minds on the things of the flesh; but those who live according to the Spirit set their minds on the things of the Spirit.
ekegusii: Baria bagotunyana chingencho chiabo chi’ebibe nigo barengereretie chingencho chi’ebibe, korende baria bagotunyana chingencho chi’Omoika nigo barengereretie chingencho chi’Omoika.
swahili: Kwa maana wale wanaoishi kwa kuufuata mwili huziweka nia zao katika vitu vya mwili, lakini wale wanaoishi kwa kufuata Roho, huziweka nia zao katika mambo ya Roho.

english: The mind of the flesh is death, but the mind of the Spirit is life and peace,
ekegusii: Inaki okorengereria kw’engencho y’ebibe n’amakweri, korende okorengereria kw’engencho y’Omoika nobogima na omorembe.
swahili: Kwa maana kuwa na nia ya mwili ni mauti, bali kuwa na nia inayoongozwa na Roho ni uzima na amani.

english: because the mind of the flesh is hostile to God: It does not submit to God’s law, nor can it do so.
ekegusii: Inaki okorengereria koria kw’engencho y’ebibe nobobisa igoro ase Nyasae, ekiagera tikori gwancha koigwera amachiiko a Nyasae, gose tikori koyaigwera nonya ng’ake.
swahili: Kwa kuwa ile nia ya mwili ni uadui na Mungu, kwa maana haiitii sheria ya Mungu, wala haiwezi kuitii.

english: Those controlled by the flesh cannot please God.
ekegusii: Abagotunyana chingencho chi’ebibe tibakonyara kogwenera Nyasae.
swahili: Wale wanaotawaliwa na mwili, hawawezi kumpendeza Mungu.

english: You, however, are controlled not by the flesh, but by the Spirit, if the Spirit of God lives in you. And if anyone does not have the Spirit of Christ, he does not belong to Christ.
ekegusii: Onye Omoika o Nyasae kamenyete ime yaino, rirorio timori gotunyana chingencho chi’ebibe, korende chingencho chi’Omoika. Onde bwensi otari n’Omoika o Kristo, oyio tari omonto oye.
swahili: Lakini ninyi, hamtawaliwi na mwili, bali na Roho, ikiwa Roho wa Mungu anakaa ndani yenu. Mtu yeyote ambaye hana Roho wa Kristo, yeye si wa Kristo.

english: I speak the truth in Christ; I am not lying, as confirmed by my conscience in the Holy Spirit.
ekegusii: Nigo ngokwana ekeene ase Kristo, tindi goteeba oborimo. Okomanya gw’enkoro y’ane ime, gokwamorekirwe n’Omoika Omochenu, kwambereire kirori,
swahili: Ninasema kweli katika Kristo, wala sisemi uongo, dhamiri yangu inanishuhudia katika Roho Mtakatifu.

english: Not only that, but Rebecca’s children were conceived by one man, our father Isaac.
ekegusii: Gose tari igo rioka, korende Rebeka nere nabogoretie oborito ase omosacha oyomo, nere Isaka sokoro yaito.
swahili: Wala si hivyo tu, bali pia watoto aliowazaa Rebeka walikuwa na baba huyo huyo mmoja, yaani, baba yetu Isaki.

english: So it is written: “Jacob I loved, but Esau I hated.”
ekegusii: Inaki nigo eriikire, “Namwanchete Yakobo, korende nkamogeecha Esau.” Nyasae n’omonyene oboronge
swahili: Kama vile ilivyoandikwa, “Nimempenda Yakobo, lakini nimemchukia Esau.” Mungu Hana Upendeleo

english: What then shall we say? Is God unjust? Certainly not!
ekegusii: Ninki rende torateebe? Ogotaba boronge nkore ase Nyasae? Yaya, taibo!
swahili: Tuseme nini basi? Je, Mungu ni dhalimu? La, hasha!

english: For He says to Moses: “I will have mercy on whom I have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I have compassion.”
ekegusii: Inaki nigo atebeetie Musa, “Nimororere amaabera ere oyo ndarorere amaabera, na nimororere amabeebe ere oyo ’ndarorere amabeebe.”
swahili: Kwa maana Mungu alimwambia Mose, “Nitamrehemu yeye nimrehemuye, na pia nitamhurumia yeye nimhurumiaye.”

english: So then, it does not depend on man’s desire or effort, but on God’s mercy.
ekegusii: Ase igo, tari ng’a nigo ere ase ogwancha kw’omonto, gose nokw’oria ogokora omokia, korende nokw’oria okororera amaabera, nere Nyasae.
swahili: Kwa hiyo haitegemei kutaka kwa mwanadamu au jitihada, bali hutegemea huruma ya Mungu.

english: For the Scripture says to Pharaoh: “I raised you up for this very purpose, that I might display My power in you, and that My name might be proclaimed in all the earth.”
ekegusii: Inaki amariiko nigo agoteeba ase Farao, “Nigo nagotenenetie, erinde nyorokie okobua kw’ane ase ore, na erieta riane nario rirararigwe ase ense yonsi.”
swahili: Kwa maana Maandiko yamwambia Farao, “Nilikuinua kwa kusudi hili hasa, ili nipate kuonyesha uweza wangu juu yako, na ili Jina langu lipate kutangazwa duniani yote.”

english: Therefore God has mercy on whom He wants to have mercy, and He hardens whom He wants to harden.
ekegusii: Ase igo, oyo arigetie kororera amaabera, nigo akomoororera amaabera, na oyo arigetie gokora abe omokong’u ase enkoro yaye, nigo akomokora abe omokong’u. Nyasae n’omogaambi omonene
swahili: Kwa hiyo basi, Mungu humhurumia yeye atakaye kumhurumia na humfanya mgumu yeye atakaye kumfanya mgumu.

english: One of you will say to me, “Then why does God still find fault? For who can resist His will?”
ekegusii: Aande gose nonteebie, “Nase ki nonya mbono Nyasae akonyora okomocha ase Mwanyabaanto? Inaki ning’o oranyare koamereria okorigia kwaye?”
swahili: Basi mtaniambia, “Kama ni hivyo, kwa nini basi bado Mungu anatulaumu? Kwa maana ni nani awezaye kupinga mapenzi yake?”

english: I have deep sorrow and unceasing anguish in my heart.
ekegusii: ng’a ninde nobororo obonge na ogwechanda kogendererete ase enkoro y’ane.
swahili: Nina huzuni kuu na uchungu usiokoma moyoni mwangu.

english: But who are you, O man, to talk back to God? Shall what is formed say to Him who formed it, “Why did You make me like this?”
ekegusii: Mwanyabaanto, aye naye ng’o okoiraneria Nyasae? Inee! Egento getongire nakemoteebie oyogetongete, “Ninki gwankorerete iga?”
swahili: Lakini, ewe mwanadamu, u nani wewe ushindane na Mungu? “Je, kilichoumbwa chaweza kumwambia yeye aliyekiumba, ‘Kwa nini umeniumba hivi?’ ”

english: Does not the potter have the right to make from the same lump of clay one vessel for special occasions and another for common use?
ekegusii: Gose omokori chinyongo tari n’okobua igoro ase esike, ase ribomba ri’esike gokora egento ekemo eki’ogosikwa, na ekende kebe getari nogosikwa?
swahili: Je, mfinyanzi hana haki ya kufinyanga kutoka bonge moja vyombo vya udongo, vingine kwa matumizi ya heshima na vingine kwa matumizi ya kawaida?

english: What if God, intending to show His wrath and make His power known, bore with great patience the vessels of His wrath, prepared for destruction?
ekegusii: Inaki rende onye Nyasae okorigia koorokia endamwamu yaye, na komanyia abanto okobua kwaye, na ase oboremereria obonge akabogorerania n’ebinto biria bi’endamwamu biakorirwe ase ogosareka,
swahili: Iweje basi, kama Mungu kwa kutaka kuonyesha ghadhabu yake na kufanya uweza wake ujulikane, amevumilia kwa uvumilivu mwingi vile vyombo vya ghadhabu vilivyoandaliwa kwa uharibifu?

english: What if He did this to make the riches of His glory known to the vessels of His mercy, whom He prepared in advance for glory—
ekegusii: erinde aorokie obonda bw’obonene bwaye, ase ebinto biria bi’amaabera ebiaroisetie korwa kare binyore obonene?
swahili: Iweje basi, kama yeye alitenda hivi ili kufanya wingi wa utukufu wake ujulikane kwa vile vyombo vya rehema yake, alivyotangulia kuvitengeneza kwa ajili ya utukufu wake,

english: including us, whom He has called not only from the Jews, but also from the Gentiles?
ekegusii: Abwo nintwe, twarangeretigwe nere, tari korwa ase Abayahudi boka, korende nonya nkorwa ase abanto b’Ebisaku boigo.
swahili: yaani pamoja na sisi, ambao pia alituita, si kutoka kwa Wayahudi peke yao, bali pia kutoka kwa watu wa Mataifa? Yote Yalitabiriwa Katika Maandiko

english: As He says in Hosea: “I will call them ‘My People’ who are not My people, and I will call her ‘My Beloved’ who is not My beloved,”
ekegusii: Naboigo akwanete ase egetabu ya Hosea, “Abanto baria batarenge abanto baane, nimbaroke abanto baane; na oyotarenge omwanchwa one, nimoroke omwanchwa one.”
swahili: Kama vile Mungu asemavyo katika Hosea: “Nitawaita ‘watu wangu’ wale ambao si watu wangu; nami nitamwita ‘mpenzi wangu’ yeye ambaye si mpenzi wangu,”

english: and, “It will happen that in the very place where it was said to them, ‘You are not My people,’ they will be called ‘sons of the living God.’”
ekegusii: “N’abe aase aria barabwo bateebetigwe: Inwe timori abanto baane, abwo inabarokwe abana ba Nyasae ore moyo.”
swahili: tena, “Itakuwa hasa mahali pale walipoambiwa, ‘Ninyi si watu wangu,’ wao wataitwa ‘wana wa Mungu aliye hai.’ ”

english: Isaiah cries out concerning Israel: “Though the number of the Israelites is like the sand of the sea, only the remnant will be saved.
ekegusii: Isaya nere ogoaka eriogi riaye igoro y’Abaisraeli, ogoteeba, “Omobaro bw’Abaisraeli n’oba buna omokenye ore nyancha, abatigari nabwo boka barache gotoorigwa;
swahili: Isaya anapiga kelele kuhusu Israeli: “Ingawa idadi ya wana wa Israeli ni wengi kama mchanga wa pwani, ni mabaki yao tu watakaookolewa.

english: For the Lord will carry out His sentence on the earth thoroughly and decisively.”
ekegusii: inaki Omonene n’ache ase ense agaambe ekiina, akenache na kogekoora.”
swahili: Kwa kuwa Bwana ataitekeleza hukumu yake duniani kwa haraka na kwa ukamilifu.”

english: It is just as Isaiah foretold: “Unless the Lord of Hosts had left us descendants, we would have become like Sodom, we would have resembled Gomorrah.” Israel’s Unbelief
ekegusii: Naende buna Isaya atang’anete gokwana. “Onye Omonene bw’Emeganda atatotigerete oroiboro, nanga nigo twabeete buna Sodomu, na koreng’anigwa na Gomora.” Ekiagerete Abaisraeli bakagwa
swahili: Ni kama vile alivyotabiri Isaya akisema: “Kama Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote asingelituachia uzao, tungelikuwa kama Sodoma, tungelifanana na Gomora.” Kutokuamini Kwa Israeli

english: For I could wish that I myself were cursed and cut off from Christ for the sake of my brothers, my own flesh and blood,
ekegusii: Inaki nanga naganetie ng’a ndagererigwe inche omonyene na gwatananwa korwa ase Kristo ase engencho y’abaminto abare b’eamate y’ane ase egesaku giaito.
swahili: Kwa maana ningetamani hata mimi nilaaniwe na kutengwa na Kristo kwa ajili ya ndugu zangu hasa, wale walio wa kabila langu kwa jinsi ya mwili,

english: What then will we say? That the Gentiles, who did not pursue righteousness, have obtained it, a righteousness that is by faith;
ekegusii: Ninki rende torateebe? Ng’a abanto b’Ebisaku, abatarenge korigia oboronge ’mbanyorete oboronge boria bw’okwegena;
swahili: Kwa hiyo tuseme nini basi? Kwamba watu wa Mataifa ambao hawakutafuta haki, wamepata haki ile iliyo kwa njia ya imani.

english: but Israel, who pursued a law of righteousness, has not attained it.
ekegusii: korende Abaisraeli abare korigia oboronge bokorwa ase amachiiko, tibaikerete oboronge boria.
swahili: Lakini Israeli, ambao walijitahidi kupata haki kwa njia ya sheria, hawakuipata.

english: Why not? Because their pursuit was not by faith, but as if it were by works. They stumbled over the stumbling stone,
ekegusii: Nase ki? Ekiagera tibarenge koborigia ase enchera y’okwegena, korende nase enchera y’ogokora, bakagochwa igoro ase rigena riria rikogocha;
swahili: Kwa nini? Kwa sababu hawakuitafuta kwa njia ya imani bali kwa njia ya matendo. Wakajikwaa kwenye lile “jiwe la kukwaza.”

english: as it is written: “See, I lay in Zion a stone of stumbling and a rock of offense; and the one who believes in Him will never be put to shame.”
ekegusii: buna eriikire, “Rigereria, nabekire ase Sayoni rigena riragoche abanto, na egetare kerabaiyerie inse, na onde bwensi oramwegene takorora obosooku.”
swahili: Kama ilivyoandikwa: “Tazama naweka katika Sayuni jiwe la kukwaza watu na mwamba wa kuwaangusha. Yeyote atakayemwamini hataaibika kamwe.”

english: the people of Israel. Theirs is the adoption as sons; theirs the divine glory and the covenants; theirs the giving of the law, the temple worship, and the promises.
ekegusii: Barabwo n’Abaisraeli, bakorirwe koba Abana ba Nyasae, barorire, obonene, bancheirwe okobwatana, baeirwe amachiiko ne ribaga ri’ogosasiima Nyasae, baeirwe ne chiira chiaye.
swahili: yaani, watu wa Israeli, ambao ndio wenye kule kufanywa wana, ule utukufu wa Mungu, yale maagano, kule kupokea sheria, ibada ya kwenye Hekalu na zile ahadi.

english: Theirs are the patriarchs, and from them proceeds the human descent of Christ, who is God over all, forever worthy of praise! Amen. God’s Sovereign Choice (Genesis 25:19–28; Malachi 1:1–5)
ekegusii: Inaki abagaaka baito ba kare nabaabo, na korwa ase bare Kristo nao aiboretwe buna Mwanyabaanto; ere nigo are Nyasae igoro ase ebinto bionsi, oy’orabakwe goika kare na kare. Amina. Chiira chia Nyasae tichiamochete goikeranigwa
swahili: Wao ni wa uzao wa mababa wakuu wa kwanza, ambao kutoka kwao Kristo alikuja kwa jinsi ya mwili kama mwanadamu, yeye ambaye ni Mungu aliye juu ya vyote, mwenye kuhimidiwa milele! Amen.

english: It is not as though God’s word has failed. For not all who are descended from Israel are Israel.
ekegusii: Tari ng’a ring’ana ria Nyasae ndiasinyire goikeranigwa. Inaki tari bonsi abare b’egesaku ki’Abaisraeli bare Abaisraeli b’ekeene;
swahili: Si kwamba Neno la Mungu limeshindwa. Kwa maana si kila Mwisraeli ambaye ni wa uzao utokanao na Israeli ni Mwisraeli halisi.

english: Nor because they are Abraham’s descendants are they all his children. On the contrary, “Through Isaac your offspring will be reckoned.”
ekegusii: gose tari bonsi bare abana ba Aburaamu ekiagera baruete ase oroiboro rw’aye, otatiga, “Ase Isaka oroiboro rwao narwatorwe.”
swahili: Wala hawakuwi wazao wa Abrahamu kwa sababu wao ni watoto wake, lakini: “Uzao wako utahesabiwa kupitia kwake Isaki.”

english: So it is not the children of the flesh who are God’s children, but it is the children of the promise who are regarded as offspring.
ekegusii: Engencho yaye, tari abana b’ororeria bare Abana ba Nyasae, korende n’abana b’eira bakobarwa ng’a noroiboro rw’aye.
swahili: Hii ina maana kwamba, si watoto waliozaliwa kimwili walio watoto wa Mungu, bali ni watoto wa ahadi wanaohesabiwa kuwa uzao wa Abrahamu.

english: For this is what the promise stated: “At the appointed time I will return, and Sarah will have a son.”
ekegusii: Inaki ring’ana ri’eira neri, “Ekero kenga buna eke ninchiche, inyore ng’a Sara onyorire omwana omoisia.”
swahili: Kwa maana ahadi yenyewe ilisema, “Nitakurudia tena wakati kama huu, naye Sara atapata mtoto wa kiume.”

english: In the days when the judges ruled, there was a famine in the land. And a certain man from Bethlehem in Judah, with his wife and two sons, went to reside in the land of Moab.
ekegusii: Ase amatuko aria, ekero abagaambi ebiina barenge kogambera Abaisraeli, enchara enene ekaba ase ense yabo. Ase ayio, omonto oyomo o Bethlehemu, y’Aboyahudi, akaimoka amo na mokaye na abamura baye babere, akagenda komenya ase ense y’Abamoabu.
swahili: Wakati Waamuzi walipotawala Israeli, kulikuwa na njaa katika nchi. Mtu mmoja kutoka nchi ya Bethlehemu ya Yuda, pamoja na mke wake na wanawe wawili, akaenda kuishi katika nchi ya Moabu.

english: and said, “Surely we will return with you to your people.”
ekegusii: bakamoteebia, “Yaya, titokogotiga! Nigo torigetie kogenda amo naye ase abanto baino.”
swahili: wakamwambia, “Tutarudi pamoja na wewe nyumbani kwa watu wako.”

english: But Naomi replied, “Return home, my daughters. Why would you go with me? Are there still sons in my womb to become your husbands?
ekegusii: Korende Naomi akabairaneria, akabateebia, “Abana baane, irana mogende seino! Nase ki moganetie kogenda amo nainche? Inee! Ninyare naende korwa ase enda yane koibora abana bagochia kobanyuoma?
swahili: Lakini Naomi akasema, “Rudini nyumbani, binti zangu. Kwa nini mnifuate? Je, mimi nitaweza tena kuwa na wana wengine ambao wataweza kuwaoa ninyi?

english: Return home, my daughters. Go on, for I am too old to have another husband. Even if I thought there was hope for me to have a husband tonight and to bear sons,
ekegusii: Abana baane, irana mogende seino, ekiagera inche nagotire mono, tinkonyuomwa naende. Nonya nare korengereria ng’a ninde nogosemeria, na onye nare konyora omosacha reero, nyibore abana abamura.
swahili: Rudini nyumbani, binti zangu; mimi ni mzee kiasi kwamba siwezi kumpata mume mwingine. Hata kama ningefikiria kuwa bado kuna tumaini kwangu, hata kama ningekuwa na mume usiku huu na kuwazaa wana,

english: would you wait for them to grow up? Would you refrain from having husbands? No, my daughters, it grieves me very much for your sakes that the hand of the LORD has gone out against me.”
ekegusii: Inee, nkoganya mware goika bakine? Gose ngwetanga mware timonyuomwa nabasaacha bande? Taibo, abana baane! Amang’ana ane namakong’u mono ase more ase engencho Omonene ong’onchokeire.”
swahili: je, mngesubiri mpaka wakue? Mngebakia bila kuolewa mkiwasubiri? La, hasha, binti zangu. Nimepata uchungu kuliko ninyi, kwa sababu mkono wa Bwana umekuwa kinyume nami!”

english: Again they wept aloud, and Orpah kissed her mother-in-law goodbye, but Ruth clung to her.
ekegusii: Naende bagachaaka korera mono goetania. Erio Oripa akanyunyunta ng’ina biara, akamotiga, korende Rutu akaanga komotiga.
swahili: Kisha wakalia tena kwa sauti. Orpa akambusu mama mkwe wake, akaenda zake, lakini Ruthu akaambatana naye.

english: “Look,” said Naomi, “your sister-in-law has gone back to her people and her gods; follow her back home.”
ekegusii: Ase igo Naomi agateebia Rutu, “Naama! Oripa, moka momura omwabo omosacha oo, oiranire ase abanto baye, na ase enyasae yaye. Naye irana, mogende komo!”
swahili: Naomi akamwambia, “Tazama, mwenzako anarejea kwa watu wake na kwa miungu yake. Rudi pamoja naye.”

english: But Ruth replied: “Do not urge me to leave you or to turn from following you. For wherever you go, I will go, and wherever you live, I will live; your people will be my people, and your God will be my God.
ekegusii: Korende Rutu akamoiraneria, “Tagonsorora ng’a ngotige. Tiga ngende amo naye. Aande onsi ase aye ogochia, nainche nao ndachie; na aande onsi ase aye oramenye, nainche nao ndamenye. Abanto bao mbabe abanto baane, na Nyasae oo nabe Nyasae one.
swahili: Lakini Ruthu akajibu, “Usinisihi nikuache au niache kukufuata. Utakakokwenda nami nitakwenda, na wewe utakapoishi nitaishi. Watu wako watakuwa watu wangu, na Mungu wako atakuwa Mungu wangu.

english: Where you die, I will die, and there I will be buried. May the LORD punish me, and ever so severely, if anything but death separates you and me.”
ekegusii: Aase aye orakwere, nainche nao ndakwere, na ntindekwe aroro. Tiga Omonene ang’e egesusuro ekenene kegima bono na kogenderera onye gento kende kegochia konyatanana korwa asore, otatiga amakweri oka.”
swahili: Pale utakapofia nami nitafia hapo, na papo hapo nitazikwa. Bwana na aniadhibu vikali, kama kitu kingine chochote kitanitenga nawe isipokuwa kifo.”

english: When Naomi saw that Ruth was determined to go with her, she stopped trying to persuade her. The Return to Bethlehem
ekegusii: Ekero Naomi arooche ng’a Rutu bwerure kogeenda amo nere, takwana gento kende.
swahili: Naomi alipotambua kwamba Ruthu amenuia kufuatana naye, hakuendelea kumsihi tena.

english: So Naomi and Ruth traveled until they came to Bethlehem. When they entered Bethlehem, the whole city was stirred because of them, and the women of the city exclaimed, “Can this be Naomi?”
ekegusii: Ase igo barabwo babere bakagenderera orogendo rwabo, goika bagaika Bethlehemu. Ekero baigete aroro, abanto bonsi b’omochie bakaeegaeega ase engencho yabo, na abakungu bakaboorania, bagoteeba, “Inee! Oyo Naomi?”
swahili: Kwa hiyo hao wanawake wawili wakaondoka, wakafika Bethlehemu. Walipofika Bethlehemu, mji mzima ulitaharuki, wanawake wakashangaa, wakasema, “Huyu aweza kuwa ni Naomi?”

english: The man’s name was Elimelech, his wife’s name was Naomi, and the names of his two sons were Mahlon and Chilion. They were Ephrathites from Bethlehem in Judah, and they entered the land of Moab and settled there.
ekegusii: Omonto oria nigo arenge korokwa Elimeleki, na mokaye Naomi, na abamura baye babere Mahaloni na Kilioni. Barabwo nigo barenge Abaefarati ba Beteremu ya Boyahudi. Barabwo bakang’anya gochia ense ya Moabu bakamenya aroro.
swahili: Mtu huyu aliitwa Elimeleki, mkewe aliitwa Naomi, na hao wanawe wawili waliitwa Maloni na Kilioni. Walikuwa Waefrathi kutoka Bethlehemu ya Yuda. Wakaenda katika nchi ya Moabu, wakaishi huko.

english: “Do not call me Naomi, ” she replied. “Call me Mara, because the Almighty has dealt quite bitterly with me.
ekegusii: Naomi akabateebia, “Timondoka Naomi, ndoke Mara, ekiagera Nyasae Omobui ondeteire obororo obonge.”
swahili: Akawaambia, “Msiniite tena Naomi, niiteni Mara, kwa sababu Mwenyezi amenitendea mambo machungu sana.

english: I went away full, but the LORD has brought me back empty. Why call me Naomi? After all, the LORD has testified against me, and the Almighty has afflicted me.”
ekegusii: Ekero nagendete nigo narenge omonda, korende Omonene ong’iranirie inde namaboko amasa. Nase ki rende mokondoka Naomi bono, ekero Omonene Omobui ang’onchokeire na ondeteire amaakwa?
swahili: Mimi niliondoka hali nimejaa, lakini Bwana amenirudisha mtupu. Kwa nini kuniita Naomi? Bwana amenitendea mambo machungu; Mwenyezi ameniletea msiba.”

english: So Naomi returned from the land of Moab with her daughter-in-law Ruth the Moabitess. And they arrived in Bethlehem at the beginning of the barley harvest.
ekegusii: Naboigo Naomi airanete korwa ase ense y’Abamoabu amo na Rutu, oria Omomoabu, moka momura oye. Barabwo bagaika Bethlehemu ekero abanto konya bachakire kogesa esairi.
swahili: Kwa hiyo Naomi alirudi pamoja na Ruthu Mmoabu mkwe wake, nao wakafika Bethlehemu mwanzoni mwa kuvuna shayiri.

english: Then Naomi’s husband Elimelech died, and she was left with her two sons,
ekegusii: Elimeleki omosacha o Naomi agakwa, agatiga Naomi ore omotakaanwa, ore nabamura baye babere.
swahili: Elimeleki mumewe Naomi akafa, hivyo Naomi akabaki na wanawe wawili.

english: who took Moabite women as their wives, one named Orpah and the other named Ruth. And after they had lived in Moab about ten years,
ekegusii: Barabwo bakanyuoma abaiseke b’Abamoabu; oyomo nigo are korokwa Oripa na oyonde Rutu. Magega kabamenyire aroro koreng’ana emiaka ikomi,
swahili: Nao wakaoa wanawake Wamoabu, jina la mmoja aliitwa Orpa, na wa pili aliitwa Ruthu. Baada ya kama miaka kumi,

english: both Mahlon and Chilion also died, and Naomi was left without her two sons and without her husband. Ruth’s Loyalty to Naomi
ekegusii: Mahaloni na Kilioni nabarabwo bagakwa. Igo Naomi agakwerwa omosacha oye na abamura baye babere. Naomi na Rutu bakoirana gochia Bethlehemu
swahili: Maloni na Kilioni pia wakafa. Basi Naomi akabaki hana mume wala wanawe wawili.

english: When Naomi heard in Moab that the LORD had attended to His people by providing them with food, she and her daughters-in-law prepared to leave the land of Moab.
ekegusii: Naomi kare agwo ase ense y’Abamoabu akaigwa ng’a Omonene ororeire abanto baye amaabera, obaeire endagera naende; ase ayio akamanora korua ense eria amo na baka bamura baye babere.
swahili: Aliposikia akiwa huko Moabu kwamba Bwana amewasaidia watu wake kwa kuwapa chakula, Naomi na wakweze wakajiandaa kurudi nyumbani.

english: Accompanied by her two daughters-in-law, she left the place where she had been living and set out on the road leading back to the land of Judah.
ekegusii: Barabwo bagatiga aase aaria bamenyete, bagachaaka orogendo koirana gochia ase ense y’Abayuda,
swahili: Yeye na wakweze wawili wakaondoka pale walipokuwa wakiishi na kushika njia kurudi nchi ya Yuda.

english: Then Naomi said to her two daughters-in-law, “Go back, each of you to your mother’s home. May the LORD show you loving devotion, as you have shown to your dead and to me.
ekegusii: Naomi agateebia baka bamura baye babere ng’a bairane, na kera oyomo agende komenya mwa ng’ina. Naende akabora, “Tiga Omonene abakorere amaya, buna inwe mwakoreire baria bakuure, boigo nainche mwankoreire.”
swahili: Ndipo Naomi akawaambia wale wakwe zake wawili, “Rudini, kila mmoja wenu nyumbani kwa mama yake. Bwana na awatendee fadhili kama mlivyowatendea hao waliofariki, na pia mimi.

english: May the LORD enable each of you to find rest in the home of your new husband.” And she kissed them as they wept aloud
ekegusii: Omonene abanchere kera oyomo oino anyuomwe naende, na anyore mwaye. Erio Naomi akabanyunyunta ase okobatiga. Korende barabwo bagachaaka korera mono,
swahili: Bwana na amjalie kila mmoja wenu maisha mema nyumbani kwa mume mwingine.” Kisha akawabusu, nao wakalia kwa sauti kubwa,

english: Now Naomi had a relative on her husband’s side, a prominent man of noble character from the clan of Elimelech, whose name was Boaz.
ekegusii: Naomi nabwate omoamate oyomo ore korokwa Boazi, omonto omonda na bwesiko bw’eamate y’Elimeleki, omosacha oye. Ere nigo arenge omonto bwomong’uso, naende omonda.
swahili: Basi Naomi alikuwa na jamaa wa upande wa mume wake, kutoka ukoo wa Elimeleki, mtu maarufu ambaye aliitwa Boazi.

english: At this, she fell on her face, bowing low to the ground, and said to him, “Why have I found such favor in your eyes that you should take notice of me, even though I am a foreigner?”
ekegusii: Rutu agatung’ama inse akaumama, akaboria Boazi, “Naki gwakora kwanyechandera na gonkorera buya iga, na inche nomomenyi inde aa?”
swahili: Kwa ajili ya hili, akasujudu mpaka nchi, akamwambia, “Jinsi gani nimepata kibali machoni pako, hata ukanijali mimi mgeni?”

english: Boaz replied, “I have been made fully aware of all you have done for your mother-in-law since the death of your husband, how you left your father and mother and the land of your birth, and how you came to a people you did not know before.
ekegusii: Boazi akamoiraneria, “Nateebigwe amang’ana onsi gwakoreire nyoko biara korwa ekero omosacha oo akwete. Namanyire buna gwatigire iso na nyoko, na ense yao kwaiboreretwe, ogaacha komenya nabaanto otamanyete agwo ritang’ani.
swahili: Boazi akamjibu, “Nimeambiwa yote uliyomtendea mama mkwe wako tangu mume wako alipofariki, na jinsi ulivyomwacha baba yako na mama yako na nchi yako ulimozaliwa, ukaja kuishi na watu ambao hukuwafahamu awali.

english: May the LORD repay your work, and may you receive a rich reward from the LORD, the God of Israel, under whose wings you have taken refuge.”
ekegusii: Omonene agoakane ase aya gwakorire; ee, Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, oyo gwatameire, erinde orendwe inse ye chimbaaba chiaye.”
swahili: Bwana na akulipe kwa yale uliyoyatenda. Ubarikiwe kwa wingi na Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli, ambaye umekimbilia mabawani mwake.”

english: “My lord,” she said, “may I continue to find favor in your eyes, for you have comforted and spoken kindly to your maidservant, though I am not like one of your servant girls.”
ekegusii: Rutu akamoiraneria, “Omonene one, kwabeire omuya mono ase ’nde, kwandemirie ase ogokwana nobwororo nainche, omosomba oo, nonya tindenga’aini oyomo bw’abasomba bao abaiseke.”
swahili: Kisha Ruthu akasema, “Naomba niendelee kupata kibali machoni pako, bwana wangu. Kwa maana umenifariji na umezungumza kwa ukarimu na mjakazi wako, hata ingawa mimi si bora kama mmoja wa watumishi wako wa kike.”

english: At mealtime Boaz said to her, “Come over here; have some bread and dip it into the vinegar sauce.” So she sat down beside the harvesters, and he offered her roasted grain, and she ate and was satisfied and had some left over.
ekegusii: Ekero abanto bachete koragera, Boazi agateebia Rutu, “Inchuo aa, orie omogati otongerie ase omosori ore nedivai.” Naboigo Rutu agaikaransa amo nabagesi baria, na Boazi akamoa ebigara bisambire. Rutu akaria, akaigota, naende eyende egatigara.
swahili: Wakati wa chakula, Boazi akamwambia Ruthu, “Karibia hapa. Kula mkate na uchovye ndani ya siki.” Alipoketi pamoja na wavunaji, akampa nafaka zilizookwa. Akala kiasi alichotaka na kusaza.

english: When Ruth got up to glean, Boaz ordered his young men, “Even if she gathers among the sheaves, do not insult her.
ekegusii: Na ekero Rutu agendete gochora ebigara naende, Boazi agachiika abasomba baye, akabateebia, “Momotige achore ebigara nonya nase egati y’emesaima, timomokania.
swahili: Alipoinuka ili kuokota mabaki ya nafaka, Boazi akawaagiza watu wake, “Hata kama atakusanya kati ya miganda, msimzuie.

english: Rather, pull out for her some stalks from the bundles and leave them for her to gather. Do not rebuke her.”
ekegusii: Naende momoruserie ebigara korwa ase emesaima, momotigere abichore, timobaisa komotanga.”
swahili: Badala yake, toeni masuke katika miganda, mwachieni ayaokote, na msimkemee.”

english: So Ruth gathered grain in the field until evening. And when she beat out what she had gleaned, it was about an ephah of barley.
ekegusii: Igo Rutu akagenderera gochora ebigara ase omogondo oria goika mogoroba, na ekero abibungete akanyora ng’a biaisanire ebitonga bibere.
swahili: Basi Ruthu akaokota masazo shambani hata jioni. Akatwanga ile shayiri aliyokusanya, ikajaa efa moja.

english: She picked up the grain and went into the town, where her mother-in-law saw what she had gleaned. And she brought out what she had saved from her meal and gave it to Naomi.
ekegusii: Erio agetweka ebitonga biria, akairana gochia omochie, akaorokia ng’ina biara ebio achorete. Naende akamoa endagera eria yatigarete ekero ariete akaigota.
swahili: Akaibeba na kuelekea mjini, naye mama mkwe wake akaona jinsi alivyoweza kuokota nafaka nyingi. Pia Ruthu akachukua kile alichobakiza baada ya kula na kushiba, akampa.

english: Then her mother-in-law asked her, “Where did you glean today, and where did you work? Blessed be the man who noticed you.” So she told her mother-in-law where she had worked. “The name of the man I worked with today is Boaz,” she said.
ekegusii: Naomi akamobooria, “Ng’ai kware gochora ebigara reero? Nase omogondo o ng’o kware gokora emeremo? Asesenigwe omonto oyio ogwechandera kogokonya!” Rutu agateebia Naomi ng’a nigo arenge gokora emeremo ase omogondo bw’omonto ore korokwa Boazi.
swahili: Basi mkwewe akamuuliza, “Je, umeokota wapi leo? Umefanya kazi wapi? Abarikiwe mtu yule aliyekujali.” Ndipo Ruthu akamwambia mama mkwe wake juu ya yule ambaye yeye alikuwa amefanyia kazi katika shamba lake. Akasema, “Yule mtu niliyefanyia kazi kwake leo, anaitwa Boazi.”

english: And Ruth the Moabitess said to Naomi, “Please let me go into the fields and glean heads of grain after someone in whose sight I may find favor.” “Go ahead, my daughter,” Naomi replied.
ekegusii: Rutu, oria Omomoabu, agateebia Naomi, “Ntige ngende gochora ebigara ebitigari ase omogondo bw’omonto orang’e ribaga nkore bo.” Naomi akamoiraneria, “Genda, mwana one!”
swahili: Ruthu, Mmoabu, akamwambia Naomi, “Nitakwenda mashambani nikaokote mabaki ya nafaka nyuma ya yule nitakayepata kibali machoni pake.” Naomi akamwambia, “Nenda, binti yangu.”

english: Then Naomi said to her daughter-in-law, “May he be blessed by the LORD, who has not withdrawn His kindness from the living or the dead.” Naomi continued, “The man is a close relative. He is one of our kinsman-redeemers. ”
ekegusii: Naomi agateebia Rutu, moka momura oye, “Boazi oyio tiga asesenigwe n’Omonene, oyio ogoikerania chiira chiaye chi’obwanchani ase abwo bare moyo, na ase abwo bakuure.” Naende agateeba, “Omonto oyio nomonyamwando ominto, oyomo bw’abaamate baito.”
swahili: Naye Naomi akamwambia mkwewe, “ Bwana ambariki! Hakuacha kuonyesha fadhili zake kwa walio hai na kwa waliokufa.” Pia akamwambia, “Huyo mtu ni mmoja wa jamaa yetu wa karibu anayestahili kutukomboa.”

english: Then Ruth the Moabitess said, “He also told me, ‘Stay with my young men until they have finished gathering all my harvest.’”
ekegusii: Naende Rutu, Omomoabu oria, akamoteebia, “Amo nayio ere nigo anteebia ng’a mbeere amo nabasomba baye goika bakoore rigesa riaye rionsi.”
swahili: Kisha Ruthu, Mmoabu, akasema, “Hata aliniambia, ‘Kaa pamoja na watumishi wangu mpaka watakapomaliza kuvuna nafaka yangu yote.’ ”

english: And Naomi said to her daughter-in-law Ruth, “My daughter, it is good for you to work with his young women, so that nothing will happen to you in another field.”
ekegusii: Erio Naomi ageteebia Rutu, “Ee, omwana one, mbuya mono kobua asore okore emeremo nabaiseke abwo bakomokorera Boazi. Oise kogenda ase omogondo bw’omonto omoao, abanto bare aroro mbaabaise kogokorera bobe.”
swahili: Kisha Naomi akamwambia Ruthu mkwewe, “Binti yangu, itakuwa vyema wewe ufuatane na wasichana wake, kwa sababu katika shamba la mtu mwingine wanaweza kukudhuru.”

english: So Ruth stayed close to the servant girls of Boaz to glean grain until the barley and wheat harvests were finished. And she lived with her mother-in-law.
ekegusii: Ase ayio Rutu agakora emeremo amo nabaiseke baria, akaba ogochora ebigara goika bagakoora rigesa ri’esairi na eri’engano. Korende akagenderera komenya amo na ng’ina biara.
swahili: Kwa hivyo Ruthu akafuatana na watumishi wa kike wa Boazi, akaokota mpaka mwisho wa mavuno ya shayiri na ya ngano. Naye aliishi na mama mkwe wake.

english: So Ruth departed and went out into the field and gleaned after the harvesters. And she happened to come to the part of the field belonging to Boaz, who was from the clan of Elimelech.
ekegusii: Ase igo Rutu akagenda ase omogondo gete, akaba ogochora ebigara ebitigari korwa magega y’abagesi. Na bono egatoka ng’a omogondo oyio nigo orenge oyo o Boazi, omonto oria bw’eamate y’Elimeleki.
swahili: Basi akaenda, akaokota mabaki ya nafaka mashambani nyuma ya wavunaji. Ikatokea kwamba alijikuta anafanya kazi kwenye shamba lililokuwa mali ya Boazi, ambaye alitoka kwenye ukoo wa Elimeleki.

english: Just then Boaz arrived from Bethlehem and said to the harvesters, “The LORD be with you.” “The LORD bless you,” they replied.
ekegusii: Erio agwo Boazi agacha aroro korwa Bethlehemu, agakwania abagesi, ogoteeba, “Omonene abe amo nainwe!” Nabarabwo bakairaneria, “Omonene agosesenie!”
swahili: Papo hapo Boazi akarudi kutoka Bethlehemu, akawasalimu wavunaji, akasema, “ Bwana awe nanyi!” Nao wakamjibu, “ Bwana akubariki.”

english: And Boaz asked the foreman of his harvesters, “Whose young woman is this?”
ekegusii: Boazi akaboria omoteneneri bw’abagesi baye, “Inee! Omosubati oyo, noyo ng’o?”
swahili: Boazi akamuuliza msimamizi wa wavunaji, “Je, yule mwanamwali ni wa nani?”

english: The foreman answered, “She is the Moabitess who returned with Naomi from the land of Moab.
ekegusii: Omoteneneri oria bw’abakori emeremo akamoiraneria, “Oyo nomosubati bw’Abamoabu, oria ochicha na Naomi korwa ase ense yabo.
swahili: Msimamizi akamjibu, “Ni yule Mmoabu aliyerudi kutoka nchi ya Moabu pamoja na Naomi.

english: She has said, ‘Please let me glean and gather among the sheaves after the harvesters.’ So she came out and has continued from morning until now, except that she rested a short time in the shelter.”
ekegusii: Nigo aboria ribaga ri’ogochora ebigara ebitigari korwa magega y’abagesi, na korwa mambia goika bono nigo agendererete gochora ebigara, taratimoka rinde otatiga bono ase engaki ensinini akendererete ase ekegutu keria.”
swahili: Yeye aliomba, ‘Tafadhali niruhusu niokote na kukusanya miongoni mwa miganda nyuma ya wavunaji.’ Naye ameshinda shambani tangu asubuhi pasipo kupumzika, isipokuwa kwa muda mfupi kivulini.”

english: Then Boaz said to Ruth, “Listen, my daughter. Do not go and glean in another field, and do not go away from this place, but stay here close to my servant girls.
ekegusii: Erio Boazi agakwana na Rutu, akamoteebia, “Mwana one, ntegerera! Tobaisa kogenda gochora ebigara ebitigari ase omogondo omoao; obeere aa oka, obe kogokora emeremo na abaiseke aba.
swahili: Kisha Boazi akamwambia Ruthu, “Binti yangu, nisikilize. Usiende kuokota mabaki ya mavuno katika shamba lingine, na usiondoke hapa. Kaa hapa na hawa watumishi wangu wa kike.

english: Let your eyes be on the field they are harvesting, and follow along after these girls. Indeed, I have ordered the young men not to touch you. And when you are thirsty, go and drink from the jars the young men have filled.”
ekegusii: Origererie orore ase bakogesa obabwatie korwa magega! Nakanirie abanto baane tibakogochanda. Gokorang’a, ogende ase chinsiongo echio baichoirie amaache, otaae onywe!”
swahili: Angalia shamba wanaume wanamovuna, ufuate nyuma yao. Nimewaamuru wanaume hawa wasikuguse. Wakati wowote ukiona kiu, nenda kwenye mitungi ukanywe maji waliyoyateka wanaume hawa.”

english: One day Ruth’s mother-in-law Naomi said to her, “My daughter, should I not seek a resting place for you, that it may be well with you?
ekegusii: Rituko erimo Naomi agateebia Rutu, moka momura oye, “Narorire ng’a mbuya nkonyorere omosacha, erinde onyore enka yao.
swahili: Kisha Naomi akamwambia mkwewe, “Binti yangu, je, nisingelikutafutia pumziko ambako utatunzika vyema?

english: Then Boaz said, “May the LORD bless you, my daughter. You have shown more kindness now than before, because you have not run after the younger men, whether rich or poor.
ekegusii: Erio Boazi akamoteebia, “Mwana one, Omonene agosesenie. Aye bono kworokirie amasikani kobua buna kworogetie ritang’ani. Aye torarigia abasacha bande, abataka gose abanda.
swahili: Akamwambia, “Binti yangu, ubarikiwe na Bwana. Wema huu wa sasa ni mkuu kushinda hata ule ulioonyesha mwanzoni. Hukuwakimbilia vijana, wakiwa matajiri au maskini.

english: And now do not be afraid, my daughter. I will do for you whatever you request, since all my fellow townspeople know that you are a woman of noble character.
ekegusii: Ase ayio, mwana one, toiroka, ekiagera abanto bonsi ase omochie oyo nigo bamanyete ng’a aye nomokuungu omweriti. Ningokorere ande onsi oraganie.
swahili: Sasa, binti yangu, usiogope. Nitakufanyia yote uliyoomba. Kwa maana mji wote wa watu wangu wanakujua ya kwamba wewe ni mwanamke mwenye tabia nzuri.

english: Yes, it is true that I am a kinsman-redeemer, but there is a redeemer nearer than I.
ekegusii: Nabo nekeene ng’a inche nomonyamwando o iso biara inde, korende nare omonyamwando onde omoao ore ang’e kombua.
swahili: Ingawa ni kweli kwamba mimi ndiye jamaa aliye karibu, bado kuna mtu mwingine wa jamaa aliye karibu zaidi wa kukomboa kuliko mimi.

english: Stay here tonight, and in the morning, if he wants to redeem you, good. Let him redeem you. But if he does not want to redeem you, as surely as the LORD lives, I will. Now lie here until morning.”
ekegusii: Bono beera aa ase obotuko obo goika mambia, torore gose omonyamwando oria onde ore ang’e kombua nanche gokorenda. Karakore igo mbuya. Onye tagwancha, rirorio ekeene, buna Omonene are moyo, inche ninkorende. Bono rara aiga goika mambia.”
swahili: Wewe kaa hapa usiku huu, kisha asubuhi kama akikubali kukomboa, vyema na akomboe. La sivyo kama hayuko tayari, hakika kama Bwana aishivyo nitafanya hivyo. Lala hapa mpaka asubuhi.”

english: So she lay down at his feet until morning, but she got up before anyone else could recognize her. Then Boaz said, “Do not let it be known that a woman came to the threshing floor.”
ekegusii: Ase igo omokungu oria akarara ase amagoro aye maate goika mambia, korende mambia chuni botarakiamoka akaimoka kogenda, erinde monto onde tamorora, ekiagera Boazi tatagete monto onde amanye ng’a omokungu oria nachete ase ekeooreri kiaye.
swahili: Hivyo huyo mwanamke akalala miguuni pake mpaka asubuhi, akaondoka mapema pasipo mtu kuweza kumtambua mwenzake, maana Boazi alisema, “Isijulikane kabisa ya kuwa mwanamke alifika kwenye sakafu ya kupuria.”

english: And he told her, “Bring the shawl you are wearing and hold it out.” When she did so, he shoveled six measures of barley into her shawl. Then he went into the city.
ekegusii: Naende Boazi akamoteebia, “Renta egetambaa ekio bwambarete, okiaare.” Na Rutu agakiaara. Erio Boazi akamorengera esairi eisaine ebitita bitano na ekemo, akamoyetweka. Erio omokungu oria akairana gochia ase omochie.
swahili: Pia akamwambia, “Leta shela yako uliyoivaa, uitandaze.” Naye alipoitandaza, akamimina vipimo sita vya shayiri, akamtwika. Kisha Ruthu akarudi zake mjini.

english: When Ruth returned to her mother-in-law, Naomi asked her, “How did it go, my daughter?” Then Ruth told her all that Boaz had done for her.
ekegusii: Ekero Rutu aigete ase ng’ina biara, ere akamobooria, “Mang’ana ki, omwana one?” Rutu akamoteebia amang’ana onsi Boazi amokorerete.
swahili: Basi Ruthu alipofika kwa mama mkwe wake Naomi, akamuuliza, “Je, binti yangu, ilikuwaje huko?” Ndipo akamwelezea kila kitu Boazi alichomfanyia.

english: And she said, “He gave me these six measures of barley, for he said, ‘Do not go back to your mother-in-law empty-handed.’”
ekegusii: Naende agateeba, “Boazi nigo anteebia ng’a tinkonyara koirana gocha asore namaboko amasa. Ase igo ong’a esairi eye ebitita bitano na ekemo.”
swahili: Akaendelea kusema, “Amenipa shayiri vipimo sita akisema, ‘Usiende kwa mama mkwe wako mikono mitupu.’ ”

english: “Wait, my daughter,” said Naomi, “until you find out how things go, for he will not rest unless he has resolved the matter today.”
ekegusii: Naomi akamoteebia, “Bono omwana one, remereria oganye goika orore aya arabe asore. Boazi tagokira reero goika arore ng’a oroisirie amang’ana ao.”
swahili: Kisha Naomi akasema, “Subiri binti yangu, mpaka utakapojua kwamba hili jambo limekwendaje. Kwa sababu mtu huyu hatatulia mpaka akamilishe jambo hili leo.”

english: Now is not Boaz, with whose servant girls you have been working, a relative of ours? In fact, tonight he is winnowing barley on the threshing floor.
ekegusii: Nomanyete ng’a Boazi, oria ase konya ogokora emeremo nabasomba baye, nigo are omonyamwando ominto? Naama! Ase omogoroba o reero nache abe okoora esairi ase ekeooreri kiaye.
swahili: Je, Boazi, ambaye umekuwa pamoja na watumishi wake wasichana, si jamaa yetu wa karibu? Usiku wa leo atakuwa anapepeta ngano kwenye sakafu ya kupuria.

english: Therefore wash yourself, put on perfume, and wear your best clothes. Go down to the threshing floor, but do not let the man know you are there until he has finished eating and drinking.
ekegusii: Ase ayio esibie, bweake amaguta agotioka buya, obeke chianga chiao chingiya. Erio otirimboke gochia ase ekeooreri, korende tobaisa kweorokia ase omonto oria goika ekero akoorire koragera na konywa.
swahili: Basi oga na ukajipake marashi, ujivalie nguo zako nzuri. Kisha uende kwenye sakafu ya kupuria, lakini angalia asijue kwamba upo pale mpaka atakapomaliza kula na kunywa.

english: When he lies down, note the place where he lies. Then go in and uncover his feet, and lie down, and he will explain to you what you should do.”
ekegusii: Ekero ararire, origererie omanye aase aria. Erio ogende aroro, otubore ekiebisio kiaye korwa ase amagoro aye maate, oraareo nere nagoteebie aya ogwenerete gokora.”
swahili: Atakapokwenda kulala, angalia mahali atakapolala. Kisha uende ufunue miguu yake, ulale. Naye atakuambia utakalofanya.”

english: “I will do everything you say,” Ruth answered.
ekegusii: Rutu akairaneria, “Aya onsi gwanteebia ninyakore.”
swahili: Ruthu akajibu, “Lolote usemalo nitatenda.”

english: So she went down to the threshing floor and did everything her mother-in-law had instructed her to do.
ekegusii: Ase igo Rutu agatirimboka gochia ase ekeooreri, agakora buna ng’ina biara konya amotebirie.
swahili: Basi akashuka mpaka kwenye sakafu ya kupuria, akafanya kila kitu mama mkwe wake alichomwambia kufanya.

english: After Boaz had finished eating and drinking and was in good spirits, he went to lie down at the end of the heap of grain. Then Ruth went in secretly, uncovered his feet, and lay down.
ekegusii: Boazi kariire na konywa akaigwa buya ase omoyo oye erio, akagenda ang’e netui y’esairi, akarara aroro. Erio Rutu agachoba ng’ora‐ng’ora, agatubora ekiebisio korwa ase amagoro a Boazi, akarara aroro.
swahili: Wakati Boazi alipomaliza kula na kunywa, naye akawa amejawa na furaha, alikwenda kulala mwisho wa lundo la nafaka. Ruthu akanyemelea polepole, akafunua miguu yake, na akalala.

english: At midnight, Boaz was startled, turned over, and there lying at his feet was a woman!
ekegusii: Na kobwabeire botuko gati, Boazi agataboboka. Ani! Omokungu naraire magoro aye maate.
swahili: Usiku wa manane, kitu kilimshtua Boazi, akajigeuza, akagundua yupo mwanamke amelala miguuni pake.

english: “Who are you?” he asked. “I am your servant Ruth,” she replied. “Spread the corner of your garment over me, for you are a kinsman-redeemer. ”
ekegusii: Boazi akamobooria, “Naye ng’o?” Ere akamoiraneria, “Ninche Rutu omosomba oo, ekiagera aye nigo ore omonyamwando o tata biara. Ase igo koranche nywome.”
swahili: Akauliza, “Wewe ni nani?” Akajibu, “Ni mimi Ruthu, mjakazi wako. Uitande nguo yako juu yangu, kwa sababu wewe ndiwe jamaa wa karibu wa kutukomboa.”

english: Meanwhile, Boaz went to the gate and sat down there. Soon the kinsman-redeemer of whom he had spoken came along, and Boaz said, “Come over here, my friend, and sit down.” So he went over and sat down.
ekegusii: Boazi akagenda agaikaransa ase etureti agwo ase egeita ki’omochie. Ekaba ng’a omonto oria omonyamwando bw’Elimeleki ore ang’e kobua Boazi, oria Boazi akwanete igoro yaye, ngoeta arenge. Boazi akamorangeria, akamoteebia, “Oyominto, gobera gocha aa, oikaranse!” Omonto oria akagobera, agaikaransa.
swahili: Boazi akakwea mpaka kwenye lango la mji, akaketi pale. Yule mtu wa jamaa aliyekuwa wa karibu wa kukomboa, ambaye Boazi alimtaja, akaja. Boazi akasema, “Njoo hapa, rafiki yangu. Karibu uketi.” Naye akakaribia, akaketi.

english: Moreover, I have acquired Ruth the Moabitess, Mahlon’s widow, as my wife, to raise up the name of the deceased through his inheritance, so that his name will not disappear from among his brothers or from the gate of his home. You are witnesses today.”
ekegusii: Amo nayio Rutu, Omomoabu oria, oyorenge moka Mahaloni, namoirire abe mokane, erinde inyare goteneneria oria okwete egesaku kerarie omwando oye, nario ororeria rwaye rotasire ase abamwabo, gose ase abanto b’omochie oye. Ase amang’ana aya mbirori more reero.”
swahili: Nimemchukua pia Ruthu, Mmoabu, mjane wa Maloni, awe mke wangu, ili kuendeleza jina la marehemu pamoja na mali zake, ili jina lake marehemu lisitoweke miongoni mwa jamaa yake, wala katika kumbukumbu za mji wake. Leo hivi ninyi ni mashahidi!”

english: “We are witnesses,” said the elders and all the people at the gate. “May the LORD make the woman entering your home like Rachel and Leah, who together built up the house of Israel. May you be prosperous in Ephrathah and famous in Bethlehem.
ekegusii: Abagaaka baria na abanto bande bonsi abarenge ase etureti agwo ase egeita ki’omochie bakairaneria, “Ee, mbirori tore. Tiga Omonene asesenie omokungu oyio orache ase enka yao abe buna Raeli na Lea, abwo baiborerete Israeli abana abange bakaba egesaku. Aye osesenigwe ase egati y’Abaefarati na omanyekane ase Bethlehemu.
swahili: Kisha wazee pamoja na watu wote waliokuwa langoni wakasema, “Sisi ni mashahidi. Bwana na amfanye mwanamke huyu aingiaye nyumbani mwako kuwa kama Raheli na kama Lea, wale wanawake wawili ambao pamoja waliijenga nyumba ya Israeli. Nawe ufanikiwe katika Efrathi na uwe mashuhuri katika Bethlehemu.

english: And may your house become like the house of Perez, whom Tamar bore to Judah, because of the offspring the LORD will give you by this young woman.” Boaz Marries Ruth
ekegusii: Naende enka yao ebe buna eya Peresi, oria Tamari aiborerete Yuda, goetera ase oroiboro rori’Omonene arakoe korwa ase omokungu oyio.”
swahili: Kupitia kwa watoto ambao Bwana atakupa kutokana na huyu mwanamwali, jamaa yako na ifanane na ya Peresi, ambaye Tamari alimzalia Yuda.” Wazao Wa Boazi

english: So Boaz took Ruth, and she became his wife. And when he had relations with her, the LORD enabled her to conceive, and she gave birth to a son.
ekegusii: Ase igo Boazi akaira Rutu, na ere akaba mokaye. Erio bakamenyana, n’Omonene aganchera Rutu koba morito, na ere akaibora omwana omoisia.
swahili: Basi Boazi akamwoa Ruthu, naye akawa mke wake. Alipoingia kwake, Bwana akamjalia Ruthu, naye akapata mimba, akamzaa mtoto wa kiume.

english: Then the women said to Naomi, “Blessed be the LORD, who has not left you this day without a kinsman-redeemer. May his name become famous in Israel.
ekegusii: Erio abakungu b’omochie oyio bagateebia Naomi, “Omonene atogigwe! Ere tagotigeti; reero okoeire omonyamwando, oyio erieta riaye riramanyekane ase egati y’Abaisraeli!
swahili: Wanawake wakamwambia Naomi: “Ahimidiwe Bwana, asiyekuacha bila kuwa na jamaa wa karibu wa kukomboa. Na awe mashuhuri katika Israeli yote!

english: He will renew your life and sustain you in your old age. For your daughter-in-law, who loves you and is better to you than seven sons, has given him birth.”
ekegusii: Nere oragotimokie, abe chinguru chiao abe ogokorageria ase obogotu bwao. Moka momura oo nigo agwanchete; ere ogokoreire amaya kobua abamura batano na babere, na bono oiboire omwana oyio.”
swahili: Atakurejeshea uhai wako na kukuangalia katika siku za uzee wako. Kwa maana mkweo ambaye anakupenda, na ambaye kwako ni bora zaidi ya watoto wa kiume saba, ndiye alimzaa.”

english: And Naomi took the child, placed him on her lap, and became a nurse to him.
ekegusii: Naomi akaimokia omwana oria, akamoagata, akaba okomorera.
swahili: Basi Naomi akamchukua yule mtoto, akampakata na akawa mlezi wake.

english: The neighbor women said, “A son has been born to Naomi,” and they named him Obed. He became the father of Jesse, the father of David. The Line of David (Matthew 1:1–17; Luke 3:23–38)
ekegusii: Abakungu abarenge abagisangio baye bakaboora, “Naomi oiboreirwe omwana omochokoro omomura”, bakamoroka Obedi. Obedi oyio nere orenge ise Yese, na Yese akaba ise Daudi. Chisokoro chia Daudi
swahili: Wanawake waliokuwa jirani zake wakasema, “Naomi ana mtoto wa kiume.” Wakamwita jina lake Obedi. Yeye ndiye baba yake Yese, aliye baba yake Daudi.

english: Now these are the generations of Perez: Perez was the father of Hezron,
ekegusii: Abanto aba nabwo ororeria rwa Peresi: Peresi akaibora Hezironi;
swahili: Hivi ndivyo vizazi vya Peresi: Peresi alimzaa Hesroni,

english: Hezron was the father of Ram, Ram was the father of Amminadab,
ekegusii: Hezironi akaibora Ramu, na Ramu akaibora Aminadabu;
swahili: Hesroni akamzaa Ramu, Ramu akamzaa Aminadabu,

english: Then Boaz took ten of the elders of the city and said, “Sit here,” and they did so.
ekegusii: Naende Boazi akarangeria abagaaka ikomi b’omochie baikaranse aroro, ase igo bagaikaransa.
swahili: Boazi akatwaa watu kumi miongoni mwa wazee wa mji, akawaambia, “Ketini hapa.” Nao wakaketi.

english: Amminadab was the father of Nahshon, Nahshon was the father of Salmon,
ekegusii: Aminadabu akaibora Nahesoni, na Nahesoni akaibora Salimoni;
swahili: Aminadabu akamzaa Nashoni, Nashoni akamzaa Salmoni,

english: Salmon was the father of Boaz, Boaz was the father of Obed,
ekegusii: Salimoni akaibora Boazi, na Boazi akaibora Obedi;
swahili: Salmoni akamzaa Boazi, Boazi akamzaa Obedi,

english: Obed was the father of Jesse, and Jesse was the father of David.
ekegusii: Obedi akaibora Yese, na Yese akaibora Daudi.
swahili: Obedi akamzaa Yese, na Yese akamzaa Daudi.

english: And he said to the kinsman-redeemer, “Naomi, who has returned from the land of Moab, is selling the piece of land that belonged to our brother Elimelech.
ekegusii: Erio Boazi agateebia omonyamwando oria, “Naomi, oria oirana korwa ense y’Abamoabu, nkoonia are oboremo boria bwarenge omwando bw’Elimeleki ominto.
swahili: Kisha akamwambia yule jamaa wa karibu wa kukomboa, “Naomi, aliyerudi hapa kutoka nchi ya Moabu, anauza sehemu ya ardhi iliyokuwa mali ya ndugu yetu Elimeleki.

english: I thought I should inform you that you may buy it back in the presence of those seated here and in the presence of the elders of my people. If you want to redeem it, do so. But if you will not redeem it, tell me so I may know, because there is no one but you to redeem it, and I am next after you.” “I will redeem it,” he replied.
ekegusii: Inche nigo narengereretie gokomanyia amang’ana aya. Bono nonyare kobogora aiga ase amasio abagaaka b’abanto baane aba, na ase aba bonsi baikaransete igaa. Onye kogwancha kobogora, bogore, korende onye taibo, ntebie imanye, ekiagera naye ore omonyamwando ore ang’e, na magega yao ninche.” Omonto oria akairaneria, “Ee, nimbogore.”
swahili: Nami niliwaza nikujulishe wewe na kukuambia uinunue mbele ya hawa waliopo hapa, na mbele ya wazee wa watu wangu. Kama wewe utaikomboa, haya fanya hivyo. Lakini kama hutaikomboa, uniambie, ili nijue. Kwa kuwa hakuna mtu mwingine mwenye haki ya kuikomboa ila wewe na baada yako ni mimi.” Naye akasema, “Nitaikomboa mimi.”

english: Then Boaz said, “On the day you buy the land from Naomi and also from Ruth the Moabitess, you must also acquire the widow of the deceased in order to raise up the name of the deceased on his inheritance.”
ekegusii: Erio Boazi akamoteebia, “Korende onye gokogora oboremo korwa ase Naomi, rirorio oire Rutu, Omomoabu oria, moka oria okwete, abe mokao, naye omotenenerie oria okwete egesaku kerarie omwando oye.”
swahili: Ndipo Boazi akasema “Siku utakaponunua hiyo ardhi kutoka kwa Naomi na Ruthu, Mmoabu, itakubidi kumchukua pia huyo mjane, ili kudumisha jina la marehemu pamoja na mali yake.”

english: The kinsman-redeemer replied, “I cannot redeem it myself, or I would jeopardize my own inheritance. Take my right of redemption, because I cannot redeem it.”
ekegusii: Omonyamwando oria akairaneria, akabora, “Onye naboigo, rirorio tinkobogora, mbaise gosiria omwando one. Ribaga riane ri’okobogora, aye riire; tinkonyara kobogora.”
swahili: Aliposikia hili, yule jamaa wa karibu wa kukomboa akasema, “Basi mimi sitaweza kuikomboa, kwa sababu inaonekana nitauhatarisha urithi wangu. Wewe ikomboe mwenyewe. Mimi sitaweza.”

english: Now in former times in Israel, concerning the redemption or exchange of property, to make any matter legally binding a man would remove his sandal and give it to the other party, and this was a confirmation in Israel.
ekegusii: Ase amatuko a kare ase Abaisraeli, ekero enibo yare koboorigwa, gose koonchorerigwa, engencho yabo nigo yarenge ng’a oyomo bw’abwo nigo arenge gosomora egekoroto kiaye ekemo omoa oria onde. Ayio nigo are kogera aria agambwa takoonchoranwa, na ogokora okwo kwaba kirori.
swahili: (Basi katika siku za kale huko Israeli, ili kukamilisha tendo la kukomboa na kukabidhiana mali, mmoja huvua kiatu chake na kumpatia mwingine. Hii ilikuwa ni njia ya kuhalalisha mabadilishano katika Israeli.)

english: So the kinsman-redeemer removed his sandal and said to Boaz, “Buy it for yourself.”
ekegusii: Ase igo omonyamwando oria agateebia Boazi, “Aye bogore”, na akamosomorera egekoroto kiaye.
swahili: Basi yule jamaa wa karibu wa kukomboa akamwambia Boazi, “Wewe inunue mwenyewe.” Naye huyo jamaa akavua kiatu chake.

english: At this, Boaz said to the elders and all the people, “You are witnesses today that I am buying from Naomi all that belonged to Elimelech, Chilion, and Mahlon.
ekegusii: Erio Boazi agateebia abagaaka baria na abanto bonsi abarengeo, “Inwe mbirori more reero ng’a nagorire korwa ase amaboko a Naomi bionsi ebiarenge ebi’Elimeleki, na ebia Kilioni amo nebia Mahaloni.
swahili: Kisha Boazi akawatangazia wazee na watu wote waliokuwepo, “Leo ninyi ni mashahidi kwamba mimi nimenunua kutoka kwa Naomi yote yaliyokuwa mali ya Elimeleki, Kilioni na Maloni.

english: This is Solomon’s Song of Songs. The Bride
ekegusii: Ogoteera gwa Sulemani okwo kore okuya goetania amatera onsi. Ogoteera Kw’eritang’ani (Omoriakari)
swahili: Wimbo ulio bora wa Solomoni. Shairi La Kwanza Mpendwa

english: Your cheeks are beautiful with ornaments, your neck with strings of jewels. The Friends
ekegusii: Chinsea chiao nechinseera, chichabeire n’ebinto bi’oboseera, ne rigoti riao nigo richabeire ne chisonoi.
swahili: Mashavu yako yanapendeza yakiwa na vipuli, shingo yako ikiwa na mikufu ya vito.

english: We will make you ornaments of gold, studded with beads of silver. The Bride
ekegusii: Intwe ntokoroiserie ebinyuri bie chitaabu bi’ogwechabera, ebitonire ne chifeta. (Omoriakari)
swahili: Tutakufanyia vipuli vya dhahabu, vyenye kupambwa kwa fedha. Mpendwa

english: While the king was at his table, my perfume spread its fragrance.
ekegusii: Ekero omorwoti arenge aase aye agotimokera, amaguta aane akorokwa narada agatioka rimisu rigiya.
swahili: Wakati mfalme alipokuwa mezani pake, manukato yangu yalisambaza harufu yake nzuri.

english: My beloved is to me a sachet of myrrh resting between my breasts.
ekegusii: Omwanchi one nigo are ase ’nde buna omobuko o manemane, oyo nkobeeka ase egekuba kiane gati gati yechimbeere chiane.
swahili: Mpenzi wangu kwangu mimi ni kifuko cha manemane kati ya matiti yangu.

english: My beloved is to me a cluster of henna blossoms in the vineyards of En-gedi. The Bridegroom
ekegusii: Omwanchi one nigo are ase ’nde buna egesago ki’ebisicha bikorokwa hena, bire ase emegondo y’emesabibu y’Eni‐Gedi. (Omonyuomi)
swahili: Mpenzi wangu kwangu mimi ni kama kishada cha maua ya mhina kutoka mashamba ya mizabibu ya En-Gedi. Mpenzi

english: How beautiful you are, my darling! Oh, how very beautiful! Your eyes are like doves. The Bride
ekegusii: Naama! Aye omwanchi one, naki ore omoseera mono! Ee, nabo ore omoseera mono. Ekieni ki’amaiso ao nigo kenga eki’amaruma. (Omoriakari)
swahili: Tazama jinsi ulivyo mzuri, mpenzi wangu! Tazama jinsi ulivyo mzuri! Macho yako ni kama ya hua. Mpendwa

english: How handsome you are, my beloved! Oh, how delightful! The soft grass is our bed. The Bridegroom
ekegusii: Aye omwanchi one, nigo ore omoseera. Ee, aye nigo ore oyo bw’okogokia, oborere bwaito nigo borabe obonyansi bore machani.
swahili: Tazama jinsi ulivyo mzuri, mpenzi wangu! Ee, tazama jinsi unavyopendeza! Na kitanda chetu ni cha majani mazuri. Mpenzi

english: The beams of our house are cedars; our rafters are fragrant firs.
ekegusii: Ebisigisa bi’enyomba yaito nebi’emecharake, ne chindote nechi’emetarakwa.
swahili: Nguzo za nyumba yetu ni mierezi, na mapao yetu ni miberoshi.

english: Let him kiss me with the kisses of his mouth! For your love is more delightful than wine.
ekegusii: Tiga anyunyunte nokonyunyunta kw’omonwa oye. Ekiagera obwanchani bwao nobuya kobua edivai.
swahili: Unibusu kwa busu la kinywa chako, kwa maana upendo wako unafurahisha kuliko divai.

english: The fragrance of your perfume is pleasing; your name is like perfume poured out. No wonder the maidens adore you.
ekegusii: Amaguta ao akweakwa nigo are ne rimisu rigiya; erieta riao nigo ringa buna amaguta aumoirwe, ase ayio abakungu nigo bagwanchete.
swahili: Manukato yako yananukia vizuri, jina lako ni kama manukato yaliyomiminwa. Ndiyo sababu wanawali wanakupenda!

english: Take me away with you—let us hurry! May the king bring me to his chambers. The Friends We will rejoice and delight in you; we will praise your love more than wine. The Bride It is only right that they adore you.
ekegusii: Ing’use nkobwatie, tominyoke kogenda. Omorwoti ondetire ase enyomba yaye. Ntokogokere na kogochengera, ntotogie obwanchani bwao kobua edivai. Ekeene, nakio abakungu bagwancherete.
swahili: Nichukue twende nawe, na tufanye haraka! Mfalme na anilete ndani ya vyumba vyake. Marafiki Tunakushangilia na kukufurahia, tutasifu upendo wako zaidi kuliko divai. Mpendwa Tazama jinsi ilivyo bora wakupende!

english: I am dark, yet lovely, O daughters of Jerusalem, like the tents of Kedar, like the curtains of Solomon.
ekegusii: Inwe abakungu ba Yerusalemu, inche nigo inde omomwamu ti, noyo bw’okogokia. Nigo inga buna chiema chia Kedari, naende buna ebitambaa bi’ogosungwa bia Sulemani.
swahili: Mimi ni mweusi, lakini napendeza, enyi binti za Yerusalemu, mweusi kama mahema ya Kedari, kama mapazia ya hema la Solomoni.

english: Do not stare because I am dark, for the sun has gazed upon me. My mother’s sons were angry with me; they made me a keeper of the vineyards, but my own vineyard I have neglected.
ekegusii: Timobaisa kondigereria, ekiagera inde omomwamu ti; nomobaso bw’erioba onsambire. Abamura ba baba nigo bambeete, bakambeeka korenda emegondo y’emesabibu, korende omogondo one bw’emesabibu tinarendete.
swahili: Usinikazie macho kwa sababu mimi ni mweusi, kwa sababu nimefanywa mweusi na jua. Wana wa mama yangu walinikasirikia na kunifanya niwe mtunza mashamba ya mizabibu. Shamba langu mwenyewe la mizabibu nimeliacha.

english: Tell me, O one I love, where do you pasture your sheep? Where do you rest them at midday? Why should I be like a veiled woman beside the flocks of your companions? The Friends
ekegusii: Aye omwanchi bw’omoyo one, nteebie ng’ai okorisia riicho riao. Ng’ai okoriira riakenderera mobaso gati? Nase ki ndabe nkona‐gotayaya ase egati y’amaicho ’abagisangio bao? (Omonyuomi)
swahili: Niambie, wewe ambaye ninakupenda, unalisha wapi kundi lako la kondoo na ni wapi unapowapumzisha kondoo wako adhuhuri. Kwa nini niwe kama mwanamke aliyefunikwa shela karibu na makundi ya rafiki zako? Marafiki

english: If you do not know, O fairest of women, follow the tracks of the flock, and graze your young goats near the tents of the shepherds. The Bridegroom
ekegusii: Aye ore omoseera kobua abakungu bonsi; onye tomanyeti, bwatia amabarato e riicho, obe gokorisia chimanwa chiao chie chimbori ang’e ne chiema chi’abarisia.
swahili: Kama hujui, ewe mwanamke mzuri kuliko wote, fuata nyayo za kondoo, na kulisha wana-mbuzi wako karibu na hema za wachungaji. Mpenzi

english: I compare you, my darling, to a mare among Pharaoh’s chariots.
ekegusii: Aye omwanchi one, nigo ngokoreng’ania nebarasi eaberi ekong’usa egari ya Farao.
swahili: Mpenzi wangu, ninakufananisha na farasi jike aliyefungwa katika mojawapo ya magari ya vita ya Farao.

english: I am a rose of Sharon, a lily of the valley. The Bridegroom
ekegusii: Inche nigo inga egesicha gia Saroni gekorokwa rosi, naende egesicha ekiya kie rikura. (Omonyuomi)
swahili: Mimi ni ua la Sharoni, yungiyungi ya bondeni. Mpenzi

english: My beloved calls to me, “Arise, my darling. Come away with me, my beautiful one.
ekegusii: Omwanchi ngokwana are na gonteebia. (Omonyuomi) Aye omwanchi one, nigo ore omuya, imoka, inchwo togende,
swahili: Mpenzi wangu alizungumza na kuniambia, “Inuka, mpenzi wangu, mrembo wangu, tufuatane.

english: For now the winter is past; the rain is over and gone.
ekegusii: ekiagera bono engaki y’etoigo yaerire, boigo engaki y’embura yaerire ne mbura yachiire.
swahili: Tazama! Wakati wa masika umepita, mvua imekwisha na ikapita.

english: The flowers have appeared in the countryside; the season of singing has come, and the cooing of turtledoves is heard in our land.
ekegusii: Ebisicha biasichire ase ense, engaki y’amatera yaikire, ee, eriogi ri’amatera ’amaruma riaigurwe ase ense yaito.
swahili: Maua yanatokea juu ya nchi; majira ya kuimba yamewadia, sauti za njiwa zinasikika katika nchi yetu.

english: The fig tree ripens its figs; the blossoming vines spread their fragrance. Arise, come away, my darling; come away with me, my beautiful one.” The Bridegroom
ekegusii: Emeko yachakire kwama amako, na emesabibu yachakire gosicha, nigo egotioka rimisu rigiya. Aye omosani one omuya, imoka togende!
swahili: Mtini unatunga matunda yake ya mwanzoni, zabibu zinazochanua zaeneza harufu nzuri. Inuka, njoo mpenzi wangu. Mrembo wangu, tufuatane.” Mpenzi

english: O my dove in the clefts of the rock, in the crevices of the cliff, let me see your face, let me hear your voice; for your voice is sweet, and your countenance is lovely. The Friends
ekegusii: Aye riruma riane ore ase omwenya bw’egetare, agwo ase obwebiso bw’egetare, tiga indore obosio bwao, naende inyigwe eriogi riao, ekiagera eriogi riao neriansu, na obosio bwao noboseera.
swahili: Hua wangu penye nyufa za majabali, mafichoni pembezoni mwa mlima, nionyeshe uso wako, na niisikie sauti yako, kwa maana sauti yako ni tamu, na uso wako unapendeza.

english: Catch for us the foxes— the little foxes that ruin the vineyards— for our vineyards are in bloom. The Bride
ekegusii: Tobwatere ebibwe, ebibwe biria ebike, ebio bigosaria emegondo y’emesabibu, korwa ekero emesabibu yaito yasichete. (Omoriakari)
swahili: Tukamatie mbweha, mbweha wale wadogo wanaoharibu mashamba ya mizabibu, mashamba yetu ya mizabibu yaliyochanua. Mpendwa

english: My beloved is mine and I am his; he pastures his flock among the lilies.
ekegusii: Inche nigo inde oyo bw’omwanchi one, nere noyone; nigo akorisia riicho riaye ase egati y’ebisicha ebiya.
swahili: Mpenzi wangu ni wangu, nami ni wake, yeye hujilisha katikati ya yungiyungi.

english: Before the day breaks and shadows flee, turn, my beloved, and be like a gazelle or a young stag on the mountains of Bether.
ekegusii: Ekero rigochia kogoroba na emerengari egochia gosira, aye omwanchi one, onchoka gocha ase ’nde, ominyoke buna engabi, gose buna ensune ensae igoro ase egetunwa kere chinchwara.
swahili: Mpaka jua linapochomoza, na vivuli vikimbie, rudi, mpenzi wangu, na uwe kama paa, au kama ayala kijana juu ya vilima vya Betheri.

english: Like a lily among the thorns is my darling among the maidens. The Bride
ekegusii: Ee, koreng’ana buna egesicha ekiya kere ase egati y’amagwa, naboigo omwanchi one are ase egati y’abaiseke. (Omoriakari)
swahili: Kama yungiyungi katikati ya miiba ndivyo alivyo mpenzi wangu katikati ya wanawali. Mpendwa

english: Like an apricot tree among the trees of the forest is my beloved among the young men. I delight to sit in his shade, and his fruit is sweet to my taste.
ekegusii: Koreng’ana buna omote bw’amapera osimekire ase egati y’emete y’orosana, naboigo omwanchi one are ase egati y’abamura. Nigo ngokirie goikaransa ase ekiriri kiaye, na amatunda aye akanyansera.
swahili: Kama mti wa mtofaa miongoni mwa miti ya msituni ndivyo alivyo mpenzi wangu miongoni mwa wanaume vijana. Ninafurahia kuketi kivulini mwa mwanaume huyu, na tunda lake ni tamu kwangu.

english: He has brought me to the house of wine, and his banner over me is love.
ekegusii: Ere akang’ira ase enyomba y’omoyega, na obwanchani bwaye nigo bore buna ebendera igoro yane.
swahili: Amenichukua mpaka kwenye ukumbi wa karamu, na bendera ya huyu mwanaume juu yangu ni upendo.

english: Sustain me with raisins; refresh me with apples, for I am faint with love.
ekegusii: Inyigotie na amasabibu amomo na ongokie na amapera, ekiagera amaiga ’obwanchani anyarire.
swahili: Nitie nguvu kwa zabibu kavu, niburudishe kwa matofaa, kwa maana ninazimia kwa mapenzi.

english: His left hand is under my head, and his right arm embraces me.
ekegusii: Okoboko kwaye kwa bomosi nigo kore inse y’omotwe one, na okwa borio nigo komboanetie.
swahili: Mkono wake wa kushoto uko chini ya kichwa changu, na mkono wake wa kuume unanikumbatia.

english: O daughters of Jerusalem, I adjure you by the gazelles and does of the field: Do not arouse or awaken love until the time is right.
ekegusii: Inwe abakungu ba Yerusalemu, nigo nkobasorora, nkobatiania ase chingabi ne chinsune chi’orosana ng’a timobaisa gotabobora obwanchani, gose koboichania, goika bobe Engaki yaye yaikeranire. Ogoteera Gwa Kabere (Omoriakari)
swahili: Binti za Yerusalemu, ninawaagiza kwa paa na kwa ayala wa shambani: Msichochee wala kuamsha mapenzi hata yatakapotaka yenyewe. Shairi La Pili Mpendwa

english: Listen! My beloved approaches. Look! Here he comes, leaping across the mountains, bounding over the hills.
ekegusii: Tegerera moigwe eriogi ri’omwanchi one! Rora oyio ogocha! Nigo agocharoka‐charoka igoro ase ebitunwa, na gocharara ase ebigoro.
swahili: Sikiliza! Mpenzi wangu! Tazama! Huyu hapa anakuja, akirukaruka juu milimani akizunguka juu ya vilima.

english: My beloved is like a gazelle or a young stag. Look, he stands behind our wall, gazing through the windows, peering through the lattice.
ekegusii: Omwanchi one nigo anga engabi gose ensune ensae. Rora, bono nigo ateneine magega y’enyasi y’enyomba yaito. Origereretie gocha ime goetera ase chitirisa, goetera ase ekebao kiabekire ebitange.
swahili: Mpenzi wangu ni kama paa au ayala kijana. Tazama! Anasimama nyuma ya ukuta wetu, akitazama kupitia madirishani, akichungulia kimiani.

english: On my bed at night I sought the one I love; I sought him, but did not find him.
ekegusii: Botuko ekero naraire borere bwane, nkamorigia oria omoyo one bwanchete, nkamorigia, korende tinamonyora.
swahili: Usiku kucha kwenye kitanda changu nilimtafuta yule moyo wangu umpendaye; nilimtafuta, lakini sikumpata.

english: He has made its posts of silver, its base of gold, its seat of purple fabric. Its interior is inlaid with love by the daughters of Jerusalem.
ekegusii: Amagoro aye kegotenenera nigo aroiseirie chifeta, na ekiegeko kiaye nigo kiaroiseirie chitaabu; egeikaransero kiaye nigo giatubire negetambaa kere monyinga. Abakungu ba Yerusalemu nigo bagechaberete ime, bare nomoyo bw’ogwancha.
swahili: Nguzo zake alizitengeneza kwa fedha, kitako chake kwa dhahabu. Kiti chake kilipambwa kwa zambarau, gari lake likanakshiwa njumu kwa upendo na binti za Yerusalemu.

english: Come out, O daughters of Zion, and gaze at King Solomon, wearing the crown his mother bestowed on the day of his wedding— the day of his heart’s rejoicing.
ekegusii: Inwe abasubati ba Sayoni, inchwo morore Sulemani omorwoti obegeete ekiore keria ng’ina amobeekerete ase rituko riria Sulemani akoreretwe enyangi, rituko riria ri’omogooko bw’enkoro yaye.
swahili: Tokeni nje, ninyi binti za Sayuni, mkamtazame Mfalme Solomoni akiwa amevaa taji, taji ambalo mama yake alimvika siku ya arusi yake, siku ambayo moyo wake ulishangilia.

english: I will arise now and go about the city, through the streets and squares. I will seek the one I love. So I sought him but did not find him.
ekegusii: “Erio nkaimoka nkagenda ase omochie, ng’aeta ase chinchera chiaye na ase ebiooreri biaye, nkarigia omwanchi bw’omoyo one.” Nkamorigia, korende tinamonyora.
swahili: Sasa nitaondoka na kuzunguka mjini, katika barabara zake na viwanja; nitamtafuta yule moyo wangu umpendaye. Kwa hiyo nilimtafuta lakini sikumpata.

english: I encountered the watchmen on their rounds of the city: “Have you seen the one I love?”
ekegusii: Ekero abarendi barenge goetanana omochie koyorata, bakanyoora inche, na inche nkababooria, “Mwarora omwanchi bw’omoyo one?”
swahili: Walinzi walinikuta walipokuwa wakizunguka mji. Nikawauliza, “Je, mmemwona yule moyo wangu umpendaye?”

english: I had just passed them when I found the one I love. I held him and would not let go until I had brought him to my mother’s house, to the chamber of the one who conceived me.
ekegusii: Ase obwango obwo naruete ase abarendi abwo, nkanyora omwanchi bw’omoyo one. Nkamotarera tinamotiga agende; nigo namorentete mwa baba, nkamosoyia gochia ase akanyomba gokorara.
swahili: Kitambo kidogo tu baada ya kuwapita nilimpata yule moyo wangu umpendaye. Nilimshika na sikumwachia aende mpaka nilipomleta katika nyumba ya mama yangu, katika chumba cha yule aliyenichukua mimba.

english: O daughters of Jerusalem, I adjure you by the gazelles and does of the field: Do not arouse or awaken love until the time is right. Solomon Arrives on His Wedding Day
ekegusii: Inwe abakungu ba Yerusalemu, nigo nkobasorora, nkobatiania ase chingabi na ase chinsune chi’orosana ng’a timobaisa gotabobora obwa’nchani gose koboichania, goika bobe bwancheranire obonyene. Ogoteera Kw’a Gatato (Omoriakari)
swahili: Binti za Yerusalemu, ninawaagiza kwa paa na kwa ayala wa shambani: Msichochee wala kuamsha mapenzi hata yatakapotaka yenyewe. Shairi La Tatu Mpenzi

english: Who is this coming up from the wilderness like a column of smoke, scented with myrrh and frankincense from all the spices of the merchant?
ekegusii: Ngeto ki keria kegocha korwa ase erooro kenga buna rikundesi ri’erioki? Ninki eke keagete amaguta a manemane na ubani, ebinto ebio bikoonigwa nabakori ebiasara.
swahili: Ni nani huyu anayekuja kutoka jangwani kama nguzo ya moshi, anayenukia manemane na uvumba iliyotengenezwa kwa vikolezo vyote vya mfanyabiashara?

english: Behold, it is Solomon’s carriage, escorted by sixty of the mightiest men of Israel.
ekegusii: Rora aaria, ekerogo gi’okobogoreria Sulemani, geetananire nabasaacha emerongo etano nomo, abare chituoni chi’Abaisraeli.
swahili: Tazama! Ni gari la Solomoni lisindikizwalo na mashujaa sitini, walio wakuu sana wa Israeli,

english: All are skilled with the sword, experienced in warfare. Each has his sword at his side prepared for the terror of the night.
ekegusii: Abwo bonsi nigo beboeranetie emeyio ya birende, na nigo bare abanto bamanyete korwana esegi. Kera oyomo nigo abogoreti omoyio obirende, orendete ase okogoswa kwa botuko.
swahili: wote wamevaa panga, wote wazoefu katika vita, kila mmoja na upanga wake pajani, wamejiandaa kwa ajili ya hofu za usiku.

english: King Solomon has made his carriage out of the timber of Lebanon.
ekegusii: Omorwoti Sulemani nigo eroiseretie ekerogo keria korwa ase emete ya Lebanoni.
swahili: Mfalme Solomoni alijitengenezea gari; alilitengeneza kwa mbao kutoka Lebanoni.

english: How beautiful you are, my darling— how very beautiful! Your eyes are like doves behind your veil. Your hair is like a flock of goats streaming down Mount Gilead.
ekegusii: Aye omwanchi one, naki ore omoseera! Naama! Nigo ore omoseera! Korwa ime y’egietubo kiao ekieni ki’amaiso ao nigo kenga eki’amaruma; etukia yao nigo enga buna riicho rie chimbori, nigo chigotirimboka ase ebitirimboko bia Gileadi.
swahili: Tazama jinsi ulivyo mzuri, mpenzi wangu! Ee, jinsi ulivyo mzuri! Macho yako nyuma ya shela yako ni kama ya hua. Nywele zako ni kama kundi la mbuzi zikishuka kutoka Mlima Gileadi.

english: How delightful is your love, my sister, my bride! Your love is much better than wine, and the fragrance of your perfume than all spices.
ekegusii: Aye moiseke ominto, omoriakari one, obwanchani bwao naki bore obuya mono! Naki bore obuya mono kobua edivai! Ne rimisu ri’amaguta ao ogweaka nigo ribuete ebinsari bionsi!
swahili: Tazama jinsi pendo lako linavyofurahisha, dada yangu, bibi arusi wangu! Pendo lako linafurahisha aje zaidi ya divai, na harufu ya manukato yako zaidi ya kikolezo chochote!

english: Your lips, my bride, drip sweetness like the honeycomb; honey and milk are under your tongue, and the fragrance of your garments is like the aroma of Lebanon.
ekegusii: Aye omoriakari one, ebikoba biao nigo bikonyororokia obooke; obooke na amabeere nigo bire inse y’oromeme rwao. Rimisu rie chianga chiao nigo ringa eria Lebanoni.
swahili: Midomo yako inadondosha utamu kama sega la asali, bibi arusi wangu; maziwa na asali viko chini ya ulimi wako. Harufu nzuri ya mavazi yako ni kama ile ya Lebanoni.

english: My sister, my bride, you are a garden locked up, a spring enclosed, a fountain sealed.
ekegusii: Moiseke ominto, omoriakari one, naye omogondo ogiteire, naye ensoko y’amaache egiteire, na entuboka emumekire na ebekire ekemanyererio.
swahili: Wewe ni bustani iliyofungwa, dada yangu, bibi arusi wangu; wewe ni chanzo cha maji kilichozungushiwa kabisa, chemchemi yangu peke yangu.

english: Your branches are an orchard of pomegranates with the choicest of fruits, with henna and nard,
ekegusii: Buna omogondo ore namakomomanga aye nigo okwama amatunda amaya mono, na ebisicha bikorokwa hena mbireo, na ebimeri bikorokwa narada,
swahili: Mimea yako ni bustani ya mikomamanga yenye matunda mazuri sana, yenye hina na nardo,

english: with nard and saffron, with calamus and cinnamon, with every kind of frankincense tree, with myrrh and aloes, with all the finest spices.
ekegusii: na ebimeri bigosegwa safarani; boigo kalamusi, na omodalasini, na emete yonsi ya ubani, na manemane, na omogaka, amo nebinsari ebiya mono.
swahili: nardo na zafarani, mchai na mdalasini, pamoja na kila aina ya mti wa uvumba, manemane na udi, na aina zote za vikolezo bora kuliko vyote.

english: You are a garden spring, a well of fresh water flowing down from Lebanon. The Bride
ekegusii: Aye nigo onga buna ensoko y’amaache are moyo ere mogondo, naende nigo onga buna chindooche chikorwa Lebanoni. (Omoriakari)
swahili: Wewe ni chemchemi ya bustani, kisima cha maji yatiririkayo, yakitiririka kutoka Lebanoni. Mpendwa

english: Awake, O north wind, and come, O south wind. Breathe on my garden and spread the fragrance of its spices. Let my beloved come into his garden and taste its choicest fruits.
ekegusii: Aye embeo ekorwa sugusu, imoka! Na aye eyekorwa Irianyi, inchwo! Gusa igoro y’omogondo one, tiga rimisu riaye rigiya rirurukigwe rirande. Tiga omwanchi one ache ase omogondo oye, arie amatunda are amaya mono.
