swahili: Amka, upepo wa kaskazini, na uje, upepo wa kusini! Vuma juu ya bustani yangu, ili harufu yake nzuri iweze kuenea mpaka ngʼambo. Mpendwa wangu na aje bustanini mwake na kuonja matunda mazuri sana.

english: Your teeth are like a flock of newly shorn sheep coming up from the washing; each has its twin, and not one of them is lost.
ekegusii: Amaino ao nigo anga ching’ondi chiaaberi chianachirwe amarionya, chiarure gosibigwa chiarabire se, chionsi nigo chikobiara chisare, na manwa ende teri gokwa.
swahili: Meno yako ni kama kundi la kondoo waliokatwa manyoya sasa hivi, watokao kuogeshwa. Kila mmoja ana pacha lake, hakuna hata mmoja aliye peke yake.

english: Your lips are like a scarlet ribbon, and your mouth is lovely. Your brow behind your veil is like a slice of pomegranate.
ekegusii: Ebikoba biao nigo binga eusi embariri, omonwa oo nigo ore oyo bw’okogokia, chinsea chiao chitubire ime ase egietubo kiao; nigo chinga buna ebing’ese bie ritunda rikorokwa rikomomanga.
swahili: Midomo yako ni kama uzi mwekundu, kinywa chako kinapendeza. Mashavu yako nyuma ya shela yako ni kama vipande viwili vya komamanga.

english: Your neck is like the tower of David, built with rows of stones; on it hang a thousand shields, all of them shields of warriors.
ekegusii: Rigoti riao nigo ringa buna omoorobiri o Daudi, oyio oagachetwe nao ebirwanero bw’esegi biare kogachwa. Agwo nao chinguba elifu eyemo chisungire, chionsi nigo chire echi’abasikari bare chituoni.
swahili: Shingo yako ni kama mnara wa Daudi, uliojengwa kwa madaha, juu yake zimetundikwa ngao elfu, zote ni ngao za mashujaa.

english: Your breasts are like two fawns, twins of a gazelle grazing among the lilies.
ekegusii: Chimbeere chiao ibere nigo chinga buna chimanwa ibere buna chisare chi’engabi chikorisia agwo ase egati y’ebisicha ebiya.
swahili: Matiti yako mawili ni kama wana-paa wawili, kama wana-paa mapacha wajilishao katikati ya yungiyungi.

english: Before the day breaks and the shadows flee, I will make my way to the mountain of myrrh and to the hill of frankincense.
ekegusii: Ekero bogochi koira na emerengari egochia gosira, ningende ase egetunwa ase manemane ekoruerwa na ase ekegoro ki’ogosambera ubani.
swahili: Hata kupambazuke na vivuli vikimbie, nitakwenda kwenye mlima wa manemane na kwenye kilima cha uvumba.

english: You are altogether beautiful, my darling; in you there is no flaw.
ekegusii: Aye omwanchi one, nigo ore omoseera bori, tori na kemoa kende!
swahili: Wewe ni mzuri kote, mpenzi wangu, hakuna hitilafu ndani yako.

english: Come with me from Lebanon, my bride, come with me from Lebanon! Descend from the peak of Amana, from the summits of Senir and Hermon, from the dens of the lions, from the mountains of the leopards.
ekegusii: Aye omoriakari one, togende torue aa Lebanoni, torue Lebanoni, togende komo. Otirimboke korwa ase egechuria ki’egetunwa ki’Amana, na ekia Seniri na Herimoni. Orue ase amakuruma e chindo, na ase ebitunwa chingo chimenyete.
swahili: Enda nami kutoka Lebanoni, bibi arusi wangu, enda nami kutoka Lebanoni. Shuka kutoka ncha ya Amana, kutoka juu ya Seniri, kilele cha Hermoni, kutoka mapango ya simba na kutoka mlima wapendapo kukaa chui.

english: You have captured my heart, my sister, my bride; you have stolen my heart with one glance of your eyes, with one jewel of your neck.
ekegusii: Aye moiseke ominto, omoriakari one, kwang’usire enkoro yane na kwangokirie, okorigereria kw’amaiso ao kwang’usire enkoro yane, ee, esonoi eyemo yoka ye chisonoi chia igoti riao yang’usire.
swahili: Umeiba moyo wangu, dada yangu, bibi arusi wangu; umeiba moyo wangu kwa mtazamo mmoja wa macho yako, kwa kito kimoja cha mkufu wako.

english: I have come to my garden, my sister, my bride; I have gathered my myrrh with my spice. I have eaten my honeycomb with my honey; I have drunk my wine with my milk. The Friends Eat, O friends, and drink; drink freely, O beloved. The Bride
ekegusii: Aye moiseke ominto, omoriakari one, nasoire ase omogondo one, ngosangereria inde manemane amo nebinsari biane bigotioka buya; nkoria inde eriana amo nobooke bwane, nkonywa inde edivai yane amo namabeere aane. (Abakungu ba Yerusalemu) Inwe abasani, ragera na monywe! Inwe abanchani, kanywe mono goika moichorwe nobwanchani! Ogoteera Gwa Kane (Omoriakari)
swahili: Nimekuja kwenye bustani yangu, dada yangu, bibi arusi wangu; nimekusanya manemane yangu pamoja na kikolezo changu. Nimekula sega langu la asali na asali yangu; nimekunywa divai yangu na maziwa yangu. Marafiki Kuleni, enyi marafiki, mnywe; kunyweni ya kutosha, ee wapenzi. Shairi La Nne Mpendwa

english: My beloved is dazzling and ruddy, outstanding among ten thousand.
ekegusii: Omwanchi one nigo are omorabu se okomeka‐meka, naende omobariri; nigo are nogwatananekana korwa ase abanto chilifu ikomi.
swahili: Mpenzi wangu anangʼaa, tena ni mwekundu, wa kuvutia miongoni mwa wanaume kumi elfu.

english: His head is purest gold; his hair is wavy and black as a raven.
ekegusii: Omotwe oye nigo ore omuya onga etaabu echenire, etukia yaye nigo ere omosamugoku bw’obwari; nigo ere emwamu ti buna amarionya ’ekegonkoru.
swahili: Kichwa chake ni dhahabu safi kuliko zote, nywele zake ni za mawimbi na ni nyeusi kama kunguru.

english: His eyes are like doves beside the streams of water, bathed in milk and mounted like jewels.
ekegusii: Amaiso aye nigo agwekaine amaruma are ase chindooche, ee, nigo anga amaruma asibigwe namabeere, naende nigo anga amagena akomeka‐meka achokire buya.
swahili: Macho yake ni kama ya hua kandokando ya vijito vya maji, aliyeogeshwa kwenye maziwa, yaliyopangwa kama vito vya thamani.

english: His cheeks are like beds of spice, towers of perfume. His lips are like lilies, dripping with flowing myrrh.
ekegusii: Chinsea chiaye nigo chinga buna ebigondo bi’ebimeri bi’ebinsari, bigotioka rimisu rigiya. Ebikoba biaye nigo binga buna ebisicha ebiya, nigo bigotonyia manemane.
swahili: Mashavu yake ni kama matuta ya vikolezo yakitoa manukato. Midomo yake ni kama yungiyungi inayodondosha manemane.

english: His arms are rods of gold set with beryl. His body is an ivory panel bedecked with sapphires.
ekegusii: Amaboko aye nigo anga buna etaabu ebombire buya, echabeire amagena akomeka‐meka. Omobere oye nigo onga buna amaino e chinchogu aroisirie buya, na gochaberwa namagena e rigori rinene akorokwa safiro.
swahili: Mikono yake ni fimbo za dhahabu iliyopambwa kwa krisolitho. Mwili wake ni kama pembe ya ndovu iliyongʼarishwa iliyopambwa na yakuti samawi.

english: His legs are pillars of marble set on bases of pure gold. His appearance is like Lebanon, as majestic as the cedars.
ekegusii: Amagoro aye nigo anga chisiiro chi’amagena amarabu se akomeka‐meka, abeekire ase chinterekerero chi’echitaabu chingiya. Okororekana kwaye nigo konga buna okwa Lebanoni, ekieni kiaye nigo kere ekiya buna eki’emecharake,
swahili: Miguu yake ni nguzo za marmar zilizosimikwa katika vitako vya dhahabu safi. Sura yake ni kama Lebanoni, bora kama miti yake ya mierezi.

english: His mouth is most sweet; he is altogether lovely. This is my beloved, and this is my friend, O daughters of Jerusalem.
ekegusii: Chinkwana chiaye nigo chire chinyansu mono, chingencho chiaye chionsi nigo chire echi’ogosanerwa mono. Inwe abasubati ba Yerusalemu, naboigo omwanchi one are, oyio ore omosani one.
swahili: Kinywa chake chenyewe ni utamu, kwa ujumla yeye ni wa kupendeza. Huyu ndiye mpenzi wangu, huyu ndiye rafiki yangu, ee binti za Yerusalemu.

english: I sleep, but my heart is awake. A sound! My beloved is knocking: “Open to me, my sister, my darling, my dove, my flawless one. My head is drenched with dew, my hair with the dampness of the night.”
ekegusii: Inche nigo narenge indaire, korende enkoro yane nigo yategesetie. Igwa! Omwanchi one oyio ogokongonta egesieri ogontura. (Omonyuomi) Moiseke ominto, omwanchi one, riruma riane na omoikeranu one, inyigorere! Inyigorere, ekiagera omotwe one otoorire riime, na etukia yane yanyiire nembura ya botuko. (Omoriakari)
swahili: Nililala lakini moyo wangu ulikuwa macho. Sikiliza! Mpenzi wangu anabisha: “Nifungulie, dada yangu, mpenzi wangu, hua wangu, asiye na hitilafu. Kichwa changu kimeloa umande, na nywele zangu manyunyu ya usiku.”

english: I have taken off my robe— must I put it back on? I have washed my feet— must I soil them again?
ekegusii: Narusirie eanga, inee, inyebeeke naende? Nesibirie amagoro, inee, inyabeeke eubi naende?
swahili: Nimevua joho langu: je, ni lazima nivae tena? Nimenawa miguu yangu: je, ni lazima niichafue tena?

english: My beloved put his hand to the latch; my heart pounded for him.
ekegusii: Erio omwanchi one akabeeka okoboko kwaye ase ekebao, erio nkaba nomosasoko omonene ime ase enkoro yane.
swahili: Mpenzi wangu aliweka mkono wake kwenye tundu la komeo; moyo wangu ulianza kugonga kwa ajili yake.

english: I rose up to open for my beloved. My hands dripped with myrrh, my fingers with flowing myrrh on the handles of the bolt.
ekegusii: Nkaimoka gochia koigorera omwanchi one, amaboko aane akanyororokia manemane, na ebiara biane bigatonyia manemane ekero nabwatete echabi yegesieri.
swahili: Niliinuka kumfungulia mpenzi wangu, mikono yangu ikidondosha manemane, vidole vyangu vikitiririka manemane, penye vipini vya komeo.

english: I opened for my beloved, but he had turned and gone. My heart sank at his departure. I sought him, but did not find him. I called, but he did not answer.
ekegusii: Ngachia koigorera omwanchi one, korende nkanyora ng’a ochiire. Omoyo one okairianyeka ekero akwanete. Nkaba nkomorigia, korende tinamonyorete. Nkamorangeria, korende taitabete.
swahili: Nilimfungulia mpenzi wangu, lakini mpenzi wangu alishaondoka; alikuwa amekwenda zake. Moyo wangu ulishuka kwa kuondoka kwake. Nilimtafuta lakini sikumpata. Nilimwita lakini hakunijibu.

english: I encountered the watchmen on their rounds of the city. They beat me and bruised me; they took away my cloak, those guardians of the walls.
ekegusii: Ekero abarendi barenge goetanana omochie koyorata, bakanyoora inche, bakang’aka chingoma; bakang’ura egetambaa gi’okwambara, abarendi baria barendete chindwaki.
swahili: Walinzi walinikuta walipokuwa wakifanya zamu za ulinzi mjini. Walinipiga, wakanijeruhi, wakaninyangʼanya joho langu, hao walinzi wa kuta!

english: O daughters of Jerusalem, I adjure you, if you find my beloved, tell him I am sick with love. The Friends
ekegusii: Inwe abasubati ba Yerusalemu, nigo nkobasorora ng’a mokonyora omwanchi one, momoteebie ng’a amaiga ’obwanchani anyaarire. (Abakungu ba Yerusalemu)
swahili: Enyi binti za Yerusalemu, ninawaagiza: kama mkimpata mpenzi wangu, mtamwambia nini? Mwambieni ninazimia kwa mapenzi. Marafiki

english: How is your beloved better than others, O most beautiful among women? How is your beloved better than another, that you charge us so? The Bride
ekegusii: Aye ore omoseera kobua abakungu bonsi, inee, omwanchi oyio oo, naki abuete abanchi bande? Ee, omwanchi oyio oo, naki abuete abanchi bande, goika gwatosoroire iga? (Omoriakari)
swahili: Je, mpendwa wako ni bora kuliko wengine namna gani, wewe uliye mzuri kupita wanawake wote? Je, mpendwa wako ni mzuri kuliko wengine, namna gani, hata unatuagiza hivyo? Mpendwa

english: Where has your beloved gone, O most beautiful among women? Which way has he turned? We will seek him with you. The Bride
ekegusii: Aye ore omoseera kobua abakungu bonsi, ng’ai omwanchi oo achiire? Omwanchi oyio oo, ng’ai aonchokire gochia? Togende amo naye tomorigie. (Omoriakari)
swahili: Mpenzi wako amekwenda wapi, ewe mzuri kupita wanawake wote? Mpenzi wako amegeukia njia ipi, tupate kumtafuta pamoja nawe? Mpendwa

english: Who is this who shines like the dawn, as fair as the moon, as bright as the sun, as majestic as the stars in procession? The Bridegroom
ekegusii: Ning’o oyio okorigereria buna erioba rigotonga mambia? Ning’o oyio ore omuya buna omotienyi, na okomeka‐meka buna erioba? Ere nigo are oyo bw’okoirokia buna abasikari babogoretie chibendera chiabo.
swahili: Ni nani huyu atokeaye kama mapambazuko, mzuri kama mwezi, mwangavu kama jua, ametukuka kama nyota zifuatanazo? Mpenzi

english: I went down to the walnut grove to see the blossoms of the valley, to see if the vines were budding or the pomegranates were in bloom.
ekegusii: Inche nigo natirimbogete gochia ase omogondo bw’emete enga buna emelozi; nkagenda ase rikura korora ebimeri ebiya buna bikoreereta, na korora gose emesabibu yachakire goseboka. Na emekomomanga gose yachakire gosicha.
swahili: Niliteremka kwenye bustani ya miti ya milozi ili kutazama machipuko ya bondeni, kuona kama mizabibu imechipua au kama mikomamanga imechanua maua.

english: Before I realized it, my desire had set me among the royal chariots of my people. The Friends
ekegusii: Ekero konya ntaramanya, omoyo one okang’ira, okambeka ase egari y’omogambi bw’abaanto baane. (Abakungu ba Yerusalemu)
swahili: Kabla sijangʼamua, shauku yangu iliniweka katikati ya magari ya kifalme ya kukokotwa na farasi ya watu wangu. Marafiki

english: Come back, come back, O Shulammite! Come back, come back, that we may gaze upon you. The Bridegroom Why do you look at the Shulammite, as on the dance of Mahanaim?
ekegusii: Irana! Irana, aye Omosulamiti! Irana! Irana, erinde tokorigererie! (Omoriakari) Nase ki mokondigereria inche Omosulamiti, buna mokorigereria ogotenga kw’ebiombe bibere bi’abasikari?
swahili: Rudi, rudi, ee Mshulami; rudi, rudi ili tupate kukutazama! Mpenzi Kwa nini kumtazama Mshulami, kama kutazama ngoma ya Mahanaimu?

english: My beloved has gone down to his garden, to the beds of spices, to pasture his flock in the gardens and to gather lilies.
ekegusii: Omwanchi one mogondo agenda, ogendire ase ebigondo bi’ebimeri bi’ebinsari. Ogendire korisia riicho riaye ase emegondo, naende nao akare kona‐gosangereria ebisicha ebiya.
swahili: Mpenzi wangu amekwenda bustanini mwake, kwenye vitalu vya vikolezo, kujilisha bustanini na kukusanya yungiyungi.

english: I belong to my beloved and he belongs to me; he pastures his flock among the lilies. The Bridegroom
ekegusii: Inche nigo inde oyo bw’omwanchi one, nere nigo are oyone; nigo akorisia riicho riaye agwo ase ebisicha ebiya bire. Ogoteera Kwa Gatano (Omonyuomi)
swahili: Mimi ni wake mpenzi wangu, na mpenzi wangu ni wangu; yeye hujilisha katikati ya yungiyungi. Shairi La Tano Mpenzi

english: You are as beautiful, my darling, as Tirzah, as lovely as Jerusalem, as majestic as troops with banners.
ekegusii: Aye omwanchi one, nigo ore omoseera buna omochie o Tirisa; nigo ore bw’okogokia buna Yerusalemu, na oyo bw’okoirokia buna abasikari babogoretie ebendera.
swahili: Wewe ni mzuri, mpenzi wangu, kama Tirsa, upendezaye kama Yerusalemu, umetukuka kama jeshi lenye bendera.

english: Turn your eyes away from me, for they have overcome me. Your hair is like a flock of goats streaming down from Gilead.
ekegusii: Onchora amaiso ao otige kondigereria, ekiagera ambuire; etukia yao nigo enga buna riicho rie chimbori, chigotirimboka ase ebitirimboko bia Gileadi.
swahili: Uyageuze macho yako mbali nami, yananigharikisha. Nywele zako ni kama kundi la mbuzi wanaoteremka kutoka Gileadi.

english: Your teeth are like a flock of sheep coming up from the washing; each has its twin, and not one of them is lost.
ekegusii: Amaino ao nigo anga riicho rie ching’ondi chiabeeri chianachirwe amarionya, chiarure gosibigwa chiarabire se, chionsi nigo chikobiara chisare, na manwa ende teri egokwa.
swahili: Meno yako ni kama kundi la kondoo watokao kuogeshwa. Kila mmoja ana pacha lake, hakuna hata mmoja aliye peke yake.

english: Your brow behind your veil is like a slice of pomegranate.
ekegusii: Chinsea chiao nigo chitubire ime ase egietubo kiao, nigo chinga buna chimbaara chie ritunda rikorokwa rikomomanga.
swahili: Mashavu yako nyuma ya shela yako ni kama vipande viwili vya komamanga.

english: There are sixty queens and eighty concubines, and maidens without number,
ekegusii: Mbareo abakungu chiting’ana chi’omorwoti emerongo etano nomo, na abakungu ba sere‐sere emerongo etano na etato, boigo mbareo abaiseke abekungi abange batari kobareka.
swahili: Panaweza kuwepo malkia sitini, masuria themanini na mabikira wasiohesabika;

english: but my dove, my perfect one, is unique, the favorite of the mother who bore her. The maidens see her and call her blessed; the queens and concubines sing her praises. The Friends
ekegusii: Korende oyomo bweka nere omwanchi one, nere riruma riane omoikeranu. Ere nigo are omwana omomoima ng’ina abwate, oyo omoiborete nigo amwanchete. Abaiseke abwo bakamorora, bakamoroka oyosesenirie; abakungu baria chiting’ana na baria ba sere‐sere boigo bakamorora, bakamotogia.
swahili: lakini hua wangu, mkamilifu wangu, ni wa namna ya pekee, binti pekee kwa mama yake, kipenzi cha yeye aliyemzaa. Wanawali walimwona na kumwita aliyebarikiwa; malkia na masuria walimsifu. Marafiki

english: How beautiful are your sandaled feet, O daughter of the prince! The curves of your thighs are like jewels, the handiwork of a master.
ekegusii: Aye omoiseke bw’omogambi, naki ebisanyi bi’amagoro ao bire ebiya ase ebikoroto ime! Naki ebibwato biao bimerete buya, nigo bire buna emeremo y’omooroisia omong’aini.
swahili: Ee binti wa mwana wa mfalme, tazama jinsi inavyopendeza miguu yako katika viatu! Miguu yako yenye madaha ni kama vito vya thamani, kazi ya mikono ya fundi stadi.

english: I belong to my beloved, and his desire is for me.
ekegusii: Inche nigo inde oyo bw’omwanchi one, ere nigo are namaiga ase ’nde.
swahili: Mimi ni mali ya mpenzi wangu, nayo shauku yake ni juu yangu.

english: Come, my beloved, let us go to the countryside; let us spend the night among the wildflowers.
ekegusii: Aye omwanchi one, inchwo togende ase amaremo aito, tobeere ase emechie botuko,
swahili: Njoo, mpenzi wangu, twende mashambani, twende tukalale huko vijijini.

english: Let us go early to the vineyards to see if the vine has budded, if the blossom has opened, if the pomegranates are in bloom— there I will give you my love.
ekegusii: toimoke mambia chuni togende ase emegondo y’emesabibu, torore gose yachakire goseboka, naende gose amasabibu amanokire na gosicha, boigo gose amakomomanga asichire. Aroro agwo ninkoboanie nobwanchani bwane.
swahili: Hebu na twende mapema katika mashamba ya mizabibu tuone kama mizabibu imechipua, kama maua yake yamefunguka, na kama mikomamanga imetoa maua: huko nitakupa penzi langu.

english: The mandrakes send forth a fragrance, and at our door is every delicacy, new as well as old, that I have treasured up for you, my beloved.
ekegusii: Aye omwanchi one, amatunda amansu nigo agotioka rimisu rigiya mono, na igoro y’ebisieri biaito nareo amatunda ao ao are amaya mono, amakoro na amayia; ayio nasangereirie ase ogokogachera.
swahili: Mitunguja hutoa harufu zake nzuri, kwenye milango yetu kuna matunda mazuri, mapya na ya zamani, ambayo nimekuhifadhia wewe, mpenzi wangu.

english: Your navel is a rounded goblet; it never lacks blended wine. Your waist is a mound of wheat encircled by the lilies.
ekegusii: Ekenyobu kiao nigo keborongosire buya buna egetaabo getari koererwa edivai yochoganirie. Enda yao nigo ere buna etui y’engano, eetananeirie ebisicha ebiya.
swahili: Kitovu chako ni kama bilauri ya mviringo ambayo kamwe haikosi divai iliyochanganywa. Kiuno chako ni kichuguu cha ngano kilichozungukwa kwa yungiyungi.

english: Your breasts are like two fawns, twins of a gazelle.
ekegusii: Chimbeere chiao nigo chinga buna chimanwa ibere chire chisare chi’engabi.
swahili: Matiti yako ni kama wana-paa wawili, mapacha wa paa.

english: Your neck is like a tower made of ivory; your eyes are like the pools of Heshbon by the gate of Bath-rabbim; your nose is like the tower of Lebanon, facing toward Damascus.
ekegusii: Rigoti riao nigo ringa buna omoorobiri oroiseirie amaino e chinchogu, amaiso ao nigo anga buna amatibo a Hesiboni, ang’e negeita kia Bati‐Rabimu. Emioro yao nigo enga buna omoorobiri o Lebanoni orochie Damesiki.
swahili: Shingo yako ni kama mnara wa pembe ya ndovu. Macho yako ni vidimbwi vya Heshboni karibu na lango la Beth-Rabi. Pua lako ni kama mnara wa Lebanoni ukitazama kuelekea Dameski.

english: Your head crowns you like Mount Carmel, the hair of your head like purple threads; the king is captured in your tresses.
ekegusii: Omotwe oo nigo osongoire buna egetunwa gia Karimeli. Etukia y’omotwe oo ekona‐gosanyoka nigo ere ekieni kemonyinga; eyio yang’usire omorwoti.
swahili: Kichwa chako kinakuvika taji kama mlima Karmeli. Nywele zako ni kama zulia la urujuani; mfalme ametekwa na mashungi yake.

english: How fair and pleasant you are, O love, with your delights!
ekegusii: Naki aye ore omoseera naende oyo bw’okogokia mono! Aye omwanchi bw’okogokia!
swahili: Tazama jinsi ulivyo mzuri na unavyopendeza, ee pendo, kwa uzuri wako!

english: Your stature is like a palm tree; your breasts are clusters of fruit.
ekegusii: Aye nigo okinete buna omokendo, ne chimbeere chiao nigo chire buna ebisago bi’amasabibu.
swahili: Umbo lako ni kama la mtende, nayo matiti yako kama vishada vya matunda.

english: I said, “I will climb the palm tree; I will take hold of its fruit.” May your breasts be like clusters of the vine, the fragrance of your breath like apples,
ekegusii: Nkarengereria: Nkoriina inde omokendo oyo, imbwaterere chinsagia chiaye. Naki yare koba buya onye chimbeere chiao nchiaba buna ebisago bi’amasabibu, ne rimisu ri’omonwa oo ribe buna eri’amapera,
swahili: Nilisema, “Nitakwea mtende, nami nitayashika matunda yake.” Matiti yako na yawe kama vishada vya mzabibu, harufu nzuri ya pumzi yako kama matofaa,

english: and your mouth like the finest wine. The Bride May it flow smoothly to my beloved, gliding gently over lips and teeth.
ekegusii: na omonwa oo obe buna edivai ere engiya mono. (Omoriakari) Ee, edivai eyio nigo egetirimboka gochia ime y’omwanchi one, naende yanyororoka ng’ora ng’ora, yakuna ebikoba bi’abwo baraire.
swahili: na kinywa chako kama divai bora kuliko zote. Mpendwa Divai na iende moja kwa moja hadi kwa mpenzi wangu, ikitiririka polepole juu ya midomo na meno.

english: O that you were to me like a brother who nursed at my mother’s breasts! If I found you outdoors, I would kiss you, and no one would despise me.
ekegusii: Onye ndiria kwarenge koba momura ominto, kwagongete orobeere rwa baba! Onye ndiria naumeranete naye isiko, nanga nigo nare gokonyunyunta, na onde tare gonchaya.
swahili: Laiti ungelikuwa kwangu kama ndugu wa kiume, ambaye aliyanyonya matiti ya mama yangu! Kisha, kama ningekukuta huko nje, ningelikubusu, wala hakuna mtu yeyote angelinidharau.

english: I am a wall, and my breasts are like towers. So I have become in his eyes like one who brings peace.
ekegusii: Inche nigo inde orwaki, ne chimbeere chiane nigo chinga buna emerobiri; ase ayio nkaba ase amaiso aye buna oyo onyorire omorembe. (Omonyuomi)
swahili: Mimi ni ukuta, nayo matiti yangu ni kama minara. Ndivyo ambavyo nimekuwa machoni pake kama yule anayeleta utoshelevu.

english: Solomon had a vineyard in Baal-hamon. He leased it to the tenants. For its fruit, each was to bring a thousand shekels of silver.
ekegusii: Sulemani nabwate omogondo bw’emesabibu agwo Baali‐Hamoni, akayotigera abarendi, na kera omorendi nigo arenge korenta chitaabu chi’echifeta elifu eyemo goakanera amatunda.
swahili: Solomoni alikuwa na shamba la mizabibu huko Baal-Hamoni; alikodisha shamba lake la mizabibu kwa wapangaji. Kila mmoja angeleta kwa ajili ya matunda yake shekeli 1,000 za fedha.

english: But my own vineyard is mine to give; the thousand shekels are for you, O Solomon, and two hundred are for those who tend its fruit. The Bridegroom
ekegusii: Korende omogondo bw’emesabibu oyore oyone bori ninche omonyene nyorendete. Aye Sulemani, ira chilifu chiao, na abarendi b’amatunda baire amagana abere.
swahili: Lakini shamba langu la mizabibu ambalo ni langu mwenyewe ni langu kutoa; hizo shekeli 1,000 ni kwa ajili yako, ee Solomoni, na shekeli mia mbili ni kwa ajili ya wale wanaotunza matunda yake. Mpenzi

english: You who dwell in the gardens, my companions are listening for your voice. Let me hear it! The Bride
ekegusii: Aye oria omenyete ase emegondo, abagisangio baane nigo bategererete baigwe eriogi riao, tiga nainche indiigwe. (Omoriakari)
swahili: Wewe ukaaye bustanini pamoja na marafiki mliohudhuria, hebu nisikie sauti yako! Mpendwa

english: Come away, my beloved, and be like a gazelle or a young stag on the mountains of spices.
ekegusii: Aye omwanchi one, minyoka bwango, obe buna engabi gose ensune ensae ekominyoka igoro ase ebitunwa bire nebimeri bigotioka buya.
swahili: Njoo, mpenzi wangu, uwe kama swala au kama ayala kijana juu ya milima iliyojaa vikolezo.

english: I would lead you and bring you to the house of my mother who taught me. I would give you spiced wine to drink, the nectar of my pomegranates.
ekegusii: Nigo nanga nakorentete mwa baba, obe gokonyorokereria. Nigo nare gocha gokoa onywe edivai yochoganirie ebinsari, naende nkoe amaache amitire korwa ase amakomomanga aane.
swahili: Ningelikuongoza na kukuleta katika nyumba ya mama yangu, yeye ambaye amenifundisha. Ningelikupa divai iliyokolezwa unywe, asali ya maua ya mikomamanga yangu.

english: His left hand is under my head, and his right arm embraces me.
ekegusii: Okoboko kwaye kwa bomosi nigo kore inse y’omotwe one, na okwa borio komboanetie.
swahili: Mkono wake wa kushoto uko chini ya kichwa changu, na mkono wake wa kuume unanikumbatia.

english: O daughters of Jerusalem, I adjure you: Do not arouse or awaken love until the time is right. The Friends
ekegusii: Inwe abasubati ba Yerusalemu, nigo nkobasorora na kobatiania ng’a timobaisa gotabobora obwanchani na koboichania, goika bobe bwancheranire obonyene. Ogoteera Kwa Gatano na Rimo (Abakungu ba Yerusalemu)
swahili: Binti za Yerusalemu, ninawaagiza: msichochee wala kuamsha mapenzi hata yatakapotaka yenyewe. Shairi La Sita Marafiki

english: Who is this coming up from the wilderness, leaning on her beloved? The Bride I roused you under the apple tree; there your mother conceived you; there she travailed and brought you forth.
ekegusii: Monto ki oria ogotiira gocha aa korwa ase erooro, oyio bweegegete omwanchi oye? (Omoriakari) Agwo inse y’omote bw’amapera inche nigo nagoturete oboke. Aroro agwo nyoko nigo arenge nobororo bw’okobina akoibore, ee, agwo nao nyoko akoiborerete ore nobororo.
swahili: Ni nani huyu anayekuja kutoka nyikani akimwegemea mpenzi wake? Mpendwa Nilikuamsha chini ya mtofaa, huko mama yako alipotunga mimba yako, huko yeye alipata utungu akakuzaa.

english: Set me as a seal over your heart, as a seal upon your arm. For love is as strong as death, its jealousy as unrelenting as Sheol. Its sparks are fiery flames, the fiercest blaze of all.
ekegusii: Imbeke ase enkoro yao imbe buna ebonyi ere nekemanyererio, ee, buna ebonyi ere nekemanyererio ase okoboko kwao. Obwanchani nigo bore ne chinguru buna amakweri, ne ribero nigo rire ritindi buna embeera. Ogwoka kw’obwanchani nigo konga ebibemberi bi’omorero, ee, nekebemberi gekorwa ase Omonene.
swahili: Nitie kama muhuri moyoni mwako, kama muhuri kwenye mkono wako; kwa maana upendo una nguvu kama mauti, wivu wake ni mkatili kama kuzimu. Unachoma kama mwali wa moto, kama mwali mkubwa wa moto wa Bwana hasa.

english: Mighty waters cannot quench love; rivers cannot sweep it away. If a man were to give all the wealth of his house for love, his offer would be utterly scorned. The Friends
ekegusii: Amaache are amange mono takonyara gokendia obwanchani, gose chindooche tichikonyara koboiranana. Omonto naisa korua obotenenku bwonsi bw’enyomba yaye konyora obwanchani, oyio nigo arachaywe. (Abamura bamwabo omoriakari)
swahili: Maji mengi hayawezi kuuzimisha upendo, mito haiwezi kuugharikisha. Kama mtu angelitoa mali yote ya nyumbani mwake kwa ajili ya upendo, angelidharauliwa kabisa. Marafiki

english: We have a little sister, and her breasts are not yet grown. What shall we do for our sister on the day she is spoken for?
ekegusii: Intwe ntobwate omoiseke ominto ore omoke, korende tabwati mbeere; ekero engaki yaye erache akorigigwa anyuomwe, ninki torakorere omoiseke oyio ominto?
swahili: Tunaye dada mdogo, matiti yake hayajakua bado. Tutafanya nini kwa ajili ya dada yetu wakati atakapokuja kuposwa?

english: If she is a wall, we will build a tower of silver to protect her. If she is a door, we will enclose her with panels of cedar. The Bride
ekegusii: Ere karabe orwaki, ntoagache igoro yaye omoorobiri oroiseirie efeta, korende karabe egesieri, rirorio ntomosiekere ne chibao chi’emecharake. (Omoriakari)
swahili: Kama yeye ni ukuta, tutajenga minara ya fedha juu yake. Na kama yeye ni mlango, tutamzungushia mbao za mierezi. Mpendwa

english: Paul, a servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ for the faith of God’s elect and their knowledge of the truth that leads to godliness,
ekegusii: Inche Paulo nomosomba o Nyasae, na omotomwa o Yeso Kristo. Inche nigo narangeretigwe naboigo gotomwa ogokonya okwegena kw’abachoore ba Nyasae, erinde baike ase ayare ay’ekeene, ayio akworokererigwa ase okwegena gwaito,
swahili: Paulo, mtumishi wa Mungu na mtume wa Yesu Kristo kwa ajili ya imani ya wateule wa Mungu na kuijua kweli iletayo utauwa:

english: For many are rebellious and full of empty talk and deception, especially those of the circumcision,
ekegusii: Inaki mbare abange, mono korwa ase Abayahudi baria baonchokire batari koigwera, abagokwana amang’ana atari nengeencho, abakong’aina abande ase ayio.
swahili: Kwa maana wako wengi wasiotii, wenye maneno yasiyo na maana, hasa wale wa kikundi cha tohara.

english: who must be silenced. For the sake of dishonorable gain, they undermine entire households and teach things they should not.
ekegusii: Abwo mbagwenerete bakirigwe, ekiagera nkoonchorana bare abanto b’echinyomba chingima ase okworokereria aya’atagwenereti, naende ase obosooku, barabwo nigo bakorigia kwenyorera chitaabu.
swahili: Hao ni lazima wanyamazishwe, kwa sababu wanaharibu watu wa nyumba nzima wakifundisha mambo yasiyowapasa kufundisha. Wanafanya hivyo kwa ajili ya kujipatia mapato ya udanganyifu.

english: As one of their own prophets has said, “Cretans are always liars, evil beasts, lazy gluttons.”
ekegusii: Omonto oyomo obo Omokirete, omobani obo abanyene, oteebire, “Abanto ba Kirete nabanyaborimo botambe, ne ching’iti chintindi chi’orosana, abaribobe aboro.”
swahili: Hata mmojawapo wa manabii wao mwenyewe amesema, “Wakrete ni waongo siku zote, wanyama wabaya, walafi, wavivu.”

english: This testimony is true. Therefore rebuke them sternly, so that they will be sound in the faith
ekegusii: Ase igo nekogwenerete kobatogonyera bokong’u erio batware okwegena kore buya.
swahili: Ushuhuda huu ni kweli. Kwa hiyo, uwakemee kwa ukali wapate kuwa wazima katika imani,

english: and will pay no attention to Jewish myths or to the commands of men who have rejected the truth.
ekegusii: Naende totwara ribaga ri’ogotegerera emegano y’Abayahudi, gose amachiiko y’abanto abwo bakwanga ekeene.
swahili: ili wasiendelee kuangalia hadithi za Kiyahudi au maagizo ya wale watu wanaoikataa kweli.

english: To the pure, all things are pure; but to the defiled and unbelieving, nothing is pure. Indeed, both their minds and their consciences are defiled.
ekegusii: Ebinto bionsi nebichenu ase abwo bare abachenu, korende tikeri ekere egechenu ase abwo batachenegeti na abategeneti, ekiagera ebirengererio biabo na okomanya gwe chinkoro chiabo ime biabeire ebitachenegeti.
swahili: Kwa wale walio safi, kila kitu ni safi kwao. Lakini kwa wale waliopotoka na wasioamini, hakuna chochote kilicho safi. Kwa kweli nia zao na dhamiri zao zimepotoka.

english: They profess to know God, but by their actions they deny Him. They are detestable, disobedient, and unfit for any good deed.
ekegusii: Barabwo nigo bagoteeba ng’a mbamomanyete Nyasae, korende ase ogokora kwabo bagekaana. Nigo bare abokogeechia, abatari koigwera, na ase ayio tibakonyaara gokora ogokora konde gwonsi okuya.
swahili: Wanadai kumjua Mungu, lakini kwa matendo yao wanamkana. Hao watu ni chukizo, wasiotii, wasiofaa kwa jambo lolote jema.

english: in the hope of eternal life, which God, who cannot lie, promised before time began.
ekegusii: ekio keigekire ase ogosemeria kw’obogima bwa kare na kare. Obogima obo Nyasae ariete eira korwa kare na kare.
swahili: imani na ujuzi ulioko katika tumaini la uzima wa milele, ambao Mungu, asiyesema uongo, aliahidi hata kabla ya kuwekwa misingi ya ulimwengu,

english: In His own time He has made His word evident in the proclamation entrusted to me by the command of God our Savior.
ekegusii: Na ekero engaki yaye yaigete akabomaanora ase ring’ana riaye, eri inche negenirwe korandia ase ogochika kwa Nyasae, Omotooria oito.
swahili: naye kwa wakati wake aliouweka alilidhihirisha neno lake kwa njia ya mahubiri ambayo mimi nimewekewa amana kwa amri ya Mungu Mwokozi wetu:

english: To Titus, my true child in our common faith: Grace and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Savior. Appointing Elders on Crete (1 Timothy 3:1–7; 1 Peter 5:1–4)
ekegusii: Ngokoriikera nde aye Tito, omwana one bori ase okwegena tosangete naye: Obuya na omorembe bikorwa ase Nyasae Tata, na ase Kristo Yeso, Omotooria oito. Emeremo ya Tito aria Kirete
swahili: Kwa Tito, mwanangu hasa katika imani tunayoshiriki sote: Neema iwe kwako na amani itokayo kwa Mungu Baba na kwa Kristo Yesu Mwokozi wetu. Kazi Ya Tito Huko Krete

english: The reason I left you in Crete was that you would set in order what was unfinished and appoint elders in every town, as I directed you.
ekegusii: Nkagotiga Kirete, erinde oroisie aria aganetie gokorwa erio ochore abagaaka ime ase kera omochie. Inyora buna nagochigeete.
swahili: Sababu ya mimi kukuacha huko Krete ni ili uweke utaratibu mambo yale yaliyosalia na kuwaweka wazee wa kanisa katika kila mji, kama nilivyokuagiza.

english: An elder must be blameless, the husband of but one wife, having children who are believers and who are not open to accusation of indiscretion or insubordination.
ekegusii: Omogaka goika abe omoikeranu; abe ore n’omokuungu oyomo, na ore nabana begenete, batari gosoerwa ng’a nabanyaka bare, gose abatari koigwera.
swahili: Mzee wa kanisa asiwe na lawama, awe mume wa mke mmoja, mtu ambaye watoto wake ni waaminio na wala hawashtakiwi kwa ufisadi.

english: As God’s steward, an overseer must be above reproach—not self-absorbed, not quick-tempered, not given to drunkenness, not violent, not greedy for money.
ekegusii: Ase engencho omotang’ani bw’ekanisa agotenera ebire ebia Nyasae, ere abe omoikeranu. Ere taaba omonto omoenenu, gose omwango bw’okobea, gose oy’ogotinda, gose omonto bwanchete goaka abanto, gose rinyandambe ase okonyora chitaabu.
swahili: Kwa kuwa mwangalizi, kama wakili wa Mungu, imempasa kuwa mtu asiye na lawama, asiwe mwenye majivuno au mwepesi wa hasira, wala mlevi, wala asiwe mtu mwenye tamaa ya mapato yasiyo ya halali.

english: Instead, he must be hospitable, a lover of good, self-controlled, upright, holy, and disciplined.
ekegusii: Korende abe omooroisia abageni, oyobwanchete amaya, oyobwerendete ase onsi, omooronge, omochenu, na oy’omanyete kweriita ase onsi.
swahili: Bali awe mkarimu, anayependa mema, mwenye kiasi, mwenye haki, mwadilifu, mnyofu, mtakatifu na mwenye kuitawala nafsi yake.

english: He must hold firmly to the faithful word as it was taught, so that he can encourage others by sound teaching and refute those who contradict it. Correcting False Teachers (1 Timothy 1:3–11)
ekegusii: Ere nigo emogwenerete abwate ring’ana ri’ekeene buna riorokereretigwe, erinde anyare koremia abanto ase okworokereria gw’ekeene, na korongeyia abakoengererania nario.
swahili: Inampasa alishike kwa uthabiti lile neno la imani kama lilivyofundishwa, kusudi aweze kuwaonya wengine kwa mafundisho manyofu na kuwakanusha wale wanaopingana nayo. Walimu Wa Uongo

english: But as for you, speak the things that are consistent with sound doctrine.
ekegusii: Korende aye, nekobetereretie gokwana amang’ana agwenerete okworokereria gw’okwegena.
swahili: Inakupasa kufundisha itikadi sahihi.

english: not stealing from them, but showing all good faith, so that in every respect they will adorn the teaching about God our Savior. God’s Grace Brings Salvation
ekegusii: tibaaba abakobaibera. Korende babaorokie obwegenwa obuya ase onsi, erinde ase amang’ana onsi yogokora kwabo abe ekiorokererio ekiya gi’okworokereria kwa Nyasae, Omotooria oito.
swahili: wala wasiwaibie, bali waonyeshe kuwa wanaweza kuaminika kabisa, ili kwa kila namna wayafanye mafundisho ya Mungu Mwokozi wetu yawe ya kuvutia.

english: For the grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation to everyone.
ekegusii: Inaki Nyasae oorokriie obuya bwaye ase ogotooreka ase Mwanyabaanto bonsi.
swahili: Kwa maana neema ya Mungu ambayo inawaokoa wanadamu wote imefunuliwa.

english: It instructs us to renounce ungodliness and worldly passions, and to live sensible, upright, and godly lives in the present age,
ekegusii: Obo nigo bogotworokereria okwanga amang’ana atari y’obonyasae ase obomenyo bwaito, na okogania okobe gw’ense eye, erinde tonyaare kwerenda ase onsi, na koba noboronge amo ne chingeencho chi’obonyasae ime ase ense eye,
swahili: Nayo yatufundisha kukataa ubaya na tamaa za kidunia, ili tupate kuishi maisha ya kiasi, ya haki na ya utaua katika ulimwengu huu wa sasa,

english: as we await the blessed hope and glorious appearance of our great God and Savior Jesus Christ.
ekegusii: gatoganyete ogoikeranigwa ogosemeria kwe Rituko Risesenirie, na okooroka kw’obonene bwa Nyasae omonene, na Omotooria oito Kristo Yeso,
swahili: huku tukilitazamia tumaini lenye baraka na ufunuo wa utukufu wa Mungu wetu Mkuu, aliye Mwokozi wetu Yesu Kristo.

english: He gave Himself for us to redeem us from all lawlessness and to purify for Himself a people for His own possession, zealous for good deeds.
ekegusii: Ere omonyene oyobweruete ase engencho yaito, erinde atoboorie korwa ase ogosaria gwonsi, naboigo gotosibia ere omonyene abanto babe abaye, bare nomokia ase ogokora okuya.
swahili: Ndiye alijitoa nafsi yake kwa ajili yetu, ili atukomboe kutoka uovu wote na kujisafishia watu kuwa mali yake Mwenyewe, yaani, wale walio na juhudi katika kutenda mema.

english: Speak these things as you encourage and rebuke with all authority. Let no one despise you.
ekegusii: Kwana amang’ana aya, ase okobua gwonsi ore nakwo, kuurera, na gotogonyera abategereri bao. Tibwanchera omonto onde bwensi agochaaye.
swahili: Basi wewe fundisha mambo haya. Onya na kukaripia kwa mamlaka yote. Mtu yeyote asikudharau.

english: Older men are to be temperate, dignified, self-controlled, and sound in faith, love, and perseverance.
ekegusii: Oorokererie abagaaka babe aberiiti, abare n’ogosika, aberendete ase onsi, babe abagima ase okwegena, ase obwanchani, na ase oboremereria.
swahili: Wafundishe wazee kuwa na kiasi, wastahivu, wenye busara na wanyofu katika imani, upendo na saburi.

english: Older women, likewise, are to be reverent in their behavior, not slanderers or addicted to much wine, but teachers of good.
ekegusii: Naboigo oorokererie abakungu abagotu babe norogendo rw’obochenu, tibaaba abang’aachi, gose abasomba gochia ase edivai. Yababetereirie barabwo babe aborokia b’ayare amaya,
swahili: Vivyo hivyo, wafundishe wanawake wazee kuwa na mwenendo wa utakatifu, wala wasiwe wasingiziaji au walevi, bali wafundishe yale yaliyo mema,

english: In this way they can train the young women to love their husbands and children,
ekegusii: erinde borokererie abakungu abake banche abasacha babo, na abana babo.
swahili: ili waweze kuwafundisha wanawake vijana kuwa na kiasi, wawapende waume zao na kuwapenda watoto wao,

english: to be self-controlled, pure, managers of their households, kind, and submissive to their own husbands, so that the word of God will not be discredited.
ekegusii: Naende babe aberendete ase onsi, abachenu, abagokora emeremo ase chinka chiabo, abaya, abaigwerete abasacha babo abanyene, erinde ring’ana ria Nyasae tiriramwa nonde bwensi.
swahili: wawe waaminifu, watakatifu, wakitunza vyema nyumba zao, wema, watiifu kwa waume zao, ili mtu yeyote asije akalikufuru neno la Mungu.

english: In the same way, urge the younger men to be self-controlled.
ekegusii: Naboigo, obasorore abamura babe aberiti ase onsi.
swahili: Vivyo hivyo, himiza vijana wawe na kiasi.

english: In everything, show yourself to be an example by doing good works. In your teaching show integrity, dignity,
ekegusii: Ase amang’ana onsi, aye omonyene bweorokie koba ekiorokererio ki’ogokora okuya. Okwane ayare ekeene na kworokereria nokwerwa gwonsi.
swahili: Katika kila jambo uwe kielelezo kwa kutenda mema. Katika mafundisho yako uonyeshe uadilifu, utaratibu,

english: and wholesome speech that is above reproach, so that anyone who opposes us will be ashamed to have nothing bad to say about us.
ekegusii: Ogokwana kwao kobe ogoikeranu, okwo gotanyaare gosoerwa, erinde omoengereria onde bwensi asooke, taaba ne ring’ana riibe agokwana igoro yaito.
swahili: na usemi sahihi usio na lawama, ili wanaokupinga watahayari, wakose neno lolote baya la kusema juu yetu.

english: Slaves are to submit to their own masters in everything, to be well-pleasing, not argumentative,
ekegusii: Abasomba mbagwenerete baigwere naboigo kobagokia abanene babo ase amang’ana onsi, na tibaaba abakobairaneria bobe,
swahili: Wafundishe watumwa kuwatii mabwana zao katika kila jambo, wakijitahidi kuwapendeza wala wasijibizane nao,

english: Remind the believers to submit to rulers and authorities, to be obedient and ready for every good work,
ekegusii: Oinyorie abanto bao bekeyie ase abagaambi, na ase abare nokobua, naende babe abaigweri, ase kera enchera bebeke ang’e gokora ogokora okuya.
swahili: Wakumbushe watu kuwanyenyekea watawala na kuwatii wenye mamlaka, wawe tayari kutenda kila lililo jema.

english: Reject a divisive man after a first and second admonition,
ekegusii: Omoe omonto oraarente okweatanana ogokuurera goika kabere, korwa agwo, aye tobaisa koba n’ering’ana rinde asare ere.
swahili: Mtu anayesababisha mafarakano, mwonye mara ya kwanza, kisha mwonye mara ya pili. Baada ya hapo, usihusike naye tena.

english: knowing that such a man is corrupt and sinful; he is self-condemned. Final Remarks and Greetings
ekegusii: Nomanyete buna omonto onga buna oyio nomosareku, naende ebibe biaye biamwatananire, nere omonyene bwegaambirie. Ogotebereria ase y’ogokoorera
swahili: Kwa kuwa unajua kwamba mtu kama huyo amepotoka na tena ni mwenye dhambi. Yeye amejihukumu mwenyewe. Maneno Ya Mwisho Na Kumtamkia Baraka

english: As soon as I send Artemas or Tychicus to you, make every effort to come to me at Nicopolis, because I have decided to winter there.
ekegusii: Kondatome Artemas gose Tukiko gocha ase ore, teema buna oranyaare gocha ase ’nde aria Nikopoli bwango, inaki nindengereretie komenya aroro ekero gi’etoigo.
swahili: Mara nitakapomtuma Artema au Tikiko kwako, jitahidi kuja unione huko Nikopoli, kwa sababu nimeamua kukaa huko wakati wa majira ya baridi.

english: Do your best to equip Zenas the lawyer and Apollos, so that they will have everything they need.
ekegusii: Kora omokia gokoonya Zena, omonogeri bw’amachiiko, na Apolo, ekero okobatoma ase orogeendo rw’abo, na origererie buya ng’a ’mbabwate kera ekemo keria baganetie.
swahili: Fanya kila uwezalo uwasafirishe Zena yule mwanasheria na Apolo na uhakikishe kwamba wana kila kitu wanachohitaji katika safari yao.

english: And our people must also learn to devote themselves to good works in order to meet the pressing needs of others, so that they will not be unfruitful.
ekegusii: Na abanto baito tiga beorokererie kwerua ase ogokora okuya, na gokoonya aase oboremerwa bore ase ekeene, erinde tibaaba abataisaini kende gionsi.
swahili: Watu wetu hawana budi kujifunza kutenda mema, ili waweze kuyakimu mahitaji ya kila siku, wasije wakaishi maisha yasiyokuwa na matunda.

english: All who are with me send you greetings. Greet those who love us in the faith. Grace be with all of you.
ekegusii: Aba bonsi bare amo nainche bagokwanirie. Tokwanerie baria abasani baito ase okwegena. Obuya bwa Nyasae Omobui bobe ase more mwensi. Obuya bobe amo nainwe mwensi.
swahili: Wote walio pamoja nami wanakusalimu. Wasalimu wale wanaotupenda katika imani. Neema iwe nanyi nyote. Amen.

english: to malign no one, and to be peaceable and gentle, showing full consideration to everyone.
ekegusii: Obateebie tibakwana bobe igoro ya monto onde bwensi, korende barabwo babe abanto b’omorembe n’obosaani, babe abaremereria naende abakoorokia obwororo ase abanto bonsi.
swahili: Wasimnenee mtu yeyote mabaya, wasiwe wagomvi, bali wawe wapole, wakionyesha unyenyekevu kwa watu wote.

english: For at one time we too were foolish, disobedient, misled, and enslaved to all sorts of desires and pleasures—living in malice and envy, being hated and hating one another.
ekegusii: Inaki agwo ritang’ani naintwe nigo twarenge abariri, abaenenu, na abang’ainegete. Nigo twarenge abosomba b’okogania okobe gwe chingeencho ao ao ase okwegokia. Tokamenya ase obobe n’emoko, tokogeechigwa na kogeechana.
swahili: Maana sisi wenyewe wakati fulani tulikuwa wajinga, wasiotii, tukiwa watumwa wa tamaa mbaya na anasa za kila aina. Tuliishi katika uovu na wivu, tukichukiwa na kuchukiana sisi kwa sisi.

english: But when the kindness of God our Savior and His love for mankind appeared,
ekegusii: Korende ekero oboitongo na obwanchani bwa Nyasae, Omotooria oito bwaorogetigwe,
swahili: Lakini wema na upendo wa Mungu Mwokozi wetu ulipofunuliwa,

english: He saved us, not by the righteous deeds we had done, but according to His mercy, through the washing of new birth and renewal by the Holy Spirit.
ekegusii: ere agatotooria, tari ase ogokora kw’oboronge twakorete intwe, korende ase amaabera aye ere omonyene ogosibigwa goetera ase Omoika Omochenu oyio ogotoa okoiborwa okoyia, na obogima oboyia.
swahili: alituokoa, si kwa sababu ya matendo ya haki tuliyotenda, bali kwa sababu ya rehema zake. Alituokoa kwa kutuosha kwa kuzaliwa mara ya pili na kwa kufanywa wapya kwa njia ya Roho Mtakatifu,

english: This is the Spirit He poured out on us abundantly through Jesus Christ our Savior,
ekegusii: Oyo atoitererete Omoika Omochenu ase obonge goetera ase Yeso Kristo, Omotooria oito,
swahili: ambaye Mungu alitumiminia kwa wingi kwa njia ya Yesu Kristo Mwokozi wetu,

english: so that, having been justified by His grace, we would become heirs with the hope of eternal life.
ekegusii: erinde obuya bwaye, tonyore oboronge ase ere Nyasae Omobui erio, tonyaare koba abanyamwando b’obogima bwa kare na kare, obwo tosemeretie.
swahili: ili kwamba, tukiisha kuhesabiwa haki kwa neema yake, tupate kuwa warithi tukiwa na tumaini la uzima wa milele.

english: This saying is trustworthy. And I want you to emphasize these things, so that those who have believed God will take care to devote themselves to good deeds. These things are excellent and profitable for the people. Avoid Divisions (Romans 16:17–20)
ekegusii: Ring’ana eri neri’ekeene. Igoro y’amang’ana ayio nindigetie oyakwane ne chinguru, erinde abwo bamwegenete Nyasae banyaare kwerua ase ogokora okuya. Amang’ana aya namaya, naende nanyare gokoonya abanto bonsi.
swahili: Hili ni neno la kuaminiwa. Nami nataka uyasisitize mambo haya, ili wale ambao wamemwamini Mungu wapate kuwa waangalifu kujitoa kwa ajili ya kutenda mema wakati wote. Mambo haya ni mazuri tena ya manufaa kwa kila mtu.

english: But avoid foolish controversies, genealogies, arguments, and quarrels about the law, because these things are pointless and worthless.
ekegusii: Korende aye, bweatanane korwa ase amaborio y’oboriri, n’omoroberio omotambe bwe chinderia chi’echisokoro, na eriomana, na okoamererania igoro y’amachiiko, ekiagera tibigokoonya kende, naende tibiri nengeencho.
swahili: Lakini jiepushe na maswali ya kipuzi, mambo ya koo, mabishano na ugomvi kuhusu sheria, kwa sababu hayana faida, tena ni ubatili.

english: Ask the LORD for rain in springtime; the LORD makes the storm clouds, and He will give everyone showers of rain and crops in the field.
ekegusii: Inwe saba Omonene abatwerie embura y’okwamia endagera ase engaki yaye. Omonene natonge amare akomesa, na atwerie abanto embura na koa kera oyomo endagera korwa mogondo.
swahili: Mwombeni Bwana mvua wakati wa vuli; ndiye Bwana atengenezaye mawingu ya tufani. Huwapa watu manyunyu ya mvua, pia mimea ya shambani kwa ajili ya kila mtu.

english: I will bring them back from Egypt and gather them from Assyria. I will bring them to Gilead and Lebanon until no more room is found for them.
ekegusii: Nimbairanie inka korwa ase ense ya Misiri, nimbasangererie korwa ase ense y’Asuri; mbabeeke ase ense ya Gileadi na ase Lebanoni, mbaichore aroro goika baborwe aase bakomenya.
swahili: Nitawarudisha kutoka Misri na kuwakusanya toka Ashuru. Nitawaleta katika nchi ya Gileadi na Lebanoni, na hapo hapatakuwa na nafasi ya kuwatosha.

english: They will pass through the sea of distress and strike the waves of the sea; all the depths of the Nile will dry up. The pride of Assyria will be brought down, and the scepter of Egypt will depart.
ekegusii: Ekero baraete ase egati y’enyancha y’emechando, inche Omonene ning’ake emerindo yaye, ne chindiba chionsi chi’orooche rwa Naeli nchikame; na igo oboenenu bw’Abaasuri mbotiringerwe inse, na enyimbo y’obogambi ya Misiri nesirigwe.
swahili: Watapita katika bahari ya mateso; bahari iliyochafuka itatulizwa na vilindi vyote vya Mto Naili vitakauka. Kiburi cha Ashuru kitashushwa, nayo fimbo ya utawala ya Misri itatoweka.

english: I will strengthen them in the LORD, and in His name they will walk,” declares the LORD.
ekegusii: Inche nimbeke abanto baane chinguru ime yane inche Omonene, barabwo mbabe bagotaara ase erieta riane.” Omonene okwanire ayio.
swahili: Nitawaimarisha katika Bwana, na katika jina lake watatembea,” asema Bwana.

english: For idols speak deceit and diviners see illusions; they tell false dreams and offer empty comfort. Therefore the people wander like sheep, oppressed for lack of a shepherd.
ekegusii: Ebinyasae bire ase chinyomba nigo bigokwana amang’ana are bosa, na amaroro ’abaringoria nay’oborimo. Abaroti chindoto nigo bagokwana chindoto chi’obong’ainereria, na baremia abande ase okoremia kwa bosa. Ase engencho eyio abanto nigo bagotayaya buna riicho rie ching’ondi, bachandegete, ekiagera tibabwati omorisia.
swahili: Sanamu huzungumza udanganyifu, waaguzi huona maono ya uongo; husimulia ndoto ambazo si za kweli, wanatoa faraja batili. Kwa hiyo watu wanatangatanga kama kondoo walioonewa kwa kukosa mchungaji.

english: “My anger burns against the shepherds, and I will punish the leaders. For the LORD of Hosts attends to His flock, the house of Judah; He will make them like His royal steed in battle.
ekegusii: “Endamwamu yane nigo egwoka igoro y’abarisia, ning’ee chigoree chiria egesusuro, ekiagera inche Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo ndendete riicho riane nabwo abanto b’enyomba ya Yuda; nindikore ribe ebarasi yane engiya y’esegi.
swahili: “Hasira yangu inawaka dhidi ya wachungaji, nami nitawaadhibu viongozi; kwa kuwa Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote atalichunga kundi lake, nyumba ya Yuda, naye atawafanya kuwa kama farasi mwenye kiburi akiwa vitani.

english: The cornerstone will come from Judah, the tent peg from him, as well as the battle bow and every ruler together.
ekegusii: Rigena ri’ekoona narinyorekane korwa ase abanto abwo. Boigo korwa ase bare ekeroochi ki’eema na obota bw’esegi mbinyorekane, naende kera omogambi nanyorekane korwa ase bare.
swahili: Kutoka Yuda litatokea Jiwe la pembeni, kutoka kwake vitatoka vigingi vya hema, kutoka kwake utatoka upinde wa vita, kutoka kwake atatoka kila mtawala.

english: They will be like mighty men in battle, trampling the enemy in the mire of the streets. They will fight because the LORD is with them, and they will put the horsemen to shame.
ekegusii: Barabwo mbabe buna chituoni chi’esegi, batiringere ababisa babo inse buna eubi ere ase chinchera. Mbarwane, ekiagera inche Omonene nigo inde amo nabarabwo, basookie abariini be chibarasi.
swahili: Kwa pamoja watakuwa kama mashujaa wanaokanyaga barabara za matope wakati wa vita. Kwa sababu Bwana yu pamoja nao, watapigana na kuwashinda wapanda farasi.

english: I will strengthen the house of Judah and save the house of Joseph. I will restore them because I have compassion on them, and they will be as though I had not rejected them. For I am the LORD their God, and I will answer them.
ekegusii: “Ning’ee Abayuda chinguru, ee, nintoorie abanto b’egesaku kia Yusufu. Nimbairanie bamenye inka, ekiagera nabaroreire amaabera; barabwo mbarorekane buna inche konya timbaangeti, ekiagera inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae obo, ninyigwe ogosaba kwabo.
swahili: “Nitaiimarisha nyumba ya Yuda na kuiokoa nyumba ya Yosefu. Nitawarejesha kwa sababu nina huruma juu yao. Watakuwa kama watu ambao sijawahi kuwakataa kwa sababu mimi ndimi Bwana Mungu wao, nami nitawajibu.

english: Ephraim will be like a mighty man, and their hearts will be glad as with wine. Their children will see it and be joyful; their hearts will rejoice in the LORD.
ekegusii: Abanto ba Efraimu mbabe buna chituoni chi’esegi, bagoke ase chinkoro chiabo buna abanyure edivai. Abana babo mbarore ayio, bagoke, mbagokere Omonene ase chinkoro chiabo ime.
swahili: Waefraimu watakuwa kama mashujaa, mioyo yao itafurahi kana kwamba ni kwa divai. Watoto wao wataona na kufurahi, mioyo yao itashangilia katika Bwana.

english: I will whistle for them to gather, for I have redeemed them; and they will be as numerous as they once were.
ekegusii: “Nimbasime, mbasangererie amo, ekiagera nababooririe, na barabwo mbamentekane babe abange buna barenge kare.
swahili: Nitawaashiria na kuwakusanya ndani. Hakika nitawakomboa, nao watakuwa wengi kama walivyokuwa mwanzoni.

english: Though I sow them among the nations, they will remember Me in distant lands; they and their children will live and return.
ekegusii: Nonya nabasiarerete gochia ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku, mbabe bakong’inyora ase chinse chiria chi’aare. Barabwo mbabe moyo amo nabana babo, naende bairane inka.
swahili: Ijapokuwa niliwatawanya miongoni mwa mataifa, hata hivyo wakiwa katika nchi za mbali watanikumbuka mimi. Wao na watoto wao watanusurika katika hatari nao watarudi.

english: Open your doors, O Lebanon, that the fire may consume your cedars!
ekegusii: Aye Lebanoni, igora ebisieri biao, erinde omorero osambe emecharake yao.
swahili: Fungua milango yako, ee Lebanoni, ili moto uteketeze mierezi yako!

english: Next I took my staff called Favor and cut it in two, revoking the covenant I had made with all the nations.
ekegusii: Erio nkaimokia enyimbo eria yane yarenge korokwa “Ogwancherwa”, nkayebuna, na igo ngasaria okobwatana kwane kw’ogotianania okwo konya nakorire nabaanto bonsi.
swahili: Kisha nikachukua fimbo yangu inayoitwa Fadhili nikaivunja, kutangua Agano nililofanya na mataifa yote.

english: It was revoked on that day, and so the afflicted of the flock who were watching me knew that it was the word of the LORD.
ekegusii: Ase ayio okobwatana koria kogasarigwa ase rituko riria, ne ching’ondi chiria chiachandegete, chiria chiansemeretie chikamanya ng’a ring’ana riria riakoretwe nigo riarwete ase Omonene.
swahili: Likatanguka siku hiyo, kwa hiyo wale waliodhurika katika kundi, waliokuwa wakiniangalia wakajua kuwa hilo lilikuwa neno la Bwana.

english: Then I told them, “If it seems right to you, give me my wages; but if not, keep them.” So they weighed out my wages, thirty pieces of silver.
ekegusii: Erio ngateebia abanto baria: “Onye morooche ng’a mbuya, ing’a eng’eria yane; onye taibo, yegache.” Barabwo bakarenga chitaabu chi’echifeta emerongo etato chikaba eng’eria yane.
swahili: Nikawaambia, “Mkiona kuwa ni vyema, nipeni ujira wangu, la sivyo, basi msinipe.” Kwa hiyo wakanilipa vipande thelathini vya fedha.

english: And the LORD said to me, “Throw it to the potter”—this magnificent price at which they valued me. So I took the thirty pieces of silver and threw them to the potter in the house of the LORD.
ekegusii: Omonene aganteebia “Chirute ase omokori chinyongo.” (Rigori eri rinene nakoreretwe nabaanto baria.) Erio nkaimokia chitaabu chiria chi’echifeta emerongo etato, ngachiruta ase enyomba y’Omonene, ase omokori chinyongo oria.
swahili: Naye Bwana akaniambia, “Mtupie mfinyanzi,” hiyo bei nzuri waliyonithaminia! Kwa hiyo nikachukua hivyo vipande thelathini vya fedha na kumtupia huyo mfinyanzi katika nyumba ya Bwana.

english: Then I cut in two my second staff called Union, breaking the brotherhood between Judah and Israel.
ekegusii: Nyuma y’ayio nkabuna enyimbo eria ya kabere yarenge korokwa “Obomo,” na igo ngasaria okoigwana kwarenge ase egati y’Abayuda na Abaisraeli.
swahili: Kisha nikaivunja fimbo yangu ya pili iitwayo Umoja, kuvunja undugu kati ya Yuda na Israeli!

english: And the LORD said to me: “Take up once more the equipment of a foolish shepherd.
ekegusii: Erio Omonene aganteebia, “Bono imokia ebikorero bi’omorisia oyio otagwenereti kende.
swahili: Kisha Bwana akaniambia, “Vitwae tena vifaa vya mchungaji mpumbavu.

english: For behold, I will raise up a shepherd in the land who will neither care for the lost, nor seek the young, nor heal the broken, nor sustain the healthy, but he will devour the flesh of the choice sheep and tear off their hooves.
ekegusii: Rora, nkorenta nde omorisia ase ense eye oyio otari gwechandera ching’ondi echio chigochia gokwa, gose korigia chinsiru, gose korwaria echiabunekire, gose korageria echire buya, korende nigo ararie chinyama chi’echire chinoru na achimiora‐miorie nonya nebitaago biabo.
swahili: Kwa maana ninakwenda kumwinua mchungaji juu ya nchi ambaye hatamjali aliyepotea, wala kuwatafuta wale wachanga au kuwaponya waliojeruhiwa, wala kuwalisha wenye afya, lakini atakula nyama ya kondoo wanono na kuzirarua kwato zao.

english: Woe to the worthless shepherd, who deserts the flock! May a sword strike his arm and his right eye! May his arm be completely withered and his right eye utterly blinded!”
ekegusii: Obobe nobwaye omorisia oyio otagwenereti, oyio ogotiga riicho rie ching’ondi! Tiga omoro oake okoboko kwaye na eriso riaye ria borio. Tiga okoboko kwaye kwome pa, na eriso riaye ria borio riukore kegima!”
swahili: “Ole wa mchungaji asiyefaa, anayeliacha kundi! Upanga na uupige mkono wake na jicho lake la kuume! Mkono wake na unyauke kabisa, jicho lake la kuume lipofuke kabisa!”

english: Wail, O cypress, for the cedar has fallen; the majestic trees are ruined! Wail, O oaks of Bashan, for the dense forest has been cut down!
ekegusii: Aye omotarakwa, rera, ekiagera omocharake oiyerigwe inse. Emete ere nobonene yasirigwe. Inwe emete enga Emealuni ere Basani, rera, ekiagera rinani rinoru riaiyerigwe inse.
swahili: Piga yowe, ee mti wa msunobari, kwa kuwa mwerezi umeanguka; miti ya fahari imeharibiwa! Piga yowe, enyi mialoni ya Bashani, msitu mnene umefyekwa!

english: Listen to the wailing of the shepherds, for their glory is in ruins. Listen to the roaring of the young lions, for the thickets of the Jordan are destroyed.
ekegusii: Tegerera moigwe buna abarisia bakorera bono ekero obonene na obuya bwabo bwasirigwe! Tegerera moigwe buna chindo chinsae chikoruma bono ekero rinani rinoru ria Yorodani riasirigwe! Abarisia babere
swahili: Sikiliza yowe la wachungaji; malisho yao manono yameangamizwa! Sikia ngurumo za simba; kichaka kilichostawi sana cha Yordani kimeharibiwa! Wachungaji Wawili Wa Kondoo

english: This is what the LORD my God says: “Pasture the flock marked for slaughter,
ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene, Nyasae one, agoteeba: “Risia riicho rie ching’ondi echio chiachikeirwe konyenywa.
swahili: Hili ndilo asemalo Bwana Mungu wangu: “Lilishe kundi lililokusudiwa kuchinjwa.

english: whose buyers slaughter them without remorse. Those who sell them say, ‘Blessed be the LORD, for I am rich!’ Even their own shepherds have no compassion on them.
ekegusii: Abanto bagochigora nigo bagochinyenya, tibari korora ng’a mbare nokomocha, na abwo bagochioonia nigo bagoteeba: Omonene atogigwe, ekiagera twenyoreire obonda obonge. Nonya nabarisia babo abanyene tibari gochirorera amaabera.
swahili: Wanunuzi wake huwachinja na kuondoka pasipo kuadhibiwa. Wale wanaowauza husema, ‘ Bwana asifiwe, mimi ni tajiri!’ Wachungaji wao wenyewe hawawahurumii.

english: For I will no longer have compassion on the people of the land, declares the LORD, but behold, I will cause each man to fall into the hands of his neighbor and his king, who will devastate the land, and I will not deliver it from their hands.”
ekegusii: “Bono tinkogenderera kororera abanto b’ense eye amaabera. Naama! Nindue kera oyomo agwe ase okoboko kw’oyomwabo, na ase okoboko kw’omorwoti oye; abarwoti babo mbasarie ense, na inche tingotooria nonya nomonto oyomo korwa ase amaboko abo.” Nabo Omonene agoteeba.
swahili: Kwa kuwa sitawahurumia tena watu wa nchi,” asema Bwana. “Nitawakabidhi kila mtu mkononi mwa jirani yake na mfalme wake. Wataitenda jeuri nchi, nami sitawaokoa kutoka mikononi mwao.”

english: So I pastured the flock marked for slaughter, especially the afflicted of the flock. Then I took for myself two staffs, calling one Favor and the other Union, and I pastured the flock.
ekegusii: Ase ayio nkaba nkorisia riicho rie ching’ondi chiria chiarenge gochia konyenywa, ee, ching’ondi chiria chiachandegete. Nkaimokia chinyimbo ibere, eyemo nkayeroka “Ogwancherwa” na eyende “Obomo”. Erio nkaba nkorisia ching’ondi chiria.
swahili: Kwa hiyo nikalilisha kundi lililotiwa alama kwa kuchinjwa, hasa kundi lililoonewa sana. Kisha nikachukua fimbo mbili, moja nikaiita Fadhili na nyingine Umoja, nami nikalilisha kundi.

english: And in one month I dismissed three shepherds. My soul grew impatient with the flock, and their souls also detested me.
ekegusii: Ngasiria abarisia batato ase omotienyi oyomo. Erio nkagechigwa ne ching’ondi chiane, nachirochio chikangecha.
swahili: Katika mwezi mmoja nikawaondoa wachungaji watatu. Kundi la kondoo likanichukia, nami nikachoshwa nao,

english: Then I said, “I will no longer shepherd you. Let the dying die, and the perishing perish; and let those who remain devour one another’s flesh.” Thirty Pieces of Silver (Matthew 27:3–10)
ekegusii: Erio ngateba: “Inche tinkobarisia inwe rinde. Oyo ogokwa, tiga akwe, na oyo ogosirigwa, tiga asirigwe, na abatigari babe bakorianana.”
swahili: nikasema, “Sitakuwa mchungaji wenu. Waache wanaokufa wafe na wanaoangamia waangamie. Wale waliobakia kila mmoja na ale nyama ya mwenzake.”

english: This is the burden of the word of the LORD concerning Israel. Thus declares the LORD, who stretches out the heavens and lays the foundation of the earth, who forms the spirit of man within him:
ekegusii: Eri n’ering’ana rikong’u ri’Omonene igoro y’Abaisraeli: Aya naro Omonene agoteeba, oyio oramborete igoro chionsi na akabeeka oboroso bw’ense, oyio otongete omoika ime ase omonto:
swahili: Hili ni neno la Bwana kuhusu Israeli. Bwana, yeye azitandaye mbingu, awekaye misingi ya dunia na aiumbaye roho ya mwanadamu ndani yake, asema:

english: Then I will pour out on the house of David and on the people of Jerusalem a spirit of grace and prayer, and they will look on Me, the One they have pierced. They will mourn for Him as one mourns for an only child, and grieve bitterly for Him as one grieves for a firstborn son.
ekegusii: “Ning’umorere abanto b’enyomba ya Daudi, na aba Yerusalemu, omoika bw’amaabera na ogosaba. Ekero barandigererie mbarore oyo babetete babe bakondeera, buna omonto okoreera omwana oye omomoima; mbandeere bare nobororo buna obw’omonto okoreera omwana oye omotangi.
swahili: “Nami nitamiminia nyumba ya Daudi na wakazi wa Yerusalemu roho ya neema na maombi. Watanitazama mimi, yule waliyemchoma. Nao watamwombolezea kama mtu anayemwombolezea mwanawe wa pekee na kusikitika kwa uchungu kama anayemsikitikia mzaliwa wake wa kwanza wa kiume.

english: On that day the wailing in Jerusalem will be as great as the wailing of Hadad-rimmon in the plain of Megiddo.
ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio, ebirero ebirabe ime ya Yerusalemu mbibe ebinene buna ebio biabeete igoro ya Hadadi‐Rimoni agwo ase ense omweya ya Megido.
swahili: Katika siku hiyo kilio kitakuwa kikubwa Yerusalemu, kama kilio cha Hadad-Rimoni katika tambarare ya Megido.

english: The land will mourn, each clan on its own: the clan of the house of David and their wives, the clan of the house of Nathan and their wives,
ekegusii: Abanto b’ense eye mbeumie, kera eamate ase ensemo yaye; eamate y’enyomba ya Daudi ensemo yaye, na abakungu babo ensemo yabo; eamate y’enyomba ya Nathani ensemo yaye, na abakungu babo ensemo yabo;
swahili: Nchi itaomboleza, kila ukoo peke yake, nao wake zao peke yao. Ukoo wa nyumba ya Daudi na wake zao, ukoo wa nyumba ya Nathani na wake zao,

english: the clan of the house of Levi and their wives, the clan of Shimei and their wives,
ekegusii: eamate y’enyomba ya Lawi ensemo yaye, na abakungu babo ensemo yabo; eamate ya Simei ensemo yaye, na abakungu babo ensemo yabo;
swahili: ukoo wa nyumba ya Lawi na wake zao, ukoo wa Shimei na wake zao,

english: “Behold, I will make Jerusalem a cup of drunkenness to all the surrounding peoples. Judah will be besieged, as well as Jerusalem.
ekegusii: “Rora, inche nigo inde ang’e gokora Yerusalemu obe buna egekombe kere nekenyugwa kegotindia ase abanto bonsi bamenyete ase chinsemo chiaye chionsi, boigo nkebanyore Abayuda ekero Yerusalemu orache koboerwa.
swahili: “Nitakwenda kufanya Yerusalemu kuwa kikombe cha kuyumbisha mataifa yote yanayoizunguka. Yuda utazingirwa kwa vita na Yerusalemu pia.

english: On that day, when all the nations of the earth gather against her, I will make Jerusalem a heavy stone for all the peoples; all who would heave it away will be severely injured.
ekegusii: Ekero engaki eyio eraike, ninkore Yerusalemu obe buna rigena ririto ase abanto bonsi; bonsi abarateeme korietweka mbateke chingoma abanyene. Abanto b’ebisaku bionsi bi’ense nabasangererekane amo bayoumokere.
swahili: Katika siku hiyo, wakati mataifa yote ya dunia yatakapokusanyika dhidi yake, nitaufanya Yerusalemu kuwa jabali lisilosogezwa kwa mataifa yote. Wote watakaojaribu kulisogeza watajiumiza wenyewe.

english: On that day, declares the LORD, I will strike every horse with panic, and every rider with madness. I will keep a watchful eye on the house of Judah, but I will strike with blindness all the horses of the nations.
ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio nindutere kera ebarasi omoondoko, na omonto oyeriinete abe ebarimo. Korende nimbe ndigereretie na korenda Abayuda, ekero ndaukorie chibarasi chi’abaanto b’ebisaku.” Nabo Omonene atebiire.
swahili: Katika siku hiyo nitampiga kila farasi kwa hofu ya ghafula, naye ampandaye nitampiga kwa uwazimu,” asema Bwana. “Nitalielekeza jicho langu la ulinzi juu ya nyumba ya Yuda, nami nitawapofusha farasi wote wa mataifa.

english: Then the leaders of Judah will say in their hearts: ‘The people of Jerusalem are my strength, for the LORD of Hosts is their God.’
ekegusii: Erio abagaambi b’egesaku ki’Abayuda mbetebie ase chinkoro chiabo ime: “Abanto bamenyete Yerusalemu nigo babwate chinguru goetera ase Omonene bw’Emeganda, Nyasae obo.
swahili: Kisha viongozi wa Yuda watasema mioyoni mwao, ‘Watu wa Yerusalemu wana nguvu kwa sababu Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote ni Mungu wao.’

english: On that day I will make the clans of Judah like a firepot in a woodpile, like a flaming torch among the sheaves; they will consume all the peoples around them on the right and on the left, while the people of Jerusalem remain secure there.
ekegusii: “Ase engaki eria ninkore abagaambi b’egesaku ki’Abayuda babe buna orogio rore nomorero ogosamba chinko, naende buna ekieri ki’omorero ogosamba emesaima y’amasakwe. Barabwo mbasambe abanto bonsi bamenyete ase chinsemo chiabo chionsi, basirie aande onsi, ensemo ya borio na eya bomosi, korende Yerusalemu nogenderere kobeera ase ore bono.
swahili: “Katika siku hiyo nitawafanya viongozi wa Yuda kuwa kama kigae cha moto ndani ya lundo la kuni, kama mwenge uwakao kati ya miganda. Watateketeza kulia na kushoto mataifa yote yanayowazunguka, lakini Yerusalemu utabaki salama mahali pake.

english: The LORD will save the tents of Judah first, so that the glory of the house of David and of the people of Jerusalem may not be greater than that of Judah.
ekegusii: “Inche Omonene nintoorie obomenyo bw’Abayuda ritang’ani, erinde abanto b’enyomba ya Daudi, na aba Yerusalemu, tibaabaisa gwetogia ng’a mbare nobonene igoro y’Abayuda.
swahili: “ Bwana atayaokoa makao ya Yuda kwanza, ili heshima ya nyumba ya Daudi na wakazi wa Yerusalemu isiwe kubwa zaidi kuliko ile ya Yuda.

english: On that day the LORD will defend the people of Jerusalem, so that the weakest among them will be like David, and the house of David will be like God, like the angel of the LORD going before them.
ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio Omonene nakengere abanto bamenyete Yerusalemu, erinde oyore omworo mono ase egati yabo abe buna Daudi, na abanto b’enyomba ya Daudi babe buna Nyasae, ee, buna omomalaika bw’Omonene oyo obatang’aine.
swahili: Katika siku hiyo, Bwana atawakinga wale waishio Yerusalemu, ili kwamba aliye dhaifu kupita wote miongoni mwao awe kama Daudi, nayo nyumba ya Daudi itakuwa kama Mungu, kama Malaika wa Bwana akiwatangulia.

english: So on that day I will set out to destroy all the nations that come against Jerusalem. Mourning the One They Pierced (John 19:31–37)
ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio ninganie gosiria abanto b’ebisaku bionsi barache korwania Yerusalemu.
swahili: Katika siku hiyo nitatoka kuangamiza mataifa yote yatakayoshambulia Yerusalemu. Kumwombolezea Yule Aliyechomwa Mkuki

english: “On that day a fountain will be opened to the house of David and the people of Jerusalem, to cleanse them from sin and impurity.
ekegusii: “Ekero engaki eyio eraike, ensoko netuboke ase abanto b’enyomba ya Daudi, na ase abanto ba Yerusalemu, erinde basibigwe korwa ase ebibe biabo, na ogotacheneka kwabo.
swahili: “Katika siku hiyo, chemchemi itafunguliwa kwa nyumba ya Daudi na wakazi wa Yerusalemu, kuwatakasa dhambi na unajisi.

english: And on that day, declares the LORD of Hosts, I will erase the names of the idols from the land, and they will no longer be remembered. I will also remove the prophets and the spirit of impurity from the land.
ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio ninsirie amarieta ’emegwekano egosasimwa ase ense eye, tagwatorwa naende nonya ng’ake. Boigo nindusie ababani amo n’Omoika bw’ogotacheneka korwa aiga.” Nabo Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteeba.
swahili: “Katika siku hiyo, nitayakatilia mbali majina ya sanamu kutoka nchi, nayo hayatakumbukwa tena,” asema Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote. “Nitaondoa manabii wao pamoja na roho ya uchafu katika nchi.

english: And if anyone still prophesies, his father and mother who bore him will say to him, ‘You shall not remain alive, because you have spoken falsely in the name of the LORD.’ When he prophesies, his father and mother who bore him will pierce him through.
ekegusii: Nigo erabe ng’a omonto aise kooroka kobana, ng’ina na ise abwo bamoiborete bamoteebie, “Aye tokonyara koba moyo, ekiagera nigo okobana oborimo ase erieta ri’Omonene.” Ekero omonto oyio agendererete kobana, abaibori abwo baye mbamobete ritimo.
swahili: Ikiwa yupo yeyote atakayeendelea kutabiri, baba yake na mama yake waliomzaa watamwambia, ‘Ni lazima ufe, kwa sababu umesema uongo kwa jina la Bwana.’ Atakapotabiri, wazazi wake mwenyewe watampasua tumbo.

english: And on that day every prophet who prophesies will be ashamed of his vision, and he will not put on a hairy cloak in order to deceive.
ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio kera omobani nabe nobosooku ase amaroro aye ekero akobana; gose onde takobeeka eganchwa eroiseirie amarionya ase okong’aina abanto.
swahili: “Katika siku hiyo, kila nabii ataaibika kwa maono ya unabii wake. Hatavaa vazi la kinabii la nywele ili apate kudanganya watu.

english: He will say, ‘I am not a prophet; I work the land, for I was purchased as a servant in my youth. ’
ekegusii: Kera oyomo obo nigo arakane atebe: Inche tindi omobani, korende nigo inde omoremi, ekiagera korwa obwana bwane nigo nagoretwe ngakorwa omosomba.
swahili: Atasema, ‘Mimi sio nabii. Mimi ni mkulima; ardhi imekuwa kazi yangu tangu ujana wangu.’

english: If someone asks him, ‘What are these wounds on your chest?’ he will answer, ‘These are the wounds I received in the house of my friends.’ The Shepherd Struck, the Sheep Scattered (Matthew 26:31–35; Mark 14:27–31)
ekegusii: Omonto karamoborie, “Ng’ai kwanyorete ebimanyererio ebi bie chingoma bire ase amaboko ao?” Ere nairanerie, “Ebi nigo nabinyorete korwa ase enyomba y’abwo inyanchete.” Ogochika kw’ogoita omorisia o Nyasae
swahili: Ikiwa mtu atamuuliza, ‘Majeraha haya yaliyo mwilini mwako ni ya nini?’ Atajibu, ‘Ni majeraha niliyoyapata katika nyumba ya rafiki zangu.’ Mchungaji Apigwa, Nao Kondoo Watawanyika

english: Awake, O sword, against My Shepherd, against the man who is My Companion, declares the LORD of Hosts. Strike the Shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered, and I will turn My hand against the little ones.
ekegusii: Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo agoteeba iga: “Aye omoro, imoka orwanie omorisia one, oyio ore oyomo nainche. Aka omorisia oyio, erinde ching’ondi chiserebekane; erio inche ing’onchore okoboko kwane igoro ya chiria chire chindeu.”
swahili: “Amka, ee upanga, dhidi ya mchungaji wangu, dhidi ya mtu aliye karibu nami!” asema Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote. “Mpige mchungaji, nao kondoo watatawanyika, nami nitageuza mkono wangu dhidi ya walio wadogo,

english: And in all the land, declares the LORD, two-thirds will be cut off and perish, but a third will be left in it.
ekegusii: Ee, inche Omonene nigo ngoteeba iga: “Nigo erabe ng’a chinsemo ibere ase isato chi’abwo bamenyete ase ense eria mbaitwe basirigwe, korende ensemo eyemo y’abwo netigare ere moyo.
swahili: katika nchi yote,” asema Bwana, “theluthi mbili watapigwa na kuangamia; hata hivyo theluthi moja watabaki ndani yake.

english: This third I will bring through the fire; I will refine them like silver and test them like gold. They will call on My name, and I will answer them. I will say, ‘They are My people,’ and they will say, ‘The LORD is our God.’”
ekegusii: Abanto b’ensemo eyio eyemo ya isato nimbaetie ase omorero ime, mbasibie buna efeta egosibigwa, na mbateeme buna etaabu egoteemwa. Barabwo mbarangerie erieta riane ng’a batoorigwe, na inche nimbaigwe. Inche nintebe: Abanto abwo nabaane. Barabwo mbairanerie: Omonene nere Nyasae oito.”
swahili: Hii theluthi moja nitaileta katika moto; nitawasafisha kama fedha isafishwavyo na kuwajaribu kama dhahabu. Wataliitia Jina langu nami nitawajibu; nitasema, ‘Hawa ni watu wangu,’ nao watasema, ‘ Bwana ni Mungu wetu.’ ”

english: Behold, a day of the LORD is coming when your plunder will be divided in your presence.
ekegusii: Rora, rituko ri’Omonene ngocha rire, ekero ebinto biaino birasakorwe biatananerwe agwo ase egati yaino.
swahili: Siku ya Bwana inakuja ambayo nyara zilizotekwa kwenu zitagawanywa miongoni mwenu.

english: All the land from Geba to Rimmon south of Jerusalem will be turned into a plain, but Jerusalem will be raised up and will remain in her place, from the Benjamin Gate to the site of the First Gate to the Corner Gate, and from the Tower of Hananel to the royal winepresses.
ekegusii: Ekero ekio ense eye yonsi neonchorwe ebe ense omweya korwa Geba goika Rimoni, Irianyi ya Yerusalemu. Korende Yerusalemu oro nogenderere kobeera igoro agwo aase aye, korwa ase Egeita kia Benjamini goika ase Egeita kie Ritang’ani, na goika ase Egeita gi’Ekoona, na korwa ase Omorobiri bwa Hananeli goika ase ebimitero bi’edivai bi’omorwoti.
swahili: Nchi yote kuanzia Geba, kaskazini mwa Yuda, hadi Rimoni, kusini mwa Yerusalemu, itakuwa kama Araba. Lakini Yerusalemu utainuliwa juu na kubaki mahali pake, toka Lango la Benyamini hadi mahali pa Lango la Kwanza, mpaka kwenye Lango la Pembeni na kutoka Mnara wa Hananeli hadi kwenye mashinikizo ya divai ya mfalme.

english: People will live there, and never again will there be an utter destruction. So Jerusalem will dwell securely.
ekegusii: Abanto mbamenye Yerusalemu, okoragererigwa tigokobao, ekiagera omochie oyio nigo orabe n’obotoereru.
swahili: Utakaliwa na watu, kamwe hautaharibiwa tena, Yerusalemu utakaa salama.

english: And this will be the plague with which the LORD strikes all the peoples who have warred against Jerusalem: Their flesh will rot while they stand on their feet, their eyes will rot in their sockets, and their tongues will rot in their mouths.
ekegusii: Amaakwa aya naro Omonene ararue ase abanto abwo bonsi barache korwania abanto ba Yerusalemu: Chinyama chi’emebere yabo nchigunde ekero bagendererete gotenena namagoro abo, na amaiso abo nagunde ekero are ase chinyongo chiabo ime, ne chimeme chiabo inachigunde ase emenwa yabo ime.
swahili: Hii ndiyo tauni ambayo Bwana atapiga nayo mataifa yote ambayo yalipigana dhidi ya Yerusalemu: Nyama ya miili yao itaoza wangali wamesimama kwa miguu yao, macho yao yataoza kwenye matundu yake na ndimi zao zitaoza vinywani mwao.

english: On that day a great panic from the LORD will come upon them, so that each will seize the hand of another, and the hand of one will rise against the other.
ekegusii: Ase engaki eyi’Omonene nabarentere obotantanu, abanto mbaonchokerane, baitane kera oyomo noyomwabo.
swahili: Katika siku hiyo Bwana atawatia wanaume hofu kuu. Kila mwanaume atakamata mkono wa mwenzake nao watashambuliana.

english: Judah will also fight at Jerusalem, and the wealth of all the surrounding nations will be collected—gold, silver, and apparel in great abundance.
ekegusii: Nonya n’Abayuda mbarwanie abanto ba Yerusalemu. Obotenenku obonge bwe chitaabu, ne chifeta, ne chianga, mbosangererigwe korwa ase abanto b’ebisaku bionsi bamenyete ase chinsemo chionsi.
swahili: Yuda pia atapigana katika Yerusalemu. Utajiri wa mataifa yote yanayoizunguka Yerusalemu utakusanywa, wingi wa dhahabu, fedha na nguo.

english: And a similar plague will strike the horses and mules, camels and donkeys, and all the animals in those camps. All Nations Will Worship the King (Leviticus 23:33–44; Nehemiah 8:13–18)
ekegusii: Amaakwa amabe buna ayio nache boigo ase chibarasi, ne chibarasi, ne chingamia, ne chitigere, ne ching’iti chinde chionsi chire ase ebitwori biabo.
swahili: Tauni ya aina iyo hiyo itapiga farasi na nyumbu, ngamia na punda, nao wanyama wote walioko kwenye kambi za adui.

english: Then all the survivors from the nations that came against Jerusalem will go up year after year to worship the King, the LORD of Hosts, and to celebrate the Feast of Tabernacles.
ekegusii: Erio omonto onde bwensi oratigare ore moyo korwa ase abanto b’ebisaku abwo bachete korwania abanto ba Yerusalemu nabe ogotiira omwaka ase omwaka gochia gosasiima Omorwoti, nere Omonene bw’Emeganda, naende narende Amatuko Amanene ay’Ebigutu.
swahili: Kisha walionusurika katika mataifa yote ambayo yaliushambulia Yerusalemu watakuwa wakipanda Yerusalemu kila mwaka kumwabudu Mfalme, Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote na kuadhimisha Sikukuu ya Vibanda.

english: And should any of the families of the earth not go up to Jerusalem to worship the King, the LORD of Hosts, then the rain will not fall on them.
ekegusii: Onye abanto b’egesaku kende gionsi kere ase ense bakwanga kogenda Yerusalemu gosasiima Omorwoti, nere Omonene bw’Emeganda, rirorio embura tegotwa ase ense yabo.
swahili: Ikiwa taifa lolote la dunia hawatakwenda Yerusalemu kumwabudu Mfalme, Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, mvua haitanyesha kwao.

english: And if the people of Egypt will not go up and enter in, then the rain will not fall on them; this will be the plague with which the LORD strikes the nations who do not go up to celebrate the Feast of Tabernacles.
ekegusii: Onye abanto ba Misiri tibagotiira gochia aroro gosasiima, nabarabwo nababorwe embura. Ayio naro amaakwa Omonene arae abanto bonsi abatari gotiira gochia korenda Amatuko Amanene ay’Ebigutu.
